english: *yawn* I told you human, I'm not interested in following your Saradomin.
translation: *打哈欠* 我告诉过你了人类，我对追随你的萨拉多明没兴趣。

english: I see you're finally awake!
translation: 我看你终于醒了！

english: Oh, you're a different human than last time. Well, Marimbo is the only goddess for me and you won't persuade me otherwise.
translation: 哦，你和上次那个不一样了。好吧，玛丽姆博才是我唯一的女神，你说破天也没用。

english: You don't have to worry, I'm not a priest. I won't try to convert you to Saradomin.
translation: 你不用担心，我不是祭司。我不会试图让你改信萨拉多明。

english: Although, I'm not all that familiar with Marimbo. Is that the god you worship?
translation: 不过，我对玛丽姆博不太熟悉。那是你崇拜的神吗？

english: Goddess, but yes. All monkeys send their thoughts and prayers to Marimbo.
translation: 是女神，没错。所有猴子都会向玛丽姆博献上他们的思绪和祈祷。

english: I didn't realise monkeys were so religious. You learn something new every day I suppose!
translation: 我没想到猴子这么虔诚。真是每天都能学到新东西啊！

english: Well, if you could start learning how to open this cage that would be appreciated. I've got a job to do.
translation: 好吧，如果你能开始学怎么打开这个笼子就好了。我还有活儿要干。

english: Oh, sure... I'll get right on it. But it might take me a while to figure it out.
translation: 哦，当然……我马上就去。不过搞清楚怎么开可能得花点时间。

english: This is the Barbarian Assault arena.
translation: 这就是野蛮人突袭竞技场。

english: It was established as a battleground to fight a race of creatures called the 'Penance'. The Penance have been created upon this planet by the gods. You see, we have performed many dishonourable deeds over the years
translation: 这里被建立为一个战场，用来对抗一种名为'忏悔者'的生物种族。忏悔者是众神在这个星球上创造出来的。你看，这些年来我们犯下了许多不光彩的行为，

english: and it's for this that the gods have created these creatures on Gielinor.
translation: 正因如此，众神才在吉莱诺尔创造了这些生物。

english: Really? How can you be sure?
translation: 真的吗？你怎么能确定？

english: Quiet, you piteous-pool-of-black-dragon-dribble!
translation: 闭嘴，你这可怜巴巴的黑龙口水坑！

english: We never question what is fact.
translation: 我们从不质疑事实。

english: What was I saying...?
translation: 我刚才说到哪了……？

english: Oh yes, we have established this place for all to pay their debt to the gods, through combat. For this is the only true honour.
translation: 哦对了，我们建立这个地方，是为了让所有人通过战斗向众神偿还他们的罪孽。因为这才是唯一的真正荣誉。

english: Isn't fighting wrong?
translation: 战斗难道不是错误的吗？

english: What...?
translation: 什么……？

english: Just ignore me, I don't really know what I'm saying.
translation: 别理我，我自己都不知道在说什么。

english: Exactly. Well, in the arena below you can fight the Penance in teams of five players and, if you make it through nine waves of these monsters, we will pit you against their Queen. You can go through these waves
translation: 没错。嗯，在下面的竞技场里，你可以五人组队对抗忏悔者，如果能挺过九波这些怪物，我们就会让你挑战它们的女王。你可以

english: as many times as you wish.
translation: 随意重复挑战这些波次。

english: You will notice a ladder in the centre of this room. If you go down it you will find the briefing rooms. It's within these that you can sign up a team of four other players to enter the game with.
translation: 你会注意到这个房间中央有一个梯子。下去之后你会找到简报室。你可以在那里招募另外四名玩家组队加入游戏。

english: Heading down the ladder...
translation: 走下梯子……

english: You will notice there are ten numbered rooms - one for each wave of Penance you can fight - so you should go and stand in the wave room that you wish to start on, so long as you have reached that level.
translation: 你会注意到有十个编号的房间——每个对应你可以挑战的一波忏悔者——所以你应该去你想开始的波次房间站好，前提是你已经达到了那个等级。

english: There are tables within each room from which you can pick up a scroll. Simply select 'use' on this scroll, then click on another player. You need to get the signature of four other members you want in your team.
translation: 每个房间里都有桌子，你可以从上面拿起一张卷轴。只需选择'使用'这张卷轴，然后点击另一名玩家。你需要获得你想要组队的其他四名成员的签名。

english: Alternatively you can join someone else's team if they use the scroll on you.
translation: 或者，如果别人对你使用卷轴，你也可以加入他们的队伍。

english: With a full team enlisted, add your name to the scroll by right-clicking and selecting 'Write-role', then proceed down one of the ladders to start a game. Note that you need to have 'Accept Aid' on to be signed up.
translation: 队伍满员后，右键点击卷轴并选择'写入-角色'来添加你的名字，然后走下其中一个梯子开始游戏。请注意，你需要开启'接受援助'才能被招募。

english: You will also notice an additional larger room. In there, you don't have to sign up people to play with, just enter, and when there are enough people, we will start a game for you.
translation: 你还会注意到一个额外的大房间。在那里，你不需要招募玩家一起玩，直接进入，当人数足够时，我们会为你开始一局游戏。

english: Going down the ladder from a recruitment room, this is the arena in which you shall be fighting.
translation: 从招募房间走下梯子，这就是你们将要战斗的竞技场。

english: Once you have entered the battle, your task depends on which of the four roles you have chosen: Attacker, Defender, Collector or Healer. I will explain these roles shortly.
translation: 一旦进入战斗，你的任务取决于你选择的四个角色之一：攻击者、防御者、收藏家或治疗者。我稍后会解释这些角色。

english: Each role is provided with a different piece of information in their interface. This information must be communicated to other members of your team using a horn, which we shall provide...
translation: 每个角色的界面都会提供不同的信息。这些信息必须通过我们提供的号角传达给你队伍的其他成员……

english: The Penance use a form of telepathic communication, which one of our elders has managed to tap into and relay to anyone. You are rewarded 'Honour Points' dependant on how well you fight, which can later be
translation: 忏悔者使用一种心灵感应交流方式，我们的一位长者成功截获了这种信号并将其转播给所有人。根据你的战斗表现，你会获得'荣誉点数'，之后可以

english: exchanged for rewards.
translation: 用来兑换奖励。

english: Starting the game, all players are given an icon to show what role they are playing. If you choose to be an Attacker, you will find yourself with a red symbol around your feet.
translation: 游戏开始时，所有玩家都会获得一个图标来显示他们扮演的角色。如果你选择成为攻击者，你的脚下会出现一个红色符号。

english: The Attacker can use melee, ranged or magic to attack the...
translation: 攻击者可以使用近战、远程或魔法来攻击……

english: ...Penance Fighters...
translation: ……忏悔者战士……

english: ...and the Penance Rangers.
translation: ……和忏悔者射手。

english: These monsters have an intuitive defensive system that allows them to protect against different types of attack. This is good for them, but bad for you.
translation: 这些怪物拥有直觉性的防御系统，可以保护自己免受不同类型的攻击。这对它们有好处，但对你们来说就糟糕了。

english: You will need to adopt one of four different fighting stances to overcome the Penance, which can be accessed via the combat menu.
translation: 你需要采用四种不同的战斗姿态之一来克服忏悔者，这可以通过战斗菜单来切换。

english: If you attack in the wrong stance, your attacks will backfire against you.
translation: 如果你用错了姿态攻击，你的攻击会反噬你自己。

english: The stance you are supposed to use will be displayed in the interface at the top right corner, next to the 'ear' icon - this is the information you last heard from the Collector.
translation: 你应该使用的姿态会显示在右上角的界面中，就在'耳朵'图标旁边——这是你上次从收藏家那里听到的信息。

english: In this role, you are also responsible for telling the Collector what they have to do. Use the horn we give you to call out what is displayed next to the 'mouth' icon.
translation: 在这个角色中，你还要负责告诉收藏家他们需要做什么。使用我们给你的号角，喊出'嘴巴'图标旁边显示的内容。

english: So, to recap: DO what is next to the EAR icon; SHOUT out what is next to the MOUTH icon.
translation: 所以，总结一下：做耳朵图标旁边的事；喊出嘴巴图标旁边的内容。

english: Shouting out updates the other players' interfaces, so you need to make sure you regularly shout out the information next to the mouth. You will also see the current wave you are on and the role you are working
translation: 喊话会更新其他玩家的界面，所以你需要确保定期喊出嘴巴旁边的信息。你还会看到当前所在的波次以及你正在扮演的角色。

english: with.
translation: 角色。

english: You can get all the runes and arrows you could possibly need from the Attacker machine near the room's entrance - the machine with a red 'sword' symbol on it.
translation: 你可以从房间入口附近带有红色'剑'符号的攻击者机器那里，获取你可能需要的所有符咒和箭矢。

english: You may want to check out the statues of the Penance Ranger and Penance Fighter near the entrance. It may give you a better idea of what you are up against when playing as an Attacker.
translation: 你可能想看看入口附近的忏悔者射手和忏悔者战士的雕像。这可能会让你在扮演攻击者时，更好地了解你将面对什么。

english: If you're a Defender, you will find yourself with the blue symbol around your feet.
translation: 如果你是防御者，你的脚下会出现一个蓝色符号。

english: As the Defender, you will have to stop the Penance Runners.
translation: 作为防御者，你必须阻止忏悔者跑手。

english: These Penance Runners will start off at the far north end of the arena and make their way to the south end. This is a trick we are playing on them - luring them with the smell of their Queen - to test you.
translation: 这些忏悔者跑手会从竞技场的最北端出发，一路向南移动。这是我们给它们设下的圈套——用它们女王的气味引诱它们——来考验你们。

english: As the Defender, the only way to stop these Penance is to lure them towards traps on the floor. There is one each at the east and west edges of the arena.
translation: 作为防御者，阻止这些忏悔者的唯一方法是将它们引诱到地板上的陷阱里。竞技场的东侧和西侧各有一个陷阱。

english: You can lure them with a selection of food that's available from the Defender machine near the room's entrance - the machine with a blue 'shield' symbol on it. There are different types of food that you must drop
translation: 你可以用从房间入口附近带有蓝色'盾牌'符号的防御者机器那里获取的精选食物来引诱它们。有不同类型的食物，你必须将它们丢在忏悔者跑手附近的地板上，最后再在陷阱旁边丢下一块。

english: on the floor in their vicinity, before finally dropping a piece next to the trap.
translation: 将它们丢在忏悔者跑手附近的地板上，最后再在陷阱旁边丢下一块。

english: The type of food you are supposed to use (worms, tofu or crackers) will be displayed in the interface at the top right corner, next to the 'ear' icon. This is transmitted to you by the Healer.
translation: 你应该使用的食物类型（蠕虫、豆腐或拉炮）会显示在右上角的界面中，就在'耳朵'图标旁边。这是由治疗者传达给你的。

english: The type of food changes as the Penance Runners wisen to your tactics, and if you use the wrong food type, the Penance Runners will discover your plans and head back from where they came. In this role, you
translation: 随着忏悔者跑手对你的战术变得警觉，食物类型会发生变化，如果你使用了错误的食物类型，忏悔者跑手会发现你的计划并掉头返回。在这个角色中，你还要负责告诉治疗者他们需要的信息。

english: will also be responsible for telling the Healer the information they need. Simply use the horn we give you to call out what is next to the 'mouth' symbol.
translation: 还要负责告诉治疗者他们需要的信息。只需使用我们给你的号角，喊出'嘴巴'符号旁边的内容。

english: Unfortunately, the traps don't last forever. You must fix them with the materials to the north.
translation: 不幸的是，陷阱不会永远持续。你必须用北边的材料来修复它们。

english: You can also use these materials to build barricades over the cave entrances to slow down the Penance.
translation: 你也可以用这些材料在洞穴入口处建造路障，以减缓忏悔者的速度。

english: Have a look at the statue of the Penance Runner near the entrance, if you want to learn a little more about these strange creatures.
translation: 如果你想多了解这些奇怪的生物，可以看看入口附近的忏悔者跑手雕像。

english: By choosing to be a Collector, you'll find yourself with a yellow symbol.
translation: 选择成为收藏家，你的脚下会出现一个黄色符号。

english: In the Collector role, you must pick up eggs that are dropped by defeated Penance. You can only hold so many at a time, but you can temporarily store them in a bag that we will provide you with when you enter.
translation: 在收藏家角色中，你必须捡起被击败的忏悔者掉落的蛋。你一次只能携带有限的数量，但你可以暂时将它们存放在我们进入时提供给你的袋子里。

english: You must then take these eggs, and load them into the launchers up on the podiums, so they can be fired at the Penance. There are three types of egg: explosive, poison and stun.
translation: 然后你必须把这些蛋装入讲台上的蛋发射器中，这样它们就能被发射向忏悔者。有三种类型的蛋：爆炸蛋、毒蛋和眩晕术蛋。

english: It's not quite as simple as that, though, because you can only pick up eggs of a certain colour at a certain time. This is because they have a special defence mechanism and will explode upon being touched.
translation: 不过，事情没那么简单，因为你只能在特定时间捡起特定颜色的蛋。这是因为它们有一种特殊的防御机制，一碰就会爆炸。

english: The correct colour will be displayed in the interface at the top right corner, next to the 'ear' icon. This is communicated to you by the Attacker. You will also be responsible for telling the Attacker what type of stance
translation: 正确的颜色会显示在右上角的界面中，就在'耳朵'图标旁边。这是由攻击者传达给你的。你还要负责通过喊出'嘴巴'图标旁边的内容，

english: to use, by calling out what is next to the 'mouth' icon. So, to recap: DO what is next to the EAR symbol; SHOUT what is next to the MOUTH symbol.
translation: 使用方法是喊出'嘴'图标旁边的内容。所以，总结一下：做'耳'图标旁边的事；喊出'嘴'图标旁边的事。

english: I suggest you have a look at the statues of the various Penance, at the entrance to this arena. It may give you a better idea of what you'll be trying to avoid as you collect eggs, if you choose to be a Collector.
translation: 我建议你看看竞技场入口处各种忏悔者的雕像。如果你选择成为收藏家，这可能会让你更好地了解在收集蛋时你需要避开什么。

english: By choosing to be a Healer, you will have a green circle around your feet. As a Healer, your job is to heal players and poison...
translation: 选择成为治疗者，你的脚下会出现一个绿色圆圈。作为治疗者，你的工作是治疗玩家并毒害……

english: ...the Penance healers. Look at those nasty teeth! They will heal their own kind and poison your team mates.
translation: ……忏悔者治疗者。看看那些恶心的牙齿！它们会治疗自己的同类并毒害你的队友。

english: You can get vials from the Healer machine near the room's entrance - the machine with a green 'star' symbol on it. These vials can be used with the nearby spring...
translation: 你可以从房间入口附近带有绿色'星星'符号的治疗者机器那里获取小瓶。这些小瓶可以在附近的泉水处……

english: ...to fill up and create a special healing potion for use on other players.
translation: ……装满，制成一种特殊的治疗药水，用于其他玩家。

english: The dispenser also gives poisoned food that you can use on the Penance Healers. There are three kinds of this poisoned food that you can use - tofu, worms and meat.
translation: 分配器还会提供有毒食物，你可以用来对付忏悔者治疗者。有三种有毒食物可以使用——豆腐、蠕虫和肉。

english: The type to use will be displayed on the interface at the top right, next to the 'ear' icon, which is communicated to you by the Defender. You will also be responsible for telling the Defender which type of food they should be
translation: 要使用的类型会显示在右上角的界面中，就在'耳朵'图标旁边，这是由防御者传达给你的。你还要负责通过用号角喊出'嘴巴'图标旁边的内容，

english: using, by calling out with the horn what is next to the 'mouth' icon. So, to recap: DO what is next to the EAR icon; SHOUT what is next to the MOUTH icon.
translation: 使用方法是吹响号角喊出'嘴'图标旁边的内容。所以，总结一下：做'耳'图标旁边的事；喊出'嘴'图标旁边的事。

english: Along the bottom you will see the names of the other players and the state of their health. Keep this in mind and watch out for players that shout for your help.
translation: 在底部你会看到其他玩家的名字和他们的生命状态。记住这一点，并留意那些呼救的玩家。

english: It'd be a good idea for you to take a look at the statue of the Penance Healer near the entrance. It should help you better understand what you would have to do should you choose the role of Healer.
translation: 你最好看看入口附近的忏悔者治疗者雕像。这应该能帮助你更好地理解，如果你选择治疗者角色，你需要做什么。

english: Other than performing the task of your role, there are two other things you can do.
translation: 除了执行你角色的任务外，你还可以做另外两件事。

english: There are two egg launchers in the arena. These are stocked up by the Collector, but can be fired by anyone. Simply click on the launcher, select the type of monster you want to fire at and the egg you want to
translation: 竞技场中有两个蛋发射器。这些由收藏家装填，但任何人都可以发射。只需点击发射器，选择你想攻击的怪物类型和你想发射的蛋

english: fire (assuming there are eggs of that type loaded).
translation: （假设那种类型的蛋已经装填好了）。

english: You will also spot a rather large horn in the corner of the arena.
translation: 你还会在竞技场的角落里发现一个相当大的号角。

english: Anyone can use this to shout out information to people in the arena. Using the horn, you will be shown an interface that will display all the information you need to know.
translation: 任何人都可以用它向竞技场中的人喊话。使用号角时，你会看到一个界面，显示所有你需要知道的信息。

english: So, you will battle through the waves in your given role, earning Honour Points.
translation: 所以，你将按照指定的角色在波次中战斗，赚取荣誉点数。

english: You will notice these blackboards dotted around. You can use these to view your progress as a soldier. You can battle through these waves as many times as you wish.
translation: 你会注意到这些散布各处的黑板。你可以用它们来查看你作为士兵的进度。你可以随意重复挑战这些波次。

english: Also, should you want, there is a bank chest to allow you to stow away any items you don't need while in battle.
translation: 另外，如果你愿意，还有一个银行箱可以让你存放战斗中不需要的任何物品。

english: Let me get something clear. At the start of the First Age, the mighty Guthix placed deposits of runes all around Gielinor for people to use. But this gift simply wasn't enough for some people, and they greedily
translation: 让我把话说清楚。在第一纪元之初，强大的古斯在吉莱诺尔各地放置了符咒矿脉供人们使用。但这个礼物对某些人来说根本不够，他们贪婪地

english: started crafting their own runes.
translation: 开始自己制作符石。

english: We believe in only using those runes that were given to us in the first place. We have one such depository of runes that we have used ever since Guthix's kindness. We won't allow you to use runes that are no doubt
translation: 我们只相信使用最初赐予我们的那些符咒。我们有一个自古斯的恩赐以来一直使用的符咒矿藏。我们不允许你使用那些无疑是你自己

english: created by yourself or some other greedy runecrafter!
translation: 或其他贪婪的符石制作师制作的符石！

english: We also won't let you use any prayers - there is no time to pray! Arrows, too, are provided in the arena, so you had better leave them behind.
translation: 我们也不允许你使用任何祈祷——没有时间祈祷！箭矢也在竞技场内提供，所以你最好把它们留在外面。

english: On the tenth wave you will face the final battle. The dungeon you are placed in is slightly different from the other waves, but you can still perform your normal tasks within the roles of Attacker, Defender, Collector
translation: 在第十波，你将面对最终战斗。你所在的地牢与其他波次略有不同，但你仍然可以在攻击者、防御者、收藏家

english: and Healer.
translation: 和治疗者的角色中执行你的正常任务。

english: After a certain amount of time you will see the deadly Penance Queen. At this point you will need to remove all the other Penance from the room before you can go about tackling the Queen. Hence, it's best to get rid of
translation: 一段时间后，你会看到致命的忏悔者女王。此时，你需要先清除房间里所有其他的忏悔者，然后才能着手对付女王。因此，最好尽快

english: the normal Penance as fast as possible.
translation: 消灭普通的忏悔者。

english: With the Queen, your task will change. The Queen lays a new type of egg - a yellow egg!
translation: 面对女王时，你的任务会改变。女王会产下一种新型的蛋——黄色蛋！

english: The Queen can't be beaten by normal combat or by normal eggs and hence, it is up to you as a team to change these yellow eggs into omega eggs.
translation: 女王无法通过普通战斗或普通蛋来击败，因此，你们团队需要将这些黄色蛋变成欧米伽蛋。

english: The omega eggs can then be launched from the egg launcher back at the Queen!
translation: 然后，欧米伽蛋可以从蛋发射器发射回女王身上！

english: The egg will need to be passed from one person to the next, each person doing something to the egg to prepare it and make it into an omega egg.
translation: 蛋需要从一个人传递给下一个人，每个人都要对蛋做一些处理，将其准备并制作成欧米伽蛋。

english: I shall go through each role to tell you what you will be responsible for. This is a lot to take in but don't worry, I will provide you with a book that will remind you of your task.
translation: 我会逐一介绍每个角色，告诉你各自负责什么。信息量很大，但别担心，我会给你一本书，提醒你的任务。

english: As the Collector, you must pick up the yellow eggs and pass them to the Healer. This you can do by simply selecting 'use' on the egg and then selecting the Healer. You will also have to take the omega eggs from the
translation: 作为收藏家，你必须捡起黄色蛋并将它们传递给治疗者。你可以通过选择'使用'蛋，然后选择治疗者来完成。你还需要从

english: Defender and load them into the launcher.
translation: 防御者那里接过欧米伽蛋，并将它们装填到发射器中。

english: As the Healer, you will be taking the yellow eggs from the Collector...
translation: 作为治疗者，你要从收藏家那里接过黄色蛋……

english: ...and dipping them in the poison pools to create a poisoned yellow egg, before passing them onto the Attacker.
translation: ……并将它们浸入毒池中，制成有毒的黄色蛋，然后再传递给攻击者。

english: As the Attacker, you will be taking the poisoned yellow eggs from the Healer...
translation: 作为攻击者，你要从治疗者那里接过有毒的黄色蛋……

english: ...then attaching spikes, which you can break off from these mushrooms, before passing them on to the Defender.
translation: ……然后装上你可以从这些蘑菇上掰下来的尖刺，再传递给防御者。

english: As the Defender, you will be taking the spiked, poisoned yellow eggs from the Attacker...
translation: 作为防御者，你要从攻击者那里接过带刺的有毒黄色蛋……

english: ...then heating them up in the lava to create an omega egg, before passing it onto the Collector who can then load the egg into the launcher.
translation: ……然后在熔岩中加热它们，制成欧米伽蛋，再传递给收藏家，然后收藏家就可以将蛋装填到发射器中。

english: Then you can fire the egg at the Queen. Just repeat until she dies.
translation: 然后你就可以把蛋射向女王。重复这个过程直到她死亡。

english: Again, don't worry, you will be given a book to remind you of these tasks.
translation: 再说一次，别担心，你会得到一本书来提醒你这些任务。

english: So, would you like a book to remind you of your role?
translation: 那么，你想要一本书来提醒你的角色吗？

english: I don't have enough space to carry one.
translation: 我没有足够的空间拿一个。

english: Well, you can come back and get one from me at any time.
translation: 好吧，你随时可以回来找我拿一个。

english: You may regret that, but remember you can come back and get one from me at any time.
translation: 你可能会后悔，但记住你随时可以回来找我拿一个。

english: At the end of each wave of Penance you will be presented with a score sheet, which will inform you of how you performed as a team and how you performed as an individual.
translation: 在每一波忏悔者结束后，你会看到一张成绩单，告诉你你们团队的表现和你个人的表现。

english: You will be rewarded Honour Points for each individual role (Attacker, Defender, Collector or Healer). You can then spend these Honour Points as you wish with Commander Connad, who you will find in this entrance
translation: 你会根据每个角色（攻击者、防御者、收藏家或治疗者）获得荣誉点数。然后你可以随自己意愿在康纳德指挥官那里花掉这些荣誉点数，他就在这个入口

english: hall. The points you earn in the waves are dependant on how you perform, with a variety of factors counted towards it. You can see all these factors at the end of the wave and, hence, it is worth noting for future
translation: 大厅里。你在波次中获得的点数取决于你的表现，很多因素都会计入。你可以在每波结束时看到所有这些因素，因此值得记下来以便将来

english: attempts.
translation: 尝试时参考。

english: You can unlock special rewards for killing the Penance Queen. You should also take note that there is a maximum of 5000 Honour Points that you can save in each role before you have to go and spend them.
translation: 你可以通过击杀忏悔者女王解锁特殊奖励。另外注意，在你去花掉之前，每个角色最多可以储存5000荣誉点数。

english: That's all I can tell you! You're ready to start your career, soldier!
translation: 我能告诉你的就这些了！你已经准备好开始你的职业生涯了，士兵！

english: Sir! Thank you, sir!
translation: 长官！谢谢您，长官！

english: Feel free to return to me at any time to repeat any of the training. It doesn't hurt to make sure you are totally clear on what you have to do.
translation: 随时可以回来找我重复任何训练。确保你对要做什么完全清楚总没坏处。

english: Let me out! Let me out! When I get out of this crate, I'm going to give that axe merchant a piece of my mind.
translation: 放我出去！放我出去！等我出了这个板条箱，我一定要找那个卖斧头的商人算账。

english: That's exactly why I'm not letting you out. You've caused enough trouble as it is.
translation: 这正是我不放你出去的原因。你已经惹了够多麻烦了。

english: I didn't do anything at all! All I wanted was a monkey-sized battle axe and when I found one, that human started yelling and throwing things at me.
translation: 我什么都没做！我只是想要一把猴子大小的战斧，等我找到了，那个人类就开始大喊大叫，还朝我扔东西。

english: I even offered to pay for it but he wouldn't accept my money.
translation: 我甚至提出付钱，但他不肯收我的钱。

english: I mean you did try to steal his stuff first. Perhaps you should be more honest next time?
translation: 我的意思是你确实先试图偷他的东西。下次也许该更诚实一点？

english: But I'm a paying customer! I have rights! He can't treat me like that!
translation: 但我可是付钱的顾客！我有权利！他不能那样对我！

english: *sigh* If I put in a word with his manager, would that satisfy you?
translation: *叹气* 如果我跟他的经理说句话，这样你满意了吗？

english: Only if I get compensation too!
translation: 除非我也得到补偿！

english: That was a mighty fine banana. Do you have any more?
translation: 刚才那根香蕉真不错。你还有吗？

english: I'm afraid that was the last one I had.
translation: 恐怕那是最后一根了。

english: Oh, that's unfortunate.
translation: 哦，真可惜。

english: You can speak?
translation: 你会说话？

english: And so can you. What's your point?
translation: 你也会啊。你想说什么？

english: I mean, how can you speak? I thought you guys could only say things like 'ook ook'? Is it magic?
translation: 我是说，你怎么能说话？我以为你们只会说'呜嗷呜嗷'？是魔法吗？

english: When we decided to come here and thwart your Humans Against Monkeys operation, we made sure to obtain some amulets of humanspeak so that we could better intimidate you all.
translation: 当我们决定来这里挫败你们那'人类对抗猴子'的行动时，我们确保弄到了一些人类语言护身符，这样就能更好地吓唬你们所有人。

english: I see... can I have your amulet of humanspeak?
translation: 我明白了……能把你的那个人类语言护身符给我吗？

english: Oh... okay then.
translation: 哦……好吧。

english: Ah! Is it gone yet? Did you kill it?
translation: 啊！它走了吗？你杀了它吗？

english: Kill what? Are you okay? What's wrong?
translation: 杀了什么？你还好吗？怎么了？

english: I... I'm not the bravest amongst my friends and when I left the group I saw this huge, creepy, green-skinned creature! I thought it was going to eat me!
translation: 我……我不是朋友里最勇敢的，我离开队伍时看到了一只巨大的、可怕的、绿色皮肤的生物！我以为它要吃了我！

english: Huge... green skinned?
translation: 巨大……绿色皮肤？

english: Oh! You mean a goblin! I suppose they would be quite a bit scarier from your perspective.
translation: 哦！你是说地精！我想从你的视角看它们确实挺吓人的。

english: I... don't know what it is but please just send me back to Ape Atoll. I don't think I am cut out for this.
translation: 我……不知道那是什么，但请把我送回猿猴岛吧。我觉得我不适合干这个。

english: It's okay, you're safe now inside this cage and you'll be back home before you know it.
translation: 没事的，你现在在笼子里很安全，很快就会到家了。

english: I h4ve n4ts
translation: 我有自然符文

english: You sell?
translation: 你卖？

english: Please don't block my line of fire!
translation: 请别挡着我的射击路线！

english: Hey, what are you doing?
translation: 嘿，你在干什么？

english: Something like that, yes. I was just minding my own business, trying to keep those pesky thieves off my stalls, when I heard a strange noise and a scream.
translation: 差不多就是这样。我当时只顾自己的事，想把那些烦人的小偷赶出我的摊位，突然听到奇怪的声响和尖叫声。

english: I went across to see what was going on, but there was a bright purple flash and everything went black. Before I knew what had happened, I was standing in Falador!
translation: 我走过去想看个究竟，但一道亮紫色的闪光闪过，然后一切都黑了。我还没反应过来，就已经站在法拉多城了！

english: No, they were standing behind that old man's door.
translation: 不，他们站在那老头的门后面。

english: It took me ages to get back, and when I arrived I saw there was a huge hole in the bank wall and some of the bankers had been killed!
translation: 我花了很长时间才回来，到的时候看见银行墙上有个大洞，有些银行职员被杀了！

english: You're welcome. Would you like to see my fine selection of seeds?
translation: 不客气。你想看看我精选的种子吗？

english: He really shouldn't leave his door open all day, especially in this neighbourhood - there are thousands of thieves around, and anyone could wander in!
translation: 他真不该整天敞着门，尤其是在这附近——周围有成千上万的小偷，任何人都可能溜进来！

english: Ah, now I can get on with it...
translation: 啊，现在我可以继续了……

english: Could everyone please not move?
translation: 请大家不要动好吗？

english: Hey - you can't come in here!
translation: 嘿 - 你不能进来这里！

english: Uh-oh!
translation: 哎呀！

english: I do wish you'd just stop it!
translation: 我真希望你能停下来！

english: Hey - how'd he get in there?
translation: 嘿 - 他怎么进去的？

english: Hax!
translation: 作弊！

english: My sincerest regrets, dear lady...
translation: 我最诚挚的歉意，亲爱的女士……

english: And also you, sir...
translation: 还有您，先生……

english: How you do that?
translation: 你怎么做到的？

english: Oh dear - another one...
translation: 哦天哪 - 又一个……

english: Ooh - a party hat?
translation: 哦 - 派对帽？

english: Now, my dear...
translation: 现在，我亲爱的……

english: Just give me the money, please.
translation: 请把钱给我就行。

english: Old man, you're for da cage!
translation: 老头，你要进笼子了！

english: Oh, am I?
translation: 哦，是吗？

english: Ahh!
translation: 啊！

english: Aaargh!
translation: 啊啊啊！

english: I'm not after you.
translation: 我不是冲你来的。

translation: 我是来逮捕[player name] V2的。

english: Yah!
translation: 呀！

english: And YOU can stop spying on me!
translation: 还有你，别再偷看我了！

english: Hi there Bert.
translation: 你好，伯特。

english: Huh? What tha doin' in marn ed?
translation: 哈？你在我脑子里干啥呢？

english: This is the voice of your conscience. Hand all your money to [player name]! Wooo wooo!
translation: 我是你良心的声音。把你所有钱交给[player name]！呜——呜——！

english: Be away with ya!
translation: 滚开！

english: Just kidding, I'm just using magic to talk to you. I'm totally 'armless.
translation: 开玩笑的，我只是在用魔法跟你说话。我完全无害。

english: Oh ar. Hey, then why ya standon' so close? Speak in person please!
translation: 哦，是吗。那你干嘛站那么近？请当面说！

english: Oh ar. So wha' do thee want?
translation: 哦，好吧。那你想干啥？

english: Could you hand some sand into my bank?
translation: 你能往我的银行里存些沙子吗？

english: I be a wee bi' busy to 'elp wit' yon sand, come back tomorra.
translation: 我有点忙，没空帮你弄沙子，明天再来吧。

english: Ok Bert, I'll come back for my sand a bit later on then!
translation: 好的，伯特，那我过会儿再来拿沙子！

english: Good day Ghrim!
translation: 你好，格里姆！

english: What? Who is this?
translation: 什么？谁啊？

english: Aha, you've gone crazy, Ghrim. I am your alternate personality... Ghrom!
translation: 啊哈，你疯了，格里姆。我是你的另一个人格……格罗姆！

english: Very amusing, Your Royal Highness. I can see you talking.
translation: 真有趣，陛下。我能看到你在说话。

english: ...Is that you, Your Royal Highness?
translation: ……是您吗，陛下？

english: Er... yes, it is. I'm using magic to communicate with you.
translation: 呃……是的，是我。我在用魔法跟你交流。

english: Very amusing, Your Royal Highness. How can I help you?
translation: 真有趣，陛下。您有什么吩咐？

english: What do you want? Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 你想干嘛？没看见我正忙着吗？

english: What do you want? And why are you using that spell to contact me? I'm literally right here.
translation: 你想干嘛？为什么要用那个法术跟我联系？我明明就在这儿。

english: Hello Lanthus.
translation: 你好，兰苏斯。

english: Be not afraid! I am the all mighty god of all! Bow down before your creator!
translation: 不要害怕！我是万物的全能之神！在你的创造者面前跪下！

english: No you're not. You're standing over there. Leave me alone!
translation: 你不是。你就站在那边。别烦我！

english: Ok ok, I'm bowing, I'm bowing. Don't h...h...hurt me!
translation: 好好好，我跪，我跪。别……别……伤害我！

english: Are you listening to me, Lanthus?
translation: 你在听我说话吗，兰苏斯？

english: I... I am.. how may I h...help y...y...you?
translation: 我……我在……有……有什么事吗？

english: You could just talk to me, you know - I am standing right here.
translation: 你可以直接跟我说话，你知道的——我就站在这里。

english: Oi, I'm just over here - come and talk to me properly.
translation: 喂，我就在这儿——过来好好跟我说。

english: There are [x] juniper logs in the [east/west] burner being converted to juniper charcoal: [x]%
translation: 有[x]根杜松原木正在[east/west]燃烧器中转化为杜松木炭：[x]%

english: The [east/west] burner has converted [x] juniper logs to charcoal, which is ready to collect.
translation: [east/west]燃烧器已将[x]根杜松原木转化为木炭，可以收集了。

english: The [east/west] burner is empty.
translation: [east/west]燃烧器是空的。

english: No, I've got nothing for you in either of my burners.
translation: 不，我两个燃烧器里都没东西给你。

english: We don't know of any gang meetings scheduled at the moment. Try again in a few minutes. Crime never stops in this kingdom.
translation: 我们目前不知道任何帮派集会的时间。过几分钟再试试。犯罪在这王国里永不停歇。

english: I still need [type of clue] from you before I give you a master clue scroll.
translation: 我还需要你提供[type of clue]才能给你一个大师线索卷轴。

english: I've had one of each lower tier clue scroll from you. Come and collect a master clue scroll off me when you're ready.
translation: 每种低阶线索卷轴我都从你那里收过一个了。准备好了就来找我拿大师线索卷轴。

english: I have a master clue scroll for you, but you already have one to complete! Finish it or discard it, I don't care which.
translation: 我有个大师线索卷轴给你，但你已经有一个需要完成了！完成它或者丢弃它，我无所谓。

english: 'Ello again, wherever you are! I see you're drinking like a barbarian - do you want to stop smashing your vials when you finish them?
translation: 嘿，又见面了，不管你在哪里！我看到你喝得像野蛮人一样——你想在喝完小瓶后停止摔碎它们吗？

english: 'Ello again, wherever you are! Do you want me to show you how to smash your vials when you finish drinking them?
translation: 嘿，又见面了，不管你在哪里！你想让我教你喝完药水后怎么摔碎小瓶吗？

english: Keep your foreign magicks out of my head!
translation: 别把你那外来的魔法弄到我脑子里！

english: My Arm hear noise in head.
translation: 我的手臂听到头里有噪音。

english: Go away voice, leave My Arm.
translation: 走开，声音，离开我的手臂。

english: Now that's the most weird conversation I've had in a long time.
translation: 这可是我好久以来最奇怪的一次对话了。

english: Is dat you, [player name]? My Arm can hear you but you not here.
translation: 是你吗，[player name]？我的手臂能听到你，但你不在这里。

english: I'm using magic to talk to you. How's the goutweed?
translation: 我在用魔法跟你说话。痛风草怎么样了？

english: Sorry, [player name], but My Arm not know magic, so My Arm no can reply.
translation: 抱歉，[player name]，但我的手臂不懂魔法，所以我的手臂无法回复。

english: Is dat you, [player name]? Why you talking in My Arm's head?
translation: 是你吗，[player name]？你为什么在“我的手臂”的脑子里说话？

english: I'm using magic to talk to you. How are you feeling about this quest we're doing?
translation: 我在用魔法跟你说话。你觉得我们正在做的这个任务怎么样？

english: I'm using magic to talk to you. How's life in Weiss? Is Snowflake well?
translation: 我在用魔法跟你说话。韦斯过得怎么样？雪花还好吗？

english: Hallo!
translation: 你好！

english: Whoa! A voice in my head! What do you want?
translation: 哇！我脑子里的声音！你想干嘛？

english: I am your evil master!
translation: 我是你的邪恶主人！

english: You're using dark magic to contact me! That is SO evil! What is thy bidding, O Master?
translation: 你在用黑暗魔法联系我！这太邪恶了！敢问主人有何吩咐？

english: Build me an army worthy of Zamorak!
translation: 给我打造一支配得上萨莫拉克的军队！

english: Yes, O master! As soon as I get this summoning thing to work, my army of evil UNDEAD CHAOS ZOMBIE DEMON ASSASSINS OF DARKNESS will overrun the world! Mwuhahahahaaa!
translation: 遵命，主人！等我把这召唤术搞定了，我的邪恶不死混沌僵尸恶魔暗影刺客大军就会横扫世界！呜哈哈哈！

english: Error! Perception mismatch (auditory/visual).
translation: 错误！感知不匹配（听觉/视觉）。

english: Don't worry, Golem! It's [player name]!
translation: 别担心，魔像！是[player name]！

english: I am sorry. I can hear you but not see you. I will have to examine my eyes.
translation: 对不起。我能听到你但看不见你。我得检查一下我的眼睛。

english: No, you can't see me because I'm not there. I'm contacting you by magic!
translation: 不，你看不见我因为我不在那里。我在用魔法联系你！

english: If you are not here then I cannot be hearing you. I will have to examine my ears.
translation: 如果你不在这儿，那我就应该听不到你说话。我得检查一下我的耳朵。

english: Don't worry about it, Golem.
translation: 别担心这个，魔像。

english: What you want Bentnoze?
translation: 你想干啥，弯鼻子？

english: Then who did say something? Who that?
translation: 那刚才是谁在说话？那是谁？

english: It's [player name]! I'm talking to you by magic!
translation: 是[player name]！我在用魔法跟你说话！

english: Bentnoze, [he/she] is here! I hear [him/her] in head!
translation: 弯鼻子，[he/she]在这儿！我听到[him/her]在脑子里！

english: Me not crazy, Bentnose! [He/She] talk to me by magic!
translation: 我没疯，弯鼻子！[He/She]用魔法跟我说话！

english: You shut up Bentnoze! You stupid! You just jealous [player name] talk to me not you!
translation: 你闭嘴，弯鼻子！你真蠢！你就是嫉妒[player name]跟我说话不跟你说话！

english: Shut up Bentnoze! You stupid!
translation: 闭嘴，弯鼻子！你真蠢！

english: SHUT UP!
translation: 闭嘴！

english: Why helloooo!
translation: 哎呀，你好呀！

english: Well this is grand, darling. How nice it is to make your acquaintance!
translation: 这真是太棒了，亲爱的。认识你真是太好了！

english: Oh my, oh my. These youngsters today and their new- fangled gadgets!
translation: 哎呀呀，哎呀呀。现在的年轻人啊，整天搞这些新奇的小玩意儿！

english: Reveal yourself!
translation: 现出真身！

english: Ha, call yourself a Spymaster! You can't see me!
translation: 哈，还自称间谍大师呢！你连我都看不见！

english: Ahh, I'm hallucinating! Must cut back on sq'irks!
translation: 啊，我产生幻觉了！得少喝点斯奎克果汁了！

english: Ha! You can't see me!
translation: 哈！你看不见我！

english: Oh, hello. You sound lovely.
translation: 哦，你好。你的声音真好听。

english: You sound lovely. You have a beautiful...twang to your voice.
translation: 你的声音真好听。你的嗓音有种美妙的……韵味。

english: Twang? It's Romeo, isn't it.
translation: 韵味？你是罗密欧，对吧。

english: May I compare thee to some pineapple chunks?
translation: 我能否把你比作一些菠萝块？

english: No, Romeo. Goodbye.
translation: 不，罗密欧。再见。

english: Blurberry here! Can I help?
translation: 布鲁贝利在此！需要帮忙吗？

english: He he. Yes you can. I'm looking for a Gnome. Gnome Mates.
translation: 嘿嘿，是的。我在找一个地精。地精伙伴。

english: Okay, I'll ask. Everybody shush! Is there a Gnome Mates here? Did anyone come in with Gnome Mates?
translation: 好的，我问问。大家安静！这儿有地精伙伴吗？有人带着地精伙伴进来吗？

english: Ooooh, who is this? I'll get you!
translation: 哦哦哦，这是谁啊？我饶不了你！

english: Hahaha.
translation: 哈哈哈。

english: Thanks. Oh – and be careful in the Wilderness. Tonight is not your night.
translation: 谢谢。哦——在荒野里小心点。今晚不是你的幸运夜。

english: Certainly do! I'm the best darn sandsweeper this side of the Lum.
translation: 当然可以！我是卢姆河这边最好的扫沙工。

english: Yo! Party, party, party!
translation: 哟！派对，派对，派对！

english: Um, Party Pete?
translation: 呃，派对皮特？

english: Yeah! Party's the name, and partying is the game! Actually it's a full-time profession. You can't stop the party.
translation: 耶！派对我名字，派对是游戏！其实是全职工作。你阻止不了派对。

english: Party Pete. Do you ever want to just relax?
translation: 派对皮特。你就不想放松一下吗？

english: Relax, don't do it! Yeah! Party mania! Yeah!
translation: 放松，别这么做！耶！派对狂热！耶！

english: Bye, Party.
translation: 再见，派对。

english: You may leave the party, but the party never leaves you! Party!
translation: 你可以离开派对，但派对永远不会离开你！派对！

english: Ah, Bob! I've been meaning to ask you some questions
translation: 啊，鲍勃！我一直想问你几个问题。

english: Okay, but be quick.
translation: 好吧，但快点。

english: Well, where did you come from? Why do you wander around Gielinor? I've heard lots of rumours about your past!
translation: 嗯，你从哪儿来？为什么你在吉莱诺四处游荡？我听过很多关于你过去的传闻！

english: It's simple really...
translation: 其实很简单……

english: *cough* *cough*.
translation: *咳咳* *咳咳*。

english: *cough* I'm *cough* just...
translation: *咳咳* 我 *咳咳* 只是……

english: Bob! Don't die! Noooooo!
translation: 鲍勃！别死！不不不不！

english: Sorry, I had a hairball.
translation: 抱歉，我咳了个毛球。

english: Euw! That's nasty.
translation: 呕！真恶心。

english: Hey, it's normal. I'm off now!
translation: 嘿，这很正常。我走了！

english: Oh no, Bob, please don't go.
translation: 哦不，鲍勃，求你别走。

english: What? Such insolence! How dare you speak like that, you poor excuse for goblin-dribble!
translation: 什么？如此无礼！你竟敢这么说话，你这连哥布林口水都不如的家伙！

english: Drop and give me twenty!
translation: 趴下，做二十个俯卧撑！

english: Okay, okay. I'm doing them now.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我现在就做。

english: Liar!
translation: 骗子！

english: Wait a minute, I don't have to put up with this. You do twenty!
translation: 等等，我可没必要忍这个。你做二十个！

english: Why I oughtta!
translation: 看我不教训你！

english: Erm, yeah. Bye!
translation: 呃，好吧。再见！

english: It's [player name]. How are you?
translation: 我是[player name]。你还好吗？

english: Fine, thanks. How about you?
translation: 很好，谢谢。你呢？

english: Alchemists return the other day. Me turn them into animals.
translation: 炼金术士那天回来了。我把他们变成了动物。

english: No! Really?
translation: 不会吧！真的吗？

english: Yeah, me made a uniman and a chickalchemist!
translation: 是啊，我造了个独角人（uniman）和小鸡炼金术士（chickalchemist）！

english: Baa, baaaa, BAA!
translation: 咩，咩咩，咩！

english: Wha... what's going on? Is it time to attack the humans yet?
translation: 啥……怎么回事？是不是该攻击人类了？

english: Erm, no, not yet. You can continue sleeping.
translation: 呃，不，还没到。你可以继续睡。

english: Oh... okay then...
translation: 哦……那好吧……

english: Out for the count. It's probably for the best.
translation: 彻底睡过去了。这样大概最好。

english: You lied to me human. While that was a mighty fine banana, it was not the best banana in the world!
translation: 你骗了我，人类。虽然那根香蕉确实很好，但它并不是世界上最好的香蕉！

english: And how would you know? Have you tried every banana in the world?
translation: 你怎么知道？你尝过世界上所有的香蕉吗？

english: Well, no... I suppose not, but I've had better. On Ape Atoll there is a tree which grows red bananas. They are the best!
translation: 嗯，没有……我想没有，但我吃过更好的。在猿猴岛上有一棵树，结着红色的香蕉。那才是最好吃的！

english: Ah, of course. I almost forgot about those. I once had to prepare a stuffed snake using those bananas for King Awowogei.
translation: 啊，当然。我差点忘了那些。我曾经必须用那些香蕉为阿沃盖国王准备一道填馅蛇。

english: Wait? You've worked for our great ruler? I didn't realise we had started employing human chefs. Bring me a banana sandwich immediately!
translation: 等等？你为我们伟大的统治者工作过？我都不知道我们开始雇用人类厨师了。马上给我拿来一个香蕉三明治！

english: Red bananas? Surely you're pulling my leg? There's no such thing.
translation: 红色香蕉？你肯定是在逗我吧？哪有这种东西。

english: What? I'm in this cage. I can't pull your leg.
translation: 什么？我在这个笼子里。我可没法拉你的腿。

english: Erm... never mind.
translation: 呃……算了。

english: Pleased to meet you, I'm [player name]. So, what's wrong with the Council?
translation: 很高兴见到你，我是[player name]。那么，议会出了什么问题？

english: Oh my friend, suspicious is the dish of the day whenever the Council is around. And what I've just told you barely scratches the surface. Things have been getting even worse recently.
translation: 哦，我的朋友，每当议会在附近时，可疑就成了家常便饭。我刚才告诉你的只是冰山一角。最近情况变得更糟了。

english: Do you know of Councillor Sophia Hughes? Lovely lady. Spends her free time with the Disciples of Yama, a wonderful cult of Zamorakian demon summoners.
translation: 你知道索菲娅.休斯议员吗？可爱的女士。她的空闲时间都和阎魔的门徒在一起，一个由萨莫拉克恶魔召唤者组成的奇妙邪教。

english: Councillor Hughes? I was the one who helped imprison her in the first place.
translation: 休斯议员？当初是我帮忙把她关进监狱的。

english: Ah, so you're the adventurer who's been cooking up a storm around here. Well you'll be pleased to know your hard work was all for nothing. Councillor Hughes has escaped. Lucky her.
translation: 啊，原来你就是那个在这里搞得风生水起的冒险者。不过，很高兴地告诉你，你的努力全都白费了。休斯议员已经逃走了。算她走运。

english: Escaped? How?
translation: 逃跑了？怎么逃的？

english: Believe it or not, no one actually knows. The Council is trying to keep it all on the down low of course. Almost like they have something to hide.
translation: 信不信由你，实际上没人知道。议会当然想尽量低调处理。就好像他们有什么要隐瞒似的。

english: That's quite the accusation. Do you have proof?
translation: 这指控可不轻。你有证据吗？

english: Oh, we will soon! Just you give it time. They'll slip up sooner or later.
translation: 哦，我们很快就会有的！你等着瞧吧。他们迟早会露出马脚。

english: Hmm... Rather than just waiting for that to happen, maybe I could investigate her escape.
translation: 嗯...与其干等着，也许我可以调查一下她的逃跑。

english: What an interesting idea. I suppose you would be well placed to have a little nosey, considering your history with the Councillor. Though you'd need to get permission, of course.
translation: 真是个好主意。考虑到你和议员的历史，我想你确实适合去探听一下。不过你当然需要得到许可。

english: I hear the Kourend Royal Guard are leading the investigation. Commander Lydia Fullore is their leader. You'll find her in the castle.
translation: 我听说库兰德皇家卫队正在主导调查。指挥官莉迪亚.富洛尔是他们的领袖。你可以在城堡里找到她。

english: I'll go speak to her.
translation: 我去跟她谈谈。

english: Good luck friend. Your eyes are open now. Don't trust the Council.
translation: 祝你好运，朋友。你现在看清楚了。别相信议会。

english: Well, I think I'll stay out of this one. Good luck with your protest.
translation: 嗯，我想我还是不掺和了。祝你们抗议顺利。

english: As you wish, but you shouldn't be afraid to open your eyes. If you change your mind, we'll be here.
translation: 随你便，但你不该害怕看清事实。如果你改变主意，我们就在这儿。

english: Hey there. Remind me, where can I find Commander Fullore?
translation: 嘿。提醒我一下，我在哪里能找到富洛尔指挥官？

english: She'll be somewhere in the castle.
translation: 她会在城堡的某个地方。

english: Then you're just the person I'm looking for. I'm [player name]. I hear you're the one to talk to about the recent escape of Councillor Hughes.
translation: 那你就是我要找的人了。我是[player name]。我听说你是那个可以谈谈休斯议员最近逃跑的人。

english: Ah, let me guess, you've been talking to Martin Holt?
translation: 啊，让我猜猜，你一直在和马丁.霍尔特谈话？

english: You know him?
translation: 你认识他？

english: Oh, I know him alright. Martin and I have quite the history.
translation: 哦，我当然认识他。马丁和我颇有渊源。

english: Really? He didn't mention it.
translation: 真的？他没提过。

english: He wouldn't. He has a very selective memory. I imagine he also didn't mention that he used to work for the Council that he hates so much.
translation: 他不会提的。他的记性很有选择性。我想他也没提过他曾经为他现在如此憎恨的议会工作过。

english: No... that's not something that ever came up.
translation: 没有...他从没提起过。

english: Well I imagine his Royal Society friends wouldn't make so much of him if they knew where his loyalties used to lie.
translation: 嗯，我想如果他皇家学会的朋友们知道他过去效忠的对象，就不会这么看重他了。

english: So I'm guessing you don't agree with his views on the Council.
translation: 所以我猜你不同意他对议会的看法。

english: Well I wouldn't be very good at my job if I did. Martin is always quick to point out the failings of the Council, but he conveniently forgets about all the good they've done.
translation: 嗯，如果我同意的话，那我就做不好我的工作了。马丁总是急于指出议会的缺点，但他却选择性地忘记了他们所做的一切好事。

english: You know that smell in Port Piscarilius?
translation: 你知道皮斯卡里琉斯港的那股味道吗？

english: It is a bit ripe there.
translation: 那里是有点臭气熏天。

english: Imagine that but ten times worse. That's what it was like before the Council had a new sewage system installed. The entire kingdom is now cleaner and safer because of them.
translation: 想象一下，但比那糟糕十倍。那就是议会安装新的污水系统之前的样子。整个王国现在因为他们而变得更干净、更安全。

english: Not only that, but without the Council, you wouldn't even be stood here. It was under them that trade with your lands to the east was established.
translation: 不仅如此，如果没有议会，你甚至不会站在这里。正是在他们的领导下，与你们东方土地的贸易才得以建立。

english: Without those trade routes, you would have no easy way of getting here.
translation: 没有那些贸易路线，你就没有便捷的方式来这儿。

english: I could go on, but I have more urgent things to attend to.
translation: 我还可以继续说，但我有更紧急的事情要处理。

english: Like the escape of Councillor Hughes?
translation: 比如休斯议员的逃跑？

english: Well, since it's clearly no secret, yes. The former Councillor is a dangerous individual, so I want her back in a cell as soon as possible.
translation: 嗯，既然这显然不是秘密，是的。前议员是个危险人物，所以我希望尽快把她关回牢里。

english: You know, I might be able to help you with that. In case you didn't know, I was the one who helped catch her in the first place.
translation: 你知道，我也许能帮你。如果你不知道的话，起初是我帮忙抓住她的。

english: So, this is what Martin has put you up to! Well, no thank you. The last thing I need is one of his people getting in the way.
translation: 所以，这就是马丁让你干的！嗯，不必了。我最不需要的就是他的人来碍事。

english: I'm not one of his people! I barely know him. I'm just a willing adventurer who wants to help.
translation: 我不是他的人！我几乎不认识他。我只是一个愿意帮忙的冒险者。

english: Think about it. However this investigation goes, you'll be seen as biased towards the Council. I'm a neutral third party with no ties to the Councillor or the protesters. I'm in an ideal position to help out here.
translation: 想想看。无论这次调查结果如何，你都会被看作偏向议会。我是一个中立的第三方，与议员或抗议者都没有关系。我处于理想的位置来帮忙。

english: Hmm... you do have the experience. And I can't deny, the fact that you have the support of the protesters could be useful.
translation: 嗯...你确实有经验。而且我不能否认，你有抗议者的支持这一事实可能很有用。

english: This whole situation with Councillor Hughes has caused enough civil unrest. We certainly don't need it to get any worse.
translation: 休斯议员的整个情况已经引起了足够的内乱。我们当然不希望情况变得更糟。

english: Alright, you can help. But for the duration of this investigation, you're working for me. What I say goes, is that clear?
translation: 好吧，你可以帮忙。但在这调查期间，你为我工作。我说了算，明白吗？

english: Crystal clear. Where do we start?
translation: 非常清楚。我们从哪里开始？

english: Right now we don't have any leads on where Councillor Hughes might have gone. I'm heading over to her home to see if there's anything there that can help us. You should join me.
translation: 目前我们没有任何关于休斯议员可能去哪里的线索。我去她家看看有没有什么能帮到我们的。你应该跟我一起去。

english: Let's get going.
translation: 那我们走吧。

english: Commander Fullore! How wonderful to see you.
translation: 富洛尔指挥官！见到你太好了。

english: Tomas! What are you doing here?
translation: 托马斯！你在这里做什么？

english: Why, I'm here about Sophia Hughes of course! As the person who discovered her corruption in the first place, I was an obvious choice to lead the investigation into her disappearance.
translation: 哎呀，我当然是来这里处理索菲娅.休斯的事！作为最初发现她腐败的人，我显然是领导调查她失踪的合适人选。

english: But that wasn't you! I did all the work!
translation: 但那不是你！所有工作都是我做的！

english: Ah, and hello again, my financially challenged friend! Of course, the capture of Sophia Hughes wouldn't have been possible without your minor contributions.
translation: 啊，又见面了，我经济拮据的朋友！当然，没有你微薄的贡献，抓住索菲娅.休斯是不可能的。

english: The Kourend Royal Guard are conducting the investigation, Tomas. Your presence is not needed.
translation: 库兰德皇家卫队正在进行调查，托马斯。不需要你到场。

english: Well, that's just the thing. Councillor Andrews was so impressed with my work, he put me in charge of this investigation.
translation: 嗯，问题就在这里。安德鲁斯议员对我的工作印象深刻，他让我负责这次调查。

english: That is not his call to make! I'm in charge of Council security. This investigation is mine to lead!
translation: 这不是他能决定的！我负责议会安全。这次调查应该由我领导！

english: He is head of the Council. If he wants to make that call, he can.
translation: 他是议会的头。如果他想做这个决定，他可以。

english: Regardless...
translation: 不管怎样...

english: Look, I can see you're very passionate, which is wonderful. Tell you what, as you're so eager, I'll allow you both to help me in my investigation.
translation: 听着，我看得出你们很热情，这很好。这样吧，既然你们这么着急，我允许你们都来帮我调查。

english: Do join me inside when you're ready.
translation: 准备好了就进来吧。

english: Captain Ginea. I'm guessing Lord Shayzien sent you.
translation: 吉内亚船长。我猜是谢兹恩领主派你来的。

english: He did. He's keen to see this Hughes business sorted quickly.
translation: 是的。他急于看到休斯这件事尽快解决。

english: He's not alone there, but he doesn't need to worry. We have things under control.
translation: 不只是他这么想，但他不用担心。一切都在掌控之中。

english: Forgive me Commander, but it doesn't seem like you do. Hughes escaped from right under your nose, and now Councillor Andrews is putting his faith in Lawry over you.
translation: 恕我直言，指挥官，但看起来并非如此。休斯就在你眼皮底下逃走了，而现在安德鲁斯议员信任劳里而不是你。

english: While this may be Council business, Lord Shayzien is responsible for dealing with both internal and external threats. He wants to be sure that Hughes won't be an issue.
translation: 虽然这可能是议会的事务，但谢兹恩领主负责处理内外威胁。他希望确保休斯不会再成为问题。

english: You have my word. She'll be back in a cell before the day is out.
translation: 我向你保证。今天结束前她就会回到牢里。

english: I hope you're right. There's already a lot of doubt in the Council these days. It would be rather embarrassing for them if the Shayzien Army had to step in.
translation: 希望你是对的。如今议会内部已经有很多怀疑的声音。如果谢兹恩军队不得不介入，那对他们来说会相当尴尬。

english: For someone who supports the Council so much, you don't seem very happy about Councillor Andrews' decision.
translation: 作为一个如此支持议会的人，你似乎对安德鲁斯议员的决定不太高兴。

english: I can support the Council while not agreeing with every choice they make.
translation: 我可以在不支持他们所做出的每一个选择的同时支持议会。

english: I feel like you're not totally being honest with me.
translation: 我觉得你没有完全对我说实话。

english: Would that be so wrong? I hardly know you.
translation: 那有什么错吗？我几乎不认识你。

english: Here's some advice for you: focus on the investigation. Leave the politics to the experts.
translation: 给你一些建议：专注于调查。把政治留给专家。

english: Fine. I guess we'd better get started.
translation: 好吧。我想我们最好开始行动。

english: Have a look around the house and see if you can find any hints on where Councillor Hughes might have gone. I'll ask around out here and see if anyone's seen anything suspicious.
translation: 在房子里四处看看，看看能不能找到任何关于休斯议员可能去哪里的线索。我在这里四处打听一下，看看有没有人看到什么可疑的事情。

english: Good luck. Don't let Lawry get in your way.
translation: 祝你好运。别让劳里妨碍你。

english: I just need to do something first.
translation: 我需要先做点事。

english: Okay, just let me know when you're ready to depart.
translation: 好的，准备好了就告诉我。

english: Are you ready to head over to Councillor Hughes' home?
translation: 你准备好去休斯议员家了吗？

english: Hello again. I hope things are going well.
translation: 又见面了。希望一切顺利。

english: Well, keep up the good work. After all, it would be very awkward for our friends on the Council if you caught Sophia Hughes again.
translation: 嗯，继续好好干。毕竟，如果你再抓住索菲娅.休斯，那可会让我们的议会朋友们很尴尬。

english: Hello again. Your desire to help out with my investigation is to be commended, but you really shouldn't worry. I'll have the former Councillor back in a cell in no time.
translation: 又见面了。你愿意协助我的调查值得称赞，但你真的不必担心。我很快就能把前议员关回牢里。

english: So you already have some leads?
translation: 这么说你已经有一些线索了？

english: Not just yet. It won't be long though. Not with my resourcefulness!
translation: 还没有。不过不会太久的。凭我的聪明才智！

english: Yeah... second only to your humility.
translation: 是啊...仅次于你的谦虚。

english: How very kind of you. I should tell you though, a skillset like mine isn't gained over night. If you wish to become like me, it will take a lot of hard work.
translation: 你真是太好心了。不过我告诉你，像我这样的技能可不是一夜之间获得的。如果你想变得和我一样，需要付出很多努力。

english: I'll keep that in mind. Anyway, I should get back to work.
translation: 我会记住的。不管怎样，我得回去工作了。

english: I've found something that might be useful.
translation: 我找到了可能有用的东西。

english: Oh yes? What is it?
translation: 哦？是什么？

english: Looks like the Councillor might be hiding out at Mount Quidamortem.
translation: 看起来议员可能躲在奎达莫滕山。

english: Mount Quidamortem? That's quite the trek.
translation: 奎达莫滕山？那可真是一段长途跋涉。

english: I could go if you like?
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以去？

english: How very kind of you, but no need. This is my investigation, and I will handle it.
translation: 你真好，但不必了。这是我的调查，我会处理。

english: Sucker.
translation: 傻瓜。

english: I think I know where Councillor Hughes has gone.
translation: 我想我知道休斯议员去哪了。

english: The Farming Guild.
translation: 农业公会。

english: Huh, not where I'd have expected. But maybe that's the point.
translation: 哈，不是我会想到的地方。但也许这就是重点。

english: If you think that's where she is, I'd recommend you go and check it out. I'll keep an eye on things here.
translation: 如果你认为她在那里，我建议你去查看一下。我会在这里盯着。

english: Okay. Where abouts is it?
translation: 好的。在什么地方？

english: North of the River Molch, west of here.
translation: 莫尔奇河以北，这里以西。

english: The Deeper Lode.
translation: 深层矿脉。

english: Seems a risky place for her to go. I'd have thought she'd pick somewhere quieter.
translation: 对她来说那似乎是个危险的地方。我还以为她会选个更安静的地方。

english: If you're sure though, I'd recommend you go and scout it out. I'll keep an eye on things here.
translation: 不过如果你确定，我建议你去侦察一下。我会在这里盯着。

english: It's the pub in Lovakengj, north west of here.
translation: 是洛瓦肯吉城的酒馆，就在这里的西北边。

english: The Little Shop of Horace.
translation: 霍拉斯的小店。

english: You don't think Horace is helping her, do you?
translation: 你不觉得霍拉斯在帮她吧？

english: Well we can't make any assumptions.
translation: 我们可不能妄下结论。

english: True. If that's where you think she is, I suggest you go and check it out. I'll keep an eye on things here.
translation: 说得对。如果你觉得她在那里，我建议你去看看。我会在这里盯着。

english: It's the general store in Hosidius, south east of here.
translation: 是霍西迪乌斯城的杂货店，就在这里的东南边。

english: The Chasm of Fire.
translation: 火焰深渊地牢。

english: That's where most of her cultist friends spend their time, seems a bit obvious.
translation: 她那些邪教徒朋友大多都待在那里，这似乎有点太明显了。

english: I guess it could still be worth a look. If you think she's there, you should go and scout it out. I'll keep an eye on things here.
translation: 我想还是值得去看看。如果你觉得她在那里，就去侦察一下。我会在这里盯着。

english: On the outskirts of Shayzien, west of here.
translation: 在谢兹恩城的郊区，这里的西边。

english: Actually, I don't know.
translation: 其实，我也不知道。

english: Well, keep looking around. There must be something here that can help us.
translation: 那就继续四处找找。这里肯定有什么东西能帮到我们。

english: What was the date when Councillor Hughes escaped?
translation: 休斯议员是什么时候逃走的？

english: It was two days ago, on the 26th of Fentuary.
translation: 是两天前，二月二十六号。

english: Hang on... If she escaped two days ago, why are we only searching her house now?
translation: 等等……如果她是两天前逃走的，为什么我们现在才搜查她的房子？

english: The start of the investigation was... delayed. I can't say any more.
translation: 调查的开始……被耽搁了。我不能再多说了。

english: Did you know there's a demon upstairs?
translation: 你知道楼上有个恶魔吗？

english: A demon? Well I guess the Disciples of Yama are known for that sort of thing. Still, that's going to be a nightmare to deal with. Can it get out?
translation: 恶魔？好吧，我猜阎魔信徒就是以这种勾当闻名的。不过，处理起来将会是一场噩梦。它能逃出来吗？

english: Good. Do your best to avoid it and we'll worry about it later.
translation: 很好。尽量避开它，我们之后再处理。

english: What should I be doing?
translation: 我该做什么？

english: Have a look around the house and see if you can find any hints on where Councillor Hughes might have gone. I'll ask around out here and see if anyone's noticed anything suspicious.
translation: 在房子里四处看看，看能不能找到休斯议员可能去了哪里的线索。我在这附近问问，看有没有人注意到什么可疑的事情。

english: Sounds good. I'll let you know if I find anything.
translation: 听起来不错。我找到什么就告诉你。

english: Hello. I'm looking for Sophia Hughes.
translation: 你好。我在找索菲娅.休斯。

english: Sophia Hughes? The councillor?
translation: 索菲娅.休斯？那位议员？

english: That's right. I think she might have come here at some point.
translation: 没错。我想她可能来过这里。

english: Well, if she did it wasn't recently. We'd have noticed a councillor.
translation: 嗯，就算她来过，也不是最近的事。有议员来的话我们会注意到的。

english: I see. Thanks for the help.
translation: 明白了。谢谢帮忙。

english: Had any councillors shop here recently?
translation: 最近有议员来店里购物吗？

english: Not as far as I can recall. Councillor Hughes used to order things from time to time, before she was arrested. None of the others have ever shopped here though.
translation: 据我所知没有。休斯议员在被捕前偶尔会订购东西。但其他议员从没来过这里购物。

english: Hmm, fair enough.
translation: 嗯，好吧。

english: I'm looking for Sophia Hughes.
translation: 我在找索菲娅.休斯。

english: You are not alone in that, but you will not find her here.
translation: 不止你一个人在找她，但你在这里找不到她。

english: She's one of your lot though, right? This seems like a good place for her to hide.
translation: 但她是你的人，对吧？这里似乎是个藏身的好地方。

english: You are welcome to go in and check. You will find nothing. Sophia Hughes no longer has a place here.
translation: 欢迎你进去检查。你什么也找不到。索菲娅.休斯在这里已经没有位置了。

english: Hmm, if you say so.
translation: 嗯，你说了算。

english: Hello, human. What's your pleasure today?
translation: 你好，人类。今天有什么需要？

english: Had any councillors stay here recently?
translation: 最近有议员在这里住过吗？

english: Councillors? What do you mean?
translation: 议员？你什么意思？

english: I'm investigating the disappearance of Councillor Sophia Hughes. I have reason to believe she rented a bed here.
translation: 我在调查索菲娅.休斯议员失踪的事。我有理由相信她在这里租了张床。

english: A disappearing councillor? That's a new one. We don't really get many humans renting beds here. The only one recently was a woman who stayed here last night, but she didn't look much like a councillor.
translation: 失踪的议员？这倒是新鲜。我们这里很少有租床的人类。最近只有一个女人昨晚住在这里，但她看起来不太像议员。

english: She could have been in disguise. Do you know where this woman is now?
translation: 她可能化了妆。你知道这个女人现在在哪里吗？

english: Well she left not long before you got here. I didn't really speak to her but I did hear her mention something about catching a ship at Port Piscarilius.
translation: 她在你来之前不久刚走。我没怎么跟她说话，但我确实听到她提到要去皮斯卡里琉斯港搭船。

english: A ship? She's trying to escape! Do you know which ship?
translation: 船？她想逃跑！你知道是哪艘船吗？

english: Well let's see now...
translation: 让我想想……

english: Blimy! That was a good one!
translation: 天哪！那一下可真够劲！

english: What on Gielinor was that?
translation: 那到底是什么鬼东西？

english: Ah, not from around here are you? That was an earthquake. We get them here from time to time. I think they come from that volcano to the west, but I'm no expert.
translation: 啊，你不是本地人吧？那是地震。我们这里时不时会有地震。我想是从西边那座火山传来的，不过我不是专家。

english: Anyway, what were we on about?
translation: 总之，我们刚才说到哪了？

english: The Councillor.
translation: 那位议员。

english: Ah yes, the Councillor. I seem to recall her mentioning Veos. It must be his ship she's taking.
translation: 啊，对了，那位议员。我好像记得她提到了维奥斯。她一定是搭他的船。

english: I need to get there quick. Thank you for the help.
translation: 我得赶快过去。谢谢你的帮助。

english: Not a problem. Good luck with your search.
translation: 不客气。祝你搜索顺利。

english: So about the Councillor.
translation: 关于那位议员的事。

english: You again? I've already told you everything. The woman mentioned Veos over at Port Piscarilius. She must be catching his ship.
translation: 你又来了？我已经把知道的都告诉你了。那个女人提到了皮斯卡里琉斯港的维奥斯。她一定是搭他的船。

english: Ah yes. I need to get there quickly.
translation: 啊，对。我得赶快过去。

english: Fuggy: Good luck.
translation: 富吉：祝你好运。

english: Err, where's Veos?
translation: 呃，维奥斯在哪？

english: Your guess is as good as mine. He was here until that earthquake. Then he suddenly just wandered off, like he was in some sort of trance.
translation: 我和你一样不知道。地震前他还在。然后他突然就溜达走了，好像中了邪似的。

english: But what about his ship?
translation: 那他的船怎么办？

english: I guess I'll have to look after it until he comes back. I hope he won't be long. I'm not really cut out for this kind of thing.
translation: 我想在他回来之前我得照看着。希望他不会去太久。我可不擅长这种事。

english: I'm looking for a councillor.
translation: 我在找一位议员。

english: I believe Councillor Sophia Hughes is planning to board this ship. I need to find her.
translation: 我相信索菲娅.休斯议员打算上这艘船。我得找到她。

english: The one that got arrested? If she wants to board the ship she'll need to do it soon. We're nearly ready to cast off. I guess you could wait around and see if she shows up.
translation: 那个被捕的议员？如果她想上船就得快点。我们差不多要起航了。我想你可以在这里等着，看她会不会出现。

english: Hey there! Do you need something?
translation: 嘿！你有什么事吗？

english: Like I said, if she's coming here it will need to be soon. Why don't you wait and see if she shows up.
translation: 就像我说的，如果她要来这里，那得尽快。不如你等等看，看她会不会出现。

english: Your guess is as good as mine. He just suddenly wandered off, like he was in some sort of trance.
translation: 我和你一样不清楚。他突然就走开了，好像陷入某种恍惚状态似的。

english: Camorra? What's a Camorra?
translation: 卡莫拉？卡莫拉是什么？

english: An ancient hero? Sounds like the Library Historical Archive is where you want to be. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library, he can take you there.
translation: 一位古代英雄？听起来你应该去图书馆历史档案馆。去找阿西乌斯城图书馆的阿尔凯奥，他可以带你去那里。

english: I'm afraid not. Did you try the Library Historical Archive?
translation: 恐怕不行。你试过图书馆历史档案馆了吗？

english: I suggest you try there. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library, he can take you to the Archive.
translation: 我建议你去那里试试。去找阿西乌斯城图书馆的阿尔凯奥，他可以带你去档案馆。

english: Not a bad idea. I think I'll do just that.
translation: 好主意。我就这么办。

english: Heard you were out here. Thought I'd come see how things are going.
translation: 听说你在这。我想来看看情况如何。

english: Not spying on me are you?
translation: 你不是在监视我吧？

english: Spying is a strong word. I just like to keep an eye on people I've not worked with before. Especially in a situation as delicate as this one.
translation: 监视这个词太重了。我只是喜欢留意那些我没合作过的人。尤其是在这种敏感的情况下。

english: That's one way of putting it.
translation: 倒也是一种说法。

english: So, what of Hughes?
translation: 那么，休斯怎么样了？

english: She booked passage on this ship, but she's not arrived yet. If she's coming, it will be soon.
translation: 她订了这艘船的船票，但还没到。如果她要来，应该快了。

english: And we'll be here when she does. Not bad.
translation: 等她来了我们就在这。不错。

english: Starting to trust me now?
translation: 现在开始信任我了？

english: Don't get ahead of yourself.
translation: 别得意忘形。

english: Ah, looks like we might have a visitor.
translation: 啊，看来我们有客人了。

english: Sophia Hughes. Going somewhere?
translation: 索菲娅.休斯。想去哪啊？

english: You! This is all your doing!
translation: 你！这都是你搞的鬼！

english: The only person to blame is yourself. When you play with fire, you get burnt.
translation: 唯一该怪的人是你自己。玩火者必自焚。

english: It's over, Sophia. You should come quietly.
translation: 结束了，索菲娅。你最好乖乖就范。

english: Commander Fullore! He would send you, wouldn't he? The little lapdog of Councillor Andrews!
translation: 富洛尔指挥官！他派你来的，对吧？安德鲁斯议员的小走狗！

english: He knew, you know! They all did. They were more than happy with my work while it was secret. But now they betray me without a second thought, just to protect themselves!
translation: 他知道的，你知道吗！他们都知道。我的工作在保密的时候他们都很满意。但现在他们为了自保，毫不犹豫地背叛了我！

english: You'd think they'd have some loyalty after all we did! After what we did to him. After what we did to his girl! We were in it together until it no longer suited them!
translation: 你可能会以为他们对我们所做的一切会有点忠诚！对我们对他做的事！对我们对他女儿做的事！我们本来是一伙的，直到这对他们不再有利！

english: What are you on about? What girl?
translation: 你在说什么？什么女儿？

english: Don't think I'm coming quietly! I've fought too hard to stop now!
translation: 别以为我会乖乖就范！我奋斗了这么久，不会现在停下！

english: Judge of Yama, hear my voice! I call upon you to bring justice to the unworthy! Cleanse them in a sea of fire! Cleanse them in a sea of blood!
translation: 阎魔法官，听我呼唤！我召唤你为不配之人带来正义！用火海净化他们！用血海净化他们！

english: Sophia Hughes. You have called upon me. Those that oppose you will be judged in the name of Yama.
translation: 索菲娅.休斯。你召唤了我。那些反对你的人将以阎魔之名接受审判。

english: But know this, Sophia Hughes. Those that call upon the Judge must first be judged themselves.
translation: 但你要知道，索菲娅.休斯。那些召唤法官的人，必须先接受审判。

english: You have betrayed the trust of Yama, Sophia Hughes. You have used his generosity to your own advantage. For this, your life is forfeit.
translation: 你背叛了阎魔的信任，索菲娅.休斯。你利用他的慷慨谋取私利。为此，你的性命将被剥夺。

english: What? No!
translation: 什么？不！

english: Come. Serve your master one last time. Bathe yourself in a sea of fire. Bathe yourself in a sea of blood.
translation: 来吧。最后一次服侍你的主人。在火海中沐浴。在血海中沐浴。

english: No... Wait!
translation: 不……等等！

english: Soon he will decend on these miserable lands and everything you know will be ash!
translation: 很快他就会降临这片悲惨的土地，你所知的一切都将化为灰烬！

english: And so the justice of Yama has been brought upon Sophia Hughes, as it will be brought upon all who wrong him.
translation: 阎魔的正义已降临到索菲娅.休斯身上，正如它也将降临到所有冒犯他的人身上。

english: Lydia Fullore, [player name]. You have been declared enemies of Yama. Your actions have endangered the work of his children. For this, your lives are forfeit.
translation: 莉迪亚.富洛尔，[player name]。你们已被宣布为阎魔的敌人。你们的行为危及了他子民的工作。为此，你们的性命将被剥夺。

english: Hey! You can't just show up and start incinerating people. That's not how justice works. How about you clear off, before I make you!
translation: 嘿！你不能就这么出现然后开始焚烧人。正义不是这么回事。你最好滚开，不然我就让你滚！

english: [player name]. You have challenged the Judge of Yama. Your guilt will be determined through combat.
translation: [player name]。你挑战了阎魔法官。你的罪孽将通过战斗来裁决。

english: Should you succeed, you will be free of your sins. Should you fail, you will be bathed in fire. You will be bathed in blood.
translation: 如果你成功，你将摆脱你的罪孽。如果你失败，你将在火海中沐浴。你将在血海中沐浴。

english: Now, in the name of Yama, let us begin.
translation: 现在，以阎魔之名，让我们开始吧。

english: Discord.gg/pvm - (Willian). You have challenged the Judge of Yama. Your guilt will be determined through combat.
translation: Discord.gg/pvm - (Willian)。你向阎魔法官发起了挑战。你的罪责将通过战斗来判定。

english: Lydia Fullore, Discord.gg/pvm - (Willian). You have been declared enemies of Yama. Your actions have endangered the work of his children. For this, your lives are forfeit.
translation: 莉迪亚.弗洛尔，Discord.gg/pvm - (Willian)。你们已被宣布为阎魔的敌人。你们的行为危及了他孩子们的成果。为此，你们的性命将被剥夺。

english: Here he is, the hero of the hour. On behalf of the Council, and indeed all of Kourend, thank you for dealing with this messy situation.
translation: 他来了，此刻的英雄。我代表议会，也代表整个库兰德王国，感谢你处理了这桩烂摊子。

english: It was nothing.
translation: 没什么。

english: You're far too humble. You've done so much for our kingdom in your short time here. Rest assured, we have noticed. In fact, I consider you a firm friend of the Council.
translation: 你太谦虚了。你在这里的短短时间里为我们王国做了这么多。放心，我们都看在眼里。事实上，我认为你是议会的坚定朋友。

english: Have you managed to work out how Councillor Hughes escaped?
translation: 你弄清楚休斯议员是怎么逃走的了吗？

english: Not yet. You need not worry though, we'll get to the bottom of it. That said, I do have another ask of you... if you don't mind.
translation: 还没呢。不过别担心，我们会查个水落石出的。说起来，我还有个事想请你帮忙……如果你不介意的话。

english: Commander Fullore tells me you've had dealings with Martin Holt and his group.
translation: 富洛尔指挥官告诉我，你和马丁.霍尔特那帮人打过交道。

english: I'm not sure about dealings, but we've met.
translation: 说不上打交道，但我们确实见过面。

english: Well regardless, your handling of the situation with Sophia Hughes seems to have had quite an impact on them.
translation: 不管怎么说，你处理索菲娅.休斯那件事的方式，似乎对他们影响不小。

english: Well, I am quite impactful. So, what is this ask?
translation: 嗯，我确实挺有影响力的。那么，你要我做什么？

english: This recent situation has been most unfortunate. People are angry, I understand that. That said, Sophia Hughes has been dealt with. It's time for Martin Holt and his protestors to go home.
translation: 最近这事非常不幸。人们很愤怒，我能理解。不过话说回来，索菲娅.休斯已经处理了。现在是时候让马丁.霍尔特和他的抗议者们回家了。

english: Ah, I see. You want me to convince them.
translation: 啊，我明白了。你想让我说服他们。

english: It would be greatly appreciated. Civil unrest is of no benefit to anyone. We'd all be better off putting this behind us.
translation: 那将感激不尽。局势动荡对谁都没好处。我们都该把这事抛在脑后，这样对大家都好。

english: Now, I must be off. Plenty of work to do. Good luck with Martin and his friends.
translation: 好了，我得走了。还有一堆事要忙。祝你和马丁那帮人好运。

english: So what now?
translation: 那现在怎么办？

english: We're looking into how Sophia Hughes might have escaped. I'll let you know if we find anything.
translation: 我们正在调查索菲娅.休斯是怎么逃走的。有什么发现我会告诉你的。

english: You know that's not what I mean.
translation: 你知道我说的不是这个。

english: I'm not sure what you're on about. Now, I'm sorry, but I need to get to work.
translation: 我不太明白你在说什么。抱歉，我得去工作了。

english: *whispers* Meet me just south of the castle.
translation: *低语* 在城堡南边等我。

english: So?
translation: 所以呢？

english: Councillor Hughes was a deranged cultist.
translation: 休斯议员是个疯狂的邪教徒。

english: And yet?
translation: 然后呢？

english: Do you not know? Or do you just not want to admit it? The man and the girl she spoke of. What did she mean?
translation: 你不知道？还是你不想承认？她提到的那个男人和那个女孩。她是什么意思？

english: Ever since King Kharedst IV died, there have been those who have questioned his death. People like Martin.
translation: 自从国王卡雷德四世驾崩后，就一直有人质疑他的死因。比如马丁那样的人。

english: It was all just wild speculation, though. The King was old, and he died of an illness. It happens all the time.
translation: 不过那都是毫无根据的猜测。国王年纪大了，死于疾病。这种事经常发生。

english: The man Councillor Hughes mentioned. It could have been the King she was referring to.
translation: 休斯议员提到的那个男人。说不定她指的就是国王。

english: Maybe. Or maybe it was someone else.
translation: 也许吧。或者也可能是别人。

english: And the girl she mentioned? The King had a daughter.
translation: 那她提到的那个女孩呢？国王有个女儿。

english: Rose. She was meant to take the throne after him, but she was too young. His advisors took over until she came of age.
translation: 玫瑰。她本该在他之后继承王位的，但她太年轻了。他的顾问们代为执政，直到她成年。

english: The Council. It never went that way though, did it? She never took the throne. Martin said they declared her mad.
translation: 议会接管了。但事情并没有那样发展，对吧？她从未登上王位。马丁说他们宣告她疯了。

english: Grief can do a lot to someone. Rose and her father were very close.
translation: 悲伤对人的影响很大。玫瑰和她父亲关系非常亲密。

english: Listen to us! Are we really considering this? The Council rule Kourend. They have done so successfully for 20 years now.
translation: 听听我们在说什么！我们真的在考虑这种事吗？议会统治着库兰德王国。二十年来他们一直干得很成功。

english: What happened to Rose in the end? Where did she go?
translation: 玫瑰最后怎么样了？她去了哪里？

english: After what happened, public life was no place for her. The Council arranged for her to move away so she could escape all of that.
translation: 在那之后，公共生活不适合她了。议会安排她搬走，让她远离这一切。

english: So where is she now?
translation: 那她现在在哪里？

english: Look, I'm the commander of the Kourend Royal Guard. My duty is to the Council.
translation: 听着，我是库兰德皇家卫队的指挥官。我的职责是对议会负责。

english: As commander of the 'Royal Guard' your duty is surely to royalty, not to some Council.
translation: 作为“皇家卫队”的指挥官，你的职责显然是对皇室，而不是什么议会。

english: What kind of person would I be if I betrayed them?
translation: 如果我背叛他们，那我成什么了？

english: What kind of person would you be if you followed them blindly, even when all the evidence says not to?
translation: 如果你盲目追随他们，即使所有证据都表明不该如此，那你又成什么了？

english: I'm sorry, but I can't.
translation: 抱歉，我做不到。

english: Oh come on...
translation: 哦，别这样……

english: I can't! But you can.
translation: 我做不到！但你可以。

english: Councillor Andrews may have been all nice to you, but he's furious with me. He's blamed me for what happened in Port Piscarilius. I have no hope of doing anything now without him knowing.
translation: 安德鲁斯议员也许对你很客气，但他对我怒不可遏。他把皮斯卡里琉斯港发生的事归咎于我。我现在想做点什么他都会知道，根本没指望。

english: But you, on the other hand... You're just some adventurer as far as they're concerned. They won't be keeping an eye on you.
translation: 但你就不同了……在他们眼里，你只是个冒险者。他们不会盯着你的。

english: But where would I start?
translation: 但我从何入手呢？

english: Rose. If she's still alive, then she's the key to the truth. You have to find her.
translation: 玫瑰。如果她还活着，那她就是揭开真相的关键。你必须找到她。

english: I'm going to hate myself for this, but I know someone who could help.
translation: 我会为此痛恨自己，但我认识一个能帮忙的人。

english: Martin. He's leader of Kourend's Royal Society. He knows more about the last royal family than anyone. If anyone can help you find Rose, it's him.
translation: 马丁。他是库兰德皇家学会的会长。他比任何人都了解上一任王室。如果有人能帮你找到玫瑰，那就是他。

english: Now, I need to get back inside, before someone finds out I'm missing.
translation: 好了，我得回去了，免得有人发现我不在。

english: Thank you, Lydia. I know this can't be easy for you.
translation: 谢谢你，莉迪亚。我知道这对你来说不容易。

english: I really need to go. Speak to Martin, and good luck.
translation: 我真的得走了。去找马丁谈谈吧，祝你好运。

english: No time to talk I'm afraid. Didn't Councillor Andrews want you to speak to Martin Holt about his protest?
translation: 恐怕没时间闲聊了。安德鲁斯议员不是想让你去找马丁.霍尔特谈他的抗议吗？

english: Hello again, friend. Isn't it a wonderful day? Sophia Hughes has been dealt with and our wonderfully corrupt Council are out rowing without a paddle. Keep up the good work!
translation: 又见面了，朋友。今天不是个好日子吗？索菲娅.休斯被处理了，我们那腐败透顶的议会现在就像船没了桨，只能干着急。继续保持！

english: Good to see you, friend. Excellent work with Sophia Hughes!
translation: 很高兴见到你，朋友。索菲娅.休斯的事干得漂亮！

english: Hello Martin. I see your protest is growing.
translation: 你好，马丁。我看你的抗议队伍越来越壮大了。

english: Indeed it is, friend. Would you believe it that apparently some councillor went and summoned a demon in Port Piscarilius? That made a lot of people angry.
translation: 确实如此，朋友。你能相信吗，好像有个议员跑到皮斯卡里琉斯港召唤了一个恶魔？这可激怒了不少人。

english: It seems the guards have also taken interest.
translation: 看来守卫们也注意到了。

english: No doubt sent by the Council to keep an eye on us. We've got them scared now.
translation: 肯定是议会派来监视我们的。现在他们怕我们了。

english: Maybe they think things will get violent?
translation: 也许他们担心事情会演变成暴力？

english: And yet they're the ones with the weapons. Interesting, huh?
translation: 可手里有武器的却是他们。有意思，对吧？

english: Anyway, what can I do for you, friend?
translation: 总之，有什么我能帮你的吗，朋友？

english: There's something important we need to talk about.
translation: 有件重要的事我们得谈谈。

english: Something important? Is it about the Council?
translation: 重要的事？是关于议会的吗？

english: Well, what is it? If you have news on the Council, we must let the people know at once.
translation: 嗯，是什么？如果你有议会的消息，我们必须立刻告知人民。

english: This one needs to stay between you and me.
translation: 这件事只能你我知道。

english: The people have a right to know, my friend.
translation: 人民有权知道，我的朋友。

english: They do. But if what I've discovered is true, we can't let the Council realise we know until we have definitive proof.
translation: 没错。但如果我发现的是真的，我们就不能让议会察觉我们已经知道了，除非我们掌握确凿的证据。

english: I see. This sounds serious. What have you learnt?
translation: 我明白了。听起来很严重。你发现了什么？

english: When I confronted Sophia Hughes, she spoke of things the Council did to a man and his daughter.
translation: 当我面对索菲娅.休斯时，她提到了议会曾对一个男人和他的女儿做的事。

english: A man and his daughter? Surely this can't mean...
translation: 一个男人和他的女儿？这不可能是指……

english: Kharedst IV. The last King of Great Kourend.
translation: 卡雷德四世。大库兰德王国的最后一位国王。

english: I knew it! I knew the Council were involved in his death!
translation: 我就知道！我就知道议会和他的死有关！

english: Like I said, we have no proof. The dying words of a cultist are not going to be enough to convince many. We need real proof.
translation: 我说了，我们没有证据。一个邪教徒的临终遗言不足以说服大多数人。我们需要真正的证据。

english: And this is why you came to me? You have a plan?
translation: 所以你来找我？你有计划了？

english: The King's daughter, Rose. If we can find her, we might be able to find out what happened.
translation: 国王的女儿，玫瑰。如果我们能找到她，说不定就能查出真相。

english: But my friend, no one knows where Rose is! Some don't even think she's alive any more. Sadly, most people have just forgotten her completely.
translation: 但是我的朋友，没人知道玫瑰在哪里！有些人甚至认为她已经不在了。可悲的是，大多数人都完全忘记了她。

english: But you haven't! You must have some idea of where they might have taken her.
translation: 可你没有忘记！你一定知道他们可能把她带到了哪里。

english: I'm afraid not. However, I wonder if Rose herself might be able to help.
translation: 恐怕我不知道。不过，我在想玫瑰本人或许能帮上忙。

english: The Council didn't declare Rose mad right away. It wasn't until a few weeks after her father died that she was moved away.
translation: 议会并没有立刻宣布玫瑰疯了。她父亲去世几周后，她才被送走。

english: But how does that help us?
translation: 但这对我们有什么帮助？

english: Rose was well known for being a good writer, even at her young age. She documented everything she did. She even wrote her father's memoirs for him.
translation: 玫瑰以擅写作而闻名，尽管她年纪轻轻。她记录下自己所做的一切。她甚至替她父亲撰写回忆录。

english: If something happened in those few weeks, maybe she wrote about it.
translation: 如果那几周里发生了什么，也许她写下来了。

english: Ah, I understand now. That does make sense.
translation: 啊，我明白了。这倒是有道理。

english: You know, I actually ended up acquiring her father's memoirs myself.
translation: 你知道吗，我其实后来搞到了她父亲的回忆录。

english: You did? Interesting. The memoirs were auctioned off recently, along with a lot of other royal possessions.
translation: 真的？有意思。那本回忆录最近被拍卖了，连同许多其他王室物品。

english: The auction was a request from the King before he died. He wanted the money to go towards helping the poor of Kourend.
translation: 这场拍卖是国王临终前的请求。他希望这笔钱能用来帮助库兰德的穷人。

english: You know, I actually ended up acquiring her father's memoirs myself. There was an interesting page hidden in the book. It suggested that something bad happened to whoever wrote it.
translation: 你知道吗，我其实后来搞到了她父亲的回忆录。书里夹着一张有趣的纸片，暗示写下它的人遭遇了不幸。

english: And you're only mentioning this now? You had proof that something happened to Rose, and you did nothing with it?
translation: 你现在才提这事？你早就有了玫瑰遭遇不测的证据，却什么都没做？

english: Well it wasn't really proof of anything. It gave no details on what actually happened, and no leads to follow. It wasn't even clear if Rose wrote it.
translation: 那也算不上什么证据。它没有提供任何具体细节，也没有线索可循。甚至不能确定是不是玫瑰写的。

english: Even still, something like that might have been worth bringing up.
translation: 即便如此，这种东西还是值得提一下的。

english: Well, now you know. I don't see how it helps us, though.
translation: 好吧，现在你知道了。不过我看不出这对我们有什么帮助。

english: The memoirs were auctioned off recently, along with a lot of other royal possessions. The auction was a request from the King before he died. He wanted the money to go towards helping the poor of Kourend.
translation: 回忆录最近和其他许多王室财产一起被拍卖了。这场拍卖是国王临终前的请求。他希望这笔钱能用来帮助库兰德的穷人。

english: The King's been dead for years. How come the auction only happened recently?
translation: 国王已经去世多年了。为什么拍卖会最近才举行？

english: For that you can thank our Council friends. They blocked it for years. They said Rose's things should not be included, as the original request only covered her father's possessions.
translation: 这得感谢我们的议会朋友。他们阻挠了好几年。他们说玫瑰的东西不该包括在内，因为最初的要求只涵盖她父亲的财产。

english: I did wonder if they had more malicious motivations, and now you've confirmed it. They clearly didn't want anyone getting their hands on Rose's writings.
translation: 我之前就怀疑他们有更恶毒的动机，现在你证实了。他们显然不想让任何人拿到玫瑰的著作。

english: Were there any other writings, apart from the memoirs?
translation: 除了回忆录，还有别的著作吗？

english: Yes. Rose's personal diary. It went to the Library Historical Archive. I hear they have it on display there.
translation: 有。玫瑰的私人日记。它被送到了图书馆历史档案馆。我听说他们在那里展出。

english: So I need to go to the Archive and get that diary.
translation: 所以我得去档案馆拿到那本日记。

english: The Archive isn't the Library. You can't just borrow things. I doubt they'll let you take it.
translation: 档案馆不是图书馆。你不能随便借东西。我怀疑他们不会让你拿走。

english: To be honest, I wasn't actually planning on asking.
translation: 说实话，我压根没打算去问。

english: A [man/woman] who knows what needs to be done. I respect that. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you to the Archive. Come back once you have the diary and we'll discuss our next steps.
translation: 一个知道该做什么的[man/woman]。我欣赏这一点。去阿西乌斯城的图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他能带你去档案馆。拿到日记后回来，我们再讨论下一步。

english: What do I need to be doing?
translation: 我需要做什么？

english: Rose's personal diary is on display in the Library Historical Archive. We need to aquire it. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you to the Archive.
translation: 玫瑰的私人日记正在图书馆历史档案馆展出。我们需要弄到手。去阿西乌斯城的图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他能带你去档案馆。

english: Welcome to the Library Historical Archive.
translation: 欢迎来到图书馆历史档案馆。

english: I have a question about Rose.
translation: 我想问个关于玫瑰的问题。

english: Rose? The princess?
translation: 玫瑰？那位公主？

english: Ah, poor girl. Her tale is such a tragic one. What would you like to know?
translation: 啊，可怜的女孩。她的故事太悲惨了。你想知道什么？

english: I heard her diary was on display here. I was wondering if I could read it.
translation: 我听说她的日记在这里展出。我想知道能不能读一下。

english: You are correct that we have her diary. It's in the display case on the eastern wall. That said, I'm afraid I can't let you read it.
translation: 你说得对，我们确实有她的日记。在东墙的展示柜里。不过，恐怕我不能让你读。

english: The diary is here to be preserved. However, we do not feel it appropriate to let people read the private thoughts of a young girl.
translation: 日记放在这里是为了保存。但我们觉得让别人读一个小女孩的私人想法不太合适。

english: Good to see you, friend. Any luck with that diary?
translation: 见到你真好，朋友。那本日记有眉目了吗？

english: Good work. Now, let's see if this diary has anything for us...
translation: 干得好。现在，我们来看看这本日记里有没有什么线索……

english: Hmm. Doesn't look to be anything obvious, but that's not suprising. Anything too in your face would have been found by the Council long ago.
