english: Hang on... I recently helped to repair some damage to the Doors of Dinh. What if this Pyromancer was the one responsible?
translation: 等等……我最近帮忙修复了丁之门的一些损坏。如果就是这个火术士干的呢？

english: Impossible to say.
translation: 无法确定。

english: But a coincidence is unlikely.
translation: 但巧合的可能性很小。

english: Well then what's to stop them doing it again? We have to do something!
translation: 那怎么阻止他们再干一次？我们必须做点什么！

english: We?
translation: 我们？

english: We have no part in this.
translation: 我们不参与此事。

english: We have already helped you.
translation: 我们已经帮过你了。

english: Keeping the balance between life and death. That's your thing isn't it? If the Wintertodt escapes, it will destroy all life in Kourend. That doesn't seem very balanced!
translation: 维持生与死的平衡。那是你们的事，对吧？如果冬将军逃出来，它会摧毁库兰德王国所有的生命。那看起来可不太平衡！

english: The human makes a valid point.
translation: 这个人类说得有道理。

english: Well it's been known to happen.
translation: 嗯，这种事也不是没发生过。

english: The Dark Altar powers the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 黑暗祭坛为丁之门提供能量。

english: We understand this power.
translation: 我们理解这种力量。

english: We can help reinforce them.
translation: 我们可以帮助加固它们。

english: To prevent further sabotage.
translation: 以防止进一步的破坏。

english: Take a defence potion.
translation: 拿一瓶防御药水。

english: Add some volcanic sulphur.
translation: 加入一些火山硫磺。

english: Then return to us.
translation: 然后回到我们这里。

english: And we will enchant it.
translation: 我们会为它附魔。

english: Where can I get volcanic sulphur?
translation: 我在哪里可以弄到火山硫磺？

english: It can be mined in Lovakengj.
translation: 可以在洛瓦肯吉城开采。

english: Got it. I'll be back soon.
translation: 明白了。我很快就回来。

english: Sulphur in a defence potion. Got it. I'll be back soon.
translation: 硫磺加进防御药水。明白了。我很快就回来。

english: Alright. I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的。我很快就回来。

english: I have the potion.
translation: 我有药水了。

english: Then hold still.
translation: 那就别动。

english: It is done.
translation: 完成了。

english: Now take the potion.
translation: 现在拿着这瓶药水。

english: Pour it on the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 把它倒在丁之门上。

english: And your work will be done.
translation: 你的工作就完成了。

english: Alright. I'll get it sorted.
translation: 好的。我会搞定的。

english: Take your potion.
translation: 喝下你的药水。

english: I lost the potion.
translation: 我弄丢了药水。

english: You are lucky.
translation: 你运气好。

english: We prepared for such an outcome.
translation: 我们为这种结果做了准备。

english: Okay. I'll get it sorted.
translation: 好的。我来解决。

english: Well that's that done. I'd better get back to Lord Arceuus.
translation: 好了，事情办完了。我最好回到阿西乌斯领主那里去。

english: Hey! What are you doing with those doors?
translation: 嘿！你在对那些门做什么？

english: Well you can either go through them or leave them alone.
translation: 你要么穿过它们，要么别去碰它们。

english: Do you have something for me?
translation: 你有什么东西要给我吗？

english: Welcome brother.
translation: 欢迎你，兄弟。

english: You stand before the Doors of Dinh, behind them lies the prison of the Wintertodt.
translation: 你面前的是丁之门，门后就是冬将军的牢狱。

english: Welcome back brother. How may I be of assistance?
translation: 欢迎回来，兄弟。我能帮你什么吗？

english: We are all related brother, for we are all children of the flame.
translation: 我们都是兄弟，因为我们都是火焰之子。

english: That is why we are here brother. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, the Order of the Sacred Flame has stood vigil over this place.
translation: 这就是我们在此的原因，兄弟。自从冬将军被囚禁以来，圣焰教团就一直在此守卫。

english: Welcome sister.
translation: 欢迎你，姐妹。

english: Pass through the Doors of Dinh to the prison within. You will find the finest of our Order channeling the power of the sacred flame into the Wintertodt.
translation: 穿过丁之门进入里面的监狱。你会看到我们教团中最优秀的人在将圣焰的力量导入冬将军。

english: We are all related sister, for we are all children of the flame.
translation: 我们都是姐妹，因为我们都是火焰之子。

english: May the sacred flame guide you brother.
translation: 愿圣焰指引你，兄弟。

english: Welcome back sister. How may I be of assistance?
translation: 欢迎回来，姐妹。我能帮你什么吗？

english: That is why we are here sister. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, the Order of the Sacred Flame has stood vigil over this place.
translation: 这就是我们在此的原因，姐妹。自从冬将军被囚禁以来，圣焰教团就一直在此守卫。

english: You do not have a full set to trade in. Come back when you do.
translation: 你没有完整的一套可以用来兑换。等你凑齐了再来吧。

english: We must hold back the Wintertodt until we can find a way to defeat it. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our Order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: 我们必须阻止冬将军，直到找到击败它的方法。进入监狱，保持圣火燃烧，这样教团才能抵御邪恶。

english: We fought against the Wintertodt until we managed to lure it behind Dinh's great doors. Our task did not end there though, for we always knew that the Wintertodt would rise again.
translation: 我们与冬将军战斗，直到设法把它引诱到丁的巨大门后。但我们的任务并未就此结束，因为我们始终知道冬将军会再次崛起。

english: May the sacred flame guide you sister.
translation: 愿圣焰指引你，姐妹。

english: That is why we are here brother. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, members of the Order of the Sacred Flame, or Pyromancers as we're often known, have stood vigil over this place.
translation: 这就是我们在此的原因，兄弟。自从冬将军被囚禁以来，圣焰教团的成员——我们常被称为火术士——就一直在此守卫。

english: That is why we are here sister. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, members of the Order of the Sacred Flame, or Pyromancers as we're often known, have stood vigil over this place.
translation: 这就是我们在此的原因，姐妹。自从冬将军被囚禁以来，圣焰教团的成员——我们常被称为火术士——就一直在此守卫。

english: The Wintertodt is no longer growing in strength but it still needs to be held back. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our Order may keep the evil at bay.
translation: 冬将军的力量不再增长，但仍需加以遏制。进入监狱，保持圣火燃烧，这样教团才能抵御邪恶。

english: You do not have any Pyromancer hood to trade in.
translation: 你没有火术士兜帽可以用来兑换。

english: You do not have any Pyromancer robe to trade in.
translation: 你没有火术士长袍可以用来兑换。

english: You do not have any Pyromancer boots to trade in.
translation: 你没有火术士靴可以用来兑换。

english: You do not have any Warm gloves to trade in.
translation: 你没有保暖手套可以用来兑换。

english: You do not have any Bruma torch to trade in.
translation: 你没有布鲁玛火把可以用来兑换。

english: You do not have any Pyromancer garb to trade in.
translation: 你没有火术士服装可以用来兑换。

english: You do not have any Tome of fire (empty) to trade in.
translation: 你没有火焰典籍 (空) 可以用来兑换。

english: You can't trade in 0 of an item.
translation: 你不能用 0 个物品进行兑换。

english: But alas, despite our best efforts, the Winterodt is growing in power again.
translation: 但可惜的是，尽管我们竭尽全力，冬将军的力量又在增强了。

english: We must hold back the Wintertodt until we can find a way to defeat it. Head into the prison and keep the holy fires lit so that our Order can keep the evil at bay.
translation: 我们必须阻止冬将军，直到找到击败它的方法。进入监狱，保持圣火燃烧，这样教团才能抵御邪恶。

english: I think you may want to remove the pages before handing that over to me.
translation: 我觉得你在把它交给我之前，最好先把书页取出来。

english: I would not appreciate your large weapon near the bank. Please take it away.
translation: 我不希望你的大型武器靠近银行。请把它拿走。

english: Do you feel the winds of the winter as they lick across the land? This is the power of the Wintertodt. We know not what it is nor from where it came. Only that it wields the power of Winter itself.
translation: 你感受到冬天的风在舔舐大地了吗？这就是冬将军的力量。我们不知道它是什么，也不知道它来自何方。只知道它拥有冬天本身的力量。

english: I am Ignisia, Grand Master of the Order of the Sacred Flame. I have served our order Faithfully since I passed the Trials of Fire before the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 我是伊格尼西亚，圣焰教团的大师。自从我在阿西乌斯城崛起之前通过了火焰试炼，我就一直忠实地为教团服务。

english: Alright, I'll leave them alone...
translation: 好吧，我不碰它们……

english: I have. They confirmed that this Xamphur is the same one that served Xeric.
translation: 我已经查过了。他们确认这个赞弗尔就是当年侍奉塞里克的那个。

english: So it's as I feared. This is not good.
translation: 正如我所担心的。这可不好。

english: There's more. We discovered that Xamphur has been working with a Pyromancer. That means he may have been involved in the sabotage of the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 还有更多。我们发现赞弗尔一直在与一位火术士合作。这意味着他可能参与了破坏丁之门的事件。

english: A Pyromancer? Do you know who?
translation: 火术士？你知道是谁吗？

english: Are you sure about this? Had the Doors of Dinh fully failed, the Wintertodt would have destroyed Kourend. What would Xamphur gain from that?
translation: 你确定吗？如果丁之门完全失效，冬将军就会摧毁库兰德。赞弗尔从中能得到什么好处？

english: I don't know, but the Tasakaal themselves confirmed it.
translation: 我不知道，但塔萨卡尔人自己确认了这件事。

english: I will have someone look into this. We'll also use this new knowledge to try and locate Xamphur.
translation: 我会派人调查此事。我们也会利用这个新线索来试图定位赞弗尔。

english: His master said they'd meet again in the south.
translation: 他的主人说他们会在南方再次相遇。

english: Interesting. This is useful information that could help our search. I wonder... could they mean the southern Kingdom of Varlamore?
translation: 有意思。这是有用的信息，可能有助于我们的搜索。我在想……他们指的是南方的瓦拉莫尔王国吗？

english: Ah, but that's one for another time. I believe we've learnt all we can about Xamphur for now. Until we can locate him, we must turn our focus towards the Council.
translation: 啊，但那是以后的事了。我相信我们已经了解了目前关于赞弗尔的一切。在我们找到他之前，必须把注意力转向议会。

english: So you'll support the new Royal Accord?
translation: 那么你会支持新的皇家协约吗？

english: I will. While I have no desire to rule myself, I'll gladly support one of my fellow leaders in that role.
translation: 我会的。虽然我自己没有统治的意愿，但我很乐意支持一位同僚领袖担任这个角色。

english: Thank you. I'd better go and speak with the others.
translation: 谢谢你。我最好去和其他人谈谈。

english: Hello there. You have my support with the Royal Accord. You should speak with the others.
translation: 你好。我支持你的皇家协约。你应该和其他人谈谈。

english: Adventurer! You came!
translation: 冒险者！你来了！

english: Phileas?
translation: 菲利亚斯？

english: You shouldn't be here! Time to die!
translation: 你不该来这里！受死吧！

english: You came for me! I knew you would!
translation: 你来救我了！我就知道你会来！

english: I don't understand Phileas. Why are you here?
translation: 我不明白，菲利亚斯。你为什么在这里？

english: These barbarians raided my home! They took me prisoner. I thought they were going to kill me!
translation: 这些野蛮人袭击了我的家！他们把我抓了起来。我以为他们要杀了我！

english: I don't know. I heard one of them saying they'd been paid to do it. But who would pay to have me captured?
translation: 我不知道。我听到其中一个人说他们是收钱办事的。但谁会出钱抓我？

english: Wait! What about that parcel? The one with King Shayzien VII's journal. Do you have it?
translation: 等等！那个包裹呢？装着谢兹恩七世国王日记的那个。你拿到了吗？

english: No. They took it from me. You don't think that's what this was about, do you?
translation: 没有了。他们从我这里拿走了。你不会认为这就是他们的目的吧？

english: I'm not sure, but I don't like this at all. I need to speak with Lord Hosidius.
translation: 我不确定，但我非常不喜欢这种情况。我需要和霍西迪乌斯领主谈谈。

english: Lord Hosidius? What's he got to do with this? And what about me?
translation: 霍西迪乌斯领主？这跟他有什么关系？那我呢？

english: There's too much to explain right now. Now, there are a lot of barbarians outside, so I can't free you at the moment. I'll go get help. Don't worry, you'll be safe soon.
translation: 现在解释起来太复杂了。外面有很多野蛮人，所以我暂时无法救你。我去找帮手。别担心，你很快就会安全了。

english: Alright. But please, don't take long.
translation: 好吧。但请别太久。

english: Is it safe to free me yet?
translation: 现在可以安全地救我了吗？

english: Not yet. I need to go and speak to Lord Hosidius. Don't worry, you'll be safe soon.
translation: 还不行。我需要去找霍西迪乌斯领主谈谈。别担心，你很快就会安全了。

english: We need to get some people down there urgently! The barbarians have Phileas Rimor prisoner.
translation: 我们得紧急派人下去！野蛮人抓住了菲利亚斯.里莫尔尔。

english: Phileas Rimor? Who's Phileas Rimor?
translation: 菲利亚斯.里莫尔尔？菲利亚斯.里莫尔尔是谁？

english: He's a retired soldier from Shayzien. I helped him out with something a while ago, but he went missing. Turns out these barbarians were paid to take him.
translation: 他是谢兹恩的一名退役士兵。不久前我帮他处理过一些事，但他失踪了。结果这些野蛮人是被人花钱雇去抓他的。

english: Paid by whom?
translation: 被谁雇的？

english: I don't know for sure, but I doubt Lord Shayzien's visit was a coincidence.
translation: 我不确定，但我怀疑谢兹恩领主的来访并非巧合。

english: So, it's as I feared. Still, that doesn't explain why Lord Shayzien would pay for one of his own citizens to be captured.
translation: 所以，正如我所担心的。不过，这并不能解释为什么谢兹恩领主会花钱让人抓捕他自己的市民。

english: The thing I was helping Phileas with involved a mysterious parcel he'd received. The parcel contained King Shayzien VII's journal. When Phileas was captured, it was taken by the barbarians.
translation: 我当时帮菲利亚斯处理的事情涉及他收到的一个神秘包裹。包裹里有谢兹恩七世国王的日记。当菲利亚斯被抓时，这本日记被野蛮人拿走了。

english: Before that happened, I followed some clues in the journal. They eventually led me to the discovery that King Shayzien VII may have been responsible for the creation of the lizardmen.
translation: 在那之前，我沿着日记中的一些线索追查。这些线索最终让我发现，谢兹恩七世国王可能要对蜥蜴人的创造负责。

english: Ah, the discovery at Quidamortem. This is all starting to make sense. It's long been believed that King Shayzien VII eventually became Xeric. That discovery did little to suggest otherwise.
translation: 啊，在奎达莫特姆的发现。这一切开始变得合理了。长期以来一直有人认为谢兹恩七世国王最终变成了谢里克。那个发现并没有提供多少反证。

english: Lord Shayzien wouldn't have been too happy of further evidence that Xeric was part of his family. He must have made arrangements to hide as much of that evidence as possible.
translation: 谢兹恩领主对于有更多证据表明谢里克是他家族的一员可不会太高兴。他肯定做了安排，尽可能多地隐藏那些证据。

english: Thank you, friend. I think we have all the information we need. I'll have some of my people head to this camp. They'll ensure Phileas is safe.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。我想我们已经掌握了所有需要的信息。我会派一些人前往那个营地。他们会确保菲利亚斯的安全。

english: It's probably best he disappear for a while, for his own safety. I'll make the arrangements.
translation: 为了他的安全，他最好消失一段时间。我会安排好的。

english: What of Lord Shayzien?
translation: 谢兹恩领主呢？

english: For now, nothing. We should keep this information to ourselves, until the time is right. As for the Royal Accord, I am ready to finalise things when you are.
translation: 暂时什么都不做。我们应该保密这些信息，直到时机成熟。至于皇家协约，我已经准备好了，等你那边弄好就最后敲定。

english: Okay. I guess I'd better go and speak with the others.
translation: 好的。我想我最好去和其他人谈谈。

english: Hello there. Thank you for your help earlier. You'll be pleased to know that Phileas is now safe.
translation: 你好。谢谢你之前的帮助。你会很高兴知道菲利亚斯现在安全了。

english: That's good to hear. Thank you for taking care of him. I'd better go and speak with the others.
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息。谢谢你照顾他。我最好去和其他人谈谈。

english: I need some help with Lady Lovakengj.
translation: 我需要有人帮我处理洛瓦肯吉女士的事。

english: She doesn't believe that Councillor Unkar has anything to do with this. She wants proof he's involved before she signs the new Royal Accord.
translation: 她不相信昂卡尔议员跟这件事有关。她要求在他签署新的皇家协约之前拿出他参与的证据。

english: That's not too suprising. The two of them are old friends. I've got nothing on him, but I can think of one person who might be able to help.
translation: 这不奇怪。他们俩是老朋友。我手上没有他的把柄，但我想有一个人或许能帮忙。

english: Martin?
translation: 马丁？

english: Exactly. His group has no doubt kept tabs on all of the councillors.
translation: 没错。他的组织无疑一直在监视所有议员。

english: But he's been arrested. I can't just go and break him out.
translation: 但他已经被捕了。我不能就这么去救他出来。

english: No, but you can still talk to him. You've helped the Council enough that no one would think much of it if you paid him a visit.
translation: 不行，但你仍然可以和他谈谈。你帮了议会那么多，如果你去探访他，没人会觉得有什么问题。

english: Fair point, I suppose. If anyone asks, I can claim I'm trying to round up more of his group.
translation: 说得有道理，我想。如果有人问起，我可以声称我在试图抓获他组织的更多成员。

english: Nice idea. They took him to the Shayzien Prison, just west of the city.
translation: 好主意。他们把他带到了谢兹恩监狱，就在城市西边。

english: Alright. I'll go and see what he knows.
translation: 好的。我去看看他知道些什么。

english: I wanted to ask you something about the leaders.
translation: 我想问你一些关于领袖们的事。

english: Have you spoken to Martin? He's in the Shayzien Prison, just west of the city.
translation: 你和马丁谈过了吗？他在谢兹恩监狱，就在城市西边。

english: I'll go and see what he knows.
translation: 我去看看他知道些什么。

english: Martin!
translation: 马丁！

english: Sorry, but I can't let you talk to the prisoners.
translation: 抱歉，我不能让你和囚犯说话。

english: But I'm here on Council business. I need to learn more about his group.
translation: 但我是为了议会事务来的。我需要了解更多关于他组织的情况。

english: Ah yes! You're the one that helped with Councillor Hughes. Carry on then.
translation: 啊，是的！你就是那个帮过休斯议员的人。那就继续吧。

english: How are things Martin?
translation: 马丁，情况怎么样？

english: Oh wonderful! There's free food and a bed! Can you believe it? Luxury compared to anything in Port Piscarilius!
translation: 哦，好极了！有免费食物和一张床！你能相信吗？比起皮斯卡里琉斯港的任何东西都豪华！

english: Well I'm glad you're keeping your spirits up. Now, I need your help with something.
translation: 嗯，很高兴你精神不错。现在，我需要你帮忙做点事。

english: Of course. Right down to business. As you can see, I'm a little indisposed right now. Apparently the right to protest isn't so much of a right after all.
translation: 当然。直接说正事吧。如你所见，我现在有点不方便。显然抗议的权利根本算不上什么权利。

english: Don't worry, it's just information I need. Things have progressed with the Council. I can't say any more here, but we're close. However, I need information on Councillor Unkar.
translation: 别担心，我只需要信息。议会那边有进展了。我不能在这里多说，但快成了。不过，我需要关于昂卡尔议员的信息。

english: Excellent work my friend! From the moment I met you, I knew you were something special. Now, what information do you need on him?
translation: 干得好，我的朋友！从我第一次见到你，我就知道你不是一般人。那么，你需要他的什么信息？

english: Anything that could prove his corruption.
translation: 任何能证明他腐败的证据。

english: If I had information on his corruption, I might not be stood in a cell right now.
translation: 如果我有他腐败的证据，我现在可能就不会站在牢房里了。

english: Of course, but you must have something on him. Anything could be helpful at this point.
translation: 当然，但你肯定有他的把柄。现在任何东西都可能有用。

english: I see. Well, there's a member of the Royal Society who has close access to Councillor Unkar's dealings. He gives me regular reports, but there hasn't been anything of note yet.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，皇家学会里有一个成员能密切接触昂卡尔议员的交易。他定期向我报告，但至今没什么值得注意的。

english: Still, things have progressed fast recently. Maybe he's had more luck since my imprisonment. As I'm stuck in here, perhaps you should go on my behalf to our usual meeting.
translation: 不过，最近事情进展很快。也许自从我被监禁以来，他有了更多的发现。既然我被困在这里，也许你应该代替我去我们通常的会面地点。

english: Sounds like a plan. Where does this meeting take place?
translation: 听起来不错。会面地点在哪里？

english: In the Shayzien Graveyard of Heroes. Look for a dwarf. He'll speak with you if you say the passphrase: 'Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.'
translation: 在谢兹恩英雄墓园。找一个矮人。如果你说出暗号：‘邪恶只有在善良者无所作为时才会获胜。’他会和你交谈。

english: Thanks for the help, Martin. We'll have you out of there soon.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，马丁。我们很快会把你弄出来的。

english: Good luck friend. Finish this for all of us!
translation: 祝你好运，朋友。为我们所有人完成这件事！

english: Hello again, Martin. Remind me, where is this meeting?
translation: 又见面了，马丁。提醒我一下，会面在哪里？

english: That was it. Thanks for the help.
translation: 就这样。谢谢你的帮助。

english: Not a problem. Now get out there and finish this!
translation: 没问题。现在出去完成这件事吧！

english: I know you! You're Jorra, Lady Lovakengj's assistant.
translation: 我认识你！你是乔拉，洛瓦肯吉女士的助理。

english: That's right. What brings you here, human?
translation: 没错。什么风把你吹来了，人类？

english: The evening owl doesn't eat much pudding.
translation: 晚上的猫头鹰不吃太多布丁。

english: Maybe you should go and lie down.
translation: 也许你应该躺下休息。

english: Evil only triumphs when the good do nothing.
translation: 邪恶只有在善良者无所作为时才会获胜。

english: Never have truer words been spoken. Martin sent you, right? I wasn't sure if anyone would come after he got arrested.
translation: 说得再正确不过了。是马丁派你来的，对吧？他被捕后，我不确定还会不会有人来。

english: That's right. So you're with the Royal Society? How come?
translation: 没错。那么你是皇家学会的人？为什么？

english: Why wouldn't I be? The Council are nothing but trouble.
translation: 为什么不是？议会只会带来麻烦。

english: But things don't seem too bad in Lovakengj with them in charge.
translation: 但由他们管理，洛瓦肯吉城似乎并不太糟。

english: Lady Lovakengj is in charge of Lovakengj, not the Council. Sure, Councillor Unkar might act like he plays a big part, but it's all empty words.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城是由洛瓦肯吉女士管理的，不是议会。当然，昂卡尔议员可能装作他起了很大作用，但那都是空话。

english: Do you not get sick of her asking for sherry?
translation: 她老是要雪莉酒，你不烦吗？

english: Not really. It's not like it's a hard job. Councillor Unkar would see us all work to death in the mines instead.
translation: 还好吧，又不是什么苦差事。昂卡尔议员恨不得我们都累死在矿场里呢。

english: I see. Well Councillor Unkar is why I'm here. I'm hoping you can give me something of note on him.
translation: 明白了。我来就是为了昂卡尔议员的事，希望你能给我一些关于他的线索。

english: Any other day you'd be wasting your time, but today you're in luck. Due to the protests, Councillor Unkar has been staying at the castle for safety. I've had a chance to go through his private documents.
translation: 平时你来就是白费功夫，但今天你运气好。因为抗议活动，昂卡尔议员为了安全一直待在城堡里。我趁机翻了他的私人文件。

english: I think you'll find...
translation: 我想你会感兴趣的……

english: Wait! What was that?
translation: 等等！那是什么声音？

english: Oh no. Not again!
translation: 哦不，又来！

english: Jorra Ashtar. You have been marked for death.
translation: 乔拉.阿什塔尔，你已被标记，必死无疑。

english: If tomorrow never comes, what is today?
translation: 如果明天永远不会到来，那今天算什么？

english: Huh... Fair enough.
translation: 哼……说得倒也没错。

english: That was close! Are you okay human?
translation: 好险！你没事吧，人类？

english: Martin warned me this would happen. The Council are trying to silence us!
translation: 马丁警告过我会这样。议会想让我们闭嘴！

english: It's not safe for me here. I need to get back to Lovakengj. Here, this should hopefully give you what you need.
translation: 这里不安全了。我得回洛瓦肯吉城去。拿着，这应该能帮到你。

english: Thanks Jorra. Stay safe.
translation: 谢了，乔拉。注意安全。

english: You have what you need human. Now I need to get back to Lovakengj.
translation: 你拿到想要的东西了，人类。我得回洛瓦肯吉城了。

english: I have a declaration from the Council that I think you should see.
translation: 我拿到一份议会的宣言，你应该看看。

english: What? But... I don't understand.
translation: 什么？可是……我不明白。

english: The Council wanted to remove me from power? They can't do that! It's not their right!
translation: 议会想把我赶下台？他们不能这么做！他们没有这个权力！

english: And Councillor Unkar...
translation: 还有昂卡尔议员……

english: I'm sorry. Do you now see why we need to stop them?
translation: 抱歉。现在你明白我们为什么必须阻止他们了吧？

english: Yes... I understand. I will support this Royal Accord.
translation: 是的……我明白了。我会支持这份皇家协约。

english: And do you wish to be considered for the throne?
translation: 那你愿意考虑继承王位吗？

english: Oh... No. Leave that for someone else.
translation: 哦……不。让别人来吧。

english: Very well. Thank you Lady Lovakengj. I'd better go and speak with the others.
translation: 很好。谢谢你，洛瓦肯吉女士。我最好去和其他人谈谈。

english: Oh... Let's see now...
translation: 哦……让我想想……

english: Do you have any sherry?
translation: 你有雪莉酒吗？

english: Sherry? No.
translation: 雪莉酒？没有。

english: Oh... Well I'm fine then.
translation: 哦……那我没事了。

english: Fair enough. I'll go speak with the others.
translation: 好吧。我去和其他人谈谈。

english: Hello again. Thank you for everything you did for Thana. You are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.
translation: 又见面了。感谢你为萨娜所做的一切。你是阿西乌斯人民的好朋友。

english: It's not a problem. Anyway, there was something I was hoping you could help me with.
translation: 不客气。其实，有件事想请你帮忙。

english: Of course. What do you need?
translation: 当然。你需要什么？

english: I have a situation with the Disciples of Yama. I hear you've been looking into them.
translation: 我遇到了阎魔门徒的问题。听说你一直在调查他们。

english: Well... Yes, I have, but that research was meant to be a secret...
translation: 嗯……是的，不过这项研究本来是保密的……

english: Ah well, you're trustworthy I suppose. What can I help you with?
translation: 啊，好吧，我想你值得信任。有什么我能帮你的？

english: What do you know of their leader, Yama?
translation: 你对他们的领袖阎魔了解多少？

english: He's a bit of a mystery. He's a demon of some sorts, but he doesn't seem to have any actual presence in Kourend yet. In fact, until recently, he had no connection to the cult.
translation: 他有点神秘。他是一种恶魔，但似乎还没在库兰德王国真正现身。事实上，直到最近，他和这个教团都没有任何联系。

english: The Disciples of Yama once had no connection to Yama?
translation: 阎魔门徒曾经和阎魔没有联系？

english: It does sound odd, but back then they were known as the Disciples of Chaos. They were just a small Zamorakian cult of little note.
translation: 听起来确实奇怪，但那时他们被称为混沌门徒，只是个不起眼的萨莫拉克小教团。

english: Interesting. So if Yama has no presence among his followers, how does he communicate with them?
translation: 有意思。那如果阎魔不在追随者中现身，他是怎么和他们沟通的？

english: Through another demon called the Voice of Yama.
translation: 通过另一个叫阎魔之声的恶魔。

english: So if I killed this Voice of Yama, the cultists would lose their connection to Yama?
translation: 所以如果我杀了这个阎魔之声，教徒们就会失去和阎魔的联系？

english: For a time, though I imagine the Voice of Yama would be quickly replaced. However, if you wanted to remove that connection, I do have another idea...
translation: 暂时会，不过我想阎魔之声很快就会被取代。但如果你想彻底切断联系，我倒是有另一个主意……

english: After what happened with Thana, I volunteered to help out with the Dark Altar investigations. The device used there was redirecting power from the Altar, but a similar device could block a magical connection entirely.
translation: 萨娜那件事之后，我自愿帮忙调查黑暗祭坛。那里用的装置是转移祭坛的力量，但类似的装置可以完全阻断魔法连接。

english: Ah, I see. So we could use a device like that to block the connection between the Voice of Yama and Yama himself?
translation: 啊，我明白了。所以我们可以用那样的装置来阻断阎魔之声和阎魔本人之间的联系？

english: That's right. We never tried it before because the Dark Altar issues were more pressing, but I don't see why it wouldn't work.
translation: 没错。我们以前没试过，因为黑暗祭坛的问题更紧迫，但我觉得这方法应该行得通。

english: Alright. So where can I get one of these devices?
translation: 好的。那我去哪里弄一个这样的装置？

english: I should be able to make you one. I'll need some molten glass and a dark essence block.
translation: 我应该能给你做一个。我需要一些熔融玻璃和一个黑暗精华块。

english: I have those right here.
translation: 我正好有。

english: Right. You'll need to hide this somewhere in the Chasm of Fire. Here you go.
translation: 好。你得把这个藏在火焰深渊地牢的某个地方。给你。

english: Alright. Thanks Mori.
translation: 好的。谢了，莫里。

english: Where can I get a dark essence block?
translation: 我去哪里弄黑暗精华块？

english: You can mine dense essence blocks from the mine north east of here. They can be turned into dark essence blocks using the Dark Altar.
translation: 你可以从这里东北方的矿场开采致密精华块。然后用黑暗祭坛把它们转化成黑暗精华块。

english: Okay, I'll come back once I have what you need.
translation: 好的，我拿到你要的东西就回来。

english: I can get those for you. I'll come back once I have them.
translation: 我能弄到那些东西。拿到就回来。

english: Hello again. Do you have some molten glass and a dark essence block yet?
translation: 又见面了。你拿到熔融玻璃和黑暗精华块了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll come back once I have them.
translation: 还没。我拿到就回来。

english: I have them right here.
translation: 我正好有。

english: Hello Mori. What should I be doing with this device?
translation: 你好，莫里。我该用这个装置做什么？

english: You just need to hide it somewhere in the Chasm of Fire.
translation: 你只需要把它藏在火焰深渊地牢的某个地方。

english: Hello Mori. Do you think you could make me another one of those devices?
translation: 你好，莫里。你能再给我做一个那样的装置吗？

english: I have enough supplies for another. Here, you'll need to hide it somewhere in the Chasm of Fire.
translation: 我有足够的补给品再做一个。给你，你需要把它藏在火焰深渊地牢的某个地方。

english: Ah, there you are. Our master foresaw your arrival.
translation: 啊，你来了。我们的主人预见到了你的到来。

english: And you have the device as well. How wonderful.
translation: 而且你还带着那个装置。真是太好了。

english: How do you...
translation: 你怎么知道……

english: Oh look at you. You need a good rest. Here, have a lie down.
translation: 哦，看看你。你需要好好休息。来，躺下吧。

english: Well that's the device hidden. Those Disciples of Yama won't be a problem anymore. I'd better tell Lady Piscarilius.
translation: 好了，装置藏好了。那些阎魔信徒不会再构成威胁了。我最好去告诉皮斯卡里琉斯女士。

english: Have you dealt with the Disciples of Yama yet?
translation: 你处理完阎魔门徒了吗？

english: It's all done.
translation: 都搞定了。

english: Absolutely. They won't be a problem anymore.
translation: 当然。他们不会再是麻烦了。

english: So will you now support this Royal Accord?
translation: 那现在你愿意支持这份皇家协约了吗？

english: Yes, but it's still a stupid idea. And don't even think about trying to put me in charge or something. I'll have no more part in this.
translation: 愿意，但这仍然是个蠢主意。而且别想让我来管事什么的。我不想再掺和了。

english: I don't think you need to worry about that. Now, I'd better go and speak with the others.
translation: 我想你不用担心这个。好了，我得去和其他人谈谈了。

english: Good. I've had enough of talking with you.
translation: 好。我跟你聊够了。

english: Fine. I need to speak with the others anyway.
translation: 行。反正我也得去找其他人谈谈。

english: I hear your father has an office here.
translation: 我听说你父亲在这里有间办公室。

english: Office? What office?
translation: 办公室？什么办公室？

english: A secret one, I'm guessing?
translation: 我猜是秘密办公室？

english: There can't be any secret offices here. I'd have noticed. I notice lots of things, you know.
translation: 这里不可能有什么秘密办公室。我会注意到的。我注意到很多事情，你知道吗。

english: Well in that case, have you noticed your father doing anything interesting here in the past?
translation: 那这样的话，你注意到你父亲以前在这里做过什么有趣的事吗？

english: He sometimes comes to inspect the wine barrels. I like to inspect them myself sometimes.
translation: 他有时会来检查酒桶。我自己有时也喜欢检查检查。

english: More than inspect, by the looks of things. Thanks for the help.
translation: 看这样子，可不仅仅是检查啊。谢谢你的帮忙。

english: Hello there, citizen. Have you found that journal?
translation: 你好啊，市民。你找到那本日记了吗？

english: Excellent work.
translation: 干得好。

english: It's sealed shut somehow.
translation: 它不知怎么被封住了。

english: Not to worry, I should be able to take care of that. When the time comes to finalise the Royal Accord, I will have the information we need to decide upon a new ruler.
translation: 别担心，我应该能处理。等皇家协约最终敲定的时候，我们就会有决定新统治者所需的信息了。

english: Alright. Thank you, Lord Shayzien. I should speak to Commander Fullore.
translation: 好的。谢谢你，谢兹恩领主。我应该去和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: Hello there, citizen. Thank you for your help earlier. I am ready to support this Royal Accord!
translation: 你好啊，市民。谢谢你之前的帮助。我准备好支持这份皇家协约了！

english: Alright. I'll go and talk with Commander Fullore.
translation: 好的。我去和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: Come with me. There's something you need to see.
translation: 跟我来。有件事你得看看。

english: Just come.
translation: 跟我来就是了。

english: What the... Is he...?
What happened? Did he jump?
translation: 发生什么事了？他是跳下去的吗？

english: I've no idea.
translation: 我不知道。

english: You don't think he was pushed, do you?
translation: 你不觉得他是被推下去的吧？

english: What do we do now?
translation: 我们现在怎么办？

english: What can we do? Even Lord Arceuus can't bring back the dead. He's gone, and that's that.
translation: 我们能做什么？就连阿西乌斯领主也无法起死回生。他已经走了，就这样了。

english: Why did any of this have to happen?
translation: 为什么非得发生这种事？

english: We can't undo what's been done, but we can still put an end to all this.
translation: 我们无法挽回已经发生的事，但至少可以终结这一切。

english: Does that mean you have good news?
translation: 这么说你有好消息了？

english: Kind of. I think I've managed to convince all the leaders to sign the Accord. That said, I have no idea who they'll pick to rule.
translation: 算是吧。我想我已经说服所有领袖签署协议了。不过，我不知道他们会选谁来统治。

english: Well, we'll just have to make it work somehow. Maybe then we can finally end this nightmare.
translation: 嗯，我们总得想办法让它成功。也许这样我们就能最终结束这场梦魇了。

english: I'll deal with this mess. Once I'm done, let's gather everyone downstairs again.
translation: 我来处理这烂摊子。等我处理完，我们再召集所有人到楼下。

english: Shall we get on with this then?
translation: 那我们开始吧？

english: Not yet. Where's Lord Hosidius and Lord Shayzien?
translation: 还没。霍西迪乌斯领主和谢兹恩领主在哪？

english: Lord Hosidius requested a private word with Lord Shayzien outside. I'm sure they'll be here soon.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯领主要求和谢兹恩领主在外面私下谈谈。我相信他们很快就到。

english: In fact, I think I hear them now.
translation: 事实上，我好像听到他们来了。

english: Now that everyone is here, I think we can begin.
translation: 既然大家都到齐了，我想我们可以开始了。

english: What of the Councillor? Is he not joining us?
translation: 那位议员呢？他不来吗？

english: Councillor Orson is dead.
translation: 奥森议员死了。

english: Dead? What happened?
translation: 死了？发生什么事了？

english: Jumped from the top of the tower, probably. It doesn't matter, the world won't miss him. Let's move on.
translation: 大概是从塔顶跳下来的。无所谓，这世界不会想念他。我们继续吧。

english: Not the attitude I'd take, but it's true that we can't dwell on this. We need to focus on stopping Councillor Andrews.
translation: 我不会采取这种态度，但确实我们不能纠结于此。我们需要集中精力阻止安德鲁斯议员。

english: Between the five of us, we can remove the Council from power with little violence. But what then? Are we willing to support a new Royal Accord?
translation: 我们五个人联手，可以几乎不流血地推翻议会。但然后呢？我们愿意支持新的皇家协议吗？

english: Lord Arceuus, let's start with you. What will it take for a new Royal Accord to gain your support?
translation: 阿西乌斯领主，从你开始吧。需要什么条件才能让你支持新的特威尔皇家协议？

english: My position is a unique one. As such, I feel it would be inappropriate for me to involve myself too heavily in this. That said, I will gladly support the decision made by this group.
translation: 我的立场很特殊。因此，我觉得自己不宜过多介入此事。不过，我会欣然支持这个团体做出的决定。

english: You would not wish to rule yourself?
translation: 你不想自己统治吗？

english: I will gladly advise the next ruler in any way I can, but it should not be me who takes the throne. I would recommend you look to Lord Hosidius or Lord Shayzien for that.
translation: 我很乐意尽我所能为下一任统治者提供建议，但不应该由我来继承王位。我建议你们考虑霍西迪乌斯领主或谢兹恩领主。

english: Very well. Lady Piscarilius?
translation: 很好。皮斯卡里琉斯女士呢？

english: For the record, I think this is all a bad idea. Still, you're all clearly set on it, so I won't try and stop you.
translation: 先说清楚，我觉得这整个主意都很糟糕。不过，你们显然都决定了，所以我不会试图阻止你们。

english: However, I stand by what I said before. The people should have a say. Anything we decide here should not be finalised until the people have voted on it.
translation: 然而，我坚持我之前说的。人民应该有发言权。我们在这里决定的任何事情，在人民投票之前都不应最终确定。

english: Any thoughts from anyone?
translation: 有人有意见吗？

english: I would be happy to see the people have a say.
translation: 我很乐意看到人民有发言权。

english: It could be a risky move.
translation: 这可能是个冒险的举动。

english: And? Without it, I'm not signing your precious document. If I don't sign, you get nothing.
translation: 那又怎样？没有这个，我不会签你那宝贵的文件。如果我不签，你们什么都得不到。

english: Hmm. Very well.
translation: 嗯。好吧。

english: Assuming the people agree to the new Accord, who do you think should rule the kingdom?
translation: 假设人民同意新协议，你认为谁应该统治王国？

english: Well not me, that's for sure. I can't imagine anything worse. Get one of these fools to do it.
translation: 反正不是我，这点可以肯定。我想不出更糟的事了。让这些傻瓜中的一个去做吧。

english: Lady Lovakengj?
translation: 洛瓦肯吉女士呢？

english: Huh? Me?
translation: 哈？我？

english: Yes. What do you think?
translation: 是的。你怎么看？

english: Well... This is all quite something. I suppose the Council have to go though, don't they?
translation: 嗯……这真是件大事。我想议会必须下台，对吧？

english: Would you be willing to take over?
translation: 你愿意接手吗？

english: Oh... No, I don't think so. I think I'll have a sherry instead.
translation: 哦……不，我不这么认为。我想我还是喝杯雪利酒好了。

english: Lord Shayzien. What are your thoughts?
translation: 谢兹恩领主。你有什么想法？

english: Well... I think the Royal Accord of Twill is a good starting point, but we'll need to make some changes for it to work.
translation: 嗯……我认为特威尔皇家协议是一个好的起点，但我们需要做一些修改才能让它奏效。

english: Lady Piscarilius wants the support of the people. Right now, they cry for a king. That means whoever takes the throne should take on the title of king or queen.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯女士想要人民的支持。现在，人民渴望一位国王。这意味着谁继承王位，就应该使用国王或女王的头衔。

english: I also feel the act of transferring rulership from one house to the next - as in the original Accord - isn't going to work for us. What we need is consistency.
translation: 我也觉得，像原协议那样将统治权从一个家族转移到下一个家族的做法对我们行不通。我们需要的是连续性。

english: Would you be open to taking on the role yourself?
translation: 你愿意自己担任这个角色吗？

english: Err... No, I don't think that would be wise.
translation: 呃……不，我认为那不明智。

english: Are you sure? You seem to be a perfect candidate.
translation: 你确定吗？你看起来是个完美的候选人。

english: I don't feel I would be best placed for it. It would be better if I kept my focus on the important task of protecting Kourend.
translation: 我觉得我不是最合适的人选。我最好还是专注于保护库兰德王国的重要任务。

english: I suggest we make Lord Hosidius the new ruler of Kourend.
translation: 我建议让霍西迪乌斯领主成为库兰德王国的新统治者。

english: Lord Hosidius?
translation: 霍西迪乌斯领主？

english: Thank you, Lord Shayzien. Taking the throne is not a duty to be considered lightly, but I believe my family and I have what it takes to shoulder this responsibility.
translation: 谢谢你，谢兹恩领主。继承王位不是一项可以轻率考虑的责任，但我相信我的家族和我有能力承担起这个责任。

english: This decision will forever change the future of Kourend. If we go forward with this, the Hosidius family will be the new royal family of Kourend.
translation: 这个决定将永远改变库兰德王国的未来。如果我们继续推进，霍西迪乌斯家族将成为库兰德王国的新王室。

english: Well... This isn't quite what I expected, but sure. Let the idiot have his throne. As long as the people agree.
translation: 嗯……这不太符合我的预期，但好吧。让那个傻瓜坐他的王位吧。只要人民同意。

english: He can do it, I suppose.
translation: 我想他能做到。

english: Lord Hosidius would be a fitting choice for the role, assuming no one else here is willing.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯领主是合适的人选，假设这里没有其他人愿意的话。

english: Are you sure about this Lord Shayzien?
translation: 你确定要这样吗，谢兹恩领主？

english: I... I am.
translation: 我……我确定。

english: Then it sounds like we have an agreement.
translation: 那么听起来我们达成一致了。

english: My friends, thank you for putting your trust in me. This kingdom has suffered through much of late, but now it is time for that suffering to end.
translation: 我的朋友们，感谢你们信任我。这个王国近来遭受了太多苦难，但现在该是结束苦难的时候了。

english: In honour of her sacrifice, I name this declaration Rose's Accord. With it, the Kingdom of Great Kourend will no longer be a kingdom divided.
translation: 为纪念她的牺牲，我将这份宣言命名为玫瑰协议。有了它，伟大的库兰德王国将不再是一个分裂的王国。

english: I promise not to let you down.
translation: 我保证不会让你们失望。

english: So... What just happened there?
translation: 所以……刚才发生了什么？

english: It seems we might have a new king.
translation: 看来我们可能有了一个新国王。

english: But Lord Shayzien? He seemed like a perfect candidate, but he didn't even want to be considered. What happened?
translation: 但是谢兹恩领主呢？他看起来是个完美的候选人，但他甚至不想被考虑。发生了什么？

english: I think I might have some idea, but I'm still a bit confused to be honest.
translation: 我想我可能有点头绪，但老实说我还是有点困惑。

english: Well, Lord Hosidius wants to have a word with you. Perhaps he can shed some light on all of this. He's downstairs.
translation: 嗯，霍西迪乌斯领主想和你谈谈。也许他能解释这一切。他在楼下。

english: I'll go and speak to him.
translation: 我去和他谈谈。

english: Hello there. No doubt you have questions about what just occurred.
translation: 你好。毫无疑问你对刚才发生的事有疑问。

english: You can say that again!
translation: 你说得没错！

english: I'm sorry for keeping you in the dark, my friend. It wasn't anything against you. I just couldn't afford to take any risks.
translation: 抱歉让你蒙在鼓里，我的朋友。这不是针对你。我只是不能冒任何风险。

english: You planned this all along, didn't you? That's why you kept the Royal Accord of Twill.
translation: 你一直计划着这一切，对吧？这就是你保留特威尔皇家协议的原因。

english: It was inevitable that one day the Council would fall. Their rule has always been fragile.
translation: 议会总有一天会垮台，这是不可避免的。他们的统治一直很脆弱。

english: So you made sure that you'd be the one to replace them.
translation: 所以你确保自己成为取代他们的人。

english: It gives me no pleasure, but this was needed for the safety of all of Kourend. Apart from Lord Shayzien, the other rulers had no interest in the throne. It was always going to be him or me.
translation: 这让我并不愉快，但为了整个库兰德的安危，这是必要的。除了谢兹恩领主，其他统治者对王位没有兴趣。一直都会是他或我之间选一个。

english: And you didn't want it to be him?
translation: 而你不想是他？

english: It was for the safety of Kourend. Lord Shayzien has a good military mind, but he is no ruler. After all, you saw what he did with Phileas.
translation: 这是为了库兰德的安危。谢兹恩领主有很好的军事头脑，但他不适合当统治者。毕竟，你看到了他对菲利亚斯做了什么。

english: To Lord Shayzien, family name is everything. Above all else, he craves glory for himself and his house. Under him, war would have been inevitable.
translation: 对谢兹恩领主来说，家族名望就是一切。他渴望为自己和家族带来荣耀，胜过一切。在他统治下，战争将不可避免。

english: War with who?
translation: 和谁开战？

english: Varlamore, the kingdom to the south. Our two kingdoms were in conflict less than a hundred years ago, and relations remain sour. It would take very little for that conflict to be reignited.
translation: 瓦拉莫尔，南方的王国。我们两个王国不到一百年前还处于冲突中，关系仍然紧张。只需一点火星就能重新点燃冲突。

english: You really think Lord Shayzien would have declared war?
translation: 你真的认为谢兹恩领主会宣战吗？

english: I can't say for sure, but it was a risk I did not intend to take.
translation: 我不能肯定，但这是一个我不打算冒的风险。

english: I see. So how did you do it?
translation: 我明白了。那你是怎么做到的？

english: A while ago, I managed to acquire the old journal of King Shayzien VII. I knew that I could use it to discredit Lord Shayzien and his family, so I made some arrangements.
translation: 不久前，我设法得到了谢兹恩七世国王的破旧的日记。我知道可以用它来诋毁谢兹恩领主和他的家族，所以我做了一些安排。

english: Phileas' mystery parcel! That was you? You acted like you didn't even know him earlier!
translation: 菲利亚斯的神秘包裹！原来是你？你之前表现得好像根本不认识他！

english: Apologies for the misdirection. It was indeed me who sent that parcel.
translation: 抱歉误导了你。那个包裹确实是我寄的。

english: Had I revealed the contents of the journal myself, I would likely have just been dismissed as trying to create a rift between our two houses. Phileas was the perfect third party.
translation: 如果我自己揭露日记的内容，很可能只会被当作试图在我们两大家族之间制造裂痕。菲利亚斯.里莫尔尔是完美的第三方。

english: But then Lord Shayzien had Phileas captured before he could reveal too much. This is all starting to make sense. You know, he actually blamed you for that!
translation: 但随后谢兹恩领主在菲利亚斯透露太多之前就抓住了他。这一切开始说得通了。你知道吗，他实际上为此责怪了你！

english: Phileas' disappearance was an interesting twist. I hadn't expected something like that. Still, it actually made things even easier in the end. Once Phileas was safe, I told Lord Shayzien and gave him a choice.
translation: 菲利亚斯的失踪是一个有趣的转折。我没想到会发生这种事。不过，最终这反而让事情变得更简单了。一旦菲利亚斯安全了，我就告诉了谢兹恩领主并给了他一个选择。

english: Oh I see. You let him pick between supporting you or being exposed.
translation: 哦我明白了。你让他在支持你和被曝光之间做选择。

english: Exactly. The truth about Phileas would have lost him the support of his people and ruined his reputation.
translation: 正是。关于菲利亚斯的真相会让他失去人民的支持，毁掉他的声誉。

english: So in the end, you never actually needed to discredit him at all. What about the journal? Lord Shayzien sent me to steal it from you, but surely he already had it.
translation: 所以到头来，你根本不需要诋毁他。那日记呢？谢兹恩领主派我来从你那偷走它，但他肯定已经拿到手了。

english: I didn't want to risk losing the real journal. The one I sent to Phileas was a copy, with many bits removed. While I covered my tracks well, Lord Shayzien must have worked out I was involved.
translation: 我不想冒险丢失真正的日记。我寄给菲利亚斯的是副本，删除了许多内容。虽然我掩盖得很好，但谢兹恩领主一定查出了我参与其中。

english: And he sent me to recover the real journal.
translation: 于是他派我去取回真日记。

english: Yes. Unfortunately for him, the one you stole was a fake. The real one is somewhere much safer.
translation: 是的。对他来说不幸的是，你偷的是假货。真品在一个更安全的地方。

english: You really thought of everything didn't you? How about the Accord? That was essential to your plans. I'm guessing it was no accident that Artur found it.
translation: 你真的考虑周全了，对吧？那协议呢？那对你的计划至关重要。我猜阿图尔找到它并非偶然。

english: I can't take too much credit from Artur there. He did do most of the work himself. I'd been looking into the Accord for a while when Artur found my research.
translation: 在那方面我不能抢阿图尔太多功劳。他确实自己完成了大部分工作。我一直在研究协议，后来阿图尔发现了我的研究。

english: When he went missing, I feared the worst. It was a nice surprise when you not only brought him back, but the Accord as well.
translation: 当他失踪时，我担心最坏的情况。当你不仅把他带回来，还带回了协议，这真是个惊喜。

english: This is a lot to take in. I don't know if I like any of it.
translation: 这信息量太大了。我不知道我是否喜欢这一切。

english: Nor do I like it myself. However, when it comes to politics, there are no perfect options. Instead, all we can do is pick the best option we have.
translation: 我自己也不喜欢。然而，在政治上，没有完美的选择。我们只能选择我们拥有的最佳选项。

english: Anyway, we will have plenty of time to discuss this later. For now, the Council needs to be dealt with. You should speak with Commander Fullore.
translation: 总之，我们以后有的是时间讨论这个。现在，需要处理议会。你应该和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: We will have to talk more later my friend. For now, the Council needs to be dealt with. You should speak with Commander Fullore.
translation: 我们以后得再谈谈，我的朋友。现在，需要处理议会。你应该和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: Hello there. It's time for us to deal with the Council. You should speak with Commander Fullore.
translation: 你好。是时候处理议会了。你应该和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: Will do. I just need to talk to Lord Hosidius first.
translation: 好的。我只需要先和霍西迪乌斯领主谈谈。

english: Lord Shayzien.
translation: 谢兹恩领主。

english: Ah... Hello there citizen.
translation: 啊……你好，市民。

english: What happened there? Why didn't you put yourself forward to become king?
translation: 刚才发生了什么？你为什么不自荐成为国王？

english: Well... It was a complex choice, citizen. I wouldn't worry about it. We're all ready to deal with the Council. Let's focus on that.
translation: 嗯...这是个复杂的选择，市民。不过你不用担心，我们已经准备好和议会打交道了。先专注这个吧。

english: Oh, it's the human. Shouldn't you be speaking with Commander Fullore?
translation: 哦，是人类啊。你不该去找富洛尔指挥官吗？

english: Actually I need to go talk to Lord Hosidius.
translation: 其实我有事要找霍西迪乌斯领主。

english: Fine. I need to speak with Lord Hosidius anyway.
translation: 好吧。反正我也要找霍西迪乌斯领主谈谈。

english: Fine. I need to speak with Commander Fullore anyway.
translation: 好吧。反正我也要找富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: Lord Hosidius wants to have a word with you. He's downstairs.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯领主想和你谈谈。他在楼下。

english: How did your chat with Lord Hosidius go?
translation: 你和霍西迪乌斯领主聊得怎么样？

english: It was definitely illuminating. It seems there was only ever really one option for Kourend's new ruler.
translation: 确实很有启发。看来库兰德王国的新统治者从一开始就只有一个人选。

english: We'll have to talk about that later. It's time to pay a visit to the Council.
translation: 我们晚点再谈这个。现在该去拜访议会了。

english: How are we doing this?
translation: 我们打算怎么做？

english: We'll join the five leaders and head to the castle. There, we'll tell the councillors everything we know and present Rose's Accord to them.
translation: 我们和五位领袖一起前往城堡。在那里，我们把知道的一切告诉议员们，并向他们提交玫瑰协定。

english: Do you think they'll come quietly?
translation: 你觉得他们会乖乖就范吗？

english: They won't have a choice. Lord Shayzien commands the Shayzien Army, and I command the Royal Guard. They'll have no one to protect them.
translation: 他们别无选择。谢兹恩领主指挥谢兹恩军队，而我指挥皇家卫队。他们将无人保护。

english: What happens then?
translation: 然后呢？

english: They'll be imprisoned. It will be for the new ruler to decide their fates. As for that, we'll aim to hold the vote Lady Piscarilius requested as soon as possible.
translation: 他们将被监禁。将由新统治者决定他们的命运。至于这一点，我们将尽快举行皮斯卡里琉斯女士要求的投票。

english: Assuming the people support Rose's Accord, we can have Lord Hosidius crowned within a few days.
translation: 假设人民支持玫瑰协定，我们可以在几天内让霍西迪乌斯领主加冕。

english: Do you think they'll support it?
translation: 你觉得他们会支持吗？

english: I think so. Many are already calling out for a king, and Lord Hosidius is popular across the whole kingdom.
translation: 我想会的。很多人已经在呼吁立国王了，而且霍西迪乌斯领主在整个王国都很受欢迎。

english: Sounds like we have everything covered, then. When do we depart?
translation: 听起来我们什么都准备好了。那我们什么时候出发？

english: As soon as you're ready. From what I hear, the protest is getting close to breaking point. We can't waste any more time.
translation: 你准备好了就走。据我所知，抗议活动快接近临界点了。我们不能再浪费时间了。

english: Ready to pay the Council a visit?
translation: 准备好去拜访议会了吗？

english: Hold the line! Under no circumstances can this castle be breached!
translation: 坚守阵地！无论如何都不能让这座城堡被攻破！

english: But Captain... They're citizens...
translation: 但是队长...他们是市民...

english: Did you not hear me? Hold the line!
translation: 你没听到我说的话吗？坚守阵地！

english: That's right, hold the line! Show everyone who you really serve!
translation: 说得对，坚守阵地！让大家看看你们真正效忠的是谁！

english: We serve Great Kourend! You are all in violation of the laws of this kingdom!
translation: 我们效忠于大库兰德！你们所有人都违反了王国的法律！

english: Laws set by your false Council! If you really served Kourend, you wouldn't be here defending those monsters!
translation: 你们那个虚假议会制定的法律！如果你们真的效忠库兰德，就不会在这里保护那些怪物！

english: Step back citizen!
translation: 退后，市民！

english: Or what? You'll kill me? Go on! I dare you to do it! See what happens!
translation: 不然呢？你要杀了我吗？来啊！我量你也不敢！看看会怎样！

english: Yeah! You can't kill us all!
translation: 没错！你杀不光我们所有人！

english: Stand back! I'm warning you!
translation: 退后！我警告你！

english: Stand down, Captain Rachelle. This situation is now under my command.
translation: 退下，雷切尔船长。现在这里由我指挥。

english: Lord Shayzien? What's going on?
translation: 谢兹恩领主？发生什么事了？

english: These citizens are to be protected. Ensure they do not enter the castle, but do not allow any harm to come to them.
translation: 这些市民必须受到保护。确保他们不进入城堡，但也不允许任何人伤害他们。

english: As you wish, Lord Shayzien. It will be done.
translation: 如您所愿，谢兹恩领主。这就去办。

english: Thank you, Captain. Now, myself and the other leaders will go and speak with the councillors. This situation will be resolved soon.
translation: 谢谢你，队长。现在我和其他领袖们要去和议员们谈谈。这个局面很快就会解决。

english: Ah, Lord Shayzien. It's good to have you here. Hopefully with your support we can get this protest under control.
translation: 啊，谢兹恩领主。很高兴您来了。希望有您的支持，我们能控制住这场抗议。

english: Though I must say, I'm a bit confused as to why everyone else is here. Is something happening?
translation: 不过我得说，我有点困惑为什么其他人都来了。发生什么事了吗？

english: That would be one way to describe it Councillor. Lord Hosidius.
translation: 可以这么说吧，议员。霍西迪乌斯领主。

english: Councillor Andrews, Councillor Unkar. We are here to present a joint declaration from the five houses of Great Kourend.
translation: 安德鲁斯议员，昂卡尔议员。我们在此提交大库兰德五大家族的联合宣言。

english: Declaration? I don't understand.
translation: 宣言？我不明白。

english: We, the leaders of the five houses of Great Kourend, declare that the Kourend Council is no longer fit to rule. As such, you are relieved of your positions with immediate effect.
translation: 我们，大库兰德五大家族的领袖，宣布库兰德议会不再适合统治。因此，你们被立即解除职务。

english: What the... What is this?
translation: 这他妈...这是什么东西？

english: Furthermore, you will both hand yourselves over to Lord Shayzien's soldiers. They will take you into custody where you will await your trial.
translation: 此外，你们俩要向谢兹恩领主的士兵自首。他们将拘留你们，等待审判。

english: Trial? Have you gone mad? Trial for what?
translation: 审判？你疯了吗？凭什么审判？

english: For the crimes of murder and high treason. Along with the now-deceased Liam Orson and Sophia Hughes, the two of you successfully conspired to murder King Kharedst IV and Crown Princess Rose.
translation: 因谋杀和叛国重罪。与现已死亡的利亚姆.奥森和索菲娅.休斯一起，你们两人成功密谋谋杀了国王卡雷斯特四世和王储玫瑰公主。

english: Liam's... dead?
translation: 利亚姆...死了？

english: This is insanity! Guards! Arrest them at once!
translation: 这太疯狂了！卫兵！立刻逮捕他们！

english: Soldiers of the Kourend Royal Guard, you serve the rightful ruler of Kourend! That is not this man. Stand down and step aside!
translation: 库兰德皇家卫队的士兵们，你们效忠的是库兰德的合法统治者！不是这个人。退下，让开！

english: No! You can't do this!
translation: 不！你不能这样！

english: David... It's over...
translation: 大卫...结束了...

english: Over? Only I decide when it's over! I am the rightful ruler of this kingdom and you all answer to me!
translation: 结束了？只有我能决定什么时候结束！我是这个王国的正统统治者，你们所有人都得听我的！

english: Guards.
translation: 卫兵。

english: Stay away from me! This is my throne! I worked too hard for you to just take it away! I'd rather die!
translation: 离我远点！这是我的王座！我付出太多心血，不能就这么被夺走！我宁愿死！

english: Do it.
translation: 动手吧。

english: Take them away.
translation: 把他们带走。

english: I need to do something first.
translation: 我得先办点事。

english: Don't take too long. Let me know when you're ready.
translation: 别太久。准备好了告诉我。

english: Well, look who it is!
translation: 哈，看看是谁来了！

english: Good to see you Martin.
translation: 很高兴见到你，马丁。

english: Can you believe it? The coronation of a king! Truth be told, there were times I wondered if this day would ever come.
translation: 你敢信吗？国王加冕！说实话，有好几次我都怀疑这一天会不会到来。

english: And is it everything you hoped for?
translation: 那跟你期望的一样吗？

english: Everything and more, my friend. And to think they even let us vote on it as well! Fantastic!
translation: 比我想的还要好，我的朋友。而且他们还让我们也投票了！太棒了！

english: Well the King certainly seems to have attracted plenty of guests.
translation: 国王陛下显然吸引了不少宾客。

english: Indeed. Seems that everyone wants to congratulate him... Or maybe they're just here for the food.
translation: 确实。好像每个人都想祝贺他...或者他们只是来吃东西的。

english: Either way, this will be an event for the ages.
translation: 不管怎样，这都会是一场令人难忘的盛事。

english: Are all the leaders here as well?
translation: 所有领袖都来了吗？

english: Most of them. Lord Shayzien was here earlier but he left. To be honest, he didn't look to be enjoying himself.
translation: 大部分都来了。谢兹恩领主之前来过，但走了。说实话，他看起来不太高兴。

english: That's not too suprising. Things weren't exactly straightforward between him and the King when this was all arranged.
translation: 这也不奇怪。当初安排这一切的时候，他和国王之间的事情就不太简单。

english: Yes, I heard there was a bit of drama here and there. Still, that's Kourend for you.
translation: 是的，我听说这里那里有些小风波。不过，这就是库兰德。

english: Now, I'll let you go and mingle. I'm sure the King himself will want a word with you at some point as well.
translation: 好了，你去交际吧。我相信国王陛下之后也会想跟你谈谈的。

english: A man who knows what needs to be done. I respect that. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you to the Archive. Come back once you have the diary and we'll discuss our next steps.
translation: 一个知道该做什么的男人。我很欣赏。去找阿西乌斯城图书馆的阿尔凯奥。他可以带你去档案馆。拿到日记后回来，我们再讨论下一步。

english: I did wonder if they had more malicious motivations. Perhaps they didn't want anyone getting their hands on Rose's writings.
translation: 我确实怀疑他们是否有更恶意的动机。也许他们不想让别人拿到罗丝的手稿。

english: Democracy is just a facade, my friend. The Council! They're meant to be a democracy! It's all a load of rubbish. Democracy is just a way of pretending the people have power.
translation: 民主只是幌子，我的朋友。议会！他们本应是民主的！全是垃圾。民主只是假装人民拥有权力的一种方式。

english: Any luck finding that key?
translation: 找到那把钥匙了吗？

english: A woman who knows what needs to be done. I respect that. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you to the Archive. Come back once you have the diary and we'll discuss our next steps.
translation: 一个知道该做什么的女人。我很欣赏。去找阿西乌斯城图书馆的阿尔凯奥。他可以带你去档案馆。拿到日记后回来，我们再讨论下一步。

english: Well let's get this panel open, then.
translation: 那我们就打开这个镶板吧。

english: The ways to unlock the other panels were hidden nearby. This one will surely be the same. Keep at it.
translation: 打开其他镶板的方法就藏在附近。这个肯定也一样。继续找吧。

english: Well read the note and see what it says!
translation: 那就读读笔记，看看上面说了什么！

english: Well go and see what's behind it.
translation: 那就去看看后面有什么。

english: Well read it and see what it says!
translation: 那就读读看上面说了什么！

english: Maybe there's something behind them.
translation: 也许它们后面有什么东西。

english: It must be somewhere nearby.
translation: 肯定就在附近某个地方。

english: Interesting. Maybe there's something around here that can tell us what the combination is.
translation: 有意思。也许附近有什么东西能告诉我们组合是什么。

english: Well keep at it. There must be something of note around here.
translation: 继续找吧。这附近肯定有什么值得注意的东西。

english: Huh? Do you hear that?
translation: 嗯？你听到了吗？

english: I'm providing important tactical support.
translation: 我在提供重要的战术支援。

english: Have a read of that note and see what you think.
translation: 读读那份笔记，看看你怎么想。

english: Hello there. This is our protest against the Kourend Council.
translation: 你好。这是我们对库兰德议会的抗议。

english: What's right with the Council?
translation: 议会有什么对的？

english: The Council is meant to be elected by the people. Despite this, the same four people have won every election since the Council was formed. No one even bothers to run against them these days.
translation: 议会本应由人民选举产生。尽管如此，自议会成立以来，每次选举都是同四个人获胜。如今甚至没人费心去和他们竞争了。

english: Did you know that the Council was just meant to be temporary? After the last king died, they were only supposed to rule until his daughter came of age.
translation: 你知道议会本来只是临时机构吗？最后一位国王去世后，他们本应只统治到他的女儿成年。

english: However, according to the Council, she went mad. Very convenient for them as it meant the Council became permanent.
translation: 然而，据议会所说，她疯了。这对他们来说非常方便，因为这意味着议会变成了永久机构。

english: Rose's personal diary went to the Library Historical Archive. I hear they have it on display there.
translation: 罗丝的私人日记被送到了图书馆历史档案馆。我听说他们在那里展出。

english: They were auctioned off recently, along with a lot of other royal possessions. The auction was a request from the King before he died. He wanted the money to go towards helping the poor of Kourend.
translation: 它们最近被拍卖了，连同许多其他皇家财产。拍卖是国王生前要求的。他希望这笔钱用于帮助库兰德的穷人。

english: I did wonder if they had more malicious motivations. Perhaps they didn't want anyone getting their hands on whatever she wrote.
translation: 我确实怀疑他们是否有更恶意的动机。也许他们不想让别人拿到她写的东西。

english: So the Council were involved in the King's death. Do you have a plan?
translation: 所以议会参与了国王之死。你有计划吗？

english: Hello there, friend. I hope things are going well out there.
translation: 你好，朋友。希望外面一切顺利。

english: Excellent stuff. Now get back to it and finish this for all of us!
translation: 太棒了。现在就回去，为我们所有人完成这件事！

english: See what you make of this.
translation: 看看这个。

english: Alright. Have fun Martin.
translation: 好吧。玩得开心，马丁。

english: Any word on Xamphur?
translation: 有赞弗尔的消息吗？

english: Nothing yet. However, we did manage to search his lair in Molch.
translation: 还没有任何发现。不过，我们设法搜查了他在莫尔奇聚落的巢穴。

english: Find anything interesting?
translation: 发现什么有趣的东西了吗？

english: Most of it had been cleared out before we arrived. There was some research left behind though. Notes on potential new spells.
translation: 我们去之前大部分东西都被清走了。不过留下了一些研究资料。关于潜在新法术的笔记。

english: Some are far too dangerous to use, but others we've found to be safe. We're preparing a tome of all the ones that are suitable. I'll make sure you get a copy once we're done.
translation: 有些法术太危险了不能用，但其他一些我们觉得是安全的。我们正在整理一本包含所有安全法术的典籍。完成后我会确保你拿到一本。

english: It's the least we can do after all you have done for us. Anyway, I won't keep you. Enjoy the coronation.
translation: 这是为了感谢你为我们所做的一切，至少能表达一点心意。好了，我不耽误你了。享受加冕典礼吧。

english: There you are! I was worried you'd miss all the fun.
translation: 你在这儿啊！我还担心你会错过所有好戏呢。

english: No chance. It's not every day you crown a new king.
translation: 不可能。又不是每天都能给新国王加冕。

english: You can say that again. You should have seen all the preperations needed. Food, drinks, entertainment, invitations... The list goes on.
translation: 确实是。你应该看看需要准备的东西。食物、饮品、娱乐、邀请函...清单多得是。

english: You'd think security would be one of the hard parts, but I actually reckon our bit is pretty straightforward in comparison.
translation: 你可能觉得安保是最难的部分之一，但说实话，相比之下我们这边其实很简单。

english: On that note, how does it feel to be serving a king now?
translation: 说到这个，现在为国王效力感觉如何？

english: I don't think it's quite sunk in yet. It still feels like it was only this morning that Councillor Hughes escaped. So much has happened in such a short time.
translation: 我感觉还没完全回过神来。感觉就好像休斯议员逃狱只是今天早上才发生的事。这么短的时间里发生了太多事。

english: Tell me about it. Had I known how this would go when Martin first recruited me, I'd have probably considered running for the hills as fast as possible.
translation: 可不是嘛。要是我当初知道事情会这样发展，马丁第一次招募我的时候，我可能就会考虑尽快逃到山里去。

english: Well, I for one am glad you didn't. We'd have never reached this point without your help.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴你没有。没有你的帮助，我们永远到不了这一步。

english: It wouldn't have been possible without you or Martin either. Have you two spoken yet?
translation: 没有你或马丁也不可能。你们俩聊过了吗？

english: Oh, I'm going to need a lot to drink before I'm ready for that conversation.
translation: 哦，我在准备好谈这件事之前还得喝很多酒。

english: Anyway, have you seen our special guest?
translation: 对了，你看到我们的特别来宾了吗？

english: It's a pleasure to finally welcome you to Great Kourend, Queen Zyanyi. You are very welcome here.
translation: 很高兴终于欢迎您来到大库兰德，扎扬伊女王。您在这里非常受欢迎。

english: The pleasure is all mine. From today, the sun will shine on our two kingdoms once more. The mistakes of the past are now behind us.
translation: 这是我的荣幸。从今天起，太阳将再次照耀我们两个王国。过去的错误已经过去了。

english: Who is she?
translation: 她是谁？

english: Zyanyi Arkan, the Sun Queen. She's the ruler of Varlamore, the kingdom in the south. This is her first visit to Kourend.
translation: 扎扬伊.阿尔坎，太阳女王。她是南方王国瓦拉莫尔的统治者。这是她第一次访问库兰德。

english: First visit?
translation: 第一次访问？

english: Indeed. The King personally invited her. He's keen to put an end to the animosity between the two kingdoms. Rumor has it she feels the same way.
translation: 没错。国王亲自邀请了她。他非常希望能结束两个王国之间的敌意。传言说她也有同样的想法。

english: Who are the knights with her?
translation: 她身边的那些骑士是谁？

english: Her royal guard, the Kualti.
translation: 她的皇家卫队，库阿尔蒂。

english: They look fancy.
translation: 他们看起来很华丽。

english: They do. If the stories are true, they're the best fighters in Varlamore.
translation: 确实。如果传闻是真的，他们是瓦拉莫尔最优秀的战士。

english: Not jealous are you?
translation: 你不是嫉妒了吧？

english: Not of that armour, that's for sure. It looks very uncomfortable.
translation: 那肯定不是那件盔甲的事。它看起来非常不舒服。

english: Ah, looks like they're done. You should go and see the King. He was pretty keen to speak to you.
translation: 啊，看来他们弄完了。你应该去见国王。他很想和你谈谈。

english: Okay. I'll see you later.
translation: 好的。回头见。

english: Good to see you, Your Majesty. Congratulations on your coronation.
translation: 很高兴见到您，陛下。恭喜您加冕。

english: Thank you my friend. Of course, none of this would have been possible without you. Let it be known that you will always be a friend of this kingdom.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友。当然，没有你这一切都不可能实现。请记住，你永远是这个王国的朋友。

english: Thank you, I'm very honoured.
translation: 谢谢，我深感荣幸。

english: As am I. In fact, I think this calls for a toast.
translation: 我也是。事实上，我认为应该为此干杯。

english: Gather around honoured guests! It's time for me to bore you all with a speech!
translation: 各位贵宾请聚过来！是时候让我用演讲来烦大家了！

english: Friends, thank you all for joining me on this special day. This is the beginning of a new chapter for Kourend, and I could not be more grateful to have you all here to celebrate with me.
translation: 朋友们，感谢大家在这个特别的日子与我相聚。这是库兰德王国新篇章的开始，我非常感激你们能在这里与我一同庆祝。

english: Still, let us not forget the hard road that led us here, nor those who were brave enough to walk along it.
translation: 不过，我们也不要忘记通往这里的艰辛道路，以及那些勇敢走在这条路上的人。

english: Martin Holt, Lydia Fullore, [player name]. Without you, we would all still be living in ignorance. You opened our eyes to the truth, and ensured a strong future for Kourend.
translation: 马丁.霍尔特、莉迪亚.福洛尔、[player name]。没有你们，我们大家仍将活在无知之中。你们让我们看到了真相，确保了库兰德王国的光明未来。

english: Now, let us all raise our glasses to these three. We are forever in their debt.
translation: 现在，让我们共同举杯敬这三位。我们永远亏欠他们。

english: Ah, there you are.
translation: 啊，你来了。

english: You wanted to speak to me?
translation: 你想找我说话？

english: I did. Sorry to take you away from the festivities. With everyone else celebrating, I thought it would be a good chance to talk in private. Don't worry. It won't take long.
translation: 是的。抱歉把你从庆典中拉出来。趁着大家都在庆祝，我觉得是个私下谈话的好机会。别担心，不会太久。

english: It's not a problem. What did you want to discuss?
translation: 没问题。你想讨论什么？

english: The councillors are behind bars and Kourend has a new ruler. On the surface, all is well again. Of course, that's not quite the case in reality.
translation: 议员们关进了监狱，库兰德有了新统治者。表面上，一切又恢复了平静。当然，现实并非如此。

english: You mean Xamphur?
translation: 你是指赞弗尔？

english: Yes. The Council did not act alone. In fact, they weren't even the true orchestrators in this. We need to find and deal with the real foe before it's too late.
translation: 是的。议会并非单独行动。事实上，他们甚至不是真正的策划者。我们必须在为时已晚之前找到并处理真正的敌人。

english: I'd be happy to help in any way I can. Xamphur and I have unfinished business.
translation: 我很乐意尽我所能提供帮助。赞弗尔和我还有未了之事。

english: I was hoping you'd say that. This is a serious threat we're facing, and I need people I can trust.
translation: 我正希望你会这么说。我们面临的威胁很严重，我需要可以信任的人。

english: So, what do you need me to do?
translation: 那么，你需要我做什么？

english: Nothing for now. I just wanted to make sure you were on board. Once we have more information on Xamphur, I will let you know.
translation: 目前没什么事。我只是想确认你支持我们。一旦我们有更多关于赞弗尔的信息，我会通知你。

english: Now, we should head back downstairs before we are missed.
translation: 现在，我们应该下楼了，免得被人发现不在。

english: Is everything alright, Your Majesty?
translation: 陛下，一切还好吗？

english: I... I can't...
translation: 我……我做不到……

english: Kandur Hosidius. You have been marked for death.
translation: 坎杜尔.霍西迪乌斯。你已被标记为死亡目标。

english: Hey Lydia. How are you doing?
translation: 嘿，莉迪亚。你还好吗？

english: It's been a rough few days since the coronation, as you can probably imagine. One moment we were crowning a new king, that next we were burying him. I'm doing okay, though. Work is a good distraction.
translation: 加冕后的这几天很艰难，你大概能想象。前一秒我们还在为新国王加冕，下一秒就在埋葬他。不过我还好。工作是个不错的分散注意力的方式。

english: Well Artur Hosidius is now the King of Great Kourend. I'm sorry you couldn't be there for the ceremony. After what happened, they felt something small would be best.
translation: 嗯，阿图尔.霍西迪乌斯现在是大库兰德国王。很遗憾你没能参加仪式。在发生那些事后，他们认为低调一些最好。

english: That's fine. I think one coronation was enough for me. Any word on the killer?
translation: 没关系。我觉得一次加冕就够了。有杀手的消息吗？

english: There's no shortage of potential suspects, but nothing solid. We've had the murder weapon sent over to Lovakengj to be examined. They have a theory, but want to do more work before they confirm it.
translation: 潜在嫌疑人不缺，但没什么确凿证据。我们已经把凶器送到洛瓦肯吉城去检验了。他们有个推测，但想在确认之前做更多工作。

english: Well let me know once they have something. I want to find whoever did this.
translation: 那他们一有结果就告诉我。我想找到做这件事的人。

english: We will.
translation: 我们会告诉你的。

english: Anything else I can do in the meantime?
translation: 这段时间我还能做点别的吗？

english: I don't think so. Lord Arceuus is trying to find out more about Xamphur, but he doesn't have anything yet. For now, all we can do is wait.
translation: 我想没有。阿西乌斯领主正在试图了解更多关于赞弗尔的信息，但还没有任何收获。目前，我们只能等待。

english: And on that note, I wanted to give you a little something to thank you for all that you've done. Not just for Kourend, but for me as well.
translation: 说到这个，我想给你一点小礼物，感谢你所做的一切。不仅为了库兰德，也为了我个人。

english: This is a bad situation we're in, but without you things would be a whole lot worse. Lord Arceuus also sent something over for you. He said you'd know what to do with it.
translation: 我们处境很糟糕，但没有你，情况会更糟。阿西乌斯领主也给你送了东西。他说你知道该怎么处理。

english: Now, I'll let you get going. Thanks again, for everything.
translation: 好了，你继续忙吧。再次感谢你所做的一切。

english: *whispers* Meet me behind the castle.
translation: *低声说* 到城堡后面见我。

english: You can say that again. You should have seen all the preparations needed. Food, drinks, entertainment, invitations... The list goes on.
translation: 可不是嘛。你真该看看需要准备多少东西。食物、饮料、娱乐、邀请函……清单老长了。

english: You need to kill that demon. Until it's dealt with, all of Port Piscarilius is at risk.
translation: 你必须杀死那个恶魔。在它被解决之前，整个皮斯卡里琉斯港都处于危险之中。

english: No. Unlike the Shayzien army, the Royal Guard serve the ruler of the kingdom directly.
translation: 不。和谢兹恩城的军队不同，皇家卫队直接效忠于王国的统治者。

english: The current ruler, or rulers as I should say, are the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom for the past twenty years, ever since the last king died.
translation: 目前的统治者，或者更准确地说统治者们，是库兰德议会。自从上任国王去世以来，他们统治了这个王国二十年。

english: No time to talk, I'm afraid. I have a lot to do.
translation: 恐怕没时间聊了。我有很多事要忙。

english: Well you don't really expect me to believe you're just here to embarrass Verzik do you? What's really going on?
translation: 你不会真以为我相信你只是来让维齐克.维图尔难堪的吧？到底怎么回事？

english: My associates prefer to keep their intentions to themselves. However, if you were to assist us with another matter, I might be able to share more.
translation: 我的同僚们更愿意保密他们的意图。不过，如果你愿意帮我们处理另一件事，我或许能透露更多。

english: Your suspicions are correct. My role here is not to embarrass Verzik Vitur. Instead, my associates have a long history with Verzik, and have sent me here to keep an eye on her.
translation: 你的怀疑没错。我来这里不是为了羞辱维齐克.维图尔。实际上，我的同僚们和维齐克有很深的渊源，派我来监视她。

english: So you're spying on her? Then why are you asking people to go and 'embarrass' her?
translation: 所以你在监视她？那你为什么还让人去‘羞辱’她？

english: Research.
translation: 研究。

english: Research?
translation: 研究？

english: Yes. As you're aware, of all those that go into the Theatre, the vast majority never come out. That said, some have managed to succeed. Of course, the vampyres would never let the citizens know this.
translation: 是的。如你所知，进入剧院的人绝大多数都没能出来。不过，确实有些人成功了。当然，吸血鬼们绝不会让市民知道这点。

english: Thanks to these successes, I've been able to gather information on Verzik and her abilities.
translation: 多亏了这些成功者，我得以收集到关于维齐克和她能力的情报。

english: Ah, so they're the ones that have been doing the spying. Still, that doesn't explain what this is all for.
translation: 啊，所以是他们一直在监视。不过，这还是没解释这一切是为了什么。

english: Verzik has abilities unlike any other vampyre. However, she did not always possess these abilities. My associates are keen to discover how she obtained them.
translation: 维齐克拥有其他吸血鬼所没有的能力。但她并非一直拥有这些能力。我的同僚们很想知道她是如何获得这些能力的。

english: You mean that thing she does where she turns into a spider?
translation: 你是说她变成蜘蛛那招？

english: Right, I think I understand now. So where do I come in?
translation: 好，我想我现在明白了。那我该做什么？

english: These were recently recovered from within the Theatre. Take a look at them.
translation: 这些是最近从剧院里找到的。你看看。

english: Eggs?
translation: 蛋？

english: Not just any eggs. These are the eggs of a nylocas, one of Verzik's arachnid pets.
translation: 不是普通的蛋。这些是尼洛卡斯蛛的蛋，维齐克的一种蜘蛛宠物。

english: Normally this wouldn't be anything special. After all, Verzik has hundreds of nylocas. However, these eggs are from a variant we've never encountered before.
translation: 通常这没什么特别的。毕竟维齐克有几百只尼洛卡斯蛛。不过，这些蛋来自一个我们从未见过的变种。

english: What's more interesting than that though is how they were obtained. For lack of a better description, the mercenary who recovered them claimed they 'fell out' of Verzik herself.
translation: 但更有趣的是它们是怎么得到的。简单来说，回收它们的雇佣兵声称这些蛋是从维齐克自己身上‘掉出来’的。

english: Verzik laid some eggs?
translation: 维齐克下了些蛋？

english: Apparently so.
translation: 显然如此。

english: How lovely. I think you've safely put me off my food for the rest of today. So you think these eggs are somehow connected to her unique abilities?
translation: 真不错。我想你今天成功地让我没胃口了。所以你觉得这些蛋和她的独特能力有关？

english: It would line up with some suspicions my associates have had for a while.
translation: 这和我同僚们一段时间以来的某些猜测吻合。

english: And I suppose you want me to look into this?
translation: 我猜你想让我调查这个？

english: Not to mention the whole turning into a spider thing I guess. I suppose you want me to look into this?
translation: 更别说她变成蜘蛛那事了。我猜你想让我调查这个？

english: That is correct. I also believe you have a friend who can help.
translation: 没错。而且我相信你有个朋友能帮忙。

english: I have a friend?
translation: 我有个朋友？

english: A dead one.
translation: 一个死掉的朋友。

english: Ah, that sounds about right. Which dead friend are we talking about here?
translation: 啊，听起来没错。我们说的是哪个死掉的朋友？

english: Ranis Drakan.
translation: 拉尼斯.德雷坎。

english: Right... And how's a dead vampyre going to help us exactly?
translation: 好吧……一个死掉的吸血鬼到底能怎么帮我们？

english: My kind have the ability to relive our memories as if they are happening again. We can also relive the memories of others if we are able to make physical contact with them. I could show you if you want?
translation: 我们这类人有能力像重新经历一样重温自己的记忆。如果我们能和他们有身体接触，也能重温别人的记忆。你想看的话我可以演示给你？

english: Please don't go poking through my memories. Also, what do you mean by 'your kind'?
translation: 请别翻我的记忆。还有，你说的‘我们这类人’是什么意思？

english: I am not at liberty to say.
translation: 我无可奉告。

english: Of course. How silly of me. And you want to relive Ranis' memories I'm guessing? Will that even work now that he's dead?
translation: 当然。我真傻。我猜你想重温拉尼斯的记忆？他都死了还能行吗？

english: We are lucky that vampyre corpses deteriorate slower than many other species. Enough of his brain should still be intact for me to work with.
translation: 幸运的是，吸血鬼的尸体腐烂得比其他许多物种慢。他的大脑应该还有足够的部分完好，让我能处理。

english: Err... Nice. What's he got to do with these eggs though?
translation: 呃……不错。不过他和这些蛋有什么关系？

english: Ranis and Verzik were close friends. He interacted with her more than anyone else did. Getting close enough to Verzik to observe her own memories will be... problematic. He is the next best option.
translation: 拉尼斯和维齐克是密友。他和她的互动比任何人都多。要接近维齐克去观察她自己的记忆会……很麻烦。他是次优选择。

english: Within his memories we can hopefully learn more about Verzik and her abilities. As for the eggs, they are our catalyst.
translation: 在他的记忆里，我们希望能了解更多关于维齐克和她的能力。至于这些蛋，它们是我们的催化剂。

english: It would take years to search through all of Ranis' mind, but I can use these eggs to help us find relevant memories much faster.
translation: 要搜索完拉尼斯所有的记忆需要好几年，但我可以用这些蛋来更快地找到相关记忆。

english: Now, I must remain here. That means you will need to recover Ranis for us.
translation: 现在，我必须留在这里。也就是说你需要替我们把拉尼斯找回来。

english: And where can I find him?
translation: 我在哪里能找到他？

english: Luckily for us, Ranis always loved the Theatre. As such, he is actually buried deep below it. You can use the staircase to the north east to access his crypt.
translation: 对我们来说幸运的是，拉尼斯一直很喜欢剧院。所以，他实际上被埋在剧院深处。你可以用东北方向的楼梯进入他的墓穴。

english: Be careful, it's well guarded. Even other vampyres are not allowed in. I suggest you take that flail of yours.
translation: 小心点，那里守卫森严。连其他吸血鬼都不允许进入。我建议你带上你的连枷。

english: Also, you don't need to bring his whole body back of course. That wouldn't be very subtle. We only need his brain.
translation: 还有，你当然不用把他的整个身体带回来。那太不隐蔽了。我们只需要他的大脑。

english: Brains are generally attached to the body you know.
translation: 你知道大脑通常是连着身体的吧。

english: I know. That's why I'd recommend you take a saw.
translation: 我知道。所以我建议你带把锯子。

english: Oh... Oh god.
translation: 哦……哦天哪。

english: Actually, I'm not that interested.
translation: 其实，我没那么感兴趣。

english: As you wish. Return to me if you change your mind.
translation: 随你便。改变主意了再回来找我。

english: I've managed to defeat Verzik!
translation: 我成功击败了维齐克！

english: Yes! After beating all of her challenges, she chose to face me herself. I couldn't fully defeat her though. She just transformed into a bat and flew away.
translation: 是的！在打败了她所有的挑战后，她选择亲自面对我。不过我没能完全击败她。她变成一只蝙蝠飞走了。

english: Very impressive. I had a feeling you would have what it takes.
translation: 非常令人印象深刻。我就觉得你有这个本事。

english: Verzik will be back soon enough. Death will not come easy for her. However, you have still been of great use to my associates.
translation: 维齐克很快就会回来。死亡对她来说不会那么容易。不过，你仍然对我的同僚们很有用。

english: Speaking of your associates, what's all this really about?
translation: 说到你的同僚，这一切到底是为了什么？

english: You again. Interested in heading back into the Theatre?
translation: 又是你。有兴趣再进剧院吗？

english: What's this thing you need from me?
translation: 你需要我做什么？

english: Where can I find Ranis?
translation: 我在哪里能找到拉尼斯？

english: You can use the staircase to the north east to access his crypt. Remember, you don't need to bring his whole body back. We only need his brain. I'd recommend you take a saw.
translation: 你可以用东北方向的楼梯进入他的墓穴。记住，你不需要把他的整个身体带回来。我们只需要他的大脑。我建议你带把锯子。

english: I think I want to be sick.
translation: 我觉得我想吐。

english: Well this is probably one of the more disgusting things I've ever done. Here goes nothing...
translation: 好吧，这可能是我做过的最恶心的事之一了。豁出去了……

english: Hey there Ranis. Didn't expect to see you again. How are you doing?
translation: 嘿，拉尼斯。没想到还能再见到你。你还好吗？

english: Well I think I might be at my lowest point in life right now. I really need to find a hobby or something.
translation: 嗯，我想我现在可能处于人生的最低谷。我真的需要找个爱好什么的。

english: I managed to recover Ranis' head.
translation: 我成功找到了拉尼斯的头颅。

english: Good work. Hand it over.
translation: 干得好。把它给我。

english: Well... I seem to have lost it.
translation: 呃……我好像把它弄丢了。

english: You should probably go and find it again then.
translation: 那你最好再去找回来。

english: Hmm... Yes, I think this will work.
translation: 嗯……是的，我想这能行。

english: It seems that Ranis has many memories of these eggs, or at least of something very similar. Thanks to my abilities, we can view these memories. Hopefully they will reveal the truth about Verzik.
translation: 看来拉尼斯有很多关于这些蛋的记忆，或者至少是非常相似的东西。多亏了我的能力，我们可以查看这些记忆。希望它们能揭示维齐克的真相。

english: Now, I suggest we start at the beginning. Take my hand.
translation: 现在，我建议我们从最开始看起。抓住我的手。

english: Why are you making this weird?
translation: 你为什么要把这事搞得这么奇怪？

english: I require physical contact to share the memory with you.
translation: 我需要身体接触才能和你分享记忆。

english: Oh... Fair enough.
translation: 哦……那好吧。

english: Do you have them?
translation: 你拿到了吗？

english: Right here, my lord.
translation: 就在这里，大人。

english: Excellent. I will take them from here.
translation: 太好了。接下来交给我吧。

english: Ranis my dear, how wonderful to see you.
translation: 亲爱的拉尼斯，见到你真是太好了。

english: And you Verzik.
translation: 你也是，维齐克。

english: I see you've wasted no time in introducing our new guest to the Theatre.
translation: 我看你毫不耽搁就把我们的新客人介绍给剧院了。

english: I must say, I find the name you've given her to be quite interesting. Not the kind of thing I'd have expected from you.
translation: 我得说，我觉得你给她取的名字挺有意思的。不像是我会从你这里想到的东西。

english: Well I thought it would be quite humorous.
translation: 嗯，我觉得这挺幽默的。

english: I see. So you intend to use her as a new challenge?
translation: 我明白了。所以你打算把她用作新的挑战？

english: It seemed an ironically fitting role for her, given that fun little narrative you came up with. Besides, with all the work you put in, it would have felt wrong to just abandon her.
translation: 考虑到你编的那个有趣的小故事，这对她来说似乎是个讽刺又合适的角色。再说了，你花了那么多功夫，就这么抛弃她感觉也不对。

english: You should not have worried about that. The things we learnt from her down in the labs more than made up for the effort.
translation: 你不必担心这个。我们在实验室里从她身上学到的东西，已经足以弥补付出的努力了。

english: Well either way, I'm glad she's here. I've found her to be quite the inspiration. Thanks to her, I've decided to give the whole place a bit of a sprucing up.
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，我很高兴她在这里。我发现她给了我不少灵感。多亏了她，我决定把整个地方好好翻新一下。

english: You're replacing all the challenges?
translation: 你要替换掉所有的挑战？

english: Absolutely! Those old ones were getting dull. It's time for some fresh excitement in this place.
translation: 当然！那些旧的都变得无聊了。是时候给这里带来点新鲜刺激了。

english: Well perhaps I have something that can help with that. I have a gift for you.
translation: 嗯，也许我有点东西能帮上忙。我有个礼物给你。

english: A gift? Oh Ranis you do spoil me!
translation: 礼物？哦拉尼斯你真是宠坏我了！

english: You can thank Lowerniel for this one. He found these eggs in an arachnid nest north of Darkmeyer. He thought you might be able to use them in your nylocas breeding program.
translation: 这个你得感谢洛维尼尔。他在达克迈尔北边的一个蜘蛛巢里发现了这些蛋。他觉得你可能能在你的尼洛卡斯蛛培育计划中用上它们。

english: How exciting! Do pass on my thanks. He is always welcome to come and pay me a visit himself, of course.
translation: 太令人兴奋了！请代我向他道谢。当然，随时欢迎他自己来拜访我。

english: The Theatre has never really been his thing.
translation: 剧院从来不是他的菜。

english: Oh Ranis, I do love your brother, but he is such a bore! He needs to learn to live a little!
translation: 哦拉尼斯，我确实喜欢你的兄弟，但他真是个无趣的人！他得学着活得潇洒点！

english: Anyway, tell me more about this nest.
translation: 总之，再跟我说说那个巢穴的事。

english: The arachnids there are highly unique. Lowerniel thinks their queen might be of a higher power.
translation: 那里的蜘蛛非常独特。洛维尼尔认为它们的女王可能拥有更高的力量。

english: A higher power? He doesn't think that silly stone he used to have is involved, does he?
translation: 更高的力量？他不会觉得是他以前那块傻石头搞的鬼吧？

english: No, he suspects something more natural.
translation: 不，他怀疑是更自然的东西。

english: Really? Well either way, if he's right, these eggs could be key to some very exciting new nylocas.
translation: 真的吗？好吧，不管怎样，如果他是对的，这些蛋可能是培育出一些非常令人兴奋的新尼洛卡斯蛛的关键。

english: I look forward to seeing the results.
translation: 我期待看到结果。

english: As do I...
translation: 我也是……

english: Interesting... Very interesting...
translation: 有意思……非常有意思……

english: That was Verzik?
translation: 那是维齐克？

english: It was. However, the memory was from many years ago, before she gained her unique abilities.
translation: 确实如此。不过，这段记忆来自许多年前，在她获得独特能力之前。

english: I see. So what's our next step?
translation: 我明白了。那我们下一步该怎么做？

english: The eggs in that memory were very similar to the ones in my possession, but they were not identical. It sounded like Verzik intended to use them to breed new nylocas.
translation: 那段记忆里的蛋和我的蛋非常相似，但并非完全相同。听起来维齐克打算用它们来培育新的尼洛卡斯蛛。

english: Perhaps that breeding is what led to the eggs you have.
translation: 也许正是那次培育造就了你手上的那些蛋。

english: And perhaps it was also the starting point for Verzik's abilities.
translation: 而且这可能也是维齐克能力的起点。

english: How can we be sure?
translation: 我们怎么能确定呢？

english: We will need to recover some of those eggs for ourselves. With them, we may be able to find further relevant memories.
translation: 我们需要自己弄到一些那种蛋。有了它们，我们也许能找到更多相关的记忆。

english: Ranis said they came from a nest north of Darkmeyer. I'll see if I can find it.
translation: 拉尼斯说它们来自达克迈尔北部的一个巢穴。我去看看能不能找到。

english: Good idea. I will remain here.
translation: 好主意。我留在这里。

english: Any reason why you're not able to join me?
translation: 有什么理由你不能和我一起去吗？

english: Actually, let me guess. Your associates...
translation: 实际上，让我猜猜。是你的同伙……
