english: My associates would prefer I remain here.
translation: 我的同伙更希望我留在这里。

english: I'm not sure why I asked. I'll be back once I've explored this nest.
translation: 我不知道我为什么要问。我探索完这个巢穴就回来。

english: So what are we doing with Ranis' head?
translation: 那我们拿拉尼斯的头颅怎么办？

english: So about that memory...
translation: 那么关于那段记忆……

english: Where can I find that nest?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到那个巢穴？

english: It's supposedly just north of Darkmeyer. Go there and see if you can find any eggs matching the ones Ranis gave to Verzik.
translation: 据称就在达克迈尔以北。去那里看看能不能找到和拉尼斯给维齐克的那些相匹配的蛋。

english: Alright. I'll be back once I've explored this nest.
translation: 好的。我探索完这个巢穴就回来。

english: Well met!
translation: 幸会！

english: Got any sulphuric acid?
translation: 有硫酸吗？

english: What? What for?
translation: 什么？要它干嘛？

english: Well I was exploring a cave west of here and I think I found your assistant.
translation: 呃，我在西边探索一个洞穴时，我想我找到了你的助理。

english: I was wondering where she got to. Where is she now?
translation: 我还想知道她去哪了呢。她现在在哪儿？

english: Ah yes... About that...
translation: 啊，是的……关于那个……

english: Well... she's dead I'm afraid. Looks like the spiders in the cave killed her. Ate most of her as well...
translation: 呃……恐怕她死了。看起来是洞穴里的蜘蛛杀了她。还把她吃掉了大半……

english: What a disaster! It's going to take forever to find a new willing assistant who's competent as well.
translation: 真是场灾难！要再找到一个既有能力又愿意的助理，可不知道要等到什么时候了。

english: Yeah... Oddly enough I can't imagine many people will be queueing up to go get themselves eaten by spiders for you.
translation: 是啊……奇怪的是，我想象不出会有多少人排队等着被蜘蛛吃掉来为你做事。

english: Still, if it helps, it looks like she did find what she was after. There's an egg sac near where I found her. If I had some sulphuric acid, I could melt through it.
translation: 不过，如果有点帮助的话，看起来她确实找到了她要找的东西。在我发现她的地方附近有一个卵囊。要是我有些硫酸，我就能把它熔穿。

english: Well I suppose I can give you some. Consider it a thank you for bringing me the news about my assistant.
translation: 好吧，我想我可以给你一些。就当是感谢你告诉我关于我助理的消息。

english: Come back when you have some room for it.
translation: 等你腾出地方再来拿吧。

english: Thanks! Want me to bring you some of those eggs?
translation: 谢谢！要不要我帮你带些那些蛋回来？

english: No, it's fine. I'll send my new assistant to get me some... Once I find a new assistant anyway.
translation: 不用了，没关系。我会派我的新助理去给我弄一些……等我找到新助理再说吧。

english: Yes, here you go.
translation: 好的，给你。

english: Looks like you already have some.
translation: 看来你已经有一些了。

english: Oh... So I do. Thanks.
translation: 哦……还真有。谢谢。

english: Did I not already give you some?
translation: 我不是已经给过你一些了吗？

english: Oh... Well I suppose I can spare some.
translation: 哦……好吧，我想我可以匀出一些。

english: I found some of those eggs.
translation: 我找到了一些那种蛋。

english: Excellent. Let's have a look at them.
translation: 太好了。让我们看看。

english: I don't actually have them with me.
translation: 我实际上没带在身上。

english: Well I'll need you to bring them here. They could be key to understanding Verzik's abilities.
translation: 嗯，我需要你带过来。它们可能是理解维齐克能力的关键。

english: Hmm... How curious...
translation: 嗯……真奇特……

english: I believe I can use these new eggs to help us find more memories of note. Hopefully they will start to present a clearer picture for us.
translation: 我相信我能用这些新蛋帮助我们找到更多值得关注的记忆。希望它们能为我们呈现更清晰的图景。

english: Well that would be nice. I'm still a bit lost to be honest... Then again, I guess that's just the norm for me.
translation: 那太好了。老实说，我还是有点迷茫……不过话说回来，我想这对我来说也是常态了。

english: Once we're done, I'll also have the eggs sent to my associates. Assuming they do have a connection to Verzik's abilities, they will come in very useful.
translation: 等我们处理完了，我也会把蛋寄给我的同伙。假设它们确实和维齐克的能力有关，那将会非常有用。

english: Your associates aren't trying to replicate her powers are they?
translation: 你的同伙不会是想复制她的力量吧？

english: Oh quite the opposite. Their hope is to find a way to counteract them.
translation: 哦，恰恰相反。他们的希望是找到一种方法来抵消它们。

english: Anyway, I think I have found a new memory for us.
translation: 总之，我想我为我们找到了一个新的记忆。

english: Bloat? Not the most elaborate of names, is it?
translation: 臃肿怪？这名字不算多巧妙吧？

english: A crude name for a crude creation.
translation: 粗糙的造物配个粗糙的名字。

english: Well it's most definitely crude... Quite disgusting as well.
translation: 好吧，它确实很粗糙……而且相当恶心。

english: Turns your stomach, does it Ranis? I'm surprised you'd find anything disgusting after what you did to that girl.
translation: 让你反胃了是吧，拉尼斯？我很惊讶，在你对那个女孩做了那些事之后，你居然还会觉得什么东西恶心。

english: I just think it's important to take a bit of pride in your work. This is a Theatre, Verzik. We should be producing art!
translation: 我只是觉得对自己的工作有点自豪很重要。这是一个剧院，维齐克。我们应该创造艺术！

english: Ranis darling, I couldn't agree more. Come have a look at this.
translation: 拉尼斯，亲爱的，我完全同意。过来看看这个。

english: A new nylocas?
translation: 一个新的尼洛卡斯蛛？

english: The athanatos! Isn't it magnificent!
translation: 阿萨纳托斯！是不是很壮观！

english: It's quite a sight to behold.
translation: 真是值得一看的景象。

english: I have you and Lowerniel to thank for this one. This is the result of those eggs you gave me.
translation: 这个我得感谢你和洛尼尔。这是你给我的那些蛋的成果。

english: I'm glad you were able to make good use of them.
translation: 我很高兴你能善加利用它们。

english: Oh I've been able to work wonders with them, and I'm not done yet. If all goes well, the athanatos will be just the beginning...
translation: 哦，我用它们创造了奇迹，而且我还没做完呢。如果一切顺利，阿萨纳托斯仅仅是个开始……

english: So Verzik did manage to use those eggs to create new nylocas. However, something is still missing.
translation: 所以维齐克确实成功用那些蛋创造了新的尼洛卡斯蛛。不过，还缺了点什么。

english: Is there another memory that could tell us more?
translation: 还有别的记忆能告诉我们更多信息吗？

english: Yes, I believe there is. Let us see what it can tell us.
translation: 是的，我相信有。让我们看看它能告诉我们什么。

english: My my... You've really outdone yourself this time.
translation: 哎呀哎呀……这次你可真是超越了自己。

english: Ranis you flatterer!
translation: 拉尼斯，你就会恭维人！

english: So was this one also the result of those eggs?
translation: 那么这个也是那些蛋的杰作吗？

english: Much more boring I'm afraid. I still have plans for those eggs, but I'm missing a key aspect right now. Don't worry, I'm sure I'll get it worked out.
translation: 恐怕要无聊得多。我对那些蛋还有计划，但目前还缺一个关键环节。别担心，我肯定能解决的。

english: Perhaps I can help. What are you missing?
translation: 也许我能帮忙。你缺什么？

english: Oh Ranis, you're not trying to steal my thunder are you?
translation: 哦，拉尼斯，你不是想抢我的风头吧？

english: Verzik, you know I wouldn't...
translation: 维齐克，你知道我不会的……

english: Just joking Ranis! I know you're far too noble for that.
translation: 开玩笑的啦，拉尼斯！我知道你太高尚了，不会那样做。

english: The thing I need is something with the ability to regenerate. Nylocas are strong in numbers, but far too weak on their own.
translation: 我需要的是具有再生能力的东西。尼洛卡斯蛛数量众多，但它们自身太弱了。

english: Hmm... I think I know just the thing. When we created the Maiden, we experimented heavily in that area.
translation: 嗯……我想我知道什么东西可以。我们创造苏加丁蒂少女时，在那个领域做了大量实验。

english: Ah, of course. You and your haemalchemy.
translation: 啊，当然。你和你的血炼术。

english: Well in the end it wasn't actually haemalchemy that gave us the answer. It came in the form of a gift from the old queen.
translation: 嗯，最终给我们答案的其实不是血炼术。而是以礼物形式从旧女王那里得来的东西。

english: Not another of her plants was it?
translation: 又是她的某种植物？

english: Precisely that! Specifically the hespori. Their bark has wonderful regenerative abilities.
translation: 正是！具体来说是赫斯波里。它们的树皮有出色的再生能力。

english: I see... Yes, I think that might just work. Thank you, Ranis.
translation: 我明白了……是的，我想那可能行得通。谢谢你，拉尼斯。

english: Hespori... Of course.
translation: 赫斯波里……原来如此。

english: I've grown a hespori before!
translation: 我以前种过一株赫斯波里！

english: What's a hespori?
translation: 什么是赫斯波里？

english: They are remarkable plants with a will of their own. Not to mention their many unique properties...
translation: 它们是奇特的植物，有自己的意志。更别提它们的许多独特特性了……

english: They were grown here back when this place was still known as Hallowvale. The Saradominist Queen of the region used them as weapons against the vampyres.
translation: 这里还被称为哈洛维尔的时候，它们就生长在这里。该地区的萨拉多明女王曾用它们作为对抗吸血鬼的武器。

english: You know your history.
translation: 你倒是很了解历史。

english: More than most.
translation: 比大多数人都了解。

english: It sounds like the vampyres found multiple uses for the hespori. Not only did they play a part in the creation of the Maiden of Sugadinti, but they were also potentially used to make a new nylocas.
translation: 听起来吸血鬼找到了赫斯波里的多种用途。不仅参与了苏加丁蒂少女的创造，还可能被用来制造新的尼洛卡斯蛛。

english: I'm guessing this is the bit where I retrieve some hespori bark for us.
translation: 我猜接下来我要去弄些赫斯波里树皮回来。

english: You are correct. However, I'd suggest you collect some from a naturally occuring hespori rather than one you've grown yourself.
translation: 你说得对。不过，我建议你从自然生长的赫斯波里上采集，而不是你自己种的。

english: Do you know where I can find one?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能找到一株吗？

english: They are native to Morytania, but they are quite rare. I'm afraid I'm not an expert on nature.
translation: 它们原产于莫利塔尼亚，但相当稀有。恐怕我不是自然方面的专家。

english: Hmm... I know of a nature spirit who lives in the swamp. He can probably help.
translation: 嗯……我知道一个住在沼泽里的自然之灵。他可能帮得上忙。

english: Perfect. I will await your return.
translation: 太好了。我等你回来。

english: So we have the eggs. Now what?
translation: 所以我们有蛋了。然后呢？

english: That memory didn't tell us too much.
translation: 那段记忆没告诉我们太多信息。

english: It seems Verzik did manage to use those eggs to create new nylocas. However, something is still missing.
translation: 看起来维齐克确实成功用那些蛋创造了新的尼洛卡斯蛛。不过，还缺了点什么。

english: That memory seemed more useful.
translation: 那段记忆似乎更有用。

english: Indeed. It seems a hespori is key to our next steps.
translation: 确实。看来赫斯波里是我们下一步的关键。

english: Where can I find a hespori?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到赫斯波里？

english: I'm not sure. They are native to Morytania, but they are quite rare. You mentioned a nature spirit who could help.
translation: 我不太确定。它们原产于莫利塔尼亚，但相当稀有。你提到过有一个自然之灵可以帮忙。

english: That's right! He lives in the swamp.
translation: 没错！他住在沼泽里。

english: Then you should go and speak to him. I will await your return.
translation: 那你去找他谈谈吧。我在这里等你回来。

english: Welcome back, my friend. I sense that you need my help with something.
translation: 欢迎回来，我的朋友。我感觉你有事需要我帮忙。

english: That's right! I'm looking for a hespori. I was hoping you might know where one is.
translation: 没错！我在找一株赫斯波里。希望你知道哪里有。

english: Ah, a hespori. They're wonderful plants. Why are you looking for one?
translation: 啊，赫斯波里。它们是奇妙的植物。你为什么要找它？

english: Err... Just some research...
translation: 呃……只是做些研究……

english: Research? What are you researching?
translation: 研究？你在研究什么？

english: Just... plants... and stuff...
translation: 只是……植物……之类的东西……

english: I see... Well do be very careful. Hespori are rare enough as it is without people damaging them.
translation: 我明白了……那你千万要小心。赫斯波里已经很稀有了，可别让人破坏了它们。

english: Yeah... I'm definitely not going to damage it in any way.
translation: 是啊……我绝对不会以任何方式破坏它的。

english: Wonderful! Now, let me see...
translation: 太好了！让我想想……

english: Yes! I can sense the presence of a hespori near here. It's to the north east, on a small island in the swamp.
translation: 有了！我能感觉到附近有一株赫斯波里。就在东北方，沼泽中的一个小岛上。

english: For you my friend, it is no problem at all.
translation: 对你来说，我的朋友，这完全不成问题。

english: Welcome back, my friend. Did you find that hespori?
translation: 欢迎回来，我的朋友。你找到那株赫斯波里了吗？

english: Can you remind me where it is?
translation: 你能提醒我它在哪吗？

english: I can sense it to the north east, on a small island in the swamp.
translation: 我能感觉到它在东北方，沼泽中的一个小岛上。

english: I found a hespori.
translation: 我找到了一株赫斯波里。

english: Perfect. Do you have some bark from it?
translation: 太好了。你从它身上拿到树皮了吗？

english: Then you should go and recover some. Be careful, for it will likely fight back. I will await your return.
translation: 那你应该去取一些回来。小心，它很可能会反击。我在这里等你回来。

english: Excellent. This is just what we needed.
translation: 太好了。这正是我们需要的。

english: Can it help us find more memories?
translation: 它能帮我们找到更多记忆吗？

english: Yes, I think so. Let me see what I can find...
translation: 是的，我想可以。让我看看能找到什么……

english: Ah, here we go. I believe we're getting close now.
translation: 啊，找到了。我相信我们快接近了。

english: Power over the Shadow Realm you say? That takes me back to the old empire.
translation: 你说掌控阴影领域？这让我想起了旧帝国。

english: That was the inspiration. Alas, the experiments didn't really go anywhere in the end.
translation: 那就是灵感来源。可惜，那些实验最后都没什么进展。

english: Such a pity. Still, he will make for a fine new challenge here. As always Ranis, you are far too generous.
translation: 真可惜。不过，他会成为这里一个不错的新挑战。一如既往，拉尼斯，你真是太慷慨了。

english: Speaking of experiments, did you think any more on my hespori suggestion for that new nylocas?
translation: 说到实验，你有没有再考虑我那个关于用赫斯波里培育新尼洛卡斯蛛的建议？

english: That I did. It's going very well so far. Still too early to be sure, but I think this could be the one.
translation: 考虑过了。目前进展非常顺利。现在下结论还为时过早，但我觉得这次可能成功了。

english: The one?
translation: 成功了？

english: Absolutely! The nylocas to end all nylocas.
translation: 当然！终结所有尼洛卡斯蛛的尼洛卡斯蛛。

english: That's quite the ambition. So when do we get to see the results?
translation: 野心不小啊。那我们什么时候能看到成果？

english: Patience now Ranis. You can't rush perfection. It won't be long now, I'm sure of it...
translation: 耐心点，拉尼斯。完美是急不来的。不会太久了，我确信……

english: Interesting, but not overly illuminating. Still, we are not far off now.
translation: 有趣，但没什么启发性。不过，我们离目标不远了。

english: There is one final memory. Let us hope it provides the answers we seek.
translation: 还有最后一段记忆。希望它能提供我们寻找的答案。

english: Alright. Let's take a look.
translation: 好吧，我们来看看。

english: The last King of the yarasa... I never thought I'd see one of their kind again.
translation: 亚拉萨的最后一位国王……我从没想过还能再见到他们中的一员。

english: Does this mean Lowerniel finally found a way home?
translation: 这是否意味着洛尼尔最终找到了回家的路？

english: It would seem so, but he did not enlighten me on how he did it.
translation: 看起来是这样，但他没有告诉我他是怎么做到的。

english: Fascinating...
translation: 真迷人……

english: Anyway, I have something you simply have to see. Come take a look.
translation: 总之，我有样东西你一定要看看。过来瞧瞧。

english: Is this...?
translation: 这是……？

english: This is the one Ranis. This is my new Queen Nylocas. All that work has finally paid off.
translation: 就是这个，拉尼斯。这是我的新尼洛卡斯蛛女王。所有努力终于有了回报。

english: It's very small.
translation: 它好小。

english: Oh don't worry darling, it will grow. I'll have to come up with a fancy name as well.
translation: 哦，别担心，亲爱的，它会长大的。我还得给它想个花哨的名字。

english: Ouch! You little...
translation: 哎哟！你这小……

english: Not what you were expecting?
translation: 没想到会这样？

english: I really thought this was the one...
translation: 我真的以为这次成功了……

english: Back to square one I guess. What a waste.
translation: 看来又得从头开始了。真是浪费。

english: That was it? She made a new nylocas, it bit her and it just died?
translation: 就这样？她造了一只新尼洛卡斯蛛，咬了它一口，然后就死了？

english: We have still gained a lot here. That bite almost certainly led to her abilities, and we know how the nylocas variant responsible was created.
translation: 我们还是收获了很多。那次咬伤几乎肯定导致了她的能力，而且我们也知道了创造那种尼洛卡斯蛛变种的方法。

english: We even have the relevant materials as well. Between them and the knowledge we now have, my associates should be able to begin work on new weapons and techniques to use against Verzik.
translation: 我们甚至还有相关的材料。有了这些材料和我们现在掌握的知识，我的同伴们应该可以开始研发新的武器和技巧来对付维兹克了。

english: But who knows what may have happened after that bite... What if we're missing some key information?
translation: 但谁知道那次咬伤之后发生了什么……如果我们遗漏了一些关键信息呢？

english: I admit, while hopefully not essential, clarity on what happened next would be very useful. However, Ranis has no further memories of use to us. There's likely to only be one place to find the truth now.
translation: 我承认，虽然希望不是必需的，但弄清楚之后发生了什么会非常有用。不过，拉尼斯已经没有更多对我们有用的记忆了。现在恐怕只有一个地方能找到真相了。

english: You mean Verzik herself?
translation: 你是说维兹克本人？

english: Correct. But for me to gain access to Verzik's memories, I'd need to make physical contact with her. That would require us to enter the Theatre, something I was quite keen to avoid.
translation: 没错。但要让我获取维兹克的记忆，我需要与她进行身体接触。这就要求我们进入剧院，而这正是我一直极力避免的。

english: I've made it through the Theatre before. I could do it again.
translation: 我以前闯过剧院。我可以再来一次。

english: I've never made it through the Theatre before, but I'm sure I can manage it.
translation: 我以前从没闯过剧院，但我确信我能应付。

english: True, but I am no fighter. However...
translation: 没错，但我不是战士。不过……

english: I know that there have been times when groups have entered the Theatre and had members not actually participate in the challenges.
translation: 我知道有些时候，队伍进入剧院后，有些成员实际上并没有参与挑战。

english: Provided the more able members of the group succeed, these individuals are still considered to have beaten the challenge.
translation: 只要队伍中更有能力的成员成功了，这些人仍然被视为通过了挑战。

english: So you want me to 'carry' you through the Theatre?
translation: 所以你想让我带你通过剧院？

english: That is an apt way of putting it. If you can get me to Verzik, I should hopefully be able to extract the memories we need. The moment of defeat will be my best opportunity, when she is weakest.
translation: 这么说很贴切。如果你能把我带到维兹克面前，我应该就能提取出我们需要的记忆。她被打败的那一刻将是我最好的机会，那时她最虚弱。

english: Okay, I think we can make this work.
translation: 好吧，我觉得我们可以做到。

english: You can still take other people in as well of course. Just use the notice board to set up a party and find suitable allies. Once you're ready, I will join you in the Theatre.
translation: 当然，你也可以带其他人一起进去。用公告板组建队伍，寻找合适的盟友。准备好了，我就会在剧院里和你汇合。

english: In that case, I'll see you in there.
translation: 既然如此，那我们里面见。

english: Can we use this bark to find more memories?
translation: 我们能利用这块树皮找到更多记忆吗？

english: Do you have any more memories for us to look at?
translation: 你还有更多记忆给我们看吗？

english: This Verzik business kind of feels like it's been a waste of time.
translation: 感觉维兹克这件事有点浪费时间。

english: Verzik made a new nylocas, it bit her and it just died. That was it.
translation: 维兹克造了一只新尼洛卡斯蛛，它咬了她一口，然后就死了。就这样。

english: Ready to enter the Theatre?
translation: 准备好进入剧院了吗？

english: I am. Remember, you need to get me all the way to Verzik herself and then defeat her. When she is at her weakest, I should be able able to extract the memories we need.
translation: 准备好了。记住，你需要一路把我带到维兹克本人面前，然后击败她。当她最虚弱的时候，我应该就能提取出我们需要的记忆。

english: Don't forget you can use the notice board to find suitable allies to join us if you don't feel comfortable doing this alone. I will join you inside once you are ready.
translation: 别忘了，如果你觉得一个人做没把握，可以用公告板找合适的盟友加入我们。你准备好了，我就会进去和你汇合。

english: You fought well. Now, let us move on. We have to reach Verzik so that I can extract her memories.
translation: 你打得不错。现在，我们继续前进。我们必须到达维兹克那里，这样我才能提取她的记忆。

english: The Maiden of Sugadinti. Such an ironic name.
translation: 苏加丁蒂少女。真是个讽刺的名字。

english: What do you know about her?
translation: 你对她了解多少？

english: Not much more than you probably know yourself. Hers is a tragic tale of misguided hope.
translation: 可能不比你知道的多多少。她的故事是一个关于误入歧途的希望的悲剧。

english: You might find it useful to know that she's a powerful user of magic. Unsurprisingly, blood magic is her specialism. I hear she also has a habit of using nylocas to further increase her power.
translation: 知道她是个强大的魔法使用者可能会对你有用。不出所料，血魔法是她的专长。我听说她还习惯用尼洛卡斯蛛来进一步增强自己的力量。

english: The Pestilent Bloat. What a disgusting monstrosity.
translation: 瘟疫肿胀怪。真是个恶心的怪物。

english: What even is it?
translation: 它到底是什么？

english: Nothing fancier than some crude necromancy. Still, that doesn't mean it's not dangerous. Don't even try to take it head on. Wait for the perfect moment and attack while it is weak.
translation: 不过是些粗劣的亡灵术。不过，这并不意味着它不危险。别试图正面硬抗。等待最佳时机，在它虚弱时攻击。

english: Nylocas... I've always hated nylocas.
translation: 尼洛卡斯蛛……我一直讨厌尼洛卡斯蛛。

english: You've encountered nylocas before?
translation: 你以前遇到过尼洛卡斯蛛？

english: Some types. Alone they're not overly dangerous, but you'll never encounter them alone. Their power is in numbers.
translation: 遇到过一些种类。单独一只并不太危险，但你永远不会单独遇到它们。它们的力量在于数量。

english: So how do I overcome that?
translation: 那我该怎么应对？

english: Different variants have different weaknesses. Prioritise your targets, and ensure you use the right weaponry against them.
translation: 不同的变种有不同的弱点。优先选择目标，确保使用正确的武器对付它们。

english: Sotetseg. One of the greater mysteries of this Theatre.
translation: 索特塞格。这个剧院里最大的谜团之一。

english: He's some sort of modified dark beast. No dark beasts have ever been encountered in Morytania, so who knows how the vampyres got him here. Perhaps he is not of this world at all...
translation: 他是一种经过改造的暗黑兽。莫利塔尼亚从未发现过暗黑兽，所以谁知道吸血鬼是怎么把他弄到这里来的。也许他根本不属于这个世界……

english: Be careful, for he has a strong affinity with the shadow realm. He will almost certainly use it against you. Expect the unexpected.
translation: 小心，他与阴影领域有很强的联系。他几乎肯定会利用这一点来对付你。要预料到意想不到的事。

english: Unexpected?
translation: 意想不到的事？

english: Yes. Survivors of the Theatre have spoken of some sort of strange shadowy maze.
translation: 是的。剧院的幸存者提到过某种奇怪的阴影迷宫。

english: The once great King of the yarasa. This prison is such a sad end for Xarpus.
translation: 曾经伟大的亚拉萨国王。这座监狱对扎普斯来说真是个悲惨的结局。

english: You feel sorry for him?
translation: 你为他感到难过？

english: Death would be preferable to a life of imprisonment. The Theatre is a testament to that.
translation: 死亡也比囚禁一生要好。剧院就是证明。

english: Anyway, we are close now. Defeat Xarpus, and the path to Verzik is clear.
translation: 总之，我们快到了。击败扎普斯，通往维兹克的道路就畅通了。

english: Any advice?
translation: 有什么建议吗？

english: He will attempt to power himself up before he fights. Try and stop that where you can. Once the fight begins, be careful of his highly poisonous attacks.
translation: 他会在战斗前试图给自己充能。尽量阻止他。战斗开始后，小心他极具毒性的攻击。

english: Okay thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: You fought well. Now, only Verzik awaits. Remember, you must fully defeat her for me to have a chance to extract her memories. Let us proceed once you are ready.
translation: 你打得不错。现在，只剩下维兹克了。记住，你必须彻底击败她，我才有机会提取她的记忆。你准备好了我们就继续。

english: Did you manage to get any useful memories from Verzik?
translation: 你从维兹克那里得到什么有用的记忆了吗？

english: Yes and no. I have a memory that I believe has answers for us. However, it is not Verzik's memory.
translation: 算是吧。我有一段记忆，相信里面有我们需要的答案。不过，那不是维兹克的记忆。

english: I think it's best if I just show you.
translation: 我想最好直接给你看。

english: Doctor... are you still there?
translation: 医生……你还在吗？

english: I'm right here, my lady. I was just finishing my notes.
translation: 我就在这儿，夫人。我刚写完我的笔记。

english: I feel... I feel... wrong.
translation: 我感觉……我感觉……不对劲。

english: My lady, as I've already said, we really should take you to my surgery in Darkmeyer. Whatever that nylocas did, it was no normal bite.
translation: 夫人，正如我已经说过的，我们真该带您去我在达克迈尔的手术室。不管那只尼洛卡斯蛛做了什么，那都不是普通的咬伤。

english: No! This is my home! You will not take me!
translation: 不！这是我的家！你们不能带我走！

english: I understand. My notes are finished now. I will leave you in peace.
translation: 我明白了。我的笔记写完了。我让您安静休息吧。

english: Peace? Yes...
translation: 安静？是的……

english: Doctor... It's... inside me!
translation: 医生……它……在我体内！

english: My lady?
translation: 夫人？

english: I can feel it! Help me!
translation: 我能感觉到它！救救我！

english: What...
translation: 什么……

english: Come... Come my pretties...
translation: 来……来吧我的小可爱们……

english: Destroy the witness... Let us dine on his corpse!
translation: 消灭目击者……让我们以他的尸体为食！

english: The rule of the vampyres is over... The rule of the nylocas has begun...
translation: 吸血鬼的统治结束了……尼洛卡斯蛛的统治开始了……

english: Verzik... She died!
translation: 维尔齐克……她死了！

english: We feared the worst, but we never anticipated something like this.
translation: 我们预料到了最坏的情况，但从未想到会发生这种事。

english: But does this mean... the Verzik in the Theatre...
translation: 但这是不是意味着……剧院里的那个维尔齐克……

english: ...is really just that nylocas in disguise. We must inform my master at once.
translation: ……其实只是那只尼洛卡斯蛛伪装而成的。我们必须立刻通知我的主人。

english: Your master? So these associates you've been going on about... they don't actually exist do they?
translation: 你的主人？所以你说的那些同伙……其实并不存在，对吧？

english: They do not. My master preferred that I keep his involvement a secret, but I feel you are now trusted enough to meet him.
translation: 确实不存在。我的主人希望我保密他的参与，但我觉得现在你足够值得信任，可以见见他。

english: Meet him? Where?
translation: 见他？在哪里？

english: In a similar way to how my kind can relive our memories, we can also communicate across great distances.
translation: 类似于我们这类生物可以重温记忆的方式，我们也可以远距离交流。

english: Another of my kind is with my master. Through the two of us, you will be able to speak with him.
translation: 我的另一个同类和我的主人在一起。通过我们两个，你将能够和他交谈。

english: Okay, I think I understand.
translation: 好吧，我想我明白了。

english: Well this is weird.
translation: 嗯，这太奇怪了。

english: It can take some getting used to. Now, I will contact my master and inform him of what we have discovered. Once I am done, I expect he will want to speak with you.
translation: 这需要一点时间适应。现在，我会联系我的主人，告诉他我们的发现。等我完成后，我预计他会想和你谈谈。

english: There. Now, when I next speak, it will be my voice you hear. However, the words are from my master.
translation: 好了。现在，当我再开口时，你听到的是我的声音。但话语来自我的主人。

english: Greetings my child. It is good that we are finally able to speak, for you have done a great service to me and my disciples.
translation: 你好，我的孩子。我们终于能交谈了，这很好，因为你为我和我的门徒们立下了大功。

english: It would be nicer if we could speak in person.
translation: 如果我们能当面交谈就更好了。

english: If that were possible, we would make it so. There are many constraints upon us. Still, these constraints are often to our benefit.
translation: 如果可能的话，我们会那样做的。我们受到许多限制。不过，这些限制常常对我们有利。

english: We share many common enemies, you and I. Enemies that infest Hallowvale like a disease.
translation: 你我有很多共同的敌人。那些像疾病一样肆虐霍洛韦尔的敌人。

english: By remaining far away from this disease, I keep us all safer. Instead, my disciples act as my eyes, ears, and hands upon Gielinor. They are the harbingers of my will.
translation: 远离这种疾病，我让我们大家都更安全。相反，我的门徒充当我在吉列诺尔的眼睛、耳朵和手。他们是我意志的先行者。

english: So where are you then?
translation: 那你到底在哪里？

english: Right... And what's your connection to Verzik?
translation: 好吧……你和维尔齐克有什么关系？

english: She was an old foe. We will not weep for her demise.
translation: 她是个老对手。我们不会为她的死而哭泣。

english: What about this nylocas that's replaced her?
translation: 那只取代了她的尼洛卡斯蛛呢？

english: A concerning development. However, you have gathered all that we need to overcome it when the time is right.
translation: 一个令人担忧的发展。不过，你已经收集了我们所需的一切，以便在时机成熟时战胜它。

english: When the time is right?
translation: 时机成熟时？

english: When the time is right.
translation: 时机成熟时。

english: So there's nothing further for us to do now?
translation: 所以我们现在没有别的事可做了？

english: No. For now, we must wait. But once again, you have my thanks. My disciple will ensure you are suitably rewarded. Know that you are now a friend of Sugadinti.
translation: 没有了。目前，我们必须等待。但我再次感谢你。我的门徒会确保你得到适当的奖赏。要知道，你现在是苏加丁提的朋友了。

english: 'Damaged roof tiles for sale'... 'Come on down to Bob's Axes'... 'Contributions welcomed to Ned's New-Window Fund'...
translation: '出售损坏的屋顶瓷砖'... '欢迎光临鲍勃的斧头店'... '欢迎为内德的新窗户基金捐款'...

english: Wait a minute, what's this?
translation: 等等，这是什么？

english: This could be worth looking into.
translation: 这或许值得调查。

english: Right, let's go and see what Sarah has in mind.
translation: 好，我们去看看莎拉有什么想法。

english: Weird... What sort of monster charges at someone and then steals a bunch of carrots?
translation: 奇怪...什么样的怪物会冲向人然后偷走一堆胡萝卜？

english: Would you look at that... Apparently our monster is picky.
translation: 你看看...显然我们的怪物很挑剔。

english: Something pretty big must have come running through here to knock this over.
translation: 一定有什么很大的东西跑过这里把它撞倒了。

english: This looks like the place. It's a long way down, though... I'll need to tie something onto the edge.
translation: 看起来就是这里了。不过下面很深...我需要把什么东西绑在边缘。

english: Huh... there's a rope already down here. I hope nooneelse has got to this monster first.
translation: 哈...这里已经有绳子了。希望没有其他人先找到这个怪物。

english: Oh it's you, my monster slayer! How goes the quest?
translation: 哦，是你啊，我的怪物杀手！任务进行得怎么样了？

english: I'm still working on it... I've managed to find its lair though.
translation: 我还在处理...不过我找到了它的巢穴。

english: Sounds like you're making progress. Take care!
translation: 听起来你正在取得进展。保重！

english: There's also a scrawled note. It's barely readable...
translation: 还有一张潦草的笔记。几乎难以辨认...

english: Well, that's not exactly reassuring.
translation: 嗯，这可不太让人安心。

english: Uhh... Nice piggy?
translation: 呃...乖猪猪？

english: Argh! My eyes!
translation: 啊！我的眼睛！

english: Argh! My eyes! The goggles do nothing!
translation: 啊！我的眼睛！护目镜一点用都没有！

english: *Sniff* *Sniff*
*Snort*
Well then, what do we have here?
translation: 那么，我们这里有什么？

english: Still breathing, eh...?
translation: 还在呼吸，呃...？

english: Seems I came at just the right time.
translation: 看来我来的正是时候。

english: We'd better get you out of here before that thing returns.
translation: 我们最好在那东西回来之前把你带出去。

english: W-what happened? Where am I?
translation: 发-发生了什么？我在哪里？

english: I think I findout more about that monster from Spria in Draynor Village before heading back down there.
translation: 我想我应该在返回那里之前，先去德雷诺村从斯普里亚那里了解更多关于那个怪物的信息。

english: Oh, you're awake!
translation: 哦，你醒了！

english: Who are you? How did I end up here?
translation: 你是谁？我怎么到这里来的？

english: My name's Spria and I'm a slayer master. You've had a nasty encounter with a Sourhog.
translation: 我叫斯普里亚，我是个杀戮大师。你遇到了一只酸猪，遭遇很糟糕。

english: A Sourhog? You mean the giant pig monster?
translation: 酸猪？你是说那个巨大的猪怪物？

english: Precisely. You're extremely lucky that I found you. Another few hours and you'd have been hog chow.
translation: 没错。你非常幸运我找到了你。再过几个小时你就成了猪饲料了。

english: Were you responding to Sarah's bounty too?
translation: 你也是响应莎拉的悬赏吗？

english: Yes... It sounded like an easy few coins...
translation: 是的...听起来像是容易赚的几个金币...

english: I thought as much. I found you on the floor of the cave, you must have been knocked unconscious.
translation: 我猜到了。我在洞穴的地板上找到了你，你一定被打昏了。

english: That thing caught me completely off-guard. Normally I can handle myself in a fight, but its spitting attack is pretty fearsome!
translation: 那个东西完全出乎我的意料。通常我能在战斗中自保，但它的喷射攻击相当可怕！

english: I have an item for you that will help you on your quest, but you don't seem to have enough space. Come and see me again when you've cleared some room.
translation: 我有一个物品给你，能帮助你的任务，但你似乎没有足够的空间。等你清理出一些空间后再来找我。

english: The beast's saliva is extremely acidic and your eyes are most vulnerable. It'll cause terrible injuries and leave you unable to attack or defend yourself very well.
translation: 这野兽的唾液酸性极强，你的眼睛最脆弱。它会造成可怕的伤害，让你无法很好地攻击或防御。

english: So how am I supposed to handle that?
translation: 那我该怎么对付它？

english: Luckily, the Slayer skill provides us with an array of useful equipment and techniques for dealing with... special foes.
translation: 幸运的是，杀戮技能为我们提供了一系列有用的装备和技术来对付...特殊的敌人。

english: In the case of our Sourhog, you'll be needing these.
translation: 至于我们的酸猪，你会需要这个。

english: This eyewear will protect you from the spitting attack, allowing you to fight the monster on equal terms.
translation: 这个眼镜能保护你免受吐痰攻击，让你能够公平地与怪物战斗。

english: Most enemies have a weakness, too. The Sourhog's thick hide provides excellent protection against slashing and insulates it from magic damage.
translation: 大多数敌人也有弱点。酸猪的厚皮对劈砍有极好的防护，并且能隔离魔法伤害。

english: You'd be best trying to pierce it with arrows or a stabbing weapon.
translation: 你最好尝试用箭或刺击武器刺穿它。

english: Go now, the bounty is all yours to claim. I suggest you recoup your strength and head back to fight it using your new goggles.
translation: 去吧，赏金全是你的了。我建议你恢复体力，然后戴上你的新护目镜回去战斗。

english: If you make it out alive, collect your bounty and then come see me so that we can speak further.
translation: 如果你活着出来，领取悬赏然后来见我，我们好进一步谈谈。

english: Why are you helping me?
translation: 你为什么帮我？

english: Well, I suppose I could have left you in there to be eaten...
translation: 嗯，我想我本可以把你留在那里被吃掉...

english: But you know what that'd make me? A monster. And as a slayer master, that's really not a great look.
translation: 但你知道那会让我变成什么吗？一个怪物。而作为杀戮大师，那可不太好看。

english: Besides, my father always taught me that knowledge is worth more than gold. I'm happy to sacrifice a few coins in order to pass my experience on to you.
translation: 此外，我父亲总是教导我，知识比黄金更值钱。我很乐意牺牲几个金币，把我的经验传授给你。

english: Well, I sure am glad you were there to lend a hand. Thank you!
translation: 嗯，我真的很高兴你在那里帮我一把。谢谢你！

english: Don't mention it. Was there something else?
translation: 不客气。还有别的事吗？

english: How did I end up back in Draynor Village?
translation: 我怎么回到德雷诺村的？

english: I carried you out and dragged you back here to my house to recover, it really wasn't easy. You're welcome to rest here for as long as you need.
translation: 我把你背出来，拖回我家休养，可真不容易。你愿意在这里休息多久都行。

english: Was there something else?
translation: 还有别的事吗？

english: You said you were a slayer master. What's that?
translation: 你说你是个杀戮大师。那是什么？

english: There are many of us. We're experts in the ancient art of monster slaying. People from across Gielinor come to us for tasks and advice.
translation: 我们是古老怪物杀戮技艺的专家。来自吉莱诺各地的人们来找我们接任务和寻求建议。

english: Well... actually, I'm fairly new to this. I've been learning from my father, Turael, for many years. We decided it was finally time for me to continue the family profession.
translation: 嗯...其实，我对此还相当新手。我向我父亲图拉尔学习了很多年。我们决定是时候让我继承家族事业了。

english: Can I have another pair of Reinforced Goggles?
translation: 我能再要一副加固的护目镜吗？

english: No, you're still wearing the last pair I gave you!
translation: 不行，你还戴着我上次给你那副呢！

english: You've still got the last one I gave you, it's there in your inventory! Those things aren't cheap, you know.
translation: 你还有我上次给你的那副，就在你的背包里！那些东西可不便宜，你知道的。

english: I know many people all across Gielinor, and my sources tell me you still have the last one in your bank.
translation: 我在整个吉莱诺认识很多人，我的消息来源告诉我你银行里还有上次那副。

english: Sure, I have another going spare. Please try to take better care of these.
translation: 当然，我还有一副备用的。请尽量好好保管它们。

english: What can you tell me about the Sourhog?
translation: 你能告诉我关于酸猪的什么信息？

english: Well, I'm not much of a history buff... But I'll tell you what I know.
translation: 嗯，我不太是历史爱好者...但我会告诉你我所知道的。

english: Many years back, before even I was around, there were two rival family farms not far from where we're standing.
translation: 很多年前，甚至在我出生之前，离我们现在站的地方不远有两家互相竞争的家族农场。

english: Every year the village would hold a 'Finest Swine in Show' prize at the annual faire.
translation: 每年村子里都会在年度集市上举办'最佳猪展'奖项。

english: The same farmer would win year after year without fail. Driven mad with jealousy, his rival decided to hire a dodgy dark wizard to give him an edge over the competition.
translation: 同一个农夫每年都赢，从不失手。他的对手嫉妒得发疯，决定雇用一个可疑的黑巫师，让他在竞争中占上风。

english: The wizard attempted to alter the pig's appearance. I'm sure you can guess how well that went!
translation: 魔法师试图改变猪的外貌。我相信你能猜到结果如何！

english: Long story short, the mutant, what we now know as a Sourhog, went on a brief rampage and escaped.
translation: 长话短说，那个突变体，也就是我们现在所说的酸猪，短暂地狂暴了一阵然后逃走了。

english: It must have somehow managed to reproduce, because people have reported seeing them in groups.
translation: 它一定设法繁殖了，因为人们报告说看到它们成群出现。

english: Up until now, so long as they were left alone, they'd keep to themselves. Rumors are, they live in deep underground caverns, scavenging what they can find.
translation: 直到现在，只要不去打扰它们，它们就会安分守己。传言说，它们住在深深的地下洞穴里，搜寻能找到的东西。

english: But if they're living so close-by and attacking people on roads, then... they must be getting bold and trying to resurface.
translation: 但如果它们住得这么近，还在路上袭击人，那么...它们一定是变得大胆了，试图重新出现。

english: That'll be all for now.
translation: 暂时就这些了。

english: Very well. Good luck, slayer.
translation: 很好。祝你好运，杀戮者。

english: I don't want to go back down there without wearing the right equipment!
translation: 我不想没有穿戴正确的装备就回去那里！

english: I don't think Spria will be rescuing me this time. If I go in there, I'm fighting this thing to the death!
translation: 我觉得斯普里亚这次不会救我了。如果我进去，我要和这玩意儿决一死战！

english: Before I leave, I should go and collect a foot from that dead Sourhog as proof of my kill.
translation: 我应该去那只死酸猪那里收集一只猪脚作为杀死它的证据。

english: Perhaps I should go and get something sharp.
translation: 也许我应该去找点锋利的东西。

english: I don't think that's sharp enough to cut a foot off...
translation: 我觉得那不够锋利，切不下脚...

english: I've already collected a foot from this thing. I should take it to Sarah.
translation: 我已经从这个东西上收集了一只脚。我应该把它带给莎拉。

english: I don't need to go back down there right now. I should take the foot to Sarah and collect my reward.
translation: 我现在不需要回去那里。我应该把脚带给莎拉并领取奖励。

english: I did it! I killed the Sourhog!
translation: 我做到了！我杀死了酸猪！

english: Nicely done. Did you collect your reward from Sarah?
translation: 干得好。你从莎拉那里领到奖励了吗？

english: Go and collect your reward and then come and speak with me.
translation: 去领取你的奖励，然后来和我谈谈。

english: I guess I'll go and get you some proof.
translation: 我想我会去给你弄些证据来。

english: Feeling better now that the monster's gone?
translation: 怪物走了，感觉好些了吗？

english: Very much so! Thanks again. What was it, anyway?
translation: 好多了！再次感谢。那到底是什么？

english: It was a Sourhog. A giant bipedal pig creature!
translation: 是一只酸猪。一个巨大的双足猪生物！

english: Oh crumbs... I think I've heard of those... My grandfather was always rambling on about them.
translation: 哦天哪...我想我听说过那种东西...我祖父总是唠叨它们。

english: Nevermind... that's all history now. Weren't you heading off to see Spria?
translation: 算了...那都是过去的事了。你不是要去找斯普里亚吗？

english: Yes, I suppose I should get going.
translation: 是的，我想我该出发了。

english: I did it! I killed the Sourhog and collected the bounty from Sarah.
translation: 我做到了！我杀死了酸猪并从莎拉那里领了悬赏。

english: Very impressive, slayer. I'm glad that the goggles served you well.
translation: 非常令人印象深刻，杀戮者。我很高兴护目镜对你有用。

english: Although, these Sourhogs often live in primitive tribes. I fear that where there's one, there's likely to be more to follow.
translation: 不过，这些酸猪通常生活在原始部落中。我担心发现一只，可能还会有更多。

english: We may have to monitor that lair from time to time to keep their population in check.
translation: 我们可能需要不时监视那个巢穴，控制它们的数量。

english: I've noticed that you've unlocked the ability to craft slayer helms. From now on, when assembling one, fasten a pair of Reinforced Goggles to the eye holes to gain their benefit.
translation: 我注意到你已经解锁了制作杀戮头盔的能力。从现在起，在组装头盔时，将一副加固的护目镜固定在眼孔处以获得其效果。

english: While we're on the topic, I can upgrade any of your existing slayer helms now.
translation: 说到这个话题，我现在可以升级你任何现有的杀戮头盔了。

english: That should do the trick.
translation: 这应该就行了。

english: By the way, you seem to have a natural talent for killing monsters. Would you like a new slayer task now?
translation: 顺便一提，你似乎有杀死怪物的天赋。你现在想要一个新的杀戮任务吗？

english: What's this big hole in the ground all about?
translation: 地上那个大洞是怎么回事？

english: Oh I wish I knew for sure... All I do know is that it opened seemingly by itself a few months ago. It was first discovered by the students over at the digsite, a few of which have gone down there but never returned.
translation: 唉，我也想知道到底是怎么回事……我只知道它似乎是几个月前自己裂开的。最初是考古场的学生发现的，有几个下去了，但再也没回来。

english: They told me about it straight away.
translation: 他们立刻告诉了我这件事。

english: So why is it important to you?
translation: 那么为什么这对你很重要？

english: A few reasons, but I think the situation is beyond help now.
translation: 有几个原因，但我觉得现在的情况已经无可救药了。

english: What situation? Maybe I can help.
translation: 什么情况？也许我能帮忙。

english: I suppose it wouldn't hurt to tell you. I'm waiting to see my son Tolna. Don't suppose you've seen him?
translation: 我想告诉你也无妨。我在等我的儿子托尔纳。你没见过他吧？

english: Your son, Tolna? I don't know, what does he look like?
translation: 你的儿子托尔纳？我不知道，他长什么样？

english: I don't really know.
translation: 我真的不知道。

english: You don't know what your own son looks like?
translation: 你不知道自己儿子长什么样？

english: No. You see, I haven't seen him for... for... 25 years now. He just ran away one day and never returned. I'm hoping he's down this rift as I know he headed in this direction. My husband went to look, but he hasn't
translation: 是的。你看，我已经……已经25年没见过他了。有一天他就这么跑掉了，再也没回来。我知道他是往这个方向走的，所以我希望他在这个裂隙里。我丈夫去找他了，但他还没

english: returned for days.
translation: 已经好几天没回来了。

english: Would you like me to go down to look for your husband and son?
translation: 你想让我下去找你的丈夫和儿子吗？

english: You would do that? Oh thank you so much!
translation: 你愿意这么做？哦太感谢你了！

english: Don't worry. I'll investigate.
translation: 别担心。我会去调查的。

english: Thank you. You can use a rope to get into the rift, just attach it at the edge.
translation: 谢谢你。你可以用一条绳子进入裂隙，只要把它固定在边缘就行。

english: Be careful.
translation: 小心点。

english: Surely by now they'd both be dead?
translation: 到现在他们肯定都死了吧？

english: What?!?!
How could you say such a thing? Get away from me!
translation: 你怎么能说出这种话？离我远点！

english: Have you discovered anything yet?
translation: 你发现什么了吗？

english: Sorry, what am I supposed to do again?
translation: 抱歉，我要做什么来着？

english: Go into the rift beside me and find my husband and son!
translation: 进到我旁边的裂隙里去找我的丈夫和儿子！

english: Ah, I'm on my way!
translation: 啊，我这就去！

english: Why should I, Tolna, be trapped in such a wretched place?
translation: 为什么我，托尔纳，要被困在这种破地方？

english: Arrghh, It's not fair! Feel my ANGER!
translation: 啊呃，这不公平！感受我的愤怒！

english: Hi, I've been down into the rift and I found a strange room. I also heard a voice claiming to be called Tolna.
translation: 嗨，我下到裂隙里了，发现一个奇怪的房间。我还听到一个声音自称是托尔纳。

english: My son! What did he say?
translation: 我儿子！他说了什么？

english: He said, 'Why should I, Tolna, be trapped in such a wretched place? Feel my ANGER!'.
translation: 他说：“为什么我，托尔纳，要被困在这种破地方？感受我的愤怒！”

english: Who can be surprised at his frustration?
translation: 他的挫败感谁会感到惊讶呢？

english: It's a very aggressive room. I think I need to defeat the monsters in there.
translation: 那是一个非常具有攻击性的房间。我想我需要打败里面的怪物。

english: Don't waste any time, his life could depend on you.
translation: 别浪费时间了，他的命可能就靠你了。

english: Arrrgghhh!
Wow! How did I do that? There's something truly mental about this place!
translation: 哇！我是怎么做到的？这个地方真有点精神错乱的感觉！

english: Where are you going?
translation: 你要去哪里？

english: I can't live with your rules any more, Mother.
translation: 我再也受不了你的规矩了，母亲。

english: I'm tired of working hard for very little money. There's great wealth that's mine for the taking!
translation: 我厌倦了辛苦工作却赚那么少钱。有巨大的财富等着我去取！

english: But why? We're surviving perfectly fine on what we're earning.
translation: 但为什么？我们靠赚的钱过得挺好的。

english: I'm tired of your pathetic outlook. Good bye.
translation: 我受够了你可悲的见解。再见。

english: Tolna?
translation: 托尔纳？

english: TOLNA !!!
translation: 托尔纳！！！

english: I managed to defeat the monsters in the room!
translation: 我成功打败了房间里的怪物！

english: Have you found him then?
translation: 那么你找到他了吗？

english: Sorry, I've yet to enter the next room.
translation: 抱歉，我还没进下一个房间。

english: Please hurry!
translation: 请赶快！

english: It's so quiet and dark. I FEAR I may never escape this horrid place.
translation: 这么安静又黑暗。我害怕我可能永远逃不出这个可怕的地方。

english: Mum, Dad, help me!
translation: 妈，爸，救救我！

english: Hmmm, no light sources. So why can I still see down here? This can't just be a simple dungeon.
translation: 嗯，没有光源。那我为什么还能看见下面？这不可能只是个简单的地牢。

english: Hi. I've made my way into a second room. I heard your son's voice again as well.
translation: 嗨。我进到了第二个房间。我又听到了你儿子的声音。

english: What did he say? What did he say?
translation: 他说了什么？他说了什么？

english: 'It's so quiet and dark. I FEAR I may never escape this horrid place. Mum, help me!'
translation: “这么安静又黑暗。我害怕我可能永远逃不出这个可怕的地方。妈，救救我！”

english: You must save him! Help him get over his fear!
translation: 你一定要救他！帮他克服恐惧！

english: What on Gielinor?
translation: 这到底是怎么回事？

english: Ahhhh
Help me!
translation: 救救我！

english: Is anybody there?
translation: 有人吗？

english: I can't see!
translation: 我看不见！

english: I don't like looking in these holes but I must!
translation: 我不喜欢看这些洞，但我必须看！

english: I don't feel quite so afraid now.
translation: 我现在不那么害怕了。

english: These holes aren't that spooky.
translation: 这些洞没那么吓人。

english: This isn't so scary after all!
translation: 其实也没那么可怕！

english: Phew, I don't feel so scared now. This feels like the figment of someone's imagination!
translation: 呼，我现在不那么害怕了。感觉就像是某个人想象的产物！

english: I've overcome fear in the second room and an exit has been illuminated.
translation: 我已经克服了第二个房间的恐惧，一个出口被照亮了。

english: What can you see?
translation: 你看到了什么？

english: I've done nothing wrong... Arrrghhh...

translation: 嗨。我已经战胜了第三个房间。

english: Are you any closer to finding my son?

english: I think I may be getting closer.
translation: 我想我可能越来越接近了。

english: Please don't waste any time.
translation: 请不要浪费任何时间。

english: What's the point? No-one will ever help me.
translation: 有什么意义？没人会帮我的。

english: I'm not worth anything. Will anyone ever combat my HOPELESSNESS?
translation: 我毫无价值。有人会对抗我的绝望吗？

translation: 我穿过了第四个房间。我一进去你儿子的声音就对我说话了！

english: Oh my! What did he say?
translation: 哦天哪！他说了什么？

english: He said, 'What's the point? Why do I defy such HOPELESSNESS? No-one will ever help me'.
translation: 他说：“有什么意义？我为什么要反抗这种绝望？没人会帮我的。”

english: You must fight to give him back his hope!
translation: 你必须战斗，把希望还给他！

english: Can I succeed?
translation: 我能成功吗？

english: Is there any end to killing these monsters?
translation: 杀这些怪物有完没完？

english: This is hard work!
translation: 这活儿真累！

english: I've almost killed them all now!
translation: 我差不多把他们都杀光了！

english: Maybe if I kill one more?
translation: 也许再杀一个？

english: A bridge of hope! Tolna should feel that help is at hand by now!
translation: 一座希望之桥！托尔纳现在应该能感觉到帮助就在眼前了！

english: I have endured against hopelessness to finish the fourth room.
translation: 我承受住了绝望，完成了第四个房间。

english: Any sight of my son?
translation: 有我儿子的消息吗？

english: You must find him and bring him back to me. Please, I beg you.
translation: 你一定要找到他，把他带回来。求你了。

english: Don't worry, I will find him!
translation: 别担心，我会找到他的！

english: Son! Is that you?
translation: 儿子！是你吗？

english: Please speak to me! Tolna?
translation: 请跟我说话！托尔纳？

english: You'll always be my son!
translation: 你永远是我的儿子！

english: There must be a way.
translation: 一定有办法的。

english: Don't give up so easily!
translation: 别这么轻易放弃！

english: Sorry, but your mother and I...
translation: 抱歉，但你母亲和我……

english: tried so hard to find you!
translation: 费了这么大劲才找到你！

english: Your father isn't lying.
translation: 你父亲没有说谎。

english: Please! You must help my son! He's beyond sense.
translation: 求你了！你必须帮帮我儿子！他已经失去理智了。

english: I take it you have travelled through the mental dilemmas of my son, as I have.
translation: 我想你已经像我一样，经历了我儿子的精神困境。

english: That's correct.
translation: 没错。

english: Now you must do what I cannot, conquer the physical dilemma!
translation: 现在你必须做我做不到的事——征服他的肉体困境！

english: I will try.
translation: 我会试试。

english: Thank you stranger.
translation: 谢谢你，陌生人。

english: I've found your son.
translation: 我找到你儿子了。

english: And your husband, but I'm afraid your son is no longer physically what he once was.
translation: 还有你丈夫，但恐怕你儿子的身体已经不再是原来的样子了。

english: Can you save them?
translation: 你能救他们吗？

english: I think I've saved your son.
translation: 我想我已经救了你儿子。

english: Please talk to him, make sure he's OK!
translation: 请和他谈谈，确保他没事！

english: I have returned your son to his normal state!
translation: 我已经让你儿子恢复正常了！

english: And you've spoken to him?!?
translation: 那你和他谈过了？！？

english: Er, no, sorry. I just came back here to tell you.
translation: 呃，没有，抱歉。我只是回来告诉你一声。

english: What are you waiting for, bring him back to me!
translation: 你还等什么，把他带回来给我！

english: TOLNA !!!
translation: 托尔纳！！！

english: Sorry? What happened?
translation: 什么？发生什么事了？

english: You've been trapped down here for years. I've come to rescue you on behalf of your parents.
translation: 你被困在这里好几年了。我是受你父母之托来救你的。

english: Oh yeah. I was looking for the legacy of a civilisation that used to live down here.
translation: 哦，对。我在寻找一个曾经住在这里的文明的遗产。

english: Son!
translation: 儿子！

english: Father? Oh, I'm so sorry, can you ever forgive me?
translation: 父亲？哦，我太抱歉了，你能原谅我吗？

english: Don't worry, I'm just glad you're back to yourself. Are you OK?
translation: 别担心，我很高兴你恢复了正常。你还好吗？

english: I'm fine, my memories are slowly returning. How's mother?
translation: 我没事，我的记忆正在慢慢恢复。母亲怎么样？

english: She misses you dearly!
translation: 她非常想念你！

english: Where is she?
translation: 她在哪里？

english: She's up at the surface waiting for you.
translation: 她在地面上等你。

english: Thank you traveller, I'm glad my wife and I never gave up hope. We should return to her and tell her the good news.
translation: 谢谢你，旅行者。我很高兴我和妻子从未放弃希望。我们应该回去告诉她这个好消息。

english: Sorry but your mother and I...
translation: 抱歉，但你母亲和我……

english: ...tried so hard to find you!
translation: ……那么努力地寻找你！

english: Thank you so much. I truly owe you for your help.
translation: 非常感谢。我真的很感激你的帮助。

english: I'm just glad I could help.
translation: 我很高兴能帮上忙。

english: Hello Tolna.
translation: 你好，托尔纳。

english: Hi. Thanks again for saving me, I'm so glad to be out of that horrible place. I was foolish to ignore my parents' warnings when I ran away that day. Luckily I've been able to patch things up with them so they've
translation: 嗨。再次感谢你救了我，我很高兴能离开那个可怕的地方。那天我逃跑时无视父母的警告真是太蠢了。幸运的是，我已经和他们和好了，所以他们...

english: returned home with peace of mind.
translation: ...安心地回家了。

english: What exactly happened to you down there?
translation: 你在下面到底发生了什么？

english: I managed to find the remnants of the ancient civilisation that the stories talked about. It seems people used to worship a god there years ago in numbers far greater than a simple cult following. Sadly there is little
translation: 我找到了传说中那个古代文明的遗迹。似乎多年前那里的人们崇拜一位神，人数远不止一个简单的教派。可惜剩下的东西很少...

english: remaining so I have nothing else to tell. As soon as I entered this area the ground swallowed me whole. I felt there was something watching, waiting. It's like there is some evil power under the ground that wanted me to
translation: ...所以我没什么可说的了。我一进入这个区域，地面就把我整个吞没了。我感觉有什么东西在注视、在等待。就像地下有某种邪恶力量想要我...

english: suffer. As if it got some sort of empowerment from it. At least what ever it is, it doesn't want to reveal itself to the world yet...
translation: ...受苦。好像它能从中获得某种力量。至少不管它是什么，它还不打算向世界现身...

english: At least we have a warning. Did you manage to retrieve anything?
translation: 至少我们有了警告。你拿回什么东西了吗？

english: Not really, just a few coins, which you're welcome to have.
translation: 没什么，就几枚金币，你想要就拿去吧。

english: Thanks. So what are you going to do now?
translation: 谢谢。那你现在打算做什么？

english: I've decided to keep open the rift. There is a part of it that is perfectly laid out for combat training and remnants of my subconscious remain in there. I want to show people the problems I have faced, so that they
translation: 我决定让裂隙保持开放。里面有一部分非常适合战斗训练，而且我潜意识的残余还在那里。我想让人们看到我面临过的问题，这样他们...

english: may learn from them. You're welcome to go down there and practice fighting any time.
translation: ...可以从中学习。欢迎你随时下去练习战斗。

english: Hello, do you have a cat?
translation: 你好，你有猫吗？

english: I do but my cat is in a safe place.
translation: 我有，但我的猫在一个安全的地方。

english: Oh, hmm.
translation: 哦，嗯。

english: Hello, I see you have a cat.
translation: 你好，我看到你有一只猫。

english: Indeed I do! Do you have a cat?
translation: 我确实有！你有猫吗？

english: I do! His name is Bob but I can't find him!
translation: 我有！他叫鲍勃，但我找不到他了！

english: I haven't seen him for a week! What am I to do?!
translation: 我已经一个星期没见到他了！我该怎么办？！

english: Meow, meow.
translation: 喵，喵。

english: What a wet blanket, Bob can look after himself.
translation: 真是个扫兴的家伙，鲍勃能照顾好自己的。

english: I know puss, but he is in distress.
translation: 我知道，猫咪，但他现在很苦恼。

english: Whaa...
translation: 哇啊……

english: Tell you what. I'll help you!
translation: 这样吧，我来帮你！

english: Would you? Oh that would be so great!
translation: 真的吗？哦，那太好了！

english: I don't want to leave the house in case Bob comes back.
translation: 我不想离开家，万一鲍勃回来了呢。

english: He must be hungry by now!
translation: 他现在一定饿了！

english: This guy gets on my nerves.
translation: 这家伙真让我神经紧张。

english: Er... Where did you see Bob last?
translation: 呃……你最后一次见到鲍勃是在哪里？

english: Well he usually comes back to me once a week. Usually a Wednesday a bit before lunchtime.
translation: 嗯，他通常每周回来一次。通常是周三午饭前一点。

english: I wonder why it's on a Wednesday.
translation: 我在想为什么是周三。

english: Hmph, well, this week he hasn't come back for his food and I'm worried.
translation: 哼，好吧，这周他没回来吃东西，我很担心。

english: So he could be anywhere?
translation: 所以他可能在任何地方？

english: I've just had an idea!
translation: 我刚想到一个主意！

english: Oh my, you win... a biscuit!
translation: 哦天哪，你赢了……一块饼干！

english: Puss!
translation: 猫咪！

english: Do you want to help or not?!
translation: 你到底帮不帮忙？！

english: I said I would, didn't I?
translation: 我说过我会帮的，不是吗？

english: My friend Hild is cleverer than me...
translation: 我的朋友希尔德比我聪明……

english: ANYONE would be 'cleverer'!
translation: 任何人都比你‘聪明’！

english: Hehe!
translation: 嘿嘿！

english: This isn't funny!
translation: 这一点都不好笑！

english: Where was I? Oh yes... my friend Hild might be able to locate where Bob is, she lives in the house just up the road.
translation: 我说到哪了？哦对了……我的朋友希尔德也许能找出鲍勃在哪里，她就住在路那头的那栋房子里。

english: Ok. I'll go speak to her!
translation: 好的，我去跟她谈谈！

english: Have you spoken to Hild about locating Bob?
translation: 你跟希尔德谈过找鲍勃的事了吗？

english: She lives in the village, just follow the path north a little.
translation: 她住在村子里，沿着这条路往北走一点就到了。

english: Ok, I'll speak to her.
translation: 好的，我去跟她谈谈。

english: Greetings Adventurer, why have you come to me in my abode?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你为什么来我的住所找我？

english: Greetings Hild, I am trying to find Unferth's cat...
translation: 你好，希尔德，我在找昂弗斯的猫……

english: Unferth's cat? Pfft! Unferth is Bob's human!
translation: 昂弗斯的猫？噗！昂弗斯是鲍勃的人类！

english: Your cat speaks some truth, it is humans that misinterpret their relationship with cats.
translation: 你的猫说得有些道理，是人类误解了自己和猫的关系。

english: You understand what my cat is saying?!
translation: 你听得懂我的猫在说什么？！

english: Bob didn't come home this week.
translation: 鲍勃这周没回家。

english: Hmm. This is not like Bob, I wonder what could be the problem?
translation: 嗯。这可不像鲍勃，我想知道会是什么问题？

english: I don't think there is a problem, Bob is probably chasing females again!
translation: 我觉得没什么问题，鲍勃大概又在追母猫了！

english: Hello? I'm still here!
translation: 喂？我还在这儿呢！

english: I am sorry [player name]. I will help Unferth find Bob, he has been a friend of mine for many years.
translation: 对不起，[player name]。我会帮昂弗斯找到鲍勃的，他是我多年的朋友。

english: Ah... good! He could be anywhere though!
translation: 啊……太好了！不过他可能在任何地方！

english: I see you have an Amulet of Catspeak. If you open the amulet up, you will see contained inside is a mechanism. If this is enchanted correctly it can be used to locate a cat, in our case Bob. If you bring me five death runes
translation: 我看到你有一个猫语护身符。如果你打开护身符，你会看到里面有一个机关。如果正确附魔，它可以用来定位一只猫，在我们这里就是鲍勃。如果你给我五枚死亡符文，

english: then I will be able to perform the enchantment for you.
translation: 我就能为你施展附魔。

english: I don't have the death runes.
translation: 我没有死亡符文。

english: Greetings Adventurer, do you have the death runes so I can enchant your Amulet of Catspeak?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你有死亡符文了吗？这样我就能给你的猫语护身符附魔了。

english: Bob! I've found you at last!
translation: 鲍勃！我终于找到你了！

english: Hi there son.
translation: 嗨，孩子。

english: The humans have been looking for you, they get worried too easily.
translation: 人类一直在找你，他们太容易担心了。

english: Ah. I should've realised Unferth would miss me.
translation: 啊。我早该意识到昂弗斯会想我的。

english: Sigh. I can't believe it but I've fallen for Neite!
translation: 唉。真不敢相信，但我爱上了奈特！

english: Neite...now, I'm sure I've heard that name before...
translation: 奈特……嗯，我肯定以前听过这个名字……

english: What a beauty she is! It's the way the shimmer from the hot sand makes her eyes sparkle, the way she flicks her tail as she leaps gracefully across the pyramids, the way she cleans herself after a good rat. As you humans
translation: 她多美啊！热沙的微光让她的眼睛闪闪发光，她优雅地跃过金字塔时甩动尾巴的样子，她吃完一只好老鼠后清理自己的样子。就像你们人类

english: would say, she's the cat's whiskers. Oh how I long to be curled up with her in front of a log fire and a big bowl of tuna. Menaphos would be a great place to start a family.
translation: 说的，她是猫中翘楚。哦，我多么渴望和她一起蜷缩在炉火前，面前放着一大碗金枪鱼。梅纳福斯会是个组建家庭的好地方。

english: Wow! He's got it bad! Real bad! I never thought I'd see the day!
translation: 哇！他陷得太深了！太深了！我从没想过会有这一天！

english: I know but there is something about her. The way she...well, it's everything! Oh, the hidden pain of love. Love lies not with the eyes but with the mind, and therefore is the winged Cupid painted blind.
translation: 我知道，但她身上有种特别的东西。她那种……嗯，一切！哦，爱情隐藏的痛苦。爱不在眼中，而在心中，因此带翅膀的丘比特被画成盲人。

english: I'm starting to feel sick...
translation: 我开始觉得恶心了……

english: I haven't been home because I've wanted to be alone.
translation: 我没回家是因为我想一个人待着。

english: Does Neite feel the same way about you?
translation: 奈特对你有同样的感觉吗？

english: She said she has feelings for me but would never get involved with someone like me that has no family or status.
translation: 她说她对我有感觉，但绝不会和像我这样没有家庭或地位的人交往。

english: Don't you know who your parents are?
translation: 你不知道你的父母是谁吗？

english: All I know is that Gertrude found me on her doorstep one day. She looked after me when I was a kitten.
translation: 我只知道有一天格特鲁德在她家门口发现了我。我还是小猫的时候，是她照顾我的。

english: The crazy cat lady?
translation: 那个养猫的疯女人？

english: Don't you have any memory of your parents?
translation: 你对你的父母一点记忆都没有吗？

english: Nothing! The furthest back I can remember is Gertrude looking after me.
translation: 没有！我能记得的最早就是格特鲁德照顾我。

english: [player name] let's go and talk to Gertrude! Perhaps she knows who Bob's parents are!
translation: [player name]，我们去和格特鲁德谈谈吧！也许她知道鲍勃的父母是谁！

english: Do I look like a match maker?!
translation: 我看起来像媒人吗？！

english: Come on! We can help Bob!
translation: 来吧！我们可以帮鲍勃！

english: Hmph...Oh Neite...My bounty is as boundless as the sea, my love as deep. The more I give to thee, the more I have, for both are infinite.
translation: 哼……哦，奈特……我的慷慨像海一样无边，我的爱像海一样深。我给你的越多，我拥有的也越多，因为两者都是无限的。

english: OK OK... This is becoming dangerous. If we don't do something he will probably implode! We'll go to Gertrude and ask if she knows who your parents are!
translation: 好了好了……这变得危险了。如果我们不做点什么，他可能会爆炸！我们去找格特鲁德，问问她是否知道你的父母是谁！

translation: 欢迎回来，冒险者！你的猫怎么样了？

english: He says he's fine.
translation: 他说他很好。

english: What can I do for you then? I hope it's not about death runes. I heard a terrible rumour you know.
translation: 那我有什么能帮你的？我希望不是关于死亡符文的事。我听说了一个可怕的谣言，你知道吗。

english: Death runes? No idea.... No, it's not that. I, erm...
translation: 死亡符文？不知道……不，不是那个。我，呃……

english: Come on, spit it out.
translation: 说吧，别吞吞吐吐的。

english: This is going to sound silly...
translation: 这听起来可能有点傻……

english: Why, are you going to talk in a stupid accent? Go on, try me.
translation: 怎么，你打算用愚蠢的口音说话吗？说吧，试试看。

english: Ok... Well... Do you know who Bob's parents are?
translation: 好吧……嗯……你知道鲍勃的父母是谁吗？

english: Bob.... you mean the big tomcat who hangs around the Heroes' guild? No, I'm afraid I don't know a lot about him. People round here know I care for sick and abandoned animals, and one day I found a basket with
translation: 鲍勃……你是说那只常在英雄公会附近出没的大公猫？不，恐怕我对他了解不多。这附近的人都知道我照顾生病和被遗弃的动物，有一天我发现一个篮子，

english: a kitten inside it left on my doorstep. I brought him up as best I could and he soon learnt to take care of himself. He really was an amazing little thing. There was this one time when.....
translation: 里面有一只小猫，被留在我家门口。我尽力把它养大，它很快就学会了照顾自己。它真是个了不起的小家伙。有一次……

english: We don't have time for this, Bob could be in trouble! Tell her to get on with it.
translation: 我们没时间听这个，鲍勃可能有麻烦了！让她说重点。

english: Crumbs! Your cat's quite noisy isn't it? Is everything OK?
translation: 天哪！你的猫真吵，不是吗？没事吧？

english: No, it's erm... It needs to be taken to the vets, URGENTLY. For an emergency AMPUTATION!
translation: 不，它呃……需要紧急送医。做紧急截肢！

english: I do hope you're joking. These claws are real you know, none of your bronze nonsense.
translation: 我希望你是在开玩笑。这些爪子可是真的，不是你们那些青铜的玩意儿。

english: See, it just can't stop howling. Allergic to cat hair apparently. Anyway, you were talking about Bob's parents.
translation: 看，它不停地嚎叫。显然是对猫毛过敏。总之，你刚才在说鲍勃的父母。

english: Oh was I... Oh yes, well, I'm afraid I don't know anything about them adventurer.
translation: 哦，我说了吗……哦，是的，嗯，恐怕我对他们一无所知，冒险者。

english: Hang on, maybe this is something to do with the legend... yes, it just might. Have you ever heard of Robert the Strong?
translation: 等等，也许这和那个传说有关……是的，有可能。你听说过强者罗伯特吗？

english: Vaguely?
translation: 隐约听说过？

english: Ask Gertrude if she knows anything.
translation: 问问格特鲁德她知道什么。

english: Hmm... Gertrude, do you know anything of the legend, Robert the Strong?
translation: 嗯……格特鲁德，你知道关于强者罗伯特的传说吗？

english: No, sorry. If it's a legend, it's Reldo you need to talk to. He's in Varrock palace library, knows all about that kind of thing.
translation: 不，抱歉。如果是传说，你得去找雷尔多。他在维洛克城宫殿图书馆，对这类事情了如指掌。

english: Good old Gertrude! Come on, lets go.
translation: 好样的格特鲁德！走吧，我们出发。

english: I'll explain later!
translation: 我待会儿解释！

english: Hello Gertrude!
translation: 你好，格特鲁德！

english: Greetings adventurer, have you spoken to Reldo in the palace library about Robert the Strong?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你和宫殿图书馆的雷尔多谈过强者罗伯特的事了吗？

english: Come on, lets go.
translation: 走吧，我们出发。

english: So, about Robert the Strong...
translation: 那么，关于强者罗伯特……

english: Never mind, I've found out enough now, I should go back to Bob.
translation: 算了，我已经了解得够多了，该回去找鲍勃了。

english: We've found out enough now, we should go back to Bob.
translation: 我们已经了解得够多了，该回去找鲍勃了。

english: Did you find out who my parents are?
translation: 你查出我的父母是谁了吗？

english: Not exactly...
translation: 不完全是……

english: We think you are... or used to be... Robert the Strong!
translation: 我们认为你就是……或者说曾经是……强者罗伯特！

english: Robert the who?
translation: 罗伯特什么？

english: I thought this was stupid.
translation: 我早就觉得这很蠢。

english: Robert the Strong was a great hero, you have no memory of him?
translation: 强者罗伯特是一位伟大的英雄，你对他一点印象都没有吗？

english: No... I'm afraid not.
translation: 不……恐怕没有。

english: Does a black panther called Odysseus ring any bells?
translation: 一只叫'奥德修斯'的黑豹，你有印象吗？

english: What about the dragonkin? A vicious race of bird like creatures?
translation: 那龙人呢？一个凶残的鸟类生物种族？

english: Looks like theres nothing else we can do puss.
translation: 看来我们别无他法了，小猫咪。

english: I'm not done yet!
translation: 我还没说完呢！

english: Do you remember when you were hypnotised by the Devourer?
translation: 你还记得被吞噬者催眠的时候吗？

english: Well no... I was hypnotised!
translation: 呃，不……我都给催眠了！

english: The Sphinx understood how you were hypnotised, it might be able to access Bob's memories of Robert the Strong.
translation: 斯芬克斯明白你是怎么被催眠的，它或许能查阅鲍勃关于强者罗伯特的记忆。

english: Sounds crazy... guess it might work!
translation: 听起来很疯狂……不过没准能行！

english: Bye for now Bob, we're going to speak to the Sphinx.
translation: 先再见了，鲍勃，我们去找斯芬克斯谈谈。

english: Have you been to the Sphinx yet?
translation: 你们去见过斯芬克斯了吗？

english: No we haven't. Come on [player name], let's go.
translation: 还没去。来吧[player name]，我们走。

english: Have you found Bob yet?
translation: 你们找到鲍勃了吗？

english: Don't worry, we're working on it.
translation: 别担心，我们正在处理。

english: Please hurry, I'm worried.
translation: 请快点，我很担心。

english: What is it human?
translation: 什么事，人类？

english: Sphinx, we need your help!
translation: 斯芬克斯，我们需要你的帮助！

english: Yes, please help!
translation: 是的，请帮帮忙！

english: Very well, I see you have a close relationship with your cat, I will help you if I can.
translation: 好吧，我看得出你和你的猫关系亲密，我会尽力帮忙的。

english: What is the problem?
translation: 问题是什么？

english: Bob is in love with Neite but we need to prove that he used to be Robert the Strong before she will have anything to do with him!
translation: 鲍勃爱上了奈特，但我们得证明他曾经是强者罗伯特，否则她根本不理他！

english: Slow down human!
translation: 慢点说，人类！

english: Bob has fallen in love?
translation: 鲍勃恋爱了？

english: This I did not foresee!
translation: 这我倒没料到！

english: Who is this Robert the Strong that you speak of?
translation: 你说的这个强者罗伯特是谁？

english: He was a mighty hero!
translation: 他曾是一位强大的英雄！

english: Human myths interest me not.
translation: 人类的神话我不感兴趣。

english: Robert the Strong was no ordinary human though!
translation: 不过强者罗伯特可不是普通人类！

english: It is true that there is something about Bob... there is the mark of power on him, I have ignored it for too long.
translation: 确实，鲍勃身上有些特别……他带有力量印记，我忽略太久了。

english: But Bob has no memory of this!
translation: 但鲍勃对此毫无记忆！

english: Then it is the time for action!
translation: 那么是时候行动了！

english: Come with me into the desert so we are not disturbed.
translation: 跟我到沙漠里去，以免被打扰。

english: Quiet please.... I shall summon Bob.
translation: 请安静……我要召唤鲍勃。

english: What..? What happened?
translation: 什么……？发生了什么？

english: I was eating a particularly nice piece of tuna.
translation: 我刚才在吃一块特别好吃的金枪鱼。

english: Greetings Bob.
translation: 你好，鲍勃。

english: Oh, hi there Sphinx.
translation: 哦，你好，斯芬克斯。

english: Hi there [player name], what's going on?
translation: 你好[player name]，这是怎么了？

english: I have brought you here to find out who you really are.
translation: 我把你带到这里是为了弄清你的真实身份。

english: So you buy this Robert the Strong stuff?
translation: 所以你也信这套强者罗伯特的说辞？

english: I have long suspected that your appearance as an ordinary cat belies your true nature.
translation: 我早就怀疑你普通猫的外表掩盖了你的真实本质。

english: Hey! I'm just this cat, you know?
translation: 嘿！我就是这只猫，你知道吗？

english: Look into my eyes.
translation: 看着我的眼睛。

english: Sure... whatever.
translation: 行……随便吧。

english: You are now under my influence.
translation: 你现在受我影响。

english: Let's start with something simple. What is your name?
translation: 先从简单的开始。你叫什么名字？

english: My name is Bob.
translation: 我叫鲍勃。

english: Good. Are you or have you ever been called Robert the Strong?
translation: 好。你以前是否被称为强者罗伯特？

english: I... I don't know.
translation: 我……我不知道。

english: Think back to your earliest memories.
translation: 回想你最早的记忆。

english: I see a big cat...
translation: 我看到一只大猫……

english: Where are you now?
translation: 你现在在哪里？

english: I am in front of a dark tower... the cat is called Odysseus.
translation: 我在一座黑暗的塔前……那只猫叫奥德修斯。

english: My name is Robert.
translation: 我叫罗伯特。

english: I am walking towards the tower...
translation: 我正朝塔走去……

english: Come, Odysseus!
translation: 来吧，奥德修斯！

english: Hesente!
translation: 赫森特！

english: Crasortius!
translation: 克拉索提乌斯！

english: You are no longer under my influence.
translation: 你已不再受我影响。

english: Wow Bob! You really are Robert the Strong!
translation: 哇，鲍勃！你真的是强者罗伯特！

english: Yes! When you were hypnotised you told us of when you defeated a dragonkin!
translation: 是的！你被催眠时告诉我们你打败了一只龙人！

english: I did?
translation: 我说了吗？

english: Yes! How can Neite refuse you now!
translation: 是的！现在奈特怎么能拒绝你呢！

english: Sphinx, summon Neite please!
translation: 斯芬克斯，请召唤奈特！

english: There are more important matters than match making.
translation: 还有比牵线更重要的事。

english: That can wait! Bob has been love sick, we have to tell Neite!
translation: 那可以等等！鲍勃害了相思病，我们必须告诉奈特！

english: Very well! I shall summon Neite!
translation: 好吧！我召唤奈特！

english: Oh... furballs!
translation: 哦……毛球！

english: Hi Neite!
translation: 嗨，奈特！

english: Hello, to what do I owe this pleasure?
translation: 你好，我何德何能让你大驾光临？

english: Bob is Robert the Strong!
translation: 鲍勃是强者罗伯特！

english: The Sphinx hypnotised Bob. Bob told us about when he was Robert the Strong fighting dragonkin.
translation: 斯芬克斯催眠了鲍勃。鲍勃告诉我们他作为强者罗伯特对抗龙人的事。

english: So you're supposed to be Robert the Strong?
translation: 所以你说你是强者罗伯特？

english: So they tell me.
translation: 他们是这么告诉我的。

english: For too long I have ignored the fact that there is a mark of power on Bob. Under my influence Bob was able to recall memories that had remained hidden until now. It proves he is, or was, Robert the Strong.
translation: 长久以来我一直忽略鲍勃身上有力量印记的事实。在我的影响下，鲍勃能够回忆起一直隐藏的记忆。这证明他就是，或曾经是，强者罗伯特。

english: Come here you.
translation: 过来。

english: (Neite whispers in Bob's ear.)
translation: （奈特在鲍勃耳边低语。）

english: Neite!
translation: 奈特！

english: Of course kitten.
translation: 当然，小猫咪。

english: Hey [player name], could you do me a favour?
translation: 嘿[player name]，能帮我个忙吗？

english: Myself and Neite are going away for a few days. Could you look after Unferth for me whilst I'm away?
translation: 我和奈特要外出几天。我不在的时候你能帮我照顾昂弗斯吗？

english: Er... sure.
translation: 呃……当然。

english: I'll give you a list of what needs doing.
translation: 我给你列个需要做的事的清单。

english: OK, no problem Bob.
translation: 好的，没问题鲍勃。

english: [player name], since you are to look after Unferth, shall I teleport you to his house?
translation: [player name]，既然你要去照顾昂弗斯，要我传送你去他家吗？

english: Have you completed the chores that Bob asked you to?
translation: 你完成鲍勃交代的杂务了吗？

english: Come on!
translation: 来吧！

english: Hi Unferth, I'm doing some ch...
translation: 嗨昂弗斯，我正在做……

english: Don't tell him you're doing his chores!
translation: 别告诉他你在做他的杂务！

english: Part of the cat-human relationship is to let them believe they are in control.
translation: 猫和人类关系的一部分就是让它们以为自己在掌控一切。

english: Ah... OK.
translation: 啊……好吧。

english: What do I have to do for 'Tidy House'?
translation: 我要怎么做才能完成“整洁房屋”？

english: Look round the house for anything messy that needs to be put right.
translation: 在屋子里找找看有没有需要整理的地方。

english: You've finished that chore.
translation: 你已经完成那件家务了。

english: What do I have to do for 'Warm Human'?
translation: 我要怎么做才能完成“温暖人类”？

english: Theresonly one source of warmth in the house, I suggest you use it.
translation: 屋子里只有一个热源，我建议你利用它。

english: What do I have to do for 'Feed Human'?
translation: 我要怎么做才能完成“喂食人类”？

english: There's a table with empty dishes, I think they need refilling.
translation: 有张桌子上摆着空盘子，我想它们需要重新装满。

english: What does Unferth eat?
translation: 昂弗斯吃什么？

english: I've no idea, perhaps you can find out.
translation: 我不知道，也许你可以查出来。

english: What do I have to do for 'Tidy Human'?
translation: 我要怎么做才能完成“整洁人类”？

english: Have you noticed that Unferth's hair has grown rather long?
translation: 你有没有注意到昂弗斯的头发已经长得很长了？

english: Do you know where I can get some scissors?
translation: 你知道我在哪里可以弄到剪刀吗？

english: It's so long I should think you'd need shears to cut it!
translation: 头发这么长，我看你得用大剪刀才能剪断！

english: What do I have to do for 'Tend Garden'?
translation: 我要怎么做才能完成“照料花园”？

english: Check the garden to see if anything needs tending.
translation: 检查一下花园，看看有没有需要打理的地方。

english: I've weeded the garden, now what?
translation: 我已经给花园除过草了，现在呢？

english: I'm sure there should be something growing in the garden.
translation: 我确定花园里应该种点什么。

english: I'm not touching someone else's bed!
translation: 我才不碰别人的床！

english: Well done, that's all the chores finished!
translation: 干得好，所有家务都完成了！

english: Let's talk to Unferth to see if there's anything else we can do.
translation: 我们去跟昂弗斯谈谈，看看还有没有别的事可以做。

english: So. Now what?
translation: 那么，现在呢？

english: You've done all the chores so you should see if Unferth needs anything else done.
translation: 你已经完成了所有家务，所以应该去看看昂弗斯是否还有其他事需要帮忙。

english: Hi Unferth, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 嗨，昂弗斯，有什么我能为你效劳的吗？

english: Ugh...
Now what?!
translation: 又怎么了？！

english: I don't feel so good...
translation: 我感觉不太舒服……

english: Oh dear! What's up?
translation: 哦天哪！怎么了？

english: Nothing, I bet!
translation: 我敢打赌没什么事！

english: I think I need the Doctor...ugh...
translation: 我想我需要医生……呃……

english: What Doctor is that?
translation: 什么医生？

english: Just a Doctor... please hurry... I don't think I'll last long...
translation: 就是医生……请快点……我觉得我撑不了多久了……

english: Snarl!
translation: 吼！

english: We can't let Bob see him like this!
translation: 我们不能让鲍勃看到他这个样子！

english: I guess you're right, there is the Apothecary in Varrock.
translation: 我想你说得对，维洛克城有个药剂师。

english: Good idea!
translation: 好主意！

english: Don't worry, I'll get the Apothecary from Varrock!
translation: 别担心，我去维洛克城找药剂师来！

english: Hello Apothecary, Unferth has fallen ill. Could you go and see him please?
translation: 你好，药剂师，昂弗斯病倒了。你能去看看他吗？

english: That Unferth! Honestly, I have been to see him more times than my Mother's hair has fallen out!
translation: 那个昂弗斯！说真的，我去看他的次数比我妈掉头发的次数还多！

english: I never did like that guy!
translation: 我从来就不喜欢那家伙！

english: I'm beginning to agree with you!
translation: 我开始同意你的看法了！

english: What can I do with Unferth?
translation: 我能拿昂弗斯怎么办？

english: I have a few suggestions!
translation: 我有几个建议！

english: It's quite simple. Unferth is what we call a hypochondriac; he isn't ill but he thinks he is. All you need to do is convince him you are a Doctor or a Nurse and give him a potion to make him 'better'.
translation: 很简单。昂弗斯就是我们所说的疑病症患者；他没病，但他觉得自己有病。你只需要让他相信你是医生或护士，然后给他一瓶药水让他“好起来”。

english: How do I make Unferth believe I am a Doctor or Nurse?
translation: 我怎样才能让昂弗斯相信我是医生或护士？

english: Easy, make sure you are dressed in white robes and take one of these hats to wear.
translation: 简单，确保你穿着白色长袍，再戴上其中一顶帽子。

english: Then all you need to do is give him a vial of water and he'll take it thinking it's a cure potion.
translation: 然后你只需要给他一瓶水，他就会以为那是治疗药水而喝下去。

english: I always wanted to be a Doctor!
translation: 我一直想当医生！

english: Hello Apothecary.
translation: 你好，药剂师。

english: Have you been to 'cure' Unferth by dressing up in white robes, wearing the hat and giving him a vial of water?
translation: 你有没有通过穿上白色长袍、戴上帽子并给他一瓶水来“治疗”昂弗斯？

english: That's what I was going to do! Thanks, I'll see you later.
translation: 我正打算这么做！谢谢，回头见。

english: Good day Unferth, I am Doctor [player name].
translation: 你好，昂弗斯，我是[player name]医生。

english: No you're not! A Doctor wouldn't be holding that!
translation: 你不是！医生才不会拿着那个！

english: I am so glad to see you Doctor!
translation: 很高兴见到你，医生！

english: I am not a well man!
translation: 我身体不舒服！

english: What seems to be the problem?
translation: 哪里不舒服？

english: Theres something wrong with his head!
translation: 他的脑袋有问题！

english: My back hurts!
translation: 我的背疼！

english: No problem...
translation: 没问题……

english: I think my arm is broken!
translation: 我觉得我的手臂断了！

english: We can...
translation: 我们可以……

english: Then there's my spleen!
translation: 还有我的脾脏！

english: Your what...?
translation: 你的什么……？

english: My liver has packed in!
translation: 我的肝脏罢工了！

english: All you need to do is take this potion.
translation: 你只需要喝下这瓶药水。

english: Is that it?! I'm much more ill than that!
translation: 就这样？！我病得比那严重多了！

english: We could offer to bonk him on the head with a big hammer.
translation: 我们可以提议用大锤子敲他的头。

english: Doctor Please take this seriously! I demand treatment!
translation: 医生，请认真对待！我要求治疗！

english: Of course sir! The potion I have given you is the latest technology. It cures all known illnesses, and a few unknown ones. It's what we call in the trade a 'miracle cure'.
translation: 当然，先生！我给你的药水是最新技术。它能治愈所有已知疾病，以及一些未知的。这就是我们行内所谓的“奇迹疗法”。

english: Wow! What can I say... I feel special!
translation: 哇！我还能说什么……我感觉很特别！

english: Do you feel better?
translation: 你感觉好点了吗？

english: Wait! I feel something! Yes! I can feel the potion working... The pain has gone... I can walk on my leg... Doctor! I'm cured!
translation: 等等！我感觉到什么了！是的！我能感觉到药水在起作用……疼痛消失了……我的腿能走路了……医生！我痊愈了！

english: That's... great! Phew!
translation: 那……太好了！呼！

english: Indeed. Bob should be back by now; let's go find him.
translation: 确实。鲍勃现在应该回来了；我们去找他吧。

english: Hello Unferth.
translation: 你好，昂弗斯。

english: I feel much better now.
translation: 我现在感觉好多了。

english: We should go and see Bob now Unferth is feeling better, he should be back by now.
translation: 昂弗斯感觉好多了，我们应该去看看鲍勃，他现在应该回来了。

english: Hi Bob! How's it hang... going?
translation: 嗨，鲍勃！最近怎么样……？

english: Wonderful! Neite and I have been all over Gielinor! We 'borrowed' a magic carpet...
translation: 棒极了！奈特和我游遍了整个吉莱诺！我们“借”了一张魔法飞毯……

english: Where do we turn here?
translation: 我们该往哪转？

english: North... I think.
translation: 北边……我想。

english: You think?!
translation: 你想？！

english: Yes: north.
translation: 是的：北边。

english: Slow down!
translation: 慢点！

english: That camel!
translation: 那只骆驼！

english: What camel?!
translation: 什么骆驼？！

english: Are you sure this is a good idea?
translation: 你确定这是个好主意吗？

english: Yeh, the old King and I go way back.
translation: 是啊，我和老国王是老交情了。

english: Hey old King! How's things?
translation: 嘿，老国王！最近怎么样？

english: Same as always: adventurers trying to kill me.
translation: 老样子：总有冒险者想杀我。

english: There, there, could be worse!
translation: 好了，好了，情况可能更糟！

english: I guess... one moment...
translation: 我想也是……等一下……

english: See what I mean?
translation: 明白我的意思了吧？

english: Mate! You need a new line of work!
translation: 哥们！你得换个行当了！

english: I said left at the camel!
translation: 我说了在骆驼那里左转！

english: You're too close to the pyramid!
translation: 你离金字塔太近了！

english: Do you want to drive?!
translation: 你想来开吗？！

english: I think we're lost.
translation: 我想我们迷路了。

english: No, I know where I'm going.
translation: 不，我知道我要去哪。

english: Are we there yet?
translation: 我们到了吗？

english: I'm the King of Gielinor!
translation: 我是吉莱诺的国王！

english: Hi Unferth!
translation: 嗨，昂弗斯！

english: Hello! Bob came home today! I'm so happy!
translation: 你好！鲍勃今天回家了！我太高兴了！

english: That's good news!
translation: 真是好消息！

english: Fat lot of use you were! He came home on his own!
translation: 你一点用都没有！他自己回家的！

english: This guy is unbelievable!
translation: 这家伙真是难以置信！

english: You're not wrong.
translation: 你说得没错。

english: Of course I'm not wrong.
translation: 我当然没错。

english: Before you go, I found the strangest thing. There was a package left under the bed, it's addressed to you.
translation: 在你走之前，我发现了一件最奇怪的事。床底下有个包裹，是寄给你的。

english: Hello there. Interested in hearing the tale of Serafina?
translation: 你好。有兴趣听听塞拉菲娜的故事吗？

english: Great! Now, in case you didn't know, the castle before you is Ver Sinhaza. It's home to the Theatre of Blood.
translation: 太好了！你可能不知道，你面前的这座城堡就是维尔.辛哈扎。这里是血腥剧场的所在地。

english: So it's a form of entertainment for them? Why do the citizens take part?
translation: 所以这对他们来说是一种娱乐形式？为什么市民们要参与？

english: The Theatre is run by a famous vampyre noble, Lady Verzik Vitur. She has promised that any citizen of Meiyerditch who survives the Theatre will be freed of the vampyre blood tithes.
translation: 剧场由一位著名的吸血鬼贵族维齐克.维图尔女士经营。她承诺，任何在剧场中幸存下来的迈尔迪奇市民都将免除吸血鬼的血税。

english: I suppose that must be rather tempting to a lot of people. So who's this Serafina?
translation: 我想这对很多人来说一定相当诱人。那么这位塞拉菲娜是谁？

english: The Theatre has been around for many years and thousands of people have tried their luck against it. However, in all that time, only one person has ever survived until the end.
translation: 剧场已经存在很多年了，成千上万的人曾试图碰碰运气。然而，在这么长的时间里，只有一个人成功活到了最后。

english: Serafina?
translation: 塞拉菲娜？

english: Exactly. Serafina's younger brother was very ill and he wasn't going to survive many more blood tithes. She couldn't just let him die, so she did what no other person ever had.
translation: 没错。塞拉菲娜的弟弟病得很重，他撑不过几次血税了。她不能眼睁睁看着他死，于是她做了别人从未做过的事。

english: She entered the Theatre and succeeded in every challenge she faced. They say that Verzik wasn't too happy about that, but she kept her promise. Serafina and her brother were freed.
translation: 她进入了剧场，并成功通过了所有挑战。据说维齐克对此不太高兴，但她还是遵守了诺言。塞拉菲娜和她的弟弟获得了自由。

english: Sounds like you're a big fan of her.
translation: 听起来你是她的忠实粉丝。

english: Well of course. When she survived the Theatre, she provided hope to every person in Meiyerditch. Hope that they can one day follow in her footsteps.
translation: 那当然。当她从剧场中幸存下来时，她给了迈尔迪奇每个人希望。希望有一天他们能追随她的脚步。

english: So what happened to her in the end?
translation: 那她最后怎么样了？

english: Well I suppose she left Meiyerditch. Can't imagine any free person wanting to stick around here.
translation: 嗯，我想她离开了迈尔迪奇。无法想象任何一个自由人会想留在这里。

english: You suppose? So you don't know for sure?
translation: 你想？所以你不确定？

english: Well... No. It was a long time ago. Not many people around who remember it.
translation: 嗯……不。那是很久以前的事了。周围没多少人记得了。

english: That'll do nicely, madam. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that patch grows for you.
translation: 这样就很好，女士。交给我吧——我会确保那块地为你长好的。

english: Every day, vampyres from across Morytania come to the Theatre to watch as citizens attempt the various challenges within.
translation: 每天，来自莫利塔尼亚各地的吸血鬼都会来到剧场，观看市民们尝试其中的各种挑战。

english: I'll want 200 Coins to chop down your tree.
translation: 砍你的树要收200金币。

english: I want 15 papaya fruits for that.
translation: 我要15个木瓜果来换。

english: I want 10 pineapples for that.
translation: 我要10个菠萝来换。

english: I want 5 baskets of bananas for that.
translation: 我要5篮香蕉来换。

english: I want 10 watermelons for that.
translation: 我要10个西瓜来换。
