english: I want 4 baskets of apples for that.
translation: 我要4篮苹果来换。

english: I want 9 raw sweetcorn for that.
translation: 我要9个生甜玉米来换。

english: I want 3 baskets of strawberries for that.
translation: 我要3篮草莓来换。

english: Beneath the castle you'll find the Theatre of Blood. Every day, citizens of Meiyerditch take on various challenges set up by Verzik, all to provide entertainment for the vampyres.
translation: 在城堡下方你会找到血腥剧场。每天，迈尔迪奇的市民们都会接受维齐克设置的各种挑战，全是为了给吸血鬼们提供娱乐。

english: That's a stump. It'll grow back if you just leave it alone for a while.
translation: 那是个树桩。只要你放着不管一段时间，它就会重新长出来。

english: Yep, that's where we are at the moment. The region is split into two cities, Meiyerditch in the south and Darkmeyer in the north.
translation: 是啊，我们现在就在这儿。这个地区分为两座城市，南边的迈尔迪奇和北边的达克迈尔。

english: Not much really. There seems to be three main types, juveniles, juvinates and vyres.
translation: 其实不太多。似乎主要有三种类型：幼年体、青年体和成年吸血鬼。

english: I want 15 coconuts for that.
translation: 我要15个椰子来换。

english: No one had seen anything of him for years. They say he's back now though. But we shouldn't talk of him. The vyrewatch might not like it.
translation: 好多年没人见过他了。不过他们说他现在回来了。但我们不该谈论他。吸血鬼哨兵可能不喜欢这样。

english: If you like, but I want 10 pineapples for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我要10个菠萝来换。

english: Well then you'll know that vampyres from across Morytania come to the Theatre for entertainment. They take great joy in watching the citizens attempt the various challenges within.
translation: 那你应该知道，来自莫利塔尼亚各地的吸血鬼都会来剧场寻乐子。他们非常喜欢看市民们尝试里面的各种挑战。

english: There's no such thing. You'd do well not to mention that name around here again.
translation: 没这回事。你最好别再在这儿提起那个名字。

english: Ranis or Vanescula?
translation: 拉尼斯还是瓦内斯库拉？

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him for many years now. You can occasionally see Ranis or Vanescula flying about, but not too often.
translation: 嗯，好多年都没人见过他了。你偶尔能看到拉尼斯或瓦内斯库拉飞来飞去，但不太频繁。

english: That's where Serafina comes in. Lady Verzik Vitur, the owner of the Theatre, has promised that any citizen of Meiyerditch who survives the Theatre will be freed of the vampyre blood tithes.
translation: 这就是塞拉菲娜的作用。剧场的拥有者维齐克.维图尔女士承诺，任何在剧场中幸存下来的迈尔迪奇市民都将免除吸血鬼的血税。

english: If you like, but I want 15 papaya fruits for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我要15个木瓜果来换。

english: If you like, but I want 9 raw sweetcorn for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我要9个生甜玉米来换。

english: If you like, but I want 10 watermelons for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我要10个西瓜来换。

english: If you like, but I want 5 baskets of bananas for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我要5篮香蕉来换。

english: If you like, but I want 4 baskets of apples for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我要4篮苹果来换。

english: If you like, but I want 15 coconuts for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，但我要15个椰子来换。

english: Well obviously it's the seasons. They all seem to be out- of-wack these days. Summer comes earlier and earlier each year, but then it simply rushes by!
translation: 嗯，很明显是季节的问题。这些日子以来，季节全都乱套了。夏天一年比一年来得早，然后又匆匆而过！

english: No, sorry, but find that out and you'll get to the root of our problems.
translation: 不，抱歉，但如果你找出原因，就能找到我们问题的根源了。

english: Well I can tell by the look on your face that I'm not the first person you've asked. Why don't you tell me what you've heard from other members of the group so far?
translation: 嗯，看你的表情我就知道我不是你第一个问的人。不如先告诉我，你从其他成员那里听到了什么？

english: Did you ever consider that all those theories might be correct?
translation: 你有没有想过，所有这些理论可能都是对的？

english: I'm serious!
translation: 我是认真的！

english: I'll let you into a little secret that'll explain it all to you. In a word - fairies!
translation: 我告诉你一个小秘密，你就全明白了。简单来说——是妖精！

english: How can you ask such a thing? It's obvious! It's all you adventurers. Every time I get a crop planted, some adventurer comes along and digs it up and plants crops of their own, as if they owned my farming patch!
translation: 你怎么能问这种问题？这不明摆着吗！都是你们这些冒险者害的。每次我种好庄稼，就有冒险者跑来挖掉，种上他们自己的作物，好像那是他们的种植地一样！

english: Don't give me that! You're an adventurer, they're all adventurers. I bet you have some sort of secret guild and you gather there and say things like 'let's annoy the gardeners this week', don't you?
translation: 别跟我来这套！你是个冒险者，他们也都是冒险者。我敢打赌你们有个什么秘密公会，聚在一起说些‘这周我们去烦烦园丁吧’之类的话，是不是？

english: If you find out what is upsetting the seasons you'll find out what is causing the harvest to fail.
translation: 如果你找出是什么扰乱了季节，你就会找到收成失败的原因。

english: Aha, so you admit it then! You should be ashamed of yourselves!
translation: 啊哈，那你就是承认了！你们应该感到羞耻！

english: Surely if all of those things have been mentioned as catalysts to our problems it stands to reason that the fairies are actually the cause?
translation: 如果所有这些都被认为是问题的催化剂，那按理说，妖精才是真正的罪魁祸首，不是吗？

english: There are six main Farming areas - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 有六个主要的农业区——法拉多城附近的埃尔斯坦区、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区、阿多尼城附近的克拉根区、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区、霍西迪乌斯城的马里西区，以及农业公会的艾伦区。

english: Think it through. There are fairies who control everything natural from the weather to the seasons.
translation: 好好想想。有妖精控制着从天气到季节的一切自然事物。

english: I don't think the crops ARE failing, now leave me alone, I have work to do.
translation: 我不觉得庄稼在歉收，现在别烦我了，我还有活要干。

english: It's really annoying! You should speak to your friends about their rude behaviour!
translation: 真的很烦人！你应该跟你的朋友们说说他们这粗鲁的行为！

english: You don't have to buy all your plantpots you know, you can make them yourself on a pottery wheel. If you're a good enough craftswoman, that is.
translation: 你知道吗，你不必买所有的花盆，你可以自己在陶轮上做。当然，前提是你是个足够好的工匠。

english: Hewwo dawe.
translation: 泥嚎，亲耐的。

english: If you want to make your own sacks and baskets you'll need to use the loom that's near the Farming shop in Falador. If you're a good enough craftswoman, that is.
translation: 如果你想自己做麻袋和篮子，你需要用法拉多城农业商店附近的织布机。当然，前提是你是个足够好的工匠。

english: Insects! That's what you can tell him! Insects! Stop the insects from eating so many of our crops and we'd get maximum yield, I tell you!
translation: 是虫子！你就这么告诉他！虫子！别再让虫子吃掉我们那么多庄稼，我们就能获得最大收成，我告诉你！

english: I've already told you everything I suspect.
translation: 我已经把我怀疑的一切都告诉你了。

english: Well there you go then. Until you find out how to make it rain you're going to have a hard time solving our problems.
translation: 那就这样吧。在你找到办法让天下雨之前，你很难解决我们的问题。

english: Ah, Martin sent you, why didn't you say so? I personally think that our problems are all down to the fact that we haven't had enough rain of late. It's plain to see - just look at the levels of the rivers.
translation: 啊，是马丁派你来的，你怎么不早说？我个人认为，我们所有的问题都归结于最近雨水不足。这很明显——看看河里的水位就知道了。

english: We need more rain. I don't suppose you can do anything about that?
translation: 我们需要更多雨水。我想你对此也无能为力吧？

english: That'ww do nicewy, siw. Leave it with me - I'ww make suwethat patch gwows fow u.
translation: 介样就很好，先森。交给窝吧——窝会确保那块地为泥长好的。

english: That'ww do nicewy, madam. Leave it with me - me'ww makesuwe that patch gwows fow u.
translation: 介样就很好，女先。交给窝吧——窝会确保那块地为泥长好的。

english: It's cawwed Vew Sinhaza. They say it was once da homeof a Sawadominist queen. Now it bewongs to VewzikVituw, a vampywe nobwe.
translation: 它叫维辛哈扎。据说曾经是一位萨拉多明女王的家。现在它属于维齐克.维图尔，一位吸血鬼贵族。

english: Beneath da castwe u'ww find da Theatwe of Bwood.Evewy day, citizens of Meiyewditch take on vawiouschawwenges set up by Vewzik, aww to pwovide entewtainmentfow da vampywes.
translation: 在城堡下面泥会找到血腥剧场。每天，迈尔迪奇的市民们都会接受维齐克设置的各种挑战，全是为了给吸血鬼们提供娱乐。

english: The citizens don't need to be fowced though. Anyonewho suwvives da Theatwe is pwomised fweedom fwom davampywes. It pwovides a wittwe bit of hope in dis dawkpwace.
translation: 不过市民们不需要被强迫。任何在剧场中幸存下来的人都被承诺能从吸血鬼手中获得自由。它在这个黑暗的地方提供了一点点希望。

english: Dawkmeyew is da vampywe capitaw. Humans awen'tawwowed dawe unwess day'we a pewsonaw swave of somewowd ow wady. They say da vampywes dawe wive vewywuxuwious wifestywes.
translation: 达克迈尔是吸血鬼的首都。人类不允许去那里，除非他们是某个领主或女士的私人奴隶。他们说那里的吸血鬼过着非常奢华的生活。

english: Meiyewditch is just one wawge ghetto. The city is spwitinto sectows so that da vampywes can cowwect bwood tidason a wotationaw basis. That way day don't kiww evewyoneoff in one go.
translation: 迈尔迪奇只是一个大型贫民窟。城市被分成多个区域，这样吸血鬼就可以轮流收取血税。这样他们就不会一次把所有人都杀光。

english: Juveniwes seem to be da wowest fowm of da vampywe.No one awound hewe knows fow suwe but da genewawconsensus is that day'we fowmew humans who've beenconvewted in some way.
translation: 幼年体似乎是吸血鬼的最低形态。这里没人确切知道，但普遍的共识是，它们是以某种方式转化而来的前人类。

english: Then u have da vywes. Vewy nasty and vewypowewfuw. mewouwdn't get on da wwong side of one if Iwewe u.
translation: 然后泥还有成年吸血鬼。非常讨厌，也非常强大。窝要是泥，就不会惹毛它们。

english: Not much weawwy. Thewe seems to be thwee main types,juveniwes, juvinates and vywes.
translation: 其实不太多。似乎主要有三种类型：幼年体、青年体和成年吸血鬼。

english: Juvinates awe initiated juveniwes who've had sometwaining and awe stawting to gain some powews.
translation: 青年体是经过一些训练并开始获得一些力量的进阶幼年体。

english: Hmm, nothing has been seen of him fow many yeawsnow. You can occasionawwy see Vanescuwa fwying about,but not too often.
translation: 嗯，好多年都没人见过他了。你偶尔能看到瓦内斯库拉飞来飞去，但不太频繁。

english: Yep, that's whewe we awe at da moment. The wegion isspwit into two cities, Meiyewditch in da south andDawkmeyew in da nowth.
translation: 是啊，我们现在就在这儿。这个地区分为两座城市，南边的迈尔迪奇和北边的达克迈尔。

english: Vanescuwa?
translation: 瓦内斯库拉？

english: That was Vanstrom Klause and Ranis Drakan!
translation: 那是范斯特罗姆.克劳斯和拉尼斯.德雷坎！

english: Safalaan and the Myreque will want to hear about this.
translation: 萨法拉安和迈雷克会想听这个的。

english: It's nice to see you again, [player name], and congratulations on your well deserved promotion!
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，[player name]，恭喜你当之无愧的晋升！

english: Safalaan! I've seen something I think you should know about.
translation: 萨法拉安！我看到了一些我觉得你应该知道的事情。

english: What is it, [player name]?
translation: 是什么，[player name]？

english: I was at Ver Sinhaza and I saw Vanstrom Klause and Ranis Drakan.
translation: 我在维尔.辛哈扎，看到了范斯特罗姆.克劳斯和拉尼斯.德雷坎。

english: What were they doing?
translation: 他们在做什么？

english: I'm not sure, they arrived at the same time and both entered the castle.
translation: 我不确定，他们同时到达，然后都进了城堡。

english: Ver Sinhaza is home to the Theatre of Blood. Maybe they were just there as spectators?
translation: 维尔.辛哈扎是血腥剧场的所在地。也许他们只是作为观众去的？

english: Hmmm. Ranis is known to visit the Theatre quite regularly. However, I've never heard of Vanstrom going there before. I'd say this is worth investigating.
translation: 嗯。拉尼斯经常去剧场是众所周知的。不过，我从没听说过范斯特罗姆去过那里。我觉得这值得调查。

english: What do you need from me?
translation: 你需要我做什么？

english: Return to Ver Sinhaza and see if you can work out what Vanstrom and Ranis are up to. If you need some help, we recently sent a few of King Roald's mercenaries in that direction.
translation: 回到维尔.辛哈扎，看看你能不能弄清楚范斯特罗姆和拉尼斯在搞什么鬼。如果你需要帮助，我们最近派了一些罗尔德国王的雇佣兵往那个方向去了。

english: What do you need me to do again?
translation: 你再说一遍需要我做什么？

english: Go to Ver Sinhaza and see if you can work out what Vanstrom and Ranis are up to. We recently sent a few of King Roald's mercenaries in that direction, talk to them if you need help.
translation: 去维尔.辛哈扎，看看你能不能弄清楚范斯特罗姆和拉尼斯在搞什么鬼。我们最近派了一些罗尔德国王的雇佣兵往那个方向去了，如果你需要帮助，就去找他们谈谈。

english: Hello. You don't look like the usual rabble around here. What's your story?
translation: 你好。你看起来不像这里常见的乌合之众。你是什么来头？

english: Safalaan sent me. He said you could help me with something.
translation: 萨法拉安派我来的。他说你可以帮我做点事。

english: Ahh Safalaan. Interesting chap isn't he? Those eyes of his are a bit creepy.
translation: 啊，萨法拉安。挺有意思的家伙，不是吗？他那双眼睛有点吓人。

english: Anyway, we might be able to help but it will need to be quick. We're just about to head into the Theatre. Compared to the citizens, we shouldn't have any issues in there.
translation: 总之，我们也许能帮忙，但得快一点。我们正要进剧场。和那些市民相比，我们在里面应该不会有什么问题。

english: So what help do you need?
translation: 那么你需要什么帮助？

english: I saw Vanstrom Klause and Ranis Drakan arriving at the castle earlier. Do you know if they're still here?
translation: 我之前看到范斯特罗姆.克劳斯和拉尼斯.德雷坎到达城堡。你知道他们还在不在吗？

english: Yeah we saw them as well. Pretty hard to miss. We haven't seen them leave yet so I guess they're still inside.
translation: 是的，我们也看到了。很难错过。我们还没看到他们离开，所以我猜他们还在里面。

english: I need to know what they're doing in there. Any idea how I can do that?
translation: 我需要知道他们在里面做什么。你知道我该怎么做吗？

english: Well this place has quite a few windows. Maybe you could use one of them. They're all high up though so you'd need to climb to reach them.
translation: 嗯，这个地方有不少窗户。也许你可以利用其中一扇。不过它们都很高，所以你得爬上去才能够到。

english: Aye that might work. Parts of the castle wall have been damaged, it shouldn't be too hard to climb.
translation: 啊，这也许可行。城堡墙有些部分已经损坏了，爬上去应该不太难。

english: Interesting. Thanks for the help.
translation: 有意思。谢谢你的帮助。

english: Hello again. Did you manage to work out what Vanstrom and Ranis are up to?
translation: 又见面了。你弄清楚范斯特罗姆和拉尼斯在搞什么鬼了吗？

english: You might be able to spy on them through one of the windows. You'll need to climb to reach them though.
translation: 你也许可以通过一扇窗户监视他们。不过你得爬上去才能够到。

english: Get away from there food sack.
translation: 离那个食物麻袋远点。

english: Doesn't look like I'll be able to climb up here with that guard watching. I'll need to distract them somehow.
translation: 看来有那个守卫看着，我没法爬上去。我得想办法引开他们。

english: Do you think you could distract that guard for me while I climb this wall?
translation: 你觉得你能在我爬这堵墙的时候帮我引开那个守卫吗？

english: I ain't getting on the wrong side of a vyrewatch for nothing. You'll have to pay me.
translation: 我可不想无缘无故得罪一个吸血鬼哨兵。你得付钱给我。

english: Eugh fine. How much?
translation: 呃，好吧。多少钱？

english: 1,000 coins should do.
translation: 1000金币应该够了。

english: 1,000 coins? What can you even buy around here for that?
translation: 1000金币？在这里你能用这个买到什么？

english: There's a guy in sector three who sells weapons. Top secret, the vampyres can't know about it. I want to buy a sword from him so I have a better chance in the Theatre.
translation: 第三区有个卖武器的人。绝密，不能让吸血鬼知道。我想从他那里买一把剑，这样我在剧场里机会更大。

english: Fine. I'll come back when I have the money.
translation: 好吧。我拿到钱就回来。

english: Fine, here's the money.
translation: 好吧，给你钱。

english: Thanks. Climb the wall when you're ready. I'll distract the guard when you do.
translation: 谢谢。准备好了就爬墙。你爬的时候我会引开守卫。

english: I'm not paying.
translation: 我不付钱。

english: Do you have my money yet?
translation: 你拿到我的钱了吗？

english: Climb the wall when you're ready. I'll distract the guard when you do.
translation: 准备好了就爬墙。你爬的时候我会引开守卫。

english: Hey vampyre! Over here!
translation: 嘿，吸血鬼！这边！

english: I'll be here when you do.
translation: 你回来的时候我会在这儿的。

english: ...and you believe this creature will be suitable?
translation: ……你认为这个生物合适吗？

english: I have no doubt that it will adequately meet your requirements.
translation: 我毫不怀疑它能充分满足你的要求。

english: Perhaps. But I still believe the vyrewatch can handle this.
translation: 也许吧。但我仍然相信吸血鬼哨兵能处理这件事。

english: We've given your vyrewatch more than enough opportunities and yet the Myreque still elude us. It's time for another strategy.
translation: 我们已经给了你的吸血鬼哨兵足够多的机会，但迈雷克仍然躲着我们。是时候换个策略了。

english: The creature before you has advantages over a vyre. It is the perfect hunter. Once it gets a taste of its foes blood, it can track them anywhere.
translation: 你面前的这个生物比维尔吸血鬼更有优势。它是完美的猎手。一旦它尝到敌人的血，就能追踪到任何地方。

english: We'd still need the blood though.
translation: 不过我们仍然需要血。

english: I may have a solution to that, if this is indeed the route we're taking. There is also the question of your sister. She's specifically requested that Safalaan and that outsider be left to her.
translation: 如果这确实是我们选择的路线，我或许有解决办法。还有你妹妹的问题。她特别要求把萨法拉安和那个外来者留给她处理。

english: Now is not the time for her games. We can't afford to let the enemy slip through our fingers again.
translation: 现在不是她玩游戏的时候。我们不能再让敌人从我们手中溜走了。

english: Anyway, you worry about the Myreque. I'll handle Vanescula.
translation: 总之，你操心迈雷克的事。我来处理范内斯库拉。

english: Vanstrom?
translation: 范斯特罗姆？

english: Hmm?
translation: 嗯？

english: Very well, I will make preparations immediately. The sooner we deal with the Myreque the better. Even our kind have weaknesses and if Serafina could discover them, the Myreque can as well.
translation: 很好，我马上做准备。我们越早处理迈雷克越好。即使是我们这样的种族也有弱点，如果塞拉菲娜能发现它们，迈雷克也能。

english: Then I think we're done here. Thank you for your time Verzik.
translation: 那么我想我们谈完了。感谢你抽出时间，维齐克。

english: And thank you Ranis. You're always welcome here.
translation: 也谢谢你，拉尼斯。你在这里总是受欢迎的。

english: Well that didn't sound good. I'd better let Safalaan know.
translation: 嗯，听起来不妙。我最好告诉萨法拉安。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Do you have any news for us?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你有什么消息要告诉我们吗？

english: I do. It's not good I'm afraid.
translation: 有。恐怕不是什么好消息。

english: I managed to spy on a meeting between Vanstrom, Ranis and Verzik Vitur. Verzik gifted them this strange creature which she said would help them track down the Myreque.
translation: 我成功偷听到了范斯特罗姆、拉尼斯和维齐克.维图尔的一次会面。维齐克送给他们一个奇怪的生物，她说这能帮助他们追踪迈雷克。

english: Track down the Myreque? How?
translation: 追踪迈雷克？怎么追踪？

english: She claimed that the creature could track anyone provided it got a taste of their blood.
translation: 她声称这个生物只要尝到目标的血，就能追踪任何人。

english: So they'd still need blood from one of us? We might be okay then. It's not like the vampyres name and number the tithes they take.
translation: 所以他们仍然需要从我们中的某个人身上取血？那我们可能还好。吸血鬼又不是会给他们征收的血税命名和编号。

english: I wouldn't be so sure. Vanstrom seemed to think he had a way around that. Not only that, it sounded like he'd be making his move very soon.
translation: 我不太确定。范斯特罗姆似乎认为他有办法绕过这个问题。不仅如此，听起来他很快就会采取行动。

english: This isn't good. If Vanstrom thinks he can use this creature against us, I have no reason to disbelieve him. He's proven time and time again that he should not be underestimated.
translation: 这可不妙。如果范斯特罗姆认为他能用这个生物对付我们，我没有理由不相信他。他一次又一次地证明了他不容小觑。

english: So what's our plan?
translation: 那我们有什么计划？

english: I'm not sure yet. We'll need to make one quickly though.
translation: 我还不确定。不过我们得尽快制定一个。

english: Can I help with anything?
translation: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: Vertida and I will begin forming a plan of action. In the meantime, do you remember that book on haemalchemy you found for us?
translation: 维尔蒂达和我会开始制定行动计划。与此同时，你还记得你为我们找到的那本关于血炼术的书吗？

english: Well our head researcher, Flaygian Screwte, has been working on translating it. Could you check up on him and see how things are going?
translation: 我们的首席研究员弗莱吉恩.斯克鲁特一直在翻译它。你能去看看他，看看进展如何吗？

english: Remind me.
translation: 提醒我一下。

english: Following a hint given to you by Sarius Guile, Vanescula Drakan's servant, you found a secret laboratory beneath Meiyerditch. Inside you found a book on haemalchemy.
translation: 根据范内斯库拉.德雷坎的仆从萨里乌斯.盖尔给你的提示，你在迈尔迪奇地下发现了一个秘密实验室。在里面你找到了一本关于血炼术的书。

english: Ah yes. So, what's happening with this book?
translation: 啊，是的。那么这本书怎么样了？

english: Hello there. Safalaan said you were working on translating the haemalchemy book.
translation: 你好。萨法拉安说你在翻译那本血炼术的书。

english: Indeed I am. It's not a quick process I'm afraid. Large parts of the book are written using the vampyric language which isn't easy to translate.
translation: 确实如此。恐怕这不是一个快速的过程。书的大部分内容都是用吸血鬼语写的，不容易翻译。

english: I didn't know the vampyres had their own language.
translation: 我不知道吸血鬼有自己的语言。

english: Oh yes. It seems to be very old and they don't use it much anymore but it does exist. I suspect it comes in quite useful for things like this where they don't want humans prying into their work.
translation: 哦，是的。它似乎非常古老，他们现在不怎么用了，但它确实存在。我怀疑它在像这样他们不想让人类窥探他们工作的事情上非常有用。

english: But you can translate it? How's that going so far?
translation: 但你能翻译它？目前进展如何？

english: Like I say, it's slow. My knowledge on the language only comes from things I've seen around the city so I'm having to make a lot of assumptions. I'm making progress though.
translation: 就像我说的，很慢。我对这种语言的了解只来自我在城里看到的东西，所以我不得不做很多假设。不过我在取得进展。

english: Anything to report?
translation: 有什么要报告的吗？

english: The book seems to document a lot of the experiments being performed in that lab you found. Interestingly, the experiments were performed on vampyres themselves, as well as humans.
translation: 这本书似乎记录了你发现的那个实验室里进行的许多实验。有趣的是，实验是在吸血鬼自身以及人类身上进行的。

english: It appears that they were trying to use the power of haemalchemy to modify both humans and vampyres.
translation: 看来他们试图利用血炼术的力量来改造人类和吸血鬼。

english: What is haemalchemy?
translation: 什么是血炼术？

english: There are some that believe there is a hidden power in blood. Haemalchemy is the act of modifying blood, both magically and scientifically, to harness this power.
translation: 有些人相信血液中隐藏着力量。血炼术就是通过魔法和科学手段改造血液，以利用这种力量的行为。

english: It seems that the vampyres are strong believers in the power of haemalchemy as they've been experimenting quite heavily.
translation: 看来吸血鬼是血炼术力量的坚定信徒，因为他们一直在进行大量的实验。

english: It looks like they had two reasons. First of all they were looking for a way to increase the amount of blood that can be harvested from a human.
translation: 看起来他们有两个原因。首先，他们在寻找一种方法来增加可以从人类身上采集的血量。

english: Unsurprisingly, the vampyres here have multiplied much faster than the humans. Perhaps there's no longer enough blood to go around.
translation: 毫不意外，这里的吸血鬼繁殖速度比人类快得多。也许已经没有足够的血来维持了。

english: And the other reason?
translation: 那另一个原因呢？

english: That's the more interesting one. As we're already aware, vampyres possess some form of immunity against our attacks.
translation: 那才是更有趣的一个。正如我们已经知道的，吸血鬼对我们的攻击拥有某种形式的免疫力。

english: It starts off as only partial in juveniles and juvinates but by the time they become vyres they are totally invulnerable.
translation: 在幼年和少年阶段，这种免疫力只是部分性的，但等到他们成为成年吸血鬼时，就完全无敌了。

english: This book implies that the vampyres immunity isn't perfect and that it can be overcome. It seems they were trying to improve this immunity.
translation: 这本书暗示吸血鬼的免疫力并非完美，是可以被克服的。看来他们当时正试图增强这种免疫力。

english: Overcome? How?
translation: 克服？怎么克服？

english: I haven't got that far yet I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我还没读到那部分。

english: Hmmm. I might actually be able to help with that bit. I was spying on Vanstrom and Ranis earlier for Safalaan and I heard Vanstrom say something quite interesting.
translation: 嗯。我或许能帮上忙。我之前为萨法拉安监视范斯特罗姆和拉尼斯，听到范斯特罗姆说了一些很有趣的话。

english: He implied that Serafina had discovered their weakness.
translation: 他暗示塞拉菲娜发现了他们的弱点。

english: Serafina? As in the Serafina who survived the Theatre of Blood?
translation: 塞拉菲娜？是那个在血腥剧场中幸存下来的塞拉菲娜吗？

english: I believe so.
translation: 我想是的。

english: That would actually make a lot of sense. We've always wondered how Serafina managed to survive all of the challenges in the Theatre.
translation: 那其实说得通。我们一直好奇塞拉菲娜是如何在剧场的所有挑战中幸存下来的。

english: But what if she never needed to? Maybe she took advantage of the vampyres weakness and forced them to let her leave?
translation: 但如果她根本不需要呢？也许她利用了吸血鬼的弱点，强迫他们放她离开？

english: Do you think this is worth exploring?
translation: 你觉得这值得探究吗？

english: I do. I'll stay here and keep working on this book. You head out and see if you can find out what Serafina discovered. Safalaan should be able to help you.
translation: 是的。我会留在这里继续研究这本书。你出去看看能不能查出塞拉菲娜发现了什么。萨法拉安应该能帮你。

english: What do I need to do again?
translation: 我需要再做什么？

english: We need to find out what Serafina discovered about the vampyres. Talk to Safalaan, he should be able to help you.
translation: 我们需要查明塞拉菲娜发现了关于吸血鬼的什么。去和萨法拉安谈谈，他应该能帮你。

english: Hi Safalaan. How are things going?
translation: 嗨，萨法拉安。情况怎么样？

english: Not good I'm afraid, [player name]. We've looked over our options and we can't see any solution to this problem. If the vampyres truly have the ability to track us then we won't be safe anywhere in Morytania.
translation: 恐怕不太好，[player name]。我们审视了所有选择，但看不到任何解决这个问题的办法。如果吸血鬼真的有能力追踪我们，那我们在莫利塔尼亚任何地方都不安全。

english: So what do we do?
translation: 那我们怎么办？

english: We'll have to leave. We should be able to sneak out of Meiyerditch using the same route you did.
translation: 我们得离开。我们应该能用你之前用的那条路线偷偷溜出迈尔迪奇。

english: We can meet up with Veliaf and the rest of the Myreque in Burgh de Rott. Once we're all together, we can travel to Paterdomus and cross the Salve into Misthalin.
translation: 我们可以在伯格德罗特镇与维利亚夫和迈雷克的其他成员会合。等大家聚齐后，我们可以前往帕特多姆斯，穿过萨尔维河进入米斯塔林。

english: Retreat to Misthalin? But what about all the people here that need our help? They'll die without us.
translation: 撤退到米斯塔林？那这里所有需要帮助的人怎么办？没有我们他们会死的。

english: I know it's not ideal, but we can't help anyone if we're dead. The only place we'll be safe from this new threat is on the other side of the Salve.
translation: 我知道这不理想，但如果我们死了，谁也帮不了。唯一能避开这个新威胁的安全之地是在萨尔维河的另一边。

english: There must be another way. What about Roald's mercenaries? Can't they help us?
translation: 一定还有别的办法。罗阿尔德的雇佣兵呢？他们不能帮我们吗？

english: Even with their help the vampyres outnumber us ten to one. The only reason we've survived this long is by hiding in the shadows. Once the vampyres know where we are, we'll be doomed.
translation: 即使有他们帮忙，吸血鬼的数量也是我们的十倍。我们能活到现在唯一的原因就是躲在暗处。一旦吸血鬼知道我们在哪里，我们就完了。

english: I'm sorry, [player name]. This isn't the end of our fight though. Once we're in Misthalin we can build up our strength and find more support. We'll come back stronger than ever before.
translation: 对不起，[player name]。但这并不是我们战斗的结束。一旦到了米斯塔林，我们可以积蓄力量，寻找更多支持。我们会比以前更强大地回来。

english: So when do we leave?
translation: 那我们什么时候走？

english: It will take a while to pack up all of our equipment but we aim to be gone as soon as possible.
translation: 打包所有装备需要一些时间，但我们的目标是尽快离开。

english: Do you think there's time for one last job before we go?
translation: 你觉得我们走之前还有时间做最后一件事吗？

english: I guess that depends what it is.
translation: 那得看是什么事。

english: While translating the haemalchemy book, Flaygian found reference to a possible weakness in the vampyres.
translation: 在翻译血炼术书时，弗拉吉安发现了一处提到吸血鬼可能存在的弱点的内容。

english: Not only that, I also heard Vanstrom talking about this same weakness. He implied that Serafina found a way to take advantage of it.
translation: 不仅如此，我还听到范斯特罗姆谈到同样的弱点。他暗示塞拉菲娜找到了利用它的方法。

english: Serafina? I suspect she's nothing more than a myth. A tale fabricated by the vampyres to drive people to that Theatre of theirs.
translation: 塞拉菲娜？我怀疑她不过是个神话。是吸血鬼编造的故事，用来驱使人们去他们的那个剧场。

english: But this came from Vanstrom himself.
translation: 但这是范斯特罗姆亲口说的。

english: That is a valid point I guess. Old Man Ral used to tell plenty of stories about Serafina and he did once tell me where she apparently lived.
translation: 我想这倒是个合理的观点。老人拉尔以前讲过很多关于塞拉菲娜的故事，他确实告诉过我她似乎住在哪里。

english: I suppose we have time to go and have a quick look around while the others pack everything up here.
translation: 我想我们还有时间，趁其他人在这里打包的时候，去快速查看一下。

english: So where do we go?
translation: 那我们去哪里？

english: You'll find the house in sector four. To get there, leave the base, head north and then head west. Go all the way to the western wall and you'll find a broken fountain. The house is the one directly south of the fountain.
translation: 你会在第四区找到那栋房子。要去那里，离开基地，向北走，然后向西走。一直走到西墙，你会看到一个破损的喷泉。房子就在喷泉的正南方。

english: It's best that we travel separately so you head out first and I'll meet you there.
translation: 我们最好分开走，所以你先出发，我在那里和你碰面。

english: How can I find the house again?
translation: 我怎么才能再找到那房子？

english: You'll find it in sector four. To get there, leave the base, head north and then head west. Go all the way to the western wall and you'll find a broken fountain. The house is the one directly south of the fountain.
translation: 你会在第四区找到它。要去那里，离开基地，向北走，然后向西走。一直走到西墙，你会看到一个破损的喷泉。房子就在喷泉的正南方。

english: This looks like the fountain that Safalaan mentioned. Serafina's house must be this one to the south.
translation: 这看起来像是萨法拉安提到的喷泉。塞拉菲娜的房子一定是南边这栋。

english: So this is where Serafina lived. Or so they claim.
translation: 所以这就是塞拉菲娜住过的地方。或者他们是这样声称的。

english: Everyone else I've spoken to looks up to Serafina, but you don't even think she was real.
translation: 我见过的其他人都很敬仰塞拉菲娜，但你甚至不认为她是真实存在的。

english: I guess it's not about if she was real or not. It's about what she is now. A symbol. A false one.
translation: 我想这无关她是否真实。而是她现在代表什么。一个象征。一个虚假的象征。

english: Every day, citizens of Meiyerditch throw their lives away in that damn Theatre. All because of her.
translation: 每天，迈尔迪奇的市民都在那个该死的剧场里送命。全都是因为她。

english: But why don't they fight with the Myreque instead?
translation: 但他们为什么不加入迈雷克一起战斗呢？

english: I guess they don't think the vampyres will ever be beaten. They believe that joining the Myreque will lead to certain death.
translation: 我想他们不认为吸血鬼会被打败。他们相信加入迈雷克必死无疑。

english: Thanks to Serafina, they believe that they at least have a chance with the Theatre.
translation: 多亏了塞拉菲娜，他们相信至少在剧场里还有一线生机。

english: Anyway, I'm getting distracted. There's a locked door here that might be hiding what we're looking for. Let's see if we can find a way to open it.
translation: 总之，我分心了。这里有一扇锁着的门，可能藏着我们要找的东西。看看我们能不能找到打开它的方法。

english: We should keep looking.
translation: 我们应该继续找找。

english: I found a herb. It's not a type I recognise.
translation: 我找到了一株草药。不是我认识的那种。

english: Maybe a potion is needed. See if you can make one. You can get some water from the broken fountain outside.
translation: 也许需要一种药水。看看你能不能做一瓶。你可以从外面破损的喷泉里取些水。

english: How odd. We should see if we can find anything else.
translation: 真奇怪。我们应该看看能不能找到别的东西。

english: I found some ingredients and started making a potion with them.
translation: 我找到了一些材料，开始用它们制作药水。

english: A potion? See if you can finish it off.
translation: 药水？看看你能不能把它完成。

english: I found some ingredients and made a potion with them.
translation: 我找到了一些材料，用它们制作了一瓶药水。

english: Interesting. Maybe there's something you can use it with.
translation: 有趣。也许有什么东西你可以用它来配合。

english: The door has an inscription on it.
translation: 门上刻有铭文。

english: What does it say?
translation: 上面写着什么？

english: 'Blood is the price of victory.'
translation: “血是胜利的代价。”

english: Blood? Maybe haemalchemy is involved here. We should keep looking around.
translation: 血？也许这里涉及血炼术。我们应该继续四处看看。

english: I found some ingredients for a potion. I made it and tried using it with the door but nothing happened. I also found an inscription on the door.
translation: 我找到了一些药水材料。我制作了药水并试着用在门上，但什么也没发生。我还发现门上有一句铭文。

english: Hmm... I wonder...
translation: 嗯……我在想……

english: What are you thinking?
translation: 你在想什么？

english: I have an idea that may work. Bring me an empty vial.
translation: 我有个主意，可能行得通。给我拿个空瓶来。

english: 'Blood is the price of victory.' Now try making the potion with this. If my suspicions are correct it should work.
translation: “血是胜利的代价。”现在用这个试试做药水。如果我的猜测正确，应该能行。

english: Fine. Next time please warn me before you start cutting yourself.
translation: 好吧。下次你开始割自己之前请先提醒我。

english: Do you have that vial?
translation: 你有那个瓶子吗？

english: Well bring one to me. I have an idea.
translation: 那就带一个给我。我有个主意。

english: Could I have another vial of blood.
translation: 能再给我一瓶血瓶吗？

english: I don't have unlimited blood you know! Use the one you've got.
translation: 你知道我没有无限的血！用你有的那瓶。

english: I hope you don't think I have unlimited blood to spare. Bring me another vial and try not to lose this one.
translation: 我希望你不认为我有无限的血可以浪费。再给我拿个瓶子来，这次别弄丢了。

english: Please be more careful with this one. I'd rather not die of blood loss.
translation: 请对这个瓶子更小心些。我可不想失血过多而死。

english: Any luck with that potion?
translation: 那瓶药水有进展吗？

english: Keep at it.
translation: 继续努力。

english: I've got a finished potion here.
translation: 我这里有一瓶做好的药水。

english: Well try using it with the door. If my suspicions are correct it should work.
translation: 那就试试用在门上。如果我的猜测正确，应该能行。

english: It worked this time. The door is unlocked.
translation: 这次成功了。门开了。

english: Good work. Hopefully there's something useful behind it.
translation: 干得好。希望后面有什么有用的东西。

english: I found some old notes behind the door.
translation: 我在门后找到了一些破旧的纸条。

english: Excellent. Hopefully they contain something useful. We should head back to the hideout and give them to Flaygian. I can take them if you want?
translation: 太好了。希望里面有些有用的东西。我们应该回藏身处把它们交给弗拉吉安。如果你愿意，我可以拿着它们？

english: Thanks. We should head back to the hideout.
translation: 谢谢。我们应该回藏身处了。

english: I'll look after them.
translation: 我会保管它们的。

english: As you wish. Just make sure they get to Flaygian at the hideout.
translation: 随你便。只要确保它们能到藏身处交给弗拉吉安就行。

english: I think we're all done here. We should head back to the hideout.
translation: 我想我们这里都做完了。我们应该回藏身处了。

english: How are things looking Vertida?
translation: 情况怎么样，维蒂达？

english: All of the essentials are packed up and ready to go.
translation: 所有必需品都打包好，准备出发了。

english: Excellent. Let the others know that we'll be leaving shortly.
translation: 太好了。告诉其他人我们很快就要出发了。

english: I... I don't understand...
translation: 我……我不明白……

english: What is it, Flaygian?
translation: 怎么了，弗拉吉安？

english: I'm looking through these notes you found but there's nothing here.
translation: 我正在看你找到的这些笔记，但里面什么也没有。

english: What do you mean nothing?
translation: 你说什么也没有是什么意思？

english: As in nothing. It's just a load of rubbish. Why would Serafina have written this?
translation: 就是什么也没有。只是一堆垃圾。塞拉菲娜为什么会写这个？

english: Hello there. I'm afraid I'm quite busy at the moment. You should talk to Safalaan if you need something.
translation: 你好。恐怕我现在很忙。如果你需要什么，应该去找萨法拉恩。

english: Not yet. I'll let you know once I have something. In the meantime, you should check in with Safalaan.
translation: 还没有。一旦我有进展会通知你。同时，你应该去跟萨法拉恩汇报一下。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Did you find out anything about Serafina?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你查到关于塞拉菲娜的什么了吗？

english: Great! Hand them over then.
translation: 太好了！那把它们交出来吧。

english: Thanks. I'll start looking over them to see what we can learn. In the meantime, you should check in with Safalaan.
translation: 谢谢。我会开始翻阅这些笔记，看看能发现什么。同时，你应该去跟萨法拉恩汇报一下。

english: Hello again. Have you found out anything about Serafina yet?
translation: 又见面了。你查到关于塞拉菲娜的什么了吗？

english: Well let me know when you do. In the meantime, I'll keep working on this book.
translation: 好吧，查到了就告诉我。同时，我会继续研究这本书。

english: Please don't be childish, [player name]. I need to see these notes to work out if they're useful or not.
translation: 请不要孩子气，[player name]。我需要看看这些笔记才能确定它们有没有用。

english: Because she might not have been the one to write it. [player name], what was it that Verzik said about this creature Vanstrom is using?
translation: 因为可能不是她写的。[player name]，维齐克关于范斯特罗姆使用的那个生物说了什么？

english: That it can track anyone if it has a taste of their blood.
translation: 说它只要尝过一个人的血就能追踪任何人。

english: And when we were at Serafina's home, we used our blood to open that door.
translation: 而我们在塞拉菲娜家时，用了我们的血来打开那扇门。

english: You don't mean...
translation: 你不会是说……

english: Vanstrom! He used us as bait. Vertida, get the others. We need to leave now!
translation: 范斯特罗姆！他利用我们当诱饵。维蒂达，叫其他人。我们现在得走了！

english: Oh f...
The vyrewatch are getting more ferocious by the day. You're doing well if you can get from one side of Meiyerditch to the other without getting attacked!
translation: 吸血鬼哨兵一天比一天凶猛。你能从迈尔迪奇的一边走到另一边而不被攻击，就算很厉害了！

english: Mekritus!
translation: 梅克里图斯！

english: Time to die beast!
translation: 该死了，野兽！

english: I'm helping protect the base camp. How about you, what are you doing here?
translation: 我在帮忙保护大本营。你呢，你在这里做什么？

english: Flaygian look out!
translation: 弗莱吉恩，小心！

english: No! Flaygian!
translation: 不！弗莱吉恩！

english: What's happening? Safalaan?
translation: 发生什么事了？萨法拉恩？

english: It's weakened! Let's finish it off!
translation: 它变弱了！让我们了结它！

english: Safalaan! Are you okay?
translation: 萨法拉恩！你没事吧？

english: I'll be fine. Now we need to get out of here before Vanstrom and his vampyres turn up.
translation: 我没事。现在我们需要在范斯特罗姆和他的吸血鬼到来之前离开这里。

english: [player name], we have an old hideout beneath Old Man Ral's house in southern Meiyerditch. Meet us there.
translation: [player name]，我们在迈尔迪奇南部老人拉尔家的房子下面有一个旧藏身处。在那里与我们碰头。

english: Hello Veliaf.
translation: 你好，维利亚夫。

english: Vanstrom attacked the Myreque in Meiyerditch!
translation: 范斯特罗姆袭击了迈尔迪奇的迈雷克！

english: Well we need to go help!
translation: 那我们得去帮忙！

english: The attack is already over. We won but there were casualties.
translation: 攻击已经结束了。我们赢了，但也有伤亡。

english: Mekritus... Andiess... Flaygian... How many more need to die to those monsters?
translation: 梅克里图斯...安迪耶斯...弗莱吉恩...还需要多少人死在那群怪物手上？

english: Are you okay, Safalaan?
translation: 你没事吧，萨法拉恩？

english: I knew Serafina was a lie. But I wanted so hard to believe. To believe that someone could have actually beaten those vampyres.
translation: 我知道塞拉菲娜是个谎言。但我太想去相信了。相信真的有人能打败那些吸血鬼。

english: But I was naive and people died because of it.
translation: 但我太天真了，有人因此而死。

english: More would have died if not for you. Your magic weakened that thing. We would never have been able to kill it without that.
translation: 如果不是你，会有更多人丧命。你的魔法削弱了那东西。没有它，我们根本杀不死它。

english: What was that magic?
translation: 那是什么魔法？

english: To be honest, I don't know. It's a power I've had for as long as I can remember. I've never been able to control it though, it only seems to come on when I'm angry or threatened.
translation: 老实说，我不知道。这是我记事以来就拥有的力量。但我从未能控制它，似乎只有在我生气或受到威胁时才会出现。

english: How strange.
translation: 真奇怪。

english: Indeed. I wish I could tell you more about it but I don't actually remember much about the times it has happened. It's like I have these blank spots in my memory.
translation: 确实。我希望我能告诉你更多，但我实际上不太记得它发生时的情景。就好像我的记忆中有这些空白点。

english: Anyway, now is not the time to dwell on it.
translation: 总之，现在不是纠结这个的时候。

english: So what's the plan boss?
translation: 那么计划是什么，头儿？

english: We should make our way to Burgh de Rott and meet up with Veliaf and the others.
translation: 我们应该前往伯格德罗特镇，与维利亚夫他们会合。

english: You mean we're still leaving?
translation: 你的意思是我们还是要离开？

english: What other choice do we have?
translation: 我们还有其他选择吗？

english: I just lost some very good friends of mine. I can't walk away from that. The vampyres need to pay.
translation: 我刚刚失去了一些非常好的朋友。我不能就这样算了。吸血鬼必须付出代价。

english: We all nearly died back there. I don't intend to throw any more lives away today. We are leaving.
translation: 我们刚才都差点死在那里。我今天不打算再牺牲任何生命了。我们要离开。

english: Just think for a second though. The vampyres will probably think we all died in the attack. They'll have dropped their guard. Now is the best time to retaliate.
translation: 不过你想想看。那些吸血鬼大概会以为我们都在袭击中死了。他们会放松警惕。现在正是反击的最佳时机。

english: That is a good point.
translation: 说得好。

english: It is. However, in case you'd forgotten, we don't have anything to retaliate with. Serafina was a lie, just another one of Vanstrom's little plots.
translation: 确实。不过，以防你忘了，我们没有任何可以反击的东西。塞拉菲娜是个谎言，只是范斯特罗姆的另一个小把戏。

english: We have no weapon to use against the vampyres. And with Flaygian gone, that won't be changing.
translation: 我们没有可以用来对付吸血鬼的武器。而弗莱吉恩不在了，情况也不会改变。

english: Actually, I think you might be wrong there.
translation: 实际上，我认为你在这点上可能错了。

english: Flaygian managed to translate some more of the haemalchemy book while you two were investigating Serafina.
translation: 在你们两个调查塞拉菲娜时，弗莱吉恩成功翻译了血炼术书的更多内容。

english: We never got the chance to look over his new discoveries before the attack. However, I did recover his notes as we left.
translation: 在攻击之前，我们一直没机会查看他的新发现。不过，我在离开时确实找回了他的笔记。

english: Hmmm... All right. [player name], work with Vertida and see if you can finish off Flaygian's work. Make no mistake though, if this doesn't come to anything then we will be leaving.
translation: 嗯...好吧。[player name]，和维蒂达一起工作，看看你们能否完成弗莱吉恩的工作。不过别搞错了，如果这没有结果，那我们就会离开。

english: Hello Vertida.
translation: 你好，维蒂达。

english: Hello there. I have these notes for us to review. Come back when you have room for them and we'll get started.
translation: 你好。我有这些笔记要我们一起审查。等你有多余空间再来拿，我们就开始。

english: Hello there. Here are the notes Flaygian made. Have a read through and let me know if you need any help.
translation: 你好。这是弗莱吉恩做的笔记。通读一遍，如果需要帮助就告诉我。

english: Do you need any help with Flaygian's notes?
translation: 你需要帮忙处理弗莱吉恩的笔记吗？

english: I need the Rod of Ivandis
translation: 我需要伊万迪斯之杖

english: I imagine you'd know more about that than me. Weren't you the one who remade it?
translation: 我想你比我懂得更多。不是你重新制作了它吗？

english: I was but I gave it to Veliaf.
translation: 是我，但我把它给了维利亚夫。

english: Well I'm sure he still has it. You should ask him if you can have it back. Alternatively, you could always make another.
translation: 嗯，我肯定他还有。你应该问问他能不能拿回来。或者，你也可以重新做一个。

english: Check the crates around here, we should have some chain lying around.
translation: 检查一下这里的板条箱，我们应该有锁链放在附近。

english: Well we have some blessed silver sickles in storage here. You should check the crates. What kind of enchantment does it need?
translation: 嗯，我们这里库存了一些祝福过的银镰刀。你应该检查板条箱。它需要什么附魔？

english: An emerald enchantment
translation: 绿宝石附魔

english: Well you'll need to get an emerald and attach it to the sickle. You'll be needing a chisel to do that. Once you've attached the emerald, you should be able to enchant the sickle using an enchantment spell.
translation: 嗯，你需要弄到一颗绿宝石，然后把它装到镰刀上。你需要一把凿子来做这件事。一旦装上绿宝石，你应该就能用附魔法术给镰刀附魔了。

english: Hello Vertida. I've finished the weapon.
translation: 你好，维蒂达。我完成了武器。

english: Great work. You should let Safalaan know.
translation: 干得好。你应该告诉萨法拉恩。

english: I was wondering if I could ask a favour?
translation: 我在想能不能请你帮个忙？

english: Of cause, ask away.
translation: 当然，尽管问。

english: Would it be possible for me to have the Rod of Ivandis back?
translation: 我能否拿回伊万迪斯之杖？

english: I want to convert it into a flail. I have reason to believe that will make it even more effective against vampyres.
translation: 我想把它改造成连枷。我有理由相信这会使它对吸血鬼更有效。

english: Well I can hardly say no to that. Here you go.
translation: 嗯，我很难拒绝。给你。

english: Well I'd be happy to help but you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 嗯，我很乐意帮忙，但你没有足够的空间放它。

english: Looks like you have one right there.
translation: 看起来你那里就有一个。

english: Oh yeah, how didn't I notice.
translation: 哦对，我怎么没注意到。

english: But I already gave it to you.
translation: 但我已经把它给你了。

english: Well you'll just have to make another then. That was the only one I had.
translation: 嗯，那你只能再做一个了。那是我唯一的一个。

english: Hopefully Flaygain's work will help us against the vampyres.
translation: 希望弗莱吉恩的工作能帮助我们对抗吸血鬼。

english: Good news Safalaan, the weapon is complete.
translation: 好消息，萨法拉恩，武器完成了。

english: About time we had some good news. Great work.
translation: 总算有点好消息了。干得好。

english: Well I wasn't convinced at first but it turns out you were right. The vampyres seem to believe we're all dead. That's not all though, tell them Kael.
translation: 嗯，我一开始并不相信，但结果证明你是对的。吸血鬼似乎以为我们都死了。不过还不止这些，告诉他们，凯尔。

english: Ranis Drakan himself has sent an open invitation to the people of Meiyerditch, inviting them to Ver Sinhaza.
translation: 拉尼斯.德雷坎本人向迈尔迪奇的民众发出公开邀请，邀请他们前往维辛扎。

english: Apparently he intends to officially announce the defeat of the Myreque.
translation: 显然他打算正式宣布迈雷克的失败。

english: This is quite possibly one of the best opportunities we've ever been given. Ranis Drakan is brother to Lowerniel Drakan himself and is one of the most senior figures in vampyric society.
translation: 这很可能是我们得到过的最好机会之一。拉尼斯.德雷坎是洛厄尼尔.德雷坎本人的兄弟，也是吸血鬼社会中最高层的人物之一。

english: And for the first time, we have a weapon that could actually defeat him.
translation: 而且，我们第一次有了一把能真正打败他的武器。

english: Exactly. This is our chance to bring real hope to these people. The death of any vampyre would send a strong message but the death of Ranis Drakan could change everything.
translation: 正是如此。这是我们给这些人带来真正希望的机会。任何一个吸血鬼的死都会发出强烈的信号，但拉尼斯.德雷坎的死能改变一切。

english: You don't need to convince me. It's time to show these monsters that their days are done.
translation: 你不需要说服我。是时候向这些怪物展示他们的末日到了。

english: [player name], you are not a citizen of Meiyerditch. You have never felt the pain that these people have. And yet, you have fought for them all the same.
translation: [player name]，你不是迈尔迪奇的市民。你从未感受过这些人所经历的痛苦。然而，你仍然为他们战斗。

english: Now I must ask that you fight for them again. You are the most experienced amongst us. You have the best chance of defeating Ranis.
translation: 现在我必须请求你再次为他们而战。你是我们中最有经验的。你最有可能击败拉尼斯。

english: I've come this far. I'm not about to leave now. What's our plan.
translation: 我已经走到这一步了。现在不打算离开。我们的计划是什么？

english: Take the new weapon and head to Ver Sinhaza. Kael will meet you there. Wait until Ranis has begun his speech, that will be the best time to strike.
translation: 带上新武器前往维辛扎。凯尔会在那里和你碰头。等到拉尼斯开始演讲，那将是发起攻击的最佳时机。

english: I won't let you down.
translation: 我不会让你失望的。

english: Thank you, [player name]. Myreque prevail.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。迈雷克必胜。

english: Hello, player. I'll be leaving for Ver Sinhaza soon. You should meet me there.
translation: 你好，玩家。我马上就要出发去维辛扎了。你应该在那里与我碰头。

english: Hello, player. You'd better get moving. Ranis will be starting his speech soon.
translation: 你好，玩家。你最好快点行动。拉尼斯马上就要开始演讲了。

english: Well I have made a few more. I suppose I could let you have one. I'll have to charge you though, some of this stuff isn't easy to get hold of.
translation: 嗯，我又做了几个。我想我可以给你一个。不过我得收费，有些东西不容易弄到。

english: 20,000 coins should do it.
translation: 两万金币应该够了。

english: Sounds good to me. I'll take it.
translation: 听起来不错。我买了。

english: Here you go. Put it to good use
translation: 给你。好好利用它。

english: I'm afraid you don't have enough room for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 恐怕你没有足够的空间。等有了再来吧。

english: That's a bit too much for me. I guess I'll make myself another one instead.
translation: 对我来说有点太贵了。我想我还是自己再做一个吧。

english: I don't have that much on me.
translation: 我身上没带那么多。

english: Well met, [player name]. Ranis will be starting his speech soon. Are you ready?
translation: 幸会，[player name]。拉尼斯马上要开始演讲了。你准备好了吗？

english: Well just let me know when you are.
translation: 好吧，等你准备好了就告诉我。

english: Citizens of Meiyerditch! I stand before you today so that we may share in a moment of triumph!
translation: 迈尔迪奇的市民们！我今天站在你们面前，是为了让我们共同分享胜利的时刻！

english: For years, the Myreque have lurked in the shadows of this city! Their acts of defiance tainting the greatness that we have all achieved together!
translation: 多年来，迈雷克一直潜伏在这座城市的阴影中！他们的反抗行为玷污了我们共同取得的伟大成就！

english: Today, that defiance finally came to an end! Today, we entered the home of the Myreque and eradicated their kind!
translation: 今天，这种反抗终于结束了！今天，我们闯入了迈雷克的老巢，消灭了他们的同类！

english: Our efforts today would not have been possible without every single one of you. The blood you provide ensures that we remain ever capable of facing these threats.
translation: 没有你们每一个人，我们今天就不可能取得这些成果。你们提供的血液确保我们始终有能力面对这些威胁。

english: For that, you should all be proud.
translation: 为此，你们都应该感到自豪。

english: However, while today is very much a day of celebration, it should also act as a reminder.
translation: 然而，虽然今天是一个非常值得庆祝的日子，但它也应该作为一个提醒。

english: Rebellion. Resistance. Defiance. These are not the path to freedom. They are merely the path to death.
translation: 反叛。抵抗。反抗。这些都不是自由之路。它们只是通向死亡之路。

english: Anyone who wishes to be free of this life should instead look to Serafina.
translation: 任何想要摆脱这种生活的人，应该转而看向塞拉菲娜。

english: Follow in her footsteps. Enter the Theatre and survive. Do this and freedom will be yours.
translation: 追随她的脚步。进入剧院并活下来。做到这一点，自由就属于你。

english: As good as all of that sounds, I do have just a few issues with it.
translation: 尽管这一切听起来很好，但我确实有些异议。

english: What is this?
translation: 这是什么？

english: You stand here claiming the Myreque are dead but I'm here to prove otherwise.
translation: 你站在这里声称迈雷克已经死了，但我来此就是要证明并非如此。

english: For too long you have lorded yourself over these people. Today, that comes to an end. Today...
translation: 你凌驾于这些人之上太久了。今天，这一切都将结束。今天...

english: ...you die.
translation: ...你死定了。

english: You know, over the course of my life, I have tasted more blood than you could ever imagine. The variety of flavours is incredible, and yet, there's one taste that all others pale in comparison to.
translation: 你知道吗，在我的一生中，我品尝过的血液比你想象的还要多。各种风味令人难以置信，然而，有一种味道让其他所有味道都相形见绌。

english: You see, there's nothing sweeter than a taste of hope. And you're full of it.
translation: 你看，没有什么比希望的味道更甜美了。而你，满身都是。

english: I'm going to enjoy killing you.
translation: 我会很享受杀死你的过程。

english: I take it you killed that abomination then? It was a human once you know. How does that feel?
translation: 那么我猜你杀了那个憎恶怪？它曾经是个人类，你知道吗。感觉如何？

english: He was doomed. With his illness he'd have soon died with or without our tithing. We saved him, just like she wanted. All for you to just kill him!
translation: 他注定要死。以他的病情，不管我们是否献祭，他很快都会死。我们救了他，正如她所愿。结果你却杀了他！

english: She was one of the smart ones. She was willing! Saving him was all that mattered. She was ready to sacrifice anything for that.
translation: 她是聪明人之一。她是自愿的！救他才是最重要的。她愿意为此牺牲一切。

english: It's a shame her mind is no longer there. One of the negatives of the process unfortunately. Otherwise I'd have introduced you. I'm sure she'd have loved to meet her brother's killer.
translation: 可惜她的心智已经不在了。不幸的是，这是该过程的副作用之一。否则我早就介绍你们认识了。我相信她一定很想见见杀死她兄弟的杀手。

english: Sooo... I guess this is the part where I say something...
translation: 所以...我想现在是该我说点什么的时候了...

english: For hundreds of years, the people of Morytania have suffered under Lord Lowerniel Drakan and his vampyres.
translation: 数百年来，莫利塔尼亚的人民一直遭受着洛厄尼尔.德雷坎领主及其吸血鬼的压迫。

english: For too long, they've filled you with false hope. Hope of freedom. All you have to do is follow Serafina and you'll be free. Or so they claim.
translation: 长久以来，他们用虚假的希望填满你们。自由的希望。你只需要跟随塞拉菲娜就能获得自由。至少他们是这么声称的。

english: Well whoever Serafina was, she is gone. There is no freedom in that Theatre. No hope. Just lies. If freedom is truly what you want, there is another path.
translation: 不管塞拉菲娜是谁，她已经不在了。那个剧院里没有自由。没有希望。只有谎言。如果你真的想要自由，还有另一条路。

english: You see, the vampyres are not as powerful as they'd have you believe. Ranis Drakan lies dead before you. Killed by a mere human. If he can die, so can the rest.
translation: 你看，吸血鬼并不像他们让你相信的那样强大。拉尼斯.德雷坎就死在你面前。被一个普通人类杀死。如果他能死，那么其他吸血鬼也能。

english: So now, I ask that you join us. Fight alongside the Myreque and together, we will push back the darkness of Hallowvale.
translation: 所以现在，我请求你加入我们。与迈雷克并肩作战，我们将一起击退哈洛维尔的黑暗。

english: Together, we will end the tyranny of the Drakan family. Together, we will bring hope to all of Morytania.
translation: 我们将一起终结德雷坎家族的暴政。我们将一起为整个莫利塔尼亚带来希望。

english: Myreque prevail!
translation: 迈雷克必胜！

english: That was amazing, [player name]. Now you'd better get back to the hideout. This place will be filled with vampyres soon.
translation: 太棒了，[player name]。现在你最好回藏身处去。这里很快就会被吸血鬼填满。

english: Good news Safalaan, Ranis Drakan is no more!
translation: 好消息，萨法拉安，拉尼斯.德雷坎已经死了！

english: I've already heard. The whole city is talking about it.
translation: 我已经听说了。全城都在议论这件事。

english: [player name], it can never be understated what you have done today. This is the turning of the tide in our battle and it's all down to you.
translation: [player name]，你今天所做的一切再怎么强调也不为过。这是我们战斗的转折点，全都归功于你。

english: Thanks Safalaan. What happens now?
translation: 谢谢，萨法拉安。现在怎么办？

english: Lowerniel Drakan is unlikely to ignore the death of his brother. He will do everything he can to destroy us. I don't expect things to be easy for us from here.
translation: 洛厄尼尔.德雷坎不太可能无视他兄弟的死。他会竭尽全力摧毁我们。我不指望接下来的日子会轻松。

english: However, thanks to you, we should hopefully see more support for our own cause. You've finally given these people something to fight for. Something real.
translation: 不过，多亏了你，我们的事业有望获得更多支持。你终于给了这些人一个奋斗的目标。一个真实的目标。

english: We'll start planning what our next steps should be right away. You can leave that to us though, you've earnt a break.
translation: 我们会立即开始计划下一步行动。不过你可以把这些交给我们，你赢得了休息的机会。

english: Also, it seems only right that you are rewarded for what you've done today. I can't offer much but I do have this tome of knowledge that might come in useful. I think Kael has something for you as well.
translation: 另外，你今天所做的一切理应得到奖励。我拿不出太多东西，但我有这本知识典籍，或许能派上用场。我想凯尔也有东西给你。

english: That's right. I recovered this medallion from Ranis, you might find a good use for it.
translation: 没错。我从拉尼斯那里找到了这枚勋章，你也许能好好利用它。

english: Anyway, we'll let you get off. And once again, [player name], thank you.
translation: 总之，我们让你走吧。再次感谢你，[player name]。

english: Much better thanks to you. It actually feels like we're winning for once.
translation: 多亏了你，好多了。终于感觉我们好像要赢了。

english: Good to have you here, player.Everthing seems to feel more positive when you're around.
translation: 很高兴你在这里，玩家。你在的时候，一切似乎都更积极了。

english: Hmmm... Lord Drakan won't be pleased about this.
translation: 嗯...德雷坎领主不会高兴的。

english: Oh I'm counting on it...
translation: 哦，我正指望呢...

english: Hello there, I'm busy with my research. Come back in a bit, could you?
translation: 你好，我正忙着做研究。过会儿再来好吗？

english: Hello there and welcome to my humble abode. It's sadly rather more humble than I'd like, to be honest, although perhaps you can help with that?
translation: 你好，欢迎来到寒舍。说实话，这地方比我想象中寒酸多了，不过也许你能帮上忙？

english: I would be happy to make your home a better place.
translation: 我很乐意帮你把家变得更舒适。

english: Yay, I didn't even have to talk about a reward; you're more gullible than most adventurers, that's for sure.
translation: 耶，我甚至不用提报酬的事；你比大多数冒险者还好骗，这点毫无疑问。

english: Don't worry, though; I just need you to help fix this vile old bed for me. Then I'll find a suitable reward for you.
translation: 不过别担心；我只需要你帮我修好这张破旧的老床。然后我会给你一份合适的报酬。

english: Great, will I be able to take a nap in it?
translation: 太好了，我能在这床上打个盹吗？

english: Don't be silly; everyone knows that true warriors don't ever sleep...or perform many other bodily functions, for that matter. I'll come up with something, though.
translation: 别傻了；谁都知道真正的战士从不睡觉……也不怎么进行其他身体机能活动。不过我会想出点东西来的。

english: I'm not convinced by just a vague something; can you be a slight bit more inspiring in your offer?
translation: 光说个模糊的“东西”可说服不了我；你的提议能不能再具体点？

english: What I need is simple: a couple of undead chickens. You should be able to pick some up at the farm near Port Phasmatys. I'll use one for my bed, then see what I can make from the other in the way of a reward. I have some ideas involving infinite feathers.
translation: 我需要的东西很简单：几只亡灵鸡。你应该能在法斯提斯港附近的农场弄到一些。我会用一只来修床，然后看看能用另一只做出什么当报酬。我有些关于无限羽毛的想法。

english: Very well then, I shall await my mystery prize with bated breath.
translation: 那好吧，我就屏息以待我的神秘奖品了。

english: I'm not much into interior design, to tell the truth.
translation: 说实话，我对室内设计不太感兴趣。

english: Very well, I suppose I'll just have to resort to the Professor's patented sleeping aid in order to get some rest. It does so bruise my head, though.
translation: 好吧，看来我只能用教授那专利助眠法来休息了。不过那东西确实会撞得我头疼。

english: What's a nice girl like you doing in a place like this?
translation: 像你这样的好姑娘在这种地方做什么？

english: I'm not a nice girl. I'm a respectable scientist researching the interactions between ghosts and the force of pure science.
translation: 我不是什么好姑娘。我是一位研究幽灵与纯粹科学力量之间互动的可敬科学家。

english: I took over the position of assistant the the Professor upstairs, although, to be honest, his methods are somewhat eccentric. Did you head about the Ernest scandal?
translation: 我接替了楼上教授的助理职位，不过说实话，他的方法有点古怪。你听说过欧内斯特那桩丑闻吗？

english: Ah, yes. I helped sort that out; he did seem a bit odd.
translation: 啊，是的。我帮忙解决了那件事；他确实有点奇怪。

english: You don't know the half of it - can you believe that he thinks he has proven Goldbach's First Conjecture using an optimised segmented sieve?
translation: 你只知其一不知其二——你能相信吗，他居然认为自己用优化分段筛法证明了哥德巴赫第一猜想？

english: Er, quite, Yes.
translation: 呃，确实，是的。

english: Do you need a reminder what you are supposed to do? I know you must have shiny beads distracting you, but it is an important job you are doing for me.
translation: 需要我提醒你该做什么吗？我知道肯定有什么闪亮的小玩意儿在分散你的注意力，但你为我做的这件事很重要。

english: ...And people say we scientists are absent minded...
translation: ……还说我们科学家心不在焉……

english: You need to fetch 2 undead chickens for me to use in my redecoration. It's not rocket science.
translation: 你需要去弄两只亡灵鸡来，我要用来重新装饰。这又不是什么高深科学。

english: Rocket?
translation: 火箭？

english: If they existed, they would be like arrows but much, much bigger. Considering the mess you rangers make with small bits of stick, we scientists have decided they don't exist. Now get chicken hunting.
translation: 如果存在的话，它们就像箭矢，但要大得多得多。考虑到你们这些游侠用小木棍就能搞得一团糟，我们科学家决定它们不存在。现在去抓鸡吧。

english: No thank you; I just came to gossip with you.
translation: 不了谢谢；我只是来跟你聊聊天。

english: Well, the Witch next door has been cooking some rather nice gingerbread, but I don't think that counts as gossip.
translation: 嗯，隔壁的女巫最近烤了一些相当不错的姜饼，但我觉得那不算八卦。

english: Can you head off and do adventurous stuff, please? I hear the Wilderness is fun this time of year.
translation: 你能去做点冒险的事吗？我听说这个季节的荒野很好玩。

english: What are you doing? I'm not ticklish.
translation: 你在干什么？我可不怕痒。

english: What are you doing? Yuck, dead things.
translation: 你在干什么？噫，死东西。

english: What are you doing? Do I look that thin?
translation: 你在干什么？我看上去有那么瘦吗？

english: What are you doing? Trying to infect me with some vile disease?
translation: 你在干什么？想用什么恶心的疾病传染我吗？

english: I'm not sure what you are trying to do, are you sure you aren't slightly deranged?
translation: 我不确定你想干什么，你确定自己没疯吗？

english: I'm here about a quest.
translation: 我是来做任务的。

english: I am after one of your, er, unhealthier poultry. Could you help me?
translation: 我想要你的一只，呃，不太健康的家禽。你能帮我吗？

english: You need those useless, undead chickens? How odd you adventurers are.
translation: 你想要那些没用的亡灵鸡？你们这些冒险者真奇怪。

english: You need to talk to my husband, though - not that I can these days.
translation: 不过你得跟我丈夫谈——虽然我现在没法跟他谈。

english: Whyever would this be?
translation: 这又是为什么？

english: Can't you see, he is dead. I can't talk to the dead.
translation: 你看不见吗，他死了。我不能跟死人说话。

english: Woo woo!
translation: 呜呼！

english: I do miss the wife though; tell 'er I still loves her.
translation: 我确实很想念我老婆；告诉她我还爱着她。

english: Would I be able to buy some of your chickens?
translation: 我能买你几只鸡吗？

english: Talk to my wife and I'll think about it.
translation: 跟我老婆谈谈，我会考虑的。

english: 'Ave you talked to my wife for me?
translation: 你替我跟我老婆谈过了吗？

english: Not yet; I've been distracted by the thought of undead cow milk.
translation: 还没；我一直想着亡灵牛奶的事，分心了。

english: I have a message from your husband. He wants you to know that he still loves you, despite his ghostly state.
translation: 我带来了你丈夫的口信。他想让你知道，尽管他变成了幽灵，但他仍然爱你。

english: The curse of undeath was so cruel; all the men out here succumbed, but Lyra and I were left alive.
translation: 亡灵诅咒太残酷了；这里所有的男人都 succumbed 了，但莱拉和我还活着。

english: Tell him I love him but I can't find our savings. I know he had our collection of gold and 'prize cow' rosettes just before the curse struck.
translation: 告诉他我爱他，但我找不到我们的积蓄了。我知道在诅咒降临之前，他拿着我们收集的金币和'奖品奶牛'的玫瑰花结。

english: I'll have a word with him, then; magic has its uses I suppose.
translation: 那我去跟他说说；我想魔法总有它的用处。

english: Have you spoken to my husband yet?
translation: 你跟我丈夫谈过了吗？

english: I'm working on it
translation: 我正在处理。

english: Your wife says she needs the family cash and wants to know what you did with it.
translation: 你妻子说她需要家里的钱，想知道你把它怎么了。

english: Tell 'er I spent it on cheap spirits, har har.
translation: 告诉她我拿去买了便宜酒，哈哈。

english: Your sense of humour died too, it seems...
translation: 看来你的幽默感也死了……

english: Hah, just trying to lift your spirits.
translation: 哈，只是想逗你开心。

english: I rest my case.
translation: 我说完了。

english: Suit yerself, stick-in-the-mud. Anyway, Oim not one o' them yokels. Tell 'er I putted the cash in the bank like she always told me to.
translation: 随你便，老古板。总之，俺可不是那种乡巴佬。告诉她俺把钱存进银行了，就像她一直嘱咐俺的那样。

english: A warning to ya, too: annoy her and I'll haunt ya till yer hair turns white.
translation: 也警告你：要是惹恼了她，我就缠着你直到你头发变白。

english: Any luck wiv me wife?
translation: 跟我老婆谈得咋样了？

english: Nothing new, no.
translation: 没什么新进展。

english: I'm here about that quest.
translation: 我是来做那个任务的。

english: Your husband says he put the cash in the bank.
translation: 你丈夫说他把钱存银行了。

english: I'll need his bank pass, in that case.
translation: 那样的话，我需要他的银行密码。

english: Can't you just take a ghostspeak amulet? Then you could talk to him directly.
translation: 你就不能拿个鬼语护符吗？那样你就可以直接跟他说话了。

english: I tried that once, but all those other ghosts - and even the undead chickens and cows - scared me so much. I wouldn't try it again for all the cash in Varrock bank.
translation: 我试过一次，但所有那些其他幽灵——甚至那些亡灵鸡和亡灵牛——都把我吓坏了。就算把维洛克银行里所有的现金给我，我也不会再试了。

english: Have you asked him about the bank pass?
translation: 你问他银行密码的事了吗？

english: You may not believe me, but she wants me to find your bank pass now.
translation: 你可能不信，但她现在要我去找你的银行密码。

english: Maybe she said that, maybe she didn't. I think you're just after me savings. Tell 'er that no one but a fool gives away their pass numbers.
translation: 也许她说了，也许没说。我觉得你就是想要俺的积蓄。告诉她，只有傻瓜才会把密码告诉别人。

english: Go tell 'er now, if you're not a double-dealin' scammer, that is.
translation: 现在就去告诉她，除非你是个两面三刀的骗子。

english: 'Ave you talked to 'er?
translation: 你跟她谈过了吗？

english: Not since we last spoke.
translation: 自从上次谈过之后就没有了。

english: He says he won't trust me with the bank pass.
translation: 他说他不信任我，不会给我银行密码。

english: What if I gave some sort of altered ghostspeak amulet to him - surely that would work?
translation: 如果我给他一个某种改造过的鬼语护符呢——那肯定能行吧？

english: You're so clever; I've overheard passing adventurers say that there's some witch near here who changes ghostspeak amulets.
translation: 你真聪明；我偶然听到路过的冒险者说，附近有个女巫会改造鬼语护符。

english: I think she lives a bit west of that mad Professor Fenksomething, past the Farming patch.
translation: 我想她住在那个疯疯癫癫的芬克什么教授西边一点，过了种植地就是。

english: I'll see if I can find her. Big nose and a monstrous hat, I assume? I wonder where the beautiful young witches hide...
translation: 我去看看能不能找到她。大鼻子和怪帽子，我猜？不知道漂亮的女巫都躲在哪里……

english: Mysterious indeed, but in this case she actually looks pretty normal.
translation: 确实神秘，但就她而言，她看起来其实挺正常的。

english: Have you found a way for me to talk to my husband yet?
translation: 你找到让我跟我丈夫说话的办法了吗？

english: I've not progressed at all, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我一点进展都没有。

english: Alice and her husband are having trouble talking to one another and said you might be able to help.
translation: 爱丽丝和她丈夫没法互相交谈，他们说你可能帮得上忙。

english: Ah, I know them; shame about those cows. Why would they think that I could help?
translation: 啊，我认识他们；那些奶牛真可惜。他们为什么会觉得我能帮忙？

english: Alice seems to think you could alter a ghostspeak amulet in order to allow them to communicate.
translation: 爱丽丝似乎认为你可以改造一个鬼语护符，让他们能够交流。

english: In addition, when I was attempting to thwart Necrovarus, you created a new type of amulet for me. I thought that perhaps you might also do so on this occasion.
translation: 另外，在我试图挫败尼克罗瓦鲁斯时，你为我制作了一种新型护符。我想也许这次你也能这么做。

english: Well, the poor young lady has such family problems; I quite feel her pain. I'd be happy to help.
translation: 嗯，那位可怜的年轻女士有这种家庭问题；我感同身受。我很乐意帮忙。

english: You seem to have one of her golden hairs on your shoulder, so I can use that...
translation: 你肩膀上似乎有她的一根金发，所以我可以利用那个……

english: Talk to me again with a ghostspeak amulet and some space in your backpack and I'll be ready to work on this little good deed. The way I plan is quite simple, really.
translation: 戴上鬼语护符，背包里留点空间，再跟我说话，我就准备好做这件小小的善事了。我的计划其实很简单。

english: I can mirror part of the unused mystical essence of the ghostspeak amulet, bind it with Alice's hair and thus create a second amulet.
translation: 我可以镜像鬼语护符中未使用的神秘精华的一部分，用爱丽丝的头发将其束缚，从而制造出第二个护符。

english: The second amulet will be useful for the purpose you desire, though it won't work for any other ghost or human other than the farmer and his wife.
translation: 第二个护符将满足你的需求，但它只对那个农夫和他妻子有效，对其他幽灵或人类都没用。

english: I'm here to see if you are ready to do your mystical stuff with my ghostspeak amulet.
translation: 我来看看你是否准备好对我的鬼语护符施展你的神秘法术了。

english: I most certainly am, but you don't have an ghostspeak amulet.
translation: 我当然准备好了，但你并没有鬼语护符。

english: I most certainly am, but you don't have space in your backpack.
translation: 我当然准备好了，但你背包里没有空间。

english: I most certainly am; there you go.
translation: 我当然准备好了；给你。

english: Wow, that was quick and painless.
translation: 哇，真快，一点也不痛。

english: Just being a good neighbour.
translation: 只是做个好邻居。

english: Would you be able to replace the amulet you made? I seem to have lost it.
translation: 你能再做一个你之前做的护符吗？我好像弄丢了。

english: Here you are; lucklily, I saved some of Alice's hair in case you were careless. Which you were.
translation: 给你；幸好我留了一些爱丽丝的头发，以防你粗心大意。而你的确如此。

english: Well, to tell the truth, I just came back to chat with you. Any news?
translation: 嗯，说实话，我只是回来跟你聊聊天。有什么新闻吗？

english: Disgraceful! Deliver that amulet; a young lady's happiness depends upon it.
translation: 不像话！快把那个护符送过去；一位年轻女士的幸福就靠它了。

english: Have you handed him an enhanced amulet?
translation: 你把强化护符交给他了吗？

english: I have obtained the amulet; I just haven't handed it over yet. So, it's looking good!
translation: 我已经拿到护符了；只是还没交出去。所以，情况不错！

english: I talked to your wife and thought that if you had a special amulet, you could speak to her and sort out the bank situation without me being involved.
translation: 我跟你妻子谈过了，我想如果你有一个特殊的护符，你就可以直接跟她说话，解决银行的事，不用我掺和了。

english: Arr, that makes far more sense than I was expecting from a muscle-head like you. My wife's a clever one.
translation: 啊，这比我预想的你这个肌肉脑袋要聪明得多。我老婆真是个聪明人。

english: Well... oh, never mind. I'm desperate enough for those chickens to let that pass.
translation: 好吧……哦，算了。我为了那些鸡已经够绝望了，就放过你吧。

english: Give me that amulet, then, and we'll be seeing about your unnatural desire for chickens.
translation: 那就把那个护身符给我吧，我们来看看你那种对鸡的非自然渴望是怎么回事。

english: Okay, you need it more than I do, I suppose.
translation: 好吧，我想你比我更需要它。

english: Ta, mate.
translation: 谢了，伙计。

english: Lucky we had such a brilliant idea.
translation: 幸亏我们想到了这么绝妙的主意。

english: I don't think I'm ready to hand it over yet.
translation: 我觉得还没准备好把它交出去。

english: Ahhh, many thanks. Now what was it you were wanting again?
translation: 啊哈，多谢了。那么，你刚才想要什么来着？

english: I need a couple of your chickens.
translation: 我需要你的几只鸡。

english: Chickens is tricksy, 'specially dead 'uns. I'll have to catch 'em for ye.
translation: 鸡可狡猾了，尤其是死鸡。我得帮你去抓它们。

english: They look pretty pathetic; how hard can it be?
translation: 它们看起来挺惨的，能有多难？

english: Stand back while I catches 'em, ya city slicker.
translation: 退后，让我来抓它们，你这个城里人。

english: Here, chicky chicky!
translation: 过来，小鸡小鸡！

english: Git 'ere, yer pesky bird!
translation: 给我过来，你这该死的鸟！

english: Where'd she go?
translation: 她跑哪儿去了？

english: Git orf my laaand!
translation: 滚出我的地！

english: You heard my husband: leave now!
translation: 你听见我丈夫的话了：现在就走！

english: Always the same; I can never get these animals to myself.
translation: 每次都是这样；我从来没法独享这些动物。

english: You killed Bessie!
translation: 你杀了贝茜！

english: Buying cowhides and feathers - ahh, that chicken is next; feathers for me!
translation: 收购牛皮和羽毛——啊哈，接下来是那只鸡；羽毛归我啦！

english: Woo woo woo!
translation: 唔唔唔！

english: Well, that's one way to catch a chicken, I suppose.
translation: 好吧，我想这也算是一种抓鸡的方法。

english: Hello, how can I help you? I'm sellin' if you have ecto- tokens.
translation: 你好，有什么需要帮忙的吗？如果你有灵界代币，我就卖。

english: Could I buy those chickens now?
translation: 我现在能买那些鸡了吗？

english: I can hand over a chicken if you give me 10 of them ecto-token thingies per bird.
translation: 如果你每只鸟给我10个灵界代币那种小玩意儿，我就可以给你一只鸡。

english: Ta, some day soon I'll be havin' a nice undead bed to kip in.
translation: 谢了，总有一天我会有一张漂亮的亡灵床来睡觉。

english: Could I buy 2 chickens?
translation: 我能买两只鸡吗？

english: Great! I'm laying away me tokens for some killer cows. That'll learn them bone rustlers.
translation: 太好了！我在存代币，想买一些杀手奶牛。让那些偷骨头的家伙长长记性。

english: Har har, how many ghost chicky farmers d'you know, den?
translation: 哈，哈，你认识几个幽灵鸡农夫啊？

english: The ghosts I talk to say that the tokens have something to do with the tower just east of here. If you need to collect some I'd try there.
translation: 跟我说话的幽灵们说，那些代币和东边的那座塔有关系。如果你需要收集一些，我建议你去那里试试。

english: Hello, friend, and thanks for allowing me to talk to my husband Malcolm. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，朋友，谢谢你让我和我丈夫马尔科姆说话。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: My spiritometric devices show that you have been in close contact with ghostly animals. Are we closer to success?
translation: 我的灵体测量装置显示你和幽灵动物有过密切接触。我们离成功更近了吗？

english: Here they are.
translation: 它们在这里。

english: Amazing! Success! I can look forward to some good nights' sleep after all.
translation: 太神奇了！成功了！我终于能期待好好睡几晚觉了。

english: Can I ask exactly how an undead chicken will help you sleep?
translation: 我能问一下，一只亡灵鸡到底怎么帮你睡觉？

english: Well, I need the feathers to make my bed more comfortable. A comfortable bed will help me sleep. Obvious, really.
translation: 嗯，我需要羽毛来让我的床更舒服。舒服的床能帮我入睡。显而易见，真的。

english: Obvious, yes, but why on Gielinor would you need an undead chicken when there are perfectly good live chickens just down the road?
translation: 是显而易见，但为什么非要要一只亡灵鸡不可呢？就在路那边明明有完全活得好好的鸡。

english: Well, for a start, undead feathers are much cleaner than living ones; no dust mites or anything. Secondly, I always think of Ernest when I see a chicken, so my nerves can't take killing them.
translation: 嗯，首先，亡灵羽毛比活鸡的羽毛干净多了，没有任何尘螨之类的东西。其次，我一看到鸡就会想起欧内斯特，所以我的神经受不了去杀它们。

english: Then why do I need a chicken for my reward; we already established that I don't use a bed?
translation: 那为什么我的奖励需要一只鸡？我们之前已经确定了我不用床的。

english: Seeing as how you ranger types use so many feathers in your arrows, I was thinking I could harness an undead chicken to make an unending supply of arrow flights for you.
translation: 考虑到你们射手类型在箭上用那么多羽毛，我想我可以利用一只亡灵鸡来为你制造源源不断的箭羽。

english: Beats chicken slaying or hanging around in fishing shops, I suppose. So, what next?
translation: 总比杀鸡或者窝在钓鱼店里强，我猜。那么，接下来呢？

english: We'll need a magnet next, one with purely natural fields and made from a carefully selected iron bar. A firm impact when the iron is parallel to Gielinor's field will stabilise this field in the rod.
translation: 接下来我们需要一块磁铁，要纯天然磁场，并且用精挑细选的铁锭制成。在铁棒与吉列诺的磁场平行时用力敲击，就能将磁场稳定在铁棒中。

english: Go and talk to the Witch next door.
translation: 去和隔壁的女巫谈谈。

english: Well, I can buy the ones you want but I don't have any on me.
translation: 嗯，我可以买你想要的，但我身上现在没有。

english: Stunning. I should have tried to hire some gnomes instead. They may be obsessed with their bellies but they can at least be trusted to deliver unpleasant perishables.
translation: 真够呛。我本该试着雇几个地精的。他们虽然整天惦记着肚子，但至少能指望他们送来容易腐烂的东西。

english: Well, I have this one which I can use to club people.
translation: 嗯，我有一根，可以用来砸人。

english: Are you going to hand it over or do you want to continue to waft it about menacingly?
translation: 你是打算交出来，还是想继续威胁性地挥舞它？

english: I prefer to keep this fine weapon with which to smite mine enemies.
translation: 我更想留着这把精良的武器，用来惩戒我的敌人。

english: You would be more menacing if your weapon weren't quite so rotten.
translation: 如果你的武器没那么破烂的话，你可能会更吓人一点。

english: You can take it; it smells anyway.
translation: 你拿走吧，反正它也臭了。

english: On second thought, the way you wave it about makes me fear for my life. Stow it in your back and talk to me again.
translation: 转念一想，看你挥舞它的样子，我怕会没命。把它收起来，再跟我说话。

english: Here's one.
translation: 这里有一只。

english: Thanks! This is great for me, although I'll need another one if you want any sort of reward.
translation: 谢谢！这对我是大好事，但如果你想要任何奖励，我还需要另一只。

english: Why do you come back with no chickens? I'll be needing another one before I give you your reward! I'm not going to relent, even if you say 'plz plz plz' and claim you were just scammed.
translation: 你怎么没带鸡回来？在我给你奖励之前，我还需要另一只！就算你说“求求求”并且声称你刚被骗了，我也不会让步。

english: Here's the second one for my reward.
translation: 这是第二只，用来换我的奖励。

english: Go and talk to the Witch next door. She'd talk the hid legs off a donkey but she can select the iron with which is suitable for the chicken to interact.
translation: 去和隔壁的女巫谈谈。她能把驴的腿都说下来，但她能挑出适合与鸡互动的铁。

english: Despite my extensive studies, her years of experience make her better at instinctive magico-mystical interaction. Oh well, at least I'm cleverer, prettier and will have a better bed.
translation: 尽管我学识渊博，但她多年的经验使她在本能的神秘魔法互动方面更胜一筹。哦好吧，至少我更聪明、更漂亮，还会有一张更好的床。

english: Okay, okay, you're great. Yes, I'll go and talk to her when you've finished praising yourself.
translation: 好了好了，你很棒。行，等你夸完自己，我就去跟她谈谈。

english: Hello, hello, my poppet. What brings you to my little room?
translation: 你好啊，我的小宝贝。什么风把你吹到我这个小房间里来了？

english: Ava told me to ask you about making magnets. Something about natural fields and other stuff. Sounded like she needed a farmer, to be honest.
translation: 艾娃让我来问你关于制作磁铁的事。提到什么天然磁场之类的东西。说真的，听起来她好像需要个农夫。

english: Don't worry, deary, I can tell you just what to do and you won't have to worry your pretty head about the complicated bits.
translation: 别担心，亲爱的，我能告诉你怎么做，你不用为你那颗漂亮的小脑袋操心那些复杂的部分。

english: No need to patronise me quite so much, you know.
translation: 你知道，没必要这么屈尊俯就地对我说话。

english: I went to anger management classes, my lambkin; that's why I was treating you so kindly. It's either this way of talking or I'll go back to shoving children into ovens.
translation: 我去上了愤怒管理课，我的小羊羔；所以我才对你这么客气。要么就这么说话，要么我就回去把小孩塞进烤箱。

english: Just bring me 5 iron bars, though, and you're well on the way to never having to talk to me again.
translation: 给我带5根铁锭来，这样你就快不用再跟我说话了。

english: I am back.
translation: 我回来了。

english: Oh, but sugarpie, I need 5 iron bars, you don't have any. Come back to me quickly with all 5 of them.
translation: 哦，但是小甜心，我需要5根铁锭，你一根都没有。快点把5根都拿来给我。

english: I have some iron bars here.
translation: 我这里有一些铁锭。

english: Oh, but sugarpie, I need 5 iron bars, you don't have enough. Come back to me quickly with all 5 of them.
translation: 哦，但是小甜心，我需要5根铁锭，你不够。快点把5根都拿来给我。

english: I've talked to the Witch and she has asked me for some iron bars.
translation: 我和女巫谈过了，她问我要一些铁锭。

english: Do I resemble an iron-bar merchant?
translation: 我看起来像铁锭商人吗？

english: Er, maybe; I've never met one.
translation: 呃，也许吧；我从来没遇到过。

english: An entirely logical answer; you'll make a scientiest yet.
translation: 完全合乎逻辑的回答；你迟早能当个科学家。

english: I can't say that I didn't expect this; you'd lose your head if it weren't glued on. Lucky I made some replacements. Take this one and leave me in peace.
translation: 我不能说我没预料到；你的脑袋要不是粘着早就掉了。幸好我做了些备用。拿这个去，让我清静一下。

english: You were sent to try my patience, weren't you? Go away and make that magnet, then hand it to Ava.
translation: 你是来考验我耐心的，对吧？滚去做磁铁，然后把它交给艾娃。

english: I've talked to the Witch and now I've given her some iron bars.
translation: 我和女巫谈过了，现在我已经给了她一些铁锭。

english: I'm thrilled for you. What about my magnet?
translation: 我真替你激动。我的磁铁呢？

english: The process is subject to some unexpected delays.
translation: 这个过程有一些意外延迟。

english: I can see now why Fenkenstain prefers to work with dead folk. It can't be more frustrating than working with you.
translation: 我现在明白为什么芬肯斯坦更喜欢和死人打交道了。跟你打交道也没让人更抓狂。

english: Hoorah for you, you have the magnet. Just hand it over to Ava. I'm working on my new recipe for spit-roast adventurer, so disturbing me isn't wise.
translation: 你太棒了，拿到磁铁了。把它交给艾娃就行。我在研究烤冒险者的新食谱，打扰我可不明智。

english: I've manufactured the magnet; here it is.
translation: 我造好了磁铁，在这里。

english: Great stuff! With the Witch's influence within the magnet, the undead chicken can use this, I'm sure.
translation: 太好了！有了女巫在磁铁中的影响，我相信这只亡灵鸡能用上它。

english: The plan is that the chicken will operate the magnet to attract bits of iron and steel, maybe even your own recently fired arrows. There are plenty of totally lost arrowheads lying about in the fields of Gielinor, I bet.
translation: 计划是：这只鸡将操作磁铁来吸引铁和钢碎片，甚至可能是你自己刚射出的箭。我敢打赌，吉列诺的田野里到处都是完全丢失的箭头。

english: In addition, arrows which you fire should be able to be attracted back to your quiver by the cunning avian.
translation: 此外，你射出的箭应该能被这只狡猾的鸟吸引回你的箭袋。

english: I begin to understand your plan. We've covered feathers and arrowheads now; what next?
translation: 我开始明白你的计划了。我们已经解决了羽毛和箭头，接下来呢？

english: We need a source of wood, but one which is spiritually active and can regenerate itself. That will save you some axework in the future.
translation: 我们需要一个木材来源，但要有灵性活性，能自我再生。这样你以后就能省些伐木的功夫了。

english: Try using a woodcutting axe on the pesky trees in the garden here, the ones that attack rather than the really dead ones. They are probably just the sort of thing we could use.
translation: 试试用伐木斧砍这里花园里那些烦人的树——就是那些会攻击你的树，不是真正死掉的那种。它们很可能正是我们需要的东西。

english: They will try to kill me, though, and I can't fight back!
translation: 但它们会试图杀了我，而我不能还手！

english: Now you know how those poor guards feel when you hide behind mushrooms and fences and attack them from afar! Anyway, I reckon you'll need to try a mithril or better axe on the trees. At least the trees are
translation: 现在你知道那些可怜的守卫躲在蘑菇和栅栏后面，被你从远处攻击是什么感觉了吧！不管怎样，我估计你得用秘银或更好的斧头去砍这些树。而且这些树就在附近。

english: pretty close.
translation: 很近。

english: So, what terrible hitch have you encountered now?
translation: 那么，你现在又遇到什么可怕的麻烦了？

english: Nothing really; I just decided to talk to you in case you have any great advice for me.
translation: 其实没什么；我只是决定跟你聊聊，万一你有什么好建议给我。

english: Well, I've heard that all kinds of dragons and even basilisks can drop mithril axes, if that's why you are delaying. Most of these creatures are silly enough that you can even hide behind something and plink them to
translation: 嗯，我听说各种龙甚至石化蜥蜴都可能掉落秘银斧，如果你是因为这个才拖延的话。这些生物大多蠢到你可以躲在什么东西后面，用勇敢的射手方式把它们慢慢射死。

english: death in the brave ranger way.
translation: 以勇敢射手的方式死去。

english: Well, I tried to hack the trees with my axe, but it just bounced off the trunk! It did all seem all-too-convenient to work on the first try.
translation: 嗯，我试着用斧头砍树，但斧头直接弹开了树干！第一次尝试就能成功，似乎也太方便了。

english: Fortunately for you, I've done some research and it seems to suggest that there are two choices open to you.
translation: 算你走运，我做了一些研究，看起来你有两个选择。

english: Tell me the worst.
translation: 告诉我最坏的吧。

english: The first is more interesting. We cut off your arms, have them reanimated as undead, reattach them and then you should be able to cut the trees normally.
translation: 第一个选择更有趣。我们把你的胳膊砍下来，把它们复活成亡灵状态，再接回去，然后你应该就能正常砍树了。

english: Of course, you won't be able to pick your nose anymore, so I suppose you'll want to try the second option.
translation: 当然，你以后就不能挖鼻孔了，所以我猜你会想试试第二个选择。

english: I'm not exactly addicted to picking my nose, but I do think I'll pass on that method.
translation: 我倒不是特别沉迷于挖鼻孔，但我还是觉得这个办法就算了。

english: Well, in that case, I think it may have something to do with Slayer abilities. After all, I did see [Turael/Aya] poking around the trees while I was moving in.
translation: 好吧，那样的话，我觉得这可能和杀戮能力有关。毕竟，我搬进来的时候确实看到[Turael/Aya]在树附近转悠。

english: As [he's/she's] not known for [his/her] random touristic activities, you should try chatting with this [Turael/Aya]. [He's/She's] the Slayer Master near Burthorpe.
translation: 鉴于[他/她]并不以随机旅游活动闻名，你应该试着跟这位[图拉尔/阿雅]聊聊。[他/她]是伯索普公国附近的杀戮大师。

english: Oh dear, I hope [he/she] doesn't want me to buy one of [his/her] ridiculous fashion accessories. Those earmuffs [he/she] sells make heroic adventurers into a laughing stock.
translation: 哦天哪，我希望[他/她]不是想让我买那些荒谬的时尚配饰。[他/她]卖的耳罩让英勇的冒险者成了笑柄。

english: I'm here about a quest. Ava said she saw you hanging around the moving trees near Draynor Manor.
translation: 我来这里是为了一个任务。艾娃说你曾在德拉诺庄园附近的活动树木旁闲逛。

english: Ahh, you came to the right man; odd things, those trees. What is it you are needing exactly?
translation: 啊哈，你找对人了；那些树，真是奇怪的东西。你到底需要什么？

english: I think I need some of the wood from them, but my axe just bounced off the trunk.
translation: 我想我需要一些它们的木材，但我的斧头在树干上弹开了。

english: Sounds like you need a blessed axe. No one really makes them, though, these days.
translation: 听起来你需要一把被祝福的斧。不过现在没人真的做了。

english: Blessed axes are too soft to cut normal wood since the axe's edge must be replaced by holy silver. I can do you a favour, though.
translation: 被祝福的斧太软了，砍不了普通木头，因为斧刃必须换成神圣的银。不过，我可以帮你一个忙。

english: If you can give me a mithril axe and a holy symbol of Saradomin I can let you have my axe. I'll make myself a new one when no one is pestering me for Slayer tasks.
translation: 如果你能给我一把秘银斧和一个萨拉多明圣徽，我就把我的斧头给你。等没人再拿杀戮任务烦我的时候，我会给自己做一把新的。

english: Okay, so I'll see whether I can spare an axe and a symbol. Thanks.
translation: 好的，我看看我能不能匀出一把斧头和一个圣徽。谢谢。

english: Hello, I'm here about those trees again.
translation: 你好，我又为那些树的事来了。

english: I can make an axe for you now, if you wish. Remember, it will be no use for normal woodcutting after I have added the silver edge.
