translation: 如果你愿意，我现在可以为你制作一把斧头。记住，在我加上银边之后，它就不能用于普通伐木了。

english: I'd love one, thanks.
translation: 我想要一把，谢谢。

english: Here's a new axe; may it serve you well.
translation: 这是一把新斧子；愿它助你顺利。

english: You'll need to hand over both a mithril axe and holy symbol of Saradomin. You don't have a symbol in your pack, so I'm not able to help.
translation: 你需要同时交出一把秘银斧和一个萨拉多明圣徽。你的背包里没有圣徽，所以我帮不了你。

english: Goodbye then. You may, of course, return if you decide you want a new axe.
translation: 那就再见了。当然，如果你决定要一把新斧头，你可以回来。

english: [Turael/Aya], the Slayer Master, told me what to do - with no earmuffs, spiky helmets or other laughable headgear involved.
translation: [Turael/Aya]，杀戮大师，告诉了我该怎么做——没有耳罩、尖刺头盔或其他可笑头饰的参与。

english: A pity; you'd look quite cute with rabbit ears. Perhaps I should have bribed [him/her].
translation: 可惜；你戴上兔子耳朵会看起来很可爱。也许我应该贿赂[him/her]。

english: You scare me sometimes.
translation: 你有时吓到我了。

english: I think I'm ready to cut those trees now.
translation: 我想我现在准备好砍那些树了。

english: What do you want? A prize? Go and get the wood; it's not as if the trees are wandering about and hard to find.
translation: 你想要什么？奖励？去拿木材；那些树又不是到处乱跑难以找到。

english: I have that undead wood at last. Well, twigs anyway.
translation: 我终于拿到那些亡灵木材了。好吧，至少是树枝。

english: You certainly took your time.
translation: 你真是慢啊。

english: I'd say they didn't grow on trees, but I guess you'd just be sarcastic about my sense of humour.
translation: 我本想说它们不是树上长出来的，但我想你只会对我的幽默感冷嘲热讽。

english: Quite. Now that we have all the ingredients for infinite arrows, we just need a container in which we can keep the components in the correct mutual alignment.
translation: 确实。既然我们有了无限箭矢的所有材料，我们只需要一个容器，能把组件保持正确的彼此对齐。

english: I've gathered together some research notes from various sources but I can't quite make out what they mean. If you want to have a go at making them out, just ask me for a copy.
translation: 我从各处收集了一些研究笔记，但我看不太懂它们的意思。如果你想试着弄懂它们，就问我拿一份副本。

english: I'd like to look at those research notes now, unless you have translated them without me?
translation: 我现在想看看那些研究笔记，除非你不用我就翻译好了？

english: They are still stumping me. Here are the notes; I really hope your head doesn't explode from reading them.
translation: 它们仍让我困惑。这是笔记；我真心希望你的脑袋不会因为阅读它们而爆炸。

english: I'd find it slightly inconvenient, I'm sure.
translation: 我确信我会觉得有点不便。

english: It wouldn't be all bad as your body would be useful for research after death. What I'd be upset about was if bits of you landed in my nice new bed.
translation: 也不全是坏事，因为你的尸体死后对研究有用。我会难过的是如果你碎片落在我漂亮的新床上。

english: Your concern is touching.
translation: 你的关心真是感人。

english: I seem to have lost the research notes.
translation: 我好像把研究笔记弄丢了。

english: Don't tell me, your cat ate them? You won't get out of the job that easily; here are some copies I made.
translation: 别告诉我，你的猫把它们吃了？你别想那么容易就脱身；这是我做的一些副本。

english: I have the notes but haven't translated them yet. Any hints?
translation: 我有笔记但还没翻译。有什么提示吗？

english: I know you have the notes; I gave them to you, in case you forgot. Furthermore, if I had hints, I'd have translated those notes myself.
translation: 我知道你有笔记；我给你的，以防你忘了。此外，如果我有提示，我自己就把那些笔记翻译了。

english: So, take the hint and go off and translate them. If it's too hard, you can always go and shoot demons in cages.
translation: 所以，接受提示然后去翻译吧。如果太难，你总可以去射笼子里的恶魔。

english: I've translated those notes. See? I'm not just a thuggish moron like you seem to think.
translation: 我已经翻译了那些笔记。看到了吧？我并不像你似乎认为的那样只是个粗暴的傻瓜。

english: For all I know, it was pure luck, so don't jump to any conclusions about your mighty intellect.
translation: 依我所知，那纯粹是运气，所以别对你的强大智力妄下结论。

english: I can see why you don't have any assistants; you're not exactly easy to work with.
translation: 我明白你为什么没有助手了；你不太容易共事。

english: Let's get back to the work we're doing, then. Remember, this is all a favour to you; I could have just decided to fob you off with a feather duster.
translation: 那我们回到正事上吧。记住，这都是帮你的忙；我本可以决定用鸡毛掸子糊弄你。

english: I've given you a pattern for the container; you'll need to combine them with some polished buttons and hard leather. Then we're almost done. Good news, eh?
translation: 我给了你容器的图纸；你需要把它们和一些已抛光的纽扣和硬皮革组合起来。然后我们就差不多完成了。好消息，嗯？

english: If you are having trouble finding buttons, I've heard rumours that the H.A.M. society carry this sort of stuff more than most.
translation: 如果你找不到纽扣，我听说H.A.M.组织比大多数人都更有这类东西。

english: Really? How would you know this strange detail?
translation: 真的？你怎么会知道这个奇怪的细节？

english: I hear they lose their clothes a lot to thieves so they have to make do with shoddy goods. Whatever the reason, they seem to carry buttons about in their pockets.
translation: 我听说他们的衣服经常被小偷弄丢，所以他们只能用劣质品凑合。不管什么原因，他们似乎口袋里都揣着纽扣。

english: So what do I do with this pattern again?
translation: 那么我再问一下，我怎么处理这个图纸？

english: Your short-term memory loss worries me.  Combine the pattern with hard leather and some polished buttons, then hand the resulting container to me.
translation: 你的短期记忆丧失让我担心。把图纸和硬皮革以及一些已抛光的纽扣组合，然后把做好的容器交给我。

english: The pattern seems to have vanished from my pack... not my fault, of course.
translation: 图纸似乎从我的背包里消失了……当然不是我的错。

english: You're pretty careless, aren't you? I assume you're the type who leaves a trail of arrows and knives behind them when they train?
translation: 你真是相当粗心，不是吗？我猜你是那种训练时会留下一路箭矢和刀的人？

english: Here's a replacement; perhaps if I charged for them, you'd be more careful.
translation: 这是替代品；也许我收费的话，你会更小心。

english: You've made the container, I assume?
translation: 你已经做好容器了，我猜？

english: Well, yes, although I seem to have mislaid it.
translation: 嗯，是的，不过我好像放错地方了。

english: It's only the final, vital step in your quest that you decided to leave who-knows-where. Don't worry, I have plenty of spares.
translation: 你偏偏决定把任务中最后最关键的一步丢到天知道哪里去了。别担心，我有很多备用的。

english: Why do I sense sarcasm somewhere here?
translation: 为什么我在这里感觉到了讽刺？

english: You've made one container; surely you can make another. Is it killing a cow or spotting those bright pink H.A.M. members that you are having troubles with?
translation: 你已经做了一个容器；你肯定能再做另一个。你是不是在杀奶牛或找那些亮粉色H.A.M.成员时遇到麻烦了？

english: Wow, great, now the arrow manufacturer is ready for use...there you are! Talk to me if you need more information later.
translation: 哇，太好了，现在箭矢制造机准备好使用了……给你！之后如果你需要更多信息就和我说话。

english: You are also skilled enough that I'm rewarding you with the upgraded version right away. Congratulations.
translation: 你的技能也足够高，我现在就奖励你升级版本。恭喜。

english: How is the archaeological dig going?
translation: 考古挖掘进行得怎么样了？

english: It's not finished yet.
translation: 还没完成。

english: I wish you could work more quickly. The new train link is very important to the dwarven economy.
translation: 真希望你们能快点。新的铁路连接对矮人经济非常重要。

english: I hope you're hurrying up with that archaeological dig. Every moment we wait wastes more of the Consortium's money!
translation: 希望你们考古挖掘能加快进度。我们每等一刻都在浪费财团的钱！

english: Hi [player name]!
translation: 嗨，[player name]！

english: Hi Zanik. What are you doing here?
translation: 嗨，扎尼克。你在这里做什么？

english: I'm having a look at the things that are being dug up here!
translation: 我在看看这里挖出来的东西！

english: It's really amazing to think that these things were used by my ancestors hundreds of years ago. Tegdak thinks that some of them may even have been brought down here from the surface by the early Dorgeshuun!
translation: 想到这些东西几百年前被我的祖先使用，真是令人惊叹。特格达克认为其中一些甚至可能是早期多吉需人从地表带下来的！

english: I hope those goblins hurry up with their digging. It's so frustrating having to stop work when the train link is nearly finished!
translation: 希望那些哥布林快点挖。铁路连接都快完工了却要停工，真让人沮丧！

english: Bah! These goblins don't appreciate how important this train link is! It'll be the greatest dwarven achievement of this generation, and it's being held up just so they can pick at old broken things in the ground.
translation: 呸！这些哥布林根本不懂这条铁路连接有多重要！这将是这一代矮人最伟大的成就，却因为他们要在地上捡些破旧东西而耽搁。

english: I hope the Consortium will understand it's not our fault the work will be finished late. This is the most important job of my career!
translation: 希望财团能理解工程延期不是我们的错。这是我职业生涯中最重要的工作！

english: I'm looking forward to riding on this train once it's finished. It'll be so much faster than the old steam-powered minecarts. It'll be the fastest machine in Gielinor!
translation: 我期待着火车完工后乘坐它。它会比旧式蒸汽矿车快得多。它将成为吉莱诺最快的机器！

english: Will you tell those goblins to get on with their digging? We've got a job to finish here.
translation: 你能告诉那些哥布林继续挖吗？我们这里还有工作要完成。

english: I'm looking forward to riding on this train once it's finished. It'll be so much faster than the old steam- powered minecarts. It'll be the fastest machine in Gielinor!
translation: 我很期待等这列火车完工后坐上去。它会比老式的蒸汽矿车快得多，将成为吉连诺最快的机器！

english: Oh, hello surface-dweller. I'm afraid we're a bit busy cleaning specimens at the moment so I can't help you.
translation: 哦，你好，地表居民。恐怕我们现在正忙着清理标本，所以帮不了你。

english: Ur-tag asked me to help out with the dig. I have an archaeology qualification!
translation: 乌尔.塔格让我来帮忙挖掘。我有考古学资格！

english: Oh! In that case we could use your help.
translation: 哦！那样的话我们可以请你帮忙。

english: There are some ancient goblin artefacts buried in the ground around here. We want to extract them, but we don't have much experience and could end up breaking them.
translation: 这里地下埋着一些古代哥布林文物。我们想提取它们，但经验不足，可能会弄坏。

english: Could you extract them, clean them, and then give them to me please?
translation: 你能把它们提取出来，清理干净，然后交给我吗？

english: Here, take this trowel and specimen brush.
translation: 给你，拿着这把泥铲和标本刷。

english: How are you getting on with extracting the artefacts?
translation: 文物提取进展如何？

english: I haven't got any yet.
translation: 我还没拿到任何东西。

english: Also, I lost my trowel.
translation: 而且，我的泥铲丢了。

english: Well, you'll have to free up some inventory space before I can give you a new one.
translation: 嗯，你得先腾出一些背包空间，我才能给你新的。

english: Never mind. Have another one.
translation: 没关系。再给你一个。

english: And I lost my specimen brush.
translation: 还有我的标本刷也丢了。

english: Well you'll have to free up some inventory space before I can give you a new one.
translation: 你得先腾出一些背包空间，我才能给你新的。

english: Thanks for extracting that artefact, but you'll need to clean it as well.
translation: 谢谢你提取了那件文物，但你还得清理它。

english: I've got a sample brush here but you'll have to make space in your inventory for me to give it to you.
translation: 我这里有一把标本刷，但你得在背包里腾出空间，我才能把它给你。

english: Here, use this brush to clean the artefact.
translation: 给你，用这把刷子清理文物。

english: What? No, extract the artefacts please.
translation: 什么？不，请提取文物。

english: It looks like a fragment of armour.
translation: 看起来像是一块盔甲碎片。

english: Look at the design! That's a lot like the design of the goblin armour I saw on the surface.
translation: 看这设计！很像我在地表见过的哥布林盔甲的设计。

english: That confirms that our ancestors retained a lot of customs from the surface even after they came down here. Our guards didn't start wearing lighter chainmail until after the Civil War.
translation: 这证实了我们的祖先即使来到地下后仍保留了许多地表的习俗。我们的卫兵直到内战后才开始穿更轻的锁子甲。

english: That's all the artefacts we needed to extract. Thanks again, [player name]!
translation: 这就是我们需要提取的所有文物了。再次感谢，[player name]！

english: Now, the most interesting one is this ancient mace. It's the only intact weapon, and I'm pretty sure it dates back to the time when the Dorgeshuun were on the surface.
translation: 现在，最有趣的是这把古代钉锤。它是唯一完整的武器，而且我很确定它可追溯到多吉需人还在地表的时候。

english: It's covered in symbols, but I can't decipher them. Zanik, could you take it to the scribe? He might know what they mean. I'll finish up the dig here.
translation: 上面刻满了符号，但我无法解读。扎尼克，你能把它带给书记官吗？他可能知道这些符号的意思。我在这里完成挖掘工作。

english: Sure thing! Come on, [player name], let's go talk to the scribe
translation: 没问题！来吧，[player name]，我们去找书记官谈谈。

english: I have another one.
translation: 我还有另一个。

english: It looks like a piece of a shield.
translation: 看起来像是一块盾牌碎片。

english: Look at that stress fracture. It looks like this shield broke pretty easily.
translation: 看那道应力裂缝。这面盾牌似乎很容易就碎了。

english: I would guess that this shield was made during the Dorgeshuun Civil War and not handed down from the time on the surface.
translation: 我猜这面盾牌是在多吉需内战时制造的，而不是从地表时期传下来的。

english: It seems that even by the time of the Civil War, our ancestors were beginning to lose their skills at making weapons.
translation: 看来即使在内战时期，我们的祖先已经开始失去制造武器的技能了。

english: It looks like a piece of a helmet.
translation: 看起来像是一块头盔碎片。

english: A helmet? So those are eye-holes? They look too small.
translation: 头盔？那些是眼洞吗？看起来太小了。

english: This was from the early days of Dorgesh-Kaan. It must have been before our ancestors' eyes reached their current size.
translation: 这是多吉需戛纳早期的物品。一定是在我们祖先的眼睛长到目前大小之前。

english: I'm not sure. What do you think?
translation: 我不确定。你觉得呢？

english: It looks a bit like a sword, doesn't it? I saw some people using them on the surface.
translation: 看起来有点像剑，对吧？我在地表见过有人用剑。

english: The early Dorgeshuun must have used a much larger variety of weapons than we do now.
translation: 早期的多吉需人一定使用过比我们现在更多种类的武器。

english: I'm not sure. It's got some kind of blade... Is it a spear tip?
translation: 我不确定。它有个刀片……是矛尖吗？

english: Oh, I know what it is! It's an axe head!
translation: 哦，我知道是什么了！是斧头！

english: Axes are these things they use on the surface for cutting down trees. I think they can be used as weapons too.
translation: 斧头是地表上用来砍树的东西。我想它们也可以用作武器。

english: Our ancestors must have brought it down from the surface, then. There would be no need for them to make axes when they were down here, as there are no trees.
translation: 那么我们的祖先一定是从地表带下来的。他们在地下不需要制造斧头，因为这里没有树。

english: It's amazing to think that we're handling objects that date back to the time of the war of the gods!
translation: 想到我们正在处理可追溯到诸神战争时期的物品，真是令人惊叹！

english: It's... Actually, what is it? It's a sort of stick with a lump on the end.
translation: 这是……实际上，这是什么？是一根末端有个疙瘩的棍子。

english: I think it's a mace.
translation: 我想是钉锤。

english: A mace?
translation: 钉锤？

english: A kind of weapon.
translation: 一种武器。

english: I haven't got any more yet.
translation: 我还没有更多了。

english: Thanks for your help. There's not much left for us to do here except pack everything up. Have you shown that mace to the scribe yet?
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。我们这里除了打包东西没什么可做的了。你把那把钉锤给书记官看了吗？

english: I've got a strange feeling about this mace, [player name]. Maybe when we find out about it, it will shed some light onto my destiny. Come on, let's show it to the scribe.
translation: 我对这把钉锤有种奇怪的感觉，[player name]。也许当我们了解它时，它会揭示我的命运。来吧，我们把它拿给书记官看。

english: I need to do something else for a bit.
translation: 我需要先去做点别的事。

english: All right. I'll go back and help finish the dig.
translation: 好吧。我回去帮忙完成挖掘。

english: Shall we go and talk to the scribe about this ancient mace now?
translation: 我们现在去找书记官谈谈这把古代钉锤吗？

english: Let's go then!
translation: 那我们走吧！

english: Oh well. Let me know when you're ready.
translation: 好吧。准备好了告诉我。

english: Where is the mace?
translation: 钉锤在哪里？

english: I've got it! I'll hold onto it until we've shown it to the scribe. Shall we go?
translation: 我拿着呢！我会保管好直到我们给书记官看过。我们走吗？

english: Thank you for helping with the dig! Ur-tag tells me it will be finished soon, and then we will be able to resume work!
translation: 谢谢你帮忙挖掘！乌尔.塔格告诉我很快就能完成，然后我们就可以恢复工作了！

english: Ah, Zanik. Would you like to see the results of my experiment with nature runes?
translation: 啊，扎尼克。你想看看我用自然符文的实验结果吗？

english: Not right now, Oldak. I'm helping [player name]!
translation: 现在不行，奥达克。我在帮[player name]！

english: Ah, hello Zanik, hello [player name]. How is the dig going?
translation: 啊，你好扎尼克，你好[player name]。挖掘进展如何？

english: [player name] helped us to finish the dig! Look what she dug up!
translation: [player name]帮我们完成了挖掘！看她挖出了什么！

english: Hmm... that is interesting. What do you think it is?
translation: 嗯……这很有趣。你觉得这是什么？

english: It's a mace.
translation: 是钉锤。

english: [player name] says that's a kind of weapon.
translation: [player name]说那是一种武器。

english: I can see how. I certainly wouldn't want to be hit with it!
translation: 我看得出来。我可不想被它打到！

english: We think it's a magical weapon from the surface. Can you decipher the symbols on it?
translation: 我们认为这是来自地表的魔法武器。你能解读上面的符号吗？

english: No, I'm afraid not. Our written language has developed so much since then that it's totally indecipherable to me.
translation: 不，恐怕不行。我们的书面语言自那时起发展了很多，对我来说完全无法解读。

english: Wait a moment. [player name], didn't you say you talked to some surface goblins when you were trying to find your way through our mines?
translation: 等一下。[player name]，你不是说你在试图穿过我们的矿井时和几个地表哥布林谈过话吗？

english: Yes, I talked to the generals in the Goblin Village.
translation: 是的，我和哥布林村庄的将军们谈过。

english: Perhaps you could talk to them again. They might know more about weapons than we do.
translation: 也许你可以再和他们谈谈。他们可能比我们更了解武器。

english: I'd rather not travel all that way over the surface, though. I wonder if Oldak could use magic to help us get there?
translation: 不过，我不想走那么远的路到地表去。不知道奥达克能不能用魔法帮我们到达那里？

english: Hello, Zanik. Have you found out about that mace yet?
translation: 你好，扎尼克。你查出那把钉锤的来历了吗？

english: Lieutenant Strongaxe, now the leader of the Dorgeshuun, led the tribe deeper into the caves. They found this cavern, and here they founded Dorgesh- Kaan, city of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 中尉强斧，现为多吉需族领袖，带领部落深入洞穴。他们发现了这个洞穴，并在此建立了多吉需族城市多吉需戛纳。

english: Despite reservations from many citizens, the Council eventually voted 4-3 to open Dorgesh-Kaan to surface- dwellers.
translation: 尽管许多市民持保留意见，议会最终以4比3的投票结果决定向地表居民开放多吉需戛纳。

english: However, an ogre named [player name] found his way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 然而，一个名叫[player name]的食人魔找到了穿越洞穴的路，并与矿工们取得了联系。

english: However, an ogre named [player name] found her way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 然而，一个名叫[player name]的食人魔找到了穿越洞穴的路，并与矿工们取得了联系。

english: However, a human named [player name] found his way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 然而，一个名叫[player name]的人类找到了穿越洞穴的路，并与矿工们取得了联系。

english: However, a human named [player name] found her way through the caves and made contact with the miners.
translation: 然而，一个名叫[player name]的人类找到了穿越洞穴的路，并与矿工们取得了联系。

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the H.A.M. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a H.A.M. plot to flood Dorgesh- Kaan.
translation: 议会派扎尼克去探索地表，看看H.A.M.组织是否在策划什么。在[player name]的帮助下，扎尼克挫败了H.A.M.淹没多吉需戛纳的阴谋。

english: The Council sent Zanik to explore the surface to see if the B.A.C.O.N. group was plotting anything. With [player name]'s help, Zanik defeated a B.A.C.O.N. plot to flood Dorgesh- Kaan.
translation: 议会派扎尼克去探索地表，看看B.A.C.O.N.组织是否在策划什么。在[player name]的帮助下，扎尼克挫败了B.A.C.O.N.淹没多吉需戛纳的阴谋。

english: Not yet. Come on, [player name]! We should go and ask the goblin generals about it!
translation: 还没有。来吧，[player name]！我们应该去问问哥布林将军们！

english: I can't believe we're going to the Goblin Village on the surface! I'm finally going to see how my distant relatives live!
translation: 真不敢相信我们要去地表的哥布林村庄了！我终于要看到我的远亲们怎么生活了！

english: Actually, I'm a little nervous about what I'll find there...
translation: 其实，我有点紧张会在那里发现什么……

english: Shall we go see Oldak now? I'm sure he'll have a way of getting us to the Goblin Village quickly!
translation: 我们现在去找奥达克吗？我肯定他有办法让我们快速到达哥布林村庄！

english: Yes! Now we're going to go to the Goblin Village to ask the surface goblins about it!
translation: 是的！我们现在要去哥布林村庄问地表哥布林关于它的事！

english: Good idea! Maybe Oldak can help you get there.
translation: 好主意！也许奥达克能帮你们到达那里。

english: Perhaps there is some important knowledge that we have lost since the early, more war-like days of Dorgesh- Kaan.
translation: 也许我们丢失了一些自多吉需戛纳早期、更好战的年代以来就失传的重要知识。

english: I've got a sample brush here but you'll have to have space in your inventory for me to give it to you.
translation: 我这里有一个样本刷子，但你的背包里需要有空间我才能给你。

english: Not right now, Oldak. We wanted to see if you could make Moving-Over-Distance Spheres to somewhere other than the city.
translation: 现在不行，奥达克。我们想知道你是否能制造前往城市以外地方的远距移动球。

english: Oh, yes. My research along those lines has been coming along very well. I think I could make a Moving-Over-Distance Sphere to anywhere you like, given a little work.
translation: 哦，是的。我在这方面的研究进展顺利。我想只要稍加努力，我就能制造出前往任何你喜欢的远距移动球。

english: We're trying to take this ancient goblin mace to the Goblin Village on the surface. Do you think you could help us to get there?
translation: 我们想把这把古代哥布林钉锤带到地表的哥布林村庄。你觉得你能帮我们到达那里吗？

english: Hmm. The Goblin Village, you say? Yes, I think I could do that. Just a moment.
translation: 嗯。你说哥布林村庄？是的，我想我能做到。稍等一下。

english: There you go. I've made you each one to get you to the Goblin Village and one to bring you back here.
translation: 好了。我给你们每人做了一个去哥布林村庄的，还有一个带你们回到这里的。

english: Thanks Oldak! Okay, [player name], let's go!
translation: 谢谢奥达克！好了，[player name]，我们走吧！

english: Ow, my eyes...
translation: 噢，我的眼睛……

english: So this is the Goblin Village! It's so different from Dorgesh-Kaan, isn't it, [player name]?
translation: 这就是哥布林村庄！和多吉需戛纳太不一样了，对吧，[player name]？

english: [player name], where are you?
translation: [player name]，你在哪里？

english: Sorry about that, [player name]! Oldak's calculations aren't always exact!
translation: 抱歉，[player name]！奥达克的计算并不总是精确的！

english: So this is how goblins on the surface live! Come on, [player name], lets talk to them!
translation: 原来地表哥布林就是这样生活的！来吧，[player name]，我们去和他们谈谈！

english: Where are we going?
translation: 我们要去哪里？

english: I'll meet you back in Dorgesh-Kaan, [player name].
translation: 我会在多吉需戛纳和你碰头，[player name]。

english: Come on [player name], let's get back to the Goblin Village on the surface! Shall we go?
translation: 来吧[player name]，我们回地面上的哥布林村庄去！出发吧？

english: What are we doing here, [player name]? We should get to the Goblin Village!
translation: 我们在这里做什么，[player name]？我们应该去哥布林村庄！

english: Ah, Zanik. How did you get on at the Goblin Village?
translation: 啊，扎尼克。你在哥布林村庄那边怎么样了？

english: We haven't finished there actually. Do you think you could teleport us there again?
translation: 实际上我们还没处理完。你能再把我们传送过去吗？

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 我是多吉舒恩的扎尼克！

english: Dorgeshuun?
translation: 多吉舒恩？

english: Yes! We're another tribe of goblins who live underground. We've been cut off from the surface for generations but now we're back.
translation: 没错！我们是另一支生活在地下的哥布林部落。我们与地表隔绝了数代之久，但现在我们回来了。

english: Who is in charge here?
translation: 这里谁负责？

english: That General [Wartface/Bentnoze]. He live in big hut.
translation: 那个[Wartface/Bentnoze]将军。他住在大棚屋里。

english: No General [Bentnoze/Wartface] is leader!
translation: 不对，[Bentnoze/Wartface]将军才是领袖！

english: Why are you fighting?
translation: 你们为什么打架？

english: He say [Bentnoze/Wartface] is leader but real leader is [Wartface/Bentnoze]!
translation: 他说[Bentnoze/Wartface]是领袖，但真正的领袖是[Wartface/Bentnoze]！

english: These goblins fight all the time, Zanik. Come on, Wartface and Bentnoze are both in the big hut.
translation: 这些哥布林整天打架，扎尼克。来吧，疣脸和弯鼻都在大棚屋里。

english: Lost tribe?
translation: 失落的部落？

english: That's right! We've been cut off from the outside world for thousands of years but now we're back!
translation: 没错！我们与外界隔绝了数千年，但现在我们回来了！

english: So legend true!
translation: 原来传说是真的！

english: Can you tell us anything about this mace?
translation: 你能告诉我们关于这把钉锤的事吗？

english: That holy mace of Big High War God.
translation: 那是至高战神的圣钉锤。

english: In time of great war, strongest goblin warriors carry maces like this.
translation: 在大战时期，最强大的哥布林战士都携带这样的钉锤。

english: They use them to take favour of gods away from enemy. If another god protecting enemy, goblin warrior use this mace and favour of god is stolen away!
translation: 他们用它们来剥夺敌人身上的神明眷顾。如果另一个神在保护敌人，哥布林战士就用这把钉锤，神的眷顾就会被偷走！

english: Oh. A holy mace of the War God.
translation: 哦。一把战神的圣钉锤。

english: You not look very happy.
translation: 你看起来不太高兴。

english: You should praise Big High War God for giving you holy mace!
translation: 你应该赞美至高战神赐予你圣钉锤！

english: The Dorgeshuun don't have quite the same attitude to the gods as you on the surface do.
translation: 多吉舒恩对神的态度和你们地表人不太一样。

english: All goblins worship Big High War God! Without him we nothing!
translation: 所有哥布林都崇拜至高战神！没有他我们什么都不是！

english: You not real goblin! You filthy human!
translation: 你不是真正的哥布林！你这个肮脏的人类！

english: I am a goblin!
translation: 我是哥布林！

english: You not even look like goblin! You have big eyes and wrong colour skin!
translation: 你甚至看起来不像哥布林！你眼睛太大，肤色也不对！

english: She is goblin!
translation: 她是哥布林！

english: No let him speak.
translation: 别让他说话。

english: She is goblin. And she more than that...
translation: 她是哥布林。而且不仅如此……

english: Last night I have dream. I see this new goblin come into village, holding up holy mace.
translation: 昨晚我做了个梦。我看到这个新来的哥布林走进村庄，高举着圣钉锤。

english: All goblins gather around her. Not just from village, from all over world. She is Chosen Commander!
translation: 所有哥布林都聚集在她周围。不光是村里的，而是来自全世界。她就是天命指挥官！

english: Chosen Commander?
translation: 天命指挥官？

english: That story from goblin holy book. We not had Commander of all goblins since time of great war.
translation: 那是哥布林圣典里的故事。自从大战以来，我们就没有过统领所有哥布林的指挥官了。

english: Holy book say someday Big High War God send Chosen Commander to lead us to victory over whole world.
translation: 圣典说总有一天至高战神会派遣天命指挥官带领我们征服全世界。

english: That what I see in dream. It her destiny.
translation: 那就是我在梦中看到的。这是她的命运。

english: My destiny...
translation: 我的命运……

english: That not true! She cannot be Chosen Commander! She not proper goblin! She not worship Big High War God!
translation: 那不是真的！她不可能是什么天命指挥官！她不是正经的哥布林！她也不崇拜至高战神！

english: But what if she is? If we ignore her, Big High War God strike us down!
translation: 但如果她真是呢？如果我们忽视她，至高战神会惩罚我们的！

english: All right. I not believe you Chosen Commander. But we let you talk to people in village.
translation: 好吧。我不相信你是天命指挥官。但我们允许你在村里和人说话。

english: Grubfoot! Tell people in village to gather around! Dorgesh goblin will speak to us all!
translation: 格拉布福特！告诉村里的人集合！多吉舒恩的哥布林要跟我们所有人说话！

english: Goblins listen up! This Zanik, she from Dorgeshuun tribe!
translation: 哥布林们听好了！这位是扎尼克，来自多吉舒恩部落！

english: She say she Chosen Commander!
translation: 她说她是天命指挥官！

english: No, I-
translation: 不，我——

english: We not know what she have to say. But in case she Chosen Commander, we let her speak. Speak, Zanik!
translation: 我们不知道她要说什么。但万一她真是天命指挥官，我们让她说话。说吧，扎尼克！

english: Help, [player name]! What should I say?
translation: 救命，[player name]！我该说什么？

english: I don't know!
translation: 我不知道！

english: Goblins... goblins of the Goblin Village. I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun. You may know the legend of the Dorgeshuun, but let me tell you our own version.
translation: 哥布林们……哥布林村庄的各位。我是多吉舒恩的扎尼克。你们可能知道多吉舒恩的传说，但让我告诉你们我们自己版本的真相。

english: Thousands of years ago, the Big High War God forced all goblins to fight in a terrible war.
translation: 数千年前，至高战神强迫所有哥布林参与一场可怕的战争。

english: Big High War God! Big High War God!
translation: 至高战神！至高战神！

english: No! Listen! The god commanded the Dorgeshuun to fight a battle they could not win!
translation: 不！听我说！那位神命令多吉舒恩去打一场他们赢不了的仗！

english: You weak! You hide instead of fight!
translation: 你们太弱了！你们躲起来不敢战斗！

english: You don't need to think in those terms! We've lived for centuries without war, and without gods, and-
translation: 你们不必用那种方式思考！我们经历了几个世纪没有战争、没有神的生活，而且——

english: Aaaargh!
Unk!
translation: 呃！

english: We under attack!
translation: 我们遭到攻击了！

english: Scatter!
translation: 散开！

english: The shots came from the top of that tower, [player name]! Can you see anything?
translation: 枪声是从那座塔顶传来的，[player name]！你能看到什么吗？

english: There are two snipers up there.
translation: 上面有两个狙击手。

english: I can't get anywhere without coming into their line of fire, but I think you could get around the side of the buildings to the ladder.
translation: 我无法在不暴露在他们火力线下的情况下过去，但我觉得你可以绕过建筑侧面到达梯子。

english: Sigmund!
translation: 西格蒙德！

english: You can never defeat me! I've been training my Combat by killing goblins around Lumbridge!
translation: 你永远也别想打败我！我一直在仑桥镇附近杀哥布林来训练我的战斗技能！

english: You... you murderer!
translation: 你……你这个杀人犯！

english: Quick, [player name]! Shoot him while I have him distracted!
translation: 快，[player name]！趁我分散他注意力的时候射他！

english: Aaaaah! My eyes!
translation: 啊——！我的眼睛！

english: Don't even think about it, [player name]! Make one move and I'll slit her throat!
translation: 想都别想，[player name]！动一下我就割断她的喉咙！

english: Your little goblin friend has a role in my plan! I'm taking her to the tunnel we've built from the Lumbridge Swamp Caves to the new dwarven train track.
translation: 你的哥布林小朋友在我的计划里有个角色！我要带她去我们挖好的隧道，那条隧道从仑桥镇沼泽洞穴通往新的矮人火车轨道。

english: When the cave goblins find that the dwarven train has killed their hero, there will be war between them! Saradomin's chosen children can watch as two vile underground races wipe each another out!
translation: 当洞穴哥布林发现矮人火车杀死了他们的英雄时，他们之间就会爆发战争！莎拉多明的选民可以坐视两个邪恶的地下种族互相消灭！

english: A-ha-ha-ha-ha-haaa!
translation: 啊-哈-哈-哈-哈-哈！

english: Are they gone?
translation: 他们走了吗？

english: What happen?
translation: 发生什么事了？

english: Sigmund has kidnapped Zanik!
translation: 西格蒙德绑架了扎尼克！

english: He kidnap Chosen Commander? You must rescue her!
translation: 他绑架了天命指挥官？你必须去救她！

english: Human will need help. You take our best warrior, Sergeant Mossfists.
translation: 人类需要帮手。你带上我们最厉害的战士，莫斯菲斯特中士。

english: No! Sergeant Slimetoes best warrior! Take him!
translation: 不！斯莱姆托斯中士才是最厉害的战士！带上他！

english: We don't have time for this! Why don't I take both warriors?
translation: 我们没时间争这个了！不如我两个战士都带上？

english: Grubfoot! Fetch Mossfists and Slimetoes and tell them to meet [player name] in Lumbridge Swamp!
translation: 格拉布福特！去把莫斯菲斯特和斯莱姆托斯找来，告诉他们到仑桥镇沼泽与[player name]会合！

english: You take ancient goblin mace. Maybe it be useful.
translation: 你带上这把古老的哥布林钉锤。也许能派上用场。

english: You rescue Chosen Commander and she lead us all to glory!
translation: 你救出天命指挥官，她就会带领我们走向荣耀！

english: How can I rescue Zanik?
translation: 我要怎么救扎尼克？

english: Pink robe man say they digging tunnel under Lumbridge Swamp Caves. You go there to rescue Chosen Commander.
translation: 粉袍子男人说他们在仑桥镇沼泽洞穴下面挖隧道。你去那里救天命指挥官。

english: Sergeants wait for you at entrance to Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
translation: 中士们在仑桥镇沼泽洞穴入口等你。

english: I lost the mace.
translation: 我把钉锤弄丢了。

english: We know! Some goblin find it, give it back here.
translation: 我们知道！有个哥布林找到了，把它送回来了。

english: Me tell you human not clever enough! He lose mace.
translation: 我告诉过你人类不够聪明！他把钉锤弄丢了。

english: You want mace, you give us 1,000 coins. Maybe you not lose it again if you have to pay!
translation: 你想要钉锤，就给我们1000金币。也许付了钱你就不会再弄丢了！

english: Fair enough. Here you go.
translation: 公平合理。给你。

english: You stupid human! You not have enough money!
translation: 你这个愚蠢的人类！你没有足够的钱！

english: When come back, bring 1,000 coins.
translation: 下次回来时，带1000金币来。

english: You take ancient goblin mace now and rescue Chosen Commander!
translation: 你现在拿着这把古老的哥布林钉锤去救天命指挥官吧！

english: Remember, mace has power to rob enemy of power of Prayer!
translation: 记住，钉锤有剥夺敌人祈祷之力的能力！

english: Well then, human no get mace.
translation: 那好吧，人类拿不到钉锤了。

english: But me not think you able to kill Sigmund with no mace.
translation: 但我认为没有钉锤你杀不了西格蒙德。

english: So if you care about big-eyed friend, you find 1,000 coins!
translation: 所以如果你在意你那个大眼睛的朋友，就去找1000金币来！

english: Thank you for helping with the dig! I hear that the work on the tunnel is now complete and the first train will be making the journey very soon!
translation: 谢谢你帮忙挖掘！我听说隧道工程已经完成，第一列火车很快就要开通了！

english: You've got to stop the train! Sigmund is planning something terrible down there!
translation: 你必须阻止火车！西格蒙德在底下策划着可怕的事！

english: What are you babbling about? Everyone was cleared out of the tunnel when we completed work. There's no reason to stop the train.
translation: 你在胡言乱语什么？工程完工时所有人都撤离了隧道。没有理由停止火车。

english: Shh! What if he's a human spy come to steal our dwarven engineering secrets?
translation: 嘘！万一他是人类间谍，来偷我们矮人工程秘密的呢？

english: Shh! What if she's a human spy come to steal our dwarven engineering secrets?
translation: 嘘！万一她是人类间谍，来偷我们矮人工程秘密的呢？

english: You [player name]?
translation: 你是[player name]？

english: Generals say we help you rescue Chosen Commander.
translation: 将军们说我们帮你救天命指挥官。

english: It too important for puny human to do on own. You just get killed.
translation: 这对渺小的人类来说独自完成太重要了。你会死的。

english: So we come to look after you so you not die.
translation: 所以我们来照顾你，这样你就不会死。

english: Grubfoot say pink robe man take Chosen Commander down this hole into new tunnel.
translation: 格拉布福特说粉色长袍的男人把天命指挥官带下这个洞，进了新隧道。

english: Look, there new hole with ladder just next to climby-out rope. We go down there.
translation: 看，在那个爬出绳子的旁边有个带梯子的新洞。我们从那里下去。

english: What we waiting for? We must go down into tunnel and rescue Chosen Commander!
translation: 我们还在等什么？我们必须下到隧道里，救出天命指挥官！

english: Oh no! Goblins!
translation: 哦不！哥布林！

english: Ha ha! Puny human scared of me!
translation: 哈哈！渺小的人类被我吓到了！

english: We distract guards for you. If we see them, we attack them so you get past while we fighting!
translation: 我们帮你引开守卫。如果我们看到他们，我们就攻击他们，这样你就能在我们打斗的时候过去！

english: You go quick! I keep guard busy!
translation: 你快走！我来拖住守卫！

english: You should pick up your pet before we go down there.
translation: 在我们下去之前，你应该先把你的宠物捡起来。

english: Where Slimetoes?
translation: 泥脚趾在哪？

english: You stop playing with pet! We got to rescue Chosen Commander!
translation: 泥别玩宠物了！我们得去救被选中的指挥官！

english: No he scared of me!
translation: 不，他怕我！

english: He's probably just gone to get reinforcements. He'll be back in a few moments with more guards.
translation: 他可能只是去叫增援了。他很快就会带着更多守卫回来。

english: Both of you follow me.
translation: 你们两个跟我来。

english: One of you wait here.
translation: 你们中的一个在这里等着。

english: Both of you wait here.
translation: 你们两个都在这儿等着。

english: Wait here.
translation: 在这儿等着。

english: Follow me.
translation: 跟我来。

english: Yeah it just get in the way.
translation: 是啊，它只会碍事。

english: Goblin!
translation: 哥布林！

english: Kill it!
translation: 杀了它！

english: Quick! Me keep human busy!
translation: 快！我来缠住人类！

english: Ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈！

english: Take that!
translation: 接招！

english: You there!
translation: 你！

english: Intruder!
translation: 入侵者！

english: At last I have defeated you, you filthy goblin!
translation: 我终于打败了你，你这肮脏的哥布林！

english: Any moment now the first dwarf train will come thundering down this tunnel and crush you! And then the goblins and the dwarves will go to war!
translation: 随时第一列矮人火车就会轰鸣着沿着这条隧道冲下来把你碾碎！然后哥布林和矮人就会开战！

english: Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈！

english: You monster!
translation: 你这怪物！

english: No, YOU'RE the monster! That's why you and all your filthy species must die!
translation: 不，你才是怪物！这就是为什么你和所有肮脏的物种都必须死！

english: We meet again, [player name]!
translation: 我们又见面了，[player name]！

english: This time your goblin friend cannot help you. You are on your own and have no way to overcome my prayers!
translation: 这次你的哥布林朋友帮不了你了。你只能靠自己，无法克服我的祈祷！

english: Saradomin protect me from melee!
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我免受近战伤害！

english: Saradomin protect me from missiles!
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我免受远程伤害！

english: Saradomin protect me from magic
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我免受魔法伤害！

english: Got you!
translation: 抓住你了！

english: What's happening? That weapon is overcoming Saradomin's protection! You've taken away the last of my prayer energy!
translation: 怎么回事？那把武器正在克服萨拉多明的保护！你夺走了我最后的祈祷能量！

english: Bah! You win again, [player name]! But someday, somehow, I will have my revenge!
translation: 哼！你又赢了，[player name]！但总有一天，不管怎样，我会报仇的！

english: Quick, [player name]! Untie me before the train comes!
translation: 快，[player name]！在火车来之前解开我！

english: It gives me great pleasure to declare this new train link open!
translation: 我非常荣幸地宣布这条新火车线路开通！

english: [player name], Zanik has told me about your exploits. It seems that all the Dorgeshuun owe you our lives once again.
translation: [player name]，扎尼克已经告诉我你的英勇事迹。似乎所有多戈斯昆人又一次欠你我们的命。

english: All in a day's work for an adventurer like me!
translation: 对于像我这样的冒险者来说，这不过是日常工作！

english: As a reward, I suggest you keep the ancient goblin mace that you helped to excavate.
translation: 作为奖励，我建议你保留你帮忙挖掘出的古代哥布林钉锤。

english: Most of the Dorgeshuun would be happy if such a war-like artefact was kept outside the city, and I am sure you will keep it in safe hands.
translation: 大多数多戈斯昆人会很乐意看到这样一件好战的文物被保存在城外，我相信你会妥善保管它。

english: Thank you, Ur-tag!
translation: 谢谢你，乌尔.塔格！

english: Sorry, but you need to be a better hunter before we can help you out.
translation: 抱歉，但你得先提升一下狩猎技巧，我们才能帮你。

english: Could I hunt with the guild?
translation: 我能加入公会一起狩猎吗？

english: Absolutely! There's always more work to be done. Head down into the Burrow and talk to the other hunters to get an idea of what we need help with.
translation: 当然可以！活总干不完的。下到洞穴里去，跟其他猎人们聊聊，看看我们有什么需要帮忙的。

english: I'm not sure if you have the time or the patience, iknami, but a little birdy told me that our esteemed scribe Verity may require some assistance.
translation: 我不确定你有没有时间或耐性，伊克纳米，但有小道消息告诉我，我们尊敬的书记员维里蒂可能需要些帮助。

english: What sort of assistance?
translation: 什么样的帮助？

english: If I had to guess, she needs someone to find something for her.
translation: 要我猜的话，她需要有人帮她找东西。

english: She's a wonderful scribe, but can lose some strange things here and there.
translation: 她是个很棒的书记员，但偶尔会弄丢些奇怪的东西。

english: Great! Point me in her direction and I'll get cracking!
translation: 太好了！告诉我她在哪儿，我这就去干！

english: She's behind the bar in the Burrow. Just look for the stressed woman trying to wrangle a bunch of barely- bathed hunters.
translation: 她就在洞穴的吧台后面。找一个被一群几乎没洗过澡的猎人搞得焦头烂额的女人就是了。

english: I'm not sure I have the time for that right now.
translation: 我现在恐怕没时间做这个。

english: Tetamo... Well, hopefully it's not too important.
translation: 泰塔莫……好吧，希望不是什么要紧事。

english: Are you free to talk about my quest?
translation: 你现在有空聊聊我的任务吗？

english: Absolutely. Have you spoken to Verity yet?
translation: 当然。你跟维里蒂谈过了吗？

english: No, not quite yet.
translation: 还没，还没去。

english: If you're having a hard time finding her, she's behind the bar in the Burrow. Head down the stairs in the big tree. You can't miss it, and if you can, maybe you're not cut out for the Hunter Guild.
translation: 要是你找不到她，她就在洞穴的吧台后面。从那棵大树里的楼梯下去。你不会错过的，要是还找不到，那你可能不适合猎人公会。

english: Now, what else can I do for you.
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的？

english: Well actually, I heard there might be something I could help you with?
translation: 其实我听说也许有我能帮上忙的事？

english: Hi Verity. I heard there might be something I could help you with?
translation: 嗨，维里蒂。我听说也许有我能帮上忙的事？

english: You'll have to be slightly more specific. There's always something that needs doing down here!
translation: 你得说具体点儿。这儿总有干不完的活！

english: Something a little birdy may have told Apatura?
translation: 也许是小鸟告诉阿帕图拉的那件事？

english: Tetamo... Pitri needs to stop twittering with the birds. Yes, Gilman and I are concerned about Fox. He left quietly in the night, but we have no record of what he was doing.
translation: 泰塔莫……皮特里需要停止和那些鸟闲聊了。是的，吉尔曼和我很担心福克斯。他夜里悄悄离开了，但我们没有他行踪的记录。

english: Do you normally keep track of the hunters here?
translation: 你们通常都会跟踪这里猎人的行踪吗？

english: We try to, but it's like herding cats! We at least like to keep an eye on what they're hunting and point them in the right direction. It prevents us from losing track of too many creatures... or people.
translation: 我们尽量，但简直像赶猫一样！我们至少想留意他们在猎什么，给他们指个方向。这样就不会丢失太多生物……或人的踪迹。

english: Could anyone else have put Fox onto a hunt?
translation: 有没有可能是别人派福克斯去狩猎的？

english: If anyone did, it would've been Wolf. She's always getting Fox into some kind of trouble.
translation: 如果有人知道，那一定是狼。她总是让福克斯惹上某种麻烦。

english: I'll follow up with her then.
translation: 那我找她去谈谈。

english: Have you spoken to Wolf yet?
translation: 你和狼谈过了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll have a chat to her now.
translation: 还没。我现在就去跟她聊聊。

english: Absolutely. So was our little birdy right about Verity needing a hand?
translation: 当然。那么，小鸟的消息说对了，维里蒂需要帮手？

english: They were... It wasn't an actual bird was it?
translation: 是对的……那不会真的是只鸟吧？

english: Of course not. Only Pitri talks to the birds.
translation: 当然没有。只有皮特里和鸟说话。

english: So, here to ask me what trouble I've gotten Fox into, are you?
translation: 所以，你是来问我让福克斯惹了什么麻烦的，对吧？

english: That's not quite how I'd word it... but how did you know?
translation: 我可不是这么说的……但你怎么知道的？

english: I've honed my instincts over the years.
translation: 这么多年来我磨练出了直觉。

english: Well, that and the fact you had that whole conversation within earshot.
translation: 嗯，还有就是你们刚才那通话我全听见了。

english: Right... So did you send Fox out to do something?
translation: 好吧……那么是你派福克斯出去办事的吗？

english: Sort of. He's on some very unofficial business for me.
translation: 算是吧。他在帮我办点非正式的事。

english: How unofficial?
translation: 有多非正式？

english: If I told you... I'd have to kill you!
translation: 要是我告诉你了……我就得灭口了！

english: Your face! Don't worry, I'm just pulling your leg.
translation: 瞧你那表情！别担心，我逗你玩呢。

english: I asked him to look into making some repairs to Kiko's bed. It's been getting tatty lately. I'm guessing he didn't end up having the materials needed. That'll be why he headed out.
translation: 我让他去看看能不能修修基科的床。那床最近有点旧了。我猜他手头没有需要的材料，所以他就出去了。

english: Well then I guess the first step is to work out what he went to get. Could I take a look at Kiko's bed?
translation: 那么第一步就是要弄清楚他去拿什么了。我能看看基科的床吗？

english: You're welcome to try, but you'll need to convince Kiko to let you. He's just by the table there.
translation: 你可以试试，但得先说服基科让你看。他就在那边的桌子旁边。

english: Any advice for convincing him?
translation: 有什么说服他的建议吗？

english: He's very easy to distract. We have a little fake mouse we use sometimes.
translation: 他很容易分心。我们有时候会用一只假老鼠。

english: Could I borrow it when I have a free hand to take it?
translation: 等我空出手来能借用一下吗？

english: Could I borrow it to have a go at distracting him?
translation: 我能借用那玩意试试引开他吗？

english: Have you checked Kiko's bed yet? It's just to the side of this table.
translation: 你检查过基科的床了吗？就在这张桌子旁边。

english: Not yet. Could I grab that mouse to distract him with?
translation: 还没。我能借那只老鼠来引开他吗？

english: Not yet. I'll get to it now.
translation: 还没。我这就去看。

english: Not yet. Do you happen to have that mouse to distract him with?
translation: 还没。你碰巧有那只老鼠可以借我引开他吗？

english: I already gave it to you. If you've lost it, you'll need to get another for yourself. I'd do so quickly if I were you. Kiko won't be happy if he finds out it's gone.
translation: 我已经给过你了。要是弄丢了，你得自己去弄一只。我要是你，就赶快去弄。基科要是发现老鼠不见了，会不高兴的。

english: Are you not going to wind it up first? Come on now, put some effort in.
translation: 你不先上发条吗？来吧，用点力。

english: Do you mind? I'm trying to sleep here.
translation: 你介意吗？我正想睡觉呢。

english: Here you go, little guy.
translation: 给你，小家伙。

english: A mouse? Fantastic!
translation: 一只老鼠？太棒了！

english: I managed to have a look at that bed. I've never seen such luxury material for a cat bed before.
translation: 我看了看那张床。我从没见过这么奢华的猫床材料。

english: Only the best for our Kiko.
translation: 我们基科只用最好的。

english: I'm guessing it's the actual fur itself that Fox will be looking to replace. It looks like he cut a small bit off. I don't suppose you know where he'd have gone to get that.
translation: 我猜福克斯要找的正是那层毛皮。看起来他割了一小块下来。你知道他会去哪儿弄到这个吗？

english: We have a contact who lives in Outer Fortis. She stocks the best of the best when it comes to fabrics. That'll be where he went, but knowing Fox, he won't have gone directly there.
translation: 我们在福蒂斯外围有个联系人。她卖最好的布料。他应该就是去那儿了，但以福克斯的性子，他不会直接去。

english: He'll have stopped off for a bit of hunting first. There are some pyre foxes about halfway between here and the Locus Oasis that he was eyeing up. I bet that's where you'll find him.
translation: 他会先顺路打会儿猎。从这里到洛克沙洲绿洲的半路上有些火狐，他一直惦记着。我敢说他就在那儿。

english: In that case, I'd better get out there then.
translation: 那样的话，我最好动身去那儿。

english: Have you found Fox?
translation: 你找到福克斯了吗？

english: I haven't yet. You said he might be hunting pyre foxes, right?
translation: 还没呢。你说他可能在猎火狐，对吧？

english: That's right. They're about halfway between here and the Locus Oasis.
translation: 没错。就在这儿到洛克沙洲绿洲的半路上。

english: Thanks. I'll head over there.
translation: 谢谢。我这就过去。

english: It seems like Fox is trying to find something to repair Kiko's bed with.
translation: 看起来福克斯是想找东西修基科的床。

english: Why does that not surprise me? There's two things that man loves: that cat, and not filing in his reports correctly.
translation: 一点也不意外。那家伙有两件事最爱：那只猫，和不好好填报告。

english: I checked in with Verity and apparently Fox has gone missing.
translation: 我跟维里蒂确认过了，福克斯显然失踪了。

english: Ha, that certainly sounds like Fox! What errand has Wolf got him running this time?
translation: 哈，这听起来确实像福克斯！这次狼又让他跑什么腿了？

english: How did you know Wolf was involved?
translation: 你怎么知道狼也牵扯其中？

english: Let's just say you don't run things around here without good instincts. Let me guess - it's also got something to do with Kiko.
translation: 这么说吧，没有好直觉可管不了这一摊事。让我猜猜——还跟基科有关吧。

english: That's spot on! How did you know?
translation: 猜得真准！你怎么知道的？

english: It's an open secret how much Fox and Wolf care about that cat. We all do of course, but those two don't half spoil him rotten.
translation: 福克斯和狼有多在乎那只猫，这已经是公开的秘密了。我们当然都在乎，但那两个家伙简直把他宠坏了。

english: Are you Fox? Everyone's worried about you.
translation: 你是福克斯吗？大家都在担心你。

english: Something attacked me in the dark... I can't move much...
translation: 有东西在黑暗中袭击了我……我动不了多少……

english: Can I help you? Maybe patch you up?
translation: 我能帮你吗？也许给你包扎一下？

english: That would be much appreciated! There should be a couple of plants around to make a poultice... Hold it together with an embertailed jerboa tail, and...
translation: 那真是太感谢了！附近应该有几株植物可以用来做药膏……用一条焰尾跳鼠尾把它固定住，然后……

english: There should be a couple of plants around to make a... make a...
translation: 附近应该有几株植物可以做……做……

english: Stay with me, Fox! Where are these plants?
translation: 挺住，福克斯！这些植物在哪儿？

english: It's a bit fuzzy... I've lost a lot of blood! One should be around here... the other may be near the oasis... with the capybabas... haha, capybaras...
translation: 有点模糊……我流了好多血！一株应该就在附近……另一株可能在绿洲附近……跟那些水豚一起……哈哈，水豚……

english: And what am I making with them?
translation: 我要用它们做什么？

english: A poultice! And hold it together with the tail from an embertailed jerboa.
translation: 做药膏！再用焰尾跳鼠的尾巴绑住。

english: Plants. Tail. Poultice. On it.
translation: 植物。尾巴。药膏。交给我。

english: Don't forget... your traps for the jerboa... they're boxy...
translation: 别忘了……抓跳鼠的陷阱……是盒状的……

english: How's that poul... pool... poultice... Did you find the plants?
translation: 那个药……膏……药膏怎么样了……你找到植物了吗？

english: I think I've got them both.
translation: 我想我两样都找到了。

english: It doesn't look like you do... Who's the one with the head wound again?
translation: 看着不像啊……我再问一遍，到底谁头上挨了打？

english: Where can I find them?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到它们？

english: Fox has been injured out in the savannah!
translation: 福克斯在大草原上受伤了！

english: Well, that is impressive. How has he managed that?
translation: 嗯，真了不起。他怎么做到的？

english: He said he was attacked by an unknown assailant.
translation: 他说他被一个不明袭击者攻击了。

english: Well as you're not offering your condolences, I can only assume he's survived the encounter?
translation: 既然你没来吊唁，那我只能假设他还活着？

english: He should be fine once I help him make a poultice for the wound.
translation: 等我帮他做药膏包扎伤口，他应该就没事了。

english: Excellent. A final question - was his hand injured?
translation: 太好了。最后一个问题——他手受伤了吗？

english: Wonderful! Then I look foward to reading his report.
translation: 太好了！那我等着读他的报告。

english: I've found Fox. He's been injured by something out in the savannah.
translation: 我找到福克斯了。他在大草原上被什么东西伤到了。

english: Oh no... I should've offered to go with him. It's never sensible to be out after dark alone...
translation: 哦不……我本该跟他一起去的。天黑后独自外出从来都不明智……

english: I'm going to do what I can to make sure he's okay.
translation: 我会尽力确保他没事。

english: Well thanks for checking in at least. He's still breathing and that's all Fox needs to come out on top.
translation: 好吧，至少你来说了一声。他还有气，福克斯只要活着就能翻盘。

english: Any updates on Fox?
translation: 福克斯有消息了吗？

english: He's been injured out in the savannah, but I'll do my best to make sure he makes it back.
translation: 他在稀树草原上受伤了，但我会尽力确保他能回来。

english: Tetamo! Only he could get injured on an errand for a cat!
translation: 泰塔莫！也就只有他能在替猫跑腿时受伤了！

english: I don't think I need any more leaves from this bush.
translation: 我想我不需要更多这种灌木的叶子了。

english: I have that poultice here for you.
translation: 我这里给你准备了药膏。

english: Kuani! That's making a difference already.
translation: 库阿尼！已经有效果了。

english: Happy to help. Now, how did you get on finding what you needed to fix Kiko's bed?
translation: 很高兴能帮上忙。那么，你找到修理基科床所需的东西了吗？

english: I thought a little detour wouldn't hurt. I'd caught a glimpse of the most stunning pelt ever seen!
translation: 我想稍微绕个路也无妨。我瞥见了一张从未见过的华丽毛皮！

english: As I was tracking it, I was attacked and knocked out. When I came to, it was gone.
translation: 我追踪的时候遭到了袭击，被打晕了。等我醒来时，它已经不见了。

english: Gone?
translation: 不见了？

english: Without a trace, as well as most of my hunting equipment.
translation: 毫无踪迹，我的大部分狩猎装备也不见了。

english: Do you think someone attacked you for it, or was it just an opportunist looting you?
translation: 你觉得是有人为了它袭击了你，还是碰巧有落井下石的人洗劫了你？

english: I was unconscious.
translation: 我当时昏迷了。

english: Right, of course.
translation: 对，当然。

english: You've already done me a huge favour, but I don't suppose I could ask for one more small one?
translation: 你已经帮了我大忙，但我能不能再请你帮个小忙？

english: I suppose I could. Especially if it goes towards repairing that cat's bed and getting you back to the guild.
translation: 我想可以。特别是如果这能帮助修好那只猫的床，并让你回公会的话。

english: Well it's your lucky day! Make some room and I'll give you the sample needed to fix the bed.
translation: 今天你走运了！腾点地方，我给你修理床所需的样本。

english: Well it's your lucky day! Take this sample to a woman called Atza in Outer Fortis. She'll have exactly what we need.
translation: 今天你走运了！把这个样本带去福蒂斯外围一个叫阿特扎的女人那里。她那里正好有我们需要的东西。

english: Where in the outskirts can I find her? And... what exactly do we need, again?
translation: 我在郊外哪里能找到她？还有……我们到底需要什么来着？

english: She lives by the south western gate of the city. She'll be able to give us the matching fur to repair the cat's bed with.
translation: 她住在城市西南门附近。她能给我们匹配的毛皮来修理那张猫床。

english: Perfect! Here you go!
translation: 完美！给你！

english: Any success with Atza yet?
translation: 阿特扎那边有进展了吗？

english: If you're struggling to find her, she's in Outer Fortis, near the south western gate.
translation: 如果你找不到她，她在福蒂斯外围，靠近西南门。

english: I appear to have lost the sample you gave me...
translation: 我好像把你给我的样本弄丢了……

english: Luckily, I always come prepared. Here's a spare.
translation: 幸运的是，我总有准备。这里是备份。

english: Ah. It seems I don't have room for it.
translation: 啊，看来我没有空间放它了。

english: Well I'm not going anywhere. Let me know when you do have room.
translation: 我哪儿也不去。等你有空间了告诉我。

english: I don't suppose you've got another sample of Kiko's bed for me to take to Atza?
translation: 我想你还有基科床的另一个样本让我带给阿特扎吧？

english: Fortunately for you, I'm always prepared... And our thief clearly didn't care for fine fur samples.
translation: 算你走运，我总是有备而来……而且那个盗贼显然对精美毛皮样本不感兴趣。

english: That's convenient! Usually I'm the one that's always ready for these situations.
translation: 真方便！通常我才是那个随时应对这种情况的人。

english: Absolutely. How's it going, iknami?
translation: 当然。怎么样了，伊克纳米？

english: We're getting there. I should have everything sorted very soon.
translation: 快好了。我应该很快就能把所有事情处理好。

english: How's the Fox situation?
translation: 福克斯的情况怎么样了？

english: He's doing well. He's got me doing a few things for him whilst he recuperates.
translation: 他挺好的。他让我在他休养期间帮他做几件事。

english: Ha! Now that's the Fox I know. I'll have to give him some odd jobs once he's back to make up for ones you're covering!
translation: 哈！这才是我认识的福克斯。等他回来我得给他派些零活，好弥补你代他做的那些！

english: I'm still working on it, but I'm getting there.
translation: 我还在处理，但快好了。

english: Hi there. You must be Atza. I heard you're the person to talk to about getting some material to match a sample?
translation: 你好。你一定是阿特扎吧。我听说要找到匹配样本的材料就得找你？

english: I might be. Depends who's asking... and what you're looking for, of course.
translation: 可能是吧。要看是谁问的……还有你在找什么。

english: Your friend Fox was going to bring this sample to you, but he's been a little... waylaid.
translation: 你的朋友福克斯本来要带这个样本给你，但他有点……被耽搁了。

english: Well, this wouldn't be the first time! Let's take a look.
translation: 哎，这也不是第一次了！让我看看。

english: I don't seem to have it with me.
translation: 我身上好像没带。

english: You'll have to go back to Fox and grab it then.
translation: 那你得回去找福克斯拿。

english: Good, good. Luckily for you, I recognise this fur. I do have a bit left, but I'll have to dig it out.
translation: 好，好。算你走运，我认识这种毛皮。我确实还剩下一点，但得翻找出来。

english: Shall I just wait here then?
translation: 那我就在这里等吗？

english: Oh... Fox usually helps me with my chores when he visits.
translation: 哦……福克斯来看我的时候通常会帮我做家务。

english: That's funny. He didn't mention that to me.
translation: 真有趣。他没跟我提过。

english: That's alright, I'm sure a capable adventurer like you will manage fine. Fox was going to assemble some equipment for me. You can manage that, can't you?
translation: 没关系，我相信像你这样能干的冒险者一定能搞定。福克斯本来要帮我组装一些装备。你能做到，对吧？

english: I suppose so. Where do I start?
translation: 我想可以。从哪里开始？

english: It's all in that pile on the floor there. You can work it out, I'm sure.
translation: 都在地板上的那堆东西里。我相信你能搞定的。

english: Now, luckily for you, I recognise this fur. I do have a bit left, but I'll have to dig it out.
translation: 现在，算你走运，我认识这种毛皮。我确实还剩下一点，但得翻找出来。

english: Hello again. I've given Atza the fur sample.
translation: 又见面了。我已经把毛皮样本给了阿特扎。

english: Did she give you the matching material?
translation: 她给你匹配的材料了吗？

english: Not yet. I should check back in with her.
translation: 还没有。我应该再去找她确认一下。

english: Don't forget, I need a hand setting up that equipment on the floor!
translation: 别忘了，我需要帮忙组装地板上的那套装备！

english: Don't worry, I'm on it.
translation: 别担心，我这就做。

english: So anyway, how did you come to be doing this for Fox?
translation: 话说回来，你怎么会替福克斯做这些事？

english: Well, he actually got attacked on his way over here.
translation: 呃，其实他在来这里的路上被袭击了。

english: Shouldn't you be helping him heal up?
translation: 你不应该帮他疗伤吗？

english: Oh he'll be alright. He was on the mend when I left him.
translation: 哦，他会没事的。我离开时他正在恢复。

english: All done!
translation: 全部搞定！

english: Oh, that's looking much better.
translation: 哦，看起来好多了。

english: Now that's done, did you manage to find the material?
translation: 现在这个做完了，你找到材料了吗？

english: Thanks for your help today. I hope that fur works for your project.
translation: 谢谢你今天的帮忙。希望那种毛皮对你的项目有用。

english: Yes, but you don't have enough room for it! Come back when you have space.
translation: 找到了，但你空间不够！等你有空间了再来。

english: Could I get a replacement for that fur? I managed to lose it.
translation: 我能再拿一份那种毛皮吗？我弄丢了。

english: You can, for now. I don't have an unlimited supply though, so be careful.
translation: 暂时可以。但我不是无限供应的，所以小心点。

english: Ah, you don't have space for that.
translation: 啊，你没空间放这个。

english: You should take that material back to Fox.
translation: 你应该把那个材料带回给福克斯。

english: Hello again. I got the fur from Atza. She's certainly... something.
translation: 又见面了。我从阿特扎那里拿到了毛皮。她还真是……有点特别。

english: She didn't make you do odd jobs for her, did she?
translation: 她没让你替她做零活吧？

english: She does it every time I visit!
translation: 我每次来她都这样！

english: Now, I'll need you to take this report back to Verity, but it looks like you don't have space for it at the moment.
translation: 现在，我需要你把这份报告带回给维里蒂，但看来你目前没有空间放它。

english: Anyway, now that's that, would you mind letting Wolf and Verity know I'm okay? Oh, and can you take my report back to the guild?
translation: 总之，事情就是这样了，你介意告诉狼和维里蒂我没事吗？哦，还有，你能把我的报告带回公会吗？

english: Please apologise to Verity for the condition it's in. Oh, and of course, don't forget to use that fur along with another embertailed jerboa tail to fix Kiko's bed!
translation: 请替我为报告的糟糕状态向维里蒂道歉。哦，当然，别忘了用那块毛皮和另一条焰尾跳鼠尾来修理基科的床！

english: Want me to save the world while I'm at it?
translation: 要不要我顺道拯救世界？

english: No need! You've already saved my world by making Kiko happy.
translation: 不必了！你让基科开心就已经拯救了我的世界。

english: I've lost your report.
translation: 我把你的报告弄丢了。

english: How is it you've lost the report and yet you somehow don't have space for another one?
translation: 你怎么弄丢了报告却还没空间放另一份？

english: Well, that's just the adventuring way! If something isn't tied down, I'll grab it, and probably lose it at some point too!
translation: 嘿，这就是冒险者的作风！只要不是绑住的，我就会捡起来，然后可能也会弄丢！

english: You're lucky I don't have anywhere else to be. I'll write you another one. Just a moment...
translation: 算你走运，我没什么别的事。我再给你写一份。等一下……

english: Hello there. Have you taken that report back to Verity yet?
translation: 你好。你把那份报告带回给维里蒂了吗？

english: Not yet. I still need to get around to it.
translation: 还没有。我还没腾出时间去做。

english: Is that Fox's report? Thanks for bringing that back to us. How was he?
translation: 那是福克斯的报告吗？谢谢你带回来给我们。他怎么样了？

english: He's injured, but he's on the mend. I expect he'll be back in here soon enough.
translation: 他受伤了，但正在恢复。我估计他很快就能回来。

english: Good to hear. Once you're done with the cat's bed, you might want to check in with Guildmaster Apatura.
translation: 很高兴听到这个。你弄完猫床后，可以去见见公会会长阿帕图拉。

english: Thanks for all your help. Once you're done with the cat's bed, you might want to check in with Guildmaster Apatura.
translation: 感谢你的所有帮助。你弄完猫床后，可以去见见公会会长阿帕图拉。

english: I'll go and speak to her now.
translation: 我现在就去和她谈谈。

english: Just about sorted. He'll be back here very soon.
translation: 差不多处理好了。他很快就会回来。

english: Thank you, hunter.
translation: 谢谢你，猎人。

english: I have. She was glad to hear that you'll be back soon.
translation: 已经说了。她听到你很快回来很高兴。

english: Well as much as I resent the trickery used, this bed is much comfier now.
translation: 好吧，尽管我很反感那些手段，但这张床现在舒服多了。

english: Thanks for all your help. Have you checked in with the Guildmaster?
translation: 感谢你的所有帮助。你去见过公会会长了吗？

english: Looks like the Fox situation is all sorted.
translation: 看来福克斯的事情都解决了。

english: Thank you, hunter. I'm not sure I could have forgiven myself if something terrible had happened to him.
translation: 谢谢你，猎人。如果他出了什么可怕的事，我不确定我能否原谅自己。

english: Everything's all wrapped up!
translation: 一切都圆满结束了！

english: Kuani! So what was so important for our darling Kiko that poor Fox risked life and limb?
translation: 库阿尼！那么，我们亲爱的基科到底有什么重要的事，让可怜的福克斯拼上性命？

english: So, basically Wolf sent Fox to get fur to fix Kiko's bed, but he actually needed to talk to Atza, and Atza needed me to...
translation: 所以，基本上就是狼派福克斯去弄毛皮来修理基科的床，但他实际上需要和阿特扎谈谈，而阿特扎需要我……

english: Actually... I think I'll just read the report.
translation: 其实……我想我还是直接看报告吧。

english: Just... looking around.
translation: 只是……四处看看。

english: Oh, did you lose something?
translation: 哦，你丢了什么东西吗？

english: No... I found something. A door.
translation: 不……我找到了什么东西。一扇门。

english: A door? I see doors all the time. What makes this one so special?
translation: 一扇门？我天天都能看到门。这扇门有什么特别的？

english: It's buried beneath a tonne of rocks. Could be the entrance to some ancient ruins...
translation: 它埋在一吨重的岩石下面。可能是某个古代废墟的入口……

english: Wow! Ancient ruins? Are you an archaeologist or something?
translation: 哇！古代废墟？你是考古学家还是什么的？

english: Archaeologist? Me? Hmm...
translation: 考古学家？我？嗯……

english: Of course I am! I'm the greatest archaeologist of our time. The name's Willow! Have you not heard of me?
translation: 我当然是啊！我是我们这个时代最伟大的考古学家。我叫柳木！你没听说过我吗？

english: I'm afraid I haven't. Are you looking for a way into the ruins?
translation: 恐怕没有。你在找进入废墟的路吗？

english: You bet I am, but I don't think there's any other way in.
translation: 当然啦，但我觉得没有别的路可以进去了。

english: Oh dear. Do you have another plan to get in?
translation: 哦，天哪。你有别的计划进去吗？

english: Potentially, but I won't be able to do it on my own. Nor can I leave the area. If I'm not here to guard the entrance, some other archaeologist might come along and steal the glory from me!
translation: 有可能，但我一个人做不了。我也不能离开这个区域。如果我不在这里守卫入口，其他考古学家可能会过来抢走我的功劳！

english: Maybe you could give me a hand? There could be untold riches inside the ruins!
translation: 也许你能帮我一把？废墟里可能藏着数不尽的财富！

english: A chance to uncover ancient ruins doesn't happen every day! Of course I'll help! I'm [player name] by the way. How do you plan to get in?
translation: 揭开古代废墟的机会可不是天天都有的！我当然会帮忙！顺便说一下，我叫[player name]。你打算怎么进去？

english: The entrance is covered in rocks and rubble - I don't think mining them will work.
translation: 入口被岩石和瓦砾覆盖着——我觉得靠采矿是行不通的。

english: We'll need something stronger. Who knows what could be inside the ruins. There could be traps, or even monsters!
translation: 我们需要更强大的东西。谁知道废墟里面会有什么。可能有陷阱，甚至怪物！

english: No, I think we'll need to get my old crew...
translation: 不，我想我们需要找回我以前的团队……

english: ...I mean, excavation team together. But you'll need to convince them to help us. We didn't part on the best of terms.
translation: ……我是说，挖掘团队。但你需要说服他们来帮我们。我们上次分手时闹得不太愉快。

english: We had a falling out after a, uhm... dig, went wrong.
translation: 我们在一次……嗯……挖掘出了差错之后闹翻了。

english: Where can I find your old team, and how will they help?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到你以前的团队，他们能怎么帮忙？

english: To get into the ruins we'll need to blow up all the rocks blocking the entrance.
translation: 要进入废墟，我们需要炸掉所有堵住入口的岩石。

english: That doesn't sound too safe. What if we damage the ruins? Surely it's better to go slower and preserve as much as we can?
translation: 这听起来不太安全。要是我们损坏了废墟怎么办？慢慢来，尽可能多地保存，不是更好吗？

english: No! We need to get in there as soon as possible! Burntof the dwarf will do it. He's a master with explosives.
translation: 不！我们需要尽快进去！矮人伯恩托夫能做到。他是个爆破专家。

english: From what I can remember, he's a fan of his drink. His favourite pub being the Rising Sun Inn, in Falador - I'd look there first.
translation: 据我所知，他喜欢喝酒。他最喜欢的酒馆是法拉多城的朝阳旅馆——你可以先去那里找找。

english: After we've blown the rocks away, we'll need someone to move all the rubble. Someone strong.
translation: 等我们炸开岩石后，还需要有人来清理所有瓦砾。要个力气大的人。

english: I could do it! I'm quite strong myself.
translation: 我可以做！我自己就挺强壮的。

english: Ha ha ha! I don't think so. We need a real [strongman/strongwoman] - someone with muscles. An old friend of mine, Checkal, should be able to do all the heavy lifting.
translation: 哈哈哈！我不这么认为。我们需要一个真正的[strongman/strongwoman]——一个肌肉发达的人。我的一个老朋友，切卡尔，应该能搞定所有重活。

english: Oh okay... Where can I find him?
translation: 哦，好吧……我在哪里可以找到他？

english: Hmm... We had quite a rough falling out when we last spoke, but I heard he's hanging around Barbarian Village.
translation: 嗯……我们上次谈话时闹得很僵，但我听说他最近在野蛮人村庄附近晃荡。

english: Lastly, if my hunch is correct, this place will be covered in traps. We'll need my pal Marley to disarm them. He's the best thief I know. Been doing it for years.
translation: 最后，如果我的直觉没错，这个地方会布满陷阱。我们需要我的朋友马利来解除它们。他是我认识的最好的盗贼。干这行好多年了。

english: I have no idea where he is these days. But his cousin Charlie in Varrock may know. You should talk to him. He's normally somewhere near the Blue Moon Inn.
translation: 我不知道他现在在哪儿。但他在维洛克城的表哥查理可能知道。你应该去跟他谈谈。他通常待在蓝月旅馆附近。

english: You have a rather interesting group of friends... but if they get us into the ruins, I'm all for it.
translation: 你有一群相当有趣的朋友……但如果他们能帮我们进入废墟，我完全赞成。

english: Good luck. Once you've recruited one of the team, I'll meet them at the entrance. It's on the west side of the mountain.
translation: 祝你好运。一旦你招募了团队中的一个人，我会在入口处和他们碰面。就在山的西侧。

english: Seems like you're in a bit of a pickle. Have fun with that.
translation: 看来你遇到麻烦了。祝你好运。

english: Back again? What can I help you with?
translation: 又回来了？有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Where can I find Marley?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到马利？

english: Marley is an elusive one, to be honest. I have no idea where to find him. You should try talk to his cousin Charlie near the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock. Maybe he will know.
translation: 说实话，马利是个行踪不定的人。我不知道去哪儿找他。你应该试着跟他表哥查理谈谈，他在维洛克城的蓝月旅馆附近。也许他会知道。

english: Need help finding anyone else?
translation: 还需要帮忙找其他人吗？

english: Where can I find Checkal?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到切卡尔？

english: Last I heard Checkal was hanging around Barbarian Village. Maybe you should head there to find him?
translation: 我上次听说切卡尔在野蛮人村庄附近晃荡。也许你应该去那儿找他？

english: Where can I find Burntof?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到伯恩托夫？

english: Burntof likes to hang out at the Rising Sun Inn located in Falador.
translation: 伯恩托夫喜欢待在法拉多城的朝阳旅馆。

english: Where can I find the entrance to the ruins?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到废墟的入口？

english: On the western side of Ice Mountain. There's no way up on this side so you'll need to head east of here first and go around the dwarf colony to get there.
translation: 在冰山的西侧。这边没有路上去，所以你得先往东走，绕过矮人聚居地才能到那里。

english: Hurry up! It's not exactly exciting standing out here all day.
translation: 快点！整天站在这儿可没什么意思。

english: Hello there. I'm [player name] and I'm looking for a man named Checkal.
translation: 你好。我是[player name]，我在找一个叫切卡尔的人。

english: That would be me [sir/miss]. What can I do for you?
translation: 那就是我，[sir/miss]。有什么能帮你的？

english: I was told to come find you. Willow has found a new digsi...
translation: 有人让我来找你。柳木发现了一个新的挖掘……

english: Stop right there [sir/miss]. You can tell Willow she can do the heavy lifting herself.
translation: 打住，[sir/miss]。你可以告诉柳木，让她自己干重活去。

english: And why is that?
translation: 为什么这么说？

english: Willow does not appreciate the amount of work that goes into building my physique. I would not help her lift a shrimp.
translation: 柳木根本不理解我为了练就这身肌肉付出了多少努力。我连一只虾都不会帮她搬。

english: I take great pride in these muscles and it hurts me to the core to hear such insults!
translation: 我为这些肌肉感到无比自豪，听到这样的侮辱让我痛彻心扉！

english: But we need your help! She's found a new archaeological digsite and needs you to help clear the entrance.
translation: 但我们需要你的帮助！她发现了一个新的考古挖掘点，需要你帮忙清理入口。

english: Archaeological digsite? Why is Willow interested in starting a digsite?
translation: 考古挖掘点？柳木为什么对开掘挖掘点感兴趣？

english: She said there could be some ancient ruins, even an untouched hoard of gold and treasure!
translation: 她说可能有一些古代废墟，甚至还有未被触碰过的黄金和宝藏！

english: Ah that makes sense. *Sighs* You poor [lad/lass]...
translation: 啊，说得通。*叹气* 可怜的小[lad/lass]……

english: Nothing. Look, I will help you. But first you must prove your strength to me.
translation: 没什么。听着，我会帮你。但首先你得向我证明你的力量。

english: Well Checkal, I don't mean to brag, but there are few people in Gielinor stronger than me.
translation: 好吧，切卡尔，我不是想吹牛，但在基利诺尔没几个人比我更强壮。

english: Hmm... I will see about that.
translation: 嗯……我倒要看看。

english: Yes... you do have tremendous muscle mass.
translation: 是的……你的肌肉确实很发达。

english: Your legs are strong as steel, too.
translation: 你的腿也像钢铁一样强壮。

english: Well [player name], I have to say you are the definition of strength.
translation: 好吧，[player name]，我得说你就是力量的化身。

english: I do try.
translation: 我尽力而为。

english: But a [strongman/strongwoman] doesn't stop when they reach the top. They always push themselves.
translation: 但一个[strongman/strongwoman]不会在达到顶峰时就停下。他们总是不断鞭策自己。

english: Well that shouldn't be too hard. I'm pretty strong.
translation: 那应该不难。我挺强壮的。

english: That is true. But are you strong in both body and mind?
translation: 这倒是真的。但你的身心都强壮吗？

english: Uhm... yes?
translation: 嗯……是的？

english: To be a true [strongman/strongwoman], you do not just need big muscles. No, you must have self control and an unrelenting desire to push yourself to become stronger.
translation: 要成为一个真正的[strongman/strongwoman]，你不仅需要大块肌肉。不，你还必须有自制力和不断鞭策自己变得更强的不懈渴望。

english: Oh, I'm not sure about that...
translation: 哦，这个我不太确定……

english: I would ask you to train with my old friend and trainer, Atlas, one of the strongest barbarians I know. You can find him in the hall north of here.
translation: 我请你跟我的老朋友兼教练阿特拉斯一起训练，他是我认识的最强壮的野蛮人之一。你可以在北边的大厅里找到他。

english: If you can survive his rigorous training program, I shall offer you my help.
translation: 如果你能经受住他严格的训练计划，我就答应帮你。

english: How do you know he'll train me?
translation: 你怎么知道他愿意训练我？

english: Tell him I sent you and he will train you.
translation: 告诉他是我让你去的，他就会训练你。

english: Alright then, I'll go speak to Atlas. Farewell.
translation: 好吧，那我去跟阿特拉斯谈谈。再见。

english: I seem to have forgotten where Atlas is. Can you remind me?
translation: 我好像忘了阿特拉斯在哪儿。你能提醒我一下吗？

english: Atlas can be found in the hall to the north of us.
translation: 阿特拉斯在我们北边的大厅里。

english: No problem at all.
translation: 没问题。

english: I've just come to talk to you. Checkal said you could train me. He said you're the strongest barbarian he knows.
translation: 我只是来跟你谈谈。切卡尔说你可以训练我。他说你是他认识的最强壮的野蛮人。

english: Oh did he now? What makes you think I will train you?
translation: 哦，他这么说的？你凭什么觉得我会训练你？

english: Come on then! Out with it already!
translation: 来吧！快说！

english: Well uh, he said he wouldn't...
translation: 嗯，他说他不会……

english: I'm just pulling your leg! Any friend of Checkal is a friend of mine.
translation: 我逗你玩呢！切卡尔的朋友就是我的朋友。

english: Please don't scare me like that.
translation: 请别这样吓我。

english: It's a force of habit. It comes with the barbarian lifestyle. But to apologise, I'll give you a free lesson!
translation: 这是习惯成自然。野蛮人的生活方式就是这样。但为了道歉，我免费给你上一课！

english: Oh really? How much would this usually cost?
translation: 哦，真的吗？通常要多少钱？

english: Around 25,000 coins per session.
translation: 每节课大约25,000金币。

english: That's a lot of money!
translation: 那可真是一大笔钱！

english: No price is too much for a good workout. Are you ready to start your training session?
translation: 为了好的锻炼，再高的价格也值得。你准备好开始训练了吗？

english: If you want to become a [strongman/strongwoman], you need to get into shape!
translation: 如果你想成为一个[strongman/strongwoman]，你需要把身材练好！

english: It's not all about strength! You need to get some cardio in, too.
translation: 这不只是力量的问题！你还需要做一些有氧运动。

english: You need to be tough to be a [strongman/strongwoman]! Show me what you've got! Come on!
translation: 要成为[strongman/strongwoman]，你必须坚强！让我看看你的本事！来吧！

english: Every [strongman/strongwoman] was once a beginner who refused to give up.
translation: 每个[strongman/strongwoman]都曾经是一个拒绝放弃的初学者。

english: You need to push yourself!
translation: 你需要鞭策自己！

english: Always strive to be the best that you can be! That is the [strongman/strongwoman] way.
translation: 永远努力成为最好的自己！这就是[strongman/strongwoman]之道。

english: I'm very proud of you. You've shown grit, determination and an iron will. You are a true [strongman/strongwoman] at heart.
translation: 我为你感到非常骄傲。你展现了勇气、决心和钢铁般的意志。你内心是一个真正的[strongman/strongwoman]。

english: That was exhausting... I've never worked so hard in my life!
translation: 太累了……我这辈子从没这么努力过！

english: And for that, I am proud. Now, show us what you're made of and flex those muscles!
translation: 为此，我感到自豪。现在，让我们看看你的本事，展示一下你的肌肉！

english: My work is done. Return to Checkal and show him your new-found muscles.
translation: 我的任务完成了。回到切卡尔那里，向他展示你新练出来的肌肉。

english: Not right now, I am a bit busy.
translation: 现在不行，我有点忙。

english: No problem. Come back when you are ready.
translation: 没问题。准备好了就回来吧。

english: You're back. Would you like to start that training session now?
translation: 你回来了。现在要开始那场训练吗？

english: Thanks for that workout. I can see why you normally charge people so much.
translation: 谢谢你的训练。我明白你平时为什么收费那么高了。

english: So have you completed your training session with Atlas?
translation: 那么你和阿特拉斯的训练完成了吗？

english: Just about, but it was a real struggle.
translation: 差不多完成了，但真是费了老大劲。

english: It always is, but I can see you are standing taller and looking stronger already.
translation: 向来如此，但我看得出你已经站得更直，看起来更强壮了。

english: Now, show me your muscles and I will judge if you're ready to receive my help.
translation: 现在，让我看看你的肌肉，我来判断你是否准备好接受我的帮助。

english: My goodness, those muscles are exquisite. I will definitely help a [man/lady] who shows that much dedication to their physique.
translation: 天哪，这肌肉真是绝了。我肯定会帮助一个对身体如此投入的[man/lady]。

english: Fantastic! Willow said she'd meet you by the entrance, on the west side of Ice Mountain.
translation: 太棒了！柳木说她会到入口处等你，就在冰山的西侧。

english: Thank you my friend, I will meet you there.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友，我会在那里等你。

english: What an exhausting workout. I hope the others aren't as much effort to recruit.
translation: 真是累人的训练。希望招募其他人不用这么费劲。

english: Well, that's everyone. I guess I should head off the entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.[confirmation needed]
translation: 好了，人都齐了。我想我该动身去冰山西侧的入口了。[confirmation needed]

english: What did you want me to do again?
translation: 你刚才要我做什么来着？

english: I want you to prove your strength by showing me your muscles!
translation: 我要你向我展示肌肉，证明你的力量！

english: Do you think you'll be able to handle all these rocks?
translation: 你觉得你能处理所有这些岩石吗？

english: Should not be a problem. This challenge is easy for a [strongman/strongwoman].
translation: 应该没问题。这点挑战对[strongman/strongwoman]来说轻而易举。

english: I wish I could help...
translation: 真希望我能帮上忙……

english: Do not worry my friend. If you stay dedicated and keep working everyday, you'll be able to achieve anything you dream of.
translation: 别担心，我的朋友。只要你坚持不懈，每天努力，你就能实现任何梦想。

english: Thanks Checkal, I will.
translation: 谢谢你，切卡尔，我会的。

english: One last thing - be careful when we go inside. You never know what will happen.
translation: 最后一件事——我们进去时要小心。你永远不知道会发生什么。

english: Are you Burntof?
translation: 你是伯恩托夫吗？

english: I might be, I might not. Buy ush a drink and find out *hic*.
translation: 可能是我，也可能不是。给俺买杯酒就知道了*呃*。

english: Fine... I'll get you a beer.
translation: 好吧……我给你拿杯啤酒。

english: Thanksh a bunch.
translation: 多谢啦。

english: It just so happens I've got a drink you can have.
translation: 正好我这儿有杯酒可以给你喝。

english: Giv' it 'ere then.
translation: 那拿过来吧。

english: That'sh good shtuff.
translation: 真是好东东。

english: So, are you Burntof?
translation: 那么，你是伯恩托夫吗？

english: Yesh I am *hic*. What can thish dwarf do for you?
translation: 是滴，俺就是*呃*。俺这个矮人能为你做点什么？

english: Willow sent me. She needs your help with a job.
translation: 是柳木派我来的。她有个活计需要你的帮助。

english: Willow? Now that'sh a name I drink to forget!
translation: 柳木？那名字我喝酒就是为了忘掉！

english: Willow alwaysh insishted on changing me waysh. I knows explosivesh. Just because I lost a couple of me fingersh a few yearsh back doesn't mean I'll do it again *hic*.
translation: 柳木总坚持要俺改过自新。俺懂炸药。就因为几年前俺丢了几个手指头，不代表俺会再犯*呃*。

english: I knew the exhact amount of dyn*hic*amite needed to blow that rich fool's shafe. We woulda been shet for life!
translation: 俺知道炸开那个有钱傻瓜保险柜需要的精确*呃*炸药量。咱们本该一辈子不愁了！

english: I thought you were a team of archaeologists?
translation: 我以为你们是一队考古学家？

english: Archaeologishts? Shure, if that's what you want to call ush?!
translation: 考古学家？当然，如果你想这么叫咱们的话？！

english: Willow sent me to get you. She's found a new digsite and needs your expert knowledge on explosives.
translation: 柳木派我来找你。她发现了一个新的挖掘地点，需要你的炸药专业知识。

english: Hmmm... *hic*
Tell you what. If you beat me in a friendly game of rock paper s*hic*cissorsh, I'll join the team.
translation: 这样吧。如果你在友好的一局石头剪刀*呃*布中赢了我，我就加入队伍。

english: *Whispers* We'll have the game upshtairs away from everyone.
translation: *低语*我们去楼上玩，避开所有人。

english: Where'sh my beer?
translation: 俺的啤酒呢？

english: Ah! A [lad/lass] of fhine taste *hic*. I love Dwarven shtout!
translation: 啊！一个品味不错的[lad/lass]*呃*。俺喜欢矮人烈性黑啤！

english: No messhing around with you! Only the strong stuff, I like it!
translation: 不跟你瞎扯！只来烈的，俺喜欢！

english: The rulesh are ash followsh. We both pick a shign to show and then shay 'rock, paper, shcissors.' After schissors, we show our shigns.
translation: 规则如下。咱俩各选一个手势，然后说'石头、剪刀、布'。说完'布'之后，咱就亮出手势。

english: Thish ish a besht of three game. Nowsh, pick what you are going to shhhow.
translation: 这是三局两胜。现在，选好你要出的手势。

english: Looksh like you win the firsht round.
translation: 看来你赢了第一局。

english: But...? I put out [chosen sign]?
translation: 但是……？我出了[chosen sign]？

english: Yesh, and I put out *hic* [losing sign]... I think.
translation: 是啊，俺出了*呃*[losing sign]……俺想是吧。

english: Okay then... I guess the first round goes to me.
translation: 好吧……那第一局算我赢了。

english: I won! That's two rounds to me, so you have to help.
translation: 我赢了！这样我赢了两局，你得帮忙了。

english: Hooold it right there *hic* bud, I thinksh I won that round...
translation: 给俺等等*呃*伙计，俺觉得俺赢了那局……

english: But [chosen sign] beats [losing sign]?
translation: 但是[chosen sign]克[losing sign]？

english: Yesh, that is correct, but you chose [sign that gets beaten by Burntof's]. So I win.
translation: 没错，确实如此，但你选了[sign that gets beaten by Burntof's]。所以俺赢了。

english: Whatever, let's just play the last round.
translation: 随便吧，直接玩最后一局。

english: Well, it looksh like I win, sho I don't have to help you out.
translation: 嗯，看来是俺赢了，所以俺不用帮你忙了。

english: Are you okay Burntof? I clearly beat you. Check my hand again.
translation: 你没事吧，伯恩托夫？明明是我赢了。你再看看我的手。

english: Merlinsh beard! You did. A deal'sh a deal, I'll help you out.
translation: 梅林的胡子！你赢了。一言为定，俺会帮你。

english: But I think I'll need one more drink before I hitsh the road.
translation: 不过俺想上路前还得再喝一杯。

english: Tina! Bring me another beer pleash.
translation: 蒂娜！再给俺来杯啤酒，麻烦啦。

english: Sure thing Burntof, I'll be right there!
translation: 没问题，伯恩托夫，马上就来！

english: Thanksh Tina.
translation: 谢了，蒂娜。

english: That was interesting, but that's Burntof recruited. On to the next person.
translation: 真有趣，不过伯恩托夫算是招募到了。下一个。

english: Well, that's everyone. I guess I should head off the entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.
translation: 好了，人都齐了。我想我该动身去冰山西侧的入口了。

english: You managed to make your way over to the ruins then?
translation: 那么你设法赶到废墟来了？

english: Yush, I did, why's that shuch a *hic* shurprise?
translation: 是的，俺来了，这有啥好*呃*惊讶的？

english: I thought you would pass out on your way.
translation: 我以为你会在路上昏过去。

english: Dwarshves have a very good shense of direction and we can *hic* hold our beer very well.
translation: 矮人方向感很好，而且我们*呃*很能喝啤酒。

english: Are you sure you'll be able to handle the dynamite in your current state?
translation: 你确定以你现在的状态能处理炸药吗？

english: Hah! I could blow thish rubble away with one hand and me eyesh closed.
translation: 哈！俺闭着眼睛一只手就能把这些瓦砾炸飞。

english: I'm looking for a man named Marley. Have you seen him?
translation: 我在找一个叫马利的人。你见过他吗？

english: Ah Marley, my cousin. He's always getting himself into trouble!
translation: 啊，马利，我表弟。他总是惹麻烦！

english: Oh really? Do you know where I could find him?
translation: 哦，真的吗？你知道我在哪里能找到他吗？

english: Hmm... it's been a while since I've seen him. Last I heard he got caught in the middle of a robbery and had to flee Varrock.
translation: 嗯……我有一阵子没见过他了。上次听说他卷入了一场抢劫案，不得不逃离维洛克城。

english: Something to do with trying to steal a set of Wizard robes from the museum.
translation: 好像是因为试图从博物馆偷一套魔法师长袍。

english: Great, so I'm dealing with a criminal!
translation: 太好了，这么说我在和一个罪犯打交道！

english: Afraid so. Marley is no stranger to the authorities... Knowing him, he's probably hanging out in Edgeville ruins till the attention dies down. I'd try there.
translation: 恐怕是的。马利对当局来说并不陌生……以我对他的了解，他很可能在边陲镇的废墟里闲逛，等风头过去。我会去那里找找。

english: Perfect. I'll go look for him.
translation: 太好了。我去找他。

english: Hey there. Would you happen to be Marley?
translation: 嘿，你好。你莫非就是马利？

english: I could be. Depends on who's asking? If you're with the Varrock City Guard, I had nothing to do with the robbery at the museum. I don't even know what I'd do with some Wizard robes.
translation: 可能是吧。那要看是谁在问了？如果你是维洛克城城市守卫，那博物馆的抢劫案跟我无关。我甚至都不知道拿那些魔法师长袍能干什么。

english: Uhm, no? What robbery? Wizard robes?
translation: 呃，不是？什么抢劫？魔法师长袍？

english: Robbery? Sorry [sir/miss], first I've heard of a robbery.
translation: 抢劫？抱歉[sir/miss]，我还是第一次听说有抢劫这回事。

english: Look, I'm not here with the city guard, Willow sent me to find you. She needs your help.
translation: 听着，我不是跟城市守卫一起来的。柳木派我来找你，她需要你的帮助。

english: Willow? Hmm... I'm afraid I don't recall a Willow.
translation: 柳木？嗯……恐怕我不记得有叫柳木的人。

english: Are you sure? She said you were old pals.
translation: 你确定？她说你们是老朋友了。

english: Nope, I'm sure. Only Willow I know of is a type of tree.
translation: 不，我很确定。我知道的柳木只是一种树。

english: But, then again, my memory is a bit hazy, due to how hungry I am.
translation: 不过话说回来，我饿得记性有点模糊了。

english: You're too hungry... to remember your friend?
translation: 你太饿了……以至于记不起你的朋友？

english: Yep... been a while since I had a nice hot meal.
translation: 是啊……好一阵子没吃过一顿热乎的好饭了。

english: *Sighs*... would you like me to get you something to eat, to help jog your memory?
