translation: *叹气*……要不要我去给你弄点吃的，帮你回忆回忆？

english: Oh what a kind offer! I couldn't say no.
translation: 哦，真是好心的提议！我没法拒绝。

english: Fine, I'll be back in a...
translation: 好吧，我马上回来……

english: Woah woah woah, hold your horses there friend! I can't just eat anything. I have very specific dietary requirements.
translation: 哇哦哇哦哇哦，慢着，朋友！我不能随便吃东西。我有非常严格的饮食要求。

english: Don't be like that! I don't want nothing fancy, just a Steak sandwich from the Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock.
translation: 别这样嘛！我不要什么花哨的东西，只要维洛克城蓝月旅馆的一份牛排三明治就行。

english: Why don't you go and get one then?
translation: 那你干嘛不去弄一份呢？

english: Slight problem there, friend. I've been barred and the chef won't make me another one. Something about stealing from punters. I can't remember...
translation: 有点小问题，朋友。我被禁止入内了，厨师不会再给我做。好像是关于偷顾客东西的事。我记不清了……

english: *Sighs*... Fine. If I go get you this sandwich, will you help Willow?
translation: *叹气*……好吧。如果我去给你拿这个三明治，你会帮柳木吗？

english: Of course! Oh, by the way, don't bother with the bartender. Just talk to the chef. Trust me.
translation: 当然！哦，对了，别去找酒保。直接跟厨师说就行。相信我。

english: Alright. I'll be back momentarily with your sandwich.
translation: 好的。我马上带着你的三明治回来。

english: Have you got the sandwich yet?
translation: 你拿到三明治了吗？

english: I'm still working on it. Where did you say you got them from?
translation: 我还在想办法。你说你从哪儿弄来的？

english: The Blue Moon Inn, in Varrock. They have the best cook around!
translation: 维洛克城的蓝月旅馆。那里有这一带最好的厨师！

english: I'll go speak to them, then.
translation: 那我去跟他们谈谈。

english: Hey, Marley sent me in here for a Steak sandwich.
translation: 嘿，马利叫我来这儿拿一份牛排三明治。

english: MARLEY?! Don't talk about that sorry state of a person in this establishment!
translation: 马利？！别在我这儿提那个可怜虫！

english: Woah okay, sorry! Forget I ever mentioned him.
translation: 哇，好吧，抱歉！忘了提过他吧。

english: You'd better clear off before I make you.
translation: 你最好趁我还没动手之前赶紧滚。

english: I was wondering if you'd be able to make me a Steak sandwich?
translation: 我在想你能不能给我做一份牛排三明治？

english: Hmm... we don't get many food orders in 'ere. Last person to order one of them was barred for thievin'.
translation: 嗯……我们这儿很少接到食物订单。上一个点这个的人因为偷东西被赶出去了。

english: Oh... uhm... no. It's for me?
translation: 哦……嗯……不是，是给我的？

english: No... it's for Marley...
translation: 不……是给马利的……

english: I knew it! I'm not making another meal for that thievin' git! Clear off.
translation: 我就知道！我不会再给那个偷东西的混蛋做饭了！滚开。

english: At least tell me why you hate him so much?
translation: 至少告诉我你为什么这么恨他吧？

english: I know what it's like, not knowin' where your next meals going to come from, so I let him eat 'ere for free.
translation: 我知道不知道下一顿饭从哪来的滋味，所以让他在这里免费吃。

english: The minute I turn my back, he's caught red-handed trying to pickpocket one of our patrons. We gave him the boot there 'n' then.
translation: 我一转身，他就被当场抓住，试图扒窃我们的一位顾客。我们当场就把他赶走了。

english: Well, fair enough, but it's just one sandwich. He's not even in Varrock anymore. He's moved off to Edgeville.
translation: 好吧，说得有理，但就一个三明治而已。他现在都不在维洛克城了，搬到边陲镇去了。

english: No chance mate, it's the principle. I won't make food for such a low class criminal...
translation: 没门儿，老兄，这是原则问题。我不会给这种下等罪犯做吃的……

english: Please, I really need Marley's help and he'll only offer it if I get him a Steak sandwich.
translation: 求你了，我真的需要马利的帮助，他只有我给他弄到牛排三明治才肯帮忙。

english: Well, I suppose if I give you the recipe, you can make it yourself.
translation: 好吧，我想如果把食谱给你，你可以自己做。

english: Great! I can't imagine it's that hard to make.
translation: 太棒了！我想这做起来应该不难。

english: Watch your mouth! Making a Steak sandwich is a delicate art!
translation: 说话注意点！做牛排三明治是一门精细的艺术！

english: Sorry! Of course it is. What's the recipe then?
translation: 对不起！当然是的。那食谱是什么？

english: To start, you need to get some prime beef from a cow. The fields around Lumbridge are a great source. Cook it up - medium rare is perfect. Don't cook it for too long or you'll burn it...
translation: 首先，你需要从奶牛身上弄些上等牛肉。仑桥镇周围的田野是个好来源。把它煮熟——三分熟刚刚好。别煮太久，不然会烧焦……

english: Then, you take some bread. I recommend making it fresh, but to each their own. Slice it in half and slide the beautifully cooked beef between the two halves...
translation: 然后，你拿些面包。我推荐用新鲜的，但各有所好。把它切成两半，把精心烹制的牛肉夹在两半之间……

english: And hey presto, you've got yourself a delicious, perfectly made Steak sandwich.
translation: 然后嘿，你就得到了一份美味、制作完美的牛排三明治。

english: Wow... is that it? Some beef between a loaf of bread?
translation: 哇……就这样？一块牛肉夹在面包里？

english: It's harder to make than it sounds! Now get out before I whack you one for being so rude.
translation: 做起来比听起来难多了！现在滚出去，不然我揍你一顿，谁让你这么无礼。

english: I forgot the recipe to make a Steak sandwich.
translation: 我忘了做牛排三明治的食谱了。

english: For Saradomin's sake! Take some bread, cut it in half and stick some cooked Steak inside, done.
translation: 看在萨拉多明的份上！拿些面包，切成两半，把煮熟的牛排塞进去，搞定。

english: Oh yeah, thank you!
translation: 哦对，谢谢！

english: I've managed to make myself a Steak sandwich.
translation: 我成功地给自己做了一份牛排三明治。

english: Let me take a look at it.
translation: 让我看看。

english: Ha ha ha, you call this a sandwich!?
translation: 哈哈哈，你管这叫三明治？！

english: Well, I tried my best...
translation: 呃，我已经尽力了……

english: I'm sure you did. It'll be enough for Marley, anyway.
translation: 我相信你尽力了。反正对马利来说够用了。

english: Hey Marley. I've managed to get your Steak sandwich.
translation: 嘿，马利。我弄到你的牛排三明治了。

english: Ah, just in time for my afternoon snack. Pass it over.
translation: 啊，正好赶上我的下午点心。递过来吧。

english: Aaah... not quite as good as the usual, but it hit the spot.
translation: 啊……虽然没平时做的好，但还算对味。

english: Are you finally done?
translation: 你总算是吃完了？

english: Yes [sir/miss] I am. I'll honour my side of the deal and head off to find Willow.
translation: 是的，[sir/miss]我吃完了。我会履行我的承诺，出发去找柳木。

english: Finally! You can find her on the west side of Ice Mountain.
translation: 终于！你可以在冰山的西边找到她。

english: Excellent! I'll be on my way then.
translation: 太好了！那我就出发了。

english: Marley is certainly an interesting character. Hopefully the next team member is more respectable.
translation: 马利确实是个有趣的家伙。希望下一个队员更体面些。

english: Hello again Marley.
translation: 又见面了，马利。

english: Ah, my new favourite chef. Have you got another sandwich for me?
translation: 啊，我新上任的最爱厨师。你又给我带三明治了？

english: Woah! Alright there, calm down. Was only a joke.
translation: 哇！好吧，冷静点。只是开个玩笑。

english: I don't find being your errand boy very funny.
translation: 我可觉得当你的跑腿一点也不好玩。

english: You need to lighten up a little, my friend.
translation: 你得放松点，我的朋友。

english: That's everyone gathered. Interesting company for an archaeologist to keep...
translation: 所有人都到齐了。一个考古学家结交的伙伴可真有趣……

english: *Shrugs* How many archaeologists do you actually know?
translation: *耸耸肩* 你实际上认识几个考古学家？

english: Well I-
translation: 呃，我——

english: Exactly. So who are you to judge? Anyway, we're all here and ready to break in... Um, I mean excavate... the entrance.
translation: 没错。那你凭什么评判？总之，我们都到齐了，准备闯进去……呃，我是说挖掘……入口。

english: Are you ready? Who knows what's inside the ruins?
translation: 你准备好了吗？谁知道废墟里面有什么？

english: I'm ready as I'll ever be. Let's head in.
translation: 我已经准备好了。我们进去吧。

english: Right, that's everyone gathered. Thank you, [player name], for all your help.
translation: 好了，所有人都到齐了。谢谢你，[player name]，感谢你的所有帮助。

english: Oh it was no pro...
translation: 哦，没什么大不……

english: Okay everyone, we've wasted enough time. Let's crack this door open. Burntof, you're up!
translation: 好了各位，我们浪费够多时间了。把这扇门弄开吧。伯恩托夫，轮到你了！

english: Try not to blow the entire mountain up this time...
translation: 这次别把整座山都炸了……

english: Yesh ma'am, let'sh get this rock out the way.
translation: 是的夫人，让咱把这石头弄开。

english: Jusht got to plashe thish here...
translation: 只要把这玩意儿放这儿……

english: ... little bit of dyn-*hic*-amite here...
translation: ……再放点炸-*呃*-药在这儿……

english: ... and there we go!
translation: ……好了！

english: Now we light the fushe!
translation: 现在咱点火药捻子！

english: What are you doin' standin' there?!
translation: 你站那儿干嘛呢？！

english: Everyone'sh ran for cover [lad/lass]. You'd best do the shame.
translation: 大伙儿都去找掩护了[lad/lass]。你最好也这么做。

english: Wait, what?!
translation: 等等，什么？！

english: Clock'sh ticking [lad/lass]!
translation: 时间不等人了[lad/lass]！

english: Bloomin' 'eck, Burntof!
translation: 天杀的，伯恩托夫！

english: That was a tad too explosive I think.
translation: 我觉得这炸得有点太猛了。

english: My ears are still ringing!
translation: 我的耳朵还在嗡嗡响！

english: Quit yer moanin', it did the job didnae it?
translation: 别抱怨了，它起作用了不是吗？

english: He's right, the rock's been broken up. Checkal, it's your turn.
translation: 他说得对，石头被炸碎了。切卡尔，轮到你了。

english: Of course ma'am, I will get to work.
translation: 当然，夫人，我这就开始干。

english: The work is done, Willow. My apologies if it took too long.
translation: 活干完了，柳木。如果花了太长时间，我表示歉意。

english: Don't be sorry, Checkal. Gotta put those muscles to use somehow.
translation: 别道歉，切卡尔。总得让这些肌肉派上用场。

english: Alright Marley, in you go. Let us know if you find anything.
translation: 好了，马利，你进去吧。发现什么就告诉我们。

english: Right, in I go. Wish me luck [player name].
translation: 好，我进去了。祝我好运吧，[player name]。

english: Try not to die...
translation: 别死在里面……

english: Right, let's see what hidden surprises you have in store for me.
translation: 好，让我看看你给我准备了什么隐藏惊喜。

english: That would have been nasty.
translation: 那可真够险的。

english: Is that it? I thought this place would be better protected.
translation: 就这？我还以为这地方会有更好的防护。

english: Now to disarm it...
translation: 现在把它拆掉……

english: Maybe this will work?
translation: 也许这样能行？

english: That got it!
translation: 搞定了！

english: Alright guys! It's safe to come in! I think...
translation: 好了大伙儿！可以安全进来了！我觉得……

english: Wow, this place is amazing. I can't believe this was hidden away.
translation: 哇，这地方太棒了。真不敢相信这里一直被隐藏着。

english: I wonder how long it's been left untouched for.
translation: 不知道这里多久没被人动过了。

english: You're impressed? There's nothing here but dust and fallen rocks.
translation: 你就这么惊讶？这里除了灰尘和落石什么也没有。

english: Yaaa*hic*aawn
translation: 啊-*呃*-欠

english: You don't find it exciting? As an archaeologist, I thought you would be thrilled at this discovery?
translation: 你不觉得兴奋吗？作为考古学家，我以为你会对这个发现感到激动呢？

english: Thrilled? What's there to be excited about? I don't see any gold, diamonds, rare gems or piles of lost treasure!
translation: 激动？有什么好激动的？我没看到任何金子、钻石、稀有宝石或成堆的失落宝藏！

english: It's not about the money though, right? We've potentially discovered the long lost ruins of an ancient civilisation!
translation: 不过不是为了钱，对吧？我们可能发现了某个远古文明失落已久的废墟！

english: Of course it's about the money. It's always been about money, you fool.
translation: 当然是为了钱。一直都是为了钱，你这傻瓜。

english: I don't understand...
translation: 我不明白……

english: We're not a team of archaeologist, you idiot. We're grave robbers looking for their next score.
translation: 我们不是考古队，你这个白痴。我们是寻找下一个目标的盗墓贼。

english: Theshe markings look familiar...
translation: 这些标记看着眼熟……

english: So this entire time, you've just been using me to help break into these ruins in hopes of finding someone else's treasures.
translation: 所以自始至终，你只是在利用我帮你闯入这些废墟，希望能找到别人的宝藏。

english: Yep, and you were surprisingly easy to convince. I'll admit, you have been a tremendous help, [player name].
translation: 没错，而且你出乎意料地好骗。我承认，你帮了大忙，[player name]。

english: But your usefulness has come to an end I'm afraid. I can't simply let you leave here.
translation: 但恐怕你的用处已经到头了。我不能就这么让你离开这里。

english: I can't risk you running to the authorities and telling them about our little gang. We're wanted in quite a few large cities across Gielinor.
translation: 我不能冒风险让你跑去当局告发我们这个小团伙。我们在吉里诺的不少大城市都有通缉令。

english: I've sheen thish before...
translation: 我以前见过这个……

english: I'm afraid this is the end of the road for you, [player name]. This ruin is about to become your tomb.
translation: 恐怕你的路就走到这儿了，[player name]。这废墟就要成为你的坟墓了。

english: *hic* Woops...
translation: *嗝* 哎呀……

english: What was that noise?
translation: 那是什么声音？

english: Uh... it wasn't me!
translation: 呃……不是我干的！

english: Whats happening?!
translation: 发生什么事了？！

english: It feels like the quaking has finally stopped...
translation: 感觉震动终于停了……

english: Holy Zamorak! What is that thing?! Checkal, take it down!
translation: 萨莫拉克在上！那是什么东西？！切卡尔，干掉它！

english: I'm a muscle man, not a fighter.
translation: 我是肌肉男，不是战士。

english: I think we should get out of here, Willow!
translation: 我觉得我们该离开这里了，柳木！

english: You're right, Marley. Burntof, we're leaving!
translation: 你说得对，马利。伯恩托夫，我们走！

english: I can't believe they ran so quickly. I suppose I should take care of this thing.
translation: 真不敢相信他们跑得这么快。看来我得亲自对付这玩意儿了。

english: I need a little bit more time to prepare.
translation: 我还需要一点时间准备。

english: Hurry up then! We've waited long enough.
translation: 那就快点！我们已经等得够久了。

english: Are you finally ready to crack these ruins open?
translation: 你终于准备好打开这些废墟了吗？

english: That monster showed up at the perfect time. I would have been toast if Willow and her gang had their chance to attack.
translation: 那个怪物出现得正是时候。要是柳木和她的同伙有机会攻击，我就完蛋了。

english: Speaking of which, maybe they left something behind I can salvage some kind of reward from.
translation: 说到这个，也许她们留下了什么东西，我可以从中捞点奖励。

english: Looks like Willow left a bag behind. Maybe there's something in it I could take.
translation: 看起来柳木落了个包。里面也许有我能拿的东西。

english: Those will do nicely!
translation: 这些正好合用！

english: What was that noise? Please don't be another rock monster...
translation: 那是什么声音？拜托别再是石头怪物了……

english: What the!
translation: 什么情况！

english: Bless my beard...
translation: 我的胡子啊……

english: Wow. I honestly didn't expect to see a dwarf in these ruins.
translation: 哇。说实话，我真没想到会在这些废墟里见到一个矮人。

english: I can't believe it...
translation: 真不敢相信……

english: Yeah, exactly.
translation: 是啊，没错。

english: It's been so long since I've heard another person's voice.
translation: 我已经很久没听到别人的声音了。

english: How did you find me?
translation: 你是怎么找到我的？

english: To be honest, it was all a bit of an accident.
translation: 说实话，这完全是个意外。

english: There was a gang of... well, I thought were archaeologists, but it turned out they were grave robbers.
translation: 有一帮……嗯，我以为是考古学家，结果发现他们是盗墓贼。

english: I helped them clear the entrance to these ruins and we worked our way inside, only to wake up a monster! They ran off and left me to defeat it.
translation: 我帮他们清开了这些废墟的入口，我们一路深入，结果吵醒了一只怪物！他们全跑了，留下我一个人对付它。

english: That wasn't a monster...
translation: 那不是怪物……

english: Well it looked menacing enough!
translation: 但它看起来够吓人的！

english: That was one of the guardians of this once great city.
translation: 那是这座昔日伟大城市的守护者之一。

english: City?
translation: 城市？

english: Yes! Camdozaal, home of the Imcando Dwarves.
translation: 没错！卡姆多扎尔，伊姆坎多矮人的家园。

english: These halls once bustled with life, but that was a long time ago. I'm the only one left now. The name's Ramarno.
translation: 这些大厅曾经热闹非凡，但那都是很久以前的事了。现在只剩下我一个了。我叫拉马诺。

english: Well Ramarno, I'm [player name], and you have me at a loss for words! I'd have never even imagined there would be a whole city down here.
translation: 拉马诺，我是[player name]，你让我惊讶得说不出话来！我根本没想到这下面会有一座完整的城市。

english: Not much of a city anymore, I suppose.
translation: 我想现在也算不上什么城市了。

english: I guess I didn't help with that. Sorry about breaking into your home and killing your guardian.
translation: 我想我对此也没帮上什么忙。抱歉闯进你家还杀了你的守护者。

english: We have plenty more. No real harm done. That said, I do think I might have a way for you to make up for it. There'll likely be something in it for you as well.
translation: 我们还有很多。没什么大碍。不过，我倒是有个办法让你将功补过。对你来说应该也有好处。

english: My workshop is just north of here. Meet me there and we'll talk further.
translation: 我的工作室就在北边。到那里找我，我们再详谈。

english: Please do not let this incident divert you from your path of becoming a [strongman/strongwoman]! I truly believe in you.
translation: 请不要让这件事影响你成为[strongman/strongwoman]的道路！我真心相信你。

english: Oh... I seem to have misplaced it. Sorry about that. If you come back later, I might have found it.
translation: 哦……我好像把它放错地方了。抱歉。如果你晚点回来，我可能已经找到了。

english: Oh it's fantastic! However, before we go into the details, you should make some room to carry it.
translation: 哦，太棒了！不过在细说之前，你得腾出点空间来装它。

english: Make some room? But I've not even decided if I want this... whatever it is.
translation: 腾出空间？可我还没决定要不要这东西……不管它是什么。

english: I just know that once you see it, you'll want it!
translation: 我就知道，你一见就会想要的！

english: Okay... I'll be back soon then.
translation: 好吧……那我很快回来。

english: Okay, let's have a look.
translation: 行，让我瞧瞧。

english: A ring?
translation: 一枚戒指？

english: Isn't it wonderful! Here, try it on!
translation: 是不是很漂亮！来，戴上试试！

english: Ah, it seems the ring is too small. Never mind.
translation: 啊，这戒指好像太小了。算了。

english: Wait... what?
translation: 等等……什么？

english: Well, time for me to get on with my work. Come back soon.
translation: 好了，我该继续工作了。早点回来。

english: Thanks for the offer, but I'll pass.
translation: 谢谢你的好意，但我就算了。

english: Oh, I see. Well come back if you change your mind.
translation: 哦，我明白了。那你改主意了再回来吧。

english: Hello there. Looking to buy some of my wares?
translation: 你好啊。想买点我的货物吗？

english: About that special item...
translation: 关于那件特别的东西……

english: Oh I think you're going to love it!
translation: 哦，我觉得你一定会喜欢的！

english: Yes, I'm sorry the ring didn't fit. Still, nothing lost and nothing gained, right?
translation: 是啊，很抱歉戒指不合尺寸。不过，有失才有得，对吧？

english: Maybe I should try it on again.
translation: 也许该再试一次。

english: Well, I suppose you can. But first, you should make some room to carry it.
translation: 好吧，我想可以。但首先，你得腾出点空间来装它。

english: Still too small I'm afraid. Now, it's time for me to get on with my work. Come back soon.
translation: 恐怕还是太小了。好了，我该继续工作了。早点回来。

english: But what about...
translation: 可是……

english: Sorry, but I have a lot to do. Come back soon.
translation: 抱歉，我还有很多事要做。早点回来。

english: Good, you made it.
translation: 好，你赶到了。

english: I know you! You're Maisa, that spy from Al Kharid. But you're meant to be in Menaphos!
translation: 我认识你！你是麦莎，阿尔卡里德城的那个间谍。可你应该在莫纳菲斯才对！

english: I told Osman I was done with that posting, and I meant it.
translation: 我跟奥斯曼说过我不再干那份差事了，我说到做到。

english: But how did you get out of the city?
translation: 可你是怎么出城的？

english: The same way I helped those citizens of yours. Even with the quarantine, Menaphos are still sending their dead to Sophanem.
translation: 和我帮你那些市民的办法一样。就算有隔离，莫纳菲斯人还是把死者送到索法尼恩城。

english: So you hid yourself among them? I see. Why are you out here though? And why did you send me that message?
translation: 所以你混在他们中间？明白了。可你为什么在这外面？又为什么给我送那个消息？

english: Because there's something very strange going on. I intend to work out what, but I need your help.
translation: 因为这里发生了非常奇怪的事。我打算弄清楚怎么回事，但需要你的帮助。

english: My list of allies grows shorter every day, but you actually seem to care about what's happening out here. You also seem to know what you're doing.
translation: 我的盟友名单每天都在变短，但你似乎真的关心外面发生的事。而且你看起来也清楚自己在做什么。

english: Brave of you to assume that I ever actually know what I'm doing.
translation: 你真有胆量，居然以为我真的清楚自己在做什么。

english: Well I'm sure you can't be worse than Osman. You might even have the guts to take some action if needed.
translation: 好吧，我相信你不会比奥斯曼更差。必要时你甚至可能有胆量采取行动。

english: Right... so what are these strange happenings?
translation: 好吧……那这些奇怪的事情是什么？

english: Citizens from Menaphos have been disappearing. Guards as well. They've been leaving the city, despite the quarantine.
translation: 莫纳菲斯的市民一直在失踪。守卫也是。他们不顾隔离，一直在离开城市。

english: They've been bypassing the quarantine? How?
translation: 他们绕过了隔离？怎么做到的？

english: No idea, but I have managed to find out where they've been going.
translation: 不知道，但我已经查出了他们去了哪里。

english: South of here, to the old necropolis. They're excavating something there, but I don't know what. There's also something strange going on with them.
translation: 从这里往南，到古老的墓地。他们在那里挖掘什么东西，但我不知道是什么。他们身上也有点不对劲。

english: I went to this excavation of theirs to have a look around, and the way they're acting is very unusual. It's like nothing I've seen before.
translation: 我去他们的挖掘现场看了看，他们的行为非常反常。我以前从未见过这种情形。

english: Interesting. I think I need to see this for myself.
translation: 有意思。我觉得我得亲眼去看看。

english: Well let me know when you're ready, and I'll take you down there.
translation: 那准备好了告诉我，我带你下去。

english: Let's go.
translation: 走吧。

english: Look at them! How long have they been doing this?
translation: 看他们！他们这样持续多久了？

english: I'm not sure, but they're at it both day and night.
translation: 不确定，但他们日夜不停。

english: So they never rest?
translation: 所以他们从不休息？

english: Doesn't seem so.
translation: 似乎没有。

english: How weird. Can we get a closer look?
translation: 真诡异。我们能靠近看看吗？

english: Should be able to. When I came to investigate before, I was able to walk right up to them. They didn't even seem to care. It was like they were in some sort of trance.
translation: 应该可以。我之前来调查时，能直接走到他们面前。他们甚至毫不在意。就像陷入了某种恍惚状态。

english: I'm going to have a look around.
translation: 我去周围看看。

english: I'll keep watch here. Try to keep a low profile.
translation: 我在这儿望风。尽量低调点。

english: I'll try, but low profile isn't really one of my specialties.
translation: 我尽量，但低调不是我的专长。

english: Oh good. I'll prepare for violence then.
translation: 哦，那好。那我就准备动武了。

english: Well don't take too long!
translation: 别太久！

english: What are these strange happenings you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的那些奇怪的事是什么？

english: Ready to go and investigate the excavation?
translation: 准备好去调查那个挖掘现场了吗？

english: I'm still looking.
translation: 我还在看。

english: Be careful. There's something creepy about all of this.
translation: 小心点。这一切都有点瘆人。

english: Interesting. I'd better report back to Maisa.
translation: 有意思。我最好回去向麦莎报告。

english: The work must be completed...
translation: 工作必须完成……

english: Hmm... this seems familiar...
translation: 嗯……这似乎很熟悉……

english: Hmm... this seems familiar... I'd better report back to Maisa.
translation: 嗯……这似乎很熟悉……我最好回去向麦莎报告。

english: You should not be here...
translation: 你不该在这里……

english: The work cannot be disturbed... the mistress commands it...
translation: 工作不容打扰……女主人命令如此……

english: Mistress? You mean the Devourer! This is all her doing, isn't it? I'd recognise her work anywhere.
translation: 女主人？你说的是吞噬者！这一切都是她干的，对吧？我到哪里都能认出她的把戏。

english: You know too much... you must be removed...
translation: 你知道得太多了……必须除掉你……

english: Looks like you need a hand.
translation: 看来你需要帮手。

english: Die...
translation: 去死……

english: Your false gods will not protect you!
translation: 你的假神保护不了你！

english: Come on. We'd better get back down there.
translation: 来吧。我们最好回到下面去。

english: Nice job keeping things low profile.
translation: 保持低调，干得漂亮。

english: To be fair, I did warn you.
translation: 说句公道话，我警告过你。

english: I suppose. Were you able to discover anything?
translation: 算是吧。你发现什么了吗？

english: Sort of. I still don't know why these people are here, but I do know who sent them.
translation: 算是吧。我仍然不知道这些人为什么在这，但我知道是谁派他们来的。

english: Amascut, the Devourer.
translation: 阿玛斯库特，吞噬者。

english: What? The goddess? You're joking!
translation: 什么？那位女神？你在开玩笑吧！

english: You don't believe me?
translation: 你不相信我？

english: It's just quite the claim. How do you know it's her?
translation: 这说法可够大的。你怎么知道是她？

english: She has hypnotic powers. She's the one that put them in this trance! I know it better than most. I was unlucky enough to experience it myself back in Sophanem.
translation: 她有催眠能力。就是她把这些人弄成这种恍惚状态的！我比大多数人更清楚这一点。我以前在索法尼恩城不幸亲身经历过。

english: Perhaps this one can give us something more to go on.
translation: 也许这个能给我们更多线索。

english: What's happening? Help me...
translation: 发生什么了？救救我……

english: You were hypnotised, but you're free now. Do you remember anything about what happened to you?
translation: 你被催眠了，但现在自由了。你还记得自己经历了什么吗？

english: It's all so unclear... I can't remember...
translation: 一切都很模糊……我想不起来了……

english: I know what you're going through. Try to think back to before you were hypnotised. What's the last thing you remember?
translation: 我明白你的感受。试着回想你被催眠之前的事。你记得的最后一件事是什么？

english: We were told we had an audience with Pharaoh Kemesis, but when we arrived at the palace he wasn't there. It was just this woman.
translation: 我们被告知要觐见法老凯米西斯，但当我们到达宫殿时，他不在那里。只有那个女人。

english: What woman?
translation: 什么女人？

english: I don't know. I just remember her eyes, her deep red eyes...
translation: 我不知道。我只记得她的眼睛，她那双深红色的眼睛……

english: That's Amascut alright.
translation: 那肯定是阿玛斯库特。

english: Do you remember anything after that?
translation: 在那之后你还记得什么吗？

english: We came here to find something... I think. A tomb! We unblocked the entrance, and she went inside. There were others with her.
translation: 我们来这里是为了找什么东西……我想。一个墓穴！我们打开了入口，她走了进去。还有其他人跟她在一起。

english: What does she want from the tomb?
translation: 她想从墓穴里得到什么？

english: I don't know... We never saw the inside. The entrance collapsed again after she went in.
translation: 我不知道……我们从未见过里面。她进去后入口又塌了。

english: That's okay. You've been a great help.
translation: 没关系。你已经帮了大忙了。

english: Wait! I remember one more thing... there were these monsters helping her! They walked like humans, but they had the heads of insects!
translation: 等等！我还记得一件事……有一些怪物在帮她！它们像人一样走路，但长着昆虫的头！

english: That sounds like those scarab creatures from the tunnels below Sophanem.
translation: 听起来像是索法尼恩城下面隧道里的那些圣甲虫生物。

english: Scabarites! Do you know where they came from?
translation: 圣甲虫教徒！你知道它们是从哪里来的吗？

english: Some ruins... To the north east...
translation: 一些废墟……在东北方向……

english: I think that's all we're learning from this one. I'll get him some medical attention. Meet me back at my camp.
translation: 我想我们从这个家伙身上只能得到这么多信息了。我去给他找点医疗帮助。在我的营地碰头吧。

english: The work must be completed... the mistress commands it...
translation: 工作必须完成……女主人命令的……

english: So that was... interesting. A hypnotising goddess wasn't quite what I expected.
translation: 所以……还挺有意思的。一个会催眠的女神，真没想到。

english: You sound like you still don't believe me.
translation: 听上去你还是不相信我。

english: You have to admit, it's a lot to take in. Still, I guess it doesn't change our next steps.
translation: 你得承认，这信息量挺大的。不过，我想这并不改变我们下一步的计划。

english: And what are they?
translation: 那计划是什么？

english: That guard gave us two leads to look into. Hopefully one of them will give us some answers as to what's so important about that tomb.
translation: 那个守卫给了我们两条线索去调查。希望其中一条能告诉我们那个墓穴里到底有什么重要的东西。

english: Should we reach out to Osman about this?
translation: 我们是不是该把这事告诉奥斯曼？

english: Osman? Why? That man won't be of any help. He'd have happily left me to rot in Menaphos, just like how he sent Kaleef to his death!
translation: 奥斯曼？为什么？那个人一点忙都帮不上。他当初乐得把我丢在美南波斯自生自灭，就像他把卡利夫送去送死一样！

english: Kaleef? He was the spy that was meant to relieve you, right? I thought you didn't even know him?
translation: 卡利夫？他就是那个本该来接替你的间谍，对吧？我以为你根本不认识他？

english: What? Oh, right.
translation: 什么？哦，对。

english: Look, we don't need Osman. We can handle this ourselves.
translation: 听着，我们不需要奥斯曼。我们自己能搞定。

english: Fair enough... so what are our leads?
translation: 有道理……那我们的线索是什么？

english: First up we have Kemesis, Pharaoh of Menaphos.
translation: 首先，是美南波斯的法老凯米西斯。

english: What do you know about him?
translation: 你对他了解多少？

english: Truth be told, not a lot. He's probably the most powerful man in the Kharidian Desert, but he's incredibly reclusive. He's rarely seen in public.
translation: 老实说，不多。他大概是卡里迪安沙漠里最有权势的人，但他极其隐居。很少在公共场合露面。

english: If he's under Amascut's control, that could be a big problem. Do you know how we could get to him?
translation: 如果他受阿玛斯库特控制，那问题就大了。你知道我们怎么才能接近他吗？

english: Even without the quarantine, it would be incredibly difficult. His palace is a fortress.
translation: 就算没有隔离，也极其困难。他的宫殿就是一座堡垒。

english: That doesn't sound hopeful.
translation: 听起来没什么希望。

english: It isn't. While there may be ways out of Menaphos, I don't know of any way back in again, let alone a way into the Pharaoh's own palace.
translation: 确实没有。虽然可能有办法离开美南波斯，但我知道的任何办法都无法再回去，更别提进入法老本人的宫殿了。

english: We'll leave that lead for now then. What about the other one?
translation: 那我们先把这条线索放一放。另一条呢？

english: The guard mentioned some scabarites. Perhaps we can learn something from them. He said they came from some ruins north east of the necropolis.
translation: 那个守卫提到了圣甲虫教徒。也许我们能从他们那里得到些信息。他说他们来自大墓地东北方向的某个废墟。

english: That would put the ruins directly east of here. All I see are cliffs.
translation: 那废墟就在正东方向。可我看到的全是悬崖。

english: Maybe there's something on the other side of them?
translation: 也许悬崖另一边有什么东西？

english: Could be worth exploring, I guess.
translation: 我想值得去探索一下。

english: Right, so we have our leads. One seems impossible to follow, but the other might have some promise. While I think about how we can access Menaphos, do you want to look into these ruins?
translation: 好，我们有线索了。一条似乎无法追踪，但另一条可能有希望。我在考虑如何进入美南波斯的同时，你想不想去调查一下那些废墟？

english: Sure, but where do you even plan to start?
translation: 当然，但你打算从哪里开始？

english: If we're ever going to get close to the Pharaoh, the Menaphos quarantine has to end. Kemesis himself has made it clear that will only happen when the plagues in Sophanem are eradicated.
translation: 要想接近法老，美南波斯的隔离必须解除。凯米西斯本人明确表示，只有索法尼恩城的瘟疫被根除，隔离才会结束。

english: From what I hear, they've managed to deal with most of them now. That just leaves the pox they're all infected with.
translation: 据我所知，他们现在已经处理了大部分瘟疫。就只剩下他们感染的波克斯病还没解决。

english: So what, you're going to cure the pox?
translation: 所以，你打算治愈波克斯病？

english: Surely if it were that simple, the High Priest would have done it by now.
translation: 如果真那么简单的话，大祭司早就做了。

english: Have you met that man? He can try to present himself as a wise leader all he wants, but it's just a facade. The lizards around here have bigger brains than him, and that's probably still an insult to the lizards.
translation: 你见过那个人吗？他再怎么装成英明的领袖，也不过是装模作样。这附近的蜥蜴都比他聪明，这么说恐怕还是侮辱了蜥蜴。

english: He didn't even have the guts to get rid of the plagued animals. The guards had to put them down themselves. And it's not like they can do that to the citizens!
translation: 他甚至没有胆量处理那些染病的动物。守卫们不得不亲自动手解决它们。他们又不能对市民这么做！

english: Well, they could. But I imagine that would be considered quite rude.
translation: 嗯，他们是可以，但我想那样会很没礼貌。

english: Anyway, I reckon I might have a chance of succeeding where the High Priest failed. I have an old friend in Nardah named Zahur. She's a herbalist. I think she might be able to help.
translation: 不管怎样，我觉得我或许能在大祭司失败的地方取得成功。我在那尔达城有个老朋友叫扎胡尔。她是个草药师。我想她也许能帮上忙。

english: While I go and visit her, you see if you can find these ruins. Remember, they should be just east of here. Meet me in Nardah once you have something.
translation: 我去拜访她的时候，你去看看能不能找到那些废墟。记住，它们应该就在东边。找到什么线索后，在那尔达城和我碰头。

english: Alright, good luck.
translation: 好，祝你好运。

english: So what are these leads you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的那些线索是什么？

english: Hello! You must be the scabarites I'm looking for.
translation: 你好！你肯定就是我要找的圣甲虫教徒吧。

english: I'm guessing you're going to try and kill me now?
translation: 我猜你现在打算杀了我？

english: I'll take the silence as a yes...
translation: 我把沉默当成是同意了……

english: I need to get into your father's tomb and stop Amascut.
translation: 我需要进入你父亲的墓穴，阻止阿玛斯库特。

english: Hello again. How do I access the upper chamber?
translation: 又见面了。我该怎么进入上层密室？

english: You will find a key in an urn at the back of this room. May Scabaras guide you to success.
translation: 你会在房间后面的一个瓮里找到一把钥匙。愿斯卡巴拉斯指引你走向成功。

english: Intruder! You are not welcome here!
translation: 闯入者！这里不欢迎你！

english: Fear not! I am here to rescue you!
translation: 别怕！我是来救你的！

english: Kill him!
translation: 杀了他！

english: Wait! Majaan, Manand...
translation: 等等！马贾安，马南德……

english: Silence! Champion, protect your High Priest!
translation: 住口！冠军，保护你的大祭司！

english: Fine. We'll do it your way.
translation: 好吧。那就按你的方式来。

english: Have you freed the High Priest of Scabaras yet?
translation: 你释放斯卡巴拉斯大祭司了吗？

english: You should do so soon.
translation: 你应该尽快这么做。

english: Stay back!
translation: 退后！

english: Majaan, Manand, Almuk.
translation: 马贾安，马南德，阿尔穆克。

english: What... What happened?
translation: 什么……发生了什么？

english: It's alright. You were being controlled by Amascut, but you're free now.
translation: 没事了。你之前被阿玛斯库特控制了，但现在你自由了。

english: I... I don't remember.
translation: 我……我不记得了。

english: I've been in your position. Don't worry, your memories will come back in time. Familiar places and objects can help them come back faster.
translation: 我经历过你这种情况。别担心，你的记忆会慢慢恢复的。熟悉的地方和物体能帮助记忆更快恢复。

english: This room is familiar... as I look around, I feel something stirring...
translation: 这个房间很熟悉……环顾四周，我感觉有些东西在苏醒……

english: Yes, I can see it now! There are a few gaps, but it's all coming back to me. Thank you, adventurer.
translation: 是的，我现在想起来了！虽然还有些空白，但基本上都记起来了。谢谢你，冒险者。

english: There is much for me to set right. We have made some terrible mistakes.
translation: 我有很多事要弥补。我们犯了一些可怕的错误。

english: I know the feeling. What did she have you do?
translation: 我懂这种感觉。她让你做了什么？

english: Many things. I have been under her control my whole life. It was the same for my predecessor, and her predecessor as well. We were all slaves to the Devourer, even our lord himself.
translation: 很多事。我一生都受她控制。我的前任，以及她的前任也是如此。我们都是吞噬者的奴隶，就连我们的主上也不例外。

english: She controls Scabaras?
translation: 她控制了斯卡巴拉斯？

english: Yes. She used him as her puppet for centuries, but now she has a new plan for him.
translation: 是的。几个世纪以来，她一直把他当傀儡使用，但现在她对他有了新的计划。

english: What new plan?
translation: 什么新计划？

english: I don't know. She took him into some tomb, along with the others.
translation: 我不知道。她把他带进了某个墓穴，还有其他几个。

english: Osmumten's tomb. Who are these others you speak of?
translation: 奥斯穆腾的墓穴。你说的其他人是谁？

english: Apmeken, Crondis and Het. The other avatars of Tumeken.
translation: 阿普梅肯、克伦迪斯和赫特。图梅肯的其他化身。

english: She has them all?
translation: 她把他们全抓住了？

english: She does. We helped her capture them. It took many lifetimes, but she was able to fool them all.
translation: 是的。我们帮她抓住了他们。花了无数代人的时间，但她成功愚弄了他们所有人。

english: This isn't good. There're weapons in that tomb that can transfer divine power between beings. She must be planning to use them on the lesser deities.
translation: 这可不好。那个墓穴里有可以转移神力的武器。她肯定打算对那些次级神祇使用这些武器。

english: The four of them all came from Tumeken himself. Their power is his power. If she claims that power as her own, she will become a true goddess...
translation: 这四位都源自图梅肯本身。他们的力量就是他的力量。如果她将那股力量据为己有，她将成为真正的女神……

english: Don't worry, I'll make sure that doesn't happen.
translation: 别担心，我不会让这种事发生的。

english: How can you hope to withstand her power?
translation: 你凭什么希望能抵挡住她的力量？

english: I'll find a way. Do you have any other information that can help me?
translation: 我会找到办法的。你还有其他能帮助我的信息吗？

english: We were not the only ones to fall to the Devourer. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis of Menaphos.
translation: 我们不是唯一屈服于吞噬者的人。她还控制了美南波斯的法老凯米西斯。

english: We feared as much. Do you know what she wants with him?
translation: 我们也担心过这种情况。你知道她对他有什么企图吗？

english: She needed control over the city, but she kept the reason a secret. She even had us release locusts and frogs into Sophanem so she could have Menaphos locked down.
translation: 她需要控制这座城市，但将原因保密。她甚至让我们在索法尼恩城释放蝗虫和青蛙，以便封锁美南波斯。

english: You caused the plagues? The cows and the pox as well?
translation: 你们引发了瘟疫？奶牛和波克斯病也是你们干的？

english: We did also poison the cows. I know nothing of this pox, though.
translation: 奶牛确实是我们毒死的。不过对波克斯病我一无所知。

english: Hmm... what will you do now?
translation: 嗯……你现在打算做什么？

english: I fear many of my people are forever lost, but I will save as many as I can. Together, we will reform the Sect of Scabaras, and right the wrongs of the Devourer.
translation: 恐怕我的许多族人都永远迷失了，但我会尽可能拯救更多的人。我们一起重建斯卡巴拉斯教派，纠正吞噬者造成的错误。

english: So you'll help me fight her?
translation: 所以你会帮我对抗她？

english: In our own way. Before the Devourer, we were an isolated people, just as Scabaras taught us to be. We will go back to that way of life.
translation: 以我们自己的方式。在吞噬者出现之前，我们是一个与世隔绝的民族，正如斯卡巴拉斯教导我们的那样。我们将回归那种生活方式。

english: We may go unseen, but we will be there, fighting the forces of the Devourer wherever they appear.
translation: 我们也许不为人所见，但我们会一直在那里，与吞噬者的势力战斗，无论他们出现在哪里。

english: Good to hear. Now, I'd better head over to Nardah. I have a friend there who needs to hear about all of this.
translation: 那就好。现在我得去一趟那尔达城了。我有个朋友在那里，需要知道这一切。

english: Good luck in your fight, adventurer. May Scabaras guide you.
translation: 祝你在战斗中好运，冒险者。愿斯卡巴拉斯指引你。

english: Do you have any other information about Amascut that could help me?
translation: 你还有其他关于阿玛斯库特的信息能帮到我吗？

english: That was my hope, but while the High Priest is free, many scabarites have been lost to the Devourer. I sense that they will soon descend on my tomb, hoping to reclaim it.
translation: 那正是我所希望的，但既然大祭司自由了，许多斯卡巴拉斯信徒已被吞噬者夺走。我感觉到他们很快就会降临我的陵墓，企图夺回它。

english: Ah, there you are. Any luck in those ruins?
translation: 啊，你来了。那些废墟里有收获吗？

english: Plenty. I discovered all sorts of things. How about you?
translation: 收获颇丰。我发现了各种各样的东西。你呢？

english: I filled Zahur in on our discoveries and obtained a blood sample from one of Sophanem's citizens for her. Don't ask me how. She's looked over it, and thinks the pox should be easily curable.
translation: 我把我们的发现告诉了扎胡尔，还从索法尼恩城的一个居民那里弄了一份血样给她。别问我怎么弄到的。她检查过了，认为波克斯应该很容易治愈。

english: Yes, it's a very interesting one this. Do you know of the cadava bush?
translation: 是的，这个很有意思。你知道卡达瓦灌木吗？

english: Yes! One time I used some to help this young couple. I gave one of them a cadava potion to appear dead.
translation: 知道！有一次我用它帮了一对年轻情侣。我给了其中一人一瓶卡达瓦药水，让他看起来像死了一样。

english: It all went a bit wrong though, and he ended up with her cousin instead...
translation: 不过事情有点搞砸了，他最后和她的表妹在一起了……

english: Oh, and I used one another time when I was helping My Arm!
translation: 哦，还有一次我帮'我的手臂'时也用了一瓶！

english: You were helping your arm? I'm not sure I need to know about your private life...
translation: 你在帮你的手臂？我不确定我想知道你的私生活……

english: No, not my arm. My Arm! He's a troll! He needed to kill an old man, so we used a potion to fake it.
translation: 不，不是我的手臂。是'我的手臂'！他是个巨魔！他需要杀一个老人，所以我们用药水来伪造。

english: It all went a bit wrong though... again. That seems to happen quite often for some reason...
translation: 不过事情又有点搞砸了……又是这样。不知道为什么，这种事好像经常发生……

english: What on Gielinor are you on about?
translation: 你在说些什么啊？

english: Maybe we should get back to what I was saying...
translation: 也许我们该回到我刚才说的话题……

english: As most people know, cadava berries are quite poisonous. When used in the right quantity, they can put someone into a deep sleep. Use the wrong amount...
translation: 大多数人都知道，卡达瓦莓毒性很强。用量得当，可以让人陷入深度睡眠。用量不对……

english: ... and you're not going to be waking up again. Cadava potions are standard issue for Al Kharid spies for that very reason. In fact, they're what I used to get myself and those citizens out of Menaphos.
translation: ……而且你不会再醒过来了。卡达瓦药水正是阿尔卡里德城间谍的标准配备。事实上，我就是用它把自己和那些市民带出索法尼恩城的。

english: Well, the thing about cadava berries is that they're not the only part of the bush that's dangerous. If you're not careful, the bark can have quite a nasty effect on the skin.
translation: 嗯，关于卡达瓦莓，有一点是：它们并不是灌木上唯一危险的部分。如果不小心，树皮会对皮肤产生很糟糕的影响。

english: Like the spots from the pox! Are you saying that's what caused all the trouble? A rogue cadava bush?
translation: 就像波克斯的斑点！你是说那就是所有麻烦的根源？一株盗贼卡达瓦灌木？

english: Maybe, but you won't find any of those bushes this far south. It's quite unexpected. I don't think anyone in Sophanem would even recognise cadava bark, let alone figure out it caused the pox.
translation: 也许吧，但你在这么南边的地方找不到那种灌木。这很出乎意料。我觉得索法尼恩城里没人能认出卡达瓦树皮，更别说搞清楚它引起了波克斯。

english: To be honest, I probably wouldn't have suspected it myself either. I only realised because of the time I spent training with the Apothecary in Varrock.
translation: 说实话，我自己可能也不会怀疑到它。我之所以意识到，是因为我在维洛克城和药剂师一起训练的那段时间。

english: It sounds like someone could have caused the pox on purpose.
translation: 听起来像是有人故意制造了波克斯。

english: Well that leads on to what I discovered in those ruins. I found the High Priest of Scabaras there, under Amascut's control. Turns out she had him and the scabarites cause the plagues in Sophanem.
translation: 嗯，这就要说到我在那些废墟里的发现了。我在那里找到了斯卡巴拉斯大祭司，他受阿玛斯库特控制。原来是她指使他和斯卡巴拉斯信徒在索法尼恩城制造了瘟疫。

english: They caused the plagues? Why?
translation: 他们制造了瘟疫？为什么？

english: Amascut wanted an excuse to have Menaphos locked down. She's up to something there, but the High Priest of Scabaras didn't know what. However, he did confirm that Pharaoh Kemesis is under her control as well.
translation: 阿玛斯库特想找个借口封锁美纳菲斯城。她在那里有所图谋，但斯卡巴拉斯大祭司不知道是什么。不过，他确实证实了法老凯米西斯也在她的控制之下。

english: The thing is, now that I think about it, the High Priest of Scabaras didn't actually seem to be aware of the pox. I doubt he'd have been able to get hold of cadava bark either.
translation: 问题是，现在回想起来，斯卡巴拉斯大祭司似乎并不知道波克斯的事。我怀疑他也没办法弄到卡达瓦树皮。

english: So there's other forces at play. That's not good. What else did you find out?
translation: 所以还有其他势力在作祟。这可不好。你还发现了什么？

english: The next bit is worse, I'm afraid. I found out what Amascut is looking for in that tomb. Apparently, there are two weapons in there that could grant her true godhood.
translation: 恐怕接下来更糟。我发现阿玛斯库特在那座陵墓里找什么。显然，里面有两件武器，可以让她获得真正的神性。

english: True godhood? You can't be serious!
translation: 真正的神性？你不是认真的吧！

english: I'm afraid so. She's managed to capture all four of the lesser gods. It's likely that her plan is to use the weapons to claim their power.
translation: 恐怕是的。她已经成功捕获了所有四位次级神。她的计划很可能是利用这些武器来夺取他们的力量。

english: The lesser gods? It can't be!
translation: 次级神？不可能！

english: Are you really sure about all of this?
translation: 你确定这一切都是真的吗？

english: Do not doubt the will of the Devourer, Maisa. She is a force of pure evil.
translation: 不要怀疑吞噬者的意志，麦莎。她是一股纯粹的邪恶力量。

english: It wasn't that long ago that I didn't even think she was still around. Now I'm hearing she's trying to become a true goddess! It's a lot to get used to.
translation: 就在不久前，我甚至以为她早已不在了。现在却听说她正试图成为真正的女神！这真让人难以接受。

english: I do have one bit of good news. I know an incantation that can free a person from her mind control. We can use it to free the people at the necropolis.
translation: 我确实有个好消息。我知道一个咒语，可以让人摆脱她的精神控制。我们可以用它来解放大墓地的人们。

english: Right, well we'd better get to work then. First, let's finish off this cure. Once that's done, we can free the citizens.
translation: 好，那我们最好开始行动吧。首先，完成这个解药。等解药做好，我们就可以解放市民了。

english: Anything you need me to do?
translation: 需要我做什么吗？

english: Maisa has already obtained most of what I need. All that's left now is some scarab venom and a Lily of the Elid.
translation: 麦莎已经弄到了我需要的大部分东西。现在只差一些圣甲虫毒液和一朵埃利河百合了。

english: Okay, let's split up. I'll get the scarab venom.
translation: 好，我们分头行动。我去弄圣甲虫毒液。

english: And I guess that leaves the Lily of the Elid for me. From the name, I assume they grow near the river?
translation: 那看来埃利河百合就归我了。从名字来看，我猜它们长在河边？

english: That's right. I know of a small island just west of here where you can find some.
translation: 没错。我知道西边有个小岛，那里能找到一些。

english: Alright, I'll be back soon.
translation: 好，我很快就回来。

english: As will I.
translation: 我也是。

english: So what did you find in those ruins?
translation: 那么你在那些废墟里发现了什么？

english: I found the High Priest of Scabaras there, under Amascut's control. Turns out she had him and the scabarites cause the plagues in Sophanem.
translation: 我在那里找到了斯卡巴拉斯大祭司，他受阿玛斯库特控制。原来是她指使他和斯卡巴拉斯信徒在索法尼恩城制造了瘟疫。

english: Where can I get a Lily of the Elid?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到埃利河百合？

english: There's a small island just west of here where you should be able to find some.
translation: 西边有个小岛，你应该能在那里找到一些。

english: Hello there crocodile. I think I'll call you Roger. You're looking very hungry, Roger.
translation: 你好啊，鳄鱼。我就叫你罗杰吧。你看起来很饿啊，罗杰。

english: I think I'd better find something to distract you with before I try getting any closer.
translation: 我想在靠近之前最好找点东西分散你的注意力。

english: Welcome back. Do you have a Lily of the Elid?
translation: 欢迎回来。你拿到埃利河百合了吗？

english: Well, there's a small island just west of here where you can find some.
translation: 嗯，西边有个小岛，那里能找到一些。

english: Okay. I'll be back soon.
translation: 好。我很快就回来。

english: I think I have everything I need to make the cure now.
translation: 我想我现在有制作解药所需的一切了。

english: Can I help with anything else?
translation: 还需要我帮忙做别的吗？

english: Actually, I think you can. To make the cure, I'll need to get the ingredients to just the right temperature. While I get them prepared, could you get my equipment heated up?
translation: 实际上，还真有。要制作解药，我需要把材料加热到合适的温度。在我准备材料的时候，你能帮我把我的装备预热一下吗？

english: Just adjust the individual heats until the overall temperature is at the marked level. Be warned, the equipment can be a bit temperamental sometimes.
translation: 只要调整各个加热器，直到整体温度达到标记的水平就行。提醒你，这装备有时候有点不听话。

english: Hey. You should help Zahur with her equipment.
translation: 嘿。你应该去帮扎胡尔弄她的装备。

english: What do I need to do to this equipment?
translation: 我需要对这个装备做什么？

english: Excellent! I think I have it!
translation: 太好了！我想我成功了！

english: Now, it's going to take a few batches of this to cure everyone in Sophanem. I'll get started on those right away. In the meantime, I can give you the first batch to take down there now.
translation: 现在，要治好索法尼恩城的所有人，需要好几批解药。我马上开始制作。与此同时，我可以先把第一批给你，你现在就可以带下去。

english: Okay. I can deliver it to the High Priest of Icthlarin.
translation: 好。我可以把它交给伊克哈林大祭司。

english: Meet me back at the necropolis once you're done.
translation: 完成后在大墓地和我碰头。

english: Here's the first batch for you to take to the High Priest of Icthlarin. Let him know that I'll be sending down the rest once it's done.
translation: 这是第一批，你拿去给伊克哈林大祭司。告诉他剩下的我做好后会送下去。

english: Do you have that first batch of cure for me?
translation: 你准备好第一批解药给我了吗？

english: Yes, here it is. Let the High Priest know that I'll be sending down the rest once it's done.
translation: 是的，给你。告诉大祭司剩下的我做好后会送下去。

english: I lost that crate you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那个板条箱。

english: You lost a whole crate? How?
translation: 你弄丢了一整个板条箱？怎么弄的？

english: Well I have the next batch ready now, so you can take that.
translation: 嗯，我现在有下一批了，你可以拿这个。

english: Where do I need to take this crate?
translation: 我需要把这个板条箱送到哪里？

english: It needs delivering to the High Priest of Icthlarin in Sophanem. Let him know that I'll be sending down the rest once it's done.
translation: 需要送到索法尼恩城的伊克哈林大祭司那里。告诉他剩下的我做好后会送下去。

english: Hello. How are things going here?
translation: 你好。这里情况怎么样？

english: We're making progress on those plagues. With our citizens back, we had enough people to finally drive out the frogs and locusts that were filling the town up.
translation: 我们在处理那些瘟疫上取得了进展。市民们回来了，我们终于有足够的人手赶走了城里泛滥的青蛙和蝗虫。

english: The infected cows have been dealt with as well. The only plague left now is this infuriating pox. Still, at least it isn't contagious.
translation: 感染的奶牛也处理好了。现在剩下的唯一瘟疫就是这烦人的波克斯。不过，至少它不传染。

english: Well, I think I might be able to help with that.
translation: 嗯，我想我或许能帮上忙。

english: Oh... I was meant to bring you something, but it seems I've forgotten it. I'll be right back.
translation: 哦……我本来应该给你带点东西的，但好像忘了。我马上回来。

english: What's this crate?
translation: 这个板条箱是什么？

english: If all goes well, the potions in there should cure the pox. Sophanem will finally be free of the plagues. This is just the first batch. More will come soon.
translation: 如果一切顺利，里面的药水应该能治好波克斯。索法尼恩城终于可以摆脱瘟疫了。这只是第一批，很快会有更多送来。

english: Free of the plagues? How is this possible? We tried everything!
translation: 摆脱瘟疫？这怎么可能？我们试过所有办法了！

english: Well I just found a good herbalist. What did you try?
translation: 嗯，我只是找到了一个好草药师。你们试过什么？

english: Er... mostly I prayed to Icthlarin and hoped for the best.
translation: 呃……主要是向伊克哈林祈祷，然后听天由命。

english: Right... Well I have some things to do down at the necropolis. I'll be back to see how the potions are working once I'm done.
translation: 好吧……我在大墓地那边还有些事要做。等我忙完了，会回来看药水的效果。

english: Thank you, friend. You are once again our saviour!
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。你又一次成了我们的救星！

english: Thank you for bringing us that cure. We will hopefully start seeing the effects soon.
translation: 谢谢你给我们带来解药。希望我们很快就能看到效果。

english: I'm sure it won't take long. I'll be back to see for myself once I'm done at the necropolis.
translation: 我相信不会太久。等我在大墓地忙完了，会回来看效果。

english: Hey there. Everything go okay with the High Priest?
translation: 嘿，你来了。和大祭司那边一切顺利吗？

english: I think so. I guess we'll see for sure soon.
translation: 我想是的。我们很快就能确认了。

english: Well in the meantime, do you think this incantation will work?
translation: 那在这期间，你觉得这个咒语会管用吗？

english: It did when I used it on the High Priest of Scabaras, so we shouldn't have any issues here.
translation: 我对斯卡巴拉斯大祭司用过，效果很好，所以这里应该也没问题。

english: Let's not waste any more time then.
translation: 那就别再浪费时间了。

english: Looks like we have a welcome party.
translation: 看来我们有欢迎队伍了。

english: You have been warned before... leave, now...
translation: 之前警告过你们……离开，现在就走……

english: Amascut's hold on you all is at an end. Majaan, Manand, Almuk.
translation: 阿玛斯库特对你们的控制到此为止了。玛贾安，玛南德，阿尔穆克。

english: My... my head...
translation: 我的……我的头……

english: You were all enthralled by the Devourer, but you're free now. Things will be confusing at the moment, but your memories will return in time.
translation: 你们都被吞噬者迷惑了，但现在自由了。现在可能会有些混乱，但你们的记忆会慢慢恢复的。

english: The Devourer? It can't be!
translation: 吞噬者？不可能！

english: I'm afraid so.
translation: 恐怕是的。

english: You've all been through a lot, but unfortunately you won't be able to return to Menaphos. The city remains locked down.
translation: 你们都经历了很多，但不幸的是，你们无法返回索法尼恩城了。那座城市仍然处于封锁状态。

english: You should seek refuge in Sophanem or one of the other nearby settlements. Hopefully you'll be able to go home soon.
translation: 你们应该去索法尼恩城或附近的其他定居点寻求庇护。希望你们很快就能回家。

english: You saved us!
translation: 你救了我们！

english: Well... that's quite the blockage.
translation: 嗯……这堵塞物可真够大的。

english: Clearing it is going to take work. A lot of work.
translation: 要清理它可得花不少功夫。很多功夫。

english: And time isn't on our side. Amascut is already in there looking for those weapons.
translation: 而且我们时间不多了。阿玛斯库特已经进去找那些武器了。

english: Sorry to interrupt, but we can help.
translation: 抱歉打断一下，但我们可以帮忙。

english: We can mine away the blockage for you.
translation: 我们可以帮你挖掉这堵塞物。

english: Are you sure? You've already been out here so long.
translation: 你确定吗？你们已经在这里待了这么久了。

english: The Devourer made us her slaves. We want to help you stop her.
translation: 吞噬者把我们变成了她的奴隶。我们想帮你阻止她。

english: We'll get to work at once.
translation: 我们马上开始干活。

english: It's still going to be a bit longer before the cure starts to work. I guess we should head back to my camp for now.
translation: 解药生效还需要一段时间。我想我们现在应该先回我的营地。

english: Stop!
translation: 站住！

english: Stay quiet!
translation: 别出声！

english: I know you're here! Come out!
translation: 我知道你在这里！出来！

english: Impressive, Maisa.
translation: 厉害，麦莎。

english: Osman! You've been spying on us!
translation: 奥斯曼！你一直在监视我们！

english: That is the job of a spy, Maisa. I remember that, but it seems you do not.
translation: 间谍的工作就是如此，麦莎。我记得，但你似乎忘了。

english: We had a plan, Maisa. You were ordered to stay in Menaphos. Now your recklessness has cost us dearly.
translation: 我们本来有计划，麦莎。你奉命留在梅纳福斯。现在你的鲁莽让我们付出了惨重代价。

english: Don't lecture me on cost. I know exactly how much this little game of yours has cost.
translation: 别跟我谈代价。我非常清楚你这场小游戏付出了什么代价。

english: Yes... Kaleef. Did you think I wasn't aware of your little romance?
translation: 是啊……卡利夫。你以为我不知道你的小恋情？

english: Did you take me for a fool? I've been dealing in deception since before you were born. Yours was not hard to spot.
translation: 你把我当傻瓜了？我还没出生就开始搞阴谋了。你那点事不难发现。

english: I made the mistake of letting it slide. A poor move on my part. Kaleef's death has clearly impacted your ability to think rationally.
translation: 我犯了个错，放任了它。这是我的失策。卡利夫的死显然影响了你理性思考的能力。

english: Or maybe it just made me see the truth! You're a monster, Osman! You'd see us all dead to get what you want!
translation: 或者只是让我看清了真相！你是个怪物，奥斯曼！为了达到目的，你宁愿看着我们都死！

english: I serve Al Kharid, Maisa, just as you once did.
translation: 我效忠阿尔卡里德城，麦莎，就像你曾经一样。

english: I'll never stop serving Al Kharid. I've just stopped serving you!
translation: 我永远不会停止效忠阿尔卡里德城。我只是不再效忠你了！

english: Soooo...
translation: 那么……

english: I hope you don't believe yourself innocent in all of this. You have been meddling in affairs that are not your concern.
translation: 我希望你别以为自己在这件事里是清白的。你一直在插手与你无关的事务。

english: I've only been trying to help.
translation: 我只是想帮忙。

english: By curing the pox? Tell me, who does that help? Al Kharid or Menaphos?
translation: 通过治愈波克斯？告诉我，这帮了谁？阿尔卡里德城还是梅纳福斯？

english: You know, despite all your spying, Al Kharid and Menaphos aren't actually enemies.
translation: 你知道吗，尽管你一直在监视，阿尔卡里德城和梅纳福斯其实并不是敌人。

english: On paper perhaps, but our two cities were at war for years. Signing a few treaties does not stop us from being enemies.
translation: 也许纸面上不是，但我们的两座城市交战多年。签几份条约并不能阻止我们成为敌人。

english: Even if that's true, I don't see why the pox being cured is a problem.
translation: 就算那是真的，我也不明白治愈波克斯有什么问题。

english: It will surely lead to the end of the Menaphos quarantine. That is not to our benefit. We wanted that city isolated.
translation: 这肯定会结束梅纳福斯的隔离。这对我们没好处。我们想让那座城市孤立。

english: There are larger forces at play here, Osman. That quarantine was helping them far more than it benefitted you.
translation: 这里有更大的力量在运作，奥斯曼。那隔离帮它们的程度远超过对你的好处。

english: Amascut. She has control over Pharaoh Kemesis. She arranged the quarantine to keep her actions in Menaphos a secret.
translation: 阿玛斯库特。她控制了法老凯米西斯。她安排隔离是为了保密她在梅纳福斯的行动。

english: That's why we made the cure. We need to get in there and find out what she's up to.
translation: 所以我们才制作了解药。我们需要进去看看她在搞什么鬼。

english: The Devourer? You speak of legends and fairy tales.
translation: 吞噬者？你在说传说和童话故事。

english: You don't believe the gods exist?
translation: 你不相信神存在？

english: Maybe once, but that was a long time ago.
translation: 也许曾经信过，但那很久以前了。

english: You're wrong, Osman. The Devourer's behind everything that's been happening down here, and the worst is yet to come. She's looking for some weapons. Ones that could grant her true godhood.
translation: 你错了，奥斯曼。吞噬者就是这里发生的一切的幕后黑手，最糟的还没来。她在找一些武器。一些能让她成为真神的武器。

english: And these weapons are in Menaphos?
translation: 这些武器在梅纳福斯？

english: No. She's after something else in Menaphos. We don't know what... yet. The weapons are in a tomb to the south, and she's already in there. She could be using them right now.
translation: 不。她在梅纳福斯找别的东西。我们还不知道是什么……目前。武器在南边的一座墓里，她已经进去了。她现在可能正在使用它们。

english: Pharaoh Kemesis has you fooled. This is clearly some ploy of his to keep us confused and divided. He is our true foe.
translation: 法老凯米西斯把你骗了。这显然是他耍的花招，想让我们困惑和分裂。他才是我们真正的敌人。

english: Osman, you can't...
translation: 奥斯曼，你不能……

english: Time to go...
translation: 该走了……

english: Osman! Don't you dare!
translation: 奥斯曼！你敢！

english: The mistress has tired of your interference...
translation: 女主人厌倦了你的干涉……

english: Pray to your false gods... your end comes now...
translation: 向你的假神祈祷吧……你的末日到了……

english: Great! Here we go again.
translation: 好极了！又来了。

english: Let's head back to my camp.
translation: 我们回我的营地吧。

english: Nice of you to help.
translation: 你帮忙真是太好了。

english: You had it all in hand. I must say, this has been an interesting development.
translation: 你完全掌控了局面。我得说，这发展挺有意思的。

english: So do you believe Amascut is involved now?
translation: 那么你现在相信阿玛斯库特参与其中了吗？

english: No. I believe what my eyes tell me, and I am yet to see any true evidence that this is the work of an ancient goddess.
translation: 不。我相信我亲眼所见，而我还没看到任何确凿证据表明这是远古女神所为。

english: Oh you've got to be...
translation: 哦，你真是……

english: But I will admit that there is more going on here than I first thought. Dark magic is clearly at play. This may require us to reconsider our approach.
translation: 但我承认，这里的情况比我最初想的要复杂。显然有黑暗魔法在作祟。这可能要求我们重新考虑策略。

english: What does that even mean?
translation: 那到底是什么意思？

english: For now, nothing. I need to go and think on this. I suggest you seek out Maisa and see what results your meddling has caused. I'm sure I'll be in touch at some point.
translation: 目前没什么。我需要去思考一下。我建议你去找麦莎，看看你的干预造成了什么结果。我相信我以后会联系你的。

english: Dare I ask for a 'thank you' this time?
translation: 我敢问这次能不能说声‘谢谢’？

english: I imagine Maisa will have gone to Sophanem to check on this cure. She will be waiting for you. Goodbye.
translation: 我想麦莎会去索法尼恩城检查解药。她会在那里等你。再见。

english: That's what I thought. Thanks, Osman.
translation: 我就知道。谢了，奥斯曼。

english: Sorry for leaving you back there. How was your chat with Osman?
translation: 抱歉把你丢在后面。你和奥斯曼聊得怎么样？

english: He seems to have been somewhat enlightened.
translation: 他似乎有点开窍了。

english: After you left, we were attacked by one of Amascut's servants. I think they convinced Osman that there's more to all of this than he realised.
translation: 你走后，我们被阿玛斯库特的一个仆人袭击了。我想他们让奥斯曼相信了，这里的情况比他意识到的要复杂。

english: Maybe he'll finally get his head out of the sand. We don't need him, though. Look at what we've managed on our own.
translation: 也许他终于能把头从沙子里拔出来了。不过我们不需要他。看看我们自己做到了什么。

english: Yes, the cure. Is it working?
translation: 是啊，解药。它有效吗？

english: I'll let the High Priest answer that one.
translation: 让大祭司来回答吧。

english: Hello again, friend. Your cure has worked wonderfully. Not a single citizen is infected any more. We're finally free of the plagues!
translation: 又见面了，朋友。你的解药效果非常好。没有一个市民再被感染了。我们终于摆脱瘟疫了！

english: And Menaphos?
translation: 那梅纳福斯呢？

english: We sent word to them earlier. They have agreed to meet with us at the bridge. If all goes well, this quarantine will soon be behind us.
translation: 我们早些时候给他们传了信。他们同意在桥那里和我们见面。如果一切顺利，隔离很快就会成为过去。

english: Please do join us for the meeting. After all, none of this would have been possible without you.
translation: 请务必和我们一起参加会面。毕竟，没有你这一切都不可能实现。

english: How long do you think we'll need to wait?
translation: 你觉得我们需要等多久？

english: I don't know. This has probably put Pharaoh Kemesis in an awkward spot. He'll have much to consider.
translation: 我不知道。这大概让法老凯米西斯处境尴尬。他有很多要考虑的。

english: If the quarantine benefits the Devourer, he won't want to end it. Problem is, if he doesn't, it will draw a lot of suspicion.
translation: 如果隔离对吞噬者有利，他不会想结束它。问题是，如果他不结束，就会引起很多怀疑。

english: Makes you wonder how much control he actually has left. Does he make any decisions for himself now, or is it all just Amascut?
translation: 让人好奇他到底还剩下多少控制权。他现在还能为自己做决定吗，还是全都是阿玛斯库特在操控？

english: How are you doing, by the way?
translation: 顺便问一下，你还好吗？

english: You know, the stuff Osman said about you and Kaleef.
translation: 你知道的，就是奥斯曼说的关于你和卡里夫的那些事。

english: What happened between Kaleef and I is none of your business.
translation: 我和卡利夫之间的事与你无关。

english: Speaking of Osman, that reminds me.
translation: 说到奥斯曼，这倒提醒了我。

english: He left this for you. I'll leave it in the tent at my camp for you to pick up.
translation: 他给你留了这个。我会把它放在我营地的帐篷里，你去拿。

english: He left this for you.
translation: 他给你留了这个。

english: His way of saying 'thank you' perhaps?
translation: 也许是他表达‘谢谢’的方式？

english: Doubt it. He's probably just trying to keep on your good side.
translation: 不太可能。他大概只是想讨好你。

english: Do you think he's here?
translation: 你觉得他在这里吗？

english: If not him, one of his minions will be. He'll want to know what happens at this meeting.
translation: 就算不是他本人，他的一个手下也会在。他想知道这次会面发生了什么。

english: Anyway, he wasn't the only one with something for you. This is from the High Priest.
translation: 总之，他不是唯一一个给你东西的人。这是大祭司给的。

english: You can pick it up from him once we're done here.
translation: 等我们这边结束后，你可以从他那里拿。

english: I'm sure I'll be able to put it to good use.
translation: 我相信我能好好利用它。

english: Ah, looks like something's happening.
translation: 啊，看起来有情况了。

english: Hang on... is that...?
translation: 等等……那是……？

english: Pharaoh Kemesis! I did not expect you to attend to this personally.
translation: 法老凯米西斯！我没想到你会亲自出席。

english: Pharaoh Kemesis?
translation: 法老凯米西斯？

english: The city of Menaphos will begin preparations to end the quarantine. It will take some time for these preparations to be complete. Good day.
translation: 梅纳福斯城将开始准备结束隔离。这些准备工作需要一些时间才能完成。日安。

english: Well that was anticlimactic.
translation: 这可真是虎头蛇尾。

english: That's one way of putting it. Still, I wasn't expecting Kemesis himself to make the announcement. It's very unusual for him to appear in public.
translation: 可以这么说。不过，我没想到凯米西斯会亲自宣布。他很少公开露面。

english: What do you think it means?
translation: 你觉得这意味着什么？

english: I don't know. Until we can get into Menaphos, I doubt we'll find out.
translation: 我不知道。在我们能进入梅纳福斯之前，我怀疑我们不会知道。

english: He said it would take some time for the city to open.
translation: 他说城市开放需要一些时间。

english: Stalling for as long as possible, no doubt.
translation: 毫无疑问是在尽可能拖延时间。

english: The citizens should hopefully be nearly done unblocking the entrance to Osmumten's Tomb. I'm going to head down there.
translation: 市民们应该快清理完奥斯穆滕之墓的入口了。我打算去那里。

english: As for you, I'd say you've earnt a small break. Take whatever time you need to prepare, then meet me at the tomb once you're ready.
translation: 至于你，我觉得你赢得了一点休息时间。花点时间准备，准备好了就到墓那里找我。

english: Alright, I'll see you soon. Good luck.
translation: 好的，回头见。祝你好运。

english: Hello again! Please take this as a thank you for all your help.
translation: 再次问好！请收下这个，作为对你所有帮助的感谢。

english: I think we've done all we can for the moment. Menaphos is preparing to reopen, and the citizens are unblocking the entrance to Osmumten's Tomb.
translation: 我想目前我们已经尽力了。梅纳福斯正准备重新开放，市民们正在疏通奥斯穆腾之墓的入口。

english: Until we see some progress in one of those areas, we'll just have to wait. Hopefully it won't be too long.
translation: 在我们看到这些领域中的任何一个取得进展之前，我们只能等待。希望不会太久。

english: In the meantime, I'll be helping out at the excavation. I think you'll agree that's our top priority.
translation: 与此同时，我会在挖掘现场帮忙。我想你会同意这是我们的首要任务。

english: Look after yourself. You'll need to be well prepared for what's to come. I'll send word once the entry is cleared.
translation: 照顾好自己。你需要为即将发生的事情做好充分准备。入口清理完毕后我会通知你。

english: It's not a wall! It's a rock!
translation: 这不是一堵墙！这是一块岩石！

english: What's the difference?
translation: 有什么区别？

english: It's a very special rock!
translation: 这是一块非常特别的岩石！

english: I still don't quite follow...
translation: 我还是不太明白……

english: Oh, for Guthix' sake, it's perfectly simple! See, that rock over there, it's impenetrable!
translation: 哦，看在古斯神的份上，这再简单不过了！你看，那边那块岩石，它是坚不可摧的！

english: Have you tried taking a pickaxe to it?
translation: 你试过用镐子挖它吗？

english: Of course I have, I'm holding this rune pickaxe, aren't I? We've been trying to mine through it for years!
translation: 我当然试过，我手里拿着这把符文镐，不是吗？我们多年来一直试图挖穿它！

english: We? I don't see anyone else.
translation: 我们？我没看到其他人啊。

english: Well, I'm the only one left... all the others gave up. Said it wasn't worth their while anymore. Wouldn't have a good return profit on their time investment.
translation: 呃，我是唯一剩下的……其他人都放弃了。说这不值得他们再花时间了。投入的时间得不到好的回报。

english: At first we thought there might be a huge treasure behind the rock, you see.
translation: 起初我们以为岩石后面可能藏着巨大的宝藏，你明白吧。

english: Isn't there?
translation: 难道没有吗？

english: Until we had a look further down the stream, around the rock... no, there's no treasure there, just a dead end.
translation: 直到我们沿着溪流往下游看了看，绕过岩石……不，那里没有宝藏，只是个死胡同。

english: Okay... so why were you trying to get through the rock again?
translation: 好吧……那你为什么还要试图穿过这块岩石呢？

english: Because obviously there are vast deposits of minerals inside the rock! And if not, I want to harness the extreme hardness of the rock itself!
translation: 因为岩石里面显然有大量的矿物沉积！如果没有，我也想利用岩石本身的极端硬度！

english: The only problem is that I have run out of ideas on how to do it.
translation: 唯一的问题是我已经没辙了，不知道该怎么弄。

english: Perhaps a young adventurer like you is willing to help out an old dwarf like me? Want to find out what's inside the rock?
translation: 也许像你这样的年轻冒险者愿意帮帮我这个老矮人？想看看岩石里面有什么吗？

english: Sure, sounds interesting!
translation: 当然，听起来很有趣！

english: Welcome aboard then!
translation: 那就欢迎加入！

english: No thanks, I do enough mining on my own.
translation: 不了谢谢，我自己采矿已经够忙的了。

english: Suit yourself, I don't need any help from a human anyway!
translation: 随你便，反正我也不需要人类的帮助！

english: Any idea on what's inside the rock?
translation: 你知道岩石里面有什么吗？

english: No, but that's where you come in!
translation: 不知道，但这就是你出场的时候了！

english: I want you to find out some more information on the rock.
translation: 我希望你去查查关于这块岩石的更多信息。

english: Now where would I do that?
translation: 那我该去哪里查呢？

english: I don't know! Wish I knew!
translation: 我不知道！我要是知道就好了！

english: But we have to get some better understanding of what this thing actually is. Maybe then we can find a way to break it open.
translation: 但我们必须更好地了解这东西到底是什么。也许这样我们就能找到打开它的方法。

english: And what are you going to do while I go running across half of Gielinor, I'll wager?
translation: 那在我跑遍半个吉莱诺的时候，你打算做什么？我打赌。

english: I'll guard my cannon and fire more cannonballs at it, of course! Wish I had your job, mine's a tough one!
translation: 我会守卫我的大炮，然后朝它发射更多炮弹，当然！真希望我是你的工作，我的工作太难了！

english: Want to trade places?
translation: 想换换位置吗？

english: My legs are too old and worn to do much running around anymore, I'm afraid.
translation: 我的腿太老太旧了，恐怕跑不动了。

english: Well, off you go now! Start running, start talking!
translation: 好了，你现在就出发吧！开始跑，开始聊！

english: But I still don't know where!
translation: 可我还是不知道去哪儿啊！

english: Oh, why so difficult?
translation: 哦，怎么这么难搞？

english: Look, try the city, further down the stream here. There's bound to be someone there who knows something. If you still can't find anyone, go to the librarian, he knows a lot.
translation: 听着，试试城里，沿着这条溪流往下走。那里肯定有人知道些什么。如果你还是找不到人，就去找图书管理员，他知道很多。

english: What did you need me to do?
translation: 你需要我做什么来着？

english: But I don't know much about that rock, I'm afraid. It's baffled us for many generations.
translation: 但恐怕我对那块岩石了解不多。它困扰了我们好几代人。

english: There is a dwarf in the mechanics shop, though, who I believe has some connections with a certain scholar.
translation: 不过，机械店里有个矮人，我相信他和某位学者有联系。

english: Where can I find him exactly?
translation: 我具体在哪里能找到他？

english: Go south to the palace, the shop is called Wemund's Wrench Warehouse. He should be working there somewhere.
translation: 往南走到宫殿，那家店叫“韦蒙德的扳手仓库”。他应该在那里工作。

english: Do you know anything about this rock in the mines?
translation: 你知道矿井里那块岩石的事吗？

english: Now what rock would that be, exactly?
translation: 具体是哪块岩石？

english: The big rock in the mines to the south, with an old dwarf standing beside it..?
translation: 南边矿井里那块大岩石，旁边站着一个老矮人……

english: Ah, Don's rock, right?
translation: 啊，唐的岩石，对吧？

english: Er, yes, I think so. Do you know what it's made of?
translation: 呃，是的，我想是的。你知道它是什么做的吗？

english: No, no one knows. No one here, anyway. The only one I can think of is Rolad, a renowned scholar. He was part of Dondakan's team once, many years ago.
translation: 不，没人知道。至少这里没人知道。我唯一能想到的人是罗拉德，一位著名的学者。很多年前，他曾是东达坎团队的一员。

english: So where can I find this Rolad?
translation: 那我在哪里能找到这个罗拉德？

english: He left to explore the world. Learning by experience, or so he said. Me, I prefer a cold stout at home, but it takes all sorts.
translation: 他离开去探索世界了。用经验学习，他是这么说的。而我呢，更喜欢在家喝杯冷黑啤，但各有所好。

english: I think he's currently with the Black Guard at Ice Mountain.
translation: 我想他现在和冰山上的黑卫队在一起。

english: Great, thanks a lot!
translation: 太好了，非常感谢！

english: Excuse me... would you happen to be Rolad the scholar?
translation: 打扰一下……您就是学者罗拉德吗？

english: Why, yes, I think so... who's asking?
translation: 嗯，是的，我想是的……谁在问？

english: [player name], and I've come to ask you about a rock.
translation: [player name]，我来是想问您关于一块岩石的事。

english: You're awfully tall for a dwarf, you know, [player name]. And a rock you say? I suppose I know a fair bit about rocks, yes.
translation: 你作为一个矮人可真够高的，[player name]。你说岩石？我想我对岩石还是知道不少的，是的。

english: It's this rock that Dondakan is trying to break open. You know Dondakan, right?
translation: 就是东达坎试图打开的那块岩石。你认识东达坎，对吧？

english: Oh, old Dondakan, sure I know him. And I know his rock too. It's that unbreakable one, isn't it?
translation: 哦，老东达坎，我当然认识他。我也知道他的岩石。就是那块坚不可摧的，对吧？

english: Yes, that's the one. What can you tell me about it?
translation: 是的，就是那块。你能告诉我些什么？

english: Well, as a matter of fact, I picked up an interesting book on one of my travels, from a quite out of the way dwarven outpost.
translation: 嗯，事实上，我在一次旅行中得到了一本有趣的书，来自一个相当偏僻的矮人前哨站。

english: I'm not entirely sure, but it seems to describe this very rock, and how it came to be placed in that cavern. I tore out the most interesting pages for more detailed perusal. Let me get them for you.
translation: 我不太确定，但这本书似乎描述了这块岩石，以及它是如何被放置在那个洞穴里的。我把最有趣的几页撕了下来，以便更详细地研读。我去给你拿。

english: I seem to have misplaced the pages... a pity, I had wanted to study them some more. Oh well...
translation: 我好像把那些页放错地方了……真可惜，我还想再研究一下呢。哦，算了……

english: What? No! I need that book!
translation: 什么？不！我需要那本书！

english: Oh, well, if it's that important to you, perhaps you can go and look for the pages? There should be three of them.
translation: 哦，好吧，如果它对你这么重要，也许你可以去找找那些页？应该有三页。

english: Where should I start looking?
translation: 我应该从哪里开始找？

english: I probably lost them in the mines below. I don't have them up here in any case.
translation: 我可能把它们丢在下面的矿井里了。反正我这里没有。

english: What, in the mining guild?
translation: 什么，在采矿公会里？

english: No no, I never go there, I'm not a member you know. But I sometimes go down to the regular mines to study the conditions of the working dwarf.
translation: 不不，我从不去那里，你知道我不是会员。但我有时会去普通矿井研究矮人工人的工作条件。

english: Okay, thanks, I'll go and look for the pages then.
translation: 好的，谢谢，那我就去找那些页了。

english: Rolad has a book that might help us!
translation: 罗拉德有一本书，可能对我们有帮助！

english: A book? How's a book going to help? What's in it?
translation: 一本书？一本书能有什么用？里面写了什么？

english: Well, that's the problem... the most important pages are missing.
translation: 嗯，问题就在这里……最重要的几页不见了。

english: Then run along and find them!
translation: 那就赶紧去找啊！

english: How are you getting on with finding those missing pages?
translation: 找那些丢失的页进展如何？

english: I haven't found a single one yet, I have no idea where I should be looking.
translation: 我一张都没找到，完全不知道该去哪里找。

english: Down in the mines below, that'd be my best bet. I don't know where though, they could be anywhere down there.
translation: 下面的矿井里，那是我最好的猜测。不过我不知道具体位置，它们可能在那里的任何地方。

english: Well, I found the first page, but I still have two to go.
translation: 嗯，我找到了第一页，但还有两页要找。

english: That's splendid, keep going and you'll find them all, I'm sure!
translation: 太好了，继续找，我相信你一定能全部找到！

english: I found two of the pages! But I haven't found the last one yet.
translation: 我找到了两页！但最后一页还没找到。

english: Marvelous! I'm sure it's only a matter of time before you find the final page!
translation: 太棒了！我相信找到最后一页只是时间问题！

english: Look, I found all of your missing pages!
translation: 看，我找到了你所有丢失的页！

english: Missing pages..?
translation: 丢失的页……？

english: Yes, the missing pages of that book we were talking about earlier?
translation: 是的，我们之前说的那本书丢失的页？

english: Oh yes, quite right... let me see them, please, and I'll put the book back together for you.
translation: 哦，对，没错……请让我看看，我把书重新拼好给你。

english: There you go... You will give it back when you've finished with it, won't you? I'd really like to study it in more detail some time.
translation: 给你……你看完了会还给我的，对吧？我真的很想以后有时间再仔细研究一下。

english: Of course, I'd be happy to!
translation: 当然，我很乐意！

english: Splendid, now, there's a good dwarf!
translation: 太好了，真是个好矮人！

english: Of course... when I've finished with it I'll give it back to you, sure...
translation: 当然……等我看完了，我会还给你的，肯定的……

english: Thanks again for that book, I really appreciate it.
translation: 再次感谢那本书，我真的很感激。

english: Oh yes, have you read it yet?
translation: 哦，对了，你读过了吗？

english: No, not yet, but I will.
translation: 还没，但我会读的。

english: Ahem... errr... I lost that book you gave me.
translation: 咳咳……呃……你给我的那本书我弄丢了。

english: That's terrible! Have you even read it yet?
translation: 太糟糕了！你读过了吗？

english: No, I hadn't had the chance yet.
translation: 没有，我还没来得及看。

english: Well, here, I happened to have a copy of it. Try not to lose it this time!
translation: 嗯，给你，我碰巧有一本副本。这次可别再弄丢了！

english: Wait, if you had a copy of it, why did I have to look for your missing pages?
translation: 等等，如果你有副本，为什么我还要去找你丢失的页？

english: I suppose I just forgot that I had one.
translation: 我想我只是忘了自己还有一本。

english: That was quite an interesting book you gave me.
translation: 你给我的那本书读起来挺有意思的。

english: Yes, but I'd like to hang on to it a little longer, if I may.
translation: 是的，但如果可以的话，我想再留它一段时间。

english: Why, naturally, that's no problem for someone with such a keen interest in expanding [his/her/their] knowledge!
translation: 哦，当然，对于一个如此热衷于扩展[his/her/their]知识的人来说，这完全没问题！

english: Rolad gave me a book that was quite interesting to read! I think I know what's inside it!
translation: 罗拉德给了我一本书，读起来很有趣！我想我知道里面是什么了！

english: What? What? Tell me!
translation: 什么？什么？快告诉我！

english: Ehm, well... a demonic spirit for one...
translation: 嗯，好吧……首先是一个恶魔灵魂……

english: A demonic spirit! And apparently the inside of the rock is lined with gold!
translation: 一个恶魔的灵魂！而且岩石内部似乎衬满了黄金！

english: Gold? Did you say gold?
translation: 黄金？你刚刚说黄金？

english: Yes... and a de-
translation: 是的...还有一只恶——

english: Gold! I knew it! I struck gold! I'm set for life!
translation: 黄金！我就知道！我挖到黄金了！这辈子不愁了！

english: What's left of it anyway...
translation: 反正也就剩那么点了...

english: Now tell me, how do I break open the rock?
translation: 现在告诉我，我怎么才能把这块岩石弄开？

english: Sorry, the book doesn't say... it doesn't seem to be particularly concerned with actually breaking open the rock. You see, the demonic spirit is being kept inside it.
translation: 抱歉，书上没说……它似乎对如何真正破开岩石不太在意。你看，那个恶魔的灵魂是被封印在里面的。

english: Yes yes, I heard you the first time.
translation: 是是是，我第一遍就听见了。

english: Well, we're not very much closer to a solution then, are we?
translation: 好吧，那我们离解决办法还远着呢，对吧？

english: What have you tried so far?
translation: 你到目前为止都试过什么了？

english: Well, let's see...
translation: 嗯，让我想想……

english: At one time, we had a hundred dwarves in here, all picking away at the rock. Didn't do a thing.
translation: 有一次，我们让一百个矮人进来，全都在凿那块岩石。一点用都没有。

english: Then there was the time when we set fire to this whole section of the cave. What a smell that made!
translation: 然后还有一次，我们点着了洞穴的这一整段。那味道可真够呛！

english: Any effect?
translation: 有什么效果吗？

english: Apart from coating the rock with soot? Not really, no.
translation: 除了给岩石涂了层煤灰？其实没有，完全没有。

english: I was able to borrow a cannon from the Black Guard, my son was able to pull some strings you know.
translation: 我曾经从黑卫队那里借来了一门大炮，我儿子走了点关系你懂的。

english: Of course, steel cannonballs didn't make a dent. But then ol' Donnie had a clever idea.
translation: 当然，钢铁炮弹连个印子都没留下。不过后来老唐尼想了个聪明主意。

english: I made this adamantite cannonball, you see! Cost me quite a pile of coins too!
translation: 你看，我做了这个精金炮弹！可花了我一大笔金币呢！

english: Wow! That must have made quite an impact!
translation: 哇！那一定造成了不少冲击吧！

english: Well, yes, it did... when it bounced back onto the ground it did.
translation: 嗯，确实……当它弹回地面的时候造成了冲击。

english: What else did you try?
translation: 你们还试过什么？

english: Well, then I had an even more clever idea!
translation: 嗯，后来我想到了一个更聪明的主意！

english: I put an even bigger pile of coins together to get some rune cannonballs! Good idea, right?
translation: 我又凑了一大堆金币搞了些符文炮弹！好主意，对吧？

english: Yeah, great!
translation: 是啊，太棒了！

english: No, it wasn't. Didn't do anything! Nothing at all!
translation: 不，并不棒。一点用都没有！完全没用！

english: Latest thing I've tried are these boots.
translation: 我最近试的是这双靴子。

english: Nice boots... but what about them?
translation: 不错的靴子……但这靴子怎么了？

english: They're made out of granite! I don't have enough money left to make granite cannonballs though. But see!
translation: 它们是花岗岩做的！不过我剩下的钱不够做花岗岩炮弹了。但你看！

english: Did you see? Did you?
translation: 你看到了吗？看到了吗？

english: I er... didn't see anything.
translation: 我呃……什么都没看见。

english: That's because there wasn't anything to see! Even granite doesn't do anything to it!
translation: 那是因为根本没什么可看的！连花岗岩对它也没用！

english: And now I have to come up with a material that will affect it somehow?
translation: 现在我得想出一种能对它起作用的材料？

english: You got it!
translation: 你说对了！

english: Some kind of new material that no one has ever found before but which I am supposed to accidentally stumble upon, perhaps?
translation: 某种以前没人发现过的新材料，但我得碰巧撞上，对吧？

english: Don't be silly, I'm sure there must be some known material that will affect it.
translation: 别傻了，我肯定存在某种已知材料能对它起作用。

english: I'm tired of these stories.
translation: 这些故事我听腻了。

english: Go on then... leave an old dwarf to his work.
translation: 那就走吧……让一个老矮人自己干活吧。

english: Maybe we should set up another cannon?
translation: 也许我们再架一门大炮？

english: Another cannon? How will that help?
translation: 再架一门大炮？那有什么用？

english: No, no, what we need is a different material of cannonballs. The hardest, toughest you can find.
translation: 不不，我们需要的是不同材料的炮弹。最硬、最坚固的那种，你能找到的。

english: How do you mean, that I can find? What are you doing then?
translation: 你说我能找到什么意思？那你干什么呢？

english: I'm guarding the cannon. Won't do us much good if it were stolen, would it?
translation: 我在看守大炮。要是被人偷了可不好，对吧？

english: Tried that, didn't work.
translation: 试过了，没用。

english: Perfect gold? That's much too valuable to be used to make cannonballs!
translation: 纯金？那太珍贵了，不能用来做炮弹！

english: Haha, you want me to make a golden cannonball?
translation: 哈哈，你想让我做一个黄金炮弹？

english: You know that apart from being heavy it's also very soft, don't you? It'd be a pointless waste!
translation: 你知道黄金除了重以外还很软，对吧？那纯粹是浪费！

english: Well... the book does say that there's gold inside the rock, so I thought perhaps gold can damage it as well.
translation: 嗯……书上确实说岩石里面有黄金，所以我想也许黄金也能破坏它。

english: Hmm, I suppose you have a point there.
translation: 嗯，你说的倒也有道理。

english: Tell you what, if you make a golden cannonball and give it to me, I'll fire it at the rock.
translation: 这样吧，如果你做一个黄金炮弹给我，我就用它轰那块岩石。

english: Yes, you already showed me that. But I'm not going to waste my own gold on it, make a cannonball and bring it to me.
translation: 是的，你已经演示给我看了。但我可不想浪费我自己的黄金。做个炮弹带给我吧。

english: I have that golden cannonball you asked me to make.
translation: 我做好了你要的那个黄金炮弹。

english: That... that... that's an amazing looking cannonball!
translation: 这……这……这真是个惊人模样的炮弹！

english: Are you sure you want me to fire it at the rock? It's going to make a nasty dent in it. In the cannonball that is.
translation: 你确定要我把它轰向岩石？它会在上面留下一个难看的凹痕的。我是说在炮弹上。

english: Yes, I'm sure this will crack open the rock.
translation: 是的，我确信这能砸开岩石。

english: It breaks my heart to ruin such a fine piece of crafting, but it's your gold... Alright, let's load it up then.
translation: 毁掉这么一件精美的工艺品让我心碎，但这是你的金币……好吧，那我们把它装上去。

english: Did... did... did you see that?
translation: 你……你……你看到了吗？

english: The cannonball went right through it!
translation: 炮弹直接穿过去了！

english: I don't believe it! All this time, I've been spending all my gold on opening the rock... I could've just thrown it at it!
translation: 我简直不敢相信！这么长时间我一直花光所有金币想弄开岩石……我本来可以直接把黄金扔上去的！

english: But... the rock didn't actually break, did it?
translation: 但是……岩石实际上并没有裂开，对吧？

english: No, it seemed more like it... gave way for a second... That's interesting...
translation: 不，它更像是……让开了一瞬间……真有意思……

english: So how does this help us?
translation: 那这对我们有什么帮助？

english: Why, I'll just shoot you through it so you can have a look, won't I?
translation: 这还不简单，我把你射过去，让你看看里面不就行了？

english: Shoot me... through it? Errr... what exactly do you mean?
translation: 把我射……穿过去？呃……你具体是什么意思？

english: Very simple. I'll have to make a few modifications to my cannon so that it can fire a human, and you'll need a golden helmet of course.
translation: 很简单。我得对我的大炮做一些改装，让它能发射人类，当然你还需要一顶黄金头盔。

english: Then I'll fire you at the rock so you can do a little reconnaissance. Don't worry, you should land safely on the other side of the rock.
translation: 然后我把你射向岩石，这样你就能做点侦察了。别担心，你应该会安全落到岩石的另一边。

english: Might want to pick up that cannonball again while you're at it!
translation: 顺便把那个炮弹也捡回来！

english: But... what if I bump into that demon, the one from the book?
translation: 但是……如果我撞上那个恶魔怎么办？就是书上那个？

english: Don't be silly now. It's just a rock... just a rock with lots of gold in it!
translation: 别傻了。就是一块岩石而已……一块里面有很多黄金的岩石！

english: So you want to... fire me into the rock?
