translation: 所以你想……把我射进岩石里？

english: Yes, just to see what's inside... to see if all that gold is really embedded inside it.
translation: 是的，就想看看里面有什么……看看是不是真的镶满了黄金。

english: Are you sure that it's safe?
translation: 你确定安全吗？

english: No, but then we'll never know until we've tried it, right?
translation: 不确定，但如果不试一下我们永远不会知道，对吧？

english: Find someone else for your bizarre experiment, I'm not going to crawl into that cannon of yours! Or have you shoot me at a solid rock!
translation: 找别人做你古怪的实验吧，我才不爬进你那门大炮里！或者让你把我射向一块实心岩石！

english: But we're so close to all that gold!
translation: 但我们离那些黄金如此之近！

english: I can't argue with that, shoot me in!
translation: 你说得对，把我射进去吧！

english: Well, it's not so simple... like I said, I need to make some modifications to my cannon. They're not really designed to fire humans, you know.
translation: 嗯，没那么简单……就像我说的，我需要改装一下我的大炮。它们本来不是设计来发射人类的，你知道吧。

english: Okay, I'll just wait right here until you've made them.
translation: 好的，我就在这儿等你改装好。

english: I don't really know how, actually. Never been much of an engineer.
translation: 其实我也不知道怎么改。我从来不算什么工程师。

english: If I had the right schematics for it, I could probably work with that. But I don't.
translation: 如果我有正确的示意图，我大概能照着做。但我没有。

english: Okay, so you want me to look for the schematics for you, is that it?
translation: 好吧，所以你想让我帮你找示意图，对吗？

english: That's it, yes! Here, I have one part of the schematics, sent to me by some prankster dwarf, I don't even remember his name. You'll have to find the rest on your own.
translation: 没错，就是这样！给你，这是示意图的一部分，是某个爱恶作剧的矮人送给我的，我连他名字都不记得了。剩下的你得自己找了。

english: Oh, and you'll also need a golden helmet of course. Would hurt quite a bit otherwise.
translation: 哦，对了，你当然还需要一顶黄金头盔。否则会很疼。

english: Won't a gold plated helmet do?
translation: 镀金的头盔不行吗？

english: No, it has to be a helmet made out of solid gold. Gold plated helmets contain so little actual gold, it'd be a bit dangerous.
translation: 不行，必须是纯金做的头盔。镀金头盔里的黄金太少了，会有点危险。

english: Unless you want to die when I shoot you at the rock?
translation: 除非你希望我把你射向岩石的时候死掉？

english: No no, I'll get you a helmet made out of solid gold.
translation: 不不不，我会给你弄一顶纯金头盔。

english: Although that will be a horrendously heavy thing to actually wear.
translation: 虽然那东西戴起来会重得要命。

english: Yes yes, well, get going now, why don't you? I'll guard the cannon while you're away.
translation: 是的是的，好了，现在快走吧，好吗？你不在的时候我会守卫大炮的。

english: That's what I thought you'd say.
translation: 我就知道你会这么说。

english: My head's spinning, I have to go for a bit.
translation: 我头都晕了，得出去走一走。

english: No, on second thought, I'd rather sell it for a huge profit.
translation: 不，再想想，我宁愿把它卖掉赚一大笔钱。

english: Nice idea, [player name], but no one will buy a golden cannonball!
translation: 好主意，[player name]，但没人会买一个黄金炮弹！

english: It looks nice, but it's not much use as a projectile.
translation: 它看起来不错，但作为弹头没什么用。

english: What did you want me to find again?
translation: 你刚才让我找什么来着？

english: Schematics to modify my cannon, and a golden helmet for you to wear.
translation: 改装大炮的示意图，以及一顶给你戴的黄金头盔。

english: I lost that schematic you gave me, actually.
translation: 你给我的那张示意图我弄丢了。

english: Oh, be more careful! Here, have a copy, but don't lose it again!
translation: 哦，小心点！给你，这是副本，别再弄丢了！

english: Sounds simple enough. Any idea on where I can find those schematics?
translation: 听起来挺简单的。知道我在哪里能找到那些示意图吗？

english: Not a clue! I don't even know how many parts there are. It's probably best to ask any dwarven engineers that you might know.
translation: 一点头绪都没有！我甚至不知道有多少部分。最好问问你认识的任何矮人工程师。

english: And it could be that someone in the mines or the city here knows where this part came from. Didn't you talk to someone in Keldagrim already? Just ask around!
translation: 而且说不定矿场里或者这城里的人知道这部分是从哪儿来的。你不是已经跟凯尔达格林城的人聊过了吗？到处问问吧！

english: Again...
translation: 再来一次……

english: No complaining now, run along!
translation: 别抱怨了，快去吧！

english: I'm looking for schematics to modify the dwarven multicannon to fire a human. Can you help?
translation: 我在找一些示意图，用来改装矮人连发大炮，让它能发射人类。你能帮忙吗？

english: Haha, yesh, I have jusht the shing!
translation: 哈哈，是呀，我正好有你要的东西！

english: I've been working on thish deshign for quite a while now!
translation: 这个设计我研究了好一阵子了！

english: Never got to test it, love to shee it shoot a real human!
translation: 一直没机会测试，真想看它射出一个真人！

english: Well, can you give them to me? I'd be willing to try the experiment.
translation: 那你能把它们给我吗？我愿意试试这个实验。

english: Oooh, shure, shure... I've only got one part left, though, I gave all the other parts away.
translation: 噢，当然，当然……不过我这里只剩下一部分了，其他的都给出去啦。

english: Who did you give them to?
translation: 你给谁了？

english: How should I know? I'm only a shimple dwarf.
translation: 我怎么会知道？我只是个普通的矮人。

english: Okay, okay, can I have that one schematic then?
translation: 好好好，那我能要那一份示意图吗？

english: Of courshe!
translation: 当然可以！

english: Just give me a drink and I'll gladly help you.
translation: 给我一杯喝的，我很乐意帮你。

english: No, I've had enough of buying drinks for people!
translation: 不，我受够了给别人买酒喝！

english: It's always like this... Sure, I'll help you [player name], just as soon as you get me a drink!
translation: 总是这样……好吧，我会帮你[player name]，只要你帮我弄杯喝的！

english: And more often than not they actually want a very special kind of drink that can only be gotten in the next town, or beyond.
translation: 而且很多时候他们要的是一种很特别的酒，只有在邻镇甚至更远的地方才能弄到。

english: And what is wrong with all you people anyway? Sometimes it seems as if half the population of Gielinor are alcoholics!
translation: 还有，你们这些人到底有什么毛病？有时候感觉整个基利诺尔大陆有一半人都是酒鬼！

english: So, no, I won't do it anymore, you can get your own drink for once, and I'm just going to stay right here until you've done so!
translation: 所以，不，我不会再这么做了。这回你自己去拿酒喝吧，我就在这儿等着你拿来！

english: Pffft, I only wanted a dwarven shtout from that table over there.
translation: 哼，我只不过想要那边桌子上的一杯矮人黑啤酒。

english: Here, have the shtupid schematic, I've gone right off my drink now.
translation: 给你，拿走这愚蠢的示意图吧，我现在反而不想喝了。

english: Oh, alright, what do you want to drink?
translation: 哦，好吧，你想喝什么？

english: Oooh, jusht a glash of dwarven shtout over there...
translation: 噢，就是那边的一杯矮人黑啤酒……

english: Here, I've got your dwarven stout.
translation: 给你，你的矮人黑啤酒。

english: That'sh wonderful! You're a good human, you are. Here, have thish schematic and have fun with it!
translation: 太好了！你是个好人，真的。给你这份示意图，拿去玩吧！

english: Thanks for that schematic.
translation: 谢谢你给的示意图。

english: Sho have you been shot out of a cannon yet?
translation: 那么，你被大炮射出去了吗？

english: No, fortunately not.
translation: 没有，幸好没有。

english: You've been so helpful with that book, I was wondering, can you help me with something else as well?
translation: 那本书你帮了很大的忙，我在想，你还能再帮我个忙吗？

english: Of course, anything to help a fellow dwarf, especially such a big, strong one such as yourself!
translation: 当然，只要能帮到矮人同胞，尤其是你这样高大强壮的矮人，什么都行！

english: Dondakan wants to modify his multicannon, you see, to fire a human.
translation: 是这样的，东达坎想改装他的连发大炮，用来发射人类。

english: A human, you say? Are we using humans as cannon fodder now?
translation: 你说，一个人类？我们现在拿人类当炮灰了吗？

english: Well, good for him, never did like humans anyway.
translation: 嗯，对他挺好，反正我一直不喜欢人类。

english: But can you help me with the schematics? Dondakan needs to know what he needs to modify.
translation: 但你能帮我弄到示意图吗？东达坎需要知道要改装什么。

english: Oh, I see, I see. No, I have no schematics to... what did you say? Modify the cannon to shoot humans? Such a preposterous idea.
translation: 哦，我明白了，明白了。不，我没有示意图……你刚才说什么？把大炮改成发射人类？真是荒谬的想法。

english: No, all I have are the base schematics of the cannon. I was on the multicannon project once, you know?
translation: 不，我这里只有大炮的基础示意图。你知道吗，我曾经参与过连发大炮的项目？

english: You see, back when-
translation: 你看，当时——

english: Oh, those will be a tremendous help already, can I borrow those off of you as well?
translation: 哦，那已经能帮上大忙了，我可以也借走这些吗？

english: Well, of course, I have the schematics written down on a piece of paper somewhere. Let me just look for it.
translation: 嗯，当然可以。我把示意图写在了一张纸上，放在某个地方了。让我找找看。

english: Oh dear, I seem to have lost the schematics.
translation: 哎呀，我好像把示意图弄丢了。

english: You are rather a forgetful person, aren't you?
translation: 你还真是个健忘的人，对吧？

english: I hardly ever lose anything, I'll have you know!
translation: 我很少丢东西的，我告诉你！

english: Now, you wouldn't be able to go and look for the schematics, would you?
translation: 那么，你能帮我找找示意图吗？

english: Oh, alright, I'll go and have a look.
translation: 哦，好吧，我去看看。

english: Say, you wouldn't happen to have another copy of that book, would you?
translation: 话说，你该不会碰巧还有另一本那本书吧？

english: Don't tell me you lost that book!
translation: 别告诉我你把那本书弄丢了！

english: Er, yes, I lost your book...
translation: 呃，是的，我把你的书弄丢了……

english: Lucky that I have another copy, isn't it? Please don't lose it again.
translation: 幸好我还有另一本，对吧？请别再弄丢了。

english: I can't seem to find your schematics... Did you lose them down in the mines again?
translation: 我好像找不到你的示意图……你是不是又丢在矿洞里了？

english: Oh, let's see... well... maybe. I'm not altogether sure where I left them.
translation: 哦，让我想想……嗯……也许吧。我完全记不得放在哪了。

english: No idea at all?
translation: 一点印象都没有？

english: Sorry, no... I do not even remember what I drew them on.
translation: 抱歉，没有……我甚至不记得画在哪上面了。

english: I found your schematics! You wrote them down on one of the pages of that book you gave me!
translation: 我找到你的示意图了！你把它写在你给我的那本书的其中一页上了！

english: Oh, of course, why didn't I think of that!
translation: 哦，当然了，我怎么没想到！

english: Do you have any schematics related to the dwarven multicannon?
translation: 你有关于矮人连发大炮的示意图吗？

english: Why, what do you need them for?
translation: 嗯？你要它们做什么？

english: Ah, so you do!
translation: 啊，那你就是有咯！

english: Dondakan needs schematics to modify his multicannon, to fire a human you see.
translation: 东达坎需要示意图来改装他的连发大炮，用来发射人类。

english: And you'd be the test subject? I mean, the cannonball?
translation: 而你就是那个测试对象？我的意思是，那个炮弹？

english: Ehm, yes, I suppose so...
translation: 呃，是的，我想是吧……

english: Haha, that I would like to see!
translation: 哈哈，那真是我想看到的！

english: Here, take this. Khorvak sent it to me from White Wolf Mountain, kind of as a joke. It's incomplete, of course, doesn't mean anything without other parts.
translation: 给你，拿着这个。科瓦克从白狼山寄给我的，算是个玩笑。当然，这不完整，没有其他部分就没有任何意义。

english: Haha, he's always a laugh, that Khorvak. Shooting humans out of cannons!
translation: 哈哈，科瓦克总是那么搞笑。用大炮发射人类！

english: Thanks... I suppose.
translation: 谢谢……我想是吧。

english: You wouldn't be able to carry them anyway, so why ask for them?
translation: 反正你也拿不动它们，所以为什么要问呢？

english: Yes, and I already gave a part to you, remember?
translation: 是啊，而且我已经给过你一部分了，记得吗？

english: Let me have a look at that!
translation: 让我看看那个！

english: This doesn't make any sense, it's all jumbled up! Sort it out, will you, don't torment an old dwarf with nonsensical drawings!
translation: 这根本说不通，全乱套了！整理好它，行吗？别用这些乱七八糟的图纸折磨一个老矮人！

english: I have that golden helmet you said I'd need, what else did you need again?
translation: 我有你说的那个金色头盔了，你还需要别的什么来着？

english: I still need those schematics to modify my cannon. It doesn't normally fire humans, you know.
translation: 我仍然需要那些改装大炮的示意图。你知道的，它平常不发射人类。

english: I think I have all the different parts of the schematics...
translation: 我想我收集齐了示意图的所有不同部分……

english: I've got your schematics... what else was I supposed to do?
translation: 我拿到你的示意图了……我接下来该做什么？

english: You'll need a golden helmet as well, if you want to survive the blast.
translation: 你还需要一个金色头盔，如果你想在爆炸中活下来的话。

english: I would prefer that, yes.
translation: 那当然最好不过了。

english: I've got your schematics all assembled, and I have that golden helmet as well!
translation: 我把你的示意图都组装好了，而且我也有那个金色头盔了！

english: Well, go ahead and wear your helmet! Won't protect your head if it's not on your head!
translation: 那好，戴上你的头盔吧！不戴在头上可保护不了你的脑袋！

english: Wonderful! These schematics look simple enough... are you ready for your quick trip through the rock then?
translation: 太棒了！这些示意图看起来够简单……你准备好快速穿越岩石了吗？

english: You may fire when ready!
translation: 你准备好就可以开火了！

english: Ah, such enthusiasm! Okay, here we go, let me have a look at those schematics and we'll get started.
translation: 啊，真有热情！好吧，我们开始吧，让我看看那些示意图，然后我们就动手。

english: I'm sorry, you will have to wait a moment, this schematic is more complex than I thought.
translation: 抱歉，你得等一下，这份示意图比我想象的要复杂。

english: Right, sitting comfortably?
translation: 好了，坐得舒服吗？

english: Er, not really, no...
translation: 呃，不怎么舒服……

english: Excellent, excellent, I'll get the cannon ready to fire then!
translation: 太好了，太好了，那我这就准备好大炮开火！

english: I'm starting to get second thoughts about this!
translation: 我开始有点后悔了！

english: Just think of all that gold!
translation: 想想那些金子吧！

english: I'm thinking of that demon...
translation: 我在想那个恶魔……

english: Don't worry, it'll all be over in a moment!
translation: 别担心，马上就结束了！

english: That's what I'm afraid of.
translation: 我就是怕这个。

english: Where... where am I?
translation: 我……我在哪？

english: Dondakan said there was supposed to be a river behind the rock... but I don't see a river here.
translation: 东达坎说岩石后面应该有条河……但我没看到这里有河。

english: I think... I think... I think I may be...
translation: 我想……我想……我想我可能……

english: ...inside the rock!
translation: ……在岩石里面！

english: You are in my domain now! Begone lest you wish to be destroyed!
translation: 你现在在我的领域里！滚开，否则你将被毁灭！

english: What? What was that?
translation: 什么？那是什么？

english: Ow, my poor head... this helmet seems heavier than ever!
translation: 啊，我可怜的头……这头盔感觉比以往更重了！

english: Ready as I'll ever be...
translation: 我准备好了……

english: Okay, here we go, let me have a look at those schematics and we'll get started.
translation: 好吧，我们开始吧，让我看看那些示意图，然后我们就动手。

english: Err, maybe another time, I have some important business to attend to.
translation: 呃，也许下次吧，我有点重要的事情要处理。

english: So, tell me! What did you see inside! Is there any gold in there?
translation: 那么，告诉我！你在里面看到了什么！里面有金子吗？

english: Yes... gold, yes...
translation: 有……金子，有……

english: Haha, wonderful!
translation: 哈哈，太好了！

english: I ehm, also ran into this spirit thing. You remember, from the book?
translation: 呃，我还遇到了那个灵魂的东西。你记得吧，书里提到的？

english: Ran into him? How do you mean?
translation: 遇到他？什么意思？

english: The rock... seems to be a lot larger than it appears on the outside. I was actually able to walk around in there. But it was like... walking around in a dream.
translation: 那块岩石……看起来比外表要大得多。我实际上能在里面走动。但就像……在梦里行走一样。

english: And this spirit you speak of? Was it guarding the gold?
translation: 你说的这个灵魂呢？它在守护金币吗？

english: I'm not quite sure, it all seems so distant now.
translation: 我不太确定，现在一切都显得那么遥远。

english: Well, if it is, that must mean you must kill it! Simple!
translation: 嗯，如果是的话，那就意味着你必须杀了它！简单！

english: Right. Kill it. Simple. Okay.
translation: 好的。杀了它。简单。好吧。

english: So are you ready to have another go in the rock?
translation: 所以你准备好再进岩石一次了吗？

english: Not without wearing your golden helmet you're not!
translation: 不戴上你的金色头盔可不行！

english: Okay, here we go, hold on to your helmet!
translation: 好了，我们出发，抓紧你的头盔！

english: Stop what you're doing or taste my wrath!
translation: 住手，否则尝尝我的怒火！

english: Do not touch what is not yours!
translation: 别碰不属于你的东西！

english: I would not do that again if I were you!
translation: 我要是你，就不会再这么做了！

english: You are bringing doom down on yourself!
translation: 你是在自取灭亡！

english: You did not heed my messages to stay away! You have brought doom down on to yourself!
translation: 你没有听从我的警告远离！你这是自取灭亡！

english: There are many aspects to my being and there are many skills I possess.
translation: 我的存在有很多方面，我拥有许多技能。

english: You, I can see, are a skilled warrior. Yet your might is no match for my magic!
translation: 我看得出，你是个技艺精湛的战士。但你的力量无法与我的魔法抗衡！

english: You are an able ranger, yet that is useless against my might!
translation: 你是个能干的射手，但这对我的力量毫无用处！

english: Your magical abilities are impressive, but my powers of archery will foil them!
translation: 你的魔法能力令人印象深刻，但我的箭术力量会挫败它们！

english: Behold, as my avatar descends to your level to extinguish the flame of your puny existence!
translation: 看啊，我的化身降临到你面前，熄灭你渺小存在的火焰！

english: I am invincible! You stand no chance against me!
translation: 我是无敌的！你不可能赢我！

english: You are no match for me!
translation: 你不是我的对手！

english: And while your power is great, mortal, I will still resist you!
translation: 凡人，尽管你的力量强大，但我仍会抵抗你！

english: Your puny efforts cannot harm me!
translation: 你渺小的努力伤不了我！

english: Give up and resign yourself to your death!
translation: 放弃吧，接受你的死亡！

english: The whole cave was shaking! What happened in there?
translation: 整个洞穴都在震动！里面发生了什么？

english: I em... let me just collect my thoughts. It all seems like a sort of distant dream now.
translation: 呃…让我理一下思绪。现在一切都像一场遥远的梦。

english: I think I killed the Arzinian demon thing.
translation: 我想我杀了那个阿兹尼亚恶魔的东西。

english: What, you actually killed him?
translation: 什么，你真的杀了他？

english: Well, I killed its avatar. I'm not sure what happened to the demon itself.
translation: 嗯，我杀了它的化身。我不确定恶魔本身怎么样了。

english: Probably banished it to some hellish realm or other.
translation: 可能是把它放逐到某个地狱领域之类的地方了。

english: He'll be back, but not for a few thousand years, I'm sure.
translation: 他会回来的，但肯定不是几千年内。

english: But in the mean time, there's plenty of gold for me!
translation: 但与此同时，这里有足够的金币给我！

english: For us.
translation: 给我们。

english: Of course, of course! Whenever you want to go back in there, let me know... just don't forget to bring your helmet!
translation: 当然，当然！你什么时候想回去，告诉我…别忘了带上你的头盔！

english: And here, have this rune pickaxe as well, I can just use a normal one now anyway.
translation: 还有，这个符文镐也给你，反正我现在用普通的就行了。

english: No no, thank you! After all these years, the riddle of the rock has finally been cracked!
translation: 不，不，谢谢你！这么多年了，岩石之谜终于解开了！

english: Erk! Da's a yukky chompy, I's wants a yummie chompy!
translation: 呃！这食人鸟真恶心，我要好吃的食人鸟！

english: Hey you creature... Have you made me da stabbers? I wanna stick da chompy?
translation: 嘿，你这生物……你给我做好戳戳棒了吗？我要戳食人鸟！

english: Er not exactly?
translation: 呃，还没？

english: You do stabbers quick quick! Or Rantz make stabbers for Rantz and then practice for chompy sticking on creature!
translation: 你快快做戳戳棒！不然兰茨就自己给自己做戳戳棒，然后拿你这生物练习戳食人鸟！

english: How do I make the 'stabbers' again?
translation: 我该怎么做‘戳戳棒’来着？

english: Grrr creature... you's no good stabber maker! You's make da stabbie bit from da dog bones, and get da sticksies from da Achey tree... simple see? Oh and da flufsies from da flappers as well!
translation: 哼，生物……你根本不会做戳戳棒！你要用狗骨头做戳戳头，从阿奇树上拿棍棍……简单吧？哦，还要从扑扑鸟身上拿毛毛！

english: Oh, so I need logs from the achey tree, bones from a canine... and feathers?
translation: 哦，所以我需要阿奇树的原木、犬科动物的骨头……还有羽毛？

english: Is just what Rantz sayed!~ The hulking ogre nods excitedly. ~
translation: 兰茨说的就是这个！~ 高大的食人魔兴奋地点点头。 ~

english: Ok, I'll make the 'stabbers' for you.
translation: 好吧，我来给你做‘戳戳棒’。

english: Good creature, quickly, hurry bring da stabbers!
translation: 好生物，快点，快把戳戳棒拿来！

english: Hey you Creature, Dad says you's is gonna get da stabbers!
translation: 嘿，你这生物，爸爸说你会拿戳戳棒来！

english: That's right... I'm making some 'stabbers' for Rantz.
translation: 没错……我在给兰茨做‘戳戳棒’。

english: Dat's great...Dad want's to hunt da chompy... Da chompy is our bestest yumms! Yous needies da scratchers for makin' dem huh? I's wants some bright pretties for em!
translation: 太好了……爸爸想去猎食人鸟……食人鸟是我们最好吃的美味！你需要刮刮棒来做它们对吧？我想要些亮闪闪的漂亮东西来换！

english: How many 'bright pretties' do you want?
translation: 你想要多少‘亮闪闪的漂亮东西’？

english: Bugs wants lots of bright pretties, this many!~ Bugs quickly opens and closes his hands in front ~ ~ of you to indicate a number of bright pretties. ~ ~ It looks like he wants 10 gold coins.~
translation: 巴格斯要好多亮闪闪的漂亮东西，这么多！~ 巴格斯在你面前快速张开又合拢双手， ~ ~ 表示亮闪闪漂亮东西的数量。 ~ ~ 看起来他想要10个金币。~

english: Ok, I'll give you 10 bright pretties.
translation: 好吧，我给你10个亮闪闪的漂亮东西。

english: You's not got da bright pretties... I wants da bright pretties..you not get no scratchers wid'out da bright pretties.
translation: 你没有亮闪闪的漂亮东西……我要亮闪闪的漂亮东西……没有亮闪闪的漂亮东西你就别想拿到刮刮棒。

english: Ok, dat's a good 'un, I got da bright pretties and you got da scratchers!
translation: 好，这不错，我拿到了亮闪闪的漂亮东西，你拿到了刮刮棒！

english: Er, sorry, I can't give you that many...
translation: 呃，抱歉，我不能给你那么多……

english: Well, you not have da scratchers den!
translation: 哼，那你别想拿到刮刮棒了！

english: I's sorry creature, I don't got no more scratchers! But I got lots of bright pretties! Hope you's get da stabbers for Dad soonly!
translation: 对不起，生物，我没有更多刮刮棒了！但我有很多亮闪闪的漂亮东西！希望你快点给爸爸拿到戳戳棒！

english: Hey you Creature, I know's what you is You's a 'uman!
translation: 嘿，你这生物，我知道你是什么了！你是个人类！

english: That's right... and I'm making some 'stabbers' for Rantz.
translation: 没错……我在给兰茨做‘戳戳棒’。

english: Dat's great...Dad want's to hunt da chompy... Da chompy is our bestest yumms! You needsing flufsies for stabbers, Fycie have some but I is wanting some bright pretties for em!
translation: 太好了……爸爸想去猎食人鸟……食人鸟是我们最好吃的美味！做戳戳棒需要毛毛，菲西有一些，但我想要些亮闪闪的漂亮东西来换！

english: Mee's wants lots of bright pretties, this many!~ Fycie quickly opens and closes her hands in front ~ ~ of you to indicate a number of bright pretties. ~ ~ It looks like she wants 50 gold coins.~
translation: 我要好多亮闪闪的漂亮东西，这么多！~ 菲西在你面前快速张开又合拢双手， ~ ~ 表示亮闪闪漂亮东西的数量。 ~ ~ 看起来她想要50个金币。~

english: Ok, I'll give you 50 bright pretties.
translation: 好吧，我给你50个亮闪闪的漂亮东西。

english: You's not got da bright pretties... I wants da bright pretties..you not get no flufsies wid'out da bright pretties.
translation: 你没有亮闪闪的漂亮东西……我要亮闪闪的漂亮东西……没有亮闪闪的漂亮东西你就别想拿到毛毛。

english: Ok, dat's a good 'un, I got da bright pretties and you got da flufsies!
translation: 好，这不错，我拿到了亮闪闪的漂亮东西，你拿到了毛毛！

english: Well, you not have da flufsies den!
translation: 哼，那你别想拿到毛毛了！

english: I's sorry creature, I don't got no more flufsies! But I got lots of bright pretties! Hope you's get da stabbers for Dad soonly!
translation: 对不起，生物，我没有更多毛毛了！但我有很多亮闪闪的漂亮东西！希望你快点给爸爸拿到戳戳棒！

english: Hey you creature..you made da stabbers Dat's good creature!
translation: 嘿，你这生物……你做好戳戳棒了？好生物！

english: Hey, deese stabbers no good... did you make dem you's self? You go make dem stabbers for me creature! Don't get old ones or from other creatures.
translation: 嘿，这些戳戳棒不好……是你自己做的吗？你给我去做戳戳棒，生物！别拿旧的，也别拿别的生物做的。

english: Well, yes actually, as you asked so nicely. Here you go! Here's your 'stabbers'.
translation: 嗯，其实是的，既然你问得这么客气。给你！这是你的‘戳戳棒’。

english: Dat's not enough, me's an good shot, but need some for practice. Bring more than fingers on hand…
translation: 不够，我枪法好，但需要一些来练习。带比手指头还多的来……

english: Hey, 'dee'se stabbers no good! Did you make dem you's self? YOU go make dem arrows for ME creature!
translation: 嘿，这些戳戳棒不好！是你自己做的吗？你给我去做箭，生物！

english: Dat's not enough, me's an good shot, but need some for practice. Bring more than fingers on hand...
translation: 不够，我枪法好，但需要一些来练习。带比手指头还多的来……

english: Ahh, der creature has dem... goodly, goodly. Now us can stick der chompy bird...
translation: 啊，那生物拿到了……好，好。现在我们可以戳食人鸟了……

english: But da chompy not coming without da fatsy toadies... Godda get der fatsy toadies to get da chompys. Den we put it over de're and sneaky, sneaky stick da chompy.
translation: 但没有肥肥蛤蟆，食人鸟就不会来。得弄到肥肥蛤蟆才能引来食人鸟。然后我们把它放在那边，偷偷地，偷偷地戳食人鸟。

english: How do we make the chompys come?
translation: 我们怎么才能让食人鸟来？

english: Chompys love da fatsy toadies. Toadies get big on der swamp gas and der chompys are licking der lips for em as me is licking lips for da chompy. Da chompys don't like da smaller toadies from nearby swampy.
translation: 食人鸟最爱肥肥蛤蟆。蛤蟆靠沼泽气长得肥，食人鸟馋得流口水，就像我馋食人鸟一样。食人鸟不喜欢附近沼泽里的小蛤蟆。

english: Dey's fussie eaters just like Rantz. Fycie an' Bugs play with toadies and blower dey's all times making fatsy toadies.
translation: 它们和兰茨一样挑食。菲西和巴格斯总跟蛤蟆玩，用吹气筒把它们吹成肥肥蛤蟆。

english: What are 'fatsy toadies'?
translation: 什么是‘肥肥蛤蟆’？

english: Fatsy toadies are da chompy burds bestest yumms. But da toadies here are too small for da chompy. You've godda make da toadies big and round!
translation: 肥肥蛤蟆是食人鸟最好吃的美味。但这儿的蛤蟆太小了，食人鸟看不上。你得把蛤蟆弄大弄圆！

english: Where do we put the 'fatsy toadies'?
translation: 我们把‘肥肥蛤蟆’放在哪里？

english: Over der!
translation: 那边！

english: Ok creature? You got dat? Over dere by der no tree's place.
translation: 明白了吗，生物？那边，没有树的那块地方。

english: What do you mean 'sneaky..sneaky, stick the chompy?'
translation: 你说的‘偷偷地，偷偷地，戳食人鸟’是什么意思？

english: Duh! You creature is a bit stoopid yes? Us needs to sneaky, sneaky and stick da chompy! Den we can eat da chompy!
translation: 啧！你这生物有点笨是吧？我们要偷偷地，偷偷地，然后戳食人鸟！然后就能吃食人鸟了！

english: Creature already given Rantz stabbers, Dey's worser at flying dan a dead dog.
translation: 生物已经给了兰茨戳戳棒，它们飞得比死狗还差。

english: Hey you creature, you still here?
translation: 嘿，你这生物，你还在这儿？

english: Da chompy still not coming! We need da fatsy toady to get da chompy, do you got it? Do you got da fatsy toady? Then we can sneaky, sneaky stick da chompy.
translation: 食人鸟还是不来！我们需要肥肥蛤蟆来引食人鸟，你有了吗？你有肥肥蛤蟆吗？然后我们就可以偷偷地，偷偷地戳食人鸟了。

english: No I haven't got the 'fatsy toady' yet!
translation: 不，我还没有‘肥肥蛤蟆’！

english: Dat's a pidy... but maybe Rantz can help da creature?
translation: 真可惜……但也许兰茨能帮帮这生物？

english: Rantz said that you play with the 'fatsy toadies', what are they?
translation: 兰茨说你们玩‘肥肥蛤蟆’，那是什么？

english: Oh we sometimes use da blower on da toadies but Dad don't let us get in da locked box no more. He, he, it was good fun making da toadies fat on da swamp gas.
translation: 哦，我们有时候用吹气筒吹蛤蟆，但爸爸不让我们再进那个锁着的箱子了。嘿嘿，用沼泽气把蛤蟆吹肥真好玩。

english: Oh we sometimes is using blower on da toadies but Dad don't let us get in da locksy bocksy no more. He, he, big chuklees when make da toadies fat on da swampy gas.
translation: 哦，我们有时候用吹气筒吹蛤蟆，但爸爸不让我们再进那个锁着的箱子了。嘿嘿，用沼泽气把蛤蟆吹肥，笑得肚子疼。

english: Humph!
translation: 哼！

english: I guess this is what an ogre would call a locked chest.
translation: 我猜这就是食人魔所谓的锁着的箱子。

english: Yes, I have a 'fatsy toady' for you, here look!
translation: 是的，我有一个‘肥肥蛤蟆’给你，看这里！

english: Dat's a good fatsy toady, now we's need to put it for da chompy to come.
translation: 好肥的蛤蟆，现在我们要把它放好，让食人鸟来。

english: Where should I put the 'fatsy toadies'?
translation: 我应该把‘肥肥蛤蟆’放在哪里？

english: Over 'dere creature, put da toadies over der!~ The ogre points to a clearing to the south. ~
translation: 那边，生物，把蛤蟆放那边！~ 食人魔指向南边的一块空地。 ~

english: Hey creature got da fatsy toady Is you's gonna stick da chompy?
translation: 嘿，生物拿到肥肥蛤蟆了？你要去戳食人鸟吗？

english: You's better talk to Dad, he might have something for you to do.
translation: 你最好跟爸爸谈谈，他可能有事要你做。

english: You's better talk to Dad, him chasey sneaky chompy.
translation: 你最好跟爸爸谈谈，他在追偷偷的食人鸟。

english: There you go, I've placed the bait.
translation: 好了，我已经放好诱饵了。

english: Goodz, me now waits for da chompy! It shouldn't be long now. Sneaky... sneaky...
translation: 好，我现在等食人鸟来！应该不会太久。偷偷地……偷偷地……

english: Yes, I know... stick da chompy!
translation: 是的，我知道……戳食人鸟！

english: Hey, you's creature, is da fatsy toady still dere? Go get more fatsy toadies if dey all gone!
translation: 嘿，你这生物，肥肥蛤蟆还在吗？如果没了，再去弄些肥肥蛤蟆来！

english: What? I have to get more bait if there's none there? Does this Chompy Bird even exist I wonder?
translation: 什么？如果那里没有诱饵了，我还得再去弄？这食人鸟到底存不存在啊？

english: Hey, dere's da chompy, I's gonna shoot it.
translation: 嘿，食人鸟来了，我要射它了。

english: Grrr...de'ese arrows are rubbish.
translation: 哼……这些箭真垃圾。

english: Hey there, you keep missing the chompy bird.
translation: 嘿，你老是射不中食人鸟。

english: I knows, I keeps missing... because your stabbers are worserer at flying than a dead dog.
translation: 我知道，我老是射不中……因为你的戳戳棒飞得比死狗还差。

english: Oh, keep trying then... you might hit one through pure luck.
translation: 哦，那继续试试吧……说不定纯靠运气能射中一只。

english: Grrrr... You lookin' like a chompy!
translation: 哼……你看起来像只食人鸟！

english: Come on, let me have a go...
translation: 来吧，让我试试……

english: No, is Rantz stabby thrower... you too weedy...
translation: 不行，这是兰茨的戳戳投掷器……你太弱了……

english: I'm actually quite strong... please let me try.
translation: 我其实挺强壮的……请让我试试。

english: Oh, ok...I lend you other stabby thrower... but creature don't better cry when it hurts itself.
translation: 哦，好吧……我借你另一个戳戳投掷器……但生物弄伤自己时可别哭。

english: Oh suit yourself, you'll just have to go hungry.
translation: 哦，随你便，那你只能饿肚子了。

english: Or I eat you instead!
translation: 那我就吃你！

english: Yeah, it's a goodly stabbie chucker, but you's is too weedy to use it like Rantz.
translation: 是啊，这是个好戳戳投掷器，但你太弱了，用不了像兰茨那样。

english: Hey You! Got da chompy yet?
translation: 嘿！打到食人鸟了吗？

english: Not yet!
translation: 还没！

english: Well hurry up and get some, we is hungry!
translation: 那就快点弄些来，我们饿了！

english: Hey, Rantz, I've lost the 'stabbie chucker', do you have another one please?
translation: 嘿，兰茨，我把‘戳戳投掷器’弄丢了，你能再给我一个吗？

english: Mee's has, but is not for freeness, dis one cost [500-549] of da gold coinses. Does you wants it?
translation: 我有，但不是免费的，这个要 [500-549] 个金币。你要吗？

english: Yes, I'll buy the bow.
translation: 是的，我买这把弓。

english: Hey you don't got da coins...come back when you have.
translation: 嘿，你没有金币……有了再来。

english: Yep, here's your chompy Bird!
translation: 嗯，这是你的食人鸟！

english: Dat's a great chompy, you musta got a lucky shot wiv da stabbie chucker.
translation: 好大的食人鸟，你一定是运气好，用戳戳投掷器射中了。

english: Okay's now you's needs to cook da chompy! Slurp! You's can cook it's over der!~ Rantz points to a nearby spit roast. ~
translation: 好了，现在你得把食人鸟烤了！吸溜！你可以在那边烤！~ 兰茨指向附近的叉烤肉。 ~

english: But's we's particular about our chompy yumms. Me's wants Onion. wiv mine! Fycie and Bugs want something wiv der's as well, go and ask 'em wat dey want.
translation: 但我们对自己的食人鸟美味很挑剔。我的要配洋葱！菲西和巴格斯也要配点东西，去问问他们想要什么。

english: What! Now I've got the chompy bird, you expect me to cook it as well?
translation: 什么！我好不容易弄到食人鸟，你还指望我把它烤了？

english: Yep, da spit's over der! Last time Rantz did yummies, got very bad, did bad things to food...and belly.
translation: 是啊，叉烤架在那边！上次兰茨做美味，搞砸了，把食物……和肚子都弄坏了。

english: HUH!
translation: 哼！

english: Okay's now you's needs to cook da chompy! Slurp! You's can cook it's over der! <col=0000ff>~ Rantz points to a nearby spit roast. ~
translation: 好了，现在你得把食人鸟烤了！吸溜！你可以在那边烤！<col=0000ff>~ 兰茨指向附近的叉烤肉。 ~

english: Yep, da spit's over der! Last time Rantz did yummies, got very bad, did bad things to food... and belly.
translation: 是啊，叉烤架在那边！上次兰茨做美味，搞砸了，把食物……和肚子都弄坏了。

english: But's we's particular about our chompy yumms. Me's wants Potato wiv mine! Fycie and Bugs want something wiv der's as well, go and ask 'em wat dey want.
translation: 但我们对自己的食人鸟美味很挑剔。我的要配土豆！菲西和巴格斯也要配点东西，去问问他们想要什么。

english: Dad say's you's making da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's has to have equa leaves wiv mine! Chompy is our favourite yummms!
translation: 爸爸说你给我们做食人鸟！吸溜！我的那份一定要加伊库瓦叶！食人鸟是我们最喜欢的美味！

english: Dad say's you's making da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's has to have cabbage wiv mine! Chompy is our favourite yummms!
translation: 爸爸说你给我们做食人鸟！吸溜！我的那份一定要加卷心菜！食人鸟是我们最喜欢的美味！

english: Dad say's you's roastling da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's wants tomato wiv mine! Yummy, can't wait to eats it.
translation: 爸爸说你给我们烤食人鸟！吸溜！我的那份要加番茄！好吃，等不及要吃了。

english: Dad say's you's roastling da chompy for us! Slurp! Me's wants doogle leaves wiv mine! Yummy, can't wait to eats it.
translation: 爸爸说你给我们烤食人鸟！吸溜！我的那份要加杜格尔叶！好吃，等不及要吃了。

english: Have you talked to Dad, he might have something for you to do.
translation: 你跟我爸谈过了吗？他可能有事情要你做。

english: Go talk to Dad, him chasey sneaky chompy.
translation: 去和我爸谈谈，他在追那只狡猾的食人鸟。

english: Hey creature, did you's get da cooked chompy yet? I smelled something cooking and it mades me 'ungry. Hand over da chompy if ya know what's good for ya.
translation: 嘿，生物，你拿到熟食人鸟肉了吗？我闻到有东西在烹饪，让我饿了。如果你知道什么对你好，就把食人鸟交出来。

english: Yes, here you go, here's your cooked chompy bird.
translation: 是的，给你，这是你的熟食人鸟肉。

english: Hey hey! We got da delicious chompy bird - yay! This looks really tasty as well!
translation: 嘿嘿！我们有美味的食人鸟了——耶！这看起来也很好吃！

english: Tank's very much for da chompy... Fycie an Bugs like very much da chompy yumms!~ The family of ogres sit down together and enjoy your well cooked chompy bird. ~
translation: 非常感谢你的食人鸟……菲西和巴格斯非常喜欢美味的食人鸟！~食人魔一家坐在一起享用你精心烹制的熟食人鸟肉。~

english: It's my pleasure!
translation: 这是我的荣幸！

english: Good day to you, Elena.
translation: 你好，埃琳娜。

english: You too, thanks for freeing me.
translation: 你也好，谢谢你救了我。

english: It's just a shame the mourners confiscated my equipment.
translation: 可惜的是哀悼者没收了我的装备。

english: What did they take?
translation: 他们拿走了什么？

english: My distillator. I can't test any plague samples without it. They're holding it in the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne.
translation: 我的蒸馏器。没有它我就无法检测任何瘟疫样本。他们把它扣在西阿多尼城的哀悼者总部。

english: I must somehow retrieve that distillator if I am to find a cure for this awful affliction. Do you think you could help me?
translation: 如果我想找到这种可怕疾病的解药，就必须想办法取回那个蒸馏器。你觉得你能帮我吗？

english: Of course I can help. Where do we start?
translation: 我当然能帮忙。我们从哪里开始？

english: I was hoping you would say that. Unfortunately they discovered the tunnel and filled it in. We need another way over the wall.
translation: 我就等你这句话。不幸的是，他们发现了那条隧道并把它填上了。我们需要另找办法翻过那堵墙。

english: Any ideas?
translation: 有什么主意吗？

english: My father's friend Jerico is in communication with West Ardougne. He might be able to help us. He lives in a house south east of here, north of the chapel.
translation: 我父亲的朋友杰里科与西阿多尼城有联络。他或许能帮我们。他住在这东南方的一栋房子里，就在礼拜堂北边。

english: I'm busy at the moment, I'm afraid.
translation: 我恐怕现在正忙着。

english: Hello Jerico.
translation: 你好，杰里科。

english: Hello, I've been expecting you. Elena tells me you need to cross the wall.
translation: 你好，我一直在等你。埃琳娜告诉我你需要翻过那堵墙。

english: My messenger pigeons help me communicate with friends over the wall.
translation: 我的信鸽帮助我与墙那边的朋友们通信。

english: I have arranged for two of them to aid you with a rope ladder. Omart is waiting for you at the southern end of the wall.
translation: 我已经安排其中两只来帮你弄一条绳梯。奥马特在墙的南端等你。

english: But be careful, if the mourners catch you, the punishment will be severe.
translation: 但要小心，如果哀悼者抓住你，惩罚会很严厉。

english: Thanks Jerico.
translation: 谢谢你，杰里科。

english: Hello again. Have you spoken to Omart yet?
translation: 又见面了。你和奥马特谈过了吗？

english: You'll find him at the southern end of the wall. Keep an eye out for them mourners.
translation: 你会在墙的南端找到他。注意那些哀悼者。

english: I don't need any more bird feed.
translation: 我不再需要鸟饲料了。

english: Mmm, bird feed! Now what could I do with that?
translation: 嗯，鸟饲料！我可以用它来做什么呢？

english: Omart, Jerico said you might be able to help me.
translation: 奥马特，杰里科说你可能能帮我。

english: He informed me of your problem traveller. I would be glad to help, I have a rope ladder and my associate, Kilron, is waiting on the other side.
translation: 他告诉了我你的问题，旅行者。我很乐意帮忙，我有一条绳梯，我的同伴基尔隆在另一边等着。

english: Unfortunately we can't risk it with the watchtower so close. So first we need to distract the guards in the tower.
translation: 可惜的是瞭望塔离得太近，我们不能冒险。所以首先我们需要分散塔楼里守卫的注意力。

english: I reckon some of Jerico's pigeons might help us out here. Chuck some bird feed at the tower and then release some pigeons nearby. They should provide a nice distraction.
translation: 我觉得杰里科的一些鸽子也许能帮上我们。往塔那边扔些鸟饲料，然后在附近放几只鸽子。它们应该能制造不错的干扰。

english: Where do I get the bird feed and the pigeons?
translation: 我从哪里弄到鸟饲料和鸽子？

english: I'm sure Jerico can help you out with that if you ask him nicely.
translation: 如果你好好问他，我相信杰里科能帮你解决。

english: Hello. Have you sorted that distraction yet?
translation: 你好。你搞定干扰的事情了吗？

english: Try using some of Jerico's pigeons. Chuck some bird feed at the tower and then release some pigeons nearby. Jerico should be able to help you out.
translation: 试试用一些杰里科的鸽子。往塔那边扔些鸟饲料，然后在附近放几只鸽子。杰里科应该能帮你。

english: I have. He told me to ask you about some pigeons.
translation: 我试过了。他让我来问你鸽子的事。

english: Pigeons? What do you need my pigeons for?
translation: 鸽子？你要我的鸽子做什么？

english: Omart thought they'd make a good distraction for the guards.
translation: 奥马特觉得它们可以用来分散守卫的注意力。

english: Ahh, very clever. Well I'm sure I can let you borrow some, as long as you look after them. Just grab one of the cages from behind my house. You'll want some bird feed as well. I should have some in my cupboard.
translation: 啊，很聪明。好吧，我相信我可以借你一些，只要你照顾好它们。从我房子后面拿一个笼子就行。你还需要一些鸟饲料。我橱柜里应该有一些。

english: I probably shouldn't waste it by throwing it here.
translation: 我大概不该把它浪费在这里。

english: The guards are distracted by the birds, you must go now, quickly traveller.
translation: 守卫们被鸟分散了注意力，你现在必须走了，快，旅行者。

english: Well done, the guards are having real trouble with those birds. You must go now traveller, it's your only chance.
translation: 干得好，那些守卫被那些鸟搞得够呛。你现在必须走了，旅行者，这是你唯一的机会。

english: Okay, letsdo it.
translation: 好，我们开始吧。

english: I'd recommend you wear a gas mask before entering West Ardougne. You don't want to risk catching the plague.
translation: 我建议你进入西阿多尼城之前戴上防毒面具。你不想冒染上瘟疫的风险。

english: That would be wise. Thanks Omart.
translation: 说得对。谢了，奥马特。

english: Welcome to West Ardougne friend. I'm Kilron. Let me know if you want to go back over the wall.
translation: 欢迎来到西阿多尼城，朋友。我是基尔隆。如果你想翻回墙那边，告诉我一声。

english: Thanks Kilron. Do you know where to find the Mourner Headquarters?
translation: 谢了，基尔隆。你知道哀悼者总部在哪里吗？

english: It's the most north eastern building in the city. Be careful around there.
translation: 就是这座城市最东北面的那栋建筑。在那边要小心。

english: Don't take too long, those mourners will soon be rid of those birds.
translation: 别花太长时间，那些哀悼者很快就会赶走那些鸟。

english: Hello Omart.
translation: 你好，奥马特。

english: Hello traveller. Do you wish to cross the wall?
translation: 你好，旅行者。你想翻过那堵墙吗？

english: Okay, lets do it.
translation: 好，我们开始吧。

english: Hello Kilron.
translation: 你好，基尔隆。

english: Hello traveller. Do you need to go back over?
translation: 你好，旅行者。你需要回去吗？

english: Okay, quickly now!
translation: 好，快跟上！

english: Do you know where to find the Mourner Headquarters?
translation: 你知道哀悼者总部在哪里吗？

english: Not yet Kilron.
translation: 还没，基尔隆。

english: Okay, just give me the word.
translation: 好，随时告诉我。

english: Hello again Jerico.
translation: 又见面了，杰里科。

english: So you've returned traveller. Did you get what you wanted?
translation: 你回来了，旅行者。拿到你想要的东西了吗？

english: Omart will be waiting by the wall, in case you need to cross again.
translation: 奥马特会在墙边等着，以防你需要再次翻过去。

english: Ahh, very clever. Well I'm sure I can let you borrow some, as long as you look after them. Just grab one of the cages from behind my house.
translation: 啊哈，真聪明。好吧，只要你好好照看它们，我相信我可以借你一些。去我房子后面拿一个笼子吧。

english: Hmm. I wonder if there's another way in.
translation: 嗯。我想知道有没有别的入口。

english: Looks like a nice stew is being prepared. This must be to feed all of the mourners.
translation: 看起来正在准备一锅不错的炖菜。这肯定是要喂所有哀悼者的。

english: Anyone who eats this stew is going to have a bad time now.
translation: 现在谁吃了这炖菜，谁就要倒霉了。

english: Eugh, locked. There must be a way for me to get in. Maybe there's something around here that will help me.
translation: 呃，锁着。一定有什么办法让我进去。也许附近有什么东西能帮我。

english: Back away citizen. Several mourners are ill with food poisoning.
translation: 退后，市民。有几个哀悼者食物中毒了。

english: Is there a doctor nearby? Maybe I can go fetch them.
translation: 附近有医生吗？或许我能去请他们来。

english: There are no doctors in West Ardougne, just that nurse south west of the chapel. You don't need to worry though, we'll soon have it sorted.
translation: 西阿多尼城没有医生，只有礼拜堂西南边那个护士。不过你不用担心，我们很快就能搞定。

english: A doctor? I didn't think there were any left around here.
translation: 医生？我以为这附近没有医生了。

english: I heard there was some trouble with food poisoning here.
translation: 我听说这里出了食物中毒的麻烦。

english: You heard right. Head on in and see what you can do.
translation: 你听说了。进去看看你能做什么吧。

english: Oh dear oh dear. I feel terrible, I think it was the stew.
translation: 哎呀呀。我感觉糟透了，我想是那炖菜的问题。

english: You should be more careful with your ingredients.
translation: 你应该更注意你的食材。

english: There is one mourner who's really sick. They're resting upstairs. You should see to them first.
translation: 有一个哀悼者病得很重。他在楼上休息。你应该先去看他。

english: Okay, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好的，我去看看我能做什么。

english: A doctor? At last! I don't know what I've eaten but I feel like I'm on death's door.
translation: 医生？终于来了！我不知道吃了什么，但我觉得自己离死不远了。

english: Hmm... interesting, sounds like food poisoning.
translation: 嗯……有意思，听起来像是食物中毒。

english: Yes, I'd figured that out already. What can you give me to help.
translation: 对，我已经想到了。你能给我什么来帮忙？

english: Just hold your breath and count to ten.
translation: 只要屏住呼吸，数到十。

english: What? How will that help? What kind of doctor are you?
translation: 什么？那有什么用？你是什么医生？

english: Erm... I'm new, I just started.
translation: 呃……我是新手，刚入行。

english: You're no doctor!
translation: 你不是医生！

english: The best I can do is pray for you.
translation: 我最多只能为你祈祷。

english: Pray for me? You're no doctor... You're an imposter!
translation: 为我祈祷？你不是医生……你是冒牌货！

english: There's nothing I can do, it's fatal.
translation: 我无能为力，这是致命的。

english: No, I'm too young to die! I've never even had a girlfriend.
translation: 不，我还太年轻不能死！我甚至连女朋友都没交过。

english: Wait a minute, where's your equipment?
translation: 等一下，你的装备呢？

english: It's erm... at home.
translation: 呃……在家里。

english: Sorry, I'd like to be left in peace.
translation: 抱歉，我想一个人静一静。

english: You're back, did you find the distillator?
translation: 你回来了，找到蒸馏器了吗？

english: I can't test the samples without the distillator. Please don't give up until you find it.
translation: 没有蒸馏器我就无法测试样本。请别放弃，直到找到它。

english: Yes, here it is!
translation: 找到了，给你！

english: Great! Now I can finally run these tests.
translation: 太好了！现在我终于可以运行这些测试了。

english: I don't understand... the touch paper hasn't changed colour at all...
translation: 我不明白……引火纸完全没有变色……

english: I'm not sure. My old mentor in Varrock, Guidor, might know though. Could you take these to him and see what he thinks? You'll need to drop by the chemist in Rimmington first to pick up some more touch paper.
translation: 我不确定。但我在维洛克城的老导师吉多尔可能知道。你能把这些带给他，听听他的看法吗？你需要先顺路去里明顿村的化学家那里再拿一些引火纸。

english: Now, last time I went to see Guidor, some one told the guards I was carrying some plague samples. Annoyingly, that means they've started searching everyone going to that part of the city.
translation: 上次我去见吉多尔时，有人告诉守卫我携带了一些瘟疫样本。烦人的是，这意味着他们开始搜查所有前往城市那个区域的人。

english: Ironically, the guards won't be smart enough to recognise the sample itself, so you should be able to get that in just fine. They'll probably confiscate the rest though.
translation: 具有讽刺意味的是，守卫不够聪明，认不出样本本身，所以你带样本进去应该没问题。不过他们可能会没收其他东西。

english: So what do I do?
translation: 那我该怎么办？

english: Well I know the chemist has still been managing to get chemicals to Guidor. Maybe he can help you smuggle the things in.
translation: 我知道那个化学家仍然能设法把化学品运给吉多尔。也许他能帮你把东西偷运进去。

english: Great, I'll see if he can help. See you soon.
translation: 太好了，我去问问他能不能帮忙。回头见。

english: What are you doing back here?
translation: 你怎么又回来了？

english: I just find it hard to say goodbye sometimes.
translation: 我只是有时候觉得说再见很难。

english: I see... I understand what you mean... But let's discuss that later.
translation: 我明白了……我懂你的意思……但我们晚点再谈这个。

english: I'm afraid I've lost some of the stuff that you gave me...
translation: 恐怕我弄丢了一些你给我的神秘物质……

english: Are you sure? Looks like you have everything to me.
translation: 你确定吗？我看你好像都有。

english: That's alright, I've got plenty.
translation: 没关系，我还有很多。

english: There you go. That should be everything.
translation: 给，应该都齐了。

english: Great, I'll be on my way.
translation: 太好了，我这就出发。

english: I've forgotten what I need to do.
translation: 我忘了该做什么了。

english: Go to Rimmington and get some touch paper from the chemist. Once you've done that, you'll need to take those things to Guidor in Varrock.
translation: 去里明顿村，从化学家那里拿些引火纸。弄到之后，你得把这些东西送到维洛克城的吉多尔那里。

english: You'll probably need to smuggle some of the items in to stop them getting confiscated. If you need help moving them discreetly, the chemist might be able to assist you.
translation: 你可能需要偷运一些物品进去，以免被没收。如果需要帮忙悄悄转移，化学家或许能帮你一把。

english: Okay, I'll get to it.
translation: 好的，我这就去办。

english: Hello adventurer. I'm afraid it's too risky to use the ladder again. You'll have to find another way into the city.
translation: 你好，冒险者。恐怕再用梯子太冒险了。你得另找进城的方法。

english: Sorry, I'm afraid we're just closing now. You'll have to come back another time.
translation: 抱歉，我们正要关门了。你改天再来吧。

english: But I was sent by Elena from Ardougne.
translation: 但我是阿多尼城的埃琳娜派来的。

english: Oh, well that's different then. Must be pretty important for her to send you all this way.
translation: 哦，那就不一样了。她让你大老远跑来，看样子事情挺重要。

english: She asked me to pick up some touch paper for a guy called Guidor.
translation: 她让我帮一个叫吉多尔的人拿些引火纸。

english: Guidor? This one's on me then, I owe him more than a few favours.
translation: 吉多尔？那这次算我的，我欠他不少人情。

english: I should warn you though, getting to him might not be easy if you're carrying any chemicals. The guards are searching anyone heading to that part of Varrock.
translation: 不过我得提醒你，如果你带着化学品，去找他可不太容易。守卫会搜查所有前往维洛克城那个区域的人。

english: Oh right... so am I going to be okay carrying these three vials with me?
translation: 哦，好吧……那我带着这三瓶药水过去没问题吗？

english: With touch paper as well? You're asking for trouble. You'd better use my errand boys outside. Give them a vial each. I must warn you though, they do have a habit of stealing things.
translation: 还带着引火纸？你这是自找麻烦。最好用我外面的跑腿小弟。每人给一瓶药水。但我得提醒你，他们手脚不太干净。

english: Well that's no good. How do I stop them stealing my vials?
translation: 那可不行。怎么才能让他们不偷我的药水？

english: Just make sure you give them something they have no reason to steal. One's a painter, one's a gambler, and one's a drunk. Not ideal I know, but if you pay peanuts you'll get monkeys, right?
translation: 你只要给他们点他们没理由偷的东西就行。一个是画家，一个是赌徒，一个是酒鬼。我知道不理想，但一分钱一分货，对吧？

english: Now don't stand around here gassing. This is clearly important to Elena. You'll find Guidor's home in the south east corner of Varrock.
translation: 别在这儿瞎聊了。这对埃琳娜显然很重要。吉多尔的家在维洛克城东南角。

english: Okay, thanks for your help. I know Elena appreciates it.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。我知道埃琳娜会感激的。

english: Oh hello, do you need more touch paper?
translation: 哦，你好，还需要更多引火纸吗？

english: Fair enough, don't forget to talk to my errand boys outside if you need help getting things to Guidor. I must warn you though, they do have a habit of stealing things.
translation: 行吧，如果你需要帮忙把东西送给吉多尔，别忘了跟我外面的跑腿小弟说。但我得提醒你，他们手脚不太干净。

english: Don't forget to talk to my errand boys outside if you need help getting things to Guidor. I must warn you though, they do have a habit of stealing things.
translation: 如果你需要帮忙把东西送给吉多尔，别忘了跟我外面的跑腿小弟说。但我得提醒你，他们手脚不太干净。

english: Well that's no good. What if they take my stuff?
translation: 那可不行。他们要是拿走了我的东西怎么办？

english: Hello, I've got a vial for you to take to Varrock.
translation: 你好，我有瓶药水要你帮忙带到维洛克城。

english: Tssch... that chemist asks for a lot for the wages he pays.
translation: 切……那个化学家给的工钱少，要求还多。

english: Maybe you should ask him for more money.
translation: 也许你该找他多要点钱。

english: Nah... I just use my initiative here and there.
translation: 不……我就是偶尔自己动点脑筋。

english: Right. I'll meet you at the Dancing Donkey Inn in south east Varrock. Be lucky!
translation: 行。我会在维洛克城东南的舞驴酒馆等你。祝你好运！

english: Look, I've got your vial but I'm not taking two. I always like to play the percentages.
translation: 听着，我拿了你的药水，但我不拿两瓶。我向来喜欢算概率。

english: Hello, I hear you're an errand boy for the chemist.
translation: 你好，我听说你是化学家的跑腿小弟。

english: Well that's my job yes. But I don't necessarily define my identity in such black and white terms.
translation: 嗯，那确实是我的工作。但我不一定用这种非黑即白的方式定义自己。

english: Good for you. Now can you take a vial to Varrock for me?
translation: 真不错。那你能帮我带瓶药水去维洛克城吗？

english: Okay, I'll meet you at the Dancing Donkey in Varrock.
translation: 好的，我在维洛克城的舞驴酒馆等你。

english: Oh, it's you again. Please don't distract me now, I'm contemplating the sublime.
translation: 哦，又是你。请别打扰我，我正在思考崇高的事物。

english: Hi, I've got something for you to take to Varrock.
translation: 嗨，我有点东西要你帮忙带到维洛克城。

english: Sounds like pretty thirsty work.
translation: 听起来是件很口渴的差事。

english: Well, there's an Inn in Varrock if you're desperate.
translation: 嗯，维洛克城有家酒馆，你要是渴得不行可以去。

english: Don't worry, I'm a pretty resourceful fellow you know.
translation: 别担心，我可是个很有办法的人。

english: Okay, I'll see you in Varrock.
translation: 好的，我们在维洛克城见。

english: Sure, I'm a regular at the Dancing Donkey Inn as it happens.
translation: 当然，我正好是舞驴酒馆的常客。

english: I suppose I'd better get going. I'll meet you at the Dancing Donkey Inn.
translation: 我想我该出发了。我们舞驴酒馆见。

english: Halt. I need to conduct a search on you. There have been reports of someone bringing a virus into this area of Varrock.
translation: 站住。我需要对你进行搜查。有报告称有人将一种病毒带入了维洛克城的这个区域。

english: You may now pass.
translation: 你可以通过了。

english: Hi, thanks for doing that.
translation: 嗨，谢谢你帮忙。

english: No problem. I've got some money for you actually.
translation: 不客气。其实我还给你弄了点钱。

english: Well, it turns out that potion you gave me, was quite valuable...
translation: 嗯，结果你给我的那瓶药水还挺值钱的……

english: I know that I probably shouldn't have sold it... but some friends and I were having a little wager, the odds were just too good!
translation: 我知道我不该卖掉它……但几个朋友和我打了个小赌，赔率实在太诱人了！

english: You sold my vial and gambled with the money?!
translation: 你卖了我的药水，还拿钱去赌？！

english: Actually yes... but praise be to Saradomingbecause I won! So all's well that ends well right?
translation: 确实是这样……但赞美萨拉多明，我赢了！所以结果好就一切都好，对吧？

english: No! Nothing could be further from the truth!
translation: 不！这跟事实差远了！

english: Well, there's no pleasing some people. Here's your cut anyway.
translation: 唉，有些人真难伺候。反正这是你的那份。

english: You have no idea what you have just done!
translation: 你根本不知道自己做了什么！

english: Ignorance is bliss I'm afraid. Here's your cut anyway.
translation: 恐怕无知就是福。这是你的那份。

english: Next time give me something more valuable... I couldn't get anything for this on the blackmarket.
translation: 下次给我点更值钱的东西……这玩意儿我在黑市上换不到什么钱。

english: Actually yes... but praise be to Saradoming because I won! So all's well that ends well right?
translation: 其实是的……但赞美萨拉多明，因为我赢了！所以结局好就一切都好，对吧？

english: That was the idea.
translation: 这就是我的目的。

english: Hello again. I hope your journey was as pleasant as mine.
translation: 又见面了。希望你的旅途跟我一样愉快。

english: Yep. Anyway, I'll take the package off you now.
translation: 嗯。总之，我现在要取回包裹了。

english: Package? That's a funny way to describe a liquid of such exquisite beauty!
translation: 包裹？这么称呼一种如此精美的液体，真是有趣！

english: I'm getting a bad feeling about this.
translation: 我开始有种不祥的预感。

english: Just give me the stuff now please.
translation: 请现在就把神秘物质给我。

english: You do still have it don't you?
translation: 你还留着它，对吧？

english: Absolutely. It's just not stored in a vial anymore.
translation: 当然。只不过它不再装在小瓶里了。

english: Instead it has been liberated. It now gleams from the canvas of my latest epic: The Majesty of Varrock!
translation: 它被解放了。现在它在我最新的史诗画作《维洛克城的威严》的画布上闪闪发光！

english: That's great. Thanks to you I'll have to walk back to East Ardougne to get another vial.
translation: 真不错。托你的福，我得走回东阿多尼城再拿一瓶药水。

english: Well you can't put a price on art.
translation: 嗯，艺术是无价的。

english: Well, as they say, it's always sunny in Gielinor.
translation: 嗯，常言道，基利诺尔永远阳光明媚。

english: Okay, here it is.
translation: 好了，给你。

english: Thanks, you've been a big help.
translation: 谢谢，你帮了大忙。

english: Hello, how was your journey?
translation: 你好，旅途如何？

english: Pretty thirst-inducing actually...
translation: 其实挺让人口渴的……

english: Please tell me that you haven't drunk the contents...
translation: 请告诉我你没喝掉里面的东西……

english: Of course I can tell you that I haven't drunk the contents...
translation: 我当然可以告诉你我没喝掉里面的东西……

english: But I'd be lying. Sorry about that me old mucker, can I get you a drink?
translation: 但那就是在撒谎了。抱歉啊老兄，我请你喝一杯？

english: No, I think you've done enough for now.
translation: 不用了，我觉得你已经搞得够多了。

english: Oh the gods no! What do you take me for?
translation: 哦，众神在上，当然没有！你把我当什么人了？

english: Here's your vial anyway.
translation: 总之，这是你的药水。

english: Thanks, I'll let you get your drink now.
translation: 谢谢，你继续喝你的吧。

english: I should probably talk to Guidor before leaving the area. Otherwise I'll need to get my vials smuggled in again.
translation: 我应该在离开这个区域之前跟吉多尔谈谈。否则我又得想办法偷运药水进去了。

english: That's someone's bedroom. I'm not going in there without a reason.
translation: 那是别人的卧室。没有理由我不会进去。

english: Hello. I'm a friend of Elena, here to see Guidor.
translation: 你好。我是埃琳娜的朋友，来见吉多尔。

english: I'm afraid that Guidor is not long for this world! So I'm not letting people see him now.
translation: 恐怕吉多尔时日无多了！所以我不会让人见他。

english: I'm really sorry to hear about Guidor.
translation: 听到吉多尔的事我很难过。

english: But I do have some very important business to attend to!
translation: 但我有非常重要的事情要处理！

english: You heartless rogue! What could be more important than Guidor's life? A life spent well, if not always wisely... I just hope that Saradomin shows mercy on his soul!
translation: 你这个无情的盗贼！有什么事比吉多尔的性命更重要？他这一生虽不算总是明智，却也过得充实……我只希望萨拉多明能仁慈地对待他的灵魂！

english: Guidor is a religious man?
translation: 吉多尔是信徒吗？

english: Oh goodness no! But I am! If only I could get him to see a priest!
translation: 哦，天哪，不是！但我是啊！要是能让他去见祭司就好了！

english: A priest! thank goodness! My husband is very ill! Perhaps you could read him his last rites?
translation: 一个祭司！谢天谢地！我丈夫病得很重！也许你能给他念临终祈祷？

english: Hello, you must be Guidor. I understand that you are unwell.
translation: 你好，你一定是吉多尔了。我听说你身体不适。

english: Is my wife asking priests to visit me now? I'm a man of science for god's sake. I know she means well but it's only a little cough!
translation: 我妻子现在都让祭司来看我了？看在老天分上，我可是个科学人士。我知道她是好意，但只是有点咳嗽而已！

english: She made out it was something more serious.
translation: 她把它说得好像更严重。

english: Well it's not killed me yet. So what do you want?
translation: 嗯，它还没要了我的命。所以你想要什么？

english: I've come to ask your assistance in stopping a plague.
translation: 我是来请求你协助阻止瘟疫的。

english: You mean the plague of West Ardougne?
translation: 你是说西阿多尼城的瘟疫？

english: That's the one. I have a sample here from your former student, Elena.
translation: 就是那个。我这里有你以前的学生埃琳娜送来的样本。

english: Elena eh?
translation: 埃琳娜，嗯？

english: Yes, she wants you to analyse it. You might be the only one who can help.
translation: 是的，她想让你分析一下。你可能是唯一能帮忙的人。

english: Right then, sounds like we'd better get to work!
translation: 那好，听起来我们最好开始干活了！

english: I have the plague sample.
translation: 我有瘟疫样本。

english: Now I'll be needing some liquid honey, some sulphuric broline, and then...
translation: 现在我需要一些液态蜂蜜、一些硫酸溴林，然后……

english: ... some ethenea?
translation: ……一些乙醚？

english: Look, I need all three reagents to test the plague sample. Come back when you've got them.
translation: 听着，我需要全部三种试剂来测试瘟疫样本。等你拿齐了再回来吧。

english: Oh. You don't have any touch paper. I won't be able to help after all.
translation: 哦。你一张引火纸都没有。那我也帮不上忙了。

english: Seems like you don't actually have the plague sample. It's a long way to come empty handed... and quite a long way back too.
translation: 看来你其实并没有瘟疫样本。空手跑这么远……再跑回去也挺远的。

english: Now I'll just apply these to the sample and... I don't get it... the touch paper has remained the same.
translation: 现在我把这些试剂加到样本上……我不明白……引火纸一点变化都没有。

english: That's why Elena wanted you to do it, because she wasn't sure what was happening.
translation: 所以埃琳娜才让你来做这件事，因为她也不确定发生了什么。

english: Well that's just it, nothing has happened. I don't know what this sample is, but it certainly isn't toxic.
translation: 问题就在这，什么都没有发生。我不知道这个样本是什么，但它绝对没有毒。

english: So what about the plague?
translation: 那么瘟疫是怎么回事？

english: This result can only mean one thing... there is no plague. It seems that someone has been lying about all of it. The only question is... why?
translation: 这个结果只能说明一件事……根本没有瘟疫。看来有人一直都在撒谎。唯一的问题是……为什么？

english: Well this is worrying. I'd better go and tell Elena right away.
translation: 这可真让人担心。我最好马上去告诉埃琳娜。

english: I was just going to bless your room and I've done that now.
translation: 我本来想给你的房间祈福，现在已经弄好了。

english: Oh. Goodbye then.
translation: 哦。那再见了。

english: Hello again Guidor.
translation: 吉多尔，又见面了。

english: Well, hello traveller. I still can't understand why they would lie about the plague.
translation: 哦，你好，旅行者。我还是想不通他们为什么要对瘟疫撒谎。

english: It's strange, anyway how are you doing?
translation: 真是奇怪。话说回来，你还好吗？

english: Hello there. I fear Guidor may not be long for this world!
translation: 你好。恐怕吉多尔在世上时日不多了！

english: You're back! So what did Guidor say?
translation: 你回来了！吉多尔怎么说？

english: He ran his tests and discovered nothing. The plague... it doesn't exist.
translation: 他做了测试，什么都没发现。瘟疫……根本不存在。

english: Doesn't exist? But I don't understand... why?
translation: 不存在？但我不明白……为什么？

english: I don't know, but I think we're about to uncover something huge.
translation: 我不知道，但我觉得我们快要揭开一个大秘密了。

english: Well I think there's only one thing for it. The king must be confronted!
translation: 嗯，我觉得只有一个办法。必须去找国王对质！

english: The king?
translation: 国王？

english: Yes. King Lathas of East Ardougne. He was the one that had the wall built. He was the one who called the mourners in. He must know what's really going on here.
translation: 是的。东阿多尼城的拉萨斯国王。是他下令修建了那堵墙。是他召来了送葬者。他一定知道这里真正发生了什么。

english: Well I'd better go and speak to the king then.
translation: 那我最好去跟国王谈谈。

english: Be quick. You should find him in the castle.
translation: 快点去吧。你应该能在城堡里找到他。

english: Hello Elena.
translation: 你好，埃琳娜。

english: You must go and see King Lathas immediately!
translation: 你必须马上去见拉萨斯国王！

english: I assume that you are King Lathas of East Ardougne?
translation: 我猜你就是东阿多尼城的拉萨斯国王吧？

english: You assume correctly, but where do you get such impertinence.
translation: 你猜对了，但你哪来这么大的胆子？

english: I get it from finding out that the plague is a hoax.
translation: 因为我发现了瘟疫是个骗局。

english: A hoax? I've never heard such a ridiculous thing...
translation: 骗局？我从没听过这么荒唐的事……

english: I have evidence, from Guidor of Varrock.
translation: 我有证据，来自维洛克城的吉多尔。

english: Ah... I see. Well then you are right about the plague. But I did it for the good of my people.
translation: 啊……我明白了。好吧，你说得对，瘟疫是假的。但我这么做是为了我的人民好。

english: When is it ever good to lie to people like that?
translation: 对人民撒这样的谎，什么时候会是好事？

english: When it protects them from a far greater danger, a fear too big to fathom.
translation: 当这能保护他们免受更大危险的时候——一种大得无法想象的恐惧。

english: When my father was king, he ruled over a united Ardougne. But on his deathbed, he could not decide which of his sons should succeed him, so he had the city split into two.
translation: 当我父亲还是国王的时候，他统治着统一的阿多尼城。但他在临终时无法决定哪个儿子应该继承王位，于是他把城市分成了两半。

english: I became king of East Ardougne while my brother, Tyras, ruled over West Ardougne. My brother was a good man and was great at many things. Being a king was not one of them.
translation: 我成了东阿多尼城的国王，而我的兄弟泰拉斯统治着西阿多尼城。我兄弟是个好人，很多事情都很擅长，但做国王并不在其中。

english: Rather than looking after his people, he went on numerous expeditions to the lands west of here. On one of these expeditions, he was captured by the forces of the Dark Lord.
translation: 他没有照顾自己的人民，反而多次远征西边的土地。在一次远征中，他被黑暗领主的军队俘虏了。

english: The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity.
translation: 黑暗领主同意饶他一命，但有一个条件……他必须喝下永恒圣杯里的酒。

english: The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil...
translation: 圣杯腐蚀了他。他与黑暗领主——纯粹邪恶的化身——联手了……

english: And so I erected the wall, not just to protect my people, but to protect all the people of Gielinor. Tyras is king of West Ardougne, sealing off the city was the only way to stop him and the Dark Lord.
translation: 于是我建起了那堵墙，不仅是为了保护我的人民，也是为了保护整个基利诺尔的人民。泰拉斯是西阿多尼城的国王，封锁城市是阻止他和黑暗领主的唯一办法。

english: I knew people would never believe the truth, so I had the plague made up as an excuse for the cordon. I'm not proud of it, but it was the only way to keep people safe.
translation: 我知道人们永远不会相信真相，所以我编造了瘟疫作为封锁的借口。我并不以此为荣，但这是保护人们安全的唯一办法。

english: I see. Well at least I know now.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，至少我现在知道了。

english: While my brother is still at large, I must ask that you keep this secret. We can't bring the wall down until we know he is no longer a danger.
translation: 在我兄弟仍然逍遥法外的时候，我必须要求你保守这个秘密。在我们确定他不再构成威胁之前，我们不能拆掉那堵墙。

english: But how do we stop him?
translation: 但我们怎么阻止他呢？

english: You're willing to help? Gods be praised!
translation: 你愿意帮忙？神明保佑！

english: My brother is currently gathering strength in the lands to the west. If we are to stop him, we must find a way through the mountains. There is an underground pass that should lead through but it is full of danger.
translation: 我兄弟目前正在西边的土地集结力量。要阻止他，我们必须找到一条穿越山脉的路。有一条地下通道应该能通过去，但那里危机四伏。

english: Return to me when you are ready to face this peril. Until then, I give you permission to use my training area. It's located just to the north west of the city.
translation: 当你准备好面对这个危险时，回来找我。在此之前，我准许你使用我的训练场。它就在城市的西北方向。

english: I'll also let the mourners know that you are a friend to Ardougne. You will be allowed to pass through the gates to West Ardougne whenever you please. Now, you'd better be off. You have much to prepare for.
translation: 我还会让哀悼者们知道你是阿多尼城的朋友。你将可以随时通过大门进入西阿多尼城。好了，你该出发了。你还有很多要准备的。

english: Do you need anything else adventurer?
translation: 你还需要什么吗，冒险者？

english: Why don't I get started right away?
translation: 为什么不现在就开始呢？

english: Your enthusiasm is to be commended. Very well, if you feel you are already prepared then who am I to stop you.
translation: 你的热情值得赞扬。好吧，如果你觉得自己已经准备好了，那我有什么理由阻拦你呢。

english: As we've previously discussed, my brother is currently gathering strength in the lands west of here. The only known way into those lands is through the Underground Pass.
translation: 正如我们之前讨论过的，我兄弟目前正在西边的土地集结力量。已知进入那些土地的唯一途径就是通过地下通道。

english: Very well. Return to me once you are ready and we will discuss our next steps.
translation: 好吧。等你准备好了就回来找我，我们再讨论下一步。

english: Good day King Lathas.
translation: 日安，拉萨斯国王。

english: And to you adventurer. I assume you're here about King Tyras?
translation: 你也日安，冒险者。我猜你是为了泰拉斯国王的事来的吧？

english: I am. What's our plan?
translation: 是的。我们的计划是什么？

english: Well, as we've previously discussed, my brother is currently gathering strength in the lands west of here. The only known way into those lands is through the Underground Pass.
translation: 嗯，正如我们之前讨论过的，我兄弟目前正在西边的土地集结力量。已知进入那些土地的唯一途径就是通过地下通道。

english: Fair enough. Return to me when you are ready and we will discuss our next steps.
translation: 有道理。等你准备好了就回来找我，我们再讨论下一步。

english: Hey, how are you?
translation: 嘿，你好吗？

english: Good thanks, yourself?
translation: 很好，谢谢，你呢？

english: Not bad, did you speak to the king?
translation: 还行，你跟国王谈过了吗？

english: I did, he admitted the plague is a hoax.
translation: 谈过了，他承认瘟疫是个骗局。

english: Did he say why?
translation: 他说为什么了吗？

english: He did. He asked me to keep it a secret though.
translation: 他说了。不过他让我保密。

english: Even from me?
translation: 连我也不能告诉？

english: I'm afraid so. Don't worry though, I'm working with the king to resolve all of this.
translation: 恐怕不行。不过别担心，我正在和国王一起解决这件事。

english: I hope so. Even without the plague, I still worry about the people of West Ardougne.
translation: 希望如此。就算没有瘟疫，我仍然担心西阿多尼城的人民。

english: Not bad, I do wish you could tell me what's going on with the plague though.
translation: 还行，但我真希望你能告诉我瘟疫到底是怎么回事。

english: So do I Elena. I promise I'll tell you everything once this is all over.
translation: 我也希望如此，埃琳娜。我保证等一切都结束后，我会把一切都告诉你。

english: I hope that's not too far off.
translation: 希望那一天不会太远。

english: It shouldn't be, don't worry.
translation: 应该不会的，别担心。

english: Oh hello, I can't chat now. I have to keep an eye on my husband. He's very ill!
translation: 哦，你好，我现在不能聊天。我得照看我丈夫。他病得很重！

english: I'm sorry to hear that!
translation: 听到这个消息我很难过！

english: I am the leader of the White Knights of Falador. Why do you seek my audience?
translation: 我是法拉多城白骑士的领袖。你为何求见于我？

english: I seek a quest.
translation: 我来寻求一个任务。

english: Well, I need some spy work doing but it's quite dangerous. It will involve going into the Black Knights' fortress.
translation: 嗯，我有些间谍工作需要人做，但相当危险。需要潜入黑骑士要塞。

english: I laugh in the face of danger!
translation: 我面对危险时放声大笑！

english: Well that's good. Don't get too overconfident though.
translation: 那很好。不过别太自信了。

english: You've come along at just the right time actually. All of my knights are already known to the Black Knights.
translation: 你来得正是时候。我所有的骑士都已经暴露在黑骑士面前了。

english: Subtlety isn't exactly our strong point.
translation: 低调行事可不是我们的强项。

english: Can't you just take your White Knights' armour off? They wouldn't recognise you then!
translation: 你们就不能脱掉白骑士盔甲吗？那样他们就认不出你们了！

english: I am afraid our charter prevents us using espionage in any form, that is the domain of the Temple Knights.
translation: 恐怕我们的章程禁止我们使用任何形式的间谍活动，那是圣殿骑士的领域。

english: Temple Knights? Who are they?
translation: 圣殿骑士？他们是谁？

english: That information is classified. I am forbidden to share it with outsiders.
translation: 该信息属于机密。我禁止与外人分享。

english: So... what do you need doing?
translation: 那么……需要我做什么？

english: Well, the Black Knights have started making strange threats to us; demanding large amounts of money and land, and threatening to invade Falador if we don't pay them.
translation: 嗯，黑骑士开始对我们发出奇怪的威胁；要求大量金钱和土地，并威胁说如果我们不付钱，就入侵法拉多城。

english: Now, NORMALLY this wouldn't be a problem...
translation: 通常来说，这不成问题……

english: But they claim to have a powerful new secret weapon.
translation: 但他们声称拥有一种强大的新秘密武器。

english: Your mission, should you decide to accept it, is to infiltrate their fortress, find out what their secret weapon is, and then sabotage it.
translation: 你的任务，如果你决定接受的话，就是潜入他们的要塞，查明他们的秘密武器是什么，然后破坏它。

english: Ok, I'll do my best.
translation: 好，我会尽力而为。

english: Good luck! Let me know how you get on. Here's the dossier for the case, I've already given you the details.
translation: 祝你好运！告诉我进展如何。这是案件的档案，我已经把细节告诉你了。

english: Oh. You don't appear to have any room for the dossier in your inventory. Come back when you do.
translation: 哦。你的背包似乎没有空间放档案了。有空再来吧。

english: No, I'm not ready to do that.
translation: 不，我还没准备好。

english: Come see me again if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意，再来找我。

english: I go and cower in a corner at the first sign of danger!
translation: 我一看到危险就缩到角落里发抖！

english: Well.
translation: 呃。

english: I... suppose spy work DOES involve a little hiding in corners.
translation: 我……我想间谍工作确实需要躲在角落里。

english: Oh. I suppose I'll give it a go then.
translation: 哦。那我试试看吧。

english: I don't, I'm just looking around.
translation: 没有，我只是随便看看。

english: Ok. Please don't break anything.
translation: 好吧。请别弄坏任何东西。

english: How's the mission going?
translation: 任务进展如何？

english: I haven't managed to find what the secret weapon is yet...
translation: 我还没找到秘密武器是什么……

english: Well, keep at it! Falador's future is at stake!
translation: 嗯，继续努力！法拉多城的未来危在旦夕！

english: Here's the dossier on the case.
translation: 这是案件的档案。

english: Hey! You can't come in here! This is a high security military installation!
translation: 嘿！你不能进来！这是高度安全的军事设施！

english: Well, this is the guards' entrance. I might be new here but I can tell you're not a guard.
translation: 嗯，这是守卫入口。我可能是新来的，但我能看出你不是守卫。

english: You're not even wearing proper guards uniform!
translation: 你连正式的守卫制服都没穿！

english: Oh pleeeaaase let me in!
translation: 哦，求求你让我进去吧！

english: Go away. You're getting annoying.
translation: 走开。你开始烦人了。

english: So what is this uniform?
translation: 那这制服是什么样的？

english: Well you can see me wearing it. It's an iron chainbody and a medium bronze helm.
translation: 你看到我穿的了。是铁制链甲和中型青铜头盔。

english: Hmmm... I wonder if I can make that or get some in the local towns....
translation: 嗯……不知道我能不能做一套，或者在附近城镇买到……

english: What was that you muttered?
translation: 你刚才嘀咕什么？

english: Oh, nothing important!
translation: 哦，没什么重要的！

english: Don't let it happen again.
translation: 别再犯了。

english: So who does it belong to?
translation: 那这里属于谁？

english: This fortress belongs to the order of Black Knights known as the Kinshra.
translation: 这座要塞属于名为 Kinshra 的黑骑士团。

english: Oh. Okay, thanks.
translation: 哦。好的，谢谢。

english: Get lost. This is private property.
translation: 滚开。这是私人领地。

english: Yes, but I work here!
translation: 是的，但我在这里工作！

english: Hey! Get back on duty!
translation: 嘿！回去值班！

english: Die intruder!
translation: 受死吧，入侵者！

english: So... how's the secret weapon coming along?
translation: 那么……秘密武器进展如何？

english: The invincibility potion is almost ready...
translation: 无敌药水快完成了……

english: It's taken me FIVE YEARS, but it's almost ready.
translation: 我花了五年时间，但就快完成了。

english: Greldo the Goblin here is just going to fetch the last ingredient for me.
translation: 这里的哥布林格雷尔多正要去给我取最后一种材料。

english: It's a specially grown cabbage grown by my cousin Helda who lives in Draynor Manor.
translation: 是一种特殊种植的卷心菜，由我住在德拉诺庄园的表妹赫尔达种植。

english: The soil there is slightly magical and it gives the cabbages slight magical properties....
translation: 那里的土壤略带魔法，赋予了卷心菜一些魔法特性……

english: ...not to merntion the trees!
translation: ……更别提那些树了！

english: Now remember Greldo, only a Draynor Manor cabbage will do! Don't get lazy and bring any old cabbage, THAT would ENTIRELY wreck the potion!
translation: 记住，格雷尔多，只有德拉诺庄园的卷心菜才行！别偷懒带什么普通卷心菜，那会彻底毁掉药水的！

english: Yeth, Mithreth.
translation: 是，女主人。

english: Yeth, Mithtreth.
translation: 是，是的，大师。

english: I've found out what the Black Knight's secret weapon is. It's a potion of invincibility.
translation: 我发现了黑骑士的秘密武器是什么。是一种无敌药水。

english: A potion of invincibility? That is grave news indeed. If you can sabotage it somehow, you will be very well paid.
translation: 一种无敌药水？这确实是个严重的消息。如果你能想办法破坏它，你会得到丰厚的报酬。

english: So when I finish this mission for you can I be a white knight? Can I wear your armour too?
translation: 那么，我完成这个任务后，能成为白骑士吗？也能穿你们的盔甲吗？

english: I am afraid I cannot authorise you to become a white knight unless under a situation of dire circumstance. Assisting us on a freelance basis will be well worth your time however and you will have my personal gratitude.
translation: 恐怕除非在极端危急的情况下，我无法授权你成为白骑士。不过，以自由职业者的身份协助我们，绝对值得你花时间，而且你会得到我个人的感激。

english: I can't buy stuff with personal gratitude though...
translation: 但我不能用个人感激买东西啊……

english: There is of course also the financial recompense as I said.
translation: 当然，还有我刚才说的金钱报酬。

english: Ok! I'll get on to sabotaging that potion.
translation: 好！我这就去破坏那瓶药水。

english: I wouldn't go in there if I were you. Those Black Knights are in an important meeting. They said they'd kill anyone who went in there!
translation: 我要是你，就不会进去。那些黑骑士正在开一个重要会议。他们说会杀了任何进去的人！

english: Okay, I won't.
translation: 好吧，我不进去。

english: Wise move.
translation: 明智之举。

english: I don't care. I'm going in anyway.
translation: 我不在乎。我还是要进去。

english: Why exactly would I want to do that?
translation: 我为什么要那么做？

english: I'm not supposed to be HELPING the witch you know...
translation: 我不应该去帮那个女巫，你知道的……

english: Where has Greldo got to with that magic cabbage!
translation: 格雷尔多拿到那个魔法卷心菜到哪里去了！

english: What's that noise?
translation: 那是什么声音？

english: Hopefully Greldo with the cabbage... yes, look here it co....NOOOOOoooo!
translation: 希望是格雷尔多带着卷心菜来了……是的，看，它来了……不——！

english: My potion!
translation: 我的药水！

english: Oh boy, this doesn't look good!
translation: 哦天哪，这下可糟了！

english: Meow![1]
Looks like my work here is done. Seems like that's successfully sabotaged their little secret weapon plan.
translation: 看来我的任务完成了。似乎成功破坏了他们的秘密武器计划。

english: It's RUINED! All that work, FIVE years down the drain, who was it! I'll find them and when I do....
translation: 全毁了！那么多工作，五年的心血付诸东流，是谁干的！我会找到他们，等我找到的时候……

english: Erm.. maybe we can save some of it?
translation: 呃……也许我们能抢救一些？

english: SAVE some of it? Are you mad!? That cabbage was a normal cabbage, it spoilt the whole thing and now I have to start all over again!
translation: 抢救一些？你疯了吗！？那个卷心菜是普通卷心菜，它毁了整锅药水，现在我必须从头再来！

english: No need to... get upset... you're scaring the cat.
translation: 别……激动……你吓到猫了。

english: 'The CAT'? She's not 'THE CAT'!
translation: “那只猫”？她不是“那只猫”！

english: She's Maemi... aren't you dear....
translation: 她是梅米……对吧，亲爱的……

english: Purrr....[1]
translation: 咕噜咕噜……[1]

english: Purrr....
translation: 喵呜……

english: I have ruined the Black Knights' invincibility potion. That should put a stop to your problem and an end to their little schemes.
translation: 我已经毁掉了黑骑士的无敌药水。这应该能解决你的问题，并终结他们的小阴谋。

english: Yes, we have just received a message from the Black Knights saying they withdraw their demands, which would seem to confirm your story.
translation: 是的，我们刚收到黑骑士的消息，说他们撤回要求，这似乎证实了你的说法。

english: Now I believe there was some talk of a cash reward...
translation: 我记得好像提到过现金奖励……

english: Absolutely right. Please accept this reward.
translation: 完全正确。请收下这份奖励。

english: Although you do have the necessary qualifications, I'm not sure you're ready. Come back another time, and we'll discuss further.
translation: 虽然你确实具备必要的资格，但我认为你还没准备好。下次再来吧，到时我们再详谈。

english: Yes indeed. You've helped us a great deal around the Museum and you have the necessary qualifications from the Earth Sciences exams.
translation: 没错。你在博物馆帮了我们很多忙，也通过了地球科学考试，获得了必要的资格。

english: I have received word from the digsite that the canal has been constructed, and the barge is awaiting some final touches.
translation: 我收到挖掘场的消息，运河已经建好，驳船也正在做最后的收尾工作。

english: The site foreman requested the aid of a qualified and experienced adventurer, and I believe you would be a perfect fit for the role.
translation: 现场工头请求一位合格且有经验的冒险者协助，我认为你是这个职位的不二人选。

english: Sign me up!
translation: 算我一个！

english: That's great to hear. You should speak to the foreman at the digsite canal, I'll make sure he knows to expect you.
translation: 太好了。你应该去挖掘场运河找工头谈谈，我会确保他知道你要来。

english: I'm afraid I'm far too busy right now.
translation: 恐怕我现在太忙了。

english: Fair enough, do let me know if you happen to change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，请告诉我。

english: I'm afraid there's not much more I can help you with, Dazaator. The foreman at the digsite should be able to answer any of your questions, good luck.
translation: 恐怕我帮不了你更多了，达扎托。挖掘场的工头应该能回答你的任何问题，祝你好运。

english: The expedition to the island North of Morytania is certainly the most interesting thing going on around here at the moment.
translation: 前往莫利塔尼亚北部岛屿的探险，无疑是目前这里最有趣的事情。

english: Hello, the curator said you could use some assistance here?
translation: 你好，馆长说你们这里可能需要帮手？

english: Ah yes, it's about time! We are in the final stages of preparation, there are a few minor adjustments I'd like to make to the barge before we get the crew ready.
translation: 啊，是的，是时候了！我们已经到了准备的最后阶段，在让船员们准备好之前，我想对驳船做一些小的调整。

english: Well, we've learned from our previous attempts that we need a sturdier type of wood to keep the barge afloat.
translation: 嗯，我们从之前的尝试中学到，需要一种更坚固的木材来让驳船保持漂浮。

english: However, magic logs had... well... peculiar side effects.
translation: 然而，魔法原木有……嗯……奇怪的副作用。

english: Luckily, a new high-grade wood was discovered in distant Western lands, it would make the perfect material for the areas of the barge we need to reinforce.
translation: 幸运的是，在遥远的西方大陆发现了一种新的高级木材，它将成为加固驳船某些区域的完美材料。

english: So you'd like me to bring you some of this wood?
translation: 所以你想让我带一些这种木材来？

english: It's not quite that simple, I'm afraid. You'll have to talk to the sawmill operator at the Varrock sawmill to the North West, he will let you know what has to be done.
translation: 恐怕没那么简单。你得去西北边维洛克城的锯木厂，跟锯木厂操作员谈谈，他会告诉你该怎么做。

english: Okay, I'll talk to the sawmill operator.
translation: 好的，我去找锯木厂操作员谈谈。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. Have you retrieved the supplies yet?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。你拿到补给品了吗？

english: Well we need them to reinforce the barge, the sawmill operator can tell you what you need to do if you're unsure.
translation: 嗯，我们需要它们来加固驳船，如果你不确定，锯木厂操作员可以告诉你需要做什么。

english: Do you want me to make some planks for you? Or would you be interested in some other housing supplies?
translation: 你想让我为你做些木板吗？或者你对其他房屋补给品感兴趣？

english: I'm here on behalf of the museum archaeological team.
translation: 我是代表博物馆考古队来的。

english: Ah, I was wondering when they would finally send over a member of the expedition.
translation: 啊，我还在想他们什么时候才会派探险队的人过来。

english: None of the lumber here is appropriate for the task at hand, however, I've arranged a fairly generous deal between myself and the sawmill over in the Hosidius Woodcutting guild.
translation: 这里的木材都不适合手头的任务，不过，我已经和霍西迪乌斯城伐木公会的锯木厂谈妥了一笔相当不错的交易。

english: You'll have to deliver the agreement to their sawmill operator, or a representative of the guild if you lack the requirements to enter.
translation: 你得把协议交给他们的锯木厂操作员，或者如果你没有进入公会的资格，就交给公会的代表。

english: Sounds fairly straight forward.
translation: 听起来挺直接的。

english: That's good to hear. Once the document has been signed, bring it back to me and we'll get those supplies sent over to the foreman.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。文件签好后，带回来给我，我们就把那些补给品送到工头那里去。

english: Okay, bye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: Ah yes. You need to get those documents signed by the sawmill operator in the Woodcutting guild in Hosidius. If you lack the requirements to enter, a representative of the guild can sign it on the sawmill's behalf.
translation: 啊，是的。你需要让霍西迪乌斯城伐木公会的锯木厂操作员签署那些文件。如果你没有进入公会的资格，公会的代表可以代表锯木厂签字。

english: Okay, I'll be back with those signed documents.
translation: 好的，我会带着签好的文件回来的。

english: I lost the trade proposal...
translation: 我把交易提案弄丢了……

english: No worries, here's another copy.
translation: 别担心，这里还有一份副本。

english: Hello there, what business do you have with the Woodcutting guild?
translation: 你好，你来伐木公会有何贵干？

english: I have a proposal for your guild's sawmill, it is from the Varrock sawmill.
translation: 我有一份给贵公会锯木厂的提案，来自维洛克城锯木厂。

english: Ah yes, our sawmill operator was expecting you. Do you have the proposal with you?
translation: 啊，是的，我们的锯木厂操作员正在等你。你带提案来了吗？

english: Excellent, hand it over and I'll sign it on behalf of the guild if everything looks in order.
translation: 太好了，把它交给我，如果一切看起来没问题，我就代表公会签字。

english: There you go, we'll ship the redwood planks over to Varrock sawmill immediately.
translation: 好了，我们会立即把红木板运到维洛克城锯木厂。

english: Redwood planks eh? Those would certainly make for an interesting building material...
translation: 红木板，嗯？那肯定会是一种有趣的建筑材料……

english: Welcome to the woodcutting guild, adventurer.
translation: 欢迎来到伐木公会，冒险者。

english: I'm not too sure what I'm supposed to be doing with this document.
translation: 我不太确定该拿这份文件怎么办。

english: Everything has been signed, so you just need to take it back to the sawmill operator at the Varrock sawmill.
translation: 所有文件都签好了，你只需把它带回维洛克城锯木厂的操作员那里。

english: I lost the trade agreement...
translation: 我把贸易协议弄丢了……

english: The sawmill operator in Varrock said you were in possession of some special planks?
translation: 维洛克城的锯木厂操作员说你有一些特殊的木板？

english: Ah yes, it was no easy feat, but I've managed to make some very high quality lumber out of the logs from the redwoods up there.
translation: 啊，是的，这可不是件容易的事，但我成功用那里的红木原木做出了一些质量非常高的木材。

english: Redwood planks?
translation: 红木板？

english: Precisely.
translation: 正是。

english: Could they be used to build anything else?
translation: 它们还能用来建造别的东西吗？

english: Well, it certainly makes for an interesting material, I can imagine it being used for all sorts in the future...
translation: 嗯，这确实是一种有趣的材料，我可以想象它将来会被用于各种用途……

english: Anyway, do you have the proposed deal on you? The sooner we set up our agreement the sooner we can ship these materials.
translation: 总之，你身上带着拟议的交易文件吗？我们越早达成协议，就能越早运送这些材料。

english: No, I don't have it on me right now.
translation: 不，我现在没带在身上。

english: Well you'll need to let me see the proposal before I can agree to anything.
translation: 嗯，你得让我看看提案，我才能同意任何事情。

english: Right, of course. I'll be back.
translation: 好的，当然。我会回来的。

english: Excellent, hand it over and I'll just make sure everything looks in order.
translation: 太好了，把它交给我，我确认一下一切是否妥当。

english: There you go. We'll ship the materials over to the Varrock sawmill immediately.
translation: 好了。我们会立即把材料运到维洛克城锯木厂。

english: Great, do you have the documents with you?
translation: 太好了，你带文件来了吗？

english: I don't have it with me.
translation: 我没带在身上。

english: Well, I'll need it before I can send over these supplies.
translation: 嗯，我需要它才能把这些补给品送过去。

english: That all looks to be in order. I'll get those supplies to the foreman right away.
