translation: 看起来都没问题了。我马上把这些补给品送到工头那里。

english: We're all done here, the foreman at the digsite should know what you need to do next.
translation: 我们这边都搞定了，挖掘场的工头应该知道下一步该做什么。

english: The supplies arrived earlier, my men have reinforced the barge using those redwood planks. Thanks for your help, [player name].
translation: 补给品早些时候到了，我的人用那些红木板加固了驳船。谢谢你的帮助，[player name]。

english: No problem. Is there anything else you need?
translation: 没问题。还需要别的吗？

english: The barge is prepared for the voyage, so I'm just about done here.
translation: 驳船已经准备好航行，我这里也差不多完工了。

english: Now that the barge is ready, you should probably talk to the lead navigator on board.
translation: 既然驳船准备好了，你应该去和船上的首席航海家谈谈。

english: There doesn't seem to be a gangplank... How am I meant to get on board?
translation: 好像没有跳板……我该怎么上船？

english: The barge guard will happily help you on board. Just give him a prod!
translation: 驳船守卫会很乐意帮你上船的。只要戳戳他就行！

english: Hello. You should talk to the lead navigator.
translation: 你好。你应该去找首席航海家谈谈。

english: Hello there, the lead navigator should be able to answer any questions you've got.
translation: 你好，首席航海家应该能回答你的任何问题。

english: You should talk to the lead navigator when you're ready to set sail.
translation: 你准备好启航时，应该去找首席航海家谈谈。

english: Hello, I'm the lead navigator on the expedition, I take it you're here to help us out?
translation: 你好，我是这次探险的首席航海家，我想你是来帮我们的吧？

english: Yep, that would be me.
translation: 是的，就是我。

english: Good, because we're going to need your help if we're ever going out on this voyage.
translation: 很好，因为如果我们想完成这次航行，就需要你的帮助。

english: Well, you may be aware of the previous attempts at this expedition?
translation: 嗯，你可能知道之前几次尝试这次探险的情况？

english: No, what happened?
translation: 不，发生了什么？

english: Well, the first barge had some serious design flaws... it didn't float.
translation: 嗯，第一艘驳船有严重的设计缺陷……它浮不起来。

english: The second barge suffered from 'feature creep'. Senior museum staff stuck their oar in and added unnecessary features: 'go-faster stripes', a portable fossil centrifuge and a walk-on mini-museum.
translation: 第二艘驳船遭遇了'功能蔓延'。博物馆高级职员横加干涉，添加了不必要的功能：'加速条纹'、便携式化石离心机和一个可步入的迷你博物馆。

english: Needless to say, it had... buoyancy issues.
translation: 不用说，它遇到了……浮力问题。

english: The third barge made it out to sea, but a special sealant was used that attracted sea monsters. They didn't make it very far.
translation: 第三艘驳船成功出海了，但使用了一种特殊的密封剂，结果引来了海怪。它们没走多远。

english: The fourth also used a special sealant, this one attracted icebergs.
translation: 第四艘也用了特殊的密封剂，这次引来了冰山。

english: The fifth barge crashed into the sixth.
translation: 第五艘驳船撞上了第六艘。

english: We lost the seventh one.
translation: 我们弄丢了第七艘。

english: The eighth barge is still here, we think. An accident involving a magical explosion and some talking anchovies means that it is now believed to reside 12 seconds out of phase.
translation: 第八艘驳船应该还在这里，我们想。一次涉及魔法爆炸和会说话的凤尾鱼的事故，导致它现在被认为存在于12秒的相位偏移之外。

english: The ninth version was built using magic logs. The barge gained some form of rudimentary sentience. It developed serious depression and ran itself aground near Crandor.
translation: 第九版是用魔法原木建造的。驳船获得了某种初级意识。它患上了严重的抑郁症，并在克兰多尔附近搁浅了。

english: So, now do you understand why we need your help?
translation: 那么，现在你明白我们为什么需要你的帮助了吗？

english: Um... Not really.
translation: 嗯……不太明白。

english: The voyage is clearly cursed!
translation: 这次航行明显是被诅咒了！

english: Oh... right...
translation: 哦……好吧……

english: Well, [player name], whether you believe it or not, know that none of my men will be going on this expedition unless you can ensure our safety from the curse.
translation: 好吧，[player name]，不管你信不信，要知道除非你能确保我们不受诅咒术的伤害，否则我的任何手下都不会参加这次探险。

english: How am I supposed to do that?
translation: 我该怎么做？

english: We're not the first crew to face a cursed voyage, perhaps someone who has experienced one before can give you some advice.
translation: 我们不是第一支面对被诅咒航行的船员，也许以前经历过的人可以给你一些建议。

english: Any idea where I'd be able to find someone like that?
translation: 知道我在哪里能找到这样的人吗？

english: I've heard all kinds of stories at the Rusty Anchor Inn in Port Sarim. I'm sure you'll be able to find out something about cursed voyages if you ask around the folks there.
translation: 我在沙林港的拉斯蒂锚旅馆听过各种各样的故事。如果你去那里问问周围的人，我肯定你能打听到一些关于被诅咒航行的消息。

english: Okay, I'll see what I can learn.
translation: 好的，我去看看能了解到什么。

english: Ever made any cursed voyages?
translation: 你经历过被诅咒的航行吗？

english: Naarrr, can't say I have [laddie/lassie].
translation: 嚯嚯，我可没有过，[laddie/lassie]。

english: Aye! I've sailed many a treacherous journey in my time! What it be to ye?
translation: 哎！我这一生航行过许多险恶的旅程！你问这个干嘛？

english: I'm meant to be setting sail on a voyage of my own, but the crew won't go without some sort of 'protection'. I was hoping someone here would know of a way to avoid falling victim to the so-called curse.
translation: 我本打算自己启航进行一次航行，但船员们没有某种‘保护’就不肯出发。我希望这里有人知道如何避免成为所谓的诅咒术的受害者。

english: There be nothing 'so-called' about curses, [laddie/lassie/young'un]!
translation: 诅咒可不是什么“所谓”的东西，[laddie/lassie/young'un]！

english: Aye, 'tis a matter we take very seriously. Luckily, there are ways ye can avoid a curse.
translation: 啊，这事我们非常重视。幸运的是，有办法可以避开诅咒术。

english: Great! What do I need to do?
translation: 太好了！我需要做什么？

english: Well that all depends on the nature of yer travels!
translation: 嗯，这完全取决于你旅行的性质！

english: We are heading out on an expedition to an ancient, previously unexplored, island for Varrock museum.
translation: 我们正要出发去维洛克城博物馆进行一次探险，前往一个古老的、以前未被探索过的岛屿。

english: The museum aye? Ye be diggin' up bones and them sorts then?
translation: 博物馆是吗？那你就是去挖骨头之类的东西了？

english: Well... I guess so.
translation: 嗯……我想是吧。

english: Then the way I be seein' it, ye be needin' a lucky charm to do with that!
translation: 照我看，你需要一个与此相关的幸运护符！

english: A lucky charm to do with digging up bones?
translation: 一个和挖骨头有关的幸运护符？

english: Aye! I hear folk talking of an odd old man up in the quarry near Paterdomus who sounds as if he might deal in those sorts of things.
translation: 是的！我听说有人在帕特多莫斯附近的采石场里谈论一个怪异的老人，听起来他好像就是做这类生意的。

english: Bahahahaha! This poor [laddie/lassie/young'un] is sailing a cursed voyage and ye be suggestin' lucky charms?!
translation: 哈哈哈！这个可怜的小伙子/姑娘/小家伙正在航行一个被诅咒的航程，你居然给他出建议用幸运护符？！

english: What ye be gettin' at, Ahab?
translation: 亚哈，你这是什么意思？

english: Listen here, [laddie/lassie/young'un]. There be no way out of a cursed voyage, however, there are ways one can make it through unscathed...
translation: 听着，[laddie/lassie/young'un]。被诅咒的航程是无法逃避的，不过，还是有一些办法可以安然无恙地度过……

english: Aye, just like ye and yer leg, Ahab? Ahahaha!
translation: 是啊，就像你和你的腿一样，亚哈？啊哈哈哈！

english: Take no notice of him. I just thought it be worth ye knowing all the options is all.
translation: 别理他。我只是觉得让你知道所有选项是值得的。

english: Perhaps. What would I need to do to make it through the voyage 'unscathed'?
translation: 也许吧。那我需要怎么做才能安然无恙地度过航程？

english: Folk be tellin' tales of a special potion... A 'potion of sealegs' they be callin' it.
translation: 有人在传说一种特殊的药水……他们称之为“适航药水”。

english: A potion of sealegs?
translation: 适航药水？

english: Aye. The crew simply drink the potion before they be settin' sail, and the next thing they know, they be safely at their destination!
translation: 是的。船员们只要在起航前喝下药水，然后一眨眼，他们就安全抵达目的地了！

english: Arrr! Magical potions? Be soundin' like nonsense to me!
translation: 啊！魔法药水？听起来就是胡扯！

english: Well, I guess I'll talk to the navigators and offer both up to the crew to see which they'd prefer before I go gathering them up! Thanks!
translation: 好吧，我想我会去跟航海家们谈谈，在去收集这些东西之前，把两个选择都提供给船员，看他们更喜欢哪个！谢谢！

english: Be off with ye then, and talk to them navigators! You're ruinin' me rum!
translation: 那你快走吧，去找那些航海家谈！你毁了我的朗姆酒！

english: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck finding a way for us to make it through this cursed voyage?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。有办法让我们度过这个被诅咒的航程了吗？

english: Yes, I've got two options, actually.
translation: 是的，实际上我有了两个选择。

english: Interesting, let's hear them.
translation: 有意思，说来听听。

english: The first is to use a good luck charm, something related to our expedition - a lucky bone from an odd old man in Paterdomus.
translation: 第一种是用一个幸运护符，与我们的探险相关——从帕特多莫斯的一个怪异的老人那里拿到的幸运骨头。

english: The second is a potion of sealegs, the crew would have to drink it at the start of the voyage.
translation: 第二种是适航药水，船员们需要在航程开始时喝下它。

english: Well I'm certainly not putting my crew's life in the hands of some lucky charm! I think I'll go with the potion.
translation: 嗯，我肯定不想把我船员的生命交在一个幸运护符手里！我想我会选药水。

english: I think the lucky charm sounds like a good idea...
translation: 我觉得幸运护符听起来是个好主意……

english: Oh quiet, boy - you shouldn't believe in such nonsense.
translation: 哦，安静点，小子——你不该相信这种胡说。

english: It's okay, I can get both.
translation: 没关系，我可以两个都拿到。

english: Fine by me, as long as you get that potion.
translation: 我没意见，只要你拿到那个药水。

english: The apothecary in Varrock might be able to help you out with that potion of sealegs, I'd start by paying him a visit.
translation: 维洛克城的药剂师或许能帮你搞定那个适航药水，我建议你先去拜访他。

english: Don't forget the lucky charm from the odd old man up in Paterdomus!
translation: 别忘了帕特多莫斯那个怪异的老人给的幸运护符！

english: Okay, I'll be back once I've got the potion of sealegs and the lucky charm.
translation: 好的，我一拿到适航药水和幸运护符就回来。

english: Any luck getting your hands on that potion of sealegs?
translation: 拿到那个适航药水了吗？

english: The apothecary in Varrock might be able to help you out, you should pay him a visit.
translation: 维洛克城的药剂师也许能帮你，你应该去拜访他。

english: Hey, have you managed to get me that lucky charm?
translation: 嘿，你给我搞到那个幸运护符了吗？

english: The old man up in Paterdomus collects those sort of things, I'd see if he's going anything he's willing to give up.
translation: 帕特多莫斯的那个老人收集那类东西，去看看他有没有愿意给你的。

english: Hi, I'm looking for an unusual potion to get my crew through a 'cursed' voyage.
translation: 你好，我在找一种不寻常的药水，让我船员度过一个“被诅咒”的航程。

english: Aha! Don't tell me... You want a potion of sealegs?
translation: 啊哈！别告诉我……你想要适航药水？

english: Yes, actually. What's so funny?
translation: 是的，没错。有什么好笑的？

english: You'd be amazed at the nonsense these pirates believe! I'll let you in on a little secret, there is no magical potion to save you from the sea's wrath!
translation: 你会惊讶于这些海盗相信的胡说！我告诉你一个小秘密，没有什么魔法药水能让你免受大海的愤怒！

english: Then what have you been giving those sailors?
translation: 那你一直给那些水手的是什么？

english: A simple herbal remedy containing vodka. Lots of vodka.
translation: 一种简单的草药疗法，含有伏特加。大量的伏特加。

english: Look, if you bring me the ingredients, I'll make you the potion. It's not going to save your crew from sea curses, of course, but it'll certainly put their fears to rest!
translation: 听着，如果你把材料带来，我就给你做这个药水。当然，它不会让你的船员免受海上的诅咒，但肯定能让他们安心！

english: Well I don't really have a choice here, I need that potion. What ingredients do you need?
translation: 好吧，我确实没有选择，我需要那个药水。你需要什么材料？

english: Two bottles of vodka and an unfinished marrentill potion, I already have everything else I require.
translation: 两瓶伏特加和一瓶未完成的马伦提尔草药水，其他所需的东西我都有了。

english: Do you have the ingredients for the potion?
translation: 你有药水的材料吗？

english: What were they?
translation: 它们是什么来着？

english: You need to bring me 2 bottles of vodka and an unfinished marrentill potion.
translation: 你需要给我带两瓶伏特加和一瓶未完成的马伦提尔草药水。

english: Yep, I've got them here.
translation: 是的，我带来了。

english: Excellent. Hand them over and I'll mix the potion.
translation: 太好了。把它们交给我，我来混合药水。

english: I lost the potion of sealegs...
translation: 我把适航药水弄丢了……

english: Lucky for you I made extra, try to be more careful this time!
translation: 算你走运，我多做了，这次小心点！

english: How goes the expedition?
translation: 探险进行得怎么样？

english: We haven't gone yet.
translation: 我们还没去呢。

english: Oh! Well, good luck!
translation: 哦！那好吧，祝你好运！

english: Hi, I was told you might be able to help me get a lucky charm?
translation: 你好，我听说你也许能帮我弄到一个幸运护符？

english: Oh, yes? I suppose I might have something like that laying around...
translation: 哦，是吗？我想我可能有些那样的东西丢在一边……

english: Mumblemumblemumble.
translation: 嘀咕嘀咕嘀咕。

english: Why would you be looking for such an item?
translation: 你为什么要找这样的东西？

english: I'm working with the museum.
translation: 我在为博物馆工作。

english: Mumblemumble. Mumble.
translation: 嘀咕嘀咕。嘀咕。

english: Do you take me for a fool? As if someone working for the museum would be looking for something like that!
translation: 你把我当傻瓜了吗？好像为博物馆工作的人会找这种东西似的！

english: Actually, that's not what I meant...
translation: 其实，我不是那个意思……

english: Oh really... so what would it be then?
translation: 哦，是吗……那又是什么意思呢？

english: I'm making a cursed voyage. We're heading to an island on an archaeological expedition.
translation: 我正在经历一个被诅咒的航程。我们要去一个岛屿进行考古探险。

english: Mumblemumble.
translation: 嘀咕嘀咕。

english: Interesting, yes, I may have something that could be of use...
translation: 有意思，是的，我可能有些有用的东西……

english: That's great, what would you like for it?
translation: 太好了，你想要什么来交换？

english: Absolutely nothing! You can have it free of charge...
translation: 什么都不要！免费给你……

english: Just be sure to bring me back any interesting bones you find on that island.
translation: 只要记得把你在那岛上找到的任何有趣的骨头带回来给我。

english: Err... Sure.
translation: 呃……好的。

english: I'm a collector.
translation: 我是个收藏家。

english: My collection is not up for grabs! Go find your own!
translation: 我的收藏可不供人随便拿！去找你自己的！

english: I lost the lucky charm you gave me...
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的幸运护符……

english: Lucky for you I have another one here, try to be more careful this time!
translation: 算你走运，我这里还有一个，这次小心点！

english: Back already?
translation: 这么快就回来了？

english: Did you find any for me on that expedition of yours?
translation: 你的那次探险有没有给我找到什么？

english: Err... Not yet.
translation: 呃……还没有。

english: Well make sure you keep an eye out for anything particularly interesting!
translation: 那你一定要留意任何特别有趣的东西！

english: Sure, bye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: Thanks, I'm feeling luckier already!
translation: 谢谢，我已经觉得更幸运了！

english: Yeah, I'm sure you are.
translation: 是啊，我相信你是。

english: Thanks for getting me the lucky charm, [player name]. I'm feeling a lot better about the voyage already.
translation: 谢谢你给我弄到幸运护符，[player name]。我对这次航程已经感觉好多了。

english: Excellent work, [player name]! I'm sure the crew will be very glad to hear about this.
translation: 干得好，[player name]！我相信船员们听到这个会很高兴的。

english: Looks like we've got everything we need to set off!
translation: 看来我们出发所需的一切都准备好了！

english: We're ready to go when you are, [player name].
translation: 我们准备好了，随时可以出发，[player name]。

english: What did your potion do to the crew?!
translation: 你的药水对船员做了什么？！

english: Well, the apothecary figured they can't be afraid if they're unconcious...
translation: 嗯，药剂师认为他们如果昏迷了就不会害怕了……

english: But then who's going to get us to the island?
translation: 但那样谁带我们去岛屿？

english: Aren't you meant to be a navigator?
translation: 你不是应该是个航海家吗？

english: Yes, a JUNIOR navigator! I've never navigated open waters like this!
translation: 是的，一个初级航海家！我从来没有在这样的开阔水域航行过！

english: What are we going to do?
translation: 我们该怎么办？

english: Well, I've got some sailing experience myself. Hopefully I can get us there without too much trouble.
translation: 嗯，我自己也有一些航海经验。希望我能不太麻烦地把大家送到那里。

english: But this barge is highly specialised! It's the only one of its kind and it took years for the lead navigator to learn how to sail it!
translation: 但这艘驳船非常专业！它是独一无二的，首席航海家花了好几年才学会如何驾驶它！

english: Okay, this might not be as straightforward as I thought. What are we going to do?
translation: 好吧，这可能没有我想的那么简单。我们该怎么办？

english: Okay... Let me think...
translation: 好吧……让我想想……

english: You'll need to operate the barge controls, I'll let you know if we're headed in the right direction.
translation: 你需要操作驳船控制装置，我会告诉你我们是否朝正确的方向前进。

english: You'll have to fight against the winds to keep the bearing North, you can do that by steering the barge.
translation: 你必须逆风航行以保持朝北的方向，你可以通过操纵驳船来实现。

english: You can increase or decrease our speed by adjusting the sails. You might find keeping the bearing North easier at slower speeds, but it will take longer to reach the island.
translation: 你可以通过调整船帆来增加或减少速度。你可能会发现慢速时更容易保持朝北的方向，但到达岛屿的时间会更长。

english: If we're headed in the wrong direction for too long I'll take us back to the digsite. Let me know if you want me to go back over these instructions at any point.
translation: 如果我们长时间朝错误的方向前进，我会带我们回到挖掘现场。如果你希望我随时重复这些指示，请告诉我。

english: Okay, see you soon.
translation: 好的，回头见。

english: We were completely off course, [player name]. Talk to the lead navigator to try again.
translation: 我们完全偏离了航线，[player name]。去找首席航海家再试一次。

english: My head... What happened? I thought we were going to set off on our voyage, [Player name]?
translation: 我的头……发生了什么？我以为我们要启航了，[Player name]？

english: There were some... complications.
translation: 出了一些……状况。

english: Well, are you ready to set off again? Let me know and I'll get the crew to take another dose of this potion of sealegs.
translation: 那么，你准备好再次出发了吗？告诉我，我就让船员再喝一剂适航药水。

english: Good work, [player name], you got us here in one piece!
translation: 干得好，[player name]，你让我们完好无损地到达了这里！

english: I suppose you'll want to start exploring the island as soon as possible.
translation: 我想你肯定想尽快开始探索这座岛屿。

english: Here, take this journal so you can keep track of your discoveries. Base camp is being set up on shore, let me know if you'd like to head there.
translation: 给你，拿着这本日志，这样你就可以记录你的发现。大本营正在岸边搭建，如果你想去那里，告诉我一声。

english: It takes more grit than most have te be a pirate, and I don't think ye've got what it takes [lad/lass/kid].
translation: 当海盗需要的胆量比大多数人都多，而我觉得你没有这个能耐[lad/lass/kid]。

english: Well [lad/lass/kid], I don't think ye could pirate yer way out of a chest full of piracy.
translation: 好吧[lad/lass/kid]，我觉得你连一箱海盗行径都闯不出来。

english: Awww...
translation: 哎哟哟...

english: But since nobody else will risk the trip ye'll do!
translation: 不过既然没人愿意冒这个险，那就你来吧！

english: Well [lad/lass/kid], I be Bill Teach, the Captain of the Adventurous, one of the finest ships ever to sail these waters.
translation: 好吧[lad/lass/kid]，我是比尔.蒂奇，“冒险号”的船长，这是在这片水域航行的最好船只之一。

english: I'm in port doin' some legitimate tradin' before headin' back to Mos Le'Harmless.
translation: 我靠港做些正经买卖，之后就要回莫斯勒哈姆斯岛。

english: Mos Le'Harmless? Where is that?
translation: 莫斯勒哈姆斯岛？那是哪儿？

english: It's a pirate stronghold off the southern coast of Morytania. Been in existence for years it has and I reckon it's the best place for pirates to relax!
translation: 那是莫利塔尼亚南部海岸的一个海盗要塞，存在好多年了，我觉得是海盗们放松的最佳去处！

english: Well, one of the best... A lot be liking the Pandemonium these days, and Brimhaven does have that fancy Agility Arena...
translation: 呃，最佳之一吧……现在很多人喜欢潘德莫尼姆岛，布尔哈文镇也有那个花哨的敏捷竞技场……

english: Will it be OK for me to go there if I am not a pirate?
translation: 如果我不是海盗，去那里没问题吗？

english: Of course [lad/lass/kid], once we make landfall ye'll have worked as a sailor on a pirate vessel, which is one of the easiest ways to become a true pirate.
translation: 当然[lad/lass/kid]，等我们靠岸后，你就在海盗船上当过水手了，这可是成为真正海盗最容易的途径之一。

english: Worked as a sailor? Do I really need to do that? I've already got some sailing experience.
translation: 当过水手？我真得这么做吗？我已经有些航海经验了。

english: Of course ye do, [lad/lass/kid]! Plenty be claiming they've got what it takes to be a pirate, but I can't be takin' ye word 'till I see it for myself.
translation: 当然得这么做，[lad/lass/kid]！很多人自称有当海盗的本事，但我不能光听你嘴上说说，得亲眼见识才行。

english: This brings me back to the reason I'm stuck here of course, and the reason I need your help.
translation: 这就说到我为何困在这里了，当然，也是我需要你帮忙的原因。

english: Last night I got into a war o' words with another Cap'n, and he has vowed to sink my ship and put all of my crew to the sword.
translation: 昨晚我和另一个船长发生了口角，他发誓要击沉我的船，把我的所有船员都杀掉。

english: How horrible! How did your crew react?
translation: 太可怕了！你的船员怎么反应的？

english: By desertin'.
translation: 全跑了呗。

english: All of them?
translation: 全都跑了？

english: Every last one!
translation: 一个不剩！

english: The second I leave port I'll come under attack. I think I'll be able te make it if I have another person helpin' out, but I wouldn't stand a chance by me self.
translation: 我一离开港口就会遭到攻击。我觉得如果有个人帮忙，我还能撑过去，但只靠我自己根本没机会。

english: Ye said ye would help me out [lad/lass/kid], will ye stand by yer word?
translation: 你说过会帮我的[lad/lass/kid]，你会遵守诺言吧？

english: Yes, I am a [man/woman] of my word.
translation: 是的，我说话算话。

english: Arr! Ye struck me as a [man/woman] of integrity!
translation: 啊！我就觉得你是个守信用的[man/woman]！

english: My ship is the Adventurous, and she's at the east dock.
translation: 我的船是“冒险号”，停在东码头。

english: You won't...err...I mean ye'll not regret it Cap'n!
translation: 你不会……呃……我是说您不会后悔的，船长！

english: I'm sure I won't.
translation: 我相信我不会。

english: No, if it's so dangerous your crew left, count me out.
translation: 不了，既然这么危险连你的船员都跑了，那我也不干。

english: Well, that doesn't surprise me much.
translation: 哼，我一点都不惊讶。

english: On yer way [lad/lass/kid], leave me be.
translation: 你走吧[lad/lass/kid]，别烦我。

english: I don't think that whoever owns this ship will be happy with me wandering all over it.
translation: 我觉得不管这船主人是谁，都不会乐意我在上面到处乱晃。

english: Let me finish my drink, landlubber!
translation: 让我喝完这杯酒，旱鸭子！

english: If ye ain't up te scratch as a pirate I may not get another one.
translation: 如果你当海盗不够格，我可能就再也找不到别人了。

english: Aye aye Cap'n!
translation: 是，遵命船长！

english: Just remember, [he/she]'s all ye could get, Bill, and maybe ye'll get through it...
translation: 记住，[he/she]是你唯一能找到的人了，比尔，也许你能挺过去……

english: Ye came!
translation: 你来啦！

english: You seem rather surprised.
translation: 你看起来很惊讶。

english: Well, I had the feelin' ye might have run off when ye realised how much of a task ye had ahead of ye.
translation: 呃，我本来还以为你意识到眼前的任务有多艰巨，可能就溜了呢。

english: Don't ye worry about me, Cap'n! I'm the scurviest, throat-cuttinest pirate to ever walk the mainplank! Arr!
translation: 别担心我，船长！我可是走过跳板的最卑鄙、最心狠手辣的海盗！啊！

english: Aye, I should have remembered ye was eager.
translation: 是啊，我应该记得你很急切。

english: Ye all ready to go [lad/lass]?
translation: 你准备好出发了吗[lad/lass]？

english: Let's go Cap'n!
translation: 出发吧船长！

english: Can I just go grab something?
translation: 我能先去拿点东西吗？

english: Aye [lad/lass], take yer time, I'm not goin' anywhere without ye.
translation: 好的[lad/lass]，慢慢来，没你我哪儿也不去。

english: Ye all ready to go lad?
translation: 你准备好出发了吗小伙子？

english: Well, it looks like they've found us Cap'n.
translation: 嗯，看来他们找到我们了，船长。

english: Ye don't say [lad/lass].
translation: 还用你说[lad/lass]。

english: Well, without anyone else te help ye'll have te do some hard work if we don't want to end up walkin' home on the sea bed.
translation: 好吧，如果没有别人帮忙，如果我们不想最后从海底走回家，你就得干些苦力活了。

english: What will you be doing?
translation: 那你会做什么？

english: Well if their first shot hadn't taken out the cannon I'd be firing that at them.
translation: 如果不是他们的第一炮打坏了我们的大炮，我本来是要用它轰他们的。

english: Arr! They seek te hole the ship! Go and take care of their cannon.
translation: 啊！他们想击穿船体！去处理掉他们的大炮。

english: If ye grab some fuse from the gun locker, and a rope from the repair locker, then ye can use the rope on the sails to swing over and deal with their cannon.
translation: 如果你从枪械柜里拿些引信，再从修理柜里拿根绳子，就能用绳子挂在帆上荡过去对付他们的大炮了。

english: Just take the fuse, use it on the barrel of gunpowder next to the cannon, and then light it with something.
translation: 拿上引信，把它放在大炮旁边的火药桶上，然后用什么东西点着它。

english: A lantern, a tinderbox, it doesn't matter.
translation: 灯笼、火绒盒，什么都行。

english: End of problem.
translation: 问题就解决了。

english: How do I get back?
translation: 我怎么回来？

english: They have masts as well don't they?
translation: 他们也有桅杆，对吧？

english: Just do the same trick using some rope on their sails and swing over.
translation: 用同样的招数，拿绳子挂在他们帆上荡回来就行了。

english: Arr! I'll hop to it Cap'n!
translation: 啊！我这就去办，船长！

english: Stop doin' that!
translation: 别再说那个了！

english: Ye ain't a pirate yet by a long shot!
translation: 你还差得远呢，根本不算海盗！

english: I'll be on deck if ye need me.
translation: 需要我就在甲板上。

english: Now to take care of that cannon!
translation: 现在去解决那门大炮！

english: Just to clear everything up, what is it you want me to do?
translation: 为了避免误会，你到底要我做什么？

english: Well, ye'll need to silence their cannon before it sinks us. Before ye do that though, ye'll need to swing over to their ship.
translation: 嗯，你得在它击沉我们之前，让它的大炮哑火。但在此之前，你得先荡到他们的船上去。

english: How do I make a rope swing?
translation: 怎么做绳索秋千？

english: Yer not much of a pirate are ye lad?
translation: 你不太像个海盗啊小伙子？

english: Ye climb up the mast and use a rope on the sails up there.
translation: 你爬到桅杆上，把绳子系在那上面的帆上。

english: Then ye climb down and ye swing on the rope.
translation: 然后爬下来，抓住绳子荡过去。

english: If I have te explain how ye do THAT then I might as well just send out some biscuit weevles to do the job instead.
translation: 如果连这个都得我教，那我还不如派些饼干象鼻虫去干这活儿。

english: Aye aye Cap'n! One rope swing coming right up!
translation: 是，遵命船长！绳索秋千马上就来！

english: Egad...
translation: 天哪……

english: How can I blow up their cannon?
translation: 我怎么炸掉他们的大炮？

english: Well, ye'll need some fuse from the cannon locker below decks.
translation: 嗯，你需要从甲板下的炮弹柜里拿些引信。

english: Swing over to the enemy ship and put the fuse in the barrel of gunpowder they'll have next to the cannon to speed up their firin'.
translation: 荡到敌船上，把引信放进他们大炮旁边的火药桶里，那桶火药是用来加快他们射击速度的。

english: Then, use something on the fuse te get it lit.  A tinderbox, candle or any sort of flame will do.
translation: 然后，用什么东西点着引信。火绒盒、蜡烛，或者任何火焰都行。

english: After that ye just step back and let it burn by its self.
translation: 之后你就后退，让它自己烧完。

english: Arr! I'll blow that cannon sky high, sez I!
translation: 啊！我非把那门大炮炸上天不可，我说到做到！

english: Give me strength...
translation: 给我点力量吧……

english: Err, Cap'n, can we go back to port?
translation: 呃，船长，我们能回港口吗？

english: Go back?
translation: 回去？

english: Got a little scared now have we?
translation: 现在害怕了吧？

english: It's not that, I just need to grab something from the bank, that's all...
translation: 不是那个意思，我只是需要从银行拿点东西，仅此而已……

english: A likely story.
translation: 说得倒像回事。

english: Are ye sure ye can't get by without it?
translation: 你确定没它就干不成事？

english: No, I need to go back now.
translation: 不行，我现在就得回去。

english: I thought as much.
translation: 我就知道。

english: Well, as much as this is an interestin' break, why don't ye head back to the ship and we'll see if we can beat them this time?
translation: 好吧，虽然这休息挺有意思的，但不如你回到船上，看看这次我们能不能打败他们？

english: Stop sayin' that!
translation: 别再说那个了！

english: All right, lad let's try this again. This time, try not te run away!
translation: 好吧，小子，我们再试一次。这次，试着别逃跑！

english: One look at the enemy and ye run away.
translation: 才看到敌人一眼你就跑了。

english: Get over there and take out their cannon before I throw ye there me self.
translation: 给我过去干掉他们的大炮，不然老子亲自把你扔过去。

english: Kill the squid-lovin' dog!
translation: 杀了那个喜欢章鱼的狗东西！

english: I'll have ye guts fer garters!
translation: 我要把你的肠子掏出来做吊袜带！

english: Kill the landlubber!
translation: 杀了那个旱鸭子！

english: Get off my ship!
translation: 滚下我的船！

english: Te Davy-Jones locker with ye!
translation: 送你进戴维.琼斯的储物柜！

english: Fancy a crumpet?
translation: 想来块松饼吗？

english: Sorry, I mean...
translation: 抱歉，我是说……

english: Arr! Run him through sez I!
translation: 啊！我说了干掉他！

english: I'm gonna kill ye!
translation: 我要宰了你！

english: Prepare te die!
translation: 准备受死吧！

english: It is my intention to commandeer one of these ships, pick up a crew, raid, pillage, plunder and otherwise pilfer my weasely black guts out.
translation: 我的意图是征用其中一艘船，招募船员，进行袭击、掠夺、抢劫，总之要把我狡猾的黑心肠掏空。

english: Then it must have been my fault and I apologise lad.
translation: 那一定是我的错，我道歉，小伙子。

english: Well lad, it's 'cos there be foul things in the jungle beyond.
translation: 呃，小伙子，那是因为外面的丛林里有可怕的东西。

english: Then it must have been my fault and I apologise lass.
translation: 那一定是我的错，我道歉，姑娘。

english: Garr!
translation: 嘎！

english: Aren't ye Toothless Kevin?
translation: 你不是无牙凯文吗？

english: Well lass, it's 'cos there be foul things in the jungle beyond.
translation: 呃，姑娘，那是因为外面的丛林里有可怕的东西。

english: This place smells disgusting.
translation: 这地方臭死了。

english: Dead men tell no tales.
translation: 死人不会告密。

english: I can't wait to be back at sea again.
translation: 我等不及要再次出海了。

english: Thar she blows!
translation: 她喷水了！

english: Aren't ye Toothless Lisa?
translation: 你不是无牙丽莎吗？

english: Keep yer voice down lass, can't ye see I'm busy?
translation: 小声点，姑娘，没看见我正忙着吗？

english: Keep yer voice down lad, can't ye see I'm busy?
translation: 小声点，小伙子，没看见我正忙着吗？

english: Well have a good day, sir.
translation: 那么，祝您愉快，先生。

english: Well have a good day, miss.
translation: 那么，祝您愉快，小姐。

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs boy. One step out of line and bam.
translation: 我会盯着你的，海关小子。敢越界一步，砰。

english: Arr! Run her through sez I!
translation: 啊！我说，捅她一刀！

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs girl. One step out of line and bam.
translation: 我会盯着你的，海关丫头。敢越界一步，砰。

english: Arr! I've blown their cannon to smithereens Cap'n!
translation: 啊！我把他们的大炮炸成碎片了，船长！

english: Yer not a pirate yet [lad/lass], so stop talkin' like that!
translation: 你还不是个海盗[lad/lass]，所以别那样说话！

english: Well, ye've sorted out their cannon, but we're takin' on water.
translation: 好吧，你搞定了他们的大炮，但我们的船在进水。

english: Go below deck and sort out the leaks.
translation: 去甲板下面把漏水的地方补好。

english: Will smearing swamp paste on the holes do?
translation: 在洞上抹沼泽膏能行吗？

english: No [lad/lass], these holes were made by cannon fire.
translation: 不行[lad/lass]，这些洞是大炮轰出来的。

english: Ye'll need to get some planks from the repair locker and tack them in place. Then ye smear swamp paste over the planks to seal the hole.
translation: 你得从修理柜拿些木板，用图钉钉上去。然后在木板上抹沼泽膏来封住洞口。

english: Arr! I'll have this ship ship-shape in no time! Arr!
translation: 啊！我马上就把这船修得漂漂亮亮的！啊！

english: Wait 'till we make landfall before ye start actin' like a pirate!
translation: 等我们靠岸了再开始装海盗！

english: Errr...I may well have been caught up in the whole 'pirate' thing, and I can't seem to remember what I need to do now...
translation: 呃……我可能太投入那个‘海盗’角色了，现在好像不记得该做什么了……

english: Zounds...
translation: 天哪……

english: Pay attention!
translation: 给我专心点！

english: Arr! I be rememberin' now Cap'n!
translation: 啊！我现在想起来了，船长！

english: This is what I get when I ask random strangers for help...
translation: 这就是我随便找个陌生人帮忙的下场……

english: Looks like they haven't been back to port to get that cannon fixed, which is lucky.
translation: 看来他们还没回港修那门大炮，算我们走运。

english: Get below and fix the holes in the hull pronto, or we'll sink before they have a chance te kill us!
translation: 赶紧到下面去把船体上的洞补好，否则在他们有机会杀死我们之前，我们就会沉没！

english: The holes be plugged Cap'n!
translation: 洞都堵上了，船长！

english: Nailed shut and waterproofed?
translation: 钉牢了也防水了？

english: Aye!
translation: 是的！

english: Good work [lad/lass].
translation: 干得好[lad/lass]。

english: Why not pay them a visit and go plunder their hold?
translation: 为什么不去拜访他们一下，去掠夺他们的货舱呢？

english: Arr! I'll plunder their booty and no mistake!
translation: 啊！我要掠夺他们的战利品，绝不含糊！

english: Gadzooks...
translation: 老天爷……

english: Come back here and drop it in the chest in the hold.
translation: 回来，把东西放进货舱的箱子里。

english: Aye aye Cap'n! One plunderin' comin' right up!
translation: 是，船长！马上去掠夺！

english: I've been a pirate all me life and I've never heard anyone keep harpin' on like that!
translation: 我当了一辈子海盗，从没听过有人像你这样唠叨个没完！

english: So...how many loads of plunder did you want me to get?
translation: 那么……你想要我拿多少掠夺物？

english: Ten! Can't ye count that high?
translation: 十份！你数不到那么高吗？

english: Of course I can!
translation: 我当然能！

english: What happens if I take all the plunder I find and there is less than ten loads?
translation: 如果我拿走所有找到的掠夺物，但不够十份怎么办？

english: Then ye wait for the pirates to stash some more in the hold. Since they are under attack they'll be dumpin' their gold and stuff in there every chance they get.
translation: 那就等海盗们再往货舱里藏东西。既然他们受到攻击，一有机会就会把金币和东西往那里扔。

english: Just give it a minute and head back!
translation: 等一会儿再回去就行！

english: Arr! I'll keep plunderin' till the hold be full of booty!
translation: 啊！我要一直掠夺，直到货舱装满战利品！

english: Yer not making any friends here [lad/lass], just go and do it.
translation: 你在这里交不到朋友的[lad/lass]，赶紧去做吧。

english: When yer quite done runnin' away lad ye've got a load of plunder to be grabbin'!
translation: 等你跑够了，小子，还有一堆掠夺物要拿呢！

english: I warn ye, [lad/lass], if the first word out of yer mouth is 'Arr' I'll be wearing yer spleen as a novelty hat before ye reach the second 'r'!
translation: 我警告你[lad/lass]，如果你嘴里蹦出的第一个字是‘啊’，在你发出第二个‘r’之前，我就把你的脾脏当新奇帽子戴上！

english: Ahoy shipmate!
translation: 嘿，船友！

english: I should have seen that comin'
translation: 我早该料到会这样

english: Cap'n! I've put ten loads of plunder in the chest, in the hold!
translation: 船长！我已经在货舱的箱子里放了十份掠夺物！

english: I even had some left over!
translation: 我甚至还多出了一些！

english: Let me see that.
translation: 让我看看。

english: Can I have those back?
translation: 能把那些还给我吗？

english: Have what back?
translation: 还什么？

english: Are we all done now?
translation: 我们现在都搞定了吗？

english: Not yet! Let's give em a blast with the cannon before we leave!
translation: 还没！走之前用大炮轰他们一炮！

english: How, the cannon is broken.
translation: 怎么轰，大炮坏了。

english: Alright [lad/lass], try and stay with me on this one.
translation: 好吧[lad/lass]，这次试着跟上我的思路。

english: See, there is a secret technique for making things that be broken right again.
translation: 你看，有一种秘密技术可以把坏掉的东西重新修好。

english: We call this magical process...repairin'.
translation: 我们把这个神奇的过程叫做……修理。

english: I know what repairing is!
translation: 我知道什么是修理！

english: How do I repair the cannon?
translation: 我怎么修理大炮？

english: Ye need to remove the old barrel, then replace it with a new one from the gun locker downstairs.
translation: 你得拆掉旧炮管，然后从楼下枪械柜拿根新的换上。

english: And then what?
translation: 然后呢？

english: I don't want to overload ye with too many details right now. Come tell me when the cannon is ready again.
translation: 我现在不想给你太多细节。等大炮修好了再来告诉我。

english: What was I doing again?
translation: 我刚才在做什么来着？

english: If ye know what is good for ye, yer off to fix the cannon!
translation: 如果你识相的话，就赶紧去修大炮！

english: How was I going to do that again?
translation: 我该怎么做来着？

english: By replacing the broken barrel with a new one! Hop to it [lad/lass], the salt air is clearly eatin' into yer brains!
translation: 用一个新炮管替换破损的炮管！快行动起来，[lad/lass]，咸空气明显在侵蚀你的脑子了！

english: Have ye sorted out the cannon yet?
translation: 大炮修好了吗？

english: Then hop to it lad!
translation: 那就赶紧去，小子！

english: Cap'n I...
translation: 船长，我……

english: Have ye fixed the cannon yet, yes or no.
translation: 大炮修好了没有，是还是不是。

english: Ye did? Great!
translation: 修好了？太好了！

english: Now ye can give those pirates a good shot across their bows.
translation: 现在你可以给那些海盗的船头来一炮了。

english: Ye'll need to load the cannon, and if ye get it wrong the barrel will blow, and ye'll need to start again.
translation: 你得给大炮装弹，如果搞错了炮管会炸，你就得重来。

english: First, ye take some powder from the powder keg.
translation: 首先，你从火药桶里取些火药。

english: Then ye use a ramrod from the gun locker on the powder to tamp the charge.
translation: 然后用枪械柜里的搠杖把火药压实。

english: Then ye use a canister round on the cannon.
translation: 接着把罐装弹装到大炮上。

english: Finally ye use some fuse on the cannon, and light it like ye did the fuse on the barrel earlier.
translation: 最后，你把引信用在大炮上，然后像之前点燃桶上的引信那样点燃它。

english: Then, ye'll need to use the ramrod on the cannon to clean it out for the next shot.
translation: 然后，你需要用搠杖清理大炮，为下一次射击做准备。

english: Ye got all that?
translation: 都记住了吗？

english: Yes, but if I forget I'll come and ask you.
translation: 记住了，但如果我忘了，我会来问你。

english: And te think this was all I could get te help...
translation: 想想看，这就是我能找到的全部帮手了……

english: I can guess from the lack of an explosion that ye haven't fired the cannon yet, correct?
translation: 从没有爆炸声来看，我猜你还没开炮，对吗？

english: Well, not as such no.
translation: 嗯，严格来说还没有。

english: And I'll bet ye want a quick recap of how to do it, correct?
translation: 我打赌你想让我快速重复一遍怎么做，对吧？

english: That would help to be honest.
translation: 说实话，那会有帮助。

english: Ye got all that this time?
translation: 这次都记住了？

english: Yer still not a pirate, so cut that out!
translation: 你还不是海盗，所以别那样了！

english: We were on the home stretch lad why did we turn back?
translation: 我们都快到终点了，小子，为什么又折回来了？

english: Never mind, just go shoot the pirates and let's press on.
translation: 算了，去轰那些海盗，我们继续前进。

english: Well, that seems to have showed them Cap'n!
translation: 看来这给他们点颜色看看了，船长！

english: Great! This ordeal will soon be over!
translation: 太好了！这场磨难很快就要结束了！

english: Aye Cap'n, we'll beat these pirates yet!
translation: 是的船长，我们一定能打败这些海盗！

english: Pirates?
translation: 海盗？

english: Yes, that ordeal too!
translation: 对，那场磨难也是！

english: Now [lad/lass], we'll send them to the bottom of the sea.
translation: 现在[lad/lass]，我们要把他们送到海底去。

english: Well, ye'll shoot holes in their hull with the cannon.
translation: 嗯，你要用大炮在他们的船体上轰出洞来。

english: Essentially ye do what ye just did, but use a cannonball from the gun locker in the hold instead of the canister rounds.
translation: 基本上和你刚才做的一样，但要用货舱枪械柜里的炮弹，而不是罐装弹。

english: Arr! I'll sink them scurvy dogs!
translation: 啊！我要击沉那些卑鄙的家伙！

english: Again with the 'Arr!'...
Give it three tries and see if they sink, that many holes should do it.
translation: 试三次，看看他们会不会沉，那么多洞应该够了。

english: Cap'n, I know I need to load and fire the cannon at the enemy ship...
translation: 船长，我知道我需要给大炮装弹，然后向敌船开火……

english: Aye [lad/lass]?
translation: 是的[lad/lass]？

english: and I know I do this by adding powder to the cannon, tamping the charge with a ramrod, adding a cannonball, adding some fuse and then lighting it...
translation: 我知道我是通过以下步骤来做的：向大炮里加火药，用搠杖夯实装药，加入炮弹，加入一些引信，然后点燃它……

english: And I also remembered your warning about cleaning the barrel after every shot to avoid the cannon exploding...
translation: 我还记得你警告过每次射击后要清理炮管，避免大炮爆炸……

english: But I've forgotten how many times I'm supposed to shoot the enemy ship...
translation: 但我忘了要朝敌船开多少炮……

english: Three! Three times [lad/lass]! Three! One more than two, one less than four! Got it!
translation: 三炮！三炮[lad/lass]！三！比二多一，比四少一！记住了！

english: There is no need to shout...
translation: 没必要这么大声……

english: Were almost there! Just hole their hull and we'll be able to make it past. Get to it!
translation: 快到了！只要在他们的船体上打个洞，我们就能冲过去。快去！

english: Ye've done it [lad/lass]! They're sunk now!
translation: 干得好，[lad/lass]！他们沉了！

english: Let's head to the island!
translation: 咱们去岛上吧！

english: Bill? You look like you've been to Davey Jones' locker and back.
translation: 比尔？你看起来像是去戴维.琼斯的储物柜走了一遭又回来了。

english: Oh, Miss La'Fiette, if only I were that lucky.
translation: 哦，拉菲耶特小姐，我要是有那么幸运就好了。

english: My crew deserted and I was stuck with an adventurer mannin' me ship.
translation: 我的船员都跑了，我只能和一个冒险者一起开我的船。

english: [He/She] was as piratical as a bunch of Dwellberries...
translation: [He/She]当海盗的本事就跟一把德维尔莓差不多……

english: I am still here you know...
translation: 我还在这儿呢，你知道吗……

english: Aye [lad/lass], I remember.
translation: 是啊，[lad/lass]，我记得。

english: I'll leave you two alone.
translation: 我就不打扰你们俩了。

english: Ok [player name], yer now a pirate, but...
translation: 好了，[player name]，你现在是个海盗了，但是……

english: BUT ye can't just go around talking like some pirate in a fancy play.
translation: 但是你不能像个花哨戏剧里的海盗那样到处乱说话。

english: No self-respectin' pirate says 'Arr' that much!
translation: 没有哪个有自尊的海盗会整天喊‘啊嗬’！

english: Well, except for Fancy Dan, but that be another story.
translation: 嗯，除了花哨的丹，不过那是另一个故事了。

english: Here, have this book. It'll learn ye how to be a pirate.
translation: 拿着，这本书给你。它会教你如何当个海盗。

english: Or at least learn ye te talk proper like one.
translation: 或者至少教你像模像样地说话。

english: So all I have to do is read this book and I'm a pirate?
translation: 所以我只要读这本书就是个海盗了？

english: Aye...that be all ye need te do.
translation: 是啊……你只需要做这个。

english: Ye'll need that book if ye want te trade with some of the pirates round here.
translation: 如果你想和这附近的一些海盗做交易，你就需要那本书。

english: Outsiders tend not te understand them if ye catch me drift.
translation: 外人往往听不懂他们的话，你明白我的意思吧。

english: Anyway, I'd have been shark bait without ye.
translation: 总之，没有你我就成了鲨鱼的饵料了。

english: If ye get a moment come see me fer yer share of the loot.
translation: 有空的话来找我拿你那份战利品。

english: I'm sure as soon as ye stop yellin' 'Arr!' ye'll make a great pirate.
translation: 我相信只要你不再大喊‘啊嗬！’，你就能成为一个很棒的海盗。

english: Thanks [player name]. If ye need a lift back, just come see me.
translation: 谢谢，[player name]。如果你需要搭便车回去，就来找我。

english: Can I have that gold now?
translation: 我现在能拿那些金币了吗？

english: Sure ye can. Here.
translation: 当然可以。给你。

english: Well I dunno... it takes more grit than most have te be a pirate.
translation: 嗯，我不知道……当海盗需要比大多数人更多的胆量。

english: Be ye the kind of keen-eyed archer that can hit an albatross at one hundred paces?
translation: 你是不是那种能在百步之外射中信天翁的锐眼弓箭手？

english: Have ye rendered great services to pirates in the past?
translation: 你过去是否曾为海盗立下过汗马功劳？

english: It's a pirate stronghold off the southern coast of Morytania.
translation: 那是莫利塔尼亚南部海岸外的一个海盗要塞。

english: I dunno, lad, I need a pirate to help me with my problem, but none will sail with me.
translation: 我不知道，小子，我需要一个海盗来帮我解决麻烦，但没人愿意跟我出海。

english: Tell me, be ye as agile as a cat on a hot tin roof?
translation: 告诉我，你是不是像热锡屋顶上的猫一样敏捷？

english: Be ye a smith and craftsman of great renown?
translation: 你是不是一位声名远扬的铁匠和工匠？

english: Ye've done it lad! They're sunk now!
translation: 你做到了，小子！他们现在沉了！

english: He was as piratical as a bunch of Dwellberries...
translation: 他就像一把德维尔莓一样充满海盗气概……

english: Aye lad, I remember.
translation: 是啊，小子，我记得。

english: If ye weren't set on yellin' 'Arr!' all the time I'd think ye was a born sailor.
translation: 要不是你总爱喊‘啊！’，我还以为你是个天生的水手呢。

english: I warn ye, lad, if the first word out of yer mouth is 'Arr' I'll be wearing yer spleen as a novelty hat before ye reach the second 'r'!
translation: 我警告你，小子，要是你嘴里蹦出的第一个字是‘啊’，我保证在你喊出第二个‘啊’之前，就把你的脾脏当新奇帽子戴上！

english: Look, just go below their decks and search their hold for Plunder.
translation: 听着，去他们甲板下面，搜索货舱找掠夺物。

english: Alright lad, try and stay with me on this one.
translation: 好吧，小子，这次尽量跟上我。

english: Good work lad.
translation: 干得好，小子。

english: Ye'll need to get some planks from the repair locker and tack them in place.  Then ye smear swamp paste over the planks to seal the hole.
translation: 你得从修理柜拿些木板，用图钉固定好。然后在木板上抹上沼泽膏来封住洞。

english: Well lad, I don't think ye could pirate yer way out of a chest full of piracy.
translation: 唉，小子，我看就算把你扔进装满海盗的箱子里，你也找不到出路。

english: Ye don't say lad.
translation: 还用你说，小子。

english: Of course lad, once we make landfall ye'll have worked as a sailor on a pirate vessel, which is one of the easiest ways to become a true pirate.
translation: 当然，小子，等我们一靠岸，你就算是在海盗船上当过水手了，这可是成为真正海盗最简单的方法之一。

english: Yer not a pirate yet lad, so stop talkin' like that!
translation: 你还不是海盗呢，小子，别那么说话！

english: No lad, these holes were made by cannon fire.
translation: 不，小子，这些洞是大炮轰出来的。

english: Been in existence for years it has, the best place for pirates to relax with the exception of Brimhaven.
translation: 它已经存在好多年了，是除了布尔哈文镇之外，海盗们最好的休闲去处。

english: Arr! Ye struck me as a man of integrity!
translation: 啊！我看你是个正直的人！

english: The second I leave port I'll come under attack.  I think I'll be able te make it if I have another person helpin' out, but I wouldn't stand a chance by me self.
translation: 我一离开港口就会遭到攻击。我想如果有人帮忙，我应该能撑过去，但光靠我一个人可不行。

english: Ye should be able to round up ten loads of the stuff if ye keep searchin' the hold, but it may take a while for the stuff to reappear.
translation: 如果你继续搜索货舱，应该能凑齐十份神秘物质，但可能需要等一会儿才会重新出现。

english: Will ye forgive an old sailor his temper lad? I'm in dire straits indeed.
translation: 你能原谅一个老水手的脾气吗，小子？我现在的处境确实很糟糕。

english: Regardless, those cowardly dogs seem a little too scared to swing over.
translation: 不管怎样，那些懦弱的狗东西似乎太害怕了，不敢荡过来。

english: Would be THE best, but we don't have their fancy Agility Arena.
translation: 本来会是最好的，但我们没有他们那种花哨的敏捷竞技场。

english: I'm all ready te get underway, and I'll see ye onboard when yer ready te go too.
translation: 我已经准备好出发了，等你准备好了，我们船上见。

english: I suppose ye'll be wantin' a lift while yer here, right lad?
translation: 我猜你在这儿是想搭个便车，对吧，小子？

english: Now lad, we'll send them to the bottom of the sea.
translation: 现在，小子，我们要把他们送到海底去。

english: Well lad, I be Bill Teach, the Captain of the Adventurous, one of the finest ships ever to sail these waters.
translation: 嗯，小子，我是比尔.蒂奇，‘冒险号’的船长，这是在这片海域航行过的最好的船之一。

english: I dunno, lass, I need a pirate to help me with my problem, but none will sail with me.
translation: 我不知道，姑娘，我需要一个海盗来帮我解决麻烦，但没人愿意跟我出海。

english: Be ye a smith and craftswoman of great renown?
translation: 你是不是一位声名远扬的铁匠和女工匠？

english: Ye said ye would help me out lad, will ye stand by yer word?
translation: 你说过会帮我，小子，你会信守诺言吗？

english: Ye've done it lass! They're sunk now!
translation: 你做到了，姑娘！他们现在沉了！

english: She was as piratical as a bunch of Dwellberries...
translation: 她就像一把德维尔莓一样充满海盗气概……

english: Aye lass, I remember.
translation: 是啊，姑娘，我记得。

english: I warn ye, lass, if the first word out of yer mouth is 'Arr' I'll be wearing yer spleen as a novelty hat before ye reach the second 'r'!
translation: 我警告你，姑娘，要是你嘴里蹦出的第一个字是‘啊’，我保证在你喊出第二个‘啊’之前，就把你的脾脏当新奇帽子戴上！

english: Alright lass, try and stay with me on this one.
translation: 好吧，姑娘，这次尽量跟上我。

english: Well lass, I don't think ye could pirate yer way out of a chest full of piracy.
translation: 唉，姑娘，我看就算把你扔进装满海盗的箱子里，你也找不到出路。

english: Of course lass, once we make landfall ye'll have worked as a sailor on a pirate vessel, which is one of the easiest ways to become a true pirate.
translation: 当然，姑娘，等我们一靠岸，你就算是在海盗船上当过水手了，这可是成为真正海盗最简单的方法之一。

english: Good work lass.
translation: 干得好，姑娘。

english: Ye don't say lass.
translation: 还用你说，姑娘。

english: Arr! Ye struck me as a woman of integrity!
translation: 啊！我看你是个正直的女人！

english: No lass, these holes were made by cannon fire.
translation: 不，姑娘，这些洞是大炮轰出来的。

english: Yer not a pirate yet lass, so stop talkin' like that!
translation: 你还不是海盗呢，姑娘，别那么说话！

english: Will ye forgive an old sailor his temper lass? I'm in dire straits indeed.
translation: 你能原谅一个老水手的脾气吗，姑娘？我现在的处境确实很糟糕。

english: Ye'll notice I'm not fallin' to the floor in shock right now.
translation: 你会注意到我现在并没有震惊得瘫倒在地板上。

english: Now lass, we'll send them to the bottom of the sea.
translation: 现在，姑娘，我们要把他们送到海底去。

english: Ye all ready to go lass?
translation: 你准备好了吗，姑娘？

english: Well lass, I be Bill Teach, the Captain of the Adventurous, one of the finest ships ever to sail these waters.
translation: 嗯，姑娘，我是比尔.蒂奇，‘冒险号’的船长，这是在这片海域航行过的最好的船之一。

english: Look, if I gives ye another copy will ye keep a better eye on it?
translation: 听着，我再给你一份，你能好好看着它吗？

english: Ye said ye would help me out lass, will ye stand by yer word?
translation: 你说过会帮我，姑娘，你会信守诺言吗？

english: I suppose ye'll be wantin' a lift while yer here, right lass?
translation: 我猜你在这儿是想搭个便车，对吧，姑娘？

english: Then no, lad, ye can't help with my problem.
translation: 那么不行，小子，你帮不了我的忙。

english: Yer not making any friends here lad, just go and do it.
translation: 你在这儿交不到什么朋友，小子，只管去做吧。

english: Aye lad?
translation: 嗯，小子？

english: Three! Three times lad! Three! One more than two, one less than four! Got it!
translation: 三次！三次了，小子！三！比二多一，比四少一！明白了吗！

english: Then no, lass, ye can't help with my problem.
translation: 那么不行，姑娘，你帮不了我的忙。

english: No, I should be gettin' back anyway. Come on lad, let's be off.
translation: 不，反正我也该回去了。来吧，小子，我们走。

english: Aye lass?
translation: 嗯，姑娘？

english: Yer not making any friends here lass, just go and do it.
translation: 你在这儿交不到什么朋友，姑娘，只管去做吧。

english: Three! Three times lass! Three! One more than two, one less than four! Got it!
translation: 三次！三次了，姑娘！三！比二多一，比四少一！明白了吗！

english: Just remember, he's all ye could get, Bill, and maybe ye'll get through it...
translation: 记住，他是你唯一能找到的人了，比尔，也许你能挺过去……

english: No, I should be gettin' back anyway. Come on lass, let's be off.
translation: 不，反正我也该回去了。来吧，姑娘，我们走。

english: Nothin' I won't put on hold. Come on lad, let's be off.
translation: 没什么事不能放一放的。来吧，小子，我们走。

english: By replacing the broken barrel with a new one! Hop to it lad, the salt air is clearly eatin' into yer brains!
translation: 用一个新的替换掉那个破损的木桶！赶紧去干吧，小子，咸湿的空气显然在侵蚀你的脑子了！

english: Just remember, she's all ye could get, Bill, and maybe ye'll get through it...
translation: 记住，她是你能找到的唯一的人了，比尔，也许你能挺过去……

english: Then leave me be till ye've got enough space to carry the thing.
translation: 那就别来烦我，直到你有足够的空间拿那东西为止。

english: Aye, that it be. Come back when yer liver ain't so lily- like, lad.
translation: 啊，正是如此。等你胆子大点再回来吧，小伙子。

english: Nothin' I won't put on hold. Come on lass, let's be off.
translation: 没什么事不能放一放的。来吧，姑娘，我们走。

english: By replacing the broken barrel with a new one! Hop to it lass, the salt air is clearly eatin' into yer brains!
translation: 用一个新的替换掉那个破损的木桶！赶紧去干吧，姑娘，咸湿的空气显然在侵蚀你的脑子了！

english: All right, lass let's try this again. This time, try not te run away!
translation: 好吧，姑娘，我们再来一次。这次，可别再跑掉了！

english: Well, why would ye want them when ye can't hold them?
translation: 嗯，既然你拿不了，为什么还想要呢？

english: Yer not much of a pirate are ye lass?
translation: 你不太像个海盗啊，姑娘？

english: Aye, that it be. Come back when yer liver ain't so lily- like, lass.
translation: 啊，正是如此。等你胆子大点再回来吧，姑娘。

english: Aye lad, take yer time, I'm not goin' anywhere without ye.
translation: 是啊，小子，慢慢来，没有你我不会走的。

english: On yer way lad, leave me be.
translation: 走吧，小子，别烦我。

english: Aye lass, take yer time, I'm not goin' anywhere without ye.
translation: 是啊，姑娘，慢慢来，没有你我不会走的。

english: When yer quite done runnin' away lass ye've got a load of plunder to be grabbin'!
translation: 等你跑够了，姑娘，还有一堆掠夺物等着你去拿呢！

english: Well, you took out that cannon, but we're takin' on water from the holes in the hull.
translation: 嗯，你确实干掉了那门大炮，但船体上的洞正在进水。

english: On yer way lass, leave me be.
translation: 走吧，姑娘，别烦我。

english: Ye'll need to go below decks and fix the damage.
translation: 你得下到甲板下面去修复损坏。

english: Well, why would ye want it when ye can't hold it?
translation: 嗯，既然你拿不了，为什么还想要呢？

english: We were on the home stretch lass why did we turn back?
translation: 我们眼看就要成功了，姑娘，为什么我们要掉头？

english: Ye may want te ditch some of yer baggage, lad, we are off ter sea and ye wouldn't want to fall overboard with all yer stuff te drag ye down.
translation: 你最好扔掉一些行李，小子，我们要出海了，你总不想带着所有东西掉下船被拖下水吧。

english: We had them right where we wanted them, and we ran!
translation: 我们本来已经把他们逼到绝境了，结果我们却跑了！

english: I'll be a laughing stock...
translation: 我会成为笑柄的……

english: Essentially ye do what ye did last time, but use a cannonball from the gun locker in the hold instead of the canister rounds.
translation: 基本上，你像上次一样做，但要用货舱枪械柜里的炮弹，而不是罐装弹药。

english: I can't believe ye ran away! What kind of a pirate turns back te port at the slightest thing!
translation: 我真不敢相信你居然跑了！什么海盗会因为一点小事就掉头回港！

english: Ye may want te ditch some of yer baggage, lass, we are off ter sea and ye wouldn't want to fall overboard with all yer stuff te drag ye down.
translation: 你最好扔掉一些行李，姑娘，我们要出海了，你总不想带着所有东西掉下船被拖下水吧。

english: I've been a pirate all me life and I've never heard anyone talk like that!
translation: 我当了一辈子海盗，从没听过有人像那样说话！

english: I should've seen that comin'
translation: 我早该料到会这样。

english: Well here we are again lad. Thankfully we ain't sinkin' this time.
translation: 好吧，我们又回来了，小子。谢天谢地，这次我们没沉。

english: Well here we are again lass. Thankfully we ain't sinkin' this time.
translation: 好吧，我们又回来了，姑娘。谢天谢地，这次我们没沉。

english: Hopefully ye'll have somethin' constructive te say to me.
translation: 希望你能对我说些有建设性的话。

english: Then hop to it lass!
translation: 那就赶紧去干吧，姑娘！

english: Thanks googwismciscuatak. If ye need a lift back, just come see me.
translation: 谢谢，googwismciscuatak。如果你需要搭便车回去，就来找我。

english: Ok googwismciscuatak, yer now a pirate, but...
translation: 好吧，googwismciscuatak，你现在是个海盗了，但是……

english: Just grabbin' a few more rounds while I wait fer ye te get yerself together.
translation: 趁你还没收拾好，我再喝几轮。

english: Less of yer lip! Did ye get the cannon working before poppin' home fer a nap?
translation: 少废话！你在回家打盹之前把大炮修好了吗？

english: See ye back on the ship, lad.
translation: 咱们船上见，小伙子。

english: So they're from the west?
translation: 所以他们是从西边来的？

english: Yes! They call it Varlamore, the Shining Kingdom! It's meant to be one of the most beautiful places in the world!
translation: 没错！他们管那里叫瓦拉莫尔，光辉王国！据说是世界上最美丽的地方之一！

english: Oh, nothing you need to worry about.
translation: 哦，没什么好担心的。

english: Oh, hello! Are you here to see the delegation?
translation: 哦，你好！你是来看代表团的吗？

english: Delegation?
translation: 代表团？

english: See! It's not just me who doesn't know what's happening.
translation: 看吧！不是只有我不知道发生了什么事。

english: The delegation from Varlamore, of course! After all these years, they're finally opening up the kingdom for travel and trade! Isn't it exciting?
translation: 当然是瓦拉莫尔来的代表团！经过这么多年，他们终于开放王国，允许旅行和贸易了！这难道不令人兴奋吗？

english: Why would I be excited about a place I never even knew existed?
translation: 我为什么要对一个我从来不知道存在的地方感到兴奋？

english: A whole land locked off for hundreds of years! Do you not want to be one of the first outsiders to step foot there? Think of the adventure!
translation: 一个封闭了数百年的整片土地！你不想成为第一批踏上那里的外来者吗？想想那冒险！

english: Adventure? Sounds dangerous. I'll be staying right here, thank you very much!
translation: 冒险？听起来很危险。我会待在这里，非常感谢！

english: Bah! Boring! What about you, stranger?
translation: 哼！真无聊！那你呢，陌生人？

english: Well I'm actually something of an adventurer myself.
translation: 嗯，其实我本人也算是个冒险者。

english: That's the spirit! I bet you'll want to be one of the first to head over to Varlamore!
translation: 这才像话！我打赌你会想成为首批前往瓦拉莫尔的人之一！

english: What can you tell me about Varlamore?
translation: 你能告诉我关于瓦拉莫尔的什么？

english: It's far across the western sea, over the mountains south of Great Kourend. Between the sea and the mountains, it's totally isolated! No one is allowed to come or go without good reason.
translation: 它在西海的远方，大库兰德王国南边的山脉之外。被大海和山脉包围，完全与世隔绝！没有正当理由，任何人都不允许进出。

english: Sounds like a prison.
translation: 听起来像个监狱。

english: Quite the opposite! It's a beautiful and prosperous kingdom, ruled over by the Sun Queen!
translation: 恰恰相反！那是一个美丽而繁荣的王国，由太阳女王统治！

english: The Sun Queen?
translation: 太阳女王？

english: Yes! She rules from her palace in their capital, Civitas illa Fortis. The sun plays an important role in Varlamorian life. In fact, they worship it!
translation: 是的！她在首都福蒂斯城的宫殿里统治。太阳在瓦拉莫雷人的生活中扮演着重要角色。事实上，他们崇拜太阳！

english: What... the sun?
translation: 什么……太阳？

english: That's right! They have their own religion over there dedicated to the sun and the moon. Isn't that fascinating?
translation: 没错！他们那边有自己的宗教，专门崇拜太阳和月亮。是不是很迷人？

english: I don't know... It all sounds a bit odd to me.
translation: 我不知道……对我来说听起来有点奇怪。

english: How come you know so much about Varlamore?
translation: 你怎么对瓦拉莫尔这么了解？

english: A while back, a group of travellers came through here, on their way to the dark lands of Morytania. They said they were from the College of Bards!
translation: 不久前，有一群旅行者经过这里，前往莫利塔尼亚的黑暗之地。他们说他们来自吟游诗人学院！

english: College of Bards?
translation: 吟游诗人学院？

english: Yes! It's found in the floating city of Tempestus! Members of the College are some of the only people allowed to travel to and from Varlamore.
translation: 是的！它位于漂浮之城坦佩斯图斯！学院的成员是少数被允许往返瓦拉莫尔的人之一。

english: They stayed the night in the Blue Moon Inn and spent hours telling us all about their homeland. I've been dying to visit ever since!
translation: 他们在蓝月旅馆住了一晚，花了几个小时给我们讲述他们家乡的一切。从那以后，我一直渴望去那里看看！

english: When will this delegation arrive?
translation: 代表团什么时候到？

english: Well it should be any time now!
translation: 嗯，应该随时会到！

english: Hang on... what's going on over there?
translation: 等等……那边发生了什么事？

english: Wait! That's them! They're here!
translation: 等等！是他们！他们来了！

english: There they are: The children of the sun! That's Itzla Arkan, heir to the throne of Varlamore! And there's Servius, the Teokan of Ralos!
translation: 他们来了：太阳之子！那是伊茨拉.阿坎，瓦拉莫尔王位的继承人！还有塞维乌斯，拉洛斯的特奥坎！

english: Teokan? What's a Teokan?
translation: 特奥坎？特奥坎是什么？

english: It means High Priest. He's the religious leader in Varlamore.
translation: 意思是大祭司。他是瓦拉莫尔的宗教领袖。

english: Huh...
What are you doing with that bag?
translation: 你拿着那个袋子干什么？

english: Oh... Er... Just delivering some supplies to the guards at the gates.
translation: 哦……呃……只是给大门口的守卫送些补给品。

english: Well hurry back. We need everyone at their posts.
translation: 嗯，快点回来。我们需要每个人都坚守岗位。

english: That's an unusually big bag he's carrying.
translation: 他背的那个袋子可真大。

english: Hmm... Now where might you be going with that...?
translation: 嗯……你现在要带着那个去哪里呢……？

english: Sorry, but I need to head off.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: I'm not sure. Doesn't really sound like my kind of thing.
translation: 我不确定。听起来不太像是我感兴趣的事。

english: Well... suit yourself, I guess.
translation: 好吧……那随你便吧。

english: Sorry, I can't stop to talk right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没空说话。

english: Hello again! So what do you think? Reckon you'll be one of the first to head over to Varlamore?
translation: 又见面了！你觉得怎么样？觉得自己会成为第一批前往瓦拉莫尔的人吗？

english: Hey! What are you doing?
translation: 嘿！你在干什么？

english: That was quite a large bag that guard was carrying. I wonder where he's taking it...
translation: 那个守卫拿的袋子可真大。我好奇他要把它送到哪里去……

english: Move along, citizen.
translation: 走开，市民。

english: What are you up to in there...?
translation: 你在里面搞什么鬼……？

english: You're late.
translation: 你迟到了。

english: I'm here aren't I? If you're not happy, maybe you should have been the one to steal the uniforms!
translation: 我不是来了吗？你要是不高兴，当初就该自己去偷制服！

english: Enough! We don't have much time. Do you have everything?
translation: 够了！我们时间不多了。东西都准备好了吗？

english: Mostly.
translation: 大部分吧。

english: Mostly?
translation: 大部分？

english: I grabbed what I could!
translation: 我拿到什么算什么了！

english: We're just going to have to make do. The delegation is already in the palace. We need to be ready to strike as they leave.
translation: 我们只能将就了。代表团已经进了宫殿。我们得在他们离开时准备好动手。

english: Indeed. You all know the target. Get changed quick and be ready to take your positions.
translation: 没错。你们都知道目标是谁。快点换好衣服，准备就位。

english: Good luck. You're going to need it.
translation: 祝你好运。你会需要的。

english: You lot panic too much. It's going to be fine. Now, let's get going.
translation: 你们这些人太容易慌张了。不会有事的。好了，我们走吧。

english: This doesn't sound good. I'd better let that sergeant know.
translation: 这听起来不妙。我最好去告诉那个中士。

english: Wait! I have some information that you need to hear.
translation: 等等！我有一些情报你必须听听。

english: There are some bandits disguising themselves as guards! I think they're planning to attack the delegation from Varlamore!
translation: 有些强盗伪装成了守卫！我想他们计划攻击瓦拉莫尔来的代表团！

english: Surely you can't be serious?
translation: 你肯定是在开玩笑吧？

english: It's true! One of them infiltrated your guards and stole some uniforms. He came right through here earlier with them.
translation: 是真的！其中一个混进了你的守卫队伍，偷了一些制服。他刚才带着制服从这里经过。

english: The one with the large bag? I thought I didn't recognise him, but then it's so hard to keep up. We get through guards so quickly around here for some reason...
translation: 那个拿着大袋子的？我确实觉得不认识他，但人员流动太快了。不知为什么，我们这里的守卫换得特别快……

english: So what do we do? Should we warn the delegation?
translation: 那我们怎么办？要不要警告代表团？

english: And risk a panic? No. Better we deal with this now while they're safe in the palace. Do you know how many bandits there are?
translation: 然后冒引起恐慌的风险？不。最好趁他们安全待在宫殿里的时候处理这件事。你知道有多少强盗吗？

english: Four in total.
translation: 总共四个。

english: Right, we can work with that. You get out there and point them out. With them being disguised, you'll need to keep a close eye out for any guard who looks or acts differently to the others.
translation: 好，我们能应付。你出去把他们指认出来。既然他们伪装了，你得仔细留意那些看起来或行为与众不同的守卫。

english: Don't go too far. If the bandits intend to attack the delegation, they'll either be here in the square or on the eastern road between the square and the bank.
translation: 别走太远。如果强盗打算攻击代表团，他们要么在广场这里，要么在广场和银行之间的东边路上。

english: Return to me once you've found all four and we'll take them all at the same time.
translation: 找到全部四个之后回来找我，我们会同时拿下他们。

english: Alright, I'll get to it.
translation: 好的，我这就去。

english: Get out there and point out the four bandits. They're in disguise, so be sure to keep a close eye out for any guard who looks or acts differently to the others.
translation: 出去把那四个强盗指认出来。他们伪装了，所以一定要仔细留意那些看起来或行为与众不同的守卫。

english: Remember, if they intend to attack the delegation, they'll either be here in the square or on the eastern road between the square and the bank.
translation: 记住，如果他们打算攻击代表团，要么在广场这里，要么在广场和银行之间的东边路上。

english: Alright, I've pointed out all the bandits.
translation: 好了，我已经把所有的强盗都指认出来了。

english: Are you sure? I definitely recognise at least one of them as one of my guards. Maybe you should try again.
translation: 你确定吗？我至少能认出其中一个是我手下的守卫。也许你应该再试一次。

english: Good work. I'll signal my guards to bring them in...
translation: 干得好。我会示意我的守卫把他们抓起来……

english: That could have ended up quite nasty if not for you. Once again, good work.
translation: 要不是你，事情可能会变得很糟糕。再次感谢，干得好。

english: So what happens now?
translation: 那现在怎么办？

english: The bandits will be interrogated. If all goes well, we'll get some useful information out of them.
translation: 强盗们会被审问。如果一切顺利，我们能从他们嘴里得到一些有用的信息。

english: Speaking of which... given it was you who found them in the first place, you might be able to offer some support. Would you be willing to help?
translation: 说到这个……既然是你先发现他们的，你也许能提供一些帮助。你愿意帮忙吗？

english: Of course! Where do you need me?
translation: 当然！你需要我在哪里？

english: Come with me. We'll use the cell on the palace roof for the interrogations. It's nice and out of the way.
translation: 跟我来。我们用宫殿屋顶上的牢房进行审问。那里很僻静。

english: Ah, nilsal, sergeant.
translation: 啊，尼萨尔，中士。

english: Prince Itzla! I... I'm sorry, but I wasn't expecting you here.
translation: 伊茨拉王子！我……抱歉，我没想到您会来这里。

english: Well all that politics downstairs was getting a bit dry, but then I heard there'd been a bit of a commotion. I thought I'd come see what the fuss was all about. You don't mind, do you?
translation: 楼下的那些政治话题有点枯燥，但我听说这里出了点乱子。我想过来看看是怎么回事。你不介意吧？

english: Well no, it's just...
translation: 嗯，不介意，只是……

english: Wonderful! And you! Who are you?
translation: 太好了！还有你！你是谁？

english: Hello there. I'm [player name].
translation: 你好。我是[player name]。

english: [player name]? Kuaini! Pleased to meet you. Crown Prince Itzla Arkan, heir to the Sun Throne, at your service.
translation: [player name]？库艾尼！很高兴见到你。我是伊茨拉.阿坎王子，太阳王座的继承人，听候您的差遣。

english: Tell me, [player name], are you the one who caught these would-be assassins?
translation: 告诉我，[player name]，是你抓住了这些潜在的刺客吗？

english: Well then, why don't you and I ask this one a few little questions. You don't mind, do you, sergeant?
translation: 那么，不如你和我来问这家伙几个小问题。你不介意吧，中士？

english: Not at all, but...
translation: 完全不介意，但是……

english: Excellent! Let's get started then.
translation: 太好了！那我们开始吧。

english: Nilsal to you, iknami. I hear you managed to get yourself into a spot of bother.
translation: 向你致敬，伊克纳米。我听说你给自己惹了点麻烦。

english: I'm not telling you anything.
translation: 我什么都不会告诉你的。

english: Ah, tetamo! Such a shame. No matter though! We'll have you talking in no time.
translation: 啊，泰塔莫！真可惜。不过没关系！我们很快就能让你开口的。

english: Now, you'll need to forgive me, but I'm a bit new around here, so your customs are not familiar to me. Tell me, iknami, what's the preferred method of interrogation in these parts?
translation: 现在，请原谅我，我初来乍到，对你们的习俗不太熟悉。告诉我，伊克纳米，你们这里审问的惯用方法是什么？

english: You're asking me how you should interrogate me?
translation: 你在问我该怎么审问我？

english: Well it just seemed polite to ask. We have all sorts of fun methods back home in Varlamore. We could give one or two of them a go if you want?
translation: 只是觉得问一下比较礼貌。我们在瓦拉莫尔老家有各种有趣的方法。如果你想的话，我们可以试试其中一两个？

english: If I want?
translation: 如果我想呢？

english: Absolutely! Now, what are your thoughts on chicken?
translation: 当然！那么，你对鸡有什么看法？

english: Chicken?
translation: 鸡？

english: Oh, [player name], do you not have chickens here? Sorry, again, all this is quite new to me.
translation: 哦，[player name]，你们这里没有鸡吗？抱歉，再说一次，这一切对我来说都很新鲜。

english: Yes, we have chickens. The farms around here have loads.
translation: 不，我们有鸡。这附近的农场里有很多。

english: Well then, why the confusion? Have you never seen one before? Oh you poor sheltered thing. Did your parents never show you the wonders of the countryside?
translation: 那为什么还困惑？你以前没见过鸡吗？哦，你这可怜的、没见过世面的家伙。你父母没带你看过乡村的美景吗？

english: I know what a chicken is!
translation: 我知道鸡是什么！

english: Well why didn't you say so?
translation: 那你为什么不早说？

english: I don't know what game you're playing, but it won't work on me!
translation: 我不知道你在玩什么把戏，但对我没用！

english: No game at all, iknami. The reason I ask is because one of our preferred methods in Varlamore involves just a small amount of fire, and you'd never believe it, but the smell of human flesh once it gets going...
translation: 没什么把戏，伊克纳米。我问这个是因为我们在瓦拉莫尔的一种常用方法只需要一点点火，而且你绝对不敢相信，但人肉一旦烧起来的气味……

english: You're going to cook me?
translation: 你要把我煮了？

english: Cook? No, not at all! That would imply I'm going to eat you, and I'm not a barbarian! Though, it would be interesting to know if it tastes like chicken as well...
translation: 煮？不，完全不是！那意味着我要吃掉你，而我不是野蛮人！不过，知道它尝起来是不是也像鸡倒是挺有趣的……

english: Alright, enough! I'll tell you what you want!
translation: 够了！我告诉你你想知道的！

english: Kuaini!
translation: 库阿伊尼！

english: So who are you working for?
translation: 那么你在为谁工作？

english: I don't know their name. They just paid us to attack the delegation. They didn't look to be from around here. I reckon it was one of your lot!
translation: 我不知道他们的名字。他们只是付钱让我们攻击代表团。他们看起来不像本地人。我猜是你们那边的人！

english: Why did they want you to attack the delegation?
translation: 他们为什么让你们攻击代表团？

english: They didn't say, but that priest... he was the target!
translation: 他们没说，但那个祭司……他是目标！

english: So a Varlamorian paid you to assassinate the Teokan? You're not giving me much to go on.
translation: 所以一个瓦拉莫尔人花钱让你刺杀特奥坎？你给我的信息太少了。

english: That's all I know!
translation: 我就知道这些！

english: Well I think we're done here. Come, [player name].
translation: 好吧，我想我们问完了。来吧，[player name]。

english: I think we got what we needed there.
translation: 我想我们得到了需要的信息。

english: You're sure he told you everything?
translation: 你确定他把所有事都告诉你了？

english: Oh yes. The fear of being cooked will do that to a person. All total rubbish of course! Imagine burning someone alive! We're much more civilised over in Varlamore.
translation: 哦，是的。对被煮的恐惧会让人这样。当然全是胡说八道！想象一下把人活活烧死！我们在瓦拉莫尔文明得多。

english: We just cut out their heart while it's still beating instead.
translation: 我们只是在他们心脏还在跳动时挖出来而已。

english: I can't tell if you're joking or not...
translation: 我分不清你是在开玩笑还是认真的……

english: Anyway, sounds like there'll be some work to do when we get back home. An assassination attempt on the Teokan of Ralos... Concerning stuff. First up though, I'd better get back to the politics!
translation: 总之，听起来我们回去后还有事要做。有人企图刺杀拉洛斯的特奥坎……真是令人担忧。不过首先，我最好还是回去处理政治事务！

english: [player name], once we've got these papers signed, you lot will be free to travel to Varlamore for the first time! No more needing explicit permission. You can come and go as you please!
translation: [player name]，等这些文件签好，你们就能第一次自由前往瓦拉莫尔了！不再需要明确的许可。你们可以随意来去！

english: Now, it's entirely up to you of course, but given we have you to thank for stopping this plot, I'd be very keen if you'd join me in Varlamore to continue the investigation.
translation: 当然，这完全取决于你，但既然我们要感谢你阻止了这个阴谋，我非常希望你能和我一起回瓦拉莫尔继续调查。

english: No need to decide now. It will take a bit longer for us to be ready for visitors anyway, but when the time comes, I'll have my people send word to you.
translation: 现在不必决定。我们准备好接待访客还需要一些时间，但到时候，我会派人通知你。

english: No need to decide now, but if you do wish to accept my offer, just speak to Regulus Cento outside the eastern gates of this city.
translation: 现在不必决定，但如果你愿意接受我的提议，只需和这座城市东大门外的雷古卢斯.森托谈谈。

english: Now, they'll be missing me downstairs. Timoiva, and may the sun light your way!
translation: 现在，楼下的人该等我了。蒂莫伊瓦，愿阳光照亮你的道路！

english: Well, that was interesting...
translation: 嗯，真有意思……

english: Not every day the heir to a far-off land comes and interrogates one of your prisoners?
translation: 不是每天都有远方土地的继承人来审问你的囚犯吧？

english: Oddly enough, no. This will be an interesting report to write. And on that note, I'd best get to it. All the best, adventurer. Thank you for your help.
translation: 奇怪的是，确实没有。这份报告写起来会很有趣。说到这个，我最好去写了。祝一切顺利，冒险者。谢谢你的帮助。

english: Hello again, [player name]! What can I do for you?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]！有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: As a matter of fact, [player name], I do...
translation: 事实上，[player name]，我确实有件事……

english: I have a client from the mainland who's interested in learning a bit more about Kourend. They've asked me to gather some information on the five cities for them.
translation: 我有个来自大陆的客户，想多了解一些库兰德王国的情况。他们让我帮忙收集关于五座城市的信息。

english: I was just going to do it myself, but as you're quite new around here, this might be a good opportunity for you to get to know the kingdom a bit better.
translation: 我本来打算自己去的，但既然你刚来这边不久，这倒是个让你更熟悉这个王国的好机会。

english: So what do you say?
translation: 你觉得怎么样？

english: Sounds interesting! How can I help?
translation: 听起来挺有意思！我能帮上什么忙？

english: Take this scroll.
translation: 拿着这张卷轴。

english: My client is interested in the hierarchy and general social organisation of Great Kourend. Especially when it comes to how it differs from the mainland.
translation: 我的客户对库兰德王国的等级制度和社会组织很感兴趣，尤其是和大陆不同的地方。

english: That scroll is special. When written on with a particular type of quill, my client will see what you're writing without anything being seen on the scroll itself.
translation: 这张卷轴很特别。用某种特定的羽毛笔在上面写字时，我的客户能看到你写的内容，但卷轴本身却什么也看不出来。

english: Wait, wait! I'm not spying for somebody am I?
translation: 等等，等等！我该不会是在替人当间谍吧？

english: Not exactly... My client simply wishes to keep their 'knowledge gathering' on the down low.
translation: 不完全是……我的客户只是希望他们的“知识收集”行动低调一些。

english: That seems fair. Who should I speak to in order to find out more about the cities?
translation: 这倒合理。那我该找谁了解更多关于这些城市的信息呢？

english: There's many a man and woman who could give you the information you need, but general store owners in each city will likely be your best bet.
translation: 有很多人都能给你提供所需的信息，但每个城市的杂货店老板应该是最佳人选。

english: They should know enough about their cities, and always seem up for a chat.
translation: 他们对自己的城市应该足够了解，而且似乎总是很乐意聊天。

english: Good call. What about this special quill you mentioned?
translation: 好主意。那你提到的特殊羽毛笔呢？

english: Simply touching a normal feather onto the paper should synchronise their magical ability to work together. You don't need any ink.
translation: 只要把一根普通的羽毛碰一下纸张，就能同步它们的魔法能力，让它们协同工作。你不需要墨水。

english: Right, I'll return to you when I have the information your client needs.
translation: 好的，等我拿到你客户需要的信息就回来找你。

english: See you soon.
translation: 回头见。

english: I'm busy at the moment, actually. Not now.
translation: 我现在正忙着呢，改天吧。

english: Very well. Do come back if you wish to help out my client.
translation: 好吧。如果你想帮我的客户，随时回来。

english: What am I meant to be doing, again?
translation: 我到底该做什么来着？

english: That scroll I given to youis special. When written on with a particular type of quill, my client will see what you're writing without anything being seen on the scroll itself.
translation: 我给你的那张卷轴很特别。用某种特定的羽毛笔在上面写字时，我的客户能看到你写的内容，但卷轴本身却什么也看不出来。

english: Speak to the general store owners of each city. They should have enough knowledge of their own city to pry out of them what you need, and they always seem up for a chat.
translation: 去和每个城市的杂货店老板谈谈。他们对自己城市的知识应该足够让你套出需要的信息，而且他们似乎总是很乐意聊天。

english: Remember: simply use a feather on the scroll to attune it as a quill.
translation: 记住：只要把一根羽毛用在卷轴上，就能把它调制成羽毛笔。

english: Thanks, Veos!
translation: 谢了，维奥斯！

english: I'll be happy to provide you with another scroll, [player name], though I'm afraid you don't seem to have any room in your backpack! Return to me when you have.
translation: 我很乐意再给你一张卷轴，[player name]，不过恐怕你的背包里没地方了！等有空位了再来找我吧。

english: Worry not, [player], I have many of those scrolls. Luckily, due to the way it works, you haven't lost any information on it!
translation: 别担心，[player]，这种卷轴我有很多。幸好因为它的工作原理，你并没有丢失任何信息！

english: Remember, if you still need to create a quill, simply attune a feather by using it on the scroll.
translation: 记住，如果你还需要制作羽毛笔，只要把一根羽毛用在卷轴上就行了。

english: You already have your scroll, [player], I can literally see it peeking out of your backpack...
translation: 你已经拿到卷轴了，[player]，我都能看到它从你背包里露出来了……

english: Can I ask you about Arceuus?
translation: 我能问问关于阿西乌斯城的事吗？

english: This city holds knowledge many would deem unsafe to share. Why should I be so trusting to you?
translation: 这座城市掌握着许多人不愿分享的知识。我凭什么要信任你？

english: Well, I'm a...
translation: 嗯，我是个……

english: A journalist! Yes, a journalist from the mainland. I want to let the wider world know of how this incredible city works.
translation: 记者！对，我是来自大陆的记者。我想让更广阔的世界了解这座不可思议的城市是如何运作的。

english: Someone willing to share knowledge of our great city to many others?
translation: 愿意把我们伟大城市的知识分享给更多人？

english: Very well, then. The rest of the world could certainly do with learning about our great library.
translation: 那好吧。外面的世界确实该了解了解我们伟大的图书馆。

english: I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! I'll be back in a tick!
translation: 我本想把这些都记下来，但我没带合适的装备！我马上回来！

english: You're not a very good journalist if you forget your equipment. Very well, then. I'll await your return.
translation: 连装备都能忘，你这记者当得可不怎么样。好吧，我等你回来。

english: So what exactly is it the people Arceuus bring to Great Kourend?
translation: 那么，阿西乌斯城的人民到底为库兰德王国带来了什么？

english: Arceuus is filled with literary and magical scholars. Lead by the great Trobin Arceuus. As a leader, he assists in pushing the limit of our knowledge surrounding magical abilities, souls and the crafting of runic energy.
translation: 阿西乌斯城充满了文学和魔法学者。由伟大的特罗宾.阿西乌斯领导。作为领袖，他致力于推动我们在魔法能力、灵魂以及符文能量制作方面的知识极限。

english: He cares not for petty control, focusing instead on the expansion of knowledge within Great Kourend.
translation: 他对琐碎的权力之争不感兴趣，而是专注于在库兰德王国内扩展知识。

english: What is there to do in Arceuus?
translation: 在阿西乌斯城有什么可做的？

english: Our library is something to behond, but the millennia of knowledge found there; runic, magical and religious, are but small findings compared to the power of the Dark Altar.
translation: 我们的图书馆令人叹为观止，但那里积累的千年知识——符文、魔法和宗教方面的——与黑暗祭坛的力量相比，不过是小发现罢了。

english: Through its power, we have great knowledge on life and death. This knowledge could be yours as well.
translation: 通过它的力量，我们对生与死有了深刻的了解。这些知识你也可以获得。

english: ARGH!
translation: 啊！

english: What is the matter, journalist?
translation: 怎么了，记者？

english: I must have caught my finger with the quill. Apologies; please continue.
translation: 我一定是被羽毛笔扎到手指了。抱歉，请继续。

english: Very well. As mentioned, rewards on offer within our city are priceless. The sharing of our magical research is but child's play compared to the knowledge of Blood and Soul runecrafting.
translation: 好吧。如前所述，我们城市提供的奖励是无价的。与血符文和魂符文制作的知识相比，分享我们的魔法研究简直是小巫见大巫。

english: You're welcome. Spread the word of this great city with the new knowledge you have gained, and perhaps be more careful with how you hold your scroll in the future...
translation: 不客气。用你获得的新知识去宣传这座伟大的城市吧，以后拿卷轴的时候小心点……

english: Can I ask you about Hosidius?
translation: 我能问问关于霍西迪乌斯城的事吗？

english: Well, well my friend! I've lived in this great and glorious city all of my life. I'd be happy to share with you anything you'd like to know!
translation: 哎呀，我的朋友！我在这座伟大而光荣的城市住了一辈子。我很乐意告诉你任何你想知道的事！

english: Oh dear, I'm sorry. I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! Can you hold that thought?
translation: 哦，抱歉。我本想把这些都记下来，但我没带合适的装备！你能稍等一下吗？

english: Absolutely. I'm always up for a chat with any of my new patrons!
translation: 当然可以。我随时欢迎和新顾客聊天！

english: What is it that Hosidius provides for Great Kourend?
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城为库兰德王国提供了什么？

english: Hosidius is filled with keen and skilled farmers alike! Lead by the incredibly efficient Kandur Hosidius, his intelligent resourcefulness ensures optimal agricultural production.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城到处都是热情而熟练的农民！由极其高效的坎杜尔.霍西迪乌斯领导，他聪明的资源管理确保了最佳的农业生产。

english: Our fields stretch as far as the eye can see. With incredible teamwork and group efforts, the ability to provide Great Kourend's people with food and herbal supplies is quite literally the fruits of our labour.
translation: 我们的田野一望无际。凭借令人难以置信的团队合作和集体努力，为大库兰德王国人民提供食物和草药补给品的能力，确实是我们劳动的果实。

english: What is there to do in Hosidius?
translation: 在霍西迪乌斯城有什么可做的？

english: Our personal kitchens and farming patches are lovely. That being said, the real gems of Hosidius are the vinery and Tithe farm. Both are world class!
translation: 我们私人的厨房和农田很漂亮。话虽如此，霍西迪乌斯城真正的瑰宝是葡萄园和什一税农场。两者都是世界级的！

english: Thanks for your help, Horace!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，霍拉斯！

english: Anytime, friend! Feel free to pop along if you ever need any wares!
translation: 随时欢迎，朋友！如果需要什么商品，尽管来！

english: Can I ask you about Lovakengj?
translation: 我能问问关于洛瓦肯吉城的事吗？

english: Why I'd be happy to have a chat! I do enjoy talking about this great city of ours.
translation: 我很乐意聊聊！我确实喜欢谈论我们这座伟大的城市。

english: Oh dear, excuse me, I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! I'll be back in a tick!
translation: 哦，抱歉，我本想把这些都记下来，但我没带合适的装备！我马上回来！

english: Very well, I look forward to chatting with you!
translation: 好吧，期待和你聊天！

english: What is it that Lovakengj provides for Great Kourend?
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城为库兰德王国提供了什么？

english: Lovakengj is filled with incredibly skilled blacksmiths. Under the leadership of Vulcana Lovakengj, our intelligent material saving skills make us the finest blacksmiths in the land.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城到处都是技艺精湛的铁匠。在瓦尔卡娜.洛瓦肯吉的领导下，我们聪明的材料节省技巧使我们成为这片土地上最优秀的铁匠。

english: Armours, weaponry, tools and structures - our city supplies Kourend with all of these to the finest standards known to Dwarf and Human alike.
translation: 盔甲、武器、工具和建筑——我们的城市以矮人和人类所知的最高标准为库兰德王国提供所有这些。

english: What is there to do in Lovakenj?
translation: 在洛瓦肯吉城有什么可做的？

english: Well creating dynamite and mining in the sulphur mine isn't a pretty job, but someone has to do it!
translation: 制造炸药和在硫磺矿采矿可不是什么轻松的活，但总得有人干！

english: We also make the armour worn by the very soldiers of the Shayzien Army here, not to mention the Blast Mine.
translation: 我们还在这里制造谢兹恩城军队士兵所穿的盔甲，更不用说爆破矿坑了。

english: The rewards able to be reaped in our city are nothing to be scoffed at!
translation: 我们城市能获得的奖励可不容小觑！

english: Anytime! Come back soon!
translation: 随时欢迎！早点回来！

english: Can I ask you about Port Piscarilius?
translation: 我能问问关于皮斯卡里琉斯港的事吗？

english: If it's Piscarilius information you seek, it's in my brain that you must peek!
translation: 如果你要找的是皮斯卡里琉斯城的信息，你得窥探我的大脑！

english: I'm sorry, I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment! Can you hold that rhyme?
translation: 抱歉，我本想把这些都记下来，但我没带合适的装备！你能押着韵等我一下吗？

english: If there's one thing, that I do best, it's waiting patiently, for my guests!
translation: 要说我最擅长什么，那就是耐心等待客人来！

english: You're certainly a chirpy woman! What is it that Port Piscarilius provides for Great Kourend?
translation: 你真是个活泼的女人！皮斯卡里琉斯港为库兰德王国提供了什么？

english: Within Port Piscarilius, you'll find, great fisherman, traders, pirates and I. All lead, by our ruthless leader, Shauna Piscarilius, none yet to supersede her.
translation: 在皮斯卡里琉斯港，你会发现伟大的渔夫、商人、海盗和我。都由我们无情的领袖莎娜.皮斯卡里琉斯领导，至今无人能超越她。

english: No surprise if you meet her, her tactics are ruthless. Her demeanour renders, all pirates toothless.
translation: 如果你见到她，别惊讶，她的手段很无情。她的气势让所有海盗都变得温顺。

english: Our great shore and trading, have treasures to be found, providing export and fish, in quantities abound.
translation: 我们伟大的海岸和贸易有宝藏可寻，提供出口和鱼类，数量丰富。

english: What is there to do in Port Piscarilius?
translation: 在皮斯卡里琉斯港有什么可做的？

english: Our shore is brimming, with gold from the sea, the most loyal of our people, are handed the key. We'll let you stand on our shores and collect, the great anglerfish; otheronly... covet?
