translation: 我们的海岸充满了海中的黄金，最忠诚的人会得到钥匙。我们让你站在海岸上收集伟大的安康鱼；别人只能……觊觎？

english: Hang on a second... that last one didn't rhyme too well!
translation: 等一下……最后那句押韵得不太好！

english: Listen here pal, you don't mess with people in Port Piscarilius. Do you want happy rhyming Leenz, or angry, gruff and pain-inflicting Leenz?
translation: 听着，伙计，别在皮斯卡里琉斯港惹事。你是想要开心的押韵林兹，还是愤怒、粗暴、爱揍人的林兹？

english: Happy rhyming Leenz, please! Thanks for your help!
translation: 开心的押韵林兹，拜托了！谢谢你的帮助！

english: Anytime, my adventuring friend, enjoy your time in Great Kourend!
translation: 随时欢迎，我的冒险家朋友，祝你在库兰德王国玩得开心！

english: Can I ask you about Shayzien?
translation: 我能问问关于谢兹恩城的事吗？

english: Well I could give you some info if that's all yer wantin'. Gets lonely in 'ere while me mates are out there fightin' the good war!
translation: 嗯，如果你只是想要点信息，我可以告诉你。我那些兄弟在外面打正义之战的时候，这里怪冷清的！

english: Apologies, I was hoping to write this all down but I don't have the correct equipment!
translation: 抱歉，我本想把这些都记下来，但我没带合适的装备！

english: Well ye canne remember everything I 'ave to say about this wee 'ouse without that, can you? Come back when yer 'ead's not all fried!
translation: 那你总不可能光靠脑子记住我要说的关于这座小城的一切吧？等你脑子清醒了再回来！

english: What is it that Shayzien provides for Great Kourend?
translation: 谢兹恩城为库兰德王国提供了什么？

english: Phwoar, what don' we do? This place is filled with officers and the like. Lead by our rig'rous leader Shiro Shayzien, 'e ensures ultimate justice and safety for the entirety of Great Kourend.
translation: 哇，我们什么不做？这个地方到处都是军官之类的人。由我们严厉的领袖希罗.谢兹恩领导，他确保整个大库兰德王国的终极正义与安全。

english: Our soldiers fight off the constant threat of the lizardman, while our 'ighly trained medics 'eal them from battle. Strict in combat trainin' and discipline. Law, order and defence. These are the words we live by!
translation: 我们的士兵击退蜥蜴人的持续威胁，而我们训练有素的军医则为他们治疗伤势。严格的战斗训练和纪律。法律、秩序和防御。这就是我们的信条！

english: What is there to do in Shayzien?
translation: 在谢兹恩城有什么可做的？

english: It ain't all pretty 'ere, but if you 'elp our soldiers and tackle some organised crime... you'll soon find that the spoils o' war are grand.
translation: 这里并不全是光鲜亮丽，但如果你帮助我们的士兵，打击一些有组织的犯罪……你很快就会发现战争的战利品很丰厚。

english: That's alright petal, you go'un and have fun.
translation: 没事，亲爱的，你去玩吧。

english: I have gathered information from all of the cities.
translation: 我已经从所有城市收集到信息了。

english: I could hear a voice, Veos... in my head! As if it whispered in my ear to return to you!
translation: 我听到了一个声音，维奥斯……在我脑海里！就像在我耳边低语，让我回来找你！

english: Yes, I heard it too... they mentioned that your task was complete.
translation: 是的，我也听到了……他们说你的任务完成了。

english: Let me take those items off your hands.
translation: 让我把这些东西从你手上拿走吧。

english: That reminds me, Veos! I didn't sign up to this! I wasn't told that my mind would be entered. And what about the possibility of severely damaging my hand?
translation: 这倒提醒我了，维奥斯！我可没同意过这种事！没人告诉我我的思想会被侵入。还有我的手可能严重受伤的可能性呢？

english: If it makes you feel any better, my client sends their apologies. It wasn't intentional. Needless to say, something you said provoked emotion...
translation: 如果这能让你好受点，我的委托人让我转达歉意。那不是故意的。不用说，你说的话引发了情绪……

english: Namely...
translation: 具体是……

english: The Dark Altar...
translation: 黑暗祭坛……

english: If I knew mentioning the Dark Altar would upset them so much, I'd have not written that bit of information down!
translation: 如果我知道提到黑暗祭坛会让他们那么不高兴，我就不会写下那条信息了！

english: Well that's just the thing, [player name]. My client is pleased you found such information. Tell me... Would you be willing to do one last thing for them?
translation: 问题就在这儿，[player name]。我的委托人很高兴你找到了这样的信息。告诉我……你愿意为他们做最后一件事吗？

english: Well, I don't necessarily believe I have much of a choice!
translation: 嗯，我不觉得我有什么选择！

english: I'm certainly glad you're able to assist once again.
translation: 我很高兴你能再次帮忙。

english: My client will be most pleased.
translation: 我的委托人会非常高兴。

english: My client requires... another simple task. They assure me that it will be the last. Take this orb. You must activate it beside the Dark Altar, north of Arceuus.
translation: 我的委托人需要……另一个简单的任务。他们向我保证这是最后一次。拿着这个宝珠。你必须把它在阿西乌斯城北边的黑暗祭坛旁边激活。

english: Can I ask why I would do that?
translation: 我能问一下为什么要这么做吗？

english: It's best you don't.
translation: 你最好别问。

english: Well, can't argue with that! I'll return when I'm done!
translation: 好吧，没法反驳！我做完就回来！

english: So what exactly is it your client now wants me to do?
translation: 那么你的委托人到底想让我做什么？

english: Take this orb.
translation: 拿着这个宝珠。

english: You already have the orb, [player name], I can literally see it peeking out of your backpack...
translation: 你已经有了宝珠，[player name]，我都能看到它从你的背包里露出来了……

english: I'll be happy to provide you with another orb, [player name], though I'm afraid you don't seem to have any room in your backpack! Return to me when you have room.
translation: 我很乐意再给你一个宝珠，[player name]，但恐怕你的背包里没地方了！等你有空位了再来找我。

english: Please be more careful, [player name]. Remember to return to me when you have used the orb in the area.
translation: 请小心点，[player name]。记得在区域里用过宝珠后回来找我。

english: I really wish I would be warned about these things earlier...
translation: 我真希望这些事能早点提醒我……

english: Veos, enough is enough! I've suffered through enough. Exploding orbs and burning quills...
translation: 维奥斯，够了！我受够了。爆炸的宝珠和燃烧的羽毛笔……

english: [player name]? What are you talking about?
translation: [player name]？你在说什么？

english: You know darn well what I'm talking about!
translation: 你很清楚我在说什么！

english: [player name], I haven't spoken with you since bringing you to Kourend, I have no idea what you're on ab--
translation: [player name]，自从我带你来库兰德王国后就没和你说过话，我不知道你在说什——

english: Veos, this isn't funny anymore... Are you alright? I did all that your client asked of me...
translation: 维奥斯，这一点都不好玩了……你还好吗？我做了你委托人要求的一切……

english: Indeed you have.
translation: 你确实做了。

english: Uhm... Veos?
translation: 呃……维奥斯？

english: You have done well. For that, you have my thanks.
translation: 你做得很好。为此，我感谢你。

english: Who are you? What have you done with Veos?
translation: 你是谁？你把维奥斯怎么了？

english: You need not fear for him. I will ensure no harm comes his way.
translation: 你不必为他担心。我会确保他安然无恙。

english: As for who I am... Well, that is of no importance.
translation: 至于我是谁……嗯，那不重要。

english: I have a right to know!
translation: 我有权知道！

english: Knowledge can be a curse. Sometimes, it is better to remain unaware.
translation: 知识可能是一种诅咒。有时候，保持无知更好。

english: Now, time to release this mind back to consciousness... Don't worry, I'll make sure he rewards you. After all, you've been very useful to me...
translation: 现在，是时候让这个意识恢复清醒了……别担心，我会确保他奖励你的。毕竟，你对我非常有用……

english: I have a client from the mainland interested in some more knowledge surrounding the houses of Kourend. Do you think you'd be able to retrieve it for me?
translation: 我有一个来自大陆的客户，对了解更多关于库兰德王国各家族的信息感兴趣。你觉得你能为我取来吗？

english: I was just going to do it myself but as you're quite new around here, this might be a good opportunity for you to get to know the kingdom a bit better.
translation: 我本来打算自己去的，不过既然你刚来这儿不久，这倒是个让你多了解这个王国的好机会。

english: My client is interested in the hierarchy and general social organisation of Great Kourend; how it differs from the mainland, per se.
translation: 我的客户对库兰德王国的等级制度和一般社会组织感兴趣；比如它如何与大陆不同。

english: Not exactly... My client simply wishes to keep his 'knowledge gathering' on the down low before he makes his appearance.
translation: 不完全是……我的客户只是想在公开露面之前，低调地进行他的‘知识收集’。

english: That seems fair. Who should I speak to in order to find out more about the houses?
translation: 这听起来挺合理的。那我该找谁了解更多关于这些城区的事呢？

english: There's many a man and woman who could give you the information you need, but General store owners in house will likely be your best bet. They should know enough about their houses, and always seem up
translation: 能给你提供信息的男男女女很多，但各城区的杂货店老板应该是最佳人选。他们对自己的城区应该足够了解，而且看起来总是很乐意

english: for a chat.
translation: 聊聊天。

english: Can I ask you about the Arceuus house?
translation: 我能问问关于阿西乌斯城区的事吗？

english: This house holds knowledge many would deem unsafe to share. Why should I be so trusting to you?
translation: 这个城区掌握着许多被认为不宜分享的知识。我凭什么要信任你？

english: A journalist! Yes, a journalist from the mainland. I want to let the wider world know of how this incredible house works.
translation: 我是个记者！对，来自大陆的记者。我想让外面更广阔的世界了解这个了不起的城区是如何运作的。

english: Someone willing to share knowledge of our great house to many others?
translation: 一个愿意把我们伟大城区的知识分享给更多人的人？

english: So what exactly is it the Arceuus house brings to Great Kourend?
translation: 那么，阿西乌斯家族到底给大库兰德王国带来了什么？

english: The Arceuus house is filled with literary and magical scholars. Lead by the great Trobin Arceuus, as a leader, he assists in pushing the limit of our knowledge surrounding magical abilities, religion and the crafting of
translation: 阿西乌斯城充满了文学和魔法学者。由伟大的特罗宾.阿西乌斯领导，作为领袖，他帮助推动我们关于魔法能力、宗教和制作的知识边界。

english: runic energy. He cares not for petty control, focusing instead on the expansion of knowledge within Great Kourend.
translation: 他不在乎微不足道的控制权，而是专注于扩展库兰德王国境内的知识。

translation: 别担心。我会确保他没事。他对我很有用。

english: Now, time to release this ones mind back toconsciousness... Don't worry, I'll make sure he rewardsyou. After all, you've been very useful to me...
translation: 现在，是时候让这个人的意识恢复清醒了……别担心，我会确保他奖励你的。毕竟，你对我很有用……

english: Yes... Let's do that...
translation: 是的……就这么办吧……

english: You need not fear for him. I will ensure no harmcomes his way.
translation: 你不必为他担心。我会确保他不会受到任何伤害。

english: Knowledge can be a curse. Sometimes, it is better toremain unaware.
translation: 知识有时是一种诅咒。有时候，保持无知反而更好。

english: Worry not. I'll ensure he's fine. He is of good use tome...
translation: 别担心。我会确保他没事。他对我很有用……

english: Now, time to release this mind back to consciousness...Don't worry, I'll make sure he rewards you. After all,you've been very useful to me...
translation: 现在，是时候让这个意识恢复清醒了……别担心，我会确保他奖励你的。毕竟，你对我很有用……

english: Oh hello, are you having trouble? The cogs are in four rooms below us. Place one cog on a pole on each of the four tower levels.
translation: 哦，你好，遇到麻烦了吗？齿轮在我们下面的四个房间里。把每个齿轮放在四个塔层中每层的柱子上。

english: Right, gotcha. I'll do that then.
translation: 好的，明白了。那我就去做了。

english: I've placed a cog!
translation: 我已经放好了一个齿轮！

english: That's great. Come see me when you've done the other three.
translation: 太好了。等你完成另外三个再来找我。

english: Two down!
translation: 两个搞定了！

english: Two to go.
translation: 还剩两个。

english: One left.
translation: 还剩一个。

english: I have replaced all the cogs!
translation: 我已经把所有齿轮都换好了！

english: Really..? Wait, listen! Well done, well done! Yes yes yes, you've done it! You ARE clever!
translation: 真的吗……？等等，听好了！干得好，干得好！是的是的，你做到了！你真是太聪明了！

english: The townsfolk will all be able to know the correct time now! Thank you so much for all of your help! And as promised, here is your reward!
translation: 镇上的居民现在都能知道正确的时间了！非常感谢你的帮助！正如承诺的那样，这是你的奖励！

english: Oh, thank you kind sir! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
translation: 哦，谢谢你，好心的先生！在下面的地窖里，你能找到四个齿轮。它们对我来说太重了，但你应该能一次搬一个。

english: Oh, thank you kind madam! In the cellar below, you'll find four cogs. They're too heavy for me, but you should be able to carry them one at a time.
translation: 哦，谢谢你，好心的女士！在下面的地窖里，你能找到四个齿轮。它们对我来说太重了，但你应该能一次搬一个。

english: Well, I'm only a monk so I'm not exactly rich, but I assure you I will give you a fair reward for the time spent assisting me in repairing the clock.
translation: 嗯，我只是个僧侣，所以并不富裕，但我向你保证，对于你花时间帮我修理钟，我会给你一份公平的报酬。

english: Have you got the equipment?
translation: 你拿到装备了吗？

english: Yes, I have them with me.
translation: 是的，我带着呢。

english: What do I need to get?
translation: 我需要拿什么？

english: You have all the materials. Off to the iceberg!
translation: 你所有材料都齐了。出发去冰山吧！

english: Once you have the items, meet me up by the entrance to Keldagrim, east of Rellekka. I'll be there with a boat to take us to our destination.
translation: 拿到物品后，到雷勒卡城东边的凯尔达格林城入口处与我会合。我会带着船在那里等我们一起去目的地。

english: I have no idea where that is.
translation: 我完全不知道那在哪里。

english: And you call yourself an adventurer! There is a road from Catherby going north. Take it until you reach the Sinclair Mansion.
translation: 你还自称冒险者！从凯瑟比镇往北有条路。顺着路走到辛克莱尔庄园。

english: Take a left at the Mansion, cross two bridges and follow the road until you reach Rellekka. Head east, around Rellekka to the coast near the entrance of Keldagrim.
translation: 在庄园左转，过两座桥，沿着路走到雷勒卡城。向东绕过雷勒卡城，到凯尔达格林城入口附近的海岸。

english: Did I spell that out enough for you?
translation: 我这样说够清楚了吧？

english: No need to be snippy.
translation: 没必要这么尖刻。

english: Oh, I know where to go.
translation: 哦，我知道怎么走。

english: So, how do I make a bird hide?
translation: 那么，我怎么制作一个鸟类观察点？

english: Use the planks on the patch of snow on that ridge. Once you have that constructed, use the spade on the snow to cover the hide.
translation: 在那山脊的雪地上使用木板。搭建好后，用铲子铲雪盖住观察点。

english: Okay, I've made the structure. Now what?
translation: 好了，我搭好了结构。然后呢？

english: Not bad... Now you need to cover the bird hide in snow with a spade.
translation: 不错……现在你需要用铲子把鸟掩体盖上雪。

english: Can we start observing the penguins?
translation: 我们可以开始观察企鹅了吗？

english: Yes. Let's get in and start observing. You should note down anything interesting the penguins do. I'll include it in my, uh, research.
translation: 是的。我们进去开始观察。你应该记下企鹅做的任何有趣的事情。我会把它纳入我的，呃，研究。

english: Look, here come two penguins now.
translation: 看，现在来了两只企鹅。

english: Aww, they're cute.
translation: 啊，它们好可爱。

english: EVIL. I mean, how fascinating.
translation: 邪恶的。我是说，多么迷人啊。

english: Looks like the penguins are on patrol again.
translation: 看起来企鹅又在巡逻了。

english: They're just walking around, Larry.
translation: 它们只是在走来走去，拉里。

english: They are organised! ORGANISED I tell you!
translation: 它们是有组织的！我告诉你，是有组织的！

english: I knew it. I knew they were up to something! Did you see that? They were patrolling!
translation: 我就知道。我就知道它们在图谋什么！你看到了吗？它们在巡逻！

english: It isn't! They saluted and recognised each other. They're organised!
translation: 才不是呢！它们互相敬礼并认出了对方。它们是有组织的！

english: It looked like one of them shivered and the other one just walked past. Nothing suspicious there, it is really cold here!
translation: 看起来只是其中一只抖了抖，另一只就走了过去。没什么可疑的，这里真的很冷！

english: I don't care what you think. I know they are doing something. No one ever believes me. But I'll prove them wrong. ALL OF THEM.
translation: 我不在乎你怎么想。我知道它们在搞事情。从来没人相信我。但我会证明他们都错了。所有人。

english: Okay, calm down. What do you think we should do now?
translation: 好了，冷静点。你觉得我们现在该做什么？

english: It did seem rather suspicious.
translation: 确实看起来相当可疑。

english: You believe me?
translation: 你相信我？

english: Of course! I mean, those penguins were acting quite strangely.
translation: 当然！我是说，那些企鹅的行为确实很奇怪。

english: No one ever believes me. Can I...hug you?
translation: 从来没人相信我。我能……抱抱你吗？

english: Whoa there, I don't think this calls for hugging. What do we do next about the penguins?
translation: 哇哦，我觉得没必要拥抱。关于企鹅我们下一步怎么办？

english: We need to get closer to the penguins. Infiltrate them. Learn what they are doing.
translation: 我们需要靠近企鹅。渗透进去。搞清楚它们在做什么。

english: How do you plan to do that?
translation: 你打算怎么做？

english: We can't discuss it here; there are too many spies. Let's leave the iceberg and then I'll tell you my plans.
translation: 我们不能在这里讨论；间谍太多了。我们先离开冰山，然后我再告诉你我的计划。

english: We must get away from here before we discuss our plans. We don't want to be overheard.
translation: 我们必须离开这里再讨论计划。我们不想被人偷听。

english: How do you plan to infiltrate the penguins?
translation: 你打算怎么渗透企鹅？

english: I have altered some designs of clockwork toys to make a clockwork penguin suit. We will use this to infiltrate their ranks.
translation: 我修改了一些发条装置玩具的设计，制作了一套发条企鹅装。我们将用它来潜入他们的队伍。

english: What? We'll just set it off walking? What good will that do?
translation: 什么？我们只是让它走动？那有什么用？

english: No! I'm going to use a spell to shrink you down so you can control it from the inside.
translation: 不！我会用一个法术把你缩小，这样你就可以在里面控制它了。

english: Wait a minute, why am I being shrunk? Why can't you get in the suit and annoy the penguins?
translation: 等一下，为什么是我被缩小？为什么你不能钻进企鹅装里去招惹企鹅？

english: The penguins know my scent. They'd find me out and capture me and...torture me. No, it has to be you.
translation: 企鹅知道我的气味。它们会发现我，然后抓住我，还有……折磨我。不，必须是你。

english: Don't worry. The spell only works if I'm nearby since I have to be constantly casting it. If trouble starts I'll be close by to help.
translation: 别担心。这个法术只有在我在附近时才有效，因为我必须持续施法。如果出了麻烦，我就在附近帮忙。

english: Gee, that's comforting.
translation: 天哪，这真让人安心。

english: Here's the book. It has my designs and a list of things you need to get. Use your Crafting table at your house to build it, just like regular clockwork toys.
translation: 书在这里。里面有我的设计和你需要获取的物品清单。用你家中的制作台来制作它，就像普通的发条装置玩具一样。

english: Why do I have to make the suit? I'm tired of doing all the legwork.
translation: 为什么我得做这套服装？我厌倦了做所有的跑腿活。

english: You have to make it, because since I got fired from the Zoo I've been homeless. Thanks for caring.
translation: 你必须做，因为自从我被动物园开除后，我就无家可归了。谢谢你的关心。

english: Oh, sorry... Hey, you told me you were on leave to do research!
translation: 哦，对不起……嘿，你告诉我你是请假来做研究的！

english: Well...it's permanent leave, and I am doing research! When I used to work at the Zoo, I noticed the penguins doing odd things, like taking notes or timing things. I asked to have my work detail transferred to their cage and I was fired!
translation: 呃……这是永久休假，而且我确实在做研究！我以前在动物园工作时，注意到企鹅在做奇怪的事情，比如记笔记或计时。我要求把我的工作调到它们的笼子那边，然后我就被开除了！

english: I'm sure the penguins are behind it. So I kept spying on them and I'll prove everyone wrong!
translation: 我确信是企鹅在背后搞鬼。所以我继续监视它们，我会证明所有人都错了！

english: So that's why you can't wear the suit? Because you used to work near them?
translation: 所以这就是你不能穿这套服装的原因？因为你以前在它们附近工作？

english: Err, no. I've had a few run-ins since then. But I don't have time for war stories, we need to concentrate on our mission!
translation: 呃，不是。从那以后我又遇到过几次冲突。但我没有时间讲战争故事了，我们需要专注于我们的任务！

english: When you're done making the suit, we'll head back to the iceberg and try it out.
translation: 当你做完企鹅装后，我们就回冰山去试一试。

english: Do you have the suit?
translation: 你拿到企鹅装了吗？

english: Yes, I have it.
translation: 是的，我带着呢。

english: You don't seem to have the suit with you.
translation: 你似乎没有带着企鹅装。

english: That's perfect. You are a very skilled crafter. Now we must return to the iceberg and test it.
translation: 太完美了。你真是个技艺高超的制作师。现在我们得回到冰山去测试它。

english: You haven't lost it, you just need to look for it more closely.
translation: 你没弄丢它，你只需要更仔细地找找。

english: I'm a bit confused. Can you explain how to make the suit?
translation: 我有点困惑。你能解释一下怎么制作企鹅装吗？

english: You need 1 piece of silk, 1 clockwork mechanism, and 1 wood plank.
translation: 你需要1块丝绸、1个发条装置和1块木板。

english: The book will explain how to make the suit. But, since you seem tolazy to read it, I'll summarise.
translation: 书里会解释怎么制作企鹅装。不过，既然你似乎懒得读，我就总结一下。

english: Take the materials to your house and use the Crafting table to make clockwork toys. From there you can make the suit.
translation: 把材料带到你的家中，用制作台制作发条装置玩具。然后你就可以制作那套服装了。

english: No, I'm not done yet.
translation: 不，我还没做完。

english: Look what they did to the bird hide! It's completely destroyed! The savages. The penguins are on to us.
translation: 看看它们对鸟掩体做了什么！完全被毁了！这些野蛮的家伙。企鹅发现我们了。

english: I don't think it was the penguins. You can't even make out the prints clearly, it could have been anything.
translation: 我不认为是企鹅干的。你甚至看不清脚印，可能是其他什么东西。

english: Well of course you can't make out tracks. Penguins walk single file to hide their numbers! They're clever...so very clever.
translation: 嗯，你当然无法分辨足迹。企鹅排成一列行走以隐藏它们的数量！它们很聪明……非常聪明。

english: It looks like a warning message to keep us away. I didn't think penguins were violent by nature.
translation: 看起来像是警告我们离开的信息。我没想到企鹅天生具有暴力倾向。

english: Oh, they act like they aren't, but it's all a guise. They wanted to scare us off. We must be on to something.
translation: 哦，它们表现得好像不是，但都是伪装。它们想吓跑我们。我们一定是发现了什么。

english: Well, there aren't any penguins around now, so we can't try out the suit.
translation: 嗯，现在周围没有企鹅，所以我们没法试企鹅装。

english: But, we were so close to finding out what exactly is going on. It's all ruined now. How will we ever infiltrate them if there are none around to infiltrate?
translation: 但是，我们差一点就能查明到底发生了什么。现在全毁了。如果周围没有企鹅可以渗透，我们怎么渗透它们？

english: There are other penguins. What about the ones at the Zoo? At least we can test the suit on them.
translation: 还有其他企鹅。动物园里的那些呢？至少我们可以在它们身上测试企鹅装。

english: OF COURSE! You are brilliant. I should have thought of that. It's where all of this started. Let's return to the Zoo.
translation: 当然！你太聪明了。我早该想到的。这一切就是从那里开始的。我们回动物园吧。

english: I can teleport us back to the Zoo. It'll be faster.
translation: 我可以传送我们回动物园。这样更快。

english: Then why the whole malarkey with the boat?
translation: 那为什么还要搞坐船这一套？

english: Boat rides lower my stress level.
translation: 坐船可以降低我的压力水平。

english: I'm too tired to teleport again. You'll have to get back to the Zoo on your own.
translation: 我太累了，不能再传送了。你得自己回动物园。

english: I can teleport us back to the Zoo, but you'll have to make your own way back, teleports tire me out.
translation: 我可以传送我们回动物园，但你必须自己回去，传送让我疲惫不堪。

english: After I put you in the suit, use the little gate in the enclosure to get inside. The zoo keepers won't notice.
translation: 我帮你穿上企鹅装后，用围场里的小门进去。动物园管理员不会注意到的。

english: Guess we should try this out. How do you know a shrinking spell, anyway?
translation: 我想我们应该试试这个。话说回来，你怎么会缩小法术的？

english: Well, a while back I was out in the field observing penguins. I worked for the Ardougne Zoo then. I was just quietly observing them when suddenly there was an avalanche.
translation: 嗯，一段时间前，我在野外观察企鹅。那时我在阿多尼城动物园工作。我正在安静地观察它们，突然发生了雪崩。

english: Larry, you are one unlucky dude.
translation: 拉里，你真是个倒霉的家伙。

english: I'm not done! I was trapped, but a passing old man stopped to help. He said he would shrink me so I could crawl out from under the weight of the snow.
translation: 他说可以把我缩小，这样我就能从积雪的重压下爬出来。

english: Then he taught me the spell in case I would have need of it again.
translation: 然后他教了我这个法术，以防我再次需要它。

english: Seems like a pretty wise old man.
translation: 看起来是个相当有智慧的老智者。

english: You see, that incident made me start suspecting the penguins, and my further work with them at the Zoo just confirmed it. I'm sure they got me fired. I know too much.
translation: 你看，那件事让我开始怀疑企鹅，后来我在动物园和它们一起工作的经历更证实了这一点。我确信是它们让我被炒鱿鱼的。我知道得太多了。

english: Right, well we don't have all day. Time to be a penguin!
translation: 好了，我们没时间了。是时候当企鹅了！

english: Okay, but remember, if you move too far away from me the spell will break and you'll be normal sized again. Also, if you need to switch back, just ask me and I'll unshrink you.
translation: 好的，但记住，如果你离我太远，法术就会失效，你会变回正常大小。另外，如果你需要变回来，只要告诉我，我就把你变大。

english: Right, right. Let's just get this over with.
translation: 好的，好的。我们就快点搞定吧。

english: Penguin time!
translation: 企鹅时间到！

english: You will need your hands free to operate the suit.
translation: 你需要空出双手才能操作企鹅装。

english: You can't wear a cape inside the suit, it might get caught.
translation: 你不能在企鹅装里面穿披风，可能会被卡住。

english: Don't talk to me while you're in the suit! It'll give away your cover. Here, I'll get you out of it.
translation: 你穿着企鹅装的时候不要跟我说话！会暴露你的身份。来，我带你出来。

english: Okay, I'm ready to be big again! Please get me out of this.
translation: 好了，我准备好变大了！请让我出来。

english: All right, keep calm. One growth spurt coming up.
translation: 好的，保持冷静。马上让你变大。

english: Squack! Quack, quackity squack, squee.
translation: 嘎！呱，呱呱嘎，啾。

english: What do you think you are doing?
translation: 你以为你在做什么？

english: I'm, uh, speaking penguin, I think.
translation: 我，呃，在说企鹅语，我想。

english: WAIT. How come you can speak in the common tongue? You're a penguin!
translation: 等等。你怎么会说通用语的？你是一只企鹅！

english: ...So are you.
translation: ……你也是。

english: And you are speaking in the common tongue. So, what is your point?
translation: 而且你正在用通用语说话。所以，你想说什么？

english: Oh, right. Yes, of course! Uh, I was just, uh, testing you. Making sure you're on your toes, claws, whatever.
translation: 哦，对。当然！呃，我只是，呃，在测试你。确保你保持警觉，爪子什么的都准备好了。

english: Operatives must not speak without giving the proper greeting. You have not given the proper greeting and until you do I have nothing more to say.
translation: 特工在未进行正确问候前不得发言。你尚未给出正确问候，在此之前我无话可说。

english: I better try and get this greeting right.
translation: 我最好试着把这个问候做对。

english: I am sorry comrade, but you still have not shown me the proper greeting.
translation: 抱歉同志，但你仍未向我展示正确的问候。

english: *Whew, that was right. Two more moves to do. If I get those right, he should speak to me.*
translation: *呼，这次对了。还有两个动作要做。如果我都做对了，他应该会跟我说话。*

english: *I just need to do one more move and I'll have gotten the greeting right.*
translation: *我只需要再做最后一个动作，就能把问候做对了。*

english: Welcome comrade. Now we may speak properly.
translation: 欢迎你同志。现在我们可以好好说话了。

english: What news do you bring? Have you made progress with the main directive?
translation: 你带来了什么消息？主要指令有进展吗？

english: Uh, the main directive? Yeah...sure, I made progress with it. It was...easy?
translation: 呃，主要指令？是啊……当然，我有进展。它……很容易？

english: It was easy!? It was easy to learn how to FLY?
translation: 很容易！？学会飞行很容易？

english: Uh, yeah. I just kind of jumped off a hill and flapped a lot.
translation: 呃，是啊。我就是从一个小山上跳下来，然后使劲拍打翅膀。

english: You flapped a lot? I didn't think we could fly like other birds.
translation: 你使劲拍打翅膀？我以为我们不能像其他鸟类那样飞。

english: I also launched myself out of a cannon!
translation: 我还把自己从大炮里发射了出去！

english: This caused you to fly... ingenious.
translation: 这让你飞了起来……真是天才。

english: Then I flew in a hot air balloon.
translation: 然后我坐热气球飞了。

english: A hot air balloon? This contraption made you fly?
translation: 热气球？这个装置让你飞了起来？

english: This is very amazing. I will make note of it in my mission report.
translation: 这真是太神奇了。我会把它记在我的任务报告里。

english: Why is this so important? I mean, we're good swimmers, who cares if we can't fly?
translation: 为什么这这么重要？我是说，我们游泳很厉害，谁在乎我们能不能飞？

english: Who cares? It's the entire reason we are in this wretched cage! We need to learn the secrets of flight, and the best way is to get these gullible humans to reveal it to us unwittingly. Blast them and their thumbs.
translation: 谁在乎？这正是我们被困在这个破笼子里的全部原因！我们需要学习飞行的秘密，最好的方法就是让这些容易上当的人类在不知不觉中向我们透露。该死的他们和他们的拇指。

english: You sound kind of bitter.
translation: 你听起来有点愤世嫉俗。

english: Yes, I am. I'm tired of observing these humans and being gawked at by nasty little children. I miss the fresh codfish of our motherland.
translation: 是的，我是。我厌倦了观察这些人类，被讨厌的小孩子盯着看。我想念我们祖国的新鲜鳕鱼。

english: Anything I can do?
translation: 有什么我能做的吗？

english: You could take my mission report back to the outpost for me. I don't want to risk breaking out and blowing our cover.
translation: 你可以帮我把我的任务报告带回前哨站。我不想冒险越狱而暴露我们的身份。

english: You should check in with the operatives in Lumbridge before you head to the outpost. They might have some news for you to take as well.
translation: 在你去前哨站之前，你应该先去仑桥镇和那里的特工们联系一下。他们可能也有一些消息要你带过去。

english: The penguin gave me his mission report and told me to go to Lumbridge to speak to the penguins there and then go to 'the outpost'.
translation: 企鹅把他的任务报告给了我，并告诉我去仑桥镇和那里的企鹅谈谈，然后去‘前哨站’。

english: Lumbridge? There aren't any penguins in Lumbridge. Not that I've seen. Where is this 'outpost'?
translation: 仑桥镇？仑桥镇没有企鹅。至少我没见过。那个‘前哨站’在哪里？

english: Maybe the penguins in Lumbridge are undercover?
translation: 也许仑桥镇的企鹅是卧底？

english: I didn't find out where their outpost is. I'm hoping the ones in Lumbridge will tell me.
translation: 我没找到他们的前哨站在哪里。我希望仑桥镇的那些会告诉我。

english: Seems kind of crazy that these penguins have mission reports and operatives.
translation: 这些企鹅有任务报告和特工，听起来有点疯狂。

english: They're organised little devils. Don't underestimate them.
translation: 它们是有组织的小恶魔。别小看它们。

english: You go on ahead to Lumbridge. I'll meet you there and put you in the suit.
translation: 你先去仑桥镇。我会在那里和你碰头，然后把你放进伪装服里。

english: They don't even have thumbs. How organised can they be?
translation: 它们连拇指都没有。能有多有组织？

english: So, we're in Lumbridge. Where are these penguins?
translation: 那么，我们到仑桥镇了。这些企鹅在哪里？

english: I was chatting with a local farmer, and there is a rumour about a 'thing' that lives around here. Maybe it's the penguin and these simple people don't recognise them.
translation: 我和一个当地农夫聊过，有个关于住在这附近的‘东西’的传闻。也许那就是企鹅，而这些单纯的人没认出来。

english: Hmm, I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想是吧。

english: I should probably do the secret handshake before I try talking to these penguins.
translation: 在尝试和这些企鹅说话之前，我可能应该先做那个秘密握手礼。

english: What do you think you are doing? You can't even get the greeting right.
translation: 你以为你在干什么？你连问候都做不对。

english: What do you think you are doing? You're going to blow our cover. Get away.
translation: 你以为你在干什么？你会暴露我们的。走开。

english: But I gave the correct greeting. You have to talk to me.
translation: 但我给出了正确的问候。你必须跟我说话。

english: Every two-bit soldier knows that salute. We won't give you the time of the day without the secret phrase. Now GO AWAY.
translation: 每个三流士兵都知道那个敬礼。没有秘密口令，我们不会理你。现在走开。

english: But the penguins at the Zoo sent me. They spoke to me without some phrase.
translation: 但是动物园的企鹅派我来的。它们没要什么口令就跟我说话了。

english: They are lazy, good for nothing codfish addicts. GO AWAY.
translation: 它们又懒又没用，是鳕鱼瘾君子。走开。

english: The penguins won't talk to me without some stupid secret phrase. These penguins are crazy!
translation: 没有某个愚蠢的秘密口令，这些企鹅就不跟我说话。这些企鹅疯了！

english: No, I keep trying to tell you, they aren't crazy, they are dangerous and organised.
translation: 不，我一直想告诉你，它们没疯，它们很危险而且有组织。

english: Well, since the penguin at the Zoo is the only one talking to you, maybe you should ask him.
translation: 好吧，既然动物园的企鹅是唯一跟你说话的，也许你应该去问它。

english: I can teleport us back to the Zoo, but you'll have to make your own way back. Teleports tire me out.
translation: 我可以把我们传送回动物园，但你得自己想办法回来。传送让我很累。

english: The penguins in Lumbridge refuse to talk to me. They keep demanding a secret phrase.
translation: 仑桥镇的企鹅拒绝跟我说话。它们一直要求一个秘密口令。

english: So, tell them the phrase. It's not exactly hard to remember. Pescaling Pax has a strange sense of humour.
translation: 那就告诉它们口令。这并不难记。佩斯卡林.帕克斯的幽默感很奇特。

english: Pesca-what?
translation: 佩斯卡什么？

english: Pescaling Pax. The Pescallion's son. Well, one of them. He's in charge of research and development at our headquarters.
translation: 佩斯卡林.帕克斯。佩斯卡利翁的儿子。嗯，其中之一。他在我们总部负责研发。

english: Oh, where all of the penguins...I mean us...live?
translation: 哦，是所有企鹅……我是说我们……住的地方？

english: Comrade! You really do have a funny sense of humour. No, our people live in the great city of Palingrad, of course. Ah, home, I miss it.
translation: 同志！你的幽默感真有趣。不，我们的人民当然住在大城市帕林格勒。啊，家乡，我想念它。

english: You sound pretty homesick. Can't you go and visit Palingrad?
translation: 你听起来很想家。你不能去帕林格勒看看吗？

english: If only. The Pescallion has declared that until we have finished our research of the southern species and have developed our great plan, we may not return. So I am stuck here observing humans.
translation: 要是能去就好了。佩斯卡利翁宣布，在我们完成对南方物种的研究并制定出伟大计划之前，不得返回。所以我只能困在这里观察人类。

english: Gee, I sure would like to get back, too. If only you'd tell me the phrase, so I could get the other mission report and move on.
translation: 哎呀，我也很想回去。要是你能告诉我口令，我就能拿到另一份任务报告然后继续前进了。

english: How do you not know the phrase, comrade?
translation: 同志，你怎么会不知道口令？

english: Uh, I forgot what the phrase was.
translation: 呃，我忘了口令是什么了。

english: That was very careless of you, comrade. But it is your problem, not mine.
translation: 同志，你太粗心了。但这是你的问题，不是我的。

english: I must have left the outpost before they gave out the phrase.
translation: 我肯定是在他们公布口令之前就离开了前哨站。

english: No one left before it was given out. I was one of the first operatives to leave, and I know it.
translation: 没有人是在口令公布之前离开的。我是最早离开的特工之一，我都知道。

english: What? Comrade, I think you need your head examined when you get back.
translation: 什么？同志，我觉得你回去后需要检查一下脑袋。

english: I need that phrase! Isn't there anything you can do?
translation: 我需要那个口令！你就不能做点什么吗？

english: As you are a comrade, I suppose it is my duty to help you.
translation: 既然你是同志，我想我有责任帮你。

english: The phrase is 'Do not trust the walrus'.
translation: 口令是‘不要相信海象’。

english: I see you have some raw cod with you comrade. I might be willing to exchange information for it, if you are willing.
translation: 我看到你带着一些生鳕鱼，同志。如果你愿意，我可以用信息来交换它。

english: Thank you comrade. This is like a taste of the motherland. The phrase is 'Do not trust the walrus.'
translation: 谢谢你同志。这就像尝到了祖国的味道。口令是‘不要相信海象’。

english: Hmm, no I'll hang on to it.
translation: 嗯，不，我还是留着它吧。

english: I am sorry comrade, but I cannot break protocol without good reason.
translation: 对不起同志，没有充分理由我不能违反规程。

english: Haa haa haa, that is a funny joke. I like your sense of humour comrade. It would be like asking 'Where is the motherland'.
translation: 哈哈哈，这真是个有趣的笑话。我喜欢你的幽默感同志。这就像问‘祖国在哪里’一样。

english: You mean they aren't the same?
translation: 你的意思是它们不一样？

english: Haa haa haa... oh you have me in stitches.
translation: 哈哈哈……哦，你让我笑死了。

english: The Zoo penguin won't tell me the phrase.
translation: 动物园的企鹅不告诉我口令。

english: Maybe there's something he wants, something you can trade for the phrase? Or maybe there's some kind of magic that would persuade him?
translation: 也许它想要什么东西，你可以用来交换口令？或者也许有某种魔法可以说服它？

english: Well, what do penguins like?
translation: 嗯，企鹅喜欢什么？

english: I once had to clean all the penguins feet, back when I had a job.
translation: 我以前有工作的时候，曾经不得不清洗所有企鹅的脚。

english: I distracted them by giving them cod fish and then did the job. It was gross.
translation: 我通过给它们鳕鱼来分散它们的注意力，然后做完了工作。真恶心。

english: I don't think I ever want to be a Zoo keeper.
translation: 我想我永远不想当动物园管理员。

english: Or perhaps there's some sort of magic that could persuade the penguin? An object of power or the like?
translation: 或者也许有某种魔法可以说服企鹅？比如一件有力量的物品之类的？

english: Yes, comrade?
translation: 是的，同志？

english: I got the phrase! These penguins are so weird. It's something about a walrus.
translation: 我拿到口令了！这些企鹅真奇怪。是关于海象的。

english: You aren't taking this seriously! They are dangerous!
translation: 你没认真对待这件事！它们很危险！

english: Yeah, and organised. I know.
translation: 是啊，而且有组织。我知道。

english: Oh, just go talk to the sheep.
translation: 哦，那就去跟羊说话吧。

english: Do not trust the walrus.
translation: 不要相信海象。

english: The penguin at the Zoo told me to see if you had any news.
translation: 动物园的企鹅让我来看看你有没有什么消息。

english: We can't get any news in this field! All these humans keep trying to shear us!
translation: 我们在这片田野里得不到任何消息！所有这些人类都一直想剪我们的毛！

english: We think the Farmer may be an agent for the other side, trying to have us assassinated by all these foolish humans. If you investigate him for us, we can finish our mission report and you can go on your way.
translation: 我们认为那个农夫可能是另一边的特工，试图让这些愚蠢的人类来暗杀我们。如果你替我们调查他，我们就可以完成我们的任务报告，然后你就可以上路了。

english: You want me to disguise myself as a human and talk to the Farmer? Seems like a tough request. I'll only do it if you tell me how to get to the outpost.
translation: 你想让我伪装成人类去和农夫谈话？这要求听起来很难。只有你告诉我怎么去前哨站，我才会做。

english: What do you mean 'How to get to the outpost'? Any intelligent penguin knows that.
translation: 你‘怎么去前哨站’是什么意思？任何聪明的企鹅都知道。

english: Are you calling me dumb? Fine. You can talk to the Farmer yourself, and compromise your mission.
translation: 你在说我笨吗？好吧。那你自己去和农夫谈吧，然后搞砸你的任务。

english: No, no, we'll tell you. You just deal with the Farmer.
translation: 不，不，我们会告诉你。你只管去对付那个农夫。

english: I need to talk to you about penguins.
translation: 我需要跟你谈谈关于企鹅的事。

english: About what now? What do penguins have to do with anything?
translation: 关于什么？企鹅跟这有什么关系？

english: Hey Fred! You've been messing with the wrong people. You better leave the penguins alone... OR ELSE!
translation: 嘿弗雷德！你惹错人了。你最好离那些企鹅远点……否则后果自负！

english: What are you shouting about? Don't you come into my house shouting at me.
translation: 你在喊什么？别进我家对我大喊大叫。

english: I mean it Fred, I don't know whose side you're working for, but assassinating the penguin operatives is going to get you in trouble. To think you'd even stoop to sending others to try and 'shear' them. Be careful, or you might find you've been shorn.
translation: 我是认真的弗雷德，我不知道你为哪边工作，但暗杀企鹅特工会给你惹麻烦的。没想到你甚至堕落到派别人去试图‘剪’它们的毛。小心点，否则你可能会发现自己被‘剪’了。

english: Is this some kind of joke? I'm a SHEEP farmer. That means I need to shear sheep. What are these penguins you keep talking about?
translation: 这是个玩笑吗？我是个养羊的农夫。这意味着我需要剪羊毛。你一直说的这些企鹅是什么？

english: Don't play neutral with me, Fred. I see right through you. You're probably working for the squirrels, aren't you? I'll be watching Fred. I'm always watching.
translation: 别跟我装中立，弗雷德。我看透你了。你可能在为松鼠工作，对吧？我会盯着你的弗雷德。我一直在盯着。

english: You know that 'Thing' out in your field? It's two penguins in disguise.
translation: 你知道你田里的那个‘东西’吗？那是两只伪装起来的企鹅。

english: Like I haven't heard that before.
translation: 好像我没听过这种话似的。

english: No really, it is! They're trying to observe humans to learn our weaknesses.
translation: 不，真的！他们想观察人类，找出我们的弱点。

english: Then why are they disguised as sheep?
translation: 那他们干嘛伪装成羊？

english: They probably thought they'd blend in better. Anyway, I came to warn you to not annoy them too much. They're funny little guys but they seem to have a grudge against you.
translation: 他们可能觉得这样更容易混进来。总之，我是来提醒你别太招惹他们。他们虽然挺有趣，但好像对你有意见。

english: You talk to these penguins?
translation: 你跟这些企鹅说话？

english: Yes, I have a penguin suit and I know the secret greeting. I'm infiltrating them because this crazy guy Larry is convinced they are trying to take over the world or something.
translation: 对，我有一套企鹅装，还知道秘密问候语。我在渗透他们，因为那个疯子拉里坚信他们想统治世界什么的。

english: Look, when these voices in your head start talking to you again, you might want to ignore them.
translation: 听着，等你脑子里那些声音再跟你说话时，你最好别理它们。

english: HEY! I'm not crazy! Larry's a little left of centre, but I'm just helping him out. The penguins really can talk.
translation: 嘿！我没疯！拉里是有点偏激，但我只是在帮他。企鹅真的会说话。

english: Right, right. I believe you, sure. Maybe on your way out you could ask the sheep to herd themselves for me.
translation: 对对，我相信你，当然。也许你出去的时候可以叫那些羊自己帮我放牧。

english: Fine. Don't believe me. Larry and I will prove you wrong. Just don't go near the penguins, Fred, not if you value your life.
translation: 行，不信拉倒。我和拉里会证明你错了。弗雷德，别靠近那些企鹅，除非你不要命了。

english: Is the Farmer an agent for the other side?
translation: 那个农夫是对方的人吗？

english: The Farmer is definitely an enemy. High ranking too, I think. He might even be the King of Lumbridge in disguise!
translation: 农夫绝对是敌人。而且我觉得级别很高。他甚至可能是仑桥镇的国王假扮的！

english: King? I thought there was a duke, not a king.
translation: 国王？我记得是公爵，不是国王吧。

english: Well, that's why he's in disguise. Duh.
translation: 这不废话嘛，所以他才会伪装啊。

english: This is an amazing revelation. We must include it in our report. Thank you, we'll mention your bravery.
translation: 这真是个惊人的发现。我们必须写进报告里。谢谢，我们会提到你的勇敢。

english: The Farmer is harmless. The sheep, however...now they seem pretty crafty.
translation: 那个农夫无害。不过那些羊……它们看起来挺狡猾的。

english: The sheep? But...They just wander around in this field all day. Trust us, we know.
translation: 羊？但它们……整天就在这片地里闲逛。信我们，我们清楚。

english: Exactly! So you don't suspect them! That's why they are so cunning. Watch your backs.
translation: 没错！所以你们才不怀疑它们！这就是它们狡猾的地方。小心点。

english: You have a good point. Yes, we must warn Pescaling Pax of this new threat. We'll put it in the report and you can give it to them.
translation: 你说得有道理。对，我们必须警告佩斯卡林.帕克斯这个新威胁。我们会写进报告里，你拿去给他们。

english: Well, off you go now!
translation: 好了，你现在可以走了！

english: Hey wait, you said you'd tell me where the outpost is!
translation: 嘿等等，你说过会告诉我前哨站在哪！

english: You are one clueless penguin. The outpost is the iceberg to the North. The entrance is concealed by what looks like an avalanche.
translation: 你这企鹅真是一点都不懂。前哨站在北边的冰山上。入口被看起来像雪崩的东西遮住了。

english: When you try and go through a guard will stop you and ask for the password.
translation: 你试着进去时，会有守卫拦住你，问你要口令。

english: The password is cabbage. Don't forget it.
translation: 口令是卷心菜。别忘了。

english: Haa haa, this is fun!
translation: 哈哈，真好玩！

english: What? How?
translation: 什么？怎么做到的？

english: I just convinced them Fred the Farmer was the King of Lumbridge!
translation: 我刚说服他们农夫弗雷德是仑桥镇的国王！

english: But there is no King of Lumbridge.
translation: 但仑桥镇没有国王啊。

english: Exactly! They are so gullible. Even if they are organised.
translation: 没错！他们太好骗了。就算他们组织严密也一样。

english: Don't take this so lightly. You might put Fred in danger because you were having a laugh.
translation: 别这么不当回事。你开玩笑可能会把弗雷德置于危险中。

english: Sorry. It was just a bit of fun.
translation: 抱歉。只是开个玩笑。

english: I just convinced the penguins that the sheep are agents for the other side.
translation: 我刚说服企鹅那些羊是对方的人。

english: They are?
translation: 它们是吗？

english: No! They're just sheep. But I wanted to confuse the penguins. Put them off our scent.
translation: 不！它们只是羊。但我想迷惑那些企鹅。让它们闻不到我们的气味。

english: What a good plan! I just hope the sheep aren't working for the other side.
translation: 好计划！我只希望那些羊不是对方的人。

english: Larry, we need to get you to hang out with people, not animals.
translation: 拉里，你得跟人打交道，别老跟动物混。

english: I know where their outpost is! The entrance is on the iceberg. It's concealed by an avalanche.
translation: 我知道他们的前哨站在哪了！入口在冰山上，被雪崩遮住了。

english: Great. Let's go back to the iceberg, I'll put you in your suit and we'll really see what these penguins are up to.
translation: 太好了。我们回冰山去，我帮你穿上企鹅装，然后我们看看这些企鹅到底在搞什么鬼。

english: Now you can try and enter the outpost. This is exciting.
translation: 现在你可以试着进入前哨站了。真刺激。

english: It's fun for you! You're not risking your neck.
translation: 对你来说当然好玩！你又不用冒险。

english: But you don't think penguins are dangerous anyway. So there's no danger is there? Or are you coming around to my thinking that they are dangerous?
translation: 但你不是觉得企鹅不危险吗？所以没什么危险，对吧？还是你开始认同我的想法，觉得他们危险了？

english: No...I mean...yes. Oh never mind. Just do the spell. Wait, won't the spell wear off once I'm inside? You'll be too far away.
translation: 不……我是说……算了。快施法吧。等等，我进去后法术不会失效吗？你离得太远了。

english: Oh, no. The ice magnifies this spell, so it will allow you to go greater distances.
translation: 哦，不会。冰会增强这个法术，让你能走得更远。

english: This guy looks official. I'd better do the greeting before I speak to him.
translation: 这家伙看起来挺正式的。我最好先打个招呼再跟他说话。

english: Don't stand around, agent. You look absurd.
translation: 别傻站着，特工。你看起来真可笑。

english: Password?
translation: 口令？

english: Cabbage.
translation: 卷心菜。

english: Let's see your ID and you can go through.
translation: 让我看看你的证件，你就可以进去了。

english: ID? No one told me anything about ID.
translation: 证件？没人跟我说过要证件啊。

english: No ID, no entry!
translation: 没有身份证明，不能进入！

english: The penguin at the entrance said I needed to have an ID. Nobody told me about any ID!
translation: 入口的企鹅说我要有证件。没人跟我说过什么证件！

english: ID? But...they all look alike. Well, the other penguins probably just assumed you had it, since you said you were an agent.
translation: 证件？但他们……都长得一样。嗯，其他企鹅可能以为你有了，因为你说自己是特工。

english: You know, I met a rather shifty looking penguin once, north of Miscellania. He was named after some sort of pasta...
translation: 你知道吗，我曾在米斯凯尼亚北边遇到一只看起来很可疑的企鹅。他的名字像某种意大利面……

english: Anyway, he worked for a black market. Maybe he has a contact here who could get you an ID?
translation: 总之，他在黑市干活。也许他在这里有联系人能帮你弄到证件？

english: Penguins have black markets?
translation: 企鹅也有黑市？

english: Of course. Just look around here for a shifty pasta penguin.
translation: 当然。就在这附近找找那只可疑的意大利面企鹅。

english: Oi, mate, 'u innerested i' sum 'wares?
translation: 嘿，哥们，想买点货吗？

english: Uh...maybe?
translation: 呃……也许吧？

english: I go' me sum hot 'wares, mate. Wotcha need?
translation: 我这有热货，哥们。你需要啥？

english: Well, I've misplaced me, I mean my, ID card.
translation: 嗯，我弄丢了我的，呃，证件卡。

english: Ah, frisky nigh' on leave, eh? Betcha furgo' yur missin repor' 'oo.
translation: 啊，休假前玩疯了是吧？我打赌你也忘了任务报告了。

english: Yeah, my missin repor'. I think I need one of them too.
translation: 对，我的任务报告。我想我也需要一份。

english: Well, mate. 'U scratch me back, I stab urs, right?
translation: 好吧，哥们。你帮我，我帮你，对吧？

english: What? No, no stabbing.
translation: 什么？不，别捅人。

english: I men' in a good way. I wan' sumpin in exy-change. Ima in need of sum swamp tur.
translation: 我是好意。我想要点东西作为交换。伊玛需要一些沼泽焦油。

english: Tur? Do you mean tar?
translation: 焦油？你是说焦油吗？

english: Thas wha' I sed, innit? I need sum feathers 'oo. Foive of 'em.
translation: 我就是这么说的，不是吗？我还需要一些羽毛。五根。

english: So you need swamp tar and five feathers. Will chicken feathers do?
translation: 所以你需要沼泽焦油和五根羽毛。鸡毛行吗？

english: Yea, begreat. Then I'll guv yea 'ur stuff.
translation: 行，太好了。那我就给你你的东西。

english: Yuv go' the stuff?
translation: 你拿到神秘物质了吗？

english: Yeah, I got it.
translation: 对，我拿到了。

english: Whers me swamp tur 'n feathers, mate?
translation: 我的沼泽焦油和羽毛呢，哥们？

english: Whers me feathers, mate?
translation: 我的羽毛呢，哥们？

english: Whers me swamp tur, mate?
translation: 我的沼泽焦油呢，哥们？

english: What did you need?
translation: 你需要什么来着？

english: I need swamp tur and foive feathers, mate.
translation: 我需要沼泽焦油和五根羽毛，哥们。

english: Tell me about this black market you run. Seems kind of risky.
translation: 跟我说说你经营的这个黑市。看起来挺冒险的。

english: Nah ain't risky. Bu' I dun run it. Me bruva, Alfredo, does. E runs the Fettuccine Mafia.
translation: 不，不冒险。但不是我经营的。是我兄弟阿尔弗雷多干的。他管着意大利面黑手党。

english: Riiiight. Fettucine Mafia. I'll remember that.
translation: 好……吧。意大利面黑手党。我会记住的。

english: Need summat?
translation: 需要什么吗？

english: Yeah, I need some replacements.
translation: 对，我需要一些替换品。

english: U dunna need ID.
translation: 你不需要证件。

english: Oi, 'u got 'ur repor'.
translation: 嘿，你拿到报告了。

english: All right, you can go in. The entrance is hidden under that avalanche.
translation: 好了，你可以进去了。入口藏在那个雪崩下面。

english: Once inside, go into the room to the left. You'll be debriefed there. No dawdling!
translation: 进去后，去左边的房间。你会在那里接受汇报。别磨蹭！

english: Welcome back agent...
translation: 欢迎回来，特工……

english: Peach? But, aren't you...male?
translation: 桃子？但你不是……男的吗？

english: It was either that or Pear.
translation: 要么叫这个，要么叫梨子。

english: Ah. Of course.
translation: 啊。当然。

english: Pablo? But, aren't you...female?
translation: 巴勃罗？但你不是……女的吗？

english: Hippie parents, sir. They had weird ideas about names.
translation: 嬉皮士父母，长官。他们对名字有奇怪的想法。

english: So you have just returned from your mission?
translation: 所以你刚执行完任务回来？

english: Yes, and I have my mission report. I also have the mission reports from the operatives in the Ardougne Zoo and the Lumbridge sheep field.
translation: 是的，我有我的任务报告。我也有阿多尼城动物园和仑桥镇羊场特工的任务报告。

english: How very industrious of you, agent. Please hand them over.
translation: 特工，你真是勤奋。请把它们交上来。

english: Hmm, these reports are...intriguing.
translation: 嗯，这些报告……有点意思。

english: It says you jumped off a hill and flew? Without assistance?
translation: 上面说你从小山上跳下来飞了？没借助任何东西？

english: Oh yeah. It was amazing. You know, I just...flapped. Really fast.
translation: 哦对，太神奇了。你知道，我就是……使劲拍翅膀。非常快。

english: Hmm, we shall have to research this.
translation: 嗯，我们得研究一下这个。

english: Did you really get launched out of a cannon? It seems quite risky.
translation: 你真的被大炮发射出去了？看起来挺危险的。

english: It wasn't too bad. I was wearing a helmet at the time.
translation: 还行。我当时戴着头盔。

english: This could be very useful during battle.
translation: 这在战斗中会非常有用。

english: You flew in a 'hot air balloon'? What is that exactly?
translation: 你坐了一个“热气球”飞过来的？那到底是什么东西？

english: Well, it was a sack of cloth with a basket attached to the bottom and when you filled it with hot air it went up.
translation: 嗯，那是一个布料麻袋，底部绑着一个篮子，当你往里面充入热空气时，它就升起来了。

english: Fascinating. Well done agent.
translation: 有意思。干得好，探员。

english: I am satisfied with your reports. You just need to complete a physical and you will be free to roam at your leasure.
translation: 我对你的报告很满意。你只需要完成一次体能测试，之后就可以自由活动了。

english: A physical? What, are they going to examine my body?
translation: 体能测试？什么，他们要检查我的身体吗？

english: Oh no. It's an agility course to make sure you're still fit and able to serve. Don't worry, I'm sure you won't have any difficulty getting through it. Just go through the door at the end of the room.
translation: 哦不是。是一个敏捷课程，确保你仍然健康、能够服役。别担心，我相信你通过它不会有任何困难。只要通过房间尽头的那扇门就行了。

english: Well done soldier! You've successfully completed the physical. You're free to do as you like.
translation: 干得好，士兵！你成功完成了体能测试。你现在可以自由行动了。

english: What do I do now?
translation: 我现在该做什么？

english: Just go through the gate in the fence and use the same door you came out of. You can come back whenever you like to tone up your body.
translation: 只要穿过栅栏上的门，再从来时的门出去就行了。你随时可以回来锻炼身体。

english: Larry, you were right! There's an entire army of them, and they're drilling and... Larry, they're ORGANISED!
translation: 拉里，你说对了！有一整支企鹅军队，他们正在操练，而且……拉里，他们是有组织的！

english: That's what I've been saying from the start! But an entire army? This is just an outpost, so it can't be an entire army.
translation: 我从一开始就这么说！但一整支军队？这只是一个前哨站，不可能是整支军队。

english: I know what I saw! They were doing drills and everything.
translation: 我亲眼所见！他们在操练，什么都做。

english: Still, it must only be an invasion party. The main force is on...well, it doesn't matter right now.
translation: 不过，那肯定只是一支入侵小队。主力部队在……嗯，现在这不重要。

english: I've been doing some research of my own, and I think I know what our next step should be. There's a secret room, deep in the glacier. I think that is where they are making their war plans.
translation: 我自己做了一些调查，我觉得我知道下一步该怎么走了。冰川深处有一个秘密房间。我觉得他们就是在那里制定战争计划的。

english: War plans! Who are they going to war with?
translation: 战争计划！他们要跟谁打仗？

english: With us, you dolt! They are trying to take over the world. Have you not grasped this yet? You need to find that room. Our future depends on it.
translation: 跟我们啊，傻瓜！他们想统治世界。你还没明白吗？你必须找到那个房间。我们的未来就靠它了。

english: Where could this room be?
translation: 那个房间会在哪儿呢？

english: It's probably the most well guarded room in the place. You'll need to find a way to get into it without arousing suspicion.
translation: 很可能是这里守卫最森严的房间。你得想个办法进去，还不能引起怀疑。

english: That's a pretty tall order.
translation: 这可真是个大难题。

english: What are you doing out here! You need to get in there and find the secret room.
translation: 你在这儿干什么！你得进去找到那个秘密房间。

english: Keep your shorts on; I'm working on it.
translation: 别着急；我正在处理。

english: You there, let me through those doors.
translation: 你，让我通过那扇门。

english: Let's see your ID, comrade.
translation: 让我看看你的证件，同志。

english: I'm sorry comrade, you do not have the clearance to go through these doors.
translation: 抱歉，同志，你没有通过这扇门的权限。

english: You look like...knowledgeable...penguins. What's through those doors at the end of the hall?
translation: 你们看起来……很有见识……企鹅。大厅尽头那扇门后面是什么？

english: Hey man, don't stress. Those doors open new worlds, man. Like, new rooms too.
translation: 嘿，老兄，别紧张。那扇门会打开新世界，老兄。就像，新房间也是。

english: Yes, well, I would like to know what rooms.
translation: 是的，嗯，我想知道是什么房间。

english: Like, the War Room and stuff like that, dude. Wicked stuff. Too bad only 'the man' gets to go through.
translation: 就像，作战室和那些玩意儿，老兄。厉害的东西。可惜只有“老大”才能进去。

english: Humans can go through?
translation: 人类能进去吗？

english: No, man. He just means the authority. The MAN, you know?
translation: 不是啦，老兄。他只是说权威。就是“老大”，你懂吧？

english: Who are you? You don't really look like KGP agents.
translation: 你们是谁？你们看起来不太像KGP特工。

english: Dude, we are bards. We sing of the glories of the common penguin. We are also supposed to record history, but man, it is so HIS story. Like, the MAN's story.
translation: 老兄，我们是吟游诗人。我们歌颂普通企鹅的荣耀。我们本来也该记录历史，但老兄，那全是“他的”历史。就像，老大的历史。

english: Penguins have bards?
translation: 企鹅也有吟游诗人？

english: Totally, dude. You want to hear one of our songs?
translation: 当然啦，老兄。你想听听我们的一首歌吗？

english: Sure, I haven't got anything to lose, except my eardrums.
translation: 好啊，反正我也不会损失什么，除了我的耳膜。

english: Well, like, we can't play it in THIS now. Maybe at a later now. We don't have any instruments to accompany our great song.
translation: 嗯，就像，我们现在不能在这里弹。也许在以后的“现在”。我们没有乐器来伴奏我们伟大的歌曲。

english: But this room is filled with instruments.
translation: 但这个房间里到处都是乐器啊。

english: Yeah man, but they come from the south, where humans have thumbs to play them with. We don't have thumbs. Also, the Pescaling had our old ones confiscated for being too loud.
translation: 是啊老兄，但它们是从南边来的，那里的人类有拇指可以弹奏它们。我们没有拇指。而且，佩斯卡令把我们以前的乐器没收了，说太吵了。

english: Way harsh, man.
translation: 真过分啊，老兄。

english: But dude, I was reading, and there are instruments we could play. I read about one called bongos. They just need to be hit.
translation: 但是老兄，我之前在看书，有种乐器我们可以演奏。我读到一种叫邦戈鼓的，只要敲就行。

english: But we need two instruments, man. Like, to make it harmonious with the vibes.
translation: 但我们需要两种乐器，老兄。就像，这样才能让气场和谐。

english: What about a cowbell? You don't need thumbs for that.
translation: 牛铃怎么样？那个不需要拇指。

english: Righteous man. So you'll get a cowbell and bongos for us and we'll rock out. We'll be so harmonious, no Pescallion could complain.
translation: 没错老兄。那你去给我们弄一个牛铃和一组邦戈鼓，我们就嗨起来。我们会弹得超级和谐，让所有佩斯卡令都没话说。

english: Wait, why am I getting these instruments?
translation: 等等，为什么是我去弄这些乐器？

english: Because your aura says you should.
translation: 因为你的气场告诉你应该这么做。

english: I think I have a lead. These two penguin bards seem to know a lot of the history of the iceberg. I think they might know a way into the War Room.
translation: 我好像有线索了。那两只企鹅吟游诗人似乎对冰山的历史知道得很多。我想他们可能知道进入作战室的方法。

english: Bards? They have bards?
translation: 吟游诗人？他们还有吟游诗人？

english: Yeah, that's what I said.
translation: 是啊，我就是这么说的。

english: Where would I get a cowbell or a set of bongos?
translation: 我上哪儿去弄一个牛铃或者一套邦戈鼓？

english: I'm not even going to ask why.
translation: 我甚至都不想问为什么。

english: I think dairy cows have bells, you could steal one from it. Bongos... I suppose you could make them? Mahogany is good for bending, and then just use soft leather for the drum.
translation: 我想奶牛应该挂有铃铛，你可以从它身上偷一个。邦戈鼓……我猜你可以自己做？桃花心木适合弯曲，然后用软皮革做鼓面。

english: Good plan, Larry.
translation: 好主意，拉里。

english: Man, did you bring the instruments to us?
translation: 老兄，你把乐器给我们带来了吗？

english: What did I need to get you?
translation: 我需要给你们带什么来着？

english: We want a cowbell and a set of bongos.
translation: 我们要一个牛铃和一组邦戈鼓。

english: You didn't bring the instruments.
translation: 你没带乐器来。

english: You didn't bring the bongos.
translation: 你没带邦戈鼓来。

english: You didn't bring a cowbell.
translation: 你没带牛铃来。

english: Dude, good job on the instruments. Just let us set up and we'll get going.
translation: 老兄，乐器干得漂亮。让我们布置一下，马上就开搞。

english: And a 1 and a 2 and a 3...
translation: 一、二、三……

english: Wait, wait. It needs more cowbell.
translation: 等等，等等。还需要更多牛铃。

english: You're right, man. Let's try this again!
translation: 你说得对，老兄。我们再来一次！

english: There once was a Pescallion, who travelled in a galleon.
translation: 从前有个佩斯卡令，乘着大帆船远行。

english: Our Pescallion went exploring and found this iceberg
translation: 我们的佩斯卡令探险，发现了这座冰山。

english: He travelled the world, until his toes curled.
translation: 他走遍世界，直到脚趾卷曲。

english: Upon an iceberg he came, and our lives were never the same.
translation: 来到一座冰山上，我们的生活从此不一样。

english: As an outpost it was approved, so here our people moved.
translation: 它被批准作为前哨站，于是我们的人民搬了过来。

english: To grow and learn, though our hearts did yearn...
translation: 成长学习，尽管心中渴望……

english: For the motherland.
translation: 回到祖国。

english: Deep inside the 'berg lay a threat, but don't fret!
translation: 冰山深处有个威胁，但别害怕！

english: For Pescaling Pax trapped those monsters behind a gate, but let's hope they don't mate.
translation: 因为佩斯卡林.帕克斯把那些怪物关在门后，但愿它们别繁殖。

english: Now we have no fear
translation: 现在我们无所畏惧，

english: But shed a small tear for the motherland.
translation: 只为祖国流一滴泪。

english: All right, that's enough racket.
translation: 行了，吵死了。

english: Shut those instruments up or I'm throwing you in solitary!
translation: 给我把那些乐器停了，不然把你们关禁闭！

english: I don't care if your vibes are harmonious!
translation: 我才不管你们的气场和不和谐！

english: Now might be a good time for me to slip out and get through those doors...
translation: 现在可能是我溜出去穿过那扇门的好时机……

english: And we'll move this little penguin here...and KABLOOM! Heee hee.
translation: 我们把这只小企鹅移到这里……然后砰！嘿嘿。

english: It appears we have a visitor!
translation: 看来我们有访客了！

english: Haa haa! I am glad we installed that anti-magic security. What have we here?
translation: 哈哈！真高兴我们安装了反魔法安全系统。这是什么？

english: What an ingenious little device. This will solve all our problems. Scientists! Come examine this; we have much work to do.
translation: 多么巧妙的小装置。这能解决我们所有的问题。科学家们！过来看看这个；我们有很多工作要做。

english: What about me?
translation: 那我怎么办？

english: Hmm, take that human to the Ice Lords. They'll enjoy the exercise.
translation: 嗯，把那个人类带去见冰领主。他们会喜欢运动一下的。

english: You're safe! I was really worried for a while there. What happened?
translation: 你安全了！刚才我真担心了一阵子。发生什么事了？

english: Ice Lord...hit me...ow...
translation: 冰领主……打我……噢……

english: Yes, yes, you're very brave. I mean what happened in the War Room?
translation: 是的是的，你很勇敢。我是说在作战室里发生了什么？

english: Pescaling Pax was there, and he forced me out of the suit and then threw me into a cage with the Ice Lords!
translation: 佩斯卡林.帕克斯在那里，他把我从衣服里赶了出来，然后把我扔进了关冰领主的笼子！

english: But what was IN the War Room?
translation: 但作战室里到底有什么？

english: There was a map of the world and a lot of little penguin figures.
translation: 有一张世界地图和很多小企鹅雕像。

english: YES! I knew it! I said I'd prove them all wrong. They are organised and invading. OH YEAH, Larry was right. Who was right? Larry was!
translation: 没错！我就知道！我说过我会证明他们都是错的。他们是有组织的，而且在入侵。哦耶，拉里说对了。谁对了？拉里！

english: LARRY! We've just uncovered a plot that could destroy everything we hold dear. Don't you think we should focus on stopping them?
translation: 拉里！我们刚发现了一个可能摧毁我们所珍视的一切的阴谋。你不觉得我们该集中精力阻止他们吗？

english: You are such a buzz kill.
translation: 你真扫兴。

english: We need to plan our next move, but now they know both our scents and might come after us!
translation: 我们需要计划下一步行动，但现在他们知道了我们两个的气味，可能会来追杀我们！

english: No, they only know mine. That agility course really stank up the suit and seems to have covered your scent. You might want to consider bathing soon.
translation: 不，他们只知道我的气味。那个敏捷训练场把衣服搞得臭烘烘的，似乎盖住了你的气味。你或许该考虑尽快洗个澡。

english: As for our next move, I've got...friends...elsewhere who should hear of this information, but we have plenty of time. It's not as though they made a break through in their research or something.
translation: 至于我们的下一步，我在别处有些……朋友……应该听听这个消息，不过我们时间很充裕。他们又不是在研究上取得了什么突破。

english: The hide was destroyed. It's too damaged to rebuild, so we can't use it to observe penguins any more.
translation: 呃啊啊啊！

english: Urrrrrgh!
translation: 呃啊啊啊啊！

english: So what do you plan to do now?
translation: 那你现在打算怎么做？

english: Well now that we've sorted out this business with Klenter, we can properly focus on dealing with these plagues.
translation: 嗯，既然我们已经解决了和克伦特的麻烦，就能好好专注处理这些瘟疫了。

english: And how's that looking?
translation: 情况如何？

english: Not great. However, we do have one bit of good news in that area, thanks to you.
translation: 不太乐观。不过，托你的福，我们在那方面总算有了点好消息。

english: Hello there. How goes things?
translation: 你好。事情进展如何？

english: Better now that we've sorted out that business with Klenter. Still, we're no closer to dealing with these plagues.
translation: 解决了克伦特那档子事后，现在好多了。不过，对付这些瘟疫还是没什么进展。

english: However, we do have one bit of good news in that area, thanks to you.
translation: 不过，托你的福，我们在那方面总算有了点好消息。

english: Thanks to me?
translation: 托我的福？

english: Yes. You've shown us that the pox we're all infected with can't be contagious. If it was, you'd be covered in spots by now.
translation: 没错。你证明了我们感染的波克斯不具有传染性。如果会传染，你现在早就满身是斑点了。

english: That's a very good point. Does this mean you can reopen the city?
translation: 说得很有道理。这是否意味着你可以重新开放城市？

english: It does indeed. The decision to lock things down was made very quickly, so we were forced to trap many of our citizens outside the walls. We'll be able to let them all back in now.
translation: 确实如此。封锁的决定下得很快，所以我们被迫将许多市民困在城墙外。现在我们能让他们都回来了。

english: That's wonderful news!
translation: 真是太好了！

english: It is, but there is a problem.
translation: 是的，但有个问题。

english: When the plague first started, Menaphos, our neighbouring city, closed their gates as well. Many of our citizens became trapped there when they did.
translation: 瘟疫刚开始时，邻城美那福斯也关闭了大门。许多市民当时被困在那里。

english: But if there's no risk of them becoming infected, can't they open up again as well?
translation: 但如果他们没有被感染的风险，他们不也能重新开放吗？

english: You'd think so, but they believe that there is still a danger. It seems they're even willing to kill if it helps keep their city isolated.
translation: 按理说应该如此，但他们仍然认为有危险。看来他们甚至不惜杀人来维持城市的隔离。

english: Hmm... Perhaps I could help?
translation: 嗯……也许我可以帮忙？

english: The offer is appreciated, but I don't think there's anything you can do.
translation: 很感谢你的提议，但我觉得你帮不上什么忙。

english: You'd really be willing to help us again?
translation: 你真的愿意再帮我们一次？

english: I'm very grateful. To be honest though, I'm not really sure where to start with this.
translation: 我非常感激。不过老实说，我真不知道该从哪里入手。

english: Well first up, why don't you tell me what happened with Menaphos? You said something about them being willing to kill?
translation: 嗯，首先，你何不告诉我美那福斯那边发生了什么？你刚才说他们不惜杀人？

english: Indeed. Earlier today, I led a delegation across the bridge between the two cities in the hope of convincing them to end the quarantine. It didn't go well...
translation: 是的。今天早些时候，我率领一个代表团穿过连接两城的桥，希望能说服他们解除隔离。结果不顺利……

english: Actually, I have other things to do.
translation: 其实，我还有别的事要做。

english: Halt! Don't take another step!
translation: 站住！再走一步试试！

english: That is an improper greeting. You address the High Priest of Icthlarin!
translation: 这是无礼的招呼。你面对的是伊克哈林的大祭司！

english: Don't try my patience! I have been ordered to stop anyone attempting to cross this bridge!
translation: 别考验我的耐心！我奉命阻止任何人过桥！

english: We have discovered that we are not contagious. You must let us pass!
translation: 我们已经发现我们不具有传染性。你必须让我们过去！

english: Step back or we will open fire.
translation: 退后，否则我们就要放箭了。

english: You wouldn't dare!
translation: 你们敢！

english: Archers, take your mark!
translation: 弓箭手，准备！

english: You wouldn't?
translation: 你们不会真的……？

english: Take aim!
translation: 瞄准！

english: Fire!
translation: 放箭！

english: Halt!
translation: 站住！

english: Don't take another step.
translation: 再走一步试试。

english: Don't try my patience!
translation: 别考验我的耐心！

english: I have been ordered to prevent anyone attempting to cross this bridge.
translation: 我奉命阻止任何人试图穿过这座桥。

english: Archers, take your mark.
translation: 弓箭手，准备。

english: So they just started firing arrows at you? They sound like cold-blooded thugs.
translation: 所以他们就直接朝你们放箭？听起来像是冷血的暴徒。

english: It is often the way under Pharoah Kemesis. He leads the Menaphites in a more secular manner than we would like. Respect for the old ways is diminishing.
translation: 法老凯米西斯统治下经常这样。他以一种我们不喜欢的方式世俗化地领导美那福斯人。对旧习俗的尊重正在减弱。

english: By old ways, do you mean Icthlarin?
translation: 你说的旧习俗，是指伊克哈林吗？

english: The whole Menaphite Pantheon really. Religion is starting to mean less and less in Menaphos.
translation: 实际上是整个美那福斯神系。宗教在美那福斯的重要性越来越低。

english: There was once a time when we would care for all of Menaphos' dead here. Now, many opt for less traditional burials.
translation: 曾经有一段时间，我们会在这里照料所有美那福斯的死者。现在，许多人选择不那么传统的葬礼。

english: Anyway, I've let myself become distracted. My focus is often on the dead, but right now our main worry is the living.
translation: 总之，我分心了。我通常关注死者，但眼下我们主要担心的是活着的人。

english: It's clear that the Pharaoh has no desire to open his city, so we need to find another way of getting our citizens home.
translation: 很明显，法老无意开放他的城市，所以我们得另想办法让我们的市民回家。

english: Any ideas on how we do that?
translation: 有什么办法吗？

english: Well... I don't know. I'm open to any ideas you have.
translation: 嗯……我不知道。你有什么想法尽管说。

english: What if I disguised myself as a citizen or a guard?
translation: 要是我把自己伪装成市民或守卫呢？

english: It would not work. Their quarantine is very strict, just as ours was. Even their own people are not allowed in or out of the city.
translation: 行不通。他们的隔离非常严格，就像我们之前一样。连他们自己人都不允许进出城市。

english: So how do they get food and other supplies in?
translation: 那他们怎么获得食物和其他补给品？

english: The port south of the main city is still open. Traders take their goods to the city gates and exchange them with the guards there. Everything is thoroughly checked.
translation: 主城南面的港口仍然开放。商人把货物运到城门，与那里的守卫交换。所有东西都经过彻底检查。

english: I see. Doesn't sound like we can make anything work there then.
translation: 我明白了。看来我们没办法在那里做文章。

english: Is there any way across the river?
translation: 有没有办法渡河？

english: You'd want to swim across? If the current doesn't kill you, the crocodiles surely will.
translation: 你想游过去？就算不被水流冲走，鳄鱼也肯定会要你的命。

english: Ah... Maybe not then.
translation: 啊……那还是算了。

english: Perhaps I could fight my way in?
translation: 也许我可以打进去？

english: Absolutely not! We here in Sophanem are still Menaphites and those guards are our brethren. Besides, I doubt you'd succeed against so many of them.
translation: 绝对不行！我们索法尼恩城的人仍然是美那福斯人，那些守卫是我们的同胞。再说了，我不认为你能打得过那么多人。

english: Is there any way into Menaphos from below?
translation: 有没有什么从地底进入美那福斯的方法？

english: I don't know. I don't think so.
translation: 我不知道。我觉得没有。

english: Oh. So there aren't any tunnels under this city?
translation: 哦。所以这座城市下面没有任何隧道？

english: Beyond the homes of our dead? I can't imagine so. We are not ones for digging tunnels unnecessarily. We leave that nonsense to the Sect of Scabaras, and they're long gone.
translation: 除了我们死者的安息之地？我想象不到。我们不喜欢不必要地挖隧道。那种蠢事留给斯卡巴拉斯教派去做，他们早就完蛋了。

english: The Sect of Scabaras?
translation: 斯卡巴拉斯教派？

english: They were a group dedicated to Scabaras, one of the lesser deities.
translation: 他们是一个献身于斯卡巴拉斯——一位次级神祇的团体。

english: What's a lesser deity?
translation: 什么是次级神祇？

english: You already know of Icthlarin and the Devourer. They are the son and daughter of Tumeken and Elidinis. Together, they are the four main deities of the Menaphite Pantheon.
translation: 你已经知道伊克哈林和吞噬者。他们是图梅肯和艾莉迪尼斯的子女。他们四个共同组成美那福斯神系的主要神祇。

english: However, the pantheon also has four lesser deities, or avatars as some call them. The Book of Light and Day says that Tumeken once fell into a deep sleep and dreamt for four days and four nights.
translation: 不过，神系中还有四位次级神祇，也有人称他们为化身。《光明与白昼之书》记载，图梅肯曾陷入沉睡，连梦了四天四夜。

english: With each night, his dreams took form. Those four forms became the lesser deities of the pantheon, with Scabaras being the last of them.
translation: 每一夜，他的梦境都化为实体。这四种形态就成了神系中的次级神祇，斯卡巴拉斯是最后一个。

english: And his followers liked to dig tunnels?
translation: 他的追随者喜欢挖隧道？

english: That's right. Scabaras is the god of isolation. In keeping with his teachings, his followers mostly lived underground. As such, they were said to be great architects of the subterranean.
translation: 没错。斯卡巴拉斯是孤绝之神。为了遵从他的教义，他的追随者大多居住在地下。因此，他们据说是了不起的地下建筑师。

english: So what happened to them?
translation: 那他们后来怎么了？

english: The Devourer was not the only member of the pantheon to wish ill upon our people. It is said that many years ago, Scabaras and his sect tried to claim these lands as their own.
translation: 吞噬者并非神系中唯一对我们人民心怀恶意者。据说许多年前，斯卡巴拉斯和他的教派试图占领这片土地。

english: They built great tunnels beneath the Elid and used them to attack our settlements. However, Elidinis stood against them. The sect was destroyed, and Scabaras was fittingly driven into isolation.
translation: 他们在伊利德河下修建了巨大的隧道，并用它们来攻击我们的定居点。然而，伊利德尼斯反抗了他们。那个教派被摧毁了，斯卡巴拉斯也理所当然地被驱逐到了孤绝之地。

english: And you don't think there's a chance they might have built some tunnels under Sophanem and Menaphos?
translation: 你不觉得他们有可能在索法尼恩城和梅纳弗斯城下也建了一些隧道吗？

english: Er... I suppose I've never considered it before. I guess it's not impossible.
translation: 呃……我以前从未想过。我觉得不是不可能。

english: Maybe you should visit Jex at the Temple of the Lesser Gods in the north east corner of the city. He knows more about the Sect of Scabaras than I do.
translation: 也许你应该去城市东北角的次级神庙找杰克斯。他比我更了解斯卡巴拉斯教派。

english: In fact, now that I think about it, I recall a rumour that the temple was actually once home to the sect.
translation: 事实上，我现在想起来，曾经有个传言说那座神庙其实就是教派的老巢。

english: Interesting. I'll pay him a visit.
translation: 有意思。我去找他谈谈。

english: I'll have to think some more.
translation: 我得再想想。

english: Hello again. Have you had any thoughts on how we can get our citizens out of Menaphos?
translation: 又见面了。想到什么办法能把我们的人从美那福斯弄出来吗？

english: I'll have a think about it.
translation: 我会考虑一下。

english: Hello again. Did you visit Jex at the Temple of the Lesser Gods?
translation: 又见面了。你去过次级神庙找杰克斯了吗？

english: You'll find the temple in the north east corner of the city.
translation: 神庙在城市东北角。

english: Hello. Are you Jex?
translation: 你好。你就是杰克斯吗？

english: I'm hoping to learn a bit more about the Sect of Scabaras. The High Priest said you'd be a good person to ask.
translation: 我想多了解一下斯卡巴拉斯教派。大祭司说你是合适的人选。

english: Ah yes. To be honest, not much is known about them. The sect was destroyed long ago. However, it is said that this temple was once their home.
translation: 啊，是的。老实说，关于他们知之甚少。教派很久以前就被摧毁了。不过，据说这座神庙曾是他们的居所。

english: Speaking of the temple, what happened here? The place isn't looking great.
translation: 说到神庙，这里发生了什么？这地方看起来不太好。

english: It was just before the plagues started! They burst up from under the cellar and trashed the place! It was late at night, so I couldn't see who they were, or if they were even human!
translation: 就在瘟疫爆发前！他们从地窖下冲出来，把这里砸得一团糟！当时是深夜，我看不清他们是谁，甚至不知道他们是不是人！

english: What? Why wasn't the High Priest aware of this?
translation: 什么？大祭司不知道这事？

english: The first of the plagues started that next morning. It didn't seem wise to bother him.
translation: 第一次瘟疫是第二天早上爆发的。当时去打扰他似乎不太明智。

english: I'm sure he'd have still liked to have been made aware. You say they came from beneath the cellar?
translation: 我肯定他还是想知道的。你说他们是从地窖下面来的？

english: That's right. Turns out there's quite the network of tunnels down there.
translation: 没错。原来下面有个相当大的隧道网络。

english: Well then I think this is just what I'm after. I'd like to investigate these tunnels.
translation: 那这正是我想要的。我想调查这些隧道。

english: I wouldn't if I were you. It's incredibly dangerous down there. We had a quick look, but there are some fearsome traps and vicious monsters lurking in the darkness.
translation: 我要是你就不去。下面极其危险。我们匆匆看了一眼，但黑暗中有可怕的陷阱和凶猛的怪物潜伏着。

english: I'm afraid it's essential that I go down there.
translation: 恐怕我必须下去。

english: Well then you're either very brave or very foolish. We covered the tunnel they made with a trapdoor. Just head down into the cellar and then down that trapdoor.
translation: 那你要么非常勇敢，要么非常愚蠢。我们用活板门盖住了他们挖的隧道。你只要下到地窖，再从那个活板门下去就行。

english: Oh, it's also very dark down there. You should take some sort of light source and a tinderbox with you.
translation: 哦，下面也很黑。你应该带个光源和火绒盒。

english: Thanks. You've been a great help.
translation: 谢谢。你帮了大忙。

english: I'd better get down there.
translation: 我最好下去了。

english: Hello Jex.
translation: 你好，杰克斯。

english: How's your investigation going?
translation: 你的调查进行得怎么样？

english: I haven't made it down to the tunnels yet.
translation: 我还没下去隧道。

english: Well don't forget to take a light source and a tinderbox with you.
translation: 别忘了带光源和火绒盒。

english: I will. Thanks for the warning.
translation: 我会的。谢谢提醒。

english: Hello again. Any luck with getting our people out of Menaphos?
translation: 又见面了。把我们的人从美那福斯救出来有什么进展吗？

english: Well just let me know if I can help in any way.
translation: 如果有需要帮忙的地方就告诉我。

english: We're here to guard this place. Until recently, this was a bank, but then something came from the tunnels below and trashed the place.
translation: 我们在这儿守卫这个地方。不久前这里还是家银行，但后来有什么东西从下面的隧道里出来，把这儿砸了个稀巴烂。

english: Now we're guarding the trapdoor down to the tunnels instead.
translation: 现在我们改为守卫通往隧道的活板门。

english: That's okay, I have one with me anyway.
translation: 没关系，反正我自己带着一个。

english: I'd better go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: I will, I will.
translation: 我会的，我会的。

english: It really is incredibly dangerous down there!
translation: 下面真的非常危险！

english: So people keep telling me.
translation: 大家都这么跟我说。

english: You should take some food down with you in case you get hurt!
translation: 你应该带些食物下去，以防受伤！

english: I wouldn't take many valuables down there, just in case something bad happens.
translation: 我不会带太多贵重物品下去，以防万一发生什么不好的事。

english: Have some faith in me.
translation: 对我有点信心。

english: Watch out for the traps!
translation: 小心陷阱！

english: If you see a scarab on any of the walls, stay well away from it!
translation: 如果你在墙上看到圣甲虫，一定要离它远远的！

english: Um, why?
translation: 呃，为什么？

english: I saw one of the other guards disappear down a trapdoor when he approached it. We never saw him again!
translation: 我看见另一个守卫靠近它时，掉进活板门消失了。我们再也没见过他！

english: I'll look out for them then.
translation: 那我会留意的。

english: I wouldn't take many valuables down there the first time I went, just in case something bad happened.
translation: 我第一次下去的时候不会带太多贵重物品，以防万一发生什么坏事。

english: I saw one of the other bank guards disappear down the trapdoor when he approached it and we never saw him again!
translation: 我看到另一个银行守卫一靠近那个活板门就消失不见了，我们再也没见过他！

english: Halt! You may not go down there!
translation: 站住！你不能下去！

english: We're guarding the trapdoor, making sure nothing comes up or goes down!
translation: 我们在看守这个活板门，确保没有任何东西上来或下去！

english: If you really want to go down there, you really should talk to Jex first.
translation: 如果你真的想下去，你真该先跟杰克斯谈谈。

english: Besides, the way we have it set up, I doubt you'd be able to get that trapdoor open!
translation: 再说了，以我们现在的布置，我怀疑你根本打不开那个活板门！

english: The nastiest creatures imaginable!
translation: 你能想象到的最恶心的生物！

english: Little, aside from the odd fairy tale from childhood.
translation: 除了小时候听过的那些古怪的仙子故事之外，几乎一无所知。

english: They seem to be a cross between humans and scarabs.
translation: 它们看起来像是人类和圣甲虫的混合体。

english: Rumour has it they may be connected to the ancient Sect of Scabaras!
translation: 有传言说它们可能与古老的斯卡巴拉斯教派有关！

english: Too many people have died down there for us not to take action.
translation: 太多人在下面丧命了，我们不得不采取行动。

english: Sorry to be rude, but we really need to get back to guarding the door. The scarab beasts might come back at any time.
translation: 抱歉失礼了，但我们真的得回去守门了。那些圣甲虫怪物随时可能回来。

english: There are fiendish traps and ghastly scarab monsters down there.
translation: 下面有凶险的陷阱和可怕的圣甲虫怪物。

english: When we were first posted down here, we had a look down there and only just escaped with our lives.
translation: 我们最初被派到这里时，往下看了一眼，差点就没命逃出来。

english: Not bad. Hopefully I'll make some real progress soon.
translation: 还不错。希望很快能取得实质性进展。

english: Well good luck, and be careful in those tunnels.
translation: 祝你好运，在那些隧道里小心点。

english: What the... You're not Kaleef!
translation: 搞什么……你不是卡利夫！

english: No, I'm not, I'm [player name]. As for Kaleef, I'm afraid I have some bad news about him.
translation: 不，我不是，我是[player name]。至于卡利夫，恐怕我有关于他的坏消息。

english: I'm sorry, but Kaleef is dead.
translation: 很抱歉，卡利夫死了。

english: Dead? He can't be dead! You're lying!
translation: 死了？他不可能死！你在撒谎！

english: It's true. It looks like some creature killed him as he was entering this cavern.
translation: 是真的。看起来是什么生物在他进入这个洞穴时杀死了他。

english: Kaleef... Curse you, Osman!
translation: 卡利夫……奥斯曼，你该被诅咒术咒死！

english: Were the two of you close?
translation: 你们俩关系亲密吗？

english: What... I...
translation: 什么……我……

english: No. I barely knew him. He was meant to relieve me of my posting up in Menaphos, but now I'm stuck.
translation: 不。我几乎不认识他。他本来是要接替我驻扎在梅纳菲奥斯城的，但现在我被困住了。

english: Not that it matters I suppose. Even if he had made it, he wouldn't have been able to get across this chasm. We'd hoped there would be a route between the two cities down here, but clearly not.
translation: 不过我想这也不重要了。就算他到了，他也过不了这个深渊。我们曾希望下面有一条连接两座城市的通道，但显然没有。

english: To be honest, that's kind of what I was hoping as well. I came down here to try and find a way into Menaphos.
translation: 说实话，我也希望如此。我下来就是试图找一条进入梅纳菲奥斯城的路。

english: Well good luck with that. If there was a way into the city, I'd have found it by now. This was my last hope.
translation: 那祝你好运。要是有进城的路，我早就找到了。这是我最后的希望了。

english: So you have no way to leave?
translation: 所以你没有离开的办法？

english: Oh I could leave. While I may not know of any way into the city, I do know of a way out. Problem is, I was ordered not to leave until I found a way for Kaleef to get in.
translation: 哦，我可以离开。虽然我不知道任何进城的路，但我确实知道一条出去的路。问题是，我接到命令，要等到找到让卡利夫进来的方法才能离开。

english: Hmm... That gives me an idea.
translation: 嗯……这让我有了个主意。

english: An idea? What are you talking about?
translation: 主意？你在说什么？

english: The reason I'm looking for a way into Menaphos is so that I can help the citizens of Sophanem trapped there return home. However, maybe I don't actually need to enter the city to help them.
translation: 我寻找进入梅纳菲奥斯城的办法，是为了帮助被困在那里的索法尼恩城居民回家。不过，也许我不需要真的进入城市就能帮到他们。

english: You said you knew of a way out of the city. You could help the citizens escape.
translation: 你说你知道一条出城的路。你可以帮助居民们逃出来。

english: And why would I do that?
translation: 我为什么要那么做？

english: Because if you help me, I might be able to help you. You mentioned Osman, right? I'm guessing you work for him, which makes you a spy from Al Kharid.
translation: 因为如果你帮我，我也许能帮你。你提到了奥斯曼，对吧？我猜你为他工作，那么你就是阿尔卡里德城派来的间谍。

english: That's right... I'm Maisa. You know Osman?
translation: 没错……我是麦莎。你认识奥斯曼？

english: Yes. I'm the one who helped him free Prince Ali. I'm sure I could convince him to reconsider your posting.
translation: 是的。我就是帮他解救阿里王子的人。我相信我能说服他重新考虑你的驻地安排。

english: Hmm... If you are who you say you are, tell me where the Prince was being kept.
translation: 嗯……如果你真是你说的那个人，告诉我王子被关在哪里。

english: Pollnivneach.
translation: 波尼尼镇。

english: Draynor Village.
translation: 德雷诺村。

english: Port Sarim.
translation: 沙林港。

english: Interesting. And who helped you free the Prince?
translation: 有意思。那谁帮你解救王子的？

english: Hassan.
translation: 哈桑。

english: Louie Legs.
translation: 路易腿。

english: Leela.
translation: 莉拉。

english: Ranael.
translation: 拉纳尔。

english: You're obviously an imposter. You answered both questions incorrectly!
translation: 你显然是个冒牌货。两个问题都答错了！

english: You'll have to do better than that to convince me.
translation: 你得拿出更好的说辞才能说服我。

english: Fair enough. I'm sorry I doubted you. I will help the citizens of Sophanem for you, but first you must convince Osman to come here and meet with me.
translation: 好吧。抱歉我之前怀疑你。我会帮你帮助索法尼恩城的居民，但首先你得说服奥斯曼来这里见我。

english: You want him to come here?
translation: 你想让他来这里？

english: Yes. No more secret messages or intermediaries. I want to speak to him, face to face.
translation: 是的。不要再传密信或通过中间人了。我要和他面对面谈。

english: Alright. I'll go to Al Kharid and see what I can do.
translation: 好吧。我去阿尔卡里德城看看能做什么。

english: You again. If you are who you say you are, tell me where Prince Ali was being kept.
translation: 又是你。如果你真是你说的那个人，告诉我阿里王子被关在哪里。

english: Have you brought Osman?
translation: 你把奥斯曼带来了吗？

english: Don't take too long. It's not safe for me to stay down here.
translation: 别拖太久。我待在这下面不安全。

english: Sophanem?
translation: 索法尼恩城？

english: Yes. Your help is needed urgently there.
translation: 是的。那里急需你的帮助。

english: My help is needed all over the place. What makes you suggest that I'm more urgently needed in Sophanem?
translation: 到处都需要我的帮助。凭什么你觉得索法尼恩城更需要我？

english: Maisa wants to speak with you.
translation: 麦莎想和你谈谈。

english: Maisa? You are mistaken. She's in Menaphos, and that city is locked tight to everyone, thanks in no small part to me.
translation: 麦莎？你搞错了。她在梅纳菲奥斯城，而那座城市对谁都封锁得严严实实的，这其中有我不少功劳。

english: What? What have you been up to there?
translation: 什么？你在那里搞了什么名堂？

english: Nothing you need to concern yourself with.
translation: 没什么你需要操心的。

english: You don't need to be so secretive with me. Did I not prove myself by freeing Prince Ali?
translation: 你不必对我这么保密。我解救阿里王子不证明了我的能力吗？

english: Hmm... Very well. What do you know of the political landscape here in the Kharidian Desert?
translation: 嗯……好吧。你对卡里迪安沙漠这里的政治格局了解多少？

english: Well unlike many other regions, the Kharidian Desert is not united under a single banner. Instead, there are multiple independent city states, along with various lawless collectives.
translation: 嗯，与其他许多地区不同，卡里迪安沙漠并没有统一在单一旗帜之下。相反，这里有多个独立的城邦，以及各种无法无天的团体。
