english: While all of the city states are currently at peace with each other, between some you'll find certain... rivalries.
translation: 虽然目前所有城邦之间都和平相处，但你会发现有些之间存在着某些……竞争关系。

english: Oh I see. So one of those rivalries is between Menaphos and Al Kharid?
translation: 哦，我明白了。所以梅纳菲奥斯城和阿尔卡里德城之间就是其中之一？

english: Some would say so.
translation: 有些人会这么说。

english: Including you?
translation: 包括你吗？

english: We were at war with the Menaphites for a long time. As Spymaster for Al Kharid, I know that no war is ever truly over.
translation: 我们和梅纳菲奥斯人打了很久的仗。作为阿尔卡里德城的间谍大师，我知道没有哪场战争会真正结束。

english: Does the Emir agree with you on that?
translation: 埃米尔同意你的看法吗？

english: The Emir trusts me to protect the best interests of Al Kharid. So in answer to your original question, that's what I've been doing in Menaphos and Sophanem.
translation: 埃米尔信任我来保护阿尔卡里德城的最大利益。所以回答你最初的问题，这就是我在梅纳菲奥斯城和索法尼恩城一直在做的事。

english: Look, this is all very interesting, but one of your people, Kaleef, is dead. He was meant to relieve Maisa of her post in Menaphos, but now he can't.
translation: 听着，这一切都很有趣，但你的一个手下，卡利夫，已经死了。他本应接替麦莎在梅纳菲奥斯城的职位，但现在他做不到了。

english: Then I will send someone else down instead. Is that all?
translation: 那我会派另一个人下去代替。就这些吗？

english: No. Maisa is insisting that you meet with her personally.
translation: 不。麦莎坚持要你亲自见她。

english: That's not possible and she knows it. It would be tantamount to sticking one's head in a crocodile's mouth. If the Menaphites caught me, I'd be lynched on sight.
translation: 那不可能，她也知道。这无异于把头伸进鳄鱼嘴里。要是梅纳菲奥斯人抓到我，当场就会把我私刑处死。

english: Now, return to her and tell her that I will send a replacement for Kaleef shortly.
translation: 现在，回去告诉她，我很快就会派人接替卡利夫。

english: That's not going to work. There's a chasm blocking the way from Sophanem to Menaphos. Any agent you send won't be able to enter the city. That's why Maisa wants to speak with you.
translation: 那行不通。有一个深渊挡住了从索法尼恩城到梅纳菲奥斯城的路。你派去的任何特工都进不了城。这就是麦莎想和你谈的原因。

english: If there's no way for someone to relieve Maisa, then she will have to remain there herself. This is the job she signed up for.
translation: 如果没有人能接替麦莎，那她就得自己留在那里。这是她自己选择的工作。

english: But I need Maisa to help me with something. She'll only do that if you go and speak to her.
translation: 但我需要麦莎帮我做件事。只有你去和她谈，她才会帮忙。

english: That is your problem, not mine.
translation: 那是你的问题，不是我的。

english: And Prince Ali was your problem, but I still helped you.
translation: 阿里王子也是你的问题，但我还是帮了你。

english: And you were paid for your services. What do you need from Maisa anyway?
translation: 而且你得到了报酬。你到底需要麦莎做什么？

english: When Menaphos was locked down, many citizens from Sophanem were trapped there. I need to try and get them out of the city, but I have no way of entering Menaphos myself.
translation: 当梅纳菲奥斯城封锁时，许多索法尼恩城的居民被困在了那里。我需要想办法让他们出城，但我自己没办法进入梅纳菲奥斯城。

english: So, you've convinced Maisa to help them on your behalf? What makes you think I want any part in this? The citizens of Sophanem are still Menaphites.
translation: 所以，你说服了麦莎替你帮助他们？凭什么认为我想掺和这事？索法尼恩城的居民仍然是梅纳菲奥斯人。

english: Hmm... Let's see...
translation: 嗯……让我想想……

english: It must be boring here.
translation: 这里一定很无聊吧。

english: You wish to charm me with the idea of getting my hands dirty? Well I'm perfectly happy here in Al Kharid. I did all the adventuring I ever wanted to do in my youth.
translation: 你想用亲自动手的念头来诱惑我？我在阿尔卡里德城已经非常满足了。我年轻时已经冒险够了。

english: There might be treasures underneath Sophanem.
translation: 索法尼恩城下面可能有宝藏。

english: That there might be, but if so, those treasures belong to the dead. We have treasures aplenty here in Al Kharid.
translation: 也许有，但就算有，那些宝藏也属于死者。我们阿尔卡里德城有的是宝藏。

english: It could drive a wedge between the Menaphite cities.
translation: 这可能会在梅纳菲奥斯城邦之间制造隔阂。

english: Menaphos wouldn't be happy if the citizens of Sophanem bypassed the quarantine. I imagine you'd be able to take advantage of that.
translation: 如果索法尼恩城的居民绕过隔离，梅纳菲奥斯城不会高兴的。我想你能利用这一点。

english: Hmm... Alright, you have my curiosity. Let's see where this trail takes us. Meet me outside the gates to Sophanem. I have one or two things to sort out here before I depart.
translation: 嗯……好吧，你引起了我的好奇。让我们看看这条路通向哪里。在索法尼恩城的大门外等我。我出发前要在这里处理一两件事。

english: It would give you the chance to spy first hand.
translation: 这能让你获得第一手间谍情报。

english: I have Maisa and others in place to do that already.
translation: 我已经安排了麦莎和其他人做这件事。

english: Perhaps because there is no suitable answer. Now, I must get on with my work.
translation: 也许是因为没有合适的答案。现在，我得继续工作了。

english: Fine. I give up.
translation: 好吧。我放弃。

english: So you've seen sense? Good. Now, I must get on with my work.
translation: 所以你明白道理了？很好。现在，我得继续工作了。

english: As I've already told you, I have little interest in this business of yours. Why should I help you?
translation: 我早就跟你说过，我对你这档子事没什么兴趣。凭什么要我帮你？

english: Yes, yes. I have one or two things to sort here before I depart. I'll meet you outside the gates to Sophanem.
translation: 好了好了。我出发前还有一两件事要处理。我在索法尼恩城的大门外等你。

english: There you are.
translation: 你来了。

english: Ah, you're here. Do you know of a good way into the city? I'm getting too old for scaling walls.
translation: 啊，你到了。你知道有什么好办法进城吗？我这把老骨头可爬不动墙了。

english: What's wrong with using the gates?
translation: 走大门有什么问题？

english: Are you mad or stupid?
translation: 你是疯了还是傻了？

english: Neither. Why?
translation: 都不是。为什么这么问？

english: What if I'm recognised? Do you not think they'd question the presence of Al Kharid's Spymaster?
translation: 万一我被认出来怎么办？你觉得他们不会盘问阿尔卡里德城的间谍大师为什么会出现在这里吗？

english: Okay, so maybe it wasn't one of my better suggestions.
translation: 好吧，也许这确实不是个好主意。

english: Have any other bright ideas?
translation: 还有什么高见吗？

english: I know of a secret entrance to the north.
translation: 我知道北边有个秘密入口。

english: Perfect! Where is it?
translation: 太好了！在哪儿？

english: There's a tunnel in some rocks near a camp.
translation: 有个营地附近的岩石堆里藏着一条隧道。

english: Good. Now, wait for me here. There's no point in both of us risking our necks getting seen together.
translation: 很好。现在，你在这儿等我。我们俩没必要一起冒险，免得被人看见。

english: What if you injure yourself down in the tunnels?
translation: 万一你在隧道里受伤了怎么办？

english: Don't worry about me. I may be getting older, but I didn't become Spymaster without getting into a fight or two.
translation: 别担心我。我虽然老了点，但能当上间谍大师，也不是没打过几场架的。

english: But there's...
translation: 但是……

english: Give me two hours. If I'm not back by then, come and look for me.
translation: 给我两个小时。如果到时候我还没回来，就来找我。

english: Psst!
translation: 嘘！

english: Osman's been gone for hours. I think I should have a look for him.
translation: 奥斯曼已经走了好几个小时了。我想我该去找找他。

english: I've no idea what's going on there. It's all on a need-to-know basis, and I don't need to know.
translation: 那边发生了什么我完全不知道。一切都是按需知悉，而我不需要知道。

english: Oh... hello again.
translation: 哦……又见面了。

english: Some degenerate clubbed me and gave me a lump the size of an egg on the back of my head.
translation: 有个混蛋用棍子打了我，我后脑勺肿起了一个鸡蛋大的包。

english: Oh no! I'll keep my eyes peeled for suspicious looking characters.
translation: 哦不！我会留神那些可疑的家伙。

english: I have a fairly good idea who did it.
translation: 我大概知道是谁干的。

english: What? Who?
translation: 什么？是谁？

english: That linen merchant, Siamun. He's never liked me.
translation: 那个亚麻布商人，西亚蒙。他一直看我不顺眼。

english: ... and whatever you do, don't risk giving yourself away when you help the citizens return.
translation: ……而且无论你做什么，在帮助市民返回时，千万别暴露自己。

english: I know what I'm doing Osman.
translation: 我知道该怎么做，奥斯曼。

english: Hang on... What's going on? What's that shaking?
translation: 等等……怎么回事？怎么在震动？

english: Get out of here quick! Before the cave collapses!
translation: 快离开这里！趁洞穴还没塌！

english: Osman!
translation: 奥斯曼！

english: Uh oh...
translation: 呃哦……

english: I seem to recall telling you to wait for me. What are you doing down here?
translation: 我记得我告诉过你等我。你下来干什么？

english: Rescuing your ungrateful hide!
translation: 救你这个不知好歹的家伙！

english: I had everything under control.
translation: 一切都在我的掌控之中。

english: Well your two hours ran out a long time ago. Anyway, where did you disappear off to during the fight?
translation: 得了吧，你说的两个小时早就过了。话说回来，刚才打斗的时候你躲哪儿去了？

english: I didn't go anywhere. I decided to blend into the shadows. It's one of the many tricks I've picked up over the years. Not every problem needs a blade to solve it.
translation: 我哪儿也没去。我决定融入阴影之中。这是我多年来学会的众多技巧之一。不是每个问题都需要用刀片来解决。

english: Right... So are you going to say 'thank you' or anything?
translation: 好吧……你就不能说声‘谢谢’什么的吗？

english: That's not required. Once again, I had it all under control.
translation: 没那个必要。再说一次，一切都在我的掌控之中。

english: Anyway, you'll be pleased to know that before we were interrupted, I was able to convince Maisa to remain in Menaphos. As agreed, she will help the citizens of Sophanem return home.
translation: 总之，你会很高兴地知道，在我们被打断之前，我已经说服了麦莎留在美纳波斯。按照约定，她会帮助索法尼恩城的市民回家。

english: That's good to hear. I guess I should let the High Priest know.
translation: 这真是好消息。我想我应该去告诉大祭司一声。

english: Before you leave, it seems that Kaleef was able to at least get one hit on that beast. I suggest you take his dagger. It's quite powerful, and he has no need for it now.
translation: 在你离开之前，看来卡利夫至少击中了那只野兽一次。我建议你带上他的匕首。它威力不小，而且他现在也用不着了。

english: Oh, and one more thing...
translation: 哦，还有一件事……

english: Well done. You did an alright job here.
translation: 干得不错。你这次做得还行。

english: Hello again. I have some wonderful news.
translation: 又见面了。我有个好消息。

english: Menaphos just sent over some of their dead. Imagine our suprisewhen we found some of our own citizens disguised among them! Apparently we have both you and someone called Maisa to thank.
translation: 美纳波斯刚送来了一些他们的死者。你可以想象我们有多惊讶，竟然发现我们自己的市民混在其中伪装！显然，这都要感谢你和一位叫麦莎的人。

english: Disguised among the dead? That's quite ingenious. I'm glad to hear they're home safe.
translation: 伪装在死者之中？真是聪明。很高兴听到他们平安回家了。

english: It seems that we are once again in your debt. Please, take this as a thank you.
translation: 看来我们又欠你一个人情。请收下这个作为谢礼。

english: Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, I'm in a terrible terrible mess! It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake.
translation: 哎呀呀呀，我真是糟透了！今天是公爵的生日，我应该给他做一个大大的生日蛋糕。

english: I've forgotten to buy the ingredients. I'll never get them in time now. He'll sack me! What will I do? I have four children and a goat to look after. Would you help me? Please?
translation: 我忘了买材料。现在来不及了。他会解雇我的！我该怎么办？我有四个孩子和一只山羊要照顾。你能帮我吗？求你了？

english: Oh thank you, thank you. I need milk, an egg and flour. I'd be very grateful if you can get them for me.
translation: 哦谢谢你，谢谢你。我需要牛奶、一个鸡蛋和面粉。如果你能帮我弄到这些，我会非常感激的。

english: That's an odd coincidence... Were you planning on making a cake too?
translation: 真是奇怪的巧合……你本来也打算做蛋糕吗？

english: Not exactly. I just had an odd feeling you might be needing these ingredients. If I see a cook, I presume there's food of some kind! Lucky guess I suppose.
translation: 不完全是。我只是有种奇怪的感觉，你可能会需要这些材料。如果我看到一个厨师，我猜肯定有吃的！大概是运气好猜对了。

english: So do I get to go to the Duke's Party?
translation: 那我能去参加公爵的派对吗？

english: I'm afraid not, only the big cheeses get to dine with the Duke.
translation: 恐怕不行，只有大人物才能和公爵一起用餐。

english: Well, maybe one day I'll be important enough to sit on the Duke's table.
translation: 好吧，也许有一天我会变得足够重要，能坐上公爵的桌子。

english: Maybe, but I won't be holding my breath.
translation: 也许吧，但我可不会指望这个。

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller. Make sure you take a pot with you for the flour though, you've got one on you already.
translation: 去找米莉谈谈，她会帮你的，她是个好姑娘，也是个优秀的磨坊主。记得带个罐子去装面粉，你身上已经有一个了。

english: You'll need an empty bucket for the milk itself. I do see you've got a bucket with you already luckily!
translation: 你需要一个空桶来装牛奶。我正好看到你身上已经有一个桶了，运气不错！

english: No, I don't feel like it. Maybe later.
translation: 不，我没兴趣。也许以后再说。

english: Fine. I always knew you Adventurer types were callous beasts. Go on your merry way!
translation: 好吧。我就知道你们这些冒险者都是冷酷无情的家伙。走你的路吧！

english: You're a cook, why don't you bake me a cake?
translation: 你是个厨师，为什么不给我烤个蛋糕？

english: *sniff* Don't talk to me about cakes...
translation: *抽泣* 别跟我提蛋糕……

english: Well maybe you need to take a holiday...
translation: 也许你需要度个假……

english: That would be nice, but the Duke doesn't allow holidays for core staff.
translation: 那倒不错，但公爵不允许核心员工休假。

english: Hmm, why not run away to the sea and start a new life as a Pirate?
translation: 嗯，为什么不逃到海边，开始新的海盗生涯呢？

english: My wife gets sea sick, and I have an irrational fear of eyepatches. I don't see it working myself.
translation: 我妻子晕船，而且我对眼罩有一种莫名的恐惧。我觉得这行不通。

english: Err thank you. It's a pretty ordinary cooks hat really.
translation: 呃，谢谢。这其实只是一顶很普通的厨师帽。

english: Still, suits you. The trousers are pretty special too.
translation: 不过，挺适合你的。这条裤子也很特别。

english: Its all standard cook's issue uniform...
translation: 这都是标准厨师配发的制服……

english: The whole hat, apron, stripey trousers ensemble - it works. It make you looks like a real cook.
translation: 整套帽子、围裙、条纹裤子的搭配——很协调。让你看起来像个真正的厨师。

english: I am a real cook! I haven't got time to be chatting about Culinary Fashion. I am in desperate need of help!
translation: 我就是个真正的厨师！我可没时间跟你聊烹饪时尚。我急需帮助！

english: How are you getting on with finding the ingredients?
translation: 你找材料找得怎么样了？

english: I haven't got any of them yet, I'm still looking.
translation: 我一样都还没找到，还在找。

english: Please get the ingredients quickly - I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 请快点把材料找来——我没时间了！公爵会把我赶到大街上的！

english: Here's a bucket of milk.
translation: 这是一桶牛奶。

english: Here's a pot of flour.
translation: 这是一罐面粉。

english: Here's a fresh egg.
translation: 这是一个新鲜鸡蛋。

english: What do you think you're doing???
translation: 你以为你在干什么？？？

english: Have you come to apply for the job?
translation: 你是来应聘的吗？

english: Yes, if it pays well.
translation: 是的，如果薪水不错的话。

english: I'll have to ask you some questions first.
translation: 我得先问你几个问题。

english: How would you describe yourself in one word?
translation: 用一个词形容你自己，你会怎么说？

english: Mmmm, I see.
translation: 嗯，我明白了。

english: I'm sorry, but I don't think you have the aptitude for this position.
translation: 抱歉，我觉得你不适合这个职位。

english: Just one more question. What would you say is your greatest skill?
translation: 再问一个问题。你觉得你最大的技能是什么？

english: Looks like you're just the [man/woman] for the job! Welcome aboard!
translation: 看来你正是我们要找的[man/woman]！欢迎加入！

english: Is there anything you'd like me to do for you, sir?
translation: 先生，有什么需要我为您效劳的吗？

english: Yes, there is. You're highly skilled at grave-digging, yes?
translation: 是的，有。你很擅长挖坟墓，对吧？

english: Err...yes, that's what I said.
translation: 呃……是的，我就是这么说的。

english: Excellent. Now listen carefully.
translation: 很好。现在仔细听好。

english: I need you to find some...stuff...for me.
translation: 我需要你帮我找一些……东西……

english: Stuff?
translation: 东西？

english: That's what I said...stuff.
translation: 我就是这个意思……东西。

english: Well...dead stuff.
translation: 嗯……死掉的东西。

english: I need you to get me enough dead body parts for me to stitch together a complete body, which I plan to bring to life.
translation: 我需要你收集足够的尸体部位，让我能缝合成一具完整的尸体，我打算把它复活。

english: Right...okay...if you insist.
translation: 好吧……行……如果你坚持的话。

english: No thanks, I wouldn't work here if you paid me.
translation: 不了，谢谢，就算你付我钱我也不会在这里工作。

english: Do you know where I could find body parts?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能找到尸体部位吗？

english: The soil of Morytania is unique in its ability to preserve the bodies of the dead, which is one reason why I have chosen to carry out my experiments here.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚的土壤具有独特的保存尸体的能力，这也是我选择在这里进行实验的原因之一。

english: I recommend digging up some graves in the local area. To the south-east you will find the Haunted Woods; I believe there are many graves there.
translation: 我建议你在附近挖一些坟墓。东南方你会找到闹鬼森林；我相信那里有很多坟墓。

english: There is also a mausoleum on an island west of this castle. I expect the bodies that are buried there to be extremely well preserved, as they were wealthy in life.
translation: 这座城堡西边的一个岛上还有一座陵墓。我估计埋在那里的尸体保存得非常好，因为他们生前很富有。

english: What do you want me to do, again?
translation: 再说一遍，你想让我做什么？

english: Why do you want to make a creature?
translation: 你为什么要制造一个生物？

english: I came to the land of Morytania many years ago, to find a safe sanctuary for my experiments. This abandoned castle suited my purposes exactly.
translation: 很多年前我来到莫利塔尼亚这片土地，为我的实验寻找一个安全的庇护所。这座废弃的城堡正好符合我的目的。

english: What were you experimenting in?
translation: 你当时在实验什么？

english: Oh, perfectly innocent experiments - for the good of mankind.
translation: 哦，完全无害的实验——为了人类的福祉。

english: Then why did you need to come to Morytania?
translation: 那你为什么需要来莫利塔尼亚？

english: Enough questions, now. Get back to your work.
translation: 问题问够了。现在回去工作。

english: Will this creature put me out of a job?
translation: 这个生物会让我失业吗？

english: No, my friend. I have a very special purpose in mind for this creature.
translation: 不会的，我的朋友。我对这个生物有一个非常特殊的目的。

english: I must get back to work, sir.
translation: 我得回去工作了，先生。

english: Can you tell me anything about Fenkenstrain?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于芬肯斯特雷恩的事吗？

english: Oi could tell you a few things about old Fenky, yeah.
translation: 俺可以告诉你一些关于老芬基的事，没错。

english: Once, this castle were full o' good folk - my friends. Fenky was just the castle doctor you know, to the Lord and the castle folk.
translation: 以前，这座城堡里住满了善良的人——俺的朋友们。芬基只是城堡的医生，你知道，为领主和城堡里的人服务。

english: I don't know what happened to them all, but one by one they all disappeared. When they were gone a while, I went an dug graves for 'em, in the forest.
translation: 俺不知道他们怎么了，但他们一个接一个地消失了。他们消失一段时间后，俺去森林里给他们挖了坟墓。

english: After a while there weren't no-one left, but the Lord, Fenkenstrain, and meself.
translation: 过了一段时间，除了领主、芬肯斯特雷恩和俺自己，就没人了。

english: Old Fenky sent me into the Forest to dig 'im a pit. Never said what for. Then would you believe it, someone chops me head off.
translation: 老芬基派俺去森林里给他挖个坑。从没说过要干什么。然后你信不信，有人把俺的头砍了下来。

english: Did you see who did it, before ...
translation: 你看到是谁干的了吗，在……之前……

english: Before oi kicked the bucket, you mean?
translation: 你是说在我翘辫子之前？

english: Don't worry yourself, I'm not worried about bein' dead. Worse things could happen, I suppose.
translation: 别担心，俺不在乎死了。我想，还有更糟的事呢。

english: One thing I do know is, there ain't no Lord of the castle anymore, 'cept for old Fenky. Makes you think a bit, don't it?
translation: 俺知道一件事，城堡里已经没有领主了，除了老芬基。这让你有点想法，是吧？

english: What happened to your head?
translation: 你的头怎么了？

english: Oi was in the old 'aunted Forest to the south, diggin' a pit for moi old maaster, old Fenkenstrain, when would you believe it, someone chops me head off. Awful bad luck, weren't it?
translation: 俺在南边的老闹鬼森林里，给俺的老主人老芬肯斯特雷恩挖坑，你信不信，有人把俺的头砍了下来。真是倒霉透顶，是吧？

english: Oh yes, dreadful bad luck.
translation: 哦，是的，真是倒霉透顶。

english: So oi thinks to meself, I don't needs any 'ead to be gettin on with me gardenin', long as I got me hands and me spade.
translation: 所以俺想，俺不需要头也能继续干园艺活，只要俺有手和铲子就行。

english: Would you show me where the place was?
translation: 你能带我去那个地方吗？

english: No mate, you've found my head already, oi think.
translation: 不，伙计，俺想你已经找到俺的头了。

english: Well, oi s'pose oi've got 10 minutes to spare.
translation: 嗯，俺想俺能抽出10分钟。

english: Me name? It's been a moivellous long while, mate, since I had any use for such a thing as a name.
translation: 俺的名字？伙计，俺已经很久很久不需要名字这种东西了。

english: Don't worry, I was just trying to make conversation.
translation: 别担心，我只是想聊聊天。

english: No, no, I can't be havin' that - I'll remember in a minute-
translation: 不，不，俺不能这样——俺马上就能想起来——

english: Please, don't worry.
translation: 请别担心。

english: Lestwit, that's it! Ed Lestwit!
translation: 莱斯特维特，对了！埃德.莱斯特维特！

english: You need to head off to them Haunted Woods, mate.
translation: 你得去那个闹鬼森林，伙计。

english: Go [direction], mate.
translation: 往[direction]走，伙计。

english: This is the place where I met me' maker.
translation: 这就是俺见阎王的地方。

english: Oi'm afraid you've gone well off the beaten track..
translation: 恐怕你走偏了路……

english: Fare thee well - oi must return to me' garden.
translation: 愿你安好——俺得回俺的花园了。

english: You're interested in our speciality, I see. Would you like to buy some?
translation: 我看你对我们的特产感兴趣。想买点吗？

english: What exactly is in the jar?
translation: 罐子里到底是什么？

english: Pickled brain, my friend. Only 50 gold to you.
translation: 腌制的脑，我的朋友。只收你50金币。

english: Err...pickled brain from what animal?
translation: 呃……腌制的脑是什么动物的？

english: Animal? Don't be disgusting, man! No, this is a human brain - only the best for my customers.
translation: 动物？别恶心了，老兄！不，这是人类的大脑——只给我的顾客最好的。

english: That sounds very nice, but I'm afraid I don't have enough gold at the moment.
translation: 听起来不错，但恐怕我现在没带够金币。

english: I'll buy one, please.
translation: 我买一个，谢谢。

english: A very wise choice, [sir/miss]. Don't eat it all at once, savour every morsel - that's my advice to you.
translation: 非常明智的选择，[sir/miss]。别一次吃完，细细品味每一口——这是我对你的建议。

english: I'm afraid I'm not really hungry at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我现在不太饿。

english: You can leave that alone, my friend. I've already sold you one of your own - eat that. I can't afford to give away freebies in this business!
translation: 那个你别动，我的朋友。我已经卖给你一个你自己的了——吃那个。我可不能在这行里免费赠送！

english: I have some body parts for you.
translation: 我给你带了些尸体部位。

english: Fantastic, you've brought me a head.
translation: 太棒了，你给我带来了一个头。

english: Splendid, you've brought me a torso.
translation: 太好了，你给我带来了一个躯干。

english: Great, you've brought me some arms.
translation: 很好，你给我带来了一些手臂。

english: Excellent, you've brought me some legs.
translation: 优秀，你给我带来了一些腿。

english: Superb!! Those are all the parts I need. Now to sew them together ...
translation: 太棒了！！这些就是我需要的所有部件。现在把它们缝在一起……

english: Go and get me a needle, and I'll need 5 lots of thread.
translation: 去给我拿一根针，我还需要5卷线。

english: Where are my needle and thread, [player name]?
translation: 我的针和线呢，[player name]？

english: Ah, a needle. Wonderful.
translation: 啊，一根针。太好了。

english: Some thread, excellent.
translation: 一些线，优秀。

english: Where's my thread, [player name]?
translation: 我的线呢，[player name]？

english: Where's my needle, [player name]?
translation: 我的针呢，[player name]？

english: Perfect. But I need one more thing from you - flesh and bones by themselves do not make life.
translation: 完美。但我还需要你一样东西——光有血肉和骨头并不能创造生命。

english: I have honed to perfection an ancient ritual that will give life to this creature, but for this I must harness the very power of Nature.
translation: 我已经完善了一个古老的仪式，可以赋予这个生物生命，但为此我必须驾驭大自然的力量。

english: And what power is this?
translation: 这是什么力量？

english: The power of lightning.
translation: 闪电的力量。

english: Sorry, can't make lightning, you've got the wrong man-
translation: 抱歉，我不会制造闪电，你找错人了——

english: Silence your insolent tongue! The storm that brews overhead will create the lightning. What I need you to do is to repair the lightning conductor on the balcony above.
translation: 闭嘴，你这无礼的家伙！头顶酝酿的暴风雨会产生闪电。我需要你做的就是修理上方阳台上的避雷针。

english: Repair the lightning conductor, right. Can I have a break, soon? By law I'm entitled to 15 minutes every-
translation: 修理避雷针，好的。我能很快休息一下吗？根据法律，我每……有权休息15分钟——

english: Repair the conductor and BEGONE!!!
translation: 修理好导体然后滚蛋！！！

english: How do I repair the lightning conductor?
translation: 我怎么修理避雷针？

english: Oh, it would be easier to do it myself! If you find a conductor mould you should be able to cast a new one.
translation: 哦，我自己动手还容易些！如果你找到一个导体模具，你应该能铸造一个新的。

english: Remember this, [player name]: my experiment will only work with a conductor made from silver.
translation: 记住这一点，[player name]：我的实验只有用银制成的导体才能成功。

english: Do you know where the key to the shed is?
translation: 你知道棚屋的钥匙在哪里吗？

english: Got it right 'ere in my pocket. Here you go.
translation: 就在俺口袋里。给你。

english: Do you know where I can find a lightning conductor mould?
translation: 你知道哪里能找到避雷针模具吗？

english: A conductive mould, you say? Let me see-
translation: 你说导体模具？让俺想想——

english: There used to be a bloke 'ere, sort of an 'andyman e was. Did everything round the place - fixed what was broke, swept the chimneys and the like. He would 'ave had a mould, I imagine.
translation: 以前这儿有个家伙，算是个杂工。他包揽了所有活儿——修理坏掉的东西，扫烟囱之类的。俺想他应该有个模具。

english: E's dead, just like everyone else round 'ere ... 'cept for me.
translation: 他死了，就像这儿其他所有人一样……除了俺。

english: Very good, you have made a new conductor - now get up on the roof and repair it before this storm passes!
translation: 非常好，你已经做出了一个新的导体——现在趁这场风暴还没过去，爬上屋顶把它修好！

english: So did it work, then?
translation: 那么它成功了吗？

english: Yes, I'm afraid it did, LogWarden - all too well.
translation: 是的，恐怕确实成功了，LogWarden——效果太好了。

english: I can't see it anywhere.
translation: 我到处都找不到它。

english: I tricked it into going up to the Tower, and there it remains, imprisoned.
translation: 我骗它上了塔，它就一直被困在那里。

english: So the creature wasn't all you'd hoped, then?
translation: 这么说，那个生物并没有达到你的期望？

english: ...oh, what have I done...
translation: ……哦，我都做了什么……

english: Oh, I see, we're developing a sense of right and wrong now are we?
translation: 哦，我明白了，你现在开始有是非观念了是吧？

english: Bit late for that, I'd say.
translation: 我觉得现在说这个有点晚了。

english: I have no control over it! It's coming to get me!
translation: 我控制不了它！它要来抓我了！

english: What do you want me to do about it?
translation: 你想让我怎么做？

english: Destroy it!!! Take the key to the Tower and take back the life I never should have granted!!!
translation: 摧毁它！！！带上钥匙去塔里，收回那条我本不该赐予的生命！！！

english: Same as ever, mate, just gettin' on with it regardless.
translation: 老样子，哥们，不管怎样都得继续干下去。

english: Oim the 'eadless gardener, mate.
translation: 俺是那个无头园丁，哥们。

english: So oi thinks to meself, I don't needs any 'ead [player name] gettin on with me gardenin', long as I got me hands and me spade.
translation: 所以俺寻思着，俺不需要什么脑袋，[player name]，只要俺有手和铲子，就能继续干俺的园艺活。

english: I am commanded to destroy you, creature!
translation: 我奉命消灭你，生物！

english: Oh that's *hic* not very *hic* nice ...
translation: 哦，这*呃*可不太*呃*友好……

english: Are you feeling okay?
translation: 你还好吗？

english: Abso *hic* lutely. Never *buuurrp* better.
translation: 完全*呃*没问题。从来没*嗝*这么好过。

english: You don't look very dangerous.
translation: 你看起来不怎么危险啊。

english: How *hic* do I look?
translation: 我*呃*看上去怎么样？

english: You really don't know, do you? Have a look for yourself.
translation: 你真的不知道，对吧？你自己看看吧。

english: AAAAARRGGGGHHHH!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！

english: I'm sorry. I suppose I'm partly to blame for this.
translation: 我很抱歉。我想这件事我也有部分责任。

english: No - it was him I wager - Fenkenstrain - wasn't it? He's brought me back to life!
translation: 不——我打赌是他——芬肯斯特兰——对不对？是他让我复活了！

english: Who are - were - you?
translation: 你是谁——曾经是什么人？

english: I was Rologarth, Lord of the North Coast - this castle was once mine. Fenkenstrain was the castle doctor.
translation: 我曾是罗洛加斯，北海岸领主——这座城堡曾经是我的。芬肯斯特兰是城堡的医生。

english: So the castle wasn't really abandoned when he found it?
translation: 所以当他发现这座城堡时，它并不是真正的废弃状态？

english: Is that what he told you? No, no, this castle was once full of people and life. Fenkenstrain advised me to sell them to the vampyres, which - I am sad to say - I did.
translation: 他是这么告诉你的吗？不，不，这座城堡曾经充满人和生机。芬肯斯特兰建议我把他们卖给吸血鬼，而我很遗憾地说，我照做了。

english: I found your brain in a jar in Canifis, so he must have sold you too.
translation: 我在坎尼非斯村的一个罐子里找到了你的大脑，所以他肯定也把你卖了。

english: Of that I will not speak. There lie memories that should rest with the dead, the living unable to bear them.
translation: 那件事我不愿多谈。那些记忆本应随死者安息，生者无法承受。

english: That's it - I'm leaving this dreadful place, whether I get paid or not. Is there anything I can do for you before I leave?
translation: 就这样吧——我要离开这个可怕的地方了，不管有没有报酬。在我走之前有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: Only one - please stop Fenkenstrain from carrying on his experiments, once and for all, so that no other poor soul has to endure suffering such as that of my people and I.
translation: 只有一件事——请彻底阻止芬肯斯特兰继续他的实验，这样就不会再有其他可怜的灵魂像我和我的人民一样受苦了。

english: Do you know how I can stop Fenkenstrain's experiments?
translation: 你知道我该如何阻止芬肯斯特兰的实验吗？

english: Take the Ring of Charos from him.
translation: 从他那里拿走查罗斯之戒。

english: What is this ring?
translation: 这枚戒指是什么？

english: It was my birthright, passed down to me through the ages, its origin forgotten.
translation: 那是我的继承物，代代相传到我手中，其起源已被遗忘。

english: The Ring of Charos has many powers, but Fenkenstrain has bent them to his own evil purposes. Without the power of the ring, he will not be able to raise the dead from their sleep.
translation: 查罗斯之戒拥有许多力量，但芬肯斯特兰将其扭曲用于自己的邪恶目的。没有戒指的力量，他就无法将死者从沉睡中唤醒。

english: It has one other, extremely important use - it confuses the werewolves' senses, making them believe that they smell one of their own kind. Without the ring, Fenkenstrain will be at their mercy.
translation: 它还有一个极其重要的用途——它能迷惑狼人的感官，让它们以为自己闻到了同类。没有这枚戒指，芬肯斯特兰就会任由狼人摆布。

english: So have you destroyed it?!!?
translation: 那么你已经摧毁它了吗？！？！

english: Never, now that he has told me the truth!
translation: 绝不！既然他告诉了我真相！

english: Oh my, oh my, this is exactly what I feared!
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪，这正是我所担心的！

english: Why did you have to pick Rologarth's brain of all brains?!?
translation: 为什么你偏偏选中了罗洛加斯的大脑？！？！

english: I'm through working for you.
translation: 我已经受够了为你工作。

english: No!! I refuse to release you!! You must help me build another creature to destroy this dreadful mistake!!
translation: 不！！我不会放你走的！！你必须帮我再造一个生物，来摧毁这个可怕的错误！！

english: Oh, it's part of a little test I'd like to do. A travelling salesman stopped off here a while ago and claimed you can use a duck to accurately track currents in the sea.
translation: 哦，这是我想做的一个小测试的一部分。不久前有个行商路过这里，他说可以用一只鸭子精确追踪海流。

english: My plan is to track the currents around Catherby to see if I can speed up the docking process, but there's a bit of a snag...
translation: 我打算追踪凯瑟比镇周围的海流，看看能不能加快靠港流程，但遇到了一点麻烦……

english: The local council have a by-law forbidding non-human workers from doing business in Catherby. I'd hoped the local councillor wouldn't notice, but the second the duck arrived, she came along making threats of a fine!
translation: 当地议会有一条地方法规，禁止非人类工人在凯瑟比镇工作。我本以为当地议员不会注意到，但鸭子一到，她马上就过来威胁要罚款！

english: I don't think so, but thanks for the offer.
translation: 我想不用了，不过谢谢你的提议。

english: Well, you're welcome to try talking to Councillor Catherine yourself. You'll find her in the Council Office north east of here. I warn you though, it will probably be an uphill struggle!
translation: 好吧，你可以自己去跟凯瑟琳议员谈谈。她在北边的议会办公室。不过我警告你，这恐怕会是一场苦战！

english: Thanks for the warning. I'll head over and see what I can do.
translation: 谢谢提醒。我过去看看能做些什么。

english: I'm sorry to hear that. Hopefully you manage to work something out.
translation: 听到这个我很遗憾。希望你能想出办法。

english: Thank you, friend.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。

english: Where can I find the Council Office?
translation: 议会办公室在哪里？

english: It's just north east of here. Good luck trying to deal with Councillor Catherine though.
translation: 就在这里的东北边。不过跟凯瑟琳议员打交道，祝你好运。

english: Hello there. Are you Councillor Catherine? I was hoping you could help me with something.
translation: 你好。你是凯瑟琳议员吗？我希望你能帮我个忙。

english: Thank you for enquiring at the Catherby Council Office. Your views are important to us. What is it I can do for you today?
translation: 感谢你向凯瑟比镇议会办公室咨询。你的意见对我们很重要。今天有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I had a question about one of the local by-laws. Apparently non-human workers aren't allowed to do business in Catherby?
translation: 我想问一下当地的一条法规。据说非人类工人不能在凯瑟比镇工作？

english: That is correct.
translation: 没错。

english: Doesn't that strike you as a bit... wrong?
translation: 你不觉得这有点……不妥吗？

english: If you are referring to the rumours of Humans Against Monsters sympathies within the Catherby Council, then I can assure you that a full impartial investigation found those rumours to be totally false.
translation: 如果你是指关于凯瑟比镇议会内部同情“人类反怪物”组织的传闻，那我向你保证，一次全面公正的调查已经证实那些传闻纯属子虚乌有。

english: Impartial?
translation: 公正？

english: Completely.
translation: 完全公正。

english: I see... So you wouldn't even be willing to let Arhein's duck track a few currents? The results would be very useful, not just to Arhein. I imagine any sailor docking here would find them helpful.
translation: 我明白了……所以你连让阿海因的鸭子追踪一下海流都不肯？结果不仅对阿海因有用，我想靠港的水手也会觉得有帮助。

english: Are you a sailor yourself?
translation: 你自己是水手吗？

english: Well, yes, I suppose you could say that.
translation: 嗯，是的，我想可以这么说。

english: All sailors doing business in Catherby must first be registered with the Catherby Council. Doing so requires completion of the appropriate form which is the fourth in the port series of the Catherby Registry form group.
translation: 所有在凯瑟比镇工作的水手必须先向凯瑟比镇议会登记。登记需要填写相应的表格，即凯瑟比镇登记表组港口系列的第四份。

english: Wait... What?
translation: 等等……什么？

english: Please ensure when filling in the form that all answers are clearly legible. Failure to do so may result in unnecessary processing delays.
translation: 填写表格时请确保所有答案清晰可辨。否则可能导致不必要的处理延误。

english: But why do I need to...
translation: 但我为什么要……

english: Thanks to recent budget changes, I'm pleased to confirm that the Catherby Council are now able to provide charcoal free of charge. If required, you can find some in the cabinet to my left.
translation: 得益于最近的预算调整，我很高兴地确认凯瑟比镇议会现在可以免费提供木炭。如果需要，你可以在我左边的柜子里找到一些。

english: Upon completion, please return the form to the Catherby Council Office at your earliest convenience.
translation: 填写完毕后，请尽快将表格交回凯瑟比镇议会办公室。

english: Have you fully filled in that form?
translation: 你填完那份表格了吗？

english: I am afraid there are still questions missing answers. Please make sure you fully fill the form in before you hand it in.
translation: 恐怕还有一些问题没有回答。请确保你在提交前完整填写表格。

english: Thank you very much. However, I must inform you that the Catherby Council is currently experiencing higher than usual volumes of enquiries, so there may be some delays in the processing of your form.
translation: 非常感谢。不过，我必须通知你，凯瑟比镇议会目前收到的咨询量比平时多，因此你的表格处理可能会有一些延迟。

english: Okay... I don't actually really care about the form though.
translation: 好吧……不过我其实并不在乎那份表格。

english: Then what is it I can help you with?
translation: 那我能帮你什么呢？

english: That by-law about non-humans... I want to get it changed.
translation: 那条关于非人类的地方法规……我想把它改掉。

english: Any change to the by-laws can only occur with approval from the Mayor of Catherby.
translation: 任何对地方法规的修改都必须得到凯瑟比镇镇长的批准。

english: Right, we're getting somewhere. Where can I find the mayor?
translation: 好，有进展了。我在哪里能找到镇长？

english: I'm afraid that due to the Catherby Data Protection Regulation, I am not at liberty to give out personal information on the mayor.
translation: 恐怕根据凯瑟比镇数据保护条例，我无权透露镇长的个人信息。

english: Very serious. Now, if that's all, thank you for visiting the Catherby Council Office today.
translation: 非常严肃。好了，如果没别的事，感谢你今天光临凯瑟比镇议会办公室。

english: We hope your experience was a positive one, but if you do have any feedback, I'd be more than happy to provide you with the relevant form.
translation: 我们希望你的体验是积极的，但如果你有任何反馈，我很乐意为你提供相关表格。

english: Yeah... I think I'll pass on that.
translation: 嗯……我想还是算了。

english: Then I wish you a very good day.
translation: 那我祝你今天过得愉快。

english: Please ensure that you have done so before you hand it in. Please also ensure that all answers are clearly legible. Failure to do so may result in unnecessary processing delays.
translation: 请确保你在提交前已经完成。也请确保所有答案清晰可辨。否则可能导致不必要的处理延误。

english: Welcome to the Catherby Council Office. Your views are important to us. How can I help you today?
translation: 欢迎来到凯瑟比镇议会办公室。你的意见对我们很重要。今天我能怎么帮你？

english: I need to speak to the mayor.
translation: 我需要和镇长谈谈。

english: I'm afraid that due to the Catherby Data Protection Regulation, I am not at liberty to give out personal information on the mayor. Now, if that's all, thank you for visiting the Catherby Council Office today.
translation: 恐怕根据凯瑟比镇数据保护条例，我无权透露镇长的个人信息。好了，如果没别的事，感谢你今天光临凯瑟比镇议会办公室。

english: I need to find the Mayor of Catherby.
translation: 我需要找到凯瑟比镇镇长。

english: The mayor? Oh no...
translation: 镇长？哦，不……

english: I'm afraid to say that the mayor died a few days ago.
translation: 很遗憾，镇长几天前去世了。

english: Oh... I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 哦……听到这个我很遗憾。

english: Don't worry, it happens all the time.
translation: 别担心，这种事经常发生。

english: It does? That feels like the kind of thing I should be worried about...
translation: 经常发生？我觉得这应该是让人担心的事吧……

english: Why do you need the mayor anyway?
translation: 你到底为什么需要镇长？

english: Apparently only the mayor can approve a change to the by-laws.
translation: 显然只有镇长才能批准修改地方法规。

english: Really? I don't recall that ever stopping Catherine before, but if she insists, I guess we can do this song and dance once more.
translation: 真的吗？我不记得这以前能阻止凯瑟琳，但如果她坚持，我想我们只好再唱一次老调了。

english: Meaning?
translation: 意思是？

english: We're going to need another mayor, but we need to make sure Catherine doesn't notice.
translation: 我们需要另一位镇长，但要确保凯瑟琳不会发现。

english: Where on Gielinor will we get another mayor? And how in the name of Guthix's trousers will Catherine not notice?
translation: 在吉莱诺尔上，我们上哪儿再找一个镇长？而且，看在古斯的裤子的份上，凯瑟琳怎么会不发现？

english: Well, the Mayor of Catherby has been, for a long time now, a fish.
translation: 嗯，凯瑟比镇镇长很长一段时间以来都是一条鱼。

english: A fish?
translation: 一条鱼？

english: Actually, to be precise, it has been 26 different fish, 25 of which were doing a fantastic job of pretending to be the first.
translation: 准确地说，已经换了26条不同的鱼，其中25条都很好地假装自己是第一条。

english: I'm not sure this democracy thing is going to catch on if it keeps being implemented this badly.
translation: 如果民主制度一直这样糟糕地执行下去，我不确定它还能流行起来。

english: Well, unfortunately no one in Catherby really wanted the job. In fact, there was only one candidate, and it was the one person we all definitely didn't want to be the mayor.
translation: 唉，不幸的是凯瑟比镇没有人真的想要这份工作。事实上，只有一个候选人，而且正是我们都坚决不希望成为镇长的那个人。

english: Councillor Catherine?
translation: 凯瑟琳议员？

english: Councillor Catherine.
translation: 凯瑟琳议员。

english: So the answer was a fish?
translation: 所以答案是条鱼？

english: It seemed like a good idea at the time. Problem is, Catherine responded by introducing that by-law preventing non-humans from working here.
translation: 当时这似乎是个好主意。问题是，凯瑟琳的回应是推行那条禁止非人类在此工作的法规。

english: We were lucky that a different by-law she'd already introduced clearly stated that the mayor serves until death.
translation: 幸运的是，她之前推行的另一条法规明确规定镇长任职至去世。

english: Of course. And as a result, you now need to make sure she doesn't know the mayor died.
translation: 当然。结果就是，你现在需要确保她不知道镇长去世了。

english: I'll help you replace the fish.
translation: 我来帮你换鱼。

english: A wise choice. Go and see Harry at the fishing shop. He should be able to help.
translation: 明智的选择。去钓鱼店找哈里。他应该能帮忙。

english: About the mayor...
translation: 关于镇长……

english: You'll need to go and see Harry at the fishing shop. He should be able to help you sort out a replacement mayor.
translation: 你需要去钓鱼店找哈里。他应该能帮你搞定一位替代镇长。

english: You know, out of context, that might be the strangest thing anyone has ever said.
translation: 你知道吗，断章取义的话，这可能是有人说过的最奇怪的话了。

english: Well, desperate times...
translation: 唉，非常时期嘛……

english: Welcome! If you're looking for fishing equipment, you're in the right place. I'll also give you a good price on any fish that you want to sell.
translation: 欢迎！如果你在找钓鱼装备，那你来对地方了。你卖鱼的话我也会给你个好价钱。

english: I'm here about the mayor.
translation: 我是为镇长的事来的。

english: What about the mayor?
translation: 镇长怎么了？

english: Arhein said you could help me get a replacement.
translation: 阿海因说你可以帮我找个替代的。

english: Oh, we've lost another one have we?
translation: 哦，我们又损失了一位，是吗？

english: Afraid so.
translation: 恐怕是的。

english: Well, it's easy to fix. You just need a special mayoral fishbowl and a tiny net. Once you have them, grab a fish from one of the aquariums with the net, and that is our new mayor.
translation: 嗯，这很容易解决。你只需要一个特殊的镇长鱼缸和一个小网。拿到它们后，用网从其中一个水族箱里捞出一条鱼，那就是我们的新镇长了。

english: Where can I get the fishbowl and net?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到鱼缸和网？

english: I can sell you the whole kit for 50 coins. Just come back once you've got enough room.
translation: 我可以把整套工具卖给你，只要50金币。等你有空位了再来找我。

english: I can sell you the whole kit for 50 coins.
translation: 我可以把整套工具卖给你，只要50金币。

english: I don't have enough money for that.
translation: 我没那么多钱。

english: Politics is an expensive game!
translation: 政治可是一场烧钱的游戏！

english: There you go. Once you've caught the mayor, be sure to take him to Arhein to make sure he's happy. Just don't take too long. They don't seem to have a long life span...
translation: 给你。抓到镇长后，一定要带他去给阿海因看看，确保他满意。别拖太久。这些鱼的寿命似乎不长……

english: You've got your special mayoral fishbowl and tiny net. Just grab a fish from one of the aquariums with the net, and that is our new mayor.
translation: 你已经拿到了特殊的镇长鱼缸和小网。只要用网从其中一个水族箱里捞出一条鱼，那就是我们的新镇长了。

english: I think you dropped these. Good job I noticed and picked them up for you. Now, go grab a fish from one of the aquariums with the net, and that is our new mayor.
translation: 我想你掉了这些东西。还好我注意到并帮你捡起来了。现在，去用水族箱里的网捞一条鱼，那就是我们的新镇长了。

english: I think you dropped your net and fishbowl. Don't worry, I picked them up for you. Just make soom room for them and I'll give them back.
translation: 我想你掉了网和鱼缸。别担心，我帮你捡起来了。腾出点空间我就还给你。

english: I see you've caught a new one. You'd best show him to Arhein. Just don't take too long. They don't seem to have a long life span...
translation: 我看到你抓了一条新的。最好带他去给阿海因看看。别拖太久。这些鱼似乎寿命不长……

english: Take good care of that fish!
translation: 好好照顾那条鱼！

english: Here you...oh.
translation: 给你……哦。

english: Well, you don't seem to have any free space for this right now.  Come back later when you do.
translation: 嗯，你现在似乎没有空位来放这个。等你有空位了再来吧。

english: Well, I think you have quite enough boxes for now. Why not go and fill them up?
translation: 嗯，我觉得你现在盒子够多了。为什么不去把它们装满呢？

english: Come back when you do. I'll keep the boxes to one side for you.
translation: 等你有空位了再来吧。我会先把盒子给你留着。

english: I can hardly charge you for an empty box, but you don't seem to have any space for it.
translation: 我总不能为一个空箱子收你钱，但你似乎没有空位来放它。

english: The mayor has returned.
translation: 镇长回来了。

english: Long live the mayor.
translation: 镇长万岁。

english: Well, I think I'll start keeping a stock of mayors on standby from now on.
translation: 嗯，我想我以后得开始储备一些候补镇长了。

english: That seems like a good idea, but I meant about the by- law.
translation: 听起来不错，但我指的是那条法规。

english: Ah, of course. Let me just give him his mayoral chain...
translation: 啊，当然。让我给他戴上镇长锁链……

english: There! Catherine shouldn't be able to stop us getting the by-law changed now. You should go and speak with her.
translation: 好了！凯瑟琳现在应该没法阻止我们修改法规了。你该去和她谈谈。

english: I'll head over there right away.
translation: 我马上过去。

english: What do I need to do with him now?
translation: 我现在需要对他做什么？

english: You should speak to Catherine. Now that we have the mayor, she shouldn't be able to stop us getting that by-law changed.
translation: 你应该去找凯瑟琳谈谈。既然我们有了镇长，她应该没法阻止我们修改那条法规了。

english: In that case, I'll go and see her right away.
translation: 既然如此，我马上去见她。

english: I have the mayor!
translation: 我找到市长了！

english: Well, I did have the mayor, but I appear to have misplaced him.
translation: 嗯，我确实有过市长，但好像把他放错地方了。

english: You've misplaced the mayor?
translation: 你把市长放错地方了？

english: I see... Well, if that's all, thank you for visiting the Catherby Council Office today.
translation: 我明白了……好吧，如果没有别的事，感谢您今天光临凯瑟比镇议会办公室。

english: Are you sure? It doesn't look like the mayor. Where is his mayoral chain?
translation: 你确定吗？这看起来不像市长。他的市长锁链呢？

english: Hmm... Well, if that's all, thank you for visiting the Catherby Council Office today.
translation: 嗯……好吧，如果没有别的事，感谢您今天光临凯瑟比镇议会办公室。

english: Oh, how wonderful.
translation: 哦，太棒了。

english: So, shall we get to work on getting that by-law changed?
translation: 那么，我们是不是该着手修改那条地方法规了？

english: I'm afraid a recent audit has exposed irregularities in key paperwork filed with the Catherby Council Office. These irregularities must be addressed prior to any updates to the by-laws.
translation: 恐怕最近的一次审计发现了向凯瑟比镇议会提交的关键文件中存在违规情况。在更新地方法规之前，必须先解决这些违规问题。

english: Here we go...
translation: 又来了……

english: Unfortunately, as you yourself have recently filed a form with the Catherby Council Office, I must now ask you to join me in reviewing that form to ensure everything is correct.
translation: 不幸的是，由于您本人最近向凯瑟比镇议会提交了一份表格，我现在必须请您和我一起审查那份表格，以确保一切无误。

english: What if I've forgotten what I put down?
translation: 如果我忘记自己填了什么怎么办？

english: That seems unlikely. After all, you gave accurate information, did you not?
translation: 这似乎不太可能。毕竟，您提供了准确的信息，不是吗？

english: I am shocked that you would suggest otherwise.
translation: 我对您竟然暗示并非如此感到震惊。

english: Very good. In that case, let us begin.
translation: 很好。既然如此，我们开始吧。

english: What is your main reason for making port at Catherby?
translation: 您在凯瑟比镇停靠的主要目的是什么？

english: How many hulls does your ship have?
translation: 您的船有几个船体？

english: Is your ship insured against cargo spillage and theft?
translation: 您的船是否投保了货物泄漏和盗窃险？

english: Does your first mate have first aid training?
translation: 您的大副是否接受过急救培训？

english: Does your second mate have second aid training?
translation: 您的二副是否接受过二级急救培训？

english: Have you experienced symptoms of plague in the last two weeks?
translation: 过去两周内您是否出现过瘟疫症状？

english: How much experience do you have sailing?
translation: 您有多少航海经验？

english: Where would you say your home port is?
translation: 您认为您的母港是哪里？

english: Hmm, that all seems to be right...
translation: 嗯，这些似乎都没问题……

english: Can we finally get on with this by-law change now?
translation: 我们现在终于可以继续修改地方法规了吧？

english: *sigh* Yes, I suppose everything is in order. I have a form here that needs signing by the mayor. Please make some room so that I am able to give it to you.
translation: *叹气* 好吧，我想一切都就绪了。我这里有一份需要市长签字的表格。请腾出一些空间，我好把它交给你。

english: *sigh* Yes, I suppose everything is in order. I just need this form signing by the mayor.
translation: *叹气* 好吧，我想一切都就绪了。我只需要这份表格由市长签字。

english: Right... How does the mayor sign forms usually, given his lack of hands?
translation: 好吧……考虑到市长没有手，他通常怎么在表格上签字？

english: Simply dip the form into his bowl and he will give it a nibble. We consider that to be his signature.
translation: 只需把表格浸到他的碗里，他就会咬一口。我们把这视为他的签名。

english: I'm afraid that one of your answers didn't match the original form. We will have to go through the incorrect questions again.
translation: 恐怕您的某个答案与原始表格不符。我们必须重新过一遍那些有误的问题。

english: I suppose so. You just need to get that form signed by the mayor. Simply dip the form into his bowl and he will give it a nibble. We consider that to be his signature.
translation: 我想是的。你只需要让市长在那份表格上签字。只需把表格浸到他的碗里，他就会咬一口。我们把这视为他的签名。

english: I'm sorry, but I lost the form you gave me. Can I have another?
translation: 抱歉，我弄丢了你给我的表格。能再给我一份吗？

english: Very well, but I would advise you take more care next time.
translation: 好吧，但我建议你下次小心一点。

english: I have that signed form.
translation: 我有那份签过字的表格了。

english: The by-law has now been amended. Good day.
translation: 地方法规现已修改。祝您愉快。

english: The by-law has been changed!
translation: 地方法规已经修改了！

english: Excellent! Thank you for sorting that out for me. However, I do have one more thing I'd appreciate some help with.
translation: 太好了！谢谢你帮我解决了这个问题。不过，我还有一件事想请你帮忙。

english: I have some repairs I need to do on my ship. Would you mind taking the duck out to test the currents yourself?
translation: 我需要修理一下我的船。你介意亲自带那只鸭子出去测试一下水流吗？

english: Of course. How do I do it?
translation: 当然。我该怎么做？

english: From what I've been told, you just need to release the duck, follow him while he tracks the currents, and then pick him up once he's done.
translation: 据我所知，你只需要放出鸭子，跟着它追踪水流，等它完成后再把它捡起来。

english: Sounds good. Where should I release him?
translation: 听起来不错。我该在哪里放出它？

english: I saw a good spot next to that island east of the docks. The one with the obelisk on it.
translation: 我在码头东边那个小岛旁边看到了一个好地方。就是上面有方尖碑的那个。

english: Alright, I'll sail over there right away.
translation: 好的，我马上开船过去。

english: Have fun!
translation: 玩得开心！

english: About that duck...
translation: 关于那只鸭子……

english: I'm sorry, but I've lost him.
translation: 对不起，但我把它弄丢了。

english: Yes, I noticed. Luckily for us, he came wandering back to me. Make some room to hold him and I'll give him back.
translation: 是的，我注意到了。幸运的是，它自己溜达回来了。腾出点空间来装它，我还给你。

english: Yes, I noticed. Luckily for us, he came wandering back to me. Here you go.
translation: 是的，我注意到了。幸运的是，它自己溜达回来了。给你。

english: What do I need to do with him?
translation: 我需要用它做什么？

english: There he goes! Now to follow him and see where these currents flow.
translation: 它出发了！现在跟着它，看看这些水流流向哪里。

english: I've charted the currents!
translation: 我已经绘制出了水流图！

english: Thank you so much, friend! I'm sorry for all the nonsense you had to deal with. Please, keep the duck as thanks. I have no more need of him, and he seems to really like you!
translation: 太感谢了，朋友！很抱歉你不得不应付那些乱七八糟的事。这只鸭子就留给你作为谢礼吧。我也不再需要它了，而且它似乎真的很喜欢你！

english: In fact, keep the mayor as well. It's not like I don't have plenty of spares.
translation: 事实上，市长也留给你吧。反正我有很多备用的。

english: Ah, on that note, I'm afraid I lost him.
translation: 啊，说到这个，我恐怕把它弄丢了。

english: Not to worry. As I say, I have plenty of spares.
translation: 别担心。我说了，我有很多备用的。

english: I also have a little something else for you, but it appears you don't have space to take it. Please come back when you do.
translation: 我还有点别的东西要给你，但你似乎没有空间带走。等你有空间了请再回来。

english: I believe that puts us at mayor [X] now. Long live the mayor.
translation: 我相信现在我们已经有市长[X]了。市长万岁。

english: Don't mention it. All the best!
translation: 不客气。祝你一切顺利！

english: Well I'd say our mission to establish a new hideout has been a great success. All thanks to you, of course.
translation: 嗯，我觉得我们建立新藏身处的任务非常成功。当然，这都多亏了你。

english: Hello again. How's things?
translation: 又见面了。情况如何？

english: Very good. I'd say our mission to establish a new hideout has been a great success. All thanks to you, of course.
translation: 非常好。我说过，我们建立新藏身处的任务非常成功。当然，这都多亏了你。

english: With the hideout sorted, we can now start focusing on the vampyres again. We're looking to re-establish contact with the Sanguinesti region.
translation: 藏身处安排妥当后，我们现在可以重新专注于吸血鬼了。我们正寻求与桑吉内斯蒂地区重新建立联系。

english: I also want to look into a diplomatic mission into Misthalin. The support of the king would be very helpful in our fight against Drakan.
translation: 我还想考虑派遣外交使团前往米斯萨林。国王的支持对我们对抗德雷坎会非常有帮助。

english: Is there something I can do to help out?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Well, we could use some help with scouting a route into the Sanguinesti region. Are you interested in learning more details?
translation: 嗯，我们可能需要帮忙侦察一条通往桑吉内斯蒂地区的路线。你有兴趣了解更多细节吗？

english: Yes. Please tell me more.
translation: 是的。请告诉我更多。

english: There should be another group of Myreque working in the Sanguinesti region. We need to re-establish contact with them. To do that, we need a route into the region.
translation: 桑吉内斯蒂地区应该还有另一组迈雷克成员在活动。我们需要与他们重新建立联系。为此，我们需要一条进入该地区的路线。

english: How do I get into the Sanguinesti region?
translation: 我该如何进入桑吉内斯蒂地区？

english: The entire region is surrounded by a wall that you'll find impossible to get over.
translation: 整个地区都被一堵墙包围着，你会发现无法翻越。

english: That said, you might be able to find a way around the wall at the point where it meets the sea. Perhaps there's something in Burgh de Rott that could help you.
translation: 不过，你可能在墙与海相接的地方找到绕过去的方法。也许伯格德罗特镇里有什么东西能帮到你。

english: Once you're in, try and establish contact with the Myreque there. I'm sure they'll have sympathisers amongst the citizens. Someone should be able to point you in the right direction.
translation: 一旦你进去了，试着和那里的迈雷克建立联系。我相信他们在市民中有同情者。应该有人能给你指路。

english: One last thing to be aware of is the vyrewatch. They're powerful vampyres that patrol the entire region. We haven't found any way of killing them. Even the Rod of Ivandis does nothing!
translation: 最后要注意的是吸血鬼哨兵。他们是强大的吸血鬼，在整个地区巡逻。我们还没找到任何杀死他们的方法。就连伊万迪斯之杖也没用！

english: It's a large region to the east of here. The southern part is a city called Meiyerditch. Humans live there in ghettos and are regularly tithed by the vampyres.
translation: 那是这里以东的一个大区域。南部是一座叫迈尔迪奇的城市。人类住在那里隔都里，定期被吸血鬼征收血税。

english: The northern part is the vampyre capital of Darkmeyer. It is from his castle there that Lowerniel Drakan rules over all of Morytania.
translation: 北部是吸血鬼首都达克迈尔。洛厄尼尔.德雷坎就是在那里的城堡统治整个莫利塔尼亚。

english: Can you tell me more about the Sanguinesti Myreque?
translation: 你能告诉我更多关于桑吉内斯蒂迈雷克的事吗？

english: Certainly. The Myreque, or at least the resistance that has now become the Myreque, originated in the region. Previously there was nothing.
translation: 当然。迈雷克，或者至少是现在成为迈雷克的反抗组织，起源于该地区。之前什么都没有。

english: It was many years ago that a small group, led by a man called Safalaan Hallow, managed to escape from the ghettos of Meiyerditch.
translation: 许多年前，一个由名叫萨法兰.哈洛的人领导的小组成功逃离了迈尔迪奇的隔都。

english: They got information out about what was happening and helped to organise the resistance, which today is called the Myreque.
translation: 他们向外传递了正在发生的事情的信息，并帮助组织了反抗力量，也就是今天所说的迈雷克。

english: The name was given to us by the locals, who named us after the place where we hid in Mort Myre.
translation: 这个名字是当地人给的，他们以我们在莫特迈尔藏身的地方命名了我们。

english: Err, no thanks.
translation: 呃，不了，谢谢。

english: Very well. We'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 很好。如果你改变主意，我们就在这儿。

english: What will you do here in Burgh de Rott?
translation: 你们在伯格德罗特镇会做什么？

english: Oh, the usual. Keep a low profile and keep an eye on what the vampyres are up to. There's also plenty of research to do with all the new information you've found for us.
translation: 哦，老样子。保持低调，留意吸血鬼的动向。还有大量研究工作要做，因为你为我们找到了那么多新信息。

english: Why re-establish contact with the Sanguinesti region?
translation: 为什么要与桑吉内斯蒂地区重新建立联系？

english: The region is where the heaviest blood tithing takes place. It's also home to some of the more senior members of vampyre society, including Lowerniel Drakan himself.
translation: 那个地区是血税最重的地方。也是吸血鬼社会中一些高级成员的所在地，包括洛厄尼尔.德雷坎本人。

english: Assuming the vampyres haven't put an end to them, there should be another group of Myreque operating in the region. We will need  their support in the fight against the vampyres.
translation: 假设吸血鬼还没有消灭他们，该地区应该有另一组迈雷克在活动。我们在对抗吸血鬼的战斗中需要他们的支持。

english: Why ask Misthalin for some help?
translation: 为什么要向米斯萨林寻求帮助？

english: We can't hope to fight the power of the vampyres alone. We'll need help from Misthalin by the bucket-load if we're to stand a chance against them.
translation: 我们无法独自对抗吸血鬼的力量。要想有机会对抗他们，我们需要从米斯特林得到大量帮助。

english: Well met, friend.
translation: 幸会，朋友。

english: Hey. What do I need to do again?
translation: 嘿。我需要再做什么来着？

english: We need you to find a way into the Sanguinesti region. Once you're in, you need to try and make contact with any members of the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque.
translation: 我们需要你找到进入桑吉内斯蒂地区的方法。一旦你进去了，你需要试着与桑吉内斯蒂迈雷克组织的任何成员取得联系。

english: Go about your business, meat sack, before I perforate you real good!
translation: 滚开，肉袋子，在我把你捅成筛子之前！

english: Slurp! You look positively delicious - let me help you lose a bit of weight! Either I get a bite or you can be my combat practice; which is it to be, meat sack?
translation: 嘶溜！你看起来真是美味——让我帮你减点体重吧！要么让我咬一口，要么你当我的战斗练习；你选哪个，肉袋子？

english: Hmm, you look like a tasty specimen - in fact I'm quite peckish right now. You can either give me a bite or I'll use you for combat practice; what do you say?
translation: 嗯，你看起来像个美味的标本——事实上我现在挺饿的。你可以让我咬一口，或者我用你来练习战斗；你觉得怎么样？

english: Ooh, a meat sack... I could just do with a snack. What's it to be: do I use you for combat practice or do I get a bite?
translation: 哦，一个肉袋子……我正好需要点心。怎么办：是拿你当战斗练习，还是让我咬一口？

english: Impressive. Not many of you have the spine for it these days!
translation: 厉害。现在你们很少有人有这个胆量了！

english: Hey, food sack, what's the rush? I was talking to you!
translation: 嘿，食物袋子，急什么？我在跟你说话呢！

english: Sorry, what were you saying?
translation: 抱歉，你刚才说什么？

english: Hey again. I've made my way into the Sanguinesti region, I think!
translation: 嘿，又见面了。我想我已经进入桑吉内斯蒂地区了！

english: Good news. Presumably you took precautions not to be followed?
translation: 好消息。想必你已经采取措施防止被跟踪了吧？

english: Err... Well anyway, I have some questions.
translation: 呃……不管怎样，我有几个问题。

english: Now that you've made your way into the Sanguinesti region, we need you to try and make contact with the Myreque there.
translation: 既然你已经进入了桑吉内斯蒂地区，我们需要你试着与那里的迈雷克取得联系。

english: How should I do that?
translation: 我该怎么做？

english: You may need to ask some of the citizens, but try to be discreet! Remember to avoid the vyrewatch at all costs!
translation: 你可能需要问一些市民，但要小心谨慎！记住要不惜一切代价避开吸血鬼哨兵！

english: Any tips you can give to help out a bit?
translation: 你能给点建议帮我一把吗？

english: You may get lost while in the city. It might be worth your while to invest in some teleportation devices to get yourself out.
translation: 你可能会在城市里迷路。投资一些传送装置以便脱身可能是值得的。

english: Interesting... It looks like this section of the wall has been tampered with.
translation: 有趣……看起来这段墙壁被人动过手脚。

english: Urm, well I fink we're in sector one. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!
translation: 嗯，好吧，我觉得我们在一区。不知道还能说什么。我只是个小孩，你知道吗！

english: Get off me, I haven't got anything!
translation: 放开我，我什么都没拿！

english: Urm, well I fink we're in sector two. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!
translation: 呃，嗯，我觉得我们在二区。不知道还能说啥。我只是个小孩，你知道吧！

english: Oh... I can't talk to you. I'm not allowed.
translation: 哦……我不能跟你说话。我不被允许。

english: Nuffin', I wasn't doin' nuffin'! Yous ain't my dad, I'm tellin' on you!
translation: 没……没什么，我什么都没干！你又不是我爸，我要告你状！

english: They were the good 'uns what could help us. The vyresies killed dem all though.
translation: 他们本来是能帮我们的好人。但那些吸血鬼把他们全杀了。

english: Urm, well I fink we're in sector six. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!
translation: 呃，嗯，我觉得我们在六区。不知道还能说啥。我只是个小孩，你知道吧！

english: Urm, well I fink we're in sector three. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!

english: Nuffin', I wasn't doin' nuffin'! Yous ain't my mum, I'm tellin' on you!

english: Urm, well I fink we're in sector four. Not sure what else to say. I'm only a kid ya know!
translation: 呃，嗯，我觉得我们在四区。不知道还能说啥。我只是个小孩，你知道吧！

english: Well, you're in sector one, but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 嗯，你在第一区，但如果你希望得到其他帮助，那我很抱歉。我连帮自己都很难。

english: Yes... but I really can't talk about them.
translation: 是的……但我真的不能谈论他们。

english: I really need to meet the Myreque. If you can't talk to me about them, maybe you know someone who will?
translation: 我真的需要见迈雷克。如果你不能跟我谈论他们，也许你知道谁愿意谈？

english: I understand, but you may not like what you find. Go and talk to Old Man Ral. He might help you. He lives in the centre of sector one.
translation: 我理解，但你可能不会喜欢你所发现的。去找老人拉尔谈谈。他可能会帮你。他住在一区中心。

english: *Can you introduce me to Old Man Ral?
translation: *你能把我介绍给老人拉尔吗？

english: Well, I don't need to do that. Just tell him that a friend has recommended you to him. It makes him feel important.
translation: 嗯，我不需要这样做。只要告诉他有个朋友推荐你来找他就行了。这会让他觉得自己很重要。

english: How can Old Man Ral help me?
translation: 老人拉尔能怎么帮我？

english: He should be able to give you some background information on this place and perhaps put you in touch with people of the same way of thinking as yourself... Hope that helps. See you around.
translation: 他应该能给你一些关于这个地方的背景信息，也许还能让你和志同道合的人联系上……希望这对你有帮助。回见。

english: They say this place once had a Saradominist queen. Even she could not withstand the vampyres. Anyone who has challenged their power in the past has come undone.
translation: 他们说这里曾经有位萨拉多明女王。就连她也抵挡不住吸血鬼。过去任何挑战他们权力的人，最终都落得失败的下场。

english: I'm really sorry, but I just cannot talk to you about that. I'm sorry.
translation: 真的很抱歉，但我真的不能跟你谈那件事。对不起。

english: Well, you're in sector two, but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 嗯，你在二区，但如果你还想要其他帮助，那我很抱歉。我自己都自顾不暇了。

english: Live here? Huh! I exist here. I survive here even. No one actually 'lives' here. We all gave up ideas of living a long time ago.
translation: 住在这里？哈！我在这里苟活，甚至可以说是幸存。没人真的在这里'生活'。我们很久以前就放弃生活的念头了。

english: It is, it's terrible. But keep your sympathy, my friend, it's wasted on the likes of us.
translation: 是啊，很糟糕。但收起你的同情吧，朋友，用在我们这种人身上是浪费。

english: Lost? Well I can tell you you're in sector one, if that helps.
translation: 迷路了？好吧，我可以告诉你，你在一区，如果这有帮助的话。

english: Well, you're in sector six, but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 嗯，你在六区，但如果你还想要其他帮助，那我很抱歉。我自己都自顾不暇了。

english: Well, you're in sector four, but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 嗯，你在四区，但如果你还想要其他帮助，那我很抱歉。我自己都自顾不暇了。

english: Well, you're in sector three, but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 嗯，你在三区，但如果你还想要其他帮助，那我很抱歉。我自己都自顾不暇了。

english: Lost? Well I can tell you you're in sector two, if that helps.
translation: 迷路了？好吧，我可以告诉你，你在二区，如果这有帮助的话。

english: Well, you're in sector five, but if you were hoping for any other help then I'm very sorry. I find it hard enough to help myself.
translation: 嗯，你在五区，但如果你还想要其他帮助，那我很抱歉。我自己都自顾不暇了。

english: I'm very sorry, but I'm not sure which sector this is. But go and ask someone else, they might know.
translation: 很抱歉，我不确定这是哪个区。但去问问别人吧，他们可能知道。

translation: 哼！我又知道什么？我根本不认识你！

english: Hmph! A simple man only knows simple truths, and what I know is my own business. I share that which is precious only to those who consider it valuable. Nothing will I share with those who are unknown to me.
translation: 哼！一个简单的人只知道简单的真理，我所知道的是我自己的事。我只会与那些认为它有价值的人分享珍贵的东西。我不会与我不认识的人分享任何东西。

translation: 我只是想帮忙，我该怎么做？

english: Hmph! I am a simple man, what little do I know? In esteem, must a man be held, before he feels his efforts are truly appreciated?
translation: 哼！我是一个简单的人，我知道多少？一个人是否必须受到尊重，才能感到自己的努力真正被赏识？

english: You're answering every question with a question!
translation: 你在用问题回答每个问题！

english: Hmph! Am I?
translation: 哼！是吗？

english: Someone said you could help me.
translation: 有人说你能帮我。

english: Hmph! People say things they do not mean - many times this has been true.
translation: 哼！人们会说他们不是那个意思的话——很多时候都是这样。

english: It's true. They said that you were very well informed. In fact they had a name for you!
translation: 是真的。他们说你消息非常灵通。事实上他们还给你起了个名字！

english: Hmph! Oh yes, what was it?
translation: 哼！哦，是吗，叫什么？

english: Old Man Ral, he's a very good pal.
translation: 老人拉尔，他是个很好的朋友。

english: Hmph! Nope, that's not me they're talking about, must be someone else.
translation: 哼！不，他们说的不是我，肯定是别人。

english: No, I'm sure they gave you a name, but it might have been something else.
translation: 不，我确定他们给你起了一个名字，但可能不是这个。

english: Hmph! Okay then, what was it?
translation: 哼！好吧，那是什么？

english: Old Man Ral, the nefarious rascal.
translation: 老人拉尔，那个邪恶的流氓。

english: Hmph! Nope, doesn't sound like me, you sure you've not got me confused with someone else?
translation: 哼！不，听起来不像我，你确定没把我跟别人搞混？

english: No, I'm pretty sure they directed me to you. What was that name they used to describe you?
translation: 不，我很确定他们让我来找你。他们用来描述你的那个名字是什么？

english: Hmph! Yes indeed, what was the name?
translation: 哼！确实，那名字是什么？

english: Old Man Ral, the Meiyerditch snitch.
translation: 老人拉尔，迈尔迪奇的告密者。

english: Hmph! A snitch! Are you trying to insult me? Get out! Go on!
translation: 哼！告密者！你是在侮辱我吗？出去！走开！

english: No, no, sorry, I do apologise. I'm sure that was someone else. My mistake entirely!
translation: 不不，抱歉，我道歉。我肯定是别人。全是我的错！

english: Hmph! So no one actually referred you to me at all then?
translation: 哼！那么根本就没有人让你来找我？

english: No they did, and they referred to you as...
translation: 不，他们确实让我来了，他们称你为……

english: Old Man Ral, the sage of Sanguinesti.
translation: 老人拉尔，桑吉内斯蒂的智者。

english: Hmph! Sage of Sanguinesti, eh?
translation: 哼！桑吉内斯蒂的智者，嗯？

english: Yes, yes, saying you were the local font of knowledge.
translation: 对对，说你是本地的知识源泉。

english: Hmph! So that's what they call me now is it?
translation: 哼！所以他们现在就这么称呼我？

english: Oh yes, yes. All the time. And only in the most respectful way.
translation: 哦对对，一直这么叫。而且是最尊敬的方式。

english: Hmmm. Sage of Sanguinesti. Has a nice ring to it. Yes, that sounds like they were referring to me. What else did they say about me?
translation: 嗯。桑吉内斯蒂的智者。听起来不错。是的，听起来像是在说我。他们还说了我什么？

english: They said that you might be able to help me find some people... Some hidden people...
translation: 他们说你可能能帮我找到一些人……一些藏起来的人……

english: Hmmmph. That depends. Did they hide themselves or did someone else hide them?
translation: 嗯哼。那取决于他们是自己躲起来的，还是别人把他们藏起来的。

english: Well, hopefully they hid themselves. I need to make contact with the Myreque.
translation: 嗯，希望是他们自己躲起来的。我需要和迈雷克取得联系。

english: Hmph. Myreque, eh? Well, it'll take a lot to find them. It's not an easy route up to sector three, but that's where they are. You'll need to follow the symbols in order to get there.
translation: 哼。迈雷克，嗯？要找到他们可不容易。到达三区的路并不好走，但他们就在那里。你需要沿着符号走才能到达那里。

english: And now you should leave. I have little tolerance for people and talking to you has tired me out.
translation: 现在你该走了。我对人的容忍度很低，跟你说话让我累坏了。

english: Okay, thanks very much.
translation: 好的，非常感谢。

english: Sorry to bother you.
translation: 抱歉打扰了。

english: I don't think I have any reason to go down there.
translation: 我觉得我没有理由去那里。

english: Hey. You're with the Myreque aren't you?
translation: 嘿。你是迈雷克的人，对吧？

english: Who are you? What are you doing here?
translation: 你是谁？你在这里做什么？

english: I'm [player name]. I'm a friend of the Myreque. I've come to help!
translation: 我是[player name]。我是迈雷克的朋友。我是来帮忙的！

english: Oh, and I'm just supposed to believe you am I?
translation: 哦，我就该相信你，是吗？

english: It's true. I was sent by Veliaf. We've just moved base from the Hollows to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 是真的。我是维利亚夫派来的。我们刚刚把基地从霍洛斯搬到了伯格德罗特镇。

english: Veliaf? Is he still alive? Amazing! Well, you make a convincing story, so I guess I'll have to believe you, for now.
translation: 维利亚夫？他还活着？太棒了！好吧，你说得挺像那么回事，那我就暂时相信你吧。

english: So anyway, I'm Vertida, one of the Myreque here. What brings you to this miserable place?
translation: 总之，我是维蒂达，这里的迈雷克成员之一。是什么风把你吹到这个鬼地方来了？

english: I was asked to make contact with the Myreque here.
translation: 我是奉命来和这里的迈雷克取得联系的。

english: >Well, it seems like you've done that! I'll tell you what I'll do. I'll write you out a message to give to Veliaf as proof that the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque still exists.
translation: >嗯，看来你已经做到了！我告诉你我要做什么。我会给你写一封信，让你带给维利亚夫，作为迈雷克的血色秩序仍然存在的证明。

english: I'm the second in command of the Myreque here in Meiyerditch. The others are all out on missions right now.
translation: 我是迈尔迪奇这里迈雷克的副指挥。其他人现在都出去执行任务了。

english: Have you always lived here?
translation: 你一直住在这里吗？

english: Not always. I was originally from Lumbridge, perhaps much like yourself. I ended up here when I was captured by the vampyres while exploring Mort Myre. That was a long time ago.
translation: 不总是。我原本来自仑桥镇，也许和你差不多。我在探索莫尔.迈尔时被吸血鬼抓住，最后就到了这里。那是很久以前的事了。

english: How have you survived this long?
translation: 你是怎么活到现在的？

english: I found Safalaan, the leader of this group. Together we escaped from Meiyerditch and formed the Myreque out in Mort Myre.
translation: 我找到了萨法拉安，这个组织的领袖。我们一起逃出了迈尔迪奇，在莫尔.迈尔建立了迈雷克。

english: We eventually came back here though. We knew we couldn't leave the people here to the vampyres.
translation: 不过我们最后还是回到了这里。我们知道不能把这里的人丢给吸血鬼。

english: That's really up to you. That said, I imagine you'll probably want to get back to where you came from and deliver that message I gave you.
translation: 这完全取决于你。不过，我想你大概想回到你来的地方，把我给你的信送过去。

english: Hey again. How are you?
translation: 又见面了。你还好吗？

english: Good, thanks!
translation: 很好，谢谢！

english: That's really up to you. Why are you here anyway?
translation: 这完全取决于你。话说回来，你到底是来干什么的？

english: Well met, friend. What news?
translation: 幸会，朋友。有什么消息吗？

english: I have met with the Sanguinesti Myreque!
translation: 我已经和血色迈雷克会面了！

english: Really? I can't believe it!
translation: 真的吗？我简直不敢相信！

english: Yes! They gave me a message to give to you but I don't have it on me at the moment.
translation: 是的！他们让我带一封信给你，但我现在没带在身上。

english: Well, please bring it to me when you can. I'd be very interested to hear what they have to say.
translation: 好吧，方便的话请带给我。我很想知道他们说了什么。

english: I have a message for you from the Sanguinesti Myreque!
translation: 我从血色迈雷克那里给你带来了一封信！

english: Great! Please let me see it.
translation: 太好了！请让我看看。

english: Hmm, sounds like they're struggling just as much as we are. At least they still live though.
translation: 嗯，听起来他们和我们一样挣扎。不过至少他们还活着。

english: I need some time to consider how we can best support the Sanguinesti Myreque. In the meantime, I have a new task for you.
translation: 我需要一些时间来考虑如何最好地支持血色迈雷克。与此同时，我有一个新任务给你。

english: What do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？

english: I've had word from Drezel that there's something strange going on at Paterdomus. Head up there and see what support you can offer.
translation: 我从德雷泽尔那里得到消息，说帕特多穆斯那边有些奇怪的事情。你过去看看，看看能提供什么帮助。

english: Once you're done, press onwards to Varrock and seek an audience with King Roald. Express the desperate nature of the situation here and beg him to send troops.
translation: 完成后，继续前往维洛克城，求见罗尔德国王。向他说明这里的危急情况，恳求他派遣军队。

english: Hey there. What should I do now?
translation: 嘿，我现在该做什么？

english: Myreque prevail! What can I do for you?
translation: 迈雷克必胜！我能为你做什么？

english: What can you tell me about the Myreque?
translation: 你能告诉我关于迈雷克的什么信息？

english: Well, I've been with them for years now. We have multiple groups in Morytania but I only really know about those of us based here.
translation: 嗯，我加入他们好几年了。我们在莫利塔尼亚有好几个小组，但我只了解我们这里的情况。

english: To be honest, things haven't been great for us. Our leader, Safalaan, keeps us going. We'd be nowhere without him.
translation: 说实话，我们的情况不太好。我们的领袖萨法拉安支撑着我们。没有他我们什么都不是。

english: I'm a bit lost... Can you help?
translation: 我有点迷茫……你能帮帮我吗？

english: I'd like to help, I really would, but I can't leave the base right now. The others are all out on missions so someone needs to keep watch here.
translation: 我很想帮忙，真的，但我现在不能离开基地。其他人都出去执行任务了，所以需要有人在这里看守。

english: I must speak with you on a matter of grave importance.
translation: 我必须和你谈一件极其重要的事情。

english: I'm very sorry, but I'm currently rather busy. Apparently old Drezel is having a bit of bother near Paterdomus and I have to try and sort someone out to go and visit him.
translation: 非常抱歉，但我现在很忙。显然老德雷泽尔在帕特多穆斯附近遇到了一些麻烦，我得想办法找个人去看看他。

english: I don't suppose you would fancy popping in and seeing him, would you?
translation: 你不会正好想去看看他吧？

english: Oh, Veliaf asked me to pay him a visit, actually. I guess I could go and meet with him.
translation: 哦，实际上维利亚夫让我去拜访他。我想我可以去见见他。

english: That would be very good indeed. Your king commends you!
translation: 那真是太好了。国王赞扬你！

english: Hey, Drezel. Veliaf sent me. Apparently there have been some strange goings on which you need me to investigate.
translation: 嘿，德雷泽尔。维利亚夫派我来的。据说发生了一些奇怪的事情，需要我去调查。

english: Actually, that's a bit odd isn't it? Because in Morytania, strange is the order of the day. I'd have been more surprised if there had been reports of things getting back to normal!
translation: 实际上，这有点奇怪，不是吗？因为在莫利塔尼亚，奇怪才是常态。如果报告说一切恢复正常，我反而会更惊讶！

english: I'm glad you're keeping your sense of humour. It will help you to maintain mental clarity while dealing with the tasks you've been given.
translation: 很高兴你还能保持幽默感。这有助于你在处理任务时保持头脑清醒。

english: Well there's no shortage of tasks for me. Once I'm done here I have to go and speak to King Roald, or rather, Roald. We've been on first name terms for quite a while now. Funny that, eh?
translation: 我的任务可不少。这里的事情办完后，我还得去和罗尔德国王谈谈，或者说，罗尔德。我们直呼其名已经很久了。挺有趣的，是吧？

english: To think, a lowly adventurer like me having friends like you and the king. Still, at least I haven't lost my common touch.
translation: 想想看，像我这样一个卑微的冒险者，竟然有你这样的朋友，还有国王。不过，至少我还没有失去平易近人的本色。

english: But anyway, what do you need from me?
translation: 不过话说回来，你需要我做什么？

english: Ivan mentioned that he heard some strange noises recently out in front of the temple. Could you have a look and make sure there's nothing funny going on?
translation: 伊万提到他最近在神庙前面听到一些奇怪的声音。你能去看看，确保没什么不对劲的吗？

english: When and where were these noises heard?
translation: 这些声音是什么时候、在哪里听到的？

english: Ivan said he heard them throughout the day, but usually when things were very quiet. We both looked around near the temple but we didn't find anything.
translation: 伊万说他整天都能听到，但通常是在非常安静的时候。我们俩都在神庙附近找过，但什么也没发现。

english: We were both a bit nervous about going any further west than the steps.
translation: 我们俩都有点不敢往台阶以西走太远。

english: Do you think the noises could have come from beyond the steps? I mean, from further west?
translation: 你觉得声音会不会是从台阶那边传来的？我是说，更西边？

english: It's certainly possible and more than likely. I'd be grateful if you could extend your search as wide as you can.
translation: 当然有可能，而且很有可能。如果你能尽可能扩大搜索范围，我会很感激的。

english: Did you hear the noises as well?
translation: 你也听到那些声音了吗？

english: I must confess, I have heard some strange things around here recently. Like hushed voices.
translation: 我必须承认，我最近在这里也听到了一些奇怪的声音。像是压低了的说话声。

english: So, maybe Ivan was whispering to you?
translation: 那么，也许是伊万在对你耳语？

english: They didn't sound human!
translation: 那声音不像人类！

english: Right! That's different! What did they sound like?
translation: 好吧！那就不一样了！听起来像什么？

english: Very gruff. almost animal-like in fact.
translation: 非常粗哑，实际上几乎像动物一样。

english: Hmmm, never fear, [player name] is here! I'll work this out Drezel, don't you worry!
translation: 嗯，别怕，[player name]来了！我会查清楚的，德雷泽尔，别担心！

english: Has anyone seen or reported anything unusual?
translation: 有没有人看到或报告过什么异常情况？

english: Unfortunately, they have. Several people have gone missing from the local limestone mining area.
translation: 不幸的是，确实如此。当地石灰石开采区有几个人失踪了。

english: Other locals have reported seeing shadowy figures in the Silvaria pass. Could just be an enterprising, though perhaps ruthless, bunch of brigands. If it is, simply give them a taste of Misthalin law and order.
translation: 其他当地人报告说在希尔瓦里亚隘口看到了黑影。可能只是一群有进取心但也许残忍的匪徒。如果是这样，就让他们尝尝米斯塔林的法律和秩序。

english: And if it turns out to be more than that?
translation: 如果不止如此呢？

english: Well then, my friend, I will pray that Saradomin's blessings be upon you and that he guides your actions and keeps you safe from harm.
translation: 那么，我的朋友，我会祈祷萨拉多明的祝福降临在你身上，指引你的行动，保佑你平安。

english: How incredibly reassuring!
translation: 真是让人无比安心啊！

english: Don't take that tone with me! Saradomin's powers are not to be underestimated.
translation: 别用那种语气跟我说话！萨拉多明的力量不可小觑。

english: How is Ivan? Is he okay?
translation: 伊万怎么样了？他没事吧？

english: He's as well as can be expected considering the circumstances. He's a very confused young man at the moment what with the shadowy events that started his life.
translation: 考虑到情况，他已经算不错了。他现在是个非常困惑的年轻人，因为那些阴影般的事件开启了他的人生。

english: Both his parents died in the Sanguinesti region, though he still holds hope that they may be found alive.
translation: 他的父母都死在了血色地区，但他仍然希望他们可能还活着。

english: The death of Sani has really affected him as well. Like him, she was an orphan. They had a lot in common.
translation: 萨尼的死也对他影响很大。和他一样，她也是个孤儿。他们有很多共同点。

english: It's all so tragic. I wish there was something I could do for him.
translation: 这一切太悲惨了。我希望我能为他做点什么。

english: Well, you brought him here, which was very brave. He's very grateful to you. It's remarkable, really. He has this inner calmness that I find so very affecting.
translation: 嗯，你把他带到这里来，这非常勇敢。他非常感激你。这真的很了不起。他有一种内在的平静，让我深受感动。

english: His studies go well and he has Saradomin's blessings, it's clear to see. I would see him as a worthy successor as protector of Paterdomus. When all of his teachings are done, naturally.
translation: 他的学业进展顺利，而且很明显他得到了萨拉多明的祝福。我认为他将来可以成为帕特多穆斯守护者的合格继承人。当然，是在他完成所有教导之后。

english: Sorry, Drezel, what did you want me to do again?
translation: 抱歉，德雷泽尔，你刚才要我做什么来着？

english: I told you to hide it properly!
translation: 我告诉过你要把它藏好！

english: Not to worry! Now we've got more!
translation: 别担心！现在我们有了更多！

english: Nah, we can't take her. It'll look suspicious.
translation: 不，我们不能带她走。会显得可疑。

english: Let's go! Have you got the tithe?
translation: 我们走！你拿到贡品了吗？

english: Ouch! My poor head!
translation: 哎哟！我可怜的脑袋！

english: You've returned already?
translation: 你已经回来了？

english: Yes. And I have some news!
translation: 是的。而且我有消息！

english: I was attacked near the temple! On the other side of the Salve!
translation: 我在神庙附近被袭击了！在萨尔维河的另一边！

english: Attacked by who?
translation: 被谁袭击了？

english: By beasts! From Morytania, I believe. Perhaps werewolves.
translation: 被野兽！我想是从莫利塔尼亚来的。也许是狼人。

english: The vampyres must be behind this! Did you speak with Roald yet? We need his support if we are to end this suffering.
translation: 吸血鬼一定在背后搞鬼！你和罗尔德谈过了吗？如果我们想结束这场苦难，就需要他的支持。

english: Not yet, I'm afraid. I thought you would want to know about the werewolves as soon as possible.
translation: 恐怕还没有。我以为你会想尽快知道狼人的事。

english: It's good of you to return with this information, but we need to know Roald's answer before we can make any further plans.
translation: 你带回这个消息很好，但我们需要知道罗尔德的答复才能制定进一步计划。

english: Hello, [playername]. Did you find anything out nearby?
translation: 你好，[playername]。你在附近发现什么了吗？

english: Perhaps a bit too much!
translation: 也许发现得太多了！

english: How do you mean, [playername]?
translation: 你这是什么意思，[playername]？

english: I was attacked from behind!
translation: 我从背后被袭击了！

english: Did you see the assailants?
translation: 你看到袭击者了吗？

english: Not clearly, but I believe they could have been werewolves.
translation: 没看清楚，但我认为可能是狼人。

english: This is terrible, terrible news! They have found a way to get across the Salve!
translation: 这太可怕了，太可怕了！他们找到了渡过萨尔维河的方法！

english: I know, it's very worrying.
translation: 我知道，这非常令人担忧。

english: I must make immediate preparations and meet with other members of my order. You must hurry directly to King Roald and impart this information to him.
translation: 我必须立即做准备，与教团的其他成员会面。你必须赶紧直接去找罗尔德国王，把这条信息告诉他。

english: Here, take these runes. They should help you to return to Varrock faster.
translation: 拿着这些符文。它们应该能帮你更快地回到维洛克城。

english: Very well, I'll make my way to Varrock and bid you good luck.
translation: 好吧，我这就去维洛克城，祝你好运。

english: Likewise, [playername].
translation: 也祝你好运，[playername]。

english: Hello, [playername]. Have you been to Varrock yet?
translation: 你好，[playername]。你去过维洛克城了吗？

english: Not yet, sorry. What should I do again?
translation: 还没有，抱歉。我该做什么来着？

english: You need to warn King Roald about possible incursions into Misthalin from Morytania.
translation: 你需要警告罗尔德国王，莫利塔尼亚可能入侵米斯塔林。

english: Ah yes, quite right. Thanks for reminding me.
translation: 啊，是的，非常正确。谢谢你提醒我。

english: Certainly. What seems to be the problem?
translation: 当然。有什么问题吗？

english: I've witnessed a great many terrible things happening in Morytania, some of which could be happening in Misthalin before long!
translation: 我目睹了莫利塔尼亚发生的许多可怕的事情，其中一些很快也可能发生在米斯塔林！

english: This sounds pretty grave, please go on.
translation: 这听起来相当严重，请继续说。

english: I have been helping a collection of brave freedom fighters called the Myreque for some time now. They've been fighting against the vampyres and their ruler, Lowerniel Drakan.
translation: 我一直在帮助一群勇敢的自由斗士，他们叫迈雷克，已经有一段时间了。他们一直在与吸血鬼及其统治者洛厄尼尔.德雷坎作战。

english: We're all too aware of Drakan and his vampyres. What risk do they pose to Misthalin though?
translation: 我们对德雷坎和他的吸血鬼再清楚不过了。但他们给米斯塔林带来了什么风险呢？

english: In Morytania, Drakan and his kin farm humans for their blood! People, my lord, like your own loyal subjects!
translation: 在莫利塔尼亚，德雷坎和他的同类像养殖一样收割人类的血！陛下，那可是像您自己忠诚的子民一样的人啊！

english: It's not just the citizens of Morytania at risk though. It seems that werewolves have been kidnapping people from this side of the Salve to be used as blood tithes for the vampyres!
translation: 不过，面临风险的不仅仅是莫利塔尼亚的市民。似乎狼人一直在从萨尔维河这边绑架人，作为献给吸血鬼的血税！

english: This is awful! Yes, yes of course, we must do something!
translation: 这太可怕了！是的，当然，我们必须做点什么！

english: I would beg my lord not to give in so easily to his very compassionate nature. We know not if these people are loyal Saradomin supporters, my liege.
translation: 我恳请陛下不要轻易屈从于您那非常富有同情心的天性。我们不知道这些人是否是忠诚的萨拉多明支持者，陛下。
