english: Oh yes, we need to consider that as well. You're right of course, Aeonisig. Do you know if these people follow Saradomin?
translation: 哦对，我们还需要考虑这一点。你说得当然对，埃奥尼西格。你知道这些人是否信奉萨拉多明吗？

english: I am not certain, but surely this isn't the issue? They are in dire need...
translation: 我不确定，但这肯定不是问题所在吧？他们急需帮助……

english: As are many, my young friend. Is the king meant to leave Misthalin unguarded on the whim of some errant adventurer?
translation: 很多人也都是如此，我的小朋友。国王难道要因为某个流浪冒险者的一时兴起就让米斯塔林无人守卫吗？

english: But you don't understand! It's not just about the people of Morytania. Like I say, there were werewolves in Misthalin!
translation: 但你不明白！这不只是关于莫利塔尼亚的人民。就像我说的，米斯塔林出现了狼人！

english: I dare say you gave fight and slaughtered the foul beasts where they stood!
translation: 我敢说你奋勇作战，当场屠杀了那些肮脏的野兽！

english: I'm sad to say that I did not. I had no chance. I was knocked unconscious before I could properly react. Please, Misthalin must come to the aid of the people of Morytania.
translation: 很遗憾，我没有。我没有机会。还没来得及反应就被打昏了。求求您，米斯塔林必须援助莫利塔尼亚的人民。

english: The Myreque cannot fight this battle against the vampyres by themselves!
translation: 迈雷克无法独自对抗吸血鬼！

english: Yes, yes! I will ready my army and prepare to enter Morytania via Paterdomus. Morytania has for too long threatened the borders of Misthalin.
translation: 是的，是的！我会集结我的军队，准备经由佩特多莫斯进入莫利塔尼亚。莫利塔尼亚威胁米斯塔林边境太久了。

english: My lord, this course of action will lead to very severe consequences! Your interference in Morytania will likely upset the balance and could send the world into another cataclysmic God War.
translation: 陛下，这一行动方针将导致非常严重的后果！您对莫利塔尼亚的干涉很可能会打破平衡，并可能使世界陷入另一场灾难性的神战。

english: But Drakan has invaded Misthalin! I must respond!
translation: 但德雷坎已经入侵了米斯塔林！我必须回应！

english: There is no proof that Drakan has invaded Misthalin, my lord!
translation: 没有证据表明德雷坎入侵了米斯塔林，陛下！

english: Yes there is! I saw it with my own eyes!
translation: 有！我亲眼所见！

english: Being knocked out by agents unknown does not constitute evidence. In fact, it's something that the most inexperienced of local folk could accomplish!
translation: 被不明人士打昏不算证据。事实上，这事连最没经验的本地人都能做到！

english: But I can't just stand here and do nothing, Aeonisig! I must try to help if I can.
translation: 但我不能只是站在这里什么都不做，埃奥尼西格！我必须尽力帮忙。

english: I am afraid with the Guthixian edicts regarding religious balance, there is little else we can do.
translation: 恐怕由于关于宗教平衡的古斯法令，我们无能为力了。

english: Guthixian edicts?
translation: 古斯法令？

english: Indeed. They were put in place by Guthix himself at the end of the God Wars. At least, so his followers claim. All of us must abide by them, lest the world fall into ruin again.
translation: 确实如此。它们是由古斯本人在神战结束时设立的。至少，他的追随者是这么声称的。我们都必须遵守它们，以免世界再次陷入毁灭。

english: What a load of tosh!
translation: 一派胡言！

english: An apt description, my lord. The edicts are likely to be little more than propaganda created by the followers of Guthix.
translation: 形容得贴切，陛下。这些法令很可能不过是古斯追随者制造的宣传罢了。

english: Well then what's the issue?
translation: 那问题出在哪里？

english: The edicts need closer study before we can be sure.
translation: 在确定之前，我们需要对这些法令进行更仔细的研究。

english: But that will take ages, we need to act now!
translation: 但那需要很长时间，我们现在就需要行动！

english: As you say, it will take some time. We now pay the price for our lack of foresight in letting Guthixian edicts restrict the might of Saradomin's will.
translation: 正如你所说，这需要一些时间。我们现在正在为我们缺乏远见、让古斯法令限制了萨拉多明意志的力量而付出代价。

english: Yes, yes, but we can start to make amends for that now, can't we?
translation: 是的，是的，但我们现在就可以开始弥补这一点，不是吗？

english: Yes sire, there are some papers to sign, but essentially we can start work on this right away.
translation: 是的，陛下，有一些文件需要签署，但基本上我们可以立即开始这项工作。

english: Signing papers! Is that the sum of the aid that Misthalin can provide to Morytania?
translation: 签署文件！这就是米斯塔林能给莫利塔尼亚提供的全部援助吗？

english: Hold your disrespectful tongue! How dare you address the king in that way? We should throw you in the stocks!
translation: 收起你不敬的舌头！你竟敢这样对国王说话？我们应该把你关进刑枷！

english: I am sorry, but Aeonisig is my advisor, and what he says, while it pains me, is the truth. However, I will enact a mercenary protocol.
translation: 我很抱歉，但埃奥尼西格是我的顾问，他所说的虽然让我痛心，却是事实。不过，我将启动一项雇佣兵协议。

english: This will allow all able-bodied men to fight in the defence of Misthalin for glory and spoils. You will find that many sword arms from Misthalin should soon join the resistance force.
translation: 这将允许所有体格健全的人为荣耀和战利品而战，保卫米斯特林。你会发现米斯特林许多剑术好手很快就会加入抵抗力量。

english: In the meantime, we will look into the Guthixian edicts and find a way to rid ourselves of Drakan for good.
translation: 与此同时，我们会研究古斯法令，并找到办法永远摆脱德雷坎。

english: That is for you to decide, but I would assume that you'd want to report back to your comrades in Morytania.
translation: 这由你决定，但我想你会想向你在莫利塔尼亚的同志们报告。

english: If they're relying on support from Misthalin, you'll need to let them know that it might take some time before that happens.
translation: 如果他们指望米斯塔林的支持，你需要让他们知道那可能需要一些时间。

english: So I came all this way for nothing?
translation: 所以我大老远跑来一无所获？

english: Is it nothing then to have an audience with the king? Your lack of respect astonishes me. How you have survived so long with such disgraceful manners is nothing short of a miracle!
translation: 那与国王会面就毫无价值吗？你的无礼令我震惊。你以如此可耻的举止能活这么久简直是个奇迹！

english: Sorry. I had just hoped for so much more.
translation: 抱歉。我只是希望得到更多。

english: Well then, I must try to do something to satisfy you. I will have my advisor Aeonisig teleport you to Paterdomus so that you are more quickly on your way. Will you accept my offer?
translation: 那么，我必须做点什么来让你满意。我会让我的顾问埃奥尼西格把你传送到佩特多莫斯，这样你就能更快上路。你接受我的提议吗？

english: Yes thanks. I'll accept the free teleport.
translation: 好的，谢谢。我接受免费传送。

english: Very good. My advisor, Aeonisig, will teleport you back. The best of luck to you.
translation: 很好。我的顾问埃奥尼西格会把你传送回去。祝你好运。

english: Prepare yourself for teleport!
translation: 准备传送！

english: No thanks. I've other things to do here.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我在这里还有别的事。

english: Why can't you send troops to Morytania?
translation: 为什么你不能派兵去莫利塔尼亚？

english: The Guthixian edicts supposedly exist to ensure a balance is kept when it comes to religious and spiritual beliefs in the world. At the moment, things are considered to be in balance.
translation: 古斯法令据称是为了确保世界上宗教和精神信仰的平衡而存在的。目前，情况被认为是平衡的。

english: Misthalin is a Saradominist region, but Morytania is filled with creatures of Zamorak. A war between our two regions would be considered a war between Saradomin and Zamorak.
translation: 米斯塔林是萨拉多明教区域，但莫利塔尼亚充满了扎莫拉克的生物。我们两个地区之间的战争将被视为萨拉多明与扎莫拉克之间的战争。

english: If I send troops to Morytania, there is risk that the balance will be disrupted. Many followers of Guthix are apparently bound by oath to fight to keep the balance.
translation: 如果我派兵去莫利塔尼亚，就有可能破坏平衡。许多古斯的追随者显然宣誓要战斗以维持平衡。

english: It is said that when all three sides are joined in war, Guthix will 'reawaken and remake the world without mercy for the pain of beast or man.'
translation: 据说当三方都卷入战争时，古斯会“重新觉醒，毫无怜悯地重塑世界，不顾野兽或人类的痛苦。”

english: Is that really true?
translation: 这真的吗？

english: Personally, I don't think so. However, Aeonisig does not feel we should risk it until we can do further research on the Guthixian edicts.
translation: 就我个人而言，我不这么认为。然而，埃奥尼西格认为在我们对古斯法令进行进一步研究之前，我们不应该冒这个风险。

english: What is a mercenary protocol?
translation: 什么是雇佣兵协议？

english: It means that people can fight with the blessings of the king in defence of the kingdom.
translation: 这意味着人们可以在国王的祝福下为保卫王国而战。

english: Normally, if a force is amassed, they may be considered a threat to Misthalin's national security. We'd have to send the army to disband them.
translation: 通常情况下，如果一股力量聚集起来，他们可能会被视为对米斯塔林国家安全的威胁。我们就得派军队去解散他们。

english: However, a mercenary protocol allows a group to form a mercenary company. They are allowed certain rights so long as they operate within the law.
translation: 然而，雇佣兵协议允许一群人组成一个雇佣兵公司。只要他们在法律范围内运作，他们就被允许享有某些权利。

english: The Guthixian edicts prevent us from doing too much at this point, but this situation in Morytania requires some action. Unfortunately, this is the best thing I can think of at the moment.
translation: 古斯法令目前阻止我们做太多事，但莫利塔尼亚的局势需要采取一些行动。不幸的是，这是我现在能想到的最好办法。

english: When can you send aid to Morytania?
translation: 你什么时候能向莫利塔尼亚派遣援助？

english: It depends on how long it takes the Church of Saradomin to read through the Guthixian edicts and return with an answer on how to proceed.
translation: 这取决于萨拉多明教会需要多长时间通读古斯法令并给出如何进行的答案。

english: What part does Guthix play in all this?
translation: 古斯在这其中扮演什么角色？

english: Guthixian edicts rule over those of all other religions. Many followers of Guthix claim that the edicts have largely controlled the peace that Misthalin has experienced for so many years.
translation: 古斯法令统治着所有其他宗教。许多古斯的追随者声称，这些法令在很大程度上控制了米斯塔林多年来所经历的和平。

english: Apparently, some followers of Guthix have sworn an oath to perform ceremonies to try and re-awaken Guthix if the edicts are broken.
translation: 显然，一些古斯的追随者宣誓，如果法令被打破，他们将举行仪式试图重新唤醒古斯。

english: They say that peace and tolerance are needed to maintain the balance. I've no doubt it's all a load of rubbish, but we can't proceed until we are sure.
translation: 他们说和平与宽容是维持平衡所必需的。我毫不怀疑这全是胡说八道，但在我们确定之前不能行动。

english: Does your offer of a teleport still stand?
translation: 你的传送提议还有效吗？

english: Certainly, are you ready now?
translation: 当然，你现在准备好了吗？

english: I'd like to ask a few questions if I may?
translation: 如果可以的话，我想问几个问题？

english: Certainly, go ahead.
translation: 当然，请讲。

english: Hello, [player name]. Have you been to Varrock yet?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你去过维洛克城了吗？

english: I have. King Roald isn't able to send troops for our fight against the Drakans. Apparently, some Guthixian edicts need to be scrutinised in more detail or else the balance will be affected?
translation: 去过了。罗尔德国王无法派兵支援我们对德雷坎家族的战斗。显然，一些古斯法令需要更仔细地审查，否则平衡会受到影响？

english: Oh dear! I once did some studying of the edicts. I can see why the king and his advisors are cautious.
translation: 哦天哪！我曾经研究过这些法令。我能理解为什么国王和他的顾问们很谨慎。

english: The Myreque will need to know all that you have experienced so far. You should report to Veliaf when you can.
translation: 迈雷克需要知道你所经历的一切。你应该尽快向维利亚夫报告。

english: Can you explain a little about the Guthixian edicts?
translation: 你能解释一下古斯法令吗？

english: Well, only a little. The followers of Guthix make all sorts of wild claims where he is involved. Those of us who serve Saradomin know that these claims are mostly baseless.
translation: 嗯，只能解释一点。古斯的追随者在他涉及的地方做出各种荒谬的说法。我们这些侍奉萨拉多明的人知道这些说法大多毫无根据。

english: What we do know is that Guthix is a god of nature and balance. We believe him to be of average power. Enough to pay attention to, but nothing compared to the strength of Saradomin.
translation: 我们所知道的是古斯是自然与平衡之神。我们相信他的力量一般。值得关注，但无法与萨拉多明的力量相比。

english: It is said that long ago, back when the gods walked these lands with us, a great war was fought called the God Wars.
translation: 据说很久以前，当众神与我们同行在这些土地上时，一场名为神战的大战爆发了。

english: The stories say the war lasted for thousands of years and that the carnage saw the world forever changed.
translation: 故事说战争持续了数千年，大屠杀使世界永远改变了。

english: The followers of Guthix claim that this war ended when Guthix awoke from his slumber and banished the other gods, leaving the world to mortals.
translation: 古斯的追随者声称这场战争在古斯从沉睡中醒来并驱逐其他众神、将世界留给凡人时结束。

english: This is likely not the true version of events. Guthixians also claim that it was Guthix himself who made the world. Obviously, that is not correct.
translation: 这很可能不是事件的真实版本。古斯教徒还声称是世界是古斯本人创造的。显然，那是不正确的。

english: So where do these edicts come in?
translation: 那么这些法令在何处发挥作用？

english: They were apparently created at the end of the God Wars to ensure that the world never sees a conflict like that again.
translation: 它们显然是在神战结束时创建的，以确保世界再也不会看到那样的冲突。

english: The edicts state that no single god should be allowed to gain enough power to become dominant. Instead, a balance must be kept between the gods and their servants.
translation: 法令规定不应允许任何一个神获得足够的力量成为主宰。相反，必须在众神及其仆人之间保持平衡。

english: If the balance is not kept, the followers of Guthix will try to intervene. If they are unable to restore balance, they will supposedly awaken Guthix from his slumber beneath the earth.
translation: 如果不保持平衡，古斯的追随者会试图干预。如果他们无法恢复平衡，据称他们将唤醒沉睡在地底的古斯。

english: Once he awakens, they say he will remake the world, destroying civilisation as we know it.
translation: 一旦他苏醒，他们说他将重塑世界，摧毁我们所知的文明。

english: It's just a story of course. All made up by the Guthixians to help them feel relevant.
translation: 当然，这只是个故事。全是古斯教徒编造的，让他们觉得自己很重要。

english: But if the edicts are just made up, what's the risk?
translation: 但如果法令只是编造的，那有什么风险？

english: Well when there's threats of the world being remade, you can't be too careful. It is wise to be cautious. After all, wisdom is one of Saradomin's greatest strengths.
translation: 嗯，当有世界被重塑的威胁时，你再小心也不为过。谨慎是明智的。毕竟，智慧是萨拉多明最伟大的力量之一。

english: When a guide arrives, I will aid the mercenary by holding their wealth for their eventual return. The mercenary will repay the guide by giving him a token for items which I am holding.
translation: 当向导到来时，我将通过保管他们的财富来帮助雇佣兵，以备他们最终归来。雇佣兵会给我一个代表我所保管物品的代币来回报向导。

english: When a guide arrives, I will aid the mercenary by holding their wealth for their eventual return. The mercenary will repay the guide by giving her a token for items which I am holding.
translation: 当向导到达时，我会帮助雇佣兵保管他们的财富，以备他们最终归来。雇佣兵会通过给向导一个代币来回报她，用于领取我保管的物品。

english: No need dear boy. You can do that yourself.
translation: 不必了，亲爱的孩子。你自己就能做到。

english: No need dear girl. You can do that yourself.
translation: 不必了，亲爱的姑娘。你自己就能做到。

english: Hello there. What should I do now?
translation: 你好。我现在该怎么办？

english: Myreque prevail, [player name]. You should have a chat with Safalaan. He may be able to help you.
translation: 迈雷克必胜，[player name]。你应该和萨法拉安谈谈。他也许能帮你。

english: Hello, Veliaf. I have some news for you.
translation: 你好，维利亚夫。我有消息要告诉你。

english: King Roald cannot send troops! I talked to him at great length and was unable to persuade him. His Saradominist advisor cited Guthixian edicts as the reason for not sending aid.
translation: 罗尔德国王不能派兵！我和他谈了很长时间，没能说服他。他的萨拉多明教顾问以古斯法令为理由拒绝提供援助。

english: Guthixian edicts? How do they prevent Roald from sending troops?
translation: 古斯法令？它们如何阻止罗阿尔德派兵？

english: Apparently a war in Morytania will risk disturbing the balance between Saradomin and Zamorak so the Guthixians will need to intervene.
translation: 显然，在莫利塔尼亚的一场战争会冒着破坏萨拉多明和萨莫拉克之间平衡的风险，所以古斯教徒需要干预。

english: The Church of Saradomin is looking into it now to see if it's true.
translation: 萨拉多明教会正在调查这件事，看是否属实。

english: There has long been a desire by the Church of Saradomin to see Guthixian power eroded away. This stinks of politics. They're just using the situation here for their own gain!
translation: 萨拉多明教会长期以来一直渴望看到古斯的权力被削弱。这充满了政治味道。他们只是在利用这里的情况谋取私利！

english: Roald did agree to enact a mercenary protocol. He said it was the best he could offer for the moment without contravening the Guthixian edicts.
translation: 罗尔德确实同意启动一个雇佣兵协议。他说这是他在不违反古斯教令的前提下目前能提供的最佳方案。

english: Well that's something I guess. Not exactly what we were hoping for though.
translation: 我想这总算是点东西吧。不过跟我们期望的差远了。

english: What should we do now? There must be someone else we can turn to?
translation: 我们现在该怎么办？一定还有其他人可以求助吧？

english: We must inform the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque of these events. Please go as fast as you can back to the Meiyerditch hideout and forward this information to them.
translation: 我们必须把这些事告知迈雷克的桑圭内斯蒂教团。请尽快赶回迈尔迪奇的藏身处，把这一情报转达给他们。

english: We must inform the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque of what we have learnt. Please go as fast as you can back to the Meiyerditch hideout and forward this information to them.
translation: 我们必须把了解到的情况告知迈雷克的桑圭内斯蒂教团。请尽快赶回迈尔迪奇的藏身处，把这一情报转达给他们。

english: I have a message from Veliaf. It's bad news I'm afraid. I was sent on a mission to Misthalin to seek help from King Roald. Sadly, he isn't able to offer much support.
translation: 我带来了维利亚夫的口信。恐怕不是什么好消息。我奉命前往米斯林寻求罗尔德国王的帮助，可惜他无法提供太多支援。

english: That's not all though. On my way to Varrock, I came across some beasts on the other side of the River Salve! I think they were werewolves working for the vampyres.
translation: 但这还不是全部。在前往维洛克城的路上，我在救赎河对岸遇到了一些野兽！我觉得它们是给吸血鬼效力的狼人。

english: This is disastrous! Things seem to go from bad to worse! You will have to communicate this information to our leader, Safalaan. He needs to know as soon as possible.
translation: 这太糟了！情况似乎越来越坏！你必须把这个消息传达给我们的领袖萨法拉恩。他需要尽快知道。

english: Where is Safalaan and what does he look like?
translation: 萨法拉恩在哪里？他长什么样？

english: He's out on a mission sketching Castle Drakan. He's taken the wall route so you'll need to do the same.
translation: 他出去执行任务了，正在绘制德拉肯城堡的草图。他走的是城墙路线，所以你也得走那条路。

english: There is a barricade that prevents further travel north. It's located under the wall. You'll need to search the wall southeast of the barricade to release the lock on the door.
translation: 前方有一个路障挡住了往北的路。它在城墙底下。你需要搜索路障东南方的一堵墙，才能打开门上的锁。

english: Okay, great, that's helpful. Now, how can I recognise Safalaan?
translation: 好的，太好了，这很有帮助。那我怎么认出萨法拉恩呢？

english: He's very distinctive. It shouldn't be a problem trying to find him if you know where to look, and you've got a good set of eyes on you!
translation: 他很有特点。如果你知道该去哪里找，再加上你的好眼力，认出他应该不成问题！

english: Anyway, I need to head towards the wall myself now, so you can come with me. It'll be quicker than going back on your own.
translation: 总之，我现在也要往城墙那边去，你可以跟我一起走。这比你一个人回去快多了。

english: Okay, lead the way.
translation: 好，带路吧。

english: I'll make my own way.
translation: 我自己走。

english: Hello there. What do I need to do now?
translation: 你好。我现在需要做什么？

english: You need to report to our leader, Safalaan. He's out on a mission sketching Castle Drakan. He's taken the wall route so you'll need to do the same.
translation: 你需要向我们的领袖萨法拉恩汇报。他出去执行任务了，正在绘制德拉肯城堡的草图。他走的是城墙路线，所以你也得走那条路。

english: Okay, great, that's helpful. How can I recognise Safalaan?
translation: 好的，太好了，这很有帮助。我怎么认出萨法拉恩呢？

english: You must be Safalaan. My name is [player name]. I come with a very important message from Vertida.
translation: 你一定是萨法拉恩吧。我叫[player name]。我从维尔蒂达那里带来了一个非常重要的口信。

english: Vertida, eh? What makes you think I know a Vertida?
translation: 维尔蒂达，嗯？你怎么觉得我认识维尔蒂达？

english: He's asked me to come and seek you out. I'm working with Veliaf in Burgh de Rott.
translation: 他让我来找你。我在伯格德罗特镇和维利亚夫一起工作。

english: Ah, Veliaf! Myreque prevail! My friend, you're just the tonic for my otherwise dark mood. Tell me, what news comes from the west?
translation: 啊，维利亚夫！迈雷克万岁！朋友，你真是让我这个沉闷的心情一振。告诉我，西边有什么消息？

english: I went to see King Roald to request support in our fight. Unfortunately, his advisor reminded him that the Guthixian edicts prevent his intervention.
translation: 我去见了罗尔德国王，请求他支持我们的战斗。不幸的是，他的顾问提醒他古斯教令阻止了他介入。

english: Guthixian edicts? Sounds like excuses to me. I commend you on your efforts to rally support for our cause though.
translation: 古斯教令？听起来像是借口。不过我还是要赞扬你为我们的事业争取支持的努力。

english: I'm afraid that's not all. I was attacked by beasts on the western side of the Salve, near to Paterdomus. I think they were werewolves working for the vampyres.
translation: 恐怕还不止这些。我在救赎河西岸靠近帕特多莫斯的地方遭到了野兽的攻击。我觉得它们是给吸血鬼效力的狼人。

english: This is terrible! Surely the magical influence of the Salve should be preventing that? What if the vampyres are able to cross as well? Drakan could start a full onslaught!
translation: 这太糟糕了！救赎河的魔法影响难道不应该阻止这种情况吗？如果吸血鬼也能过河怎么办？德拉肯可能会发动全面进攻！

english: I must return to the base in order to discuss this information and work out what must be done.
translation: 我必须返回基地讨论这些信息，并确定下一步该怎么做。

english: Can I help in some way?
translation: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: Yes, you certainly can, my friend. I was on a mission to scout out this castle. I have yet to start, but please could you take over for me?
translation: 是的，你当然可以，我的朋友。我本来在执行侦察这座城堡的任务。我还没开始，但你能替我做吗？

english: I can certainly try! Are there any specific details I should know?
translation: 我当然可以试试！有什么具体细节我需要知道吗？

english: Indeed there are. We need sketches of the northern, western, and southern sides of the castle.
translation: 确实有。我们需要城堡北面、西面和南面的草图。

english: I've checked the vyrewatch flight patterns and I think you'll attract less attention if you make your way to the north and do that sketch first, then sketch the western side, and finally finish off here.
translation: 我检查了吸血鬼哨兵的飞行路线，我觉得如果你先往北去画那面的草图，然后画西面，最后在这里完成，能减少被注意的风险。

english: One of the others has already marked the best spots to sketch from. If you need some more papyrus, you can get some off Old Man Ral. He's helped us out once or twice before.
translation: 其中一个人已经标记了最佳的写生地点。如果你还需要更多莎草纸，你可以从老人拉尔那里拿一些。他以前帮过我们一两次。

english: Good luck, my friend. Return to the hideout when you have completed the sketches.
translation: 祝你好运，我的朋友。画完草图后回到藏身处。

english: We need some accurate plans of the castle. Please make some careful sketches starting from the north side, moving to the west and finishing off with a sketch from this view.
translation: 我们需要一些城堡的精确平面图。请仔细画几张草图，先从北面开始，再到西面，最后从这个角度完成。

english: One of the others has already placed some markers on the walls at the best vantage points.
translation: 其他人中有一个已经在最佳观测点的墙上放置了一些标记。

english: Safalaan said I could get some more papyrus from you.
translation: 萨法拉恩说我可以从你这里拿一些莎草纸。

english: Hmph, hmm, I suppose so, here you go.
translation: 哼，嗯，我想是吧，给你。

english: Hey! I didn't say you could go down there!
translation: 嘿！我可没允许你下去！

english: Hmph, typical! Come back when you have.
translation: 哼，果然如此！等你有了再来吧。

english: Hmph. Myreque, eh? Well, it'll take a lot to find them. It's not an easy route up to sector three, but that's where they are. You'll need to follow the symbols in order to get there. And now you should leave - I have
translation: 哼。迈雷克，嗯？要找到他们可不容易。去三区的路不好走，但他们就在那里。你得跟着那些符号才能到。现在你该走了——我

english: little tolerance for people and talking to you has tired me out.
translation: 不太能容忍别人，跟你说话已经让我累了。

english: Well met, [player name]. How goes it?
translation: 幸会，[player name]。情况如何？

english: Hello, Veliaf. I'm doing some work for the Sanguinesti Myreque.
translation: 你好，维利亚夫。我正在为桑圭内斯蒂的迈雷克做些工作。

english: Good. It seems like you're really proving your worth. Keep it up.
translation: 很好。看来你确实在证明自己的价值。继续努力。

english: Safalaan asked me to sketch the north side first.
translation: 萨法拉恩让我先画北面的草图。

english: What was I supposed to be doing?
translation: 我本来应该做什么来着？

english: We really need those sketches showing the plans of the castle. Use charcoal and papyrus in order to make the sketches. There are three sides to the castle that need to be sketched.
translation: 我们确实需要那些展示城堡平面图的草图。使用木炭和莎草纸来画。城堡有三个面需要画。

english: I need to make a sketch of the western face of the castle.
translation: 我需要画一张城堡西面的草图。

english: So yes, Lady Vanescula, we're getting maximum yield from the current rotation. And more tithes are coming in all the time.
translation: 是的，瓦内斯库拉女士，我们目前轮换的产量已经达到最大。而且收到的供奉也在不断增加。

english: Good, good! You seem to be well in control.
translation: 很好，很好！你似乎控制得很好。

english: If I remember, madam, I had little choice. You were quite... 'persuasive' the last time we met.
translation: 如果我没记错，女士，我没什么选择。上次我们见面时，您可是相当……“有说服力”。

english: Ha, ha, ha. Vanstrom, you do make me laugh.
translation: 哈哈哈。范斯特罗姆，你真是让我发笑。

english: Perhaps a light refreshment m'lady? This is from the fresh batch.
translation: 或许来点清淡的茶点，女士？这是新的一批。

english: Why, with these blood tithes you're really spoiling us!
translation: 哎呀，有了这些血之供奉，你们真是把我们宠坏了！

english: Visciously efficient as ever, Vanstrom! You never fail to please us.
translation: 一如既往地高效凶狠，范斯特罗姆！你从未让我们失望。

english: Mmm, delicious! Well, it's been lovely as usual, Vanstrom.
translation: 嗯，美味！好啦，和往常一样很高兴，范斯特罗姆。

english: But we really have to get on.
translation: 但我们真的得走了。

english: The same is true for me, m'lady.
translation: 我也一样，女士。

english: Sorry, but that item doesn't look genuine. I cannot accept it.
translation: 抱歉，但那件物品看起来不像是真的。我不能接受。

english: Ha! So we meet again, [player name]. Prepare to die!
translation: 哈！我们又见面了，[player name]。准备受死吧！

english: Sorry for the interruption, Lord Vanstrom, but Lady Vanescula 'requests' that this individual be questioned before being used as a punch bag.
translation: 抱歉打扰了，范斯特罗姆大人，但瓦内斯库拉女士“要求”在把这个家伙当沙包之前先审问一下。

english: I take no orders from food sacks like you, Guile. Attend to this yourself. In any case, [he/she] wasn't much of a punch bag anyway.
translation: 我可不听像你这样的饭桶的命令，吉尔。你自己处理吧。反正，他/她也不怎么经打。

english: Awaken! There are things for you to know.
translation: 醒来！有些事你得知道。

english: Your life may be forfeit but for now you live. My mistress will understand my motives. She has an interest in the one called Safalaan.
translation: 你的性命或许难保，但至少现在还活着。我的女主人会理解我的动机。她对那个叫萨法拉恩的人很感兴趣。

english: As a gesture for my intervening on your behalf, I'd take it as a kindness if you would deliver a message to him.
translation: 作为我替你周旋的表示，如果你能帮我带个口信给他，我会感激不尽。

english: The message you will find secreted behind tiles where smoke is carried away from the depiction of statuesque evil.
translation: 口信藏在瓷砖后面，那里烟雾从雕像般的邪恶描绘处被带走。

english: And now be away, but forget not the task that Safalaan set you! For why else would you be here?
translation: 现在走吧，但别忘了萨法拉恩交给你的任务！不然你在这里做什么？

english: Hey, I've finished at the castle.
translation: 嘿，我在城堡那边做完了。

english: Good work. Do you have the sketches then?
translation: 干得好。那你拿到草图了吗？

english: Err... No.
translation: 呃……没有。

english: Sounds like you're not finished after all then. Please return once you have the sketches.
translation: 听起来你还没做完嘛。拿到草图后再回来吧。

english: Hey, I've finished at the castle. It was a close one though. I was attacked by Vanstrom!
translation: 嘿，我在城堡那边做完了。不过真是千钧一发。我遭到了范斯特罗姆的攻击！

english: He came out of nowhere! I tried to fight back, but I just couldn't hurt him.
translation: 他突然冒出来！我试图还击，但根本伤不了他。

english: Brave, very brave. He didn't follow you here did he?
translation: 勇敢，非常勇敢。他没跟你到这里来吧？

english: No, I'm pretty sure I wasn't followed. So anyway, during the fight, Vanstrom knocked me to the floor and I thought I was done for. But then a woman named Sarius showed up.
translation: 不，我很确定没人跟踪我。总之，在战斗中，范斯特罗姆把我打倒在地，我以为我完了。但后来一个叫萨里乌斯的女人出现了。

english: Sarius? Vanescula Drakan's servant? Hmmm, interesting. Was Vanescula herself nearby?
translation: 萨里乌斯？范尼斯库拉.德雷坎的仆从？嗯，有意思。范尼斯库拉本人就在附近吗？

english: No, I saw Vanescula earlier, but when I saw Sarius arrive, Vanescula wasn't around. Sarius told Vanstrom that Vanescula wanted to interrogate me. So Vanstrom got angry and flew away.
translation: 不，我之前见过瓦内斯库拉，但萨里乌斯出现时，瓦内斯库拉并不在旁边。萨里乌斯告诉范斯特罗姆，说瓦内斯库拉想审问我。于是范斯特罗姆生气地飞走了。

english: Sarius then told me about a message which was meant for you. Something about 'smoke and statues'? She said that Vanescula was interested in you for some reason?
translation: 然后萨里乌斯告诉我有一个口信是要给你的。大概是关于“烟雾和雕像”之类的？她说瓦内斯库拉为了某种原因对你感兴趣？

english: Well, [player name], you certainly seem to have had a very close call. Thanks for letting me know all of this. It's all highly interesting.
translation: 好吧，[player name]，看来你真是死里逃生。谢谢你告诉我这一切。这都非常有趣。

english: Oh, and I almost forgot. Do you have the sketches?
translation: 哦，我差点忘了。你拿到草图了吗？

english: You have my gratitude, friend! Myreque prevail! I need to take a good look at these and see what we can learn.
translation: 你应得我的感激，朋友！迈雷克万岁！我得好好看看这些，看看我们能学到什么。

english: Hmm, good question. Didn't you mention something about Sarius and a message?
translation: 嗯，好问题。你不是提到过萨里乌斯和一条口信吗？

english: That's right. If I remember correctly, she said it was hidden 'behind tiles where smoke is carried away from the depiction of statuesque evil'.
translation: 藏在“雕像般的邪恶描绘处，烟雾被带走的瓷砖后面”

english: A riddle? Clearly she doesn't want the message to be easily found. I'd appreciate it if you could look into this further.
translation: 一个谜语？显然她不想让口信容易被发现。如果你能进一步调查这件事，我会很感激。

english: Hey, I've returned.
translation: 嘿，我回来了。

english: Ah yes. I have it here.
translation: 啊，是的。我这里有。

english: Hmm, interesting. This message gives details of some sort of laboratory. Maybe there is some information there which could help us.
translation: 嗯，有意思。这条口信提供了一些关于某个实验室的细节。也许那里有些信息能帮到我们。

english: We should keep an eye out for this place. In fact, it would be great if you could look for it for us. Keep the message. It may help you to locate the laboratory.
translation: 我们应该留意这个地方。事实上，如果你能帮我们找找就太好了。留着这条口信，它可能帮你找到实验室。

english: Well that message you brought me had some details regarding a laboratory. Maybe there is some information there which could help us.
translation: 你带给我的那条口信提到了一些关于实验室的细节。也许那里有些信息能帮到我们。

english: Where do you think this laboratory could be?
translation: 你觉得这个实验室可能在哪里？

english: It's a good question, but not one I have an answer for. The message seemed to have some hints though. If you get a chance could you look into this for us?
translation: 这是个好问题，但我没有答案。那条口信似乎有些暗示。如果你有机会，能帮我们调查一下吗？

english: Yes, you've shown me this before. It's an interesting message and it's really great that you found it. Please keep it so that it will help you to locate the laboratory.
translation: 是的，你之前给我看过了。这是一条有趣的口信，你找到它真是太好了。请留着它，它会帮你找到实验室。

english: Hey, I think I've found that laboratory.
translation: 嘿，我想我找到那个实验室了。

english: Is there anything of note there?
translation: 那里有什么值得注意的东西吗？

english: I haven't found anything yet.
translation: 我还没找到什么东西。

english: Well keep looking. There must be something there we can use.
translation: 继续找。那里一定有什么我们能用的东西。

english: Safalaan. I have something you might be interested in. I found it in the laboratory.
translation: 萨法拉恩。我有一件你可能会感兴趣的东西。我在实验室里找到的。

english: You've done well, [player name], very well indeed. I can't decipher much of it, but from what I can tell, this tome contains research notes on the vampyres' weaknesses.
translation: 你做得很好，[player name]，真的非常出色。我大部分看不懂，但据我所知，这卷书里写着关于吸血鬼弱点的研究笔记。

english: Well, whatever it is, someone went to a lot of trouble to try and hide it.
translation: 好吧，不管它是什么，有人费了很大劲想把它藏起来。

english: I can believe that, [player name]. Once again you have our gratitude. For my part, your arrival has not come soon enough. I have a feeling that your efforts in our struggle are not yet over.
translation: 我相信这一点，[player name]。你再次赢得了我们的感激。就我而言，你来得正是时候。我有种感觉，你在我们斗争中的努力还远未结束。

english: I for one would be grateful for your continued assistance. Together we can pull back the darkness of Hallowvale.
translation: 就我个人而言，如果你能继续帮忙，我会非常感激。团结起来，我们能驱散哈洛维尔的黑暗。

english: I'll do what I can, Safalaan. You have my support.
translation: 我会尽我所能，萨法拉恩。我支持你。

english: Then I must beg you for one more small task, to return to Veliaf with a message to advise him of what has transpired here.
translation: 那我必须再求你办一件小事，带个口信回去给维利亚夫，告诉他这里发生的事。

english: I realise that bearing messages seems somewhat lowly, but your ability to pass in and out of the city without being detected makes you perfect for this assignment.
translation: 我知道传话听起来有点低微，但你能在不被发现的情况下进出城市，这让你成为这项任务的最佳人选。

english: I also have some information which should help with your journeys through Meiyerditch. There are two doors, one is in sector one and the other is in sector two. You can use them to reach this hideout faster.
translation: 我还有一些信息，应该能帮你在迈尔迪奇穿行。有两扇门，一扇在第一区，另一扇在第二区。你可以用它们更快地到达这个藏身处。

english: Very well, I'll return to Veliaf. Farewell.
translation: 好吧，我这就回维利亚夫那里去。告辞。

english: Farewell and good luck, my friend!
translation: 告辞，祝你好运，我的朋友！

english: What should I do again?
translation: 我该再做什么来着？

english: Take the message that I gave you to Veliaf. He should be able to explain everything to you when you get there.
translation: 把我给你的口信带给维利亚夫。你到了那里，他应该会向你解释一切。

english: But I've lost that message. Can I have another one please?
translation: 但我把口信弄丢了。能再给我一份吗？

english: Well, okay, but please don't lose this one.
translation: 好吧，但请别再弄丢这份了。

english: Well met, [player name]. It's good to see you again.
translation: 幸会，[player name]。很高兴再次见到你。

english: I've spoken to Safalaan. He gave me a message to give to you but I've misplaced it!
translation: 我跟萨法拉恩谈过了。他给了我一份口信让我带给你，但我把它放错地方了！

english: Well, that's not particularly good is it? You'll have to go back and ask him if he can rewrite the message for you.
translation: 嗯，这可不太妙，对吧？你得回去找他，问问他能不能重新写一份口信给你。

english: I have a message for you from Safalaan.
translation: 我有一份萨法拉恩的口信要带给你。

english: Really? Well, let's see it then!
translation: 真的吗？那好，让我看看！

english: Well, it seems that you have more than proven yourself worthy, [player name]. Safalaan himself has recommended you for a promotion to the rank of a private within the Myreque!
translation: 嗯，看来你已经充分证明了自己的价值，[player name]。萨法拉恩本人推荐你晋升为迈雷克的一名列兵！

english: You've done well. I'd say you've earnt a break. Before you go though, here's a little something to thank you for your hard work.
translation: 你做得很好。我觉得你该休息一下了。不过在你走之前，这点小东西是感谢你辛勤工作的。

english: I've lost my Tome of Experience.
translation: 我把我的经验之书弄丢了。

english: Hmm, okay, let's see if I have another one for you... Ah, here we go!
translation: 嗯，好吧，让我看看我是否还有另一本给你……啊，找到了！

english: So, what's going to happen now?
translation: 那么，接下来会发生什么？

english: There's plenty of options for us to move forwards. We'll still keep up intelligence-gathering operations within the local area. We'll also keep looking for weaknesses in the vampyres' defences.
translation: 我们有很多前进的选择。我们会继续在当地进行情报收集行动。我们也会继续寻找吸血鬼防御中的弱点。

english: I'll probably have to meet up with Safalaan at some point, so we can discuss strategies. This war is far from over, [player name]. There's plenty of time to contribute so don't worry about that.
translation: 我可能得找个时间和萨法拉恩碰面，这样我们可以讨论策略。这场战争远未结束，[player name]。你还有很多时间可以贡献力量，所以不用担心。

english: Well you just let me know when you next need me.
translation: 那么，下次需要我的时候就告诉我一声。

english: Don't worry, we will. Myreque prevail.
translation: 别担心，我们会找你的。迈雷克必胜。

english: Good day! I don't suppose I could trouble you for the briefest of moments?
translation: 午安！我想我能否打扰你一小会儿？

english: I suppose I could consider being troubled for a little...
translation: 我想我可以考虑让你稍微麻烦一下……

english: Ah, on second thoughts, you may not be cut out for this job.
translation: 啊，再想想，你可能不适合这份工作。

english: Good day to you! I could consider being troubled, for the right reasons.
translation: 你好！我可以考虑麻烦一下，前提是理由正当。

english: How does access to a rather fancy party sound as a motivator?
translation: 用一个相当豪华的派对作为动力怎么样？

english: Well, just as long as I get to actually enjo-
translation: 嗯，只要我能真正享受——

english: I'm sure I can also rustle up some payment to encourange you, if you have any reservations.
translation: 如果你还有什么疑虑，我肯定还能凑出一些报酬来鼓励你。

english: You may even find some... exciting opportunities inside, given the presence of some of Aldarin's wealthiest citizens!
translation: 考虑到阿尔达林岛最富有的居民也会在场，你甚至可能在里面发现一些……激动人心的机会！

english: So if you're going to this party, would you also be one of Aldarin's wealthiest citizens?
translation: 所以如果你要去这个派对，你也是阿尔达林岛最富有的居民之一吗？

english: Alas, I am, quite unfortunately, not rich in money. What I do possess is a certain wealth...
translation: 唉，很不幸，我并不富有。我所拥有的是一种特殊的财富……

english: ... of talent! For you see I am... an actor! Patzi the Grand, they'll call me... eventually.
translation: ……才华！因为你看，我是个演员！人们会叫我伟大的帕齐……迟早的事。

english: They call me [player name]... just [player name]. So if you're not rich in money, how am I going to get paid, assuming I agree to help you with... whatever it is you want.
translation: 他们叫我[player name]……就只是[player name]。所以如果你不富有，那我怎么拿到报酬？假设我同意帮你做……不管你想要什么。

english: Cutting words, but you need not worry. While you won't be getting paid upfront, I have a feeling that if all goes well, I will soon find myself with more than enough wealth to handsomely reward you.
translation: 话虽刻薄，但你不用担心。虽然你不会提前拿到报酬，但我觉得如果一切顺利，我很快就会拥有足够的财富来好好酬谢你。

english: And besides, if nothing else, I'm sure you'll have a wonderful time at the party!
translation: 而且，就算别的都没有，我相信你一定会享受派对的！

english: I suppose I could do with letting my hair down a little. Alright, I'm in.
translation: 我想我可以稍微放松一下。好吧，我加入。

english: So whose party are we going to?
translation: 那我们要去谁的派对？

english: Well, that's complicated...
translation: 嗯，这有点复杂……

english: You don't know?
translation: 你不知道？

english: Sometimes a man has to follow his heart... and a second hand invitation saying there's a party at Villa Lucens tonight.
translation: 有时候一个人必须追随内心……以及一张二手邀请函，说今晚卢森斯别墅有个派对。

english: Villa Lucens?
translation: 卢森斯别墅？

english: Yes! The villa is home to an almighty patron of the arts! He even has his own theatre atop the cliffs behind the villa! In fact, the whole reason for this party is because he's showing his new play!
translation: 是的！这栋别墅住着一位艺术界的伟大赞助人！他甚至在别墅后面的悬崖顶上拥有自己的剧院！事实上，这次派对就是为了展示他的新剧！

english: And yet you don't actually know who he is?
translation: 可你却不知道他是谁？

english: This opportunity came about quite suddenly. As such, I'm unfortunately not as prepared as I otherwise would be. However, an actor like myself can't turn down the chance to meet with a man like him.
translation: 这个机会来得太突然。因此，不幸的是我没有像平时那样准备充分。不过，像我这样的演员不能拒绝与这样的人见面的机会。

english: Not to mention the chance to enjoy a good party.
translation: 更别提还能享受一个好派对了。

english: Well said, Adala. Oh that reminds me, [player name], this is Adala. She's also helping me out today!
translation: 说得好，阿达拉。 哦，提醒了我，[player name]，这位是阿达拉。她今天也来帮我！

english: If you have her, why do you need me?
translation: 有她在，为什么还需要我？

english: She advertised herself as a bag carrier, so she's here to move my bag around. There's a lot of costumes and props that I travel with, so it's nice to have someone else carry them.
translation: 她自称是行李搬运工，所以来帮我搬行李。我出行会带很多服装和道具，有别人帮忙搬运挺好的。

english: I'm not going to say no to going to a fancy party, even as the help.
translation: 我不反对去一个豪华派对，即使只是帮工。

english: As for your part in all this, [player name], with this being a fancy party and all, I'm going to need a butler to help me fit in.
translation: 至于你在这件事中的角色，[player name]，既然这是个豪华派对，我需要一个管家来帮我融入。

english: A butler?
translation: 管家？

english: You know, serving me wine and tending to my needs. Fancy suit and all?
translation: 你知道的，给我倒酒、照料我的需求。还要穿着体面的西装？

english: Right... So I don't actually get to enjoy the party at all, do I?
translation: 好吧……所以我实际上根本不能享受派对了，对吧？

english: Oh I'm sure you will. You'll just have to act a little here and there!
translation: 哦，我相信你会享受的。你只需要偶尔表演一下！

english: I see... You mentioned a fancy suit. You wouldn't happen to have a butler outfit in that bag you mentioned?
translation: 我明白了……你提到了体面的西装。你那个行李袋里碰巧有管家制服吗？

english: I don't believe I do. I don't really take roles like that these days.
translation: 我想我没有。我现在不接那种角色了。

english: Well, in that case, any idea where I might get one, preferably free of charge?
translation: 好吧，那你知道我在哪里能弄到一套吗？最好是免费的。

english: Lots of the villas around here will have butlers, and butlers mean uniforms.
translation: 这附近很多别墅都有管家，有管家就有制服。

english: Are you suggesting I steal one?
translation: 你是建议我去偷一套？

english: I suppose you could always put it back once you're done.
translation: 我想你可以用完之后再放回去。

english: And I'm sure whoever I take it from will be overjoyed to have had someone else wearing their uniform.
translation: 而且我相信无论我从谁那里拿，他们都会很高兴有人穿过他们的制服。

english: Hmm... Maybe I should add a butler's uniform to my vast array of costumes after all.
translation: 嗯……也许我确实应该在我的大量戏服中添一套管家制服。

english: I doubt they'll ever even realise. Anyway, I remember seeing some uniforms through a window on the way over here. They were in a villa to the north.
translation: 我怀疑他们永远不会发现。总之，我记得来这里的路上透过一扇窗户看到了一些制服。在北边的一栋别墅里。

english: Right... I guess I'm off to find a uniform then.
translation: 好吧……那我大概得去找制服了。

english: I'm not really a party person these days, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我现在不太喜欢参加派对。

english: Quite unfortunate. In that case, please make sure to keep an eye out for me at your local theatre. I'll be a star soon!
translation: 真可惜。那样的话，请务必在你当地的剧院留意我。我很快就会成为明星！

english: Hello again! Are you feeling more in the partying spirit now?
translation: 又见面了！现在你更有聚会的心情了吗？

english: How's the costume hunt going?
translation: 服装找得怎么样了？

english: If I'm going to be working, shouldn't we be calling it a uniform?
translation: 如果我要工作，难道不应该叫制服吗？

english: Yes, I suppose so! Either way, Adala should be able to help you get your hands on one.
translation: 是的，我想是的！不管怎样，阿达拉应该能帮你弄到一套。

english: Any luck finding that villa with the spare uniforms in yet?
translation: 找到那栋有备用制服的别墅了吗？

english: Not quite. You said it was to the north of here?
translation: 还没有。你说是从这里往北？

english: I believe so. Once you get there, you should keep an eye out for any guards. Wouldn't want you to get arrested before the party starts!
translation: 我想是的。到了之后你应该留意任何守卫。可不想在派对开始前就被逮捕！

english: This person has a lot of uniforms, but I shouldn't take more than I need.
translation: 这个人有很多制服，但我不应该拿超出需要的量。

english: I see you've  managed to find a uniform.
translation: 看来你找到制服了。

english: I have indeed. You must have a good eye to have seen them  through a window as you walked by?
translation: 确实找到了。你真是好眼力，走路的时候透过窗户就看见了？

english: It was a bit of a lucky spot, I must admit!
translation: 我必须承认，那是有点幸运的发现！

english: Lucky indeed. It's almost like you were specifically looking for them?
translation: 确实幸运。就好像你专门在找它们似的？

english: Just good fortune. Now, I ought to get a move on getting this bag inside.
translation: 只是运气好。好了，我得赶紧把这包行李搬进去了。

english: Oh, she's in a rush, isn't she?
translation: 哦，她很着急，是吧？

english: Given the size of your bag, I'm not sure she's rushing anywhere.
translation: 鉴于你的行李包大小，我不确定她能赶去哪里。

english: Well, she sets a good example. You should probably be heading on in yourself.
translation: 她带了个好头。你也该进去了。

english: I'm guessing the entrance is just up these stairs?
translation: 我猜入口就在这些楼梯上面？

english: The guest entrance is yes...
translation: 宾客入口是的……

english: Don't tell me...
translation: 别告诉我……

english: You'll have to go in through the staff entrance, unfortunately. I can't be seen entering with the help.
translation: 不幸的是，你得从员工入口进去。我不能被人看到和帮手一起进去。

english: The help?
translation: 随从？

english: Sorry, just getting into character.
translation: 抱歉，只是在入戏。

english: You will have to use the staff entrance though.
translation: 不过你得使用员工入口。

english: Where would I find said entrance?
translation: 那个入口在哪里？

english: I'll bet Adala went through it. You should've followed her! I think she headed somewhere along that hedgerow.
translation: 我打赌阿达拉是从那儿进去的。你本该跟着她！我想她沿着那排树篱走了。

english: Where was that staff entrance that you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的那个员工入口在哪里？

english: I'm guessing Adala went through it. I think she headed somewhere along that hedgerow.
translation: 我猜阿达拉是从那儿进去的。我想她沿着那排树篱走了。

english: Sorry, entry here is for guests only.
translation: 抱歉，这里的入口只供宾客使用。

english: Oh yes, just give me a moment...
translation: 哦，好的，请稍等……

english: Nilsal to you.
translation: Nilsal 向你问好。

english: Hello there. I'm here to work.
translation: 你好。我是来工作的。

english: Not without a uniform you're not.
translation: 没有制服可不行。

english: Oh, nilsal, to you. I wasn't expecting anyone else.
translation: 哦，nilsal，也向你问好。我没料到还有别人来。

english: Sorry, there was a bit of a hold up. I'm quite new to this.
translation: 抱歉，耽搁了一下。我刚开始做这行。

english: A hold up? Nothing bad I hope? I've known people to have problems with their employers before. Is yours treating you well?
translation: 耽搁？希望不是什么坏事？我知道有人和雇主有过矛盾。你的雇主对你好吗？

english: He seems... friendly enough. I'm still not sure if I'm getting paid though.
translation: 他看起来……挺友好的。但我还不确定能不能拿到报酬。

english: Tetamo! Oh dear, oh dear. Are you part of a union?
translation: Tetamo！哦天哪，哦天哪。你加入工会了吗？

english: I don't remember joining one. I probably should with the... varied working conditions I go through.
translation: 我不记得加入过。考虑到我经历过的各种工作条件，我或许应该加入。

english: We have a fantastic one here on Aldarin, if you're interested. I can't say discussions are effective, but sometimes the wealthy do come to the table!
translation: 我们在阿尔达林岛这里有一个很棒的，如果你感兴趣的话。我不能说讨论有效，但有时富人确实会坐到谈判桌前！

english: I think this is a one-time gig for me, but thank you!
translation: 我想这只是我的一次性工作，不过谢谢你！

english: Very well. In that case, there are just a few quick admin bits to go through before I let you in.
translation: 很好。那样的话，在让你进去之前，还需要处理一些快速的行政手续。

english: First and foremost, butlers must keep their uniforms and masks on at all times. If you are seen without yours, you will be ejected from the party.
translation: 首先也是最重要的，管家必须时刻保持穿着制服和面具。如果你不穿，你将被驱逐出派对。

english: Got it. No taking off my uniform. What's this about masks?
translation: 明白。不脱制服。面具是怎么回事？

english: All staff are to be as anonymous as possible tonight so we'll provide you with a mask on entry. We'll be using them to keep track of who's coming and going.
translation: 所有员工今晚都要尽可能匿名，所以我们会在入口处给你一个面具。我们会用它们来记录进出的人。

english: Now, for security purposes, butlers are required to enter and leave with completely empty pockets. We'll hold on to anything you need us to whilst you're in there.
translation: 现在，出于安全考虑，管家进出时必须口袋里空空如也。你在里面时，我们会保管你需要的任何物品。

english: Got it, nothing in and nothing out.
translation: 明白，不带任何东西进去，也不带任何东西出来。

english: Right, I think that covers everything. Are you ready to enter?
translation: 好了，我想这些就是全部了。你准备好进去了吗？

english: I am.
translation: 准备好了。

english: Good good. We'll hold on to any items you have on you whilst you're in there.
translation: 很好很好。你在里面时，我们会保管你身上的任何物品。

english: Then you should put your follower away.
translation: 那你应该把你的随从收起来。

english: Sorry, you'll need to use the staff exit.
translation: 抱歉，你需要使用员工出口。

english: Did you want to leave?
translation: 你想离开吗？

english: Ah, welcome back. Are you ready to enter?
translation: 啊，欢迎回来。你准备好进去了吗？

english: Do you want to go back in?
translation: 你想回去吗？

english: I should probably speak to Patzi before doing anything in here.
translation: 我应该在里头做任何事之前先和帕齐谈谈。

english: I shouldn't go too far from the party for now.
translation: 我现在不该离派对太远。

english: You made it in, and don't you look the part! Magnificent!
translation: 你成功混进来了，而且看起来还真像那么回事！太棒了！

english: I feel like a court jester...
translation: 我感觉自己像个宫廷小丑……

english: I feel like a court jester... and not for the first time either.
translation: 我感觉自己像个宫廷小丑……而且这也不是第一次了。

english: Nonsense! Now, why not go and introduce yourself to our host and the other guests? I could do with knowing a little more about everyone.
translation: 胡说！现在，何不去跟我们的主人和其他客人自我介绍一下？我需要多了解一点每个人。

english: Hang on, I'm meant to be an anonymous butler. How do you expect me to get to know people for you?
translation: 等等，我本应是个匿名的管家。你指望我怎么帮你打听别人？

english: I'm sure you can get their names at least. That will give me something to work with.
translation: 我相信你至少能问到他们的名字。这样我就能有点线索了。

english: Okay... Anything else I can do for you, especially things you could easily do for yourself?
translation: 好吧……还有什么我能为你效劳的吗？特别是那些你自己就能轻松搞定的事？

english: No, no. I think you're doing more than enough right now, thank you.
translation: 不，不。我觉得你现在做得已经够多了，谢谢你。

english: How's your little task going?
translation: 你的小任务进展如何？

english: I haven't quite made my way around everyone the party yet.
translation: 我还没跟派对上的每个人都打过招呼。

english: So, this is grand isn't it?
translation: 那么，这很盛大，不是吗？

english: It certainly seems to be quite the event.
translation: 这确实像是个大场面。

english: I'd say it's one of my finest yet, though I do wish more of the guests could've made it. However, it looks like we've gained a bit of a straggler.
translation: 我得说这是我办得最成功的派对之一，不过我确实希望有更多客人能来。不过，看来我们多了个掉队的人。

english: A straggler?
translation: 掉队的人？

english: Yes, that slightly pompous fellow that hasn't introduced himself to anyone yet. The fact that he's here means he must have gained an invitation, though I don't know how...
translation: 是的，就是那个有点自命不凡、还没跟任何人自我介绍过的家伙。他能来这里，说明他肯定弄到了邀请函，虽然我不知道他是怎么弄到的……

english: Er... Is that going to be an issue?
translation: 呃……这会是个问题吗？

english: I'm sure it won't be! I'm always open to meeting new people, especially those who enjoy the arts.
translation: 我相信不会的！我一直乐于结识新朋友，尤其是那些热爱艺术的人。

english: Oh good, because it's actually him who I'm here with. He was very keen to meet you, even though he didn't actually know your name...
translation: 哦，那就好，因为实际上我就是和他一起来的。他非常渴望见到你，尽管他其实连你的名字都不知道……

english: I can't believe it! How could he not even know the name of his gracious host?
translation: 我真不敢相信！他怎么能连他慷慨的主人的名字都不知道？

english: Perhaps he's new to the island... Still, for an actor, his research seems lacking.
translation: 也许他刚来这座岛……不过，作为一个演员，他的准备工作似乎做得不够。

english: He's an actor you say? Ah, now that explains why he was so eager to be here. Well, if he's good, this might be his lucky day. I, Constantinius, am in the market for a new actor to sponsor.
translation: 你说他是个演员？啊，这就解释了他为什么这么渴望来这里了。好吧，如果他够优秀，今天可能就是他的幸运日。我，康斯坦提尼乌斯，正在物色一位新的演员来赞助。

english: Sponsor?
translation: 赞助？

english: Well, you know actors. Very profitable once they're popular. I like to... make investments.
translation: 嗯，你知道演员的。一旦他们出名了，就非常有利可图。我喜欢……做点投资。

english: For example, I've sponsored tonight's lead actor, Livius, for some time. He's done very well for himself, and for me, though he's almost too expensive for me these days.
translation: 比如说，我赞助今晚的主演利维乌斯已经有一段时间了。他为自己，也为我，干得很出色，尽管如今他贵得我几乎请不起了。

english: Anyway, perhaps you'll see him tonight on stage!
translation: 总之，也许你今晚会在舞台上看到他！

english: So, Constantinius, how often do you put on these parties?
translation: 那么，康斯坦提尼乌斯，你多久举办一次这样的派对？

english: Whenever we have a new play to unveil! I've got a couple of creatives from Tempestus that can write up a storm, so I find myself hosting these events more and more!
translation: 每当有新剧要揭幕的时候！我有几个来自坦佩斯图斯的创意人，他们能写出轰动一时的剧本，所以我发现自己举办这些活动的次数越来越多了！

english: How does one usually get themselves invited?
translation: 通常怎样才能受邀参加？

english: Normally we just send the invitations out to all the villas on the island! If you can afford one, then you're welcome here.
translation: 通常我们只是把邀请函寄到岛上所有的别墅！如果你买得起一栋，那你就受欢迎。

english: Well, I'm actually wealthy enough to be a homeowner myself, but not on Aldarin unfortunately.
translation: 嗯，我其实也富到能自己买房，但可惜不是在阿尔达林岛。

english: You must try to change that before next time. After all, the more the merrier.
translation: 下次之前你一定要想办法改变这一点。毕竟，人越多越热闹。

english: And you're definitely okay with me and my... we'll call him my employer, I guess. You're definitely okay with us being here?
translation: 你真的不介意我和我的……我们就叫他我的雇主吧。你真的不介意我们在这里？

english: Well, we sadly had a few who couldn't attend this time, so I'm actually quite glad you're here. Still, I wouldn't mind knowing how your employer managed to acquire an invitation...
translation: 嗯，遗憾的是这次有几个人不能来，所以我其实很高兴你们在这里。不过，我倒是不介意知道你的雇主是怎么弄到邀请函的……

english: Well, I actually own a home here on the island. Perhaps I can be invited next time!
translation: 嗯，我其实在岛上有一处房产。也许下次我可以被邀请！

english: Perhaps so. After all, the more the merrier.
translation: 也许吧。毕竟，人越多越热闹。

english: Sir? I thought I'd left that behind when I retired. Please, call me Cozyac.
translation: 先生？我以为我退休后就把这个称呼抛在脑后了。请叫我科齐亚克。

english: Absolutely, Cozyac. You can call me...
translation: 当然，科齐亚克。你可以叫我……

english: I seem to remember one of the rules of this party was that the staff were to remain anonymous.
translation: 我似乎记得这次聚会的规定之一是员工要保持匿名。

english: You can't call me then. Are you enjoying the party?
translation: 那你不能叫我了。你喜欢这场派对吗？

english: I am, yes. Though I am far more excited for tonight's performance. Constantinius says he's hired some of the finest actors for this one!
translation: 是的，我喜欢。不过我更期待今晚的演出。康斯坦提尼乌斯说他为这次演出请了一些最优秀的演员！

english: Still enjoying yourself, Cozyac?
translation: 还玩得开心吗，科齐亚克？

english: Absolutely! Though I'm starting to feel myself in need of another drink. I don't suppose you could sort that when you have a moment?
translation: 当然！不过我觉得自己需要再来一杯。我想你方便的时候能帮我弄一杯吧？

english: I can certainly look into it.
translation: 我当然可以看看。

english: Excuse me! You there!
translation: 打扰一下！说你呢！

english: Hi there. How can I be of service?
translation: 你好。有什么能为您效劳？

english: I could do with... another drink.
translation: 我需要……再来一杯。

english: Do you have a preference? Wine, or something non- alcoholic?
translation: 您有什么偏好吗？葡萄酒，还是非酒精饮料？

english: Alcoholic? I'll have you know that I, Pavo, am most certainly not an alcoholic. Now scram.
translation: 酒精？我告诉你，我，帕沃，绝对不是个酒鬼。现在滚开。

english: Did you get that drink I asked for?
translation: 你拿到我要的饮料了吗？

english: You sent me away before telling me what drink you actually wanted.
translation: 你还没告诉我你到底想要什么饮料就把我打发走了。

english: That's my mistake. I'll take some wine... Preferably a barrel of it.
translation: 是我的错。我来点葡萄酒……最好是一桶。

english: Nilsal to you as well. You seem different to the other staff here. First time?
translation: 也向你问候。你看起来和这里其他员工不一样。第一次来？

english: It is. How could you tell?
translation: 是的。你怎么看出来的？

english: You see similar things on boats. People look a bit wobbly until they settle.
translation: 你在船上也能看到类似的情况。人们在安定下来之前看起来有点摇摇晃晃。

english: Oh, I hadn't noticed I was...
translation: 哦，我都没注意到我……

english: Few ever do.
translation: 很少有人能注意到。

english: So do you spend a lot of time on boats?
translation: 所以你经常在船上？

english: I run something of a shipping company. If you need it moving, Xocotla's Got Ya!
translation: 我经营一家航运公司。如果你需要运输东西，索科特拉帮你搞定！

english: Well, I don't typically find myself in need of that sort of thing, but if that ever changes, I'll keep you in mind.
translation: 嗯，我通常不需要那种服务，但如果情况有变，我会记住你的。

english: So about that shipping...
translation: 那么关于航运……

english: I'd have preferred not to talk about work, but I suppose you do seem friendly enough.
translation: 我本来不想谈工作，但我想你看起来确实够友好的。

english: What sort of things can you move?
translation: 你们能运输什么样的东西？

english: We can securely move pretty much anything. Animals, valuables, bulk cargo.
translation: 我们几乎可以安全地运输任何东西。动物、贵重物品、散装货物。

english: Swiftness and discretion are valuable to us, if you catch my drift.
translation: 速度和谨慎对我们来说很有价值，如果你明白我的意思的话。

english: : I have no reason to go down there right now.
translation: 我现在没有理由下去那里。

english: I saw you make your way around the party! So then, who's who?
translation: 我看到你在派对上转了一圈！那么，谁是谁？

english: So, we've got...
translation: 那么，我们有……

english: Pavo, the drunk one over there. I'm not sure there's much to them other than their love of drinking.
translation: 帕沃，那边那个醉鬼。除了爱喝酒，我不觉得他们有什么别的特点。

english: Xocotla, who seems a lot more relaxed. It seems that she runs a shipping business.
translation: 索科特拉，看起来放松得多。她似乎经营着一家航运生意。

english: Last of all for the guests we have Cozyac. He's quite up on the rules of this party, so he might not be happy that you weren't properly invited.
translation: 最后一位客人是科齐亚克。他对这场派对的规定很了解，所以他可能不会高兴你没有正式受邀。

english: Pfft, invited? I have an invitation and I can act like I belong here! He'll never know!
translation: 切，受邀？我有邀请函，而且我可以表现得像属于这里一样！他永远不会知道！

english: He might not, but our host Constantinius does.
translation: 他可能不知道，但我们的主人康斯坦提尼乌斯知道。

english: Luckily, he didn't actually seem to mind you being here too much. Apparently he's actually looking for a new actor to sponsor.
translation: 幸运的是，他似乎并不太介意你在这里。显然他实际上正在寻找一位新的演员来赞助。

english: Sponsoring... me? How marvellous! Oh I think I should have a drink to celebrate! Could you be a dear and go into the wine cellar for me?
translation: 赞助……我？太棒了！哦，我想我应该喝一杯庆祝一下！你能帮我去酒窖拿点东西吗？

english: What would you like from the wine cellar? A beer?
translation: 你想从酒窖拿什么？啤酒？

english: Whilst that sounds lovely, I've heard there's some Principum Red down there! It's not produced any more so is rather hard to find, but our generous host seems happy enough to share.
translation: 虽然听起来不错，但我听说那里有普林西普姆红葡萄酒！这种酒已经不再生产了，所以很难找到，但我们慷慨的主人似乎很乐意分享。

english: Alright, one glass of wine coming right up.
translation: 好的，一杯葡萄酒马上就来。

english: Did you manage to find that wine yet?
translation: 你找到那瓶酒了吗？

english: I haven't had a chance to even go into the cellar yet. You'll have to give me a moment.
translation: 我还没机会进酒窖呢。你得给我点时间。

english: Remember, you're looking for Principum Red. I'm sure it will be labelled.
translation: 记住，你要找的是普林西普姆红葡萄酒。我相信它会有标签的。

english: 'Cupboard, keep out!' Why does it say keep out?
translation: “橱柜，闲人勿进！”为什么写着闲人勿进？

english: I shouldn't return to the party empty handed.
translation: 我不该空手回到派对。

english: Pri...pum Re...
translation: 普林……西普姆……红……

english: Hmm... The label's faded, but I'm sure this is the wine Patzi was talking about.
translation: 嗯……标签褪色了，但我确定这就是帕齐说的那瓶酒。

english: What... Oh, that's going to stain isn't it...
translation: 什么……哦，那会留下污渍，对吧……

english: I think it's probably best if I don't mess around with this again.
translation: 我想我最好别再碰这个了。

english: I guess I shouldn't leave without investigating that noise.
translation: 我想我不该不调查那个声音就离开。

english: Have you had too much to drink?
translation: 你是不是喝太多了？

english: You there! Don't move!
translation: 你！别动！

english: You're coming with us.
translation: 你跟我们走一趟。

english: It's always the butler, isn't it.
translation: 总是管家干的，不是吗。

english: Now now, Stradius. We don't know for sure they did it. It looks likely though.
translation: 好了好了，斯特拉迪乌斯。我们还不确定是他们干的。不过看起来很有可能。

english: Did what exactly?
translation: 到底干了什么？

english: Murder!
translation: 谋杀！

english: Stradius!
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯！

english: It was my turn to level the accusation at a suspect...
translation: 轮到我指控嫌疑人了……

english: How often do we get to handle a murder?
translation: 我们多久才能处理一次谋杀案？

english: You have to respect the systems we have, Stradius!
translation: 你必须尊重我们现有的制度，斯特拉迪乌斯！

english: I'm still here, in case you forgot?
translation: 我还在这儿呢，你们是不是忘了？

english: So, murder. Interesting choice at a party full of wealthy people, wouldn't you say?
translation: 所以，是谋杀。在满是富人的派对上发生这种事，挺有意思的选择，你不觉得吗？

english: Poor Livius... He wasn't acting this time.
translation: 可怜的利维乌斯……这次他不是在演戏。

english: But I didn't kill anyone?
translation: 但我没杀任何人啊？

english: You just happened to be found standing in a closed room with a dead body?
translation: 你只是碰巧被发现站在一个密闭的房间里，旁边还有一具尸体？

english: With bloodstains on your clothes, no less.
translation: 而且你的衣服上还有血迹。

english: Bloodstains?
translation: 血迹？

english: The red stains on your uniform. The victim's blood, I'm sure of it.
translation: 你制服上的红色污渍。我敢肯定是受害者的血。

english: You found me in a wine cellar and you won't even consider that it might be wine?
translation: 你是在酒窖里找到我的，难道你就没想过那可能是酒吗？

english: I suppose I could try tasting it...
translation: 我想我可以尝尝看……

english: Stradius! What if it's blood?
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯！万一是血呢？

english: Well, then it won't taste like wine, will it?
translation: 嗯，那它尝起来就不会像酒了，对吧？

english: No, you make a good point actually.
translation: 不，你说得确实有道理。

english: I'm just going to go...
translation: 我这就走……

english: Oh no you won't! You're going to wait right there and answer some questions!
translation: 哦，不行！你给我待在这儿，回答几个问题！

english: Would you believe me if I said I didn't do it?
translation: 如果我说不是我干的，你会相信吗？

english: We'll consider it.
translation: 我们会考虑的。

english: We will?
translation: 你们会？

english: But first, questions! Why were you down in that cellar?
translation: 但首先，问问题！你为什么会在那个地窖里？

english: I was looking for a wine. Principum Red? Patzi sent me to get some for him to drink. I just happened to hear a commotion and thought someone may have been hurt.
translation: 我在找一种酒。普林西普姆红葡萄酒？帕齐让我去给他拿一些来喝。我只是碰巧听到一阵骚动，以为可能有人受伤了。

english: So you were just trying to help?
translation: 所以你只是想帮忙？

english: Honestly, I'm sold.
translation: 说实话，我信了。

english: Stradius...
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯……

english: Ah, yes, sorry...
translation: 啊，是，抱歉……

english: I'm afraid we can't just let you go. Not without an investigation.
translation: 恐怕我们不能就这么放你走。至少得调查一下。

english: Not to mention, given our whole job here was to stop anything bad happening at this party, we're not really doing so well right now. We'll look even more ineffective if we don't have a suspect...
translation: 更何况，我们在这儿的工作就是防止派对上发生任何坏事，现在看来我们干得可不怎么样。要是连个嫌疑人都没有，我们看起来就更无能了……

english: Could be a career ender, really.
translation: 搞不好会断送职业生涯，真的。

english: Quite.
translation: 确实。

english: Okay... Well, much like I didn't kill that man, I suppose I don't want to hurt your careers. Maybe I could catch the killer!
translation: 好吧……嗯，就像我没有杀那个人一样，我想我也不想伤害你们的事业。也许我能抓住那个杀手！

english: Do you have any relevant qualifications?
translation: 你有什么相关资质吗？

english: Wait... are we meant to have...
translation: 等等……我们是不是应该有……

english: After all, training to be a butler must have taken a long time.
translation: 毕竟，训练成为一名管家肯定花了很长时间。

english: But I'm not even a butler! I got hired to act like one!
translation: 但我连管家都不是！我是被雇来假扮管家的！

english: Right, now I have to put murder back on the table! Who are you?
translation: 对，现在我得把谋杀案重新摆上台面！你是谁？

english: I'm just [player name]. I got hired by Patzi to be a butler for this evening, alongside a lady called Adala.
translation: 我只是[player name]。我被帕齐雇来今晚当管家，和一位叫阿达拉的女士一起。

english: Adala? Do we know an Adala?
translation: 阿达拉？我们认识一个叫阿达拉的吗？

english: Yes, I believe she's accounted for.
translation: 是的，我相信她已经被找到了。

english: You ran into her?
translation: 你碰到她了？

english: She came in shortly after we arrested you. Your friend, Patzi, mentioned she'd been sorting out some of his costumes.
translation: 我们逮捕你之后不久她就来了。你的朋友帕齐提到她一直在整理他的一些戏服。

english: You mean she was only accounted for after the murder took place?
translation: 你的意思是，她是在谋杀发生之后才被找到的？

english: Why do I get the feeling we're not doing a good job of actually investigating this?
translation: 我怎么觉得我们根本没在好好调查这件事？

english: It isn't just you.
translation: 不只是你。

english: Again, maybe I could be an extra pair of hands here.
translation: 再说一次，也许我可以搭把手。

english: Have a potential suspect investigate the murder? It wouldn't be orthodox, but it might work...
translation: 让一个潜在嫌疑人去调查谋杀案？这不合常规，但也许行得通……

english: I'm not sure I like the implication that we can't solve it ourselves.
translation: 我不太喜欢这种暗示，好像我们自己解决不了似的。

english: I agree, but we're not actually very qualified for this. We normally just guard drunk people, not solve murders!
translation: 我同意，但我们其实并不太适合做这个。我们通常只是看守喝醉的人，而不是解决谋杀案！

english: You make a fair point, Hutza.
translation: 你说得有道理，胡扎。

english: [player name], if you promise not to leave, can you help us work out what's happened here?
translation: [player name]，如果你保证不离开，你能帮我们弄清楚这里发生了什么吗？

english: I... promise not to flee the scene?
translation: 我……保证不逃离现场？

english: Perfect! Shall we get to investigating then?
translation: 完美！那我们开始调查吧？

english: Where should I start?
translation: 我该从哪里开始？

english: The victim was Livius, the lead actor in tonight's play. His body is still down in the cellar, so you should probably go and inspect it, along with the rest of the crime scene.
translation: 受害者是利维乌斯，今晚戏剧的主演。他的尸体还在下面的地窖里，所以你最好去检查一下，连同犯罪现场的其余部分。

english: No doubt you'll also want to question everyone. We'll keep them busy for you until you're ready. We'll also give you a case file to track your notes in!
translation: 毫无疑问，你也会想盘问所有人。我们会帮你拖住他们，直到你准备好。我们还会给你一个案件档案，用来记录你的笔记！

english: Okay, let's get to it.
translation: 好的，我们开始吧。

english: And where do you think you're going?
translation: 你觉得你要去哪儿？

english: Could you give me any tips for this investigation?
translation: 你能给我一些调查方面的建议吗？

english: You'll want to have a look down in the wine cellar I imagine. We made sure that nobody went down there after we arrested you, so everything should be as it was when the murder occurred.
translation: 我想你应该去下面的酒窖看看。我们确保逮捕你之后没人下去过，所以一切都应该和谋杀发生时一样。

english: You'll probably also want to do a bit of questioning up here as well.
translation: 你可能也想在上面这里盘问一下。

english: Are you going to help with any of this?
translation: 你们会帮忙做点什么吗？

english: We'll keep an eye on everyone for you.
translation: 我们会替你盯着所有人。

english: What if the actual murderer is still in the cellar somewhere?
translation: 如果真正的凶手还在地窖的某个地方呢？

english: We'll come looking for you if you're gone too long. It's not like there's anywhere for them to escape to!
translation: 如果你去得太久，我们会来找你的。反正他们也没地方可逃！

english: You will probably be dead by then though...
translation: 不过到那时你可能已经死了……

english: On the bright side, it would prove your innocence.
translation: 往好处想，那倒能证明你的清白了。

english: Oh, this is exciting isn't it!
translation: 哦，这真让人兴奋，不是吗！

english: I got arrested for murder because you sent me into that cellar!
translation: 我因为谋杀被逮捕，都是因为你派我去了那个地窖！

english: Did you at least manage to find what I sent you down there for?
translation: 你至少找到我派你下去找的东西了吗？

english: The Principum Red? Of course. Constantinius has a nice large container of it. However, I'm not sure if that's the most...
translation: 普林西普姆红葡萄酒？当然。康斯坦提尼乌斯有一大桶。不过，我不确定那是不是最……

english: See Adala, you were right!
translation: 看吧，阿达拉，你说对了！

english: What self-respecting man would have a wine cellar without such a historic wine in it?
translation: 哪个有自尊的男人会在酒窖里不放这种历史名酒？

english: It's a shame we're locked down up here. I'd love to try it! I came so close too, if it weren't for that actor...
translation: 可惜我们被困在上面了。我真想尝尝！就差那么一点，要不是那个演员……

english: Are you blaming Livius for his own murder?
translation: 你是在责怪利维乌斯自己被谋杀吗？

english: Of course not! I'm just ruing a missed chance to try that wine...
translation: 当然不是！我只是在惋惜错过了品尝那酒的机会……

english: Oh poor Livius! Where am I to find another actor of his calibre?
translation: 哦，可怜的利维乌斯！我上哪儿再去找一个他这种水准的演员？

english: Was he by any chance the one you mentioned earlier? The one who was starting to get too expensive for you?
translation: 他该不会就是你之前提到的那个吧？那个开始对你来说太贵了的？

english: I may have had some quibbles with how expensive his performances were, but he always made a profit!
translation: 我可能对他表演的收费有些微词，但他总能带来利润！

english: I can only hope his understudy is capable of filling the gap that's going to be left. Livius always kept her in the shadows, though he did say that she was nearly ready for a leading role of her own...
translation: 我只能希望他的替补能填补即将留下的空缺。利维乌斯一直把她藏在幕后，不过他说过她几乎准备好担任自己的主角了……

english: You didn't happen to know Livius, did you Cozyac?
translation: 你碰巧认识利维乌斯吗，科齐亚克？

english: I'm familiar with his work, but not the man himself. He's been Constantinius' preferred actor for a few years now.
translation: 我熟悉他的作品，但不认识他本人。这几年来，他一直是康斯坦提尼乌斯偏爱的演员。

english: Did he ever come and join the parties? Perhaps you crossed paths during the festivities?
translation: 他有没有来参加过派对？也许你们在庆祝活动期间碰过面？

english: I'm almost certain we didn't. The actors spend the entire party getting ready, and then I usually fall asleep by the end of the play!
translation: 我几乎可以肯定没有。演员们整个派对都在做准备，然后我通常在戏剧结束时睡着了！

english: The plays are that good are they?
translation: 戏剧有那么好看吗？

english: I'm an older man. I need a good early night to keep myself going. I am partial to a puzzle though, so solving this crime could keep me up all night!
translation: 我是个老人了。我需要早睡才能保持精力。不过我很喜欢解谜，所以破这个案子可能会让我熬夜！

english: You know, it's a surprisingly sobering moment when someone's murdered beneath your feet.
translation: 你知道吗，当有人在你脚下被谋杀时，那真是一个令人清醒的时刻。

english: Did you know him well?
translation: 你跟他很熟吗？

english: We were once drinking fellows. The things I've seen him drink without even breaking a sweat...
translation: 我们曾经是一起喝酒的朋友。我见过他喝下那些东西，连眉头都不皱一下……

english: Did you drink with him today?
translation: 你今天跟他一起喝酒了吗？

english: I don't remember... It seems likely that I would've though. He never liked to prepare for a performance without at least a small drink.
translation: 我不记得了……不过似乎很有可能。他从来不喜欢在表演前不喝点小酒。

english: Assuming you did, where would you have had a drink with him?
translation: 假设你喝了，你会在哪里和他一起喝酒？

english: Probably down in the cellar. That was always where he preferred to go.
translation: 可能在地窖里。他总是喜欢去那里。

english: So you admit that you may well have been down there with him today. Do you think something might've happened whilst you were drinking?
translation: 所以你承认你今天可能和他一起在地窖里。你觉得喝酒的时候是不是发生了什么？

english: I'd like to think that I would remember something so terrible happening in front of my eyes.
translation: 我倒希望我能记得眼前发生过这么可怕的事。

english: And yet you can't actually remember if you'd been drinking with him.
translation: 然而你实际上不记得是否和他一起喝过酒。

english: Oh, that's a good point... In that case, I don't know...
translation: 哦，说得好……那样的话，我就不知道了……

english: Quite an unfortunate turn of events, isn't it?
translation: 真是相当不幸的转折，不是吗？

english: I'm not sure it's unfortunate so much as a tragedy surely?
translation: 我不确定这是否只是不幸，这肯定是一场悲剧吧？

english: Well, I believe the play was actually intended to be a comedy. I'm hopeful they have an understudy who can fill in for today.
translation: 嗯，我相信这出戏原本是打算演成喜剧的。我希望他们有个替补演员能顶上今天的演出。

english: The play's still going ahead? Are we just going to ignore that a man was murdered?
translation: 演出还要继续？我们就打算无视有人被谋杀了吗？

english: I'd rather not think about it, personally.
translation: 我个人宁愿不去想它。

english: Okay... So Livius wasn't a customer of yours then?
translation: 好吧……那么利维乌斯不是你的顾客？

english: Would he have reason to have been?
translation: 他有什么理由成为你的顾客吗？

english: Actors seem to have a lot of costumes to move around the place. Maybe a shipping magnate such as yourself would make good money off of them.
translation: 演员似乎有很多服装要搬运。像您这样的航运大亨也许能从中赚不少钱。

english: I'm afraid I can't help you there. Good tip about the actors though. I'll have to visit the College of Bards next time I'm in Tempestus.
translation: 恐怕我帮不上忙。不过关于演员的建议不错。下次我去狂风城时得去拜访吟游诗人学院。

english: Why would Constantinius keep a broken stool around... Unless it was only just broken?
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯为什么留着破损的凳子……除非它刚被弄坏？

english: It appears to be a box full of blank wine labels. I suppose they like to keep things well organised.
translation: 看起来是一个装满空白葡萄酒标签的箱子。我猜他们喜欢保持东西井井有条。

english: Maybe there's something nearby that could give me a better idea of what happened.
translation: 也许附近有什么能让我更清楚发生了什么事。

english: It looks like someone's dropped this. I wonder if there was a fight?
translation: 看起来有人把这个掉落了。我在想是不是发生过打斗？

english: It's only half full. Someone must've been drinking from it.
translation: 只有半满。肯定有人喝过。

english: I wonder why this jug's been tucked away in the corner... Was someone trying to hide it?
translation: 为什么这个罐子被藏在角落里……是有人想藏起来吗？

english: I think I've found everything there is to find so far. What now?
translation: 我觉得目前能找到的都找到了。现在怎么办？

english: Are you sure you've investigated everything?
translation: 你确定你调查了一切吗？

english: Do you think you could pin down a suspect?
translation: 你觉得你能锁定嫌疑人吗？

english: I'm not sure. Oddly enough, no one is admitting to having done it, and given they were all here together, I'm pretty sure they'd be each other's alibis.
translation: 我不确定。奇怪的是，没人承认做了这件事，而且考虑到他们都在一起，我敢肯定他们会互相作证。

english: What if they hired someone to do it for them?
translation: 要是他们雇了别人来做呢？

english: Stradius... That's actually a good point.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯……这倒是说得好。

english: Maybe the butlers?
translation: 也许是那些管家？

english: You mean more of them might be fake like you?
translation: 你的意思是还有更多像你一样的冒牌货？

english: Well, thanks to the masks and uniforms, they're all anonymous. It's also very hard to keep track of how many there are.
translation: 嗯，多亏了面具和制服，他们都匿名了。也很难搞清楚具体有多少人。

english: Have we been keeping tabs on all the butlers? What if one's escaped! The killer might already be in the wind!
translation: 我们一直在监视所有管家吗？要是跑了一个怎么办！杀手可能已经逃之夭夭了！

english: Both of you are missing that there's no window in which they could've left that cellar.
translation: 你们俩都忽略了，那个地窖没有窗户可以逃出去。

english: Ah, yes. We came down when we heard the commotion. They wouldn't have been able to get out before then.
translation: 啊，对。我们听到骚动就下来了。他们在那之前不可能逃得出去。

english: It seems we're back to square one again, [player name], unless you can think of anything else to investigate?
translation: 看来我们又回到原点了，[player name]，除非你能想到还有什么可调查的？

english: I could try stealing from the suspects? Perhaps one of them will be carrying something incriminating.
translation: 我可以试试从嫌疑人身上偷东西？也许有人随身携带了罪证。

english: You probably shouldn't mention that in front of us.
translation: 你大概不该当着我们的面提这个。

english: I suppose we can always return things to them later.
translation: 我想我们之后总能归还东西的。

english: Hutza!
translation: 胡扎！

english: I'll be subtle.
translation: 我会小心行事。

english: No worries. We'll keep everyone under control here while you continue your investigation.
translation: 别担心。我们会控制住所有人，你继续调查。

english: No worries. We'll keep everyone under control here.
translation: 别担心。我们会控制住这里所有人。

english: How is your pocket checking going?
translation: 你的搜兜进展如何？

english: Well, keep up the good work.
translation: 嗯，继续好好干。

english: Oh, I'm so clumsy! Are you okay?
translation: 哦，我真笨手笨脚！你还好吗？

english: I wonder what these are for...
translation: 不知道这些是干什么用的……

english: I wonder what this is about...
translation: 不知道这是关于什么的……

english: Well, I suppose that's not surprising.
translation: 嗯，我想这并不意外。

english: I wonder what this is for...
translation: 不知道这是干什么用的……

english: I've had a little look through some pockets. I think all of the guests might be lying.
translation: 我稍微翻了一些口袋。我觉得所有客人可能都在撒谎。

english: Well, maybe not Pavo. They just had this old drinking flask. Xocotla and Cozyac on the other hand both had things on them that revealed they had direct dealings with Livius.
translation: 嗯，也许帕沃除外。他只有这个旧饮水瓶。而索科特拉和科齐亚克身上都带着显示他们与利维乌斯有直接往来的东西。

english: Here, have a look at what I found for yourselves.
translation: 来，你们自己看看我找到了什么。

english: Interesting... What about these labels?
translation: 有意思……这些标签是怎么回事？

english: I found them on Adala.
translation: 我在阿达拉身上找到的。

english: She was the one who wasn't accounted for when the murder took place, right?
translation: 她就是命案发生时行踪不明的那个人，对吧？

english: That's right. She's the one who came here with Patzi. Like [player name] here, both were uninvited.
translation: 没错。她就是和帕齐一起来的。像这里的[player name]一样，两人都是不请自来的。

english: Perhaps one of them is responsible... or indeed both of them.
translation: 也许其中一人是凶手……或者两人都是。

english: It's possible I suppose, but Patzi doesn't seem capable of pulling this off.
translation: 我想有可能，但帕齐看起来没能力干成这事。

english: It seems we still don't have anything conclusive. What do you think we should do?
translation: 看来我们还是没有确凿证据。你觉得我们该怎么做？

english: We could get them all together. Put pressure on them with some accusations and see who breaks?
translation: 我们可以把他们都聚在一起。用指控施压，看谁先撑不住？

english: You think that'll work?
translation: 你觉得行得通吗？

english: Only one way to find out I suppose.
translation: 我想只有一试才知。

english: It's not the worst thought, and I guess whatever happens, there's a good chance that some more of the truth will come out.
translation: 这不算坏主意，而且我想不管怎样，很可能会有更多真相浮出水面。

english: Alright, [player name], just let us know when you want everyone gathered and we'll take them upstairs for you.
translation: 好的，[player name]，你想把人集合起来时告诉我们，我们就带他们上楼。

english: Perfect! Let's get everyone upstairs!
translation: 太好了！我们把所有人都叫上楼吧！

english: I want to review the evidence a bit more.
translation: 我想再回顾一下证据。

english: Good idea. Just let us know when you're ready.
translation: 好主意。准备好了就告诉我们。

english: So what are these labels you found?
translation: 那你找到的这些标签是什么？

english: You take the lead here, [player name]. We'll be on hand to support you where needed.
translation: 你来主导吧，[player name]。我们会在需要时随时支持你。

english: This bit's all up to you, [player name].
translation: 这部分全靠你了，[player name]。

english: Constantinius, you knew Livius well, didn't you?
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯，你很了解利维乌斯，对吧？

english: I'd sponsored him for years, yes.
translation: 我赞助他多年了，是的。

english: How was that sponsorship working out for you?
translation: 这个赞助对你来说收益如何？

english: Well, I can't say I wasn't profiting from it. Although I do admit that he'd become a little... excessive with his spending in recent times.
translation: 嗯，我不能说我没从中获利。虽然我承认他最近变得有点……花钱大手大脚。

english: So you'd almost benefit from him being out of the way, letting you find someone new to sponsor?
translation: 所以他死了你几乎能受益，再找个新人来赞助？

english: The thought has crossed my mind, but he was still profitable, and it's not like I couldn't just sponsor a second actor in addition to him anyway.
translation: 我确实动过这个念头，但他仍然能盈利，而且我又不是不能在他之外再赞助第二个演员。

english: Constantinius...
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯……

english: Perhaps you should make sure you've questioned everyone before making an accusation, [player name].
translation: 也许你应该确保先审问过所有人再指控，[player name]。

english: Hmm... Fair enough.
translation: 嗯……有道理。

english: Constantinius! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. He was getting too expensive to sponsor and you needed him gone!
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯！我认为你应对利维乌斯的谋杀负责。他赞助起来太贵了，你需要他消失！

english: I wasn't tied to him... If I'd wanted to stop sponsoring him, I'd have just done that. There would have been no need to kill him...
translation: 我又不绑在他身上……如果我想停止赞助，直接做就是了。根本没必要杀他……

english: Well, perhaps you felt a murder mystery would have helped make this party interesting and memorable.
translation: 嗯，也许你觉得谋杀之谜能让这场派对更有趣且令人难忘。

english: I can't deny that it has very much enhanced the event, but do you think I'd have someone killed just for a social function?
translation: 我不能否认这确实大大增加了活动的趣味性，但你觉得我会为了一个社交场合就杀人吗？

english: That's... a fair point, and indeed, why would you kill your lead actor right before the play?
translation: 这……说得有道理，而且确实，你为什么要在演出前杀了你的主演？

english: You're the one accusing me, [player name]. You should know.
translation: 是你在指控我，[player name]。你应该知道。

english: Hmm... Very well.
translation: 嗯……好吧。

english: Haven't you already tried to accuse me?
translation: 你不是已经指控过我了吗？

english: Indeed I have. Just keeping you on your toes. As you were.
translation: 确实指控过了。只是让你保持警惕。继续吧。

english: Cozyac, did you not claim to have never interacted with Livius?
translation: 科齐亚克，你不是声称从未与利维乌斯有过往来吗？

english: I did, and I shall stand by that claim! Why are you the one making these accusations anyway? You were the one down there with him! Besides, you're just a butler!
translation: 是的，而且我坚持这个说法！为什么是你来做这些指控？你才是和他一起在下面的人！再说，你不过是个管家！

english: Stradius, the note!
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯，那封信！

english: A note written by yourself for Livius. Seems you weren't very happy with him...
translation: 一封你写给利维乌斯的信。看起来你对他很不满……

english: How did you...
translation: 你怎么……

english: So it seems you did know him. In fact, you had an issue with him, did you not?
translation: 看来你确实认识他。事实上，你和他有矛盾，不是吗？

english: Not one I would have killed him over! He owed me some money and wasn't paying up. I just needed to put some pressure on him.
translation: 不是会让我杀他的矛盾！他欠我一些钱不还。我只是需要给他施压。

english: Hmm... An outstanding debt could be considered motive for murder...
translation: 嗯……未偿还的债务可以算作谋杀动机……

english: Cozyac...
translation: 科齐亚克……

english: Cozyac! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. He owed you a debt and was refusing to pay!
translation: 科齐亚克！我认为你应对利维乌斯的谋杀负责。他欠你债而且拒绝偿还！

english: Why? Why kill someone over a debt? A dead man can't repay me, so I'd have needed to actually reclaim the money before killing him, at which point I'd have no reason to kill him anyway!
translation: 为什么？为什么为了债务杀人？死人没法还我钱，所以我得先要回钱再杀他，那时我就没理由杀他了！

english: He makes a fair point, [player name].
translation: 他说得有理，[player name]。

english: Pavo, you and Livius were drinking partners, weren't you?
translation: 帕沃，你和利维乌斯是酒友，对吧？

english: We were.
translation: 是的。

english: How heavily would you say you drank together?
translation: 你们一起喝得多厉害？

english: On occasion, a little too heavily.
translation: 有时喝得有点太多了。

english: Who provided the drinks?
translation: 谁提供的酒？

english: We'd tend to bring our own, although I did sometimes let him have a bit extra from my flask.
translation: 我们通常自己带，不过我有时会让他从我的饮水瓶里多喝一点。

english: Your flask, huh...
translation: 你的饮水瓶，嗯……

english: Stradius, the flask!
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯，那个饮水瓶！

english: This flask?
translation: 这个饮水瓶？

english: Yes, that's the one! I must've misplaced it.
translation: 对，就是这个！我一定是放错地方了。

english: If you were letting Livius drink from your flask, it wouldn't have been hard for you to poison him, would it?
translation: 如果你让利维乌斯喝你的饮水瓶，你很容易就能下毒害他，不是吗？

english: But why would I poison a friend?
translation: 但我为什么要毒害朋友？

english: That remains to be seen...
translation: 那还有待观察……

english: Pavo...
translation: 帕沃……

english: Pavo! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You poisoned him when you let him drink from your flask!
translation: 帕沃！我相信是你谋杀了利维乌斯。你让他喝你壶里的东西时给他下了毒！

english: I would never do something like that! You have no proof!
translation: 我绝不会做那种事！你没有证据！
