english: Well, the flask does still have some liquid left in it. Perhaps we should have it tested?
translation: 嗯，那个壶里确实还剩下一些液体。也许我们应该拿去检验一下？

english: Wait, there's still some left?
translation: 等等，里面还有剩的？

english: Oh... Well, I guess it's not poison then. Thanks for... helping to sort that one.
translation: 哦……好吧，那我猜不是毒药了。谢谢你……帮忙理清了这件事。

english: Xocotla, you've never had any dealings with Livius, have you?
translation: 索科特拉，你从来没和利维乌斯打过交道，对吧？

english: So he's never needed anything shipped by your company? Nothing he needed to move swiftly and discretely?
translation: 所以他从来没有需要你的公司运送过任何东西？没有什么需要快速且隐秘地移动的东西？

english: Why would he? I'm sure he's got more than enough solutions for moving his costumes around.
translation: 他为什么要呢？我敢肯定他有足够多的办法来搬运他的戏服。

english: Stradius, the contract!
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯，那份合同！

english: Care to explain this, Xocotla?
translation: 能解释一下这个吗，索科特拉？

english: That looks like a contract between... myself and Livius.
translation: 那看起来是一份……我和利维乌斯之间的合同。

english: Good eye. Interesting how you yourself seemed to not be aware of it, especially given it was you who was carrying it.
translation: 好眼力。有趣的是，你自己似乎都不知道这件事，尤其是考虑到是你自己带着它的。

english: Alright, fine. Livius had recently contracted us to help him move some of his belongings around. He's been doing well for himself and was moving into a larger property.
translation: 好吧，够了。利维乌斯最近雇我们帮他搬运一些财物。他最近混得不错，正要搬进一栋更大的房子。

english: I needed him to sign off on a slight change in timelines, and given we were both here, I thought we may as well get it sorted.
translation: 我需要他在时间安排上的一个小改动上签字，既然我们都在这里，我想不如就把它办了。

english: Hmm... I see...
translation: 嗯……我明白了……

english: Xocotla...
translation: 索科特拉……

english: Xocotla! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You pretended you didn't know him, but you lied!
translation: 索科特拉！我相信是你谋杀了利维乌斯。你假装不认识他，但你撒谎了！

english: Yes... It may surprise you to know that I didn't want to be associated with a murder victim whilst an investigation was ongoing!
translation: 是的……你可能不知道，但在调查进行期间，我不想和一个谋杀受害者扯上关系！

english: I suppose that is fair, [player name], and lying isn't a crime on its own.
translation: 我想这说得通，[player name]，而且撒谎本身并不是犯罪。

english: Patzi, Adala. The two of you weren't even invited to this party...
translation: 帕齐，阿达拉。你们两个甚至没有被邀请参加这个派对……

english: Nor were you...
translation: 你也没有……

english: But being here presented a huge opportunity for an up-and-coming actor like Patzi.
translation: 但能来这里，对像帕齐这样崭露头角的演员来说，是个巨大的机会。

english: A huge opportunity indeed!
translation: 确实是个巨大的机会！

english: You already knew that Constantinius was thinking about sponsoring a new actor. Perhaps you decided to speed things along a bit by removing the competition.
translation: 你早就知道康斯坦提尼乌斯在考虑赞助一个新演员。也许你决定通过除掉竞争对手来加快进程。

english: But why would I need to remove the competition if he was already open to sponsoring me anyway? That doesn't make sense...
translation: 但如果他本来就愿意赞助我，我为什么还需要除掉竞争对手呢？这说不通……

english: Perhaps, and indeed it is true that you couldn't have been present at the time of the murder. You never left the party. In fact you sent me down into the cellar for you, didn't you?
translation: 也许吧，而且确实，你不可能在谋杀发生时在场。你从未离开过派对。事实上，是你派我替你去地下室，对吧？

english: So you're saying that you're actually more likely to be guilty yourself?
translation: 所以你的意思是，实际上你自己更有可能是凶手？

english: Sending me down there made me look guilty! A perfect way of drawing attention away from the true culprit.
translation: 派我下去让我看起来很可疑！这是把注意力从真凶身上引开的完美方法。

english: But... that would be a terrible plan. You were here with us...
translation: 但是……那会是个糟糕的计划。你当时和我们在一起……

english: Which leads me on to you, Adala. Patzi was accounted for when the murder took place, but you were not. Care to tell us what you were up to?
translation: 这就引出了你，阿达拉。谋杀发生时，帕齐有不在场证明，但你没有。能告诉我们你当时在做什么吗？

english: I took Patzi's bag to the backstage area, spent some time chatting to the actors, and then made my way to the party.
translation: 我把帕齐的包拿到了后台区域，和演员们聊了一会儿天，然后就去了派对。

english: So you never entered the wine cellar?
translation: 所以你从未进入过酒窖？

english: But you knew a lot about it, didn't you?
translation: 但你对它了解很多，不是吗？

english: Stradius, the labels!
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯，那些标签！

english: Wine labels from Constantinius' cellar, found on your person. Care to explain?
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯酒窖里的葡萄酒标签，在你身上找到的。能解释一下吗？

english: I just found them on the floor. It's bad manners not to pick up litter.
translation: 我只是在地板上捡到的。不捡垃圾是不礼貌的。

english: What a convenient excuse...
translation: 多么方便的借口……

english: Patzi...
translation: 帕齐……

english: Patzi! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. You wanted him out of the way so you could take his place!
translation: 帕齐！我相信是你谋杀了利维乌斯。你想除掉他，这样你就可以取代他的位置！

english: But why? Constantinius was open to sponsoring me anyway. I didn't need to kill anyone...
translation: 但为什么？康斯坦提尼乌斯本来就愿意赞助我。我不需要杀任何人……

english: I think he's right, [player name]. There's no real motive here.
translation: 我觉得他说得对，[player name]。这里没有真正的动机。

english: Adala...
translation: 阿达拉……

english: Adala! I believe you were responsible for the murder of Livius. All the evidence is pointing at you!
translation: 阿达拉！我相信是你谋杀了利维乌斯。所有证据都指向你！

english: You were the only person missing at the time of the murder, and despite your claims, we have clear evidence you were in that cellar!
translation: 你是谋杀发生时唯一不在场的人，而且尽管你声称，我们有明确的证据表明你当时在那个酒窖里！

english: Alright, fine. I admit I was in the cellar.
translation: 好吧，够了。我承认我当时在酒窖里。

english: Wait, what is this?
translation: 等等，这是什么？

english: The Principum Red, you fool. I could retire on the value of that wine. All I had to do was get out of here with it.
translation: 普林西普姆红葡萄酒，你这个傻瓜。光是那瓶酒的价值就够我退休了。我只需要带着它离开这里。

english: My wine!
translation: 我的酒！

english: You used me...
translation: 你利用了我……

english: And I probably would've got away with it too, if it wasn't for this precocious butler turned investigator you hired!
translation: 要不是你雇了这个早熟的管家来当侦探，我可能就得手了！

english: What happened Adala? Did Livius interrupt your plan? Did he need to be silenced?
translation: 发生了什么事，阿达拉？利维乌斯打断了你的计划吗？他需要被灭口吗？

english: Murder! What a ridiculous assertion! I may be a thief, but I'd never kill someone!
translation: 谋杀！多么荒谬的指控！我或许是个盗贼，但我绝不会杀人！

english: Alright, I yield! You win!
translation: 好吧，我认输！你赢了！

english: I could've killed you, but I'm not that kind of person, just like how I didn't kill Livius.
translation: 我本可以杀了你，但我不是那种人，就像我没有杀利维乌斯一样。

english: Stop! You're too good for me! You win!
translation: 住手！你太厉害了，我比不过！你赢了！

english: Are you ready to confess now?
translation: 你准备好招供了吗？

english: I promise I didn't do it! I'm just a thief! I wasn't even strong enough to defeat you. How could I have killed Livius?
translation: 我发誓不是我干的！我只是个盗贼！我甚至弱到打不过你，怎么可能杀得了利维乌斯？

english: She may be telling the truth, [player name], but either way, we know she's a criminal now.
translation: 她可能说的是实话，[player name]，但不管怎样，我们现在知道她是罪犯了。

english: Come with us, Adala. You can have fun contemplating your crimes from your new cell...
translation: 跟我们走吧，阿达拉。你可以从你的新牢房里好好想想你的罪行……

english: Does this mean we can get on with tonight's play?
translation: 这是不是意味着我们可以继续今晚的戏剧了？

english: You still want to go ahead with the play? You don't even have a lead actor anymore!
translation: 你还想继续演戏剧？你连主演都没了！

english: Yes, it is a bit of a last minute issue, but I have no doubt that Livius' understudy will be able to step up.
translation: 是的，确实有点临时抱佛脚，但我毫不怀疑利维乌斯的替补演员能够顶上。

english: But Adala might not have even been the killer!
translation: 但阿达拉甚至可能根本不是杀手！

english: Well, you've been doing a wonderful job so far, so I'm sure if the villain is still loose, you'll catch them.
translation: 嗯，你到目前为止做得非常出色，所以我相信如果凶手仍然逍遥法外，你一定会抓住他的。

english: Constantinius, with respect, I'm not sure we can let everyone leave until we're sure we have this case solved.
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯，恕我直言，在我们确定案件已破之前，我不确定我们能让所有人离开。

english: That's not a problem. You can easily keep everyone in the theatre. The only place they'd be able to run to from there is straight off the cliff!
translation: 没问题。你可以轻松地把所有人留在剧院里。他们从那里唯一能逃的地方就是直接跳下悬崖！

english: It's settled then! We will proceed with the play! While we do that, if the killer is still at large, the ever capable [player name] here will ensure they are dealt with!
translation: 那就这么定了！我们将继续上演戏剧！在此期间，如果杀手仍然在逃，这里一直很能干的 [player name] 将确保他得到处理！

english: Fine, let's get going then.
translation: 好吧，那我们走吧。

english: Oh, no, you can't come with us. I don't want your investigation disrupting things. You'll need to stay out of sight. Why don't you take the back way?
translation: 哦，不，你不能跟我们一起来。我不想你的调查打乱进程。你得待在暗处。为什么不走后面的路呢？

english: The back way?
translation: 后面的路？

english: Yes! It's not been used in a while, so it's a little bit precarious these days, but I'm sure you'll manage.
translation: 对！那条路有一阵子没用过了，所以现在有点危险，但我相信你能应付。

english: Fine. Where do I find this back way?
translation: 好吧。我到哪里去找这条后面的路？

english: The pathway leads around the cliffs to the south. We'll see you at the theatre, [player name].
translation: 那条小路沿着悬崖往南走。我们在剧院见，[player name]。

english: I don't think I should be going up there.
translation: 我觉得我不应该上去那里。

english: I have no reason to go down there right now.
translation: 我现在没有理由下去那里。

english: Ah, there you are, [player name].
translation: 啊，你来了，[player name]。

english: So what's the plan here?
translation: 那么，计划是什么？

english: Well... we don't really have one, but the play is about to start and we still might have a killer on the loose.
translation: 嗯……我们其实没什么计划，但戏剧马上就要开始了，而且可能仍有杀手逍遥法外。

english: Perhaps there's some evidence we missed somewhere.
translation: 也许我们在某处遗漏了一些证据。

english: It seemed like you'd been quite thorough. The only place you didn't check was here at the theatre.
translation: 看来你已经检查得很彻底了。唯一没查过的地方就是这里，剧院。

english: Well then I guess it's time to fix that.
translation: 好吧，看来是时候弥补一下了。

english: The stairs over there lead down to the backstage area. That's where the actors, including Livius, were getting ready for the play. That seems like the best place to check for any missing clues.
translation: 那边的楼梯通往后舞台区域。演员们，包括利维乌斯，之前就是在那里为戏剧做准备。那似乎是检查任何遗漏线索的最佳地点。

english: Any luck down in the backstage area?
translation: 后舞台区域有什么发现吗？

english: Keep at it! I'm sure you can solve this one!
translation: 继续加油！我相信你能破这个案！

english: Nilsal. Are you the one who's trying to find Livius' killer?
translation: 尼尔萨尔，你就是那个想找出杀害利维乌斯的凶手的人吗？

english: That's right. So I'm guessing down here is your domain?
translation: 没错。所以我猜下面这里是你的地盘？

english: If you think I have any actual control in here, you'd be sorely mistaken. I don't think anyone could keep these actors in line. They're a... dramatic bunch.
translation: 如果你认为我对这里有实际控制权，那你就大错特错了。我觉得没人能管得住这些演员。他们是一群……戏剧性很强的人。

english: Speaking of which, where are they?
translation: 说到他们，他们在哪儿？

english: The play will be starting as we speak. They'll all be up in the theatre.
translation: 戏剧马上就要开演了。他们都会在剧院里。

english: Right, well in that case, I'd better get to it. I'd like to have a look around down here. Hopefully I can find some sort of clue as to how Livius died.
translation: 好吧，既然如此，我最好开始行动了。我想在下面这里四处看看。希望能找到一些关于利维乌斯死因的线索。

english: I'd also like to ask you a few questions, if that's okay?
translation: 如果方便的话，我还想问你几个问题。

english: What can you tell me about the actors?
translation: 你能告诉我关于那些演员的事吗？

english: There's four of them in total... Well... was four I should say.
translation: 总共有四个演员……嗯……我应该说曾经是四个。

english: There's Naiatli. She was Livius' understudy. After what happened, she's now taking the lead role tonight.
translation: 有奈亚特利。她是利维乌斯的替补演员。在那件事之后，她今晚将担任主角。

english: Then you have Clodius. He's getting close to retirement now so prefers to take on small, but impactful roles.
translation: 然后是克洛迪乌斯。他快退休了，所以更喜欢扮演一些虽小但很重要的角色。

english: Finally there's Quintilia. She's quite new, so she mostly takes on the non-speaking parts.
translation: 最后是昆提利亚。她比较新，所以通常演没有台词的配角。

english: And all of them were in here earlier?
translation: 他们刚才都在这儿吗？

english: That's right. Livius went out for his pre-performance drink, as he likes to do. The others all stayed here until after the murder happened.
translation: 是的。利维乌斯出去喝他演出前常喝的饮料了。其他人都留在这里直到谋杀发生后。

english: And you're sure none of them could have slipped out at any point?
translation: 你确定他们中没有人在任何时刻溜出去过吗？

english: I don't think so. I suppose I do get quite engrossed in my work sometimes, so it's not impossible. But I'm sure I'd have spotted someone going up the stairs...
translation: 我不这么认为。我想我有时确实会全神贯注于工作，所以也不是完全不可能。但我肯定如果有人上楼梯我会发现的……

english: What's the crate of poison for?
translation: 那个装有毒药的箱子是干什么用的？

english: Ah, that was a gift from Constantinius. We were having a bit of a rat problem, so he gave us the poison to deal with them.
translation: 啊，那是康斯坦提尼乌斯送的礼物。我们之前有点老鼠问题，所以他给了我们毒药来对付它们。

english: It seems one of the costumes has a stain on it.
translation: 有一件戏服上似乎有污渍。

english: A stain?
translation: 污渍？

english: Yes, a wine stain. Apparently the costume belongs to Naiatli. Is there any reason the costume would be stained?
translation: 是的，一个酒渍。看来那件戏服是奈亚特利的。戏服上会有污渍有什么原因吗？

english: No, none of her characters have any interaction with wine...
translation: 没有，她演的角色都没有和酒相关的互动……

english: Do you have any wine backstage?
translation: 后舞台有酒吗？

english: Well, the actors do often like to have a drink after a play, but I always ask that they do that outside so as to not risk any damage to the costumes.
translation: 嗯，演员们确实经常在戏剧结束后喝一杯，但我总是要求他们到外面去喝，以免损坏戏服。

english: Did you know there was a hidden passage in here?
translation: 你知道这里有一条秘密通道吗？

english: A passage? I had no idea, but I suppose it's not too suprising.
translation: 一条通道？我完全不知道，不过我想这也不算太令人意外。

english: This is an old villa. Apparently it once played a role in some smuggling operations a long time ago. I could see them having a few secrets to help them with that.
translation: 这是一栋古老的别墅。据说很久以前它曾在一场走私活动中扮演过角色。我可以想象他们会保留一些秘密来帮助他们。

english: I'm going to keep looking around.
translation: 我打算继续四处看看。

english: The play is well underway and for all we know there's still a killer out there. I hope you have something for us, [player name].
translation: 戏剧正在顺利上演，而且据我们所知，还有一个杀手在外面。我希望你给我们带来了些什么，[player name]。

english: I think I might. It turns out there's a secret passage from the backstage area into the wine cellar. Someone could have got in and out without anyone else knowing.
translation: 我想我可能有了。原来后舞台区域有一条秘密通道通往酒窖。有人可以在无人知晓的情况下进出。

english: Not only that, but the backstage area has had a rat problem recently. They have plenty of poison for dealing with them. That same poison could easily have been used to kill Livius.
translation: 不仅如此，后舞台区域最近有老鼠问题。他们有很多毒药来处理它们。同样的毒药很容易就能用来杀死利维乌斯。

english: Great work, [player name].
translation: 干得好，[player name]。

english: But did you find anything that could tell us who did it?
translation: 但你有没有发现什么能告诉我们是谁干的？

english: Yes, we need to confront the killer! Who was it, [player name]?
translation: 对，我们需要去指认杀手！是谁，[player name]？

english: Patzi.
translation: 帕齐。

english: But how? We established that he couldn't have accessed the cellar.
translation: 但怎么会？我们之前确定他不可能进入酒窖。

english: That's right. The secret passage doesn't change that either as he never left the villa.
translation: 没错。秘密通道也改变不了这一点，因为他从未离开过别墅。

english: Okay, not him then.
translation: 好吧，那应该不是他。

english: Adala.
translation: 阿达拉。

english: So it was her? But why?
translation: 所以是她？但为什么？

english: Adala may be a criminal, but she had no reason to want Livius dead. I don't think it was her.
translation: 阿达拉或许是个罪犯，但她没有理由想让利维乌斯死。我不认为是她。

english: Hmm... Good point.
translation: 嗯……有道理。

english: Constantinius.
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯。

english: How would he have gained from killing Livius?
translation: 他杀死利维乌斯能有什么好处？

english: Exactly. If he's wanted to stop sponsoring him, he could have just done that. No killing needed.
translation: 确实。如果他不想再赞助他，他大可以直接停止。没必要杀人。

english: Cozyac.
translation: 科齐亚克。

english: Because of the debt? That could be a motive, but he never had the means.
translation: 因为债务？那可能是一个动机，但他从来没有手段。

english: Hmm... I suppose you're right.
translation: 嗯……我想你说得对。

english: Xocotla.
translation: 索科特拉。

english: She did lie about knowing him, but we never determined any proper motive.
translation: 她的确撒谎说不认识他，但我们从未确定任何真正的动机。

english: I don't think she ever had the opportunity either.
translation: 我觉得她也从来没有机会。

english: I think you're right actually. Ignore me.
translation: 我想你说得对。当我没说。

english: Pavo.
translation: 帕沃。

english: I thought we'd ruled them out?
translation: 我以为我们已经排除他们了？

english: Do you have new information that changes that, [player name]?
translation: 你有新的信息能改变这一点吗，[player name]？

english: Er... No.
translation: 呃……没有。

english: Well then it's probably not them.
translation: 那应该就不是他们。

english: Naiatli.
translation: 奈亚特利。

english: The understudy that's on stage right now? Why?
translation: 那个现在正在台上表演的替补演员？为什么？

english: As a fellow actor, she had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar where Livius was having his pre- performance drink.
translation: 作为同行演员，她可以从秘密通道进入利维乌斯在演出前喝酒的酒窖。

english: But how did she kill him?
translation: 但她是如何杀死他的？

english: The rat poison. Enough of that would easily kill a man. She poisoned his drink so that she could be back out of the cellar before he died.
translation: 用老鼠药。足够多的量很容易杀死一个人。她在他的饮料里下了毒，这样就能在他死之前离开酒窖。

english: I suppose that makes sense, but she wasn't the only one who had access to that passage.
translation: 我想这说得通，但她不是唯一能进入那条通道的人。

english: But she was the only one who had wine on her clothes. Wine isn't allowed backstage, so it must have come from the cellar.
translation: 但她是唯一衣服上有酒的人。酒不允许带到后台，所以一定来自酒窖。

english: Oh, very good! But what about motive?
translation: 哦，非常棒！但动机呢？

english: Constantinius mentioned earlier that she had been in Livius' shadow for some time. Killing him has finally allowed her to take on a leading role.
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯之前提到过，她一直在利维乌斯的阴影下待了一段时间。杀死他终于让她有机会担任主角。

english: I suppose this does all make sense, but are you certain?
translation: 我想这一切确实说得通，但你确定吗？

english: I'd say eighty, maybe ninety percent sure.
translation: 我大概有八成，也许九成把握。

english: Well I suppose that will have to be enough. You've not taken us down too many wrong paths today...
translation: 好吧，那也只能这样了。你今天倒也没把我们带偏太多次……

english: Except for the whole fake butler act.
translation: 除了那个假管家的事。

english: True, but you were honest about that pretty quickly. We'll wait until the play is over and then we'll take her in.
translation: 没错，但你很快就老实交代了。我们等演出结束再抓她。

english: Wait? But should we not be acting now?
translation: 等？难道我们不该现在就行动吗？

english: Constantinius would kill us if we stopped the performance.
translation: 康斯坦提尼乌斯会杀了我们，如果我们打断演出。

english: And then we'd have another murder mystery on our hands...
translation: 那我们就又得处理一起谋杀之谜了……

english: Well then we'll have to just speed things along a bit. I'm going out there!
translation: 好吧，那我们只好加快点进度。我要上台了！

english: Clodius.
translation: 克洛迪乌斯。

english: The actor? But why would he do that?
translation: 那个演员？但他为什么要这么做？

english: Well, he was one of the few who had access to the secret passage into the wine cellar. He also had access to the rat poison.
translation: 嗯，他是少数几个能通过秘密通道进入酒窖的人之一。他也能接触到老鼠药。

english: But what was his motive?
translation: 但他的动机是什么？

english: We're going to need more than that, [player name].
translation: 光凭这些还不够，[player name]。

english: Quintilia.
translation: 昆蒂莉亚。

english: The actress? But why?
translation: 那个女演员？但为什么？

english: She had access to both the secret passage into the wine cellar and to the rat poison.
translation: 她既能进入酒窖的秘密通道，也能接触到老鼠药。

english: But she doesn't have a motive... She also isn't the only one who had access to the passage and poison.
translation: 但她没有动机……而且她也不是唯一能进入通道和接触到毒药的人。

english: Ah... Good point.
translation: 啊……说得好。

english: The Costumer.
translation: 服装师。

english: Well, she had access to the secret passage. She claimed not to know about it, but she did know about the history of the villa. She also had access to the rat poison.
translation: 嗯，她能进入秘密通道。她声称不知道有这通道，但她确实了解别墅的历史。她也能接触到老鼠药。

english: But why would she kill him? What's the motive?
translation: 但她为什么要杀他？动机是什么？

english: I... don't know.
translation: 我……不知道。

english: Sounds like she might not be our killer then, [player name].
translation: 听起来她可能不是我们的杀手，[player name]。

english: Livius.
translation: 利维乌斯。

english: You think Livius killed himself?
translation: 你觉得利维乌斯是自杀的？

english: Well it's the last thing anyone would expect.
translation: 嗯，这是最没人会想到的事。

english: It's the last thing anyone would expect because it obviously didn't happen! Let's try considering some more plausible candidates.
translation: 最没人会想到是因为它显然没发生！我们还是考虑些更合理的嫌疑人吧。

english: You two.
translation: 你们两个。

english: Us? But surely we'd remember...
translation: 我们？但我们肯定记得……

english: Of course it wasn't us! Stop messing around, [player name]!
translation: 当然不是我们！别胡闹了，[player name]！

english: You?! Goodness, it's the crime of the century! Right, come with us!
translation: 你？！天哪，这可是世纪大案！好了，跟我们走！

english: Wait! I was joking!
translation: 等等！我开玩笑的！

english: Stop playing around, [player name]! We have a killer to deal with!
translation: 别闹了，[player name]！我们还得对付杀手呢！

english: The dog.
translation: 那条狗。

english: The dog? But how would a dog do something like this?
translation: 那条狗？但狗怎么能做出这种事？

english: Never underestimate a dog, Hutza.
translation: 永远别低估一条狗，胡扎。

english: Okay, but even if the dog did have the means, it didn't have the opportunity, not to mention motive...
translation: 好吧，但就算狗有办法，它也没有机会，更别提动机了……

english: Okay, fine, not the dog.
translation: 好吧，好吧，不是狗。

english: I don't know yet. I need to review the evidence.
translation: 我还不知道。我需要重新审视证据。

english: Be quick, [player name].
translation: 快点，[player name]。

english: We need to confront the killer! Who was it, [player name]?
translation: 我们需要当面质问杀手！是谁，[player name]？

english: Okay, I'm going on stage.
translation: 好了，我要上台了。

english: Break a leg out there!
translation: 祝你演出顺利！

english: I need go back on stage.
translation: 我需要回到台上。

english: Go and get her!
translation: 去抓住她！

english: Shouldn't you be on stage?
translation: 你不是应该上台吗？

english: At last, the vile villain shows themselves!
translation: 终于，那个卑鄙的恶棍现身了！

english: Villain? The only villain here is you, murderer!
translation: 恶棍？这里唯一的恶棍是你，凶手！

english: I am no murderer! What vexatious allegations you come at me with!
translation: 我不是凶手！你竟敢用这种无礼的指控来指责我！

english: I'm not sure about this new character. Are they even in costume?
translation: 我不确定这个新角色是怎么回事。他们甚至没穿戏服吗？

english: Do not pretend you don't know! Your lies are at an end!
translation: 别假装你不知道！你的谎言到此为止！

english: I don't think this was in the original script...
translation: 我觉得这不在原剧本里……

english: I've overcome so much! I won't fall at this last hurdle!
translation: 我克服了这么多！不会在最后关头倒下！

english: Lay down your arms! Your heroic deeds are fabrications!
translation: 放下武器！你的英雄事迹都是捏造的！

english: Never! Now swing at me!
translation: 绝不！现在向我进攻吧！

english: Argh! You're stronger than I thought... I need to regroup!
translation: 啊！你比我想象的更强……我需要重新集结！

english: Ha! You've stepped into my trap.
translation: 哈！你踏进了我的陷阱。

english: A trap?
translation: 陷阱？

english: Aha, villain! This is where you fall!
translation: 啊哈，恶棍！这就是你倒下的地方！

english: You're no match for me!
translation: 你不是我的对手！

english: I'm sorry... You'll have to fight alone.
translation: 对不起……你得独自战斗了。

english: How could you be this powerful?
translation: 你怎么会这么强大？

english: It's all part of my grand plan. I grow stronger with every passing moment!
translation: 这是我宏伟计划的一部分。我每时每刻都在变强！

english: I can't keep up with this!
translation: 我跟不上了！

english: Then flee again, ignoble hero!
translation: 那就再次逃跑吧，卑劣的英雄！

english: I must make my last stand... Could you find it in your heart to stay your hand?
translation: 我必须做最后的抵抗……你能发发慈悲，停手吗？

english: And let you live to foil my plans another day? I'm afraid that's not the game we play!
translation: 然后让你活着，改天再来破坏我的计划？恐怕我们玩的不是这种游戏！

english: And so I take my leave from this mortal coil!
translation: 那么，我就要离开这凡尘俗世了！

english: Bravo!
translation: 太棒了！

english: Well that was a twist, wasn't it?
translation: 这真是个转折，不是吗？

english: Naiatli, I know you killed Livius. Why?
translation: 奈亚特利，我知道是你杀了利维乌斯。为什么？

english: I've been stuck in the shadow of that man for too long. He wouldn't even let me fill another role...
translation: 我活在那个男人的阴影下太久了。他甚至不让我演别的角色……

english: Murder is a bit far though. Could you not have just... lightly poisoned him?
translation: 但谋杀也太过分了。你就不能……给他下点轻毒？

english: You don't understand... I never poisoned him... I just tripped him. All I wanted was to put him out of action. A small injury would've been enough for him to not perform this evening...
translation: 你不明白……我从没给他下毒……我只是绊了他一下。我只想让他无法演出。受点小伤就够他今晚不能上台了……

english: He'd had so much to drink. He fell harder than expected, and he wouldn't get up... I fled... I never wanted him to...
translation: 他喝得太多了。他摔得比我想象的重，然后就再也起不来了……我逃走了……我从没想过让他……

english: Oh, Naiatli... Come on, let's get you to the guards.
translation: 哦，奈亚特利……来吧，我们带你去见守卫。

english: Stradius, Hutza, it's been a surprising pleasure working with you to solve this case.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯，胡扎，和你们一起破案真是出乎意料的愉快。

english: I can't believe it was all an accident...
translation: 真不敢相信这全是意外……

english: [player name], you've done well. I'd like to apologise for our hasty arrest earlier. Your commitment to helping us has been commendable.
translation: [player name]，你做得很好。我想为我们之前仓促逮捕你道歉。你帮助我们破案的决心值得称赞。

english: To be fair to us, you did seem like the perfect suspect.
translation: 公平地说，你当时看起来确实像完美的嫌疑人。

english: I suppose I did, but no harm done. I'm just glad we got it all sorted out, though I don't think Patzi is going to be paying me any time soon...
translation: 我想也是，但没造成什么伤害。我很高兴我们把事情都解决了，不过我觉得帕齐短期内是不会付我钱了……

english: You win some and you lose some I guess. All the best, [player name]!
translation: 有得必有失吧。祝你好运，[player name]！

english: You were quite impressive up on stage. Maybe you should take up a career in acting... or investigating crime.
translation: 你在台上表现得相当出色。也许你应该考虑从事表演……或者犯罪调查。

english: Thanks for your help again, [player name]. It's good to know people like you are around.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助，[player name]。很高兴知道有你这样的人在。

english: Still here, Patzi?
translation: 还在这儿呢，帕齐？

english: No thanks to you! This was meant to be a big moment for me, and you totally upstaged me!
translation: 才不是多亏了你！这本来该是我的重要时刻，结果你完全抢了我的风头！

english: Are you angry at me for getting involved in all of this? Did you forget that it was you that hired me?
translation: 你生我的气，因为我卷入了这一切？你忘了是你雇我的吗？

english: I hired you to make me look better!
translation: 我雇你是为了让我看起来更好！

english: And I don't think I did too bad a job. You never got kicked out, even though you did bring a thief in with you.
translation: 我觉得我干得还不错。你没有被赶出去，尽管你带了个盗贼进来。

english: So how about that payment you promised?
translation: 那么，你承诺的报酬呢？

english: Ah... Well... You see...
translation: 啊……这个……你看……

english: Yes, I thought as much.
translation: 嗯，我猜到了。

english: Well, I never imagined you'd be quite the actor!
translation: 好吧，我从没想过你会是个这么出色的演员！

english: I have to admit, I rather surprised myself there.
translation: 我得承认，我自己也挺惊讶的。

english: I don't suppose you'd like to be acting here in the future? To be honest, I'd prefer you to that odd fellow that brought you to my door.
translation: 你以后愿意来这里演戏吗？说实话，我更喜欢你，而不是那个把你带到我门前的古怪家伙。

english: It's a kind offer, but I'm afraid it was a one-time job.
translation: 这是个好提议，但恐怕这只是个一次性的工作。

english: A shame to be sure.
translation: 那确实可惜了。

english: Anyway, do feel free to wander around the villa whenever you fancy. I don't recommend drinking from the wine fountain though.
translation: 总之，随时欢迎你来别墅逛逛。不过我不建议你喝那个葡萄酒喷泉里的酒。

english: I wonder what this opens...
translation: 我好奇这是开什么的……

english: *Gulp*
translation: *咕嘟*

english: Well citizen, the Prince is fond of puzzles. Why we couldn't just have a key is beyond me!
translation: 市民啊，王子殿下就喜欢解谜。我真搞不懂为什么不能直接用钥匙！

english: Welcome to the Principality of Burthorpe!
translation: 欢迎来到伯索普公国！

english: Hello citizen, is there anything you'd like to know?
translation: 你好市民，有什么想知道的吗？

english: Can you remind me of the quest I am on?
translation: 能提醒一下我现在在做什么任务吗？

english: You offered to see if you could find another way up Death Plateau. We could then use it to sneak up and attack the trolls by night.
translation: 你答应去看看能不能找到另一条上死亡高原的路。这样我们就能在夜里偷偷上去攻击巨魔。

english: Ah yes, and the guard had lost the combination to your equipment room in the castle on the hill?
translation: 啊，是的，而且守卫弄丢了你在小山上的城堡里装备室的组合？

english: That's right citizen, you offered to recover the combination and unlock the door.
translation: 没错，市民，你主动提出要找回组合并打开门。

english: God speed citizen.
translation: 愿神保佑你，市民。

english: I'd better not go into someone's bedroom without a reason!
translation: 我最好还是别无缘无故进别人的卧室！

english: I'm looking for the guard that was on last night.
translation: 我在找昨晚值班的那个守卫。

english: There was only one guard on last night. Harold. He's a nice lad, if a little dim.
translation: 昨晚只有一个守卫值班。哈罗德。他是个好小伙子，就是有点笨。

english: Do you know where he is staying?
translation: 你知道他住在哪吗？

english: Harold is staying at the Toad and Chicken.
translation: 哈罗德住在蟾蜍与鸡旅馆。

english: Do you know of another way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你知道另一条上死亡高原的路吗？

english: No, sorry. I wouldn't want to go north-east from here, it's very rocky and barren.
translation: 不，抱歉。我不想从这里往东北走，那里岩石嶙峋，一片荒芜。

english: You're the guard that was on duty last night?
translation: 你就是昨晚值班的守卫？

english: Yeah.
translation: 是啊。

english: Denulth said that you lost the combination to the equipment room?
translation: 德努斯说你弄丢了装备室的组合？

english: I don't want to talk about it!
translation: 我不想谈这个！

english: I said I don't want to talk about it!
translation: 我说了我不想谈这个！

english: I found Harold but he won't talk to me!
translation: 我找到哈罗德了，但他不肯跟我说话！

english: Hmm. Harold has got in trouble a few times over his drinking and gambling. Perhaps he'd open up after a drink?
translation: 嗯。哈罗德因为喝酒和赌博惹过几次麻烦。也许喝一杯之后他就愿意开口了？

english: Thanks, I'll try that!
translation: 谢谢，我试试看！

english: You said that Harold had a weakness?
translation: 你刚才说哈罗德有什么弱点？

english: Yes, if you buy Harold a beer he might talk to you. I also know he has a weakness for gambling. Hope that helps!
translation: 对，如果你给哈罗德买杯啤酒，他可能会跟你说话。我还知道他好赌。希望这能帮到你！

english: Arrh. That hit the spot!
translation: 啊哈。真过瘾！

english: Where were you when you last had the combination?
translation: 你最后一次拿着组合的时候在哪里？

english: I honestly don't know! I've looked everywhere. I've searched the castle and my room!
translation: 我真的不知道！我到处都找过了。城堡和我的房间都搜遍了！

english: Have you tried looking between here and the castle?
translation: 你有没有在从这到城堡的路上找过？

english: Yeah, I tried that.
translation: 嗯，找过了。

english: I need another beer.
translation: 我还需要一杯啤酒。

english: Would you like to gamble?
translation: 想赌一把吗？

english: Good. Good. I have some dice. How much do you want to offer?
translation: 好。好。我有骰子。你想押多少？

english: Woah! Do you think I'm made of money? Max bet is 1000 gold.
translation: 哇！你以为我钱多啊？最高赌注是1000金币。

english: OK. I'll roll first!
translation: 好。我先掷！

english: Don't forget that once I start my roll you can't back out of the bet! If you do you lose your stake!
translation: 别忘了，一旦我开始掷，你就不能反悔了！反悔的话你的赌注就没了！

english: Sounds good! I normally drink Asgarnian Ale but you know what?
translation: 听起来不错！我通常喝阿斯加尼亚麦酒，但你知道吗？

english: I really fancy one of those Blurberry Specials. I never get over to the Gnome Stronghold so I haven't had one for ages!
translation: 我真的很想来一杯布鲁贝利特调。我从来没去过地精要塞，所以好久没喝过了！

english: Now THAT hit the spot!
translation: 这才叫过瘾！

english: 'Ello matey!
translation: 嘿，老兄！

english: Hmm...!
What wash the queshtion?
translation: 刚才的问题是什么来着？

english: Shure!
translation: 当然！

english: Place your betsh pleashe!
translation: 请下注！

english: *giggle*
translation: *咯咯笑*

english: Eashy tiger! Max bet ish 1000 coinsh.
translation: 悠着点！最高赌注是1000金币。

english: Right...er...here goes...
I fink I've had enough!
translation: 我觉得我喝够了！

english: Oh dear, I seem to have run out of money!
translation: 哦天哪，我好像没钱了！

english: Here's what I have.
translation: 这是我剩下的。

english: I'll write you out an IOU for the rest.
translation: 剩下的我给你写张借条。

english: Shixteen! How am I shupposhed to beat that!
translation: 十六点！这让我怎么赢！

english: I didn't know you could ushe four dishe. Oh well.
translation: 我不知道还能用四个骰子。算了。

english: I sheemed to have rolled a one.
translation: 我好像掷了个一点。

english: Um...not enough money.
translation: 嗯...钱不够。

english: Heresh shome of it.
translation: 先给你一部分。

english: I owe you the resht!
translation: 剩下的我欠着！

english: I've lost the IOU you gave me.
translation: 你给我的那张借条我弄丢了。

english: I'll write you another.
translation: 我再给你写一张。

english: I've run out of money!
translation: 我没钱了！

english: Oh dear. I need beer.
translation: 哦天哪。我需要啤酒。

english: Mmm... Asgarnian Ale.
translation: 嗯...阿斯加尼亚麦酒。

english: I'm shure I had money, not anymore!
translation: 我明明记得我有钱的，现在没了！

english: The IOU says that Harold owes me some money.
translation: 借条上说哈罗德欠我钱。

english: Wait just a minute!
translation: 等一下！

english: The IOU is written on the back of the combination! The stupid guard had it in his back pocket all the time!
translation: 借条就写在组合背面！那个愚蠢的守卫一直把它放在后口袋里！

english: Thank goodness you opened that door! I've been trapped here since last night!
translation: 谢天谢地你开了那扇门！我从昨晚就被困在这里了！

english: Harold is staying at the local inn, the Toad and Chicken.
translation: 哈罗德住在当地的旅馆，癞蛤蟆与鸡旅馆。

english: I've unlocked the equipment room so I just need to find an alternate route up Death Plateau!
translation: 我已经打开了装备室，现在只需要找到另一条上死亡高原的路！

english: Good work citizen!
translation: 干得好，市民！

english: I'm looking for the guard that was on duty at the castle last night.
translation: 我在找昨晚在城堡值班的守卫。

english: Who?!
Why would I want to go up there? I just want to be left in peace!
translation: 我为什么要上去？我只想安安静静的！

english: It used to be just humans trampling past my cave and making a racket. Now there's those blasted trolls too! Not only do they stink and argue with each other loudly but they are always fighting the humans.
translation: 以前只是人类在我洞穴旁边踩来踩去吵吵闹闹。现在又来了那些该死的巨魔！他们不仅臭烘烘地大声争吵，还总是和人类打架。

english: I just want to be left in peace!
translation: 我只想安安静静的！

english: Ah... I might be able to help you.
translation: 啊...我或许能帮你。

english: How?!
translation: 怎么帮？！

english: I'm trying to help the...er...humans to reclaim back Death Plateau. If you help me then at least you'd be rid of the trolls.
translation: 我在帮...呃...人类夺回死亡高原。如果你帮我，至少能摆脱那些巨魔。

english: I've only been up Death Plateau once to complain about the noise but those pesky trolls started throwing rocks at me!
translation: 我只上过一次死亡高原去抱怨噪音，但那些讨厌的巨魔就开始朝我扔石头！

english: Before the trolls came there used to be a nettlesome Sherpa that took humans exploring or something equally stupid. Perhaps he'd know another way.
translation: 在巨魔来之前，有个烦人的夏尔巴人带人类去探险或做其他蠢事。也许他知道另一条路。

english: Where does this Sherpa live?
translation: 这个夏尔巴人住在哪里？

english: I don't know but it can't be far as he used to be around all the time!
translation: 我不知道，但应该不远，因为他以前总是在附近！

english: Nothing, sorry!
translation: 没什么，抱歉！

english: Where did you say this Sherpa was?
translation: 你刚才说那个夏尔巴人在哪？

english: I dunno but he must live around here somewhere!
translation: 我不知道，但他一定住在这附近某个地方！

english: I'm not the milkman, I need your help!
translation: 我不是送牛奶的，我需要你的帮助！

english: Oh...OK. You'd better come in then.
translation: 哦...好吧。那你进来吧。

english: Where do you think you're going? This is private property!
translation: 你想去哪？这是私人领地！

english: Hello. How can I help?
translation: 你好。有什么能帮你的？

english: I'm helping the Imperial Guard. They need to find a way to sneak up Death Plateau to destroy the troll camp! Saba seemed to think you'd be able to help.
translation: 我在帮帝国守卫。他们需要找一条路偷偷上死亡高原摧毁巨魔营地！萨巴觉得你能帮忙。

english: Ah...Saba is still alive and kicking?
translation: 啊...萨巴还活着？

english: Yeh, he seemed very bitter.
translation: 是啊，他看起来怨气很重。

english: That's Saba alright!
translation: 那确实是萨巴！

english: I do know of a secret way up to Death Plateau, the Imperial Guard would be able to use it at night and not be seen until it was too late!
translation: 我确实知道一条上死亡高原的秘密通道，帝国守卫可以在夜里使用，等被发现时已经来不及了！

english: I'd be happy to show you it if you do something for me first.
translation: 如果你先帮我做件事，我很乐意带你去看。

english: Name it.
translation: 说吧。

english: I don't get into town much and I'm getting low on supplies. I need ten loaves of bread and ten cooked trout, that should see me through the winter.
translation: 我不常进城，补给品快用完了。我需要十条面包和十条熟鳟鱼，这样应该能撑过冬天。

english: Yes. My climbing boots need to have new spikes, so can you take them to Dunstan in Burthorpe? He always puts my spikes on for me.
translation: 对了。我的登山靴需要换新的尖刺，你能把它们拿到伯索普公国给邓斯坦吗？他总是帮我装尖刺。

english: OK, I'll get those for you.
translation: 好，我去帮你弄来。

english: Thank you traveller!
translation: 谢谢你，旅行者！

english: I'll find the secret way for myself.
translation: 我自己来找这条秘密路径。

english: Has Dunstan added spikes to my climbing boots yet?
translation: 邓斯坦给我的登山靴加上尖刺了吗？

english: Well, when he has, bring the boots to me with ten loaves of bread and ten cooked trout. I have to prepare for the winter, after all.
translation: 嗯，弄好之后，把靴子带给我，再加十块面包和十条烤鳟鱼。毕竟我得为冬天做准备。

english: Hi! How can I help?
translation: 嗨！有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Tenzing has asked me to bring you his climbing boots, he needs to have spikes put on them.
translation: 丹增让我把他的登山靴带给你，他需要在靴子上装尖刺。

english: He does, does he? Well I won't do it till he pays for the last set I made for him!
translation: 他想要，是吗？哼，他上次给我做的钱还没付清呢，这事儿免谈！

english: This is really important!
translation: 这件事真的很重要！

english: Well, I need the Sherpa to show me a secret way up Death Plateau so that the Imperial Guard can destroy the troll camp! He won't help me till I've got the spikes!
translation: 我需要那位夏尔巴向导带我找到一条上死亡高原的秘密路径，这样帝国守卫才能摧毁巨魔营地！他不拿到尖刺就不肯帮我！

english: Hmm. That's different!
translation: 嗯……这倒是不一样了！

english: Tell you what, I'll make them for you on one condition.
translation: 这样吧，我可以帮你做，但有一个条件。

english: *sigh* What's the condition?
translation: *叹气* 什么条件？

english: My son has just turned 16 and I'd very much like him to join the Imperial Guard. The Prince's elite forces are invite only so it's very unlikely he'll get in. If you can arrange that you have a deal!
translation: 我儿子刚满16岁，我很希望他能加入帝国守卫。殿下精英部队只接受邀请，所以他基本没机会进去。要是你能安排这事，咱们就成交！

english: That won't be a problem as I'm helping out the Imperial Guard!
translation: 这没问题，我正好在帮帝国守卫办事！

english: Excellent! You'll need to bring an Iron bar for the spikes!
translation: 太好了！你需要带一块铁锭来做尖刺！

english: Have you managed to get my son signed up for the Imperial Guard?
translation: 你把我儿子弄进帝国守卫了吗？

english: Not yet! I just need to speak to Denulth!
translation: 还没！我只需要跟德努斯谈谈！

english: Hello citizen, have you found another way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你好，市民，你找到上死亡高原的另一条路了吗？

english: Yes there is another way up Death Plateau!
translation: 是的，上死亡高原还有另一条路！

english: We are saved!
translation: 我们有救了！

english: There's one thing...
translation: 不过有一件事……

english: And what is that citizen?
translation: 什么事，市民？

english: There is a Sherpa who will only show me the secret way if I first get some spikes for his climbing boots. The smith will only do this for me if you sign up his son for the Imperial Guard!
translation: 有位夏尔巴向导，只有我先把他的登山靴装上尖刺，他才肯带我走秘密路径。而铁匠只有在您把他儿子招进帝国守卫后，才肯帮我做尖刺。

english: Hmm...this is very irregular.
translation: 嗯……这很不合规矩。

english: Will you not do this?
translation: 您不愿意这么做吗？

english: I have heard of Dunstan's son, he is a very promising young man. For the sake of your mission we can make an exception!
translation: 我听说过邓斯坦的儿子，他是个很有出息的年轻人。看在你的任务份上，我们可以破例一次！

english: This certificate proves that we have accepted Dunstan's son for training in the Imperial Guard!
translation: 这张证书证明我们已经接收邓斯坦的儿子进入帝国守卫训练！

english: Thank you Denulth, I shall be back shortly!
translation: 谢谢你，德努斯，我很快就回来！

english: Hello citizen, have you found the secret way up Death Plateau?
translation: 你好，市民，你找到上死亡高原的秘密路径了吗？

english: I'm working on it but I've lost the certificate!
translation: 我正在办，但我把证书弄丢了！

english: No problem, I have a duplicate.
translation: 没问题，我有一份副本。

english: I have but I don't have the entrance certificate on me.
translation: 我找到了，但我身上没带那张进入证书。

english: Good but I need to have the certificate.
translation: 很好，但我必须有证书才行。

english: Now to keep my end of the bargain. Give me the boots and an iron bar and I'll put on the spikes.
translation: 现在该我履行承诺了。把靴子和铁锭给我，我就装上尖刺。

english: I don't have the iron bar or the climbing boots.
translation: 我既没有铁锭也没有登山靴。

english: I don't have the climbing boots.
translation: 我没有登山靴。

english: I don't have the iron bar.
translation: 我没有铁锭。

english: I see you've got the spiked boots. Are you going to take them to the Sherpa?
translation: 我看到你拿到钉鞋了。你打算送去给夏尔巴人吗？

english: I will do shortly.
translation: 我很快就去。

english: Have you brought me the items I asked for?
translation: 你把我要的东西带来了吗？

english: I've lost the climbing boots.
translation: 我把登山靴弄丢了。

english: These are expensive, do not lose another pair!
translation: 这靴子很贵的，别再弄丢第二双了！

english: I don't have the: Spiked boots. Ten loaves of bread. Ten cooked trout.
translation: 我没有：钉鞋。十块面包。十条烤鳟鱼。

english: I don't have the: Spiked boots. Ten loaves of bread.
translation: 我没有：钉鞋。十块面包。

english: I don't have the: Spiked boots. Ten cooked trout.
translation: 我没有：钉鞋。十条烤鳟鱼。

english: I don't have the: Ten loaves of bread. Ten cooked trout.
translation: 我没有：十块面包。十条烤鳟鱼。

english: I don't have the: Spiked boots.
translation: 我没有：钉鞋。

english: I don't have the: Ten loaves of bread.
translation: 我没有：十块面包。

english: I don't have the: Ten cooked trout.
translation: 我没有：十条烤鳟鱼。

english: Thank you very much traveller. I'm now ready for the winter!
translation: 非常感谢你，旅者。我现在准备好过冬了！

english: You said you would show me the secret way to Death Plateau?
translation: 你说过你会带我走通往死亡高原的秘密路径？

english: Yes, of course! I drew up a map in case I ever needed to use it again.
translation: 当然！我画了一张地图，以备将来再用。

english: I don't think the Trolls have found the secret way yet, if they had I would've been attacked by now.
translation: 我觉得巨魔还没发现这条秘密路径，要是发现了，我早就被袭击了。

english: OK thanks but I think I'd better check the path. I don't want to send the Imperial Guards to their death!
translation: 好的，谢谢。但我最好还是先去探探路，我可不想让帝国守卫去送死！

english: You are wise for one so young.
translation: 你这么年轻就这么明智。

english: Hello Tenzing!
translation: 你好，丹增！

english: Hello again traveller. What can I do for you?
translation: 又见面了，旅者。我能为你做点什么？

english: I've lost the secret way map.
translation: 我把秘密路径地图弄丢了。

english: Never mind. I'll quickly draw you another one.
translation: 没关系，我马上再给你画一张。

english: To get back to Burthorpe follow the path going east.
translation: 要回伯索普公国，沿着往东的路走就行。

english: I thought you were going to investigate the secret way to Death Plateau? Use the back door to my hut, hop over the stile and follow that path.
translation: 我以为你要去探查通往死亡高原的秘密路径？从我小屋的后门出去，翻过阶梯，顺着那条路走。

english: Oh yes, of course! Thanks!
translation: 哦对，当然！谢谢！

english: Go in peace traveller.
translation: 一路平安，旅者。

english: I'm working on it!
translation: 我正在办呢！

english: I think this is far enough, I can see Death Plateau and it looks like the trolls haven't found the path. I'd better go and tell Denulth.
translation: 我想走到这里就够了，我能看到死亡高原，看起来巨魔还没发现这条路。我最好回去告诉德努斯。

english: Yes! There is a path that runs from a Sherpa's hut around the back of Death Plateau. The trolls haven't found it yet. The Sherpa made a map I can give you.
translation: 是的！有一条路从夏尔巴人的小屋出发，绕过死亡高原的背面。巨魔还没发现它。夏尔巴人画了一张地图，我可以给你。

english: I don't have the map on me.
translation: 我身上没带地图。

english: Excellent, this looks perfect. They will never see us coming.
translation: 太棒了，看起来完美无缺。他们绝对想不到我们会来。

english: Have you managed to open the equipment room?
translation: 你打开装备室了吗？

english: I have opened the door but I don't have the combination on me.
translation: 我打开了门，但我身上没带组合。

english: Yes! The door is open and here is the combination.
translation: 是的！门开了，这是组合。

english: Well done citizen! We will reward you by training you in attack!
translation: 干得好，市民！我们将奖励你，训练你的攻击技能！

english: Hello citzen, I have the map of the secret way you gave me earlier.
translation: 你好，市民，我有你之前给我的那条秘密路径的地图。

english: I have the combination to the equipment room that you recovered for me.
translation: 我有你帮我找回的装备室组合。

english: It is good to see you again! The Dorgeshuun Council would like to ask a favour of you, if you are interested?
translation: 很高兴再次见到你！多吉舒恩议会想请你帮个忙，你有兴趣吗？

english: What is this favour?
translation: 什么忙？

english: Surface-dwellers have been visiting the mines for some time now, but no Dorgeshuun has yet visited the surface.
translation: 地表居民来矿里已经有一阵子了，但还没有多吉舒恩人去到过地表。

english: We are curious about the surface, and we are also worried about the dangers it poses. We know that Lumbridge is friendly but we are worried that the HAM group may be plotting against us.
translation: 我们对地表很好奇，但也担心它带来的危险。我们知道仑桥镇很友好，但担心HAM组织可能在密谋对付我们。

english: We are planning to send an agent to the surface and we would like you to act as a guide.
translation: 我们计划派一名特工到地表，希望你能担任向导。

english: I'll act as a guide.
translation: 我来当向导。

english: In order to get into the HAM base undetected you will both need to go in disguise. You should get two full sets of HAM robes. Once you have them, our agent will meet you in the cellar of Lumbridge castle.
translation: 为了不被发现地潜入HAM基地，你们俩都需要伪装。你得弄两套完整的HAM长袍。拿到之后，我们的特工会在仑桥镇城堡的地窖里和你碰头。

english: I'm too busy.
translation: 我太忙了。

english: Oh dear! Our agent is ready, but the Council will not let an expedition go ahead without a guide. If you reconsider, please let me know!
translation: 哦，天哪！我们的特工已经准备好了，但议会说没有向导就不能进行探险。如果你改变主意了，请告诉我！

english: You must be the famous [player name]!
translation: 你一定就是大名鼎鼎的[player name]了！

english: Yes, I'm [player name]!
translation: 是的，我就是[player name]！

english: Pleased to meet you! I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 很高兴见到你！我是多吉舒恩的扎尼克！

english: I can't wait to see the surface! But first you need to get us both sets of HAM robes.
translation: 我等不及要看地表了！但首先你得给我们俩弄到HAM长袍。

english: Where do I get the robes?
translation: 我去哪里弄长袍？

english: How should I know? You're the surface-dweller! Maybe you could steal them from the HAM people or something.
translation: 我怎么知道？你才是地表居民！也许你可以从HAM那些人那里偷来，或者用其他办法。

english: We'll need two sets of full robes: shirt, robe, hood, cloak, gloves, boots and badge.
translation: 我们需要两套完整的长袍：衬衫、长袍、兜帽、斗篷、手套、靴子和徽章。

english: Aren't you scared of the surface?
translation: 你不害怕地表吗？

english: Well... a bit. All our legends say it's a terrible place.
translation: 嗯……有一点。我们所有的传说都说那是个可怕的地方。

english: But that's a bad reason not to visit it. Maybe the legends are wrong. Or even if they're right, we should know for sure.
translation: 但这不能成为不去看看的理由。也许传说是错的。就算它们是对的，我们也应该亲眼确认。

english: And I've always wondered... what's beyond the next cave? What's at the end of every tunnel? The surface is a whole new world to explore, and I can't wait!
translation: 而且我一直想知道……下一个洞穴后面是什么？每条隧道的尽头又是什么？地表是一个全新的世界等着去探索，我已经等不及了！

english: What's that mark on your forehead?
translation: 你额头上那个印记是什么？

english: I, er, er...
translation: 我，呃，呃……

english: To be honest I don't know. It happened when...
translation: 说实话，我也不知道。那是在……的时候发生的。

english: If you don't mind, I'd rather not talk about it now. Maybe once you've shown me some of the surface.
translation: 如果你不介意的话，我现在不太想谈这个。也许等你带我见识了一些地表风光之后再说吧。

english: No, I'm not [player name].
translation: 不，我不是[player name]。

english: Hi [player name]! Have you got our disguises yet?
translation: 嗨，[player name]！你拿到我们的伪装了吗？

english: I'm so looking forward to seeing the surface. But the Council insists that I get the disguise first.
translation: 我真的很期待看到地表。但议会坚持要我先把伪装弄好。

english: Yes, I have two sets of robes!
translation: 是的，我有两套长袍了！

english: You should pick up your pet thingy. It would only get in the way.
translation: 你应该先把你的宠物那玩意儿收起来。它会碍事的。

english: All right, let's go! I can't wait to see all around Lumbridge!
translation: 好了，我们走吧！我等不及要看看仑桥镇周围的一切了！

english: What are we waiting for? Let's go!
translation: 我们还在等什么？走吧！

english: All right. I'll wait for you in the castle cellar.
translation: 好吧。我在城堡地窖等你。

english: Aren't you going to put on your disguise?
translation: 你不穿上你的伪装吗？

english: There's no need for that yet. Why don't you show me around Lumbridge first? I'm so excited about visiting the surface!
translation: 现在还不需要。不如你先带我逛逛仑桥镇？能来地表我真是太兴奋了！

english: I, er...
translation: 我，呃……

english: I will tell you, [player name], but not just yet. Finish showing me around Lumbridge and then I'll tell you.
translation: 我会告诉你的，[player name]，但不是现在。等你带我逛完仑桥镇，我就告诉你。

english: Follow me!
translation: 跟我来！

english: Are you ready to finish our tour now?
translation: 你准备好结束我们的游览了吗？

english: Where are we? I thought that ladder led to the surface.
translation: 我们在哪？我以为那个梯子是通往地表的。

english: We are on the surface! We're in Lumbridge Castle!
translation: 我们就在地表！我们在仑桥镇城堡里！

english: It's so enclosed, it could almost be underground. Let's go outside, [player name]! I want to see the sun!
translation: 这里好封闭，几乎跟地下一样。我们出去吧，[player name]！我想看太阳！

english: So this is the surface!
translation: 原来这就是地表！

english: What's that? The giant light?
translation: 那是什么？那个巨大的光？

english: That's the sun.
translation: 那是太阳。

english: It's so bright! I can't look at it!
translation: 好亮啊！我没办法直视它！

english: But it's amazing to think that there's nothing above me. Just the sun and the air and empty space, forever...
translation: 但想到我头顶上什么都没有，只有太阳、空气和无尽的虚空，真是不可思议……

english: For generations my people have lived with rock over our heads. But now I can see the sky!
translation: 世世代代，我的人民都生活在岩石之下。但现在，我终于能看到天空了！

english: We can't go into the HAM lair yet! I'm not wearing my disguise!
translation: 我们还不能进HAM的老巢！我没穿伪装呢！

english: You said you'd show me around Lumbridge before we went down there, [player name].
translation: 你说过在我们下去之前，你会带我逛逛仑桥镇的，[player name]。

english: I'm going down anyway.
translation: 我还是要下去。

english: I'll wait for you back in the castle then.
translation: 那我回城堡等你。

english: Oi! No outsiders can mine our rocks.
translation: 喂！外人不能开采我们的岩石。

english: Big High War God say so! He make us strong!
translation: 大高战神说的！他让我们变得强大！

english: Peace is for weak. We goblins! We strong!
translation: 和平是弱者的事。我们是哥布林！我们很强！

english: Culture?
translation: 文化？

english: I'm sorry, [player name]. I'd like to show you around the city, but the council has decided not to let any surface-dwellers in yet.
translation: 对不起，[player name]。我很想带你逛逛城市，但议会决定暂时不让任何地表居民进入。

english: Eeek! What is it?
translation: 呀！这是什么？

english: A cave goblin? Well, there goes the neighbourhood!
translation: 一个洞穴哥布林？好吧，这地方算是完了！

english: It's all very well the duke signing a peace treaty with those creatures. Maybe that'll stop them attacking us.
translation: 公爵和那些生物签署和平条约倒也没什么。也许这能阻止他们攻击我们。

english: But for them to come wandering around the surface and mixing with decent people? I don't know, what's the world coming to?
translation: 但他们在地表到处乱逛，和正经人混在一起？我不知道，这世界到底要变成什么样？

english: We were never going to attack you! YOU nearly attacked US!
translation: 我们从来没打算攻击你！是你们差点攻击了我们！

english: Oh, they may say they're civilised, but they're still goblins. You can't trust them. The only reason they're not a threat is that they're so stupid.
translation: 哦，他们也许说自己文明了，但他们终究是哥布林。你不能相信他们。他们之所以不是威胁，唯一的原因就是他们太蠢了。

english: Stop talking about me like I'm not here!
translation: 别当我不存在一样议论我！

english: Keep away from me you dirty goblin!
translation: 离我远点，你这肮脏的哥布林！

english: I don't know, what will be next? Cave goblins LIVING up here? Taking our jobs? I wouldn't want my daughter to marry a goblin!
translation: 我不知道，接下来会是什么？洞穴哥布林住到上面来？抢我们的工作？我可不想让我女儿嫁给一个哥布林！

english: I'm not sure a Dorgeshuun would want to marry a human!
translation: 我不确定多吉舒恩人是否想和人类结婚！

english: What rudeness! This is why they say goblins have no manners!
translation: 真粗鲁！难怪人们说哥布林没礼貌！

english: Oh, I've got nothing against goblins in their own place. I just don't think they ought to be wandering around in our city and making the place look bad.
translation: 哦，我对哥布林待在他们自己的地方没意见。我只是觉得他们不该在我们的城市里乱逛，把地方搞得乌烟瘴气。

english: Goblins wandering around Lumbridge and talking to the duke like they're normal people? I don't know what the world's coming to.
translation: 哥布林在仑桥镇到处乱逛，还像正常人一样和公爵说话？我不知道这世界要变成什么样了。

english: It just makes me uncomfortable, is all. What if I was in bed and some horrible little goblin poked its head up through the floor?
translation: 只是让我觉得不舒服，仅此而已。要是我在床上睡觉，某个可怕的小哥布林从地板里探出头来怎么办？

english: We would never do that! We don't tunnel upwards and we're very careful not to damage human cellars.
translation: 我们绝不会那么做！我们不会向上挖隧道，而且我们非常小心，不会损坏人类的地窖。

english: You cave goblins... don't you, you know, eat people?
translation: 你们这些洞穴哥布林……你们不会，呃，吃人吧？

english: Oh! Well, that's all right then.
translation: 哦！好吧，那没事了。

english: It's good to see a visitor from the Dorgeshuun! I am Duke Horacio.
translation: 很高兴见到多吉舒恩来的访客！我是霍拉西奥公爵。

english: I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun! Headman Ur-Tag sends his greetings.
translation: 我是多吉舒恩的扎尼克！酋长乌尔.塔格向你问好。

english: Tell Ur-Tag that I wish to speak with him again. I think that our cities could profit from trading with one another, but there can be little trade if he does not allow visitors to enter the city.
translation: 告诉乌尔.塔格，我希望再和他谈谈。我认为我们的城市可以通过贸易互惠互利，但如果他不允许访客进入城市，贸易就无从谈起。

english: I know! But the ruling council is so slow to make decisions. It's made up of old fogeys who are set in their ways.
translation: 我知道！但统治议会做决定太慢了。它由一群固步自封的老顽固组成。

english: Now then, child, there is room for caution and experience in politics.
translation: 好了，孩子，政治中需要谨慎和经验。

english: Maybe when I return I can convince them to open the gates of the city.
translation: 也许等我回去后，能说服他们打开城市的大门。

english: I'd like to get into the city too.
translation: 我也想进城看看。

english: I wish I could show it to you, [player name]!
translation: 我希望我能带你参观，[player name]！

english: Someday I will, but I don't think the council will agree to open the doors any time soon.
translation: 总有一天会的，但我不认为议会会很快同意开门。

english: Tell me about the treaty.
translation: 给我讲讲条约的事。

english: It basically defines the borders between our two societies. It's not usual for two states to be above one another rather than side-by-side!
translation: 它基本上界定了我们两个社会之间的边界。两个国家一个在上一个在下，而不是并排，这可不常见！

english: Everything above ground, within the borders of Lumbridge, belongs to Lumbridge. Everything below ground belongs to the Dorgeshuun. Except for the cellars of our buildings, those belong to Lumbridge.
translation: 仑桥镇边界内，地面以上的一切都属于仑桥镇。地面以下的一切都属于多吉舒恩。但我们建筑的地窖除外，那些属于仑桥镇。

english: Of course both our underground systems might expand. Neither state can build new tunnels that are too close to the other's systems...
translation: 当然，我们双方的地下系统都可能会扩张。任何一方都不能建造过于靠近对方系统的新隧道……

english: This is boring. Let's go.
translation: 真无聊。我们走吧。

english: Have you heard of any HAM activity lately?
translation: 你最近听说过HAM有什么活动吗？

english: No... I know they've been gaining members but I haven't heard anything else from them. They may be planning something, but then again they may not.
translation: 没有……我知道他们一直在招募成员，但我没听到其他消息。他们可能在计划什么，但也可能没有。

english: Hello again, Zanik, [player name]. I hope you are enjoying your tour. Perhaps someday a human can have a similar tour of your city.
translation: 又见面了，扎尼克，[player name]。希望你们游览愉快。也许有一天，人类也能到你们的城市里参观一下。

english: What, er, who is this? Is it a cave goblin?
translation: 什么，呃，这位是谁？是洞穴哥布林吗？

english: Zanik is the first cave goblin to visit the surface! I'm giving her a tour of Lumbridge.
translation: 扎尼克是第一个来到地表的洞穴哥布林！我正在带她游览仑桥镇。

english: Well, er, pleased to meet you, Zanik.
translation: 嗯，呃，很高兴见到你，扎尼克。

english: In fact, it's a good thing I met you. It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake. I need eggs, flour and milk...
translation: 事实上，遇到你正好。今天是公爵的生日，我应该给他做一个大大的生日蛋糕。我需要鸡蛋、面粉和牛奶……

english: I don't know what those things are! Are they exotic surface foods?
translation: 我不知道那些是什么东西！是异域的地表食物吗？

english: Well, they're not exactly exotic, they're just the basic ingredients of a cake.
translation: 嗯，也不算异域，只是做蛋糕的基本原料。

english: If they're the basic ingredients, why don't you already have them?
translation: 如果是基本原料，你为什么没有？

english: Well, er...
translation: 嗯，呃……

english: I don't think Zanik has time to help you.
translation: 我想扎尼克没时间帮你。

english: It was worth a try. Anyway...
translation: 值得一试。总之……

english: What's that thing with the wheel?
translation: 那个带轮子的东西是什么？

english: This is my spinning wheel! Look at the way it goes round and round and round...
translation: 这是我的纺车！看它转啊转啊转……

english: It spins wool into balls so we can work it more easily.
translation: 它把羊毛纺成线球，这样我们就能更容易地加工了。

english: I don't know what wool is, but I'm sure it's fascinating!
translation: 我不知道羊毛是什么，但我肯定它很迷人！

english: What about you, [player name]?
translation: 那你呢，[player name]？

english: Well, as you can probably work out for yourself, crafting isn't exactly the usual way people like to make their weapons...
translation: 嗯，你大概也能猜到，制作并不是人们通常喜欢用来制作武器的方式……

english: Some things might be of interest, though - whether you wanted to craft a fine battlestaff for yourself, or maybe some kind of silver weapon.
translation: 不过有些东西可能会让你感兴趣——比如你想为自己制作一根精良的战杖，或者某种银制武器。

english: I heard that you're helping Farmer Fred out. That should make for some good practice for you!
translation: 我听说你在帮农夫弗雷德。这应该是个不错的练习机会！

english: Glass blowing? Well, it's used to make all kinds of things you might see every day!
translation: 玻璃吹制？嗯，它用于制作你每天可能见到的各种东西！

english: Beer glasses, lamps and lanterns, vials, fish bowls... Things like that.
translation: 啤酒杯、灯和灯笼、药水瓶、鱼缸……诸如此类的东西。

english: This is the Lumbridge branch of the Bank of Gielinor! Would you like to access your account?
translation: 这是吉林诺银行在仑桥镇的分行！您要存取您的帐户吗？

english: I don't have an account! All my belongings are safe at home in Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 我没有账户！我所有家当都安全地放在多吉需戛纳的家里！

english: To open your bank you can speak to any banker, as well as use a bank booth or bank chest. If you have a PIN setup you will be asked to enter the PIN before you are given access to your bank.
translation: 要打开你的银行，你可以与任何银行职员交谈，也可以使用银行柜台或银行箱。如果你设置了销钉设置，在获得银行访问权限之前，系统会要求你输入销钉。

english: To withdraw one item, left-click on it once. To withdraw many, right-click on the item and select from the menu. The same can be done for depositing items.
translation: 要取出一个物品，左键单击一次。要取出多个，右键点击物品并从菜单中选择。存入物品也是如此。

english: While you are in your bank you can click and drag items to move them around the bank. There are two modes for moving items, Swap or Insert.
translation: 在银行界面中，你可以点击并拖动物品来在银行内移动。移动物品有两种模式：交换或插入。

english: If you are using swap, the two items will switch place. If you are using Insert, the item you are moving will be placed either in front or behind the item you targeted with the item you are moving.
translation: 如果你使用交换，两个物品会互换位置。如果你使用插入，你移动的物品会被放置在你目标物品的前面或后面。

english: You can use bank notes on any banker to un-note the item. Alternatively, you can deposit the items into the bank. Then withdraw them as an item instead of a note.
translation: 你可以对任何银行职员使用银行票据来将物品解票。或者，你可以将物品存入银行。然后以物品形式取出，而不是票据。

english: You may withdraw 'notes' or 'certificates'. This will only work for items which are tradable and do not stack. To withdraw an Item as note, you need to select the 'note' withdraw as button.
translation: 你可以提取“票据”或“证书”。这仅适用于可交易且不堆叠的物品。要以票据形式提取物品，你需要选择“提取为票据”按钮。

english: They look like grey pillars, there's one just over there, near the desk. You can usually find a Bank deposit box next to a bank.
translation: 它们看起来像灰色柱子，那边就有一个，靠近书桌。通常你可以在银行旁边找到银行寄存箱。

english: The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect your items in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember and tell no one.
translation: 销钉——个人识别号——可以设置在您的银行账户上，以保护您的物品，以防有人发现您的账户密码。它由您记住且不告诉任何人的四个数字组成。

english: Bank deposit boxes save so much time as you do not have to enter in your bank PIN. If you're simply wanting to deposit a single item, 'Use' it on the deposit box.
translation: 银行寄存箱节省了很多时间，因为你不需要输入银行密码。如果你只是想存入单个物品，对它使用'使用'在寄存箱上。

english: The PIN - Personal Identification Number - can be set on your bank account to protect your items in case someone finds out your account password. It consists of four numbers that you remember, tell no one.
translation: 销钉——个人识别号——可以设置在您的银行账户上，以保护您的物品，以防有人发现您的账户密码。它由您记住、不告诉任何人的四个数字组成。

english: You can set your PIN by talking to any banker, they will allow you to access your bank pin settings. Here you can choose to set your pin and recovery delay.
translation: 你可以通过与任何银行职员交谈来设置你的销钉，他们会允许你访问你的银行销钉设置。在这里你可以选择设置你的销钉和恢复延迟。

english: Remember not to set it to anything personal such as your real life bank PIN or birthday. The recovery delay is to protect your banked items from account thieves.
translation: 记住不要将其设置为任何私人的东西，比如你现实生活中的银行销钉或生日。恢复延迟是为了保护你存入银行的物品免受账户盗贼的侵害。

english: If someone stole your account and asked to have the PIN deleted, they would have to wait a few days before accessing your bank account to steal your items. This will give you time to recover your account.
translation: 如果有人盗取了你的账户并要求删除PIN码，他们必须等待几天才能访问你的银行账户来盗取你的物品。这会给你时间恢复你的账户。

english: Talking to any banker will enable you to access your PIN settings. There you can cancel or change your PIN, but you will need to wait for your recovery delay to expire to be able to access your bank.
translation: 与任何银行职员交谈将使你能够访问你的销钉设置。在那里你可以取消或更改你的销钉，但你需要等待恢复延迟到期才能访问你的银行。

english: Would you like to setup a bank pin?
translation: 你想设置一个银行销钉吗？

english: If you find yourself faced with the PIN keypad and you don't know the PIN, just look on the right-hand side for a button marked 'I don't know it'. Click this button.
translation: 如果你发现自己面对PIN码键盘并且不知道PIN码，只需在右侧寻找一个标有'我不知道'的按钮。点击这个按钮。

english: This can be set in the settings page and will protect your items should your account be stolen.
translation: 这可以在设置页面中设置，并会在你的账户被盗时保护你的物品。

english: Your PIN will be deleted (after a delay of a few days) and you'll be able to use your bank as before. You may still use the bank deposit box without your PIN.
translation: 你的PIN码将被删除（经过几天的延迟），你将能够像以前一样使用你的银行。你仍然可以在没有PIN码的情况下使用银行寄存箱。

english: You already have one of those.
translation: 你已经有一个了。

english: It seems you already have a bank pin set up, but I'll remind you anyway.
translation: 看来你已经设置了一个银行销钉，但我还是提醒你一下。

english: You need at least 1,000 coins to exchange them for platinum tokens.
translation: 你需要至少1000金币才能将它们兑换成白金代币。

english: Good day, How may I help you?
translation: 你好，有什么可以帮你的？

english: Pleased to meet you, Zanik! I know not everyone in Lumbridge was pleased with the peace treaty, but I'm delighted to have new underground neighbours.
translation: 很高兴见到你，扎尼克！我知道并非所有仑桥镇的人都对和平条约满意，但我很高兴多了你们这些地底邻居。

english: I'm taking Zanik on a tour of Lumbridge. She's the first cave goblin to visit the surface!
translation: 我正带扎尼克参观仑桥镇。她是第一个来到地面的洞穴哥布林！

english: Hello Zanik! I hope you like what you find up here!
translation: 你好，扎尼克！希望你喜欢在地面上看到的一切！

english: It's amazing! The sky is so huge!
translation: 太棒了！天空这么大！

english: But I'm not sure I'd want to live under it for too long. It's kind of scary!
translation: 但我不确定自己能不能在底下待太久。有点吓人！

english: You'd get used to it!
translation: 你会习惯的！

english: Greetings adventurer. I am Phileas the Lumbridge Guide.
translation: 你好，冒险者。我是仑桥镇向导菲利亚斯。

english: Greetings Zanik! I am here to give information and directions to new players. Do you require any help?
translation: 你好，扎尼克！我是来给新玩家提供信息和指引的。你需要帮助吗？

english: No thank you! [player name] is showing me around!
translation: 不用了，谢谢！[player name]在带我四处参观！

english: Well, can I help you, [player name]?
translation: 那么，[player name]，我能帮你什么吗？

english: I'm sure you'll like them! What about you, [player name]? Can I help you?
translation: 我相信你会喜欢它们的！你呢，[player name]？需要帮忙吗？

english: Get out of my shop! GET OUT!
translation: 滚出我的店！滚出去！

english: We don't serve the likes of that thing in here.
translation: 我们不招待那种东西。

english: I don't need anything you've got to sell anyway!
translation: 反正我也没有需要你卖的东西！

english: Let's go, Zanik.
translation: 我们走吧，扎尼克。

english: And don't come back, you filthy goblin!
translation: 别再回来了，肮脏的哥布林！

english: I'm not with her.
translation: 我跟她不是一伙的。

english: Oh, well... what do you want?
translation: 哦，那……你想要什么？

english: Welcome to the church of Holy Saradomin!
translation: 欢迎来到神圣萨拉多明教堂！

english: What's a church? And what is Holy Saradomin?
translation: 什么是教堂？还有神圣萨拉多明是什么？

english: Oh, a GOD.
translation: 哦，一个神。

english: Not just A god! Saradomin is the god with more followers than any other! At least in this part of the world.
translation: 不只是神！萨拉多明是拥有最多信徒的神！至少在这一带是这样。

english: Which god do you cave goblins worship?
translation: 你们洞穴哥布林信奉哪位神？

english: We DON'T worship any god!
translation: 我们不信奉任何神！

english: Thousands of years ago the gods made our ancestors fight in horrible wars. It was only after we escaped from them that we were able to build a civilisation.
translation: 几千年前，众神逼迫我们的祖先卷入可怕的战争。直到我们逃离他们之后，才能建立起文明。

english: What god did the Dorgeshuun use to follow?
translation: 多吉需族以前信奉哪位神？

english: Our history does not remember his name. We know only that he was a violent god of war.
translation: 我们的历史没有记住他的名字。我们只知道他是一位暴虐的战争之神。

english: Sounds like Zamorak to me! Or one of the minor gods who followed him.
translation: 听上去像萨莫拉克！或者是跟随他的某个小神。

english: Saradomin would never be so barbaric.
translation: 萨拉多明绝不会这么野蛮。

english: What happened in the wars?
translation: 那些战争里发生了什么？

english: We do have stories about a war between the gods. I had always interpreted them as symbolic of the spiritual war between light and darkness in our hearts.
translation: 我们确实有些关于神战的传说。我一直以为那是象征意义上的，代表我们心中光明与黑暗的灵性斗争。

english: Dorgeshuun history remembers them as real. But we don't know much detail. Our ancestors were just footsoldiers, they didn't know what they were fighting for.
translation: 多吉需族的历史认为那是真实发生的。但我们不太清楚细节。我们的祖先只是步兵，他们不知道自己在为什么而战。

english: I am sure they were engaged in a noble struggle, although perhaps on the wrong side!
translation: 我相信他们参与了一场崇高的斗争，尽管可能是站在错误的一方！

english: Saradomin was fighting to bring goodness and order to the universe, but Zamorak was leading the forces of darkness in a bid to bring eternal night to the world!
translation: 萨拉多明作战是为了给宇宙带来善与秩序，而萨莫拉克则带领黑暗势力，企图让世界陷入永夜！

english: Our history doesn't make a distinction. There was your own god who would kill you if you refused to fight, and someone else's god who would only kill you if you lost.
translation: 我们的历史没有这种区分。只有你自己的神——如果你拒绝作战就会杀了你，和对方的神——如果你输了才会杀了你。

english: Not all the gods are bad!
translation: 并不是所有神都是坏的！

english: Quite right! The Dorgeshuun have just had bad experiences of them.
translation: 说得对！多吉需族只是对他们有不好的经历。

english: Maybe that's true. I should try to approach things with an open mind!
translation: 也许是真的。我应该试着保持开放的态度！

english: Exactly! You Dorgeshuun have lived in darkness for too long. But now you can come into the light of Holy Saradomin!
translation: 没错！你们多吉需族在黑暗中生活太久了。但现在你们可以进入神圣萨拉多明的光明之中！

english: We don't like bright lights. They hurt our eyes.
translation: 我们不喜欢亮光。会伤眼睛。

english: May Saradomin bless you in all your pursuits!
translation: 愿萨拉多明保佑你的一切追求！

english: I can manage without Saradomin, but thanks anyway.
translation: 没有萨拉多明我也能过得去，不过还是谢谢。

english: Greetings, Zanik! Listen to the wind in the trees...
translation: 你好，扎尼克！听听风穿过树叶的声音……

english: Are these trees then?
translation: 这些就是树吗？

english: Of course! What did you think they were?
translation: 当然！你以为它们是什么？

english: I don't know! I've never visited the surface before!
translation: 我不知道！我以前从没来过地面！

english: Shall I show you how to chop trees and make fires then?
translation: 要不要我教你怎么砍树生火？

english: Perhaps some other time. Right now I'm just looking around.
translation: 改天吧。我现在只想四处看看。

english: How about you, [player name]?
translation: 那你呢，[player name]？

english: Well, go chop down a few mahogany trees and sell the timber; then you'll be able to afford one.
translation: 嗯，去砍几棵桃花心木，卖掉木材；然后你就能买得起了。

english: Also, look out for birds' nests, you never know what our feathered friends have been collecting. Clue scrolls maybe?
translation: 另外，留意鸟巢，你永远不知道我们的羽毛朋友收集了什么。也许是线索卷轴？

english: Now, if you're looking for quests, head over to the Monastery south of Ardougne and find Brother Omad to investigate the theft of a blanket.
translation: 现在，如果你在找任务，去阿多尼城南部的修道院，找到奥马德修士，调查一条毯子被盗的事件。

english: I could show you on your map if you would like?
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以在你的地图上指给你看？

english: You don't seem to have any space so I canm't give you another tinderbox.
translation: 你似乎没有空间了，所以我不能再给你一个火绒盒。

english: If you had a tinderbox with you, click on the tinderbox, then click on one of the logs in your inventory, this will attempt to light a fire that you can use for cooking.
translation: 如果你随身带着火绒盒，点击火绒盒，然后点击背包中的一根原木，这样就会尝试生火，你可以用来烹饪。

english: I'm sorry, I can't give you one here. Try talking to me later.
translation: 抱歉，我现在不能给你一个。稍后再找我吧。

english: Hello there, Zanik! You look like you know your ores!
translation: 你好啊，扎尼克！你看起来对矿石很在行！

english: Well, I know iron and silver. What other ores are there?
translation: 嗯，我认识铁和银。还有哪些别的矿石？

english: There are all sorts! Mithril, adamantite, runite... shall I tell you about them?
translation: 种类多了！秘银、精金、符文……要不要我给你讲讲？

english: Ahh you'll need to learn to smith. You can use bronze bars on the anvil outside with a hammer.
translation: 啊，你得先学锻造。用铜条和锤子在外的铁砧上就能打。

english: But for the best advice, go to Varrock. That's where my master, the Smithing Tutor, plies his trade. Ask him to teach you how to smith.
translation: 不过要最好的建议，就去维洛克城。我的老师——锻造导师在那里谋生。让他教你如何锻造。

english: Alternatively you can run up to Varrock and smith your metal immediately after smelting it. Look for my Master, the Smithing Tutor, in the west of the city.
translation: 或者你可以跑到维洛克城，在冶炼之后立即锻造金属。在城西寻找我的主人，锻造导师。

english: Hi, Zanik! I see you know how to handle a bow!
translation: 嗨，扎尼克！我看你会用弓！

english: They tell me I'm an expert with the bone crossbow!
translation: 他们都说我是骨弩专家！

english: You don't need any more help, then. How about you, [player name]?
translation: 那你就不需要更多帮助了。你呢，[player name]？

english: Greetings Zanik! You look like someone who might know something about spells!
translation: 你好，扎尼克！你看上去像是懂点法术的人！

english: Actually I don't know anything about spells.
translation: 其实我对法术一窍不通。

english: Well, if you have some air runes and mind runes you can cast Wind Strike...
translation: 嗯，如果你有空气符文和意念符文，就可以施展风弹术……

english: You can't even cast Wind Strike?
translation: 你连风弹术都不会？

english: We Dorgeshuun don't have any magical knowledge at all.
translation: 我们多吉需族根本没有魔法知识。

english: Well, if you don't know the basics at all it'll take a long time to teach you...
translation: 好吧，如果你连基础都不会，那教起来可得花很长时间……

english: Perhaps some other time then.
translation: 那改天再说吧。

english: How about you, [player name]? Do you want any help?
translation: 那你呢，[player name]？需要帮忙吗？

english: Ho there Zanik! You look like a strong fighter!
translation: 嘿，扎尼克！你看起来是个强壮的战士！

english: I've been training on giant frogs!
translation: 我一直在拿巨型青蛙练手！

english: Greetings, Zanik! Dedication's what you need.
translation: 你好，扎尼克！需要的正是毅力。

english: Because training your prayer takes a long time!
translation: 因为训练祈祷要花很长时间！

english: I don't want to train prayer! I can manage without asking the gods for favours!
translation: 我不想训练祈祷！没有神的眷顾我也能行！

english: Suit yourself. How about you, [player name]?
translation: 随你便。你呢，[player name]？

english: The most common way to train prayer is by burying bones to offer them to the gods.
translation: 训练祈祷最常见的方式是埋葬骨头，将它们献给诸神。

english: I think you should be teaching me a thing or two, shouldn't you? Well, if you really want my advice...
translation: 我觉得应该是你教我几招才对，不是吗？好吧，如果你真的想要我的建议……

english: If you want to know what ore's in a rock before you mine it, right-click the rock and select prospect from the menu. It will take a little time, but you'll find out what's in the rock before you mine.
translation: 如果你想在开采之前知道岩石里有什么矿石，右键点击岩石，然后从菜单中选择“探矿”。这需要一点时间，但你能在开采前知道岩石里有什么。

english: You can also tell the ore you'll get from the colour of the rock.
translation: 你也可以通过岩石的颜色来判断会得到什么矿石。

english: Be careful though, the bats in the mine will attack you.
translation: 不过要小心，矿里的蝙蝠会攻击你。

english: You could start by traveling to the Al Kharid mine. Follow the path north and pass through the gate. Head north after passing through the gate and you will find the mine.
translation: 你可以先前往阿尔卡里德城的矿场。沿着小路向北走，穿过大门。穿过大门后继续向北，你就会找到矿场。

english: If you want to know what ore's in a rock before you mine it, right-click the rock and select prospect from the menu. Iu. Ill take a little time, but you'll find out what's in the rock before you mine.
translation: 如果你想在开采之前知道岩石里有什么矿石，右键点击岩石，然后从菜单中选择“探矿”。Iu. 这需要一点时间，但你能在开采前知道岩石里有什么。

english: Ahoy there Zanik! You look like you know your hook from your bait!
translation: 嘿，扎尼克！你看上去分得清鱼钩和鱼饵！

english: You're fishing?
translation: 你在钓鱼？

english: Arrr, that I am!
translation: 啊，没错！

english: I thought fish only lived in dark pools in caves! I didn't know you had them on the surface too!
translation: 我以为鱼只生活在洞穴里的黑水潭中！不知道地面上也有！

english: Of course we do! Are you going to try to catch some?
translation: 当然有！你要不要试着抓几条？

english: Perhaps some other time!
translation: 也许改天吧！

english: Aye, as you get better and better you'll find that you can fish things like Tuna and Swordfish. These be very good for combat.
translation: 没错，随着你越来越熟练，你会发现你可以钓到金枪鱼和剑鱼之类的东西。它们对战斗非常有益。

english: Arrr, choose carefully where and what you fish, you can get different fish in different places throughout the land.
translation: 啊，仔细选择钓鱼的地点和鱼种，在这片大陆的不同地方可以钓到不同的鱼。

english: You can use that Lobster cage from the pier on the island of Karamja to get yourself a whole bunch of the little critters once you reach level 40.
translation: 等你达到40级，就可以用卡拉姆詹岛码头上的那个龙虾笼抓一大堆这种小家伙了。

english: Are those... goblins?
translation: 那些……是哥布林吗？

english: H-hello? Goblin?
translation: 你……你好？哥布林？

english: Yes! The Dorgeshuun tribe? We live underground. We've been cut off from other goblins for generations but now we're back!
translation: 是的！多吉需族？我们住在地下。我们与其他哥布林隔绝了好几代，但现在我们回来了！

english: We, er, we're your distant cousins? We want to learn about your culture.
translation: 呃，我们是你的远房表亲？我们想了解你们的文明。

english: Your art! Your philosophy! Your way of life! Now that the godwars are over you must have been able to build a peaceful civilisation!
translation: 你们的艺术！你们的哲学！你们的生活方式！既然诸神之战结束了，你们一定已经建立起和平的文明了吧！

english: Why is peace for the weak?
translation: 为什么和平是孱弱的表现？

english: Big High War...
translation: 高高大战争……

english: Oh. I see.
translation: 哦。我明白了。

english: Let's go, [player name].
translation: 我们走吧，[player name]。

english: You may pass if you pay the toll, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.
translation: 付过路费就可以过去，但你的哥布林朋友必须留在这边。

english: You may pass, for you are a friend of Al Kharid, but your goblin friend must stay on this side.
translation: 你可以通过，因为你是阿尔卡里德城的朋友，但你的哥布林朋友必须待在这一边。

english: As you wish. Don't go too near the scorpions.
translation: 如你所愿。别太靠近蝎子。

english: The money goes to the city of Al-Kharid. Will you pay the toll?
translation: 这笔钱归阿尔卡里德城所有。你愿意支付通行费吗？

english: You don't have enough coins!
translation: 你的金币不够！

english: But Zanik isn't like other goblins!
translation: 但扎尼克和其他哥布林不一样！

english: Never mind, [player name]. I don't think we need to go to Al Kharid anyway!
translation: 没关系，[player name]。反正我觉得我们也不需要去阿尔卡里德城！

english: Your land?
translation: 你的地？

english: Yes, my land! This is my farm!
translation: 对，我的地！这是我的农场！

english: I'm sorry! I didn't realize. I'm Zanik of the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 对不起！我没注意到。我是多吉需族的扎尼克！

english: So you're one of them cave goblins, then? I suppose you weren't to know.
translation: 那你就是他们说的洞穴哥布林了？我想你也是不知道。

english: What are those things outside?
translation: 外面那些东西是什么？

english: Things? There's more than one now?
translation: 东西？不止一个了？

english: There are lots of them! You know, the white fluffy things?
translation: 有很多！你知道，那些白白的毛茸茸的东西？

english: Oh, you mean my sheep!
translation: 哦，你说的是我的羊！

english: 'Sheep'! Finding all these strange surface creatures is so exciting!
translation: '羊'！发现所有这些奇怪的地表生物真是太令人兴奋了！

english: But as for YOU...
translation: 但至于你……

english: This is Mill Lane Mill.  Millers of the finest flour in Gielinor, and home to the Miller family for many generations
translation: 这里是磨坊巷磨坊。吉列诺最优质面粉的磨制者，也是磨坊主家族世代居住的家园。

english: I don't care! I'm still meditating!
translation: 我不管！我还在冥想呢！

english: No thank you, I have a lantern of my own!
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我自己有灯笼！

english: Oh! Who are you? Some kind of goblin?
translation: 哦！你是谁？某种哥布林吗？

english: The Dorgeshuun live in the caves beneath the swamp. I made contact with them and now I'm giving Zanik a tour or the surface!
translation: 多吉舒恩族住在沼泽下的洞穴里。我和他们取得了联系，现在正带扎尼克参观地表呢！

english: Oh, that's good! And it's all down to the candles I sold! So do you want to buy another one?
translation: 哦，那太好了！这都归功于我卖出的蜡烛！所以你想再买一根吗？

english: I should warn you, though, it can be dangerous to take a naked flame down there.  You'd be better off making a lantern.
translation: 不过我得警告你，带着明火下去很危险。你最好做个灯笼。

english: So you could go off to the candle shop to buy one more cheaply.  You could even make your own lantern, which is a lot better.
translation: 所以你可以去蜡烛店买一个更便宜的。你甚至可以自己做一个灯笼，那会好得多。

english: But I bet you want to find out what's down there right now, don't you?  And you can pay me 1000 gold for the privilege!
translation: 但我打赌你现在就想知道下面有什么，对吧？你可以付我1000金币作为特权！

english: Out of glass.  The more advanced lanterns have a metal component as well.
translation: 用玻璃做的。更高级的灯笼还有金属部件。

english: Firstly you can make a simple candle lantern out of glass.  It's just like a candle, but the flame isn't exposed, so it's safer.
translation: 首先，你可以用玻璃做一个简单的蜡烛灯笼。它就像蜡烛一样，但火焰不暴露，所以更安全。

english: Then you can make an oil lamp, which is brighter but has an exposed flame.  But if you make an iron frame for it you can turn it into an oil lantern.
translation: 然后你可以做一个油灯，它更亮，但火焰暴露。不过如果你给它做一个铁框架，就可以把它变成油灯笼。

english: Finally there's the bullseye lantern.  You'll need to make a frame out of steel and add a glass lens.
translation: 最后是聚光灯笼。你需要用钢做一个框架，再加一个玻璃透镜。

english: Once you've made your lamp or lantern, you'll need to make lamp oil for it.  The chemist near Rimmington has a machine for that.
translation: 一旦你做好了灯或灯笼，你需要为它制作灯油。里明顿村附近的化学家有一台机器可以做到。

english: For any light source, you'll need a tinderbox to light it.  Keep your tinderbox handy in case it goes out!
translation: 对于任何光源，你都需要火绒盒来点燃它。把火绒盒放在手边，以防熄灭！

english: Hello Zanik, hello [player name]. How is your exploration of the surface going?
translation: 你好，扎尼克，你好，[player name]。你们对地表的探索进行得怎么样了？

english: I've hardly SEEN the surface yet! [player name] just dragged me back down here!
translation: 我几乎还没怎么看到地表呢！[player name] 直接把我拖回这里了！

english: Hello, Zanik! Hello, surface-dweller! Would you like me to lead you to the mines?
translation: 你好，扎尼克！你好，地表居民！需要我带你们去矿场吗？

english: Hello, Kazgar!
translation: 你好，卡兹加！

english: I ought to visit the Duke of Lumbridge while I'm here. Ur-Tag asked me to give him his regards.
translation: 既然来了，我应该去拜访一下仑桥镇公爵。乌尔.塔格让我代他向他问好。

english: Duke Horacio seemed nice. But politics is just as boring up here as it is at home!
translation: 霍拉西奥公爵看起来人不错。但政治在这里和在家里一样无聊！

english: There are so many people around! You must introduce me to them, [player name]!
translation: 这里人真多！你得把我介绍给他们，[player name]！

english: It's a pity some people up here don't like me. I suppose I should have expected that.
translation: 可惜这里有些人不太喜欢我。我想我早该料到的。

english: But at least you're friendly, [player name]!
translation: 但至少你很友好，[player name]！

english: Why don't you take me to a shop? I promised Tignik I would bring back a souvenir from the surface.
translation: 不如带我去商店吧？我答应过提格尼克要从地表带个纪念品回去。
