english: This 'wood' is an odd material. It's heavier than bone but it doesn't seem to be as brittle. It would be good for making crossbows out of!
translation: 这种叫'木头'的材料真奇怪。比骨头重，但似乎没那么脆。用来做弩弓肯定不错！

english: Are there still goblins living on the surface, [player name]? Are there any near Lumbridge?
translation: 地表上还有哥布林居住吗，[player name]？仑桥镇附近有吗？

english: I should reunite the two sides of the race!
translation: 我应该让这个种族的两边重新团结起来！

english: Those poor goblins. It's hard to believe I'm the same species as them. No wonder the HAM people hate us if they assume we're like them.
translation: 那些可怜的哥布林。真难相信我和他们是同一个物种。难怪HAM的人如果以为我们都像他们那样就会恨我们。

english: So far on the surface we haven't seen any... you know... gods.
translation: 到目前为止，在地表上我们还没看到任何……你知道的……神。

english: Of course not! The gods don't just wander around Lumbridge!
translation: 当然没有！神不会在仑桥镇到处闲逛！

english: Don't they? I have no idea what to expect!
translation: 不会吗？我完全不知道会是什么样！

english: That priest seemed friendly. I thought any servant of a god would be much more aggressive.
translation: 那个祭司看起来很友好。我还以为任何神的仆从都会更具攻击性呢。

english: What are we doing down here? I want to see the surface!
translation: 我们在这下面干什么？我想去看地表！

english: Have you seen enough of Lumbridge yet?
translation: 你看够仑桥镇了吗？

english: Perhaps we could talk to the Duke of Lumbridge. Headman Ur-Tag asked me to give him his regards.
translation: 也许我们可以和仑桥镇公爵谈谈。酋长乌尔.塔格让我代他向他问好。

english: You must introduce me to some of the surface people!
translation: 你得把我介绍给一些地表居民！

english: Well... our legends all talk about the gods living on the surface, but since I've been up here I haven't see any. Is there anyone around here who might know about them?
translation: 嗯……我们的传说都提到神居住在地表，但我上来之后一个都没看到。这附近有谁知道他们的事吗？

english: Are there still goblins living on the surface, Player? Are there any near Lumbridge?
translation: 地表上还有哥布林居住吗，玩家？仑桥镇附近有吗？

english: I promised Tignik I would bring a souvenir back from the surface. Will you take me to a shop?
translation: 我答应过提格尼克要从地表带个纪念品回去。你能带我去商店吗？

english: I think I've seen enough of Lumbridge now. If you like I'll tell you about the mark on my forehead.
translation: 我想我已经看够仑桥镇了。如果你愿意，我可以告诉你我额头上这个印记的事。

english: ...And when they opened up the giant frog's stomach they found all the missing silver, and Mistag's brooch!
translation: ……当他们剖开那只巨蛙的肚子时，发现里面全是丢失的银币，还有米斯塔格的胸针！

english: I hope I get ranging XP!
translation: 我希望我能得到远程经验值！

english: What -- what's happening?
translation: 什么——发生了什么？

english: It is not normal for the Tears to have that effect.
translation: 泪水之泉产生那种效果并不正常。

english: I know! What happened?
translation: 我知道！发生了什么？

english: It is a sign. The power of the Tears has marked you for a special purpose.
translation: 这是一个征兆。泪水之泉的力量标记了你，让你肩负一个特殊的使命。

english: I cannot tell you more now. That mark will soon fade, but someday it will glow again, and on that day you should return to me so that I can tell you more about your destiny.
translation: 我现在不能告诉你更多。那个印记很快就会消退，但总有一天它会再次发光，到那天你应该回到我这里，这样我就能告诉你更多关于你命运的事。

english: Wow...
Ever since then I've wondered what the sign meant. But perhaps you will help me to find out, [player name]!
translation: 从那时起我就一直在想那个征兆意味着什么。但也许你会帮我找出答案，[player name]！

english: I've seen enough of Lumbridge now. Let's get to the HAM lair and see if they're up to anything!
translation: 我已经看够仑桥镇了。我们去HAM的巢穴看看他们在搞什么鬼吧！

english: Actually I'm not interested!
translation: 其实我不感兴趣！

english: You don't care about me at all!
translation: 你根本不在乎我！

english: Will you tell me about the mark on your forehead?
translation: 你能告诉我你额头上那个印记的事吗？

english: All right. But not here. Let's go back into Lumbridge town.
translation: 好吧。但别在这里。我们回仑桥镇里去。

english: We're getting a bit far away from Lumbridge, [player name]. I'd like to see the rest of the world someday but not right now. Let's stick to Lumbridge for now.
translation: 我们离仑桥镇有点远了，[player name]。我希望有一天能看到世界其他地方，但不是现在。我们先待在仑桥镇吧。

english: I'm going anyway.
translation: 反正我要走了。

english: All right. I'll wait for you back in Lumbridge castle cellar.
translation: 好吧。我在仑桥镇城堡地窖等你回来。

english: Aren't you going to put on your HAM disguise? You might be able to do without one but I don't want you giving me away!
translation: 你不穿上你的HAM伪装服吗？也许你不用也能行，但我不想你暴露我！

english: I've lost my HAM disguise!
translation: 我的HAM伪装服丢了！

english: You'll have to find a new one from somewhere then.
translation: 那你得从别处再找一件了。

english: What are we waiting for? Let's get to the HAM hideout and find out what they're planning!
translation: 我们还在等什么？去HAM的藏身处看看他们在计划什么！

english: Are you ready to go to the HAM cave now?
translation: 你现在准备好去HAM洞穴了吗？

english: Well then, let's go!
translation: 那好，我们走吧！

english: Hello, brother, you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: 你好，兄弟，你穿对了衣服之后看起来顺眼多了。之前你简直像个碍眼的异类！不过还是要保持警惕；我听说我们中间有贼！

english: I don't think I've seen you before! What's your name?
translation: 我以前好像没见过你！你叫什么名字？

english: I'm Zanik of--
translation: 我是扎尼克，来自——

english: I mean, I'm Zanik!
translation: 我是说，我叫扎尼克！

english: Zanik? What kind of a name is that?
translation: 扎尼克？这算什么名字？

english: Zanik isn't from round here.
translation: 扎尼克不是本地人。

english: It's good that we're getting members from further afield!
translation: 有来自更远地方的成员加入是好事！

english: Is the monster problem very bad where you're from, Zanik?
translation: 扎尼克，你家乡的怪物问题很严重吗？

english: Oh yes. My whole city is overrun by goblins.
translation: 哦，是的。我整个城市都被哥布林占领了。

english: Goblins? That's terrible!
translation: 哥布林？那太可怕了！

english: You know, there are goblins living right underneath Lumbridge. And the duke is treating them as if they were people like you and me! He's even signed a peace treaty with them!
translation: 你知道吗，仑桥镇正下方就住着哥布林。而公爵竟然把他们当成和你我一样的人来对待！他甚至和他们签了和平条约！

english: So what's your group planning to do about it?
translation: 那你们组织打算怎么办？

english: Johanhus doesn't tell his plans to ordinary members like us, but I've heard he and Sigmund are planning something big.
translation: 约翰胡斯不会把他计划告诉我们这样的普通成员，但我听说他和西格蒙德正在策划什么大事。

english: I don't think we'll have to worry about the cave goblin threat for much longer!
translation: 我想我们不用再担心洞穴哥布林的威胁太久了！

english: No... I'm sure the threat will be dealt with soon.
translation: 不……我相信这个威胁很快就会被解决。

english: Listen to what that speaker's saying, [player name]!
translation: 听听那个演讲者在说什么，[player name]！

english: And they're all lapping it up! No one challenges him or even asks questions. They're just sitting there while he fills their minds with hate!
translation: 而他们都全盘接受！没有人质疑他，甚至没人提问。他们就坐在那里，任由他用仇恨填满他们的思想！

english: So you've brought a friend down here to mock me, [player name]? Well soon I will be the one mocking you!
translation: 所以你带了个朋友下来嘲笑我，[player name]？但很快，嘲笑你的人就是我了！

english: Is that Sigmund? The one who tried to start the war between Lumbridge and the cave goblins?
translation: 那是西格蒙德吗？就是那个试图挑起仑桥镇和洞穴哥布林之间战争的人？

english: Yes, I am! And I'm not ashamed of it! Those cave goblins are an abomination in the eyes of Holy Saradomin!
translation: 是的，就是我！而且我对此毫不羞愧！那些洞穴哥布林在神圣萨拉多明眼中是憎恶怪！

english: But I have another plan to destroy them. Soon Johanhus and I will be meeting to discuss the details.
translation: 但我有另一个计划来消灭他们。很快我和约翰胡斯就会会面讨论细节。

english: And there's nothing you can do about it!
translation: 而你对此无能为力！

english: Welcome brother... to our organisation... Ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms... and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world.
translation: 欢迎你，兄弟……加入我们的组织……我们为各种形态的人类而战……并清除世界上存在的怪物。

english: Are you planning to do anything about the cave goblins?
translation: 你们打算对洞穴哥布林采取什么行动吗？

english: You should know, brother... we don't let ordinary members in on all our plans... but rest assured those foul creatures will be dealt with very soon!
translation: 你应该知道，兄弟……我们不会让普通成员知道我们所有的计划……但请放心，那些肮脏的生物很快就会被处理掉！

english: Can't you please tell me?
translation: 你就不能告诉我吗？

english: No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Ordinary members like you must learn to...trust your leaders.
translation: 不行！那种信息只供……组织的高级成员了解。像你这样的普通成员必须学会……信任你们的领袖。

english: Is it really necessary?
translation: 真的有必要吗？

english: How can you even...ask that? Right beneath Lumbridge is a whole cave system full of those creatures! They've got a passage leading right up into the castle kitchen!
translation: 你怎么能……问出这种问题？仑桥镇正下方就是一个充满那些生物的洞穴系统！他们有一条通道直通城堡厨房！

english: And I've heard that there's a whole city of those things down there, not that anyone has ever seen it. What have they got in there? What are they planning?
translation: 而且我听说那下面有整整一座城市，虽然没人亲眼见过。他们在里面藏了什么？他们在计划什么？

english: That's good.
translation: 那就好。

english: So this is the HAM hideout. It's so squalid and dirty! I don't know how they can bear to live here.
translation: 这就是HAM的藏身处。真是又脏又乱！真不知道他们怎么能忍受住在这里。

english: Have you seen enough?
translation: 你看够了吗？

english: We ought to talk to some of the HAM people. That's what we're here for, after all!
translation: 我们应该和几个HAM的人谈谈。毕竟，我们来这里就是为了这个！

english: Let's have another look around the main area. Maybe there's something we missed.
translation: 我们再到主区域看看。也许有什么我们漏掉了。

english: Not yet. There must be another area where the HAM people make their plans. We should try to find it.
translation: 还没。肯定还有另一个区域是HAM的人制定计划的地方。我们应该试着找到它。

english: Look, there.
translation: 看，那里。

english: Over there. There's a trapdoor hidden by dirt.
translation: 那边。有一个被泥土藏起来的活板门。

english: You cave goblins must have better eyesight than humans. I would never have noticed it without you!
translation: 你们洞穴哥布林的视力一定比人类好。没有你，我根本不会注意到它！

english: Can't you open it?
translation: 你打不开它吗？

english: No, I'm not good enough at thieving.
translation: 不行，我的偷窃技术不够好。

english: I'm not much good at thieving either, I'm afraid. You'd better get some practice.
translation: 恐怕我的偷窃技术也不怎么样。你最好去练练。

english: The room where the HAM members make their plans must be down here somewhere. We've got to find it without getting caught!
translation: HAM成员制定计划的房间一定就在这下面某个地方。我们得在不被发现的情况下找到它！

english: Hey! Ordinary members aren't allowed here!
translation: 嘿！普通成员不准来这里！

english: Go back upstairs and I'll say nothing about it. But if any of the other guards see you you're in big trouble!
translation: 回楼上去，我就当没看见。但要是被其他守卫看到你，你就麻烦大了！

english: *whispers* Get him to face away from me...
translation: *低语* 让他背对着我……

english: *whispers* Get that guard to turn his back on me. Maybe if you walk around him he'll keep facing you.
translation: *低语* 让那个守卫背对着我。也许你绕着他走，他就会一直面对着你。

english: Ordinary members aren't allowed in this area. Get back to the cave above.
translation: 普通成员不准进入这个区域。回上面的洞穴去。

english: Uh!
translation: 呃！

english: We can get through this if we work together, [player name]. But I can't get too close to the guards or they'll see I'm not human.
translation: 只要我们合作，就能闯过去，[player name]。但我不能离守卫太近，否则他们会发现我不是人类。

english: You've got to get them to turn their backs on me so I can shoot them without them seeing me draw my crossbow.
translation: 你得让他们背对着我，这样我才能在他们没看到我拿出弩的时候射中他们。

english: If you can get to the other side of that guard you can make him turn around so I can shoot him. Make sure another guard doesn't catch you though!
translation: 如果你能绕到那个守卫的另一边，就能让他转身，这样我就能射他了。不过要小心别被其他守卫发现！

english: Okay, let's go!
translation: 好，我们走！

english: Isn't shooting people in the back wrong?
translation: 从背后射人不是错的吗？

english: Why more so than shooting them in the front?
translation: 那从正面射他们又有什么不同？

english: How did you kill that guard in one hit? I want to learn how to do that!
translation: 你怎么一击就杀了那个守卫？我想学这招！

english: It's a special technique with the bone crossbow. If we both get out of this alive I'll teach you, [player name]!
translation: 这是骨弩的特殊技巧。如果我们都能活着出去，我就教你，[player name]！

english: What are you doing here!?
translation: 你在这里干什么！？

english: [player name]! Wake up!
translation: [player name]！醒醒！

english: Bwuh?
translation: 唔？

english: Uuuurgh...
translation: 呃啊……

english: The guards caught you but I managed to slip away. Here, I'll let you out!
translation: 守卫抓住了你，但我设法溜走了。来，我放你出来！

english: Can't you get through?
translation: 你过不去吗？

english: No, I'm not agile enough.
translation: 不行，我敏捷不够。

english: I don't think I could get through either. You'd better get some agility training done.
translation: 我觉得我也过不去。你最好去练练敏捷。

english: Hey! What are you--
translation: 嘿！你干什——

english: Thanks, [player name]!
translation: 谢了，[player name]！

english: Is the coast clear to get past?
translation: 前面安全可以通过了吗？

english: No, there's a guard patrolling the corridor.
translation: 不，有个守卫在走廊巡逻。

english: I'll take care of him! Just tell me when his back is to us...
translation: 我来解决他！等他背对我们的时候就告诉我……

english: Now!
translation: 就是现在！

english: We got him, [player name]!
translation: 我们搞定他了，[player name]！

english: Noo! He's seen us!
translation: 不！他看到我们了！

english: There are two more guards but I don't know how to get behind them.
translation: 还有两个守卫，但我不知道怎么绕到他们后面。

english: Then maybe you could lead one of them past me...
translation: 那也许你可以引一个从我身边经过……

english: That guard in the east corridor... if I wait at the end of the corridor then you could lead him past me...
translation: 东边走廊那个守卫……如果我在走廊尽头等着，你可以引他经过我……

english: Another one down!
translation: 又解决一个！

english: There's just one guard left.
translation: 只剩一个守卫了。

english: I don't think that guard's going to move away from the door. I think we need to approach him from different directions...
translation: 我不认为那个守卫会从门口离开。我想我们需要从不同方向接近他...

english: Hey! You there!
translation: 嘿！你！

english: That's the last of them! Now to listen to what's happening in the meeting room!
translation: 最后一个也解决了！现在听听会议室里在说什么！

english: There's no more guards! We've got them all!
translation: 没有守卫了！我们全干掉了！

english: I think I can hear something happening behind the double doors. We should listen.
translation: 我好像听到双扇门后面有动静。我们应该听听看。

english: I can't hear anything.
translation: 我什么都听不到。

english: Shh! I can hear them.
translation: 嘘！我能听到他们。

english: They're saying something about... they're planning something... something about a machine...
translation: 他们在说……他们在计划什么……关于一台机器……

english: Oh! Oh no!
translation: 哦！哦不！

english: What are they saying?
translation: 他们在说什么？

english: We've got to do something, [player name]! They're going to--
translation: 我们得做点什么，[player name]！他们要——

english: Got you, you spy!
translation: 抓到你了，你这个间谍！

english: Oww... my head...
translation: 哎哟……我的头……

english: Zanik?
translation: 扎尼克？

english: Where's Zanik?
translation: 扎尼克在哪？

english: Did you see what happened to my friend?
translation: 你看到我朋友怎么了吗？

english: There was a lot of commotion when they dragged you in here. There was someone else, she was struggling like anything. They said they'd take her outside. Dunno what happened to her then.
translation: 他们把你拖进来的时候一片混乱。还有另一个人，她拼命挣扎。他们说要把她带到外面去。之后不知道她怎么样了。

english: I'm Jimmy...Jimmy the Chisel...who are you?
translation: 我是吉米……凿子.吉米……你是谁？

english: So...are you gonna bust me out of here then...
translation: 那么...你是要救我出去吗...

english: Oh, pity...well, you could speak to Johanhus...I think he's the leader.
translation: 哦，真可惜……好吧，你可以跟约翰努斯谈谈……我想他是头儿。

english: Jail break! Great, how exciting!
translation: 越狱！太好了，真刺激！

english: Hey...who are you?
translation: 嘿……你是谁？

english: We don't talk about why we're in here, we just contemplate the crime we commited...or ways to get out!
translation: 我们不谈为什么进来，只想我们犯下的罪行……或者怎么出去！

english: Blimey...the price of my neck for a few chickens...I'd say that was worth it...
translation: 天呐……为了几只鸡差点搭上我的命……我觉得值了……

english: Great...many thanks
translation: 太好了……非常感谢

english: Oh no! I've got to find her!
translation: 哦不！我得找到她！

english: Did you hear? They caught a goblin spy down in the store rooms!
translation: 你听说了吗？他们在储藏室抓到了一个哥布林间谍！

english: What did you do to her?
translation: 你们对她做了什么？

english: Oh, Sigmund and some of the guys took it upstairs and dealt with it. Can't have goblins coming down here!
translation: 哦，西格蒙德和一些人把她带上楼处理掉了。不能让哥布林跑到这里来！

english: You should have seen how it was screaming for mercy! Those monsters aren't so tough when they're outnumbered twenty to one!
translation: 你真该看看它当时是如何尖叫求饶的！那些怪物在二十比一的人数劣势下也没那么厉害！

english: Hello Brother, you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: 你好，修士。你现在穿着得体，融入得很好。之前你可是格格不入！不过要睁大眼睛，我听说我们中间有小偷！

english: Hello Sister, you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: 你好，修女。你现在穿着得体，融入得很好。之前你可是格格不入！不过要睁大眼睛，我听说我们中间有小偷！

english: So, you got out of the cell? No matter...your goblin friend has already been dealt with...and Sigmund is on his way to deal with the rest of her foul brood!
translation: 所以，你从牢里出来了？无所谓……你的哥布林朋友已经被处理掉了……西格蒙德正在去解决她那些肮脏同类的路上！

english: Zanik! Where are you?
translation: 扎尼克！你在哪？

english: Zanik? Are you okay?
translation: 扎尼克？你还好吗？

english: Zanik!
translation: 扎尼克！

english: Juna told Zanik that when the mark glowed again she should go to see her.
translation: 朱娜告诉扎尼克，当印记再次发光时，她应该去找她。

english: Perhaps I should take Zanik's body to Juna. I can't leave her here anyway!
translation: 也许我应该把扎尼克的尸体带给朱娜。反正我也不能把她留在这里！

english: But I'll have to free up an inventory slot first.
translation: 但我得先腾出一个背包格子。

english: I can't just leave Zanik's body lying around! I should take her to Juna.
translation: 我不能把扎尼克的尸体就这么丢在这里！我应该带她去找朱娜。

english: Zanik is dead!
translation: 扎尼克死了！

english: That cannot be. She had not yet returned to learn of her destiny. The mark that the tears gave her had not begun to glow again.
translation: 这不可能。她还没有回来了解自己的命运。眼泪给她的印记还没有开始再次发光。

english: It's glowing now. Look.
translation: 它现在发光了。你看。

english: This is indeed strange. I must commune with mighty Guthix and the forces of destiny.
translation: 这确实很奇怪。我必须与强大的古斯和命运之力沟通。

english: Zanik's death was premature. The gods will allow it to be reversed.
translation: 扎尼克的死是过早的。众神允许逆转它。

english: You can just bring her back to life?!
translation: 你能直接让她复活？！

english: The Tears of Guthix have powers beyond the understanding of mortals. They can restore her to life, with the gods' permission.
translation: 古斯之泪拥有凡人无法理解的力量。在众神的许可下，它们可以让她恢复生命。

english: You must collect some of the tears using Zanik's tear-bowl. Although I would not normally deem you worthy to collect the tears, I will let you into the cave for this special purpose.
translation: 你必须用扎尼克的眼泪碗收集一些眼泪。虽然我通常不会认为你配得上收集眼泪，但为了这个特殊目的，我会让你进入洞穴。

english: You must collect some of the tears using Zanik's tear-bowl. I will not count this against the next time you can collect the tears for yourself.
translation: 你必须用扎尼克的眼泪碗收集一些眼泪。这次不会算在你下次为自己收集眼泪的次数里。

english: Are you ready?
translation: 准备好了吗？

english: You must have both hands free to carry the bowl. Speak to me again when your hands are free.
translation: 你必须空出双手才能端碗。等你空出手再来跟我说话。

english: Twenty tears should be sufficient. Collect twenty blue tears, but remember that green tears will decrease the amount of blue.
translation: 二十滴眼泪应该够了。收集二十滴蓝色眼泪，但记住绿色眼泪会减少蓝色眼泪的数量。

english: Then the forces of destiny must wait until a time that is more convenient for you.
translation: 那么命运之力必须等到你更方便的时候。

english: Zanik has not yet fulfilled her destiny, so the gods will allow her to be resurrected. You must collect some of the Tears of Guthix to allow this to happen.
translation: 扎尼克尚未完成她的命运，所以众神允许她复活。你必须收集一些古斯之泪来实现这一点。

english: You will need to collect twenty tears in order to resurrect Zanik.
translation: 你需要收集二十滴眼泪才能复活扎尼克。

english: I have the Tears.
translation: 我拿到眼泪了。

english: Then I will call upon their power.
translation: 那么我将召唤它们的力量。

english: Uuuhhh!
translation: 呃啊！

english: Get off me, you monsters!
translation: 放开我，你们这些怪物！

english: What are you doing? Noo! Don't kill me! [player name], help me!
translation: 你们在干什么？不！别杀我！[player name]，救我！

english: They killed me, didn't they, [player name]?
translation: 他们杀了我，对吧，[player name]？

english: Then what am I doing here?
translation: 那我在这里做什么？

english: Juna brought you back from the dead.
translation: 朱娜让你死而复生了。

english: Listen to me, Zanik. You are marked for a special purpose, and you have been granted new life so that you can carry it out. Your destiny is to lead all goblins into a new age.
translation: 听我说，扎尼克。你被标记了，肩负着一个特殊使命，你被赐予了新的生命，以便你能完成它。你的命运是带领所有哥布林进入一个新时代。

english: But what does that mean?
translation: 但那是什么意思？

english: Someday you will know. But today you must hurry to foil the plot that even now threatens your home!
translation: 总有一天你会知道的。但今天你必须赶紧去挫败那个甚至此刻正威胁着你家园的阴谋！

english: The plot! [player name], I've got to tell you what I heard outside the meeting room!
translation: 那个阴谋！[player name]，我得告诉你我在会议室外面听到的事！

english: Good news, brothers! Our tunnel from the water mill cellar has reached the cave goblin tunnels, and the last shipment of machinery is on its way from Keldagrim.
translation: 好消息，兄弟们！我们从水磨坊地窖挖的隧道已经通到洞穴哥布林的隧道了，最后一批机械正从凯尔达格林城运来。

english: Do we have to deal with the dwarves? They may not exactly be monsters but they're still not human.
translation: 我们得对付那些矮人吗？他们可能不完全是怪物，但毕竟也不是人类。

english: If it wasn't for the King's tolerance of monsters, we humans would have a better industry than the dwarves!
translation: 要不是国王容忍那些怪物，我们人类的工业会比矮人更发达！

english: Well said, brother!
translation: 说得好，兄弟！

english: I'll need to take some of the low-level members to help unload the machinery at the Lumbridge water mill.
translation: 我需要带一些低级成员去帮忙卸下仑桥镇水磨坊的机械。

english: By all means. It's about time that lot made themselves useful.
translation: 当然可以。是时候让那帮人派上用场了。

english: Soon the mighty River Lum will wash away those evil goblins forever!
translation: 很快，强大的卢姆河就会永远冲走那些邪恶的哥布林！

english: Saradomin will surely bless us for destroying those abominations!
translation: 萨拉多明一定会保佑我们消灭那些可憎之物！

english: Death to the Dorgeshuun!
translation: 多格舒恩之死！

english: Let's go, [player name]! We've got to get to the Lumbridge water mill so we can foil Sigmund's plan!
translation: 走吧，[player name]！我们得赶到仑桥镇的水磨坊，阻止西格蒙德的计划！

english: Do it quickly, [player name]! We've got to stop Sigmund from destroying my city!
translation: 快点，[player name]！我们必须阻止西格蒙德摧毁我的城市！

english: What did Sigmund do to you?
translation: 西格蒙德对你做了什么？

english: It was horrible, [player name]!
translation: 太可怕了，[player name]！

english: They didn't just k-kill me quickly. They were enjoying themselves. The light was so bright I couldn't see but I could hear them laughing...
translation: 他们不是……不是一下子就杀了我。他们在享受这个过程。光线太刺眼，我什么都看不见，但我能听到他们的笑声……

english: Let's get them, [player name]! I need to save my city and I want to get my revenge!
translation: 我们去干掉他们，[player name]！我要拯救我的城市，还要报仇雪恨！

english: What's it like being dead?
translation: 死了是什么感觉？

english: It was... it wasn't like anything.
translation: 那感觉……就像什么都没有一样。

english: One moment Sigmund and his thugs were... you know...
translation: 上一秒西格蒙德和他的打手们还在……你懂的……

english: And then suddenly I was down in the cave and you were here. There was nothing in between.
translation: 然后突然间我就掉进了洞穴，而你就在这里。中间什么都没有。

english: We Dorgeshuun don't believe in an afterlife. At least, if there is one we don't claim to know about it. And if anything happened to me while I was dead then I don't remember it.
translation: 我们多格舒恩人不相信有来世。至少，就算有，我们也不会声称自己知道。而且，如果我死的时候发生了什么，我也不记得了。

english: And now my life's a mystery too. What was that destiny Juna talked about?
translation: 现在我的生命也成了一个谜。朱娜说的那个命运到底是什么？

english: But there's no time for that now. Let's get to the water mill!
translation: 但现在没时间想这个了。我们快去水磨坊！

english: Quick, [player name]! Let's get to the water mill and stop Sigmund from destroying my home!
translation: 快，[player name]！我们快去水磨坊，阻止西格蒙德摧毁我的家园！

english: What are we going down there again for? We know where we need to go -- the Lumbridge water mill!
translation: 我们干嘛还要下去？我们知道要去哪——仑桥镇的水磨坊！

english: We're not too late! They're still assembling the machine. Now we've got to find some way to get down there and stop them.
translation: 我们还没来晚！他们还在组装机器。现在得想办法下去阻止他们。

english: How can we get down there?
translation: 我们怎么才能下去？

english: I don't know. But there must be something around here we can use...
translation: 我不知道。但附近肯定有什么东西可以利用……

english: Mistag told me it's not safe to guide humans through unless they're carrying a light source. You wouldn't be able to see to follow me.
translation: 米斯塔格告诉我，除非人类带着光源，否则带领他们穿行不安全。你会看不见路跟上我的。

english: All right. But don't make any trouble!
translation: 好吧。但别惹麻烦！

english: Mistag towd me it's not safe to guide humans thwoughunwess day'we cawwying a wight souwce. You wouwdn't beabwe to see to fowwow me.
translation: 米斯塔格告诉窝，除非人类带着光原，否则带领他们穿行不安全。你会看不见陆跟上窝的。

english: We've not got time to talk now, Kazgar! [player name], you've got to take me to the Lumbridge water mill at once!
translation: 我们现在没时间聊天了，卡兹加！[player name]，你得马上带我去仑桥镇的水磨坊！

english: What's in these crates?
translation: 这些板条箱里是什么？

english: None of your business! Those funny pink-robed people told me to keep it secret!
translation: 不关你的事！那些穿粉色袍子的怪人让我保密！

english: Where's Sigmund?
translation: 西格蒙德在哪？

english: The guy who ordered all this? I don't see that's any of your business.
translation: 那个下订单的家伙？我觉得这不关你的事。

english: Why are you helping the HAM people?
translation: 你为什么要帮HAM的人？

english: What, these odd pink-robed people? Oh, the normal reason. Because they paid me.
translation: 什么，这些穿粉色袍子的怪人？哦，老原因。因为他们付了钱。

english: But don't you know what they're planning to do?
translation: 但你不知道他们打算做什么吗？

english: No, and I don't want to. Now go away!
translation: 不知道，也不想知道。现在走开！

english: Oh, it's another one of you funny people. Okay, grab one of the crates and take it downstairs. I told your boss how to put the parts together.
translation: 哦，又是你们这些怪人中的一个。好吧，拿一个板条箱搬到楼下去。我告诉过你老板怎么组装零件。

english: Didn't your boss tell you? It's a digging machine. Very special. Digs straight up, and can work without supervision when it's turned on.
translation: 你的老板没告诉你吗？这是一台挖掘机。非常特别。能垂直向上挖掘，而且启动后无需监督就能工作。

english: What, your boss? He's downstairs waiting for you slackers to carry the rest of the crates down. So get a move on!
translation: 什么，你老板？他在楼下等着你们这些懒鬼把剩下的板条箱搬下去呢。所以快动起来！

english: Is that what you people call yourselves? Well, it's certainly not out of the goodness of my heart. Your boss paid good money for this machine, plus my fee for transporting it all this way.
translation: 你们是这么称呼自己的吗？好吧，我可不是出于好心。你老板为这台机器付了高价，还付了我一路运输的费用。

english: So get to work and get it downstairs!
translation: 所以快干活，把它搬下楼！

english: There's no way I'm helping!
translation: 我绝不会帮忙！

english: Oh, honestly! If you're not here to help then get out of the way!
translation: 哦，真是的！如果你不是来帮忙的，那就让开！

english: *pant* Go away, outsider! *pant*
translation: *喘气* 走开，外人！*喘气*

english: These crates are heavy! I could do with some help if that's what you're here for.
translation: 这些板条箱真重！如果你是来帮忙的，我正需要人手。

english: Where do you think you're going? Only people helping assemble the machine are allowed down there!
translation: 你以为你要去哪？只有帮忙组装机器的人才能下去！

english: Hey! No goblins allowed down there!
translation: 嘿！地精不准下去！

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing going down there empty-handed? Get a crate and carry it down!
translation: 嘿！你空着手下去想干嘛？拿个板条箱搬下去！

english: Sorry, but you're not experienced enough to go through there.
translation: 抱歉，你的经验还不够，不能从这里过去。

english: Sorry, but you need level 60 Mining to go in there.
translation: 抱歉，你需要60级采矿才能进去。

english: Those must be the parts for the machine they're going to use to flood my city!
translation: 那些一定是他们用来淹没我城市的机器零件！

english: Hey... if I carried one of these crates I could slip downstairs and stop them!
translation: 嘿……如果我搬一个板条箱，就能溜下楼去阻止他们！

english: Don't you dare go down there without me, [player name]! Find some way to get us both down there so I can face Sigmund myself!
translation: 你可别丢下我自己下去，[player name]！想办法让我们俩都下去，让我亲自面对西格蒙德！

english: Are you thinking what I'm thinking, [player name]?
translation: 你在想我想的事吗，[player name]？

english: I don't know, what are you thinking?
translation: 我不知道，你在想什么？

english: I could hide in one of those crates, and then you could carry me downstairs as if you were carrying some of the machinery.
translation: 我可以躲进其中一个板条箱里，然后你假装搬运机械把我带下楼。

english: You ought to free both your hands so you can carry the crate. I'm afraid I might be heavy!
translation: 你得空出双手才能搬板条箱。我恐怕有点重！

english: Why are we going away from the mill? We should get down there and save my city!
translation: 我们为什么要离开磨坊？我们应该下去拯救我的城市！

english: This must lead to the Dorgeshuun mines! Sigmund must mean the water to run through here and flood the city!
translation: 这一定通往多格舒恩矿场！西格蒙德一定是想让水流经这里，淹没城市！

english: We've got to stop him, [player name]!
translation: 我们必须阻止他，[player name]！

english: [player name]! You and your goblin friend have interfered for the last time! Guards, kill them!
translation: [player name]！你和你的地精朋友这是最后一次捣乱了！卫兵，杀了他们！

english: I won't let you destroy my home, Sigmund!
translation: 我不会让你摧毁我的家园，西格蒙德！

english: Saradomin protect me from magic!
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我免受魔法伤害！

english: Saradomin protect me from ranged!
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我免受远程攻击！

english: Saradomin protect me from this foul goblin!
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我免受这肮脏地精的伤害！

english: Let's get them, [player name]!
translation: 我们去干掉他们，[player name]！

english: Don't leave me, [player name]! I can't defeat Sigmund without you!
translation: 别丢下我，[player name]！没有你，我打不过西格蒙德！

english: Okay, I'll stay!
translation: 好，我留下！

english: Don't worry, I'll be back!
translation: 别担心，我会回来的！

english: Hurry, [player name]!
translation: 快点，[player name]！

english: [player name]! Thank goodness you're all right! Now let's finish off Sigmund and his cronies before they flood the city!
translation: [player name]！谢天谢地你没事！现在我们得在洪水淹没城市之前，干掉西格蒙德和他的同伙！

english: Curse you, Player, and your goblin friend! You win this time, but we will meet again!
translation: 诅咒你，玩家，还有你的哥布林朋友！这次你赢了，但我们还会再见！

english: What happened? He vanished!
translation: 发生什么事了？他消失了！

english: He must have had a ring of life! It looks like he got away from us this time, Zanik.
translation: 他一定戴着生命戒指！看来这次让他跑了，扎尼克。

english: The important thing is we stopped him! Now let's smash that machine and then get back to Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 重要的是我们阻止了他！现在我们去砸烂那台机器，然后回多吉需戛纳！

english: Quick, [player name], let's smash that drilling machine before Sigmund returns! Then we can return to Dorgesh- Kaan for a hero's welcome!
translation: 快，[player name]，趁西格蒙德回来之前，我们砸烂那台钻孔机！然后我们就可以回多吉什-卡恩，享受英雄般的欢迎！

english: We can't just leave that machine there for someone else to complete! We should smash it beyond repair before returning home!
translation: 我们不能把那台机器留在那里，让别人完成它！在回家之前，我们应该把它砸得无法修复！

english: There's no need to go that way, [player name]! We can go south along the tunnel to the Dorgeshuun mine.
translation: 没必要走那条路，[player name]！我们可以沿着隧道向南走到多格舒恩矿场。

english: Now let's get back to Dorgesh-Kaan to tell them what happened! We can go south along the tunnel Sigmund has dug.
translation: 现在我们回多吉什-卡恩，告诉他们发生了什么！我们可以沿着西格蒙德挖的隧道向南走。

english: We did it, [player name]! My city is safe! Now we can follow that tunnel south back to the mines!
translation: 我们成功了，[player name]！我的城市安全了！现在我们可以沿着那条隧道向南回到矿场！

english: Where did you go? We should follow the tunnel south to Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 你去哪了？我们应该沿着隧道向南去多吉什-卡恩！

english: I'll show you the way through to the city. Wait till we tell Mistag about what happened!
translation: 我带你进城。等我们告诉米斯塔格发生了什么！

english: Welcome back, Zanik. What have you to report?
translation: 欢迎回来，扎尼克。你有什么要汇报的？

english: The city is safe! The HAM group was plotting against us, but we stopped them!
translation: 城市安全了！HAM组织在密谋对付我们，但我们阻止了他们！

english: You stopped them this time, but the surface still poses a danger. The council has been debating how much contact we should have with it, and wants you to make a recommendation.
translation: 这次你阻止了他们，但地表仍然是个威胁。议会一直在讨论我们应该与地表保持多少接触，并希望你能提出建议。

english: The surface is a strange and wonderful place! We should embrace it, not shut ourselves off!
translation: 地表是一个奇妙而精彩的地方！我们应该拥抱它，而不是封闭自己！

english: And not all surface-dwellers are bad. Without [player name] the city would have been destroyed for sure!
translation: 而且不是所有地表居民都是坏人。没有[player name]，城市肯定早就被毁了！

english: [player name], we are in your debt once again.
translation: [player name]，我们又欠你一次人情。

english: The council has voted that, if Zanik's recommendation was positive, humans from Lumbridge should be allowed into the city. You may now enter Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 议会已经投票决定，如果扎尼克的建议是积极的，那么来自仑桥镇的人类应该被允许进入城市。你现在可以进入多吉什-卡恩了！

english: This is brilliant! I'm sure you won't regret this!
translation: 太棒了！我相信你不会后悔的！

english: Thank you for taking me on that adventure, [player name]! I'll show you how to use the bone crossbow like I promised I would!
translation: 谢谢你带我经历这次冒险，[player name]！我会像之前承诺的那样，教你怎么使用骨弩！

english: Come find me in the city if you ever want to chat, [player name]. I'm going to go and think about what Juna said about my destiny. I don't know what it will involve, but I have a feeling we will adventure together again!
translation: 如果你想聊天，就到城里来找我吧，[player name]。我要去想想朱娜说的关于我命运的事。我不知道那会是什么，但我有种感觉，我们还会一起冒险！

english: It's nothing much, but apparently one of the patrons in here was ranting and raving about zombies. Most just dismissed him as having had one too many, but I'm not so sure.
translation: 没什么大事，不过这里有个客人刚才在嚷嚷着僵尸的事。大多数人都当他喝多了没当回事，但我不太确定。

english: Varrock has an interesting history when it comes to zombies. Tell me, what do you know of Arrav?
translation: 维洛克城在僵尸方面有一段有趣的历史。告诉我，你对阿拉夫了解多少？

english: Arrav? As in the Shield of Arrav? I was the one who helped return it to the museum.
translation: 阿拉夫？你是说阿拉夫之盾？就是我帮忙把它归还给博物馆的。

english: Ah, I heard about that. Excellent work! You may well know then that the former owner of that shield, Arrav himself, once defended Varrock against a zombie invasion led by a Mahjarrat named Zemouregal.
translation: 啊，我听说了。干得好！那你可能知道，那面盾的前主人，阿拉夫本人，曾经抵御过一场由名为泽莫雷加尔的玛哈加特率领的僵尸入侵，保卫了维洛克城。

english: Arrav sacrificed himself to save his city, but Zemouregal survived.
translation: 阿拉夫牺牲自己拯救了城市，但泽莫雷加尔活了下来。

english: And you think these zombie sightings mean he's returned?
translation: 你认为这些僵尸目击事件意味着他回来了？

english: Apparently the zombies were seen forming ranks. Zombies don't naturally organise themselves, so someone must be organising them. I can think of worse candidates than Zemouregal.
translation: 据说有人看到僵尸在列队。僵尸不会自己组织起来，所以一定有人在指挥它们。我想不出比泽莫雷加尔更可疑的人了。

english: I can see why you think this is worth looking into. Where do we start?
translation: 我明白你为什么认为这值得调查。我们从哪里开始？

english: Zombies are not particularly light on their feet, so my hope is we can pick up their trail. The sightings were apparently right outside the inn.
translation: 僵尸的脚步不会特别轻，所以我希望能找到它们的踪迹。目击地点就在客栈外面。

english: Follow the tracks and see where they came from. Good plan.
translation: 跟着踪迹，看看它们从哪里来。好计划。

english: Then shall we get started?
translation: 那我们开始吧？

english: Ready when you are.
translation: 你准备好了就行。

english: Excellent! I'm right behind you.
translation: 太好了！我跟着你。

english: Lead the way.
translation: 带路吧。

english: What can you tell me about Arrav and Zemouregal?
translation: 你能告诉我关于阿拉夫和泽莫雷加尔的事吗？

english: It's quite the tale and I doubt I'd be able to do it justice, but I can try and give you an overview.
translation: 这是个很长的故事，我恐怕不能讲得完全精彩，但我可以试着给你一个概述。

english: Back in the Fourth Age, a group of travellers came upon an abandoned child. It is said the child was unusual for one so young. Dark eyes and a fierce countenance, yet fair hair and skin, with a kind smile.
translation: 在第四纪元，一群旅人发现了一个被遗弃的孩子。据说这个孩子年幼却与众不同。黑眼睛，面容凶狠，但头发和皮肤白皙，带着和善的微笑。

english: The travellers saw this as an omen and set up camp where they found him. The camp soon grew into the town of Avarrocka, or Varrock as we now call it.
translation: 旅行者们将此视为预兆，并在发现他的地方扎营。营地很快发展成阿瓦罗卡镇，也就是我们现在所称的维洛克城。

english: As for the child, he grew to become a mighty hero. After defending the town from a goblin attack, he took on the name Arrav, a curse word in goblin tongue, for he had become the Curse of Goblins.
translation: 至于那个孩子，他成长为一位强大的英雄。在保卫城镇免受哥布林袭击后，他取名为阿拉夫，这是哥布林语中的诅咒词，因为他已成为哥布林的诅咒。

english: Arrav's heroic deeds continued, until he was granted a vision of the future. He saw the Mahjarrat Zemouregal claiming Avarrocka as his own.
translation: 阿拉夫的英雄事迹不断，直到他获得了一个关于未来的幻象。他看到玛哈加特泽莫雷加尔将阿瓦罗卡占为己有。

english: Determined to stop Zemouregal in any way he could, Arrav set out to find a powerful weapon with which to best him. His journey took him to the Imcando Dwarves, who granted him a powerful shield.
translation: 决心不惜一切阻止泽莫雷加尔，阿拉夫出发寻找一件强大武器来击败他。他的旅程带他找到了伊姆坎多矮人，他们赠予了他一面强大的盾牌。

english: The Shield of Arrav?
translation: 阿拉夫之盾？

english: Exactly. With the shield in hand, Arrav returned home and faced off against Zemouregal and his zombie horde. Thanks to him, the invasion was repelled, but at the cost of Arrav's life.
translation: 正是。手握盾牌，阿拉夫返回家乡，与泽莫雷加尔和他的僵尸大军对抗。多亏了他，入侵被击退，但代价是阿拉夫的生命。

english: Zemouregal has not been seen since, but it is said that his last act before retreating was to claim Arrav's body, promising to turn him into an undead slave to one day return with.
translation: 此后泽莫雷加尔便销声匿迹，但据说他撤退前最后一件事就是夺走阿拉夫的尸体，并承诺要将他变成不死奴隶，日后带着他归来。

english: Hundreds of years have now passed, and while there are few who haven't heard of Arrav, many have forgotten Zemouregal and his promise.
translation: 数百年过去了，虽然很少有人没听说过阿拉夫，但许多人已经忘记了泽莫雷加尔和他的承诺。

english: So what exactly is it you're researching?
translation: 那么你究竟在研究什么？

english: The Mahjarrat. It's fair to say they are quite the subject of fascination for me. Many of them once held dominion over huge parts of the world. Zamorak himself was a Mahjarrat, and he managed to achieve godhood!
translation: 玛哈加特。可以说他们是我非常着迷的研究对象。他们中许多曾统治着世界的广大区域。萨莫拉克本人就是一位玛哈加特，而且他成功达到了神性！

english: But now, they've all but vanished! Most will go through their whole lives without ever seeing one, and their most common appearance these days is in the spooky stories parents use to keep their children in line.
translation: 但现在，他们几乎消失殆尽了！大多数人一生都见不到一个，如今他们最常见的出现方式就是家长用来管教孩子的恐怖故事里。

english: And that's why you're so interested in Zemouregal?
translation: 所以这就是你对泽莫雷加尔如此感兴趣的原因？

english: Indeed. An actual Mahjarrat, and a very dangerous one at that. Ancient tomes can only teach us so much. If I want to learn everything there is to know about their race, it's going to take some more hands on work.
translation: 没错。一个真正的玛哈加特，而且是个非常危险的家伙。古籍能教给我们的有限。如果我想了解关于他们种族的一切，还需要更实际的研究。

english: What about the danger?
translation: 那危险呢？

english: Well that's just all the more reason for me to be here. If Zemouregal is planning a new attack on Varrock, an expert on his race might come in quite useful.
translation: 这正是我在这里的更大理由。如果泽莫雷加尔计划对维洛克城发动新攻击，一个研究他种族的专家可能会派上用场。

english: If you're an explorer, I'm guessing you travel a lot?
translation: 如果你是个探险家，我猜你一定经常旅行？

english: Indeed! From the frozen wastes of the north to the ancient tombs of the desert, I've seen it all.
translation: 没错！从北方的冰封荒原到沙漠的古墓，我都见识过。

english: So where do you call home?
translation: 那你把哪里叫做家？

english: I've lived in many places over the years, but I wouldn't really say I have a home. I guess here in Varrock would be the closest answer.
translation: 这些年来我住过很多地方，但我不能说我真的有个家。我想维洛克城算是最接近的答案了。

english: I need to do something else.
translation: 我还有别的事要做。

english: I need to do something else first.
translation: 我需要先做别的事。

english: Hello again. So what was this tip-off you received?
translation: 又见面了。那么你收到的线索是什么？

english: Ready to get back to it? My hope is we can pick up the trail left by those zombies right outside the inn.
translation: 准备好继续了吗？我希望我们能沿着客栈外那些僵尸留下的踪迹追查。

english: Do you have that key we found?
translation: 你拿着我们找到的那把钥匙吗？

english: I do indeed. Don't worry, I'll look after it until we need it.
translation: 当然。别担心，我会保管好它，直到我们需要用它。

english: Very well. I'll meet you back at the Jolly Boar Inn.
translation: 很好。我在快乐野猪客栈和你碰头。

english: I'll meet you back at the Jolly Boar Inn, [player name].
translation: 我会在快乐野猪客栈和你会合，[player name]。

english: We need to try and pick up the trail left by those zombies.
translation: 我们需要试着追踪那些僵尸留下的痕迹。

english: We need to try and follow the trail left by those zombies.
translation: 我们需要试着跟随那些僵尸留下的痕迹。

english: Look! Footprints. Let's see where they lead us.
translation: 看！脚印。让我们看看它们会带我们去哪里。

english: A key? I wonder what it opens... Best we keep a hold of it and find out.
translation: 一把钥匙？我好奇它能打开什么……最好我们先拿着它然后查清楚。

english: Why are you trying to destroy that? We need it. I can look after it for you if you want?
translation: 你为什么想毁掉它？我们需要它。如果你愿意，我可以帮你保管？

english: Actually, I'll keep hold of it.
translation: 实际上，我会自己保管。

english: A trapdoor! Now what do you reckon the chances are that we can unlock it with that key?
translation: 一个活板门！你觉得我们用那把钥匙打开它的可能性有多大？

english: Only one way to find out...
translation: 只有一种方法能知道……

english: Right, shall we go in?
translation: 好了，我们进去吗？

english: I'm not ready yet.
translation: 我还没准备好。

english: Well let's not waste too much time. We need to see what's down there.
translation: 那我们别浪费时间了。我们需要看看下面有什么。

english: Let's see what we can find down that trapdoor.
translation: 让我们看看那个活板门下面能找到什么。

english: I should probably fetch Elias first.
translation: 我可能应该先去叫埃利亚斯。

english: Ready to get back to it? We need to find out what's hiding down that trapdoor.
translation: 准备好继续了吗？我们需要查明那个活板门下面藏着什么。

english: Fascinating... What is this place?
translation: 真迷人……这是什么地方？

english: Then let's look around and find out!
translation: 那我们四处看看，查个明白！

english: Let's see if we can work out what this dungeon is for.
translation: 让我们看看能不能搞清楚这个地牢是做什么用的。

english: Zemouregal, this magical mist feels like it's corroding my insides. This seems like a bad idea...
translation: 泽莫雷加尔，这魔法迷雾感觉在腐蚀我的内脏。这看起来像是个坏主意……

english: Nonsense! The mist has no side effects. Besides, it's essential for the new security system. Everyone needs to be imbued with it if they wish to pass through any doors or gates in the base.
translation: 胡说！这迷雾没有副作用。而且，它对新的安全系统至关重要。如果任何人想要通过基地的任何门或大门，都必须被它浸透。

english: Now, what news do you bring from the north?
translation: 那么，你从北方带来了什么消息？

english: Your cousin grows unusually strong. We should consider allying ourselves to him, maybe even combine forces.
translation: 你的表弟变得异常强大。我们应该考虑与他结盟，甚至联合兵力。

english: Combine forces? I won't hear of it! Lucien would never enter into such an arrangement unless he were the one in control, and I have no desire to serve at his behest.
translation: 联合兵力？我不想听这个！卢西安绝不会同意这样的安排，除非他是掌控者，而我不愿听从他的命令。

english: Besides, Lucien isn't the only one with powerful resources...
translation: 再说，卢西安不是唯一拥有强大资源的人……

english: Is that...?
translation: 那是……？

english: Arrav. So the stories are true. The legendary hero of Avarrocka, now the slave of a disgusting necromancer.
translation: 阿拉夫。所以传说是真的。阿瓦罗卡的传奇英雄，如今成了一个可憎死灵法师的奴隶。

english: After many long years, it is time for Arrav to take command of my zombie troops. And on that note, come, let us inspect the forces.
translation: 经过漫长的岁月，是时候让阿拉夫来指挥我的僵尸部队了。说到这个，来吧，我们去检阅部队。

english: I see it's just as I suspected. Zemouregal is the one responsible for our zombie gatherings. We should inform the authorities in Varrock at once.
translation: 看来正如我所料。泽莫雷加尔就是这些僵尸聚集的幕后黑手。我们应该立即通知维洛克城的当局。

english: What about the rest of this place? There could be more useful information to uncover here.
translation: 那这个地方的其他部分呢？这里可能还有更多有用的信息要发掘。

english: True. Perhaps it would be wise for us to split up.
translation: 没错。也许我们分头行动更明智。

english: Sounds like a plan. You head to Varrock and let them know what we've found so far. I'll keep exploring.
translation: 听起来不错。你去维洛克城告诉他们我们目前发现的情况。我继续探索。

english: Very well. I'll meet you in the palace once you're done. Be careful.
translation: 很好。你完成后我在王宫和你碰头。小心。

english: You... You must leave this place. It's too... urgh...
translation: 你……你必须离开这里。这太……呃……

english: ... too dangerous for the likes of you here.
translation: ……对你这种人来说太危险了。

english: Arrav? But how are you... Are you fighting Zemouregal's control?
translation: 阿拉夫？但你怎么……你在抵抗泽莫雷加尔的控制吗？

english: My body is... under his control. I can sometimes manage to speak when Zemouregal's concentration is elsewhere, but even then, it's... painful. My mind, however... gahh...
translation: 我的身体……在他的控制之下。有时当泽莫雷加尔注意力别处时，我能够说话，但即便如此，也……很痛苦。然而我的思想……啊……

english: ... is still intact. He left it that way. He wanted me to feel the horror when I... urgh...
translation: ……仍然完整。他故意如此。他想让我在……呃……时感受恐惧。

english: I'm so sorry, Arrav. There must be some way I can help you. What can I do?
translation: 我很抱歉，阿拉夫。一定有什么办法可以帮助你。我能做什么？

english: My heart... He has it. That's how he... how he... arrgh...
translation: 我的心脏……在他那里。这就是他……他……啊……

english: I'm sorry, he calls to me. I must go. Please, leave... Leave before you...
translation: 抱歉，他在召唤我。我必须走了。请你，离开……在你……之前离开……

english: I'm telling you, he may be close to finding it.
translation: 我告诉你，他可能快要找到它了。

english: Enough! I don't have time to worry about fairy tales.
translation: 够了！我没时间担心童话故事。

english: But think of the power...
translation: 但想想那力量……

english: Do you not think that I am all too aware of the power? You couldn't begin to imagine what I'd do to have it for myself! But I am also all too aware of what happens to those who try to claim it.
translation: 你难道不认为我太清楚那力量了吗？你无法想象我为了得到它会做什么！但我也太清楚那些试图获得它的人的下场了。

english: If that is the fate Lucien wishes for himself, then he is welcome to it. In the meantime, we will focus on more practical endeavours. This is our last chance before the time comes to head north.
translation: 如果那是卢西安为自己选择的命运，那就随他去吧。与此同时，我们将专注于更实际的事业。这是在北上时机到来之前最后的机会。

english: Your forces are ready, Zemouregal.
translation: 你的部队准备好了，泽莫雷加尔。

english: Then let us waste no more time. Begin the final preparations.
translation: 那我们不要再浪费时间了。开始最后准备。

english: Soon, the Mahjarrat will hold dominion over these lands once more. Varrock will be mine. Arrav cannot save his people this time. He can only watch as he himself seals their fate!
translation: 很快，玛哈加特将再次统治这片土地。维洛克城将是我的。这次阿拉夫无法拯救他的人民。他只能眼睁睁看着自己亲手决定他们的命运！

english: This isn't good. I'd better get to Varrock right away!
translation: 这可不好。我最好立刻赶到维洛克城！

english: Ah, there you are. How did things go after I left you?
translation: 啊，你来了。我离开你之后情况如何？

english: Not good. Zemouregal is nearly ready to begin another attack on Varrock.
translation: 不好。泽莫雷加尔几乎准备好对维洛克城发动又一次攻击了。

english: Then it's just as I feared. I've already reported our discovery to Captain Rovin. Come, let's fill him in on everything else you've learnt.
translation: 那正是我所担心的。我已经向罗文船长报告了我们的发现。来，我们把其他你了解到的情况都告诉他。

english: About time, adventurer. Your companion here tells me we have a zombie army on our doorstep!
translation: 来得正好，冒险者。你的同伴告诉我我们在家门口有一支僵尸军队！

english: I'm afraid that's not all, Captain. [player name] has made some further discoveries.
translation: 恐怕不止如此，船长。[player name]还发现了更多情况。

english: Indeed. Zemouregal plans to have Arrav lead the zombies in an attack on Varrock, and he plans to do so very soon.
translation: 确实。泽莫雷加尔计划让阿拉夫率领僵尸攻击维洛克城，而且他打算很快行动。

english: Zemouregal attacking Varrock again is our greatest fear and worst nightmare. And to think he now has Arrav under his control as well... What a horrifying fate for our greatest hero.
translation: 泽莫雷加尔再次进攻维洛克城是我们最大的恐惧和最可怕的梦魇。更可怕的是他现在还控制了阿拉夫……对我们最伟大的英雄来说，这是多么可怕的命运。

english: There may still be hope for Arrav. While spying on Zemouregal, I came face to face with him. He may serve Zemouregal, but not willingly. His mind is still his own.
translation: 阿拉夫可能还有希望。在监视泽莫雷加尔时，我与他面对面了。他可能服务于泽莫雷加尔，但并非自愿。他的心智仍然属于他自己。

english: A zombie with his mind intact... Most zombies are mere husks, their souls having long departed their bodies. For one to still be sentient is highly unusual. Could it mean...
translation: 一个心智完好的僵尸……大多数僵尸只是空壳，灵魂早已离开身体。存在一个有知觉的僵尸极为罕见。难道这意味着……

english: Oh, nothing to worry about now. Still, we may be able to work with this. What did Arrav have to say to you?
translation: 哦，现在没什么好担心的。不过，我们或许可以利用这一点。阿拉夫对你说了什么？

english: He told me that Zemouregal has his heart.
translation: 他告诉我泽莫雷加尔拿走了他的心脏。

english: His heart? Interesting... Could that be how Zemouregal is controlling him?
translation: 他的心脏？有趣……难道这就是泽莫雷加尔控制他的方式？

english: What are you saying? Does this mean we might be able to save Arrav?
translation: 你的意思是？难道我们有可能解救阿拉夫？

english: In the long term, potentially. But this will require a fair amount of research. Something I fear we have little time for right now.
translation: 从长远来看，有可能。但这需要大量的研究。恐怕我们现在没多少时间了。

english: Well then what other options do we have?
translation: 那我们还有什么其他办法？

english: Well thanks to our good friend here, we have the very shield that was used to stop Zemouregal the first time he attacked.
translation: 多亏了我们这位好朋友，我们正好有当年阻止泽莫雷加尔第一次进攻时使用的那面盾牌。

english: The Shield of Arrav? But is it really any use? Despite our attempts, we've never been able to unlock its power. Could it be that the legends were exaggerated and that it's just an ordinary shield?
translation: 阿拉夫之盾？但它真的有用吗？尽管我们尝试过，却始终无法解开它的力量。会不会是传说夸大了，它只是一面普通的盾牌？

english: To answer that, our best bet would likely be to seek out the creators of the shield: The Imcando Dwarves of Camdozaal.
translation: 要回答这个问题，我们最好去寻找盾牌的制造者：卡姆多扎尔的伊姆坎多矮人。

english: Hmm... but are the Imcando not extinct now?
translation: 嗯……但伊姆坎多人不是已经灭绝了吗？

english: Not quite. There are still a few out there, including one in Camdozaal. Ramarno is his name.
translation: 不完全是。外面还有几个，包括卡姆多扎尔的一位。他叫拉马诺。

english: Well then what are we waiting for? [player name], speak to this Ramarno and seek his advice on how to use the shield to defend our city. In the meantime, we will prepare our defences.
translation: 那我们还等什么？[player name]，去找拉马诺谈谈，请教他如何使用这面盾牌来保卫我们的城市。与此同时，我们会准备防御。

english: You'd better head over to Camdozaal, [player name]. Time is not on our side.
translation: 你最好赶紧去卡姆多扎尔，[player name]。时间不等人。

english: Adventurer. Have you been to Camdozaal yet?
translation: 冒险者。你去过卡姆多扎尔了吗？

english: No, not yet. I'll be on my way shortly.
translation: 还没，我马上就去。

english: I need your help with a shield.
translation: 我需要你帮忙处理一面盾牌。

english: A shield? What kind of shield?
translation: 一面盾牌？什么样的盾牌？

english: The Shield of Arrav. We've discovered that Zemouregal intends to attack the city of Varrock with a zombie army. It was the shield that stopped him last time.
translation: 阿拉夫之盾。我们发现泽莫雷加尔打算用一支僵尸军队攻击维洛克城。上次正是这面盾牌阻止了他。

english: Ah, and you are hoping to use it to do so again. I wish I could help you, but I know little of the shield and its power. It was created far before my time.
translation: 啊，你希望再次用它来阻止他。我也想帮你，但我对盾牌和它的力量知之甚少。它是在我出生很久以前制造的。

english: Still, I may have a way for you to learn what you need.
translation: 不过，我或许有办法让你找到所需的信息。

english: The Sacred Forge of course!
translation: 当然是神圣熔炉！

english: But how will a forge help me?
translation: 但一座熔炉能帮我什么？

english: The Sacred Forge is far more than a mere furnace! It is a powerful relic from a time when the gods still walked these lands.
translation: 神圣熔炉远非普通的熔炉可比！它是众神尚行走在这片大地时期遗留下来的强大遗物。

english: Before Camdozaal's ruin, our sages would use the forge to guide our people. It is said the forge granted them access to the Dream Theatre, a place where they were blessed with visions of the past, present and future.
translation: 在卡姆多扎尔毁灭之前，我们的贤者们会利用熔炉来指引人民。据说熔炉让他们得以进入梦境剧场，在那里他们会得到过去、现在和未来的幻象。

english: I see. So how do I access this Dream Theatre?
translation: 我明白了。那我怎么进入梦境剧场？

english: The Forge will need powering, but normal barronite won't work for this. You'll need to obtain some imbued barronite. With that, provided the forge deems you worthy, you will be able to enter the Dream Theatre.
translation: 熔炉需要能量，但普通的巴隆石不行。你需要弄到一些注魔巴隆石。只要熔炉认为你值得，你就能进入梦境剧场。

english: And how do I get imbued barronite?
translation: 那我怎么得到注魔巴隆石？

english: Head to the mines and mine yourself a barronite deposit. Once you have that, imbue it using the core of a chaos golem from the golem workshop.
translation: 去矿场挖一块巴隆石矿床。得到之后，用混沌魔像工作室里的混沌魔像核心来注魔它。

english: How do I access the Dream Theatre?
translation: 我怎么进入梦境剧场？

english: You'll need to obtain some imbued barronite. Head to the mines and mine yourself a barronite deposit. Once you have that, imbue it using the core of a chaos golem from the golem workshop.
translation: 你需要弄到一些注魔巴隆石。去矿场挖一块巴隆石矿床。得到之后，用混沌魔像工作室里的混沌魔像核心来注魔它。

english: I see you've got the imbued barronite. Just place it into the Sacred Forge. Provided the forge deems you worthy, you'll then be able to enter the Dream Theatre.
translation: 我看到你拿到注魔巴隆石了。把它放进神圣熔炉里。只要熔炉认为你值得，你就能进入梦境剧场。

english: Arrav?
translation: 阿拉夫？

english: What is this? I feel... free. I can speak without pain. How is this possible?
translation: 这是什么？我感觉……自由了。我可以没有痛苦地说话了。这怎么可能？

english: We don't have much time. I'm talking to you from the Imcando Dream Theatre. I need to know how to use your shield.
translation: 我们时间不多了。我正在从伊姆坎多梦境剧场与你对话。我需要知道如何使用你的盾牌。

english: The shield... of course. What do you need to know?
translation: 盾牌……当然。你想知道什么？

english: You used the shield to defeat Zemouregal's army before. How can we do it again?
translation: 你以前用盾牌击败了泽莫雷加尔的军队。我们怎样才能再次做到？

english: It was not I who used the shield. When I faced Zemouregal, I cast the shield to the son of Avarrocka's founder. Only then did the zombies meet their doom.
translation: 不是我用的盾牌。当我面对泽莫雷加尔时，我把盾牌扔给了阿瓦罗卡创始人之子。只有那时僵尸才迎来了末日。

english: It was his blood. The shield is tied to Avarrocka. Only one with the blood of the founder can use it.
translation: 是他的血。盾牌与阿瓦罗卡相连。只有拥有创始人血统的人才能使用它。

english: So if I can find his descendant...
translation: 所以如果我能找到他的后代……

english: Then you can save my home.
translation: 那你就能拯救我的家园。

english: Wait... It's him! He knows you're here!
translation: 等等……他来了！他知道你在这里！

english: And what do we have here? Now, this is interesting... A snooping adventurer!
translation: 我们这儿有什么？嗯，真有趣……一个多管闲事的冒险者！

english: So you hope to stop me do you, you pathetic human wretch? Well my zombie army is at the walls of Varrock. You are already too late!
translation: 所以你想阻止我，是吗，你这可怜的人类渣滓？我的僵尸大军已经在维洛克城的城墙下。你已经来不及了！

english: Well? How did it go?
translation: 怎么样？进行得如何？

english: I know how to use the shield!
translation: 我知道怎么用盾牌了！

english: Now I need to get back to Varrock as fast as possible. I just hope I'm not too late.
translation: 现在我得尽快赶回维洛克城。但愿还不算太晚。

english: Oh this is not good! I need to find Elias and Captain Rovin!
translation: 哦，情况不妙！我得找到伊莱亚斯和罗文船长！

english: Where did all these zombies come from?
translation: 这些僵尸都是从哪里来的？

english: It's an invasion by Zemouregal.
translation: 是泽莫雷加尔的入侵。

english: The gods preserve us!
translation: 愿诸神保佑我们！

english: Don't worry, I'm working on a plan to get rid of them.
translation: 别担心，我正在计划怎么除掉它们。

english: We're doomed!
translation: 我们完蛋了！

english: Whatever you want, adventurer, it will need to wait. In case you hadn't noticed, there are zombies all over the palace!
translation: 不管你想要什么，冒险者，都得等等。你没注意到吗，宫殿里到处都是僵尸！

english: I'm sorry, Your Majesty. I'm trying to get rid of them.
translation: 抱歉，陛下。我正在努力赶走它们。

english: Well get to it then, rather than standing there yapping at me!
translation: 那就赶紧去办，别站在这里跟我废话！

english: What's going on? Where have all these zombies come from?
translation: 怎么回事？这些僵尸都是从哪里来的？

english: They're an army belonging to Zemouregal.
translation: 它们是泽莫雷加尔的一支军队。

english: Zemouregal? Saradomin preserve us!
translation: 泽莫雷加尔？愿萨拉多明保佑我们！

english: What are all these horrible, icky zombies doing in my nice, clean palace? You! You're an adventurer! Get out there and sort this out!
translation: 这些讨厌的、黏糊糊的僵尸在我漂亮干净的宫殿里干什么？你！你是个冒险者！出去把这些事情处理好！

english: What's happening? Where did all these zombies come from?
translation: 发生什么事了？这些僵尸都是从哪里来的？

english: It's an army of zombies belonging to Zemouregal.
translation: 是泽莫雷加尔的僵尸军队。

english: Ah... that is bad news indeed.
translation: 啊……那确实是个坏消息。

english: I'm working on a way to get rid of them, so fingers crossed.
translation: 我正在想办法赶走它们，希望一切顺利。

english: Why are there zombies all over the place? Is this normal in Misthalin?
translation: 为什么到处都是僵尸？这在米斯萨林很正常吗？

english: Not really. Normally they stick to caves and sewers.
translation: 不常见。通常它们都待在洞穴和下水道里。

english: Well I hope they get removed soon. This isn't very safe.
translation: 我希望它们很快被清除。这样不太安全。

english: Don't you think you should try and get to somewhere safer?
translation: 你不觉得你应该找个更安全的地方吗？

english: Well, I'd prefer to wait it out, but if someone doesn't deal with these things soon, I may have to.
translation: 嗯，我宁愿等一等，但如果没人尽快处理这些东西，我可能就得离开了。

english: About time you showed up! The zombies have breached the northern wall and are swarming the palace! We've managed to keep them from moving on the rest of Varrock for now, but we won't be able to do so forever!
translation: 你总算出现了！僵尸已经突破了北墙，正在涌入宫殿！我们暂时设法阻止了它们向维洛克城其余地方蔓延，但我们不可能永远挡住它们！

english: The situation isn't great, but all may not be lost. Did you manage to find out anything about how the shield works?
translation: 情况不太妙，但也许还不是全无希望。你了解到关于盾牌如何工作的任何信息了吗？

english: Sort of. I discovered that only a descendant of Varrock's original founder can use the shield, but I'm not sure how we'd find someone of that lineage still alive today.
translation: 算是吧。我发现只有维洛克城原始创始人的后代才能使用盾牌，但我不确定怎样才能找到仍然在世的血脉传人。

english: The library would be your best bet. Get down there and see if Reldo can help you.
translation: 图书馆是你最好的选择。去那里看看雷尔多能不能帮你。

english: Oh, and you'd better take this.
translation: 哦，你最好带上这个。

english: You're going to be needing this.
translation: 你会需要这个的。

english: Have you managed to make any progress, [player name]?
translation: 你有什么进展吗，[player name]？

english: You're back. Have you managed to make any progress?
translation: 你回来了。有什么进展吗？

english: Then you should get down to the library and talk to Reldo. If we don't get this situation under control, Varrock is doomed, and I'd very much prefer it if that could be avoided.
translation: 那你应该去图书馆找雷尔多谈谈。如果我们不能控制住局势，维洛克城就完蛋了，而我很希望避免这种情况。

english: Oh wonderful... he's gone.
translation: 哦，真棒……他跑了。

english: Who's gone?
translation: 谁跑了？

english: Surok Magis. The teleport block should have stopped him escaping, but it seems he was able to use the zombies as a distraction and disable the spell.
translation: 苏洛克.马吉斯。传送封锁本应阻止他逃跑，但他似乎利用僵尸作为掩护，并解除了法术。

english: In hindsight, imprisoning a deadly mage in a library was maybe not a very well thought out plan, but it seems we have bigger issues to deal with for now.
translation: 事后想来，把一名致命法师关在图书馆里也许不是个周密的计划，但眼下我们似乎有更棘手的问题要处理。

english: You can say that again. Speaking of which, I need your help. I must find out if there are any living descendants of the founder of Varrock.
translation: 你说得对。说到这个，我需要你的帮助。我必须查明是否还有维洛克城创始人的后代在世。

english: I'm normally the first person to chat about local history, but given the situation, is now really the best time for this?
translation: 通常我是第一个聊本地历史的人，但考虑到现在的情况，现在真的适合聊这个吗？

english: Yes. This information may help us to defeat the zombies.
translation: 是的。这些信息可能帮助我们击败僵尸。

english: Well in that case, I think I have what you need. There was a document on the desk in the corner listing the elders who sent Arrav on his original quest for the Shield of Arrav.
translation: 那样的话，我想我有你需要的东西。角落书桌上有一份文件，列出了当初派遣阿拉夫去寻找阿拉夫之盾的长老们。

english: One of those elders would have been the original founder of the city.
translation: 其中一位长老应该就是这座城市的原始创始人。

english: Sounds like a good start, but how would that help me track down their descendants?
translation: 听起来是个不错的开端，但这对找到他们的后代有什么用呢？

english: Notable families like that are unlikely to have changed their surnames over the years. If you consult the latest census, you'll hopefully find some matching names. You'll find it just next to the desk.
translation: 像这样的显赫家族不太可能改姓。如果你查阅最新的人口普查，希望你能找到一些匹配的姓氏。普查记录就在书桌旁边。

english: That's perfect! Thanks, Reldo.
translation: 太棒了！谢谢你，雷尔多。

english: Any luck with your search?
translation: 你的搜索有进展吗？

english: That document on the desk in the corner should be of use. It listed the names of the elders who sent Arrav on his original quest for the shield.
translation: 角落里书桌上的那份文件应该有用。上面列了当初派遣阿拉夫寻找盾牌的长老名字。

english: If you cross-reference the document with the latest census, you should hopefully be able to find their descendants.
translation: 如果你把那份文件和最新的人口普查对照一下，应该能找到他们的后代。

english: Reldo has given me a lead. Hopefully it will help us find someone who can use the shield.
translation: 雷尔多给了我一条线索。希望能帮我们找到能使用盾牌的人。

english: Good. Follow this lead and see where it takes you, but be quick about it. If we don't get this situation under control, Varrock is doomed, and I'd very much prefer it if that could be avoided.
translation: 很好。顺着这条线索去找，但要快。如果我们不能控制住局势，维洛克城就完蛋了，而我很希望避免这种情况。

english: Any luck with your search for those descendants?
translation: 你寻找那些后裔有进展吗？

english: I think so. I have some potential contenders at least.
translation: 应该有了。至少我找到了一些可能的候选人。

english: Well let's hope this works then. Things are starting to look a little bit problematic.
translation: 希望这能奏效。情况开始变得有点棘手了。

english: I have some contenders for the descendant of Varrock's original founder. I now just need to work out who the right one is.
translation: 我找到了一些维洛克城原始创始人的后代候选人。现在只需要找出哪一个是正确的。

english: Try giving the shield to them. Whoever the right person is, the shield should respond to them in some way.
translation: 试着把盾牌交给他们。谁是对的人，盾牌会以某种方式回应他。

english: And be quick about it. If we don't get this situation under control, Varrock is doomed, and I'd very much prefer it if that could be avoided.
translation: 动作快点。如果我们不控制住局面，维洛克城就完了，而我非常希望这能避免。

english: Don't worry, I'm working on a plan to get rid of them. You might be able to help by using the Shield of Arrav.
translation: 别担心，我正在制定一个消灭它们的计划。你也许可以用阿拉夫之盾来帮忙。

english: Yes. A descendant of an original elder of Avarrocka can apparently use it to stop the zombies. You're one of those descendants, although I'm not sure if you're the right one.
translation: 是的。阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔显然可以用它来阻止僵尸。你就是那些后裔之一，虽然我不确定你是不是正确的那位。

english: Well, I suppose anything is worth a try.
translation: 嗯，我想什么都值得一试。

english: Nothing seems to be happening.
translation: 似乎什么也没发生。

english: It must be someone else who's the right descendant then.
translation: 那一定是其他人才是真正的后裔。

english: Oh no... What if this doesn't work? We're doomed! We're doomed!
translation: 哦不……要是这不管用怎么办？我们完了！我们完了！

english: Nothing seems to be happening. What made you think I was descended from an original elder of Avarrocka?
translation: 似乎什么也没发生。是什么让你觉得我是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔？

english: Well your surname is Prysin. It matches the name of an elder called Khom Prysin.
translation: 嗯，你的姓氏是普里辛。它和一位叫科姆.普里辛的长老名字相符。

english: But I'm not actually a blood descendant of the Prysins. My great-grandfather, Wally, was adopted into the family.
translation: 但我其实不是普里辛家族的血脉后裔。我的曾祖父沃利是被收养进这个家族的。

english: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Prysins around?
translation: 有意思……那么，附近有真正的普里辛家族成员吗？

english: Well, none with the name Prysin. The last descendant of the Prysin line was a lady named Rhee Prysin. She married into the Fitzharmon family.
translation: 嗯，没有姓普里辛的了。普里辛家族最后一位后裔是一位名叫瑞.普里辛的女士。她嫁入了菲茨哈蒙家族。

english: As in Dimintheis Fitzharmon? Sounds like I'd better pay him a visit.
translation: 你是说迪明塞斯.菲茨哈蒙？看来我最好去拜访他一下。

english: All might not be lost. You might be able to help us by using the Shield of Arrav.
translation: 也许还有希望。你也许可以用阿拉夫之盾来帮助我们。

english: But I don't know how to use the shield... No one does.
translation: 但我不知道怎么用这面盾……没人知道。

english: I have a reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, which might mean that you have the ability to use it. Here, hold it and see if anything happens.
translation: 我有理由相信你是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔，这可能意味着你有能力使用它。来，拿着它，看看会发生什么。

english: Nothing special seems to be happening.
translation: 似乎没什么特别的事发生。

english: Then it must be someone else who's descended from the correct elder.
translation: 那一定是其他人才是正确长老的后裔。→ 那一定另有其人，是那位正确长老的后裔。

english: Well then you need to find them before these zombies kill us all!
translation: 那你得在这些僵尸杀死我们所有人之前找到他们！

english: Nothing special seems to be happening. Why do you think I'm descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, anyway?
translation: 似乎没什么特别的事发生。话说回来，你为什么觉得我是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔？

english: Well your surname is Raispher. It matches the name of an elder called Dathero Raispher.
translation: 嗯，你的姓氏是雷斯弗。它和一位叫达瑟罗.雷斯弗的长老名字相符。

english: Smart thinking, but also flawed. I'm not actually a blood descendant of the Raisphers. My great-grandfather was adopted into the family.
translation: 想法不错，但有漏洞。我其实不是雷斯弗家族的血脉后裔。我的曾祖父是被收养进这个家族的。

english: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Raisphers around?
translation: 有意思……那么，附近有真正的雷斯弗家族成员吗？

english: Well, none with the name Raispher. The last descendant of the Raispher line was a lady named Lucinda Raispher. She married into the Fitzharmon family.
translation: 嗯，没有姓雷斯弗的了。雷斯弗家族最后一位后裔是一位名叫露辛达.雷斯弗的女士。她嫁入了菲茨哈蒙家族。

english: Well I might have a solution to that. We have the Shield of Arrav.
translation: 嗯，我可能有个解决办法。我们有阿拉夫之盾。

english: No one has figured out how to unlock the powers of the shield in hundreds of years! Are we so desperate that we are relying on legends?
translation: 几百年来都没人弄清楚如何解锁这面盾的力量！我们是不是绝望到要依赖传说了？

english: It might be that you yourself can use it. I have a reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka.
translation: 也许你自己就能使用它。我有理由相信你是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔。

english: Well of course! Would you expect anything less of the man who is king?
translation: 那当然！你还能对身为国王的人期待什么呢？

english: Here, hold the shield and see if anything happens.
translation: 来，拿着这面盾，看看会发生什么。

english: It doesn't seem to be doing anything special.
translation: 它似乎没什么特别的作用。

english: It must be someone else who is descended from the correct elder then.
translation: 那一定是其他人才是正确长老的后裔。→ 那一定另有其人，是那位正确长老的后裔。

english: Well then you'd better get out there and find them! These zombies need to be stopped!
translation: 那你最好出去找到他们！这些僵尸必须被阻止！

english: A shield? Sounds like my area. What do you need?
translation: 一面盾？听起来是我的领域。你需要什么？

english: It's not your skills as a Blacksmith I need. It's to do with the zombie attack on the palace!
translation: 我需要的不是你作为铁匠的技能。而是与僵尸袭击宫殿有关！

english: Oh, I see. What do you need me to do?
translation: 哦，我明白了。你需要我做什么？

english: I have reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, which might mean you have the ability to use the Shield of Arrav to defeat the zombies.
translation: 我有理由相信你是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔，这可能意味着你有能力使用阿拉夫之盾来击败僵尸。

english: The Shield of Arrav? Sounds a bit unlikely to me, but I'll give it a go.
translation: 阿拉夫之盾？听起来有点不太可能，但我愿意试试。

english: It doesn't seem to be doing anything exciting.
translation: 它似乎没什么令人兴奋的事发生。

english: It must be a different descendant that I'm after then.
translation: 那我要找的一定是另一个后裔了。

english: Well good luck finding them. Last thing we need is those zombies moving on the rest of the city.
translation: 祝你好运找到他们。我们最不希望的就是那些僵尸蔓延到城市其他地方。

english: It doesn't seem to be doing anything exciting. Why do you think I was descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, anyway?
translation: 它似乎没什么令人兴奋的事发生。话说回来，你为什么觉得我是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔？

english: Well your surname is Ravitz. It matches the name of an elder called Ramone Ravitz.
translation: 嗯，你的姓氏是拉维茨。它和一位叫拉蒙.拉维茨的长老名字相符。

english: Ah... I'm not actually a blood descendant of the Ravitzes. My great-grandfather was adopted into the family.
translation: 啊……我其实不是拉维茨家族的血脉后裔。我的曾祖父是被收养进这个家族的。

english: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Ravitzes around?
translation: 有意思……那么，附近有真正的拉维茨家族成员吗？

english: I'm the only one I know of with the Ravitz surname. The last descendant of the Ravitz line was a lady named Shauna Ravitz. She married into the Fitzharmon family.
translation: 据我所知，我是唯一一个姓拉维茨的人。拉维茨家族最后一位后裔是一位名叫肖娜.拉维茨的女士。她嫁入了菲茨哈蒙家族。

english: I need your help with the zombie invasion.
translation: 我需要你帮忙应对僵尸入侵。

english: I'm flattered, but I'm sure I don't have the combat prowess for those kinds of shenanigans.
translation: 我很荣幸，但我肯定没有那种战斗能力去应付那种胡闹。

english: Maybe not normally, but the Shield of Arrav might change that.
translation: 也许平时没有，但阿拉夫之盾可能会改变这一点。

english: I'm not sure the shield, nice as it is, will make that much difference.
translation: 我不确定这面盾，虽然不错，但能有多大区别。

english: Well I have reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, which might mean you have the ability to use the shield. Here, hold it and see if anything happens.
translation: 嗯，我有理由相信你是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔，这可能意味着你有能力使用这面盾。来，拿着它，看看会发生什么。

english: Well, I've held it a few times in the course of my work, but I'll give it a go.
translation: 嗯，我在工作中拿过它几次，但我愿意试试。

english: Well I wish you luck in finding them.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运找到他们。

english: Nothing special seems to be happening. Why do you think I'm descended from an original elder of Varrock, anyway?
translation: 似乎没什么特别的事发生。话说回来，你为什么觉得我是维洛克城一位原始长老的后裔？

english: Well, your surname is Halen. It matches the name of an elder called Marv Halen.
translation: 嗯，你的姓氏是哈伦。它和一位叫马夫.哈伦的长老名字相符。

english: Now that is smart thinking, but I'm not actually a blood descendant of the original Halens. My great-grandfather was adopted into the family.
translation: 想法确实不错，但我其实不是原始哈伦家族的血脉后裔。我的曾祖父是被收养进这个家族的。

english: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Halens around?
translation: 有意思……那么，附近有真正的哈伦家族成员吗？

english: The last descendant of the Halen line that I know of was a lady named Edwina. She married into the Fitzharmon family.
translation: 据我所知，哈伦家族最后一位后裔是一位名叫埃德温娜的女士。她嫁入了菲茨哈蒙家族。

english: Romeo! I need to speak to you. A zombie army has invaded the palace and you might be the only one who's able to stop them.
translation: 罗密欧！我需要和你谈谈。一支僵尸军队入侵了宫殿，你可能是唯一能阻止它们的人。

english: Ooh, do you really think I could? I've always wanted to be a hero!
translation: 哦，你真的觉得我能行吗？我一直想当个英雄！

english: Well, I'm not sure. We might be able to find out with this shield though.
translation: 嗯，我不确定。不过我们也许可以用这面盾来弄清楚。

english: Shield? What do you mean?
translation: 盾？你什么意思？

english: I have reason to believe that you are descended from an original elder of Avarrocka, which might mean that you can use the Shield of Arrav to defeat the zombies. Here, hold it and see if anything happens.
translation: 我有理由相信你是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔，这可能意味着你可以用阿拉夫之盾来击败僵尸。来，拿着它，看看会发生什么。

english: Ooh, okay, that sounds fun!
translation: 哦，好的，听起来很有趣！

english: Oh... Nothing's happening.
translation: 哦……什么也没发生。

english: I guess it must be a different descendant that I'm after.
translation: 我想我要找的一定是另一个后裔。

english: That's a shame. I would have quite liked to have been the one to use it.
translation: 真可惜。我本来还挺想成为使用它的人。

english: Oh... Nothing's happening. Are you sure it was me who was meant to be using it?
translation: 哦……什么也没发生。你确定应该使用它的人是我吗？

english: Well it wasn't a guarantee, but your surname matches that of an elder called Ramone Gontamue.
translation: 嗯，这不是保证，但你的姓氏和一位叫拉蒙.贡塔缪的长老名字相符。

english: Oh, well I'm not actually a real descendant of the Gontamues. My great-grandfather was adopted into the family.
translation: 哦，我其实不是贡塔缪家族真正的后裔。我的曾祖父是被收养进这个家族的。

english: Interesting... So, are there any genuine Gontamues around?
translation: 有意思……那么，附近有真正的贡塔缪家族成员吗？

english: Not exactly. The last descendant of the Gontamue line was Lilith Gontamue. She married into the Fitzharmon family.
translation: 不完全是。贡塔缪家族最后一位后裔是莉莉丝.贡塔缪。她嫁入了菲茨哈蒙家族。

english: You have my eternal gratitude for all you have done in saving my family's honour, adventurer. Perhaps some day my sons will overcome their differences.
translation: 你为我家族荣誉所做的一切，我永远感激不尽，冒险者。也许有一天我的儿子们能化解他们的分歧。

english: Well, I suppose I could help, but I am getting on a bit now. I'm not quite the warrior I used to be.
translation: 嗯，我想我可以帮忙，但我现在有点老了。我不再是以前那个战士了。

english: I'm hoping the Shield of Arrav may help a little.
translation: 我希望阿拉夫之盾能帮上一点忙。

english: Ah, yes, I know of the shield's legend. I don't understand what that has to do with me though.
translation: 啊，是的，我知道这面盾的传说。但我不明白这和我有什么关系。

english: I have reason to believe that you're descended from one of the original elders of Avarrocka, which might mean you have the ability to use the shield.
translation: 我有理由相信你是阿瓦罗卡一位原始长老的后裔，这可能意味着你有能力使用这面盾。

english: That doesn't sound entirely convincing, but I'll give it a go.
translation: 这听起来不太有说服力，但我愿意试试。

english: Well, that is impressive.
translation: 嗯，这真是令人印象深刻。

english: I think you might be the one! Quick, let's get to the palace!
translation: 我想你就是那个人！快，我们去宫殿！

english: You want me to use the shield? It seems to be responding to me in some way! Is this what you were expecting?
translation: 你想让我用这面盾？它似乎以某种方式在回应我！这是你期望的吗？

english: I think so! Quick, let's get to the palace!
translation: 我想是的！快，我们去宫殿！

english: Die, zombie scum!
translation: 去死吧，僵尸渣滓！

english: Hurrah! Free at last.
translation: 万岁！终于自由了。

english: Erm.
translation: 呃。

english: Stay back! I won't let you eat me!
translation: 退后！我不会让你吃掉我的！

english: Zemouregal... The forces... What do we do?
translation: 泽莫雷加尔……那些军队……我们怎么办？

english: What do we do? We flee, you fool!
translation: 我们怎么办？我们逃跑，你这个傻瓜！

english: But all the work...
translation: 但所有的工作……

english: Do you have a better suggestion? Are you hiding some secret to overcoming such an astounding disaster?
translation: 你有更好的建议吗？你是不是藏着什么秘密能克服如此惊人的灾难？

english: Then recall Arrav at once! There is nothing more to be gained here. It is time for us to head north.
translation: 那就立刻召回阿拉夫！这里没什么可得的了。是时候向北进发了。

english: It seems the shield worked better than anyone could have hoped for. From what we can tell, not a single zombie remains! It was a close one, but thanks to you, Varrock is saved!
translation: 看来这面盾牌的效果比任何人预期的都要好。据我们所知，连一个僵尸都没有剩下！真是千钧一发，但多亏了你，维洛克城得救了！

english: It wouldn't have been possible without Dimintheis.
translation: 没有迪明塞斯的话，这是不可能的。

english: Indeed. I will ensure the King is made aware of his contribution.
translation: 确实。我会确保国王知道他的贡献。

english: Any word on what happened to Zemouregal?
translation: 有泽莫雷加尔的消息吗？

english: There's been no sign of him so far. We'll keep an eye out, but I suspect he'll have gone to ground.
translation: 目前还没有他的踪迹。我们会留意的，但我怀疑他已经躲起来了。

english: And he'll have Arrav with him.
translation: 而且他会带着阿拉夫。

english: We may not have been able to save Arrav today, but thanks to your discoveries, we now have a lead to follow. It will take me some time, but once I have something on this heart business, I'll be in touch.
translation: 我们今天也许没能救下阿拉夫，但多亏了你的发现，我们现在有了可以追踪的线索。这需要一些时间，但一旦我在心脏这件事上有了进展，我会联系你的。

english: And on that note, I intend to get started right away. Until we meet again.
translation: 说到这个，我打算马上开始。后会有期。

english: Well once again, adventurer, on behalf of Varrock, you have my thanks. Today's victory will go down in history.
translation: 那么再次，冒险者，我代表维洛克城感谢你。今天的胜利将载入史册。

english: Now, you'd best be on your way. I have lots of work to do, and I'm sure you have better places to be than here.
translation: 现在，你最好上路吧。我有很多工作要做，而且我相信你有比这里更好的地方要去。

english: Oh, it's you. Thank you again for your help in defeating the zombie army.
translation: 哦，是你啊。再次感谢你帮忙击败了僵尸大军。

english: Now, you must excuse me. I have lots to do.
translation: 现在，请原谅我。我还有很多事要做。

english: And you, Elias. So what brings you all the way out here?
translation: 还有你，伊莱亚斯。那么是什么风把你吹到这里来了？

english: Well it turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.
translation: 嗯，事实证明，沙漠是开始研究阿拉夫及其心脏的最佳地点。考虑到这里的埋葬习俗，这当然不奇怪。

english: And how's that going so far?
translation: 进展如何？

english: Pretty well. In fact, I think I'm getting close to something. It's related to that old mastaba up on the plateau. I reckon it might contain the knowledge we need to help old Arrav out.
translation: 相当顺利。事实上，我觉得我快接近某个发现了。这与高原上那座古老石墓有关。我估计里面可能藏有我们帮助老阿拉夫所需的知识。

english: Ah. That. Tell me more.
translation: 啊。那个。再多说点。

english: The little black cat that wanders around sometimes? Sure, most people know him.
translation: 那只偶尔到处溜达的小黑猫？当然，大多数人都认识它。

english: researched it. If you have the qualifications and help us out around the Museum, I'm sure we could offer you a place on the dig when we're ready to go.
translation: 研究过了。如果你有资质，并且在博物馆帮忙，我相信等我们准备出发时，可以给你在考古挖掘中留个位置。

english: The cleaning area, yes. Well, we have some really good archaeologists on site right now. They're cleaning up the finds that are shipped over from the Dig Site to the east of here. If you have the right qualifications, you can
translation: 清洁区，没错。嗯，我们现在现场有一些非常优秀的考古学家。他们正在清理从东边的考古挖掘场运来的发现物。如果你有合适的资质，你可以

english: help them clean the finds.
translation: 帮助他们清理发现物。

english: Hmm, your backpack seems a tad full, though. Best come back when you have a little more space!
translation: 嗯，不过你的背包似乎有点满了。最好等你有更多空间的时候再来！

english: Hello young one. Cross my palm with silver and the future will be revealed to you.
translation: 你好，年轻人。用银币划过我的手掌，未来就会向你揭示。

english: Oh dear. I don't have any money.
translation: 哎呀，我身上没带钱。

english: Come closer, and listen carefully to what the future holds for you, as I peer into the swirling mists of the crystal ball.
translation: 靠近些，仔细听好未来为你准备了什么，我要凝视水晶球中旋转的迷雾了。

english: I can see images forming. I can see you.
translation: 我看到影像在成形。我看到你了。

english: You are holding a very impressive looking sword. I'm sure I recognise that sword...
translation: 你手里拿着一把非常引人注目的剑。我肯定我认得那把剑……

english: There is a big dark shadow appearing now.
translation: 现在出现了一个巨大的黑暗阴影。

english: It's Delrith! Delrith is coming!
translation: 是德尔里斯！德尔里斯要来了！

english: Who's Delrith?
translation: 德尔里斯是谁？

english: Delrith...
translation: 德尔里斯……

english: Delrith is a powerful demon.
translation: 德尔里斯是一个强大的恶魔。

english: Oh! I really hope he didn't see me looking at him through my crystal ball!
translation: 哦！我真希望他没发现我透过水晶球在看他！

english: He tried to destroy this city 150 years ago. He was stopped just in time by the great hero Wally.
translation: 150年前他试图摧毁这座城市。幸好被伟大的英雄沃利及时阻止了。

english: Using his magic sword Silverlight, Wally managed to trap the demon in the stone circle just south of this city.
translation: 沃利用他的魔法剑银光剑，成功将恶魔困在了这座城市南边的石圈中。

english: Ye gods! Silverlight was the sword you were holding in my vision! You are the one destined to stop the demon this time.
translation: 天哪！银光剑就是你在我幻象中拿着的那把剑！你就是这次注定要阻止恶魔的人。

english: How am I meant to fight a demon who can destroy cities?!
translation: 我要怎么跟一个能毁灭城市的恶魔战斗？！

english: If you face Delrith while he is still weak from being summoned, and use the correct weapon, you will not find the task too arduous.
translation: 如果你在德尔里斯刚被召唤出来、还很虚弱的时候面对他，并且使用正确的武器，你会发现任务并不那么艰巨。

english: Do not fear. If you follow the path of the great hero Wally, then you are sure to defeat the demon.
translation: 别害怕。如果你追随伟大英雄沃利的道路，那你一定能击败恶魔。

english: Okay, where is he? I'll kill him for you!
translation: 好，他在哪？我替你去杀了他！

english: Ah, the overconfidence of the young!
translation: 啊，年轻人的过度自信！

english: Delrith can't be harmed by ordinary weapons. You must face him using the same weapon that Wally used.
translation: 普通武器伤不了德尔里斯。你必须用沃利使用过的同一把武器去面对他。

english: Wally doesn't sound a very heroic name.
translation: 沃利这名字听起来不太像个英雄。

english: Yes I know. Maybe that is why history doesn't remember him. However he was a very great hero.
translation: 是啊，我知道。也许这就是历史不记得他的原因。不过他确实是一位非常伟大的英雄。

english: Who knows how much pain and suffering Delrith would have brought forth without Wally to stop him!
translation: 要是没有沃利阻止他，谁知道德尔里斯会带来多少痛苦和磨难！

english: It looks like you are going to need to perform similar heroics.
translation: 看来你也需要做出类似的英雄壮举了。

english: So how did Wally kill Delrith?
translation: 那沃利是怎么杀死德尔里斯的？

english: Wally managed to arrive at the stone circle just as Delrith was summoned by a cult of chaos druids...
translation: 沃利恰好赶到了石圈，当时德尔里斯正被一群混沌德鲁伊召唤出来...

english: Die, foul demon!
translation: 去死吧，邪恶的恶魔！

english: Now, what was that incantation again?
translation: 那么，那句咒语是什么来着？

english: [word 1]... [word 2]... [word 3]... [word 4]... [word 5]!
translation: [word 1]……[word 2]……[word 3]……[word 4]……[word 5]！

english: I am the greatest demon slayer EVER!
translation: 我是史上最伟大的恶魔杀手！
