english: By reciting the correct magical incantation, and thrusting Silverlight into Delrith while he was newly summoned, Wally was able to imprison Delrith in the stone block in the centre of the circle.
translation: 通过念出正确的魔法咒语，并在德尔里斯刚被召唤时将银光剑刺入他体内，沃利成功将德尔里斯囚禁在圆圈中央的石块中。

english: Delrith will come forth from the stone circle again.
translation: 德尔里斯会再次从石圈中出来。

english: I would imagine an evil sorcerer is already starting on the rituals to summon Delrith as we speak.
translation: 我猜，就在我们说话的当下，已经有一个邪恶的巫师开始着手进行召唤德尔里斯的仪式了。

english: What is the magical incantation?
translation: 那句魔法咒语是什么？

english: Oh yes, let me think a second...
translation: 哦，对，让我想一下……

english: Alright, I think I've got it now, it goes.... [word 1]... [word 2]... [word 3]... [word 4]... [word 5]. Have you got that?
translation: 好了，我想我记起来了，咒语是……[word 1]……[word 2]……[word 3]……[word 4]……[word 5]。你记住了吗？

english: I think so, yes.
translation: 我想是的，记住了。

english: Where can I find Silverlight?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到银光剑？

english: Silverlight has been passed down through Wally's descendants. I believe it is currently in the care of one of the King's knights called Sir Prysin.
translation: 银光剑在沃利的后代中代代相传。我相信它目前由国王的一位名叫普里辛爵士的骑士保管。

english: He shouldn't be too hard to find. He lives in the royal palace in this city. Tell him Aris sent you.
translation: 他应该不难找。他就住在这座城市的王宫里。告诉他你是阿里斯派来的。

english: Ok thanks. I'll do my best to stop the demon.
translation: 好的，谢谢。我会尽力阻止恶魔的。

english: Good luck, and may Guthix be with you!
translation: 祝你好运，愿古斯与你同在！

english: No, I don't believe in that stuff.
translation: 不，我不信那套东西。

english: Greetings. How goes thy quest?
translation: 你好。你的任务进行得怎么样了？

english: Well if you need any advice I'm always here, young one.
translation: 如果你需要任何建议，我随时都在，年轻人。

english: Well I'd better press on with it.
translation: 嗯，我还是继续赶路吧。

english: See you anon.
translation: 回头见。

english: I am a mighty adventurer, who are you?
translation: 我是一位强大的冒险者，你是谁？

english: I am Sir Prysin. A bold and famous knight of the realm.
translation: 我是普里辛爵士，王国中一位勇敢而著名的骑士。

english: I was hoping you could tell me.
translation: 我正希望你能告诉我呢。

english: Well I've never met you before.
translation: 嗯，我以前从没见过你。

english: Aris said I should come and talk to you.
translation: 阿里斯说让我来找你谈谈。

english: Aris? Is she still alive? I remember her from when I was pretty young. Well what do you need to talk to me about?
translation: 阿里斯？她还活着？我小时候就记得她了。那么，你需要跟我谈什么？

english: I need to find Silverlight.
translation: 我需要找到银光剑。

english: What do you need to find that for?
translation: 你找那个做什么？

english: I need it to fight Delrith.
translation: 我需要用它来对抗德尔里斯。

english: Delrith? I thought the world was rid of him, thanks to my great-grandfather.
translation: 德尔里斯？我以为世界早就摆脱他了，多亏了我的曾祖父。

english: Well Aris' crystal ball seems to think otherwise.
translation: 但阿里斯的水晶球似乎不这么认为。

english: Well if the ball says so, I'd better help you.
translation: 好吧，如果水晶球这么说，那我最好帮你。

english: The problem is getting Silverlight.
translation: 问题在于如何拿到银光剑。

english: You mean you don't have it?
translation: 你是说你没有？

english: Oh I do have it, but it is so powerful that the king made me put it in a special box which needs three different keys to open it. That way it won't fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 哦，我确实有它，但它太强大了，国王让我把它放在一个需要三把不同钥匙才能打开的专用箱子里。这样它就不会落入坏人之手。

english: So give me the keys!
translation: 那就把钥匙给我！

english: Um, well, it's not so easy.
translation: 嗯，这个，没那么简单。

english: I kept one of the keys. I gave the other two to other people for safe keeping.
translation: 我自己留了一把钥匙。另外两把给了别人保管。

english: One I gave to Rovin, the captain of the palace guard.
translation: 一把我给了罗文，他是宫殿守卫的船长。

english: I gave the other to the wizard Traiborn.
translation: 另一把我给了魔法师特雷伯恩。

english: Can you give me your key?
translation: 你能把你的钥匙给我吗？

english: Well there's a problem there as well.
translation: 这里也有个问题。

english: I managed to drop the key in the drain just outside the palace kitchen. It is just inside and I can't reach it.
translation: 我不小心把钥匙掉在宫殿厨房外面的排水沟里了。它就在里面，但我够不着。

english: So what does the drain connect to?
translation: 那排水沟通向哪里？

english: It is the drain for the drainpipe running from the sink in the kitchen down to the palace sewers.
translation: 那是从厨房水槽通往宫殿下水道的排水管的排水沟。

english: Well I'd better go key hunting.
translation: 好吧，我最好去找钥匙了。

english: Ok, goodbye.
translation: 好的，再见。

english: Where can I find Captain Rovin?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到罗文船长？

english: Captain Rovin lives at the top of the guards' quarters in the north-west wing of this palace.
translation: 罗文船长住在宫殿西北翼守卫宿舍的顶层。

english: Where does the wizard live?
translation: 那个魔法师住在哪里？

english: Wizard Traiborn?
translation: 魔法师特雷伯恩？

english: He is one of the wizards who lives in the tower on the little island just off the south coast. I believe his quarters are on the first floor of the tower.
translation: 他是住在南海岸外小岛塔中的一位魔法师。我相信他的住处就在塔的一楼。

english: And why is this a problem?
translation: 为什么这是个问题？

english: He's back and unfortunately I've got to deal with him.
translation: 他回来了，不幸的是我得去对付他。

english: You don't look up to much. I suppose Silverlight may be good enough to carry you through though.
translation: 你看起来不怎么样。不过我想银光剑应该足以让你撑过去。

english: Yes she is still alive. She lives right outside the castle!
translation: 是的，她还活着。她就住在城堡外面！

english: Oh, is that the same Aris? I would have thought she would have died by now. She was pretty old when I was a lad.
translation: 哦，是那个阿里斯吗？我还以为她早就死了。我小时候她就很老了。

english: Anyway, what can I do for you?
translation: 总之，我能为你做什么？

english: So how are you doing with getting the keys?
translation: 那么，你找钥匙找得怎么样了？

english: I haven't found any of them yet.
translation: 我一把都还没找到。

english: Can you remind me where all the keys were again?
translation: 你能再提醒我一下所有钥匙都在哪里吗？

english: Ok, tell me when you've got them all.
translation: 好的，等你都拿到了再告诉我。

english: I've got the key from Captain Rovin.
translation: 我已经从罗文船长那里拿到了钥匙。

english: I've got the key from Wizard Traiborn.
translation: 我已经从魔法师特雷伯恩那里拿到了钥匙。

english: I've got the key which you dropped down the drain.
translation: 我已经拿到了你掉进排水沟的那把钥匙。

english: I've got the keys from Wizard Traiborn and Captain Rovin.
translation: 我已经从魔法师特雷伯恩和罗文船长那里拿到了钥匙。

english: I've got the key from Captain Rovin and the one that you dropped down the drain.
translation: 我已经从罗文船长那里拿到了钥匙，还有你掉进排水沟的那把。

english: I've got the key from Wizard Traiborn and the one that you dropped down the drain.
translation: 我已经从魔法师特雷伯恩那里拿到了钥匙，还有你掉进排水沟的那把。

english: There's a demon who wants to invade the city.
translation: 有个恶魔想入侵这座城市。

english: Is it a powerful demon?
translation: 是个强大的恶魔吗？

english: Well, I'm sure the palace guards can deal with it, then. Thanks for the information.
translation: 嗯，那我肯定宫殿守卫能应付得了。谢谢你的情报。

english: Yes, very.
translation: 是的，非常强大。

english: As good as the palace guards are, I don't know if they're up to taking on a very powerful demon.
translation: 虽然皇宫守卫很厉害，但我不确定他们能不能对付一个非常强大的恶魔。

english: Yeah, the palace guards are rubbish!
translation: 是啊，皇宫守卫都是废物！

english: Yeah, they're--
translation: 没错，他们——

english: Wait! How dare you insult the palace guards? Get out of my sight!
translation: 等等！你竟敢侮辱皇宫守卫？给我滚出去！

english: It's not them who are going to fight the demon, it's me.
translation: 去和恶魔战斗的不是他们，是我。

english: What, all by yourself? How are you going to do that?
translation: 什么，就你一个人？你打算怎么做？

english: I'm going to use the powerful sword Silverlight, which I believe you have one of the keys for?
translation: 我要用强大的剑——银光剑，我相信你有一把它的钥匙？

english: Yes, I do. But why should I give it to you?
translation: 没错，我确实有。但我凭什么要给你？

english: Fortune-teller Aris said I was destined to kill the demon.
translation: 占卜师阿里斯说我命中注定要杀死那个恶魔。

english: A fortune-teller? Destiny? I don't believe in that stuff. I got where I am today by hard work, not by destiny! Why should I care what that mad old fortune-teller says?
translation: 占卜师？命运？我才不信那套。我能有今天靠的是努力，不是命运！我干嘛要在乎那个疯老太婆占卜师说的话？

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city!
translation: 否则恶魔会摧毁这座城市！

english: You can't fool me! How do I know you haven't just made that story up to get my key?
translation: 你骗不了我！我怎么知道你不是编故事来骗我的钥匙？

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key.
translation: 普里辛爵士说你会把钥匙给我。

english: Oh, he did, did he? Well I don't report to Sir Prysin, I report directly to the king!
translation: 哦，他说的，是吗？我可不用向普里辛爵士汇报，我直接向国王汇报！

english: I didn't work my way up through the ranks of the palace guards so I could take orders from an ill-bred moron who only has his job because his great- grandfather was a hero with a silly name!
translation: 我辛辛苦苦从皇宫守卫一路爬上来，可不是为了听一个血统低贱、只因为他曾祖父是个名字可笑的英雄才得到这份工作的白痴的命令！

english: Why did he give you one of the keys then?
translation: 那他为什么给了你一把钥匙？

english: Only because the king ordered him to! The king couldn't get Sir Prysin to part with his precious ancestral sword, but he made him lock it up so he couldn't lose it.
translation: 只是因为国王命令他！国王没法让普里辛爵士交出他珍贵的祖传宝剑，但让他把剑锁起来，这样他就不会弄丢了。

english: I got one key and I think some wizard got another. Now what happened to the third one?
translation: 我拿到了一把钥匙，我想某个魔法师拿到了另一把。那第三把钥匙呢？

english: Sir Prysin dropped it down a drain!
translation: 普里辛爵士把它掉进排水沟里了！

english: Ha ha ha! The idiot!
translation: 哈哈哈！那个白痴！

english: Okay, I'll give you the key, just so that it's you that kills the demon and not Sir Prysin!
translation: 好吧，我把钥匙给你，只要是你去杀恶魔，而不是普里辛爵士！

english: Yes, you said before, haven't you killed it yet?
translation: 你之前说过了，你还没杀死它吗？

english: Well I'm going to use the powerful sword Silverlight, which I believe you have one of the keys for?
translation: 嗯，我要用强大的剑——银光剑，我相信你有一把它的钥匙？

english: I already gave you my key. Check your pockets.
translation: 我已经把钥匙给你了。检查一下你的口袋。

english: I already gave you my key. Maybe you left it somewhere. Have you checked your bank account?
translation: 我已经把钥匙给你了。也许你把它落在哪里了。你查过你的银行账户了吗？

english: A gypsy? Destiny? I don't believe in that stuff. I got where I am today by hard work, not by destiny! Why should I care what that mad old gypsy says?
translation: 吉普赛人？命运？我才不信那些玩意儿。我靠努力才有今天的成就，不是靠命运！我干嘛要在乎那个疯老头吉普赛人说什么？

english: Talk to me again when you have free inventory space.
translation: 等你有空余背包空间时再跟我说话。

english: Well in that case shouldn't you be outside fighting the demon and not in here?!
translation: 那这样的话，你不是应该在外面和恶魔战斗而不是待在这里吗？！

english: Only because the king ordered him to! The king couldn't get Sir Prysin to part with his precious ancestral sword, but he made him lock it up so he couldn't loose it.
translation: 只是因为国王命令他！国王无法说服普里辛爵士放弃他珍贵的祖传宝剑，但让他把剑锁起来，这样他就不会弄丢了。

english: Well, yes I suppose we'd let him up, He doesn't generally want to come up here, but if he did want to, he could.
translation: 嗯，是的，我想我们会让他上来的。他通常不想上来，但如果他想的话，他可以。

english: Talk to me againw hen you have free inventory space.
translation: 等你有空余背包空间时再跟我说话。

english: That must be the key Sir Prysin dropped.
translation: 那一定是普里辛爵士掉落的钥匙。

english: I don't seem to be able to reach it. I wonder if I can dislodge it somehow. That way it may go down into the sewers.
translation: 我好像够不着。不知道能不能用什么办法把它弄松。这样它可能会掉进下水道。

english: OK, I think I've washed the key down into the sewer. I'd better go down and get it!
translation: 好了，我想我已经把钥匙冲进下水道了。我最好下去把它捡起来！

english: I need to get a key given to you by Sir Prysin.
translation: 我需要拿到普里辛爵士给你保管的一把钥匙。

english: Sir Prysin? Who's that? What would I want his key for?
translation: 普里辛爵士？那是谁？我要他的钥匙干嘛？

english: He told me you were looking after it for him.
translation: 他告诉我你替他保管着。

english: That wasn't very clever of him. I'd lose my head if it wasn't screwed on. Go and tell him to find someone else to look after his valuables in future.
translation: 他可真不聪明。要不是脑袋长在脖子上，我连头都会弄丢。去告诉他，以后找别人保管他的贵重物品吧。

english: Okay, I'll go and tell him that.
translation: 好的，我去告诉他。

english: Oh that's great, if it wouldn't be too much trouble.
translation: 哦，那太好了，如果不太麻烦的话。

english: He's one of the King's knights.
translation: 他是国王的一位骑士。

english: Say, I remember one of the King's knights. He had nice shoes...
translation: 说起来，我记得国王的一位骑士。他穿着漂亮的鞋子……

english: ...and didn't like my homemade spinach rolls. Would you like a spinach roll?
translation: ……而且不喜欢我自制的菠菜卷。你要来一个菠菜卷吗？

english: Just tell me if you have the key.
translation: 你就告诉我你有没有钥匙。

english: The key? The key to what?
translation: 钥匙？什么钥匙？

english: There's more than one key in the world don't you know? Would be a bit odd if there was only the one.
translation: 世界上不止一把钥匙，你不知道吗？如果只有一把，那才奇怪呢。

english: It's the key to get a sword called Silverlight.
translation: 是打开一把叫银光剑的剑的钥匙。

english: Silverlight? Never heard of that. Sounds a good name for a ship. Are you sure it's not the name of a ship rather than a sword?
translation: 银光剑？从没听说过。听起来倒像是个好船名。你确定这不是一艘船的名字，而不是一把剑？

english: Yeah, pretty sure.
translation: 嗯，我很确定。

english: That's a pity, waste of a name.
translation: 真可惜，浪费了一个好名字。

english: You've lost it haven't you?
translation: 你把它弄丢了，对吧？

english: Me? Lose things? That's a nasty accusation.
translation: 我？弄丢东西？这可是个恶毒的指控。

english: Well, have you got any keys knocking around?
translation: 那么，你手头有没有什么钥匙？

english: Now you come to mention it, yes I do have a key. It's in my special closet of valuable stuff. Now how do I get into that?
translation: 你这么一说，我确实有一把钥匙。它在我那个专门放贵重物品的柜子里。可我怎么打开那个柜子呢？

english: I sealed it using one of my magic rituals. So it would make sense that another ritual would open it again.
translation: 我用我的一个魔法仪式把它封住了。所以，用另一个仪式应该就能重新打开它。

english: So do you know what ritual to use?
translation: 那你知道该用什么仪式吗？

english: Let me think a second.
translation: 让我想一下。

english: Yes a simple drazier style ritual should suffice. Hmm, main problem with that is I'll need 25 sets of bones. Now where am I going to get hold of something like that?
translation: 是的，一个简单的德雷泽风格仪式应该就够了。嗯，主要问题是我需要25套骨头。我上哪儿去弄这些东西呢？

english: Hmm, that's too bad. I really need that key.
translation: 嗯，那太糟了。我真的很需要那把钥匙。

english: Ah well, sorry I couldn't be any more help.
translation: 啊，好吧，抱歉我帮不上什么忙了。

english: I'll help get the bones for you.
translation: 我来帮你弄骨头。

english: Ooh that would be very good of you.
translation: 哦，那真是太好了。

english: Okay, I'll speak to you when I've got some bones.
translation: 好的，我弄到一些骨头后再来找你。

english: How are you doing finding bones?
translation: 你找骨头找得怎么样了？

english: I haven't got any at the moment.
translation: 我目前还没有。

english: Nevermind, keep working on it.
translation: 没关系，继续努力。

english: I have some bones.
translation: 我有一些骨头。

english: Give 'em here then.
translation: 那就把它们给我吧。

english: That's all of them.
translation: 就这些了。

english: I still need [25-X] more.
translation: 我还需要[25-X]套。

english: Ok, I'll keep looking.
translation: 好的，我会继续找。

english: Hurrah! That's all 25 sets of bones.
translation: 好极了！正好25套骨头。

english: Wings of dark and colour too, Spreading in the morning dew; Locked away I have a key; Return it now, please, unto me.
translation: 黑暗与色彩的翅膀，在晨露中舒展；我有一把钥匙被锁藏；现在请把它归还于我。

english: Not a problem for a friend of Sir What's-his-face.
translation: 对那位叫什么爵士的朋友来说，这不算什么。

english: Don't you have somewhere to be, young thingummywut? You still have that key you asked me for.
translation: 小东西，你不是还有事要做吗？你问我要的那把钥匙还在呢。

english: You're right. I've got a demon to slay.
translation: 你说得对。我还有个恶魔要杀。

english: I've lost the key you gave to me.
translation: 你给我的钥匙我弄丢了。

english: Yes I know, it was returned to me. If you want it back you're going to have to collect another 25 sets of bones.
translation: 我知道，它回到我这里了。如果你想要回去，就得再收集25套骨头。

english: I've got all three keys!
translation: 我集齐三把钥匙了！

english: Excellent! Now I can give you Silverlight.
translation: 太好了！现在我可以把银光剑给你了。

english: That sword belonged to my great-grandfather. Make sure you treat it with respect!
translation: 那把剑是我曾祖父的。你一定要好好对待它！

english: Now go kill that demon!
translation: 现在去杀了那个恶魔吧！

english: How goes the quest?
translation: 任务进行得怎么样了？

english: I found Sir Prysin. Unfortunately I haven't got the sword yet. He's made it complicated for me.
translation: 我找到普里辛爵士了。可惜我还没拿到剑。他把事情搞复杂了。

english: Ok, hurry, we haven't much time.
translation: 好的，快点，我们时间不多了。

english: Have you sorted that demon out yet?
translation: 你搞定那个恶魔了吗？

english: Well get on with it. He'll be pretty powerful when he gets to full strength.
translation: 那就赶紧去。等他恢复全部力量，会非常强大。

english: Not yet. And I, um, lost Silverlight.
translation: 还没有。而且，呃，我把银光剑弄丢了。

english: Yes, I know, someone returned it to me. Take better care of it this time.
translation: 是的，我知道，有人把它还给我了。这次要保管好。

english: I have the sword now. I just need to kill the demon, I think.
translation: 我现在有剑了。我想，只需要去杀死恶魔就行了。

english: Yep, that's right.
translation: 没错，就是这样。

english: Where can I find the demon?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到那个恶魔？

english: Just head south and you should find the stone circle just outside the city gate.
translation: 往南走，你应该会在城门外面找到那个石头圆圈。

english: Ha ha ha! At last you are free, my demonic brother! Rest now, and then have your revenge on this pitful city!
translation: 哈哈哈！你终于自由了，我的恶魔兄弟！现在休息一下，然后对这个可怜的城市复仇吧！

english: Now what was that incantation again?
translation: 那个咒语是什么来着？

english: [word 1]...
translation: [word 1]……

english: [word 2]...
translation: [word 2]……

english: [word 3]...
translation: [word 3]……

english: [word 4]...
translation: [word 4]……

english: [word 5]!
translation: [word 5]！

english: Well, it's funny you should say that. I'm not sure if I would really call it a quest as such, but I found this ancient stone tablet in one of my excavations, and it would really help me out if you could go and take it back to the digsite for me and get it examined.
translation: 嗯，你这么说还挺有意思的。我不确定这算不算得上一个任务，但我在一次挖掘中发现了这块古老的石板，如果你能帮我把它带回挖掘场让人检查一下，那可就帮了我大忙了。

english: So what did Terry Balando say about those etchings? Did he give you a translation for me?
translation: 那么，特里.巴兰多对那些蚀刻画说了些什么？他有没有给你做个翻译？

english: Um... yeah... about that... I kind of didn't go and speak to him yet...
translation: 呃……是的……关于那个……我其实还没去跟他说……

english: Well what are you waiting for? A written invitation? All I want you to do is take those etchings up to the digsite for me!
translation: 那你还等什么呢？难道要我给你下书面邀请函吗？我要你做的就是把那些蚀刻画带到挖掘场给我啊！

english: Okay, I'll do that then.
translation: 好吧，我这就去办。

english: Um... yeah... about that... I kind of lost those etchings you gave me...
translation: 呃……是的……关于那个……我好像把你给我的那些蚀刻画弄丢了……

english: Well how in the world did you do that? (sigh) Okay, I'll make another set, but try not to lose these ones this time!
translation: 你到底是怎么弄丢的？（叹气）好吧，我再做一套，但这次可别再弄丢了！

english: Hello, are you Terry Balando?
translation: 你好，你是特里.巴兰多吗？

english: That's right, who wants to know...?
translation: 没错，谁想知道……？

english: Ah yes, I recognise you! You're the fellow who found that strange artefact about Zaros for the museum, aren't you? What can I do for you now?
translation: 啊，是的，我认出你来了！你就是那个为博物馆找到了关于扎罗斯的怪异神器的小子，对吧？现在我能为你做些什么？

english: I had some etchings to deliver to you, but I don't have them on me...
translation: 我有些蚀刻画要交给你，但我现在没带在身上……

english: Then... you better go get them for me?
translation: 那……你最好去把它们拿来给我？

english: That's right. I was in the desert down by the Bedabin Camp, and I found an archaeologist who asked me to deliver this to you.
translation: 没错。我在沙漠的贝达宾营地附近，遇到了一位考古学家，他让我把这个交给你。

english: You spoke to the legendary Asgarnia Smith??? Quickly, let me see what he had to give you! He is always at the forefront of archaeological breakthroughs!
translation: 你见到了传奇人物阿斯加尼亚.史密斯？？？快，让我看看他给了你什么！他总是站在考古学突破的最前沿！

english: So what does the inscription say? Anything interesting?
translation: 那铭文上写着什么？有什么有趣的吗？

english: This... this is fascinating! These cuneiforms seem to predate even the settlement we are excavating here... Yes, yes, this is most interesting indeed!
translation: 这……这太迷人了！这些楔形文字似乎比我们正在挖掘的定居点还要古老……是的，是的，这确实非常有趣！

english: Can you translate it for me?
translation: 你能帮我翻译一下吗？

english: Well, I am not familiar with this particular language, but the similarities inherent in the pictographs seem to show a prevalent trend towards a syllabary consistent with the phonemes we have discovered in this excavation!
translation: 嗯，我不熟悉这种特定的语言，但象形文字中固有的相似性似乎显示出一种普遍的趋势，即音节表与我们在此次挖掘中发现的音素一致！

english: Um... So, can you translate it for me or not?
translation: 呃……所以，你到底能不能帮我翻译？

english: Well, unfortunately this is the only example of this particular language I have ever seen, but I might be able to make a rough translation, of sorts...
translation: 嗯，不幸的是，这是我见过的这种语言的唯一例子，但我或许能做个粗略的翻译，算是吧……

english: It might be slightly obscure on the finer details, but it should be good enough to understand the rough meaning of what was originally written. Please, just wait a moment, I will write up what I can
translation: 可能在细节上会有点模糊，但应该足以理解原文的大致意思。请稍等一下，我会把我能翻译的写下来。

english: translate into a journal for you. Then you can take it back to Asgarnia, I think he will be extremely interested in the translation!
translation: 整理成一本日记给你。然后你就可以把它带回给阿斯加尼亚了，我想他一定会对这个翻译极其感兴趣的！

english: There you go, that book contains the sum of my translating ability. If you would be so kind as to take that back to Asgarnia, I think it will reassure him that he is on the
translation: 给你，那本书里包含了我的全部翻译能力。如果你能行行好把这个带回去给阿斯加尼亚，我想这能让他确信自己正走在

english: right track for a find of great archaeological importance
translation: 寻找重大考古发现的正确道路上。

english: Wow! You write really quickly don't you?
translation: 哇！你写得真快，不是吗？

english: What can I say? It's a skill I picked up through my many years of taking field notes!
translation: 我该说点什么呢？这是我在多年野外笔记记录中练就的技能！

english: I, uh, kind of didn't take it to him yet...
translation: 我，呃，其实还没拿给他……

english: Whyever not? You're the strangest delivery boy I've ever met!
translation: 到底为什么不去？你是我见过最奇怪的送货员了！

english: I lost that translation you gave me...
translation: 我把你给我的那份翻译弄丢了……

english: Oh, no matter, I mostly remember what it said anyway! Here you go!
translation: 哦，没关系，我基本上还记得上面写了什么！给你！

english: Yeah, he did. But I don't have it with me.
translation: 是的，他给了。但我没带在身上。

english: Well could you go and get me that translation? It could be vital!
translation: 那你能不能去把那份翻译给我拿来？这可能至关重要！

english: Yeah, he did. I have it here in this book.
translation: 是的，他给了。我在这本书里。

english: Did you take a ready of this? It will do you good to understand how this profession works. Here, have a read.
translation: 你读过这个了吗？了解一下这个行业是怎么运作的对你有好处。来，读读看。

english: Yeah, I did. Kind of boring really.
translation: 是的，我读了。其实有点无聊。

english: Excellent. Just give me a moment to read this, and talk to me again in a second.
translation: 太好了。给我一点时间读一下，待会再跟我说话。

english: Hmmm. Interesting. It seems to me like there's some kind of treasure hidden out in the desert.
translation: 嗯。有趣。在我看来，沙漠里似乎藏着某种宝藏。

english: So what do you say? Fancy being a treasure hunter like me?
translation: 那么你觉得怎么样？想不想像我一样当个宝藏猎人？

english: Uh... don't you mean archaeologist?
translation: 呃……你难道不是指考古学家吗？

english: Yeeees... An archaeologist...
translation: 是——的……一位考古学家……

english: It's all this hot sun getting to me I think.
translation: 我想是这炎热的太阳晒得我有点糊涂了。

english: Well anyway, let's just assume there is a treasure hidden in the desert somewhere, and let's just say for the sake of argument that maybe if I found a big stash of gold and treasure I wouldn't necessarily just hand it
translation: 嗯，不管怎样，我们不妨假设沙漠里的某个地方藏着一批宝藏，并且，为了讨论起见，不妨假设如果我找到了一大堆黄金和宝藏，我不一定会把它

english: all over to the Museum of Varrock.
translation: 全部上交给维洛克城博物馆。

english: Let's also say, purely hypothetically, that if there were such a big stash of treasure and someone were to help me find it, then that hypothetical personal might be entitled to, oh, let's say a purely for the sake of
translation: 我们还假设，纯粹是假设，如果真有这么一大批宝藏，并且有人帮我找到了它，那么这位假设中的人或许有权获得，哦，比如说，纯粹为了

english: argument thirty percent split...
translation: 讨论的三十成……

english: Fifty percent.
translation: 五成。

english: A purely for the sake of argument fifty-fifty split on this hypothetical treasure, should it exist...
translation: 纯粹为了讨论，五五平分假设中的宝藏，如果它存在的话……

english: Do you see where I'm going with this?
translation: 你明白我的意思了吗？

english: You want me to help you find some treasure for a fifty percent share, as long as I don't tell anybody, and your reputation as an esteemed archaeologist with the Museum of Varrock remains intact, and nobody
translation: 你想让我帮你找一些宝藏，分我百分之五十，只要我不告诉任何人，并且你作为维洛克城博物馆备受尊敬的考古学家的声誉保持完好，而且没有人

english: discovers you're actually just a treasure hunter?
translation: 发现你其实只是个宝藏猎人？

english: Uh... yes, but the way you said it makes it sound like I'm doing something wrong...
translation: 呃……是的，但听你这么一说，好像我在做什么坏事似的……

english: So what do you say? Partners?
translation: 你觉得怎么样？搭档？

english: Well... I guess nobody is really going to lose out on anything, and we don't even know if there is any treasure...
translation: 好吧……我想其实谁也损失不了什么，再说了，我们甚至都不知道是不是真的有宝藏……

english: Aw, go on then. Count me in.
translation: 唉，那好吧。算我一个。

english: Good lad! Well, if we split up we'll be able to find treasure quicker.
translation: 好小子！嗯，如果我们分头行动，就能更快找到宝藏。

english: I'll continue searching around here in this Bedabin Camp, you head due South to the Bandit Village. If either of us find anything, we'll come find each other and say what, okay?
translation: 我会继续在贝达宾营地附近搜索，你往正南方向去强盗村。如果我们中的任何一个发现了什么，就来找对方说说情况，好吗？

english: You head due South, see what you can find out about this tablet.
translation: 你往正南走，看看能打听到关于这块石板的什么消息。

english: This all sounds very immoral, and I don't want any part of your seedy little schemes.
translation: 这一切听起来很不道德，我不想参与你那些见不得人的小把戏。

english: Aw, c'mon, cut me a break here man! Look, nobody is really getting hurt, right? This treasure is either going to lie around in some underground ruin, or lie around in some museum for
translation: 唉，别这样，放我一马吧，老兄！你看，没人真的会受到伤害，对吧？这些宝藏要么躺在某个地下废墟里，要么躺在某个博物馆里供

english: people to look at!
translation: 人参观！

english: It makes sense for the people to go to all the risk to get a little payback for it, right? Besides, anything of real historical value we can hand over to the museum - we'll just keep the cash for
translation: 让付出风险的人得到一点回报是合情合理的，对吧？再说了，任何有真正历史价值的东西我们都可以交给博物馆——我们只把现金留给

english: ourselves!
translation: 我们自己！

english: C'mon... what do you say? Partners?
translation: 来吧……你说呢？搭档？

english: I don't trust anything about your little scheme, including you! I want nothing to do with this!
translation: 我一点都不信任你的小把戏，包括你！我不想和这事有任何关系！

english: Eh, you'll come running back when you realize just how much money we could be talking here.
translation: 哼，等你意识到我们说的可能是多大一笔钱时，你会跑回来的。

english: I'll see you again when you come crawling back, begging to be cut in on the deal.
translation: 等你灰溜溜地跑回来，求着要分一杯羹的时候，我们会再见的。

english: Not yet...
translation: 还没呢……

english: Well, head south to that bandit camp. I bet if there's anything out here, they'll know about it.
translation: 那么，往南去那个强盗营地。我敢打赌，如果这附近有什么东西，他们肯定知道。

english: Don't let on it might be valuable though! Those thieves will steal it as soon as look at you!
translation: 但别透露它可能很值钱！那些小偷一看你就会偷走它！

english: What do you want lad?
translation: 你想要什么，小子？

english: I'm here on an archaeological expedition for the Museum of Varrock.
translation: 我是代表维洛克城博物馆来进行考古远征的。

english: I believe there may be some interesting artefacts in the area.
translation: 我相信这个地区可能有一些有趣的手工艺品。

english: You are a crazy man. The only thing you will find out here in the desert is your death.
translation: 你真是个疯子。你在这沙漠里唯一能找到的就是你的死亡。

english: Hello. I represent the Museum of Varrock, and I have reason to believe there may be some kinds of artefacts of historical significance in the nearby area...
translation: 你好。我代表维洛克城博物馆，有理由相信附近地区可能存在某些具有历史意义的手工艺品……

english: Ah yes. The only time people care about our existence is when they think they have something to gain from us.
translation: 啊，是的。只有在他们觉得能从我们这里得到什么的时候，人们才会关心我们的存在。

english: I have nothing to say to you. You and your kind are not welcome here.
translation: 我没什么好跟你说的。你和你的同类在这里不受欢迎。

english: Please, if I can just have a few minutes of your time to ask some questions...?
translation: 拜托了，我只需要您几分钟时间问几个问题……？

english: (sigh) I suppose I can spare you that. What do you wish to know about?
translation: （叹气）我想我可以抽出一点时间。你想了解什么？

english: Why are all of the people here so hostile? You would think I was asking you for money instead of just for answers to a few questions...
translation: 为什么这里的人都这么有敌意？你会以为我是在向你们要钱，而不仅仅是问几个问题的答案……

english: It is a long story, and I doubt you have much interest in hearing it. Your sort never are, you just take what you can of ours, and then abandon us once more to the desert.
translation: 说来话长，我怀疑你没什么兴趣听。你们这种人从来都这样，只拿你们能从我们这里拿走的东西，然后又一次把我们抛弃在沙漠里。

english: Actually, I'd be quite interested to hear what it is you have to say to excuse the attitude everybody in this village seems to have.
translation: 事实上，我倒是很想听听你会说些什么来为你们村里每个人似乎都有的这种态度辩解。

english: Ah, it all begun many generations ago, when our ancestors were the proud rulers of these lands...
translation: 啊，这一切始于许多代以前，那时我们的祖先还是这片土地骄傲的统治者……

english: My ancestors lived far to the North of here, and our lands stretched from the sea in the East to the river Lum, and the mountain of ice. From coast to coast, North to South, our domain was absolute.
translation: 我的祖先住在这里遥远的北方，我们的土地从东边的海洋一直延伸到卢姆河和冰之山。从海岸到海岸，从北到南，我们的领地是绝对的。

english: Our god was kind to us, and blessed us with prosperity and happiness, and in return we were merciless to his enemies wherever we found them.
translation: 我们的神对我们很仁慈，赐予我们繁荣和幸福，作为回报，我们无论在哪里找到他的敌人，都毫不留情。

english: Then came the betrayal.
translation: 然后背叛降临了。

english: Our god was banished, leaving us helpless to our fates.
translation: 我们的神被放逐了，留我们无助地面对自己的命运。

english: Without his protection, we were forced to fend for ourselves once more, against the enemies that sought to destroy us through their petty jealousies.
translation: 没有了祂的保护，我们被迫再次自力更生，对抗那些出于卑劣嫉妒而试图摧毁我们的敌人。

english: But we did not succumb without fighting! The spiteful Saradomin and pathetic Zamorak warred with each other, but the hatred they had for each other was as nothing to the hatred they held towards us!
translation: 但我们并非未经战斗就屈服了！恶毒的萨拉多明和可怜的扎莫拉克互相征战，但他们之间的仇恨与他们对我们的仇恨相比，简直微不足道！

english: With each battle they waged, we lost more and more land, unable to fight on all fronts, and were pushed further and further South into this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: 随着每一次他们发起的战斗，我们失去了越来越多的土地，无法在所有战线作战，被一步步推向南方，来到这个被神遗弃的沙漠。

english: Our greatest hero, Azzanadra, was finally trapped in a strange stone structure to the South of here, and bound within by terrible powers...
translation: 我们最伟大的英雄阿扎纳德拉最终被困在了南边一个奇怪的石头建筑里，并被可怕的力量束缚其中……

english: And with that our lands, our homes, our very lives were stolen from us! Too weak to reclaim what was rightfully ours, we made our homes here, knowing that someday Azzanadra will
translation: 此后，我们的土地、家园，甚至我们的生命都被夺走了！我们太弱小了，无法夺回本该属于我们的一切，于是我们在这里安家，知道总有一天阿扎纳德拉会

english: return with his magnificent power, and bring us back to our former glory...
translation: 带着他强大的力量回归，带我们重回昔日的荣光……

english: So you're upset because of something that happened hundreds of years ago?
translation: 所以你就因为几百年前发生的事而生气？

english: Seems to me like maybe you should find some closure, and let the past go...
translation: 依我看，也许你应该放下过去，求得解脱……

english: The insults heaped upon my race will never be forgotten, will never be forgiven and will never again be overlooked.
translation: 加诸于我族身上的侮辱永远不会被遗忘，永远不会被原谅，也永远不会再被忽视。

english: Someday, a harsh wind will blow upon this land, uncovering the wrongs of the past, and we will get back what is rightfully ours. Until such a day we will bide our time here, and will
translation: 总有一天，一阵狂风会吹过这片土地，揭露过往的错误，我们将夺回理应属于我们的一切。在那一天到来之前，我们将在此处蛰伏，并

english: always be ready with our blades for our righteous vengeance.
translation: 时刻准备好我们的利刃，以行我们正义的复仇。

english: I don't really care what your story is to be honest, there is no excuse for such rudeness or hostility.
translation: 说实话，我根本不在乎你的故事，没有理由这么粗鲁或充满敌意。

english: I have done nothing wrong to you, but everybody here treats me like I have committed some great crime against the village.
translation: 我对你们没做过任何错事，但这里的每个人都对待我好像我犯了什么针对村子的大罪似的。

english: That is because, from our point of view, you have.
translation: 那是因为，从我们的角度来看，你确实犯了。

english: What? Just because I entered your village?
translation: 什么？就因为我进了你们村子？

english: You have no right to be here! You have no right to the life you have, for it was taken at our expense!
translation: 你无权待在这里！你也没资格享受你这条命，因为那是靠牺牲我们换来的！

english: Whatever... No wonder all you loonies live out here in the desert by yourselves.
translation: 随便吧……难怪你们这些怪人都自己住在这沙漠里。

english: I was wondering if you knew anything about some treasure somewhere around here?
translation: 我想问一下，你知不知道这附近有什么宝藏？

english: I have some evidence that there might be some kind of treasure hidden very close to this village...
translation: 我有一些证据表明，很可能有一种宝藏就藏在这个村子附近……

english: If I knew of any treasure I would not choose to spend my life in this gods-forsaken desert.
translation: 如果我知道有宝藏，我才不会选择在这个被神遗弃的沙漠里过一辈子。

english: Do you know anything about some kind of fortress nearby? I have reason to believe there is, or at least used to be, some kind of fortress very close to here...
translation: 你知道附近有什么堡垒之类的东西吗？我有理由相信，这里附近曾经，或者现在仍然有一座堡垒……

english: Nobody would build anything in this wasteland unless they were forced to, to survive.
translation: 除非是被逼无奈为了活命，否则没人会在这片荒原上建任何东西。

english: I know of no fortress, I know of no reason why anyone would ever bother doing anything out here in the desert.
translation: 我不知道什么堡垒，也不知道为什么有人会费心在这沙漠里做任何事。

english: Actually, there was nothing I really wanted to ask you about.
translation: 其实，我没什么特别想问你的。

english: Yes, it is exactly like your sort to waste my time in such a way.
translation: 没错，你们这种人就是这样浪费我的时间。

english: If you're not buying anything, I have nothing to say to you.
translation: 你要是不买东西，我就没什么好跟你说的了。

english: As I understand it there's some kind of hidden treasure in these parts...
translation: 据我所知，这附近好像藏着什么宝藏……

english: Look around pal. Does it lookslike there's any treasure near here?
translation: 你四处看看，朋友。这附近有宝藏的样子吗？

english: If I were you I'd get lost before someone takes a dislike to your face and removes it for you.
translation: 换作是我，我就会赶紧滚蛋，免得有人看你的丑脸不顺眼，帮你把它卸下来。

english: You ain't got the 650 coins it costs to buy it, and I'm glad 'cos I didn't want to serve you anyway.
translation: 你连买它的650个金币都没有，我挺高兴的，反正我也不想招待你。

english: What's that? You wanna buy a beer? It'll cost ya 650 coins.
translation: 什么？你想买杯啤酒？要650个金币。

english: There you go. Now get out, we don't like your sort around here.
translation: 给你。现在快滚，我们这儿不欢迎你这种人。

english: Get out of my bar then! We don't like your sort round here!
translation: 那就滚出我的酒吧！我们这儿不欢迎你这种人！

english: You've had your drink, now get out of here. I have nothing to say to the-
translation: 你已经喝完了，现在滚出去。我没什么好跟你这种——

english: No, Wait! Look, I'm here on an archaeological expedition for the Museum of Varrock.
translation: 不，等等！听着，我是为维洛克城博物馆来做考古探险的。

english: I am only here looking for artefacts...
translation: 我来这里只是寻找文物……

english: Oh really? Our inheritance is only sand and death. What do you expect to find out here in this desert forsaken by the gods?
translation: 哦，是吗？我们的遗产只有沙子和死亡。你指望在这片被诸神遗弃的沙漠里找到什么？

english: I heard a rumour about four diamonds or crystals...
translation: 我听到一个关于四颗钻石或水晶的传闻……

english: The four diamonds of Azzanadra??? How came you to know of this?
translation: 阿扎纳德拉的四颗钻石？？？你是怎么知道这个的？

english: You've heard of them then?
translation: 那你听说过它们了？

english: It's just a fairy tale for children. Maybe one of the village elders might know more, but it's not really something I care about.
translation: 这只是给孩子们讲的童话故事。也许村里的某个长者知道更多，但这并不是我真正关心的事。

english: Now get out of here, your sort isn't welcome in my bar.
translation: 现在滚出去，你这种人我的酒吧不欢迎。

english: Certain things have led me to believe there may be some kind of ruined fortress around here...
translation: 某些线索让我相信，这附近可能有一座废弃的堡垒……

english: Doubt it. What in the world would someone need to guard against in the middle of this desert?
translation: 不可能吧。在这片沙漠中央，有什么需要防备的呢？

english: A bad attack of sand? I think you're on the wrong track, mister so-called archaeologist.
translation: 防御一场严重的沙子攻击吗？我觉得你搞错方向了，所谓的考古学家先生。

english: Tell me all you know about the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: 把你所知道的关于阿扎纳德拉钻石的事都告诉我。

english: Not that I think it's any of your business, but when I was a child I remember hearing the legend.
translation: 虽然我觉得这跟你没什么关系，但我小时候记得听过这个传说。

english: I don't recall it particularly well, other than they are said to contain an incredible power.
translation: 除了据说它们蕴含着难以置信的力量之外，我记不太清了。

english: If you really want to hear more about it you'd be best off finding someone who cares about the past, and the history of this area, and stop bothering me.
translation: 如果你真的想了解更多，最好去找个关心过去和这片地区历史的人，别再来烦我了。

english: So tell me... Did you ever hear of something called the Diamonds of Azzanadra?
translation: 那么告诉我……你听说过一种叫阿扎纳德拉钻石的东西吗？

english: This is the treasure which you seek???
translation: 这就是你寻找的宝藏？？？

english: Please accept my apologies noble sir! I thought you were but some opportunistic thief, looking to steal what heritage we have left! Now I see that you are in fact a brave adventurer,
translation: 请接受我的道歉，尊贵的先生！我还以为你只是个投机取巧的盗贼，想偷走我们仅存的一点遗产！现在我明白了，你其实是个勇敢的冒险者，

english: looking to restore our glories back upon us!
translation: 来恢复我们昔日的荣光！

english: Uh... yeah... So anyway, you have heard of them?
translation: 呃……好吧……那么，你听说过它们了？

english: Heard of them? Of course I have heard of them! They are the legacy of the great Mahjarrat hero, Azzanadra!
translation: 听说过它们？我当然听说过！它们是伟大的玛哈加特英雄——阿扎纳德拉的遗产！

english: So... do you have any idea where they might be? I have a feeling they will be very valuable.
translation: 那么……你知道它们可能在哪儿吗？我觉得它们会非常值钱。

english: Uh, valuable as historical artefacts I mean, obviously.
translation: 呃，我的意思是，显然作为历史文物很有价值。

english: They were stolen by warriors of the false god Zamorak generations ago. When you find the warriors, you will find the diamonds.
translation: 它们在几代人前被伪神萨莫洛克的战士偷走了。当你找到那些战士，你就会找到那些钻石。

english: I suspect they will not willingly part with such objects of power however.
translation: 不过我怀疑他们不会心甘情愿地交出如此强大的物品。

english: Beware too, for these warriors are very powerful; they have taken the powers of the diamonds into themselves!
translation: 也要小心，因为这些战士非常强大；他们已经将钻石的力量据为己有！

english: Each diamond has an elemental quality...
translation: 每颗钻石都有一种元素属性……

english: There is the Diamond of Blood, the Diamond of Ice, the Diamond of Smoke and the Diamond of Shadow.
translation: 有血钻石、冰钻石、烟雾钻石和阴影钻石。

english: You should expect the warriors to have taken some aspect of these diamonds as their own...
translation: 你最好期待那些战士已经将钻石的某些特性化为己用……

english: Do you have any idea how I could track down these warriors somehow, then?
translation: 那你知不知道我怎样才能追踪到这些战士？

english: There is an ancient spell I know of that may spy upon such power... But it will require a few ingredients for it to work.
translation: 我知道一种古老的法术，可以窥探到这种力量……但它需要一些材料才能生效。

english: Should you be willing to get these ingredients for me, I will be able to locate the rough area where each of these warriors has taken refuge. The spell is imprecise, but it should help you get on the
translation: 如果你愿意为我收集这些材料，我就能大致定位到每个战士藏身的地点。这个法术并不精确，但应该能帮你走上正确的搜索方向。

english: right track in your search.
translation: 你的搜索方向是对的。

english: Is your desire for our freedom strong enough? Will you gather the ingredients for this spell for me?
translation: 你对自由的渴望够强烈吗？你愿意为我收集这个法术所需的材料吗？

english: For this spell, I will need to make some scrying glasses. I will need enough so that we can view the realm in its entirety.
translation: 对于这个法术，我需要制造一些占镜。我需要足够的数量才能全面观察这个领域。

english: When enchanted, the scrying glass will be able to let us view any area that has been influenced by the presence of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: 附魔之后，这个占镜就能让我们观察到任何受到阿扎纳德拉钻石影响的地方。

english: Okay, but what exactly do you need for this spell?
translation: 好吧，但你具体需要什么呢？

english: Well, six scrying glasses should be sufficient. For each scrying glass, I will need two magic logs, a steel bar and some molten glass. This makes a total of 12 magic logs, 6 pieces of molten
translation: 嗯，六个占镜应该够了。每个占镜，我需要两根魔法原木、一个钢锭和一些熔融玻璃。总共是12根魔法原木、6块熔融玻璃

english: glass, and 6 steel bars.
translation: 和6个钢锭。

english: In addition, for the actual spell to enchant the glasses, I will require one set of normal bones, some ash, some charcoal and a single blood rune.
translation: 此外，为了让占镜附魔的实际法术生效，我还需要一套普通骨头、一些灰烬、一些木炭和一个血符石。

english: Do you understand me, adventurer?
translation: 你听明白了吗，冒险者？

english: Quick question; what kind of bones do you need?
translation: 问个小问题；你需要哪种骨头？

english: Standard bones. Other types of bones are of no use to me in this spell.
translation: 标准骨头。其他类型的骨头在这个法术中对我没用。

english: It's a slightly odd collection of ingredients, but I shouldn't have too much trouble getting those for you.
translation: 这些材料组合有点奇怪，但帮你弄到手应该不难。

english: Actually I don't feel like going on a shopping trip for you right now.
translation: 实际上，我现在不想替你跑腿买东西。

english: As you wish. I should have known not to get my hopes up that our long cursed life may soon be at an end...
translation: 随你便。我早该知道不该抱太大希望，以为我们漫长被诅咒的生活就要结束了……

english: I have some of the stuff you are looking for with me...
translation: 我身上有一些你要找的神秘物质……

english: Thank you, pass over the ingredients so that I may begin working on the spell.
translation: 谢谢，把材料给我，这样我就可以开始施法了。

english: Before I can complete the spell I will still need the following items;
translation: 在我完成法术之前，我还需要以下物品：

english: 12 magic logs 6 steel bars 6 molten glass
translation: 12根魔法原木 6个钢锭 6块熔融玻璃

english: 1 bones, 1 ashes, 1 charcoal and 1 blood rune
translation: 1根骨头、1份灰烬、1块木炭和1个血符石

english: Thank you, that is enough ash for the spell.
translation: 谢谢，这些灰烬足够施法用了。

english: Thank you, those are enough bones for the spell.
translation: 谢谢，这些骨头足够施法用了。

english: Thank you, that is enough charcoal for the spell.
translation: 谢谢，这些木炭足够施法用了。

english: Thank you, that blood rune should be sufficient for the spell.
translation: 谢谢，那个血符石应该足够施法用了。

english: Excellent! Those are all the ingredients I need to create the scrying glasses.
translation: 太好了！这些都是我制造占镜所需的全部材料。

english: I will find a suitable spot in the desert to the East of here, and set them up. When you are ready to begin your search, please come and find me there, I will show you how to utilise the
translation: 我会在沙漠东边找个合适的地方，把它们布置好。当你准备好开始搜索时，请到那里来找我，我会教你如何利用

english: mirrors to find the diamonds.
translation: 这些镜子来寻找钻石。

english: Meet me again in the desert East of here, I will use these ingredients to create a scrying glass for you.
translation: 再到东边的沙漠来找我，我会用这些材料为你制作一个占镜。

english: So can you give me any help on where to find these warriors and their diamonds?
translation: 那么，你能告诉我如何找到那些战士和他们的钻石吗？

english: No, the magic used in this spell is powerful, but inaccurate. The direction the scrying glass faces is roughly the direction you will find the warrior, but I'm afraid I
translation: 不能，这个法术使用的魔法很强大，但不精确。占镜所指的方向大致就是你会找到那个战士的方向，但恐怕我

english: can't be any more help than that.
translation: 也只能帮到这儿了。

english: I don't understand why there are six mirrors when there are only four diamonds...
translation: 我不明白为什么有六面镜子，却只有四颗钻石……

english: As I say, the enchantment is very inaccurate.
translation: 就像我说的，这个附魔非常不精确。

english: I can only focus upon the aura the diamonds have left behind them, so any place where the Diamonds were present for a significant period of time will still be shown - such as the Bandit Camp where I make my home.
translation: 我只能聚焦于钻石留下的残余灵光，所以任何钻石长期存在过的地方仍然会显示出来——比如我安家的那个强盗营地。

english: My apologies, but magic is an inaccurate art in many respects.
translation: 抱歉，但魔法在很多方面都是一门不精确的艺术。

english: Don't forget to come back here when you have collected all four diamonds.
translation: 别忘了，等你收集齐四颗钻石后回到这里。

english: Not as such... Although I think I'm onto something of a promising lead...
translation: 倒也不是……不过我想我找到了一个很有希望的线索……

english: Did you ever hear of something called the Diamonds of Azzanadra?
translation: 你听说过一种叫阿扎纳德拉钻石的东西吗？

english: Diamonds of Azzanadra? That sounds very promising indeed!
translation: 阿扎纳德拉钻石？听起来确实很有希望！

english: So you have heard of them?
translation: 那么你听说过它们了？

english: Nope, never heard of them before, but you said diamonds! Diamonds are always promising!
translation: 没有，以前从没听说过，但你说的是钻石！钻石总是很有希望的！

english: No, actually I was looking for something specific...
translation: 不，其实我在找某样具体的东西……

english: Hmmmm? And what would that be?
translation: 嗯？那是什么呢？

english: I am looking for one of the Diamonds of Azzanadra. I have reason to believe it may be somewhere around here...
translation: 我在寻找阿扎纳德拉钻石之一。我有理由相信它可能就在这附近……

english: Ahhh... The Shadow Diamond...
translation: 啊……阴影钻石……

english: I know the object of which you speak. It is guarded by a fearsome warrior known as Damis, they say, who lives in the shadows, invisible to prying eyes...
translation: 我知道你说的是什么东西。据说它由一个名叫达米斯的可怕战士守护着，他活在阴影中，肉眼看不见……

english: How can I find this 'Damis' then?
translation: 那我怎样才能找到这个'达米斯'呢？

english: Well now... perhaps we can help each other out here.
translation: 嗯……也许我们可以在这里互相帮助。

english: I have in my possession a small trinket, a ring, that allows its wearer to see the unseen...
translation: 我手上有一个小玩意，一枚戒指，可以让佩戴者看到看不见的东西……

english: How much do you want for it?
translation: 你想卖多少钱？

english: Ah, but it is not for sale... As such...
translation: 啊，但这件不卖……就这样……

english: I am offering to trade it for an item that was rightfully mine, but that was stolen by a bandit named Laheeb.
translation: 我提议用这件物品交换一件本应属于我的东西，但它被一个叫拉希布的强盗偷走了。

english: The item is question is a gilded cross, that has some sentimental value to myself. I wish for you to recover this item for me, and I will happily let you have my ring of visibility.
translation: 这个物品是一个镀金十字架，对我有感情价值。我希望你帮我找回它，然后我会乐意把真视之戒给你。

english: Where can I find this Laheeb?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这个拉希布？

english: Well, as a travelling merchant I have roamed these lands for many years...
translation: 嗯，作为一个旅行商人，我已经在这片土地上流浪了很多年……

english: To the far east of here there is an area that is dry and barren like the desert... it is called...
translation: 从这里往东很远的地方，有一个像沙漠一样干燥贫瘠的区域……它叫做……

english: Al Kharid?
translation: 阿尔卡里德城？

english: ...Yes, Al Kharid. Now to the south of Al Kharid there is a passageway, it is called the...
translation: ……是的，阿尔卡里德城。在阿尔卡里德城以南有一条通道，它叫做……

english: Shantay Pass.
translation: 沙泰隘口。

english: ...Yes. I didn't realise you had travelled there yourself.
translation: ……是的。我不知道你自己去过那里。

english: Anyway, when you have gone through the Shantay Pass, you will find yourself in a hostile desert... You will need to bring water with you to keep your life. Now, to the south-west of this pass, you will find a small
translation: 总之，当你通过沙泰隘口后，你会发现自己身处一片危险的沙漠……你需要随身带水来维持生命。现在，在这个隘口的西南方，你会找到一个小

english: village...
translation: 村庄……

english: The Bedabin camp.
translation: 贝达宾营地。

english: If you know where Laheeb lives, why did you ask me?
translation: 如果你知道拉希布住在哪里，为什么还要问我？

english: I don't. Sorry, please continue.
translation: 我不知道。抱歉，请继续。

english: Well, okay then. Anyway, south of this encampment there is an area where few have ever been... It is a village of murderous bandits, and treacherous
translation: 好吧，那算了。总之，在这个营地的南边有一个很少有人去过的地方……那是一个由凶残的强盗和奸诈的

english: thieves... This is where Laheeb makes his home.
translation: 小偷组成的村庄……拉希布就住在这里。

english: He will have hidden his stolen treasure somewhere in that village, I am sure of it. When you find his loot, you will find my gilded cross. Return it to me, and I will reward you with my ring
translation: 他肯定把偷来的宝藏藏在那个村庄的某个地方。当你找到他的赃物时，你就会找到我的镀金十字架。把它还给我，我会把我的

english: of visibility, so that you may find Damis. Does this seem fair to you?
translation: 真视之戒作为奖励，这样你就能找到达米斯。你觉得公平吗？

english: Not a problem. I'll be back with your cross before you know it.
translation: 没问题。我会很快带着你的十字架回来的。

english: Sounds like too much effort to me. I'll find this Damis by myself.
translation: 听起来太费劲了。我自己去找达米斯。

english: Where can I find this Damis again?
translation: 我再到哪里去找达米斯？

english: I have already told you, he is of the shadows. You will see neither him nor his lair without the aid of magic.
translation: 我已经告诉过你，他属于阴影。没有魔法的帮助，你既看不到他也看不到他的巢穴。

english: Have you retrieved my gilded cross for me yet?
translation: 你帮我找回我的镀金十字架了吗？

english: No, not yet...
translation: 不，还没有……

english: Well what seems to be the problem?
translation: 那么是什么问题？

english: Can't I just buy your ring?
translation: 我就不能直接买你的戒指吗？

english: No, it is not for sale. Some things are more important than money, and the return of my gilded cross is one of them.
translation: 不，它不出售。有些东西比钱更重要，找回我的镀金十字架就是其中之一。

english: Is Damis near here, then?
translation: 那么达米斯就在这附近吗？

english: You would be surprised to know just how close he is...
translation: 如果你知道他有多近，你会感到惊讶的……

english: Excellent, excellent. Here, take this ring. While you wear it, you will be able to see the things that live in shadows...
translation: 太好了，太好了。来，拿着这枚戒指。当你戴上它时，你将能看到生活在阴影中的东西……

english: Ah, but it is not for sale...  As such...
translation: 啊，但它不出售……就这样……

english: Ahhh...  The Shadow Diamond...
translation: 啊……阴影钻石……

english: ...Yes, Al-Kharid. Now, to the south of Al-Kharid there is a passageway, it is called the...
translation: ……是的，阿尔卡里德城。现在，阿尔卡里德城的南部有一条通道，它叫做……

english: And you will be able to find the entrance to Damis' lair.
translation: 然后你就能找到达米斯巢穴的入口了。

english: To the far east of here there is an area that is dry, and barren like the desert... it is called...
translation: 从这里往东很远的地方有一片干燥荒芜的地区，像沙漠一样……它叫做……

english: The item in question is a gilded cross, that has some sentimental value to myself. I wish for you to recover this item for me, and I will happily let you have my ring of visibility.
translation: 所说的物品是一个镀金十字架，它对我有感情价值。我希望你能为我找回这件物品，然后我会很高兴地把我的真视之戒给你。

english: So how goes your quest? Did you manage to find the Diamond you were looking for yet?
translation: 你的任务进展如何？你找到你要找的钻石了吗？

english: Well, his lair is very close to here. I suggest you look around for it.
translation: 嗯，他的巢穴离这里很近。我建议你四处找找。

english: I will crush you utterly!
translation: 我会彻底粉碎你！

english: You are no match for my power!
translation: 你不是我力量的对手！

english: Taste my blade and feel my wrath!
translation: 尝尝我的刀片，感受我的愤怒！

english: I... am... invincible!
translation: 我……是……无敌的！

english: Your pathetic skill won't help you now!(when havingProtect from Meleeactive)
translation: 你那可怜的技能现在帮不了你了！（当开启近战保护时）

english: You will regret ever coming here!
translation: 你会后悔来过这里！

english: Hah! I fear not your feeble power!
translation: 哈！我不怕你微薄的力量！

english: M-my lord Malak, what brings you here?
translation: 我——我的马拉克大人，是什么风把您吹来了？

english: Hmmm? You know very well that your tithe is due, Roavar.
translation: 嗯？你很清楚你的什一税到期了，罗阿瓦。

english: I am here to collect it this time.
translation: 我这次是来收取的。

english: Y-yes of course, sire, but surely your graciousness is too important to perform such menial duties such as this himself?
translation: 是——是的，当然，大人，但您的仁慈如此重要，怎么能亲自处理这种粗活呢？

english: Is this not Gadderanks job, your most high beneficence?
translation: 这难道不是加德兰克斯的工作吗，您至高无上的恩主？

english: Indeed it is Roavar, but I cannot find that incompetent fool. And assuming you are not the one who wishes to tell Lord Drakan that his tithe has not been collected, I saw
translation: 确实如此，罗阿瓦，但我找不到那个无能的傻瓜。而且假设你不是那个想告诉德拉肯大人他的什一税还没收齐的人，我觉得

english: fit to take on the duty myself this time.
translation: 这次我来承担这个职责比较合适。

english: Of course my lord, I meant no disrespect.
translation: 当然，大人，我无意冒犯。

english: So you have the tithe ready for me?
translation: 那么你已经为我准备好了什一税？

english: Of course my lord, I trust you will find it all there and in good order.
translation: 当然，大人，我相信您会发现一切都在，且井然有序。

english: A very wise choice, sir. Don't eat it all at once, savour every morsel - that's my advice to you.
translation: 非常明智的选择，先生。不要一次全吃完，细细品味每一口——这是我对你的建议。

english: A very wise choice, miss. Don't eat it all at once, savour every morsel - that's my advice to you.
translation: 非常明智的选择，小姐。不要一次全吃完，细细品味每一口——这是我对你的建议。

english: If you've got the money, I've got a real treat for you.
translation: 如果你有钱，我有个真正的好东西给你。

english: You've still got the brain I sold you - why don't you try that?
translation: 你还有我卖给你的大脑——为什么不试试那个？

english: He hates humans! Apparently his brother Draynor is trapped in Misthalin, and adventurous little human wannabe-heroes keep trying to kill him!
translation: 他恨人类！显然他的兄弟德拉诺被困在米斯塔林，而那些爱冒险的人类小英雄们总是想杀了他！

english: Hmmm. Well, for your sake you had better hope that indeed it is.
translation: 嗯。好吧，为了你好，你最好希望它确实如此。

english: The mood I am in for having to come to this wolfen cesspit means any shortfall is coming from you directly.
translation: 我不得不来这个狼人粪坑，心情很糟，这意味着任何短缺都将直接由你承担。

english: Then again... perhaps this was not a total waste of my time after all.
translation: 不过话说回来……也许这并没有完全浪费我的时间。

english: M-me?
translation: 我——我？

english: Yes, you. Your bearing suggests you are not one of the usual peasants, and your stench suggests you are not one of these filthy wolfen folk.
translation: 是的，你。你的举止说明你不是普通农民，你的臭味说明你不是这些肮脏的狼人中的一员。

english: Come here, I would like to know what you are doing in these lands.
translation: 过来，我想知道你在这些土地上做什么。

english: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.
translation: 一个人类，嗯？别以为你那可笑的戒指能骗过我。给我一个不现在就把你带到德拉肯大人面前的好理由。

english: A human, eh? Give me one good reason why I should not just take you to Lord Drakan now.
translation: 一个人类，嗯？给我一个不现在就把你带到德拉肯大人面前的好理由。

english: You had better make it a good one too, or you will not survive the night, I'll wager.
translation: 你最好给个好理由，否则我打赌你活不过今晚。

english: I am here to worship the almighty Zamorak! Yay! Go Zamorak!
translation: 我是来崇拜万能的萨莫拉克的！耶！萨莫拉克加油！

english: I see. You are a moron. You have probably settled right in with the rest of the idiots in this pathetic excuse for a village.
translation: 我明白了。你是个白痴。你可能已经和这个村子的其他傻瓜打成一片了。

english: Unfortunately for you, that is not a good enough reason to explain your presence here.
translation: 对你不幸的是，这不足以解释你为何在此。

english: Now tell me the reason for your coming here, or I will ensure you suffer a horrible fate indeed.
translation: 现在告诉我你来这里的原因，否则我会确保你遭受可怕的命运。

english: I am here only to serve the mighty Drakan. Yup, Drakan, he's the man.
translation: 我来这里只是为了侍奉强大的德拉肯。没错，德拉肯，他才是老大。

english: I see. I would perhaps be more inclined to believe you if I could not smell the death blood of his brother Draynor upon you.
translation: 我明白了。如果我没有闻到你身上有他兄弟德雷诺的死亡之血，我或许会更倾向于相信你。

english: What are you real intentions here?
translation: 你在这里的真实意图是什么？

english: Really? That is interesting, that you would want to give your life by tresspassingin this land for such an unbelievable reason.
translation: 真的吗？真有趣，你愿意因为这样一个难以置信的理由而闯入这片土地送死。

english: Now speak, what is your purpose in coming here?
translation: 现在说吧，你来这里的目的何在？

english: I came here looking for you, oh mighty Malak, so that I might serve your glory.
translation: 我来这里是为了找你，哦，伟大的马拉克，以便能够侍奉您的荣耀。

english: Please. Do not think that I am so vain and foolish as to allow you to avoid my question with such obvious sycophancy.
translation: 拜托。别以为我虚荣愚蠢到会被你这样明显的奉承蒙混过关。

english: Now tell me the reason behind your being here, or I will ensure that you suffer.
translation: 现在告诉我你在这里的原因，否则我会让你受苦。

english: I am here to kill Lord Drakan, and every stinking one of his vampyre brood!
translation: 我来这里是为了杀死德拉肯大人，以及他那些该死的吸血鬼崽子们！

english: Hah! Most entertaining, human!
translation: 哈！真是有趣，人类！

english: Now tell me the reason you are here, or we shall soon see who will be killing whom.
translation: 现在告诉我你在这里的原因，否则我们很快就会看到谁杀谁了。

english: I am here looking for a special diamond... I have reason to believe it is somewhere in this vicinity, and it is probably in the possession of a warrior of Zamorak.
translation: 我来这里是为了寻找一颗特殊的钻石……我有理由相信它就在这附近，而且很可能在一个萨莫拉克的战士手中。

english: I'm fairly sure it will have some kind of magical aura or something too. I don't suppose you've seen it, or know where it might be?
translation: 我很确定它也会有某种魔法光环之类的。我想你应该没见过它，或者知道它可能在哪儿吧？

english: Interesting... Well perhaps we can come to a little... arrangement, human.
translation: 有趣……好吧，也许我们可以达成一个小小的……协议，人类。

english: I may have information that may assist you, but you in turn will have to do something for me. What do you say? Do you think we could come to some form of
translation: 我可能有能帮到你的信息，但反过来你得为我做点什么。你觉得呢？你认为我们能达成某种

english: agreement?
translation: 协议吗？

english: Well, what kind of something? No offence, but you're not exactly the trustworthy type...
translation: 嗯，什么样的事？无意冒犯，但你看起来不太像值得信赖的类型……

english: Ah, you have a healthy sense of paranoia, I see. It is not a particularly unfair request on my part...
translation: 啊，你有着健康的偏执感，我明白了。我这边的要求并不过分……

english: All I ask is that you ensure that the current owner of the diamond is killed. For my part, I will let you know his whereabouts, and how exactly to kill him.
translation: 我只要求你确保这颗钻石的现任主人被杀死。至于我，我会告诉你他的下落，以及如何杀死他。

english: When he is dead, you may take the diamond from his corpse and do with it what you will. I have no interest in such baubles.
translation: 他死后，你可以从他的尸体上拿走钻石，随意处置。我对这种小玩意儿没兴趣。

english: So what say you? A life for a diamond. As a mark of good faith, I will give you some information free:
translation: 那么你说呢？一条命换一颗钻石。作为诚意的表示，我会免费给你一些信息：

english: The current owner of this diamond is named Dessous.
translation: 这颗钻石的现任主人名叫德索斯。

english: Well... I can't see any drawback. Okay, I accept your offer. Now tell me what you know.
translation: 嗯……我看不出有什么坏处。好吧，我接受你的提议。现在告诉我你所知道的。

english: What I know? Hah! After you have been alive for as long as I, the things I know are enough to fill a library.
translation: 我所知道的？哈！等你像我一样活了这么久，我知道的东西足以塞满一座图书馆。

english: I'm afraid you will need to be a little more specific.
translation: 恐怕你需要说得更具体些。

english: I don't see exactly how this bargain benefits you... Why exactly do you want Dessous killed anyway?
translation: 我不太明白这笔交易对你有什么好处……你到底为什么想要德索斯死？

english: That is an impertinent question to demand from myself.
translation: 你如此质问我，这个问题可真是无礼。

english: However, if it will help seal our deal, I will let you know some of the details.
translation: 不过，如果这有助于敲定我们的交易，我会让你知道一些细节。

english: As you may or may not know, myself and my blood kin are the rulers of this land, all serving under Lord Drakan. However, we tend not to die of old age or similar
translation: 你可能知道也可能不知道，我和我的血亲是这片土地的统治者，都效忠于德拉肯大人。但我们的死因往往不是年老或类似

english: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lordstithe or land, there often need to be...
translation: 自然原因，这意味着要获得另一个领主的什一税或土地，往往需要……

english: Unnatural causes of death involved. Let us just say, that Dessous is in control of some land that I myself would like some say in, and that it is not in my interest to be seen to be responsible for the
translation: 涉及非自然死亡。这么说吧，德索斯控制着一些我也想要发言权的土地，而且我如果被看到对

english: death of a fellow Lord.
translation: 一位同僚领主的死亡负责，这对我没有好处。

english: It would however be extremely advantageous to myself should some random human adventurer take it upon themself to remove this rival for me... Do you understand?
translation: 然而，如果某个随机的人类冒险者自行帮我除掉这个对手，那对我将极为有利……你明白吗？

english: Yes... I think so...
translation: 是的……我想我明白……

english: Good, we understand each other then. We will both benefit from the death of Dessous.
translation: 很好，那我们彼此理解了。我们都将从德索斯的死中获益。

english: Where can I find this Dessous?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这个德索斯？

english: He currently resides in a graveyard to the South-East of here. You will not be able to move the gravestone which he lies beneath however, you will need to find some way to
translation: 他目前住在这东南方的一个墓地里。但你无法移动他躺在下面的墓碑，你需要想办法

english: lure him out from his tomb.
translation: 把他从坟墓里引出来。

english: And how exactly would I go about doing that?
translation: 那我该如何做到呢？

english: Well, he is a vampyre, so fresh blood would almost certainly entice him out.
translation: 嗯，他是个吸血鬼，所以新鲜血液几乎肯定能把他引出来。

english: However, even though he is a frail and decrepit example of our species, he will be able to kill a weakling human such as yourself extremely easily. Having him in a bloodlust as he does so, will not make
translation: 不过，尽管他是我们种族中一个虚弱衰老的例子，但他仍然能轻易杀死像你这样弱小的人类。让他处于嗜血状态，并不会让

english: your job any easier.
translation: 你的任务变得更容易。

english: So what advice can you give me on killing Dessous?
translation: 那么关于杀死德索斯，你能给我什么建议？

english: As ancient and weak as Dessous is, he is still more than a match for the likes of you.
translation: 尽管德索斯又老又弱，但他仍然远胜于你这样的家伙。

english: That is, assuming you were to fight him fairly.
translation: 也就是说，假设你和他公平战斗的话。

english: My proposal would be for you to even the odds up a little bit...
translation: 我的建议是让你稍微拉平一下差距……

english: How would I go about doing that?
translation: 我该怎么做呢？

english: Well, my plan would be as follows. First, take a silver bar to the man living in the sewers in Draynor. He was an assistant to Count Draynor in some of his...
translation: 嗯，我的计划如下。首先，拿一根银锭去德拉诺下水道里的那个人。他曾是德雷诺伯爵的助理，参与过他的一些……

english: more interesting experiments many years past. Tell him you need a sacrificial offering pot. He will know what you speak of, it is a unique type of container used in various ancient vampyric ceremonies.
translation: 多年前更有趣的实验。告诉他你需要一个献祭祭品罐。他会知道你说的是什么，那是一种用于各种古老吸血鬼仪式的独特容器。

english: Then take the pot to Entrana and get it blessed by the Head Monk. This will lend the pot some holy power.
translation: 然后把罐子带到恩特纳岛，让首席僧侣祝福它。这将赋予罐子一些神圣力量。

english: If you then bring that silver pot back to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood, to put into it. To that pot of blood, you will add some crushed garlic, and some spice to disguise the smell.
translation: 如果你再把那个银罐带回来给我，我会给你一些新鲜血液放进去。在那罐血里，你要加入一些碎大蒜和一些香料来掩盖气味。

english: Use that pot of blood upon Dessous' tomb, and he will be unable to resist rising and drinking from it.
translation: 把那罐血用在德索斯的坟墓上，他将无法抗拒地起身喝它。

english: The combination of garlic, silver, and blessings from Saradomin will act upon him as a poison, and allow you to kill him.
translation: 大蒜、银和萨拉多曼祝福的组合会像毒药一样作用于他，让你能杀死他。

english: This is just my suggestion of course, you may ignore it if you wish, although I offer no guarantees of your ability to defeat him otherwise.
translation: 当然这只是我的建议，如果你愿意可以忽略，不过我不保证你还有其他办法能打败他。

english: Never mind, I will figure out all I need to know by myself.
translation: 算了，我自己会弄清楚所有需要知道的事。

english: As you wish. Come and see me when you have managed to kill Dessous.
translation: 随你便。等你成功杀死德索斯后再来见我。

english: I don't trust you, or anything you say. I'm afraid I have to decline.
translation: 我不信任你，也不信你说的任何话。恐怕我不得不拒绝。

english: As you wish human. I doubt anybody near here knows of the diamond you seek, however.
translation: 随你便，人类。不过我怀疑这附近有人知道你要找的钻石。

english: If you wish to claim it as your own, you have little choice but to accept my bargain. I will wait here until such time as you change your mind.
translation: 如果你想把它据为己有，你几乎没有选择，只能接受我的交易。我会在这里等你改变主意。

english: Why are you still here? I notice Dessous still lives.
translation: 你怎么还在这里？我注意到德索斯还活着。

english: Come and see my when you have prepared a silver ritual pot in the manner I have told you.
translation: 等你按照我说的方式准备好银仪式罐后再来见我。

english: I will ensure that you get some fresh blood that you may taint with garlic and spices, to lure our Dessous.
translation: 我会确保你得到一些新鲜血液，你可以用大蒜和香料污染它，来引诱我们的德索斯。

english: How am I supposed to kill Dessous again?
translation: 我该怎么杀死德索斯来着？

english: Take a silver bar to the man in the Draynor sewers. He will fashion a ritualistic pot for you, which you should then take to Entrana and get blessed.
translation: 拿一根银锭去德拉诺下水道的那个人。他会为你制作一个仪式罐，然后你把它带到恩特纳岛接受祝福。

english: When you have done that, come back here and speak to me, I will provide you with some fresh blood which you will then crush some garlic into, and then add some spices to hide the garlic.
translation: 做完之后，回到这里跟我说话，我会给你一些新鲜血液，然后你往里面加入一些碎大蒜，再加些香料来掩盖大蒜味。

english: In this way, you will be able to lure him from his tomb and he should be sufficiently weakened to be vulnerable to your attacks.
translation: 这样你就能把他从坟墓里引出来，他应该会被充分削弱，变得容易受到你的攻击。

english: You sshould not be down here...
translation: 你不应该在这里……

english: Are you an assistant to Count Draynor?
translation: 你是德雷诺伯爵的助理吗？

english: I usssed to have that honour... Why do you ssseek me?
translation: 我曾经有过那份荣幸……你为什么找我？

english: I have a silver bar with me, I was wondering if you could make it into a 'sacrificial offering pot' for me?
translation: 我有一根银锭，我想知道你能不能把它做成一个'献祭祭品罐'给我？

english: Yesss, of courssse... There you are, put it to good usssse...
translation: 是的，当然……给你，好好利用它……

english: I understand that you can make me a 'sacrificial offering pot' if I bring you a bar of silver?
translation: 我听说如果我给你一根银锭，你可以给我做一个'献祭祭品罐'？

english: And where did you hear thisss?
translation: 你从哪里听说的？

english: It was from Malak in Canifis.
translation: 是从坎尼非斯村的马拉克那里听说的。

english: Ah, I sssee... Yesss, I know how to make sssuch an item... It has been many yearsss sssince I have needed to however...
translation: 啊，我明白了……是的，我知道怎么做这种东西……不过我已经很多年没需要做了……

english: It is not my wisssh to quessstion your desssire for sssuch an item. I wasss merely sssurprisssed that one sssuch as you would make sssuch a requessst...
translation: 我无意质疑你对这种东西的渴望。我只是惊讶像你这样的人会提出这样的请求……

english: I will happily make you thisss pot, but you mussst bring me a bar of sssilver... Alasss, I can no longer collect my own ingredientsss, and mussst remain here...
translation: 我很乐意为你做这个罐子，但你必须给我一根银锭……唉，我不能再自己收集材料了，必须留在这里……

english: It is not my wisssh to quessstion your desssire for sssuch an item, I wasss merely sssurprisssed that one sssuch as you would make sssuch a requessst...
translation: 我无意质疑你对这样一件物品的渴望，我只是惊讶于像你这样的人会提出这样的请求……

english: I have no ussse for that...
translation: 我用不上那个……

english: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in it. There you go. May Saradomin walk with you.
translation: 有点奇怪的请求，但我觉得没什么坏处。给你。愿萨拉多曼与你同行。

english: Hi, I was wondering, can you quickly bless this for me?
translation: 嗨，我想知道，你能快点帮我祝福这个吗？

english: A somewhat strange request, but I see no harm in... Wait a moment... is that BLOOD?
translation: 有点奇怪的请求，但我觉得没什么……等一下……那是血吗？

english: Erm... yes...
translation: 呃……是的……

english: Why do you want me to bless a pot full of someones blood???
translation: 你为什么想让我祝福一个装满某人血的罐子？？？

english: Oh, don't worry, it's not 'someones', it's my own!
translation: 哦，别担心，不是'某人的'，是我自己的！

english: I... see... Well it is an unusual thing, but I see no harm in it. Take this, and walk in peace with Saradomin.
translation: 我……明白了……好吧，这确实不寻常，但我觉得没什么坏处。拿着这个，与萨拉多曼和平同行。

english: I found Ruantun in Draynorssewers. He made me this pot, now where can I get some fresh blood to fill it with?
translation: 我在德拉诺下水道找到了鲁安顿。他给我做了这个罐子，现在我在哪里可以弄到新鲜血液来装满它？

english: There you go. As fresh as it gets.
translation: 给你。最新鲜不过了。

english: Thanks for nothing.
translation: 多谢了，一点用都没有。

english: Come and speak to me again when you have managed to kill Dessous.
translation: 等你成功杀死德索斯后再来跟我说话。

english: Hssssssssssss
translation: 嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶

english: Well that's Dessous dead, but where is the Diamond he was supposed to have?
translation: 好了，德索斯死了，但他应该有的钻石在哪里？

english: If Malak lied to me about it, he is going to pay!
translation: 如果马拉克在这件事上骗了我，他就要付出代价！

english: Ah, the wandering hero returns! I take it you have dispatched poor old Dessous for me?
translation: 啊，流浪的英雄回来了！我猜你已经替我解决了可怜的老德索斯？

english: Quit playing games with me, Malak. I want that diamond, and I want it now!
translation: 别跟我玩游戏了，马拉克。我要那颗钻石，现在就要！

english: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. You should be thankful I have allowed you your life.
translation: 别用那种语气跟我说话，肉块。你应该庆幸我饶了你一命。

english: Here, take your precious little bauble.
translation: 给你，拿上你珍贵的小玩意儿。

english: I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesistate to take you to
translation: 我也会拿走那个银罐，人类不该拥有这样的神器。现在滚出我的视线，我们的交易完成了，如果我再在这里看到你，我会毫不犹豫地带你去见

english: Lord Drakan.
translation: 德拉肯领主。

english: He will be extremely pleased to meet the murderer of poor Dessous, I suspect.
translation: 我猜，他会非常高兴见到可怜德索斯的凶手。

english: Where is the Diamond of Blood? I know you have it!
translation: 血之钻石在哪里？我知道你拿着它！

english: Do not take that tone of voice with me, meat. Here, take your bauble. I have no use for it.
translation: 别用那种语气跟我说话，肉块。给你，拿上你的小玩意儿。我留着没用。

english: I will take that silver pot from you as well, humans are not meant to possess such artefacts. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to take you to
translation: 我还要拿走你那个银罐，人类不应该拥有这样的神器。现在滚出我的视线，我们的交易完成了，如果我再在这里看到你，我会毫不犹豫地带你去见

english: more interesting experiments many years past. Tell him you need a sacrificial offering pot. He will know what you speak of, it is a unique type of container used in various ancient vampiric ceremonies.
translation: 多年前更有趣的实验。告诉他你需要一个献祭祭品罐。他会明白你说的是什么，那是一种用于各种古老吸血鬼仪式的独特容器。

english: Then take that pot to Entrana, and get it blessed by the Head Monk. This will lend the pot some holy power.
translation: 然后拿着那个罐子去恩特纳岛，让大僧侣祝福它。这会赋予罐子一些神圣的力量。

english: Away from me, dog. I have business to discuss with the barkeep.
translation: 离我远点，狗东西。我有事要和酒保谈。

english: natural causes, which means that to gain another Lords title or land, there often need to be...
translation: 自然原因，这意味着要获得另一个领主的头衔或土地，通常需要……

english: Back for something, human? I notice Dessous still lives.
translation: 回来找什么东西吗，人类？我注意到德索斯还活着。

english: Come and see me when you have prepared a silver ritual pot in the manner I have told you.
translation: 等你按照我告诉你的方法准备好银仪式罐后再来见我。

english: Here, take your precious little bauble. Now get out of my sight, our deal is complete, and if I see you here again I will not hesitate to take you to Lord Drakan.
translation: 给你，拿好你珍贵的小玩意儿。现在滚出我的视线，我们的交易完成了，如果我再在这里看到你，我会毫不犹豫地带你去见德拉坎领主。

english: Hmmm? Oh, your precious little bauble? You may have it if you free up some inventory space, but I warn you not to use that tone of voice with me
translation: 嗯？哦，你珍贵的小玩意儿？如果你腾出一些物品栏空间，你可以拿走它，但我警告你，不要用那种语气跟我说话，

english: again, meat.
translation: 再次提醒，肉块。

english: What are your real intentions here?
translation: 你真正的意图是什么？

english: Really? That is interesting, that you would want to give your life by trespassing in this land for such an unbelievable reason.
translation: 真的吗？真有意思，你竟然愿意为了这样一个难以置信的理由在这片土地上 trespassing 而送命。

english: Waaaaaaa!
translation: 哇啊啊啊啊！

english: WAAAAAAAA!
translation: 哇啊啊啊啊啊！

english: Hey there little troll... Take this and dry those tears...
translation: 嘿，小巨魔……拿着这个，擦干眼泪……

english: (sniff)
translation: （抽泣）

english: -sniff- H-hello there.
translation: ——抽泣——你、你好。

english: Why so sad, little troll?
translation: 为什么这么伤心，小巨魔？

english: It was the bad man! He hurt my mommy and daddy! He made them all freezey!
translation: 是那个坏人！他伤害了我的妈妈和爸爸！他把他们都冻住了！

english: Bad man...?
translation: 坏人……？

english: He said it was because they stole his diamond! But they never did! They found it, and didn't know who it belonged to!
translation: 他说是因为他们偷了他的钻石！但他们没有！他们找到了它，不知道是谁的！

english: My mommy always told me stealing is wrong, they would never steal from someone!
translation: 我妈妈总是告诉我偷东西是不对的，他们绝不会偷别人的东西！

english: Then he did some wavey hand thing and my mommy and daddy got frozified!
translation: 然后他做了个挥手的手势，我妈妈和爸爸就被冻住了！

english: A diamond you say? Listen, I think I might be able to help your parents, but I need that Diamond in return.
translation: 你说钻石？听着，我想我或许能帮你的父母，但我需要那颗钻石作为回报。

english: -sniff- I don't think they really wanted it anyway, they would have given it back to the bad man if he'd asked before freezifying them...
translation: ——抽泣——反正我觉得他们也不想要它，如果那个坏人在冻住他们之前问的话，他们会还给他的……

english: I give you my promise mister that if you unfreeze my mommy and daddy, you can have the stupid diamond.
translation: 我向你保证，先生，如果你解冻我的妈妈和爸爸，你就可以拿走那颗破钻石。

english: Do we have a deal?
translation: 我们成交吗？

english: Absolutely. Don't worry kid, I'll get your parents back to you safe and sound.
translation: 当然。别担心，孩子，我会把你的父母完好无损地带回来。

english: Sorry, I can't make any promises about that, and I don't think I have the time to waste trying to defrost some stupid ice trolls.
translation: 抱歉，我不能对此做任何保证，而且我觉得我没时间浪费在解冻一些愚蠢的冰巨魔上。

english: Oh, I'm sorry. My mommy says that we ice trolls are so cold we can freeze the air around us when we are upset or angry.
translation: 哦，对不起。我妈妈说我们冰巨魔非常冷，当我们难过或生气时，可以冻结周围的空气。

english: I'm afraid I must have frozen those gates too much when I was crying, but since you told me you are going to help rescue my mommy and daddy you should be able to squeeze through the bars.
translation: 恐怕我哭的时候把那些大门冻得太厉害了，但既然你告诉我你要帮忙救我的妈妈和爸爸，你应该能从栏杆间挤过去。

english: You are much smaller than most trolls, it should be easy for you!
translation: 你比大多数巨魔小得多，对你来说应该很容易！

english: Hur hur hur! Well look here, a puny fleshy human! You should beware of the icy wind that runs through this valley, it will bring a fleshy like you to a cold end indeed!
translation: 呵呵呵！看看这是谁，一个弱小的血肉人类！你应该小心穿过这个山谷的冰冷寒风，它会让你这样的血肉之躯落得个冰冷的下场！

english: Sallamakar Ro!
translation: 萨拉马卡尔.罗！

english: Well, that must have been the 'bad man' that the troll kid was on about... His parents must be up ahead somewhere.
translation: 嗯，那一定就是巨魔小孩说的'坏人'了……他的父母一定在前面某个地方。

english: Oh thank you! It was really cold in there! But please, you must free my wife as well! Our son is depending on us!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！里面真的很冷！但请你也必须救出我的妻子！我们的儿子还指望着我们呢！

english: Wow, thanks for breaking me out of that ice! But please, my husband is still trapped in there!
translation: 哇，谢谢你把我从冰里救出来！但请救救我的丈夫，他还被困在里面！

english: Phew! Am I glad to be out of that big ice cube! Are you okay too darling?
translation: 呼！我真高兴从那个大冰块里出来了！你还好吗，亲爱的？

english: Yes, I thought we were done for! Why ever did that nasty Kamil freeze us up there anyway?
translation: 是的，我以为我们完蛋了！那个可恶的卡米尔到底为什么要把我们冻在那里？

english: He must have been trying to protect his Diamond...
translation: 他一定是在保护他的钻石……

english: You mean that diamond I found the other day belonged to him? But why didn't he just ask for it back? It's not like I really want it or anything!
translation: 你是说我那天找到的钻石是他的？但他为什么不直接要回去呢？我又不是真的想要它什么的！

english: And how did you know we had that diamond anyway, fleshy?
translation: 还有，你怎么知道我们有那颗钻石的，血肉人？

english: Your son told me. That's why I rescued you, it is very important that I have that diamond...
translation: 你儿子告诉我的。这就是我救你们的原因，那颗钻石对我来说非常重要……

english: Ooohhhhh, my poor baby! He must have been so worried about us...
translation: 哦哦哦哦，我可怜的宝贝！他一定非常担心我们……

english: Yes, but he certainly inherited his Dad's smarts!
translation: 是啊，但他肯定继承了他爸爸的聪明才智！

english: If he'd told this fleshy that he had the Diamond and not us, we might never have been rescued!
translation: 如果他告诉这个血肉人他拿着钻石而不是我们，我们可能永远得不到救援！

english: Wait... what? That stupid little troll kid had the diamond all along?
translation: 等等……什么？那个愚蠢的小巨魔孩子一直拿着钻石？

english: Don't you talk about my baby like that!
translation: 不许你那样说我的宝贝！

english: Now, now dear, all's well that ends well. We've been freed and this fleshy has certainly earned himself that diamond.
translation: 好了好了，亲爱的，结局好一切都好。我们被释放了，这个血肉人确实赢得了那颗钻石。

english: Let's get out of this terrible place and see our son!
translation: 我们离开这个可怕的地方，去见我们的儿子吧！

english: Mommy! Daddy! You're free!
translation: 妈妈！爸爸！你们自由了！

english: That's right son, and it's all thanks to this brave adventurer here. Now, make sure you hand over that diamond hewas looking for.
translation: 没错，儿子，这都多亏了这位勇敢的冒险者。现在，记得把他要找的那颗钻石交给他。

english: It has been nothing but trouble for us, let's just get back to our cave and have dinner.
translation: 它给我们带来的只有麻烦，我们回洞穴吃晚饭吧。

english: That's right son, it's your favorite tonight too! A big plate of raw mackerel!
translation: 没错，儿子，今晚也是你最爱吃的！一大盘生鲭鱼！

english: RAW MACKEREL! YUMMY!
translation: 生鲭鱼！好吃！

english: Here ya go, [mister/lady]! Thanks for getting my mom and dad away from the bad man!
translation: 给你，[mister/lady]！谢谢你让我爸爸妈妈摆脱了那个坏蛋！

english: Don't worry about it, just as long as I don't have to go back into that blizzard.
translation: 别客气，只要我不用再回到那场暴风雪里就行。

english: That's right son, and it's all thanks to this brave adventurer here. Now, make sure you hand over that diamond he was looking for.
translation: 没错，儿子，这都多亏了这位勇敢的冒险者。现在，记得把他要找的那颗钻石交出来。

english: I like the view!
translation: 我喜欢这景色！

english: I think I lost an ear ring up here earlier!
translation: 我想我之前在这里丢了一只耳环！

english: Thanks for all your help! I'm surprised you managed to survive the blizzard, being a thin skinned fleshy and all!
translation: 多谢你的帮忙！我很惊讶你居然能在暴风雪中活下来，毕竟你只是个皮薄肉嫩的家伙！

english: What can I say? I'm a lot tougher than I look.
translation: 我能说什么呢？我比看起来要坚强得多。

english: I lost that diamond of Ice you gave me...
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那颗冰之钻石……

english: That's okay, it blew back on an icy wind... It's almost like it wants to stay here! Here, take it back, you've earned it.
translation: 没关系，它被一阵寒风给吹回来了……就好像它想留在这里一样！来，拿回去吧，这是你应得的。

english: Mommy! Daddy!  You're free!
translation: 妈妈！爸爸！你们自由了！

english: Here ya go mister! Thanks for getting my mom and dad away from the bad man!
translation: 给你，先生！谢谢你让我爸爸妈妈摆脱了那个坏人！

english: Oh, I'm sorry. My mommy says, that we ice trolls are so cold we can freeze the air around us when we are upset or angry.
translation: 哦，对不起。我妈妈说，我们冰巨魔太冷了，当我们难过或生气时，能冻结周围的空气。

english: I give you my promise lady that if you unfreeze my mommy and daddy, you can have the stupid diamond.
translation: 我向你保证，女士，如果你解冻我妈妈和爸爸，你就可以得到那颗破钻石。

english: Here ya go lady! Thanks for getting my mom and dad away from the bad man!
translation: 给你，女士！谢谢你让我爸爸妈妈摆脱了那个坏人！

english: You didn't free my mommy and daddy yet?
translation: 你还没救出我妈妈和爸爸吗？

english: Please try harder! I love my mommy and daddy!
translation: 请再努力一点！我爱我的妈妈和爸爸！

english: Hey, thanks!
translation: 嘿，谢谢！

english: Hey, come talk to me when you have some free space in your inventory! I'll look after the diamond for you until you do!
translation: 嘿，等你背包有空位时再来找我！我会帮你保管钻石，直到你有空位！

english: Uh... thanks, but no thanks.
translation: 呃... 谢谢，但不用了。

english: Well, I would give it back to you, but you don't have any free space to keep it in.
translation: 嗯，我本想还给你，但你没有空位来放它。

english: I have collected one Diamond so far!
translation: 到目前为止，我已经收集到一颗钻石了！

english: That is a good start... but Azzanadra is still imprisoned!
translation: 这是个好的开始……但阿扎纳德拉仍然被囚禁着！

english: I have collected 2 Diamonds so far!
translation: 到目前为止，我已经收集到两颗钻石了！

english: I have collected 3 Diamonds so far!
translation: 到目前为止，我已经收集到三颗钻石了！

english: So I have all four of these Diamonds of Azzanadra, now what?
translation: 所以我已经集齐了这四颗阿扎纳德拉的钻石，现在该怎么办？

english: Azzanadra was our greatest ever hero. He was unkillable, and the cowardly traitors who stole our lands did not know what to do with him, for his hatred for them was as strong as his magics.
translation: 阿扎纳德拉曾是我们最伟大的英雄。他是不死之身，那些偷走我们土地的懦弱叛徒不知道该如何处置他，因为他对他们恨之入骨，就如同他的魔法一样强大。

english: In the end, they cast a spell upon him, to trap him in the stone structure to the South of here.
translation: 最终，他们对他施了一个咒语，将他困在了南方的那座石结构建筑中。

english: They stole his very life force, the essence of his power, and trapped it within four crystals - the very same Four Diamonds which you have now recovered from the brigands who stole from us.
translation: 他们偷走了他的生命力，也就是他力量的精华，并将其困在四颗水晶之中——正是你从那些抢劫我们的强盗手中夺回的那四颗钻石。

english: The four pillars surrounding the structure are keeping the containment spell intact. By placing a diamond into each, you will breach the magical defenses and begin to restore Azzanadra's
translation: 建筑周围的四根柱子维持着封印咒语。通过将一颗钻石放入每根柱子，你将打破魔法防御，开始恢复阿扎纳德拉的

english: power, and be able to enter the structure.
translation: 力量，并且能够进入那座建筑。

english: Go, place the diamonds, and free my lord Azzanadra!
translation: 去吧，放置钻石，解放我的主人阿扎纳德拉！

english: The path will be hard, for his prison is full of traps and danger to prevent his rescue, but he will reward you beyond your wildest dreams when freed!
translation: 这条路会很艰难，因为他的监狱充满了陷阱和危险，以防止他被营救，但一旦他被释放，他会给你超乎想象的回报！
