english: Quickly... After all these centuries, Lord Azzanadra is nearly free! You must spare no time, place the Diamonds upon the pillars and enter the pyramid so that you may free him!
translation: 快……经过这么多世纪，阿扎纳德拉大人几乎就要自由了！你必须抓紧时间，将钻石放在柱子上，然后进入金字塔，这样你才能释放他！

english: Hello again. How's the treasure hunting going?
translation: 又见面了。宝藏寻得怎么样了？

english: Well, I've found four diamonds.
translation: 嗯，我找到了四颗钻石。

english: What? But you've been gone ages!
translation: 什么？但你离开好久了！

english: C'mon, you can be square with me, you must have found more treasure than just four measly diamonds by now!
translation: 得了吧，你可以跟我直说，你肯定找到了比区区四颗钻石更多的宝藏吧！

english: Hmmm. Well, okay a deal is a deal. Hand two of them over.
translation: 嗯。好吧，交易就是交易。给我两颗。

english: Actually, I think I'm going to need them to gain access to the real treasure...
translation: 实际上，我想我需要它们来获得真正的宝藏……

english: REALLY? Great, I love treasure!
translation: 真的吗？太好了，我爱宝藏！

english: Don't worry about two measly diamonds if you think they'll lead to something better!
translation: 如果你觉得它们能带来更好的东西，那就不用担心那两颗微不足道的钻石了！

english: I don't usually get out of bed for less than a hundred gold certs!
translation: 我通常少于一百张金币凭证是不会起床的！

english: I used the Four Diamonds on the pillars surrounding the pyramid...
translation: 我把四颗钻石用在了金字塔周围的柱子上……

english: Yes? And what happened?
translation: 是吗？然后发生了什么？

english: Er... they changed colour.
translation: 呃……它们变了颜色。

english: Ah, that was the power being re-absorbed back into them. That should have been sufficient to break the magic seal preventing anyone exiting or entering the structure.
translation: 啊，那是力量被重新吸收回它们之中。这应该足以打破阻止任何人进出那座建筑的魔法封印了。

english: Quickly, you must let Lord Azzanadra know that he is free again after these many years!
translation: 快，你必须让阿扎纳德拉大人知道，经过这么多年，他终于再次自由了！

english: Please, when you have freed Azzanadra, let me know what words he has for his faithful followers...
translation: 拜托，当你释放了阿扎纳德拉之后，请告诉我他对他忠实的追随者说了些什么……

english: Hello again, apprentice archaeologist. How's the treasure hunting going?
translation: 又见面了，考古学徒。宝藏寻得怎么样了？

english: Well... I found four diamonds...
translation: 嗯……我找到了四颗钻石……

english: Great! Pass me my share, and it's a good job all around!
translation: 太好了！把我那份给我，这事儿就圆满结束了！

english: Um... sorry, I can't.
translation: 呃……抱歉，我不能。

english: Huh? You're not trying to break a deal here are ya???
translation: 哈？你不是想毁约吧？？？

english: No, it's just... There were these weird pillars around this pyramid...
translation: 不，只是……这个金字塔周围有一些奇怪的柱子……

english: Um... Well...
They kind of... ate the diamonds...
translation: 它们好像……把钻石给吃了……

english: Pyramid columns ate your diamonds?
translation: 金字塔的柱子吃了你的钻石？

english: That's a crazy story kid. Why would you go putting diamonds into them in the first place anyway? Diamonds!
translation: 这故事可真够扯的，小子。你一开始为什么要放钻石进去呢？那可是钻石啊！

english: Of all things!
translation: 什么东西不好放！

english: Well, I have this feeling there is some better treasure inside that pyramid, and I needed to put the diamonds in to gain entrance.
translation: 嗯，我有种感觉，那座金字塔里有更好的宝藏，我需要把钻石放进去才能进入。

english: Well what are you wasting time talking to me for?
translation: 那你还在跟我废话什么？

english: Go get me some treasure, pal!
translation: 去给我弄点宝藏来，伙计！

english: I knew they could not trap me here for long! Well done, friend. Tell me, how goes the war?
translation: 我就知道他们困不了我多久！干得好，朋友。告诉我，战事如何了？

english: War?
translation: 战事？

english: You do not know of the war for our survival? More time must have passed than I had thought...
translation: 你不知道那场为了我们生存的战争？看来过去的时间比我想象的还要久……

english: Tell me, what news of great Paddewwa? Do the shining spires of Lassar still stand? And what of glorious Annakarl? The fortress is still intact?
translation: 告诉我，伟大的帕德瓦有什么消息？拉萨尔闪耀的尖塔还在吗？还有辉煌的安娜卡尔呢？那座堡垒还完好无损吗？

english: Er... sorry, I've never heard of them...
translation: 呃……抱歉，我从没听说过它们……

english: No! My lord... what has become of you? I cannot hear your voice anymore!
translation: 不！我的主人……您怎么了？我再也听不到您的声音了！

english: My thanks to you friend for your help in freeing me from this accursed place, but it seems I have much to do to make amends. If our empire no longer stands, then it means that we must have failed my lord.
translation: 朋友，感谢你帮我从这个该死的地方解脱出来，但看来我还有很多事要做来弥补。如果我们的帝国不复存在，那就意味着我们一定辜负了我的主人。

english: How long have I been trapped here? Master... have you truly been dispatched from this world?
translation: 我被困在这里多久了？主人……您真的已经从这个世界上被驱逐了吗？

english: My friend, for your efforts in freeing me, I offer you the gift of knowledge. We Mahjarrat were once granted powerful ancient magicks by our lord. I now bestow their power upon you.
translation: 我的朋友，为了报答你释放我的努力，我赐予你知识的礼物。我们玛哈加特曾被我主赐予强大的远古魔法。现在我将它们的力量赐予你。

english: They will replace the knowledge you previously had, but you may switch between them by praying at the altar in this room at any time. May you use them well.
translation: 它们会取代你之前拥有的知识，但你随时可以通过在这个房间的祭坛前祈祷来切换它们。愿你能善加利用。

english: I trust that we shall meet again, but now I must leave you. Feel free to use the portal I shall create to return here easily in the future!
translation: 我相信我们还会再见，但现在我必须离开了。你可以随意使用我将要创造的传送门，将来可以轻松回到这里！

english: Er... He didn't really mention you at all, but he did teach me some cool new magic spells.
translation: 呃……他根本没怎么提到你，不过他确实教了我一些很酷的新魔法咒语。

english: magic of our god. This heirloom will help you with the speed of your spell-casting.
translation: 我们神的魔法。这件传家宝将提升你的施法速度。

english: Greetings. I await the return of my Lord Azzanadra and of our god. I do not know why, but I feel this spot has some significance...
translation: 你好。我等待着我的主人阿扎纳德拉和我们的神的归来。我不知道为什么，但我感觉这个地方有些特殊的意义……

english: I don't understand... How?
translation: 我不明白……怎么会这样？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hey, I know you! You're that archaeologist! What was your name again...?
translation: 嘿，我认识你！你是那个考古学家！你叫什么来着……？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You don't remember my name?! You don't remember the world famous Asgarnia Smith, archaeologist extraordinaire?
translation: 你不记得我的名字？！你不记得世界闻名的阿斯加尼亚.史密斯，这位杰出的考古学家了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No... sorry. It's not a very memorable name.
translation: 不……抱歉。这名字确实不太容易记住。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: All that work we did together, and you don't even remember my name.
translation: 我们一起做了那么多事，你居然连我的名字都不记得。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To be fair, we never really did that much work together. You sent me on a treasure hunt, but you never really contributed much yourself.
translation: 说句公道话，我们其实也没一起做多少事。你让我去寻宝游戏，但你自己根本没出什么力。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And a good job I didn't! I never saw a single ounce of gold from that partnership.
translation: 还好我没出力！那次合作我连一个金币都没见到。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well if a partnership with me was so disappointing, how come you're here?
translation: 好吧，如果跟我合作让你这么失望，那你来这里干嘛？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Bah, I'm not here for you, kid. I'm here for treasure!
translation: 哼，我不是来找你的，小子。我是来找宝藏的！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: After our last escapade turned out to be pointless, I set out in search of a new adventure! I started off on Karamja, but that didn't really go anywhere...
translation: 在我们上次的冒险被证明毫无意义之后，我便出发去寻找新的冒险！我从卡拉姆詹岛开始，但那里并没有真正取得什么进展……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: In the end, I came back to the desert and dug up this place! I've spent ages trying to work out how to get in, only for you to walk up and open the door right away!
translation: 最后，我回到了沙漠，挖出了这个地方！我花了很长时间想弄清楚怎么进去，结果你走过来一下子就打开了门！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yeah... funny that. They opened for me because of some magical abilities I gained on our last treasure hunt. You know, that one you were saying was pointless.
translation: 是啊……真有趣。它们为我打开，是因为我在上次寻宝游戏中获得的一些魔法能力。你知道的，就是你说的那次毫无意义的冒险。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Huh... Well, who'd have thought...
translation: 呃……好吧，谁能想到呢……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Alright then, kid, I'll tell you what... You didn't find us any proper treasure last time around, so now's your chance to redeem yourself!
translation: 好了，小子，我跟你说……上次你没给我们找到什么像样的宝藏，现在是你将功补过的机会了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm sure this place is the key to finding riches beyond imagination, and I, Asgarnia Smith, am willing to enter into a partnership with you, er...
translation: 我敢肯定这个地方是找到难以想象的财富的关键，而我，阿斯加尼亚.史密斯，愿意与你结为伙伴，呃……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You don't remember my name either, do you? It's [player name].
translation: 你也不记得我的名字了，对吧？我叫[player name]。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes, as I was saying, I, Asgarnia Smith, am willing to enter into a partnership with you, [player name], to uncover those riches!
translation: 是的，就像我刚才说的，我，阿斯加尼亚.史密斯，愿意与你，[player name]，结为伙伴，一起去发掘那些财富！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Who knows, perhaps you'll even learn a thing or two from a master treasure hun- I mean, a master archaeologist like me.
translation: 谁知道呢，也许你甚至能从一位寻宝大师——我是说，像我这样的考古大师那里学到一两点东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And I am willing to offer you an exclusive rate of a forty percent split!
translation: 而且我愿意给你一个独家优惠，你拿四成！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Absolutely! A forty-five percent split! So, kid, what do you say?
translation: 当然！你拿四成五！那么，小子，你觉得怎么样？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How about I look around while I think about it?
translation: 我边考虑边四处看看，怎么样？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well, kid, any thoughts on my offer?
translation: 那么，小子，对我的提议有什么想法吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm still looking around. I'll decide once I know a bit more about what this place is.
translation: 我还在四处查看。等我多了解一点这个地方是什么再做决定。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of course! Take as much time as you need, as long as you don't take long.
translation: 当然！你想花多少时间都行，只要别花太久。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you not want to hear about what I've found first?
translation: 你不想先听听我发现了什么吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh, yes, go ahead!
translation: 哦，好的，你说吧！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: According to that plaque over there, this place is a vault that was built to protect the 'mighty treasures' of the 'Empty Lord' from 'the soulless betrayers'.
translation: 根据那边的牌匾，这个地方是一个金库，用来保护‘空之主’的‘强大宝藏’免受‘无魂者背叛者’的侵害。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Mighty treasures, you say? Fantastic! Any idea how to access them?
translation: 你说强大的宝藏？太棒了！知道怎么拿到它们吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm guessing it has something to do with these statues. It looks like each of them is meant to be holding something.
translation: 我猜跟这些雕像有关。看起来每个雕像都应该拿着什么东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah, so we need to find whatever it is they should be holding. Classic treasure vault puzzle! Where do you plan to start?
translation: 啊，所以我们需要找到它们本该拿着的东西。经典的宝藏金库谜题！你打算从哪里开始？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well hang on there. I haven't actually agreed to anything yet.
translation: 等等，我还没答应任何事情呢。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But surely you can't turn down an opportunity like this! You said it yourself: Mighty treasures!
translation: 但你肯定不能拒绝这样的机会！你自己说的：强大的宝藏！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Mighty treasures that we can't access.
translation: 是强大的宝藏，但我们拿不到。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Now look here, kid. You won't get far in life with an attitude like that. Is there really nothing else we have to go on?
translation: 听好了，小子。抱着这种态度，你在这辈子走不远的。难道真的没有其他线索了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We have four names: Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer.
translation: 我们有四个名字：瓦多维斯、佩塞里亚、苏塞勒斯公爵和低语者。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: They sound like pretty solid leads to me. If we can find these four individuals, maybe we can also find whatever it is we need to get to the treasure.
translation: 对我来说，这些听起来是相当可靠的线索。如果我们能找到这四个人，也许我们也能找到获取宝藏所需的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's a big 'if' right there. This vault is clearly Zarosian, which means whoever these four are, they're from thousands of years ago. They're probably all long- dead now.
translation: 这可是个大大的‘如果’。这个金库显然是扎罗斯风格的，这意味着不管这四个人是谁，他们都是几千年前的人了。现在很可能早就死了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Zarosian? I'm sure I've heard that term before...
translation: 扎罗斯风格？我肯定以前听过这个词……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah yes! Those recent discoveries at the Digsite! I bet my good friend Terry Balando can help. Why don't you talk to him?
translation: 啊，对了！就是最近在挖掘场那些发现！我打赌我的好朋友特里.巴兰多能帮忙。你为什么不跟他谈谈？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Again, I've not actually agreed to help.
translation: 再说一次，我还没同意帮忙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No, but you're going to. I can tell. The thrill of the adventure is too much to resist. Not to mention that thirty percent split!
translation: 不，但你会的。我看得出来。冒险的刺激感是无法抗拒的。更不用说那三成的分成了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So we're agreed? Excellent! You'll find Terry at the Digsite Exam Centre. Good luck!
translation: 所以我们说定了？太好了！你会在挖掘场考试中心找到特里。祝你好运！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good to see you, kid. Did you speak to Terry Balando?
translation: 很高兴见到你，小子。你跟特里.巴兰多谈过了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You know I still haven't agreed to help you, right?
translation: 你知道我还没同意帮你，对吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You'll find Terry at the Digsite Exam Centre. You'd best get going. There's treasure to uncover!
translation: 你会在挖掘场考试中心找到特里。你最好赶紧去。有宝藏等着发掘呢！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hello again. How goes the archaeology?
translation: 又见面了。考古进展如何？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Pretty good, thanks. In fact, I've come across something I was hoping you could help me with.
translation: 相当不错，谢谢。事实上，我遇到了一些事情，希望你能帮我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I came across something very interesting down in the desert: A Zarosian vault.
translation: 我在沙漠里发现了一个非常有趣的东西：一个扎罗斯风格的金库。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Zarosian? Like that artefact you found for us?
translation: 扎罗斯风格？就像你为我们找到的那件文物？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Exactly! I'm hoping to learn about four names I discovered on statues within the vault.
translation: 没错！我希望了解我在金库雕像上发现的四个名字。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Sounds like an exciting discovery, but I'm afraid I can't help. This 'Zaros' is still mostly a mystery to me. In fact, I'd say you probably know more than I do!
translation: 听起来是个令人兴奋的发现，但恐怕我帮不上忙。这个‘扎罗斯’对我来说基本上还是个谜。事实上，我觉得你知道的比我还多！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So what would you suggest?
translation: 那你有什么建议？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well you may well be in luck. We had a new arrival at the Digsite recently who claims to be a Zarosian expert!
translation: 嗯，你可能运气不错。最近挖掘场来了一位新人，自称是扎罗斯专家！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Quite impressive for one of those to exist considering the greatest historians and archaeologists in the world has no knowledge on Zaros until very recently...
translation: 考虑到世界上伟大的历史学家和考古学家直到最近才对扎罗斯一无所知，居然还有这样的专家存在，真是令人印象深刻……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Interesting... Where can I find this expert?
translation: 有意思……我在哪里可以找到这位专家？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He's set up a new dig on the eastern edge of the Digsite. You're looking for... Ah, what was his name again...
translation: 他在挖掘场东边设立了一个新的挖掘点。你要找的是……啊，他叫什么来着……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Nabanik? No, that's not right...
translation: 纳巴尼克？不，不对……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Banikan! You'll be wanting to speak to Dr Banikan!
translation: 巴尼坎！你要找的是巴尼坎博士！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Great! I'll head over there and see if I can find him.
translation: 太好了！我这就过去看看能不能找到他。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hello again. Did you speak to Dr Banikan?
translation: 又见面了。你跟巴尼坎博士谈过了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He's set up a new dig on the eastern edge of the Digsite. You'll likely find him there.
translation: 他在挖掘场东边设立了一个新的挖掘点。你很可能在那里找到他。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Glad to hear it!
translation: 很高兴听你这么说！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh... Good day, adventurer.
translation: 哦……你好，冒险者。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Dr Banikan, I presume?
translation: 我猜你就是巴尼坎博士？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Banikan? Yes... I am Banikan.
translation: 巴尼坎？是的……我就是巴尼坎。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Are you sure? You don't seem very sure...
translation: 你确定吗？你看起来不太确定……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: My apologies. I was not expecting company down here, so you caught me a bit off guard.
translation: 抱歉。我没想到会有人来这里，所以你让我有点措手不及。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hmm... We haven't met before, have we? You seem familiar.
translation: 嗯……我们以前没见过吧？你看起来很眼熟。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't believe so.
translation: 我想没有。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So tell me, adventurer, what brings you down here?
translation: 那么告诉我，冒险者，是什么风把你吹到这儿来了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I've been told you're a Zarosian expert. I was hoping you could help me with some names.
translation: 我听说你是扎罗斯专家。我希望你能帮我查一些名字。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Names? What names?
translation: 名字？什么名字？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Vardorvis, Perseriya, Duke Sucellus and the Whisperer. I believe they were all Zarosians.
translation: 瓦多维斯、佩塞里亚、苏塞勒斯公爵和低语者。我相信他们都是扎罗斯人。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Where did you hear these names?
translation: 你从哪里听到这些名字的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I found a strange vault down in the desert, on the eastern coast. The names were on four statues inside.
translation: 我在沙漠东海岸发现了一个奇怪的金库。名字刻在里面的四尊雕像上。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A Zarosian vault? How curious...
translation: 一个扎罗斯风格的金库？真奇怪……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So can you help?
translation: 那你能帮忙吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I think so. I suspect the information you seek can be found in the very place I'm searching for.
translation: 我想可以。我怀疑你要找的信息就在我正在寻找的地方。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Excellent! Where's that?
translation: 太好了！那地方在哪儿？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You seem to be fairly knowledgeable when it comes to the Zarosian Empire, which is quite a rarity these days. How much do you know about its fall?
translation: 你似乎对扎罗斯帝国相当了解，这在如今可不多见。你对它的覆灭了解多少？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I know that Zaros was overthrown by one of his most trusted generals, Zamorak, who became a god as a result.
translation: 我知道扎罗斯被他最信任的将军之一扎莫拉克推翻，后者因此成为了神。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Spot on! You could teach the so-called experts around here a thing or two. The betrayal of Zaros ultimately led to the God Wars, making it quite possibly the most pivotal moment in all of history.
translation: 完全正确！你都可以教教这里那些所谓的专家了。对扎罗斯的背叛最终导致了神战，使其成为历史上最关键的转折点。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: However, even to those of us who do know our stuff, much of what happened to the empire following Zaros' defeat is still a mystery. That's why I'm here.
translation: 然而，即使对我们这些懂行的人来说，扎罗斯战败后帝国发生了什么，大部分仍然是个谜。这就是我来这里的原因。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Senntisten, the Zarosian settlement once located here, was believed to be the capital of the empire.
translation: 森特尼斯滕，曾经位于这里的扎罗斯定居点，被认为是帝国的首都。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: If my research is right, and I have strong reason to believe it is, the remains of a key military installation are located right beneath us.
translation: 如果我的研究没错——而且我有充分的理由相信它是对的——一个关键军事设施的遗骸就在我们脚下。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I can definitely think of worse places to discover details on the fall of the empire.
translation: 我确实想不出比这更差的地方来发现帝国覆灭的细节了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And you think this military installation could have information on the four names I found?
translation: 你认为这个军事设施可能有关于我找到的那四个名字的信息？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Absolutely! Any respectable military outpost would have been filled to the brim with key strategic intelligence. I'd expect details on notable Zarosians to be included.
translation: 当然！任何一个像样的军事前哨都会充斥着关键的战略情报。我预计会包含著名扎罗斯人的详细信息。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of course, they wouldn't have wanted that information falling into the wrong hands, so recovering it may not be straightforward...
translation: 当然，他们不会希望这些信息落入坏人之手，所以取回它可能不会那么简单……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I do love a good challenge.
translation: 嗯，我确实喜欢好的挑战。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Glad to hear it. Now, I have made good progress in excavating these ruins so far, but perhaps you can help me with the final step?
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。到目前为止，我在挖掘这些废墟方面取得了不错的进展，但也许你可以帮我完成最后一步？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Sounds like something I'd be good at! What do you need me to blow up?
translation: 听起来像是我的强项！你需要我炸掉什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well, my first major discovery here involved me blowing a big hole in some rocks to access an ancient temple. Shouldn't be too hard to do that again.
translation: 嗯，我在这里的第一个重大发现是在岩石上炸开一个大洞，进入了一座古老的神庙。再做一次应该不难。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm sorry, what?
translation: 抱歉，你说什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You risked the structural integrity of an ancient temple by blowing it open with explosives?!
translation: 你冒着破坏一座古老神庙结构完整性的风险，用炸药把它炸开了？！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Huh... I guess I never thought about it like that before. Yeah... now that you mention it, that was really quite a stupid idea.
translation: 呃……我想我以前从没这么想过。是啊……既然你提到了，那确实是个非常愚蠢的主意。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How about we take just a touch more care with this one?
translation: 这次我们能不能稍微小心一点？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good idea. What do you need me to do?
translation: 好主意。你需要我做什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Grab yourself a pickaxe and carefully clear away these rocks. There should be a pickaxe in the crate in the corner.
translation: 拿一把镐子，小心地清理掉这些岩石。角落的板条箱里应该有一把镐子。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So how come you know so much about Zaros?
translation: 那你怎么对扎罗斯了解这么多？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well... in my travels, I ended up spending a great deal of time in one of the few places Zarosian remnants can still be found. My time studying them filled me with fascination, and sadness.
translation: 嗯……在我的旅行中，我最终花了很多时间待在一个还能找到扎罗斯帝国遗迹的地方。研究它们让我充满了着迷，也感到悲伤。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Sadness?
translation: 悲伤？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: 'I walked across the sands and saw the ruins of time...'
translation: '我走过沙地，看到时光的废墟……'
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's an old poem about the rise, and inevitable fall, of kingdoms and empires. Once, Zaros' Empire stretched as far as the eye could see. Now, no one even remembers his name.
translation: 这是一首关于王国和帝国兴衰的古老诗篇。曾经，扎罗斯的帝国一望无际。如今，甚至没人记得他的名字。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To think that something that was once so absolute may soon be lost forever... It falls to people like me, and perhaps you as well, to ensure that history isn't forgotten.
translation: 想想看，曾经如此绝对的事物，可能很快就会永远消失……这就要靠像我这样的人，也许还有你，来确保历史不被遗忘。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What is it you're searching for here?
translation: 你在这里要找什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: As I said, I hope to find details about the fall of the Zarosian Empire.
translation: 正如我所说，我希望找到关于扎罗斯帝国覆灭的细节。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Anything in particular though?
translation: 但有什么具体目标吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I have a few leads. Details on individuals and artefacts that may have played a key role in the final days of the Empire.
translation: 我有几条线索。是关于一些可能在帝国最后岁月中扮演关键角色的人物和神器。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you think my four names could be connected?
translation: 你觉得我找的那四个名字可能有关联吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'd say it's definitely possible. I suppose there's only one way to find out.
translation: 我觉得很有可能。我想只有一种方法能弄清楚。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'd best get to work.
translation: 我最好开始工作了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So what is it you're searching for?
translation: 那么你具体在找什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's the rocks cleared.
translation: 石头清掉了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Excellent work. Shall we head in?
translation: 干得好。我们要进去吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'll go in first and make sure it's safe. I'll call you down when you're good to join me.
translation: 我先下去确保安全。等你准备好了我叫你下来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I appreciate your concern for my safety. Very well, I will await your call.
translation: 谢谢你关心我的安全。好吧，我等着你的信号。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Is it safe for me to head below?
translation: 我下去安全了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Not yet. I'll call you down when you're good to join me.
translation: 还没。等你准备好了我叫你下来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Okay, you're good to come down now.
translation: 好了，你可以下来了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So what was all that noise I heard?
translation: 那么我刚才听到的响声是怎么回事？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It was some sort of ancient golem. I'm guessing it was here to guard the place. Don't worry, I dealt with it.
translation: 那是一种古老的魔像。我猜它是来守卫这里的。别担心，我已经处理了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I may have destroyed it...
translation: 我可能把它毁了……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What is it with you and destroying things?
translation: 你怎么老是破坏东西？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's kind of what I do.
translation: 我这人就是这样。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well let's try and keep the destruction to a minimum from now on. If we're to discover anything down here, we'll need some things still intact.
translation: 好吧，从现在起我们尽量把破坏降到最低。如果我们要在这里发现什么，必须保留一些完好无损的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And on that note, we should take a look around.
translation: 说到这个，我们应该四处看看。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This place is remarkable! Let's have a look around and see what we can find.
translation: 这地方真了不起！我们四处看看能找到什么。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Look at this.
translation: 看这个。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A golem? Fascinating... Is this like the one that was defending this place?
translation: 一个魔像？真有意思……这跟守护这里的那个一样吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's very similar. Doesn't look like this one will be doing much fighting though.
translation: 非常相似。不过这个看起来不会打架了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No. It seems to have been heavily modified in some way. I wonder...
translation: 是啊。它似乎被某种方式大幅改造过。我想知道……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Golems do have rudimentary intelligence. Maybe we can get some information out of it.
translation: 魔像确实有初级智能。也许我们能从它那里得到一些情报。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We'll need to power it up I guess. Let me see what I can do.
translation: 我想我们得给它充能。让我看看能做什么。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hmm... This altar could be of interest.
translation: 嗯……这个祭坛可能有点意思。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It may be of little use in its current state. It doesn't seem to be giving off any magical energy.
translation: 它现在的状态可能没什么用。似乎没有散发出任何魔法能量。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I wouldn't have expected an archaeologist to be a magical expert. Do you practice magic much?
translation: 我没料到一位考古学家会是魔法专家。你经常施法吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I've dabbled.
translation: 略有涉猎。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We need to find a way to get that golem working.
translation: 我们得想办法让那个魔像动起来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Alright. Let's see what we can find.
translation: 好吧。我们看看能找到什么。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ouchie!
translation: 哎呀！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Shocking!
translation: 触电了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Careful now!
translation: 小心点！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That looked like it hurt.
translation: 看起来很疼。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I think it's working!
translation: 我觉得有效！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Looks like it. Excellent work.
translation: 看起来是的。干得好。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Please specify a search term.
translation: 请输入搜索词。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Er... What?
translation: 呃……什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I guess you should do as it asks.
translation: 我想你该照它说的做。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Checking...
translation: 正在检索……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Error: No data found.
translation: 错误：未找到数据。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Please specify another search term.
translation: 请指定另一个搜索词。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Error: Access to data denied.
translation: 错误：拒绝访问数据。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Data found. Outputting now.
translation: 找到数据。正在输出。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you wish to specify another search term?
translation: 是否要指定另一个搜索词？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Need any help?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Any thoughts on Vardorvis?
translation: 对瓦多维斯有什么看法？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It mentioned Lovakengj, presumably as in the Great Kourend Lovakengj.
translation: 它提到了洛瓦肯吉城，大概是指大库兰德王国的洛瓦肯吉城。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I can't imagine there's many others.
translation: 我想不会有其他同名的了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Any thoughts on Duke Sucellus?
translation: 对苏塞勒斯公爵有什么看法？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It mentioned this Duke taking informal command. Seems he was quite important.
translation: 它提到这位公爵非正式地接管了指挥权。看来他相当重要。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And unless the Zarosians had two prisons of the same name, I think I know where the entry to this one is.
translation: 除非扎罗斯人有两座同名监狱，我想我知道这座监狱的入口在哪了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Any thoughts on the Whisperer?
translation: 对低语者有什么看法？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It mentioned Lassar, one of the old Zarosian fortresses, built atop Ice Mountain.
translation: 它提到了拉萨尔，一座古老的扎罗斯要塞，建在冰山之上。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It was supposedly defined by its beautiful shining spires...
translation: 据说它以美丽闪耀的尖塔而闻名……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Let's keep searching.
translation: 我们继续搜索吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A Mahjarrat. I encountered him in the Kharidian Desert.
translation: 一个玛哈加特。我在卡里迪安沙漠遇到过。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Not many people can say they've met a Mahjarrat. Some don't even believe they exist.
translation: 没多少人能说自己见过玛哈加特。有些人甚至不相信它们存在。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I've actually come across a fair few.
translation: 其实我遇到过不少个。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Really? How curious...
translation: 真的吗？真奇怪……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I think that's all the information I needed.
translation: 嗯，我想我需要的信息已经够了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And quite the glut of information it was. So I suppose you intend to try and discover what happened to these four individuals?
translation: 信息量确实很大。那么我想你打算试着弄清楚这四个人的遭遇？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you think that's a good idea?
translation: 你觉得这是个好主意吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Absolutely! You have an opportunity here to uncover some lost history of the Zarosian Empire. You can't say no to that.
translation: 当然！你有一个机会去发掘扎罗斯帝国失落的历史。你不能拒绝。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I'll be sure to let you know if I find anything interesting.
translation: 好的，如果我发现了什么有趣的事，一定告诉你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'd appreciate that. Anyway, time to see if this golem has what I'm after as well...
translation: 我很感激。总之，现在该看看这个魔像有没有我想要的东西了……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Find what you wanted?
translation: 找到你想找的东西了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes and no. It's not the definitive information I was hoping for, but at least it rules out some options.
translation: 算是也算不是。这不是我希望的确切信息，但至少排除了一些可能。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I need to consult with a good friend of mine on this. Forgive me, but he lives quite far from here, so best I don't delay.
translation: 我需要就此咨询一位好友。原谅我，但他住得很远，所以我最好别耽搁。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Thank you for your help, adventurer. I hope we meet again soon.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，冒险者。希望我们很快能再见面。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I wonder what it was that he was searching for...
translation: 我好奇他到底在找什么……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Repeat last search.
translation: 重复上次搜索。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Lassar... One of the old Zarosian fortresses, built atop Ice Mountain.
translation: 拉萨尔……一座古老的扎罗斯要塞，建在冰山之上。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well those spires are long gone, but I wonder if there might be some traces left below...
translation: 那些尖塔早已不复存在，但我想知道下面是否还残留着一些痕迹……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Camdozaal. This golem here looks suspiciously like the ones I've seen there.
translation: 卡姆多扎尔。这里的魔像看起来可疑地像我在那儿见过的那些。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah, of course. We know that Saradominists built a new city over the top of Senntisten. It's quite possible the dwarves did the same at Lassar.
translation: 啊，当然。我们知道萨拉多民信徒在塞恩提斯滕原址上建了一座新城。很可能矮人在拉萨尔也做了同样的事。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A few of the other archaeologists recently set up a dig in Camdozaal. Perhaps they'll have found something of note.
translation: 其他几位考古学家最近在卡姆多扎尔开展了一次挖掘。也许他们会发现一些值得注意的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Lovakengj? As in the Great Kourend Lovakengj?
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城？你是说大库兰德王国的洛瓦肯吉城？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I've never been myself, but I do remember one of the other archaeologists, Elissa I think is her name, saying she'd visited Lovakengj.
translation: 我自己没去过，但我记得另一位考古学家，我想是叫艾丽莎，说过她去过洛瓦肯吉城。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I suspect she probably didn't encounter this Vardorvis while there.
translation: 我猜她在那里时可能没遇到这个瓦多维斯。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No, I imagine not. Still, from what she was saying, it sounded like she did spend time researching the history of the local area.
translation: 嗯，我想没有。不过，根据她说的，她似乎花时间研究过当地的历史。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I suppose there's worse places to start.
translation: 我想还有比这更糟糕的起点。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Battle for the Eye? I've never heard of it.
translation: 眼之战役？我从没听说过。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I think I know what it's referring to. There was a great battle at the Temple of the Eye long ago. A rift to the Abyss was opened as a result.
translation: 我想我知道它指的是什么。很久以前在眼之神殿发生过一场大战。结果打开了一个通往深渊的裂隙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Abyss? I've only ever heard legends of the Abyss.
translation: 深渊？我只听过关于深渊的传说。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What did the legends say?
translation: 传说中说了什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Nothing good.
translation: 没什么好事。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yeah... sounds about right.
translation: 是啊……听起来差不多。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Informal command? Seems this Duke was quite important.
translation: 非正式指挥权？看来这位公爵相当重要。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. It's in a dungeon under Weiss. I had quite the adventure there not too long ago.
translation: 是的。在维斯地底的一个地牢里。我不久前在那里有过一次相当精彩的冒险。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Let's see if this golem has what I'm after as well.
translation: 看看这魔像有没有我要的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I hear you visited Lovakengj recently.
translation: 听说你最近去了洛瓦肯吉城。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's right. Why do you ask?
translation: 没错。你问这个干嘛？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm trying to learn more about a vampyre called Vardorvis. Apparently he travelled to the west long ago in pursuit of someone called Yonrith Lovakengj.
translation: 我想了解更多关于一个叫瓦多维斯的吸血鬼的信息。显然他很久以前为了追捕一个叫约里思.洛瓦肯吉的人去了西方。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A vampyre? This must have been a very long time ago.
translation: 吸血鬼？那一定是很久以前的事了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Back when Senntisten still stood, it seems.
translation: 看来是森蒂斯坦还矗立的时候。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh wow, that is a long time! You're talking about a time before Great Kourend even existed!
translation: 哇，那可真是很久以前！你说的是大库兰德王国还不存在的时代！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Indeed. I was wondering if during your travels there, you came across any details about Vardorvis or Yonrith?
translation: 确实。我在想你在那里旅行时，有没有碰到关于瓦多维斯或约恩里特的细节？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hmm... You say this vampyre was in pursuit of Yonrith?
translation: 嗯……你说这个吸血鬼在追捕约恩里特？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well... it could be nothing, but there's this monument in Lovakengj called the Burning Man. Apparently, it represents the defeat of an ancient evil. Could be a good place to start?
translation: 嗯……可能没什么，但洛瓦肯吉城有个叫燃烧之人的纪念碑。据说它代表着一个古老邪恶的覆灭。可能是个不错的起点？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Definitely sounds worth a look.
translation: 听起来绝对值得去看看。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You'll find it in western Lovakengj. It's pretty hard to miss!
translation: 它在洛瓦肯吉城西部，很难错过的！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We've had this conversation before, haven't we? If I were you, I'd check out the Burning Man monument in western Lovakengj. Apparently it represents the defeat of an ancient evil.
translation: 我们之前说过这个了吧？要是我，就去看看洛瓦肯吉城西部的燃烧之人纪念碑。据说它代表着一个古老邪恶的覆灭。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hello! Here to see the Burning Man?
translation: 你好！来看燃烧之人的吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well you picked a great day for it! The name's Barus by the way. I work as a historian here. Those Arceuus lot may think they know it all, but I reckon I could tell you a thing or two that even they haven't realised!
translation: 那你可真挑了个好日子！顺便说一句，我叫巴鲁斯。我是这里的历史学家。那些阿西乌斯城的人可能觉得自己什么都知道，但我敢说我能告诉你一些连他们都没意识到的事情！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well on that note, what can you tell me about the Burning Man?
translation: 既然你提到了，那你说说燃烧之人是怎么回事？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thousands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.
translation: 燃烧之人是洛瓦肯吉城历史上一次伟大胜利的纪念碑。我们说的是几千年前，那时库兰德王国甚至还不是一个王国！遗憾的是，这也意味着一些细节已经随时间流逝了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What we do know is that a great evil threatened the earliest dwarven settlers here. Had that evil prevailed, Lovakengj might never have existed!
translation: 我们知道的是，一个巨大的邪恶威胁着这里最早的矮人定居者。如果那个邪恶得逞了，洛瓦肯吉城可能根本就不会存在！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Thankfully, with guidance from their brave leader, the settlers were able to overcome this evil! The Burning Man is a reminder of that.
translation: 好在他们勇敢的领袖指引之下，定居者战胜了这个邪恶！燃烧之人就是为此而立的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So I'm guessing the monument represents this evil?
translation: 所以这个纪念碑代表的就是那个邪恶？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But what was it, and where did it come from?
translation: 但那个邪恶是什么？又从哪里来的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah, now that bit is less clear. Have you heard of the Stranglewood?
translation: 啊，那部分就没那么清楚了。你听说过绞杀丛林吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Not too surprising. It's not a place you'd want to visit. Anyway, that's supposedly where this evil emerged from.
translation: 不奇怪，那地方没人想去。反正，据说那个邪恶就是从那里冒出来的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I see. What can you tell me about the Stranglewood?
translation: 明白了。关于绞杀丛林你能告诉我什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You'll find it on the border between the Kebos Lowlands and the Kingdom of Varlamore. It's a cursed place. Few have ever entered, and of those that have, none have returned!
translation: 它在凯博斯低地与瓦拉莫尔王国的交界处。那是个被诅咒的地方。很少有人进去过，进去的人没有一个回来的！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You know, I heard some chap from Hosidius went missing not too long ago. They reckon he went exploring the Stranglewood. Poor guy.
translation: 你知道吗，我听说不久前有个霍西迪乌斯城的家伙失踪了。大家说他去探索绞杀丛林了。可怜的家伙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Who was he?
translation: 他是谁？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Some botanist I think. His name escapes me, but I think he lived just south of the Hosidius Estate Agent.
translation: 我猜是个植物学家。他的名字我忘了，但我记得他住在霍西迪乌斯地产经纪人南边。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Interesting... Thanks for all the information.
translation: 有意思……谢谢你提供的信息。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Don't mention it!
translation: 不客气！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hello! Where did you say that botanist lived?
translation: 你好！你说那个植物学家住在哪里来着？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: If I remember right, he lived just south of the Hosidius Estate Agent.
translation: 如果我没记错的话，他住在霍西迪乌斯地产经纪人南边。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Perfect! Thanks for your help.
translation: 太好了！谢谢帮忙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I probably shouldn't just go drinking random potions without knowing what they are.
translation: 我恐怕不该连药水是什么都不知道就随便喝。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This Stranglewood place is supposed to be really dangerous. I should probably get myself some sort of protection before heading there.
translation: 听说绞杀丛林那个地方非常危险。去之前我最好弄点防护。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm just going to quietly go over here now.
translation: 我现在就悄悄溜到这边来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That was a close one.
translation: 真是险啊。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And who on Gielinor are you?
translation: 你又是盖林诺上的哪位？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm [player name], and you are?
translation: 我是[player name]，你是？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What are you waiting for? They're coming! Quick, head down below!
translation: 你还等什么？他们来了！快，到下面去！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: They're coming! Build some defences!
translation: 他们来了！快点建些防御工事！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I hear them approaching from the north east!
translation: 我听到他们从东北方向来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To the north east! They are coming!
translation: 东北方向！他们来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Strangled coming in from the north east!
translation: 绞杀者从东北方向过来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To the north west! They are coming!
translation: 西北方向！他们来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Strangled coming in from the north west!
translation: 绞杀者从西北方向过来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I hear them approaching from the south east!
translation: 我听到他们从东南方向来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To the south east! They are coming!
translation: 东南方向！他们来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Strangled coming in from the south east!
translation: 绞杀者从东南方向过来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I hear them approaching from the south west!
translation: 我听到他们从西南方向来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To the south west! They are coming!
translation: 西南方向！他们来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Strangled coming in from the south west!
translation: 绞杀者从西南方向过来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: They seem to be running out of steam! Let's head back up.
translation: 他们好像快没劲了！我们上去吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Where can I find those ingredients again?
translation: 我再问一下，那些材料在哪里找？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I found the herb growing atop the cliff just north west of the temple. The berries were in an old camp on the coast to the south west.
translation: 草药长在神庙西北的悬崖顶上。浆果在西南海岸的一个旧营地里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Okay, I'll see if I can find them.
translation: 好，我去找找看。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hmm... Kasonde must still be at the temple. Guess I should go and see if he needs a hand.
translation: 嗯……卡松德应该还在神庙。看来我得去看看他需不需要帮忙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I tried everything. I went to every healer, every mage, every priest.
translation: 我什么办法都试过了。我去找过每个治疗师、每个法师、每个祭司。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We're running out of time! I'm running out of time! Drink that potion. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!
translation: 我们没时间了！我快没时间了！喝了那瓶药水，能增强你对绞杀者的免疫。快走！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We're running out of time! I'm running out of time! Get to the ritual site, now!
translation: 我们没时间了！我快没时间了！快去仪式地点，现在就去！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We're running out of time! I'm running out of time! Take this potion and add those ingredients you gathered to it. It should strengthen your immunity against the Strangler. Now go!
translation: 我们没时间了！我快没时间了！拿着这瓶药水，把你收集的材料加进去，能增强你对绞杀者的免疫。快走！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Did you reach the ritual site? Did you find anything?
translation: 你到仪式地点了吗？找到什么没有？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Just a key.
translation: 只有一把钥匙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A key? Maybe it opens these doors... Quick, give it to me!
translation: 钥匙？也许能开这些门……快，给我！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Right, I think I have something, but we need to go quickly.
translation: 好，我觉得我有点发现了，但我们得快点走。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Go? Go where?
translation: 走？去哪儿？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Back to Kourend of course. You didn't think we'd be able to do this here, did you? I don't have any of the right equipment.
translation: 当然是回库兰德王国。你不会觉得我们在这里就能做这件事吧？我没有任何合适的装备。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But... the infection...
translation: 但是……感染……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes, I'm all too aware! That's why we need to go now!
translation: 对，我很清楚！所以我们才要现在走！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But what if you end up spreading it to Kourend?
translation: 但如果你最终把它传播到库兰德王国怎么办？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's a risk we're going to have to take. We have no other option!
translation: 那是个我们必须冒的风险。我们别无选择！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You can't be serious! We're talking about thousands of lives here! How do you even know this will work? When the Old Ones tried, it killed them!
translation: 你不是认真的吧！这可是关乎几千条人命！你怎么知道这能行？古人试过的时候把自己害死了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I haven't come this far to give up now! This is my last hope! If you won't help me, then step aside!
translation: 我走到这一步不是为了现在放弃！这是我最后的希望！你要是不帮我，那就让开！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's too high a cost!
translation: 代价太大了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't have time for this! I can already feel it inside me, changing me! Step aside... now!
translation: 我没时间跟你废话！我已经感觉到它在体内改变我了！让开……现在！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm sorry, Kasonde, but I can't do that.
translation: 对不起，卡松德，但我不能。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then you leave me no choice...
translation: 那你逼我别无选择……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No... Not like this... Not when I'm so close...
translation: 不……不能这样……我都这么接近了……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Please... do something... Help me!
translation: 求求你……做点什么……帮帮我！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm sorry. I didn't want it to be this way, but I couldn't let you endanger all those people.
translation: 对不起。我不想变成这样，但我不能让你危及所有那些人。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I just needed more time...
translation: 我只是需要更多时间……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I wish I could have helped you find it.
translation: 我希望我能帮你找到它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: At the ritual site... you didn't find what you we're looking for.
translation: 在仪式地点……你没找到你要的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It wasn't a question. I knew you wouldn't. You didn't find it... because I already had it.
translation: 不是疑问句。我知道你没找到。你没找到……是因为我早就拿到了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I had a feeling it was important, that it might have been what you were after, but if I'd given it to you, you wouldn't have helped me.
translation: 我直觉那东西很重要，可能就是你找的，但要是当时给了你，你就不会帮我了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You didn't know that.
translation: 你又不知道。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I couldn't take the risk. You were my last hope...
translation: 我不能冒这个险。你是我最后的希望……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The medallion. You'll find it in a chest back at my hideout. I hope... I hope it...
translation: 那个徽章。你在我藏身处的箱子里能找到。我希望……我希望它……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Er... Hi.
translation: 呃……你好。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: [player name]. I have an offer for you.
translation: [player name]。我有个提议给你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What offer?
translation: 什么提议？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You have something that my mistress wants. Give it to me and you will be rewarded.
translation: 你身上有我家女主人想要的东西。把它给我，你会得到回报。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I think you know what happens if you refuse.
translation: 我想你知道拒绝的后果。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Was that a threat?
translation: 这是威胁吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well then...
translation: 那么……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I need an answer, [player name].
translation: 我需要一个答复，[player name]。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How do I know I can trust you?
translation: 我怎么知道能相信你？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You don't.
translation: 你没办法。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This doesn't seem like a very good offer.
translation: 这听起来不像是很好的提议。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's the only offer you have. Now make your choice.
translation: 这是你仅有的选择。现在做决定吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well... I like a nice reward as much as the next person, but without any reason to trust you, I'm going to have to decline.
translation: 嗯……我跟别人一样喜欢丰厚的报酬，但既然没有理由信任你，我只能拒绝了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I will see you soon.
translation: 我们很快会再见。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good to see you, kid. Have you had any luck with these statues yet?
translation: 见到你真好，小子。这些雕像有头绪了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I have a medallion that I think one of them should be holding.
translation: 我有一块徽章，觉得其中一座雕像应该拿着它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well what are you waiting for? Go and give it to the statue! That twenty percent split won't earn itself.
translation: 那还等什么？快去把徽章给雕像！那两成分成可不会自己送上门。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Once again, I never actually agreed to work with you.
translation: 再说一次，我从没答应过要跟你合作。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Nonsense! Only a fool would say no to such a lucrative partnership, and you're clearly no fool.
translation: 胡扯！只有傻瓜才会拒绝这么赚钱的合作，而你显然不是傻瓜。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good to see you, kid. Nice work on that first statue. That treasure will be ours in no time.
translation: 见到你真好，小子。第一座雕像干得漂亮。那宝藏很快就是我们的了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Persten! You're alive!
translation: 佩尔斯滕！你还活着！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well of course I'm alive, silly. I'm Mia Persten! It takes more than the Abyss to kill me.
translation: 我当然还活着，傻孩子。我可是米娅.佩尔斯滕！区区深渊可杀不死我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Speaking of which, it's a good job I found you. If you'd have got on that boat, you'd have become fish food!
translation: 说到这个，幸好我找到了你。你要是上了那条船，早就变成鱼粮了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Fish food?
translation: 鱼粮？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Absolutely! Come, I'll explain back at my camp.
translation: 完全正确！来，回我的营地解释给你听。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Welcome to my little home away from home. It's not much, but you take what you can get in a place like this.
translation: 欢迎来到我的临时小窝。算不上什么，但在这种地方也只能将就了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Is it safe here?
translation: 这里安全吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of course! You won't find anywhere safer in all the Abyss.
translation: 当然！整个深渊都找不到比这儿更安全的地方了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well... that's probably not true, but let's pretend otherwise.
translation: 嗯……那可能不是真的，但我们就假装是吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Still, the point is, the demons don't come down here thanks to our fishy friend.
translation: 不过重点是，多亏了那位鱼朋友，恶魔们不会到这儿来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I already had so many questions, but you keep giving me more. What's this fish thing you keep talking about?
translation: 我本来就有好多问题，你现在又给我添了更多。你老说的那个鱼东西到底是什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: One of the many mysteries of this place. It's some sort of sea creature by the looks of it, but it's nothing like anything I've seen before.
translation: 这地方的众多谜团之一。看起来像是某种海洋生物，但跟我以前见过的任何东西都不一样。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's very dangerous, and it's rather annoyingly preventing any navigation of that lovely lake of goo. Quite unfortunate as there's something out there that I really need to get to.
translation: 它非常危险，而且很烦人，完全阻止了在那片可爱的黏液湖上航行。很不巧，湖上有个我必须到达的地方。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well thankfully you shouldn't need to anymore.
translation: 幸好你以后不用再去了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm guessing you were responsible for that magic signal leaving this place? The Guardians of the Rift were able to use it to stabilise the rift. It's safe for you to leave now.
translation: 我猜是你让那道魔法信号离开这里的？裂隙守护者利用它稳定了裂隙。你现在可以安全离开了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Leave? But I don't want to leave? I'm a leading expert on teleportation. I'd have had no problem getting out of here if I'd wanted to.
translation: 离开？但我不想离开啊？我可是顶尖的传送术专家。要是我真想走，离开这里根本不成问题。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What? Then why the signal?
translation: 什么？那你干嘛发信号？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Because I need to get past the big fishy, but I can't do it alone. I was hoping someone capable would follow the signal and join me. Looks like it worked perfectly!
translation: 因为我需要绕过那条大鱼，但光靠我一个人不行。我希望有本事的人能跟着信号过来帮我。看来这计划完美奏效了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But why do you need to get past this fish... thing?
translation: 但你为什么非要绕过这条……鱼东西？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There's a big old ship out there that I believe contains something I need.
translation: 那边有一艘古老的旧船，我相信里面有我需要的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: An old ship? Hmm...
translation: 一艘旧船？嗯……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Does the name Perseriya mean anything to you?
translation: 佩瑟瑞娅这个名字对你来说有意义吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes! It's her ship I'm trying to reach!
translation: 有！我正想去找她的船！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well she's actually why I'm here as well.
translation: 其实我来这里也是为了她。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And there I was thinking you'd come here just for me. Consider my feelings hurt. Still, seeing as we both want the same thing, how about we work together?
translation: 我还以为你是专门为我来的呢。我的心受伤了。不过，既然我们目标相同，不如合作吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Alright, how do we reach this ship?
translation: 好吧，我们怎么才能到那艘船？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That fish creature needs dealing with. I've already tried myself, but its scales are stronger than anything I've ever encountered before.
translation: 那个鱼形生物需要处理。我已经亲自试过了，但它的鳞片比我见过的任何东西都坚硬。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It must have some sort of weakness.
translation: 它肯定有什么弱点。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Indeed it does. There's a spot on its back where there's a gap in the scales.
translation: 确实有。它背上有一处鳞片间的缝隙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So what's the catch?
translation: 那有什么难处？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Catch? Ha! Good one.
translation: 难处？哈！说得好。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The weak spot isn't easy to reach, especially with how quickly the creature can move around the lake. If we want to get close, we'll need to trap it. There's an island next to Perseriya's ship that should work.
translation: 弱点不容易打到，尤其那生物在湖里移动得很快。要想靠近，我们得设个陷阱。佩瑟里娅船旁边有个小岛，应该可以用。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I see. So what's your plan for trapping it?
translation: 明白了。那你打算怎么困住它？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I hope you like your fish smoked, because we're going to smoke this one out!
translation: 我希望你喜欢熏鱼，因为我们要把这条鱼熏出来！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It seems Perseriya was in charge of quite the fleet. Her ship isn't the only one in here. There's plenty of others about, still filled to the brim with all sorts of explosive materials.
translation: 看来佩瑟瑞娅掌管着一支不小的舰队。这地方不止她这一艘船。周围还有很多别的船，里面装满了各种爆炸物。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah, I see. You want to set those ships alight. Where can I find them?
translation: 啊，我明白了。你想点燃那些船。我在哪里能找到它们？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There's three that I know of, which should be enough for what we need. See those tunnels over there? There's one down each of them.
translation: 我知道有三艘，应该够用了。看到那边的隧道了吗？每条隧道里都有一艘。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Two are blocked right now, but I'll get that sorted while you work on the first one. Once you set the ship alight, I'll make sure the smoke is directed right towards our fishy friend.
translation: 目前有两条隧道被堵住了，不过你去处理第一条的时候我会搞定。等你点燃船，我会确保烟雾直接飘向我们的鱼朋友。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How did you survive in here?
translation: 你是怎么在这里活下来的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It wasn't really that hard. Did you not think I would?
translation: 其实没那么难。你难道以为我活不下来？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Guardians of the Rift didn't think you'd have any chance.
translation: 裂隙守护者觉得你根本没机会活下来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Guardians of the Rift? You mentioned them earlier. Who are they?
translation: 裂隙守护者？你之前提到过。他们是谁？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A group of ancient golems built to guard the Temple of the Eye. They've been keeping the rift under control since we opened it.
translation: 一组古老的魔像，为守卫眼之神殿而建造。自从我们打开裂隙以来，它们一直控制着裂隙。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah, I'm guessing I won't be their favourite person then.
translation: 啊，那我猜它们不会喜欢我了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well it was sort of your fault.
translation: 嗯，某种程度上确实是你的错。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's not like it was intentional. Besides, we should look on the positive side. I've found all sorts of things in here to help with my research.
translation: 又不是故意的。再说，我们应该往好的方面看。我在这里找到了各种有助于研究的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm not sure they'd consider that to be worth the cost.
translation: 我不确定它们会觉得这代价值得。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well even if we wanted to, we can't turn back time. We may as well just keep looking forward.
translation: 就算想，我们也无法让时间倒流。不如就向前看吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What is it you want with Perseriya's ship?
translation: 你想从佩瑟瑞娅的船上得到什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I reckon I'll find some information there to help with my research.
translation: 我觉得能在那里找到一些对研究有帮助的信息。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What information?
translation: 什么信息？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: If I knew that, I wouldn't need to go there, would I?
translation: 要是我知道，就不用去那里了，对吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But then how do you know there's information on her ship?
translation: 但你怎么知道她的船上有信息？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I found a tablet on another shipwreck down here. It suggested she'd been experimenting with teleportation magic. If that's true, her ship seems the best place to look.
translation: 我在下面的另一艘沉船上找到了一块石板。上面暗示她一直在实验传送魔法。如果真是这样，她的船似乎是最值得找的地方。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What's with the demons in this place?
translation: 这地方的恶魔是怎么回事？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To be honest, I'm not totally sure. It's clear the Abyss has demonic connections, hence, you know, Abyssal Demons. But Black Demons? Greater Demons?
translation: 说实话，我也不太确定。很明显深渊和恶魔有关联，所以你知道，才有深渊恶魔。但黑恶魔？大恶魔？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's obvious they don't belong here. The delightful denizens of the Abyss haven't taken kindly to their presence.
translation: 很明显它们不属于这里。深渊那些可爱的原住民可不太欢迎它们。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: From the rituals they keep performing, my guess is they're looking to harness the magic of the Abyss for themselves.
translation: 从它们不断进行的仪式来看，我猜它们是想为自己利用深渊的魔法。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Any luck with those ships yet?
translation: 那些船有进展了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There should be one down each of those tunnels over there. Two are blocked right now, but I'll get that sorted while you work on the first one.
translation: 那边每条隧道里应该都有一艘。目前有两条堵住了，你去处理第一条的时候我会搞定。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Not sure if this diving equipment is going to help in here. This... brain juice... is quite thick. I'll give it a go though.
translation: 不确定这套潜水装备在这里有没有用。这……脑汁……相当粘稠。不过我会试试看。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I should probably look around and see if I can find anything of interest before I go burning everything.
translation: 在放火烧东西之前，我最好先四处看看有没有什么有趣的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I should probably read this tablet I found before I go burning everything.
translation: 在放火烧东西之前，我最好先读一读找到的这块石板。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You're back! I'm guessing from all the smoke that came this way that all went as planned?
translation: 你回来了！从飘过来的烟雾来看，一切按计划进行？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It did.
translation: 没错。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Great! I've opened up the second tunnel for you. It's ready when you are.
translation: 太好了！我已经为你打通了第二条隧道。你准备好了就可以去。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Before I go, I found something I wanted to ask you about.
translation: 走之前，我发现了点东西想问问你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I found an old tablet near the ship. It mentioned two artefacts. One was referred to as Imperium and the other as Primus.
translation: 我在船附近发现了一块古老的石板。上面提到两件神器。一件被称为'Imperium'，另一件被称为'Primus'。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Really? They must be code names. I wonder what they refer to...
translation: 真的吗？一定是代号。不知道它们指的是什么……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Apparently, the one known as Primus was being defended by Saradominists. Perseriya and her fleet were trying to claim it, but things clearly didn't go as planned, hence them ending up here.
translation: 显然，那个叫 'Primus' 的东西由萨拉多明教徒守卫着。佩瑟瑞娅和她的舰队试图夺取它，但计划显然出了岔子，所以它们才到了这里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't follow.
translation: 我不明白。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Isn't it obvious? It must be the Eye.
translation: 这还不明显吗？一定是那只“眼”。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You're starting to sound a bit accusational.
translation: 你这话听起来有点指责的意思。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I think it's fair to say that you're normally a very upbeat person, but whenever the Eye is mentioned, you start to act... different. I think you know more than you're letting on.
translation: 我觉得可以说你平时是个非常乐观的人，但每次提到那只“眼”，你的表现就……不一样了。我觉得你知道的比你说的多。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hmm... Alright, you've got me.
translation: 嗯……好吧，被你看穿了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you remember me telling you that my travels had taken me to other planes? One of them was a total wasteland. Ruins of a great civilisation as far as you could see.
translation: 你还记得我跟你说过我的旅行把我带到了其他位面吗？其中一个是彻底的荒地。放眼望去全是伟大文明的废墟。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Naturally, me being me, I was curious. I delved deep into the ruins to try and work out what happened.
translation: 当然，以我的性格，我很好奇。我深入废墟，想弄清楚发生了什么。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Turns out, they were in possession of an artefact of immense power. It was capable of limitless creation, but also unimaginable destruction. It delivered them great prosperity, but also led to their ruin.
translation: 结果发现，他们拥有一件威力巨大的神器。它能进行无限的创造，也能造成难以想象的毁灭。它带给他们巨大的繁荣，但也导致了他们的灭亡。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This artefact... The Eye?
translation: 这件神器……是那只“眼”？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I think so. It's been known by many names, and most of them have been long forgotten. The Eye of Saradomin was one. The Fist of Guthix was another. But its true name is...
translation: 我想是的。它有过许多名字，大部分早已被遗忘。萨拉多明之眼是其中之一，古斯之拳是另一个。但它真正的名字是……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Stone of Jas.
translation: 贾斯之石。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's right... How did you know that?
translation: 没错……你怎么知道的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I've seen it myself.
translation: 我亲眼见过它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You've encountered the Stone?
translation: 你遇到过石头？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes, but I knew about it even before I did. Do you remember that vision I had back in the Temple of the Eye? I saw it. I've somehow known its name ever since, but I just didn't realise until now.
translation: 是的，但我在那之前就已经知道它了。你记得我在眼之神殿里的那个幻象吗？我看到了它。从那时起我就不知怎么知道了它的名字，只是直到现在才意识到。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you remember that vision I had back in the Temple of the Eye? I saw it. I've somehow known its name ever since, but I just didn't realise until now.
translation: 你记得我在眼之神殿里的那个幻象吗？我看到了它。从那时起我就不知怎么知道了它的名字，只是直到现在才意识到。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How fascinating... Makes sense though. After all, powerful magic leaves powerful traces.
translation: 真有趣……不过倒也说得通。毕竟，强大的魔法会留下强大的痕迹。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So all that stuff about you searching for a teleportation nexus? That was a lie, wasn't it? You were really searching for information on the Stone.
translation: 所以那些关于你在寻找传送枢纽的说法？那是个谎言，对吧？你其实是在寻找关于石头的线索。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yeah... sorry about that. I had a feeling that if I suddenly popped up claiming to have information on a powerful artefact beyond anything ever encountered before, people might not believe me.
translation: 嗯……抱歉。我总觉得如果突然蹦出来说我有关于一件前所未有强大神器的信息，人们可能不会相信我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I guess that does make sense. So is that what you're hoping to find on Perseriya's ship? Information on the Stone?
translation: 我想这说得通。那么这就是你想在佩瑟里娅船上找到的东西？关于石头的线索？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I definitely wouldn't complain, but it's actually this other artefact I'm more interested in. The one referred to as Imperium.
translation: 我当然不会抱怨，但其实我对另一件神器更感兴趣。就是被称为 'Imperium' 的那件。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I always assumed the Stone to be unique, but what if it's not? Could there be other artefacts of a similar power out there? I have to find out!
translation: 我一直以为石头是独一无二的，但如果不是呢？外面会不会还有其他类似力量的神器？我必须查明！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And on that note, we should really get back to it. Those ships won't burn themselves!
translation: 说到这个，我们真该回去了。那些船可不会自己烧起来！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What do you know about Imperium so far?
translation: 关于“统御”你目前知道多少？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Before you came along, I'd already found quite a few mentions of it hidden in various shipwrecks. It seems that Perseriya possessed it for a time, but it was eventually transported somewhere to the east.
translation: 在你来之前，我已经在各种沉船残骸中找到了不少关于它的记载。似乎佩瑟瑞亚曾拥有它一段时间，但最终被运送到了东方的某个地方。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And you think it's connected to the Stone of Jas?
translation: 你觉得它跟贾斯之石有关联？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't have anything solid, but multiple times it was compared to the Stone. Even if not directly connected, it seems the two were of a similar type of power.
translation: 我没有确凿证据，但多次有人将它比作石头。即使没有直接关联，两者似乎也属于同一种力量类型。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Beyond that, I don't really have much. If we want to learn more, we need to reach Perseriya's ship.
translation: 除此之外，我知道的也不多了。想了解更多，我们就得找到佩瑟瑞亚的那艘船。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There's probably more answers lying around here. I'd better check before I burn it all.
translation: 附近可能还有更多答案。在我烧掉所有东西之前最好再检查一下。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Welcome back. How did things go?
translation: 欢迎回来。情况如何？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Not too bad. You might be interested in another tablet I found. It mentioned Imperium.
translation: 还不错。我找到的另一块石板你可能会感兴趣。上面提到了‘统御’。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How exciting! Well don't leave me hanging in anticipation. What did you find?
translation: 太让人兴奋了！别让我干等着着急啊。你发现了什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Apparently a soldier interacted with the artefact at one point. It caused another soldier to enter a frenzy and kill multiple people.
translation: 显然有个士兵曾接触过这件神器。结果导致另一名士兵陷入狂暴状态，杀了好几个人。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah, that must have been a bit of a bother for them.
translation: 啊，那对他们来说一定挺麻烦的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yeah... both soldiers in question were later executed.
translation: 是啊……那两个士兵后来都被处决了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh dear... Still, this is highly useful information. We now know the artefact has the ability to control another, which is equal parts exciting and terrifying!
translation: 哦天哪……不过，这仍然是极其有用的信息。我们现在知道这件神器有能力控制他人，这既令人兴奋又令人恐惧！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The question now is, did the artefact do it on its own, or was it enacting the will of the soldier that touched it?
translation: 现在的问题是，是神器自己做到的，还是它执行了触碰它的那个士兵的意志？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I guess there's only one way to find out.
translation: 我想只有一种方法能弄清楚了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Indeed! Just one ship to go. I've managed to open up the final tunnel for you.
translation: 没错！只剩一艘船了。我已经帮你打通了最后一条隧道。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How powerful do you think Imperium is?
translation: 你觉得‘统御’有多强大？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's a curious one. We now know Imperium has the power to control another, but that doesn't really tell us much about the overall power of the artefact.
translation: 这很有意思。我们现在知道‘统御’拥有控制他人的力量，但这并不能说明这件神器的总体力量。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Mind control is a dangerous form of magic. The Order of Wizards forbid it for obvious reasons, but with enough skill, it is possible to learn.
translation: 精神控制是一种危险的魔法。巫师教团出于显而易见的原因禁止它，但只要技艺足够，还是有可能学会的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Mind controlling magic has a large number of drawbacks. All but the most powerful mages can only use it on one person at a time, and the spell is easily broken.
translation: 精神控制魔法有很多缺点。除了最强大的法师，其他人一次只能对一个人使用，而且法术很容易被打破。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But what if Imperium can overcome these limits? What if it can control hundreds, or even thousands, with no way to break that control!
translation: 但如果‘统御’能克服这些限制呢？如果它能控制数百人甚至数千人，并且无法打破这种控制呢！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's terrifying!
translation: 那太可怕了！
