sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: First the Stone, and now this 'Imperium'. But that begs the question... how many more? So silly of me! I spent so much time focusing on the Stone, I never even considered the possibility...
translation: 先是石头，现在又是这个'Imperium'。但这引出了一个问题……还有多少？我真傻！我花了那么多时间专注于石头，从未考虑过这种可能性……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Er... hello?
translation: 呃……你好？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh, you're back! Sorry, I was in my own little world there, chittering away. Anyway, looks like our plan worked. I was able to use all that smoke to force our big fish towards that island!
translation: 哦，你回来了！抱歉，我刚刚沉浸在自己的小世界里，叽叽喳喳说个不停。总之，看来我们的计划奏效了。我成功利用那些烟雾把那条大鱼逼向那座岛了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So now we just need to properly deal with it.
translation: 所以现在我们需要好好对付它了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's right! Now don't worry, I have a very in-depth plan. Basically, one of us needs to be ready to direct the smoke in case it tries to escape while the other goes and gives it a good old poke!
translation: 没错！别担心，我有一个非常周密的计划。简单来说，我们中得有一个人准备好引导烟雾，以防它试图逃跑，另一个人则过去给它狠狠来一下！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I guess I'll be doing the poking?
translation: 看来是我去捅它了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you have the magical abilities to maintain a huge whirlwind of smoke that's strong enough to prevent a large aquatic lifeform from passing through?
translation: 你有足够的魔法能力来维持一个巨大的烟雾旋风，强大到足以阻止大型水生生物穿过吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then yes, you'll be doing the poking!
translation: 那就对了，你去捅它！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then I guess we should get to it.
translation: 那我们开始吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Absolutely! Oh, don't forget there's a weak spot on its back that you'll want to try and target. I can't see it letting you get too close, so I reckon you'll want to try and stun it first.
translation: 当然！哦，别忘了它背上有一个弱点，你要尽量瞄准那里。我看它不会让你靠得太近，所以我觉得你应该先试着用眩晕术把它打晕。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: From my experiences in this place, some sort of shadowy spell should do the trick! I'm sure a capable individual like you has access to something suitable.
translation: 根据我在这里的经验，某种阴影法术应该能行！我相信像你这样能干的人肯定有合适的法术。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hang on... How do you know about...
translation: 等等……你怎么知道……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Because I'm Mia Persten, silly! You don't get as far as me without knowing a thing or two about forbidden magic. Now, just hop on the boat and row out to the island when you're ready. Oh, and try not to die!
translation: 因为我是米娅.佩斯滕，傻瓜！如果对禁忌魔法一窍不通，我可走不到今天这一步。好了，准备好就跳上船，划到那座岛上去。哦，尽量别死！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That big fish won't go sorting itself out. Just hop on the boat and row out to the island when you're ready.
translation: 那条大鱼可不会自己搞定自己。准备好了就跳上船，划到岛上去。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Alright, let's see what we've got...
translation: 好吧，看看我们找到了什么……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Jackpot! Now let's see...
translation: 中大奖了！让我看看……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Huh? That can't be right...
translation: 咦？这不对啊……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It can't be possible... can it?
translation: 这不可能吧……能吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Persten? What does it say?
translation: 佩斯滕？上面写了什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's written by one of the crew on Perseriya's ship. Apparently they snuck into her private cabin...
translation: 是佩瑟瑞亚船上的一名船员写的。显然他偷偷溜进了她的私人船舱……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And found Imperium inside!
translation: 结果在里面发现了‘统御’！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What's not right about that? Makes sense she'd have kept it close.
translation: 这有什么不对的？她把它贴身带着也说得通。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This was after Imperium had already been delivered to the east!
translation: 但这发生在‘统御’已经被运往东方之后！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So it was never delivered? But that can't be right... We've found multiple tablets saying it was.
translation: 所以它根本没被运走？但这不可能……我们找到了好几块石板说它被运走了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Exactly! That either means she was able to sneak it back onto the ship again, or there was a second artefact!
translation: 正是！这意味着要么她设法把它又偷偷带回了船上，要么存在着第二件神器！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Could that be possible?
translation: 这有可能吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't know... I don't think so... But then again, until recently I didn't even know about this artefact at all.
translation: 我不知道……我觉得不太可能……但话说回来，直到最近我对这件神器还一无所知呢。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm not too sure. I need to gather all my research and see what I can come up with. I guess that means that I've outlived my little home here.
translation: 我也不太确定。我需要把所有研究材料汇总起来，看看能得出什么结论。看来我这个小窝也该结束了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So you're going back to the Wizards' Tower?
translation: 所以你要回法师塔了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well... maybe not just yet. I'll have to face the music there at some point, but probably best I wait until after I've got my head around all this Imperium business.
translation: 嗯……也许还不是时候。我总得在那里面对现实，但最好还是等我搞清楚这整个帝国事务之后再处理。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: If you don't mind, I'd appreciate it if you'd not mention what we found here to Sedridor and the others until I'm ready.
translation: 如果你不介意的话，在我准备好之前，希望你不要把我们在这里的发现告诉塞德里多尔他们。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Fair enough, but you do need to tell them soon.
translation: 好吧，但你得尽快告诉他们。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh don't worry, I will. Now, I'd best be getting off. I'm sure I'll see you again before long. I hope you find what you're looking for here.
translation: 哦别担心，我会的。好了，我最好走了。我相信用不了多久我们就会再见面的。希望你能在这里找到你要找的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Thanks, Persten. Good luck.
translation: 谢谢，佩斯滕。祝你好运。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good to see you, kid. Nice work on those two statues. That treasure will be ours in no time.
translation: 很高兴见到你，孩子。那两座雕像干得不错。那笔宝藏很快就会是我们的了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I need to enter the prison.
translation: 我需要进入监狱。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No. General Khazard has ordered us to guard this door. I'm not about to just let you walk through it.
translation: 不行。卡扎德将军命令我们守卫这扇门。我可不会让你就这么走过去。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But you're guarding the door because of that assassin, right? Why does that mean I can't go in?
translation: 但你守门是因为那个刺客，对吧？那为什么我不能进去？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't have time to answer your questions. I've told you that you can't go in, so go away.
translation: 我没时间回答你的问题。我已经告诉过你不能进去，所以走开。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Are you not bored of being on guard here? It can't be much fun in this dingy cold dungeon. Food must be a bit meh as well.
translation: 你在这里守卫不觉得无聊吗？在这个阴暗寒冷的地牢里肯定不会有什么乐趣。食物一定也不怎么样。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What is your point?
translation: 你想说什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: If that assassin were to be dealt with, Khazard might reconsider your posting. Rather than sitting here waiting around, why not let me go in and find him?
translation: 如果那个刺客被解决了，卡扎德可能会重新考虑你的岗位。与其在这儿干等，不如让我进去找到他？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Besides, let's be honest, if I die doing so, Khazard would probably be thrilled.
translation: 再说了，说实话，如果我在行动中死了，卡扎德搞不好还挺高兴的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Fine. If it stops you bothering me, feel free to go and get yourself killed.
translation: 好吧。只要你别再来烦我，尽管去送死吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Lovely! Thank you for your time.
translation: 太好了！谢谢你的时间。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hey! Can you hear me?
translation: 嘿！你能听见我说话吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Er... Hello?
translation: 呃……你好？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah, there you are!
translation: 啊，你来了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Who are you? Are you one of Khazard's soldiers?
translation: 你是谁？你是卡扎德的士兵吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's right! Made the mistake of sticking my nose where I shouldn't have. Now I've got myself a lovely little cell and no way to get out of it.
translation: 没错！我不该多管闲事的，结果就给自己搞了个可爱的小牢房，还没办法出去。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yeah... Seems I've got myself into a similar situation.
translation: 是啊……我似乎也陷入了类似的处境。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well, I tell you what, now that you're here, maybe we have a chance to escape!
translation: 嗯，我跟你说，既然你来了，我们也许有机会逃出去！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No idea, but I'm sure we can come up with something. Anything in your cell that you reckon could be of use?
translation: 不知道，但我肯定我们能想出办法。你的牢房里有什么东西可能用得上吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm not sure. Let me take a look.
translation: 我不确定。让我看看。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Any luck in there?
translation: 里面有发现吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Keep at it. There must be something we can use.
translation: 继续找。肯定有什么我们能用的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I found a letter on a skeleton.
translation: 我在一具骷髅上发现了一封信。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Someone was trying to help some prisoners escape. Might be we can use whatever they left behind to our advantage.
translation: 有人曾试图帮助一些囚犯逃跑。也许我们能用他们留下的东西来获利。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Brilliant! Keep looking and see what else you can find.
translation: 太棒了！继续找，看看还能发现什么。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I am not sticking my hand in there without good reason!
translation: 没有充分的理由我绝不会把手伸进去！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Eugh! I can't believe I'm doing this.
translation: 呃！真不敢相信我要这么做。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I managed to find a knife.
translation: 我找到了一把小刀。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh, pass it through! I reckon I can make use of it.
translation: 哦，递过来！我觉得我能用它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Right, give me a moment...
translation: 好的，给我点时间……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Okay, I have something! See if you can find a use for this.
translation: 好了，我有东西了！看看你能不能用到这个。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I lost that chisel you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的凿子。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh wait, it's on the floor here. Silly me.
translation: 哦等等，它就在地板上。我真傻。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How's it going in there?
translation: 里面怎么样了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm getting close I reckon.
translation: 我觉得快好了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good stuff!
translation: 好样的！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I managed to find a lockpick.
translation: 我找到了一个开锁器。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh, I'm pretty good with those! Pass it through and I'll see if I can get my cell unlocked. Once I'm out, I can free you as well!
translation: 哦，我挺擅长用那个的！递过来，我看看能不能打开我的牢门。等我出去了，也能放你出来！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You! I should have known!
translation: 你！我早该想到了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes, you probably should have.
translation: 没错，你确实应该想到。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Give me one good reason why I shouldn't kill you right now!
translation: 给我一个不立刻杀了你的好理由！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I can give you two. First, because you'll fail. You have no weapons or armour, and even if you did, it wouldn't go well. Second, because without me you'd still be in that cell.
translation: 我可以给你两个理由。第一，因为你不会成功。你没有武器或盔甲，就算有，也不会顺利。第二，因为没有我，你现在还待在那个牢房里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Without me you'd be in a cell as well!
translation: 没有我，你也得进牢房！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Correct. Now, while I appreciate you came here to kill me, we are both in each other's debt, so let's set aside the threats and start focusing on more important matters.
translation: 没错。虽然我很感激你来这里是为了杀我，但我们彼此都欠对方人情，所以把威胁放一边，开始专注于更重要的事情吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well actually I didn't come here for you. I'm looking for Duke Sucellus.
translation: 其实我不是冲你来的。我在找苏塞勒斯公爵。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Apparently he used to be in charge of this place. That letter I found mentioned the asylum, which seems a good place to start my search.
translation: 显然他以前是这里的负责人。我找到的那封信提到了疯人院，那似乎是个开始搜索的好地方。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I suspect your search will be quite a short one as things currently stand.
translation: 我猜以目前的情况来看，你的搜索会相当短暂。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It seems you are yet to consider an obvious question. Are you not wondering how I ended up in that cell?
translation: 看来你还没想到一个显而易见的问题。你不好奇我是怎么进那间牢房的吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well... yes, I suppose so.
translation: 嗯……是的，我确实好奇。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It was that Mahjarrat. Seems he doesn't think much of you either, as he was also responsible for your own imprisonment.
translation: 是那个玛哈加特。看来他也不怎么看得起你，因为他也是把你关起来的人。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Jhallan? But he was your prisoner!
translation: 贾兰？但他不是你的囚犯吗！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He was, but now he's not. There was an unfortunate mishap.
translation: 曾经是，但现在不是了。发生了一个不幸的意外。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A mishap? Nice work.
translation: 意外？干得漂亮。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So where is he now?
translation: 那他现在在哪？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't know, but he'll be nearby, and we are currently poorly equipped to deal with him. I'm missing my sword and you don't have any weapons either.
translation: 我不知道，但他肯定就在附近，而我们目前装备不足，无法对付他。我的剑不见了，你也没有任何武器。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Did you see where he put my things?
translation: 你看到他把我的东西放哪了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: They're in a chest in the cell opposite this one, but the cell is locked. My sword is in there as well.
translation: 它们在对面的牢房里的一个箱子里，但那间牢房锁着。我的剑也在里面。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Why do I feel like you have a proposal?
translation: 为什么我觉得你有个提议？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Because I do, and you'd be wise to listen to it. I came here in search of something, and the asylum is one of the last places I need to look.
translation: 因为我确实有预感，听我的对你没坏处。我来这里寻找某样东西，而疯人院是我需要寻找的最后几个地方之一。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: With Jhallan around, neither of us stand a good chance of getting what we want. However, if we work together, we can deal with him and get to the asylum.
translation: 有贾兰在，我们俩都没什么机会得到各自想要的东西。不过，如果我们合作，就能对付他，然后进入疯人院。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Look, I have no reason to trust you.
translation: 听着，我没有理由信任你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No, but you don't have any other options. Now, I suggest you focus on finding the key to that cell so we can recover our equipment. While you do that, I'll work out how to reach the asylum.
translation: 没有，但你也没有其他选择。现在，我建议你集中精力找到那间牢房的钥匙，这样我们就能取回装备。你去做这个的时候，我会想办法到达疯人院。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh, and you should take this. You might need it.
translation: 哦，还有，这个你拿着。你可能会用到。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hey, slow down there...
translation: 嘿，慢着……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We'll reconvene once you have the cell open.
translation: 等你打开牢房我们再碰头。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There you are!
translation: 你在这儿！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Did you think I wouldn't find you?
translation: 你以为我找不到你吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Going somewhere?
translation: 想走？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You won't escape me!
translation: 你逃不出我的手掌心！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I have you now!
translation: 这下你跑不掉了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you have the key?
translation: 你拿到钥匙了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good. Let's get this cell open.
translation: 很好。我们把这间牢房打开吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Not yet. First, you have to give me some answers.
translation: 还没。首先，你得回答我几个问题。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Rather than resorting to needless anger, had you considered just asking first?
translation: 与其无谓地发怒，你难道没想过先问问看吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh... well, why are you here?
translation: 哦……好吧，那你为什么在这里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I told you, I'm looking for something.
translation: 我告诉过你，我在找东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A magical artefact called the Frostenhorn.
translation: 一个叫霜寒号角的魔法神器。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Frostenhorn?
translation: 霜寒号角？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I've heard the name, but I don't know anything about it. What is it?
translation: 我听说过这个名字，但我对它一无所知。那是什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't know and I don't need to know. I've been paid to recover it from this place and that's all that matters to me.
translation: 我不知道，也不需要知道。我收了钱，要把它从这个地方找出来，这对我来说才是最重要的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Paid by who?
translation: 谁付的钱？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's confidential.
translation: 这是机密。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Did this person also pay you to steal that relic from Entrana?
translation: 这个人也付钱让你从恩特纳岛偷走那件遗物吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: They did.
translation: 是的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And what about all that business with the Hazeel Cult and the Carnilleans?
translation: 那所有关于哈兹尔邪教和卡尼利安家族的事呢？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I needed to recover that crest half from the Carnillean Mansion. Framing the Hazeel Cult was the best cover.
translation: 我需要从卡尼利安庄园取回那半个徽章。嫁祸给哈兹尔邪教是最好的掩护。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But why have Hazeel resurrected as part of that?
translation: 但为什么要把复活哈兹尔作为其中的一部分？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Because it made it believable. Now, are we done?
translation: 因为这样才可信。现在，我们问完了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But why try to have Hazeel resurrected as part of that?
translation: 但为什么要把试图复活哈兹尔作为其中的一部分？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Because it would have made it believable. Unfortunately, I failed to account for you having already done so. Now, are we done?
translation: 因为这样会让它变得可信。不幸的是，我没料到你已经这么做了。现在，我们问完了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You seem surprised by that.
translation: 你似乎对此感到惊讶。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I suppose I wasn't expecting you to be so open about it all.
translation: 我想我没想到你会这么坦诚。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You weren't going to open the gate until I provided satisfactory answers, so I provided them.
translation: 在我给出满意的答案之前，你是不会开门的，所以我就给了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Why not try to kill me instead? It's not like that's ever been a problem for you before.
translation: 为什么不试着杀了我？这以前对你来说从来不是问题。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I kill when it is the best way to further my goal. That would not have been the case here, so I chose the cleaner and more efficient option.
translation: 我只在杀人最有利于推进目标时才动手。现在不是这种情况，所以我选择了更干净、更高效的方式。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Besides, beyond placating your curiosity, the answers I gave are rather meaningless. They do not jeopardise me or my employer in any way.
translation: 此外，除了满足你的好奇心，我给出的答案其实毫无意义。它们丝毫不会危及我或我的雇主。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Now, once again, let's get this cell open.
translation: 现在，再说一次，我们把这间牢房打开吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Time is wasting. You should get this cell open.
translation: 时间不等人。你该打开这间牢房了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Right, you'll be pleased to know that I've obtained a key that can open the way to the asylum. However, Jhallan must be dealt with before we can use it safely.
translation: 好了，你会很高兴知道我拿到了一把能打开通往疯人院之路的钥匙。不过，我们必须先解决贾兰，才能安全使用它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I don't know much about the Mahjarrat, but it's clear they're not easy to kill. Jhallan is thankfully fairly weak for their kind, but that still makes him significantly stronger than us.
translation: 我对玛哈加特了解不多，但很明显他们不容易被杀死。谢天谢地，贾兰在他们同类中算是相当弱的，但这仍然让他比我们强大得多。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Our best option will be to trap him. I suggest we do so by repeating what we did before.
translation: 我们最好的选择是设陷阱抓住他。我建议我们重复之前做过的事。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What we did before?
translation: 之前做过的事？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. You distract him and I take him unaware.
translation: 是的。你分散他的注意力，我趁他不备下手。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Are you talking about what happened back in that cave? There was no 'we' about that.
translation: 你是在说那个洞穴里发生的事吗？那可不是什么‘我们’。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You provided an opportunity and I took it. Your awareness of said opportunity was irrelevant.
translation: 你创造了一个机会，我抓住了它。你是否意识到这个机会并不重要。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Right... So how do I distract him?
translation: 好吧……那我该怎么分散他的注意力？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The old refugee camp seems like a good place to spring our trap. I left a pack there with some firecrackers in. The noise should quickly attract his attention.
translation: 旧的难民营地似乎是个设陷阱的好地方。我在那里留了一个背包，里面有些鞭炮。噪音应该能很快吸引他的注意。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Once he's there, don't try to be a hero. Just keep him busy until I'm ready.
translation: 他到了之后，别想逞英雄。只要拖住他，直到我准备好。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. Now, let's be on our way.
translation: 是的。现在，我们出发吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Right, that's him dealt with.
translation: 好了，他解决了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Will that ice hold?
translation: 那冰能撑住吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It should, but it would be unwise to wait and find out. I must resume my search for the Frostenhorn and you have your Duke business to deal with.
translation: 应该会，但等着瞧可不明智。我必须继续寻找冰霜号角，而你也有你的公爵事务要处理。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To the asylum then?
translation: 那么，去疯人院？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. You can get there by heading north. I've already unlocked the gate.
translation: 是的。你往北走就能到。我已经打开了大门。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That is becoming quite tiresome.
translation: 这开始变得相当烦人了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Curious...
translation: 奇怪……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I've checked every corner of this prison now. This room was the last place to look. There is only one possibility: The Frostenhorn isn't here.
translation: 我已经检查过这座监狱的每个角落了。这个房间是最后一个要找的地方。只有一个可能：霜寒号角不在这里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But if it's not here, then where is it?
translation: 但如果它不在这里，那会在哪？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A good question, but one that is not my concern. My employer believed it to be here, but was clearly mistaken. That's their problem.
translation: 好问题，但这不是我关心的事。我的雇主认为它在这里，但显然是搞错了。那是他们的问题。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You don't mind that you failed?
translation: 你不介意自己失败了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I did all that was required of me. If they are able to discover the true location of the horn, they are welcome to hire me once more. Until then, my work is done.
translation: 我做了所有要求我做的事。如果他们能找到号角的真正位置，欢迎他们再次雇佣我。在那之前，我的工作已经完成了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What makes you think I'm going to let you go? You have a whole lot of murders you need to answer for.
translation: 你凭什么觉得我会放你走？你犯下那么多谋杀案，需要为此负责。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I will not be giving you a choice in the matter. Perhaps justice will be served someday, but not today. Goodbye.
translation: 我不会给你选择的权利。也许总有一天正义会得到伸张，但不是今天。再见。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We're getting close now, kid. Just one more statue to go! I can smell that treasure already!
translation: 我们快到了，小子。只剩最后一座雕像了！我已经能闻到宝藏的味道了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Nonsense! You'd be a fool to turn away now that we're so close! I'm about to make history - and you'll have helped!
translation: 胡说！我们这么近了，你现在放弃才是傻瓜！我就要创造历史了——而你也帮了大忙！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Have you seen any archeologists around here?
translation: 你在这附近见过考古学家吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Human archeologists? Yes, some showed up recently. I told them they'd be fine to look around as long as they were careful. They're probably over by the bank chest.
translation: 人类考古学家？有，最近来了一些。我告诉他们只要小心点，可以随便看看。他们可能就在银行箱那边。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hello again. Where did you say that hole was?
translation: 又见面了。你刚才说那个洞在哪来着？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You'll find it just on the other side of the mine. You'll need a pretty long rope to get down there though. Here, you can use mine.
translation: 你会在矿场另一边找到它。不过你需要一条很长的绳子才能下去。给你，用我的吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You'll find it just on the other side of the mine. Be careful down there.
translation: 就在矿场的另一边。下面小心点。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Huh? What happened? Where am I? And who are you?
translation: 呃？发生了什么？我在哪？你是谁？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I am Ketla. I found you wandering the streets. It nearly had you. You were nearly lost.
translation: 我是凯特拉。我发现你在街上游荡。它差点就得手了。你差点就迷失了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It? What are you on about?
translation: 它？你在说什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: An unknowable stranger with a thousand faces. An endless ocean where the lost swim. A fissure in fate that exists beyond time.
translation: 一个有着千张面孔的不可名状的陌生人。一片迷失者游荡的无尽汪洋。一道存在于时间之外的命运裂缝。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It twists its way into your very soul, devouring all that you are, until by the time it's done, only one question remains...
translation: 它扭曲着渗入你的灵魂，吞噬你的一切，直到最后，只剩下一个问题……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you think you can save them?
translation: 你觉得你能拯救他们吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh... I'm sorry. Sometimes it becomes difficult to resist the call. It gets harder with every day that goes by.
translation: 哦……抱歉。有时候很难抗拒那召唤。日子一天天过去，越来越难了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Resist what? It?
translation: 抗拒什么？它？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. It wants my soul, and I fear it will soon have it. My strength is leaving me and I cannot hold it back. This city will be my doom.
translation: 是的。它想要我的灵魂，我担心它很快就会得手。我的力量正在流失，我无法再阻止它。这座城市将是我的末日。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But then why not leave? I'm guessing you're an Imcando dwarf, right? A survivor from Camdozaal? Others of your kind still live. You could leave this place and join them.
translation: 但为什么不离开呢？我猜你是伊姆坎多矮人，对吧？卡姆多扎尔的幸存者？你的同类还有活着的。你可以离开这里去加入他们。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Others still live? I feared I was the last...
translation: 还有活着的同类？我还以为我是最后一个……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well then that is all the more reason to stay. For the good of my people, for all people, it has to be stopped.
translation: 那更是留下来的理由。为了我族人的利益，为了所有人的利益，必须阻止它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Maybe I could help? I'm a pretty good fighter. I'm sure I can deal with whatever this thing is.
translation: 也许我能帮忙？我是个不错的战士。我肯定能对付得了这东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Your weapons are worthless. It is not an evil to be slain.
translation: 你的武器毫无用处。它并非能被斩杀的邪恶。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then how can we stop it?
translation: 那我们怎样才能阻止它？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The totem. It links our world to the shadows... to it.
translation: 图腾。它将我们的世界与阴影……与它连接了起来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The shadows? As in the Shadow Realm?
translation: 阴影？你是说阴影领域？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You know of the shadows?
translation: 你知道阴影？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: More than know. I've been there! I have a ring that lets me do so.
translation: 何止知道。我去过那里！我有一枚戒指能让我这么做。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A ring? I must see it.
translation: 一枚戒指？我得看看。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of course. I don't have it with me, but I can go and fetch it.
translation: 当然。我没带在身上，但我可以去取来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. Please bring it to me.
translation: 好。请带来给我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of course. I have it right here.
translation: 当然。我正好带着呢。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you have the ring?
translation: 你带着戒指吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A wandering merchant gave it to me. I never asked how he got it.
translation: 一个流浪商人给我的。我从没问过他是怎么弄到的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a great power to this ring, but the shadows here reject it. It must know the ring is a threat.
translation: 这枚戒指有强大的力量，但这里的阴影排斥它。它一定知道戒指是个威胁。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So the ring is useless?
translation: 所以戒指没用？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: On its own, yes. The ring can see into the shadows, but it is not of the shadows. However, I have something that is.
translation: 单独用的话，是的。这枚戒指能看透阴影，但它本身不属于阴影。不过，我有一样属于阴影的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A shard of the totem. Too dangerous to use on its own, but with the power of this ring, perhaps I can make it safe.
translation: 一块图腾碎片。单独使用太危险，但有了这枚戒指的力量，也许我能让它变得安全。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Sounds like it's worth a go.
translation: 听起来值得一试。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Give me a moment...
translation: 给我点时间……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There. The fragment should be safe to use now.
translation: 好了。现在碎片应该可以安全使用了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So what can we do with it?
translation: 那我们能用它做什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You said the ring let you enter the shadows, but that is not the case. It simply allowed you a small glimpse into their darkness.
translation: 你说那枚戒指让你进入了阴影，但事实并非如此。它只是让你得以瞥见它们的黑暗。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But it rules the shadows. To overcome it, you must enter the shadows as well. The fragment will allow you to do so now.
translation: 但它统治着阴影。要战胜它，你也必须进入阴影。现在这块碎片将允许你这么做。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So I can use this fragment to enter the Shadow Realm? But surely there's going to be a lot of danger entering the domain of this... whatever it is.
translation: 所以我可以使用这块碎片进入阴影领域？但进入这个……不管是什么东西的领地，肯定会有很多危险。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. Once you enter the shadows, you will be at its mercy. Unless you long for the eternal sea, you would be wise not to stay for long.
translation: 是的。一旦你进入阴影，就任由它摆布了。除非你渴望永恒之海，否则明智之举是不要久留。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's... concerning.
translation: 这……真让人担心。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It is the only way. You must enter the shadows and destroy the totem.
translation: 这是唯一的办法。你必须进入阴影并摧毁图腾。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But where is the totem?
translation: 但图腾在哪里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Its power is strongest in the sunken cathedral. That is likely where the totem will be found.
translation: 它的力量在沉没大教堂中最强。图腾很可能就在那里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And I'm guessing I won't just be able to walk on in there?
translation: 我想我不可能直接走进去吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No. It has blocked the way. You will need to clear the path with cleansing flames.
translation: 不。它挡住了路。你需要用净化火焰清除路径。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Cleansing flames? Like a tinderbox?
translation: 净化火焰？像火绒盒那样的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The fire of our world will do nothing in the shadows, but the old inhabitants of this city, they tried to fight off the inevitable darkness. They created things that could help you.
translation: 我们这个世界的火焰在阴影中毫无作用，但这座城市的古老居民曾试图抵挡那不可逃避的黑暗。他们创造了一些能帮助你的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: If you find their old schematics, bring them to me. I can use them to create new tools for you.
translation: 如果你找到他们古老的示意图，就带给我。我可以利用它们为你制作新的工具。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Alright. Anything else I should know?
translation: 好的。还有其他我需要知道的吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The fragment won't just work anywhere. To enter the shadows, you must use it where they are strongest. Seek out the places where that is the case. You will know them when you see them.
translation: 碎片不是随处都能生效的。要进入阴影，你必须在它们最强的地方使用它。去寻找那些地方。当你看到它们时，你就会知道。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And what about leaving again?
translation: 那怎么出来呢？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That is thankfully easier. The fragment will let you leave the shadows whenever you desire. Be sure to use it before darkness claims you.
translation: 幸运的是，那更容易。只要你愿意，碎片就能让你离开阴影。记得在黑暗吞噬你之前使用它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You know of Camdozaal. That means you have seen what became of our home.
translation: 你知道卡姆多扎尔。那意味着你看到了我们家园的遭遇。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: When the barbarians came, many tried to fight. I should have fought with them, but I turned away. I had a duty to my people, but I abandoned them.
translation: 当蛮族来袭时，许多人试图战斗。我本该和他们并肩作战，但我却转身离开了。我对我的子民负有责任，但我抛弃了他们。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The barbarians had blocked all exits, so the only way to flee was down. I hid down here while my people died, but now I pay the price for my choice.
translation: 蛮族封锁了所有出口，所以唯一的逃跑方向是往下。在我的子民死去时，我躲在这里，但现在我为自己的选择付出了代价。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There are worse things than death, and this city is home to them all.
translation: 有比死亡更糟糕的事情，这座城市里到处都是。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You shouldn't feel guilty for fleeing. Your people had no hope against the barbarians.
translation: 你不该为逃跑感到内疚。你的子民面对蛮族毫无胜算。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You misunderstand. Fleeing was not the cause of my guilt. My punishment is for what happened next...
translation: 你误解了。逃跑并非我愧疚的原因。我的惩罚是为了后来发生的事……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It is best you do not know. Please, let us speak of something else.
translation: 你最好别知道。请让我们谈点别的吧。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What do you know about this city?
translation: 关于这座城市，你知道些什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Lassar. That is what they called this place. It was once home to some of the greatest minds in the world.
translation: 拉萨尔。他们就是这么称呼这个地方的。它曾是世上一些最伟大智者的家园。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I knew about the fortress of Lassar, but I had no idea a city was here as well.
translation: 我知道拉萨尔堡垒，但我不知道这里还有一座城市。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It seems they kept it hidden on purpose. This city was a place of discovery, where magic and science were practiced in equal measure. They did not want their secrets falling into the wrong hands.
translation: 看来他们有意将其隐藏。这座城市是个发现之地，魔法与科学在此并行不悖。他们不想让秘密落入错误之手。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I guess that's how this place is so well preserved. No one even knew it was here.
translation: 我想这就是为什么这里保存得这么好。根本没人知道它的存在。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. They remained hidden down here long after their fortress fell. They were still here even after the construction of Camdozaal.
translation: 是的。他们在堡垒陷落后很久一直躲藏在这里。甚至在卡姆多扎尔建成后，他们仍然在这里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Their isolation kept them safe for a time, but when darkness fell, there was no one to hear their screams.
translation: 与世隔绝让他们暂时安全，但当黑暗降临时，没有人听到他们的尖叫。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Can you tell me any more about this entity?
translation: 你能再多告诉我一些关于这个实体的事吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It is beyond our understanding. It exists in the shadows, and there it should remain, but the blackstone is like a blade. It cuts through into our world.
translation: 它超出我们的理解。它存在于阴影中，也应该留在那里，但黑石就像一把刀片。它切开了通往我们世界的通道。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Blackstone?
translation: 黑石？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It comes from the shadows as well. It holds a great power, and many have tried to use it, not knowing the cost of doing so.
translation: 它也来自阴影。它拥有强大的力量，许多人试图使用它，却不知道代价。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Is that what happened here?
translation: 这就是这里发生的事吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. They were studying the totem, but in doing so, they followed in our footsteps, dooming their city.
translation: 是的。他们正在研究图腾，但这样做却重蹈了我们的覆辙，注定了他们城市的命运。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Followed in your footsteps? But it wasn't blackstone that destroyed Camdozaal, was it?
translation: 重蹈你们的覆辙？但摧毁卡姆多扎尔的并不是黑石，对吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Camdozaal was not the first home of my people. From a young age, we are all taught of the Fall of Imcandoria, of the disaster that claimed our city.
translation: 卡姆多扎尔并不是我们子民最初的家乡。从小我们就被教导伊姆坎多利亚的陷落，以及那场夺走我们城市的灾难。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But down here, I have seen the truth. It was no volcano that destroyed our home, it was the totem.
translation: 但在这里，我看到了真相。摧毁我们家园的不是火山，而是图腾。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The same totem that's now here?
translation: 就是现在在这里的那个图腾？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Did it follow us, or did we follow it? Are we fated to be its victims forevermore? Or will the cycle end here? It will soon be time to find out.
translation: 是它跟着我们，还是我们跟着它？我们是否注定要永远成为它的受害者？还是这个循环会在此终结？很快就能见分晓了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You will need this.
translation: 你会需要这个的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is an avalanche of horrors which has discovered your name.
translation: 有一场雪崩般的恐怖之物知晓了你的名字。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a bard who sings of your final moments.
translation: 有一位吟游诗人吟唱着你的最后时刻。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a blood-soaked record of your darkest moments.
translation: 有一份浸血的记录记载着你最黑暗的时刻。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a choir of souls who you will one day meet.
translation: 有一支灵魂合唱团，你终有一天会遇见他们。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a city of blackstone where the screams are ever silent.
translation: 有一座黑石之城，那里的尖叫永远寂静。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is an empire of darkness where hope flickers and dies.
translation: 有一个黑暗帝国，希望在那里闪烁然后熄灭。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a judge who has already passed your sentence.
translation: 有一位法官已经宣判了你的刑罚。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a library of sorrow where your final fate is written.
translation: 有一座悲伤图书馆，里面写着你的最终命运。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a monument built in honour of the suffering you desire.
translation: 有一座纪念碑，为纪念你所渴望的苦难而建。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is an ocean of souls where you are one day fated to swim.
translation: 有一片灵魂之海，你终有一天注定要在其中遨游。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is an open wound that bleeds only darkness.
translation: 有一道敞开的伤口，只流淌着黑暗。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a priest who prays for the oceans of the dead.
translation: 有一位祭司为死亡之海祈祷。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a reaper who has a thousand gibbering faces.
translation: 有一位死神，长着一千张叽叽喳喳的面孔。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a song so loud that you only hear silence.
translation: 有一首歌如此响亮，以至于你只听到寂静。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a stranger who wears a black mask under their skin.
translation: 有一位陌生人，皮肤下戴着黑色面具。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a void that echoes with the cries of those you failed to save.
translation: 有一片虚空，回荡着你未能拯救之人的哭喊。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Your fate is sealed, [player name], and only one question remains...
translation: 你的命运已定，[player name]，只剩下一个问题……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You only have one future, [player name], so ask yourself this...
translation: 你只有一个未来，[player name]，所以问问自己……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you really think you can save them?
translation: 你真的以为你能救他们吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I have a schematic here.
translation: 我这里有一份示意图。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Let me see.
translation: 让我看看。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes, I think I can work with this. Give me a moment...
translation: 是的，我想我能处理这个。给我一点时间……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There. You can collect your new item from the workbench. Let me know if you want any information on how it works.
translation: 好了。你可以从工作台领取你的新物品了。如果你想了解它的使用方法，请告诉我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Could you tell me more about one of these items?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于其中一件物品的信息吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Which one?
translation: 哪一件？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Could you tell me more about the Shadow Torch?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于阴影火把的事吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It is a light that will aid you in the shadows, where all other lights fail. It is the only thing that can destroy what lurks there. Use it well.
translation: 那是一盏能在阴影中帮助你的光，所有其他的光在那里都会熄灭。它是唯一能摧毁潜伏其中之物。善用它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Could you tell me more about the Shadow Blocker?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于阴影驱散器的事吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Almost nothing can stop you from being consumed by the shadows, but set the Shadow Blocker down, and it will provide a small area of safety. It's the only safety you'll get.
translation: 几乎没有什么能阻止你被阴影吞噬，但放下阴影驱散器，它就能提供一小片安全区域。这是你能得到的唯一安全。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Could you tell me more about the Revitalising Idol?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于复苏神像的事吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Unless you wish for the void, you must not spend too long in the shadows. Once set down, you can use the Revitalising Idol to give you more time there. But remember, time still always runs out in the end.
translation: 除非你渴望虚空，否则你不能在阴影中逗留太久。一旦放下，你可以使用复苏神像来获得更多的时间。但要记住，时间终究会耗尽。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Could you tell me more about the Anima Portal?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于灵能传送门的事吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Those that lurk in the shadows do not take kindly to we that still live. They will hunt you. Use the Anima Portal to give them something else to hunt. It provides a glimmer of life in their sea of emptiness.
translation: 潜伏在阴影中的存在对我们这些仍然活着的人并不友善。它们会猎杀你。使用灵能传送门给它们一些别的东西去猎杀。它在它们的空虚之海中提供了一丝生命的光芒。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Are you ready, my child?
translation: 你准备好了吗，我的孩子？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I... I think so.
translation: 我……我想是的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He has doubts.
translation: 他有疑虑。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No! It's just...
translation: 不！只是……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do not be afraid, my child, for you are not alone. Your voice will be one of thousands, singing an eternal silence.
translation: 不要害怕，我的孩子，因为你并不孤单。你的声音将是千百个声音中的一个，吟唱永恒的寂静。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Seek out our divine order in the cistern below. They will guide you across the waves.
translation: 去下方蓄水池寻找我们的神圣秩序。他们会指引你渡过波涛。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Go now, and keep our icon close, for it marks you as one of the chosen. Without it, you are forsaken.
translation: 现在走吧，随身携带我们的图标，因为它标志着你是被选中之人。没有它，你将被遗弃。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Okay... I'll go right away!
translation: 好……我马上去！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And so another voice joins the Silent Choir.
translation: 又有一个声音加入了寂静合唱团。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He is afraid. He is not ready.
translation: 他害怕了。他还没准备好。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It matters not. The day of ascension approaches. His fear will be washed away by the endless sea...
translation: 没关系。飞升之日即将来临。他的恐惧将被无尽之海冲刷殆尽……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This torch schematic. It's a fake.
translation: 这张火把示意图是假的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Fake? But how?
translation: 假的？怎么可能？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It is marked by the black hand. This is the doing of the Silent Choir.
translation: 上面有黑手的标记。这是寂静合唱团干的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Silent Choir?
translation: 寂静合唱团？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: They were the first to fall. It corrupted them and made them its own. They undid the work of those that tried to resist. Harbingers for what was to come.
translation: 他们是第一批堕落的人。它腐蚀了他们，让他们成为自己的傀儡。他们毁掉了那些试图抵抗的人们的心血。是即将到来之事的预兆。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So they stole the real schematic? Where would they have taken it?
translation: 所以他们偷走了真正的示意图？他们会把它带到哪里去？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You ask many questions. I have one for you.
translation: 你问题真多。我也有一个问题要问你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Really? Is now the best time?
translation: 真的吗？现在问合适吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You did not come to help, but you do so anyway. Why are you here?
translation: 你本不是来帮忙的，但你还是帮了。你为什么会在这里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm looking for information on someone known as the Whisperer. I have reason to beleveshe was here before the city fell.
translation: 我在找一个被称为低语者的人的消息。我有理由相信她在城市陷落前曾在这里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There are many whispers in this city, and it hears them all. Will you join them? Will you join the Silent Choir?
translation: 这座城市里有无数低语，而它听得见所有。你愿意加入它们吗？你愿意加入寂静合唱团吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ketla? Are you okay?
translation: 凯特拉？你还好吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It sees you, [player name]. Did you really think you could hide? Did you really think you could save them?
translation: 它看见你了，[player name]。你真以为你能躲藏吗？你真以为你能拯救他们吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ketla!
translation: 凯特拉！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Huh? What is it?
translation: 嗯？怎么了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Are you okay? You were in some sort of trance.
translation: 你还好吗？你刚才好像陷入了某种恍惚状态。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It knows. It knows what we are trying to do. We must hurry. Soon it will be impossible to resist.
translation: 它知道了。它知道我们想做什么。我们必须抓紧时间。很快它就会变得无法抵抗。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Silent Choir. They had a church. They built it somewhere in the city. Somewhere hidden.
translation: 寂静合唱团。他们有一座教堂。他们把它建在城里的某个地方。某个隐秘之处。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hmm... I think it might be in the cistern beneath us.
translation: 嗯……我想它可能在我们脚下的蓄水池里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: How do you know this?
translation: 你怎么知道的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Something I found earlier. However, it also seemed to suggest that some sort of icon is needed to enter the church.
translation: 我之前发现了一些东西。不过，它似乎也暗示进入教堂需要某种图标。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then you must find one of these icons. Be quick. Time is not on our side.
translation: 那你必须找到一个这样的图标。快去吧。时间不站在我们这边。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then we have to find it. Can you think of anywhere that would be a good place to start?
translation: 那我们得找到它。你觉得从哪里开始找比较好？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The inn. They met there. Hiding in plain sight. Perhaps they left something behind.
translation: 旅馆。他们在那里碰头。就在光天化日之下躲藏。也许他们留下了什么东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's worth a shot. I'll be back soon.
translation: 值得一试。我很快回来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Be quick. Time is not on our side.
translation: 快去吧。时间不站在我们这边。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You have the icon? Good. You should be able to reach the cistern using the drain in the square outside. Hurry.
translation: 你拿到图标了？很好。你应该能通过外面广场的排水沟到达蓄水池。快点。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is an atrocity written upon blackstone.
translation: 黑石上刻着一桩暴行。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a king who presides over a court of corpses.
translation: 有一位国王，统治着由尸骸组成的朝堂。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What is this? What's happening?
translation: 这是什么？怎么回事？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a truth written upon the blackstone, and you cannot escape it.
translation: 黑石上刻着一条真理，你无从逃避。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Come, [player name]. The Silent Choir awaits you. It is time for your eternal song.
translation: 来吧，[player name]。寂静合唱团在等着你。是时候唱响你永恒的歌声了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This isn't real! I know this isn't real!
translation: 这不是真的！我知道这不是真的！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You cannot escape your fate, [player name]. The endless sea calls for you.
translation: 你逃不掉你的命运，[player name]。无尽之海在召唤你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you really think you can hide, [player name]?
translation: 你真以为你能躲藏吗，[player name]？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The totem! I... What happened?
translation: 图腾！我……发生了什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You were gone too long. I came to find you, but it already had you. You had fallen.
translation: 你离开太久了。我来找你，但它已经控制了你。你沦陷了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then how did you save me?
translation: 那你是怎么救我的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The totem. I destroyed it.
translation: 图腾。我摧毁了它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You did? So it's over?
translation: 你摧毁了？那就结束了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No... I thought destroying the totem would be enough, but it's already too late. It has claimed this place now. We can never undo that.
translation: 不……我本以为摧毁图腾就足够了，但已经太迟了。它已经占领了这个地方。我们永远无法挽回了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But surely destroying the totem did something?
translation: 但摧毁图腾肯定有点作用吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Its influence has been weakened. Without the totem, it cannot spread beyond this city.
translation: 它的影响力被削弱了。没有图腾，它无法扩散到这座城市之外。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then you still achieved what you set out to do, right? The surviving Imcando are safe now. You can leave.
translation: 那你的目标还是达成了，对吧？幸存的伊姆坎多人现在安全了。你可以离开了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I thought destroying the totem would be the end. I thought it would bring peace...
translation: 我曾以为摧毁图腾就是终结。我曾以为它会带来和平……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But there is no peace. I still hear their screams. I will never be free of what I did to them.
translation: 但根本没有和平。我仍然能听到他们的尖叫。我永远无法从我对他们做的事中解脱出来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good. Pray that you never have to.
translation: 很好。祈祷你永远不必经历这些。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No more of this. I found the missing schematic in the church. Your new tool is ready. Perhaps you can use it to find what it is you seek here.
translation: 够了。我在教堂里找到了丢失的示意图。你的新工具已经准备好了。也许你可以用它来找到你在这里寻找的东西。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The cathedral is the only place I haven't searched.
translation: 大教堂是我唯一没搜查过的地方了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There is a darkness there. I thought it was the totem, but clearly not. Something else lurks in those depths...
translation: 那里有一片黑暗。我以为是图腾，但显然不是。有什么别的东西潜伏在那深处……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then I'd best be careful.
translation: 那我最好小心点。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I will not be here when you return. My journey in this place is done. It is time to start a new one. I will leave my things on the workbench for you.
translation: 你回来时我不会在这里了。我在这地方的旅程已经结束。是时候开始新的旅程了。我会把我的东西留在工作台上给你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Thank you, Ketla, for everything. Whatever it is you're looking for... I hope you eventually find it.
translation: 谢谢你，凯特拉，为一切。不管你在找什么……我希望你最终能找到它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Farewell, [player name]. Perhaps we will meet again.
translation: 再会，[player name]。也许我们会再次相见。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I will be departing this place soon. Be careful in the cathedral, [player name].
translation: 我很快就要离开这个地方了。在大教堂里小心点，[player name]。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I found another dwarf!
translation: 我找到了另一个矮人！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A dwarf? An Imcando Dwarf?
translation: 一个矮人？伊姆坎多矮人？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It seems so. Her name is Ketla. I found her in a hidden Zarosian ruin beneath us.
translation: 似乎是的。她叫凯特拉。我在我们脚下的一处隐秘的扎洛斯废墟里找到了她。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You know her?
translation: 你认识她？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I did, long ago. I thought she was gone. Tell me... was she alone?
translation: 我认识，很久以前。我以为她已经不在了。告诉我……她是一个人在那里吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: She was.
translation: 是的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I see... How is she?
translation: 我明白了……她还好吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: She's... okay. Things haven't been great for her, but I think the worst is behind her.
translation: 她……还行。她的境况不太好，但我想最糟糕的时候已经过去了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's good. I hope I get to meet her soon.
translation: 那就好。我希望能尽快见到她。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm glad they didn't win, I suppose. But it doesn't change much for me. The Imcando are all but extinct. I am one of the last to remain.
translation: 我想我很高兴他们没有赢。但这对我而言改变不了什么。伊姆坎多人几乎灭绝了。我是仅存的最后几人之一。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But not the last. Don't forget Ketla.
translation: 但不是最后一个。别忘了凯特拉。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But not the last. Don't forget Thurgo and Ketla.
translation: 但不是最后一个。别忘了瑟戈和凯特拉。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes... You're right, [player name]. I should not be so down. There is still a chance my kind can live on.
translation: 是的……你说得对，[player name]。我不该这么消沉。我的族人还有机会延续下去。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You escaped.
translation: 你逃出来了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It seems I have a knack for that sort of thing. Maybe you underestimated me.
translation: 看来我很擅长这种事。也许你小看我了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Unlikely. You have displayed moderate skill at best.
translation: 不太可能。你展示出的技巧最多算中等水平。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I assume you have the medallion?
translation: 我猜勋章在你手里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And I'm guessing you're not about to just give it to me?
translation: 我猜你不会就这么把它给我？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Correct. You are left with two options.
translation: 正确。你只剩下两个选择。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: If you wish, I will allow you to accept your defeat and walk away.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以允许你接受失败然后走人。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Or?
translation: 或者？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I have gone too long without a worthy challenger. You say I underestimated you? Prove it. Show me a true fight.
translation: 我已经太久没有遇到像样的对手了。你说我小看你？证明给我看。让我见识一场真正的战斗。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I'm not backing down now.
translation: 我现在可不会退缩。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Blimey, kid. You don't half take your time, do you? That treasure of ours won't uncover itself!
translation: 天哪，小子。你可真够磨蹭的，是吧？我们的宝藏可不会自己暴露出来！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ours? Like I said before, I never actually agreed to work with you.
translation: 我们的？就像我之前说的，我从没同意和你合作。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What? You're not thinking of double-crossing me, are you?
translation: 什么？你不是想背弃我吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I can't double-cross you if I was never working with you to begin with! Besides, we have more important things to worry about than treasure.
translation: 我一开始就没和你合作，哪来的背弃！再说了，我们有比宝藏更重要的事要操心。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh, I see what's happening! You're trying to trick me so you can take the treasure for yourself!
translation: 哦，我明白怎么回事了！你想骗我，好把宝藏独吞！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Listen to me! We're not the only ones trying to get into this place! There was this woman who kept trying to steal the medallions. Someone sent her!
translation: 听我说！想进入这个地方的不止我们！有个女人一直想偷勋章。有人派她来的！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well of course there will be others who want the treasure! All the more reason for you to stop messing around.
translation: 当然还会有别人想要宝藏！所以你更该别磨蹭了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm not going any further until we work out what's going on.
translation: 在我们弄清楚怎么回事之前，我不会再往前走了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I really thought you had what it takes, kid, but you're just another fool. If you won't help me find the treasure, I'll just have to do it myself!
translation: 我之前真以为你有两下子，小子，但你也不过是另一个傻瓜。既然你不肯帮我找宝藏，那我就自己来！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What in the world are you playing at?
translation: 你到底在搞什么鬼？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Look at it... It's... beautiful!
translation: 看它……它……真美！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you feel that? There's a power radiating off it unlike anything I've felt before...
translation: 你感觉到了吗？有一股力量从中散发出来，是我从未感受过的……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: This power... I've felt it before...
translation: 这股力量……我以前感受过……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So you know what it is?
translation: 所以你知道它是什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Not exactly. The last time I felt this power, it was something very different creating it.
translation: 不完全知道。上次我感受到这股力量时，产生它的东西完全不同。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That said, I reckon I do have some idea as to what this is.
translation: 不过话说回来，我觉得我对这东西还是有点了解的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Frostenhorn. I've no idea what it does, but it's a powerful Zarosian artefact that it seems quite a few people are searching for.
translation: 弗洛斯坦号角。我不知道它有什么作用，但它是强大的萨洛希安神器，似乎有不少人在寻找它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Frostenhorn has the ability to amplify power to potentially unimaginable levels.
translation: 弗洛斯坦号角有能力将力量放大到可能难以想象的水平。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Its rediscovery would be revolutionary, but there's just one problem...
translation: 它的重新发现将是革命性的，但只有一个问题……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: That's not the Frostenhorn.
translation: 那不是弗洛斯坦号角。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Dr Banikan? You followed me here?
translation: 巴尼坎博士？你跟踪我到了这里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I did. You must forgive me, friend, for I'm afraid I've deceived you in another way as well.
translation: 是的。你必须原谅我，朋友，恐怕我在另一方面也欺骗了你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Azzanadra?!
translation: 阿扎纳德拉？！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: My apologies, but my subterfuge was necessary. There are far too many who would have tried to stop me recovering the Frostenhorn.
translation: 抱歉，但我必须使用这种伪装。太多人会试图阻止我找回弗洛斯坦号角了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: After our earlier encounter, I came to believe it might be here, but it seems I was mistaken.
translation: 在我们上次相遇之后，我开始相信它可能在这里，但看来我错了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But if this isn't the Frostenhorn, then what is it?
translation: 但如果这不是弗洛斯坦号角，那它是什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: There are many powerful artefacts in this world, but few are truly unknowable. This is one of those few. A relic that predates even the gods themselves.
translation: 这个世界上有许多强大的神器，但真正不可知的东西很少。这就是其中之一。一件甚至比众神本身还要古老的遗物。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It has had many names over many millennia, but to us, it was simply known as the Elder Horn.
translation: 在数千年的岁月里，它有过许多名字，但对我们来说，它简称为长老号角。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What does it do?
translation: 它有什么用？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It grants absolute control. With this, one person has the power to bring entire armies to their knees, all without a single drop of blood being shed.
translation: 它赋予绝对的控制权。有了它，一个人就能让整个军队屈服，而不流一滴血。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hang on... I think I've heard of this artefact. You say it's been known by many names? Was one of them Imperium?
translation: 等等……我想我听说过这件神器。你说它有过许多名字？其中之一是不是叫帝国？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You are well informed. Perhaps then you also know that the Horn was supposedly sent far to the east, which begs the question as to how it stands before us.
translation: 你消息很灵通。那么或许你也知道号角据说被送到了遥远的东方，这就引出了一个问题：它怎么会出现在我们面前。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Because there were two.
translation: 因为有两个。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Something I discovered while tracking down Perseriya. It didn't make sense then, but it does now.
translation: 这是我在追踪佩塞里娅时发现的事情。当时说不通，但现在明白了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The one she took east was a fake. She secretly kept the real one. The intention must always have been to hide it here.
translation: 她带到东方的那个是假的。她秘密保留了真的那个。目的肯定一直是要把它藏在这里。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A clever deception, although it does raise another question. If the Frostenhorn was never here, then where is it?
translation: 一个巧妙的骗局，不过这也引出了另一个问题。如果弗洛斯坦号角从来不在这里，那它在哪里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Azzanadra. It's been a while.
translation: 阿扎纳德拉。好久不见了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hazeel. I thought I sensed someone lurking in the shadows. How long have you been here?
translation: 哈兹尔。我就感觉有人在暗处潜伏。你在这里多久了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Long enough. And in answer to your question, the Frostenhorn was destroyed.
translation: 够久了。至于你的问题，弗洛斯坦号角已经被摧毁了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Destroyed? How?
translation: 摧毁了？怎么做到的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I was hoping you might be able to enlighten us, considering you were there when it happened.
translation: 我希望能由你来为我们解惑，毕竟事情发生时你也在场。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I was?
translation: 我在场？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yes. It was during your little excursion to Ghorrock Prison.
translation: 是的。就在你去戈罗克监狱的那次小旅行期间。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Enough talk, Hazeel. We have business to attend to. The Elder Horn will be claimed in Zamorak's name.
translation: 少说废话，哈兹尔。我们还有正事要办。长老号角将以上莫拉克的名义被夺取。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Enakhra. You knew the Elder Horn was here?
translation: 伊纳克拉。你知道长老号角在这里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of course not! Do you really think we'd have left it here for so long if that were the case? We are not fools.
translation: 当然不知道！你真以为如果知道的话我们会让它留在这里这么久吗？我们可不是傻子。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Speaking of fools, I know he's here as well! Reveal yourself!
translation: 说到傻子，我知道他也在这里！现身吧！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Gladly.
translation: 乐意之至。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Were all of you just waiting for me to open this place?
translation: 你们所有人都在等我打开这个地方？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We had no choice. This vault was sealed with magics that prevented beings like ourselves from opening it.
translation: 我们别无选择。这个金库被魔法封住了，像我们这样的存在无法打开它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It didn't have to be that way, Hazeel. We had proxies available. Had you supported my plan, we'd have the Horn by now.
translation: 不一定非得这样，哈兹尔。我们有代理人可用。如果你支持我的计划，我们现在就已经拿到号角了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Unlikely. Your minion failed to recover even one of the medallions.
translation: 不太可能。你的手下连一个徽章都没能找回来。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What a surprise. Enakhra coming up with a flawed plan as usual.
translation: 真令人惊讶。伊纳克拉又提出了一个漏洞百出的计划。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Would you like me to turn you into a boneguard again, you camel-loving coward?
translation: 要我再次把你变成骸骨守卫吗，你这个爱骆驼的懦夫？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'd like to see you try. Come, Azzanadra. We can make short work of these traitors and claim the Horn for Zaros.
translation: 我倒想看看你试试。来吧，阿扎纳德拉。我们可以轻松解决这些叛徒，然后为萨洛斯夺取号角。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You Zarosians have no hope of withstanding the power of two Zamorakian Mahjarrat. The Horn is ours.
translation: 你们萨洛希安人绝无可能抵挡两位萨莫拉基安玛哈加特的力量。号角是我们的了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Two? We are not the fools you take us for, Enakhra. I can sense five Mahjarrat here, but I only see four.
translation: 两位？我们可不像你们想的那样愚蠢，伊纳克拉。我能感觉到这里有五位玛哈加特，但只看到四位。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Who are you hiding? Khazard? He always loved lurking in the shadows.
translation: 你在藏谁？卡扎德？他总是喜欢躲在暗处。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Khazard is attending to business in the North. Surely it is you who is hiding someone.
translation: 卡扎德正在北方处理事务。反倒是你，一定藏了什么人。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We do not hide like you do. We came alone.
translation: 我们不像你们那样躲躲藏藏。我们是独自来的。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But if you all came alone...
translation: 但如果你们都是独自来的……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh... hello.
translation: 哦……你好。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Sliske. I should have known.
translation: 斯利斯克。我早该知道。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Azzanadra.
translation: 阿扎纳德拉。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Serpent himself. Why are you here?
translation: 毒蛇本人。你为什么在这里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Why am I here?
translation: 我为什么在这里？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I'm here for the Horn.
translation: 嗯，我来这里是为了号角。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You think you can just take it?
translation: 你觉得你就能直接拿走？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of course. My friend here and I worked hard for it.
translation: 当然。我和我的朋友为此付出了很多努力。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm not your friend! I don't even know you!
translation: 我不是你的朋友！我根本不认识你！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No? I think you do. I think you know me better than anyone.
translation: 不认识吗？我觉得你认识。我觉得你比任何人都了解我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You and I have been friends for some time now. Don't you remember?
translation: 你和我做朋友已经有一段时间了。你不记得了吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Don't you remember how we survived the horrors of the Scar?
translation: 你不记得我们是如何在疤痕之地的恐怖中幸存下来的吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Don't you remember how we escaped Ghorrock Prison?
translation: 你不记得我们是如何逃出戈罗克监狱的吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Don't you remember how we held back the shadows of Lassar?
translation: 你不记得我们是如何抵挡拉萨尔之影的吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Don't you remember how we overcame the infected Stranglewood?
translation: 你不记得我们是如何战胜受感染的绞杀林吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You?
translation: 是你？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So... they were never real? It was all a lie? It was always just you?
translation: 所以……他们从来都不是真的？全都是谎言？自始至终都只是你？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A lie? No. They were all so real, until their lives were cut short. Their stories would have ended, but I stepped in.
translation: 谎言？不。他们都是真实的，直到他们的生命被切断。他们的故事本应结束，但我介入了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I became them and they became me. In many ways, they're the real me, far more so than the form before you now.
translation: 我成为了他们，他们也成为了我。从很多方面来说，他们才是真实的我，远比你现在面前的这个形态更真实。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You used them to manipulate me! Why?
translation: 你利用他们来操纵我！为什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He needed you to open the vault.
translation: 他需要你打开金库。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But he didn't need me to get those medallions! He already had one of them!
translation: 但他不需要我来获取那些徽章！他早就有一个了！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Were you just toying with me?
translation: 你只是在玩弄我吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Toying? No. It was a test.
translation: 玩弄？不。这是一场考验。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What test?
translation: 什么考验？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: To see if you were worthy.
translation: 为了看看你是否够资格。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of what?
translation: 够资格做什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Of me.
translation: 够资格做我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You should have contacted me, Sliske. You should have told me about the Horn.
translation: 你应该联系我的，斯利斯克。你应该告诉我号角的事。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He clearly wanted it for himself.
translation: 他显然是想自己独吞。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No, not myself. I want the Horn for all of us.
translation: 不，不是为了我自己。我希望号角为我们所有人所用。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What nonsense are you on about?
translation: 你在胡说八道些什么？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Do you not see our fate? Over and over, we have our ritual. Over and over, we doom one of our kind to the endless void.
translation: 你们难道看不到我们的命运吗？一次又一次，我们举行仪式。一次又一次，我们使我们中的一员堕入无尽的虚空。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It's all so... predictable. It's all so... tiresome. And in the end, it will be the death of us all.
translation: 这一切都太……可预测了。这一切都太……令人厌倦了。而最终，这将成为我们所有人的末日。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: But the Horn will be our salvation. I will use it to break the cycle that has shackled us for so long. We will finally be free.
translation: 但号角将是我们的救赎。我将用它打破长久以来束缚我们的循环。我们终将获得自由。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The ritual approaches once more, but things will be different this time. This will be the final Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
translation: 仪式再次临近，但这次将会不同。这将是玛哈加特的最后一次仪式。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He's finally lost it. We can take him. He's alone.
translation: 他终于疯了。我们可以对付他。他只有一个人。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm never alone.
translation: 我从不孤单。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You will not be taking that Horn, Enakhra. Not while I stand.
translation: 你拿不走那个号角的，伊纳克拉。只要我还在。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then I'll just have to kill you first!
translation: 那我就先杀了你！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Stop! You're not going anywhere with that horn!
translation: 住手！你休想带着那个号角离开！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Don't you see, [player name]? I can't stop now. Do you not see our future? Only with the Horn can we make it happen.
translation: 你还不明白吗，[player name]？我现在不能停。你看不到我们的未来吗？只有靠号角才能实现。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Whatever future you're planning, it ends here!
translation: 不管你计划什么未来，就在这里终结吧！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: End? No. This is just the beginning. In time, you will see the truth.
translation: 终结？不。这只是开始。总有一天，你会看到真相。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I doubt that!
translation: 我表示怀疑！
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Perhaps some more familiar faces will change your mind.
translation: 也许一些更熟悉的面孔会改变你的想法。
