sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You fought well, [player name]. You will be a worthy vessel.
translation: 你战斗得很好，[player name]。你将是一个值得的容器。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'll see you in the North.
translation: 我们在北方见。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We have failed.
translation: 我们失败了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'll see you at the ritual, Akthanakos. Perhaps this one will be your last.
translation: 仪式上见，阿克塔纳科斯。也许这次将是你的最后一次。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Our allies must be informed of this. Come, Azzanadra.
translation: 必须通知我们的盟友这件事。来吧，阿扎纳德拉。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It seems your pet has broken free of his leash, Azzanadra.
translation: 看来你的宠物挣脱了锁链，阿扎纳德拉。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You know as much as I that Sliske serves no one but himself. His actions are his own.
translation: 你我都知道斯利斯克只为自己服务。他的行为是他自己的选择。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Yet you have shielded him for centuries. A choice that all of us may now suffer from.
translation: 然而你庇护了他数个世纪。这个选择可能让我们所有人都付出代价。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: You can blame me as much as you wish, Hazeel. It is irrelevant. Sliske now holds the Elder Horn and we must be ready to oppose him.
translation: 你想怎么怪我都可以，哈兹尔。这无关紧要。斯利斯克现在拿着长老号角，我们必须准备好对抗他。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: We? You made your choice a long time ago, Azzanadra. There is no 'we' anymore.
translation: 我们？你很久以前就做出了选择，阿扎纳德拉。已经没有'我们'了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And yet you yourself admit that Sliske poses a threat to us all. The prospect of working with Zamorakians gives me no pleasure, but it may be the only option.
translation: 可你自己也承认斯利斯克对我们所有人都构成威胁。和萨拉多民信徒合作的前景让我毫无愉悦可言，但这恐怕是唯一的选择了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Perhaps. Perhaps not. Time will soon tell.
translation: 也许吧，也许不是。时间很快就会揭晓。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Now, we're done here. I'll see you soon, Azzanadra.
translation: 好了，我们到此为止。很快会再见的，阿扎纳德拉。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well, adventurer, it seems I owe you an apology.
translation: 嗯，冒险者，看来我欠你一个道歉。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I did not show you the trust that you deserved. You freed me from my prison, a feat even my closest followers failed to achieve, and yet I doubted you.
translation: 我没有给予你应得的信任。你把我从牢笼中解救出来，这是连我最亲近的信徒都没能完成的壮举，而我却怀疑你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I did not know your allegiance, and so I was cautious, but it is clear that focusing on allegiances has blinded us. Sliske took advantage of that.
translation: 我不知道你的忠诚归属，所以我一直很谨慎，但现在看来，过分关注阵营让我们变得盲目。斯利斯克利用了这一点。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Oh, well thank you, I suppose.
translation: 哦，好吧，我想谢谢您。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Now, I must ask about the destruction of the Frostenhorn. Sliske's doing?
translation: 现在，我必须问问霜冻号角的毁坏。是斯利斯克干的？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: It must have been.
translation: 肯定是他。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then I fear the other artefacts will have met a similar fate.
translation: 那我担心其他神器也遭遇了同样的命运。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Other artefacts?
translation: 其他神器？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: The Frostenhorn was one of three powerful items I was seeking. Together, they may have been my best chance to determine the fate of my lord.
translation: 霜冻号角是我正在寻找的三件强大物品之一。它们合在一起，也许是我决定我主命运的最佳机会。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And Sliske didn't want that?
translation: 而斯利斯克不希望那样？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Apparently not, though who could say why. I would never describe Sliske as a true believer, but until now, he always supported the Empty Lord.
translation: 显然不想，虽然没人能说清原因。我从不认为斯利斯克是真正的信徒，但直到现在，他一直支持着空之主。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Indeed, he himself was entrusted with another of the three artefacts. An icon that was kept under close guard by those wights of his.
translation: 确实，他本人还受托保管了另外三件神器中的一件。一个由他那群尸妖严密看守的图标。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah... Well unless they were guarding multiple icons, I'm afraid Sliske destroyed that one as well. As for your third artefact, it didn't happen to be on Entrana, did it?
translation: 啊……好吧，除非他们在看守多个图标，恐怕斯利斯克连那个也毁了。至于你的第三件神器，它碰巧不在恩特纳岛上吧？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I had yet to track it down, but that does seem likely. It was stolen by Saradominists long ago.
translation: 我还没追踪到它，但这似乎很有可能。它很久以前被萨拉多民信徒偷走了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Then I think it's safe to say it's been destroyed too. Sliske stole it from Entrana while disguised as that assassin.
translation: 那我敢肯定它也被毁了。斯利斯克伪装成那个刺客从恩特纳岛偷走了它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: So my worst fears are confirmed. This may well be the darkest day for us since the fall of the Empty Lord.
translation: 所以我最坏的担忧成真了。这很可能是自空之主陨落以来我们最黑暗的一天。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Since you freed me, I have been driven by a singular purpose. I exist for Zaros. I exist for the Empire. Sliske thinks he has destroyed that purpose, but I will not give up.
translation: 自从你解救了我，我一直被一个单一的目标所驱使。我为萨罗斯而活。我为帝国而活。斯利斯克以为他摧毁了那个目标，但我不会放弃。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: However, that is for another day. There are more immediate matters to concern myself with now. The Ritual of the Mahjarrat is fast approaching, and whatever Sliske is planning will happen there.
translation: 不过，那是以后的事了。现在有更紧迫的事情需要我操心。玛哈加特仪式很快就要来临，无论斯利斯克在策划什么，都会在那里发生。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I must ensure I am prepared, and while it may not have been your intention, you are part of this now. You must also ensure you are ready. To help with this, I have something to offer you.
translation: 我必须确保自己做好准备，虽然这可能不是你的本意，但你现在也是其中一部分了。你也必须确保自己准备好。为此，我有些东西要给你。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I understand you are in possession of a ring that lets you see into the Shadow Realm? Considering Sliske's mastery over that place, that is a power that will likely be of great use to you.
translation: 我听说你有一枚能让你看到阴影领域的戒指？考虑到斯利斯克对那个地方的掌控，那力量对你来说很可能大有用处。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Allow me to upgrade it with some offensive and defensive enchantments. They may well give you an important edge if you find yourself fighting in the shadows.
translation: 让我给它升级，加上一些攻击和防御附魔。如果你发现自己要在阴影中战斗，它们可能会给你重要的优势。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Thank you. Do you need me to fetch the ring for you?
translation: 谢谢你。需要我去取戒指吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: No need. I can summon it with ease.
translation: 不必。我可以轻松召唤它。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: And on that note, I must leave you, my friend. May you walk in the shadow of the Empty Lord.
translation: 至此，我必须离开了，我的朋友。愿你在空之主的阴影中行走。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hello, adventurer.
translation: 你好，冒险者。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Hello there. How are things here?
translation: 你好。这里情况如何？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Things aren't easy for the family, especially since they never got closure. They're getting through it, though.
translation: 家里日子不好过，尤其是他们从未得到过了结。不过他们正在熬过去。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I'm not sure if it will help them much, but I do have some news on that assassin.
translation: 嗯，我不确定这对他们有多大帮助，但我确实有关于那个刺客的消息。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: He was actually a Mahjarrat in disguise. I got close to dealing with him, but he escaped.
translation: 他实际上是玛哈加特伪装的。我差点就解决他了，但他逃走了。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: A Mahjarrat? I don't even know what one of those is... You say he escaped?
translation: 玛哈加特？我甚至不知道那是什么……你说他逃走了？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: For now, but I don't intend to let him keep eluding me forever.
translation: 暂时而已，但我可没打算让他永远躲着我。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Well I wish you luck in your search, adventurer. Thank you for the update.
translation: 嗯，祝你搜索顺利，冒险者。谢谢你的消息。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: About Ketla...
translation: 关于凯特拉……
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: I'm sorry, but the person I thought was Ketla... It wasn't her at all.
translation: 抱歉，但我以为的凯特拉……根本不是她。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: What? But then... what happened to her?
translation: 什么？可那……她出了什么事？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Ah! Do tell, old bean.
translation: 啊！快说说，老兄。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Did you know he was a Mahjarrat?
translation: 你知道他是玛哈加特吗？
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: While your there, it might be worth looking up something called the Elder Horn. It's an artefact that Sliske has now claimed. One that has the ability to control minds.
translation: 既然你在那里，不妨查查一个叫长老号角的东西。那是斯利斯克现在占有的神器。一件能够控制心灵的神器。
sub_category: Desert Treasure II - The Fallen Empire

english: Good day to you, adventurer.
translation: 冒险者，日安。

english: And to you. What brings you all the way out here?
translation: 你也日安。是什么风把你吹到这儿来了？

english: I am on my return journey from the dark lands of Morytania. It would be remiss of me not to stop and take in the glory of Paterdomus before my return to Entrana.
translation: 我正从莫利塔尼亚的黑暗之地返回。在返回恩特纳岛之前，若不停下来瞻仰帕特多姆斯的荣光，那便是我的失职。

english: Morytania? That's quite a dangerous place for a monk.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚？对僧侣来说，那地方相当危险。

english: Indeed, but as a faithful servant of Saradomin, it is my duty to confront the taint of Zamorak, wherever it may be found. Violence is to be abhorred, but at times it is an unfortunate necessity.
translation: 确实，但作为萨拉多明的忠实仆从，我有责任对抗扎莫拉克的污秽，无论它出现在何处。暴力固然可憎，但有时却是无奈之举。

english: I see. Well I'd better leave you to it.
translation: 我明白了。那我就不打扰你了。

english: Before you depart, adventurer, I was wondering if you might be interested in helping me with something?
translation: 在你离开之前，冒险者，我想知道你是否愿意帮我一个忙？

english: Did you reconsider my request? I'd be very grateful if you'd be able to help me with something.
translation: 你重新考虑我的请求了吗？如果你能帮我一个忙，我会非常感激。

english: On my travels in Morytania, I encountered an individual from the lands to the far east. He spoke of a weapon from his homeland that I think would be very valuable in our fight against the darkness.
translation: 在莫利塔尼亚的旅途中，我遇到一个来自遥远东方的人。他提到一种他家乡的武器，我认为它在我们对抗黑暗的战斗中会非常有价值。

english: If you could help me build one of these weapons, you would be highly rewarded by the Church of Saradomin.
translation: 如果你能帮我打造一把这种武器，萨拉多明教会会重重酬谢你。

english: A new weapon? Interesting!
translation: 新武器？有意思！

english: Yes, now pay attention. I need you to take a two-handed mithril sword and grind it down to a slender blade. I know of a dwarf living north of Falador whose whetstone is unmatchable. It will be perfect for this task.
translation: 是的，现在听好了。我需要你拿一把双手秘银剑，把它磨成细长刀刃。我知道法拉多城北边住着一个矮人，他的磨刀石无与伦比，用来做这个正合适。

english: Once the blade is flexible enough, you should then be able to string it with a normal bow string. That is all you need to do.
translation: 一旦刀片足够柔韧，你应该就能用普通的弓弦给它上弦了。你需要做的就这些。

english: Alright, I'll be back once I have this weapon.
translation: 好的，等我拿到这把武器就回来。

english: Ah, well do come and see me if you change your mind.
translation: 啊，如果你改变主意，随时可以来找我。

english: Hello again, adventurer. Have you brought the weapon for me?
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。你把武器带来了吗？

english: Remember, you need to take a two-handed mithril sword and grind it down to a slender blade. There is a dwarf living north of Falador whose whetstone will be perfect for this.
translation: 记住，你需要拿一把双手秘银剑，把它磨成细长刀刃。法拉多城北边住着一个矮人，他的磨刀石用来做这个正合适。

english: I have it right here for you.
translation: 我这就给你。

english: Excellent! Your help won't be forgotten.
translation: 太好了！你的帮助我不会忘记的。

english: Now, I think it's high time for me to make my return to Entrana. There is a special ceremony taking place soon, and to miss it would fill me with regret.
translation: 现在，我想是时候返回恩特纳岛了。那里很快会举行一场特别的仪式，错过的话我会非常遗憾。

english: On that note, there might be something else you can help me with...
translation: 说到这个，也许你还能帮我另一个忙……

english: I have a special gift I wish to present at the ceremony. It's one that I know my fellow monks will appreciate. As such, it feels only right that a special gift is delivered in a special way.
translation: 我有一份特别的礼物想在仪式上献上。我知道我的僧侣同伴们一定会喜欢。因此，我觉得这份特别的礼物应该用特别的方式送达。

english: I would like my companions to enter the ceremony with no knowledge of the gift. It will then make for a joyous surprise for them. However, to do that, it must be smuggled onto the island.
translation: 我希望我的同伴们在进入仪式时对礼物毫不知情。这样对他们来说会是一个惊喜。但要做到这一点，就必须把礼物偷偷运上岛。

english: Smuggled? Sounds a bit shifty.
translation: 偷运？听起来有点可疑。

english: I confess, to do so would not quite be in keeping with our rules, but for such a wonderful gift, the opportunity can't be disregarded.
translation: 我承认，这样做不太符合我们的规矩，但为了这么棒的礼物，这个机会不能错过。

english: Hmm... Fair enough. So you want me to sneak this gift onto the island? How do I do that?
translation: 嗯……说得有道理。所以你想让我把这份礼物偷偷带上岛？我该怎么做？

english: Our island is home to the Runic Altar of Law. Recently, I have heard whispers of a way to access these altars via another realm.
translation: 我们岛上有一座律法符石祭坛。最近，我听到一些传言，说可以通过另一个领域进入这些祭坛。

english: You speak of the Abyss. I'm familiar with it.
translation: 你说的是深渊。我听说过。

english: Excellent! In that case, please take this orb and journey through this 'Abyss' to the island of Entrana. Please do keep the orb safe though, for it is highly delicate.
translation: 太好了！既然如此，请拿着这颗宝珠，穿过这个‘深渊’前往恩特纳岛。不过请务必保管好宝珠，它非常脆弱。

english: The Abyss isn't exactly the safest of places.
translation: 深渊可不是什么安全的地方。

english: The same voices that whispered of this 'Abyss' also spoke of pouches used to store runes. I'm sure a large one of those would be suitable.
translation: 那些提到这个‘深渊’的传言也提到了用来储存符石的袋子。我相信一个大号的袋子应该够用。

english: Alright, I'll get that done.
translation: 好的，我会办妥的。

english: Wonderful! Here is the orb. Once you arrive, just place it on the altar in Entrana's church.
translation: 太好了！这是宝珠。等你到了，就把它放在恩特纳岛教堂的祭坛上。

english: Hello again. You need to hurry or you'll miss the ceremony.
translation: 又见面了。你得快点，不然就赶不上仪式了。

english: How am I meant to get there again?
translation: 我该怎么去那里来着？

english: Use this 'Abyss' you spoke of to travel to the Runic Altar of Law. When doing so, make sure to put the orb in a large rune pouch to keep it safe.
translation: 用你提到的这个‘深渊’前往律法符石祭坛。去的时候，记得把宝珠放在大符石袋里以确保安全。

english: Once you arrive, just place the orb on the altar in Entrana's church.
translation: 等你到了，就把宝珠放在恩特纳岛教堂的祭坛上。

english: Er... I lost the orb...
translation: 呃……我把宝珠弄丢了……

english: You're very lucky that I found it. Please be more careful with it this time.
translation: 你运气很好，我找到了。这次请小心保管。

english: Protect the relic!
translation: 保护遗物！

english: You won't have it!
translation: 你休想得逞！

english: The relic! This is a disaster!
translation: 遗物！这简直是灾难！

english: Adventurer, did you see who put that teleport beacon on the altar?
translation: 冒险者，你看到是谁把那个传送信标放在祭坛上的吗？

english: Uh... yeah, about that...
translation: 呃……这个嘛……

english: I put it there...
translation: 是我放的……

english: There was this monk near Paterdomus. He told me it was a gift...
translation: 帕特多姆斯附近有个僧侣。他告诉我那是个礼物……

english: No worshipper of Saradomin would ever do something like this! Adventurer, you must return to Paterdomus and see if you can find any trace of this 'monk'.
translation: 没有哪个萨拉多明的信徒会做出这种事！冒险者，你必须回到帕特多姆斯，看看能不能找到这个‘僧侣’的踪迹。

english: I'll go right away.
translation: 我马上去。

english: Adventurer, have you found that 'monk' yet?
translation: 冒险者，你找到那个‘僧侣’了吗？

english: Please hurry to Paterdomus and see if you can find any trace of him.
translation: 请赶快去帕特多姆斯，看看能不能找到他的任何踪迹。

english: This isn't good. I'd better get back and tell the High Priest.
translation: 情况不妙。我最好回去告诉大祭司。

english: I went back to Paterdomus, but all I found was a dead body.
translation: 我回到了帕特多姆斯，但只发现了一具尸体。

english: It looked like he'd been killed by magic. The thing is, I'm not convinced he was the person I spoke to before.
translation: 看起来他是被魔法杀死的。问题是，我不确定他是不是我之前交谈的那个人。

english: This is not good. That relic wasn't just for show! It was once part of a powerful artefact. You must report this to Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador Park.
translation: 这可不妙。那个遗物不只是摆设！它曾经是一件强大神器的一部分。你必须向法拉多公园的蒂菲.卡申爵士报告此事。

english: I'll head there right away.
translation: 我马上就去。

english: Jolly good show on getting into the White Knights, what?
translation: 加入白骑士团干得不错嘛，对吧？

english: Now how can I help you old [boy/girl/bean]?
translation: 那么，老[boy/girl/bean]，我能帮你什么忙？

english: I've got some bad news...
translation: 我有坏消息要告诉你……

english: This wouldn't be about that old relic being stolen from Entrana, would it?
translation: 这不会是关于那个从恩特纳岛被偷走的古老遗物吧？

english: Uh... yeah, how'd you know?
translation: 呃……是啊，你怎么知道的？

english: Part of the business, old bean. So what do you know about what went on?
translation: 干这行的一部分，老伙计。那么，你知道发生了什么吗？

english: Well there was this monk who needed help...
translation: 嗯，有个僧侣需要帮助……

english: ... and so I was told to come see you.
translation: ……然后有人让我来找你。

english: Good, that confirms our own intel. We will get to work at once.
translation: 很好，这证实了我们自己的情报。我们会立刻开始行动。

english: Not yet, but we'll be in touch if we need you, old bean. For now, you should be on your way, but don't worry, we'll get to the bottom of this!
translation: 暂时还没有，但如果需要你，我们会联系你的，老伙计。现在你可以走了，不过别担心，我们会查个水落石出的！

english: But I'm not a good enough miner to get iron ore.
translation: 但我不是个够格的矿工，挖不到铁矿石。

english: Oh well, you could practice mining until you can. Can't beat a bit of mining - it's a useful skill. Failing that, you might be able to find a more experienced adventurer to buy the iron ore off.
translation: 哦，这样啊，你可以练习采矿直到能挖到为止。采矿是个有用的技能，没什么比得上它。如果不行，你也许可以找个更有经验的冒险者买铁矿石。

english: Have you got my materials yet, traveller?
translation: 旅行者，你拿到我的材料了吗？

english: Sorry, I don't have them all yet.
translation: 抱歉，我还没全部拿到。

english: Not to worry, stick at it. Remember, I need 6 clay, 4 copper ore, and 2 iron ore.
translation: 别着急，慢慢来。记住，我需要6块粘土、4块铜矿石和2块铁矿石。

english: I have everything you need!
translation: 我拿到你需要的所有东西了！

english: Many thanks! Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils any time you want.
translation: 多谢！请把它们递过来。我可以给你一些金币作为酬劳，而且我的铁砧你随时都可以用。

english: Sorry, but I've got a running order with Nurmof.
translation: 抱歉，但我跟努莫夫有订单要处理。

english: Many thanks. Pass them here, please. I can spare you some coins for your trouble, and please use my anvils anytime you want.
translation: 多谢。请把它们递过来。我可以给你一些金币作为酬劳，而且我的铁砧你随时都可以用。

english: I make pickaxes. I am the best maker of pickaxes in the whole of Zaros.
translation: 我制作镐子。我是整个扎罗斯地区最好的镐子工匠。

english: Can I have a quest?
translation: 能给我一个任务吗？

english: Yes! A mighty and perilous quest fit only for the most powerful champions! And, at the end of it, you will earn the right to wear the legendary rune platebody!
translation: 当然！一个伟大而危险的任务，只适合最强大的冠军！完成之后，你将获得穿戴传奇符文胸甲的权利！

english: So, what is this quest?
translation: 那么，这个任务是什么？

english: You'll have to speak to Oziach, the maker of rune armour. He sets the quests that champions must complete in order to wear it.
translation: 你得去找符文盔甲的制造者奥扎克谈谈。他设定了冠军们为了穿戴它必须完成的任务。

english: Oziach lives in a hut, by the cliffs to the west of Edgeville. He can be a little...odd...sometimes, though.
translation: 奥扎克住在边陲镇西边悬崖旁的一间小屋里。不过他有时候会有点……古怪。

english: Actually, I'll give it a miss.
translation: 算了，我还是不去了。

english: You're already on a quest for me, if I recall correctly. Have you talked to Oziach yet?
translation: 如果我没记错的话，你已经在为我执行一个任务了。你跟奥扎克谈过了吗？

english: Well, he's the only one who can grant you the right to wear rune platemail. He lives in a hut, by the cliffs west of Edgeville.
translation: 嗯，他是唯一能授予你穿戴符文胸甲权利的人。他住在边陲镇西边悬崖旁的一间小屋里。

english: Okay, I'll go and talk to him.
translation: 好的，我去找他谈谈。

english: Can you sell me a rune platebody?
translation: 你能卖给我一件符文胸甲吗？

english: So, how does thee know I 'ave some?
translation: 那么，你咋知道我有？

english: The Guildmaster of the Champions' Guild told me.
translation: 冠军公会的公会会长告诉我的。

english: Yes, I suppose he would, wouldn't he? He's always sending you fancy-pants 'heroes' up to bother me. Telling me I'll give them a quest or sommat like that.
translation: 是啊，我猜他肯定会，对吧？他总是派你们这些花里胡哨的‘英雄’来烦我，跟我说我会给他们任务什么的。

english: Well, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So, leave me alone.
translation: 哼，我可不会让随便什么人都穿我的符文胸甲。只有英雄才能穿。所以，别来烦我。

english: I thought you were going to give me a quest.
translation: 我以为你会给我一个任务。

english: All right, I'll give ye a quest. I'll let ye wear my rune platemail if ye...
translation: 好吧，我给你个任务。如果你……我就让你穿我的符文胸甲。

english: Slay the dragon of Crandor!
translation: 杀死克兰多尔的巨龙！

english: A dragon, that sounds like fun!
translation: 一条龙，听起来挺有意思！

english: Hah, yes, you are a typical reckless adventurer, aren't you? Now go kill the dragon and get out of my face.
translation: 哈，没错，你真是个典型的鲁莽冒险者，对吧？现在去杀龙吧，别在我眼前晃了。

english: But how can I defeat the dragon?
translation: 但我怎么才能打败那条龙呢？

english: Go talk to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. He'll help ye out if yer so keen on doing a quest. I'm not going to be handholding any adventurers.
translation: 去找冠军公会的公会会长谈谈。如果你这么想做任务，他会帮你的。我可不会手把手教任何冒险者。

english: I may be a champion, but I don't think I'm up to dragon-killing yet.
translation: 我或许是个冠军，但我觉得自己还不足以去杀龙。

english: Yes, I can understand that. Yer a coward.
translation: 嗯，我能理解。你是个懦夫。

english: That's a pity, I'm not a hero.
translation: 真可惜，我不是英雄。

english: Aye, I ken tell!
translation: 啊，我看得出来！

english: I am a master detective.
translation: 我可是个侦探大师。

english: I solved the Sinclair murder mystery by myself!
translation: 我独自破解了辛克莱尔庄园的谋杀之谜！

english: Never 'eard of yer.
translation: 从没听说过你。

english: Well, however you found out about it, I'm not going to let just anyone wear my rune platemail. It's only for heroes. So leave me alone.
translation: 好吧，不管你是怎么知道的，我可不会让随便什么人都穿我的符文胸甲。只有英雄才能穿。所以别来烦我。

english: Have ye slayed that dragon yet?
translation: 你杀了那条龙没？

english: Be off with ye then.
translation: 那就滚吧。

english: I talked to Oziach and he gave me a quest.
translation: 我跟奥扎克谈过了，他给了我一个任务。

english: Oh? What did he tell you to do?
translation: 哦？他让你做什么？

english: Defeat the dragon of Crandor.
translation: 击败克兰多尔的巨龙。

english: The dragon of Crandor?
translation: 克兰多尔的巨龙？

english: Um, yes...
translation: 呃，是的……

english: Goodness, he hasn't given you an easy job, has he?
translation: 天哪，他可没给你一个轻松的差事，对吧？

english: What's so special about this dragon?
translation: 这条龙有什么特别的？

english: Thirty years ago, Crandor was a thriving community with a great tradition of mages and adventurers. Many Crandorians even earned the right to be part of the Champions' Guild!
translation: 三十年前，克兰多尔是一个繁荣的社区，有着悠久的魔法师和冒险者传统。许多克兰多尔人甚至赢得了加入冠军公会的权利！

english: One of their adventurers went too far, however. He descended into the volcano in the centre of Crandor and woke the dragon Elvarg.
translation: 然而，他们中的一个冒险者做得太过分了。他下到克兰多尔中心的火山中，唤醒了巨龙艾尔瓦格。

english: He must have fought valiantly against the dragon because they say that, to this day, she has a scar down her side,
translation: 他一定与巨龙英勇战斗过，因为据说直到今天，她身侧还有一道伤疤，

english: but the dragon still won the fight. She emerged and laid waste to the whole of Crandor with her fire breath!
translation: 但巨龙还是赢得了战斗。她现身并用火焰吐息将整个克兰多尔夷为平地！

english: Some refugees managed to escape in fishing boats. They landed on the coast, north of Rimmington, and set up camp but the dragon followed them and burned the camp to the ground.
translation: 一些难民乘渔船逃脱了。他们登上了里明顿村北边的海岸，搭起了营地，但那条龙跟了过去，将营地烧成了灰烬。

english: Out of all the people of Crandor there were only three survivors: a trio of wizards who used magic to escape. Their names were Thalzar, Lozar and Melzar.
translation: 在所有克兰多尔人中，只有三个幸存者：三位用魔法逃脱的魔法师。他们的名字是萨尔扎、洛扎和梅尔扎。

english: If you're serious about taking on Elvarg, first you'll need to get to Crandor, and to my knowledge, the only way to do that is by sea.
translation: 如果你真的想对付艾尔瓦格，首先你得去克兰多尔，据我所知，唯一的方法就是走海路。

english: So I just sail over there? Seems easy enough.
translation: 那我直接开船过去就行了？听起来挺简单的。

english: If only that were true. The island is surrounded by dangerous underwater reefs. You'll need a map to guide you through them and a ship capable of doing so.
translation: 要是那么简单就好了。岛屿周围环绕着危险的水下暗礁。你需要一张地图来指引你穿过它们，还需要一艘能胜任的船。

english: And then of course there's the dragon herself. Once you reach Crandor, you'll need some kind of protection against her breath.
translation: 当然还有巨龙本身。一旦你到达克兰多尔，你需要某种防护来抵御她的吐息。

english: Where can I find a map to Crandor?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到去克兰多尔的地图？

english: After what happened, people were afraid of enraging the dragon. Most maps to the island were destroyed, but I have heard that one survived. It was held by Melzar, Thalzar and Lozar.
translation: 在那件事之后，人们害怕激怒巨龙。大多数去那座岛的地图都被销毁了，但我听说有一张幸存了下来。它由梅尔扎、萨尔扎和洛扎保管。

english: However, the three apparently split the map into three pieces, which each of them taking one piece.
translation: 然而，那三个人显然把地图分成了三份，每人拿了一份。

english: Where is Melzar's map piece?
translation: 梅尔扎的地图碎片在哪里？

english: Melzar built a castle on the site of the Crandorian refugee camp, north of Rimmington. He's locked himself in there and no one's seen him for years.
translation: 梅尔扎在里明顿村北边的克兰多尔难民营地原址上建了一座城堡。他把自己锁在里面，好几年没人见过他了。

english: The inside of his castle is like a maze, and is populated by undead monsters. Maybe, if you could get all the way through the maze, you could find his piece of the map.
translation: 他的城堡内部像个迷宫，里面充满了不死怪物。也许，如果你能一路穿过迷宫，就能找到他那份地图碎片。

english: Adventurers sometimes go in there to prove themselves, so I can give you this key to Melzar's Maze.
translation: 冒险者有时会进去证明自己，所以我可以给你这把梅尔扎迷宫的钥匙。

english: Where is Thalzar's map piece?
translation: 萨尔扎的地图碎片在哪里？

english: Thalzar was the most paranoid of the three wizards. He hid his map piece and took the secret of its location to his grave.
translation: 萨尔扎是三位魔法师中最偏执的一个。他把自己的地图碎片藏了起来，并把位置的秘密带进了坟墓。

english: I don't think you'd be able to find out where it is by ordinary means. You'll need to talk to the Oracle on Ice Mountain.
translation: 我觉得你没法用普通方法找到它在哪里。你得去冰山找神谕者谈谈。

english: Where is Lozar's map piece?
translation: 洛扎的地图碎片在哪里？

english: A few weeks ago, I'd have told you to speak to Lozar herself, in her house across the river from Lumbridge.
translation: 几周前，我还会让你去找洛扎本人，她住在仑桥镇河对岸的房子里。

english: Unfortunately, goblin raiders killed her and stole everything. One of the goblins from the Goblin Village probably has the map piece now.
translation: 不幸的是，哥布林袭击者杀了她，偷走了所有东西。现在哥布林村庄里的某个哥布林可能拿着那块地图碎片。

english: What kind of ship do I need?
translation: 我需要什么样的船？

english: Quite a specific one I'm afraid. Even with a map, very few ships will be able to navigate the reefs around the island. You're going to need one of Crandorian design.
translation: 恐怕是相当特殊的一种。即使有地图，也很少有船能在岛屿周围的暗礁中航行。你需要一艘克兰多尔设计的船。

english: If there's still one in existence, it's probably in Port Sarim. However, a ship will also need a captain, and I'm not sure where you'd find one willing to sail to Crandor!
translation: 如果还有一艘存在的话，它很可能在沙林港。不过，船还需要一位船长，而且我不确定你到哪里能找到愿意航行去克兰多尔的人！

english: Could I not just captain it myself? I have some experience in that area.
translation: 我不能自己当船长吗？我在那方面有些经验。

english: I suppose you could, but given you have a dragon to be dealing with, I'd suggest getting someone else to worry about the captaining for you.
translation: 我想你可以，但考虑到你要对付一条龙，我建议你找别人来替你操心掌舵的事。

english: How can I protect myself from the dragon's breath?
translation: 我怎样才能保护自己免受龙息伤害？

english: That part shouldn't be too difficult, actually. I believe the Duke of Lumbridge has a special shield in his armoury that is enchanted against dragon's breath.
translation: 实际上，那部分应该不会太难。我相信仑桥镇公爵的军械库里有一面特殊的盾牌，附有抵御龙息的魔法。

english: Okay, I'll get going!
translation: 好的，我这就出发！

english: About my quest to kill the dragon...
translation: 关于我杀龙的任务……

english: I seek a piece of the map to the island of Crandor.
translation: 我在找一张去克兰多尔岛的地图碎片。

english: The map's behind a door below, but entering is rather tough. This is what you need to know: You must use the following stuff.
translation: 地图在下面一扇门后面，但进去相当困难。你需要知道这些：你必须使用以下神秘物质。

english: First, a drink used by a mage. Next, some worm string, changed to sheet. Then, a small crustacean cage. Last, a bowl that's not seen heat.
translation: 首先，一位魔法师用过的饮品。其次，一些蠕虫线，变成片状。然后，一个小型甲壳类笼子。最后，一个没见过热量的碗。

english: I've heard that one of your number has got hold of part of a map.
translation: 我听说你们中的一个人拿到了一张地图的一部分。

english: Aha, that'd be Wormbrain.
translation: 啊哈，那肯定是虫脑。

english: Where would he be?
translation: 他在哪里？

english: Wormbrain steals too much. He got caught. Now he lives in Port Sarim town jail.
translation: 虫脑偷得太多了。他被抓了。现在他住在沙林港镇监狱里。

english: I believe you've got piece of a map that I need.
translation: 我相信你有一块我需要的地图碎片。

english: So? Why should I be giving it to you? What you do for Wormbrain?
translation: 所以呢？我凭什么给你？你为虫脑做了什么？

english: I'm not going to do anything for you. Forget it.
translation: 我不会为你做任何事。算了吧。

english: Be dat way then.
translation: 那就这样吧。

english: I'll let you live. I could just kill you.
translation: 我饶你一命。我本可以杀了你。

english: Ha! Me in here and you out dere. You not get map piece.
translation: 哈！我在这儿，你在外面。你拿不到地图碎片。

english: I suppose I could pay you for the map piece. Say, 500 coins?
translation: 我想我可以付钱买这块地图碎片。比如，500金币？

english: Me not stoopid, it worth at least 10,000 coins!
translation: 俺不傻，它至少值10,000金币！

english: You must be joking! Forget it.
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑！算了。

english: Fine, you not get map piece.
translation: 好吧，你拿不到地图碎片。

english: Alright then, 10,000 coins it is.
translation: 好吧，那就10,000金币。

english: Oops, I don't have enough on me.
translation: 哎呀，我身上没带够钱。

english: Comes back when you has enough.
translation: 等你带够了再来。

english: Fank you very much! Now me can bribe da guards, hehehe.
translation: 非常感谢！现在俺可以贿赂守卫了，嘿嘿嘿。

english: Where did you get the map piece from?
translation: 你从哪里弄到这块地图碎片的？

english: We rob house of stupid wizard. She very old, not put up much fight at all. Hahaha!
translation: 我们抢了那个蠢魔法师的房子。她太老了，根本没怎么反抗。哈哈哈！

english: Uh... Hahaha.
translation: 呃……哈哈哈。

english: Her house full of pictures of a city on island and old pictures of people. Me not recognise island.
translation: 她房子里全是岛上城市的画和旧人物画。俺认不出那个岛。

english: Me find map piece. Me not know what it is, but it in locked box so me figure it important.
translation: 我找到地图碎片。我不知道那是什么，但它在上锁的箱子里，所以我猜很重要。

english: But, by the time me get box open, other goblins gone. Then me not run fast enough and guards catch me.
translation: 但等我打开箱子，其他哥布林已经走了。然后我跑得不够快，被守卫抓住了。

english: But now you want map piece so must be special! What you do for me to get it?
translation: 但现在你想要地图碎片，那它一定很特别！你为俺做什么才能得到它？

english: You stupid human, you not have enough inventory space.
translation: 你这个愚蠢的人类，你没有足够的背包空间。

english: Hello there! Interested in buying this fine ship? I'm sure I can offer her to you for a much better price than any of those shipwrights ask for!
translation: 你好！有兴趣买这艘好船吗？我保证我能给你一个比那些造船匠要价便宜得多的价格！

english: A much better price? What's the catch?
translation: 便宜得多？有什么陷阱？

english: Well, she's not quite seaworthy right now...
translation: 嗯，她现在还不能出海……

english: Not seaworthy? Why would I want to buy her then?
translation: 不能出海？那我为什么要买她？

english: Because this isn't just any ship! This is the Lady Lumbridge, one of the last Crandorian ships! Despite her size, she's one of the most agile shiparound!
translation: 因为这可不是普通的船！这是仑桥女士号，克兰多尔最后一批船只之一！尽管体型不大，它却是最灵活的船只之一！

english: Except she's not seaworthy...
translation: 但她不能出海……

english: No, but a bit of work will quickly sort that out!
translation: 没错，但稍微修整一下就能搞定！

english: I'd like to buy her.
translation: 我想买下她。

english: Of course! I'm sure the work needed to do on it wouldn't be too expensive.
translation: 当然！我相信要修好她花不了多少钱。

english: How does 2,000 gold sound? I'll even throw in my cabin boy, Jenkins, for free! He'll swab the decks and splice the mainsails for you!
translation: 两千金币怎么样？我甚至免费附赠我的船舱侍应，詹金斯！他会帮你擦甲板、接主帆！

english: Yep, sounds good.
translation: 嗯，听起来不错。

english: ...except I don't have that kind of money on me...
translation: ……只是我身上没带那么多钱……

english: Okey-dokey! She's all yours!
translation: 好嘞！她归你了！

english: I'm not paying that much for a broken boat!
translation: 我可不会花那么多钱买一艘破损的船！

english: That's fair enough, I suppose.
translation: 我想这也很合理。

english: Why is she damaged?
translation: 她为什么坏了？

english: Oh, there was no particular accident, just years of wear and tear. It's been a long time since Crandor was destroyed and she's had several owners since then. Unfortunately, not all of them looked after her.
translation: 哦，没什么特别的事故，就是多年的磨损。克兰多被毁已经很久了，她换过好几个主人。可惜不是每个人都好好照顾她。

english: Hello, captain! Here to inspect your new ship? Just a little work and she'll be seaworthy again.
translation: 你好，船长！来检查你的新船吗？只要稍微修整一下，她就能重新出海了。

english: So, what needs fixing on this ship?
translation: 那么，这艘船需要修哪里？

english: Well, the big gaping hole in the hold is the problem. You'll need a few wooden planks hammered in with steel nails to fix it.
translation: 嗯，货舱里那个大洞是个问题。你需要用钢钉把几块木板钉进去才能修好。

english: I dunno. It looks fine to me.
translation: 我不知道，我觉得看起来挺好的。

english: But you said it needed fix-
translation: 但你说过需要修——

english: Yes, but that was before you fixed it!
translation: 是啊，但那是在你修好之前！

english: So would you like to sail this ship to Crandor for me?
translation: 那么，你愿意帮我开这艘船去克兰多吗？

english: Crandor? You're joking, right?
translation: 克兰多？你在开玩笑吧？

english: Yes. Ha ha ha!
translation: 是啊。哈哈哈！

english: Crandor's not something we sailors joke about. You can't sail from here to Catherby, or Entrana, or Ardougne without going past that accursed island.
translation: 克兰多可不是我们水手开玩笑的事。从这儿去凯瑟比镇、恩特纳岛或阿多尼城，都得经过那座该死的岛。

english: You can't get close to it because of the reefs, but you can always see it.
translation: 因为暗礁，你没法靠近它，但总能看见它。

english: Sometimes you can see a dark shape in the sky, circling the island. That's when you have to sail on as quick as you can and pray it's not hungry. Every year, more ships are lost to that dragon.
translation: 有时你能看到天空中有一个黑影，绕着那座岛盘旋。那时你就得尽快驶离，祈祷它不饿。每年都有更多船只葬身在那条龙的口中。

english: No. I want to go to Crandor.
translation: 不。我要去克兰多。

english: Then you must be crazy.
translation: 那你一定是疯了。

english: That island is surrounded by reefs that would rip this ship to shreds. Even if you found a map, you'd need an experienced captain to stand a chance of getting through
translation: 那座岛周围全是暗礁，能把这艘船撕成碎片。就算你找到了地图，也需要一位经验丰富的船长才有机会穿过去。

english: and, even if I could get to it, there's no way I'm going any closer to that dragon than I have to. They say it can destroy whole ships with one bite.
translation: 而且，就算我能到那儿，我也绝不会靠近那条龙一步。据说它一口就能毁掉整艘船。

english: What are you going to do now you don't have a ship?
translation: 你现在没船了，打算怎么办？

english: Oh, I'll be fine. I've got work as Port Sarim's first lifeguard!
translation: 哦，我没事。我在沙林港找到了第一救生员的工作！

english: Can I board the ship now?
translation: 我现在可以上船吗？

english: Sure thing, she's all yours.
translation: 当然，她归你了。

english: Ahoy! What d'ye think of yer ship then?
translation: 嘿！你觉得你的船怎么样？

english: I'm ready to go back on shore.
translation: 我准备好回岸上了。

english: I'd like to inspect her some more.
translation: 我想再检查一下她。

english: Can you sail this ship to Crandor?
translation: 你能开这艘船去克兰多吗？

english: Not me, sir! I'm just an 'umble cabin boy. You'll need a proper cap'n.
translation: 我不行，先生！我只是个卑微的船舱侍应。你需要一位真正的船长。

english: Where can I find a captain?
translation: 我在哪里能找到船长？

english: The cap'ns round 'ere seem to be a mite scared of Crandor. I ask 'em why and they just say it was afore my time,
translation: 这附近的船长似乎都有点怕克兰多。我问他们为什么，他们只说那是在我出生之前的事。

english: but there is one cap'n I reckon might 'elp. I 'eard there's a retired 'un who lives in Draynor Village who's so desperate to sail again 'e'd take any job.
translation: 但我觉得有一位船长可能会帮忙。我听说有个退休的住在德雷诺村，他太想再次出海了，什么活都愿意接。

english: I can't remember 'is name, but 'e lives in Draynor Village an' makes rope.
translation: 我不记得他的名字了，但他住在德雷诺村，做绳子。

english: Hello there. Are you in need of planks or construction supplies?
translation: 你好。你需要木板或建筑补给品吗？

english: As it so happens, I do need some wooden planks!
translation: 巧了，我确实需要一些木板！

english: Fortunately for you, you've come to the right place!
translation: 算你走运，你来对地方了！

english: Less fortunately for you, I'm on a legally mandated break right now.
translation: 但不太走运的是，我现在正在法定强制休息时间。

english: Could you make an exception? I need the planks to go and fight a dragon.
translation: 你能破个例吗？我需要木板去杀一条龙。

english: A dragon? How are planks going to help you with that?
translation: 一条龙？木板怎么能帮到你？

english: I'm repairing a boat to sail to Crandor so that I can slay Elvarg.
translation: 我在修一艘船，要开到克兰多去，这样我就能杀死艾尔瓦格。

english: Crandor? Elvarg? Well, far be it from me to stop you trying.
translation: 克兰多？艾尔瓦格？好吧，我可不想拦着你尝试。

english: So you'll make some planks for me?
translation: 那你会帮我做木板吗？

english: I will, but I can't make you too many. It'll be just my luck if King Roald decides to audit this place and I've been making planks off the clock.
translation: 我会的，但我不能给你做太多。要是罗尔德国王决定来查账，而我却在下班时间做木板，那就倒霉了。

english: What do you need from me to make some planks?
translation: 做木板需要我提供什么？

english: Unfortunately I can't make any more planks for you without drawing attention to myself. You're going to have to source them elsewhere.
translation: 可惜我不能再给你做木板了，否则会引人注意。你得去别处找了。

english: You'll have to provide the logs and 100 coins for each plank. Just basic logs will do for what you need.
translation: 每块木板你需要提供原木和100金币。你需要的只是普通原木就行。

english: As a reminder, I can't make you very many without risking an audit, so I'll have to stop at nine planks.
translation: 提醒一下，我不能给你做太多，否则有被查账的风险，所以我最多只能做到九块木板。

english: Those planks cost 100 coins. You don't have enough money for all of them.
translation: 那些木板每块要100金币。你的钱不够买全部。

english: Can you help me get to Crandor Island?
translation: 你能帮我去克兰多岛吗？

english: Arrr, matey, ye canna be serious! That be the home of Elvarg the Dragon!
translation: 啊，伙计，你不是认真的吧！那可是龙艾尔瓦格的老巢！

english: Yes, that's right. I 've got to go there and kill the dragon for this quest I'm doing.
translation: 是的，没错。我得去那里杀了那条龙，完成我正在做的这个任务。

english: I canna help ye. And right sorry I be to see a fine young [laddie/lassie/'un] like yerself go off to yer doom.
translation: 我帮不了你。看到像你这样优秀的年轻人去送死，我真是难过。

english: Thanks, but I'll be fine!
translation: 谢谢，但我会没事的！

english: Arrr...
Crandor Island, ye say?
translation: 克兰多岛，你说？

english: Arrr, keep yeself away from that accursed place if ye values yer skin!
translation: 啊，如果你珍惜自己的小命，就离那个该死的地方远点！

english: So that's a 'No', then?
translation: 那就是‘不行’了？

english: Aye, that it be.
translation: 是啊，就是这样。

english: Do you know anyone who would take me there?
translation: 你知道有谁愿意带我去吗？

english: No, I don't know many idiots. Except for young Ben there.
translation: 不，我不认识多少傻瓜。除了那边那个小本。

english: Arrr, get away with ye, ye scurvy scallywag!
translation: 啊，滚开，你这个卑鄙的无赖！

english: Okay, thanks anyway.
translation: 好吧，还是谢谢你。

english: Arrr, ye may be wanting to go to Crandor Island now, but if ye gets there, ye'll be a-wantin' to get off it again quickly enough!
translation: 啊，你现在可能想去克兰多岛，但如果你到了那儿，你很快就会想离开的！

english: [Aye, laddie/Aye, lassie/Aye], that it is.
translation: [Aye, laddie/Aye, lassie/Aye]，就是这样。

english: There's only one sailor alive daft enough to go there. Old Ned, the ropemaker in Draynor Village. I can't think of any other fools just now. Except for old Jack Seagull there.
translation: 只有一个活着的傻瓜水手会去那里。老内德，德雷诺村的制绳匠。我现在想不出其他傻瓜了。除了那边那个老杰克.海鸥。

english: Arrr, who are ye calling old?
translation: 啊，你说谁老呢？

english: I'd rather go to Crandor.
translation: 我宁愿去克兰多。

english: Crandor? No chance! You may have a death wish, but we don't!
translation: 克兰多？没门！你可能有寻死的念头，但我们没有！

english: [Certainly sir/Certainly madam/Certainly]. Where would you like to go?
translation: [Certainly sir/Certainly madam/Certainly]。你想去哪里？

english: Crandor? Are you crazy? No charter ship would take you to that island. You'd need to use your own ship, but even then, you'd need a miracle to find a safe route there!
translation: 克兰多？你疯了吗？没有包船会带你去那个岛。你得用自己的船，但即便如此，你也需要奇迹才能找到一条安全路线！

english: Certainly madam. Where would you like to go?
translation: 当然可以，女士。您想去哪里？

english: We run ships from Port Phasmatys over to Port Tyras, stopping at Port Sarim, Catherby, Brimhaven, Musa Point, the Shipyard and Port Khazard.
translation: 我们运营从法斯提斯港到提拉斯港的航线，中途停靠沙林港、凯瑟比镇、布尔哈文镇、穆萨角、造船厂和卡扎德港。

english: Why, hello there, [lad/lass/kid]. Me friends call me Ned. I was a man of the sea, but it's past me now. Could I be making or selling you some rope?
translation: 哎呀，你好啊，[lad/lass/kid]。朋友们都叫我内德。我曾经是个海员，但现在不行了。我能给你做或卖些绳子吗？

english: You're a sailor? Could you take me to the island of Crandor?
translation: 你是水手？你能带我去克兰多岛吗？

english: Well, I was a sailor. I've not been able to get work at sea these days, though. They say I'm too old.
translation: 嗯，我曾经是水手。不过这些天我找不到海上工作了。他们说我太老了。

english: Sorry, where was it you said you wanted to go?
translation: 抱歉，你刚说想去哪儿？

english: To the island of Crandor.
translation: 去克兰多岛。

english: Crandor?
translation: 克兰多？

english: But... It would be a chance to sail a ship once more. I'd sail anywhere if it was a chance to sail again.
translation: 但……这是个再次驾船的机会。只要能再航行一次，去哪里都行。

english: Then again, no captain in his right mind would sail to that island...
translation: 不过话说回来，没有哪个头脑正常的船长会去那座岛……

english: Ah, you only live once! I'll do it!
translation: 啊，人生只有一次！我干了！

english: So, where's your ship?
translation: 那么，你的船在哪儿？

english: Well, I don't actually have a ship yet.
translation: 嗯，我其实还没有船。

english: Ah, well. Let me know when you do. The place to look would be Port Sarim.
translation: 啊，好吧。等你有了再告诉我。去沙林港找找看。

english: It's the Lady Lumbridge, in Port Sarim.
translation: 是沙林港的仑桥女士号。

english: That old pile of junk? Last I heard, she wasn't seaworthy.
translation: 那堆老垃圾？我上次听说，她不能出海了。

english: I fixed her up!
translation: 我修好她了！

english: You did? Excellent!
translation: 你修好了？太好了！

english: Excellent! I'll meet you at the ship, then.
translation: 太好了！那我在船上等你。

english: Uh...yeah...about that. I don't actually have a map on me.
translation: 呃……嗯……关于这个。我其实没带地图。

english: You'd better go find it, then. I'm not going to go sailing off without a map to show me where to head!
translation: 那你最好去找一张。我可不想没有地图就出海，不知道往哪儿开！

english: Hello again, [lad/lass/kid]. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 又见面了，[lad/lass/kid]。需要帮忙吗？也许想买些绳子？

english: Will you take me to Crandor now, then?
translation: 那现在你能带我去克兰多岛吗？

english: I said I would and old Ned is a man of his word!
translation: 我说过我会的，老内德是个信守诺言的人！

english: Yes, good point. I'd better go and fix her up.
translation: 是的，说得对。我最好去修好她。

english: Well, you're a braver man than I!
translation: 嗯，你比我勇敢！

english: Back in my father's day, Crandor was an important city-state. Politically, it was as important as Falador or Varrock and its ships traded with every port.
translation: 在我父亲那个年代，克兰多岛是个重要的城邦。政治上，它和法拉多城或维洛克城一样重要，它的船只与每个港口贸易。

english: But, one day when I was little, all contact was lost. The trading ships and the diplomatic envoys just stopped coming.
translation: 但有一天，在我很小的时候，所有联系都断了。商船和外交使节都不再来了。

english: I remember my father being very scared. He posted lookouts on the roof to warn if the dragon was approaching. All the city rulers were worried that Elvarg would devastate the whole continent.
translation: 我记得我父亲非常害怕。他在屋顶上布置了瞭望哨，以防巨龙靠近。所有城市统治者都担心艾尔瓦格会摧毁整个大陆。

english: That's a relief. I would hate to see such a promising adventurer cut down in [his/her/their] prime.
translation: 那就放心了。我可不想看到这么有前途的冒险者英年早逝。

english: I said I would and old Ned is a man of his word! I'll meet you on board the Lady Lumbridge in Port Sarim.
translation: 我说到做到，老内德说话算话！我到沙林港的仑桥女士号上等你。

english: Arr, Jim lad!
translation: 啊，吉姆小子！

english: It's Jenkins, cap'n!
translation: 是詹金斯，船长！

english: Arr, Jenkins lad!
translation: 啊，詹金斯小子！

english: Aye aye, cap'n!
translation: 是是，船长！

english: Splice the mainsail!
translation: 拼接主帆！

english: Swab the deck!
translation: 擦洗甲板！

english: Weigh the anchor!
translation: 起锚！

english: It's too heavy, cap'n!
translation: 太沉了，船长！

english: Ah, it's good to be on board a ship again! No matter how long I live on land, a ship will always seem better. Are you ready to depart?
translation: 啊，再次登船真好啊！无论我在陆地上生活多久，船总是更棒。你准备好出发了吗？

english: Yes, let's go!
translation: 是的，走吧！

english: No, I'm not quite ready yet.
translation: 不，我还没完全准备好。

english: Well, you go do whatever you need to do. I'll wait here for you until you're ready.
translation: 好吧，你去处理你的事。我在这里等你准备好。

english: Ah, it's good to feel the salt spray on my face once again!
translation: 啊，再次感受到脸上的咸味水花真好！

english: And this is a mighty fine ship. She don't look much, but she handles like a dream.
translation: 而且这是一艘非常棒的船。她看起来不怎么样，但操纵起来像梦一样顺畅。

english: How much longer until we reach Crandor?
translation: 我们还要多久才能到克兰多尔？

english: Not long now! According to the chart, we'd be able to see Crandor if it wasn't for those clouds on the horizon.
translation: 快了！根据海图，要不是地平线上那些云，我们就能看到克兰多尔了。

english: Looks like there's a storm coming up, cap'n. Soon we won't be able to see anything!
translation: 看起来暴风雨要来了，船长。很快我们就什么也看不见了！

english: Oh, well. The weather had been so good up until now.
translation: 哦，好吧。之前天气一直这么好。

english: Did you see that?
translation: 你看到了吗？

english: See what?
translation: 看到什么？

english: I thought I saw something up above us.
translation: 我好像看到我们上方有什么东西。

english: It's the dragon!
translation: 是那条龙！

english: We're going to sink!
translation: 我们要沉了！

english: Look! Land ahead!
translation: 看！前方有陆地！

english: We're going to crash!
translation: 我们要撞上了！

english: Now I see why all the other captains said I'd be mad to go near Crandor. It looks like we're stranded.
translation: 现在我明白为什么其他船长都说我靠近克兰多尔是疯了。看来我们被困住了。

english: Don't worry about that. I found a secret passage in the dragon's lair that leads off the island!
translation: 别担心。我在龙的巢穴里找到了一条秘密通道，可以离开这座岛！

english: Oh, that's good. I'll be able to get back to Draynor somehow,
translation: 哦，那太好了。我总能想办法回到德雷诺，

english: if I can sneak past all the skeletons and demons on this island!
translation: 只要我能偷偷绕过这座岛上所有的骷髅和恶魔！

english: The ship's in a sorry state. You'd better fix up the hole in the hull before we can go anywhere.
translation: 这船的状况糟透了。在我们能出发之前，你最好先把船体上的洞补好。

english: Wow! You sure are lucky! Seems the Lady Lumbridge just washed right up into the dock by herself!
translation: 哇！你可真走运！看来仑桥女士号自己就冲进了码头！

english: She's pretty badly damaged, though...
translation: 不过她受损很严重……

english: So, are you interested in buying a ship? Now, I'll be straight with you: she's not quite seaworthy right now, but give her a bit of work and she'll be the nippiest ship this side of Port Khazard.
translation: 那么，你有兴趣买一艘船吗？现在，我跟你说实话：她目前还不太适航，但稍微修整一下，她就会成为卡扎德港这边最灵活的船。

english: Okey dokey, she's all yours!
translation: 好嘞，她是你的了！

english: Hello, captain! Here to take your new ship for a spin?
translation: 你好，船长！来试试你的新船吗？

english: So, are you interested in buying the Lady Lumbridge? Now, I'll be straight with you: she's not quite seaworthy right now, but give her a bit of work and she'll be the nippiest ship this side of Port Khazard.
translation: 那么，你有兴趣买下仑桥女士号吗？我跟你直说吧：她现在还不适合航海，但稍微修整一下，她会成为卡扎德港这边最灵活的船。

english: No, not really. Port Sarim's shipbuilders aren't very efficient so it could be quite a while.
translation: 不，不太可能。沙林港的造船工效率不高，所以可能要等很久。

english: Oh, there was no particular accident. It's just years of wear and tear.
translation: 哦，没什么特别的事故。只是多年的磨损。

english: The Lady Lumbridge is an old crandorian fishing ship - the last one of her kind, as far as I know. That kind of ship was always mightily manoeuvrable, but not too tough.
translation: 仑桥女士号是一艘古老的克兰多尔渔船——据我所知是最后一艘了。那种船向来非常灵活，但不够坚固。

english: but once she's patched up, she'll be good as new!
translation: 但一旦修补好，她就会焕然一新！

english: She happened to be somewhere else when Crandor was destroyed, and she's had several owners since then. Not all of them have looked after her too well,
translation: 克兰多尔被毁时，她碰巧在别处，之后换了好几个主人。并非所有人都好好照顾她，

english: I killed the dragon!
translation: 我杀了那条龙！

english: Really? That's amazing!
translation: 真的？太惊人了！

english: You are a true hero. There's no way that Oziach can refuse to sell you rune platemail now. You should tell him at once!
translation: 你是一个真正的英雄。现在奥扎克没理由拒绝卖给你符文板甲了。你应该马上告诉他！

english: Only one map exists that shows the route through the reefs of Crandor. That map was split into three pieces by Melzar, Thalzar and Lozar, the wizards who escaped from the dragon. Each of them took one piece.
translation: 只有一张地图显示了穿越克兰多尔礁石的路线。那张地图被从龙手中逃脱的巫师梅尔扎、萨尔扎和洛扎分成了三块。他们每人拿走了一块。

english: If you're serious about taking on Elvarg, first you'll need to get to Crandor. The island is surrounded by dangerous reefs, so you'll need a ship capable of getting through them and a map to show you the way.
translation: 如果你真的想挑战艾尔瓦格，首先你得去克兰多尔。那座岛被危险的礁石环绕，所以你需要一艘能穿过礁石的船，以及一张指路的地图。

english: Even if you find the right route, only a ship made to the old crandorian design would be able to navigate through the reefs to the island.
translation: 即使你找到了正确的路线，也只有按照古老的克兰多尔设计建造的船才能穿过礁石到达岛上。

english: When you reach Crandor, you'll also need some kind of protection against the dragon's breath.
translation: 到达克兰多尔后，你还需要某种防护来抵御龙息。

english: If there's still one in existence, it's probably in Port Sarim.
translation: 如果还有一艘存在的话，很可能在沙林港。

english: Then, of course, you'll need to find a captain willing to sail to Crandor, and I'm not sure where you'd find one of them!
translation: 然后，当然，你需要找到一个愿意航行到克兰多尔的船长，我不确定你会在哪里找到这样的人！

english: Ask me about Melzar's map piece again when you have enough free inventory space for the key.
translation: 当你有足够的空背包空间来放钥匙时，再来问我关于梅尔扎的地图碎片的事。

english: I think I already gave you a key to the maze. Maybe you've got it stored somewhere.
translation: 我想我已经给了你一把迷宫的钥匙。也许你把它存放在某个地方了。

english: Of course you can, but you'll have to free up some inventory space first.
translation: 当然可以，但你必须先腾出一些背包空间。

english: Yes, I have!
translation: 是的，我杀死了！

english: I have its head here.
translation: 我把它的头带来了。

english: You actually did it?
translation: 你真的做到了？

english: I underestimated ye, adventurer. I apologise.
translation: 我低估了你，冒险者。我道歉。

english: Yer a true hero, and I'd be happy to sell ye rune platebodies.
translation: 你是个真正的英雄，我很乐意卖给你符文板甲身。

english: Only the most worthy may access our guild and I'm afraid you are not quite there yet. Go out and hone your skills. Then you can return to us.
translation: 只有最值得的人才能进入我们的公会，恐怕你还不够格。去磨练你的技能吧。然后你才能回到我们这里。

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island, but they're locked. I think something important lies behind them.
translation: 我正在调查艾尔瓦格的起源。我在一个废墟岛上发现了一些旧门，但它们锁着。我觉得门后藏着什么重要的东西。

english: Well keep at it. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
translation: 那就继续努力吧。如果你帮我们填满知识图书馆，我们就让你进入公会。

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found some old doors on a ruined island, but they're locked. I'm trying to find the key.
translation: 我正在调查艾尔瓦格的起源。我在一个废墟岛上发现了一些旧门，但它们锁着。我正在找钥匙。

english: I'm investigating the origin of Elvarg. I've found an ancient vault beneath a ruined island. I think it contains something important.
translation: 我正在调查艾尔瓦格的起源。我在一个废墟岛下发现了一个古老的金库。我觉得里面藏着什么重要的东西。

english: Well you'd better investigate it then. If you help us fill our Library of Knowledge, we shall grant you access to the guild.
translation: 那你最好去调查一下。如果你帮我们填满知识图书馆，我们就让你进入公会。

english: I was investigating the origin of Elvarg but I accidently released a dragonkin!
translation: 我本来在调查艾尔瓦格的起源，但我不小心放出了一只龙人！

english: Hello there. I'm [player name]. Are you Dallas Jones?
translation: 你好。我是[player name]。你是达拉斯.琼斯吗？

english: I am. Pleased to meet you. I'm assuming you're here because of my advert?
translation: 是的。很高兴见到你。我猜你是因为我的广告来的？

english: Er... yes?
translation: 呃……是的？

english: Excellent! Let me run you through the details.
translation: 太好了！让我给你详细说说。

english: We're to head to Elvarg's lair beneath Crandor. There we will begin a research project on Elvarg and her attack on the island.
translation: 我们要前往克兰多尔下方的艾尔瓦格巢穴。在那里我们将开始一个关于艾尔瓦格及其对岛屿袭击的研究项目。

english: I trust you know the tale of Elvarg?
translation: 我相信你知道艾尔瓦格的故事吧？

english: Well I was the one who killed her in the first place.
translation: 嗯，我就是当初杀了她的人。

english: You're the Hero of Crandor? Amazing!
translation: 你就是克兰多尔的英雄？太棒了！

english: I take it you know her story very well then?
translation: 那么我想你一定很了解她的故事了？

english: Thirty years ago, an adventurer descended into the caves beneath Crandor. There he discovered the dragon Elvarg.
translation: 三十年前，一位冒险者进入了克兰多尔下方的洞穴。在那里，他发现了龙艾尔瓦格。

english: Elvarg made short work of the adventurer. Once she was finished with him, she emerged from the caves and laid waste to the island.
translation: 艾尔瓦格轻松地解决了那个冒险者。解决掉他之后，她从洞穴中出来，将整个岛屿夷为平地。

english: For the next thirty years, Elvarg remained on Crandor until she was finally defeated, by you.
translation: 在接下来的三十年里，艾尔瓦格一直留在克兰多尔，直到最终被你击败。

english: Now that Elvarg is dead, we have the opportunity to perform research on the island and investigate her attack.
translation: 既然艾尔瓦格死了，我们就有机会在岛上进行研究，调查她的袭击事件。

english: Meet me in Elvarg's Lair beneath Crandor when you're ready to begin.
translation: 准备好后，到克兰多尔下方的艾尔瓦格巢穴来找我。

english: Sounds good. See you there.
translation: 听起来不错。到时候见。

english: Yes I know it well.
translation: 是的，我很了解。

english: Wonderful. I won't waste your time with it then.
translation: 太好了。那我就不浪费你的时间讲这些了。

english: Hello, Dallas. So what exactly are we researching here?
translation: 你好，达拉斯。我们到底在这里研究什么？

english: Elvarg's attack on Crandor is a bit of an anomaly. We're here to work out why.
translation: 艾尔瓦格袭击克兰多尔这件事有点反常。我们来这里就是为了弄清楚原因。

english: What made it an anomaly?
translation: 为什么说它反常？

english: Elvarg is very unusual in that she is one of the few dragons to live alone. Most of her kind live in large groups.
translation: 艾尔瓦格非常不寻常，因为她是少数独居的龙之一。她的同类大多群居。

english: Not only that, she also displayed far greater aggression than most other dragons by directly attacking Crandor.
translation: 不仅如此，她还表现出比大多数龙更强的攻击性，直接袭击了克兰多尔。

english: But aren't all dragons aggressive?
translation: 但难道不是所有的龙都有攻击性吗？

english: Not like Elvarg was. Most dragons will only attack those who enter their territory. Elvarg strayed well outside of hers when she attacked the island.
translation: 不像艾尔瓦格那样。大多数龙只会攻击进入它们领地的人。而艾尔瓦格袭击岛屿时，远远超出了她的领地范围。

english: I see. Where should we start?
translation: 我明白了。我们从哪里开始？

english: This is where Elvarg made her home. There must be something here to point us in the right direction. Have a look around and see what you can find.
translation: 这就是艾尔瓦格的家。这里一定有什么东西能给我们指明方向。四处看看，看看你能找到什么。

english: Let's talk about the investigation.
translation: 我们来谈谈调查的事。

english: I've found a strange wall that looks like it might have something behind it. We might be able to mine through it.
translation: 我发现了一面奇怪的墙壁，看起来后面可能藏着什么东西。我们也许能挖穿它。

english: Good work. I'm afraid you'll need to be the one to do the mining. My back isn't what it once was.
translation: 干得好。恐怕采矿得由你来做了。我的腰背不如从前了。

english: Not much to tell really. My name is Dallas Jones and I'm a researcher for the Varrock Museum. Many of the researchers have an area of expertise. Mine is dragons.
translation: 其实没什么好说的。我叫达拉斯.琼斯，是维洛克城博物馆的研究员。很多研究员都有自己的专长领域。我的专长是龙。

english: Why dragons?
translation: 为什么是龙？

english: My father used to live on Crandor before it was destroyed. He was one of the many who were killed by Elvarg.
translation: 我父亲在克兰多尔被毁之前曾住在那里。他是被艾尔瓦格杀害的许多人之一。

english: His death left me with a great interest in dragons and I've spent the last fifteen years trying to learn more about them.
translation: 他的死让我对龙产生了浓厚的兴趣，过去十五年里，我一直在努力了解更多关于它们的信息。

english: I see. Thanks, Dallas.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你，达拉斯。

english: I've mined through a strange wall and found a tunnel behind it.
translation: 我挖穿了一面奇怪的墙壁，发现后面有一条隧道。

english: I can see that. We could well be on to something here. You go through the tunnel and see if it's safe. I'll be right behind you.
translation: 我看到了。我们可能真的发现什么了。你先进隧道看看是否安全。我马上跟在你后面。

english: Goodness me! What is this place?
translation: 天哪！这是什么地方？

english: It looks like some sort of laboratory.
translation: 看起来像某种实验室。

english: Are the tales true? Could this mean?
translation: 那些传说是真的吗？难道这意味着……

english: Mean what?
translation: 意味着什么？

english: There are ancient tales that tell of the origin of the dragons. They say they were created by a powerful race of creatures known as the dragonkin.
translation: 有一些古老的传说讲述了龙的起源。它们说龙是由一个强大的生物种族——龙人——创造出来的。

english: Dragonkin? I've heard of them.
translation: 龙人？我听说过他们。

english: Yes, you likely will have. We know for a fact that the dragonkin existed. They terrorised the world for many years during the early Fourth Age.
translation: 是的，你很可能听说过。我们确知龙人存在过。在第四纪早期，他们曾肆虐世界多年。

english: The thing is, despite their similar names, no actual connection between the dragonkin and the dragons has ever been proven.
translation: 问题是，尽管名字相似，但龙人和龙之间从未被证实有实际联系。

english: Well maybe we'll be the ones to prove it.
translation: 嗯，也许我们就是能证明这一点的人。

english: We might just be. We should look around and see what we can uncover.
translation: 也许吧。我们应该四处看看，看看能发现什么。

english: I just can't believe it. This place may not just hold the secrets of Elvarg, but of the whole dragon race!
translation: 我简直不敢相信。这个地方可能不仅藏着艾尔瓦格的秘密，还藏着整个龙族的秘密！

english: What was that creature?
translation: 那是什么生物？

english: How strange. We should keep looking around.
translation: 真奇怪。我们应该继续四处看看。

english: I've found an old mural. It has lots of dragons and fungi on it along with some strange writing.
translation: 我发现了一幅古老的壁画。上面有很多龙和真菌，还有一些奇怪的文字。

english: What did it say?
translation: 上面说了什么？

english: I don't know. It looked like a different language. It had odd words on it like 'Lithkren'.
translation: 我不知道。看起来像是一种不同的语言。上面有一些奇怪的词，比如'Lithkren'。

english: Lithkren? That name sounds familiar. Where have I seen it before?
translation: Lithkren？这个名字听起来耳熟。我在哪里见过？

english: Of course! Fossil Island! I was there recently as part of the research team investigating the differences between wyverns and dragons.
translation: 当然！化石岛！我最近作为研究团队的一员在那里调查飞龙和龙之间的差异。

english: There's an old settlement on the island with similar architecture to this place. It contains lots of books, many written in a strange language. One of the books mentioned a place called Lithkren.
translation: 岛上有一个古老的定居点，建筑风格和这里相似。里面有很多书，很多是用一种奇怪的语言写的。其中一本书提到了一个叫Lithkren的地方。

english: You know, now that you mention it, I think I may have read that book as well.
translation: 你知道吗，既然你提到了，我想我也读过那本书。

english: Well that just confirms it! Not to mention that Fossil Island is also coated in various types of fungi. It must be connected!
translation: 那就证实了！更不用说化石岛上也覆盖着各种真菌。它们一定有联系！

english: Fossil Island is also coated in various types of fungi. It must be connected!
translation: 化石岛上也覆盖着各种真菌。它们一定有联系！

english: In that case, we should probably go to Fossil Island.
translation: 那样的话，我们可能应该去化石岛。

english: I agree. Head to the old settlement on the north side of the island. I'll meet you there once I've finished up here.
translation: 我同意。前往岛北侧的古老定居点。我在这里处理完后就去那里和你碰面。

english: It looks like we've found everything here. We should move on to Fossil Island. I'll meet you at the old settlement on the north side of the island.
translation: 看来我们在这里找到了所有东西。我们应该继续前往化石岛。我会在岛北侧的古老定居点和你碰面。

english: Hello, Dallas.
translation: 你好，达拉斯。

english: So while I was waiting for you, I had a look through these books again. One of them mentions a nearby island called Lithkren. Thing is, there are lots of islands around here. It doesn't say which one it is.
translation: 我在等你的时候，又翻了翻这些书。其中一本提到了一个叫Lithkren的附近岛屿。问题是，这附近有很多岛屿。它没说是哪一个。

english: So how do we know which island to go to?
translation: 那我们怎么知道要去哪个岛？

english: Have a look at this grid on the floor. I think it might actually be a map. If you look at that tile in the middle, it looks like part of this island.
translation: 看看地板上的这个网格。我觉得它可能实际上是一张地图。如果你看中间那块瓷砖，它看起来像是这个岛的一部分。

english: Hmm... So this map could lead us to Lithkren. Most of the pieces are missing though.
translation: 嗯……所以这张地图可能能带我们去Lithkren。不过大部分碎片都不见了。

english: That they are. However, I had a look around and I managed to find some of the pieces.
translation: 确实如此。不过，我四处看了看，设法找到了一些碎片。

english: By my calculations, there are 24 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 据我计算，还有24块碎片要找。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Great! I'll have a look around and see if I can find them.
translation: 太好了！我四处看看，看能不能找到它们。

english: Good luck. Once you have all of the pieces, bring them here and we'll see about putting this map together.
translation: 祝你好运。一旦你集齐所有碎片，就把它们带到这里，我们来看看怎么拼好这张地图。

english: Which book was it?
translation: 是哪本书？

english: Check the pile behind the ladder. You should find it there.
translation: 检查梯子后面的那堆书。你应该能在那里找到它。

english: Have you managed to find those map pieces yet?
translation: 你找到那些地图碎片了吗？

english: Well keep looking. We have [amount] pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还有[amount]块碎片要找。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Yes. I have some here.
translation: 是的。我这里有一些。

english: Great. I'll look after them for you.
translation: 太好了。我来帮你保管。

english: Is that all of them?
translation: 就这些了吗？

english: Not yet. We have [amount] pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 还没。我们还有[amount]块碎片要找。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: I think that's all of them.
translation: 我想这就是全部了。

english: It looks like it is. Good job.
translation: 看起来是的。干得好。

english: Now then, shall we see about finishing this map?
translation: 那么，我们来看看怎么完成这张地图吧？

english: Fair enough. Let me know when you're ready.
translation: 有道理。准备好了就告诉我。

english: I do believe you've got it! Yes, we should be able to find Lithkren now.
translation: 我相信你做到了！是的，我们现在应该能找到Lithkren了。

english: But which island is it?
translation: 但它是哪个岛？

english: There's a strange symbol on the map in two places. One marks this building and the other marks an island. I bet that's Lithkren.
translation: 地图上有两个地方有一个奇怪的符号。一个标记了这栋建筑，另一个标记了一个岛屿。我打赌那就是Lithkren。

english: I think you might be right. So now that we know where the island is, we need to find a way there. Do you think the museum can help us?
translation: 我想你说得对。既然我们知道那个岛在哪里了，我们需要找到去那里的方法。你觉得博物馆能帮我们吗？

english: The museum? No that won't work. Any requisition of museum resources requires a mountain of paperwork and we simply don't have time.
translation: 博物馆？不行，那行不通。任何博物馆资源的申请都需要大量的文书工作，我们根本没有时间。

english: Don't we?
translation: 我们没有吗？

english: Of course not! Besides, I've spent years working towards this and I'm tired of waiting. It's time to discover the truth.
translation: 当然没有！而且，我已经为此努力了多年，我厌倦了等待。是时候发现真相了。

english: Alright, alright. So what do we do instead?
translation: 好吧，好吧。那我们该怎么办？

english: We'll need a boat. Find a dwarf called Jardric. He should be somewhere on the island. He's an old friend who owes me a favour. He should be able to get a boat for us.
translation: 我们需要一艘船。找一个叫贾德里克的矮人。他应该在这岛上的某个地方。他是我的老朋友，欠我一个人情。他应该能给我们弄到一艘船。

english: While you're doing that, I'm going to take a copy of this map.
translation: 你去做这件事的时候，我要复制一份这张地图。

english: What should I be doing again?
translation: 我该做什么来着？

english: We'll need a boat to get to Lithkren. Jardric should be able to help us. See if you can find him. He should be somewhere on the island.
translation: 我们需要一艘船去利思克伦。贾德里克应该能帮我们。看看你能不能找到他。他应该就在岛上的某个地方。

english: Are you Jardric?
translation: 你是贾德里克吗？

english: That I am. Former boatman and now a researcher for Keldagrim. What can I do for you?
translation: 正是我。以前是船夫，现在是凯尔达格林城的研究员。我能为你做些什么？

english: I'm working with Dallas Jones on a research project. We're investigating the destruction of Crandor. We need a boat to get to one of the nearby islands. Dallas said you could help us.
translation: 我正在和达拉斯.琼斯一起做一个研究项目。我们在调查克兰多尔的毁灭。我们需要一艘船去附近的一个岛屿。达拉斯说你可以帮我们。

english: Did he now? Looking to cash in on that favour I bet. I'm afraid I can't help you. All the boats around here are owned by the museum and they won't just let you take them.
translation: 他这么说了？我猜他是想利用那个人情。恐怕我帮不了你。这里所有的船都归博物馆所有，他们不会让你随便开走的。

english: Of course, Dallas works with the museum and he could easily put in a request for one, but he's not a fan of waiting around...
translation: 当然，达拉斯在博物馆工作，他很容易就能申请到一艘船，但他不喜欢干等着……

english: He said as much. So what can we do?
translation: 他也是这么说的。那我们能做什么？

english: Well I suppose you could always build your own. If the island isn't far you'll only need a small rowboat.
translation: 嗯，我想你总可以自己造一艘。如果岛屿不远，你只需要一艘小划艇。

english: Mind you, you'll want to be quite good at building things, unless you fancy a trip to the bottom of the ocean.
translation: 不过，你得相当擅长建造东西，除非你想去海底一游。

english: I'm not actually too bad when it comes to construction. What will I need?
translation: 其实我在建筑方面还不算太差。我需要什么？

english: Let's see... I'd say eight oak planks, ten swamp paste and 12 nails of any kind should do it. Obviously you'll need a hammer and a saw too.
translation: 让我想想……我觉得八块橡木板、十份沼泽膏和十二颗任意种类的钉子应该就够了。显然你还需要一把锤子和一把锯子。

english: You'll probably be wanting someone to look after the boat as well. I guess I can do that. But this means that Dallas and I are even.
translation: 你可能还需要有人照看船。我想我可以做。但这意味着我和达拉斯两清了。

english: There should be a good spot to build the boat on the west side of the island, near the mushroom forest.
translation: 在岛的西边，靠近蘑菇森林的地方应该有个好位置可以造船。

english: Hello again. How's the boat coming along?
translation: 又见面了。船造得怎么样了？

english: What do I need again?
translation: 我需要什么来着？

english: You'll need a saw, a hammer, eight oak planks, ten swamp paste and 12 nails of any kind. The best place to build the boat will be on the west side of the island, near the mushroom forest.
translation: 你需要一把锯子、一把锤子、八块橡木板、十份沼泽膏和十二颗任意种类的钉子。造船的最佳位置在岛的西边，靠近蘑菇森林。

english: Hello again. This should be a good place to build the boat.
translation: 又见面了。这里应该是造船的好地方。

english: You'll need a saw, a hammer, eight oak planks, ten swamp paste and 12 nails of any kind.
translation: 你需要一把锯子、一把锤子、八块橡木板、十份沼泽膏和十二颗任意种类的钉子。

english: Well talk to Jardric if you need some help. He'll know what to do.
translation: 如果你需要帮助，就去找贾德里克。他知道该怎么做。

english: That's the boat all finished.
translation: 船造好了。

english: And not a bad boat either. Good job.
translation: 而且这船还不错。干得好。

english: This is it. This is our chance to finally find some answers. To finally find out the truth behind Elvarg. Are you ready to go?
translation: 就是这里了。这是我们终于找到答案的机会。终于查明艾尔瓦格背后的真相。你准备好出发了吗？

english: Look at this place! I'm going to explore and see what I can find.
translation: 看看这个地方！我要去探索一下，看看能找到什么。

english: Someone's in a hurry. I suppose I should look around as well.
translation: 有人很着急。我想我也该四处看看。

english: And I guess I'll stay here and look after the boat. Good luck.
translation: 那我就在这儿照看船吧。祝你好运。

english: Well don't take too long. We've had to wait years for this. I don't want to wait much longer.
translation: 别花太长时间。我们为这个等了好几年了。我不想再等下去了。

english: Well those are some big doors.
translation: 哇，那门可真大。

english: Look at them. Look at the markings on them.
translation: 看看它们。看看上面的标记。

english: Dragons?
translation: 龙？

english: Exactly. This is it. This has to be the place.
translation: 没错。就是这里。这一定是那个地方。

english: Shall we go in?
translation: 我们要进去吗？

english: We can't. I already tried, but the doors are sealed. There's a circular indentation in the middle. Maybe it's a keyhole.
translation: 进不去。我已经试过了，但门是封死的。中间有一个圆形凹痕。也许是个钥匙孔。

english: Well a keyhole isn't much good if there isn't a key. We should look around and see if there are any clues nearby.
translation: 没有钥匙的话，钥匙孔也没什么用。我们应该四处看看附近有没有线索。

english: I found an old diary nearby but I haven't read it yet.
translation: 我在附近找到了一本破旧的日记，但还没读。

english: Well read it and see what it says. It could well contain the information we need.
translation: 那就读读看上面写了什么。很可能有我们需要的信息。

english: I found an old diary nearby. It mentioned a battle that took place here involving Robert the Strong.
translation: 我在附近找到了一本破旧的日记。上面提到这里发生过一场战斗，涉及强者罗伯特。

english: Robert the Strong? He spent most of his life fighting the dragonkin. Does this mean it's true? Did they really create the dragons?
translation: 强者罗伯特？他一生大部分时间都在与龙人作战。这是不是意味着那是真的？他们真的创造了龙？

english: I guess we'll never know though. Robert the Strong is gone. We've reached a dead end.
translation: 不过我想我们永远不会知道了。强者罗伯特已经不在了。我们走进了死胡同。

english: Not necessarily. Robert the Strong might not be as dead as you think.
translation: 不一定。强者罗伯特可能并没有你想象的那么死透了。

english: Robert the Strong is still alive. He's been reincarnated as a cat called Bob.
translation: 强者罗伯特还活着。他转世成了一只叫鲍勃的猫。

english: Just think once before you speak please.
translation: 说话前请先过过脑子。

english: I'm serious! Why would I lie about this?
translation: 我是认真的！我为什么要在这件事上撒谎？

english: Well I'm definitely not convinced, but let's say you're telling the truth... how can a cat help us?
translation: 好吧，我肯定不信，但就算你说的是真的……一只猫能怎么帮我们？

english: I have an amulet that lets me talk to cats. I can use it to ask Bob what he knows.
translation: 我有一个护符，可以让我和猫说话。我可以用它来问问鲍勃他知道什么。

english: This is all very confusing. You go find this cat of yours. I need to sit down and clear my head of all this weirdness.
translation: 这一切太让人困惑了。你去找你的那只猫吧。我需要坐下来，把这些怪事从脑子里清空。

english: Very well. I shall return once I've learnt more.
translation: 好吧。等我了解更多之后就会回来。

english: Hello. Have you found that cat yet?
translation: 你好。你找到那只猫了吗？

english: Not yet I'm afraid. He likes to move around a lot.
translation: 恐怕还没有。他喜欢到处跑。

english: Well keep at it. We need to get through these doors.
translation: 继续找吧。我们需要穿过这些门。

english: Hey, Bob!
translation: 嘿，鲍勃！

english: Hello, [player name]. How's things?
translation: 你好，[player name]。最近怎么样？

english: Not bad. I was wondering if you could help me with something.
translation: 还不错。我在想你能不能帮我个忙。

english: So you know how you're actually Robert the Strong?
translation: 那么你知道你其实是强者罗伯特吗？

english: So you and the Sphinx tell me.
translation: 你和斯芬克斯是这么告诉我的。

english: Long story, I'll keep it brief. I found an old dungeon with a large set of doors in it. There was a skeleton nearby with a diary that mentioned Robert the Strong.
translation: 说来话长，我长话短说。我发现了一个古老的地牢，里面有一扇大门。附近有一具骷髅，旁边有本日记提到了强者罗伯特。

english: I was hoping you could use your memories of Robert the Strong to help me open the doors.
translation: 我希望你能利用你作为强者罗伯特的记忆来帮我打开那扇门。

english: But I don't have any memories of Robert the Strong. It was only when the Sphinx hypnotised me that we learnt who I really was and I don't even remember that.
translation: 但我没有强者罗伯特的任何记忆。只有在斯芬克斯催眠我的时候，我们才知道我到底是谁，而我甚至不记得那件事。

english: Hmm... This is problematic.
translation: 嗯……这有点麻烦。

english: Maybe the Sphinx can help us again.
translation: 也许斯芬克斯能再帮我们一次。

english: Well it worked last time.
translation: 上次不是挺管用的嘛。

english: That it did. Bob, would you mind meeting me in Sophanem?
translation: 确实管用。鲍勃，你介意在索法尼恩城和我碰面吗？

english: Well I suppose I don't have anything better to do. Not unless Unferth has forgotten where he lives again.
translation: 嗯，我想我也没有更好的事可做。除非昂弗斯又忘了自己住哪儿。

english: Ahem.
translation: 咳咳。

english: Oh fudge. Give me one moment, [player name].
translation: 哦，糟了。稍等一下，[player name]。

english: Well that all sounds great to me, [player name]. I'll meet you in Sophanem.
translation: 听起来不错，[player name]。我会在索法尼恩城和你碰面。

english: Thanks, Bob.
translation: 谢谢，鲍勃。

english: Hello, [player name]. I'm on my way to Sophanem to see the Sphinx.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我正在去索法尼恩城见斯芬克斯的路上。

english: Great! I'll meet you there.
translation: 太好了！我会在那里和你碰面。

english: I should probably wear my catspeak amulet before talking to Bob and the Sphinx.
translation: 在和鲍勃及斯芬克斯说话之前，我最好戴上我的猫语护符。

english: Hello, human. Bob was just telling me about your dungeon.
translation: 你好，人类。鲍勃刚才正在跟我说你的地牢。

english: That's right. Before we get into that though, about that thing I mentioned...
translation: 没错。不过在谈这个之前，关于我之前提到的那件事……

english: Thing?
translation: 那件事？

english: Ah yes. That amulet of yours is very useful, but it has limitations. I can use my power to grant you the ability to talk to cats even when you're not wearing it.
translation: 啊，是的。你的那个护符很有用，但有局限性。我可以利用我的力量赐予你即使不戴护符也能和猫说话的能力。

english: Very few humans are ever given this power, but you've proven yourself to be a friend to feline kind.
translation: 很少有人类被赐予这种力量，但你已经证明了自己是猫科动物的朋友。

english: Excellent. Prepare yourself!
translation: 太好了。准备好！

english: All done. Now, what is it you need my help with?
translation: 完成了。现在，你需要我帮什么忙？

english: We were hoping you could hypnotise Bob again so we can learn more about his past.
translation: 我们希望你能再次催眠鲍勃，这样我们就能了解更多关于他的过去。

english: What is it you wish to learn?
translation: 你想了解什么？

english: It's about that dungeon. I believe that it was once visited by Robert the Strong. I want to know what he did while he was there.
translation: 是关于那个地牢的。我相信强者罗伯特曾经去过那里。我想知道他在那里做了什么。

english: I'm afraid I will be of little help here. All I can do is hypnotise Bob. I can't enter his mind and choose which memory to view.
translation: 恐怕我在这里帮不上什么忙。我只能催眠鲍勃。我无法进入他的大脑并选择查看哪段记忆。

english: Hmm... Enter his mind...
translation: 嗯……进入他的大脑……

english: What are you thinking, [player name]?
translation: 你在想什么，[player name]？

english: I once entered the mind of a guy called Cyrisus to confront some personal issues of his. The Oneiromancer on Lunar Isle helped me do it. Maybe she can help us now.
translation: 我曾经进入过一个叫西里苏斯的人的大脑，去面对他的一些个人问题。月亮岛上的梦境法师帮我做到的。也许她现在能帮我们。

english: Okay, I'll join you there. That's going to be a long walk on these paws.
translation: 好的，我会在那里和你会合。用这爪子走路可够远的。

english: More walking? Why don't we ever get a nice easy teleport for these things?
translation: 又要走路？为什么这些事我们从来不能轻松传送一下？

english: I'm not ready to set out yet. You go on ahead. I'll meet you on Lunar Isle and we'll ask the Oneiromancer to help us.
translation: 我还没准备好出发。你先走。我会在月亮岛和你会合，然后我们请梦境法师帮忙。

english: Hello again, [player name]. The Oneiromancer and I were just discussing what our perfect Sunday would be.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。我和梦境法师刚才正在讨论我们理想的星期天是什么样的。

english: I didn't know you two knew each other. Also, how can you speak to cats?
translation: 我不知道你们俩认识。还有，你怎么能和猫说话？

english: You know it's really not that hard. You just need a bit of magic on your side. Anyway, Bob and I go way back.
translation: 你知道这其实没那么难。你只需要一点魔法相助。总之，鲍勃和我交情很深。

english: Seems like everyone knows everyone in these parts.
translation: 看来这一带大家都互相认识。

english: Huh... small world.
translation: 哈……世界真小。

english: So what was it you wanted?
translation: 那么你想要什么？

english: We need to unlock Bob's memories from his old life as Robert the Strong. We were hoping that we could use a shared dream.
translation: 我们需要解锁鲍勃作为强者罗伯特的前世记忆。我们希望可以使用共享梦境。

english: Well we've never actually done a shared dream between a human and a cat before, but it shouldn't be any different. You'll just need another Potion of Shared Dreaming.
translation: 嗯，我们以前从未在人类和猫之间进行过共享梦境，但应该没什么不同。你只需要再来一瓶共享梦境药水。

english: Should we be worried here?
translation: 我们该担心吗？

english: Would you like me to remind you how they are made?
translation: 需要我提醒你它们是怎么制作的吗？

english: I'll give you a vial. You'll need to fill it with water, followed by one ground astral rune and some goutweed.
translation: 我会给你一个瓶子。你需要先装满水，然后加入一颗磨碎的星界符石和一些痛风草。

english: Once you've done that, light the brazier in the middle of town. When you're ready to begin your dream, just use the potion on the brazier.
translation: 完成后，点燃镇子中央的火盆。当你准备好开始梦境时，把药水用在火盆上。

english: You'll need to make some room in your inventory for this vial. Come back to me when you have.
translation: 你需要在背包里腾出空间来放这个瓶子。腾出空间后再来找我。

english: Here's a vial for your potion. Good luck.
translation: 这是给你做药水的瓶子。祝你好运。

english: You should get to work on making that potion.
translation: 你应该开始制作那瓶药水了。

english: Hi, Bob! I've finished the Potion of Shared Dreaming.
translation: 嗨，鲍勃！我已经做好了共享梦境药水。

english: Good stuff. Take it to the brazier in the middle of town and we can begin the dream.
translation: 好东西。把它拿到镇子中央的火盆那里，我们就可以开始入梦了。

english: Take the vial I gave you and fill it with water. After that, add one ground astral rune and some goutweed.
translation: 拿上我之前给你的小瓶，装满水。然后加一份磨碎的星界符石和一些痛风草。

english: I've made the Potion of Shared Dreaming.
translation: 我已经做好了共享梦境药水。

english: In that case you should take it to the brazier in the middle of town.
translation: 既然这样，你就该把它拿到镇子中央的火盆那里。

english: Good stuff. Light the brazier then add the potion.
translation: 好东西。点燃火盆，然后把药水加进去。

english: Good stuff. Add the potion to the brazier and we can begin.
translation: 好东西。把药水倒进火盆，我们就可以开始了。

english: Ready, Bob?
translation: 准备好了吗，鲍勃？

english: Ready when you are, [player name].
translation: 我随时可以，[player name]。

english: Hello, [player name]. Shall we go back into the dream again?
translation: 你好，[player name]。我们再回梦境里看看？

english: Well one thing's for sure, I'm definitely Not Bob.
translation: 有件事可以肯定：我绝对不是鲍勃。

english: Okay... so who are you then?
translation: 好吧……那你到底是谁？

english: I just told you, I'm Not Bob.
translation: 我刚刚说了，我是‘不是鲍勃’。

english: Well this is confusing.
translation: 这可真让人糊涂。

english: These dreams usually are.
translation: 梦境通常都这样。

english: So Not Bob, why are you here?
translation: 那么，不是鲍勃，你为什么会在这里？

english: You tell me. It's your mind we're in right now.
translation: 你告诉我啊。现在我们可是在你的脑海里。

english: We're here to recover Bob's lost memories from his life as Robert the Strong. Do you think you can help us?
translation: 我们来这里是为了找回鲍勃遗失的记忆——他作为强者罗伯特时的那段人生。你觉得你能帮我们吗？

english: I suppose I can. This barrier represents the divide between Bob the Cat and Robert the Strong. The memories you seek are right here, on the other side of the barrier.
translation: 我想可以。这道屏障代表了猫鲍勃和强者罗伯特之间的分界。你要找的记忆就在这道屏障的另一边。

english: So all we need to do is go through the barrier?
translation: 所以我们只需要穿过屏障就行了？

english: Going through the barrier will give you access to Robert's memories, but only while you're in the dream. As soon as you leave, you'll forget them again.
translation: 穿过屏障会让你接触到罗伯特的记忆，但仅限于在梦境中的时候。一旦你离开，你就会再次忘记。

english: So how can we permanently unlock them?
translation: 那怎样才能永久解锁它们呢？

english: Destroying the barrier of course. Head through the barrier and defeat the guardian. That should do the trick.
translation: 当然是摧毁屏障。穿过屏障，击败守护者。应该就能解决问题。

english: Defeat the guardian? I'm no good at combat... I'm a cat.
translation: 击败守护者？我不擅长战斗……我是一只猫。

english: Good job this is a shared dream then. It doesn't have to be you that defeats him.
translation: 幸好这是个共享梦境。不一定要由你来击败他。

english: Looks like it's up to me then. Wish me luck.
translation: 看来得靠我了。祝我好运吧。

english: Good luck, [player name].
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。

english: Apparently you need to defeat the guardian on the other side of this barrier. Sounds odd to me, but what do I know.
translation: 显然你需要打败这道屏障另一边的守护者。我觉得很奇怪，但我知道什么呢。
