english: Pass through the barrier and defeat the guardian. That should restore Bob's lost memories.
translation: 穿过屏障并击败守护者。这样应该就能恢复鲍勃失去的记忆。

english: I remember! Lithkren! The dragonkin! The vault!
translation: 我想起来了！利斯克伦！龙人！金库！

english: Robert! I should have known that this would be your doing.
translation: 罗伯特！我早该知道这是你的杰作。

english: It's over dragonkin. The island is ours. You have lost.
translation: 结束了，龙人。这座岛归我们了。你们输了。

english: Lost? This is no more than a minor setback. The work we have done here will see the end of your kind. You are too late to stop it.
translation: 输了？这只不过是个小挫折。我们在这里所做的工作将终结你们种族。你们已经来不及阻止了。

english: And what work might that be?
translation: 什么工作？

english: Our new weapon. One that will bring a swift end to humanity. I'd love to be able to show you, but I'm afraid I have more pressing matters.
translation: 我们的新武器。一种能迅速终结人类的东西。我很想展示给你看，但恐怕我有更紧迫的事要处理。

english: Like dying perhaps?
translation: 比如去死？

english: You'd like that, wouldn't you? Alas, I'm afraid that I won't be the one that dies today.
translation: 你倒是想，对吧？可惜，今天死的不会是我。

english: Yes we will, for this is where it begins.
translation: 会的，因为一切从这里开始。

english: No. This is where it ends.
translation: 不。一切到这里结束。

english: Aivas!
translation: 艾瓦斯！

english: You'll pay for that!
translation: 你会为此付出代价的！

english: Looks like some sort of key. For these doors I assume.
translation: 看起来像某种钥匙。我猜是用来开这些门的。

english: Should we open them?
translation: 我们要打开它们吗？

english: No. That dragonkin mentioned a weapon. One that could destroy us all. Better something like that remains hidden... for now.
translation: 不。那个龙人提到了一件武器。一件能毁灭我们所有人的武器。最好让那种东西继续隐藏下去……暂时如此。

english: How are you doing, Bob?
translation: 你还好吗，鲍勃？

english: I've got a lot to take in and understand, but I'm okay.
translation: 我有很多东西要消化和理解，但我还行。

english: So do you have all of your memories back now?
translation: 那你的记忆全都恢复了吗？

english: Yes and no. I now have my old memories again, but there are so many of them. I can't quite piece them all together yet. I need time to properly work things out.
translation: 是也不是。我找回了过去的记忆，但记忆太多了。我还不能完全把它们拼凑起来。我需要时间来理清一切。

english: However, one thing that I do remember clearly is that battle. I also remember what happened next.
translation: 不过，有一件事我记得很清楚：那场战斗。我也记得后来发生了什么。

english: So what did happen?
translation: 后来到底发生了什么事？

english: After the battle, myself, Tristan and Camorra split the key into four pieces. We vowed to ensure that the dragonkin would never recover them, and to only return once the war was won.
translation: 战斗结束后，我、特里斯坦和卡莫拉把钥匙分成了四块。我们发誓绝不让龙人找回它们，只有战争胜利后才回来。

english: But you never did?
translation: 可你们再也没回来过？

english: No. In the end, we went our seperate ways. Of the four pieces, Camorra took one, Tristan took another and I took the final two.
translation: 没有。最后，我们分道扬镳了。四块碎片中，卡莫拉拿了一块，特里斯坦拿了一块，我拿了最后两块。

english: Camorra eventually boarded a ship for lands to the far west, never to be seen again. She took her key piece with her.
translation: 卡莫拉最终登上了前往遥远西方的船只，再也没有出现过。她带走了她的那块钥匙碎片。

english: Tristan passed his piece on to his descendants. They lived in the city of Saranthium, where Varrock now stands. Perhaps the Varrock Library has some record of them.
translation: 特里斯坦把他的那块传给了后代。他们住在萨兰提姆城，也就是现在维洛克城所在的地方。也许维洛克图书馆里有关于他们的记录。

english: I hid one of my pieces in the most unlikely of places, an abandoned dragonkin fortress. You'll find the fortress on a snow covered island, north west of Rellekka.
translation: 我把其中一块藏在了最意想不到的地方——一座废弃的龙人要塞。你会在雷勒卡城西北方一座冰雪覆盖的岛屿上找到那座要塞。

english: The final piece I took to Karamja. I hid it in an ancient temple on the south coast of the island.
translation: 最后一块我带到了卡拉姆詹岛。我把它藏在了岛屿南海岸的一座古老神庙里。

english: Sounds like I have a fair amount of work to do. Thanks, Bob.
translation: 听起来我要做的事不少。谢谢你，鲍勃。

english: With the dragonkin long gone, the vault should be safe to open. That said, you should still be cautious, [player name].
translation: 龙人早已消失，金库应该是安全的，可以打开了。不过，你还是应该小心，[player name]。

english: The scars of our war with the dragonkin remain to this day, and the weapon in that vault could still be very dangerous.
translation: 我们与龙人战争留下的伤疤至今犹在，那个金库里的武器可能仍然非常危险。

english: Don't worry, I'll be careful.
translation: 别担心，我会小心的。

english: Hi, Bob. Could you remind me where those key pieces are?
translation: 嗨，鲍勃。能再告诉我那些钥匙碎片在哪儿吗？

english: The key was split into four different pieces. Camorra took one piece, Tristan took another and I took the final two.
translation: 钥匙被分成了四块不同的碎片。卡莫拉拿了一块，特里斯坦拿了一块，我拿了最后两块。

english: Camorra boarded a ship for lands to the far west, never to be seen again. She took her key piece with her.
translation: 卡莫拉登上了前往遥远西方的船只，再也没有出现过。她带走了她的那块钥匙碎片。

english: Hello. I was wondering if you could help me with something?
translation: 你好。我想知道你能不能帮我个忙？

english: Ah, you must mean Tristan Corvo. I can't remember anyone ever asking about him before. Most prefer to hear about the bigger heroes like Arrav or Robert.
translation: 啊，你肯定是指特里斯坦.科沃。我不记得以前有人问起过他。大多数人更喜欢听那些大英雄的故事，比如阿拉夫或罗伯特。

english: Well we do have census records which date back to when the city was still called Avarrocka, but I'm afraid we don't have anything from before that time.
translation: 嗯，我们有可以追溯到这座城市还叫阿瓦罗卡时期的人口普查记录，但恐怕没有更早之前的资料了。

english: Hmm... It might still be worth a look. Where can I find this information?
translation: 嗯……也许还是值得一看。我在哪里能找到这些信息？

english: I have a book around here somewhere with all of the details. Why don't you see if you can find it? It's red if I remember right.
translation: 我这附近有本书，里面记录着所有细节。你不如自己找找看？如果我没记错，是红色的。

english: Wonderful! Let's have a look.
translation: 太好了！让我们看看。

english: Okay let's see... The Corvo family... Here we are! According to this, there was a family by the name of Corvo living in Avarrocka for most of the Fourth Age.
translation: 好的，让我看看……科沃家族……找到了！根据这个记录，第四纪的大部分时间里，有一个姓科沃的家族住在阿瓦罗卡。

english: Impossible to say for sure, but it was around that time that many people left Misthalin to settle in Morytania. It's possible that the Corvo family was among them.
translation: 无法确定，但大约在那段时间，许多人离开了米斯沙林，定居在莫利塔尼亚。科沃家族可能也在其中。

english: Hello. Do you know anyone with the name Corvo?
translation: 你好。你认识姓科沃的人吗？

english: Sarah Corvo? She lives in the house next to the bank.
translation: 莎拉.科沃？她就住在银行隔壁的房子里。

english: Of course. I'm Sarah Corvo. Not many people interested in visiting me these days. What brings you here?
translation: 当然。我就是莎拉.科沃。这些天没多少人对我有兴趣。你来有什么事？

english: I'm on the hunt for the piece of a key. It was once in the possession of your ancestor, Tristan Corvo.
translation: 我在找一块钥匙碎片。它曾经由你的祖先特里斯坦.科沃保管。

english: I see. I'm afraid I can't help you. The key piece is gone.
translation: 我明白了。恐怕我帮不了你。那块钥匙碎片不见了。

english: Yes gone. When my father passed the key piece down to me, he told me that I must keep it safe no matter what. When the vampyres came to Port Phasmatys, I buried it out in the swamps to stop them getting it.
translation: 是的，不见了。我父亲把钥匙碎片传给我的时候，他告诉我无论如何都要保证它的安全。当吸血鬼来到法斯提斯港时，我把它埋在了沼泽地里，防止他们拿到。

english: But how do I get it back?
translation: 但我怎样才能拿回来呢？

english: You don't. The key piece is gone and it's safer that way. I never liked looking after that red lump of metal anyway.
translation: 你不能。钥匙碎片不见了，这样更安全。我从来就不喜欢照看那块红色金属疙瘩。

english: Hmm... I think I might know just the scientist to help me out with this. Time for me to visit Draynor Manor.
translation: 嗯……我想我知道哪位科学家能帮我解决这个问题。该去拜访德拉诺庄园了。

english: Oh, nothing. I'd best be off. Thank you for your time.
translation: 哦，没什么。我得走了。谢谢你的时间。

english: You again. You're not still after that key piece are you?
translation: 又是你。你还没放弃那块钥匙碎片吧？

english: Nope. Just stopping by to say hello.
translation: 不。只是路过打个招呼。

english: Well that was great. See you later.
translation: 那挺好。回头见。

english: I need your help with a key piece.
translation: 我需要你帮忙找一块钥匙碎片。

english: A key piece?
translation: 钥匙碎片？

english: Yes. I'm looking for the piece of a key made out of red metal. I know it's buried somewhere in Mort Myre Swamp, but I don't know exactly where. I was thinking...
translation: 是的。我在找一块红色金属制成的钥匙碎片。我知道它埋在莫尔沼泽的某个地方，但不知道确切位置。我在想……

english: You were thinking that because I made you a metal attracting device before that I'd be able to do it again.
translation: 你在想，既然我之前给你做过一个金属吸引装置，那我就能再做一次。

english: Er... yeah, pretty much.
translation: 呃……嗯，差不多。

english: Should be doable. Will need to be quite different to your device though. Much greater distance and a different type of metal. You said it was red, right?
translation: 应该可行。不过得跟你的装置大不一样。距离远得多，而且是不同类型的金属。你说它是红色的，对吧？

english: Yes it's...
translation: 是的，它是……

english: Must be orikalkum. Dragon as you adventuring lot call it. Quite rare. Should make things easier. Now let me think about this... If we just... hmm... yes... perfect!
translation: 那一定是奥利卡尔库姆。你们这些冒险者管它叫龙金属。相当稀有。应该能让事情简单些。现在让我想想……如果我们……嗯……对……完美！

english: Perfect?
translation: 完美？

english: Go get one cut dragonstone and two molten glass. Use a glassblowing pipe to craft a glass orb with the dragonstone in the centre. Once you have it, bring it to me. Any questions? Good. Bye.
translation: 去找一块切割好的龙石和两块熔融玻璃。用玻璃吹管制作一个中间镶嵌龙石的玻璃宝珠。做好之后带给我。有问题吗？好。再见。

english: Have you crafted that orb yet?
translation: 你做好那个宝珠了吗？

english: You adventurers are so forgetful. You'll need one cut dragonstone and two molten glass. Use a glassblowing pipe to craft a glass orb with the dragonstone in the centre. When you're done, bring it back here.
translation: 你们这些冒险者真健忘。你需要一块切割好的龙石和两块熔融玻璃。用玻璃吹管制作一个中间镶嵌龙石的玻璃宝珠。做好之后带回这里。

english: Excellent. Now just a few small adjustments and...
translation: 太好了。现在只需要做一些小调整……

english: Here you go. You can use this to track down that key piece of yours.
translation: 给你。你可以用这个来追踪你那块钥匙碎片。

english: Great! How does it work?
translation: 太好了！这东西怎么用？

english: The orb will pull you in the direction of the key piece, but be careful with it. It's a little unstable.
translation: 定位宝珠会把你拉向钥匙碎片的方向，但要小心使用。它有点不稳定。

english: Awesome! That's just... Wait... what do you mean unstable?
translation: 太棒了！那只是……等等……你说不稳定是什么意思？

english: Nothing to get worried about. It might just sting a bit when you use it.
translation: 没什么好担心的。只是你用它的时候可能会有点刺痛。

english: Er... great? Anyway, before I go I was wondering...
translation: 呃……好吧？总之，在我走之前，我想问一下……

english: If I could upgrade that device of yours?
translation: 我能不能升级一下你的那个装置？

english: Well now that you mention it...
translation: 嗯，既然你提到了……

english: Hmm... Might be possible. The chicken is the weakness at the moment. If you find something with a bit more kick, I might be able to upgrade it further.
translation: 嗯……也许有可能。目前鸡是弱点。如果你能找到更有劲的东西，我或许能进一步升级它。

english: Bit more kick?
translation: 更有劲？

english: Yes. Something a bit stronger. A bit more undead.
translation: 对。更强一点的东西。更偏向亡灵一点。

english: Okay... Thanks for the help Ava. See you later.
translation: 好吧……谢谢你的帮助，艾娃。回头见。

english: I already made you a locator orb. What else do you need?
translation: 我已经给你做了一个定位宝珠了。你还需要别的什么？

english: Don't get mad.
translation: 别生气。

english: You lost it, didn't you?
translation: 你把它弄丢了，对吧？

english: Well luckily for you, I made a spare. Please try to look after this one.
translation: 算你走运，我多做了一个备用的。这次请好好保管。

english: Good day, Bwana. The Kharazi jungle is especially beautiful today, isn't it?
translation: 日安，先生。今天的卡拉兹丛林格外美丽，不是吗？

english: I'm looking for an ancient temple.
translation: 我在找一个远古神庙。

english: A temple? There's an old dungeon in the south east corner of the jungle. Could this be what you seek, Bwana?
translation: 神庙？丛林东南角有一个古老的地牢。那会不会就是你要找的地方，先生？

english: It may well be. Thanks for the help.
translation: 很有可能。谢谢你的帮助。

english: I must warn you, Bwana, that place is dangous. Many of our people have entered and never returned.
translation: 我必须警告你，先生，那个地方很危险。我们很多人进去后就再也没出来过。

english: It can never be easy can it? Okay, I'll be careful. Thanks again.
translation: 事情从来都不会简单，对吧？好吧，我会小心的。再次感谢。

english: Did you try that dungeon in the south east corner of the jungle, Bwana?
translation: 你试过丛林东南角那个地牢了吗，先生？

english: I didn't. I'll look there. Thank you.
translation: 还没。我会去那里看看的。谢谢你。

english: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. How are things?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。最近怎么样？

english: Hello, Brundt. I wanted to ask you about something.
translation: 你好，布伦特。我想问你点事。

english: Well ask away, [Fremennik name].
translation: 尽管问吧，[Fremennik name]。

english: Apparently there's an island north of here with an ancient fortress on it. Have you heard of it?
translation: 据说北边有个岛，上面有座远古堡垒。你听说过吗？

english: I think I know of this island. Ungael, we call it. It is a dark place, guarded by a deadly beast. Some of our finest warriors tried to take the beast down, but to no success.
translation: 我想我知道那个岛。我们叫它昂盖尔。那是个黑暗的地方，由一头致命的野兽守护着。我们一些最优秀的战士试图击败那头野兽，但都没有成功。

english: Do you intend to slay this beast for yourself, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你打算亲自去猎杀这头野兽吗，[Fremennik name]？

english: Er... yes, I think I do.
translation: 呃……是的，我想是的。

english: This is no easy task, [Fremennik name], but glory awaits you if you succeed.
translation: 这不是件容易的事，[Fremennik name]，但如果你成功了，荣耀在等着你。

english: Go see Torfinn on the docks. He can take you to Ungael. Good luck, [Fremennik name].
translation: 去码头找托尔芬。他可以带你去昂盖尔。祝你好运，[Fremennik name]。

english: Will he talk to me while I'm exiled?
translation: 在我被流放期间，他会跟我说话吗？

english: He should do. Just tell him I sent you.
translation: 他应该会的。就告诉他是我派你去的。

english: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. Have you destroyed that beast yet?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。你干掉那头野兽了吗？

english: Well if you speak to Torfinn on the docks he will take you to Ungael. Good luck, [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果你去码头跟托尔芬说，他会带你去昂盖尔。祝你好运，[Fremennik name]。

english: Good day to you, [Fremennik name]. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。有什么能帮你的？

english: The chieftain says you can take me to Ungael.
translation: 酋长说你可以带我去昂盖尔。

english: That I can. You should know though, Ungael is a dangerous place. It is guarded by a deadly foe, one that spits fire at its enemies.
translation: 我可以。不过你应该知道，昂盖尔是个危险的地方。那里由一头致命的敌人守护着，它会向敌人喷火。

english: I shouldn't really be talking to you [Fremennik name].
translation: 我不应该跟你说话的，[Fremennik name]。

english: I know but the Chieftain says you can take me to Ungael.
translation: 我知道，但酋长说你可以带我去昂盖尔。

english: Well if the Chieftain says it's okay then I guess I can. You should know though, Ungael is a dangerous place. It is guarded by a deadly force, one that spits fire at its enemies.
translation: 既然酋长说可以，那我想我可以。不过你应该知道，昂盖尔是个危险的地方。那里由一头致命的敌人守护着，它会向敌人喷火。

english: Spits fire? Sounds like some sort of fire protection might be useful.
translation: 喷火？听起来某种防火措施可能会派上用场。

english: So, [Fremennik name], are you ready to go to Ungael?
translation: 那么，[Fremennik name]，你准备好去昂盖尔了吗？

english: Then we shall go.
translation: 那我们就出发吧。

english: I will be here when you are.
translation: 你准备好了我就在这儿。

english: Good day to you, [Fremennik name]. Do you want to go to Ungael?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。你想去昂盖尔吗？

english: I'm not meant to be talking to you [Fremennik name]. I guess I can still take you to Ungael though if you want.
translation: 我不该跟你说话的，[Fremennik name]。不过我想如果你愿意，我还是可以带你去昂盖尔。

english: She was an ancient hero who lived about two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled here at some point.
translation: 她是一位大约两千年前生活的远古英雄。我相信她曾到过这里。

english: An ancient hero? Sounds like the Library Historical Archive is where you want to be. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.
translation: 一位古代英雄？听起来你想去的是图书馆历史档案馆。去阿西乌斯图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他可以带你去那里。

english: Great. Thank you.
translation: 太好了。谢谢你。

english: I suggest you try there. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.
translation: 我建议你去那里试试。去阿西乌斯图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他可以带你去那里。

english: I think I have heard that name before. Who is she?
translation: 我想我以前听过这个名字。她是谁？

english: She was a hero who lived around two thousand years ago.
translation: 她是一位大约两千年前生活的英雄。

english: I see. We have very few records from before the founding of Kourend. That said, perhaps Imerominia could help you? As a horologist, such ancient topics may fall within her purview.
translation: 我明白了。我们在库兰德王国建立之前的记录很少。话虽如此，也许伊梅罗米尼亚能帮你？作为一位钟表学家，这类远古话题可能在她的研究范围内。

english: She's a hero from around two thousand years ago. I believe she travelled to Kourend during the Dragonkin Conflicts. I was hoping to learn more about her.
translation: 她是大约两千年前的一位英雄。我相信她在龙人冲突期间来到了库兰德王国。我希望了解更多关于她的信息。

english: I can't, but someone might be able to. The five cities of Kourend were founded long before the kingdom itself. Each city has their own historian who might have more information on the early days of their city.
translation: 我不能，但也许有人可以。库兰德王国的五座城市在王国建立之前很久就已建成。每座城市都有自己的历史学家，他们可能对各自城市的早期历史有更多了解。

english: Camorra. She was a great hero who fought in the Dragonkin Conflicts. I think she travelled to Kourend during the war. I'm trying to find out what happened to her.
translation: 卡莫拉。她是一位伟大的英雄，曾参与龙人冲突。我认为她在战争期间来到了库兰德王国。我想查明她后来怎么样了。

english: A hero? Well she wouldn't have had much to do with Hosidius. The early Hosidius settlers were all pacificts. They'd have stayed away from people like her.
translation: 一位英雄？那她跟霍西迪乌斯城应该没什么关系。早期的霍西迪乌斯城定居者都是和平主义者。他们会远离像她这样的人。

english: Oh well. Thanks for the help.
translation: 哦，好吧。谢谢你的帮助。

english: Have you heard of Camorra?
translation: 你听说过卡莫拉吗？

english: Well Shayzien was founded by those fleeing the Dragonkin Conflicts, and the city has never been short of heroes. There's a good chance she was connected to Shayzien in some way.
translation: 嗯，谢兹恩城是由那些逃离龙人冲突的人建立的，这座城市从不缺少英雄。她很有可能以某种方式与谢兹恩城有关联。

english: No, but that's not surprising. Much of our history was lost during Xeric's reign. However, there is somewhere you might find answers.
translation: 没有，但这并不奇怪。我们的大部分历史都在塞里克统治期间遗失了。不过，有个地方你或许能找到答案。

english: Let me guess... there's a catch isn't there?
translation: 让我猜猜……肯定有陷阱，对吧？

english: I'm afraid so. For hundreds of years, the crypts have been overrun by the dead. We've tried clearing them out, but they just come back again.
translation: 恐怕是的。几百年来，墓穴里到处都是亡灵。我们试图清理过，但它们总是卷土重来。

english: Well thankfully I ain't afraid of no ghosts. Where do I start?
translation: 幸好我不怕什么幽灵。我从哪里开始？

english: They're zombies and skeletons, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, west of here. Be careful.
translation: 那是僵尸和骷髅，不是幽灵。你会在英雄墓地找到墓穴入口，就在西边。小心点。

english: The most likely place to find answers is the Shayzien Crypts. You'll find the entrance in the Graveyard of Heroes, west of here. Be careful, it's filled with zombies and skeletons.
translation: 最有可能找到答案的地方是谢兹恩墓穴。你可以在西边的英雄之墓找到入口。小心，那里满是僵尸和骷髅。

english: How's it going, Bob?
translation: 最近怎么样，鲍勃？

english: Now that I've started to regain my memories, I find myself hungry for answers. I'd like to see for myself what these doors guard.
translation: 既然我开始恢复记忆，我发现自己渴望答案。我想亲眼看看这些门守卫着什么。

english: Well we'll be finding out very soon. I've managed to fix the key.
translation: 我们很快就会知道了。我已经修好了钥匙。

english: Let's see if it works then.
translation: 那就看看它能不能用吧。

english: I've managed to repair the key.
translation: 我已经修好了钥匙。

english: Well no point waiting around. Let's get these doors open.
translation: 那还等什么。咱们把这些门打开吧。

english: That is one big dragon!
translation: 好大一条龙！

english: This isn't right... We've made a mistake. We need to leave now!
translation: 这不对劲……我们犯了个错误。我们得马上离开！

english: Magnificent isn't he?
translation: 很壮观，不是吗？

english: His name is Galvek. In our tongue, it means...
translation: 他叫加尔维克。在我们的语言里，它的意思是……

english: Fate.
translation: 命运。

english: You! I remember you. Zorgoth.
translation: 你！我记得你。佐戈斯。

english: Hello, Robert. You've had quite the makeover.
translation: 你好，罗伯特。你的变化可真大。

english: You should be dead.
translation: 你应该已经死了。

english: We dragonkin are not as flimsy as you. I'm afraid you failed.
translation: 我们龙人可不像你们那么脆弱。恐怕你失败了。

english: You're a dragonkin?
translation: 你是龙人？

english: Ah, I see you brought your friend with you. I'm surprised to see you here after all this time. Curious...
translation: 啊，我看到你带了你的朋友来。真没想到过了这么久还能在这里见到你。真奇怪……

english: What do you...
translation: 你什么……

english: Hello there, dragonkin.
translation: 你好啊，龙人。

english: You I don't recognise. Who are you?
translation: 你我不认识。你是谁？

english: I'm Dallas Jones, and I came here for answers.
translation: 我是达拉斯.琼斯，我来这里寻找答案。

english: Is that so? Then tell me, Dallas Jones, what answers do you seek?
translation: 是吗？那告诉我，达拉斯.琼斯，你在寻找什么答案？

english: I want to know the truth about Elvarg, about Crandor.
translation: 我想知道关于艾尔瓦格和克兰多尔的真相。

english: Elvarg? Crandor? These names mean nothing to me.
translation: 艾尔瓦格？克兰多尔？这些名字对我来说毫无意义。

english: Elvarg was a dragon who attacked the island of Crandor. We found a lab hidden in her lair. We followed the clues and they led us here, to you.
translation: 艾尔瓦格是一条攻击克兰多尔岛的龙。我们在她的巢穴里发现了一个实验室。我们顺着线索找到了这里，找到了你。

english: You gave her a name? I never bothered. She was nothing.
translation: 你给她起了名字？我从来懒得管。她什么都不是。

english: Nothing? What do you mean?
translation: 什么都不是？你什么意思？

english: After your failed attempt on my life, I realised that we were starting to lose the war against your kind. We needed to turn the tide. We needed a new weapon.
translation: 在你刺杀我失败后，我意识到我们正在输掉与你们族的战争。我们需要扭转局势。我们需要一件新武器。

english: The creature you call Elvarg was the first. An attempt to create a being which would crush humanity once and for all. She was a failure. Too weak. Pathetic.
translation: 你们称之为艾尔瓦格的生物是第一个。一次试图创造一个能一劳永逸粉碎人类的存在的尝试。她是个失败品。太弱了。可悲。

english: We moved on. We tried various other methods, all ending in disappointment. In the end, we came here. Our largest facility yet. Here we began work on what would become our masterpiece.
translation: 我们继续前进。我们尝试了各种其他方法，都以失望告终。最后，我们来到了这里。我们迄今为止最大的设施。在这里，我们开始着手打造我们的杰作。

english: But we got here first.
translation: 但我们先到了这里。

english: An annoying setback. When you attacked, I had this place sealed, to keep our work safe. My people were to return after the attack and release me again.
translation: 一个烦人的挫折。当你们攻击时，我封闭了这里，以保护我们的工作。我的人本应在袭击后回来，把我放出来。

english: But we killed them before they could leave.
translation: 但我们赶在他们离开之前杀了他们。

english: I suspected as much. However, it turned out quite well for me in the end. I have been sealed here for hundreds of years, alone and without disturbance. More than enough time for me to perfect our salvation.
translation: 我早就猜到了。不过，结果对我来说倒是不错。我被封印在这里数百年，独自一人，不受打扰。这段时间足够让我完善我们的拯救计划了。

english: Galvek.
translation: 加尔维克。

english: Yes. He has power that no other dragon has. The power to influence the minds of other dragons. Through him, an army will be raised. One that will annihilate humanity.
translation: 没错。他拥有其他龙没有的力量——影响其他龙心智的力量。通过他，一支军队将集结起来，一支足以毁灭人类的军队。

english: Why? You attacked us. Tried to destroy us. You took away our homes, our people. Were we expected to stand by and watch?
translation: 为什么？是你们先攻击我们，试图毁灭我们。你们夺走了我们的家园，我们的同胞。难道我们该袖手旁观吗？

english: We were defending ourselves. You threatened to destroy us all.
translation: 我们是在自卫。你们威胁要毁灭我们所有人。

english: Not all of us. Only a few gave in to the anger of the curse. Only a few waged war on you. But you were not willing to distinguish. And now, neither am I.
translation: 并非我们所有人。只有少数人屈服于诅咒术的愤怒。只有少数人对你们发动了战争。但你们不愿区分。现在，我也不愿区分了。

english: Humanity is a disease. You have just unleashed the cure.
translation: 人类是一种疾病。你们刚刚释放了解药。

english: Do you really think we're letting you leave this place?
translation: 你真以为我们会让你离开这里？

english: I don't think you have a choice. Let me show you...
translation: 我不认为你们有选择。让我给你们看看……

english: Awaken!
translation: 醒来！

english: It's moving!
translation: 它在动！

english: Dallas!
translation: 达拉斯！

english: We'd better go!
translation: 我们最好快走！

english: What's happening?
translation: 发生什么事了？

english: You dare!
translation: 你敢！

english: The doors are unlocked! Release us!
translation: 门没锁！放我们出去！

english: That really hurt!
translation: 好痛！

english: It looks like we may have a slight problem on our hands.
translation: 看来我们手头可能有点小麻烦了。

english: What do we do? That dragonkin said he was going to assemble an army of dragons!
translation: 我们怎么办？那个龙人说他要集结一支龙族大军！

english: This is too much for just us to deal with. We're going to need some help.
translation: 单凭我们对付不了。我们需要帮手。

english: Any suggestions?
translation: 有什么建议吗？

english: King Roald commands one of the largest armies in the world. He's probably a good starting point.
translation: 罗尔德国王统领着世界上最大的军队之一。从他开始应该不错。

english: Good plan. I'll go see the King.
translation: 好计划。我去见国王。

english: And I'll get in touch with Keldagrim. Maybe they can help us.
translation: 我去联系凯尔达格林城。也许他们能帮忙。

english: Hello there. Do you need something?
translation: 你好。有什么事吗？

english: I'm here to talk about dragons.
translation: 我是来谈龙的事情的。

english: If you mean the dragons that have been spotted flying around, we're well aware. I have my best people investigating this and we will make sure the citizens are safe. Now, be on your way.
translation: 如果你指的是那些被目击到处飞的龙，我们很清楚。我已经派了最得力的人调查此事，我们会确保市民的安全。现在，你可以走了。

english: Wait! I know what the dragons are doing.
translation: 等等！我知道那些龙在做什么。

english: Yes. There's a dragonkin named Zorgoth who has managed to bring them under his control. He is forming an army which he intends to use to attack humanity!
translation: 是的。有个叫佐戈斯的龙人设法控制了它们。他正在组建一支军队，打算用它来攻击人类！

english: A dragonkin? That's preposterous. The dragonkin have been dead for hundreds of years.
translation: 龙人？荒谬。龙人已经死了几百年了。

english: I know it sounds crazy, but you have to believe me! Why else would the dragons be acting so odd?
translation: 我知道这听起来很疯狂，但你必须相信我！不然那些龙为什么行为如此反常？

english: Well I suppose you've been a friend to Varrock in the past. What would you ask of us?
translation: 好吧，我想你过去一直是维洛克的朋友。你希望我们做什么？

english: You need to gather your soldiers. We have to destroy this dragon threat before it destroys us.
translation: 你需要集结你的士兵。我们必须赶在这龙患毁灭我们之前消灭它。

english: Gather the soldiers? My lord, do you know what this means?
translation: 集结士兵？陛下，您知道这意味着什么吗？

english: Of course I know what it means. But this citizen is right, we have no choice.
translation: 我当然知道这意味着什么。但这位市民说得对，我们别无选择。

english: But my lord...
translation: 可是陛下……

english: Enough. This enemy is threatening us directly and we must respond.
translation: 够了。这个敌人直接威胁到我们，我们必须回应。

english: Enough. This isn't like Morytania. There is no godly involvement here. This enemy is threatening us directly and we must respond.
translation: 够了。这和莫利塔尼亚不同。这里没有神明的介入。这个敌人直接威胁到我们，我们必须回应。

english: I will make the necessary preparations. In the meantime, citizen, you will visit King [Lathas/Thoros], Chieftain Brundt and Sir Amik Varze. Tell them to come to Varrock to discuss the dragon threat.
translation: 我会做必要的准备。同时，市民，你去拜访拉萨斯国王/索罗斯国王、布伦特酋长和阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士。告诉他们到维洛克城来商议龙患。

english: Chieftain Brundt? You would ally with those barbarians?
translation: 布伦特酋长？你要和那些野蛮人结盟？

english: For Saradomin's sake! They have ships and they have soldiers! We need them on our side.
translation: 看在萨拉多明的份上！他们有船有士兵！我们需要他们站在我们这边。

english: I'm not sure if we want King Lathas on our side.
translation: 我不确定我们是否想让拉萨斯国王站在我们这边。

english: You as well? Put your petty disagreements aside and look at the big picture. We must all work together if we are to survive.
translation: 连你也这样？放下你们那些小分歧，看看大局。如果我们想活下去，就必须团结一致。

english: Now, you should get moving. Time is not on our side. While you're gone, I'll have Aeonisig reach out to some other people as well. We need all the help we can get.
translation: 现在，你该动身了。时间不等人。你不在的时候，我会让艾奥尼西格也联系其他人。我们需要尽可能多的帮助。

english: Hello there. Have you spoken to the other leaders yet?
translation: 你好。你和其他领袖谈过了吗？

english: Not yet. Who am I meant to be speaking to again?
translation: 还没有。我该去找谁来着？

english: Talk to King [Lathas/Thoros], Chieftain Brundt and Sir Amik Varze. Tell them that they are needed in Varrock to discuss the dragon threat. Now hurry up and get it done.
translation: 去找拉萨斯国王/索罗斯国王、布伦特酋长和阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士。告诉他们需要到维洛克城讨论龙患。快去完成。

english: Hello, Sir Amik.
translation: 你好，阿米克爵士。

english: I assume you mean all these dragons that have been flying around. Do you know something?
translation: 我猜你指的是那些飞来飞去的龙。你知道些什么？

english: I do. It's not good I'm afraid. The dragons are uniting under a dragonkin named Zorgoth. He intends to use them against us.
translation: 是的。恐怕不是什么好消息。那些龙正在一个名叫佐戈斯的龙人带领下联合起来。他打算用它们来对付我们。

english: I thought all the dragonkin were dead!
translation: 我以为所有龙人都死了！

english: History says they are a formidable enemy. Do you have a plan to combat this threat?
translation: 历史上说他们是个可怕的敌人。你有应对这个威胁的计划吗？

english: King Roald is forming an army to take on the dragons. He's requested your presence in Varrock to discuss this.
translation: 罗尔德国王正在组建一支军队来对付这些龙。他要求你到维洛克城商议此事。

english: Very well, I shall head to Varrock. Thank you for passing on this message.
translation: 很好，我会前往维洛克城。谢谢你传达这个消息。

english: Hello there. I will be leaving for Varrock soon.
translation: 你好。我很快就要动身去维洛克城了。

english: I'll see you there.
translation: 到时候见。

english: Greetings. Do you require something?
translation: 你好。需要什么吗？

english: I wanted to talk to you about some dragons.
translation: 我想和你谈谈关于龙的事情。

english: We've had various reports come in about a sudden increase in dragon activity. I assume this is what you're referring to?
translation: 我们收到多份报告，说龙的活动突然增加。我猜你指的就是这个？

english: It is. The increase in activity is caused by a dragonkin called Zorgoth. He's forming an army of dragons to destroy humanity with.
translation: 是的。活动增加是由一个叫佐戈斯的龙人引起的。他正在组建一支龙族大军，用来毁灭人类。

english: I see. I will ensure our forces are ready to fight back against this threat.
translation: 我明白了。我会确保我们的军队准备好反击这个威胁。

english: You need not fight it alone. King Roald is preparing his own men and would like you to fight with him. A meeting is to be held in Varrock to plan the defence.
translation: 你不必孤军奋战。罗尔德国王正在准备他的人马，希望你能和他并肩作战。将在维洛克城举行会议，商讨防御计划。

english: An alliance with King Roald? Interesting. We have no quarrel with Misthalin. I accept.
translation: 与罗尔德国王结盟？有意思。我们和密斯萨林并无争执。我接受。

english: Great. I'll see you in Varrock.
translation: 太好了。维洛克城见。

english: I appreciate you're busy, but I wanted to talk to you about some dragons.
translation: 我知道你很忙，但我想和你谈谈关于龙的事情。

english: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. Have you seen those beasts flying towards Ungael? Might be best to stay clear of that place for a while.
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。你看到那些飞向昂格尔的野兽了吗？最好暂时离那个地方远点。

english: Hello, Brundt. That's what I wanted to talk to you about.
translation: 你好，布伦特。我就是想和你谈这个。

english: Let me guess, you intend to take these beasts on?
translation: 让我猜猜，你打算对付这些野兽？

english: You are a true warrior, [Fremennik name], though I fear this may be too much even for you. You are heavily outnumbered.
translation: 你是个真正的战士，[Fremennik name]，不过我担心这对你来说也太过分了。你们寡不敌众。

english: I don't plan on doing it alone. I have the support of King Roald. I was hoping you'd help as well.
translation: 我没打算独自去做。我有罗尔德国王的支持。我希望你也能帮忙。

english: Fight alongside outerlanders? That is not typically our way, [Fremennik name].
translation: 和外乡人并肩作战？这通常不是我们的作风，[Fremennik name]。

english: I understand. However, these dragons are threatening humanity as a whole. We must fight back.
translation: 我明白。不过，这些龙威胁的是整个人类。我们必须反击。

english: Well let it not be said that the Fremennik turned away from a good fight. You have our support. Maybe we'll show your outerlander friends a thing or two!
translation: 好吧，不能让人说弗雷门尼克人逃避一场好战斗。我们支持你。也许我们还能教教你那些外乡朋友一两招！

english: The council won't be happy. I'll tell them we're doing it to show your outerlander friends how to fight. That should convince them.
translation: 议会不会高兴的。我会告诉他们，我们这么做是为了教你的外乡朋友如何战斗。这应该能说服他们。

english: Thanks, Brundt. There is to be a meeting in Varrock to discuss our plan of action. It would be good if you could attend.
translation: 谢谢，布伦特。将在维洛克城举行会议，讨论行动计划。如果你能参加就太好了。

english: Pah! Outerlanders and their meetings. I will attend, but this better not take long. We have dragons to kill!
translation: 哼！外乡人和他们的会议。我会参加，但这最好别花太长时间。我们还有龙要杀呢！

english: Hello, Brundt. Are you ready for the meeting in Varrock.
translation: 你好，布伦特。你准备好去维洛克城开会了吗？

english: I shall be heading there soon, [Fremennik name].
translation: 我很快就要动身了，[Fremennik name]。

english: In that case, I'll see you there.
translation: 那样的话，到时候见。

english: Hello, Bob.
translation: 你好，鲍勃。

english: Hello, [player name]. How's it going?
translation: 你好，[player name]。怎么样？

english: I've arranged a meeting with King Roald and some other rulers. We're going to discuss how to combat the dragons.
translation: 我已经安排了与罗尔德国王和其他一些统治者的会议。我们将讨论如何对抗这些龙。

english: It's not the dragons I'm worried about, [player name]. It's Zorgoth.
translation: 我担心的不是龙，[player name]。是佐戈斯。

english: We'll beat him.
translation: 我们会打败他的。

english: I hope you're right. You'd better head in and get this meeting done. Come talk to me once it's finished. There's something we need to discuss.
translation: 希望你是对的。你最好进去把会议开完。结束后过来找我，有件事我们需要谈谈。

english: Hello, Jardric.
translation: 你好，贾德里克。

english: Hello there. While you were arranging this meeting I spoke to the Consortium in Keldagrim. I'm afraid they won't be helping us.
translation: 你好。在你安排会议的时候，我和凯尔达格林城的联合矿业谈过了。恐怕他们不会帮助我们。

english: Well we still have Roald and the other rulers.
translation: 好吧，我们还有罗尔德和其他统治者。

english: Indeed. Speaking of which, you should head on in. The meeting will be starting soon.
translation: 确实。说到这个，你该进去了。会议很快就要开始了。

english: Thank you all for coming. As I'm sure you are aware, we are facing one of the greatest threats ever seen in our time.
translation: 感谢各位的到来。我相信你们都知道，我们正面临我们这个时代最严重的威胁之一。

english: Our job here is to decide upon a solution and then enact it.
translation: 我们在这里的任务是决定一个解决方案，然后付诸实施。

english: The solution is clear. We need to take these dragons head on and destroy them.
translation: 解决方案很清楚。我们需要正面迎击这些龙，消灭它们。

english: Careful Lathas. I have seen the horrors of war first hand. This is not something we should merrily jump into.
translation: 小心点，拉萨斯。我亲身经历过战争的恐怖。这不是我们应该轻易涉足的事情。

english: And what would the great King Arthur have us do? Would you cower in fear while these dragons annihilate those around you?
translation: 那么伟大的亚瑟王想让我们做什么？难道你要在恐惧中退缩，任由这些龙消灭你身边的人们吗？

english: Enough!
translation: 够了！

english: With our forces united, we should have the strength to take on these dragons and destroy them.
translation: 我们的力量联合起来，应该有能力对抗这些龙并消灭它们。

english: I take no joy in it, but war may be the only option here. If even half of what history says is true, the dragonkin are merciless.
translation: 我并不以此为乐，但战争可能是唯一的选择。如果历史记载哪怕只有一半是真的，龙人是冷酷无情的。

english: Before this meeting, I thought I'd have a good old rummage around in our archives. I'm afraid the old bean is right. War is inevitable.
translation: 在会议开始前，我在我们的档案里好好翻了一遍。恐怕那位老伙计是对的。战争不可避免。

english: With all due respect, how can we be sure that this is the work of a dragonkin? I trust [player name] as much as anyone, but what if there was a mistake?
translation: 恕我直言，我们怎么能确定这是龙人的所作所为？我和任何人一样信任[player name]，但万一弄错了呢？

english: It's no mistake. I saw it myself.
translation: 没错，我亲眼所见。

english: They speak the truth.
translation: 他们说的是实话。

english: Let me guess, you used your magic to work that one out?
translation: 让我猜猜，你是用魔法算出来的？

english: Careful, Brundt, I am not the enemy here.
translation: 说话小心点，布伦特，我可不是你的敌人。

english: If we are agreed that the threat is real, may I suggest we get to work on solving it rather than bickering amongst ourselves.
translation: 既然我们都同意威胁是真实存在的，不如先想办法解决它，而不是在这里内讧。

english: As much as I hate to agree with a White Knight, he's right. We need to work together if we are going to survive.
translation: 虽然我很不想同意白骑士的话，但他说的对。要想活命，我们就得合作。

english: The dragons are amassing at Ungael. We should take the fight to them and destroy the danger before it leaves that island!
translation: 龙群正在昂格尔集结。我们应该主动出击，在它们离开那座岛之前消灭这个威胁！

english: That would keep the fight away from any innocents, but it would be a great risk.
translation: 这样可以把战斗引离无辜的人，但风险也很大。

english: Indeed. Boats do not do well against dragonfire.
translation: 确实。船可扛不住龙火。

english: The citizens must take priority. If we have an opportunity to keep the danger away from them, we should take it.
translation: 市民的安全必须优先考虑。既然有机会把危险挡在远处，我们就该抓住它。

english: Well said, fellow. Well said indeed.
translation: 说得好，朋友。说得真好。

english: So we amass the fleets?
translation: 那我们就集结舰队？

english: We do. Unless anyone has any complaints. [player name]? You've been very quiet throughout this. What are your thoughts?
translation: 就这么办。除非有人反对。[player name]？你一直很安静。你怎么看？

english: It's a good plan.
translation: 这是个好计划。

english: It's a bad plan.
translation: 这是个烂计划。

english: I fear we don't have a choice. The risks are great, but they were always going to be with a threat like this.
translation: 恐怕我们别无选择。风险很大，但面对这样的威胁，风险从来就少不了。

english: He's right. This is the only option.
translation: 他说得对。这是唯一的选择。

english: Then we are agreed. This room contains some of the most powerful people in the world. Heroes and rulers alike. We may be the only thing that stands in the way of annihilation.
translation: 那我们就达成一致了。这个房间里聚集了世界上最强大的一些人，有英雄也有统治者。我们可能是阻止毁灭的唯一希望。

english: We may not all like each other, and some of us have a checkered history, but we will work together to destroy this enemy.
translation: 我们也许并不都喜欢彼此，有些人还有不光彩的历史，但我们会携手合作，消灭这个敌人。

english: Good luck to us all.
translation: 祝我们大家好运。

english: You should join us for this fight, [Fremennik name]. Torfinn will take you to the fleet when you are ready.
translation: 你应该加入我们这场战斗，[Fremennik name]。准备好了就去找托尔芬，他会带你去舰队。

english: Could I have a word with you outside, [player name]? There's something we need to discuss.
translation: 能出来跟你说句话吗，[player name]？有件事我们需要谈谈。

english: Hello, [player name]. We need to talk about Zorgoth.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我们需要谈谈佐戈斯。

english: What about him?
translation: 他怎么了？

english: He is the real threat here. You can kill as many dragons as you want in this battle, but it won't be over until Zorgoth himself is dealt with.
translation: 他才是真正的威胁。这场战斗里你可以杀再多龙，但只要佐戈斯本人没被解决，事情就没完。

english: Do you have a plan?
translation: 你有计划吗？

english: Dragonkin are not easy to kill. In fact, they are immune to most weapons. But Zorgoth made it clear that Galvek is the key to his plan. The only reason he has this army is because of that dragon.
translation: 龙人可不好杀。事实上，大多数武器对他们都无效。但佐戈斯明确表示，加尔维克是他计划的关键。他之所以有这支军队，全靠那条龙。

english: So Galvek must die?
translation: 所以加尔维克必须死？

english: Yes. Without Galvek, Zorgoth has nothing. Removing his army is the only chance of stopping him. It must be done, no matter the cost.
translation: 是的。没有加尔维克，佐戈斯就一无所有。除掉他的军队是阻止他的唯一机会。必须这么做，无论代价如何。

english: That won't be easy.
translation: 那不会容易。

english: It won't, but I have faith in you, [player name]. Now you'd better head to the fleet. I'll see you in Rellekka.
translation: 是不容易，但我相信你，[player name]。现在你最好去舰队了。我们雷勒卡城见。

english: You're coming with us?
translation: 你跟我们一起？

english: I am. I can't fight any more, but I know a lot about the dragonkin. I might be able to use that knowledge to help. Besides, much of this is my fault, so it's only right that I help fix it. Now let's get going.
translation: 是的。我不能再战斗了，但我对龙人了解很多。也许能用这些知识帮上忙。再说，这很大程度上是我的错，所以我来帮忙也是应该的。我们走吧。

english: Our armies are preparing for the assault on Ungael. Speak to Torfinn in Rellekka when you are ready, he will take you to the fleet.
translation: 我们的军队正在准备进攻昂格尔。准备好了就去雷勒卡城找托尔芬，他会带你去舰队。

english: Good day to you, [Fremennik name]. Do you want to go to the fleet?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。你想去舰队吗？

english: I'm not meant to be talking to you [Fremennik name]. I guess I can still take you to the fleet though if you want.
translation: 我不该跟你说话，[Fremennik name]。不过如果你愿意，我还是可以带你去舰队。

english: Alert!
translation: 警报！

english: I can see the island! We're almost there!
translation: 我看到岛了！我们快到了！

english: Incoming!
translation: 来了！

english: Time to wake up, [Fremennik name]. You have dragons to slay!
translation: 该醒醒了，[Fremennik name]。你有龙要杀！

english: Eugh... what happened?
translation: 呃……发生了什么？

english: Dragons happened, that's what.
translation: 龙来了，就这么回事。

english: Where did everyone else go?
translation: 其他人都去哪了？

english: They went on ahead. You should catch up. I'll cover the rear.
translation: 他们先走了。你应该跟上。我来断后。

english: [player name]! Thank goodness you're here. We've got ourselves into quite the situation.
translation: [player name]！谢天谢地你来了。我们可摊上大事了。

english: What do we do? We're never going to make it to the island now.
translation: 我们怎么办？现在肯定到不了岛上了。

english: We'll have to worry about that later. For now, you'll need to take out these dragons.
translation: 那事以后再说。现在，你得先干掉这些龙。

english: No time to talk, [player name]. Get out there and kill those dragons.
translation: 没时间闲聊了，[player name]。出去杀了那些龙。

english: Well look who it is. I see you're still alive.
translation: 看看这是谁。看来你还活着。

english: I'm not easy to kill.
translation: 我可没那么容易死。

english: As for you, Robert...
translation: 至于你，罗伯特……

english: You should have stayed at home. You're not a warrior anymore.
translation: 你本该待在家里的。你已经不是战士了。

english: Maybe not, but I'm right where I need to be.
translation: 也许不是，但我正该在这里。

english: How touching.
translation: 真感人。

english: I'm sorry, [player name].
translation: 对不起，[player name]。

english: Bob!
translation: 鲍勃！

english: See how the mighty fall.
translation: 看看强者是怎么倒下的。

english: You will pay for this!
translation: 你要为此付出代价！

english: Why do you persist? Can't you see you've already lost?
translation: 你为什么还要坚持？你看不出来你已经输了吗？

english: Enough of this! You've had your fun! But that fun is at an end!
translation: 够了！你玩够了吧！但游戏到此为止了！

english: We've got your back, [player name]. Now you show that dragon what for!
translation: 我们支持你，[player name]。现在让那条龙见识见识你的厉害！

english: Yes, come on, Dragon Slayer. Let's see what you've got.
translation: 是的，来吧，屠龙者。让我们看看你有什么本事。

english: Nooooooooooo!
That was for Bob!
translation: 这是为了鲍勃！

english: A true warrior.
translation: 真正的战士。

english: Good show old bean!
translation: 干得漂亮，老伙计！

english: Great work, [Fremennik name].
translation: 干得好，[Fremennik name]。

english: You did it!
translation: 你做到了！

english: I hear we have a hero in our midst. You have faced one of the greatest threats this world has ever seen and come out victorious.
translation: 我听说我们中间出了一位英雄。你面对了这个世界有史以来最大的威胁之一，并取得了胜利。

english: Not without losses though.
translation: 但也付出了代价。

english: Indeed. We will ensure their sacrifice is never forgotten.
translation: 确实。我们会确保他们的牺牲永不被人遗忘。

english: All that remains is to ensure that history will forever remember this day. Now, tell me everything.
translation: 剩下的就是确保历史永远铭记这一天。现在，把一切都告诉我吧。

english: Thank you friend. You have helped us to fill our Library of Knowledge. The secrets that you have uncovered are worth more than any coin. It is an honour to welcome you into the Myths' Guild.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。你帮我们充实了知识图书馆。你发现的秘密比任何金币都珍贵。很荣幸欢迎你加入神话公会。

english: Zorgoth?
translation: 佐戈斯？

english: Dead.
translation: 死了。

english: Then we are free at last!
translation: 那我们终于自由了！

english: And a strength grows within us!
translation: 而且一股力量在我们体内增长！

english: The Stone has been uncovered. The mortals try to claim its power.
translation: 石头被发现了。凡人们试图夺取它的力量。

english: Then let us bring terror and pain to them!
translation: 那就让我们给他们带去恐惧和痛苦！

english: Yes! The dragonkin will rise once more!
translation: 没错！龙人将再次崛起！

english: Uuummmpf...
translation: 唔嗯嗯...

english: Owww... paaaain.
Don't move, don't move!
translation: 别动，别动！

english: You'll be okay. You'll be fine.
translation: 你会没事的。你会好起来的。

english: Help me.
translation: 救救我。

english: I will, just stay still.
translation: 我会的，你保持不动。

english: Just about.
translation: 差不多。

english: Just don't worry.
translation: 别担心。

english: You think things will turn out okay?
translation: 你觉得事情会好起来吗？

english: Well, probably not, to be honest.
translation: 嗯，说实话，可能不会。

english: I thought so. I'm doomed!
translation: 我就知道。我完蛋了！

english: I'm going to have to go soon.
translation: 我很快就要走了。

english: Oh no, please don't leave me alone!
translation: 哦不，请别丢下我一个人！

english: Sorry, I have work to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有事要做。

english: I don't think I will survive much longer.
translation: 我觉得我撑不了多久了。

english: It's quite dark down here.
translation: 这里真暗啊。

english: I hadn't noticed. Who knows what danger lurks in the shadows. I'm so scared.
translation: 我没注意到。谁知道阴影里藏着什么危险。我好害怕。

english: Did you hear that noise?
translation: 你听到那个声音了吗？

english: What!
translation: 什么！

english: I thought I heard something...
translation: 我好像听到了什么...

english: Oh no, they're coming to get us!
translation: 哦不，他们来抓我们了！

english: No, it's okay. I must have been imagining things.
translation: 不，没事。一定是我幻听了。

english: You're looking better now.
translation: 你现在看起来好多了。

english: You're lying. I look dreadful.
translation: 你撒谎。我看起来糟透了。

english: No, honest.
translation: 不，真的。

english: Really? In what way?
translation: 真的？哪里好了？

english: You don't look dead any more, for a start.
translation: 首先，你看起来不像死人了。

english: Well it's a start, I suppose. Doesn't sound too promising.
translation: 好吧，算是个开始吧。听起来不太乐观。

english: Well, you look and sound more lively.
translation: 嗯，你看起来和听起来都更有活力了。

english: That's promising. Perhaps I will make it out of here.
translation: 这有希望。也许我能活着离开这里。

english: How long have you been down here?
translation: 你在这里待了多久了？

english: I don't know, probably days. I just can't remember.
translation: 我不知道，大概好几天了。我记不清了。

english: That's quite terrible.
translation: 那真是太糟了。

english: This place gives me the creeps!
translation: 这地方让我毛骨悚然！

english: Me too. I'm so scared. Please don't leave me.
translation: 我也是。我好害怕。请别离开我。

english: I'm afraid I shall have to soon.
translation: 恐怕我很快就要走了。

english: Feeling positive?
translation: 感觉乐观吗？

english: Are you looking forward to getting out?
translation: 你期待出去吗？

english: Definitely. A good wash, fresh clothes, a nice meal.
translation: 当然。好好洗个澡，换身干净衣服，吃顿好的。

english: Just take it a step at a time.
translation: 一步一步来。

english: Sorry, I was getting a bit over-excited there, I think.
translation: 抱歉，我想我刚才有点太激动了。

english: Thank you, your help really is appreciated.
translation: 谢谢你，你的帮助真的很感激。

english: Why do you look so sad?
translation: 你为什么看起来这么难过？

english: Wouldn't you if you were about to die?
translation: 如果你快死了，你难道不会吗？

english: I imagine so.
translation: 我想也是。

english: Cheer up, it may never happen!
translation: 振作点，也许根本不会发生！

english: True, I may never get out of here.
translation: 说得对，我可能永远出不去。

english: Always so negative. It's not good for you!
translation: 总是这么消极。这对你没好处！

english: Those are some deep cuts on your legs.
translation: 你腿上有几道很深的伤口。

english: Cuts? I hadn't noticed. Where?
translation: 伤口？我没注意到。在哪里？

english: There, just above your shin.
translation: 那里，就在你胫骨上方。

english: Oh no, oh no, oh no.
translation: 哦不，哦不，哦不。

english: Stop panicking!
translation: 别慌！

english: Easy for you to say!
translation: 你说得倒轻松！

english: I think I feel a bit ill.
translation: 我觉得有点不舒服。

english: Ill? You can't feel ill, I'm depending on you!
translation: 生病？你不能生病，我还指望你呢！

english: I can't help being ill.
translation: 生病又不是我能控制的。

english: You seem like a nice guy.
translation: 你看起来是个好人。

english: Ah, thanks. That's a really nice thing to say.
translation: 啊，谢谢。你这么说真是太好了。

english: I thought I had better say it before it's too late.
translation: 我觉得还是趁早说出来好，免得来不及。

english: Oh, I see. I understand.
translation: 哦，我明白了。我理解。

english: Just being honest.
translation: 只是实话实说。

english: Thank you. Right back at ya!
translation: 谢谢你。你也一样！

english: I can't believe how many suqahs are on this island.
translation: 真不敢相信这个岛上居然有这么多苏卡。

english: You're right. I really should never have come to this island.
translation: 你说得对。我真不该来这个岛。

english: Perhaps you're right.
translation: 也许你说得对。

english: Don't you think you should give up being an adventurer?
translation: 你不觉得自己该放弃当冒险者了吗？

english: Well, erm... you know.
translation: 嗯，呃……你知道的。

english: You don't seem to be doing too well at the moment.
translation: 你现在看起来状态不太好。

english: Thanks for the support, friend.
translation: 谢谢你的支持，朋友。

english: When we get out of here I'll buy you a drink!
translation: 等我们出去我请你喝一杯！

english: That's nice, what kind?
translation: 那不错啊，喝什么？

english: Whatever and wherever you want - my treat.
translation: 你想喝什么、在哪儿喝都行——我请客。

english: That's really appreciated. Thank you.
translation: 真的很感激。谢谢。

english: Something cheap. Although it's my pleasure, helping you is costing me.
translation: 来点便宜的吧。虽然我很乐意帮你，但这样下去我可要破费了。

english: Okay. Fair enough.
translation: 好吧，说得有道理。

english: Hope you don't mind me saying, but you smell a bit.
translation: 希望你别介意我说，你身上有点味道。

english: No it's not, this is so embarrassing.
translation: 不会吧，太尴尬了。

english: It'll be a while before we get out.
translation: 我们还得过一阵子才能出去。

english: Oh no. I don't think I can stand much more.
translation: 哦不。我觉得我快撑不住了。

english: Well you have to. You just have to.
translation: 但你必须撑住。你必须。

english: Air. I wish I could breathe fresh air.
translation: 空气。我真希望能呼吸到新鲜空气。

english: I'm very impressed you managed to get into this cave.
translation: 你能爬进这个洞穴，真让我印象深刻。

english: I must admit it was hard to crawl this far.
translation: 我得承认，爬这么远确实很难。

english: I would have given up personally.
translation: 要是我，早就放弃了。

english: Really? I was determined to survive.
translation: 真的吗？我下定决心要活下去。

english: That's good!
translation: 那就好！

english: Congratulations on not dying!
translation: 恭喜你没死！

english: Oh. Erm. Thanks.
translation: 哦，呃……谢谢。

english: Good job you didn't find more suqah down here.
translation: 还好你没在下面发现更多苏卡。

english: I suppose so. But now that I think about it, I don't know why there are none down here.
translation: 我想是吧。但话说回来，我也不知道为什么下面一只都没有。

english: I wonder why nothing lives down here.
translation: 我在想为什么下面什么活物都没有。

english: I haven't really thought about it.
translation: 我还真没想过这个问题。

english: It's probably not very easy to survive down here.
translation: 可能在这里活下去不太容易吧。

english: I trust you usually look smarter.
translation: 我相信你平时看起来更精神。

english: Yes, I am a bit scruffy at the moment.
translation: 是的，我现在是有点邋遢。

english: Just a bit.
translation: 只是有一点。

english: Not to worry.
translation: 别担心。

english: It's a bit damp in here.
translation: 这里有点潮湿。

english: Is it? I suppose so. Why do you say that?
translation: 是吗？我想是吧。你为什么这么说？

english: Just concerned that it will make your condition worse.
translation: 只是担心会让你的情况更糟。

english: It wouldn't surprise me. I don't seem to be having much luck recently.
translation: 这倒不奇怪。我最近运气一直不太好。

english: Spider!
translation: 蜘蛛！

english: Arrghh! Where?
translation: 啊！在哪？

english: Oh, you scared me to death.
translation: 哦，你吓死我了。

english: You'll survive this easily.
translation: 这点事你肯定能挺过去。

english: I'm not so sure.
translation: 我不太确定。

english: Come on. Think positive!
translation: 振作点。往好处想！

english: What's the point?
translation: 有什么意义呢？

english: Think of all the places you can visit when you get out!
translation: 想想你出去后能去多少地方！

english: That's true.
translation: 那倒是真的。

english: Such possibilities and adventures!
translation: 那么多的可能性和冒险！

english: Yes. I can't wait!
translation: 是啊。我等不及了！

english: Because otherwise you'll fail.
translation: 因为否则你会失败。

english: Failure...
translation: 失败……

english: Yes. So you must think positive.
translation: 对。所以你必须往好处想。

english: I'll try, maybe when I feel a bit stronger.
translation: 我会试试，也许等我感觉好点再说。

english: I had better be going now.
translation: 我最好现在就走。

english: Oh no please don't go.
translation: 哦不，请别走。

english: Please.
translation: 求你了。

english: I... I... need you to help me.
translation: 我……我……需要你帮我。

english: What are you going to do when you get out of here?
translation: 你出去以后打算做什么？

english: Well I don't know. What should I do?
translation: 嗯，我不知道。我该做什么？

english: That's up to you. You could travel with me!
translation: 这取决于你。你可以跟我一起旅行！

english: You'd do that for me? That sounds marvellous! I will look forward to it.
translation: 你愿意为我这样做吗？听起来太棒了！我会期待的。

english: If I were you I'd stay indoors.
translation: 如果我是你，我会待在屋里。

english: You have a good point there.
translation: 你说得有道理。

english: Any chance you could pay me for this?
translation: 你能不能给我点报酬？

english: Perhaps. Oh, but I don't think I have any money left on me.
translation: 也许吧。哦，但我身上好像没钱了。

english: It's very cold down here.
translation: 下面好冷。

english: Yes. Could you perhaps give me a blanket?
translation: 是啊。你能给我条毯子吗？

english: No, sorry. I don't have any on me.
translation: 不，抱歉。我身上没有。

english: I'll probably be okay. Thanks, though.
translation: 我可能还好。不过谢谢。

english: It's a good thing you have me to look after you.
translation: 幸好有我来照顾你。

english: That is true.
translation: 那倒是真的。

english: I rule!
translation: 我最厉害！

english: You ought to be careful with that attitude.
translation: 你这个态度最好小心点。

english: No, I don't have to worry about anything because I'm the best!
translation: 不，我什么都不用担心，因为我是最棒的！

english: We'll see.
translation: 走着瞧。

english: Not that I'm bragging or anything.
translation: 我不是在吹牛什么的。

english: That's okay. I think you deserve it a bit for saving my life.
translation: 没关系。我觉得你救了我的命，多少有资格这么说。

english: What would you do if I wasn't here?
translation: 如果我不在这里，你会怎么办？

english: Probably be dead I suppose.
translation: 大概已经死了吧，我想。

english: Quite the coincidence that I found you!
translation: 我找到你真是巧啊！

english: Yes, I think I've been very lucky.
translation: 是啊，我觉得自己很幸运。

english: That you have.
translation: 你确实很幸运。

english: So you don't know how long you've been down here?
translation: 所以你也不知道自己在这里待了多久？

english: No. Could have been days. I don't remember much after stumbling down the ladder: just crawling.
translation: 不知道。可能好几天了。我只记得跌跌撞撞地爬下梯子之后的事就不太记得了：只是一直爬。

english: That's quite scary.
translation: 那挺吓人的。

english: Not long now and you'll be back on your feet!
translation: 用不了多久你就能重新站起来了！

english: Oh, my friend, you really think so?
translation: 哦，我的朋友，你真的这么认为吗？

english: That kind of depends.
translation: 那要看情况。

english: On whether we have to amputate your legs or not.
translation: 取决于我们是否要截掉你的腿。

english: Amputate! You can't be serious?
translation: 截肢！你不是认真的吧？

english: Ooops, erm, no I'm sure it won't come to that.
translation: 哎呀，呃，不，我肯定不会到那一步的。

english: Oh no. Why can't I die peacefully?
translation: 哦不。为什么我不能安详地死去？

english: On whether you mind me helping you further.
translation: 关于你是否介意我进一步帮助你。

english: I'm so glad to have your help. I would never turn it down!
translation: 我很高兴能得到你的帮助。我绝不会拒绝！

english: I am glad.
translation: 我很高兴。

english: Do you think there is anyone else down here?
translation: 你觉得这下面还有其他人吗？

english: Depends on what the person is like.
translation: 那要看那个人是什么样的人。

english: Hmm, hopefully someone nice.
translation: 嗯，希望是个好人。

english: Oh I do hope so!
translation: 哦，我真希望如此！

english: You've got quite the collection of bruises there!
translation: 你身上可真是伤痕累累啊！

english: I know. It hurts to move.
translation: 我知道。动一下都疼。

english: They will mend in time.
translation: 它们会慢慢愈合的。

english: Time is something I don't have much of.
translation: 时间对我来说不多了。

english: Since when did you only have one leg?
translation: 你什么时候只剩一条腿了？

english: One leg! What the?
translation: 一条腿！搞什么？

english: So mean.
translation: 真刻薄。

english: I'm tired, I think I'll take a nap.
translation: 我累了，我想打个盹。

english: Now?
translation: 现在？

english: Oh, no reason. Just thought you would help me out.
translation: 哦，没什么原因。只是觉得你会帮我一把。

english: Do you think this cave is stable?
translation: 你觉得这个洞穴稳固吗？

english: I'm not too sure. What do you think?
translation: 我不太确定。你觉得呢？

english: I don't know, hence why I asked you.
translation: 我不知道，所以才问你。

english: Oh. I hope it's safe.
translation: 哦。我希望这里安全。

english: You're sounding much better.
translation: 你听起来好多了。

english: My voice, you mean?
translation: 你是说我的声音？

english: Yes, much more positive. Which is great.
translation: 是的，积极多了。这很好。

english: But you probably want to sort out the bad breath.
translation: 但你可能得先解决一下口臭问题。

english: I'll let you off. But just this once.
translation: 我放过你。但仅此一次。

english: If you need anything, just let me know.
translation: 如果你需要什么，就告诉我。

english: You have a big appetite.
translation: 你胃口真大。

english: I am hungry. Sorry for eating all your food.
translation: 我饿了。抱歉吃光了你所有的食物。

english: I'll let you off I suppose.
translation: 我想我就放过你吧。

english: Let's sing a song!
translation: 我们来唱首歌吧！

english: Is it really the time to?
translation: 现在真的是时候吗？

english: Half a pound of tuppenny rice, half a pound of treacle.
translation: 半磅两便士的米，半磅糖浆。

english: That's the way the money goes. Pop goes the weasel!
translation: 钱就是这么花的。砰的一声，黄鼠狼跑了！

english: Please go away...
translation: 请走开……

english: It's quite cosy in here.
translation: 这里面还挺舒适的。

english: That's a strange thing to say.
translation: 这话说得真奇怪。

english: You don't like it?
translation: 你不喜欢吗？

english: There's no pleasing you, is there?
translation: 真是怎么都伺候不了你，是吧？

english: How about a joke!
translation: 讲个笑话怎么样！

english: Please, I don't...
translation: 拜托，我不想……

english: How does the queen bee get around her hive?
translation: 蜂后是怎么在她的蜂巢里走动的？

english: Okay, go on.
translation: 好吧，继续说。

english: She's throne.
translation: 她是被抬着走的（throne/王座，谐音thrown/被扔）。

english: That was bad.
translation: 真烂。

english: This would probably make a nice home.
translation: 这里大概能成为一个不错的家。

english: Yes, do you?
translation: 是啊，你觉得呢？

english: Not really, I think I'll stick to living ABOVE ground.
translation: 不太觉得，我想我还是住在地面上吧。

english: We could do with something for you to sit on.
translation: 我们得给你找个坐的地方。

english: Well, I just thought it would be a bit more civil.
translation: 嗯，我只是觉得这样会文明一点。

english: You're a bit weird.
translation: 你有点奇怪。

english: Can you smell gas?
translation: 你闻到煤气味了吗？

english: Gas? Why would you smell gas?
translation: 煤气？你为什么会闻到煤气味？

english: I just thought I could, you know... mines often have poisonous gases.
translation: 我只是觉得可能，你知道……矿井里常有有毒气体。

english: Please, let's talk about something else.
translation: 拜托，我们聊点别的吧。

english: Let me tell you about myself!
translation: 让我给你讲讲我的故事！

english: I started off my life as a simple adventurer, battling goblins, picking up coins on the floor...
translation: 我最初只是个简单的冒险者，与哥布林战斗，捡起地板上的金币……

english: I remember the day when I was excited to find a thousand coins.
translation: 我记得有一天，我因为找到一千个金币而兴奋不已。

english: Now it is nothing!
translation: 现在这根本不算什么！

english: Sorry to stop you, but are you going to help me?
translation: 抱歉打断你，但你会帮我吗？

english: Not a fan of stories, then? Fair enough.
translation: 不喜欢听故事，是吗？好吧。

english: What do you want to talk about?
translation: 你想聊什么？

english: I don't know, I don't think I feel like talking.
translation: 我不知道，我觉得我不想说话。

english: Is it okay if I talk to you?
translation: 我可以和你聊聊吗？

english: No, I think I'd rather be left alone.
translation: 不，我想一个人待着。

english: Tell me a bit about yourself.
translation: 跟我说说你自己吧。

english: Yes, you.
translation: 是的，说你呢。

english: Well, I grew up in Ardougne. Erm, I quite enjoy Fishing.
translation: 嗯，我在阿多尼城长大。呃，我很喜欢钓鱼。

english: Fishing?
translation: 钓鱼？

english: Sounds a bit boring to me.
translation: 听起来有点无聊。

english: Don't knock it till you've tried it.
translation: 没试过就别妄下结论。

english: Fishing!
translation: 钓鱼！

english: I like fishing too!
translation: 我也喜欢钓鱼！

english: Perhaps we can fish together one day?
translation: 也许哪天我们可以一起去钓鱼？

english: I'm so pleased you're getting better! You must stay still though. You're not fit to walk yet.
translation: 我很高兴你正在好转！但你必须躺着别动。你现在还不能走路。

english: Where am I? Who are you?
translation: 我在哪？你是谁？

english: My name's [player name]. You're on Lunar Isle, in a cave.
translation: 我叫[player name]。你在月亮岛的一个洞穴里。

english: I'm Cyrisus. Oh yes, I remember, I was on the island and...
translation: 我是西里苏斯。哦，是的，我记得，我当时在岛上，然后……

english: Suqahs! There were suqah monsters!
translation: 苏卡！有苏卡怪物！

english: They attacked! I ran and ran. I crawled down here.
translation: 它们攻击了我！我跑啊跑。我爬到了这里。

english: It's okay, it's okay. You're safe now.
translation: 没事了，没事了。你现在安全了。

english: I was so afraid.
translation: 我吓坏了。

english: Oh my head hurts. And my legs. I'm so tired.
translation: 哦，我的头好疼。腿也疼。我好累。

english: Please, just leave me, I'm a waste of effort, my body is in ruin.
translation: 请别管我了，我是在白费力气，我的身体已经废了。

english: No, just trust me, I'll see that you get out of here. Don't give up.
translation: 不，相信我，我会带你离开这里的。别放弃。

english: Hi there. How are you feeling?
translation: 嗨。你感觉怎么样？

english: Still painful.
translation: 还是很疼。

english: There we are.
translation: 好了。

english: Thank you [player name]. I would surely be dead without you.
translation: 谢谢你[player name]。没有你，我肯定已经死了。

english: Don't worry. So what were you doing on this island?
translation: 别担心。那你来这个岛上做什么？

english: Exploring. I greatly enjoy travelling the world and taking in all the experiences available.
translation: 探险。我非常喜欢周游世界，体验各种经历。

english: I can relate to that, and Lunar Isle is definitely worth a visit. Where else have you been?
translation: 我深有同感，月亮岛绝对值得一游。你还去过哪里？

english: Well, I've travelled from the frozen wastes in the Wilderness to the pyramids of the Kharidian Desert. I've lived with the monkeys of Ape Atoll and dined with the TzHaar under the volcano of Karamja.
translation: 嗯，我从荒野的冰封荒原，到卡里迪安沙漠的金字塔。我和猿猴岛的猴子一起生活过，也和卡拉姆詹岛火山下的特扎尔一起吃过饭。

english: Impressive. You must have a great many stories and mastered loads of skills.
translation: 真了不起。你一定有很多故事，掌握了很多技能。

english: I could smith you full rune, farm spirit trees and still have time to cook you a summer pie for tea.
translation: 我可以为你锻造全套符文装备，种植灵魂树，还有时间为你烤一个夏日派当茶点。

english: Wow. No need to say more.
translation: 哇。不用再说了。

english: But why have you had such difficulty with the suqah? Surely you're a skilled warrior?
translation: 但为什么你在苏卡面前如此狼狈？你肯定是个技艺高超的战士吧？

english: Err, well...
translation: 呃，这个……

english: You must have mastered all forms of combat?
translation: 你一定精通所有战斗方式吧？

english: No. Not really.
translation: 不。其实并不。

english: I... erm...
Please, let's leave that line of conversation.
translation: 拜托，我们换个话题吧。

english: Oh, okay. If you wish. So, what now?
translation: 哦，好吧。随你便。那现在怎么办？

english: I still don't feel fit enough to go outside. I could also do with some armour.
translation: 我还是觉得自己不够强壮，无法出去。我也需要一些盔甲。

english: I suppose I could loan you some armour?
translation: 我想我可以借你一些盔甲？

english: Oh, there's really no need to worry.
translation: 哦，真的不用担心。

english: Trust, me, there's no need. Please, just go to the bank on this island, I have a friend working there. Just tell him I sent you.
translation: 相信我，没必要。请去这座岛上的银行，我有个朋友在那里工作。告诉他是我让你来的就行。

english: And what does he look like? What's his name?
translation: 他长什么样？叫什么名字？

english: Trust me: when you see him, you'll know.
translation: 相信我：你见到他就会知道了。

english: Okaaay.
translation: 好吧……

english: Oh, and if you want, you can contact me with the NPC Contact spell in the Lunar Spellbook. It might save you running back and forth.
translation: 哦，如果你愿意，可以用月亮法术书里的 NPC 联络法术联系我。这样你就不用跑来跑去了。

english: So you're in need of some armour?
translation: 所以你需要一些盔甲？

english: It would be good, yes. You should be able to talk to my friend in the bank on this island.
translation: 是的，这样就好了。你应该能跟我在这座岛银行里的朋友谈谈。

english: Hi! Managed to get my armour yet?
translation: 嗨！拿到我的盔甲了吗？

english: I think I had best visit the bank and see what I can get.
translation: 我想我最好去趟银行，看看能拿到什么。

english: Well, I would appreciate it if you could hurry.
translation: 嗯，如果你能快点，我会很感激的。

english: I'm getting a bit cold.
translation: 我有点冷了。

english: Hi there, this may sound a bit random, but do you know Cyrisus?
translation: 嗨，听上去可能有点冒昧，但你知道西里苏斯吗？

english: 'That I do. But I must say you seem quite familiar too.
translation: '我当然知道。但我必须说，你看起来也很眼熟。

english: I do?
translation: 是吗？

english: 'Why! You're that insolent fool who insulted my navigational skills!
translation: '哎呀！你就是那个侮辱我导航技术的无礼蠢蛋！

english: 'Accusing me of navigating in circles!
translation: '指责我绕圈航行！

english: Wait a minute! Now I recognise you; you're the navigator on the ship that first took me to Lunar Isle! The first time I visited this place your navigation was useless!
translation: 等等！我现在认出你了；你就是第一次载我去月亮岛的那艘船上的导航员！我第一次来这个地方时，你导航得一点用都没有！

english: 'How dare you! It was a jinx.
translation: '你竟敢这么说！那是运气不好。

english: Ahh.
translation: 啊。

english: Well, if it wasn't for me you would never have reached this place.
translation: 嗯，要不是我，你根本到不了这个地方。

english: 'Oh, behold the great adventurer [player name]. How the world would crumble without her.
translation: '哦，瞧瞧这位伟大的冒险者 [player name]。没有她，世界都要崩塌了。

english: Oh, the wit.
translation: 哦，好幽默啊。

english: 'Better than yours.
translation: '总比你的好。

english: Er, no it isn't.
translation: 呃，并没有。

english: 'Er. Yes it is.
translation: '呃。是的。

english: Er. No, it...
translation: 呃。不，它……

english: Stop. Let's not do that again. So, why are you working here now?
translation: 停。我们别再这样了。那么，你现在为什么在这里工作？

english: 'Why, you have a problem with it?
translation: '怎么，你有意见吗？

english: Oh no. It's just that the job of banker doesn't seem quite as... 'exotic' as 'pirate'. Seems like a step-down to me.
translation: 哦不。只是银行职员这份工作看起来没有……'海盗'那么'有异域风情'。对我来说像是降级了。

english: 'How dare you! I'll have you know that the job of a banker is far more exciting than that of a pirate!
translation: '你竟敢这么说！我要告诉你，银行职员的工作比海盗刺激多了！

english: Er, yeah, whatever you say mate.
translation: 呃，好吧，随你怎么说，伙计。

english: 'It is! And it's an honest living.
translation: '就是如此！而且是正当营生。

english: 'I was tired of looting and hunting for treasure. It was time to turn my life around.
translation: 我厌倦了掠夺和寻宝。是时候改变我的生活了。

english: What a heart touching story.
translation: 多么感人的故事啊。

english: 'Don't patronise me.
translation: '别对我摆出高人一等的姿态。

english: Anyway, as I was saying, do you know Cyrisus?
translation: 总之，正如我刚才说的，你认识西里苏斯吗？

english: 'Yes.
translation: '认识。

english: Well, he's down in the caves at the north of this island, and I need your help.
translation: 嗯，他在这个岛北边的洞穴里，我需要你的帮助。

english: 'Listening.
translation: '听着呢。

english: I need to get some items out of his bank account. Is that possible?
translation: 我需要从他的银行账户里取一些物品。能行吗？

english: 'I suppose. Knock yourself out.
translation: '我想可以。随便你弄。

english: 'I suppose you had better take this chest to carry his stuff. Don't want you losing any of it.
translation: '我想你最好拿这个箱子装他的东西。别弄丢了任何一件。

english: 'Ah, I would if you had any space.
translation: '啊，如果你有空位的话我就给你。

english: Hello again. Could I access Cyrisus's bank account again.
translation: 又见面了。我能再访问西里苏斯的银行账户吗？

english: 'Okay. You best help him quickly or else I'll be after you!
translation: '好吧。你最好快点帮他，否则我会找你算账！

english: 'Ah, you can't unless you have the chest.
translation: '啊，除非你有箱子，否则不行。

english: Well, I'm afraid I have lost it.
translation: 呃，恐怕我弄丢了。

english: 'Well, I don't suppose it would be a problem to give you another. Here you go.
translation: '嗯，再给你一个应该没问题。给你。

english: Yes, I think I left it in my bank account.
translation: 是的，我想我把它落在我的银行账户里了。

english: I have got a chest and filled it with some items.
translation: 我拿到了一个箱子，还装了一些物品。

english: Superb! What have you got?
translation: 太好了！你弄到了什么？

english: Robin hood hat
translation: 罗宾汉帽

english: It doesn't particularly impress me...
translation: 这个不太让我满意……

english: Karil's leathertop
translation: 卡里尔的皮甲上衣

english: No comment.
translation: 不予置评。

english: Black d'hide chaps
translation: 黑龙皮裤

english: Not too sure about that.
translation: 不太确定。

english: Ranger boots
translation: 射手靴

english: That's spot-on.
translation: 这个恰到好处。

english: Magic shortbow
translation: 魔法短弓

english: Hmmm, I'd rather something else.
translation: 嗯，我宁愿要别的。

english: I'm glad you know what you want.
translation: 很高兴你知道自己想要什么。

english: Dragon med helm
translation: 龙金中盔

english: Ahrim's robetop
translation: 阿赫姆的长袍上衣

english: Oh, good choice!
translation: 哦，选得好！

english: Ahrim's robeskirt
translation: 阿赫姆的长袍裙装

english: Very good.
translation: 非常好。

english: Abyssal whip
translation: 深渊长鞭

english: Superb!
translation: 太棒了！

english: Hi, I've been to see 'Bird's-Eye' Jack, and I've got a chest.
translation: 嗨，我去见过'鸟眼''杰克了，而且我弄到了一个箱子。

english: I've also filled it with some armour; what do you think?
translation: 我还往里面装了些盔甲；你觉得怎么样？

english: Okay, I'll try it on. No peeking!
translation: 好吧，我试穿一下。不准偷看！

english: Oh, I won't. I'll close my eyes.
translation: 哦，我不会的。我会闭上眼睛。

english: Still changing.
translation: 还在换。

english: I've put the clothes back in the chest, they're not too bad.
translation: 我把衣服放回箱子了，它们不算太差。

english: But not too good either. I need a different combination.
translation: 但也不算太好。我需要不同的组合。

english: Well, I'm confused, any tips?
translation: 嗯，我有点困惑，有什么建议吗？

english: I can't stand the item of headgear you've chosen - get rid of that straight away!
translation: 我受不了你选的头饰——赶紧扔掉！

english: What's with the body armour? Totally not my style!
translation: 这身盔甲是怎么回事？完全不是我的风格！

english: I'd much rather have something else protecting my legs.
translation: 我更希望有别的什么来保护我的腿。

english: The footwear has to go. I can't rely on them to help me.
translation: 鞋子必须换。我不能指望它们帮我。

english: I'm not all that good at using the type of weapon you offered. Please bring something else.
translation: 我不太擅长使用你提供的那种武器。请带点别的来。

english: Perfect! I couldn't ask for a better set-up!
translation: 完美！我找不到更好的搭配了！

english: Looking good in your kit!
translation: 穿上这身装备真好看！

english: Perfect! I feel healthy, I'm positively charged and I'm dressed like a war machine!
translation: 完美！我身体健康，精力充沛，而且穿得像台战争机器！

english: You certainly look the part!
translation: 你看起来确实像那么回事！

english: Why thanks, I feel it too!
translation: 多谢夸奖，我自己也这么觉得！

english: Now, Cyrisus. Please tell me.
translation: 现在，西里苏斯。请告诉我。

english: Why did you have such difficulty against the suqahs?
translation: 为什么你在对抗苏卡时这么困难？

english: Ah, well. Best I tell you. The thing is... the thing that I should say... the problem I have, for which you should know...
translation: 啊，好吧。最好还是告诉你。事情是这样的……我应该说的……我的问题，你应该知道……

english: Just tell me.
translation: 告诉我吧。

english: I'm afraid of combat.
translation: 我害怕战斗。

english: I've tried so hard over the years, but I simply cannot gather the courage to fight monsters.
translation: 这些年来我努力了很久，但我就是鼓不起勇气去打怪物。

english: I've learnt the techniques, I've got the equipment. I just get so afraid. My legs turn to jelly, I'm dripping with sweat. All I can do is run.
translation: 我的腿软得像果冻，浑身冒汗。

english: Now that surprises me.
translation: 这倒让我很意外。

english: I know it seems bad, but honestly, I've tried. It was part of the reason I came to Lunar Isle to see the Moon Clan. I trust you've gone through the ceremony to visit the Dreamland?
translation: 我知道这听起来很糟，但老实说，我真的试过了。这也是我来月亮岛找月亮部族的原因之一。我相信你已经完成了仪式去拜访梦境之地吧？

english: I have indeed. A very strange day I must say, but very valuable! Especially gaining the Lunar spells.
translation: 确实去过了。我得说那是非常奇怪的一天，但非常有价值！尤其是学会了月亮系法术。

english: Yes, so I came to the Moon Clan again to see if they could help me visit my dreams again and conquer my fear of combat. But then I came across the suqah.
translation: 是的，所以我再次来找月亮部族，看看他们能不能帮我再次进入梦境，克服我对战斗的恐惧。但后来我遇到了苏卡。

english: Say, would you come with me to the Oneiromancer? Perhaps you can give me some support or guidance?
translation: 那个，你愿意跟我一起去找梦境法师吗？也许你能给我一些支持或指导？

english: Well, I suppose. Can't see why not.
translation: 嗯，我想可以。没什么理由拒绝。

english: Excellent! Please, you go on ahead, I'll make my way there myself. I'm not walking out of this cave past those suqahs again!
translation: 太好了！请你先走一步，我自己会过去。我可不想再从这个洞穴走出去，经过那些苏卡身边！

english: Ready?
translation: 准备好了吗？

english: Of course! You just go speak with the Oneiromancer and I'll be right with you, faster than you'd think.
translation: 当然！你只管去和梦境法师说话，我马上就到，比你想象的还快。

english: 'How's Cyrisus? Where is he?
translation: “西里苏斯怎么样了？他在哪里？”

english: 'Good, I'm pleased.
translation: “很好，我很高兴。”

english: 'Don't think that this means I like you now!
translation: “别以为这样我就喜欢你了！”

english: 'Yes? What about it.
translation: “嗯？怎么了。”

english: 'Not really.
translation: “不太想。”

english: Oh hello [player name]! It has been a while.
translation: 哦，你好啊[player name]！好久不见了。

english: What brings you here again? Creating more astral runes?
translation: 这次又是什么风把你吹来了？来制作更多的星界符石吗？

english: Not at the moment. I've come on behalf of a friend. You will probably have met him - his name is Cyrisus.
translation: 现在不是。我是替一位朋友来的。你可能见过他——他叫西里苏斯。

english: Oh yes, I know him. A bright man. What is it about him, my dear?
translation: 哦，是的，我认识他。一个聪明的人。他怎么了，亲爱的？

english: Well, I...
translation: 嗯，我……

english: Cyrisus. It's been a while. Your kind friend here was just talking about you.
translation: 西里苏斯。好久不见。你这位好心的朋友刚才还在说你呢。

english: Good. We were hoping you could help us.
translation: 很好。我们希望你能帮帮我们。

english: Yes? I can try.
translation: 是吗？我可以试试。

english: I need to get over my fear of combat. Surely I can sort that out in the Dreamland?
translation: 我需要克服对战斗的恐惧。我肯定能在梦境之地解决这个问题吧？

english: Of course. With the Potion of Shared Dreaming. It'll send you both into the Dreamland, and sort out your biggest issue.
translation: 当然可以。用共享梦境药水。它会把你们俩都送进梦境之地，解决你最大的问题。

english: In most ways, yes. However, it will be dangerous.
translation: 大部分来说，是的。不过，这会很危险。

english: To get you into the dream together, the potion works by binding your subconsciousnesses together. The brazier has its own intelligence in interpreting your subconscious so it will understand your intentions when
translation: 为了让你们一起进入梦境，药水会把你们的潜意识绑定在一起。火盆有自己的情报来解读你们的潜意识，所以它会在

english: placing you in the dream.
translation: 把你们送入梦境时理解你们的意图。

english: Okay, I shall just take your word for that bit, but I still can't see the dangerous part...
translation: 好吧，这部分我就信你了，但我还是看不出危险在哪里……

english: With your minds melded as one, you need each other to survive. If one of you dies, you both die for real. Unlike before, you will die just as if you were killed by a monster in the wild.
translation: 当你们的思想融为一体时，你们需要彼此才能生存。如果你们其中一人死了，你们俩都会真的死去。不像以前，你们会像在野外被怪物杀死一样真正死亡。

english: I'm not so sure about this anymore.
translation: 我现在不太确定了。

english: Don't worry Cyrisus, we can do this. Oneiromancer, how do we make the potion?
translation: 别担心，西里苏斯，我们能行的。梦境法师，我们怎么制作药水？

english: Simple. I shall give you a vial, within which you should place water followed by one ground astral rune and goutweed. Then just use it on the brazier. Oh! You'll have to light it first, of course.
translation: 简单。我给你一个小瓶子，你往里面放水，然后加一份磨碎的星界符石和痛风草。然后把它用在火盆上就行了。哦！当然，你得先点燃火盆。

english: Wait. Do we need to wear the clothes we had to wear to go to the dreamland before.
translation: 等等。我们还需要穿上次去梦境之地时穿的衣服吗？

english: Oh no, no need. They were simply ceremonial clothes, you can wear whatever you want.
translation: 哦，不用，不需要。那些只是仪式用的衣服，你们想穿什么就穿什么。

english: See you at the brazier!
translation: 火盆那儿见！

english: Hi Cyrisus.
translation: 嗨，西里苏斯。

english: Hi [player name]. I must admit to being a bit nervous. Could you talk to the Oneiromancer? I want to get this out of the way quickly.
translation: 嗨，[player name]。我得承认我有点紧张。你能跟梦境法师谈谈吗？我想快点把这事解决了。

english: I'm still making the potion. Can you tell me what ingredients it takes again?
translation: 我还在制作药水。你能再告诉我一遍需要什么材料吗？

english: Water, an astral rune and goutweed.
translation: 水、一个星界符石和痛风草。

english: Any chance you have a vial you can give me?
translation: 你有没有小瓶子可以给我一个？

english: And the magic word is?
translation: 那魔法口令是什么？

english: Erm. Lunar?
translation: 呃。月亮？

english: Oh dear, of course not!
translation: 哦，天哪，当然不是！

english: Oh, sorry. PLEASE!
translation: 哦，对不起。拜托！

english: Now that wasn't difficult, was it?
translation: 这并不难，对吧？

english: Apparently so. I don't have any free space to take a vial. I'll be back in a second.
translation: 显然是的。我没有空位拿小瓶子。我马上回来。

english: Okay, I have the Potion of Shared Dreaming; now what?
translation: 好了，我有共享梦境药水了；现在怎么办？

english: Best you light the brazier with a tinderbox first, then give me the potion.
translation: 你最好先用火绒盒点燃火盆，然后把药水给我。

english: Let me know when you're ready.
translation: 准备好了就告诉我。

english: Okay, so we need to make the Potion of Shared Dreaming.
translation: 好吧，所以我们需要制作共享梦境药水。

english: Yes. Water, goutweed and one astral rune all in that...
translation: 是的。水、痛风草和一个星界符石，都放进那个……

english: Wait, where did you put the vial?
translation: 等等，你把小瓶子放哪儿了？

english: Ask the Oneiromancer nicely, I'm sure she will have another.
translation: 好好跟梦境法师说，我相信她还有另一个。

english: Yes. Water, goutweed and one astral rune all in that tiny vial.
translation: 是的。水、痛风草和一个星界符石，都放进那个小瓶子里。

english: Very well so far, we have the Potion of Shared Dreaming.
translation: 到目前为止一切顺利，我们有共享梦境药水了。

english: We just need to visit Cyrisus's dreams and come to a solution.
translation: 我们只需要进入西里苏斯的梦境，找到解决办法。

english: I like your spirit!
translation: 我喜欢你的精神！

english: Arrghhh!!!
What on Gielinor is that?
translation: 那是什么鬼东西？

english: Cyrisus?
translation: 西里苏斯？

english: Cyrisus...
translation: 西里苏斯……

english: That lectern is rather pretty.
translation: 那个讲台还挺漂亮的。

english: Turn.
translation: 转。

english: Around.
translation: 过来。

english: Arghh!
translation: 啊！

english: Don't ask me, it's your dream!
translation: 别问我，这是你的梦！

english: You must really be afraid of combat!
translation: 你肯定真的很害怕战斗！

english: What do you mean 'why'? This huge creature must symbolise your fears!
translation: 你问“为什么”是什么意思？这个巨大的生物一定象征着你的恐惧！

english: I'm guessing we're going to be fighting my fears.
translation: 我猜我们要和我的恐惧战斗了。

english: Cyrisus. Let's do this!
translation: 西里苏斯。我们上吧！

english: I'm still scared. Show me how you fight, and I should gain courage.
translation: 我还是很害怕。让我看看你是怎么战斗的，这样我就能鼓起勇气。

english: Not bad. We've been into the dream, but we are yet to conquer it.
translation: 还不错。我们进过梦境了，但还没征服它。

english: We're probably going to need more of that potion.
translation: 我们可能还需要更多那种药水。

english: Perhaps Cyrisus can help you out there, he's a resourceful chap.
translation: 也许西里苏斯能帮你，他是个足智多谋的家伙。

english: We need to go into the dream again.
translation: 我们需要再次进入梦境。

english: Do we have to?
translation: 我们非得去吗？

english: It looks like there is a little potion left in the bottle.
translation: 看起来瓶子里还剩一点药水。

english: That may be the case, but you need to light the brazier with a tinderbox first.
translation: 可能是这样，但你需要先用火绒盒点燃火盆。

english: Graaaaarrr!
Fight to give me courage.
translation: 战斗吧，给我勇气。

english: Hope you're okay, [player name]
translation: 希望你没事，[player name]。

english: You shall never get me!
translation: 你永远抓不到我！

english: Have vengeance!
translation: 尝尝复仇术！

english: Oh, I can't attack. I'm too afraid!
translation: 哦，我无法攻击。我太害怕了！

english: I'm building up my courage. I'll attack soon.
translation: 我正在鼓起勇气。我很快就会攻击。

english: I don't know if I can do this.
translation: 我不知道我能不能做到。

english: Now, now, now! Cyrisus! Get it!
translation: 就是现在，现在，现在！西里苏斯！干掉它！

english: Okay! Take this!
translation: 好！接招！

english: I did! Yes! Thanks!
translation: 我做到了！是的！谢谢！

english: I knew you'd do it.
translation: 我就知道你能行。

english: Back to reality, I suppose, and on to the Oneiromancer!
translation: 我想，该回到现实了，然后去找梦境法师！

english: See you there!
translation: 那儿见！

english: No, WE did it. Thank you [player name]. It really is appreciated.
translation: 不，是我们做到了。谢谢你，[player name]。真的很感激。

english: Ah, no worries, it was fun.
translation: 啊，别客气，挺有趣的。

english: Well I'm not sure I enjoyed almost getting killed, but yes, it was good.
translation: 嗯，我不确定我是否享受差点被杀的感觉，但没错，这很好。

english: We did it!
translation: 我们做到了！

english: Yes, I've conquered my fear of combat.
translation: 是的，我克服了对战斗的恐惧。

english: We beat those monsters well and good, didn't we?
translation: 我们把那些怪物打得落花流水，对吧？

english: We sure did! I was very afraid to start off with, but once I saw how you dealt with combat I felt sure I could do it too.
translation: 我们确实做到了！一开始我很害怕，但看到你如何应对战斗后，我确信我也能做到。

english: Oh, I'm pleased. Congratulations.
translation: 哦，我很高兴。恭喜你。

english: Thank you [player name]. I really couldn't have done it without your help. Please, let me pass some of my knowledge onto you.
translation: 谢谢[player name]。没有你的帮助我真的做不到。请让我把我的一些知识传授给你。

english: Ah, sorry but could you do me a favour and clear some inventory space first?
translation: 啊，抱歉，你能帮我个忙，先清出一些背包空间吗？

english: Okay, in what way?
translation: 好的，用什么方式？
