english: On my last visit to this island I spent a good while with the Moon Clan. It seems it isn't all that impossible to instantly transfer knowledge to one another.
translation: 上次我去这座岛时，和月亮一族待了一段时间。看来瞬间将知识传递给对方也不是完全不可能的事。

english: I shall just use lunar magic to pass some information onto you.
translation: 我会用月亮魔法把一些信息传给你。

english: Just keep your mind blank, relax and hold still.
translation: 保持头脑放空，放松，别动。

english: Ooooh. That was a weird sensation.
translation: 呜——这感觉好奇怪。

english: I must admit, I do feel enlightened already. Thank you!
translation: 我得承认，我已经感觉开窍了。谢谢你！

english: My pleasure. And I best be off, I think I am going to put my courage to the test! I have a new goal to reach - the ultimate warrior!
translation: 不客气。我最好走了，我想我要去检验一下我的勇气！我有一个新目标要达到——成为终极战士！

english: I will. I'll see you around, I'm sure!
translation: 我会的。我们后会有期，我肯定！

english: Hello again, adventurer. You will need to speak to my fellow druid Sanfew in the village south of here to continue in your quest.
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。你需要和我南边村子的德鲁伊同伴桑福谈谈，才能继续你的任务。

english: I've been sent to assist you with the ritual to purify the Varrockian stone circle.
translation: 我被派来协助你进行净化维洛克石圈的仪式。

english: Well, what I'm struggling with right now is the meats needed for the potion to honour Guthix. I need the raw meat of four different animals for it, but not just any old meats will do.
translation: 嗯，我现在头疼的是制作贡奉古斯药水所需的肉类。我需要四种不同动物的生肉，但不是随便什么肉都行。

english: Each meat has to be dipped individually into the Cauldron of Thunder for it to work correctly.
translation: 每块肉必须单独浸入雷霆大锅中，才能正确生效。

english: Where can I find this cauldron?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这口大锅？

english: It is located somewhere in the mysterious underground halls which are located somewhere in the woods just South of here. They are too dangerous for me to go myself however.
translation: 它位于南边森林某处神秘的地下大厅里。不过那些地方对我来说太危险了，我不能亲自去。

english: Ok, I'll do that then.
translation: 好的，那我就去做。

english: Well thank you very much!
translation: 那真是太感谢你了！

english: Actually I don't need to speak to you.
translation: 其实我不需要和你说话。

english: Did you bring me the required ingredients for the potion?
translation: 你带给我制作药水所需的材料了吗？

english: Well, let me know when you do young 'un.
translation: 好吧，等你有了一年轻人，再告诉我。

english: What was I meant to be doing again?
translation: 我原本该做什么来着？

english: Trouble with your memory eh young 'un? I need the raw meats of four different animals that have been dipped into the Cauldron of Thunder so I can make my potion to honour Guthix.
translation: 记性不好是吧，年轻人？我需要四种不同动物的生肉，浸过雷霆大锅的，这样我才能制作贡奉古斯的药水。

english: Ooooh yeah, I remember.
translation: 哦哦，对，我想起来了。

english: Yes, I have all four now!
translation: 是的，我现在四种都有了！

english: Thank you so much adventurer! These meats will allow our potion to honour Guthix to be completed, and bring one step closer to reclaiming our stone circle!
translation: 非常感谢你，冒险者！这些肉将让我们的药水得以完成，以纪念古斯，并让我们离夺回石圈更近一步！

english: Now go and talk to Kaqemeex and he will introduce you to the wonderful world of herblore and potion making!
translation: 现在去和卡基米克斯谈谈吧，他会向你介绍草药学和药水制作的奇妙世界！

english: I have word from Sanfew that you have been very helpful in assisting him with his preparations for the purification ritual. As promised I will now teach you the ancient arts of Herblore.
translation: 我从桑福那里听说你在协助他准备净化仪式时非常帮忙。正如我承诺的，我现在将教你古老的草药学技艺。

english: We druids value wisdom over wealth, so if you expect material gain, you will be disappointed. We are, however, very skilled in the art of Herblore, which we will share with you
translation: 我们德鲁伊重视智慧胜过财富，所以如果你期待物质回报，那你会失望的。不过，我们非常精通草药学，如果你能协助我们完成这个任务，我们会与你分享这门技艺。

english: if you can assist us in this task. You may find such wisdom a greater reward than mere money.
translation: 我们会与你分享这门技艺。你可能会发现，这样的智慧比单纯的金钱更有价值。

english: That used to be our stone circle. Unfortunately, many years ago, dark wizards cast a wicked spell upon it so that they could corrupt its power for their own evil ends.
translation: 那曾经是我们的石阵。不幸的是，多年前黑暗巫师对它施了恶咒，使其力量堕落为他们邪恶的目的。

english: When they cursed the rocks for their rituals they made them useless to us and our magics. We require a brave adevnturer to go on a quest for us to help purify the circle of Varrock.
translation: 当他们诅咒那些石头用于仪式时，它们就对我们和我们的魔法失去了作用。我们需要一位勇敢的冒险者去帮助我们净化维洛克城的石阵。

english: Excellent. Go to the village south of this place and speak to my fellow Sanfew who is working on the purification ritual. He knows better than I what is required to complete it.
translation: 太好了。去南边的村庄，找我的同伴桑福，他正在研究净化仪式。他知道还需要什么才能完成它。

english: You will need to speak to my fellow druid Sanfew in the village south of here to continue in your quest adventurer.
translation: 你需要去南边的村庄找我的同伴德鲁伊桑福，才能继续你的任务，冒险者。

english: We are the druids of Guthix. We worship our god at our famous stone circles. You will find them located throghout these lands.
translation: 我们是古斯神的德鲁伊。我们在著名的石阵中崇拜我们的神。你会在这些土地上找到它们。

english: What, personally? No, ofcoure I didn't. However, our four fathers did. The first Druids of Guthix built many stone circles across these lands over eight hundred years ago.
translation: 什么，亲自？不，当然不是我。但我们的四位先祖确实做过。第一批古斯神的德鲁伊在八百多年前在这些土地上建造了许多石阵。

english: Unfortunately we only know of two remaining and of those only one is usuable by us anymore.
translation: 不幸的是，我们只知道剩下两个，而且其中只有一个还能为我们所用。

english: Guthix be praised, the cavalry has arrived! Hero, how would you like to be made an honorary member of the Black Guard?
translation: 古斯宾在上，骑兵终于到了！英雄，你想成为黑卫队的荣誉成员吗？

english: The Black Guard? What's that?
translation: 黑卫队？那是什么？

english: Hawhaw! 'What's that' [he/she] asks, what a sense of humour! The Black Guard is the finest regiment in the dwarven army. Only the best of the best are allowed to join it and then they receive months of rigorous training.
translation: 哈哈哈！'那是什么'，[he/she]问得真幽默！黑卫队是矮人军队中最精锐的团。只有最优秀中的最优秀才能加入，然后还要接受数月的严格训练。

english: However, we are currently in need of a hero, so for a limited time only I'm offering you, a human, a chance to join this prestigious regiment. What do you say?
translation: 不过，我们现在急需一位英雄，所以限时特惠，我给你这个人类一个加入这个光荣军团的机会。你觉得怎么样？

english: Sure, I'd be honoured to join.
translation: 当然，我很荣幸能加入。

english: That's the spirit! Now trooper, we have no time to waste - the goblins are attacking from the forests to the South. There are so many of them, they are overwhelming my men and breaking through our
translation: 这就对了！现在，士兵，我们没时间浪费了——地精们正从南边的森林发起攻击。它们数量太多，正在压倒我的部下，突破我们的...

english: perimeter defences; could you please try to fix the stockade by replacing the broken rails with these new ones?
translation: 外围防线；你能不能用这些新栏杆替换掉破损的，试着修好栅栏？

english: Sure, sounds easy enough...
translation: 当然，听起来挺简单的……

english: You'll need this hammer too.
translation: 你还需要这把锤子。

english: Report back to me once you've fixed the railings.
translation: 修好栏杆后向我报告。

english: Yes Sir, Captain!
translation: 是，船长！

english: I'm sorry, I'm too busy mining.
translation: 抱歉，我忙着采矿呢。

english: Well best make the most of it while you can, if the goblins over-run us they'll descend on the mines like a plague of locusts!
translation: 那你最好趁现在多采点，要是哥布林攻破我们，他们会像蝗虫一样涌进矿坑！

english: I'm not going to be able to fix this without a new railing. Lawgof should have some spare ones.
translation: 没有新栏杆我修不了这个。劳戈夫应该有些备用的。

english: Oooch!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Urrrgh!
translation: 呃啊！

english: I've fixed all these railings now.
translation: 我现在已经修好了所有栏杆。

english: That's better, the goblins won't get past this piece of fencing now.
translation: 好多了，哥布林现在别想越过这段围栏了。

english: Hello, trooper, how are you doing with those railings?
translation: 你好，士兵，那些栏杆修得怎么样了？

english: I'm getting there.
translation: 快好了。

english: The goblins are still getting in, so there must still be some broken railings.
translation: 哥布林还在进来，肯定还有破损的栏杆。

english: But I'm out of railings...
translation: 但我没有栏杆了……

english: That's okay, we've got plenty, here you go.
translation: 没关系，我们还有很多，给你。

english: There's no room in your backpack, so I can't give you anymore.
translation: 你的背包没空间了，所以我不能再给你了。

english: Don't worry, I'll find them soon enough.
translation: 别担心，我很快就能找到它们。

english: Well done, trooper! The goblins seems to have stopped getting in. I think you've done the job!
translation: 干得好，士兵！哥布林似乎不再能进来了。我想你完成任务了！

english: Great, I'll be getting on then.
translation: 太好了，那我先走了。

english: What? I'll have you jailed for desertion!
translation: 什么？我会以逃兵罪把你关进监狱！

english: Besides, I have another commission for you. Just before the goblins over-ran us we lost contact with our watch tower to the South, that's why the goblins managed to catch us unawares. I'd like you to perform
translation: 而且，我还有另一个任务给你。就在哥布林攻破我们之前，我们和南边的瞭望塔失去了联系，所以哥布林才能打我们个措手不及。我要你执行

english: a covert operation into enemy territory, to check up on the guards we have stationed there.
translation: 一次潜入敌后的秘密行动，去查看我们驻扎在那里的守卫。

english: They should have reported in by now ...
translation: 他们早该报告了……

english: Okay, I'll see what I can find out.
translation: 好的，我去看看能发现什么。

english: Excellent! I have two men there, the dwarf-in-charge is called Gilob, find him and tell him that I'll send him a relief guard just as soon as we mop up these remaining goblins.
translation: 太好了！我在那里有两个人，负责的矮人叫吉洛布，找到他并告诉他，等我们清理完剩下的哥布林，我会立刻派一队增援守卫给他。

english: Hello, any news from the watchman?
translation: 你好，有看守的消息吗？

english: Well, as quick as you can then.
translation: 那就尽快吧。

english: What? Carrying one set of Dwarf remains is enough...
translation: 什么？带一套矮人遗骸就够了……

english: I had better take these remains.
translation: 我最好带上这些遗骸。

english: Have you been to the watch tower yet?
translation: 你去过瞭望塔了吗？

english: Yes, I went up but there was no one there.
translation: 是的，我上去过，但那里没人。

english: That's strange, Gilob would never leave his post... His son was also with him, something doesn't smell right. Can you return and look for clues?
translation: 真奇怪，吉洛布绝不会离开他的岗位……他的儿子也和他在一起，事情不对劲。你能回去寻找线索吗？

english: Of course, I'll do what I can.
translation: 当然，我会尽力。

english: I have some terrible news for you Captain, the goblins over ran the tower, your guards fought well but were overwhelmed.
translation: 船长，我有坏消息要告诉你，哥布林攻占了塔楼，你的守卫们英勇奋战，但寡不敌众。

english: I can't believe it, Gilob was the finest lieutenant I had! We'll give him a fitting funeral, but what of his command? His son, Lollk, was with him. Did you find his body too?
translation: 我简直不敢相信，吉洛布是我最好的中尉！我们会给他办个像样的葬礼，但他的指挥权怎么办？他儿子洛尔克和他在一起。你也找到他的尸体了吗？

english: No, there was only one body there, I searched pretty well.
translation: 没有，那里只有一具尸体，我搜得很仔细。

english: The goblins must have taken him. Please traveler, seek out the goblins' hideout and return the lad to us. They always attack from the South-east, so they must be based down there.
translation: 一定是哥布林抓走了他。请，旅行者，找到哥布林的藏身处，把那孩子带回来给我们。他们总是从东南方进攻，所以他们的基地一定在那边。

english: Okay, I'll see if I can find their hideout.
translation: 好的，我去看看能不能找到他们的藏身处。

english: Thank the heavens, you saved me! I thought I'd be goblin lunch for sure!
translation: 谢天谢地，你救了我！我还以为我肯定要变成哥布林的午餐了！

english: I think so, I'd better run off home.
translation: 我想是的，我最好赶紧跑回家。

english: That's right, you get going, I'll catch up.
translation: 没错，你先走，我随后跟上。

english: Thanks again, brave adventurer.
translation: 再次感谢你，勇敢的冒险者。

english: Hello, has Lollk returned yet?
translation: 你好，洛尔克回来了吗？

english: He has, and I thank you from the bottom of my heart - without you he'd be a goblin barbecue!
translation: 他回来了，我由衷地感谢你——没有你，他早就变成哥布林的烤肉了！

english: Always a pleasure to help.
translation: 能帮上忙总是好的。

english: In that case could I ask one more favour of you...
translation: 既然如此，我能再请你帮个忙吗……

english: When the goblins attacked us some of them managed to slip past my guards and sabotage our cannon. I don't have anybody who understands how it works, could you have a look at it and see if you could get it working for
translation: 哥布林攻击我们时，有些家伙溜过我的守卫，破坏了我们的矮人大炮。我没有懂它工作原理的人，你能去看看，看看能不能让它重新工作

english: us, please?
translation: 吗？拜托了？

english: Thank you, take this toolkit, you'll need it...
translation: 谢谢你，拿着这套工具，你会用到的……

english: You don't have room to take this, report back to me when you do.
translation: 你背包没空间拿这个，等有空了再来找我报告。

english: Report back to me if you manage to fix it.
translation: 如果你修好了，就向我报告。

english: Sorry, I've done enough for today.
translation: 抱歉，我今天做得够多了。

english: Fair enough, didn't think you'd be able to help anyway, not much chance for a human to be able to fix it when the best dwarven engineers have failed.
translation: 好吧，反正我也没指望你能帮上忙，连最优秀的矮人工程师都修不好，一个人类更没什么机会。

english: I guess I'd better fix it with the toolkit I was given.
translation: 我想我最好用拿到的工具修好它。

english: How are you doing in there, trooper? We've been trying our best with that thing, but I just haven't got the patience.
translation: 士兵，里面怎么样了？我们一直在尽力弄那玩意儿，但我就是没那个耐心。

english: It's not an easy job, but I'm getting there.
translation: 这不是件容易的活，但我快好了。

english: Good stuff, let me know if you have any luck. If we manage to get that thing working, those goblins will be no trouble at all.
translation: 好样的，要是成功了就告诉我。要是能让那玩意儿工作起来，那些哥布林就根本不是问题了。

english: I'm afraid I lost the toolkit...
translation: 我恐怕把工具弄丢了……

english: That was silly... never mind, I can give you another, but you'll have to free up some space in your backpack first.
translation: 真够蠢的……算了，我可以再给你一套，但你先得腾出背包空间。

english: That was silly... never mind, here you go.
translation: 真够蠢的……算了，给你。

english: This should work nicely now that I've fixed it.
translation: 既然我修好了，现在应该能正常工作了。

english: What do you think you're doing, trooper! Did I give you orders to move that cannon? No! Well then don't!
translation: 你以为你在干什么，士兵！我命令你移动那门大炮了吗？没有！那就别动！

english: Hello there trooper, how's things?
translation: 你好啊士兵，情况怎么样？

english: Well, I think I've done it, take a look...
translation: 嗯，我想我修好了，来看看……

english: Well I don't believe it, it seems to be working perfectly! I seem to have underestimated you, trooper!
translation: 我真不敢相信，它居然完美运转了！看来我小看你了，士兵！

english: Not bad for an adventurer eh?
translation: 对一个冒险者来说还不错吧？

english: Not bad at all, your effort is appreciated, my friend. Now, if I could figure what the thing uses as ammo...
translation: 确实不错，你的努力值得赞赏，我的朋友。现在，要是能搞清楚这东西用什么当弹药就好了……

english: The Black Guard forgot to send instructions. I know I said that was the last favour, but...
translation: 黑卫队忘了送说明书。我知道我说过这是最后一个忙，但是……

english: I can't leave this post, could you go to the Black Guard base and find out what this thing actually shoots?
translation: 我不能离开这个岗位，你能去黑卫队基地查明这东西到底发射什么吗？

english: Sorry, I've really done enough.
translation: 抱歉，我真的做得够多了。

english: Fair enough, fair enough.
translation: 好吧，好吧。

english: Okay then, just for you!
translation: 好吧，那就为你破例一次！

english: That's great, we were lucky you came along when you did. The base is located just South of the Ice Mountain.
translation: 太好了，幸好你当时来了。基地就在冰山南边。

english: You'll need to speak to Nulodion, the Dwarf Cannon engineer. He's the Weapons Development Chief for the Black Guard, so if anyone knows how to fire this thing, it'll be him.
translation: 你需要和矮人大炮工程师努洛迪翁谈谈。他是黑卫队的武器研发主管，所以如果有人知道怎么发射这东西，那一定是他。

english: Hi again.
translation: 又见面了。

english: Hello trooper, any word from the Cannon Engineer?
translation: 你好士兵，大炮工程师有消息了吗？

english: The Black Guard camp is South of the Ice Mountain, the quicker we can get some ammo for this thing the quicker those Goblins will leave us be.
translation: 黑卫队营地在冰山南边，我们越快给这东西弄到弹药，那些哥布林就越快消停。

english: I'll get to it.
translation: 我这就去办。

english: Captain Lawgof sent me. He's having trouble with his cannon.
translation: 是劳戈夫船长派我来的。他的大炮出了点问题。

english: Of course, we forgot to send the ammo mould!
translation: 当然，我们忘了送弹药模具！

english: It fires mould?
translation: 它发射模具？

english: Don't be silly - the ammo's made by using a mould. Here, take these to him. The instructions explain everything.
translation: 别傻了——弹药是用模具做的。拿着这些给他。说明书里解释了一切。

english: You can't take these things unless you free up some space in your inventory. I suggest you visit a bank and then come back to talk to me.
translation: 除非你腾出背包空间，否则你拿不了这些东西。我建议你先去趟银行，然后回来找我说话。

english: That's great, thanks.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。

english: Thank you, adventurer. The Dwarf Black Guard will remember this.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者。矮人黑卫队会记住这份恩情。

english: I've lost the notes.
translation: 我把笔记弄丢了。

english: Here, take these...
translation: 给你，拿着这些……

english: I've lost the cannonball mould.
translation: 我把炮弹模具弄丢了。

english: Deary me, you are trouble. Here, take this one.
translation: 天哪，你可真麻烦。给你，拿这个。

english: So has the Captain figured out how to work the cannon yet?
translation: 那么，船长搞明白怎么操作大炮了吗？

english: Not yet, but I'm sure he will.
translation: 还没有，但我相信他会的。

english: If you can get those items to him it'll be a great help.
translation: 如果你能把那些东西交给他，那会是很大的帮助。

english: Ha ha ha, what a muddle-headed numpty you are!
translation: 哈哈哈，你真是个糊涂的笨蛋！

english: Hmmm. I think you'll find the broken cannon still happily parked on the spot where you put it.
translation: 嗯。我想你会发现那门破损的大炮还好好地停在原地。

english: Hmmm. I think you'll find it's still happily parked on the spot where you put it.
translation: 嗯。我想你会发现它还好好地停在原地。

english: Wait a moment, our records show you already own some cannon equipment I'm afraid you can only have one set at a time.
translation: 等等，我们的记录显示你已经拥有一些大炮装备，恐怕你一次只能拥有一套。

english: Hmmm. I think you'll find the base still happily parked on the spot where you put it.
translation: 嗯。我想你会发现底座还好好地停在原地。

english: Hmmm. I think you'll find most of the cannon still happily parked on the spot where you put it.
translation: 嗯。我想你会发现大炮的大部分零件还好好地停在原地。

english: Hmmm. I think you'll find the base and stand still happily parked on the spot where you put them.
translation: 嗯。我想你会发现底座和支架还好好地停在原地。

english: Yes, I have spoken to him.
translation: 是的，我跟他说过话了。

english: He gave me some items to give you... but I seem to have lost something.
translation: 他给了我一些东西要给你……但我好像弄丢了什么。

english: If you could go back and get another, I'd appreciate it.
translation: 如果你能回去再拿一份，我会很感激。

english: He gave me an ammo mould and some notes to give to you...
translation: 他给了我一个弹药模具和一些笔记要给你……

english: Aah, of course, we make the ammo! This is great, now we will be able to defend ourselves. I don't know how to thank you...
translation: 啊，当然，我们制造弹药！太好了，现在我们可以自卫了。我真不知道该怎么感谢你……

english: You could give me a cannon...
translation: 你可以给我一门大炮……

english: Hah! You'd be lucky, those things are worth a fortune.
translation: 哈！你想得美，那些东西值一大笔钱呢。

english: I'll tell you what though, I'll write to the Cannon Engineer requesting him to sell you one. He controls production of the cannons.
translation: 不过我跟你说，我会写信给大炮工程师，要求他卖你一门。他控制着大炮的生产。

english: He won't be able to give you one, but for the right price, I'm sure he'll sell one to you.
translation: 他不能免费给你，但只要你出得起价，我肯定他会卖你一门。

english: Well done, trooper! The goblins seem to have stopped getting in. I think you've done the job!
translation: 做得好，士兵！哥布林似乎不再闯进来了。我想你已经完成任务了！

english: The goblins must have taken him. Please traveller, seek out the goblins' hideout and return the lad to us. They always attack from the South-east, so they must be based down there.
translation: 一定是地精抓走了他。请，旅行者，找到地精的藏身处，把那孩子带回来给我们。他们总是从东南方进攻，所以他们的基地一定在那边。

english: Hawhaw! 'What's that' he asks, what a sense of humour! The Black Guard is the finest regiment in the dwarven army. Only the best of the best are allowed to join it and then they receive months of rigorous training.
translation: 哈哈！他问‘那是什么’，真有幽默感！黑卫队是矮人军队中最精锐的兵团。只有顶尖中的顶尖才有资格加入，之后还要接受数月的严格训练。

english: Hawhaw! 'What's that' she asks, what a sense of humour! The Black Guard is the finest regiment in the dwarven army. Only the best of the best are allowed to join it and then they receive months of rigorous
translation: 哈哈！她问‘那是什么’，真有幽默感！黑卫队是矮人军队中最精锐的兵团。只有顶尖中的顶尖才有资格加入，之后还要接受数月的严格

english: training. However, we are currently in need of a hero, so for a limited time only I'm offering you, a human, a chance to join this prestigious regiment. What do you say?
translation: 训练。不过，我们现在急需一位英雄，所以限时提供给你，一个人类，加入这个赫赫有名的兵团的机会。你觉得怎么样？

english: Trooper, have you managed to find the goblins' base?
translation: 士兵，你找到哥布林的基地了吗？

english: I can't give you these replacement railings until you make some space in your backpack. Come and see me as soon as you can take them.
translation: 在你清出背包空间之前，我不能给你这些替换的栏杆。等你准备好能拿它们了，再来找我。

english: Trooper, have you found the goblins' hideout?
translation: 士兵，你找到哥布林的藏身处了吗？

english: Sounds like that could be it, any sign of the boy?
translation: 听起来有可能，有那孩子的踪影吗？

english: Please find him, for Gilob's sake.
translation: 拜托找到他，看在吉洛布的份上。

english: Hmmm... sounds interesting, I might take you up on that.
translation: 嗯……听起来很有意思，我或许会接受你的提议。

english: I've told you already.
translation: 我已经告诉过你了。

english: Journey to the north into the land of the trolls, and find the secret of the herb the trolls call goutweed.
translation: 往北走，进入巨魔之地，找到那种巨魔称为痛风草的草药的秘密。

english: I need to find some goutweed. Sanfew said you might be able to help.
translation: 我需要找一些痛风草。桑福说你可能帮得上忙。

english: Sanfew, you say? Ah, haven't seen him in a while...
translation: 桑福，是吗？啊，好久没见到他了……

english: Goutweed is used as an ingredient in troll cooking. You should ask one of their cooks.
translation: 痛风草是巨魔烹饪中的一种配料。你应该去问问他们的厨师。

english: Er, hi.
translation: 呃，你好。

english: Hmm? What human do in troll kitchen? Burntmeat tired of cooking goats. Human look tasty.
translation: 嗯？人类在巨魔厨房做什么？烧肉厌倦了煮山羊。人类看起来很好吃。

english: Oh, you don't want to eat me! I'm a tough, hardened adventurer, not tender or tasty at all!
translation: 哦，你可不想吃我！我可是个身经百战的冒险者，一点都不嫩也不好吃！

english: Hmm. Burntmeat think you probably right. What human doing here?
translation: 嗯。烧肉觉得你大概说得对。人类在这里做什么？

english: I'm on a quest to find some goutweed.
translation: 我在执行一项任务，要找一些痛风草。

english: Bwahahaha! Burntmeat not give his greatest cooking secret away so easily.
translation: 哇哈哈哈！烧肉可不会这么轻易就把最伟大的烹饪秘诀交出来。

english: But Burntmeat also has quest for human!
translation: 不过烧肉也有任务给人类！

english: Really? What is it?
translation: 真的吗？是什么？

english: Bring back a tasty human for Burntmeat's stew. If you find tasty human, Burntmeat will give you good reward.
translation: 带一个好吃的人类回来给烧肉的炖菜。如果你找到好吃的人类，烧肉会给你丰厚的奖励。

english: Right. I'll just...go fetch that for you then. Bye!
translation: 好的。那我就……去帮你找吧。再见！

english: Did you find tasty human?
translation: 你找到好吃的人类了吗？

english: Erm, not yet, but I'm working on it...
translation: 呃，还没，但我正在努力……

english: Oh, it's you. Have you talked to the troll cook yet?
translation: 哦，是你啊。你跟那个巨魔厨师谈过了吗？

english: I talked to the troll cook but he wouldn't tell me anything, and now he wants me to find him some tasty human for his stew.
translation: 我和巨魔厨师谈过，但他什么也不肯告诉我，现在他让我给他找些好吃的人类来做他的炖菜。

english: Oh dear, that's no good. You can't just go hand over a human to those trolls...
translation: 哦天哪，这可不好。你不能就这么把一个人类交给那些巨魔……

english: Aha! I have a plan!
translation: 啊哈！我有个计划！

english: Yes! It's bound to work. First of all, I will need a parrot!
translation: 没错！这计划肯定行得通。首先，我需要一只鹦鹉！

english: A PARROT? Where am I going to find one of those?
translation: 一只鹦鹉？我去哪儿找那玩意儿？

english: At the zoo, where else?
translation: 动物园啊，还能去哪儿？

english: Anything else I can do for you?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Oh, it's you. Have you got me a parrot yet?
translation: 哦，是你啊。你给我弄到鹦鹉了吗？

english: I haven't been able to find one yet.
translation: 我还没找到一只。

english: Well, go see if the zoo haveone.
translation: 嗯，去动物园看看他们有没有。

english: Where's the zoo?
translation: 动物园在哪儿？

english: It's in Ardougne, south west of here.
translation: 在阿多尼城，从这里往西南方向走。

english: They won't drink it straight from the bottle...
translation: 它们不会直接从瓶子里喝……

english: I need some way to slow it down...
translation: 我需要想办法让它慢下来……

english: Hah! Got you now!
translation: 哈！这下抓住你了！

english: Sqwaawk...*hic*
translation: 呱呱……*呃*

english: Hey! What are you doing with that parrot?
translation: 嘿！你对那只鹦鹉做了什么？

english: It looks drunk! You should NEVER feed alcohol to a parrot!
translation: 它看起来喝醉了！你绝对不应该给鹦鹉喂酒！

english: Well, good thing I found it! I'll just take it to the vet for you, shall I?
translation: 嗯，幸好我发现了！我就带它去看兽医吧，好吗？

english: Oh, thank you! We're ever so busy here at the Zoo.
translation: 哦，谢谢你！我们在动物园这里一直忙得不可开交。

english: The parrottflew off, I wonder where it went? Silly thing prefered Eadgar to me!
translation: 那只鹦鹉飞走了，不知道它去哪儿了？这傻东西居然更喜欢埃德加而不是我！

english: Raaawk! Polly wanna cracker!
translation: 呱呱！波莉要拉炮！

english: Here it is! Now are you going to explain your plan?
translation: 给你！现在你打算解释一下你的计划了吗？

english: Yes, yes, of course. It's quite ingenious really!
translation: 是的，是的，当然。这计划其实相当巧妙！

english: What we need is something that looks like a human, sounds like a human, smells like a human and tastes like a human.
translation: 我们需要一个看起来像人、听起来像人、闻起来像人、尝起来也像人的东西。

english: How are we going to make it look like a human?
translation: 我们怎么让它看起来像人？

english: We'll just make a scarecrow. We'll need logs, and 10 sheaves of wheat for stuffing.
translation: 我们做个稻草人就行了。需要原木，还有十捆小麦做填充物。

english: How are we going to make it sound like a human?
translation: 我们怎么让它听起来像人？

english: That's what the parrot's for, of course.
translation: 那当然就是鹦鹉的用处了。

english: Who's a pretty boy then?
translation: 谁是漂亮的小家伙？

english: Although the trolls might get suspicious if it doesn't say what they expect a human to say...
translation: 不过，如果它不说巨魔们期望人类说的话，他们可能会起疑心……

english: You should hide it for a while somewhere it can pick up some more appropriate catchphrases.
translation: 你应该把它藏在一个地方一段时间，让它学一些更合适的口头禅。

english: How are we going to make it smell like a human?
translation: 我们怎么让它闻起来像人？

english: Well, we'll need to dress it up anyway; if we use dirty clothes it'll smell human to the trolls.
translation: 嗯，反正我们也得给它穿上衣服；如果我们用脏衣服，对巨魔来说闻起来就像人类了。

english: I'm a man of few clothes myself, so you might want to ask old Sanfew about that one.
translation: 我自己衣服不多，所以你可能得去问问老桑福这件事。

english: And how are we going to make it taste like a human?
translation: 那我们怎么让它尝起来像人？

english: That's easy, we'll just stuff it with a few chickens. Everything tastes like chicken! Five raw chickens should be enough.
translation: 那简单，我们塞几只鸡进去就行了。所有东西吃起来都像鸡！五只生鸡应该够了。

english: That's the plan. Anything else I can do for you?
translation: 计划就是这样。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: What should I do with this parrot?
translation: 我该拿这只鹦鹉怎么办？

english: I told you, put it somewhere it'll learn to say the sort of thing the trolls will expect it to say.
translation: 我告诉过你，把它放在一个能学会说巨魔们期望它说的话的地方。

english: This is likely to be screaming. There's bound to be a good spot somewhere in the troll prison.
translation: 这很可能是尖叫声。巨魔监狱里肯定有个好地方。

english: Polly wanna cracker!
translation: 波莉要拉炮！

english: Pieces of eight! Pieces of eight!
translation: 八分币！八分币！

english: I don't think it's done yet.
translation: 我觉得它还没准备好。

english: I hid the parrot under the rack in the troll prison.
translation: 我把鹦鹉藏在巨魔监狱的架子下面了。

english: Good work. How about those other items?
translation: 干得好。其他那些东西呢？

english: I have [no/the] logs, [no/one/two/three/four/five] [chicken/chickens], [no/one/two/three/four/five/six/seven/eight/nine/ten] [bundle/bundles] of grain and [no/the] dirty clothes.
translation: 我有[没有/这些]原木，[没有/一/二/三/四/五]只[鸡/鸡]，[没有/一/二/三/四/五/六/七/八/九/十]捆谷物，以及[没有/那些]脏衣服。

english: You now need [no/the] logs, [no/one/two/three/four/five] [chicken/chickens], [no/one/two/three/four/five/six/seven/eight/nine/ten] [bundle/bundles] of grain and [no/the] dirty clothes.
translation: 你现在需要[没有/这些]原木，[没有/一/二/三/四/五]只[鸡/鸡]，[没有/一/二/三/四/五/六/七/八/九/十]捆谷物，以及[没有/那些]脏衣服。

english: Eadgar says he needs some dirty clothes for his plan, and he said you might be able to help.
translation: 埃德加说他的计划需要一些脏衣服，他说你可能帮得上忙。

english: Now why would he need that?
translation: 他怎么会需要那个？

english: It's a long story.
translation: 说来话长。

english: Never mind then... I think Tegid is doing his laundry outside. You could ask him if you can borrow one of his dirty robes.
translation: 那算了……我想特吉德正在外面洗衣服。你可以问问他能不能借一件他的脏袍子。

english: You wouldn't be able to spare any of those dirty robes by any chance? It's a matter of the utmost importance.
translation: 你碰巧能匀出一件那些脏袍子吗？这是件至关重要的事情。

english: What? No! These are my robes!
translation: 什么？不行！这些是我的袍子！

english: I'm sure Sanfew won't be happy when I tell him it's your fault he can't perform the purification ritual.
translation: 我敢肯定，当我告诉桑福，因为他你无法进行净化仪式时，他不会高兴的。

english: What? Oh well, if it's a matter of that much importance, I suppose you can borrow one...
translation: 什么？哦好吧，如果事情真的那么重要，我想你可以借一件……

english: You'll give me those robes right now...or I'm going to cut down trees until you do.
translation: 你现在就把那些袍子给我……否则我就去砍树，直到你给为止。

english: Of course I would. They're just trees.
translation: 我当然会。它们只是树而已。

english: You monster! Take the robes and leave this place!
translation: 你这个怪物！拿着袍子离开这里！

english: That's everything!
translation: 东西都齐了！

english: Good, good, everything is almost finished.
translation: 好，好，一切都快完成了。

english: Of course, we can't just give him the dummy and expect to get anything useful out of him.
translation: 当然，我们不能就这么把假人给他，然后指望从他那里得到什么有用的信息。

english: No, of course not. We need to make sure he'll tell you what you need to know.
translation: 不，当然不能。我们需要确保他会告诉你需要知道的事情。

english: And how do we do that?
translation: 那我们该怎么做？

english: I happen to know that the trolls are susceptible to a certain kind of plant that grows around this mountain. I call it Troll Thistle. If properly prepared, it can be made into a sort of Troll truth potion.
translation: 我碰巧知道巨魔对一种生长在这座山周围的植物很敏感。我称之为巨魔蓟。如果处理得当，它可以制成一种巨魔真话药水。

english: How do you prepare it?
translation: 怎么处理它？

english: You'll have to dry it in a fire, then grind it and mix it into a potion with Ranarr weed.
translation: 你得用火把它烘干，然后磨碎，再和拉纳尔草混合成药水。

english: Okay, I'll be back with that soon.
translation: 好的，我很快就带着那个回来。

english: How do I make the troll truth potion again?
translation: 我该怎么再做那个巨魔真话药水来着？

english: Troll Thistle grows around this mountain. If properly prepared, it can be made into a sort of Troll truth potion.
translation: 巨魔蓟生长在这座山周围。如果处理得当，它可以制成一种巨魔真话药水。

english: I'd better not mess around with Eadgar's stew!
translation: 我最好别乱动埃德加的炖菜！

english: I've got the troll truth potion.
translation: 我拿到巨魔真话药水了。

english: Excellent, thank you. Now just go fetch that poor parrot back, it's probably had enough by now.
translation: 太好了，谢谢你。现在去把那只可怜的鹦鹉带回来吧，它大概已经受够了。

english: Ah, hello Sir. Could you please free me? I seem to have ... OW! What are you doing? That's my spleen!
translation: 啊，你好，先生。你能放了我吗？我好像……哎哟！你在干什么？那是我的脾脏！

english: I think it's probably heard enough.
translation: 我想它大概听得够多了。

english: Oh, it's you. You didn't lose your parrot did you? One flew over here and I managed to capture it.
translation: 哦，是你啊。你没弄丢你的鹦鹉吧？有一只飞到这里，我设法抓住了它。

english: That's what I thought.
translation: 我也是这么想的。

english: Just give me a moment...there we go! Can you tell this isn't a bona fide human being? I sure can't!
translation: 给我一点时间……好了！你能看出这不是一个真正的人类吗？反正我是看不出来！

english: I've brought the parrot.
translation: 我把鹦鹉带来了。

english: Hand it here...there we go! Can you tell this isn't a bona fide human being? I sure can't!
translation: 把它给我……好了！你能看出这不是一个真正的人类吗？反正我是看不出来！

english: What am I doing here? Ow! Where's the rest of the Guard? Agh! I won't tell you anything!
translation: 我在这里做什么？哎哟！守卫队的其他人呢？啊！我什么都不会告诉你的！

english: Have you given the fake man to the troll cook yet?
translation: 你把假人给巨魔厨师了吗？

english: Go on then, give it to the cook!
translation: 那就去吧，把它交给厨师！

english: No. I lost it.
translation: 不，我弄丢了。

english: You bumbling imbecile!
translation: 你这个笨手笨脚的白痴！

english: Never mind, here's one I prepared earlier.
translation: 算了，这里有一个我提前准备好的。

english: Did you find tasty human? Burntmeat smell something good.
translation: 你找到好吃的人类了吗？烧肉闻到好东西的味道。

english: Yes! Look!
translation: 是的！你看！

english: Heeeeeeelp!
Ah, dat look like nice tasty human.
translation: 啊，那个看起来像好吃的人类。

english: Aaaargh! Somebody save me!
translation: 啊——！谁来救救我！

english: Yep, sound like human too. Burntmeat put it in stew. Good work, human. Burntmeat give precious reward.
translation: 对，听起来也像人类。烧肉把它放进炖菜里。干得好，人类。烧肉给你珍贵的奖励。

english: This is burnt meat.
translation: 这是烧焦的肉。

english: It first thing I ever try to cook! Very precious to Burntmeat.
translation: 这是烧肉第一次尝试烹饪的东西！对烧肉来说非常珍贵。

english: Thank you... and how's the stew?
translation: 谢谢你……那炖菜怎么样了？

english: Slurp, mmm... Human stew cheer Burntmeat up!
translation: 吸溜，嗯……人类炖菜让烧肉开心起来！

english: So, where can I get some goutweed?
translation: 那么，我在哪里可以弄到痛风草？

english: Hah! Trolls pick it all until none left, many years ago. Only remaining stock in storeroom.
translation: 哈！很多年前巨魔就把它们全采光了，一点不剩。仅存的存货在储藏室里。

english: It well guarded, and Burntmeat hide key in fake bottom of kitchen drawer. Nobody find it there.
translation: 那里守卫森严，烧肉把钥匙藏在厨房抽屉柜的假底里。没人能找到那里。

english: That's some well-guarded secret alright. I'll just be off on my way now.
translation: 这秘密守护得可真严实。那我就先走了。

english: Bye, bye.
translation: 拜拜。

english: How's the stew?
translation: 炖菜怎么样了？

english: Hm?
translation: 嗯？

english: Well? Did the plan work?
translation: 怎么样？计划成功了吗？

english: Yes! I can get into the storeroom now.
translation: 是的！我现在能进储藏室了。

english: I have some goutweed!
translation: 我有一些痛风草！

english: Excellent! I will be able to complete the next part of the ritual now. I will teach you a new spell and give you some of my knowledge in Herblore as a token of thanks.
translation: 太好了！我现在可以完成仪式的下一步了。我会教你一个新法术，并传授一些我的草药学知识作为感谢。

english: If you ever come across more goutweed, bring it to me; I don't need any more for the ritual, but it's still quite difficult for me to get. I'll exchange it for some other herbs.
translation: 如果你以后找到更多痛风草，带给我；仪式上我不需要更多了，但对我来说仍然很难弄到。我会用它换其他草药。

english: Ah, hello again. Have you had any luck finding out about Nickolaus' whereabouts yet?
translation: 啊，又见面了。你找到尼古拉斯的下落了吗？

english: No, nothing yet I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕还没有任何消息。

english: Like I said, he's most likely to be camping out somewhere to the west of the Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 就像我说的，他很可能在地精要塞西边的某个地方露营。

english: Hello? Er... excuse me?
translation: 你好？呃……打扰一下？

english: Hello?  Er... excuse me?
translation: 你好？呃……打扰一下？

english: Hello, are you Nickolaus?
translation: 你好，你是尼古拉斯吗？

english: Aha, I see my reputation precedes me. Yes, I am the renowned hunter and explorer Nickolaus. You've arrived just in time to witness a very momentous occasion, for I have just discovered the nest of a giant
translation: 啊哈，看来我的名声在外。没错，我就是著名的猎人和探险家尼古拉斯。你来得正好，可以见证一个非常重要的时刻，因为我刚刚发现了一个巨鹰的巢穴。

english: eagle.  And a most amazing discovery it is too, even if I do say so myself.
translation: 鹰。而且这也是一个非常了不起的发现，就算是我自己说的。

english: The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.
translation: 阿多尼城的动物园管理员派我来找你。

english: Ah yes, he sent me to find a ferret. A trivial task, and one which pales in comparison compared to this momentous discovery. I'm sure he can wait.
translation: 啊，是的，他派我去找一只雪貂。一个微不足道的任务，和这个惊人的发现相比简直不值一提。我相信他可以等一等。

english: So it's not that you're trapped then?
translation: 所以你不是被困住了？

english: Well I think trapped is quite a negative way of looking at it.
translation: 嗯，我觉得‘被困住’这个说法有点太消极了。

english: I will admit however that getting out of here may be a little tricky. I did have a plan, but unfortunately it didn't involve being stuck in this nest.
translation: 不过我得承认，要离开这里可能有点棘手。我确实有个计划，但不幸的是，这个计划不包括被困在这个巢穴里。

english: Could I help at all?
translation: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: Actually I believe you could. I need to somehow trick the eagles into thinking I'm one of them. Could you fashion some sort of disguise for me?
translation: 事实上，我觉得你可以。我需要想办法骗过这些鹰，让它们以为我是它们的一员。你能帮我做一套伪装吗？

english: What would that involve?
translation: 那需要些什么？

english: Well, you could go and speak to the fancy dress shop owner in Varrock.  He can make anything if you give him the right materials. In fact you should probably get a couple of disguises, one for each of us.
translation: 嗯，你可以去维洛克城找那家奇装异服店的老板谈谈。只要你给他合适的材料，他什么都能做。事实上，你最好做两套伪装，我们一人一套。

english: That's a good idea. There are plenty of feathers around here. I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好主意。这附近有很多羽毛。我去看看能做些什么。

english: Well it'll give you a lot of time to study the eagles.
translation: 这样你就有很多时间研究这些鹰了。

english: Very true, and certainly an opportunity I wouldn't want to miss.
translation: 说得对，这绝对是个我不想错过的机会。

english: Well, I'll let you get on with your work then.
translation: 好吧，那我就不打扰你工作了。

english: It's always a pleasure to discuss my discoveries.
translation: 讨论我的发现总是令人愉快。

english: I've come to rescue you.
translation: 我是来救你的。

english: How very kind of you. But Nickolaus Farrick never needs rescuing.  I may apparently be trapped in a giant eagle's nest, but it is all a cunning ruse to put the beast at ease.
translation: 你真是太客气了。但尼古拉斯.法瑞克从来不需要别人救援。我表面上可能被困在巨鹰的巢穴里，但这其实是一个让这只野兽放松警惕的狡猾计策。

english: Oh, so you're not really trapped?
translation: 哦，所以你不是真的被困住了？

english: Aren't giant eagles mythical?
translation: 巨鹰不是传说中的生物吗？

english: Oh many people believe so, yes, but my relentless exploration has paid off once again, for I stand now in the nest of such a supposedly mythical creature.
translation: 哦，很多人确实这么认为，是的，但我不懈的探索再次得到了回报，因为我现在就站在这种所谓传说生物的巢穴里。

english: How did you manage to find the nest?
translation: 你是怎么找到这个巢穴的？

english: Through unfaltering dedication, attention to detail, oh, and I suppose there's the minor point that I got carried here by an eagle.
translation: 通过坚定不移的奉献精神、对细节的关注，哦，还有一个小细节，我是被一只鹰叼到这里来的。

english: So in fact the eagle found you?
translation: 所以实际上是那只鹰找到了你？

english: So it might appear to an amateur yes, and, well, I may have been a little lucky, but it's still a remarkable discovery don't you think?
translation: 在外行看来可能是这样，嗯，好吧，我可能有点运气，但这仍然是一个了不起的发现，你不觉得吗？

english: Amazing, but what do you intend to do now you've discovered it?
translation: 太神奇了，但你发现了它之后打算做什么？

english: Well, there's all sorts to do. I need to observe its behaviour patterns and document its feeding habits.  The discovery is only just the beginning you know.
translation: 嗯，有很多事要做。我需要观察它的行为模式，记录它的进食习惯。你知道，发现只是开始而已。

english: I think you're trapped.
translation: 我觉得你被困住了。

english: Hello Nickolaus, how are you getting on with your discoveries?
translation: 你好，尼古拉斯，你的发现进展如何？

english: Wonderfully, these giant eagles are simply magnificent creatures.  I absolutely must see about getting one as a pet.
translation: 棒极了，这些巨鹰真是了不起的生物。我一定要想办法弄一只当宠物。

english: A pet?  Are you crazy?
translation: 当宠物？你疯了吗？

english: Quite possibly, quite possibly, but I haven't found a creature I couldn't tame yet.
translation: 很有可能，很有可能，但我还没遇到过我驯服不了的生物。

english: Wonderfully thank you, although I am still having just a little trouble convincing them to let me leave.
translation: 非常好，谢谢，虽然我还是有点难以说服它们让我离开。

english: I don't suppose you've managed to get that disguise I asked for yet?
translation: 我想你还没弄到我之前要的伪装吧？

english: I'm afraid not yet.
translation: 恐怕还没有。

english: Well like I said, the Varrock fancy dress shop is a good bet if you have the materials, and there are plenty of feathers around here.
translation: 嗯，就像我说的，如果你有材料，维洛克城的奇装异服店是个好选择，而且这附近有很多羽毛。

english: And while you're working on that, I'll get back to studying these incredible winged wonders.
translation: 在你忙这个的时候，我就回去研究这些不可思议的有翼奇观了。

english: Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.
translation: 嗯，具体来说，我想要几套鸟类服装。

english: Ah, an inspired choice. What kind of bird were you thinking of?
translation: 啊，有品位的选择。你想要哪种鸟？

english: A giant eagle.
translation: 巨鹰。

english: Very interesting. Unfortunately I don't think I have any giant eagle costumes in stock at the moment.
translation: 非常有趣。可惜我目前店里没有巨鹰服装的库存。

english: Of course if I had the materials I could make them for you.
translation: 当然，如果我有材料的话，我可以为你做。

english: What materials would you need?
translation: 你需要什么材料？

english: Well, the main problem is that I'm fresh out of giant eagle feathers. I've been meaning to get onto my supplier about that for some time.
translation: 嗯，主要问题是我的巨鹰羽毛用完了。我早就想联系我的供应商了。

english: Wait a second, you have a supplier? But I thought nobody knew where to find the nests?
translation: 等等，你有供应商？但我以为没人知道在哪里能找到巢穴？

english: Well, there was some chap in desert clothing. He said his name was Ali. He assured me they were giant eagle feathers, although when I come to think about it they were suspiciously similar to chicken feathers.
translation: 嗯，有个穿沙漠服装的家伙。他说他叫阿里。他向我保证那是巨鹰羽毛，虽然我现在想想，那些羽毛和鸡毛可疑地相似。

english: Anyway, you're probably looking at about 10 giant eagle feathers, assuming you can find a nest.
translation: 总之，如果你能找到巢穴，你可能需要大约10根巨鹰羽毛。

english: I'd also need some swamp tar to hold things together and some yellow dye for the beaks.  Everything else I can supply myself.
translation: 我还需要一些沼泽焦油来固定，以及一些黄色染料来做喙。其他东西我自己可以提供。

english: What was it you needed to make those eagle costumes again?
translation: 你刚才说做那些鹰服装需要什么来着？

english: I should be able to knock something up if you get me 10 of the right sort of feather. I'll also need some swamp tar and some yellow dye.
translation: 如果你给我10根合适的羽毛，我应该能拼凑出来。我还需要一些沼泽焦油和一些黄色染料。

english: I've got the feathers and materials you requested. Can you make those giant eagle costumes for me now?
translation: 我拿到了你要的羽毛和材料。你现在能帮我做那些巨鹰服装了吗？

english: Certainly. It'll also cost you 50 gold pieces.
translation: 当然可以。不过还要收你50金币。

english: I'm afraid I don't have that much money with me.
translation: 恐怕我没带那么多钱。

english: Okay, here are the materials.  Eagle me up.
translation: 好吧，材料在这里。把我变成鹰吧。

english: There we go; two eagle costumes. You should be the envy of the entire party with those.
translation: 做好了；两套鹰服装。穿上它们，你一定会成为整个派对上最令人羡慕的人。

english: On second thoughts, that's too expensive.
translation: 再想想，太贵了。

english: Well, feel free to come back if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意，随时可以回来。

english: Yes, I have one right here.
translation: 是的，我这里就有一个。

english: Well bring it over here then.  It's not much use to me over there.
translation: 那就把它拿过来吧。放在那边对我没什么用。

english: What's this, a young hatchling?  Oh no, I hope it doesn't think I'm its dinner!
translation: 这是什么，一只幼鸟？哦不，我希望它别以为我是它的晚餐！

english: No, Nickolaus, it's me!  I'm just in disguise!
translation: 不，尼古拉斯，是我！我只是伪装了一下！

english: You're sure...you're sure you're not going to eat me?
translation: 你确定……你确定你不会吃了我？

english: No of course not. You sent me to get you an eagle outfit remember?  So you could get out of this nest?
translation: 当然不会。是你派我去给你弄一套鹰服装的，记得吗？这样你就能离开这个巢穴了？

english: Wow, that really is a very convincing disguise.  Have you got one for me too?
translation: 哇，这伪装真的很逼真。你也有给我一套吗？

english: Hey, give me that!
translation: 嘿，把它给我！

english: Give me that or... Er...
translation: 把它给我，否则……呃……

english: Your mother was a hamster, and your father smelt of elderberries!
translation: 你母亲是只仓鼠，你父亲闻起来像接骨木果！

english: Excellent, now there is no way the eagle will be able to tell me from one of its own.
translation: 太好了，现在这只鹰绝对分不清我和它自己了。

english: Now you run off, and I'll meet you back down at the camp site.
translation: 现在你先跑开，我在下面的营地和你碰头。

english: I've given you the disguise you needed, can we go now?
translation: 我已经给了你需要的伪装，我们现在可以走了吗？

english: Calm down.  You must realise I can't leave just like that, this is far too amazing an opportunity.  Just go down to the camp site and I'll meet you there.
translation: 冷静点。你得明白我不能就这么离开，这个机会实在太难得了。你先去营地，我随后就到。

english: : Ah, hello again.  Can I help at all?
translation: 啊，又见面了。我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret.  Can you get me one at all?
translation: 嗯，我最初是被派来找你的，因为要抓一只雪貂。你能帮我弄一只吗？

english: I'll do better than that.  I'll teach you how to capture one yourself.
translation: 我做得比那更好。我会教你如何自己抓一只。

english: That sounds good to me.  What do I do.
translation: 听起来不错。我该怎么做？

english: Come with me and I'll show you.
translation: 跟我来，我演示给你看。

english: Okay, so we've baited the trap with meat, now what?
translation: 好了，我们已经用肉做了陷阱的诱饵，现在呢？

english: And now...we wait. Quietly!
translation: 现在……我们等着。安静地等！

english: But what if I don't like waiting for things?
translation: 但如果我不喜欢等待呢？

english: Did I mention we wait quietly?
translation: 我有没有提到我们要安静地等？

english: Shhh, here comes something.
translation: 嘘，有东西来了。

english: Ha ha, there you go! One gift-wrapped ferret ready for delivery.
translation: 哈哈，搞定了！一只包装好的雪貂，准备交货。

english: See, it's all just a matter of patience.
translation: 看吧，这全靠耐心。

english: I've not got the time right now.
translation: 我现在没时间。

english: Ah you don't get out of it that easily. When you've got the time come back and see me.
translation: 啊，你可别想这么容易就溜掉。等你有时间了，回来找我。

english: Ah, hello again. Have you had any luck finding a clue as to Nickolaus' whereabouts yet?
translation: 啊，又见面了。你找到尼古拉斯下落的线索了吗？

english: Yes I have actually. He'd been abducted by giant eagles, but I managed to rescue him. He's now gotten back to his hunting.
translation: 实际上我找到了。他被巨鹰抓走了，但我成功救了他。他现在已经回去打猎了。

english: Giant eagles? What a strange notion. Well, regardless, if you've found him can you tell him to hurry up with that ferret.
translation: 巨鹰？真是个奇怪的说法。好吧，不管怎样，如果你找到了他，能告诉他快点把那只雪貂弄来吗？

english: Even better, I have a ferret right here for you.
translation: 更棒的是，我这里就有一只雪貂给你。

english: You do? Ah, yes, wonderful, I never doubted you for a second. That'll make an excellent addition to the zoo.
translation: 真的吗？啊，是的，太好了，我从来就没怀疑过你。这会给动物园增添一个绝佳的展品。

english: Now to explore this area thoroughly, to find what forgotten secrets it contains.
translation: 现在要彻底探索这个区域，找出它隐藏的秘密。

english: I hope I got that right.
translation: 希望我没搞错。

english: Ah, an adventurer. Could you spare some of your time to help me?
translation: 啊，一位冒险者。你能抽出一些时间来帮我吗？

english: It's a sorry tale. I was once an accomplished sculptor, you see.
translation: 说来话长。我曾经是个技艺高超的雕刻师。

english: I made statues for the kings, queens and rulers of Gielinor. But then there was the accident...
translation: 我曾为吉莱诺的国王、女王和统治者们制作雕像。但后来发生了一场意外……

english: After that, I could never hold a chisel again.
translation: 从那以后，我再也没能握住凿子。

english: But I have been struck by my muse while travelling the desert, and want nothing more than to build a statue in this area.
translation: 但我在穿越沙漠时受到了缪斯的启发，现在只想在这里建一座雕像。

english: The desert's plain and full of sand, and needs more decoration.
translation: 这片沙漠平坦又满是沙子，需要更多的装饰。

english: So, what would you need my help with?
translation: 那么，你需要我帮什么忙呢？

english: As I said, I can't hold a chisel, but I can guide you in crafting the statue for me.
translation: 正如我所说，我握不住凿子，但我可以指导你制作这座雕像。

english: I'd need you to quarry the stone for it, as well.
translation: 我还需要你去采石场开采石头。

english: Well, will you help me with my art?
translation: 那么，你愿意帮助我完成我的艺术吗？

english: You'll have to explain it to me as you go along, but count me in.
translation: 你需要边走边向我解释，但我愿意加入。

english: Excellent.
translation: 太好了。

english: What should I be doing to make your statue?
translation: 我该怎么做才能制作你的雕像呢？

english: There is a stone quarry nearby; I require several blocks of sandstone in order to make the statue.
translation: 附近有一个采石场；我需要几块砂岩来制作雕像。

english: Each of these blocks should be around... well, let's say thirty two kilograms for the first one.
translation: 每一块应该大约……嗯，第一块就说是三十二公斤吧。

english: I can't mine a block that big!
translation: 我可采不了那么大的石块！

english: Well, then, bring me enough smaller blocks to make thirty two kilograms, and I will deal with it.
translation: 那好吧，带给我足够多的小石块，凑足三十二公斤，我来处理。

english: So, how much do different blocks of sandstone weigh?
translation: 那么，不同大小的砂岩块各有多重呢？

english: From what the last adventurer told me, there are tiny blocks that weigh 1 kg, small blocks that weigh 2 kg, and medium-sized blocks that weigh 5 kg.
translation: 据上一个冒险者告诉我，有重1公斤的极小石块，重2公斤的小石块，和重5公斤的中等石块。

english: There are also large blocks that weigh 10 kg, but I doubt a weedy adventurer like you could even carry one, let alone mine one cleanly.
translation: 还有重10公斤的大石块，但我觉得像你这样瘦弱的冒险者恐怕连一块都搬不动，更别说干净利落地开采出来了。

english: Apparently, the more skilled you are at mining, the larger the blocks you can chip off the rock.
translation: 显然，你的采矿技能越高，能从岩石上凿下的石块就越大。

english: Okay, I'll get on with it.
translation: 好的，我这就去办。

english: I don't know, that sounds like a lot of work.
translation: 我不确定，听起来工作量很大。

english: All true art requires work.
translation: 所有真正的艺术都需要付出努力。

english: I have some sandstone for you!
translation: 我给你带了些砂岩！

english: Well, hand it over, then.
translation: 嗯，那就交出来吧。

english: That makes [1-32] kg I'm carrying now.
translation: 我现在携带了[1-32]公斤。

english: I'm now carrying [1-32] kg of your inexpertly-quarried stone.
translation: 我现在正拎着你那开采技术拙劣的[1-32]公斤石头。

english: That's [1-32] kg I have now.
translation: 我现在有[1-32]公斤了。

english: I need [1-32] kg more stone to make the base. Any more stone you want to burden me down with?
translation: 我还需要[1-32]公斤石头来做底座。你还想拿更多石头来压着我吗？

english: I need [1-32] kg more stone to make the base. Have you any more to make me carry?
translation: 我还需要[1-32]公斤石头来做底座。你还有更多石头要我搬吗？

english: I need [1-32] kg more stone to make the base. Do you have any more stone you want to offload onto me?
translation: 我还需要[1-32]公斤石头来做底座。你还有石头想甩给我吗？

english: Yes, I have more stone.
translation: 是的，我还有更多石头。

english: Here's a large 10 kg block.
translation: 这是一块重10公斤的大石块。

english: Thank you, adventurer.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者。

english: Here's a medium 5 kg block.
translation: 这是一块重5公斤的中等石块。

english: Oh, joy. I'm sure I'll treasure it.
translation: 哦，真高兴。我肯定会珍藏它的。

english: Here's a small 2 kg block.
translation: 这是一块重2公斤的小石块。

english: So generous of you, adventurer.
translation: 你可真慷慨，冒险者。

english: Here's a tiny 1 kg block.
translation: 这是一块重1公斤的极小石块。

english: Either you've been splitting stone into smaller blocks, or you're worse at quarrying stone than I expected.
translation: 要么你把石头敲成了更小的块，要么你采石的技术比我想象的还要差。

english: Why won't you take more than 32 kg of stone?
translation: 为什么你不收下超过32公斤的石头呢？

english: Because, adventurer, I'm not going to carry more of your blocks than I absolutely must.
translation: 因为，冒险者，除非万不得已，我不想多搬你的石块。

english: If your blocks are too big, break them with a chisel or a pick.
translation: 如果你的石块太大，就用凿子或镐子敲碎它们。

english: That's enough for the base of the statue, certainly.
translation: 这些肯定足够做雕像的底座了。

english: Here you are, adventurer. Now, use a chisel to craft it into a base for the statue.
translation: 给你，冒险者。现在，用凿子把它制作成雕像的底座。

english: How am I supposed to carry that? It's huge!
translation: 我怎么可能搬得动那个？它太大了！

english: Oh, stop whining. The last adventurer who helped me was carrying around a girl in a barrel.
translation: 哦，别抱怨了。上一个帮我的冒险者还抱着一个装在桶里的女孩到处走呢。

english: Zamorak only knows why, but [he/she] didn't complain.
translation: 萨莫拉克才知道为什么，但[he/she]可没抱怨。

english: No, that's all for now.
translation: 不，就这些了。

english: I have this large block of sandstone you gave me...
translation: 我有你给我的这块大砂岩……

english: I told you to carve it into the base of the statue, correct?
translation: 我告诉过你把它雕刻成雕像的底座，对吧？

english: Yes, you did.
translation: 是的，你说过。

english: Then why are you standing around brainlessly? Get on with it!
translation: 那你为什么还傻站着？赶紧去做！

english: I've made the base of the statue!
translation: 我已经做好了雕像的底座！

english: Excellent. Now, just put it on the flat ground next to me.
translation: 太好了。现在，把它放在我旁边平坦的地面上。

english: What do you want me to do now?
translation: 你现在想让我做什么？

english: Hmph. Well, the base of the statue is done, but it needs a body. Twenty kilograms should be enough for you to make it.
translation: 哼。好吧，雕像的底座已经做好了，但它还需要一个身体。二十公斤应该足够你制作了。

english: I'll do it right away!
translation: 我马上去办！

english: That makes [1-20] kg I'm carrying now.
translation: 我现在携带了[1-20]公斤。

english: I'm now carrying [1-20] kg of your inexpertly-quarried stone.
translation: 我现在正拎着你那开采技术拙劣的[1-20]公斤石头。

english: That's [1-20] kg I have now.
translation: 我现在有[1-20]公斤了。

english: I need [1-20] kg more stone to make the body. Any more stone you want to burden me down with?
translation: 我还需要[1-20]公斤石头来做身体。你还想拿更多石头来压着我吗？

english: I need [1-20] kg more stone to make the body. Have you any more to make me carry?
translation: 我还需要[1-20]公斤石头来做身体。你还有更多石头要我搬吗？

english: I need [1-20] kg more stone to make the body. Do you have any more stone you want to offload onto me?
translation: 我还需要[1-20]公斤石头来做身体。你还有石头想甩给我吗？

english: That should be enough to use for the statue's body.
translation: 这些应该足够用来做雕像的身体了。

english: All you have to do with it, adventurer, is chisel it into the body of the statue.
translation: 冒险者，你只需要用凿子把它雕刻成雕像的身体。

english: I have this large block of sandstone you gave me.
translation: 我有你给我的这块大砂岩。

english: Very nice, adventurer. You're supposed to make it into the statue's body.
translation: 非常好，冒险者。你应该把它做成雕像的身体。

english: Get your chisel ready and start working.
translation: 拿起你的凿子开始工作吧。

english: I've made the statue's body!
translation: 我已经做好了雕像的身体！

english: Well done, adventurer. Not as dense as you look.
translation: 干得好，冒险者。不像你看起来那么笨。

english: Go on, add it to the base of the statue.
translation: 去吧，把它加到雕像的底座上。

english: You utter incompetent! Have you added the body to the statue yet?
translation: 你这个彻底的废物！你把身体加到雕像上了吗？

english: Of course I have!
translation: 我当然加了！

english: Hmm, then perhaps I'm still missing something...
translation: 嗯，那也许我还是漏掉了什么……

english: What do you want me to do next?
translation: 你接下来想让我做什么？

english: Oh, I don't know, adventurer. Go and chisel the statue a bit more, or something.
translation: 哦，我不知道，冒险者。再去凿一凿雕像，或者做点别的。

english: It shouldn't have taken this long... did I miscalculate?
translation: 不应该花这么长时间的……是我算错了吗？

english: Ah, adventurer. As you can see, the statue is nearly complete. All it needs is a head.
translation: 啊，冒险者。如你所见，雕像几乎完成了。它只需要一个头。

english: The head should be made out of granite, which you can find in that quarry nearby.
translation: 头应该用花岗岩制作，你可以在附近的那个矿场找到。

english: As for whose head... well, perhaps I'll let you impose your own artistic vision on it.
translation: 至于用谁的头……嗯，也许我让你来发挥你自己的艺术创意。

english: Whose head do you think should be on the statue?
translation: 你觉得雕像上应该是谁的头？

english: I think it should have my head!
translation: 我觉得应该用我的头！

english: Are you mad?
translation: 你疯了吗？

english: You'd start carving it, then you'd take a helmet off or change your hairstyle, and nobody would know who on Gielinor it was supposed to be!
translation: 你开始雕刻它，然后你摘掉头盔或者换个发型，就没人知道在吉莱诺它本该是谁了！

english: Statues are far more permanent than you adventurers and your fashions.
translation: 雕像可比你们这些冒险者和你们的时尚持久多了。

english: So I can't put my head on the statue?
translation: 所以我不能把我的头放在雕像上？

english: No. Now choose something sensible.
translation: 不能。现在选个明智的。

english: I think it should have your head.
translation: 我觉得应该用你的头。

english: After all, it's your statue.
translation: 毕竟，这是你的雕像。

english: Why, that's very generous of you, adventurer.
translation: 哎呀，你真是太慷慨了，冒险者。

english: Are you hoping for a bigger reward for saying that?
translation: 你是希望能通过这么说得到更大的奖励吗？

english: Er, maybe.
translation: 呃，也许吧。

english: Wonderful. Well, at least you have me here for reference.
translation: 太好了。好吧，至少你这里有我这个参照物。

english: Now, go and find a suitable block of granite and make that head.
translation: 现在，去找一块合适的花岗岩，把那个头做出来。

english: And do try to remember which one it is you're carving.
translation: 并且一定要记住你正在雕刻的是哪一个。

english: I think it should have a god's head.
translation: 我觉得应该用一个神明的头。

english: And which god were you thinking of? There's very little reference material here in the desert.
translation: 你想到哪个神明了？沙漠里可没什么参考资料。

english: Whose head do you think I should make?
translation: 你觉得我应该做谁的头？

english: Well, some of the people in the desert worship a god called Icthlarin.
translation: 嗯，沙漠里有不少人信奉一位名叫伊克哈林的神明。

english: Or, if you prefer, I'm sure you could sculpt Zamorak instead.
translation: 或者，如果你更喜欢，我肯定你可以改雕刻扎莫拉克。

english: I'll use Zamorak's head for the statue.
translation: 我会用萨莫拉克的头部来做雕像。

english: Ah, an excellent choice.
translation: 啊，选得好。

english: Now you should find a suitable block of granite, and make that head.
translation: 现在你该去找一块合适的花岗岩，然后把那个头雕出来。

english: Try to remember which head you've decided to carve - I know you adventurers. Memories like fishing nets.
translation: 试着记住你决定雕刻哪颗头——我了解你们冒险者。记忆力就像渔网一样。

english: I'll use Icthlarin's head for the statue.
translation: 我会用伊克哈林的头部来做雕像。

english: An interesting choice - I'm sure there's some reference material you can use around here.
translation: 一个有趣的选择——我相信附近一定有些参考资料你可以用。

english: Find a suitable block of granite, and get carving.
translation: 找一块合适的花岗岩，然后开始雕刻。

english: And make sure to remember which one you're supposed to be carving. I've known some of you adventurers to forget things you were told three seconds ago.
translation: 并且确保记住你应该雕刻哪一个。我知道你们有些冒险者会忘记三秒钟前刚被告知的事情。

english: A human statue with a camel's head? Is there any particular reason?
translation: 一个人身骆驼头的雕像？有什么特别的原因吗？

english: Er, no. I just thought it would be funny.
translation: 呃，没有。我只是觉得这样会很好笑。

english: Well, it is appropriate, all things considered...
translation: 嗯，综合考虑的话，倒也挺合适的……

english: Very well, it'll work well in a desert setting. Now, find a suitable block of granite, and carve that head.
translation: 很好，在沙漠环境里会很搭。现在，去找一块合适的花岗岩，然后把那个头雕出来。

english: Make sure you remember which head you're carving. The last adventurer who tried to help me forgot half- way through carving, and produced the strangest mixture of camel and human I've ever seen.
translation: 确保你记住你在雕刻哪颗头。上一个试图帮我的冒险者在雕刻中途忘记了，结果做出了我见过的最奇怪的骆驼和人类的混合体。

english: You know, I've done something like this before.
translation: 你知道吗，我以前做过类似的事。

english: I had to help rebuild a statue in the city of Keldagrim, and then choose whose head should be placed on the top!
translation: 我曾在凯尔达格林城帮忙重建一座雕像，还要选择谁的头像该放在最上面！

english: Keldagrim? Hmph. Technically good sculptors, the dwarves, but they have no sense of art.
translation: 凯尔达格林城？哼。矮人技术上是好雕刻师，但他们没有艺术感。

english: I'm sure that none of them would even think of travelling to the desert and building a statue here.
translation: 我敢肯定，他们中没有一个会想到来沙漠并在这种地方建雕像。

english: Can I use the head I chose for that statue on yours?
translation: 我能用我为那座雕像选的头像，用在你的这座上吗？

english: Do you even remember what it looked like?
translation: 你甚至还记得它长什么样吗？

english: Then no, you can't. Now, choose something else.
translation: 那就不行。现在，选点别的。

english: Hmm. Which head did I decide to use for the statue?
translation: 嗯。我到底决定用哪个头来做雕像来着？

english: There, that looks good.
translation: 好了，看起来不错。

english: Was it supposed to look like that?
translation: 它应该长这样吗？

english: I have a head for the statue, but...
translation: 我有一个给雕像用的头，但是……

english: I'm not sure it's the right one.
translation: 我不确定是不是对的。

english: You decided to make the statue's head look like me, you said.
translation: 你说过，你决定让雕像的头看起来像我。

english: Hmm. I don't think much of your artistic skills, adventurer, but it's a passable likeness.
translation: 嗯。我不觉得你的艺术天赋有多高，冒险者，但至少勉强能认出是我的模样。

english: ...You really have a shorter attention span than a grain of sand, don't you?
translation: ……你的注意力真的比一粒沙子还要短，对吧？

english: You said you'd make the statue's head look like me, not like modern art!
translation: 你说过要让雕像的头看起来像我，不是像现代艺术！

english: I'm sorry, I'll remember next time.
translation: 对不起，下次我会记住的。

english: Perhaps it was too difficult for you. Do you want to change what head you'll make?
translation: 也许这对你来说太难了。你想换一个头来雕刻吗？

english: No, I'll stay with the one I chose first.
translation: 不，我坚持最初的选择。

english: Fair enough. Remember, you're carving my head for the statue.
translation: 好吧。记住，你在为雕像雕刻我的头。

english: Yes, I'd like to change my choice.
translation: 是的，我想改变我的选择。

english: Well, which will you choose this time?
translation: 那么，这次你选哪个呢？

english: You said you'd make the statue's head look like Zamorak.
translation: 你说过要让雕像的头看起来像萨莫拉克。

english: Hmm. You're not a particularly good sculptor, adventurer, but it's at least recognisable.
translation: 嗯。你不是什么特别出色的雕刻师，冒险者，但至少还能认出来。

english: Do you even remember who you were supposed be carving?
translation: 你还记得你应该雕刻谁吗？

english: It was supposed to be Zamorak, not the horrific monstrosity you've carved!
translation: 它本该是萨莫拉克，而不是你雕出来的这个可怕的怪物！

english: But I thought that was what he looked like.
translation: 但我以为他就是那个样子。

english: How dare you?
translation: 你怎么敢？

english: Ahem, that is to say, er...
translation: 咳咳，我是说，呃……

english: Well, it was obviously too tough for you. Do you want to change what head you'll make?
translation: 好吧，显然这对你来说太难了。你想换一个头来雕刻吗？

english: Well, you said that you'd make the statue's head look like Icthlarin.
translation: 嗯，你说过要让雕像的头看起来像伊克哈林。

english: You're not much of an artist, but at least you did your research. It'll pass.
translation: 你算不上什么艺术家，但至少你做了功课。能凑合看。

english: Weren't you supposed to be carving Icthlarin's head?
translation: 你不是应该雕刻伊克哈林的头吗？

english: ...I was?
translation: ……是吗？

english: Well, you're paying lots of attention, aren't you? Honestly, you adventurers.
translation: 嗯，你倒是很专注，对吧？说实话，你们这些冒险者啊。

english: It would be easier on your poor little brain if you changed what head you'll make, don't you agree?
translation: 如果你改变你要做的头，对你可怜的小大脑来说会更容易，你同意吗？

english: You said you'd make the statue's head look like a camel, and that looks like...
translation: 你说过要让雕像的头看起来像一头骆驼，而这个看起来像……

english: Well, it wouldn't fool a camel, but it's close enough for the statue.
translation: 嗯，骗不过骆驼，但对雕像来说也够用了。

english: I don't believe it. You said you were planning to make a camel head, but what's this?
translation: 我真不敢相信。你说你打算做一个骆驼头，但这又是什么？

english: Er, not a camel head?
translation: 呃，不是一个骆驼头？

english: Correct, adventurer! Have a cake.
translation: 没错，冒险者！赏你一块蛋糕。

english: Of course not! Why would I give something to you for having a worse memory than a piece of burnt fish?
translation: 当然不会！我为什么要因为你记性比一块烧焦的鱼还差就给你东西？

english: Do you want to change what head you'll make to something you have a chance of remembering?
translation: 你想不想换一个你有可能记得住的头来雕刻？

english: Hold it! I know you adventurers.
translation: 等等！我知道你们这些冒险者。

english: I bet you've managed to make the wrong head, or something like that.
translation: 我打赌你肯定雕错了头，或者类似的事。

english: I know what I'm doing, honest...
translation: 我知道我在做什么，真的……

english: I don't care if you think you know what you're doing. Let me have a look at that head.
translation: 我不在乎你是否觉得自己知道在做什么。让我看看那个头。

english: Fine, fine...
translation: 好吧，好吧……

english: Argh, my duodenum!
translation: 啊，我的十二指肠！

english: Ow... Lazim has some explaining to do!
translation: 哎哟……拉齐姆得好好解释一下！

english: Ah, excellent, it's all gone as planned.
translation: 啊，太好了，一切都按计划进行。

english: Gone as planned?
translation: 按计划进行？

english: We just fell through the ground into some weird temple!
translation: 我们刚刚掉进了一个奇怪的庙里！

english: Of course we did! That's why I had you build a statue.
translation: 当然是计划之内！这就是为什么我让你建那座雕像。

english: I don't think you really are a sculptor. What are you looking for in this temple?
translation: 我觉得你真的不是一个雕刻家。你在这个庙里找什么？

english: Oh, nothing. No treasure here. No priceless artefacts from the lost ages of Gielinor, or anything like that.
translation: 哦，没什么。这里没有宝藏。没有来自吉莱诺失落时代的无价神器，或其他类似的东西。

english: I'll be leaving, then.
translation: 那我就要走了。

english: Wait! If you help me, then...
translation: 等等！如果你帮我，那么……

english: I'll give you a share of whatever we find.
translation: 我会把我们找到的任何东西分你一份。

english: That sounds better. So, where's the treasure?
translation: 这听起来好多了。那么，宝藏在哪里？

english: At the top of the temple. We've fallen through to the very bottom, so you'll have to climb up to the next floor.
translation: 在神庙顶部。我们一路掉到了最底部，所以你得爬上下一层。

english: That's good, but...
translation: 那很好，但是……

english: How do I get further into the temple?
translation: 我怎么才能深入庙里？

english: The stories I've heard say there are odd doors in this temple, that have locks that don't need keys, but... rather large limbs.
translation: 我听说的故事里提到这座庙里有奇怪的门，它们的锁不需要钥匙，而是……相当大的肢体。

english: You can use your chisel or pick to take them from the statue. They should be the right size.
translation: 你可以用你的凿子或镐头把它们从雕像上取下来。它们的大小应该正合适。

english: Be thankful they're the statue's limbs and not yours, adventurer.
translation: 要庆幸那是雕像的肢体，而不是你的，冒险者。

english: Do you know where the statue's head is?
translation: 你知道雕像的头在哪里吗？

english: Ah, it fell off when the statue dropped through the ceiling. I've been keeping it safe since then.
translation: 啊，雕像掉穿天花板的时候头掉下来了。从那以后我一直妥善保管着它。

english: Try not to lose it, adventurer.
translation: 尽量别弄丢了，冒险者。

english: You didn't get far from here before you mislaid it.
translation: 你没离开这里多远就把它放丢了。

english: This time, try not to drop it.
translation: 这次，尽量别掉了。

english: ...You're carrying it, adventurer.
translation: ……你正拿着它呢，冒险者。

english: Been at the Asgarnian Ale a little too much, have we?
translation: 阿斯加尼亚麦酒喝太多了，是吧？

english: Could you make these stone limbs easier to carry?
translation: 你能把这些石头肢体弄得更容易携带一些吗？

english: They're really heavy, and they weigh me down.
translation: 它们真的很重，压得我受不了。

english: Of course not! I'm not a carnival conjurer.
translation: 当然不行！我又不是嘉年华的魔术师。

english: Adversity builds character, adventurer. Heft them around by yourself.
translation: 逆境塑造品格，冒险者。你自己扛着它们到处走吧。

english: I mislaid the statue's right arm.
translation: 我把雕像的右臂放丢了。

english: I suppose I'm useful to have around at these times. I found it when you dropped it around here.
translation: 我想这时候我还有点用。你掉在这附近的时候我找到了。

english: I can't find the statue's left arm.
translation: 我找不到雕像的左臂。

english: It's lucky for you that I notice these things. Here, you managed to drop it in this room.
translation: 你运气好，我注意到了这些东西。给，你掉在这个房间里了。

english: Er... I don't know where I put the statue's left leg.
translation: 呃……我不记得我把雕像的左腿放哪了。

english: You dropped it near the statue. Do I have to hold your hand through everything?
translation: 你把它掉在雕像附近了。我是不是得事事都手把手教你？

english: Here it is.
translation: 给你。

english: I lost the statue's right leg.
translation: 我把雕像的右腿弄丢了。

english: Well, it didn't go far - I found it in here. Take better care of it next time.
translation: 嗯，它没跑多远——我在这里找到了。下次好好保管它。

english: Ow, my head...
translation: 哎哟，我的头……

english: At last, it's complete. A temple fit for my lord.
translation: 终于完成了。一座配得上我主的庙宇。

english: All right, men, destroy that evil sorceress... and her temple with her!
translation: 好了，士兵们，摧毁那个邪恶的女巫……还有她的庙宇！

english: You will never have this temple - it belongs to my lord!
translation: 你永远别想得到这座庙宇——它属于我主！

english: F-for Avarrocka!
translation: 为……为阿瓦罗卡而战！

english: Ah ha ha ha ha!
translation: 啊哈哈哈！

english: Well, why would Zamorak want a temple? You said he needed weapons instead.
translation: 嗯，萨莫拉克为什么要一座庙宇？你说过他需要的是武器。

english: I wish I'd never supported him.
translation: 我真希望自己从未支持过他。

english: So you've seen sense? You'll join our side?
translation: 所以你明白过来了？要加入我们这边？

english: Heh heh heh...
translation: 嘿嘿嘿……

english: Surely this would make a good weapon...
translation: 这肯定能做成一件好武器……

english: No, no! Curse it, that doesn't work!
translation: 不，不！该死的，这行不通！

english: Can you help me with this pedestal I've found?
translation: 你能帮我看看我找到的这个基座吗？

english: What pedestal?
translation: 什么基座？

english: It's on the floor above this. It looks sort of important.
translation: 就在这上面一层。看起来挺重要的。

english: Really? Did it have some sort of recess on the top?
translation: 真的吗？它顶部是不是有个凹处？

english: Now that you mention it, it did...
translation: 你这么一说，确实有……

english: In that case, perhaps you should try using the head of the statue on it.
translation: 那样的话，也许你应该试试把雕像的头放上去。

english: Yes, and I tried using the statue's head with it...
translation: 是的，我试过把雕像的头放上去……

english: ...but it didn't fit properly.
translation: ……但不太合适。

english: Hmm. Intriguing, adventurer.
translation: 嗯。真有意思，冒险者。

english: Perhaps you should find out what shape the recess is, so you can sculpt something that will fit in it.
translation: 也许你应该先弄清楚那个凹处的形状，这样就能雕刻出合适的东西放进去。

english: Are you sure that will work?
translation: 你确定这能行？

english: Adventurer, I know more about this temple than you do.
translation: 冒险者，我对这座庙宇的了解比你多。

english: All you need to do is make a mould of the recess somehow, then use it as a guide to make another head.
translation: 你只需要想办法给那个凹处做个模具，然后照着它再做一个头。

english: It should be made from the same granite as the statue's head was.
translation: 应该用和雕像头一样的花岗岩来做。

english: Ow, not another headache...
translation: 哎哟，又头疼了……

english: But it's still a nice temple, isn't it?
translation: 但这仍然是一座不错的庙宇，对吧？

english: Wait... What is this?
translation: 等等……这是什么？

english: Ha ha ha. You believed me, didn't you?
translation: 哈哈哈。你相信我了，对吧？

english: I would never desert my lord!
translation: 我永远不会背弃我主！

english: Well done unlocking those doors, adventurer. Did you have any problems?
translation: 干得好，冒险者，把那些门都打开了。遇到什么麻烦了吗？

english: I saw some really strange visions. Everything went grey...
translation: 我看到了一些非常奇怪的幻象。一切都变成了灰色……

english: Those are some of the traps to keep people away from this temple.
translation: 那些是阻止人们靠近这座庙宇的陷阱。

english: Thankfully, they didn't send you mad this time.
translation: 谢天谢地，这次它们没让你发疯。

english: That doesn't sound good.
translation: 听起来可不太好。

english: So, are we at the top of the temple now?
translation: 那么，我们现在到庙宇顶层了吗？

english: No, there is another floor above this. You have to go up a ladder in the room to the north.
translation: 不，这上面还有一层。你得从北边房间的梯子上去。

english: Hah, that's easy. Treasure, here I come!
translation: 哈，那简单。宝藏，我来啦！

english: There's a magic barrier in the way. And right now, it won't let anything through.
translation: 路上有一道魔法屏障。现在，它什么都不会放过去。

english: Is there any other way to get upstairs?
translation: 有没有别的办法上楼？

english: No, but I suspect the other rooms on this floor have magical properties. If you solve all the puzzles they present, then...
translation: 不，但我怀疑这一层的其他房间有魔法属性。如果你解决它们呈现的所有谜题，那么……

english: How will I know when I've solved them?
translation: 我怎么知道什么时候解开了？

english: Oh, it'll be quite obvious.
translation: 哦，到时候会非常明显的。

english: The globes on the pedestal here will also light when you've solved the room they correspond to.
translation: 当你解开了某个房间对应的谜题时，这个基座上的球体也会亮起来。

english: Have you come to torture me again?
translation: 你又是来折磨我的吗？

english: Oh, you may look human, but I know you're not. I've heard stories.
translation: 哦，你看起来像人类，但我知道你不是。我听过一些传闻。

english: How you Mahjarrat can take on any form, and use magic to inflict pain without any weapons.
translation: 你们玛哈加特能变成任何形态，还能不用武器就用魔法施加痛苦。

english: I, er... what?
translation: 我，呃……什么？

english: I have no idea what you're talking about, but I'm just as human as you are.
translation: 我完全不知道你在说什么，但我和你一样是人类。

english: You'll never get what you want from me. I'm a soldier of Avarrocka, and will stand strong!
translation: 你永远别想从我这里得到任何东西。我是阿瓦罗卡的士兵，会坚守到底！

english: Look, I'm not going to hurt you!
translation: 听着，我不会伤害你的！

english: Besides, I am already wounded, and have been so for many years, thanks to this spell you cast on me. And hungry. So very, very hungry.
translation: 而且，我已经受伤多年了，都是因为你对我施的这个咒语。还很饿。非常非常饿。

english: I've got some food you can have. It's quite tasty.
translation: 我有些食物可以给你。味道很不错。

english: Here, try this. It should fill you up.
translation: 来，尝尝这个。应该能让你填饱肚子。

english: Have some of this food. It's really good, I promise!
translation: 吃点这个吧。真的很好吃，我保证！

english: My daughter was learning to cook this when I left.
translation: 我离开的时候，我女儿正在学做这个。

english: I haven't remembered her in so long... thank you for reminding me of her.
translation: 我已经很久没想起她了……谢谢你让我记起她。

english: My son loved this dish. He would have eaten it every day if we had let him.
translation: 我儿子很喜欢这道菜。要是我们允许，他大概会天天吃。

english: I haven't remembered him in so long... thank you for reminding me of him.
translation: 我已经很久没想起他了……谢谢你让我记起他。

english: A cake? There's nothing to celebrate, is there?
translation: 蛋糕？没什么值得庆祝的吧？

english: So many years gone by. My children must have grown up and left home.
translation: 这么多年过去了。我的孩子们一定已经长大成人，离开家了。

english: I haven't remembered them in so long... thank you for reminding me of them.
translation: 我已经很久没想起他们了……谢谢你让我记起他们。

english: Did you just dig that up and throw it into an oven?
translation: 你该不会是刚把它挖出来就扔进烤箱了吧？

english: It doesn't look good at all.
translation: 看起来一点都不好吃。

english: I'd prefer it with some sort of topping...
translation: 我更喜欢加点什么浇头……

english: That doesn't look too bad at all.
translation: 那看起来还不错嘛。

english: It could almost be my wife's wonderful cooking.
translation: 这几乎就像我妻子美妙的烹饪。

english: What do you take me for? A rabbit?
translation: 你把我当什么了？兔子吗？

english: What's this? Did you just dig it out of the ground?
translation: 这是什么？你刚从地里挖出来的？

english: What do you think I am, a bear? It's not even seasoned!
translation: 你以为我是什么，熊吗？连调味都没有！

english: I'm a civilised man, not a barbarian gnawing on his kill!
translation: 我是个文明人，不是啃着猎物的野蛮人！

english: Oh, how pleasant. I'm surprised you remembered to cook it after you killed it!
translation: 哦，真不错。我还挺惊讶你杀了它之后还记得把它煮熟！

english: I'm hungry, but not so hungry that I'll eat your leftovers.
translation: 我是很饿，但还没饿到要吃你的剩菜。

english: That's revolting! Why would you give people food you've already eaten half of?
translation: 真恶心！你怎么能把吃了一半的食物给别人？

english: I'm not touching that!
translation: 我才不碰那个！

english: I might have enjoyed that food if you hadn't already eaten part of it.
translation: 如果你没先吃一部分的话，我可能还会喜欢这食物。

english: So, you're throwing scraps of food to me like I'm a dog, are you?
translation: 所以，你就像喂狗一样把食物残渣扔给我，是吗？

english: If only you could feel the bite of my sword!
translation: 真希望你能尝尝我剑的滋味！

english: Do you think I'm a gnome, or something? I'm not going to eat that!
translation: 你以为我是地精还是什么？我才不吃那个！

english: What are you trying to feed me? I don't want that!
translation: 你想喂我吃什么？我不要那个！

english: Are you just trying to feed me everything you have?
translation: 你该不会是想把你所有的东西都喂给我吧？

english: What do you take me for? A goat who'll eat whatever's in front of him?
translation: 你把我当什么了？什么都吃的山羊吗？

english: What are you trying to do, kill me?
translation: 你想干嘛，杀了我吗？

english: Oh, I get it, you're experimenting on me with different things to see what I'll eat.
translation: 哦，我明白了，你是在拿不同的东西在我身上做实验，看我会吃什么。

english: I'm not going to eat something your cat dragged in!
translation: 我才不吃你猫叼来的东西！

english: I'd rather have some good human home baking.
translation: 我宁愿吃点好的家常烘焙。

english: Some fresh home baking would be delicious.
translation: 来点新鲜的家常烘焙就太好了。

english: I'd like something that's had some care put into making it.
translation: 我想要点用心做出来的东西。

english: I'd like to have a hearty meal fresh from the oven.
translation: 我想吃一顿刚从烤箱里拿出来的丰盛大餐。

english: When we came to the temple, that fountain was frosted with ice.
translation: 我们刚到庙宇的时候，那个喷泉上结了一层冰。

english: Even chipping at it with swords or lighting fires under it didn't do anything.
translation: 即使用剑去凿，或者在下面生火，都毫无作用。

english: My guess is that some sort of magic is keeping it that way.
translation: 我猜是某种魔法让它保持那个状态。

english: Tell me about the room with the furnace.
translation: 跟我说说那个有熔炉的房间。

english: I tried to go in there, but the smoke was so thick I could barely see the furnace.
translation: 我试着进去过，但烟雾太浓了，我几乎看不见熔炉。

english: It may be that it's blocked, in which case you'll have to clear it out.
translation: 可能是堵住了，那样的话你得把它清理干净。

english: A good breeze should do the trick.
translation: 一阵好风应该就能解决问题。

english: Tell me about the dark room.
translation: 跟我说说那个黑暗的房间。

english: I never went in there myself, but I peered through the door.
translation: 我自己没进去过，但从门口往里看了看。

english: There seemed to be fires of some sort all around the room, but they were burning low.
translation: 房间里似乎到处都有某种火焰，但都烧得很低。

english: I'd imagine they've gone out by now.
translation: 我想现在它们应该已经熄灭了。

english: The treasure's up ahead, adventurer. Be careful of the traps.
translation: 宝藏就在前面，冒险者。小心陷阱。

english: What traps?
translation: 什么陷阱？

english: Oh, I don't know. Perhaps, say, huge skeletons that'll tear your arms and legs off?
translation: 哦，我不知道。也许，比如说，巨大的骷髅会把你的胳膊和腿撕下来？

english: Nothing, adventurer, nothing. You just trot along and get that treasure, now.
translation: 没什么，冒险者，没什么。你只管小跑过去，拿到宝藏吧。

english: Leave this temple at once, or I shall be forced to attack!
translation: 立刻离开这座神殿，否则我将被迫攻击！

english: I will defend this door until I am released from this prison of bone...
translation: 我会守护这扇门，直到我从这骨牢中解脱……

english: You shall not pass me, unless I crumble into dust!
translation: 你无法通过我，除非化为尘土！

english: These bones that trap me will block your path!
translation: 这些困住我的骨头会挡住你的路！

english: Now, flee before I attack you!
translation: 现在，在我攻击你之前快逃！

english: Thank you, kind [sir/lady]... now I am free from my imprisonment.
translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的[sir/lady]……现在我终于从囚禁中解脱了。

english: I no longer need these bones - take them, please, and bury what you can.
translation: 我不再需要这些骨头了——请拿着它们，把能埋的埋掉。

english: Don't interrupt me, human! I have to concentrate.
translation: 别打扰我，人类！我必须集中精神。

english: I'm keeping a weapon under control. If my attention wavers...
translation: 我正控制着一件武器。如果我的注意力稍有动摇……

english: ...then it tries to escape me. I must keep it safe for my lord Zamorak.
translation: ……它就会试图逃离我。我必须为主人萨莫拉克保护它。

english: Leave this place, before I am forced to attack!
translation: 离开这里，在我被迫攻击之前！

english: If you value your life, young [man/woman/one], then flee!
translation: 如果你珍惜生命，年轻的[man/woman/one]，那就快逃！

english: You should not be here! This is a dangerous place for beings such as you!
translation: 你不该在这里！这里对你这样的存在来说太危险了！

english: I am impressed, young [man/woman/one]. You seem to have more resilience than those I have fought off before.
translation: 我很佩服，年轻的[man/woman/one]。你似乎比我之前击退的那些人更有韧性。

english: Perhaps, then, you could help me with my predicament?
translation: 那么，也许你能帮帮我的困境？

english: I am trapped in this form against my will... it has been a long and painful struggle to even regain control over my own mind.
translation: 我被迫困在这副形态里……为了重新掌控自己的心智，我经历了漫长而痛苦的斗争。

english: Why did you attack me?
translation: 你为什么攻击我？

english: I didn't do anything to deserve it!
translation: 我没做任何该挨打的事！

english: As I said, I am trapped like this against my will.
translation: 正如我所说，我是被迫困在这里的。

english: I am forced to defend the one who enslaved me from any harm, even though it disgusts me to do so!
translation: 我被迫保护那个奴役我的人免受任何伤害，尽管这样做让我感到厌恶！

english: Who's trapped you in this form?
translation: 是谁把你困在这副形态里的？

english: SHE has. She was my rival before we came to this world, and supported that upstart Zamorak in his quest to be a god.
translation: 是她。在来到这个世界之前，她是我的对手，还支持那个暴发户萨莫拉克追求成为神。

english: It angers me to think at how she tricked me into slavery...
translation: 想到她是怎么骗我沦为奴隶的，我就愤怒……

english: Yes, I understand, but who is 'she'?
translation: 是的，我明白，但'她'是谁？

english: Her name is Enakhra, and she is the one who made this accursed temple and this boneguard that I am trapped in.
translation: 她叫伊纳克拉，就是她建造了这座该死的神殿，以及我身陷其中的这副骸骨守卫。

english: Now, since you show some interest in my situation, will you help me?
translation: 既然你对我的处境有些兴趣，你会帮我吗？

english: Of course, I'll help you out. But first of all, do you have any treasure?
translation: 当然，我会帮你。但首先，你有宝藏吗？

english: I, er, was just wondering...
translation: 我，呃，只是好奇……

english: Certainly, young [man/woman/one]. If you help me, I will give you a valuable amulet, and some of my knowledge.
translation: 当然可以，年轻的[man/woman/one]。如果你帮我，我会给你一条珍贵的护身符，以及我的一些知识。

english: That's good enough for me. What do I have to do?
translation: 对我来说足够了。我需要做什么？

english: Enakhra keeps me trapped in this form with magic.
translation: 伊纳克拉用魔法把我困在这副形态里。

english: Her hold over me grew weaker over the years, and I began to build a wall to keep her trapped in her own temple forever.
translation: 多年来她对我的控制逐渐减弱，我开始建造一堵墙，让她永远困在自己的神庙里。

english: Unfortunately, she has strengthened her spells lately, and I can no longer will myself to continue building.
translation: 不幸的是，她最近加强了自己的法术，我再也无法让自己继续建造了。

english: I want you to finish building this wall, that we might seal her in this temple forever, where she cannot taint the world with her creations again.
translation: 我希望你完成这堵墙的建造，这样我们就可以把她永远封在这座神殿里，让她无法再用她的造物污染这个世界。

english: About this wall...
translation: 关于这堵墙……

english: Where do I get the stone?
translation: 我到哪里去弄石头？
