english: There is a pile of rubble nearby, made of blocks that have fallen from the walls and the ceiling over time.
translation: 附近有一堆瓦砾堆，是由从墙壁和天花板上掉下来的石块堆积而成的。

english: I have been trapped here for several thousand years, after all...
translation: 毕竟，我被困在这里几千年了……

english: How do I build the wall?
translation: 我怎么建造这堵墙？

english: Since the blocks are heavy, you will need to be quite strong in order to lift them up to the wall.
translation: 因为石块很重，你需要相当强壮才能把它们举到墙上。

english: Once you have placed the stones up on the wall, you must trim them with a chisel so that they do not fall off when you place the next layer.
translation: 一旦你把石头放在墙上，你必须用凿子装饰它们，这样当你放置下一层时它们就不会掉下来。

english: How long will it take?
translation: 需要多长时间？

english: I was not far from finishing, I must say. It will most likely only take you three loads to finish building it.
translation: 我得说，我离完成已经不远了。很可能只需要你跑三趟就能完成建造。

english: Could you tell me more about Enakhra?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于伊纳克拉的事吗？

english: She is a coward, and a despicable traitor. She even supported Zamorak when he tried to become a god.
translation: 她是个懦夫，一个卑鄙的叛徒。她甚至在萨莫拉克试图成为神时支持他。

english: Of course, even though she built a temple for him, he didn't care, and she's been hiding here ever since.
translation: 当然，尽管她为他建了一座神殿，他并不在乎，从那以后她就一直躲在这里。

english: Could you tell me more about yourself?
translation: 你能多谈谈你自己吗？

english: I was once a proud mage, and now look at me. Trapped inside a bone skeleton and forced to defend my rival's temple.
translation: 我曾是个自豪的法师，现在看看我。被困在一个骨骷髅里，被迫保卫对手的神殿。

english: To think I believed her when she said she wanted to become allies and make amends for our rivalry!
translation: 想想我竟然相信了她说的想结盟并为我们的敌对关系补偿的话！

english: That two-faced, conniving, backstabbing wretch...
translation: 那个两面三刀、诡计多端、背后捅刀子的混蛋……

english: I suppose it is our nature, after all.
translation: 我想这毕竟是我们的本性。

english: Okay, I'll start building.
translation: 好吧，我开始建造。

english: Thank you. Once you are finished, the wall itself will shield me from most of her magic, and I will be free to move once more.
translation: 谢谢你。一旦你完成，墙本身就会让我免受她大部分魔法的伤害，我就能够再次自由行动了。

english: So, you're determined to meddle in other people's business?
translation: 所以，你决心要管别人的闲事？

english: That weapon has suddenly become a lot harder to control.
translation: 那件武器突然变得更难控制了。

english: And I know it's your doing. He's tried to get you to help, hasn't he?
translation: 而且我知道这是你的杰作。他试图让你帮忙，对吧？

english: If you're talking about Akthanakos, then yes!
translation: 如果你是在说阿克塔纳科斯，那没错！

english: Of course, I don't suppose he's told you who he's trying to support, has he?
translation: 当然，我想他没告诉你他想支持谁，对吧？

english: Er, no. But if you hate him so much, I suppose he doesn't support Zamorak...
translation: 呃，没有。但既然你这么恨他，我想他并不支持萨莫拉克……

english: How dare you throw around his name so casually?
translation: 你竟敢如此随意地提及他的名号？

english: No, Akthanakos never supported Zamorak. Not even after these thousands of years...
translation: 不，阿克塔纳科斯从未支持过萨莫拉克。即使过了这几千年也没有……

english: He has pledged his allegiance to someone much more foul.
translation: 他向一个更加邪恶的人宣誓效忠。

english: ...There are some names it is wiser not to mention, human.
translation: ……有些名字不提更明智，人类。

english: Such as the name of my lord Zamorak, that you seem so fond of throwing around.
translation: 比如我主萨莫拉克的名号，你似乎很喜欢随意提及。

english: But you said 'Zamorak' first!
translation: 但你先说了'萨莫拉克'！

english: Out of my sight, you unworthy scum, before I rend your flesh from your bones.
translation: 滚出我的视线，你这不值一提的渣滓，在我把你的肉从骨头上撕下来之前。

english: Never dishonour his name again.
translation: 永远不要再玷污他的名号。

english: Well, adventurer, do you have the treasure yet?
translation: 那么，冒险者，你拿到宝藏了吗？

english: There doesn't seem to be any treasure there.
translation: 那里似乎没有任何宝藏。

english: None at all?
translation: 一点也没有？

english: Hmm... the big skeleton promised to give me something if I helped him.
translation: 嗯……那个大骷髅答应如果我帮他，就给我点东西。

english: Ah ha! So, it's not attacking you? Well done, adventurer. Your second brain cell must be working overtime today.
translation: 啊哈！所以它没有攻击你？干得好，冒险者。你的第二大脑细胞今天一定在加班工作。

english: No! What have you done?
translation: 不！你做了什么？

english: The wall's finally built!
translation: 墙终于建好了！

english: Thank you. Thank you very much for all your help.
translation: 谢谢你。非常感谢你的所有帮助。

english: I can feel Enakhra's control over me fading. Finally, I can be free from this imprisonment...
translation: 我能感觉到伊纳克拉对我的控制在减弱。终于，我可以从这囚禁中解脱了……

english: After thousands of years... finally, I am no longer her slave.
translation: 几千年后……终于，我不再是她的奴隶了。

english: Honour demands that I reward you... and yet you have no room to carry my reward. Please, return when you can take it from me.
translation: 荣誉要求我奖励你……然而你没有空间携带我的奖励。请在你能够从我这里拿走它时再回来。

english: As thanks for your help, young [man/woman/one], please take this amulet of mine.
translation: 作为对你帮助的感谢，年轻的[man/woman/one]，请收下我的这条护身符。

english: Wow. Er, what does it do?
translation: 哇。呃，它有什么用？

english: It allows you to understand the speech of the Ugthanki, my patron animals, and other camels.
translation: 它让你能听懂乌格坦基骆驼，我的庇护动物，以及其他骆驼的语言。

english: It is also bound to the desert, and can thus transport you back to this temple if you wish.
translation: 它还和沙漠相连，因此如果你愿意，可以把你传送回这座神殿。

english: After so many years, why didn't you just give up?
translation: 过了这么多年，你为什么没有放弃？

english: Now my lord will punish you for destroying his weapon.
translation: 现在我的主人会因你毁掉他的武器而惩罚你。

english: Ha ha... in that case, I'm sure lord Zaros will be happy to intervene.
translation: 哈哈……那样的话，我相信萨罗斯大人会很乐意介入的。

english: I'll be waiting for you in the north, Akthanakos.
translation: 我会在北方等你，阿克塔纳科斯。

english: It'll be a pleasure to fight you once more...
translation: 再次与你战斗将是件乐事……

english: I want knowledge!
translation: 我想要知识！

english: I'm sure I've dropped hints the size of Varrock, but you might not have noticed. I'm a Zamorakian mage.
translation: 我肯定我丢下了维洛克城那么大的提示，但你可能没注意到。我是个萨莫拉克的法师。

english: You scatterbrained fool. You dropped it in here. Since you have no space to carry it, I can't give it back yet.
translation: 你这个没头脑的傻瓜。你把它掉在这里了。既然你没有空间携带它，我还不能还给你。

english: No, I don't have it on me at the moment. I must have stored it somewhere.
translation: 不，我现在没有带在身上。我一定把它存放在某个地方了。

english: Of course you did. I bet you spend your life collecting junk, storing it, then complaining you've run out of storage space. Fetch the amulet if you want my help.
translation: 你当然这么做了。我敢打赌你一辈子都在收集垃圾，存放起来，然后抱怨储物空间用完了。如果你想要我的帮助，就去把护身符拿来。

english: Greetings! Would you like to be my number one accomplice? I mean, assistant?
translation: 你好！想不想当我的头号同伙？我是说，助理？

english: How exactly do you plan to get to Taverley in that? How will it work?
translation: 你究竟打算怎么靠那个东西去塔韦利村？它要怎么运作？

english: Have you noticed how ashes float above fires for long periods of time?
translation: 你有没有注意到灰烬能在火焰上方飘浮很长时间？

english: What's your point?
translation: 你想说什么？

english: Don't you see? It's the hot air! It rises, taking the ashes with it.
translation: 你还不明白吗？是热空气！热空气上升，带着灰烬一起飞起来。

english: I had this epiphany while I was at the glass blower's house. If we pump hot air into an envelope it will rise because it is lighter than the cold air around it.
translation: 我在玻璃工匠家里时突然灵光一闪。如果我们把热空气泵入一个气囊里，它就会上升，因为它比周围的冷空气轻。

english: Come again?
translation: 你再说一遍？

english: We are going to sew a big sack and light a fire under it. Once the sack fills with hot air it will begin to rise, taking us along with it in the basket.
translation: 我们要缝一个大麻袋，然后在它下面生火。等麻袋里充满热空气，它就会开始上升，带着我们和篮子一起飞起来。

english: You seem pretty confident about this. Have you tested it?
translation: 你看起来很有把握。你测试过吗？

english: Well, no. You see, I don't have the materials here to make any test balloons.
translation: 呃，没有。你看，我这里没有材料来做测试气球。

english: That's where you come in!
translation: 所以就需要你出马了！

english: You are going to collect materials for two test runs of the balloon.
translation: 你要去收集材料，用来进行两次气球的测试。

english: You will need to get three sheets of papyrus, one ball of wool, one full sack of potatoes, and one unlit candle.
translation: 你需要弄到三张莎草纸、一个毛线球、一满麻袋土豆，以及一根未点燃的蜡烛。

english: What am I supposed to do with all of that junk?
translation: 我要拿那堆垃圾做什么？

english: When you have all of it, bring it to me and I'll explain what to do next. Any questions?
translation: 等你都收集齐了，就带过来给我，我会告诉你下一步怎么做。有什么问题吗？

english: Where do I get all this stuff?
translation: 这些东西我去哪里弄？

english: You're the adventurer, you should know! Think of logical places, like, churches; they have tons of candles.
translation: 你是冒险者，你应该知道才对！想想合乎逻辑的地方，比如教堂；那里有成堆的蜡烛。

english: Err, no. I can't see that kind of detail.
translation: 呃，不。我看不到那么细节的东西。

english: You don't? Oh...well...it's just, they rise, you know, from the fire...Maybe you should pay more attention to things!
translation: 你看不到？哦……好吧……只是，它们会上升，你知道的，从火焰里……也许你应该多注意观察事物！

english: Have you gotten the materials?
translation: 材料弄到了吗？

english: Good, you have everything! Now, I need you to create an origami balloon.
translation: 好，你都齐了！现在，我需要你做一个折纸气球。

english: How do you make the origami balloon?
translation: 折纸气球怎么做？

english: Once you have done that let me know and we will begin our experiment.
translation: 做好之后告诉我，我们就可以开始实验了。

english: What am I supposed to do with a note? I can't make a balloon from notes!
translation: 你给我一张笔记有什么用？我总不能拿笔记来做气球吧！

english: You don't seem to have any of the materials.
translation: 你好像什么材料都没有。

english: You need a ball of wool, three sheets of papyrus, an unlit candle, and a full sack of potatoes.
translation: 你需要一个毛线球、三张莎草纸、一根未点燃的蜡烛，以及一满麻袋土豆。

english: You need more papyrus.
translation: 你需要更多莎草纸。

english: You need a ball of wool.
translation: 你需要一个毛线球。

english: You need more papyrus and a ball of wool.
translation: 你需要更多莎草纸和一个毛线球。

english: You need an unlit candle.
translation: 你需要一根未点燃的蜡烛。

english: You need papyrus and an unlit candle.
translation: 你需要莎草纸和一根未点燃的蜡烛。

english: You need a full sack of potatoes.
translation: 你需要一满麻袋土豆。

english: You need more papyrus and a full sack of potatoes.
translation: 你需要更多莎草纸和一满麻袋土豆。

english: You need a ball of wool and an unlit candle.
translation: 你需要一个毛线球和一根未点燃的蜡烛。

english: You need a ball of wool and a full sack of potatoes.
translation: 你需要一个毛线球和一满麻袋土豆。

english: You need more papyrus, a full sack of potatoes, and an unlit candle.
translation: 你需要更多莎草纸、一满麻袋土豆，以及一根未点燃的蜡烛。

english: You need an unlit candle and a full sack of potatoes.
translation: 你需要一根未点燃的蜡烛和一满麻袋土豆。

english: You need a ball of wool, an unlit candle, and papyrus.
translation: 你需要一个毛线球、一根未点燃的蜡烛和莎草纸。

english: You need a ball of wool, papyrus, and a full sack of potatoes.
translation: 你需要一个毛线球、莎草纸，以及一满麻袋土豆。

english: You need a ball of wool, an unlit candle, and a full sack of potatoes.
translation: 你需要一个毛线球、一根未点燃的蜡烛，以及一满麻袋土豆。

english: Failure is not an option.
translation: 失败不是选项。

english: What do I need to get again?
translation: 我需要再弄些什么来着？

english: I just need a plain origami balloon. The dye could contaminate the experiment.
translation: 我只需要一个普通的折纸气球。染料可能会污染实验。

english: I finished the origami balloon!
translation: 我做好折纸气球了！

english: Wonderful! I'll take that, and we'll conduct our first experiment.
translation: 太棒了！把它给我，我们来开始第一次实验。

english: That was perfect. My hypothesis was right!
translation: 完美。我的假设是对的！

english: Did you not see the burning?
translation: 你没看到它在烧吗？

english: One more test. Then we shall proceed.
translation: 再做一次测试。然后我们再继续。

english: Burning? Fire? Hello?
translation: 烧着了？火？喂？

english: We shall meekly go! No...no...it needs to sound grander. We shall cautiously go...
translation: 我们要温顺地前进！不……不……这听起来不够宏大。我们要谨慎地前进……

english: We're doomed.
translation: 我们完蛋了。

english: Do you have the other two sheets of papyrus and a full sack of potatoes?
translation: 你还有另外两张莎草纸和一满麻袋土豆吗？

english: Commendable. If I may have those, I will construct this experiment.
translation: 值得称赞。如果你能把那些给我，我就来构建这个实验。

english: Destroy the floating thing!
translation: 摧毁那个漂浮的东西！

english: Well, that went down like a lead balloon.
translation: 嗯，这就像铅气球一样沉下去了。

english: You need a full sack of potatoes and more papyrus.
translation: 你需要一满麻袋土豆和更多莎草纸。

english: Oh, I've misplaced them.
translation: 哦，我放错地方了。

english: Those peasants...where did they come from?
translation: 那些乡巴佬……他们是从哪冒出来的？

english: Ahh, the flash mob phenomenon. Many have hypothesized that they are beings of great power sent to smite those who question the gods.
translation: 啊哈，快闪族现象。许多人推测他们是拥有强大力量的存在，被派来惩戒那些质疑神明的人。

english: And this isn't worrying because...?
translation: 而这并不令人担心，因为……？

english: Don't worry! I know exactly what I'm doing.
translation: 别担心！我很清楚自己在做什么。

english: Those experiments went extraordinarily well.
translation: 那些实验进行得异常顺利。

english: Was I the ONLY one who saw them burning? BURNING???
translation: 难道只有我一个人看到它们在烧吗？在烧啊！！！

english: Yes, very well indeed. Now we will start building the balloon that will carry us off the island.
translation: 是的，确实非常顺利。现在我们要开始建造能带我们离开这座岛的气球了。

english: This task will be much greater than the last two. I hope you are prepared for it.
translation: 这个任务会比前两个艰巨得多。我希望你已经准备好了。

english: This is madness.
translation: 这太疯狂了。

english: You need to get the following items:
translation: 你需要弄到以下物品：

english: Yellow dye Red dye Ten pieces of silk A clay bowl
translation: 黄色染料 红色染料 十块丝绸 一个粘土碗

english: and eight sandbags.
translation: 以及八个沙袋。

english: Sandbags can be made by getting empty sacks and filling them at the sand pit here on Entrana.
translation: 沙袋可以通过拿空麻袋，在恩特纳岛这里的沙坑装满沙子来制作。

english: However, there are other sand pits around the world that will work as well; there is one in Yanille, Rellekka, and Zanaris.
translation: 不过，世界上还有其他沙坑也能用；亚尼勒城、雷勒卡城和扎纳里斯城各有一个。

english: You can bring items back to me as you get them, while you are waiting for the tree to grow.
translation: 你可以在等树长大的时候，把收集到的物品陆续带回来给我。

english: What tree?
translation: 什么树？

english: I am going to give you a willow sapling and a basket of apples. You must plant the willow sapling at a tree patch.
translation: 我要给你一棵柳树树苗和一篮子苹果。你必须把柳树树苗种在树木种植地里。

english: If you give the basket of apples to the gardener near the patch, he will look after the tree for you while it grows.
translation: 如果你把一篮子苹果给种植地附近的园丁，他会在树生长期间为你照看它。

english: Don't lose the sapling! It took me a long time to save up enough for one. If you do, you'll have to pay me 30,000 coins for a new one.
translation: 别弄丢了树苗！我攒了很久才买得起一棵。如果你弄丢了，就得付我三万金币买一棵新的。

english: Once the tree is fully grown, cut twelve branches from it using secateurs. Bring the branches back here and use them on the metal frame on the platform to create the basket.
translation: 等树完全长大后，用修枝剪从树上剪下十二根枝条。把枝条带回这里，用在平台上的金属框架上，就能做成篮子。

english: Here you go. Now be very careful not to lose it!
translation: 给你。现在千万小心别弄丢了！

english: Looks like you don't have enough room in your inventory for the basket and the sapling. Come back when you do.
translation: 看来你的背包里没有足够的空间同时装下篮子和树苗。等有空间了再来吧。

english: Yes, I want to give you some items.
translation: 是的，我想给你一些物品。

english: Here's the dye.
translation: 这是染料。

english: Ah, wonderful, yellow dye. Thank you.
translation: 啊，太好了，黄色染料。谢谢你。

english: Red dye! Thank you.
translation: 红色染料！谢谢你。

english: That's the last of it!
translation: 这是最后一件了！

english: You just need to build the basket and I can finish the balloon! How are you getting on with the willow?
translation: 你只需要做好篮子，我就能完成气球了！你的柳木进展如何？

english: Use the willow sapling I gave you to grow a willow tree. Cut twelve branches from it using secateurs. Use the branches on the platform here.
translation: 用我给你的柳树树苗种一棵柳树。用修枝剪剪下十二根枝条。把枝条用在平台这里。

english: I still need red dye for the balloon.
translation: 我还需要红色染料来做气球。

english: I still need yellow dye for the balloon.
translation: 我还需要黄色染料来做气球。

english: You don't have any dye with you.
translation: 你身上没有染料。

english: I need red and yellow dye for the balloon.
translation: 我需要红色和黄色染料来做气球。

english: I need red dye for the balloon.
translation: 我需要红色染料来做气球。

english: I need yellow dye for the balloon.
translation: 我需要黄色染料来做气球。

english: Here are the sandbags.
translation: 这是沙袋。

english: Sandbags, thank you. This will allow us to change height.
translation: 沙袋，谢谢你。这能让我们改变高度。

english: You don't have enough sandbags. Please bring me eight.
translation: 你的沙袋不够。请给我带八个来。

english: However, there are other sand pits around the world that will work as well.
translation: 不过，世界上还有其他沙坑也能用。

english: Here's the silk.
translation: 这是丝绸。

english: What am I supposed to do with a note?? I can't make a balloon from notes!
translation: 你给我一张笔记有什么用？？我总不能拿笔记来做气球吧！

english: Silk for the balloon, thank you.
translation: 做气球的丝绸，谢谢你。

english: You don't have enough silk. Please bring me ten pieces.
translation: 你的丝绸不够。请给我带十块来。

english: Here's the bowl.
translation: 碗在这里。

english: You need to fire that bowl.
translation: 你需要烧制那个碗。

english: Ah the bowl. This will be used to hold the fuel while it heats the air in the balloon.
translation: 啊，碗。这个用来盛放燃料，加热气球里的空气。

english: I need a plain clay-fired bowl; they're quite easy to come by.
translation: 我需要一个普通的粘土烧制的碗；它们很容易弄到。

english: I'm having some trouble finding some of the items.
translation: 我在找一些物品时遇到了麻烦。

english: I was told a while ago that there was a witch who made dye in Draynor Village. Maybe you should start by looking there.
translation: 之前有人告诉我德雷诺村有个女巫会做染料。也许你应该先到那里看看。

english: Hmm, I believe silk is imported from the desert. Perhaps someone there can tell you where to find it.
translation: 嗯，我相信丝绸是从沙漠进口的。也许那里有人能告诉你在哪里找到它。

english: I think there is a spare one in the glass blower's house. I rent a room from him there, so I don't think he'll mind you taking it.
translation: 我想玻璃工匠家里有一个备用的。我在那里租了他一间房，所以他不会介意你拿走它的。

english: I have lost my willow sapling. Can I buy a replacement?
translation: 我的柳树树苗丢了。能买一棵替代的吗？

english: It will cost you 30,000 gold coins to replace it, do you want to pay that?
translation: 补买要花三万金币，你愿意付吗？

english: You already have one! Don't be greedy.
translation: 你已经有了！别贪心。

english: You already have one in your bank! Don't be greedy.
translation: 你银行里已经有一个了！别贪心。

english: You don't have enough money for it. You should have been more careful.
translation: 你的钱不够。你该更小心一点的。

english: Looks like you don't have enough room in your inventory. Come back when you do.
translation: 看来你的背包空间不够。有空间了再来吧。

english: Here you go. Now be very careful not to lose it again!
translation: 给你。这次千万小心别再弄丢了！

english: You need to use that on the balloon frame on the platform.
translation: 你得把它用在平台上的气球框架上。

english: Great! Let me just put it all together and we'll be ready for lift off! Speak to me again in a moment.
translation: 太好了！让我把它们组装起来，我们就能起飞了！过一会儿再跟我说话。

english: Well, let's get going!
translation: 好，我们出发吧！

english: Wait; tell me what we're doing.
translation: 等等，告诉我我们要做什么。

english: Theoretically, we are ready for the maiden voyage.
translation: 理论上，我们已经准备好首航了。

english: Theoretically?
translation: 理论上？

english: Well, of course. With you piloting I am sure we will survive.
translation: 当然。有你驾驶，我相信我们能活下来。

english: WHAT!? This is your balloon! Why aren't you going to pilot it? And what do you mean 'survive'? You never said anything about me flying this bird!
translation: 什么！？这是你的气球！你为什么不去驾驶它？你说'幸存'是什么意思？你从没说过要我飞这只鸟！

english: Don't be silly. I'm not going to pilot it. We will be safe in the basket, the only thing we will lose are the logs.
translation: 别傻了。我不开。我们在篮子里很安全，唯一会损失的就是那些原木。

english: You will pilot it, won't you?
translation: 你会开的，对吧？

english: Fine, I will. So how do I control the balloon?
translation: 好吧，我来开。那怎么操控气球？

english: Wonderful! Let me explain my hypothesis on how to control a balloon.
translation: 太棒了！让我解释一下我关于如何操控气球的假说。

english: Oh no, not another hypothesis!
translation: 哦不，又是什么假说！

english: The balloon needs ten normal logs for fuel. I believe the balloon will be controlled based on weight, so you must not have more than 40 kg with you.
translation: 气球需要十根普通原木作为燃料。我相信气球是通过重量控制的，所以你身上不能携带超过40公斤的物品。

english: Also, I seem to have lost my tinderbox...do you think you could bring one? We need it to light the fire.
translation: 还有，我好像把我的火绒盒弄丢了……你能带一个来吗？我们需要它来点火。

english: And here, I thought all the legwork was done. Fine, I'll bring a tinderbox.
translation: 我还以为所有跑腿活都干完了。好吧，我带一个火绒盒来。

english: Right! So, the balloon mechanics. Your prime direction will always be to land the balloon on the target at the end of our route.
translation: 好了！那么，气球的操作原理。你的首要目标始终是把气球降落在我们航线终点的目标上。

english: I've written to some friends in Taverley who have kindly painted one on the ground there.
translation: 我已经写信给塔韦利村的一些朋友，他们好心地在地面上画了一个。

english: We must avoid everything, because the balloon is very fragile. Even clouds will be dangerous! But if my calculations are correct, we will be able to squeeze through some surprising spaces, if you pilot it well.
translation: 我们必须避开一切，因为气球非常脆弱。就连云朵都很危险！但如果我的计算没错，只要你驾驶得好，我们就能穿过一些意想不到的狭窄空间。

english: Those sandbags you made earlier will give the balloon a big lift when dropped, whereas adding the logs will only make it rise a little bit. But don't use them up too quickly! We have no way of replenishing them.
translation: 你之前做的那些沙袋，扔下去时能给气球带来很大的升力，而添加原木只会让它稍微上升一点。但别太快用完它们！我们没法补充。

english: If you do run out of logs and sandbags you will not be able to go up any longer. Just make the best of it and hope we can make it to our destination without going upwards.
translation: 如果你真的用完了原木和沙袋，就无法再上升了。只能尽力而为，希望我们不用上升也能到达目的地。

english: I've added two ropes, the red one is an emergency rope, it will let the hot air out of the balloon and we will drop quickly. The other rope will only drop us a little.
translation: 我加了两根绳子，红色的是紧急绳子，它会放出气球里的热空气，让我们快速下降。另一根绳子只会让我们下降一点点。

english: If we get into tribb...beg your pardon, trouble, in all likelihood we will crash. But do not fear! We should be fine. Just make sure you come back to Entrana so we can try again.
translation: 如果我们遇到麻……请原谅，麻烦的话，很可能会坠毁。但别怕！我们应该没事的。只要记得回恩特纳岛来，我们就能再试一次。

english: If it all goes horribly wrong, you can always bail. If we're still over Entrana, we can land quickly and try again. However, once past the island, we will crash.
translation: 如果情况糟糕到极点，你随时可以弃船。如果我们还在恩特纳岛上空，可以快速降落再试一次。但一旦越过岛屿，我们就会坠毁。

english: Are you ready to go?
translation: 你准备好了吗？

english: You need to put your pet into your inventory before the flight.
translation: 飞行前你需要把你的宠物放进背包里。

english: You have too much weight in your bag. You may only bring 40kg of weight.
translation: 你背包里的重量太大了。你只能携带40公斤。

english: You need a tinderbox.
translation: 你需要一个火绒盒。

english: You don't have enough logs. You need ten normal logs.
translation: 你没有足够的原木。你需要十根普通原木。

english: No, I'm not ready.
translation: 不，我还没准备好。

english: Great Scott! Ocean! Ahhh!
translation: 老天爷！大海！啊啊啊！

english: Crashed, off course. Ocean! Oh dear... I feel very...
translation: 坠毁了，偏离航线。大海！哦天哪……我觉得很……

english: Contemplative? Concerned for your life? Desperate?
translation: 沉思？担心你的小命？绝望？

english: No...more along the lines of ill...You might want to swim away now. Use the plank...
translation: 不……更像是难受……你现在最好游走。用那块木板……

english: How are you going to get back? What about the balloon?
translation: 你怎么回去？气球怎么办？

english: I'm sure a fishing trawler will come by and give me a lift. Don't worry, I shall return.
translation: 我相信会有捕鱼拖网船经过载我一程。别担心，我会回来的。

english: Well, that didn't go as planned.
translation: 好吧，事情没有按计划进行。

english: So what now? How will we get the balloon back?
translation: 那现在怎么办？我们怎么把气球弄回来？

english: I'll have to get one of the monks to come pick it up. You head back on your own; just follow the path. I'll meet you back at Entrana.
translation: 我得找个修士来把它捡回去。你自己先回去，沿着路走。我在恩特纳岛等你。

english: The crash must have really sent us off course; I'm near Falador!
translation: 坠毁肯定让我们严重偏离航线；我在法拉多城附近！

english: We have travelled in a way that no man has travelled before! The next step will be to go where no men have gone before.
translation: 我们以前所未有的方式旅行了！下一步将是前往无人踏足之地。

english: [player name], it has been a privilege flying with you.
translation: [player name]，很荣幸与你同飞。

english: For all your hard work, I give you this jacket and cap for future ballooning adventures.
translation: 为了感谢你的辛勤工作，我送你这件夹克和这顶帽子，用于未来的气球探险。

english: You don't have enough space in your inventory. Speak to me again when you do.
translation: 你的背包空间不够。等有空间了再跟我说。

english: So what are you going to do now?
translation: 那你现在打算做什么？

english: I am considering starting a balloon enterprise. People all over Gielinor will be able to travel in a new, exciting way.
translation: 我在考虑创办一个气球企业。整个吉里诺的居民都能以一种新颖刺激的方式旅行。

english: As my first assistant, you will always be welcome to use a balloon. You'll have to bring your own fuel, though.
translation: 作为我的第一助理，你随时都可以使用气球。不过你得自带燃料。

english: I will base my operations in Entrana. If you'd like to travel to new places, come see me there.
translation: 我会把基地设在恩特纳岛。如果你想前往新地方，就来那里找我。

english: Have you found my sweetheart yet?
translation: 你找到我的心上人了吗？

english: I'm looking for a guy called Ernest.
translation: 我在找一个叫欧内斯特的人。

english: Ah Ernest, top notch bloke. He's helping me with my experiments.
translation: 啊，欧内斯特，一流的好家伙。他正在帮我做实验。

english: So you know where he is then?
translation: 那你知道他在哪里吗？

english: He's that chicken over there.
translation: 他就是那边那只鸡。

english: Ernest is a chicken...? Are you sure?
translation: 欧内斯特是一只鸡……？你确定？

english: Oh, he isn't normally a chicken, or at least he wasn't until he helped me test my pouletmorph machine.
translation: 哦，他通常不是鸡，或者说，在他帮我测试我的变鸡机器之前，他不是。

english: It was originally going to be called a transmutation machine. But after testing pouletmorph seems more appropriate.
translation: 它原本打算叫变形机器。但测试之后，叫变鸡机器似乎更合适。

english: I'm glad Veronica didn't actually get engaged to a chicken.
translation: 我很高兴维罗妮卡没有真的和一只鸡订婚。

english: Who's Veronica?
translation: 维罗妮卡是谁？

english: Ernest's fiancee. She probably doesn't want to marry a chicken.
translation: 欧内斯特的未婚妻。她大概不想嫁给一只鸡。

english: Ooh I dunno. She could have free eggs for breakfast.
translation: 哦，谁知道呢。她早餐可以免费吃鸡蛋。

english: I think you'd better change him back.
translation: 我觉得你最好把他变回来。

english: Umm... It's not so easy...
translation: 嗯……没那么容易……

english: My machine is broken, and the house gremlins have run off with some vital bits.
translation: 我的机器坏了，房子里的地精偷走了一些关键零件。

english: Well I can look for them.
translation: 我可以去找找看。

english: That would be a help. They'll be somewhere in the manor house or its grounds, the gremlins never get further than the entrance gate.
translation: 那会很有帮助。它们肯定在庄园宅邸或庭院里的某个地方，地精们从来不会跑出大门。

english: I'm missing the pressure gauge and a rubber tube. They've also taken my oil can, which I'm going to need to get this thing started again.
translation: 我缺了压力表和一根橡胶管。它们还拿走了我的油罐，我需要用油罐才能让这玩意儿重新启动。

english: Change him back this instant!
translation: 立刻把他变回来！

english: Yes, he's a chicken.
translation: 是的，他是一只鸡。

english: I know he's not exactly brave but I think you're being a bit harsh.
translation: 我知道他算不上勇敢，但我觉得你有点过分了。

english: No no, he's been turned into an actual chicken by a mad scientist.
translation: 不不，他是被一个疯狂科学家变成了一只真正的鸡。

english: Eeeeeek!
translation: 呀啊啊啊！

english: My poor darling, why must these things happen to us.
translation: 我可怜的亲爱的，为什么这些事总要发生在我们身上。

english: Well I'm doing my best to turn him back.
translation: 我正在尽力把他变回来。

english: Well be quick, I'm sure being a chicken can't be good for him.
translation: 那就快点，我敢肯定当一只鸡对他没好处。

english: Seeing as we were a little lost Ernest decided to go in and ask for direction.
translation: 因为我们有点迷路，欧内斯特决定进去问路。

english: I'm afraid you'll need to own a house to help me. Come back when you have one.
translation: 恐怕你需要拥有一栋房子才能帮我。等你有了再来吧。

english: Have you foudn my sweetheart yet?
translation: 你找到我的心上人了吗？

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of them yet!
translation: 恐怕我一样都还没找到！

english: I need a rubber tube, a pressure gauge and a can of oil. Then your friend can stop being a chicken.
translation: 我需要一根橡胶管、一个压力表和一罐油。这样你的朋友就不用再当鸡了。

english: There seems to be a pressure gauge in here...
translation: 这里面好像有一个压力表……

english: ... and a lot of piranhas! I can't get the gauge out.
translation: ……还有很多食人鱼！我拿不出压力表。

english: ... and a lot of dead fish.
translation: ……还有很多死鱼。

english: It's full of dead fish!
translation: 里面全是死鱼！

english: I don't think I want to use that water any more.
translation: 我觉得我不想再用那些水了。

english: I've only got the rubber tube so far.
translation: 我目前只找到了橡胶管。

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my pressure gauge and oil can too.
translation: 这是个好的开始，但我还需要我的压力表和油罐。

english: Ok, I'll go and look for them.
translation: 好的，我去找找它们。

english: I've only got the pressure gauge so far.
translation: 我目前只找到了压力表。

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my oil can and rubber tube too.
translation: 这是个好的开始，但我还需要我的油罐和橡胶管。

english: I've only got the oil can so far.
translation: 我目前只找到了油罐。

english: It's a good start, but I'll need my pressure gauge and rubber tube too.
translation: 这是个好的开始，但我还需要我的压力表和橡胶管。

english: I've got the rubber tube and the pressure gauge.
translation: 我找到了橡胶管和压力表。

english: That's good, but I still need my oil can.
translation: 很好，但我还需要我的油罐。

english: Ok, I'll go and look for it.
translation: 好的，我去找找它。

english: I've got the oil can and the rubber tube.
translation: 我找到了油罐和橡胶管。

english: That's good, but I still need my pressure gauge.
translation: 很好，但我还需要我的压力表。

english: I've got the oil can and the pressure gauge.
translation: 我找到了油罐和压力表。

english: That's good, but I still need my rubber tube.
translation: 很好，但我还需要我的橡胶管。

english: I have everything!
translation: 我全都找到了！

english: Let's get this fixed then.
translation: 那我们赶紧把它修好吧。

translation: [player name] 在你通过那里之前，我必须警告你，另一边有闪烁的灯光和频闪效果。如果你患有癫痫，绝对不能进入！你仍然想通过吗？

english: Portals, eh? That sounds like a top notch plan.
translation: 传送门，嗯？听起来是个绝妙的计划。
