english: [Thank you sir/Thank you m'lady/Thank you]. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: [Thank you sir/Thank you m'lady/Thank you]。当一只鸡真是烦死人了。我该怎么感谢你呢？

english: Well a cash reward is always nice...
translation: 现金奖励总是好的……

english: Of course, of course.
translation: 当然，当然。

english: Thank you sir. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: 谢谢你，先生。当一只鸡真是烦透了。我该如何报答你？

english: Thank you m'lady. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: 谢谢你，女士。当一只鸡真是烦透了。我该如何报答你？

english: A high price? That'll be nice for whoever can figure it out...
translation: 高价？那对能搞清楚的人来说倒是不错……

english: A high price? I guess I am somewhat of an expert on finding things for museums...
translation: 高价？我想我算得上是帮博物馆找东西的专家了……

english: Maybe I should talk to the curator to find out some more.
translation: 也许我该跟馆长谈谈，了解更多情况。

english: But this will have to be a job for another time.
translation: 但这得等下次再说了。

english: Could you tell me more about that empty display?
translation: 能跟我多说说那个空展示柜的事吗？

english: Oh yes, Xerna's Diadem... Quite a shame, isn't it? Do you know anything about it?
translation: 哦，是的，泽尔娜的头冠……真是可惜，对吧？你了解它吗？

english: I'm afraid not, but maybe I can help find it? I have managed to return stolen property to museums in the past.
translation: 恐怕不了解，但也许我能帮忙找到它？我以前成功帮博物馆找回过失窃物品。

english: That would certainly be most appreciated. The local guards said they'd investigate for us, but it's not proven to be a fast process so far.
translation: 那真是太感谢了。当地的守卫说会帮我们调查，但到目前为止，进展并不快。

english: I was starting to consider trying to find it myself, but I'm no detective. It doesn't seem to me like anything else is even out of place...
translation: 我甚至开始考虑自己去找，但我可不是侦探。在我看来，其他东西似乎都没放错地方……

english: Perhaps you'll have better luck though. Maybe you could have a look around for any sort of clues and see if you can find anything wrong.
translation: 不过也许你运气会好一些。你可以四处看看有没有什么线索，找找看有没有什么不对劲的地方。

english: I'll do that. Hopefully I can find something!
translation: 我会的。希望能找到点什么！

english: Nilsal to you, iknami. Welcome back to the Grand Museum. If you have any questions, I'm happy to help.
translation: 向你致敬，旅者。欢迎回到大博物馆。如果你有任何问题，我很乐意帮忙。

english: About that empty display...
translation: 关于那个空展示柜……

english: How are you getting on with your investigation?
translation: 你的调查进展如何？

english: Not so well. I've not made much progress yet.
translation: 不太顺利。我还没取得什么进展。

english: Well, you have our thanks for all your efforts in finding it. Thank you, iknami.
translation: 嗯，我们感谢你为寻找它付出的一切努力。谢谢你，旅者。

english: Apparently someone was acting a bit odd around here recently. They left and headed towards the quetzals.
translation: 显然最近有人在这里行为有点古怪。他们离开后朝着绿咬鹃的方向去了。

english: It sounds like you have a lead, iknami. You should follow it.
translation: 听起来你有线索了，旅者。你应该跟上去看看。

english: Well, it's looking like it could be quite the journey... I'll keep you updated!
translation: 嗯，看来这可能会是一段漫长的旅程……我会随时向你汇报的！

english: I just know I've almost got it! We'll have the diadem back in no time!
translation: 我就知道我快找到了！我们很快就能把头冠拿回来了！

english: I don't think I'm going to find much more just lying around... Maybe I should try asking if anyone nearby saw anything.
translation: 我觉得光是在这里转悠也找不到更多线索了……也许我该问问附近有没有人看到什么。

english: Nilsal! Can I help you?
translation: 向你致敬！需要帮忙吗？

english: I was wondering if you'd seen anything unusual around the museum lately?
translation: 我想问问你最近在博物馆附近有没有看到什么不寻常的事？

english: No, I don't think so...
translation: 没有，我想没有……

english: That's a shame. Well, thanks for your help.
translation: 那太可惜了。好吧，谢谢你的帮助。

english: What sort of unusual?
translation: 什么样的不寻常？

english: I'm looking into the missing diadem display.
translation: 我在调查那个丢失的头冠展示柜。

english: Oh... Sorry, but I don't think I can be much help.
translation: 哦……抱歉，但我想我帮不上什么忙。

english: Well, thanks anyway.
translation: 好吧，还是谢谢了。

english: Hi! Can I help you?
translation: 嗨！需要帮忙吗？

english: Now you mention it, I did see somebody skulking around here recently... I thought they looked a little shifty at the time!
translation: 你这么一说，我确实看到最近有人在这里鬼鬼祟祟的……我当时就觉得他们看起来有点可疑！

english: You did? Do you know where they went?
translation: 真的吗？你知道他们去哪了吗？

english: They left through the front door and turned right, towards the quetzal landing site.
translation: 他们从前门出去，然后右转，朝着绿咬鹃着陆点去了。

english: They left through the front door and turned right, towards where they have those big birds.
translation: 他们从前门离开，向右拐，朝着他们养那些大鸟的地方去了。

english: Ah that'll be the quetzals. Thanks!
translation: 啊，那应该是绿咬鹃。谢谢！

english: Quetzals? You learn something new every day!
translation: 绿咬鹃？真是活到老学到老！

english: Have you seen anybody suspicious around?
translation: 你在这附近看到什么可疑的人了吗？

english: What kind of suspicious?
translation: 什么样的可疑？

english: Maybe someone carrying something out of the museum, perhaps?
translation: 也许是有人从博物馆里搬了什么东西出来？

english: Well let's see... Come to think of it, there was this one person carrying some sort of case...
translation: 让我想想……说起来，确实有个人拿着一个箱子之类的东西……

english: He came along and asked if he could have a go with my bird.
translation: 他走过来，问能不能用一下我的鸟。

english: He asked if he could have a go with your bird?
translation: 他问能不能用一下你的鸟？

english: Yes, I thought it was quite strange. I told him no, and he made his way east, towards the Cothon.
translation: 是啊，我当时觉得挺奇怪的。我拒绝了他，然后他就往东边去了，朝着科松港的方向。

english: To the Cothon... Okay, I guess I'll go and see if I can find some more leads there. Thanks for the help!
translation: 去科松港了……好吧，我想我得去那里看看能不能找到更多线索。谢谢你的帮助！

english: Safe travels, iknami.
translation: 一路平安，旅者。

english: Just that man I already told you about. He headed east, towards the Cothon.
translation: 就是我告诉过你的那个男人。他往东边去了，朝着科松港。

english: Ah, yes. Thanks for the help!
translation: 啊，好的。谢谢帮忙！

english: Have you seen a man with a case?
translation: 你见过一个拿着箱子的男人吗？

english: Well, I'm looking for something and I think he might have it...
translation: 嗯，我在找一样东西，我想可能在他那里……

english: I don't think people would really like us talking all about their travels...
translation: 我觉得人们不会喜欢我们到处谈论他们的行程……

english: Although, we could use a hand... Think you could do us a small favour?
translation: 不过，我们倒是需要帮手……你能帮我们一个小忙吗？

english: Sure. What do you need?
translation: 当然。需要我做什么？

english: As long as it is just the one favour...
translation: 只要帮一个忙就行……

english: We've been meaning to get our old sails stitched up, but haven't had a chance to get away and have it done...
translation: 我们一直想把旧船帆缝补好，但一直没机会脱身去弄……

english: Hard to believe that Trader Stan had these clothes enchanted to re-stitch themselves so we can't ruin them, but the sails were too much to ask for! Some people's priorities, huh?
translation: 真不敢相信商人斯坦给这些衣服施了自动缝补的魔法，这样我们就不会弄坏它们了，但船帆却没法让他帮忙！有些人的优先事项，是吧？

english: I suppose I can help with that.
translation: 我想我可以帮忙。

english: Perfect! There's a crafting store just down the road. They should be able to fix them up.
translation: 太好了！沿着这条路走下去就有一家制作店。他们应该能修好。

english: Actually, I might need to make some space before I can take them.
translation: 实际上，我可能需要腾出点空间才能拿它们。

english: Then I don't know anything about a man with a case.
translation: 那我可不知道什么拿箱子的男人。

english: That depends. Are you ready to take us up on that favour?
translation: 那得看情况。你准备好帮我们那个忙了吗？

english: So, about that man with the case.
translation: 那么，关于那个拿箱子的男人。

english: Oh, yeah. You're meant to be getting our sails fixed up, right?
translation: 哦，对。你是要帮我们把船帆修好吧？

english: Where was it that I should get them fixed?
translation: 我该去哪里修它们来着？

english: That crafting store just down the road.
translation: 沿着这条路走下去的那家制作店。

english: I am, but I may have misplaced them...
translation: 我是要帮忙，但我可能把它们弄丢了……

english: You misplaced them right here. Here you go.
translation: 你就丢在这儿了。给你。

english: I am, but I think I might need to make some space before I can take them.
translation: 我是要帮忙，但我想我得先腾出点空间才能拿它们。

english: I am. Could I grab them now?
translation: 我是要帮忙。我现在能拿它们吗？

english: Alright, here you go.
translation: 好吧，给你。

english: I was hoping for some help.
translation: 我希望你能帮个忙。

english: What sort of help?
translation: 什么样的忙？

english: I've got these sails that need fixing up for the charter ship in the Cothon. The crew thought you could help.
translation: 我有些船帆需要修补，是给科松港的包船用的。船员们觉得你能帮忙。

english: Oh, in that case, I'll help you out, just so long as you can do me a small favour.
translation: 哦，这样的话，我会帮你，只要你也能帮我一个小忙。

english: All I ask is that you tell the charter crew that Artima says thanks for the latest shipment they brought in!
translation: 我只想让你告诉包船的船员们，阿蒂玛感谢他们最近运来的那批货！

english: Oh, what a relief! I will be sure to pass on the message when I get back there.
translation: 哦，真是松了一口气！我回去的时候一定会转达的。

english: Perfect. Now hand those sails over.
translation: 完美。现在把那些船帆给我吧。

english: Let's see... Thread that through there...
translation: 让我看看……把线从这里穿过去……

english: Grab some of that, then pull that through...
translation: 拿一点那个，然后从这里拉过去……

english: Tie off the end there and...
translation: 把末端在这里打个结，然后……

english: There we have it! They might not look the prettiest, but they'll be sturdy enough for the job at least.
translation: 搞定了！它们可能看起来不是最漂亮的，但至少足够结实，能胜任工作了。

english: Take care now iknami, and come by the shop whenever you need any crafting bits and bobs.
translation: 保重，旅者，以后需要什么制作材料就来店里看看。

english: Suit yourself, but those sails won't fix themselves you know.
translation: 随你便，但那些船帆可不会自己修好。

english: So about those sails...
translation: 那么，关于那些船帆……

english: Are you ready to do that small favour I mentioned?
translation: 你准备好帮我那个小忙了吗？

english: I already fixed them for you.
translation: 我已经帮你修好了。

english: You did, but then I lost them.
translation: 你是修好了，但我后来又弄丢了。

english: Well, I'd be able to fix more if you had more.
translation: 嗯，如果你还有的话，我倒是可以再修。

english: Luckily I do. Here you go.
translation: 幸好我还有。给你。

english: Here they are!
translation: 给你！

english: Oh, and Artima said thanks for the latest shipment.
translation: 哦，对了，阿蒂玛说谢谢你们最近运来的那批货。

english: That's great! Always nice to hear from a happy customer!
translation: 太好了！听到顾客满意总是很开心！

english: Anyway, the man with the case. Grey-haired fella, right? Yeah, he came by. Asked if he could have a go with our boat. Told him that's not really how this works.
translation: 总之，那个带箱子的男人。灰头发的家伙，对吧？是的，他来过。问能不能用我们的船。我告诉他这可不是这么回事。

english: And then what? Where did he go?
translation: 然后呢？他去哪了？

english: Well, we explained how it does work and he then asked us to take him to Port Sarim...
translation: 嗯，我们解释了正确的流程，然后他让我们带他去沙林港……

english: Port Sarim? I see... Thanks.
translation: 沙林港？我明白了……谢谢。

english: Oh, yeah. Grey-haired fella, right? Yeah, he came by. Asked if he could have a go with our boat. Told him that's now how this works.
translation: 哦，是的。灰头发的家伙，对吧？是的，他来过。问能不能用我们的船。我告诉他这可不是这么回事。

english: Have you seen a grey-haired man with a case?
translation: 你见过一个灰头发带箱子的男人吗？

english: Yeah, I know the one. Came all the way from Fortis, right?
translation: 对，我知道那个人。从福蒂斯一路过来的，对吧？

english: That's right! Do you know where he went?
translation: 没错！你知道他去哪了吗？

english: Wandered up north, I think. Said something about trying to get hold of some runes.
translation: 往北边去了，我想。说了句想搞点符文之类的话。

english: I see... Thanks for the help!
translation: 我明白了……谢谢你的帮助！

english: The one from Fortis? He wandered up north, I think. Said something about trying to get hold of some runes.
translation: 福蒂斯来的那个？他往北边去了，我想。还说了些要弄点符文之类的话。

english: Certainly sir, where would you like to go?
translation: 当然可以，先生，您想去哪里？

english: The charter ship that goes to that port is currently out of commission.
translation: 前往那个港口的包船目前无法使用。

english: We run ships from Port Phasmatys over to Port Tyras, stopping at Port Sarim, Catherby, Jaramja, the Shipyard and Port Khazard.
translation: 我们运营从法斯提斯港到提拉斯港的航线，中途停靠沙林港、凯瑟比镇、贾拉姆贾、造船厂和卡扎德港。

english: We certainly do! We have acces to items bought and sold from around the world.
translation: 当然可以！我们可以接触到从世界各地买卖来的物品。

english: I'm one of the Trader Stan's crew; we are all part of the largest fleet of trading and sailing vessels to ever sail the seven seas.
translation: 我是商人斯坦的船员之一；我们都是曾航行七海的贸易和航行船队中最大舰队的一员。

english: Oh, the one with the monocle? Yes, he did come in.
translation: 哦，戴单片眼镜的那个？对，他确实来过。

english: Let me guess, he asked if he could have a go with your runes?
translation: 让我猜猜，他是不是问能不能玩玩你的符文？

english: What? What does that even mean?
translation: 什么？这到底是什么意思？

english: No, he came in looking to buy some runes, but he didn't really know what he was looking for.
translation: 不，他是来买符文的，但他自己也不太清楚要找什么。

english: Where did he go?
translation: 他去哪儿了？

english: I don't know. He took a look at my stock, but didn't see what he wanted. He then left.
translation: 我不知道。他看了看我的货，没找到想要的，然后就走了。

english: Have you got any idea what runes he was looking for?
translation: 你知道他到底在找什么符文吗？

english: I did take some notes. It was driving me crazy trying to make sense of it!
translation: 我确实记了些笔记。想弄明白那些东西简直快把我逼疯了！

english: Could I take a look?
translation: 能让我看看吗？

english: Be my guest! Good luck making sense of them.
translation: 请便！祝你也能看懂它们。

english: Oh... I'd better free up some space first.
translation: 哦……我得先腾出点空间来。

english: About those notes...
translation: 关于那些笔记……

english: What about them?
translation: 笔记怎么了？

english: Do you have any idea what he was hoping to do with the runes?
translation: 你知道他想用那些符文做什么吗？

english: Not a clue. Maybe you can figure out what he was trying to cast.
translation: 完全不知道。也许你能搞清楚他想施什么法术。

english: Could I take another look at them?
translation: 我能再看一眼吗？

english: What could this mean?
translation: 这能是什么意思呢？

english: I'm looking for Xerna's Diadem.
translation: 我在找泽尔娜的头冠。

english: Xerna's Diadem? How did you-
translation: 泽尔娜的头冠？你怎么——

english: Er... How did you come to hear about that? It's not something you hear of much around these parts!
translation: 呃……你是怎么听说这个的？这在这附近可不常听到！

english: Well, it's missing from the Grand Museum in Fortis. I was hoping to try and find it...
translation: 嗯，它从福蒂斯的大博物馆失踪了。我想试着找到它……

english: What awful news! I'm not sure I can help you with that, though...
translation: 真是糟糕的消息！不过，我不确定我能帮上忙……

english: Okay, if you say so...
translation: 好吧，既然你这么说……

english: Yes, awful news! I do hope you manage to find it!
translation: 是啊，真是糟糕的消息！我真希望你能找到它！

english: Well what do we have here? I wonder what our local curator has to say about this...
translation: 看看我们这儿有什么？我很好奇我们当地的馆长对此会怎么说……

english: I found Xerna's Diadem...
translation: 我找到了泽尔娜的头冠……

english: So you found the diadem? That's... Er... That's wonderful news!
translation: 所以你找到头冠了？那……呃……那真是个好消息！

english: I'm sure that the Grand Museum will be thrilled to hear it.
translation: 我相信大博物馆听到这个消息会很高兴的。

english: Do you know where I found it?
translation: 你知道我在哪儿找到的吗？

english: I... No, why would I?
translation: 我……不，我怎么会知道？

english: Be honest with me, curator!
translation: 馆长，跟我说实话！

english: I don't know what you're talking about!
translation: 我不知道你在说什么！

english: You can't just steal artefacts and claim them as your own for the museum!
translation: 你不能就这么偷走文物，然后声称是博物馆的收藏！

english: Steal?! I would never! You need to get your facts straight!
translation: 偷？！我绝不会！你得搞清楚事实！

english: The other museums will never trust you again!
translation: 其他博物馆再也不会信任你了！

english: They'd understand my actions... I'm just trying to preserve history.
translation: 他们会理解我的行为...我只是想延续历史。

english: How would you feel if someone came in here and stole all your stuff?
translation: 如果有人闯进来偷走你所有的东西，你会怎么想？

english: Well, I'd feel terrible! Wait...
translation: 嗯，我会感觉很糟！等等……

english: You've ruined Varlamore's museum.
translation: 你毁了瓦拉莫尔的博物馆。

english: Well, as soon as they're ready to display it again, they can have it back!
translation: 好吧，等他们准备好重新展出的时候，就可以拿回去！

english: Just give it back already!
translation: 现在就还回去！

english: No! You have no idea what you're asking me!
translation: 不！你根本不知道你要求我做什么！

english: What if Varlamore finds out what you've done?
translation: 如果瓦拉莫尔发现你做了什么怎么办？

english: They will find out! As soon as you stop bothering me, I plan to tell them myself.
translation: 他们会发现的！只要你不再烦我，我打算亲自告诉他们。

english: How do you sleep at night?
translation: 你晚上怎么睡得着？

english: Much better knowing that this valuable artefact is safe and sound!
translation: 知道这件珍贵的文物安然无恙，我睡得可香了！

english: I thought archaeology was cool. I didn't realise it was just thieving!
translation: 我还以为考古学很酷呢。没想到这根本就是偷窃！

english: Archaeology is cool! This was just an exceptional circumstance...
translation: 考古学是很酷！这只是特殊情况……

english: You should be ashamed of yourself.
translation: 你应该为自己感到羞耻。

english: There's nothing for me to be ashamed of! I merely did the best I could in a tough situation.
translation: 我没什么好羞耻的！我只是在艰难的情况下尽了最大努力。

english: A real historian would never steal!
translation: 真正的历史学家绝不会偷窃！

english: Believe me, 'real' historians have done far worse.
translation: 相信我，'真正的'历史学家做过更糟的事。

english: If you're looking for stolen goods, I can get my hands on plenty.
translation: 如果你在找赃物，我能弄到很多。

english: What? Is this really how people see us?
translation: 什么？大家真是这么看我们的吗？

english: Do your colleagues know what you've done? What do they think?
translation: 你的同事们知道你做了什么吗？他们怎么想？

english: I... haven't had time to inform them yet. But I will! I just have to get my story straight...
translation: 我……还没来得及通知他们。但我会的！我只是得先把我的说辞理顺……

english: So can anyone just go around stealing and call it archaeology?
translation: 所以任何人都可以到处偷东西，然后称之为考古学？

english: No, but this really is archaeology! I promise!
translation: 不，但这真的是考古学！我保证！

english: You're supposed to protect history, not steal it!
translation: 你应该保护历史，而不是偷窃它！

english: Sometimes protecting history means taking... unconventional measures.
translation: 有时候保护历史需要采取……非常规手段。

english: Nobody wants to see stolen goods on display!
translation: 没人想看到赃物被展出！

english: That's why I put it in storage! No, wait, that's not what I meant!
translation: 所以我才把它收起来了！不，等等，我不是那个意思！

english: You should give Varlamore a chance before stealing their stuff.
translation: 在偷他们的东西之前，你应该给瓦拉莫尔一个机会。

english: Maybe, but I know what I saw, and I wasn't impressed!
translation: 也许吧，但我知道我看到了什么，而且我印象不怎么样！

english: Do you even have room to display this artefact?
translation: 你甚至还有地方展出这件文物吗？

english: No, but our duties go well beyond putting artefacts on display for adventurers to gawk at!
translation: 没有，但我们的职责远不止是把文物摆出来让冒险者们傻看！

english: Don't you have enough artefacts of your own?
translation: 你自己的文物还不够多吗？

english: If everyone cared only for their own town's history, we'd have a pretty boring world.
translation: 如果每个人都只关心自己城镇的历史，那这个世界就太无聊了。

english: Do you really think you did the right thing?
translation: 你真的认为你做对了吗？

english: I had no other choice. I couldn't just stand by!
translation: 我别无选择。我不能袖手旁观！

english: Did you know Varlamore sends thieves to the Colosseum?
translation: 你知道瓦拉莫尔会把盗贼送到竞技场吗？

english: But I'm no thief! Give me a chance to explain...
translation: 但我不是盗贼！给我个机会解释……

english: What if I came into your house and stole your stuff?
translation: 如果我闯进你家偷你的东西呢？

english: Then you'd be a thief! This is nothing like that!
translation: 那你就是盗贼！这跟那完全不一样！

english: You've committed a crime.
translation: 你犯了罪。

english: I have not! Just give me a chance to explain!
translation: 我没有！给我个机会解释！

english: How will Varlamorians learn their history now?
translation: 那瓦拉莫雷人以后怎么学习他们的历史？

english: Well, they can always come visit. Or perhaps we can arrange a loan?
translation: 嗯，他们可以随时来参观。或者我们可以安排借展？

english: Varlamore might never let you and your colleagues visit again!
translation: 瓦拉莫尔可能再也不会让你和你的同事参观了！

english: I've done Varlamore a great service! They just don't know it yet...
translation: 我为瓦拉莫尔立了大功！他们只是还不知道而已……

english: You should return all these artefacts. It's the only right thing to do.
translation: 你应该归还所有这些文物。这是唯一正确的事。

english: I'll return them as soon as I know they'll be safe. Until then, they'll stay right here!
translation: 等我确定它们安全了，我就会归还。在那之前，它们就待在这儿！

english: You're a disgrace to your entire profession!
translation: 你是整个行业的耻辱！

english: How dare you! I've never once failed to follow the proper procedures. Well, except this one time. But this is different!
translation: 你竟敢这么说！我从未不遵守正当程序。呃，除了这一次。但这次不一样！

english: Varlamore might close their lands again after this.
translation: 瓦拉莫尔可能会因此再次关闭他们的领地。

english: Better that than the loss of a priceless artefact! It's not my fault they didn't look after it.
translation: 那也比丢失一件无价之宝好！他们没照看好，又不是我的错。

english: How do you explain the other stolen artefacts you have in storage?
translation: 你怎么解释你仓库里其他被盗的文物？

english: I didn't steal them! The museum simply borrowed them for further study.
translation: 我没偷！博物馆只是借来进一步研究而已。

english: You could have damaged the artefact!
translation: 你可能会损坏文物！

english: Had I not done something, it could well have been damaged anyway!
translation: 如果我不做点什么，它本来也可能被损坏！

english: Why don't you just cooperate with Varlamore?
translation: 你为什么不跟瓦拉莫尔合作？

english: Believe me, I've been trying!
translation: 相信我，我一直都在尝试！

english: Why should you get to decide who gets to keep their artefacts?
translation: 凭什么由你来决定谁能保留他们的文物？

english: Because I'm the only one willing to protect them!
translation: 因为我是唯一愿意保护它们的人！

english: You're setting a terrible example.
translation: 你树立了一个坏榜样。

english: Oh dear... Children! Pay no attention to this loud, dramatic argument!
translation: 哦，天哪……孩子们！别在意这场吵闹的激烈争论！

english: Is everything here stolen from other museums?
translation: 这里所有的东西都是从其他博物馆偷来的吗？

english: Nothing here is stolen from other museums! Er... I mean, nothing is stolen at all!
translation: 这里没有任何东西是从其他博物馆偷来的！呃……我是说，根本没有任何东西是偷来的！

english: You can't justify theft by saying it's for preservation.
translation: 你不能用保护为偷窃辩解

english: Well that's the reality. Sometimes you have to make tough choices.
translation: 好吧，现实就是这样。有时候你得做出艰难的选择。

english: I'm sick of your excuses!
translation: 我听够了你的借口！

english: I'm sick of your shouting!
translation: 我听够了你的大喊大叫！

english: You're not above the law! You stole this stuff!
translation: 你不能凌驾于法律之上！你偷了这些东西！

english: It's more complicated than that!
translation: 事情没那么简单！

english: What makes you think you know better?
translation: 你凭什么觉得自己更懂？

english: The fact that I had to save this artefact at all says enough. It needs to be kept safe!
translation: 我不得不拯救这件文物的事实本身就说明了一切。它必须被安全保管！

english: What if it's cursed?! It could be dangerous!
translation: 万一它被诅咒了呢？！它可能有危险！

english: Are you quite serious? Just because an artefact is from another culture doesn't mean it's cursed. Adventurers these days...
translation: 你是认真的吗？就因为一件文物来自其他文化不代表它被诅咒了。现在的冒险者啊……

english: Stealing is stealing, no matter how you try to justify it.
translation: 偷窃就是偷窃，不管你怎样辩解。

english: Normally I'd agree, but this one situation is a little more nuanced than that...
translation: 通常我会同意，但这一情况比那要更复杂一些……

english: Is the artefact really safer here?
translation: 这文物在这里真的更安全吗？

english: Absolutely! We're the greatest, most well-equipped museum in the world!
translation: 当然！我们是世界上最伟大、设备最齐全的博物馆！

english: Look me in the eye and tell me you did the right thing.
translation: 看着我的眼睛告诉我你做了正确的事。

english: I... I did the right... Stop staring at me like that!
translation: 我……我做了正确……别那样盯着我看！

english: You're hoarding artefacts, but you should be sharing them!
translation: 你在囤积文物，但你本应分享它们！

english: We don't have enough room to show everything in our collections. If only we had the funding...
translation: 我们没有足够的空间展示所有藏品。要是我们有资金就好了……

english: You're a loose cannon.
translation: 你是个不按常理出牌的家伙。

english: A loose cannon? A wild card maybe. Or a lone ranger. But a loose cannon?! Surely not...
translation: 不按常理出牌？也许是张鬼牌，或者是独行侠。但不按常理出牌？！肯定不是……

english: Hand that artefact back this instant!
translation: 马上把那个文物交回来！

english: There's no need to take that tone with me!
translation: 没必要用那种语气跟我说话！

english: I guess you were just in it for the glory, were you?
translation: 我猜你只是为了荣耀，对吧？

english: That's not true! I mean, I am better than this. I mean... oh, I'm all mixed up.
translation: 不是这样！我的意思是，我不该这样。我的意思是……哦，我自己都糊涂了。

english: This is stealing! Thieving! Taking what's not yours!
translation: 这是偷窃！偷窃！拿走不属于你的东西！

english: Please stop telling everyone I'm a thief...
translation: 请不要再告诉所有人我是个盗贼了……

english: You've stolen from several other museums, too!
translation: 你还从其他几家博物馆偷过东西！

english: Not every museum has the resources to keep their artefacts safe. We're just taking care of them for now.
translation: 不是每家博物馆都有资源安全保管文物。我们只是暂时替他们照料。

english: This artefact doesn't belong to you! It belongs to Varlamore!
translation: 这件文物不属于你！它属于瓦拉莫尔！

english: I believe artefacts like this belong to all of us. That's why it's so important for me to preserve them.
translation: 我相信这样的文物属于我们所有人。这就是为什么保护它们对我来说如此重要。

english: Have you no respect for your colleagues in Varlamore?
translation: 你难道不尊重你在瓦拉莫尔的同行吗？

english: They had the choice to take better care with this artefact! That's not on me.
translation: 他们本可以选择更好地保管这件文物！这不是我的错。

english: Aren't you embarrassed to have stolen items in your collection?
translation: 你的收藏里有偷来的东西，你不觉得羞耻吗？

english: I'm not embarrassed! I just put it in storage for... for normal reasons!
translation: 我不觉得羞耻！我只是把它放在储藏室里，为了……为了正常的原因！

english: You're nothing but a common thief!
translation: 你不过是个普通的盗贼！

english: How dare you? I'm a well-renowned professional, not a thief!
translation: 你怎么敢？我是个赫赫有名的专业人士，不是盗贼！

english: Stealing is against the law!
translation: 偷窃是违法的！

english: Well, sometimes the law is wrong!
translation: 好吧，有时候法律是错的！

english: You ought to be ashamed.
translation: 你应该感到羞耻。

english: For what? I'm only doing my job!
translation: 为什么？我只是在做我的工作！

english: This could destroy your reputation! Everyone will think you're a thief!
translation: 这会毁了你的声誉！所有人都会以为你是盗贼！

english: Oh, nonsense! Any real historian would see I'm only trying to preserve vital historical knowledge.
translation: 哦，胡说！任何真正的历史学家都会明白我只是在努力保存重要的历史知识。

english: You've betrayed the trust of Varlamore.
translation: 你辜负了瓦拉莫尔的信任。

english: It's not my fault they couldn't look after their own history. Better that I took it than some thief!
translation: 他们不能好好保护自己的历史，这不是我的错。我拿走总比某个盗贼拿走好！

english: Are you even a real historian, or just a petty criminal?
translation: 你到底算是个真正的历史学家，还是个小偷小摸的罪犯？

english: Of course I'm a real historian! This just isn't my finest moment...
translation: 我当然是个真正的历史学家！只是这并非我最光彩的时刻……

english: You don't even have room to display it! It's just sitting in storage!
translation: 你甚至没有地方展示它！只是放在储藏室里！

english: Artefacts aren't just for gawking at! We keep things in storage so they can be studied and taken care of.
translation: 文物不只是为了供人观赏！我们把东西放在储藏室里是为了研究和照料。

english: You're not preserving anything. You're just a thief.
translation: 你什么都没有延续。你只是个盗贼。

english: Pish-posh! I haven't dedicated my life to this museum for you to slander my good name!
translation: 胡说八道！我毕生奉献给这座博物馆，可不是为了让你诽谤我的好名声！

english: Think of the Varlamorian children who won't get to see this artefact.
translation: 想想那些看不到这件文物的瓦拉莫孩子们。

english: Now that's not true! They can see it any time they visit Varrock, for free!
translation: 那可不对！他们任何时候来维洛克城都能免费看到它！

english: You can't just keep claiming these stolen goods as your own!
translation: 你不能一直声称这些赃物是自己的！

english: Oh, pish posh! I've had enough of this little shame game of yours! I've got better things to be doing with my time. Come back to me when you've got your facts straight!
translation: 哦，呸！我受够了你这套羞耻游戏！我有更重要的事要做。等你的事实搞清楚了再来找我！

english: I didn't steal anything! These are ethically acquired antiquities!
translation: 我没偷任何东西！这些都是通过正当途径获得的文物！

english: What do you mean? How did you come into possession of Xerna's Diadem? I've heard all about your travels back here with it.
translation: 你什么意思？你是怎么得到泽尔娜的头冠的？我听说了你带着它回来的全部经过。

english: Naturally, as soon as Varlamore opened, I was keen to visit their Grand Museum.
translation: 自然，瓦拉莫尔一开放，我就迫不及待去参观他们的宏伟博物馆。

english: There was a big event over at the Colosseum, so it was nice and quiet. Perfect for taking in everything the museum had to offer.
translation: 竞技场那边有个大型活动，所以博物馆里很安静。非常适合细细品味博物馆的一切。

english: All of a sudden, I heard a strange noise coming from behind me...
translation: 突然，我听到身后传来奇怪的声音……

english: It was a thief! He'd stolen Xerna's Diadem!
translation: 是个盗贼！他偷走了泽尔娜的头冠！

english: I had to act quick. I called upon my skills from my time in the Varrock Guard and I showed him what for!
translation: 我必须迅速行动。我用上了在维洛克城守卫时学到的技能，给了他一顿教训！

english: He went down easily, but I was left with a conundrum: What to do with the diadem.
translation: 他轻易就被制服了，但我却留下了一个难题：该怎么处理头冠。

english: This was a priceless artefact, and it was at risk! I knew it had to be protected, and there was nowhere better than in Varrock...
translation: 这是一件无价之宝，而且有风险！我知道必须保护它，而没有什么比维洛克城更合适的地方了……

english: Now I don't know what to do...
translation: 现在我不知道该怎么办了……

english: You can't just be taking these things as your own!
translation: 你不能就这样把这些东西据为己有！

english: I promise, I only wanted to keep it safe. I guess I panicked...
translation: 我保证，我只是想保证它的安全。我猜我当时慌了……

english: I'll do you a deal. If you arrange for the safe delivery of the diadem back to the Grand Museum, I'll let them know it's taken care of without mentioning your name.
translation: 我跟你做个交易。如果你安排好把头冠安全送回宏伟博物馆，我会告诉他们事情已经解决，而且不提你的名字。

english: Okay... I'll have it sent back at once.
translation: 好吧……我立刻派人送回去。

english: Thank you. I'll head over there and let them know.
translation: 谢谢。我去那边通知他们。

english: About Xerna's Diadem...
translation: 关于泽尔娜的头冠……

english: I'm just making arrangements to have it sent back to Fortis. It will be there very soon.
translation: 我正在安排把它送回福蒂斯。很快就会到那里。

english: Well, it turned out to be quite the saga, but I found it! Xerna's Diadem is on its way back here, as we speak.
translation: 好吧，这还真是一段传奇，但我找到了！泽尔娜的头冠正在运回这里的路上，就在我们说话的时候。

english: It is? That's great news! Where did you find it?
translation: 是吗？太好了！你在哪里找到的？

english: It was a little far away... But we'll save that story for another day.
translation: 有点远……不过这个故事改天再说吧。

english: Well, what matters is that you found it. Now, I guess you'll be expecting that reward the display mentioned?
translation: 好吧，重要的是你找到了它。现在，我想你等着那个展示提到的奖励吧？

english: Oh yes, I better make some space for it.
translation: 哦对，我得给它腾点地方。

english: Well, what matters is that you found it. Now, I guess you'll be expecting that reward the display mentioned? Here you go.
translation: 好吧，重要的是你找到了它。现在，我想你等着那个展示提到的奖励吧？给你。

english: Hello, [player name], you look familiar. Didn't I catch you going through my pockets not that long ago?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你看起来很眼熟。不久前是不是被我抓到你翻我口袋？

english: Me? No, I'm afraid you must have me confused with somebody else!
translation: 我？不，恐怕你认错人了吧！

english: I could have sworn ...
translation: 我本来还蛮肯定……

english: Oh well, never mind. I have bigger problems to worry about right now.
translation: 哎呀，算了。我现在有更大的麻烦要操心。

english: I can't chat now, I have too many things to worry about.
translation: 我现在没空聊天，烦心的事太多了。

english: I certainly could do with some help.
translation: 我当然希望有人能帮上忙。

english: So tell me about your problems.
translation: 那跟我说说你的问题吧。

english: It all seemed to start about a month ago. I grow roses, you know?
translation: 大概一个月前开始的。我种玫瑰，你知道吧？

english: Um, you seem to be getting side-tracked already.
translation: 呃，你好像已经跑题了。

english: What? Oh sorry.
translation: 什么？噢，抱歉。

english: As I was saying about a month ago I noticed that the yield on my prize rose bushes had dropped slightly. I immediately suspected Crown Gall, a disease that can be fatal to a Mister Lincoln.
translation: 我刚才说到，大约一个月前，我发现我那几株珍贵的玫瑰丛产量略有下降。我立刻怀疑是冠瘿病，这病对林肯先生来说可是致命的。

english: You're not making much sense. Who's Mister Lincoln?
translation: 你这话讲得不清不楚的。林肯先生是谁？

english: Sorry, Mister Lincoln's are the variety of roses that I specialise in. None of the plants showed any other symptoms of disease though. Then I noticed a reduced yield occurring in most of my other crops too.
translation: 抱歉，林肯先生是我专门培育的玫瑰品种。不过那些植株都没有表现出其他病害症状。接着我又发现其他大部分作物的产量也下降了。

english: I spoke to other gardeners that I know, and they had all noticed similar problems.
translation: 我跟我认识的几个园丁都聊过，他们也注意到了类似的问题。

english: Vegetable patches are growing fewer vegetables, bushes are producing fewer berries and everything that is planted seems to be more prone to disease!
translation: 蔬菜田越长越少，灌木丛结的果子也越来越少，种下去的东西好像都更容易得病了！

english: If you were more interested in turning your hand to farming, you would have noticed it too.
translation: 如果你对农业更上心一点，你也会注意到这一点。

english: You've done some farming, haven't you noticed a decrease in the amount of produce you are getting lately?
translation: 你做过一些农业，难道没有注意到最近你获得的农产品数量减少了吗？

english: So what do you want me to do?
translation: 那你想让我做什么？

english: I'd like you to find out what is causing this terrible problem and to try and rectify whatever the problem is.
translation: 我希望你能找出造成这个可怕问题的原因，并尽力解决它。

english: Do you have any ideas where I should start?
translation: 你知道我应该从哪里开始吗？

english: If I were you I would start by speaking to some of the other gardeners.
translation: 如果我是你，我会先跟其他几个园丁谈谈。

english: This doesn't sound like something I can help with. Good luck.
translation: 这听起来不是我帮得上忙的事。祝你好运。

english: I'm not sure I can, but I guess I have to try.
translation: 我不确定自己行不行，但我想我得试试看。

english: What is the banner for?
translation: 这面旗帜是干什么用的？

english: That banner is the emblem of the Group of Advanced Gardeners. We're a loosely affiliated group of gardeners that are united in our concern for declining vegetable production.
translation: 那面旗帜是“高级园丁集团”的徽记。我们是一个松散的园丁组织，因为担心蔬菜产量下降而团结在一起。

english: Err, of course you are.
translation: 呃，你们当然是咯。

english: Say, you're a brave adventurer, would you be interested in trying to get to the root of our woes? There would be a cash reward if you could help us.
translation: 喂，你是个勇敢的冒险者，有兴趣探究一下我们烦恼的根源吗？如果你能帮上忙，会有金钱奖励的。

english: Of course I'll help.
translation: 我当然乐意帮忙。

english: I'm so glad to hear that.
translation: 听到你这么说，我很高兴。

english: You don't look it.
translation: 你看起来可不像。

english: Sorry, what was that?
translation: 抱歉，你说什么？

english: Oh, nothing. Don't worry about it.
translation: 噢，没什么。别在意。

english: Sorry, I have better things to do.
translation: 抱歉，我有更要紧的事要做。

english: Oh. Oh dear. Oh well, if there's nothing I can do to make you change your mind...
translation: 噢。哦，天哪。好吧，要是没法让你改变主意……

english: No, nothing. My mind is made up.
translation: 不，没办法。我已经决定了。

english: Well come back and chat to me if you change it.
translation: 那等你改变主意了，再来找我聊聊吧。

english: Have you spoken to any other members of the Gardening Group yet?
translation: 你跟园艺集团的其他成员谈过了吗？

english: No, I haven't had a chance yet.
translation: 还没，我还没找到机会。

english: Well please hurry, otherwise I won't be able to make enough produce to feed my 13 children soon.
translation: 请快点吧，不然我很快就连给十三个孩子糊口的收成都拿不出来了。

english: I've spoken to one of your members and they reckon that it's the lack of rain that we've had recently.
translation: 我跟你的一个成员谈过，他觉得是最近雨水太少。

english: I'm afraid that can't be the problem. It never rains on the farming patches. That's why we have to water the crops.
translation: 恐怕不是这个问题。农业用地上从不下雨，所以我们才要给作物浇水。

english: Oh, yeah. I hadn't thought of that.
translation: 哦，对哦。我倒没想到这点。

english: Go chat to some other group members. Maybe somebody has a different idea.
translation: 去跟其他集团成员聊聊吧。也许谁会有不同的想法。

english: Insects! You need to get rid of the insects! They're eating the crops.
translation: 昆虫！你得除掉那些昆虫！它们在啃食庄稼。

english: Good idea, but I spray my crops with insecticide every week. No, that's not the problem.
translation: 好主意，但我每周都会给庄稼喷洒杀虫剂。不，那不是问题所在。

english: But...but...they're not my friends! I've never even spoken to most of them!
translation: 可是……可是……他们不是我朋友！我跟他们大部分人连话都没说过！

english: No, I mean yes. There is a heroes guild, but ...!
translation: 不，我是说没错。是有个英雄公会，可是……！

english: Oh, I give up!
translation: 唉，我放弃了！

english: One of your members is implying that the gardeners' problems are all caused by adventurers using the plots. I would like to point out that these plots are communal property and that we have as much right as anyone to
translation: 你的一个成员暗示园丁们的问题都是冒险者使用田地造成的。我要指出的是，这些田地是公共财产，我们和其他人一样有权在这里种植物！

english: grow plants here!
translation: 种植物在这里！

english: All right! All right! You're absolutely right! I never said there was a problem with anybody using my plots. Besides, we get part of our income from watching crops for adventurers. I'm afraid that our problem is
translation: 好啦好啦！你说得完全对！我从没说过有人用我的田有问题。再说，我们的一部分收入也来自帮冒险者看管作物。恐怕我们的问题是完全不同的。

english: something totally different.
translation: 完全不同的。

english: Well obviously it's the seasons. They all seem to be out-of-wack these days. Summer comes earlier and earlier each year, but then it simply rushes by!
translation: 显然是季节的问题嘛。这些日子季节全乱套了。夏天一年比一年来得早，然后又匆匆而过！

english: I don't suppose you have any ideas about what could cause the seasons to be mixed up?
translation: 我想你大概不知道是什么导致季节混乱的吧？

english: Apparently, the seasons are all mixed up. Late summers and early winters. I don't know what I can do to solve that problem, though.
translation: 很明显，季节全乱套了。夏天晚来，冬天早到。不过我也不知道该怎么解决这个问题。

english: Yes, I've noticed that the seasons seem to be slightly confused, but that hasn't been a big enough change to affect the crops so badly. I'm afraid you should try a different branch of investigation to get to the root
translation: 没错，我也注意到季节确实有点混乱，但这个变化还不至于严重到影响收成。恐怕你得换个调查方向，才能找到我们问题的根源。

english: of our problems.
translation: 我们问题的根源。

english: Ha ha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！

english: What are you laughing at? These are serious problems!
translation: 你在笑什么？这是很严重的问题！

english: You're absolutely right. Don't worry, I'll find out what the problem is.
translation: 你说得对。别担心，我会找出问题所在的。

english: Why not? They all seem to be a bunch of loonies anyway.
translation: 为什么不去？反正他们看起来都是一群怪人。

english: I've been told that it's the lack of rain, plagues of insects and recently I was told that the entire order of seasons is confused!
translation: 有人跟我说是缺雨、昆虫泛滥，最近还有人告诉我整个季节顺序都乱了！

english: But they're all different, how could they all be correct?
translation: 可是这些都不一样啊，怎么可能全对呢？

english: Oh no! Not another crack-pot theory!
translation: 哦不！别再提另一个疯狂的理论了！

english: Right, well thanks for your input. I'll think over what you said.
translation: 好吧，谢谢你的意见。我会考虑你说的话。

english: I am, but this isn't a good time to talk about that.
translation: 是的，但现在不是谈这个的好时机。

english: Hello again, [player name]. How are you getting on with solving the Gardening Group's problems?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。解决园艺集团问题的进展如何？

english: To be honest I'm worried about the sort of person you let join your organisation.
translation: 说实话，我有点担心你允许什么样的人加入你的组织。

english: I've heard theories ranging from climate change to fairies from your members.
translation: 我从你的成员那里听说了从气候变化到仙子的各种理论。

english: Hmm, that's an interesting idea. Now that I think about it that does make some sense. Yes, maybe you should talk to a fairy about it.
translation: 嗯，这个想法倒是挺有意思。现在想想，确实有点道理。对，也许你应该找个仙子谈谈这事。

english: O-kay! You're the boss, any idea which flower I should look under to find a fairy?
translation: 好吧！你是老大，知不知道我该翻哪朵花才能找到仙子？

english: No, sorry, but I did hear that there were some adventurers with a similar problem in the swamps near Lumbridge. Just don't mention my name if you talk to them, they're trying to keep it a secret, but everybody actually knows what they're up to.
translation: 不知道，抱歉，不过我听说仑桥镇附近的沼泽里有些冒险者也遇到了类似问题。如果你去找他们，别提我的名字，他们想保密，但其实大家都知道他们在干什么。

english: Yes, I've spoken to them before.
translation: 是的，我之前跟他们谈过。

english: Who are you? Where's the Fairy Queen? What's going on here? Where's the Fairy Queen's throne gone?
translation: 你是谁？仙子女王在哪里？这里发生了什么事？仙子女王的王座去哪儿了？

english: Ciao esploratore! So many questions. Whicha one would you hava me answer first?
translation: Ciao esploratore!（你好，探险家！）这么多问题。你想让我先回答哪一个？

english: Me?! I am-a da Fairy Godfather.
translation: 我？！我是仙子教父。

english: I see-a by your face dat you have-a not-a heard of-a me. Irrispettoso, eet iz of no eemportance. You weesh-a to know sometheeng else or no?
translation: 我看你那张脸就知道你没听说过我。无礼，但这不重要。你还想知道别的事情吗？

english: Ah, eet iz a trageec-a tale. Da Queen Bee she iz-a, how-you-say, seek?
translation: 啊，这是个悲剧故事。女王蜂她，怎么说呢，病了？

english: You mean sick. What happened?
translation: 你是说生病了。发生了什么？

english: Ah, a tragedy to be-a struck-a down so young.
translation: 啊，一个悲剧，这么年轻就倒下了。

english: How-a much do ya know about-a da fairy folk, my beeg friend?
translation: 你对仙子一族了解多少，我的大朋友？

english: Not actually a whole deal, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕其实不太了解。

english: Well, let-a me enlighten yous. Zanaris iz-a a nexus of-a da worlds. Da Queen Bee, she iz-a da guardian of-a all da folk dat live-a in Zanaris.
translation: 好吧，让我来给你指点一下。扎纳里斯城是一个连接各个世界的枢纽。女王蜂她是所有居住在扎纳里斯城的子民的守护者。

english: So when-a thees Tanglefoot arrives, da Queen Bee she-a goes to da Cosmic Temple area to kill-a eet, but someting goes-a wrong. Da Queen Bee, she gets-a hurt and is-a now inna da magic sleep.
translation: 所以当那个缠足怪来了的时候，女王蜂她就去了宇宙神殿区域想杀死它，但出了点问题。女王蜂她受了伤，现在陷入了魔法沉睡。

english: Thanks, I'll go see her then. Goodbye.
translation: 谢谢，那我之后去找她。再见。

english: Ciao. Oh, and [player name]...
translation: Ciao（再见）。对了，[player name]……

english: A word-a of advice. You be-a careful not to cause da trouble for da folk while you are Zanaris. Ciao.
translation: 给你句忠告。在扎纳里斯城的时候，小心别给这里的居民惹麻烦。Ciao（再见）。

english: Hmm, an eenteresting question, my friend. I am-a trying to run-a da fairy kingdom, and youz iz-a being da irritating adventurer.
translation: 嗯，问得有意思，我的朋友。我在努力管理仙子王国，而你在这里当一个烦人的冒险者。

english: That's not what I mean!
translation: 我不是那个意思！

english: No, but-a dat iz da question I answered. Now iz-a dere anything else?
translation: 不，但那就是我回答的问题。现在还有别的事吗？

english: Where's the Fairy Queen's throne gone?
translation: 仙子女王的王座去哪儿了？

english: An eenteresting place to start... I am-a here, ze Queen Bee iz not. So my chair - eet iz-a here, her throne - eet iz- a not. Eez there anytheeng else? I ama a bizy fairy.
translation: 一个有趣的起点……我在这里，蜂后不在。所以我的椅子在这里，她的宝座不在这里。还有别的吗？我是个忙碌的仙子。

english: Eef there iz anytheeng I can-a help you weeth whilst you are-a veesiting Zanaris, plsi, do not-a trouble to bother me.
translation: 如果你在扎纳里斯城期间有什么我能帮忙的，请别麻烦来找我了。

english: Da Boss is a busy fairy! He don' have time to talk to yous humans. Vamoose!
translation: 老大是个忙仙子！他没时间跟你们人类说话。快走！

english: Sorry, I'm very busy and can't chat. If you want to know something go and talk to the Godfather.
translation: 抱歉，我很忙，没空聊天。想知道什么就去找教父谈。

english: I did, he said I should come and talk to you!
translation: 我去过了，他说我应该来找你谈！

english: Sorry, I didn't realise.
translation: 抱歉，我没意识到。

english: Actually it's more a case of what I can help you with? I told the Fairy Godfather that I would help you find a cure for the Queen.
translation: 其实更准确地说，是我能帮你什么？我跟仙子教父说了，我会帮你们找到治愈女王的方法。

english: Oh, thank you! I really need help, I have no idea what ails the Queen. You must be a mighty healer!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！我真的需要帮助，我完全不知道女王得了什么病。你一定是个了不起的治疗师！

english: Err...no, not me.
translation: 呃……不，不是我。

english: A great druid then?
translation: 那么，是一位伟大的德鲁伊？

english: Umm...'fraid not.
translation: 嗯……恐怕不是。

english: A shaman?
translation: 一位萨满？

english: A surgeon?
translation: 一位外科医生？

english: A doctor, medic, nurse?
translation: 医生、医师、护士？

english: No, no and no.
translation: 不，不，都不是。

english: So what are you then?
translation: 那你到底是什么？

english: I'm a mighty adventurer!
translation: 我是一名强大的冒险者！

english: A what?!
translation: 一个什么？！

english: A mighty adventurer!
translation: 一名强大的冒险者！

english: Yes, I heard. It's just not what I was expecting to hear.
translation: 是的，我听到了。只是这和我预想的不太一样。

english: But hang on, you might be just the sort of person I need to help me!
translation: 不过等等，你也许正是我需要帮忙的那种人！

english: How is that then?
translation: 怎么说？

english: I'm sure the Godfather told you that the Queen is in an enchanted sleep?
translation: 我相信仙子教父告诉过你，女王陷入了魔法沉睡？

english: Well sort of, I couldn't really understand everything he was talking about.
translation: 算是吧，我不太能完全理解他说的每件事。

english: Shhh, somebody might hear. Look you're a visitor, so I'll tell you this much; it doesn't pay to talk about the Godfather behind his back.
translation: 嘘，可能会有人听到。听着，你是访客，所以我只告诉你这么多：在背后议论仙子教父可没好下场。

english: But back to the problem at hand - the Fairy Queen. She was brought here after her battle with the Tanglefoot in a terrible state, extremely weak and barely able to fly!
translation: 但回到眼前的问题——仙子女王。她在与缠足怪战斗后被带到这里，状态极差，极度虚弱，几乎无法飞行！

english: When the Queen got back here, she was clearly weakening fast. It appears as if the magic force that is her life essence is slowly unravelling.
translation: 女王回到这里后，明显在迅速衰弱。看起来，作为她生命精华的魔法力量正在慢慢瓦解。

english: Now, what I need you to do is find a mage by the name of Zandar Horfyre. He has spent many years studying magical illness. Take the list to him and ask him if he knows what ails the Queen, please.
translation: 现在，我需要你去找一位名叫赞达尔.霍菲尔的法师。他花了多年时间研究魔法疾病。把这份清单带给他，问他是否知道女王得了什么病，拜托了。

english: That doesn't sound too difficult, where will I find him.
translation: 听起来不太难，我在哪里能找到他？

english: I believe he now resides in the Dark Wizard's tower near Falador, and [player name], please hurry. I fear the Queen doesn't have much time left!
translation: 我相信他现在住在法拉多城附近的黑暗巫师塔里，还有[player name]，请快点。我担心女王的时间不多了！

english: You're back soon! Did you find out what ails the Fairy Queen?
translation: 你这么快就回来了！你查出仙子女王得了什么病吗？

english: No, I'm afraid I've lost the list of symptoms you gave me.
translation: 没有，恐怕我把你给我的症状清单弄丢了。

english: Well not to worry, I have a copy of it here.
translation: 别担心，我这里还有一份副本。

english: Hello, I need your help.
translation: 你好，我需要你的帮助。

english: And why should I help you, fool? You attack my brethren and I, and then you demand my help! I think not!
translation: 我为什么要帮你，蠢货？你攻击我和我的同胞，然后还要求我帮忙！想都别想！

english: But Fairy Nuff said you would help me!
translation: 但仙子纳夫说你会帮我的！

english: Fairy Nuff sent you!
translation: 是仙子纳夫派你来的！

english: The Fairy Queen is extremely ill. She was in a battle with a Tanglefoot and her injuries have resulted in her being in a coma.
translation: 仙子女王病得很重。她和一只缠足怪战斗后受了伤，导致她陷入了昏迷。

english: This is grave news indeed!
translation: 这真是严重的消息！

english: You think the Tanglefoot is responsible? I don't see how that could be. A Tanglefoot will normally kill its victim outright...unless...hmmmm...I wonder...
translation: 你觉得是缠足怪干的？我不明白怎么会这样。缠足怪通常会直接杀死受害者……除非……嗯……我想知道……

english: Fairy Nuff gave me a list of her symptoms. Here, have a look at it.
translation: 仙子纳夫给了我一份她的症状清单。给你，看看吧。

english: Hmm...yes...slow discorporation of ethreal body, eh? Hmm...I think I know what the problem might be.
translation: 嗯……是的……灵体缓慢消散，嗯？嗯……我想我知道问题可能是什么了。

english: You do? That's great! What is it?
translation: 你知道？太好了！是什么？

english: From what I know about fairies, their basic lifeforce is pure magic. Much as we humans would refer to our souls as our life essence, so too does a fairy have a life essence of pure magic.
translation: 根据我对仙子的了解，她们的基本生命力就是纯粹的魔法。就像我们人类把灵魂视为生命精华一样，仙子也拥有纯粹魔法的生命精华。

english: You could actually refer to fairies as magic embodied and not be wrong.
translation: 你甚至可以说仙子就是魔法的化身，这也没错。

english: Yes, but about the Fairy Queen?
translation: 是的，但关于仙子女王呢？

english: Patience, I'm getting to that. It appears the Fairy Queen has lost a large part, indeed the majority, of her life essence. Either it was drained from her by the Tanglefoot or she did it voluntarily.
translation: 耐心点，我正要说。看来仙子女王失去了很大一部分，实际上是大部分的生命精华。要么是被缠足怪吸走了，要么是她自愿这么做的。

english: Although why she would do that is beyond me.
translation: 虽然她为什么要这么做，我就想不通了。

english: So I guess I need to go and kill this Tanglefoot and get back her magic essence if I am to help her?
translation: 那么我想我需要去杀了那只缠足怪，拿回她的魔法精华，才能帮助她？

english: Yes, but if I were you I would seek out a necromancer by the name of MalignusMortifer. I believe that he once fought a Tanglefoot, many years ago.
translation: 是的，但如果我是你，我会去找一位名叫马利格努斯.莫蒂菲尔的死灵法师。我相信他多年前曾与一只缠足怪战斗过。

english: You should probably ask him for advice on how to combat it.
translation: 你或许应该向他请教如何对抗它。

english: MalignusMortifer. Any idea where I can find him?
translation: 马利格努斯.莫蒂菲尔。你知道我在哪里能找到他吗？

english: He's rumoured to have been seen near Port Sarim with his followers recently. Rumour has it that he's working on a spell that has something to do with fungus!
translation: 有传言说他最近和追随者出现在沙林港附近。据说他正在研究一个与蘑菇有关的法术！

english: Ok, thanks very much.
translation: 好的，非常感谢。

english: Don't mention it, and give my regards to Nuff, when you see her next.
translation: 别客气，下次见到纳夫时，代我向她问好。

english: Fairy Nuff gave me a list of her symptoms, but I don't have it with me.
translation: 仙子纳夫给了我一份她的症状清单，但我没带在身上。

english: Well, I can't diagnose the problem without knowing the symptoms. You'd better go and find that list, or get Fairy Nuff to give you another one.
translation: 好吧，不知道症状我可没法诊断问题。你最好去找那份清单，或者让仙子纳夫再给你一份。

english: Yes, but if I were you I would seek out a necromancer by the name of Malignus Mortifer. I believe that he once fought a Tanglefoot, many years ago.
translation: 是的，但如果我是你，我会去找一个名叫马利格努斯.莫蒂菲尔的死灵法师。我相信他多年前曾与一只缠足怪战斗过。

english: Hmm...yes...slow discorporation of ethereal body, eh? Hmm...I think I know what the problem might be.
translation: 嗯...是的...灵体的缓慢消散，嗯？嗯...我想我知道问题可能出在哪里了。

english: How is she? I owe her a great deal, she saved me from a mortal injury I sustained when I was investigating the nature of Otherworldly beings. So, how can I help?
translation: 她怎么样了？我欠她很多，她救了我一命，当时我正在调查异界生物的本质时受了致命伤。那么，我能帮上什么忙？

english: You think the Tanglefoot is responsible? I don't see how that could be. A Tanglefoot will normally kill its victim outright...unless...hmmm...I wonder...
translation: 你觉得是缠足怪干的？我不明白怎么会这样。缠足怪通常会直接杀死受害者...除非...嗯...我在想...

english: I don't suppose you could give me more details about the Fairy Queen's condition, could you?
translation: 你能不能告诉我更多关于仙子女王状况的细节？

english: My name is Zandar Horfyre, and you [player name] are trespassing in my tower, not to mention attacking my students! I thank you to leave immediately!
translation: 我叫赞达尔.霍菲尔，而你，[player name]，正在擅闯我的塔，更别提还攻击我的学生！我请你立刻离开！

english: I need help with fighting a Tanglefoot. Can you help me?
translation: 我需要帮助来对抗一只缠足怪。你能帮我吗？

english: Almost certainly, I am a great practitioner of the magic arts, after all.
translation: 几乎可以肯定，毕竟我可是魔法艺术的大师。

english: Great, thanks. I was told by Zandar Horfyre that you fought one once.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。赞达尔.霍菲尔告诉我你曾经和一只缠足怪战斗过。

english: That is true and an epic battle it was too.
translation: 没错，那也是一场史诗般的战斗。

english: That's great! I presume you won as you are here to tell me about it, could you tell me how to defeat one, please?
translation: 太好了！我猜你赢了，因为你在这里告诉我这件事，能请你告诉我如何击败一只吗？

english: Of course I won! As I've already stated I am a master of the magic arts.
translation: 我当然赢了！正如我已经说过的，我是魔法艺术的大师。

english: Why do you want to know how to kill a Tanglefoot?
translation: 你为什么想知道如何杀死一只缠足怪？

english: There is a Tanglefoot in the lost city of Zanaris and I have been asked to kill it.
translation: 在失落之城扎纳里斯城有一只缠足怪，我被要求去杀死它。

english: I see. Well I could tell you how to defeat your Tanglefoot, however I would need you to perform a little undertaking for me first.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，我可以告诉你如何击败你的缠足怪，但我需要你先为我做一件小事。

english: What exactly did you have in mind?
translation: 你具体想让我做什么？

english: To the north-east of here is a haunted manor. Bring me a skull from a grave you find there and you shall have your answer.
translation: 从这里往东北方向有一座闹鬼的庄园。从那里的一座坟墓里给我带一个头骨来，你就会得到你的答案。

english: Actually I have it right here.
translation: 其实我正好有一个。

english: Excellent, hand it over then.
translation: 太好了，那就交出来吧。

english: Right then, to business. A Tanglefoot can not be harmed by might nor magic. The only weapon that can damage them are a pair of enchanted secateurs!
translation: 好了，说正事。缠足怪无法被武力或魔法伤害。唯一能伤害它们的武器是一把附魔的修枝剪！

english: Where can I get a pair of these enchanted secateurs?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到这样一把附魔的修枝剪？

english: You will have to make them... listen carefully and I'll tell you how.
translation: 你必须自己制作……仔细听，我来告诉你方法。

english: Obviously you will need a pair of secateurs, you will also need to gather [item 1], [item 2] and [item 3].
translation: 显然你需要一把修枝剪，你还需要收集[item 1]、[item 2]和[item 3]。

english: Take them to the Nature Spirit and ask him to perform the ceremony of Phasma Phasmatis Natura.
translation: 把它们带给自然之灵，请他进行“幻影自然之形”仪式。

english: Phasma Phasmatis Natura. Got it! Is that all?
translation: 幻影自然之形。记住了！就这些吗？

english: Yes, that's all. You'll be able to use those secateurs to kill the monster.
translation: 是的，就这些。你就能用那把修枝剪杀死那只怪物了。

english: Great, thanks very much.
translation: 太好了，非常感谢。

english: I'll go and get it then.
translation: 那我现在就去拿。

english: Fine, I'll see you soon.
translation: 好的，我们很快再见。

english: I was asking you about fighting a Tanglefoot...
translation: 我刚才在问你关于对抗缠足怪的事……

english: So, have you brought me the skull?
translation: 那么，你给我带来头骨了吗？

english: Well come and talk to me once you have it.
translation: 等你拿到头骨再来找我谈吧。

english: I have already told you all I know about fighting a Tanglefoot. What more would you have of me?
translation: 我已经告诉了你所有我知道的关于对抗缠足怪的事。你还想从我这里知道什么？

english: Could you tell me how to kill a Tanglefoot again, please?
translation: 你能再告诉我一次如何杀死一只缠足怪吗？

english: I guess so. Forgot to take notes did you? Well, listen carefully this time. You will need to enchant a pair of secateurs. Only these can harm a Tanglefoot.
translation: 我想可以。忘记做笔记了是吧？好吧，这次仔细听。你需要附魔一把修枝剪。只有这个能伤害缠足怪。

english: What did I need to take to the Nature Spirit again?
translation: 我需要带什么给自然之灵来着？

english: You will need a pair of secateurs. You will also need to gather [item 1], [item 2] and [item 3].
translation: 你需要一把修枝剪。你还需要收集[item 1]、[item 2]和[item 3]。

english: Welcome back, my friend. I sensed that you require my help and so I have once more returned.
translation: 欢迎回来，我的朋友。我感觉到你需要我的帮助，所以我再次回来了。

english: Thank you! I need your help in enchanting a pair of secateurs.
translation: 谢谢你！我需要你帮我附魔一把修枝剪。

english: Secateurs? That's a strange thing to enchant. Would you care to inform me why you need them?
translation: 修枝剪？附魔这个可真奇怪。你愿意告诉我为什么需要它们吗？

english: Sure. A Tanglefoot has invaded the fairy kingdom of Zanaris and the only way I can fight it is with a pair of enchanted secateurs, apparently.
translation: 当然。一只缠足怪入侵了仙子的王国扎纳里斯城，显然我唯一能对抗它的方法就是使用一把附魔的修枝剪。

english: Ah, a Tanglefoot! Your information is correct, secateurs that have been blessed by a Nature Spirit are the only weapons that can harm such a terrible creature.
translation: 啊，缠足怪！你的信息没错，被自然之灵祝福过的修枝剪是唯一能伤害这种可怕生物的武器。

english: I shall be glad to help you. Do you have all of the required items for the ceremony?
translation: 我很乐意帮助你。你带齐了仪式所需的所有物品吗？

english: Yes, I have everything right here.
translation: 是的，我全都带齐了。

english: Then let us begin...
translation: 那么让我们开始吧……

english: It is done!
translation: 完成了！

english: Farewell, [player name] and good luck with your coming battle.
translation: 再会了，[player name]，祝你在即将到来的战斗中好运。

english: No, I still need to collect some things.
translation: 不，我还需要收集一些东西。

english: Alright, my friend. Return to me when you have all that is required. I shall be waiting.
translation: 好的，我的朋友。当你集齐所有需要的东西时再回来找我。我会等着。

english: Hello, [player name]. Why have you returned so soon after your last visit?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你上次来过后怎么这么快又回来了？

english: I'm glad you're here. I'm afraid I've lost the secateurs you enchanted for me.
translation: 很高兴你在这里。恐怕我把你附魔的修枝剪弄丢了。

english: That's alright; if you bring me the components for the spell, I'll enchant another pair for you. Would you happen to have all of the required items for the ceremony with you now?
translation: 没关系；如果你把法术的材料带来，我会再为你附魔一把。你现在碰巧带齐了仪式所需的所有物品吗？

english: I did it! I've got the Fairy Queens'enchanted secateurs!
translation: 我做到了！我拿到了仙子女王的附魔修枝剪！

english: That's fantastic! You'd better take them to the Fairy Godfather though; he'd be cross if he knew you brought them to me first. But, come back to me once the queen has had a chance to recover. I'm sure she'll want to thank you personally.
translation: 太棒了！不过你最好把它们交给仙子教父；如果他发现你先拿给我，他会生气的。但是，等女王有机会康复后，再回来找我。我相信她会想亲自感谢你。

english: Ciao [player name]. I am-a glad to see-a yous back! I was-a worried that the Tanglefoot would-a kill-a you too.
translation: 再见，[player name]。很高兴看到你回来！我还在担心那只缠足怪也会杀了你呢。

english: You needn't have worried I managed to kill it!
translation: 你不用担心，我成功杀了它！

english: Ben fatto, my friend! Da folk-a dey owe yous a great-a deal! So did-a youss getta back da Queen Bee's magic power?
translation: 干得好，我的朋友！大家可欠你一个大人情！那么，你拿回女王蜂的魔法力量了吗？

english: I retrieved this pair of Enchanted secateurs, I think they must contain the Queen's missing magic.
translation: 我拿回了这把附魔修枝剪，我想它们一定包含了女王丢失的魔法。

english: Grazie infinite! I will give-a dem to da healing fairy. Da Queen Bee, she will-a soon be strong again!
translation: 非常感谢！我会把它们交给治愈仙子。蜜蜂女王很快就会恢复强壮！

english: I've solved your problems! I've returned the Fairy Queen's magical essence!
translation: 我已经解决了你的问题！我找回了仙子女王的魔法精华！

english: The Fairy Queen was in an enchanted deep sleep, because the Tanglefoot had taken the secateurs that contained her magic. I fought and killed the Tanglefoot and have given the Godfather the Fairy Queen's secateurs. She'll
translation: 仙子女王陷入了魔法沉睡，因为缠足怪偷走了蕴含她魔力的修枝剪。我击败了缠足怪，把女王的修枝剪交给了仙子教父。她

english: wake up now and everything will get back to normal.
translation: 很快就会苏醒，一切都会恢复正常。

english: I'm glad to hear it, but if you don't mind I'll go and plant some seeds now and wait until they grow before I give you the reward that I promised.
translation: 听到这个消息我很高兴，但如果你不介意的话，我现在要去种些种子，等它们长出来，我再给你承诺的奖励。

english: I guess it does sound rather far-fetched. Ok, I'll come back and see you after your crops have had a chance to grow.
translation: 听起来确实有点离谱。好吧，等你的庄稼有机会长成之后，我再来见你。

english: Great! I'll see you soon then.
translation: 太好了！那我过会儿见。

english: So, have your vegetables grown yet?
translation: 那么，你的蔬菜长出来了吗？

english: Stop being so impatient, [player name]. They'll grow in their own good time - come back later.
translation: 别这么着急，[player name]。它们会长好的，只是时候未到——过会儿再来吧。

english: Hello Martin, you must be the slowest gardener in the world! I don't suppose those crops have grown yet?
translation: 你好，马丁，你一定是世界上最慢的园丁！那些庄稼应该还没长出来吧？

english: Well, you've got a nerve showing up around here again!
translation: 哼，你竟敢又出现在这里！

english: What? What are you talking about?
translation: 什么？你在说什么？

english: You told me that you'd solved the problems of the Gardening Group's members, well I've planted loads of seeds since then and there's no doubt that even more plants are dying!
translation: 你告诉我你已经解决了园艺小组成员的问题，可我从那以后种了一大堆种子，毫无疑问，更多的植物正在枯死！

english: But I gave the Fairy Queen's secateurs back to the Godfather, things should be growing again.
translation: 但我已经把仙子女王的修枝剪还给了教父，一切应该重新开始生长才对。

english: Yah, sure, whatever. You know, I didn't believe you when you told me that story about 'the fairies' in the first place. You'd just better solve this problem, when people get hungry, they get angry and you're the
translation: 哼，当然，随你怎么说。你知道吗，我一开始就不信你那个关于‘仙子’的故事。你最好解决这个问题，因为人们饿肚子就会生气，而你正是那个

english: person who said that everything would be all right, so you're the person who they'll get angry with!
translation: 说一切都会没事的人，所以他们只会冲你发火！

english: I suppose I'd better go and see what the problem is then.
translation: 看来我最好去瞧瞧问题出在哪里。

english: I've done enough for you, sort it out yourself!
translation: 我已经为你做得够多了，你自己搞定吧！

english: Hello again, [player name]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast, the food reserves are starting to fail. People will start to realise that there is an imminent food crisis soon!
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。我们的庄稼还在减产。请快想办法，食物储备已经开始告急。很快人们就会意识到粮食危机迫在眉睫！

english: Don't worry, I'm working on it.
translation: 别担心，我正在处理。

english: Please hurry. Things are getting dire!
translation: 请快点。情况越来越糟了！

english: No, sorry, but I did hear that there were some adventurers with a similar problem in the swamps near Lumbridge. Just don't mention my name if you talk to them, they're trying to keep it a secret, but everybody
translation: 不，抱歉，不过我听说仑桥镇附近的沼泽里也有一些冒险者遇到了类似的问题。如果你去找他们，别提我的名字，他们想保密，但每个人

english: actually knows what they're up to.
translation: 其实都知道他们在干什么。

english: I know I am. Depressing isn't it?
translation: 我知道我很弱。很沮丧，不是吗？

english: Yes, I've noticed that the seasons seem to be slightly confused, but that hasn't been a big enough change to affect the crops so badly. I'm afraid you should try a different branch of investigation to get to the root of
translation: 是的，我注意到季节似乎有些混乱，但变化还不至于严重影响庄稼。恐怕你得换条调查路线才能找到根

english: our problems.
translation: 根源。

english: That's not very observant of you.
translation: 你观察力不够啊。

english: All right! All right! You're absolutely right! I never said there was a problem with anybody using my plots. Besides we get part of our income from watching crops for adventurers. I'm afraid that our problem is
translation: 行行行！你说得完全对！我从没说过别人用我的地有啥问题。而且我们的一部分收入就来自帮冒险者照看庄稼。恐怕我们的问题是

english: Hello again, [player name]. Our crops are still failing. Please do something fast or we will all go out of business.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。我们的庄稼还在减产。请快点想办法，否则我们都得关门大吉了。

english: I'm afraid that can't be the problem. It never rains on the farming patches, that's why we have to water the crops.
translation: 恐怕不可能是这个问题。农业地块从来不下雨，所以我们才需要给庄稼浇水。

english: Godfather! Where is the Fairy Queen?
translation: 教父！仙子女王在哪？

english: Whata are you-a talking about?
translation: 你在说什么啊？

english: I've just been to Fairy Nuff's cave and when I got there I found it ransacked! Everything has been broken and the Fairy Queen and Fairy Nuff are missing!
translation: 我刚去过仙子纳夫的洞穴，到那里发现被洗劫一空！所有东西都被破坏了，仙子女王和仙子纳夫都不见了！

english: Essere nel panico! You-a say datta Queen Bee, she izza meesing? Theez izza terreeble! Who could-a have done such a theeng? We musta find her! I weel organise a search-a party right-a-way!
translation: 天啊！你说女王蜂，她不见了？这太可怕了！谁会做出这种事？我们必须找到她！我马上就组织搜索队！

english: Calm down! Let's think this through carefully.
translation: 冷静！我们好好想想。

english: Do you have any idea who could have done this?
translation: 你知道是谁干的吗？

english: Errm...no! None atta all! Da Queen Bee, she izza well liked by-a everyone.
translation: 呃……不！一点都不知道！女王蜂，她深受大家喜爱。

english: That's not very helpful.
translation: 这没什么帮助。

english: Where could she have been taken to?
translation: 她可能被带去了哪里？

english: Ze keednapper must-a have taken her through-a da fairyreengs. Dey weel-a be long gone by-a now.
translation: 绑匪一定是通过仙女环把她带走了。现在他们肯定已经走远了。

english: We must go after them!
translation: 我们必须追上去！

english: Yes! We must-a, but most-a of da folk are away from Zanaris atta the momento.
translation: 是的！我们必须，但大部分人都暂时不在扎纳里斯城。

english: Well tell me what to do and I'll go myself.
translation: 那么告诉我该怎么做，我自己去。

english: Ye-es, dat izza good idea. Hokay, you may use-a da fairyreengs. Talk-a to da co-ordinator, she will-a explain-a to you how to use-a da reengs, but you must-a promees me dat you weel come-a back-a here, eef you
translation: 嗯，这是个好主意。好吧，你可以使用仙女环。去找协调员，她会教你如何使用环，但你必须答应我，如果你找到她，就回到这里。要是你

english: find-a her. Whoever keednapped her must-a be very powerful. You find-a da Queen Bee and den-a yous come right back here and we will-a rescue her together. Hokay?
translation: 找到了她。绑架她的人一定非常强大。你找到女王蜂，然后马上回到这里，我们一起救她。好吗？

english: Good. Now-a yous talk-a to da co-ordinator. She will-a tell you how-a da fairyreengs work.
translation: 好。现在去找协调员吧。她会告诉你仙女环怎么用。

english: No, I'll rescue her myself.
translation: 不，我要自己去救她。

english: Oh no, dat eet eez no good. Yous wanna to be da hero, but what-a about me? She izza my queen! No, no. You cannot-a use-a da fairyreengs
translation: 哦不，那可不好。你想当英雄，但我呢？她是我的女王！不行不行。你不能使用仙女环。

english: Where have all the fairies gone?
translation: 仙子们都去哪了？

english: Da people are mostly out-a and about-a tryeeng to keep-a theengs working. Eet izza not easy weeth da Queen Bee notta here!
translation: 大家大多在外面努力维持运转。女王蜂不在，可不容易啊！

english: Ah, [player name], yous hassa changed your mind? Yous weel-a come and getta me before yous rescue da Queen Bee? Only den can-a I geev yous permission to use-a da reengs.
translation: 啊，[player name]，你改变主意了？你会回来找我，然后再去救女王蜂？只有这样我才能允许你使用环。

english: Good, I knew-a you would change-a your mind. Now I just-a need you to sign-a dis scroll before I geev-a yous da permission to use-a da fairyreengs.
translation: 好，我就知道你会改变主意。现在你只需要在这份卷轴上签字，我就允许你使用仙女环。

english: I am not signing this! It says I am indebted to you until you release me!
translation: 我不会签这个！上面写着我要欠你人情，直到你放我走！

english: Eet does? Oh, sorry, must-a geeven yous da wrong-a scroll. Tell-a yous what, yous hazza da honest face, so I'll trust-a yous. Go ahead, use-a da fairyreengs, but just-a make sure dat yous come-a back here and tell-a
translation: 是吗？哦，抱歉，肯定给错了卷轴。这样吧，你长着一张诚实的脸，我就相信你。去吧，使用仙女环，但一定要记得回来告诉我

english: me when-a yous finda da Queen Bee, like-a yous promised. Now go-a and talk-a to da co-ordinator. She-a weel tell-a yous how da fairyreengs work.
translation: 你找到女王蜂的消息，就像你承诺的那样。现在去找协调员吧。她会告诉你仙女环怎么用。

english: No, there's no chance of that happening.
translation: 不，绝无可能。

english: Yous weel change-a your mind. Come and talk-a to me me yous do.
translation: 你会改变主意的。等你改变主意了，再来和我谈。

english: Hi, the Godfather said I should ask you to explain how the fairy rings work.
translation: 嗨，仙子教父说应该让你解释一下仙女环的用法。

english: Goodness! As if I don't have enough to do already without giving every adventurer that comes along a history lesson! Let's get this over with quickly. Zanaris is an extremely old place, it was here long before we
translation: 天哪！好像我手头的事还不够多，还要给每个路过的冒险者上历史课！快点搞定吧。扎纳里斯城是个非常古老的地方，早在我们来

english: fairyfolk came to live here. In fact it is rumoured to be the nexus of all planes. When we arrived here we found many of the magical properties of this place to be dormant. One of these was the ability to jump between
translation: 仙子族来这里居住之前它就存在了。事实上，有传言说它是所有位面的连接点。我们到达这里时，发现这个地方的许多魔法特性都处于休眠状态。其中之一就是通过一个被封印了几个世纪

english: planes using a powerful portal that had been sealed for centuries. The Fairy Queen harnessed that magic and created the fairy rings, these are not as powerful as the original portal would have been, but are very effective
translation: 的强大传送门在位面之间跳跃的能力。仙子女王驾驭了那种魔法，创造了仙女环。它们虽然不如原本的传送门那么强大，但也非常有效。

english: nonetheless. There are 3 fairy rings in Zanaris, the one in the market and the one near the evil chicken's shrine will only take users to one specific place. However the third fairy ring, near the fountains, is a major portal.
translation: 尽管如此。扎纳里斯城有三个仙女环，市场里的那个和邪恶鸡神龛附近的那个只会把使用者送到一个特定地点。然而第三个仙女环，靠近喷泉的，是一个主要传送门。

english: Anybody who activates that fairy ring will find themselves able to dial in a 3 digit code. These codes will all take the user to different locations. Some of the codes no longer work and other codes go to extremely
translation: 任何激活那个仙女环的人都会发现自己可以输入一个三位数的代码。这些代码会把使用者送到不同的地点。有些代码已经失效，而其他代码会通往极其

english: dangerous places, so be careful. Fortunately the fairy rings are imbued with a powerful protective magic and as long as you stand in the middle of them nothing will be able to attack you. Remember, because you are a
translation: 危险的地方，所以要小心。幸运的是，仙女环被注入了强大的保护魔法，只要你站在它们中间，就没什么能攻击你。记住，因为你是一个

english: human, you will need to be holding your dramen staff to activate the rings. Now I must get back to work, there is so much to do and so few fairies left to do it.
translation: 人类，你需要手持德拉门法杖才能激活环。现在我必须回去工作了，事情太多，剩下的仙子太少。

english: [player name], you are-a back! Have-a you found da Queen Bee?
translation: [player name]，你回来了！找到女王蜂了吗？

english: Err, no, not yet.
translation: 呃，还没。

english: Den whatta are you doing-a back here? Go and-a search for her!
translation: 那你在这里做什么？去搜索她！

english: For why you show-a me dat? I-a busy fairy! I donn-a have time for nonsense!
translation: 你给我看这个干嘛？我可是个忙仙子！没时间陪你瞎闹！

english: Can't the human take a hint? I've been ignoring you! Do you think I would ignore you if I wanted to discuss your Rorschach ink-blots ?
translation: 难道这人类还不明白吗？我一直在无视你！你觉得如果我想讨论你的罗夏墨迹测验，我会无视你吗？

english: The human found some symbolsAnd doesn't know what they meanSo now it's cross-examining meAnd spoiling my routine!
translation: 人类找到了一些符号，却不知它们代表何意，于是跑来盘问我，打乱了我的日常作息！

english: Very nice, dearie, but that belongs to Fairy Nuff. I should put it back on her wall before she misses it if I were you. You wouldn't want her to think you stole it now, would you?
translation: 说得真好，亲爱的，但那属于仙子纳夫。我要是你，就会在它被她发现之前放回墙上。你总不想让她以为是你偷的吧？

english: That you've been doodelling? If you don't mind I have a job to do, please stop distracting me.
translation: 你在瞎画吗？没事的话我还有工作要做，别打扰我。

english: Sorry, we cannot allow you to bring those sacks into the market for security reasons.
translation: 抱歉，出于安全原因，我们不能让你把这些麻袋带进市场。

english: Fairy Nuff is very proud of that certificate, it's her most prized possession. She won't like you taking it.
translation: 仙子纳夫非常珍视那份证书，那是她最宝贵的财产。她不会喜欢你拿走它的。

english: They look familiar, but I can't think where I've seen marks like that. Try asking around, maybe someone else will recognise them.
translation: 它们看起来眼熟，但我想不起来在哪里见过这样的标记。去问问别人吧，也许有人能认出来。

english: Sorry, I don't have time for idle chit-chat, I need to send a fairy to get little Freddies tooth!
translation: 抱歉，我没时间闲聊，我得派一只仙子去拿小弗雷迪的牙齿！

english: Thank you, [player name] but you'd better keep hold of it. You can't get to this hideout without it.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]，但最好还是你拿着。没有它你去不了那个藏身处。

english: Be careful when you pick mushrooms near the strange ruins to the south.  Some of them will try to eat you!
translation: 在南边奇怪的废墟附近采蘑菇时要小心。有些蘑菇会试图吃掉你！

english: Not as bad as the ones by the strange ruins to the south though.  They're much bigger.
translation: 不过没有南边奇怪废墟旁边的那么糟。那些要大多了。

english: How could everything have gone so wrong, so quickly?
translation: 一切怎么会这么快就糟成这样？

english: The Queen is the true ruler of Zanaris, not that wicked Godfather!
translation: 女王才是扎纳里斯城的真正统治者，不是那个邪恶的教父！

english: I hope that the Queen wakes up soon, I want to go back home.
translation: 我希望女王快点醒来，我想回家。

english: The Godfather's henchmen tried to pull off my wings!
translation: 教父的手下试图扯掉我的翅膀！

english: The Godfather has a lot to answer for, just look at all these injured fairies!
translation: 教父有很多事情需要负责，看看这些受伤的仙子！

english: What is that evil fairy doing to our beautiful kingdom?
translation: 那个邪恶的仙子对我们的美丽王国做了什么？

english: [player name]! You found us! I'm so glad, I was afraid you wouldn't get my message.
translation: [player name]！你找到我们了！太好了，我还担心你收不到我的消息呢。

english: Fairy Nuff, what happened?
translation: 仙子纳夫，发生什么事了？

english: After you brought back the Queen's enchanted secateurs and gave them to the Fairy Godfather, I went to him to ask for them so that I could wake Her Majesty up, but he refused to give them to me. Then I
translation: 你找回女王附魔的修枝剪并交给仙子教父之后，我前去找他要，想用它唤醒女王陛下，但他拒绝给我。然后我

english: noticed that lots of my friends were missing, when I asked him about them he said they were off working for him and then he threatened to have his bodyguards pull my wings off! I was scared for the Queen, and so I
translation: 发现很多朋友都不见了。我问他的时候，他说他们都在为他工作，然后威胁说要让他的保镖扯掉我的翅膀！我很担心女王，所以

english: moved her here.
translation: 把她转移到了这里。

english: When I returned to Zanaris I found my cave ransacked! There were other fairies that had been attacked by the Godfather and so we fled the city and came here. I managed to hide a note that I hoped you
translation: 当我回到扎纳里斯城时，发现我的洞穴被洗劫一空！还有其他仙子被仙子教父攻击，于是我们逃离了城市来到这里。我设法藏了一张纸条，希望你能

english: would find...
translation: 找到……

english: ... obviously you did.
translation: ……显然你找到了。

english: But why would the Godfather do this?
translation: 但教父为什么要这么做？

english: Isn't it obvious? He wants to rule Zanaris instead of the Fairy Queen. The latest fairies to arrive have even reported that he has invited all sorts of monsters to the Lost City.
translation: 这还不明显吗？他想取代仙子女王统治扎纳里斯城。最新到达的仙子报告说，他邀请了各种怪物进入失落之城。

english: So what should we do about it do you think?
translation: 那你觉得我们该怎么办？

english: I've got terrible news! One of our spies has just returned from Zanaris and has reported that the Godfather has enlisted an army of orcs! Apparently they are wandering freely around our homes!
translation: 我有坏消息！我们的一个间谍刚从扎纳里斯城回来，报告说教父招募了一支兽人军队！显然它们正在我们的家园中自由游荡！

english: I'm sorry, but who are you?
translation: 抱歉，你是谁？

english: Oh, I've heard of you. You're the young adventurer that defeated the Tanglefoot.
translation: 哦，我听说过你。你就是那个击败缠足怪的年轻冒险者。

english: So you're also the idiot who gave that Godfather maniac the Fairy Queen's magic secateurs!
translation: 那么你也就是那个把仙子女王的魔法修枝剪交给那个教父疯子的傻瓜！

english: But that was a mistake! I thought he was trying to help the Fairy Queen!
translation: 但那是个误会！我以为他是想帮助仙子女王！

english: So you're not evil, you're just not too bright. Well I'm glad you found this place, although if you can find it it's obviously not much of a hiding place, now you can help fix the damage that you've done!
translation: 所以你不是邪恶，只是不太聪明。好吧，我很高兴你找到了这里，尽管你能找到说明这里显然算不上什么藏身之处。现在你可以帮忙弥补你造成的损失了！

english: Alright, what do I need to do?
translation: 好吧，我需要做什么？

english: The first thing we have to do is wake up the Fairy Queen. You will have to go back to Zanaris and find a way to get those magical secateurs back from the Godfather!
translation: 首先我们必须唤醒仙子女王。你得回到扎纳里斯城，想办法从教父那里拿回那对魔法修枝剪！

english: That's easy I'll just pickpocket them off of him, I'm really good at that.
translation: 这简单，我直接从他身上偷回来就行，我很擅长这个。

english: Ok, just be careful, his henchmen have keen eyes and will be watching out for him.
translation: 好，小心点，他的手下眼睛很尖，会盯着他的。

english: I'm so worried about the Queen, without her the fairy people may be chased out of Gielinor completely! You must wake her, for all our sakes!
translation: 我太担心女王了，没有她，仙子一族可能会被彻底赶出吉列诺！为了我们大家，你必须唤醒她！

english: What are you doing? You need to get those secateurs back very urgently!
translation: 你在干什么？你必须立刻拿回那对修枝剪！

english: Rocco, teach-a thees thief a lesson!
translation: 罗科，给这个盗贼点教训！

english: Ben fatto, my friend! Da folk-a dey owe yous a great-a deal! So did-a yous getta back da Queen Bee's magic power?
translation: 干得好，我的朋友！那些家伙欠你一个大人情！那么，你拿回蜂后的魔法力量了吗？

english: Essere nel panico! You-a say datta da Queen Bee, she izza meesing? Theez izza terreeble! Who could-a have done such a theeng? We musta find her! I weel organise a search-a party right-a-way!
translation: 惊慌失措！你说蜂后不见了？这太可怕了！谁会做出这种事？我们必须找到她！我马上组织一个搜索队！

english: Ye-es, dat izza good idea. Hokay, you may use-a da fairyreengs. Talk-a to da co-ordinator, she will-a explain- a to you how to use-a da reengs, but you must-a promees me dat you weel come-a back-a here, eef you
translation: 是——的，这是个好主意。好吧，你可以使用仙子戒指。去找协调员，她会向你解释如何使用戒指，但你必须答应我，如果你遇到麻烦，你会回到这里。

english: A word-a of advice. You be-a careful not to cause da trouble for da folk while you are in Zanaris. Ciao.
translation: 一句忠告。你在扎纳里斯城时要小心，别给居民惹麻烦。再见。

english: So when-a thees Tanglefoot arrives, da Queen Bee she- a goes to da Cosmic Temple area to kill-a eet, but someting goes-a wrong. Da Queen Bee, she gets-a hurt and is-a now inna da magic sleep.
translation: 所以当那个缠足怪出现时，蜂后就去宇宙神庙区域杀它，但出了点问题。蜂后受伤了，现在陷入了魔法沉睡。

english: She is-a being cared for by-a Fairy Nuff, who lives-a just north of-a da bank.
translation: 仙子纳夫在照顾她，她就住在银行北边。

translation: 毒药，女王正是因此受苦——她的生命精华被毒害了。然后我们需要加入催化剂成分：戈拉克爪的粉末。戈拉克会吸取猎物的生命，所以用它们的

english: Ah... well... hmmm... yes... I do have a piece of it anyway...

english: returning to him with an incomplete crest... We each went our seperate ways many years past, none of us seeing our father or willing to give up our fragments.

english: So do you know where I could find any of your brothers?

english: Well, we haven't really kept in touch... what with the dispute over the crest and all... I did hear from my brother Avan a while ago though.

english: So can I have your bit?
translation: 那我能拿你的那块吗？
