translation: 我都带齐了。

english: Where did you say I could find Avan again?
translation: 你刚才说我在哪里可以再找到阿凡？

english: Last I heard he was on some stupid hunt for gold or treasure, somewhere in the desert east of Lumbridge. You might want to ask the traders there about him.
translation: 我上次听说他在仑桥镇以东的沙漠里愚蠢地寻找黄金或宝藏。你也许可以问问那里的商贩关于他的事。

english: How are you doing getting the crest pieces?
translation: 家徽碎片收集得怎么样了？

english: I am still working on it.
translation: 还在努力中。

english: Then why are you wasting your time here?
translation: 那你为什么还在这里浪费时间？

english: I have lost the piece you gave me...
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那块……

english: I have some good news for you then. One of my customers found this on their travels and recognised it as mine and returned it to me here.
translation: 那我有个好消息。我的一位顾客在旅途中发现了它，认出是我的，就还给了我。

english: I suggest you be less careless in the future. The crest is extremely valuable, and utterly irreplaceable.
translation: 我建议你以后小心点。家徽非常珍贵，而且完全无法替代。

english: Hello again. I'm just putting the finishing touches to my masterful salad.
translation: 又见面了。我正在给我的大师级沙拉做最后的点缀。

english: Good luck with that then.
translation: 那祝你好运。

english: Luck? LUCK? With my cooking skill, I don't really need LUCK.
translation: 运气？运气？以我的烹饪技术，根本不需要运气。

english: I've got it right here!
translation: 它就在我这里！

english: Excellent work! Please take it to my father immediately.
translation: 干得好！请立刻把它交给我父亲。

english: The Duke of Lumbridge? And what could he have to do with me? To him I am but a simple scimitar salesman.
translation: 仑桥镇的公爵？他跟我有什么关系？对他来说，我不过是个卖弯刀的小贩。

english: I'm afraid my trap designs are more... experimental than anything. Sadly the Duke will have to look elsewhere if he wishes to obtain a monkey.
translation: 恐怕我的陷阱设计更多是……实验性质的。如果公爵想弄到一只猴子，恐怕得另想办法了。

english: You're in luck, adventurer! I just so happen to have the supplies on hand. Help yourself to the supplies in my shop.
translation: 你运气真好，冒险者！我手头正好有补给品。我店里的补给品你随便拿。

english: Certainly. However, I only have one spare knife so be careful not to lose it!
translation: 当然可以。不过，我只有一把备用的刀，小心别弄丢了！

english: I've been wanting to get my hands on a monkey from Ape Atoll for a while now. Cunning, crafty and much more intelligent than your average Karamjan variant.
translation: 我一直想从猿猴环礁弄一只猴子。它们狡猾、机灵，比卡拉姆贾普通的猴子聪明多了。

english: You're going to need to make one for each monkey, so 6 traps in total and you'll need a knife to construct each trap.
translation: 你需要为每只猴子做一个陷阱，所以总共需要6个陷阱，而且你需要一把刀来制作每个陷阱。

english: What we need is a special kind of trap. Made from 3 pieces of bamboo and loaded with a banana so irresistible that they won't hesitate to jump inside.
translation: 我们需要一种特殊的陷阱。用3根竹子做成，里面放上一根诱人的香蕉，让它们忍不住跳进去。

english: Ape Atoll? What are those banana-brained nitwits doing over here? Well...well... I guess I may just be able to help you after all, sir.
translation: 猿猴环礁？那些香蕉脑袋的蠢货跑这里来干什么？好吧……好吧……我想我或许真能帮上你的忙，先生。

english: A thousand greetings, madam.
translation: 万分敬意，女士。

english: You asked for my help in building a monkey trap. You can build one by using a knife on three pieces of bamboo with a premium banana. I have the bamboo and premium bananas on hand in the barrels nearby.
translation: 你找我帮忙造猴子陷阱。你可以用刀在三根竹子上使用，再配上上等香蕉来制作一个。我手头有竹子和上等香蕉，就在附近的桶里。

english: Haha! Wouldn't you like to know? Luthas would kill me if I told you!
translation: 哈哈！你倒想知道？我要是告诉你了，卢萨斯会杀了我的！

english: Forget I said anything.
translation: 就当我什么都没说。

english: I'd imagine the Duke is waiting for news about the monkeys. You should return to him once you are done here.
translation: 我想公爵正在等猴子的消息。你在这里完成后应该回去找他。

english: Ape Atoll? What are those banana-brained nitwits doing over here? Well...well... I guess I may just be able to help you after all, madam.
translation: 猿猴环礁？那些香蕉脑袋的蠢货跑这里来干什么？好吧……好吧……我想我或许真能帮上你的忙，女士。

english: Well, business hasn't been doing great lately. Years ago there wasn't a person who didn't know of Zeke and his amazing scimitars!
translation: 唉，最近生意不太好。几年前，没有人不知道齐克和他那神奇的弯刀！

english: Yes! Exactly! If I can get my hands on the most premium of scimitars, I'll be swarmed by eager customers. The name Zeke will be known across the land once again!
translation: 没错！正是！如果我能弄到最顶级的弯刀，顾客就会蜂拥而至。齐克这个名字将再次响彻这片土地！

english: After a while, mithril scimitars were no longer good enough and no matter how hard I tried I couldn't find a reliable smith to supply adamant or runite variants.
translation: 过了一段时间，秘银弯刀也不够好了，不管我怎么努力，都找不到可靠的铁匠来供应精金或符文弯刀。

english: I sell scimitars, not whips! This is not that kind of shop!
translation: 我卖的是弯刀，不是鞭子！这里可不是那种店！

english: However, I understand that those monkeys on Ape Atoll somehow obtained a supply of DRAGON scimitars but, despite my best efforts, I haven't been able to find the supplier.
translation: 不过，我知道猿猴环礁上的那些猴子不知从哪里弄到了龙金弯刀，但尽管我尽了最大努力，还是找不到供应商。

english: Ah, [player name]. I see that you were successful in capturing the monkeys! And you must've put in a good word because the Duke himself sent an invitation for me to join the party!
translation: 啊，[player name]。看来你成功抓住了猴子！而且你一定说了好话，因为公爵本人发来邀请，请我参加派对！

english: Please do not spare any details. I want to know everything about how it went. Did the structural integrity of the cages hold up? How about the bananas? Did they like them?
translation: 请不要漏掉任何细节。我想知道整个过程的一切。笼子的结构牢固吗？香蕉呢？它们喜欢吗？

english: I see, I see. Well then, perhaps I am one step closer to obtaining the dragon scimitar supplier after all!
translation: 我明白了，我明白了。那么，也许我离找到龙金弯刀的供应商又近了一步！

english: Although I will admit, I was a little caught off guard when I found out the monkeys were talking to me. I never considered that communicating with them was an option.
translation: 虽然我承认，当我发现那些猴子在跟我说话时，我有点措手不及。我从没想过与它们交流也是一种选择。

english: Perhaps I'll have to try and get my hands on one of those amulets of Monkey Speak first.
translation: 也许我得先弄一个猴子语护符才行。

english: No way, man!
translation: 没门，老兄！

english: I already gave you my spare knife. I don't have another one, but you should be able to purchase one from the Lumbridge general store.
translation: 我已经把我备用的刀给你了。我没有另一把了，不过你应该可以在仑桥镇的杂货店买一把。

english: Leave that barrel alone! That property doesn't belong to you!
translation: 别碰那个桶！那东西不是你的！

english: Are you sure you don't already have a knife on you?
translation: 你确定你身上没有刀吗？

english: I think the Duke would like to speak with you.
translation: 我想公爵想跟你谈谈。

english: No way, lady!
translation: 没门，女士！

english: Haven't you already captured all of the monkeys? Leave some bananas for me!
translation: 你不是已经抓住所有猴子了吗？给我留点香蕉！

english: Haven't you already captured all of the monkeys? That bamboo wasn't cheap!
translation: 你不是已经抓住所有猴子了吗？那些竹子可不便宜！

english: After a while, mithril scimitars were no longer good enough and no matter how hard I tried, I couldn't find a reliable smith to supply adamant or runite variants.
translation: 过了一段时间，秘银弯刀也不够好了，不管我怎么努力，都找不到可靠的铁匠来供应精金或符文弯刀。

english: HoweverI understand that those monkeys on Ape Atoll somehow obtained a supply of DRAGON scimitars but, despite my best efforts, I haven't been able to find the supplier.
translation: 不过我知道猿猴环礁上的那些猴子不知从哪里弄到了龙金弯刀，但尽管我尽了最大努力，还是找不到供应商。

english: Certainly, however you do not appear to have space for one.
translation: 当然可以，不过你好像没有空间放一把。

english: Would you like to see them?
translation: 你想看看吗？

english: Good day lad. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好啊，小伙子。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Good day lass. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好啊，姑娘。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: One of them even came round here and threatened me with a hammer!
translation: 有个人甚至跑到我这里来，用锤子威胁我！

english: I don't like these men he's brought in from the southern desert. They're up to no good, I'm sure.
translation: 我不喜欢他从南方沙漠带来的那些人，我敢肯定他们没安好心。

english: Keep selling armour, of course! Would you like to buy some?
translation: 当然是继续卖盔甲啦！你想买一些吗？

english: He said that it'd be better for us if we worked for Ali Morrisane, and that it was our own fault if we didn't, and... bad things started to happen.
translation: 他说如果我们为阿里.莫里桑干活，对我们更好，如果我们不干，那就是我们自己的错，然后……坏事就开始发生了。

english: But if they're just setting up shop, why does he need to send them around to threaten us?
translation: 但如果他们只是要开店，为什么还要派人来威胁我们呢？

english: He's a shifty man. Brought several men from his home town to try to set up shops here, or so he says.
translation: 他是个狡猾的人。从他家乡带了几个人来，想在这里开店，至少他是这么说的。

english: I'm sorry, there's nothing I can do.  Goodbye.
translation: 抱歉，我无能为力。再见。

english: I'm not going to let those thugs run me out of this town.
translation: 我不会让那些暴徒把我赶出这个镇的。

english: So I'll just keep selling armoured skirts here. Would you like to buy any?
translation: 所以我会继续在这里卖盔甲裙。你想买一些吗？

english: One of them came here, waved his hammer around dangerously, and said things would be worse for us if we didn't join them!
translation: 有个人来了，挥舞着他的锤子危险地晃来晃去，还说如果我们不加入他们，情况会更糟！

english: Fitzharmon eh? Hmmm.... If I'm not mistaken that's the family name of a member of the Varrockian nobility. You know, I HAVE seen someone of that
translation: 菲茨哈蒙？嗯……如果我没记错，那是维洛克贵族的一个姓氏。你知道吗，我最近确实见过一个那样的人，

english: persuasion around here recently... Wearing a poncey yellow cape he was! Came in here all la-di-dah, high and mighty, asking for jewelrymade
translation: 穿着件花哨的黄斗篷！他来这里时一副高高在上的样子，要求用‘完美黄金’做首饰——

english: from 'perfect gold' - whatever that is - like 'normal' golds just not good enough for little lord fancy pants there! I told him to head to the desert
translation: 好像普通黄金配不上那位小少爷似的！我告诉他去沙漠那边，

english: 'Cos I know theres gold out there, in them there sand dunes... and if it's not up to his lordships high standards of 'gold perfection'...
translation: 因为我知道那里有黄金，就在那些沙丘里……如果连那都不符合他大人对‘完美黄金’的高标准……

english: Maybe we'll all get lucky and the scorpions will deal with him.
translation: 也许我们都会走运，让蝎子来收拾他。

english: persuasion around here recently... Wearing a poncey yellow cape he was! Came in here all la-di-dah, high and mighty, asking for jewelry made
translation: 最近这附近有人来游说……他穿着件花哨的黄斗篷！大摇大摆、趾高气扬地走进来，要订做珠宝

english: Why are you lurking around a scorpion pit?
translation: 你为什么在蝎子坑附近鬼鬼祟祟的？

english: It's a good place to find gold...
translation: 这是个找黄金的好地方……

english: I'm looking for a man... his name is Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: 我在找一个人……他叫阿凡.菲茨哈蒙。

english: Then you have found him. My name is Avan Fitzharmon.
translation: 那你找到了。我就是阿凡.菲茨哈蒙。

english: You have a part of your family crest. I am on a quest to retrieve all of the fragmented pieces and restore the crest.
translation: 你有一块家族家徽的碎片。我正在寻找所有碎片，以恢复家徽。

english: Ha! I suppose one of my worthless brothers has sent you on this quest then?
translation: 哈！我猜是我某个没用的兄弟派你来的吧？

english: No, it was your father who has asked me to do this for him.
translation: 不，是你父亲请我为他做这件事的。

english: My... my father wishes this? Then that is a different matter. I will let you have my crest shard, adventurer, but you must first do something for me.
translation: 我……我父亲希望这样？那就不一样了。冒险者，我可以把我的家徽碎片给你，但你必须先为我做件事。

english: There is a certain lady I am trying to impress. As a man of noble birth, I can not give her just any old trinket to show my devotion. What I intend to give her,
translation: 有位女士我想打动她。作为贵族出身，我不能随便给她个小饰品来表达我的爱意。我打算给她的，

english: is a golden ring, embedded with the finest precious red stone available, and a necklace to match this ring. The problem however for me, is that
translation: 是一枚金戒指，镶嵌着最上等的红宝石，还有一条与这枚戒指相配的项链。但对我来说，问题在于

english: not just any old gold will be suitable. I seek only the purest, the most high quality of gold - what I seek, if you will, is perfect gold.
translation: 不是随便什么黄金都合适。我只追求最纯净、最高品质的黄金——我追求的，如果你愿意，就是完美黄金。

english: None of the gold around here is even remotely suitable in terms of quality. I have searched far and wide for the perfect gold I desire, but have had no success so
translation: 这附近的黄金在品质上都不够格。我四处寻找我想要的完美黄金，但恐怕一直没有成功。

english: in finding it I am afraid. If you can find me my perfect gold, make a ring and necklace from it, and add rubies to them, I will
translation: 如果你能帮我找到完美黄金，用它做成戒指和项链，并镶上红宝石，

english: gladly hand over my fragment of the family crest to you.
translation: 我会很高兴地把我的家徽碎片交给你。

english: Can you give me any help on finding this 'perfect gold'?
translation: 你能给我一些关于找到这‘完美黄金’的提示吗？

english: I thought I had found a solid lead on its whereabouts when I heard of a dwarf who is an expert on gold who goes by the name of 'Boot'.
translation: 我本以为找到了一个可靠线索，听说有个叫‘靴子’的矮人是黄金专家。

english: Unfortunately he has apparently returned to his home, somewhere in the mountains, and I have no idea how to find him.
translation: 不幸的是，他显然已经回到了山里某处的家，我不知道怎么找到他。

english: Well, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。

english: So how are you doing getting me my perfect gold jewelry?
translation: 那么，我的完美黄金首饰做得怎么样了？

english: I'm still after that 'perfect gold'.
translation: 我还在找那‘完美黄金’。

english: I know how you feel... for such a long time I have searched and searched for the elusive perfect gold... I thought I had gotten a good lead on finding it
translation: 我理解你的感受……我找了那么久，一直在寻找 elusive 的完美黄金……我本以为找到了一个好线索，

english: when I heard talk of a dwarven expert on gold named Boot some time back, but unfortunately for me, he has returned to his mountain home, which I cannot find.
translation: 当时听说有个叫‘靴子’的矮人黄金专家，但不幸的是，他已经回到了山里，我找不到。

english: Hello. I'm in search of very high quality gold.
translation: 你好。我在寻找非常高纯度的黄金。

english: High quality gold eh? Hmmm... Well, the very best quality gold that I know of, is just East of the large city Ardougne, underground somewhere.
translation: 高品质黄金？嗯……据我所知，最好的黄金就在阿多尼城东边，地下的某个地方。

english: I don't believe it's exactly easy to get to though...
translation: 不过我觉得不太容易到达……

english: So how are you doing making me my perfect gold jewelry?
translation: 那么，我的完美黄金首饰做得怎么样了？

english: I have spoken to Boot the dwarf about the location of 'perfect gold' but haven't managed to make you your jewelryyet.
translation: 我已经和矮人‘靴子’谈过‘完美黄金’的位置，但还没能为你做好首饰。

english: Well, I won't entrust you with my piece of the crest until you have brought me a necklace of perfect gold with a red precious stone, and a perfect gold ring to match.
translation: 嗯，除非你给我带来一条完美的金项链，上面镶有红宝石，以及一枚与之相配的完美金戒指，否则我不会把我的那块家徽托付给你。

english: I have the ring and necklace right here.
translation: 戒指和项链就在这里。

english: These... these are exquisite! EXACTLY what I was searching for all of this time! Please, take my crest fragment!
translation: 这些……这些太精美了！正是我一直在寻找的！请收下我的家徽碎片！

english: Now, I suppose you will be wanting to find my brother Johnathon who is in possession of the final piece of the family's crest?
translation: 现在，我想你接下来要去找我兄弟乔纳森，他拿着家徽的最后一块碎片？

english: Well, the last I heard of my brother Johnathon, he was studying the magical arts, and trying to hunt some demon or other out in The Wilderness.
translation: 嗯，我上次听到我兄弟乔纳森的消息时，他正在学习魔法，试图在荒野里猎杀某个恶魔。

english: Unsurprisingly, I do not believe he is doing a particularly good job of things, and spends most of his time recovering from his injuries in
translation: 毫不意外，我觉得他做得并不好，大部分时间都在荒野边缘的某个酒馆里养伤。

english: some tavern or other near the edge of The Wilderness. You'll probably find him still there.
translation: 荒野边缘的某个酒馆之类的。你大概还能在那里找到他。

english: Thanks Avan.
translation: 谢谢，阿凡。

english: Where did you say I could find your brother Johnathon again?
translation: 你刚才说我在哪里可以再找到你兄弟乔纳森？

english: Greetings again, adventurer. How are you doing on retrieving the crest pieces?
translation: 再次问候你，冒险者。家徽碎片收集得怎么样了？

english: I hope you succeed for my father's sake.
translation: 为了我父亲，我希望你能成功。

english: I have lost the fragment you gave me...
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的碎片……

english: I have a confession myself adventurer... I did not fully trust you with the actual part of my family's crest before, and gave you a worthless replica before...
translation: 冒险者，我自己也有个忏悔……我之前并不完全信任你，所以给了你一个毫无价值的复制品……

english: In hindsight, it seems I was right. I will give you the real piece now, but PLEASE try not to lose it; it is a priceless family heirloom.
translation: 现在看来，我这么做是对的。我现在把真品给你，但请尽量别弄丢；这是无价的家族传家宝。

english: I have assembled all of the pieces!
translation: 我已经集齐了所有碎片！

english: Very well done adventurer! Now please return it to my father!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！现在请把它交给我父亲！

english: Greetings. Would you happen to be Johnathon Fitzharmon?
translation: 你好。请问你是乔纳森.菲茨哈蒙吗？

english: That... I am...
translation: 我……我是……

english: I am here to retrieve your fragment of the Fitzharmon family crest.
translation: 我是来取回你的菲茨哈蒙家徽碎片的。

english: The.. poison.. it is all.. too much... My head... will not... stop spinning...
translation: 毒……毒液……太……太厉害了……我的头……停不下来……旋转……

english: What... what did that spider... DO to me? I... I feel so weak... I can hardly... think at all...
translation: 那……那只蜘蛛……对我做了什么？我……我感觉好虚弱……我几乎……无法思考……

english: Ooooh... thank you... Wow! That's completely cured me!
translation: 哦……谢谢你……哇！这完全治好了我！

english: How can I reward you?
translation: 我该如何报答你？

english: I've come here for your piece of the Fitzharmon family crest.
translation: 我来这里是为了取回你手中的那部分菲茨哈蒙家徽。

english: You have? Unfortunately I don't have it any more... in my attempts to slay the fiendish Chronozon, the blood demon, I lost a lot of equipment in
translation: 是吗？可惜我已经没有了……在我试图杀死那个恶魔般的克罗诺宗——血恶魔时，我损失了大量装备，

english: our last battle when he bested me and forced me away from his den. He probably still has it now.
translation: 在上一场战斗中，他击败了我，把我从他的巢穴赶了出来。现在那东西很可能还在他手上。

english: So is this Chronozon hard to defeat?
translation: 这个克罗诺宗很难打败吗？

english: Well... you will have to be a skilled Mage to defeat him, and my powers are not good enough yet. You will need to hit him once with each of the four elemental spells of death
translation: 嗯……你必须是个技艺高超的法师才能击败他，而我的力量还不够。你需要用四种死亡元素法术各击中他一次，

english: before he will be defeated.
translation: 才能将他击败。

english: Where can I find Chronozon?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到克罗诺宗？

english: The fiend has made his lair in the Wilderness below the Obelisk of Air.
translation: 那个恶魔把巢穴建在荒野中风方尖碑的下方。

english: So how did you end up getting poisoned?
translation: 那你是怎么中毒的？

english: Those accursed poison spiders that surround the entrance to Chronozon's lair... I must have taken a nip from one of them as I attempted to make my escape.
translation: 都是那些该死的毒蜘蛛，它们守在克罗诺宗巢穴的入口处……我逃跑的时候肯定被其中一只咬了一口。

english: I will be on my way now.
translation: 我现在该走了。

english: My thanks for the assistance adventurer.
translation: 感谢你的帮助，冒险者。

english: I'm trying to kill this demon Chronozon that you mentioned...
translation: 我正试图杀死你提到的那个恶魔克罗诺宗……

english: Wish me luck.
translation: 祝我好运吧。

english: Good luck. You'll need it.
translation: 祝你好运。你会需要的。

english: I have your piece of the crest!
translation: 我拿到你那部分家徽了！

english: Well done! Now return it to my father!
translation: 干得好！现在把它还给我父亲吧！

english: I have retrieved your crest.
translation: 我取回了你的家徽。

english: Adventurer... I can only thank you for your kindness, although the words are insufficient to express the gratitude I feel!
translation: 冒险者……我只能感谢你的善意，尽管言语不足以表达我内心的感激之情！

english: You are truly a hero in every sense, and perhaps your efforts can begin to patch the wounds that have torn this family apart...
translation: 你无论从哪方面看都是真正的英雄，也许你的努力可以开始弥合撕裂这个家庭的伤痕……

english: I know not how I can adequately reward you for your efforts... although I do have these mystical gauntlets, a family heirloom that through some power unknown to me, have always returned to the head of the family
translation: 我不知道该如何充分报答你的努力……不过我确实有这双神秘的手套，它是家族传家宝，凭借某种我所不知的力量，它总能回到家族首领手中，

english: whenever lost, or if the owner has died. I will pledge these to you, and if you should lose them return to me, and they will be here.
translation: 即使丢失或主人去世也是如此。我将它托付给你，如果你弄丢了，就回来找我，它会在这里等着。

english: They can also be granted extra powers. Take them to one of my sons, they should be able to imbue them with a skill for you.
translation: 它还可以被赋予额外的力量。把它拿给我的一个儿子，他们应该能为你注入一项技能。

english: I hear you brought the completed crest to my father. I must say, that was awfully impressive work.
translation: 我听说你把完整的家徽带给了我父亲。不得不说，这真是令人印象深刻的工作。

english: I believe your father mentioned you would be able to improve these gauntlets for me...
translation: 我相信你父亲提到过，你可以帮我改进这双手套……

english: Yes, that is correct. I can slightly alter these gauntlets to allow you some of my skill at preparing seafood by making them cooking gauntlets.
translation: 是的，没错。我可以稍微改造这双手套，让你获得一些我处理海鲜的技巧，把它们变成烹饪手套。

english: When you wear them you will burn lobsters, sharks and swordfish a lot less. It will be a permanent modification however, so make sure this is what you want.
translation: 戴上它们后，你烹饪龙虾、鲨鱼和剑鱼时烧焦的几率会大大降低。不过这是永久性的改造，所以请确保这是你想要的。

english: Yes, please do that for me.
translation: 好的，请帮我改造吧。

english: I'll see what your brothers have to offer first.
translation: 我先看看你兄弟们能提供什么。

english: As you wish. Let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 随你便。如果改变主意了，就告诉我。

english: Your father mentioned that you could improve these gauntlets in some way for me...
translation: 你父亲提到你可以帮我改进这双手套……

english: Indeed I can. In my long time searching for the 'perfect' gold I learned a lot about gold items. I can improve these gauntlets so that they provide more than normal
translation: 确实可以。在我长期寻找‘完美’黄金的过程中，我学到了很多关于金制品的知识。我可以改进这双手套，让它们在锻造金时提供比平常更多的经验。

english: experience when smithing gold. I can easily modify these for you.
translation: 锻造黄金时的经验。我可以很容易地为你修改这些。

english: That sounds good, improve them for me!
translation: 听起来不错，帮我改造吧！

english: I think I'll check my other options with your brothers before committing myself.
translation: 我想在决定之前，先看看你兄弟们能提供什么其他选择。

english: If you feel you really must consort with the likes of them. I await your decision.
translation: 如果你真的觉得必须和那类人为伍的话。我等着你的决定。

english: Your father tells me you can improve these gauntlets for me...
translation: 你父亲告诉我你可以帮我改进这双手套……

english: And right he is at that. Although my skill with Death Rune magiks was not great enough to defeat Chronozon, I am adequately skilled at Chaos Rune magiks.
translation: 他说得没错。虽然我的死亡符石魔法不足以击败克罗诺宗，但我对混沌符石魔法还是相当精通的。

english: If you give me your gauntlets I will bestow upon them some of my power, and make any bolt spells you wish to cast more effective.
translation: 如果你把手套给我，我会将一部分力量注入其中，让你施放的任何箭矢法术都更有效。

english: That sounds good to me!
translation: 听起来不错！

english: I doubt they will offer anything as useful as my magical boost, but as you wish.
translation: 我怀疑他们能提供什么像我的魔法增强一样有用的东西，但随你便吧。

english: Hi there. Looks like you're in some trouble.
translation: 嗨，你好。看来你遇到麻烦了。

english: The cart? That's the least of my problems. I've got to find my family...
translation: 推车？那是我最不担心的问题。我得找到我的家人……

english: Your family? Can I help?
translation: 你的家人？我能帮忙吗？

english: You'd be willing to?
translation: 你愿意吗？

english: Of course. Tell me what happened.
translation: 当然。告诉我发生了什么。

english: Well, I'm Lady Servil. I was travelling to Ardougne with my husband, Justin, and son, Sammy, when our cart broke on some rocks.
translation: 嗯，我是塞尔维尔夫人。我和丈夫贾斯汀、儿子萨米正前往阿多尼城，结果推车在岩石上坏了。

english: Some of General Khazard's men spotted us and offered to help, but they demanded my husband and son fight in their arena first! We said no, but they took them anyway!
translation: 卡扎德将军的一些手下发现了我们，主动提出帮忙，但他们要求我丈夫和儿子先到他们的竞技场里战斗！我们拒绝了，可他们还是强行带走了他们！

english: General Khazard?
translation: 卡扎德将军？

english: He's a menace! This entire area is under the control of him and his mercenary group, the Khazard Army. They prey on the weak and vulnerable, making them fight in that arena of theirs, all for entertainment!
translation: 他是个祸害！整个地区都被他和他的雇佣兵团——卡扎德军控制着。他们欺压弱小，强迫人们在他们的竞技场里战斗，纯粹是为了取乐！

english: That's horrible! How are they able to get away with it?
translation: 太可怕了！他们怎么能逍遥法外？

english: The authorities don't care. Khazard's men just pay them off if they ever come to investigate.
translation: 当局根本不管。要是有人来调查，卡扎德的手下就用钱打发他们。

english: Well they won't stop me. I'm going to try my best to find your family.
translation: 但他们阻止不了我。我会尽全力找到你的家人。

english: Thank you. They'll be somewhere inside the arena. I'll be waiting here for you.
translation: 谢谢你。他们应该在竞技场里的某个地方。我在这儿等你。

english: Well I hope it works out. Good luck.
translation: 嗯，希望一切顺利。祝你好运。

english: Adventurer, please... bring back my family. They'll be somewhere inside the arena.
translation: 冒险者，拜托了……把我的家人带回来。他们应该在竞技场里的某个地方。

english: Don't worry, I'll find them.
translation: 别担心，我会找到他们的。

english: Hello, stranger. Are you here for the fight arena?
translation: 你好，陌生人。你是来参加战斗竞技场的吗？

english: I suppose I am.
translation: 算是吧。

english: Just visiting some friends.
translation: 只是来拜访几个朋友。

english: Inside? Are you sure about that? Only Khazard guards are allowed in there. Unless you know where to get some of their armour, you won't be visiting anyone.
translation: 里面？你确定吗？只有卡扎德守卫才能进去。除非你知道从哪里弄到他们的盔甲，否则你谁也拜访不了。

english: Hello Lady Servil.
translation: 你好，塞尔维尔夫人。

english: Have you had any luck with freeing my family?
translation: 解救我家人的事有进展了吗？

english: I've managed to get a guard's uniform, hopefully I can infiltrate the arena.
translation: 我弄到了一套守卫制服，希望能混进竞技场。

english: Please hurry.
translation: 请快点。

english: Hello there. I hear the Servil family are fighting soon. Should be very entertaining.
translation: 你好。我听说塞尔维尔一家很快就要上场了。应该会很有意思。

english: This door appears to be locked.
translation: 这扇门似乎是锁着的。

english: Nice observation guard. You could have just asked to be let in like a normal person.
translation: 观察得真仔细啊，守卫。你本来可以像个正常人一样请求放你进去的。

english: Do either of you know of the Servil family?
translation: 你们俩谁知道塞尔维尔一家吗？

english: If we did, why would we tell a guard?
translation: 就算知道，我们为什么要告诉一个守卫？

english: Until our last breath, our every action will be against Khazard. Never will we help you.
translation: 只要我们还有一口气，我们的每一个行动都是对抗卡扎德。我们绝不会帮你。

english: I spit on Khazard, and all who do his bidding.
translation: 我唾弃卡扎德，以及所有替他卖命的人。

english: I've heard of them, but if your hope is to help them, I fear you may be too late.
translation: 我听说过他们，但如果你想帮他们，恐怕已经太晚了。

english: You should leave while you can. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.
translation: 趁现在还能走，快离开吧。要是被守卫抓住，下一个进这里的就是你。

english: Hello there. I'm looking for the Servil family.
translation: 你好。我在找塞尔维尔一家。

english: Please leave me alone.
translation: 请别烦我。

english: I've never heard of them.
translation: 我从没听说过他们。

english: No one important. I'm looking for the Servil family.
translation: 不是什么重要的人。我在找塞尔维尔一家。

english: I've seen them in here, but my advice to you is to leave them. Whatever plan you have will only end with you in a cell as well.
translation: 我在这里见过他们，但我建议你别管他们。不管你有什么计划，最后只会让你也进了牢房。

english: I'm looking for the Servil family.
translation: 我在找塞尔维尔一家。

english: Hello. Are you Sammy?
translation: 你好。你是萨米吗？

english: Please... don't hurt me.
translation: 求求你……别伤害我。

english: Don't worry, I'm here to help. Where do they keep the keys?
translation: 别担心，我是来帮忙的。他们把钥匙放在哪里？

english: The Head Guard has them. He's the one with the big sword.
translation: 钥匙在守卫长那里。就是那个拿着大剑的家伙。

english: Don't lose heart, I'll be back.
translation: 别灰心，我会回来的。

english: Hello, Sammy.
translation: 你好，萨米。

english: Hello. Do you have the keys?
translation: 你好。你有钥匙了吗？

english: Please hurry. The Head Guard has them. He's the one with the big sword.
translation: 请快点。钥匙在守卫长那里。就是那个拿着大剑的家伙。

english: Lady Servil, I have managed to infiltrate General Khazard's arena.
translation: 塞尔维尔夫人，我已经成功潜入了卡扎德将军的竞技场。

english: And my family?
translation: 我的家人呢？

english: What did I do to deserve this?
translation: 我做了什么要受这种罪？

english: You're not safe here. Leave while you can.
translation: 你在这里不安全。趁还能走，快离开吧。

english: I'd like a Khali brew please.
translation: 请给我一杯卡利酒。

english: That'll be five gold coins please.
translation: 请付五个金币。

english: There you go, that's five gold coins. I suggest lying down before you drink it. That way you have less distance to collapse.
translation: 给你，五个金币。我建议你喝之前先躺下，这样倒下去的距离短一点。

english: The gate is locked, but Sammy's not in there anyway.
translation: 门是锁着的，不过萨米反正不在里面。

english: Sammy look, I have the keys.
translation: 萨米你看，我拿到钥匙了。

english: Wow! Please hurry and set me free.
translation: 哇！快放我出去吧。

english: We'll need to wait for the guards to change shift, but don't worry, you'll be out soon...
translation: 我们得等守卫换班，但别担心，你很快就能出去了……

english: Alright, the coast is clear.
translation: 好了，安全了。

english: Now, let's get you out of here.
translation: 现在，我们带你离开这里。

english: Not yet! We need to find my dad!
translation: 还不行！我们得找到我爸爸！

english: Sammy, wait!
translation: 萨米，等等！

english: Quick, help him!
translation: 快，帮他！

english: Hello there. I hear Khazard's got some great fights lined up today. I can't wait!
translation: 你好。我听说卡扎德今天安排了好几场精彩的战斗。我等不及了！

english: Hello, stranger. I hear Khazard's got some great fights lined up today. I can't wait!
translation: 你好，陌生人。我听说卡扎德今天安排了好几场精彩的战斗。我等不及了！

english: Lady Servil, I freed your son, but he went to help your husband.
translation: 塞尔维尔夫人，我释放了你儿子，但他跑去帮你丈夫了。

english: No! Please, you have to help them!
translation: 不！拜托，你得帮帮他们！

english: Well, well, well, you seem to be in quite the rush. Do you have somewhere else to be?
translation: 哎呀，哎呀，看来你挺着急的。赶着去哪儿吗？

english: General Khazard, I presume?
translation: 想必你就是卡扎德将军吧？

english: You presume correct. I must say, I sense a great air of defiance to you. Does my appearance not fill you with fear?
translation: 你猜对了。我得说，我感觉到你身上有一股强烈的反抗气息。难道我的长相不让你感到恐惧吗？

english: I've seen worse.
translation: 我见过更吓人的。

english: How arrogant. No matter though, you will come to learn.
translation: 真是狂妄。不过没关系，你慢慢就会领教了。

english: Now, despite your entertaining show, the two individuals you are attempting to leave with are my property.
translation: 听着，虽然你刚才的表演很有趣，但你想带走的那两个人是我的财产。

english: They belong to nobody!
translation: 他们不属于任何人！

english: Ha! Well if their freedom is so valuable to you, how about a trade? Fight in my arena, and if you win, I'll let them go.
translation: 哈！既然他们的自由对你那么重要，不如做个交易？到我的竞技场里打一场，如果你赢了，我就放他们走。

english: And what if I refuse your offer?
translation: 如果我拒绝你的提议呢？

english: Well... I wasn't actually giving you a choice. Guards, take [him/her/them] to the cells.
translation: 嗯……我其实没给你选择。守卫，把[him/her/them]带到牢房去。

english: Hey, you're the one from the arena! That was some great fighting!
translation: 嘿，你就是竞技场里的那个家伙！打得太精彩了！

english: So you're back for more are you? General Khazard will be pleased.
translation: 所以你又回来找打了是吗？卡扎德将军会很高兴的。

english: Now watch closely, friends. I fear this may be where your protector dies.
translation: 现在看好了，朋友们。恐怕这就是你们的保护者丧命的地方。

english: Ignore him! You can do it!
translation: 别理他！你能行的！

english: Impressive, but now for a proper challenge. Time for my puppy. Bring on Bouncer!
translation: 令人印象深刻，但现在该来点真正的挑战了。该我的小狗上场了。放出保镖！

english: Bouncer! No!
translation: 保镖！不！

english: You monster! You'll pay for what you've done!
translation: 你这个怪物！你会为你的所作所为付出代价的！

english: I only did what you asked. I fought in your arena. Now let the Servils go.
translation: 我只是按你的要求做了。我在你的竞技场里打了。现在放了塞尔维尔一家。

english: Fine! I am not a coward who makes false promises. I have no need of them anyway. You on the other hand, won't be going anywhere.
translation: 行！我不是那种食言的懦夫。反正我也不需要他们了。至于你，哪儿也去不了。

english: Guard, escort the Servils out. I'll take great pleasure in dealing with this one myself!
translation: 守卫，护送塞尔维尔一家出去。我非常乐意亲自处理这个家伙！

english: Don't try to fight him! Just run!
translation: 别和他打！快跑！

english: Hey, you're the one who beat Bouncer! Amazing!
translation: 嘿，你就是打败保镖的那个人！太厉害了！

english: But... I killed you!
translation: 可是……我明明杀了你！

english: Ha! Arrogant fool! You think you can kill me? I am General Khazard! My power is absolute!
translation: 哈！狂妄的蠢货！你以为你能杀了我？我是卡扎德将军！我的力量是绝对的！

english: Now, part of me would very much like to kill you for what you've done today, but let it be known that I am not without generosity.
translation: 现在，我有一部分很想杀了你，为今天的事付出代价，但我要让你知道，我并非毫无度量。

english: You proved yourself in battle against me. That is something few can boast of. For that, you may leave. However, if you ever oppose me again, I won't hesitate to wipe you from existence!
translation: 你在与我的战斗中证明了自己。没几个人能这么说。为此，你可以走了。但是，如果你再敢反抗我，我会毫不犹豫地将你抹杀！

english: Now go. I have business to attend to elsewhere that is far more important than you.
translation: 现在走吧。我还有比你要重要得多的要事处理。

english: Lady Servil.
translation: 塞尔维尔夫人。

english: You're alive! I feared General Khazard would have killed you!
translation: 你还活着！我还担心卡扎德将军会杀了你！

english: He tried, but I escaped.
translation: 他试过了，但我逃了出来。

english: Thank goodness. I'd have never forgiven myself if you'd have died saving my family.
translation: 谢天谢地。要是你为了救我的家人而死，我永远不会原谅自己。

english: Now, you'll be pleased to know that my son and husband are safe and recovering at home. Without you they would certainly be dead. Thank you, for everything.
translation: 现在，你会很高兴知道，我儿子和丈夫都安全在家休养。没有你，他们肯定已经死了。谢谢你，谢谢你做的一切。

english: Please, take this payment. It's the least you deserve.
translation: 请收下这份报酬。这是你应得的一点心意。

english: He tried, but I was able to defeat him.
translation: 他试过了，但我击败了他。

english: You killed General Khazard?
translation: 你杀了卡扎德将军？

english: I thought I had at first, but it seems he is not that easy to kill.
translation: 一开始我也以为杀了他，但看来他没那么容易死。

english: Well, at least you're alive.
translation: 好吧，至少你还活着。

english: This area is restricted, leave now!
translation: 此区域禁止进入，立刻离开！

english: OUT! And don't come back.
translation: 滚出去！别再回来。

english: I don't know you stranger. Get off our land.
translation: 我不认识你，陌生人。离开我们的土地。

english: Hello stranger, are you new to these parts? You look lost.
translation: 你好陌生人，你是新来的吗？你看起来迷路了。

english: I suppose you're here for the fight arena? There are some rich folk fighting tomorrow. Should be entertaining.
translation: 我猜你是来看战斗竞技场的？明天有些有钱人要打斗，应该很精彩。

english: Oh I wish this broken cart was my only problem... I've got to find my family...
translation: 唉，我真希望这辆破损的推车是我唯一的问题……我得找到我的家人……

english: Would you? Please?
translation: 你愿意吗？拜托？

english: I'm Lady Servil, my husband is Sir Servil. We were travelling north together with our son Sammy when we were ambushed by General Khazard's men.
translation: 我是塞尔维尔夫人，我丈夫是塞尔维尔爵士。我们和儿子萨米一起向北旅行时，遭到了卡扎德将军手下的伏击。

english: He's been after me ever since I declined his hand in marriage.
translation: 自从我拒绝了他的求婚，他就一直追着我不放。

english: Now he's kidnapped my husband and son to fight in his battle arena to the south of here. I hate to think what he'll do to them. He's a sick and twisted man.
translation: 现在他绑架了我的丈夫和儿子，让他们在城南的战斗竞技场里打斗。我不敢想象他会对他们做什么。他是个变态扭曲的人。

english: I'll try my best to return your family.
translation: 我会尽力把你的家人带回来。

english: Please do. My family is wealthy and can reward you handsomely. I'll be waiting here for you.
translation: 拜托了。我的家族很富有，可以给你丰厚的报酬。我会在这里等你。

english: I hope you can, good luck.
translation: 希望你能做到，祝你好运。

english: Brave traveller, please... bring back my family.
translation: 勇敢的旅人，求求你……把我的家人带回来。

english: I don't know who you are. Get out of my house stranger.
translation: 我不认识你。滚出我的房子，陌生人。

english: Despicable thieving scum, that was good armour. Did you see anyone around here soldier?
translation: 卑鄙的偷窃渣滓，那可是好盔甲。你在这附近看到什么人了吗，士兵？

english: Me? No, no one!
translation: 我？没有，没人！

english: Hmmmm.
Can I help you stranger?
translation: 需要帮忙吗，陌生人？

english: Oh, you're a guard as well. That's ok then. We don't like strangers around here.
translation: 哦，你也是守卫。那就没事了。我们不喜欢这附近的陌生人。

english: I heard the Servil family are fighting soon. Should be very entertaining.
translation: 我听说塞尔维尔一家很快就要打斗了。应该会非常精彩。

english: Hello stranger, are you new to these parts?
translation: 你好陌生人，你是新来的吗？

english: What's your business?
translation: 你有什么事？

english: Just visiting friends in the cells.
translation: 只是来牢房探望朋友。

english: Visiting, that's funny.
translation: 探望，真有趣。

english: Only Khazard guards are allowed to see prisoners. Unless you know where to get some Khazard armour, you won't be visiting anyone.
translation: 只有卡扎德守卫才能见囚犯。除非你知道哪里能弄到卡扎德盔甲，否则你谁也见不了。

english: That'll be two gold coins please.
translation: 请付两枚金币。

english: There you go, that's two gold coins.
translation: 给你，这是两枚金币。

english: If you want to see the action around here you should visit the famous Khazard fight arena. I've seen some grand battles in my time. Ogres, goblins, even dragons have fought there.
translation: 如果你想看这里的精彩场面，应该去著名的卡扎德战斗竞技场。我见过不少大战。食人魔、哥布林，甚至龙都在那里打过。

english: Although you have to feel sorry for some of the slaves sent in there.
translation: 不过你也会为一些被送进去的奴隶感到难过。

english: I've never seen you around here before!
translation: 我以前从没见过你！

english: Erm.. yes.. soldier, I take it you're new around here?
translation: 呃……是的……士兵，我猜你是新来的？

english: Khazard died two hundred years ago. However his dark spirit remains in the form of the undead maniac General Khazard. Remember he is your master, always watching.
translation: 卡扎德两百年前就死了。然而，他那黑暗的灵魂以亡灵狂人卡扎德将军的形式留存下来。记住他是你的主人，一直在注视着你。

english: Got that newbie?
translation: 记住了吗，新来的？

english: Undead, maniac, master. Got it, loud and clear.
translation: 亡灵、疯子、主人。记住了，清清楚楚。

english: Do either of you know a Justin or Sammy Servil?
translation: 你们认识贾斯汀或萨米.塞尔维尔吗？

english: If we did, why would we tell you guard?
translation: 就算认识，我们为什么要告诉你，守卫？

english: I spit on Khazard's grave, and all who do his bidding.
translation: 我唾弃卡扎德的坟墓，以及所有为他卖命的人。

english: I have heard of those of whom you speak. But I fear it may be too late.
translation: 我听说过你说的那些人。但我恐怕已经太迟了。

english: It is said that Khazard has a personal vendetta against those two, their time is therefore short.
translation: 据说卡扎德对那两个人有私人恩怨，所以他们的时间不多了。

english: You're a brave [man/woman]. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.
translation: 你是个勇敢的[man/woman]。如果守卫抓到你，下一个进这里的就是你。

english: Do you know of a Justin or Sammy Servil in this arena?
translation: 你知道这个竞技场里有没有一个叫贾斯汀或萨米.塞尔维尔的人？

english: I've not met anybody in here by that name.
translation: 我在这里没见过叫这个名字的人。

english: Do you know a Justin or Sammy Servil?
translation: 你认识贾斯汀或萨米.塞尔维尔吗？

english: You're not a real guard. I've been in here long enough to know that. What's your business?
translation: 你不是真正的守卫。我在这里待得够久了，看得出来。你有什么事？

english: I've been sent to rescue Sir Servil and his son.
translation: 我是被派来救塞尔维尔爵士和他儿子的。

english: I've seen them in here, although they don't look up to much. My advice to you is to leave before you end up in a cell too.
translation: 我在这里见过他们，不过他们看起来不太行。我建议你趁还没进牢房之前赶紧离开。

english: And where do you think you're going? Only General Khazard decides who fights in the arena. Get out of here.
translation: 你以为你要去哪？只有卡扎德将军才能决定谁在竞技场里打斗。滚出去。

english: Erm.. yes.. quite right.
translation: 呃……是的……说得对。

english: Have you come to laugh at the fight slaves? I used to really enjoy it, but after a while they become quite boring.
translation: 你是来嘲笑打斗奴隶的吗？我以前很喜欢看，但过了一阵子就变得很无聊了。

english: Now I just want a decent drink. Mind you, too much Khali brew and I'll fall asleep.
translation: 现在我只想喝杯好酒。不过，卡利酒喝太多我会睡着的。

english: Bored, bored, bored. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining. Selfish the lot of them.
translation: 无聊，无聊，无聊。你还以为奴隶们会更有趣些。真自私，这帮家伙。

english: I used to enjoy this job, but now all I want is a decent drink.
translation: 我以前喜欢这份工作，但现在我只想喝杯好酒。

english: Please Sir, don't hurt me.
translation: 求求您，先生，别伤害我。

english: Sshh. This uniform is a disguise, I'm here to help. Where do they keep the keys?
translation: 嘘。这身制服是伪装，我是来帮忙的。他们把钥匙放在哪？

english: Sshh. I'm here to help. Where do they keep the keys?
translation: 嘘。我是来帮忙的。他们把钥匙放在哪？

english: The guard always keeps hold of them.
translation: 守卫总是随身带着。

english: Bored, bored, bored. You'd think the slaves would be more entertaining. Selfish the lot of them.*Player:Do you still fancy a drink?
translation: 无聊，无聊，无聊。你还以为奴隶们会更有趣些。真自私，这帮家伙。*玩家：你还想喝一杯吗？

english: I really shouldn't... oh... ok then just the one.
translation: 我真的不该……哦……好吧，就一杯。

english: Blimey this stuff is pretty good. It's not too strong is it?
translation: 哎呀，这玩意儿真不错。不会太烈吧？

english: No, not at all. You'll be fine.
translation: 不，一点也不。你会没事的。

english: That is some gooood stuff... yeah... wooh yeah!
translation: 真是好东……西……耶……呜呼耶！

english: Yeesshh, hiccup! Oooh, maybe I sshould relax for a while.
translation: 是……的，呃！哦，也许我该休息一会儿。

english: Yeesh, yes that shounds reasonable. Here, 'hiccup', take the keysch. Any trouble, you give... you givem a good beating.
translation: 是……的，听起来合……理。给你，呃，拿着钥匙。有麻烦，你就……你就狠狠揍他们一顿。

english: No problem, I'll keep them in line.
translation: 没问题，我会管好他们的。

english: Hello, how's the job?
translation: 你好，工作怎么样？

english: Please, leave me alone. I'm sure the walls never used to sway that much.
translation: 拜托，别烦我。我敢肯定墙壁以前没晃得这么厉害。

english: Hi, er.. I lost the keys.
translation: 嗨，呃……我把钥匙弄丢了。

english: What?!  You're foolish...
translation: 什么？！你真蠢……

english: ...and I'm drunk. Here, take my spare set.
translation: ……而且我醉了。给你，拿我的备用钥匙。

english: Go away. Thish areash resh... restricted! We don't like strangersh, 'specially ones who sway. Oooh!
translation: 走开。这……里是禁……区！我们不喜欢陌生人，尤其是会晃的。哦！

english: Wow! Please set me free, then we can find my dad. I overheard a guard talking. I think they've taken him to the arena.
translation: 哇！请放我出去，然后我们去找我爸爸。我偷听到一个守卫说话。我想他们把他带到竞技场去了。

english: Ok, we'd better hurry.
translation: 好，我们得快点。

english: I'll run ahead.
translation: 我先跑过去。

english: Sammy, where's your father?
translation: 萨米，你父亲在哪？

english: Quick, help him! That beast will kill him. He's too old to fight.
translation: 快，帮帮他！那只野兽会杀了他的。他太老了，打不了。

english: What do you want guard? I'm a busy man.
translation: 你想要什么，守卫？我很忙。

english: Of course sir.
translation: 当然，先生。

english: In the last two hundred years, I have survived all horrors imaginable. Now it is my turn to cover this land in darkness. One day you shall see, all will quake on hearing my name.
translation: 在过去两百年里，我熬过了所有能想象的恐怖。现在轮到我把这片土地笼罩在黑暗中了。总有一天你会看到，所有人听到我的名字都会颤抖。

english: Now leave me.
translation: 现在离开我。

english: Who dares enter my home? You? A feeble traveller?
translation: 谁敢进入我的家？你？一个孱弱的旅人？

english: Feeble?!
translation: 孱弱？！

english: Get out!  Whoever let you in shall be severely punished for this.
translation: 滚出去！不管是谁放你进来的，都会因此受到严厉惩罚。

english: Lady Servil sent me to rescue you and your son. Come on, we have to get out of here.
translation: 塞尔维尔夫人派我来救你和你的儿子。快，我们得离开这里。

english: I'm too old to fight. I'm afraid you'll have to kill that ogre by yourself.
translation: 我太老了，打不动了。恐怕你得自己杀了那只食人魔。

english: Please don't go, you must help us. We'll never survive in here alone.
translation: 请别走，你必须帮我们。我们独自在这里活不下去。

english: Where's your father Sammy?
translation: 萨米，你父亲在哪？

english: Lady Servil. I freed your son, however he has returned to the arena to help your husband.
translation: 塞尔维尔夫人。我救出了你的儿子，但他又回到竞技场去帮你丈夫了。

english: Oh no, they won't stand a chance. Please go back and help.
translation: 哦不，他们没机会的。请回去帮忙。

english: You saved my life and my son's, I am eternally in your debt brave traveller.
translation: 你救了我和我儿子的命，我永远欠你一份情，勇敢的旅人。

english: Haha, well done, well done that was rather entertaining. I am the great General Khazard, and the two men you just 'saved' are my property.
translation: 哈哈，干得好，干得好，真是相当精彩。我是伟大的卡扎德将军，你刚刚‘救’的那两个人是我的财产。

english: They belong to nobody.
translation: 他们不属于任何人。

english: Well, I suppose we could find some arrangement for their freedom... hmmm?
translation: 嗯，我想我们可以商量一下他们的自由……嗯？

english: I'll let them go, but you must stay and fight for me. You'll make me double the gold if you manage to last a few fights.
translation: 我会放了他们，但你必须留下来为我打斗。如果你能撑过几场，你会让我赚到双倍的金币。

english: Guards! Take [him/her] to the cells.
translation: 守卫！把[him/her]带到牢房去。

english: The General seems to have taken a liking to you. He'd normally kill imposters like you without a second thought.
translation: 将军似乎挺喜欢你的。他通常二话不说就会杀了像你这样的冒牌货。

english: You saved my life and my son's. I am eternally in your debt brave traveller.
translation: 你救了我和我儿子的命，我永远欠你一份情，勇敢的旅人。

english: Come on Sammy, we have to get out of here.
translation: 快，萨米，我们得离开这里。

english: Thank you for saving my father.
translation: 谢谢你救了我父亲。

english: I have come to demand the release of Sir Servil and his son.
translation: 我来要求你释放瑟维尔爵士和他的儿子。

english: Why would I give them up, those two men are my property now.
translation: 我为什么要放了他们？那两个人现在是我的财产。

english: Please help me.
translation: 请帮帮我。

english: You're not safe here, leave while you can.
translation: 你在这里不安全，趁还能走就快离开吧。

english: I hope you're keeping busy.
translation: 希望你一直有事可做。

english: General Khazard doesn't tolerate the lazy. If you're not keeping busy I'll practice my combat skills on your hide.
translation: 卡扎德将军容不下懒人。如果你不忙，我就拿你练练我的战斗技巧。

english: Get away, get away. One day I'll have my revenge, and I'll have all your heads.
translation: 滚开，滚开。总有一天我会报仇的，我会砍下你们所有人的头。

english: Spare me your fake pity. I spit on Khazard's grave, and all who do his bidding.
translation: 省省你虚伪的怜悯吧。我唾弃卡扎德的坟墓，以及所有为他卖命的人。

english: You're not safe here traveller. Leave while you still can
translation: 你在这里不安全，旅者。趁还能走就快离开吧。

english: You're a brave person. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.
translation: 你是个勇敢的人。如果守卫抓到你，你下一个就会进到这里。

english: If I did, why would I tell you guard?
translation: 就算我知道，我为什么要告诉你，守卫？

english: You're a brave man. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.
translation: 你是个勇敢的人。要是被守卫抓住，你下一个就得进这儿了。

english: I have heard of those of whom you speak. But I fear you may be too late.
translation: 我听说过你说的那些人。但恐怕你来晚了。

english: You're a brave woman. If the guards get you, you'll be in here next.
translation: 你是个勇敢的女人。要是被守卫抓住，你下一个就得进这儿了。

english: You're not safe here traveller. Leave while you still can.
translation: 你在这儿不安全，旅者。趁还能走，赶紧离开吧。

english: Are you ok stranger?
translation: 你还好吗，陌生人？

english: So Khazard got his hands on you too?
translation: 所以卡扎德也抓到你了吗？

english: If you're lucky you may last as long as me.
translation: 如果你运气好，也许能和我撑得一样久。

english: I've been in Khazard's prisons ever since I can remember. I was a child when his men kidnapped me. My whole life has been spent killing and fighting, all in the hope that one day I might escape.
translation: 从我记事起，我就一直被关在卡扎德的监狱里。他的手下绑架我时，我还是个孩子。我的一生都在杀戮和战斗中度过，只希望有一天能逃出去。

english: Thanks friend.
translation: 谢谢，朋友。

english: Wait.. sshh, the guard is coming. Looks like you'll be going into the arena. Good luck friend.
translation: 等等……嘘，守卫来了。看来你要进竞技场了。祝你好运，朋友。

english: Right you, move it.
translation: 你，快走。

english: Don't worry, I'll get us out of here.
translation: 别担心，我会带我们离开这里的。

english: Thanks traveller. I'm sorry that you too are now a subject of this arena.
translation: 谢谢你，旅者。很抱歉你也成了这个竞技场的囚徒。

english: You've incurred the anger of Khazard yourself now. He won't let any of us go easily.
translation: 你现在也惹怒了卡扎德。他不会轻易放过我们任何人的。

english: How dare you speak to me, you are a slave of this arena now.
translation: 你竟敢跟我说话，你现在是这个竞技场的奴隶了。

english: It would be impolite to leave now. The General insists you stay a little longer.
translation: 现在离开可不礼貌。将军坚持要你多待一会儿。

english: Not bad, not bad at all. I think you need a tougher challenge. Time for my puppy. Guards! Guards! Bring on Bouncer!
translation: 不错，真不错。我觉得你需要一个更难的挑战。该我的小狗上场了。守卫！守卫！把保镖带上来！

english: Come on, we only have to fight a creature called bouncer now.
translation: 来吧，我们现在只需要对付一个叫保镖的生物。

english: You may laugh, but the name of the General's 'pet' is feared by many in this land.
translation: 你尽管笑，但将军的‘宠物’的名字在这片土地上可是让很多人闻风丧胆。

english: Hey you're the guy from the arena! How'd you get out!
translation: 嘿，你就是竞技场里那家伙！你怎么出来的！

english: I don't know how you managed to escape the arena, but you may not be as lucky next time. Get out of here while you can.
translation: 我不知道你是怎么逃出竞技场的，但下次你可能就没这么幸运了。趁还能走就快离开这里吧。

english: Nooooo! Bouncer! How dare you? You've taken the life of my only friend. Now you'll suffer traveller, prepare to meet your maker.
translation: 不——！保镖！你怎么敢？你夺走了我唯一朋友的生命。现在你要受苦了，旅者，准备去见你的造物主吧。

english: You agreed to let the Servils go if I stayed to fight.
translation: 你答应过，如果我留下来战斗，就放了瑟维尔父子。

english: Indeed. I obviously underestimated you, although you still pale in comparison to the might of General Khazard.
translation: 没错。我显然低估了你，尽管你与卡扎德将军的力量相比仍然相形见绌。

english: You shall see that I am not cowardly enough to make false promises. They may go.
translation: 你会看到，我还不至于懦弱到做出虚假承诺。他们可以走了。

english: You however have caused me much trouble today. You must remain here so that I may at least have the pleasure of killing you myself.
translation: 但你今天给我惹了不少麻烦。你必须留在这里，这样我至少还能享受亲手杀死你的乐趣。

english: What does Khazard want with us now?
translation: 卡扎德现在想拿我们怎么样？

english: I don't know, but I can't imagine he'll be happy with you now.
translation: 我不知道，但我猜他现在不会对你满意的。

english: The agreement was that the Servils may leave if you won a few fights, and indeed they are now free to do so.
translation: 协议是，如果你赢了几场战斗，瑟维尔父子就可以离开，现在他们确实自由了。

english: I don't know, but he won't be happy that you've killed his so called pet.
translation: 我不知道，但他不会高兴你杀了他所谓的宠物。

english: You can run, Khazard's interest is in me now.
translation: 你可以跑了，卡扎德现在只对我感兴趣。

english: My thanks, we'll be ok now. I suggest you run too, General Khazard is mighty and his anger fearsome.
translation: 多谢，我们现在没事了。我建议你也快跑，卡扎德将军很强大，他的怒火也很可怕。

english: My thanks. But Khazard is not as easy to kill as you might think. I suggest that none of us remain here too long.
translation: 多谢。但卡扎德可没你想的那么好杀。我建议我们谁也别在这儿待太久。

english: You and your father should run, Khazard's interest is in me now.
translation: 你和你父亲应该快跑，卡扎德现在只对我感兴趣。

english: I'm sorry to have gotten you into so much trouble. You should run as well, Khazard is too dangerous.
translation: 很抱歉给你惹了这么多麻烦。你也应该快跑，卡扎德太危险了。

english: Thank you, we are truly indebted to you.
translation: 谢谢你，我们真的欠你一份人情。

english: You killed my pet, and yet still you dare to speak to me?
translation: 你杀了我的宠物，还敢跟我说话？

english: You shall die for your insolence.
translation: 你将因你的无礼而死。

english: You're [him/her]. The one who murdered the General's pet.
translation: 你就是[him/her]。那个杀了将军宠物的人。

english: You'll pay for that mistake!
translation: 你会为那个错误付出代价的！

english: You're the one who killed Bouncer.
translation: 你就是杀了保镖的人。

english: Die traitor!
translation: 去死吧，叛徒！

english: Yeah, it's to prevent people like you bothering us. Get out of here.
translation: 是啊，就是为了防止你这种人打扰我们。滚出去。

english: You're him. The one who murdered the General's pet.
translation: 就是你。杀了将军宠物的人。

english: You're her. The one who murdered the General's pet.
translation: 就是你。杀了将军宠物的人。

english: You're the fiend who killed Bouncer.
translation: 你就是杀了保镖的那个恶棍。

english: You're the guy who beat Bouncer, amazing!
translation: 你就是打败保镖的家伙，太厉害了！

english: That makes you a champion to many, but you'd better get out of here while you still can. General Khazard liked that brute.
translation: 这让很多人视你为英雄，但你最好趁还能走就离开这里。卡扎德将军很喜欢那个畜生。

english: Hello stranger. Khazard's got some great fights lined up this week. I can't wait.
translation: 你好啊，陌生人。卡扎德这周安排了好几场精彩的打斗，我都等不及了。

english: You're alive, I thought Khazard's men had taken you.
translation: 你还活着，我还以为卡扎德的手下把你抓走了。

english: My son and husband are safe and recovering at home. Without you they would certainly be dead. I am truly grateful for your service.
translation: 我的儿子和丈夫都安全了，正在家里休养。没有你，他们肯定已经死了。我真心感谢你的帮助。

english: All I can offer in return is material wealth. Please take these coins as a sign of my gratitude.
translation: 我唯一能回报的只有物质财富。请收下这些金币，作为我感激之情的象征。

english: Oh hello my dear. My husband and son are resting while I wait for the cart fixer.
translation: 哦，你好，亲爱的。我丈夫和儿子在休息，我在等修推车的人。

english: I hope he's not too long.
translation: 希望他不会太久。

english: Thanks again for everything.
translation: 再次感谢你所做的一切。

english: Oh I wish this broken cart was my only problem. sob.. I've got to find my family.. sob.
translation: 唉，我真希望这辆破损的推车是我唯一的问题……呜……我得找到我的家人……呜……

english: I need another competition pass.
translation: 我还需要一张比赛通行证。

english: Hmmm. It's a good job they sent us spares.
translation: 嗯。还好他们给我们留了备用的。

english: There you go. Try not to lose that one.
translation: 给你。这次可别再弄丢了。

english: No, it takes preparation to win fishing competitions.
translation: 不，赢得钓鱼比赛是需要准备的。

english: Maybe that's where we are going wrong when we try fishing?
translation: 也许这就是我们钓鱼时总是搞砸的原因？

english: Probably.
translation: 很可能。

english: Maybe we should talk to that old Jack fella near the competition, everyone seemed to be ranting about him.
translation: 也许我们该去和比赛场地附近那个叫杰克的老家伙聊聊，大家好像都在谈论他。

english: I have one here.
translation: 我这里有一张。

english: Move on through. Talk to Bonzo to enter the competition.
translation: 请进。去找邦佐报名参加比赛吧。

english: It is vonderful! Ze vomen are beautiful und ze nights are long!
translation: 真是太棒了！女人漂亮，夜晚漫长！

english: Luck haz notsing to do vith it it is all in ze technique.
translation: 运气跟这个没关系，全靠技巧。

english: My doctor told me to take up ein velaxing hobby. Vhen I am stressed I tend to get ein little..
translation: 医生让我找个放松的爱好。我压力大的时候会有点……

english: Hello young man! Come to visit old Grandpa Jack? I can tell ye stories for sure. I used to be the best fisherman these parts have seen!
translation: 你好啊，年轻人！是来看望杰克爷爷的吗？我当然可以给你讲讲故事。我曾经可是这一带最棒的渔夫！

english: Are you entering the fishing competition?
translation: 你要参加钓鱼比赛吗？

english: Ah... the Hemenster fishing competition...
translation: 啊……赫门斯特的钓鱼比赛……

english: I know all about that... I won that four years straight! I'm too old for that lark now though...
translation: 我可太了解了……我连续赢了四年！不过现在我已经老得玩不动这种把戏了……

english: I don't suppose you could give me any hints?
translation: 您能不能给我点提示？

english: Well, you sometimes get these really big fish in the water just by the outflow pipes.
translation: 嗯，有时候你会在排水管附近的水里钓到特别大的鱼。

english: I think they're some kind of carp...
translation: 我觉得是某种鲤鱼……

english: I used to get those from McGrubor's wood, north of here. Just dig around in the red vines up there but be careful of the guard dogs.
translation: 我以前是从北边的麦格鲁伯树林弄到那些的。就在那里的红色藤蔓周围挖一挖，但要小心守卫犬。

english: There's this weird creepy guy who says he's not a vampyre using that spot. He keeps winning too.
translation: 有个怪异的家伙，他说自己不是吸血鬼，总占着那个位置。他也老是赢。

english: Ahh well, I'm sure you'll find something to put him off. After all, there must be a kitchen around here with some garlic in it, perhaps in Seers Village or Ardougne. If he's pretending to be a vampyre then he can pretend to be scared of garlic!
translation: 啊，好吧，我相信你一定能找到办法赶走他。毕竟，这附近肯定有个厨房，里面有大蒜，也许在先知村或者阿多尼城。如果他假装是吸血鬼，那他也可以假装怕大蒜！

english: You're right! Thanks Jack!
translation: 你说得对！谢谢杰克！

english: That's less competition for me then.
translation: 那我的竞争对手就少了。

english: Why you young whippersnapper! If I was twenty years younger I'd show you something that's for sure!
translation: 你这不知天高地厚的小子！我要是年轻二十岁，肯定让你见识见识！

english: But young man, you have your own. I'll not sell you mine when you already have one!
translation: 但是年轻人，你自己有啊。你既然已经有了，我可不会把我的卖给你！

english: Hey, you need to pay to enter the competition first! Only 5 gp entrance fee!
translation: 嘿，你得先付钱才能参加比赛！入场费只要5金币！

english: Enter the great Hemenster fishing competition!
translation: 快来参加盛大的赫门斯特钓鱼比赛！

english: Only 5gp entrance fee!
translation: 入场费仅需5金币！

english: I'll enter the competition please.
translation: 我要报名参加比赛。

english: Ok, nearly everyone is in their place already. You fish in the spot by the willow tree, and the Sinister Stranger, you fish by the pipes.
translation: 好的，差不多所有人都就位了。你在柳树旁的位置钓鱼，而那位阴森的陌生人，你在管道旁边钓。

english: Arrgh! WHAT is that GHASTLY smell??? I think I will move over here instead...
translation: 啊！这恶心的味道是什么？？我想我还是换到这边来吧……

english: Hmm. You'd better go and take the area by the pipes then.
translation: 嗯。那你最好去管道那边钓吧。

english: No thanks, I'll just watch the fun.
translation: 不了，谢谢，我看看热闹就好。

english: Ok, we've got all the fishermen! It's time to roll!
translation: 好了，所有渔夫都到齐了！比赛开始！

english: You've already paid, you don't need to pay me again!
translation: 你已经付过钱了，不用再付了！

english: Ewww - it's a smelly sewage pipe.
translation: 呃——这是一根臭烘烘的下水管道。

english: So you're calling it quits here for now?
translation: 所以你现在打算收手了？

english: Yes I'll compete again another day.
translation: 是的，我改天再来比。

english: Ok, I'll see you again.
translation: 好的，下次见。

english: Actually I'll go back and catch some more.
translation: 其实我想回去再钓几条。

english: So how are you doing so far?
translation: 那你现在钓得怎么样了？

english: I caught some fish! Here...
translation: 我钓到了一些鱼！给你……

english: And the winner is... The stranger in black!
translation: 获胜者是……那位穿黑衣的陌生人！

english: I have this big fish.
translation: 我钓到了这条大鱼。

english: Is it enough to win?
translation: 这够赢了吗？

english: Well, we'll just wait till time is up.
translation: 嗯，我们得等到时间结束。

english: We have a new winner! The heroic-looking person who was fishing by the pipes has caught the biggest carp I've seen since Grandpa Jack used to compete!
translation: 我们有了新的获胜者！那位在管道旁钓鱼、看起来英姿飒爽的人，钓到了自杰克爷爷参赛以来我见过的最大的鲤鱼！

english: I think I might still be able to find a bigger fish.
translation: 我想我可能还能找到更大的鱼。

english: Ok, good luck!
translation: 好的，祝你好运！

english: I don't feel like a champ...
translation: 我感觉不像个冠军……

english: Why not champ?
translation: 为什么不像，冠军？

english: I lost my fishing trophy...
translation: 我把我的钓鱼大赛奖杯弄丢了……

english: Is that all chump? Don't worry, I have a spare!
translation: 就这点小事啊，笨蛋？别担心，我还有个备用的！

english: Well done! That's brilliant! Do you have the trophy with you?
translation: 干得好！太棒了！奖杯你带在身上了吗？

english: Yep, I have it right here!
translation: 是的，就在我这儿！

english: Oh! It's even more shiny and gold than I thought possible...
translation: 哦！它比我想象的还要闪亮和金光闪闪……

english: You've done us proud. Thank you [lad/lass]. I think we can now trust you enough to let you in...
translation: 你让我们感到骄傲。谢谢你，[lad/lass]。我想我们现在足够信任你，可以让你进去了……

english: In where?
translation: 进哪里？

english: Why the tunnel of course! You may now come and go freely, avoiding the wolves and dangers of the cold, high mountain. You could even stop in for a beer or two!
translation: 当然是隧道啦！你现在可以自由进出，避开狼群和高山上的严寒危险。你甚至可以进来喝一两杯啤酒！

english: Excellent. That will come in most handy.
translation: 太好了。这将会非常有用。

english: Hi there, Veldaban! Have you got any new quests for me?
translation: 嘿，维达班！有什么新任务给我吗？

english: Not at the moment, no, [player name].
translation: 目前没有，[player name]。

english: That's too bad, I'm starting to get a little bored.
translation: 真可惜，我开始觉得有点无聊了。

english: Then perhaps you should try your hand at the Hemenster Fishing Contest.
translation: 那你或许该去试试赫门斯特的钓鱼大赛。

english: Er, that's a bit of a random suggestion. Why would I go on a fishing contest?
translation: 呃，这建议有点莫名其妙。我为什么要去参加钓鱼大赛？

english: We dwarves don't know much about fishing, but a couple of our brothers at White Wolf Mountain want to win the competition.
translation: 我们矮人对钓鱼不太了解，但我们在白狼山的几个兄弟想赢得比赛。

english: Why would they want to do that if they don't know much about fishing?
translation: 既然他们不太懂钓鱼，为什么还想赢？

english: Ah, you see, the trophy is made of pure gold. And these dwarves in particular love gold.
translation: 啊，你看，奖杯是纯金做的。而这些矮人特别爱金子。

english: Alright, sounds interesting, I'll check it out. White Wolf mountain, you said?
translation: 好吧，听起来挺有意思，我去看看。你说的是白狼山？

english: Yes, you can speak to a dwarf at either side of the mountain.
translation: 是的，你可以在山的两边各找一个矮人谈谈。

english: [player name]! Have you heard?
translation: [player name]！你听说了吗？

english: You mean, half the world has suddenly become a sailor?
translation: 你是说，半个世界突然都变成水手了？

english: No, not that. It's the Red Axe!
translation: 不，不是那个。是红斧！

english: What have those grumpy little guys done now?
translation: 那些脾气暴躁的小家伙又干了什么？

english: They've left the city! They were already boycotting the trade floor, but now they've completely left the city.
translation: 他们已经离开了城市！他们之前就在抵制交易大厅，但现在他们彻底离开了城市。

english: Oh dear, is that serious?
translation: 哦天哪，这严重吗？

english: It's never happened before! At the moment it's unclear yet if they've left the Consortium as well. The directors are in turmoil!
translation: 以前从没发生过！目前还不清楚他们是否也退出了联合商会。董事们一片混乱！

english: Well... I may require your services again. Are you interested in hearing more?
translation: 嗯……我可能又需要你的帮助了。你有兴趣听听吗？

english: Very interested!
translation: 非常有兴趣！

english: We need some more information about what the Red Axe is up to.
translation: 我们需要更多关于红斧动向的情报。

english: Are you asking me to... spy on them? Isn't that treason?
translation: 你是要我去……监视他们？那不是叛国吗？

english: The other directors of the Consortium don't think so and are likely to expel the Red Axe completely anyway.
translation: 联合商会的其他董事不这么认为，而且他们很可能无论如何都会把红斧彻底驱逐出去。

english: So where would you like me to go?
translation: 那你希望我去哪里？

english: That's the problem. We don't know where they moved their headquarters to. But we may have one lead...
translation: 问题就在这里。我们不知道他们把总部搬到了哪里。但我们可能有一条线索……

english: There is a dwarf, all the way to the northeast in Keldagrim-East. He talks about kebabs a lot. Don't suppose you've met him?
translation: 有一个矮人，在凯尔达格林城东边最远的地方。他老是谈论烤肉串。你该不会见过他吧？

english: Yes, I do believe I have. Smashed glasses, wrecked house? Poor personal hygiene standards? Brother or cousin to that other drunken dwarf?
translation: 是的，我确实觉得我见过。打碎的玻璃杯，被砸烂的房子？糟糕的个人卫生习惯？是那个醉醺醺的矮人的兄弟还是表亲？

english: That's him, poor fellow. He didn't always used to be like that.
translation: 就是他，可怜的家伙。他以前不总是那样的。

english: No, I don't believe so.
translation: 不，我想我没见过。

english: He lives in his brother's house.
translation: 他住在他兄弟的房子里。

english: Or was it his cousin?
translation: 还是他表亲？

english: In any case, he's a bit of a drunk these days. Well, when I say a bit, he's actually smashed all the time.
translation: 总之，他最近有点酗酒。好吧，当我说有点的时候，其实他整天都烂醉如泥。

english: But he seems to know something about the Red Axe for some odd reason. He speaks of them sometimes in one of his many rants.
translation: 但出于某种奇怪的原因，他似乎知道一些关于红斧的事。他有时会在胡言乱语中提到他们。

english: Problem is, no one believes him. Everyone thinks he's completely mad. And perhaps they're right.
translation: 问题是，没人相信他。大家都觉得他完全疯了。也许他们是对的。

english: But if he does indeed know something about the Red Axe or where their headquarters may be, we need to find out.
translation: 但如果他真的知道一些关于红斧或他们总部位置的事，我们必须查清楚。

english: What do you say then, [player name]? Do you want to help the Black Guard with this?
translation: 你觉得呢，[player name]？你愿意帮黑卫队处理这件事吗？

english: Sounds like just the job for me!
translation: 听起来正合我意！

english: Excellent, good luck to you in your quest! May Guthix protect you!
translation: 太好了，祝你好运！愿古斯保佑你！

english: Well, here I am... at the drunken dwarf's relative's residence, who is also drunken. I wonder what drunken tales he can tell me.
translation: 好吧，我到了……那个醉醺醺的矮人亲戚的住处，他亲戚也醉醺醺的。不知道他能给我讲些什么醉话。

english: No, I try to stay away from drunken dwarves.
translation: 不，我尽量远离醉醺醺的矮人。

english: Although I wish they would try to stay away from me too...
translation: 虽然我希望他们也尽量远离我……

english: Very well. Come back when you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。等你改变主意了再回来。

english: Some other time, perhaps.
translation: 也许改天吧。

english: How goes the search for the Red Axe?
translation: 寻找红斧的进展如何？

english: Haven't found them yet, sorry.
translation: 还没找到他们，抱歉。

english: I need to know about the Red Axe...
translation: 我需要知道红斧的事……

english: THE RED AXE WILL COME FOR YOU!
translation: 红斧会来找你的！

english: What, what do you mean?
translation: 什么，你什么意思？

english: I don't know... I c-c-c-can't think shtraight when I'm *hic* sober.
translation: 我不知道……我我我我清醒的时候*嗝*脑子就不清醒。

english: You don't look very sober to me!
translation: 我看你一点都不清醒！

english: DON'T contradict me! Or I won't tell you about ehm... about the... whatever it is you wanted to know.
translation: 别反驳我！否则我就不告诉你呃……关于那个……你想知道的那件事。

english: Have you ever considered to stop drinking? It's bad for you.
translation: 你有没有想过戒酒？这对你不好。

english: I'll shtop, right after you get me shome of the good shtuff!
translation: 我会戒的，等你给我弄点好货来再说！

english: Did you get me shome of the good stuff yet?
translation: 你给我弄到好货了吗？

english: What wash that? *hic* No no no, this ish noooooo good! I want some of the REALLY good stuff.
translation: 那是什么？*嗝*不不不，这个不不不不不好！我要点真正的好货。

english: What's the REALLY good stuff then?
translation: 那真正的好货是什么？

english: Some of them original Kelda Stout! Ash blue ash the river! Ash strong ash ole Dondakan's rock. Ash foul tasting ash ash.
translation: 有些是原版的凯尔达黑啤酒！像河水一样灰蓝！像老东达坎之石一样烈。像灰一样难喝。

english: Hey, er, I don't think that's good for you.
translation: 嘿，呃，我觉得那对你不好。

english: I know, but get me shome of it anyway. 'ere, have a seed.
translation: 我知道，但还是给我弄点来吧。喏，拿个种子。

english: What am I supposed to do with a seed?
translation: 你给我种子干嘛？

english: You silly human! Silly shilly silly *hic* hman. You need FOUR seeds, and grow them into hops.
translation: 你这个傻人类！傻傻傻傻*嗝*人类。你需要四颗种子，然后把它们种成霍普斯。

english: Hop hop hop! *hic*
translation: 跳跳跳！*嗝*

english: Where do I get the other seeds then?
translation: 那我去哪里弄其他种子？

english: Some of me drinking buddies might have 'em. They're quite rare, you shee. Oh yesh, quite rare.
translation: 我的一些酒友可能有。它们很稀有，你明白吗。哦是的，非常稀有。

english: Drinking buddies. Yes, find me some drinking buddies. No, find the other seeds. Yes.
translation: 酒友。对，帮我找些酒友。不，找其他种子。对。

english: Right, I think what you're trying to say is... I need to find some other drunken dwarves, collect Kelda seeds from them until I have four, then grow them into hops so I can make Kelda stout.
translation: 好吧，我想你想说的是……我需要找其他醉醺醺的矮人，从他们那里收集凯尔达种子，直到集齐四颗，然后把它们种成霍普斯，这样我就能酿造凯尔达黑啤酒了。

english: You're awfully shmart for a human!
translation: 你作为一个人类，真是聪明得过分了！

english: Maybe that's just because I don't drink as much as you.
translation: 也许只是因为我没有你喝得那么多。

english: Jusht pop down to the Laughing Miner and get some, will you?
translation: 去欢笑矿工酒馆弄点来，行吗？

english: The Laughing Miner?
translation: 欢笑矿工酒馆？

english: It'sh the pub to the... er. North. No, shouth. South.
translation: 就是那个酒馆，在……呃。北边。不，南边。南边。

english: Got me my Kelda stout?
translation: 给我弄到凯尔达黑啤酒了吗？

english: Not yet, no. I'm still trying to collect all of the seeds.
translation: 还没呢。我还在收集所有种子。

english: I'm having some problems with the seeds...
translation: 我在种子方面遇到些问题……

english: Oh, you bothershome human. Here.
translation: 哦，你这个烦人的人类。给你。

english: Not yet, no. I need to grow my seeds into hops first.
translation: 还没呢。我得先把种子种成霍普斯。

english: Hold on a second there, I need your help!
translation: 等一下，我需要你的帮助！

english: Help, from me? You musht be more drunk than I am.
translation: 找我帮忙？你肯定比我醉得还厉害。

english: No, I try not to get drunk, it's not good for you. But I do need help in brewing some beer.
translation: 不，我尽量不喝醉，这对你不好。但我确实需要帮忙酿点啤酒。

english: Mmmm, beer.
translation: 嗯，啤酒。

english: I need to brew Kelda stout, but I haven't got enough seeds to grow the hops.
translation: 我需要酿造凯尔达黑啤酒，但我没有足够的种子来种霍普斯。

english: Mmmm, Kelda stout.
translation: 嗯，凯尔达黑啤酒。

english: Do you know where I can find any seeds?
