english: Hello there. I'm looking for some Kelda hop seeds.
translation: 你好。我在找一些凯尔达啤酒花种子。

english: Oh, we've got an expert here! Kelda shtout is delishious!
translation: 哦，我们这儿来了个专家！凯尔达黑啤酒超好喝的！

english: It sounds ghastly to me. But I want to brew some to help out, errr, a friend of mine.
translation: 听起来挺恶心的。但我想酿一些来帮帮，呃，我一个朋友。

english: Oh, I've got a sheed you might like to borrow!
translation: 哦，我有一颗种子可以借给你！

english: Borrow?? How can I borrow a seed? I can hardly give it back once I've grown it.
translation: 借？？我怎么能借一颗种子？等我种出来了我几乎没法还给你。

english: Then we've got no deal!
translation: 那就算了！

english: What if I offer you a drink?
translation: 要是我请你喝一杯呢？

english: Ah, err, are you offering?
translation: 啊，呃，你要请我吗？

english: I just thought I'd save myself the trouble of waiting for you to ask me this time.
translation: 我只是想省点麻烦，这次不用等你开口找我。

english: I've never ashked you for a drink in my life!
translation: 我这辈子从没找你要过酒喝！

english: No, but it seems just about everyone else has!
translation: 不，但好像其他所有人都找你要过！

english: Well it'sh hardly a big deal, ish it? We've got a huge shupply of dwarven shtouts right here.
translation: 哎呀这又没什么大不了的对吧？我们这儿有海量的矮人黑啤酒存货。

english: That's not the point!
translation: 这不是重点！

english: And a dwarven shtout against a Kelda hop seed? I'm not sure if that'sh a fair trade.
translation: 而且拿矮人黑啤酒跟凯尔达啤酒花种子比？我不确定这买卖划不划算。

english: Look!
translation: 听着！

english: Dwarven stout, here!
translation: 矮人黑啤酒，在这儿！

english: Now do you want it or not? I'm not asking you again!
translation: 你要不要？我可不会再问一遍！

english: Alright, you talked me into it.
translation: 好吧，你说服我了。

english: Hmm, that shtout was delicious... here, have my invaluable Kelda hop sheed now, it wash my lasht one.
translation: 嗯，那酒真好喝……来，拿着我宝贵的凯尔达啤酒花种子，这是我最后一个了。

english: Er, well, I was going to offer you a dwarven stout, but I seem to have left it in my other pants.
translation: 呃，好吧，我本来想给你一杯矮人黑啤酒的，但好像落在我另一条裤子口袋里了。

english: Haha, you make me laugh human!
translation: 哈哈，你这人类真逗！

english: Shtouts are just on the table over there, help yourshelf!
translation: 黑啤酒就在那边的桌子上，自便！

english: No wait, I want to borrow it after all.
translation: 不，等等，我还是想借那个种子。

english: You are going to give it back after you're done widdit, right?
translation: 你用完会还给我的，对吧？

english: Of course, of course! After I've grown my Kelda seeds into hops, then harvested the hops and brewed my Kelda stout... sure, I'll give you back your seed!
translation: 当然当然！等我把我那些凯尔达啤酒花种子种成霍普斯，然后收割霍普斯，再酿成我的凯尔达黑啤酒……没问题，我会把种子还给你的！

english: That'sh very deshent of you, human.
translation: 你这人类可真够意思。

english: Only too happy to help!
translation: 很乐意帮忙！

english: Hey, err... wait... wait a second! Hey, wait!
translation: 嘿，呃……等等……等一下！嘿，等等！

english: Err, yes?
translation: 呃，什么事？

english: How are you goin' to give me back my sheed once you've made the Kelda stout? You'll be too drunk to find your way back here!
translation: 等你酿好凯尔达黑啤酒后，你怎么把我的种子还回来？你到时候会醉得找不到回来的路！

english: Oh, don't worry... like I said, it's not for myself, it's for a friend.
translation: 哦，别担心……我说了，这不是给我自己喝的，是给一个朋友的。

english: That'sh alright then, here you go.
translation: 那好吧，给你。

english: I'm still looking for some Kelda hop seeds.
translation: 我还在找凯尔达啤酒花种子。

english: We don't serve that sort of brew here, this is a high class establishment!
translation: 我们这儿不卖那玩意儿，这可是高级场所！

english: Oh, I'm sorry... perhaps you can tell me where to get some then?
translation: 哦，抱歉……那你能告诉我哪里能弄到吗？

english: If you insist. You might want to try the Laughing Miner in East. If anyone is selling that, it would be them.
translation: 既然你坚持。你可以去东边的欢笑矿工试试。如果有人卖那东西，那一定是他们。

english: But I doubt it. Kelda stout is very rare these days. Fortunately.
translation: 但我怀疑。凯尔达黑啤酒现在很少见。幸好如此。

english: Alright, I'll check it out, thanks.
translation: 好的，我去看看，谢谢。

english: A good day to you, sir!
translation: 祝您愉快，先生！

english: Say, you know a lot about beer, right?
translation: 喂，你对啤酒很了解，对吧？

english: A fair bit if I say so myself, yes. What do you want to know?
translation: 要说的话我也算懂一些，没错。你想知道什么？

english: Do you know anything about Kelda stout?
translation: 你知道凯尔达黑啤酒吗？

english: Ah, very rare that is! Very rare indeed. This place doesn't stock it. Don't think the Laughing Miner does either.
translation: 啊，那可稀罕了！非常稀有。这里不卖。估计欢笑矿工也没有。

english: Yes, that's what I heard, so I'm going to brew it myself.
translation: 是的，我听说了，所以我打算自己酿。

english: Then you'll probably need some seeds!
translation: 那你大概需要一些种子！

english: Have you got any?
translation: 你有吗？

english: Have a toast to our good health with me and I'll tell you!
translation: 先跟我为健康干一杯，我就告诉你！

english: Drinking is bad for you, but I'll make an exception this time.
translation: 喝酒有害健康，但这次我就破例了。

english: Hurrah for the human!
translation: 为人类喝彩！

english: That was fun! Here, I've got one Kelda seed left. A sociable chap like you is more than welcome to it.
translation: 真好玩！给，我还剩一颗凯尔达啤酒花种子。像你这样喜欢交际的家伙，我很乐意把它给你。

english: So did you have any Kelda seeds?
translation: 所以你究竟有没有凯尔达种子？

english: Were you going to have a toast to our good health?
translation: 你是要和我为健康干杯吗？

english: I'd better ask the gardener for permission to use this patch first.
translation: 我最好先问问园丁能否使用这块地。

english: I need some help.
translation: 我需要帮助。

english: Yes, [player name]? What can a humble gardener like myself help you with?
translation: 怎么了，[player name]？我这样一个卑微的园丁能帮你什么吗？

english: I have four Kelda seeds here, but need some advice on growing them.
translation: 我有四颗凯尔达种子，但需要一些种植方面的建议。

english: Marvelous, those seeds are quite rare don't you know!
translation: 太棒了，那些种子很稀有，你知道吗？

english: First of all, you must remember that these seeds only grow underground. Sunlight is harmful to them, for some strange reason.
translation: 首先，你必须记住这些种子只在地下生长。出于某种奇怪的原因，阳光对它们有害。

english: There is a patch in the palace garden that you're more than welcome to use.
translation: 皇宫花园里有一块地，你完全可以用它。

english: Thanks! Is there anything else I need to know?
translation: 谢谢！还有其他需要注意的吗？

english: Just take care of the weed in the patch and plant your seeds. They'll grow into hops very quickly, if you're lucky. Kelda seeds have a remarkably fast grow rate.
translation: 只要清理掉地里的杂草，然后种下种子。如果运气好，它们会很快长成霍普斯。凯尔达种子生长速度非常快。

english: Thank you! Your advice is much appreciated!
translation: 谢谢！非常感谢你的建议！

english: I think I need some more help with this whole farming business.
translation: 我觉得我在整个农业方面还需要更多帮助。

english: Just get rid of the weeds in the patch, plant you seeds and wait for the hops to grow. The miracle of nature will do the rest!
translation: 只要除掉地里的杂草，种下种子，然后等待霍普斯生长。剩下的自然奇迹会完成！

english: Do I have to wait here all this time then?
translation: 那我必须一直在这儿等着吗？

english: Yes and no. Yes, you do have to wait, but no, you don't have to stay here. You can help out people in the city, for instance, there's always someone who needs help with an urgent job.
translation: 既是也不是。是的，你需要等待，但不一定非要待在这儿。你可以去帮助城里的人，比如，总有人急需帮忙干活。

english: You mean the mining companies? I did jobs for them, they're not very profitable.
translation: 你是说采矿公司？我帮他们干过活，不怎么赚钱。

english: No no, just people like shopkeepers and such, they're quite willing to teach you things in exchange for the jobs as well.
translation: 不不，就像店主这样的人，他们很愿意教你东西作为干活的回报。

english: But here, tell you what, I'll give you some seeds if you can deliver this letter to a friend in Falador.
translation: 不过这样吧，如果你能把这封信送到法拉多城的一个朋友那儿，我就给你一些种子。

english: Do I have to do that? I just want to grow my hops and get on with my quest for Veldaban.
translation: 我必须这么做吗？我只想种好我的霍普斯，继续为维尔达班完成任务。

english: Oh no, you don't have to do it all, I just thought you wanted something to do while you were waiting.
translation: 哦不，你不一定非得做，我只是觉得你在等待时找点事做。

english: Alright, I'll deliver that letter for you.
translation: 好吧，我帮你去送那封信。

english: Happy to hear that! His name is Elstan, he lives just south of Falador.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说！他叫埃尔斯坦，住在法拉多城以南。

english: I'll be right back!
translation: 我马上回来！

english: I'd rather just sit here and stare at this patch, thanks.
translation: 我宁愿就坐在这儿盯着这块地，谢谢。

english: Very well. That can be quite relaxing, actually, I often do it myself.
translation: 好吧。那其实挺放松的，我自己也常这么做。

english: Hello again, [player name]! Have you been able to deliver that letter yet?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]！你送出那封信了吗？

english: No, I haven't been to Falador yet, but I will soon.
translation: 还没，我还没去法拉多城，但很快会去的。

english: Much appreciated, [player name]!
translation: 非常感谢，[player name]！

english: No, I've decided not to deliver it after all.
translation: 不，我决定不送了。

english: Oh, I'm sad to hear that.
translation: 哦，听你这么说我很遗憾。

english: Oh well, I'll see if I can find someone else instead.
translation: 好吧，我看看能不能找别人。

english: No, sorry, I lost your letter.
translation: 不，抱歉，我把你的信弄丢了。

english: That's a little clumsy, [player name]! Here, I've got a copy, please deliver this one instead.
translation: 有点马虎啊，[player name]！给，我有一份副本，请送这份吧。

english: Hello there. Are you Elstan?
translation: 你好。你是埃尔斯坦吗？

english: Why yes, I am. Have I become that well known?
translation: 是的，我就是。我已经这么出名了吗？

english: Well, I've got a letter here from your friend in Keldagrim.
translation: 嗯，我这儿有你一个来自凯尔达格林城的朋友的信。

english: Ah, you mean Rind? Great to hear from the little fellow again. Can I see it please?
translation: 啊，你是说林德？很高兴又能听到那小家伙的消息。能让我看看吗？

english: Most enlightening. Please give him my regards next time you see him, I look forward to the next conference.
translation: 太有启发了。下次见到他请代我问候，我期待下一次会议。

english: I've delivered your letter to Elstan, he told me to give you his regards.
translation: 我已经把你的信送给了埃尔斯坦，他让我代他向你问好。

english: Wonderful, that's just wonderful! Here, have these two seeds as a reward. They may not be Kelda hop seeds, but you should be able to grow a decent amount of herbs with them.
translation: 太棒了，真是太好了！给你，这两颗种子作为奖励。它们可能不是凯尔达啤酒花种子，但你应该能用它们种出不少草药。

english: How are you getting along with growing your seeds into hops, [player name]?
translation: 你的种子种成霍普斯进展如何了，[player name]？

english: Hmm, I'm not sure... let me check the patch.
translation: 嗯，我不确定……让我看看那块地。

english: I've grown my seeds into hops, but I have no idea what to do with them. Can you turn them into stout for me please?
translation: 我已经把种子种成了霍普斯，但我不知道该怎么处理。你能帮我把它们酿成黑啤酒吗？

english: Haha, it doesn't quite work like that, I'm afraid!
translation: 哈哈，恐怕不是这么回事！

english: You will have to bring your hops to a brewery.
translation: 你得把你的霍普斯带到酿酒厂去。

english: Where's the nearest brewery then?
translation: 那最近的酿酒厂在哪儿？

english: Oh, there's one in Keldagrim-East, upstairs in the Laughing Miner. They brew their own beer they do.
translation: 哦，凯尔达格林城东区有一家，在欢笑矿工的楼上。他们自己酿啤酒。

english: How does it work though?
translation: 那具体怎么操作？

english: I'm sure someone there will be able to help you out, it's not my specialty you see.
translation: 我相信那里面有人能帮你，这可不是我的专长，你懂的。

english: Alright, thanks a lot!
translation: 好的，非常感谢！

english: I've grown my seeds into hops, but I seem to have mislaid them.
translation: 我把种子种成了霍普斯，但好像弄丢了。

english: Ah! Fortunately I found some hops after your recent harvest. Here, I believe this belongs to you.
translation: 啊！幸好你最近收获后我找到了一些霍普斯。给你，我相信这是你的。

english: I want my Kelda shtout!
translation: 我要我的凯尔达黑啤酒！

english: My hops still need fermenting, sorry.
translation: 我的霍普斯还在发酵，抱歉。

english: I'm brewing my hops into Kelda stout, but it seems to be taking an awfully long time.
translation: 我正在把霍普斯酿成凯尔达黑啤酒，但似乎要花很长时间。

english: Just have patience, my young friend! Have a wander around town, see if anyone has jobs for you!
translation: 耐心点，小朋友！在城里逛逛，看看有没有人需要帮忙！

english: I'm just so angry, my hops aren't fermenting at all. I want my Kelda stout!
translation: 我太生气了，我的霍普斯根本没发酵。我要我的凯尔达黑啤酒！

english: Now now, my young human friend! Are you sure about that?
translation: 好了好了，我的人类小朋友！你确定吗？

english: Perhaps you should go back to the brewery, I wouldn't be surprised if your stout has fermented by now.
translation: 也许你应该回酿酒厂看看，如果你的黑啤酒已经发酵好了，我也不会惊讶。

english: Just get rid of the weeds in the patch, plant your seeds and wait for the hops to grow. The miracle of nature will do the rest!
translation: 只要把田里的杂草除掉，种下种子，然后等待霍普斯生长就行了。剩下的交给大自然的奇迹！

english: Ask away, seeds are a subject I'm particularly interested in myself!
translation: 随便问吧，种子正是我特别感兴趣的话题！

english: Hmmmm...
If you do find some, though, be sure to come back here if you want to grow them into hops.
translation: 不过，如果你真的找到了一些，想种成霍普斯的话，一定要回到这里。

english: They're extremely rare and they can be grown only underground. Unfortunately, I don't know where to find them.
translation: 它们极其稀有，而且只能在地下种植。不幸的是，我不知道在哪里能找到它们。

english: Also, if you need a rake, you'll find one just south of here, I left it there 5 minutes ago.
translation: 另外，如果你需要耙子，在这南边就有一个，我五分钟前放在那儿的。

english: I'm sure someone there will be able to help you out, it's not my speciality you see.
translation: 我相信那里有人能帮你，因为这不是我的专长。

english: You will need to bring your hops to a brewery.
translation: 你需要把你的霍普斯带到酿酒厂去。

english: Just have patience, my young human friend! Have a wander around town, see if anyone has any jobs for you!
translation: 耐心点，我的人类小友！在镇上四处逛逛，看看有没有人给你活干！

english: Sorry, I've found no seeds recently.
translation: 抱歉，我最近没找到种子。

english: Well, I might have some for you, but you can't carry anything more.
translation: 嗯，我可能有一些给你，但你不能再拿更多东西了。

english: That's not good. Fortunately I have a copy, I'll give it you when you can carry it.
translation: 那可不好。幸好我有一份副本，等你能拿的时候我再给你。

english: This stout seems absolutely vile and disgusting. Besides, I'm supposed to bring it to my drunken, kebab obsessed friend.
translation: 这黑啤酒看起来又恶心又难喝。而且，我应该把它带给我那个醉醺醺、痴迷烤肉的朋友。

english: I'd like a Kelda stout please
translation: 请给我一杯凯尔达黑啤酒。

english: I don't think I'd be able to sell it to anyone.
translation: 我觉得我卖不出去。

english: Well, we don't stock them anymore, but some of our more frequent visitors may have some left.
translation: 呃，我们不再进货了，不过有些常客手里可能还留着一些。

english: Oh, they're easy enough to spot!
translation: 哦，他们很好认的！

english: It should. Although you might want to check White Wolf Mountain as well, the bar underneath it is quite popular too.
translation: 应该吧。不过你也可以去白狼山看看，山底下那家酒吧也挺受欢迎的。

english: Just look for the dwarves that like their drinks.
translation: 找那些爱喝酒的矮人就行了。

english: I may have some for you, but you don't seem to be able to carry it.
translation: 我可能还有一些可以给你，但你看起来好像拿不了。

english: They're not easy to come by... and I believe you already have one?
translation: 这东西不好找……而且我相信你已经有一个了？

english: Haven't got any on me, sorry.
translation: 我身上没有，抱歉。

english: Well hurry up! I'm dying of thirsht!
translation: 那就快点！我快渴死了！

english: I've got some Kelda stout right here. I just brewed it in the Laughing Miner!
translation: 我这里有些凯尔达黑啤酒。我刚在欢笑矿工酒馆酿的！

english: Now there'sh a good human, gimme that!
translation: 这才是个好人类，给我！

english: Are you sure? This is pretty bad stuff.
translation: 你确定？这东西挺难喝的。

english: You want to hear about the Red Kebabsh or what? I mean... the Red Axe.
translation: 你想听红烤肉的事还是什么？我是说……红斧。

english: Ooooh, THAT'sh the good shtuff!
translation: 哦哦，这才是好东西！

english: The Red Axe? You want to know about them, do you? Then let me tell you my tale. It is long and quite unforgettable...
translation: 红斧？你想知道他们的事，是吗？那就让我给你讲讲我的故事。很长，而且令人难忘……

english: A long time ago, quite a while ago, yes... I resigned from my mining company, the Magenta Accordion.
translation: 很久以前，有一阵子了，是的……我从我的采矿公司——品红手风琴辞职了。

english: The what? The Magenta Accordion? That's not a mining company!
translation: 什么？品红手风琴？那可不是采矿公司！

english: It is, it is! It's one of the many minor companies, not part of the Consortium.
translation: 是的，是的！它是众多小公司之一，不属于联合矿业。

english: Alright, if you say so...
translation: 好吧，既然你这么说……

english: Right, so I had just left my company. I'd had enough of slaving away in the mines and decided to become an explorer. Oh yes, like my cousin.
translation: 对，我刚离开公司。我受够了在矿里当奴隶，决定去当探险家。哦，就像我表弟那样。

english: I explored this old mine, you know, just south of Keldagrim. I think it's boarded up now. Some amazing things I saw there.
translation: 我探索了这个旧矿，你知道，就在凯尔达格林城以南。我想现在已经被封起来了。我在那里看到了一些神奇的东西。

english: First of all...
translation: 首先……

english: ...and then I nearly fell into the Abyss! But I...
translation: ……然后我差点掉进深渊！但我……

english: ...so I had to run for my life, but then...
translation: ……所以我不得不拼命逃跑，但然后……

english: ...pink dragons...
translation: ……粉色龙……

english: ...and I don't really remember anything after that. People think I'm a drunken fool.
translation: ……之后的事我真的不记得了。大家都觉得我是个醉鬼傻瓜。

english: That was very interesting! I'll ignore that part with the pink dragons though...
translation: 那非常有趣！不过我会忽略粉色龙那部分……

english: But I shall investigate that tunnel immediately! South of the cart station, just south of the carts to White Wolf mountain?
translation: 但我马上去调查那条隧道！在推车站南边，就在通往白狼山的推车南边？

english: If you shay sho... I just want to smash up shome shtuff now.
translation: 如果你这么说……我现在只想砸些东西。

english: I don't know anyshing about the Red Kebabs.
translation: 我对红烤肉一无所知。

english: But that tale you told me!
translation: 但你给我讲的那个故事！

english: I don't know what you're *hic* talking 'bout.
translation: 我不知道你在说*嗝*什么。

english: I think I'm on to something! Something about a disused mine tunnel southeast of town.
translation: 我觉得我发现了什么！关于镇东南边一条废弃的矿道的事。

english: Happy to hear that, [player name]! Please go and check it out!
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息，[player name]！请去查看一下！

english: Excuse me, can you tell me what's behind that boarded up tunnel to the south?
translation: 打扰一下，你能告诉我南边那条被封住的隧道后面是什么吗？

english: Why, that part of the mines hasn't been used in a long time. I don't rightly know what you would find behind there.
translation: 哎呀，那片矿区已经很久没用了。我真不知道后面会有什么。

english: I need to go through there. Can you open up the tunnel for me?
translation: 我需要过去。你能帮我打开隧道吗？

english: I don't have the authority to do that kind of thing.
translation: 我没有权力做那种事。

english: Then who do I talk to? I really need to get in.
translation: 那我该找谁？我真的需要进去。

english: I don't know. Perhaps you have an influential friend?
translation: 我不知道。也许你有位有影响力的朋友？

english: I really need to go through that tunnel.
translation: 我真的需要穿过那条隧道。

english: I can't help you, sorry.
translation: 我帮不了你，抱歉。

english: At least tell me who can, please?
translation: 至少告诉我谁能帮，好吗？

english: I don't know that either. Don't you have any influential friends in the city?
translation: 我也不知道。你在城里没有有影响力的朋友吗？

english: Ahoy up there! The mine cart station's closed, so please don't come down here.
translation: 喂，上面那位！矿车站关了，所以请别下来这里。

english: Watch out, sir! Don't want anything to run over your follower!
translation: 小心点，先生！可别让什么东西碾到你的随从！

english: Watch out, madam! Don't want anything to run over your follower!
translation: 小心点，女士！可别让什么东西碾到你的随从！

english: Yes sir? Can I help you at all?
translation: 是的，先生？有什么能帮您的吗？

english: Wait a shecond... WAIT a shecond! You're a human! I don't think you're allowed to use the carts.
translation: 等一哈……等一哈！你是个人类！我觉得你不能用这些矿车。

english: Maybe if you find another way into the city *hic*, maybe you can speak to someone and they'll let you.
translation: 也许你找别的路进城*嗝*，跟里面的人说说，他们可能会让你用。

english: Yes m'am? Can I help you at all?
translation: 是的，女士？有什么能帮您的吗？

english: You don't seem fit to ride mine carts, I'm afraid!
translation: 你看起来不适合坐矿车，恐怕不行！

english: Well... I could have taken you to Keldagrim, but I don't think you'd fit in right now.
translation: 嗯……我本来可以带你去凯尔达格林城的，但我觉得你现在这样子不太合适。

english: The grand capital of all the dwarven realm!
translation: 整个矮人王国的伟大首都！

english: Not right now! That's a special privilege!
translation: 现在不行！那可是特殊待遇！

english: I'm sorry, madam, but I don't believe you can hold the ticket.
translation: 抱歉，女士，但我觉得你拿不了这张票。

english: Are you shure you haven't had too mush to drink yourshelf? Hopsh? Kelda sheeds? I haven't a clue what you mean.
translation: 你确定你自己没喝太多吗？蛇麻草？凯尔达种子？我完全不知道你在说什么。

english: Whaaaat? What kind of queshtion ish that to ask?
translation: 什——么？这算什么问题？

english: What'sh thish brewing you shpeak of? Beer flowsh down from the great beer mountain. When the beersnow meltsh, you know.
translation: 你说的这个酿造是什么？啤酒是从伟大的啤酒山上流下来的。你知道的，当啤酒雪融化的时候。

english: Well, shince you're quite obvioushly drunk, you might want to go down the tunnel a lil' bit. Plenty of drunken dwarvesh down there who might help.
translation: 嗯，既然你明显喝醉了，你也许可以往隧道里走一小段。下面有很多喝醉的矮人，他们可能会帮忙。

english: I think I may have a good lead now!
translation: 我想我现在有了一个好线索！

english: But I need some boarding removed, I need to go through some disused mine cart tunnels.
translation: 但我需要移除一些封板，我需要穿过一些废弃的矿车隧道。

english: I see... I cannot make that decision, I'm afraid. Speak to the director of [company name], he may be able to help you.
translation: 我明白了……恐怕我不能做这个决定。去找[company name]的主管谈谈，他也许能帮你。

english: Ah yes, I'm a member now, they must be able to help!
translation: 啊，是的，我现在是成员了，他们一定能帮忙！

english: Hello [player name]! Have you seen the statue? It looks beautiful! It's a pity it's been overshadowed by the departure of the Red Axe.
translation: 你好，[player name]！你看到雕像了吗？它真漂亮！可惜被红斧的离开抢了风头。

english: Can you help me with a boarded up tunnel?
translation: 你能帮我处理一条被封住的隧道吗？

english: Ah, and what would be lurking behind this particular tunnel?
translation: 啊，这条隧道后面藏着什么？

english: I think it leads to something that might be related to the Red Axe.
translation: 我觉得它通向可能与红斧有关的东西。

english: The Red Axe!
translation: 红斧！

english: This is indeed an important issue. They've gone too far this time. A major company willingly leaving the Consortium has never happened before.
translation: 这确实是个重要问题。这次他们太过分了。一家大公司自愿离开联合矿业，以前从未发生过。

english: Can you help me get the boarding removed then?
translation: 那你能帮我移除封板吗？

english: Forthwith, [player name], forthwith! I'll order the removal at once!
translation: 立刻，[player name]，立刻！我马上下令移除！

english: Thanks! I'll investigate the tunnel immediately!
translation: 谢谢！我马上去调查隧道！

english: And? What of the Red Axe?
translation: 然后呢？红斧怎么样了？

english: I will have lots to tell you soon, Veldaban!
translation: 我很快会有很多事要告诉你，维尔达班！

english: Happy to hear that!
translation: 很高兴听到这个消息！

english: I'm deep underground now, but how am I supposed to get across here?
translation: 我现在在地下深处，但我该怎么过去？

english: This junction is blocked. I'd better go back to the start and find some way to make it go left or right.
translation: 这个岔路被堵住了。我最好回到起点，想办法让它向左或向右。

english: I've come to a dead end. I'd better get back to the start.
translation: 我走到了死胡同。我最好回到起点。

english: What's the new plan?
translation: 新计划是什么？

english: Me dead human!
translation: 我死了，人类！

english: No, not yet. He may still prove useful to us.
translation: 不，还没。他可能对我们还有用。

english: My axe on his head would be more useful!
translation: 我的斧头砍在他头上更有用！

english: Forget about the human and the statue for now. Our experiments are more important.
translation: 暂时忘掉那个人类和雕像。我们的实验更重要。

english: We are nearly ready with our next test.
translation: 我们快准备好下一次测试了。

english: More little fire lookers?
translation: 更多的小火苗观察者？

english: This time they'll survive, I hope.
translation: 这次我希望它们能活下来。

english: Our slaves are too weak, it will never work.
translation: 我们的奴隶太弱了，这永远不会成功。

english: Yes, things would have been so much easier with the statue.
translation: 是的，如果有雕像的话，事情会容易得多。

english: It was a great plan! Sabotaging the base of the statue and bribing that boatman to crash into it!
translation: 那是个好计划！破坏雕像底座，贿赂那个船夫让他撞上去！

english: My axe on her head would be more useful!
translation: 我的斧头砍在她头上更有用！

english: And we would have gotten away with it too, if it wasn't for that pesky human.
translation: 要不是那个讨厌的人类，我们本来能得手的。

english: Pesky human, huh? Well, I think I have enough info now. I'd better explore the rest of these mines.
translation: 讨厌的人类，嗯？好吧，我觉得我掌握的信息够多了。我最好探索一下矿区的其他地方。

english: I should stay and listen for a bit longer...
translation: 我应该再待一会儿，多听一些……

english: Looks like another chasm I need to cross.
translation: 看起来又是一个需要跨越的深渊。

english: I should explore this room fully before moving on. I should be able to find out a little bit more.
translation: 在继续前进之前，我应该彻底探索这个房间。我应该能发现更多信息。

english: Statistical data, salary structures, shopping lists... no, I don't think there's anything interesting here.
translation: 统计数据、薪资结构、购物清单……不，我觉得这里没什么有趣的。

english: What the Guthix is this? Another chasm? And even more tracks!
translation: 这他妈的是什么？又一个深渊？还有更多的轨道！

english: There's the Red Axe director again!
translation: 又是那个红斧主管！

english: How did the experiment go?
translation: 实验怎么样了？

english: The test subjects are still alive, director. They will suffice as soldiers.
translation: 测试对象还活着，主管。他们足以充当士兵。

english: Excellent! We are improving. Laneel!
translation: 太好了！我们在进步。拉尼尔！

english: Return to Arposandra and tell your superiors we've had a partial success.
translation: 回到阿波桑德拉，告诉你的上级我们取得了部分成功。

english: I will tell them, but I'd like to see some of your test subjects first, if I may.
translation: 我会告诉他们，但如果可以的话，我想先看看你的一些测试对象。

english: Look, here comes the first group!
translation: 看，第一组来了！

english: Behold the power of Zamorak!
translation: 见证萨莫拉克的力量！

english: Chaos dwarves!!!
translation: 混沌矮人！！！

english: I must tell Veldaban!!!
translation: 我必须告诉维尔达班！！！

english: Lookings likes we's finding da spying creatures'ies!
translation: 看来我们找到了那个偷窥的小东西！

english: Nooooooo!
Er, what? Where am I? Errrrr... I must tell Veldaban... something. Yes... ehm. I don't remember what though. Errr...
translation: 呃，什么？我在哪？呃呃呃……我必须告诉维达班……一些事。对……嗯。但我记不起是什么了。呃呃……

english: Veldaban, I must tell you something incredibly important!
translation: 维达班，我必须告诉你一件非常重要的事！

english: I must tell you about... about...
translation: 我必须告诉你关于……关于……

english: ...about my incredible craving for a kebab. Mmm, kebabs. A kebab and a beer, that sounds great right now.
translation: ……关于我超想吃烤肉的事。嗯，烤肉。现在来份烤肉和一杯啤酒，听起来太棒了。

english: Errr, are you alright? Don't you have any important information about the Red Axe?
translation: 呃，你还好吗？难道你没有关于红斧的重要情报吗？

english: Mmm, yes, I'll be perfectly alright... just after I've had my beer and a kebab. Yes. I'll have a beer and a kebab in the Laughing Miner. Yum!
translation: 嗯，是的，我完全没事……只要我喝上啤酒、吃上烤肉就行。对。我要去欢笑矿工酒馆喝杯啤酒、吃份烤肉。好吃！

english: Watch out kebabs, I come for you!
translation: 烤肉们小心，我来找你们了！

english: Poor [player name], I think you've been bewitched.
translation: 可怜的[player name]，我想你是被施了魔法了。

english: [player name], I thought you had something important to tell me?
translation: [player name]，我以为你有重要的事要告诉我？

english: Yes... yes... Red... ehm. Red...
translation: 是的……是的……红……呃。红……

english: Red Kebab? Red Ale?
translation: 红烤肉？红艾尔啤酒？

english: I will feast on kebabs and beer! Ahahaha!
translation: 我要大吃烤肉大喝啤酒！啊哈哈哈！

english: I knew it were you matey! 'Ere, have some of the good stuff!
translation: 我就知道是你，伙计！来，给你点好东西！

english: Very kind ob you, [player name]!
translation: 你真是太好了，[player name]！

english: Tell us another tale, [player name]!
translation: 再给我们讲个故事吧，[player name]！

english: Tell us more about your kebabs!
translation: 再跟我们说说你的烤肉吧！

english: Haha, kebabs!
translation: 哈哈，烤肉！

english: That was fun! Here, I've got one Kelda seed left. A sociable lady like you is more than welcome to it.
translation: 真好玩！喏，我还剩一颗凯尔达啤酒花种子。像你这样友善的女士，我很乐意送给你。

english: A good day to you, madam!
translation: 女士，祝您今天愉快！

english: Right, these kebabsh, right? *hic* A whole g-g-group of kebabs came marching in! I'm telling you! Marching in line!
translation: 好吧，这些烤肉，对吧？*嗝* 一整群烤肉列队走进来了！我跟你说！排着队走进来！

english: Tee hee hee!
translation: 嘻嘻嘻！

english: And then, I'll tell you... Then! Ehm...
translation: 然后，我告诉你……然后！嗯……

english: Then I'll have another drink!
translation: 然后我再喝一杯！

english: Hahaha, idiot!
translation: 哈哈哈，白痴！

english: Let's see now... Can you get me 4 empty pots in the next 17 minutes?
translation: 让我想想……你能在接下来的17分钟内给我弄来4个空罐子吗？

english: Let's see now... Can you get me 5 bronze arrows in the next 20 minutes?
translation: 让我想想……你能在接下来的20分钟内给我弄来5支青铜箭吗？

english: Let's see now... Can you get me 3 pieces of rope in the next 14 minutes?
translation: 让我想想……你能在接下来的14分钟内给我弄来3根绳子吗？

english: Did you get me 3 empty pots, [player name]? I don't really have an awful lot of time anymore.
translation: [player name]，你帮我弄到3个空罐子了吗？我真的没多少时间了。

english: Let's see now... Can you get me 3 bronze arrows in the next 14 minutes?
translation: 让我想想……你能在接下来的14分钟内给我弄来3支青铜箭吗？

english: Let's see now... Can you get me 5 empty oil lamps in the next 20 minutes?
translation: 让我想想……你能在接下来的20分钟内给我弄来5个空油灯吗？

english: Let's see now... Can you get me 4 shears in the next 17 minutes?

english: I think... I think I must have. It's so hard to remember.

english: I don't know, I think something terrible has happened, but everyone seems to think I'm an idiot for some reason...

english: What's going on here? I see a lot of farming patches with nothing growing in them.

english: No, one has just had them installed. One has had the most marvellous idea to bring renewed happiness to one's own dearest husband.

english: One? I'm not sure I understand you-
translation: 本宫？我不太明白你的意思——

english: Oh dear - the common classes, oh how they fill one with intolerable levels of exasperation, I swear to be most true.

english: Ri-ight ... if you say so, my lady. I'll be off then, if you don't mind-

english: Yes, be off with you, before I call the guards.

english: No problem, sorry to have bothered you.
