english: Peasant - WAIT!!!
translation: 农民——等等！！！

english: Are you speaking to me?
translation: 你是在跟我说话？

english: Who else would I be speaking to, you funny little fool? Of course you.
translation: 不跟你说话还能跟谁说话，你这可笑的小傻瓜？当然是你。

english: Well for a moment there I thought there was a dog around here somewhere...
translation: 嗯，刚才我还以为附近有条狗呢……

english: Oh yes, sarcasm - how amusing. No, no, peasant - I have a question to ask of you, and you are required to answer.
translation: 哦对，挖苦人——真有趣。不，不，农民——本宫有个问题要问你，你必须回答。

english: Well, seeing as you put it so nicely...
translation: 好吧，既然您这么客气……

english: Do you know of anyone who might have some degree of horticultural experience?
translation: 你知道有谁懂得园艺吗？

english: Well, hurry off then. You are of no use to me.
translation: 那赶紧走吧。你对我没用。

english: Oh, marvellous! Peasant, I hereby order you to assist me with a little project I have planned.
translation: 哦，太棒了！农民，本宫命令你协助本宫的一个小计划。

english: You'll have to ask me nicely first.
translation: 你得先好好求我才行。

english: Oh, what I have to deal with these days - to think this is what being a Queen has become. Very well then: would you ... good sir help me with a little project of mine?
translation: 哦，如今本宫都得这样低声下气——想想当女王竟落到这地步。好吧：这位……好先生，您愿意帮本宫一个小忙吗？

english: Oh dear, what a pathetic creature you are. One would give you a list, but you do not appear to have room enough to carry it.
translation: 哦天哪，你这生物真可怜。本宫本想给你一张清单，但你似乎没有足够的地方携带。

english: I would be happy to help someone who is so in touch with the people.
translation: 我很乐意帮助一位如此亲民的人。

english: Ah, more sarcasm - wonderful. Well, it is nice to have a master of the fine art of gardening to assist me; in the absence of any such person, I gladly accept your service.
translation: 啊，又是挖苦——精彩。嗯，有一位园艺大师来协助本宫真是太好了；既然没有这样的人，本宫欣然接受你的服务。

english: I'm not sure if that's a compliment or not. Anyway, what would you like me to do, and what do I get out of it?
translation: 我不确定这是夸奖还是挖苦。总之，您要我做什么？我又能得到什么？

english: To answer your first question, you have noticed the new farming patches that we have had installed around us. We wish to grow many varied and exotic plants in them, to bring happiness back to my husband.
translation: 回答你的第一个问题，你注意到了我们周围新安装的那些农业用地。我们希望在里面种植各种奇花异草，让本宫的丈夫重新快乐起来。

english: King Roald?
translation: 罗尔德国王？

english: The very same, and that's 'His Most Royal Majesty' to you. Now we come to the plants that one wishes you to grow in these patches. I would tell you all at once, but I fear that your small mind would not cope.
translation: 正是，而且你要称呼他为“陛下”。现在说说本宫希望你在这些地里种什么植物。本宫本想一次告诉你，但恐怕你那小脑袋消化不了。

english: Thanks, I'm sure. So tell me Queeny, how do I know which plants I am to get for you?
translation: 多谢夸奖。那么告诉我，女王陛下，我怎么知道要给你弄哪些植物？

english: I have given you a list of the items that I need in each patch. One is sure that you will know how to use the list with each patch to find out what needs to go in each one. There is one more thing, though.
translation: 本宫给了你一个清单，上面列出了每个地里需要的东西。本宫相信你知道如何用这个清单对照每块地，找出需要种什么。不过还有一件事。

english: One listens with bated breath...
translation: 本宫洗耳恭听……

english: Obtaining the seeds may prove difficult if you go about it by hacking and slashing everything that moves. No, to gather these items you will need to employ a finer tactic; the art of persuasion.
translation: 如果你靠砍砍杀杀来获取种子，恐怕很难。不，要收集这些东西，你需要用更高明的策略：说服的艺术。

english: You must go at once and converse with the wise old man who is said to dwell in Draynor Village; he may guide you in mastering this delicate and sophisticated ability.
translation: 你必须立刻前往德雷诺村，去找传说中住在那里的一位老智者；他或许能指导你掌握这种精妙的能力。

english: I'd rather jump off the docks at Port Sarim.
translation: 我宁愿从沙林港的码头上跳下去。

english: Well don't allow one to delay you - it is probably the most constructive thing you could do with your life, to be honest.
translation: 那就别让本宫耽误你——说实话，这可能是你这辈子能做的最有意义的事了。

english: Can I have another list?
translation: 我能再要一张清单吗？

english: Take better care with this one.
translation: 这次好好保管。

english: How am I supposed to move statues all the way here?
translation: 我怎么能把雕像一路运到这里？

english: You use the dormant object that lies between your ears, that's how. A statue may be far too heavy to carry, but simplicity itself to push.
translation: 用你耳朵之间那个沉睡的东西，就这么办。雕像可能太重搬不动，但推起来却很简单。

english: Push?
translation: 推？

english: Yes peasant, push. One would give you something to help with this task, but you do not appear to have room enough to carry it.
translation: 对，农民，推。本宫本想给你点东西帮忙，但你似乎没有足够的地方携带。

english: Yes peasant, push. Here - take this trolley. You can use it to push the statues here.
translation: 对，农民，推。给——拿着这辆手推车。你可以用它把雕像推过来。

english: What I am supposed to be getting again?
translation: 我到底要弄什么来着？

english: Haven't you got that list I gave you?
translation: 你没拿我给你的那张清单吗？

english: Err ... no ... I seem to have lost it.
translation: 呃……不……我好像弄丢了。

english: Oh dear, what a pathetic creature you are. One would give you another list, but you do not appear to have room enough to carry it.
translation: 哦天哪，你这生物真可怜。本宫本想再给你一张清单，但你似乎没有足够的地方携带。

english: Oh dear, what a pathetic creature you are. Here, have another one.
translation: 哦天哪，你这生物真可怜。给你，再拿一张。

english: Will these patches need much in the way of watering?
translation: 这些地需要很多水吗？

english: Well, you are supposed to be the gardener here, but I would say not. One had the soil imported from an extremely fertile area at great cost - watering should not be necessary one would have thought.
translation: 嗯，按理说你才是园丁，不过本宫觉得不需要。本宫花了大价钱从一块非常肥沃的地区进口了土壤——浇水应该是不必要的，本宫是这么想的。

english: Very good peasant, thank you for showing one that, but one has given you a job to do. Do it.
translation: 很好，农民，谢谢你展示给本宫看，但本宫已经给了你任务。去做吧。

english: I want you to place a statue of Saradomin there.
translation: 本宫要你在那里放一座萨拉多明雕像。

english: I want you to place a statue of a Misthalin king there.
translation: 本宫要你在那里放一座米斯塔林国王的雕像。

english: I want you to grow yellow orchids there.
translation: 本宫要你在那里种黄色兰花。

english: I want you to grow pink orchids there.
translation: 本宫要你在那里种粉色兰花。

english: Queen Ellamaria has sent me to seek your guidance.
translation: 是埃拉玛利亚女王派我来向您求教的。

english: Ellamaria? Well, if you're in her service my guidance is this: do the fastest run that you can off the shortest pier you can find.
translation: 埃拉玛利亚？哼，你要是为她效劳，我的建议就是：找最短的码头，用最快的速度跑下去。

english: You know Queen Ellamaria?
translation: 您认识埃拉玛利亚女王？

english: Oh yes, we go way back, long before she married that fool the King of Varrock. She wasn't always royal you know.
translation: 哦，当然，我们交情很深，远在她嫁给维洛克城那个傻瓜国王之前。你知道吗，她不是天生就是贵族。

english: No, in her youth she was a barmaid at the Blue Moon inn. All that fancy talk, that's just for show. No, the Ellamaria I knew was as common as muck, until she lucked onto good King Roald.
translation: 不，她年轻的时候是蓝月旅馆的女招待。那些花言巧语，都是装出来的。我认识的埃拉玛利亚以前就是个普通得不能再普通的人，直到她攀上了罗尔德国王这棵高枝。

english: I'll certainly look at her in a different light when I return to Varrock.
translation: 等我回到维洛克城，看她的眼光肯定不一样了。

english: So what sort of guidance has Little-Miss-Hoity-Toity sent you to seek?
translation: 那么那位自命不凡的小姐派你来寻求什么指导？

english: I am supposed to gain some knowledge of diplomacy and persuasion from you.
translation: 我应该从您这里学习外交和说服的技巧。

english: That is an area that - luckily for you, young [player name] - I have studied. Have you heard of the diplomat known as Charos?
translation: 这倒是个领域——算你走运，年轻[player name]——我研究过。你听说过一位叫查罗斯的外交官吗？

english: Charos? I must say the name rings a bell...
translation: 查罗斯？我得说这个名字听起来耳熟……

english: Charos...
translation: 查罗斯……

english: Yes, I remember! Once, during my travels to Morytania, I came upon an item of magical jewellery called the Ring of Charos.
translation: 对了，我想起来了！有一次我在莫利塔尼亚旅行时，偶然发现了一件魔法首饰，叫做查罗斯之戒。

english: You have found the Ring of Charos?!? Tell me - do you still have it in your possession?
translation: 你找到了查罗斯之戒？！告诉我——它还在你手上吗？

english: Yes, I'm wearing it at the moment. Is it important, then?
translation: 是的，我现在正戴着它。那么，它很重要吗？

english: Yes, I have it in my bag. Is it important, then?
translation: 是的，我把它放在包里。那么，它很重要吗？

english: Yes, I have it stored somewhere. Is it important, then?
translation: 是的，我把它存放在某个地方。那么，它很重要吗？

english: Important?!? This ring possesses hidden power beyond belief! Go and get it, and I will tell you its secrets.
translation: 重要？！这枚戒指拥有超乎想象的隐藏力量！快去拿来，我来告诉你它的秘密。

english: No, I'm afraid that I lost it at some point.
translation: 不，恐怕我在某个时候把它弄丢了。

english: Lost the Ring of Charos?!? That is indeed a disastrous turn of events. This ring that you have so casually thrown away possesses hidden power beyond belief.
translation: 弄丢了查罗斯之戒？！这可真是灾难性的转折。你这么随手扔掉的戒指，拥有超乎想象的隐藏力量。

english: How can I re-obtain the Ring of Charos?
translation: 我怎样才能重新拿到查罗斯之戒？

english: If everything I have heard about Charos's ring is true, it will not stay lost forever. Where did you originally find it?
translation: 如果我听到的有关查罗斯之戒的消息都是真的，它不会永远丢失。你最初是在哪里找到它的？

english: I ... um ... 'borrowed' it from a rather shady character called Fenkenstrain.
translation: 我……呃……从一个叫芬肯斯特雷恩的可疑家伙那里“借”来的。

english: In order to find the ring it may be wise to return to Fenkenstrain - he may have found a way to regain it. If you manage to reobtain the ring, return to me and I will reveal its secrets to you.
translation: 要找到戒指，可能最好回到芬肯斯特雷恩那里——他可能已经找到了重新得到它的方法。如果你成功拿回戒指，回来找我，我会向你揭示它的秘密。

english: Charos rose to power under the rule of Lord Drakan of Morytania, his only living servant. The Vampyre Lord suffered the existence of Charos because of the talents that this sophisticated diplomat had to offer.
translation: 查罗斯是在莫利塔尼亚的德拉肯领主的统治下崛起的，他是德拉肯唯一活着的仆从。这个吸血鬼领主容忍查罗斯的存在，是因为这位老练的外交官所能提供的才能。

english: The art of persuasion?
translation: 说服的艺术？

english: Indeed. Charos had many uses - spy, assassin, negotiator - because he could convince anyone to do his wishes. These talents were in some part Charos's own, but greatly enhanced by the ring that he fashioned.
translation: 没错。查罗斯有很多用途——间谍、刺客、谈判者——因为他能说服任何人听从他的意愿。这些才能有一部分是查罗斯自己的，但主要得益于他打造的这枚戒指的增强。

english: The Ring of Charos.
translation: 查罗斯之戒。

english: Exactly. One who wears the ring must possess some innate ability of their own, which the ring enhances so that the wearer can convince all but the most strong- minded to do their bidding.
translation: 正是。戴上这枚戒指的人必须本身具备一定的天赋，戒指会增强这种天赋，使佩戴者几乎能说服所有人——除了意志最坚定的人——听从他的命令。

english: What happened to Charos? And why did Fenkenstrain have the ring?
translation: 查罗斯后来怎么了？为什么芬肯斯特雷恩会有这枚戒指？

english: Charos had a castle built on the northern coast of Morytania, where he dwelt for many years in service to Drakan. None really know what became of him, but some say that he became too certain of his abilities,
translation: 查罗斯在莫利塔尼亚北海岸建了一座城堡，在那里住了很多年，为德拉肯效力。没有人真正知道他后来怎么了，但有人说他过于自信，

english: and turned them on his master. This would have been his ultimate downfall, for the ring's power would have had little or no effect upon Drakan.
translation: 转而将能力用在了主人身上。这导致了他的最终覆灭，因为戒指的力量对德拉肯几乎或者根本不起作用。

english: Fenkenstrain probably found the ring many years later, buried somewhere within the depths of Charos's castle.
translation: 芬肯斯特雷恩很可能在许多年后，在查罗斯城堡的深处某个地方发现了这枚戒指。

english: So what you are telling me is that nobody really knows what happened to Charos? That he could still be alive? And if he is still alive...
translation: 所以您的意思是，没人真正知道查罗斯的下落？他可能还活着？如果他还活着……

english: ...he would naturally come looking for the ring that is his by right. But I don't believe that you should worry about that - it has been many years since his disappearance, and the likelyhood is that he is dead.
translation: ……他自然就会来找回本该属于他的戒指。但我认为你不必担心这个——他失踪已经很多年了，很可能已经死了。

english: Still - it doesn't inspire me with much confidence.
translation: 不过——这并不能让我安心多少。

english: I could activate the power within this ring for you, but for me to do that I must know that you will use it wisely. To do that I must ask you a few questions, to see how good a diplomat you can be.
translation: 我可以帮你激活这枚戒指的力量，但我必须确认你会明智地使用它。为此，我要问你几个问题，看看你有多擅长外交。

english: Okay, go ahead...
translation: 好的，问吧……

english: Okay, I've answered your questions - what's the verdict?
translation: 好了，我回答了你的问题——结果如何？

english: Mmmm, it was close but..
translation: 嗯，差一点就过了，但是……

english: ... but I'm afraid that you don't seem to have the aptitude. To you, the Ring of Charos is but a worthless trinket.
translation: ……恐怕你似乎没有这个天赋。对你来说，查罗斯之戒不过是个无用的玩意。

english: I can't believe that - can I have another go?
translation: 我不信——能让我再试一次吗？

english: Well, if you think it will do any good ... here goes then-
translation: 好吧，如果你觉得有用的话……那就再来——

english: Oh well, that's that I suppose.
translation: 唉，我想就这样吧。

english: Now look, don't start making me feel sorry for you...
translation: 喂，别让我同情你……

english: No, I'm just a dull-headed moron, you're right about that.
translation: 不，我只是个笨头笨脑的白痴，你说得对。

english: I didn't say that - look, if you want another try, come back and speak to me again.
translation: 我没那么说——听着，如果你想再试一次，回来再跟我说。

english: ... Congratulations! You have clearly got what it takes to use the Ring of Charos. Wait a moment, [player name]...
translation: ……恭喜！你显然具备了使用查罗斯之戒的条件。稍等一下，[player name]……

english: The Ring of Charos has now been opened to you, [player name]. You may use its power to charm the weak-minded, but it will only work whilst you are wearing it.
translation: 查罗斯之戒现已对你开放，[player name]。你可以用它来迷惑意志薄弱的人，但只有在你佩戴它时才会生效。

english: I think you wanted to give me a thousand coins...
translation: 我觉得你是想给我一千枚金币……

english: Ha ha! I thought you might try that!! But remember, [player name] - the power of the Ring of Charos will not work with everybody, especially not a wise old bird like me!
translation: 哈哈！我就知道你会这么试！！但记住，[player name]——查罗斯之戒的力量不是对所有人都管用的，尤其对我这样睿智的老家伙没用！

english: Thanks for your help, wise old man.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，老智者。

english: Funny, I thought you would take the chance to test the power of the ring on me! No matter - leave me be now, I have important surveillance duties to carry out.
translation: 有趣，我还以为你会趁机在我身上测试戒指的力量呢！算了——别打扰我了，我还有重要的监视任务要执行。

english: I have returned to you with the Ring of Charos. Now will you reveal its 'hidden power beyond belief'?
translation: 我把查罗斯之戒带回来了。现在你愿意揭示它那'超乎想象的隐藏力量'了吗？

english: I don't see it on you - do you have it in your bag?
translation: 我没看到你戴着它——你放在包里了吗？

english: Er, no - I've stored it somewhere.
translation: 呃，没有——我把它收在别处了。

english: Well go and get it then, and I will tell you its secrets.
translation: 那就去拿来吧，然后我会告诉你它的秘密。

english: The Ring of Charos? What's that?
translation: 查罗斯之戒？那是什么？

english: I thought you told me to-
translation: 我以为你叫我——

english: Just joking, [player name] - good good, I will now tell you what this ring is capable of.
translation: 开个玩笑，[player name]——好好好，我现在就告诉你这枚戒指的能力。

english: Can I retake the diplomacy test?
translation: 我能重新考外交测试吗？

english: Do you have the ring with you?
translation: 你带着戒指吗？

english: I have it stored in the bank. Should I go and get it then?
translation: 我把它存在银行里了。要我去拿来吗？

english: Yes, yes get it and return back to me.
translation: 对对对，去拿来然后回来找我。

english: Do you have any delphinium seeds to spare?
translation: 你有多余的翠雀花种子吗？

english: I do have delphinium seeds, yes - but to spare, I'm not so sure. You don't look like that much of a gardener to me.
translation: 我确实有翠雀花种子，没错——但要说多余，我可不太确定。我看你不太像是个园丁。

english: I'll have you know I'm a pretty good farmer, actually!
translation: 我告诉你，我可是个相当不错的农夫！

english: That is why I have come to an expert for advice.
translation: 所以我才来找专家请教。

english: Ah, now that I like the sound of. So people are saying I'm an expert, then?
translation: 啊，这话我爱听。所以大家都说我是专家了？

english: No, I just said that to get you to give me some seeds.
translation: 不，我只是为了让你给我些种子才那么说的。

english: Really?!? Well, give me any more of that kind of talk and I'll give you something to remember me by, and I'll tell you now that it ain't seeds!!
translation: 真的？！好吧，再敢这么说话，我就让你尝尝我的厉害，我告诉你，那可不是种子！！

english: Yeah, carry on - milk it for all it's worth.
translation: 是啊，继续——尽情炫耀吧。

english: What?!? Any more of that talk and it'll be curtains for you, mate!
translation: 什么？！再这么说，你就完蛋了，伙计！

english: Not just AN expert, Elstan - they say you are THE expert.
translation: 不只是个专家，埃尔斯坦——他们说你才是真正的专家。

english: I can't say that I'm surprised, really - I do seem to have the golden touch with the old gardening lark. Only just the other day I managed to grow a - I'm not boring you, am I?
translation: 说实话，我并不惊讶——我似乎对园艺这行当有种天生的本事。就在前几天，我还种出了一棵——我没让你觉得无聊吧？

english: Yes, please stop right now.
translation: 是的，请立刻打住。

english: As a matter of fact I will! I'm not wasting my time on the likes of you!
translation: 我偏不！我可不想在你这种人身上浪费时间！

english: Oh no, I love listening to gardening stories...
translation: 哦不，我最爱听园艺故事了……

english: You do! That's the first person I've ever met has said that! Well, don't you worry mate, I've got millions of 'em!
translation: 真的吗！你是我遇到的第一个这么说的人！好吧，别担心，伙计，我多的是故事！

english: Somebody kill me now.
translation: 谁来杀了我吧。

english: Millions? Ah, just what I wanted to hear...
translation: 多的是？啊，正是我想听的……

english: Ah, but there's plenty of time for stories. You wanted delphinium seeds, did you say?
translation: 啊，不过故事有的是时间讲。你刚才是说想要翠雀花种子吗？

english: Er .. what ... er ...
translation: 呃……什么……呃……

english: Yes, delphinium seeds!
translation: 是的，翠雀花种子！

english: As I'm in an especially good mood I think I will let you have some. But you have to do something for me first.
translation: 既然我今天心情特别好，我想我可以给你一些。但你先得帮我做件事。

english: And what's that?
translation: 什么事？

english: I need some marigolds to give to Lyra, one of my fellow gardeners over in Morytania. She's a bit mysterious, and has some - well - sinister ways to be sure, but she's just my type.
translation: 我需要一些金盏花送给莱拉，她是我在莫利塔尼亚的一位园丁同行。她有点神秘，而且有些——嗯——确实有些阴险的手段，但她正是我喜欢的类型。

english: So, a bunch of marigolds then?
translation: 所以，要一束金盏花？

english: Yes, and while I'm at it I can see how good a gardener you are. Grow those marigolds in this flower patch here from seed to flower, pick them and give them to me, and I'll give you some delphinium seeds.
translation: 是的，而且趁此机会，我可以看看你是个多好的园丁。在这块花卉种植地里把那些金盏花从种子种到开花，摘下来给我，我就给你一些翠雀花种子。

english: I have those marigolds for you.
translation: 我帮你把金盏花带来了。

english: Ah, fantastic - Lyra will surely be mine now! Here you go mate, here's those delphinium seeds you were after. Yes, here you go – I hope they grow for you.
translation: 啊，太棒了——莱拉现在肯定是我的了！给你，伙计，这是你要的翠雀花种子。是的，给你——希望它们能为你生长。

english: Okay, I'll grow you some marigolds.
translation: 好的，我会为你种些金盏花。

english: No, I don't have time to do that.
translation: 不，我没时间做那个。

english: Have it your own way, mate. No seeds for you then.
translation: 随你便，伙计。那你就别想得到种子了。

english: Are you sure you don't just want to give me the seeds now?
translation: 你确定不想现在就把种子给我吗？

english: Strange - there's this funny buzzing in my head that says that I should - but I don't think I will. I need those marigolds for Lyra.
translation: 奇怪——我脑子里有种奇怪的嗡嗡声，告诉我应该给——但我觉得我不会给。我需要那些金盏花给莱拉。

english: Hang on, I didn't see you growing any marigolds! I want them grown here, in this patch.
translation: 等等，我没看到你种金盏花！我要你在这里，在这块地里种。

english: But they'll be no different to any other marigolds!
translation: 但它们和其他金盏花没什么区别啊！

english: Do you want those seeds or not?
translation: 你到底想不想要那些种子？

english: If you're going to be like that, it'll take more than flowers to make Lyra want to date you.
translation: 如果你要这样，那光靠花可没法让莱拉愿意和你约会。

english: Ah, fantastic - Lyra will surely be mine now! Here you go mate, here's those delphinium seeds you were after.
translation: 啊，太棒了——莱拉现在肯定是我的了！给你，伙计，这是你要的翠雀花种子。

english: Yes, here you go - I hope they grow for you.
translation: 是的，给你——希望它们能为你生长。

english: What did I agree to do for delphinium seeds?
translation: 我同意做什么来换翠雀花种子来着？

english: I need some marigolds so that I can woo Lyra. Grow them from seed to flower in this flower patch here, pick them and give them to me, and I'll give you some delphinium seeds.
translation: 我需要一些金盏花来追求莱拉。在这块花卉种植地里把金盏花从种子种到开花，摘下来给我，我就给你一些翠雀花种子。

english: I can't believe you're asking me to do that! I asked you to grow some marigolds for me, not for me to look after them for you! No, I won't look after them!
translation: 我真不敢相信你居然让我做这个！我是让你帮我种金盏花，不是让我替你照顾它们！不，我不会照顾它们的！

english: Can I have some more delphinium seeds?
translation: 我能再要一些翠雀花种子吗？

english: I would give you some, but you don't appear to have room to carry them.
translation: 我本想给你一些，但你似乎没有空间携带它们。

english: Ah, marigolds. I didn't see you grow these, though. Did you grow these from seed, then?
translation: 啊，金盏花。不过我没看到你种这些。你是从种子种起的吗？

english: No, thought not. You grow some, and I'll give you the seeds you're after.
translation: 不，我想也不是。你种一些，我就给你想要的种子。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 像这样的农业区还有五个——丹塔拉在凯瑟比镇附近的区域、克拉根在阿多尼城附近的区域、莱拉在莫利塔尼亚的区域、马里西在霍西迪乌斯城的区域，以及艾伦在农业公会的区域。

english: Marigolds? You've already given me a bunch of those, mate. Do you want some more seeds, is that what you're after?
translation: 金盏花？你已经给过我一把了，老兄。你是想要更多种子吗？

english: I would give you some, but you seem to have enough already.
translation: 我本想给你一些，但你似乎已经够了。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 像这样的农业区还有五个——丹塔拉在凯瑟比镇附近的区域、克拉根在阿多尼城附近的区域、莱拉在莫利塔尼亚的区域、马里西在霍西迪乌斯城的区域、艾伦在农业公会的区域，以及奥斯瓦特的

english: Plant Cure, eh? I might have some of those. Tell you what, I'll sell you some plant cure for 25 GP if you like.
translation: 植物治疗药水，嗯？我可能有一些。这样吧，如果你想要，我可以卖给你一些植物治疗药水，25金币。

english: Compost, eh? I might have some of those. Tell you what, I'll sell you some compost for 35 GP if you like.
translation: 堆肥，嗯？我可能有一些。这样吧，如果你想要，我可以卖给你一些堆肥，35金币。

english: You don't have anything planted in that patch. Plant something and I might agree to look after it for you.
translation: 你那个地块里什么都没种。种点东西，我或许会同意帮你照看。

english: There's four main Farming areas - Elstan looks after an area south of Falador, Dantaera has one to the north of Catherby, Krage has one near Ardougne, and Lyra looks after a place in north Morytania.
translation: 有四个主要的农业区——埃尔斯坦照看法拉多城以南的区域，丹塔拉在凯瑟比镇以北有一个，克拉根在阿多尼城附近有一个，莱拉照看莫利塔尼亚北部的一个地方。

english: I want 10 jute fibre for that.
translation: 我要10根黄麻纤维来换。

english: Looks like your crops in that patch have already finished growing. There's no need for me to look after it for you.
translation: 看来你那个地块的作物已经长好了。不需要我帮你照看了。

english: I want compost for that.
translation: 我要堆肥来换。

english: That'll do nicely, madam. Leave it with me - I'll make sure it grows for you.
translation: 这样就行了，女士。交给我吧——我会确保它为你长好的。

english: That'll do nicely, sir. Leave it with me - I'll make sure it grows for you.
translation: 这样就行了，先生。交给我吧——我会确保它为你长好的。

english: I want 10 curry leaf for that.
translation: 我要10片咖喱叶来换。

english: I want 2 sack of cabbage2s for that.
translation: 我要2麻袋卷心菜来换这个。

english: I want 1 sack of onions for that.
translation: 我要1麻袋洋葱来换这个。

english: Do you have any orchid seeds to spare?
translation: 你有多余的兰花种子吗？

english: Please, do not bother me - I have problems to attend to.
translation: 请别烦我——我有问题要处理。

english: Oh sorry, I didn't mean to take up your valuable time.
translation: 哦抱歉，我不是有意占用你宝贵的时间。

english: If you tell me your problems, I may be able to help you.
translation: 如果你告诉我你的问题，我或许能帮你。

english: As you ask so nicely I will relate my problems to you, but I very much doubt that you may help me at all.
translation: 既然你问得这么客气，我就把我的问题告诉你，但我非常怀疑你能帮上什么忙。

english: Try me.
translation: 试试看。

english: You must think it strange that a girl such as myself would choose to ply her trade in a place such as this, this darkest of lands.
translation: 你一定觉得奇怪，像我这样的女孩会选择在这种地方，这片最黑暗的土地上谋生。

english: No, not really - you fit in here a treat.
translation: 不，并不奇怪——你在这里很合适。

english: Then begone simple fool and halt your churlish tongue. There are things about me that would leave you with nightmares for the rest of your life.
translation: 那就滚吧，愚蠢的傻瓜，闭上你粗鲁的嘴。关于我的事情会让你余生都做噩梦。

english: Yes, I was wondering about that.
translation: 是的，我正觉得奇怪呢。

english: My mother, Alice, tends to our farming shop in yonder farmhouse, while I tend to this small allotment. Passing trade has quite literally died off in recent years, and with it our income.
translation: 我的母亲，爱丽丝，在那边农舍里打理我们的农业商店，而我则照料这块小农田。近年来过往的生意可以说是彻底凋零了，我们的收入也随之而去。

english: I can only say one thing to you - move.
translation: 我只能对你说一句话——搬走。

english: And leave behind all that we possess?!? Never!!!
translation: 抛下我们拥有的一切？！？绝不！！！

english: Times must be very hard for you.
translation: 你的日子一定很艰难。

english: It is but the smallest of our worries. We get by, we survive, on the miserable harvests that I grow here. The price of our survival is what pains me, as it is a price I have paid with the souls of others.
translation: 这不过是我们最小的烦恼。我们勉强度日，靠着我在这里种出的可怜收成生存。真正让我痛苦的是我们生存的代价，那是我用他人的灵魂付出的代价。

english: Ah, it all makes sense now - you're a psychopath.
translation: 啊，现在一切都说得通了——你是个精神病患者。

english: If your time is so pressing then leave me be and go about your business!
translation: 如果你的时间这么紧迫，那就别管我，去做你的事吧！

english: And what is the nature of this fee that you pay?
translation: 你付出的代价是什么性质的？

english: Mother and I must pay a tithe of blood to the vampyres. Father would have protected us, but he is no longer with us, although his presence still walks among us in the fields. We pay with the blood of others.
translation: 母亲和我必须向吸血鬼缴纳血的贡品。父亲本可以保护我们，但他已经不在了，尽管他的身影仍在田野间游荡。我们用他人的血来支付。

english: Er, can I withdraw my offer of help now?
translation: 呃，我现在能撤回我的帮助提议吗？

english: If not yours, then whose blood are you offering?
translation: 如果不是你的血，那你献上的是谁的血？

english: Sometimes I travel to market fairs in distant lands, and I use my feminine arts to lure young farmers back to this land; then the vampyres come for them and I see them no more.
translation: 有时我会去远方的集市赶集，用我的女性魅力引诱年轻的农夫回到这片土地；然后吸血鬼就会来找他们，我就再也见不到他们了。

english: Something tells me that you actually enjoy it, really.
translation: 我有种感觉，你其实很享受这个过程。

english: I would not talk so if I were you - I know a secret call that will bring the vampyres here right now, and then you may live only long enough to feel regret for your impertinence.
translation: 如果我是你，我就不会这么说——我知道一个秘密召唤，可以立刻把吸血鬼引到这里来，到时候你只能活到足够后悔你无礼的那一刻。

english: How can you deal with so much guilt?
translation: 你怎么能承受这么多内疚？

english: Please - ask me no more. You said that you were looking for some orchid seeds? I do have some as a matter of fact, and you may as well have them because they do not grow well in this grim land.
translation: 拜托——别再问了。你说你在找兰花种子？事实上我确实有一些，你不如就拿去吧，因为它们在这片阴森的土地上长不好。

english: Okay, can I have them then...
translation: 好吧，那我能拿它们吗……

english: You must pass a test first. These are no ordinary flowers, and no ordinary farmer can grow them. You must grow onions here in one of these patches, and when they are fully grown I will give you the seeds.
translation: 你得先通过一个测试。这些不是普通的花，也不是普通的农夫能种活的。你必须在这里的其中一块地里种洋葱，等它们完全长成后，我就给你种子。

english: That's a deal – I'll grow a patch of onions for you.
translation: 成交——我会为你种一块洋葱地。

english: Speak to me when they are fully grown. You need not pick them for me, I will be able to assess your skills by simply watching you.
translation: 等它们完全长成后再来找我。你不需要摘给我，我只要看着你就能评估你的技能。

english: I think not – I've loitered too long in this land.
translation: 我不这么认为——我在这片土地上逗留太久了。

english: Yes, I agree - far too long.
translation: 是的，我同意——太久了。

english: Oh for Saradomin's sake, just give me the seeds!
translation: 哦，看在萨拉多明的份上，直接把种子给我吧！

english: This feeling in my head - it is so strange - and it is a feeling I have felt before, although I cannot explain it. If you are trying to use some unnatural power over me, you have failed.
translation: 我脑子里的这种感觉——太奇怪了——而且我以前也有过这种感觉，虽然我无法解释。如果你想用某种超自然的力量控制我，那你失败了。

english: I need you to grow some onions in one of these vegetable patches, from seed until they are fully grown - then I will give you some orchid seeds.
translation: 我需要你在其中一块蔬菜地里种些洋葱，从种子种到完全长成——然后我就给你一些兰花种子。

english: Okay, I've grown those onions like you asked.
translation: 好的，我已经按你的要求种好了那些洋葱。

english: Yes, you have demonstrated that you have some moderate skills as a farmer, but I fear that you would not have the space to carry them.
translation: 是的，你已经证明了自己有一些中等水平的农夫技能，但我担心你没有空间携带它们。

english: Yes, you have demonstrated that you have some moderate skills as a farmer. Take these seeds, and do with them what you will.
translation: 是的，你已经证明了自己有一些中等水平的农夫技能。拿着这些种子，随你怎么处理吧。

english: I can't believe you're asking me to do that! I asked you to grow some onions for me, not for me to look after them for you! No, I won't look after them!
translation: 我真不敢相信你居然让我做这个！我是让你帮我种洋葱，不是让我替你照顾它们！不，我不会照顾它们的！

english: Can I have some more orchid seeds?
translation: 我能再要一些兰花种子吗？

english: I would give you some orchid seeds, but I fear that you would not have the space to carry them.
translation: 我本想给你一些兰花种子，但我担心你没有空间携带它们。

english: You say this, but you know nothing of my crimes. I cannot tell you all, but this much I will say - that being allowed to exist in this land is a privilege that must be paid for, and the cost is dear.
translation: 你这么说，但你对我的罪行一无所知。我不能告诉你全部，但我可以说这么多——能够在这片土地上生存是一种特权，必须付出代价，而且代价高昂。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 还有另外五个农业区，分别是：法拉多城附近的艾尔斯丹区、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区、阿多尼城附近的克拉根区、霍西迪乌斯城的玛丽西区，以及农业公会的艾伦区。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and
translation: 还有另外五个农业区，分别是：法拉多城附近的艾尔斯丹区、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区、阿多尼城附近的克拉根区、霍西迪乌斯城的玛丽西区、农业公会的艾伦区，以及

english: Do you have any snowdrop seeds to spare?
translation: 你有多余的雪花莲种子吗？

english: No I don't, as it happens. Sorry.
translation: 不，我没有。抱歉。

english: But I was told that you did!
translation: 可我听说你有！

english: Well, you were told wrong then!
translation: 哼，那你听错了！

english: Goodbye!!
translation: 再见！！

english: You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
translation: 朋友，你看上去有点暴躁啊。

english: Oh, you think so?!? And what concern is it of yours?
translation: 哦，你这么觉得？！？关你什么事？

english: I'm not concerned, I just want you to give me some snowdrop seeds.
translation: 我不关心，我只是想让你给我一些雪花莲种子。

english: Is that right?!? Well, I do actually have some snowdrop seeds, but you would be the last person I would give them to.
translation: 原来如此？！？好吧，我确实有一些雪花莲种子，但就算给谁也不会给你。

english: I don't like to see a fellow human being so upset.
translation: 我不愿看到同胞如此难过。

english: I must say, you don't often meet people who show concern the way you have done.
translation: 不得不说，像你这样表达关心的人还真少见。

english: I can't take it anymore - just give me the seeds.
translation: 我受不了了——快把种子给我。

english: And to think I listened to you! I was right after all - there is no kindness between human beings anymore.
translation: 亏我还听了你的话！我果然没错——人与人之间已经没有善意了。

english: So what ails you, my friend?
translation: 那么，朋友，你究竟为何烦恼？

english: All these people, asking me to look after their crops! And no-one ever asking me how I feel, or if there's something they can do for me!
translation: 这些人，一个个都让我照看他们的庄稼！却从没人问问我感觉如何，或者有没有什么能帮我的！

english: Oh stop whining, it's not like you do it for free.
translation: 别抱怨了，又不是白干活。

english: Well, is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 那有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: Oh, that's very kind of you! And there I was, thinking of giving it all up and heading off across the seas to find my fortune!
translation: 哦，你真是太好了！我还正想着放弃一切，漂洋过海去淘金呢！

english: Don't let me stop you, there are plenty of ships missing cabin boys.
translation: 那我不拦你，很多船正缺船舱服务生呢。

english: If you carry on speaking to me like that I might just put this spade to good use, and I'm not talking about digging!
translation: 你要是再这么跟我说话，我可要把这铲子派上好用场了——我说的可不是挖地！

english: I'd like just for once for somebody to grow something for me. Just something simple; some vegetables would be nice.
translation: 我真希望有人能为我种点东西。就简简单单的，比如些蔬菜就好。

english: How about some potatoes?
translation: 土豆怎么样？

english: Nah, there's a whole field of them over to the west. I don't have any particular use for onions, so how about cabbages, then?
translation: 不，西边已经有一大片了。我对洋葱没什么特别需求，那卷心菜呢？

english: Cabbages? Sounds good to me. Where do you want me to grow them?
translation: 卷心菜？听起来不错。你想让我种在哪里？

english: Oh, in one of these allotments here. Plant them from seed, and when they're ready for harvesting let me know, I'll give you your seeds.
translation: 哦，就在这里的某块地里。从种子种起，等它们可以收获时告诉我，我就给你想要的种子。

english: That's a deal - I'll let you know when your cabbages are ready.
translation: 成交——你的卷心菜准备好时我会通知你。

english: I'm not wasting my time growing cabbages.
translation: 我可不想浪费时间种卷心菜。

english: And I'm not wasting my seeds on an upstart like you!
translation: 我也没兴趣把种子浪费在你这种狂妄之徒身上！

english: Aarrrrrghhhh! I hate cabbages!!!! Give me the seeds!!!!!
translation: 啊——！我恨卷心菜！！！把种子给我！！！！

english: Give ... you ... the ...
translation: 把……种子……给你……

english: ... yes I should ...
translation: ……对，我应该……

english: ... no I won't ...
translation: ……不，我不给……

english: Not after speaking to me like that you upstart!!! Is it a deal or not?!?
translation: 跟我说完那种话还想拿种子，你这狂妄之徒！！！到底成不成？！？

english: You said that you would grow me some cabbages in one of these allotments. When they're ready for harvest come and talk to me, and I'll give you those snowdrop seeds that you're after.
translation: 你说过要在其中一块地里给我种些卷心菜。等它们可以收获时来找我，我就给你想要的雪花莲种子。

english: Okay, I've grown those cabbages like you asked.
translation: 好了，我按你说的种了那些卷心菜。

english: Yes, I saw - what fine farming prowess! Nobody has ever done anything like that for me before; here you go, these are the seeds you were after I believe.
translation: 是的，我看到了——真是高超的农业技艺！以前从来没人这么为我做过。给你，我相信这就是你想要的种子。

english: I can't believe you're asking me to do that! I asked you to grow some cabbages for me, not for me to look after them for you! No, I won't look after them!
translation: 真不敢相信你居然要我这么做！我是让你给我种卷心菜，不是让我替你照看它们！不，我不会照看的！

english: Can I have some more snowdrop seeds?
translation: 能再给我一些雪花莲种子吗？

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Dantaera's area near Catherby, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 还有另外五个农业区，分别是：法拉多城附近的艾尔斯丹区、凯瑟比镇附近的丹塔拉区、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区、霍西迪乌斯城的玛丽西区、农业公会的艾伦区，以及奥斯沃尔特的

english: Watering Can, eh? I might have one of those. Tell you what, I'll sell you one watering can for 25 GP if you like.
translation: 浇水壶，是吗？我可能有一个。这样吧，如果你愿意，我可以用25金币卖给你一个浇水壶。

english: Rake, eh? I might have one of those. Tell you what, I'll sell you one rake for 15 GP if you like.
translation: 耙子，是吗？我可能有一个。这样吧，如果你愿意，我可以用15金币卖给你一个耙子。

english: I might - what's the problem?
translation: 也许吧——怎么了？

english: You see those grapevines over there?
translation: 你看到那边那些葡萄藤了吗？

english: Yes. They don't look too happy at the moment.
translation: 看到了。它们现在看上去不太健康。

english: They've come down with some strange disease that I've never encountered before. I've tried everything with them, but nothing seems to work. If it carries on like this I will lose all this year's crops.
translation: 它们染上了一种我从未见过的奇怪疾病。我试了一切办法，但都没用。再这样下去，我今年所有的收成就全毁了。

english: I could probably help you with that, but I'd need something in return.
translation: 我或许可以帮你，但得有些回报。

english: Anything, you just need to ask!
translation: 什么都行，你尽管开口！

english: Well, I'd like a supply of Burthorpe Vine seeds.
translation: 嗯，我想要一些伯索普藤蔓种子。

english: I'm afraid I can't do that.
translation: 恐怕我不能答应。

english: I thought you said anything!
translation: 你刚才不还说什么都行吗！

english: I'm afraid that is the one thing I cannot give you. Burthorpe Vine has been bred over many years and many past generations of my family. I could never give away something so special.
translation: 恐怕这是唯一一件我不能给你的东西。伯索普藤蔓是经过许多年、我家许多代人的培育才得到的。我绝不能把这么特别的东西送出去。

english: But it is the only way that these vines will be cured.
translation: 可这是治好这些藤蔓的唯一方法。

english: Hmm, you may be right. If I lose these crops what use are more seeds to me, when I have gone out of business? Very well then, this is the deal - cure my vines and I will give you some Burthorpe Vine seeds.
translation: 嗯，你也许是对的。如果我的这些作物都毁了，就算有再多种子，对我这个已经破产的人来说又有什么用呢？那好吧，就这么办——治好我的藤蔓，我就给你一些伯索普藤蔓种子。

english: Actually, it seems like a lot of hard work for nothing.
translation: 说实话，这听起来像是白费力气。

english: I wouldn't call my livelihood 'nothing' if I were you. Very well, I shall find someone else to assist me.
translation: 要我是你，就不会把我的生计说成是“白费力气”。好吧，我找别人帮我。

english: Plant cure not doing the trick, eh?
translation: 植物治疗药水不管用，嗯？

english: I don't understand - it's worked with everything else.
translation: 我不明白——它对其他东西都管用。

english: That grapevine disease must be much stronger than the usual. You'll need something a bit more potent to cut out that infection.
translation: 那种葡萄藤疾病肯定比普通的凶猛得多。你需要更有效的东西来消除感染。

english: Do you know of any stronger cures?
translation: 你知道有什么更强的治疗方法吗？

english: No, I don't - but I know of a man who might. Not far from here there's a druid gardener who goes by the name of Alain. He's an expert on things like this, so they tell me.
translation: 不，我不知道——但我知道一个人可能知道。离这不远有个叫阿兰的德鲁伊园丁。据他们说，他是这方面的专家。

english: Why didn't you just go and ask him yourself?
translation: 那你为什么不自己去找他？

english: These vines are very precious indeed. I could not hazard the risk that someone would steal my grapes while I was away - they may be diseased, but they still contain Burthorpe Vine seeds.
translation: 这些藤蔓确实非常珍贵。我不能冒险让有人在我离开时偷走我的葡萄——它们可能染病了，但里面仍然有伯索普藤蔓种子。

english: I need to ask you about strong plant cures.
translation: 我想问你关于强力植物治疗药水的事。

english: Well, you have come to the right person, then - I researched exotic plant diseases as part of my druidic training. What is the affliction that you need to cure?
translation: 那你来对人了——我在德鲁伊训练时研究过奇异植物疾病。你需要治疗的是什么病？

english: Bernald up in Burthorpe has got some seriously diseased grapevines. I tried plant cure on them, but it didn't seem to have any positive effect.
translation: 伯索普公国的伯纳德有一些严重染病的葡萄藤。我用植物治疗药水试过，但似乎没有任何正面效果。

english: Ah, so is this the famous Burthorpe Vine?
translation: 啊，这就是著名的伯索普藤蔓吗？

english: The very one.
translation: 正是。

english: I'm afraid that my researches did not extend to Burthorpe Vine. Bernald and his ancestors have always closely guarded their heritage, that vine. In fact, I'm surprised that he has involved you.
translation: 恐怕我的研究没有涉及到伯索普藤蔓。伯纳德和他的祖先们一直严密守护着他们的遗产，那株藤蔓。事实上，我很惊讶他会让你参与进来。

english: Er, I did have some ... assistance there.
translation: 呃，我确实……得到了一些帮助。

english: I see. Well, if it involves some unnatural power I would rather not know. I prefer the use of power that can be brought forth from the plants around us.
translation: 我懂了。好吧，如果涉及某种超凡力量，我宁可不知道。我更喜欢运用周围植物本身所能释放的力量。

english: Are you sure there's nothing you can suggest?
translation: 你真的没有任何建议吗？

english: There is one thing you could try. One of the most potent cures I have discovered involves using the natural power held within a very special mineral, but it is a very closely guarded secret.
translation: 有一件事你可以试试。我发现的最有效的疗法之一，是利用一种特殊矿物中蕴含的自然力量，但这可是个严守的秘密。

english: Do you mean the rune essence?
translation: 你是指符文精华？

english: You know of that?!? Then I can do no further harm here. You can make a potent plant cure by mixing some crumbled rune essence into a normal plant cure. This may possibly cure Bernald's vines.
translation: 你知道那个？！？那我再说下去也无妨了。你可以把一些碾碎的符文精华混入普通的植物治疗药水中，制成强效的植物治疗药水。这或许能治好伯纳德的藤蔓。

english: Thank you Alain, I will try it out immediately!
translation: 谢谢阿兰，我马上去试试！

english: You're hiding something from me.
translation: 你有事瞒着我。

english: This is the power you are abusing!! I feel it now - it emanates from the ring you wear, a festering fountain of corruption that appalls my very soul!!!
translation: 这就是你滥用的力量！！我现在感觉到了——它从你戴的戒指中散发出来，像一口腐烂的喷泉，令我的灵魂感到震惊！！！

english: Oh, sorry. I forgot that it only works on the weak-minded.
translation: 哦，抱歉。我忘了它只对意志薄弱的人起作用。

english: You, [player name], are the one who must be weak- minded, if you consider using such a dreadful weapon. Beware - it may one day be your downfall.
translation: 你，[player name]，你才是那个意志薄弱的人，如果你会考虑使用如此可怕的武器。当心——它终有一天会让你栽跟头。

english: I want 10 cactus spines for that.
translation: 我要10根仙人掌刺来换这个。

english: I want 25 coconuts for that.
translation: 我要25个椰子来换这个。

english: I want one basket of tomatoes for that.
translation: 我要一篮子番茄来换这个。

english: You, [player name], are the one who must be weak-minded, if you consider using such a dreadful weapon. Beware - it may one day be your downfall.
translation: 你，[player name]，如果你觉得用这种可怕的武器没问题，那你才是脑子不清醒的那个。小心点——它总有一天会害了你。

english: If you like, but I want 10 cactus spines for that.
translation: 如果你愿意的话也行，但我要10根仙人掌刺来换这个。

english: I want 10 cactus spine for that.
translation: 我要10根仙人掌刺来换这个。

english: I want 1 basket of tomatos for that.
translation: 我要1篮子番茄来换这个。

english: Have you spoken to Alain yet?
translation: 你找阿兰谈过了吗？

english: Yes. He has given me some knowledge so that I can make a more potent plant cure.
translation: 是的。他给了我一些知识，让我能制作更有效的植物治疗药水。

english: Let's hope that it does the job, then.
translation: 那就希望它能奏效吧。

english: My vines are cured! You have worked a wonder here, [player name]! Here, you can have those seeds like I promised.
translation: 我的藤蔓治好了！你在这里创造了一个奇迹，[player name]！给你，你可以得到我承诺的那些种子了。

english: Do you have any more Burthorpe Vine seeds?
translation: 你还有更多的伯索普藤蔓种子吗？

english: What did you do with the ones I gave you?
translation: 你把之前我给你的种子怎么了？

english: Oh thank you! Please speak to me again when you have cured the vines for me, and hence saved my livelihood.
translation: 哦，谢谢你！等你帮我治好藤蔓，救了我的生计之后，请再来跟我说话。

english: I thought you were the one with the horticultural knowledge here. How would you normally cure plant diseases?
translation: 我还以为你才是这里懂园艺的人。你平时都是怎么治愈植物疾病的？

english: Do you know how I could grow a White Tree?
translation: 你知道我怎样才能种出一棵白树吗？

english: There are no more White Trees left in the world - they have all been chopped down, and their beauty has forever left this world.
translation: 世界上已经没有更多的白树了——它们全被砍光了，它们的美丽已永远离开了这个世界。

english: Then my quest is over - I cannot grow a White Tree.
translation: 那我的任务就结束了——我种不了白树。

english: Even if there were a White Tree somewhere I would not tell you, for as soon as it would grow then it would be slaughtered in its prime. Man's hunger for fire is greater than his admiration of beauty.
translation: 即使某处还有白树，我也不会告诉你，因为它一旦长成就会在盛年被砍伐。人类对火焰的渴望胜过了对美的欣赏。

english: I think that there is something that you are not telling me.
translation: 我觉得你还有事瞒着我。

english: Am I so transparent? You have seen through me; there is something I would rather not tell you.
translation: 我就这么容易被看穿吗？你看穿我了。确实有件事我不愿告诉你。

english: You need to chill out and stop taking yourself so seriously.
translation: 你需要冷静一下，别把自己太当回事。

english: Leave me in peace then, if you are so unable to understand my grief.
translation: 那就让我安静地待着吧，既然你无法理解我的悲伤。

english: A secret is a dreadful burden to have to keep to yourself.
translation: 保守秘密是个沉重的负担。

english: It is not hard to keep this secret - to give it away would cause me great sorrow.
translation: 保守这个秘密并不难——说出来反而会给我带来巨大的悲伤。

english: I don't see how. Tell me your secret, and I will keep it as well as you have done.
translation: 我不明白怎么会这样。把你的秘密告诉我，我会像你一样守口如瓶。

english: Very well - I feel deep trust in you for some reason. It is the White Tree, last survivor of a race of Trees that have disappeared from our landscape. Once they covered the land; now there is only one.
translation: 好吧——不知为何，我对你有一种深深的信任。就是白树，一种已经从我们风景画中消失了的树木的最后一个幸存者。曾经它们遍布大地；现在只剩一棵了。

english: Man desired the wood of the White Tree, because of its wood of pure white. Need I tell you more?
translation: 人类渴望白树的木材，因为其木质纯白。还需要我多说吗？

english: I can fill in the rest. So where is the remaining White Tree?
translation: 剩下的我自己能猜到。那么剩下的那棵白树在哪？

english: She stands atop Ice Mountain, alone and sorrowful; and, I fear, that she is dying.
translation: 她孤零零地矗立在冰山山顶，孤独而悲伤；而且，我担心，她正在死去。

english: If I took a cutting from ... her ... then I could grow another one.
translation: 如果我……从她身上……剪下一根枝条，那我就能再种一棵。

english: Yes, but she only has life enough to produce one shoot. Cut this shoot, and she will die, last of her kind gone forever. If you failed to grow this shoot, there would be no more White Trees.
translation: 是的，但她只剩够长出一个新芽的生命了。如果剪下这个新芽，她就会死，这一物种的最后一员将永远消失。如果你没能让这个新芽长大，就不会再有白树了。

english: You should get out a bit more and quit worrying about trees.
translation: 你应该多出去走走，别再为树操心了。

english: No, I am afraid I cannot do that. She is the last White Tree, and I am the last to care about her. I will not let her pass away alone and unloved.
translation: 不，恐怕我不能那样做。她是最后一棵白树，而我是最后一个关心她的人。我不会让她孤独无依地逝去。

english: Unless you allow me to do this she will die anyway.
translation: 除非你让我这么做，否则她终究还是会死。

english: I know, but I try not to think about that. You speak truly - she does not have much time left.
translation: 我知道，但我尽量不去想。你说得对——她时日不多了。

english: Then will you allow me to take this cutting?
translation: 那你愿意让我取下这根枝条吗？

english: Do so with my blessing. I wish you good fortune, [player name]. Go now, and save the beauty of the White Tree.
translation: 带着我的祝福去做吧。祝你好运，[player name]。去吧，拯救白树的美。

english: Here is the shoot that Dantaera spoke of. Everything she told me is true – this tree will die once I cut this shoot. Well, here goes...
translation: 这就是丹塔拉说的那根枝条。她告诉我的一切都是真的——一旦我切下这根枝条，这棵树就会死去。好吧，动手吧……

english: I have already cut the shoot from the White Tree. I should quickly grow a new tree in Queen Ellamaria's garden.
translation: 我已经从白树上切下了枝条。我应该尽快在艾拉玛利亚王后的花园里种一棵新树。

english: Ah, luckily there is another shoot here that I can cut. Better not lose this one...
translation: 啊，幸好这里还有另一根枝条可以切。最好别再弄丢这根了……

english: I have lost the cutting from the White Tree.
translation: 我把白树的枝条弄丢了。

english: I do not believe what I am hearing, after everything you said to me before!
translation: 我真不敢相信我听到的，你之前可不是这么说的！

english: Er, yes I know ... sorry ...
translation: 呃，是的，我知道……抱歉……

english: Maybe - just maybe - there might be another shoot somewhere on the Tree that you can take as a cutting. Go and havealook, before she dies without offspring!
translation: 也许——只是也许——树上别处还有另一根枝条可以让你切下来。在她没有后代就死去之前，快去找找看！

english: The last of the White Trees stands dying atop Ice Mountain. I would greatly desire that you take her last cutting - although she is then certain to die - and cultivate her offspring.
translation: 最后一棵白树正垂死地矗立在冰山顶上。我非常希望你能取下她最后的枝条——尽管那样她必死无疑——然后培育她的后代。

english: Then it is done now, whatever happens. Though I am eager for her offspring to be planted I am doubly sorrowful that she will now die.
translation: 那么，无论发生什么，现在都成定局了。虽然我渴望她的后代能被种下，但我更悲伤的是她即将死去。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius and Alan's area in the Farming Guild.
translation: 还有另外五个像这样的农业区——法拉多城附近的埃尔斯坦区、阿多尼城附近的克拉根区、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区、霍西迪乌斯城的玛丽西区，以及农业公会的艾伦区。

english: Maybe - just maybe - there might be another shoot somewhere on the Tree that you can take as a cutting. Go and have a look, before she dies without offspring!
translation: 也许——只是也许——树上某个地方还有另一根可以让你取下的枝条。在她没有后代就死去之前，去看看！

english: You need to plant a healthy plant in that patch.
translation: 你需要在那个苗圃里种一株健康的植物。

english: There are five other Farming areas like this one - Elstan's area near Falador, Kragen's area near Ardougne, Lyra's area in Morytania, Marisi's area in Hosidius, Alan's area in the Farming Guild and Oswallt's
translation: 还有另外五个像这样的农业区——法拉多城附近的埃尔斯坦区、阿多尼城附近的克拉根区、莫利塔尼亚的莱拉区、霍西迪乌斯城的玛丽西区、农业公会的艾伦区，以及奥斯瓦尔特区。

english: I want 1 basket of potatos for that.
translation: 我要1篮子土豆来换这个。

english: Can I have some rosebush seeds, please?
translation: 能给我一些玫瑰丛种子吗？

english: No, I think not. These bushes are my pride and joy, and I will not give them away so cheaply.
translation: 不，我想不行。这些灌木是我的骄傲和快乐，我不会这么轻易地送人。

english: These are the most beautiful rosebushes I've ever seen.
translation: 这是我见过最美丽的玫瑰丛。

english: Nice of you to say so, but I sense the use of some unnatural power underneath your fine words. You are concealing something of great evil, an evil that cannot touch someone of my purity.
translation: 你这么说很好，但我感觉到你花言巧语之下使用了某种不自然的力量。你隐藏着某种巨大的邪恶，这种邪恶无法触及像我这样纯洁的人。

english: Oh ... no, that's not true ...
translation: 哦……不，不是这样的……

english: Nonsense, you reek of this evil power! I suggest that you throw whatever dark talisman it is that you are using down the Edgeville well, and never think of it again! Either that or just simply destroy it!
translation: 胡说，你身上散发着这种邪恶力量的气味！我建议你把你正在使用的那个黑暗护符扔进边陲镇的井里，再也不要想起它！要么就直接毁掉它！

english: Fish in a well? There can't be anything down there except water!! Perhaps I should try some place where I might expect to find fish - a fishing spot maybe?
translation: 在井里钓鱼？那下面除了水什么都没有！！也许我应该去个可能找到鱼的地方试试——比如钓鱼点？

english: la-de-da
translation: 啦-滴-啦

english: dum-de-dum
translation: 嘟-滴-嘟

english: (whistles a happy tune)
translation: （吹着欢快的口哨）

english: Are you messing about with my rosebushes again?
translation: 你又在乱动我的玫瑰丛了吗？

english: Er ... no ... I was just admiring them.
translation: 呃……没有……我只是在欣赏它们。

english: Ah, I sense that you speak so without the use of the evil power you carried before. That is good. As you have taken the road back towards the light, you may take any seeds that you wish.
translation: 啊，我感觉到你说话时没有使用之前携带的邪恶力量。很好。既然你已经踏上了回归光明之路，你可以随意取用任何你想要的种子。

english: That is good. Although it could always be regained by someone using an implement long enough to reach the bottom of the well, something with a hook on the end to catch the ring with.
translation: 那就好。不过，如果有人用足够长的工具伸到井底，比如末端带钩子的东西，还是有可能把戒指捞回来的。

english: I hope I haven't put any ideas into your head.
translation: 希望我没给你什么坏主意。

english: That is good. Although I sense that an evil talisman like that cannot be truly destroyed - it will probably try to find it's way back to it's master.
translation: 那就好。不过我感觉到，像那样的邪恶护符是不可能被真正摧毁的——它很可能会试图回到它主人身边。

english: I pray that you don't try and seek it out again.
translation: 我祈祷你不要再试图去找它了。

english: Why are you messing about with my rosebushes?
translation: 你动我的玫瑰丛干什么？

english: You still have not gotten rid of the evil thing that you carried! Do as I said to you before, and throw the thing down the Edgeville well, or simply destroy it!!
translation: 你还没把你带着的那件邪恶东西处理掉！照我之前说的做，把那东西扔进边陲镇的井里，或者干脆毁掉它！！

english: No you're not - you're trying to steal some seeds. Well, you can leave them alone. It's taken me many long months of tending to bring them to this fine state of near-perfection.
translation: 不，你不是——你是想偷些种子。哼，你最好别碰它们。我花了多少个月的精心照料，才把它们培育到这种近乎完美的状态。

english: No. Now leave me in peace.
translation: 不。现在让我清静一下。

english: (Hmmm ... better not let those guards see me...)
translation: （嗯……最好别让那些守卫看见我……）

english: So what are you doing this weekend?
translation: 那你这个周末打算做什么？

english: This weekend?
translation: 这个周末？

english: You haven't been here longI take it.
translation: 看来你在这儿待得不久。

english: Do you know the life expectancy of a Falador guard?
translation: 你知道法拉多城守卫的平均寿命是多少吗？

english: About thirty seconds, I reckon.
translation: 我猜大概三十秒。

english: Thirty seconds???
translation: 三十秒？？？

english: They didn't tell me that when I signed up!!!
translation: 我报名的时候他们可没告诉我这个！！！

english: Any second now someone is going to try and kill us, for no apparent reason, completely unprovoked.
translation: 随时都会有人无缘无故、毫无挑衅地来杀我们。

english: But why, Bob???
translation: 但为什么，鲍勃？？？

english: What have we ever done to them?

english: But I'm not wasting my final seconds worrying about it.
translation: 但我不想浪费我最后的几秒钟去担心这个。

english: Bob???

english: See you in the next world...

english: Aaarrrgghhh!!!!

english: NOOOOO!!!!!!!!!

english: Why are you doing this?!?

translation: 我本应该从仑桥镇弄一座国王雕像来。我不是专家，但在我看来那是个王后。

translation: 是的，很好，农民，你拿到了种子；但人家想要的是伯索普公国藤蔓，不是种子。把它种在伯索普公国藤蔓种植地里，让它生长。

english: Yes, very good peasant, you've got the seed; but it's a [red/white/yellow] rosebush that one wishes, not seeds. Plant it in the [red/white/yellow] rosebush patch, and let it grow.
translation: 是的，很好，农民，你拿到了种子；但人家想要的是[red/white/yellow]玫瑰丛，不是种子。把它种在[red/white/yellow]玫瑰丛种植地里，让它生长。

english: Yes, very good peasant, you've got the seed; but it's snowdrops that one wishes, not seeds. Plant it in the snowdrop patch, and let it grow.
translation: 是的，很好，农民，你拿到了种子；但人家想要的是雪花莲，不是种子。把它种在雪花莲种植地里，让它生长。

english: Hey, why are you digging that up? Leave it alone!
translation: 嘿，你为什么把它挖出来？别动它！

english: Oh, sorry, didn't mean to...
translation: 哦，抱歉，我不是故意的……

english: Well, I think that's everything...
translation: 嗯，我想都齐了……

english: One finds that hard to believe. Out of my way, let me see for myself.
translation: 人家很难相信。让开，让我自己看看。

english: One was right not to trust your word, common as it is. The garden is not yet complete.
translation: 人家不相信你的话是对的，真是粗俗。花园还没有完成。

english: Really? What haven't I finished yet?
translation: 真的吗？我还有什么没做完？

english: I see that the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 我看到[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: Also, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 还有，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: Thirdly, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 第三，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: Oh look, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 哦看，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: To add to that, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 除此之外，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: And what a surprise, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 真让人惊讶，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: Oh you are doing so well, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 哦，你做得真好，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: To add insult to injury, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 更糟的是，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: And finally, the [plant name] [hasn't/haven't] finished growing.
translation: 最后，[植物名称]还没有长成。

english: One suggest you learn a little patience. These plants should not take long to grow - these patches have been filled with extremely fertile soil that was very expensive to import.
translation: 人家建议你学点耐心。这些植物应该不会长太久——这些种植地里装满了极其肥沃的土壤，进口价格非常昂贵。

english: Oh yes, very nice, if a little yobbish. Rollie will be so pleased–
translation: 哦，是的，非常好，虽然有点粗俗。罗利会很高兴的——

english: Rollie?!?
translation: 罗利？！？

english: You will address my husband by his proper title!!!!! Speaking of whom, I think it is time that we brought him to see his new garden. And when one says we, one means you.
translation: 你要用他正确的头衔来称呼我的丈夫！！说到他，我想是时候带他来看看他的新花园了。当人家说“我们”的时候，意思是你。

english: Oh, you want me to go and get Roald – sorry ... King Roald ... and bring him here. Fair enough, wait here then, I'll be back in a mo.
translation: 哦，你想让我去把罗阿尔德——抱歉……罗尔德国王——带到这里来。好吧，那在这儿等着，我马上回来。

english: So are you going to get Rollie then?
translation: 那你去不去找罗利呢？

english: No, I haven't spoken to Roll ... King Roald ... yet.
translation: 不，我还没和罗……罗尔德国王……说过话。

english: Well hurry along peasant. This garden will be such a wonderful surprise!
translation: 那就快点吧，农民。这个花园会是一个多么美妙的惊喜！

english: One suggests you learn a little patience. These plants should not take long to grow - these patches have been filled with extremely fertile soil that was very expensive to import.
translation: 有人建议你学学耐心。这些植物用不了多久就能长好——这些苗圃里填满了极其肥沃的土壤，进口成本很高。

english: Ah, Rollie my love!
translation: 啊，我的罗利！

english: Behold your new garden!!
translation: 看看你的新花园！！

english: Rollie?
translation: 罗利？

english: One has gone to great pains to provide you with this beautiful garden!
translation: 本宫费了很大功夫才为你弄来这个漂亮的花园！

english: YOU CAN SHOW ONE A LITTLE GRATITUDE!!
translation: 你就不能对本宫表示一点感激之情吗！！

english: SILENCE!!
translation: 闭嘴！！

english: Well? Are you going to thank one, Rollie?
translation: 嗯？罗利，你打算感谢本宫吗？

english: SPEAK UP, I CAN'T HEAR YOU!!
translation: 大声点，本宫听不见！！

english: Much better. Now get back to the castle and rule our kingdom.
translation: 这还差不多。现在回城堡去治理我们的王国吧。

english: Excuse my husband, he can be so rude sometimes.
translation: 请原谅我的丈夫，他有时候就是这么粗鲁。

english: Are you being rude again ... ?
translation: 你是不是又粗鲁了……？

english: Oh yes, very nice, if a little yobbish. Rollie will be so pleased-
translation: 哦，是的，非常漂亮，虽然有点粗俗。罗利一定会很高兴的——

english: Yes, and that's all he deserves! Here you go, your help here has proved invaluable.
translation: 是的，他也就配这个了！拿着吧，你在这里的帮助非常宝贵。

english: I see that the delphiniums haven't finished growing.
translation: 我看到翠雀花还没长好。

english: Who else would I be speaking to, you funny little man? Of course you.
translation: 不然本宫还能跟谁说话呢，你这有趣的小男人？当然是你了。

english: I see that the pink orchids haven't finished growing.
translation: 我看到粉色兰花还没长好。

english: Also, the pink orchids haven't finished growing.
translation: 还有，粉色兰花还没长好。

english: Also, the yellow orchids haven't finished growing.
translation: 还有，黄色兰花还没长好。

english: Thirdly, the yellow orchids haven't finished growing.
translation: 第三，黄色兰花还没长好。

english: Who else would I be speaking to, you funny little woman? Of course you.
translation: 不然本宫还能跟谁说话呢，你这有趣的小女人？当然是你了。

english: Oh look, the snowdrops haven't finished growing.
translation: 哦看，雪花莲还没长好。

english: I see that the White Tree hasn't finished growing.
translation: 我看到白树还没长好。

english: Oh, what I have to deal with these days - to think this is what being a Queen has become. Very well then: would you ... good lady help me with a little project of mine?
translation: 哦，本宫现在要应付的都是些什么事——想想看，当王后竟然变成了这样。那好吧：你……好心的女士，能帮本宫一个小忙吗？

english: Thirdly, the snowdrops haven't finished growing.
translation: 第三，雪花莲还没长好。

english: To add to that, the Burthorpe Vine hasn't finished growing.
translation: 除此之外，伯索普藤蔓还没长完。

english: Oh you are doing so well, the pink rosebush hasn't finished growing.
translation: 哦，你做得真不错，粉色玫瑰丛还没长好。

english: And what a surprise, the white rosebush hasn't finished growing.
translation: 真让人意外，白色玫瑰丛还没长好。

translation: 雪上加霜的是，红色玫瑰丛还没长好。

english: Well read it then! That should tell you everything you need to know!!

english: Yes, hurry off peasant - you are of no use to me.
translation: 是的，快滚吧农民——你对本宫没用了。

english: What are you talking about?!? You still have the one I gave you!
translation: 你在说什么？！？本宫给你的那个你还没用完呢！

english: Also, the snowdrops haven't finished growing.
translation: 还有，雪花莲还没长好。

english: To add to that, the White Tree hasn't finished growing.
translation: 除此之外，白树还没长好。

english: I want you to grow snowdrops there.
translation: 本宫要你在那里种雪花莲。

english: I want you to grow a White Tree there.
translation: 本宫要你在那里种一棵白树。

english: Also, the white rosebush hasn't finished growing.
translation: 还有，白色玫瑰丛还没长好。

english: Thirdly, the pink rosebush hasn't finished growing.

english: What, you want to dig up the plants that took one so long to grow? Don't be ridiculous, you silly little man.
translation: 什么，你想把本宫花了那么久才种好的植物挖出来？别荒谬了，你这愚蠢的小男人。

translation: 还有，红色玫瑰丛还没长好。

english: To add to that, the red rosebush hasn't finished growing.
translation: 除此之外，红色玫瑰丛还没长好。

english: Oh, let one see peasant - perhaps it is a potion for making supercompost?
translation: 哦，让本宫看看农民——也许这是制作超级堆肥的药水？

english: You wish to know how to use it? Pour it on some normal compost and it will transform into supercompost. You can do this with a bucket of compost, although it is possibly wiser to use it on a full compost bin.
translation: 你想知道怎么用？把它倒在一些普通堆肥上，它就会变成超级堆肥。你可以对一桶堆肥这样做，不过把它用在一个装满的堆肥箱上可能更明智。

english: Well, that is as may be. However, this task may also involve some knowledge of the skills of diplomacy and persuasion. From the manner of your speech, these are skills I doubt that you possess.
translation: 嗯，也许吧。不过，这个任务可能还需要一些外交和说服技巧。从你说话的方式来看，本宫怀疑你并不具备这些技能。

english: Be off with you, peasant. You are mightily fortunate that I do not call the guards this instant, after which you may never see another sunrise.
translation: 滚开吧，农民。本宫没有立刻叫卫兵来，你已经非常幸运了，否则你可能再也见不到下一个日出了。

english: I want you to grow a red rosebush there.

english: I see that the yellow orchids haven't finished growing.
translation: 我看到黄色兰花还没长好。

english: Also, the Burthorpe Vine hasn't finished growing.
translation: 还有，伯索普藤蔓还没长完。

english: One would give you another, but you do not appear to have room for it.
translation: 本宫本想再给你一个，但你似乎没有空间放了。

english: Leave one's table alone, peasant!
translation: 离本宫的桌子远点，农民！

english: Botherations, will you never leave one alone?!? One has no further need for you, so please do one a favour and remove your ungainly presence from my husband's garden before one has you arrested for loitering!
translation: 烦死了，你就不能放过本宫吗？！？本宫不再需要你了，所以请你行行好，在本宫以闲荡罪逮捕你之前，从本宫丈夫的花园里消失！

english: I see that the pink rosebush hasn't finished growing.
translation: 我看到粉色玫瑰丛还没长好。

english: What are you doing, peasant? I have no need for that.
translation: 你在干什么，农民？本宫不需要那个。

english: Have you brought my dear husband to witness the garden that one has created for him? No? Then why are you wasting one's time then, you horrid little man?
translation: 你带本宫亲爱的丈夫来看本宫为他创造的花园了吗？没有？那你为什么还在浪费本宫的时间，你这可恶的小男人？

english: Yes, very good peasant, you've got the seed; but it's a pink rosebush that one wishes, not seeds. Plant it in the pink rosebush patch, and let it grow.
translation: 是的，很好农民，你拿到种子了；但本宫想要的是粉色玫瑰丛，不是种子。把它种在粉色玫瑰丛苗圃里，让它生长。

english: Have you brought my dear husband to witness the garden that one has created for him? No? Then why are you wasting one's time then, you horrid little woman?

english: Yes, very good peasant, you've got the seed; but it's a white rosebush that one wishes, not seeds. Plant it in the white rosebush patch, and let it grow.

english: I see that the red rosebush hasn't finished growing.

english: Yes, very good peasant, you've got the seed; but it's a red rosebush that one wishes, not seeds. Plant it in the red rosebush patch, and let it grow.
translation: 是的，很好农民，你拿到种子了；但本宫想要的是红色玫瑰丛，不是种子。把它种在红色玫瑰丛苗圃里，让它生长。

english: Yes pumpkin?
translation: 怎么了南瓜？

english: Pumpkin I-
translation: 南瓜我——

english: Yes, citizen. Do you need something?
translation: 是的，市民。你需要什么吗？

english: Would you like to follow me for a minute?
translation: 你愿意跟我走一会儿吗？

english: Follow you?!? I am the King! I am the followed, not the follower!!
translation: 跟你走？！？我是国王！我是被跟随的人，不是跟随者！！

english: Well, if you can't be bothered then neither can I.
translation: 好吧，如果你不乐意，那我也不乐意。

english: No, you suit yourself.
translation: 不，你随意。

english: You're quite argumentative for a peasant.
translation: 作为一个农民，你还挺爱抬杠的。

english: I'm not the one who's arguing, you are.
translation: 抬杠的不是我，是你。

english: Then why do you keep answering me back?
translation: 那你为什么一直顶嘴？

english: No, you're answering me back.
translation: 不，是你在顶嘴。

english: Well, stop talking and I'll stop answering.
translation: 好吧，你闭嘴我就不回嘴了。

english: No, you stop talking.
translation: 不，你闭嘴。

english: I have stopped talking.
translation: 我已经闭嘴了。

english: No you haven't, you're doing it now.
translation: 不，你没有，你现在就在说话。

english: No, I'm just answering what you're saying.
translation: 不，我只是在回应你说的话。

english: Okay, so if I don't say anything, you won't answer me back.
translation: 好吧，那如果我不说话，你就不会回嘴了。

english: Suits me.
translation: 我没意见。

english: Go on, then.
translation: 那你先请。

english: No, you first.
translation: 不，你先。

english: See, that's better.
translation: 看，这样好多了。

english: Yes, much better.
translation: 是的，好多了。

english: What were you saying about me following you somewhere?
translation: 你刚才说让我跟你去什么地方来着？

english: I can't remember, it was such a long time ago.
translation: 我不记得了，那是很久以前的事了。

english: Ah, that's a shame - I could have done with a breath of fresh air.
translation: 啊，真可惜——我本来可以出去透透气的。

english: Yes, never mind.
translation: 是啊，算了。

english: Yes, see you later.
translation: 好的，回头见。

english: I thought you were going.
translation: 我以为你要走了。

english: I was until you spoke to me again.
translation: 我本来是要走的，直到你又跟我说话。

english: I'm sorry, I'll stop speaking to you then.
translation: 抱歉，那我就不跟你说话了。

english: Of course, your majesty - please forgive me.
translation: 当然，陛下——请原谅我。

english: Forgiveness is something that cannot be earned so easily. And I'm certainly not following you off on some wild goose chase when I have important matters of state to attend to.
translation: 宽恕可不是那么容易就能得到的。而且我手头有重要的国事要处理，可没空跟你去搞什么荒唐的追鹅行动。

english: That's it - I've had it with royalty.
translation: 够了——我受够这些王室成员了。

english: And I've had enough of peasantry! Get out of my castle!
translation: 我也受够你们这些农民了！滚出我的城堡！

english: The Queen asked me to bring you.
translation: 是王后让我来带你过去的。

english: Ellie?
translation: 艾莉？

english: Now that's a different matter. Lead on, peasant - let's see what my darling wife has been up to now.
translation: 这倒另当别论。带路吧，农民——让我看看我亲爱的妻子又在搞什么名堂。

english: You will have to excuse me then. I am very busy as I have a kingdom to run!
translation: 那你得原谅我了。我很忙，毕竟要管理一个王国！

english: This is murder on my hay fever you know...
translation: 你知道这简直要了我的花粉症老命……

english: What have you been up to now, pumpkin?
translation: 你又搞什么名堂了，南瓜？

english: Have you been spending my money again?
translation: 你是不是又在乱花我的钱？

english: Here's some orchids from Morytania.
translation: 这是从莫利塔尼亚弄来的兰花。

english: Orchids bring me out in a rash.
translation: 兰花会让我起疹子。

english: Vines from Burthorpe!
translation: 从伯索普公国弄来的藤蔓！

english: Oh great, let's hope they don't eat into the walls.
translation: 哦，太好了，希望它们别把墙给啃了。

english: Snowdrops from Ardougne!
translation: 从阿多尼城弄来的雪花莲！

english: What a boring colour.
translation: 颜色真单调。

english: The last surviving White Tree!
translation: 最后一棵幸存的白树！

english: Should make a nice table and chairs.
translation: 应该能做成不错的桌子和椅子。

english: Delphiniums from Falador!
translation: 从法拉多城弄来的翠雀花！

english: I hate delphiniums.
translation: 我讨厌翠雀花。

english: Actually I think I did most of-
translation: 其实我觉得大部分都是我——

english: Thank you very much my darling.
translation: 非常感谢你，亲爱的。

english: Yes pumpkin.
translation: 是的，南瓜。

english: Only sometimes?
translation: 只是有时候？

english: Are you being rude again ... ?
translation: 你是不是又在无礼了……？

english: What's the supercompost potion for?
translation: 那超级堆肥药水是干嘛用的？

english: No, I didn't mean that-
translation: 不，我不是那个意思——

english: Hello, are you okay?
translation: 你好，你没事吧？

english: Do I look okay? Those kids drive me crazy.
translation: 我看起来像没事吗？那些孩子快把我逼疯了。

english: I'm sorry. It's just that I've lost her.
translation: 抱歉。只是我找不到她了。

english: Lost who?
translation: 找不到谁？

english: Fluffs, poor Fluffs. She never hurt anyone.
translation: 毛毛，可怜的毛毛。她从没伤害过任何人。

english: Who's Fluffs?
translation: 毛毛是谁？

english: My beloved feline friend Fluffs. She's been purring by my side for almost a decade. Please, could you go search for her while I look over the kids?
translation: 我心爱的猫咪朋友弗拉芙丝。她在我身边咕噜咕噜叫了快十年了。拜托，你能不能在我照看孩子们的时候去找找她？

english: Well, I suppose I could.
translation: 嗯，我想我可以试试。

english: Really? Thank you so much! I really have no idea where she could be!
translation: 真的吗？太感谢你了！我真的不知道她会在哪里！

english: I think my sons, Shilop and Wilough, saw the cat last. They'll be out in the market place.
translation: 我想我的儿子们，希洛普和威洛，最后见过那只猫。他们现在应该在市场那边。

english: Alright then, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，那我去看看能帮上什么忙。

english: Sorry, I'm too busy to play pet rescue.
translation: 抱歉，我太忙了，没空玩宠物救援。

english: Well, okay then. I'll have to find someone else.
translation: 好吧，那算了。我得找别人了。

english: Hello Gertrude.
translation: 你好，格特鲁德。

english: Have you seen my poor Fluffs?
translation: 你看到我可怜的毛毛了吗？

english: What about Shilop?
translation: 希洛普呢？

english: No sign of him either.
translation: 也没看到他。

english: Hmmm...strange, he should be at the market.
translation: 嗯……奇怪，他应该会在市场才对。

english: Hello there, I've been looking for you.
translation: 嘿，我一直在找你。

english: I didn't mean to take it! I just forgot to pay.
translation: 我不是故意要拿的！我只是忘了付钱。

english: What? I'm trying to help your mum find Fluffs.
translation: 什么？我在帮你妈妈找毛毛。

english: I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.
translation: 我可能帮得上忙。毛毛跟着我去了我的秘密游乐区，之后我就再没见过它了。

english: Ohh...well, in that case I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to my secret play area, I haven't seen her since.
translation: 哦……好吧，那样的话我可能帮得上忙。毛毛跟着我去了我的秘密游乐区，之后我就再没见过它了。

english: Where is this play area?
translation: 这个游乐区在哪里？

english: If I told you that, it wouldn't be a secret.
translation: 如果我告诉你了，那就不叫秘密了。

english: Tell me sonny, or I will hurt you.
translation: 告诉我，小子，否则我就对你不客气。

english: W..wh..what?! Y..you wouldn't! A young lad like me! I'd have you behind bars before nightfall!
translation: 你……你……什么？！你……你不敢！像我这样的小伙子！天黑前我就能把你送进监狱！

english: What will make you tell me?
translation: 要怎样你才肯告诉我？

english: Well...now you ask, I am a bit short on cash.
translation: 嗯……既然你问了，我手头确实有点紧。

english: 10 coins.
translation: 10个金币。

english: 10 coins?!
translation: 10个金币？！

english: I'll handle this.
translation: 让我来处理。

english: 100 coins should cover it.
translation: 100个金币应该够了。

english: 100 coins! Why should I pay you?
translation: 100个金币！我为什么要付钱给你？

english: You shouldn't, but we won't help otherwise. We never liked that cat anyway, so what do you say?
translation: 你是不该付，但否则我们就不帮忙。反正我们从来就不喜欢那只猫，你觉得呢？

english: I'm not paying you a penny.
translation: 我一分钱都不会给你。

english: Okay then, I'll find another way to make money.
translation: 那好吧，我找别的办法赚钱。

english: Okay then, I'll pay.
translation: 好吧，我付钱。

english: There you go, now where did you see Fluffs ?
translation: 给你，现在告诉我你在哪里看到毛毛的？

english: I play at an abandoned lumber mill to the north east. Just beyond the Jolly Boar Inn. I saw Fluffs running around in there.
translation: 我在东北边一个废弃的木材磨坊玩。就在快乐野猪旅店过去一点。我看到毛毛在那里跑来跑去。

english: Well, you'll have to find the broken fence to get in. I'm sure you can manage that.
translation: 嗯，你得找到破损的栅栏才能进去。我相信你能搞定。

english: Well, never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
translation: 算了，是毛毛没福气。

english: I'm sure my mum will get over it.
translation: 我相信我妈妈会想开的。

english: Where did you say you saw Fluffs?
translation: 你刚才说在哪里看到毛毛的？

english: Weren't you listening? I saw the flea bag in the old lumber mill just north east of here. Just walk past the Jolly Boar Inn and you should find it.
translation: 你没在听吗？我在东北边那个旧木材磨坊里看到那只跳蚤包的。走过快乐野猪旅店就能找到。

english: Hello again, did you manage to find Shilop? I can't keep an eye on him for the life of me.
translation: 又见面了，你找到希洛普了吗？我根本看不住他。

english: He does seem quite a handful.
translation: 他确实挺难管的。

english: You have no idea! Did he help at all?
translation: 你根本不知道！他帮上忙了吗？

english: I think so, I'm just going to look now.
translation: 我想是的，我现在就去找找看。

english: Thanks again, adventurer.
translation: 再次感谢你，冒险者。

english: Hisss!
Hello. How's it going? Any luck?
translation: 你好。怎么样了？有进展吗？

english: Yes, I've found Fluffs!
translation: 是的，我找到毛毛了！

english: Well well, you are clever! Did you bring her back?
translation: 哎呀，你真聪明！你把它带回来了吗？

english: Well, that's the thing, she refuses to leave.
translation: 嗯，问题就在这里，它不肯离开。

english: Oh dear, oh dear! Maybe she's just hungry. She loves doogle sardines but I'm all out.
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪！也许它只是饿了。它很喜欢杜格尔沙丁鱼，但我都用完了。

english: Doogle sardines?
translation: 杜格尔沙丁鱼？

english: Yes, raw sardines seasoned with doogle leaves. Unfortunately I've used all my doogle leaves, but you may find some in the woods out back.
translation: 是的，用杜格尔叶调味的生沙丁鱼。可惜我的杜格尔叶都用完了，不过你也许能在后面的树林里找到一些。

english: Hey traveller, did Fluffs eat the sardines?
translation: 嘿，旅行者，毛毛吃沙丁鱼了吗？

english: Yeah, she loved them, but she still won't leave.
translation: 吃了，它很喜欢，但它还是不肯走。

english: Well that is strange, there must be a reason.
translation: 那真是奇怪，一定有什么原因。

english: Purr...
translation: 咕噜……

english: Hello Gertrude. Fluffs ran off with her kitten.
translation: 你好，格特鲁德。毛毛带着它的小猫跑了。

english: You're back! Thank you! Thank you! Fluffs just came back! I think she was just upset as she couldn't find her kitten.
translation: 你回来了！谢谢你！谢谢你！毛毛刚回来了！我想它只是因为找不到它的小猫而难过。

english: If you hadn't found her kitten it would have died out there!
translation: 如果你没找到它的小猫，它可能就死在外面了！

english: That's okay, I like to do my bit.
translation: 没关系，我喜欢尽一份力。

english: I don't know how to thank you. I have no real material possessions. I do have kittens! I can only really look after one.
translation: 我不知道该怎么感谢你。我没什么值钱的东西。但我有小猫！我只能照顾一只。

english: Well, if it needs a home.
translation: 嗯，如果它需要一个家的话。

english: I would sell it to my cousin in West Ardougne. I hear there's a rat epidemic there. But it's too far.
translation: 我本来想把它卖给我在西阿多尼城的表亲。我听说那里老鼠成灾。但太远了。

english: Here you go, look after her and thank you again!
translation: 给你，照顾好它，再次感谢你！

english: Oh by the way, the kitten can live in your backpack, but to make it grow you must take it out and feed and stroke it often.
translation: 哦对了，小猫可以住在你的背包里，但要让它长大，你必须经常把它拿出来喂食和抚摸。

english: I think we're good. Thank you for the offer though.
translation: 我觉得我们没问题。不过谢谢你的好意。

english: Well actually, there is something we've been having a problem with.
translation: 呃，其实有件事我们遇到了麻烦。

english: Recently, some strange beast has been stealing our livestock at night. The soldiers are too busy dealing with the lizardmen to help, so we haven't been able to stop it.
translation: 最近，有只奇怪的野兽晚上偷我们的牲畜。士兵们忙着对付蜥蜴人，没空帮忙，所以我们一直没能阻止它。

english: You look like you know your way around a weapon. If you can kill the beast and bring me its head as proof, I'll ensure you are compensated for your trouble.
translation: 你看起来挺会用武器的。如果你能杀了那只野兽，把它的头带回来作为证明，我会确保你得到应有的报酬。

english: Bring back the head? I can do that. I'm good at killing things. Do you know where the beast is?
translation: 把头带回来？我能做到。我很擅长杀东西。你知道那只野兽在哪儿吗？

english: Well it can't be living too far from here, but I don't know exactly where. You might want to check with my wife, Mary. Perhaps she's seen something I haven't.
translation: 它应该不会离这儿太远，但我不确定具体位置。你可以问问我妻子玛丽，也许她看到了我没注意到的东西。

english: Very well. I'll return once I have the head of this beast!
translation: 好吧。等我拿到这只野兽的头就回来！

english: Not something I can help with I'm afraid. Good luck though.
translation: 恐怕这个我帮不上忙。不过祝你好运。

english: I understand. I'm sure someone else will be able to help.
translation: 我明白。我相信会有其他人能帮忙的。

english: Hello again. Any luck finding that beast?
translation: 又见面了。找到那只野兽了吗？

english: I've been trying, but I haven't made much progress yet.
translation: 一直在找，但还没什么进展。

english: Well it can't be living too far from here. You might want to check with my wife, Mary. Perhaps she's seen something I haven't.
translation: 它应该不会离这儿太远。你可以问问我妻子玛丽，也许她看到了我没注意到的东西。

english: Hello there. Are you Mary?
translation: 你好，你是玛丽吗？

english: That's right. Who are you?
translation: 没错。你是谁？

english: I'm [player name]. Your husband told me that some beast has been causing you both trouble. I've agreed to kill it and bring back its head!
translation: 我是[player name]。你丈夫告诉我，有只野兽给你们带来了麻烦。我同意去杀了它，并把它的头带回来！

english: Ah, that's good to hear. We've already lost a lot of livestock to it.
translation: 啊，那太好了。我们已经损失了不少牲畜。

english: Well fear not. I'm sure I'll make short work of it. I do have one issue, however.
translation: 别担心。我很快就会解决它。不过我有个问题。

english: I don't yet know where to find this beast. I was wondering if you'd seen anything?
translation: 我还不知道去哪儿找这只野兽。你看到过什么吗？

english: I'm afraid not. It only ever comes in the night, so we haven't been able to get a proper look at it.
translation: 恐怕没有。它只在晚上出没，所以我们没能看清它。

english: Hmm. This is a problem.
translation: 嗯，这有点麻烦。

english: Oh! I have an idea! If this beast ended up getting coated in flour, it wouldn't be hard for you to track it back to its home.
translation: 哦！我有个主意！如果这只野兽身上沾了面粉，你就不难跟踪它回老巢了。

english: But how would I get it coated in flour?
translation: 那我怎么让它沾上面粉呢？

english: Oh come on now! You're the adventurer here! Why don't you use your head?
translation: 哦，别这样！你才是冒险者！为什么不动动脑子？

english: Use my head? Wait... Did you just...?
translation: 动动脑子？等等……你刚才是……？

english: I don't know what you mean.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。

english: Hello there. How goes the headhunt?
translation: 你好。猎头进展如何？

english: I'm still trying to come up with a way to cover the beast in flour.
translation: 我还在想办法让那只野兽沾上面粉。

english: Well I'm sure you'll think of something. Just remember to use your head.
translation: 我相信你会想到办法的。记住要动动脑子。

english: Hello. Do you know anything about the beast causing trouble around here?
translation: 你好。你知道关于那只在这里惹麻烦的野兽的事吗？

english: The farmers mentioned it. We haven't seen anything though. Our focus is on the lizardmen.
translation: 农夫们提过。但我们没看到什么。我们的重点是蜥蜴人。

english: Surely you'd notice a big beast wondering around though?
translation: 但一只大野兽到处晃悠，你们肯定能注意到吧？

english: The farmers said it came at night. We're not on shift then.
translation: 农夫说它是晚上来的。那时候我们不在岗。

english: But then who's guarding the farm at night?
translation: 那晚上谁在守卫农场？

english: That's not our problem. We're just here to follow orders.
translation: 那不关我们的事。我们只是奉命行事。

english: Fine. I'll find the beast myself.
translation: 好吧。我自己去找那只野兽。

english: Anything you need from me?
translation: 你需要我做什么吗？

english: Just one question. You said this beast has been going for your livestock. Which animals has it been targeting?
translation: 就一个问题。你说这只野兽一直偷你的牲畜。它主要针对哪种动物？

english: It's mainly been going for the cattle. I fixed up a new gate which has kept it out the past couple of nights. Not sure how long it will hold though.
translation: 主要是牛。我修了个新栅栏，前两晚挡住了它。不过不知道能撑多久。

english: There we go. Anything that touches this gate will end up coated in flour. Now just to wait for the beast to come...
translation: 好了。任何碰到这扇栅栏的东西都会沾上面粉。现在就等着野兽来了……

english: Looks like the beast tried to get in again. Now to see if the flour plan worked...
translation: 看来野兽又试图进来了。现在看看面粉计划有没有奏效……

english: Your wife gave me a good idea to help track it down. I'll have its head soon enough!
translation: 你妻子给了我一个好主意来追踪它。我很快就会拿到它的头！

english: Great to hear!
translation: 太好了！

english: The flour idea worked great. Now I just need to find the beast's home.
translation: 面粉主意很管用。现在只需要找到野兽的老巢了。

english: Well keep your head up. I'm sure you'll manage it.
translation: 那就振作起来。我相信你能做到的。

english: Ah... a headless beast. Can't really bring back the head if there isn't one. Let's hope Gordon is still happy to reward me...
translation: 啊……一头无头野兽。如果没有头，就没法把头带回去。希望戈登仍然愿意给我奖励……

english: I've run into a little issue. The beast is dead, but it didn't have a head.
translation: 我遇到了个小问题。野兽已经死了，但它没有头。

english: Oh dear. You should probably talk to Gordon about this.
translation: 哦，天哪。你应该去跟戈登谈谈这个。

english: The beast is dead!
translation: 野兽死了！

english: Wonderful! Do you have the head?
translation: 太好了！你拿到头了吗？

english: Well that's the thing...
translation: 呃，问题就在这里……

english: Is there a problem?
translation: 有什么问题吗？

english: So it didn't actually have a head.
translation: 它实际上没有头。

english: Didn't have a head?
translation: 没有头？

english: Like... at all?
translation: 就是……完全没头？

english: Not even a proper stump.
translation: 连个像样的树桩都没有。

english: Can I get paid now?
translation: 现在能给我报酬了吗？

english: I'm sorry, but no. I agreed to pay you for a head and you don't have one.
translation: 抱歉，不行。我同意你拿头来换报酬，而你并没有头。

english: Well actually I do have a head. Quite a good looking one in fact. It was the beast that didn't.
translation: 其实我确实有头。实际上还挺好看的。没头的是那只野兽。

english: That's not what I meant. Look, it's nothing personal, but I can't be seen paying someone if they didn't do the job.
translation: 我不是那个意思。听着，这不是针对你，但如果有人没完成任务，我不能给人付钱。

english: But I did the job... How am I meant to bring you the head of a beast with no head?
translation: 但我确实完成了任务……一只没有头的野兽，我怎么能把它的头带来？

english: Maybe you killed the wrong beast? It doesn't make sense that a headless beast would be taking cattle. How would it eat them?
translation: 也许你杀错了野兽？无头野兽会偷牛，这说不通啊。它怎么吃呢？

english: Well if you manage to get hold of the beast's head, let me know. Until then, I can't pay you.
translation: 如果你设法弄到野兽的头，就告诉我。在那之前，我不能付你钱。

english: Hello again. Do you have the head of that beast yet?
translation: 又见面了。你拿到那只野兽的头了吗？
