english: Well I can't pay you if you don't have the head.
translation: 如果你没有头，我不能付你钱。

english: I don't have the head of the beast. I do have proof it was headless though.
translation: 我没有野兽的头。但我有证据证明它是无头的。

english: Proof? This doesn't seem like proof to me. Anyone could have written this. Maybe you wrote it?
translation: 证据？这在我看来不像证据。谁都能写这个。也许是你写的？

english: You assume I can read and write.
translation: 你假设我能读会写。

english: Can you?
translation: 你能吗？

english: Well.. yes. I promise I didn't write this though.
translation: 呃……是的。但我发誓这不是我写的。

english: Well you would say that. I'm sorry but I'm not having this. Come back when you have the head of the beast.
translation: 你当然会这么说。抱歉，我不接受这个。等你拿到野兽的头再回来。

english: I don't have the head of the beast. I do have the bones though!
translation: 我没有野兽的头。但我有它的骨头！

english: Bones? I don't want bones! I want the beast's head!
translation: 骨头？我不要骨头！我要野兽的头！

english: Have you considered that you might be being too picky?
translation: 你有没有想过你可能太挑剔了？

english: Of course not! Besides, these bones could be from anywhere.
translation: 当然没有！再说了，这些骨头可能来自任何地方。

english: Eugh! Fine!
translation: 呃！好吧！

english: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof!
translation: 我打败了野兽，现在把它的头带来作为证明！

english: Hmmm... I'm not so sure...
translation: 嗯……我不太确定……

english: This is literally the head of a dead bear. What is wrong with you?
translation: 这根本就是一只死亡的熊的头。你怎么回事？

english: I can see this is the head of a bear! This beast we're dealing with is more than a mere bear though!
translation: 我看得出这是熊的头！但我们对付的这只野兽可不仅仅是一只熊！

english: What? You said you'd never seen the beast! How do you know it wasn't just a bear?
translation: 什么？你说你从没见过那只野兽！你怎么知道它不只是一只熊？

english: We've dealt with bears before! This is clearly something more! Now, go and find the real beast!
translation: 我们之前对付过熊！这显然更厉害！现在，去找真正的野兽！

english: What? But this is clearly just part of a costume!
translation: 什么？但这显然只是戏服的一部分！

english: Err... No it's not...
translation: 呃……不，不是……

english: It's hollow!
translation: 它是空的！

english: Maybe it didn't have any brains.
translation: 也许它没有脑子。

english: The only thing without brains is you! Come back once you have the actual head!
translation: 唯一没脑子的人是你！等你拿到真正的头再回来！

english: I've run into a little issue. The beast is dead, but it didn't have a head. Your husband says he won't pay me until I bring him one.
translation: 我遇到了个小问题。野兽已经死了，但它没有头。你丈夫说除非我带回头来，否则不付我钱。

english: Oh dear. I'm afraid Gordon can be quite picky sometimes.
translation: 哦天哪。恐怕戈登有时候挺挑剔的。

english: But what do I do now? I can't bring him a head if there isn't one.
translation: 但我现在该怎么办？如果没有头，我总不能带给他一个头。

english: Well, between you and me, Gordon is a good farmer but I wouldn't say he's a genius by any means. He also doesn't actually know what the beast looks like.
translation: 嗯，这话我只跟你说，戈登是个好农夫，但他绝不是什么天才。而且他其实也不知道那只野兽长什么样。

english: So I make him a fake head! Great idea!
translation: 所以我可以给他做个假头！好主意！

english: That's the spirit! I've tried my hand at clay modelling in the past. You can make all sorts of things. Just get some soft clay and a knife and I'm sure you'll be able to make a lovely head.
translation: 就是这个灵魂！我以前试过做粘土模型。你可以做出各种东西。只需拿些软粘土和一把刀，我相信你就能做出一个漂亮的头。

english: I'll give it a shot!
translation: 我会试试的！

english: Hello there. Any luck with that head?
translation: 你好。头的事有进展吗？

english: Keep at it! I've tried my hand at clay modelling in the past. You can make all sorts of things. Just get some soft clay and a knife and I'm sure you'll be able to make a lovely head.
translation: 继续努力！我以前试过做粘土模型。你可以做出各种东西。只需拿些软粘土和一把刀，我相信你就能做出一个漂亮的头。

english: It looks awful!
translation: 它看起来很糟糕！

english: Still, maybe it will be enough to convince Gordon.
translation: 不过，也许足以说服戈登了。

english: I've made a head out of clay.
translation: 我用粘土做了一个头。

english: Wonderful! You should show it to Gordon.
translation: 太好了！你应该拿给戈登看看。

english: Its head? This is its head?
translation: 它的头？这就是它的头？

english: But this just looks like clay... It feels like clay...
translation: 但这看起来就是粘土……摸起来也像粘土……

english: It's falling apart... What creature is this?
translation: 它正在碎裂……这是什么生物？

english: Ah yes! A good question! A very good question! A good question in need of a good answer I'm sure!
translation: 啊，没错！问得好！问得非常好！一个需要好答案的好问题，我敢肯定！

english: Okay... So what is the answer?
translation: 好吧……那答案是什么？

english: Yes... well... This is the head of a... a claybear!
translation: 嗯……这个……这是……一只粘土熊的头！

english: Claybear? There's no such thing!
translation: 粘土熊？哪有这种东西！

english: They're quite rare around here.
translation: 它们在这里相当罕见。

english: Quite rare because they don't exist! I'm no fool, this is clearly a pretend head! It doesn't even have any fur!
translation: 非常罕见，因为它们根本不存在！我不是傻瓜，这显然是个假头颅！上面甚至没有毛皮！

english: Come back once you have the real head of the beast!
translation: 等你拿到真正的野兽头再回来吧！

english: Do you have the head of that beast yet? Or do you just have more clay?
translation: 你拿到那只野兽的头了吗？还是你只有更多的粘土？

english: No head, no pay.
translation: 没头，就没钱。

english: I made a head out of clay. Gordon didn't buy it though.
translation: 我用粘土做了一个头。不过戈登没买账。

english: Oh dear. Keep trying. I'm sure with a few tweaks you can make a head that will convince him.
translation: 哦，天哪。继续试试吧。我相信稍作调整，你就能做出一个能说服他的头。

english: It somehow looks even worse than before!
translation: 不知怎么的，它看起来比之前更糟了！

english: Gordon said it needed fur though. Maybe he'll be happy with this one.
translation: 不过戈登说它需要毛皮。也许这个他会满意。

english: I made a head out of clay. Gordon didn't buy it though, so I've now added some fur.
translation: 我用粘土做了一个头。不过戈登没买账，所以我现在加了些毛皮。

english: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof! For real this time!
translation: 我已经打败了那只野兽，并带来了它的头作为证明！这次是真的！

english: Well there's fur this time. It does look like an actual head, I have to admit.
translation: 嗯，这次有毛皮了。我得承认，它看起来确实像个真头。

english: Yes, I think this is the head of a beast.
translation: 是的，我认为这是一只野兽的头。

english: Wonderful! So about my payment?
translation: 太好了！那我的报酬呢？

english: Well hang on just a moment...
translation: 嗯，先等一下……

english: Where's the blood? If this is a fresh kill, the head should have blood on.
translation: 血呢？如果是刚杀死的，头上应该有血才对。

english: Ah... Yes... Well the thing about this head is that this is the head of a...
translation: 啊……是的……这个嘛，关于这个头，情况是这样的，这是一只……的头

english: A... bloodbear?
translation: 一只……血熊？

english: Bloodbear? What's a bloodbear?
translation: 血熊？什么是血熊？

english: It's a rare type of bear. One that doesn't have any blood.
translation: 一种稀有的熊。一种没有血的熊。

english: It's called a bloodbear but it doesn't have blood? Did a fool name it?
translation: 它叫血熊却没有血？是哪个傻子取的名字？

english: Well actually the one that named it is quite the intellectual... Very cool as well... not that I know them or anything.
translation: 嗯，实际上给它取名的人相当有学识……而且也很酷……虽然我不认识他什么的。

english: You must take me for an idiot! This is some head you bought from a taxidermist or something. It's clearly not a fresh kill!
translation: 你肯定把我当白痴了！这是你从标本师那里买来的头吧。显然不是刚杀死的！

english: Come back once you have the real head!
translation: 等你拿到真正的头再回来！

english: Do you have the head of that beast yet? Or do you just have more fakes?
translation: 你拿到那只野兽的头了吗？还是你只有更多的假货？

english: No head, no reward. Come back once you have it!
translation: 没头，就没奖励。等你拿到了再回来！

english: Gordon didn't buy the clay head so I tried adding some fur. He still wasn't convinced though.
translation: 戈登不相信那是粘土头颅，所以我试着加了些毛皮。但他还是不信。

english: Well I'm sure you're not far off. Keep it up!
translation: 嗯，我相信你离成功不远了。继续加油！

english: Great! Now it looks bloody!
translation: 太棒了！现在它看起来血淋淋的了！

english: Well... it doesn't. It actually looks like someone tried to dye a fur covered clay monstrosity red.
translation: 嗯……并没有。实际上它看起来像是有人试图把一个覆盖着毛皮的粘土怪物染成红色。

english: Still, maybe Gordon won't notice...
translation: 不过，也许戈登不会注意到……

english: Gordon didn't buy the clay head so I tried adding some fur. He still wasn't convinced so I've dyed it red to make it look bloody.
translation: 戈登不相信那是粘土头颅，所以我试着加了些毛皮。他还是不信，于是我把头颅染成红色，让它看起来血淋淋的。

english: Wonderful! I'm sure this will convince him. You should show him what you've got.
translation: 太好了！我相信这一定能说服他。你应该给他看看你做的。

english: I have bested the beast and I bring you its head as proof... Again!
translation: 我已经打败了那只野兽，并带来了它的头作为证明……又一次！

english: It's...
It's wonderful! This is clearly the head of the beast! Well done adventurer!
translation: 太棒了！这显然是那只野兽的头！干得好，冒险者！

english: Hooray!
translation: 万岁！

english: There's just one thing though...
translation: 不过还有一件事……

english: Oh for the love of-
translation: 哦，看在老天的份上——

english: A head like this deserves a place of honour! My friend, please could you mount it in our home?
translation: 这样的头值得一个荣誉之地！我的朋友，你能把它挂在我们家里吗？

english: Eugh. Fine.
translation: 呃。好吧。

english: Have you mounted the head of the beast in our home yet?
translation: 你把那只野兽的头挂在我们家里了吗？

english: Well let me know once you have and I'll give you your reward.
translation: 等你挂好了告诉我，我就给你奖励。

english: Yes. Gordon was happy with the head I made. In fact, he was so happy that he wants it mounting in your home.
translation: 是的。戈登对我做的头很满意。事实上，他高兴得想把它挂在你家里。

english: Oh dear. Well if it keeps him happy, I suppose. There should be a good spot near the stairs.
translation: 哦，天哪。好吧，如果这能让他开心的话，我想也行。楼梯附近应该有个好位置。

english: What a work of art! I've really outdone myself this time! I guess I should let Gordon know.
translation: 真是件艺术品！这次我真是超常发挥了！我想我应该去告诉戈登。

english: Not to worry. If it keeps Gordon happy, so be it. Anyway, you should go and let him know it's all done.
translation: 别担心。只要能让戈登开心，就这样吧。总之，你应该去告诉他一切都弄好了。

english: Have you mounted the head of the beast yet?
translation: 你把那只野兽的头挂起来了吗？

english: That's great! I'd say it's about time for your reward. But first, let's have a look at this head...
translation: 太好了！我想是时候给你奖励了。不过首先，让我们看看这个头……

english: Hello there. Not to bad, thanks.
translation: 你好啊。还不错，谢谢。

english: Nope. Not too long ago you couldn't safely travel around these parts. Too many lizardmen. Some Hosidius explorers discovered how fertile this land was though.
translation: 不。不久之前，你还没法安全地在这些地方旅行。蜥蜴人太多了。不过，一些霍西迪乌斯城的探险家发现了这片土地有多肥沃。

english: Take pity on me, please - eternity stretches out before me and I am helpless in its grasp.
translation: 请可怜可怜我吧——永恒在我面前延伸，我无力挣脱它的掌控。

english: Why, what is the matter?
translation: 怎么了？发生什么事了？

english: Oh, I'm sorry - I was just wailing out loud. I didn't mean to scare you.
translation: 哦，抱歉——我只是在自言自语地哀嚎。我不是故意要吓到你的。

english: No, that's okay - it takes more than a ghost to scare me. What is wrong?
translation: 不，没关系——能吓到我的可不只是幽灵。到底怎么了？

english: Do you know the history of our town?
translation: 你知道我们小镇的历史吗？

english: Yes, I do. It is a very sad story.
translation: 是的，我知道。那是个非常悲伤的故事。

english: Would you help us obtain our release into the next world?
translation: 你愿意帮助我们解脱，前往来世吗？

english: No - could you tell me?
translation: 不——你能告诉我吗？

english: As the years went by, our numbers dwindled and many spoke of abandoning the town for safer lands.  Then, Necrovarus came to us.
translation: 随着岁月流逝，我们的人数日渐减少，许多人提议放弃小镇，前往更安全的土地。然后，尼克罗瓦鲁斯来到了我们身边。

english: That's a very sad story.
translation: 真是个悲伤的故事。

english: Yes, of course I will. Tell me what you want me to do.
translation: 是的，我当然愿意。告诉我需要做什么。

english: Oh, thank you!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！

english: Necrovarus will not listen to those of us who are already dead. He might rethink his position if someone with a mortal soul pleaded our cause.
translation: 尼克罗瓦鲁斯不会听我们这些已死之人的话。但如果有一个拥有凡人之魂的人为我们请愿，他或许会重新考虑他的立场。

english: If he declines, there may yet be another way.
translation: 如果他拒绝，或许还有别的办法。

english: I'm sorry, but it isn't really my problem.
translation: 抱歉，但这真的不关我的事。

english: No, you're right - it's our own fault. If you do change your mind though, please come back and help us. We will be here ... forever.
translation: 不，你说得对——这是我们自己的错。不过，如果你改变主意，请回来帮助我们。我们会一直在这里……永远。

english: Leave me alone - I'm scared of ghosts!!!
translation: 别烦我——我怕幽灵！！！

english: I sense that you have not yet spoken to Necrovarus.
translation: 我感觉你还没和尼克罗瓦鲁斯谈过。

english: No, I was just getting to that.
translation: 不，我正要去呢。

english: Well, I suppose we do have all the time in the world...
translation: 嗯，我想我们有的是时间……

english: I must speak with you on behalf of Velorina.
translation: 我必须代表韦洛里娜和你谈谈。

english: You dare to speak that name in this place?????
translation: 你竟敢在这里提起那个名字？？？？？

english: She wants to pass-
translation: 她想要超-

english: Silence!! Or I will incinerate the flesh from your bones!!!
translation: 闭嘴！！否则我就把你骨头上的肉烧成灰！！！

english: But she-
translation: 但是她-

english: Get out of my sight!! Or I promise you that you will regret your insolence for the rest of eternity!!!
translation: 滚出我的视线！！否则我保证你会为你的无礼后悔永生永世！！！

english: Please, listen to me-
translation: 拜托，听我说-

english: No - listen to me. Go from this place and do not return, or I will remove your head.
translation: 不——听我说。离开这里，别再回来，否则我就砍下你的头。

english: I'm sorry, but Necrovarus will not let you go.
translation: 抱歉，但尼克罗瓦鲁斯不会放你走的。

english: I feared as much. His spirit is a thing of fire and wrath.
translation: 我担心也是如此。他的灵魂充满了火焰和愤怒。

english: You spoke of another way.
translation: 你提到了另一个办法。

english: It is only a small chance. During the building of the Ectofuntus one of Necrovarus's disciples spoke out against him. It is such a long time ago I cannot remember her name, although I knew her as a friend.
translation: 机会渺茫。在建造灵泉期间，尼克罗瓦鲁斯的一个门徒曾出言反对他。那是很久以前的事了，我记不起她的名字，虽然我曾视她为朋友。

english: She fled before the Ectofuntus took control over us, but being a disciple of Necrovarus she would have been privy to many of his darkest secrets. She may know of a way to aid us without Necrovarus.
translation: 她在灵泉控制我们之前就逃走了，但作为尼克罗瓦鲁斯的门徒，她应该知道许多他最黑暗的秘密。她或许知道如何在不借助尼克罗瓦鲁斯的情况下帮助我们。

english: Do you know where this woman can be found?
translation: 你知道这个女人在哪里能找到吗？

english: I have a vision of a small wooden shack, the land it was built on the unholy soil of Morytania. I sense the sea is very close, and that there are loomscastles to the west and the east.
translation: 我预见到一座小木屋，它建在莫利塔尼亚那片不洁的土地上。我感觉大海非常近，东西两侧都有城堡隐约耸立。

english: If it was such a long time ago, won't she be dead already?
translation: 如果那是很久以前的事，她不是应该已经死了吗？

english: She was a friend of mine. Had she died, I would have felt her spirit pass over to the next world, though I may not follow.
translation: 她曾是我的朋友。如果她死了，我应该能感觉到她的灵魂前往来世，尽管我可能无法跟随。

english: Were you once a disciple of Necrovarus in the Temple of Phasmatys, old woman?
translation: 老妇人，你曾经是法斯提斯神庙里尼克罗瓦鲁斯的门徒吗？

english: I don't remember; I am so old and my memory goes back only so far...
translation: 我不记得了；我太老了，记忆只能追溯到那么远……

english: Is there anything that can help to refresh your memory?
translation: 有什么能帮你恢复记忆吗？

english: Yes, I would love a nice hot cup of nettle tea.
translation: 是的，我很想喝一杯热腾腾的荨麻茶。

english: Here's some tea for you, like you asked.
translation: 这是你要的茶。

english: Yes, but it's not in my special cup! I only ever drink from my special cup!!
translation: 是的，但没放在我的特殊杯子里！我只用我的特殊杯子喝茶！！

english: I see. Can I have this special cup, then?
translation: 我明白了。那我能要这个特殊杯子吗？

english: Do you know where I can find nettles around here?
translation: 你知道这附近哪里有荨麻吗？

english: I believe they grow wild in the Haunted Forest.
translation: 我相信它们生长在闹鬼森林里。

english: Here's a lovely cup of tea for you, in your own special cup.
translation: 这是给你的一杯好茶，用你自己的特殊杯子装的。

english: Oh no, it hasn't got milk in it. I only drink tea with milk, I'm afraid.
translation: 哦不，里面没有加牛奶。恐怕我只喝加牛奶的茶。

english: Here's a lovely cup of milky tea for you, in your own special cup.
translation: 这是给你的一杯好奶茶，用你自己的特殊杯子装的。

english: Ah, that's better. Now, let me see... Yes, I was once a disciple of Necrovarus.
translation: 啊，好多了。现在，让我想想……是的，我曾经是尼克罗瓦鲁斯的门徒。

english: I have come from Velorina. She needs your help.
translation: 我是从韦洛里娜那里来的。她需要你的帮助。

english: Velorina? That name sounds familiar...
translation: 韦洛里娜？这个名字听起来很耳熟……

english: Yes, Velorina was once a very good friend! It has been many years since we spoke last. How is she?
translation: 是的，韦洛里娜曾经是我的好朋友！我们上次说话已经很多年了。她还好吗？

english: She's a ghost, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕她变成幽灵了。

english: They are all dead, then. Even Velorina. I should have done something to stop what was happening, instead of running away.
translation: 那么他们都死了。连韦洛里娜也是。我当初应该做点什么来阻止这一切，而不是逃跑。

english: She and many others want to pass on into the next world, but Necrovarus will not let them. Do you know of any way to help them?
translation: 她和许多其他人都想前往来世，但尼克罗瓦鲁斯不放他们走。你知道有什么办法能帮助他们吗？

english: There might be one way...
translation: 也许有一个办法……

english: Do you have such a thing as a ghostspeak amulet?
translation: 你有鬼语护符这种东西吗？

english: No I don't, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我没有。

english: Well, you'll need to find one.
translation: 嗯，那你得去找一个。

english: Yes, I'm carrying one in my bag.
translation: 是的，我包里就带着一个。

english: Well, that's a stroke of luck.
translation: 嗯，那真是走运。

english: Yes, I'm wearing one right now.
translation: 是的，我现在就戴着一个。

english: There is an enchantment that I can perform on such an amulet that will give it the power of command over ghosts. It will work only once, but it will enable you to command Necrovarus to let the ghosts pass on.
translation: 我可以在这种护符上施展一种附魔，赋予它命令幽灵的力量。它只能使用一次，但能让你命令尼克罗瓦鲁斯放那些幽灵前往来世。

english: What do you need to perform the enchantment?
translation: 施展附魔需要什么？

english: Necrovarus had a magical robe for which he must have no more use. Only these robes hold the power needed to perform the enchantment.
translation: 尼克罗瓦鲁斯有一件魔法长袍，他现在肯定用不着了。只有这些长袍拥有施展附魔所需的力量。

english: All his rituals came from a book written by an ancient sorcerer from the East called Haricanto. Bring me this strange book.
translation: 他所有的仪式都来自一本由东方古代巫师哈里坎托所写的书。把这本书奇怪的书带给我。

english: You are doing so much for me - is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 你为我做了这么多——有什么我能为你做的吗？

english: I have lived here on my own for many years, but not always. When I left Port Phasmatys, I took my son with me. He grew up to be a fine boy, always in love with the sea.
translation: 我独自在这里住了很多年，但并非一直如此。当我离开法斯提斯港时，我带上了我的儿子。他长大后成了一个好孩子，始终热爱大海。

english: He was about twelve years old when he ran away with some pirates to be a cabin boy. I never saw him again.
translation: 他大约十二岁时，跟着一些海盗跑了，去当船舱侍应。我再也没见过他。

english: That's the second saddest story I have heard today.
translation: 这是我今天听到的第二悲伤的故事。

english: If you ever see him, please give him this...and tell him that his mother still loves him.
translation: 如果你见到他，请把这个给他……告诉他，他的母亲仍然爱他。

english: Was this his boat?
translation: 这是他的船吗？

english: Yes, he made it himself. It is a model of the very ship in which he sailed away. The paint has peeled off and it has lost its flag, but I could never throw it away.
translation: 是的，他自己做的。这是他乘船离开时那艘船的模型。油漆已经剥落，旗帜也丢了，但我一直舍不得扔掉。

english: If I find him, I will pass it on.
translation: 如果我找到他，我会转交给他的。

english: Remind me - what can I do about Necrovarus?
translation: 提醒我一下——关于尼克罗瓦鲁斯，我能做什么？

english: I cannot read the strange letters of the eastern lands. I will need something to help me translate the book.
translation: 我看不懂东方的奇怪文字。我需要一些东西来帮我翻译这本书。

english: What did you want me to get for you?
translation: 你希望我帮你拿什么？

english: I'll go and search for those items you need.
translation: 我会去搜索你需要的那几样东西。

english: I am afraid I have not found your son yet.
translation: 恐怕我还没找到你的儿子。

english: I never expected that you would find him - although if you do, please let me know.
translation: 我本来也没指望你能找到他——不过如果你找到了，请告诉我。

english: Do you know where I can find the Book of Haricanto?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能找到哈里坎托之书吗？

english: Nobody knows what has happened to the Book. It was stolen when our port was raided by pirates many years ago, and never seen since.
translation: 没人知道那本书的下落。很多年前，我们的港口遭到海盗袭击时，它被偷走了，从此下落不明。

english: Do you know where I can find the Robes of Necrovarus?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能找到尼克罗瓦鲁斯的长袍吗？

english: I imagine they are still worn by his mortal body, which now lies in a coffin inside the Temple.
translation: 我想它们还穿在他凡人的身体上，现在那具身体躺在神庙里的棺材里。

english: I need something to translate the Book of Haricanto.
translation: 我需要一些东西来翻译哈里坎托之书。

english: I don't really know. You could try asking some of the traders from the East - they might be able to help you.
translation: 我不太清楚。你可以问问一些来自东方的商人——他们或许能帮你。

english: I don't remember. Everyone around here just calls me 'boy'.
translation: 我不记得了。这里的人都叫我‘小子’。

english: You're the cabin boy?!?
translation: 你就是那个船舱侍应？！？

english: Yes, and proud of it.
translation: 是的，而且我以此为荣。

english: Can I have the key to the chest?
translation: 能把箱子的钥匙给我吗？

english: Hang on, let me ask the Captain ...
translation: 等等，让我问问船长……

english: The Captain says no.
translation: 船长说不行。

english: Is this your toy boat?
translation: 这是你的玩具船吗？

english: No - I made a toy boat a long while ago, but that one had a flag.
translation: 不——我很久以前做过一艘玩具船，但那艘船上有一面旗帜。

english: No - I made a toy boat a long while ago, but the colours on the flag were different.
translation: 不——我很久以前做过一个玩具船，但旗帜的颜色不一样。

english: My word - so it is!!! I never thought I would see it again!! Where did you get it from?
translation: 天哪——真的是它！！！我从没想过还能再见到它！！你从哪里弄来的？

english: Your mother gave it to me to pass on to you.
translation: 你母亲让我转交给你的。

english: My mother? She still lives?
translation: 我母亲？她还活着？

english: Yes, in a shack to the west of here.
translation: 是的，就在西边的一个小屋里。

english: After all these years ...
translation: 这么多年过去了……

english: Can I have the key to the chest, then?
translation: 那我能拿箱子的钥匙了吗？

english: The Captain says yes.
translation: 船长说可以。

english: I've lost my key to the chest - do you have another one?
translation: 我弄丢了箱子的钥匙——你还有另一把吗？

english: What? But the chest is only just over there! How on Gielinor did you lose it in that short distance?
translation: 什么？箱子就在那边！你在吉列诺是怎么在这么短的距离内弄丢的？

english: Sorry, I won't do it again...
translation: 抱歉，我不会再犯了……

english: Good news! I have found your son!
translation: 好消息！我找到你儿子了！

english: Goodness! Where is he?
translation: 天哪！他在哪里？

english: He lives on a shipwreck to the east of here. He remembers you and wishes you well.
translation: 他住在东边的一艘沉船上。他还记得你，并祝你安好。

english: Oh thank you!! I will travel to see him as soon as I am able!!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！！我一有机会就去看他！！

english: As a matter of fact, it does seem a little expensive. 10 ectotokens it is then.
translation: 事实上，确实有点贵。那就10个灵界代币吧。

english: Would you like to visit Dragontooth Island? If so, I recommend you take off that sheet first. The winds are very strong out at sea.
translation: 你想去龙牙岛吗？如果要去，我建议你先脱掉那张床单。海上的风非常大。

english: If you would like to visit Dragontooth Island, I recommend you take off that sheet first. The winds are very strong out at sea.
translation: 如果你想去龙牙岛，我建议你先脱掉那张床单。海上的风非常大。

english: It's nice to see a human face around here.
translation: 在这里看到一张人类面孔真好。

english: My name Ak-Haranu. I am trader, come from many far across sea in east.
translation: 我叫阿克.哈兰努。我是个商人，从遥远的东方跨海而来。

english: You come from the lands of the East? Do you have anything that can help me translate a book that is scribed in your language?
translation: 你来自东方大陆？你有没有什么东西能帮我翻译一本用你们语言写的书？

english: Ak-Haranu may help you. A translation manual I have, much good for reading Eastern language.
translation: 阿克.哈兰努或许能帮你。我有一本翻译手册，对阅读东方语言很有用。

english: Ak-Haranu not want money for this book, as is such small thing. But there may be something you could do for me. I am big admirer of Robin, Master Bowman. He staying in village inn.
translation: 阿克.哈兰努不想要这本书的钱，这只是小事一桩。但也许你能帮我做点事。我非常崇拜神射手罗宾大师。他住在村里的旅馆里。

english: What would you like me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？

english: Please get Master Bowman sign an oak longbow for me, so Ak-Haranu can show family and friends when returning home and become much admired. Then I give you book in exchange.
translation: 请让神射手大师在一把橡木长弓上签名，这样阿克.哈兰努回家后就能向家人朋友展示，备受钦佩。然后我就把书给你作为交换。

english: Okay, wait here - I'll get you your bow.
translation: 好的，在这里等着——我去给你拿弓。

english: Sorry, I have too much to do at the moment.
translation: 抱歉，我现在有太多事要做。

english: Have you got an oak longbow that I can get Robin to sign for you?
translation: 你有橡木长弓让我找罗宾签名给你吗？

english: No, Ak-Haranu afraid that no longbow in supply at moment. You must make one or buy one.
translation: 不，阿克.哈兰努恐怕目前没有长弓存货。你得自己做一把或买一把。

english: How Master [player name] getting on with longbow?
translation: [player name]大师，长弓的事怎么样了？

english: I'll let you know.
translation: 我会告诉你的。

english: Hey you, why don't you have a game of Runedraw with me? If you've got 25 gold pieces I've got a bag of runes we can use.
translation: 嘿，你，要不要跟我玩一局符文抽？如果你有25个金币，我有一袋符石可以玩。

english: I don't have enough money on me for a game of Runedraw at the moment.
translation: 我现在身上没带够钱玩符文抽。

english: Yes, I'll give you a game.
translation: 好，我跟你玩一局。

english: So are you going to pay up then? You owe me [#] gold coins!
translation: 那你打算付钱了吗？你欠我[#]个金币！

english: How about another game? I'll pay you back with the winnings.
translation: 再玩一局怎么样？我用赢来的钱还你。

english: What if you lose again?
translation: 要是你又输了呢？

english: Er ... we'll deal with that when we come to it.
translation: 呃……到时候再说吧。

english: No, you didn't pay up the last time you lost.
translation: 不，你上次输了就没付钱。

english: Well done, you beat me. But you still owe me [#] gold pieces.
translation: 干得好，你赢了我。但你还欠我[#]个金币。

english: Err ... how about another game? We can settle up after we've finished playing.
translation: 呃……再玩一局怎么样？玩完了我们再结账。

english: I've had enough of you not paying up - you owe me 100 gold coins. I'm going to tell the ghosts what you're doing.
translation: 我受够了你不付钱——你欠我100个金币。我要去告诉幽灵们你在干什么。

english: Please don't do that!!! They will suck the life from my bones!!!
translation: 求求你别那样做！！！他们会吸干我骨头里的生命！！！

english: How about you signing my longbow then?
translation: 那你在我的长弓上签名怎么样？

english: Yes, anything!!!
translation: 好，什么都行！！！

english: How do you play Runedraw?
translation: 符文抽怎么玩？

english: Two players take turns to draw a rune from a bag, which contains ten runes in total. Each rune has a different value: an air rune is worth one point, up to a Nature rune which is worth nine points.
translation: 两名玩家轮流从袋子里抽一个符石，袋子里总共有十个符石。每个符石有不同的分值：风符石值一分，最高到自然符石值九分。

english: If a player draws the Death rune then the game is over, and they have lost.
translation: 如果玩家抽到死亡符石，游戏立即结束，该玩家输。

english: A player can choose to hold if they wish and not draw any more runes, but this runs the risk of the other player drawing more runes until they have a greater points total and win.
translation: 玩家可以选择停牌，不再抽符石，但这有风险，因为对方可能会继续抽符石直到总分更高并获胜。

english: No, that doesn't sound fun.
translation: 不，听起来不好玩。

english: I have your signed longbow for you.
translation: 我给你带来了签名的长弓。

english: Ah, can it be true? You have obtained bow from Master Bowman?
translation: 啊，这是真的吗？你从神射手大师那里拿到了弓？

english: He was more than happy to oblige (cough). Here you are.
translation: 他很乐意帮忙（咳）。给你。

english: May honour be bestowed upon you and your family!
translation: 愿荣耀降临于你和你的家人！

english: I'm sorry, I seem to have lost the translation manual you gave me.
translation: 抱歉，我好像把你给我的翻译手册弄丢了。

english: Ah, no worry, my friend. For the gift of longbow Ak-Haranu would give a thousand books.
translation: 啊，别担心，我的朋友。为了长弓这份礼物，阿克.哈兰努愿意给一千本书。

english: How Mistress [player name] getting on with longbow?
translation: [player name]女士，长弓用得怎么样？

english: But this longbow not signed, Master [player name]!
translation: 但这把长弓没有签名，[player name]先生！

english: But this longbow not signed, Mistress [player name]!
translation: 但这把长弓没有签名，[player name]女士！

english: Ah, no worry, my friend. For the gift of longbow Ak- Haranu would give a thousand books.
translation: 啊，别担心，我的朋友。为了这把长弓的礼物，阿卡-哈拉努愿意献上一千本书。

english: Another signed longbow? No thank you, you have done too much honour already.
translation: 又一把签名的长弓？不用了，你已经给了我太多荣耀。

english: Will you join with me and protest against the evil desires of Necrovarus and his disciples?
translation: 你愿意和我一起抗议尼克罗瓦鲁斯和他门徒的邪恶意图吗？

english: After hearing Velorina's story I will be happy to help out.
translation: 听了维洛琳娜的故事后，我很乐意帮忙。

english: I'd give you a petition form, but you look like you're carrying too much already.
translation: 我想给你一份请愿书，但你看起来已经拿得太多了。

english: Excellent, excellent!! Here - take this petition form, and try and get 10 signatures from the townsfolk.
translation: 太好了，太好了！！给你——拿着这份请愿书，试着从镇民那里收集10个签名。

english: I'm sorry, I seem to have lost my petition form.
translation: 抱歉，我好像弄丢了请愿书。

english: Blown away in the sea breeze, hey? Oh well, can't be helped. I'd give you another one, but you look like you're carrying too much already.
translation: 被海风吹走了，是吧？唉，没办法。我想再给你一份，但你看起来已经拿得太多了。

english: Blown away in the sea breeze, hey? Oh well, can't be helped. Here's another one, but you'll have to start from scratch again.
translation: 被海风吹走了，是吧？唉，没办法。这里还有一份，但你必须从头开始。

english: Come on - you haven't even started yet! You need 10 more signatures.
translation: 加油——你还没开始呢！还需要10个签名。

english: Well, that's a start I supposeYou need [#] more signatures.
translation: 嗯，这算是个开始。你还需要[#]个签名。

english: Not doing bad I see! You need 6 more signatures.
translation: 干得不错嘛！还需要6个签名。

english: Are you sure you haven't done this type of thing before? You need 3 more signatures.
translation: 你确定以前没做过这种事？还需要3个签名。

english: Very nearly there!! Only 1 more signature to go.
translation: 快完成了！！只差1个签名了。

english: You've got them all! Now go and present it to Necrovarus!!
translation: 你全收集到了！现在去把它交给尼克罗瓦鲁斯！！

english: I'm sure you know the story already, but seeing as you asked...
translation: 我相信你已经知道这个故事了，但既然你问了……

english: But old Gravingas is far too obvious in his methods. Now Velorina, she's a ghost of a different colour altogether. If you feel like helping our cause at all, go speak to Velorina.
translation: 但老格拉文加斯的手法太明显了。至于韦洛里娜，她完全是另一种幽灵。如果你想帮助我们的事业，就去找韦洛里娜谈谈吧。

english: I'm sorry, I don't sign autographs.
translation: 抱歉，我不签名的。

english: While you're here, though, why don't you have a game of Runedraw with me? If you've got 25 gold pieces I've got a bag of runes we can use.
translation: 不过，既然你来了，不如跟我玩一局符文抽牌？如果你有25个金币，我有一袋符文可以玩。

english: How about another game?
translation: 再来一局怎么样？

english: You have already claimed your daily bonemeal and slime. Come back again tomorrow for some more.
translation: 你已经领取了今天的骨粉和粘液。明天再来吧。

english: I'll certainly sign your longbow, if you bring me one!!
translation: 如果你给我带一把长弓来，我当然会在上面签名！！

english: Oh, okay - just keep your promise not to tell the ghosts anything.
translation: 哦，好吧——只要你答应不告诉那些幽灵任何事。

english: Would you sign this petition form, please?
translation: 你能在这份请愿书上签名吗？

english: I'm sorry, but it's hard to believe that a mortal could be interested in helping us.
translation: 抱歉，很难相信一个凡人会愿意帮助我们。

english: Why are you wearing that bedsheet? If you're trying to pretend to be one of us, you're not fooling anybody - you're not even green!!
translation: 你为什么穿着那条床单？如果你想假装是我们中的一员，你骗不了任何人——你连绿色都不是！！

english: Most certainly, I will.
translation: 当然，我会签。

english: I'll do anything that annoys Necrovarus.
translation: 只要能惹恼尼克罗瓦鲁斯，我什么都愿意做。

english: Yes! It's about time somebody did something about Necrovarus.
translation: 是的！是时候有人对尼克罗瓦鲁斯做点什么了。

english: It'll cost you...
translation: 得付出代价……

english: I will if you make it worth my while...
translation: 如果你让我觉得值得，我就签……

english: You scratch my back and I'll scratch yours...
translation: 你帮我，我帮你……

english: Oh, it'll cost you [1-3] ecto-tokens.
translation: 哦，得花你[1-3]个幽魂代币。

english: I don't have that many on me.
translation: 我身上没带那么多。

english: No tokens, no signature.
translation: 没代币，没签名。

english: Okay, if you insist.
translation: 好吧，如果你坚持的话。

english: There's no way I'm giving in to corruption.
translation: 我绝不会向腐败低头。

english: I will have you know that I am a fervent supporter of Necrovarus.
translation: 我要告诉你，我是尼克罗瓦鲁斯的狂热支持者。

english: How dare you accost me in the street?
translation: 你怎么敢在街上拦住我？

english: Get lost.
translation: 滚开。

english: I don't have time for this nonsense.
translation: 我没时间管这种无聊事。

english: You only just asked me the same thing! Leave me alone - I've had my say!
translation: 你刚才才问过我同样的事！别烦我——我已经说过了！

english: Thank you for your kind support.
translation: 谢谢你的善意支持。

english: I must let you know, Necrovarus, that I am collecting signatures from the citizens of Port Phasmatys.
translation: 尼克罗瓦鲁斯，我必须告诉你，我正在收集法斯提斯港市民的签名。

english: Oh, I do admire an activist. Do let me know when you're finished, and I'll give it my fullest consideration.
translation: 哦，我确实欣赏活动家。等你完成了，务必告诉我，我会给予最充分的考虑。

english: Necrovarus, I am presenting you with a petition form that has been signed by 10 citizens of Port Phasmatys.
translation: 尼克罗瓦鲁斯，我向你提交一份由十位法斯提斯港市民签名的请愿书。

english: A petition you say? Continue, mortal.
translation: 你说请愿书？继续说，凡人。

english: It says that the citizens of Port Phasmatys should have the right to choose whether they pass over into the next world or not, and not have this decided by the powers that be on their behalf.
translation: 上面写着，法斯提斯港的市民应该有权选择是否前往来世，而不是由当权者替他们决定。

english: So you will let them pass over if they wish?
translation: 所以如果他们愿意，你会让他们过去吗？

english: NO!!!!! Get out of my sight before I burn every ounce of flesh from your bones!!!!!
translation: 不！！！！在我把你骨头上的每一寸肉都烧掉之前，给我滚出我的视线！！！！

english: So, have you changed your mind yet?
translation: 那么，你改变主意了吗？

english: NEVER!!!!!
WHICH IS A VERY LONG TIME!!!!!!
translation: 那是非常长的时间！！！！！！

english: It matters not that you ignore your citizens' wishes, Necrovarus. Wheels have been set in motion, wheels that will set them free.
translation: 尼克罗瓦鲁斯，你无视市民的意愿并不重要。车轮已经开始转动，这些车轮将让他们获得自由。

english: I have almost completely lost patience with you, mortal. Another word, and every threat I have uttered will be made real for you.
translation: 我几乎对你完全失去耐心了，凡人。再说一个字，我所说的每一个威胁都会在你身上成真。

english: What are you doing going in there?
translation: 你进去那里干什么？

english: Err, I was just curious...
translation: 呃，我只是好奇……

english: Inside that room is a coffin, inside which lie the mortal remains of our most glorious master, Necrovarus. None may enter.
translation: 那个房间里有一口棺材，里面躺着我们最光荣的主人尼克罗瓦鲁斯的遗骸。任何人不得进入。

english: What do you think you're doing? Get that away from the Ectofuntus!
translation: 你以为你在干什么？把那东西从灵泉旁边拿开！

english: Put bones of any type into the machine's hopper, and then turn the handle to grind them. You will need a pot to empty the machine of ground up bones.
translation: 把任何类型的骨头放进机器的料斗里，然后转动手柄把它们磨碎。你需要一个罐子来清空机器里磨碎的骨头。

english: woooo wooooo woooo
Not unless you make space to carry it, mortal.
translation: 除非你腾出空间来拿它，凡人。

english: The Book of Haricanto! I have no idea how you came by this, but well done!!
translation: 哈里坎托之书！我不知道你是怎么弄到这本书的，但干得好！！

english: A translation manual - yes, this should do the job.
translation: 一本翻译手册——是的，这应该能行。

english: Good - the robes of Necrovarus.
translation: 好——尼克罗瓦鲁斯的袍子。

english: Wonderful; that's everything I need.
translation: 太棒了；这就是我需要的一切。

english: I seem to have lost my ghostspeak amulet.
translation: 我好像把我的鬼语护符弄丢了。

english: Oh dear, that's unfortunate. You'll have to go and find another one, then.
translation: 哦，天哪，那太不幸了。那你得再去弄一个了。

english: I will now perform the ritual of enchantment.
translation: 我现在将进行附魔仪式。

english: Did it work?
translation: 成功了吗？

english: Actually, I haven't tried it yet.
translation: 实际上，我还没试过。

english: I have had the Amulet of Ghostspeak enchanted, which I shall use to command Necrovarus to set you free.
translation: 我已经让鬼语护符附了魔，我将用它来命令尼克罗瓦鲁斯释放你。

english: Oh, kind adventurer - you are the answer to all our prayers!
translation: 哦，善良的冒险者——你真是我们所有祈祷的答案！

english: You dare to face me again - you must be truly insane!!!!
translation: 你竟敢再次面对我——你一定是真的疯了！！！！

english: No, Necrovarus, I am not insane. With this enchanted amulet of ghostspeak I have the power to command you to do my will!
translation: 不，尼克罗瓦鲁斯，我没疯。有了这个附魔的鬼语护符，我有能力命令你服从我的意志！

english: Let any ghost who so wishes pass on into the next world.
translation: 让任何希望如此的幽灵前往来世。

english: I - will - let ...
Carry on...
translation: 继续……

english: ... ghost who so wishes ...
translation: ……希望如此的幽灵……

english: I think we're almost getting there...
translation: 我想我们快成功了……

english: ... pass into the next world.
translation: ……进入来世。

english: Tell me a joke.
translation: 给我讲个笑话。

english: Knock knock
translation: 咚咚咚

english: Egbert.
translation: 埃格伯特。

english: Egbert who?
translation: 埃格伯特谁？

english: Egbert no bacon.
translation: 埃格伯特没培根。

english: Do a chicken impression.
translation: 模仿一下鸡。

english: Cluck cluck squuuaaaakkkk cluck cluck
translation: 咯咯咯——嘎——咯咯咯

english: I think I've laid an egg...
translation: 我想我下了一个蛋……

english: Quiet, evil priest!! If you try anything I will command you again, but this time it will be to throw yourself into the Endless Void for the rest of eternity.
translation: 闭嘴，邪恶的祭司！！如果你敢耍花样，我会再次命令你，但这次是命令你把自己扔进无尽虚空，永世不得超生。

english: Oh goody goody. I just can't wait.
translation: 哦，太好了太好了。我都等不及了。

english: I have had enough of your pathetic, weak-kneed excuse for a rebellion. Get out of here!!
translation: 我受够了你那可怜巴巴、软弱无能的所谓叛乱了。给我滚出去！！

english: You don't need to tell me [player name] - I sensed the removal of Necrovarus's psychic barrier!
translation: 你不需要告诉我[player name]——我已经感觉到尼克罗瓦鲁斯的精神屏障被移除了！

english: Only happy to help out.
translation: 只是乐于帮忙。

english: Here, take this as a thank you for the service that you have given us.
translation: 拿着这个，作为你为我们所做服务的谢礼。

english: This is an Ectophial. If you ever want to come back to Port Phasmatys, empty this on the floor beneath your feet, and you will be instantly teleported to the temple - the source of its power.
translation: 这是一个灵瓶。如果你以后想回到法斯提斯港，把它倒在你脚下的地板上，你就会立刻被传送到神庙——那是它力量的源头。

english: Remember that once the Ectophial has been used you need to refill it from the Ectofuntus.
translation: 记住，灵瓶使用后，你需要从灵泉重新装满它。

english: You don't need to tell me [player name]- I sensed the removal of Necrovarus's psychic barrier!
translation: 不用你告诉我，[player name]——我已经感觉到尼克罗瓦鲁斯的精神屏障被移除了！

english: I have a vision of a small wooden shack, the land it was built on the unholy soil of Morytania. I sense the sea is very close, and that there looms castles to the west and the east.
translation: 我看到了一个景象：一间小木屋，建在莫利塔尼亚的不洁土壤上。我感觉到大海很近，东西两边都有城堡若隐若现。

english: Oh, kind sir - you are the answer to all our prayers!
translation: 哦，好心的先生——你就是我们所有祈祷的答案！

english: Oh, kind lady - you are the answer to all our prayers!
translation: 哦，好心的女士——你就是我们所有祈祷的答案！

english: No, you've got nowhere to hold it.
translation: 不，你没地方放它。

english: Well, that's a start I suppose You need 9 more signatures.
translation: 嗯，我想这是个开始。你还需要9个签名。

english: Well, that's a start I suppose You need 7 more signatures.
translation: 嗯，我想这是个开始。你还需要7个签名。

english: Well, that's a start I suppose You need 8 more signatures.
translation: 嗯，我想这是个开始。你还需要8个签名。

english: Are you sure you haven't done this type of thing before? You need 2 more signatures.
translation: 你确定你以前没做过这种事？你还需要2个签名。

english: Not doing bad I see! You need 5 more signatures.
translation: 我看干得不错嘛！你还需要5个签名。

english: Not doing bad I see! You need 4 more signatures.
translation: 我看干得不错嘛！你还需要4个签名。

english: So have you presented the petition to Necrovarus?
translation: 那么，你把请愿书交给尼克罗瓦鲁斯了吗？

english: That's exactly what I thought he would do.
translation: 那正是我预料他会做的事。

english: It never hurts to get involved in politics.
translation: 参与政治总没坏处。

english: Are you sure? Have another look in the bank - you might be mistaken.
translation: 你确定吗？再去银行看看——你可能搞错了。

english: All goblins should wear red armour!
translation: 所有哥布林都该穿红色盔甲！

english: Not red! Red armour make you look fat.
translation: 不要红色！红色盔甲会让你显胖。

english: Everything make YOU look fat!
translation: 什么东西穿在你身上都显胖！

english: Fatty!
translation: 胖子！

english: Even this human think you look fat! Don't you, human?
translation: 连这个人类都觉得你胖！对吧，人类？

english: Yes, he looks fat!
translation: 对，他看起来就是胖！

english: Ha ha! See, fatty? Even human think you fat!
translation: 哈哈！看到了吧，胖子？连人类都觉得你胖！

english: Me not care what human think! Human ugly!
translation: 我才不在乎人类怎么想！人类丑死了！

english: Why are you arguing about the colour of your armour?
translation: 你们为什么在争论盔甲的颜色？

english: We decide to celebrate goblin new century by changing colour of our armour. Brown get boring after a bit. We want change.
translation: 我们决定换盔甲颜色来庆祝哥布林新世纪。棕色穿久了很无聊。我们想换换。

english: Problem is, we can't agree on new colour. We think maybe we use old goblin tribe colours, but Bentnoze from rubbish Thorobshuun tribe and me from much better Garagorshuun tribe.
translation: 问题是，我们无法就新颜色达成一致。我们想用古老的哥布林部落颜色，但来自垃圾索罗布舒恩部落的弯鼻子和来自好得多的加拉戈舒恩部落的我意见不合。

english: Thorobshuun tribe colour is red! Way better than silly green of Garagorshuun tribe.
translation: 索罗布舒恩部落的颜色是红色！比加拉戈舒恩部落那愚蠢的绿色好多了。

english: Goblin century mark year of battle on Plain of Mud. That when Big High War God give goblin commandments.
translation: 哥布林世纪以泥原之战那一年为标志。那时大战神赐予了哥布林戒律。

english: Big High War God?
translation: 大战神？

english: Big High War God is god for goblins. He take us and make us strong, not stupid like humans.
translation: 大战神是哥布林的神。他带领我们，让我们变得强大，不像人类那么愚蠢。

english: Me bet Big High War God would pick red armour.
translation: 我打赌大战神会选择红色盔甲。

english: Shut up! Big High War God would hate you!
translation: 闭嘴！大战神会讨厌你的！

english: Wouldn't you prefer peace?
translation: 你们难道不想要和平吗？

english: Goblins not so good at peace. Maybe peace be okay though, as long as it peace wearing green armour.
translation: 哥布林不太擅长和平。不过，只要和平是穿着绿色盔甲的，也许和平也行。

english: But green too much like skin. Nearly make you look naked!
translation: 但绿色太像皮肤了。几乎让你看起来像没穿衣服！

english: Yes, as long as you pick green.
translation: 对，只要你选绿色就行。

english: No you have to pick red!
translation: 不，你必须选红色！

english: You should wear red.
translation: 你们应该穿红色。

english: See? Even stupid human think red best. Now we all wear red!
translation: 看到了吧？连愚蠢的人类都觉得红色最好。现在我们全穿红色！

english: Human not know anything! If we wear red then whole village be ugly like YOU!
translation: 人类什么都不知道！如果我们穿红色，那整个村子就会变得像你一样丑！

english: Go away human. You not helping.
translation: 走开，人类。你帮不上忙。

english: You should wear green.
translation: 你们应该穿绿色。

english: Green! We all wear green now, human has decided!
translation: 绿色！我们都穿绿色，人类已经决定了！

english: Why we have to do what human say? He not boss of us!
translation: 我们为什么要听人类的？他又不是我们的老大！

english: No but he agree with me!
translation: 不，但他同意我的看法！

english: That prove you a filthy human-lover!
translation: 这证明你是个肮脏的人类爱好者！

english: Me hate humans! This human just happen to be right!
translation: 我讨厌人类！这个人类只是碰巧说对了！

english: Go away human. You not know anything.
translation: 走开，人类。你什么都不知道。

english: What about a different colour?
translation: 换个别的颜色怎么样？

english: That would mean me wrong... but at least Wartface not right!
translation: 那意味着我错了……但至少疣脸不对！

english: Well Bentnoze never been right in his life. Still, maybe new colour good, but will have to see armour before decide.
translation: 嗯，弯鼻子这辈子就没对过。不过，也许新颜色不错，但得先看到盔甲才能决定。

english: Human! You bring us armour in new colour!
translation: 人类！你给我们带新颜色的盔甲来！

english: I can do that.
translation: 我能做到。

english: What colour we try?
translation: 我们试试什么颜色？

english: Orange armour might be good.
translation: 橙色盔甲可能不错。

english: Yep, bring us orange armour.
translation: 对，给我们弄件橙色盔甲。

english: How am I meant to get orange armour?
translation: 我怎么能弄到橙色盔甲呢？

english: Well first you get goblin armour...
translation: 嗯，首先你得弄到哥布林盔甲……

english: ...and then you dye it orange!
translation: ……然后你把它染成橙色！

english: Even human should be able to work that out!
translation: 连人类都应该能想明白！

english: Where do I get goblin armour?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到哥布林盔甲？

english: There some spare armour around village somewhere. You can take that.
translation: 村子附近有些备用的盔甲。你可以拿那些。

english: It in crates somewhere. Can't remember which crates now.
translation: 放在某个板条箱里。现在记不清是哪个板条箱了。

english: Where do I get dye?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到染料？

english: You go north of here into wilderness. There you find many ways to die!
translation: 你从这里往北走，进入荒野。在那里你会找到很多死法！

english: No, D-Y-E, not D-I-E.
translation: 不，是染料，不是去死。

english: Stupid Bentnoze, you not know how to spell!
translation: 愚蠢的弯鼻子，你连拼写都不会！

english: Do you know where I can get dye?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能弄到染料吗？

english: Me not know where dye come from.
translation: 我不知道染料从哪来。

english: Well where did you get your red and green dye from?
translation: 那你们的红色和绿色染料是从哪弄来的？

english: Some goblin or other, he steal it. Say he steal it from old witch in Draynor Village.
translation: 某个哥布林偷来的。他说是从德雷诺村的一个老女巫那里偷的。

english: Maybe you can get more dye from her?
translation: 也许你可以从她那里弄到更多染料？

english: Actually, I think I'll leave you to it.
translation: 其实，我想我还是不管你们了。

english: No, he doesn't look fat.
translation: 不，他看起来不胖。

english: Shut up human! Wartface fat and human stupid!
translation: 闭嘴人类！疣脸胖，人类蠢！

english: I tell all goblins in village to wear green armour now!
translation: 我现在就告诉村里所有哥布林穿绿色盔甲！

english: They not listen to you! I already tell them wear red armour!
translation: 他们不会听你的！我已经告诉他们穿红色盔甲了！

english: They listen to me not you! They know me bigger general!
translation: 他们听我的不听你的！他们知道我是更大的将军！

english: Me bigger general! They listen to me!
translation: 我才是更大的将军！他们听我的！

english: Human! What colour armour they wearing out there?
translation: 人类！外面那些人穿什么颜色的盔甲？

english: Half of them are wearing red and half of them green.
translation: 一半穿红色，一半穿绿色。

english: Shut up human! They wearing green armour really! Human lying because he scared of you!
translation: 闭嘴人类！他们其实穿的是绿色盔甲！人类撒谎是因为他怕你！

english: Human scared of me not you? Then you think me bigger general!
translation: 人类怕我不怕你？那你觉得我才是更大的将军！

english: What? Me mean...
translation: 什么？我的意思是……

english: Shut up! Me bigger general!
translation: 闭嘴！我才是更大的将军！

english: We should wear green armour!
translation: 我们应该穿绿色盔甲！

english: Green armour? Are you stupid?
translation: 绿色盔甲？你傻了吗？

english: You stupid! Only stupid goblins think red armour better!
translation: 你才傻！只有愚蠢的哥布林才觉得红色盔甲更好！

english: No they don't! Me think red armour better!
translation: 他们不觉得！我觉得红色盔甲更好！

english: That because you stupid!
translation: 那是因为你傻！

english: Me not stupid!
translation: 我不傻！

english: Then why you not like green armour?
translation: 那你为什么不喜欢绿色盔甲？

english: Because red armour better!
translation: 因为红色盔甲更好！

english: Only stupid goblins think that! You stupid!
translation: 只有愚蠢的哥布林才这么想！你傻！

english: Green armour best.
translation: 绿色盔甲最好。

english: No no red every time.
translation: 不不，红色永远最好。

english: Go away human, we busy.
translation: 走开人类，我们忙着呢。

english: Red armour best.
translation: 红色盔甲最好。

english: No it has to be green!
translation: 不，必须是绿色！

english: Green!
translation: 绿色！

english: Green armour best!
translation: 绿色盔甲最好！

english: Green armour stupid!
translation: 绿色盔甲真蠢！

english: Green not red!
translation: 绿色不是红色！

english: Red armour best!
translation: 红色盔甲最好！

english: Red armour stupid!
translation: 红色盔甲真蠢！

english: Red not green!
translation: 红色不是绿色！

english: Red red red!
translation: 红色红色红色！

english: Stupid greenie!
translation: 愚蠢的绿皮！

english: Stupid reddie!
translation: 愚蠢的红皮！

english: What do you think of this colour?
translation: 你觉得这个颜色怎么样？

english: That wrong colour.
translation: 颜色不对。

english: We tell you get orange armour.
translation: 我们告诉你要弄件橙色盔甲。

english: I have some orange armour here.
translation: 我这里有些橙色盔甲。

english: Grubfoot!
translation: 格拉布福特！

english: Yes General Wartface?
translation: 是的，疣脸将军？

english: Put on this armour!
translation: 穿上这件盔甲！

english: No I don't like that much.
translation: 不，我不太喜欢那样。

english: It clashes with skin colour.
translation: 它和肤色不搭。

english: We need darker colour, like blue.
translation: 我们需要更深的颜色，比如蓝色。

english: Yeah blue might be good.
translation: 是啊，蓝色可能不错。

english: Human! Get us blue armour!
translation: 人类！给我们弄蓝色盔甲来！

english: We tell you get blue armour.
translation: 我们说了，你去弄蓝色盔甲。

english: I have some blue armour here.
translation: 我这里有一些蓝色盔甲。

english: That not right. Not goblin colour at all.
translation: 那不对。根本不是哥布林的颜色。

english: Goblins wear dark earthy colours like brown.
translation: 哥布林穿深色土色系，比如棕色。

english: Yeah brown might be good.
translation: 是啊，棕色可能不错。

english: Human! Get us brown armour!
translation: 人类！给我们弄棕色盔甲来！

english: But I thought brown was the armour you were changing from...
translation: 但我以为棕色才是你原本要换掉的盔甲……

english: Never mind, anything is worth a try.
translation: 算了，什么都值得一试。

english: Me not like this blue colour.
translation: 我不喜欢这个蓝色。

english: Me not know. It just make me feel...
translation: 我不知道。就是让我觉得……

english: Makes you feel blue?
translation: 让你感到忧郁？

english: Makes me feel kind of sad.
translation: 让我有点难过。

english: We tell you get brown armour.
translation: 我们说了，你去弄棕色盔甲。

english: I have some brown armour here.
translation: 我这里有一些棕色盔甲。

english: That colour quite nice. Me can see myself wearing that.
translation: 那颜色挺不错。我能想象自己穿上它的样子。

english: It a deal then. Brown armour it is.
translation: 那就说定了。就棕色盔甲了。

english: Thank you for sorting out argument, human. You have reward now.
translation: 谢谢你解决了争执，人类。你现在有奖励了。

english: Thanks... I think...
translation: 谢谢……我想是吧……

english: Welcome Traveller. I am King Narnode. It's nice to see an outsider.
translation: 欢迎你，旅者。我是纳诺德国王。很高兴见到外来者。

english: Hi! It seems to be a very busy settlement.
translation: 你好！这里看起来是个很繁忙的聚居地。

english: You seem worried, what's up?
translation: 你看起来忧心忡忡，怎么了？

english: Traveller, can I speak to you in strictest confidence?
translation: 旅者，我能跟你私下说句话吗？

english: Of course sire.
translation: 当然可以，陛下。

english: Not here, follow me. Down here.
translation: 这里不方便，跟我来。到下面去。

english: Enjoy your stay with us. There are many things to see in my kingdom.
translation: 希望你在这里过得愉快。我的王国里有很多值得一看的东西。

english: Down here.
translation: 到下面来。

english: These, my friend, are the foundations of the stronghold.
translation: 我的朋友，这些就是要塞的地基。

english: They look like roots to me.
translation: 在我看来它们就是树根。

english: Not just any roots Traveller! These were created by gnome mages eons ago, since then they have grown to become a mighty stronghold!
translation: 可不是普通的树根，旅者！这些是远古时期由地精法师创造的，从那以后它们就长成了一座宏伟的要塞！

english: Impressive. What exactly is the problem?
translation: 真了不起。问题究竟出在哪里？

english: In the last two months our tree guardians have reported continuing deterioration of the Grand Tree's health. I've never seen this before! It could be the end for us all!
translation: 过去两个月，我们的树之守护者不断报告大树家园的健康状况在持续恶化。我从未见过这种情况！这可能是我们所有人的末日！

english: You mean the tree is ill?
translation: 你是说这棵树生病了？

english: In effect yes. Would you be willing to help us discover what is happening to the tree?
translation: 实际上是的。你愿意帮我们找出这棵树到底怎么了？

english: I'm sorry, I don't want to get involved.
translation: 抱歉，我不想卷入其中。

english: I understand Traveller. Please keep this to yourself.
translation: 我理解，旅者。请对此保密。

english: I'll show you the way back up.
translation: 我带你回去。

english: Up here.
translation: 到上面来。

english: I'd be happy to help!
translation: 我很乐意帮忙！

english: Thank Guthix for your arrival! The first task is to find out what's killing the tree.
translation: 感谢古斯派你来了！首要任务是找出是什么在杀死这棵树。

english: Do you have an idea?
translation: 你有头绪吗？

english: My top tree guardian, Glough, believes it's human sabotage. I'm not so sure! The only way to know for sure is to talk to Hazelmere.
translation: 我的首席树之守护者格劳夫认为是人类的破坏。我不太确定！唯一能确定的方法就是和黑兹尔米尔谈谈。

english: Who's Hazelmere?
translation: 黑兹尔米尔是谁？

english: Hazelmere is one of the mages that created the Grand Tree. He is the only one that has survived from that time. Take this bark sample to him, he will be able to help!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔是创造大树家园的法师之一。他是那个时代唯一幸存下来的人。把这个树皮样本带给他，他会有办法的！

english: The mage only talks in the old tongue, you'll need this.
translation: 那位法师只说古老的语言，你需要这个。

english: It's a translation book, you'll need it to translate what Hazelmere says. Do that carefully! His words are our only hope! You'll find his dwellings high upon a towering hill, on an island east of Yanille. I'll show you the way back up. Up here.
translation: 这是一本翻译书，你需要用它来翻译黑兹尔米尔说的话。小心行事！他的话是我们唯一的希望！你会在亚尼勒城东边一座高耸的小山上的居所里找到他。我带你返回上面的路。往这边走。

english: Traveller, any word from Hazelmere?
translation: 旅者，黑兹尔米尔有消息吗？

english: I've lost the bark sample.
translation: 我把树皮样本弄丢了。

english: Here's another sample, hang on to it this time!
translation: 这里还有一份样本，这次可要拿好了！

english: I've lost the translation book.
translation: 我把翻译书弄丢了。

english: Don't worry, I have more.
translation: 别担心，我还有。

english: Hazelmere lives on an island just south of the Khazard Fight Arena, Give him the sample and translate his reply.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔住在卡扎德战斗竞技场南边的一座岛上，把样本给他，然后翻译他的回答。

english: I just hope he can help us in our hour of need!
translation: 我只希望他在我们急需帮助的时候能伸出援手！

english: Blah, blah...Daconia...blah, blah.
translation: 巴拉巴拉……达科尼亚……巴拉巴拉。

english: Can you write this down and I'll try and translate it?
translation: 你能把这个写下来吗？我来试着翻译一下。

english: Blah, blah....Daconia...blah, blah.
translation: 巴拉巴拉……达科尼亚……巴拉巴拉。

english: Hello again, Your highness.
translation: 又见面了，陛下。

english: Hello Traveller, did you speak to Hazelmere?
translation: 你好，旅者，你和黑兹尔米尔谈过了吗？

english: Yes! I managed to find him.
translation: 是的！我找到他了。

english: Do you understand what he said?
translation: 你明白他说的话吗？

english: I think so!
translation: 我想是的！

english: So what did he say?
translation: 那他说了什么？

english: King Narnode must be stopped, he is a madman!
translation: 必须阻止纳诺德国王，他是个疯子！

english: Praise be to the great Zamorak!
translation: 赞美伟大的萨莫拉克！

english: Do you have any bread? I do like bread.
translation: 你有面包吗？我很喜欢面包。

english: The time has come to attack!
translation: 进攻的时刻到了！

english: The tree is fine, you have nothing to fear.
translation: 这棵树没事，你们没什么好怕的。

english: You must come and see me!
translation: 你必须来见我！

english: The tree needs watering as there has been drought.
translation: 这棵树需要浇水，因为发生了干旱。

english: Grave danger lies ahead, only the bravest will linger.
translation: 前方有巨大的危险，只有最勇敢的人才会留下。

english: Time is of the essence! We must move quickly.
translation: 时间紧迫！我们必须迅速行动。

english: A man came to me with the King's seal.
translation: 有个人带着国王的印信来找我。

english: There is no need for haste.
translation: 不必急躁。

english: You must act now or we will all die!
translation: 你必须立刻行动，否则我们都得死！

english: Time passes us by.
translation: 时间流逝而去。

english: I gave the man Daconia rocks.
translation: 我把达科尼亚石给了那个人。

english: You must use force!
translation: 你必须使用武力！

english: Use a bucket of milk from a sacred cow.
translation: 用一桶来自神圣奶牛的牛奶。

english: Take this banana to him, he will understand.
translation: 把这根香蕉带给他，他会明白的。

english: Only Adamantite is any use.
translation: 只有精金矿才有用。

english: All with be fine on the third night.
translation: 到第三个晚上一切都会好起来的。

english: You must wait till the second night.
translation: 你必须等到第二个晚上。

english: Nothing will help us now!
translation: 现在什么也帮不了我们了！

english: The tree will die in five days!
translation: 这棵树五天之内就会死！

english: And Daconia rocks will kill the tree!
translation: 而达科尼亚石会杀死这棵树！

english: Of course! I should've known! Someone must've forged my royal seal. Hazelmere thought I sent him for the Daconia stones!
translation: 当然！我早该知道！一定是有人伪造了我的皇家印章。黑兹尔米尔以为是我派他去取达科尼亚石的！

english: What are Daconia stones?
translation: 什么是达科尼亚石？

english: Hazelmere created the Daconia stones. They are a safety measure, in case the tree grew out of control. They're the only thing that can kill the tree.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔创造了达科尼亚石。它们是安全措施，以防树失去控制。它们是唯一能杀死那棵树的东西。

english: This is terrible! The stones must be recovered!
translation: 这太可怕了！必须找回那些石头！

english: First, I must warn the tree guardians. Please, could you tell the chief tree guardian, Glough. He lives in a tree house just in front of the Grand Tree.
translation: 首先，我必须警告树之守护者。请你去告诉首席树之守护者格劳夫，他就住在大树家园前面的一间树屋里。

english: If he's not there he will be at his girlfriend Anita's place. Meet me back here once you've told him.
translation: 如果他不在那里，那就是在他女朋友安妮塔那里。你告诉他之后回这里找我。

english: Ok! I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的！我很快就回来。

english: Wait a minute! That doesn't sound like Hazelmere! Are you sure you translated correctly?
translation: 等一下！那听起来不像黑兹尔米尔的话！你确定翻译正确吗？

english: Erm...I think so.
translation: 呃……我想是的。

english: I'm sorry Traveller but this is no good. The translation must be perfect or the information's no use. Please come back when you know exactly what Hazelmere said.
translation: 抱歉旅者，这样不行。翻译必须准确无误，否则信息毫无用处。请等你完全确定黑兹尔米尔说了什么再回来。

english: Time is of the essence Traveller!
translation: 时间紧迫，旅者！

english: Hello Traveller, did you speak to Glough?
translation: 你好旅者，你和格劳夫谈过了吗？

english: OK. He lives just in front of the Grand Tree. Let me know when you’ve talked to him.
translation: 好的。他就住在大树家园前面。你跟他谈完告诉我一声。

english: Can I help human? Can't you see I'm eating?!
translation: 我能帮你吗，人类？你没看到我在吃饭吗？！

english: The King asked me to inform you that the Daconia rocks have been taken!
translation: 国王让我通知你，达科尼亚石被拿走了！

english: Surely not!
translation: 怎么可能！

english: Apparently a human took them from Hazelmere. Hazelmere believed him; he had the King's seal!
translation: 显然是一个人类从黑兹尔米尔那里拿走的。黑兹尔米尔相信了他，因为他有国王的印信！

english: I should've known! The humans are going to invade!
translation: 我早该知道！人类要入侵了！

english: Your type can't be trusted! I'll take care of this! Go back to the King.
translation: 你们这种家伙不可信！我会处理这件事的！回到国王那里去。

english: You shouldn't be here human!
translation: 你不该来这里，人类！

english: The Gnome Stronghold is for gnomes alone!
translation: 地精要塞只属于地精！

english: We don't need your sort round here!
translation: 我们这里不需要你这种人！

english: Hello, Your highness. Have you any news on the Daconia stones?
translation: 你好，殿下。有关于达科尼亚石的消息吗？

english: It's OK Traveller, thanks to Glough! He found a human sneaking around! He had three Daconia rocks on him!
translation: 没事了旅者，多亏了格劳夫！他发现了一个鬼鬼祟祟的人类！那个人身上带着三块达科尼亚石！

english: Wow! That was quick!
translation: 哇！真快！

english: Yes Glough really knows what he's doing. The human has been detained until we know who else is involved. Maybe Glough was right, maybe humans are invading!
translation: 是啊，格劳夫确实很有一套。那个人类已经被拘留了，直到我们查清还有谁参与。也许格劳夫是对的，也许人类真的要入侵了！

english: I doubt it, can I speak to the prisoner?
translation: 我表示怀疑，我能和那个囚犯谈谈吗？

english: Certainly. He's on the top level of the tree. Be careful, it's a long way down!
translation: 当然可以。他在树的顶层。小心，从那里掉下来可不得了！

english: Hello Traveller. If you wish to talk to the prisoner go to the top of the tree, you'll find him there.
translation: 你好旅者。如果你想和囚犯谈话，就到大树家园顶层去，你会在那里找到他。

english: Tell me. Why would you want to kill the Grand Tree?
translation: 告诉我，你为什么要杀死大树家园？

english: Don't tell me, you just happened to be caught carrying Daconia rocks!
translation: 别告诉我你只是碰巧被抓到带着达科尼亚石！

english: All I know is that I did what I was asked.
translation: 我只知道我是奉命行事。

english: Glough paid me to go to this gnome on a hill. I gave the gnome a seal and he gave me some Daconia rocks to give to Glough.
translation: 格劳夫付钱让我去找山上那个地精。我把一个印章给了那个地精，他给了我们一些达科尼亚石让我交给格劳夫。

english: I've been doing it for weeks, this time though Glough locked me up here! I just don't understand it.
translation: 我已经这样做了好几个星期，但这次格劳夫却把我关在了这里！我真不明白。

english: Sounds like Glough is hiding something.
translation: 听起来格劳夫在隐瞒什么。

english: I don't know what he's up to. If you want to find out, you'd better search his home.
translation: 我不知道他想干什么。如果你想查明真相，最好去搜索他的家。

english: OK. Thanks Charlie.
translation: 好的。谢谢你，查理。

english: Hello adventurer. Have you figured out what's going on?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你搞清楚怎么回事了吗？

english: No idea.
translation: 毫无头绪。

english: To get to the bottom of this you'll need to search Glough's home.
translation: 要查个水落石出，你得去搜索格劳夫的家。

english: Hello Traveller. So, did you speak to the culprit?
translation: 你好，旅者。那么，你和那个罪犯谈过了吗？

english: Yes I did and something's not right!
translation: 是的，谈过了，事情不对劲！

english: The prisoner said he was paid by Glough to get the Daconia stones!
translation: 那个囚犯说他是受格劳夫指使去偷达科尼亚石头的！

english: That's absurd! He's just trying to save himself!
translation: 荒谬！他不过是想给自己开脱！

english: Since Glough's wife died he's been a little strange. He would never wrongly imprison someone though! Now that the culprit is locked up we can relax. It's sad but I think Glough was right.
translation: 自从格劳夫的妻子去世后，他就有点古怪。但他绝不会冤枉好人！现在罪犯已经被关起来了，我们可以放心了。虽然很遗憾，但我觉得格劳夫是对的。

english: Humans are planning to invade and wipe out the tree gnomes!
translation: 人类正计划入侵并消灭树地精！

english: Who knows? You may have to leave soon Traveller! I trust you but the local gnomes are getting paranoid.
translation: 谁知道呢？旅者，你可能很快就要离开了！我信任你，但本地的地精们越来越疑神疑鬼了。

english: Your highness! I'm concerned about Glough!
translation: 陛下！我很担心格劳夫！

english: Why? Don't worry about him now the culprit has been caught. I'm sure Glough's resentment of humans will pass with time.
translation: 为什么？现在罪犯已经抓到了，别担心他了。我相信格劳夫对人类的怨恨会随时间淡去的。

english: If you're really concerned speak to him.
translation: 如果你真的很担心，就去和他谈谈吧。

english: Glough! I don't know what you're up to but I know you paid Charlie to get those rocks!
translation: 格劳夫！我不知道你在搞什么鬼，但我知道是你花钱让查理去偷那些石头的！

english: You're a fool human! You have no idea what's going on.
translation: 你这个愚蠢的人类！你根本不知道发生了什么。

english: I know the Grand Tree's dying! And I think you're part of the reason.
translation: 我知道大树正在枯萎！而且我认为你是原因之一。

english: How dare you accuse me! I'm the head tree guardian! Guards! Guards!
translation: 你竟敢指控我！我是首席树之守护者！卫兵！卫兵！

english: Come with me!
translation: 跟我来！

english: So they got you as well?
translation: 他们连你也抓了？

english: It's Glough! He's trying to cover something up.
translation: 是格劳夫！他想掩盖些什么。

english: I shouldn't tell you this adventurer. But if you want to get to the bottom of this you should go and talk to the Karamja Shipyard foreman.
translation: 冒险者，我不该告诉你这些的。但如果你想查个水落石出，你应该去和卡拉姆詹岛造船厂的工头谈谈。

english: Glough sent me to Karamja to meet him. I delivered a large amount of gold. For what? I don't know. He may be able to tell you what Glough's up to. That's if you can get out of here. You'll find him
translation: 格劳夫派我去卡拉姆詹岛见他。我送了一大笔金币过去。为了什么？我不知道。他也许能告诉你格劳夫在搞什么鬼。前提是你能从这里出去。你会在卡拉姆詹岛造船厂找到他，就在希洛村东边。

english: in the Karamja Shipyard, east of Shilo Village. Be careful! If he discovers you're not working for Glough, there'll be trouble! The sea men use the password Ka-Lu-Min.
translation: 希洛村东边的卡拉姆詹岛造船厂找到他。小心点！如果发现你不是为格劳夫工作的，会有麻烦的！那些水手用暗号卡-鲁-敏。

english: Thanks Charlie!
translation: 谢谢你，查理！

english: Traveller please accept my apologies! Glough had no right to arrest you! I just think he's scared of humans. Let me get you out of there.
translation: 旅者，请接受我的道歉！格劳夫无权逮捕你！我只是觉得他害怕人类。让我放你出去。

english: I don't think you can trust Glough, Your highness. He seems to have an unnatural hatred for humans.
translation: 陛下，我认为您不能信任格劳夫。他似乎对人类有着不正常的仇恨。

english: I know he can be a bit extreme at times. But he's the best tree guardian I have, he has made the gnomes paranoid about humans though.
translation: 我知道他有时可能有点极端。但他是我手下最好的树之守护者，不过他也确实让地精们对人类变得疑神疑鬼。

english: I'm afraid Glough has placed guards on the front gate to stop you escaping! Let my glider pilot fly you away until things calm down around here.
translation: 恐怕格劳夫已经派卫兵守住了前门，不让你逃跑！让我的滑翔机飞行员载你飞走，等这里的事情平息下来再说。

english: Well, OK.
translation: 嗯，好吧。

english: I'm sorry again Traveller!
translation: 旅者，我再次向你道歉！

english: Glough is looking for you! Leave on the glider now before it's too late!
translation: 格劳夫在找你！趁现在还来得及，快乘滑翔机离开！

english: I can't figure this out Charlie!
translation: 查理，我想不明白！

english: Go and see the foreman in the Karamja jungle, there's a shipyard there, you might find some clues. Don't forget the password is Ka-Lu-Min; if they realise that you're not working for Glough there'll be trouble!
translation: 去卡拉姆詹岛的丛林里找那个工头，那里有个造船厂，你可能会找到一些线索。别忘了暗号是卡-鲁-敏；如果他们发现你不是为格劳夫工作的，会有麻烦的！

english: Hi. The king said that you need to leave?
translation: 嗨。国王说你需要离开？

english: Apparently humans are invading!
translation: 显然人类要入侵了！

english: I find that hard to believe. I have lots of human friends.
translation: 我觉得难以置信。我有很多人类朋友。

english: I don't understand it either!
translation: 我也不明白！

english: So where to?
translation: 那么，去哪儿？

english: Take me to Karamja please.
translation: 请带我去卡拉姆詹岛。

english: Okay, you're the boss! Hold on tight, it'll be a rough ride.
translation: 好的，听你的！抓紧了，路上会很颠簸。

english: Not anywhere for now.
translation: 暂时哪儿也不去。

english: Okay. I'll be here for when you're ready.
translation: 好的。我在这儿等你准备好。

english: That turbulence over the Karamja Volcano was a bit unexpected, and the area round here isn't well suited for emergency landing.
translation: 卡拉姆詹岛火山附近的气流有点出乎意料，而且这附近的地形不太适合紧急降落。

english: Still! we're still alive that's the main thing. Are you okay?
translation: 不过！我们还活着，这才是最重要的。你没事吧？

english: I'm fine, I can't say the same for your glider!
translation: 我没事，但你的滑翔机可就没这么幸运了！

english: I don't think I can fix this. Looks like we'll be heading back by foot. I might see if I can find Penwie while I'm here, I believe he's charting the area.
translation: 我觉得我修不好这个了。看来我们得步行回去了。我看看能不能在这里找到彭维，我记得他正在绘制这个区域的地图。

english: Where's the shipyard from here?
translation: 造船厂从这里怎么走？

english: I think I saw some buildings on the coast east of here while we were crashing. I'd have a look there.
translation: 我记得坠毁的时候看到东边的海岸上有一些建筑。你可以去那里看看。

english: Take care adventurer!
translation: 保重，冒险者！

english: Take care little man.
translation: 保重，小个子。

english: It's east of here. I thought I saw some buildings on the coast while we were crashing...
translation: 就在东边。我记得坠毁的时候看到海岸上有一些建筑……

english: I find that hard to believe! I have lots of human friends.
translation: 这很难让人相信！我有很多人类朋友。

english: Okay! You're the boss! Hold on tight, it'll be a rough ride!
translation: 好吧！听你的！抓紧了，这趟会很颠簸！

english: Hi, the King said that you need to leave?
translation: 嗨，国王说你需要离开？

english: That turbulence over the Karamja Volcano was a bit unexpected, and the area round here isn't well suited for emergency landing. Still! we're still alive that's the main thing. Are you okay?
translation: 卡拉姆詹岛火山那阵湍流有点出乎意料，而且这附近不太适合紧急降落。不过！我们还活着，这才是最重要的。你还好吗？

english: Call it 'creative landing'.
translation: 这叫‘创意着陆’。

english: It's east of here. I think I saw some buildings on the coast while we were crashing...
translation: 就在东边。我们坠毁的时候，我好像看到海岸上有一些建筑……

english: If you wish.
translation: 随你便。

english: What do you want human?
translation: 你想干什么，人类？

english: Hello, are you in charge?
translation: 你好，你是负责人吗？

english: That's right, and you are...?
translation: 没错，你是……？

english: Glough sent me to check on how you are doing.
translation: 格劳夫派我来看看你进展如何。

english: Right. Glough sent a human?
translation: 是吗。格劳夫派了一个人类来？

english: His gnomes are busy.
translation: 他的地精们都很忙。

english: Hmm...in that case we'd better go to my office. Follow me.
translation: 嗯……这样的话，我们最好去我的办公室谈。跟我来。

english: Tell me again why you're here.
translation: 再说一遍你为什么来这里。

english: Er...Glough sent me?
translation: 呃……格劳夫派我来的？

english: By the way how is Glough? Still with his wife?
translation: 顺便问一下，格劳夫怎么样了？还和他妻子在一起吗？

english: Yes, they're getting on great.
translation: 是的，他们相处得很好。

english: Really? That's odd, considering she died last year. Die imposter!
translation: 真的吗？真奇怪，考虑到她去年就死了。去死吧，冒牌货！

english: Always arguing as usual!
translation: 还是像往常一样爱吵架！

english: Sadly his wife is no longer with us!
translation: 遗憾的是，他的妻子已经不在了！

english: Right answer. I have to watch for imposters. What's Glough's favourite dish?
translation: 回答正确。我得提防冒牌货。格劳夫最喜欢吃什么菜？

english: He loves tangled toads legs.
translation: 他喜欢吃缠结蟾蜍腿。

english: Our survey said.... Bzzzzzz! Wrong answer!
translation: 我们的调查显示……哔哔哔！回答错误！

english: He loves worm holes.
translation: 他喜欢吃蠕虫洞。

english: OK. Just one more. What's the name of his new girlfriend?
translation: 好的。最后一个问题。他新女友叫什么名字？

english: Anita.
translation: 安妮塔。

english: Well, well, you do know Glough. Sorry for the interrogation but I'm sure you understand.
translation: 哎呀呀，看来你确实认识格劳夫。抱歉刚才的盘问，但我相信你能理解。

english: Of course, security is paramount.
translation: 当然，安全第一。

english: As you can see things are going well.
translation: 如你所见，一切进展顺利。

english: When I was asked to build a fleet large enough to invade Port Sarim and carry 300 gnome troops I said: 'If anyone can, I can.'
translation: 当初有人让我建造一支足够入侵沙林港并运送300名地精部队的舰队时，我说过：‘如果有人能做到，那就是我。’

english: That's a lot of troops!
translation: 那可是很多部队！

english: Truebut if the gnomes are really going to take over Gielinor they'll need at least that.
translation: 没错，但如果地精们真的想占领整个吉莱诺，他们至少需要这么多。

english: Take over?
translation: 占领？

english: Of course, why else would Glough want 30 battleships? Between you and me I don't think he stands a chance.
translation: 当然，不然格劳夫要30艘战舰干嘛？私下跟你说，我觉得他根本没机会成功。

english: I mean, for the kind of battleships Glough's ordered I'll need tons and tons of lumber! Still, if he says he can supply the wood I'm sure he can! Anyway, here's the order for the lumber.
translation: 我的意思是，按照格劳夫订购的那种战舰，我需要成千上万吨的木材！不过，既然他说他能提供木材，我相信他肯定能！总之，这是木材的订单。

english: OK. I'll head off and give this order to Glough.
translation: 好的。我这就去把订单交给格劳夫。

english: Alia.
translation: 阿莉娅。

english: You almost had me fooled! Die imposter!
translation: 你差点骗到我了！去死吧，冒牌货！

english: Elena.
translation: 埃琳娜。

english: I'm afraid we have orders not to let you in.
translation: 恐怕我们接到命令，不能让你进去。

english: Orders from who?
translation: 谁的命令？

english: The head tree guardian, he says you're a spy!
translation: 首席树之守护者，他说你是间谍！

english: Glough!
translation: 格劳夫！

english: I'm sorry but you'll have to leave.
translation: 很抱歉，你必须离开。

english: I can't believe they won't let me in!
translation: 真不敢相信他们不让我进去！

english: I don't believe all this rubbish about an invasion. If mankind wanted to, they could have invaded before now.
translation: 我才不信这些关于入侵的鬼话。如果人类想这么做，他们早就入侵了。

english: I really need to see King Narnode. Could you help me sneak in?
translation: 我真的需要见纳诺德国王。你能帮我偷偷溜进去吗？

english: Well, as you helped me I suppose I could. We'll have to be careful. If I get caught I'll be in the cage!
translation: 嗯，既然你帮过我，我想我可以帮你。但我们得小心点。如果被抓住，我就要被关进笼子了！

english: OK, what should I do?
translation: 好的，我该怎么做？

english: Jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine.
translation: 跳到推车后面去。这是送食物的，应该没问题。

english: Why should I help you, you wouldn’t help me!
translation: 我为什么要帮你，你当初可没帮我！

english: Erm I know, but this is an emergency!
translation: 呃，我知道，但这是紧急情况！

english: So was lifting that barrel! Tell you what, call it a round 1000 gold pieces.
translation: 搬那个桶也是紧急情况！这样吧，算你1000金币。

english: 1000 gold pieces!
That’s right, 1000 and I’ll sneak you in.
translation: 没错，1000金，我就偷偷带你进去。

english: No chance!
translation: 没门！

english: OK then, here you go.
translation: 好吧，给你。

english: Alright, jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine.
translation: 好吧，跳进推车后面。这是送食物的，应该没问题。

english: OK traveller, you'd better get going.
translation: 好了旅行者，你最好出发吧。

english: Thanks again!
translation: 再次感谢！

english: That's OK, all the best.
translation: 不客气，祝你好运。

english: Now, to get this lot to the Grand Tree!
translation: 现在，把这批货送到大树家园！

english: No, I'm OK traveller. I can manage from here.
translation: 不，我没事旅行者。这里我自己能行。

english: Okay, traveller, you'd better get going.
translation: 好了，旅行者，你最好出发了。

english: Jump in the back of the cart. It's a food delivery, we should be fine
translation: 跳到推车后面去。这是送食物的，应该没问题。

english: That's okay, all the best.
translation: 没关系，祝你一切顺利。

english: Why should I help you? You wouldn't help me!
translation: 我为什么要帮你？你又不帮我！

english: So was lifting that barrel!
translation: 抬那个桶也是！

english: That's right, 1000 and I'll sneak you in.
translation: 没错，一千金币，我就偷偷带你进去。

english: Tell you what, call it a round 1000 gold pieces.
translation: 这样吧，就算一千金币整。

english: Oh, alright, I suppose so.
translation: 哦，好吧，我想也是。

english: No, you're okay, traveller. I can manage from here.
translation: 不，你没事了，旅行者。我自己能行。

english: I'd better get going!
translation: 我最好走了！

english: I know what you're up to Glough!
translation: 我知道你在搞什么鬼，格劳夫！

english: You have no idea human!
translation: 你根本不懂，人类！

english: You may be able to make a fleet but the tree gnomes will never follow you into battle against humans.
translation: 你也许能造出舰队，但树地精永远不会跟随你与人类作战。

english: So, you know more than I thought! The gnomes fear humanity more than any other race. I just need to give them a push in the right direction. There's nothing you can do traveller! Leave before it's too late!
translation: 看来你知道的比我想象的多！地精比任何种族都更害怕人类。我只需要推他们一把，引向正确的方向。你无能为力，旅行者！趁还来得及，快离开吧！

english: King Narnode won't allow it!
translation: 纳诺德国王不会允许的！

english: The King's a fool and a coward! He'll bow to me! You'll soon be back in that cage!
translation: 国王是个蠢货加懦夫！他会向我屈服的！你很快就会被关回笼子里！

english: King Nardone, I need to talk!
translation: 纳诺德国王，我需要谈谈！

english: Traveller, what are you doing here? The stronghold has been put on full alert! It's not safe for you here!
translation: 旅行者，你在这里做什么？要塞已经全面警戒！你在这里不安全！

english: Your highness, I believe Glough is killing the trees in order to make a mass fleet of warships!
translation: 陛下，我相信格劳夫正在杀害树木，以建造大量军舰舰队！

english: That's an absurd accusation!
translation: 这是荒谬的指控！

english: His hatred for humanity is stronger than you know!
translation: 他对人类的仇恨比你想象的更深！

english: That's enough Traveller, you sound as paranoid as him! Traveller please leave! It's bad enough having one human locked up.
translation: 够了，旅行者，你听起来和他一样偏执！请你离开！已经关了一个人类就够糟了。

english: How are you doing Charlie?
translation: 你还好吗，查理？

english: Glough has some plan to rule Gielinor!
translation: 格劳夫有个统治吉莱诺尔的计划！

english: I wouldn't put it past him, the Gnome's crazy!
translation: 我觉得他干得出来，那个地精疯了！

english: I need some proof to convince the King.
translation: 我需要一些证据来说服国王。

english: Hmm... you could be in luck! Before Glough had me locked up I heard him mention that he'd left his chest key at his girlfriend's house. She lives just west of the toad swamp.
translation: 嗯...你运气不错！在格劳夫把我关起来之前，我听到他提到他把宝箱钥匙留在了他女朋友家。她就住在蟾蜍沼泽西边。

english: Okay, I'll see what I can find.
translation: 好吧，我去看看能找到什么。

english: Hello, your highness.
translation: 你好，陛下。

english: Please Traveller, if the gnomes see me talking to you they'll revolt against me.
translation: 求你了旅行者，如果地精们看到我和你说话，他们会反我的。

english: That's crazy!
translation: 太疯狂了！

english: Glough's scared the whole town, he expects the humans to attack any day. He's even begun to recruit hundreds of gnome soldiers.
translation: 格劳夫吓住了整个城镇，他预计人类随时会攻击。他甚至已经开始招募数百名地精士兵。

english: Don't you understand he's creating his own army?!
translation: 难道你不明白他在组建自己的军队吗？！

english: Please Traveller, leave before it's too late!
translation: 求你了旅行者，趁还来得及快走吧！

english: I'm going to stop you, Glough!
translation: 我要阻止你，格劳夫！

english: You're becoming quite annoying traveller!
translation: 你变得相当烦人了，旅行者！

english: Where are that darn key?
translation: 那个该死的钥匙在哪里？

english: Leave human, before I have you put in the cage!
translation: 离开，人类，否则我就把你关进笼子！

english: Oh hello, I've seen you with the King.
translation: 哦你好，我见过你和国王在一起。

english: Yes, I'm helping him with a problem.
translation: 是的，我在帮他解决一个问题。

english: You must know my boyfriend Glough then?
translation: 那你一定认识我的男朋友格劳夫吧？

english: Could you do me a favour?
translation: 你能帮我个忙吗？

english: Please give this key to Glough, he left it here last night.
translation: 请把这把钥匙交给格劳夫，他昨晚落在这里了。

english: No... thank you!
translation: 不...谢谢！

english: Have you taken that key to Glough yet?
translation: 你把钥匙带给格劳夫了吗？

english: No, I'm still carrying it around.
translation: 没有，我还带在身上。

english: Oh. Please take it to Glough!
translation: 哦。请把它带给格劳夫！

english: You were right! I searched Glough's chest and found some invasion plans!
translation: 你说得对！我搜查了格劳夫的箱子，发现了一些入侵计划！

english: Go to the king and tell him! Finally you have proof. Surely King Narnode will believe you now and set me free!
translation: 去告诉国王！你终于有证据了。纳诺德国王现在一定会相信你，放我自由！

english: Hold tight Charlie!
translation: 坚持住，查理！

english: I'm not going anywhere!
translation: 我哪儿也不去！

english: Hi, Your highness, did you think about what I said?
translation: 嗨，陛下，您考虑过我说的话了吗？

english: Look, if you're right about Glough I would have him arrested but there's no reason for me to think he's lying.
translation: 听着，如果你对格劳夫的指控是对的，我会逮捕他，但我没有理由认为他在说谎。

english: Look, I found this at Glough's home!
translation: 看，我在格劳夫家发现了这个！

english: If these are to be believed then this is terrible! But it's not proof, any one could have made these. Traveller, I understand your concern, I had guards search Glough's house but they found nothing suspicious, just these odd twigs. On the other hand, if Glough's right about the humans we will need an army of gnomes to protect ourselves. So I've decided to allow Glough to raise a mighty gnome army. The Grand Tree's still slowly dying, if it is human sabotage we must respond!
translation: 如果这些是真的，那就太可怕了！但这不能算证据，任何人都能造出这些东西。旅行者，我理解你的担忧，我派守卫搜索了格劳夫的房子，但他们没有发现任何可疑的东西，只有这些奇怪的树枝。另一方面，如果格劳夫关于人类的说法是对的，我们就需要一支地精军队来保护自己。所以我决定允许格劳夫组建一支强大的地精军队。大树家园仍在缓慢死去，如果这真是人类的破坏，我们必须做出回应！

english: Please Traveller, take my advice and leave!
translation: 旅行者，请听我的劝告离开吧！

english: I've lost those twigs you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那些树枝。

english: Here take these, I don't see how it will help you though.
translation: 给你这些，不过我看不出这对你有什么帮助。

english: Hmm. Looks like you can't carry anymore. Put 4 things down and come back to me.
translation: 嗯。看起来你不能再拿了。放下4样东西再回来找我。

english: Anybody?
translation: 有人吗？

english: Glough?
translation: 格劳夫？

english: You really are becoming a headache! Well, at least now you can die knowing you were right, it will save me having to hunt you down like all the other human filth of Gielinor!
translation: 你真是越来越让人头疼了！好吧，至少你现在可以死得明白自己是对的，省得我像追杀吉莱诺尔其他人类渣滓一样追杀你！

english: You're crazy, Glough!
translation: 你疯了，格劳夫！

english: Bah! Well, soon you'll see, the gnomes are ready to fight, in three weeks this tree will be dead wood, in ten weeks it will be 30 battleships! Finally we will rid the world of the disease called humanity!
translation: 哼！好吧，你很快就会看到，地精们已经准备好战斗，三周内这棵树就会变成朽木，十周内它就会变成30艘战舰！最终我们将从世界上根除那种叫做人类的疾病！

english: What makes you think I'll let you get away with it?
translation: 是什么让你觉得我会让你得逞？

english: Fool... meet my little friend!
translation: 蠢货...见见我的小朋友吧！

english: Pay attention when I'm talking to you!
translation: 我跟你说话时给我注意点！

english: Just die, human!
translation: 去死吧，人类！

english: Your highness, it's true about Glough I tell you! He's planning to take over Gielinor!
translation: 陛下，我告诉你，关于格劳夫的事是真的！他计划接管吉莱诺尔！

english: I'm sorry Traveller but it's just not realistic. How could Glough, even with a gnome army, take over?
translation: 抱歉旅行者，但这不现实。就算格劳夫有地精军队，他怎么接管？

english: He plans to make a fleet of warships from the Grand Tree's wood!
translation: 他打算用大树家园的木材造一支军舰舰队！

english: That's enough Traveller! I've no time for make believe. The tree's still dying. I must get to the truth of this!
translation: 够了旅行者！我没时间听你胡编乱造。树还在死。我必须查明真相！

english: Traveller you're wounded! What happened?
translation: 旅行者你受伤了！怎么回事？

english: It's Glough! He set a demon on me!
translation: 是格劳夫！他放恶魔攻击我！

english: What?! Glough?! With a demon?!
translation: 什么？！格劳夫？！和恶魔在一起？！

english: Glough has a store of Daconia rocks further up the passage! He's been accessing the roots from a secret passage at his home.
translation: 格劳夫在通道更深处储存了一批达科尼亚石！他一直通过他家的一条秘密通道接触树根。

english: Never! Not Glough! He's a good gnome at heart! Guard!
translation: 绝不！不会是格劳夫！他骨子里是个好地精！守卫！

english: Sire!
translation: 陛下！

english: Go and check out that passage!
translation: 去查看那条通道！

english: We found Glough hiding under a horde of Daconia rocks!
translation: 我们发现格劳夫藏在一堆达科尼亚石下面！

english: That's what I've been trying to tell you! Glough's been fooling you!
translation: 这正是我一直想告诉你的！格劳夫一直在愚弄你！

english: I..I don't know what to say! How could I have been so blind?! Guard! Call off the military training! The humans are not attacking!
translation: 我……我不知道该说什么！我怎么那么盲目？！守卫！取消军事训练！人类没有在进攻！

english: I'm afraid that we have orders not to let you in.
translation: 恐怕我们接到命令，不能让你进去。

english: The head tree guardian, he say's you're a spy!
translation: 首席树守护者说你是间谍！

english: Halt, human!
translation: 站住，人类！

english: By order of the head tree guardian! You can not leave!
