translation: 奉首席树守护者之命！你不能离开！

english: Humans are planning to attack our stronghold. You could be a spy!
translation: 人类正计划攻击我们的要塞。你可能是间谍！

english: Maybe, but that's the orders, I'm sorry.
translation: 也许吧，但这是命令，我很抱歉。

english: You have my full apologies Traveller! And my gratitude! A reward will have to wait though, the tree is still dying! The guards are clearing Glough's rock supply now but there must be more Daconia hidden somewhere in the roots! Help us search, we have little time!
translation: 我向你致以最诚挚的道歉，旅行者！还有我的感激！奖励必须等一等，那棵树还在枯萎！守卫们正在清理格劳夫的岩石储备，但肯定还有更多达科尼亚石藏在树根里！帮我们搜索，时间不多了！

english: Traveller, have you managed to find the Daconia?
translation: 旅行者，你找到达科尼亚石了吗？

english: No sign of it so far.
translation: 目前还没有迹象。

english: The tree will still die if we don't find it! It could be anywhere!
translation: 如果我们找不到它，树还是会死的！它可能在任何地方！

english: Don't worry Your highness! We'll find it!
translation: 别担心陛下！我们会找到的！

english: Is this it?
translation: 是这个吗？

english: Yes! Excellent, well done!
translation: 是的！太好了，干得漂亮！

english: It's incredible, the tree's health is improving already! I don't know what to say, we owe you so much! To think Glough had me fooled all along!
translation: 真不可思议，树已经在好转了！我不知道该说什么，我们欠你太多了！想想格劳夫居然一直愚弄我！

english: All that matters now is that humans and gnomes can live together in peace!
translation: 现在最重要的是人类和地精能够和平共处！

english: I'll drink to that! From now on I vow to make this stronghold a welcoming place for all! I'll grant you access to all our facilities.
translation: 我为此干杯！从今以后我发誓要让这座要塞成为欢迎所有人的地方！我将允许你使用我们所有的设施。

english: Thanks! I think!
translation: 谢谢！我想是吧！

english: It should make your stay here easier. You can use the spirit tree to transport yourself, as well as the gnome glider. I also give you access to our mine.
translation: 这应该能让你在这里的停留更便利。你可以使用灵魂树传送自己，还有地精滑翔机。我还允许你进入我们的矿坑。

english: Mine?
translation: 矿坑？

english: Very few know of the secret mine under the Grand Tree. If you push on the roots just to my north they will separate and let you pass.
translation: 很少有人知道大树家园下的秘密矿坑。如果你推动我北边的树根，它们会分开让你通过。

english: Strange!
translation: 真奇怪！

english: That's magic trees for you! All the best Traveller and thanks again!
translation: 这就是魔法树嘛！祝你好运旅行者，再次感谢！

english: You too, Your highness!
translation: 您也是，陛下！

english: I warn you now, human: stay out of my affairs!
translation: 我现在警告你，人类：别管我的事！

english: I've stopped you before, Glough, and I'll stop you again!
translation: 我以前阻止过你，格劳夫，我还会再阻止你一次！

english: Hello there. My name's [player name].
translation: 你好啊。我叫[player name]。

english: Ahhh, good day young adventurer. I can't stop to talk right now I'm afraid.
translation: 啊啊，日安，年轻的冒险者。恐怕我现在没空跟你聊。

english: Ahhh, good day young adventurer. A good day indeed! Sylas is the name. It is lucky for you that you met me.
translation: 啊啊，日安，年轻的冒险者。真是个美好的日子！我叫赛拉斯。你碰到我算是走运了。

english: Why, what do you mean?
translation: 哦？你这话是什么意思？

english: Well it just so happens, [player name], that I have something you simply must have!
translation: [player name]，就是这么巧，我正好有件你绝对不能错过的东西！

english: Beans, my friend! Beans!
translation: 豆子，我的朋友！豆子！

english: Why would I want beans exactly? I mean, beans are good, of course, but I'm pretty sure I can get them anywhere.
translation: 我干嘛非要豆子不可？豆子虽然不错，但我觉得哪儿都能买到吧。

english: Ahhh, but not beans like this, young [player name]. No, not at all! These are 'magic' beans.
translation: 啊啊，但可不是普通的豆子，年轻的[player name]。绝不是！这些可是'魔法'豆。

english: Ok then. So what do they do exactly?
translation: 好吧。那它们到底有什么用处？

english: An excellent question! Excellent indeed! What do they do? What do they do? Yes, yes! A most excellent question!
translation: 问得好！真是好问题！它们有什么作用？什么作用？对，对！问得太好了！

english: O...kay. So, are you going to tell me what they do?
translation: 好……吧。那你到底打算告诉我它们有什么用吗？

english: You must plant them in the ground. Water them well. Then the magic will work, it's...er...magic...yes! Plant them, [player name].
translation: 你得把它们种到土里，好好浇水。然后魔法就会生效，这是……呃……魔法……没错！种下去吧，[player name]。

english: So, can I have the beans then?
translation: 那么，我能拿到豆子了吗？

english: All in good time, my excitable young friend. All in good time.
translation: 别着急，我激动的小朋友。到时候自然会给你的。

english: Few things in this world are free, you know, and beans - magical or otherwise - are no exception!
translation: 世界上可没多少东西是免费的，你知道的，豆子——无论是魔法豆还是普通豆——也不例外！

english: So, how much gold do you want for the beans, if I decide to buy them?
translation: 那如果我想买这些豆子，你要多少金币？

english: Ah, well you see now I am a collector of rare and unusual trinkets and objects. Not much in value, but very important to me.
translation: 啊，你看，我是个收藏家，专门收集珍奇古怪的小玩意和物品。虽然不值什么钱，但对我很重要。

english: Oh, I see. Ok then.
translation: 哦，我明白了。那好吧。

english: Right, well I think that for magic beans, I will need something magical back and I know of just the right items that would help my collection.
translation: 没错，我觉得用魔法豆来换，我也需要一些魔法物品作为交换。我知道有哪些东西正好能丰富我的收藏。

english: Ok, so if I get these items, you will trade them for the beans. Is that right?
translation: 好吧，也就是说，如果我拿到这些东西，你就用豆子跟我交换，对吧？

english: Yes! Excellent! You do catch on quick! I can see that we will become great business partners indeed. Oh, yes. Yes indeed! Hmm-ha! Yes.
translation: 没错！太棒了！你反应真快！看得出来我们一定会成为绝佳的生意伙伴。哦，对，确实如此！哼哈！没错。

english: What items do you need me to find then - assuming I still want those beans of course. Not that I do, but I might.
translation: 那你需要我找什么东西？当然前提是我还想要那些豆子。倒不是说我很想要，不过也有可能。

english: Well, there are two. The first item should be nice and simple for you to get for me. I want a griffin feather. Now, this is not just any feather, this one is special.
translation: 嗯，有两样。第一样你应该很容易就能弄到。我要一根狮鹫羽毛。不过这不是普通的羽毛，这根很特别。

english: There is a griffin named Grimgnash who lives in a nest on one of the peaks of White Wolf Mountain. It is one of his feathers that I want.
translation: 有一只叫格里姆纳什的狮鹫，住在白狼山的一座山峰上的巢穴里。我要的就是他的一根羽毛。

english: But although this task should be easy, you must be careful [player name]. Grimgnash has a very bad temper and even sharper claws!
translation: 不过虽然这个任务应该不难，但你必须小心，[player name]。格里姆纳什脾气很坏，爪子更是锋利得很！

english: Ok, thanks for the advice.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的提醒。

english: What do you need the feather for?
translation: 你要这根羽毛做什么？

english: I told you, [player name]. It is for my collection of magical items and trinkets, weird and wonderful thereof.
translation: 我跟你说过了，[player name]。它是为了我的魔法物品和小玩意收藏，奇奇怪怪的种种。

english: Thereof?
translation: 种种？

english: Yes, I was quite happy with that word. I think it went rather well in that last sentence, don't you?
translation: 没错，我对这个词很满意。我觉得放在刚才那句话里挺合适的，你不觉得吗？

english: I guess. If you say so.
translation: 也许吧。你说了算。

english: Yes. Excellent! Yes. Now...er...was there anything else?
translation: 没错。太棒了！好。那么……呃……还有别的事吗？

english: How do I find Grimgnash again?
translation: 我怎么才能找到格里姆纳什来着？

english: When he's not chewing on some poor soul's bones or raining terror on an unsuspecting village, he can be found in his nest, atop White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 当他不啃某些可怜人的骨头，或者不袭击某个毫无防备的村庄时，你可以在白狼山山顶的巢穴里找到他。

english: Excuse me...say what now? He chews people's bones? I thought you said this was an easy task?
translation: 等等……你说什么？他啃人骨头？你不是说这个任务很容易吗？

english: Oh, I daresay he has to eat sometimes. But I don't think he'd take too much fancy for you. Not much meat on you at all. Oh dear me, no!
translation: 哦，我敢说他总得吃东西吧。不过我觉得他不会对你太感兴趣。你身上根本没什么肉。哎呀呀，可不是嘛！

english: You know, I'm not sure that was even a compliment.
translation: 你知道吗，我都不知道这算不算夸奖。

english: I'm sure it was meant to be! Don't worry, [player name], you'll be fine. Now was there anything else?
translation: 我肯定是夸奖！别担心，[player name]，你不会有事的。还有别的事吗？

english: What's the other item I need to find?
translation: 我需要找的另一件东西是什么？

english: Right, well, the second item is this. I know of a dwarf named Rupert the Beard who has a very fine dwarven helmet. I'd like you to see if you can obtain it for me.
translation: 好，第二件东西是这样的。我知道有个叫胡子鲁伯特的矮人，他有一顶非常精致的矮人头盔。我希望你试着把它弄来给我。

english: Ok. Where can I find him?
translation: 好的。我在哪里能找到他？

english: Travel north-east from here and between the Goblin Village and Ice Mountain you will find Rupert in a tower there.
translation: 从这里往东北走，在哥布林村庄和冰山之间，你会在一座塔里找到鲁伯特。

english: Ok, that seems simple enough. I'll get the helmet for you as well.
translation: 好的，听起来挺简单的。我也会把头盔弄来给你。

english: Excellent! Yes, yes. Now was there anything else?
translation: 太棒了！好，好。还有别的事吗？

english: Do you have any weird items in your collection?
translation: 你的收藏里有什么奇怪的东西吗？

english: Haha! Weird items? Oh yes. Yes indeed! Yes. Many items. Many items. Yes.
translation: 哈哈！奇怪的东西？哦，有啊。确实有！有。很多很多。没错。

english: Umm...I see. Well, can you tell me about any of them?
translation: 嗯……我明白了。那你给我讲讲其中一些吧？

english: Hmm. Well let's see now. I have the second eye of a mutant two-eyed cyclops. That was a rare find indeed! And at a tidy price too!
translation: 嗯，让我想想。我有一只变异双睛独眼巨人的第二只眼睛。那真是稀有的发现！而且价格也不菲！

english: A two-eyed cyclops? Uh...wouldn't that be a normal giant perhaps?
translation: 双睛独眼巨人？呃……那不就是普通的巨人吗？

english: Whatever do you mean? How many mutant two-eyed cyclops do you think there are out there? Not many, I'd wager!
translation: 你这是什么意思？你觉得外面有多少只变异双睛独眼巨人？我敢打赌没几只！

english: Umm...no, I guess not. Well, what else do you have?
translation: 嗯……没有，我想确实不多。那你还有什么别的？

english: Ah, well I'm glad you asked. My most prized possession to date: Through my connections, I managed to acquire a horn-less Unicorn!
translation: 啊，好吧，很高兴你问起。我迄今为止最珍贵的财产：通过我的关系，我设法弄到一只没有角的独角兽！

english: Really? That's amazing! A unicorn without a horn?
translation: 真的吗？太棒了！一只没有角的独角兽？

english: Yes. Yes indeed! Indeed yes! And I'm very proud of it, too! It was an exceptionally lucky find, I must say!
translation: 没错。确实如此！一点不假！我也很自豪！不得不说，那真是极为幸运的发现！

english: I expect so. Well, on to other things for now then, I guess.
translation: 我想也是。好吧，那我们先说别的事吧。

english: Of course. Was there anything else you wanted?
translation: 当然。你还有别的事吗？

english: I should be off, I think.
translation: 我想我该走了。

english: Excellent, excellent! Best of luck then, my friend. I'll be right here waiting for you to return.
translation: 好极了，好极了！那就祝你好运了，我的朋友。我就在这儿等你回来。

english: I have a question or two I would like to ask you.
translation: 我有几个问题想问你。

english: Of course. Go ahead.
translation: 当然，问吧。

english: Uh...hello?
translation: 呃……有人吗？

english: Human? Human come to Grimgnash? Grimgnash pleased! Grimgnash hungry!
translation: 人类？人类来找格里姆纳什？格里姆纳什高兴！格里姆纳什饿了！

english: No, wait! I didn't come to be eaten!
translation: 不，等等！我不是来给你吃的！

english: What human come for then? Grimgnash tired and hungry. Be quick, human. Answer Grimgnash before Grimgnash eats your legs!
translation: 那人类来干什么？格里姆纳什又累又饿。快说，人类。在格里姆纳什吃掉你的腿之前回答俺！

english: Uh...uh...
I heard you were a great and mighty Griffin!
translation: 我听说你是一只伟大而强大的狮鹫！

english: Hah! Human hears right about Grimgnash! Grimgnash great and mighty griffin!
translation: 哈！人类说得对！格里姆纳什是伟大而强大的狮鹫！

english: Now what human want? Grimgnash tired and can't sleep. Wolves make awful howling racket. Keep Grimgnash up all night.
translation: 现在人类想要什么？格里姆纳什累了睡不着。狼群嚎叫得厉害，吵得俺整晚睡不着。

english: Perhaps I can help you get to sleep in some way. Is there anything I can do?
translation: 也许我能想办法帮你入睡。有什么我能做的吗？

english: I have come for your magic feather!
translation: 我是来要你的魔法羽毛的！

english: Grimgnash's feather? Human come to steal feather? How dare human! Puny, scrawny little morsel! Grimgnash should eat human where human stands!
translation: 格里姆纳什的羽毛？人类来偷羽毛？人类好大的胆子！瘦弱的小点心！格里姆纳什应该当场吃掉人类！

english: Quests? Quests? Human morsel wants a quest from Grimgnash? Human think Grimgnash is drunken dwarf or lazy ork? Grimgnash not gives quests!
translation: 任务？任务？人类小点心想要格里姆纳什给任务？人类以为俺是醉酒的矮人还是懒惰的兽人？格里姆纳什不给任务！

english: Grimgnash tired and hungry and will eat little bite-size human!
translation: 格里姆纳什又累又饿，要吃掉一口就能吞下的人类！

english: Human toothpick dares to approach Grimgnash again after what human just say? Why human disturb Grimgnash? Human have death wish?
translation: 人类牙签居然还敢接近格里姆纳什？人类为什么打扰俺？人类想找死吗？

english: No, wait! I was wondering if perhaps I could help you at all. You said you couldn't sleep. Is there anything I can do?
translation: 不，等等！我在想也许我能帮上忙。你说你睡不着。有什么我能做的吗？

english: Human help Grimgnash sleep? This good. Grimgnash let human help.
translation: 人类帮格里姆纳什睡觉？这不错。格里姆纳什让人类帮忙。

english: Ok. What can I do?
translation: 好的。我能做什么？

english: Hmm. When Grimgnash little grifflet, Grimgnash's mother-griff used to tell bedtime story to Grimgnash. That always help Grimgnash sleep.
translation: 嗯。当格里姆纳什还是小狮鹫时，格里姆纳什的狮鹫母亲常常给格里姆纳什讲睡前故事。那总是能让格里姆纳什入睡。

english: So you want me to tell you a bed-time story, is that right?
translation: 所以你想让我给你讲个睡前故事，对吗？

english: Yes! Grimgnash like stories!
translation: 对！格里姆纳什喜欢故事！

english: Right, well I'm sure that shouldn't be too hard. I know lots of stories!
translation: 好吧，这应该不难。我知道好多故事！

english: Good. Grimgnash like stories. Lots of death and fire and destruction! Grimgnash ready!
translation: 好。格里姆纳什喜欢故事。要有好多死亡、火焰和毁灭！格里姆纳什准备好了！

english: Death and fire?...ok then. Let me see...
translation: 死亡和火焰？……好吧。让我想想……

english: And make story good. Otherwise, if no sleep, Grimgnash more hungry!
translation: 故事要精彩。不然，要是睡不着，格里姆纳什更饿！

english: There once was a graveyard filled with undead.
translation: 从前有个墓地，里面满是亡灵。

english: Graveyard is good place for story. Is undeads all horrible and ugly?
translation: 墓地是讲故事的好地方。那些亡灵都又可怕又丑陋吗？

english: Uh...yes...yes I suppose they could be.
translation: 呃……是的……我想是的。

english: Grimgnash like this story. Go on. Go on.
translation: 格里姆纳什喜欢这个故事。说下去。说下去。

english: There lived a skeleton named Grimgnash.
translation: 那里住着一个骷髅，名叫格里姆纳什。

english: Grimgnash? That Grimgnash's name! Not stupid skeleton's name! How skeleton have Grimgnash's name?
translation: 格里姆纳什？那是俺的名字！不是蠢骷髅的名字！骷髅怎么会有俺的名字？

english: Oh, wait! Sorry! I got that bit wrong there. I was thinking of your name. My mistake! What I meant was...
translation: 哦，等等！抱歉！我刚才说错了。我想到你的名字了。我的错！我的意思是……

english: There lived a skeleton named Skullrot.
translation: 那里住着一个骷髅，名叫枯骨。

english: Oh yes! Skullrot. That great name! Grimgnash like that name. Maybe Grimgnash call himself Grimgnash Skullrotter? What human think?
translation: 哦对！枯骨。好名字！格里姆纳什喜欢这个名字。也许格里姆纳什可以自称格里姆纳什.枯骨者？人类觉得怎么样？

english: I...er..I'm sure nobody would disagree with you.
translation: 我……呃……我肯定没人会反对。

english: Yes. Grimgnash Skullrotter. Grimgnash like that very much. What happens next? This good story...for human.
translation: 对。格里姆纳什.枯骨者。格里姆纳什很喜欢。接下来呢？这个故事不错……对人类来说。

english: Skullrot was happy!
translation: 枯骨很开心！

english: Why Skullrot happy?
translation: 为什么枯骨开心？

english: Uh...he was happy because...er...he was dead?
translation: 呃……他开心是因为……呃……他死了？

english: Because he dead? That stupid. How someone happy if they dead? Stupid human tell stupid story! Raaargh!
translation: 因为他死了？真蠢。死了怎么会开心？蠢人类讲蠢故事！嗷嗷嗷！

english: Skullrot was sad!
translation: 枯骨很难过！

english: Sad? Why he sad?
translation: 难过？他为什么难过？

english: Uh...I guess because he was...er...dead?
translation: 呃……我猜是因为他……呃……死了？

english: What human mean, dead? How Skullrot dead if he alive and walking around? That stupid!
translation: 人类说的死是什么意思？如果颅腐还活着到处走，他怎么会死？真蠢！

english: No, I don't think you understand what a skeleton is, exactly...
translation: 不，我觉得你不太明白骷髅到底是什么……

english: Now human call Grimgnash stupid? Human is stupid! Human is tasty morsel! Grimgnash likes tasty morsels!
translation: 现在人类说格里姆纳什蠢？人类才蠢！人类是美味的小点心！格里姆纳什喜欢美味的小点心！

english: Argh...!
Skullrot was angry!
translation: 颅腐生气了！

english: What Skullrot angry about?
translation: 颅腐为什么生气？

english: Uh...he was angry because...er...he had a headache?
translation: 呃……他生气是因为……呃……他头疼？

english: A headache? That daft idea. Skeletons have nothing in head to ache. Grimgnash think human is making story up. Not real story like mother-griff used to tell.
translation: 头疼？这想法真蠢。骷髅脑袋里什么都没有，怎么会疼。格里姆纳什觉得人类在编故事。不像母亲狮鹫以前讲的那种真实故事。

english: Grimgnash just eat human instead!
translation: 格里姆纳什干脆把人类吃掉算了！

english: Skullrot was insane!
translation: 颅腐疯了！

english: Yes, insane! Grimgnash like that word! Grimgnash mother always say Grimgnash's daddy insane. Grimgnash's daddy eat own claws. Grimgnash laughed.
translation: 对，疯了！格里姆纳什喜欢这个词！格里姆纳什的母亲总说格里姆纳什的爸爸疯了。格里姆纳什的爸爸吃自己的爪子。格里姆纳什笑了。

english: That's...lovely. Uh...shall I continue?
translation: 真……温馨。呃……我能继续吗？

english: Yes! Grimgnash liking this story now! Go on!
translation: 好！格里姆纳什开始喜欢这个故事了！继续！

english: Ok, then. So Skullrot was completely insane. He was off his rocker. One noodle short of a bowl of spaghetti. Not quite all there.
translation: 好吧，那么。颅枯彻底疯了。他完全失去理智。一碗意大利面缺一根面条。不太正常。

english: Anyway, he was out haunting his graveyard one day when he came across a small gnome.
translation: 总之，有一天他在自己的墓地里游荡时，遇到了一个小地精。

english: Grimgnash not like gnomes. They stringy and chewy and they not have much meat for Grimgnash's belly.
translation: 格里姆纳什不喜欢地精。他们又筋道又难嚼，而且肉太少，填不饱格里姆纳什的肚子。

english: Uh, I'm sorry to hear that. Anyway, this poor gnome had somehow got his foot stuck under a fallen gravestone.
translation: 呃，听你这么说我很遗憾。总之，这个可怜的地精不知怎么把脚卡在了一块倒下的墓碑下面。

english: Skullrot lifted the gravestone off.
translation: 颅腐把墓碑抬了起来。

english: And the gnome ran away as quick as his little feet could carry him.
translation: 然后地精用他的小脚丫能跑多快就跑多快地逃走了。

english: What?! Gnome snack gets away? That dumb. How Skullrot eat? Stupid human can't tell good story!
translation: 什么？！地精点心跑了？真蠢。颅腐怎么吃？愚蠢的人类不会讲好故事！

english: No, wait...!
translation: 不，等等……！

english: Skullrot left the gnome there to die.
translation: 颅腐把地精留在那里等死。

english: So the gnome, thinking this was his chance, found a log to lever the stone off his foot and he scarpered away quickly.
translation: 于是那个地精觉得这是他的机会，找到一根原木把石头从脚上撬开，然后迅速溜走了。

english: What?! Gnome snack gets away? That stupid. That not good story! Grimgnash only feel more hungry now!
translation: 什么？！地精点心跑了？真蠢。这故事不好！格里姆纳什现在只觉得更饿了！

english: No, wait, I got it wrong! Wait...!
translation: 不，等等，我搞错了！等等……！

english: Skullrot laughed at the gnome.
translation: 颅腐嘲笑那个地精。

english: In fact, he laughed so hard that he fell backwards into an empty grave and was never seen again. The end.
translation: 事实上，他笑得那么厉害，以至于向后跌进了一个空坟墓里，再也没有人见过他。故事结束。

english: Graah! That good stor...wait. What happen to gnome?
translation: 嘎啊！这故事好……等等。地精怎么了？

english: Eh? Oh, uh...well without Skullrot there he was able to get himself free again and ran away, vowing never to return to the graveyard ever again.
translation: 嗯？哦，呃……没有颅腐在那里，他就能自己挣脱出来跑掉了，并发誓再也不回墓地。

english: What?! Little bite-size gnome runs away? That not good ending! Gnome should be mashed by something like...something like Grimgnash! Stupid human get eaten now!
translation: 什么？！小不点地精跑了？这结局不好！地精应该被什么东西碾碎，比如……像格里姆纳什这样的！愚蠢的人类现在要被吃掉了！

english: Skullrot hungrily grabbed the gnome's hair.
translation: 颅腐饥饿地抓住了地精的头发。

english: Skullrot wrenched the gnome out with one hand, pulling hard on his hair. The poor gnome's foot snapped out of the gravestone and went crack as his foot dislocated!
translation: 颅腐一只手抓住地精的头发，使劲把他拽了出来。可怜的地精的脚从墓碑下猛地抽出来，咔嚓一声，脚脱臼了！

english: Raahahaha! Stupid gnome! Serves gnome right for being stringy and chewy! What happen next?
translation: 哈哈哈！愚蠢的地精！活该他那么筋道又难嚼！然后呢？

english: Well, the poor gnome - Nobby was his name - was in terrible pain and fear as to what would happen to him next.
translation: 嗯，可怜的地精——他叫诺比——痛苦万分，又害怕接下来会发生什么。

english: Grimgnash not care what gnome's name is. Grimgnash not give food names. Does human call a carrot Jasper or something? Tell rest of story!
translation: 格里姆纳什不在乎地精叫什么名字。格里姆纳什不给食物起名字。难道人类会给一根胡萝卜起名叫贾斯珀什么的吗？快讲剩下的故事！

english: Ok, ok. Anyway, the gnome was in awful pain, so Skullrot took him back to his home in his grave where he...
translation: 好吧，好吧。总之，地精疼得要命，所以颅腐把他带回了自己坟墓里的家，在那里他……

english: Locked him in an iron cage.
translation: 把他锁在一个铁笼子里。

english: Luckily, the bars were built for a human sized person and so the gnome quickly slipped through them and ran - painfully - out the door.
translation: 幸运的是，笼子的栏杆是按人类体型做的，所以地精很快就钻了过去，忍着疼痛跑出了门。

english: The gnome headed straight out the graveyard, glad to still be alive and never wanting to return.
translation: 地精径直跑出墓地，庆幸自己还活着，再也不想回来了。

english: Stringy gnome gets away? Stupid human make Grimgnash more hungry with story like that!
translation: 筋道的地精跑了？愚蠢的人类讲这种故事让格里姆纳什更饿了！

english: No, stop! Arrgh...!
translation: 不，住手！啊……！

english: Put him into a pot for dinner.
translation: 把他放进罐里当晚餐。

english: Skullrot was making a stew and had decided that the gnome would taste wonderful in it.
translation: 颅腐正在做炖菜，觉得把地精放进去味道一定很棒。

english: Ah! Grimgnash likes gnome stew. Just like Grimgnash used to eat at home. Mmmm!
translation: 啊！格里姆纳什喜欢地精炖菜。就像格里姆纳什以前在家吃的一样。嗯嗯！

english: However, Skullrot had filled the pot up too much, and so while the skeleton's back was turned, the gnome swam to the edge of the pot and up, over the side.
translation: 然而，颅腐怪把罐子装得太满了，所以趁骷髅转身时，地精游到罐子边缘爬了上去，翻过了边沿。

english: With a little shout of glee, the gnome hopped on one leg straight out of the door and fled as fast as his little foot could hop him!
translation: 地精高兴地喊了一声，单腿跳着径直出了门，用他的小脚丫能跳多快就跳多快地逃走了！

english: Gnome gets away? What kind of story that? Grimgnash think he eat human now!
translation: 地精跑了？这算什么故事？格里姆纳什觉得现在该吃人了！

english: Started to strangle the poor gnome.
translation: 开始掐那个可怜的地精的脖子。

english: The gnome struggled with the cold boney fingers that were trying to end his life until he managed to pry himself free!
translation: 地精与那些试图结束他生命的冰冷骨指挣扎着，直到他设法挣脱出来！

english: Ohhh! This getting good! Grimgnash like this. (Yawn!) Grimgnash feels sleepy.
translation: 哦哦！这开始精彩了！格里姆纳什喜欢这样。（打哈欠）格里姆纳什觉得困了。

english: Ok, it was all the little gnome could do to crawl painfully across the floor away from Skullrot, who was busy getting a pot to put the gnome in.
translation: 好吧，小地精只能痛苦地爬过地板，远离正在忙着找罐子来装他的颅腐怪。

english: Then, when all seemed lost for the little gnome, he suddenly saw something that might save his little life!
translation: 然后，当小地精似乎一切都完了的时候，他突然看到了可能拯救他小命的东西！

english: Grargh! What? What? What little gnome see? He must not escape! Grimgnash hungry to think of it!
translation: 嘎啊！什么？什么？小地精看到了什么？他绝不能逃跑！格里姆纳什一想到就饿了！

english: Ok, ok! Don't worry, we're almost done.
translation: 好吧，好吧！别担心，我们快讲完了。

english: Grmmm. Good. Grimgnash getting sleepy...(yawn).
translation: 嗯嗯。好。格里姆纳什困了……（打哈欠）。

english: So, then. The gnome looked up and he saw what might be his best chance to get out alive!
translation: 那么，地精抬起头，看到了可能是他活着出去的最好机会！

english: He saw a hole he could just fit through.
translation: 他看到了一个刚好能钻过去的洞。

english: As he crawled forward two yellow slitted eyes appeared in the gloom before him. He froze in fear!
translation: 当他向前爬时，两只黄色的细长眼睛出现在他面前的黑暗中。他吓得僵住了！

english: Skullrot did not get his dinner that night, but something else...something much worse...did. The end.
translation: 那天晚上颅腐没有吃到晚餐，但别的东西……更可怕的东西……吃到了。故事结束。

english: So what did you think, Grimgnash?
translation: 你觉得怎么样，格里姆纳什？

english: Zzzzzz....zzzz....zzz...
translation: 呼噜噜……呼噜……呼……

english: He saw a big axe leaning on the wall.
translation: 他看到墙上靠着一把大斧头。

english: He crawled painfully, oh so painfully over to the axe. He could use it to kill Skullrot.
translation: 他痛苦地，哦，那么痛苦地爬到斧头那里。他可以用它来杀死颅腐。

english: As he grasped the axe he realised it was a lot heavier than it looked! In fact much heavier indeed! He couldn't hold it or stop it falling off the wall!
translation: 当他抓住斧头时，他意识到它比看起来重得多！事实上，重得多！他拿不住它，也无法阻止它从墙上掉下来！

english: SCHNUNK!!
translation: 咔嚓！！

english: What happened? Human tell Grimgnash!
translation: 发生了什么？人类快告诉格里姆纳什！

english: As the axe fell, the poor gnome could not get out of the way in time and the razor sharp blade fell CRACK! And it killed him instantly.
translation: 斧头落下时，可怜的地精来不及躲开，锋利的刀片咔嚓一声落下！当场就把他砍死了。

english: And so Skullrot was pleased to find that he had a nice dinner for that night and sat down for a big supper! The end.
translation: 于是颅腐很高兴地发现那天晚上有了一顿丰盛的晚餐，坐下来大吃一顿！故事结束。

english: What did you think, Grimgnash?
translation: 你觉得怎么样，格里姆纳什？

english: He saw some bones lying in the corner.
translation: 他看到角落里有一些骨头。

english: He quickly remembered that if he buried them he could get his prayer up and so might be able to cast a heal spell on his legs!
translation: 他很快想起，如果他把它们埋了，就能提升他的祈祷，也许就能对腿施一个治疗法术！

english: He dragged his painful body over to the bones and buried them all - there was quite a large pile - in the floor.
translation: 他拖着疼痛的身体爬到骨头那里，把它们全部埋进了地板里——那里有一大堆。

english: All of a sudden, he remembered a good spell to heal himself from his injuries. He started to recite the prayer quickly.
translation: 突然，他想起了一个好法术来治疗自己的伤势。他开始快速念诵祈祷词。

english: Just then, a huge zombie appeared out of nowhere and mumbled something about his bones being disturbed! The zombie crunched his fist down on the gnome's head.
translation: 就在这时，一个巨大的僵尸不知从哪里冒出来，咕哝着说他的骨头被打扰了！僵尸一拳砸在地精的头上。

english: The gnome cried out in terror and realised that all was lost! He could not get away now!
translation: 地精惊恐地大叫，意识到一切都完了！他现在逃不掉了！

english: And so, Skullrot decided to invite the zombie to dinner as he never usually had guests.
translation: 于是，颅腐决定邀请僵尸共进晚餐，因为他平时很少有客人。

english: Then the two of them laughed and joked merrily throughout the night with their stomachs full of a hearty dinner! The end.
translation: 然后他们两个整晚都开心地笑着、开着玩笑，肚子吃得饱饱的！故事结束。

english: He saw a small sandwich on the floor.
translation: 他看到地板上有一个小三明治。

english: He pulled himself over to it. In his desperation he thought to himself, there's a sandwich here. A sandwich! Maybe the skeleton will eat that instead?
translation: 他拖着身子爬过去。在绝望中，他心想，这里有个三明治。一个三明治！也许骷髅会吃那个代替？

english: He quickly grasped the sandwich in his little hands. Strangely, in his panic-stricken state, he noticed that it was long and tubular shaped.
translation: 他迅速用小手抓住了三明治。奇怪的是，在恐慌的状态下，他注意到它又长又管状。

english: What an odd thing to notice, he thought. And then all of a sudden he heard an almighty voice boom out of nowhere!
translation: 注意到这个真奇怪，他想。然后突然他听到一个巨大的声音不知从何处响起！

english: 'SANDWICHES!!!'
'Oi!', said the voice. 'I didn't say you could take that!' And with that, there was an almighty crunch on his little gnome head, and that was the last thing he felt.
translation: '喂！'，那个声音说。'我没说你可以拿那个！'话音刚落，他的小地精脑袋上传来一声巨响，那是他最后的感觉。

english: Skullrot sat down for the night and had a lovely big dinner, followed by many baguette sandwiches. Not triangle ones, no, no! The end.
translation: 颅腐坐下来过夜，吃了一顿丰盛的大餐，接着又吃了很多法棍面包三明治。不是三角形的，不，不！故事结束。

english: Locked the gnome in the attic to die.
translation: 把地精锁在阁楼里等死。

english: Fortunately for the gnome, Skullrot forgot that he lived in a grave, so he didn't have an attic. Instead the gnome was locked outside.
translation: 幸运的是，对地精来说，颅腐忘记了自己住在坟墓里，所以他没有阁楼。结果地精被锁在了外面。

english: The gnome quickly limped away, glad to still be alive.
translation: 地精一瘸一拐地迅速走开了，庆幸自己还活着。

english: Gnome gets away? What kind of story that? Stupid human make Grimgnash more hungry!
translation: 地精跑了？这算什么故事？愚蠢的人类让格里姆纳什更饿了！

english: There lived a skeleton named Boney.
translation: 从前有一个叫骨头的骷髅。

english: Boney? That stupid name for skeleton. Of course he boney. Human think Grimgnash stupid? Human make fun of Grimgnash? Grimgnash think human look better in Grimgnash's belly!
translation: 骨头？给骷髅起这名字真蠢。他当然浑身是骨头。人类觉得格里姆纳什蠢？人类在取笑格里姆纳什？格里姆纳什觉得人类在格里姆纳什的肚子里更好看！

english: No wait...I...
translation: 不，等等……我……

english: There lived a skeleton named Harry.
translation: 从前有一个叫哈里的骷髅。

english: What kind of name Harry for skeleton? That stupid name. How many skeletons called Harry you meet?
translation: 给骷髅起名叫哈里算什么？这名字真蠢。你见过几个骷髅叫哈里？

english: Uh, I've not really...
translation: 呃，我其实没……

english: Grimgnash think Grimgnash just eat you instead of story!
translation: 格里姆纳什觉得格里姆纳什干脆把你吃掉算了，不讲故事了！

english: There once was a king named Roland.
translation: 从前有一个叫罗兰的国王。

english: Gaah! This sound like boring story! Maybe Grimgnash eat you instead, yes?
translation: 嘎啊！这听起来像无聊的故事！也许格里姆纳什还是吃掉你算了，嗯？

english: What? No! Wait, I got that bit wrong! Sorry. What I meant was...
translation: 什么？不！等等，我那段说错了！抱歉。我的意思是……

english: There once was a princess named Esmerelda.
translation: 从前有一位名叫埃斯梅拉达的公主。

english: Urgh! Grimgnash hate princesses. They bones and no meat. Need eating more, Grimgnash thinks. Speak of eating, Grimgnash maybe eat you instead of story!
translation: 呃！格里姆纳什讨厌公主。她们只有骨头没有肉。格里姆纳什觉得需要多吃点。说到吃，格里姆纳什也许改吃你，不听故事了！

english: There once was a little bunny called Flumper.
translation: 从前有一只名叫弗伦珀的小兔子。

english: Bunnies? Bunnies!? Grimgnash hate this story! This story smell worse than Grimgnash's feet. Stupid human tell awful story! Make Grimgnash more hungry than ever!
translation: 兔子？兔子！？格里姆纳什讨厌这个故事！这个故事闻起来比格里姆纳什的脚还臭。愚蠢的人类讲了个糟糕的故事！让格里姆纳什比以往更饿了！

english: Hi, Sylas. I have Grimgnash's feather for you.
translation: 嗨，赛拉斯。我帮你拿到了格里姆纳什的羽毛。

english: Ah! Good work. Let me take that from you then.
translation: 啊！干得好。那就让我拿走吧。

english: I still need you to find Rupert the Beard's Helmet for me.
translation: 我还需要你帮我找到鲁伯特.胡子的头盔。

english: Ok, I'll get that next.
translation: 好的，我接下来就去拿那个。

english: Excuse me. You can't go in there.
translation: 不好意思。你不能进去那里。

english: I'm pretty sure I don't want that.
translation: 我很确定我不想要那个。

english: Well it's mine and you can't have it anyway. So there!
translation: 嗯，那是我的，反正你也拿不到。就这样！

english: Hey, what's that noise over there? Is someone there? Who's near my tower?
translation: 嘿，那边是什么声音？有人在那里吗？谁在我的塔附近？

english: Uh...no...no, nothing to see here. It was just the...er...wind! Yes, the wind.
translation: 呃……不……不，这里没什么好看的。只是……呃……风！对，是风。

english: Oh. Oh I see! Oh, yes. How clever! Remarkable idea! However did you think of that? Good show, old bean!
translation: 哦。哦，我明白了！哦，是的。真聪明！了不起的想法！你是怎么想到的？干得好，老伙计！

english: Yes, old ogleroot! On account of my wonderfully long bearded chin, you see.
translation: 是的，老眼根！你看，因为我那奇妙的长胡子下巴。

english: By Guthix, I know how you can help me!
translation: 以古斯之名，我知道你怎么能帮我了！

english: Sure. What can I do?
translation: 当然。我能做什么？

english: Hey, what's that noise over there? Is someone there?
translation: 嘿，那边是什么声音？有人在那里吗？

english: Ye gods! We can't talk like this anymore. You need to find a way up to speak to me privately, old boot!
translation: 天哪！我们不能再这样说话了。你得找个办法上来私下跟我谈，旧靴子！

english: Why? I don't understand what's going on!
translation: 为什么？我不明白发生了什么！

english: That woman is a princess. She's holding me prisoner. If she sees you I will be in even more trouble and who knows what she'll do to you!
translation: 那个女人是个公主。她把我囚禁在这里。如果她看到你，我的麻烦就更大了，谁知道她会对你做什么！

english: Right! Let me have a think, then!
translation: 好吧！让我想想！

english: Umm...it's me again. [player name]. I'm speaking in the drain pipe, remember?
translation: 嗯……又是我。[player name]。我在排水管里说话，记得吗？

english: Drain pi...oh, yes! Of course! Well, hello again old cigar! How great to se...er...hear from you again.
translation: 排水管……哦，是的！当然！好吧，又见到你了老雪茄！再次见到……呃……听到你的消息真是太好了。

english: I'm sure there must be something I can do to help you up there.
translation: 我相信一定有办法能帮你从上面下来。

english: Hmm. Let me think now.
translation: 嗯。让我想想。

english: I think I might have an idea!
translation: 我想我可能有个主意了！

english: You there! Young scrub! Was that you making all that noise back there? Well? Speak up now.
translation: 你！小毛头！是你在那边弄出那些噪音吗？嗯？快说。

english: Noise? What noise? I didn't hear any noise.
translation: 噪音？什么噪音？我没听到任何噪音。

english: Well I distinctly heard voices at least! In any case, keep away from my tower.
translation: 哼，我明明听到了说话声！不管怎样，离我的塔远点。

english: I am a princess. I don't have to be nice.
translation: 我是公主。我没必要对人友善。

english: I thought princesses were usually kind and loving and graceful?
translation: 我以为公主通常都是善良、有爱心、优雅的？

english: Ha! This isn't a fairytale, you know. This is rea...well, it's life!
translation: 哈！这可不是童话，你知道的。这是现……嗯，这就是生活！

english: I see. Well I think I had better go then.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，我想我最好还是走吧。

english: Yes, and stay away from my dwar...uh...tower!
translation: 对，离我的矮人……呃……塔远点！

english: Jolly good show, old bean! What do you suggest?
translation: 干得好，老伙计！你有什么建议？

english: You could try and climb down.
translation: 你可以试着爬下来。

english: Climb down? What what what? It's miles! People are like little ants from up here...oh wait...no that's just a line of ants on the wall.
translation: 爬下去？什么什么什么？有好几英里高！从这里看人像小蚂蚁……哦等等……不，那只是墙上的一排蚂蚁。

english: It's really not that far.
translation: 其实没那么远。

english: Tish, posh and nonsense! You and your gangly long legs might be fine, but we dwarves are of shorter, stockier breed, old toothbrush!
translation: 胡说八道！你和你那细长的长腿可能没问题，但我们矮人是更矮小、更粗壮的种族，旧牙刷！

english: So you won't try it then?
translation: 所以你不打算试试？

english: Indeed, definitely and most indubitably not! Think of something else!
translation: 确实，绝对，毫无疑问地不试！想点别的！

english: I could try and climb up.
translation: 我可以试着爬上去。

english: Hmm, a worthy endeavour I would say. Possibly with its merits. Yes, indeed. Now how will you get up here?
translation: 嗯，我得说这是个值得一试的努力。可能自有其优点。是的，确实。现在你打算怎么上来？

english: I could try and climb the walls.
translation: 我可以试着爬墙。

english: I don't know if that would work, old trousers. These walls are made from very smooth and flat stone. Excellent workmanship. Simply excellent.
translation: 我不知道那行不行得通，旧裤子。这些墙是用非常光滑平坦的石头砌成的。工艺精湛。简直精湛。

english: I'm glad you're able to admire the architecture, but you're still stuck up there!
translation: 我很高兴你能欣赏建筑，但你还被困在上面呢！

english: Right you are, old pockets! Keep thinking! These are excellent ideas you're having!
translation: 说得对，旧口袋！继续想！你这些主意都很棒！

english: Is there anything up there that can help?
translation: 上面有什么东西能帮忙吗？

english: Not really, old spoon. There's not much up here except for me and my beard. Ha ha!
translation: 没什么，旧勺子。上面除了我和我的胡子，没什么东西。哈哈！

english: Wait! That's it!
translation: 等等！就是这个！

english: What's it, old banana?
translation: 是什么，旧香蕉？

english: I can't believe I'm going to say this, but...Rupert, Rupert, let down your beard!
translation: 我真不敢相信我会这么说，但是……鲁伯特，鲁伯特，放下你的胡子！

english: Eh? Let down my beard? Have you lost it down there, old chum? Going a bit loopy?
translation: 呃？放下我的胡子？你在下面疯了吗，老友？有点神志不清了？

english: No, I mean hang your beard down over the tower and I'll climb up it, ok?
translation: 不，我是说把你的胡子垂到塔外面，我爬上去，行吗？

english: Ah ha ha! Excellent idea, old tomato! Here it comes then!
translation: 啊哈哈哈！好主意，旧番茄！那就来了！

english: I can fly!
translation: 我会飞！

english: By Guthix and Saradomin, that's astounding! You are an absolute marvel! Can you really fly?
translation: 以古斯和萨拉多明之名，太惊人了！你真是个奇迹！你真的会飞？

english: Well...er...no, sorry, I made that last bit up!
translation: 嗯……呃……不，抱歉，最后那句是我编的！

english: I see. Not very sporting in the circumstances, was it?
translation: 我明白了。在这种情况下，这不太光明正大，不是吗？

english: Umm, no I guess not. Sorry about that.
translation: 嗯，我想不是。抱歉。

english: There must be something down here that might help.
translation: 下面一定有什么东西能帮忙。

english: I'm afraid I have no idea! It's a long way down as I said, so I can't see much from way up here!
translation: 恐怕我不知道！就像我说的，下面很远，我从这里看不太清楚！

english: I'm telling you, it's really not that high.
translation: 我告诉你，真的没那么高。

english: Lies! Lies! Now can you see anything down there that might help, old chicken?
translation: 谎言！谎言！现在你能看到下面有什么能帮忙的吗，老鸡？

english: I could ask the princess!
translation: 我可以去问公主！

english: Hang on, old underpants!...you're going to ask the princess to help you climb up this wall to see her prisoner.
translation: 等等，老内裤！……你要去问公主帮你爬上这堵墙来看她的囚犯。

english: You know, on second thought maybe that's not such a good idea after all.
translation: 你知道，再想想，也许那毕竟不是个好主意。

english: No, indeed. Indeed, no.
translation: 不，确实。确实，不。

english: Well, I could try and ask her to let you out, perhaps? You know, get her to listen to reason.
translation: 嗯，也许我可以试着请她放你出来？你知道，让她讲点道理。

english: Reason, eh? Hmmm. Well you could give that a try.
translation: 讲道理，呃？嗯。你可以试试看。

english: I could try speaking to the princess.
translation: 我可以试着和公主谈谈。

english: Well, I suppose it wouldn't hurt to try, old socks! What would you say?
translation: 嗯，我想试试也无妨，老袜子！你想说什么？

english: Well, I could try and get her to listen to reason, I suppose.
translation: 嗯，我想我可以试着让她讲点道理。

english: Reason, eh? Hmmm. Well, you could give that a try.
translation: 讲道理，呃？嗯。你可以试试看。

english: I could kill the princess for you!
translation: 我可以为你杀了公主！

english: What? Kill the princess?
translation: 什么？杀了公主？

english: Sure, she doesn't look so tough!
translation: 当然，她看起来没那么厉害！

english: What ever has gotten into your head, old war wound? Kill the princess. No, no, no. We don't do that sort of thing round here.
translation: 你脑子里到底在想什么，老伤疤？杀了公主。不，不，不。我们这里不做那种事。

english: But she's kidnapped you. Surely that makes her evil?
translation: 但她绑架了你。这肯定说明她是邪恶的吧？

english: Well, yes of course. In a manner of speaking, yes. But...but that still doesn't give us the right to go around lopping people's heads off because they're not very nice!
translation: 嗯，是的，当然。从某种意义上说，是的。但是……但那仍然不给我们权利到处砍人的头，只因为他们不太友善！

english: No, there must be another way! Keep thinking!
translation: 不，一定有别的办法！继续想！

english: But it would have been fun though, wouldn't it? Haha!
translation: 但那样会很有趣，不是吗？哈哈！

english: She would never have seen it coming! Blam!
translation: 她绝对想不到！砰！

english: Yes, I get the idea. Now be a sport and think of a better idea!
translation: 是的，我明白了。现在拿出点风度，想个更好的主意！

english: Right!
translation: 好吧！

english: Pardon me...?
translation: 打扰一下……？

english: Yes? Please make it quick, I am waiting for someone.
translation: 嗯？请快点说，我在等人。

english: Oh, really? Who are you waiting for? Maybe I've met them?
translation: 哦，真的吗？你在等谁？也许我见过他们？

english: You think so? Ha! Although you'd most likely remember if you had met this person. If you must know, I am waiting for a relative of mine to arrive.
translation: 你这么想？哈！不过如果你见过这个人，你很可能会记得。如果你非要知道，我在等我的一个亲戚到来。

english: Oh, okay. Can I ask you something?
translation: 哦，好吧。我能问你点事吗？

english: I notice you have a dwarf in the tower here. I was wondering why he is locked in there?
translation: 我注意到你的塔里有个矮人。我想知道他为什么被锁在里面？

english: You are a nosy young person! Well, if you must know, he's in there because I have caught him for someone.
translation: 你真是个爱管闲事的年轻人！好吧，如果你非要知道，他在里面是因为我替别人抓到了他。

english: Oh, who's that then?
translation: 哦，那是谁？

english: I am not at liberty to say. In any case, this dwarf was caught spying and snooping and that sort of thing is not taken lightly.
translation: 我无可奉告。无论如何，这个矮人是因为刺探和窥探被抓到的，这种事可不能轻饶。

english: But he seems like a very nice person to me. A bit odd perhaps, but couldn't you let him go?
translation: 但在我看来他是个很好的人。也许有点古怪，但你不能放了他吗？

english: No, I don't think so. I will be nicely rewarded for catching him.
translation: 不，我不这么认为。抓到他我会得到丰厚的报酬。

english: Oh go on. Please?
translation: 哦，拜托了。求你了？

english: Hmm, well as you asked nicely. Ok then.
translation: 嗯，既然你好好请求了。那好吧。

english: No! Now please leave. You're annoying me!
translation: 不行！现在请离开。你烦到我了！

english: Hello? Rupert?
translation: 喂？鲁伯特？

english: Eh? What? Oh! You don't have to use that anymore, old spoon! Climb up to speak to me!
translation: 嗯？什么？哦！你不用再用那个了，老勺子！爬上来跟我说话！

english: Climb up how?
translation: 怎么爬上去？

english: Up my beard of course! It was your idea after all, old spinach.
translation: 当然是顺着我的胡子爬上来！这主意还是你出的呢，老菠菜。

english: Aha! You made it. Well done, old sausage!
translation: 啊哈！你上来了。干得好，老香肠！

english: Yes, it was quite a climb, but you have a very strong beard.
translation: 是啊，爬得可真够呛，不过你的胡子真结实。

english: Indeed I do. Indeed I do.
translation: 确实如此。确实如此。

english: So, what can I help you with?
translation: 那么，我能帮你什么忙？

english: Ah! Straight to the point, eh, what? Good show old carrot, good show. Now let me explain.
translation: 啊！开门见山，是吧？好样的，老胡萝卜，好样的。现在让我来解释一下。

english: I'm in a bit of a fix right now. You see, the princess down there has this horrible relative who happens to be a witch.
translation: 我现在有点麻烦。你看，下面那位公主有个可怕的亲戚，恰好是个女巫。

english: A witch? Let me guess, would this witch be her evil stepmother?
translation: 女巫？让我猜猜，这个女巫该不会是她的邪恶继母吧？

english: Stepmother? Ho! Good lord, no. No king in his right mind would marry a hag like that! No, this is her evil second-cousin, twice-removed.
translation: 继母？嚯！老天爷，当然不是。哪个神志正常的国王会娶那种丑老太婆！不，这是她的远房表姐，隔了两层亲的。

english: I see. Go on.
translation: 我明白了。继续说。

english: Right, well a young gnome friend of mine by the name of Winkin recently disappeared whilst delivering ogleroots to the market in Draynor.
translation: 好，我有个叫温金的地精朋友，最近在运送眼球根到德雷诺市场的路上失踪了。

english: Really? What happened to him?
translation: 真的吗？他出什么事了？

english: I don't know exactly, but someone told me he was last seen talking to a witch before he disappeared.
translation: 我也不太清楚，但有人告诉我，他失踪前最后一次被人看见是在和一个女巫说话。

english: Ok, so how can I help?
translation: 好吧，那我能帮上什么忙？

english: My investigations brought me to our friend the princess down there, old pinata. She's related to this witch, as I mentioned. I was...you know...showing a bit of interest in her to get her to give me information.
translation: 我的调查把我带到了我们那位公主朋友那里，老皮纳塔。就像我说的，她和这个女巫是亲戚。我……你知道……对她表现出一点兴趣，好让她给我提供信息。

english: She invited me back to her 'tower', saying she would tell me all I wanted to know, and then as I walked in the door she slammed it shut behind me.
translation: 她邀请我去她的‘塔’，说会告诉我所有我想知道的事，结果我一进门，她就把门在我身后砰地关上了。

english: Goodness me! How rude!
translation: 天哪！真粗鲁！

english: Yes, indeed! Rude indeed! Then, as I was hammering on the door I heard a hissing sound and smelt something strange. The next thing I remember is waking up to find my armour gone!
translation: 是啊，没错！确实粗鲁！然后，我正在砸门的时候，听到一阵嘶嘶声，闻到一股怪味。接下来我记得的事就是醒来发现我的盔甲不见了！

english: That wench must have taken it!
translation: 一定是那个臭丫头拿走了！

english: Ok, let me go and talk to her for you, then.
translation: 好吧，那让我去跟她谈谈。

english: Excellent! Good show, old spice! Off you go then.
translation: 太好了！好样的，老香料！那你去吧。

english: Ahh, you're back. Have you spoken to the princess yet, old mushroom?
translation: 啊，你回来了。你跟公主谈过了吗，老蘑菇？

english: Oh, no I haven't had a chance yet. I'll be back when I have.
translation: 哦，还没，我还没找到机会。等我谈完了再回来。

english: Right you are then, old chestnut.
translation: 那好吧，老栗子。

english: Pardon me, your ladyship.
translation: 打扰一下，小姐。

english: Ah! What nice manners. It's so hard to find decently mannered young people these days. My name is Princess Miazrqa.
translation: 啊！多有礼貌。现在很难找到这么有教养的年轻人了。我叫米娅尔卡公主。

english: Pleased to meet you, Princess Miarz... er... Mizaz... Miquipzi... Marzipan?
translation: 很高兴见到你，米娅尔……呃……米扎兹……米奎普齐……杏仁糖公主？

english: Miazrqa. With a silent Q.
translation: 米娅尔卡。Q不发音。

english: That's an unusual name. Where is it from?
translation: 真是个不寻常的名字。从哪来的？

english: My birth certificate. Now. howcan I be of help?
translation: 我的出生证书上写的。那么，我能帮你什么忙？

english: I see there is an embarrassed-looking dwarf in the tower there.
translation: 我看到塔里有个看起来很尴尬的矮人。

english: Yes, that's right. I'm waiting for him to be collected by someone.
translation: 是的，没错。我在等有人来接他。

english: Your first-cousin, once removed?
translation: 你的远房表姐？

english: No. You shouldn't guess answers like that. It's not very becoming. She is my second-cousin, twice removed and she is also a very powerful witch who could turn you into something nasty!
translation: 不。你不该那样瞎猜。这很不体面。她是我的远房表姐，隔了两层亲，而且她是一个非常强大的女巫，能把你变成什么恶心的东西！

english: Gosh! Sorry, please continue.
translation: 天哪！抱歉，请继续。

english: Now as I was saying, my second-cousin, twice-removed is coming to collect the dwarf. She will find out why he's been snooping around. She has most...persuasive methods.
translation: 就像我刚才说的，我的远房表姐要来带走这个矮人。她会查清楚他为什么在这里鬼鬼祟祟的。她有的是……说服人的手段。

english: Yes, that's actually why I came to speak with you. I was wondering if you couldn't let Rupert go? He's a nice fellow and I can't think he'd have done anything wrong.
translation: 是的，我正是为此而来。我想知道你能不能放了鲁伯特？他是个好人，我不觉得他会做什么坏事。

english: Ha! That won't matter to my cousin. She values her privacy above all else, you see.
translation: 哈！那对我表姐来说可不管用。她把隐私看得比什么都重要，你知道的。

english: Surely there must be something that will change your mind? Is there anything you want?
translation: 肯定有什么能让你改变主意吧？你有什么想要的吗？

english: Hmmm...well I suppose there is something you can do for me that might make me change my mind.
translation: 嗯……我想有件事你也许能为我做，或许能让我改变主意。

english: Ok, what's that?
translation: 好，什么事？

english: I was at my second-cousin's house just the other day when I suddenly dropped a very valuable pendant that I was wearing. The chain must have broken, you see.
translation: 就在前几天，我在我远房表亲家，突然掉了一个我戴着的非常珍贵的吊坠。肯定是链子断了，你明白的。

english: Ok, go on.
translation: 好，继续说。

english: Well, no sooner had it touched the ground when all of a sudden a mouse ran out from a hole in the wall. It took my pendant in its teeth and disappeared back inside its hole.
translation: 它刚一落地，突然一只老鼠从墙上的洞里跑了出来。它叼起我的吊坠，又钻回洞里去了。

english: As I'm sure you will believe, I was most upset as the pendant was a gift from my mother. I simply must get it back somehow.
translation: 我相信你也能理解，我非常难过，因为那条吊坠是我母亲送给我的礼物。我必须想办法把它拿回来。

english: So you would like me to find it for you?
translation: 所以你想让我帮你找到它？

english: Oh, yes please! It means so much to me. If you are able to find the pendant for me, I will let your dwarf friend go.
translation: 哦，是的，拜托了！它对我意义重大。如果你能帮我找到吊坠，我就放了你的矮人朋友。

english: Very well. I will find it for you.
translation: 很好。我会帮你找到它的。

english: Where is your second-cousin's house?
translation: 你表姐的房子在哪？

english: It's not far to the west of here, in Taverley village. It has a beautiful long garden - you can't miss it!
translation: 就在西边不远，塔韦利村里。有一个漂亮的长花园——你不会错过的！

english: Hey! I do know that house! I rescued some little kid's ball from there!
translation: 嘿！我知道那房子！我之前帮一个小孩从那里拿回过球！

english: That was you? Oh, my cousin was absolutely furious when she found out about that! She went on about it for ages and even made her hair turn a quite ghastly green colour!
translation: 是你干的？哦，我表姐发现后气疯了！她念叨了好久，甚至把她的头发都弄成了相当可怕的绿色！

english: Well I suggest you be extra careful when you look for my pendant then.
translation: 那我建议你找吊坠的时候格外小心。

english: What does your pendant look like?
translation: 你的吊坠长什么样？

english: It's a lovely gold pendant.
translation: 是一条可爱的金吊坠。

english: Is it particularly valuable?
translation: 它特别值钱吗？

english: Only to me really. It's not worth much and isn't magical, but it has a lot of sentimental value. It was my mother's pendant. She gave it to me on my tenth birthday.
translation: 只是对我来说很珍贵。它不值什么钱，也没有魔法，但很有纪念意义。那是我母亲的吊坠。她在我十岁生日时送给我的。

english: Where are you the princess of exactly?
translation: 你到底是哪里的公主？

english: I am the daughter of a great and powerful king. In a land far, far away.
translation: 我是一位伟大而强大的国王的女儿。在一个非常非常遥远的地方。

english: How far, exactly?
translation: 具体有多远？

english: Far, far.
translation: 非常非常远。

english: Oh. What's the place called?
translation: 哦。那地方叫什么？

english: Asgarnia.
translation: 阿斯加尼亚。

english: Asgarnia? Aren't we in Asgarnia?
translation: 阿斯加尼亚？我们现在不就在阿斯加尼亚吗？

english: Well...yes. I suppose, but that doesn't mean it's not far, far away from somewhere else.
translation: 嗯……是的，我想是的，但这不代表它不能离别的地方很远很远。

english: Uh...I see.
translation: 呃……我明白了。

english: I am the great niece of King Vallance himself.
translation: 我本人就是瓦兰斯国王的侄孙女。

english: How impressive!
translation: 真了不起！

english: Yes, it is, isn't it? Now was there anything else?
translation: 是啊，不是吗？现在还有别的事吗？

english: I need a key for the house.
translation: 我需要房子的钥匙。

english: Of course. You may have one of my spare keys.
translation: 当然。你可以拿我的一把备用钥匙。

english: Don't be silly. You have one already in your bag. Goodness me, how ever will you find my pendant with a memory like that?
translation: 别傻了。你包里已经有一把了。天哪，就这记性，你怎么能找到我的吊坠？

english: Ah, yes. Sorry.
translation: 啊，是的。抱歉。

english: Very well. Good luck with finding my pendant.
translation: 好吧。祝你找到我的吊坠。

english: Your second-cousin, once removed?
translation: 你的远房表姐？

english: Your first-cousin, twice removed?
translation: 你的远房表姐？

english: Your second-cousin, twice removed?
translation: 你的远房表姐？

english: Why, yes! That was a very clever guess indeed! She's actually a very powerful witch. Now allow me to reward you in some way as I am feeling generous.
translation: 哎呀，没错！猜得真准！她其实是个非常强大的女巫。现在我心情不错，就给你点奖励吧。

english: As I said, my cousin is a witch but she is also a lover of music. She has a lovely gramophone and she keeps a piano in her basement - why? I have no idea - but you may find it interesting to examine.
translation: 就像我说的，我表姐是个女巫，但她也很喜欢音乐。她有一台可爱的留声机，还在她地下室里放了一架钢琴——为什么？我不知道——但你可能会觉得检查一下很有趣。

english: What's so special about it? I've seen pianos all over the place.
translation: 那钢琴有什么特别的？我在好多地方都见过钢琴。

english: I don't really know. I know my cousin goes on about that piano a lot, but I've played on it many times and I can't figure out why she likes it so much.
translation: 我也不太清楚。我知道我表姐经常念叨那架钢琴，但我弹过很多次，就是不明白她为什么那么喜欢它。

english: I see. Thank you for that...er...useful knowledge.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的……呃……有用信息。

english: Please can you repeat that last bit? A flock of noisy birds flew overhead there and I couldn't hear you.
translation: 拜托你能重复一下最后那部分吗？有一群吵闹的鸟从头顶飞过，我没听清你的话。

english: I see. How ghastly. Let me continue.
translation: 我明白了。真烦人。让我继续说。

english: I just have another question before I look for your pendant.
translation: 在我去找你的吊坠之前，我还有个问题。

english: If you must, but you are wasting time.
translation: 如果你非问不可的话，但你在浪费时间。

english: Hi Rupert.
translation: 嗨，鲁伯特。

english: Ah! Welcome back, old curtains! How did it go with the old princess down there? Did she agree to let me out?
translation: 啊！欢迎回来，老窗帘！跟下面那位公主谈得怎么样？她同意放我出去了吗？

english: Sort of. She's asked me to do something for her first.
translation: 差不多吧。她让我先帮她做件事。

english: Oh, right. What was it then, old parrot?
translation: 哦，这样啊。什么事，老鹦鹉？

english: I have to find a gold pendant of hers that she lost in that witch's house in Taverley.
translation: 我必须找到她丢失的一个金色吊坠，就在塔韦利村那个女巫的房子里。

english: By all the gods! You have to go in there? You must be careful, [player name]. She's a wily one that witch, from what I've heard. No doubt there's all sorts of weird magics over there!
translation: 众神在上！你得进那里面去？你一定要小心，[player name]。据我所知，那个女巫很狡猾。毫无疑问，那里到处都是各种奇怪的魔法！

english: Don't worry. I'll be careful. I've been in there once before, so I know what's there.
translation: 别担心。我会小心的。我以前进去过一次，所以知道里面有什么。

english: You've been in there? Goodness me! What did you see? Did you see a gnome in there anywhere?
translation: 你进去过？天哪！你看到了什么？你在里面看到地精了吗？

english: I don't think so. I'm sure I would have remembered. I was looking for a ball for a boy who had lost it in the witch's garden.
translation: 我想没有。我肯定我会记得的。我当时是在帮一个男孩找掉在女巫花园里的球。

english: Hmm, he was probably lucky that was all he lost with all that weird magic going on, eh?
translation: 嗯，在那么多奇怪魔法环绕下，他只丢了球，算是走运了，是吧？

english: Yes, quite. I'll see what I can find out though.
translation: 是啊，没错。不过我会看看能发现什么。

english: Ah! Good show, old kebab! I'll wait here for you. But don't be long. Who knows what that princess will do to me next!
translation: 啊！干得好，老烤肉！我在这儿等你。但别太久。谁知道那位公主接下来会对我做什么！

english: Nnnngh!
translation: 唔唔唔！

english: Ah! [player name], old pantaloons! Good to see you, good to see you. What news?
translation: 啊！[player name]，老宽松裤！见到你真好，真好。有什么消息吗？

english: Princess Miazrqa has agreed to free you.
translation: 米娅尔卡公主同意释放你了。

english: Princess Marzipan, eh? What a mouthful.
translation: 杏仁糖公主，嗯？这名字真拗口。

english: Miazrqa. It's a silent Q.
translation: 是米娅尔卡。Q不发音。

english: Ah, I see. Good show. Say, did you find out anything about my missing friend?
translation: 啊，我明白了。干得好。对了，你找到我失踪朋友的消息了吗？

english: I did, I think. But it's not good news. The witch has your friend locked up in a cage, down under the house itself.
translation: 我想我找到了。但不是什么好消息。女巫把你的朋友关在房子下面的笼子里。

english: Good gods! That's awful! I won't have all this kidnapping nonsense! And to think we're supposed to be a civilised land!
translation: 天哪！太可怕了！我绝不容忍这种绑架的胡闹！想想看，我们本该是个文明之地！

english: What will you do?
translation: 你打算怎么办？

english: I'll think of something. In the meantime, you still need to get me out of here. Maybe you should see if Miazrqa is ready to let me out.
translation: 我会想办法的。与此同时，你还需要把我弄出去。也许你该去看看米娅尔卡是否准备好放我走了。

english: Right. I'm on it!
translation: 好的，我马上去办！

english: I found your pendant, Princess Miazrqa!
translation: 我找到你的吊坠了，米娅尔卡公主！

english: Oh, how wonderful! I'm so grateful.
translation: 哦，太棒了！我感激不尽。

english: Umm, your second-cousin has some very strange...creatures she keeps.
translation: 嗯，你的远房表妹养了一些非常奇怪的……生物。

english: Oh yes. Those are her little darlings. I shudder to think what she might do if something were to happen to any of them.
translation: 哦，是的。那些是她的宝贝。我不敢想象如果它们中任何一个出了什么事，她会怎么做。

english: Uh... Really?
translation: 呃……真的吗？

english: Oh yes. Why, only last month one of them got out for a wander and some horrid farmer attacked it with his ear!
translation: 哦，是的。就在上个月，其中一只跑出去闲逛，一个可恶的农夫用他的耳朵攻击了它！

english: With his ear?
translation: 用他的耳朵？

english: Indeed! Tried to choke the poor thing with it. Anyway, my cousin went into a frightful rage and turned that wretched farmer into one of his own chickens. We had a lovely roast meal that day. Happy memories...
translation: 没错！想用耳朵勒死那可怜的小东西。总之，我表妹勃然大怒，把那个可恶的农夫变成了他自己的鸡。那天我们吃了一顿美味的烤鸡。快乐的回忆……

english: I think I feel a little ill...
translation: 我觉得有点不舒服……

english: Oh dear, I hope you're not coming down with something.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，希望你不是染上什么病了。

english: Now, can I have the pendant please?
translation: 现在，能把吊坠给我了吗？

english: Will you agree to let Rupert go free?
translation: 你同意释放鲁伯特吗？

english: Of course. The pendant means more to me than anything.
translation: 当然。这个吊坠对我来说比什么都重要。

english: By Saradomin! My armour was on the stairs up there!
translation: 以萨拉多明之名！我的盔甲还在那边的上楼梯上！

english: That's better!
translation: 这样好多了！

english: FREEDOM!
translation: 自由了！

english: Aha! Sweet freedom! It's good to be alive, old sweet shop! Thank you for freeing me, [player name].
translation: 啊哈！甜蜜的自由！活着真好，老糖果店！谢谢你救了我，[player name]。

english: Thank you, [player name]. You've done a great service for me and all the dwarves and gnomes.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。你为我和所有矮人及地精立了大功。

english: I'm just happy I could help...hey! What happened to your long beard? Where did it go?
translation: 我很高兴能帮上忙……嘿！你的长胡子怎么了？去哪儿了？

english: Hah! Don't fret, old penny whistle! It's still here. The front of my armour was specially crafted to allow my beard to fold up inside. Do you see?
translation: 哈！别担心，老口哨！它还在这儿。我的盔甲前面是特制的，可以让我的胡子折叠在里面。看到了吗？

english: Oh yes! I can see it now. That's pretty clever!
translation: 哦，是的！我现在看到了。真聪明！

english: Indeed it is, old cheese! Now allow me to reward you in some way. All I have is my armour, but you are welcome to take any piece of it that you wish.
translation: 确实如此，老乳酪！现在让我以某种方式奖励你。我只有我的盔甲，但你可以随意拿走你想要的任何一件。

english: Please could I have the helmet?
translation: 请问我能要头盔吗？

english: Of course, of course. Here you go, old pumpkin.
translation: 当然，当然。给你，老南瓜。

english: So what will you be doing now, Rupert?
translation: 那你现在打算做什么，鲁伯特？

english: Thanks to you I can carry on my investigations. Good show, old brussels sprout!
translation: 多亏了你，我可以继续我的调查了。干得好，老抱子甘蓝！

english: I'm glad I could help.
translation: 很高兴我能帮上忙。

english: Princess Miazrqa, I found out what your cousin is up to.
translation: 米娅尔卡公主，我发现你表妹在做什么了。

english: Really? You know, I have always wondered. She's ever so secretive and never tells me anything. I was hoping she might tell me when I saw her next.
translation: 真的吗？你知道吗，我一直很好奇。她总是神神秘秘的，什么都不告诉我。我本来希望下次见到她时她会告诉我。

english: So you didn't know that she kidnaps poor defenceless gnomes?
translation: 所以你不知道她绑架可怜无助的地精？

english: What?! Never! That's absolutely awful! How could she? Oh, that's just so...so...mean!
translation: 什么？！绝不可能！这太可怕了！她怎么能这样？哦，这真是太……太……卑鄙了！

english: I thought so too.
translation: 我也这么觉得。

english: It's quite hard to believe. Do you have any proof?
translation: 真难以置信。你有证据吗？

english: Yes. There is a gnome in her basement right now!
translation: 有。现在她的地下室里就有一个地精！

english: How horrid! Well, when I see her I will tell her exactly what I think. Thank you for telling me all this, [player name].
translation: 太可恶了！好吧，等我见到她，我会把我的想法告诉她。谢谢你告诉我这一切，[player name]。

english: You know, Rupert - the dwarf here - is trying to put a stop to what is going on. I am sure he could use your help.
translation: 你知道吗，这里的矮人鲁伯特正试图阻止这一切。我相信他需要你的帮助。

english: Really? You may tell him that I will help him in any way I can.
translation: 真的吗？你可以告诉他，我会尽我所能帮助他。

english: Great! Thanks.
translation: 太好了！谢谢。

english: Rupert, I told Miazrqa about what the witch was doing and she was horrified by it.
translation: 鲁伯特，我把女巫的所作所为告诉了米娅尔卡，她吓坏了。

english: I'm not surprised, old kiwi. It's a pretty ghastly business with all this kidnapping gnomes and dwarves.
translation: 我不惊讶，老猕猴桃。绑架地精和矮人这种事确实很可怕。

english: Yes. Miazrqa has said she would like to help you with your investigations and that you can use this tower as your base of operations if you want.
translation: 是的。米娅尔卡说她想帮助你进行调查，如果你愿意，你可以用这座塔作为行动基地。

english: Really? That's just fantastic! You are certainly full of surprises, [player name]. Good show!
translation: 真的吗？太棒了！你真是充满惊喜，[player name]。干得好！

english: Well, I had better be going for now. Good luck.
translation: 好吧，我现在得走了。祝你好运。

english: And to you, my friend. And to you.
translation: 也祝你好运，我的朋友。也祝你好运。

english: I managed to get Rupert's helmet for you.
translation: 我帮你拿到了鲁伯特的头盔。

english: Excellent, [player name]! I'll take that as well. I hope all this work wasn't too difficult.
translation: 太好了，[player name]！这个我也收下。希望这一切不算太难。

english: Difficult? You have no idea! There were huge creatures trying to eat me, other creatures trying to tear me apart, witches, gnomes in distress, princesses, and I had to deal with them all!
translation: 难？你根本不知道！有巨大的生物想吃我，有其他生物想撕碎我，还有女巫、遇险的地精、公主，我全都得应付！

english: Goodness me! I'm glad I sent you instead of going myself.
translation: 天哪！还好我派你去而不是自己去。

english: Er...I mean...I knew sending you was the right thing to do. I was sure you could handle anything that came up. Now then, the beans...
translation: 呃……我是说……我知道派你去是对的。我相信你能处理好任何情况。那么，这些豆子……

english: Yes, that's what all this was about wasn't it? Some beans! They must be worth a lot for this much trouble!
translation: 是啊，这一切都是为了这个，对吧？一些豆子！它们一定很值钱，才值得费这么大劲！

english: Actually, the beans are almost worthless.
translation: 实际上，这些豆子几乎一文不值。

english: Worthless? So why did I go to all of this trouble for you? I'm not particularly happy about that.
translation: 一文不值？那我为什么为你费这么大劲？我对此不太高兴。

english: Calm down, my young, hot-headed friend. There was a good reason for getting these beans.
translation: 冷静点，我年轻气盛的朋友。拿这些豆子是有充分理由的。

english: Now that you have proven yourself worthy of being a competent and trustworthy treasure collector, I can tell the real use for the beans.
translation: 既然你已经证明自己是个称职且值得信赖的宝藏收藏家，我可以告诉你这些豆子的真正用途了。

english: As I said before, these beans are magical. There is a specially prepared mound of earth to the south-east of Taverley.
translation: 就像我之前说的，这些豆子是魔法豆。在塔韦利村东南方有一个特制的土堆。

english: Plant the beans there and then be sure to water them well. You will need to have some knowledge of farming for this.
translation: 把豆子种在那里，然后一定要浇足水。你需要有一些农业知识。

english: Ok, so then what do I do?
translation: 好的，那我接下来做什么？

english: When the beans are planted and watered, they will grow into an enormous plant of some sort. I'm not sure what exactly. At the top of this plant is our prize.
translation: 当豆子种下并浇水后，它们会长成某种大型植物。我不确定具体是什么。在这棵植物的顶端就是我们的奖品。

english: Our prize? What exactly is this prize?
translation: 我们的奖品？这个奖品到底是什么？

english: The ultimate collectible item, my dear friend. It is rumoured that in a land of clouds where none dare to tread lest they plummet to the earth, lies a goblin made of gold...
translation: 终极收藏品，我亲爱的朋友。传说在一片无人敢踏足的云层之地，否则就会坠落到地面，那里有一个金子做的哥布林……

english: A golden goblin?
translation: 一个金色哥布林？

english: Yes. Yes, indeed! A golden goblin. Legend tells of a time when goblins discovered gold in an abandoned dwarf mine and began to mine and smelt it. What for, nobody knows. Something evil, I'd wager.
translation: 是的。没错！一个金色哥布林。传说中，哥布林在一个废弃的矮人矿井里发现了金子，并开始开采和冶炼。为了什么，没人知道。我敢打赌，是邪恶的勾当。

english: The goblins produced great smelting works, overseen by a particularly smart goblin with a head for business. Gubblebak was his name. He was shrewd, cunning and he loved gold...
translation: 哥布林们建立了巨大的冶炼厂，由一个特别聪明、有商业头脑的哥布林监督。他叫古布巴克。他精明、狡猾，而且热爱金子……

english: He worked his fellow goblins day and night to produce more and more gold, until finally they could stand his hard labour no more and they mutinied.
translation: 他日夜驱使他的哥布林同胞生产越来越多的金子，直到最后他们再也无法忍受他的苦役，发动了叛变。

english: They mutinied?
translation: 他们叛变了？

english: That's right. They turned on him. No-one is sure about the exact events, but somehow Gubblebak fell into one of the smelting pots of liquid gold.
translation: 没错。它们反噬了他。没人确切知道具体发生了什么事，但古伯巴克掉进了一个熔金的锅里。

english: That's horrible! Was he killed?
translation: 太可怕了！他死了吗？

english: Well now, goblins are tough little creatures and he managed to somehow crawl out of the pot covered in hot, molten gold.
translation: 好吧，哥布林是顽强的小生物，他设法从罐里爬了出来，全身沾满了滚烫的金液。

english: He was smart indeed, but even smart people do foolish things. He threw himself into a nearby water trough.
translation: 他确实很聪明，但即使是聪明人也会做蠢事。他跳进了附近的一个水槽里。

english: But surely that's what anyone would have done? Why is that a bad thing?
translation: 但这难道不是任何人都会做的吗？为什么这是坏事？

english: Ahh, well you see...when you take hot liquid metal and cool it instantly, it becomes rock hard straight away. That's how blacksmiths make their weapons and armour.
translation: 啊，你看……当你把热的液态金属迅速冷却时，它会立刻变得像石头一样硬。铁匠就是这样制作武器和盔甲的。

english: Oh, I see. So Gubblebak became hard as a rock?
translation: 哦，我明白了。所以古布巴克变得像石头一样硬？

english: That's right. And that's the way he stayed ever afterwards. So the legend says, at least. And the cloud area will be waiting for you when you have planted the beans to find this golden goblin.
translation: 没错。从那以后他就一直那样。至少传说是这么说的。当你种下豆子后，那片云层区域就会等着你去寻找这个金色哥布林。

english: So let me see if I have this straight.
translation: 让我确认一下我理解得对不对。

english: I need to plant the beans in an earth mound south-east of here, water them, let them grow into some big plant and then climb the plant to get to a cloudy area, find a golden goblin and bring it back to you?
translation: 我需要把豆子种在东南方的土堆里，浇水，让它们长成某种大型植物，然后爬上植物到达云层区域，找到一个金色哥布林，然后带回来给你？

english: Exactly right! You've got it. Now did I mention about the giant?
translation: 完全正确！你明白了。对了，我提到过巨人吗？

english: The...giant?
translation: ……巨人？

english: Yes, that's right. The giant.
translation: 是的，没错。巨人。

english: No, I'm pretty sure you didn't mention any giants! What giant? Now would be a good time to mention it if you were going to!
translation: 不，我很确定你没提过什么巨人！什么巨人？如果你打算说的话，现在正是时候！

english: Oh right, sorry. Must have slipped my mind. There's a bit of a large-ish giant up there. Uh...shouldn't be anything to worry about. But...uh...I think he might have the goblin, you see.
translation: 哦，对，抱歉。一定是忘了。上面有个有点大的巨人。呃……应该没什么好担心的。但是……呃……我想他可能拿着那个哥布林，你看。

english: So how exactly do I get the goblin then?
translation: 那我到底怎么拿到哥布林？

english: Well, you're probably going to have to kill him for it. But...but a big strong adventurer like yourself shouldn't have any trouble whatsoever with that, I'm sure!
translation: 嗯，你可能得杀了他才能拿到。但是……但是像你这样强壮勇敢的冒险者，应该完全没问题，我敢肯定！

english: Here are the beans as promised.
translation: 这是答应给你的豆子。

english: Ok then, to recap. I need to plant the beans over there, water them, let them grow into some big plant, climb the plant to get to a cloudy area, kill a giant, find a golden goblin and bring it back to you?
translation: 好吧，总结一下。我需要把豆子种在那里，浇水，让它们长成某种大型植物，爬上植物到达云层区域，杀死一个巨人，找到一个金色哥布林，然后带回来给你？

english: Oh, well done! You do pay attention! Good luck!
translation: 哦，干得好！你确实很用心！祝你好运！

english: Thanks...I think I'm going to need it.
translation: 谢谢……我想我会需要的。

english: So then. Do you want to run through what you need to do for me again?
translation: 那么，你想再回顾一下你需要为我做什么吗？

english: Ok then, to recap: I need to plant the beans, water them, let them grow into some big plant, climb the plant to get to a cloudy area, kill a giant, find a golden goblin and bring it back to you?
translation: 好吧，总结一下：我需要把豆子种下，浇水，让它们长成某种大型植物，爬上植物到达云层区域，杀死一个巨人，找到一个金色哥布林，然后带回来给你？

english: I've grown the beans into a huge stalk, as you asked. What am I supposed to do now?
translation: 我已经按你的要求把豆子种成了一根巨大的豆茎。我现在该做什么？

english: Hmm, have you climbed up the stalk yet?
translation: 嗯，你爬上豆茎了吗？

english: Very well. Did you find the giant?
translation: 很好。你找到那个巨人了？

english: Right then. Did you defeat him and find the golden goblin?
translation: 那么。你打败他并找到金色哥布林了吗？

english: Excellent! Well done. Now bring me the golden goblin and we're almost done.
translation: 太好了！干得好。现在把金色哥布林带给我，我们就快完成了。

english: Umm...what happens if I forget to pick up the golden goblin after defeating the giant and leave?
translation: 嗯……如果我打败巨人后忘了捡起金色哥布林就离开了，会怎么样？

english: Well, I expect it will still be waiting up there for you when you go back up. It's highly unlikely anyone would risk going up there to steal it.
translation: 嗯，我想等你再上去的时候，它还在那里等着你。不太可能有人会冒险上去偷它。

english: Right then, that's your next task. You will need to defeat that giant to get the golden goblin from him.
translation: 那么，这就是你的下一个任务。你需要打败那个巨人，从他那里拿到金色哥布林。

english: He wasn't there? This is highly irregular. Are you sure you looked properly? I expect he'd be hard to miss.
translation: 他不在那里？这太反常了。你确定你仔细找了吗？我想他应该很难被忽略才对。

english: I'll go and have another look.
translation: 我再去看看。

english: Right, then you will need to climb the stalk and find the golden goblin for me.
translation: 好，那么你需要爬上豆茎，为我找到金色哥布林。

english: Where can I find it?
translation: 我在哪里能找到它？

english: I think a big giant has it at the top of the stalk. You will need to get it from him.
translation: 我想是一个大巨人在豆茎顶端拿着它。你需要从他那里拿到。

english: Right. I'm on my way.
translation: 好。我这就去。

english: Sylas! I found the golden goblin!
translation: 赛拉斯！我找到金色哥布林了！

english: Excellent work, Player! Now, that giant will likely have friends. It is too dangerous to leave that stalk up there like that.
translation: 干得好，玩家！现在，那个巨人很可能有同伴。让那根豆茎那样留在那里太危险了。

english: Ok, so what should we do?
translation: 好，那我们该怎么办？

english: First, let me take that goblin from you. Next we need to cut down that beanstalk as soon as possible. I hope you're a good woodcutter!
translation: 首先，让我从你那里拿走那个哥布林。接下来我们需要尽快砍倒那根豆茎。我希望你是个好樵夫！

english: Find an axe. Any axe should do. Then cut down that stalk as soon as you can before another giant finds out what you have done and comes for us!
translation: 找一把斧头。任何斧头都行。然后尽快砍倒那根豆茎，免得另一个巨人发现你做了什么，来找我们算账！

english: Can you remind me what I am doing now?
translation: 你能提醒我现在该做什么吗？

english: You've forgotten already? Did you get hit on the head by that giant? Do you have amnesia?
translation: 你已经忘了？你是不是被那个巨人打到了头？你失忆了吗？

english: No, I just can't remember what I am supposed to do.
translation: 不，我只是不记得我该做什么了。

english: Cool!
translation: 酷！

english: Timber!
translation: 木材！

english: Have you cut down the stalk?
translation: 你砍倒豆茎了吗？

english: Yes, it's done.
translation: 是的，搞定了。

english: Good work, [player name]! At last we can relax. We've completed our task and you have done me a great service!
translation: 干得好，[player name]！我们终于可以放松了。我们完成了任务，你帮了我一个大忙！

english: Now, let me reward you. You may have wondered what possible use I could have had for Rupert's helmet.
translation: 现在，让我奖励你。你可能一直想知道我要鲁伯特的头盔有什么用。

english: It did indeed seem like an odd item to look for.
translation: 那确实看起来是个奇怪的物品。

english: Ah, yes! However, tucked inside the helmet is a tiny bottle with a very special potion. It was made by a witch, here in Taverley, but Rupert must have found it.
translation: 啊，是的！不过，头盔里面藏着一个很小的瓶子，里面装着一种非常特别的药水。它是塔韦利村的一个女巫制作的，但鲁伯特一定是找到了它。

english: Not knowing what the potion was, he simply tucked it away in his helmet.
translation: 他不知道那是什么药水，就随手把它塞进了头盔里。

english: Not more potions?! I've had enough of potions for now.
translation: 不是又是什么药水吧？！我现在受够药水了。

english: Relax, my friend. This potion is almost harmless. It is actually a particularly strong hair-tonic.
translation: 放松点，我的朋友。这瓶药水几乎无害。它实际上是一种特别强效的生发剂。

english: Oh! Well, that would explain Rupert's beard then.
translation: 哦！嗯，那就能解释鲁伯特的胡子了。

english: Yes, indeed! I also imagine poor Rupert never understood why his beard grew so alarmingly fast. Poor lad.
translation: 是的，确实如此！我还想象可怜的鲁伯特从未明白为什么他的胡子长得那么快。可怜的小伙子。

english: Anyway, I have removed the potion now and you may keep the helmet along with your rewards. Don't worry, it's quite harmless and the helmet should help you in your adventures.
translation: 总之，我现在已经把药水取出来了，你可以保留头盔和你的奖励。别担心，它完全无害，而且头盔应该能在你的冒险中帮到你。

english: Great work, [player name]. Now, I have something for you, but you're going to need a space in your inventory. Speak to me again when you have made some room.
translation: 干得好，[player name]。现在，我有东西要给你，但你的背包里需要腾出一个空位。等你腾出空间后再跟我说话。

english: Excellent work, [player name]! Now, that giant will likely have friends. It is too dangerous to leave that stalk up there like that.
translation: 干得好，[player name]！现在，那个巨人很可能还有同伙。让那根茎秆就这么留在那里太危险了。

english: Can't talk! Things to collect, magic beans to plant!
translation: 没空聊！要收集东西，还要种魔法豆！

english: Oh, well done! You do pay attention well! Good luck!
translation: 哦，干得漂亮！你真的很用心！祝你好运！

english: Hello again! I still have these beans for you.
translation: 又见面了！这些豆子我还是留给你的。

english: Well now, that is indeed extremely interesting! I remember finding something just like that a little while back. Perhaps it's still in my collection? Let me see...
translation: 哎呀，这可真是太有趣了！我记得不久前也发现过类似的东西。也许还在我的收藏里？让我看看……

english: Goodness me! I hope this isn't all proving too difficult for you.
translation: 天哪！希望这些对你来说不会太难。

english: These beans are still for sale if you want them.
translation: 这些豆子还在卖，如果你想要的话。

english: Excellent! You're halfway done, [player name]. Let me take that from you. Now I still need Grimgnash's feather, of course.
translation: 太棒了！你已经完成一半了，[player name]。让我收下这个。当然，我现在还需要格里姆纳什的羽毛。

english: Well? Are you going to find me these items to trade for the magic beans?
translation: 怎么样？你打算帮我找到这些东西来换魔法豆吗？

english: Ah! Come back for the beans, eh? Couldn't resist the magic, I expect. They're still available.
translation: 啊！回来拿豆子了，嗯？我猜是抵挡不住魔法的诱惑吧。它们还在。

english: Not a problem! I always keep a few spare for such an emergency as this!
translation: 没问题！我总会多备一些，以防这种紧急情况！

english: Oh, hang on a second! I know where you may have left them. If they're not in your bag, perhaps they're in your bank?
translation: 哦，等一下！我知道你可能把它们落在哪里了。如果不在你的包里，也许在你的银行里？

english: State thy allegiance stranger.
translation: 说出你的效忠对象，陌生人。

english: I follow the path of Saradomin. Strength through wisdom.
translation: 我追随萨拉多明的道路。力量源于智慧。

english: Ah, a wise choice my friend. But if you truly follow Saradomin, what brings you to these evil lands?
translation: 啊，明智的选择，我的朋友。但如果你真的追随萨拉多明，是什么让你来到这片邪恶之地？

english: I come seeking challenges and quests.
translation: 我来寻找挑战和任务。

english: A noble cause indeed. One that I can sympathise with, for I myself am upon a quest.  One that will allow Saradomin to be glorified even in these dark lands.
translation: 确实是一个崇高的目标。我能理解，因为我自己也在进行一项任务。一项能让萨拉多明即使在这片黑暗之地也能得到荣耀的任务。

english: What quest is that then?
translation: 那是什么任务？

english: Well, below the very ground you stand upon lies an intricate network of tunnels that make up the abandoned Mort Ridge mines. These mines used to be a valuable resource to the inhabitants of Morytania.
translation: 嗯，在你脚下的地面之下，有一张由错综复杂的隧道构成的网络，那便是废弃的莫特岭矿场。这些矿场曾是莫利塔尼亚居民的宝贵资源。

english: As with many things, this changed when Misthalin was finally able to push the minions of Morytania back, and Saradomin himself blessed the river Salve.
translation: 和许多事物一样，当米尔萨林最终将莫利塔尼亚的爪牙击退，萨拉多明亲自祝福了萨鲁夫河时，这一切都改变了。

english: The mines are also the site where the legendary artefact, the salve amulet, was thought to have been carved from the crystals that grow in the lower levels of the mine.
translation: 矿场也是传说中的神器——萨鲁夫护符——被认为是用矿场下层生长的水晶雕刻而成的地方。

english: These crystals are thought to be formed by the blessed water of the river Salve as it percolates through the rocks to the lower levels of the mine.
translation: 这些水晶被认为是萨鲁夫河的圣水渗过岩石到达矿场下层时形成的。

english: It is not known what happened to the salve amulet, but it is generally believed that by encapsulating within it some of the goodness of Saradomin himself, it afforded the bearer power over evil.
translation: 萨鲁夫护符后来如何不得而知，但普遍认为，通过将萨拉多明自身的一些善意封装其中，它赋予了佩戴者对抗邪恶的力量。

english: Saradomin has entrusted me alone with the task of regaining access to the mines, whatever the dangers.
translation: 萨拉多明单独委托我重新进入矿场的任务，无论有何危险。

english: How can an abandoned mine be dangerous?
translation: 一座废弃的矿场能有什么危险？

english: Because the mines are said to be haunted. The crystals and the ridge used to be protected by Zamorak's mage, Treus Dayth.
translation: 因为据说矿场闹鬼。那些水晶和山脊曾由萨莫拉克的法师特鲁斯.戴斯守护。

english: Dayth failed and fell during an incursion by Saradominists, who then made it into the mines and were able to remove a shard of crystal.
translation: 戴斯在萨拉多明信徒的一次入侵中失败并倒下，入侵者随后进入矿场并取走了一块水晶碎片。

english: Zamorak, furious at his mage, condemned Dayth's soul indefinitely to an existence of turmoil in the mines. Dayth's soul is bound to prevent the crystals from ever being reached again.
translation: 萨莫拉克震怒于他的法师，将戴斯的灵魂无限期地判罚在矿场中永无宁日。戴斯的灵魂被束缚，以防止水晶再次被触及。

english: Further, Zamorak's then ruler upon the land ordered the slaughter of anyone within the mines and that the mines be sealed.
translation: 此外，萨莫拉克当时的土地统治者下令屠杀矿场内的所有人，并封死矿场。

english: I must be going now, good luck on your quest.
translation: 我现在得走了，祝你任务好运。

english: You should believe not in luck, but in the protection of Saradomin. Farewell.
translation: 你不该相信运气，而应相信萨拉多明的庇护。再见。

english: I hope it goes well.Goodbye.
translation: 希望你顺利。再见。

english: Goodbye, and may Saradomin give you strength through wisdom.
translation: 再见，愿萨拉多明赐予你智慧中的力量。

english: Ok I lied, I don't support Saradomin. I'm only here for dastardly evil purposes.
translation: 好吧我撒谎了，我不支持萨拉多明。我来这里只是为了卑劣邪恶的目的。

english: Then leave me, I have no time to listen to your poisonous tongue.
translation: 那就离开我，我没时间听你毒舌。

english: I could ask the same of you.
translation: 我也想问你同样的问题。

english: Saradomin has granted you wisdom. The evil creatures of this land are cunning and you are right to question anyone's purpose here.
translation: 萨拉多明赐予了你智慧。这片土地上的邪恶生物狡猾无比，你质疑任何人的目的都是对的。

english: I am upon a quest. One that will allow Saradomin to be glorified even in these dark lands.
translation: 我正在执行一项任务。一项能让萨拉多明即使在这片黑暗之地也能得到荣耀的任务。

english: I serve only Zamorak. Strength through chaos.
translation: 我只侍奉萨莫拉克。力量源于混乱。

english: Then begone.  Normally I would strike you down in an instant, but for now I have no time. I am on a quest of the utmost importance.
translation: 那就滚吧。换作平时我会立刻将你击倒，但现在我没时间。我正在进行一项至关重要的任务。

english: What is this quest of which you speak?
translation: 你说的任务是什么？

english: It is no concern of yours, but rest assured it will help in crushing you and those others who serve your vile master.
translation: 与你无关，但放心，这将有助于粉碎你和那些侍奉你邪恶主人的人。

english: I would expect nothing less of you, misguided as you already are.
translation: 我对你的期望也无非如此，你早已误入歧途。

english: Fine, I didn't want to talk to you either.
translation: 好吧，我本来也不想跟你说话。

english: Fear not fiend, even though I may leave you be, you shall not escape justice at the hands of the righteous.
translation: 别怕，恶魔，即使我现在放过你，你也逃不过正义之手的制裁。

english: My beliefs are in accord with the teachings of Guthix. Balance is power.
translation: 我的信仰与古斯的教义一致。平衡即力量。

english: A wishy washy set of beliefs. You should follow Saradomin and find a real purpose in your life.
translation: 一组模棱两可的信仰。你应该追随萨拉多明，找到生活的真正目标。

english: And what sort of purpose would that be?
translation: 那是什么样的目标？

english: To further the glory of Saradomin of course.
translation: 当然是增进萨拉多明的荣耀。

english: Take myself, I am upon a quest that will allow Saradomin to be glorified even in these dark lands.
translation: 就拿我自己来说，我正在执行一项任务，能让萨拉多明即使在这片黑暗之地也能得到荣耀。

english: I can make my own choices, who are you to dispute them?
translation: 我能自己做选择，你凭什么质疑？

english: I look only to help those who are misguided.
translation: 我只是想帮助那些误入歧途的人。

english: I have no particular allegiance.
translation: 我没有特别的效忠对象。

english: Then your life is without reason or direction. I would talk to you further on the matter, but for now my attentions must be elsewhere.
translation: 那你的生活就没有理由也没有方向了。我本想跟你多谈谈，但现在我必须去做别的事了。

english: Then I shall leave you to your business.
translation: 那我就不打扰你了。

english: I shall pray that Saradomin grants you the wisdom to see through your folly.
translation: 我会祈祷萨拉多明赐予你智慧，让你看清自己的愚行。

english: Why, what are you doing?
translation: 为什么，你在做什么？

english: Hello again. I'm afraid I'm rather preoccupied. What was it you wanted?
translation: 又见面了。恐怕我现在很忙。你想要什么？

english: Can you explain the history of these mines again?
translation: 你能再解释一下这些矿场的历史吗？

english: Is there any other way into the mines?
translation: 还有别的路能进矿场吗？

english: Indeed I have found hope that this may be so. By making discreet inquiries I have been led to believe that a second entrance may exist into the mines.
translation: 确实，我看到了希望。通过谨慎的打听，我得知矿场可能还有第二个入口。

english: Further, I have come into possession of a key that will apparently afford entrance to the lower levels of the mines once inside.
translation: 而且，我得到了一把钥匙，一旦进入矿场，它显然能打开通往下层的大门。

english: Where is the second entrance to the mines?
translation: 矿场的第二个入口在哪里？

english: Of this I am not yet sure. From what I have been able to gather, it was not originally built for humans to enter by. Where it may be, I am still endeavoring to find out.
translation: 我还不确定。根据我收集到的信息，那个入口原本不是为人类进入而建的。我仍在努力寻找它的位置。

english: How can you be discreet with THAT star emblazoned on your robes?
translation: 你那袍子上绣着那么显眼的星星，怎么可能谨慎行动？

english: Saradomin watches over me, I am not troubled by those who are not meant to notice.
translation: 萨拉多明看护着我，我不会被那些不该注意的人困扰。

english: Even so, you're not exactly keeping quiet about your allegiance are you?
translation: 即便如此，你对你的效忠对象也未免太张扬了吧？

english: Saradomin will protect me. Even if I should fall there are many behind me who would stand in my place.
translation: 萨拉多明会保护我。即使我倒下，我身后也有许多人会接替我的位置。

english: Is that much consolation when you get chopped up into little pieces?
translation: 当你被剁成碎块时，这点安慰能有多大用？

english: I would rather be cut into little pieces whilst proclaiming the goodness of Saradomin than hiding my faith.
translation: 我宁愿在宣扬萨拉多明之善时被剁成碎块，也不愿隐藏我的信仰。

english: I can't see anyone behind you.
translation: 我没看见你身后有什么人。

english: Although you may not realise it, Saradomin works quietly in many people, such is the folly of looking with your eyes and not with your heart.
translation: 虽然你可能没意识到，但萨拉多明默默地在许多人心中工作，这就是用眼睛而非用心去看的愚昧之处。

english: And I would be one of them. So, can I borrow that key?
translation: 那我就是其中之一。所以，能把那把钥匙借我用用吗？

english: I am afraid my task can be entrusted to nobody else. Saradomin has asked me alone to do this. I cannot take the slightest risk of losing this key. The stakes are too high.
translation: 恐怕我的任务不能委托给任何人。萨拉多明只要求我独自完成。我不能冒丢失这把钥匙的任何风险。赌注太高了。

english: You're right, I was wrong to doubt Saradomin.
translation: 你说得对，我不该怀疑萨拉多明。

english: Let not your faith in Saradomin falter, for all else is insignificant.
translation: 不要动摇你对萨拉多明的信仰，因为其他一切都微不足道。

english: You're nuts, goodbye.
translation: 你疯了，再见。

english: Can I borrow your key?
translation: 能把你的钥匙借我吗？

english: Please? I'll be very careful with it.
translation: 拜托嘛？我会很小心的。

english: You know not what you deal with. There is evil in that mine and, whatever your assurances, I cannot risk you falling to the creatures within.
translation: 你不知道你在面对什么。那矿场里有邪恶存在，无论你怎么保证，我不能再冒险让你落入里面的生物手中。

english: And you think you'll be safer in the mine than me?
translation: 你觉得你在矿场里会比我更安全？

english: Of course I'll be safe, my faith in Saradomin protects me.
translation: 我当然安全，我对萨拉多明的信仰保护着我。

english: I'll trade for it.
translation: 我拿东西跟你换。

english: Saradomin provides for my every need. There is nothing you could offer me.
translation: 萨拉多明满足我的一切所需。你没有什么能给我的。
