english: Pretty pretty please?
translation: 求求你了嘛？

english: Saradomin grant me patience. The answer is no.
translation: 萨拉多明赐我耐心。答案是不行。

english: I didn't want that key anyway.
translation: 反正我本来也不想要那把钥匙。

english: Witness the goodness of Saradomin, that he has granted you the wisdom to see our positions in perspective.
translation: 见证萨拉多明之善，他赐予你智慧，让你看清我们的立场。

english: How does a lost artefact that was only legendary help?
translation: 一个失传的、传说级别的神器能有什么用？

english: Although the amulet was lost, it is my hope that if I can make it into the mines I can craft another.
translation: 虽然护符已经遗失，但我希望如果能进入矿场，我可以再制作一个。

english: Why was everyone in the mines slaughtered? Surely it wasn't their fault that the crystals formed?
translation: 为什么矿场里的人全都被屠杀了？水晶形成又不是他们的错。

english: It is said that some of the workers in the mines, merely from being in the presence of these crystals, found themselves bestowed with the love of Saradomin.
translation: 据说矿场里的一些工人，仅仅因为接触这些水晶，就发现自己被赋予了萨拉多明之爱。

english: The advantage to our cause was considered too great by some within Morytania. They set about mercilessly and brutally killing everyone in the mines rather than risk losing them to us.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚的一些人认为这对我方的优势太过巨大。他们无情而残忍地屠杀了矿场里的所有人，而不是冒险让这些人投向我们。

english: Such is the treachery of the servants of evil, that they even destroy their own kind without a moments thought.
translation: 这就是邪恶仆从的背信弃义，他们甚至毫不犹豫地摧毁自己的同类。

english: The mines are now rumoured to be haunted by the souls of all those brutally and needlessly killed.
translation: 现在有传言说，矿场里闹鬼，全是那些被残忍无端杀害的灵魂。

english: I've found the second entrance to the mine, I've managed to make it inside.
translation: 我找到了矿场的第二个入口，我已经成功进去了。

english: You are foolhardy indeed should you venture inside. The presence of evil is strong within the mines. If you take the risk I shall pray for your safety, although I hold little hope for your safe return.
translation: 你若是贸然进去，真是鲁莽至极。矿场内邪恶的力量很强大。如果你冒这个险，我会为你祈祷平安，尽管我对你安全归来不抱太大希望。

english: Unfortunately I need a key to use the lift that goes to the lower levels.  Can you help?
translation: 不幸的是，我需要一把钥匙来使用通往下一层的升降机。你能帮忙吗？

english: Indeed? My own inquiries have led me into possession of a key. I was informed that this key would apparently afford entrance to the lower levels. It therefore seems likely that this is the key which you seek.
translation: 是吗？我自己的打探让我得到了一把钥匙。我被告知这把钥匙显然能打开通往下一层的门。所以这很可能就是你要找的钥匙。

english: Yes, that sounds like the one. May I borrow it?
translation: 对，听起来就是这把。能借我用吗？

english: I've made it in to the mines. Unfortunately some parts are too dark to navigate.
translation: 我进入了矿场。不幸的是，有些地方太暗了，无法通行。

english: Ah ye of little faith. Let Saradomin guide you even in the darkest places. By his light you may reach your goal.
translation: 啊，你这信心不足的人。让萨拉多明指引你，即使在最黑暗的地方。藉着他的光芒，你必能抵达目标。

english: As much as I respect your fanaticism, that was spectacularly unhelpful.
translation: 尽管我尊重你的狂热，但这回答一点用都没有。

english: G... g... g... ghost!  Scary ghost! Machinery flying everywhere.
translation: 鬼...鬼...鬼...鬼啊！可怕的幽灵！机械飞得到处都是。

english: I warned you not to enter those mines. It sounds like you've met Dayth.  You must not go back down there.
translation: 我警告过你不要进入那些矿场。听起来你遇到了戴斯。你不能再回那里去了。

english: Who did you say Dayth was again?
translation: 你再说一遍戴斯是谁来着？

english: Treus Dayth was Zamorak's mage in charge of defending the ridge during the time of the orginal amulet.
translation: 特鲁斯.戴斯是萨莫拉克的法师，在最初的护符时期负责守护山脊。

english: Nonsense, he'll be no match for me.
translation: 胡扯，他根本不是我的对手。

english: I don't know if you think your persistancemakes you heroic, but you must realise it's just going to get you killed.
translation: 我不知道你是否觉得你的坚持让你显得英勇，但你必须意识到这只会让你送命。

english: I met that Dayth character you talked about. He wasn't as tough as all that.
translation: 我遇到了你提到的那个戴斯。他没那么厉害。

english: I was afraid this would happen. The fear you must have experienced within those mines has left you delusional. There's no way you could have survived had you actually fought Dayth.
translation: 我就担心会发生这种事。你在那些矿场里经历的恐惧让你产生了幻觉。如果你真的和戴斯战斗了，是不可能活下来的。

english: Arrrrrrrgh, you're unbelievable. Get out of my sight.
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊，你真是不可理喻。给我滚远点。

english: I don't know if you think your persistance makes you heroic, but you must realise it's just going to get you killed.
translation: 我不知道你是不是觉得你的坚持让你显得很英勇，但你必须明白，这只会让你送命。

english: I wonder if that cart is anywhere useful now?
translation: 我在想那辆推车现在还有用吗？

english: Ooooo Wooooo Woo
translation: 呜呜呜——呜呜——呜

english: It's kind of dark down here. I should probably find a light source before going further.
translation: 这里有点暗。我最好先找个光源再继续前进。

english: Hey - my light source isn't working! I'd better find a more suitable one before trying to go any further.
translation: 嘿——我的光源不亮了！我最好找个更合适的再往前走。

english: What the... ?
translation: 这什么……？

english: Blooming, thieving cultists! Why don't they leave me alone? String them all up, that's what I say!
translation: 这些该死的偷窃邪教徒！为什么就不能放过我？把他们全吊死，我说的！

english: It's those blooming cultists from the south! They keep breaking into my house!
translation: 就是南部那些该死的邪教徒！他们老是闯进我家！

english: Have they taken much?
translation: 他们拿走了很多东西吗？

english: Well... no. They stole a suit of armour when they first broke in months ago, but they've been back four more times since then and taken nothing.
translation: 嗯...没有。几个月前他们第一次闯进来时偷了一套盔甲，但之后又回来了四次，却什么都没拿。

english: I see. And you are?
translation: 原来如此。你是？

english: You don't know me? Why, I am Sir Ceril Carnillean! Mine is quite a famous bloodline, you know. We've played a vital role in the politics of Ardougne for many generations.
translation: 你不认识我？我可是塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士！我的家族血统相当有名，你知道吗。我们家族世代在阿多尼城的政治中扮演着重要角色。

english: Well I'm [player name]. Maybe I can help you with these cultists?
translation: 我是[player name]。也许我能帮你处理这些邪教徒？

english: Interesting... I suppose the authorities haven't been much help so far. Yes, very well. If you return the stolen armour, I will provide you with a modest cash reward!
translation: 有意思...看来官方至今也没帮上什么忙。好吧，如果你能找回被偷的盔甲，我会给你一笔可观的现金奖励！

english: Yes, of course, I'd be happy to help.
translation: 好的，当然，我很乐意帮忙。

english: That's very noble of you! Keep that attitude up and one day you might have the honour of working full-time for someone like me.
translation: 真是高尚！保持这种态度，总有一天你会有幸像我这样全职工作。

english: Now, I caught a glimpse of the thieves leaving, but due to... uh... my cold, I was unable to give chase.
translation: 我瞥见那些小偷逃走了，但因为...呃...我感冒了，所以没能追赶。

english: What I do know is that they belong to some sort of cult. They seem to be based in a cave just south of the city, near the Clock Tower.
translation: 我只知道他们属于某个邪教组织。他们的据点似乎在城市南边的一个洞穴里，就在钟楼附近。

english: My old butler, Higson, once followed them there. Unfortunately, the next night he died in his sleep.
translation: 我的老管家希格森曾经跟踪他们到那里。不幸的是，第二天晚上他就死在了睡梦中。

english: No, it's okay. Jones, a replacement from the Servants' Guild, arrived the next day. He's been great - makes an excellent broth!
translation: 不，没关系。琼斯，从仆从公会来的替代者，第二天就到了。他非常棒——做的肉汤一流！

english: Right... I'll see if I can find this cave.
translation: 好...我去看看能不能找到这个洞穴。

english: No thanks. I've got other plans.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我有其他安排。

english: Well no wonder I'm the one with the big house and you're the one on the streets.
translation: 难怪我住大房子而你流落街头。

english: You probably deserve it.
translation: 你活该。

english: And who are you to judge me? You look like a peasant anyway. I'm wasting my time talking to you.
translation: 你凭什么评判我？反正你看起来就像个农民。跟你说话简直是浪费时间。

english: You seem uptight. I'll leave you alone.
translation: 你好像很紧张。我不打扰你了。

english: Yes, I doubt you could help anyway.
translation: 是啊，反正我也不觉得你能帮上忙。

english: That's Sir Ceril to you, you impudent scamp. Show a bit of respect to your betters. Now, shouldn't you be recovering my armour?
translation: 叫我塞里尔爵士，你个无礼的小鬼。对长辈放尊重些。现在，你不是该去取回我的盔甲了吗？

english: Yeah yeah, I'm on it.
translation: 是是是，我这就去。

english: Good. I suggest you start with that cave south of the city, near the Clock Tower. That is where the cult is based.
translation: 很好。我建议你先去城南钟楼附近的那个洞穴看看。那就是邪教的据点。

english: Hello there. I hear you're after that cult who broke in the other night. It always gladdens me when civilians assist the law like this.
translation: 你好。我听说你在追查那晚闯入的邪教。看到平民像这样协助执法，我总是很高兴。

english: I'm just happy to be of help.
translation: 能帮上忙我很开心。

english: Oh, hello. I'm afraid I'm not very presentable at the moment. I've been under incredible stress of late! It's ruining my complexion!
translation: 哦，你好。恐怕我现在不太体面。最近我承受着巨大的压力！这毁了我的气色！

english: Why? What's wrong?
translation: 为什么？怎么了？

english: It's those awful cultists! I just don't feel safe here anymore!
translation: 都是那些可恶的邪教徒！我觉得这里再也不安全了！

english: Mommy said you're here to kill all the nasty people that keep breaking in.
translation: 妈妈说你来这里是要杀死所有闯进来的坏人。

english: Can I watch?
translation: 我能看吗？

english: Oi - I don't want people messing around with my range!
translation: 喂——我可不想别人乱动我的炉灶！

english: You can call me Clivet. What do you want, adventurer?
translation: 叫我克利维特就行。你想干什么，冒险者？

english: Do you know the Carnilleans?
translation: 你认识卡尼利安家的人吗？

english: Carnilleans? Don't think I've ever heard of them.
translation: 卡尼利安？我不记得听说过他们。

english: Look, I know you're lying. I know all about your cult.
translation: 听着，我知道你在撒谎。我对你们的邪教了如指掌。

english: Is that so? In that case, I'd say you'd be wise to leave now.
translation: 是吗？那样的话，我劝你现在离开是明智之举。

english: Unfortunately, I have a job to do. I'm not leaving until it's done.
translation: 不幸的是，我有任务在身。没完成之前我不会走。

english: Ah, I see. That two-faced snob has made you fall for his propaganda, eh?
translation: 啊，我明白了。那个两面三刀的势利眼让你相信了他的宣传，是吧？

english: The Carnillean home does not belong to them. It was built long ago by the great Lord Hazeel, who once ruled over this entire region.
translation: 卡尼利安的府邸并不属于他们。那是很久以前伟大的哈兹尔领主建造的，他曾经统治整个地区。

english: Many years ago, the Carnilleans led a rebellion against Lord Hazeel and all who followed him. Under the cover of darkness, they stormed his home in an angry mob, torturing and butchering everyone they found.
translation: 许多年前，卡尼利安家族领导了一场反对哈兹尔领主及其追随者的叛乱。在夜幕的掩护下，他们组成愤怒的暴民冲进他的家，折磨和屠杀了所有他们找到的人。

english: The following morning, the Carnillean forefathers moved into the empty household and claimed it as their own. They have grown fat on the hard work of Lord Hazeel ever since.
translation: 第二天早上，卡尼利安的先祖们搬进了空荡荡的宅邸，并宣称那是他们的财产。从那以后，他们靠着哈兹尔领主的辛勤劳作而养尊处优。

english: Right... And what happened to this Hazeel?
translation: 这样啊...那这个哈兹尔怎么样了？

english: The foolish Carnilleans believed him dead. Unluckily for them, being an all-powerful Mahjarrat gave him access to powers and enchantments they knew nothing of.
translation: 愚蠢的卡尼利安家族以为他死了。对他们来说不幸的是，作为全能的玛哈加特，他掌握着他们一无所知的力量和魔法。

english: As they stormed his home, Lord Hazeel made preparations for his eventual return. We, his faithful followers, have been working to bring that about ever since.
translation: 当他们冲进他家时，哈兹尔领主为他最终的回归做好了准备。我们，他忠实的追随者，从那以后一直致力于实现这一点。

english: What makes you think I care about the politics and histories of Ardougne?
translation: 你凭什么觉得我会在乎阿多尼城的政治和历史？

english: I could kill you right now and be done with it, but I don't think you're the fool that the Carnilleans believe you to be. Instead, I offer you a chance to join us.
translation: 我现在就可以杀了你一了百了，但我不认为你是卡尼利安家族所认为的那种傻瓜。相反，我给你一个加入我们的机会。

english: Help us bring about the return of Lord Hazeel, and you will be well rewarded. However, should you continue to try and prevent his return, you will suffer the wrath of Zamorak.
translation: 帮助我们实现哈兹尔领主的回归，你将得到丰厚的奖赏。然而，如果你继续试图阻止他的回归，你将承受萨莫拉克的怒火。

english: Before I decide, I have some questions for you.
translation: 在我决定之前，我有一些问题要问你。

english: Tell me more about Hazeel.
translation: 再跟我讲讲哈兹尔的事。

english: Lord Hazeel is one of the great Mahjarrat who once fought alongside Zamorak himself. He ruled this region for many years, until the cowardly Carnilleans rebelled against him.
translation: 哈兹尔领主是伟大的玛哈加特之一，曾与萨莫拉克本人并肩作战。他统治这个地区多年，直到懦弱的卡尼利安家族反叛他。

english: But he survived?
translation: 但他活下来了？

english: Of course! The Mahjarrat know magic that others can only dream of. Lord Hazeel used his abilities to ensure that one day he'd eventually return. That day will soon be upon us.
translation: 当然！玛哈加特掌握着别人只能梦想的魔法。哈兹尔领主利用他的能力确保自己有朝一日终将回归。那一天很快就会到来。

english: Why did the Carnilleans rebel against Hazeel?
translation: 为什么卡尼利安家族要反叛哈兹尔？

english: The Carnilleans served the pathetic Saradomin. They considered it their duty to overthrow Hazeel due to his loyalties to Zamorak. They were fools, blinded by Saradominist propaganda!
translation: 卡尼利安家族效忠于可怜的萨拉多明。他们认为推翻哈兹尔是他们的责任，因为哈兹尔效忠于萨莫拉克。他们是傻瓜，被萨拉多明的宣传蒙蔽了双眼！

english: Saradominist propaganda?
translation: 萨拉多明的宣传？

english: Yes! Something even more prevalent today. Too many people now are fooled into believing that Saradomin is a god of good, while Zamorak is evil. Those lies couldn't be further from the truth!
translation: 没错！如今这种宣传更加盛行。太多人被愚弄，相信萨拉多明是善良之神，而萨莫拉克是邪恶的。这些谎言与真相相去甚远！

english: Why do you keep breaking into the Carnillean Mansion?
translation: 你们为什么不断闯入卡尼利安宅邸？

english: There is something we need inside. I will say no more unless you agree to join us.
translation: 里面有我们需要的东西。除非你同意加入我们，否则我不会多说。

english: What can you tell me about the Mahjarrat?
translation: 你能告诉我有关玛哈加特的什么事？

english: Surely you have heard of the Mahjarrat? Their race is the ultimate example of power! Each of them wields the strength of an entire army. To oppose any one of them, is to face your doom!
translation: 你肯定听说过玛哈加特吧？他们的种族是力量的终极典范！他们每个人都拥有整支军队的力量。反对他们中的任何一个，就意味着面对你的末日！

english: And Hazeel is one of them?
translation: 哈兹尔是其中之一吗？

english: More than that! Hazeel is one of the greatest Mahjarrat to have ever lived!
translation: 不仅如此！哈兹尔是有史以来最伟大的玛哈加特之一！

english: I have no more questions.
translation: 我没有更多问题了。

english: Then we have nothing more to discuss until you've made your choice.
translation: 那在你做出选择之前，我们没什么好谈的了。

english: Alright, I've made my decision.
translation: 好吧，我已经决定了。

english: I'll help you.
translation: 我来帮你。

english: Good. Now, we are not the monsters that the Carnilleans would claim we are, so we were hoping to do this without violence. However, the fact they sent you here makes it clear that won't work now.
translation: 很好。我们并不像卡尼利安家族所说的那样是怪物，所以我们本来希望不通过暴力解决。然而，他们派你来的事实清楚地表明，现在行不通了。

english: You must prove your loyalty to our cause, and Ceril Carnillean must die. Kill him for us, and we will know you are truly dedicated to Lord Hazeel.
translation: 你必须证明你对我们事业的忠诚，塞里尔.卡尼利安必须死。为我们杀了他，我们就会知道你是真正忠于哈兹尔领主的。

english: Alright, how do I do it?
translation: 好吧，我该怎么做？

english: I can already tell I was right about you. I can see you are of exactly the right character to join the followers of Hazeel.
translation: 我看得出来，我对你的判断没错。我看得出你的性格完全适合加入哈兹尔的追随者。

english: Here, take this poison and pour it into Ceril Carnillean's food. Once the deed is done, return here and speak to me once more.
translation: 拿着，把这毒药倒进塞里尔.卡尼利安的食物里。事成之后，回到这里再跟我说话。

english: I need some time to think on this.
translation: 我需要一些时间考虑这事。

english: Don't take too long.
translation: 别拖太久。

english: I won't help you.
translation: 我不会帮你的。

english: Then you are a fool. Go back to your small-minded little life. You will never know the glories you could have tasted as one of us!
translation: 那你就是个傻瓜。回到你那狭隘的小日子去吧。你永远不会知道作为我们中的一员能品尝到的荣耀！

english: You know I'm going to stop you, right?
translation: 你知道我会阻止你的，对吧？

english: You'll try, but you'll never find us.
translation: 你会尝试，但你永远找不到我们。

english: Actually, I need more time to think on this.
translation: 实际上，我需要更多时间考虑这事。

english: So, you've returned. I hope you're here because you've recognised the folly in serving the Carnilleans. Think about what you could achieve if you join us instead.
translation: 你回来了。我希望你来是因为你认识到为卡尼利安家族服务是愚蠢的。想想你如果加入我们能取得什么成就。

english: I've come for the Carnillean family armour. Hand it over, or face the consequences.
translation: 我来取卡尼利安家族的盔甲。把它交出来，否则后果自负。

english: I thought I made it clear to Jones that you could not be allowed to interfere with our mission. The incompetent fool must be going soft.
translation: 我以为我已经向琼斯说清楚了，不能让你干涉我们的任务。这个无能的傻瓜一定是心软了。

english: So the butler's part of your little cult? Why is it always the butler? I should have known...
translation: 这么说管家是你们小邪教的一员？为什么总是管家？我早该知道...

english: Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! Die!
translation: 那你活不到去告诉任何人的时候了！去死吧！

english: Get away from that chest!
translation: 离那个箱子远点！

english: Hello, adventurer. How are you doing with your quest?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你的任务进展如何？

english: Drop the act, Jones. I know you're in league with the cultists.
translation: 别装了，琼斯。我知道你和邪教徒是一伙的。

english: Have you hit your head? That's a preposterous accusation!
translation: 你撞到头了吗？这指控太荒谬了！

english: Really? So you won't mind me telling Ceril then?
translation: 真的吗？那你不会介意我告诉塞里尔吧？

english: Oh, you think he'll take your word over mine? He trusts me completely!
translation: 哦，你觉得他会相信你的话而不是我的？他完全信任我！

english: You're back. Have you had any luck yet?
translation: 你回来了。有进展了吗？

english: Look! I've recovered your armour!
translation: 看！我找回了你的盔甲！

english: Well done! I must say I am very impressed! Come on, hand it over.
translation: 干得好！我必须说，我非常佩服！来吧，把它交出来。

english: Before we send you on your way with your payment, I'll just get Jones to whip you up a batch of his special broth.
translation: 在我们付钱让你离开之前，我让琼斯给你做一批他的特色肉汤。

english: I'd rather not if it's all the same to you. Apparently Jones is in league with the cultists.
translation: 如果你没意见的话，我宁可不要。显然琼斯和邪教徒是一伙的。

english: What? Right! You! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now, once and for all!
translation: 什么？好！你！我们要把这破事一次性彻底解决！

english: Jones! This commoner says you had something to do with the cultists that stole my armour. What do you have to say for yourself?
translation: 琼斯！这个平民说你和偷我盔甲的邪教徒有关系。你有什么要说的？

english: Nothing to do with me, sir. I am, as you know, a loyal servant.
translation: 与我无关，先生。你知道的，我是一个忠诚的仆从。

english: Humph. Quite right too. I cannot fathom why this scoundrel would accuse you of such a crime without evidence to back up the accusations.
translation: 哼。说得没错。我无法理解这个无赖为什么会在没有证据支持的情况下指控你犯下这样的罪行。

english: Right, I have made a decision. I have given my word as a nobleman to reward you for your efforts in retrieving my armour, but I must also compensate Jones for this terrible slander.
translation: 好，我已经决定了。我以贵族的名义承诺过要奖励你找回盔甲的努力，但我还必须补偿琼斯，为他受到的可怕诽谤。

english: Now take this and leave! And don't darken my doorstep again!
translation: 现在拿着这个离开！别再出现在我家门口！

english: Don't worry, sir, he won't be bothering us any more.
translation: 别担心，先生，他不会再烦我们了。

english: Hey! You owe me money.
translation: 嘿！你欠我钱。

english: I owe you nothing you scoundrel! Now get out or I'll have Jones throw you out!
translation: 我什么都不欠你，你这个无赖！现在滚出去，否则我叫琼斯把你扔出去！

english: You! Don't think you can go around insulting our trusted staff and then waltz up to me as though nothing has happened!
translation: 你！别以为你可以到处侮辱我们信任的职员，然后若无其事地走到我面前！

english: Everything I said was the truth.
translation: 我说的都是实话。

english: Ha! Don't be so ridiculous! Next you'll be trying to tell me that Jones murdered our old butler!
translation: 哈！别这么荒谬！接下来你是不是要告诉我，是琼斯谋杀了我们以前的管家！

english: Daddy says you don't like Mr Jones. Mr Jones is nice. He brings me toys and sweets.
translation: 爸爸说你不喜欢琼斯先生。琼斯先生人很好。他会给我带玩具和糖果。

english: Jones is a bad man.
translation: 琼斯是个坏人。

english: Well if you think that, I don't like you!
translation: 哼，你要是这么想，我就不喜欢你了！

english: Well I'll do my best to console myself over your feelings towards me.
translation: 好吧，我会尽力安慰自己，不介意你对我的看法。

english: I believe you've been asked to leave, adventurer.
translation: 冒险者，我想你已经被人要求离开了。

english: You won't get away with this, Jones! I know who you really are!
translation: 琼斯，你逃不掉的！我知道你到底是什么人！

english: That's quite enough of that. All of us here are starting to tire of your theatrics.
translation: 够了。我们这里所有人都开始厌倦你的表演了。

english: This isn't over! I will find proof!
translation: 这事没完！我会找到证据的！

english: Hello, adventurer. I hear you accused Jones of being part of that cult. Is that true?
translation: 你好，冒险者。我听说你指控琼斯是那个邪教的一员。是真的吗？

english: It is, but nobody believes me.
translation: 是的，但没人相信我。

english: You have my utter faith, adventurer. I can't openly defy Sir Ceril, but I'd like you to know that I think you're on the right track with this.
translation: 我完全相信你，冒险者。我不能公开违抗塞里尔爵士，但我想让你知道，我认为你在这件事上的方向是对的。

english: I always found it suspicious that Jones would just show up on the doorstep the very day after the old butler died. Good luck in clearing your name
translation: 我一直觉得可疑，老管家去世的第二天，琼斯就出现在门口。祝你好运，洗清你的名声。

english: And what do we have here...
translation: 看看我们这里有什么……

english: Ceril!
translation: 塞里尔！

english: What do you want now you scoundrel?
translation: 你这个无赖，现在又想要什么？

english: Take a look at what I've found.
translation: 看看我找到了什么。

english: What's this... Poison?
translation: 这是什么……毒药？

english: Jones?
translation: 琼斯？

english: Just for killing rats, sir.
translation: 只是用来毒老鼠的，先生。

english: Right... but this amulet... I recognise this! Those cultists wore amulets like this!
translation: 好吧……但这个护身符……我认得这个！那些邪教徒就戴着这样的护身符！

english: Jones! We trusted you! We took you into our home!
translation: 琼斯！我们信任你！我们让你住进我们家！

english: You senile old fool... it was all too easy! I should have killed you and your pathetic family weeks ago!
translation: 你这个老糊涂……简直太容易了！我几周前就该杀了你和你可悲的家人！

english: Guard!
translation: 守卫！

english: This man is one of those cultists! Take him away!
translation: 这个人是那些邪教徒之一！把他带走！

english: Don't think this is over, Ceril! You will die at the hands of the Hazeel Cult! I promise you that!
translation: 别以为这事就这么完了，塞里尔！你一定会死在哈兹尔邪教手里！我向你保证！

english: Well... It looks like I am indebted to you!
translation: 嗯……看来我欠你一个人情！

english: No problem. We all make mistakes.
translation: 没问题。人都会犯错。

english: But if it weren't for you... my whole family... we could have been...
translation: 但如果不是你……我全家……我们可能已经……

english: I apologise for my harshness before. The very least I can do is to reward you for your noble efforts, and to offer my sincerest apologies as a gentleman.
translation: 我为我之前的严厉道歉。至少我能做的，就是奖励你的高尚行为，并以绅士的身份向你致以最诚挚的歉意。

english: No, no, thank you! Feel free to stop by anytime, adventurer!
translation: 不，不，谢谢你！随时欢迎你来坐坐，冒险者！

english: Here's that poison you need. Take it and pour it into Ceril Carnillean's food. Once the deed is done, return here and speak to me once more.
translation: 这是你需要的毒药。拿着，把它倒进塞里尔.卡尼利安的食物里。事成之后，回到这里再跟我说话。

english: You have a mission for us, adventurer. Go to the Carnilliean household and poison Ceril Carnillean's meal to prove your loyalty.
translation: 冒险者，我们有个任务给你。去卡尼利安家，在塞里尔.卡尼利安的饭里下毒，以证明你的忠诚。

english: I need some more poison.
translation: 我还需要一些毒药。

english: Fool! Be more careful with it this time.
translation: 蠢货！这次小心点。

english: Hello, adventurer. I hear your quest is going well.
translation: 你好，冒险者。我听说你的任务进展顺利。

english: Oh yes. Do keep up the good work.
translation: 哦，是的。继续好好干。

english: I'm afraid not, Ceril.
translation: 恐怕还没有，塞里尔。

english: That's Sir Ceril you blooming scoundrel! Show respect when addressing someone of my rank! I must say, I am a bit disapointed you haven't made any progress. Maybe I was wrong about you.
translation: 是塞里尔爵士，你这个混蛋！跟我这样身份的人说话要放尊重点！我得说，你一点进展都没有，我有点失望。也许我看错你了。

english: Yeah, well, just unlucky I guess.
translation: 是啊，嗯，大概只是运气不好吧。

english: Oh, hello. I hope you've found those awful cultists! I simply cannot sleep at night knowing they're loose!
translation: 哦，你好。我希望你找到了那些可怕的邪教徒！知道他们在外面逍遥法外，我晚上根本睡不着！

english: I'm afraid I haven't found them yet.
translation: 恐怕我还没找到他们。

english: Well you really are useless, aren't you?
translation: 哼，你可真没用，不是吗？

english: You're that adventurer the family asked to help deal with those weird cultists, right?
translation: 你就是那个家里请来帮忙对付那些怪邪教徒的冒险者，对吧？

english: Hello there. Caught any of those weird cultists yet?
translation: 你好啊。抓到那些怪邪教徒了吗？

english: Well, keep at it!
translation: 嗯，继续努力！

english: Those hooligans! They slaughtered my precious Scruffy! I shall never recover! I am emotionally scarred for life!
translation: 那些流氓！他们杀了我心爱的斯克拉菲！我这辈子都缓不过来了！我留下了永久的心理创伤！

english: Yeah... Hopefully someone finds them soon.
translation: 是啊……希望有人能尽快找到他们。

english: Hello, adventurer. Such a terrible shame about Scruffy. I wonder if the family will ever fully recover.
translation: 你好，冒险者。斯克拉菲的事真是太可惜了。不知道这家人能不能完全恢复过来。

english: Anyway, I hear your quest is going well.
translation: 总之，我听说你的任务进展顺利。

english: Someone killed Scruffy. I liked Scruffy. He never told me off.
translation: 有人杀了斯克拉菲。我喜欢斯克拉菲。他从来不说我。

english: Yeah... it's a real shame.
translation: 是啊……真是太可惜了。

english: I want my mommy.
translation: 我要妈妈。

english: Oh the inhumanity... the cruelty... the misery... the pain...
translation: 哦，这惨无人道……这残忍……这痛苦……这悲伤……

english: My son is a good boy, really, but how could he give his dinner to Scruffy without having the servants test it for poison first? How? How could he be so thoughtless and careless? He knows we are all under threat!
translation: 我儿子其实是个好孩子，但他怎么能不先让仆人试毒就把晚餐给斯克拉菲吃呢？怎么能？他怎么能这么粗心大意？他知道我们都受到威胁！

english: Scruffy?
translation: 斯克拉菲？

english: He's been with our family for twenty years... that's 140 in dog years! The poor dog... What did he ever do to deserve such a fate?
translation: 它在我们家已经二十年了……按狗年算就是一百四十年！可怜的狗……它到底做了什么要遭受这样的命运？

english: Your dog got poisoned? That's not right.
translation: 你的狗被毒死了？这太不应该了。

english: I agree! I hope whichever evildoer is responsible gets the full weight of the law brought upon them!
translation: 我同意！我希望无论哪个作恶者，都要受到法律的严惩！

english: Uh... yeah... me too.
translation: 呃……是啊……我也是。

english: Oh the misery... How could someone do something like this?
translation: 哦，真痛苦……怎么会有人做出这种事？

english: Uh... I'm sure they won't get away with it...
translation: 呃……我相信他们逃不掉的……

english: Today is a dark day. Those cultists have been back, and this time they've gone further than ever before! Murder! We can't afford to keep letting them get away with this.
translation: 今天是黑暗的一天。那些邪教徒又回来了，这次他们比以往任何时候都更过分！谋杀！我们不能再让他们逍遥法外了。

english: I poisoned the food as requested, but it didn't quite go to plan.
translation: 我按要求在食物里下了毒，但事情进展得不太顺利。

english: Yes, we heard all about it from one of our sources. It's a shame that Ceril Carnillean survived, but that is no fault of yours. You have proven your loyalty to Hazeel.
translation: 是的，我们从线人那里听说了。很遗憾塞里尔.卡尼利安活了下来，但这并不是你的错。你已经证明了你对哈兹尔的忠诚。

english: I would like you to meet with our leader, Alomone. You'll find him in our hideout, deeper in the sewers. You can use this raft to get there.
translation: 我希望你去见见我们的领袖，阿洛蒙。你可以在下水道更深处我们的藏身处找到他。你可以用这个木筏到那里去。

english: However, be warned that reaching the hideout is impossible unless the flow of water down here is set correctly. You'll need to use the sewer valves above to do that.
translation: 不过，要提醒你，除非下面的水流设置正确，否则不可能到达藏身处。你需要使用上面的下水道阀门来做到这一点。

english: But how will I know how to set the valves?
translation: 但我怎么知道该怎么设置阀门呢？

english: For that, you'll need this.
translation: 为此，你需要这个。

english: Going from left to right, turn each of the five sewer valves above so that they follow the design of the amulet. Once you've done that, you'll be able to use the raft here to enter our hideout.
translation: 从左到右，转动上面五个下水道阀门，使它们与护身符的图案一致。完成后，你就可以用这里的木筏进入我们的藏身处了。

english: Here, you'll need this.
translation: 给你，你会需要这个的。

english: Careless! Look aferthis one!
translation: 粗心！看好这个！

english: What am I meant to be doing?
translation: 我该做什么？

english: Use the raft here to enter our hideout and meet with our leader, Alomone.
translation: 用这里的木筏进入我们的藏身处，去见我们的领袖阿洛蒙。

english: Be warned, you'll need to ensure the flow of water down here is set correctly for you to be able to use the raft.
translation: 提醒你，你需要确保下面的水流设置正确，才能使用木筏。

english: Going from left to right, turn each of the five sewer valves above so that they follow the design of the amulet I gave you.
translation: 从左到右，转动上面五个下水道阀门，使它们与我给你的护身符图案一致。

english: I cannot talk right now. Lord Hazeel will soon be back with us and I have many preparations to make.
translation: 我现在没空说话。哈兹尔大人很快就要回到我们身边了，我有很多准备工作要做。

english: Well, well, well... we have a new recruit. Clivet told me of your desire to join us in our glorious task to resurrect the mighty Hazeel.
translation: 哎呀呀……我们来了个新成员。克利维特告诉我，你渴望加入我们，共同完成复活强大的哈兹尔的光荣任务。

english: Well if all goes well, you'll play a key role in just that. Before his defeat, Hazeel secured within his home a powerful magical scroll of restoration. It remains there still, hidden to even the foolish Carnilleans.
translation: 好吧，如果一切顺利，你将在这件事中扮演关键角色。在他的失败之前，哈兹尔在他的家中藏了一卷强大的魔法恢复卷轴。它仍然在那里，甚至愚蠢的卡尼利安家族也没发现。

english: Up to now, our attempts to recover this scroll have been met with disappointment. However, I know you will not fail us.
translation: 到目前为止，我们找回这卷轴的努力都令人失望。不过，我知道你不会让我们失望的。

english: So you want me to find this scroll?
translation: 所以你想让我找到这卷轴？

english: That is correct. You must return to the Carnillean Mansion and find where it is hidden. We already have an agent in place to support you.
translation: 没错。你必须回到卡尼利安庄园，找到它藏在哪里。我们已经安排了一个内应来支持你。

english: Indeed. Their Butler Jones is in fact a faithful follower of Hazeel. He has been unsuccessful in locating the scroll himself, but together the two of you will find it.
translation: 确实如此。他们的管家琼斯实际上是哈兹尔的忠实信徒。他自己没能找到卷轴，但你们俩一起就能找到。

english: Now, go with haste. Soon we will restore Hazeel to his true power and glory!
translation: 现在，快去吧。很快我们就能让哈兹尔恢复他真正的力量和荣耀！

english: Hazeel has already waited far too long for his return. It is imperative that you find that scroll! It hides somewhere within the Carnillean Mansion.
translation: 哈兹尔已经等得太久了。你必须找到那卷轴！它藏在卡尼利安庄园的某个地方。

english: Hello, Ceril. How's things?
translation: 你好，塞里尔。最近怎么样？

english: Sir Ceril! Sir! And things are terrible! Our beloved dog is dead, and I fear it's only a matter of time before those cultists strike again!
translation: 塞里尔爵士！先生！情况糟透了！我们心爱的狗死了，我担心那些邪教徒再次下手只是时间问题！

english: Don't worry, I'm sure it will all be okay in the end.
translation: 别担心，我相信最后一切都会好起来的。

english: I just don't understand it! How? How could someone poison my delicious food without me even noticing? I... I just don't get it!
translation: 我就是不明白！怎么会？怎么会有人在我美味的食物里下毒而我都没注意到？我……我就是想不通！

english: Oh man... I hope I don't lose my job over this... but how? How did they do it? And why would they want to kill poor Scruffy anyway? He was such a good dog...
translation: 哦，天哪……我希望我不会因此丢掉工作……但是怎么会？他们是怎么做到的？而且他们为什么要杀可怜的斯克拉菲？它可是条好狗……

english: Yeah... it's a real mystery.
translation: 是啊……真是个谜。

english: Ceril. How are you?
translation: 塞里尔。你还好吗？

english: Oh cruel world! Scruffy... I knew you well... I... just... don't think I can... go on without...
translation: 哦，残酷的世界！斯克拉菲……我那么了解你……我……只是……觉得我……撑不下去了……

english: Loosen up already. It was only a DOG.
translation: 放松点吧。不过是一条狗而已。

english: I'm making progress. On that note, I hear you might be able to help me with my next task.
translation: 我正在取得进展。说到这个，我听说你也许能帮我完成下一个任务。

english: Ah yes, the scroll. I'm afraid I've searched high and low, but have so far been unable to locate it. I'm sure it is somewhere within the house, hidden where even the family won't find it.
translation: 啊，是的，卷轴。恐怕我已经到处找过了，但至今没能找到它。我确定它就在房子里的某个地方，藏在连家人都找不到的地方。

english: Hmm... So it must be somewhere they'd have never stepped foot. I'll keep on looking.
translation: 嗯……所以它一定在他们从未踏足过的地方。我会继续找。

english: Hello, adventurer. How is your quest going?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你的任务进展如何？

english: I'm making progress.
translation: 我正在取得进展。

english: Good. Remember, the scroll must be somewhere within the house, hidden where even the family won't find it.
translation: 很好。记住，卷轴一定在房子里的某个地方，藏在连家人都找不到的地方。

english: Hmm... I'll keep on looking.
translation: 嗯……我会继续找。

english: I have the scroll!
translation: 我拿到卷轴了！

english: Then you should waste no time in returning to Alomone. The return of Hazeel will soon be upon us!
translation: 那你应该立刻回到阿洛蒙那里。哈兹尔的回归即将到来！

english: I'm sorry. I am far too upset to talk to anybody right now. Oh... poor Scruffy...
translation: 对不起。我现在太难过了，不想跟任何人说话。哦……可怜的斯克拉菲……

english: Yeah... poor Scruffy.
translation: 是啊……可怜的斯克拉菲。

english: Hello, adventurer. I hope you find the cult soon. We have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.
translation: 你好，冒险者。我希望你尽快找到那个教团。我们非常怀疑又发生了一起入室盗窃案。

english: Have you brought the scroll of restoration?
translation: 你带来了复原卷轴吗？

english: Yes, I have it right here.
translation: 是的，我就在这里。

english: Watch adventurer, and witness the glorious rebirth of Hazeel!
translation: 看着吧，冒险者，见证哈兹尔的光荣重生！

english: Sentente sillaberi junque dithmento! Ia! Ia! Dextrimon encanto! Termando... Imcando... Solly enty rando... Sentente! Ia! Ia! Indenti zaggarati g'thxa!
translation: 森滕特.西拉贝里.琼克.迪斯门托！伊亚！伊亚！德克斯特里蒙.恩坎托！特尔曼多……伊姆坎多……索利.恩蒂.兰多……森滕特！伊亚！伊亚！因登蒂.扎加拉蒂.格萨！

english: Dintenta! Sententa! Retenta! Q'exjta! Ia! Sottottott! Ia! Dysmenta junque fammatio svelken! Sottey! Sentey! Soloment!
translation: 丁滕塔！森滕塔！雷滕塔！克埃克斯塔！伊亚！索托托特！伊亚！迪斯门塔.琼克.法马蒂奥.斯维尔肯！索泰！森泰！索洛门特！

english: My loyal followers, I have pride in you all. You have achieved a feat many would have considered impossible and returned me to this land.
translation: 我忠诚的追随者们，我为你们所有人感到骄傲。你们完成了一项许多人认为不可能完成的壮举，让我重返这片土地。

english: Much time has passed and I have much to attend to, but first, I believe there is one here who deserves my gratitude.
translation: 时光流逝，我有很多事要处理，但首先，我相信这里有一位值得我感谢的人。

english: Adventurer, I know that your efforts were essential in bringing about my return. You have my thanks. Know that I consider you an ally.
translation: 冒险者，我知道你的努力对我回归至关重要。我感谢你。要知道，我把你视为盟友。

english: Now, I must leave you, loyal subjects, for time is short. My Mahjarrat kin will soon head northwards, and I have much to prepare.
translation: 现在，我必须离开你们了，忠诚的子民们，因为时间紧迫。我的玛哈加特同胞很快就要北上，我有很多事情要准备。

english: Rest assured, when my work is done, I will return to you. Before long, the world will know of Hazeel once more!
translation: 请放心，等我的工作完成后，我会回到你们身边。不久之后，世界将再次知晓哈兹尔之名！

english: You must find it and bring it to me! Hazeel has already waited far too long for his return.
translation: 你必须找到它并带给我！哈兹尔已经为他的回归等待太久了。

english: Blooming, thieving, weirdo cultists! Why don't they leave me alone? String 'em all up, that's what I say!
translation: 该死的偷窃怪癖邪教徒！他们为什么不放过我？把他们全绞死，我就是这么说的！

english: It's those blooming cultists from the forest! Those freaks keep breaking into my house!
translation: 又是那些从森林里来的该死的邪教徒！那些怪人老是闯进我家！

english: They first broke in months ago and stole a suit of armour. The strange thing is that they've broken in four times since but taken nothing.
translation: 他们几个月前第一次闯进来，偷了一套盔甲。奇怪的是，之后他们又闯进来了四次，但什么都没拿。

english: And you are...?
translation: 那么你是……？

english: Why, I am Sir Ceril Carnillean! We really are quite a famous bloodline... who've played a vital role in the politics of Ardougne for many generations.
translation: 哎呀，我是塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士！我们家族可是非常显赫的血统……好几代以来都在阿多尼城的政治中扮演着至关重要的角色。

english: Perhaps you would be able to assist me in returning the stolen armour? For a modest cash reward of course!
translation: 也许你能帮我找回被偷的盔甲？当然，会有一笔可观的现金报酬！

english: No wonder I'm the one with the big house, and you're the one on the streets.
translation: 难怪我住大房子，而你流落街头。

english: That's very noble of you sirrah! I caught a glimpse of the thieves leaving but due to... uh.. yeah, my cold I was unable to give chase.
translation: 你真是太高尚了，小子！我瞥见那些小偷离开，但由于……呃……对，我的感冒，我没能追上去。

english: They're some kind of crazy cult who dress all in black, and hang out near the cave entrance in the forest south of here.
translation: 他们是某种疯狂的邪教，全都穿黑衣服，经常出没在往南森林里那个洞穴入口附近。

english: My old butler, Higson, once followed them to their hideout there. Unfortunately the next night he died in his sleep.
translation: 我的老管家，希格森，曾经跟踪他们到那里的藏身处。不幸的是，第二天晚上他就死在睡梦中了。

english: No, it's ok. A replacement arrived the next day. He's been great - cooks an excellent broth!
translation: 不，没关系。第二天就来了个接替的。他干得很好——煮的汤味道棒极了！

english: Ok. I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好的。我去看看能做什么。

english: And who are YOU to judge ME? Hmmm. You look like a peasant anyway. I'm wasting my time talking to you.
translation: 你算老几，也配来评判我？哼。我看你也就是个农民。跟你说话真是浪费时间。

english: Have you had any luck yet?
translation: 有进展了吗？

english: I'm afraid not Ceril.
translation: 恐怕还没有，塞里尔。

english: That's SIR Ceril you blooming scoundrel! Show respect when addressing someone of my rank! It's strange you haven't recovered it yet though as Jones seemed quite sure of their location.
translation: 是塞里尔爵士，你这个该死的无赖！跟我这样身份的人说话要放尊重点！奇怪的是你居然还没找回来，因为琼斯似乎很确定他们的位置。

english: Hello. What is this building?
translation: 你好。这是什么建筑？

english: This is the home of Sir Ceril Carnillean of the noble Carnillean family. You're welcome to look around, but I'm afraid I'll have to keep an eye on you.
translation: 这是高贵的卡尼利安家族，塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士的府邸。欢迎你四处看看，但恐怕我得盯着你。

english: Recently we've been having a real problem with thieves and strange cultists coming out of the forest for some reason.
translation: 最近我们一直有麻烦，不知为何，总有小偷和奇怪的邪教徒从森林里跑出来。

english: Yes, well, these things are bound to happen when you're as wealthy as the Carnilleans.
translation: 是啊，嗯，像卡尼利安家这么有钱，这种事是免不了的。

english: Have you any more info on the Carnilleans?
translation: 关于卡尼利安家，你还有什么信息吗？

english: There's a lot I could tell you about the Carnillean family history. However, I'm afraid if I did speak about such matters I would be at risk of losing my job.
translation: 关于卡尼利安家族的历史，我能告诉你很多。不过，如果我谈论这些事，恐怕会有丢掉工作的风险。

english: Long enough to know the Carnilleans are not as innocent or noble as they seem.
translation: 时间长到足以知道卡尼利安家并不像他们看起来那么无辜和高尚。

english: You mind your business, I'll mind mine.
translation: 你管好你的事，我管好我的事。

english: Look, I KNOW you're hiding something. I've heard theres a cult hideout down here.
translation: 听着，我知道你在隐瞒什么。我听说这下面有个邪教藏身处。

english: If you want to stay healthy you'll leave now.
translation: 如果你想平安无事，现在就离开。

english: I have my orders.
translation: 我奉命行事。

english: So... that two faced cold hearted snob has made you fall for his propaganda eh?
translation: 所以……那个两面三刀、冷酷无情的势利眼让你相信了他的宣传，嗯？

english: Sir Ceril Carnillean is a man of honour!
translation: 塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士是个有荣誉感的人！

english: Is he now? Is he REALLY? There is a lot more to the Carnilleans than meets the eye you fool...
translation: 是吗？他真的是吗？卡尼利安家的事远比你看到的要复杂得多，你这个蠢货……

english: And none of it is honourable.
translation: 而且没有一件是荣誉的。

english: The Carnillean home does not belong to them. The builder of the house was Lord Hazeel, one of the Mahjarrat followers of Zamorak. Many years ago there was a civil war
translation: 卡尼利安的家不属于他们。房子的建造者是哈兹尔领主，他是玛哈加特的扎莫拉克追随者之一。多年前有一场内战……

english: in this land, and the hateful Saradominists declared war upon all Zamorakians who lived here. Lord Hazeel nobly would not repent his beliefs, and the Carnilleans harrassed
translation: 可恨的萨拉多明主义者向所有住在这里的萨莫拉克信徒宣战。哈兹尔勋爵高尚地不肯放弃他的信仰，而卡尼利安家族则持续骚扰

english: Hazeel and his followers for many decades. One fateful night, under cover of darkness, they stormed his home in an angry mob torturing and butchering all loyal
translation: 哈兹尔和他的追随者长达数十年。在一个命运攸关的夜晚，趁着夜色掩护，他们暴民般冲进他的家，折磨并屠杀了里面所有忠诚的

english: Zamorakians they encountered inside. The following morning, the Carnillean forefathers moved into the empty household and claimed it as their own.
translation: 萨莫拉克信徒。第二天早上，卡尼利安家的祖先搬进了这栋空房子，并宣称这是他们的财产。

english: They have grown fat on the hard work of Lord Hazeel ever since. Unluckily for them Lord Hazeel as a Mahjarrat had access to powers and enchantments they knew nothing
translation: 从那以后，他们就靠着哈兹尔勋爵的辛勤劳动养得脑满肠肥。对他们来说不幸的是，哈兹尔勋爵作为玛哈加特，掌握着他们一无所知的

english: about, and made preparations for his return when first they began to storm his home. Soon the day will come when he will return to wreak his vengeance upon the thieves!
translation: ……关于这件事，并在他家开始被围攻时就为他的回归做了准备。很快他回来对这些窃贼复仇的日子就要到了！

english: The politics and histories of Ardougne do not concern me. I have been given a job and intend to see it through to the end.
translation: 阿多尼城的政治和历史与我无关。我接受了任务，就打算把它完成。

english: Well then friend, perhaps I can offer you a different job then? Sooner or later Our master WILL return to this land; those faithful to him will be well rewarded.
translation: 那么，朋友，也许我可以给你一份不同的工作？我们的主人迟早会回归这片土地；忠于他的人将得到丰厚的回报。

english: Join our cult and assist us in his restoration, and you will be well rewarded; try and prevent his return and suffer the wrath of Zamorak and the Mahjarrat.
translation: 加入我们的教团，协助我们让他复苏，你将得到丰厚的奖赏；试图阻止他的回归，就等着承受萨莫拉克和玛哈加特的怒火吧。

english: You're crazy, I'd never help you.
translation: 你疯了，我绝不会帮你。

english: Then you are a fool. Go back to your small minded mundane little life; you will never know the glories you could have tasted as one of us!
translation: 那你就是个傻瓜。滚回你狭隘平庸的小日子去吧；你永远不会知道作为我们一员所能品尝到的荣耀！

english: So what would I have to do?
translation: 那么我需要做什么？

english: You must prove your loyalty to our cause. Killing one of the Carnillean household should be sufficient proof of your dedication to resurrecting our master Lord Hazeel.
translation: 你必须证明你对我们的忠诚。杀死一个卡尼利安家族的人，应该足以证明你致力于复活我们的主人哈兹尔勋爵。

english: So what say you adventurer? Join our side against the Carnillean thieves?
translation: 那么你怎么说，冒险者？加入我们这边，对抗卡尼利安那些小偷？

english: No. I won't do it.
translation: 不。我不会做的。

english: Then you are a fool. Go back to your small minded, mundane little life; you will never know the glories you could have tasted as one of us!
translation: 那你就是个傻瓜。滚回你狭隘平庸的小日子去吧；你永远不会知道作为我们一员所能品尝到的荣耀！

english: Ok, count me in.
translation: 好吧，算我一个。

english: Excellent. It takes a rare character to see through the cursed Carnillean lies. I can tell you are a [man/lady] of exactly the right character to join the followers of Hazeel.
translation: 太好了。能看穿卡尼利安家那些该死的谎言，需要非凡的品格。我看得出来，你正是那种适合加入哈兹尔追随者的[man/lady]。

english: Here. Take this poison. Pour it into their food, and once the deed is done, return here and speak to me once more.
translation: 拿着。把这毒药倒进他们的食物里，事成之后，回到这里再跟我说话。

english: I've heard enough of your rubbish!
translation: 你的废话我听够了！

english: Then leave, fool!
translation: 那就滚吧，蠢货！

english: So. You've returned. Now do you want to know the truth about the 'honourable' Carnilleans?
translation: 所以，你回来了。现在你想知道关于那些“高尚的”卡尼利安家的真相吗？

english: How did YOU get in here?
translation: 你是怎么进来的？

english: I thought I made it clear to the butler you could not be allowed to interfere with our mission. The incompetent fool must be going soft.
translation: 我以为我已经跟管家说清楚了，不能让你干扰我们的任务。那个无能的蠢货一定是心软了。

english: So the butler's part of your sordid little cult huh? Why is it ALWAYS the butler? I should have known...
translation: 所以管家也是你们那个肮脏小教团的一员，嗯？为什么总是管家？我早该知道的……

english: Well you won't live long enough to tell anyone! DIE!!!
translation: 哼，你活不到去告诉任何人的时候了！去死吧！！！

english: What? Who are you and why did you come here? It doesn't matter, leave now adventurer. While you still can.
translation: 什么？你是谁，为什么来这里？没关系，现在离开，冒险者。趁你还能走。

english: Hello Ceril.
translation: 你好，塞里尔。

english: That's SIR Ceril to you, you impudent scamp. Show a bit of respect to your betters. And shouldn't you be recovering my armour?
translation: 是塞里尔爵士，你这个无礼的小鬼。对你的长辈放尊重点。你不是应该去帮我找回盔甲吗？

english: Yeah yeah, I'm on it, I'm ON it.
translation: 是是是，我正在办，正在办。

english: Oh no... not you again.
translation: 哦不……又是你。

english: WHERE is the cult hideout?
translation: 邪教藏身处在哪里？

english: You're more of a fool than you look if you think you will ever find it. When Lord Hazeel is revived you will be first to grovel for his mercy!
translation: 如果你以为能找到它，那你比看起来还要蠢。等哈兹尔勋爵复活，你将是第一个匍匐在他脚下乞求仁慈的人！

english: Hello Ceril. Yes, I found their hideout.
translation: 你好，塞里尔。是的，我找到他们的藏身处了。

english: SIR Ceril to you. But good work there! BLOOMING good work! Hand over the armour then.
translation: 是塞里尔爵士。不过干得好！干得真他娘的好！那把盔甲交出来吧。

english: Uh... yeah... about that... I interrogated a cult member at the hideout's entrance, but he managed to escape into the sewer system.
translation: 呃……嗯……关于这个……我在藏身处入口盘问了一个邪教成员，但他设法逃进了下水道系统。

english: Seems they have some sort of grievance against you and your family. Something about some guy called Hazeel?
translation: 看来他们对你和你的家族有些怨恨。好像跟一个叫哈兹尔的人有关？

english: Hazeel? Uh... umm... err.. hmmmm.
translation: 哈兹尔？呃……嗯……呃……嗯嗯。

english: Nope, they're obviously a bunch of blooming loonies! Go find them and bring me back my blooming armour! Nobody steals from Sir Ceril Carnillean!!!
translation: 不，他们显然就是一群该死的疯子！去找他们，把我的该死的盔甲带回来！没人能从塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士这里偷东西！！！

english: Hello madam.
translation: 你好，夫人。

english: I hope you found those awful hooligan cultists! I simply cannot sleep at night knowing they're loose!
translation: 我希望你找到那些可恶的流氓邪教徒了！知道他们还在外面逍遥，我晚上根本睡不着觉！

english: I know, I know, I'm working on it ok?
translation: 我知道，我知道，我正在处理，好吗？

english: I don't know, honestly I don't. There are some very odd folk around these parts.
translation: 我不知道，老实说我不知道。这附近有些非常古怪的人。

english: What? How did you get in here? Who are you and why do you come here? It doesn't matter, you will not live long enough to tell anyone of our hideout!
translation: 什么？你怎么进来的？你是谁，为什么来这里？没关系，你活不到去告诉任何人我们的藏身处了！

english: Hello Alomone.
translation: 你好，阿洛蒙。

english: Out of my way idiot! We are preparing matters your puny mind could not hope to understand!
translation: 别挡路，白痴！我们正在准备的事情，你那渺小的脑子根本无法理解！

english: I'm fine. Where's my armour?
translation: 我很好。我的盔甲呢？

english: Uh... I didn't get it yet... I DID find the cult's hideout though!
translation: 呃……我还没拿到……不过我确实找到了邪教的藏身处！

english: Well what are you waiting for? I'm not paying you to blooming sight see you know!
translation: 那你还在等什么？我可不是花钱雇你来该死的观光的，你知道吧！

english: What? An intruder? HERE? How did you get in here? You must leave! NOW!
translation: 什么？入侵者？在这里？你是怎么进来的？你必须离开！马上！

english: You again! You meddle in our affairs too much! When Lord Hazeel returns to this realm he will lay a mighty vengeance upon you!
translation: 又是你！你太多管闲事了！等哈兹尔领主回到这个领域，他会对你施加巨大的复仇！

english: Oh, hello again adventurer. I trust you did not have too much trouble dealing with those hooligans?
translation: 哦，又见面了，冒险者。我相信你对付那些流氓没遇到太多麻烦吧？

english: Nah, it was a piece of cake.
translation: 没有，小菜一碟。

english: Jones. We need to talk.
translation: 琼斯。我们需要谈谈。

english: Yes? You need some help with your quest?
translation: 嗯？你需要任务方面的帮助吗？

english: Drop the act Jones. I know you're in league with the cultists.
translation: 别装了，琼斯。我知道你和那些邪教徒是一伙的。

english: W-what? N-no I'm not, don't be silly!
translation: 什……什么？不，我没有，别傻了！

english: Listen pal, I went to your hideout, I heard them talking about you. You're fooling nobody.
translation: 听着，伙计，我去过你的藏身处，我听到他们谈论你了。你骗不了任何人。

english: You think you're so smart don't you? You might think you know what's going on but you have no idea.
translation: 你以为你很聪明，是吧？你可能觉得你知道发生了什么，但你根本一无所知。

english: I know all I need to know and when I reveal the truth you're going directly to jail.
translation: 我知道我需要知道的一切，等我揭发真相，你就直接进监狱吧。

english: Oh, you think so do you? You think that silly old fool Ceril will take YOUR word over MINE? He trusts me completely!
translation: 哦，你这么想是吗？你觉得那个愚蠢的老傻瓜塞里尔会相信你的话，而不是我的？他完全信任我！

english: This is your last warning adventurer: keep your nose out of our business.
translation: 这是你最后的警告，冒险者：别管我们的闲事。

english: I'd rather not if it's all the same to you. I overheard the cultists talking, and apparently Jones is in league with them.
translation: 如果你不介意的话，我宁愿不。我无意中听到那些邪教徒在说话，显然琼斯和他们是一伙的。

english: W-what? RIGHT! You! Come with me upstairs! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now once and for all!
translation: 什……什么？好！你！跟我上楼去！我们他娘的现在就把这事彻底解决！

english: W-what? RIGHT! You! We're going to blooming well sort this out right now once and for all!
translation: 什……什么？好！你！我们他娘的现在就把这事彻底解决！

english: Jones! This commoner says you had something to do with the theft of my armour. What do you have to say for yourself about that?
translation: 琼斯！这个平民说你和我的盔甲被盗有关。对此你有什么要说的？

english: It wasn't me m'lud. I am, as you know, a loyal servant.
translation: 不是我，大人。如您所知，我是一个忠诚的仆从。

english: Humph. Quite right too. I cannot fathom why this scoundrel would accuse you of such a crime without evidence to back up his accusations.
translation: 哼。说得没错。我真想不通，这个无赖怎么会毫无证据就指控你犯下这样的罪行。

english: Right. I have decided. I have given my word as a nobleman to reward you for your efforts in retrieving my armour.
translation: 好了。我决定了。我以贵族的名义承诺，会因为你找回盔甲的努力而奖励你。

english: but I must also compensate Jones for this terrible slander you have made against him.
translation: 但我还必须赔偿琼斯，因为你对他进行了如此恶劣的诽谤。

english: Now take it and leave you scoundrel! And don't darken my doorstep again!
translation: 拿着它滚吧，你这个无赖！别再踏进我家门一步！

english: Don't worry m'lud, this fool won't be bothering us any more.
translation: 别担心，老爷，这个蠢货不会再烦我们了。

english: Hello again adventurer. Still hanging around here eh? I'll be honest, I'm glad someone of your ability is around to assist me in case of trouble.
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。还在这儿晃悠呢？老实说，我很高兴有你这样能力的人在身边，万一出了麻烦也能帮上忙。

english: You owe me money.
translation: 你欠我钱。

english: Cretin. Did you think you could 'save the day' just by accusing me? We've been planning this for YEARS. your meddling has been nothing more than a minor inconvenience.
translation: 白痴。你以为光凭指控我就能‘拯救世界’？我们策划这件事已经好几年了。你的干涉不过是个小麻烦罢了。

english: When Lord Hazeel returns, the likes of you and the arrogant Carnilleans will be first to suffer his vengeance.
translation: 等哈兹尔领主回来时，像你这样的人和傲慢的卡尼利安家族将首先承受他的复仇。

english: Not if I can help it!
translation: 只要有我在，休想！

english: That's basically my point. You cannot help it. Now begone!
translation: 这正是我的意思。你阻止不了。现在滚吧！

english: Hello Henryeta.
translation: 你好，亨丽埃塔。

english: You! Don't think you can go accusing our trusted staff and then waltz up to me as though nothing has happened!
translation: 你！别以为你可以到处指责我们信任的职员，然后若无其事地走到我面前！

english: HA! Don't be so ridiculous! Next you'll be trying to tell me Jones murdered our old butler!
translation: 哈！别这么荒谬！接下来你是不是还要告诉我，琼斯谋杀了我们以前的管家！

english: I have no time to waste with the likes of you do-gooder.
translation: 我没时间浪费在你这种爱管闲事的人身上。

english: You again. Mark my words meddler; when Lord Hazeel returns you will be punished most severely for your interference in our schemes.
translation: 又是你。记住我的话，多管闲事的家伙；等哈兹尔大人回归，你对我们计划的干涉必将受到最严厉的惩罚。

english: Hello! How are you today?
translation: 你好！今天怎么样？

english: Hello guard.
translation: 你好，守卫。

english: Hello adventurer. I hear you accused Jones the butler of being an accomplice of that loony cult. Is that true?
translation: 你好，冒险者。我听说你指控管家琼斯是那个疯子邪教的同伙。是真的吗？

english: That's true, but nobody believes me.
translation: 是真的，但没人相信我。

english: You have my utter faith adventurer. I can't openly defy my employer, Sir Ceril, but I'd like you to know that I think you're on the right track there.
translation: 我完全相信你，冒险者。我不能公开违抗我的雇主，塞里尔爵士，但我想让你知道，我认为你的方向是对的。

english: Hey, thanks! That actually does make me feel a bit better!
translation: 嘿，谢谢！这确实让我感觉好多了！

english: You've already proven to me that you're a law-abiding citizen. Besides, I always found it suspicious that Jones would just show up here on the doorstep the very day after the old butler died in such suspicious
translation: 你已经向我证明了你是个守法的市民。而且，我一直觉得奇怪，老管家在那么可疑的情况下死去的第二天，琼斯就出现在门口。

english: circumstances. Good luck in clearing your name. You have my support.
translation: 祝你好运，洗清你的名声。我支持你。

english: Look what I've found in the cupboard!
translation: 看看我在橱柜里发现了什么！

english: I... I don't believe it! Poison! JONES!
translation: 我……我不信！毒药！琼斯！

english: You called m'lud?
translation: 您叫我吗，老爷？

english: JONES! Just WHAT is this POISON doing here???
translation: 琼斯！这毒药到底是怎么回事？！

english: P-p-poison??? yeah... uh... well, hmm... Oh, it's for Killing rats.
translation: 毒……毒药？？？是啊……呃……嗯，嗯……哦，是用来毒老鼠的。

english: Yes, that's right. Killing rats. I am but a loyal butler sir.
translation: 是的，没错。毒老鼠。我只是个忠诚的管家，先生。

english: Rats eh? Yes, fair enough. Sorry to have doubted you old boy.
translation: 老鼠，嗯？好吧，说得通。抱歉怀疑你了，老伙计。

english: Then how about this?
translation: 那这个呢？

english: Wh-what??? I've seen this amulet before... The thieves that broke in... One of them was wearing an identical amulet! Jones! I don't believe it!
translation: 什……什么？？？我以前见过这个护身符……那些闯进来的小偷……其中一个就戴着完全一样的护身符！琼斯！我真不敢相信！

english: You senile old fool... It was all too easy! I should have killed you and your pathetic family weeks ago!
translation: 你这个老糊涂……简直太容易了！我几周前就该杀了你和你可悲的家人！

english: To think we took you in and trusted you... and this is how you repay us...
translation: 想想我们收留了你，信任你……而你就是这样报答我们的……

english: GUARD!
translation: 守卫！

english: Take him away. Attempted murder and burglary.
translation: 把他带走。罪名是谋杀未遂和入室盗窃。

english: Don't think this is the last you have heard of me Ceril. You and your family will pay dearly for this. GLORY TO HAZEEL! ALL PRAISE ZAMORAK!
translation: 别以为这事就这么完了，塞里尔。你和你的家人会为此付出惨痛代价。荣耀归于哈兹尔！赞美萨莫拉克！

english: Now now. Come along quietly. There'll be no revenge where YOU'RE going - Port Sarim Jail.
translation: 好了好了。乖乖跟我走。你要去的地方可没机会报仇——沙林港监狱。

english: It looks like I am indebted to you sirrah!
translation: 看来我欠你一个人情，小子！

english: But if it weren't for you... My whole family... we could have been... I apologise for my harshness before.
translation: 但如果不是你……我全家……我们可能已经……我之前对你态度不好，我道歉。

english: the very least I can do is to reward you for your noble efforts, and to offer my sincerest apologies as a Lord and gentleman.
translation: 至少我能做的是奖励你的高尚行为，并作为一名贵族和绅士，向你致以最诚挚的歉意。

english: Thank you Lord Ceril.
translation: 谢谢您，塞里尔勋爵。

english: No, no, thank YOU! Feel free to stop by anytime adventurer!
translation: 不，不，应该谢谢你！随时欢迎你来做客，冒险者！

english: You have a mission for us adventurer. Go to the Carnilliean household and poison their meal to prove your loyalty.
translation: 冒险者，我们有个任务交给你。去卡尼尔家，在他们的饭菜里下毒，以证明你的忠诚。

english: I lost the poison you gave me...
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的毒药……

english: Useless. Take this and don't mess up this time. Lord Hazeel is depending on you.
translation: 废物。拿着这个，这次别再搞砸了。哈兹尔大人指望着你呢。

english: Leave me alone, can't you see I'm busy? We have a lot to do preparing for the imminent return of Lord Hazeel
translation: 别烦我，没看见我正忙着吗？我们有很多事要做，准备迎接哈兹尔大人即将回归。

english: Can't you see I'm busy???
translation: 你没看见我正忙着吗？？？

english: Hello. I hear tell you're after that loony cult who broke in the other night. It always gladdens me when civilians assist the law like this.
translation: 你好。我听说你在追查那晚闯进来的疯子邪教。看到市民这样协助执法，我总是很高兴。

english: Humph. You really are useless aren't you?
translation: 哼。你真是没用，对吧？

english: Yup. Guess I am.
translation: 是啊。我想是的。

english: More toys! I want MORE TOYS!
translation: 更多玩具！我要更多玩具！

english: Sorry, I don't have any.
translation: 抱歉，我没有。

english: Sweets! Gimme sweets!
translation: 糖果！给我糖果！

english: Nope, sorry, I don't have sweets either.
translation: 不，抱歉，我也没有糖果。

english: I hate you! HATE YOU! Where's my mommy?
translation: 我恨你！恨你！我妈妈呢？

english: You're that adventurer the family asked to help get those weird cultists who keep breaking in, right?
translation: 你就是那个家里请来帮忙对付那些老是闯进来的怪邪教徒的冒险者，对吧？

english: Hello there. Caught any of those weird thieves yet?
translation: 你好啊。抓到那些怪小偷了吗？

english: Nope. Afraid not.
translation: 没有。恐怕还没有。

english: Hello. Are you okay?
translation: 你好。你没事吧？

english: No, no I am very far from OK. Those hooligans slaughtered my precious Scruffy! I shall never recover! I am emotionally scarred for life!
translation: 不，不，我离没事差远了。那些流氓杀了我亲爱的斯克拉菲！我这辈子都缓不过来了！我留下了终生的心理创伤！

english: It WAS only a dog you know...
translation: 那只是一条狗而已，你知道的……

english: Hello friend. I heard about your handiwork. Quite amusing really. I'm sure Hazeel will be pleased anyway; Keep up the good work!
translation: 你好，朋友。我听说你的杰作了。真有意思。我相信哈兹尔会很高兴的；继续好好干！

english: Hello youngster.
translation: 你好，小家伙。

english: Someone killed scruffy. I liked scruffy. He never told me off.
translation: 有人杀了斯克拉菲。我喜欢斯克拉菲。他从来不说我。

english: Yeah. It's a real shame.
translation: 是啊。真可惜。

english: Oh.. the inhumanity... the cruelty.. the misery... the pain... my son is a good boy, really, but how could he give his dinner to Scruffy without having the servants test it for poison first? How? How could he be so
translation: 哦……这没人性……这残忍……这痛苦……这悲伤……我儿子其实是个好孩子，但他怎么能不先让仆人试毒就把晚餐给斯克拉菲吃呢？怎么可以？他怎么能这么

english: thoughtless and careless? He knows we are all under threat!
translation: 没脑子、这么粗心？他知道我们都受到威胁！

english: He's been with our family for twenty years... that's 140 in dog years! The poor dog... what did HE ever do to deserve such a fate???
translation: 他在我们家二十年了……按狗年算就是一百四十年！可怜的狗……他到底做了什么要遭受这样的命运？？？

english: Your DOG got poisoned???
translation: 你的狗被毒死了？？？

english: That's not right.
translation: 这不对。

english: Uh.... yeah... me too.
translation: 呃……是啊……我也是。

english: Hello. The sarge is furious with me! Apparently those loony cultists have been back somehow without me noticing! I got a right roasting earlier...
translation: 你好。中士对我大发雷霆！显然那些疯子邪教徒不知怎么又在我没注意的时候回来了！我之前被狠狠训了一顿……

english: I don't exactly know what they got up to in the house... but that's besides the point. Sir Ceril was extremely upset, and I don't blame him.
translation: 我不太清楚他们在房子里干了什么……但这不是重点。塞里尔爵士非常生气，我也不怪他。

english: Hello. Oh, are you new?
translation: 你好。哦，你是新来的？

english: Well, it's always good to have a new recruit. Soon we shall retrive Hazeels' scroll and the ritual to revive him can begin!
translation: 嗯，有新成员总是好的。很快我们就能找到哈兹尔的卷轴，复活他的仪式就可以开始了！

english: I poured the poison into the Carnillean's meal as requested. It didn't quite go to plan however.
translation: 我按要求把毒药倒进了卡尼尔家的饭菜里。不过事情并没有完全按计划进行。

english: Yes, we heard all about it from one of our sources. Hazeel has eyes everywhere! You have now proved your loyalty and will be rewarded when Hazeel is revived!
translation: 是的，我们从线人那里听说了。哈兹尔无处不在！你已经证明了自己的忠诚，等哈兹尔复活后，你会得到奖赏！

english: Ok. So what's next?
translation: 好的。那接下来呢？

english: But of course, you already knew that, as you already have The Sign Of Hazeel.
translation: 当然，你已经知道了，因为你已经有了哈兹尔之徽。

english: How does this amulet help do that then?
translation: 那这个护身符怎么帮忙呢？

english: Hazeel in his wisdom when he built this lair did so by making it inaccessible unless the flow of the sewers is controlled exactly by the sewer valves above ground.
translation: 哈兹尔以其智慧建造了这个巢穴，除非通过地面上的下水道阀门精确控制下水道的水流，否则无法进入。

english: Each sewer valve must be correctly set before the water level is such that you may enter. The secret of the correct settings is contained in these amulets which honour him.
translation: 每个下水道阀门都必须正确设置，水位才能让你进入。正确设置的秘密就包含在这些尊崇他的护身符中。

english: Starting from left to right, follow the design of the amulet to locate each sewer valve, and then turn each so as to follow the amulet design.
translation: 从左到右，按照护身符的图案找到每个下水道阀门，然后转动每个阀门，使其与护身符图案一致。

english: When you solve the sequence you may enter our hideout where our leader, Alomone, awaits you.
translation: 当你解开这个序列后，就可以进入我们的藏身处，我们的领袖阿洛蒙在那里等你。

english: Well well well... So we have a new recruit. Clivet told me of your desire to join us in our glorious task to resurrect the mighty Hazeel from his slumber.
translation: 哎呀呀……看来我们有了个新成员。克利维特告诉我，你渴望加入我们光荣的任务，将强大的哈兹尔从沉睡中唤醒。

english: To accomplish this, we require the ancient words of summoning which will restore his shattered body, so that he can bring vengeance upon his enemies.
translation: 要做到这一点，我们需要古老的召唤咒语，它将恢复他破碎的身体，这样他就能对敌人施以复仇。

english: Hazeel in his mighty cunning anticipated that he might be defeated and secured within his home somewhere a powerful magical scroll that could restore him.
translation: 哈兹尔以其强大的智慧预见到自己可能会被击败，并在自己家中的某个地方藏了一个强大的魔法卷轴，可以修复他。

english: The words to this powerful enchantment are hidden within the Carnillean mansion, right under the nose of his unsuspecting foes. We already have an agent in place there
translation: 这个强大附魔的咒语就藏在卡尼尔大宅里，就在那些毫无戒心的敌人眼皮底下。我们已经在里面安插了一个内应

english: in their Butler Jones, a faithful follower to Hazeel. His loyalty to Hazeel is beyond questioning, yet he has been unsuccessful in locating the scroll containing the spell so far.
translation: 就是他们的管家琼斯，他是哈兹尔的忠实追随者。他对哈兹尔的忠诚毋庸置疑，但到目前为止，他还没能找到那个包含咒语的卷轴。

english: Go back to the mansion, and assist us in finding this enchantment, so that together we can restore Hazeel to his true power and glory!
translation: 回到宅邸，协助我们找到这个附魔，这样我们就能一起让哈兹尔恢复他真正的力量和荣耀！

english: Hello once more adventurer. All we need is Hazeels' magical scroll to bring him forth once more to this world.
translation: 再次欢迎你，冒险者。我们只需要哈兹尔的魔法卷轴，就能让他再次降临这个世界。

english: Well hello! Until we have retrieved the scroll of Hazeel we cannot resurrect our master. You must find it and bring it to us.
translation: 你好啊！在我们取回哈兹尔的卷轴之前，我们无法复活我们的主人。你必须找到它并带给我们。

english: Hazeel has waited long enough to return! It is IMPERATIVE you find that spell!
translation: 哈兹尔已经等得够久了！你必须找到那个法术，这是当务之急！

english: Yeah yeah yeah, I'm on it, I'm ON it.
translation: 是是是，我这就去，这就去。

english: Hello again adventurer. Still hanging around here eh? Let me know if you spot any of those loony cultists sniffing around.
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。还在这儿晃悠呢？要是你看到那些疯疯癫癫的邪教徒在附近探头探脑，就告诉我一声。

english: Mommy said you're here to kill all the nasty men that keep breaking in.
translation: 妈妈说你是来杀光那些老是闯进来的坏人的。

english: I'm sorry. I am far too depressed to talk to anybody right now. Oh... poor Scruffy...
translation: 抱歉。我现在太难过了，不想跟任何人说话。哦……可怜的斯克拉菲……

english: Yeah. Poor Scruffy.
translation: 是啊。可怜的斯克拉菲。

english: Hello again friend. I see you have the mark now; You should keep it covered up.
translation: 又见面了，朋友。我看到你已经有印记了；你最好把它遮起来。

english: That? Oh, it's nothing. Just an old amulet.
translation: 这个？哦，没什么。只是个旧护身符。

english: Hello again friend. I see you decided to keep the mark of Hazeel discreetly about you.
translation: 又见面了，朋友。看来你决定把哈兹尔的印记低调地戴在身上了。

english: Mark of Hazeel? I'm sure I don't know what you mean.
translation: 哈兹尔的印记？我肯定不明白你在说什么。

english: You don't have to pretend with me, friend! Our cause is one and the same; the sooner Lord Hazeel is avenged the better for this city... and for us!
translation: 朋友，你没必要在我面前装！我们目标一致；哈兹尔大人越早复仇，对这座城市……还有对我们越好！

english: So do you have any idea where the scroll with the enchantment is?
translation: 那你知不知道那个附魔卷轴在哪儿？

english: No idea I'm afraid. I KNOW it's somewhere in this house, but for the life of me I can't find it anywhere. I've searched high and low for it!
translation: 恐怕不知道。我知道它就在这房子里，但无论如何我都找不到。我上上下下都找遍了！

english: And Sir Ceril doesn't suspect a thing?
translation: 而塞里尔爵士一点都没怀疑？

english: Ha! That silly old fool? He can't see the forest for the trees.
translation: 哈！那个愚蠢的老糊涂？他那是只见树木不见森林。

english: I'll keep on looking then...
translation: 那我继续找吧……

english: Hello Claus.
translation: 你好，克劳斯。

english: I... just CAN'T understand it! How? HOW could someone poison my delicious food without me even noticing??? I... I just don't understand!
translation: 我……就是不明白！怎么会？怎么会有人在我没注意到的情况下毒害我美味的食物？？？我……我就是不明白！

english: Oh man... I hope I don't lose my job over this... but HOW? How did they do it? And why would the villain want to kill poor Scruffy anyway? He was such a good dog...
translation: 哦天哪……我希望我不会因此丢掉工作……但是怎么会？他们是怎么做到的？而且那个恶棍为什么要杀死可怜的斯克拉菲？它可是条好狗啊……

english: Yeah. It's a real mystery, huh?
translation: 是啊。真是个谜，对吧？

english: Hello Jones.
translation: 你好，琼斯。

english: Have you recovered the scroll?
translation: 你找回卷轴了吗？

english: I have it right here.
translation: 就在我这儿。

english: Uh... yeah... about that.. I don't exactly have it right now...
translation: 呃……嗯……关于这个……我现在还没拿到……

english: Incompetent fool! The future of our entire plans relies on that scroll! You MUST find it and take it back to our hideout as soon as possible!
translation: 无能的蠢货！我们整个计划的未来都靠那个卷轴！你必须尽快找到它，带回我们的藏身处！

english: Quick, get it back to our hideout! These are glorious times indeed adventurer, when the mighty Hazeel returns things are REALLY going to change around here!
translation: 快，把它带回我们的藏身处！这真是辉煌的时刻，冒险者，当强大的哈兹尔回归时，这里的一切都将彻底改变！

english: Hello, how are you today?
translation: 你好，今天过得怎么样？

english: Fine and dandy.
translation: 好得很。

english: Why hello there.
translation: 哎呀，你好啊。

english: That's right. I hear that they had some problems with the last one.
translation: 没错。我听说他们上一个出了点问题。

english: It's an honour to be in your presence again adventurer. I hope things are well
translation: 能再次见到你真是荣幸，冒险者。希望你一切安好。

english: Hello Ceril. How's things?
translation: 你好，塞里尔。最近怎么样？

english: SIR Ceril! SIR! And I'm not sure but I think the thieves have been back in my house.
translation: 是塞里尔爵士！爵士！我不太确定，但我觉得那些小偷又回我家了。

english: Well, either I'm going crazy, or theres been an intruder in Jones' room upstairs!
translation: 嗯，要么是我疯了，要么就是有人闯进了楼上琼斯的房间！

english: Well hello again adventurer! It's good to see you again! If it wasn't for your quick thinking the treacherous Jones would have poisoned my family and me by now! We are in your debt.
translation: 哎呀，又见面了，冒险者！很高兴再次见到你！要不是你反应快，那个背信弃义的琼斯早就毒死我和我的家人了！我们欠你一个人情。

english: Oooooh... I may be wrong... but ever since I asked for your help things around here have gone from bad to worse...
translation: 哦哦哦……也许我错了……但自从我请你帮忙以来，这里的情况就每况愈下……

english: I think you'd better keep out of my way. And for the LAST time: it's SIR Ceril. SIR! It's not that hard to blooming remember!
translation: 我想你最好离我远点。最后说一次：是瑟瑞尔爵士。爵士！这他妈没那么难记吧！

english: Now take it and leave you scoundrel! And don't darken my door step again!
translation: 现在拿着它滚蛋，你这个无赖！别再踏进我家门一步！

english: That's SIR Ceril to you, you impudent scamp. Show some blooming respect! And shouldn't you be recovering my armour?
translation: 是瑟瑞尔爵士，你这个无礼的小鬼。放尊重点！你不是应该去取回我的盔甲吗？

english: Oh, heh, ok then.
translation: 哦，呵，那好吧。

english: Have you got me some toys?
translation: 你给我带玩具了吗？

english: Then I don't like you!
translation: 那我就不喜欢你了！

english: Gee. I guess I'll just have to live with that then.
translation: 唉，看来我也只能接受这个事实了。

english: Those animals... how could they do that to poor Scruffy? What kind of lowlife would do that???
translation: 那些畜生……他们怎么能对可怜的斯克拉菲做出那种事？什么样的下流胚子会干这种事？？？

english: Sorry! Can't stop to chat! You would be AMAZED at how many meals this family gets through daily!
translation: 抱歉！没空聊天！你会惊讶于这家人每天要消耗多少顿饭！

english: Well hello there adventurer! Are we fit and well?
translation: 你好啊，冒险者！你身体还好吗？

english: Get out of my kitchen scoundrel. You're NOT welcome HERE.
translation: 滚出我的厨房，无赖。这里不欢迎你。

english: Is THAT supposed to be FUNNY? OUT! Before I call the Guard!
translation: 你觉得这很好笑吗？出去！在我叫守卫之前！

english: Get over it, it was only a dog.
translation: 别难过了，不过是一条狗而已。

english: Hello adventurer. I hope you find the cult soon we have a horrible suspicion that there's been another burglary.
translation: 你好，冒险者。希望你尽快找到那个邪教，我们有种可怕的预感，觉得又发生了一起入室盗窃。

english: Yes, it is. What's worse is I have no idea how they keep doing it. It's like they do it under my very nose!
translation: 是啊。更糟的是，我完全不知道他们是怎么做到的。就好像他们是在我眼皮底下干的！

english: Have you acquired the enchanted scroll required to resurrect Hazeel yet?
translation: 你拿到复活哈兹尔所需的附魔卷轴了吗？

english: Yes, it was in the house all along. Jones can't have looked that hard for it.
translation: 拿到了，它一直就在房子里。琼斯肯定没仔细找。

english: At last! The pieces are all in place for the glorious resurrection of Lord Hazeel! Now is the starting point for a new page in history, and our chance for vengeance!
translation: 终于！所有碎片都已就位，为了哈兹尔大人的光荣复活！现在正是历史新篇章的起点，也是我们复仇的机会！

english: Quickly now! Take the scroll to Alomone so that we may begin the ritual... and when Lord Hazeel returns I promise you that you shall be well rewarded!
translation: 快！把卷轴拿给阿洛蒙，这样我们就能开始仪式了……等哈兹尔大人归来，我保证你会得到丰厚的奖赏！

english: Uh... yeah... about that... I seem to have, errm, misplayed it somewhere...
translation: 呃……嗯……关于这个……我好像，呃，把它放错地方了……

english: Incompetent cretin! Return to the Carnillean household and do not return again without it!
translation: 无能的蠢货！回到卡尼利安家去，没拿到卷轴就别回来！

english: Welcome back adventurer! Since you have brought us the scroll of Hazeel we can now perform the resurrection ceremony! Soon our master will return!
translation: 欢迎回来，冒险者！既然你给我们带来了哈兹尔的卷轴，我们现在就可以举行复活仪式了！我们的主人很快就会归来！

english: Have you brought me the scroll of restoration to complete the ritual?
translation: 你带来了完成仪式所需的复原卷轴吗？

english: Yep. Got it right here.
translation: 是的。就在我这儿。

english: FINALLY! Quickly, give it to me and I will begin the ritual!
translation: 终于！快，把它给我，我要开始仪式了！

english: Yes... YES! With the words contained within this scroll our Lord shall return to this realm and bring destruction to our enemies!
translation: 是的……是的！有了这卷轴上记载的咒语，我们的主人将重返这个位面，给我们的敌人带来毁灭！

english: Lord Hazeel... Lord Zamorak... I call upon the powers of evil... The forces of chaos... The strength of hatred...
translation: 哈兹尔大人……萨莫拉克大人……我呼唤邪恶的力量……混沌之力……仇恨之力……

english: Sentente sillaberi junque dithmento! Ia! Ia! dextrimon encanto! termando... imcando... solly enty rando... sentente! Ia! Ia! Indenti zaggarati g'thxa!
translation: 森坦特.西拉贝里.琼克.迪斯门托！伊亚！伊亚！德克斯崔蒙.恩坎托！特曼多……伊姆坎多……索利.恩蒂.兰多……森坦特！伊亚！伊亚！因登蒂.扎加拉提.格萨！

english: Dintenta! Sententa! Retenta! Q'exjta! Ia! Sottottott! Ia! Dysmenta junque fammatio svelken! Sottey! Sentey! SOLOMENT!
translation: 丁坦塔！森坦塔！瑞坦塔！克萨塔！伊亚！索托托特！伊亚！迪斯门塔.琼克.法马提奥.斯维尔肯！索泰！森泰！索罗门特！

english: My loyal followers. I have pride in you all. Never did I expect to return to this land and I see I have much to attend to.
translation: 我忠诚的追随者们。我为你们所有人感到骄傲。我从没想过能重返这片土地，看来我有很多事要处理。

english: Soon this world will cower once more at the name Hazeel, and my fury will blaze across mine enemies just as my loyal followers gain their rewards.
translation: 很快，这个世界将再次在哈兹尔的名字面前颤抖，我的怒火将烧向我的敌人，正如我忠诚的追随者将获得他们的奖赏。

english: Adventurer. I know that thy efforts were principal in my return to this plane of existence. I offer you my thanks directly.
translation: 冒险者。我知道你的努力是我重返这个位面的关键。我亲自向你表示感谢。

english: You may not be a follower of Zamorak directly but your cunning and treachery mark you as a friend to the Mahjarrat. Rest assured; I will call on your assistance again.
translation: 你可能不是萨莫拉克的直接追随者，但你的狡猾和诡计让你成为玛哈加特的朋友。放心；我会再次召唤你的帮助。

english: Weak as I am now, my strength shall return, and my followers will be greatly rewarded when my powers peak once more. Join me in my cause as my servant, and all
translation: 虽然我现在还很虚弱，但我的力量会恢复的，当我的力量再次达到顶峰时，我的追随者将得到巨大的奖赏。加入我的事业，做我的仆从，那么

english: the riches of this plane shall be yours to share, in domination over all who oppose my kind. You would be wise to pledge yourself now while you still may.
translation: 这个位面的所有财富都将与你共享，并统治所有反对我族的人。趁现在还有机会，你最好明智地宣誓效忠。

english: I serve nobody but myself.
translation: 我只效忠于我自己。

english: Your insolence shall be overlooked this time for I am in truth in your debt. Come close: I shall reward you with wealth such as you deserve.
translation: 这次我就原谅你的无礼，因为我确实欠你人情。靠近点：我会给你应得的财富作为奖赏。

english: Although your true reward will be later, when Zamorak and I, together, lay waste to this miserable planet, and you are spared as an ally to us.
translation: 不过你真正的奖赏还在后头，等我和萨莫拉克一起将这颗悲惨的星球夷为平地时，你会作为我们的盟友而幸免于难。

english: And now I must leave you loyal subjects for time is short, and I have many pressing matters to address before I may make my return. I must leave now, and head Northwards
translation: 现在我得离开你们这些忠诚的子民了，因为时间紧迫，在我能够回归之前，还有很多紧迫的事情要处理。我现在必须离开，向北进发

english: to join my fellow mahjarrat and regain my strength and powers. I shall return when I am ready to fight my enemies and much blood shall flow across these lands!
translation: 去与我的玛哈加特同胞会合，恢复我的力量和法力。等我准备好与敌人作战时，我会回来，届时这片土地将血流成河！

english: You must find it and bring it to me! Without it we cannot resurrect Hazeel and our efforts to do so will fail!
translation: 你必须找到它并带给我！没有它我们就无法复活哈兹尔，我们为此付出的努力都将白费！

english: I'm a hero. May I apply to join?
translation: 我是一个英雄。我能申请加入吗？

english: You're a hero? I've never heard of you.
translation: 你是英雄？我从没听说过你。

english: Well, you seem to meet our initial requirements, so you may now begin the tasks to earn membership in the Heroes' Guild.
translation: 嗯，你似乎符合我们的初步要求，现在可以开始执行任务以获取英雄公会的会员资格。

english: The three items required for entrance are: An Entranan Firebird feather, a Master Thieves' armband, and a cooked Lava Eel.
translation: 进入所需的三种物品是：一根恩特纳火鸟羽毛，一条盗贼臂章，和一条烹熟的熔岩鳗。

english: Any hints on getting the thieves armband?
translation: 有什么关于获取盗贼臂章的提示吗？

english: I'm sure you have the relevant contacts to find out about that.
translation: 我相信你有相关的消息来源可以查到。

english: Any hints on getting the feather?
translation: 有什么关于获取羽毛的提示吗？

english: Not really - other than Entranan firebirds tend to live on Entrana.
translation: 没什么特别的——除了恩特纳火鸟通常生活在恩特纳岛上。

english: Any hints on getting the eel?
translation: 有什么关于获取熔岩鳗的提示吗？

english: Maybe go and find someone who knows a lot about fishing?
translation: 也许去找一个非常懂钓鱼的人？

english: I'll start looking for all those things then.
translation: 那我这就开始寻找这些东西。

english: How goes thy quest adventurer?
translation: 冒险者，你的任务进展如何？

english: It's tough. I've not done it yet.
translation: 很艰难。我还没完成。

english: Remember, the items you need to enter are:
translation: 记住，你需要进入的物品是：

english: An Entranan Firebirds' feather, A Master Thieves armband, and a cooked Lava Eel.
translation: 一根恩特纳火鸟羽毛、一条盗贼大师臂章和一条烹熟的熔岩鳗。

english: How would I go about getting a Master Thief armband?
translation: 我怎样才能获得盗贼臂章？

english: Ooh... tricky stuff. Took me YEARS to get that rank.
translation: 哦……这可是个棘手的东西。我花了多年才得到那个等级。

english: Well, what some of the more aspiring thieves in our gang are working on right now is to steal some very valuable candlesticks from Scarface Pete - the pirate leader on Karamja.
translation: 嗯，我们帮派里一些更有抱负的盗贼现在正在努力的是从卡拉姆詹岛的海盗头子斯嘉菲斯.皮特那里偷一些非常值钱的烛台。

english: His security is excellent, and the target very valuable so that might be enough to get you the rank.
translation: 他的安保非常严密，目标也极其贵重，所以那个成果可能足以让你获得这个等级。

english: Go talk to our man Alfonse, the waiter in the Shrimp and Parrot.
translation: 去找我们的人阿尔方斯谈谈，他是虾与鹦鹉餐馆的服务员。

english: Use the secret word 'gherkin' to show you're one of us.
translation: 用暗号‘酸黄瓜’证明你是自己人。

english: You told me you wanted to get a Master thief's armband! Now pay attention.
translation: 你跟我说过你想要获得盗贼臂章！现在注意听。

english: Some of the more aspiring thieves in our gang are working on right nowis to steal some very valuable candlesticks from Scarface Pete - the pirate leader on Karamja.
translation: 我们帮派里一些更有抱负的盗贼现在正在努力的是从卡拉姆詹岛的海盗头子斯嘉菲斯.皮特那里偷一些非常值钱的烛台。

english: Welcome to the Shrimp and Parrot. Would you like to order, sir?
translation: 欢迎来到虾与鹦鹉餐厅。先生要点餐吗？

english: Do you sell Gherkins?
translation: 你们卖酸黄瓜吗？

english: Hmmmm Gherkins eh? Ask Charlie the cook, round the back. He may have some 'gherkins' for you!
translation: 嗯……酸黄瓜是吧？去后面找厨师查理问问。他可能有一些‘酸黄瓜’给你！

english: Hey! What are you doing back here?
translation: 嘿！你跑到后面来干什么？

english: I'm looking for a gherkin...
translation: 我在找酸黄瓜……

english: Aaaaaah... a fellow Phoenix! So, tell me compadre... what brings you to sunny Brimhaven?
translation: 啊……是凤凰会的兄弟！那么，告诉我，伙计……是什么风把你吹到阳光明媚的布尔哈文镇来的？

english: Sun, sand and the fresh sea air!
translation: 阳光、沙滩和清新的海风！

english: Well, can't say I blame you compadre. I used to be a city boy myself, but have to admit it's a lot nicer living here nowadays. Brimhaven's certainly good for it.
translation: 嗯，我不怪你，伙计。我以前也是个城市小子，但不得不承认现在住在这里舒服多了。布尔哈文镇确实适合居住。

english: I want to steal Scarface Pete's candlesticks.
translation: 我想偷斯嘉菲斯.皮特的烛台。

english: Ah yes, of course. The candlesticks. Well, I have to be honest with you compadre, we haven't made much progress in that task ourselves so far. We can however offer
translation: 啊，当然。烛台。嗯，我得跟你说实话，伙计，我们自己在那个任务上到目前为止也没取得太大进展。不过我们可以提供一点帮助。

english: a little assistance. The setting up of this restaurant was the start of things; we have a secret door out the back of here that leads through the back of Mr Olbors' garden.
translation: 开这家餐馆只是开始；我们后面有一扇秘密门，可以通到奥尔伯斯先生的花园后面。

english: Now, at the other side of Mr Olbors' garden, is an old side entrance to Scarface Pete's mansion. It seems to have been blocked off from the rest of the mansion some years ago
translation: 在奥尔伯斯先生花园的另一边，是斯嘉菲斯.皮特豪宅的一个旧侧门。似乎几年前就被封死了，我们找不到进去的路。

english: and we can't seem to find a way through. We're positive this is the key to entering the house undetected however, and I promise to let you know if we find anything there.
translation: 不过我们确信这就是潜入房子的关键，我保证如果我们有发现会通知你。

english: Mind if I check it out for myself?
translation: 我自己去查看一下介意吗？

english: Not at all! The more minds we have working on the problem, the quicker we get that loot!
translation: 一点也不！越多的人解决这个问题，我们就能越快拿到那批战利品！

english: I'm a fellow member of the Phoenix gang.
translation: 我是凤凰会的成员。

english: Just exploring...
translation: 只是看看……

english: Well get out! This kitchen isn't for exploring! It's a private establishment! It's out of bounds to customers!
translation: 那就出去！这个厨房不是给你探索的！这是私人场所！顾客止步！

english: Oi! Where do you think you're going pal?
translation: 喂！你以为你要去哪里，伙计？

english: This room isn't a lot of use on its own... Maybe I can get extra help from the inside somehow... I wonder if any of the other players have found a way in.
translation: 这个房间本身没什么用……也许我可以从内部得到额外帮助……不知道其他玩家有没有找到进去的方法。

english: I have retrieved a candlestick!
translation: 我取回了一个烛台！

english: Well, in all honesty, you didn't actually retrieve it yourself, did you? You don't qualify as a master thief unless you actually steal it yourself, you know...
translation: 嗯，说实话，你实际上并不是自己取回的吧？除非你自己亲自偷到手，否则你不符合盗贼的条件，你知道……

english: Hmmm. Not bad, not bad. Let's see it, make sure it's genuine.
translation: 嗯。不错，不错。让我看看，确保是真货。

english: So is this enough to get me a Master Thief armband?
translation: 所以这足以让我获得盗贼臂章吗？

english: I dunno...
translation: 我不知道……

english: Aww, go on then. I suppose I'm in a generous mood today.
translation: 哎呀，那就这样吧。我想我今天心情很慷慨。

english: I'm afraid I've lost my Master Thief armband.
translation: 恐怕我把我的盗贼臂章弄丢了。

english: Lucky for you I have a spare. Don't lose it again!
translation: 算你走运，我有个备用的。别再弄丢了！

english: Is there any way I can get the rank of master thief?
translation: 有没有办法让我获得盗贼的等级？

english: Master thief? Ain't we the ambitious one!
translation: 盗贼？我们可真是雄心勃勃啊！

english: Well, you're gonna have to do something pretty amazing.
translation: 嗯，你得做点非常了不起的事。

english: Anything you can suggest?
translation: 你有什么建议吗？

english: Well, some of the MOST coveted prizes in thiefdom right now are in the pirate town of Brimhaven on Karamja.
translation: 嗯，目前盗贼界最令人垂涎的一些奖品就在卡拉姆詹岛上的海盗小镇布尔哈文镇。

english: The pirate leader Scarface Pete has a pair of extremely valuable candlesticks.
translation: 海盗头子斯嘉菲斯.皮特有一对极其值钱的烛台。

english: His security is VERY good.
translation: 他的安保非常好。

english: We, of course, have gang members in a town like Brimhaven who may be able to help you.
translation: 当然，我们在布尔哈文镇这样的地方有帮派成员，他们也许能帮你。

english: Visit our hideout in the alleyway on Palm Street. To get in you will need to tell them the secret password 'four leafed clover'.
translation: 来我们在棕榈树街巷子里的藏身处吧。要进去，你需要告诉他们秘密口令'四叶草'。

english: Eh? What are you on about? Go away!
translation: 呃？你在说什么？走开！

english: Oh, you're one of the gang are you? Ok, hold up a second, I'll just let you in through here.
translation: 哦，你是帮派的人？好，等一下，我让你从这儿进去。

english: Hi. Welcome to our Brimhaven headquarters. I'm Trobert and I'm in charge here.
translation: 嗨。欢迎来到我们在布尔哈文镇的总部。我是特罗伯特，这里由我负责。

english: So can you help me get Scarface Pete's candlesticks?
translation: 那么你能帮我拿到斯嘉菲斯.皮特的烛台吗？

english: Well, we have made some progress there. We know that one of the only keys to Pete's treasure room is carried by Grip, the head guard, so we thought it might be good to get close to him somehow.
translation: 嗯，我们在那方面取得了一些进展。我们知道皮特的宝藏室仅有的几把钥匙之一由守卫长格里普携带，所以我们想也许可以想办法接近他。

english: Grip was taking on a new deputy called Hartigen, an Asgarnian Black Knight who was deserting the Black Knight Fortress and seeking new employment here on Brimhaven.
translation: 格里普正要招收一个新副手叫哈蒂根，是一个从黑骑士要塞逃跑并到布尔哈文镇来找新工作的阿斯加尼亚黑骑士。

english: We managed to waylay him on the journey here, and steal his I.D. papers. Now all we need is to find somebody willing to impersonate him and take the deputy role to get that key for us.
translation: 我们设法在途中拦截了他，偷走了他的身份证件。现在只需要找个人愿意冒充他，当上副手，为我们拿到那把钥匙。

english: I volunteer to undertake that mission!
translation: 我自愿执行那个任务！

english: Good good. Here's the I.D. papers. Take them and introduce yourself to the guards at Scarface Pete's mansion. We'll have that treasure in no time.
translation: 好好好。这是身份证件。拿着它们向斯嘉菲斯.皮特豪宅的守卫自我介绍。我们很快就能拿到那批宝藏了。
