english: Well, good luck then.
translation: 那么，祝你好运。

english: Someone will show up eventually.
translation: 总会有人出现的。

english: Fine, thanks.
translation: 好吧，谢谢。

english: I have lost Hartigen's ID paper...
translation: 我把哈蒂根的身份证件弄丢了……

english: Well that was careless of you wasn't it? Fortunately for you, he had a spare. Take this one, but please try to be more careful with this one.
translation: 你真是太粗心了，不是吗？算你走运，他还有个备用的。拿这个吧，但请尽量小心点。

english: I have lost Hartigen's ID papers...
translation: 我把哈蒂根的身份证件弄丢了……

english: Well that was careless of you, wasn't it? Fortunately for you, he had a spare set. Take this one, but please try to be more careful with it.
translation: 你真是太粗心了，不是吗？算你走运，他还有一套备用的。拿这个吧，但请尽量小心保管。

english: Good good. Well, Here's the I.D. papers, take them and introduce yourself to the guards at Scarface Pete's mansion, we'll have that treasure in no time.
translation: 好好好。那么，这是身份证件，拿着它去疤脸皮特庄园那里向守卫自我介绍，我们很快就能拿到那批宝藏了。

english: Hi. I'm Hartigen. I've come to work here.
translation: 嗨。我是哈蒂根。我来这里工作。

english: Hartigen the Black Knight? I don't think so. He doesn't dress like that.
translation: 哈蒂根那个黑骑士？我不信。他可不是这样打扮的。

english: I assume you have your I.D. papers then?
translation: 那么我想你带着身份证件吧？

english: You'd better come in then. Grip will want to talk to you.
translation: 那你最好进来。格里普要跟你谈谈。

english: Yes, of course you can. You DO work here.
translation: 是的，你当然可以。你确实在这里工作。

english: Uh... yeeeeaaaaah.... about that.... I must have left them in my other suit of armour....
translation: 呃……啊……那个……我一定是把它们落在我另一套盔甲里了……

english: Hi there. I am Hartigen. reportingfor duty as your new deputy sir!
translation: 你好。我是哈蒂根。前来报到就任您的新副手，长官！

english: Ah good, at last. You took your time getting here! Now let me see...
translation: 啊，好，终于来了。你真够慢的！让我看看……

english: I'll get your hours and duty roster sorted out in a while. Oh, and do you have your I.D. papers with you? Internal security is almost as important as external security for a guard.
translation: 我待会儿会安排你的工时和值班表。哦，你带身份证件了吗？对守卫来说，内部安保几乎和外部安保一样重要。

english: Right here sir!
translation: 就在这儿，长官！

english: Oh dear... I don't have that with me anymore..
translation: 哎呀……我不再带着它了……

english: Well that's no good! Go get them immediately, then report back for duty.
translation: 那不行！马上去拿，然后回来报到上班。

english: I have a candlestick now!
translation: 我现在有一个烛台了！

english: I'll be giving a master thieves armband to the one who retrieved that. I know it wasn't you.
translation: 我会把盗贼臂章给那个取回它的人。我知道不是你。

english: Wow.... is... it REALLY it?
translation: 哇……这……真的是它吗？

english: This really is a FINE bit of thievery.
translation: 这真是一手漂亮的盗窃。

english: Us thieves have been trying to get hold of this one for a while!
translation: 我们这些盗贼为了弄到这个已经努力了好一阵子！

english: You wanted to be ranked as a master thief didn't you? Well, I guess this just about ranks as good enough!
translation: 你想被评上盗贼等级，对吧？嗯，我想这差不多够格了！

english: Hello, I am in search of an Entranan Firebird. Can you help me?
translation: 你好，我在寻找一只恩特纳火鸟。你能帮我吗？

english: Oh ho! Another one! I don't think they exist, but you'd probably ask the head monk about it. If anyone would know, he would!
translation: 哦嚯！又是一个！我不觉得它们存在，但你大概该去问问首席僧侣。如果有人知道，那就是他了！

english: Well adventurer, I have heard that they exist on this island, but have not ever seen one myself.
translation: 嗯，冒险者，我听说过它们存在于这座岛上，但自己从未见过。

english: According to legend however, they are so hot that their merest touch can burn flesh.
translation: 但根据传说，它们极其炽热，轻轻一碰就能灼伤皮肉。

english: Apparently long ago a great hero used a pair of magical gloves, stolen from the Queen of the Ice to cool the bird down enough to catch as a pet.
translation: 显然很久以前，一位伟大的英雄用了一副从冰女王那里偷来的魔法手套，让那只鸟冷却下来，足够抓住当宠物。

english: So where would I find this 'Queen of the Ice' then?
translation: 那么我在哪里能找到这位‘冰女王’呢？

english: I know not adventurer, it was just a myth I was told as a young boy. Perhaps somewhere icy?
translation: 我不知道，冒险者，这只是我小时候听说的一个神话。也许是在某个寒冷的地方？

english: I want to find out how to catch a lava eel.
translation: 我想知道怎么抓熔岩鳗。

english: Lava eels eh? That's a tricky one that is, you'll need a lava-proof fishing line. The method for making this would be to take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.
translation: 熔岩鳗是吧？那玩意儿可不好弄，你需要一根耐熔的钓鱼线。制作方法是拿一根普通的鱼竿，然后涂上防火的污油。

english: You know... thinking about it... I may have a jar of Blamish Slime around here somewhere... Now where did I put it?
translation: 你知道吗……我想想……我这儿附近好像有一罐污油黏液……我放哪儿来着？

english: Aha! Here it is! Take this slime, mix it with some Harralander and water and you'll have the Blamish Oil you need for treating your fishing rod.
translation: 啊哈！找到了！拿着这团黏液，和一些哈拉兰德草和水混合，就能得到处理鱼竿所需的污油了。

english: You'll need a lava-proof fishing line. I'm sure I already gave you what you need for this - take an ordinary fishing rod, and then cover it with the fire-proof Blamish Oil.
translation: 你需要一根耐熔岩的钓鱼线。我确信我已经给了你所需的东西——拿一根普通的鱼竿，然后涂上防火的污油。

english: You know... I'd really rather not.
translation: 你知道吗……我真不想这么做。

english: I have a raw Lava Eel!
translation: 我有一条生熔岩鳗！

english: That's nice. I require it to be cooked however.
translation: 很好。不过我需要把它煮熟。

english: I have all the required items.
translation: 我所有需要的物品都齐了。

english: I see that you have. Well done; Now, to complete the quest, and gain entry to the Heroes' Guild in your final task all that you have to do is...
translation: 我看到你已经做到了。干得好；现在，要完成任务，并在最后一项任务中获得进入英雄公会的资格，你所要做的就是……

english: W-what? What do you mean? There's MORE???
translation: 什……什么？你什么意思？还有任务？？？

english: I'm sorry, I was just having a little fun with you. Just a little Heroes' Guild humour there. What I really meant was
translation: 抱歉，我只是跟你开个小玩笑。一点英雄公会式的幽默。我真正的意思是

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Heroes' Guild entry requirements! You will find the door now open for you! Enter, Hero! And take this reward!
translation: 恭喜！你已经完成了英雄公会的入门要求！你会发现大门已经为你敞开！进去吧，英雄！并收下这份奖励！

english: How goes thy quest?
translation: 你的任务进行得如何？

english: I am making progress, but I have not recovered the Grail yet.
translation: 我正在取得进展，但还没有找回圣杯。

english: Well, the Grail IS very elusive, it may take some perseverance.
translation: 嗯，圣杯确实非常难以捉摸，可能需要一些毅力。

english: As I said before, speak to Merlin in the workshop by the library.
translation: 就像我之前说的，去图书馆旁的工作室找梅林谈谈。

english: Hello. King Arthur has sent me on a quest for the Holy Grail. He thought you could offer some assistance.
translation: 你好。亚瑟王派我来执行寻找圣杯的任务。他认为你能提供一些帮助。

english: Ah yes... the Holy Grail...
translation: 啊，是的……圣杯……

english: That is a powerful artefact indeed. Returning it here would help Camelot a lot.
translation: 那确实是一件强大的神器。把它带回来会对卡美洛大有帮助。

english: Due to its nature the Holy Grail is likely to reside in a holy place.
translation: 由于其本质，圣杯很可能存在于一个神圣的地方。

english: I believe there is a holy island somewhere not far away... I'm not entirely sure... I spent too long inside that crystal! Anyway, go and talk to someone over there.
translation: 我相信不远处有一个神圣的岛屿……我不太确定……我在那个水晶里待得太久了！总之，去那边找个人谈谈吧。

english: I suppose you could also try speaking to Sir Galahad?
translation: 我想你也可以试着和加拉哈德爵士谈谈？

english: He returned from the quest many years after everyone else. He seems to know something about it, but he can only speak about those experiences cryptically.
translation: 他在其他人都回来很多年后才从任务中返回。他似乎知道些什么，但他只能隐晦地谈论那些经历。

english: Thank you for the advice.
translation: 谢谢你的建议。

english: Where can I find Sir Galahad?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到加拉哈德爵士？

english: Galahad now lives a life of religious contemplation. He lives somewhere west of McGrubor's Wood I think.
translation: 加拉哈德现在过着宗教冥想的生活。我想他住在麦格鲁伯森林西边的某个地方。

english: I'd like some advice on finding the Grail.
translation: 我想请教一些关于寻找圣杯的建议。

english: Sorry, I cannot help you with that.
translation: 抱歉，我无法帮你这个忙。

english: I seek the Grail of legend!
translation: 我在寻找传说中的圣杯！

english: I'm afraid I don't have any suggestions...
translation: 恐怕我没有任何建议……

english: Thanks. I'll try and find someone who does.
translation: 谢谢。我会试着找个有建议的人。

english: Good day to you!
translation: 日安！

english: I seek the Grail in the name of Camelot!
translation: 我以卡美洛之名寻找圣杯！

english: The Grail? That is truly a noble quest indeed. None but Galahad have come close.
translation: 圣杯？那确实是一个崇高的任务。除了加拉哈德，没人能接近它。

english: Galahad? Who is he?
translation: 加拉哈德？他是谁？

english: He used to be one of the Knights of the Round Table, but he mysteriously disappeared many years ago.
translation: 他曾经是圆桌骑士之一，但许多年前神秘失踪了。

english: Why would he quit being a Knight?
translation: 他为什么要放弃当骑士？

english: That is a good question.
translation: 这是个好问题。

english: I'm afraid I don't have the answer.
translation: 恐怕我没有答案。

english: Good morrow!
translation: 早安！

english: I hear you are questing for the Holy Grail?!
translation: 我听说你在寻找圣杯？！

english: That's right. Any hints?
translation: 没错。有什么提示吗？

english: Unfortunately not, Sirrah.
translation: 不幸的是，没有，先生。

english: I am seeking the Grail...
translation: 我在寻找圣杯……

english: Any suggestions on finding the Grail?
translation: 关于寻找圣杯有什么建议吗？

english: My best guess would be some sort of spell. Merlin is our magic expert. Ask him?
translation: 我最好的猜测是某种咒语。梅林是我们的魔法专家。问问他？

english: Although having said that, I believe Galahad found its location once...
translation: 不过话虽如此，我相信加拉哈德曾经找到过它的位置……

english: Really? Know where I can find him?
translation: 真的吗？知道我在哪里可以找到他吗？

english: I'm afraid not. He left here many moons ago and I know not where he went.
translation: 恐怕不知道。他很久以前就离开了这里，我不知道他去了哪里。

english: I am questing for the Holy Grail.
translation: 我在执行寻找圣杯的任务。

english: The Grail? Ha! Frankly, friend, you're not in that league.
translation: 圣杯？哈！老实说，朋友，你还没那个级别。

english: You got lucky with freeing Merlin but there's no way a puny wannabe like you is going to find the Holy Grail where so many others have failed.
translation: 你运气好解救了梅林，但像你这样弱小的冒牌货，绝不可能在那么多人都失败的地方找到圣杯。

english: Hello, I am in search of the Holy Grail.
translation: 你好，我在寻找圣杯。

english: The object of which you speak did once pass through holy Entrana. I know not where it is now however.
translation: 你所说的那个物品确实曾经过神圣的恩特纳岛。不过我现在不知道它在哪里。

english: Nor do I really care.
translation: 我也不太在乎。

english: Did you say the Grail? You are a Grail knight, yes? Well you'd better hurry. A Fisher King is in pain.
translation: 你刚才是说圣杯吗？你是圣杯骑士，对吧？那你最好快点。渔王正承受着痛苦。

english: Well I would, but I don't know where I am going!
translation: 嗯，我想去，但我不知道要去哪里！

english: Go to where the six heads face, blow the whistle and away you go!
translation: 去六个头面对的方向，吹响哨子，你就出发了！

english: What are the six heads?
translation: 什么是六个头？

english: The six stone heads have appeared just recently in the world. They all face the point of realm crossing. Find where two of the heads face,
translation: 六个石头头最近才出现在世界上。它们都面向着界域交汇点。找到其中两个头面对的方向，

english: and you should be able to pinpoint where it is.
translation: 你应该就能确定它的位置。

english: What's a Fisher King?
translation: 什么是渔王？

english: The Fisher King is the owner and slave of the Grail...
translation: 渔王是圣杯的主人和奴隶……

english: Ok, I will go searching.
translation: 好的，我会去寻找。

english: What do you mean by the whistle?
translation: 你说的哨子是什么意思？

english: You don't know about the whistles yet? The whistles are easy.
translation: 你还不知道哨子的事？哨子很容易得到。

english: You will need one to get to and from the Fisher King's realm. They reside in a haunted manor house in Misthalin, though you may not perceive them unless you carry something from the realm of the Fisher
translation: 你需要一个才能往返于渔王的领域。它们栖息在米斯林的一座闹鬼庄园里，不过除非你带着来自渔王领域的某样东西，否则你可能看不到它们。

english: King...
The point of realm crossing?
translation: 界域交汇点？

english: The realm of the Fisher King is not quite of this reality. It is of a reality very close to ours though... Where it is easiest to cross, THAT is a point of realm crossing.
translation: 渔王的界域并不完全属于这个现实。但它非常接近我们的现实……最容易穿越的地方，那就是界域交汇点。

english: Wait!
translation: 等等！

english: Hello deary.
translation: 你好啊，亲爱的。

english: I'm on a quest to find the Holy Grail!
translation: 我在执行寻找圣杯的任务！

english: Ah... the Grail... yes... that did fill me with wonder! Oh, that I could have stayed forever! The spear, the food, the people...
translation: 啊……圣杯……是的……那让我充满了惊奇！哦，我真希望能永远留在那里！那长矛，那食物，那些人……

english: The Grail castle... It's... hard to describe with words. It mostly felt like a dream!
translation: 圣杯城堡……很难用语言描述。感觉大部分都像一场梦！

english: Why did you leave?
translation: 你为什么离开？

english: Apparently the time is getting close when the world will need Arthur and his knights of the round table again.
translation: 显然，世界再次需要亚瑟王和他的圆桌骑士的时刻即将来临。

english: And that includes me.
translation: 那也包括我。

english: Leaving was tough for me, so I took this small cloth from the table as a keepsake.
translation: 离开对我来说很艰难，所以我从桌上拿了这块小布作为纪念品。

english: Why didn't you bring the Grail with you?
translation: 你为什么不把圣杯带回来？

english: ...I'm not sure. Because... it seemed to be... NEEDED in the Grail castle? Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
translation: ……我不确定。因为……它似乎……是圣杯城堡所需要的？稍等一下，你的茶准备好了。

english: So how can I find it?
translation: 那我怎么才能找到它？

english: I did not find it through looking - though admittedly I looked long and hard - eventually, it found me.
translation: 我不是通过寻找找到它的——虽然我承认我找了很久很久——最终，是它找到了我。

english: Well, I'd better be going then.
translation: 嗯，那我该走了。

english: Half a moment, your cup of tea is ready.
translation: 稍等一下，你的茶准备好了。

english: If you do come across any particularilydifficult obstacles on your quest, do not hesitate to ask my advice.
translation: 如果你在任务中遇到特别困难的障碍，尽管来请教我。

english: I know more about the realm of the Grail than many, and I have a feeling you may need to come back and speak to me anyway...
translation: 我比大多数人都更了解圣杯的界域，而且我有种感觉，你可能还需要回来找我谈谈……

english: I seek an item from the realm of the Fisher King.
translation: 我在寻找一件来自渔王界域的物品。

english: Funny you should mention that, but when I left there I took this small cloth from the table as a keepsake.
translation: 你提到这个真有趣，但我离开那里时，从桌上拿了这块小布作为纪念品。

english: Would you like a cup of tea? I'll just put the kettle on.
translation: 要来杯茶吗？我这就把水壶烧上。

english: I'm impressed! That's something I was never able to do. Half a moment; your cup of tea is ready.
translation: 真让我刮目相看！那是我一直做不到的事。稍等一下；你的茶好了。

english: If you do come across any particularily difficult obstacles on your quest, do not hesitate to ask my advice.
translation: 如果你在冒险途中遇到特别棘手的障碍，尽管来问我建议。

english: A black knight titan hmm? Haven't seen one of them about in a while...
translation: 一个黑骑士泰坦，嗯？好久没见过这种东西了……

english: You'll need a special sword to defeat it, such as excalibur. You should be able to get that from the lady of the lake ...if you haven't already.
translation: 你需要一把特殊的剑才能击败它，比如王者之剑。你应该能从湖中女士那里拿到……如果你还没拿到的话。

english: Lucky I had more than one, eh?
translation: 幸好我还有不止一把，对吧？

english: Try not to lose this one!
translation: 这次可别再弄丢了！

english: I don't suppose I could borrow that? It could come in useful on my quest.
translation: 我想我能不能借用一下？它可能对我的任务有用。

english: Okay, have at ye oh evil knight!
translation: 好吧，接招吧，邪恶的骑士！

english: Actually I think I'll run away!
translation: 其实我想我还是逃跑吧！

english: Hi! I don't get many visitors here!
translation: 嗨！我这里很少有访客！

english: How's the fishing?
translation: 钓鱼怎么样？

english: Not amazing. Not many fish can live in this gungey stuff. I remember when this was a pleasant river teeming with every sort of fish...
translation: 不怎么样。没多少鱼能活在这种黏糊糊的东西里。我记得这里曾经是一条宜人的河流，满是各种鱼……

english: Any idea how to get into the castle?
translation: 知道怎么进城堡吗？

english: Why, that's easy!
translation: 哎呀，那简单！

english: Just ring one of the bells outside.
translation: 只要按一下外面的一个铃铛就行了。

english: ...I didn't see any bells.
translation: ……我没看到什么铃铛。

english: You must be blind then. There's ALWAYS bells there when I go to the castle.
translation: 那你一定是瞎了。我去城堡的时候那里总有铃铛。

english: Yes, well, this place is a dump!
translation: 是啊，好吧，这地方真是个垃圾场！

english: This place used to be very beautiful, however, as our king grows old and weak, the land seems to be dying too.
translation: 这地方以前很美，然而，随着我们的国王年老体衰，这片土地似乎也在死去。

english: Woe is me! Our crops are all failing... how shall I feed myself this winter?
translation: 我真命苦！我们的庄稼都歉收了……这个冬天我该怎么养活自己？

english: Ah! You got inside at last! You spent all that time fumbling around outside, I thought you'd never make it here.
translation: 啊！你终于进来了！你在外面摸索了那么久，我还以为你永远到不了这里。

english: How did you know what I have been doing?
translation: 你怎么知道我在做什么？

english: Oh, I can see what is happening in my realm. I have sent clues to help you get here, such as the fisherman, and the crone.
translation: 哦，我能看到我的界域里发生的事。我派了线索来帮你到这里，比如那个渔夫和老巫婆。

english: I seek the Holy Grail.
translation: 我在寻找圣杯。

english: Ah excellent. A knight come to seek the Holy Grail. Maybe our land can be restored to its former glory.
translation: 啊，太好了。一位骑士来寻找圣杯。也许我们的土地可以恢复昔日的荣光。

english: At the moment the Grail cannot be removed from the castle. Legend has it a questing knight will one day work out how to restore our land; then he will claim the Grail as his prize.
translation: 目前圣杯无法从城堡中移走。传说有一天，一位寻求任务的骑士会想出如何恢复我们的土地；然后他将获得圣杯作为奖赏。

english: Any ideas how I can restore the land?
translation: 知道我怎么才能恢复这片土地吗？

english: None at all.
translation: 完全不知道。

english: You don't look too well.
translation: 你看起来不太好。

english: Nope, I don't feel so good either.
translation: 不，我也感觉不太好。

english: I fear my life is running short... Alas, my son and heir is not here. I am waiting for my son to return to this castle.
translation: 恐怕我的生命所剩无几了……唉，我的儿子和继承人不在。我在等我儿子回到这座城堡。

english: If you could find my son, that would be a great weight off my shoulders.
translation: 如果你能找到我儿子，我肩上的重担就能卸下了。

english: Who is your son?
translation: 你儿子是谁？

english: He is known as Percival.
translation: 他叫珀西瓦尔。

english: I believe he is a knight of the round table.
translation: 我相信他是一位圆桌骑士。

english: I shall go and see if I can find him.
translation: 我这就去看看能不能找到他。

english: Do you mind if I have a look around?
translation: 你介意我四处看看吗？

english: No, not at all. Please, be my guest.
translation: 不，完全不介意。请随意。

english: Hello, do you have a knight named Sir Percival?
translation: 你好，你们这里有一位叫珀西瓦尔爵士的骑士吗？

english: Ah yes. I remember young Percival. He rode off on a quest a couple of months ago. We are getting a bit worried, he's not back yet...
translation: 啊，是的。我记得年轻的珀西瓦尔。他几个月前出发去执行一项任务了。我们有点担心，他还没回来……

english: He was going to try and recover the golden boots of Arkaneeses.
translation: 他要去尝试找回阿卡尼西斯的黄金靴。

english: Any idea which way that would be?
translation: 知道大概是哪个方向吗？

english: Not exactly. We discovered some magic golden feathers that are said to point the way to the boots...
translation: 不太确定。我们发现了一些魔法金羽毛，据说能指引靴子的方向……

english: They certainly point somewhere.
translation: 它们确实指向某个地方。

english: Just blowing gently on them will supposedly show the way to go.
translation: 据说只要轻轻吹气，它们就会显示该走的路。

english: Free up some space and I'll give you a feather.
translation: 腾出点空间，我给你一根羽毛。

english: Wow, thank you! I could hardly breathe in there!
translation: 哇，谢谢你！我在里面都快喘不过气了！

english: How did you end up in a sack?
translation: 你是怎么被困在麻袋里的？

english: It's a little embarrassing really.
translation: 说起来有点尴尬。

english: After going on a long and challenging quest to retrieve the boots of Arkaneeses, defeating many powerful enemies on the way, I fell into a goblin trap!
translation: 在经历了一场漫长而艰巨的寻回阿卡尼西斯靴子的任务，并沿途击败了许多强大的敌人之后，我掉进了一个哥布林陷阱！

english: I've been kept as a slave here for the last 3 months!
translation: 过去三个月我一直被关在这里当奴隶！

english: A day or so ago, they decided it was a fun game to put me in this sack:then they forgot about me!
translation: 大概一两天前，他们觉得把我塞进这个麻袋是个好玩的游戏，然后就把我给忘了！

english: I'm now very hungry, and my bones feel very stiff.
translation: 我现在饿得要命，骨头也僵硬得很。

english: Come with me, I shall make you a king.
translation: 跟我来，我会让你成为国王。

english: The king of where?
translation: 哪里的国王？

english: Your father is apparently someone called the Fisher King. He is dying and wishes you to be his heir.
translation: 你父亲显然是个叫渔王的人。他快死了，希望你来继承他的王位。

english: I have been told that before.
translation: 我以前就听说过这事。

english: I have not been able to find that castle again though...
translation: 但我后来再也找不到那座城堡了……

english: Well, I do have the means to get us there - wait, let me go get the magic whistle!
translation: 嗯，我确实有办法带我们去那里——等等，让我去拿魔法哨子！

english: Well, I do have the means to get us there - a magic whistle!
translation: 嗯，我确实有办法带我们去那里——一个魔法哨子！

english: Ok, I will see you there then!
translation: 好，那我们到时候见！

english: Your father wishes to speak to you.
translation: 你父亲想和你谈谈。

english: My father? You have spoken to him recently?
translation: 我父亲？你最近和他谈过话？

english: He is dying and wishes you to be his heir.
translation: 他快死了，希望你来继承他的王位。

english: I said I will see you there then!
translation: 我说了我们到时候见！

english: A day or so ago, they decided it was a fun game to put me in this sack: then they forgot about me!
translation: 大概一天前，他们觉得把我放进这个麻袋里是个好玩的游戏，然后就把我忘了！

english: I got here and agreed to take over duties as king here, then before my eyes the most miraculous changes occured here... grass and trees were growing outside before our very eyes!
translation: 我到了这里，同意接任国王的职责，然后就在我眼前，最不可思议的变化发生了……草和树木就在我们眼前在外面生长起来！

english: I have retrieved the Grail!
translation: 我找到了圣杯！

english: Wow! Incredible! You truly are a splendid knight!
translation: 哇！太不可思议了！你真是个了不起的骑士！

english: Hmmm. I heard you freed Merlin. Either you're better than you look or you got lucky. I think the latter.
translation: 嗯。我听说你解放了梅林。要么你比看起来厉害，要么你只是运气好。我觉得是后者。

english: Oh, please find my darling! I just know something horrible has happened!
translation: 哦，请找到我的亲爱的！我就知道一定发生了什么可怕的事！

english: Hi, are you called Gunnjorn?
translation: 嗨，你叫冈乔恩吗？

english: Why, indeed I am. I own this agility course, it can be very dangerous!
translation: 嗯，我确实是。我拥有这个敏捷训练场，它可能非常危险！

english: Yeah, that's great. Anyway, I understand you have a cousin named Larrissa who gave you a key...?
translation: 是啊，那很好。总之，我听说你有个表妹叫拉里萨，她给了你一把钥匙……？

english: Yes, she did! How do you know of this? She said she probably wouldn't need it, but gave it to me for safe keeping just in case.
translation: 是的，她确实给了！你怎么知道的？她说她可能用不着，但为了以防万一，交给我保管。

english: Well, something has happened at the lighthouse, and she has been locked out. I need you to give me her key.
translation: 嗯，灯塔那边出事了，她被锁在外面了。我需要你把她的钥匙给我。

english: Well, I would give you the key, but apparently you don't have any room.
translation: 嗯，我倒是想把钥匙给你，但看来你身上没地方放了。

english: Welcome again to my obstacle course. Have fun, but remember this isn't a child's playground. People have died here.
translation: 再次欢迎来到我的障碍训练场。玩得开心，但记住这不是小孩的游乐场。有人死在这里过。

english: Hello again, Gunnjorn. I'm afraid I've lost that key you gave me.
translation: 又见面了，冈乔恩。恐怕你给我的那把钥匙我弄丢了。

english: Well, I would give you another, but apparently you don't have any room.
translation: 嗯，我倒是想再给你一把，但看来你身上没地方放了。

english: No problem. Here you go.
translation: 没问题。给你。

english: What? My cousin is the one who gave you my spare copy of the lighthouse key. Do you have memory problems, adventurer?
translation: 什么？就是我表妹把我那把灯塔备用钥匙给了你。冒险者，你记性有问题吗？

english: Um... no... I was just... Testing you. Yeah. Testing.
translation: 嗯……不……我只是……在测试你。对。测试。

english: I've got your key for you!
translation: 我拿到你的钥匙了！

english: Thank you adventurer, but I need you to fix the bridge for me. The key to the lighthouse is of little comfort while I am trapped here on this causeway!
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者，但我需要你帮我修好桥。我被困在这条堤道上，光有灯塔钥匙也没什么用！

english: I've fixed the bridge for you!
translation: 我帮你把桥修好了！

english: Oh, thank you so much!
translation: 哦，太感谢你了！

english: Please find the key to the lighthouse for me though!
translation: 不过请帮我找到灯塔的钥匙！

english: I cannot bear to think that something bad may have happened to my darling Jossik...
translation: 我不敢去想我的亲爱的乔西克可能遭遇了什么不幸……

english: Please adventurer... We are both curious as to what has happened in that lighthouse, but you need to fix the bridge for me!
translation: 拜托了，冒险者……我们都很好奇灯塔里发生了什么，但你需要先帮我修好桥！

english: Quickly, we must go inside and find out what has happened to my beloved Jossik!
translation: 快，我们必须进去看看我亲爱的乔西克到底怎么了！

english: This is terrible...
translation: 这太可怕了……

english: What can have happened here? Please, you must fix the light, we cannot let my darling Jossik take the blame for any shipwrecks!
translation: 这里到底发生了什么？拜托，你必须修好灯，我们不能让我亲爱的乔西克为任何海难背黑锅！

english: Okay, I will see what I can do.
translation: 好的，我看看我能做些什么。

english: You MUST find a way to fix the lighthouse! The ships are in terrible danger as long as the light is not working properly!
translation: 你必须想办法修好灯塔！只要灯不能正常工作，船只就处于巨大的危险之中！

english: Do you have any idea how I could do that?
translation: 你知道我该怎么做吗？

english: I'm sorry adventurer, I do not know anything about lighthouses.
translation: 抱歉，冒险者，我对灯塔一无所知。

english: I'm sure there must be some kind of user's guide around here somewhere though.
translation: 不过我肯定这附近某个地方会有使用指南之类的东西。

english: My darling Jossik knew nothing about Lighthouses when he first came here, so the council must have left him some kind of manual or something.
translation: 我亲爱的乔西克刚来这里时对灯塔也一无所知，所以议会肯定给他留了某种手册之类的东西。

english: Adventurer! You MUST do something about the broken light!
translation: 冒险者！你必须想办法处理这盏坏掉的灯！

english: It is terribly important that ships coming round this coastline do not crash here!
translation: 确保绕过这片海岸线的船只不会在这里撞毁，这非常重要！

english: Please adventurer... Do not let curiosity get the better of you! We Have to fix the lighthouse before any accidents happen!
translation: 拜托了，冒险者……别让好奇心占了上风！我们必须在任何事故发生前修好灯塔！

english: I have managed to fix the light!
translation: 我成功修好了灯！

english: Excellent work, adventurer!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！

english: Now you can devote all of your energies to finding out what has happened to my darling Jossik!
translation: 现在你可以把全部精力都放在查明我亲爱的乔西克到底发生了什么事上了！

english: Have you found any sign of my darling Jossik yet?
translation: 你找到我亲爱的乔西克的任何踪迹了吗？

english: I came out here to see if I could find some sign of him...
translation: 我出来是想看看能不能找到他的一些线索……

english: But there is nothing at all. I am so worried...
translation: 但什么都没有。我真的很担心……

english: Don't worry, I'm sure he's fine. I'll find him somehow.
translation: 别担心，我相信他没事。我会想办法找到他的。

english: I don't think I'll get that back if I put it in there.
translation: 我觉得把它放进去就拿不回来了。

english: *cough* Please... please help me... I think my leg is broken, and those creatures will be back any minute now!
translation: *咳嗽* 请……请帮帮我……我想我的腿断了，那些生物随时会回来！

english: I guess you're Jossik then... What creatures are you talking about?
translation: 我猜你就是乔西克吧……你说的生物是什么？

english: I... I do not know. I have never seen their like before!
translation: 我……我不知道。我以前从没见过像它们这样的东西！

english: I was searching for information about my uncle Silas, who vanished mysteriously from this lighthouse many months ago. I found the secret of that strange wall, and discovered that I could use it as a door, but when I
translation: 我一直在寻找关于我叔叔赛拉斯的信息，他几个月前从这个灯塔神秘失踪了。我发现了那堵奇怪墙壁的秘密，并发现我可以把它当作一扇门，但当我……

english: came down here I was attacked by...
translation: 下来这里时，我被……袭击了。

english: Well, I do not know what they are, but they are very strong! They hurt me badly enough to trap me here, and I have been fearing for my life ever since!
translation: 嗯，我不知道它们是什么，但它们非常强壮！它们把我伤得很重，把我困在这里，从那以后我一直担心自己的性命！

english: Don't worry, I'm here now. Larrissa was worried about you and asked for my help.
translation: 别担心，我来了。拉里萨很担心你，请我来帮忙。

english: I'll go back upstairs and let her know that I've found you and that you're still alive, and then we can work out some way of getting you out of here, okay?
translation: 我先回楼上告诉她我找到你了，你还活着，然后我们再想办法把你弄出去，好吗？

english: NO! No, you can't leave me now! Look! They're coming again! Do something!
translation: 不！不，你现在不能丢下我！看！它们又来了！快做点什么！

english: Okay, now that the creature's dead we can get you out of here.
translation: 好了，现在生物死了，我们可以把你弄出去了。

english: No... you do not understand...
translation: 不……你不明白……

english: That was not the creature that attacked me...
translation: 袭击我的不是那个生物……

english: That was one of its babies...
translation: 那是它的一个幼崽……

english: I found Jossik! He's in a cavern underground...
translation: 我找到乔西克了！他在一个地下洞穴里……

english: That is wonderful news! But why does he not come up out of there?
translation: 真是好消息！但他为什么不上来呢？

english: Um... well, there's a big monster down there with him stopping him leaving.
translation: 嗯……这个嘛，下面有个大怪物和他在一起，不让他离开。

english: What?!?! You MUST save him! I beseech you, please! Do something!
translation: 什么？！？！你必须救他！我恳求你，拜托！快做点什么！

english: Okay, okay, sheesh, keep your hair on...
translation: 好了好了，哎呀，别激动……

english: Okay, it's dead! Let's get out of here!
translation: 好了，它死了！我们快离开这里！

english: Yes, quickly, the mother might be dead, but it's children are not!
translation: 对，快，母亲可能死了，但它的孩子们还在！

english: Follow me upstairs, I might be able to help you with that casket you found.
translation: 跟我上楼，我或许能帮你处理你找到的那个宝箱。

english: Bring it to my library, it looks familiar somehow...
translation: 把它带到我的书房，它看起来有点眼熟……

english: Good day, wanderer.
translation: 日安，流浪者。

english: Hello to you too, adventurer.
translation: 你也好，冒险者。

english: Aghhh get that cat away from me. Quickly please.
translation: 啊——把那只猫从我身边弄走。请快点。

english: Why? What's your problem with it?
translation: 为什么？你对它有什么意见？

english: Just take it away please. Take it away. If you do, I'll tell you of the secret passageway.
translation: 拜托带走它就好。带走它。如果你这么做，我就告诉你秘密通道的事。

english: What secret passage?
translation: 什么秘密通道？

english: Get the cat away from me first and then I'll tell you.
translation: 先把猫从我身边弄走，然后我再告诉你。

english: Okay, now where is this passage?
translation: 好吧，现在这通道在哪？

english: It's by that group of rocks just to the north east, but you won't be able to enter. Well, not yet anyway...
translation: 就在东北方的那堆岩石旁，但你进不去。嗯，至少现在还不行……

english: Where does it lead to?
translation: 它通向哪里？

english: To Sophanem, the city of the dead.
translation: 通往索法尼恩城，死人之城。

english: The second city of the Menaphites, full of giant monuments to their departed.
translation: 梅纳菲人的第二座城市，到处都是为逝者建造的巨大纪念碑。

english: The place is locked down at the moment, so the passage is the only way in. Apparently, they've been hit by a set of plagues. That pathetic new High Priest of Icthlarin is probably to blame.
translation: 目前那里被封锁了，所以通道是唯一的入口。显然，他们遭受了一系列瘟疫的袭击。那个可悲的伊克哈林新任大祭司大概要负全责。

english: Interesting... Tell me about this Icthlarin.
translation: 有趣……跟我说说这个伊克哈林。

english: Oh. Well fair enough then.
translation: 哦。那好吧，这样也行。

english: So why do you say I won't be able to enter the passage?
translation: 那你为什么说我进不了通道？

english: First bring me some supplies and then I'll tell you. I'm running low and I'm about to embark on a long journey.
translation: 先给我带些补给品，然后我再告诉你。我的补给快用完了，而且我即将踏上漫长的旅途。

english: Get me a full waterskin and a tinderbox. I seem to have lost my own and these desert nights are very cold.
translation: 给我一个装满水的水袋和一个火绒盒。我好像弄丢了自己的，而且沙漠的夜晚非常寒冷。

english: Okay. I actually have those on me already.
translation: 好的。我身上其实已经有了。

english: Okay, I'll get you your supplies.
translation: 好的，我会给你拿补给品。

english: Sorry, I've got other things to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有别的事要做。

english: Fool! Only I can give you the knowledge on the secret passageway!
translation: 蠢货！只有我能告诉你秘密通道的知识！

english: Hiss
translation: 嘶嘶

english: Get that cat away from me!
translation: 把那只猫从我身边弄走！

english: You again. Do you have my supplies?
translation: 又是你。你有我的补给品吗？

english: Yes. I have them here.
translation: 有。我带来了。

english: What did you need again?
translation: 你刚才是要什么来着？

english: Bring me a full waterskin and a tinderbox.
translation: 给我带一个装满水的水袋和一个火绒盒。

english: Yuck! It smells like there's dead cats in there or something. I'm not going in.
translation: 恶！里面闻起来像有死猫还是什么的。我不进去。

english: Good... Now, look into my eyes...
translation: 好……现在，看着我的眼睛……

english: Look deeply into them...
translation: 深深地看着它们……

english: Don't blink...
translation: 别眨眼……

english: Ah, my poor head. What's going on?
translation: 啊，我可怜的脑袋。发生什么事了？

english: How did I get here? That wanderer... This is her doing!
translation: 我怎么到这里的？那个流浪者……这是她搞的鬼！

english: You foul thief, return what is mine!
translation: 你这个卑鄙的盗贼，把我的东西还回来！

english: You heard me! Restore what you have stolen from my tomb!
translation: 你听到了！把你从我坟墓偷走的东西归还！

english: Spawn of evil!
translation: 邪恶的幼体！

english: Organ snatcher!
translation: 器官窃贼！

english: Evil doer!
translation: 作恶者！

english: Grave defiler!
translation: 坟墓亵渎者！

english: You pathetic excuse for a thief!
translation: 你这个差劲的盗贼！

english: You worm! May the Devourer take your soul!
translation: 你这个蠕虫！愿吞噬者带走你的灵魂！

english: Grave robber!
translation: 盗墓者！

english: Thank you adventurer, you have given my soul some respite, I will cease to haunt you and the plague creatures will no longer seek you out.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者，你让我的灵魂得到了安宁。我将不再纠缠你，瘟疫生物也不会再找你的麻烦。

english: You foul thief, return what is mine.
translation: 你这该死的盗贼，把我的东西还回来。

english: You heard me, restore what you have stolen from my tomb!
translation: 你听到了，把我坟墓里偷走的东西还回来！

english: Spawn of evil.
translation: 邪恶的幼体。

english: Organ snatcher.
translation: 器官窃贼。

english: Thief.
translation: 盗贼。

english: Return what is mine.
translation: 把我的东西还回来。

english: Evil doer.
translation: 作恶者。

english: Grave defiler.
translation: 坟墓亵渎者。

english: You pathetic excuse for a thief.
translation: 你这个差劲的盗贼。

english: You worm! May the devourer take your soul.
translation: 你这蠕虫！愿吞噬者带走你的灵魂。

english: Grave robber.
translation: 盗墓者。

english: Give me my guts back, thief.
translation: 把我的肠子还给我，盗贼。

english: I will not speak with a defiler of the dead. Be gone!
translation: 我不会和死者的亵渎者说话。走开！

english: Get away! You're a thief and a desecrator of the dead.
translation: 走开！你是个盗贼和死者的亵渎者。

english: You heard me! Clear off!
translation: 你听到了！滚开！

english: Clear off! I'll have nothing to do with you!
translation: 滚开！我跟你不会有任何关系！

english: Go!
translation: 走！

english: Get away from me you filthy grave robber.
translation: 离我远点，你这个肮脏的盗墓者。

english: Clear off you evil body snatcher! You won't get any of my wares.
translation: 滚开，你这个邪恶的尸体窃取者！你别想得到我的任何商品。

english: What business do you have with a servant of Icthlarin?
translation: 你与伊克哈林的仆从有何来往？

english: I need some help figuring out what's going on.
translation: 我需要一些帮助来弄清楚发生了什么。

english: I will not aid a defiler of the dead. Be gone!
translation: 我不会帮助死者的亵渎者。走开！

english: Hello. Can I go through this gate?
translation: 你好。我可以通过这扇门吗？

english: No. Nobody may enter or leave Sophanem for any reason due to the quarantine. Move along.
translation: 不行。由于隔离，任何人都不得以任何理由进出索法尼恩城。走吧。

english: Sorry, but Sophanem is under quarantine. No one may leave or enter.
translation: 抱歉，索法尼恩城正在隔离中。任何人不得离开或进入。

english: But I'm not infected with anything!
translation: 但我没有感染任何东西！

english: I'm afraid my orders are clear.
translation: 恐怕我的命令很清楚。

english: You! I will have no dealings with those who plunder the houses of the dead.
translation: 你！我不会与那些掠夺死者居所的人有任何瓜葛。

english: Get thee gone from my presence!
translation: 从我面前消失！

english: Excuse me. I need help.
translation: 打扰一下。我需要帮助。

english: Yes, your companion tells me that you are in a spot of bother.
translation: 是的，你的同伴告诉我你遇到了一点麻烦。

english: What companion? Oh, you mean my pet cat?
translation: 什么同伴？哦，你是指我的宠物猫？

english: Do you have any idea what happened to me? One moment I was talking to a wanderer in the desert, the next I was here. I also have a cracking headache.
translation: 你知道我发生了什么事吗？前一秒我还在沙漠里和一个流浪者说话，下一秒我就到了这里。而且我头痛欲裂。

english: A wanderer?
translation: 一个流浪者？

english: Yes. She had red hair, and weird red eyes as well.
translation: 是的。她有一头红发，还有一双诡异的红眼睛。

english: Interesting, very interesting. I'm afraid I do not know what happened to you, but it sounds like quite a bit occurred between you meeting that wanderer and now.
translation: 有趣，非常有趣。恐怕我不知道你发生了什么，但听起来你遇见那个流浪者和现在之间发生了很多事。

english: But I can't remember any of it.
translation: 但我一点都不记得了。

english: Then I suggest you find something to remind you. I find that important objects and locations can trigger memories, no matter how repressed they are.
translation: 那我建议你找些东西来提醒自己。我发现重要的物品和地点可以触发记忆，无论它们被压抑得多深。

english: We've already had this conversation, have we not? You're in a spot of bother, but you can't remember what happened to you.
translation: 我们已经谈过这个了，不是吗？你遇到了一点麻烦，但你不记得发生了什么。

english: Perhaps you should try to find something to remind you again. I find that important objects and locations can trigger memories, no matter how repressed they are.
translation: 也许你应该再试着找些东西来提醒自己。我发现重要的物品和地点可以触发记忆，无论它们被压抑得多深。

english: I must go to the heart of the pyramid... The mistress commands it...
translation: 我必须去到金字塔的中心……女主人命令我……

english: I must get to the heard of the pyramid...
translation: 我必须去到金字塔的中心……

english: I remember! That wanderer, she hypnotised me!
translation: 我想起来了！那个流浪者，她催眠了我！

english: But... I can't remember why. I needed to get... something. This is so confusing...
translation: 但是……我不记得为什么。我需要去拿……某样东西。这太令人困惑了……

english: Maybe someone around here can tell me what on Gielinor is going on.
translation: 也许附近有人能告诉我这基利诺尔到底发生了什么事。

english: Drat! It's locked.
translation: 该死！锁住了。

english: I managed to regain some of my memories.
translation: 我设法恢复了一些记忆。

english: Yes, your cat tells me you're in a spot of bother. Something to do with grave robbing, tisk tisk. So unbecoming of a guardian of cats.
translation: 是的，你的猫告诉我你有点麻烦。跟盗墓有关，啧啧啧。真不像一个猫咪守护者的作为。

english: Yes, your cat told me already. Something to do with grave robbing, tisk tisk. So unbecoming of a guardian of cats.
translation: 是的，你的猫已经告诉我了。跟盗墓有关，啧啧啧。真不像一个猫咪守护者的作为。

english: Can you help me? Please?
translation: 你能帮我吗？求你了？

english: Well, I have to say I enjoy a laugh at someone's expense now and again... so let's have a bit of fun.
translation: 嗯，我得说我有时候喜欢拿别人开开心……所以我们来玩点有趣的吧。

english: I don't like the sound of this.
translation: 我不喜欢这话听起来的感觉。

english: I'll help you if you can solve a simple puzzle of mine, but...
translation: 如果你能解开我的一个简单谜题，我就帮你，但是……

english: There's always a 'but', isn't there?
translation: 总有个‘但是’，是吧？

english: ... but if you answer incorrectly, I get to keep your cat.
translation: ……但如果你回答错误，我就留下你的猫。

english: A husband and wife have six sons and each son has one sister. How many people are in the family?
translation: 一对夫妻有六个儿子，每个儿子都有一个妹妹。这个家庭有多少人？

english: Totally positive.
translation: 完全正确。

english: I think your master has proven that [he/she] is too foolish to look after you. Come with me.
translation: 我认为你的主人已经证明[he/she]太愚蠢了，无法照顾你。跟我来。

english: Oh, come on! You can't take my cat. I've spent so long training and looking after it!
translation: 哦，拜托！你不能带走我的猫。我花了那么长时间训练和照顾它！

english: Well, you should have thought of that before you risked it for some advice from a crazy old Sphinx.
translation: 嗯，你在冒险向一个疯狂的老斯芬克斯求取建议之前就该想到这一点。

english: Could you at least help me now?
translation: 你至少现在能帮我吗？

english: What was it you needed help with? Oh yes, I remember now. You're a grave robber.
translation: 你需要什么帮助来着？哦，对了，我想起来了。你是个盗墓者。

english: I don't know. I don't want to risk my cat.
translation: 我不知道。我不想拿我的猫冒险。

english: How disappointing. Still, nothing ventured, nothing gained. Goodbye.
translation: 真令人失望。不过，不入虎穴焉得虎子。再见。

english: Well answered, human. I guess you get to keep your cat.
translation: 回答得好，人类。我想你可以留下你的猫了。

english: Now, will you help me?
translation: 现在，你会帮我了吗？

english: With your grave robbing problem?
translation: 为了解决你的盗墓问题？

english: I don't want to risk my cat.
translation: 我可不想拿我的猫冒险。

english: I didn't rob anybody's grave!
translation: 我没有盗过任何人的墓！

english: Too true, you didn't rob just anybody's grave. You managed to rob the grave of Klenter, the recently deceased High Priest of Icthlarin. Do you know what that means?
translation: 说得太对了，你盗的不是随便什么人的墓。你成功盗取了克伦特的墓，他是最近去世的伊克哈林大祭司。你知道这意味着什么吗？

english: Icthlarin is the Menaphite god of the dead. By desecrating the tomb of one of his priests, you've made an enemy out of every person in this city.
translation: 伊克哈林是梅奈菲特的死神。你亵渎了他一位祭司的墓，就等于跟这座城市里每一个人为敌。

english: But I didn't desecrate any tomb! There's no proof!
translation: 但我没有亵渎任何坟墓！没有证据！

english: Really? Because if I'm not mistaken, that's Klenter's shade right over there. He definitely doesn't seem happy with you. There's also the burial jar in your possession. How do you explain that?
translation: 是吗？如果我没看错，那边就是克伦特的阴魂。他看起来很不爽你。而且你手里还有个骨灰罐。这你怎么解释？

english: How did you know about the burial jar?
translation: 你怎么知道骨灰罐的事？

english: I can smell the rotting organs from here.
translation: 我在这儿就能闻到腐烂的内脏味。

english: Look, I don't know exactly what happened. All I know is that wanderer hypnotised me and had me steal something from this pyramid.
translation: 听着，我也不完全清楚发生了什么。我只知道那个流浪者催眠了我，让我从这个金字塔里偷了东西。

english: The burial jar?
translation: 那个骨灰罐？

english: I... I guess so. It's all still very unclear.
translation: 我……我想是吧。一切都还很模糊。

english: Interesting. I'm afraid I can't help you. I have my own concerns without involving myself with petty human affairs.
translation: 有意思。恐怕我帮不了你。我自有操心的事，不想卷入人类那些琐事。

english: However, I suggest you seek out the new High Priest of Icthlarin to the south east. He might be able to assist you. Of course, you'll need to convince him to talk to you first.
translation: 不过，我建议你去找东南边那位伊克哈林的新任大祭司。他也许能帮你。当然，你得先说服他跟你说话。

english: Here, I have a token that he will know is from me. Take that to him, and I'm sure he will speak with you.
translation: 给你，我有一个代币，他看到就知道是我给的。拿给他，我相信他会跟你谈谈的。

english: I'll go speak with the High Priest.
translation: 我去跟大祭司谈谈。

english: But you stole my last one!
translation: 但你偷了我上一个代币！

english: Well, you would be well advised to get another.
translation: 那你最好再弄一个来。

english: I lost that token you gave me. Could I have another please?
translation: 你给我的那个代币弄丢了。能再给我一个吗？

english: Ah, you humans.
translation: 唉，你们这些人类啊。

english: I am an agent of neither good nor evil. I am unconcerned with the plight of mankind and their petty wars and beliefs.
translation: 我既非善也非恶。我不关心人类的困境以及他们那些无聊的战争和信仰。

english: Well, now that you've told me what you're not, can you perhaps tell me what you are?
translation: 好吧，既然你告诉了我你不是什么，能不能告诉我你是什么？

english: I am the guardian of feline kind.
translation: 我是猫族的守护者。

english: Why would they need a guardian?
translation: 它们为什么需要守护者？

english: Cats play a significant role in the religion of this area, particularly when it comes to guarding the dead from the Devourer.
translation: 猫在这一带的宗教中扮演重要角色，尤其是在守护死者免受吞噬者侵害方面。

english: The Devourer?
translation: 吞噬者？

english: She's the very incarnation of destruction.
translation: 她就是毁灭的化身。

english: What understanding do you have of the Menaphite gods?
translation: 你对梅奈菲特的诸神了解多少？

english: Little to none.
translation: 几乎不了解。

english: Well the Menaphite Pantheon is made up of four main deities.
translation: 梅奈菲特神系由四位主要神祇组成。

english: The two main gods of the pantheon are Tumeken, the god of light, and Elidinis, the goddess of fertility.
translation: 神系的主神是光明之神图梅肯和丰饶女神艾利迪尼斯。

english: Tumeken and Elidinis also have two children. Icthlarin is one, and the Devourer is the other.
translation: 图梅肯和艾利迪尼斯还有两个孩子。一个是伊克哈林，另一个就是吞噬者。

english: They named her the Devourer? Not great at parenting, were they?
translation: 他们给她起名叫吞噬者？当父母的不太合格吧？

english: She was not always called such. She is known by her deeds now, rather than her name.
translation: 她并非一直被称为吞噬者。现在人们用她的所作所为来称呼她，而不是本名。

english: So if the Devourer is the bad sibling, does that make Icthlarin the good one?
translation: 那么如果吞噬者是坏的那个，伊克哈林就是好的那个吗？

english: That is the common belief, but things are rarely that simple. In some ways, neither of them are good or bad.
translation: 通常人们这么认为，但事情很少这么简单。从某些方面来说，他们俩都不算好也不算坏。

english: Icthlarin is the god of the dead. He takes care of the passing of souls to their next life. The Devourer is the goddess of destruction, and that is what she craves.
translation: 伊克哈林是死神，负责把灵魂引领到下一世。吞噬者是毁灭女神，她渴望的就是毁灭。

english: I thought you said she wasn't evil?
translation: 你不是说她不是邪恶的吗？

english: That's not quite what I said. Still, is destruction enough to make one evil? Fire destroys, but is that evil?
translation: 我并不是那个意思。不过，毁灭就足以构成邪恶吗？火会毁灭，但那算邪恶吗？

english: Um... no, but it also creates heat.
translation: 呃……不算，但它也产生热量。

english: We could have an overlong theological debate now, but let's instead get to my point. Destruction has a place, so maybe the Devourer does as well. However, she has taken it too far.
translation: 我们现在可以展开一场冗长的神学辩论，但让我直接说重点吧。毁灭有其存在的意义，所以也许吞噬者也有。但她做得太过分了。

english: The Devourer wishes to destroy every soul in existence, living or dead. As you can imagine, this has brought her into conflict with Icthlarin.
translation: 吞噬者想要毁灭所有存在的灵魂，不论生者还是死者。可想而知，这让她与伊克哈林起了冲突。

english: Ah, I see where this is going. The cats are used to protect the dead from the Devourer, like you said earlier. But who protects the cats?
translation: 啊，我明白你的意思了。就像你刚才说的，猫被用来保护死者不受吞噬者侵害。那谁来保护猫呢？

english: Well anticipated. The Devourer is terrified of cats for reasons I will not explain. However, her followers, although few in number, are not. I ensure the survival of cats. For this service, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
translation: 你猜得不错。吞噬者非常害怕猫，原因我不解释。不过，她的信徒虽然人数不多，却不怕猫。我确保猫的生存。作为回报，伊克哈林赐予我永生。

english: So, then, you are a follower of Icthlarin?
translation: 那么，你是伊克哈林的信徒？

english: Nothing of the sort. As I've said before, I have no interest in humans and their gods. I look after my kind. For that, Icthlarin looks after me.
translation: 才不是。我之前说过，我对人类和他们的神没兴趣。我照顾我的同类，为此，伊克哈林照顾我。

english: This is all very interesting, but I've got to get going.
translation: 这些都很有意思，但我得走了。

english: What's going on in this city?
translation: 这座城市发生了什么？

english: I thought that would be pretty obvious.
translation: 我以为这很明显。

english: Well, I could benefit from your point of view. You seem the independent type.
translation: 好吧，听听你的看法对我有好处。你看起来是那种独立自主的人。

english: Flattery, my adventurer, will get you everywhere. But to answer your question, Sophanem has been struck with plagues.
translation: 奉承话，我的冒险者，能让你畅通无阻。不过回答你的问题，索法尼恩城遭到了瘟疫的袭击。

english: More than one?
translation: 不止一种？

english: Quite a number. There's a plague of frogs to the west. In the east, you can also find locusts.
translation: 有好几种。西边有青蛙灾，东边还有蝗虫灾。

english: The cows have only been producing sour milk since the outbreak, and the residents have been struck down by a rash of spots.
translation: 自从瘟疫爆发后，奶牛产的奶都是酸的，居民们也长满了斑点疹。

english: The residents? There are a lot of living people here for a city of the dead.
translation: 居民？死人之城里居然有这么多活人。

english: Sophanem is called the city of the dead because the dead are brought here. Death plays a rather large role in the beliefs of the people and, as a result, the business.
translation: 索法尼恩城之所以被称为死人之城，是因为死者被运到这里。死亡在人们的信仰中占很大比重，因此也影响了这里的生意。

english: What do you want, cursed one?
translation: 你想干什么，被诅咒的人？

english: The Sphinx told me to find the High Priest of Icthlarin.
translation: 斯芬克斯让我来找伊克哈林的大祭司。

english: A likely story. She would never reduce herself to talk to one as lowly as you, never mind help you!
translation: 编得倒像回事。她绝不会自降身份跟你这种低贱的人说话，更别说帮你了！

english: Wait! The Sphinx told me that I should talk to you.
translation: 等等！斯芬克斯告诉我应该跟你谈谈。

english: The Sphinx? Is it possible? That contrary old cat has never done anything to help us. Prove it!
translation: 斯芬克斯？怎么可能？那只别扭的老猫从来没帮过我们。证明给我看！

english: She gave me a token to show you, but I lost it.
translation: 她给了我一个代币给你看，但我弄丢了。

english: Well then stop wasting my time! Can't you see I'm trying to put a stop to these plagues?
translation: 那就别浪费我的时间！你看不到我正在试图阻止这些瘟疫吗？

english: Well this is... unexpected...
translation: 这可真是……没想到……

english: So what do you want from me, thief?
translation: 那你想要我怎么样，盗贼？

english: I appreciate it doesn't look great right now, but I'm not actually a bad person.
translation: 我知道现在看起来不太好，但我其实不是坏人。

english: Well you could have fooled me! Good people don't rob from the dead!
translation: 你倒是骗到我了！好人不会盗死人的东西！

english: It wasn't me! Well... it was, I guess. I didn't do it on purpose though. I was hypnotised!
translation: 不是我干的！好吧……大概算是我。但我不是故意的，我被催眠了！

english: Hypnotised?
translation: 被催眠了？

english: Yes! There was this wanderer! She had me break into that pyramid to steal... a burial jar... I think. It's all still a bit confusing.
translation: 对！有一个流浪者！她让我闯进那座金字塔偷……一个骨灰罐……我想是的。一切都还有点混乱。

english: This is all a disaster! The plagues were bad enough, but now we've got hypnotised adventurers plundering tombs! I've only just started this job as well!
translation: 全乱套了！瘟疫已经够糟了，现在还有被催眠的冒险者盗墓！我才刚上任啊！

english: You do seem to be going through a rough patch. Do you know what caused the plagues?
translation: 你看起来确实处境艰难。你知道瘟疫是什么引起的吗？

english: We fear they are a punishment sent by the gods. Perhaps we have displeased Icthlarin in some way. Maybe I am to blame. All this only started after I became High Priest.
translation: 我们担心这是神降下的惩罚。也许我们在某方面惹怒了伊克哈林。或许是我的错。这一切都是在我成为大祭司后才开始的。

english: Well I'm not sure if I can help with your plagues, but I need to fix whatever mess I caused in that pyramid. Can you help me?
translation: 我不确定能不能帮你解决瘟疫，但我得收拾我在那座金字塔里惹下的烂摊子。你能帮我吗？

english: Oh, er... I suppose the burial jar you took must be returned as soon as possible. That will allow my predecessor to rest once more.
translation: 哦，呃……我想你拿走的那个骨灰罐必须尽快还回去。这样我的前任才能安息。

english: I can do that. Do you have any advice for me when it comes to the pyramid?
translation: 我能做到。关于那座金字塔，你有什么建议吗？

english: I don't think so... No wait! There is something important.
translation: 我想没有……等等！有件重要的事。

english: As with many of our tombs, the pyramid has magical seals to protect it from the Devourer, the goddess of destruction. The fact that you were able to get in before means that you must have a cat.
translation: 和我们的许多陵墓一样，金字塔有魔法封印来保护它免受毁灭女神吞噬者的侵害。你之前能进去，说明你一定有只猫。

english: Well... yes. But how did you know that?
translation: 呃……对。但你怎么知道的？

english: Cats act as guardians against the Devourer. I'm surprised the Sphinx didn't tell you this. As such, only a cat can open the pyramid door.
translation: 猫是抵御吞噬者的守护者。我很惊讶斯芬克斯没告诉你这个。因此，只有猫才能打开金字塔的门。

english: I see. I guess that makes sense.
translation: 明白了。我想这说得通。

english: One of my priests found this lying outside the pyramid. Please try to be more respectful of our dead.
translation: 我的一个祭司在金字塔外面发现了这个。请对我们的死者多些尊重。

english: Oops. I'll make sure I look after it this time. Sorry.
translation: 哎呀。这次我会保管好的。抱歉。

english: Have you managed to return the jar yet?
translation: 你把骨灰罐还回去了吗？

english: Please hurry. The people are beginning to... well...
translation: 请快一点。人们开始……呃……

english: What? Question your sanity?
translation: 什么？怀疑你疯了？

english: No, just my authority. Don't forget that to enter the pyramid, you'll need a cat.
translation: 不，只是怀疑我的权威。别忘了，要进入金字塔，你需要一只猫。

english: Why is it so important that the jar be returned?
translation: 为什么把骨灰罐还回去这么重要？

english: Well those jars are a key part of our burial practices. To remove one is to directly insult not just Icthlarin, but all those that have passed on to the next life.
translation: 这些罐子是我们安葬仪式的重要部分。拿走一个不仅直接侮辱了伊克哈林，也侮辱了所有已逝的人。

english: Not to mention, it wasn't just any jar you took. You stole a jar from the tomb of our former High Priest! Why do you think his ghost is now wandering the city once more?
translation: 更何况，你拿走的可不是普通罐子。你偷了我们前任大祭司墓里的罐子！不然你以为他的幽灵为什么又在城里游荡了？

english: But what will happen if I don't return the jar?
translation: 但如果我不还回去会怎么样？

english: Have you not noticed the plagues already filling our city? How long before Klenter calls upon Icthlarin to send a few more?
translation: 你没看到瘟疫已经蔓延全城了吗？克伦特还要多久才会召唤伊克哈林再降下几场瘟疫？

english: For all we know, the plagues we already have could be punishment for your grave robbing!
translation: 据我们所知，我们已经遭受的瘟疫可能就是对你盗墓行为的惩罚！

english: Hey, don't go blaming me for that. Those plagues were here before I even met that wanderer!
translation: 嘿，别把这事怪到我头上。那些瘟疫在我遇到那个流浪者之前就有了！

english: Perhaps Icthlarin foresaw what would happen and sent the plagues as a pre-emptive punishment?
translation: 也许伊克哈林预见到了会发生的事，所以提前降下瘟疫作为惩罚？

english: You really think he'd do that?
translation: 你真觉得他会这么做？

english: I don't know... Icthlarin is a patient and forgiving god. It does not make sense to me that he would do this to us.
translation: 我不知道……伊克哈林是位耐心且宽容的神。我不觉得他会这样对我们。

english: Maybe he's not the one responsible.
translation: 也许不是他的责任。

english: Perhaps. Either way, that jar needs to be returned.
translation: 也许吧。不管怎样，那个罐子必须还回去。

english: Can you tell me more about the plagues.
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于瘟疫的事吗？

english: They started a few days ago. We have locusts in the east of the city and frogs in the west. The cows have started to produce sour milk, and all of us have become infected with some sort of pox.
translation: 它们是几天前开始的。城东有蝗虫，城西有青蛙。奶牛开始产酸奶，我们所有人都感染了某种痘症。

english: Once it became clear how bad it was, Menaphos, our neighbouring city, closed their gates to us and everyone else. We closed our own gates soon after.
translation: 当情况变得如此糟糕时，我们的邻城梅纳菲斯关闭了通往我们和其他人的大门。我们很快也关闭了自己的大门。

english: That can't have been an easy choice to make.
translation: 那一定不是一个容易做出的选择。

english: I didn't want to, but the other priests insisted. We had to stop the plagues from spreading. It seems that our choice was the right one. So far, the plagues have remained contained, but at a great cost.
translation: 我不想这么做，但其他祭司坚持。我们必须阻止瘟疫蔓延。看来我们的选择是正确的。到目前为止，瘟疫被控制住了，但代价巨大。

english: Many of our citizens are trapped outside the city. Some are stuck in Menaphos, with more in other parts of the desert.
translation: 我们许多市民被困在城外。有些被困在梅纳菲斯，更多的在沙漠的其他地方。

english: However, that may well be for the best. Without trade from other settlements, we've been struggling to even feed the few of us left in the city.
translation: 不过，这也许是最好的结果。没有其他定居点的贸易，我们连城里剩下的少数人都难以养活。

english: How much longer do you think you can last?
translation: 你觉得你们还能撑多久？

english: Not long. We need to find a way to stop the plagues soon.
translation: 不久了。我们需要尽快找到阻止瘟疫的方法。

english: Can you tell me more about Icthlarin.
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于伊克哈林的事吗？

english: Icthlarin is the son of Tumeken and Elidinis and brother to the Devourer. He is the Menaphite god of the dead. He is responsible for ensuring the safe passage of all souls from this life to the next.
translation: 伊克哈林是图梅肯和艾莉迪尼斯的儿子，吞噬者的兄弟。他是梅纳菲斯的死神。他负责确保所有灵魂从此生安全过渡到来世。

english: Here in Sophanem, we support Icthlarin in his role by making sure the dead are suitably prepared for their journey.
translation: 在索法尼恩城，我们通过确保死者为他们的旅程做好适当准备来支持伊克哈林的职责。

english: So is Icthlarin only responsible for those that die in the desert?
translation: 那么伊克哈林只负责在沙漠中死去的人吗？

english: No. While Icthlarin is only worshipped here, his responsibilities stretch across all of Gielinor. He cares not for an individual's beliefs. All who pass on, enter his care.
translation: 不。虽然伊克哈林只在这里被崇拜，但他的职责遍及整个吉莱诺。他不在乎个人的信仰。所有逝去的人都进入他的照料。

english: I imagine there are plenty of people out there who have a different take on things.
translation: 我想外面有很多人对事情有不同的看法。

english: Which they are welcome to. It does not change the facts.
translation: 他们可以这么想。但这不会改变事实。

english: You seem very sure in these 'facts'.
translation: 你似乎对这些'事实'非常确信。

english: While most of the gods, Tumeken and Elidinis included, may be long gone from Gielinor, Icthlarin remains. His important role in caring for the dead means that he is still able to interact with us.
translation: 虽然大多数神祇，包括图梅肯和艾莉迪尼斯，可能早已离开吉莱诺，但伊克哈林仍然存在。他在照料死者方面的重要角色意味着他仍然能够与我们互动。

english: So you've met him?
translation: 所以你见过他？

english: Well... no. While he is able to walk among us if he desires, he chooses not to so as to respect our way of life. Not to mention, his role requires his constant attention.
translation: 嗯……没有。虽然他如果愿意可以行走在我们中间，但他选择不这样做，以尊重我们的生活方式。更不用说，他的职责需要他持续关注。

english: Can you tell me more about the Devourer.
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于吞噬者的事吗？

english: Long ago, back when Tumeken and Elidinis still walked these lands, they had two children. Icthlarin, god of the dead, was one. The other was Amascut, the goddess of rebirth.
translation: 很久以前，当图梅肯和艾莉迪尼斯还行走在这片土地上时，他们有两个孩子。死神伊克哈林是其中之一。另一个是阿玛斯库特，重生女神。

english: For a time, Icthlarin and Amascut worked together in harmony. Icthlarin would ensure most souls are safely guided to the next life, while Amascut would select a small number to be reborn.
translation: 有一段时间，伊克哈林和阿玛斯库特和谐地合作。伊克哈林确保大多数灵魂被安全引导到来世，而阿玛斯库特则选择少数灵魂重生。

english: But something happened?
translation: 但发生了什么事？

english: Yes. During a great war over these lands, Amascut became corrupted. She was warped into the Devourer, becoming the goddess of destruction.
translation: 是的。在这片土地上的大战期间，阿玛斯库特被腐化了。她扭曲成了吞噬者，成为毁灭女神。

english: Since then, her only goal has been to devour every soul in existence, both living and dead.
translation: 从那时起，她唯一的目标就是吞噬所有存在的灵魂，无论是生者还是死者。

english: The Sphinx told me something similar, but her interpretation was a bit different.
translation: 斯芬克斯告诉过我类似的事情，但她的解释有点不同。

english: We here have a lot of respect for the Sphinx. However, you should be careful of her words. She does not know the gods like we priests do.
translation: 我们这里非常尊重斯芬克斯。不过，你应该小心她的话。她不像我们祭司那样了解众神。

english: So is the Devourer still around?
translation: 那么吞噬者还在吗？

english: Unfortunately so. Most gods have long since left this world. However, the Devourer was able to find a way to remain.
translation: 不幸的是，是的。大多数神早已离开这个世界。然而，吞噬者找到了留下来的方法。

english: Luckily for us, some of her former priestesses were able to weaken her, but she still poses a great threat.
translation: 幸运的是，她的一些前女祭司能够削弱她，但她仍然构成巨大威胁。

english: Cursed one, why have you not yet returned the burial jar of our old leader?
translation: 被诅咒的家伙，你为什么还没有归还我们老领袖的葬罐？

english: I'm working on that still.
translation: 我还在处理这件事。

english: I wonder how someone as insignificant as you even managed to get inside the pyramid, never mind reach its heart.
translation: 我想知道像你这样微不足道的人是怎么进入金字塔的，更不用说到达它的核心了。

english: If you must, then I bestow the blessing of Icthlarin and the minor deities upon you. Climb down the ladder in the corner of the temple. This will leave you in the wrecked bank.
translation: 如果你非要去，那我就赐予你伊克哈林和几位小神的祝福。从神殿角落的梯子爬下去。那里会通向被毁的银行。

english: I wouldn't, if I were you. It's incredibly dangerous down there. We've lost far too many townsfolk already who underestimated the dangers. There are some fearsome traps and vicious monsters lurking in the
translation: 如果我是你，我就不去。下面极其危险。我们已经失去了太多低估了危险的镇民。那里潜伏着可怕的陷阱和凶猛的怪物。

english: Some strange scarab creatures burst up from the cellars a few months ago. We fought them back into some kind of dungeon but, in doing so, the temple and the bank beneath were devastated.
translation: 几个月前，一些奇怪的圣甲虫生物从地窖里涌出来。我们把他们打回了某个地牢里，但在这个过程中，神殿和下面的银行都被毁了。

english: I know bits and pieces about its history; I help maintain the place and even held services until recently. Please excuse its current sorry state.
translation: 我对它的历史略知一二；我负责维护这个地方，直到最近还在主持仪式。请原谅它现在这副破败的样子。

english: It's dark down there; you should really take a torch or some sort of light source along with you - that and a tinderbox in case it goes out.
translation: 下面很黑；你真的应该带个火把或者某种光源下去——再带个火绒盒，以防火灭了。

english: Remember, be very careful down there; it is seriously dangerous. I don't want to be kept awake by your cries of anguish when your light goes out.
translation: 记住，在下面要非常小心；那里非常危险。我可不想你的灯灭了之后，被你的惨叫声吵得睡不着觉。

english: We've posted a number of guards there to hold back the scarab monsters. There is a barricaded trapdoor there that is a little complicated to open.
translation: 我们在那里派驻了一些守卫，以阻挡圣甲虫怪物。那里有一个用路障堵住的活板门，打开它有点复杂。

english: Jex rubs his head tenderly.
translation: 杰克斯轻柔地揉了揉头。

english: That linen merchant, Siamun; he's never liked me.
translation: 那个亚麻布商人，西亚蒙；他一直都不喜欢我。

english: Greetings, non-believer. May the blessings of Icthlarin rest on your tired shoulders and may they set you at ease during interesting times.
translation: 你好，非信徒。愿伊克哈林的祝福落在你疲惫的肩膀上，愿他们在多事之秋让你感到安心。

english: The minor gods aren't really that revered on this side of the Elid. Icthlarin holds sway here and, although a fine deity indeed, he's not the most jolly of sorts.
translation: 在艾利德河的这一边，小神们其实并不那么受尊崇。伊克哈林在这里掌权，虽然他是个不错的神祇，但并不是最欢乐的那种。

english: Well, yes and no. I am primarily a priest of Icthlarin, certainly, but I have been trained in the rites of the minor gods as well.
translation: 嗯，既是也不是。我主要是伊克哈林的祭司，没错，但我也接受过小神仪式的训练。

english: I'm not really sure, to be honest. Most of the natural worshippers are in Menaphos, of course, and the local economy is rather depressed. In addition, that Templeton rogue made off with some of the damaged
translation: 老实说，我也不太确定。当然，大部分自然崇拜者都在美纳佛斯，而当地经济相当萧条。另外，那个叫坦普尔顿的盗贼还偷走了一些受损的

english: If you have any sense you wouldn't go down there but I can see you're determined to give it a go. Be sure to bring a light source and a tinderbox or you may suffer a grisly fate.
translation: 如果你有点理智，就不会下去，但我看得出你决心要试一试。一定要带上光源和火绒盒，否则你可能会遭遇可怕的命运。

english: Bother me not, I am in preparation for the burial ceremony. I'm sure even you can curb your trivial demands until after that.
translation: 别来烦我，我正在准备葬礼仪式。我相信即使是你，也能把那些琐碎的要求推迟到那之后吧。

english: Do you think you'll find it down there?
translation: 你觉得你能在下面找到它吗？

english: stonework. We should hunt him down like the jackal he is.
translation: 石工。我们应该像追捕胡狼一样追捕他。

english: What business does the cursed one have with a servant of Icthlarin?
translation: 被诅咒者与伊克哈林的仆从有何贵干？

english: I will not aid a defiler of the dead. Get ye gone; your presence is soiling my austere aura.
translation: 我不会帮助死者的亵渎者。你走吧；你的存在玷污了我肃穆的气场。

english: Surely you can confide in me?
translation: 你总能信任我吧？

english: Goodbye; may the gods be with you.
translation: 再见；愿众神与你同在。

english: Don't be afraid; you are a heroic sort. Go on, tell me!
translation: 别害怕；你是个英雄人物。说吧，告诉我！

english: In that case, I prefer to remain mystified but alive. May the gods be with you.
translation: 那样的话，我宁愿保持神秘但活着。愿众神与你同在。

english: What does the cursed one want?
translation: 被诅咒者想要什么？

english: A likely story. She would never reduce herself to talk to one as lowly as you, never mind help you.
translation: 说得倒好听。她绝不会自降身份和你这样低贱的人说话，更别提帮你了。

english: I think you'll have gathered most of the relevant details from elsewhere, but general knowledge isn't always the most accurate.
translation: 我想你从别处已经收集到了大部分相关细节，但常识并不总是最准确的。

english: Not really; there are simply details of Scabaras' fall from grace that are only known to we priests.
translation: 并非如此；只是关于斯卡巴拉斯失宠的细节只有我们祭司知道。

english: Some of his supposed faults can be forgiven. I just can't explain why at the moment.
translation: 他的一些所谓过错是可以原谅的。只是我现在无法解释原因。

english: Apmeken is the most mischievous, playful and unpredictable of the minor deities. My personal favourite, in fact.
translation: 阿普梅肯是众小神中最调皮、最贪玩、最难以捉摸的。事实上，他是我个人最喜欢的。

english: Apmeken is the deity of mental pleasures, so he can appeal to both the most erudite scholar or the most barefaced liar. I'd like to be considered amongst the former category.
translation: 阿普梅肯是精神愉悦之神，所以他既能吸引最博学的学者，也能吸引最厚颜无耻的骗子。我希望自己被归入前一类。

english: He has the head of a monkey, ape or baboon, depending upon which exact nature he is displaying. The monkey is skilful, the ape is wise and the baboon is usually comical.
translation: 他长着猴子、猿或狒狒的头，具体取决于他展现的是哪种本性。猴子灵巧，猿猴智慧，而狒狒通常很滑稽。

english: Not at all! Our greatest memory masters and orators also tend to follow Het. As you can imagine, the services can be home to some strenuous discussions.
translation: 一点也不！我们最伟大的记忆大师和演说家也往往追随赫特。可以想象，仪式上有时会有激烈的讨论。

english: Het is the least strange looking of our deities to foreign eyes; he looks just like us. I suspect this is why his shrines are particularly targeted by the infamous Templeton.
translation: 在外国人看来，赫特是我们神祇中外表最不奇怪的；他看起来和我们一样。我怀疑这就是为什么他的神龛特别受到臭名昭著的坦普尔顿的针对。

english: Well spotted. I suppose that, more accurately, he is seen in the form of an ape with or without vibrant skin colouration. The baboon is the one with bright colours. Apmeken does, however, have a tail only in his monkey
translation: 观察得真仔细。我想，更准确地说，他呈现的是猿猴的形态，皮肤颜色可能有也可能没有。狒狒是颜色鲜艳的那个。不过，阿普梅肯只有在猴子形态时才有尾巴。

english: He is the very incarnation of health in both mind and body. He is quite popular amongst our soldiers as a result.
translation: 他是身心健康的化身。因此，他在我们的士兵中很受欢迎。

english: Also with arguments. They really couldn't decide whether it was a punishment from Het or a curse and an affront to Het. I stayed out of that debate.
translation: 还有争论。他们真的无法确定那究竟是赫特的惩罚，还是一个诅咒术以及对赫特的冒犯。我置身于那场辩论之外。

english: Only if they taste nice. Crondis worshippers are often skilled cooks, stealthy hunters or lazy sybarites.
translation: 只要味道好就行。克伦迪斯的信徒通常是熟练的厨师、隐秘的猎人或懒惰的享乐主义者。

english: Enough flippancy; remember, she is a deity and this is her place of power. Her area of interest is all physical pleasures.
translation: 别轻浮了；记住，她是一位女神，这里是她的力量之所。她主管的领域是所有肉体上的愉悦。

english: Crondis is a ferocious looking lady with the head of a mighty crocodile.
translation: 克伦迪斯是一位长相凶猛的女士，长着一颗巨大的鳄鱼头。

english: A sybarite enjoys all the fine things in life. Of course, if you happen to be a sybarite with no money, you'll just be called a lazy good-for-nothing.
translation: 享乐主义者享受生活中所有美好的事物。当然，如果你碰巧是个没钱的享乐主义者，那你只会被叫做懒惰的废物。

english: form.
translation: 形态。

english: Ah, human. How go things, great guardian of cats?
translation: 啊，人类。事情进展如何，猫的伟大守护者？

english: Are you mocking me?
translation: 你在嘲笑我吗？

english: I don't need to mock you, human. You're doing a good enough job of that on your own.
translation: 我不需要嘲笑你，人类。你自己做得已经够好了。

english: Fine. Come on, cat. Lets leave the nasty Sphinx alone.
translation: 好吧。来吧，猫。我们离开这讨厌的斯芬克斯。

english: I think the High Priest mentioned something about needing a cat to enter the pyramid.
translation: 我想大祭司提到过需要一只猫才能进入金字塔。

english: Hey puss! What do you reckon about that cat on the door? Do you think you can open it?
translation: 嘿，猫咪！你觉得门上那只猫怎么样？你能打开它吗？

english: Meeeow.
Hey puss! Think you can open this door again?
translation: 嘿，猫咪！你能再打开这扇门吗？

english: I need to get the burial jar for the mistress...
translation: 我需要为女主人拿到葬罐……

english: I don't want this jar.
translation: 我不想要这个罐子。

english: You will not defile this place!
translation: 你不会玷污这个地方的！

english: So I really did steal the jar. I need to return it as fast as I can.
translation: 所以我真的偷了罐子。我需要尽快归还它。

english: I've already caused enough trouble over these jars. I'll just leave them alone.
translation: 我已经因为这些罐子惹了够多麻烦。我还是别碰它们了。

english: Bother me not. I am preparing for the ceremony. I'm sure even you can curb your trivial demands until after that.
translation: 别烦我。我正在准备仪式。我相信即使是你也能在那之后才提出你那些琐碎的要求。

english: It's done.
translation: 完成了。

english: Wonderful! Now we can prepare for the ceremony.
translation: 太好了！现在我们可以准备仪式了。

english: Er... ceremony?
translation: 呃……仪式？

english: The ceremony to reconsecrate Klenter's tomb of course!
translation: 当然是重新祝圣克伦特之墓的仪式！

english: It would have been nice for you to mention this earlier.
translation: 你早点提到这个就好了。

english: Sorry, with all this plague business, it must have slipped my mind.
translation: 抱歉，因为这场瘟疫的事，我一定是忘了。

english: You're the High Priest of Icthlarin, but you forgot a key ceremony?
translation: 你是伊克哈林的大祭司，但你忘了关键仪式？

english: Well if you want to try running a city with multiple plagues, you're welcome to take over.
translation: 好吧，如果你想尝试管理一个有多场瘟疫的城市，欢迎你来接手。

english: That's not what I... Never mind.
translation: 我不是那个意思……算了。

english: Good. Now, this ceremony is very dangerous, so we must ensure everything is done correctly.
translation: 很好。现在，这个仪式非常危险，所以我们必须确保一切正确进行。

english: Dangerous? How?
translation: 危险？怎么危险？

english: Well the pyramid has these magical seals on it...
translation: 嗯，金字塔上有这些魔法封印……

english: ... to protect it from the Devourer. Yes, you told me earlier.
translation: ……用来保护它免受吞噬者的侵害。是的，你之前告诉过我。

english: Right! Of course I did. Well for us to properly reconsecrate the tomb, we must first remove those seals. That means that once we begin, the pyramid will be vulnerable until the ceremony is complete.
translation: 对！我当然告诉过你。为了正确重新祝圣坟墓，我们必须先移除那些封印。这意味着一旦我们开始，金字塔将在仪式完成前变得脆弱。

english: Now, we made many of the preparations while you were gone, but the carpenter and the embalmer could both use a hand. Could you go and speak with them?
translation: 现在，你不在的时候我们做了很多准备，但木匠和防腐师都需要帮手。你能去和他们谈谈吗？

english: Why do I have to help?
translation: 为什么我必须帮忙？

english: Did you forget that this is all your fault?
translation: 你忘了这都是你的错吗？

english: I guess I assumed that by returning the jar I stole, my job would be done.
translation: 我以为归还我偷的罐子后，我的任务就完成了。

english: The job will be done when Klenter is at rest once more.
translation: 当克伦特再次安息时，任务才算完成。

english: Besides, thanks to the plagues, we're not allowing people to leave the city. However, as you seem to be unaffected, I've told the guards to make an exception for you.
translation: 此外，由于瘟疫，我们不允许人们离开城市。不过，既然你似乎不受影响，我告诉守卫为你破例。

english: And that means I'm best placed to help. Fine. The carpenter and the embalmer, did you say?
translation: 这意味着我最适合帮忙。好吧。你说的是木匠和防腐师？

english: That's right. We need the carpenter to create a new holy symbol for the ceremony. He lives over to the east. The embalmer also needs help gathering some supplies. He lives just south of here.
translation: 没错。我们需要木匠为仪式制作一个新的神圣护符。他住在东边。防腐师也需要帮助收集一些补给品。他住在这南边。

english: Have you helped the embalmer and the carpenter yet?
translation: 你帮过防腐师和木匠了吗？

english: The embalmer lives just south of here and the carpenter lives over to the east. Please hurry. We need to get this ceremony performed before some other bad thing happens.
translation: 防腐师住在这南边，木匠住在东边。请快点。我们需要在别的坏事发生之前举行这个仪式。

english: Yes. The High Priest has given you permission to come and go as you please.
translation: 是的。大祭司已经允许你自由进出。

english: Oh, it's you. I hear you're helping us now. To be honest, I'm still not thrilled to have you around, but so be it.
translation: 哦，是你。我听说你现在在帮我们。说实话，我仍然不太高兴你在这里，但就这样吧。

english: I guess that's probably the best I can ask for, given the situation. Anyway, the High Priest said you needed help gathering some supplies for the ceremony.
translation: 我想考虑到情况，这大概是我能期望的最好结果了。总之，大祭司说你需要帮忙收集一些仪式用的补给品。

english: That's right. I need three things, but the quarantine is making some of them hard to obtain.
translation: 没错。我需要三样东西，但隔离使得其中一些很难获得。

english: First, I need some salt. Normally I get mine from the salt lake just north of the city. Just fill a bucket from the lake and then use the suntrap outside to separate the salt from the water.
translation: 首先，我需要一些盐。通常我从城北的盐湖获取。只需从湖中装满一个桶，然后用外面的日光陷阱将盐和水分离。

english: Next, I need some tree sap. You can use a knife to extract some from a tree, but make sure you have a bucket ready. Most coniferous evergreen trees should have some. They're the cone-shaped ones.
translation: 接下来，我需要一些树液。你可以用小刀从树上提取，但确保你有一个桶准备好。大多数针叶常青树应该都有。它们是锥形的。

english: Finally, I need some linen. That one shouldn't be too hard. The local cloth salesman should have some.
translation: 最后，我需要一些亚麻布。那个应该不难。当地的布料商应该有。

english: Well that was unexpected. Thank you.
translation: 嗯，真没想到。谢谢你。

english: Good afternoon.
translation: 下午好。

english: It's hot and sunny, which is good enough for me. So can I help you with anything?
translation: 天气炎热晴朗，对我来说就够了。那么我能帮你什么吗？

english: I've met with the town's embalmer and he mentioned that he needed a few things, linen being one of them.
translation: 我见过镇上的防腐师，他提到他需要几样东西，亚麻布是其中之一。

english: Well I can sell you a sheet of linen for 30 coins.
translation: 我可以卖给你一张亚麻布，30金币。

english: I don't have that much on me. I'll be back.
translation: 我身上没带那么多。我回头再来。

english: Of course. That will be 30 coins please and thank you.
translation: 当然。那是30金币，请付钱，谢谢。

english: Do come again.
translation: 欢迎再来。

english: Ah yes, very good...., very good.... here I have just the thing for you.
translation: 啊，是的，非常好……非常好……我这正好有你要的东西。

english: Thank you come again.
translation: 谢谢光临，欢迎再来。

english: That will be 30 coins please and thank you.
translation: 承惠30金币，谢谢。

english: All you adventurers are alike!
translation: 你们这些冒险者都是一个样！

english: You're all trouble.
translation: 你们全都是麻烦精。

english: Clear off you despicable vagabond.
translation: 滚开，你这个卑鄙的流浪汉。

english: Well if it isn't the great adventurer [player name]?
translation: 哟，这不是伟大的冒险者[player name]吗？

english: I've had these spots since the last time you tried help. I'm wondering what's going to happen this time.
translation: 自从上次你帮忙之后，我身上这些斑点就一直在。我很好奇这次又会出现什么状况。

english: Ready to mess things up here again?
translation: 准备好再次把这里搞得一团糟了吗？

english: I see you have managed to mess things up again.
translation: 看来你又成功把事情搞砸了。

english: Well the ceremony should have been over by now, yet the plagues remain.
translation: 嗯，仪式现在应该早就结束了，可瘟疫还在。

english: Well I could hold it against you, but then again adventurers are my best customers. So may I interest you in any of my wares?
translation: 我本可以记恨你，但话说回来，冒险者是我最好的顾客。所以，有兴趣看看我的商品吗？

english: Hello.~ The merchant replies guardedly.
translation: 你好。~ 商人戒备地回答。

english: Well I could hold it against you, but then again adventurers are my best customers and because of this quarantine my only customers. So may I interest you in any of my wares?
translation: 我本可以记恨你，但话说回来，冒险者是我最好的顾客，而且因为这次隔离，他们成了我唯一的顾客。所以，有兴趣看看我的商品吗？

english: I've a business to run, I'll sell you this sheet of linen for 30 gold coins.
translation: 我得做生意，这张亚麻布卖你30金币。

english: Hello again, any news on the ceremony?
translation: 又见面了，仪式有什么新消息吗？

english: Oh I see so you're just floating around here and doing nothing about it then. Is that it?
translation: 哦，我明白了，所以你就在这儿晃荡，什么都不做，是吧？是这样吗？

english: Well seeing as you caused us to suffer from these cursed plagues can you blame us?
translation: 既然是你害我们遭受这些该死的瘟疫，你能怪我们吗？

english: What? Do you think everyone in this town is naturally spotty and that this place is always under quarantine?
translation: 什么？你以为镇上的人天生就长斑点，这地方永远都在隔离中？

english: Get away from me you fool, your stupidity might be catching and then where would I be.
translation: 离我远点，你这个傻瓜，你的愚蠢可能会传染，到时候我可怎么办。

english: You can of course, but you'll have to remind me, my memory isn't as good as it used be.
translation: 当然可以，但你得提醒我一下，我的记性不如从前了。

english: Ok let's give it a go so.
translation: 好吧，那就试试看。

english: Aghhh!!! I got some in my eye. Owwww it stings.
translation: 啊！！！溅到我眼睛里了。嗷呜，好疼。

english: My name's Raetul.
translation: 我叫雷图尔。

english: Scram or I'll give you something to feel sorry about.
translation: 快滚，否则我让你后悔都来不及。

english: What? You intolerable, insufferable idiot. I've just burned my eye out for no reason? I would say get out of my sight but that's not far enough away.
translation: 什么？你这个令人无法忍受、不可理喻的白痴。我就这么白白烧了自己的眼睛？我本想让你滚出我的视线，但这还不够远。

english: Do you really think that asking me all these pointless questions is going to achieve anything?
translation: 你真的以为问这些没完没了的无聊问题能有什么作用吗？

english: Well I wonder, I stand in front of a clothes stall and I sell clothes all day long.
translation: 嗯，我想想，我站在一个服装摊位前，整天卖衣服。

english: Oh get away from me, I don't want to give your stupidity the chance to dull my razor sharp intellect and wit.
translation: 哦，离我远点，我可不想让你的愚蠢有机会削弱我敏锐的才智和机锋。

english: Well you're obviously not doing a great job, my spots are getting worse. I've got one right inside my left ear and if it bursts I think it could flood my brain.
translation: 你显然干得不怎么样，我的斑点越来越严重了。我左耳朵里面就有一个，要是它破了，我觉得能淹了我的大脑。

english: Oh, it's you. Any luck obtaining those items?
translation: 哦，是你。那些物品有眉目了吗？

english: Thank you. I think that's everything I need.
translation: 谢谢你。我想这就是我需要的一切了。

english: Great. I guess I should go and see how the carpenter is getting on.
translation: 太好了。我想我应该去看看木匠怎么样了。

english: Well you'd better get a move on.
translation: 那你最好快点行动。

english: Where do I get tree sap?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到树液？

english: You can use a knife to extract some from a tree, but make sure you have a bucket ready. Most coniferous evergreen trees should have some. They're the cone- shaped ones.
translation: 你可以用小刀从树上提取一些，但确保你有一个桶准备好。大多数针叶常青树应该都有。它们是锥形的。

english: Where do I get salt?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到盐？

english: Normally I get mine from the salt lake just north of the city. Just fill a bucket from the lake and then use the suntrap outside to separate the salt from the water.
translation: 通常我从城北的盐湖获取。只需从湖中装满一个桶，然后用外面的日光陷阱将盐和水分离。

english: Where do I get linen?
translation: 我在哪里可以得到亚麻布？

english: The local cloth salesman should have some for sale.
translation: 当地的布料商应该有一些出售。

english: Okay, I'll get going.
translation: 好的，我这就去。

english: Oh, it's you. You've already gathered everything I need. I'm sure you have plenty of other things to be doing.
translation: 哦，是你。你已经收集了我需要的一切。我相信你还有很多其他事情要做。

english: I guess I do still need to speak to the carpenter.
translation: 我想我确实还需要和木匠谈谈。

english: Hello, adventurer. The High Priest says that you're here to help us.
translation: 你好，冒险者。大祭司说你是来帮我们的。

english: That's right. He asked me to come and speak to you about a holy symbol for the ceremony.
translation: 没错。他让我来和你谈谈关于仪式用的神圣护符。

english: Ah yes, it needs to be made from willow. Thing is, there's a small problem with that.
translation: 啊，没错，它得用柳木制作。问题是，这里有个小麻烦。

english: Is this the part where you need me to get you something?
translation: 现在是不是该你让我去拿点东西了？

english: Wow, you're quick. I'm all out of willow, and due to the quarantine, I'm unable to leave the city to get more. However, the High Priest mentioned that a special exception has been made for you.
translation: 哇，你真机灵。我的柳木用完了，而且因为隔离，我没办法出城去弄更多。不过，大祭司提到为你破了一次例。

english: Meaning I can leave the city and get you some. Alright, I'll be back soon.
translation: 意思是，我可以离开城市去给你弄一些。好吧，我很快就回来。

english: Well there's actually no need for me to go anywhere. I already have some willow logs here.
translation: 其实我哪儿也不用去。我这里已经有一些柳木原木了。

english: Thank you. Now, just give me a moment...
translation: 谢谢。现在，给我一点时间……

english: There we go. All done.
translation: 好了，完成了。

english: I imagine the High Priest will be down in the pyramid by now. You should take that to him as soon as possible.
translation: 我想大祭司现在应该在金字塔里了。你应该尽快把这个带给他。

english: Will do. Thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Do you have that wood for me?
translation: 你拿到我要的木材了吗？

english: Hello, adventurer. I'm still working on that symbol. Do you have something else you can do in the meantime?
translation: 你好，冒险者。我还在制作那个护符。你在这期间有别的事可以做吗？

english: Yes, I need to help out the embalmer.
translation: 是的，我需要去帮防腐师的忙。

english: Well you're probably best off doing that then. I'm sure I'll have it ready by the time you're done.
translation: 那你最好先去做那件事。我肯定在你做完之前能把它准备好。

english: Hello, adventurer. The symbol is all finished now.
translation: 你好，冒险者。护符已经全部完成了。

english: Have you got the linen I asked for?
translation: 我要的亚麻布你拿来了吗？

english: Have you got the sap I asked for?
translation: 我要的树液你拿来了吗？

english: Good day to you. I won't say you're welcome into my workplace, because you're not. However, I must apologise if I was outrightly hostile towards you earlier.
translation: 你好。我不会说欢迎你来我的工作场所，因为你确实不受欢迎。不过，如果我之前对你态度过于敌视，我得道个歉。

english: I'll admit that I shed no tears when he passed away. He was a rather cruel and hard leader.
translation: 我承认他去世时我没掉一滴眼泪。他是个相当残酷又严厉的领袖。

english: Yes, because of the quarantine I cannot leave Sophanem. You seem to have been left unaffected by it so perhaps the guards will let you out of the city.
translation: 是的，因为隔离，我不能离开索法尼恩城。你似乎没受影响，也许守卫会放你出城。

english: Good, that's what I like to hear. Now, to carry out the ceremony, I need three things.
translation: 好，我就爱听这个。现在，要举行仪式，我需要三样东西。

english: Well, the salt should be easy enough to get from the salt lake to the north.
translation: 嗯，盐应该很容易从北边的盐湖弄到。

english: The sap you should be able to get easily enough from any coniferous tree.
translation: 树液你应该很容易从任何针叶树上弄到。

english: Have you got the salt I asked for?
translation: 我要的盐你拿来了吗？

english: Evergreen, cone shaped, you know the ones I'm talking about.
translation: 常青的，锥形的，你知道我说的是哪种树。

english: Well, you'll probably need something to cut the tree's bark and something else to collect the sap in.
translation: 嗯，你可能需要点东西来割树皮，再找个容器来收集树液。

english: That's everything I need to get the ceremony underway. I'll send word to the high priest to get things started.
translation: 仪式需要的东西都齐了。我会通知大祭司，让他开始准备。

english: Never-the-less, I'll let the high priest know that everything's sorted from this side.
