translation: 不管怎样，我会告诉大祭司这边都准备好了。

english: Well, there's no point in complaining about him. I want rid of his cursed plague as soon as possible and, according to the high priest, the best way to do that is to carry out the final ceremony.
translation: 唉，抱怨他也没用。我想尽快摆脱他那该死的瘟疫，而据大祭司说，最好的办法就是举行最后的仪式。

english: I need some linen to wrap the corpse up with. That should be easily obtained from a cloth salesman here in the town.
translation: 我需要一些亚麻布来包裹尸体。这应该很容易从镇上的布料商那里买到。

english: I also need some salt and some sap. I need the salt to preserve the body and the sap for sealing the bandages.
translation: 我还需要一些盐和一些汁液。我需要盐来保存尸体，汁液用来密封绷带。

english: Sorry, adventurer, I have nothing to trade with you.
translation: 抱歉，冒险者，我没什么可跟你交易的。

english: Well, can you get on with it?
translation: 嗯，你能快点吗？

english: Well, you've collected all the things that I need, so when's this plague going to end?
translation: 好吧，你收集了我需要的东西，那这瘟疫什么时候才能结束？

english: Clear off, you evil body snatcher. You won't get any of my wares.
translation: 滚开，你这邪恶的偷尸贼。你休想从我这里得到任何东西。

english: Hrmph!!
Heh!!
Pah!!
Keh!!
Well, I suppose that's only to be expected. The old high priest was a vindictive sort. He could hold a grudge forever.
translation: 嗯，我想这也是意料之中的。老祭司是个记仇的人。他能永远记恨下去。

english: Hello.~The embalmer replies warily.
translation: 你好。~防腐师警惕地回答。

english: Well, you can take your curiosity elsewhere.
translation: 哼，带着你的好奇心去别处吧。

english: He might just make this city of the dead a dead city if he does carry on for much longer.
translation: 他要是再这么搞下去，恐怕要把这座亡者之城变成一座死城了。

english: Anyway I'm rambling.
translation: 算了，我扯远了。

english: I'd nearly forgotten about those; running my spice stall has taken my mind off the plagues.
translation: 我差点忘了那些事；经营我的香料摊位让我暂时忘了瘟疫。

english: Well, I'm trying to find a balm for our spots.
translation: 嗯，我在试着找一种药膏来治我们的斑点。

english: I got some cream from a merchant in Al Kharid that was meant to help but all it seems to do is repel insects.
translation: 我从阿尔卡里德城的一个商人那里买了些药膏，本来说是有用的，结果好像只能驱虫。

english: Anyway, I'm rambling. You're here to buy something, not to chat.
translation: 算了，我又扯远了。你是来买东西的，不是来聊天的。

english: That's him. How do you know him?
translation: 就是他。你怎么认识他的？

english: What would that be, then?
translation: 那是什么？

english: You won't succeed; we've tried already and that brute Coenus sent us packing.
translation: 你不会成功的；我们已经试过了，那个野蛮的科努斯把我们赶走了。

english: Hello. Have you given the symbol to the High Priest yet?
translation: 你好。你把护符交给大祭司了吗？

english: Well you should as soon as possible. He'll be down in the pyramid by now.
translation: 你最好尽快去交。他现在应该已经在金字塔里了。

english: Actually, there's a slight problem with the symbol.
translation: 其实，护符出了点小问题。

english: What? But I made it to exactly match the drawings from the High Priest. I can't believe this!
translation: 什么？我可是严格按照大祭司的图纸做的。真不敢相信！

english: Oh, I'm sure the symbol itself is fine. The problem is... I lost it.
translation: 哦，我确定护符本身没问题。问题是……我把它弄丢了。

english: Agh, you fool! Is stupidity the newest plague in town?
translation: 啊，你这个蠢货！愚蠢是城里最新的瘟疫吗？

english: Can you please calm down? I gave you plenty of willow. I'm sure there's some left over for another symbol.
translation: 你能不能冷静点？我给了你很多柳木。肯定还有剩下的再做另一个护符。

english: Fine. Just give me a moment...
translation: 好吧。给我一点时间……

english: There we go. All done. Try not to lose this one.
translation: 好了，完成了。这次别再弄丢了。

english: Now you should take that to the High Priest as soon as possible. He'll be down in the pyramid by now.
translation: 现在你应该尽快把这个交到大祭司手上。他应该在金字塔里了。

english: So, does the high priest have any instructions for me?
translation: 那么，大祭司有什么指示给我吗？

english: Yes, I remember he gave me some drawings a few days ago. Now what wood was it to be made of again?
translation: 是的，我记得他几天前给了我一些图纸。现在，那东西要用什么木材来做来着？

english: Ah yes, I remember now, it was to be made of willow. Though there's a small problem with that.
translation: 啊，对了，我想起来了，要用柳木来做。不过，这有点小问题。

english: Just adding the finishing touches.
translation: 正在做最后的修饰。

english: Okay, it's finished here you go.
translation: 好了，完成了，给你。

english: Wow, you're quick. I'm all out of willow wood and seeing as I'm unable to get any more due to the quarantine, I'm going to need some help with this.
translation: 哇，你真快。我的柳木木材用完了，而且由于隔离，我弄不到更多了，所以我需要你帮个忙。

english: That's good. I'll have the symbol ready for you shortly. I'm sure you have plenty of other important things to do in the meanwhile.
translation: 很好。我很快就能把符号准备好给你。我相信你在此期间还有很多其他重要的事情要做。

english: Well, last time I checked, the job description for a carpenter is to craft things out of wood, while you, being an adventurer, need to run around doing thankless tasks for people in need...and right now I
translation: 嗯，上次我查过，木匠的工作描述是用木材制作东西，而你，作为一个冒险者，需要到处跑，为有需要的人做吃力不讨好的任务……而现在我

english: You should get that to the high priest as soon as possible. We're all really getting sick of these plagues.
translation: 你应该尽快把这个交给大祭司。我们都受够了这些瘟疫。

english: Not a notion.
translation: 一点头绪都没有。

english: Oh, one more thing, I think that the high priest has had a particularly bad dose of these spots so he's gone off to start the ceremony already.
translation: 哦，还有一件事，我觉得大祭司身上的这些斑点特别严重，所以他已经动身去开始仪式了。

english: Apologies if I was a little on the cold side earlier, but the high priest said that you're working with him and that's good enough for me.
translation: 如果我之前态度有点冷淡，我道歉，但大祭司说你在和他合作，这对我来说就足够了。

english: Have you got the logs yet?
translation: 你拿到原木了吗？

english: Give me a second.
translation: 等一下。

english: need you to do this.
translation: 需要你来做这个。

english: No, now look... I'm busy trying to get this thing finished. If you don't stop annoying me, it will never get done.
translation: 不，听着……我正忙着把这东西做完。如果你再烦我，它就永远完不成了。

english: Sorry, no. I've recently worked out a decent supply which bypasses the grey economy.
translation: 抱歉，没有。我最近找到了一条不错的供应渠道，绕开了灰色经济。

english: It's selling bits and pieces through unofficial channels, avoiding taxes and import duty. Since I'm trying to keep on the good side of our esteemed rulers, I don't trade that way these days.
translation: 就是通过非官方渠道零碎地卖点东西，避开了税收和进口关税。既然我想在我们尊敬的统治者面前保持好印象，我现在就不那么交易了。

english: Have you given the symbol to the high priest yet?
translation: 你把符号交给大祭司了吗？

english: Well, if he's not in town, then I'm sure he must be down in the pyramid getting the ceremony underway.
translation: 嗯，如果他不在镇上，那我肯定他一定是在金字塔里开始仪式了。

english: Well, seeing as I have gotten this dreadful dermatological disease as a direct result of some of your antics, I think you should be duty bound to help me.
translation: 嗯，既然我得了这种可怕的皮肤病，直接是因为你的一些胡闹造成的，我认为你有义务帮我。

english: So explain why that spectre is accusing you of such a crime. The dead rarely have need for lies.
translation: 那就解释一下为什么那个幽灵指控你犯下这样的罪行。死者很少需要撒谎。

english: Well then, hurry up and get me those willow logs.
translation: 那么，快点去给我弄那些柳木原木来。

english: In your on good time. don't rush on my behalf; I'm only half crippled with these pus-filled pustules of penance.
translation: 你慢慢来，不用为我着急；我只是被这些充满脓液的赎罪脓包折磨得半死不活而已。

english: Good day, grave robber. What do you want?
translation: 你好啊，盗墓者。你想要什么？

english: Well aren't you wonderful! Do you want a medal for your efforts.
translation: 哎呀，你可真了不起！要不要给你发个奖章表彰你的努力？

english: I'd hope so. Because of your actions, I'm covered with the most awful spots, I've been forced to close my business down, there are hordes of giant frogs and locust roaming the streets and all the nearby livestock
translation: 我希望如此。因为你的行为，我浑身长满了可怕的斑点，被迫关闭了生意，成群的巨型青蛙和蝗虫在街上游荡，附近所有的牲畜都病了。

english: The carpenter glares angrily at you. You notice a veinon his left temple starting to bulge...
translation: 木匠愤怒地瞪着你。你注意到他左太阳穴上的一根血管开始鼓起来……

english: How are things going with the ceremony?
translation: 仪式进行得怎么样了？

english: are sick.
translation: 都病了。

english: Sorry, it's just these spots. They have me half demented. Just hang on a second and I'll make up another one.
translation: 抱歉，只是这些斑点。它们让我有点发疯。稍等一下，我再做一个。

english: Here you go. Now, do hurry up and get this to the ceremony.
translation: 给你。好了，快点把这个送到仪式上去吧。

english: What? What? I made that symbol to exactly match the drawings I was given. I can't believe this.
translation: 什么？什么？我做的那个符号完全按照给我的图纸来的。我真不敢相信。

english: Well, I suppose things could be worse, though I really did have my hopes up. I thought you could fix things up.
translation: 嗯，我想情况可能更糟，尽管我确实抱过希望。我以为你能把事情搞定。

english: Well, I've got a business to run here. I can't keep feeling sorry for myself for ever.
translation: 嗯，我这里有生意要打理。我不能一直自怨自艾。

english: Not too bad. Since the town reopened, the embalmer is importing a soothing balm from a merchant called Ali M. It's meant to take the itch away.
translation: 还不错。自从城镇重新开放后，防腐师从一个叫阿里.M的商人那里进口了一种舒缓香膏。据说能止痒。

english: Those plague locusts and frogs aren't too keen on it either.
translation: 那些瘟疫蝗虫和青蛙也不太喜欢它。

english: Would you listen to me; I'm rambling. Let's talk business.
translation: 你听听我；我在胡言乱语。我们谈正事吧。

english: Aghhh!!! You stupid man. Will I ever be free of these plagues? First it was the spots, now it's stupidity.
translation: 啊！！！你这个蠢男人。我到底能不能摆脱这些瘟疫？先是斑点，现在是愚蠢。

english: Aghhh!!! You stupid woman. Will I ever be free of these plagues? First it was the spots, now it's stupidity.
translation: 啊！！！你这个蠢女人。我到底能不能摆脱这些瘟疫？先是斑点，现在是愚蠢。

english: The stonemason was out of town surveying rocks when the plague struck. I don't think he wants to return and get a dose of spots.
translation: 瘟疫爆发时，石匠出城去勘测岩石了。我觉得他不想回来染上斑点。

english: A little better since I heard you're on the case again.
translation: 自从听说你又接手这个案子后，感觉好一点了。

english: I know you're working for the return of our townspeople; the new faces should create enough of a distraction for me to forget about these spots.
translation: 我知道你在为我们镇民的回归而努力；新面孔应该能分散我的注意力，让我忘记这些斑点。

english: Get a move on; I'm really getting sick of these spots.
translation: 快点行动吧；我真的受够了这些斑点。

english: Okay, let's give it a go so.
translation: 好吧，那就试试看吧。

english: Aghhh!!! I got some in my eye. Owwww, it stings.
translation: 啊！！！有些弄到我眼睛里了。嗷嗷嗷，好痛。

english: Oh, do hurry up, will you. I really need this interminable itching to end.
translation: 哦，快点吧，行不行。我真的需要这没完没了的瘙痒停下来。

english: I need to hide the mistress's symbol in the ceremonial room...
translation: 我需要把女主人的护符藏在仪式室里……

english: No... It must be somewhere more secret...
translation: 不……必须藏在更秘密的地方……

english: Yes... Now the mistress can enter the pyramid whenever she pleases...
translation: 没错……现在女主人随时都可以进入金字塔了……

english: The wanderer! She's going to attack the ceremony! I need to warn them!
translation: 流浪者！她要攻击仪式！我需要警告他们！

english: Ah there you are. Do you have the holy symbol?
translation: 啊，你来了。你拿到神圣护符了吗？

english: Wait! We can't begin the ceremony!
translation: 等等！我们不能开始仪式！

english: What? But we've already started.
translation: 什么？可我们已经开始了。

english: But the wanderer is coming!
translation: 但那个流浪者就要来了！

english: You have done well, adventurer. All my brother's dogs in one place, with no one around to save them.
translation: 你做得很好，冒险者。我兄弟的所有狗都聚在一起，周围没人能救他们。

english: Hello to you too adventurer.
translation: 冒险者，你也好啊。

english: Have you gotten my supplies?
translation: 你拿到我的补给品了吗？

english: Don't blink.
translation: 别眨眼。

english: My thanks adventurer. You have been most helpful. I will have my soul now.
translation: 多谢你，冒险者。你帮了大忙。现在我要取走我的灵魂了。

english: No matter, I will just create another minion to destroy all of you. You've already served your purpose.
translation: 没关系，我只需再创造一个仆从就能毁灭你们所有人。你已经完成了你的使命。

english: Just take it away please. Take it away. If you do I'll tell you of the secret passageway.
translation: 请把它拿走，求你了。把它拿走。如果你这么做，我就告诉你秘密通道的位置。

english: It's over yonder by the group of rocks to the east. But you won't be able to enter, well not yet anyway.
translation: 就在东边那堆岩石附近。但你进不去，好吧，至少现在还不行。

english: Look deeply into them.
translation: 深深地凝视它们。

english: First bring me some supplies and then I'll tell you. I'm running low and am about to embark on a long journey.
translation: 先给我带些补给品来，然后我再告诉你。我快用完了，而且正要踏上长途旅程。

english: Get me a full water skin and a tinderbox. I seem to have lost my own and these desert nights are cold.
translation: 给我弄一个满的水囊和一个火绒盒。我自己的好像丢了，沙漠的夜晚很冷。

english: You priest of the dog lord, kill your brethren.
translation: 你这个狗神祭司，去杀了你的同胞。

english: Adventurer I command you to kill these priests.
translation: 冒险者，我命令你去杀了这些祭司。

english: Give me the supplies first and then I'll show you the entrance.
translation: 先把补给品给我，然后我再告诉你入口在哪。

english: You will travel to Sophanem and enter the pyramid of the priests of Icthlarin.
translation: 你将前往索法尼恩城，进入伊克哈林祭司的金字塔。

english: You will find a room within containing four jars take one of them and return to me.
translation: 你会在里面找到一个房间，里面有四个罐子，拿其中一个回来给我。

english: Take this symbol. You will know what to do with it when the time comes.
translation: 拿着这个符号。到时候你会知道该怎么用它。

english: Don't fail me, or else I'll eat your soul.
translation: 别让我失望，否则我就吃掉你的灵魂。

english: Now go.
translation: 现在去吧。

english: Look deeply into my eyes.
translation: 深深地凝视我的眼睛。

english: You will do what I say.
translation: 你会照我说的去做。

english: Wandering, drifting and just surviving. What about you?
translation: 四处游荡，漂泊求生。你呢？

english: I survive off what little the land provides and the generosity of strangers and fellow travellers.
translation: 我靠这片土地微薄的馈赠以及陌生人和同行旅人的慷慨过活。

english: Yes, Sophanem to the south, but it is closed to all outsiders.
translation: 是的，南边的索法尼恩城，但对外来者关闭了。

english: Just a nameless one. I had a name once, but it's been long forgotten.
translation: 只是个无名之辈。我曾经有过名字，但早已被遗忘。

english: I don't doubt that.
translation: 我不怀疑。

english: I need both of them now. Hurry back when you have them.
translation: 我现在两样都要。拿到后快点回来。

english: ~Sniff, sniff.
translation: ~吸吸鼻子。

english: You have the smell of cats about you. Do you have one?
translation: 你身上有猫的味道。你养猫吗？

english: Filthy nasty creatures.
translation: 肮脏可恶的畜生。

english: Do you want to enter the city or not? Hurry up and get my supplies, I intend to leave soon.
translation: 你到底想不想进城？快点去拿补给品，我打算很快离开。

english: It's the second city of the Menaphites, full of giant monuments to their dead.
translation: 那是梅纳菲特人的第二座城市，到处都是纪念他们死者的巨型纪念碑。

english: No but there is still plenty of adventure and gold to be had, plundering the graves of the rich and powerful.
translation: 不，不过还是有很多冒险和黄金可赚，只要去掠夺那些有钱有势之人的坟墓。

english: The pathetic new high priest of Icthlarin.Thewanderer spits the last name out as if it were a curse.
translation: 那个可怜的伊克哈林新大祭司。流浪者像念咒语一样吐出这个姓氏。

english: Oh no reason whatsoever except that I hate cats!
translation: 哦，没什么特别原因，只是我讨厌猫！

english: Yes awful creatures, the brood of Icthlarin.
translation: 是的，可怕的畜生，伊克哈林的后代。

english: Nasty cats, filthy sneaking beasts.....
translation: 讨厌的猫，肮脏鬼祟的畜生……

english: Fool! It's the only way into the city. Wander the desert and die of thirst, see if I care.
translation: 傻瓜！这是进城唯一的路。在沙漠里游荡渴死吧，我才不在乎。

english: Have you found the entrance yet?
translation: 你找到入口了吗？

english: It can't be... It's the Devourer!
translation: 不可能……是吞噬者！

english: Adventurer, kill these pathetic priests.
translation: 冒险者，杀了这些可怜的祭司。

english: I'm not your slave any more!
translation: 我再也不是你的奴隶了！

english: Shame. Not to worry though, I have plenty more.
translation: 可惜。不过别担心，我还有很多。

english: You! Priest of the dog lord. You are now mine. Kill your brethren!
translation: 你！狗神大人的祭司。现在你是我的了。杀了你的同胞！

english: Yes mistress...
translation: 是，女主人……

english: Have fun...
translation: 玩得开心点……

english: Protect us, adventurer! We must complete the ceremony!
translation: 保护我们，冒险者！我们必须完成仪式！

english: You have surprised me... I commend you for your efforts.
translation: 你让我感到意外……我赞赏你的努力。

english: Thank you so much, adventurer. Thanks to you, we were able to complete the ceremony.
translation: 非常感谢你，冒险者。多亏了你，我们才能完成仪式。

english: Well it was the least I could do. After all, it was sort of my fault all this happened.
translation: 这是我应该做的。毕竟，这一切某种程度上是我的错。

english: Well on that note, what exactly did happen there? That was the Devourer!
translation: 说到这个，到底发生了什么？那是吞噬者！

english: It seems the wanderer that hypnotised me was actually the Devourer all along.
translation: 看来那个催眠了我的流浪者其实就是吞噬者。

english: I'm guessing the reason she had me steal that burial jar was because she knew you'd have to gather here to reconsecrate the tomb again.
translation: 我猜她让我偷那个陪葬罐的原因，是她知道你们为了重新祝圣陵墓一定会聚集在这里。

english: She wanted to kill us all in one go?
translation: 她想一次性杀了我们所有人？

english: Yes, and she had me plant an unholy symbol here to allow her to teleport right in.
translation: 是的，她还让我在这里放了一个邪恶护符，好让她能直接传送进来。

english: Well once again, thank you. Without you, the Devourer would have struck a devastating blow against Icthlarin.
translation: 再次感谢你。没有你，吞噬者就会给伊克哈林带来毁灭性的打击。

english: Here's that holy symbol, by the way.
translation: 对了，这是那个神圣护符。

english: Thank you. We wouldn't have been able to complete the ceremony without that in our presence.
translation: 谢谢。如果没有它在我们身边，我们不可能完成仪式。

english: We have a few things to finish here, but then we'll head back up into the city. Please join us there.
translation: 我们这里还有些事要处理，之后会回到城里。请到那里与我们会合。

english: I must do as the mistress commands...
translation: 我必须听从女主人的命令……

english: Did my sister really think that I would not sense her presence here?
translation: 我妹妹真的以为我感应不到她在这里的气息吗？

english: Amascut! Release your hold on this human!
translation: 阿玛斯库特！放开你对这个人类的控制！

english: What's this! A mortal thieving from my domain? This will not do.
translation: 这是什么！一个凡人在我的领域偷窃？这可不行。

english: Arise, spirit of Klenter, protect your soul.
translation: 起来吧，克伦特之灵，守护你的灵魂。

english: This is no mere mortal in front of me. Amascut, release your hold on this human.
translation: 站在我面前的绝非普通凡人。阿玛斯库特，放开你对这个人类的控制。

english: I command you to halt.
translation: 我命令你停下。

english: Argh...
Well I guess that explains why Amascut's control over me was broken. Not every day the god of the dead comes to your rescue.
translation: 好吧，我想这解释了为什么阿玛斯库特对我的控制被打破了。不是每天都能有死神前来救你的。

english: Ah, there you are. You were gone for quite a while. As a thank you for what you've done, I have a little trinket for you. I'm sure you'll get a huge amount of enjoyment out of it.
translation: 啊，你来了。你离开了挺久。为了感谢你所做的一切，我有个小饰品要给你。我相信你一定会从它那里得到很多乐趣。

english: I think it would be best if I stayed out of this tomb after what happened last time.
translation: 经过上次的事情后，我觉得最好还是别进这座墓了。

english: So how are you doing finding my beads?
translation: 你找我的珠子找得怎么样了？

english: I've not found any yet.
translation: 我一颗都没找到。

english: Well get on with it. I've lost a white bead, a red bead, a black bead, and a yellow bead. Go kill some imps!
translation: 那就赶紧去找。我丢了一颗白珠子、一颗红珠子、一颗黑珠子和一颗黄珠子。去杀些小鬼吧！

english: I have found some of your beads.
translation: 我找到了你的一些珠子。

english: Come back when you have them all. The colour of the four beads that I need are red, yellow, black, and white. Go chase some imps!
translation: 等你集齐了再回来。我需要的四颗珠子的颜色是红、黄、黑、白。去追些小恶魔吧！

english: You're a fool, [player name]. Do you really think you'll find four imps out of thousands? Good luck. Ha!
translation: 你真是个傻瓜，[player name]。你真以为你能从成千上万个小鬼里找到四颗？祝你好运。哈！

english: Talk to the kid. He'll tell you to get some stuff. Honestly, he knows more about this stuff than I do. Just do what he needs, and make him go away.
translation: 去跟那小子谈谈。他会让你弄些东西。老实说，他比我知道得更多。照他需要的去做，然后让他离开。

english: You're an adventurer, right? So you'll do errands for people?
translation: 你是个冒险者，对吧？所以你愿意帮人跑腿？

english: Great! See, I'm famous for summoning imps, but I'm trying to get something more interesting. More demons, like the one in the cage, for example.
translation: 太好了！你看，我以召唤小鬼而闻名，但我正在尝试弄点更有趣的东西。比如更多恶魔，像笼子里那个一样。

english: He's creeping me out, standing there looking at me with that face. I need you to get the stuff he needs to reopen the portal to the Realm of Memories, so he can go away.
translation: 他让我毛骨悚然，站在那里用那张脸看着我。我需要你去拿他需要的神秘物质，用来重新打开通往记忆领域的传送门，这样他就能离开了。

english: But in the past there were much bigger demons. Such as Thammaron, in the Third Age. Imagine if I could get control of something like that - that'd show Mizgog who's smart!
translation: 但在过去有更大的恶魔。比如第三纪元的萨马隆。想象一下，如果我能控制那样的东西——那就能证明谁比米兹高更聪明了！

english: But it didn't work. Instead of inventing time travel to the Third Age of Gielinor, my portal reached something called the Realm of Memories. And instead of a mighty demon, I got this weird kid.
translation: 但没成功。我的传送门没有发明出前往吉列诺第三纪元的时间旅行，反而到达了一个叫记忆领域的地方。而且我得到的不是一个强大的恶魔，而是一个古怪的小子。

english: That kid is still hanging around, you know. Hurry up and get him what he needs so that he'll go away for good!
translation: 那小子还在附近晃悠，你知道吗。快点去拿他需要的东西，让他永远消失！

english: Well, I wanted to access the Third Age of Gielinor, but that's not what this is. Instead, the Realm of Memories recalls how the world used to be, back when things were different.
translation: 嗯，我想进入吉列诺的第三纪元，但这并不是。相反，记忆领域回忆着世界过去的样子，那时候一切都不同。

english: The kid tells me it's the exact same date in the Realm of Memories - it's still the Fifth Age, same as it is out here. It's not the history of Gielinor I've unlocked - it's the history of RuneScape.
translation: 那小子告诉我，记忆领域里的日期完全一样——仍然是第五纪元，和外面一样。我解锁的不是吉列诺的历史，而是 RuneScape 的历史。

english: So you think you're clever do you?
translation: 所以你觉得你很聪明，是吧？

english: Get the kid to explain it to you, if you care. All I know is that I can't get uber-powerful demons from there, so I'm no longer interested. Just make the kid go away.
translation: 如果你在乎，就让那小子解释给你听。我只知道我不能从那里得到超级强大的恶魔，所以我没兴趣了。只管让那小子离开。

english: I thought of a way around that. To all but the most stultified mind, life itself is an adventure. And you would be alive while helping me. Therefore you would be having an adventure. Okay?
translation: 我想到了一个变通办法。对于所有不是最呆滞的人来说，生活本身就是一场冒险。而你在帮我的时候是活着的。因此你就是在经历一场冒险。懂了吗？

english: Well, the kid droned on and on about artefacts, and I think he wanted me to give him items, but it made no sense... honestly, his voice drives me mad, and I can't cope with him anymore.
translation: 嗯，那小子没完没了地唠叨什么神器，我想他是想让我给他物品，但完全说不通……老实说，他的声音让我发疯，我再也受不了他了。

english: Like I said, I opened a portal to the Realm of Memories, by mistake, and this weird kid came through.
translation: 就像我说过的，我不小心打开了一个通往记忆领域的传送门，然后这个古怪的小子就过来了。

english: I didn't ask him to come through the portal! Anyway, he knows more about this stuff than I do. He's not a vulnerable innocent - and I'm not the archetypal Wise Old Man figure in this story.
translation: 我没请他穿过传送门！总之，他比我更了解这些东西。他不是什么脆弱无辜的人——我也不是这个故事里典型的老智者形象。

english: You made the weird kid go away! Nice one.
translation: 你让那古怪小子走了！干得好。

english: That's right. Off you go!
translation: 没错，快走吧！

english: The kid said they didn't have massive ancient demons in there, or anything particularly powerful, so I'm not interested. And I don't want to see his face again - it's haunting!
translation: 那小子说那里没有巨大的古代恶魔，或者任何特别强大的东西，所以我没兴趣。而且我不想再看到他的脸——太阴魂不散了！

english: Look, can you just help me, please? I bet you wouldn't even be talking to me about this unless you were willing to help.
translation: 听着，你能不能帮我？我敢打赌，除非你愿意帮忙，否则你根本不会跟我谈这个。

english: Oh. Well, maybe another time.
translation: 哦。好吧，那就下次再说。

english: I was telling you about the problem.
translation: 我刚才在跟你说问题所在。

english: You're a fool, if you think you'll find four imps out of thousands! I won't bother talking to you about that.
translation: 如果你觉得能从成千上万只小鬼中找到四只，那你就是个傻瓜！我不想跟你谈这个。

english: I see you've got the portal open again. Make the weird kid go through it, so I don't have to see him again.
translation: 我看到传送门又打开了。让那古怪小子穿过去，这样我就不用再见到他了。

english: Honestly, no.
translation: 老实说，没有。

english: I've got all four beads. It was hard work I can tell you.
translation: 我找到了全部四颗珠子。我告诉你，这可不容易。

english: Hello there. Swapping heads with vegetables, you say? Have we got a cabbage head on our hands?
translation: 你好啊。你说用蔬菜调换脑袋？我们手上是不是有个卷心菜脑袋？

english: Ah yes. I know many young wizards who have attempted that spell and failed. They tend to be arrogant and take on more than they can handle.
translation: 啊，没错。我认识很多年轻魔法师尝试过那个法术都失败了。他们往往自视过高，承担了超出能力范围的事。

english: Once a year, around this time, the witch Eve shows up. Little is known about her. Some say that she's been around for longer than any of us.
translation: 每年这个时候，女巫夏娃会出现。关于她人们所知甚少。有人说她存在的时间比我们任何人都长。

english: Like I said, she only shows up once a year, but it should be around this time.
translation: 就像我说的，她一年只出现一次，但应该就是这个时候。

english: Sadly there's nothing I can do. There's only one person who knows that kind of magic well enough. Her name is Eve.
translation: 遗憾的是我无能为力。只有一个人足够精通那种魔法。她的名字叫夏娃。

english: Ah, it should be tonight! What a coincidence. She sometimes sets up camp east of here, along the west coast of the Lumbridge Swamp.
translation: 啊，应该就是今晚！真巧。她有时会在这里以东、仑桥镇沼泽西岸扎营。

english: My pleasure, [player name]. Be careful out there. Not all who go to see Eve return.
translation: 不客气，[player name]。外面小心。去找夏娃的人并非都能回来。

english: Are you saying that you stole my beads all this time and I've been blaming these imps!?
translation: 你是说一直以来都是你偷了我的珠子，而我一直在责怪这些小恶魔！？

english: The last wizard who got his head swapped like that couldn't get it back for months.
translation: 上一个像这样被调换了脑袋的魔法师，几个月都没能换回来。

english: And that she knows a lot about old magic that is mostly lost to us now.
translation: 而且她对古老魔法了解很多，这些魔法我们大多已经失传了。

english: Eve only shows up around this time of year. She is said to appear along the west coast of the Lumbridge Swamp.
translation: 夏娃只在每年这个时候出现。据说她会出现在仑桥镇沼泽的西岸。

english: Well, I'm no expert when it comes to witches, but... with how long she's been around, people are speculating that she might be dead.
translation: 嗯，说到女巫我可不是专家，但是……她存在这么久，人们猜测她可能已经死了。

english: Well, yes. Possibly. Dead and come back to life for this one day a year. That's what they say anyway. Personally I think that sounds ridiculous.
translation: 嗯，是的。有可能。死了然后在每年这一天复活。反正他们是这么说的。我个人觉得这听起来很荒谬。

english: Rick? So he's the pumpkin head? I won't let him forget that one!
translation: 里克？所以他就是南瓜头？我可不会让他忘了这事！

english: You don't seem to have one of each coloured bead on you at the moment. Return when you have a black, white, yellow and red in your backpack!
translation: 你手头似乎没有每种颜色的珠子各一颗。等你背包里有黑色、白色、黄色和红色珠子时再来吧！

english: Did you really? What was she like?
translation: 你真的见到了？她是什么样？

english: Party? Did you party with an undead witch?
translation: 派对？你和不死女巫一起开派对了？

english: Did it really? That's great news. Now I don't have to feel bad for making fun of his pumpkin head.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了。现在我不用因为取笑他的南瓜头而感到内疚了。

english: Not that it stopped me, of course. It's just that now I don't have to feel bad about it.
translation: 当然，这并没有阻止我。只是现在我不必为此感到内疚了。

english: The imps stole all sorts of my things. Most of these things I don't really care about, just eggs and balls of string and things.
translation: 小恶魔偷了我各种各样的东西。这些东西大多数我其实并不在意，不过是些蛋、线团之类的东西。
你做得很好，Vel！

english: You're back. Any luck in Canifis?
translation: 你回来了。在坎尼非斯村有收获吗？

english: I went back to the place where I first met Vanstrom. He was gone though.
translation: 我回到了第一次遇见范斯特罗姆的地方。但他已经不在了。

english: I feared as much. Worry not though. The day will come when we get our revenge on him and the rest of his kind.
translation: 我就担心是这样。不过别担心，总有一天我们会向他和他那些同类复仇的。

english: Anyway, now that you're back, there was something I was hoping you'd help us with.
translation: 好了，既然你回来了，有件事我想请你帮忙。

english: Now that our base of operations is no longer safe, we're going to need to relocate before the vyrewatch descend on us.
translation: 现在我们的行动基地已经不安全了，我们必须在吸血鬼哨兵找上门之前转移。

english: Seems like a wise move. What part do I play?
translation: 听起来很明智。我需要做什么？

english: To the south of Mort'ton there's an old town known as Burgh de Rott. The place was abandoned but I hear some escapees from Meiyerditch have made their home there.
translation: 在莫顿镇南边有一座叫伯格德罗特镇的老镇子。那里曾经被遗弃，但我听说有些从迈尔迪奇逃出来的人在那里安了家。

english: And you want me to scout the place out?
translation: 你是想让我去探探路？

english: Exactly. Head down to Burgh de Rott and see if you can find a suitable place for our new hideout. While you're there, do what you can to forge a good relationship with the townspeople.
translation: 没错。前往伯格德罗特镇，看看能否为我们的新藏身处找个合适的地方。你在那里的时候，尽力与镇民建立良好的关系。

english: I'll get it done.
translation: 交给我吧。

english: Be sure to take a weapon of silver with you. You'll find it of great use if vampyres attack. Good luck to you.
translation: 记得带上一把银制武器。如果吸血鬼攻击你，它会派上大用场。祝你好运。

english: Sorry. I'm not interested.
translation: 抱歉，我没兴趣。

english: Very well. You know where we are if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。如果你改变主意了，知道我们在哪儿。

english: Well met, [player name].
translation: 幸会，[player name]。

english: Head to Burgh de Rott and see if the town has a suitable location for our new hideout. While you're there, do what you can to forge a good relationship with the townspeople.
translation: 前往伯格德罗特镇，看看镇上是否有适合我们新藏身处的地点。你在那里的时候，尽力与镇民建立良好的关系。

english: You'll find the town just south of Mort'ton. Good luck.
translation: 镇子就在莫顿镇南边。祝你好运。

english: Get out of it! You're not having our food or our blood!
translation: 滚开！你休想拿走我们的食物或血！

english: Get out of it! You ain't commingin here to get our blood or our food!
translation: 滚开！你甭想进来抢我们的血或食物！

english: What on earth makes you think I want your food or your blood?
translation: 你到底凭什么觉得我会想要你们的食物或血？

english: Hey! Don't try to sweet talk me. I know you want something! But we got nothing! Nothing!
translation: 嘿！别想跟我套近乎。我知道你想要东西！但我们什么都没有！什么都没有！

english: What blood we've got, we're keeping for ourselves! You can tell that stinking Vanstrom to go suck a cow's udder!
translation: 我们仅有的血要留给自己！你回去告诉那个臭烘烘的范斯特罗姆，让他去吸牛的乳头！

english: And as for food, why we've barely got enough to feed ourselves. So you ain't having none!
translation: 至于食物，我们连自己都不够吃。所以你别想得到任何东西！

english: This is our town! We live here. It's called Burgh de Rott, and you ain't coming in!
translation: 这是我们的镇子！我们住在这里。它叫伯格德罗特镇，你不准进来！

english: Where did you all come from?
translation: 你们都是从哪里来的？

english: We escaped from the vampyres. They had us trapped in Meiyerditch to drink our blood! Yuck!
translation: 我们从吸血鬼那里逃了出来。他们把我们困在迈尔迪奇，喝我们的血！恶心！

english: What's Meiyerditch?
translation: 迈尔迪奇是什么地方？

english: As if you don't know! It's that dark city to the east where humans are kept like animals to feed those greedy evil vampyres!
translation: 你装什么不知道！就是东边那座黑暗的城市，人类像牲口一样被关在那里，供养那些贪婪邪恶的吸血鬼！

english: Sounds like an awful place! Let me in and I'll help you!
translation: 听起来是个可怕的地方！让我进去，我可以帮你们！

english: Yeah, okay then eh! No way! You can't trick me like that!
translation: 哼，还装好人！没门！你休想骗我！

english: Why would I want your blood?
translation: 我为什么要你们的血？

english: Yourprobably one of them stinking vampyres in disguise! You ain't coming in!
translation: 你八成是那些臭烘烘的吸血鬼假扮的！不准进来！

english: I don't want your blood!
translation: 我不要你们的血！

english: We don't care. You probably want our food then, so you ain't coming in!
translation: 我们不在乎。那你肯定是想要我们的食物，所以不准进来！

english: Why would I want your food?
translation: 我为什么要你们的食物？

english: You probably want to eat it all and we ain't gonna let you!
translation: 你肯定想全部吃光，我们不会让你得逞！

english: But I don't want to eat your food. I'm plenty healthy enough!
translation: 可我不想吃你们的食物。我自己吃得够饱了！

english: Well, that's as maybe, but yous probably wants to drink ours blood! And you aint having it and you aint coming in!
translation: 那也说不定，但你八成是想喝我们的血！你休想得到，也休想进来！

english: Blimey, did you see that? [He/She] put some food in the chest for us! [He/She]'s probably not after anything!
translation: 哎呀，你看到了吗？[He/She]把一些食物放进了箱子里给我们！[He/She]大概不是来打我们主意的！

english: Hey, what did you put in that chest? Is it something tasty, like a nice cooked snail? Or perhaps a well matured piece of cheese with some fresh bread? Ohhh, I bet it's dead tasty...
translation: 嘿，你在箱子里放了什么？是好吃的东西吗，比如一只煮得不错的蜗牛？或者一块陈年乳酪配新鲜面包？噢，我打赌一定很好吃……

english: Not so bad.
translation: 还不错。

english: How come you have no food?
translation: 你们怎么没有食物？

english: Well obviously we just don't seem to get out to the shops like we used to!
translation: 很明显，我们没法像以前那样去商店买东西了！

english: We can only stay in the village and there's precious little food in here, just rats to live on! Not very appetising.
translation: 我们只能待在村子里，里面几乎没什么食物，只能靠吃老鼠维生！一点都不美味。

english: There's also nowhere to store any food around here, the town is incredibly run down.
translation: 而且这里也没有地方储存食物，整个镇子破败不堪。

english: We dare not leave the town for fear that the vampyres might spot us and force us to pay a blood tithe.
translation: 我们不敢离开镇子，生怕被吸血鬼发现，被迫缴纳血税。

english: We're all very weak and would most likely die if they took more blood from us.
translation: 我们都很虚弱，如果他们再抽我们的血，我们很可能会死。

english: This is our town! We's live here. It's called Burgh de Rott. It aint much to look at, but it's our home.
translation: 这是我们的镇子！我们住在这里。它叫伯格德罗特镇。虽然不怎么好看，但这是我们的家。

english: My name's [citizen name]. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: 我叫[citizen name]。我什么都干一点。就是想活下去，其实我们也做不了别的。

english: Oh, my name's [citizen name]. I just help out around here, you know, looking for food and so on.
translation: 哦，我叫[citizen name]。我就在这儿帮忙，你知道的，找找食物什么的。

english: Not that it makes much difference but my name's [citizen name]. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: 虽然说了也没什么用，但我的名字是[citizen name]。和其他幸存者一样，我只是努力凑合着过，一天一天挨过去。

english: Oh hi. I'm [citizen name]. I hunt rats mostly. Speaking of which, this rat tastes awful, but it's the only food we have!
translation: 哦你好。我是[citizen name]。我主要是抓老鼠。说到这个，这老鼠的味道真难吃，但这是我们唯一的食物了！

english: Huh? I'm [citizen name]. Ravaging after food is what I mostly do. Ocasionally I'll happen across a rat, and that's a good day, just like today!
translation: 嗯？我是[citizen name]。我主要就是到处找食物。偶尔能碰到一只老鼠，那就是好日子了，就像今天！

english: Oh, hello. [Citizen name] is the name and I help to keep the village clear of rat infestations. Clearly I love my work, as I bring it home with me... On a stick!
translation: 哦，你好。我叫[Citizen name]，负责清理村里的老鼠。显然我很热爱我的工作，因为我把它带回家了……串在棍子上！

english: I'm [citizen name]. I'm just trying to stay warm.
translation: 我是[citizen name]。我只想尽量保持暖和。

english: I'm Elisabeta, the village leader.
translation: 我是伊丽莎白，村里的领袖。

english: I'm Teodor. I'm a farmer. Not that there's much to grow here.
translation: 我是提奥多尔。我是个农夫。不过这里也没什么好种的。

english: I'm Aurel, the village store owner.
translation: 我是奥雷尔，村里的杂货店老板。

english: I'm sorry my friend, but I cannot open a store which has no stock.
translation: 抱歉，朋友，我不能开一家没有货物的店。

english: I'm Cornelius. I don't really do anything here.
translation: 我是科尼利厄斯。我在这儿其实什么也不做。

english: I'm Gabriela. I'm looking after my husband who isn't feeling too well!
translation: 我是加布里埃拉。我在照顾我的丈夫，他身体不太舒服！

english: Are there any 'out of the way' places here?
translation: 这里有没有什么‘偏僻的地方’？

english: How do you mean, 'out of the way'?
translation: 什么叫‘偏僻的地方’？

english: Somewhere where myself and a couple of friends could hold up for a while without attracting any vampyre attention?
translation: 就是我和几个朋友能暂时躲一阵子，不引起吸血鬼注意的地方？

english: Ah, right, I know what you mean. Hmm, let's think now...
translation: 啊，明白了。嗯，让我想想……

english: Well, there's the inn. You could look there I suppose. The cellar would have been useful, but the trapdoor down to it is covered with rubble from a broken wall.
translation: 嗯，有个旅馆。我想你可以去看看。地下室本来挺有用的，但通往那里的活板门被破损的墙壁掉下来的瓦砾盖住了。

english: The cellar itself is probably filled with rubble as well. But you may be able to do something with it.
translation: 地下室本身可能也堆满了瓦砾。不过你也许能处理一下。

english: That could work. Thanks.
translation: 应该可以。谢谢。

english: Listen, if you do decide to join us here, we'll expect you to contribute. You know, help to fix things up a bit.
translation: 听着，如果你决定加入我们，我们希望你能出一份力。你知道的，帮忙修缮一下。

english: Sorry. I shouldn't talk to strangers.
translation: 抱歉，我不该和陌生人说话。

english: Hey there. So you're looking to clear out the cellar at the inn? How's it going?
translation: 嘿，你好。看来你是想清理旅馆的地下室？进度如何？

english: Not so bad, but it's a lot of hard work to be honest.
translation: 还行，不过说实话，活儿挺重的。

english: Oh well, I'm sure you can manage.
translation: 哦，我相信你能搞定的。

english: Hey there, I'm finished with my project at the inn.
translation: 嘿，旅馆的工程我完工了。

english: Oh, that's good to know.
translation: 哦，那太好了。

english: What do you think of your town?
translation: 你觉得你们的镇子怎么样？

english: It's barely a town. I mean, not exactly a breeding ground for high society is it?
translation: 这还算不上个镇子。我的意思是，这可不是培养上流社会的地方，对吧？

english: At least we can hide from the vampyres here though. Hopefully we can start to get things up and running soon. You know, some of the trappings of normal life.
translation: 不过至少我们在这里能躲开吸血鬼。希望能尽快让一切运转起来。你懂的，过上一点正常生活的样子。

english: I'd like to help fix up the town.
translation: 我愿意帮忙修缮镇子。

english: Oh, that's very kind of you!
translation: 哦，你真是太好了！

english: Perhaps you'd consider fixing up the general store. Go and have a chat with Aurel if you want more details.
translation: 也许你愿意帮忙修缮一下杂货店。想了解更多细节的话，去找奥雷尔聊聊。

english: Hmm, sounds interesting.
translation: 嗯，听起来挺有意思的。

english: Yeah, what can I do ya for?
translation: 嗨，有什么能帮你的？

english: Hi there. You've done a good job on my store! It's starting to look great!
translation: 你好。你把我的店修得不错！越来越像样了！

english: Yeah, but I've only fixed the roof and the walls.
translation: 是啊，但我只修了屋顶和墙壁。

english: Hello, I wonder if I could ask a few questions?
translation: 你好，我能问几个问题吗？

english: It's looking better since you fixed my store, that's for sure. It would be good to get some stock in as well though.
translation: 自从你修了我的店，看起来好多了，这是肯定的。不过要是能进点货就更好了。

english: Just some basic commodities, nothing too fancy like.
translation: 只是一些基本商品，不用太花哨的那种。

english: How did everyone come to be here?
translation: 大家是怎么来到这里的？

english: We managed to escape from Meiyerditch where we were being farmed as food for the vampyres.
translation: 我们设法从迈尔迪奇逃了出来，那里的人被当成吸血鬼的食物来饲养。

english: Meiyerditch?
translation: 迈尔迪奇？

english: That's right. It's part of the Sanguinesti region to the east of here.
translation: 没错。它是东边桑吉内斯蒂地区的一部分。

english: Perhaps you would consider helping to fix up my general store. It certainly could do with sorting out.
translation: 你愿意帮忙修缮我的杂货店吗？它确实需要整理一下。

english: What needs fixing?
translation: 需要修什么？

english: Please can you fix the roof, then the walls. Once that's done, come and have a chat with me regarding the stores stock.
translation: 麻烦你先修屋顶，再修墙壁。修好之后，过来找我聊聊店里的存货。

english: Yes I know. You said you'd help fix up my general store!
translation: 是的我知道。你说过你会帮忙修我的杂货店的！

english: Oh! Right, did I? Where was I?
translation: 哦！对，我说过吗？我说到哪儿了？

english: Well, I'm not sure. Could you take a look at the roof and then look at the walls. Once you've done that come and have a chat with me.
translation: 嗯，我不太确定。你能先看看屋顶，再看看墙壁吗？修好之后过来找我聊聊。

english: I thought you were fixing up my general store? First fix the roof, then the walls. After that, come and have a chat with me.
translation: 你不是在修我的杂货店吗？先修屋顶，再修墙壁。之后来找我聊聊。

english: Well you could stock the store for us. We'd really start looking like a town then.
translation: 嗯，你可以帮我们进货。那样我们这儿才真正像个镇子了。

english: What stock do you need?
translation: 你需要什么货物？

english: I need 3 tinderboxes, 10 snails of any type/raw mackerel and 10 bronze axes.
translation: 我需要3个火绒盒，10只任意类型的蜗牛/生鲭鱼，以及10把铜斧头。

english: There you go. You can put them in that.
translation: 给你。你可以把它们放进那个里面。

english: You need to collect 10 bronze axes, 10 [snails of any type/raw mackerel] and 3 tinderboxes.
translation: 你需要收集10把青铜斧头、10条[snails of any type/raw mackerel]和3个火绒盒。

english: It's coming together now. The store is looking nicer now that it's been fixed up a bit. It would be better with some stock in it though.
translation: 现在有点样子了。稍微修整一下后，这家店看起来好多了。不过要是有点存货就更好了。

english: I thought you were helping Aurel stock his store?
translation: 你不是在帮奥雷尔给他的店补货吗？

english: Wow, that's fantastic. Well done! You're doing a great job.
translation: 哇，太棒了。干得好！你做得非常出色。

english: Hey, you've done such a great job for me. Would you consider helping us fix up the bank as well?
translation: 嘿，你为我做得太好了。你愿意也帮我们修好银行吗？

english: I can probably look into it.
translation: 我可以考虑一下。

english: Hey it's you! You're doing a great job with the town! It's really getting a lot better!
translation: 嘿，是你！你把小镇打理得真好！情况真的好转了很多！

english: I'm happy to help!
translation: 我很乐意帮忙！

english: It's a lot better now that we have a general store, you're doing a great job! What a hero!
translation: 有了杂货店之后好多了，你干得太棒了！真是个英雄！

english: Oh, I think it's going great. We're all so pleased with the work you're doing, but there's still lots left to do.
translation: 哦，我觉得进展很顺利。我们都对你所做的工作非常满意，但还有很多事情要做。

english: It would be good if you could fix the bank up. I'd suggest starting with the bank booth first.
translation: 如果你能修好银行就好了。我建议先从银行柜台开始。

english: You need to fix up the bank. If the booth is done then you should move onto the wall.
translation: 你需要修好银行。如果柜台修好了，那你就该去修那堵墙了。

english: Well, the bank is all fixed now, but it isn't going to serve people all on its own. You'll have to recruit someone!
translation: 嗯，银行现在都修好了，但它自己可没法服务别人。你得招募个人来！

english: Do you fancy the job?
translation: 你想干这份工作吗？

english: Me? Why, I guess I could... Yes, in fact, I'm sure I could!
translation: 我？嗯，我想我可以……是的，事实上，我肯定我能行！

english: I'd best go and get changed now...
translation: 我最好现在就去换衣服……

english: Hello there. Thank you so much for all of your work so far. We all really appreciate it.
translation: 你好。非常感谢你到目前为止所做的一切。我们都很感激。

english: Oh it's brilliant, but we could really do with somewhere to melt down the local ores. Maybe you could fix up the furnace?
translation: 哦，这太棒了，但我们真的很需要有个地方来熔炼当地的矿石。也许你能修好熔炉？

english: Why does everyone stay in this town?
translation: 为什么大家都留在这个镇上？

english: It's safer here than anywhere else in Morytania. I guess we could try and escape across the Salve but those horrible ghasts in Mort Myre would probably just eat us alive!
translation: 这里比莫利塔尼亚任何其他地方都安全。我想我们可以试着逃过萨尔维河，但莫特迈尔那些可怕的食尸鬼大概会把我们活活吃掉！

english: You've already done quite a lot and we're all super grateful. That said, I overheard someone saying how great it would be if the old furnace were up and working again.
translation: 你已经做了很多，我们都非常感激。话说回来，我无意中听到有人说，要是旧熔炉能重新运转起来就好了。

english: Gadderanks.
translation: 加德兰克斯。

english: My lord... We've finished our latest round of tithing. I'm afraid we haven't been able to collect the desired amount.
translation: 我的大人……我们完成了最新一轮的征税。恐怕我们没能收集到所需的数额。

english: I saw your wife today, Gadderanks. She's well.
translation: 我今天看到你妻子了，加德兰克斯。她很好。

english: I hope she stays that way.
translation: 我希望她能一直这样。

english: My lord Vanstrom, there are precious few human settlements left worth collecting tithes from.
translation: 我的大人范斯特罗姆，值得征收血税的人类定居点已经所剩无几了。

english: Mort'ton is just a dead town, full of afflicted. Lord Malak was so ill when he drank of them last time.
translation: 莫顿镇只是个死镇，到处都是被折磨者。上次马拉克大人吸食他们的血时病得很重。

english: Canifis is delivering more than expected but that still isn't sufficient.
translation: 坎尼非斯村交出的比预期的多，但那仍然不够。

english: Please, where should I get the remainder from?
translation: 求求您，我该从哪里弄到剩下的？

english: I couldn't care less for your problems Gadderanks. Just do the job you've been appointed to do.
translation: 我才不管你的问题，加德兰克斯。做好你被指派的工作就行了。

english: Wait... Do you smell that? Smoke. It's coming from Burgh de Rott.
translation: 等等……你闻到那个味道了吗？烟雾。是从伯格德罗特镇传来的。

english: But Burgh de Rott is abandoned.
translation: 但伯格德罗特镇已经废弃了。

english: No. Burgh de Rott was abandoned. That is clearly no longer the case.
translation: 不。伯格德罗特镇曾经是废弃的。但现在显然不是这样了。

english: It seems you have a fresh appointment, Gadderanks. I hope there will be no more delay.
translation: 看来你有了新的任务，加德兰克斯。我希望不要再有延误了。

english: It's Gadderanks! He's found us!
translation: 是加德兰克斯！他发现我们了！

english: Well done big shot! The smoke from the furnace attracted Gadderanks and his juvinates!
translation: 干得好啊大人物！熔炉的烟雾引来了加德兰克斯和他的年轻吸血鬼！

english: Well done big shot! The smoke from the furnace attracted Gadderanks and his juvinates. They've set up a blood tithing station in the general store!
translation: 干得好啊大人物！熔炉的烟雾引来了加德兰克斯和他的年轻吸血鬼。他们在杂货店里设了一个血税征收站！

english: Who's Gadderanks?
translation: 加德兰克斯是谁？

english: He's some human lackie for the vampyres. His job is to collect blood tithes from all the villages around here. He goes around with his juvinate bodyguards because he's too weak to defend himself.
translation: 他是吸血鬼的一个人类走狗。他的工作是从这附近所有的村庄收集血税。他带着他的年轻吸血鬼保镖到处走，因为他太弱了，保护不了自己。

english: What's a juvinate?
translation: 什么是年轻吸血鬼？

english: A form of vampyre. They're stronger than juveniles but not as bad as a full-blown vyre. Still, no one that I've seen has ever gotten the better of one.
translation: 吸血鬼的一种形态。他们比少年吸血鬼强，但不如完全体的维尔吸血鬼那么厉害。不过，我还没见过有人能胜过他们。

english: If I were you, I'd get out of town. Now that Gadderanks is here, I doubt many people will stay around!
translation: 我要是你，我就离开镇子。既然加德兰克斯来了，我怀疑没多少人会留下来！

english: Maybe I can stop him.
translation: 也许我能阻止他。

english: Ha! In your dreams. He's right here if you want to give it a go. It's your funeral though!
translation: 哈！做梦去吧。他就在这儿，如果你想试试的话。不过这可是你的葬礼！

english: Ha! In your dreams. He's set up in the general store if you want to give it a go. It's your funeral though!
translation: 哈！做梦去吧。他在杂货店里安顿下来了，如果你想试试的话。不过这可是你的葬礼！

english: Oh happy days! It's so good we found all these specimens here! If it hadn't been for some good soul lighting that furnace, we'd have never come down here!
translation: 哦，快乐的日子！我们在这里找到所有这些标本真是太好了！要不是某个好心人点燃了那个熔炉，我们根本不会到这里来！

english: Now I should be able to make my blood tithe quota... especially after you pay your tithe. You look like an incredibly fit specimen!
translation: 现在我应该能完成我的血税配额了……尤其是在你缴完税之后。你看起来是个非常健壮的标本！

english: I bet you could pay twice as much as the others before passing out!
translation: 我打赌你在昏倒之前能比其他人多交两倍的血！

english: I don't have any intentions of paying a blood tithe!
translation: 我没有任何缴纳血税的打算！

english: Ha! We'll see about that!
translation: 哈！我们走着瞧！

english: We're getting some delicious blood tithes from these sacks of food. Yum!
translation: 我们从这些食物麻袋里收取了一些美味的血税。好吃！

english: They're draining my blood, that's what they're doing!
translation: 他们在抽我的血，他们就是在干这个！

english: I've had enough of you poking your nose in here! If you think you can stop us, go ahead!
translation: 我受够了你在这里多管闲事！如果你觉得你能阻止我们，那就来吧！

english: Fear not my friend! I will come to your aid!
translation: 别怕，我的朋友！我会来帮你的！

english: Huh, it looks like Gadderanks is still alive. Perhaps he's ready to give us some information before he meets his maker.
translation: 嗯，看来加德兰克斯还活着。也许他准备好在他去见造物主之前给我们一些信息了。

english: You don't look too well, Gadderanks. Against my better judgement, I feel sorry for you.
translation: 你看起来不太好，加德兰克斯。虽然我不该这么想，但我还是为你感到难过。

english: You... You do?
translation: 你……你为我感到难过？

english: Yes, I do. I understand that you wanted to feel strong, but you took the wrong side.
translation: 是的，我确实为你感到难过。我理解你想变得强大，但你站错了队。

english: But... you don't understand. I just didn't want my family... I wanted to keep them safe.
translation: 但是……你不明白。我只是不想让我的家人……我想保护他们的安全。

english: You need to take a second and think of them then. Think of why you did this in the first place. All of that will count for nothing if you don't help us!
translation: 那你需要花点时间想想他们。想想你最初为什么要这么做。如果你不帮助我们，这一切都将毫无意义！

english: Then... will you do me a favour? Please, try to save them. Please! I beg you!
translation: 那么……你能帮我一个忙吗？求求你，试着救救他们。求你了！我求你了！

english: You have my word. If we find them, we'll take care of them.
translation: 我向你保证。如果我们找到他们，我们会照顾他们的。

english: Thank you. I have some information which may help you...
translation: 谢谢你。我有一些信息可能对你有帮助……

english: They fear some things. Silver dust and garlic to name a couple. Also outlawed are *cough* -ralander and *cough* -ders eggs. The potion which you make with them is also forbidden.
translation: 他们害怕一些东西。银粉和大蒜就是其中两样。另外被禁止的是*咳* -拉兰德的蛋和*咳* -德斯的蛋。用它们制作的药水也是被禁止的。

english: Take it easy Gadderanks. Let's see if we can sort you out.
translation: 放松点，加德兰克斯。让我们看看能不能帮你。

english: It's too late for me *cough*. Though with what I've told you *cough*, perhaps you can find a way to *cough* bring light to Morytania.
translation: 对我来说太晚了*咳*。不过，有了我告诉你的信息*咳*，也许你能找到一种方法*咳*给莫利塔尼亚带来光明。

english: Hey there! Gadderanks dropped this warhammer, I guess it belongs to you now!
translation: 嘿！加德兰克斯掉了这把战锤，我想它现在属于你了！

english: Phew! Thanks for your help Veliaf. It sure was good of you to turn up.
translation: 呼！谢谢你的帮助，维利亚夫。你出现真是太好了。

english: Don't mention it. Have you had any luck with finding us a new hideout?
translation: 别客气。你找到我们的新藏身处了吗？

english: I have. The cellar of the inn here should work perfectly.
translation: 找到了。这里旅馆的地窖应该很合适。

english: Excellent! Now, I must return to the Hollows. Please, meet me there so we can arrange getting everyone down here safely.
translation: 太好了！现在，我必须回到霍洛斯。请到那里与我会合，这样我们就能安排把所有人都安全地送到这里。

english: Well met, friend. Glad you made it back in one piece.
translation: 幸会，朋友。很高兴你平安回来了。

english: Likewise. So, what happens now?
translation: 彼此彼此。那么，现在怎么办？

english: Do you know of Drezel?
translation: 你知道德雷泽尔吗？

english: The priest at Paterdomus? Yes, I've helped him out before.
translation: 帕特多姆斯的那位祭司？是的，我以前帮过他。

english: Ah, excellent. Well Drezel is an old friend and he's agreed to do us a favour. Ivan is too young and inexperienced to be out here with us. He also aspires to be a priest himself.
translation: 啊，太好了。德雷泽尔是我的老朋友，他同意帮我们一个忙。伊万太年轻，经验不足，不能和我们一起待在这里。而且他自己也想成为一名祭司。

english: Drezel has agreed to take him in and train him. Once he is older and wiser, he can rejoin our fight as a spiritual advisor.
translation: 德雷泽尔同意收留他并训练他。等他长大懂事一些，他就可以作为精神顾问重新加入我们的战斗。

english: Myself, Polmafi and Radigad will soon be heading down to Burgh de Rott. While we do so, I'd appreciate it if you could escort Ivan to Paterdomus.
translation: 我、波尔马菲和拉迪加德很快就要前往伯格德罗特镇。在此期间，如果你能护送伊万去帕特多姆斯，我会很感激。

english: I'm sure I can manage that.
translation: 我想我能做到。

english: Thank you. There's something else I could use your help with as well.
translation: 谢谢你。还有一件事我也需要你的帮助。

english: I'm sure you've noticed by now that our weapons have limited use against the vampyres. Even weapons made of silver only go so far. If we're to have any hope of beating their kind, we'll need to address this problem.
translation: 我相信你现在已经注意到，我们的武器对吸血鬼的作用有限。即使是银制的武器也只能做到这一步。如果我们想有任何希望打败他们这类生物，我们就需要解决这个问题。

english: If you've met Drezel, then I've no doubt that he's told you the tale of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the Salve and saved Misthalin.
translation: 如果你见过德雷泽尔，那么我肯定他告诉过你关于七位祭司勇士的故事，他们祝福了萨尔维河并拯救了米斯萨林。

english: He has indeed.
translation: 他确实告诉过我。

english: Well I have heard rumour that one of these warriors, a man called Ivandis Seergaze, used a weapon of great power against the vampyres. I have also heard that he isn't actually buried at Paterdomus with the others.
translation: 嗯，我听到传闻说，其中一位勇士，一个叫伊万迪斯.西尔盖兹的人，曾使用过一种威力强大的武器对付吸血鬼。我还听说他实际上并没有和其他人一起葬在帕特多姆斯。

english: I see. And you'd like me to look into this?
translation: 我明白了。你想让我调查这件事？

english: If you could, my friend, you would have my gratitude. Drezel will likely know more, though I find he isn't always forthcoming where rumours are involved.
translation: 如果你能的话，我的朋友，我会非常感激。德雷泽尔可能知道得更多，不过我发现他对于传闻并不总是那么直言不讳。

english: I'll see what I can dig up.
translation: 我会看看能挖出些什么。

english: Before you go, do you mind telling Polmafi and Radigad that it's time for us to depart.
translation: 在你走之前，你介意去告诉波尔马菲和拉迪加德，我们该出发了吗？

english: Well met. Do you need something?
translation: 幸会。你需要什么吗？

english: First, let Polmafi and Radigad know that it's time for us to depart. After you've done that, please could you escort Ivan to Paterdomus.
translation: 首先，让波尔马菲和拉迪加德知道我们该出发了。做完之后，请护送伊万去帕特多姆斯。

english: Once you're there, Drezel might be able to help you with this Ivandis business.
translation: 到了那里之后，德雷泽尔也许能帮你处理伊万迪斯那件事。

english: Please could you escort Ivan to Paterdomus. Once you're there, Drezel might be able to help you with this Ivandis business.
translation: 请护送伊万去帕特多姆斯。到了那里之后，德雷泽尔也许能帮你处理伊万迪斯那件事。

english: What do you make of what Gadderanks said?
translation: 你怎么看加德兰克斯说的话？

english: It could be a load of rubbish, but it may be worth looking into. I recognise at least two of the items he mentioned as ingredients for a potion.
translation: 可能是一堆废话，但也值得调查一下。我认出他提到的至少两样东西是药水的原料。

english: The mention of garlic and silver is interesting though. We know vampyres are weak to both. The way he talked though suggests they could be used in a potion as well.
translation: 不过，提到大蒜和银粉很有意思。我们知道吸血鬼对这两样东西都很脆弱。但他说话的方式暗示它们也可以用在药水里。

english: How would I test that?
translation: 我该怎么测试呢？

english: A good question my friend, but I have no answer for you. Perhaps you could experiment?
translation: 好问题，我的朋友，但我没有答案给你。也许你可以实验一下？

english: Why does Ivan need to go to Paterdomus?
translation: 为什么伊万需要去帕特多姆斯？

english: He'll be safer there under the eye of Drezel. Drezel can help him further his spiritual skills so that when he is older and wiser, he can rejoin the fight.
translation: 他在德雷泽尔的照看下会更安全。德雷泽尔能帮他提升灵性技能，这样等他长大懂事些，就能重新加入战斗。

english: Tell me more about Ivandis.
translation: 多跟我说说伊万迪斯的事。

english: Long ago, the Seven Priestly Warriors drove the vampyre forces out of Misthalin and blessed the Salve so that they'd never be able to return.
translation: 很久以前，七位祭司战士将吸血鬼势力逐出了米斯塔林，并祝福了萨尔维河，让他们永远无法返回。

english: Now, the priests of Saradomin would have you believe that all seven are buried beneath Paterdomus. However, I have heard rumour that one of the warriors, Ivandis Seergaze, is actually buried elsewhere.
translation: 现在，萨拉多明的祭司会让你相信，这七位全部埋葬在帕特多穆斯之下。然而，我听到传言说，其中一位战士，伊万迪斯.希尔盖兹，其实葬在其他地方。

english: So where is he buried instead?
translation: 那他葬在哪里呢？

english: He supposedly led countless charges into Morytania and ultimately perished somewhere within these lands. If that is the case, his followers would likely have buried him near the place he died.
translation: 据说他无数次领军冲入莫利塔尼亚，最终死在了这片土地上的某个地方。如果是这样，他的追随者很可能会把他葬在离他死去地点附近的地方。

english: The reason this is important is because it is said that Ivandis wielded a weapon of great power against the vampyres. If he died in Morytania, this weapon may have been buried with him.
translation: 这一点之所以重要，是因为据说伊万迪斯曾使用一件强大的武器对抗吸血鬼。如果他死在莫利塔尼亚，这件武器可能与他一同下葬了。

english: Hey there. I hear you're going to be taking me to the temple.
translation: 嘿，听说你要带我去神殿。

english: That's right. I just need to speak with Polmafi and Radigad and then we'll head off.
translation: 没错。我只需跟波尔马菲和拉迪加德说一声，然后我们就出发。

english: Hey. Veliaf says it's time to head down to the new hideout in Burgh de Rott. Could you let Radigad know as well? I'm taking Ivan to Paterdomus.
translation: 嘿。维利亚夫说该前往伯格德罗特镇的新藏身处了。你能顺便告诉拉迪加德吗？我要带伊万去帕特多穆斯。

english: Okay. Thanks for letting me know. I'll tell Radigad.
translation: 好的。谢谢告知。我会告诉拉迪加德。

english: Don't worry, I'm just getting my stuff together before leaving. Good luck with your trip to the temple.
translation: 别担心，我正收拾东西准备出发。祝你去神殿一路顺利。

english: Hey. Veliaf says it's time to head down to the new hideout in Burgh de Rott. Could you let Polmafi know as well? I'm taking Ivan to Paterdomus.
translation: 嘿。维利亚夫说该前往伯格德罗特镇的新藏身处了。你能顺便告诉波尔马菲吗？我要带伊万去帕特多穆斯。

english: Okay. Thanks for letting me know. I'll tell Polmafi.
translation: 好的。谢谢告知。我会告诉波尔马菲。

english: Thanks for the helmet! That's great! It's going to help a lot! I'm going to wear it under my normal clothes.
translation: 谢谢你的头盔！太棒了！会很有帮助！我会把它穿在普通衣服里面。

english: Thanks for the chainbody! That's great! It's going to help a lot! I'm going to wear it under my normal clothes.
translation: 谢谢你的链甲！太棒了！会很有帮助！我会把它穿在普通衣服里面。

english: Thanks for the steel legs! That's great! It's going to help a lot! I'm going to wear them under my normal clothes.
translation: 谢谢你的钢腿！太棒了！这会帮大忙！我会把它们穿在正常衣服里面。

english: You might find this sickle helpful on our travels.
translation: 这把镰刀在旅途中可能会帮上你的忙。

english: Many thanks friend, I shall endeavour to wield it as bravely as Veliaf and yourself!
translation: 多谢了朋友，我会努力像维利亚夫和你一样勇敢地挥舞它！

english: Ohh delicious, some food! I'll keep that for the trip. I could carry another [number] bits of food.
translation: 哦，真好吃，一些食物！我留着路上吃。我还能再带[number]份食物。

english: Ohh delicious, some food! I'll keep that for the trip. I'm totally stocked up with food now, thanks!
translation: 哦，真好吃，一些食物！我留着路上吃。我现在食物完全够了，谢谢！

english: Thanks for the kind offer of food, but my favourites are either cooked snails, salmon, slimy eel or stew!
translation: 谢谢你的食物好意，但我最喜欢的是熟蜗牛、鲑鱼、黏糊糊的鳗鱼或炖菜！

english: That's right. We should get going soon.
translation: 没错。我们该出发了。

english: Very well. I'm ready, lead the way.
translation: 很好。我准备好了，带路吧。

english: There's that tasty morsel Ivan! Time for some food...
translation: 那个美味的小点心伊万来了！该吃点东西了……

english: Let's get of this place... I'm scared!
translation: 我们离开这里吧……我好害怕！

english: Did those vampyres say they wanted to 'eat' me?
translation: 那些吸血鬼是说想“吃”我吗？

english: Food is the very last thing on my mind right now... let's get out of here!
translation: 我现在最不想考虑的就是食物……我们快离开这里！

english: I'm getting badly beaten up here, I'm going to die here if I stay...see you back at the old base.
translation: 我在这里被打得很惨，再待下去会死在这里……老据点见。

english: Many thanks for bringing me safely to the temple. I'm going to rush on ahead as I'm eager to get out of these muddy clothes.
translation: 非常感谢你安全带我来到神殿。我要赶紧进去，我急着想脱掉这些满是泥土的衣服。

english: Not a problem. I need to chat to Drezel about some things. I'll see you later.
translation: 没问题。我得跟德雷泽尔谈点事情。回头见。

english: Well done for bringing Ivan to the temple, [player name]. He will be much safer here.
translation: 干得好，你把伊万带到了神殿，[player name]。他在这里会安全得多。

english: Yes, it seems to be more dangerous in Morytania doesn't it?
translation: 是啊，莫利塔尼亚似乎越来越危险了，不是吗？

english: Indeed it does my friend. But thanks to you and the Myreque, we have at least the hope of finding salvation in this dark and oppressive land.
translation: 确实如此，我的朋友。但多亏了你和迈雷克，我们至少在这片黑暗压抑的土地上有了获得救赎的希望。

english: Veliaf told me about Ivandis.
translation: 维利亚夫跟我说了伊万迪斯的事。

english: Hmmm, how can I say this diplomatically. Veliaf is a good leader, but perhaps he shouldn't be voicing ideas about religious history.
translation: 嗯，我该怎么委婉地说呢。维利亚夫是个好领袖，但他或许不该对宗教历史发表看法。

english: But you don't even know what he said about Ivandis.
translation: 但你甚至不知道他说了伊万迪斯的什么。

english: I assume he's made suggestions that Ivandis isn't actually buried in this temple? If he has made such a claim, it's not something I'm prepared to talk about.
translation: 我猜他暗示伊万迪斯实际上并没有葬在这座神殿里？如果他有这样的说法，那不是我准备好要谈论的事情。

english: So, you're sure that Ivandis is buried here then?
translation: 那么，你确定伊万迪斯葬在这里吗？

english: If you don't mind me saying, that is a bit of a redundant question. All of the Seven Priestly Warriors are buried here, including Ivandis.
translation: 如果你不介意我这么说，这问题有点多余。七位祭司战士都葬在这里，包括伊万迪斯。

english: So where did this rumour that he's buried elsewhere come from then?
translation: 那他葬在别处的谣言是从哪里来的？

english: Rumours come from all kinds of places. They are rarely true. I am sorry to be so blunt, but I'm offended that you challenge me on this.
translation: 谣言来自四面八方。它们很少是真的。我很抱歉这么直白，但你在这件事上质疑我，我感到被冒犯。

english: What proof do you have that Ivandis is buried here?
translation: 你有什么证据证明伊万迪斯葬在这里？

english: Servants of Saradomin are not concerned with trifflingmatters such as proof. We have our faith, and our faith guides us.
translation: 萨拉多明的仆人不关心诸如证据之类的琐碎事情。我们有信仰，信仰指引着我们。

english: So you don't actually know for sure that he is buried here?
translation: 所以你其实并不确定他是否葬在这里？

english: Please, do not challenge me on matters of faith.
translation: 请别在信仰问题上挑战我。

english: What do you know about the history of this temple?
translation: 你对这座神殿的历史了解多少？

english: I know that it is built on the site where the Seven Priestly Warriors defended Misthalin against the evil vampyres. I also know that their sanctified and holy remains rest peacefully beneath us.
translation: 我知道它建在七位祭司战士抵御邪恶吸血鬼保卫米斯塔林的地点。我也知道他们神圣的遗骸安息在我们脚下。

english: Have you checked that then? Have you seen their remains with your own eyes?
translation: 那你检查过吗？你亲眼见过他们的遗骸吗？

english: Why would I need to? You'd have me dig up their blessed remains? For what?
translation: 我为什么需要检查？你让我挖出他们受祝福的遗骸？为了什么？

english: Is there somewhere that I might get more information on Ivandis?
translation: 有没有什么地方可以让我获得更多关于伊万迪斯的信息？

english: What little information there is, is probably already known to you.
translation: 仅有的那点信息，你大概已经知道了。

english: So you have no further information on him that could possibly help me? Anything you know might be of use in freeing the poor people of Morytania.
translation: 那你没有更多关于他的信息可能对我有帮助吗？你知道的任何事情也许能帮助解放莫利塔尼亚的可怜人民。

english: I have told you all I know. That is as much as I, or anyone, can do.
translation: 我已经告诉了你我所知道的一切。这是我，或任何人，能做的全部了。

english: Will you let me check Ivandis' tomb?
translation: 你能让我检查伊万迪斯的坟墓吗？

english: Absolutely not! What a disgrace that you should even ask! He rests pure and undisturbed beneath this hallowed earth!
translation: 绝对不行！你居然问得出口，真是耻辱！他纯净安详地长眠在这片圣地之下！

english: We need to consider every possible thing which could help us!
translation: 我们需要考虑一切可能帮助我们的事情！

english: I don't see how that can help you! And if you continue in this vein, it will certainly hinder you for you shall not have my support!
translation: 我不明白那怎么能帮到你！如果你继续这样，肯定会妨碍你，因为你将失去我的支持！

english: Why are you so resistant to talking about history?
translation: 你为什么这么抗拒谈论历史？

english: I am not resistant at all, my friend. I would happily talk history with you for as long as you desire. You do not wish to speak of history though, just rumours.
translation: 我一点也不抗拒，我的朋友。我很乐意和你聊历史，想聊多久都行。但你不想谈历史，只想谈谣言。

english: I think you're holding something back! We really need all the help we can get!
translation: 我觉得你在隐瞒什么！我们真的需要一切能得到的帮助！

english: I understand that my friend, but digging up the remains of saintly heroes will not aid us in any way!
translation: 我理解，我的朋友，但挖出圣洁英雄的遗骸对我们毫无帮助！

english: The lives of those pitiful few left in Morytania could rest on this!
translation: 莫利塔尼亚那些可怜人的性命可能就取决于此！

english: And you know I would do anything to help those people.
translation: 你知道我愿意为帮助那些人做任何事。

english: I know. So please, help me as much as you can.
translation: 我知道。所以请尽全力帮助我。

english: Very well, but there is only so much I can do. Remember that I am still a priest of Saradomin.
translation: 好吧，但我能做的有限。记住我仍是萨拉多明的祭司。

english: I know not if it will help, but please take this key. It will allow you access to a secret library here in the mausoleum. In there you may find what you're looking for, but I pray you never reveal this to me.
translation: 我不知道这是否有帮助，但请收下这把钥匙。它将允许你进入陵墓里的一间秘密图书馆。在那里你或许能找到你要找的东西，但我祈祷你永远不要向我透露此事。

english: Thank you, Drezel.
translation: 谢谢你，德雷泽尔。

english: Very well then. Morytania is lost to ignorance.
translation: 那好吧。莫利塔尼亚因无知而沦陷。

english: Not ignorance my friend. There are ways to save Morytania from the vampyres. This is not one of them.
translation: 不是无知，我的朋友。有办法把莫利塔尼亚从吸血鬼手中拯救出来。但这不是其中之一。

english: Thanks very much for your help. I really appreciate it.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助。我真的很感激。

english: I just hope that all our sacrifices are worth it.
translation: 我只希望我们所有的牺牲都是值得的。

english: Thanks for getting Ivan to Paterdomus safely. Let me know if you have any luck finding information on Ivandis.
translation: 谢谢你安全地把伊万送到帕特多穆斯。如果你找到伊万迪斯的信息，请告诉我。

english: I've found a library under Paterdomus.
translation: 我在帕特多穆斯下面发现了一个图书馆。

english: Well that can only be good news. I imagine it will contain all sorts of useful information. Do let me know if you find anything in there of note.
translation: 那只能是个好消息。我想里面会有各种有用的信息。如果你在里面发现什么值得注意的东西，一定要告诉我。

english: Do you know where Ivandis' tomb could be?
translation: 你知道伊万迪斯的坟墓可能在哪里吗？

english: Well if I knew where it was, I'd be there now.
translation: 如果我知道在哪里，我现在就在那里了。

english: Well yeah, but maybe you have a rough idea.
translation: 嗯，但也许你有个大致的想法。

english: I suspect he is buried somewhere in Morytania. He supposedly led countless charges into these lands and ultimately perished while doing so.
translation: 我怀疑他葬在莫利塔尼亚的某个地方。据说他无数次领军冲入这片土地，并最终在此丧生。

english: As for where in Morytania, I can't imagine he'd have made it too far from Paterdomus.
translation: 至于在莫利塔尼亚的哪里，我不觉得他能从帕特多穆斯走得太远。

english: What do you know about Ivandis?
translation: 关于伊万迪斯你知道些什么？

english: Ivandis Seergaze was one of the Seven Priestly Warriors. Along with the other six, he managed to hold back the vampyres when they attempted to invade Misthalin.
translation: 伊万迪斯.希尔盖兹是七位祭司战士之一。与其他六人一起，他在吸血鬼试图入侵米斯塔林时成功阻止了他们。

english: The seven of them were also responsible for blessing the Salve, preventing the vampyres from ever crossing.
translation: 他们七人也负责祝福萨尔维河，阻止吸血鬼永远无法渡过。

english: It is said that Ivandis wielded a great weapon against the vampyres. One that could render them immobile for a short time.
translation: 据说伊万迪斯曾使用一件强大的武器对抗吸血鬼。一件能让它们短暂无法动弹的武器。

english: There are also stories that credit him with the restoring of something called 'Guthix balance'.
translation: 还有一些故事说他恢复了某种叫做“古斯平衡”的东西。

english: Guthix? Interesting.
translation: 古斯？有意思。

english: Indeed. As the god of balance, it is said that Guthix will always try to ensure that both Saradomin and Zamorak do not gain an upper hand against the other.
translation: 确实。作为平衡之神，据说古斯总是努力确保萨拉多明和萨莫拉克不会互相占得上风。

english: Now, why a Saradominist warrior-priest is connected to him, I couldn't say.
translation: 至于为什么一位萨拉多明的战士祭司会与他有关联，我就说不上了。

english: Well met. How's it going?
translation: 幸会。进展如何？

english: I think I've found Ivandis' tomb.
translation: 我想我找到了伊万迪斯的坟墓。

english: That's great news! Hopefully you can find something of use in there.
translation: 真是好消息！希望你能在里面找到有用的东西。

english: There's just a coffin from what I can tell. There's some sort of rod fused to the top of it though.
translation: 据我所知只有一口棺材。不过棺材顶上嵌着一根某种棍棒。

english: A rod you say? This sounds like it could be the weapon we seek.
translation: 一根棍棒？听起来这可能是我们寻找的武器。

english: I suspect it is. I don't think there's any way to remove it though.
translation: 我怀疑是的。但我觉得没办法把它取下来。

english: I hope you are wrong about that. If we cannot break the mould of our historical defeats, we will never be able to stop Drakan.
translation: 我希望你说的是错的。如果我们不能打破历史上失败的定式，我们将永远无法阻止德雷坎。

english: Well, there's a coffin with some sort of rod fused to the top of it.
translation: 嗯，有一口棺材，顶上嵌着一根某种棍棒。

english: I don't think the rod can be removed. However, I made a clay mould of it so I might be able to make a new one.
translation: 我觉得那根棍棒取不下来。不过我用粘土做了个模具，也许能造个新的。

english: Excellent work. Let me know how it goes.
translation: 干得好。有进展告诉我。

english: Do you know which metal I should use to make the rod?
translation: 你知道我应该用哪种金属来制作那根棍棒吗？

english: I do not, I'm afraid. You mentioned that the original rod is still in Ivandis' tomb though. I'm sure studying it will give you a clue as to how it was made.
translation: 我不知道，恐怕。你提到原来的棍棒还在伊万迪斯的坟墓里。我相信研究它会给你关于它如何制造的线索。

english: If that doesn't work, you might be able to learn something at Paterdomus.
translation: 如果那不管用，你或许能在帕特多穆斯学到些什么。

english: Do you know what the rod does?
translation: 你知道那根棍子有什么用吗？

english: I believe this rod is the weapon that Ivandis used against the vampyres. The stories say that he used to render them immobile for a short time. You might be able to learn more at Paterdomus.
translation: 我相信这根棍子就是伊凡迪斯用来对付吸血鬼的武器。传说中他可以用它让它们短暂无法动弹。你或许能在帕特多穆斯了解更多。

english: I have brought you the Rod of Ivandis!
translation: 我把伊凡迪斯之杖带来了！

english: Hmm, well it certainly looks very authentic. But there doesn't seem to be any enchantment on it, either mortal or devine.Perhaps there is a step of the process you have not completed yet?
translation: 嗯，它看起来确实很逼真。但上面似乎没有任何附魔，无论是凡人的还是神明的。也许你还没有完成过程中的某一步？

english: Where would I find out about the process for completing the rod?
translation: 我去哪里可以找到完成这根杖的方法？

english: If the truth is anywhere, I bet it's at Paterdomus.
translation: 如果真相存在某个地方，我打赌就在帕特多穆斯。

english: Here you go. I've managed to recreate the Rod of Ivandis.
translation: 给你。我成功重现了伊凡迪斯之杖。

english: Hmm, well it certainly looks very authentic, and I can see it's been enchanted. But there doesn't seem to be any divine blessing on the item. Perhaps there is a step of the process you have not completed yet?
translation: 嗯，它看起来确实很逼真，而且我能看到它已经被附魔了。但上面似乎没有任何神圣祝福。也许你还没有完成过程中的某一步？

english: Very impressive. Good work.
translation: 非常令人印象深刻。干得好。

english: Hmmm, I can't take it off your hands while you're still using it. If you want to offer it to me, you'll need to unequip it.
translation: 嗯，如果你还在使用它，我不能从你手里接下它。如果你想把它给我，你需要先卸下它。

english: I... I don't believe it! You've really done it!
translation: 我……我真不敢相信！你真的做到了！

english: Well [player name], you have certainly excelled yourself in this task. I believe you may soon be true Myreque material.
translation: 嗯，[player name]，你在这次任务中确实表现出色。我相信你很快就能成为真正的迈雷克成员。

english: Hello there. The name's Vanstrom Klause. How goes it stranger?
translation: 你好啊。我叫范斯特罗姆.克劳斯。陌生人，你怎么样？

english: Quite well, thanks for asking. How about you?
translation: 挺好的，谢谢关心。你呢？

english: Hmm, well, I am a little concerned about some friends of mine. They're in dire need of some assistance, but I'm at a loss as to how I can help them.
translation: 嗯，怎么说呢，我有点担心我的一些朋友。他们急需帮助，但我却不知道该怎么帮他们。

english: What friends are these?
translation: 什么朋友？

english: It's a personal tragedy that I have yet to meet them in the flesh. But their exploits make mouth watering stories... The real meat and drink of high adventure and daring... So they say.
translation: 说来遗憾，我还没亲眼见过他们。但他们的壮举可是让人垂涎的故事……真正的高风险冒险，充满胆识……至少大家都这么说。

english: What does that mean exactly? I mean, I have some stories. I'm quite a hero myself, you may actually be talking about me?
translation: 这到底是什么意思？我是说，我也有一些故事。我自己也算是个英雄，你说的该不会就是我吧？

english: They're a group of rebels fighting against the vampyres that rule over Morytania. They're known as the Myreque. Some people call them terrorists while others call them freedom fighters!
translation: 他们是一群反抗统治莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼的叛军。人称“迈雷克”。有人叫他们恐怖分子，也有人称他们为自由斗士！

english: I see. And you want to help them?
translation: 我明白了。你想帮他们？

english: Of course. I'm a big fan of their cause. I was hoping to supply them with some new weapons. Alas, I find that I'm rather lacking in ability when it comes to this kind of thing!
translation: 当然。我非常支持他们的事业。我本想给他们提供一些新武器。唉，但我发现自己在这些事情上能力不足啊！

english: Well perhaps I could take these weapons to the Myreque. What do they need?
translation: 也许我可以把这些武器带给迈雷克。他们需要什么？

english: Really? You would help?
translation: 真的吗？你愿意帮忙？

english: I was hoping to deliver some steel to them. A longsword, two shortswords, a dagger, a mace and a warhammer.
translation: 我本想给他们送些钢制武器。一把长剑、两把短剑、一把匕首、一把钉锤和一把战锤。

english: Though if you wish to do this, I'm afraid you'll need to acquire the weapons yourself. My efforts to procure them have been rather unsuccessful.
translation: 不过如果你想做这件事，恐怕你得自己去弄到这些武器。我设法搞到它们的过程相当不顺利。

english: Right. Get some steel weapons and take them to the Myreque. Where can I find them?
translation: 好的。去弄些钢制武器，然后带给迈雷克。我在哪里能找到他们？

english: The vampyres are always hunting them, so they keep themselves hidden. I hear the boatman in Mort'ton has dealings with them though.
translation: 吸血鬼一直在追捕他们，所以他们躲藏了起来。不过我听说莫顿镇的船夫跟他们有来往。

english: Well I'd better get going then.
translation: 那我最好现在就出发。

english: How wonderful! Perhaps the people of Morytania now have an additional hero that they can come to rely on?
translation: 太好了！也许莫利塔尼亚的人民又多了一位可以信赖的英雄？

english: What else do you know about the Myreque?
translation: 你还知道迈雷克的其他事吗？

english: There's always some evil heel ready to grind the face of humanity into the dirt. Here in Morytania, it's the vampyres! They rule over the region with an iron fist, killing any who oppose them.
translation: 总有些邪恶的恶棍准备把人类的脸踩进泥土里。在莫利塔尼亚这里，就是吸血鬼！他们用铁腕统治着这个地区，杀死任何反抗他们的人。

english: The Myreque are the only ones brave enough to stand up to them. They stay in the shadows though, lest the vampyres track them down!
translation: 迈雷克是唯一有勇气站出来对抗他们的人。不过他们躲在暗处，以免被吸血鬼追踪到！

english: No one knows for sure how many of them there are. The group hiding in Mort Myre supposedly has six members. There are whispers of more in other parts of Morytania though.
translation: 没人确切知道他们有多少人。躲在莫特迈尔的那伙据说有六名成员。不过也有传言说莫利塔尼亚其他地方还有更多人。

english: And this group in Mort Myre? They're who the weapons are for?
translation: 那莫特迈尔的这伙人？武器就是给他们的？

english: Yes, indeed! The Myreque are almost certainly able to handle themselves... But they need the tools to do it!
translation: 没错，正是！迈雷克处理自身事务肯定没问题……但他们需要工具才能做到！

english: Remind me, what weapons do I need?
translation: 提醒我一下，我需要哪些武器？

english: You've forgotten already? Ha! That's funny! But I do understand, my memory isn't what it was either!
translation: 你已经忘了？哈！真有意思！不过我理解，我的记性也不如从前了！

english: I'd suggest a longsword, two shortswords, a dagger, a mace and a warhammer, all made of steel.
translation: 我建议你准备一把长剑、两把短剑、一把匕首、一把钉锤和一把战锤，都要钢制的。

english: You'll need to obtain the weapons yourself. Fear not though! If you return to me here once you've found them, I'll be sure to give you a nice surprise in return for your help!
translation: 你得自己去弄到这些武器。不过别担心！等你找到它们后回到我这里，我一定会给你一个惊喜作为回报！

english: Where can I find this boatman?
translation: 我在哪里能找到这个船夫？

english: I hear he lives in Mort'ton. You'll find the town south of here, through Mort Myre. It's a nasty place, but where isn't in Morytania?
translation: 我听说他住在莫顿镇。从这里向南穿过莫特迈尔就能找到镇子。那是个恶心的地方，不过莫利塔尼亚哪里不恶心呢？

english: Most of the town has supposedly fallen to some strange affliction. The boatman is apparently one of the few healthy people left!
translation: 据说镇上大部分人得了一种怪病。船夫显然是少数几个还健康的人之一！

english: And you say he's had dealings with the Myreque?
translation: 你说他跟迈雷克有来往？

english: So I hear. There are many who sympathise with their movement. Rumour is that this boatman's been ferrying supplies to their hideout, somewhere in Mort Myre!
translation: 我是这么听说的。很多人都同情他们的运动。有传言说这个船夫一直在把补给品运送到他们的藏身处，就在莫特迈尔的某个地方！

english: I wish I could help, but I'm busy at the moment.
translation: 我希望我能帮忙，但眼下我很忙。

english: Oh well, I'm sure someone will be along to help soon. Thanks for even considering it though.
translation: 哦好吧，我相信很快就会有人来帮忙的。不过还是谢谢你愿意考虑。

english: Hello again. Any luck finding the Myreque?
translation: 又见面了。找到迈雷克了吗？

english: Hello there. I'm guessing you're the boatman?
translation: 你好。我猜你就是那个船夫吧？

english: Well I am 'a' boatman. I don't know about 'the' boatman though. Why do you ask anyway?
translation: 嗯，我是个船夫。但我不确定是不是你说的“那个”船夫。你问这个干嘛？

english: I hear you have dealings with the Myreque. I was hoping to take some weapons to them.
translation: 我听说你跟迈雷克有来往。我想给他们送些武器。

english: Hmm, I'm sure I don't know what you're talking about.
translation: 嗯，我肯定不知道你在说什么。

english: Come on, I know you're in cahoots with them. It's important that I get these weapons to them.
translation: 别装了，我知道你跟他们是一伙的。我必须把这些武器送到他们手上，这很重要。

english: Well... Okay, I may have done some work for them before. It's too dangerous now though. I'm sorry, I can't help you.
translation: 好吧……我之前可能为他们做过一些事。但现在太危险了。抱歉，我不能帮你。

english: Oh come on, you can tell me!
translation: 哎呀，你就告诉我吧！

english: I'm sorry, I just can't... They're watching us you know... Eyes everywhere!
translation: 对不起，我真的不能说……他们在监视我们，你知道的……到处都是眼睛！

english: Well, I guess they'll just die without weapons.
translation: 好吧，那我猜他们没有武器就会死。

english: Hmm, you don't seem too concerned about their welfare. I'm glad I didn't tell you where they are. In any case, they're resourceful, they can look after themselves.
translation: 哼，你看起来并不太关心他们的安危。幸好我没告诉你他们在哪。不管怎样，他们足智多谋，能照顾好自己的。

english: They're resourceful folks, that's all I'm saying. The leader of their group, Veliaf, looks after them well.
translation: 他们足智多谋，我就说这么多。他们的头领维利亚夫把他们照顾得很好。

english: Resourceful enough to get their own steel weapons?
translation: 足智多谋到能自己弄到钢制武器？

english: Maybe they are... What do you care anyway? They've been up against it ever since they got started.
translation: 也许吧……反正你操什么心？他们从一开始就一直在对抗困境。

english: All of 'em have suffered more loss and heartache than you'll ever know. Now, leave me be!
translation: 他们所有人都承受了你永远无法想象的损失和心痛。现在，别烦我了！

english: What have they been up against?
translation: 他们对抗的是什么？

english: You're clearly not from around here or you wouldn't be asking such foolish questions.
translation: 你显然不是本地人，否则不会问这种愚蠢的问题。

english: Drakan. That's what they've been up against.
translation: 德雷坎。他们对抗的就是德雷坎。

english: Drakan?
translation: 德雷坎？

english: Lord Lowerniel Drakan. Leader of the vampyres and ruler of Morytania. His reign over these lands means we all live in fear.
translation: 洛厄尼尔.德雷坎大人。吸血鬼的首领，莫利塔尼亚的统治者。他对这片土地的统治意味着我们都生活在恐惧中。

english: What kind of loss and heartache have they suffered?
translation: 他们承受了什么样的损失和心痛？

english: The worst kind. Most have lost members of their family.
translation: 最糟糕的那种。大多数人都失去了家人。

english: Take Sani Piliu for example. she was orphaned overnight when a vampyre went on the rampage. Imagine that, losing your entire family in one night. Terrible!
translation: 就拿萨尼.皮利乌来说吧。一个吸血鬼狂暴肆虐，她一夜之间就成了孤儿。想象一下，一夜之间失去整个家庭。太可怕了！

english: It sounds awful... Who is Sani Piliu?
translation: 听起来真惨……萨尼.皮利乌是谁？

english: She's the only female member of the Myreque. Her agility and light fingers have got them out of quite a few sticky situations.
translation: 她是迈雷克唯一的女性成员。她的敏捷和灵巧的手指帮他们摆脱了不少困境。

english: If you don't tell me, their deaths are on your head!
translation: 如果你不告诉我，他们的死就怪你！

english: There's death aplenty in this forsaken place... What do I care that some fool hardy vigilantes decided to go it alone against the Drakans?
translation: 这个被遗弃的地方死亡多的是……我管那些愚蠢的治安员独自对抗德雷坎家族干嘛？

english: Stupidity of youth is to blame. I won't carry it on my shoulders!
translation: 要怪就怪年轻人太愚蠢。我可不想担这个责任！

english: One man's vigilante is another man's freedom fighter!
translation: 一个人的治安维持者是另一个人的自由斗士！

english: Aye, you can see it from both sides I suppose. But many of us consider it fool hardy to fight for something we'll never get.
translation: 是啊，我想你可以从两个角度看问题。但我们很多人认为为了一件永远得不到的东西去战斗是愚蠢的。

english: I remember a conversation I had with Polmafi, a scholar, such as he was. Even he agrees that the chances are slim.
translation: 我记得我和波尔马菲谈过一次话，他是个学者吧。连他也承认希望渺茫。

english: Polmafi? Who's he?
translation: 波尔马菲？他是谁？

english: Polmafi Ferdygris is one of the Myreque. He's a technical sort and advises on all sorts of things to Veliaf. He was a scholar before he became a renegade.
translation: 波尔马菲.费迪格里斯是迈雷克的一员。他擅长技术，给维利亚夫提供各种建议。他在成为叛徒之前是个学者。

english: What do you know of the Drakans?
translation: 你知道德雷坎家族的什么事？

english: They're the family that leads the vampyres. They're the ones to whom the blood tithes are paid. Too much I have told you already!
translation: 他们是领导吸血鬼的家族。血税就是交给他们的。我已经跟你说得太多了！

english: Ignorance is better than these truths I tell you! I can pretend once more that I am a free man and some relief from this gloom can I feel again.
translation: 无知比我告诉你的这些真相更好！我可以再次假装自己是个自由人，再次感受到从这片阴霾中解脱出来的轻松。

english: Be gone with you now and leave me with my dreams.
translation: 你现在走吧，让我独自沉浸在梦里。

english: What kind of a man are you to say that you don't care?
translation: 你说你不在乎，你算什么人？

english: Don't dare to judge me young fool... what do you know of the heartache I carry? I want to help them! I did help them! But my part is done now. To do any more is to risk death!
translation: 别敢评判我，小傻瓜……你知道我背负着怎样的心痛吗？我想帮他们！我确实帮过他们！但现在我的任务已经完成了。再做更多就是冒生命危险！

english: You're risking death either way. Better to risk it and help the cause, than to stand by and do nothing.
translation: 不管怎样你都在冒死亡的风险。与其袖手旁观，不如冒险去支持他们的事业。

english: Hmmm. Very well, if you would take your chance to help these strangers, who am I to stop you?
translation: 嗯……好吧。如果你愿意冒险去帮助这些陌生人，我又有什么理由阻止你呢？

english: So you'll help me? Will you take me to them?
translation: 所以你会帮我？你会带我去找他们吗？

english: No, I won't take you, but you can use my boat.
translation: 不，我不会带你去，但你可以用我的船。

english: You'll be going through Mort Myre though, so I won't be letting you go unless you've got some defence against the ghasts.
translation: 不过你要穿过莫特迈尔，所以除非你有对付食尸鬼的防御手段，否则我不会让你走的。

english: I don't have anything which I can use against them.
translation: 我没有任何可以用来对付他们的东西。

english: Well return to me once you have.
translation: 那等你有了再回来找我。
