english: I have this druid pouch! This turns the ghasts visible and I can kill them once I can see them.
translation: 我有这个德鲁伊的袋！它能让食尸鬼显形，我就能看见它们然后杀死它们了。

english: Very well, you can go! But you'll need to bring me six wooden planks first.
translation: 很好，你可以走了！但你先要给我带六块木板来。

english: The boat took some damage on my last trip. It needs repairing. There's also a bridge you'll need to cross later in your journey. It's rotten and will likely need repairs.
translation: 上次航行船受了些损伤，需要修理。另外，你旅途后面还要过一座桥。那座桥已经腐朽了，很可能也需要修理。

english: Three of the planks are for the boat and three are for the bridge. I suggest you bring some tools and steel nails along as well.
translation: 三块木板用于修船，三块用于修桥。我建议你顺便带些工具和钢钉过来。

english: Here are some planks for you.
translation: 这些木板给你。

english: Right. You can take the boat. Just jump in when you're ready to leave.
translation: 好了。你可以用船了。准备好出发时就跳上去。

english: Go as far north as you can and you'll arrive at the Hollows. Keep heading north on foot, over the rotten bridge, and you'll eventually reach an odd looking tree. That is where you'll find the Myreque.
translation: 尽量往北走，你会到达空洞地。继续步行向北，穿过那座腐朽的桥，最终你会看到一棵长相奇特的树。那里就是你能找到迈雷克的地方。

english: Why do you say that this place is forsaken?
translation: 你为什么说这个地方是被遗弃的？

english: All of these lands are forsaken of Saradomin's kindness, only cold death from evil do we now feel.
translation: 所有这些土地都被萨拉多明的仁慈所遗弃，我们现在只能感受到来自邪恶的冰冷死亡。

english: Those lucky ones to the west of the Salve little realise their fate if the river should one day become tainted.
translation: 那些在萨尔维河以西的幸运儿，很少意识到如果有一天河水被污染，他们会面临怎样的命运。

english: I'll give you some cash if you tell me.
translation: 如果你告诉我，我会给你一些钱。

english: You think you can buy me?
translation: 你以为你能收买我？

english: Err, no. I just want to compensate you for your trouble.
translation: 呃，不是。我只是想补偿你的辛苦费。

english: You keep your money and I'll keep my secrets.
translation: 你留着你的钱，我留着我的秘密。

english: I just want to help them, I think they need help.
translation: 我只是想帮他们，我觉得他们需要帮助。

english: Aye, everyone in these lands needs help. I'm sorry though, it's just not safe and it's not likely to get safer any time soon.
translation: 是啊，这片土地上的每个人都需要帮助。但对不起，这太不安全了，而且短时间内也不会变得更安全。

english: Look, I feel for them, I really do. They're fighting the good fight out there and unfortunately, some of them probably won't live through it.
translation: 听着，我同情他们，真的。他们在外面进行正义的战斗，不幸的是，其中一些人可能活不下来。

english: Ivan in particular I feel sorry for. He's the youngest of their group and he's seen too few winters to be involved in such toil.
translation: 我特别为伊万感到难过。他是他们中最年轻的，经历的冬天太少，不该卷入这种艰辛之中。

english: Then tell me how to find them. I can help them.
translation: 那就告诉我怎么找到他们。我能帮他们。

english: I support their cause. That doesn't mean I want to die for them though. I'm sorry, but I will not risk the wrath of the vampyres.
translation: 我支持他们的事业。但这并不意味着我想为他们而死。对不起，我不会冒着触怒吸血鬼的风险。

english: Please. I need to know how to find the Myreque.
translation: 拜托了。我必须知道怎么找到迈雷克。

english: I'm sorry, but I can't help you. I guess you're all out of luck.
translation: 抱歉，我帮不了你。看来你们都没戏了。

english: So, will you take me to the Myreque?
translation: 那么，你能带我去找迈雷克吗？

english: Can I ask you some more questions?
translation: 我能再问你几个问题吗？

english: Sure you can.
translation: 当然可以。

english: Where am I meant to be going?
translation: 我该往哪走？

english: Take my boat as far north as you can and you'll arrive at the Hollows. Keep heading north on foot, over the rotten bridge, and you'll eventually reach an odd looking tree. That is where you'll find the Myreque.
translation: 坐我的船一直往北走，你会到达霍洛斯。然后继续步行向北，穿过那座腐朽的桥，最终你会看到一棵奇特的树。那里就是你能找到迈雷克的地方。

english: Tell me more about the Myreque.
translation: 再跟我讲讲迈雷克的事。

english: Why are they called the Myreque?
translation: 他们为什么叫迈雷克？

english: It's a name the locals gave them. It means 'hidden in the myre'. Nothing fancy, it's just because that's where they hide, in Mort Myre.
translation: 这是当地人给他们起的名字。意思是'隐藏在沼泽中'。没什么特别的，就因为他们藏在莫特迈尔沼泽里。

english: Tell me about the members of the Myreque.
translation: 跟我说说迈雷克的成员吧。

english: Well you have Radigad Ponfit. He was a mercenary from Asgarnia but he joined up with the Myreque to settle some mysterious score with the Drakans.
translation: 嗯，有拉迪加德.庞菲特。他以前是阿斯加尼亚的雇佣兵，但为了和德雷坎家族了结一笔神秘旧账，加入了迈雷克。

english: Then there's Veliaf Hurtz, the leader of the group. He's been fighting the fight longer than any of them.
translation: 然后是维利亚夫.赫茨，他是这个组织的领袖。他战斗的时间比他们任何人都长。

english: Next there's Ivan Strom. He's the youngest. I hear he's an aspiring priest. Not that there's much time for that around here.
translation: 接下来是伊万.斯特罗姆。他是最年轻的。我听说他立志成为一名祭司。不过在这种地方，可没多少时间干那个。

english: You've also got Sani Piliu, the only female of the group. She's a bit of a shady one. I reckon she was a thief before the Myreque found her.
translation: 还有萨尼.皮利乌，组里唯一的女性。她有点来路不明。我猜在迈雷克找到她之前，她是个盗贼。

english: There's Harold Evans. Used to be part of some militia but was kicked out for being too hot-headed. Now he's the main fighter for the Myreque.
translation: 还有哈罗德.埃文斯。他以前是某个民兵组织的，但因为太冲动被赶了出来。现在他是迈雷克的主力战士。

english: Finally, you have Polmafi Ferdygris. He's the brains of the operation in many ways. Believe it or not, he used to be a scholar.
translation: 最后是波尔马菲.费迪格里斯。从很多方面来说，他是行动的智囊。信不信由你，他以前是个学者。

english: And that's all of them?
translation: 就这些了？

english: In Mort Myre it is. I sometimes hear rumour of more groups hidden in other parts of Morytania. Who knows if that's true though.
translation: 在莫特迈尔就这些了。我有时会听到传闻，说莫利塔尼亚其他地方还藏着更多组织。不过谁知道是不是真的呢。

english: Tell me about the Drakans.
translation: 跟我说说德雷坎家族吧。

english: They're the family of vampyres that rules all of Morytania. Lowerniel Drakan is the head of the family. Every bit of misery in this place is caused by him.
translation: 他们是统治整个莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼家族。洛厄尼尔.德雷坎是家族的首领。这地方所有的苦难都是他造成的。

english: No one out here ever sees the Drakans, but their presence is always felt. Their castle towers over all of the region. A constant reminder of their tyranny.
translation: 这里没人见过德雷坎家族的人，但总能感受到他们的存在。他们的城堡高耸于整个地区之上，时刻提醒着人们他们的暴政。

english: I'm just a humble boatman. Cyreg Paddlehorn is my name. Like most of the Paddlehorns before me, I make my living by tacking the swamps of Mort Myre.
translation: 我只是个卑微的船夫。我叫赛雷格.帕德尔霍恩。和我的大多数祖先一样，我靠在莫特迈尔的沼泽里行船为生。

english: There's death a plenty in this forsaken place... What do I care that some fool hardy vigilantes decided to go it alone against the Drakans?
translation: 这个被遗弃的地方死亡随处可见……我干嘛在乎那些愚蠢的义警们决定独自对抗德拉坎家族？

english: There doesn't seem to be many charges in that. Get it refilled my friend. I won't let you go into Mort Myre without some protection.
translation: 那里面好像没多少充能了。去把它充满吧，我的朋友。我不会让你没有任何保护就进入莫特迈雷的。

english: Hmm, I'm sure I don't know what you're talking about. Besides, even if I did, it doesn't look like you have suitable weapons for these 'Myreque'.
translation: 嗯，我肯定不知道你在说什么。再说了，就算我知道，你看起来也没有适合这些‘迈雷克’的武器。

english: Hey. What're you doin' here?
translation: 嘿。你在这儿干嘛？

english: I've come to help the Myreque. I've brought weapons.
translation: 我是来帮助迈雷克的。我带了武器。

english: It don't look like you have suitable weapons to me! Get out of here you fake!
translation: 我看你带的武器可不合适！滚出去，你这个冒牌货！

english: Okay, I see ya got some weapons. But here's da thing. These guys out here, they don't wanna be found. They paid me good money to keep em hidden.
translation: 好吧，我看到你确实带了些武器。但问题是，外面那些人可不想被找到。他们付了我一大笔钱让我保守秘密。

english: Now, you seems all sincered up to me... It's choking me up right here. But hey, I's godda do my job or da kids don't get fed!
translation: 现在，你看起来挺真诚的……我都快被你感动了。但是，嘿，我得做好我的工作，不然孩子们就没饭吃了！

english: But I just want to deliver these weapons.
translation: 但我只是想把这些武器送过去。

english: Okay, I's got an idea. Say I asks you a few questions and you answer them all correct and so on... Well that'd make me trust you's. How's dat sound?
translation: 好吧，我有个主意。我考你几个问题，你要是全答对了……那我就信你。怎么样？

english: Sounds fine to me... Go ahead, shoot!
translation: 我没问题……来吧，问吧！

english: Hey... Don't tempt me! You's dicing wiv death here my friend!
translation: 嘿……别引诱我！你这是在拿命开玩笑，朋友！

english: Okay, [first/second/third and final] question. Name the only female member of the Myreque.
translation: 好了，[first/second/third and final]问题。说出迈雷克中唯一的女性成员的名字。

english: Sani Piliu.
translation: 萨尼.皮利乌。

english: Santi Peliou.
translation: 桑蒂.佩利乌。

english: Sani Peridou.
translation: 萨尼.佩里杜。

english: Sandi Pherimou.
translation: 桑迪.费里穆。

english: Okay, [first/second/third and final] question. Who is the youngest member of the Myreque?
translation: 好了，[first/second/third and final]问题。迈雷克中最年轻的成员是谁？

english: Ivan Strom.
translation: 伊万.斯特罗姆。

english: Veliaf Hurtz.
translation: 维利亚夫.赫茨。

english: Radigad Ponfit.
translation: 拉迪加德.庞菲特。

english: Okay, [first/second/third and final] question. Who is the leader of the Myreque in Mort Myre?
translation: 好了，[first/second/third and final]问题。莫特迈尔的迈雷克领袖是谁？

english: Harold Evans.
translation: 哈罗德.埃文斯。

english: Okay, [first/second/third and final] question. Which member of the Myreque was originally a scholar?
translation: 好了，[first/second/third and final]问题。迈雷克中哪位成员原本是学者？

english: Polmafi Ferdygris.
translation: 波尔马菲.费迪格里斯。

english: Okay, [first/second/third and final] question. What is the name of the boatman who helps the Myreque?
translation: 好了，[first/second/third and final]问题。帮助迈雷克的船夫叫什么名字？

english: Geof Paddleman.
translation: 杰奥夫.帕德尔曼。

english: Cyreg Paddlebone.
translation: 赛雷格.帕德尔博恩。

english: Gyrec Paddlehorn.
translation: 吉雷克.帕德尔霍恩。

english: Cyreg Paddlehorn.
translation: 赛雷格.帕德尔霍恩。

english: Okay, [first/second/third and final] question. What vampyre family rules over Morytania?
translation: 好了，[first/second/third and final]问题。统治莫利塔尼亚的是哪个吸血鬼家族？

english: Drunken.
translation: 德兰肯。

english: Drakan.
translation: 德雷坎。

english: Draynor.
translation: 德雷诺。

english: Praymore.
translation: 普雷莫尔。

english: Okay, interesting answer. That's the first question done.
translation: 好吧，答案挺有意思。第一个问题答完了。

english: An interesting response. That's the second question answered.
translation: 回答得挺有意思。第二个问题答完了。

english: Hmm. Very interesting. That's the third question answered.
translation: 嗯。非常有意思。第三个问题答完了。

english: I'm sorry but you got no questions correct! Go on get outta here...
translation: 抱歉，你一个问题都没答对！赶紧滚出去……

english: I'm sorry but you only got one question correct! Go on get outta here...
translation: 抱歉，你只答对了一个问题！赶紧滚出去……

english: I'm sorry but you only got two questions correct! Go on get outta here...
translation: 抱歉，你只答对了两个问题！赶紧滚出去……

english: Okay, I believes ya... You can go on in. Head through the doors behind the tree. Once you's in, take the first cave on the right.
translation: 好吧，我相信你了……你可以进去了。穿过树后面的门。进去之后，走右边的第一个洞穴。

english: I don't have to answer to you!
translation: 我没必要回答你！

english: You do if you know what's good for you!
translation: 你要是识相的话，就得回答！

english: No reason!
translation: 没什么理由！

english: Come on... Speak up! I may be able to help you. However, yous gotta know that your tresspassing and that by rights I should slap your around a bit. You know, just like as a warning.
translation: 说吧……大声点！我也许能帮你。不过，你得知道你这是在擅闯，按理说我该揍你一顿。就当是警告。

english: I'm lost. Can you show me the way out?
translation: 我迷路了。你能告诉我怎么出去吗？

english: You got yourself here... Now get yourself out... Quickly if I were you.
translation: 你自己进来的……就自己出去……要是我，就快点。

english: Sure... Be on your way stranger.
translation: 行……你走吧，陌生人。

english: Back again? You ain't getting in 'till you answer my questions.
translation: 又回来了？不回答我的问题，你休想进去。

english: Well let's hear them then.
translation: 那好，说来听听。

english: Okay, first question...
translation: 好了，第一个问题……

english: Wat ya still doing out here? Head through the doors behind the tree. Once you's in, take the first cave on the right.
translation: 你还在这儿干嘛？穿过树后面的门。进去之后，走右边的第一个洞穴。

english: Okay, first question. What is the name of the boatman who helps the Myreque?
translation: 好，第一个问题。帮助迈雷克的船夫叫什么名字？

english: Okay, first question. What vampyre family rules over Morytania?
translation: 好，第一个问题。哪个吸血鬼家族统治着莫利塔尼亚？

english: Okay, first question. Name the only female member of the Myreque.
translation: 好，第一个问题。说出迈雷克中唯一的女性成员的名字。

english: Okay, first question. Which member of the Myreque was originally a scholar?
translation: 好，第一个问题。迈雷克中哪位成员原本是学者？

english: Okay, first question. Who is the youngest member of the Myreque?
translation: 好，第一个问题。谁是迈雷克中最年轻的成员？

english: Okay, first question. Who is the leader of the Myreque in Mort Myre?
translation: 好，第一个问题。谁是莫特迈雷中迈雷克的领袖？

english: Okay, second question. What vampyre family rules over Morytania?
translation: 好，第二个问题。哪个吸血鬼家族统治着莫利塔尼亚？

english: Okay, second question. What is the name of the boatman who helps the Myreque?
translation: 好，第二个问题。帮助迈雷克的船夫叫什么名字？

english: Okay, second question. Who is the youngest member of the Myreque?
translation: 好，第二个问题。谁是迈雷克中最年轻的成员？

english: Okay, second question. Who is the leader of the Myreque in Mort Myre?
translation: 好，第二个问题。谁是莫特迈雷中迈雷克的领袖？

english: Okay, second question. Which member of the Myreque was originally a scholar?
translation: 好，第二个问题。迈雷克中哪位成员原本是学者？

english: Okay, second question. Name the only female member of the Myreque.
translation: 好，第二个问题。说出迈雷克中唯一的女性成员的名字。

english: Okay, third and final question. What is the name of the boatman who helps the Myreque?
translation: 好，第三个也是最后一个问题。帮助迈雷克的船夫叫什么名字？

english: Okay, third and final question. Who is the leader of the Myreque in Mort Myre?
translation: 好，第三个也是最后一个问题。谁是莫特迈雷中迈雷克的领袖？

english: Okay, third and final question. Name the only female member of the Myreque.
translation: 好，第三个也是最后一个问题。说出迈雷克中唯一的女性成员的名字。

english: Okay, third and final question. Which member of the Myreque was originally a scholar?
translation: 好，第三个也是最后一个问题。迈雷克中哪位成员原本是学者？

english: Okay, third and final question. What vampyre family rules over Morytania?
translation: 好，第三个也是最后一个问题。哪个吸血鬼家族统治着莫利塔尼亚？

english: Okay, third and final question. Who is the youngest member of the Myreque?
translation: 好，第三个也是最后一个问题。谁是迈雷克中最年轻的成员？

english: Hey... You's tresspassin'. Be off wiv ya!
translation: 嘿……你闯进来了。快给我滚！

english: Hey! Who are you and why are you here?
translation: 嘿！你是谁，为什么来这里？

english: It's okay. I'm a friend. I'm here to deliver some weapons to you.
translation: 别紧张。我是朋友。我来给你们送些武器。

english: Weapons? You'd better talk to Veliaf then. I'll be keeping an eye on you though, so don't go trying anything.
translation: 武器？那你最好去跟维利亚夫说。不过我会盯着你的，别想耍花样。

english: I'm keeping my eye on you. Nothing personal. We just need to be careful with newcomers. Anyway, Veliaf will want to speak to you.
translation: 我会盯着你的。不是针对你。我们只是对新人得小心点。总之，维利亚夫想跟你谈谈。

english: Greetings! Good to see some new blood. You'd better speak with Veliaf. He's in charge here.
translation: 欢迎！很高兴看到新鲜血液。你最好去跟维利亚夫谈谈。他是这里的负责人。

english: Hello there. Here to help the cause are you? Speak to Veliaf. He'll sort you out.
translation: 你好啊。是来帮忙的吗？去找维利亚夫吧。他会安排你的。

english: Hi there. You're new here aren't you? You'd best go and talk with Veliaf.
translation: 嗨。你是新来的吧？你最好去和维利亚夫谈谈。

english: Oh... Hello. Sorry, but I'm not sure if I'm supposed to be talking to you. You'd better speak to Veliaf.
translation: 哦……你好。抱歉，我不确定该不该跟你说话。你最好去找维利亚夫。

english: You... I saw you come in. Harold didn't kill you though so I'm guessing you're no enemy. Who are you?
translation: 你……我看见你进来了。不过哈罗德没杀了你，所以我猜你不是敌人。你是谁？

english: I'm [Player name]. Don't worry, I'm a friend. I was asked to bring you some weapons.
translation: 我是[Player name]。别担心，我是朋友。有人让我给你们带些武器来。

english: It's true that we could do with some supplies. Thank you for bringing them here. I'll have a proper look over them in a moment but there's something I must finish first.
translation: 确实，我们急需一些补给品。谢谢你带过来。我待会儿会好好看看，但我得先把手头的事做完。

english: Feel free to introduce yourself to the others in the meantime.
translation: 在此期间，你可以去和其他人认识一下。

english: Ah, well met. We'll discuss those weapons shortly. I need to finish something first though. Feel free to introduce yourself to the others in the meantime.
translation: 啊，幸会。我们待会儿再谈那些武器。我得先完成一件事。在此期间，你可以去和其他人认识一下。

english: Hello there. Forgive me if I seem cautious of you. We just need to be careful with newcomers.
translation: 你好。如果我显得谨慎，请见谅。我们只是对新人得小心点。

english: It's fine. Do you mind if I ask a few questions?
translation: 没关系。我能问几个问题吗？

english: I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?
translation: 如果可以的话，我想问几个问题？

english: Sure. I'll do my best to answer them.
translation: 当然。我会尽力回答。

english: What's your job here?
translation: 你在这里是做什么的？

english: Cheating death seems to be my main role. I'm the main fighter for the group so I'm always in the thick of it. It's gone okay for me so far though.
translation: 我的主要任务似乎是死里逃生。我是团队的主力战士，所以总是冲在最前面。不过到目前为止，我运气还不错。

english: What can you tell me about this group?
translation: 你能告诉我关于这个组织的事吗？

english: We're a good team, though many of the others haven't had any proper training before. I used to be in a militia so I've been trying to share my knowledge as best I can.
translation: 我们是个好团队，尽管其他很多人以前没受过正规训练。我以前在民兵组织待过，所以我一直在尽力分享我的知识。

english: In most cases we end up having to improvise though. Thankfully, this lot are good at that. Ivan over there, he saved our bacon in a recent run in with some juves.
translation: 不过大多数情况下，我们最后都得随机应变。幸好，这帮人很擅长这个。那边的伊万，他最近在一次和几个幼年吸血鬼的遭遇中救了我们一命。

english: Juves? What are they?
translation: 幼年吸血鬼？那是什么？

english: Juveniles, the lowest form of vampyre. We come across them quite often around here. They may be the weakest vampyres but they're still very dangerous.
translation: 幼年体，最低级的吸血鬼。我们在这附近经常碰到它们。它们可能是最弱的吸血鬼，但仍然非常危险。

english: They're stronger and faster than many well trained soldiers, and twice as bloodthirsty.
translation: 它们比许多训练有素的士兵更强更快，而且嗜血程度是他们的两倍。

english: What's your grasp of the situation?
translation: 你对局势怎么看？

english: The situation is grave. It would be dangerous to think differently.
translation: 情况很严峻。不这么想会很危险。

english: We're really up against it, but we have no choice. This is a battle for our very existence and we need to employ any tactics to achieve our goal.
translation: 我们确实处境艰难，但别无选择。这是一场关乎我们存亡的战斗，我们必须采取一切手段来实现目标。

english: Have you heard any rumours?
translation: 你听到什么传闻了吗？

english: Yes, I hear them all the time. I don't pay any attention to them though.
translation: 是的，我经常听到。不过我从不理会它们。

english: Ah, I see you've introduced yourself to Veliaf. Are you planning to join the fray against the Drakans?
translation: 啊，看来你已经向维利亚夫介绍过自己了。你打算加入对抗德雷坎家族的战斗吗？

english: Maybe. I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?
translation: 也许吧。如果可以的话，我想问几个问题？

english: Hello again! How can I be of service to you?
translation: 又见面了！有什么能帮你的吗？

english: I'd like to ask you few questions.
translation: 我想问你几个问题。

english: Sure, go ahead. I'll answer as best I can.
translation: 当然，问吧。我会尽力回答。

english: I help with anything I can. I used to be a mercenary before joining the Myreque so I know my way around a blade. I've relied on Veliaf's sword arm many a time. I like to think that he can rely on mine.
translation: 我能帮上什么忙就帮。加入迈雷克之前我是个雇佣兵，所以对刀片还算熟悉。我多次依靠维利亚夫的剑术。我也希望他能信赖我的剑。

english: We're the only resistance against the vampyres. We're seriously outnumbered though. Veliaf doesn't like to hear us saying 'hopeless' but that's our situation at the minute.
translation: 我们是唯一抵抗吸血鬼的力量。不过我们的人数严重不足。维利亚夫不喜欢听我们说‘绝望’，但这就是我们目前的处境。

english: What're your plans for the future?
translation: 你们未来的计划是什么？

english: That's more a question for Veliaf. Ultimately though, our goal is to rid Morytania of the vampyres so that we might reclaim our right to exist.
translation: 这问题更适合问维利亚夫。不过归根结底，我们的目标是清除莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼，夺回我们生存的权利。

english: For me personally, I hope that more people will join our ranks soon. Strengh comes in numbers after all.
translation: 就我个人而言，我希望很快有更多人加入我们的行列。毕竟人多力量大。

english: I have. Something you might find interesting is that Safalaan Hallow, the leader of another Myreque group, has apparently managed to sneak one of his people into the vampyre capital, Darkmeyer.
translation: 我确实有。你可能会感兴趣的是，另一个迈雷克小组的领袖萨法兰.哈洛，似乎成功将他的一名手下潜入了吸血鬼的首都达克迈尔。

english: I'm not sure how true that is. It would be great though!
translation: 我不确定这是不是真的。不过如果是真的那就太好了！

english: Ah, I see you've introduced yourself to Veliaf. Now, what can I do for you?
translation: 啊，看来你已经向维利亚夫介绍过自己了。现在，我能为你做些什么？

english: Do you mind if I ask a few questions?
translation: 你介意我问几个问题吗？

english: Salutations! How are you?
translation: 你好！你怎么样？

english: Fine thanks. I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?
translation: 挺好的，谢谢。如果可以的话，我想问几个问题？

english: Not at all. I'm sure I'll be able to help.
translation: 没问题。我相信我能帮上忙。

english: I'm a key advisor to Veliaf. He seeks my council on many issues before we engage the enemy. Not that we do that very often. Our foes heavily outnumber us.
translation: 我是维利亚夫的关键顾问。他在与敌人交战前，会在许多问题上征求我的意见。不过我们并不经常交战。我们的敌人数量远超我们。

english: We don't give up though. After all, all that is required for evil to survive is for good people to do nothing.
translation: 但我们不会放弃。毕竟，邪恶得以存续，只需要好人无所作为。

english: Well there's multiple groups of us. Even we don't know exactly how many. The less we know about our allies, the less we can reveal to the vampyres if captured.
translation: 嗯，我们有好几个小组。连我们自己都不确切知道有多少。我们对盟友了解得越少，被俘后能向吸血鬼透露的就越少。

english: Veliaf leads this group. We operate throughout Mort Myre and the surrounding villages. He reports to Calsidiu who is the head of our resistance.
translation: 维利亚夫领导这个小组。我们在莫特梅尔及周边村庄活动。他向我们的抵抗运动领袖卡尔西迪乌汇报。

english: What do you know about Morytania?
translation: 你对莫利塔尼亚了解多少？

english: All the land on this side of the Salve is known as Morytania. Humans and vampyres are the main occupants of the region, though other races also live out here.
translation: 萨尔维河这一侧的所有土地都称为莫利塔尼亚。人类和吸血鬼是该地区的主要居民，不过其他种族也住在这里。

english: Yes, I hear them all the time. They're neither correct or even all that interesting though.
translation: 是的，我经常听到。不过它们既不准确，也没什么意思。

english: Hello. Very nice to meet you! The name's Sani Piliu. What's yours?
translation: 你好。很高兴认识你！我叫萨尼.皮利乌。你叫什么？

english: I'm [Player name]. Nice to meet you Sani.
translation: 我是[Player name]。很高兴认识你，萨尼。

english: The pleasure's all mine! I've got a good feeling about you. I reckon you're going to do great things for us! You have a powerful aura. Sorry, that must seem really strange.
translation: 我也很高兴！我对你有种好预感。我觉得你会为我们做出伟大的事！你有一种强大的气场。抱歉，这听起来一定很奇怪。

english: Well, perhaps a little. It's nice of you to say so in any case though. I'd like to ask a few questions if that's okay?
translation: 嗯，也许有点。不过你这么说还是很好。如果可以的话，我想问几个问题？

english: Oh, hello [Player name]. Nice to see you again! How's things?
translation: 哦，你好[Player name]。很高兴再次见到你！最近怎么样？

english: Fine thanks. Do you mind if I ask a few questions?
translation: 挺好的，谢谢。你介意我问几个问题吗？

english: There's not much to tell really. I was nine years old when my family was ripped to pieces by a vampyre.
translation: 其实没什么好说的。我九岁时，我的家人被一个吸血鬼撕成了碎片。

english: One moment I was a happy member of a loving family, the next I was an orphan living a hand to mouth existence.
translation: 前一秒我还是一个幸福家庭中的快乐成员，下一秒就成了孤儿，过着朝不保夕的生活。

english: Somehow I managed to get by, eking out a living wherever I could. People took pity on me and I earnt food by helping them out.
translation: 我设法熬了过来，到处勉强度日。人们同情我，我帮他们干活来换取食物。

english: I quickly found I had a very useful set of skills and there were plenty of people willing to pay for them.
translation: 我很快发现自己有一身非常有用的技能，而且有很多人愿意为此付钱。

english: I bumped into Veliaf in Canifis. He saw that I would be an asset to the Myreque and invited me to join. I said yes of course. I couldn't turn down the chance to fight against those who took away my family.
translation: 我在坎尼非斯村遇到了维利亚夫。他看出我会成为迈雷克的财富，于是邀请我加入。我当然答应了。我不能放弃向那些夺走我家人的人复仇的机会。

english: Well Veliaf is the leader of our group. We're not the only ones in Morytania though. Veliaf reports to someone called Calsidiu who's in charge of all the Myreque. I've never met any of the others though.
translation: 嗯，维利亚夫是我们小组的领袖。不过我们在莫利塔尼亚并不是唯一的小组。维利亚夫向一个叫卡尔西迪乌的人汇报，他负责整个迈雷克。不过我从未见过其他小组的人。

english: Our hope is to one day bring an end to the reign of Lowerniel Drakan and his vampyres.
translation: 我们的希望是有朝一日终结洛厄尼尔.德雷坎及其吸血鬼的统治。

english: For now though, we're just trying to find any weaknesses we can take advantage of. We need to know how to kill them before we take the war to them!
translation: 不过目前，我们只是在努力寻找任何可以利用的弱点。在向它们开战之前，我们必须知道如何杀死它们！

english: You make it sound easy!
translation: 你说得倒轻松！

english: With determination you can achieve great things. However, Veliaf always tells us not to underestimate the enemy. I've made that mistake before. I won't be making it again.
translation: 只要有决心，就能成就大事。不过，维利亚夫总是告诫我们不要低估敌人。我以前犯过这个错误。我不会再犯了。

english: What's going on in Morytania?
translation: 莫利塔尼亚发生了什么？

english: The entire region is ruled over by Lowerniel Drakan and his family. Everyone living here must pay blood tithes to the vampyres. The tithes keep the vampyres fed and ensure that people are too weak to oppose them.
translation: 整个地区都由洛厄尼尔.德雷坎及其家族统治。这里的所有人都必须向吸血鬼缴纳血税。这些血税让吸血鬼得以饱腹，并确保人们虚弱到无法反抗他们。

english: That's where we come in. We won't just offer our family members to the Drakans as a weekly snack. We're going to fight back!
translation: 这就是我们登场的原因。我们不会把自己的家人当作每周的点心献给德雷坎家族。我们要反击！

english: Is this your main camp?
translation: 这是你们的主要营地吗？

english: It's our only camp! At least, for our group. I know there's more Myreque in other parts of Morytania but I don't know exactly where.
translation: 这是我们唯一的营地！至少对我们小组来说是这样。我知道莫利塔尼亚其他地方还有更多迈雷克成员，但我不确定具体位置。

english: Hi there. Veliaf said that I should introduce myself to everyone.
translation: 你好。维利亚夫说我应该向大家介绍一下自己。

english: Okay. Well my name is Ivan. It's nice to meet you.
translation: 好的。我叫伊万。很高兴认识你。

english: Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?
translation: 你介意我问几个问题吗？

english: Oh, hello again. How are you?
translation: 哦，又见面了。你怎么样？

english: Fine thanks. Would you mind if I asked you a few questions?
translation: 挺好的，谢谢。你介意我问几个问题吗？

english: That's fine. I don't know how much I can help though.
translation: 没问题。不过我不知道能帮上多少忙。

english: Me personally? I shouldn't be here really. I'm training to be a priest and I was meant to travel to Paterdomus to learn from Drezel. The trip's too dangerous at the moment though.
translation: 我个人？其实我不该在这里。我正在接受祭司训练，本应前往帕特多姆斯向德雷泽尔学习。不过现在这趟旅程太危险了。

english: Is it really important for you to train as a priest? I'd have thought there'd be more pressing issues.
translation: 接受祭司训练真的那么重要吗？我以为会有更紧迫的事情。

english: Veliaf thinks it would be useful to have a priest to advise him. I think he also wants me further away from harm until I'm more experienced.
translation: 维利亚夫认为有一位祭司给他建议会很有用。我想他也希望在我更有经验之前，让我远离危险。

english: We're the only ones brave enough to put up a fight against the Drakans. I'm proud to be one of them.
translation: 我们是唯一有勇气对抗德雷坎家族的人。我为自己是其中一员而自豪。

english: I do worry that I might let the others down though. I'm not as skilled as they are.
translation: 不过我确实担心自己会让其他人失望。我没有他们那么熟练。

english: It's a lost land. The evil Drakan family rule all of the region. People cling to each other in fear when the blood tithes are to be paid. It's horrible!
translation: 这是一片失落之地。邪恶的德雷坎家族统治着整个地区。当血税要缴纳时，人们恐惧地互相依偎。太可怕了！

english: It won't be like this forever though. The Myreque will bring light back to this dark place.
translation: 但不会永远这样。迈雷克会给这片黑暗之地带来光明。

english: Sorry, but I haven't heard anything notable recently.
translation: 抱歉，我最近没听到什么值得注意的消息。

english: Well met. I see you've introduced yourself to everyone. Shall we discuss those weapons now? Or was there something else you wanted to talk about?
translation: 幸会。看来你已经向大家介绍过自己了。我们现在谈谈那些武器吗？还是你想谈点别的？

english: Let's talk about the weapons.
translation: 我们来谈谈武器吧。

english: Let's see what you have for us.
translation: 让我们看看你给我们带了什么。

english: These weapons look great! Many thanks.
translation: 这些武器看起来很棒！非常感谢。

english: Vampyre!
translation: 吸血鬼！

english: It's Vanstrom!
translation: 是范斯特罗姆！

english: Well done adventurer! You led me right to them. The little dears are going to wonder which side you're on!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！你直接把我带到了他们面前。这些小可爱们会怀疑你到底站在哪一边！

english: The Drakans have been wanting you lot dealt with for a while now. We wouldn't want to disappoint them, would we?
translation: 德雷坎家族早就想收拾你们了。我们可不想让他们失望，对吧？

english: We're dead!
translation: 我们死定了！

english: Oh, hello [player name]. Nice to see you again! How's things?
translation: 哦，你好[player name]。很高兴再见到你！最近怎么样？

english: Quite right.
translation: 说得没错。

english: We're really up against it, but we have no choice. This is a battle for our very existance and we need to employ any tactics to achieve our goal.
translation: 我们确实处境艰难，但别无选择。这是一场为了我们生存的战斗，我们必须用尽一切手段来实现我们的目标。

english: Sorry Harold, you too!
translation: 抱歉，哈罗德，你也一样！

english: And now... A little gift for the rest of you.
translation: 现在……给你们剩下的人一点小礼物。

english: Ah. I'm afraid you don't have suitable weapons for us. Sorry friend.
translation: 啊。恐怕你没有适合我们的武器。抱歉，朋友。

english: What weapons do you need?
translation: 你们需要什么武器？

english: Well we all have our own specialisms. We could do with a longsword, two shortswords, a dagger, a mace and a warhammer, all made from steel.
translation: 嗯，我们各有专长。我们需要一把长剑、两把短剑、一把匕首、一把钉锤和一把战锤，都要钢制的。

english: Okay. I'll come back once I have them.
translation: 好的。我拿到后就回来。

english: So you're the leader of this group?
translation: 所以你是这个小组的领袖？

english: That's right. I can't say I particularly asked for it. The others look up to me though, so they decided I was the best man for the job.
translation: 没错。我不能说是我特别要求的。不过其他人很尊敬我，所以他们认定我是最合适的人选。

english: Can you tell me about your organisation?
translation: 你能告诉我关于你们组织的情况吗？

english: Well I wouldn't say we're an organisation. We're really not that organised.
translation: 嗯，我不会说我们是一个组织。我们其实没那么有组织。

english: Anyway though, we're a group of Myreque freedom fighters. We're dedicated to mounting a resistance against the Drakan family and their vampyre kin.
translation: 不过话说回来，我们是一群迈雷克自由战士。我们致力于抵抗德雷坎家族及其吸血鬼同族。

english: What can you tell me about Morytania?
translation: 你能告诉我关于莫利塔尼亚的情况吗？

english: If legend is to be believed, it was once a beautiful place. But then Lowerniel Drakan and his vampyres arrived.
translation: 如果传说可信的话，它曾经是个美丽的地方。但后来洛厄尼尔.德雷坎和他的吸血鬼来了。

english: Who is Lowerniel Drakan?
translation: 洛厄尼尔.德雷坎是谁？

english: Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan is his full name. He's the vampyre that heads up the Drakan family. Helped by his brother Ranis and his sister Vanescula, he rules over all of Morytania.
translation: 他的全名是洛厄尼尔.维尔吉迪亚德.德雷坎。他是领导德雷坎家族的吸血鬼。在他的兄弟拉尼斯和妹妹瓦内斯库拉的协助下，他统治着整个莫利塔尼亚。

english: You sound very bitter.
translation: 你听起来非常愤恨。

english: So would you if you lost everyone dear to you at the hands of such monsters.
translation: 如果你也失去了所有亲人，而且是被这样的怪物所害，你也会这样。

english: What are your plans for the future?
translation: 你们未来的计划是什么？

english: At the moment we're maintaining a low profile here at our hideout. We were recently spotted while out on a scouting mission so we're playing it safe and lying low.
translation: 目前我们在藏身处保持低调。我们最近在一次侦察任务中被发现，所以我们在谨慎行事，潜伏起来。

english: Looking further ahead, we need to build more support if we have any hope of taking on the vampyres. We also need to learn more about their weaknesses, so we can take advantage of them.
translation: 展望未来，如果我们想有机会对抗吸血鬼，就需要争取更多支持。我们还需要更多地了解他们的弱点，以便加以利用。

english: Sani... Harold... That murderer killed them!
translation: 萨尼……哈罗德……那个凶手杀了他们！

english: I'm so sorry. This is all my fault.
translation: 非常抱歉。这都是我的错。

english: I don't understand though. He said you led him here. How?
translation: 不过我不明白。他说是你把他带到这里来的。怎么做到的？

english: He was the one that asked me to bring the weapons to you. He looked like a human though.
translation: 是他让我把武器带给你们的。不过他看起来像个人类。

english: I'm sorry friend, but he clearly took advantage of you. Vampyres can shapeshift to look like humans. Someone from around here might have realised. You were not to know though.
translation: 抱歉，朋友，但他显然利用了你。吸血鬼可以变形伪装成人类。附近的人可能早就察觉了。但你不知情。

english: No. I'm still responsible though.
translation: 不。但我仍然有责任。

english: The burden of what happened here is for your conscience to bear. That said, you managed to kill that pet of his. We might all be dead if not for you.
translation: 这里发生的一切，你的良心要背负这个重担。不过话说回来，你杀死了他的那只宠物。要不是你，我们可能都死了。

english: I imagine you now see why we fight for our freedom.
translation: 我想你现在明白我们为什么为自由而战了。

english: Yes. I think I understand. Is there anything I can do to help now? I first met Vanstrom in Canifis. I could go back and see if he's still there?
translation: 是的，我想我明白了。现在有什么我能帮忙的吗？我第一次见到范斯特罗姆是在坎尼非斯村。我可以回去看看他还在不在那里？

english: I suspect he will have moved on now. You're welcome to try though. I know a shortcut that you might find useful.
translation: 我猜他现在已经离开了。不过你想去试试也行。我知道一条捷径，你可能会觉得有用。

english: If you head back into the main cave and go north you'll reach a wall. There's a hidden door in that wall that leads right into the basement of the Hair of the Dog Tavern.
translation: 如果你回到主洞穴往北走，你会遇到一堵墙。那堵墙上有一扇暗门，直通狗毛酒馆的地下室。

english: That's very useful. Thanks.
translation: 这太有用了，谢谢。

english: Once you are done, I'd appreciate you coming back here to discuss a few things. You held your own against that creature. We could use someone like you.
translation: 等你忙完了，我希望你能回来这里，我们商量点事。你刚才对付那个生物的表现很不错。我们需要像你这样的人。

english: I want to join your organisation.
translation: 我想加入你们的组织。

english: Well we could definitely use someone like you. You should go and see if Vanstrom is still in Canifis though. Come back once you're done, and we'll talk.
translation: 嗯，我们确实需要像你这样的人。不过你还是先去坎尼非斯村看看范斯特罗姆还在不在吧。等你办完了再回来，我们好好谈谈。

english: What do you plan to do now?
translation: 你们现在打算怎么办？

english: We won't be able to stay here now that Vanstrom knows where we've been hiding. We have some time though. He'll expect that we're all dead. We'll use that time to form a plan of action.
translation: 既然范斯特罗姆知道我们躲在这里，我们就不能继续待下去了。不过我们还有点时间。他会以为我们都死了。我们会利用这段时间制定行动计划。

english: How do I get out of here again?
translation: 我怎么才能离开这里？

english: That monster! He killed them! We'll make them all pay!
translation: 那个怪物！他杀了他们！我们要让他们血债血偿！

english: This is a dark day for the Myreque.
translation: 对迈雷克来说，这是黑暗的一天。

english: I'm so sorry for your loss.
translation: 对于你的损失，我深表遗憾。

english: Don't worry. No one blames you. You were tricked and that's that. It serves no useful purpose to blame any of ourselves for this.
translation: 别担心。没人怪你。你被骗了，事情就是这样。为此责怪我们任何人都是没有意义的。

english: Thank Saradomin you managed to kill that awful beast! I just wish we could have done more.
translation: 感谢萨拉多明，你成功杀死了那头可怕的野兽！我只希望我们能做得更多。

english: I'm so sorry for your loss. If there's anything I can do, please let me know.
translation: 对于你的损失，我深表遗憾。如果有什么我能做的，请告诉我。

english: I will. Thank you.
translation: 我会的。谢谢你。

english: Hello Bwana, do you have the Snake Weed?
translation: 你好，先生，你有蛇草吗？

english: Please don't try to deceive me.
translation: 请不要试图欺骗我。

english: I really need that Snake Weed if I am to make this potion.
translation: 要制作这瓶药水，我真的需要那种蛇草。

english: Great, you have the Snake Weed! Many thanks. Ok, the next herb is called Ardrigal. It is related to the palm and grows to the east in its brother's shady profusion.
translation: 太好了，你有蛇草！非常感谢。好了，下一种草药叫阿德里加草。它与棕榈树有关，生长在东边，在其兄弟的繁茂树荫之下。

english: To the east you will find a small peninsula, it is just after the cliffs come down to meet the sands, here is where you should search for it.
translation: 往东你会找到一个小半岛，就在悬崖落至沙滩之后，那里就是你该寻找它的地方。

english: That's not fresh snake weed, did you pick it yourself? Go get me some fresh snake weed and remember to pick it yourself.
translation: 那不是新鲜的蛇草，是你自己采的吗？去给我弄些新鲜的蛇草来，记住要自己采。

english: Not yet, sorry, what's the clue again?
translation: 还没有，抱歉，线索是什么来着？

english: It grows near vines in an area to the south west where the ground turns soft and the water kisses your feet.
translation: 它生长在西南方一个区域的藤蔓附近，那里地面变得松软，水会轻抚你的脚。

english: Hello Bwana, have you been able to get the Ardrigal?
translation: 你好，先生，你找到阿德里加草了吗？

english: I really need that Ardrigal if I am to make this potion.
translation: 要制作这瓶药水，我真的需要那种阿德里加草。

english: Great, you have the Ardrigal! Many thanks.
translation: 太好了，你有阿德里加草！非常感谢。

english: You are doing well Bwana. The next herb is called Sito Foil, and it grows best where the ground has been blackened by the living flame.
translation: 你做得很好，先生。下一种草药叫西托箔草，它最擅长生长在被活火熏黑过的土地上。

english: Not yet, sorry, what's the clue again ?
translation: 还没有，抱歉，线索是什么来着？

english: You are looking for Ardrigal. It is related to the palm  and grows in its brothersshady profusion.
translation: 你要找的是阿德里加草。它与棕榈树有关，生长在其兄弟的繁茂树荫之下。

english: Greetings Bwana, have you been successful in getting the Sito Foil?
translation: 你好，先生，你成功找到西托箔草了吗？

english: I really need that Sito Foil if I am to make this potion.
translation: 要制作这瓶药水，我真的需要那种西托箔草。

english: Well done Bwana, just two more herbs to collect.
translation: 干得好，先生，只剩两种草药要收集了。

english: The next herb is called Volencia Moss. It clings to rocks for its existence. It is difficult to see, so you must search for it well.
translation: 下一种草药叫瓦伦西亚苔。它依附在岩石上生存。很难看到，所以你必须仔细搜索。

english: It prefers rocks of high metal content and a frequently disturbed environment. There is some, I believe to the south east of this village.
translation: 它喜欢金属含量高的岩石和经常被扰动的环境。我相信在这个村庄的东南方有一些。

english: You are looking for Sito Foil, and it grows best where the ground has been blackened by the living flame.
translation: 你要找的是西托箔草，它最擅长生长在被活火熏黑过的土地上。

english: Greetings Bwana, have you been successful in getting the Volencia Moss?
translation: 你好，先生，你成功找到瓦伦西亚苔了吗？

english: Please don't try to deceive me! I really need that Volencia Moss if I am to make this potion.
translation: 请不要试图欺骗我！要制作这瓶药水，我真的需要那种瓦伦西亚苔。

english: Ah Volencia Moss, beautiful. One final herb and the potion will be complete. This is the most difficult to find as it inhabits the darkness of the underground. It is called Rogue's Purse, and is only to be found in
translation: 啊，瓦伦西亚苔，真漂亮。最后一种草药，药水就完成了。这是最难找的，因为它生长在地下的黑暗之中。它叫盗贼草，只存在于

english: caverns in the northern part of this island. A secret entrance to the caverns is set into the northern cliffs of this land. Take care Bwana as it may be dangerous.
translation: 这个岛屿北部的洞穴里。一个通往洞穴的秘密入口位于这片土地北部的悬崖上。小心点，先生，那里可能很危险。

english: You are looking for Volencia Moss. It clings to rocks for its existence. It is difficult to see, so you must search for it well.
translation: 你要找的是瓦伦西亚苔。它依附在岩石上生存。很难看到，所以你必须仔细搜索。

english: I really need that Volencia Moss if I am to make this potion.
translation: 要制作这瓶药水，我真的需要那种瓦伦西亚苔。

english: Greetings Bwana, have you been successful in getting the Rogue's Purse?
translation: 你好，先生，你成功找到盗贼草了吗？

english: Please don't try to deceive me, I really need that Rogue's Purse if I am to make this potion.
translation: 请不要试图欺骗我，要制作这瓶药水，我真的需要那种盗贼草。

english: Sorry Bwana, that herb is so dirty I can't even tell whether it is fresh. Please clean it first.
translation: 抱歉，先生，那草药太脏了，我甚至看不出它是不是新鲜的。请先把它弄干净。

english: Most excellent Bwana! You have returned all the herbs to me and,I can finish the preparations for the potion, and at last divine with the gods.
translation: 太棒了，先生！你把所有草药都带回来了，我可以完成药水的准备工作，并最终与众神沟通了。

english: Many blessings on you! I must now prepare, please excuse me while I make the arrangements.
translation: 愿神多多保佑你！我现在必须准备了，请原谅，我要去安排一下。

english: You are looking for Rogues Purse.
translation: 你要找的是盗贼草。

english: It inhabits the darkness of the underground, and grows in caverns to the north. A secret entrance to the caverns is set into the northern cliffs, be careful Bwana.
translation: 它生长在地下的黑暗之中，生长在北方的洞穴里。一个通往洞穴的秘密入口位于北部的悬崖上，小心点，先生。

english: I really need that Rogues Purse if I am to make this potion.
translation: 要制作这瓶药水，我真的需要那种盗贼草。

english: Oh, I remember you. You're the one that discovered Lord Sinclair's murderer. Well, I can tell you, strange things are afoot once again.
translation: 哦，我记得你。你就是那个发现辛克莱尔庄园勋爵凶手的人。好吧，我可以告诉你，奇怪的事情又发生了。

english: Really? What's happened?
translation: 真的吗？发生了什么事？

english: Well, you didn't hear it from me, but I've heard the Sinclair family have vamoosed! Just up and left the mansion.
translation: 好吧，你可别说是我说的，但我听说辛克莱尔庄园家族都跑路了！直接抛下庄园就走了。

english: You mean they let the murderer get away?
translation: 你是说他们让凶手逃走了？

english: Of course not! Anna's safely locked in the Seers' Village jail. She'll be going to trial soon, so I've heard.
translation: 当然不是！安娜被安全地关在先知村的监狱里。我听说她很快就要受审了。

english: Anna? Is that who they arrested? I thought...hmm, never mind.
translation: 安娜？他们逮捕的是她？我还以为……嗯，算了。

english: Yes, the guards received evidence from one of the family members that conclusively proved Anna did it. All other evidence was thrown out, it was that good.
translation: 是的，守卫从一名家族成员那里收到了证据，确凿地证明了安娜是凶手。所有其他证据都被推翻了，那份证据太有力了。

english: So they arrested her and soon the case will go to court.
translation: 所以他们逮捕了她，案子很快就要开庭了。

english: So, why is it a big deal that the Sinclairs have left, then? Maybe they wanted to get away from the memory of their father's death.
translation: 那么，辛克莱尔庄园家族离开有什么大不了的呢？也许他们只是想远离父亲去世的回忆。

english: Well, it wouldn't be suspicious at all, but King Arthur has also disappeared.
translation: 嗯，这本来一点也不可疑，但亚瑟王也失踪了。

english: No one has seen him or the knights in quite a while. Quite a coincidence, don't you think?
translation: 好一阵子没人见过他或那些骑士了。真是巧合，你不觉得吗？

english: How curious. Maybe I should investigate it.
translation: 真奇怪。也许我该调查一下。

english: You didn't hear it from me, but I believe that guard in the garden is also investigating it. He might be able to tell you more.
translation: 你可别说是我说的，但我相信花园里那个守卫也在调查这件事。他也许能告诉你更多。

english: Very odd coincidence, but I don't really have time to look into it now.
translation: 非常奇怪的巧合，但我现在真的没时间调查。

english: Ah, too bad. I'll have to get news from my other sources.
translation: 啊，太可惜了。我得从其他渠道获取消息了。

english: You know, this has been bugging me for a while: Why do the Sinclairs have a dog handler on the payroll when they only have one dog?
translation: 你知道吗，有件事困扰我很久了：辛克莱尔庄园家族明明只有一条狗，为什么还要雇一个训犬师？

english: Have you seen that dog? It's a nasty piece of work. Even I don't like going near it.
translation: 你见过那条狗吗？它可不是善茬。连我都不喜欢靠近它。

english: 'Allo. I don't think you'll be able to visit the mansion today, it's been locked up tight for a while now.
translation: 你好。我觉得你今天进不了庄园了，它已经被锁得严严实实好一阵子了。

english: Good day, [player name]. I'm afraid we meet under strange circumstances again.
translation: 日安，[player name]。恐怕我们又在奇怪的情况下见面了。

english: So I have heard. The town gossip informed me that something was amiss. I've come to offer my assistance.
translation: 我听说了。镇上的八卦人士告诉我出了事。我是来提供帮助的。

english: Finally, that man serves a purpose. I'm glad to have your help. I'm baffled again and my hands are tied.
translation: 终于，那家伙派上用场了。很高兴能得到你的帮助。我又一次感到困惑，而且束手无策。

english: The Sinclairs have disappeared, though I'm not sorry to see them go, but what worries me is the disappearance of King Arthur and his knights around the same time.
translation: 辛克莱尔庄园家族消失了，虽然我并不可怜他们离开，但让我担心的是亚瑟王和他的骑士们也在差不多同一时间失踪了。

english: They haven't returned to their other realm have they?
translation: 他们没有回到他们的另一个领域吧？

english: No, there's no evidence to suggest that. It never sat well with the Sinclair children when their old man gave the castle to King Arthur and
translation: 不，没有证据表明这一点。当辛克莱尔家的老爷子把城堡交给亚瑟王和……时，他的孩子们一直对此耿耿于怀。

english: moved the family to this mansion. I suspect the murder of old Sinclair was just the first step in a deeper plot to retake their 'birthright'.
translation: 把全家搬到这座庄园时，辛克莱尔庄园的孩子们就一直耿耿于怀。我怀疑老辛克莱尔庄园勋爵被杀只是更深层阴谋的第一步，目的是夺回他们的‘与生俱来的权利’。

english: How goes the investigation, then? What evidence have you gathered so far?
translation: 那么调查进展如何？你目前收集到了什么证据？

english: That's the problem. The Seers' Village council has forbidden the guards from breaking into Camelot or the Sinclair Mansion for further investigation.
translation: 问题就在这里。先知村议会禁止守卫闯入卡美洛或辛克莱尔庄园进行进一步调查。

english: They claim it's a breach of privacy or something like that. My suspicions mean nothing without proof to back them up, but I can't get proof without losing my job.
translation: 他们声称这侵犯了隐私之类的。没有证据支持，我的怀疑毫无意义，但我要拿到证据就会丢掉工作。

english: Which is why you're happy to see me, right? A rogue party could break into the mansion and investigate further, without the fear of losing their job. Am I right?
translation: 所以你才高兴见到我，对吧？一个盗贼可以闯入庄园进一步调查，不用担心丢掉工作。我说得对吗？

english: Exactly! I'm sure you'll manage to find a way into the house.
translation: 没错！我相信你一定能找到办法进入房子。

english: Hi. I was wondering, do you know why the mansion is all locked up?
translation: 嗨。我想知道，你知道为什么庄园被锁得严严实实吗？

english: I'm not meant to talk to anyone outside the family. On pain of death.
translation: 我不被允许和家族以外的人说话。违者处死。

english: That's a bit harsh. Thanks anyway.
translation: 这有点过分了。不过还是谢谢。

english: 'Allo, what can I do for you?
translation: 你好，我能为你做点什么？

english: I'm trying to get into the mansion. Do you know why it's all locked up?
translation: 我想进庄园。你知道为什么它被锁得这么严实吗？

english: I wasn't privy to the reason, but the whole family upped and left not long ago. Since then, I haven't heard a peep from anyone. I was told not to enter the mansion or to speak about their departure.
translation: 我不清楚原因，但整个家族不久前突然离开了。从那以后，我没听到任何人的消息。我被告知不得进入庄园，也不得谈论他们的离开。

english: But you're willing to speak to me?
translation: 但你愿意跟我说话？

english: Didn't say I was going to obey them, did I?
translation: 我又没说我会服从他们，对吧？

english: Soooooo? What did the guard have to say?
translation: 所——以？那个守卫说了什么？

english: Promise you won't tell?
translation: 保证你不会说出去？

english: The guard asked me to break into the Sinclair Mansion and search for clues about where they had gone.
translation: 守卫让我闯入辛克莱尔庄园，寻找关于他们去向的线索。

english: that you were a gossip and I shouldn't divulge privileged information.
translation: 说你是个大嘴巴，我不该泄露机密信息。

english: What are you doing here? I thought the house was locked up tight.
translation: 你在这里做什么？我以为房子被锁得严严实实的。

english: Oh, it is, except for that broken window... Very convenient.
translation: 哦，确实如此，除了那扇破损的窗户……真方便。

english: Where has the Sinclair family gone?
translation: 辛克莱尔家族去哪了？

english: I'm under strict orders not to speak to anyone not of the Sinclair family.
translation: 我接到严格命令，不得与辛克莱尔家族以外的人说话。

english: I was told if I left the house that I would be killed!
translation: 我被告知，如果我离开房子就会被杀！

english: I think you need to look for a new job. Your employers are a bit scary.
translation: 我觉得你需要找份新工作。你的雇主有点吓人。

english: What are you doing in here? I didn't think anyone could enter or leave this place.
translation: 你在这里做什么？我以为没人能进出这个地方。

english: I'm looking for clues as to where the Sinclair family has gone. Why can't anyone enter or leave?
translation: 我在寻找关于辛克莱尔家族去向的线索。为什么没人能进出？

english: We were told a curse had been placed on us. If we left the mansion we'd be struck down in an instant.
translation: 我们被告知被下了诅咒术。如果我们离开庄园，瞬间就会被击倒。

english: Who...? Oh, I remember you! You were asking all those questions about Lord Sinclair's murder. You had all sorts of evid-whats-its.
translation: 谁……？哦，我记得你！你问过所有那些关于辛克莱尔勋爵谋杀案的问题。你有一大堆证什么据的。

english: Yes, that was me. Now I'm trying to find out where the Sinclair family has gone.
translation: 是的，就是我。现在我正试图找出辛克莱尔家族去了哪里。

english: I don't know. They got really secretive after Lord Sinclair was killed and then suddenly left. That's all I know.
translation: 我不知道。辛克莱尔勋爵被杀后，他们变得非常神秘，然后突然离开了。我就知道这些。

english: You aren't here to murder us in our sleep are you?
translation: 你不是来趁我们睡觉时谋杀我们的吧？

english: Well, I'd not be doing a very good job of it, if I was, considering you're not asleep.
translation: 嗯，如果我是的话，考虑到你还没睡着，我做得可不怎么样。

english: So, you are here to kill us!
translation: 所以，你是来杀我们的！

english: Uh, no. I'm just browsing.
translation: 呃，不是。我只是随便看看。

english: I don't know anything about that.
translation: 我对此一无所知。

english: Any luck getting into the mansion? Did you get some evidence?
translation: 进庄园有进展吗？找到什么证据了吗？

english: I have proof that the Sinclairs have left.
translation: 我有证据证明辛克莱尔家族已经离开了。

english: A form? What does this prove?
translation: 一张表格？这能证明什么？

english: Don't you see? The Sinclairs have left for good. They premeditated their departure from the mansion.
translation: 你没看出来吗？辛克莱尔家族已经永远离开了。他们预谋好了离开庄园。

english: Ah! Of course. Unfortunately, they filled in all of the form except where their new address is.
translation: 啊！当然。不幸的是，他们填了表格的所有部分，唯独没填新地址。

english: Really? Where?
translation: 真的吗？在哪里？

english: Errr, I seem to have left it somewhere.
translation: 呃，我好像把它落在某个地方了。

english: I have proof that links the Sinclairs to Camelot.
translation: 我有证据将辛克莱尔家族与卡美洛联系起来。

english: Aha! They've gone to the desert. They're meeting up with a camel.
translation: 啊哈！他们去了沙漠。他们要跟一头骆驼会面。

english: No...It's not camel, like the animal. The note isn't whole, they were writing the word Camelot. They were meeting at Camelot, this is our evidence to connect the Sinclairs to King Arthur.
translation: 不……不是骆驼那种动物。纸条不完整，他们写的是卡美洛这个词。他们在卡美洛会面，这就是我们将辛克莱尔家族与亚瑟王联系起来的证据。

english: Oh, right. Well, it connects them to King Arthur, but it doesn't prove that they had any bad intent towards him. For all we know they were going to a party.
translation: 哦，对。好吧，这把他们和亚瑟王联系起来了，但并不能证明他们对他有任何恶意。说不定他们只是去参加派对呢。

english: I have proof of foul play.
translation: 我有不正当行为的证据。

english: Hmm, this armour resembles Black Knight armour. The only Black Knights on this side of White Wolf Mountain are those that work for Morgan Le Faye.
translation: 嗯，这副盔甲很像黑骑士的盔甲。白狼山这一侧唯一的黑骑士就是为摩根.勒菲工作的那些。

english: Exactly. And we know Morgan Le Faye has a history of harassing Merlin and King Arthur.
translation: 没错。而且我们知道摩根.勒菲有骚扰梅林和亚瑟王的历史。

english: Since there is no sign of a struggle inside the Sinclair Mansion, we can only assume the knights were there by request.
translation: 既然辛克莱尔庄园内没有打斗的迹象，我们只能假设骑士们是应要求到场的。

english: Oh right! With this evidence and the note you brought me, we know they had intentions to do harm to King Arthur.
translation: 哦对！有了这个证据和你带给我的纸条，我们知道他们有意伤害亚瑟王。

english: Thank you, [player name]. We have all the proof we need to present to the Seers' Village council that something suspicious is going on.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。我们有足够的证据向先知村议会证明有可疑的事情发生。

english: They'll review the evidence and hopefully give me permission to take a team to Camelot. It shouldn't be too difficult to get to the bottom of this.
translation: 他们会审查证据，希望会允许我带一队人去卡美洛。查清这件事应该不会太难。

english: When do you expect to go to Camelot? Perhaps I could assist you?
translation: 你预计什么时候去卡美洛？也许我可以协助你？

english: Oh the Seers' Village council convenes in a month or so, I'll present it then. No doubt they'll want a few days to review the evidence.
translation: 哦，先知村议会大约一个月后开会，到时候我会提交证据。毫无疑问他们会花几天时间审查证据。

english: We'll go sometime after that...if none of the other guards are on holiday. There are only four of us, ya know.
translation: 之后我们会找个时间去……如果其他守卫没有休假的话。我们只有四个人，你知道的。

english: WHAT?
translation: 什么？

english: A month or more? King Arthur could be in grave danger. Morgan Le Faye is involved and she is not one to be trifled with. One of the Sinclairs has already committed murder, who's to say another won't?
translation: 一个月或更久？亚瑟王可能处于极度危险之中。摩根.勒菲也牵涉其中，她可不是好惹的。辛克莱尔家已经有人犯了谋杀罪，谁能保证不会再有人犯呢？

english: And you're going to wait a MONTH?
translation: 而你要等一个月？

english: I have to follow procedure, my hands are tied.
translation: 我必须遵守程序，我束手无策。

english: However, were a rogue adventurer to take the matter in to their own hands...
translation: 不过，如果有个不受管束的冒险者亲自处理这件事……

english: Aye, what then?
translation: 嗯，然后呢？

english: Well, if I were them, I would learn as much as I can about the Sinclair family history.
translation: 嗯，如果我是他们，我会尽可能多地了解辛克莱尔家族的历史。

english: That's all the advice you can give?
translation: 你只能给这些建议？

english: Well, often the best historians are the town gossips. I'd start there. Good luck, brave adventurer!
translation: 嗯，最好的历史学家往往是镇上的八卦人士。我会从那里开始。祝你好运，勇敢的冒险者！

english: Find out all you can about the Sinclair family history. I'm sure there is a clue or two there.
translation: 尽可能找出关于辛克莱尔庄园家族历史的一切。我相信那里会有一两条线索。

english: Hello again. Can you tell me about the Sinclair family history?
translation: 又见面了。你能告诉我关于辛克莱尔家族的历史吗？

english: Hmph. I don't see why I should tell you anything.
translation: 哼。我不觉得有什么理由要告诉你任何事。

english: What? Why not?
translation: 什么？为什么不行？

english: Perhaps if you had been less rude to me, I would have been willing to tell you.
translation: 也许如果你对我没那么粗鲁，我会愿意告诉你的。

english: I'm sorry I was rude. You are a vital part of this investigation. Unless you tell me about the Sinclairs, I won't be able to continue.
translation: 对不起，我太粗鲁了。你是这次调查的关键人物。除非你告诉我关于辛克莱尔家族的事，否则我无法继续。

english: Vital part, you say? So, I'll get credit for assistance? Well...I do know quite a bit about their history. I suppose I can't hold up an investigation as important as this. What do you want to know?
translation: 你说关键部分？那么，我会因为协助而得到认可吗？好吧……我确实知道不少他们的历史。我想我不能耽误这么重要的调查。你想知道什么？

english: Tell me about the family.
translation: 告诉我关于这个家族的事。

english: I've heard plenty about each of them...but I'll try to keep it as short as I can.
translation: 我听说过很多关于他们每个人的事……但我会尽量简短。

english: Old Lord Sinclair was a well respected man this side of White Wolf. He was great friends with King Ulthas and did many good works for the kingdom.
translation: 老辛克莱尔勋爵在白狼山这一侧是个备受尊敬的人。他是乌尔萨斯国王的好朋友，为王国做了许多善事。

english: His children on the other hand were spoiled and horrid. They cared for no one but themselves and gave themselves such aires. Each had their own vice, but I didn't expect any of them would be driven to murder!
translation: 另一方面，他的孩子们被宠坏了，令人厌恶。他们只关心自己，还摆出一副高高在上的样子。每个人都有自己的恶习，但我没想到他们中会有人被逼到杀人！

english: What have they been up to since the arrest of their sibling?
translation: 自从他们的兄弟姐妹被捕后，他们都在做些什么？

english: They've been living very quietly, a nice change from the norm. But almost too quietly. I always thought they'd get into more trouble. No good will come from them, let me tell you!
translation: 他们一直过得很安静，跟平时大不一样。但安静得有点过头了。我总觉得他们会惹出更多麻烦。我跟你说，他们准没好事！

english: Tell me about the mansion.
translation: 跟我说说那座庄园吧。

english: The mansion? The mansion is quite new. Originally, the Sinclair family lived in Camelot, although it went under a different name then.
translation: 庄园？这座庄园相当新。最初，辛克莱尔家族住在卡梅洛特，尽管那时它不叫这个名字。

english: But when King Arthur and his knights appeared, old Lord Sinclair agreed with King Ulthas that the knights had greater need for the castle than the Sinclair family.
translation: 但当亚瑟王和他的骑士出现时，老辛克莱尔勋爵同意乌尔萨斯王的看法，认为骑士们比辛克莱尔家族更需要这座城堡。

english: So, Lord Sinclair had the mansion built, packed his family up and vacated. His children were furious with him for doing it.
translation: 于是，辛克莱尔勋爵建造了这座庄园，收拾好家当搬走了。他的孩子们对此非常愤怒。

english: They felt themselves far better than the knights and felt insulted at having to live in a stuffy mansion.
translation: 他们觉得自己比那些骑士强多了，对不得不搬进一座闷人的庄园感到备受侮辱。

english: What happened next?
translation: 后来发生了什么？

english: Well, you should know best... Anna killed her father. Poor man.
translation: 嗯，你应该最清楚……安娜杀了她父亲。可怜的人啊。

english: Tell me about Anna Sinclair.
translation: 跟我讲讲安娜.辛克莱尔。

english: Anna? The guards are keeping her in the jail in the courthouse in Seers' Village. I hear she's been acting like a royal pain.
translation: 安娜？守卫把她关在先知村法院的监狱里。我听说她一直像个大麻烦一样闹腾。

english: But what is she like? Can she be reasoned with?
translation: 但她是个什么样的人？能跟她讲道理吗？

english: Reasoned with? She killed her own father!
translation: 讲道理？她杀了自己的父亲！

english: I hear she's being so unreasonable that no lawyer in Gielinor will represent her. She's going to get a guilty verdict for sure.
translation: 我听说她蛮不讲理，以至于吉列诺没有一个律师愿意为她辩护。她肯定会被判有罪的。

english: Still, I go and visit her at the Seers' Village courthouse sometimes to try and keep her spirits up.
translation: 不过，我还是会时不时去先知村的法院探望她，试着让她打起精神来。

english: Could I ask you about the Sinclair family again?
translation: 我能再问问你关于辛克莱尔家族的事吗？

english: Well, I'm not one to gossip, but as it's for your investigation... What would you like to know?
translation: 嗯，我不是个爱八卦的人，但既然是为了你的调查……你想知道什么？

english: Where is Anna Sinclair being held?
translation: 安娜.辛克莱尔被关在哪里？

english: At the Seers' Village courthouse.
translation: 在先知村的法院。

english: What can you tell me about Anna Sinclair?
translation: 关于安娜.辛克莱尔，你能告诉我什么？

english: What? I'm no gossip; I've got nothing to say about it.
translation: 什么？我不是爱嚼舌根的人；我没什么好说的。

english: What can you tell me about Anna?
translation: 你能告诉我关于安娜的什么事？

english: Why do you want to know about her?
translation: 你为什么想知道她的事？

english: I may need her help to get in touch with the rest of the Sinclairs.
translation: 我可能需要她的帮助来联系辛克莱尔家的其他人。

english: Good luck, mate. She's a right pain in the...
translation: 祝你好运，哥们。她真是个让人头疼的……

english: In the...?
translation: 让人头疼的……？

english: Sorry, you still here? I started thinking about turnips.
translation: 抱歉，你还在这儿？我刚才走神想萝卜去了。

english: Anna? She was a spoiled brat, that's for sure.
translation: 安娜？她就是个被宠坏的小鬼，这点毫无疑问。

english: Can't you tell me anything more useful than that?
translation: 你就不能告诉我点更有用的信息吗？

english: Anna? Why?
translation: 安娜？为什么？

english: Because she may be responsible for murder!
translation: 因为她可能犯了谋杀罪！

english: Oh yes. Well, I can't say I ever liked Anna. She was always chasing after some boy or other.
translation: 哦，对。嗯，我不能说我曾经喜欢过安娜。她总是追着这个或那个男孩跑。

english: Anna? I don't know very much.
translation: 安娜？我知道的不多。

english: You must have been privy to some of the children's secrets. Anything would be helpful.
translation: 你肯定知道一些孩子们的秘密。任何信息都会有帮助。

english: No, I don't know anything like that. I kept my head down and did my work.
translation: 不，我不知道那种事。我一直埋头做自己的事。

english: Anna?
translation: 安娜？

english: Yes, Anna.
translation: 是的，安娜。

english: Well, she's a murderer. What more could you need to know?
translation: 嗯，她是个杀人犯。你还想知道什么？

english: That Sinclair woman is such a pain! She keeps demanding gourmet meals and ridiculous things like silk sheets.
translation: 那个辛克莱尔女人真是个大麻烦！她一直要求美食餐点和像丝绸床单这样荒谬的东西。

english: Can I speak to her?
translation: 我能跟她谈谈吗？

english: Go ahead. It means she won't be demanding things from me.
translation: 去吧。这样她就不会来烦我了。

english: Mother said to join the guards, see the world! What do I end up doing? Guarding some stuck-up brat in a backwater village full of hippies.
translation: 母亲说去当守卫，见见世面！结果我最后干了什么？在一个满是嬉皮士的偏僻村子里看守一个傲慢的小鬼。

english: May I speak to the prisoner?
translation: 我可以和囚犯谈谈吗？

english: Hello. Do you remember me?
translation: 你好。你还记得我吗？

english: Hmmm...yes, you were that nosy person asking all those questions about daddy's murder.
translation: 嗯……是的，你就是那个多管闲事，问了一大堆关于爸爸谋杀案问题的人。

english: So he's 'daddy' now is he? If he was so dear to you why did you kill him?
translation: 所以现在叫他‘爸爸’了？既然他那么亲，你为什么杀了他？

english: I didn't! No one will believe me. It was my brother. He set me up.
translation: 我没有！没人相信我。是我哥哥干的。他陷害我。

english: But there's hard evidence against you.
translation: 但是有确凿的证据对你不利。

english: It's forged! I swear, I never touched that dagger or poisoned my father.
translation: 那是伪造的！我发誓，我从来没碰过那把匕首，也没给我父亲下毒。

english: I didn't come here to just chit-chat. I need to know where your family has disappeared to. I have suspicions they've reclaimed Camelot.
translation: 我不是来闲聊的。我需要知道你的家人都躲到哪里去了。我怀疑他们重新占领了卡梅隆。

english: How should I know? I've been locked up here since you stuck your nose into our family's business.
translation: 我怎么会知道？自从你插手我们家的闲事以来，我就一直被关在这里。

english: Well, I'll be off then. Have fun spending the rest of your life in jail.
translation: 好吧，那我走了。祝你剩下的日子在监狱里过得愉快。

english: I... I might know how to find them...but I need a favour from you in return.
translation: 我……我可能知道怎么找到他们……但我需要你帮我一个忙作为回报。

english: Name your price.
translation: 开个价吧。

english: I need a defence lawyer. None of the ones around here will represent me, they all think I'm guilty.
translation: 我需要一个辩护律师。这附近的律师没人愿意为我辩护，他们都认为我有罪。

english: Maybe it's because you ARE guilty. Your sibling offered hard proof you did it!
translation: 也许是因为你确实有罪。你的兄弟姐妹拿出了确凿的证据证明是你干的！

english: No he didn't! He just said he saw me in the room. Why does everyone believe him?
translation: 他没有！他只是说看到我在房间里。为什么大家都相信他？

english: Can't you see he framed me? I was the scapegoat so they could all inherit their fortunes and live the good life.
translation: 你看不出来是他陷害我吗？我是替罪羊，这样他们就能继承遗产，过上好日子。

english: Why should I believe you? As far as I know you did kill your father.
translation: 我为什么要相信你？据我所知，你确实杀了你父亲。

english: I don't care if you don't believe me. I know I'm innocent...but I'm also the only one that can show you how to get into Camelot. There's a secret passage that I discovered as a child when we lived there.
translation: 我不在乎你信不信我。我知道自己是清白的……但也只有我能告诉你如何进入卡美洛。有一条我小时候住在那里时发现的秘密通道。

english: So, if I agree to get you a 'not guilty' verdict at trial, you promise to tell me how to get into this secret passage that will lead me straight into Camelot?
translation: 所以，如果我同意在审判中帮你获得‘无罪’判决，你就保证告诉我如何进入这条能直通卡美洛的秘密通道？

english: Yes! Exactly. So, what do you say?
translation: 是的！没错。那么，你觉得怎么样？

english: Okay, I guess I don't have much of a choice. I'll go start gathering evidence.
translation: 好吧，我想我没什么选择。我会开始收集证据。

english: Try speaking to the servants at the Mansion. They'll probably be able to give you useful testimony.
translation: 试着跟庄园里的仆人们谈谈。他们大概能提供有用的证词。

english: Wait, take this.
translation: 等等，拿着这个。

english: You can use it as evidence.
translation: 你可以用它作为证据。

english: Of what, your guilt?
translation: 证明什么，你的罪行？

english: No, show it to the servants. You'll find one of my siblings wears similar colours.
translation: 不，把它给仆人们看。你会发现我的一个兄弟姐妹穿着类似颜色的衣服。

english: Have you made any progress?
translation: 你有进展了吗？

english: I'm working on it. It's not exactly easy to unprove something that's true.
translation: 我正在努力。要推翻一件真实的事情可不容易。

english: I need a piece of thread from the clothes you wore the night of the murder.
translation: 我需要你谋杀当晚穿的衣服上的一根线。

english: Whatever for?
translation: 要这个做什么？

english: I might need to show it to people when I ask them questions about the murder. It's evidence in the case.
translation: 我可能需要在向人们询问谋杀案时给他们看。这是案件中的证据。

english: I hear you're the defence lawyer for Anna, now.
translation: 我听说你现在是安娜的辩护律师了。

english: How can you possibly know that already?
translation: 你怎么可能已经知道了？

english: I'm the town gossip, I'm supposed to know this stuff. Are you preparing for the trial?
translation: 我是镇上的八卦精，当然要知道这些事。你在准备审判吗？

english: Well, I'm going to talk to the servants and see if I can learn anything new from them...but other than that, I don't really know what I'm doing.
translation: 嗯，我打算去跟仆人们谈谈，看看能不能从他们那里了解到什么新情况……但除此之外，我真的不知道该怎么做。

english: Well, my father was in the guards and he attended many trials. As a defence lawyer you need to disprove any evidence presented by the prosecution. Disproving it gives reasonable doubt as to whether or not your
translation: 嗯，我父亲曾在守卫队服役，他参加过许多审判。作为辩护律师，你需要反驳控方提出的任何证据。反驳它就能对你的……是否……产生合理怀疑。

english: client actually committed the crime.
translation: 当事人是否真的犯了罪。

english: But how do I know what evidence will be presented?
translation: 但我怎么知道会提出什么证据呢？

english: Some of it will be the evidence you found: the dagger, the poison and the thread. There was also an eyewitness saying they saw Anna tamper with Lord Sinclair's dinner. Start asking questions about those things and
translation: 其中一些会是你找到的证据：匕首、毒药和线。还有一个目击者说看到安娜在辛克莱尔勋爵的晚餐里动手脚。开始就这些事情提问，

english: see where you get.
translation: 看看你能发现什么。

english: I'm representing Anna Sinclair as a defence lawyer.
translation: 我作为辩护律师代表安娜.辛克莱尔。

english: Ha, ha, ha. That's a good one. Whoo, I needed a laugh.
translation: 哈哈哈，这笑话不错。呼，我正需要笑一笑。

english: Err, I'm not joking. I have to prove she is innocent.
translation: 呃，我没开玩笑。我必须证明她是清白的。

english: But the proof against her is conclusive. Someone saw her tamper with Sinclair's dinner!
translation: 但指控她的证据确凿。有人看到她在辛克莱尔的晚餐里动手脚！

english: One of her siblings claims to have seen that, but who can say if they're telling the truth?
translation: 她的一个兄弟姐妹声称看到了，但谁能说他们说的是真话呢？

english: Besides, it's for King Arthur. Anna is the only lead I have on how to find the King and his knights.
translation: 而且，这是为了亚瑟王。安娜是我能找到国王和他的骑士们的唯一线索。

english: This is a sad, sad day. I can't stop you from doing it, but I wish with all my heart you wouldn't. You'll be aiding a murderer.
translation: 真是可悲的一天。我无法阻止你这么做，但我真心希望你不要去。你这是在帮助一个杀人犯。

english: I'm representing Anna Sinclair as her defence lawyer. I need to ask you some questions about what happened the night of Lord Sinclair's murder.
translation: 我作为安娜.辛克莱尔的辩护律师代表她。我需要问你一些关于辛克莱尔勋爵被杀当晚发生的事情。

english: Dang, that's too bad for you. Isn't it a bit of conflict of interest, considering you were part of the investigation that proved she was guilty?
translation: 哎呀，那你可真倒霉。考虑到你也是证明她有罪的调查的一部分，这难道不是有点利益冲突吗？

english: Uh, anyways, I need to ask you some questions.
translation: 呃，不管怎样，我需要问你一些问题。

english: What can you tell me about the night of the murder?
translation: 关于谋杀当晚，你能告诉我什么？

english: I fed the dog and went to the inn in town. When I got back the guards were all over the place.
translation: 我喂了狗，然后去了镇上的酒馆。等我回来时，到处都是守卫。

english: Where did you last see Anna Sinclair on that fateful night?
translation: 在那个决定性的夜晚，你最后一次见到安娜.辛克莱尔是在哪里？

english: Didn't see any of the family. I was outdoors most of the evening, tending to things, then went to town.
translation: 没看到任何家族成员。我大半个晚上都在户外打理事情，然后去了镇上。

english: Did you ever see Anna in possession of the dagger that was found embedded in Lord Sinclair's body?
translation: 你见过安娜持有那把插在辛克莱尔勋爵尸体上的匕首吗？

english: That dagger? I think Lord Sinclair kept it in the library. It was only decorative, so  never paid much attention to it.
translation: 那把匕首？我想辛克莱尔勋爵把它放在图书馆里。它只是装饰品，所以我从没太注意它。

english: So, any of the family or servants would have had access to it.
translation: 所以，任何家族成员或仆人都可能拿到它。

english: Yes, I suppose they would.
translation: 是的，我想是的。

english: Err, I seem to have forgotten the thread I was going to show you. I'll need to get it from Anna Sinclair at the jail.
translation: 呃，我好像忘了要给你看的那根线。我得去监狱找安娜.辛克莱尔拿。

english: Can you tell me which Sinclair family member this thread belongs to?
translation: 你能告诉我这根线属于哪个辛克莱尔家族成员吗？

english: I'm not sure; it could be Anna's or David's.
translation: 我不确定；可能是安娜的，也可能是大卫的。

english: So, you can't identify the owner of the thread for certain?
translation: 所以，你不能确定这根线的主人是谁？

english: I can't.
translation: 我不能。

english: What can you tell me about the poison?
translation: 关于毒药，你能告诉我什么？

english: The poison salesman came around the mansion and practically everyone bought some.
translation: 毒药商人来过庄园，几乎每个人都买了点。

english: Can you tell me exactly who bought poison from him?
translation: 你能确切告诉我谁从他那里买了毒药吗？

english: Each of the Sinclair kids did. They all had chores they were meant to do. I had a chat with that salesman. Whoo, you any idea how strong that stuff was? Just a small amount would be enough to kill a cow.
translation: 每个辛克莱尔家的孩子都买了。他们都有各自的杂活要做。我和那个商人聊过。哇，你知道那玩意有多强吗？只需一点点就能毒死一头奶牛。

english: So, you're completely certain all of the Sinclair children bought poison? And it would only have needed a small portion to kill Lord Sinclair.
translation: 那么，你完全确定所有辛克莱尔家的孩子都买了毒药？而且只需要一小部分就能杀死辛克莱尔勋爵。

english: Yup, that's what the poison salesman said. I had a chat with him at the pub.
translation: 是啊，毒药商人就是这么说的。我在酒馆和他聊过。

english: That means someone could have used a small amount to frame Anna and still have done their chore. That's great news.
translation: 这意味着有人可能只用了一小部分来陷害安娜，同时还能完成他们的工作。这是个好消息。

english: Why in Gielinor would you want to do that? That's a lost cause if I ever heard one.
translation: 你在吉莱诺到底为什么要这么做？我从没听说过比这更没指望的事。

english: I know, I know, but circumstances... Well, I just need to ask you some questions, alright?
translation: 我知道，我知道，但情况……好吧，我只是需要问你几个问题，行吗？

english: Not all that much. I worked out here 'til late. I was getting ready to come in for dinner when all the commotion started.
translation: 没太多可说的。我在这里干活干到很晚。正准备进来吃晚饭，就乱起来了。

english: She must have been in the house, since I didn't see her out here.
translation: 她肯定在房子里，因为我在外面没看见她。

english: Didn't you hear the glass breaking when the window was smashed by the murderer?
translation: 凶手打碎窗户时，你没听到玻璃破碎的声音吗？

english: No, I was on this side of the garden and you can't hear much but the dog from over here.
translation: 没有，我在花园的这一边，除了狗叫，这边听不到什么。

english: Was the dog barking that night?
translation: 那晚狗叫了吗？

english: Hmm, not that I can remember. It was kept on display as some sort of replica of a great weapon. I'm not much good at history so I can't remember any details.
translation: 嗯，我不记得了。它一直被作为某种伟大武器的复制品展示。我历史不太好，所以记不清细节了。

english: Did you see anyone else handle the dagger?
translation: 你看到有别人碰过那把匕首吗？

english: I think the maid may have dusted it, but I don't really know, I work outside.
translation: 我想女仆可能擦过它，但我不太确定，我在外面工作。

english: This salesman came around selling this poison that could fix anything. I think most everyone bought some to use for chores around the mansion.
translation: 那个商人来卖这种能解决任何问题的毒药。我想大多数人都买了点，用在庄园的杂活上。

english: Did you buy any?
translation: 你买了吗？

english: No, but I requested one of the Sinclairs buy some to use on the compost. I can't remember if they did or not.
translation: 没有，但我让某个辛克莱尔家的人买了些用来做堆肥。我不记得他们有没有买。

english: Did Anna Sinclair buy any poison?
translation: 安娜.辛克莱尔买毒药了吗？

english: Yes, she did. I definitely remember seeing her buying some. I'm pretty sure she didn't use it for her chore either.
translation: 是的，她买了。我肯定记得看见她买了。我也很确定她没有把毒药用在她的杂活上。

english: Oh dear. That's not good.
translation: 哦天哪。这可不妙。

english: Didn't you already ask me questions about this? You were investigating the case and got all that evidence. Besides, Anna was proven guilty - by one of her own siblings.
translation: 你不是已经问过我这方面的问题了吗？你调查了案子，收集了所有证据。而且，安娜已经被证明有罪——还是被她自己的一个兄弟姐妹证明的。

english: Errr, well, circumstances have changed. Anyway, I need to ask you some questions.
translation: 呃，嗯，情况有变。总之，我需要问你一些问题。

english: I was tidying the bedrooms most of the afternoon and then assisted Louisa in the kitchen, preparing dinner. I gave Lord Sinclair's dinner to Mary, and shortly there after heard her screaming.
translation: 我大半个下午都在整理卧室，然后帮路易莎在厨房准备晚餐。我把辛克莱尔勋爵的晚餐给了玛丽，不久后就听到她尖叫。

english: I'm afraid I didn't see her. I didn't meet anyone when I walked from the bedrooms to the kitchen.
translation: 我没看到她。我从卧室走到厨房的路上谁也没遇见。

english: No, I only saw Lord Sinclair handle it.
translation: 没有，我只看到辛克莱尔勋爵碰过它。

english: No one else ever touched it?
translation: 没有别人碰过它？

english: Well, now that you have me thinking about it, I believe I saw David handle it once. I'm not really sure what he was doing with it, but I do remember him looking at it.
translation: 嗯，既然你让我想起这事，我记得好像看到大卫碰过它一次。我不太确定他在做什么，但我记得他看了看它。

english: That's wonderful? Why didn't you mention it before? It means it could have been planted to make it seem like Anna did it.
translation: 那太好了？你之前怎么没提？这意味着它可能是被故意放那里，让人以为是安娜干的。

english: So, you can't identify the owner of the thread, for certain?
translation: 所以，你不能确定这根线的主人是谁？

english: There were various chores around the house that required poison.
translation: 当时房子里有各种需要毒药的杂活。

english: Do you remember who bought poison?
translation: 你记得谁买了毒药吗？

english: I personally did not; I do not know about the others.
translation: 我自己没买；其他人我不知道。

english: About the murder? Well, there's not much to tell, honestly.
translation: 关于谋杀？嗯，老实说，没什么好说的。

english: I'm sorry to trouble you, but I really need some answers.
translation: 抱歉打扰你，但我真的需要一些答案。

english: I was with Hobbes the butler and Mary the maid in the kitchen. We were preparing dinner. I gave Mary Lord Sinclair's meal and sent her on her way.
translation: 我当时和管家霍布斯、女仆玛丽在厨房准备晚餐。我把辛克莱尔领主的饭给了玛丽，让她送过去。

english: So, you didn't see Mary deliver the food to Lord Sinclair?
translation: 所以，你没看到玛丽把食物送给辛克莱尔领主？

english: Of course not. I was here cooking, she was taking the meal to him. That's when she found the body.
translation: 当然没有。我当时在这里烹饪，她正在把餐食送去给他。就在那时她发现了尸体。

english: Then someone could have tampered with the meal while she was on the way?
translation: 那么，有可能有人在送饭途中在饭里动过手脚？

english: I can't imagine how. Mary carries the meal right in front of her the entire way!
translation: 我想象不出怎么动手脚。玛丽一路上都把饭端在身前！

english: But now that you mention it, I do remember seeing Anna Sinclair hanging about the kitchen earlier that day. She looked a bit shifty.
translation: 不过你一提，我倒记得那天早些时候看到安娜.辛克莱尔在厨房附近转悠。她看起来有点鬼鬼祟祟。

english: I was in the kitchen almost all day, but I did see her just before I began cooking the evening meal. She was wandering aimlessly. So, I snapped at her to get out of the way.
translation: 我几乎整天都在厨房里，但我确实在开始烹饪晚餐之前看到了她。她正漫无目的地游荡。所以，我厉声让她让开。

english: What did she do then?
translation: 她然后做了什么？

english: Stuck her tongue out at me and wandered away. Useless girl.
translation: 朝我吐了吐舌头，然后走开了。没用的丫头。

english: Well, that's not very conclusive.
translation: 嗯，这不太有说服力。

english: Not that I can remember. None of the children seemed to pay any attention to it, as it was just a replica and not worth anything.
translation: 我不记得了。孩子们似乎都没注意它，因为它只是个复制品，不值钱。

english: Did you see anyone else in possession of it?
translation: 你看到有别人拿着它吗？

english: I suppose Mary dusted it now and then, but I think it just sat on one of the bookshelves.
translation: 我想玛丽偶尔会擦擦它，但我觉得它就放在某个书架上。

english: It could be Anna's or David's.
translation: 可能是安娜的，也可能是大卫的。

english: I told Carol to buy some for the drains. I haven't a clue if she actually did or not, she rarely paid me any heed.
translation: 我让卡罗尔买些毒药用来清理排水沟。我不知道她到底买了没有，她很少听我的话。

english: Who else bought poison?
translation: 还有谁买了毒药？

english: I don't know. The Sinclairs were so stingy about money that I'm surprised any of them bought some.
translation: 我不知道。辛克莱尔家族在钱上那么抠门，我都很惊讶居然有人买了。

english: I don't like talking about that night. I still have nightmares about it.
translation: 我不想谈那晚的事。我现在还做噩梦。

english: I'm sorry to put you through it again, but I really have to get some answers.
translation: 抱歉让你再经历一次，但我真的需要得到一些答案。

english: What an awful night. It started out normally, I was in the kitchen with Hobbes and Louisa, helping with dinner. They gave me Lord Sinclair's meal. I went to deliver it and I found him...
translation: 那晚真可怕。一开始很正常，我和霍布斯、路易莎在厨房帮忙做晚饭。他们给了我辛克莱尔领主的饭。我去送饭，然后发现他……

english: There, there. I don't need you to tell me any more of that. What about on the way to the study? Did you see Anna?
translation: 好了好了。我不需要你再说那些了。去书房的路上呢？你看到安娜了吗？

english: No, I didn't pass Anna, I'm sure of that. I think I passed one of the other young Sinclairs though. A man.
translation: 没有，我没碰到安娜，我确定。但我好像碰到了另一个年轻的辛克莱尔家族成员。一个男的。

english: Really? So, you can't place Anna at the murder scene, but there was a man there? David, Bob or Frank?
translation: 真的？那么，你不能把安娜和谋杀现场联系起来，但那里有一个男人？大卫、鲍勃还是弗兰克？

english: I can't remember. I just remember it being a man.
translation: 我不记得了。我只记得是个男人。

english: That's great news.
translation: 这真是好消息。

english: I was cleaning the library. I saw her come into the room.
translation: 我当时在打扫图书馆。我看见她进了房间。

english: What was she doing?
translation: 她在做什么？

english: Nothing really, just wandering.
translation: 没什么，就是闲逛。

english: She wasn't acting suspicious?
translation: 她没表现出可疑行为？

english: No, nothing like that.
translation: 不，没有。

english: Did you see her anywhere near the scene of the murder?
translation: 你在谋杀现场附近见过她吗？

english: No, I never did. And I walked from the kitchen to Lord Sinclair's room, so I would have.
translation: 没有，从来没有。而且我从厨房走到辛克莱尔领主的房间，要是她在附近我肯定会看到。

english: Very interesting. That's very helpful.
translation: 非常有趣。这很有帮助。

english: Not that I can think of.
translation: 我想不到什么。

english: Not really. I can't remember who handled it, if anyone.
translation: 不太确定。我不记得有谁碰过它。

english: Hmm, it could be Anna's or David's.
translation: 嗯，可能是安娜的，也可能是大卫的。

english: Nothing, really. I didn't buy any.
translation: 没什么可说的。我没买。

english: Do you know who did?
translation: 你知道谁买了？

english: No, I was upstairs cleaning when the salesman came by, so I didn't know until after he left that he'd been here.
translation: 不知道，商人来的时候我在楼上打扫，所以我直到他离开后才知道他来过了。

english: But she was proven guilty! There was even evidence.
translation: 但她已经被证明有罪了！甚至还有证据。

english: Well, I have my doubts.
translation: 嗯，我有疑虑。

english: I went to bed early as I'd been up very early fixing some garden equipment.
translation: 我很早就上床了，因为我很早就起来修花园的装备。

english: So, you didn't see or hear anything unusual?
translation: 那么，你没有看到或听到任何不寻常的事情吗？

english: Let's see. I'd finished up early for the day and was heading to bed. I can't remember seeing any one on my way there.
translation: 让我想想。那天我提早收工，正准备上床睡觉。我不记得在路上看到任何人。

english: Are you certain?
translation: 你确定吗？

english: Hmm, I seem to remember her looking at it a few days before the murder.
translation: 嗯，我好像记得在谋杀案发生前几天，她曾经看过它。

english: Nothing much. I didn't buy any and I don't remember who did.
translation: 没什么。我没买过，也不记得谁买了。

english: You're certain you don't remember anything?
translation: 你确定你什么都不记得了？

english: Hmm, I think I'll gather more evidence, first.
translation: 嗯，我想我还是先收集更多证据吧。

english: This court is now in session.
translation: 本庭现在开庭。

english: This trial is to determine the guilt or innocence of Anna Sinclair for the murder of Lord Sinclair.
translation: 本次审判旨在裁定安娜.辛克莱尔谋杀辛克莱尔勋爵一案是有罪还是无罪。

english: Is the prosecution ready?
translation: 检察官准备好了吗？

english: The prosecution is ready, Your Honour.
translation: 检察官准备好了，法官大人。

english: Is the defence ready?
translation: 防御方准备好了吗？

english: The defence is ready, Your Honour.
translation: 辩方准备好了，法官大人。

english: Very well. The prosecution may present its case.
translation: 很好。检察官可以陈述案情了。

english: Thank you, Your Honour.
translation: 谢谢您，法官大人。

english: Members of the jury, I am going to present you with evidence that decisively proves Anna Sinclair is a murderer.
translation: 陪审团成员们，我将向你们出示证据，确凿地证明安娜.辛克莱尔庄园是一名谋杀犯。

english: First, the dagger. The dagger was found stabbed into Lord Sinclair's body; it has the fingerprints of Anna Sinclair all over it.
translation: 第一，匕首。这把匕首被发现刺入辛克莱尔勋爵体内；上面布满了安娜.辛克莱尔的指纹。

english: Second, the thread. This thread was found at the scene of the crime; it matches Anna Sinclair's clothes.
translation: 第二，线。这根线在犯罪现场被发现；它与安娜.辛克莱尔的衣服相符。

english: Last, but certainly not least, the poison that actually killed Lord Sinclair; it was found at the scene of the crime and had been bought by the defendant. Members of the jury, this woman is guilty.
translation: 最后但同样重要的是，真正杀死辛克莱尔勋爵的毒药；它在犯罪现场被发现，并且是由被告购买的。陪审团成员们，这个女人有罪。

english: Thank you, prosecutor.
translation: 谢谢你，检察官。

english: Defence, as this is your first time in court, I'm going to explain how we do things around here.
translation: 辩方，鉴于这是你第一次出庭，我来解释一下这里的程序。

english: You may call for a recess at any time by leaving through the gate behind you. You'll have to start the trial over when you return. You may call witnesses by speaking to me. When you are finished with a witness
translation: 你可以随时通过身后的门离开，申请休庭。回来后需要重新开始审判。你可以通过与我交谈来传唤证人。当你结束与一位证人的问答后，

english: simply speak to me and call the next one.
translation: 只需与我交谈，然后传唤下一位。

english: Your job is to disprove the evidence presented by the prosecution by having your witnesses testify. If you need to hear the prosecution's case again, just speak to him. Let's begin.
translation: 你的任务是通过让证人作证来反驳检察官提出的证据。如果你需要重新听取检察官的案情陈述，只需与他交谈。我们开始吧。

english: Who would you like to call as a witness?
translation: 你想传唤谁作为证人？

english: The defence calls the Sinclairs' handyman.
translation: 辩方传唤辛克莱尔家的杂工。

english: The defence calls the Sinclairs' dog handler.
translation: 辩方传唤辛克莱尔家的狗管理员。

english: The defence calls the Sinclairs' butler.
translation: 辩方传唤辛克莱尔家的管家。

english: The defence calls the Sinclairs' maid.
translation: 辩方传唤辛克莱尔家的女仆。

english: What's your name and occupation?
translation: 你的名字和职业是什么？

english: Hobbes; I am the butler.
translation: 霍布斯；我是管家。

english: No, I only saw Lord Sinclair handle it. It was on display in the library.
translation: 不，我只看到辛克莱尔庄园勋爵碰过它。它当时陈列在图书馆里。

english: Well, now that you have me thinking about it, I believe I saw Frank handle it once. I'm not really sure what he was doing with it, but I do remember him looking at it.
translation: 嗯，既然你让我回想，我想我看到弗兰克碰过一次。我不太确定他在拿它做什么，但我记得他盯着它看。
