english: You are saying that you saw someone other than Anna handle the dagger?
translation: 你是说你还看到除了安娜之外的人碰过这把匕首？

english: Not only has a person other than my client been identified handling the weapon, but the dagger was within easy access to anyone in the household.
translation: 不仅有人被指认除了我的委托人之外碰过这件武器，而且这把匕首对庄园里的任何人都唾手可得。

english: My client's fingerprints could have been planted on it by another party.
translation: 我的委托人的指纹可能是被另一方故意留在上面的。

english: Order! ORDER!
translation: 肃静！肃静！

english: Donovan; I'm the handyman.
translation: 多诺万；我是杂工。

english: Could you tell us who this thread belongs to?
translation: 你能告诉我们这根线是谁的吗？

english: That thread could be Anna's or David's; they always seemed to be wearing that colour.
translation: 那根线可能是安娜的，也可能是大卫的；他们似乎总是穿那个颜色的衣服。

english: So, you can't say for certain who this thread belongs to.
translation: 那么，你不能确定这根线是谁的。

english: No, sorry, I can't.
translation: 不，抱歉，我不能。

english: Then this thread could have come from either of Anna or David's clothes, and they had many of this colour. A fact that would be known to anyone of the household.
translation: 那么这根线可能来自安娜或大卫的衣服，而且他们有很多这种颜色的衣服。庄园里的任何人都知道这个事实。

english: Sure, anybody would have seen that.
translation: 当然，谁都会看到这一点。

english: Then the thread could have been planted by someone else to throw suspicion on my client. I think we can all see this thread is very questionable evidence.
translation: 那么这根线可能是别人故意留下的，以将怀疑引向我的委托人。我想我们都能看出这根线作为证据非常可疑。

english: Pierre; I'm the dog handler.
translation: 皮埃尔；我是狗管理员。

english: Each of the Sinclair kids did; they all had chores they were meant to do. I had a chat with that salesman. Whoo-boy, you any idea how strong that stuff was? Just a small amount would be enough to kill a cow.
translation: 辛克莱尔庄园的每个孩子都买了；他们都有自己该做的家务。我和那个推销员聊过。哎呀，你知道那东西有多强吗？一点点就足以杀死一头奶牛。

english: So, only a small amount of poison would be enough to kill a man, I suppose?
translation: 那么，我想只需要少量毒药就足以杀死一个人了？

english: Yeah, I s'pose it would.
translation: 是啊，我想是的。

english: Therefore, any one of the Sinclairs who bought poison could have done their chore and poisoned Lord Sinclair as well. Just because my client was too lazy to do her chore doesn't mean she poisoned Lord Sinclair.
translation: 因此，任何一个买了毒药的辛克莱尔家人都可以在做家务的同时毒死辛克莱尔勋爵。仅仅因为我的委托人懒得做家务，并不代表她毒死了辛克莱尔勋爵。

english: Mary; I'm the maid.
translation: 玛丽；我是女仆。

english: Where did you last see Anna on that fateful night?
translation: 在那个关键的夜晚，你最后一次看到安娜是在哪里？

english: I was in the kitchen with Hobbes and Louisa, helping with dinner. They gave me Lord Sinclair's meal. I went to deliver it and I found him...
translation: 我当时和霍布斯、路易莎一起在厨房帮忙准备晚餐。他们把辛克莱尔庄园勋爵的餐食交给我。我去送餐，然后发现他……

english: What about on the way to the study? Did you see Anna?
translation: 那在去书房的路上呢？你看到安娜了吗？

english: No, I didn't pass Anna, I'm sure of that. I think I passed one of the other young Sinclairs, though. A man.
translation: 不，我没有碰到安娜，我确定。不过我想我碰到了另一个年轻的辛克莱尔家的人。一个男人。

english: Indeed. Well, if my client can't be placed at the murder scene, and there is evidence that a man was there, I think it casts a great deal of doubt on the case.
translation: 确实。那么，如果我的委托人无法被证明在谋杀现场，而且有证据表明那里有一个男人，我认为这给本案带来了很大的疑虑。

english: I believe we've heard enough.
translation: 我相信我们已经听够了。

english: Would the jury please pronounce their verdict?
translation: 请陪审团宣布裁决？

english: Very well. Anna Sinclair, you are hereby declared 'not guilty' by a jury of your peers. You are free to go.
translation: 很好。安娜.辛克莱尔，你被同等地位的陪审团宣告‘无罪’。你现在可以自由离开了。

english: I can't believe you did it. I'm free!
translation: 我简直不敢相信你做到了。我自由了！

english: Yes, but what about our deal?
translation: 是的，但我们的约定呢？

english: Shhh. Don't talk about that here! The guards are going to take me back to my cell for paperwork. Meet me there and I'll explain how to get into Camelot.
translation: 嘘。别在这儿说！守卫要带我回牢房办手续。在那儿等我，我会解释如何进入卡美洛。

english: What's with the balloons?
translation: 这些气球是怎么回事？

english: Ah, the court house was built over the Party Room...
translation: 啊，法院是建在派对房间上面的……

english: Balloons we can handle, it's when those dancing knights show up that it gets troublesome.
translation: 气球我们能应付，但那些跳舞的骑士出现时才会变得麻烦。

english: Well, being an attorney was an interesting experience.
translation: 嗯，当律师是一次有趣的经历。

english: Those were some dirty tricks you played. Your so- called 'proof' doesn't hold up under any scrutiny.
translation: 你玩的那些花招可真卑鄙。你所谓的“证据”根本经不起任何推敲。

english: I know, but I needed to get a 'not guilty' verdict.
translation: 我知道，但我必须得到“无罪”的裁决。

english: You've let a cold-blooded murderer go free. I hope the guilt eats away at you.
translation: 你让一个冷血杀手逍遥法外了。我希望内疚会吞噬你。

english: That was a well presented case. Court is now over, so you may leave when you like.
translation: 这是一个很好的案件陈述。现在庭审结束，你可以随时离开了。

english: Can I speak to my client?
translation: 我可以和我的委托人谈谈吗？

english: Of course. You can speak to them here or back at the jail cell. They'll be released later today after some paperwork gets filled out.
translation: 当然可以。你可以在这里和他们谈，也可以回牢房谈。他们今天晚些时候办完手续就会被释放。

english: I can't believe such an incompetent fool as you managed to prove me innocent.
translation: 我真不敢相信像你这样无能的傻瓜居然能证明我无罪。

english: You need to hold up your end of the bargain. Tell me how to get into Camelot or I go back to the judge and tell him I have doubts about your innocence.
translation: 你得履行你的承诺。告诉我怎么进卡美洛，否则我就回去找法官，告诉他我对你的清白有疑虑。

english: You are demanding for a peasant, aren't you. Walk around the edge of Camelot towards the back of the castle. From the hedges, you should be able to see the garden temple. There's a statue back there, if you pull
translation: 作为一个农民，你还真敢提要求。沿着卡美洛的边缘绕到城堡后面。从树篱那里，你应该能看到花园神殿。后面有一座雕像，如果你拉动

english: the arm a secret entrance will appear. Go inside and it will take you straight into Camelot.
translation: 它的手臂，就会出现一个秘密入口。走进去，它会直接把你带进卡美洛。

english: What are you going to be doing? Aren't you coming with me?
translation: 你打算做什么？你不跟我一起去吗？

english: I have to sign some paper work before I can leave here. Besides, the last thing I want to do is go hang out with my family. I'm sure you can manage this on your own.
translation: 我得先签些文件才能离开这里。而且，我最不想做的就是跟我的家人混在一起。我相信你能自己搞定这件事。

english: How do I get into Camelot again?
translation: 我怎么进入卡美洛来着？

english: Walk around the edge of Camelot towards the back of the castle. From the hedges, you should be able to see the garden temple. There's a statue back there, if you pull the arm a secret entrance will appear. Go inside
translation: 沿着卡美洛的边缘绕到城堡后面。从树篱那里，你应该能看到花园神殿。后面有一座雕像，如果你拉动它的手臂，就会出现一个秘密入口。走进去，

english: and it will take you straight into Camelot.
translation: 它会直接把你带进卡美洛。

english: You see, I told you that adventurer would turn up. He believed my every word.
translation: 你看，我告诉过你那个冒险者会出现。他相信我说的每一句话。

english: Well done, sibling. I knew you'd manage to get a 'not guilty' verdict, but to lure this cretin here as well...
translation: 干得好，兄弟/姐妹。我就知道你能搞定“无罪”裁决，但居然还把这家伙引到这里来了……

english: What can I say, I'm impressed.
translation: 我还能说什么呢，印象深刻。

english: Why thank you. What are we going to do with him now?
translation: 多谢夸奖。我们现在拿他怎么办？

english: Enough! I'm sick of having to listen to your drivel.
translation: 够了！我听腻了你们的废话。

english: Do you think 'she' would want to see him?
translation: 你觉得“她”想见他吗？

english: Most definitely. Have someone go and fetch her.
translation: 绝对想。派人去把她带来。

english: I hear you have something of interest to me.
translation: 我听说你有我感兴趣的东西。

english: Yes, my lady. The meddling adventurer who helped King Arthur in the past.
translation: 是的，夫人。那个过去帮助过亚瑟王的多管闲事的冒险者。

english: I knew it. I knew Morgan Le Faye had to be involved. Where is King Arthur and his knights? What have you done with them?
translation: 我就知道。我就知道摩根.勒菲肯定参与了。亚瑟王和他的骑士们在哪里？你们把他们怎么了？

english: Oh, they are quite safe. You'll be seeing them soon, although not Arthur. He's a bit...busy at the moment.
translation: 哦，他们非常安全。你很快就会见到他们的，不过亚瑟除外。他此刻有点……忙。

english: I'll foil your plans Morgan, just like I always do. I won't let you win. Good alwa-
translation: 我会像往常一样挫败你的计划，摩根。我不会让你得逞的。正义永-

english: I'm tired of this.
translation: 我受够了。

english: I should speak to Merlin first.
translation: 我应该先和梅林谈谈。

english: Isn't it terrible what happened to King Arthur? He was turned to stone before my eyes! I have failed him, I am not worthy of being his knight. To allow such lowlifes to take Camelot right from under our noses... It's unforgivable.
translation: 亚瑟王遭遇的事太可怕了，不是吗？他就在我眼前变成了石头！我辜负了他，我不配做他的骑士。让这些下等人就从我们眼皮底下夺走卡美洛……这是不可原谅的。

english: Buck up, man. We'll escape from here and set everything to right.
translation: 振作点，伙计。我们会从这里逃出去，把一切纠正过来。

english: I will wreak havoc upon those worthless Sinclairs. Betraying their father's wishes like that, it's despicable.
translation: 我要对那些无用的辛克莱尔庄园人大肆报复。那样背叛他们父亲的意愿，真是可耻。

english: I could have taken all of them on! Those Black Knights wouldn't stand a chance against me, the greatest knight in the land.
translation: 我本可以一个人对付他们所有人！那些黑骑士根本不是我的对手，我是这片土地上最伟大的骑士。

english: Then why are you in this jail?
translation: 那你为什么在这间牢房里？

english: They attacked while I was in the bath. What was I to do?
translation: 我在浴池里的时候他们袭击了我。我还能怎么办？

english: Hey, are you laughing at me, the greatest knight in the land?
translation: 嘿，你是在嘲笑我吗，这片土地上最伟大的骑士？

english: Huh, oh no. I wouldn't laugh at the greatest knight in the land.
translation: 呃，没有。我可不敢嘲笑这片土地上最伟大的骑士。

english: Please, don't ask me any questions. I am still too upset from our defeat at the hands of those treacherous Sinclairs.
translation: 拜托，别问我任何问题。我还在为败给那些背信弃义的辛克莱尔庄园而难过。

english: Greetings, brave knight. I believe you should speak to Merlin, he probably has need of your assistance.
translation: 你好，勇敢的骑士。我觉得你应该去找梅林谈谈，他可能需要你的帮助。

english: Oh dear, did Morgan capture you too?
translation: 哦天哪，摩根也把你抓来了？

english: Err, no. It was all part of my brilliant plan. I allowed her to capture me so I could find out where she was keeping all of you.
translation: 呃，不是。这都是我英明计划的一部分。我故意让她抓住我，这样我就能查出她把你们关在哪里了。

english: Eh, is that so? Very clever. Now that you've found us, what is your plan, oh brilliant leader?
translation: 呃，是吗？真聪明。既然你找到我们了，那你的计划是什么，哦英明的领袖？

english: Hey, why do I have to do all the thinking here? You're the brilliant wizard.
translation: 嘿，为什么所有动脑子的事都得我来？你才是那个聪明的魔法师。

english: Well, all great plans start with knowledge. Let me bring you up to speed with the situation. What do you want to know?
translation: 嗯，所有伟大的计划都始于了解情况。让我给你讲讲目前的局势。你想知道什么？

english: Where is King Arthur now? He's not in the jail cell with us.
translation: 亚瑟王现在在哪？他没和我们一起在牢房里。

english: As the final blow to our morale, Morgan turned Arthur into a granite statue before our very eyes. He was taken away by the Black Knights, for what purposes I know not.
translation: 为了彻底打击我们的士气，摩根当着我们的面把亚瑟变成了一尊花岗岩雕像。他被黑骑士带走了，我不知道他们有什么目的。

english: What is the connection between Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs?
translation: 摩根.勒菲和辛克莱尔庄园之间有什么关系？

english: Morgan Le Faye has been itching to get revenge upon Arthur and myself for some time. When she heard of the murder of old Sinclair, she learned she was not the only one with a vendetta against Camelot.
translation: 摩根.勒菲一直渴望找机会向亚瑟王和我复仇。当她听说老辛克莱尔庄园被谋杀时，她得知自己并不是唯一一个对卡美洛特怀有仇怨的人。

english: The Sinclairs have wanted to get their slimy hands on Camelot since their father's death. With Morgan's cunning and their riches, they make a formidable team. They bought the services of the Black Knights from
translation: 自从父亲死后，辛克莱尔家族就一直想把他们肮脏的手伸向卡美洛特。凭借摩根的狡猾和他们的财富，他们组成了一个强大的团队。他们从达夸里乌斯领主那里买来了黑骑士的服务，

english: Lord Daquarius and overran Camelot. We were outnumbered and taken by surprise.
translation: 达夸里乌斯领主攻占了卡美洛。我们寡不敌众，而且被打了个措手不及。

english: The Sinclairs stole our home, but Morgan struck the greater blow by stealing the Holy Grail, Arthur's most prized possession.
translation: 辛克莱尔家族偷走了我们的家园，但摩根更狠，她偷走了圣杯——亚瑟最珍贵的宝物。

english: So what's the plan of escape? Are you going to teleport us all away? Turn us into fish and swim to sea?
translation: 那逃跑计划是什么？你要把我们全都传送走吗？还是把我们变成鱼游到海里去？

english: During the battle at Camelot, Morgan cast a spell against me which appears to have stripped me of my powers. I must admit, the loss of my magic has left me befuddled, making it difficult to create a plan.
translation: 在卡美洛特的战斗中，摩根对我施了一个咒语，似乎剥夺了我的力量。我必须承认，失去魔法让我不知所措，很难制定计划。

english: Well, I'm sure if we put our heads together we will think of something.
translation: 嗯，我相信只要我们集思广益，一定能想出办法的。

english: Let's talk about a plan of escape.
translation: 我们来谈谈逃跑计划吧。

english: Escape is only a short-term plan. We should discuss the long-term goals as well.
translation: 逃跑只是短期计划。我们也应该讨论一下长期目标。

english: How will we go about reclaiming Camelot?
translation: 我们怎么夺回卡美洛特？

english: I think I could reclaim Camelot from the Sinclairs on my own.
translation: 我觉得我一个人就能从辛克莱尔家族手里夺回卡美洛特。

english: How do you plan to do that? You couldn't even defend it from them.
translation: 你打算怎么做？你连防守都防不住他们。

english: They don't know I've lost my magic. Besides, I've got a few tricks up my sleeves. For all their snobberies, they're still just spoiled brats. It shouldn't be difficult, but time is of the essence. I need you to break me out
translation: 他们不知道我失去了魔法。再说了，我袖子里还有几招。尽管他们自命不凡，但终究只是被宠坏的小鬼。应该不难，但时间紧迫。我需要你尽快悄悄地把我弄出去，

english: of here quickly and quietly, so Morgan cannot alert them.
translation: 这样摩根就没法通知他们了。

english: So to reclaim Camelot, I need to break you out of jail quietly.
translation: 所以要夺回卡美洛特，我需要悄悄把你弄出监狱。

english: How do I retrieve the Holy Grail? Do you know where it is?
translation: 我怎么才能找回圣杯？你知道它在哪吗？

english: Morgan always keeps things of power near her. So the Grail will be somewhere in Keep Le Faye. However, it will most likely be disguised and booby-trapped. Morgan has a thing about transmogrifying.
translation: 摩根总是把有力量的东西放在身边。所以圣杯应该在勒菲堡的某个地方。不过，它很可能被伪装起来，还设有陷阱。摩根对变形术情有独钟。

english: The last time I was in Keep Le Faye, it was pretty well guarded. I don't think I'll be able to sneak in quietly.
translation: 上次我去勒菲堡的时候，那里守卫森严。我觉得我没法悄悄溜进去。

english: No, that won't work. Better to break out of the jail with all of the Round Table Knights. Let them deal with the guards while you retrieve the Grail.
translation: 不，那行不通。最好和所有圆桌骑士一起越狱。让他们对付守卫，你去取圣杯。

english: So, I need to break eight knights out of jail? That could be troublesome.
translation: 所以，我需要把八个骑士救出监狱？那可能很麻烦。

english: Often the most complicated things have the simplest answers. Try leaving through the door.
translation: 最复杂的事情往往有最简单的答案。试试从门走出去。

english: But it's locked.
translation: 但门是锁着的。

english: When has that ever stopped an intrepid adventurer such as yourself?
translation: 这什么时候难倒过像你这样勇敢的冒险者？

english: Assuming I can escape from this jail, how can I save King Arthur?
translation: 假设我能逃出这个监狱，我怎么才能救亚瑟王？

english: I believe he's been taken to the headquarters of the Black Knights. I'm afraid I'm not well travelled on that side of the world, so I don't know its exact location. However, it's trickier than just finding Arthur. You'll
translation: 我相信他被带到了黑骑士的总部。可惜我对那边不太熟悉，所以不知道确切位置。不过，找到亚瑟只是第一步，你还需要

english: need to free him of the spell that turned him into a granite statue.
translation: 解除把他变成花岗岩雕像的咒语。

english: And how do I go about doing that?
translation: 那我该怎么做呢？

english: Let me finish. I may have no idea, but a wizard friend of mine should. His name is Wizard Cromperty, and he's very experienced in freeing people from stone since he keeps teleporting them into it. Speak to him in East
translation: 让我说完。我可能不知道，但我的一位魔法师朋友应该知道。他叫法师克伦珀蒂，在把人从石头里解救出来方面经验丰富，因为他经常把人传送到石头里。去东阿多尼城找他，

english: Ardougne, he'll help you.
translation: 阿多尼城，他会帮你。

english: Any thoughts on how we could escape?
translation: 想到什么逃跑的办法了吗？

english: No, but when we do, I'm going to make those Black Knights black and blue all over.
translation: 不，但等我们找到他，我要把那些黑骑士打得浑身青一块紫一块。

english: Have you had any brilliant ideas on how to get out of here?
translation: 你有没有想出什么离开这里的妙计？

english: You usually leave rooms through doors, but this one is locked.
translation: 你通常都是通过门离开房间的，但这扇门是锁着的。

english: Any thoughts on how we can get out of this cell?
translation: 想到什么办法离开这个牢房了吗？

english: I saw a grate high up on the wall of the cell. I think someone could slip through that, but I'm not sure how they would reach it.
translation: 我看到牢房墙上高处有一个格栅。我觉得有人能钻过去，但不知道怎么够到它。

english: I have great faith that you will lead us to victory. But first we must win the battle, then worry about the war. If you require my assistance in escaping from this wretched cell, please tell me.
translation: 我坚信你会带领我们走向胜利。但我们必须先打赢这场战斗，再担心战争。如果你需要我帮忙逃离这个可恶的牢房，请告诉我。

english: Thank you, I will let you know.
translation: 谢谢，我会告诉你的。

english: Any ideas...
translation: 有什么想法吗……

english: Please, no questions. I am in mourning for our King.
translation: 求你了，别问问题。我正在为我们的国王哀悼。

english: Any thoughts on how we could break out of this cell?
translation: 想到什么办法逃出这个牢房了吗？

english: Well, I would have thought picking the lock was really the best way, but I don't have the knowledge or tools to do it.
translation: 嗯，我觉得撬锁是最好的办法，但我既没有知识也没有工具。

english: Any ideas on how to get out of this cell?
translation: 有什么办法离开这个牢房吗？

english: Sir Kay and I noticed a grate high up on the wall that leads to the small docks at the back of the keep, but it's too high up to reach and we couldn't figure out a way to boost our height.
translation: 凯爵士和我注意到墙上高处有一个格栅，通向城堡后面的小码头，但太高了够不着，我们想不出办法增加高度。

english: We don't have a ladder...but we do have a lot of knights.
translation: 我们没有梯子……但我们有很多骑士。

english: Hey guys! I've got an idea...
translation: 嘿，伙计们！我有个主意……

english: Hey guys, do you think you could lift me out too? I need to run some errands. I'll come back and free you all as soon as I can!
translation: 嘿，伙计们，你们能也把我抬出去吗？我需要去办点事。我会尽快回来救你们所有人的！

english: Pie? How very useful to our cause.
translation: 馅饼？这对我们的事业可真是大有用处。

english: We need to get through the cell door, but I haven't got anything to open it. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: 我们需要打开牢房门，但我没有开锁的东西。你口袋里有什么有用的东西吗？

english: Great, these will be a huge help.
translation: 太好了，这些会帮上大忙。

english: Gee, thanks. You've contributed so much to my plan.
translation: 哎呀，多谢了。你对我的计划贡献真大。

english: I'm working on it. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: 我正在想办法。你口袋里有什么有用的东西吗？

english: I'm sorry, I don't have any pockets.
translation: 抱歉，我没有口袋。

english: I'm afraid not. I didn't have anything with me when we were captured.
translation: 恐怕没有。被抓的时候我什么都没带。

english: I'm looking for inspiration. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: 我在寻找灵感。你口袋里有什么有用的东西吗？

english: Thanks... I think.
translation: 谢谢……我想是吧。

english: The quickest way is through the cell door, but I don't have anything to pick the lock with. Have you got any useful objects in your pockets?
translation: 最快的办法是通过牢房门，但我没有撬锁的工具。你口袋里有什么有用的东西吗？

english: Err, thanks.
translation: 呃，谢谢。

english: Need a hand?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

english: No, my revenge will be my own. You must retrieve the Holy Grail!
translation: 不，我的复仇要由我自己来完成。你必须去取回圣杯！

english: WHOO! Get 'em! Show no mercy.
translation: 喔！揍他们！不要仁慈。

english: They shall pay for what they have done.
translation: 他们必须为所作所为付出代价。

english: Give me an R. Give me an O. Give me a U...
translation: 给我一个R。给我一个O。给我一个U……

english: Give him a right hook!
translation: 给他一记右勾拳！

english: How would I do that when I'm holding a sword? Leave me to the fighting, you find the Holy Grail!
translation: 我拿着剑怎么给你加油？让我专心战斗，你去找圣杯！

english: You guys deal with the guards, I'll get the Holy Grail
translation: 你们对付守卫，我去拿圣杯。

english: DIE SCUM!
translation: 去死吧，渣滓！

english: How's it going, Sir Lancelot?
translation: 怎么样了，兰斯洛特爵士？

english: How dare you attempt to imprison the greatest knight in the land? Have at thee!
translation: 你竟敢试图囚禁这片土地上最伟大的骑士？看招！

english: Please! Stop the hurting!
translation: 求你了！别打了！

english: Show them what for!
translation: 给他们点颜色看看！

english: What for what?
translation: 什么颜色？

english: I'll make them pay for what they've done to King Arhtur.
translation: 我要让他们为他们对亚瑟王所做的一切付出代价。

english: I fear we may never escape this dank dungeon.
translation: 我担心我们永远也逃不出这个阴湿的地牢了。

english: How could this have happened to us?
translation: 这种事怎么会发生在我们身上？

english: Sad is the day when the Round Table Knights fail their King.
translation: 圆桌骑士辜负了他们的国王，真是可悲的一天。

english: I shall avenge Arthur for this misdeed!
translation: 我一定要为亚瑟报此仇！

english: Now I just need to get out of here and see Wizard Cromperty.
translation: 现在我只需要离开这里，去见法师克伦珀蒂。

english: Hello there. My name is Cromperty. I am a wizard, and an inventor.
translation: 你好。我叫克伦珀蒂。我是一名魔法师，也是一名发明家。

english: Wizard Cromperty! Merlin sent me. King Arthur has been kidnapped and turned into a granite statue.
translation: 法师克伦珀蒂！是梅林派我来的。亚瑟王被绑架了，还被变成了花岗岩雕像。

english: Why would he want to be a statue?
translation: 他为什么要变成雕像？

english: He didn't WANT to be a statue. Morgan Le Faye turned him into one.
translation: 他不是想变成雕像。是摩根.勒菲把他变成的。

english: Oh yes, I see now. Why are you telling me all this?
translation: 哦，是的，我现在明白了。你为什么要告诉我这些？

english: Merlin said you might know how to free King Arthur.
translation: 梅林说你可能知道怎么解救亚瑟王。

english: Oh, well, I don't know anything about rocks. I'm a teleportation expert, myself. But there was this one time I teleported a girl right into a rock. What a mess that was.
translation: 哦，这个嘛，我对石头一窍不通。我自己是传送方面的专家。不过有一次我把一个女孩直接传送进了石头里。那可真是一团糟。

english: Yes, Wizard Cromperty, I remember, I was there.
translation: 是的，法师克伦珀蒂，我记得，我当时在场。

english: Oh were you? Of course you were. Well, I suppose being turned into a statue is very similar to being teleported into a rock. Let me see what we'll need.
translation: 哦，是吗？你当然在场。嗯，我觉得变成雕像和传送到石头里很相似。让我看看我们需要什么。

english: If my calculations are correct, this spell will need a bit more 'oomph' than last time around.
translation: 如果我的计算没错，这次施法需要比上次多一点‘劲儿’。

english: Well, before you were simply reanimating the person within the rock. This time you need to unravel Morgan Le Faye's spell first.
translation: 嗯，之前你只是把石头里的人重新激活。这次你得先破解摩根.勒菲的咒语。

english: You'll need King Arthur's most prized possession. That will unravel Morgan's spell. Then you'll need a piece of granite, the same rock Arthur was turned into.
translation: 你需要亚瑟王最珍视的宝物。那将解开摩根的咒语。然后你需要一块花岗岩，就是亚瑟王变成的那种岩石。

english: That's not so difficult. I already have the Holy Grail, King Arthur's most prized possession, and I know he was turned into a granite statue.
translation: 这并不难。我已经有了圣杯，亚瑟王最珍视的宝物，而且我知道他被变成了一尊花岗岩雕像。

english: Oh, it looks like you still have the scroll I gave you.
translation: 哦，看来你还拿着我给你的卷轴。

english: So what do I do with this spell?
translation: 那我用这个法术要怎么做？

english: Take the scroll, the Holy Grail and a piece of granite, any amount will do, to the statue of King Arthur. Once in front of him, read the scroll and the magic should do the rest.
translation: 带上卷轴、圣杯和一块花岗岩（多少都行），去到亚瑟王的雕像前。站在它面前，读出卷轴，剩下的魔法会自动生效。

english: Where is King Arthur being kept, anyway?
translation: 话说回来，亚瑟王被关在哪里？

english: Merlin suspects King Arthur had been taken to the Black Knights' Fortress. The last time I was there I needed to disguise myself in a bronze medium helm and an iron chainbody just to get past the door.
translation: 梅林怀疑亚瑟王被带到了黑骑士要塞。上次我去那里时，不得不乔装打扮，戴上铜制中头盔、穿上铁制链甲才能进门。

english: Well, that should still get you into the fortress, but I imagine you'll need a better disguise than that to reach King Arthur. He's a very important person and will be well guarded by the Black Knights.
translation: 嗯，那应该还能让你进入要塞，但我想你要见到亚瑟王还需要更好的伪装。他是个非常重要的人物，黑骑士们一定会严密守卫。

english: Don't underestimate them.
translation: 别小看他们。

english: Thanks, Wizard Cromperty!
translation: 谢谢，法师克伦珀蒂！

english: Hmm...I wonder...if you used a magical object that turned you into stone on the statue, would it turn him back to being human? I must research that...
translation: 嗯……我在想……如果你用一个能把你变成石头的魔法物品对着雕像使用，会不会把他变回人？我得研究一下……

english: Oh, are you still here? Go on then, you've got a king to save!
translation: 哦，你还在这儿？快去吧，你还有个国王要救呢！

english: Hello, Wizard Cromperty.
translation: 你好，法师克伦珀蒂。

english: Why hello, [player name], what can I do for you?
translation: 哎呀，你好啊，[player name]，我能帮你什么忙？

english: What did I need for the spell to work?
translation: 施法需要些什么来着？

english: Take the scroll, the Holy Grail and a piece of granite, of any size, shape or weight, to the statue of King Arthur. Once in front of him, read the scroll and the magic should do the rest.
translation: 带上卷轴、圣杯和一块花岗岩（大小、形状、重量不限），去到亚瑟王的雕像前。站在它面前，读出卷轴，剩下的魔法会自动生效。

english: How do I get into the Black Knights' Fortress?
translation: 我怎么才能进入黑骑士要塞？

english: How should I know, I'm just a simple wizard.
translation: 我怎么会知道，我只是个普普通通的魔法师。

english: However, from what you said about having to wear a helm and chainmail, it sounds like you were disguised as a mere guard.
translation: 不过，听你说得戴头盔和穿链甲，听起来你当时伪装成了普通守卫。

english: And...
translation: 然后……

english: Well, King Arthur's statue wouldn't be trusted to mere guards. Only fully-fledged Black Knights will guard it. So you'll need to disguise yourself as one of them if you want to get access to the statue.
translation: 嗯，亚瑟王的雕像不会交给普通守卫看管。只有正式的黑骑士才会守卫它。所以如果你想接近雕像，就需要伪装成他们中的一员。

english: Of course! Thanks, Wizard Cromperty.
translation: 当然！谢谢，法师克伦珀蒂。

english: I heard something happened to King Arthur and that Lord Daquarius was behind it.
translation: 我听说亚瑟王出了事，背后是达夸里乌斯领主搞的鬼。

english: Really? Where is King Arthur now?
translation: 真的？亚瑟王现在在哪里？

english: I have no idea, but it's a great victory for Lord Daquarius. To take such a mighty supporter of the White Knights down... Truly brilliant.
translation: 我不知道，但这对达夸里乌斯领主来说是一场伟大的胜利。扳倒白骑士如此强大的支持者……真是高明。

english: Good day, brave knight. Congratulations on your victory against King Arthur.
translation: 日安，勇敢的骑士。恭喜你击败了亚瑟王。

english: Errr, thanks. Why don't you tell me in your own words how glorious you thought our victory was.
translation: 呃……谢谢。不如你用自己的话跟我说说，你觉得我们的胜利有多光荣？

english: Of course. It was so clever of Lord Daquarius to lend our men to Morgan Le Faye in exchange for our prize. We got the better end of the deal, no doubt.
translation: 当然。达夸里乌斯领主真是聪明，把我们的人借给摩根.勒菲来换取我们的战利品。毫无疑问，我们占了便宜。

english: I don't have everything necessary to cast the spell.
translation: 我还缺少施法所需的全部材料。

english: I need to bring you some guard armour to disguise yourself in or you'll never be able to escape.
translation: 我得给你带套守卫盔甲来伪装，否则你根本逃不出去。

english: Very well. I'll await you here.
translation: 很好。我在这里等你。

english: Thank you! I was afraid that would be the end of me.
translation: 谢谢你！我还以为我完蛋了。

english: It's no trouble. But we need to get you out of here quickly before any of the Black Knights suspect something.
translation: 不麻烦。但我们得趁黑骑士们起疑之前赶紧把你弄出去。

english: The Black Knights? I thought Morgan did this to me.
translation: 黑骑士？我还以为是摩根对我下的手。

english: There's no time to explain; here, take this disguise.
translation: 没时间解释了；来，穿上这套伪装。

english: You leave first and I'll sneak out in a few minutes. Meet me back at Camelot and I shall reward you generously for your aid.
translation: 你先走，我几分钟后偷偷溜出去。我们在卡美洛特碰头，我会重重酬谢你的帮助。

english: I should go meet King Arthur at Camelot. He should have escaped by now.
translation: 我该去卡美洛特见亚瑟王了。他现在应该已经逃出来了。

english: I see you made it back safely.
translation: 看来你平安回来了。

english: Indeed, thanks to the disguise you gave me. I arrived back just as Merlin had kicked out the Sinclair children. He scared them off with a few puffs of smoke and frogs. He told them if any of them left their house
translation: 确实，多亏了你给我的伪装。我回来时正好赶上梅林把辛克莱尔庄园的孩子们赶走。他用几团烟雾和青蛙把他们吓跑了。他还告诉他们，要是谁敢再离开房子，

english: again, he'd turn them all into rabbits.
translation: 他就会把他们都变成兔子。

english: I guess we won't be hearing a peep out of them for awhile.
translation: 我猜他们一时半会儿不敢吭声了。

english: Indeed. We of the Round Table are greatly indebted to you for all of your help. I wish to reward you for all the help you have given us...
translation: 确实如此。我们圆桌骑士对你的所有帮助感激不尽。我想报答你给予我们的所有帮助……

english: Do you have any interesting news?
translation: 有什么有趣的消息吗？

english: Err, no?
translation: 呃，没有？

english: Then what are you standing around for!
translation: 那你还在等什么！

english: I'm afraid I'm too busy to speak to you right now.
translation: 恐怕我现在太忙，没空跟你说话。

english: What training grounds?
translation: 什么训练场？

english: My knights train daily on the top floor of Camelot. There they test their skills and strength against each other. Because of all the help you have given us, I open this training ground to you as well.
translation: 我的骑士们每天在卡美洛特的顶楼训练。他们在那里互相测试技能和力量。因为你给了我们这么多帮助，我也向你开放这个训练场。

english: Speak to the squire on the top floor of Camelot - he will explain the rules of the training grounds in detail.
translation: 和卡美洛特顶楼的侍从谈谈——他会详细解释训练场的规则。

english: So how did you remove the Sinclairs from Camelot?
translation: 那你是怎么把辛克莱尔庄园的人从卡美洛特赶走的？

english: Ah, Merlin has offered, as a reward for your help, to let your respawn in the safety of Camelot, should you befall misfortune elsewhere in the world. Should you wish to change your respawn back to Lumbridge, simply
translation: 啊，梅林作为对你帮助的奖赏，提出如果你在世界上其他地方遭遇不幸，你可以重生在安全的卡美洛特。如果你想将重生点改回仑桥镇，只需

english: Good day, my lord. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 日安，我的大人。有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

english: Please let me in Dorgesh-city!
translation: 请让我进多吉需戛纳！

english: I'm sorry, but surface goblins are not allowed into the city.
translation: 抱歉，地面哥布林不能进城。

english: Grubfoot? What are you doing here?
translation: 格拉布福特？你在这做什么？

english: [player name]! I so glad you here! You help me get into Dorgesh-city? I want talk to Chosen Commander.
translation: [player name]！你在这太好了！你能帮我进多吉需戛纳吗？我想和选召指挥官谈谈。

english: Chosen Commander? You mean Zanik?
translation: 选召指挥官？你是说扎尼克？

english: Yes, that her. I have dream about her, remember, before you come to Goblin Village. She Chosen Commander who lead all goblins to new age.
translation: 对，就是她。我之前梦到过她，记得吗，在你来哥布林村庄之前。她是带领所有哥布林进入新时代的选召指挥官。

english: Generals still not sure, but Grubfoot sure. She Chosen Commander!
translation: 将军们还不确定，但格拉布福特很确定。她就是选召指挥官！

english: Mistag, why won't you let Grubfoot into the city?
translation: 米斯塔格，你为什么不放格拉布福特进城？

english: Our laws don't currently allow surface goblins to enter. The council wants to extend a hand of friendship to their kind, but we have heard that they are a very warlike people.
translation: 我们目前的法律不允许地面哥布林进入。议会想向他们伸出友谊之手，但我们听说他们非常好战。

english: I'll take responsibility for Grubfoot. I know he won't cause any trouble.
translation: 我会为格拉布福特负责。我知道他不会惹麻烦。

english: Hmm... If you are prepared to vouch for him, then I suppose we can trust him.
translation: 嗯……既然你愿意为他担保，那我想我们可以信任他。

english: Very well, Grubfoot. You may enter Dorgesh-Kaan, but you must stay with [player name] until you leave.
translation: 好吧，格拉布福特。你可以进入多吉需戛纳，但离开前必须一直跟着[player name]。

english: Thank you, [player name]! I promise I be no trouble.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]！我保证不惹麻烦。

english: I think I'll let you two sort this out yourselves.
translation: 我想这事就由你们自己处理吧。

english: Hello, [player name]! Will you take me into Dorgesh-city now?
translation: 你好，[player name]！你现在带我进多吉需戛纳吗？

english: I follow you, but you should pick up pet thingy first.
translation: 我跟着你，但你应该先带上宠物那玩意儿。

english: I don't have time right now.
translation: 我现在没时间。

english: Will you take me into Dorgesh-city now?
translation: 你现在带我进多吉需戛纳吗？

english: Okay. I go back to wait in Dorgesh-mines.
translation: 好吧。我回多吉需矿洞等着。

english: I want go into Dorgesh-city, not go that way. I meet you back at Dorgesh mines.
translation: 我想进多吉需戛纳，不是走那边。我在多吉需矿洞和你碰头。

english: So big...so many Dorgesh-goblins...
translation: 好大……好多多吉需哥布林……

english: Chosen Commander...
translation: 选召指挥官……

english: You talk to her for me, [player name]! I too nervous!
translation: 你替我跟她说吧，[player name]！我太紧张了！

english: What are you doing in the city, surface goblin?
translation: 你在城里干什么，地面哥布林？

english: I looking for Chosen Commander!
translation: 我在找选召指挥官！

english: Commander of the guard?
translation: 守卫指挥官？

english: He means Zanik.
translation: 他是说扎尼克。

english: Zanik's not any kind of commander. She'd never fit into a command structure, she's too independant.
translation: 扎尼克才不是什么指挥官。她不适合任何指挥体系，她太独立了。

english: Anyway, I think I saw her with Oldak earlier. You should check his lab.
translation: 总之，我之前看到她和奥达克在一起。你应该去他的实验室看看。

english: A surface goblin in the city? That's against the rules!
translation: 地面哥布林进城？这是违规的！

english: Mistag said that Grubfoot could come in as long as he stayed with me.
translation: 米斯塔格说只要格拉布福特跟着我就可以进来。

english: Hmm... Carry on, then. But I'm keeping an eye on you.
translation: 嗯……那你们走吧。但我可盯着你们呢。

english: I'm keeping an eye on you, surface gobiln.
translation: 我盯着你呢，地面哥布林。

english: I not make any trouble!
translation: 我不会惹麻烦的！

english: Nothing wrong with my eyes.
translation: 我的眼睛没问题。

english: Grubfoot is a goblin from the surface. They all have eyes that size.
translation: 格拉布福特是地面来的哥布林。他们眼睛都那么大。

english: Oh! Welcome to the city, surface goblin! What are you doing down here?
translation: 哦！欢迎来到城里，地面哥布林！你来地下做什么？

english: I looking for Chosen Commander.
translation: 我在找选召指挥官。

english: Zanik? She's no commander... I think she's in Oldak's lab at the moment.
translation: 扎尼克？她不是什么指挥官……我想她这会儿在奥达克的实验室。

english: Eek! A goblin!
translation: 伊克！一个哥布林！

english: But... you're a goblin!
translation: 可是……你也是哥布林啊！

english: Yes, but a goblin from the surface...
translation: 对，但我是从地面来的哥布林……

english: I not mean any harm. Just here to see Chosen Commander.
translation: 我没有恶意。只是来见选召指挥官。

english: Zanik? I should hope that fool isn't in command of anything!
translation: 扎尼克？我倒希望那个傻瓜什么都不指挥！

english: Where is Chosen Commander?
translation: 选召指挥官在哪？

english: Yes. Zanik is Chosen Commander.
translation: 没错。扎尼克就是选召指挥官。

english: Oh? Chosen by whom?
translation: 哦？被谁选中的？

english: Big High War God! He choose Zanik to lead all goblins into new age!
translation: 至高战神！他选中扎尼克带领所有哥布林进入新时代！

english: The war god? Oh no!
translation: 战神？哦不！

english: It's okay! Zanik isn't in league with any war god.
translation: 没关系！扎尼克没有和任何战神勾结。

english: Grubfoot, you probably shouldn't mention the Big High War God down here. He's not exactly popular with the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 格拉布福特，你在地下可能不该提至高战神。多吉需恩人对他可没什么好感。

english: A surface goblin? What are you doing in the city?
translation: 地面哥布林？你在城里做什么？

english: Miner person say I can come in.
translation: 矿工说我可以进来。

english: Mistag said that Grubfoot could come into the city as long as he stayed with me.
translation: 米斯塔格说只要格拉布福特跟着我，就可以进城。

english: That is somewhat irregular, but I suppose it is reasonable. Welcome to the city, surface goblin! What brings you to Dorgesh-Kaan?
translation: 这有点不合常规，但我想也合理。欢迎来到城里，地面哥布林！是什么风把你吹到多吉需戛纳来了？

english: Ah yes, of course. I think she has been helping Oldak with his experiments recently. You should check Oldak's lab.
translation: 啊，对，当然。我想她最近一直在帮奥达克做实验。你应该去奥达克的实验室看看。

english: Hello, Zanik! There's someone here to see you.
translation: 你好，扎尼克！有人来看你。

english: Remarkable! You must be a goblin from the surface, correct?
translation: 了不起！你一定是地面来的哥布林，对吧？

english: Yes. I am goblin.
translation: 对。我是哥布林。

english: I recognize you. You were in Goblin Village, weren't you? You said you had a dream about me.
translation: 我认出你了。你之前在哥布林村庄，是不是？你说你梦到过我。

english: Yes. You Chosen Commander. Other goblins not believe, but I believe.
translation: 对。你是选召指挥官。其他哥布林不信，但我信。

english: Why don't other goblins believe?
translation: 为什么其他哥布林不信？

english: They say Zanik not true goblin. She cannot be Chosen Commander because she not worship Big High War God. Because she not think war good.
translation: 他们说扎尼克不是真正的哥布林。她不能是选召指挥官，因为她不信仰至高战神。因为她认为战争不好。

english: I certainly don't!
translation: 我当然不认为！

english: But does that mean she have no destiny? Perhaps her destiny to lead goblins into new age of peace.
translation: 但那就代表她没有命运吗？也许她的命运就是带领哥布林进入和平的新时代。

english: That's an unusual sentiment for a goblin.
translation: 这对哥布林来说真是不同寻常的想法。

english: Yes. I thought all surface goblins thought war was good.
translation: 是啊。我以为所有地面哥布林都认为战争好。

english: Most do, but not me. I see goblins kill goblins, humans kill goblins. I think, is this really best thing in life?
translation: 大部分是，但不是我。我看到哥布林杀哥布林，人类杀哥布林。我想，这真的是生命中最好的事吗？

english: I not say that to other goblins. They kill me if they think I not like war.
translation: 我没跟其他哥布林说。如果他们觉得我不喜欢战争，会杀了我。

english: What is the Chosen Commander?
translation: 选召指挥官是什么？

english: Goblin legend. Hopespear, long ago goblin, he have dream. He say someday Chosen Commander come, lead all goblins to new age.
translation: 哥布林传说。很久以前有个哥布林叫希望矛，他做了个梦。他说有一天选召指挥官会来，带领所有哥布林进入新时代。

english: Most goblins, they think Chosen Commander lead goblins to war and fight other races. But I think maybe not.
translation: 大部分哥布林认为选召指挥官会带领哥布林去战争，与其他种族战斗。但我想也许不是。

english: I have dreams that Zanik is Chosen Commander. Before you visit Goblin Village I dream about Zanik. And now, last night I have new dream.
translation: 我做梦梦到扎尼克是选召指挥官。在你访问哥布林村庄之前我就梦到了扎尼克。而现在，昨晚我又做了个新梦。

english: So why have you come to talk to Zanik?
translation: 那你为什么来和扎尼克谈话？

english: To tell Chosen Commander about new dream I have.
translation: 来告诉选召指挥官我的新梦。

english: What was this new dream?
translation: 这个新梦是什么？

english: Yes, what was it?
translation: 对，是什么？

english: I have dream of far-off land. It like no land I ever see, but somehow I know it.
translation: 我梦到了一个遥远的地方。它不像我见过的任何地方，但不知怎的我知道它。

english: It cool and wet. Ground is soft, big plants everywhere, red water bubbling.
translation: 那里凉爽潮湿。地面柔软，到处是巨大的植物，红色的水在冒泡。

english: I see goblins, many goblins. Goblins of all tribes, but they not fight. They have no weapons. They live in peace.
translation: 我看到哥布林，很多哥布林。所有部落的哥布林，但他们不打架。他们没有武器。他们和平地生活。

english: Then I see Chosen Commander. She stand at entrance to new land, she show way in. She lead all goblins on long journey to new land.
translation: 然后我看到选召指挥官。她站在新土地的入口，她指引进入的路。她带领所有哥布林进行漫长的旅程到新土地。

english: I never see land before. I see it only in dream. But somehow I know what it is. It Yu'biusk, Land of the Goblins.
translation: 我以前从未见过这片土地。我只在梦里见过。但不知怎的我知道它是什么。它是尤比斯克，哥布林之地。

english: So... What's Yu'biusk?
translation: 所以……尤比斯克是什么？

english: That goblin legend. Land of Goblins. Legend say long ago, even before war of gods, goblins come from Yu'biusk. Big High War God find them in Yu'biusk and take them to other lands.
translation: 那是哥布林传说。哥布林之地。传说很久以前，甚至在诸神战争之前，哥布林就来自尤比斯克。至高战神在尤比斯克发现了他们，把他们带到了其他土地。

english: Most goblins forget legend. Think only of war. But I think, if Zanik lead us back to Yu'biusk, maybe we have peace. Maybe we be safe from people who want to kill us.
translation: 大部分哥布林忘了传说。只想着战争。但我想，如果扎尼克带领我们回到尤比斯克，也许我们就能和平。也许我们就能免受那些想杀我们的人的伤害。

english: How do you know your dream was true?
translation: 你怎么知道你的梦是真的？

english: Yes, how do you know? Dorgeshuun scientists and philosophers generally believe that dreams are a way for the mind to sort through memories. There is no known mechanism by which they can predict the future.
translation: 对，你怎么知道？多吉需恩的科学家和哲学家普遍认为，梦是大脑整理记忆的一种方式。目前还不知道有什么机制能让它们预测未来。

english: This dream not like other dream. It so real.
translation: 这个梦不像其他梦。它太真实了。

english: What do you think, [player name]?
translation: 你怎么看，[player name]？

english: It's just a dream. It doesn't mean anything.
translation: 只是个梦而已。没什么意义。

english: It not just dream! It true! I know in heart!
translation: 不只是梦！它是真的！我心里知道！

english: I'm sorry, Grubfoot, but wanting something badly doesn't make it true.
translation: 抱歉，格拉布福特，但渴望某事并不能让它成真。

english: Even so... if there's any chance there might be something in it, we have to investigate.
translation: 即便如此……如果有一丝可能它意味着什么，我们也得调查一下。

english: I think it must mean something.
translation: 我想它一定有意义。

english: Thank you, [player name]! I know you believe me!
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]！我就知道你会相信我！

english: It's probably nothing, but if there's even a small chance there's something in it, we have to investigate.
translation: 可能没什么，但即使只有一点点可能，我们也得调查一下。

english: So where is this promised land, Grubfoot?
translation: 那么这应许之地在哪儿，格拉布福特？

english: I not know. Not know any goblin who know. But...
translation: 我不知道。不认识任何知道的哥布林。但是……

english: But what?
translation: 但是什么？

english: I should not tell! Not in front of non-goblin!
translation: 我不能说！不能在非哥布林面前说！

english: [player name] is a friend. You can tell [him/her/them].
translation: [player name] 是朋友。你可以告诉[him/her/them]。

english: I suppose...
translation: 我想是吧……

english: There secret place. Secret temple to Big High War God. No one know of it but goblins. Priests in secret temple, I bet they know way to Yu'biusk.
translation: 那里有个秘密地方。是献给大高等战神的神殿。除了哥布林没人知道。秘密神殿里的祭司，我打赌他们知道去尤比乌斯克的路。

english: But before I tell you where temple is, you must make promise. Promise not to tell any other non-goblins where temple is. If humans find out, maybe they attack, kill all goblins in temple.
translation: 但在告诉你神殿位置之前，你必须发誓。发誓不告诉任何非哥布林的人神殿在哪。如果人类发现了，他们可能会攻击，杀死神殿里所有的哥布林。

english: I promise, Grubfoot. I won't tell anyone where the temple is.
translation: 我发誓，格拉布福特。我不会告诉任何人神殿的位置。

english: If that is what is required to keep your temple safe, then I promise too.
translation: 如果这是保护你们神殿安全所必需的，那我也发誓。

english: [player name], you must promise as well. That very important.
translation: [player name]，你也必须发誓。这非常重要。

english: I promise not to tell anyone where the temple is.
translation: 我发誓不告诉任何人神殿的位置。

english: I trust you, [player name]. You save village from H.A.M. attack. Now I tell you where temple is.
translation: 我相信你，[player name]。你从H.A.M.的攻击中拯救了村庄。现在我告诉你神庙在哪里。

english: It built long ago, on Plain of Mud. It sink into mud and now it underground in muddy caves. It far west of here, near place where many humans catch fish.
translation: 它很久以前建在泥泞平原上。它沉入了泥中，现在在泥泞洞穴的地下。它在这里西边很远的地方，靠近许多人类捕鱼的地方。

english: Hmm... I've heard of a cave system to the west where many goblins live. That must be where this temple is hidden. I can make teleport spheres to take you there.
translation: 嗯……我听说过西边有个洞穴系统，里面住着很多哥布林。那里一定就是神殿隐藏的地方。我可以制作传送球把你送到那里。

english: I can't go. I must get back to village before generals miss me.
translation: 我不能去。我必须在将军们发现我不在之前赶回村庄。

english: Oh, that's a pity. Just a minute...
translation: 哦，真可惜。稍等一下……

english: Here, break this sphere on the ground. It will take you back to the Goblin Village.
translation: 给，把这个球摔在地上，它会把你送回哥布林村庄。

english: Thank you. I go now, but you must go to temple and find way to Yu'biusk.
translation: 谢谢你。我现在走了，但你必须去神殿找到去尤比乌斯克的路。

english: [player name], Zanik, are you ready to leave?
translation: [player name]、扎尼克，你们准备好出发了吗？

english: I'm ready!
translation: 我准备好了！

english: Then let's go!
translation: 那我们出发吧！

english: I'm not ready.
translation: 我还没准备好。

english: I'll wait until you are, [player name].
translation: 我会等你准备好，[player name]。

english: Hello, [player name]. What did you find in the Goblin Temple?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你在哥布林神殿里发现了什么？

english: We haven't gone in yet.
translation: 我们还没进去呢。

english: Ah, well you'd better get back there then.
translation: 啊，那你最好赶紧回去。

english: Did you go to Land of Goblins?
translation: 你去哥布林之地了吗？

english: The entrance to the secret temple must be around here somewhere, [player name].
translation: 秘密神殿的入口一定就在这附近某处，[player name]。

english: Okay, [player name]. I'll meet you back at the cave entrance.
translation: 好的，[player name]。我会在洞穴入口跟你碰头。

english: Dorgesh tribe?
translation: 多格什部落？

english: Me hear Dorgesh tribe return from below ground.
translation: 我听说多格什部落从地底下回来了。

english: You want get into temple, Dorgesh-goblin?
translation: 你想进神殿吗，多格什-哥布林？

english: You goblin, you come in.
translation: 你是哥布林，你进来。

english: Human! Where you think you going?
translation: 人类！你以为你要去哪？

english: But you said we could go in!
translation: 但你说过我们可以进去的！

english: No, we say Dorgesh-goblin go in. You human, you go away!
translation: 不，我们说多格什-哥布林进去。你是人类，你走开！

english: Humans not allowed! Only goblins allowed!
translation: 人类不许进！只有哥布林可以！

english: Go away, human! We already tell you not to come in!
translation: 滚开，人类！我们已经告诉过你不准进来！

english: Only goblins allowed in. If you goblin, you come in. But you not goblin, you stupid stinky puny human.
translation: 只有哥布林才能进。如果你是哥布林，你就进来。但你不是哥布林，你是个又蠢又臭又弱小的人类。

english: Humans aren't allowed inside. They let Zanik in, but not me.
translation: 人类不准进去。他们让扎尼克进去了，但不让我进。

english: Hmm... that is an interesting problem. But I think there is a way to get you in.
translation: 嗯……这问题挺有趣。不过我觉得有办法让你进去。

english: How can I get into the temple without being a goblin?
translation: 我如何能在不是哥布林的情况下进入神殿？

english: Perhaps you can't.
translation: 也许你没办法。

english: What? But you said you had a way.
translation: 什么？但你说你有办法的。

english: Yes, I think you can get into the temple, but not without being a goblin. I have been in correspondence with some of the wizards who live on the surface. I know of one who might be able to help you.
translation: 是的，我认为你可以进入神殿，但前提是你得是个哥布林。我一直和地面上的一些巫师有通信联系。我知道有一位可能能帮你。

english: They are known as the Makeover Mage. You should go and talk to them. I believe they live south west of the human city of Falador.
translation: 他们被称为变身法师。你应该去找他们谈谈。我相信他们住在人类城市法拉多城的西南方向。

english: Can you teleport me to the temple again?
translation: 你能再把我传送到神殿吗？

english: I can, but I can't afford to keep doing it for free. If you get me two law runes and a piece of molten glass, I'll make a sphere to take you there.
translation: 可以，但我不能一直免费这么做。如果你给我两个律法符文和一块熔融玻璃，我就做个球把你送过去。

english: I'll have to go get some law runes and molten glass then.
translation: 那我得去弄些律法符文和熔融玻璃。

english: Never mind, I'll walk.
translation: 算了，我走路去。

english: I'll go and see this mage.
translation: 我去见见这位法师。

english: Hello, [player name]. Did you speak to the Makeover Mage?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你跟变身法师谈过了吗？

english: You really should. I believe they live south west of the human city of Falador.
translation: 你真的该去。我相信他们住在人类城市法拉多城的西南方向。

english: Can you turn me into a goblin?
translation: 你能把我变成哥布林吗？

english: Into a goblin? What do you want to turn into a goblin for?
translation: 变成哥布林？你为什么要变成哥布林？

english: I need to slip past some goblin guards.
translation: 我需要从一些哥布林守卫旁边溜过去。

english: Really? What are they guarding?
translation: 真的吗？他们在守卫什么？

english: I promised not to tell anyone.
translation: 我发誓不告诉任何人。

english: Okay, okay, sorry I asked.
translation: 好吧，好吧，是我不该问。

english: Can you turn me into a goblin or not?
translation: 你到底能不能把我变成哥布林？

english: I think I know how, but I've never deliberately transmogrified someone into another species before. It's a very risky procedure, and I don't want to be held responsible if it goes wrong.
translation: 我想我知道怎么做，但我以前从未有意将某人变成另一个物种。这是个非常危险的过程，如果出了岔子，我可不想承担责任。

english: How about I tell you the recipe so you can make the potion yourself. It's not too complex. You'll just need to take a toadflax potion and add some pharmakos berries.
translation: 不如我告诉你食谱，这样你可以自己制作药水。不算太复杂。你只需要拿一瓶亚麻蟾蜍草药水，再加一些法尔马科斯莓。

english: Pharmakos berries?
translation: 法尔马科斯莓？

english: That's right. They're quite rare, but have wonderful properties that help with transmogrification. Luckily, I grow plenty right outside. Feel free to take some.
translation: 没错。它们相当稀有，但具有奇妙的特性，有助于变形术。幸运的是，我在外面种了很多。随便拿一些吧。

english: Now, once you've made the potion, remember that the transformation is very delicate. It will reverse itself if you are in direct sunlight or if you perform a strenuous activity like fighting.
translation: 现在，一旦你做好了药水，记住这个变形非常脆弱。如果你暴露在直射阳光下，或者进行像战斗这样的剧烈活动，它就会自行解除。

english: For that reason, you should only drink it in the area where you're going to need it. I'd also suggest you take off any pieces of armour or similar before drinking it, just in case the transformation damages them.
translation: 因此，你应该只在需要它的区域喝下它。我还建议你在喝之前脱下任何盔甲或类似的装备，以防变形损坏它们。

english: Okay. Thanks for the help.
translation: 好的。谢谢你的帮助。

english: I just like goblins.
translation: 我只是喜欢哥布林。

english: What a strange thing to want to turn into.
translation: 想变成的东西真奇怪。

english: Actually, I don't want to be a goblin.
translation: 其实，我不想变成哥布林。

english: You can do it yourself using that potion I told you about. Just take a toadflax potion and add some pharmakos berries.
translation: 你可以用我告诉你的那种药水自己来做。只需拿一瓶亚麻蟾蜍草药水，再加一些法尔马科斯莓。

english: Hello, [player name]. Any luck getting into the Goblin Temple?
translation: 你好，[player name]。进入哥布林神殿有进展吗？

english: Not yet, but I spoke to the Makeover Mage. They told me how to make a potion to turn myself into a goblin.
translation: 还没有，但我和变身法师谈过了。他们告诉我如何制作药水把自己变成哥布林。

english: Excellent! You'd better head back to the temple and try this potion out.
translation: 太好了！你最好回神殿去试试这瓶药水。

english: I'd like to get into the temple please.
translation: 我想进神殿，拜托了。

english: Why you talk strange?
translation: 你为什么说话怪怪的？

english: Oh... Err...
Me want get into temple?
translation: 我想进神殿？

english: That better.
translation: 这还差不多。

english: What your name, goblin?
translation: 你叫什么名字，哥布林？

english: No wait, I guess.
translation: 别说了，我猜一下。

english: Is it [goblin name]?
translation: 是不是[goblin name]？

english: Yes, me [goblin name].
translation: 是的，我是[goblin name]。

english: Ha ha! Me knew me guess right!
translation: 哈哈哈！我就知道我猜对了！

english: You not come into temple with that thing.
translation: 你不能带着那东西进神殿。

english: What thing?
translation: 什么东西？

english: That thing you carrying! It look alive!
translation: 你带着的那个东西！看起来是活的！

english: Goblin guard: That thing! That thing that following you!
translation: 哥布林守卫：那个东西！那个跟着你的东西！

english: My follower?
translation: 我的跟宠？

english: Me not like it.
translation: 我不喜欢它。

english: You go take it somewhere else before you go in.
translation: 你进去之前先把它带到别处去。

english: You go into temple now, [goblin name].
translation: 你现在可以进神殿了，[goblin name]。

english: No. You guess again.
translation: 不。你再猜猜。

english: Actually, me no want to go in temple.
translation: 其实，我不想进神殿。

english: You go away then.
translation: 那你走开。

english: Me want get into temple.
translation: 我想进神殿。

english: You want go into temple, [goblin name]?
translation: 你想进神殿吗，[goblin name]？

english: What is it then?
translation: 那到底是什么？

english: You goblins listen!
translation: 你们这些哥布林听着！

english: This is what Big High War God say:
translation: 这是大高等战神说的：

english: Slay enemies of Big High War God!
translation: 杀死大高等战神的敌人！

english: Enemies must die!
translation: 敌人必须死！

english: Not to run from battle!
translation: 不准临阵脱逃！

english: Cowards must die!
translation: 懦夫必须死！

english: Not to show mercy!
translation: 不得展现仁慈！

english: Merciful must die!
translation: 仁慈者必须死！

english: Not to doubt Big High War God!
translation: 不得怀疑至高战神！

english: Doubters must die!
translation: 怀疑者必须死！

english: Not to make own plans!
translation: 不得自作主张！

english: Thinkers must die!
translation: 思考者必须死！

english: In beginning, goblins weak.
translation: 起初，哥布林很弱小。

english: Big High War God make us strong!
translation: 至高战神让我们变强！

english: In beginning, goblins have no commander.
translation: 起初，哥布林没有指挥官。

english: Big High War God send commander!
translation: 至高战神派来了指挥官！

english: In time of great war...
translation: 在大战时期……

english: He send commander to lead us.
translation: 他派指挥官来领导我们。

english: Now we have no commander.
translation: 现在我们没有指挥官了。

english: But some day he send new commander!
translation: 但总有一天他会派新的指挥官来！

english: New commander leads goblins to victory!
translation: 新指挥官会带领哥布林走向胜利！

english: Goblins conquer all of world!
translation: 哥布林将征服整个世界！

english: Then Big High War God return!
translation: 然后至高战神就会归来！

english: Me hear Dorgesh tribe come back from underground. Maybe now all tribes united, prophecy will come true! Chosen Commander come and lead all tribes to victory over world!
translation: 我听说多吉需部族从地底回来了。也许现在所有部族联合起来，预言就会成真！被选中的指挥官会来带领所有部族征服世界！

english: Me hear there ghost in temple crypt! No one see it, but sometimes they hear it. 'Wooo... wooo...' it say.
translation: 我听说神庙墓穴里有幽灵！没人见过它，但有时能听到它的声音。它会说'呜……呜……'。

english: Me mighty warrior of Big High War God! Me find farmer working in field, and me attack! He so scared he run off! Then me trample on crops! This deeds of great warrior of Big High War God!
translation: 我是至高战神的强大战士！我找到在田里干活的农夫，然后攻击他！他吓得逃跑了！然后我践踏了他的庄稼！这就是至高战神伟大战士的功绩！

english: Me glad me finally get to secret goblin temple! Me walk long way to get here, always in danger of humans. But now me here, me safe! There no humans here!
translation: 我很高兴终于来到了秘密的哥布林神庙！我走了很远的路才到这里，一路上总是有被人类发现的危险。但现在我在这里，我安全了！这里没有人类！

english: Me hate humans! When me leave temple, me go and kill many human children!
translation: 我恨人类！等我离开神庙，我要去杀很多人类小孩！

english: Shh! Not to talk in temple!
translation: 嘘！不准在神庙里说话！

english: Praise Big High War God!
translation: 赞美至高战神！

english: Me have question.
translation: 我有问题。

english: Questions for High Priest. He the one that knows stuff.
translation: 问题要问大祭司。他才是懂行的人。

english: You go away! Only [tribe name] tribe come in here!
translation: 你走开！只有[tribe name]部族才能进来！

english: You can pass!
translation: 你可以通过了！

english: May the Big High War God fill your soul with the glory of war!
translation: 愿至高战神用战争的荣耀充满你的灵魂！

english: May the Big High War God fill your eyes with hate for his enemies!
translation: 愿至高战神用对敌人的仇恨充满你的双眼！

english: May the Big High War God clear your mind of all thoughts!
translation: 愿至高战神清除你脑中所有杂念！

english: May the Big High War God fill your heart with courage to die for him!
translation: 愿至高战神用为他而死的勇气充满你的心！

english: May the Big High War God fill your arms with strength to do his bidding!
translation: 愿至高战神用执行他命令的力量充满你的双臂！

english: Where Zanik?
translation: 扎尼克在哪？

english: Zanik? Who is Zanik?
translation: 扎尼克？扎尼克是谁？

english: She Dorgeshuun goblin.
translation: 她是多吉需迅族的哥布林。

english: She Chosen Commander.
translation: 她是被选中的指挥官。

english: Chosen Commander? You have history mixed up. Chosen Commander come in future, not now. When Chosen Commander come, I know, and I not see any Chosen Commander today.
translation: 被选中的指挥官？你把历史搞混了。被选中的指挥官会在未来到来，不是现在。如果被选中的指挥官来了，我会知道，但我今天没看到任何被选中的指挥官。

english: Oh... well she Dorgeshuun goblin.
translation: 哦……好吧，她是多吉需迅族的哥布林。

english: Yes, there was goblin who say she Dorgesh-goblin. She have big eyes and she speak in strange accent. She ask about Yu'biusk, but she not pass test.
translation: 是的，有个哥布林说她是多吉需族的哥布林。她眼睛很大，说话口音很奇怪。她问关于尤比乌斯克的事，但她没通过测试。

english: She not just not know answers. Lots of goblins not know answers. She start shouting crazy ideas about how war is bad and we not need gods.
translation: 她不只是不知道答案。很多哥布林都不知道答案。她开始大喊大叫，说些战争不好、我们不需要神的疯狂想法。

english: Huzamogaarb guards, they grab her and they put her in prison in Huzamogaarb enclave.
translation: 胡扎莫加布的守卫抓住了她，把她关进了胡扎莫加布飞地的监狱里。

english: How me get into Huzamogaarb enclave?
translation: 我怎么才能进入胡扎莫加布飞地？

english: Only Huzamogaarb tribe allowed in the enclave. That not you. You wearing wrong armour. The Huzamogaarb tribe wear black armour.
translation: 只有胡扎莫加布部族才允许进入飞地。你不是。你穿的盔甲不对。胡扎莫加布部族穿黑色盔甲。

english: How they get black armour?
translation: 他们怎么弄到黑色盔甲的？

english: They use dye to make armour black. Other tribes do similar, but in own tribe colour instead.
translation: 他们用染料把盔甲染成黑色。其他部族也类似，但用的是自己部族的颜色。

english: Yellow for Yurkolgokh, white for Saragorgak, purple for Horogothgar, orange for Narogoshuun, blue for Ekeleshuun and like said, black for Huzamogaarb.
translation: 黄色代表尤尔科格克，白色代表萨拉戈加克，紫色代表霍罗戈斯加，橙色代表纳罗戈舒恩，蓝色代表埃克勒舒恩，就像我说的，黑色代表胡扎莫加布。

english: Where they get dye?
translation: 他们从哪弄到染料？

english: Some goblins say they go to witch-lady in Draynor for it. Me hope they beat up witch-lady and take dye! That way of Big High War God!
translation: 有些哥布林说他们去找德雷诺的女巫要的。我希望他们揍了那个女巫一顿然后把染料抢走了！那才是至高战神的方式！

english: You forgetful? I told you, guards put her in prison in Huzamogaarb enclave.
translation: 你健忘吗？我告诉过你，守卫把她关进了胡扎莫加布飞地的监狱里。

english: Hello, [player name]. Have you discovered anything in the Goblin Temple?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你在哥布林神庙发现什么了吗？

english: The goblins there have imprisoned Zanik!
translation: 那里的哥布林把扎尼克关起来了！

english: Oh no! You'd better find a way to get her out!
translation: 哦不！你最好想办法把她救出来！

english: What do you want now?
translation: 你现在还想要什么？

english: Zanik! It's me, [player name]!
translation: 扎尼克！是我，[player name]！

english: I turned myself into a goblin so I could get in here!
translation: 我把自己变成了哥布林才能进到这里来！

english: You did what?
translation: 你做了什么？

english: Yes... Definitely one of my more interesting choices.
translation: 是的……绝对是我做过的最有趣的选择之一。

english: I'll say. You can tell me all about it later. For now, I could do with a bit of a hand getting out of here.
translation: 我同意。你以后可以再告诉我所有细节。现在，我需要你帮我离开这里。

english: I managed to upset the high priest. He said he'd tell me about Yu'biusk if I passed a test on goblin religion. I don't think he liked my answers.
translation: 我惹恼了大祭司。他说如果我通过哥布林宗教的测试，就告诉我关于尤比乌斯克的事。我觉得他不喜欢我的答案。

english: Clearly. Well luckily I have a moving-over-distance sphere here. You can use it to teleport out.
translation: 显然如此。幸好我这里有一个空间移动球。你可以用它传送出去。

english: Thank you, [player name]! I'm sorry to leave you, but it looks like you'll have to find out about Yu'biusk on your own. Hopefully you have better luck with that high priest than I did.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]！很抱歉要留下你，但看来你得自己想办法了解尤比乌斯克了。希望你在那个大祭司那里比我运气好。

english: Don't worry, I'll work it out. I'll see you back in Dorgesh-Kaan.
translation: 别担心，我会搞定的。我们多吉需戛纳见。

english: Clearly. So how can I get you out?
translation: 显然如此。那我怎么才能把你弄出去？

english: I had a moving-over-distance sphere with me, but they confiscated it when they put me in here. They didn't even know what it was. They were just frightened that it might explode.
translation: 我本来带了一个空间移动球，但他们把我关进来的时候没收了。他们甚至不知道那是什么。只是害怕它可能会爆炸。

english: I'll look around and see if I can find it.
translation: 我四处找找，看能不能找到它。

english: Is that you, [player name]? Do you have that moving-over-distance sphere?
translation: 是你吗，[player name]？你拿到那个空间移动球了吗？

english: The guards confiscated it when they put me in here. It must be somewhere nearby.
translation: 他们把我关进来的时候没收了。一定就在附近某个地方。

english: You're back! Any luck at the temple? Have you found out where Yu'biusk is?
translation: 你回来了！在神庙有收获吗？你找到尤比乌斯克在哪了吗？

english: Don't give up! I know you'll work it out.
translation: 别放弃！我知道你会搞定的。

english: Hello, [player name]. Have you found out anything about Yu'biusk yet?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你查到关于尤比乌斯克的任何消息了吗？

english: I'm sure you'll uncover something soon.
translation: 我相信你很快就能发现些什么。

english: Me want to know about Yu'biusk.
translation: 我想知道关于尤比乌斯克的事。

english: That knowledge not for ordinary goblin. Only those who understand ways of Big High War God may learn of Yu'biusk.
translation: 那个知识不是给普通哥布林的。只有那些理解至高战神之道的人才能了解尤比乌斯克。

english: I understand Big High War God.
translation: 我理解至高战神。

english: Then you answer my questions, and we will see.
translation: 那你回答我的问题，我们看看。

english: True or false: Those who do not believe in Big High War God, whether they goblins or other races, must die.
translation: 对还是错：那些不信奉至高战神的人，无论是哥布林还是其他种族，都必须死。

english: Big High War God commands it.
translation: 这是至高战神的命令。

english: That right! It in commandments.
translation: 没错！这在戒律里。

english: 'Not to doubt Big High War God! Doubters must die!' This mean we slay goblins who not believe.
translation: '不得怀疑至高战神！怀疑者必须死！'这意味着我们要杀死不信奉的哥布林。

english: 'Always to slay enemies of Big High War God!
translation: 必须永远杀戮至高战神的敌人！

english: Second question. True or false: Big High War God chose goblins to be his race because goblins mighty warriors.
translation: 第二个问题。对还是错：至高战神选择哥布林作为他的种族，是因为哥布林是强大的战士。

english: Really? Then how we come to be mighty warriors, before Big High War God find us?
translation: 真的吗？那在至高战神找到我们之前，我们是怎么成为强大战士的？

english: We taught selves to be mighty!
translation: 我们自学成才变得强大！

english: Fool! Heretic! You guilty of sin of pride! Goblins teach selves nothing. All good we have come from Big High War God!
translation: 蠢货！异端！你犯了骄傲之罪！哥布林什么也教不了自己。我们拥有的一切美好都来自至高战神！

english: Other god made us mighty.
translation: 是别的神让我们变得强大。

english: You confused. Yes, in time of great war, some goblins serve other gods. But no one make us mighty but Big High War God.
translation: 你糊涂了。是的，在大战时期，有些哥布林侍奉其他神。但除了至高战神，没人能让我们变得强大。

english: Look around at how mighty we are! How we proud of war. How we never flinch from battle or pain or death. How we never surrender or show mercy or pity!
translation: 看看我们有多强大！我们多么以战争为荣。我们从不畏惧战斗、痛苦或死亡。我们从不投降、不展现仁慈或怜悯！

english: How could any other god but Big High War God do this?
translation: 除了至高战神，还有哪个神能做到这一点？

english: We naturally mighty warriors.
translation: 我们天生就是强大的战士。

english: Naturally? Let me tell you what goblins are naturally! We tiny, we weak, we cowardly, we love peace and not war!
translation: 天生？让我告诉你哥布林天生是什么样！我们渺小、我们软弱、我们懦弱、我们热爱和平而不是战争！

english: All that is good, that is strong, that is powerful, we get from Big High War God! Go away and remember this!
translation: 所有美好的、强大的、有力的东西，我们都从至高战神那里得到！走开，记住这一点！

english: False.
translation: 错。

english: Oh? Why you say that?
translation: 哦？你为什么这么说？

english: He chose us for other quality.
translation: 他选择我们是出于其他品质。

english: What other quality important, except that we great warriors? Get away, silly goblin! Too much drink muddle brain and give you strange thoughts!
translation: 除了我们是伟大的战士，还有什么其他重要的品质？走开，愚蠢的哥布林！喝太多酒会搞乱脑子，让你产生奇怪的想法！

english: Goblins not mighty warriors before he chose us.
translation: 在他选择我们之前，哥布林并不是强大的战士。

english: That good! Goblins mighty warriors now, but that only because Big High War God make us so! Without Big High War God we nothing! Remember that.
translation: 那很好！哥布林现在是强大的战士，但那只是因为至高战神让我们如此！没有至高战神，我们什么都不是！记住这一点。

english: Third question. True or false: Goblin leaders should be good at planning in order to win battles.
translation: 第三个问题。对还是错：哥布林领袖应该善于计划，以便赢得战斗。

english: Big High War God rewards victory.
translation: 大战神赐予胜利。

english: Even victory that comes through clever dirty tricks? Even victory that comes through breaking Big High War God's commandments? No. Not all victory honour Big High War God.
translation: 就算是用狡猾的诡计赢来的胜利也算吗？就算是通过违反大战神的戒律赢来的胜利也算吗？不。并非所有胜利都能荣耀大战神。

english: Big High War God teaches us to think for selves.
translation: 大战神教导我们要自己思考。

english: What? Where you hear that? You think for yourself, you maybe think stupid, dangerous thoughts. You maybe think war not good, or Big High War God not best god.
translation: 什么？你从哪听来的？你自己思考，可能会想出愚蠢又危险的想法。你可能会觉得战争不好，或者大战神不是最好的神。

english: No. Do not think for self. Think only thoughts of Big High War God. His thoughts perfect, so if you think different thoughts, those thoughts bad.
translation: 不。不要自己思考。只思考大战神的想法。他的想法是完美的，所以如果你有不同的想法，那些想法就是坏的。

english: That why Big High War God command, 'Not to make own plans. Thinkers must die.'
translation: 这就是为什么大战神命令道：“不得自作主张。思考者必须死。”

english: Planning is part of war, and all parts of war are good.
translation: 谋划是战争的一部分，而战争的一切都是好的。

english: You confused. It true all parts of war are good, but not all parts of war are for goblins.
translation: 你糊涂了。战争的一切都是好的，这没错，但战争的一切并不都是为哥布林准备的。

english: Big High War God not make us commanders. He make us soldiers, and send commanders to lead us. They make plans for us. We not have commander now, but still we must not make own plans.
translation: 大战神没有让我们当指挥官。他让我们当士兵，并派指挥官来领导我们。他们为我们制定计划。我们现在没有指挥官，但我们仍然不能自作主张。

english: That one of the commandments.
translation: 这是戒律之一。

english: That right. 'Not to make own plans. Thinkers must die.'
translation: 没错。“不得自作主张。思考者必须死。”

english: Last question. Prophecy say someday Big High War God send Chosen Commander. What Chosen Commander do?
translation: 最后一个问题。预言说总有一天大战神会派来被选中的指挥官。被选中的指挥官会做什么？

english: Lead goblins to promised land of Yu'biusk.
translation: 带领哥布林前往应许之地尤比斯克。

english: Yu'biusk? You have story wrong way round! Yu'biusk land all goblins come from. But there no prophecy that we go back there.
translation: 尤比斯克？你把故事说反了！尤比斯克是所有哥布林来的地方。但可没有预言说我们要回去那里。

english: Lead goblins to victory over whole world.
translation: 带领哥布林征服整个世界。

english: That right! And war will end in victory and victory last forever!
translation: 没错！战争将以胜利告终，而胜利将永存！

english: Destroy world.
translation: 毁灭世界。

english: Destroy world? Why Big High War God want to do that? Then there be no goblins to fight for him!
translation: 毁灭世界？大战神为什么要这么做？那样就没有哥布林为他而战了！

english: Make goblins fight each other.
translation: 让哥布林互相残杀。

english: Ha ha ha! Big High War God not need send commander to do that! Only reason goblins not fight more is prophet Hopespear say not.
translation: 哈哈哈！大战神不需要派指挥官来做这个！哥布林没打起来，唯一的原因是先知希望矛说不可以。

english: Big High War God controls outcome of the battle.
translation: 大战神掌控着战斗的结果。

english: That true. But it true whether goblin leaders make plans or not. So it not answer question.
translation: 这倒是真的。但无论哥布林首领是否制定计划，这都是真的。所以这并没有回答问题。

english: Goblins stupid and would make poor plans.
translation: 哥布林很蠢，会制定出糟糕的计划。

english: You call me stupid? Big High War God make goblins perfect! Big High War God tell us not make plans, but if we make plans, they be best plans ever!
translation: 你说我蠢？大战神把哥布林造得完美！大战神告诉我们不要制定计划，但如果我们制定了计划，那一定是有史以来最好的计划！

english: Goblins not mighty warriors.
translation: 哥布林不是强大的战士。

english: How dare you? You insult goblin race in holy temple! We mighty warriors because we worship Big High War God!
translation: 你好大的胆子！你竟敢在神圣的庙宇里侮辱哥布林一族！我们是强大的战士，因为我们崇拜大战神！

english: Goblins like you, who say we not strong, you are thing that make us weak! Never doubt, never question, never think! That way of Big High War God.
translation: 像你这种说我们不强壮的哥布林，正是让我们变弱的东西！永不怀疑，永不质疑，永不思考！这才是大战神之道。

english: They might lead us astray.
translation: 他们可能会把我们引入歧途。

english: That wrong! No true goblin be lead astray by those who not believe. If goblin led astray, that goblin deserve to die!
translation: 那不对！真正的哥布林不会被那些不信者引入歧途。如果哥布林被引入歧途，那哥布林就该死！

english: I think you weak in faith, if you think you be led astray. You go now, think on this. Be stronger in faith.
translation: 如果你觉得自己会被引入歧途，我看你是信仰不坚定。你现在走吧，好好想想。坚定你的信仰。

english: Oh? Why not?
translation: 哦？为什么不行？

english: Big High War God command we not kill enemies?
translation: 大战神命令我们不要杀死敌人？

english: You not understand Big High War God at all! You like filthy stinking cave goblin! Go away and think on how stupid you are!
translation: 你根本不懂大战神！你就像个肮脏发臭的洞穴哥布林！滚开，好好想想你有多蠢！

english: Goblin should not fight goblin.
translation: 哥布林不应该打哥布林。

english: It true that prophet Hopespear tell us goblin should not fight against goblin. But Big High War God, he command that those who not believe must die.
translation: 先知希望矛确实告诉我们哥布林不应该与哥布林为敌。但大战神，他命令不信者必须死。

english: To little mind, weak mind, this seem to contradict. But only if you not have faith. In Big High War God, there no contradiction.
translation: 对于狭隘、软弱的头脑来说，这似乎矛盾。但只有在你没有信仰时才会这样。在大战神那里，没有矛盾。

english: We try to convert them instead.
translation: 我们试着转化他们。

english: Convert them? You stupid goblin! You not even know name of god. He Big High WAR God! We kill enemies, not convert!
translation: 转化他们？你这个蠢哥布林！你连神的名字都不知道。他是大战神！我们杀敌人，不是转化！

english: I not know.
translation: 我不知道。

english: That good. True goblin not want to understand. Fight and die for glory of Big High War God. Never ask question or have thought.
translation: 很好。真正的哥布林不想去理解。为大战神的荣耀而战而死。从不提问，从不思考。

english: Is not for me then.
translation: 那不适合我。

english: You ready to answer questions?
translation: 你准备好回答问题了吗？

english: You have passed test. Now I answer your questions.
translation: 你通过了考验。现在我来回答你的问题。

english: Yu'biusk is goblin legend. Very old legend, from before this temple built. From before Hopespear the prophet. Even before great war.
translation: 尤比斯克是哥布林的传说。非常古老的传说，早在这座庙宇建成之前。早在先知希望矛之前。甚至在大战之前。

english: Legend say that goblins come from land of Yu'biusk. Big High War God find goblins in Yu'biusk and bring them to other lands to train them as warriors!
translation: 传说说哥布林来自尤比斯克之地。大战神在尤比斯克找到哥布林，把他们带到其他土地，训练他们成为战士！

english: Will goblins return to Yu'biusk?
translation: 哥布林会回到尤比斯克吗？

english: Why we want to return to Yu'biusk? In Yu'biusk we weak. Big High War God take us from Yu'biusk and make us strong.
translation: 我们为什么要回尤比斯克？在尤比斯克我们很弱小。大战神把我们带出尤比斯克，让我们变得强大。

english: Where is Yu'biusk?
translation: 尤比斯克在哪里？

english: Me not know. Me think Snothead maybe know.
translation: 我不知道。我觉得斯诺黑德可能知道。

english: Where can I find him?
translation: 我在哪里能找到他？

english: He old high priest in temple crypt behind me! He dead!
translation: 他是我身后墓穴里的老祭司！他死了！

english: Maybe me ask him next time me see him.
translation: 也许我下次见到他时问问他。

english: What? But you said he dead!
translation: 什么？但你说他死了！

english: Ha ha! You not know, but since you pass test, me tell you.
translation: 哈哈！你不知道，但既然你通过了考验，我就告诉你。

english: When goblin high priest die, they buried in temple crypt in special magic way.
translation: 当哥布林大祭司死后，他们会被以特殊的魔法方式埋葬在庙宇墓穴里。

english: This mean next high priest can ask them questions, even though they dead. I just say name of high priest over grave, and he appear and answer questions.
translation: 这意味着下一任大祭司可以问他们问题，即使他们已经死了。我只要在坟墓上说出大祭司的名字，他就会现身回答问题。

english: Can I talk to old high priests?
translation: 我能和前任大祭司说话吗？

english: No. Temple crypt is holy place. Only high priest allowed into crypt, and that me. No other goblin ever go in.
translation: 不行。庙宇墓穴是圣地。只有大祭司才能进入墓穴，也就是我。没有其他哥布林进去过。

english: Crypt door locked by six keys, kept by six tribal priests. Priests only give keys to me. They never give them to normal goblin like you.
translation: 墓穴的门由六把钥匙锁着，由六位部落祭司保管。祭司们只把钥匙给我。他们绝不会给你这样的普通哥布林。

english: What Big High War God's real name?
translation: 大战神的真名是什么？

english: You ask big question. Big High War God's true name not for normal goblin minds, but since you pass test, I tell you. His true name Bandos.
translation: 你问了个大问题。大战神的真名不适合普通哥布林的头脑，但既然你通过了考验，我就告诉你。他的真名是班多斯。

english: That name that ogres call him, that orks call him. That name that goblin priests call him on holy days. But normal goblins, you must show respect. You only call him Big High War God.
translation: 那是食人魔叫他的名字，兽人也这么叫他。那是哥布林祭司在圣日叫他的名字。但普通哥布林，你们必须表示尊重。你们只能叫他大战神。

english: Why there only six tribes in temple?
translation: 为什么庙宇里只有六个部落？

english: Goblin tribes are thing of past. Long ago, all goblins divided into twelve tribes. Dorgeshuun tribe rebel, so Big High War God punish them. Then there eleven tribes.
translation: 哥布林部落是过去的事了。很久以前，所有哥布林分为十二个部落。多吉舒恩部落反叛了，所以大战神惩罚了他们。然后就剩下十一个部落。

english: No other tribes disappear like Dorgeshuun, but over ages, tribes merge. Now most goblins, they not know what tribe they come from.
translation: 没有其他部落像多吉舒恩那样消失，但随着时间的推移，部落合并了。现在大多数哥布林都不知道自己来自哪个部落。

english: Sometimes, goblins who know what tribe they come from, they come here and make tribal enclaves. They colour armour different colours to show what tribe they in. But not all tribes here.
translation: 有时，知道自己来自哪个部落的哥布林会来到这里，建立部落飞地。他们把盔甲染成不同的颜色，以显示他们属于哪个部落。但并非所有部落都在这里。

english: How me get into tribal enclaves?
translation: 我怎么进入部落飞地？

english: Goblins show tribe by dying armour special tribe colour. Yellow for Yurkolgokh, white for Saragorgak, purple for Horogothgar, orange for Narogoshuun, blue for Ekeleshuun and black for Huzamogaarb.
translation: 哥布林通过将盔甲染成特殊的部落颜色来展示部落。黄色代表尤尔科格克，白色代表萨拉戈加克，紫色代表霍罗戈斯加，橙色代表纳罗戈舒恩，蓝色代表埃克勒舒恩，黑色代表胡扎莫加布。

english: You not wearing colour, you not entering the enclave.
translation: 你没穿对应颜色，就进不了飞地。

english: Me have no questions.
translation: 我没有问题了。

english: Good. Goblins should not ask questions. Fight and die for glory of Big High War God. Never ask question or have thought.
translation: 很好。哥布林不应该提问。为大战神的荣耀而战而死。从不提问，从不思考。

english: Me want to take test again.
translation: 我想再考一次。

english: Good. Goblins must always remember faith to Big High War God.
translation: 很好。哥布林必须永远牢记对大战神的信仰。

english: Then bring glory to Big High War God.
translation: 那就为大战神带来荣耀吧。

english: Can you make black or white dye?
translation: 你能做黑色或白色染料吗？

english: Black dye can be made by grinding up black mushrooms. That's dead easy. The mushrooms grow in some old caves and ruins.
translation: 黑色染料可以通过研磨黑蘑菇制成。这非常简单。那些蘑菇生长在一些古老的洞穴和废墟里。

english: But white dye? There's no such thing!
translation: 但白色染料？没这种东西！

english: Then how can you colour clothes white?
translation: 那你怎么把衣服染成白色？

english: Usually you can't, but with poorly-made clothes, it's possible to remove the dye. Even then, it's a very tricky process involving a special ingredient found in the gut of the Hemenster Whitefish.
translation: 通常不行，但对于做工粗糙的衣服，可以去除染料。即便如此，这也是一个非常棘手的过程，需要用到赫门斯特白鱼内脏里的一种特殊成分。

english: Hemenster Whitefish?
translation: 赫门斯特白鱼？

english: Yes, found only at Hemenster, oddly enough. It's the place where they have those fishing contests.
translation: 是的，奇怪的是，只在赫门斯特有。就是那个举办钓鱼比赛的地方。

english: If you fancy catching some, you should know that very specific bait is needed. Only slimy eels will work. I hear you can catch those in the caves below Lumbridge Swamp.
translation: 如果你想抓一些，要知道需要非常特殊的鱼饵。只有黏糊糊的鳗鱼才行。我听说你可以在仑桥镇沼泽下面的洞穴里抓到那些。

english: Anyway, if you do have something you want the dye removing from, just bring me a Hemenster Whitefish and five coins.
translation: 总之，如果你有东西想去除染料，就给我带一条赫门斯特白鱼和五枚金币来。

english: Could you remove the dye from this goblin mail?
translation: 你能去除这件哥布林链甲上的染料吗？

english: That'll be five coins please.
translation: 请付五枚金币。

english: You'll need to go and get a Hemenster Whitefish first.
translation: 你得先去弄一条赫门斯特白鱼。

english: Yeah, I was just about to do that.
translation: 是啊，我正打算去。

english: What goblin mail?
translation: 什么哥布林链甲？

english: Oh, right. I'll go and get some.
translation: 哦，好吧。我去弄一些。

english: That goblin mail is already white.
translation: 那件哥布林链甲已经是白色的了。

english: Oh yes, so it is.
translation: 哦，是啊，还真是。

english: Listen! Whoever does not worship Big High War God, whether great or small, goblin or other, must die!
translation: 听着！凡是不崇拜大战神的，无论大小，无论哥布林还是其他种族，都必须死！

english: If another goblin tell you to worship different gods, you not listen to them! You kill them! All tribe kill them!
translation: 如果有其他哥布林让你崇拜不同的神，你不要听他们的！你要杀了他们！整个部落都要杀了他们！

english: Kill peoples who worship different gods! Smite them! Destroy them! Do not show mercy!
translation: 杀死崇拜不同神的人！惩戒他们！毁灭他们！不要仁慈！

english: Enemies must die! Doubters must die! These words of Big High War God!
translation: 敌人必须死！怀疑者必须死！这是大战神的话！

english: Remember, we holy people of Big High War God! He chose us to be special people, better than all people in world!
translation: 记住，我们是大战神的圣民！他选择我们成为特殊的民族，比世界上所有民族都优秀！

english: Big High War God not choose us because we many, or because we strong. We nothing before he choose us! But he take us from Yu'biusk with mighty hand, and make us strong!
translation: 大战神选择我们，不是因为我们人多，也不是因为我们强大。在他选择我们之前，我们什么都不是！但他用大能的手将我们从尤比斯克带出来，使我们变得强大！

english: Soon Big High War God send Chosen Commander!
translation: 大战神很快就会派来被选中的指挥官！

english: I tell you truth! There some goblins here who not die before they see Chosen Commander coming with glory of Big High War God!
translation: 我跟你们说实话！这里有些哥布林，在亲眼看到被选中的指挥官带着大战神的荣耀降临之前，是不会死的！

english: Then Chosen Commander lead goblins into war as one army, and we kill every other race and all followers of other gods!
translation: 然后被选中的指挥官将带领哥布林作为一支军队投入战争，我们将杀死所有其他种族和所有其他神的追随者！

english: Then Big High War God himself return and sit on throne of bronze and rull over all!
translation: 然后大战神亲自归来，坐上青铜王座，统治一切！

english: Let me tell you story about Hopespear! He prophet of Big High War God! He very holy goblin!
translation: 让我给你讲讲希望矛的故事！他是大战神的先知！他是非常神圣的哥布林！

english: When Hopespear old, he walking near Goblin Village, and little goblin children came out of village and make fun of him.
translation: 希望矛老了的时候，他在哥布林村庄附近散步，小孩子们从村里跑出来取笑他。

english: The he look at them, and curse them in name of Big High War God. Then monsters come and tear children to pieces!
translation: 然后他看着他们，以大战神的名义诅咒他们。接着怪物来了，把孩子们撕成了碎片！

english: May Big High War God give you faith!
translation: 愿大战神赐予你信仰！

english: Before you enter battle, clear mind of thought. Do not think about what you will do or what may happen.
translation: 进入战斗前，清空思绪。不要去想你要做什么或会发生什么。

english: When battle start, Big High War God guide your arm and fill your heart with courage.
translation: 战斗开始时，大战神会指引你的手臂，让你的心中充满勇气。

english: Have faith in Big High War God. He rule all war, so whatever happen in war, it his will.
translation: 要相信大战神。他主宰一切战争，所以战争中发生的一切，都是他的意志。

english: Goblins great nation in time of great war!
translation: 哥布林在伟大战争的时代是伟大的民族！

english: Big High War God himself lead us into battle! Then we crush enemies, we burn cities to ground, we kill every man, woman and child! Even animals!
translation: 大战神亲自带领我们上战场！然后我们碾碎敌人，烧毁城市，杀死每一个男人、女人和孩子！连动物都不放过！

english: Some enemies, we kill them so bad, now there no trace and no one ever remember them! That what happen to enemies of Big High War God!
translation: 有些敌人，我们把他们杀得太彻底，现在连痕迹都没有，也没人记得他们了！这就是大战神敌人的下场！

english: You beat me. What you want?
translation: 你打败了我。你想要什么？

english: It long way away. Me not know where. High priest who come before me, he say that when goblins die we go to Yu'biusk. Perhaps he know where it is.
translation: 很远很远。我不知道在哪。在我之前的大祭司说，哥布林死后会去尤比斯克。也许他知道在哪。

english: What was your predecessor's name?
translation: 你的前任叫什么名字？

english: Snailfeet. That his name.
translation: 斯奈尔菲特。那是他的名字。

english: You not goblin. Not high priest. So me attack.
translation: 你不是哥布林。不是大祭司。所以我要攻击你。

english: It dark. Very dark. And cold.
translation: 很黑。非常黑。还很冷。

english: You beaten me. Ask your questions.
translation: 你打败了我。问你的问题吧。

english: Far, far away. Me not know where. But high priest who come before me, he say that when goblins die in battle, our souls travel to Yu'biusk.
translation: 很远很远。我不知道在哪。但在我之前的大祭司说，哥布林在战斗中死去时，我们的灵魂会前往尤比斯克。

english: Mosschin.
translation: 莫斯钦。

english: You not goblin high priest! Me only answer questions for goblin high priest!
translation: 你不是哥布林大祭司！我只回答哥布林大祭司的问题！

english: Why me here? Me die in battle, fighting humans! Why me not in Yu'biusk?
translation: 我为什么在这里？我是在战斗中死去的，和人类战斗！为什么我不在尤比斯克？

english: You have defeated me, human. Ask your questions.
translation: 你打败了我，人类。问你的问题吧。

english: Far beyond this world. Long ago, the Big High War God brought goblins from Yu'biusk.
translation: 远在这个世界之外。很久以前，大战神把哥布林从尤比斯克带了过来。

english: The high priest who came before me said that whenever goblins die in battle and their blood spills onto the ground, Yu'biusk is close and their souls can travel there.
translation: 在我之前的大祭司说，每当哥布林在战斗中死去，他们的血流到地上时，尤比斯克就近在咫尺，他们的灵魂就能前往那里。

english: Redeyes.
translation: 雷德艾斯。

english: I only answer questions for those who are worthy! I had to test you!
translation: 我只回答配得上的人的问题！我必须考验你！

english: All alone. I thought my soul would travel to Yu'biusk. But perhaps I was not worthy.
translation: 孤零零的。我以为我的灵魂会前往尤比斯克。但也许我不配。

english: Yu'biusk is far away. Beyond the icelands to the north, beyond the mountains to the west, beyond the oceans to the south and the deserts to the east.
translation: 尤比斯克很远。在北方的冰原之外，在西方的山脉之外，在南方的海洋之外，在东方的沙漠之外。

english: But it is also close. Wherever goblins fight in the name of the Big High War God and their blood spills on the ground, Yu'biusk is close.
translation: 但它也很近。无论哥布林在哪里以大战神的名义战斗，他们的血流到地上时，尤比斯克就近在咫尺。

english: My predecessor told me that no living goblin has ever gone to Yu'biusk. If no living goblin can go there, then perhaps the dead can.
translation: 我的前任告诉我，没有活着的哥布林去过尤比斯克。如果没有活着的哥布林能去那里，也许死者可以。

english: Strongbones. He was a mighty high priest and warrior of the Big High War God. It was he who learned the magic that allows us to be called up to speak with the living.
translation: 斯特朗博恩斯。他是一位强大的大祭司和大战神的战士。正是他学会了让我们被召唤出来与活人交谈的魔法。

english: You are not a goblin high priest, so I had to see if you were worthy.
translation: 你不是哥布林大祭司，所以我必须看看你是否配得上。

english: I had thought perhaps I would go to Yu'biusk, to fight in endless battles for the Big High War God. Instead, there is only endless sleep.
translation: 我本以为也许我会去尤比斯克，为大战神进行无尽的战斗。但相反，只有无尽的沉睡。

english: Good luck in your quest, human.
translation: 祝你的任务好运，人类。

english: You have proved yourself the stronger, human. Ask your questions.
translation: 你证明了自己更强，人类。问你的问题吧。

english: Yu'biusk is another plane of existence. No goblin alive today has ever been there.
translation: 尤比斯克是另一个存在位面。今天活着的哥布林没有一个去过那里。
