english: It is many millennia since the Big High War God brought our ancestors from Yu'biusk, but the call to that plane is still strong in us.
translation: 大战神将我们的祖先从尤比斯克带来已有数千年，但那个位面的召唤在我们心中依然强烈。

english: If the barriers between the planes were ever to be broken, goblin blood would call out and open a portal to Yu'biusk.
translation: 如果位面之间的屏障被打破，哥布林的血会发出召唤，打开通往尤比斯克的传送门。

english: His name is not important. He is not buried here. Before my time, priests were cremated, and their ashes scattered to the winds. You cannot talk to him.
translation: 他的名字不重要。他没有葬在这里。在我之前，祭司们被火化，骨灰随风飘散。你无法和他交谈。

english: You are a human, not one of the children of the Big High War God. For this reason, you had to prove yourself in combat before I could speak with you.
translation: 你是人类，不是大战神的子民。因此，你必须先在战斗中证明自己，我才能和你说话。

english: I cannot tell you. I no longer remember what it is like to be alive.
translation: 我无法告诉你。我不再记得活着是什么感觉了。

english: Goodbye, human. I am sure that the Chosen Commander will find what she is looking for when you bring her to Yu'biusk.
translation: 再见，人类。我相信当你带她到尤比斯克时，被选中的指挥官会找到她所寻找的东西。

english: Sort of. I've discovered that Yu'biusk is another plane of existence. Apparently if the barriers between the planes are breached, goblin blood will call out to Yu'biusk and create a portal leading there.
translation: 差不多吧。我发现尤比斯克是另一个存在位面。显然，如果位面之间的屏障被打破，哥布林的血会向尤比斯克发出召唤，并创建一个通往那里的传送门。

english: Another plane? You mean goblins aren't native to Gielinor? That's remarkable. Think of the historical implications...
translation: 另一个位面？你是说哥布林不是吉列诺的本土生物？这太惊人了。想想历史意义……

english: But how could we breach the barriers between the planes?
translation: 但我们怎么能打破位面之间的屏障呢？

english: I know! The fungus ring in the southern caves! Didn't you say that had magical properties, Oldak?
translation: 我知道！南部洞穴里的蘑菇圈！你不是说它有魔法特性吗，奥达克？

english: Yes... that sample you showed me had very similar properties to Law runes. I believe that the fungus ring could create an effect similar to my moving-over-distance spheres.
translation: 是的……你给我看的那个样本与律法符文有非常相似的特性。我相信蘑菇圈可以产生类似于我的远距离移动球的效果。

english: Fungus ring? That sounds like a fairy ring. They're part of a big teleportation network.
translation: 蘑菇圈？听起来像仙女环。它们是一个大型传送网络的一部分。

english: Well that confirms it then. This fungus ring might be just what we need!
translation: 那就确认了。这个蘑菇圈可能正是我们需要的！

english: If the ring can create a moving-over-distance effect... then with enough power, we should be able to use it to break the planar barriers.
translation: 如果这个圈能产生远距离移动效果……那么有了足够的能量，我们应该能用它来打破位面屏障。

english: Then we just need goblin blood to call out to Yu'biusk!
translation: 那我们只需要哥布林的血来向尤比斯克发出召唤！

english: Well I reckon we've got plenty of that.
translation: 嗯，我想我们有的是。

english: I can't believe this! The goblin homeland! This could be somewhere safe for goblins like Grubfoot. A new home, free of war!
translation: 我简直不敢相信！哥布林的故乡！这可能是像格拉布福特这样的哥布林的安全之地。一个没有战争的新家！

english: Could this be it, [player name]? Could this be my destiny? Could this be why I was marked by the Tears of Guthix?
translation: 这会是这样吗，[player name]？这是我的命运吗？这就是我被古斯之泪标记的原因吗？

english: We should see if this works before we tell anyone else. Now, I think I can create some apparatus to provide power to the fungus ring.
translation: 我们应该先看看这是否有效，再告诉别人。现在，我想我可以制作一些装置来为蘑菇圈提供能量。

english: Come on, Zanik. [player name], will you meet us by the fungus ring to the south of the city?
translation: 来吧，扎尼克。[player name]，你能在城市南边的蘑菇圈那里和我们碰面吗？

english: Hey Zanik. How's it going?
translation: 嘿，扎尼克。怎么样？

english: Hey, [player name]. This is incredible! I can't believe we're really going to go to Yu'biusk, the Land of the Goblins!
translation: 嘿，[player name]。这太不可思议了！我简直不敢相信我们真的要去尤比斯克，哥布林之地！

english: What do you think we'll find there?
translation: 你觉得我们会在那里找到什么？

english: I don't know. All we have to go on is Grubfoot's dream, which isn't much. Still, not long now until we find out!
translation: 我不知道。我们只能依靠格拉布福特的梦，这不算多。不过，用不了多久我们就能知道了！

english: Anyway, you should help Oldak out with the machine. He wants me to stand here so that when the portal opens, it'll have a goblin right next to it.
translation: 总之，你应该帮奥达克处理机器。他想让我站在这里，这样当传送门打开时，旁边就会有一个哥布林。

english: Ah, [player name]. The machine is nearly ready. When I activate it, it will bombard the fungus ring with magical energy.
translation: 啊，[player name]。机器快准备好了。当我激活它时，它会用魔法能量轰击蘑菇圈。

english: For this to work, we'll need to make sure the power is distributed correctly between the three circles of fungi. I need to handle the activation. [player name], could you please handle the power distribution?
translation: 要让它工作，我们需要确保能量在三个蘑菇圈之间正确分配。我需要处理激活。[player name]，你能处理能量分配吗？

english: The inner circle has a radius of one zurg, the middle circle has a radius of two zurgs, and the outer circle has a radius of three zurgs. You will need to distribute the power in proportion to the area of each circle.
translation: 内圈半径为一祖格，中圈半径为二祖格，外圈半径为三祖格。你需要按照每个圆圈的面积比例分配能量。

english: Oldak! It's working!
translation: 奥达克！它成功了！

english: Something must have gone wrong. This isn't what Grubfoot described.
translation: 一定是出了什么问题。这不是格拉布福特描述的样子。

english: No, no, no...
translation: 不，不，不……

english: I don't understand. What happened here?
translation: 我不明白。这里发生了什么？

english: We must be missing something. This can't be it...
translation: 我们一定漏掉了什么。这不可能是……

english: Maybe we should look around.
translation: 也许我们应该四处看看。

english: Yes, let's.
translation: 是的，我们走吧。

english: I'll stay here and keep an eye on the portal.
translation: 我留在这里看着传送门。

english: You should have a look around and see if you can find out anything about this place. I'll stay here and keep an eye on the portal.
translation: 你应该四处看看，看看能不能找到关于这个地方的任何信息。我留在这里看着传送门。

english: [player name]. We should head back through the portal. Zanik is waiting on the other side.
translation: [player name]。我们应该通过传送门回去。扎尼克在另一边等着。

english: Don't go too far! I don't know how stable this portal is!
translation: 别走太远！我不知道这个传送门有多稳定！

english: There must be something around here. It can't all be dead... can it?
translation: 这附近一定有什么东西。不可能全是死的……对吧？

english: Yes, but we haven't properly explored it yet.
translation: 是的，但我们还没有好好探索过。

english: This is really it, isn't it? Grubfoot's dream was just that, a dream. All Yu'biusk is now is an empty wasteland.
translation: 这就是真的，对吧？格拉布福特的梦只是个梦。尤比斯克现在只是一个空旷的荒地。

english: I don't understand... What happened here?
translation: 我不明白……这里发生了什么？

english: The Big High War God happened.
translation: 大战神干的。

english: I thought this might be it, [player name]. I really did. I thought this place might finally give me some answers, but it's just another dead end.
translation: 我本以为这可能就是答案，[player name]。我真的这么想。我以为这个地方最终能给我一些答案，但只是另一个死胡同。

english: I'm sorry, Zanik.
translation: 我很抱歉，扎尼克。

english: Let's have a look at what this box is, then let's go home. There's nothing here for anyone any more.
translation: 让我们看看这个箱子是什么，然后回家吧。这里对任何人都没什么了。

english: What's happening? [player name]!
translation: 发生什么事了？[player name]！

english: The portal is closing! You've got to get back now!
translation: 传送门正在关闭！你必须马上回来！

english: Zanik...
translation: 扎尼克……

english: [player name]? What's going on? Where's Zanik?
translation: [player name]？发生什么事了？扎尼克在哪？

english: She's gone.
translation: 她不见了。

english: Gone? What do you mean?
translation: 不见了？你什么意思？

english: I don't know... She just disappeared...
translation: 我不知道……她就这么消失了……

english: No... Zanik...
translation: 不……扎尼克……

english: The portal... We have to go.
translation: 传送门……我们必须走了。

english: I'll find you Zanik.
translation: 我会找到你的，扎尼克。

english: What are we going to do about Zanik?
translation: 我们打算怎么处理扎尼克的事？

english: We can only assume she's still in Yu'biusk somewhere. Problem is, I haven't been able to get the fungus ring machine working again.
translation: 我们只能假设她还在尤比斯克的某个地方。问题是，我一直没能让蘑菇圈机器重新工作。

english: So there's no way back?
translation: 所以没有回去的路了？

english: Perhaps not. Still, now that we've broken the planar barriers between Gielinor and Yu'biusk, maybe we've enabled some alternate methods of transport there.
translation: 也许没有。不过，既然我们已经打破了吉列诺和尤比斯克之间的位面屏障，也许我们启用了其他前往那里的交通方式。

english: Those fungus rings would be a good starting point. Maybe you could use one of them to find another way to Yu'biusk. In the meantime, I'll keep trying to get the machine working again.
translation: 那些蘑菇圈会是一个好的起点。也许你可以用其中一个找到另一条去尤比斯克的路。与此同时，我会继续尝试让机器重新工作。

english: I managed to get back to Yu'biusk.
translation: 我成功回到了尤比斯克。

english: You did? Did you find anything there? Was there any trace of Zanik?
translation: 你去了？在那里发现了什么吗？有扎尼克的踪迹吗？

english: No, there was nothing.
translation: 不，什么都没有。

english: Then it's just as I feared. It seems that whatever's happened to Zanik, wherever she is... she's on her own.
translation: 那就和我担心的一样了。看来不管扎尼克出了什么事，不管她在哪儿……她都只能靠自己了。

english: I will find her, Oldak.
translation: 我会找到她的，奥达克。

english: I know you will, [player name].
translation: 我知道你会的，[player name]。

english: Yes, but it wasn't how you'd dreamed. It was a devastated wasteland.
translation: 是的，但和你想象的完全不同。那是一片被摧毁的荒原。

english: Yu'biusk... Land of Goblins... All gone?
translation: 尤比乌斯克……哥布林之地……全都没了？

english: I'm afraid so. And that's not all. Zanik vanished there.
translation: 恐怕是的。而且还不止这样。扎尼克在那里消失了。

english: Chosen Commander? She vanish?
translation: 被选中的指挥官？她消失了？

english: Yes. A bright white light picked her up and then she was gone.
translation: 是的。一道亮眼的白光把她提了起来，然后她就不见了。

english: She not gone. I sure of it. Someday she return.
translation: 她没有消失。我确信。总有一天她会回来的。

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them you can talk to them.
translation: 你会发现这个世界上的许多居民都会对你说些有用的话。通过[clicking/tapping]他们，你可以和他们交谈。

english: Now then, let's start by looking at your settings menu.
translation: 那么，我们先来看看你的设置菜单吧。

english: You will find many inhabitants of this world have useful things to say to you. By [clicking/tapping] on them, you can talk to them.
translation: 你会发现这个世界上的许多居民都会对你说些有用的话。通过[clicking/tapping]他们，你可以和他们交谈。

english: Excellent work. Next you'll want to cook those shrimp. To do that, you'll need a fire. This brings us on to the Woodcutting and Firemaking skills.
translation: 干得好。接下来你得烹饪那些虾。要这样做，你需要生一堆火。这就引出了伐木和生火技能。

english: As you move your mouse over the various skills the small tooltip will show you the exact amount of experience you have and how much is needed to get to the next level.
translation: 当你将鼠标移动到各种技能上时，小提示会显示你当前拥有的确切经验值，以及升到下一级还需要多少。

english: You can also [click/tap] on a skill to open up the relevant skillguide. In the skillguide, you can see all of the unlocks available in that skill.
translation: 你也可以[click/tap]某个技能来打开相应的技能指南。在技能指南中，你可以看到该技能的所有解锁内容。

english: Woodcutting, eh? Don't worry, newcomer, it's really very easy. Simply equip your axe and [click/tap] on a nearby tree to chop away.
translation: 伐木？别担心，新手，其实很简单。只需装备你的斧头，然后[click/tap]附近的树木就可以砍伐了。

english: The range is the only place you can cook a lot of the more complex foods in Gielinor. To cook on a range, all you need to do is [click/tap] on it. You'll need to make sure you have the required items in your inventory though.
translation: 在吉妮诺大陆，炉灶是唯一能烹饪许多复杂食物的地方。要在炉灶上烹饪，你只需[click/tap]它。不过你得确保背包里有需要的材料。

english: I don't think you're ready to go down there yet.
translation: 我觉得你还没准备好去那里。

english: Now that you have the quest list open, you can see all the quests within it. Opening a quest's journal will provide you with more information on it.
translation: 现在你打开了任务列表，可以看到里面所有的任务。打开某个任务的日志会给你提供更多信息。

english: There's not a lot more I can tell you about questing. You have to experience the thrill of it yourself to fully understand. Let me know if you want a recap, otherwise you can move on.
translation: 关于任务我能告诉你的已经不多了。你必须亲自体验那种刺激才能完全理解。如果你想回顾一下，就告诉我，否则你可以继续前进。

english: Within your quest list, you'll unsurprisingly find a list of quests. Opening a quest's journal will provide you with more information on it.
translation: 在你的任务列表中，不出意外你会看到一个任务列表。打开某个任务的日志会给你提供更多信息。

english: Earlier I gave you a bronze pickaxe. It's the most inefficient pickaxe available, but it's perfect for a beginner.
translation: 之前我给了你一把青铜镐。这是效率最低的镐子，但对于初学者来说正合适。

english: To mine, simply [click/tap] on a rock that contains ore while you have a pickaxe with you, and you will keep mining the rock until you manage to get some ore, or until it is empty.
translation: 要采矿，只需在带着镐子的情况下[click/tap]含有矿石的岩石，你会一直开采那块岩石，直到获得一些矿石，或者直到它被采空。

english: You're not ready to continue yet. You need to know about combat before you go on.
translation: 你还没准备好继续。你需要先了解战斗才能继续。

english: Oi! Get away from there. Only enter the rat cage when I say so.
translation: 喂！离那里远点。只有我说了才能进老鼠笼子。

english: I am Vannaka, the greatest swordsman alive, and I'm here to teach you the basics of combat.
translation: 我是范纳卡，在世的最伟大的剑士，我来教你战斗的基础知识。

english: Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen through the nearby gate and kill one of those rats.
translation: 是时候实战了！从附近的门进入围栏，杀掉一只老鼠。

english: Next up we have ranged combat. With this you can kill foes from a distance. With ranged, you'll be able to attack the rats without entering the pit meaning they won't be able to fight back.
translation: 接下来是远程战斗。使用远程你可以从远处杀死敌人。有了远程，你可以在不进坑的情况下攻击老鼠，这样它们就无法反击了。

english: No, don't enter the pit. Range the rats from outside the cage.
translation: 不，不要进坑里。在笼子外面用远程攻击老鼠。

english: Before going into combat with an opponent it is wise to see what combat level they are.
translation: 在与敌人战斗之前，明智的做法是查看他们的战斗等级。

english: There's various things you can do with your account which is where the Account Management menu comes into play. Let's take a look at it now.
translation: 你的角色可以做很多事情，这时候账户管理菜单就派上用场了。我们现在来看看吧。

english: Before we go any further, you should have a look at the Account Management menu.
translation: 在我们继续之前，你应该先看看账户管理菜单。

english: This is your Prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. [Click]/[Tap] on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and [click]/[tap] it again to deactivate it.
translation: 这是你的祈祷列表。祈祷在战斗中能帮上大忙。[点击/轻触]你想使用的祈祷来激活它，再次[点击/轻触]即可取消激活。

english: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by [clicking]/[tapping] them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.
translation: 正如你注意到的，大多数敌人被击败后会掉落骨头。通过[点击/轻触]背包里的骨头来埋葬它们，可以获得祈祷经验。

english: That's all I have to teach you for now. If you need a reminder about your prayers, just speak to me again.
translation: 目前我要教你的就这些了。如果你需要复习祈祷，随时再来找我。

english: Ah, yes, your prayer list. Prayers can help a lot in combat. [Click/Tap] on the prayer you wish to use to activate it, and [click/tap] it again to deactivate it.
translation: 啊，对了，你的祈祷列表。祈祷在战斗中能帮上大忙。[Click/Tap]你想使用的祈祷来激活它，再次[click/tap]即可取消激活。

english: As you noticed, most enemies will drop bones when defeated. Burying bones, by [clicking/tapping] them in your inventory, will gain you Prayer experience.
translation: 正如你注意到的，大多数敌人被击败后会掉落骨头。通过[clicking/tapping]背包里的骨头来埋葬它们，可以获得祈祷经验。

english: Hello, [player name]. I'm Paul, the Ironman tutor. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，[player name]。我是保罗，铁人导师。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Hey there Paul.
translation: 嘿，保罗。

english: Hail, [Ironman type]! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，[Ironman type]！有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Tell me about Ironmen.
translation: 告诉我关于铁人的事。

english: When you play as anIronman, you do everything for yourself. You don't trade with other players, or take their items, or accept their help.
translation: 当你以铁人身份游玩时，所有事情都要靠自己完成。你不能与其他玩家交易，不能拿他们的物品，也不能接受他们的帮助。

english: As anIronman, you choose to have these restrictions imposed on you, so everyone knows you're doing it properly.
translation: 作为铁人，你选择接受这些限制，这样大家就知道你是在正当地游玩。

english: If you think you have what it takes, you can choose to become aHardcore Ironman.
translation: 如果你觉得自己有这个能耐，你可以选择成为一名硬核铁人。

english: In addition to the standard restrictions,Hardcore Ironmenonly haveone life. In the event of a dangerous death, yourHardcore Ironmenstatus will be downgraded to that of astandard Ironman, and your
translation: 除了标准限制外，硬核铁人只有一条命。如果发生致命死亡，你的硬核铁人身份将降级为标准铁人，并且你的

english: stats will be frozen on theHardcore Iron manhiscores.
translation: 属性将在硬核铁人排行榜上冻结。

english: If you have some friends, you could stand alone... Together, asGroup Ironmen. Group Ironmen have the same restrictions as regular Ironmen except you can trade your items with each other!
translation: 如果你有朋友，你们可以独自站立……但一起，作为团体铁人。团体铁人与普通铁人有相同的限制，但你们可以互相交易物品！

english: For the ultimate challenge, you can choose to become anUltimate Ironman, a game mode inspired by the playerIronNoBank.
translation: 为了终极挑战，你可以选择成为一名终极铁人，这是一个受到玩家铁人无银行启发的游戏模式。

english: In addition to the standard restrictions,Ultimate Ironmenare blocked from using the bank, and they drop all their items when they die.
translation: 除了标准限制外，终极铁人无法使用银行，并且死亡时会掉落所有物品。

english: While you're on Tutorial Island, you can switch freely between being astandard Ironman, anUltimate Ironman, aHardcore Ironman, aGroup Ironman, aHardcore Group Ironmanor a regular character.
translation: 在教程岛上，你可以在标准铁人、终极铁人、硬核铁人、组队铁人、硬核组队铁人或普通角色之间自由切换。

english: So he will letHardcore IronmenorUltimate Ironmendowngrade tostandard Ironmen, and he'll let all types ofIronmanbecome normal players.
translation: 所以他会让硬核铁人或终极铁人降级为标准铁人，并且让所有类型的铁人变成普通玩家。

english: I must warn you that Ironman mode is not recommended for new players. You can still give it a go if you think you're up for the challenge though.
translation: 我必须警告你，铁人模式不推荐新玩家使用。不过如果你觉得自己能接受挑战，还是可以尝试一下。

english: I'd like to change my Ironman mode.
translation: 我想改变我的铁人模式。

english: Make sure you've got your Ironman settings all sorted before you leave Tutorial Island. Some things can't be changed later.
translation: 在离开教程岛之前，确保你的铁人设置都安排好了。有些事情之后就无法更改了。

english: All you have to do is open the magic interface by [clicking/tapping] on the flashing icon.
translation: 你只需通过[clicking/tapping]闪烁的图标来打开魔法界面。

english: Excellent, I think that covers everything. When you're ready to go, use your home teleport spell to teleport to Lumbridge!
translation: 太好了，我想该教的都教了。当你准备好出发时，使用你的传送法术传送到仑桥镇！

english: Were you planning to become an Ironman, by the way?
translation: 顺便问一下，你打算成为铁人吗？

english: What's an Ironman?
translation: 什么是铁人？

english: If you're interested in that, you should go and ask the Ironman tutor before you leave this island. He's standing outside my house.
translation: 如果你对这个感兴趣，你应该在离开这座岛之前去找铁人导师问问。他就站在我房子外面。

english: Yes, I do want to become an Ironman.
translation: 是的，我想成为铁人。

english: Yes, how can I help you?
translation: 是的，有什么可以帮你的？

english: This is the Legends' Guild!
translation: 这里是传奇公会！

english: Legendary citizens of Gielinor are invited on a quest in order to become members of the guild.
translation: 吉列诺的传奇市民会被邀请去完成一个任务，才能成为公会的成员。

english: Can I go on the quest?
translation: 我可以去执行这个任务吗？

english: Well, it looks as if you are eligible for the quest. Grand Vizier Erkle will give you the details about the quest. You can go and talk to him about it if you like?
translation: 嗯，看起来你符合执行任务的条件。大维齐尔.厄克尔会告诉你任务的细节。如果你愿意，可以去找他谈谈。

english: Who is Grand Vizier Erkle?
translation: 大维齐尔.厄克尔是谁？

english: He is the head of the Legends Guild. His full name is Radimus Erkle. Would you like to talk to him about the quest?
translation: 他是传奇公会的首领。他的全名是拉迪穆斯.厄克尔。你想和他谈谈这个任务吗？

english: Yes, I'd like to talk to Grand Vizier Erkle.
translation: 是的，我想和大维齐尔.厄克尔谈谈。

english: Ok, very well... You need to go into the building on the left, he's in his study.
translation: 好的，很好……你需要去左边的建筑，他在他的书房里。

english: Good Luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: Some other time perhaps?
translation: 也许改天吧？

english: What kind of quest is it?
translation: 这是什么类型的任务？

english: Well, to be honest, I'm not really sure. You'll need to talk to Grand Vizier Erkle to find that out.
translation: 嗯，老实说，我也不太确定。你需要和大维齐尔.厄克尔谈谈才能知道。

english: You're welcome...
translation: 不客气……

english: How do I get in here?
translation: 我怎么才能进去？

english: Well, you'll need to be a legendary citizen of Gielinor.
translation: 嗯，你需要成为吉列诺的传奇市民。

english: If you want to enter the Legends' Guild, you'll be invited to complete a quest. Once you have completed that quest, you'll be a fully fledged member of the Guild.
translation: 如果你想进入传奇公会，你会被邀请去完成一个任务。一旦你完成了那个任务，你就会成为公会的正式成员。

english: Can I speak to someone in charge?
translation: 我能和负责人谈谈吗？

english: Well, Radimus Erkle is the Grand Vizier of the Legends Guild. He's a very busy man. And he'll only talk to those people eligible for the quest.
translation: 嗯，拉迪穆斯.厄克尔是传奇公会的大维齐尔。他是个大忙人。而且他只和那些符合任务条件的人谈话。

english: I'm very sorry but you need to complete more quests before you can go on this quest. Additionally you need to gain [#] more quest points. They don't call it the Legends Guild for nothing you know!
translation: 非常抱歉，你需要先完成更多的任务才能去执行这个任务。另外，你还需要获得 [#] 个任务点数。你知道的，它可不是白叫传奇公会的！

english: Which quests do I need to complete?
translation: 我需要完成哪些任务？

english: Well, you'll need to complete the following quests: [Heroes' Quest], [Family Crest], [Shilo Village], [Underground Pass] and [Waterfall Quest].
translation: 嗯，你需要完成以下任务：[Heroes' Quest]、[Family Crest]、[Shilo Village]、[Underground Pass] 和 [Waterfall Quest]。

english: You also need a total of 107 quest points.
translation: 你还需要总共 107 个任务点数。

english: They don't call it the Legends Guild for nothing you know! Best of luck if you intend to become a member!
translation: 你知道的，它可不是白叫传奇公会的！如果你打算成为会员，祝你好运！

english: That's no problem... Best of luck if you intend to become a member!
translation: 没问题……如果你打算成为会员，祝你好运！

english: It's ok thanks.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。

english: Very well!
translation: 很好！

english: Good day to you, adventurer! No doubt you are keen to become a member of the Legends' Guild?
translation: 你好，冒险者！毫无疑问，你很想成为传奇公会的成员吧？

english: Yes actually, what's involved?
translation: 是的，具体要做什么？

english: Well, you'll need to complete a quest for us as proof that you've got what it takes to be a Legend. How do you fancy mapping the Kharazi Jungle? It's the unexplored southern part of Karamja Island.
translation: 嗯，你需要为我们完成一个任务，以证明你有成为传奇人物的本事。你觉得绘制卡拉兹丛林的地图怎么样？那是卡拉姆詹岛南部未被探索的区域。

english: We'd also like you to befriend a Kharazi tribesman, and bring back a token of the tribe's friendship. The Legends' Guild has allies in all corners of the map, and we could always use more.
translation: 我们还希望你和一位卡拉兹部落成员交朋友，并带回一件部落友谊的信物。

english: What do you say? Are you interested in this quest?
translation: 你觉得怎么样？对这个任务感兴趣吗？

english: Yes, it sounds great!
translation: 是的，听起来很棒！

english: Excellent! I've already started mapping the jungle myself. You can take my research to help you along.
translation: 太好了！我自己已经开始绘制丛林地图了。你可以带上我的研究资料来帮助你。

english: Complete this map when you get to the Kharazi Jungle. It's in the southernmost part of Karamja.
translation: 当你到达卡拉兹丛林时，完成这张地图。它在卡拉姆詹岛的最南端。

english: There's three sections I want you to focus on.
translation: 我希望你重点关注三个区域。

english: You'll need additional papyrus and charcoal to complete the map, of course.
translation: 当然，你还需要额外的莎草纸和木炭来完成地图。

english: It is likely to be very tough going. You'll need an axe and machete to cut through the dense Kharazi Jungle, so collect a machete from the cupboard before you leave. You'll need to find your own axe, preferably a
translation: 这可能会非常艰难。你需要一把斧头和砍刀来砍开茂密的卡拉兹丛林，所以出发前从橱柜里拿一把砍刀。你需要自己找一把斧头，最好是

english: good one.
translation: 一把好斧头。

english: Finally, whatever token of friendship you bring back must be fit to display in our hall. I'll know if it's some cheap knock-off, and I will not be best pleased.
translation: 最后，你带回来的任何友谊代币都必须适合在我们的大厅里展示。如果是什么廉价仿制品，我会知道的，而且我会很不高兴。

english: All that aside, I wish you the very best of luck!
translation: 除此之外，我祝你一切顺利！

english: Not just at the moment.
translation: 现在不了。

english: Very well, if you change your mind, please come back and see me.
translation: 很好，如果你改变主意，请回来找我。

english: As you wish...
translation: 如你所愿……

english: My name is Radimus Erkle. I am the Grand Vizier of the Legends' Guild. Are you interested in becoming a member?
translation: 我叫拉迪穆斯.厄克尔。我是传奇公会的大维齐尔。你有兴趣成为会员吗？

english: Hello there, how is the quest going?
translation: 你好，任务进行得怎么样了？

english: It's alright, but I've forgotten what to do.
translation: 还行，但我忘了要做什么了。

english: Taken one too many hits to the noggin, have you? Here's what I want you to do.
translation: 脑袋挨了太多下，是吧？这是我要你做的事。

english: You need to find a way into the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 你需要找到进入卡拉兹丛林的路。

english: Then you need to explore and map the three areas I asked you to.
translation: 那么你需要探索并绘制我要求的那三个区域的地图。

english: While you're there you need to make contact with the Kharazi tribe and establish friendly relations.
translation: 在那里的时候，你需要和卡拉兹部落取得联系并建立友好关系。

english: As proof of all this, I want you to bring back the completed map and a token of the Kharazi's esteem - something we can put on display.
translation: 作为这一切的证明，我希望你带回完成的地图和一件卡拉兹人敬意的代币——一件我们可以展示的东西。

english: Did you get all that?
translation: 你都明白了吗？

english: Terrible, I lost my map of the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 糟了，我弄丢了我的卡拉兹丛林地图。

english: Oh dear! Well, luckily one of those friendly foresters sent me a copy. But I'll need to charge you a fee of 30 Gold Pieces. The cost of postage these days is horrendous...
translation: 哦，天哪！幸好，一位友好的护林员给我寄了一份副本。但我需要向你收取 30 金币的费用。现在的邮费真是贵得离谱……

english: It looks as though you don't have the funds for it at the moment. How irritating...
translation: 看来你目前没有足够的资金。真烦人……

english: Do you agree to pay?
translation: 你同意支付吗？

english: Yes, I'll pay for it.
translation: 是的，我愿意支付。

english: Right then. Please don't lose this one.
translation: 好吧。请别再弄丢这张了。

english: No, I won't pay for it.
translation: 不，我不会付钱。

english: Well, that's your decision, of course.. but you won't be able to complete the quest without it. Now, if you'll excuse me, I have other business to attend to.
translation: 嗯，这当然是你的决定……但没有它你就无法完成任务。现在，请见谅，我还有别的事要处理。

english: I need another machete.
translation: 我还需要一把砍刀。

english: Well, just get another one from the cupboard.
translation: 嗯，那就从橱柜里再拿一把。

english: I've run out of charcoal.
translation: 我的木炭用完了。

english: Well, get some more! Have a little initiative, would you?
translation: 那就再去弄一些！有点主动性，好吗？

english: It's hardly legendary to fail a quest because you can't find a little bit of burnt wood!
translation: 因为找不到一小块烧焦的木头而任务失败，这可算不上什么传奇！

english: I've run out of papyrus.
translation: 我的莎草纸用完了。

english: It's hardly legendary to fail a quest because you can't find some papyrus!
translation: 因为找不到一些莎草纸而失败，这可不怎么传奇！

english: I've completed the quest.
translation: 我已经完成了任务。

english: Excellent! Does this mean you have a suitable gift from the Kharazi? Becoming a legend is more than just fighting you know. It also requires some careful diplomacy and problem solving skills.
translation: 太好了！这是否意味着你从卡拉兹人那里得到了合适的礼物？你知道，成为传奇人物不仅仅是战斗。它还需要一些谨慎的外交和解决问题的能力。

english: I'd like to see the completed map, too.
translation: 我也想看看完成的地图。

english: Hope the quest is going [well, sir!/well, madam!/well!]
translation: 希望任务进展顺利，[well, sir!/well, madam!/well!]

english: This is an impressive map! I'm amazed, it's just great! Do you mind if I make a copy of it? I'll give you my Bullroarer in return.
translation: 这张地图真令人印象深刻！我太惊讶了，真是太棒了！你介意我复制一份吗？我会用我的牛吼器作为交换。

english: Go ahead, make a copy!
translation: 请便，复制吧！

english: Many thanks, friend.
translation: 非常感谢，朋友。

english: Perfect.
translation: 完美。

english: That's a Bullroarer. Swing it above your head and it'll make a funny noise. It's great for attracting people's attention!
translation: 这是一个牛吼器。把它在头顶上挥舞，它会发出有趣的声音。非常适合吸引别人的注意！

english: You'll give me what in return?
translation: 你会给我什么作为交换？

english: My Bullroarer! Look.
translation: 我的牛吼器！看。

english: If you swing it above your head it makes a funny noise. It's great for attracting people's attention!
translation: 如果你把它在头顶上挥舞，它会发出有趣的声音。非常适合吸引别人的注意！

english: Sorry, I'm busy questing.
translation: 抱歉，我正忙着做任务。

english: This is a great map, thanks for letting me have a copy! I'm excited to explore more of the jungle.
translation: 这是一张很棒的地图，谢谢你让我复制一份！我很期待探索更多丛林。

english: Greetings, Bwana. Why do you make such strange sounds and disturb the peace of the jungle?
translation: 你好，先生。你为什么发出这么奇怪的声音，打扰丛林的宁静？

english: I was hoping to attract the attention of a Kharazi tribe member.
translation: 我希望引起卡拉兹部落成员的注意。

english: Well, it worked! I am Gujuo, proud member of the Kharazi tribe. What did you want to talk about, Bwana?
translation: 嗯，成功了！我是古朱奥，卡拉兹部落的骄傲成员。你想谈什么，先生？

english: I've been sent by the Legends' Guild. We want to develop friendly relations with your people.
translation: 我是传奇公会派来的。我们想和你们的人民发展友好关系。

english: Very good, Bwana... this is indeed a friendly gesture. However, you've come at a bad time.
translation: 很好，先生……这确实是一个友好的姿态。不过，你来得不是时候。

english: My people are scattered and in hiding.
translation: 我的人民都分散躲藏起来了。

english: Can you get your people together?
translation: 你能把你的人民聚集起来吗？

english: We normally meet regularly around our tribe's totem pole. Unfortunately, ours has been polluted by an evil spirit, and now we are all afraid to approach it.
translation: 我们通常定期在我们部落的图腾柱周围聚会。不幸的是，我们的图腾柱被一个恶灵污染了，现在我们都不敢靠近它。

english: We send our shaman, Ungadulu, to confront the spirit... but he has not returned.
translation: 我们派了我们的萨满，昂加杜鲁，去对抗那个灵魂……但他没有回来。

english: Is there any way I could help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: We could work together to make a new totem pole - but I'm afraid it won't be easy. We carve them from the trunk of the sacred Yommi tree.
translation: 我们可以一起制作一个新的图腾柱——但恐怕这并不容易。我们用神圣的约米树的树干来雕刻它们。

english: How do we make a totem pole?
translation: 我们怎么制作图腾柱？

english: First we need to plant a sacred Yommi tree. It is a magical tree of great power. Our shaman, Ungadulu, is the only one trusted with the seeds.
translation: 首先我们需要种一棵神圣的约米树。那是一棵拥有强大力量的魔法树。我们的萨满，昂加杜鲁，是唯一被信任保管种子的人。

english: And as I said, he hasn't returned from his mission. He was supposed to be communing with the spirits in some caves in the northwestern part of the jungle.
translation: 就像我说的，他执行任务后就没有回来。他本应在丛林西北部的一些洞穴里与灵魂交流。

english: I'll go find Ungadulu.
translation: 我去找昂加杜鲁。

english: You mean it? That would be wonderful, Bwana! He was last seen in the northwestern part of the Kharazi Jungle, near the great cliffs. Look there, and you will see three rocks that form a triangle.
translation: 真的吗？那太好了，先生！他最后一次出现是在卡拉兹丛林的西北部，靠近大悬崖的地方。去那里看看，你会看到三块岩石组成一个三角形。

english: They mark the secret entrance to the caves where Ungadulu communes with the spirits. If you rescue him, he will surely entrust you with the Yommi tree seeds, and we can restore our totem.
translation: 它们标记着昂加杜鲁与灵魂交流的洞穴的秘密入口。如果你救了他，他一定会把约米树种子托付给你，这样我们就能修复我们的图腾了。

english: I have to collect herbs now, Bwana...
translation: 我现在得去采集草药了，先生……

english: Oh well, sorry to hear about that.
translation: 唉，真遗憾听到这个消息。

english: That's okay, Bwana. Ungadulu has probably been torn apart by wild beasts, or driven mad by spirits... there's no point searching for him now.
translation: 没关系，Bwana。昂加杜鲁多半是被野兽撕碎了，或者被灵魂逼疯了……现在找他也没用了。

english: If my people survive this calamity, it will be a miracle...
translation: 如果我的族人能在这场灾难中幸存，那真是奇迹……

english: Okay, thanks for your help.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。

english: You're more than welcome, Bwana.
translation: 不客气，Bwana。

english: If I find Ungadulu, what's in it for me?
translation: 如果我找到昂加杜鲁，对我有什么好处？

english: Well, the Kharazi would be forever in your debt. Return our shaman, and we will certainly be able to establish friendly relations with your Legends' Guild.
translation: 嗯，卡拉兹族将永远欠你人情。找回我们的萨满，我们当然能和你们的传奇公会建立友好关系。

english: I'm lost, can you show me the way out?
translation: 我迷路了，能带我出去吗？

english: I can take you to the edge of the Kharazi Jungle. Shall we go now?
translation: 我可以带你去卡拉兹丛林边缘。我们现在就走吗？

english: Yes Please...
translation: 是的，请……

english: Follow me...
translation: 跟我来……

english: As you wish... Again, Bwana, What is it that brings you to the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 如你所愿……再问一次，Bwana，是什么风把你吹到卡拉兹丛林来了？

english: Sorry, it was a mistake?
translation: 抱歉，是我搞错了？

english: That's quite alright, Bwana. But I have to ask... what are you doing in the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 没关系，Bwana。但我得问一句……你在卡拉兹丛林做什么？

english: Bwana! Have you found Ungadulu?
translation: Bwana！你找到昂加杜鲁了吗？

english: I can't find the caves.
translation: 我找不到那些洞穴。

english: Well, they were still there last time I checked... go west through the jungle until you reach the see, then walk eastwards again with the barrier rocks to the north.
translation: 嗯，我上次检查时它们还在……向西穿过丛林直到你看到海，然后向东走，让屏障岩石在北边。

english: Walk past the covered pass and you'll find three rocks, arranged in a triangle shape on slightly elevated ground. You'll find the caves there.
translation: 走过那个遮蔽的通道，你会看到三块岩石，在微微隆起的地面上排成三角形。洞穴就在那里。

english: I am tired, Bwana, I must go and rest...
translation: 我累了，Bwana，我得去休息了……

english: Whew!
translation: 呼！

english: Wow, that looks hot!
translation: 哇，看起来好烫！

english: Please, come no closer! The flames will incinerate you.
translation: 请别再靠近了！火焰会把你们烧成灰烬。

english: How can I extinguish the flames?
translation: 我怎样才能扑灭火焰？

english: Please, don't try-
translation: 求求你，别试——

english: Yes, douse the flames with water... pure water...
translation: 对，用水浇灭火焰……纯水……

english: Please, leave now! Don't listen... I beg you, leave now, and do not return!
translation: 求你现在就走！别听……我求你了，现在就走，别再回来！

english: Where do I get pure water from?
translation: 我从哪里弄到纯水？

english: No... I will not tell you!
translation: 不……我不会告诉你的！

english: ...from the sacred pool, in the lands above... hurry and release me...
translation: ……从圣池里，在上方的土地上……快，释放我……

english: N-no! Please, Bwana, just leave while you still can!
translation: 不——不！求你了，Bwana，趁你还能走就走吧！

english: Hurry, Vacu, the heat of these flames is killing me... ha ha ha!
translation: 快啊，瓦库，这些火焰的热量快烧死我了……哈哈哈！

english: I am Ungadulu, shaman of the Kharazi tribe.
translation: 我是昂加杜鲁，卡拉兹部落的萨满。

english: Bring me pure water! Douse the flames, lest ye -
translation: 给我拿纯水来！浇灭火焰，否则你——

english: Please, Bwana, don't listen to me! Run, tell my people I am lost...
translation: 求你了，Bwana，别听我的！快跑，告诉我的族人我迷失了……

english: Ungadulu looks a little strange.
translation: 昂加杜鲁看起来有点奇怪。

english: Be wary, Bwana. The jungle is full of strange and powerful spirits. You may have been tricked...
translation: 小心点，Bwana。丛林里到处都是奇怪而强大的灵魂。你可能是被骗了……

english: Farewell Bwana, good luck.
translation: 再见，Bwana，祝你好运。

english: What kind of trick?
translation: 什么样的骗局？

english: Our forefathers summoned many strange spirits, in an attempt to learn their wisdom.
translation: 我们的祖先召唤了许多奇怪的灵魂，试图学习它们的智慧。

english: But something went wrong. Now they haunt the caves around this area, and make our lives miserable. Only the magic of the totem keeps them at bay.
translation: 但出了点问题。现在它们出没于这一带的洞穴，把我们的生活搞得苦不堪言。只有图腾的魔法才能阻挡它们。

english: These spirits are full of tricks. Take nothing as it first appears.
translation: 这些灵魂诡计多端。不要相信表面现象。

english: Sorry for bothering you.
translation: 抱歉打扰你了。

english: That's fine Bwana, not to worry. I hope your quest is going well.
translation: 没事的，Bwana，别担心。希望你的任务进展顺利。

english: How did they summon the spirits?
translation: 他们是怎么召唤灵魂的？

english: Such matters are best left to the shamans. I am told that certain patterns, scored on the ground, can bind a spirit and prevent it from doing harm... but that's all I know.
translation: 这种事情最好留给萨满处理。我听说，在地上刻出特定的图案可以束缚灵魂，防止它作恶……但我就知道这么多了。

english: Hmm... I think I might have seen one of those patterns recently.
translation: 嗯……我想我最近可能见过其中一个图案。

english: I'm not sure what to do.
translation: 我不确定该怎么做。

english: I wish I could help, but I'm as confused as you. Normally I'd call upon Ungadulu to solve a mystery like this... but he's part of the puzzle!
translation: 我希望我能帮忙，但我和你一样困惑。通常我会叫昂加杜鲁来解决这样的谜团……但他自己就是谜题的一部分！

english: I need some pure water to douse some magic flames.
translation: 我需要一些纯水来浇灭一些魔法火焰。

english: This all sounds very odd. You're not possessed, are you Bwana?
translation: 听起来真奇怪。你没被附身吧，Bwana？

english: I don't think so. I need the water to help Ungadulu!
translation: 应该没有。我需要水去救昂加杜鲁！

english: Well, then I suppose there's no harm in telling you. There is a sacred pool, right at the centre of the Kharazi jungle.
translation: 好吧，那我告诉你也无妨。在卡拉兹丛林的正中央有一个圣池。

english: The water contains special properties, but they will only be retained if it's stored in a blessed vessel made from the metal of the sun. It's no easy task, but I'm sure an adventurer like you could manage it.
translation: 那水有特殊性质，但只有储存在太阳金属制成的祝福容器中才能保持效力。这可不是件容易的事，但我相信像你这样的冒险者能办到。

english: Metal of the sun... what is that?
translation: 太阳金属……那是什么？

english: It is a bright and precious metal, much sought after, but uncommonly found. It is the same bright colour as the sun, and yet its light never fades. A blessed vessel made of this metal protects the purity of the water.
translation: 那是一种明亮而珍贵的金属，备受追捧，但十分稀有。它的颜色和太阳一样明亮，而且光芒永不褪色。用这种金属制成的祝福容器能保护水的纯净。

english: Where can I find this metal?
translation: 我在哪里能找到这种金属？

english: By mining it, of course!
translation: 当然是靠采矿了！

english: But be careful. This metal can influence people in strange ways. Fall under its power, and you will think of nothing else for the rest of your days, no matter how much of it you find.
translation: 但要小心。这种金属会以奇怪的方式影响人。一旦被它的力量控制，无论你找到多少，余生都会心无旁骛。

english: That's why we only use it to create blessed vessels for the sacred water.
translation: 这就是为什么我们只用它来制作盛放圣水的祝福容器。

english: What kind of a vessel?
translation: 什么样的容器？

english: A bowl would hold plenty of water. However, it must be made from the metal of the sun, and it must be blessed.
translation: 一个碗就能盛很多水。不过，它必须由太阳金属制成，而且必须经过祝福。

english: Here, this is what the vessel should look like... I hope that helps.
translation: 给，这就是容器应该的样子……希望这对你有帮助。

english: Similar to the one in the picture I have already given you.
translation: 和我已经给你的那张图里的差不多。

english: How do I bless the vessel?
translation: 我该怎么祝福这个容器？

english: When you have made the vessel, bring it to me. I will help but you need to ensure that you are devout and have faith. Your Prayer will be thoroughly tested.
translation: 等你做好容器，把它带给我。我会帮忙，但你必须确保自己虔诚且怀有信仰。你的祈祷将受到彻底的考验。

english: Ungadulu called me 'Vacu'. What does that mean?
translation: 昂加杜鲁叫我'瓦库'。那是什么意思？

english: It seems that Ungadulu has started to lose his senses. In the days of our forefathers, the 'Vacu' were shamans who could summon powerful, wise spirits.
translation: 看来昂加杜鲁开始失去理智了。在我们祖先的时代，'瓦库'是能够召唤强大智慧灵魂的萨满。

english: But they asked too much, and were enslaved by the spirits they sought to command.
translation: 但他们索取太多，最终被他们试图命令的灵魂所奴役。

english: How terrible...
translation: 太可怕了……

english: Indeed. Every Kharazi child knows not to mess with evil spirits. What has our shaman gotten himself into?
translation: 确实如此。每个卡拉兹孩子都知道不能招惹恶灵。我们的萨满到底卷进了什么事？

english: I have work to do Bwana, best of luck on your quest...
translation: 我有事要忙了，Bwana，祝你的任务好运……

english: Greetings, Bwana. Ah, I see you have the golden bowl! Would you like me to bless it for you?
translation: 你好，Bwana。啊，我看到你有了金碗！要我为你祝福它吗？

english: Bwana... your faith is not strong enough to bless this vessel.
translation: Bwana……你的信仰不够坚定，无法祝福这个容器。

english: Very well, Bwana...
translation: 好吧，Bwana……

english: Ohhhhhmmmmmm.
translation: 哦哦哦嗯嗯嗯嗯——

english: Oooooommmmmmmmmm
translation: 哦哦哦嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯——

english: Oooooohhhhmmmmmmmmmm
translation: 哦哦哦哦嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯——

english: Well done, Bwana! This is a fine vessel for the sacred water. Shall I show you how to bless it?
translation: 干得好，Bwana！这是盛放圣水的好容器。要我教你怎么祝福它吗？

english: No thanks, I'll wait.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我等等再说。

english: Very well, let me know when you want to try.
translation: 好吧，你想试的时候告诉我。

english: Sorry, but I don't need that, Bwana.
translation: 抱歉，我不需要那个，Bwana。

english: Go... go now...!
translation: 走……现在就走……！

english: Foolish Vacu... now thou shalt be my pawn.
translation: 愚蠢的瓦库……现在你将是我的棋子。

english: Foolish Vacu... come for me again and thou shalt taste more of my power!
translation: 愚蠢的瓦库……再来找我，你就尝尝我更多的力量！

english: Hmm, interesting.
translation: 嗯，有意思。

english: This will be a challenge.
translation: 这会是个挑战。

english: Easy does it...
translation: 慢慢来……

english: Easy as pie...
translation: 小菜一碟……

english: Hup!
translation: 嘿！

english: Urghhhhh!
translation: 呃啊啊啊！

english: Arghhhhhhh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！

english: Hnnnnnnnngh...!
translation: 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯……！

english: Shhhhhhhshshehshsh
translation: 嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘嘘

english: How goes your quest to release Ungadulu, Bwana?
translation: 你解救昂加杜鲁的任务进展如何，Bwana？

english: Ungadulu mumbled something about 'pure' water?
translation: 昂加杜鲁咕哝着什么'纯'水？

english: That sounds odd. Perhaps our shaman has lost his mind. My apologies, Bwana, it seems that I've sent you on a fool's errand. Unless...
translation: 听起来很奇怪。也许我们的萨满已经神志不清了。抱歉，Bwana，看来我让你白跑了一趟。除非……

english: We do have a sacred pool which contains pure water. I don't know why Ungadulu would need it, though. Maybe you should talk to him again and get more information.
translation: 我们确实有一个圣池，里面是纯水。不过我不知道昂加杜鲁为什么需要它。也许你应该再和他谈谈，获取更多信息。

english: I'll do that. Goodbye!
translation: 我会的。再见！

english: Farewell, Bwana, and good luck on your quest.
translation: 再见，Bwana，祝你任务好运。

english: Hmm... we have a pool of pure, sacred water nearby. I wonder if that's what Ungadulu meant?
translation: 嗯……我们附近有一个纯圣水池。我在想昂加杜鲁说的是不是这个？

english: Can we still get the people together?
translation: 我们还能把大家聚在一起吗？

english: I am sorry, Bwana. Without the totem pole, it isn't safe to gather together. The evil spirits could strike at any time...
translation: 抱歉，先生。没有图腾柱，聚在一起不安全。恶灵随时可能袭击……

english: Where is this sacred pool of yours?
translation: 你说的圣水池在哪里？

english: If Ungadulu has requested your help, I suppose I can tell you. It's in the centre of the Kharazi jungle.
translation: 既然昂加杜鲁请求你帮忙，我想我可以告诉你。它在卡拉兹丛林的中心。

english: But be careful! The water contains special properties which will only be retained if it's stored in a blessed vessel made from the metal of the sun.
translation: 但要小心！那水有特殊属性，只有用太阳金属制成的祝福容器盛装才能保持效力。

english: Don't you need to take some pure water down to the caves? If you haven't got the water yet, try getting some from the pool.
translation: 你不是需要带些纯净水去洞穴吗？如果还没拿到水，试试从水池里取一些。

english: I am sorry Bwana, but I have no adventuring experience to speak of. I would only get in your way...
translation: 抱歉，先生，但我没什么冒险经验可言。我只会碍你的事……

english: Thy faith will help you little here.
translation: 你的信仰在这里帮不了你多少。

english: Argh! It burns...!
translation: 啊！好烫……！

english: Ha ha ha... I shall return for thee when the time is right.
translation: 哈哈哈……时机成熟时我会回来找你的。

english: But I will leave thee with a taste of my power...
translation: 但我会让你尝尝我的力量……

english: Nezikchened:Ha ha ha ha ha!
translation: 内齐克切内德：哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: Hey! That's no way to treat a shaman.
translation: 嘿！怎么能这样对待一个萨满。

english: Bwana, you've saved me from the demon Nezikchened! How can I ever repay this favour?
translation: 先生，你把我从恶魔内齐克切内德手中救了出来！我该怎么报答这份恩情？

english: I need to collect some Yommi tree seeds for Gujuo.
translation: 我需要为古朱奥收集一些约米树种子。

english: Yommi tree seeds? To grow a new totem? Then Nezikchened's influence has spread further than I thought...
translation: 约米树种子？用来种新的图腾？那内齐克切内德的影响范围比我想象的还要广……

english: You should know that growing a Yommi tree is no simple task - but I'll help you as much as I can.
translation: 你要知道，种植约米树可不是件简单的事——但我会尽力帮你。

english: Here you are, take these with my gratitude. You'll need to soak them in sacred water to germinate them before planting them.
translation: 给你，带着我的感激收下这些。种植前，你需要把它们浸泡在圣水中催芽。

english: How do I grow the Yommi tree?
translation: 我该怎么种植约米树？

english: First you will need to soak the seeds in some sacred water. This will help them germinate and begin the growing process.
translation: 首先，你需要把种子浸泡在圣水里。这能帮助它们发芽并开始生长。

english: Next, you'll need to find a patch of fertile soil and plant the seeds.
translation: 接下来，你需要找一块肥沃的土壤，把种子种下去。

english: Yommi trees are magical, and grow very quickly. You'll need to water them often with more sacred water - there should be plenty in the spring.
translation: 约米树是魔法树，生长得非常快。你需要经常用更多的圣水浇灌——泉水里应该有很多。

english: What do you know about the sacred water?
translation: 关于圣水，你知道些什么？

english: The sacred water comes from a magical spring, the source of which lies deep underground.
translation: 圣水来自一处魔法泉眼，其源头深藏于地下。

english: Legend has it that the water is protected by spirits of long-dead adventurers who went in search of the spring's source. But you don't need to worry about that.
translation: 传说泉水由早已死去的冒险者的灵魂守护着，他们曾去寻找泉水的源头。但你不用担心这个。

english: Now that you have defeated the demon you can come and go as you please. I cast a spell on you which means that you can pass through the flames without harm.
translation: 既然你已经打败了恶魔，就可以自由来去了。我在你身上施了咒，这样你就能毫发无伤地穿过火焰。

english: I will remain here in the protection of the flaming octagram and continue my research into the spirit world. My recent experience has made me something of an authority on the subject!
translation: 我会留在这里，在火焰八角星的保护下继续研究灵魂世界。我最近的经历让我在这方面成了权威！

english: But do please visit me here if you have any problems with your Yommi tree. I remember carving my first totem... it's no easy feat!
translation: 不过，如果你的约米树有任何问题，请一定来这里找我。我记得我雕刻第一个图腾的时候……那可不是件容易的事！

english: Okay, thanks...
translation: 好的，谢谢……

english: It's the least I can do!
translation: 这是我应该做的！

english: How goes your quest to free Ungadulu?
translation: 你解救昂加杜鲁的任务进行得怎么样了？

english: Ungadulu is free! He was possessed by a demon and I killed it.
translation: 昂加杜鲁自由了！他被一个恶魔附身，我把它杀了。

english: A demon? You are truly brave, Bwana. Well done, and thank you for freeing our shaman.
translation: 恶魔？你真是勇敢，先生。干得好，谢谢你解放了我们的萨满。

english: I have the Yommi tree seeds.
translation: 我有约米树种子了。

english: That's great, Bwana. Now you just need to germinate the seeds and then plant them in some fertile soil. I'm sure that Ungadulu has explained all this to you already.
translation: 太好了，布瓦纳。现在你只需要让种子发芽，然后把它们种在肥沃的土壤里。我相信昂加杜鲁已经向你解释过这一切了。

english: If you have the Yommi tree seeds, you will need to germinate them.
translation: 如果你有约米树种子，就需要先催芽。

english: Place the seeds into pure water, and they will begin to sprout tiny shoots. You can then plant them in fertile soil.
translation: 把种子放进纯净水里，它们就会开始长出小芽。然后你就可以把它们种在肥沃的土壤里了。

english: Thank you for releasing Ungadulu! My fellow Kharazi and I feel much safer now that our shaman is back. Is the Yommi tree growing well?
translation: 谢谢你释放了昂加杜鲁！萨满回来了，我和其他卡拉兹人都觉得安全多了。约米树长得还好吗？

english: I have germinated the Yommi tree seeds.
translation: 我已经给约米树种子催芽了。

english: Well done, Bwana. Thanks to your hard work we'll soon have a new totem pole. Now you need to plant the seed in the fertile earth.
translation: 干得好，先生。多亏你的努力，我们很快就能有新的图腾柱了。现在你需要把种子种在肥沃的土地里。

english: Where can I find fertile soil?
translation: 我在哪里能找到肥沃的土壤？

english: There's lots of fertile ground in the Kharazi jungle. My people have marked the patches we've seen with old wood.
translation: 卡拉兹丛林里有很多肥沃的土壤。我的人民用旧木材标记了我们看到的土地。

english: If you find a rotten tree, or what looks like a rotten totem pole, it's probably on fertile soil.
translation: 如果你找到一棵腐烂的树，或者看起来像腐烂的图腾柱的东西，那很可能就在肥沃的土壤上。

english: You'll need to chop the markers down with a sharp Woodcutting axe.
translation: 你需要用一把锋利的伐木斧把这些标记砍倒。

english: I have visited Ungadulu in the caves. He's hard at work studying, but he looks well! Have you grown the Yommi tree yet?
translation: 我去洞穴里拜访了昂加杜鲁。他正在努力研究，看起来气色不错！你种出约米树了吗？

english: The water pool has dried up, but I need more pure water.
translation: 水池干涸了，但我还需要更多纯净水。

english: This is indeed a bad omen, Bwana. I've never known the sacred pool to dry up before...
translation: 这确实是个不祥之兆，先生。我以前从没见过圣水池干涸……

english: Does the Yommi tree have to have pure water?
translation: 约米树一定要用纯净水吗？

english: Of course! It is a magical tree and can only survive on the water from the sacred pool.
translation: 当然！它是魔法树，只能靠圣水池的水存活。

english: Where's the source of the pure water?
translation: 纯净水的源头在哪里？

english: Oh, Bwana, it is a terrible place. Be thankful you don't have to go there.
translation: 哦，先生，那是个可怕的地方。庆幸你不用去那里。

english: Bwana, you cannot be thinking of travelling to the source!
translation: 先生，你该不会是想去源头吧！

english: But I suppose we have no choice...
translation: 但我想我们别无选择……

english: Deep in the caves where you found Ungadulu is a terrible place, guarded by the angry spirits of the undead.
translation: 在你找到昂加杜鲁的那个洞穴深处，有个可怕的地方，由愤怒的不死灵魂守卫着。

english: The legends say they died trying to find the source of the sacred water, and now they are cursed to guard it for all eternity.
translation: 传说他们是在试图寻找圣水源头时死去的，现在他们被诅咒永远守护着它。

english: The first to die was a powerful sorcerer, and his strange magic lingers in the cave. Now all who venture near are struck by terror, and cannot proceed.
translation: 第一个死去的是一位强大的巫师，他奇怪的魔法仍萦绕在洞穴中。现在所有靠近的人都会被恐惧击中，无法前进。

english: With all my heart, Bwana, nothing could convince me to go near such a place.
translation: 我真心实意地说，先生，没什么能说服我靠近那种地方。

english: Okay, I won't go...
translation: 好吧，我不去……

english: That's sensible of you, Bwana. It would be a waste of a perfectly fine life. We will just have to restore the totem some other way... or else leave our home forever...
translation: 你这么做很明智，先生。白白浪费一条好命可不值得。我们只能另想办法恢复图腾……否则就永远离开我们的家园……

english: If I looked for the source, could you help me?
translation: 如果我去寻找源头，你能帮我吗？

english: If you're determined to find the source, I will help as much as I can. First, you must overcome the curse of fear that blocks the cave.
translation: 如果你决心找到源头，我会尽力帮忙。首先，你必须克服阻挡洞穴的恐惧诅咒。

english: I know a potion that may help with that.
translation: 我知道一种药水可能对此有帮助。

english: You will need to find two herbs, Snake Weed and Ardrigal. Add them both to a Vial of Water, and you will feel braver than a lion!
translation: 你需要找到两种草药：蛇草和阿德里加草。把它们都加入一瓶水中，你就会感觉比狮子还勇敢！

english: Where can I find Snake Weed?
translation: 我在哪里能找到蛇草？

english: Snake Weed is usually found in swampy, marshy areas.
translation: 蛇草通常生长在沼泽、湿地地区。

english: There's some marsh to the south of Tai Bwo Wannai village - maybe you could check there? It likes to grow near jungle vines, so look carefully.
translation: 泰博瓦纳村南边有片沼泽——也许你可以去那里看看？它喜欢长在丛林藤蔓附近，所以要仔细找。

english: Where can I find Ardrigal?
translation: 我在哪里能找到阿德里加草？

english: Ardrigal is often found growing near large groups of palms. If you head east out of Tai Bwo Wannai village you should come across a big group of them.
translation: 阿德里加草通常生长在大片棕榈树附近。如果你从泰博瓦纳村往东走，应该会遇到一大片棕榈树。

english: The herb grows in the shade of the palm, so check carefully.
translation: 这种草药生长在棕榈树的树荫下，所以要仔细检查。

english: Will I really need this Potion? I'm already pretty brave.
translation: 我真的需要这种药水吗？我已经够勇敢了。

english: The caves are protected by a supernatural curse which would leave even the bravest adventurer a trembling wreck.
translation: 洞穴受到超自然诅咒的保护，即使是最勇敢的冒险者也会被吓得浑身发抖。

english: You must take the potion if you plan to journey there.
translation: 如果你打算去那里，就必须带上药水。

english: I searched the caves thoroughly and didn't find any sacred water...
translation: 我彻底搜索了洞穴，但没有找到任何圣水……

english: The source of the sacred water is a terribly dangerous place. Perhaps the elders have hidden the path, or buried it under rubble?
translation: 圣水的源头是个极其危险的地方。也许长老们把路藏起来了，或者埋在瓦砾下面了？

english: The Yommi tree died.
translation: 约米树死了。

english: Well, it requires pure, sacred water for it to grow. It is a very special tree...
translation: 嗯，它需要纯净的圣水才能生长。这是一种非常特别的树……

english: I have visited Ungadulu in the caves. He's hard at work studying, but he looks well! How is your quest going, Bwana?
translation: 我去洞穴里拜访了昂加杜鲁。他正在努力研究，看起来气色不错！你的任务进行得怎么样了，先生？

english: Where can I get more water for the Yommi tree?
translation: 我在哪里能给约米树弄到更多水？

english: If the pool of sacred water has dried up, there may be a way to get to the source of the spring. But it is said to be very, very dangerous.
translation: 如果圣水池干涸了，也许有办法到达泉水的源头。但据说那里非常非常危险。

english: Hello, Bwana! How is your Yommi tree doing?
translation: 你好，先生！你的约米树怎么样了？

english: I am on a quest to get more sacred water.
translation: 我正在寻找更多圣水。

english: Well, if it's sacred water you want, you'd do well to have a look around here.
translation: 嗯，如果你想要圣水，最好在这附近找找。

english: Long ago, the elders blocked off the entrance to the Viyeldi caves, somewhere in this same cave system. There's bound to be evidence of the entrance somewhere.
translation: 很久以前，长老们堵住了维耶尔迪洞穴的入口，就在这个洞穴系统的某处。入口的痕迹肯定还在某处。

english: Beware though - the caves are deeply cursed, and should you fall, your spirit will be trapped within the caves forever, sworn to protect their secret.
translation: 但要小心——洞穴深受诅咒，如果你倒下，你的灵魂将永远被困在洞穴中，发誓守护它们的秘密。

english: What do you know about the source of the sacred water?
translation: 关于圣水的源头，你知道些什么？

english: Many people have tried, and failed, to find it. My great-grandfather told me he once even saw an expedition of dwarves down there!
translation: 很多人尝试过，但都失败了。我的曾祖父告诉我，他甚至曾看到一队矮人探险队下去过！

english: Something terrible must have happened to them, because they never returned.
translation: 他们一定遭遇了可怕的事情，因为他们再也没有回来。

english: They say the spirits of those poor adventurers linger still, cursed to protect the water even in undeath...forever...
translation: 据说那些可怜冒险者的灵魂仍在徘徊，即使死后也被诅咒守护着水……永远……

english: I need more Yommi tree seeds.
translation: 我需要更多约米树种子。

english: You already have some Yommi tree seeds. Use those first and then come back to me if you need any more.
translation: 你已经有一些约米树种子了。先用那些，如果还需要更多再来找我。

english: Take better care of these, please. They're very rare.
translation: 请好好保管这些。它们非常稀有。

english: No! It's too scary!
translation: 不！太吓人了！

english: Something funny's going on in these caves... I wonder if the Kharazi can help me get past this?
translation: 这些洞穴里有点不对劲……不知道卡拉兹人能不能帮我解决这个问题？

english: Ahhhhhhhhhhhh!
Beware, adventurer. You are brave, but braver folk than you have fallen in pursuit of the sacred water.
translation: 小心，冒险者。你很勇敢，但比你更勇敢的人也在追寻圣水的过程中倒下了。

english: Perilous dangers do await thee, Tojalon, Senay and Devere make three. None hold malice but will test your might, pray you do not lose these fights.
translation: 危险在前方等待着你，托贾隆、塞奈和德维尔三人成行。他们并无恶意，但会考验你的力量，祈祷你莫要输掉这些战斗。

english: If, however, you win this day, take heart that see the spring you may.
translation: 然而，若你今日获胜，鼓起勇气，你或许就能见到泉水。

english: Through Dragon's eye will you gain new heart. Heed these words, else swiftly depart.
translation: 通过龙之眼，你将获得新的勇气。谨记此言，否则速速离去。

english: Adventurer, I am already deceased, and therefore impervious to your attacks. Still, I can tell when I'm not wanted...
translation: 冒险者，我已经死了，所以你的攻击对我无效。不过，我还是能看出自己不受欢迎……

english: Ahhhhhhhhhh!
Your destiny awaits, adventurer...
translation: 你的命运在等待，冒险者……

english: My duty is done. I hope the source brings you all that you hoped for...
translation: 我的职责已尽。希望源头能带给你所期望的一切……

english: May your aim be true, challenger.
translation: 愿你的目标精准，挑战者。

english: You have proved yourself worthy of this prize.
translation: 你已证明自己配得上这份奖赏。

english: Your aim was true, challenger.
translation: 你的目标很精准，挑战者。

english: You have bested me. Go forth, and discover the source.
translation: 你打败了我。去吧，去发现源头。

english: Ready your weapon and defend yourself.
translation: 准备好你的武器，保护自己。

english: I am humbled by your honourable deeds.
translation: 你的高尚行为让我感到谦卑。

english: You fought well, adventurer.
translation: 你战斗得很好，冒险者。

english: Who disturbs the rocks of Zekin?
translation: 谁在打扰泽金的岩石？

english: Er... me?
translation: 呃……是我？

english: So, you desire the sacred water that flows here?
translation: 那么，你想要这里流淌的圣水？

english: Yes, I need it for my quest.
translation: 是的，我的任务需要它。

english: The water babbles so loudly and I am already so tortured. I cannot abide the sound, so I have stoppered the streams. Care you not for my torment and pain?
translation: 水声潺潺，我已经备受折磨。我无法忍受这声音，所以堵住了溪流。你难道不关心我的痛苦吗？

english: Not really, I just wondered if I could push that big rock.
translation: 并不关心，我只是想知道能不能推开那块大石头。

english: The rock must remain! I placed it there to stop the sound of the water's babbling. The noise troubles my soul and I seek a little rest... rest from this terrible torture...
translation: 石头必须留着！我把它放在那里是为了阻止水声。那噪音困扰着我的灵魂，我只想寻求一点安宁……从这可怕的折磨中解脱……

english: Why are you tortured?
translation: 你为什么受折磨？

english: I was robbed of my life by a cruel man named Viyeldi. For centuries I have searched for him, so I might enact my vengeance.
translation: 我被一个叫维耶尔迪的残忍之人夺去了生命。几个世纪以来我一直在寻找他，以便实施我的复仇术。

english: But, oh! Tragedy of tragedies, while searching for the source of the sacred water, his spirit became trapped! Now he is neither living nor dead, and I will never be released from my torment.
translation: 但是，哦！悲剧中的悲剧，在寻找圣水源头的过程中，他的灵魂被困住了！现在他既非生也非死，我将永远无法从折磨中解脱。

english: What can I do about that?
translation: 我能做些什么？

english: I was brutally murdered by a vicious man called Viyeldi. I sense his presence nearby.
translation: 我被一个叫维耶尔迪的恶毒之人残忍杀害。我感觉到他就在附近。

english: My spirit burns with the need for revenge. While that fiend yet lives, I cannot rest. If you seek the sacred water, you must ensure he meets his end.
translation: 我的灵魂因复仇的渴望而燃烧。只要那个恶魔还活着，我就无法安息。如果你想要圣水，就必须确保他灭亡。

english: If you refuse, then I swear, the sacred water shall never flow again! Will you put an end to Viyeldi for me?
translation: 如果你拒绝，那我发誓，圣水将永远不再流淌！你愿意为我终结维耶尔迪吗？

english: I'll do what I must to get the water.
translation: 为了得到水，我会做必须做的事。

english: Destroy Viyeldi, and the sacred water is yours. But beware, for this is no simple task.
translation: 摧毁维耶尔迪，圣水就是你的了。但小心，这可不是简单的任务。

english: I will furnish you with a weapon which will destroy Viyeldi for good. Here, take this.
translation: 我会给你一件武器，它能彻底摧毁维耶尔迪。拿着这个。

english: To complete your task you must use this weapon on Viyeldi.
translation: 要完成任务，你必须用这件武器攻击维耶尔迪。

english: Use this dagger to slay the fiendish Viyeldi, and bring it back to me once he is dead... for good, this time.
translation: 用这把匕首杀死邪恶的维耶尔迪，等他死后——这次是彻底死亡——把匕首带回来给我。

english: You've made the right decision. Soon, the sacred water will be yours. Bring the dagger back to me when you have completed your task.
translation: 你做了正确的决定。很快，圣水就是你的了。完成任务后把匕首带回来给我。

english: I've changed my mind, I can't do it.
translation: 我改变主意了，我做不到。

english: That's your decision. Are you sure you don't need the sacred water, though? Deny me, and it will forever be out of your reach...
translation: 那是你的决定。不过，你确定不需要圣水吗？拒绝我，它将永远遥不可及……

english: No, I won't take someone's life for you.
translation: 不，我不会为你夺走别人的性命。

english: A noble sentiment, but Viyeldi is not alive! He is merely a vessel for the sacred water's power.
translation: 高尚的想法，但维耶尔迪并非活人！他只是圣水力量的容器。

english: If that is your decision then so be it, but I cannot allow access to the stream until Viyeldi is dead.
translation: 如果你这么决定，那好吧，但在维耶尔迪死之前，我不能让你接近溪流。

english: Can't I just get some water?
translation: 我就不能直接取点水吗？

english: First, you must help me. Revenge is the only thing that keeps my spirit in this place.
translation: 首先，你必须帮我。复仇是唯一让我的灵魂留在此处的东西。

english: Help me take vengeance on Viyeldi and I will gladly remove the rocks and allow you access to the water. What say you, adventurer?
translation: 帮我向维耶尔迪复仇，我就很乐意移开岩石，让你取水。你觉得怎么样，冒险者？

english: Who's asking?
translation: 谁在问？

english: I am Echned Zekin, and I seek peace from my eternal torture...
translation: 我是埃克内德.泽金，我寻求从永恒的折磨中解脱……

english: I am long since dead and buried, lost in the passages of time. My kin have departed and I am forgotten by all who knew me... so it is unlikely that you were one of them. I am but a poor tortured soul, trying to get
translation: 我早已死去并被埋葬，迷失在时间的流逝中。我的亲人都已离去，所有认识我的人都忘记了我……所以你不太可能是他们中的一员。我只是一个可怜的、被折磨的灵魂，试图得到

english: some rest...
translation: 一些安宁……

english: Why do you return when your task is still incomplete?
translation: 任务还没完成，你怎么回来了？

english: Who am I supposed to kill again?
translation: 我要杀的人是谁来着？

english: I seek revenge on Viyeldi, the cruel fiend who slew me centuries ago.
translation: 我要向维耶尔迪复仇，那个几个世纪前杀死我的残忍恶魔。

english: I sense he is nearby. Kill him, and I will grant you access to the sacred water.
translation: 我感觉到他就在附近。杀了他，我就让你取圣水。

english: Er, I've had second thoughts.
translation: 呃，我改变主意了。

english: It is too late for second thoughts... do as you promised and return to me, with haste! Viyeldi's presence torments me so...
translation: 改变主意已经太晚了……照你承诺的去做，然后赶紧回来见我！维耶尔迪的存在让我备受折磨……

english: I have to be going...
translation: 我得走了……

english: Return the dagger to me when your task is complete.
translation: 任务完成后把匕首还给我。

english: So, you have fallen for the foul one's trick...
translation: 这么说，你中了那个邪恶家伙的诡计……

english: Alas! Alas!
translation: 哎呀！哎呀！

english: Does this mean you do not wish to help me take vengeance on Viyeldi?
translation: 这是否意味着你不想帮我向维耶尔迪复仇？

english: Here, take the dagger back.
translation: 给，把匕首拿回去。

english: Very well, I respect your decision - but I cannot allow you to access the sacred water while my tormentor lives.
translation: 很好，我尊重你的决定——但只要我的折磨者还活着，我就不能让你取圣水。

english: No, I'll complete the task.
translation: 不，我会完成任务。

english: Very well, return to me when it is done.
translation: 很好，完成后回来见我。

english: I have found the source of the sacred water!
translation: 我找到了圣水的源头！

english: That's great, Bwana! But please, be careful...
translation: 太好了，主人！但请小心……

english: Do you know anything more about the caves?
translation: 你对洞穴还有什么了解吗？

english: I have told you everything I know, Bwana.
translation: 我知道的都告诉你了，主人。

english: Do you know the name 'Viyeldi'?
translation: 你知道“维耶尔迪”这个名字吗？

english: It seems familiar. Maybe I heard it from the Elders...?
translation: 听起来有点耳熟。也许我从长老们那里听过？

english: Of course! Viyeldi was the name of the sorcerer who first went in search of the sacred water's source.
translation: 当然！维耶尔迪是第一个去寻找圣水源头的魔法师的名字。

english: Have you encountered his spirit? Be careful, Bwana... he must be very powerful.
translation: 你遇到他的灵魂了吗？小心，主人……他一定非常强大。

english: Ouch! The mosquitoes are biting! I'm going for a swim...
translation: 哎哟！蚊子咬人！我要去游个泳……

english: Can you remind me where the source of the sacred water is?
translation: 你能提醒我圣水的源头在哪里吗？

english: Deeper in the caves where you found Ungadulu is a terrible place, guarded by the angry spirits of the undead.
translation: 在你找到昂加杜鲁的洞穴更深处，有一个可怕的地方，由愤怒的不死灵魂守卫着。

english: I've forgotten how I got to the sacred water.
translation: 我忘了怎么去圣水那里了。

english: The path must be well hidden. You should take another look around the cave where you found Ungadulu. The entrance is most certainly there somewhere!
translation: 那条路一定隐藏得很好。你应该再去你找到昂加杜鲁的那个洞穴周围看看。入口肯定就在那里某个地方！

english: Hello, Bwana. How goes your search for the sacred water?
translation: 你好，先生。你寻找圣水进行得怎么样了？

english: I have killed Viyeldi!
translation: 我杀了维耶尔迪！

english: Why would you do that?!
translation: 你为什么要这么做？！

english: A spirit called Echned Zekin said I had to avenge his spirit by killing Viyeldi if I wanted him to unblock the sacred spring.
translation: 一个叫埃克内德.泽金的灵魂说，如果我想要他疏通圣泉，就必须杀死维耶尔迪来为他的灵魂复仇。

english: Bwana, I'm afraid this spirit has tricked you! Viyeldi was the spirit of a powerful sorcerer, who controlled the spirits of those bound to the sacred water.
translation: 主人，恐怕这个灵魂骗了你！维耶尔迪是一位强大巫师的灵魂，他控制着那些与圣水绑定的灵魂。

english: If he is truly dead, then those spirits are now free to be controlled by other, far worse forces - that lying spirit is probably one of them.
translation: 如果他真的死了，那些灵魂现在就可以被其他更糟糕的力量控制——那个说谎的灵魂可能就是其中之一。

english: I met a spirit in the Viyeldi Caves.
translation: 我在维耶尔迪洞穴里遇到了一个灵魂。

english: You did well to come to me, Bwana. As I said before, I am an expert in these matters.
translation: 你来找我做得好，主人。正如我之前所说，我是这方面的专家。

english: Spirits are tricky creatures. In most circumstances you should just ignore them - but be especially wary if they ask you for favours. They may be trying to trick you...
translation: 灵魂是狡猾的生物。大多数情况下你应该忽略它们——但如果它们请你帮忙，要特别小心。它们可能想骗你……

english: The spirit told me to kill Viyeldi!
translation: 那个灵魂让我杀了维耶尔迪！

english: Goodness! That sounds like a fiendish spirit indeed. You're better off banishing it - I have a spell that will do the trick.
translation: 天哪！那听起来确实是个邪恶的灵魂。你最好驱逐它——我有一个法术可以做到。

english: But I need an item that belongs to the spirit to make it work.
translation: 但我需要一件属于那个灵魂的物品才能施法。

english: If you have something like that, please show it to me.
translation: 如果你有类似的东西，请给我看看。

english: Do you know anything about daggers?
translation: 你知道关于匕首的事吗？

english: I know some things about them - especially the magical kind. Do you have one of those?
translation: 我知道一些关于它们的事——尤其是魔法匕首。你有那样的东西吗？

english: This dagger has been made for one purpose only... thank goodness you brought it to me.
translation: 这把匕首只有一个用途……谢天谢地你把它带给了我。

english: Now we can turn the tables! I can make you a spell with this item which will force the spirit to reveal its true self. Once activated, you will be able to attack it like any normal creature.
translation: 现在我们可以扭转局面了！我可以利用这件物品制作一个法术，迫使灵魂显露出真面目。一旦激活，你就可以像攻击普通生物一样攻击它。

english: Use this spell on the spirit. It will force it to show its true self and make it vulnerable to attack.
translation: 对那个灵魂使用这个法术。它会迫使它显露出真面目，并使其容易受到攻击。

english: You seem filled with determination. Have you slain Viyeldi? Give me the dagger, quickly!
translation: 你看起来充满决心。你杀了维耶尔迪吗？把匕首给我，快！

english: I don't have the dagger.
translation: 我没有匕首。

english: Bring it to me with all haste, or feel my wrath!
translation: 赶紧把它带来给我，否则就承受我的怒火！

english: I haven't killed Viyeldi yet.
translation: 我还没杀维耶尔迪。

english: Go now and slay him, as you agreed. Unless you'd like me to take vengeance on you, instead?
translation: 现在就去杀了他，就像你答应的那样。除非你想让我转而向你复仇？

english: I have something else in mind!
translation: 我有别的打算！

english: Worthless Vacu! How dare you lie to me! Go and slay Viyeldi, as you promised, or I will lay upon you all the pain and torment I have endured these long years!
translation: 无用的瓦库！你竟敢骗我！去杀了维耶尔迪，就像你承诺的那样，否则我会让你承受我这些年来忍受的所有痛苦和折磨！

english: What's this we have here?
translation: 我们这里有什么？

english: Perish, Vacu!
translation: 去死吧，瓦库！

english: Aha, I see you have completed your task. I'll take that dagger from you now.
translation: 啊哈，看来你完成了任务。现在把匕首给我。

english: Ahhhhh, yes... I feel my power returning. Now, to deal with thee...
translation: 啊——是的……我感觉力量在恢复。现在，该对付你了……

english: Foolish Vacu! Thou hast fallen for my tricks...
translation: 愚蠢的瓦库！你中了我的诡计……

english: Now, look upon my true face... and know thy doom!
translation: 现在，看看我的真面目……然后知道你的末日！

english: Ha, ha, ha... feel my power!
translation: 哈，哈，哈……感受我的力量吧！

english: Argh! Foul Vacu!
translation: 呃啊！可恶的瓦库！

english: Still thou seekst to challenge me?!
translation: 你竟还敢挑战我？！

english: This isn't over, Vacu.
translation: 这事还没完，瓦库。

english: Blessings upon you Bwana. Did you use the spell I gave you to deal with the spirit? And did you find the sacred water?
translation: 愿神保佑你，布瓦纳。你用了我的咒语对付那个灵魂吗？还有，你找到圣水了吗？

english: Yes, I've killed the spirit.
translation: 是的，我已经杀了那个灵魂。

english: Well, actually, it wasn't a spirit at all - it was Nezikchened!
translation: 嗯，其实，那根本不是灵魂——那是内齐克切内德！

english: Nezikchened returned? And you defeated him a second time? You truly are a legend, Bwana.
translation: 内齐克切内德回来了？而你再次击败了他？你真是个传奇，布瓦纳。

english: Did you find the source of the sacred water, too?
translation: 你也找到圣水的源头了吗？

english: Yes, I've got the water.
translation: 是的，我拿到水了。

english: That's wonderful, Bwana. Well done!
translation: 太好了，布瓦纳。干得好！

english: Well, you should be able to plant the Yommi tree and keep it alive by watering it with the sacred water. After that, you can carve your totem pole!
translation: 那么，你应该可以种下约米树，并用圣水浇灌它来维持生命。之后，你就可以雕刻你的图腾柱了！

english: Let us hope we've seen the last of Nezikchened... who knows what he might try next?
translation: 希望我们再也见不到内齐克切内德了……谁知道他下一步会搞什么鬼？

english: Bwana! You're alive! I'm pleased to see you.
translation: 布瓦纳！你还活着！真高兴见到你。

english: Something feels different about the jungle... I suspect it's down to your good deeds.
translation: 我感觉丛林有些不一样了……我猜这归功于你的善行。

english: I found the source of the spring and I got some sacred water.
translation: 我找到了泉水的源头，还取了一些圣水。

english: You are truly a brave warrior, Bwana. Now your Yommi tree can grow to be just as strong as you are - and we'll have a new totem pole in no time.
translation: 你真是个勇敢的战士，布瓦纳。现在你的约米树会长得和你一样强壮——我们很快就能有一根新的图腾柱了。

english: I defeated the demon - for good this time!
translation: 我击败了那个恶魔——这次是永绝后患！

english: Can it be true? My people and I have noticed a difference in the jungle. The trees seem to sing again, the air tastes fresh and cool... and we have you to thank.
translation: 这是真的吗？我和我的人民都注意到丛林的变化。树木仿佛再次歌唱，空气清新凉爽……这一切都要感谢你。

english: How do I make the totem pole?
translation: 我该怎么做图腾柱？

english: First, your Yommi tree must be fully grown. Then, you must chop it down - quickly, before it rots!
translation: 首先，你的约米树必须完全长成。然后，你必须砍倒它——要快，在它腐烂之前！

english: Once you have felled the tree, trim the branches.
translation: 一旦你砍倒了树，就修剪树枝。

english: Finally, you can craft a new totem pole from the bare trunk.
translation: 最后，你可以用光秃秃的树干制作一根新的图腾柱。

english: You'll need a very sharp, very tough axe for all of this.
translation: 做这些事你需要一把非常锋利、非常结实的斧头。

english: But when you're done, you can replace one of the rotten totem poles, and the Kharazi will be forever in your debt!
translation: 但完成后，你就可以替换掉一根腐朽的图腾柱，卡拉兹人将永远感激你！

english: I must check in on my people... these are dangerous times.
translation: 我得去看看我的人民……现在是非常时期。

english: I've made the totem pole, now what do I do with it?
translation: 我已经做好了图腾柱，现在该拿它怎么办？

english: Well Bwana, that's a very interesting piece of work! Not bad at all.
translation: 嗯，布瓦纳，这真是件有趣的作品！相当不错。

english: Now we need to replace an existing corrupted totem pole with your newly constructed one. You should be able to find totems within the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 现在我们需要用你新做的图腾柱替换掉一根现有的腐朽图腾柱。你应该能在卡拉兹丛林里找到那些图腾。

english: Tales of your exploits are told throughout the jungle!
translation: 你的英勇事迹在整个丛林里传颂！

english: How goes your quest to grow the sacred Yommi tree?
translation: 你种植神圣约米树的任务进展如何？

english: I've already made the totem pole.
translation: 我已经做好图腾柱了。

english: That's great news, Bwana. Once you replace the corrupted one, our people will be able to gather together once more.
translation: 太好了，布瓦纳。一旦你替换掉那根腐朽的，我们的人民就能再次聚集在一起了。

english: I'm not sure what to do with the totem pole.
translation: 我不太清楚该拿这根图腾柱做什么。

english: Simply replace a corrupted totem pole with the one you've made. That should make any nearby spirits think twice about bothering my people!
translation: 只需用你做的图腾柱替换掉一根腐朽的。这应该能让附近的任何灵魂在骚扰我的人民之前三思！

english: And now thou seekst to defile my sanctuary...
translation: 而现在，你竟敢玷污我的圣所……

english: I will teach thee a final lesson!
translation: 我要给你上最后一课！

english: Protectors of the sacred water, ye alive in death,
translation: 圣水的守护者们，你们虽死犹生，

english: do not rest while this Vacu draws breath!
translation: 只要这个瓦库还活着，就不得安息！

english: I beg you... slay the beast! Free me from this torment!
translation: 我求你们……杀了这野兽！让我从这折磨中解脱！

english: Doomed! Doomed to eternal torment...
translation: 完了！注定要受永恒的折磨……

english: Forever will I languish in torment...
translation: 我将永远在折磨中受苦……

english: ...until the beast is slain!
translation: ……直到那野兽被杀死！

english: Graaaaargh!
translation: 嘎啊啊啊！

english: I'll kill thee myself!
translation: 我要亲手杀了你！

english: Noooooooooo...
To be beaten by a mere mortal...
translation: 竟被一个凡人所败……

english: I will have... my... revenge...
translation: 我……会……报仇的……

english: Yeah, yeah, whatever.
translation: 是是是，随便啦。

english: Heard it all before.
translation: 早就听腻了。

english: Greetings, Bwana! I can tell you've already placed the totem. The jungle feels alive again, and my people can finally gather without being bothered by evil spirits.
translation: 你好，布瓦纳！我看得出来你已经放置了图腾。丛林又恢复了生机，我的人民终于可以聚集在一起，不再受恶灵骚扰了。

english: You have done us a great service, Bwana.
translation: 你帮了我们一个大忙，布瓦纳。

english: Please accept this token of our friendship.
translation: 请接受这个我们友谊的信物。

english: Take this to your Legends' Guild - let them know that you are a friend of the Kharazi. And please, come back and visit us anytime.
translation: 把这个带去你的传奇公会——让他们知道你是卡拉兹的朋友。还有，请随时回来拜访我们。

english: I must go and hunt now, Bwana...
translation: 我现在得去打猎了，布瓦纳……

english: Good day, Bwana. The Kharazi Jungle is especially beautiful today, isn't it?
translation: 日安，布瓦纳。今天的卡拉兹丛林格外美丽，不是吗？

english: None at all! Everything is fine now, thanks to you.
translation: 完全没有！多亏了你，现在一切都好了。

english: Where are all your people?
translation: 你的人民都在哪里？

english: The evil spirits you vanquished have haunted this jungle for many years. It will take some time for my people to fully trust strangers - even strangers as famous as you!
translation: 你击败的那些恶灵在这片丛林中作祟多年。我的人民需要一些时间才能完全信任陌生人——即使是像你这样有名的陌生人！

english: Rest assured, you will always be a friend of the Kharazi.
translation: 请放心，你永远是卡拉兹的朋友。

english: I've lost the totem pole you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的图腾柱。

english: Lost it? That totem pole was a sign of our friendship, Bwana...
translation: 弄丢了？那根图腾柱是我们友谊的象征啊，布瓦纳……

english: Luckily, I made an extra one. Please be more careful with it this time.
translation: 幸好我多做了一个。这次请小心保管。

english: You have done well, Bwana, to have succeeded where so many others have failed. You are a true legend.
translation: 你做得很好，布瓦纳，在众多失败者中取得了成功。你是一个真正的传奇。

english: Well, it looks as if you have something interesting there. Let's have a look!
translation: 嗯，看来你带了什么有趣的东西。让我看看！

english: This is truly amazing...
translation: 这真是太惊人了……

english: This totem pole will take pride of place in the Legends' Guild, as a reminder of your quest. The legends of the future will surely be inspired by such a feat of craftsmanship.
translation: 这根图腾柱将安放在传奇公会最显眼的位置，作为你冒险的纪念。未来的传奇们一定会从这件工艺杰作中获得启发。

english: Well, you've completed the tasks I set you. That map of the Kharazi jungle will be very helpful for future expeditions.
translation: 嗯，你已经完成了我的任务。那张卡拉兹丛林的地图对未来的探险会很有帮助。

english: Congratulations, welcome to the Legends' Guild. Please, go through to the main Legends' Guild building, and I will join you shortly.
translation: 恭喜你，欢迎加入传奇公会。请前往传奇公会主楼，我稍后就到。

english: Congratulations, welcome to the Legends' Guild. Please, go through to the main Legends' Guild building and I will join you shortly.
translation: 恭喜你，欢迎加入传奇公会。请前往传奇公会主楼，我稍后就到。

english: Welcome to the Legends' Guild Main Hall. As you can see, the totem pole you brought us has pride of place. Every member of the Legends' Guild can see it as soon as they come through the doors, and they'll know that it
translation: 欢迎来到传奇公会主厅。如你所见，你带给我们的图腾柱被放在了显眼的位置。每个传奇公会的成员一进门就能看到它，他们会知道这是

english: was you who brought it back.
translation: 你把它带回来的。

english: Now that you're a fully-fledged member of the guild, I'd like to offer you some training. Shall we get started now?
translation: 既然你已经是公会的正式成员了，我想给你一些训练。我们现在就开始吗？

english: You can choose [four/three/two/one] skill[s] to increase your abilities in.
translation: 你可以选择[四/三/两/一]项技能来提升能力。

english: Right, that's all the training I can offer you. I hope you're happy with your new skills. Do feel free to explore the rest of the building.
translation: 好了，我能提供的训练就这些了。希望你对新技能感到满意。请随意探索大楼的其他地方。

english: No, I've got something else to do at the moment.
translation: 不了，我现在还有别的事要做。

english: Very well. Return when you are able, but don't leave it too long. You'll benefit considerably from this training.
translation: 好吧。等你准备好了再回来，但别拖太久。这次训练对你大有裨益。

english: Now, please excuse me for a while. I have other matters to attend to. Do feel free to explore the rest of the building.
translation: 现在请容我失陪一下，我还有其他事要处理。请随意探索大楼的其他地方。

english: So I hear theresa leprechaun around here who can show me the way to Zanaris?
translation: 我听说这附近有个小矮妖，能告诉我怎么去扎纳里斯城？

english: ...W-what? How did you..?
translation: ……什、什么？你怎么……？

english: No. You're wrong. Now go away.
translation: 不。你错了。现在给我走开。

english: Found that leprechaun yet?
translation: 找到那个小矮妖了吗？

english: Hahaha go away amateur! You're not worthy of joining our great group!
translation: 哈哈哈，走开吧菜鸟！你还不配加入我们伟大的团体！

english: Have you found the tree with the leprechaun yet?
translation: 你找到那棵有小矮妖的树了吗？

english: No, we've looked for ages but haven't... Hey! Wait a minute! How did you know about that?
translation: 不，我们找了很久都没找到……嘿！等等！你怎么知道那件事的？

english: ...You tricked me. I'm not talking to you anymore.
translation: ……你骗了我。我不想再跟你说话了。

english: Nay, ye be wantin' to ask Shamus if ye wants to knows about fairies. He be living up a tree somewhere near Draynor Village. Last I heard, he were wailin' about some biggun tryin' to chop his tree down!
translation: 不，你要是想知道关于精灵的事，得去问沙姆斯。他住在德雷诺村附近的一棵树上。我上次听说，他正嚷嚷着有个大家伙要砍他的树呢！

english: An' why would I not be here? Now that there be farming patches, there'll be folk needing a leprechaun to hold their stuff! So, do ye want to be using the store?
translation: 我为什么不能在这儿？既然有了农业用地，就会有人需要小矮妖帮他们保管东西！那么，你想用用仓库吗？

english: Nay, ye be wantin' to ask Shamus if ye wants to know about the Lost City. He be living up a tree somewhere near Draynor Village. Last I heard, he were wailin' about some biggun tryin' to chop his tree down!
translation: 不，你要是想知道关于失落之城的事，得去问沙姆斯。他住在德雷诺村附近的一棵树上。我上次听说，他正嚷嚷着有个大家伙要砍他的树呢！

english: We'll hold onto yer rake, yer seed dibber, yer spade, yer secateurs, yer waterin' can and yer trowel - but mind it's not one of them fancy trowels only achaeologists use!
translation: 我们可以帮你保管你的耙子、种植锥、铲子、修枝剪、水壶和泥铲——但注意，可不是那种只有考古学家用的花哨泥铲！

english: We'll take a few buckets off yer hands too, and even yer compost and yer supercompost. There's room in our shed for plenty of compost, so bring it on!
translation: 我们也可以收下你的一些桶，甚至你的堆肥和超级堆肥。我们的棚屋里能放很多堆肥，尽管拿来吧！

english: Also, if you hand me yer farming produce, I might be able to change it into banknotes.
translation: 另外，如果你把你的农产品交给我，我也许能把它们换成银行票据。

english: Ye must be dafter then ye look if ye likes luggin' yer tools everywhere ye goes!
translation: 你要是喜欢走到哪儿都拖着你的工具，那你肯定比看起来还傻！

english: Ah, 'tis a foine day to be suwe! Wewe yez wantin' me tostowe yew toows, ow maybe ye might be wantin' yew stuffback fwom me?
translation: 啊，今天真是个好日子！你是想让我帮你存工具，还是想从我这儿拿回你的东西？

english: Nay, I can't turn that into a banknote.
translation: 不，那个我可没法换成银行票据。

english: I want to find Zanaris.
translation: 我想找到扎纳里斯城。

english: Zanaris is it now? Well well well... Yer'll be needing to be going to that funny little shed out there in the swamp, so you will.
translation: 扎纳里斯城是吧？好好好……你得去沼泽里那个古怪的小棚屋，就是这样。

english: ...but... I thought... Zanaris was a city...?
translation: ……但是……我以为……扎纳里斯城是一座城市……？

english: Aye that it is!
translation: 没错，它确实是！

english: ...How does it fit in a shed then?
translation: ……那它怎么能装进一个棚屋里呢？

english: Ah yer stupid elephant! The city isn't IN the shed! The doorway to the shed is being a portal to Zanaris, so it is.
translation: 啊，你这头蠢大象！城市不在棚子里！棚子的门口是通往扎纳里斯城的传送门，就是这样。

english: So I just walk into the shed and end up in Zanaris then?
translation: 那么我只要走进棚子就会到扎纳里斯城？

english: Oh, was I fergetting to say? Yer need to be carrying a Dramenwood staff to be getting there! Otherwise Yer'll just be ending up in the shed.
translation: 哦，我是不是忘了说？你得拿着一根德拉门木法杖才能到那儿！否则你只会走进棚屋里。

english: So where would I get a staff?
translation: 那我上哪儿弄法杖去？

english: Dramenwood staffs are crafted from branches of the Dramen tree, so they are. I hear there's a Dramen tree over on the island of Entrana in a cave
translation: 德拉门木法杖是用德拉门树的树枝做的，就是这样。我听说恩特纳岛上的一个洞穴里有棵德拉门树，

english: or some such. There would probably be a good place for an elephant like yer to be starting looking I reckon.
translation: 或者类似的地方。我想那里对你这样的大象来说，应该是个不错的起点。

english: The monks are running a ship from Port Sarim to Entrana, I hear too. Now leave me alone yer elephant!
translation: 我还听说僧侣们有船从沙林港开到恩特纳岛。现在别烦我了，你这头大象！

english: I've been in that shed. I didn't see a city.
translation: 我去过那个棚屋了。我没看到什么城市。

english: Ha! Look at yer! Look at the stupid elephant who tries to go catching a leprechaun when he don't even be knowing what he wants!
translation: 哈！看看你！看看这头笨大象，连自己想要什么都不知道就想抓小矮妖！

english: How do I get to Zanaris again?
translation: 我怎么才能再去扎纳里斯城？

english: Yer stupid elephant! I'll tell yer again! Yer need to be entering the shed in the middle of the swamp while holding a dramenwood staff! Yer can make the Dramen staff
