translation: 你这头笨大象！我再告诉你一次！你得拿着一根德拉门木法杖走进沼泽中央的棚屋！你可以用德拉门树枝做德拉门法杖，

english: from a dramen tree branch, and there's a Dramen tree on Entrana! Now leave me alone yer great elephant!
translation: 用德拉门树的树枝，恩特纳岛上有一棵德拉门树！现在别烦我了，你这头大象！

english: Hahaha you're such an amateur! Go away and play with some cabbage amateur!
translation: 哈哈哈，你真是个菜鸟！走开去玩你的卷心菜吧，菜鸟！

english: so our prayers seem to have less effect down there. Oh, also, you won't be able to come back this way -  This ladder only goes one way!
translation: 所以我们的祈祷在那下面效果似乎没那么好。哦，还有，你没法从这条路回来了——这个梯子只能单向通行！

english: Don't talk to me outerlander! I don't have time for the likes of you!
translation: 别跟我说话，外地人！我没时间搭理你这种人！

english: Hey! Don't call me outerlander! I'm known as the mighty [Fremennik name]!
translation: 嘿！别叫我外地人！我可是人称强大的[Fremennik name]！

english: Can't say I've heard of you. So they let your sort into the clan nowadays? Wow. Things have really changed since I've been gone...
translation: 没听说过你。现在他们允许你这种人加入部族了？哇。我离开这么久，变化真大……

english: You don't look like a Fremennik yourself...
translation: 你自己看起来也不像弗里蒙尼克人……

english: Yes, I suppose that's true... I have been gone such a long time...
translation: 是的，我想确实如此……我离开太久了……

english: You've been away from these parts a while?
translation: 你离开这些地方有一阵子了？

english: Oh, you haven't heard of the infamous Lokar, scourge of the northern seas?
translation: 哦，你没听说过臭名昭著的洛卡尔，北海之灾吗？

english: Erm... no... That's you then, is it?
translation: 呃……没有……那就是你了，是吗？

english: Forgotten already? Tch! I have no regrets about why I left!
translation: 已经被遗忘了吗？切！我对自己离开的原因毫不后悔！

english: As a young man, I learnt that the Fremennik way of life was too slow for me...
translation: 年轻时，我认识到弗里蒙尼克的生活方式对我来说太慢了……

english: Oh, sure, every so often we got to go on big raiding parties, looting and pillaging the weaker islands around here for food and profit, but...
translation: 哦，当然，偶尔我们会参加大型掠夺队，洗劫周围较弱的岛屿，抢夺食物和财富，但是……

english: Well, after a while, that was all I looked forward to doing.
translation: 好吧，过了一阵子，那成了我唯一期待的事。

english: Growing crops, milking cows, catching and cooking food, the day to day activities of our life...
translation: 种植庄稼、挤牛奶、捕鱼和烹饪食物，我们日常生活的活动……

english: THEY'RE SO BORING!
translation: 太无聊了！

english: No, I knew what I wanted to do, and that was attack innocent people going about their daily business, steal all their money, then spend it on wine, women and song!
translation: 不，我知道自己想干什么，那就是攻击那些过着日常生活的无辜百姓，偷走他们所有的钱，然后花在美酒、女人和歌声上！

english: Oh.... Kaaaaay....
translation: 哦……好吧……

english: So I ran away from Rellekka to become a PIRATE! It's way more fun. Plus you get to see the world!
translation: 所以我从雷勒卡城逃出来，成了一名海盗！这有趣多了。而且还能看看世界！

english: Was the world good then? Only, you seem to have returned to Rellekka after all.
translation: 那世界还不错吗？毕竟你似乎还是回到了雷勒卡城。

english: Yes, I have returned here, but that's only because we're short on supplies.
translation: 是的，我回来了，但那只是因为我们的补给品短缺。

english: I see. So where are you and your scurvy sea-dogs headed to next? Arrr shiver-me timbers!
translation: 明白了。那你和你那群坏血的海狗们接下来打算去哪儿？啊啊，摇我的船骨！

english: You're trying my patience...
translation: 你在挑战我的耐心……

english: Sorry, got caught up in the moment.
translation: 抱歉，一时激动。

english: Indeed. Well, the rest of the group are at Lunar Isle at the moment. It's where the Moon Clan live.
translation: 确实。嗯，其他同伴现在在月亮岛。那是月亮氏族居住的地方。

english: The Moon Clan... I think I've heard of them...
translation: 月亮氏族……我好像听说过他们……

english: I'd be surprised if you hadn't, they're the Fremenniks' most hated enemy!
translation: 你没听说过才怪，他们是弗里蒙尼克人最痛恨的敌人！

english: They've been at war with them for hundreds of years!
translation: 他们之间已经打了数百年仗了！

english: Hmmm. Actually, that might be a problem for you then.
translation: 嗯。实际上，那对你来说可能是个问题。

english: A problem?
translation: 一个问题？

english: Yeah, they're a really powerful race of mages. They'd read your mind and see that you're a Fremennik straight away, then probably turn you inside out and feed you to the birds.
translation: 是啊，他们是一个非常强大的魔法师种族。他们会读取你的思想，立刻发现你是弗瑞曼尼人，然后很可能把你里外翻个遍，拿去喂鸟。

english: Cosmic.
translation: 真厉害。

english: But you went there okay?
translation: 但你去那里没事？

english: Yeah, but I think the Fremenniks are a bunch of losers. They probably picked up on that.
translation: 是啊，但我觉得弗里蒙尼克人就是一群废物。他们大概察觉到了这点。

english: Look, I know a way you'll be able to travel there without, you know, getting killed and that, if you fancy a trip!
translation: 听着，我知道一个方法让你能去那里，而不会被杀之类的，如果你想来趟旅行的话！

english: Why not, I've always wondered what the state of my innards are!
translation: 为什么不呢？我一直想知道自己的内脏是什么状态！

english: Well, what you want to do is go and talk to Brundt the Chieftain and get a Seal of Passage from him.
translation: 嗯，你要做的就是去找酋长布伦特谈，从他那里弄到通行印章。

english: A Seal of Passage? What's that?
translation: 通行印章？那是什么？

english: Well, it shows that you're a diplomat for the Fremennik, so you'll have immunity from being killed and stuff.
translation: 嗯，它表明你是弗里蒙尼克的外交官，所以你会豁免被杀害之类的。

english: It's an ancient tradition not to attack anyone bearing a Seal of Passage, because they're probably on a diplomatic mission. Or well connected with powerful allies. Either way, killing them is usually a bad idea.
translation: 这是一种古老的传统，不得攻击任何持有通行印章的人，因为他们很可能在执行外交任务，或者与强大的盟友关系密切。不管怎样，杀了他们通常是个坏主意。

english: So I have to try and bring peace to two warring nations who have been fighting for centuries?!?!
translation: 所以我必须试着让两个打了几个世纪仗的交战国和平相处？！？！

english: What? I never said you had to bother trying to do that, you just have to pretend like you might.
translation: 什么？我可没说你得费心去做那件事，你只要假装可能会做就行。

english: No skin off my nose if those losers want to get slaughtered by the Moon Clan, just more stuff for me to loot when they're all dead.
translation: 那些废物要是被月亮氏族宰了，关我屁事，等他们死光了，我还能多捞点战利品。

english: Well I will try. I am the mighty [Fremennik name] after all!
translation: 好吧，我会试试的。毕竟我可是强大的[Fremennik name]！

english: Yes....
translation: 是啊……

english: So I just have to go talk to Brundt the Chieftain and tell him I want a Seal of Passage?
translation: 所以我只需要去找酋长布伦特谈，告诉他说我想要一枚通行印章？

english: That's it? Because in my experience simple tasks like that always seem to take longer than I expect...
translation: 就这样？因为以我的经验，这种简单的任务总是比我想象的要花更长时间……

english: Yeah, just go over and talk to the chief loser. You might have to tell him some rubbish he wants to hear, but that's it.
translation: 是啊，直接去找那个废物头子谈。你也许得说些他想听的废话，但仅此而已。

english: Come back here when you got it, my supplies are loaded and I'm good to head back to our ship.
translation: 拿到之后回来找我，我的补给品都装好了，我准备回我们船上了。

english: No thanks, I'd like to live.
translation: 不了谢谢，我还想活着。

english: Oh, so you're a loser like the rest of the Fremenniks then? See ya around, loser.
translation: 哦，那你就像其他弗里蒙尼克人一样是个废物喽？回头见，废物。

english: Hey there [Fremennik name]. So you get that seal thingy off of the Brundt the Chieftain yet?
translation: 嘿，[Fremennik name]。你从酋长布伦特那里拿到印章了吗？

english: No... Not yet...
translation: 还没……还没呢……

english: Well hurry it up, okay? I'm sick of this dump of a town, I want to go back to the ship!
translation: 那快点行吗？我受够这个垃圾小镇了，我要回船上去！

english: Yes, but you have no room to carry it. You should have thought of that before, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 是啊，但你身上没地方放。你之前就该想到这点，[Fremennik name]！

english: So you want another one?
translation: 所以你还想再要一个？

english: Well... I would if I had space to carry one.
translation: 嗯……如果我有地方放的话我当然想要。

english: Ah, [Fremennik name]. How goes the peace talks with the accursed Moon Clan?
translation: 啊，[Fremennik name]。和该死的月亮氏族的和谈怎么样了？

english: Oh, you know. Ongoing negotiations.
translation: 哦，你知道的。谈判进行中。

english: I see. Well, I don't hold out for much hope!
translation: 我明白了。好吧，我不抱太大希望！

english: I'm glad you're confident in my abilities.
translation: 很高兴你信任我的能力。

english: So you got that seal yet from Brundt the Chieftain? Can I leave this dump of a town?
translation: 所以你到底从酋长布伦特那里拿到印章没有？我能离开这个垃圾小镇了吗？

english: Uh... yeah... Well, Brundt the Chieftain gave me a seal, but I think I lost it somewhere along the way...
translation: 呃……是的……嗯，酋长布伦特给了我一个印章，但我想我在路上弄丢了……

english: What are you? Useless? Go get another one from Brundt the Chieftain, and hurry it up, I don't want to be here any longer than I have to be!
translation: 你算什么？废物吗？再去找酋长布伦特要一个，快点，我不想在这里多待一分钟！

english: Yup, I've got it right here!
translation: 没错，我拿在手里呢！

english: Great! Then let's head back to my ship! You ready to go now?
translation: 太好了！那我们回我的船吧！你现在准备好走了吗？

english: Arrr! Yar! Let's be on our way, yar!
translation: 啊！呀！我们出发吧，呀！

english: ...Why are you talking like that?
translation: ……你为什么那样说话？

english: Um... isn't that how pirates talk?
translation: 嗯……海盗不都是那样说话的吗？

english: Only the very stupid ones...
translation: 只有最蠢的才那样……

english: I suggest you DON'T talk like that to my crew. They will probably assume you are mocking them and kill you.
translation: 我建议你别这样跟我的船员说话。他们很可能会以为你在嘲笑他们，然后把你干掉。

english: So let's start again: Are you ready to go?
translation: 所以我们重新开始：你准备好走了吗？

english: Why yes! Tally-ho!
translation: 当然！好嘞！

english: I suppose that will have to do.
translation: 我想也只能这样了。

english: Here we are at the Pirates' Cove! You'll find the captain already on board.
translation: 我们到了海盗湾！你会发现船长已经在船上了。

english: Not just yet...
translation: 还没……

english: Well hurry it up okay? This place is a dump, and I'm a vicious blood-thirsty pirate, not your personal travel agent.
translation: 那快点行吗？这地方是个垃圾场，我是个凶残嗜血的海盗，又不是你的私人旅行代理。

english: Lokar, can you take me back to your ship?
translation: 洛卡尔，你能带我回你的船吗？

english: Sheesh, make your mind pal, I'm not a taxi service!
translation: 啧，想清楚再说啊伙计，我又不是出租车服务！

english: Sheesh, make your mind up pal, I'm not a taxi service!
translation: 啧，想清楚再说好吗，老兄，我又不是出租车！

english: Sheesh, make your mind up lady, I'm not a taxi service!
translation: 啧，想清楚再说好吗，女士，我又不是出租车！

english: Your skills are blatantly lacking. You need to go practice more!
translation: 你的技能明显不足。你需要多去练习！

english: You've experience yet to gain. Especially in keeping with the Fremenniks and their trials!
translation: 你还有经验要积累。尤其是在遵守弗瑞曼尼克的传统和考验方面！

english: Only people who've travelled on quests far from here can talk to me!
translation: 只有那些远行冒险过的人才能和我说话！

english: You're not a worthy enough adventurer to talk to me!
translation: 你不够资格和我说话！

english: I can tell straight away that you have many mysteries yet to unravel!
translation: 我一眼就能看出你还有很多谜团尚未解开！

english: What the..? Why'd you go and put it in a bank? You're gonna need it with you!
translation: 搞什么……？你干嘛把它存到银行里？你得随身带着它！

english: Well, yeah, I guess MAYBE YOU BETTER HAD, genius!
translation: 嗯，好吧，我想你最好还是带着吧，天才！

english: Seesh, make your mind up pal, I'm not a taxi service!
translation: 啧，想清楚再说好吗，老兄，我又不是出租车！

english: Afternoon.
translation: 下午好。

english: Hey, how you doing? You a stowaway?
translation: 嘿，你好吗？你是偷渡客吗？

english: (sigh) NO, I am NOT a stowaway...
translation: （叹气）不，我不是偷渡客……

english: And to be honest, I don't know why everybody seems to think I am...
translation: 老实说，我不知道为什么每个人都觉得我是……

english: Hey, I'm not here to judge you, if you're a stowaway you picked a good ship for it!
translation: 嘿，我不是来评判你的，如果你是偷渡客，那你可算挑对船了！

english: There's lots of convenient hiding places around here - I should know, whenever I'm in trouble with the Captain I find myself a good barrel to hide in, until the fuss dies down.
translation: 这附近有很多方便的藏身之处——我知道，每当我在船长面前惹麻烦，我就找个好桶躲进去，等风头过去。

english: You know, I've always wondered...
translation: 你知道吗，我一直很好奇……

english: What exactly is it that a 'cabin boy' actually does on a pirate ship anyway?
translation: 在海盗船上，“船舱侍童”到底是干什么的？

english: Mostly make coffee. Occasionally I have to swab the decks, but pirates aren't exactly known for cleanliness, you know?
translation: 大部分时间是煮咖啡。偶尔得擦甲板，但你知道海盗可不算以干净著称。

english: Hello. See anything good through your telescope there?
translation: 你好。通过你的望远镜看到什么好东西了吗？

english: Not really, just those creatures on the island. Don't worry, we sent some men out there to deal with them.
translation: 没什么，只是岛上那些生物。别担心，我们派了些人去处理它们。

english: The captain said we might have a barbecue out there later...
translation: 船长说我们晚点可能在岛上搞烧烤……

english: You seem unhappy about that... Wouldn't a barbecue on the beach be fun?
translation: 你好像不太高兴……在海滩上搞烧烤不是很好玩吗？

english: You obviously haven't met the cook yet...
translation: 你显然还没见过厨子……

english: Hey, how you doing?
translation: 嘿，你好吗？

english: It is customary when stowing away on a vessel to not introduce yourself to the Captains First Mate, oh foolish one.
translation: 在船上偷渡时，惯例是不向船长的大副自我介绍，哦，愚蠢的家伙。

english: Hey! I'm not a stowaway!
translation: 嘿！我不是偷渡客！

english: That Lokar guy invited me aboard...
translation: 是那个洛卡尔邀请我上船的……

english: I see. Well, don't distract me as I'm making preparations for departure.
translation: 明白了。嗯，我正在准备出发，别打扰我。

english: Try not to distract any of the crew either, Zamorak knows it's hard enough to get them to do any work around here without strangers wandering round the ship asking them inane questions.
translation: 也别打扰任何船员，扎莫拉克知道让这些人干活已经够难了，更别说还有陌生人在船上闲逛问一些无聊问题。

english: So... What are you doing?
translation: 那么……你在做什么？

english: Me? I'm the navigator. My job is to ensure the ship travels where it's supposed to go once it's moving by constantly checking our
translation: 我？我是领航员。我的工作是确保船在移动时能按照计划航线行驶，通过持续检查我们的

english: bearings against our plotted course, using charts and a sextant.
translation: 方位与计划航线是否一致，使用海图和六分仪。

english: People often think that we just sail off when we feel like it, but its actually far more complicated than that!
translation: 人们常常以为我们想出海就出海，但实际上比那复杂多了！

english: Why, when you think of just how much sea there is out there, ANYTHING could happen if there wasn't a competent navigator on board ensuring that we reach our destination safely and in the shortest possible time!
translation: 想想看，海那么大，要是船上没有一个称职的领航员确保我们安全、最快地到达目的地，什么事都可能发生！

english: Okay. So... What are you doing?
translation: 好吧。那么……你在做什么？

english: As I say, being a navigator is a real skill - you really have to think on your feet!
translation: 就像我说的，当领航员是门真本事——你得随机应变！

english: Yesiree, once we get sailing, it's all up to me to make sure we don't run into trouble or go off course!
translation: 没错，一旦我们起航，就全靠我来确保我们不会遇到麻烦或偏离航线！

english: Yep, as the rest of the crew basically stand around not doing much, I'll be the one in the cabin, comparing wind speeds, landmarks and charts with my sextant, making sure that we get to the destination on time, and on
translation: 是啊，当其他船员基本闲站着没事干时，我会在船舱里，用六分仪比较风速、地标和海图，确保我们准时、按计划到达目的地。

english: course!
translation: 按计划！

english: You could almost say that I'm the linchpin of the entire operation! Why, if it wasn't for me, the rest of the guys might be sailing for, oooh, hours, and be slightly off course and
translation: 你几乎可以说我是整个行动的关键！要不是我，其他人可能会航行……嗯，好几个小时，然后稍微偏离航线，

english: never even known it!
translation: 却浑然不知！

english: They might even be a few hours late for their destination! Or a few miles down the road from it!
translation: 他们甚至可能晚几个小时到达目的地！或者偏离目的地几英里！

english: And then where would they be?
translation: 那他们会在哪里？

english: A few hours late or a few miles down the road?
translation: 晚几个小时或者偏离几英里？

english: Great. So... What are you doing?
translation: 很好。那么……你在做什么？

english: Oh, just relaxing while I wait for the ship to cast off.
translation: 哦，只是在等船起航时放松一下。

english: When we're sailing I'll be very busy you know! I'm probably the single most important person on board when we're sailing!
translation: 航行时我会很忙的，你知道！航行时我可能是船上最重要的人！

english: Okay, OKAY!
translation: 好了，好了！

english: The galley ain't open fer food yet whipper-snapper, ye'll hafta come back later if'n ye be wanting food.
translation: 厨房还没开饭呢，小崽子，你要是想吃东西，得晚点再来。

english: Uh... something something open, something something food?
translation: 呃……什么什么开门，什么什么食物？

english: Aye, ter be sure, yer yella-bellied land-lizard!
translation: 啊，没错，你这胆小的旱地蜥蜴！

english: Aye-aye cap'n!
translation: 是，船长！

english: Hmmmm? I don't recognise you as one of my men, what are you doing aboard my ship?
translation: 嗯？我不认识你，你不是我的人，你在我船上做什么？

english: Stowaway! Stowaway! *Squark*
translation: 偷渡者！偷渡者！*呱*

english: Oh, Lokar offered me a journey. He said you could take me to the island of the Moon Clan.
translation: 哦，洛卡给了我一次旅程。他说你可以带我去月亮族人的岛。

english: Oh he DID, did he? (sigh) I sometimes regret ever allowing that vagabond to join the crew.
translation: 哦，他说的，是吗？（叹气）我有时真后悔让那个流浪汉加入船员。

english: He has a very bad work ethic, and I have to say his attitude can be very confrontational.
translation: 他工作态度很差，而且我得说他的态度非常挑衅。

english: Lokar's a loser! *Brakawk*!
translation: 洛卡是个失败者！*嘎嘎*！

english: So... You won't take me to Lunar Isle?
translation: 那么……你不带我去月亮岛？

english: Well now, I didn't say that.
translation: 嗯，我可没那么说。

english: We are returning there again soon anyway, as our last visit was most profitable.
translation: 反正我们很快又要回去那里，上次去收获颇丰。

english: In fact as soon as our boys are finished loading stocks we should be ready to depart!
translation: 事实上，等我们的人装完补给品，我们就可以出发了！

english: Now, as captain of this ship I feel I must play host, even if you aren't exactly a welcome guest, so was there anything you wished to know?
translation: 作为这艘船的船长，我觉得必须尽地主之谊，即使你算不上受欢迎的客人，所以你有什么想知道的吗？

english: So... What can you tell me about this 'Moon Clan'? It all seems very mysterious I must say...
translation: 那么……你能告诉我关于这个‘月亮族’的事吗？我得说，这一切看起来非常神秘……

english: The Moon Clan? Oh, very fine people. Very hospitable.
translation: 月亮族？哦，非常好的人。非常好客。

english: We had heard that they are very wary of strangers, and dislike people just showing up on their island, but when we sent a landing party aboard they all seemed more than happy to see us.
translation: 我们听说他们很警惕陌生人，不喜欢别人突然出现在他们的岛上，但当我们派登陆队上岸时，他们似乎都很高兴见到我们。

english: Well, they even threw a big festival in our honour!
translation: 嗯，他们甚至为我们举办了一场盛大的节日！

english: Anyway, they had a large supply of items that we felt we could use on the high seas, so we made a few trades with them, and were on our way.
translation: 总之，他们有一大批我们认为在公海上有用的物品，所以我们和他们做了几笔交易，然后就上路了。

english: What kinds of items?
translation: 什么样的物品？

english: Well, I'm not sure how much you've heard about them, but they are magical experts.
translation: 嗯，我不确定你听说过多少，但他们是魔法专家。

english: They sold us many rune-stones, as well as a few good luck charms and talismans and such to help us on our voyage.
translation: 他们卖给我们许多符文石，还有一些好运护符和护身符之类的东西，帮助我们航行。

english: Yes, they might have been a little secretive about that strange temple, and the old lodge of theirs in town, and I must say they certainly have the strangest house I have ever seen in my life in their little village, but it was
translation: 是的，他们可能对那个奇怪的寺庙和镇上他们那间旧小屋有点保密，而且我得说，他们小村庄里那栋房子是我这辈子见过最奇怪的，但总的来说，

english: a pleasant trip all round, and I look forward to trading there again in the future.
translation: 这是一次愉快的旅行，我期待将来再去那里交易。

english: After all, it's not everywhere that a pirate captain and his crew can rest ashore without having to worry about the authorities catching them, is it?
translation: 毕竟，不是每个地方都能让海盗船长和他的船员在岸上休息，而不用担心被当局抓住，对吧？

english: Fight the law! *Squawk*
translation: 对抗法律！*呱*

english: No, I guess it isn't.
translation: 不，我想不是。

english: Was there anything else you wished to ask me about while I'm not busy?
translation: 趁我不忙，你还有什么想问的吗？

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle anyway? I always thought pirates would be... You know. Out pirating.
translation: 你们在月亮岛到底做什么？我一直以为海盗会……你知道的。出去抢劫。

english: Well, obviously the actual pirating is a big part of our agenda, but we like to think of ourselves as non- regulated merchants.
translation: 嗯，显然真正的抢劫是我们议程的重要部分，但我们喜欢把自己看作不受监管的商人。

english: What good is plunder if you have nothing to spend it on, hmmmm?
translation: 如果掠夺物没地方花，那还有什么用，嗯？

english: Likewise, I am a forward thinking captain, and endeavour to invest much of my plunder back into the ship and its crew, so that we can be a better and more efficient force for theft upon the seas.
translation: 同样，我是一个有远见的船长，努力把大部分掠夺物投资回船和船员身上，这样我们就能成为海上更强大、更高效的盗窃力量。

english: So you went to Lunar Isle for supplies?
translation: 所以你们去月亮岛是为了补给品？

english: Well, obviously not initially. Obviously, our first thought was to show up, rob them blind, then take off again with the plunder spilling from our decks.
translation: 嗯，显然最初不是。显然，我们最初的想法是出现，把他们抢个精光，然后带着从甲板上溢出的掠夺物离开。

english: So what made you change your mind?
translation: 那是什么让你改变了主意？

english: Well, firstly there were the monsters.
translation: 嗯，首先是因为那些怪物。

english: M-monsters?
translation: 怪……怪物？

english: Oh yes, hundreds of the things. The island's swarming with them you know.
translation: 哦，是的，成百上千。你知道，岛上到处都是。

english: Dirty smelly beasts, as big as a wolf! Yes, you'd certainly better be either handy with a blade or quick on your toes if you wanted to spend much time outside of their village with those things around
translation: 肮脏发臭的野兽，和狼一样大！是的，如果你想在那些东西遍布的地方，在村子外面待久一点，你最好要么擅长用刀片，要么腿脚利索。

english: everywhere.
translation: 到处都是。

english: *Squawk* Run fer yer lives lads, it's a monster! *Squawk*
translation: *呱* 快跑保命吧伙计们，有怪物！*呱*

english: So you didn't attack the Moon Clan because you were worried you would yourself be attacked by these monsters trying to make your escape?
translation: 所以你们没有攻击月亮族，是因为担心在试图逃跑时会被这些怪物攻击？

english: Oh yes, absolutely. That and the next reason.
translation: 哦，是的，绝对。还有下一个原因。

english: The next reason?
translation: 下一个原因？

english: Yes, the next reason being that the Moon Clan are quite stupendously powerful magicians.
translation: 是的，下一个原因是月亮族是极其强大的魔法师。

english: You'll notice it as soon as you look at them, really quite, quite powerful indeed.
translation: 你一看到他们就会注意到，真的非常、非常强大。

english: As soon as we saw them we lost any thoughts about trying to attack or steal from them.
translation: 一看到他们，我们就打消了任何攻击或偷窃他们的念头。

english: Which as it turned out was lucky for us.
translation: 结果证明这对我们来说是幸运的。

english: Bunch of blooming loonies! *Brakawk*
translation: 一群该死的疯子！*嘎嘎*

english: It was?
translation: 是吗？

english: Oh yes. They can read minds, you see. If we'd shown up there thinking about robbing them they would have just killed us all on the spot.
translation: 哦，是的。他们会读心术，你看。如果我们带着抢劫的念头出现在那里，他们会当场杀了我们所有人。

english: I did mention that they are extraordinarily powerful magicians, didn't I?
translation: 我提过他们是极其强大的魔法师，对吧？

english: Yes, yes you did.
translation: 是的，你说过。

english: Ah, I'm glad I did. Because they really, really are. And mind-readers.
translation: 啊，很高兴我说过。因为他们真的、真的是。而且还会读心术。

english: Yes, all in all I'm glad we didn't try any funny business in the end after all.
translation: 是的，总的来说，我很高兴我们最后没有耍什么花招。

english: Plus there's that other good reason.
translation: 再加上另一个好理由。

english: That reason being?
translation: 那个理由是？

english: Well, when you are a crew of successful pirates, it becomes more and more difficult to ever moor somewhere and spend your loot.
translation: 嗯，当你是一群成功的海盗时，找个地方停泊并花掉你的战利品就变得越来越难了。

english: People are far too quick to call the guards on a troublemaker nowadays.
translation: 现在的人太容易因为捣乱者而叫守卫了。

english: So finding a village where people are more than happy to trade with you regardless of who you may have just stolen from and killed.
translation: 所以找到一个村子，那里的人非常乐意和你交易，不管你可能刚刚偷了谁、杀了谁。

english: I like that non-judgemental attitude of theirs!
translation: 我喜欢他们那种不评判的态度！

english: Anything else you wanted to know before we set sail?
translation: 在我们起航前，你还有什么想知道的吗？

english: I was hoping you could tell me a little bit about your ship. I must say, it's really very impressive.
translation: 我希望你能告诉我一些关于你的船的事。我得说，它真的非常令人印象深刻。

english: Ah, a connoisseur! Yes, she's named the Lady Zay, and may I say, is one of the finest ships to ever sail the seas!
translation: 啊，行家！是的，她叫‘扎伊女士号’，我可以说是航行在海上最好的船之一！

english: It was a steal from the Karamjan shipyards.
translation: 这是从卡玛詹造船厂偷来的。

english: And when I say it was a steal, I mean to say that myself and some of the lads broke in and stole it one night.
translation: 我说偷来的，意思是说我和一些伙计有一天晚上闯进去偷了它。

english: I don't know who they were building these warships for, but whoever it was seemed to be a little on the short side.
translation: 我不知道他们为谁建造这些战舰，但不管是谁，似乎个子有点矮。

english: We had to do a little remodelling of the doors and rooms so that we didn't have to crouch around everywhere, but I've finally got her just how I want her, and we have enough cannons down below decks to
translation: 我们不得不对门和房间进行一些改造，这样我们就不用到处弯腰了，但我终于把她弄成了我想要的样子，而且下层甲板上有足够的大炮，

english: bombard a small town I'd wager!
translation: 我敢打赌能轰炸一个小镇！

english: *Brawwwwwwk* I want guns, lots of guns! I want guns, lots of guns!
translation: *嘎嘎嘎嘎* 我要枪，很多枪！我要枪，很多枪！

english: I used to own my own ship you know...
translation: 我以前也有自己的船，你知道……

english: It was called the Lady Lumbridge if I remember correctly...
translation: 如果我没记错的话，它叫仑桥镇女士号……

english: I wonder whatever happened to it...
translation: 不知道它后来怎么样了……

english: Interesting. You never struck me as being Captain material, but I guess there's a ship out there for everyone...
translation: 有意思。我从没觉得你有船长的料，但我想每条船都有它的主人……

english: The Lady Zay is certainly a big step up from my last ship anyway.
translation: ‘扎伊女士号’肯定比我上一艘船好多了。

english: Your last ship? Why, what was wrong with it?
translation: 你上一艘船？怎么了，它有什么问题？

english: Well, it just wasn't sturdy enough!
translation: 嗯，就是不够坚固！

english: I was on a perfectly routine raiding expedition to the east of here, when we ran into a squall, that pushed us towards the rocky shore.
translation: 我当时正在这里以东进行一次完全例行的掠夺远征，结果遇到了一场暴风，把我们推向了岩石海岸。

english: A few select men and myself managed to escape with our lives intact on a small row boat, but the rest of my crew were washed ashore as the ship was wrecked on those jagged rocks.
translation: 我和几个精选的人乘着一艘小划艇侥幸逃生，但其余的船员随着船在那些锯齿状的岩石上失事而被冲上了岸。

english: Ah yes, it was a tragedy...
translation: 啊，是的，那是一场悲剧……

english: To lose such a fine ship in such an insulting manner...
translation: 以如此侮辱的方式失去一艘这么好的船……

english: And of course the rest of your crew...
translation: 当然，还有你其余的船员……

english: Who? Oh. Yes. The crew. Yes, it was a tragedy.
translation: 谁？哦。是的。船员。是的，那是一场悲剧。

english: I'd paid them in advance you know, I'll never see that money again!
translation: 我提前付了钱给他们，你懂的，那笔钱再也拿不回来了！

english: Um... no, I actually meant it was a shame that so many of your crew must have died in the shipwreck.
translation: 嗯……不，我其实是想说，这么多船员肯定在沉船中丧生，真是太可惜了。

english: Was it? Well, if you say so.
translation: 是吗？好吧，既然你这么说。

english: Actually, the last I had heard quite a few of them had survived, and had set up a little hideaway next to the remains of the shipwreck.
translation: 实际上，我上次听说他们中有不少人活了下来，并在沉船残骸旁边建了一个小小的藏身处。

english: If you're particularly worried about them, perhaps you might like to go and pay them a visit someday, and make sure to bring a lot of easily transferable wealth with you.
translation: 如果你特别担心他们，也许哪天可以去拜访一下，记得带上大量容易转移的财富。

english: They love people visiting with easily transferable wealth.
translation: 他们最喜欢别人带着容易转移的财富上门了。

english: Now, was there something you wished to talk to me about? Time is pressing on, and we really need to set sail soon if we want to make the most of the winds.
translation: 好了，你有什么想跟我谈的吗？时间紧迫，要想充分利用风力，我们得赶紧起航了。

english: *Squawk* Move it or lose it, move it or lose it.
translation: *嘎嘎* 要么走要么留，要么走要么留。

english: Well, I would be more than happy to take you, unfortunately the Moon Clan are, frankly, very scary people, and I believe they would not take kindly to us bringing a Fremennik there.
translation: 嗯，我很乐意带你去，但说实话，月亮族的人非常可怕，我觉得他们不会欢迎我带一个弗瑞民奈克人过去。

english: They are at war with them after all.
translation: 毕竟他们之间还在交战。

english: But I thought Lokar had already been there?
translation: 但我以为洛卡尔已经去过了？

english: Yes. Yes he has. I'm talking about you.
translation: 是的，他确实去过。我说的是你。

english: Oh. Oh yeah, I'm a Fremennik aren't I?
translation: 哦。哦对，我是弗瑞民奈克人，对吧？

english: I probably should have kept that Seal Of Passage Brundt the Chieftain gave me with me, shouldn't I?
translation: 我大概应该把酋长布伦特给我的那个通行印章带在身上，对吧？

english: Yes, yes you should have. Honestly, you're going to need it with you.
translation: 是的，你应该带着。老实说，你确实需要把它带在身上。

english: I'm afraid I can't let you travel with us without it.
translation: 恐怕没有它，我不能让你跟我们一起走。

english: *Brakawk* Don't drop quest items half way through a quest! *Squawk*
translation: *布拉咔咔* 别在任务做到一半时把任务物品弄丢了！*嘎嘎*

english: Okay, I'll go and get it again then.
translation: 好吧，那我去再拿一次。

english: You do that.
translation: 你去吧。

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now? I must say, it all sounds very intriguing over there...
translation: 我们现在能出发去月亮岛了吗？我得说，那里听起来确实很有趣……

english: As long as you keep your Seal Of Passage with you at all times while you are on the island you should be okay, even if you are a Fremennik.
translation: 只要你始终把通行印章带在身上，就算你是弗瑞民奈克人，也应该没事。

english: I'm not kidding, they are a very dangerous people, and it would NOT be wise for you to travel there without your Seal Of Passage marking you as a diplomat.
translation: 我没开玩笑，他们是非常危险的人，没有通行印章表明你是外交官，去那里是不明智的。

english: Okay, keep my Seal with me at all times, check. Can we go now?
translation: 好的，随时带着印章，明白。我们可以走了吗？

english: Ah, yes indeed! The winds seem good, so let's make a move!
translation: 啊，确实！风向不错，我们出发吧！

english: She's blowing a storm, cap'n! *Brarrrrrk*
translation: 风暴来了，船长！*布拉啦啦啦啦*

english: Well... THAT was deuced strange!
translation: 嗯……这真是古怪透顶！

english: Um... Way to sail a boat?
translation: 嗯……开船技术不错？

english: *Squawk* Way to sail a boat! Way to sail a boat! *Brarrrk*
translation: *嘎嘎* 开船技术不错！开船技术不错！*布拉啦啦*

english: This... This is VERY strange!
translation: 这……这非常奇怪！

english: No, actually, I don't really want to know anything that you can tell me.
translation: 不，实际上，我根本不想听你能告诉我的任何事情。

english: In fact, I don't even know why I began talking to you in the first place!
translation: 事实上，我甚至不知道当初为什么跟你说话！

english: Hmmmm. You could perhaps be more grateful to someone offering you free transport, but then I suppose you are a friend of Lokar's, and a Fremennik, so I suppose the
translation: 嗯……对于提供免费交通的人，你或许可以更感激一点，但我想你是洛卡尔的朋友，又是弗瑞民奈克人，所以粗鲁是天性。

english: rudeness is natural.
translation: 粗鲁是天性。

english: Make sure you are ready for departure, I will be issuing orders to set sail shortly.
translation: 准备好出发，我很快就会下令起航。

english: What happened to the ship?
translation: 船怎么了？

english: I have no idea! It doesn't normally do that!
translation: 我不知道！它平时不会这样！

english: Weird.
translation: 奇怪。

english: So the Captain's a very bad sailor I take it?
translation: 这么说船长是个很糟糕的水手？

english: No... Usually he's one of the best around, I don't know why we didn't reach our destination like we were supposed to, and it CERTAINLY wasn't anything to do with me
translation: 不……他通常是这一带最好的之一，我不知道为什么我们没有到达预定目的地，而且这绝对跟我没关系，

english: or anything I have done!
translation: 跟我做的事也没关系！

english: Alright, calm down I wasn't accusing you of anything!
translation: 好了，冷静点，我又没指责你什么！

english: Good, because it has NOTHING to do with me!
translation: 很好，因为这事跟我一点关系都没有！

english: IT'S NOT MY FAULT!
translation: 不是我的错！

english: I think you should lay off the coffee for a bit, youngster...
translation: 我觉得你该少喝点咖啡了，年轻人……

english: Do you know what's wrong with the ship? I've never seen a ship sail in a big circle like that before...
translation: 你知道这艘船出了什么问题吗？我以前从没见过船像那样绕大圈航行……

english: I can't say for sure, but it must be either the Captain or the Navigator to blame.
translation: 我不能肯定，但要么是船长，要么是领航员的责任。

english: They're the only ones who control the actual sailing of the ship.
translation: 只有他们实际控制船的航行。

english: I see... Thank you, that's very helpful.
translation: 我明白了……谢谢，这很有帮助。

english: So you reckon it's the navigator or the Captain's fault?
translation: 所以你觉得是领航员或船长的错？

english: Yeah, stands to reason, dunnit?
translation: 是啊，合情合理，对吧？

english: Did you just see that?
translation: 你刚才看到了吗？

english: The ship sailing. Or not sailing. Or sailing in a big circle and coming back here.
translation: 船在航行。或者没在航行。或者绕个大圈又回到这里。

english: I don't know, I'm not a sailor! But whatever it was, it was very odd!
translation: 我不知道，我不是水手！但不管怎样，这很奇怪！

english: Can't say that I did, no. Sorry, I was keeping an eye out.
translation: 我没看到，抱歉。我一直在留意观察。

english: An eye out? For what?
translation: 留意观察？观察什么？

english: Um... Sorry, I can't really say, but I'll know it when I see it!
translation: 嗯……抱歉，我不能说，但等我看到了就知道了！

english: Was the ship supposed to go in a big loop like that?
translation: 船本来该像那样绕大圈吗？

english: Pretty sure it wasn't, no...
translation: 肯定不该，不是……

english: Any idea what caused it?
translation: 知道是什么导致的吗？

english: Absolutely none at all...
translation: 完全不知道……

english: Pretty crazy sailing you guys got here!
translation: 你们这开船技术真够疯的！

english: Weird, the ships never done that before...
translation: 奇怪，船以前从没这样过……

english: In all my years as a pirate, I have never seen such sailing!
translation: 我当海盗这么多年，从没见过这样的航行！

english: What do you think caused it?
translation: 你觉得是什么导致的？

english: If I was a less superstitious person, I would suggest an evil magic of some kind.
translation: 要是我不那么迷信，我会说是某种邪恶的魔法。

english: Iiiinteresting...
translation: 有意思……

english: Wow. Pretty rubbish sailing just then, huh?
translation: 哇。刚才那航行真够烂的，是吧？

english: I have literally never seen anything like it! The ship seemed to... I don't know, suddenly swing round as we approached shore!
translation: 我真的从没见过这种事！船好像……怎么说呢，在我们接近岸边时突然掉头！

english: then somehow we were right back where we started! This is all very peculiar if you ask me, I have never seen anything like it in all of my years on the high seas.
translation: 然后不知怎么的我们就回到了原点！要我说，这一切太古怪了，我在海上这么多年从没见过这种事。

english: What do you think might be happening?
translation: 你觉得可能发生了什么？

english: Well, my first thought would be that we have jinx aboard.
translation: 嗯，我的第一反应是船上有扫把星。

english: A jinx?
translation: 扫把星？

english: Yes, a jinx. Someone who has recently come aboard and seems to be bringing us bad luck. If it is a jinx, the only answer would be to throw them
translation: 对，扫把星。某个刚上船的人，似乎给我们带来了厄运。如果是扫把星，唯一的办法就是把他

english: overboard as shark food.
translation: 扔下船喂鲨鱼。

english: You just recently came aboard the ship yourself didn't you? Because I don't recall us having any trouble before you showed up.
translation: 你自己也是刚上船的吧？因为我不记得你来之前我们有过什么麻烦。

english: Uh... yes... But... I'm pretty sure I didn't do anything. I hope.
translation: 呃……是的……但我很肯定我什么都没做。希望如此。

english: Well, you had better hope it isn't your fault. If there's one thing I hate more than a stowaway, it's a jinx.
translation: 哼，你最好祈祷不是你的错。如果说有比偷渡客更让我讨厌的东西，那就是扫把星。

english: What do you want, spoken to the captain yet?
translation: 你想干什么，跟船长谈过了吗？

english: Not yet, but I will.
translation: 还没，但我会的。

english: Well do it.
translation: 那就去。

english: I am, watch, here I go.
translation: 我正要去呢，看着，我这就去。

english: Oh, I'm sooooo scared now.
translation: 哦，我好怕怕哦。

english: Yeah, you better be.
translation: 没错，你最好怕。

english: But you're still here.
translation: 但你还在这儿。

english: Yeah but not for long.
translation: 是啊，但不会太久了。

english: Well you better go then.
translation: 那你最好快走。

english: Fine, I'm gone.
translation: 行，我走了。

english: How... bizarre.
translation: 真是……莫名其妙。

english: You didn't see what the ship just did?
translation: 你没看到船刚才干了什么？

english: Yes... But I'm not a sailor. Is that abnormal then?
translation: 是的……但我不是水手。那不正常吗？

english: Yes, yes it is. VERY abnormal.
translation: 是的，非常不正常。

english: Sorry, don't have time to chat! Something's up with the ship, I'm trying to find out what!
translation: 抱歉，没时间聊天！船出了点问题，我得弄清楚怎么回事！

english: Woah! Did you see that crazy trip?
translation: 哇！你看到那段疯狂的航程了吗？

english: Yeah, what do you think happened?
translation: 看到了，你觉得发生了什么？

english: I dunno, but I'm keeping out of it. I don't want anyone blaming me for it!
translation: 不知道，但我可不掺和。我可不想让人怪到我头上！

english: Who's driving this thing anyway?
translation: 这玩意儿到底是谁在开？

english: It's called sailing, but I don't know what's happening.
translation: 这叫航行，但我也不知道发生了什么。

english: Is someone gonna fix it then?
translation: 那有人会修吗？

english: I hope so. I wanted to pick up some new clothes on Lunar Isle next time we went back.
translation: 希望如此。下次我们回去月亮岛时，我还想买几件新衣服呢。

english: What's happening with the ship???
translation: 船到底怎么了？？？

english: I was hoping you could tell me...
translation: 我还指望你能告诉我呢……

english: Pretty crazy sailing we did just then, huh?
translation: 刚才咱们那趟航行可真够疯的，对吧？

english: Did we? Ah, sorry ter say but I missed the whole thing, I've bin a mite busy down here in the ole galley.
translation: 我们到了吗？啊，抱歉，我完全错过了整个过程，我一直在这下面的老厨房里忙个不停。

english: We seemed to be getting somewhere, but we're right back where we started!
translation: 我们好像快到了，结果又回到了起点！

english: Aye, I've felt like that me whole life ter be honest...
translation: 是啊，我这辈子一直都有这种感觉，说实话……

english: ...Okay. I'll just leave you to... Whatever it is that you do.
translation: ……好吧。我就让你去忙你……那些事儿吧。

english: Aye, that'll be fer the best whipper-snapper, if'n ye be wanting any food cooked at all.
translation: 对，这样最好，小崽子，要是你还想吃点熟食的话。

english: I... I don't understand... This is all very strange...
translation: 我……我不明白……这一切太奇怪了……

english: That was possibly the most pointless journey I have ever taken in my life.
translation: 这可能是我这辈子最没意义的旅程了。

english: The course was plotted, we had a fair tailwind the whole journey...
translation: 航线都规划好了，一路上还都是顺风……

english: BUT WE HAVEN'T BUDGED AN INCH!
translation: 可我们一寸都没移动！

english: I just don't understand it... Maybe you should speak with Jack.
translation: 我就是搞不懂……也许你该去跟杰克谈谈。

english: Our navigator. He's at the rear of the ship, one floor below deck. He's an old sea-dog with a brown pirate's hat.
translation: 我们的导航员。他在船尾，楼下地板下面。他是个老海狗，戴着棕色海盗帽。

english: Below deck, below deck!
translation: 甲板下面，甲板下面！

english: Can we try again?
translation: 我们能再试一次吗？

english: Yes, you're right, perhaps it was just a freak wind. Off we go!
translation: 是啊，你说得对，可能只是阵怪风。我们出发吧！

english: Hey, are you the navigator?
translation: 嘿，你是导航员吗？

english: That I am. Why?
translation: 我是。怎么了？

english: Think you can navigate us a course on this ship that isn't a BIG STUPID CIRCLE?
translation: 你觉得你能在这艘船上规划出一条不是大傻圆圈的航线吗？

english: I'm SURE I don't know what you mean!
translation: 我肯定不明白你在说什么！

english: C'mon now... If you're the navigator, then it stands to reason it's your fault we didn't sail anywhere!
translation: 拜托……如果你是导航员，那照理说我们哪儿也没去成就是你的错了！

english: Now listen here bucko, my course was true, like all of my others, and if you have a problem with how I do my job, then you'd better go and speak to the Captain about it, because I don't appreciate a stowaway
translation: 喂，听着，小子，我的航线是准的，跟我其他所有航线一样，如果你对我的工作有意见，那你最好去跟船长说，因为我不欢迎一个偷渡客

english: wandering in here and criticising me!
translation: 跑进来批评我！

english: Well maybe I will go and talk to the Captain about you.
translation: 好吧，也许我真该去跟船长说说你的事。

english: You'd better do that then.
translation: 那你就去说吧。

english: Fine, I will.
translation: 好，我会的。

english: Hey there captain.
translation: 嘿，船长。

english: What are you wanting now?
translation: 你现在又想要什么？

english: Perhaps the navigator made a mistake when he plotted the course?
translation: 也许是导航员规划航线时搞错了？

english: Hmmm, you think so? Perhaps I'd better ask him about that...
translation: 嗯，你觉得呢？也许我该去问问他……

english: But... His course looked true.. I just don't understand...
translation: 但是……他的航线看起来是对的……我就是不明白……

english: I'll go ask him what happened for you, Captain.
translation: 我去问问他发生了什么，船长。

english: You will? Well, thank you!
translation: 你去？好吧，谢谢！

english: You're very helpful for a stowaway! He's one floor below deck. To the rear of the ship.
translation: 作为一个偷渡者，你真是帮了大忙！他在甲板下面一层。在船的后部。

english: I'M NOT A STOWAWAY! GAH!
translation: 我不是偷渡客！啊！

english: I heard a rumour that the ship isn't going anywhere because of the navigator...
translation: 我听说船开不动是因为导航员……

english: I don't deal with gossips.
translation: 我不跟爱传闲话的人打交道。

english: So what do you think? We keep going round in circles because the navigator is useless?
translation: 那你觉得呢？我们一直兜圈子是因为导航员没用？

english: Yeah, the navigator, absolutely, sounds about right, yup.
translation: 是啊，导航员，绝对没错，听起来就是这样，对。

english: Nope, it has certainly nothing to do with me or anything that I have done to the ship, I swear on my dead mothers life!
translation: 不，肯定跟我无关，也跟我对船做的手脚无关，我拿我已故母亲的生命发誓！

english: Um... okay then.
translation: 嗯……好吧。

english: Well, I spoke to both the Captain and the Navigator, and it seems to me it must be the navigator's fault that we're sailing in circles.
translation: 嗯，我跟船长和导航员都谈过了，在我看来肯定是导航员的错，我们才会绕圈航行。

english: Seems a logical conclusion to me too.
translation: 对我来说这也是个合理的结论。

english: Glad you think so!
translation: 很高兴你也这么想！

english: Hello there. So... That navigator.
translation: 你好啊。所以……那个导航员。

english: Rumours say that it's his fault the ships going round in circles now.
translation: 有传言说船现在兜圈子是他的错。

english: Really? Seems strange to me, I made a point of watching our course last time we sailed, and we didn't deviate at all, but somehow ended up back here.
translation: 真的吗？我觉得很奇怪，上次航行我特意观察了我们的航线，完全没有偏离，但不知怎么就回到了这里。

english: Well, the Captain thinks it must be his fault!
translation: 嗯，船长认为一定是他的错！

english: No... I'm not so sure about that...
translation: 不……我不太确定……

english: This crazy sailing... Think it could be the navigator's fault?
translation: 这疯狂的航行……你觉得会是导航员的错吗？

english: Well, I guess it could be... Seems a little strange for him to do that though.
translation: 嗯，我想有可能……不过他这么做有点奇怪。

english: Yeah, I guess.
translation: 是啊，我想也是。

english: That sailing was horrible. I blame the navigator.
translation: 那航行太糟糕了。我怪导航员。

english: You know, speaking ill of someone behind their back isn't cool.
translation: 你知道吗，在别人背后说坏话可不好。

english: Yeah, you're right, sorry.
translation: 是啊，你说得对，抱歉。

english: The captain seems to think that the navigator is repsonsiblefor the problems with the ship...
translation: 船长似乎觉得导航员要负责这船的问题……

english: He's an arrogant fool, but he gets the job done.
translation: 他是个傲慢的傻瓜，但他能把活儿干完。

english: I'd have to say the Captains wrong about that.
translation: 我得说船长在这点上错了。

english: Hmmm. Okay, thanks.
translation: 嗯。好吧，谢谢。

english: So what did the navigator have to say for himself?
translation: 那么导航员自己怎么说？

english: Does he have any explanation for why we keep sailing in a big circle every time we try to get to Lunar Isle?
translation: 他有没有解释为什么每次我们试图前往月亮岛时，船总是绕大圈？

english: I, uh, kind of didn't bother to go and talk to him yet...
translation: 我，呃，还没去找他谈过……

english: *Squaaaawk* Lazy stowaway!
translation: *嘎嘎* 懒惰的偷渡客！

english: Maybe we were just unlucky that last time?
translation: 也许上次只是我们运气不好？

english: Oh, you want me to try and set sail again?
translation: 哦，你想让我再试一次出海？

english: It can't hurt, right?
translation: 试试又没坏处，对吧？

english: I suppose so. Off we go!
translation: 我想也是。我们出发吧！

english: So... The rumour is that it's all the navigator's fault that the ship keeps going around in a big circle.
translation: 所以……谣言说船一直绕大圈都是领航员的错。

english: Is it now? That sounds like exactly the kind of thing that a stowaway and a jinx might say to throw suspicion off of himself.
translation: 是这样吗？听起来正像是一个偷渡客兼扫把星会说的话，想把自己身上的嫌疑甩掉。

english: You think this is my fault?
translation: 你觉得这是我的错？

english: Ah, so you finally admit you are a stowaway and a jinx!
translation: 啊，你终于承认自己是偷渡客兼扫把星了！

english: What? NO! Look, I'm pretty sure it's nothing to do with me...
translation: 什么？不！听着，我很确定这跟我无关……

english: Well, for your sake I hope you're right. Killing people is such a chore.
translation: 好吧，为了你好，我希望你是对的。杀人可是件麻烦事。

english: I'll go and speak to the navigator immediately.
translation: 我马上去跟导航员谈谈。

english: I bet it's the navigator's fault.
translation: 我打赌是导航员的错。

english: The weirdness with the ship.
translation: 这船的怪事。

english: Hmm. Could be I suppose.
translation: 嗯。我想也有可能。

english: I blame the navigator for the ships weirdness.
translation: 我认为船的怪事是导航员的错。

english: His fault, eh? Well, I never liked him much anyway.
translation: 他的错，嗯？好吧，反正我从来就不怎么喜欢他。

english: Yeah, me neither.
translation: 是啊，我也不喜欢。

english: Hey, think the problems with the ship is the navigator's fault?
translation: 嘿，你觉得船的问题是导航员的错吗？

english: Yup, could be. Could well be.
translation: 对，有可能。很可能。

english: Hello there. What can you tell me about the navigator of this ship?
translation: 你好。关于这艘船的导航员，你能告诉我些什么？

english: Sorry, I've never spoken to the man.
translation: 抱歉，我从没跟那人说过话。

english: How can you never have spoken to him? There's only like 10 people aboard the entire ship!
translation: 你怎么可能从没跟他说过话？整艘船上也就十来个人！

english: Dunno. Sorry.
translation: 不知道。抱歉。

english: Do you know of any reason why the navigator would be deliberately sabotaging our journey?
translation: 你知道导航员有什么理由故意破坏我们的旅程吗？

english: No, and I can't believe he would.
translation: 不知道，我也不相信他会这么做。

english: So. Absolutely rubbish sailing. It's the navigator's fault, right? You're with me on that, yeah?
translation: 所以。航行糟糕透顶。是导航员的错，对吧？你同意我，对吧？

english: Aye, if'n yer say it's true then it must be!
translation: 对，既然你这么说，那肯定就是了！

english: ...and [player name] is the greatest pirate who ever lived?
translation: ……而[player name]是史上最伟大的海盗？

english: [player name] yer say? Aye, well I guess that they must be if'n that's what ye're telling me there.
translation: [player name]你说？对，嗯，我想既然你这么告诉我，那他们肯定就是了。

english: You know what? I like you.
translation: 你知道吗？我喜欢你。

english: Although admittedly I haven't tried any of your food...
translation: 虽然坦白说，我还没尝过你做的食物……

english: So... Call yourself a navigator huh? Way to plot a course that's a big circle!
translation: 所以……你自称是领航员是吧？这就是你规划航线的方式，一个大圆圈！

english: Frankly sirrah your rudeness is quite appalling!
translation: 坦白说，老兄，你的无礼真是令人震惊！

english: My calculations and plotted course were expertly calculated, and there can be only one reason why the ship has failed to arrive at its expected destination.
translation: 我的计算和规划的航线都是专业推算的，船没能到达预期目的地只能有一个原因。

english: Oh really? What's that then? Wrong kind of waves? Your steering wheel got stuck?
translation: 哦，真的吗？那是什么？风向不对？你的轮子卡住了？

english: I do not have to take this kind of abuse from a common stowaway!
translation: 我可没必要忍受一个普通偷渡客的这种侮辱！

english: I'll have you know that I am a personal friend of the Captain, and he himself invited me aboard for a small cruise around Lunar Isle along with a variety of local delicacies and beverages!
translation: 我告诉你，我是船长的私人朋友，是他本人邀请我上船，去月亮岛附近短途航行，还备了各种当地美食和饮料！

english: Really? You don't seem like the type he would make friends with.
translation: 真的吗？你看起来不像他会交朋友的那种人。

english: Oh, absolutely. Me and him go way back. Waaaaaaay back.
translation: 哦，当然。我和他交情可深了。非常非常深。

english: We're like... apples and custard. Everybody says so.
translation: 我们就像……苹果和蛋奶酱。大家都这么说。

english: Yup, me and Captain Renney, we're a team.
translation: 没错，我和雷尼船长，我们是一伙的。

english: You mean Captain Bentley?
translation: 你是说本特利船长？

english: Right. Bentley. That's what I said.
translation: 对。本特利。我就是这么说的。

english: No you didn't. You called him Captain Renney.
translation: 不，你没有。你叫他雷尼船长。

english: Oh, yeah, it's like a nickname. Only his friends are allowed to call him that.
translation: 哦，是啊，那是个绰号。只有他的朋友才能这么叫他。

english: Yet I have known him for over 20 years and he has never asked to be referred to as anything except Captain Bentley.
translation: 可我认识他超过二十年了，他从来没要求过别人用本特利船长以外的称呼叫他。

english: Wow, he must hate you.
translation: 哇，那他一定很讨厌你。

english: And indeed, he has never mentioned any stowaway looking vagabonds as friends.
translation: 而且，他也从来没提过有什么偷渡的流浪汉是他的朋友。

english: Well, that's all besides the point. It's all your fault and I'm going to make sure the Captain fizzles your gizzard, or whatever it is you piratey types do to each other.
translation: 好吧，这些都不重要。都是你的错，我要让船长好好收拾你，或者你们海盗之间互相干的那种事。

english: But it wasn't my fault!
translation: 但这不是我的错！

english: Look, see for yourself! All co-ordinates for the journey are carefully plotted to all visible waypoints and landmasses!
translation: 看，你自己瞧瞧！这次航行的所有坐标都仔细标注到了所有可见的航标点和陆地上！

english: There can only be one POSSIBLE explanation why the ship hasn't reached its destination, as I mentioned before!
translation: 只有一个可能的解释能说明为什么船没到达目的地，就像我之前说的！

english: Oh really? And what would that be then?
translation: 哦，是吗？那是什么解释？

english: And your explanation had better be good, or Captain Renney is going to shiver your timbers for good!
translation: 你的解释最好说得通，否则雷尼船长会让你吃不了兜着走！

english: Right. Whatever. Carry on.
translation: 好吧。随便。继续。

english: Magic. It must be magic. Somebody must have jinxed our ship, but I have no idea who would have done that or why.
translation: 魔法。一定是魔法。肯定有人对我们的船下了咒，但我不知道是谁干的，也不知道为什么。

english: Although your highly suspicious behaviour towards me, and mysterious sudden appearance on board at the *exact time* that this jinx appears to have been brought upon us would seem to make you the obvious candidate.
translation: 不过，你对我那种高度可疑的态度，以及你恰好在这个诅咒降临在我们头上的*同一时间*神秘地突然出现在船上，这让你成了明显的嫌疑犯。

english: And we all know what we do to someone who is a jinx.
translation: 而且我们都知道，我们对带来厄运的人会怎么做。

english: Uh... We do?
translation: 呃……我们知道？

english: Oh, I'm sure your good friend Captain Bentley has told you all about the last jinx we had on board.
translation: 哦，我相信你的好朋友本特利船长肯定告诉过你，上次船上那个带来厄运的人的下场。

english: Oh, absolutely he did, yes. I just uh, have these lapses in memory occasionally.
translation: 哦，他当然说了，是的。我只是呃，偶尔会有点失忆。

english: Oh, it was horrible. I never knew the human body could contain so many mackerel.
translation: 哦，那太可怕了。我从不知道人体里能塞进那么多鲭鱼。

english: And then that thing they did with the tinderbox and the cheese... I still wake up with nightmares about that sometimes...
translation: 然后他们用火绒盒和乳酪干的那事……我有时候还会做噩梦醒来……

english: Er... Right. I'd better go find that jinx then before someone else accuses me of this being my fault.
translation: 呃……好吧。我最好在别人也指责这是我的错之前，先去找那个带来厄运的家伙。

english: I have it on good authority that there's a jinx on board the ship stopping it sailing anywhere.
translation: 我有可靠消息说，船上有个厄运诅咒，让船哪儿也去不了。

english: A jinx, you say? My my my, it's been a long time since I've heard of one of those...
translation: 你说厄运诅咒？哎呀呀呀，我好久没听说过这种东西了……

english: Do you know anything about it.
translation: 你知道些什么吗？

english: I'm afraid not, but I hope you find it. They're evil things, especially on a boat.
translation: 恐怕不知道，但我希望你能找到它。它们是邪恶的东西，尤其是在船上。

english: Hello there... Mr. Boy?
translation: 你好啊……小子先生？

english: Just call me 'boy'. Everybody else does.
translation: 就叫我‘小子’吧。其他人都这么叫。

english: Don't you have a real name?
translation: 你没有真名吗？

english: Not that I can remember, no.
translation: 我不记得了，没有。

english: Oh. Right then.
translation: 哦。那好吧。

english: Anyway, I believe that there may be a jinx aboard this ship, and that is what is preventing us from sailing to Lunar Isle.
translation: 总之，我相信这艘船上可能有个厄运诅咒，这就是我们无法航行到月亮岛的原因。

english: A jinx? I don't know ANYTHING about that!
translation: 厄运诅咒？我对此一无所知！

english: IT'S NOT MY FAULT OKAY?
translation: 不是我的错，行了吧？

english: I don't think I was actually accusing you of anything there...um, boy.
translation: 我想我并没有真的在指责你什么……呃，小子。

english: You weren't? Oh. IT WAS STILL NOTHING TO DO WITH ME!
translation: 你没有？哦。那也跟我没关系！

english: You're very defensive, aren't you?
translation: 你很有戒心，是吧？

english: Sorry. It's my job, you know?
translation: 抱歉。这是我的工作，你懂吗？

english: I'm always getting the blame for things that go wrong aboard.
translation: 船上出了什么事，我总是被责怪。

english: Well, I guess you don't know anything useful.
translation: 好吧，我想你也不知道什么有用的信息。

english: Now, I'm not much of a seafaring guy, but as I understand it this ship has somehow gotten a jinx, which is messing up the sailing to Lunar Isle!
translation: 我虽然不太懂航海，但据我所知，这艘船不知怎么被下了厄运诅咒，搞得没法航行到月亮岛！

english: Really? Oh, that's terrible news.
translation: 真的吗？哦，那真是坏消息。

english: I hope someone's doing something about it.
translation: 我希望有人在处理这件事。

english: Er, yeah, I am.
translation: 呃，是啊，就是我。

english: Seems like the problems with the ship are all down to a jinx.
translation: 看来船的问题都是因为一个厄运诅咒。

english: Aw no... I hate those things...
translation: 哦不……我讨厌那东西……

english: The captain thinks there might be a jinx aboard. Any help?
translation: 船长觉得船上可能有个厄运诅咒。你能帮忙吗？

english: Well, that makes sense, but sorry I don't know anything about that.
translation: 嗯，有道理，但抱歉，我对此一无所知。

english: I have reason to believe that there is a jinx aboard this ship.
translation: 我有理由相信这艘船上有个厄运诅咒。

english: IT MIGHT EVEN BE YOU!
translation: 甚至可能就是你！

english: Do I look like a jinx to you?
translation: 我看起来像厄运诅咒吗？

english: Erm... I don't know. I don't know what a jinx looks like.
translation: 呃……我不知道。我不知道厄运诅咒长什么样。

english: It might be an idea for you to find out before accusing people.
translation: 在指责别人之前，你最好先搞清楚。

english: Oh captain, my captain.
translation: 哦船长，我的船长。

english: So you've spoken to my navigator again, yes? What does he have to say for himself?
translation: 所以你又和我的领航员谈过了，是吧？他有什么要说的？

english: Oh yes. He tried to hide his incompetence by blaming the ships' problems on a jinx of some sort.
translation: 哦，是的。他试图把自己的无能归咎于船上的某种厄运诅咒，来掩饰自己的失职。

english: A JINX you say???
translation: 你说厄运诅咒？？？

english: Aye, I have to admit that does sound like a logical explanation...
translation: 是啊，我不得不承认这听起来确实是个合理的解释……

english: No, I'm still pretty sure it's just the navigator being really rubbish at his job...
translation: 不，我还是很确定只是领航员工作太差劲了……

english: No, no, a jinx, that makes all too much sense I'm afraid...
translation: 不，不，厄运诅咒，恐怕这太说得通了……

english: Well, the solution is obvious.
translation: 嗯，解决办法很明显。

english: We need to find who or what has been jinxed and remove it from the ship immediately.
translation: 我们需要找出是谁或什么东西被诅咒了，然后立刻把它从船上弄走。

english: Right. And when you say 'we' need to find you actually mean...?
translation: 对。当你说‘我们’需要去找的时候，你实际的意思是……？

english: *brakawk* He means you dummy! You dummy! *Squawk*
translation: *嘎嘎* 他的意思是你，笨蛋！你，笨蛋！*嘎嘎*

english: Well, as Captain I have certain responsibilities that must be fulfilled, so I would greatly appreciate a little assistance in tracking down this jinx...
translation: 嗯，作为船长，我有某些必须履行的职责，所以如果你能帮忙追踪这个厄运诅咒，我会非常感激……

english: Yeah, I was afraid you were going to say that...
translation: 是啊，我就怕你会这么说……

english: Okay, I'll try and track down this jinx for you.
translation: 好吧，我会试着帮你追踪这个厄运诅咒。

english: Good lad! Let me know if you find out anything important.
translation: 好小子！如果发现什么重要线索，就告诉我。

english: (sigh) Yes, Captain.
translation: （叹气）是，船长。

english: Hey hey hey! Apparently there's a jinx on board. Or the navigator is rubbish.
translation: 嘿，嘿，嘿！显然船上有个厄运诅咒。或者领航员很糟糕。

english: One of the two, I'm not sure which.
translation: 两者之一，我不确定是哪个。

english: Yes, and I believe I'm looking right at him. Would this jinx also be a stowaway?
translation: 是的，而且我相信我正看着他。这个厄运诅咒也是个偷渡客吗？

english: Look, this calling me a stowaway and a jinx isn't funny!
translation: 喂，叫我偷渡客和厄运诅咒可不好笑！

english: I quite agree. Perhaps you should leave?
translation: 我完全同意。也许你该离开了？

english: I'm going to find who or what this jinx is, if only so I can prove to you that it's not me!
translation: 我要去找出这个厄运诅咒是谁或是什么，哪怕只是为了向你证明不是我！

english: Hmmm. Well, you had best do that then, and stop disturbing me.
translation: 嗯。那你最好赶紧去，别再来烦我了。

english: You had better get some evidence quickly as well, I would so hate to have to kill you. Killing someone really tends to ruin my day.
translation: 你最好也快点找到证据，我可不想杀了你。杀人真的很破坏我一天的心情。

english: SO! I've found you, YOU JINX!
translation: 所以！我找到你了，你这个厄运诅咒！

english: What? I'm not a jinx, we've already had this discussion!
translation: 什么？我不是厄运诅咒，我们之前已经讨论过了！

english: Sorry. I thought you might be, and that I could trick it out of you by shouting it at you as an accusation.
translation: 抱歉。我以为你可能是，这样我就能通过冲你大喊指控来骗你承认。

english: That approach works, does it?
translation: 这方法管用吗？

english: Well, not yet, no. But there's always a first time for everything.
translation: 嗯，目前还没有。但凡事总有第一次。

english: I think a more subtle approach might yield you better results.
translation: 我觉得更巧妙的方法可能会给你带来更好的结果。

english: (sigh) I suppose so... It just won't be as much fun...
translation: （叹气）我想也是……只是那样就没那么好玩了……

english: I heard a rumour there's a jinx aboard...
translation: 我听说有个谣言，说船上有个厄运诅咒……

english: Really? I hope not, they're evil things.
translation: 真的吗？我希望不是，它们是邪恶的东西。

english: You don't know anything about a jinx onboard do you?
translation: 你不知道船上有什么厄运诅咒的事吧？

english: Hi, I'm looking for a jinx...
translation: 嗨，我在找一个厄运诅咒……

english: Why would you be after one of those evil things?
translation: 你为什么要找那种邪恶的东西？

english: Well, I think there might be one onboard.
translation: 嗯，我觉得船上可能有一个。

english: Gosh, I hope not!
translation: 天哪，我希望没有！

english: Hi. Know anything about jinxes?
translation: 嗨。知道什么关于厄运诅咒的事吗？

english: Absolutely nothing. Sorry.
translation: 完全不知道。抱歉。

english: Do you know anything about jinxes?
translation: 你知道什么关于厄运诅咒的事吗？

english: Only that they're extremely bad things to have aboard a ship.
translation: 只知道船上带着它们是极其糟糕的事。

english: Yup, I'd already figured that much out.
translation: 是啊，我早就猜到了。

english: Hello there. I have reason to believe that someone or something has somehow placed a jinx upon this ship, preventing it from sailing as it is supposed to.
translation: 你好。我有理由相信，有人或某种东西对这艘船下了诅咒，导致它无法正常航行。

english: Know anything about that?
translation: 你知道些什么吗？

english: A jinx yer say? Wassat, some kinda fancy foreign vegetable?
translation: 你说诅咒？那是啥，某种花哨的外国蔬菜？

english: Um... No, no I don't think this ship has been cursed by a fancy foreign vegetable...
translation: 呃……不，我不认为这艘船是被花哨的外国蔬菜诅咒的……

english: All vegetables are evil if you ask me!
translation: 要我说，所有蔬菜都是邪恶的！

english: I don't think I did ask you...
translation: 我好像没问你……

english: That's right then, we'll hear no more about evil foreign vegetables.
translation: 那就对了，我们别再提什么邪恶的外国蔬菜了。

english: Or evil domestic vegetables.
translation: 或者邪恶的本土蔬菜。

english: Or vegetables at all! Death ter vegetables!
translation: 或者任何蔬菜！蔬菜去死！

english: Okay then... 'bye.
translation: 好吧……再见。

english: Hello there. So, I'm wondering if you know anything about a jinx at all?
translation: 你好。我想知道，你对诅咒的事了解多少？

english: A jinx you say? Argh, those are evil things!
translation: 你说诅咒？啊，那可是邪恶的东西！

english: Quick question: What exactly is a jinx anyway?
translation: 问个问题：诅咒到底是什么？

english: Ah, well they take many forms.
translation: 啊，它们有很多种形式。

english: Sometimes it will just be a person with such staggeringly bad luck that everything they do or say invariably leads them into trouble and commotion, through no fault of their own.
translation: 有时候，它可能只是一个运气背到极点的人，他们所做或所说的每件事，都会莫名其妙地惹上麻烦和骚动，尽管这并非他们的错。

english: Everything they touch will always bring them misery, and everything they think they have achieved will always end in disaster.
translation: 他们碰到的每件事都会带来痛苦，他们以为已经达成的一切，最终都会以灾难收场。

english: But then there is the other kind of jinx, the even worse kind.
translation: 但还有另一种诅咒，更糟糕的那种。

english: It is a curse put upon someone, often attached to an object of some kind, and it is done deliberately, so that misfortune will always follow the owner of that object.
translation: 这是对某人下的诅咒，通常附着在某种物品上，而且是故意为之，这样厄运就会一直跟随着那件物品的主人。

english: So why is it such a big deal to sailors?
translation: 那为什么对水手来说这么严重？

english: Ah, well now. When you're on land, bad luck can be an annoyance, and possibly even bring you grief, but it is rarely deadly.
translation: 啊，这个嘛。在陆地上，坏运气可能只是烦人，甚至可能让你伤心，但很少会致命。

english: A jinx on land may fall over tree roots, or lose their coins down a drain, or some other irritation.
translation: 陆地上的诅咒可能让人被树根绊倒，或者把金币掉进排水沟，或者其他一些恼人的事。

english: But at sea! With nothing saving you from the cold murky death of drowning except the wood below your feet?
translation: 但在海上！除了脚下的木材，没有任何东西能救你免于冰冷黑暗的溺死？

english: Why, jinxes can kill not just you, but the entire crew of a ship! They are an evil thing indeed, and the only thing you can do to save yourself and your crew is to forcibly
translation: 诅咒不仅能杀死你，还能杀死整艘船的船员！它们确实是邪恶的东西，而拯救自己和船员的唯一方法，就是尽快

english: remove the jinx from the ship as soon as possible. Dead or alive.
translation: 把诅咒从船上移除。不管死活。

english: Or casting some kind of anti-curse magic upon the jinxed item might work, but to be honest, throwing them overboard is quicker.
translation: 或者对那个倒霉物品施放某种反诅咒魔法可能也行，但老实说，把它们扔到船外更快。

english: Wait, so someone with magical powers can deliberately place a jinx upon someone or something?
translation: 等等，所以有魔法能力的人可以故意对某人或某物下诅咒？

english: Oh, yes. But they would have to be a very magical and very evil person to risk the lives of an entire ship over some trivial matter.
translation: 哦，是的。但他们必须是一个非常邪恶且法力高强的人，才会为了一些琐事拿整艘船的人命冒险。

english: Someone highly magical like, oh, let's say for the sake of argument, the inhabitants of Lunar Isle, a.k.a the Moon Clan?
translation: 像月亮岛的居民，也就是月亮部落那样法力高强的人？

english: Well, I suppose so... But for them to curse our entire boat?
translation: 嗯，我想是吧……但他们要诅咒我们整艘船？

english: Somebody from the landing party must have done something highly offensive to them at the feast for them to place such an evil enchantment that risks the lives of the entire crew.
translation: 登陆队里一定有人在宴会上做了非常冒犯他们的事，才会让他们施下这种危及整船人命的邪恶魔法。

english: So somebody from the landing party must have gotten themselves jinxed...
translation: 所以登陆队里一定有人被诅咒了……

english: Thanks a lot 'Eagle-eye', you've been extremely helpful.
translation: 非常感谢你，'鹰眼'，你帮了大忙。

english: Hi. Now... about this jinx...
translation: 嗨。现在……关于这个诅咒……

english: I have reason to believe that it may have been caused by somebody who has offended the Moon Clan somehow while on that recent visit of yours to Lunar Isle.
translation: 我有理由相信，可能是你们最近去月亮岛时，有人冒犯了月亮部落导致的。

english: Yup. I'm afraid so.
translation: 是的。恐怕是这样。

english: That doesn't sound like anyone on board...
translation: 听起来不像船上的人会做的事……

english: We may be pirates, but we're all surprisingly well- mannered!
translation: 我们虽然是海盗，但都出奇地有礼貌！

english: So you don't know anything about it?
translation: 所以你什么都不知道？

english: Hey. What's up?
translation: 嘿。怎么了？

english: Well, it's like this: Apparently one of the crew was up to something on Lunar Isle that caused the Moon Clan to be offended, which has led to this jinx being placed on someone or
translation: 嗯，是这样的：显然有个船员在月亮岛上做了什么事，惹怒了月亮部落，导致他们对船上的人或东西下了诅咒。

english: something aboard the ship.
translation: 船上的某样东西。

english: That's the closest I can figure it anyway, I have to admit this is all very confusing...
translation: 我发誓我不是故意的！

english: I SWEAR I DIDN'T MEAN TO!
translation: 我发誓我不是故意的！

english: ...Nothing. I didn't do anything. At all.
translation: ……没什么。我什么都没做。完全没有。

english: And nobody can prove that I did, even if I had, which I didn't so they can't. So there.
translation: 而且没人能证明是我做的，就算是我做的——反正不是——所以他们证明不了。就这样。

english: Wait, are you telling me you might have had something to do with this?
translation: 等等，你是说你可能和这事有关？

english: No, I'm telling you the EXACT OPPOSITE!
translation: 不，我告诉你的是完全相反的意思！

english: It wasn't me! I SWEAR!
translation: 不是我！我发誓！

english: Are you sure? Because a minute ago it really sounded to me as though you-
translation: 你确定吗？因为刚才听起来你好像——

english: NO! NOT ME! NUH-UH! NO WAY!
translation: 不！不是我！才不是！绝不可能！

english: Okay, okay, I believe you, I believe you. There's no need to shout at me.
translation: 好吧好吧，我相信你，我相信你。不用对我大喊大叫。

english: Sorry, I just didn't want you getting the wrong impression and telling the Captain anything, is all.
translation: 抱歉，我只是不想让你误会，然后告诉船长任何事情，仅此而已。

english: Fair enough, I can understand that. Well, see you around.
translation: 有道理，我能理解。好吧，回头见。

english: IT WASN'T -
translation: 那不是——

english: Oh, I mean, goodbye stowaway.
translation: 哦，我是说，再见，偷渡者。

english: I feel kind of awkward asking...
translation: 我觉得问这个有点尴尬……

english: Ah, just come out and say it. I'm a pirate, it's not like I get offended easily.
translation: 啊，直说吧。我是个海盗，我又不是那么容易生气的人。

english: Actually it's about offending people. You didn't, you know, tick off any of the Moon Clan while you were there recently did you?
translation: 其实就是关于冒犯人的事。你最近在月亮部落那里，没有惹恼他们吧？

english: Gosh, I hope not. They might have been very hospitable towards us, but there was definitely something spooky about them!
translation: 天哪，我希望没有。他们对我们确实很热情，但他们身上绝对有点诡异！

english: And I suppose you didn't see anyone acting untoward around them?
translation: 我想你也没看到有人在他们周围行为不端吧？

english: Sorry, can't say as I did...
translation: 抱歉，我没看到……

english: Okay, well thanks anyway.
translation: 好吧，还是谢谢了。

english: Hey, no problem.
translation: 嘿，没问题。

english: So... Any ideas who might have offended the Moon Clan and caused them to place a jinx on the ship?
translation: 那么……有没有想到是谁得罪了月亮部族，导致他们对船下了厄运诅咒？

english: No, I'm afraid I have no idea. I guess it must have happened when we were all on shore leave, but I honestly don't remember much about it...
translation: 不，恐怕我不知道。我猜应该是我们上岸休假时发生的，但我实在记不清了……

english: Hmmm. No ideas at all?
translation: 嗯。一点头绪都没有？

english: Anyone from the crew you think would be particularly offensive to a bunch of highly powerful magic users?
translation: 你觉得船员中有谁特别容易冒犯一群非常强大的魔法使用者？

english: Well, we're something of a mixed bag around here as I'm sure you've noticed, but...
translation: 嗯，你肯定也注意到了，我们这儿什么人都有，但是……

english: Sorry. Nobody springs to mind.
translation: 抱歉。我想不到任何人。

english: Hi. I don't suppose you have any juicy gossip about that trip to Lunar Isle do you?
translation: 嗨。我想你不会有什么关于那次月亮岛之行的劲爆八卦吧？

english: Gossip? Like what?
translation: 八卦？比如什么？

english: I heard a really funny story about the First Mate, the captain's parrot and a coconut!
translation: 我听说了一个关于大副、船长的鹦鹉和一个椰子的非常有趣的故事！

english: No... I was thinking more something about someone behaving very badly and offending the Moon Clan somehow...
translation: 不……我想问的是有没有人行为很恶劣、不知怎么冒犯了月亮部落之类的……

english: Sorry, I wouldn't know anything about that.
translation: 抱歉，我对此一无所知。

english: Hi. Erm, don't take this the wrong way or anything, but are you particularly offensive?
translation: 嗨。呃，别误会，但你是不是特别招人反感？

english: Does your mere presence at any occasion cause young children to start crying, old ladies to faint, that kind of thing?
translation: 你只要一出现，就会让小孩哭起来、老太太晕倒，诸如此类？

english: I'm not sure I like your tone of voice!
translation: 听着，我只想知道，是不是你完全不顾社交礼仪，导致这艘船和船上所有船员被下了诅咒。

english: Look, all I want to know is if your terrible disregard for social niceties has caused a jinx to be levelled upon this ship and all who sail in her.
translation: 听着，我只想知道，是不是你完全不顾社交礼仪，导致这艘船和船上所有的人都中了厄运诅咒。

english: ABSOLUTELY NOT!!!
translation: 绝对没有！！！

english: Okay, thanks! All I wanted to know!
translation: 好的，谢谢！我只想知道这个！

english: I'm looking for somebody who may have offended the Moon Clan on your recent visit to Lunar Isle...
translation: 我在找一个可能在上次去月亮岛时得罪了月亮部族的人……

english: I'm sure I know nothing about that.
translation: 我确定我对此一无所知。

english: Oh. I was hoping you did.
translation: 哦。我还指望你知道呢。

english: [player name] on the bridge, Captain!
translation: [player name]在舰桥，船长！

english: What? Oh, it's you.
translation: 什么？哦，是你啊。

english: You have discovered something about this 'jinx' then?
translation: 这么说，你发现了这个'诅咒'的线索？

english: Well... possibly. Although I'm convinced this is all the navigator's fault. I just don't trust that guy!
translation: 是的，你对领航员的感受已经表达得非常清楚了。

english: Yes, you have made your feelings towards the navigator abundantly clear.
translation: 现在，你对下在我船上的这个诅咒发现了什么？

english: Now what have you discovered about this jinx that has been placed upon my ship?
translation: 嗯……我猜是去月亮岛的登陆队里有人做了什么事冒犯了月亮部落，作为报复，他们对船下了诅咒。

english: Well... I reckon that somebody from the landing party that went to Lunar Isle did something to offend the Moon Clan, and as retaliation they have placed a jinx upon the
translation: 嗯……我猜是上次登陆月亮岛的队伍中有人做了什么事得罪了月亮部族，作为报复，他们对船下了厄运诅咒。

english: ship.
translation: 船。

english: I see. Well, that seems to make sense.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，这似乎说得通。

english: So who was it who has caused this, and how can I lift the jinx?
translation: 那么是谁造成的？我要怎么解除这个诅咒？

english: Um... well... I, uh, didn't find anything out about that yet.
translation: 呃……嗯……我，呃，还没查出来。

english: I see. Well, I suggest you ask the crew if they know anything, and let me know the second you have a solution.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，我建议你去问问船员们知不知道什么，一有办法就立刻告诉我。

english: Assuming you do in fact want to go to Lunar Isle instead of staying here.
translation: 假设你确实想去月亮岛而不是留在这里。

english: Sure thing captain.
translation: 当然，船长。

english: (ahem)
translation: （咳咳）

english: I have heard some terrible, scurrilous rumours about your wanton and depraved behaviour towards the Moon Clan when on shore leave.
translation: 我听说了一些关于你们在岸上休假时对月亮族做出放荡堕落行为的可怕谣言。

english: What? What ARE you talking about?
translation: 什么？你到底在说什么？

english: Oh come now, we all know what you were up to...
translation: 哦，得了吧，我们都知道你干了什么……

english: Your behaviour was so bad that the Moon Clan have brought a terrible curse down upon the ship, trapping it on this gods-forsaken island forever!
translation: 你的行为太恶劣了，导致月亮氏族对船降下了可怕的诅咒，把它永远困在了这个被神遗弃的岛上！

english: Hmmm. Well, I'm sure the crew have more sense than to listen to the insane babble of a stowaway, especially not one whose rantings are designed to cover his own jinxed
translation: 嗯。好吧，我相信船员们有足够的理智，不会听信一个偷渡者的疯言疯语，尤其是一个用胡言乱语来掩盖自己晦气人生的家伙。

english: life.
translation: 人生。

english: So you deny it then?
translation: 所以你否认了？

english: Deny what? You come in here, spouting some random bilge at me, with a flurry of accusations, and expect anyone to take you seriously?
translation: 否认什么？你跑进来，冲我胡说八道一通，劈头盖脸地指控，还指望有人把你当回事？

english: Oh.. erm... Well done. You've passed the test.
translation: 哦……呃……干得好。你通过测试了。

english: Test?
translation: 测试？

english: Yeah... the, uh, loyalty test. The Captain wanted to make sure his crew were all well behaved on their shore leave, so I came up with this little test to make sure you were.
translation: 是啊……呃，忠诚度测试。船长想确保他的船员上岸休假时都规规矩矩的，所以我想出了这个小测试来确认你没问题。

english: And congratulations! You passed!
translation: 恭喜你！你通过了！

english: A stowaway, a jinx, AND a liar.
translation: 一个偷渡者，一个扫把星，还是个骗子。

english: I must say I am extremely glad you are only here temporarily, I would hate for any of my crew to have any sort of dealing with you.
translation: 我得说，我非常庆幸你只是暂时待在这儿，我可不想我的任何一个船员跟你有任何瓜葛。

english: Please make sure you close the door on your way out.
translation: 出去的时候请记得关上门。

english: Erm, 'bye then.
translation: 呃，那再见了。

english: AH-HA! I KNOW it was YOU!
translation: 啊哈！我就知道是你干的！

english: Oh, what is it now?
translation: 哦，又怎么了？

english: Well, it seems that someone must have offended the Moon Clan, so that they put a jinx on the ship!
translation: 嗯，看来是有人得罪了月亮族，所以他们给船下了诅咒！

english: And from what I've seen you're the obvious culprit!
translation: 根据我的观察，你就是最明显的嫌疑犯！

english: This seems once again an effort on your behalf to throw the trail away from your own jinxed self bringing us misfortune.
translation: 这看起来又是你试图转移视线，掩盖你自己这个扫把星给我们带来厄运的事实。

english: So... You didn't offend any Moon Clan while you were on their island?
translation: 那么……你在月亮岛上没有得罪任何月亮族的人？

english: Are you REALLY sure?
translation: 你确定吗？

english: I am the very model of self-restraint. As you should have realised by now, as I haven't yet given the order to have you put to death. Yet.
translation: 我是自我克制的典范。你现在应该已经意识到了，因为我还没下令处死你。暂时还没有。

english: Hum. Are you sure?
translation: 哼。你确定吗？

english: REALLY sure?
translation: 真的确定？

english: Yes. I suggest you check elsewhere.
translation: 是的。我建议你去别处查查。

english: Fine. But I've got my eye on you Mr Navigator!
translation: 好吧。但我可盯着你呢，导航员先生！

english: Yes, and I certainly have my eye on you.
translation: 是的，我当然也盯着你呢。

english: You know that visit to Lunar Isle you lot have just made...?
translation: 你知道你们刚去了一趟月亮岛……？

english: Oh yeah! It was great! They're kind of spooky, but hey, it was a great do they laid on for us!
translation: 哦，是啊！太棒了！他们有点吓人，但嘿，他们为我们准备的招待可真不错！

english: You didn't see anyone, you know, acting inappropriately or anything did you?
translation: 你没看到有人，你知道的，行为不当或者别的什么吧？

english: Um... Anyone doing anything that would offend them?
translation: 嗯……有人做了什么会冒犯他们的事吗？

english: Nope, can't say as I did...
translation: 没有，我没看到……

english: Hmmm. Okay then.
translation: 嗯。那好吧。

english: On Lunar Isle...
translation: 在月亮岛上……

english: You didn't... You know. Do anything offensive towards the Moon Clan did you?
translation: 你没有……你知道的。做什么冒犯月亮族的事吧？

english: Hmmm. Okay, it was worth asking anyway.
translation: 嗯。好吧，反正问问也无妨。

english: 'Bye then.
translation: 那再见了。

english: Seeya.
translation: 回见。

english: I've heard you were a little bit merry on the old Lunar Isle expedition...
translation: 我听说你在上次月亮岛探险时有点得意忘形……

english: Possibly so merry that you did something to offend the Moon Clan and unleash a horrible curse upon us all...
translation: 可能高兴得做了什么事冒犯了月亮氏族，给我们所有人招来了可怕的诅咒……

english: Heavens, no! Just because I'm a pirate doesn't mean I don't treat all cultures no matter how different with the utmost respect!
translation: 天哪，没有！虽然我是个海盗，但这不代表我不会以最大的尊重对待所有文化，无论它们有多不同！

english: So it wasn't you?
translation: 所以不是你？

english: Nope. Sorry.
translation: 不是。抱歉。

english: Quick question: Do you know anyone who offended the Moon Clan on your recent visit?
translation: 问个问题：你知道你们最近去的时候，有谁冒犯了月亮族吗？

english: Quick answer: No.
translation: 简单回答：不知道。

english: Okay, thanks!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: Dude! Duuuuuuude! Dude!
translation: 哥们！哥——们！哥们！

english: I'm sorry, do I know you?
translation: 抱歉，我认识你吗？

english: Dude! How about them Moon Clan, huh?
translation: 哥们！月亮族怎么样，嗯？

english: Wow, we offended them so hard on that shore leave, huh?
translation: 哇，我们那次上岸休假可把他们得罪惨了，是吧？

english: You, uh, didn't do anything to offend the Moon Clan on shore leave, did you?
translation: 你，呃，上岸休假时没做什么冒犯月亮族的事吧？

english: And I look like an idiot now, don't I?
translation: 我现在看起来像个白痴，对吧？

english: You do, yes. Very much so.
translation: 是的，你看起来确实像。非常像。

english: It would probably be best if I just left now, instead of carrying on talking, wouldn't it?
translation: 我最好现在就离开，而不是继续聊下去，对吧？

english: It would, yes.
translation: 是的，最好这样。

english: I'll go and do that then...
translation: 那我就走了……

english: Sorry, the galley's closed fer restockings! Yer'll hafta come back later if'n ye be wanting food!
translation: 抱歉，厨房正在补货，关门了！你要是想吃东西，得等会儿再来！

english: Actually, I'm not after food, I'm after information...
translation: 其实，我不是来找吃的，我是来打听消息的……

english: Wussat? Some kind of alkyhol? If'n it ain't grog, I don't be stocking it!
translation: 啥？是某种酒吗？要不是格罗格酒，我这里可不存！

english: ...Can I just ask you a few questions?
translation: ...我能问你几个问题吗？

english: Aye, that yer may, long'n as yer don't mind me carrying on with me restockings while we talk.
translation: 啊，你可以问，只要你不介意我一边聊天一边继续补货。

english: No, that's fine. I appreciate your time.
translation: 不，没关系。感谢你抽时间。

english: So... I have reason to believe that a jinx has befallen the ship due to someone offending the Moon Clan somehow... I was wondering if you knew anything about that.
translation: 所以……我有理由相信船被下了诅咒，是因为有人不知怎么得罪了月亮族……我想知道你是否了解什么。

english: The Moon Clan yer say? Ah, well I dinna know much about them folks, when everyone else went to that there big old feast I stayed aboard the ship...
translation: 你说月亮族？啊，我对那些人不太了解，其他人去那个盛大的宴会时，我留在船上……

english: I gots ter be honest, I never trust any food I ain't prepared meself!
translation: 老实说，我从不信任不是我亲手准备的食物！

english: Wait... So the whole crew except yourself were at a big feast on Lunar Isle?
translation: 等等……所以除了你之外，全体船员都在月亮岛参加了一个盛大宴会？

english: Was there drink involved at this feast?
translation: 这个宴会上有酒吗？

english: Aye, ter be sure!
translation: 啊，当然有！

english: So a bunch of drunken pirates feasting on Lunar Isle.
translation: 所以是一群喝醉的海盗在月亮岛大吃大喝。

english: I think I have my suspect for when the Moon Clan were offended.
translation: 我想我知道月亮族被冒犯的时候嫌疑犯是谁了。

english: Thanks for the help there, Beefy!
translation: 谢谢你帮忙，比菲！

english: Hi. Did you find the jinx yet?
translation: 嗨。你找到诅咒的来源了吗？

english: Funny you should ask, I have a few questions for you about that.
translation: 你问得正好，我正有几个问题想问你。

english: Oh no... Look, I'm SO SORRY, I SWEAR it wasn't my fault!
translation: 哦不……听着，我非常抱歉，我发誓那不是我的错！

english: Erm, sorry, nothing, what did you want to know?
translation: 呃，抱歉，没什么，你想知道什么？

english: Oh, well, it was about that feast that you all went to on Lunar Isle.
translation: 哦，是关于你们都在月亮岛参加的那个宴会。

english: Oh, the feast, right, yeah, I was definitely there at that, absolutely.
translation: 哦，那个宴会，对，我当然在场，绝对在。

english: So... Did you notice anyone not there? Or anyone acting very rudely to the Moon Clan? Anything like that?
translation: 那么……你有没有注意到谁没去？或者谁对月亮族举止粗鲁？类似的事情？

english: Um, no, no, everyone was there, yup.
translation: 嗯，没有，没有，所有人都去了，是的。

english: Nothing at all?
translation: 一点都没有？

english: Nope, we had a meal and then, um, some other stuff happened...
translation: 没有，我们吃了顿饭，然后，呃，发生了些别的事……

english: Um... And then... Er, we all went to bed for an early night.
translation: 嗯...然后...呃，我们都早早地上床睡觉了。

english: Really? That doesn't sound much like the big raucous feast I've been hearing about from other people...
translation: 真的吗？这听起来和其他人告诉我的那个热闹的宴会不太一样……

english: No, it TOTALLY happened EXACTLY like that. I swear.
translation: 不，事情完全就是那样发生的。我发誓。

english: Hmmm. Weird. Maybe I'm barking up the wrong tree...
translation: 嗯。奇怪。也许我找错方向了……

english: Yup, sounds like it, okay, well 'bye!
translation: 对，听起来是这样，好吧，再见！

english: That big feast in Lunar Isle...
translation: 月亮岛上的那个盛大宴会……

english: Yes? What about it?
translation: 嗯？怎么了？

english: Was everyone there?
translation: 所有人都去了吗？

english: Except for the Captain, I think so, yes.
translation: 除了船长，我想是的。

english: And did you see anyone misbehaving particularly badly?
translation: 你有没有看到谁行为特别不当？

english: No, I don't think I did.
translation: 没有，我不觉得有。

english: Hi. How's the search for the jinx going?
translation: 嗨。寻找厄运的进展如何？

english: Not very well to be honest...
translation: 说实话不太顺利……

english: I think I've worked out that whatever happened to cause the Moon Clan offence and get this ship cursed somehow must have happened at that big feast you all went to, but I'm still no wiser as to what actually
translation: 我想我已经推断出，导致月亮族被冒犯和船被诅咒的事情一定是在你们都参加的那个盛大宴会上发生的，但我仍然不知道到底发生了

english: happened...
translation: 什么……

english: Well, if you think it will help I can tell you everything I remember about the feast...?
translation: 好吧，如果你觉得有用，我可以告诉你我记得关于那个宴会的一切……？

english: Actually yeah, that might help give me some clue as to what happened. Please, go ahead.
translation: 实际上是的，那可能会给我一些线索。请说吧。

english: Well now, let's see...
translation: 那么，让我想想……

english: I recall that we all headed onto the island as we were due shore leave, and the Captain had arranged a big feast with the Moon Clan so that we could kick back and relax.
translation: 我记得我们都上了岛，因为我们该上岸休假了，船长和月亮族安排了一个盛大宴会，这样我们可以放松一下。

english: I think we were all there, but we had a table to ourselves where they just brought us food and wine all evening.
translation: 我想我们都在那里，但我们有自己的桌子，整个晚上他们只给我们送食物和酒。

english: I remember Beefy the cook was being a bit of a killjoy and had stayed on board the ship, and the Captain was having some fancy meal with the Moon Clan toffs, but I'm pretty sure the rest of us were all at the meal...
translation: 我记得厨师比菲有点扫兴，留在了船上，而船长正在和月亮族的头面人物吃一顿精致的餐食，但我很确定我们其他人都在吃饭……

english: Anyway, spirits got a little high later on after we'd finished eating, and I remember Tommy Two-times got out his old fiddle, and we sang and danced all through the night until daybreak when we made our way back
translation: 总之，我们吃完后情绪有点高涨，我记得汤米.两次拿出了他的旧小提琴，我们唱歌跳舞一整夜，直到天亮我们才回到

english: aboard the ship, and set sail.
translation: 船上，然后启航。

english: When you say there were high spirits... You don't think perhaps you accidentally offended the Moon Clan somehow do you?
translation: 你说情绪高涨……你不觉得也许你们不小心冒犯了月亮族吗？

english: No, not at all! A couple of charming Moon Clan members came over and danced along with us!
translation: 不，完全没有！有几个可爱的月亮族成员过来和我们一起跳舞！

english: Well, thanks for the help, but I don't think I'm any closer to solving this whole jinx mystery...
translation: 好吧，谢谢你的帮助，但我觉得我没有更接近解决这个诅咒谜团……
