english: Mother has trolls already who chuck rocks really hard. Also Mother has seen birds - they are not scary.
translation: 母亲已经有扔石头很用力的巨魔了。而且母亲见过鸟——它们并不可怕。

english: Dis bird - it were really big though...
translation: 那只鸟——但它真的很大啊……

english: Mother is not impressed. Have Stronghold trolls nothing else to offer?
translation: 母亲不感兴趣。要塞的巨魔就没有别的可贡献了吗？

english: What we do now, [player name]?
translation: 我们现在怎么办，[player name]？

english: Tell him to show respect to his daughter.
translation: 告诉他要尊重他的女儿。

english: Yeah, My Arm not like how Mother talks to Snowflake.
translation: 是啊，"我的手臂"不喜欢母亲对雪花说话的方式。

english: Mother is boss; Snowflake will obey her father. Arm troll is making Mother angry. Now, what you teaching us?
translation: 母亲是首领；雪花会服从她的父亲。手臂巨魔让母亲生气了。现在，你要教我们什么？

english: Dis not working, [player name]!
translation: 这行不通啊，[player name]！

english: Tell him you love his daughter!
translation: 告诉他你爱他的女儿！

english: Really? If My Arm start talking' bout what My Arm want to do with his daughter, he probably gonna get angry or freaked out.
translation: 真的？如果"我的手臂"开始谈论他想对他女儿做什么，他可能会生气或吓坏。

english: I meant on a more emotional level...
translation: 我指的是更情感层面上的……

english: Mother can hear you! It not matter. Mother's daughter, Snowflake, will marry Don't Know What. Then he can be boss when Mother retires.
translation: 母亲能听见你！没关系。母亲的女儿雪花会嫁给'不知道什么'。这样等母亲退休后他就能当首领了。

english: Trolls need strong boss. Mother kept trolls alive through Mother's strength! Otherwise trolls would have died long ago. Once Mother retires, Don't Know What is strongest.
translation: 巨魔需要强大的首领。母亲靠母亲的力量保护巨魔活了下来！否则巨魔早就灭绝了。一旦母亲退休，'不知道什么'是最强的。

english: So Don't Know What will marry Snowflake and be boss of Weiss. No more talk on this! You arm troll, you teach us something good or go home!
translation: 所以'不知道什么'会娶雪花，成为Weiss的首领。这事不再讨论了！你，手臂巨魔，要么教点有用的东西，要么回家！

english: I'll get back to you in a bit.
translation: 我待会儿再来找你。

english: Sorry, Mother, My Arm got nothing else. But My Arm not want to leave - can My Arm stay please?
translation: 抱歉，母亲，"我的手臂"没有别的了。但"我的手臂"不想离开——"我的手臂"可以留下吗？

english: Arm troll is useless. Get out of here!
translation: 手臂巨魔真没用。滚出去！

english: Oh, [player name], My Arm is being sent home. Stupid big Mother not interested in goutweed. My Arm would prefer to stay with Snowflake.
translation: 哦，[player name]，"我的手臂"要被送回家了。愚蠢的大母亲对痛风草不感兴趣。"我的手臂"更愿意和雪花待在一起。

english: I wish My Arm did not have to leave.
translation: 我希望"我的手臂"不必离开。

english: Mother wasn't very nice to Snowflake in there.
translation: 母亲在里面的时候对雪花不太友善。

english: My father, Mother, did not like me talking to My Arm. Whoever marries me will rule Weiss after Father retires or dies, and Father wishes that to be Don't Know What, the biggest sentry.
translation: 我的父亲，母亲，不喜欢我和"我的手臂"说话。无论谁娶了我，都将在父亲退休或去世后统治魏斯，而父亲希望那个人是"Don't Know What"，最大的哨兵。

english: My Arm not happy 'bout dat.
translation: 我的手臂对此不高兴。

english: My Arm is not as big as Don't Know What, and I think he is less strong too. Father would not approve of him as a suitor for me.
translation: "我的手臂"没有"Don't Know What"那么大，而且我觉得他也更弱。父亲不会同意他作为我的追求者。

english: Mother should mind own business, an' not tell Snowflake who to marry.
translation: 母亲应该管好自己的事，不要告诉雪花该嫁给谁。

english: Father is... horrible to me.
translation: 父亲……对我很苛刻。

english: Snowflake, you seemed to like My Arm.
translation: 雪花，你似乎喜欢"我的手臂"。

english: He is different from other man-trolls. I know already that I want My Arm by my side.
translation: 他和其他男巨魔不同。我已经知道我想要"我的手臂"在我身边。

english: My Arm want that too.
translation: 我的手臂也想要那样。

english: Odd Mushroom, why are you here with us?
translation: 奇特蘑菇，你为什么和我们在一起？

english: Oh, Mother's been annoying me for years. He doesn't care about anything except fighting. Whatever I invent for him, he ignores it completely if he can't use it in combat.
translation: 哦，母亲这些年来一直烦我。他除了战斗什么都不关心。我为他发明的东西，只要不能用于战斗，他就完全忽视。

english: That's why he dismissed My Arm's farming expertise too. He's really holding Weiss back. Trolls should aspire to be more than just lumbering monsters.
translation: 这也是为什么他否定了'我的手臂'的农业专长。他确实在拖Weiss的后腿。巨魔应该追求比笨重怪物更高的目标。

english: Mother won't change himself, and none of us are strong enough to force him, especially with Don't Know What guarding him... but maybe My Arm can help.
translation: 母亲不会改变自己，我们也没有足够的力量强迫他，尤其是有"Don't Know What"保护他...但也许"我的手臂"能帮忙。

english: It sounds like you want My Arm to overthrow Mother for you.
translation: 听起来你想让"我的手臂"为你推翻母亲。

english: I deplore violence. No, I want Mother to let Snowflake marry My Arm, instead of marrying Don't Know What. Snowflake's smart, and she'll rule us better.
translation: 我谴责暴力。不，我希望母亲让雪花嫁给"我的手臂"，而不是嫁给"Don't Know What"。雪花很聪明，她会更好地统治我们。

english: But if she marries Don't Know What, he'll insist on ruling Weiss himself like Mother does - and he's no better than Mother. So I'd rather My Arm stayed here and married Snowflake.
translation: 但如果她嫁给'不知道什么玩意'，他会像母亲一样坚持要自己统治魏斯——而且他并不比母亲好。所以我宁愿'我的手臂'留在这里，娶雪花。

english: The choice should be from my heart, not from anyone else - though I like this plan very much!
translation: 选择应该由我的心来决定，而不是别人——不过我非常喜欢这个计划！

english: My Arm like plan too. My Arm marry Snowflake, an' she become boss of town, an' My Arm teach town to farm goutweed. Yup, good plan.
translation: '我的手臂'也喜欢这个计划。'我的手臂'娶雪花，她成为镇子的首领，'我的手臂'教镇子种植痛风草。是的，好计划。

english: So we will need Mother to gain respect for My Arm, so that he'll consent to the marriage.
translation: 所以我们需要让母亲尊重'我的手臂'，这样他才会同意这桩婚事。

english: How can we get Father to respect My Arm? He likes Don't Know What because Don't Know What is strong, but My Arm is... different.
translation: 我们怎样才能让父亲尊重'我的手臂'？他喜欢'不知道什么玩意'是因为'不知道什么玩意'很强壮，但'我的手臂'是...不同的。

english: Can I kill Mother? That usually solves problems in quests.
translation: 我能杀了母亲吗？通常这在任务里能解决问题。

english: I would prefer you not to kill Father. He is cruel, but he is my blood.
translation: 我希望你不要杀父亲。他很残忍，但他是我血亲。

english: Let's not have any unnecessary killing.
translation: 我们别搞不必要的杀戮。

english: Can My Arm fight Mother?
translation: '我的手臂'能跟母亲打吗？

english: He really big though.
translation: 不过他真的很大。

english: I do not think that would be wise, dear.
translation: 我认为那样做并不明智，亲爱的。

english: Can My Arm fight Don't Know What?
translation: '我的手臂'能跟'不知道什么玩意'打吗？

english: He look dumb, but he kinda big.
translation: 他看起来傻，但他块头不小。

english: He is dumb, but he is big. I think this would not work.
translation: 他是傻，但他块头大。我认为这行不通。

english: Does Mother respect anything except fighting?
translation: 母亲除了战斗还尊重其他东西吗？

english: Mother's strength saved this tribe, in the past. That's how he became chief. He truly believes that if our chief is not physically strong, we will die out.
translation: 母亲的力量在过去拯救了这个部落。他就是那样当上首领的。他真心相信如果我们的首领身体不够强壮，我们就会灭绝。

english: You see, we have not always lived in Weiss. We used to live further south, near the dwarf town they call Keldagrim, until we were driven out...
translation: 你看，我们并不是一直都住在Weiss。我们以前住在更南边，靠近一个叫凯尔达格林城的矮人城镇，直到我们被赶出来……

english: That Wise Young Man drove us out into the barren icy mountains. Without Mother's strength to overcome obstacles and catch food, I believe we would have perished.
translation: 那个聪明的年轻人把我们赶到了荒凉的冰山上。如果没有母亲的力量来克服障碍和捕捉食物，我相信我们早就灭亡了。

english: Did you say the dwarves called that human the 'Wise Young Man'?
translation: 你刚才说矮人们把那个人类叫做'聪明的年轻人'？

english: Yes, that's right. They treated him as a great hero after he drove us out of our tunnels.
translation: 没错。他把我们赶出地道后，他们把他当大英雄看待。

english: I know that Wise Young Man you mentioned! I did a quest with him where we saved a fishing colony. He's the Wise Old Man now.
translation: 我认识你提到的那个聪明的年轻人！我和他一起做了一个任务，我们拯救了一个渔村。他现在是老智者了。

english: You know the mortal enemy of our people! What did you do in the fishing colony with him?
translation: 你认识我们族人的死敌！你和他在渔村做了什么？

english: We killed a lot of trolls.
translation: 我们杀了很多巨魔。

english: Very well. That Wise Young Man killed many of our people, and I am disappointed that you worked with him, but I shall overlook it for My Arm.
translation: 很好。那个聪明的年轻人杀了我们很多人，我很失望你和他合作，但为了'我的手臂'，我会忽略这件事。

english: So if you all hate dis old man, how about My Arm kill him? Then Mother gonna really like My Arm! Old human sounds easy to kill.
translation: 既然你们都恨这个老家伙，那让'我的手臂'杀了他怎么样？那样母亲肯定会喜欢'我的手臂'！老人类听起来很容易杀。

english: I did some fishing and fetched some stuff.
translation: 我钓了些鱼，取了些东西。

english: Very well. That Wise Young Man killed many of our people, and I am glad that you are different from him.
translation: 好吧。那个聪明的年轻人杀了我们很多族人，我很高兴你跟他不一样。

english: Yes! If you kill the human who drove us out from the Keldagrim tunnels, Mother will call you a hero and be pleased for you to marry Snowflake. Can you go and do it?
translation: 对！如果你杀了那个把我们赶出凯尔达格林城地道的人类，母亲就会称你为英雄，并乐意让你娶雪花。你能去办吗？

english: No, My Arm can't kill the Wise Old Man! The Wise Old Man is far too powerful.
translation: 不，'我的手臂'不能杀老智者！老智者太强大了。

english: Dat a shame. But he know you, [player name], an' you helped him in fishy colony place. Maybe you ask him a favour now?
translation: 那太可惜了。但他认识你，[player name]，你在渔村地方帮过他。也许你现在可以请他帮个忙？

english: You're suggesting I ask him to let you kill him, just so that you can marry Snowflake?
translation: 你的意思是让我请他让你杀了他，好让你能娶雪花？

english: Ah, no. He surely won't agree to die. But perhaps he can pretend he's dead, while My Arm tricks Mother into believing it. Can you ask him, [player name]?
translation: 啊，不。他肯定不会同意去死。但也许他可以假装死了，而'我的手臂'骗母亲相信了。你能问问他吗，[player name]？

english: This is a very strange request!
translation: 这个请求还真奇怪！

english: Please ask him, [player name]! For me and My Arm!
translation: 请问问他，[player name]！为了我和'我的手臂'！

english: I'll be back in a moment.
translation: 我马上回来。

english: Snowflake can leave with us. Then she and My Arm can be together, in the Troll Stronghold.
translation: 雪花可以和我们一起离开。这样她和'我的手臂'就能在一起了，在巨魔要塞。

english: Um... thank you for the offer, but...
translation: 呃……谢谢你的提议，但是……

english: Ah. Mother is our chief, and as his daughter, Snowflake is the heir to the throne of Weiss. So Snowflake or her future husband will rule this town. My Arm may be a charming chappy...
translation: 啊。母亲是我们的酋长，作为他的女儿，雪花是魏斯王位的继承人。所以雪花或她未来的丈夫将统治这个镇子。'我的手臂'可能是个迷人的家伙...

english: T'anks, mushroom troll.
translation: 谢谢，蘑菇巨魔。

english: ... but Snowflake shouldn't be expected to run away from Weiss, abandoning what's hers. No, we should try to keep My Arm here.
translation: ...但雪花不应该被期望逃离魏斯，放弃属于她的东西。不，我们应该努力让'我的手臂'留在这里。

english: Have you asked the Wise Old Man to help us? We only need him to pretend to be dead, so My Arm can claim credit for killing him, and impress Father.
translation: 你问过老智者来帮我们了吗？我们只需要他假装死了，这样'我的手臂'就能声称杀了他，给父亲留下好印象。

english: Yes, that would impress Mother very much.
translation: 对，那样肯定能让母亲印象深刻。

english: I've not discussed it with him yet.
translation: 我还没跟他商量过。

english: It's good of you to pop in, [player name]. What brings you to Draynor today?
translation: 欢迎光临，[player name]。今天来德雷诺有什么事吗？

english: My Arm needs your help.
translation: '我的手臂'需要你的帮助。

english: You should see a doctor about your arm.
translation: 你应该找医生看看你的手臂。

english: Not my arm, I mean My Arm.
translation: 不是我的手臂，我是说'我的手臂'。

english: ... you should see a doctor about your brain.
translation: ……你应该找医生看看你的大脑。

english: That's not helping.
translation: 那可帮不上忙。

english: Can you pretend you're dead?
translation: 你能假装死了吗？

english: That looked very strange.
translation: 那看起来太奇怪了。

english: You asked me to pretend I'm dead. That's what I imagine it would be like.
translation: 你让我假装死了，那就是我想象中的样子。

english: Let me explain... A troll called My Arm needs to pretend he's killed you. This will impress his girlfriend's father, Mother.
translation: 让我解释一下...一个叫'我的手臂'的巨魔需要假装杀了你。这会给他女朋友的父亲，母亲，留下好印象。

english: His girlfriend's father, Mother?
translation: 他女朋友的父亲，叫母亲？

english: Yes. You drove Mother's tribe of trolls out of the dwarf tunnels near Keldagrim, long ago, and Mother's hated you ever since.
translation: 对。很久以前，你把他母亲那一族的巨魔从凯尔达格林城附近的矮人地道里赶了出来，母亲从那时起就一直恨你。

english: I remember driving trolls out of those tunnels, yes. So now there's a troll called My Arm who wants to pretend he's killed me in revenge, to impress his girlfriend's father, who is called Mother?
translation: 我记得把巨魔赶出那些隧道，是的。所以现在有一个叫'我的手臂'的巨魔想假装杀了我来报仇，以取悦他女朋友的父亲，那个叫母亲的？

english: That's right. If Mother thinks My Arm has killed you, he'll let My Arm marry his daughter, Snowflake.
translation: 没错。如果母亲认为'我的手臂'杀了你，他就会让'我的手臂'娶他的女儿雪花。

english: Hmmmph. That's quite a big favour you're asking. I've spent much of my life saving people from monsters like that, not providing family mediation services for them.
translation: 哼，你这是在让我帮一个大忙。我这辈子大部分时间都在从那种怪物手里救人，而不是为他们提供家庭调解服务。

english: You'll get rewarded if you help.
translation: 如果你帮忙，你会得到奖励的。

english: I don't think so, thank you. In my experience, a troll's idea of a quest reward is probably something useless like a pile of burnt meat.
translation: 我不这么认为，谢谢。依我的经验，巨魔所谓的任务奖励，很可能是一堆烧焦的肉之类没用的东西。

english: You owe me a favour after the Fishing Colony quest.
translation: 在渔村任务之后，你欠我一个人情。

english: I suppose you did save my life from the Sea Troll Queen. That has to count for something...
translation: 我想你确实从海巨魔女王手里救了我一命。那总得有点价值……

english: Very well, I'll help. I'll need a cadava potion from the Varrock Apothecary, calibrated to suit my age. Also build me a proper mahogany coffin here - I wouldn't be seen dead in a cheap oak or teak one.
translation: 好吧，我帮忙。我需要一瓶来自维洛克城药剂师调制的卡达瓦药水，要校准到适合我的年龄。还有，在这里给我造一口上好的桃花心木棺材——我可不想死后被人看见躺在便宜的橡木或柚木棺材里。

english: Thank you. I'll try to get the potion and build you a coffin here.
translation: 谢谢你。我会尽力去拿药水，并在这里给你造口棺材。

english: I asked you to get me a cadava potion from the Varrock Apothecary, calibrated to suit my age, and to build me a mahogany coffin. How are you getting on?
translation: 我让你去维洛克城药剂师那里拿一瓶适合我年龄的卡达瓦药水，再给我造一口桃花心木棺材。你办得怎么样了？

english: I've not built the coffin yet.
translation: 我还没造好棺材。

english: So I see. Make sure it's mahogany when you do - I wouldn't be seen dead in a cheap oak or teak one. You can build it here.
translation: 我看出来了。造的时候一定要用桃花心木——我可不想死后被人看见躺在便宜的橡木或柚木棺材里。你可以在这里造。

english: I've not got the potion from the Apothecary yet.
translation: 我还没从药剂师那里拿到药水。

english: Really? He's in Varrock, near the south-west corner of the city. He's a funny chap, but he knows his trade.
translation: 真的吗？他在维洛克城，靠近城市西南角。他是个有趣的家伙，但精通自己的手艺。

english: Do you remember the Cadava potion you made for Juliet? Can you make another one for the Wise Old Man? He said you'd need to calibrate the dosage to suit his age.
translation: 你还记得你给朱丽叶做的卡达瓦药水吗？能再给老智者做一瓶吗？他说你需要根据他的年龄来调整剂量。

english: I suppose he'd need a smaller dose than Juliet did, yes. She's a healthy young woman in the prime of her life, while he's been around for decades.
translation: 我想他需要的剂量确实比朱丽叶少，没错。她是个正值壮年的健康年轻女子，而他已经活了几十年了。

english: Well, I'm sure you remember the drill. I'll supply the wing of rat, tail of frog, ear of snake and horn of dog... and you need to bring me some Cadava berries.
translation: 嗯，我相信你还记得流程。我会提供老鼠翅膀、青蛙尾巴、蛇耳朵和狗角...你需要给我带一些卡达瓦莓来。

english: Oh yeah, cadava berries. I'll be back.
translation: 哦对了，卡达瓦莓。我马上回来。

english: Yup, I brought some of those.
translation: 没错，我带了一些。

english: That's very clever. I hope you've got a real feeling of pride and satisfaction from that.
translation: 真聪明。希望你从中获得了真正的自豪感和满足感。

english: Well, I've built the coffin.
translation: 嗯，我已经造好棺材了。

english: Maybe I should have told you to make a gilded one, with a marble pedestal and crystal ornamentation. It would look more fitting... but no, this will do.
translation: 我早该让你造一口镀金的，带大理石基座和水晶装饰的。那样看起来会更合适……不过算了，这个也行。

english: I got the potion from the Apothecary.
translation: 我从药剂师那里拿到药水了。

english: Good. Hand it to me, then let us proceed with this charade.
translation: 好。把它给我，然后我们就继续这场戏吧。

english: Yes, that looks about right. I wouldn't want to drink more than this, or I might risk an overdose. Well, here goes...
translation: 对，看起来差不多。我可不想喝超过这个量，否则可能会有过量的风险。好了，来吧……

english: The Wise Old Man has disguised himself as a corpse in a coffin to help you two.
translation: 老智者把自己伪装成一具棺材里的尸体来帮助你们两个。

english: He very obliging, dis mortal enemy of Weiss. Must have been big favour he owed [player name]. Okieday, give coffin to My Arm, an' My Arm give him to Mother.
translation: 他真是乐于助人，这个魏斯的死敌。一定是欠了[player name]一个大人情。好吧，把棺材给'我的手臂'，然后'我的手臂'把他交给母亲。

english: Okieday, now My Arm has Wise Old Man in box! We go show Mother now. Maybe he like My Arm for killing big enemy of trolls.
translation: 好吧，现在'我的手臂'把老智者装在盒子里了！我们现在去给母亲看。也许他会因为'我的手臂'杀了巨魔的大敌而喜欢他。

english: Here, Mother, look what My Arm done! My Arm done killed your old enemy! He kick you out of Keldagrim long back, now My Arm got him dead in gift-box!
translation: 给，母亲，看看'我的手臂'做了什么！'我的手臂'杀了你的老敌人！他很久以前把你赶出了凯尔达格林城，现在'我的手臂'把他装在礼物盒里弄死了！

english: My Arm did this? My Arm killed him?
translation: '我的手臂'做的？'我的手臂'杀了他？

english: My Arm is clearly a great warrior, beyond the skills of any Weiss troll. We should welcome him into the tribe.
translation: '我的手臂'显然是个伟大的战士，超越了魏斯任何巨魔的技能。我们应该欢迎他加入部落。

english: Yeah, let My Arm stay in Weiss please. Also, can My Arm marry your daughter?
translation: 是啊，请让'我的手臂'留在魏斯吧。还有，'我的手臂'能娶你的女儿吗？

english: Huh. Mother must think about that. But look at this body here...
translation: 哼。母亲得想想。但看看这具尸体……

english: What kind of fight was this? Where is the blood? When Mother kills an enemy, there is blood. Much blood. Blood, brains, gut juices.
translation: 这是什么样的战斗？血在哪？母亲杀敌人的时候，是有血的。很多血。血、脑浆、肠汁。

english: This old man could have died of old age in his sleep. How is that revenge for what he did to Mother? And to Mother's people?
translation: 这个老人家可能是在睡梦中老死的。这怎么算是对他对母亲做过的事的报复？对他对母亲族人的事的报复？

english: Come on, Mother. That man was our mortal enemy, and now My Arm's brought us his corpse. Accept My Arm as a friend and let's move on like civilised people.
translation: 得了吧，母亲。那个人是我们的死敌，现在'我的手臂'把他的尸体带来了。接受'我的手臂'作为朋友，让我们像文明人一样继续前进。

english: You shut up, Odd Mushroom! Always talking about moving on, talking about civilising, talking about progress - what kind of troll are you?
translation: 你闭嘴，奇特蘑菇！老是在说什么继续前进，说什么文明，说什么进步——你算是什么样的巨魔？

english: You messed up Mother's daughter - she uses long words like you, talks about leading trolls into future.
translation: 你把我女儿带坏了——她说跟你一样的长词，说什么带领巨魔走向未来。

english: She needs to marry proper troll, like Don't Know What, and remember how trolls are. Don't Know What can lead tribe for real.
translation: 她需要嫁给一个正经的巨魔，比如'不知道什么'，并且记住巨魔该是什么样。'不知道什么'才能真正领导部落。

english: Stop it, Father! You cannot tell me how to think, or how to live, or how to love. And I will be with My Arm.
translation: 住口，父亲！你不能告诉我该怎么想，怎么活，或者怎么爱。我要和'我的手臂'在一起。

english: I am Mother. I am your father, and you will obey me! This Arm troll brings nothing but trouble, and Mother does not trust him. In fact...
translation: 我是母亲。我是你父亲，你必须服从我！这个手臂巨魔只会带来麻烦，母亲不信任他。事实上……

english: * snore *
translation: *打鼾声*

english: Um... Don't worry, Mother, this is totally normal for a dead wizard. It's the magic escaping from the cadaver...
translation: 呃……别担心，母亲，这对于一个死去的魔法师来说完全正常。是魔法从尸体里跑出来了……

english: * parp *
I don't remember Juliet doing that!
translation: 我不记得朱丽叶会这样！

english: A TRICK!
translation: 有诈！

english: Those salt formations are really quite remarkable. Your troll friends are having a private moment, so I'll study these while my head recovers from that potion.
translation: 那些盐晶构造真是相当了不起。你的巨魔朋友们正在私下里谈话，所以我在脑子从药水里恢复过来的时候，先研究研究这些。

english: Snowflake, are you there? Reason tells me there is light in here, but my mind sees darkness.
translation: 雪花，你在吗？理智告诉我这里有光，但我的心里却一片黑暗。

english: Snowflake?
translation: 雪花？

english: I am here. Father did not hurt me much. Can you stand, Odd Mushroom?
translation: 我在这里。父亲没怎么伤到我。你能站起来吗，奇特蘑菇？

english: ... no, I don't think so. I am glad you are here with me, Snowflake. I must tell you something...
translation: ……不，我想不行。我很高兴你在这里陪着我，雪花。我有件事必须告诉你……

english: I can smell that Mother has lit a Fire of Domination, up above. He never cared for most of my inventions, but he liked that one.
translation: 我能闻到母亲在上面点燃了支配之火。他从来不怎么在乎我的大多数发明，但他喜欢那个。

english: That's the one that traps his enemies, and helps him beat them to a pulp. Definitely his favourite. He must intend to kill you all.
translation: 那个火能困住他的敌人，帮他痛扁他们。绝对是他的最爱。他肯定打算把你们都杀了。

english: Fire of Domination?
translation: 支配之火？

english: ... I suppose I have no secrets, now, even from the age- old enemy of Weiss. But you and I are thinkers, and in other circumstances we might have been friends.
translation: ……我想我现在没有秘密了，即使是对魏斯的世仇也一样。但你和我都是思考者，在其他情况下，我们说不定能成为朋友。

english: These salts in the mine - I invented ways to combine them, unlock their power. In a fire, they can work wonders.
translation: 矿里的这些盐——我发明了组合它们、释放它们力量的方法。在火焰中，它们能创造奇迹。

english: The Fire of Domination will block teleportation magicks, and it also aids Mother in a fight. It makes him incredibly dangerous.
translation: 支配之火会阻止传送魔法，还会在战斗中帮助母亲。这让他变得极其危险。

english: So we can't teleport out of here?
translation: 所以我们不能传送出去？

english: That hole leads down to the sea. But it's far too narrow for a troll to get through.
translation: 那个洞通向大海。但对巨魔来说太窄了，过不去。

english: My Arm not want to enter smelly hole!
translation: '我的手臂'不想进发臭的洞！

english: I don't think I could get in there either, even if the smell weren't abhorrent. But [player name] might be able to fit.
translation: 我想我也进不去，就算那气味没那么难闻也不行。但[player name]也许能钻进去。

english: I'll never leave you.
translation: 我绝不会离开你们。

english: You good friend, [player name].
translation: 你是好朋友，[player name]。

english: Anyway, Odd Mushroom was telling us about the fires he'd invented.
translation: 总之，奇特蘑菇刚才在讲他发明的火焰。

english: I wrote down my inventions, but many of my notes are lost. Mother only ever cared about the Fire of Domination, and fires he could use for combat.
translation: 我写下了我的发明，但我的许多笔记都丢失了。母亲只关心支配之火，以及他能用于战斗的火。

english: It can be hard to interest trolls in the delicate skill of Firemaking, sometimes. But perhaps Snowflake can find my lost notes, and carry on the science. She's far smarter than her father.
translation: 有时候，要让巨魔对生火这门精细技艺感兴趣并不容易。但也许雪花能找到我丢失的笔记，继续这项科学。她比她父亲聪明多了。

english: But I never invented a fire that could stave off the eternal dark, and... I feel it coming.
translation: 但我从未发明出一种能抵御永恒黑暗的火，而且……我感觉它要来了。

english: Snowflake, you must take over Weiss. You saw what Mother did to you, and to me, and to My Arm. Trolls will never be more than thuggish monsters as long as he rules.
translation: 雪花，你必须接管魏斯。你看到母亲对你，对我，对'我的手臂'做了什么。只要他统治，巨魔就永远只是暴徒般的怪物。

english: Mother did hit My Arm pretty hard.
translation: 母亲确实把'我的手臂'打得很重。

english: I know what I must do. With My Arm at my side, I will avenge you. You were always more of a father to me than Mother ever could be.
translation: 我知道我必须做什么。有'我的手臂'在我身边，我会为你报仇。你对我来说一直比母亲更像父亲。

english: Thank you, child...
translation: 谢谢你，孩子……

english: I am glad you are here with me, Snowflake. I must tell you something...
translation: 我很高兴你在这里陪着我，雪花。我必须告诉你一件事……

english: Perhaps Snowflake can find my notes, where I wrote down my inventions. Then she can carry on the science. She's far smarter than her father.
translation: 也许雪花能找到我的笔记，我记录下了我的发明。然后她就能继续科学研究。她比她父亲聪明得多。

english: Jolly good - let's go and tell Mother that My Arm has defeated the mortal enemy of Weiss, the Wise Young Man! Then Mother will surely let My Arm marry Snowflake.
translation: 太好了——我们去告诉母亲，'我的手臂'打败了魏斯的死敌，聪明的年轻人！那样母亲肯定会让'我的手臂'娶雪花的。

english: No thank you, [player name].
translation: 不用了，谢谢，[player name]。

english: Oh, jolly good. Now hand him over to My Arm, and let's try to fool Mother into thinking My Arm killed the man.
translation: 哦，太好了。现在把他交给'我的手臂'，让我们试着骗母亲，让她以为是'我的手臂'杀了那个人。

english: That'll be handy if I feel like escaping.
translation: 如果我想逃跑，那会很有用。

english: My Arm, [player name], Old Man, we are going to get out of here, and punish my father for what he has done.
translation: '我的手臂'，[player name]，老头，我们要离开这里，并惩罚我父亲的所作所为。

english: You have my support.
translation: 我支持你。

english: And My Arm.
translation: 还有'我的手臂'。

english: I hate to be indelicate, but... it may not be possible to overthrow Mother without killing him, especially if the fire makes him as dangerous as Odd Mushroom said.
translation: 我不想说得太直白，但是……不杀死母亲可能无法推翻他，尤其是如果那火让他像奇特蘑菇说的那样危险。

english: Father killed Odd Mushroom. Odd Mushroom was like a father to me. Mother must pay the price. Also I think he really will kill us all.
translation: 父亲杀了奇特蘑菇。奇特蘑菇对我来说就像父亲一样。母亲必须付出代价。而且我觉得他真的会杀了我们所有人。

english: [player name], you heard Odd Mushroom's warning. We can't use our teleport magicks, so the only escape - for you - is down the smelly hole.
translation: [player name]，你听到了奇特蘑菇的警告。我们不能使用传送魔法，所以唯一的逃生之路——对你来说——就是下到发臭的洞里。

english: Also, if we drop anything in here, I bet you're not going to be able to retrieve it. Items dropped in here will be lost forever.
translation: 另外，如果我们在这里掉落任何东西，我打赌你无法找回。在这里掉落的物品将永远丢失。

english: So I can't teleport, and I may lose stuff? Okay.
translation: 所以我不能传送，还可能丢失东西？好吧。

english: [player name] is brave human an' good friend for My Arm and Snowflake!
translation: [player name]是勇敢的人类，是'我的手臂'和雪花的好朋友！

english: Old Man, do your magic and open that door!
translation: 老人，用你的魔法打开那扇门！

english: Aargh - they're out!
translation: 啊——他们出来了！

english: I'm not ready to fight yet.
translation: 我还没准备好战斗。

english: Okieday, we hang around here until you are.
translation: 好的，我们在这儿等着，直到你准备好。

english: ... so you two kill the stupid Arm troll and the human it brought with it. Mother will sort Snowflake out permanently.
translation: ……所以你们两个杀了那个愚蠢的手臂巨魔和它带来的人类。母亲会永久解决雪花。

english: Mother cannot mean to kill Snowflake, surely?
translation: 母亲肯定不是要杀雪花吧？

english: You want to do it yourself?
translation: 你想自己动手？

english: Um... that was not what I meant.
translation: 呃……我不是那个意思。

english: Question Mother again, and it will be your blood that Mother drinks instead. Snowflake betrayed her father, and Mother does not forgive.
translation: 再质疑母亲，母亲喝的就是你的血。雪花背叛了她的父亲，母亲不会原谅。

english: We are not happy about this.
translation: 我们对此很不高兴。

english: Mother does not need you to be happy. Mother requires only that you obey, or die. We are trolls, not softy liberals like Snowflake.
translation: 母亲不需要你高兴。母亲只要求你服从，否则死。我们是巨魔，不是像雪花那样的软心自由派。

english: OLD MAN IN THE DUNGEON!
translation: 地牢里的老人！

english: OLD MAN IN THE DUNGEON! Thought you ought to know.
translation: 地牢里的老人！觉得你应该知道。

english: Of course he is in the dungeon. Mother put him there.
translation: 他当然在地牢里。母亲把他关在那里的。

english: Mother told the arm troll to go home. You go away too, human.
translation: 母亲让手臂巨魔回家去。你也走开，人类。

english: Hahaha! Mother does not believe little arm troll could kill anything. Arm troll is useless. Get him out of Weiss.
translation: 哈哈哈！母亲可不相信小小的手臂巨魔能杀死任何东西。手臂巨魔毫无用处。把他赶出韦斯。

english: Just go away, human.
translation: 快走开，人类。

english: Farming is a stupid skill for a man-troll. Proper man-troll should use his muscles. You teach us something better than that, or you get out and not come back!
translation: 农业对于一个男性巨魔来说是愚蠢的技能。真正的男性巨魔应该用他的肌肉。你教我们点更好的东西，否则就滚出去别再回来！

english: Mother is not interested in what human wants to show. Go away.
translation: 母亲对人类想展示的东西不感兴趣。走开。

english: The arm troll talks of farming, and talks of love. Mother has no use for these. Arm troll has nothing to offer, so he must go home.
translation: 手臂巨魔谈农业，还谈爱情。母亲对此毫无兴趣。手臂巨魔没什么能提供的，所以他必须回家。

english: When he goes, you make sure you go too. Mother does not like humans.
translation: 他走的时候，你最好也跟着走。母亲不喜欢人类。

english: No, I mean he got out.
translation: 不，我是说他出来了。

english: We got him!
translation: 我们抓住他了！

english: My Arm sorry 'bout your dad, Snowflake. But he kinda gonna kill us, anyway.
translation: '我的手臂'对你父亲的事感到难过，雪花。但他反正有点想杀了我们。

english: I am sorry too. Father was flawed, but he did much for our people, and he should have retired with honour long ago.
translation: 我也很难过。父亲有缺陷，但他为我们的人民做了很多，他早就应该光荣退休了。

english: Old Man, [player name], thank you both for your help.
translation: 老人、[player name]，感谢你们俩的帮助。

english: I'm not sure this was my proudest adventure, but you're welcome. I think I'll head off home to Draynor quite soon.
translation: 我不确定这是我最自豪的冒险，但不用谢。我想我很快就会回德雷诺的家了。

english: Very well. You will always be welcome here. Now, that is enough of the past. I feel the future beginning in Weiss... Let us summon my tribe.
translation: 很好。你在这里永远受欢迎。现在，过去的事就到此为止。我感觉未来在魏斯开始……让我们召唤我的部落。

english: Trolls of Weiss, I am Snowflake, daughter of Mother, my father. Mother is dead, and I claim the throne.
translation: 魏斯的巨魔们，我是雪花，母亲（我的父亲）的女儿。母亲死了，我要求继承王位。

english: Yup, My Arm helped Snowflake kill him.
translation: 是的，'我的手臂'帮雪花杀了他。

english: Let's not emphasise that bit now, eh?
translation: 我们现在别强调那一点了，嗯？

english: Does any troll here challenge me?
translation: 这里有巨魔要挑战我吗？

english: Nope, we like Snowflake.
translation: 不，我们喜欢雪花。

english: Snowflake nicer than Mother. We okay with Snowflake.
translation: 雪花比母亲好。我们接受雪花。

english: Then the throne of Weiss is mine. I also call you to witness our marriage. [player name], please step forward.
translation: 那么魏斯王座是我的了。我也请你们见证我们的婚礼。[player name]，请上前。

english: I, Snowflake, give myself to My Arm. I take My Arm as my support and comforter. I will hold My Arm by my side for life.
translation: 我，雪花，将自己献给'我的手臂'。我接受'我的手臂'作为我的支持和安慰者。我将一生与'我的手臂'携手同行。

english: My Arm is my friend forever. I will share the sorrows of life with My Arm, and I will share the joys of love with My Arm.
translation: '我的手臂'是我永远的朋友。我将与'我的手臂'分享生活的悲伤，也将与'我的手臂'分享爱的喜悦。

english: My Arm will support Snowflake. My Arm will be at Snowflake's side. My Arm takes Snowflake by the hand for life.
translation: '我的手臂'会支持雪花。'我的手臂'会在雪花身边。'我的手臂'会一生牵着雪花的手。

english: My Arm will be Snowflake's companion when sun shines an' life is bright. My Arm will be Snowflake's comfort in dark places.
translation: 当阳光普照、生活美好时，'我的手臂'会是雪花的伴侣。在黑暗之处，'我的手臂'会是雪花的慰藉。

english: I pronounce you husband and wife!
translation: 我宣布你们结为夫妻！

english: We now perform the ancient dance of love...
translation: 我们现在表演古老的爱情之舞……

english: Well, that was jolly charming, but I'm off now. Good bye.
translation: 嗯，那真是非常迷人，但我现在要走了。再见。

english: Sure would have been easier gettin' up to dis place if My Arm could do tellypot like dat!
translation: 如果'我的手臂'能像那样传送，上这地方肯定容易多了！

english: [player name], we owe you so much, and we will thank you - but we still need one small favour first.
translation: [player name]，我们欠你很多，我们会感谢你——但我们还需要你先帮一个小忙。

english: You need... one small favour...? I've heard that said before.
translation: 你需要……一个小忙……？我以前听过这话。

english: Yup, you good at dis stuff. My Arm been telling Snowflake how you fetched all kinda stuff to Stronghold for My Arm before.
translation: 是的，你很擅长这个。'我的手臂'一直在告诉雪花你以前是怎么为'我的手臂'把各种东西运到要塞的。

english: ... yes, as an experienced adventurer, I have indeed fetched stuff for people.
translation: ……是的，作为一个有经验的冒险者，我确实为人们取过东西。

english: Good. Now please fetch us some goat dung. You should find some in the goat pen outside. Meanwhile I need to assign some of my trolls to different duties around Weiss.
translation: 好。现在请给我们取些山羊粪。你应该在外面山羊圈里找到一些。同时我需要分配一些我的巨魔在魏斯各处担任不同的职责。

english: What do you want with goat dung?
translation: 你要山羊粪做什么？

english: I think it will be useful to us. You will see why soon enough.
translation: 我觉得它对我们有用。你很快就会知道为什么。

english: Okay, I'll be back.
translation: 好的，我马上回来。

english: This is the kind of thing that's best carried in buckets.
translation: 这种东西最好用桶来装。

english: Have you got the goat dung?
translation: 你拿到山羊粪了吗？

english: No, I've not got any goat dung yet.
translation: 不，我还没拿到山羊粪。

english: You should find some in the goat pen outside. Meanwhile I need to assign some of my trolls to different duties around Weiss.
translation: 你应该在外面山羊圈里找到一些。同时我需要分配一些我的巨魔在魏斯各处担任不同的职责。

english: My Arm, what do you think, dear?
translation: '我的手臂'，你觉得呢，亲爱的？

english: My Arm t'inks dis gonna work, yeah!
translation: '我的手臂'觉得这能行，是啊！

english: Good! My Arm said you needed camel dung to grow goutweed. But goat dung is similar enough - I will make my trolls build farming patches from goat dung instead.
translation: 好！'我的手臂'说你需要骆驼粪来种痛风草。但山羊粪也差不多——我会让我的巨魔用山羊粪代替来建造种植区。

english: She got trolls to use goat poo to make two herb patches! One for us to grow goutweed, an' one for you, 'cos you been good friend. We protect your stuff from disease.
translation: 她让巨魔用山羊粪做了两个草药地块！一个给我们种痛风草，一个给你，因为你是好朋友。我们会保护你的作物免受疾病。

english: I have searched through Odd Mushroom's possessions. Sadly much of his research has been lost. I have copied what I could find into a book for you.
translation: 我搜遍了奇特蘑菇的遗物。遗憾的是他的许多研究都丢失了。我把能找到的抄录成了一本书给你。

english: He would have wanted you to have it - some of his inventions are not useful here, but you are a traveller and may find places to use them.
translation: 他会希望你能拥有它——他的一些发明在这里没用，但你是旅行者，可能会找到使用它们的地方。

english: You give it looksie now, an' see if you learn good stuff! Go on, Snowflake work hard on dis for you!
translation: 你现在看看它，看看能不能学到好东西！去吧，雪花为你辛苦做了这个！

english: You read book from Snowflake yet? She work hard on it for you.
translation: 你读了雪花给你的书了吗？她为你辛苦做了它。

english: Not yet. I've got it here.
translation: 还没。我把它带在身上。

english: I read that book you gave me.
translation: 我读了你给我的那本书。

english: Good! Now you know all Odd Mushroom's fire learnings, an' maybe they be useful to you.
translation: 好！现在你知道奇特蘑菇所有的火焰知识了，也许它们对你有用。

english: When we have finished here, I would like you to try the Fire of Nourishment. Although Boulder made two herb patches as we told him, crops will not grow without such a fire to strengthen them.
translation: 我们在这里完成后，我希望你尝试滋养之火。虽然巨石按照我们说的做了两个草药地块，但没有这样的火来增强它们，作物不会生长。

english: Herbie patches are outside Weiss, through gap in fence, west of town. One patch is for you, an' Boulder gonna protect it from disease for you.
translation: 草药地块在魏斯外面，穿过栅栏的缝隙，在镇子西边。一个地块是给你的，巨石会保护它免受疾病。

english: I'll bear it in mind. Through the gap in the fence, to the west of the town, you say?
translation: 我会记住的。穿过栅栏的缝隙，在镇子西边，你是说？

english: That is right, [player name]. You can mine the salts in the cave below, next to the prison.
translation: 没错，[player name]。你可以在下面的洞穴里开采盐，就在监狱旁边。

english: Now, let us thank you for bringing us together, for saving our lives and for marrying us...
translation: 现在，让我们感谢你让我们团聚，救了我们的命，并为我们主持婚礼……

english: Are you Erin?
translation: 你是艾琳吗？

english: That I am. What do you want? You realise I'm working here.
translation: 正是我。你想干嘛？你应该知道我正在工作。

english: This shouldn't take too long. I just want to ask you a bit about your great Grandfather, the one who lived in the outpost?
translation: 不会耽误你太久。我只是想问问你关于你曾祖父的事，就是那个住在前哨站的人？

english: I'm doing some research for a man called Jorral. Apparently the King is going to make the outpost into his very own alchemists' lab.
translation: 我在帮一个叫乔拉尔的人做研究。据说国王打算把那个前哨站改造成他自己的炼金术实验室。

english: That can only cause chaos! Well, my great Grandfather lived and died there according to my mother, but even she knows very little about him.
translation: 那只会带来混乱！嗯，据我母亲说，我的曾祖父在那里出生，也在那里去世，但就连她对他也不甚了解。

english: The only thing I have of his is a key. It's a strange key, it changes temperature by itself as you walk around. I'm afraid I don't know what it's for though.
translation: 我唯一从他那里得到的东西就是一把钥匙。这是一把奇怪的钥匙，你走动的时候它会自己改变温度。不过，恐怕我也不知道它是用来干什么的。

english: Well, I imagine it's to some sort of chest of his belongings as it's too small for a door. Perhaps if you find some of his belongings you will discover some clues amongst them.
translation: 嗯，我猜它是用来开某个存放他物品的箱子的，因为它太小了，不像是开门的钥匙。也许如果你找到他的一些遗物，就能从中发现一些线索。

english: It's better than nothing. Will you lend it to me then?
translation: 总比没有好。那你愿意把它借给我吗？

english: Why not. I can't use it anyway. Try feeling its change in temperature as you walk around.
translation: 有何不可。反正我也用不了。试着在你走动时感受它的温度变化吧。

english: Keep trying. Have you noticed that the key changes temperature as you walk around?
translation: 继续试试。你有没有注意到，当你走动时，钥匙的温度会发生变化？

english: Hi. I found a chest.
translation: 嗨。我找到了一个箱子。

english: Best you look inside then.
translation: 那你最好看看里面。

english: Would you like to see the journal I have found?
translation: 你想看看我找到的日志吗？

english: Very interesting. Best you show it to Jorral at the outpost.
translation: 非常有趣。你最好把它拿给前哨站的乔拉尔看看。

english: I was just about to. Do you want the key back?
translation: 我正打算去。你想要回钥匙吗？

english: Keep it, it may come in handy.
translation: 你留着吧，也许以后用得着。

english: I found a journal!
translation: 我找到了一本日志！

english: Good work. Let's see what it says.
translation: 干得好。让我们看看上面写了什么。

english: The person who wrote the journal spent time living in the outpost, following the order of Zamorak.
translation: 写这本日志的人曾在前哨站住过一段时间，追随萨莫拉克的教义。

english: He talks of all the nasty things they did to the people of Ardougne, which I don't care to mention! It looks like they were stopped by someone. But it doesn't say who.
translation: 他提到了他们对阿多尼城人民做的所有那些恶心事，我就不细说了！看起来他们是被某个人阻止了。但没说那个人是谁。

english: Hello. Are you Droalak?
translation: 你好。你是德罗拉克吗？

english: Wow. I haven't spoken to the living for... for... I don't remember how long.
translation: 哇。我已经很久……很久……没和活人说过话了，久到我都记不清了。

english: So your name IS Droalak?
translation: 所以你的名字确实是德罗拉克？

english: Sorry, yes I am he.
translation: 抱歉，是的，我就是。

english: Great. Do you know anything about the outpost North of Ardougne?
translation: 太好了。你知道阿多尼城北边那个前哨站的事吗？

english: I don't really like to talk about it, but I died there.
translation: 我不太想谈这个，但我死在那里。

english: I do have a scroll which might interest you that describes the timeline of the outpost. But first I wonder if I could ask you to tie up a problem?
translation: 我确实有一份卷轴，你可能会感兴趣，它描述了前哨站的时间线。但首先，我想知道能否请你帮我解决一个麻烦？

english: Well, I left to go to the outpost against the wishes of my wife. I promised I would return to her, but obviously I did not as I died there. She's a ghost nearby, but won't listen to my apologies.
translation: 嗯，我当初是违背妻子的意愿前往前哨站的。我答应她会回来，但显然我没能回去，因为我死在了那里。她就在附近，成了一个幽灵，但不愿接受我的道歉。

english: You want me to patch things up?
translation: 你想让我去调解一下？

english: Yes, how'd you guess?
translation: 是的，你怎么猜到的？

english: Call it 'traveller's intuition'.
translation: 就当是‘旅行者的直觉’吧。

english: OK, well perhaps you could give her a strung sapphire amulet, because this is what I gave her the day I left. Her name is Melina by the way.
translation: 好吧，也许你可以给她一条串好的蓝宝石护符，因为这是我离开那天送给她的。对了，她的名字叫梅琳娜。

english: I have a sapphire amulet!
translation: 我有一条蓝宝石护符！

english: I said it needed to be a STRUNG sapphire amulet - best get some string!
translation: 我说的是需要一条串好的蓝宝石护符——最好去找点线来！

english: Good work. Just give it to Melina, who's wandering somewhere nearby.
translation: 干得好。把它交给梅琳娜就行了，她就在附近游荡。

english: What do you want me to do again?
translation: 你再说一遍要我做什么？

english: Make a strung sapphire amulet and give it to Melina!
translation: 做一条串好的蓝宝石护符，然后交给梅琳娜！

english: Ok. Ok.
translation: 好吧。好吧。

english: Oh why did he leave me? Did he truly love me?
translation: 哦，他为什么要离开我？他真的爱过我吗？

english: Erm. I think you're talking about Droalak. I believe he did love you and he's very sorry for leaving you!
translation: 呃。我想你是在说德罗拉克。我相信他确实爱过你，而且他对离开你感到非常抱歉！

english: You're giving me empty words. That is all.
translation: 你只是在说空话。仅此而已。

english: If you don't mind me asking, are you Melina?
translation: 如果你不介意我问一下，你是梅琳娜吗？

english: That I am. What's it to you?
translation: 正是我。关你什么事？

english: I've been talking to Droalak. I believe he left you but never returned.
translation: 我和德罗拉克谈过了。我相信他离开了你，但再也没有回来。

english: He did. I suppose he has asked you to tell me he's sorry. What an empty gesture!
translation: 他确实如此。我猜他让你来告诉我他很抱歉。真是虚情假意！

english: Well actually he told me to give you this amulet.
translation: 嗯，实际上他让我把这个护符给你。

english: A sapphire amulet! He remembers! It's just like the one he gave me before he left.
translation: 一条蓝宝石护符！他还记得！就像他离开前送我的那条一样。

english: I honestly believe he's sorry.
translation: 我真的相信他很抱歉。

english: I'm so glad. Please, tell him I forgive him!
translation: 我太高兴了。请告诉他，我原谅他了！

english: At last I feel complete. Fare well.
translation: 我终于感到圆满了。愿你安好。

english: Oh why did he leave me?
translation: 哦，他为什么要离开我？

english: I've given her the amulet. She was very pleased and said she just wanted to know you still cared.
translation: 我已经把护符给她了。她非常高兴，说她只是想确认你还在乎她。

english: Excellent! I am so glad she believes me. I can finally rest in peace.
translation: 太好了！我很高兴她相信了我。我终于可以安息了。

english: Could I have that scroll you mentioned first?
translation: 我能先要你之前提到的那份卷轴吗？

english: Of course. Let me know if it was of any use and then I can be forever free.
translation: 当然可以。告诉我它有没有用，这样我就能永远解脱了。

english: Thank's for the scroll, but I seem to have lost it.
translation: 谢谢你的卷轴，但我好像把它弄丢了。

english: It's a good job I stuck around then isn't it! Have another copy.
translation: 幸好我还没走，对吧！再给你一份副本。

english: Take that scroll to Jorral in the outpost.
translation: 把那份卷轴拿到前哨站给乔拉尔。

english: I have been in contact with the ghost you suggested, and I've recovered this:
translation: 我已经按照你的建议联系了那个幽灵，并且找到了这个：

english: Very interesting. So there was a great battle at the outpost. Then one of the survivors became king, and the other started the market place. Good work.
translation: 非常有趣。原来前哨站发生过一场大战。然后其中一个幸存者成了国王，另一个则建立了市场。干得好。

english: Look, I don't have time for weaklings, if you want conversation, talk to my brother Blanin!
translation: 听着，我没时间搭理弱者，如果你想聊天，去找我兄弟布拉宁！

english: Hello there. Are you the brother of Dron?
translation: 你好。你是德隆的兄弟吗？

english: That I am. Why? Has he killed one of your family?
translation: 正是我。怎么了？他杀了你的家人吗？

english: Not that I know of...
translation: 据我所知没有……

english: Oh good, how can I help you?
translation: 哦，那就好，我能帮你什么？

english: Well I'd like to talk to your brother Dron about the outpost North of Ardougne.
translation: 嗯，我想和你兄弟德隆谈谈关于阿多尼城北边那个前哨站的事。

english: I'm afraid he's not easy to talk to, so it's good that you came to see me. You'll need to remember a few things when talking to him.
translation: 恐怕他不太好说话，所以你来找我是对的。和他说话时，你需要记住几件事。

english: You must be firm with him and don't mention that I sent you. In case he asks, he wields an iron mace in battle, eats rats for breakfast, kittens for lunch and bunnies for tea!
translation: 你必须对他态度强硬，而且别提是我让你去的。万一他问起来，他战斗时用的是铁制钉锤，早餐吃老鼠，午餐吃小猫，下午茶吃兔子！

english: His favorite drink is red spider blood, he's 36 years, 8 months and 21 days old, studies famous battles of the Fourth and Fifth ages, lives on the North East side of town and his, erm... pet cat is called Fluffy.
translation: 他最喜欢的饮料是红蜘蛛血，他今年36岁8个月零21天大，研究第四和第五纪元的著名战役，住在城镇的东北边，还有，呃……他的宠物猫叫毛毛。

english: I know this sounds strange but Dron won't talk to anyone unless they know him well - he's a secretive guy.
translation: 我知道这听起来很奇怪，但德隆不会和任何不熟悉他的人说话——他是个很隐秘的人。

english: Making progress?
translation: 有进展吗？

english: Sure. You must be firm with him and don't mention that I sent you. In case he asks, he wields an iron mace in battle, eats rats for breakfast, kittens for lunch and bunnies for tea.
translation: 当然。你必须对他强硬点，而且不要提是我让你去的。以防他问起，就说他在战斗中挥舞铁制钉锤，早餐吃老鼠，午餐吃小猫，下午茶吃兔子。

english: Just remember those points when you speak to Dron. He's nearby, so you should still be able to find him.
translation: 跟德隆说话时记住这些要点。他就在附近，你应该还能找到他。

english: His favorite drink is red spider blood, he's 36 years, 8 months and 21 days old, he studies famous battles of the Fourth and Fifth ages, lives on the North East side of town and his, erm... pet cat is called Fluffy.
translation: 他最爱喝红色蜘蛛血，今年36岁又8个月零21天，研究第四和第五纪元的著名战役，住在城里的东北侧，还有，呃……他的宠物猫叫毛球。

english: Good day to you sir.
translation: 先生你好。

english: Good day to you ma'am.
translation: 女士你好。

english: Begone exile, before I call the Fremennik guards!
translation: 滚开，流放者，否则我要叫弗瑞穆尼克守卫了！

english: Begone exile, you're no brother to me.
translation: 滚开，流放者，你不再是我的兄弟了。

english: Leave exile, before I alert the guards.
translation: 离开吧流放者，否则我要警告守卫了。

english: Leave now, before I get rid of you myself.
translation: 现在就离开，否则我要亲自动手了。

english: Begone exile, you're no sister to me.
translation: 滚开，流放者，你不再是我的姐妹了。

english: I'm sorry, you are our sister no more. I cannot help you. Leave, before I must call the guards.
translation: 对不起，你不再是我的姐妹了。我无法帮助你。离开吧，否则我必须叫守卫了。

english: I'm sorry, you are our brother no more. I cannot help you. Leave, before I must call the guards.
translation: 对不起，你不再是我的兄弟了。我无法帮助你。离开吧，否则我必须叫守卫了。

english: I need to talk to you.
translation: 我需要和你谈谈。

english: Why should I?
translation: 我凭什么要和你谈？

english: Erm, sorry I don't mean to cause offence.
translation: 呃，抱歉，我不是有意冒犯。

english: Please don't hurt me.
translation: 请别伤害我。

english: I'm after important answers.
translation: 我是来寻求重要答案的。

english: But how do you know me?
translation: 但你怎么认识我的？

english: I just talked to your brother.
translation: 我刚和你兄弟谈过。

english: Don't talk of my brother. He's not on my good side at the moment.
translation: 别提我兄弟。他现在惹到我了。

english: Why, you're the famous warrior Dron!
translation: 怎么，你可是大名鼎鼎的战士德隆！

english: If so, what weapon do I use?
translation: 如果真是这样，那我用什么武器？

english: An iron mace.
translation: 铁制钉锤。

english: When do I like to eat rats?
translation: 我喜欢什么时候吃老鼠？

english: Breakfast.
translation: 早餐。

english: When are kittens best devoured?
translation: 什么时候最适合享用小猫？

english: Lunch.
translation: 午餐。

english: What do I usually eat for tea?
translation: 我下午茶通常吃什么？

english: Bunnies.
translation: 兔子。

english: What colour spider blood tastes the best?
translation: 什么颜色的蜘蛛血味道最好？

english: How many years old am I?
translation: 我今年多少岁？

english: and months?
translation: 那几个月呢？

english: What are the most interesting ages for battles?
translation: 哪个纪元的战役最有趣？

english: Fifth and Fourth.
translation: 第五和第四纪元。

english: And my house is situated where?
translation: 我的房子在什么位置？

english: North East side of town.
translation: 城镇的东北边。

english: What is my brother's name?
translation: 我兄弟叫什么名字？

english: Blanin.
translation: 布拉宁。

english: And my pet cat is called?
translation: 我的宠物猫叫什么？

english: Fluffy.
translation: 毛毛。

english: What's 5 plus 7?
translation: 5 加 7 等于多少？

english: 12, but what does that have to do with anything?
translation: 12，但这跟那有什么关系？

english: Everything! Besides, it's 13!
translation: 关系可大了！而且，是 13！

english: Er, I think you'll find it's 12.
translation: 呃，我想你会发现是 12。

english: Very well, you seem to know me quite well, I'll answer your questions best I can.
translation: 好吧，看来你很了解我，我会尽力回答你的问题。

english: Well what are they then?
translation: 那它们到底是什么？

english: I'm trying to find out the history of the outpost near Ardougne. I was hoping you could help me.
translation: 我想弄清楚阿多尼城附近那个前哨站的历史。希望你能帮我。

english: Let me see. Ah yes, I remember reading of a battle that took place at the outpost many years ago. Two ex- friends led forces in a small battle that ended with them pitted against each other at the top of the outpost as the
translation: 让我想想。啊，对了，我记得读过关于多年前在前哨站发生的一场战斗。两个昔日好友各自率领部队进行了一场小规模战斗，最终在前哨站顶端对峙，成为

english: sole survivors because of their superior strength.
translation: 唯一的幸存者，因为他们优越的力量。

english: Ex-friends?
translation: 昔日好友？

english: They were once friends but a difference in their beliefs meant they fell out. One chose to follow the god Zamorak, whilst the other chose Saradomin. But finding themselves in this extreme situation at the top of the
translation: 他们曾是朋友，但因信仰分歧而决裂。一人选择追随邪神萨莫拉克，另一人则选择了萨拉多明。但当他们发现自己在前哨站顶端陷入这种绝境时，

english: outpost caused them to see the errors of their ways, like the waste of life, the lost friendship and the wasted time. They both then decided to unite under Guthix.
translation: 这让他们看清了自己的错误，比如生命的浪费、友谊的丧失和虚度的光阴。于是他们决定共同团结在古斯的旗帜下。

english: Ah, I like happy endings.
translation: 啊，我喜欢大团圆结局。

english: You would.
translation: 你当然喜欢。

english: Thank you, I can report this back to Jorral now.
translation: 谢谢你，我现在可以回去向乔拉尔报告了。

english: Well, I was wondering how you get the blood stains out of your clothes?
translation: 嗯，我想知道你是怎么把衣服上的血迹洗掉的？

english: BE GONE!
translation: 滚开！

english: Dave.
translation: 戴夫。

english: Dev?
translation: 德夫？

english: No. D-A-V-E
translation: 不。是 D-A-V-E

english: What a strange name. Unlike my brothers!
translation: 真是个奇怪的名字。不像我的兄弟们！

english: Kittens.
translation: 小猫。

english: Eww. Gross. You have some strange tastes.
translation: 呃，真恶心。你的口味真奇怪。

english: You can't lecture ME on eating habits.
translation: 你可没资格教训我的饮食习惯。

english: Don't waste my time!
translation: 别浪费我的时间！

english: You know nothing!
translation: 你什么都不知道！

english: Wrong, wrong, wrong!
translation: 错，错，全错！

english: I've talked to the warrior.
translation: 我和那个战士谈过了。

english: Excellent! What did he say?
translation: 太好了！他说了什么？

english: And then I asked him about getting the blood stains out of his clothes, but he didn't like that!
translation: 然后我问他怎么把衣服上的血迹洗掉，但他不喜欢这个问题！

english: It seems you're lucky he didn't beat you up! Well done, that's another piece of the puzzle.
translation: 看来他没揍你算你走运！干得好，这又是拼图的一块。

english: It all makes sense now, I never realised there was quite so much history to this place, it was more than I could have hoped.
translation: 现在一切都说得通了，我从没意识到这个地方有这么多历史，这超出了我的预期。

english: I'm glad to hear. What's the whole story?
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。整个故事是怎样的？

english: Many years ago, there were two friends who fell out over their difference of opinion in religion. One decided to dedicate his life to Saradomin, the other to Zamorak. Years passed and the follower of Zamorak moved into
translation: 很多年前，有两个朋友因宗教信仰分歧而闹翻。一人决定将一生奉献给萨拉多明，另一人则献给萨莫拉克。多年后，萨莫拉克的信徒搬进了

english: this outpost with a group of others to cause havoc for the city of Ardougne. The people of the city called upon some Saradomin followers, who happened to be led by the other friend. A battle ensued that ended with the
translation: 这个前哨站，与一群其他人一起，给阿多尼城制造混乱。城里的人召集了一些萨拉多明的信徒，而带领他们的恰好是另一位朋友。一场战斗随之爆发，最终

english: two ex-friends at the top of the outpost as the sole survivors. Realising their mistakes they made friends again. One decided to become King and spread the word of equality, and the other chose to start up a
translation: 前哨站顶端的两个前朋友成了唯一的幸存者。意识到自己的错误后，他们重新成为了朋友。一个决定成为国王，传播平等的理念，另一个选择创办一个

english: market where all could trade their wares equally and fairly. The one that became king is the great grandfather of the King Lathas that we know!
translation: 市场，让所有人都能公平地交易货物。成为国王的那位，正是我们所知的拉萨斯国王的曾祖父！

english: So what should I do now?
translation: 那我接下来该做什么？

english: Well, what I'll do is write down the details you have provided in a more easy to digest manner, along with my plans for using this building as a museum.
translation: 嗯，我会把你提供的细节以更容易理解的方式写下来，连同我打算把这栋建筑改造成博物馆的计划。

english: Well I would give you the letter if you had space to carry it.
translation: 如果你有空间携带的话，我会把信给你。

english: Then I suppose you want ME to deliver it to the king?
translation: 那么我想你是要我把信送给国王？

english: You've got that right!
translation: 你说对了！

english: Don't suppose you could give me the letter again?
translation: 你能不能再给我一封信？

english: Ok. Just don't lose it again!
translation: 好吧。这次别再弄丢了！

english: Have you taken that letter to King Lathas in Ardougne yet?
translation: 你把那封信送给阿多尼城的拉萨斯国王了吗？

english: Any time soon would be great.
translation: 尽快就好。

english: Excuse me. I have been asked to give you from Jorral... Ooops, I had a letter, but I don't have it with me - be right back!
translation: 打扰一下。乔拉尔让我把这封信给你……哎呀，我本来有封信，但没带在身上——马上回来！

english: Excuse me. I have been asked to hand you this from Jorral at the outpost.
translation: 打扰一下。前哨站的乔拉尔让我把这封信交给你。

english: I had no idea that place had any value at all! All this about my Great Grandfather and Jorral's plans to make it into a museum makes for a convincing case.
translation: 我完全不知道那个地方有任何价值！所有这些关于我曾祖父的事，以及乔拉尔要把它改造成博物馆的计划，都很有说服力。

english: I am sure he only wants what is best.
translation: 我相信他只想要最好的结果。

english: Very well, I will comply with his request. Take this letter back to him with my kind regards.
translation: 好吧，我会同意他的请求。把这封信带回去给他，并转达我的亲切问候。

english: Excuse me sire, but I seem to have lost that letter you gave me.
translation: 抱歉，陛下，我好像把你给我的那封信弄丢了。

english: Very well, take another.
translation: 好吧，再拿一封。

english: Have you taken that letter to Jorral yet?
translation: 你把那封信送给乔拉尔了吗？

english: I was given a letter to give to you from the king! But I seem to have lost it!
translation: 国王给了我一封信让我转交给你！但我好像弄丢了！

english: Perhaps he will give you another one.
translation: 也许他会再给你一封。

english: I've been to see the king and he gave me this letter.
translation: 我去见了国王，他给了我这封信。

english: Quick, let me see.
translation: 快，让我看看。

english: Hurrah! Good work, you've done it. You've saved the outpost!
translation: 万岁！干得好，你做到了。你拯救了前哨站！

english: I can now continue with my plans for this place. Thank you.
translation: 我现在可以继续我对这个地方的计划了。谢谢你。

english: Take a look at the artefacts in the new museum room. You may find something of interest.
translation: 去新博物馆房间看看那些文物吧。你可能会发现一些感兴趣的东西。

english: Wait a minute. You already have the scroll in your bank!
translation: 等等。你的银行里已经有那卷轴了！

english: I would give it to you, but you don't have enough space to carry it!
translation: 我想给你，但你身上没有空间携带它！

english: You don't have enough space to carry it!
translation: 你没有足够的空间携带它！

english: Hello? Can I help you?
translation: 你好？需要帮忙吗？

english: I don't know? Can you?
translation: 我不知道？你能帮上忙吗？

english: Hang on... You're one of them easterners, aren't you?
translation: 等等……你是那些东方人之一，对吧？

english: Well I suppose I am.
translation: 嗯，我想是吧。

english: Kuani! I'm Emelio, and you might be just the person I need to help me out with an exciting new business venture!
translation: 库阿尼！我是埃梅利奥，你也许正是我需要的人，来帮我开展一个激动人心的新生意！

english: What business venture?
translation: 什么生意？

english: Well as an easterner, I've no doubt you're all too familiar with the wonder that is the kabit!
translation: 嗯，作为东方人，我敢肯定你对卡比特这种神奇的东西再熟悉不过了！

english: Kabit? What's a kabit?
translation: 卡比特？卡比特是什么？

english: You don't know? But how could you not know? My life was changed forever when I tried one!
translation: 你不知道？你怎么可能不知道？我尝过一次之后，人生就彻底改变了！

english: Believe it or not, I never used to be keen on opening the Kingdom to outsiders. In fact, I even spent some time as part of the Varlaless movement.
translation: 信不信由你，我以前并不热衷于向外界开放王国。事实上，我甚至一度是瓦尔拉莱斯运动的成员。

english: But then I tried a kabit, and it changed everything! If that's the kind of food you easterners can make, then as far as I'm concerned, you're welcome here any day of the week!
translation: 但后来我尝了一个卡比特，一切都变了！如果你们东方人能做出那种食物，那对我来说，你们随时都受欢迎！

english: Okay... but what's a kabit?
translation: 好吧……但卡比特到底是什么？

english: A kabit! The amazing blend of meat, spices and salad, all wrapped in bread! Genius!
translation: 卡比特！肉、香料和沙拉的美妙混合，全部包在面包里！天才！

english: Oh, you mean a kebab!
translation: 哦，你说的是烤肉！

english: Yes, kebab! Brilliant!
translation: 对，烤肉！太棒了！

english: But what do kebabs have to do with this business venture?
translation: 但烤肉和这个生意有什么关系？

english: Well, quite simply, I wish to bring the kebab to Varlamore. Everyone here deserves a chance to taste their brilliance!
translation: 嗯，很简单，我想把烤肉带到瓦拉莫尔。这里的每个人都应该有机会品尝它的美味！

english: So you're opening a kebab shop?
translation: 所以你要开一家烤肉店？

english: I see. So what is it you need help with?
translation: 我明白了。那你需要我帮什么忙？

english: My hope is to blend ingredients from the east with ones from right here in Varlamore. The end result will be a mighty kebab just like you easterners make, but with a Varlamorian twist!
translation: 我希望将东方的食材与瓦拉莫尔本地的食材融合在一起。最终成果将是一种像你们东方人做的那样美味的烤肉，但带有瓦拉莫尔的特色！

english: Problem is, some of the ingredients I've ordered haven't arrived yet. Would you be able to go and see what the delay is?
translation: 问题是，我订购的一些食材还没到。你能去看看出了什么延误吗？

english: Which ingredients haven't arrived?
translation: 哪些食材还没到？

english: We're still missing the Kharidian spices I ordered in. The Spice Merchant in the Bazaar was sorting that out for me. We don't have the buffalo meat either. That was coming from Alba at Ortus Farm.
translation: 我们还在等卡里迪安的香料。集市里的香料商人正在帮我处理这件事。水牛肉也还没到。那是从奥图斯农场的阿尔芭那里订购的。

english: Okay, I guess I can go see where they've got to.
translation: 好吧，我想我可以去看看它们到哪了。

english: Kuani! I look forward to your return.
translation: 库阿尼！期待你回来。

english: Sorry, but I think I'll have to pass on this one.
translation: 抱歉，但我想这次我帮不上忙了。

english: Nilsal, friend. Any luck with those missing ingredients?
translation: 尼萨尔，朋友。那些缺失的食材有消息了吗？

english: Which ingredients was it again?
translation: 再说一遍是哪些食材来着？

english: I'm here about a missing delivery.
translation: 我来是为了一个延误的送货。

english: Ah, I'm betting Emelio sent you, right?
translation: 啊，我猜是埃梅利奥派你来的，对吧？

english: Well the good news is that his spices arrived this morning. The bad news is that I can't get the box open.
translation: 好消息是他的香料今天早上到了。坏消息是我打不开箱子。

english: Can't get the box open? How come?
translation: 打不开箱子？怎么回事？

english: Well this is the first time I've ever had to order in spices from the east, so I needed to find a reputable supplier. I ended up going with a guy called Ali Morrisane who seemed like he knew his stuff.
translation: 嗯，这是我第一次需要从东方订购香料，所以我得找个可靠的供应商。最后我找了一个叫阿里.莫里桑的家伙，他看起来挺懂行的。

english: Thing is, he's gone and locked the box to make sure the goods can't be stolen, but hasn't told me how to unlock it again!
translation: 问题是，他把箱子锁上了，以确保货物不会被偷，但又没告诉我怎么开锁！

english: Here, let me take a look.
translation: 来，让我看看。

english: Could I have a look at that locked box?
translation: 我能看看那个锁着的箱子吗？

english: Kuani! You did it! I'll have these sent over to Emelio right away. Thanks for the help.
translation: 库阿尼！你做到了！我马上把这些送到埃梅利奥那里。谢谢你的帮助。

english: About that missing delivery...
translation: 关于那个延误的送货……

english: It's on route to Emelio as we speak. I'm sure it will be with him soon.
translation: 现在正在送往埃梅利奥的路上。我相信很快就会到他那里。

english: Perfect, thank you.
translation: 太好了，谢谢你。

english: I did manage to speak to the Spice Merchant and helped them get that delivery sorted, it should be here soon.
translation: 我和香料商人谈过了，帮他们解决了送货问题，应该很快就到。

english: Kuani! Now all that's left is the buffalo meat.
translation: 库阿尼！现在只剩下水牛肉了。

english: I'm on it.
translation: 交给我吧。

english: Nilsal, iknami. What can I do for you today?
translation: 尼萨尔，伊克纳米。今天有什么能帮你的？

english: I'm guessing you must be Alba? Emelio sent me to check up on his meat order.
translation: 我猜你一定是阿尔芭？埃梅利奥派我来查看他的肉订单。

english: Ah, yes. Apologies, iknami, but we've been dealing with a bit of a wolf problem recently and it's delayed some of our orders.
translation: 啊，是的。抱歉，伊克纳米，我们最近遇到了一点狼的问题，导致一些订单延误了。

english: A wolf problem? Maybe I could help out with that?
translation: 狼的问题？也许我能帮忙解决？

english: Well we'd never say no to some extra help, and it would mean we'd be able to get working on Emelio's order faster.
translation: 嗯，我们从不拒绝额外的帮助，这样我们也能更快地处理埃梅利奥的订单。

english: Sounds like we have a deal then. What do you need me to do?
translation: 听起来我们成交了。需要我做什么？

english: The wolves have a den directly west of here. Most of them don't cause too much of a problem, but there's a big one that we've been struggling with.
translation: 狼的巢穴就在西边。大多数狼不太惹麻烦，但有一只大的我们一直搞不定。

english: Okay, I'll head over there and deal with this wolf.
translation: 好的，我过去处理这只狼。

english: Nilsal, iknami. Any luck with that wolf?
translation: 尼萨尔，伊克纳米。那只狼解决了吗？

english: You'll find the den directly west of here. Remember, it's the big one that we need dealing with.
translation: 巢穴就在西边。记住，我们需要处理的是那只大的。

english: Aarrooooo!
translation: 嗷呜——！

english: It's been dealt with.
translation: 已经解决了。

english: Kuani! Thank you so much for the help, iknami. While you were gone, I was able to get Emelio's order finished. It's on the way to him now.
translation: 库阿尼！非常感谢你的帮助，伊克纳米。你不在的时候，我已经把埃梅利奥的订单做好了。现在正在送去的路上。

english: Perfect! Thank you for sorting that.
translation: 太好了！谢谢你处理好了。

english: Not a problem. Until next time, iknami.
translation: 不客气。下次见，伊克纳米。

english: I did manage to speak to Alba and helped them get that delivery sorted, it should be here soon.
translation: 我和阿尔芭谈过了，帮他们解决了送货问题，应该很快就到。

english: Kuani! Now all that's left is the spices.
translation: 库阿尼！现在只剩下香料了。

english: I hope this food is worth it. I've got plenty of other things to be doing.
translation: 我希望这食物值得。我还有很多别的事要做。

english: I'll never turn down free food! I just hope it tastes good!
translation: 我从不拒绝免费食物！我只希望它好吃！

english: I wonder what Emelio has cooked up this time.
translation: 不知道埃梅利奥这次又做了什么。

english: Nilsal, friend. Thanks to your good work out there, all the ingredients have now arrived! Now we move on to the critical step: The recipe!
translation: 尼萨尔，朋友。多亏你在外面干得漂亮，所有食材都到了！现在我们进入关键步骤：食谱！

english: Outside, I have gathered the finest group of connoisseurs who will assist us in finding the perfect ratio of ingredients to achieve the ultimate kebab!
translation: 外面，我召集了一群最优秀的品鉴师，他们会帮我们找到制作终极烤肉的最佳食材比例！

english: Where did these connoisseurs come from?
translation: 这些品鉴师是从哪来的？

english: Oh, I just went into the local pub and promised a free drink to anyone who would help.
translation: 哦，我只是去了当地酒吧，答应给任何愿意帮忙的人一杯免费饮料。

english: I see. Are you sure they're going to give us the most reliable opinions?
translation: 我明白了。你确定他们会给我们最可靠的意见吗？

english: Of course! People like them are going to be our top customers!
translation: 当然！像他们这样的人将会是我们的顶级顾客！

english: Imagine, you've been out late at your local establishment, and before heading home, you find yourself in need of the perfect late-night meal. That is where we come in!
translation: 想象一下，你在当地的酒馆待到很晚，在回家之前，你发现自己需要一顿完美的深夜餐。这就是我们登场的时候了！

english: Absolutely! Now, before we get our recipe sorted, I've allowed our friends outside to try the ingredients individually. They'll have already formed some opinions on how much of each is right.
translation: 没错！现在，在我们确定食谱之前，我让外面的朋友们单独品尝了食材。他们应该已经对每种食材该放多少有了些想法。

english: Head on out there and have a chat with them to see if you can work out the perfect ratio of meat, salad, spice and sauce.
translation: 出去和他们聊聊，看看你能不能找出肉、沙拉、香料和酱汁的完美比例。

english: Kuani!
translation: 库阿尼！

english: Hello there. I was wondering if you had any thoughts on ingredient ratios for these kebabs?
translation: 你好。我想知道你对这些烤肉的食材比例有什么想法吗？

english: The sauce is essential. You want there to be as much sauce as there is spice and salad combined.
translation: 酱汁是必不可少的。酱汁的量要和香料与沙拉的总和一样多。

english: Don't overdo the spice! You want to make sure there's less spice than there is salad.
translation: 别放太多香料！要确保香料比沙拉少。

english: Well the main thing is to make sure you're not putting too much salad in. You want there to be twice as much meat as there is salad.
translation: 嗯，主要是确保别放太多沙拉。肉的量要是沙拉的两倍。

english: Nilsal, friend. Have you worked out the ingredient ratios yet?
translation: 尼萨尔，朋友。你算出食材比例了吗？

english: Kuani! I've currently got one portion each of meat, salad, spice and sauce, but I reckon we can fit in up to four portions of each. What are we going for?
translation: 库阿尼！我目前每种肉、沙拉、香料和酱汁各有一份，但我想每种最多可以放四份。我们选哪种？

english: Let's try one portion of meat.
translation: 我们试试一份肉。

english: That's what we have already. Maybe we should change something else.
translation: 那已经是现在的量了。也许我们该改改别的。

english: Let's try two portions of meat.
translation: 我们试试两份肉。

english: Very well. Anything else?
translation: 很好。还要别的吗？

english: Let's try three portions of meat.
translation: 我们试试三份肉。

english: Let's try four portions of meat.
translation: 我们试试四份肉。

english: Let's try one portion of salad.
translation: 我们试试一份沙拉。

english: Let's try two portions of salad.
translation: 我们试试两份沙拉。

english: Let's try three portions of salad.
translation: 我们试试三份沙拉。

english: Let's try four portions of salad.
translation: 我们试试四份沙拉。

english: Let's try one portion of spice.
translation: 我们试试一份香料。

english: Let's try two portions of spice.
translation: 我们试试两份香料。

english: Let's try three portions of spice.
translation: 我们试试三份香料。

english: Let's try four portions of spice.
translation: 我们试试四份香料。

english: Let's try one portion of sauce.
translation: 我们试试一份酱汁。

english: Let's try two portions of sauce.
translation: 我们试试两份酱汁。

english: Let's try three portions of sauce.
translation: 我们试试三份酱汁。

english: Let's try four portions of sauce.
translation: 我们试试四份酱汁。

english: I think that's perfect!
translation: 我觉得这样完美了！

english: Kuani! That gives us [number] portion[s] of meat, [number] portion[s] of salad, [number] portion[s] of spice and [number] portion[s] of sauce. Definitely happy with that?
translation: 库阿尼！这样就是[数字]份肉、[数字]份沙拉、[数字]份香料和[数字]份酱汁。确定满意了吗？

english: Well in that case, why don't you take this kebab to one of our connoisseurs outside and see what they reckon.
translation: 嗯，既然如此，你何不把这个烤肉拿给外面的一位品鉴师尝尝，看看他们怎么说。

english: Actually, let's make some more changes.
translation: 其实，我们再做一些调整吧。

english: Nilsal, friend. I've currently got [number] portion[s] of meat, [number] portion[s] of salad, [number] portion[s] of spice and [number] portion[s] of sauce. Do you want to make any changes?
translation: 你好，朋友。我现在有 [number] 份肉、[number] 份沙拉、[number] 份香料和 [number] 份酱汁。你想做任何调整吗？

english: Have you seen what our connoisseurs reckon of that kebab?
translation: 你看到我们的美食家对那份烤肉的评价了吗？

english: Tatamo! We're very lucky I made some spares.
translation: 太好了！幸好我多准备了一些。

english: Well, don't keep me waiting! I must hear what they think.
translation: 别让我等着！我必须听听他们的想法。

english: What do you make of this?
translation: 你觉得这个怎么样？

english: Eww! This is awful.
translation: 呃！这太难吃了。

english: Oh. I guess we'd better try again.
translation: 哦。我想我们最好再试一次。

english: This is brilliant! Amazing stuff!
translation: 太棒了！真是绝妙的东西！

english: Fantastic! I'll let Emilio know right away!
translation: 太棒了！我马上告诉埃梅利奥！

english: They didn't like it.
translation: 他们不喜欢。

english: Tatamo! This is worse than the day my father left us! We must try again. I've currently got [number] portion[s] of meat, [number] portion[s] of salad, [number] portion[s] of spice and [number] portion[s] of sauce. What shall we change?
translation: 天哪！这比我父亲离开我们的那天还要糟糕！我们必须再试一次。我现在有 [number] 份肉、[number] 份沙拉、[number] 份香料和 [number] 份酱汁。我们该改什么？

english: They loved it!
translation: 他们很喜欢！

english: So are we all ready to start selling now?
translation: 那么我们现在都准备好开始销售了吗？

english: Not quite, iknami. There is one final thing we must do. We now know we have a winning recipe, but we need the rest of Varlamore to know as well!
translation: 还没完全准备好，朋友。还有最后一件事要做。我们现在知道我们有成功的食谱，但我们也需要让瓦拉莫尔的其他人都知道！

english: How do we do that?
translation: 我们该怎么做？

english: One word, iknami: Marketing! And I know just the place to do it.
translation: 一句话，朋友：营销！而且我知道该去哪里做。

english: You must visit Lelia at the Colosseum at once. Take her a sample of our fine kebabs, and she will beg us to let her help sell them to the people of Varlamore!
translation: 你必须马上去竞技场找莱莉亚。带一份我们美味的烤肉样品给她，她会求我们让她帮忙卖给瓦拉莫尔的人民！

english: Well now that we're done here, when am I getting paid?
translation: 好了，既然我们这里的事办完了，我什么时候能拿到报酬？

english: I think I deserve a lifetime supply of these kebabs for helping to get things started.
translation: 我觉得我帮忙开了个头，应该得到这些烤肉的终身供应。

english: I think Emelio might actually be on for a winner this time.
translation: 我觉得埃梅利奥这次可能真的能成功。

english: Nilsal, friend. Have you taken those kebabs to Lelia at the Colosseum yet?
translation: 你好，朋友。你把那些烤肉带给竞技场的莱莉亚了吗？

english: I lost one.
translation: 我弄丢了一个。

english: Now you must hurry over there at once!
translation: 那你现在必须马上赶到那里去！

english: I lost them.
translation: 我弄丢了它们。

english: Then you must hurry over there at once!
translation: 那你必须马上赶到那里去！

english: Are you Lelia? Emelio sent me to speak to you.
translation: 你是莱莉亚吗？埃梅利奥派我来找你谈谈。

english: Looking to market another one of his buisness ideas is he? It will cost him double this time. We still haven't cleaned up the mess made by his last great idea.
translation: 又想推销他的另一个商业点子，是吗？这次要收他双倍价钱。我们还没清理完他上一个伟大主意造成的烂摊子呢。

english: Is this a common occurance?
translation: 这种事经常发生吗？

english: Emelio having ideas, or said ideas not being very good? Yes to both, I suppose.
translation: 埃梅利奥有主意，还是说这些主意不怎么样？我想两者都有吧。

english: Well he seems very confident about this one.
translation: 嗯，他这次似乎对这个主意很有信心。

english: Alright, let's hear it then.
translation: 好吧，那说来听听。

english: He wants to bring a new type of food to Varlamore: kebabs. We have them over in the east. Here, he sent one for you to try.
translation: 他想给瓦拉莫尔带来一种新食物：烤肉。我们在东方那边就有。喏，他送了一个给你尝尝。

english: Hmm... I must admit, I'm somewhat impressed. Emelio might finally be on to something here.
translation: 嗯……我得承认，我有点被打动了。埃梅利奥这次可能真的找对路了。

english: So you'll help?
translation: 那么你愿意帮忙吗？

english: Yes, and it's your lucky day. We have an advertising spot open before the next contest. The last promoter had to pull out suddenly.
translation: 是的，而且今天是你走运的日子。在下场比赛之前，我们正好有一个广告位空出来了。上一个推广人突然退出了。

english: Excellent! So how does this work exactly.
translation: 太好了！那么具体是怎么操作的呢？

english: Nice and simple really. Before the contest starts, we run a couple of adverts for local businesses. You get a few minutes to promote your product however you feel suitable.
translation: 其实很简单。比赛开始前，我们会为本地商家播放几个广告。你有几分钟时间，用你觉得合适的方式来推广你的产品。

english: In some cases we allow promoters to make use of some of the Colosseum creatures as part of their advert, provided I deem it suitable.
translation: 在某些情况下，只要我觉得合适，我们会允许推广人使用一些竞技场的生物作为他们广告的一部分。

english: And would our kebabs be considered suitable?
translation: 那我们的烤肉会被认为是合适的吗？

english: Well I suppose they did impress me, and we do have a young minotaur spare from that promoter who had to pull out. Very well, you can make use of him.
translation: 嗯，我想它们确实给我留下了深刻印象，而且我们正好有一个从那个不得不退出的推广人那里留下的年轻牛头怪。很好，你可以用他。

english: Great! So, er... What do I do with this minotaur?
translation: 太好了！那么，呃……我要拿这个牛头怪做什么？

english: You want to convince people to buy these kebabs, right? I'd suggest you head on in, take a bite out of one and then give the minotaur a good kick.
translation: 你想说服人们买这些烤肉，对吧？我建议你走进去，咬一口烤肉，然后狠狠地踢那个牛头怪一脚。

english: He'll pretend to go down in one. The audience will love it.
translation: 他会假装被一击打倒。观众会喜欢的。

english: Will the minotaur be okay with that?
translation: 那个牛头怪会同意吗？

english: Why wouldn't he be?
translation: 他为什么会不同意？

english: I guess I don't really know much about minotaurs.
translation: 我想我对牛头怪了解得不多。

english: If the crowd is happy, he'll be happy. Now, are you ready?
translation: 只要观众开心，他就会开心。现在，你准备好了吗？

english: What? Right now?
translation: 什么？现在？

english: Yup. Next contest starts soon and we don't have another slot for weeks.
translation: 是的。下一场比赛马上就要开始了，我们接下来几周都没有其他空档了。

english: I'll need to go grab another kebab first.
translation: 我得先去拿另一个烤肉。

english: Well, make it quick.
translation: 好吧，快点。

english: Right, get to it then.
translation: 好了，那就开始吧。

english: Welcome, one and all, to the Fortis Colosseum! We have a thrilling event lined up for you today, but first, we have something new to show you!
translation: 欢迎各位来到福蒂斯竞技场！今天为你们准备了一场激动人心的比赛，但首先，我们有新东西要展示给你们看！

english: Introducing the kebab! This delicacy comes straight from the east and is just the thing to give you the strength you need after a hard day of work.
translation: 隆重介绍烤肉！这种美味直接来自东方，正是你在辛苦工作一天后补充力量所需的东西。

english: Indeed, observe the strength provided by a single bite of one!
translation: 没错，看看只咬一口就能提供的力量！

english: Huh? Human... eat... friend?
translation: 嗯？人类……吃……朋友？

english: What? No, it's a kebab. The meat is... buffalo... I think.
translation: 什么？不，这是烤肉。肉是……水牛……我想。

english: Kebab... is... minotaur?
translation: 烤肉……是……牛头怪？

english: No. It's buffalo.
translation: 不。是水牛。

english: Human... eat... minotaur! Human... die!
translation: 人类……吃……牛头怪！人类……去死！

english: Oh boy...
translation: 哦，天哪……

english: I need to prepare first.
translation: 我需要先准备一下。

english: Well make it quick.
translation: 那就快点。

english: Moo!
translation: 哞！

english: Moooooo!
Are you ready? Your advertising slot is coming up and I don't intend to delay the contest for you.
translation: 你准备好了吗？你的广告时段就要到了，我可不想为了你推迟比赛。

english: Then you should do so at once!
translation: 那你应该马上去做！

english: That minotaur tried to kill me!
translation: 那个牛头怪想杀了我！

english: Yes, he doesn't seem too happy about those kebabs. I'll speak to the beastmaster about it. In the meantime, you'd better get in there and deal with him.
translation: 是的，他看起来对那些烤肉不太高兴。我会和驯兽师谈谈这件事。与此同时，你最好进去解决他。

english: Because if you don't, no one will want to buy those kebabs of yours.
translation: 因为如果你不这么做，就没人会想买你的那些烤肉了。

english: I have. She set me up with a slot to promote them to the crowd, but there's been a bit of an issue.
translation: 我去过了。她给我安排了一个向人群推广它们的时段，但出了点小问题。

english: Well, then you'd better get back there and sort it out.
translation: 嗯，那你最好回去解决它。

english: You put on a good performance in there. The crowd seemed very impressed.
translation: 你在里面表现得很出色。观众们看起来印象很深刻。

english: What about that minotaur?
translation: 那个牛头怪呢？

english: What about it? It got out of control and you killed it. Saves the beastmaster a job.
translation: 它怎么了？它失控了，你杀了它。省了驯兽师一份工作。

english: But it could have killed me! You said it would be safe.
translation: 但它差点杀了我！你说过会很安全的。

english: You survived, didn't you? I don't see the problem.
translation: 你不是活下来了吗？我不觉得有什么问题。

english: Now, I need to get things ready for the next slot. Why don't you go and tell Emelio about the good impression his kebabs made.
translation: 现在，我需要为下一个时段做准备。你不如去告诉埃梅利奥，他的烤肉给人留下了好印象。

english: I don't think you need anything else, do you? Why don't you go and tell Emelio about the good impression his kebabs made.
translation: 我想你不需要别的了吧？你不如去告诉埃梅利奥，他的烤肉给人留下了好印象。

english: Okay, thanks, I guess.
translation: 好吧，谢谢，我想。

english: Nilsal, friend. Given that I've already served our first customers, I take it your trip to the Colosseum was a success?
translation: 你好，朋友。既然我已经在招待我们的第一批顾客了，我想你去竞技场之行很成功吧？

english: Well I did run into a slight complication, but apart from that, it went very well.
translation: 嗯，我确实遇到了一点小麻烦，但除此之外，一切都很顺利。

english: You have done a great service to Varlamore, friend. Thanks to you, all here will be able to indulge in the joy that is kebabs. As thanks, I will offer you a special price for any kebabs you buy!
translation: 你为瓦拉莫尔立了大功，朋友。多亏了你，这里的所有人都能享受到烤肉带来的快乐。作为感谢，你买任何烤肉我都会给你一个特价！

english: Do I not get to share in any of the profits, given I helped set it all up?
translation: 既然我帮忙把这一切都建立起来了，难道我不应该分到一些利润吗？

english: Sorry, friend, but I must prepare some more kebabs for our next customers! Until next time.
translation: 抱歉，朋友，但我必须为下一位顾客准备更多的烤肉了！下次再见。

english: Well then you must complete your quest to rescue Merlin. Talk to my knights if you need any help.
translation: 那你得完成拯救梅林的任务。如果需要帮助，就跟我的骑士们谈谈。

english: Any ideas on getting Merlin out of that crystal?
translation: 有没有办法把梅林从那个水晶里弄出来？

english: The only person I know of who would possibly have been of help is Merlin...
translation: 我认识的人里，唯一可能帮上忙的，大概就是梅林本人了……

english: Yeah, that's not actually too helpful.
translation: 是啊，这说了跟没说一样。

english: I am well aware of that, adventurer.
translation: 我很清楚这一点，冒险者。

english: I want to get Merlin out of the crystal.
translation: 我想把梅林从水晶里救出来。

english: Well, if the Knights of the Round Table can't manage it, I can't see how a commoner like you could succeed where we have failed.
translation: 嗯，如果圆桌骑士都做不到，我看不出像你这样的平民怎么能成功，而我们却失败了。

english: Any suggestions on freeing Merlin?
translation: 关于解救梅林，有什么建议吗？

english: I've tried all the weapons I can find, yet none are powerful enough to break his crystal prison...
translation: 我试过所有能找到的武器，但没有一把强大到能打破他的水晶牢笼……

english: Excalibur eh? Where would I find that?
translation: 王者之剑，嗯？我在哪能找到它？

english: The Lady of the Lake is looking after it I believe... but I know not where she resides currently.
translation: 我想是湖中女士在保管它……但我不知道她现在住在哪里。

english: I'd like some advice on breaking that Crystal Merlin's trapped in.
translation: 我想请教一下，怎么打破困住梅林的那个水晶。

english: My best guess would be some sort of magic. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.
translation: 我猜大概得用某种魔法。可惜梅林才是我们的魔法专家。

english: Ok, well, thanks anyway.
translation: 好吧，那还是谢谢了。

english: Do you know much about breaking magical crystals?
translation: 你了解怎么打破魔法水晶吗？

english: Funnily enough...absolutely nothing.
translation: 说来好笑……我完全不懂。

english: Ok. Goodbye.
translation: 好吧，再见。

english: Any ideas on how to get Merlin out of that crystal?
translation: 有没有办法把梅林从那个水晶里弄出来？

english: I'm a little stumped myself. We've tried opening it with anything and everything!
translation: 我自己也有点没辙了。我们试过用各种东西去打开它！

english: Do you know how Merlin got trapped?
translation: 你知道梅林是怎么被困住的吗？

english: I would guess this is the work of the evil Morgan Le Faye!
translation: 我猜这一定是邪恶的摩根.勒菲干的！

english: And where could I find her?
translation: 那我在哪能找到她？

english: She lives in her stronghold to the south of here, guarded by some renegade knights led by Sir Mordred.
translation: 她住在南边的要塞里，由莫德雷德爵士带领的一群叛变骑士守卫着。

english: Any idea how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?
translation: 知道怎么进入摩根.勒菲的要塞吗？

english: No, you've got me stumped there...
translation: 不知道，这你可把我问住了……

english: Thank you for the information.
translation: 谢谢你的情报。

english: It is the least I can do.
translation: 这是我应该做的。

english: Any ideas on getting into Mordred's fort?
translation: 有没有办法进入莫德雷德的堡垒？

english: Mordred... So you think he may be involved with the curse upon Merlin?
translation: 莫德雷德……所以你觉得他可能和梅林身上的诅咒术有关？

english: Good a guess as any right?
translation: 瞎猜的，对吧？

english: I think that you may be onto something there. Unfortunately his fortress is impregnable!
translation: 我觉得你可能说到点子上了。可惜他的堡垒固若金汤！

english: ...I'll figure something out.
translation: ……我会想出办法的。

english: I need to get into Mordred's Fortress.
translation: 我需要进入莫德雷德的堡垒。

english: So... you think Mordred's behind this? I'm afraid I don't have any suggestions...
translation: 所以……你觉得是莫德雷德在背后搞鬼？恐怕我没什么建议……

english: I'd like some advice on breaking into Mordred's fort.
translation: 我想请教一下怎么闯入莫德雷德的堡垒。

english: Any suggestions on getting into Mordred's fort?
translation: 有什么进入莫德雷德堡垒的建议吗？

english: My best guess would be using magic. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.
translation: 我猜最好是用魔法。可惜梅林才是我们的魔法专家。

english: Um... Hello. I need to get into Mordred's fort...
translation: 呃……你好。我需要进入莫德雷德的堡垒……

english: Any ideas on how to get into Morgan Le Faye's stronghold?
translation: 有没有办法进入摩根.勒菲的要塞？

english: That stronghold is built in a strong defensive position.
translation: 那座要塞建在一个易守难攻的位置。

english: It's on a big rock sticking out into the sea.
translation: 它建在一块伸入海中的大岩石上。

english: There are two ways in that I know of, the large heavy front doors, and the sea entrance, only penetrable by boat. They get all their deliveries by boat from Catherby.
translation: 据我所知有两条路可以进去，一是沉重的前大门，二是海路入口，只能乘船进入。他们所有的补给都是从凯瑟比镇用船运来的。

english: Hello! Would you like to trade?
translation: 你好！想交易吗？

english: Is that your ship?
translation: 那是你的船吗？

english: Yes, I use it to make deliveries to my customers up and down the coast. These crates here are all ready for my next trip.
translation: 是啊，我用它来给海岸沿线的客户送货。这些板条箱都准备好了，就等我下次出航。

english: Do you deliver to the fort just down the coast?
translation: 你送货到海岸边那个堡垒吗？

english: Yes, I do have orders to deliver there from time to time. I think I may have some bits and pieces for them when I leave here next actually.
translation: 是的，我确实时不时有订单要送到那里。我想我下次离开这里时，可能正好有些零碎东西要送给他们。

english: Can you drop me off on the way down please?
translation: 能顺路捎我一程吗？

english: I don't think Sir Mordred would like that. He wants as few outsiders visiting as possible. I wouldn't want to lose his business.
translation: 我觉得莫德雷德爵士不会喜欢这样。他希望尽可能少让外人来访。我可不想失去他的生意。

english: Aren't you worried about supplying evil knights?
translation: 你不担心给邪恶的骑士们供货吗？

english: Hey, you gotta take business where you can find it these days! Besides, if I didn't supply them, someone else would.
translation: 嘿，这年头有生意就得做！再说了，我不供货，别人也会供的。

english: Where do you deliver to?
translation: 你都送货到哪些地方？

english: Sorry pal, but I'm afraid I'm not quite ready to sail yet.
translation: 抱歉伙计，我恐怕还没准备好出航。

english: I'm waiting on a big delivery of candles which I need to deliver further along the coast.
translation: 我在等一大批蜡烛的货，要送到海岸更远的地方去。

english: Thanks buddy!
translation: 谢了，哥们！

english: Are you rich then?
translation: 那你很有钱吗？

english: Business is going reasonably well... I wouldn't say I was the richest of merchants ever, but I'm doing fairly well all things considered.
translation: 生意还算不错……我不敢说我是史上最富有的商人，但总的来说，干得还行。
