english: Hey buddy! Get away from my ship alright?
translation: 嘿，哥们！离我的船远点，行吗？

english: Yeah... uh... sorry...
translation: 呃……嗯……抱歉……

english: You DARE to invade MY stronghold?!?! Have at thee knave!!!
translation: 你竟敢闯入我的要塞？！？！看招，你这无赖！！！

english: STOP! Please... spare my son.
translation: 住手！求求你……饶了我儿子。

english: Tell me how to untrap Merlin and I might.
translation: 告诉我怎么解救梅林，我或许会考虑。

english: You have guessed correctly that I'm responsible for that.
translation: 你猜对了，那件事是我干的。

english: I suppose I can live with that fool Merlin being loose for the sake of my son.
translation: 为了我儿子，我想我可以忍受让那个傻瓜梅林重获自由。

english: Setting him free won't be easy though.
translation: 不过要放他出来可不容易。

english: You will need to find a magic symbol as close to the crystal as you can find.
translation: 你需要找到一个尽可能靠近水晶的魔法符号。

english: You will then need to drop some bats' bones on the magic symbol while holding a lit black candle.
translation: 然后，你需要手持一根已点燃的黑色蜡烛，把一些蝙蝠骨头丢在那个魔法符号上。

english: This will summon a mighty spirit named Thrantax.
translation: 这会召唤出一个名叫斯兰塔克斯的强大灵魂。

english: You will need to bind him with magic words.
translation: 你需要用魔法咒语束缚住他。

english: Then you will need the sword Excalibur with which the spell was bound in order to shatter the crystal.
translation: 然后你需要用那把用来束缚咒语的剑——王者之剑，才能击碎水晶。

english: So where can I find Excalibur?
translation: 那我在哪能找到王者之剑？

english: The lady of the lake has it. I don't know if she'll give it to you though, she can be rather temperamental.
translation: 湖中女士拿着它。不过我不知道她会不会给你，她脾气可不太好。

english: Ok, I will go do all that.
translation: 好，我这就去办。

english: What are the magic words?
translation: 魔法咒语是什么？

english: You will find the magic words at the base of one of the chaos altars.
translation: 你会在其中一个混沌祭坛的底座上找到魔法咒语。

english: Which chaos altar I cannot remember.
translation: 是哪个混沌祭坛，我记不清了。

english: No. He deserves to die.
translation: 不。他该死。

english: Have you got any black candles?
translation: 你有黑色蜡烛吗？

english: BLACK candles???
translation: 黑色蜡烛？？？

english: Hmmm. In the candle making trade, we have a tradition that it's very bad luck to make black candles.
translation: 嗯……在蜡烛制作这一行，我们有传统，做黑色蜡烛是非常不吉利的。

english: VERY bad luck.
translation: 非常不吉利。

english: I will pay good money for one...
translation: 我会出高价买一根……

english: I still dunno...
translation: 我还是觉得不行……

english: IF you can bring me a bucket FULL of wax.
translation: 如果你能给我带来一桶装满的蜡。

english: Have you got any wax yet?
translation: 你弄到蜡了吗？

english: Tell you what. I'll supply you with a black candle...
translation: 这样吧。我提供给你一根黑色蜡烛……

english: Give it 'ere and I'll trade you for a black candle.
translation: 把它给我，我就跟你换一根黑色蜡烛。

english: Wha- what's that? You've already got a bucket of wax!
translation: 什——什么？你已经有一桶蜡了！

english: Yes, I have some now.
translation: 是的，我现在有一些了。

english: Nope, not yet.
translation: 还没呢。

english: Any ideas on finding Excalibur?
translation: 知道怎么找到王者之剑吗？

english: Unfortunately not, adventurer.
translation: 可惜不知道，冒险者。

english: I need to find Excalibur.
translation: 我需要找到王者之剑。

english: I'd like some advice on finding Excalibur.
translation: 我想请教一下怎么找到王者之剑。

english: Any suggestions on finding Excalibur?
translation: 有什么找到王者之剑的建议吗？

english: My best guess would be some sort of spell. Unfortunately Merlin is our magic expert.
translation: 我猜最好是用某种咒语。可惜梅林才是我们的魔法专家。

english: I need to find Excalibur...
translation: 我需要找到王者之剑……

english: I would want to give it away only to one who is worthy and good.
translation: 我只想把它交给一个配得上它、心地善良的人。

english: And how am I meant to prove that?
translation: 那我该怎么证明呢？

english: I shall set a test for you.
translation: 我会给你设一个考验。

english: First I need you to travel to Port Sarim. Then go to the upstairs room of the jeweller's shop there.
translation: 首先，我需要你前往沙林港。然后去那里珠宝店楼上的房间。

english: Ok. That seems easy enough.
translation: 好。这看起来挺简单的。

english: Please, stranger... my family and I are starving...
translation: 求求您，陌生人……我和我的家人都快饿死了……

english: Could you find it in your heart to spare me a simple loaf of bread?
translation: 你能否发发善心，施舍我一块普通的面包？

english: Yes, certainly.
translation: 好的，当然可以。

english: Well done. You have passed my test.
translation: 做得很好。你已经通过了我的考验。

english: Here is Excalibur, guard it well.
translation: 这是王者之剑，好好保管它。

english: ... except I don't have any bread on me at the moment...
translation: ……只不过我现在身上没有面包……

english: Well, if you get some, you know where to come.
translation: 好吧，如果你拿到了，你知道该去哪里找我。

english: No, I don't have any bread with me.
translation: 不，我没有面包带在身上。

english: Have you got any bread for me yet?
translation: 你给我带面包来了吗？

english: Please kind sir... my family and I are starving...
translation: 好心的先生……我和我的家人快饿死了……

english: Please kind lady... my family and I are starving...
translation: 好心的女士……我和我的家人快饿死了……

english: Good day to you madam.
translation: 日安，夫人。

english: I don't think you are worthy enough.
translation: 我觉得你还不够资格。

english: Come back when you are a better person.
translation: 等你成为更好的人之后再回来。

english: Good day to you, sir.
translation: 日安，先生。

english: Aye, I have that aretefact in my possession.
translation: 是的，那件圣物就在我手上。

english: Actually, I'm wrong. I still don't have any bread. Sorry.
translation: 其实我错了，我还是没有面包。抱歉。

english: Sorry, no, I still have none.
translation: 抱歉，没有，我还是没有。

english: Now what were those magic words again?
translation: 那些魔法词是什么来着？

english: Thou hast me in thine control. So that I mayst return from whence I came, I must grant thee a boon. What dost thou wish of me?
translation: 你已将我掌控。为了让我能返回原处，我必须赐予你一个恩赐。你想向我索求什么？

english: I wish to free Merlin from his giant crystal!
translation: 我想把梅林从他的巨型水晶里解救出来！

english: The deed is done. Thou mayst now shatter Merlin's crystal with Excalibur, and I can once more rest. Begone! And leave me once more in peace.
translation: 契约已完成。汝今可用王者之剑击碎梅林的水晶，吾亦可再次安息。退下！让吾重归宁静。

english: Thou hast me in thine control. So that I mayst return from whence I came, I must grant thee a boon.
translation: 你已将我掌控。为了让我能返回原处，我必须赐予你一个恩赐。

english: What dost thou wish of me?
translation: 你想向我索求什么？

english: The deed is done.
translation: 契约已完成。

english: and I can once more rest. Begone! And leave me once more in peace.
translation: 我终于能再次安息了。走吧！让我重归安宁。

english: Thou mayst now shatter Merlins' crystal with Excalibur,
translation: 你现在可以用王者之剑击碎梅林的水晶了，

english: Thou mayst now shatter Merlin's Crystal with Excalibur,
translation: 你现在可以用王者之剑击碎梅林的水晶了，

english: Thank you! Thank you! Thank you!
translation: 谢谢你！谢谢你！谢谢你！

english: It's not fun being trapped in a giant crystal!
translation: 被困在巨型水晶里可不好玩！

english: Go speak to King Arthur, I'm sure he'll reward you!
translation: 去找亚瑟王谈谈，我相信他会奖赏你的！

english: I have freed Merlin from his crystal!
translation: 我已经把梅林从他的水晶里解救出来了！

english: Ah. A good job, well done. I dub thee a Knight Of The Round Table. You are now an honorary knight.
translation: 啊。干得好，做得漂亮。我赐予你圆桌骑士的称号。你现在是名誉骑士了。

english: What has happened here?
translation: 这里发生了什么？

english: We were invited to a house party on an island not far from here... Something felt wrong about the whole thing but we went anyway...
translation: 我们受邀去附近一个岛上参加家庭派对……整件事感觉不对劲，但我们还是去了……

english: The house seemed pretty creepy, but everything was going fine, we were all having a good time...
translation: 那房子挺阴森的，但一开始一切顺利，我们都玩得很开心……

english: ...and that's when we got attacked...
translation: ……然后我们就遭到了袭击……

english: I... I tried to save her...
translation: 我……我试着救她……

english: Hewey bought me enough time to find an old boat. I went back to get him but it was too late. I'm scared that he won't make it.
translation: 休伊为我争取了足够的时间找到一艘旧船。我回去找他，但已经太晚了。我担心他撑不下去了。

english: You have to do something... they can't get away with this!
translation: 你得做点什么……他们不能逍遥法外！

english: That psycho is still out there, you have to bring them to justice.
translation: 那个疯子还在外面，你必须将他们绳之以法。

english: The boat we escaped on is just over there, you can use it to get to the island.
translation: 我们逃出来的船就在那边，你可以用它去那个岛。

english: I'm not getting involved in this!
translation: 我可不想掺和这事！

english: Please, you need to make sure they don't get away with this! You can use the boat over there to get to the island we escaped from.
translation: 求你了，你得确保他们不能逍遥法外！你可以用那边的船去我们逃出来的那个岛。

english: I should probably talk to whoever left this boat here before rowing off in it...
translation: 在划走之前，我或许该和留下这艘船的人谈谈……

english: I'll have to find the key...
translation: 我得找到钥匙……

english: Woo, party on bro!
translation: 呜呼，派对嗨起来，兄弟！

english: Woah, that wind totally just felt like someone breathing on my neck!
translation: 哇，那阵风感觉就像有人在我脖子上吹气！

english: Whoah, not cool bro...
translation: 哇哦，这可不好玩，兄弟……

english: ...urgh...
...I'm feeling woozy...
translation: ……我头晕……

english: ...gargh...
...I see the light...
translation: ……我看到光了……

english: ...urrggghhh...
translation: ……呃啊啊啊……

english: ...it's not my time...glurgh
translation: ……还没到我死的时候……咕噜

english: ...gargle...urgh...
translation: ……咕噜……呃啊……

english: ...glargh...help...me...
...urgh...hergle...
translation: ……呃啊……赫格……

english: ...flergh.
translation: ……弗格。

english: Gosh, that was horrible and so drawn out!
translation: 天哪，太可怕了，还拖这么久！

english: Oh wow, he's still going...
translation: 哦哇，他还在挣扎……

english: I think he is actually dead this time.
translation: 我觉得他这次真的死了。

english: Who are you? Why are you doing this!?
translation: 你是谁？为什么要这么做！？

english: Gah! I've got to find a way into that house and stop this maniac!
translation: 啊！我得想办法进那房子，阻止这个疯子！

english: I wonder what it was that I saw fall into that barrel?
translation: 我好奇掉进那个桶里的是什么？

english: The barrel is full of rainwater, I can't see what's in there.
translation: 桶里装满了雨水，我看不见里面有什么。

english: Gurgle...
translation: 咕噜……

english: Nooooo!
What's this? A note? I guess I should read it.
translation: 这是什么？一张笔记？我想我该读读看。

english: The fuse is too damp to light...
translation: 引信太湿了，点不着……

english: The fuse is lit, I should get out of here before it blows!
translation: 引信点着了，我该在爆炸前离开这里！

english: The fuse is already lit! I need to get out of here before it blows!
translation: 引信已经点着了！我得在爆炸前离开这里！

english: Please, stop this, just let me go!
translation: 求求你，住手，放我走吧！

english: We're going to play a game. Do you like to play games?
translation: 我们来玩个游戏。你喜欢玩游戏吗？

english: No...yes....whatever you say, just don't hurt me!
translation: 不……是……你说什么都行，别伤害我！

english: Whether you get hurt or not is entirely up to you. Your fate is in your own hands.
translation: 你会不会受伤完全取决于你。你的命运掌握在自己手中。

english: What!? What do you mean!?
translation: 什么！？你什么意思！？

english: Leave her alone you monster!
translation: 放开她，你这个怪物！

english: Ah, [player name], how kind of you to join us. Now if you say another word, I will end her right now!
translation: 啊，[player name]，你真好心来加入我们。现在你再多说一个字，我立刻杀了她！

english: Sorry, where were we? Ah yes, of course! The game!
translation: 抱歉，我们说到哪了？啊，对了！游戏！

english: Do you like quests, Lacey?
translation: 你喜欢任务吗，蕾西？

english: Ummm, sure, I like quests.
translation: 嗯，当然，我喜欢任务。

english: Do you like scary quests?
translation: 你喜欢恐怖任务吗？

english: What's your favourite scary quest?
translation: 你最喜欢的恐怖任务是什么？

english: You have to have a favourite.
translation: 你总得有个最喜欢的。

english: Umm.....the one with that vampyre in it who lives in a big house.
translation: 嗯……那个住在大房子里的吸血鬼的任务。

english: Good, good. And now for that game I spoke about.
translation: 好，好。现在来说说我提到的那个游戏。

english: I am going to ask you one question. Get it wrong and you die, but get it right and you live.
translation: 我要问你一个问题。答错你就死，答对你就活。

english: Oh Guthix please no, please don't, I don't want to die!
translation: 哦，古斯神啊，求求你，不要，我不想死！

english: Then think hard about your answer. You like vampyres so this should be easy for you. The question is this...
translation: 那就好好想想你的答案。你喜欢吸血鬼，所以这对你来说应该很容易。问题是……

english: Who is the Vampyre that resides in South Misthalin?
translation: 住在南米斯林的那个吸血鬼是谁？

english: Urm...
Count Draynor!
translation: 德雷诺伯爵！

english: Count Check!
translation: 检查伯爵！

english: Lord Drakan!
translation: 德拉肯领主！

english: This game didn't involve you [player name]! Now her death is on you! Her blood is on your hands you fool!
translation: 这个游戏没你的事，[player name]！现在她的死要怪你！她的血在你手上，你这个蠢货！

english: Gargle...urgh...
translation: 咕噜……呃啊……

english: Oh yes, yes, I know it! Count Draynor!
translation: 哦，是的，是的，我知道！德雷诺伯爵！

english: Ha, in your face you masked freak!
translation: 哈，打脸了吧，你这个蒙面怪胎！

english: Oh Lacey, Lacey, Lacey. I did tell you to think hard about your answer.
translation: 哦，蕾西，蕾西，蕾西。我告诉过你要好好想想你的答案。

english: Count Draynor is in fact a vampyre, and he does reside in his manor in Misthalin.
translation: 德雷诺伯爵确实是个吸血鬼，他也确实住在米斯林的庄园里。

english: But that manor is in WEST Misthalin! I was talking about Count Check! Thanks for playing!
translation: 但那个庄园在西米斯林！我说的是检查伯爵！谢谢参与！

english: No, no you tricked me! This isn't fair, ask me another...
translation: 不，不，你耍我！这不公平，再问我一个……

english: That monster! I have to stop them! Let's see what that new note says.
translation: 那个怪物！我必须阻止他！看看那张新笔记上写了什么。

english: There is no time to be playing around!
translation: 没时间玩了！

english: I don't think that's right... Perhaps the clue the killer left behind could help?
translation: 我觉得那不对……也许杀手留下的线索能帮上忙？

english: Why am I the one who is always left clearing up after everyone?
translation: 为什么总是我留下来收拾残局？

english: Hello? Anyone there?
translation: 喂？有人吗？

english: Hello? Lacey? Sid?
translation: 喂？蕾西？西德？

english: Hmm, well I guess I should go check it out. No point staying in this nice, locked room when I could go outside into the creepy darkness.
translation: 嗯，我想我该去看看。与其待在这个舒适的上锁房间里，不如出去面对那诡异的黑暗。

english: Seriously!?
translation: 真的假的！？

english: Oh, and I don't think there is any need to take this big, shiny weapon with me in order to defend myself. Nothing bad ever happens when people go check out noises in the dark outside of houses!
translation: 哦，而且我觉得没必要带上这把又大又亮的武器来防身。毕竟，人们出去查看房子外面黑暗中的声响时，从来不会出什么坏事！

english: You have got to be kidding...
translation: 你肯定是在开玩笑……

english: Ok, well, here I go!
translation: 好吧，那我去了！

english: Hello, anyone out here?
translation: 喂，外面有人吗？

english: See, I knew nothing would happen! Must have just been a squirrel or something running about.
translation: 看吧，我就知道什么事都不会发生！肯定只是只松鼠之类的东西在跑来跑去。

english: Oh well, back to the dishes.
translation: 哦，算了，回去洗盘子吧。

english: Phew, that was lucky!
translation: 呼，真走运！

english: No...why...me...
translation: 不……为什么……我……

english: That psycho! He was just toying with her!
translation: 那个疯子！他只是在玩弄她！

english: Another note. This guy really likes playing games, but this is going to be a game he won't win!
translation: 又一张笔记。这家伙真的很喜欢玩游戏，但这将是他赢不了的局！

english: I don't think that's the right order.. Perhaps the clue the killer left behind could help?
translation: 我觉得顺序不对……也许杀手留下的线索能帮上忙？

english: Show yourself you coward!
translation: 出来啊，你这个懦夫！

english: So we meet at last. I have to say, I'm impressed you worked out my riddles.
translation: 我们终于见面了。我得说，你能解开我的谜题，让我印象深刻。

english: Well maybe you aren't as smart as you think you are.
translation: 哼，也许你没自己想的那么聪明。

english: Oh really? All the dead bodies suggest otherwise. And what did you do to stop them?
translation: 哦，是吗？那些尸体可说明不是这样。你又做了什么来阻止他们？

english: NOTHING!
translation: 什么都没做！

english: People think you are some big hero but you're not. All you adventurers are the same. Nothing but opportunists!
translation: 人们以为你是什么大英雄，但你根本不是。你们这些冒险者都一样。不过是些机会主义者！

english: What are you going on about?
translation: 你在胡说什么？

english: Well, I did have this big speech planned out but quite frankly I don't think you are worth the effort it would take to deliver it.
translation: 嗯，我本来准备了一大段演讲，但老实说，我觉得你不值得我费那个劲。

english: So, this is the end of the line for you. It is time for the final act. The showdown. The finale. Let's see if you are up to the challenge!
translation: 所以，你的死期到了。是时候上演最后一幕了。对决。终局。让我看看你是否能应对挑战！

english: *ouch*
translation: *哎哟*

english: Urgh...I think I may have underestimated you.
translation: 呃……我想我可能低估你了。

english: You've lost at your own game. And now it is time to see who you really are under that mask!
translation: 你在自己的游戏里输了。现在是时候看看你面具下到底是谁了！

english: No! You!? But why!? Why on earth would you kill all your friends!? Why beg me to come here to help them!?
translation: 不！是你！？但为什么！？你到底为什么要杀死你所有的朋友！？为什么求我来这里帮助他们！？

english: You just don't get it do you?
translation: 你就是不明白，对吧？

english: So big headed. So used to it all being about you. About you saving the day.
translation: 太自大了。已经习惯了所有事情都围着你转，习惯了你来拯救一切。

english: Well I'm sick of it!
translation: 我受够了！

english: Adventurers! You're all the same. Everything always has to be about you.
translation: 冒险者！你们都是一个样。所有事情总是得围着你们转。

english: I don't understand?
translation: 我不明白？

english: Of course you wouldn't! Because you can't see past yourself!
translation: 你当然不明白！因为你眼里只有你自己！

english: Believe it or not... I used to be like you.
translation: 信不信由你……我过去也曾像你一样。

english: I'd hear about some damsel in distress and go to help. To have my moment. For me to be the hero, just for once.
translation: 我听说某个落难少女就会去帮忙，为了拥有我的时刻，为了让我成为英雄，哪怕只有一次。

english: But YOU! You and every other darned adventurer! Every time I get there to help, it's too late. Crisis solved. Disaster averted. Reward claimed. Every time you and those other adventurers steal my moment!
translation: 但是你这家伙！还有你们其他所有该死的冒险者！每次我赶去帮忙时，都已经太晚了。危机解决了，灾难避免了，报酬领走了。每次你和那些冒险者都偷走了我的时刻！

english: But not this time!
translation: 但这次不会了！

english: This time, it is all about me! I'm the star of the show! ME ME ME ME ME!
translation: 这一次，所有焦点都是我！我是这场戏的主角！我我我我我！

english: Well not any longer. The show is over, and there will be no curtain call.
translation: 现在可不长了。表演结束了，不会有谢幕。

english: Oh, but there is always a curtain call.
translation: 哦，但总有谢幕的时候。

english: What!? How!? There was another killer!?
translation: 什么！？怎么回事！？还有另一个杀手！？

english: Of course. Every good show needs a good supporting actor. Now, take off your mask darling. Take a bow. You have earned it.
translation: 当然。每一场好戏都需要一个好的配角。现在，摘下你的面具吧，亲爱的。鞠个躬，你应得的。

english: Of course, my love.
translation: 当然，我的爱人。

english: Ah, masis sprofcont, how kind of you to join us. Now if you say another word, I will end her right now!
translation: 啊，masis sprofcont，你真好心来加入我们。现在你要是再多说一个字，我立刻就要她的命！

english: This game didn't involve you waskammanreabe! Now her death is on you! Her blood is on your hands you fool!
translation: 这场游戏跟你无关，waskammanreabe！现在她的死要算在你头上！她的血沾在你手上了，你这个蠢货！

english: Ah, waskammanreabe, how kind of you to join us. Now if you say another word, I will end her right now!
translation: 啊，waskammanreabe，你真好心来加入我们。现在你要是再多说一个字，我立刻就要她的命！

english: You!? But how!? You were almost dead when I saw you! I saw your wounds!
translation: 你！？但怎么可能！？我见到你时你都快死了！我看到了你的伤口！

english: No, what you watched was what we wanted you to watch. A masterful performance if I do say myself.
translation: 不，你看到的是我们想让你看到的。我自己都觉得这是一场精湛的表演。

english: But what is in this for you?
translation: 但你这样做图什么？

english: Everyone loves the limelight, and who better to share it with than my beloved Abigale.
translation: 每个人都爱聚光灯，还有谁比我亲爱的阿比盖尔更适合一起分享呢？

english: But your friends?
translation: 但你的朋友们呢？

english: They didn't deserve to die!
translation: 他们不该死！

english: Perhaps not, but neither did I deserve to be cast back into the shadows when I deserve the spotlight!
translation: 或许不该，但我也不该被推回阴影里，我值得拥有聚光灯！

english: Yes, while we deserve the spotlight.
translation: 没错，我们值得拥有聚光灯。

english: And now I have my starring role!
translation: 而现在，我有了我的主角角色！

english: OUR starring role.
translation: 是我们的主角角色。

english: Gielinor will forever remember this night and what I have done here.
translation: 吉莱诺将永远铭记今晚和我在这里所做的一切。

english: No, what WE have done!
translation: 不，是我们所做的一切！

english: Quiet Hewey! This is my moment!
translation: 闭嘴，休伊！这是我的时刻！

english: No, this is supposed to be our moment! It isn't just all about you either! We were in this together!
translation: 不，这应该是我们的时刻！这件事也不全是关于你！我们是一起做的！

english: Stop ruining this Hewey! I have worked so hard for this and I'm not going to let you take it away from me!
translation: 别破坏这一切，休伊！我为这一刻付出了那么多，我不会让你把它从我这里夺走！

english: Well I'm not going to be pushed aside either, we were both in this as equals!
translation: 好吧，我也不会被推到一边，我们两个是平等的！

english: We were never equals! How could you possibly compare to me!?
translation: 我们从来就不平等！你怎么可能跟我比！？

english: You egotistical, selfish...
translation: 你这个自大、自私的……

english: No...my love...
translation: 不……我的爱人……

english: No....no...what have I done!?
translation: 不……不……我做了什么！？

english: It wasn't supposed to be like this...but you just couldn't let me have my moment. WHY HEWEY WHY!? I loved you...
translation: 事情不应该是这样的……但你偏偏不肯让我拥有我的时刻。为什么，休伊，为什么！？我爱过你……

english: This could be my chance to take advantage of the situation...
translation: 这可能是我利用局势的机会……

english: I don't think he's in a very talkative mood.
translation: 我觉得他现在不太想说话。

english: I'm not going at her empty-handed!
translation: 我可不想空手去找她！

english: It would be wiser to use the killer's knife rather than my own weapon...
translation: 用杀手之刀，而不是我自己的武器，会更明智……

english: Well thank Saradomin that's over! I should get out of here.
translation: 感谢萨拉多明，总算结束了！我该离开这里了。

english: I don't think she wants to talk to me right now.
translation: 我觉得她现在不想跟我说话。

english: You'll never escape me!
translation: 你永远逃不出我的手掌心！

english: You dare try and ruin my moment!
translation: 你竟敢试图破坏我的时刻！

english: Hewey is dead because of you!
translation: 休伊是因为你而死的！

english: Now it is time for you to join him!
translation: 现在是时候让你去陪他了！

english: You're not killing anyone else!
translation: 你不能再杀任何人了！

english: No....this can't be it....
translation: 不……不可能就这样结束……

english: *sobs* Please just leave me alone... *sobs*
translation: *啜泣* 拜托让我一个人待着... *啜泣*

english: Wow, that was close!
translation: 哇，真险啊！

english: Mandy, how are you alive!? I watched you get stabbed through the heart!
translation: 曼迪，你怎么还活着！？我亲眼看见你被刺穿心脏！

english: I did get stabbed, but I was born with a rare condition called Dextrocardia.
translation: 我确实被刺了，但我生来有一种罕见的病症，叫右位心。

english: Dextrowhat?
translation: 右位什么？

english: Dextrocardia. It means that my heart is on the right side of my chest, not the left like most people.
translation: 右位心。意思是我的心脏在胸腔右侧，不像大多数人那样在左侧。

english: So when the killer thought they stabbed you in the heart, they actually missed?
translation: 所以当杀手以为刺中了你的心脏时，实际上刺偏了？

english: Well, missed the heart yes.
translation: 嗯，心脏是躲过了。

english: I did still get stabbed though, and am actually feeling pretty woozy...
translation: 不过我还是被刺中了，而且现在真的有点头晕……

english: Oh, yes, right! You should go sort yourself out!
translation: 哦，对，没错！你该去处理一下伤口！

english: I will wait outside the house after seeing to this stab wound. You should come talk to me there.
translation: 我把伤口处理完后会在房子外面等你。你应该到那里来找我谈话。

english: Oh hi, [player name].
translation: 哦，嗨，[player name]。

english: Hi Mandy. How are you feeling now?
translation: 嗨，曼迪。你现在感觉怎么样？

english: Much better thanks, and lucky to be alive, thanks to you in no small part.
translation: 好多了，谢谢，而且能活下来真是幸运，很大程度上多亏了你。

english: Well we saved the day as a team, so thank you too.
translation: 我们作为团队拯救了这一天，所以也谢谢你。

english: I found some stuff in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. You need [3 more spaces/2 more spaces/another space] in your inventory to take it all.
translation: 我在处理伤口时在衣柜里找到了一些东西。你的物品栏需要[3 more spaces/2 more spaces/another space]才能全部拿走。

english: Here, I found these in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. I don't want them so please, take them...
translation: 给，我在处理伤口时在衣柜里发现了这些。我不想要，所以请收下吧……

english: Thanks again for your help, [player name]. Stay safe.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助，[player name]。保重。

english: I found some stuff in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. You need another space in your inventory to take it all.
translation: 我处理伤口的时候在衣柜里找到了一些东西。你需要背包里多一个空位才能全部拿走。

english: I found some stuff in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. You need 2 more spaces in your inventory to take it all.
translation: 我处理伤口的时候在衣柜里找到了一些东西。你需要背包里多两个空位才能全部拿走。

english: I found some stuff in the wardrobe when I was seeing to my wound. You need 3 more spaces in your inventory to take it all.
translation: 我处理伤口的时候在衣柜里找到了一些东西。你需要背包里多三个空位才能全部拿走。

english: Oh hi, [player name]. I meant to give you some Crafting training along with those other rewards, but I forgot.
translation: 哦嗨，[player name]。我本来想和那些奖励一起给你一些制作训练，但我忘了。

english: You too, Mandy.
translation: 你也是，曼迪。

english: *yawn*...oh, hello again...*yawn*
translation: *哈欠*……哦，又见面了……*哈欠*

english: Please tell me you have the blanket.
translation: 请告诉我你拿到毯子了。

english: I need some sleep!
translation: 我需要睡一觉！

english: *yawn*
translation: *哈欠*

english: Yes! I've recovered it from the clutches of the evil thieves!
translation: 是的！我已经从邪恶盗贼的魔爪中夺回来了！

english: Really, that's excellent, well done! Maybe now I will be able to get some rest.
translation: 真的吗，太棒了，干得好！也许现在我终于能休息一下了。

english: *yawn*..I'm off to bed! Farewell brave traveller!
translation: *打哈欠*..我要去睡觉了！再见了，勇敢的旅行者！

english: Can't wait for the party!
translation: 等不及要参加派对了！

english: Much better now I'm sleeping well! Now I can organise the party.
translation: 睡得好多了！现在我可以组织派对了。

english: Ooh! What party?
translation: 哦！什么派对？

english: The son of Brother Androe's birthday party. He's going to be one year old!
translation: 安德罗修士儿子的生日派对。他就要满一岁了！

english: That's sweet!
translation: 真贴心！

english: It's also a great excuse for a drink!
translation: 这也是个喝酒的好借口！

english: We just need Brother Cedric to return with the wine.
translation: 我们只需要塞德里克修士带着酒回来。

english: Who's Brother Cedric?
translation: 塞德里克修士是谁？

english: Cedric is a member of the order too. We sent him out three days ago to collect wine. But he didn't return!
translation: 塞德里克也是我们教团的一员。我们三天前派他去取酒，但他没回来！

english: He most probably got drunk and lost in the forest!
translation: 他很可能喝醉了，在森林里迷路了！

english: I don't suppose you could look for him?
translation: 你能去找找他吗？

english: I've no time for that, sorry.
translation: 我没时间做那个，抱歉。

english: Okay traveller, take care.
translation: 好吧，旅人，保重。

english: Where should I look?
translation: 我该去哪里找？

english: Oh, he won't be far. Probably out in the forest.
translation: 哦，他不会走远的。大概就在森林里。

english: Ok, I'll go and find him.
translation: 好，我去找他。

english: Can I come to the party?
translation: 我能来参加派对吗？

english: Of course, but we need the wine first.
translation: 当然可以，但我们得先有酒。

english: Enjoy it! I'll see you soon!
translation: 好好享受！我们很快再见！

english: Take care traveller.
translation: 保重，旅人。

english: Hello brother Omad.
translation: 你好，奥马德修士。

english: Hello adventurer, have you found Brother Cedric?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你找到塞德里克修士了吗？

english: Well, keep looking, we need that wine!
translation: 嗯，继续找吧，我们需要那酒！

english: Brother Cedric are you okay?
translation: 塞德里克修士，你还好吗？

english: Yeesshhh, I'm very, very drunk..hic..up..
translation: 是……是的，我喝得非……非常醉……呃……

english: Brother Omad needs the wine for the party.
translation: 奥马德修士需要酒来办派对。

english: Oh dear, oh dear, I knew I had to do something!
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪，我就知道我有事要做！

english: Pleashhh, find me a jug of water. Once I'm sober I'll 'elp you take the wine back.
translation: 请……帮我找一壶水。等我清醒了，我就帮你把酒带回去。

english: Hic up! Oh my head! I need a jug of water.
translation: 呃！哦我的头！我需要一壶水。

english: I'll see if I can get some.
translation: 我去看看能不能弄到一些。

english: Thanks! *hic*
translation: 谢谢！*呃*

english: Yes I've seen him, he's a bit drunk!
translation: 是的，我看到他了，他有点醉了！

english: Well, try your best to get him back here!
translation: 嗯，尽力把他带回来！

english: Cedric! Here, drink! I have some water.
translation: 塞德里克！来，喝吧！我弄到水了。

english: Good stuff, my head's spinning!
translation: 好东西，我头好晕！

english: Gulp... gulp!
translation: 咕嘟……咕嘟！

english: Aah! That's better!
translation: 啊！好多了！

english: Now I just need to fix this cart and we can go party.
translation: 现在我只需要修好这辆推车，我们就可以去派对了。

english: Could you help?
translation: 你能帮个忙吗？

english: No, I've helped enough monks today!
translation: 不，我今天帮的修士够多了！

english: In that case I'd better drink more wine! It helps me think.
translation: 那样的话，我最好再喝点酒！这有助于我思考。

english: Yes, I'd be happy to!
translation: 好的，我很乐意！

english: Excellent, I just need some wood. Some plain logs, or maybe a basic plank.
translation: 太好了，我只需要一些木材。一些普通的原木，或者一块基本的木板。

english: OK, I'll see what I can find.
translation: 好，我去看看能找到什么。

english: Hello again brother Omad.
translation: 又见面了，奥马德修士。

english: Hello adventurer, where's Brother Cedric?
translation: 你好，冒险者，塞德里克修士呢？

english: He's having a bit of trouble with his cart.
translation: 他的推车出了点问题。

english: Hmmm! Maybe you could help?
translation: 嗯！也许你能帮上忙？

english: Did you manage to get some wood?
translation: 你弄到木材了吗？

english: Not yet, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕还没有。

english: Well done! Now I'll fix this cart. You head back to Brother Omad and tell him I'll be there soon.
translation: 干得好！现在我来修这辆推车。你先回奥马德修士那里，告诉他我很快就到。

english: Ok! I'll see you later!
translation: 好！回头见！

english: Hello Cedric.
translation: 你好，塞德里克。

english: Hi, I'm almost done here. Could you tell Omad that I'll be back soon?
translation: 嗨，我快弄好了。你能告诉奥马德我很快就回去吗？

english: Excellent, I just need some wood.
translation: 太好了，我只差一些木材。

english: Oh dear, oh dear, I knew I had to do something! Pleashh, find me a jug of water. Once I'm sober I'll 'elp you take the wine back.
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪，我就知道我得做点什么！求求你了，给我找一壶水来。等我清醒了，我就帮你把酒搬回去。

english: Now I just need to fix this cart and we can go party. Can you help?
translation: 现在我只差修好这辆推车，我们就可以去派对了。你能帮忙吗？

english: Gulp...gulp! Aah! That's better!
translation: 咕咚...咕咚！啊哈！这下好多了！

english: In that case i'd better drink more wine! It helps me think.
translation: 那样的话我最好再多喝点酒！喝酒能帮我思考。

english: ...hic ..up
Hi Omad, Brother Cedric is on his way!
translation: 嗨，奥马德，塞德里克修士正在路上！

english: Good! Good! Now we can party!
translation: 好！好！现在我们可以开派对了！

english: I have little to repay you with but please, take these runes.
translation: 我没什么能回报你的，但请收下这些符文。

english: Thanks Brother Omad!
translation: 谢谢，奥马德修士！

english: OK, let's party!
translation: 好，让我们开始派对吧！

english: Party!
translation: 派对！

english: Woop!
translation: 呜呼！

english: Let's boogie!
translation: 一起摇摆！

english: Oh baby!
translation: 哦宝贝！

english: GO!
translation: 上！

english: Get down!
translation: 嗨起来！

english: Feel the rhythm!
translation: 感受节奏！

english: Dance!
translation: 跳舞！

english: Watch me go!
translation: 看我表演！

english: You go!
translation: 你来！

english: *hic* What a party! Wow!
translation: *呃* 多棒的派对！哇！

english: Are you ready to investigate the shipyard for me?
translation: 你准备好替我调查船厂了吗？

english: What do I have to do?
translation: 我需要做什么？

english: Go to Glough's old shipyard on the eastern coast of Karamja. Find out what happened to the 10th squad of my Royal Guard.
translation: 去格劳夫在卡拉姆詹岛东海岸的旧船厂。查明我的皇家卫队第十小队发生了什么事。

english: As I said, they were sent to oversee the decommission of the ship building facilities, but I have heard nothing from them.
translation: 正如我说的，他们被派去监督造船设施的退役，但我没有收到任何他们的消息。

english: What am I meant to do?
translation: 我该做什么？

english: How did the 10th squad travel?
translation: 第十小队是怎么旅行的？

english: They would have each flown a Gnome Glider.
translation: 他们每人都会驾驶一架地精滑翔机。

english: Hello. Do I know you? You seem remarkably familiar...
translation: 你好。我认识你吗？你看起来非常眼熟……

english: Erm, no you don't know me.
translation: 呃，不，你不认识我。

english: If you say so. Anyway, what do you want?
translation: 随你怎么说吧。那么，你想要什么？

english: Have you seen any of King Narnode's Royal Guard recently? They were meant to be doing ... some work in the area.
translation: 你最近见过纳诺德国王的皇家卫队吗？他们应该在这个区域做……一些工作。

english: I wouldn't know anything about that. You should see Caranock.
translation: 我对此一无所知。你应该去找卡拉诺克。

english: Who is Caranock?
translation: 卡拉诺克是谁？

english: Our Gnome Liaison Officer.
translation: 我们的地精联络官。

english: Who are you? Did Glough send you?
translation: 你是谁？是格劳夫派你来的吗？

english: Glough? No. He has been forced to resign by the King.
translation: 格劳夫？不。他已经被国王强迫辞职了。

english: Forced to resign??
translation: 强迫辞职？？

english: He was plotting to start a war between Gnomes and humankind.
translation: 他正在策划发动一场地精与人类之间的战争。

english: Anyway, I am here on a separate mission. I am investigating the mysterious disappearance of the 10th squad of King Narnode's Royal Guard. They were to carry out some work in the area.
translation: 总之，我来这里是执行一项独立任务。我正在调查纳诺德国王的皇家卫队第十小队的神秘失踪事件。他们本应在该区域执行一些工作。

english: Royal Guard? I know nothing about them. Absolutely nothing.
translation: 皇家卫队？我对此一无所知。绝对不知道。

english: You have no idea why they mysteriously disappeared?
translation: 你完全不知道他们为什么神秘失踪了吗？

english: None whatsoever. What were they here to do?
translation: 一点都不知道。他们来这里做什么？

english: They were to oversee the decommission of the shipyard.
translation: 他们来监督船厂的退役。

english: Decommission the shipyard... I see. Well, we have had some seriously strong southerly winds of late. They may have been blown off course during flight.
translation: 退役船厂……我明白了。嗯，我们最近遇到了非常强烈的南风。他们可能在飞行中被吹离了航线。

english: I shall personally see to the decommission. You should report to the King immediately.
translation: 我会亲自处理退役事宜。你应该立即向国王报告。

english: Why are you still here? You should report immediately to the King!
translation: 你怎么还在这里？你应该立即向国王报告！

english: Hello. I investigated the shipyard.
translation: 你好。我调查了船厂。

english: Thank you for doing this. What did you find?
translation: 感谢你这么做。你发现了什么？

english: I met a Gnome who goes by the name of Caranock. Do you recognise it?
translation: 我遇到了一个名叫卡拉诺克的地精。你认识这个名字吗？

english: The name sounds a little familiar, but it is nobody I know personally.
translation: 这个名字听起来有点耳熟，但我个人并不认识。

english: He calls himself a Gnome Liaison Officer. He seemed a little... odd
translation: 他自称是地精联络官。他看起来有点……奇怪

english: Never mind that - did you find anything out about my 10th squad?
translation: 别管那个了——你找到我第十小队的任何消息了吗？

english: Caranock suggested they were blown off course by extreme southern winds.
translation: 卡拉诺克暗示他们被极端的南风吹离了航线。

english: Do you believe him?
translation: 你相信他吗？

english: I don't have any other information right now.
translation: 我现在没有其他信息。

english: Very well. I will now prepare some orders. You must convey them to my new High Tree Guardian, Daero.
translation: 很好。我现在准备一些命令。你必须把它们传达给我的新大树守护者，达埃罗。

english: Where will I find Daero?
translation: 我在哪里能找到达埃罗？

english: You will find him attending to business somewhere on the Grand Tree.
translation: 你会在“大树家园”的某处找到他，他正在处理事务。

english: How goes the mission?
translation: 任务进展如何？

english: I'm still working on it...
translation: 我还在努力中……

english: Yes, adventurer?
translation: 是的，冒险者？

english: You know those orders you gave me -
translation: 你知道你给我的那些命令——

english: You've lost them?
translation: 你弄丢了它们？

english: Yes - how did you know?
translation: 是的——你怎么知道的？

english: Oh, it often happens. Luckily I had the foresight to write in a secret code on self-destructing paper.
translation: 哦，这经常发生。幸运的是我有先见之明，用密码写在自毁纸上。

english: Here, take a another.
translation: 给你，再拿一份。

english: Are you Daero?
translation: 你是达埃罗吗？

english: Indeed I am - and you are?
translation: 确实是我——你是？

english: I am an adventurer. I am currently in the service of your King.
translation: 我是一个冒险者。我目前正在为你们的国王服务。

english: I see. You must be the individual who helped defeat my predecessor Glough. I hope you'll find me a more honest replacement.
translation: 我明白了。你一定就是那个帮助击败我前任格劳夫的人。希望你会觉得我是一个更诚实的替代者。

english: I have been asked to give you orders from King Narnode.
translation: 我被要求给你送来纳诺德国王的命令。

english: Well hand them over here then.
translation: 那就把它们交给我吧。

english: However, I appear to have lost them...
translation: 不过，我好像把它们弄丢了……

english: Well you'd better retrieve them as soon as possible. Our enemies may extract sensitive information from them.
translation: 那你最好尽快找回它们。我们的敌人可能会从中提取敏感信息。

english: It is written in an old military code. Bear with me whilst I decode this.
translation: 这是用旧军用密码写的。请稍候，我来解码。

english: I hope you feel like a quest adventurer ...
translation: 我希望你感觉自己像个任务冒险者……

english: ... because you are going to get one.
translation: ……因为你即将接到一个任务。

english: Tell me what the orders say!
translation: 告诉我命令说了什么！

english: Given your recent performance of uncovering and neutralising a threat at the very extremes of the Gnome hierarchy, the King has decreed that you are to undertake a reconnaisance mission.
translation: 鉴于你最近在地精高层揭露并消除威胁的表现，国王下令让你执行一次侦察任务。

english: Where to?
translation: 去往何处？

english: You are to be taken far to the south of Karamja, further than any Gnome has purposely travelled before. You are to investigate Caranock's claim that Garkor's squad were blown off course.
translation: 你将前往卡拉姆詹岛以南很远的地方，比任何地精之前有意前往的距离都要远。你要调查卡拉诺克关于加科尔小队被吹离航线的说法。

english: You must really have impressed the King in the past.
translation: 你过去一定给国王留下了深刻印象。

english: What lies to the south of Karamja?
translation: 卡拉姆詹岛以南有什么？

english: We do not know. Initial reports spoke of a large atoll populated by monkeys.
translation: 我们不知道。初步报告提到一个由猴子居住的大型环礁。

english: Monkeys? Like on Karamja?
translation: 猴子？像卡拉姆詹岛上的那种？

english: From what I have heard, not quite like those monkeys...
translation: 据我所听说的，不太像那些猴子……

english: How will I travel?
translation: 我怎么去？

english: It is my responsibility to make arrangements for your mission. We will shortly visit a colleague of mine who will be accompanying you.
translation: 为你的任务做安排是我的责任。我们很快会去见一位同事，他将与你同行。

english: Are you coming with me?
translation: 你跟我一起去吗？

english: I am afraid not. I must remain here to safeguard the Grand Tree. I will assign a Gnome agent to travel with you.
translation: 恐怕不行。我必须留在这里保护"大树家园"。我会指派一名地精特工与你同行。

english: Why did the King send a squad of the Royal Guard?
translation: 为什么国王要派一支皇家卫队小队？

english: The Royal Guard is composed of particularly elite soldiers who have proven themselves in battle. They are duty bound to protect the Grand Tree its King and his interests.
translation: 皇家卫队由特别精锐的士兵组成，他们在战斗中证明了自己。他们有义务保护"大树家园"、国王及其利益。

english: In the face of danger, they can more than take care of themselves.
translation: 面对危险时，他们完全可以照顾好自己。

english: So the King worries we have come across an equally formidable foe?
translation: 所以国王担心我们遇到了同样强大的敌人？

english: He worries about this, yes.
translation: 他担心这个，是的。

english: Who is Garkor?
translation: 加科尔是谁？

english: Sergeant Garkor holds the command of the 10th squad. As a soldier, he is extremely able. If his men are in trouble, he will be tirelessly working to save them.
translation: 中士加科尔指挥第十小队。作为一名士兵，他非常有能力。如果他的手下遇到麻烦，他会不知疲倦地努力拯救他们。

english: You should aim to make contact with him.
translation: 你应该设法与他取得联系。

english: Why are the 10th squad so famous?
translation: 为什么第十小队这么有名？

english: They are, as you humans might say, the best of the best. As well as Sergeant Garkor, they have in their company a High Mage, two sappers and battle hardened foot soldiers.
translation: 他们，正如你们人类可能说的，是精英中的精英。除了中士加科尔，他们队伍中还有一名高阶法师、两名工兵和久经沙场的步兵。

english: What is a sapper?
translation: 什么是工兵？

english: You might consider the role as that of an engineer. Or perhaps of a munitions expert.
translation: 你可以把这个角色看作工程师，或者军械专家。

english: I have never heard of him. According to the report you made to the King, he is the Gnome Liaison Officer at the eastern Karamja shipyard.
translation: 我从没听说过他。根据你向国王的报告，他是卡拉姆詹岛东部船厂的地精联络官。

english: What is a Gnome Liaison Officer?
translation: 什么是地精联络官？

english: It was a position Glough introduced. Gnome Liaison Officers are in general responsible for coordinating activities between Gnomes and other beings in our remote operations.
translation: 这是格劳夫引入的一个职位。地精联络官通常负责在我们偏远行动中协调地精与其他生物之间的活动。

english: I'm not so sure about Caranock...
translation: 我不太确定卡拉诺克这个人……

english: I do not know. He just seemed a little suspicious. He was very keen to see me leave.
translation: 我不知道。他只是看起来有点可疑。他非常希望我离开。

english: I do not know him; he is from before my time. Glough would presumably have hand picked him.
translation: 我不认识他；他是在我之前任职的。格劳夫大概会亲自挑选他。

english: Let us go then.
translation: 那我们走吧。

english: I must first introduce you to a colleague of mine who will be accompanying you on your mission.
translation: 我必须先给你介绍一位同事，他将陪同你执行任务。

english: Who is it?
translation: 是谁？

english: His name is Flight Commander Waydar.
translation: 他叫飞行指挥官韦达。

english: We must go now and meet Waydar. For security reasons I must ask you to wear a blindfold.
translation: 我们现在必须去见韦达。出于安全原因，我必须要求你戴上眼罩。

english: I work better on my own...
translation: 我单独行动效率更高……

english: Tough. You will be working with Flight Commander Waydar.
translation: 不行。你将与飞行指挥官韦达一起工作。

english: Sorry, I am not authorised to talk to you.
translation: 抱歉，我没有权限与你交谈。

english: Welcome, adventurer, to the Underground Military Glider Hangar.
translation: 欢迎你，冒险者，来到地下军用滑翔机机库。

english: Wow! Why would Gnomes need such a place?
translation: 哇！地精为什么需要这样的地方？

english: We do not, if the truth be told. This hangar was part of Glough's contingency planning. Had the attacks by land and sea failed, he would have turned to air.
translation: 说实话，我们并不需要。这个机库是格劳夫应急计划的一部分。如果陆地和海上攻击失败，他就会转向空中。

english: It is fortunate indeed that you managed to expose him. The military gliders in this hangar are a prototype for a much refined version of the standard variety we currently use.
translation: 幸运的是，你成功揭露了他。这个机库里的军用滑翔机是我们目前使用的标准型号的改良版原型机。

english: Let me introduce you to Flight Commander Waydar.
translation: 让我为你介绍飞行指挥官韦达。

english: Flight Commander Waydar, I would like you to meet [player name].
translation: 飞行指挥官韦达，我想让你认识一下[player name]。

english: Greetings High Tree Guardian.
translation: 你好，大树守护者。

english: And greetings to you too, visitor.
translation: 也向你问好，访客。

english: Not just any old visitor Waydar; this is the person who exposed Glough and defeated his demon.
translation: 韦达，他可不是什么普通访客；他就是那个揭发格劳夫并击败他恶魔的人。

english: I see. Well, there are no more demons left here.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，这里已经没有恶魔了。

english: Quite. [He is/She is/They are] now on a secret mission for the King.
translation: 没错。[He is/She is/They are]现在正在为国王执行一项秘密任务。

english: As you know, the 10th squad went missing during their mission to decommission the eastern shipyard of Karamja.
translation: 如你所知，第十小队在执行拆除卡拉姆詹岛东部造船厂的任务时失踪了。

english: We still do not know what happened, but evidence suggests they were blown far off course to the south.
translation: 我们仍然不知道发生了什么，但有证据表明他们被吹离了航线，远远飘向了南方。

english: Their standard gliders must have fallen prey to the tropical weather.
translation: 他们的标准滑翔机一定遭受了热带天气的影响。

english: When reinitialisation has been completed, you are to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name] and accompany [him/her/them] on the mission.
translation: 当重新初始化完成后，你将与[player name]一起飞往卡拉姆詹岛南部，并陪同[him/her/them]执行任务。

english: We are no closer to reinitialising sir - the code is too hard. It is likely the only person who could do it is Glough.
translation: 长官，我们离重新初始化还差得远——代码太难了。可能唯一能解开它的人就是格劳夫。

english: That Gnome is never stepping foot in this hangar again. He always was and still is a menace. Do you understand me?
translation: 那个地精永远别想再踏进这个机库一步。他过去是，现在也仍然是个祸害。你明白我的意思吗？

english: Very well. Notify me when you have managed to reinitialise.
translation: 很好。等你们成功重新初始化了再通知我。

english: [player name], you will have to wait till reinitialisation is complete.
translation: [player name]，你得等到重新初始化完成。

english: Hello again, adventurer. Would you like to return to the hangar?
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。你想回机库吗？

english: Very well. Return to me when you do.
translation: 好吧。等你想好了再来找我。

english: How do I leave?
translation: 我怎么离开？

english: There is a teleporter round the corner. You must use this.
translation: 拐角处有一个传送器。你必须用它。

english: Where is the hangar?
translation: 机库在哪里？

english: We try to ensure the location of the hangar remains a secret. If you must know something, then know that it lies directly beneath the Gnomeball pitch. However, I cannot reveal the location of its entrance.
translation: 我们努力确保机库的位置保密。如果你必须知道什么，那就知道它就在地精球球场正下方。不过，我不能透露入口的位置。

english: There is a teleporter round the corner.
translation: 拐角处有一个传送器。

english: How do I return later?
translation: 我以后怎么回来？

english: Come and find me on the Grand Tree. I will probably be at the bar.
translation: 来大树家园找我。我大概会在酒吧里。

english: What is reinitialisation?
translation: 什么是重新初始化？

english: Glough left a code on the facility which periodically needs to be entered if we wish to maintain the supply of power.
translation: 格劳夫在设施上留下了一个代码，如果我们想维持电力供应，就需要定期输入。

english: Without going through this process of reinitiliasation, we cannot power the mechanism which deploys the millitary gliders.
translation: 不完成这个重新初始化的过程，我们就无法为部署军用滑翔机的机制提供动力。

english: What are military gliders?
translation: 什么是军用滑翔机？

english: As Daero said, they are a prototype for a new version of glider. They are reinforced yet are built out of lighter materials. They can fly much faster and for longer.
translation: 就像达埃罗说的，它们是新型滑翔机的原型。它们经过加固，却由更轻的材料制成。它们能飞得更快、更远。

english: Why are the gliders folded against the wall?
translation: 为什么滑翔机都折叠着靠在墙上？

english: It is the most compact way to store them. Unfortunately, they will remain like that until they are powered. We can only fully power the hangar when reinitialisation has been completed.
translation: 这是最节省空间的存放方式。不幸的是，在它们获得动力之前，只能保持这样。只有重新初始化完成后，我们才能为整个机库提供全部动力。

english: When will reinitialisation be completed?
translation: 重新初始化什么时候能完成？

english: I cannot be sure. It is a difficult code; it may happen the next instant - then again it may not.
translation: 我不确定。这是一个很难的代码；可能下一秒就解开了——也可能解不开。

english: You could even have a go at solving the code yourself.
translation: 你也可以自己试试破解这个代码。

english: Where is the reinitialisation code?
translation: 重新初始化代码在哪里？

english: The code must be entered at the red control panel just by the wall over there.
translation: 代码必须在那边的墙旁边的红色控制面板上输入。

english: You look frustrated, human.
translation: 你看起来很沮丧，人类。

english: I've been told to wait for reinitialisation of the hangar. They mentioned your name.
translation: 他们让我等着机库重新初始化。他们提到了你的名字。

english: Of course they would. I'm the only one who knows how to do it.
translation: 他们当然会提到我。我是唯一知道怎么做的人。

english: This is really quite embarrassing, but...
translation: 这真的很尴尬，但是……

english: Let me guess, you need my help...
translation: 让我猜猜，你需要我的帮助……

english: Yes, I suppose I do.
translation: 是的，我想是的。

english: I am able to remotely reinitialise...
translation: 我可以远程重新初始化……

english: But... ?
translation: 但是……？

english: It will cost you...
translation: 这需要你付出代价……

english: Oh... just a measly 200,000 coins. Yes, I think that will do me nicely.
translation: 哦……只要区区20万金币。是的，我想这个数目对我来说正合适。

english: I don't have that kind of money on me right now.
translation: 我现在身上没带那么多钱。

english: Ok then. You win again, Glough.
translation: 好吧。格劳夫，你又赢了。

english: It's been a pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 跟你做生意很愉快。

english: Indeed. I wish I could say the same for you.
translation: 确实。真希望我也能对你说同样的话。

english: That's outrageous!
translation: 这太离谱了！

english: No, I'd rather skin a monkey than take your help!
translation: 不，我宁愿去剥猴子的皮也不要你的帮助！

english: You don't know how to do that yet!
translation: 你还不知道怎么剥呢！

english: Well done, adventurer. You have managed to break Glough's code. Now the process of reinitialisation is complete, you can truly begin your journey into the unknown.
translation: 干得好，冒险者。你成功破解了格劳夫的代码。现在重新初始化过程已经完成，你可以真正开始你的未知之旅了。

english: I've had some practice in the past.
translation: 我以前有过一些练习。

english: You are clearly a human of many talents.
translation: 你显然是一个多才多艺的人类。

english: Flight Commander Waydar, now that reinitialisation is complete, I order you to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name]
translation: 飞行指挥官韦达，既然重新初始化已经完成，我命令你和[player name]一起飞往卡拉姆詹岛南部。

english: You are to safeguard [him/her/them] on this potentially dangerous mission.
translation: 你要在这次潜在的危险任务中保护[him/her/them]的安全。

english: [player name], speak to Waydar when you are ready to leave.
translation: [player name]，准备好出发时就跟韦达说。

english: And ... good luck.
translation: 还有……祝你好运。

english: Well done on breaking the code. You should speak to the High Tree Guardian.
translation: 干得好，破解了代码。你应该去跟大树守护者谈谈。

english: Flight Commander Waydar, now that reinitialisation is complete, I order you to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name].
translation: 飞行指挥官韦达，既然重新初始化已经完成，我命令你和[player name]一起飞往卡拉姆詹岛南部。

english: You should stock up well on food before our journey. I can carry only enough provisions for myself.
translation: 在我们出发前，你应该多储备些食物。我只能携带足够自己用的补给品。

english: I'd be careful of the local fauna too - I've heard the bite is far worse than any noise they make.
translation: 也要小心当地的动物——我听说它们的咬伤比它们的叫声可怕多了。

english: Do you wish to fly right now?
translation: 你想现在就飞吗？

english: I am not sure. We appear to have landed where the 10th squad crashed. The number of gnome gliders is correct. Unfortunately for them, it appears that none of their gliders survived the collision.
translation: 我不确定。我们似乎降落在了第十小队坠毁的地方。地精滑翔机的数量是对的。但对他们来说不幸的是，似乎没有一架滑翔机在撞击中幸存下来。

english: Did our glider survive?
translation: 我们的滑翔机幸存了吗？

english: Who are you two?
translation: 你们两个是谁？

english: We are on a mission for King Narnode Shareen. I am [player name] and this is Flight Commander Waydar.
translation: 我们正在为纳罗德.沙林国王执行一项任务。我是[player name]，这位是飞行指挥官韦达。

english: What business do you have here?
translation: 你们来这里有什么事？

english: We are to investigate the disappearance of the 10th squad of the Royal Guard. Am I right in suspecting that you, Lumdo, are a member of the 10th squad?
translation: 我们要调查皇家卫队第十小队失踪的事件。我猜得没错的话，你，卢姆多，是第十小队的成员吧？

english: I might be. Do you have any way to prove that you are who you say are?
translation: 也许吧。你有什么办法证明你的身份吗？

english: I have the Gnome Royal Seal.
translation: 我有地精皇家印章。

english: I see. Sorry for my distrust.
translation: 我明白了。抱歉我多疑了。

english: We flew here on a military gnome glider. Is that not proof enough?
translation: 我们乘坐军用滑翔机飞到这里。这还不够证明吗？

english: I suppose it is. Sorry for my distrust.
translation: 我想是的。抱歉我多疑了。

english: So are you Lumdo of the 10th squad?
translation: 那么，你就是第十小队的卢姆多吗？

english: I am indeed -
translation: 我确实是——

english: Where are the rest of your squad? Where is your Sergeant?
translation: 你小队的其他成员呢？你们的中士呢？

english: Let me begin at the beginning, human.
translation: 让我从头说起吧，人类。

english: We were on our way to decommission Glough's old ship building facilities in eastern Karamja, as you probably know. However, we obviously chose the wrong season to fly.
translation: 我们当时正要去拆除格劳夫在卡拉姆詹岛东部的旧造船设施，你可能也知道。但是，我们显然选错了飞行的季节。

english: We were one gnome to a glider, so each was extremely light. Like leaves in a wind, we were blown south before we even landed on that island.
translation: 我们每个地精一架滑翔机，所以每架都非常轻。就像风中的叶子一样，我们还没降落到那个岛上就被吹到了南方。

english: Did you crash straight here?
translation: 你们是直接坠毁在这里的吗？

english: Yes. The winds drove us into the treetops, which destroyed the canvas of our gliders. We dragged what remained of the gliders out onto this beach.
translation: 是的。风把我们吹进了树梢，毁坏了我们滑翔机的帆布。我们把滑翔机的残骸拖到了这片海滩上。

english: What did you do then?
translation: 然后你们做了什么？

english: Whilst we were falling, Sergeant Garkor noticed a large populated atoll to our west. You cannot see it from here, but it is within sailing distance.
translation: 在我们坠落的时候，加科尔中士注意到我们西边有一个大型有人居住的环礁。你从这里看不到，但它在航行距离之内。

english: We spent time gathering enough wood to fashion two boats. The Sergeant took the rest of the 10th squad in the larger of the boats to explore the island and to search for potential glider launch sites.
translation: 我们花时间收集了足够的木材来造两艘船。中士带着10号分队的其余人乘坐较大的那艘船去探索岛屿并寻找潜在的滑翔机发射地点。

english: Presumably you are to guard the gliders until they return?
translation: 想必你被留下来看守滑翔机直到他们回来？

english: Affirmative.
translation: 是的。

english: You must take us to the island. I have orders from the High Tree Guardian to make contact with your Sergeant.
translation: 你必须带我们去那个岛。我奉大树守护者之命要与你们的中士取得联系。

english: And I have orders from the Sergeant to stay here.
translation: 而我奉中士之命要留在这里。

english: You will not take me?
translation: 你不带我去？

english: I will not take orders from you.
translation: 我不会听从你的命令。

english: Will you take me to the atoll?
translation: 你能带我去那个环礁吗？

english: I am under direct orders to remain here.
translation: 我接到直接命令要留在这里。

english: What shall we do now?
translation: 我们现在该怎么办？

english: During our descent I noticed a large populated island far to the west. I suggest we try and make our way there.
translation: 在我们下降的过程中，我注意到西边远处有一个大型有人居住的岛屿。我建议我们试着去那里。

english: Do you recognize the gnome on the beach?
translation: 你认识海滩上的那个地精吗？

english: If I recall correctly, which I probably do, he is Lumdo of the 10th squad. I imagine he has been left to guard their gliders.
translation: 如果我没记错，他应该是10号分队的卢姆多。我想他被留下来看守他们的滑翔机了。

english: Can you take me back to your kingdom?
translation: 你能带我回你的王国吗？

english: Let me remind you that we are on a mission for King Narnode. We must attend to this mission.
translation: 让我提醒你，我们正在执行纳罗德.沙林国王的任务。我们必须专注于这个任务。

english: My mission involves leaving this island!
translation: 我的任务就是离开这座岛！

english: This is highly irregular.
translation: 这太不合常规了。

english: I cannot convince Lumdo to take us to the island...
translation: 我无法说服卢姆多带我们去那座岛……

english: He claims to be under direct orders from Garkor to guard their gliders until the rest return.
translation: 他声称直接受加科尔命令，要在这里看守滑翔机直到其余人回来。

english: His zeal in this matter is to be expected. The Royal Guard - in particular the 10th squad - are renowned for their fierce loyalty.
translation: 他在这件事上的热忱可以理解。皇家卫队——特别是第十小队——以忠诚著称。

english: Can you do anything?
translation: 你能做点什么吗？

english: I would rather not get involved. My mission is to protect you.
translation: 我宁愿不掺和。我的任务就是保护你。

english: You must do something!
translation: 你必须做点什么！

english: You are becoming tiresome, human. As you wish.
translation: 你真烦人，人类。如你所愿。

english: Foot soldier Lumdo of the 10th squad.
translation: 步兵卢姆多，10号分队的。

english: I am Flight Commander Waydar. I believe you are under direct orders from your Sergeant to guard these gliders?
translation: 我是飞行指挥官韦达。我相信你直接听从你的中士的命令看守这些滑翔机？

english: That is correct, Commander.
translation: 没错，指挥官。

english: I need not remind you that I outrank Garkor. As of this instant, your orders are to convey the human to the atoll and remain there until [he needs/she needs/they need] to return.
translation: 我不需要提醒你，我的军衔高于加科尔。从现在起，你的命令是护送这位人类前往环礁，并在那里等待，直到[he needs/she needs/they need]需要返回。

english: Garkor will not be pleased!
translation: 加科尔会不高兴的！

english: Then he can take up his issues with me personally.
translation: 那他可以直接来找我谈。

english: Waydar! Will you not accompany me to the island?
translation: 韦达！你不陪我一起去岛上吗？

english: No. After all, somebody has to look after the gliders.
translation: 不。毕竟总得有人照看滑翔机。

english: But it is your mission to protect me!
translation: 但你的任务是保护我！

english: Enough. Return here when you are done.
translation: 够了。你完事之后就回到这里。

english: The workers are getting restless, Caranock.
translation: 工人们越来越焦躁了，卡拉诺克。

english: I know...
translation: 我知道……

english: All this talk of Glough being replaced doesn't bode well for ... how shall I put this ... their morale.
translation: 关于格劳夫被替代的那些传言，对……该怎么说呢……对士气可不是好兆头。

english: Look, I know.
translation: 听着，我知道。

english: Those are all men with children to feed. Famished families. Worried wives. All of us rely on this shipyard.
translation: 那些人都有孩子要养。饥饿的家庭，忧心忡忡的妻子。我们都依赖这个造船厂。

english: If something isn't done soon, there'll be revolt. And I won't be able to stop it.
translation: 如果不尽快采取行动，就会发生暴动。到时候我可拦不住。

english: Stop worrying. I'm working on something -
translation: 别担心了。我正在想办法——

english: What something? You're always working on something. All we ever hear is bad news.
translation: 什么办法？你总说在想办法。我们听到的永远只有坏消息。

english: First, Glough disappears. Then news of a missing squad of the Royal Guard in our area. And what about that human sent by the King?
translation: 先是格劳夫失踪了。然后又是我们区域有一队皇家卫队失踪的消息。还有国王派来的那个人类是怎么回事？

english: The human means nothing. If it becomes too much trouble, I will simply have it ... removed. In the meantime, let it continue to search for that blasted 10th squad.
translation: 这个人类无关紧要。如果它惹了太多麻烦，我直接把它……处理掉。在此期间，让它继续寻找那该死的10号分队吧。

english: I am still worried. What am I meant to tell the men?
translation: 我还是很担心。我要怎么跟手下说？

english: Stop worrying. I'm working on something - Glough left a few of his agents in the Gnome airforce.
translation: 别担心。我正在处理一件事——格劳夫在地精空军里留了几个他的特工。

english: For now, tell your men to continue work on the battleships. Give me some time.
translation: 现在，告诉你的手下继续建造战舰。给我点时间。

english: I hope you're right, Caranock, for your sake. My sake. For all of our sakes...
translation: 但愿你是对的，卡拉诺克。为了你，为了我，为了我们所有人……

english: Look - a newcomer. I'd say let me be the first to welcome you to Ape Atoll, but I see you've already met the welcoming party...
translation: 看——来了个新面孔。我想说让我第一个欢迎你来到猿猴环礁，不过看来你已经领教过欢迎仪式了……

english: Hello - Who are you?
translation: 你好——你是谁？

english: I am in the service of King Narnode Shareen. I have been sent here to locate the missing 10th squad of the Royal Guard.
translation: 我为纳罗德.沙林国王效力。我被派到这里寻找失踪的皇家卫队第十小队。

english: Well we're certainly missing home, I'll give you that.
translation: 好吧，我们确实挺想家的，这点我得承认。

english: Oh, not for too long ... The jail guards keep us entertained every now and then too.
translation: 哦，不会太久……监狱守卫偶尔也会给我们找点乐子。

english: Isn't that right Bunkdo?
translation: 对吧，邦克多？

english: That's right Lumo. Remember the time when they got all confused when changing shifts?
translation: 没错，卢莫。还记得他们换班时搞得一团糟的那次吗？

english: Oh yeah. Trefaji and Aberab - they're as dense as bricks. They do give mighty punches though.
translation: 哦，是啊。特雷法吉和阿贝拉布——他们像砖头一样迟钝。不过他们出拳确实很猛。

english: Indeed. My backside is still a little sore...
translation: 确实。我的屁股现在还有点疼……

english: Your backside??
translation: 你的屁股？？

english: I turned around at the wrong time...
translation: 我当时转身的时机不对……

english: Serves you bloody right too.
translation: 那也是你活该。

english: Now, now lads, watch your language. You'll have to excuse them, human, they're only soldiers!
translation: 好了好了，小伙子们，注意言辞。人类，你得原谅他们，他们只是些士兵而已！

english: Excuse me -
translation: 抱歉——

english: Oh that's quite alright...
translation: 哦，没关系……

english: So human, what can we do for you?
translation: 那么人类，我们能为你做点什么？

english: Well I suppose I ought to help you escape.
translation: 我想我应该帮你们逃出去。

english: No, it's alright, laddie, we quite like it in here.
translation: 不，没关系，老弟，我们挺喜欢呆在这里的。

english: Do your best to ignore him...
translation: 尽量无视他……

english: To be fair human, you're not much help stuck in there.
translation: 说实话，人类，你被困在里面也帮不上什么忙。

english: Well how do I get out?
translation: 那我怎么出去？

english: Well, you can try picking the lock on your door. Watch out for the guards though.
translation: 嗯，你可以试着撬开你门上的锁。不过要小心守卫。

english: We've been trying to pick ours but we haven't been able to do so yet.
translation: 我们一直在试着撬我们的锁，但还没成功。

english: No, it's alright, we quite like it in here.
translation: 不，没关系，我们挺喜欢呆在这里的。

english: What are you looking at then? Never seen a Gnome in a Monkey jail before?
translation: 那你盯着看什么？没见过地精在猴子监狱里吗？

english: Not before I came here, no...
translation: 来这之前还真没见过……

english: Well I'm not complaining - this jail cell is larger than my room in the Grand Tree! It is a little sparse however...
translation: 好吧，我可不是抱怨——这个牢房比我在大树家园的房间还大！就是有点空荡荡的……

english: We'll get you out of there soon enough.
translation: 我们很快就会把你弄出去的。

english: No hurries...
translation: 不急……

english: And another one ... eats the dirt.
translation: 然后另一个……吃了土。

english: The phrase is 'bites the dust' Lumo...
translation: 那叫'倒毙'，卢莫……

english: You know, we could try and break out ourselves.
translation: 你知道吗，我们可以自己试着越狱。

english: No... don't be silly. We're here to be rescued, after all.
translation: 不……别傻了。毕竟我们是来等着被救的。

english: Carado - are you thinking what I'm thinking?
translation: 卡拉多——你是不是跟我想的一样？

english: Only if it involves 3 tonnes of ice-cream, a helium balloon and an inflatable pink gorilla...
translation: 除非那跟三吨冰淇淋、一个氦气球和一只充气粉色大猩猩有关……

english: ... a 'no' would have sufficed.
translation: ……说个'不是'就行了。

english: Ouch. That must have hurt.
translation: 哎哟。那一定很疼。

english: ... and that completes our tour of the Jail of the Future. Please remember to use your conveniently located and totally pickable cell-door to exit.
translation: ……这就结束了我们未来监狱的参观。请记得使用你方便的、完全可撬开的牢房门离开。

english: and B - I - N - G - O. I win!
translation: 然后 B - I - N - G - O。我赢了！

english: Bunkdo?
translation: 邦克多？

english: Do you ever look up at the stars at night and think about just how insignificant all of this is?
translation: 你有没有在夜里仰望星空，思考这一切是多么微不足道？

english: Stars? You can look UP??
translation: 星星？你能往上看？？

english: And I thought 'night' was just a rumour...
translation: 我还以为'夜晚'只是个谣传……

english: Don't you ever get tired of, you know, wandering around?
translation: 你难道从来不会厌倦，嗯，到处闲逛吗？

english: No. I for one happen to like standing bolt upright all of the time.
translation: 不会。我个人就喜欢一直笔直地站着。

english: Aww, I lose. Let's play something else.
translation: 啊，我输了。我们玩点别的吧。

english: Wow. Somebody with a Dragon Square Shield. I win this game too!
translation: 哇。有人带着龙形方盾。这局我也赢了！

english: Bah. I hate bingo.
translation: 呸。我讨厌宾果。

english: Those cheerleaders down the Gnomeball pitch...
translation: 地精球场那边的啦啦队员……

english: Yeah I know the ones you mean...
translation: 是啊，我知道你说的那些……

english: Mmmmm hmmmm.
translation: 嗯嗯嗯。

english: They're a bit short, ain't they?
translation: 她们有点矮，是吧？

english: Carado, they're gnomes!
translation: 卡拉多，她们是地精！

english: Darn you, Carado - you always get the large jail cells.
translation: 该死的，卡拉多——你总能分到大牢房。

english: That is so not true. What about the time in Draynor?
translation: 那才不对。上次在德雷诺那次怎么说？

english: The Prince Ali thing? We all shared a cell that time.
translation: 阿里王子那件事？那次我们都挤在一个牢房里。

english: And that time in Varrock?
translation: 还有在维洛克城那次？

english: Yeah yeah, OK.
translation: 行行行，好吧。

english: Hey guys, look who's here.
translation: 嘿，伙计们，看谁来了。

english: ... and please remain prone until the room has come to a complete stop.
translation: ……请在房间完全停稳之前保持俯卧姿势。

english: Hey look, they've come round!
translation: 嘿快看，他们醒了！

english: Have you noticed how they all look the same?
translation: 你有没有注意到它们长得都一样？

english: And they all seem to have the same clothes...
translation: 而且它们穿的衣服好像也一样……

english: Spooky.
translation: 瘆人。

english: You know - I've noticed something.
translation: 你知道吗——我注意到一件事。

english: No matter how many monkeys these people seem to kill, there are never any fewer of them...
translation: 不管这些人杀了多少只猴子，数量好像一点都没少……

english: That's just the Way of the World, Lumo.
translation: 这就是世道，卢莫。

english: We are indefatigable Gnomes...
translation: 我们是永不疲倦的地精...

english: And we really likes our homes...
translation: 而且我们真的很喜欢我们的家...

english: If you pick with us a fight...
translation: 如果你要和我们打架...

english: You may well just might...
translation: 你很可能就会...

english: Find yourself without no bones!
translation: 发现自己连骨头都不剩！

english: ... and then the chicken said to the farmer: 'It was an aspirin!'
translation: ...然后鸡对农夫说：'那是阿司匹林！'

english: That has to be the worst joke I've ever heard...
translation: 这一定是我听过最烂的笑话了...

english: Have we seen this one before?
translation: 我们以前见过这个吗？

english: I'm not sure - I'm beginning to lose track.
translation: 我不确定——我开始搞不清了。

english: You know, you should really try to avoid being captured.
translation: 你知道，你真的应该尽量避免被抓住。

english: I think [he/she] knows that Lumo...
translation: 我想[he/she]知道这一点，卢莫...

english: ... and that's how I saved Narnode from the fire-breathing gnome-eating lizard-dragon-king of Jool.
translation: ……我就是这样从朱尔那只喷火吃地精的蜥蜴龙之王手中救出纳罗德的。

english: You know - everytime I hear that story it seems less and less convincing...
translation: 你知道吗——每次我听到这个故事，都觉得越来越不可信了...

english: Look at that Bunkdo, [he/she/they] almost looks like they're praying.
translation: 看看那个邦克多，[he/she/they]看起来像是在祈祷。

english: [player name], [player name], he's our man! If he can't do it, nobody can!
translation: [player name]，[player name]，他是我们的人！如果他做不到，没人能做到！

english: I don't think that's helping, Lumo.
translation: 我觉得那没什么帮助，卢莫。

english: Er Lumo, it's a she.
translation: 呃，卢莫，是女的。

english: Oh my god - [he's/she's/they've] been through here ten times now.
translation: 哦天哪——[he's/she's/they've]已经从这里经过十次了。

english: And which god would that be, eh?
translation: 那是哪个神啊，嗯？

english: You know what I mean...
translation: 你知道我的意思...

english: Fifteen times ... wait: is it fifteen?
translation: 十五次……等等：是十五次吗？

english: Yup, it sure is.
translation: 没错，确实是。

english: I'm beginning to lose count now.
translation: 我现在开始数不清了。

english: Twenty times! Give this kid an applause!
translation: 二十次！给这孩子鼓掌！

english: Lumo, you're beginning to irritate me. Imagine what it's like for them.
translation: 卢莫，你开始惹恼我了。想象一下他们是什么感受。

english: Fifty times a loser! I don't believe it!
translation: 失败五十次！我真不敢相信！

english: Wahey - party hats all round!
translation: 哇嘿——大家都有派对帽！

english: I was only kidding...
translation: 我只是开玩笑...

english: One hundred times... It's just not real anymore.
translation: 一百次……这已经不再真实了。

english: I think we should give [him/her] a prize.
translation: 我觉得我们应该给[him/her]一个奖品。

english: You're right. I know just the thing.
translation: 你说得对。我知道该给什么。

english: No... not the..
translation: 不……不是那个……

english: Monkey corpse stuffed with seaweed!?
translation: 塞满海藻的猴尸！？

english: Hello? Is anybody there?
translation: 喂？有人吗？

english: That depends on who is asking...
translation: 那要看是谁在问……

english: I see. As you can see, this is a dangerous place to be.
translation: 我明白了。如你所见，这里是个危险的地方。

english: It certainly is ... who are you?
translation: 确实如此……你是谁？

english: Karam, 10th squad, Royal Guard. High Assassin at your service.
translation: 卡拉姆，第十小队，皇家卫队。高级刺客为您效劳。

english: I am thinking of a way to free my friends. In the meantime, I am helping those who further my cause.
translation: 我正在想办法解救我的朋友。同时，我在帮助那些推进我事业的人。

english: How do you remain unseen?
translation: 你是怎么保持隐身的？

english: I have been gifted by Zooknock, our squad mage. I have saved his life on a number of occasions.
translation: 我得到了我们小队法师祖克诺克的赐福。我曾多次救过他的命。

english: Is there any way I could be like that?
translation: 有没有办法让我也能这样？

english: Your best chance is to hide in this grass, human.
translation: 你最好的机会就是躲在这片草里，人类。

english: How can you be everywhere?
translation: 你怎么能无处不在？

english: I move quickly.
translation: 我行动迅速。

english: A fine day you have chosen to visit this hellish island, human.
translation: 你选了个好日子来参观这个地狱般的岛屿，人类。

english: Good day to you too Sergeant. I've been sent by your King Narnode to -
translation: 中士，你也好。我是被你们的国王纳罗德.沙林派来——

english: Investigate the circumstances surrounding the mysterious disappearance of my squad. Yes, I know.
translation: 调查我小队神秘失踪的情况。是的，我知道。

english: How did you know that?
translation: 你怎么知道的？

english: The King and I are still in communication, albeit sporadic. I decided I need a human of your calibre to assist me. It is pleasing to see you are still alive.
translation: 国王和我仍有联系，尽管断断续续。我决定需要像你这样能力的人类来协助我。很高兴看到你还活着。

english: Why do you need a human?
translation: 你为什么需要人类？

english: There is more going on than meets your eye, human. Did you not find it strange that an entire squad be sent to decommission a shipyard?
translation: 人类，事情远比你看到的要复杂。你不觉得派整个小队去拆除一个造船厂很奇怪吗？

english: Well -
Indeed. But there are more pressing matters at hand. Three of my squad have been captured and placed in the jail. They are watched over by somewhat overpowering guards.
translation: 确实。但眼下有更紧迫的事。我的三名队员被俘，关在监狱里。他们由一些实力过强的守卫看守。

english: Before we can resume our original mission we must rescue them.
translation: 在我们恢复原任务之前，必须先救出他们。

english: I know about the guards - I had to sneak out between the change of shifts.
translation: 我知道那些守卫——我不得不在换班间隙溜出来。

english: Trust me; we too have considered this, but whilst it is possible for one, it is near impossible for three.
translation: 相信我；我们也考虑过这一点，但一个人可能做到，三个人几乎不可能。

english: We have considered many things. I have my squad mage and sappers working below us right now. My, assassin Karam, is operating in the village itself.
translation: 我们考虑了很多事情。我的小队法师和工兵现在正在我们下方工作。我的刺客卡拉姆正在村子里行动。

english: I remain here so that I may overhear Awowogei's plans.
translation: 我留在这里以便能偷听到阿沃盖的计划。

english: Awowogei?
translation: 阿沃盖？

english: The self-proclaimed ruler of the island. I have been listening to him for some time now. I believe we will incur a minimum of casualties if we have an insider - a monkey working for us.
translation: 这个岛的自封统治者。我已经偷听他一段时间了。我相信如果我们有一个内应——一只为我们工作的猴子——我们就能将伤亡降到最低。

english: Have you seen these monkeys? You could never convince them to work for you!
translation: 你见过这些猴子吗？你永远不可能说服它们为你工作！

english: I wasn't suggesting convincing them, human, but you.
translation: 我不是建议说服它们，人类，而是说服你。

english: Don't be ridiculous! I'm a human - not a monkey!
translation: 别开玩笑了！我是人类——不是猴子！

english: Do not be so sceptical ... you humans are considered to be quite closely related to monkeys.
translation: 别这么怀疑……你们人类被认为和猴子关系很近。

english: Yes, but -
translation: 是的，但是——

english: Go and see my squad mage, Zooknock. Tell him I have asked you to be 'disguised' as a monkey so that you may infiltrate the village. As you will see, he is something of an expert on the subject.
translation: 去找我的小队法师祖克诺克。告诉他我要求你被'伪装'成猴子，这样你就能潜入村子。你会看到，他在这方面算是个专家。

english: I can't even communicate with the monkeys!
translation: 我甚至无法和猴子交流！

english: Just go and find my squad mage, human.
translation: 去找我的小队法师吧，人类。

english: Have you spoken to Zooknock about the monkey disguise yet?
translation: 你和祖克诺克谈过猴子伪装的事了吗？

english: You must hurry. He is working somewhere beneath the Ape Atoll.
translation: 你必须快点。他正在猿猴岛地下的某个地方工作。

english: Can't talk now.
translation: 现在没空说话。

english: I'm too busy to talk, sorry.
translation: 我太忙了，没空说话，抱歉。

english: A human... here? What business have you on Ape Atoll?
translation: 一个人类……在这里？你来猿猴岛有何贵干？

english: I am on a mission for King Narnode Shareen of the Gnomes.
translation: 我受地精的纳罗德.沙林国王之命执行任务。

english: I have been sent to investigate the whereabouts of the 10th squad of his Royal Guard, which went missing during a recent mission to Karamja.
translation: 我被派来调查他的皇家卫队第十小队的下落，他们在最近一次前往卡拉姆詹岛的任务中失踪了。

english: Well you've found us - what's left of us, that is.
translation: 好吧，你找到我们了——也就是我们剩下的这些人。

english: I am Zooknock, the 10th squad mage. These are Bunkwicket and Waymottin, two of our finest sappers. I assume you will want to know how we got here?
translation: 我是祖克诺克，第十小队法师。这两位是邦克威克特和韦莫廷，我们最优秀的工兵。我猜你想知道我们是怎么到这里的？

english: Your story first, human. What possessed you to travel to this forsaken island?
translation: 人类，先说说你的故事。是什么驱使你来到这个被遗弃的岛屿？

english: I am currently in the service of your King. I was the human who exposed Glough's warfaring plans and defeated his demon.
translation: 我目前为你们的国王服务。我就是那个揭露格洛夫的战争计划并击败他的恶魔的人类。

english: As far as I understand, the 10th squad were sent to oversee the decommission of Glough's shipyard in east Karamja.
translation: 据我所知，第十小队被派去监督格洛夫在东卡拉姆詹岛的造船厂拆除工作。

english: Rumour has it you were blown off course. The King worried as to your fate, and sent me to investigate.
translation: 有传言说你们被吹离了航线。国王担心你们的命运，派我来调查。

english: You were sent alone?
translation: 你被单独派来？

english: No, I have been accompanied by Flight Commander Waydar. We flew south on a special type of glider and landed on a small island to our east.
translation: 不，飞行指挥官韦达陪同我。我们乘坐一种特殊的地精滑翔机向南飞行，降落在我们东边的一个小岛上。

english: The so called Crash Island. We left there one of our number, Lumdo, to guard our gliders until our return.
translation: 所谓的坠机岛。我们把一名同伴卢姆多留在那里看守我们的滑翔机直到我们返回。

english: Yes, we have met. He ferried me across to the atoll.
translation: 是的，我们见过。他把我渡到了环礁。

english: He did!? He was explicitly ordered to guard the gliders! How did this happen? Who is guarding the gliders now?
translation: 他这么做了？！他被明确命令看守滑翔机！怎么会这样？现在谁在看守滑翔机？

english: Waydar ordered him to leave his post. He is guarding the gliders himself.
translation: 韦达命令他离开岗位。他自己在看守滑翔机。

english: Flight Commander Waydar you said? For some reason that name is familiar...
translation: 你说飞行指挥官韦达？不知为何这个名字很耳熟……

english: The rumours are correct. We were indeed blown off course. Fortunately, we managed to find a small island to steer our gliders towards, else we surely would have drowned.
translation: 传言没错。我们确实被吹离了航线。幸运的是，我们设法找到了一个小岛，把滑翔机驶向那里，否则我们肯定淹死了。

english: Then you gathered enough wood to fashion two boats. Your Sergeant and the rest of the 10th squad took the larger boat to this island, leaving Lumdo to guard the gliders and the other boat...
translation: 然后你们收集了足够的木材造了两艘船。你的中士和第十小队的其余人乘大船去了这个岛，留下卢姆多看管滑翔机和另一艘船……

english: Correct. I assume Lumdo told you this?
translation: 正确。我猜是卢姆多告诉你的？

english: Yes. What happened when you landed here?
translation: 是的。你们在这里登陆后发生了什么？

english: We split up into several small groups to search the island for potential gnome glider launch sites. Whilst we knew the island to be inhabited, we did not expect its occupants to be quite so ... militant.
translation: 我们分成几个小组搜索岛屿，寻找潜在的地精滑翔机发射点。虽然我们知道岛上有人居住，但我们没想到居民会如此……好战。

english: Monkeys. Lots of monkeys. They are unlike any other type of monkey we've come across. A far cry from the usual wild variety, these were armed with high quality weaponry and uncanny tactical ability.
translation: 猴子。很多猴子。它们和我们见过的任何其他猴子都不同。与通常的野生品种截然不同，它们装备着高质量的武器，拥有不可思议的战术能力。

english: We were overwhelmed in numbers. Some of us managed to escape, but the rest were taken captive.
translation: 我们在数量上被压倒。我们中的一些人设法逃脱，但其余人被俘。

english: Who survived?
translation: 谁幸存了？

english: Myself, the Sergeant, Bunkwicket and Waymottin here. Karam, our assassin, probably managed to escape - he usually does.
translation: 我自己，中士，邦克威克特和韦莫廷在这里。我们的刺客卡拉姆可能设法逃脱了——他通常都能逃脱。

english: And of the rest?
translation: 其余的人呢？

english: Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado were captured, as I said. We believe they are being held in the jail. We are working on a way to release them. I have sensed there lies a cavern to the north.
translation: 卢莫、邦克多和卡拉多被抓了，正如我说的。我们相信他们被关在监狱里。我们正在想办法释放他们。我感觉到北边有一个洞穴。

english: We are attempting to tunnel to this northern cavern and then move upwards from there.
translation: 我们正试图挖一条隧道通往这个北边的洞穴，然后再从那里往上走。

english: Why don't you just go overground?
translation: 为什么不直接走地面？

english: We have considered this, but every entrance seems to be excessively guarded.
translation: 我们考虑过，但每个入口似乎都有重兵把守。

english: I have spoken to your Sergeant. He believes that the best way to rescue the rest of your squad with the minimum of casualties is to have an insider - a monkey working for us.
translation: 我和你的中士谈过了。他认为，要救出你小队的其他人并将伤亡降到最低，最好的方法就是有个内应——一只为我们工作的猴子。

english: Aha. He wants me to turn you into a monkey.
translation: 啊哈。他是想让我把你变成一只猴子。

english: Actually, it was more along the lines of a disguise...
translation: 其实，比较像是伪装……

english: I think you misunderstand, human. Do you know why you were sent here?
translation: 我想你误会了，人类。你知道你为什么被派来这里吗？

english: King Narnode Shareen asked me to...
translation: 纳罗德.沙林国王让我……

english: Indeed. However, King Narnode Shareen is still in contact with Garkor! You were sent here because Garkor specifically asked Narnode for you!
translation: 确实。不过，纳罗德.沙林国王仍然与加科尔保持联系！你被派到这里是因为加科尔专门向纳罗德要了你！

english: Why wasn't I told?
translation: 为什么没人告诉我？

english: Before you arrived on this island, that information would have endangered both yourself and the mission.
translation: 在你到达这个岛之前，那个情报会危及你自身和任务。

english: But why a human? Why me?
translation: 但为什么是人类？为什么是我？

english: Garkor had long decided that we need a monkey insider. I have the necessary magic to perform the shapeshifting spell, but we needed a human to transform.
translation: 加科尔早就决定我们需要一个猴子内应。我掌握施展变形法术所需的魔法，但我们需要一个人类来变形。

english: Why don't you just transform a gnome?
translation: 为什么不直接转化一个地精？

english: It has been tried in the past, but the results were far from ... satisfactory. Although we, like you, are related to the monkeys, the link is too weak for a successful transformation. That is why we need you.
translation: 以前试过，但结果远非……令人满意。虽然我们和你们一样，与猴子有亲缘关系，但这个联系太弱，无法成功转化。这就是为什么我们需要你。

english: Right. What do I have to do?
translation: 好吧。我需要做什么？

english: There will be two aspects to your transformation. We must first arrange it so that you are able to understand and communicate with the monkeys.
translation: 你的转化有两个方面。我们必须先安排，让你能够理解并与猴子沟通。

english: We must also transform your body so that you may pass amongst them unnoticed.
translation: 我们还必须转化你的身体，让你能在他们中间不被察觉地行动。

english: So that the effects of my spells are not permanent, I will invest their power into magical items which you must find. You can then use them at your will.
translation: 为了不让我的法术效果变成永久，我会将它们的力量注入你必须找到的魔法物品中。然后你就可以随心所欲地使用它们。

english: What kind of items?
translation: 什么样的物品？

english: For the spells to take full effect, they will have to be in some way related to the monkeys.
translation: 为了让法术发挥最大效果，它们必须在某种程度上与猴子相关。

english: I suggest that I invest the ability to communicate with the monkeys in an authentic monkey amulet.
translation: 我建议将与猴子沟通的能力注入一个正宗的猴子护身符中。

english: Similarly, the transformation spell should be stored in a monkey talisman of some kind.
translation: 同样，变形法术应该储存在某种猴子护符里。

english: What do we need for the monkey amulet?
translation: 制作猴子护身符需要什么？

english: We need a gold bar, a monkey amulet mould and something to do monkey speech.
translation: 我们需要一个金锭、一个猴子护符模具和某种与猴子说话有关的东西。

english: Where do I find a gold bar?
translation: 我在哪里能找到金锭？

english: I am not sure. You look wealthy enough to know the answer to that question anyway.
translation: 我不太确定。你看起来够有钱，应该知道这个问题的答案才对。

english: Where do I find a monkey amulet mould?
translation: 我在哪里能找到猴子护符模具？

english: They ought to be for sale in the village, but be careful: you probably will not be able to walk straight in and buy one.
translation: 村子里应该有卖，但要小心：你大概没办法直接走进去买一个。

english: Where do I find something to do with monkey speech?
translation: 我去哪里找与猴子语言相关的东西？

english: I don't know. I'm sure you'll think of something.
translation: 我不知道。我相信你会想出办法的。

english: What do we need for the monkey talisman?
translation: 我们做猴子护符需要什么？

english: We need some kind of monkey remains as well as an authentic magical monkey talisman.
translation: 我们需要某种猴子遗骸以及一个真正的魔法猴子护符。

english: Where do I find monkey remains?
translation: 我在哪里能找到猴子遗骸？

english: I'll leave that to your better judgement... However, bear in mind the type of remain might affect the type of monkey you become...
translation: 这就留给你自行判断了……不过，请记住，遗骸的类型可能会影响你变成哪种猴子……

english: What if I need to be another type of monkey?
translation: 如果我需要变成另一种猴子呢？

english: Then bring me different monkey remains and another talisman.
translation: 那就给我带不同的猴子遗骸和另一个护符来。

english: Where do I find a magical monkey talisman?
translation: 我在哪里能找到魔法猴子护符？

english: There ought to be something in the village. I cannot be sure, as I have not spent much time there.
translation: 村子里应该有。我不能确定，因为我在那里待的时间不多。

english: How goes the tunneling work?
translation: 挖掘隧道的工作进行得如何？

english: Slow, as ever. Can't you tell?
translation: 一如既往地慢。你看不出来吗？

english: I have been sent by your Sergeant. He believes that the best way to rescue the rest of your squad with the minimum of casualties is to have an insider - a monkey working for us.
translation: 我是你的中士派来的。他认为，要救出你小队的其他人并将伤亡降到最低，最好的方法就是有个内应——一只为我们工作的猴子。

english: Finally. He wants me to turn you into a monkey.
translation: 终于啊。他是想让我把你变成一只猴子。

english: Well done, human.
translation: 做得好，人类。

english: We still need the gold bar and something to do with monkey speech.
translation: 我们还缺金锭和某种与猴子说话有关的东西。

english: We still need the gold bar.
translation: 我们还缺金锭。

english: Now listen closely, human. I will cast a spell to enchant this gold bar with the power contained in these monkey dentures.
translation: 现在仔细听好了，人类。我将施法赋予这个金锭以这些猴子假牙中蕴含的力量。

english: You must then smith the gold using the monkey amulet mould. However, unless you do this in a place of religious significance to the monkeys, the spirits contained within will likely depart.
translation: 然后你必须用猴子护符模具锻造金锭。不过，除非你在对猴子具有宗教意义的地方进行，否则其中蕴含的灵魂很可能会离开。
