english: Where do I find a place of religious significance to monkeys?
translation: 我去哪里找对猴子有宗教意义的地方？

english: Somewhere in the village. It ought to be obvious. Now give me a moment.
translation: 村子里的某个地方。应该很明显。现在，等我一下。

english: Hello there little monkey.
translation: 你好啊，小猴子。

english: Ook. Ook. Ook Ah Uh! Ook Ah Uh!
translation: 呜呜。呜呜。呜啊呃！呜啊呃！

english: Hello big-big. Aunty told me not to talk to strangers.
translation: 你好，大个子。阿姨叫我不要跟陌生人说话。

english: Oh I'm not a stranger...
translation: 哦，我不是陌生人……

english: You look strange to me!
translation: 你在我看来就很奇怪！

english: Hello again little monkey.
translation: 又见面了，小猴子。

english: You're strange! Go away!
translation: 你好奇怪！走开！

english: I'm not a stranger...!
translation: 我不是陌生人……！

english: Then what are you?
translation: 那你又是什么？

english: I'm a monkey's brother!
translation: 我是猴子的兄弟！

english: Ook! But I don't have any brothers!
translation: 呜！可是我没有兄弟！

english: I knew your sister's mother!
translation: 我认识你姐姐的母亲！

english: But I don't have any sisters! Ook Ook!
translation: 可是我没有姐妹！呜呜！

english: I'm just a monkey lover!
translation: 我只是个猴子爱好者！

english: Aunty told me not to talk to monkey lovers! Ook!
translation: 阿姨叫我不要跟猴子爱好者说话！呜！

english: Well I'll be a monkey's uncle!
translation: 好吧，那我就是猴子的叔叔！

english: Uh ah! You do look like my uncle!
translation: 呃啊！你确实长得像我的叔叔！

english: You never said what you were!
translation: 你一直没说你是谁！

english: You look a lot bigger than last time, Uncle!
translation: 叔叔，你看起来比上次大多了！

english: I've been ... eating more bananas... just like you should be!
translation: 我一直在……吃更多香蕉……就像你应该做的那样！

english: Why are you bored?
translation: 你为什么觉得无聊？

english: Aunty told me to pick loads of bananas. She said if, I got bananas, she'd give me a new toy!
translation: 阿姨叫我摘很多香蕉。她说，如果我拿到香蕉，她就会给我一个新玩具！

english: What kind of toy did Aunty say she'd give you?
translation: 阿姨说她会给你什么样的玩具？

english: She said it would be something from the magic shop!
translation: 她说会是魔法商店里的东西！

english: How many bananas did Aunty want?
translation: 阿姨要多少根香蕉？

english: Twenty! But I can't count! It's very mean of her, isn't it Uncle?
translation: 二十根！可是我不会数数！她这样很坏，对不对，叔叔？

english: Yes, very mean ... do you want me to get the bananas for you?
translation: 对，很坏……你要我帮你拿香蕉吗？

english: Ok! Ook Ook!
translation: 好！呜呜！

english: But only if you promise to let me borrow your toy...
translation: 但你得答应借我玩你的玩具……

english: Ok Uncle!
translation: 好的，叔叔！

english: Did you get any bananas, Uncle?
translation: 叔叔，你拿到香蕉了吗？

english: No, not yet. I'm still trying to get them.
translation: 还没，还没拿到。我还在想办法。

english: Yes, I have some here.
translation: 有，我这里有一些。

english: That doesn't look like 20 bananas Uncle! Aunty will be so angry with me!
translation: 叔叔，那看起来不像二十根香蕉！阿姨会很生我的气的！

english: Don't worry, I'll get some more.
translation: 别担心，我会再拿一些。

english: Wow that's a lot of bananas! Are there twenty?
translation: 哇，好多香蕉！有二十根吗？

english: Yes, of course there are.
translation: 有，当然有。

english: Aunty will be so happy!
translation: 阿姨一定会很开心的！

english: Has Aunty given you the toy yet?
translation: 阿姨把玩具给你了吗？

english: No, not yet... she said she's too busy dealing with something called humans.
translation: 还没，还没呢……她说她太忙了，在处理什么叫人类的东西。

english: Yeah - it's really neat!
translation: 对啊——真的很棒！

english: Can I borrow it now then?
translation: 那现在可以借我玩一下吗？

english: Ok then...
translation: 好吧……

english: We still need some kind of monkey remains.
translation: 我们还缺某种猴子遗骸。

english: We still need an authentic magical monkey talisman.
translation: 我们还缺一个真正的魔法猴子护符。

english: Bear with me human: I must now cast an extremely powerful spell. It is not often we are successful in investing shapeshifting powers within objects.
translation: 稍等一下，人类：我现在必须施展一个极其强大的法术。我们很少能成功将变形能力注入物品中。

english: I am afraid I have not been able to fully invest my powers in that talisman. You may use it, but it will continue to draw its energy directly from me.
translation: 恐怕我没能将我的力量完全注入那个护符。你可以使用它，但它会继续直接从我这里汲取能量。

english: The range at which I will be able to sustain it is limited. I cannot ensure it will be effective off the atoll.
translation: 我能维持它的范围有限。我无法保证它在环礁外有效。

english: Furthermore, you will not be able to attack whilst using this, so be careful. Perhaps when I refine my spells I could look into making this possible.
translation: 此外，你使用这个法术时无法攻击，所以要小心。也许等我改进我的法术后，我可以研究如何让它也支持攻击。

english: It is good of you to meet me, Waydar.
translation: 韦达，很高兴你能来见我。

english: It is good to see you again, Caranock. It is a strange island these monkeys inhabit.
translation: 卡兰诺克，很高兴再次见到你。这些猴子居住的岛屿真奇怪。

english: Well observed. How have you been keeping yourself occupied?
translation: 观察得很仔细。你最近都在忙些什么？

english: I am now a Flight Commander. My duties include testing Glough's prototype military glider.
translation: 我现在是飞行指挥官了。我的职责包括测试格劳夫的军用滑翔机原型。

english: My my. How things have changed somewhat since Glough's time... Now, what of the human?
translation: 哎呀呀。自从格劳夫的时代以来，事情变化了不少啊……那么，那个人类呢？

english: The human? Just somebody Narnode appears to have taken a fancy to. It is hard to tell why. I suspect the human was involved with Glough's fall from grace.
translation: 那个人类？只是纳罗德似乎看上了的一个家伙。很难说为什么。我怀疑那个人类与格劳夫的失宠有关。

english: You may be right. Never mind - there are greater matters afoot. With Glough gone, it falls to us to continue with his plans.
translation: 你也许说得对。不过，还有更重要的事情要进行。格劳夫不在了，我们得接过他的计划继续干。

english: Also, the shipyard workers are becoming restless.
translation: 而且，造船厂的工人们也开始不安分了。

english: I see. What do you have in mind?
translation: 我明白了。你有什么打算？

english: Money for me, Waydar, and promotion for you. As you know, the 10th squad of the Royal Guard are slightly worse for wear on this island.
translation: 韦达，对我来说是钱，对你来说是升职。你也知道，皇家卫队的第十小队在这个岛上有点吃不消了。

english: This I know. But I don't see how it leads to money or promotion.
translation: 这我知道。但我看不出这怎么就能带来钱和升职。

english: What if they were to die? An entire squad of the Royal Guard goes missing in the jungle of Karamja ... We could blame it on the humans.
translation: 要是他们都死了呢？一整队皇家卫队在卡拉姆詹岛的丛林里失踪了……我们可以把这事怪到人类头上。

english: Narnode would be furious!
translation: 纳诺德会暴怒的！

english: Precisely. He might even order an invasion. At the very least he'll step up the defence. More orders for me, promotion for you.
translation: 正是。他甚至可能会下令入侵。至少他会加强防御。这样我就能接到更多订单，而你就能升职了。

english: Very clever. It might also serve us well to remind Narnode of Bolren's situation.
translation: 真聪明。另外，让纳诺德记住博尔伦的处境对我们也有好处。

english: Ah yes - all that trouble with the Khazard. Last I heard, Bolren had retrieved the orbs of protection. Apparently some human lent their assistance.
translation: 啊，对——那些跟卡扎德族的麻烦事。我上次听说，博尔伦已经找回了防护宝珠。好像是有个人类帮了忙。

english: Really? Typical meddling human behaviour. Nevertheless, it will stoke fires of worry. After all, the battle still continues.
translation: 真的吗？典型的人类多管闲事。不过，这也能引起一些担忧的火苗。毕竟，战斗还没结束。

english: I agree. Anyhow, we don't want your human wondering as to your whereabouts. When the time is right, don't hesitate to ... dispose of it.
translation: 我同意。总之，我们不想让你的那个人类起疑心。时机到了，就毫不犹豫地……把它处理掉。

english: Understood. Military gliders are after all an untested form of transport...
translation: 明白。军用滑翔机毕竟还是一种未经验证的交通工具……

english: I've lost the monkey amulet...
translation: 我弄丢了猴子护符……

english: Careless human. No matter - bring me the same materials again and I will prepare for you another one.
translation: 粗心的人类。没事——再拿同样的材料来，我帮你做一个新的。

english: Can you make another monkey talisman?
translation: 你能再做另一个猴子护符吗？

english: Very well. Bring me the required materials again and I will prepare for you another one.
translation: 好吧。再拿来所需的材料，我会为你准备另一个。

english: Actually, I'm not that sure.
translation: 其实，我也不是很确定。

english: Oh nothing ... I'm just passing by.
translation: 哦，没什么……我只是路过。

english: Yes - I've now made an amulet of monkey speak and a monkey greegree.
translation: 是的——我已经做了一个猴语护符和一个猴子变身的雕像。

english: Very good. In a moment, speak to me through your monkey disguise so that I may judge how good it is.
translation: 很好。待会，你以猴子的伪装跟我说话，让我来评判一下它有多逼真。

english: My my, Zooknock has outdone himself this time. You do look very much like a monkey you know.
translation: 哎呀呀，祖克诺克这次真是超水平发挥。你知道吗，你看起来真的很像一只猴子。

english: However, you look like the wrong sort of monkey. My plan requires that you look like one of the monkeys of mainland Karamja.
translation: 不过，你看起来像是错误种类的猴子。我的计划需要你看起来像卡拉姆詹岛主岛上的猴子。

english: What exactly is your plan?
translation: 你的计划到底是什么？

english: When the time comes, you are to pretend you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and that you are seeking an alliance.
translation: 到时候，你要假装自己是卡拉姆詹岛猴子派来的使者，来寻求结盟。

english: How do you know this will work?
translation: 你怎么知道这样会奏效？

english: As I said, I've been listening to Awowogei for some time now. Come back when you look like one of the Karamjan monkeys.
translation: 我说了，我已经偷听阿沃盖讲话一段时间了。等你看起来像卡拉姆詹猴子再回来吧。

english: And by happy coincidence you appear to be just the right sort of monkey.
translation: 真巧，你现在看起来正好就是那种猴子。

english: I need you now to seek audience with Awowogei. Claim you are an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja and are seeking an alliance.
translation: 我现在需要你求见阿沃盖。声称你是来自卡拉姆詹岛的使者，寻求结盟。

english: You must win his trust if we are to succeed.
translation: 如果我们要成功，你必须赢得他的信任。

english: What brings you up here, monkey?
translation: 猴子，你上来干嘛？

english: Nothing ... I'm just exploring.
translation: 没什么……我只是在四处看看。

english: You would do better to explore elsewhere - we are extremely busy at the moment.
translation: 你最好去别处看看——我们现在非常忙。

english: I'd like to speak with Awowogei, please.
translation: 我想跟阿沃盖谈谈，拜托了。

english: Only the Captain of the Monkey Guard or those he authorises may enter this building. You will need his permission to enter.
translation: 只有猴子守卫的队长或他授权的人才能进入这座建筑。你需要得到他的许可才能进入。

english: Who is the Captain of the Monkey Guard?
translation: 谁是猴子守卫的队长？

english: He goes by the name of Kruk.
translation: 他名叫克鲁克。

english: I have come to seek audience with Awowogei. I am told I need your permission to do so.
translation: 我来求见阿沃盖。我听说需要你的许可才能见。

english: That's right - you do. What business have you on our island?
translation: 没错——你需要。你来我们岛上有什么事？

english: I am envoy from the monkeys of Karamja. I have come to propose an alliance.
translation: 我是来自卡拉姆詹岛的使者。我来提议结盟。

english: I don't believe you. You don't look much like any Karamja monkey I've seen.
translation: 我不相信你。你看起来一点也不像我见过的任何卡拉姆詹岛猴子。

english: Stop wasting my time.
translation: 别浪费我的时间。

english: I see. Very well, you look genuine enough. Follow me.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，你看上去确实够逼真的。跟我来。

english: Good day, visitor.
translation: 你好，访客。

english: Sorry, I am far too busy dealing with the invaders right now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在忙着对付入侵者，没空。

english: Greetings, Awowogei.
translation: 日安，阿沃盖。

english: Greetings, visitor. What brings you to my island?
translation: 你好，访客。是什么风把你吹到我的岛上来了？

english: I am an envoy from the monkeys of Karamja. We wish to propose an alliance.
translation: 我是来自卡拉姆詹岛的使者。我们希望提议结盟。

english: I see. Ours is a strong and mighty lineage of monkey, visitor. We clearly do not need your offer of an alliance.
translation: 我明白了。访客，我们猴子一族的血统强大而尊贵。我们显然不需要你提出结盟。

english: Awowogei, please consider my offer carefully.
translation: 阿沃盖，请慎重考虑我的提议。

english: We offer strength in numbers and our island would serve as a northern platform for defence. All that we ask for in return is peace.
translation: 我们以数量提供力量，我们的岛屿可以作为北部的防御平台。我们要求的回报只是和平。

english: I don't believe him, Awowogei. Never trust a northern monkey.
translation: 我不相信他，阿沃盖。永远不要相信北方的猴子。

english: What is your opinion, Murowoi?
translation: 你有什么看法，穆罗沃伊？

english: I think heseems trustworthy, sir.
translation: 我觉得他看起来值得信任，大人。

english: I must admit, I have always regarded your kind as our inferior cousins, visitor.
translation: 我得承认，访客，我一直把你们当作我们低等的表亲。

english: However, I am well aware that you may have a few things to offer.
translation: 不过，我很清楚你们或许有些东西可以贡献。

english: Don't listen to him, Awowogei!
translation: 别听他的，阿沃盖！

english: Be silent, Uwogo.
translation: 闭嘴，乌沃戈。

english: I have heard your kind are exceptionally resourceful. I wish to put this reputation to the test.
translation: 我听说你们一族特别足智多谋。我想检验一下这个名声是否属实。

english: You must be well aware your kind are hunted and trapped almost everywhere.
translation: 你很清楚，你们族群几乎在各地都被捕猎和捕捉。

english: In particular you may have heard of such activities in a city known to the humans as Ardougne.
translation: 特别是，你可能听说过人类称之为阿多尼城的那些活动。

english: There are several of your kind kept captive there. I challenge you to free one and return it to me.
translation: 那里有你们几个同族被关在笼子里。我要你去解救一个，然后带回来给我。

english: How am I meant to free one of them?
translation: 我该怎么救出一个来？

english: This is for you to decide, visitor.
translation: 这由你来决定，访客。

english: Very well. I will be back later, with one of the captives.
translation: 好吧。我晚点带一个俘虏回来。

english: Have you brought with you a captive?
translation: 你带俘虏回来了吗？

english: Then hurry, visitor. I am beginning to lose my faith in you.
translation: 那就快点，访客。我开始对你失去信心了。

english: Hello there, little monkey.
translation: 嗨，小猴子。

english: How would you like to get out of here?
translation: 你想不想离开这里？

english: Escape!? It's all I ever think about!
translation: 逃走！？我整天都在想这个！

english: That's convenient. When would you like to leave?
translation: 那正好。你想什么时候走？

english: Where will you be taking me?
translation: 你要带我去哪？

english: Erm ... to the happy, sunny jungle of Karamja...
translation: 呃……到快乐阳光的卡拉姆詹岛丛林去……

english: Wowee! I was born there you know!
translation: 哇哦！我就是在那里出生的，你知道吗！

english: That's nice. Are you ready to go?
translation: 那很好。你准备好了吗？

english: Yes. Actually, can I bring some of my friends?
translation: 可以。不过，我能带些朋友吗？

english: No, I only have space for one.
translation: 不行，我只能装一个。

english: Pleeeeease?
Pretty pleeeeease?
No!!
translation: 不行！！

english: Pretty please with a banana on top?
translation: 求求你了嘛，加根香蕉在上面？

english: Look, I already said no. If you want to come then jump into my backpack.
translation: 听着，我已经说了不行。你想来就跳进我的背包里。

english: You have shown yourself to be very resourceful. You have managed to complete an extremely long journey remarkably quickly.
translation: 你证明了自己非常足智多谋。你这么快就完成了一段极其漫长的旅程。

english: You are clearly well acquainted with the ways of this world. We will talk more on this later.
translation: 你显然很熟悉这个世界的套路。我们晚点再详谈。

english: In the meantime, feel free to remain as long as you like on my island.
translation: 在此期间，欢迎你随时在我的岛上停留。

english: What about the proposed alliance, Awowogei?
translation: 阿沃盖，那提议的结盟呢？

english: I must think upon it some more and discuss the matter with my advisers. We will contact you when we are ready.
translation: 我需要再考虑一下，和我的顾问们讨论这件事。我们准备好后会联系你。

english: We are still pondering your proposition...We will let you know when we have an answer...
translation: 我们还在考虑你的提议……有结果后会通知你的……

english: Well done on winning Awowogei's trust. I overheard everything from here.
translation: 干得好，赢得了阿沃盖的信任。我在这里全都听到了。

english: However, your efforts may be in vain...
translation: 不过，你的努力可能白费了……

english: Progress in the caves has been slow. Whilst you were in Ardougne, Bunkwicket and Waymottin overheard a slightly disturbing conversation.
translation: 洞穴里的进展很慢。你在阿多尼城时，邦克威克特和韦莫廷偷听到了一段有点令人不安的对话。

english: Who was speaking? What was said?
translation: 谁在说话？说了什么？

english: Listen closely whilst I narrate the details...
translation: 仔细听我叙述细节……

english: Good evening, Awowogei.
translation: 阿沃盖，晚上好。

english: It is always dark here, Gnome. Why have you asked to see me in private?
translation: 这里总是很暗，地精。你为什么要求私下见我？

english: Caranock and I have a suggestion to make.
translation: 卡拉诺克和我有个提议。

english: Then be quick about it.
translation: 那就快说吧。

english: The foot soldiers of the Royal Guard in your jail...
translation: 你监狱里的皇家卫队步兵……

english: Would it not be easier if they were somehow just to ... die?
translation: 如果他们就这样……死了，不是更容易吗？

english: Why would I want to do that? Your king would declare war on my island.
translation: 我为什么要那么做？你们的国王会向我的岛屿宣战。

english: I can assure you he will not. We will lay the blame at the humans' feet.
translation: 我向你保证他不会。我们会把责任推到人类身上。

english: Narnode will indeed declare war: not against you, but against humankind.
translation: 纳诺德确实会宣战：不是针对你，而是针对人类。

english: You are of course welcome to your share of the profits.
translation: 你当然可以分得你那份利润。

english: Intriguing. I have recently secured an alliance with the northern monkeys, which may prove useful.
translation: 有意思。我最近与北方的猴子结成了联盟，这可能会派上用场。

english: What would you have me do?
translation: 你想让我做什么？

english: Kill the foot soldiers and the rest of the 10th squad. My superior has sent you a few tricks which may prove useful.
translation: 杀死那些步兵和10号分队的其他成员。我的上级给你送来了一些可能有用的小把戏。

english: High magic: the ability to summon the entire 10th squad to a single location. And -
translation: 高等魔法：能将整个10号分队召唤到一个地方的能力。而且——

english: Even those who escaped?
translation: 连那些逃走的也包括在内？

english: Yes. And of course, you will also receive access to one of his 'pets'.
translation: 是的。当然，你还能使用他的一只“宠物”。

english: You must be careful with these, as you have only one use of each. Ensure you set your trap well - none must survive lest they spread the truth.
translation: 你必须小心使用这些东西，每个只能用一次。确保设好陷阱——不能让任何人活下来，以免他们传播真相。

english: What of my human?
translation: 我的那个人类呢？

english: What human??
translation: 什么人类？？

english: Ignore [him/her/them]. My colleague's official mission was to look after a human in the area, but don't worry: it is probably dead already.
translation: 别管[him/her/them]。我同事的官方任务是照顾该地区的一个人类，但别担心：可能已经死了。

english: I should hope so, for both of your sakes.
translation: 我希望如此，为了你们俩好。

english: Very well. I shall let you know when I have dealt with the Royal Guard.
translation: 很好。等我处理完皇家卫队，我会通知你。

english: Good luck, Awowogei.
translation: 祝你好运，阿沃盖。

english: With access to one of Glough's 'pets', I don't think I'll need it...
translation: 有了格洛的一只“宠物”，我想我不需要运气了……

english: What shall we do?
translation: 我们该怎么办？

english: Zooknock and I have come up with a plan.
translation: 祖克诺克和我想出了一个计划。

english: What kind of a plan?
translation: 什么样的计划？

english: I hope you were listening closely. The teleportation spell that was provided will teleport ALL of the 10th squad, no matter where we may be.
translation: 我希望你听仔细了。提供的传送法术会把整个10号分队都传送走，无论我们身在何处。

english: In effect, the spell will break Lumo, Bunkdo and Carado out of the jail for us.
translation: 实际上，这个法术会把卢莫、邦克多和卡拉多从监狱里解救出来。

english: But you will be teleported straight into whatever trap they have prepared!
translation: 但你们会被直接传送到他们准备好的任何陷阱里！

english: Indeed. This is where you come in. Do not forget that we are the 10th squad of the Royal Guard, and that we are more than capable of holding our own.
translation: 确实。这就是你的用武之地。别忘了我们是皇家卫队第10分队，完全有能力自保。

english: With your assistance, we should be able to defeat whatever is thrown at us.
translation: 有你的协助，我们应该能击败任何迎面而来的敌人。

english: But how will I join you?
translation: 但我怎么加入你们？

english: Simple. We fool the teleportation spell that you are in fact a member of our squad.
translation: 简单。我们让传送法术误以为你实际上是我们的队员。

english: Zooknock knows Glough's grasp of magic well. He believes the spell is linked to the sigils that all of our squad carry.
translation: 祖克诺克很清楚格劳夫对魔法的掌握。他认为这个法术与我们分队所有人携带的队徽有关。

english: It is these sigils that identify us as a member of the squad.
translation: 正是这些队徽标识我们是队员。

english: Welcome to the 10th squad, [player name].
translation: 欢迎加入10号分队，[player name]。

english: It is a replica Waymottin has made of our squad sigils. If you wear that when the spell is cast, you will be summoned along with the rest of us.
translation: 这是韦莫廷仿制的我们分队队徽。如果施法时你戴上它，你就会和我们一起被召唤。

english: You should prepare. Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear the sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.
translation: 你应该做好准备。整理好思绪和物品，然后戴上队徽。快点，人类，我们不想没有你就投入战斗。

english: All I have to do is wear this sigil?
translation: 我只需要戴上这个队徽？

english: Yes - but do not do so until you are ready.
translation: 是的——但等你准备好了再戴。

english: Collect your thoughts and belongings and then wear our squad sigil. Hurry, human, we do not wish to enter this fight without you.
translation: 整理好思绪和物品，然后戴上我们的分队队徽。快点，人类，我们不想没有你就投入战斗。

english: What kind of enemy do we face?
translation: 我们要面对什么样的敌人？

english: I don't know. I truly don't know.
translation: 我不知道。我真的不知道。

english: I've lost the sigil...
translation: 我弄丢了队徽……

english: For all your power, your kind are exceptionally foolish. You must seek out Waymottin and ask him to make a replica. I have no spares.
translation: 尽管你们很有力量，但你们这种族异常愚蠢。你必须去找韦莫廷，让他做一个仿制品。我没有备用的。

english: Sergeant Garkor has sent me. You are asked to create another replica of the 10th squad sigil so that I may join you for the final battle.
translation: 加科尔中士派我来的。请你再做一个10号分队队徽的仿制品，这样我就能加入你们进行最终决战。

english: Already made one. Figured it would come in handy.
translation: 已经做了一个。想着可能会派上用场。

english: He's cleverer than he looks, is that Waymottin.
translation: 他比看起来要聪明，那个韦莫廷。

english: Can I have it then?
translation: 那能给我吗？

english: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins!
translation: 准备好，人类：最终决战开始了！

english: Ready yourself, human: the final battle begins... again!
translation: 准备好，人类：最终决战又开始了！

english: Stop talking and start fighting!
translation: 别说话了，开始战斗！

english: Well done, human! For a second there, I thought we would fail.
translation: 干得好，人类！有那么一瞬间，我以为我们要失败了。

english: Well, we made it.
translation: 嗯，我们成功了。

english: Indeed we did - and with no casualties either.
translation: 确实如此——而且没有任何伤亡。

english: You should report to King Narnode immediately. Tell him that the 10th squad still survives and has suffered no casualties.
translation: 你应该立刻向纳诺德国王报告。告诉他10号分队还活着，且没有任何伤亡。

english: Rest assured, I will do so. How do I leave this place?
translation: 放心，我会的。我怎么离开这里？

english: Speak to Zooknock. He will arrange for you to leave.
translation: 跟祖克诺克说，他会安排你离开。

english: It looks like you're trying to escape. Would you like some help?
translation: 看起来你想逃跑。需要帮忙吗？

english: I ... uh ... yes.
translation: 我……呃……是的。

english: No thank you. Who are you by the way?
translation: 不用了，谢谢。顺便问一下，你是谁？

english: Never mind that child. You should worry more about who you are and the nature of the forces that have driven you here.
translation: 别管那孩子。你更应该担心你自己是谁，以及把你逼到这里的力量的本质。

english: I'll ... keep that in mind, thanks.
translation: 我会……记住的，谢谢。

english: We WILL meet again, [player name].
translation: 我们一定会再见的，[player name]。

english: Well done, human. Bear with me now.
translation: 干得好，人类。现在忍耐一下。

english: King Narnode!
translation: 纳诺德国王！

english: Yes? How is the mission going ... it has been quite some time since I sent you on your way.
translation: 嗯？任务进行得如何……我派你出发已经有段时间了。

english: It's over - it's finally over.
translation: 结束了——终于结束了。

english: What do you mean 'over'?
translation: 你说“结束”是什么意思？

english: I mean 'finished.'
translation: 我的意思是“完成了”。

english: Yes, alright. Report on what happened.
translation: 好吧。报告一下发生了什么。

english: With all due respect sir, if I told you, you would not believe me. I expect Sergeant Garkor will be sending you a full report soon enough.
translation: 恕我直言，长官，如果我告诉你，你不会相信的。我想加科尔中士很快会给你一份详细报告。

english: And what of my 10th squad?
translation: 那我的10号分队呢？

english: They all live - we suffered no casualties.
translation: 他们都活着——我们没有伤亡。

english: 'We', [player name]?
translation: “我们”，[player name]？

english: I, uh, I'm part of the 10th squad now. I even have the sigil.
translation: 我，呃，我现在是10号分队的一员了。我甚至还有队徽。

english: Well, now. It appears I cannot argue with that. Garkor obviously thinks highly of you, as do I.
translation: 哦，这样啊。看来我无法反驳。加科尔显然很看重你，我也是。

english: No service such as what you have done for me goes unrewarded in my kingdom. I personally made a visit to the Royal Treasury to withdraw your reward.
translation: 在我王国里，像你为我所做的贡献不会没有回报。我亲自去了皇家金库为你取了奖励。

english: So you're officially a member of the 10th squad then?
translation: 那么你正式成为10号分队的一员了？

english: Well then you had better sign up for training.
translation: 那你最好报名参加训练。

english: Training?
translation: 训练？

english: Yes. All members of the Royal Guard must complete a mandatory training programme.
translation: 是的。所有皇家卫队成员都必须完成强制性训练课程。

english: Where do I sign up for this?
translation: 我在哪里报名？

english: The High Tree Guardian Daero is in charge of the training programme. You should know where to find him by now.
translation: 高树守护者达埃罗负责训练课程。你现在应该知道在哪里能找到他了。

english: This isn't the last you'll see of me, human. Mark my words - the monkeys are listening.
translation: 你还会再见到我的，人类。记住我的话——猴子们在听着。

english: How did you get back in there?
translation: 你们是怎么回到那里的？

english: Simple: we got caught again.
translation: 简单：我们又被抓了。

english: Deliberately?
translation: 故意的？

english: Yes. We are working undercover here. Isn't that right, guys?
translation: 是的。我们在这里卧底。对吧，兄弟们？

english: Whatever you say, boss.
translation: 老大说什么就是什么。

english: See.
translation: 你看。

english: I'm meant to be here now. We're working undercover.
translation: 我现在就该在这里。我们在卧底。

english: But if you ever lose your sigil, let me know.
translation: 但如果你的队徽丢了，告诉我一声。

english: All is not well, [player name]. Despite having had Glough under close surveillance since the events on Ape Atoll, he has managed to escape the Stronghold.
translation: 情况不妙，[player name]。尽管自从猿猴岛事件以来，我们一直严密监视格劳夫，但他还是设法逃出了要塞。

english: I know you have already done so much for our kingdom, but could you look into Glough's disappearance?
translation: 我知道你已经为我们的王国付出了很多，但你能调查一下格劳夫失踪的事吗？

english: I'll help you look for Glough.
translation: 我会帮你寻找格劳夫。

english: Any idea on where to start?
translation: 知道从哪里开始吗？

english: You should look anywhere Glough may have left behind clues of his whereabouts. I've already had my men search his home, but perhaps you can find something they missed.
translation: 你应该看看格劳夫可能留下线索的任何地方，关于他的下落。我已经派我的人搜查过他的家，但也许你能找到他们遗漏的东西。

english: I'll get right to it.
translation: 我马上去办。

english: I'm busy at the moment.
translation: 我现在很忙。

english: How are you getting on, [player name]?
translation: 你进展如何，[player name]？

english: What should I be looking for again?
translation: 我应该再找什么来着？

english: I wonder who could have left this in Glough's home? The initials A.A. are embroidered into it.
translation: 不知道是谁把这个落在格劳夫家里的？上面绣着首字母 A.A.。

english: Is this your handkerchief?
translation: 这是你的手帕吗？

english: Why, yes, it is. I must have left it behind somewhere...
translation: 哎呀，是的，是我的。我一定是把它落在什么地方了……

english: *sob* W-what do you want? *sob*
translation: *抽泣* 你……你想要什么？*抽泣*

english: *sob* It's Glough... I fear for the worst!
translation: *抽泣* 是格劳夫……我担心最坏的情况发生了！

english: I think he might be seeing someone else! *sob* I hadn't heard from him in a while, and so decided to give him a visit.
translation: 我觉得他可能有了别人！*抽泣* 我有一阵子没他的消息了，所以决定去看看他。

english: At first, I thought there was nobody home... *sob* But then I heard... *sob*
translation: 起初，我以为没人在家……*抽泣* 但我后来听到了……*抽泣*

english: Heard what?
translation: 听到了什么？

english: I've already said too much. *sob* The last time I helped you, Glough lost his job!
translation: 我已经说得太多了。*抽泣* 上次我帮你，格劳夫就丢了工作！

english: What do you care? He's seeing someone else!
translation: 你还在乎什么？他都有别人了！

english: He might be in trouble, I could help.
translation: 他可能有麻烦了，我可以帮忙。

english: I heard whispering coming from higher up in his tree! I managed to climb the first branch... *sob* But I'm not agile enough to get up to the highest level...
translation: 我听到他树屋高处传来低语声！我设法爬上了第一根树枝……*抽泣* 但我身手不够敏捷，上不到最高层……

english: Do you really think he might have gotten into trouble? *sob*
translation: 你真的觉得他可能遇到麻烦了吗？*抽泣*

english: There's another level to his home?
translation: 他家还有另一层？

english: *sob* There's nowhere else the voices could have been coming from... *sob* Please, climb up there and let me know what you find!
translation: *抽泣* 声音不可能从别处传来……*抽泣* 求你了，爬上去看看，然后告诉我你发现了什么！

english: Any idea where Glough is?
translation: 知道格劳夫在哪儿吗？

english: The last time I helped you... *sob* Glough lost his job!
translation: 上次我帮你……*抽泣* 格劳夫就丢了工作！

english: Nothing, goodbye.
translation: 没事了，再见。

english: The note is blank... I'm not sure what I'm meant to be reading right now.
translation: 笔记是空白的……我不知道现在该读什么。

english: I need to translate this before it's going to be of any use... Maybe the King can help.
translation: 我得先翻译一下才能派上用场……也许国王能帮忙。

english: What could the note mean? I should show it to the King, he might be able to make some sense of it.
translation: 这笔记是什么意思？我应该拿给国王看看，他也许能明白些什么。

english: I found a note in Glough's home which might be of use.
translation: 我在格劳夫家里找到了一张可能有用的笔记。

english: Excellent, do you have it with you?
translation: 太好了，你带在身上了吗？

english: Ah, I see that it is written in the ancient gnome language... Perhaps you could translate it with that translation book you've used before?
translation: 啊，我看这是用古代地精语写的……也许你可以用你以前用过的那本翻译书来翻译它？

english: I don't have a copy of the translation book any more.
translation: 我没有那本翻译书的副本了。

english: Here's a spare copy.
translation: 这里有一本备用的。

english: There's too much missing from this translation book to make much sense of the note.
translation: 这本翻译书缺失太多内容，无法理解这张笔记。

english: It is true that the translation guide is incomplete... Perhaps it would be of more use to go to the author directly?
translation: 确实，翻译指南是不完整的……也许直接去找作者更有用？

english: I'll see if the author can help translate the note for me, then.
translation: 那我看看作者能不能帮我翻译这张笔记。

english: Could you translate these notes? I found them in Glough's home, half of it is missing.
translation: 你能翻译这些笔记吗？我在格劳夫家里找到的，有一半内容缺失了。

english: Hmm... This certainly isn't Glough's handwriting...
translation: 嗯……这肯定不是格劳夫的笔迹……

english: Here you go, hopefully it helps you find Glough.
translation: 给你，希望能帮你找到格劳夫。

english: King Narnode! With Anita's help I was able to translate the note... It appears Glough had help leaving the stronghold!
translation: 纳诺德国王！在安妮塔的帮助下，我翻译了那张笔记……看来格劳夫逃离要塞是有人帮忙的！

english: What!? Who could have committed such a crime? Show me the note.
translation: 什么！？谁会犯下这样的罪行？把笔记给我看看。

english: The note refers to a replacement pilot, we've only had one pilot reassigned recently and that's Lori taking over Le Smith's post as a balloon pilot.
translation: 纸条上提到一名替换飞行员，我们最近只重新分配了一名飞行员，那就是洛里接替勒.史密斯的岗位成为热气球飞行员。

english: [player name], you must find out where Glough might have travelled to. Assistant Lori may be able to help.
translation: [player name]，你必须查明格劳夫可能去了哪里。助理洛里也许能帮忙。

english: Have you been able to find out where Glough has gone, [player name]
translation: 你查到格劳夫去哪儿了吗，[player name]？

english: Not yet, King Narnode.
translation: 还没有，纳诺德国王。

english: Please hurry, [player name]. Glough is very dangerous and must be stopped!
translation: 请快点，[player name]。格劳夫非常危险，必须阻止他！

english: I am Assistant Lori. I've been assigned to the stronghold by Auguste.
translation: 我是助理洛里。我是由奥古斯特指派到要塞来的。

english: What happened to Assistant Le Smith?
translation: 助理勒.史密斯怎么了？

english: I'm not sure, you would have to speak to Auguste about that.
translation: 我不太清楚，你得去问奥古斯特。

english: I'd like to talk about Assistant Le Smith.
translation: 我想谈谈助理勒.史密斯的事。

english: What a coincidence, he just so happened to visit recently. What's this about?
translation: 真巧，他最近刚好来拜访过。这是怎么回事？

english: I need to know about the route you taught him.
translation: 我需要知道你教给他的路线。

english: Ah... I insisted it was far too dangerous, nobody has attempted to make that journey before!
translation: 啊……我当时坚持说那太危险了，以前没人尝试过那条路线！

english: Ape Atoll...
translation: 猿猴岛……

english: Can you teach me the route?
translation: 你能教我这路线吗？

english: Most certainly not! For all I know, I've already sent one of my finest pilots to his peril!
translation: 当然不行！据我所知，我已经把我最优秀的飞行员之一送上了绝路！

english: I've found evidence that Glough may have headed to Ape Atoll.
translation: 我发现证据表明格劳夫可能去了猿猴岛。

english: How could this be?
translation: 这怎么可能？

english: Assistant Le Smith is involved, it appears he has flown them there.
translation: 助理勒.史密斯也牵涉其中，看来是他用热气球把他们送到那里的。

english: Agh! We were foolish to allow him to stay here after dismissing him from the glider regiment.
translation: 啊！我们太愚蠢了，在把他从滑翔机兵团开除后，竟然还允许他留在这里。

english: So, what should we do now?
translation: 那么，我们现在该怎么办？

english: Glough must be working with the monkeys once again. Fortunately, the rest of the 10th squad remained on Ape Atoll after your previous mission, they have been keeping a close eye on Awowogei.
translation: 格劳夫一定又在和猴子们合作了。幸运的是，在你上次任务之后，第十小队的其余成员留在了猿猴岛，他们一直在密切监视阿沃盖。

english: Perhaps they will have spotted something out of the ordinary that could help indicate what Glough is doing.
translation: 也许他们发现了什么不寻常的事情，能帮助我们判断格劳夫在做什么。

english: Glough is a threat to us all... I must hereby re-assign you to Ape Atoll, [player name]. Report to Sergeant Garkor on Ape Atoll for further orders.
translation: 格劳夫对我们所有人都是威胁……我在此必须将你重新指派到猿猴岛，[player name]。向猿猴岛上的加科尔中士报到，等待进一步命令。

english: I have given you orders, [player name]. Report to Sergeant Garkor on Ape Atoll for further instruction.
translation: 我已经给你下达了命令，[player name]。向猿猴岛上的加科尔中士报到，等待进一步指示。

english: Welcome back, [player name].
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。

english: King Narnode has sent me. I'm investigating the disappearance of Glough.
translation: 是纳诺德国王派我来的。我正在调查格劳夫的失踪案。

english: Glough... really? We've not had any indication that he has returned to Ape Atoll.
translation: 格劳夫……真的吗？我们没有收到任何迹象表明他回到了猿猴岛。

english: But we have been seeing a lot of activity from Awowogei and his commanders - I assumed the king would send someone soon enough.
translation: 但我们注意到阿沃盖和他的指挥官们活动频繁——我本以为国王很快就会派人来的。

english: Any idea what they're up to?
translation: 知道他们在搞什么鬼吗？

english: We're not entirely sure, he has been keeping a tight lid on his plans. I guess it could be tied to Glough's disappearance? Perhaps you could get more information from Awowogei directly...
translation: 我们不太确定，他对自己的计划守口如瓶。我猜这可能和格劳夫的失踪有关？也许你可以直接从阿沃盖那里获取更多信息……

english: He may be willing to share his plans with you, assuming you are disguised with a greegree, that is.
translation: 他也许愿意和你分享他的计划，前提是你用咕噜咕噜变身术伪装起来。

english: That sounds far too dangerous.
translation: 那听起来太危险了。

english: A member of the 10th squad should never back down in the face of adversity, come back when you're feeling up to the task.
translation: 10号分队的成员面对逆境绝不应退缩，等你觉得自己能胜任这个任务时再回来。

english: My squad and I are still carrying out reconnaissance. Awowogei has been very occupied as of lately, could this have something to do with why you're here?
translation: 我和我的小队仍在进行侦察。阿沃盖最近非常忙碌，这和你来这里的原因有关吗？

english: I'm only passing through.
translation: 我只是路过。

english: Have you learned anything from Awowogei yet?
translation: 你从阿沃盖那里打听到什么了吗？

english: We can't give up, [player name], come back when you've got more information.
translation: 我们不能放弃，[player name]，等你有了更多信息再回来。

english: I'll get to it right away.
translation: 我马上去办。

english: What do you want? I'm very busy right now.
translation: 你想要什么？我现在很忙。

english: How are things going, Awowogei?
translation: 最近怎么样，阿沃盖？

english: I don't have time for idle chat! What do you want?
translation: 我没时间闲聊！你想要什么？

english: I'm here to discuss military strategies.
translation: 我是来讨论军事策略的。

english: I only discuss such matters with my highest ranking military officials. In fact, I am supposed to be in a meeting with my commander right now. Kruk has been consistently late to our meetings recently.
translation: 我只和我最高级别的军事官员讨论这类事情。事实上，我现在应该正在和我的指挥官开会。克鲁克最近开会总是迟到。

english: Uwogo, have a messenger fetch him from his post.
translation: 乌沃戈，派一个信使去他的岗位把他叫来。

english: I'm afraid all of our messengers are busy.
translation: 恐怕我们所有的信使都很忙。

english: Hmmm, perhaps you could make yourself useful after all, visitor. Why don't you run along to the gate and remind Kruk of our meeting.
translation: 嗯，也许你终究还是能派上用场的，访客。你不如跑到门口去提醒克鲁克我们的会议。

english: Of course, my king.
translation: 当然，我的国王。

english: Garkor isn't going to be happy when I tell him about this...
translation: 加科尔知道这事肯定不会高兴……

english: What was that? Is there a problem?
translation: 你说什么？有问题吗？

english: Excellent. I must prepare for my meeting, Uwogo.
translation: 很好。我得为会议做准备了，乌沃戈。

english: I'm afraid your time with the king is up, you should fetch Kruk from his post on the gate.
translation: 恐怕你和国王的时间结束了，你应该去城门岗位把克鲁克叫来。

english: I don't take orders from you!
translation: 我不听你的命令！

english: Any idea where I can find Glough?
translation: 知道我在哪里能找到格劳夫吗？

english: I don't know what you're talking about. We haven't been involved with Glough since he failed us.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。自从格劳夫让我们失望之后，我们就没再和他有来往了。

english: He won't discuss his plans with anyone but his military commanders.
translation: 他除了和他的军事指挥官之外，不会和任何人讨论他的计划。

english: Ah, the monkey has more sense than we give him credit for... Perhaps you could go back in there as one of his commanders?
translation: 啊，这猴子比我们想的要聪明……也许你可以假扮成他的一个指挥官再进去？

english: Zooknock could get you disguised as one of Awowogei's commanders if you retrieved the necessary items for him to make a greegree. We just need to choose which commander to go after...
translation: 如果你能取回必要的材料让祖克诺克制作一个咕噜咕噜，他就能把你伪装成阿沃盖的一个指挥官。我们只需要选择要针对哪个指挥官……

english: Well Awowogei mentioned something about a meeting with Kruk. He wanted me to go to find him.
translation: 嗯，阿沃盖提到了要和克鲁克会面的事。他想让我去找他。

english: Kruk eh... Captain of the monkey guard would certainly be a useful disguise to have at our disposal. Hopefully you can find him somewhere isolated from the rest of the guards... Once you have defeated him, take his
translation: 克鲁克啊……猴子守卫的船长，能弄到他的伪装对我们来说必定很有用。希望你能在不惊动其他守卫的地方找到他……一旦击败了他，就拿上他的

english: corpse to Zooknock along with an uncharged monkey talisman, well, you know the routine.
translation: 尸体，连同未充能的猴子护符一起交给祖克诺克。嗯，你知道怎么做。

english: I'm still working on getting that greegree.
translation: 我还在想办法弄到那个咕噜咕噜面具。

english: Please hurry [player name], we need this information from Awowogei before it's too late.
translation: 请快点，[player name]，我们必须在为时已晚之前从阿沃盖那里得到情报。

english: The king has sent me with a message for Kruk, any idea where I can find him?
translation: 国王派我来给克鲁克传话，你知道我在哪里能找到他吗？

english: Your guess is as good as mine, you didn't hear it from me, but he's been disappearing from his post a lot lately...
translation: 我和你一样不清楚，别说是我说的，但他最近经常擅离职守……

english: You might be able to track him down if you've got what it takes, although I wouldn't want to be the one caught sneaking up on Kruk!
translation: 如果你有本事的话，也许能追踪到他，不过我可不想成为那个偷偷接近克鲁克的人！

english: Any idea where to start looking?
translation: 知道从哪里开始找吗？

english: There's only one way off the wall, and that's down the Western ramp to the shore. I know that's where I'd start looking.
translation: 离开这座墙只有一条路，那就是从西边的斜坡下去到岸边。我知道我会从那里开始找。

english: Any luck finding Kruk?
translation: 找到克鲁克了吗？

english: You'd best not keep the king waiting, try tracking down Kruk's movements.
translation: 你最好别让国王等太久，试着追踪克鲁克的动向。

english: Stop right there, Kruk!
translation: 站住，克鲁克！

english: I'm impressed you made it so far, human.
translation: 我很佩服你能走到这一步，人类。

english: However, I'm afraid that this is the end of the line for you.
translation: 不过，恐怕你的路就到这里为止了。

english: Ah finally, Kruk! I was beginning to think you had run into trouble...
translation: 啊，终于来了，克鲁克！我还以为你遇到麻烦了……

english: Uh... No, everything is fine.
translation: 呃……不，一切顺利。

english: Excellent. Have you had any further considerations for our plans?
translation: 很好。你对我们的计划还有什么进一步的想法吗？

english: And which plans would we be talking about here?
translation: 你指的是哪个计划？

english: Are you sure everything is okay Kruk? You seem very distracted lately.
translation: 你确定一切都还好吗，克鲁克？你最近好像心不在焉的。

english: I'm fine, just been very busy thinking over those plans. Could you remind me where we left off last time?
translation: 我没事，只是一直在忙着思考那些计划。你能提醒我上次我们说到哪里了吗？

english: We decided to move forward with our three-way assault.
translation: 我们决定推进三线进攻的计划。

english: You were negotiating an alliance with the ogres and trolls, working on a new fleet of battleships and then developing that secret weapon of yours.
translation: 你当时在跟食人魔和巨魔谈判结盟，同时建造新的战船舰队，还要开发你的秘密武器。

english: So, how is progress of our plans coming along?
translation: 那么，我们的计划进展如何？

english: Don't let me down Kruk, we all know what is at stake here.
translation: 别让我失望，克鲁克，我们都知道这里面的利害关系。

english: The monkeys are planning another attack!
translation: 猴子们正在计划另一次攻击！

english: Ah, this comes as little surprise. Did you uncover any details of the plans?
translation: 啊，这倒不意外。你打听到计划的具体细节了吗？

english: The assault is coming in three stages...
translation: 进攻分三个阶段……

english: First, the monkeys wish to join into an alliance with the trolls and ogres...
translation: 首先，猴子们想和巨魔以及食人魔结成联盟……

english: That makes sense, it's no secret that those races are no fans of humans, other than perhaps as ingredients in a soup... What else did you learn?
translation: 说得通，众所周知那些种族都不喜欢人类，除了也许会把人类当汤里的配料……你还打听到了什么？

english: The monkeys have been building a fleet of battleships.
translation: 猴子们一直在建造一支战船舰队。

english: That is odd, we have spies posted at the shipyard who haven't reported any news of this to us. I'll get a few scouts to look into it further. What's the final element to this attack?
translation: 这很奇怪，我们在船厂布置了间谍，但没有人向我们报告过这个消息。我会派几个侦察兵进一步调查。这次攻击的最后一个要素是什么？

english: Apparently Kruk has been working on a secret weapon, I've got no idea what it is.
translation: 据说克鲁克一直在研制一种秘密武器，我不知道那是什么。

english: Well then, that sounds ominous. I'll have some men look into it. For now, let's deal with the problems we can solve.
translation: 嗯，听起来不祥。我会派人去调查。现在，我们先处理能解决的问题。

english: You must convince the trolls and ogres not to ally with the monkeys.
translation: 你必须说服巨魔和食人魔不与猴子结盟。

english: Any ideas on how?
translation: 有什么主意吗？

english: You should pay a visit to the military officials of each race. I believe a troll general by the name of Kob is still filling that role in the Troll Stronghold. As for the ogres, I would recommend finding the head of the city
translation: 你应该去拜访每个种族的军事长官。我记得巨魔要塞里有个叫科布的巨魔将军还在任职。至于食人魔，我建议你去找古塔诺斯市的城市守卫

english: guard in Gu'Tanoth.
translation: 古塔诺斯的守卫。

english: What you do here, human?
translation: 人类，你来这里做什么？

english: Alliance? We plan to crush the hairy little men as soon as the humans are gone!
translation: 结盟？等人类被消灭了，我们还要把那些毛茸茸的小矮子也给碾碎！

english: You won't be around to crush anyone when I'm done with you.
translation: 等我收拾完你，你就没机会碾碎任何人了。

english: Ah, this food thinks it's a brave one, this will be fun!
translation: 啊，这份食物觉得自己挺勇敢嘛，这下好玩了！

english: Here's the game, I kill you, we help little hairy men kill all the humans. You kill me, we call off the attack.
translation: 游戏规则是这样的：我杀了你，我们就帮小毛人们杀光所有人类。你杀了我，我们就取消攻击。

english: Maybe human not as brave as Kob thinks!
translation: 也许人类并不像科布想的那么勇敢！

english: What would it take to persuade you not to attack the humans?
translation: 要怎样才能说服你不攻击人类？

english: Humans are all so weak! There is nothing you can offer us to stop the attack!
translation: 人类全都这么弱！你没什么能阻止我们攻击的！

english: I am Kob, mightiest of the troll generals!
translation: 我是科布，最强大的巨魔将军！

english: I'll just be on my way.
translation: 那我就先走了。

english: Hurry before I get hungry!
translation: 快点，趁我还没饿！

english: Wait! Maybe battle to death is too much...
translation: 等等！也许拼死决战太过了……

english: You win, I will call off the attack.
translation: 你赢了，我会取消攻击。

english: I have convinced the ogres and trolls not to form an alliance with the monkeys.
translation: 我已经说服食人魔和巨魔不与猴子结盟。

english: Excellent work, [player name].
translation: 干得好，[player name]。

english: I have had my men look into this supposed fleet of battleships. The shipyard has turned up nothing, although, someone did say they saw a familiar face sneaking around town.
translation: 我已经派手下调查那所谓的战船舰队了。造船厂那边什么也没发现，不过有人确实看到一个熟悉的面孔在城里鬼鬼祟祟地走动。

english: An old pilot from the stronghold, he went by the name of Le Smith. I hadn't heard of him since he was dismissed from the glider regiment.
translation: 一个来自要塞的老飞行员，名叫勒.史密斯。自从他被滑翔机兵团开除后，我就再也没听过他的消息了。

english: Right. He's the one who flew Glough here...
translation: 对。就是他载着格劳夫来这里的……

english: If that's the case then he's likely to have information we could use. You should track him down and see what you can learn.
translation: 如果是这样，那他很可能掌握我们可以利用的情报。你应该找到他，看看能打听到什么。

english: Any idea where I should start looking?
translation: 知道从哪里开始找吗？

english: Your guess is as good as mine - he must be somewhere on Ape Atoll.
translation: 我也不知道——他一定在猿猴岛的某个地方。

english: Sorry, I don't have an amulet of monkey speak.
translation: 抱歉，我没有猴子语护符。

english: That's okay, I am wearing my... uh... amulet of human speak.
translation: 没关系，我戴着我的……呃……人类语护符。

english: Oh, right... What are you doing here?
translation: 哦，这样……你在这里做什么？

english: I was going to ask you the same question.
translation: 我正要问你同样的问题。

english: Glough told me not to talk to anyone while I'm here.
translation: 格劳夫告诉我在这里不要跟任何人说话。

english: So you're here with Glough?
translation: 所以你跟格劳夫一起来的？

english: I've already said too much. Please, leave me be.
translation: 我说得太多了。请让我一个人待着。

english: The fleet must be kept top secret... Agh! Forget I said anything.
translation: 舰队必须高度保密……啊！忘了我说的。

english: Awowogei has already informed me about the battleships. In fact, he sent me here to check up on your progress.
translation: 阿沃盖已经告诉我战船的事了。事实上，就是他派我来检查你的进展。

english: So what is it you want to know?
translation: 那你想知道什么？

english: Where is the fleet? The shipyard still seems pretty bare.
translation: 舰队在哪里？造船厂看起来还是空荡荡的。

english: Aha! The shipyard? Of course you aren't going to find anything there!
translation: 啊哈！造船厂？你在那里当然找不到任何东西！

english: Aha... right... Of course?
translation: 啊哈……对……当然？

english: The airships are being built just off the coast of Ape Atoll.
translation: 飞艇正在猿猴岛近海建造。

english: Airships!? I mean... Right.
translation: 飞艇！？我是说……对。

english: Anyway, I have to get back to work. Let Awowogei know everything is on schedule.
translation: 总之，我得回去工作了。告诉阿沃盖一切按计划进行。

english: Actually, I know enough already.
translation: 其实，我知道的已经够了。

english: What fleet are you talking about?
translation: 你在说什么舰队？

english: King Awowogei has sent me to find Glough.
translation: 阿沃盖国王派我来找格劳夫。

english: Well you're not going to find him up here. I'm afraid I'm too busy to chat right now.
translation: 反正你在这里是找不到他的。抱歉我现在太忙，没空聊天。

english: I was just admiring the view.
translation: 我只是在欣赏风景。

english: Me too, it's perfect conditions for my test flight.
translation: 我也是，这天气正适合我的试飞。

english: Good for you, I'll just be on my way.
translation: 那你好好享受，我先走了。

english: Test flight?
translation: 试飞？

english: Oh sorry, ignore that. I just meant it's a lovely day.
translation: 哦抱歉，当我没说。我只是说今天天气不错。

english: I was just leaving.
translation: 我正要走了。

english: Assistant Le Smith?
translation: 助理勒.史密斯？

english: Yes? Wait... what are you doing here?
translation: 嗯？等等……你在这里做什么？

english: I've already said too much, human. Please, leave me be.
translation: 我已经说得太多了，人类。请让我一个人待着。

english: Odd, I didn't think Awowogei was the type to work with humans...
translation: 奇怪，我以为阿沃盖不是那种会和人类合作的人……

english: Um.. I am a prisoner of war here, Awowogei gets me to run errands.
translation: 呃……我是这里的战俘，阿沃盖让我跑腿办事。

english: King Narnode has sent me to find Glough.
translation: 纳罗德国王派我来找格劳夫。

english: I'm afraid I have no idea what you're talking about... I'm just here on vacation!
translation: 恐怕我不知道你在说什么……我只是来度假的！

english: I've spoken to Assistant Le Smith.
translation: 我和助理勒.史密斯谈过了。

english: What have you learned?
translation: 你打听到了什么？

english: He mentioned something about airships being built off the coast of Ape Atoll.
translation: 他提到了在猿猴岛近海建造飞艇的事。

english: Airships? No wonder we didn't find anything at the shipyard... You'll have to do something about them.
translation: 飞艇？难怪我们在造船厂什么都没找到……你得想办法对付它们。

english: Firstly, you have to find out where they're constructing these airships...
translation: 首先，你得找出他们建造这些飞艇的地点……

english: Once you've found the location, you'll have to find a way to sabotage the airships.
translation: 找到位置后，你得想办法破坏那些飞艇。

english: I'm keeping watch on who comes and goes from the construction platform.
translation: 我正在监视进出建筑平台的人。

english: There's a large scale construction project taking place offshore.
translation: 离岸正在进行一项大规模的建筑工程。

english: Can I visit the platform?
translation: 我可以参观平台吗？

english: I'm afraid only authorised personnel are allowed to visit the platform.
translation: 恐怕只有授权人员才能参观平台。

english: Yes, sir. The engineers needed a large open space to construct the fleet, an offshore platform was the obvious solution.
translation: 是的，长官。工程师们需要一大片开阔空间来建造舰队，海上平台是显而易见的解决方案。

english: Of course, sir.
translation: 当然，长官。

english: Okay. See you around.
translation: 好的，回头见。

english: I was just passing through. Goodbye.
translation: 我只是路过，再见。

english: There must be some kind of explosive somewhere on this platform that I can use...
translation: 这个平台上一定有什么炸药之类的东西可以用……

english: That should be enough, now I just have to get back to the boat...
translation: 应该够了，现在只需要回到船上……

english: I've destroyed the airships!
translation: 我已经摧毁了飞艇！

english: Excellent, [player name]!
translation: 干得好，[player name]！

english: While you were away, we managed to uncover something quite unsettling.
translation: 你不在的时候，我们发现了一些相当令人不安的事情。

english: We were investigating the tunnels where you found Kruk, and discovered an entrance to a much deeper cavern.
translation: 我们调查了你发现克鲁克的那条隧道，发现了一个通往更深洞穴的入口。

english: Unfortunately, we were unable to access the entrance ourselves, there was some magical force stopping us from getting through.
translation: 不幸的是，我们无法自行进入那个入口，有一种魔法力量阻止我们通过。

english: We are fairly confident this is where the 'secret weapon' Kruk was working on is being developed, you'll have to find a way into the area.
translation: 我们相当确信，这就是克鲁克正在研发的“秘密武器”的所在地，你必须想办法进入那个区域。

english: How do you expect me to find a way through the magical barrier?
translation: 你指望我怎么穿过那道魔法屏障？

english: I'm sure you'll find a way, [player name].
translation: 我相信你会找到办法的，[player name]。

english: Have you found out any more about the 'secret weapon' Kruk was working on?
translation: 关于克鲁克正在研发的“秘密武器”，你还有什么发现吗？

english: Please hurry, [player name], we need to find out what we're up against here.
translation: 请快点，[player name]，我们需要弄清楚我们面对的是什么。

english: Kruk! Where have you been? The experiments have broken out of their cages again, get them back under control before they destroy any more of my work!
translation: 克鲁克！你跑哪去了？实验体又逃出笼子了，在它们毁掉我更多成果之前，赶紧把它们控制住！

english: Good work getting them back under control Kruk.
translation: 干得好，克鲁克，把它们控制住了。

english: Clearly that last strain of the mutagen was too unstable...
translation: 显然，最后一批诱变剂太不稳定了……

english: Mutagen?
translation: 诱变剂？

english: Right... I forgot I don't keep you around for your brains.
translation: 对……我忘了留着你可不是为了你的脑子。

english: I've been experimenting on those specimens you've been gathering for me.
translation: 我一直在用你为我收集的那些样本做实验。

english: I've been trying to find a mutagen stable enough to allow me to have control over the creatures, whilst keeping them aggressive enough to tear apart anything that stands in our way.
translation: 我一直在尝试找到一种足够稳定的诱变剂，既能让我控制这些生物，又能让它们保持足够的攻击性，撕碎挡在我们路上的一切。

english: I think I may have finally found the perfect balance, however, I will need time to carry out some final tests.
translation: 我想我终于找到了完美的平衡，不过我还需要时间进行一些最终测试。

english: How big is this army of creatures?
translation: 这支生物军队有多大？

english: I'm only using our test subjects at the moment, however, once I've processed the mutagen into an airborne form, I'll be able to unleash it across all of Ape Atoll!
translation: 目前我只用了我们的测试对象，不过一旦我把诱变剂加工成气态形式，我就能把它释放到整个猿猴岛！

english: All that we have to do now is wait for the mutagen to infuse power from these charged onyx gems.
translation: 我们现在要做的就是等待诱变剂从这些已充能的玛瑙宝石中汲取力量。

english: I'm going to find out where Le Smith has disappeared to, I'll let you know when I next require your services. Farewell, Kruk.
translation: 我要去找找史密斯工匠跑哪去了，下次需要你的时候我会通知你。再见，克鲁克。

english: I should check what effect this has had on the mutagen.
translation: 我应该检查一下这对诱变剂有什么影响。

english: I've taken care of Glough's secret weapon, he was working on some kind of mutagen for apes.
translation: 我已经解决了格劳夫的秘密武器，他一直在研究某种针对猿类的诱变剂。

english: Good work, [player name]! Now all that's left to do is inform Awowogei of his failed plans. If he has any sense, he will call off his plans for attack.
translation: 干得好，[player name]！现在只需通知阿沃盖他的计划失败了。如果他还有理智，就会取消他的攻击计划。

english: Have you informed Awowogei of his failed plans?
translation: 你通知阿沃盖他的计划失败了吗？

english: Please hurry, [player name], we are so close to victory!
translation: 请快点，[player name]，我们离胜利就差一步了！

english: I'm afraid I have bad news.
translation: 恐怕我有坏消息。

english: The trolls and ogres have backed out of our alliance...
translation: 巨魔和食人魔退出了我们的联盟……

english: The fleet of battleships will not be ready in time for our attack...
translation: 战舰舰队无法及时准备好发动攻击……

english: This is a disaster! What about your secret weapon?
translation: 这简直是灾难！那你的秘密武器呢？

english: Unfortunately there have been some complications, the weapon is still too unstable for use on the battlefield.
translation: 不幸的是，出现了一些问题，武器仍然太不稳定，无法在战场上使用。

english: Agh! You have left me no choice but to cancel our assault on the mainland...
translation: 啊！你让我别无选择，只能取消对大陆的进攻……

english: You have failed me for the last time, Kruk, you are hereby stripped of your rank and duties. Uwogo, cancel all of my upcoming meetings, I need some time alone.
translation: 克鲁克，你最后一次让我失望了，我在此剥夺你的军衔和职责。乌沃戈，取消我接下来所有的会议，我需要一个人待会儿。

english: You are not welcome here, Kruk.
translation: 这里不欢迎你，克鲁克。

english: Yes, and he has called off the attack!
translation: 是的，他取消了攻击！

english: I knew you could do it, [player name]!
translation: 我就知道你能行，[player name]！

english: It would appear your mission on Ape Atoll is complete. You should inform the king that we've located Glough and thwarted Awowogei's plans. While you're ...
translation: 看来你在猿猴岛的任务已经完成了。你应该通知国王，我们已经找到了格劳夫并挫败了阿沃盖的计划。趁你……

english: Huh? What was that?
translation: 嗯？你说什么？

english: You said you dealt with the airships, [player name]!
translation: 你说你处理了飞艇，[player name]！

english: I thought I did!
translation: 我以为我处理了！

english: Huaarghh! I knew I couldn't rely on these primitive apes, I'll just have to do this myself!
translation: 哈啊！我就知道不能指望这些原始猿类，看来我得亲自动手了！

english: Le Smith, set our course for the Grand Tree, let's end this once and for all!
translation: 史密斯工匠，把航向设定为大树家园，让我们一劳永逸地结束这一切！

english: Yes, sir.
translation: 是，长官。

english: We have to stop Glough! Get back to the Stronghold and warn the king before it's too late! I'll get the rest of the 10th squad together and we'll meet you there.
translation: 我们必须阻止格劳夫！快回要塞警告国王，趁还来得及！我去召集第十小队的其他人，我们在那里碰头。

english: There's no time for chatting, [player name]! You need to get back to the Gnome Stronghold!
translation: 没时间闲聊了，[player name]！你得赶紧回地精要塞！

english: How is the mission going, [player name]?
translation: 任务进展如何，[player name]？

english: I found Glough, he's headed for the Stronghold! We need to evacuate!
translation: 我找到格劳夫了，他正朝要塞去！我们需要疏散！

english: Evacuate? I think you're overreacting... My troops can handle Glough.
translation: 疏散？我觉得你反应过度了……我的部队能对付格劳夫。

english: You don't understand, he has an airship and army of demonic experiments!
translation: 你不明白，他有一艘飞艇和一支恶魔实验体大军！

english: This is bad... I will put the troops on high alert. And... Well, we do have someone else who may be able to help...
translation: 这糟了……我会让部队进入高度戒备状态。而且……嗯，我们还有另一个人也许能帮忙……

english: Nieve is the most highly skilled warrior we have here, get her assistance and defend the Stronghold.
translation: 尼芙是我们这里最技艺高超的战士，去找她帮忙，保卫要塞。

english: Get Nieve and defend the Stronghold, [player name]!
translation: 去找尼芙，保卫要塞，[player name]！

english: Glough is leading an attack on the Stronghold with an army of demonic creatures! We need your help!
translation: 格劳夫正带领一队恶魔生物攻击要塞！我们需要你的帮助！

english: It's a long story, the king has requested that you join me in assisting the troops with the Stronghold's defence.
translation: 说来话长，国王要求你和我一起协助部队防守要塞。

english: I am unable to leave my post unattended, I'll have to bring in a replacement while I'm helping. Are you sure you want me to join you?
translation: 我无法离开岗位无人看管，我得找个替班才能帮忙。你确定要我加入你吗？

english: You should pick up your pet first. It would only get in the way.
translation: 你应该先把你的宠物收起来。它只会碍事。

english: What in Gielinor is that thing?
translation: 那是什么鬼东西？

english: It's Glough's airship - and it's heading straight for the Grand Tree!
translation: 那是格劳夫的飞艇——它正径直朝大树家园飞去！

english: Sir, those experiments of yours are out of control back there, isn't there something you can do?
translation: 长官，你的那些实验体在后面失控了，你就不能做点什么吗？

english: Just focus on piloting the ship! Narnode isn't going to know what's hit him!
translation: 专心驾驶飞船！纳诺德根本不知道是什么击中了他！

english: But sir, it's only a matter of time before they... Agghh!
translation: 但是长官，它们迟早会……啊！

english: Huh? It completely missed the Grand Tree! We should head North to the crash site...
translation: 嗯？它完全没击中大树家园！我们应该往北去坠毁地点……

english: Wait, look! Some of those things have broken into the Stronghold! We have to stop them, let's go!
translation: 等等，看！有些东西闯进了要塞！我们必须阻止它们，上！

english: Come on, [player name], we've got to defend the Stronghold!
translation: 来吧，[player name]，我们必须保卫要塞！

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, [player name].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，[player name]。

english: I think we've dealt with enough of these things, the troops can handle the rest! Let's join the 10th squad by the breach in the outer wall to the North.
translation: 我想我们已经解决了足够多的这些东西，剩下的部队能应付！我们去北边外墙缺口处和第十小队会合。

english: Good work, [player name], my troops can take it from here. You and Nieve should investigate the crash site.
translation: 干得好，[player name]，我的部队能接手这里。你和尼芙应该去调查坠毁地点。

english: We'll head there now.
translation: 我们现在就去。

english: Don't just stand there, [player name], help us deal with these abominations!
translation: 别光站着，[player name]，帮我们对付这些怪物！

english: Good work dealing with those abominations, [player name], you should talk to the commander.
translation: 干得好，解决了那些怪物，[player name]，你应该和指挥官谈谈。

english: Some of those things have made it into the Stronghold, you've got to defeat them, [player name]!
translation: 有些东西已经闯进了要塞，你必须击败它们，[player name]！

english: We'll keep the breach secure, [player name]. You should head to the crash site to make sure Glough is dealt with, once and for all.
translation: 我们会守住缺口，[player name]。你应该去坠毁地点确保格劳夫被彻底解决。

english: No problem, I'll finish this once and for all.
translation: 没问题，我会一劳永逸地结束这一切。

english: I know you're tough, [player name], but it would be unwise to head out there on your own. Get Nieve and then come back.
translation: 我知道你很厉害，[player name]，但一个人去那里是不明智的。去找尼芙，然后再回来。

english: You. Always it's you. Have you any idea how sick I am of you? What have you even got against me?
translation: 你。总是你。你知道我有多烦你吗？你到底跟我有什么仇？

english: Surrender to us, Glough, or I swear by my shiny blue shield that I will end you right here.
translation: 向我们投降，格劳夫，否则我以我闪亮的蓝色盾牌发誓，我会当场了结你。

english: Oh, will you? The lady talks tough. Let's see how you fare against my best pets!
translation: 哦，是吗？这位女士口气不小。让我看看你在我最好的宠物面前能撑多久！

english: Bah! Never trust a monkey to do a gnome's work.
translation: 呸！永远别指望猴子能干地精的活。

english: I guess I'll just have to deal with you two meddling buffoons myself!
translation: 看来我只能亲自对付你们两个多管闲事的蠢货了！

english: He has the mutagen! We have to stop him!
translation: 他拿着诱变剂！我们必须阻止他！

english: Nieve, wait!
translation: 尼芙，等等！

english: Nooooooooo!
You'll pay for this Glough!
translation: 格劳夫，你要为此付出代价！

english: Uh oh!
translation: 哦哦！

english: [player name], are you okay? We detected a very powerful presence in the caverns and decided to pull you out, I couldn't get a lock on Nieve, is she alright?
translation: [player name]，你没事吧？我们在洞穴里探测到一股非常强大的力量，决定把你拉出来，但我无法锁定尼芙，她还好吗？

english: I'm afraid she didn't make it... It was Glough, he injected himself with the demonic mutagen he had been developing... He was too powerful...
translation: 恐怕她没能挺过来……是格劳夫，他给自己注射了正在研发的恶魔诱变剂……他太强大了……

english: And what of Glough now?
translation: 那格劳夫现在怎么样了？

english: He's not a problem any longer.
translation: 他不再是问题了。

english: I hope you are right, [player name].
translation: 我希望你是对的，[player name]。

english: You should report back to the king, I can teleport you to the Grand Tree if you would like?
translation: 你应该回去向国王报告，如果你愿意，我可以把你传送回大树家园。

english: Report back to the king as soon as possible.
translation: 尽快回去向国王报告。

english: Glough has been defeated, and his demonic creations are trapped deep within the caverns to the North.
translation: 格劳夫已经被击败，他的恶魔造物被困在北方的洞穴深处。

english: The monkeys were planning another attack, however, I managed to sabotage their plans.
translation: 那些猴子原本计划再次发动攻击，不过，我设法破坏了他们的计划。

english: This is excellent news, [player name]. Where is Nieve?
translation: 这真是好消息，[player name]。尼芙在哪里？

english: I'm afraid she didn't make it.
translation: 恐怕她没能挺过来。

english: Her sacrifice will not be forgotten.
translation: 她的牺牲不会被遗忘。

english: I have received word from monkey messengers that Awowogei himself wishes to make a visit to the Stronghold...
translation: 我收到了猴子信使的消息，阿沃盖本人希望访问要塞……

english: Apparently he wishes to set up an agreement of peace between Ape Atoll and the mainland.
translation: 显然，他希望在猿猴岛和大陆之间达成一项和平协议。

english: A peace treaty... Do you trust him?
translation: 一份和平条约……你信任他吗？

english: I don't have a choice. It would be foolish to decline such an offer, there may not be many more opportunities for peace between our kingdoms.
translation: 我没有选择。拒绝这样的提议是愚蠢的，我们两个王国之间可能没有更多和平的机会了。

english: So, what now?
translation: 那么，现在怎么办？

english: Rest, [player name], you have earned it. I will have you summoned when the peace agreement is complete, you should be present during a moment of such historic importance.
translation: 休息吧，[player name]，这是你应得的。等和平协议完成后，我会召唤你，你应该出席这样具有历史意义的时刻。

english: So, I hear you were the one to foil Glough's plans. Thank you, human, he had been setting our kingdoms against one another for far too long.
translation: 那么，我听说就是你挫败了格劳夫的计划。谢谢你，人类，他让我们的王国相互对立太久了。

english: Finally, there can be peace between Ape Atoll and the mainland. [player name], you are welcome to visit Ape Atoll whenever you please, we will be opening our gates to the outside world for the first time.
translation: 终于，猿猴岛和大陆之间可以和平了。[player name]，欢迎你随时访问猿猴岛，我们将首次向外界敞开大门。

english: Awowogei has allowed us to set up a Gnome glider route to Marim, you are welcome to use it as you wish.
translation: 阿沃盖允许我们在马里姆设立一条地精滑翔机航线，你可以随意使用。

english: Please, feel free to talk to the new head of the Ape Atoll guard, Duke, about advanced combat training, should you wish to receive it.
translation: 如果你希望接受高级战斗训练，请随意与猿猴岛守卫的新首领公爵谈谈。

english: I must be heading back now. Farewell, King Narnode, and thank you again, [player name].
translation: 我现在必须回去了。再会，纳诺德国王，再次感谢你，[player name]。

english: On behalf of the Gnomes I can only thank you, [player name].
translation: 我代表地精们只能感谢你，[player name]。

english: Please accept this gift as a token of our gratitude for your services to our people.
translation: 请收下这份礼物，作为我们对您服务我们人民的感谢。

english: This is one of my personal seed pods, handed down through the generations of my family.
translation: 这是我个人的一颗种子荚，在我家族中世代相传。

english: Simply commune with a pod and you'll be teleported right here to the Grand Tree.
translation: 只需与种子荚沟通，你就会被传送到这里——大树家园。

english: Thank you, King Narnode!
translation: 谢谢你，纳诺德国王！

english: Greetings, outerlander, I am Hamal. I am the chieftain of this tribe.
translation: 你好，外地人，我是哈马尔。我是这个部落的首领。

english: And my name is [player name/Fremennik name], honourable chieftain.
translation: 我的名字是[player name/Fremennik name]，可敬的首领。

english: Ah, an outerlander with manners.
translation: 啊，一个懂礼貌的外地人。

english: So tell me what you want from us.
translation: 那么告诉我，你想从我们这里得到什么。

english: Actually, I'm a Fremennik, not an outerlander.
translation: 其实，我是弗瑞曼尼克人，不是外地人。

english: We are not Fremennik, outerlander.
translation: 我们不是弗瑞曼尼克人，外地人。

english: But you look like Fremennik!
translation: 但你们看起来像弗瑞曼尼克人！

english: And you do not look like a Fremennik, but still claim to be one.
translation: 而你看起来不像弗瑞曼尼克人，却仍声称自己是。

english: But I will not deceive you. We were part of the Fremennik once, but left the village of Rellekka long ago.
translation: 但我不骗你。我们曾经是弗瑞曼尼克人的一部分，但很久以前就离开了雷勒卡城。

english: That's fascinating, but I'm afraid I have other things to do at the moment.
translation: 真有意思，但恐怕我现在有别的事要做。

english: Why is everyone being so hostile to me?
translation: 为什么大家都对我这么有敌意？

english: We are a solitary group, outerlander, and have little experience or interest in outside contact.
translation: 我们是个孤立的群体，外地人，对外界接触没什么经验，也没什么兴趣。

english: It is also our custom not to talk to outerlanders without my sanction. And I see no reason to sanction it for you.
translation: 而且我们的习俗是，没有我的许可，不得与外地人交谈。而我看不出有什么理由为你破例。

english: So what are you lot all doing up here in the mountains?
translation: 那你们这群人在这山上做什么？

english: We left Rellekka because we wanted to live closer to nature. We feel that the people of Rellekka have grown complacent and rely too much on their tools rather than their skill. And while they share our view on the sanctity
translation: 我们离开雷勒卡城，是因为我们想更贴近自然地生活。我们觉得雷勒卡城的人变得自满，过于依赖工具而非自身技艺。虽然他们和我们一样，认为符文石是神圣的，

english: of the runestones, they still employ and actively use magic.
translation: 但他们仍然雇佣并积极使用魔法。

english: Their Seer is an affront to the gods!
translation: 他们的先知是对诸神的侮辱！

english: And you haven't even seen what he did to his house!
translation: 你还没见过他对自己的房子做了什么！

english: Anyway.
translation: 总之。

english: We do not recognise the council of Rellekka and want nothing more to do with them. We live on rock and stone now, pure and hard.
translation: 我们不承认雷勒卡城的议会，也不想再和他们有任何瓜葛。我们现在生活在岩石和石头上，纯粹而坚硬。

english: We move on to another part of the mountain slope when the rough land cannot sustain us anymore.
translation: 当崎岖的土地无法再支撑我们时，我们就转移到山坡的另一部分。

english: That said, we have tarried at this location for too long and should be moving on.
translation: 话说回来，我们在这个地方停留太久了，应该继续前行了。

english: So why are you still here?
translation: 那你们为什么还在这里？

english: For one thing, this side of the mountain is mostly free from the menace of the trolls and the delvings of the deformed dwarves.
translation: 一方面，山的这边基本没有巨魔的威胁，也没有那些畸形的矮人来挖掘。

english: Well, you see...
translation: 呃，你看……

english: My daughter has gone missing. We have been looking for her and cannot go on without her.
translation: 我的女儿失踪了。我们一直在找她，没有她我们无法继续前行。

english: A damsel in distress! I will search for her!
translation: 一位遇难的少女！我要去找她！

english: Haha, you have spirit, [player name/fremennik name].
translation: 哈哈，你很有灵魂，[player name/fremennik name]。

english: But we do not employ outerlanders.
translation: 但我们不雇佣外地人。

english: You don't need to employ me! Just let me look for her.
translation: 你不需要雇佣我！就让我去找她吧。

english: That seems acceptable to me. Very well, I will allow you to look for her.
translation: 这对我来说似乎可以接受。好吧，我允许你去找她。

english: I will instruct my people to let you roam about the area freely, and give limited consent to them to talk to you.
translation: 我会吩咐我的人，让你在这片区域自由走动，并有限度地允许他们和你交谈。

english: Great! I'll be back with her soon. Just wait here.
translation: 太好了！我很快就带她回来。就在这里等着。

english: Oh, I'll be waiting here alright.
translation: 哦，我当然会在这里等着。

english: We do not need your sympathy, outerlander.
translation: 我们不需要你的同情，外地人。

english: Maybe the trolls got her?
translation: 也许是巨魔抓走了她？

english: Do not say such things in jest, outerlander.
translation: 别说这种玩笑话，外地人。

english: Besides, stealth and kidnapping is not their way.
translation: 况且，潜行和绑架不是他们的作风。

english: Forget it then, you can figure it out on your own.
translation: 那算了，你们自己想办法吧。

english: Oh, I'll stop talking to you then.
translation: 哦，那我就不跟你说话了。

english: As you wish, outerlander.
translation: 随你便，外地人。

english: I'm looking for a quest! Do you have any for me?
translation: 我在找一个任务！你有什么任务给我吗？

english: We do not employ outerlanders.
translation: 我们不雇佣外地人。

english: Okay, I know the drill, where do I sign up for the trials to join your tribe?
translation: 好吧，我知道规矩，在哪里报名参加加入你们部落的试炼？

english: And we certainly don't let them join us!
translation: 而且我们当然不会让他们加入我们！

english: Uhm... any idea on where I should start looking for your daughter?
translation: 呃……你知道我该从哪里开始找你的女儿吗？

english: There is a large pool of water beyond the camp. She used to go there often, it was her favourite spot.
translation: 营地那边有一个大水池。她以前常去那里，那是她最喜欢的地方。

english: Ragnar, her fiance, is probably there as well. I will give him my permission to talk to you.
translation: 拉格纳，她的未婚夫，可能也在那里。我会允许他和你说话。

english: What does your daughter look like?
translation: 你女儿长什么样？

english: She is the fairest maiden of all our tribe, and I daresay of all the northern lands. She has flowing black hair, and when last we saw her, she was wearing a brown dress.
translation: 她是我们部落最美丽的少女，我敢说是整个北方最美丽的。她有一头飘逸的黑发，我们最后一次见到她时，她穿着一件棕色连衣裙。

english: Perhaps you should speak to the man she is to marry, tribesman Ragnar. He can probably tell you more.
translation: 也许你应该和她要嫁的那个人谈谈，土著拉格纳。他可能知道得更多。

english: You can find him out by the pool beyond the camp, where my daughter used to go so often.
translation: 你可以在营地那边的水池旁找到他，我女儿以前常去那里。

english: Hello! I'm trying to help your chieftain here.
translation: 你好！我是来帮你们首领的。

english: We don't need any help.
translation: 我们不需要任何帮助。

english: Hello there! Can you help me?
translation: 你好！你能帮我吗？

english: Stay away from me, outerlander.
translation: 离我远点，外地人。

english: I think I need some help.
translation: 我想我需要一些帮助。

english: Well, yes...
translation: 嗯，是啊……

english: Run along then!
translation: 那就快走吧！

english: Hello, I'm-
translation: 你好，我是——

english: Oh no, I wouldn't know that... I've never even seen her!
translation: 哦不，我可不知道那个……我甚至从未见过她！

english: I know!
translation: 我知道！

english: I thought you were here to help us?
translation: 我还以为你是来帮我们的？

english: Go to someone else to cure you from your ignorance, outerlander.
translation: 去找别人治你的无知吧，外地人。

english: You can go there yourself! He's in the big tent over there!
translation: 你自己去那边吧！他在那边的大帐篷里！

english: I'm not allowed to!
translation: 我不被允许去！

english: Talk to our chieftain! He's in that big tent over there!
translation: 去找我们的酋长谈谈！他在那边的大帐篷里！

english: But I-
translation: 但我——

english: Isn't there-
translation: 难道没有——

english: Can you come and help me? The chieftain's daughter-
translation: 你能来帮我吗？首领的女儿——

english: Do you have any idea where the chieftain's daughter is?
translation: 你知道首领的女儿在哪里吗？

english: That's what we would all like to know.
translation: 那是我们都想知道的事。

english: So, you are the outerlander whom Hamal said would look for Asleif.
translation: 那么，你就是哈马尔说的那个会去找阿斯莱芙的外地人。

english: You don't even know her name!
translation: 你连她的名字都不知道！

english: I am sorry outerlander, I have not spoken with your kind for a long time and I'm not feeling so well. You see, I was set to marry Asleif, the most beautiful woman ever to grace this world.
translation: 对不起，外地人，我已经很久没和你们这种人说话了，而且我现在感觉不太好。你看，我本来要娶阿斯莱芙的，她是这个世界上最美丽的女人。

english: Do you have any idea where she might be?
translation: 你知道她可能在哪里吗？

english: She used to come here every day, you know, whenever our camp was set up in the vicinity. She would come to sing, her voice reflecting on the mountains and falling into the pool like sparkling silver. Sometimes I think I can hear her singing, but when I follow the sound around the pool I just end up here again.
translation: 她以前每天都来这里，你知道的，只要我们的营地扎在附近。她会来唱歌，她的歌声在山间回荡，像闪烁的银光一样落入水池。有时我觉得我能听到她在唱歌，但当我循着声音绕着水池走时，最后总是回到这里。

english: So... do you have any idea where she might be now?
translation: 那么……你知道她现在可能在哪里吗？

english: We were supposed to meet here, at the tree by the pool. I think if I wait long enough maybe she will show up again.
translation: 我们本该在这里见面的，在水池边的树下。我想如果我等得够久，也许她会再次出现。

english: But... you don't actually have any idea where she is right at the moment?
translation: 但是……你实际上并不知道她现在在哪里？

english: If I knew I wouldn't be standing here, would I?
translation: 如果我知道，我就不会站在这里了，对吧？

english: What do you mean, my kind?
translation: 你说“你们这种人”是什么意思？

english: You outerlanders with your fancy armour and your runestones and all your convenient little tools.
translation: 你们这些外地人，穿着花哨的盔甲，带着符文石，还有所有那些方便的小工具。

english: Oh, that kind...
translation: 哦，那种人啊……

english: What do you mean, my kind? I'm a Fremennik you know.
translation: 你说“你们这种人”是什么意思？我可是弗瑞曼尼克人。

english: Yet you still use magic, I assume, and have little actual knowledge of the earth and the rock that you stand on every day.
translation: 然而我猜你仍然使用魔法，对你每天脚下踩着的土地和岩石几乎一无所知。

english: Then you are an ignorant, an insult to the gods... and an outerlander.
translation: 那你就是个无知的人，是对诸神的侮辱……而且是个外地人。

english: Okay, okay, you made your point!
translation: 好了好了，你说得对！

english: Er... yes, hello?
translation: 呃……是的，你好？

english: I think I'm going mad, I'm starting to hear things.
translation: 我想我快疯了，我开始听到幻听了。

english: Hello! Who are you? And where for that matter?
translation: 你好！你是谁？还有，你在哪里？

english: Well, I suppose that answered both questions then.
translation: 嗯，我想这回答了这两个问题。

english: Wait, you're Asleif? I think I was looking for you! Where are you hiding?
translation: 等等，你是阿斯莱芙？我想我就是在找你！你躲在哪里？

english: But I thought you said you were Asleif?
translation: 但你刚才不是说你是阿斯莱芙吗？

english: I think I'd better have a lie down, I'm starting to get a little dizzy.
translation: 我想我最好躺下休息一下，我开始有点头晕了。

english: So what exactly do you want from me?
translation: 那么你到底想从我这里得到什么？

english: Er, I don't think they like the idea of me helping them.
translation: 呃，我觉得他们不喜欢我帮忙的想法。

english: All right, that sounds like something I can do.
translation: 好吧，听起来是我能做的事。

english: So let's see, peace with Rellekka, and a new supply of food.'
translation: 那么让我想想，与雷勒卡城和平相处，以及新的食物补给品。

english: I'm sorry, but I'm not really a farmer. You'll have to find someone else.
translation: 对不起，但我真的不是农夫。你得找别人了。

english: I'm sorry, but I'm not really a diplomat. You'll have to find someone else.
translation: 对不起，但我真的不是外交官。你得找别人了。

english: Don't tell me, there's an anthem involved?
translation: 别告诉我，这里面还有一首颂歌？

english: I spoke to Asleif!
translation: 我和阿斯莱芙说过话了！

english: Really? You found her? Where is she, tell me!
translation: 真的吗？你找到她了？她在哪里，快告诉我！

english: Well... there's something you should know.
translation: 嗯……有件事你得知道。

english: Er, she's sort of... well...
translation: 呃，她有点……嗯……

english: She's sort of dead.
translation: 她算是死了。

english: What? Do not say such things! Tell me where you saw her!
translation: 什么？别说这种话！告诉我你在哪儿见到她的！

english: I didn't actually see her, not as such. But I did talk to her, right there, on that island in the center of the pool.
translation: 我其实没有亲眼见到她，不算真正见到。但我确实跟她说过话，就在那儿，水池中央的那个岛上。

english: That island is bare! There's no one there! Do not try to deceive me, outerlander, she is not dead and you did not talk to her!
translation: 那个岛光秃秃的！根本没人！别想骗我，外来者，她没有死，你也没跟她说过话！

english: Fine, don't believe me then.
translation: 好吧，那你就别信我。

english: I have found your daughter!
translation: 我找到你女儿了！

english: Where is she? Tell me, outerlander!
translation: 她在哪儿？告诉我，外来者！

english: Well, er, she is dead.
translation: 呃，她死了。

english: Do not play games with me. I gave you leave to walk about our camp, not to trick us.
translation: 别跟我耍花招。我允许你在我们营地里走动，不是让你来骗我们的。

english: About the people of Rellekka...
translation: 关于雷勒卡城的人……

english: Why do you hate them so much?
translation: 你为什么那么恨他们？

english: We do not hate them, outerlander, but we do not approve of their ways either.
translation: 我们并不恨他们，外来者，但我们也不赞同他们的做法。

english: But don't you basically believe in the same things?
translation: 但你们信仰的东西不是基本一样吗？

english: It is true that our beliefs are not all that different, but we have a different way of applying them, a stricter way.
translation: 确实，我们的信仰相差不大，但我们有不一样的践行方式，一种更严格的方式。

english: So you've never considered, say, making peace with them?
translation: 那么你从没考虑过，比如，跟他们和解？

english: We are not at war with them, outerlander, but we try to ignore each other.
translation: 我们没有跟他们开战，外来者，但我们尽量互不搭理。

english: But I must admit that I have, in fact, sent out a representative to Rellekka to talk about improving relations and perhaps setting up a basic trade route.
translation: 但我必须承认，实际上我已经派了一名代表去雷勒卡城，商讨改善关系，或许还能建立一条基本的贸易路线。

english: Great! Well, that was easy.
translation: 太好了！嘿，这还挺容易的。

english: Unfortunately we have not heard from Svidi, our representative, for a few days.
translation: 不幸的是，我们已经好几天没收到我们的代表斯维迪的消息了。

english: Shall I go looking for him as well then?
translation: 那我也去找他？

english: Do as you wish, outerlander.
translation: 随你便，外来者。

english: You're all such a group of petty bickerers! I've only just gone and made peace between Miscellania and Etceteria!
translation: 你们真是一群斤斤计较的争吵者！我刚去促成了米斯凯尼亚和埃西特利亚岛之间的和平！

english: Miscellania? So that group survived?
translation: 米斯凯尼亚？那伙人还活着？

english: Why, do you know them?
translation: 怎么，你认识他们？

english: Oh yes... that group left the mainland a long time ago. And good riddance to them, I say.
translation: 哦，是啊……那伙人很久以前就离开了大陆。要我说，他们走了倒好。

english: Don't tell me you're fighting them as well.
translation: 别告诉我你们也在跟他们打。

english: Oh, we're not fighting anyone. But we cannot forgive them for their insulting behaviour before they left.
translation: 哦，我们没有跟任何人打仗。但我们无法原谅他们离开前的无礼行为。

english: It is quite inappropriate to pray to the gods when the moon is half full. Yet it is almost as if they wanted to make a point of it, holding parties in honour of gods almost every night.
translation: 在半月时向神明祈祷是非常不合适的。但他们却几乎每晚都举办敬神聚会，仿佛故意要这么做。

english: That, and they like to dress up in fancy clothes a bit too much to our tastes.
translation: 还有，他们喜欢穿太花哨的衣服，不合我们的品味。

english: Go on then, go on, tell me, who else split off from your little group of infighting barbarians?
translation: 接着说，接着说，告诉我，你们这群内斗的蛮子还有谁分裂出去了？

english: How do you mean? There is no one else. Well, there's the Gunnarian people who left this area over a century ago, but they don't really count, do they?
translation: 你什么意思？没有别人了。嗯，有一个多世纪前离开这个地区的冈纳族，但他们不算数，对吧？

english: And I suppose that the people of-
translation: 我想还有……的人——

english: No! Forget it! I didn't really want to hear all that!
translation: 不！算了！我其实不想听这些！

english: From what I understand you're starting to run out?
translation: 据我所知，你们的补给快用完了？

english: Where did you get that idea from, outerlander?
translation: 你从哪儿听说的，外来者？

english: Er, I just happened to overhear it.
translation: 呃，我碰巧听到的。

english: There is some truth to it, yes. If it were not for my missing daughter, we would have moved on already, and finding food would be easier again for a while.
translation: 确实有些道理。要不是我女儿失踪了，我们早就继续前进了，那时找食物也会容易一阵子。

english: Can I help you with finding a new supply of food?
translation: 我能帮你找新的食物补给吗？

english: I would be interested to see how you would manage that, outerlander. But if you insist on trying, go ahead.
translation: 我倒想看看你怎么做到，外来者。不过如果你执意要试试，那就请便吧。

english: Are you, by any chance, Svidi? Sent by Hamal to talk to Brundt and the council of Rellekka?
translation: 你该不会就是斯维迪？哈马尔派你去跟布伦特和雷勒卡城议会谈事的？

english: Maybe... who is asking? You're an outerlander, aren't you?
translation: 也许吧……谁在问？你是个外来者，对吧？

english: Yes, but Hamal asked me to rescue you from a Rellekka prison. What are you doing here?
translation: 是的，但哈马尔让我去雷勒卡城的监狱救你。你在这儿做什么？

english: I haven't actually been in Rellekka yet...
translation: 我其实还没进雷勒卡城……

english: Why, can't you find the way?
translation: 怎么，你找不到路？

english: Well, I'm not actually sure if I should go in there, you see.
translation: 呃，我不太确定我该不该进去，你明白吗？

english: I've always been told that the people of Rellekka are ignorants, almost as bad as other outerlanders. I think they might kill me if I go there.
translation: 我一直听说雷勒卡城的人很无知，跟其他外来者差不多糟糕。我觉得如果我去那儿，他们可能会杀了我。

english: Nonsense. I'm an outerlander and I haven't killed you either!
translation: 胡说。我就是个外来者，我也没杀你啊！

english: Yes, but you're on your own, they have a whole village.
translation: 是啊，但你只有一个人，他们可是一整个村子。
