english: So I don't want to go in there, but I don't want to go back to the camp and tell Hamal that I didn't dare to go to Rellekka either.
translation: 所以我不想进去，但也不想回营地告诉哈马尔我也不敢去雷勒卡城。

english: Aren't you supposed to be a ferocious warrior?
translation: 你不是应该是个凶猛的战士吗？

english: Not all of us are warriors.
translation: 我们并不全是战士。

english: Some of us are schooled in the fine art of diplomacy.
translation: 有些人受过外交艺术的训练。

english: Can't I persuade you to go in there somehow?
translation: 我能不能想办法说服你进去？

english: I won't go in there unless I know it's safe.
translation: 除非我知道那里安全，否则我不会进去。

english: Do you want me to go with you as your bodyguard?
translation: 你要我作为你的保镖和你一起去吗？

english: You? But you're an outerlander! You'd probably lead me to a cave to kill me yourself!
translation: 你？可你是个外来者！你大概会把我引到一个洞穴里亲手杀了我吧！

english: What if I get you some kind of guarantee of safe passage from the village? Will that do?
translation: 如果我从村子里给你弄到某种安全通行的保证呢？这样行吗？

english: Yes, that will do.
translation: 行，那样可以。

english: Weren't you on your way to Rellekka?
translation: 你不是要去雷勒卡城吗？

english: Weren't you on your way to get me a guarantee of safe passage into Rellekka?
translation: 你不是要去给我弄一张安全进入雷勒卡城的保证吗？

english: Oh yes, I almost forgot.
translation: 哦对，我差点忘了。

english: Brundt doesn't want to talk to any representative until your tribe gives back some rock or other.
translation: 布伦特不想跟任何代表谈，除非你们的部落还回某块石头什么的。

english: In that case I'm staying right here. I don't have the authority to trade away our rock.
translation: 那样的话我就待在这儿。我没有权力把我们族的石头交易出去。

english: Besides, it's ours and he can't have it.
translation: 而且，那是我们的，他别想得到。

english: The chieftain from the mountain camp has sent a representative to Rellekka!
translation: 山营地的酋长已经派了一名代表到雷勒卡城！

english: Very unusual, outerlander, but we have not seen him yet.
translation: 很不寻常，外来者，但我们还没见到他。

english: Well, that's the problem, he doesn't dare to come into Rellekka. He's afraid he's going to get hurt.
translation: 问题就在这儿，他不敢进雷勒卡城。他怕自己会受伤。

english: What? He's not much of a warrior, is he?
translation: 什么？他算不上什么战士，对吧？

english: That's what I thought. He says he wants a guarantee of safety.
translation: 我也这么想。他说他想要安全保障。

english: I will meet with this man on one condition, outerlander.
translation: 我可以见这个人，但有一个条件，外来者。

english: When their group split off from Rellekka, they stole one of the ancient relics of the Fremennik. Our ancient rock.
translation: 当年他们那伙人从雷勒卡城分裂出去时，偷了一件弗勒蒙尼克的古代遗物。我们的古代岩石。

english: Ancient rock? What did it do?
translation: 古代岩石？它有什么作用？

english: Do?
translation: 作用？

english: Did it contain vast magical powers?
translation: 它蕴含强大的魔力吗？

english: Did it give the owner unimaginable strength?
translation: 它会给拥有者无法想象的力量吗？

english: Was it the eternal prison of an immortal demon?
translation: 它是一个不朽恶魔的永恒监牢吗？

english: Amusing, [Fremennik name], but as a Fremennik yourself you know better than that.
translation: 有意思，[Fremennik name]，但你身为弗勒蒙尼克人，应该比这更清楚。

english: No, no, no. Little do you understand our ways, outerlander.
translation: 不，不，不。你对我们了解得太少了，外来者。

english: The rock was just that, a rock. It had no special properties and was in essence no different from any other rock.
translation: 那块石头就是块石头。它没有特殊属性，本质上和其他任何石头没有区别。

english: So what did it mean?
translation: 那它有什么意义？

english: It symbolised our refusal to use the runestones for ourselves, instead relying on our own abilities.
translation: 它象征着拒绝为自己使用符文石，而是依靠自身的能力。

english: The people you speak of took the stone with them when they left for the mountains. They claimed their way of living was more pure and closer to nature.
translation: 你说的那些人前往山里时带走了那块石头。他们声称他们的生活方式更纯净、更贴近自然。

english: And is that true?
translation: 那是真的吗？

english: Maybe, but where's the harm in a bit of feasting from time to time?
translation: 也许吧，但偶尔搞点宴会有何不可？

english: In any case, before the council and I meet with anyone from their camp, they will have to give our rock back.
translation: 无论如何，在议会和我见他们营地的任何人之前，他们必须归还我们的石头。

english: Did it look pretty?
translation: 它看起来好看吗？

english: Hmm, not especially I think...
translation: 嗯，我觉得不特别……

english: Why won't you meet with the representative of the mountain camp?
translation: 你为什么不愿见山营地的代表？

english: Like I said, we don't want anything to do with them until they give back our ancient rock.
translation: 就像我说的，除非他们归还我们的古代岩石，否则我们不想跟他们有任何瓜葛。

english: What is it, outerlander?
translation: 什么事，外来者？

english: Chieftain Brundt says that he won't meet with Svidi unless you give him back some rock or other.
translation: 酋长布伦特说，除非你归还某块石头，否则他不会见斯维迪。

english: What, do you mean our ancient rock that our fathers took with them when they left the ignorants of Rellekka?
translation: 什么，你是说我们父辈离开雷勒卡城那些无知者时带走的古代岩石？

english: Yes, that's the one.
translation: 对，就是那块。

english: Out of the question. That rock belongs to us. It symbolises what we stand for. What would Brundt want with it anyway?
translation: 不可能。那块石头属于我们。它象征我们代表的东西。布伦特要它做什么？

english: So I can't persuade you to part with the rock?
translation: 所以我没法说服你交出石头？

english: Did you not hear me the first time, outerlander? It belongs to us, we will not part with it.
translation: 你第一次没听清吗，外来者？它属于我们，我们不会把它交出去。

english: What do you have there, outerlander? It's not our rock, is it?
translation: 你那儿拿着什么，外来者？那不是我们的石头吧？

english: No, of course not! See? It's a completely different rock, it's much smaller.
translation: 不，当然不是！看？这是一块完全不同的石头，小得多。

english: Alright, you be on your way then.
translation: 好吧，那你走吧。

english: I've brought you back your rock!
translation: 我把你的石头带回来了！

english: Really? Let me see!
translation: 真的？让我看看！

english: This rock seems a lot smaller than our bard made it out to be.
translation: 这块石头看起来比我们的吟游诗人说的要小得多。

english: Well, it's not the whole rock, it's part of the rock...
translation: 嗯，这不是整块石头，只是石头的一部分……

english: I split it in two.
translation: 我把它劈成了两半。

english: You truly have the Fremennik spirit in you, [player name]
translation: 你体内真有弗瑞曼尼克族的灵魂，[player name]

english: You are unusually insightful for an outerlander!
translation: 作为一个外来者，你异常有洞察力！

english: Yes, we are satisfied with sharing the rock. I'll meet with this representative and will inform the council to join us here in the longhall.
translation: 是的，我们对共享石头感到满意。我会见这位代表，并通知议会到长厅来加入我们。

english: Although I see that Manni is already here.
translation: 尽管我看到曼尼已经在这里了。

english: Can I have that guarantee of safe passage, then, to give to the representative?
translation: 那么，我能否拿到那份安全通行保证书，交给代表？

english: Oh yes, here it is.
translation: 哦，是的，给你。

english: Brundt gave me the guarantee of safe passage to give to you!
translation: 布伦特把安全通行保证书给了我，让我交给你！

english: Let me see that, I want to be sure it's authentic.
translation: 让我看看，我要确认它是真的。

english: Okay, this looks valid enough. I'll go and talk to Brundt.
translation: 好吧，这看起来足够有效。我去跟布伦特谈谈。

english: I did it, I persuaded Brundt to speak to your representative!
translation: 我做到了，我说服了布伦特跟你们的代表谈话！

english: Indeed, outerlander, and how did you accomplish that without giving him our rock?
translation: 确实，外来者，你是怎么做到不把我们的石头给他就办到的？

english: Well, yeah, I need to talk to you about that...
translation: 嗯，是的，我需要跟你谈谈这件事……

english: Worry not, you made a wise decision and your boldness is impressive.
translation: 别担心，你做了明智的决定，你的胆量令人印象深刻。

english: It does not matter, after all, how large the rock is, or what its shape is. And perhaps the two halves of the rock will have extra symbolism now, representing the two halves of the Fremennik culture.
translation: 毕竟，石头的大小或形状并不重要。也许现在这两半石头会有额外的象征意义，代表着弗瑞曼尼克文化的两半。

english: But first things first. Did Svidi go into Rellekka yet, to speak to Brundt on behalf of our tribe?
translation: 但重要的事先来。斯维迪已经去雷勒卡城代表我们部落跟布伦特谈了吗？

english: Oops, I completely forgot about that. I'd better hurry back to him.
translation: 哎呀，我完全忘了这事。我得赶快回去找他。

english: I understand that Svidi's meeting with Brundt went quite well. I must thank you for your assistance, outerlander.
translation: 我听说斯维迪和布伦特的会面进行得很顺利。我必须感谢你的帮助，外来者。

english: I'm looking for some bushes that carry White Pearl fruit. Do you know where I can find any?
translation: 我在找结白珍珠果实的灌木。你知道哪里能找到吗？

english: Weren't you the one who was supposed to be looking for it for me?
translation: 你不是应该替我去找它的那个人吗？

english: Oh yes, good point.
translation: 哦，是的，说得对。

english: How goes the goat herding?
translation: 放羊怎么样了？

english: It goes, outerlander...
translation: 还行吧，外来者……

english: Times are hard here at the moment. We've been here for too long and there is not much food left, or places where I can take my goats.
translation: 现在这里日子难过。我们在这里待得太久了，食物所剩无几，能带山羊去的地方也没多少了。

english: Well, I'm trying to find a new supply of food for your people. Any ideas on where to start?
translation: 我正在努力为你们的人找新的食物补给。有什么头绪吗？

english: If only it were so easy!
translation: 要是那么容易就好了！

english: That being said...
translation: 话虽如此……

english: I have heard there is a certain kind of fruit... that will grow even here, in the mountains.
translation: 我听说有一种果子……即使在这里，山里也能生长。

english: What's the name of the fruit?
translation: 这果子叫什么名字？

english: It is called White Pearl, named after its white appearance.
translation: 它叫白珍珠，因其白色外表而得名。

english: Any ideas on where to find some?
translation: 知道哪里能找到一些吗？

english: I do not know. I believe it grows mainly in the mountains, and it can grow in even the most difficult circumstances.
translation: 我不知道。我相信它主要生长在山里，即使在最恶劣的环境下也能生长。

english: We cannot move on until we find the chieftain's daughter, and we do not generally move far inland. But perhaps you can search for it.
translation: 在我们找到酋长的女儿之前不能继续前进，而且我们一般不会深入内陆。但也许你可以去找找。

english: I'll see what I can find.
translation: 我会看看能找到什么。

english: Where could I find that fruit again?
translation: 我能在哪里再找到那种果子呢？

english: You mean the White Pearl?
translation: 你是指白珍珠吗？

english: I do not know, outerlander, but you might want to try looking on mountains.
translation: 我不知道，外来者，但你可以试试在山里找找。

english: What about this one?
translation: 这座山呢？

english: No, if it grew on here I would have known.
translation: 不，如果它长在这里我早就知道了。

english: Look, I found the White Pearl fruit!
translation: 看，我找到白珍珠果实了！

english: You seem to be quite resourceful, outerlander. Go and show it to the chieftain.
translation: 你似乎很足智多谋，外来者。去把它拿给酋长看看。

english: Here, I have something that might interest you.
translation: 给你，我有样东西你可能会感兴趣。

english: It's White Pearl fruit, which grows in even the hardiest circumstances. I found this growing on White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 这是白珍珠果实，即使在最严酷的环境下也能生长。我是在白狼山上找到的。

english: And what use is one piece of fruit to us, outerlander? It won't feed our tribe for even a day.
translation: 一个果子对我们有什么用，外来者？它连我们部落一天的口粮都不够。

english: Oops, I hadn't thought of that.
translation: 哎呀，我没考虑到这点。

english: I've found this seed that may be of interest to you.
translation: 我找到了这个种子，你可能会感兴趣。

english: Interesting, what is it?
translation: 有意思，这是什么？

english: It's the seed of the White Pearl fruit. It grows on White Wolf mountain, even in the snow.
translation: 这是白珍珠果实的种子。它长在白狼山上，甚至在雪地里也能生长。

english: With luck, you'll be able to grow it here as well.
translation: 运气好的话，你们也能在这里种它。

english: This is a great gift, [player name/fremennik name], which I humbly accept.
translation: 这是一份大礼，[player name/fremennik name]，我谦卑地收下了。

english: I must thank you for your generous gift, outerlander.
translation: 我必须感谢你的慷慨礼物，外来者。

english: Gift?
translation: 礼物？

english: Yes, the seed of the White Pearl. It grows remarkably well.
translation: 是的，白珍珠的种子。它长得非常好。

english: Ah... well, glad to be of help.
translation: 啊……嗯，很高兴能帮上忙。

english: Hamal, I'm sorry, but your daughter is dead.
translation: 哈马尔，我很抱歉，你的女儿死了。

english: I told you before not to say such things.
translation: 我告诉过你不要说这种话。

english: What proof of it do you have anyway?
translation: 你又能有什么证据呢？

english: Ehm, none really...
translation: 呃，其实没有……

english: Then do not say it again. I appreciate what you've done for us already, but don't try our patience.
translation: 那就不要再说了。我感激你已经为我们做的事，但别考验我们的耐心。

english: Hey, ehm... Asleif spirit thing? Hello?
translation: 嘿，呃……阿斯莱夫灵魂？喂？

english: I did what you asked me to! I improved the relations between Rellekka and the mountain camp, and I found a new supply of food!
translation: 我做了你要求我做的事！我改善了雷勒卡城和山中营地之间的关系，还找到了新的食物补给！

english: So do you have any other quests for me, perhaps with some bigger rewards?
translation: 那你还有别的任务给我吗？也许奖励更丰厚些？

english: How do I do that, exactly? I don't think I'll be able to get him down to this little island.
translation: 具体要怎么做？我觉得我没法把他带到这个小岛上来。

english: Do not attack me, puny mortal [player name/fremennik name]!
translation: 别攻击我，渺小的凡人[player name/fremennik name]！

english: I did not give you permission to touch that, mortal!
translation: 我没允许你碰那个，凡人！

english: Errr... hello?
translation: 呃……喂？

english: Who dares to disturb my slumber?
translation: 谁胆敢打扰我的沉睡？

english: It's just me, [player name/fremennik name], no one special.
translation: 只是我，[player name/fremennik name]，不是什么特别的人。

english: Have you come, then, to pay your respects?
translation: 那么，你是来致敬的吗？

english: How... exactly do I do that?
translation: 具体……要怎么做？

english: With your blood, mortal!
translation: 用你的血，凡人！

english: Time to go, see you later!
translation: 该走了，回头见！

english: Go now, mortal, but I'll be watching you!
translation: 走吧，凡人，但我会盯着你的！

english: You mean a sacrifice? Are you some kind of god?
translation: 你指的是献祭？你是某种神吗？

english: I am the guardian of the mountain, the god of the northern lands. I move the earth and control the skies. I am the Kendal!
translation: 我是山的守护者，北地之神。我移动大地，掌控天空。我是肯达尔！

english: I seek your advice, oh great one.
translation: 我寻求你的建议，哦，伟大的存在。

english: I seek the cowardly murderer of a young lady of a nearby clan of mountain people. Do you know where I can find this person?
translation: 我在寻找一个懦弱的凶手，他杀害了附近山中部落的一位年轻女子。你知道我在哪里能找到这个人吗？

english: I am not here to answer questions of such trivial nature! Go now before doom befalls you, mortal!
translation: 我不是来回答这种琐碎问题的！在厄运降临到你头上之前，现在就走，凡人！

english: You look like you escaped from a fairground!
translation: 你看起来像是从游乐场逃出来的！

english: I would not say such things if I were you, mortal!
translation: 我要是你，就不会说这种话，凡人！

english: You look like a man in a bearsuit!
translation: 你看起来像个穿着熊皮套装的人！

english: What did you say, mortal?
translation: 你说什么，凡人？

english: I said, you look like a man wearing a bearsuit!
translation: 我说，你看起来像个穿着熊皮套装的人！

english: How did you figure that out? How did you know?
translation: 你怎么猜到的？你怎么知道的？

english: I just said you looked like a man wearing a bearsuit, I didn't know you were!
translation: 我只是说你看起来像个穿着熊皮套装的人，我又不知道你真是！

english: So what are you doing here, pretending to be a god?
translation: 那你在这里干什么，假装成神？

english: Ah, the people that live in the mountains here, they are a superstitious lot. They fear few things, but magic and gods they're scared to death of.
translation: 啊，住在这里山里的人，他们很迷信。他们没多少怕的东西，但对魔法和神，他们怕得要死。

english: So I took on the guise of one of their legends. It's a good way of being left alone.
translation: 所以我假装成他们传说中的形象。这是避免被打扰的好方法。

english: And do you leave them alone as well?
translation: 那你也不去打扰他们吗？

english: Ah, you're referring to the skeletons you see here? Yes, I did. Most of the time, at least. When there was no troll to be ambushed, and I had to eat...
translation: 啊，你是指你在这里看到的骷髅？是的，我干的。至少大部分时候是。当没有巨魔可以偷袭的时候，我得吃东西……

english: Did you kill a young lady, by the lake? Just recently?
translation: 你杀了一个年轻女子吗？在湖边？就在最近？

english: Recently? Oh no, the entrance you came through has been blocked off for a good many years now. I've only seen trolls and the occasional stray dwarf since then, until you came along.
translation: 最近？哦不，你进来的入口已经被封了很多年了。从那以后，我只见过巨魔和偶尔走散的矮人，直到你出现。

english: But yes, more than ten years ago, I did kill someone like that.
translation: 但是，是的，十多年前，我的确杀过这样一个人。

english: Oh, never mind then, that can't be the person I'm looking for. I'll be off.
translation: 哦，那算了，不可能是我要找的人。我走了。

english: Can I see that corpse? I'd like to make sure of something.
translation: 我能看看那具尸体吗？我想确认一件事。

english: She is just over there, in the centre, with the dress. I did not eat her after I killed her, she was too beautiful for that.
translation: 她就在那边，中间，穿着裙子。我杀了她之后没有吃掉她，她太美了，下不去口。

english: I felt sorry for killing her, but by then it was already too late.
translation: 杀了她我很后悔，但那时已经太晚了。

english: Yes, she does match the description I was given, it is her after all!
translation: 是的，她确实符合我得到的描述，终究是她！

english: I demand that you hand the body over to me! I must return them to her father!
translation: 我命令你把尸体交给我！我必须把她送回她父亲那里！

english: You demand nothing! You may have uncovered my disguise, but my claws can still tear you apart at will!
translation: 你什么也命令不了！你也许揭穿了我的伪装，但我的爪子依然可以随意撕碎你！

english: I will not allow you to leave!
translation: 我不会让你离开的！

english: I humbly request to be given the remains, so I can return them to her father.
translation: 我谦卑地请求你把遗骸给我，这样我就能把她送回她父亲那里。

english: I cannot do that. If they knew I wasn't a god, and if her father knew I killed his daughter, the whole tribe would come in here at once and I'd be finished.
translation: 我不能那么做。如果他们知道我不是神，如果她父亲知道是我杀了他的女儿，整个部落会立刻冲进来，我就完了。

english: I will kill you myself!
translation: 我要亲手杀了你！

english: Come and try!
translation: 来试试看！

english: I'm afraid I can't allow you to leave either. You cannot tell anyone about me.
translation: 恐怕我也不能让你离开。你不能告诉任何人关于我的事。

english: I think you're completely mad, walking around in your silly bearsuit, killing innocent people!
translation: 我觉得你完全疯了，穿着你那可笑的熊套装走来走去，杀害无辜的人！

english: And how is that very much different from you, walking around in silly suits of armour, killing everything that moves?
translation: 那跟你又有多大区别呢？你穿着可笑的盔甲套装走来走去，杀死一切移动的东西。

english: It's [player name/fremennik name], of whom many legends are sung.
translation: 他是[player name/fremennik name]，有许多传奇赞颂的人物。

english: You are brave, to come into my cave and say a thing like that!
translation: 你很大胆，竟敢进入我的洞穴说出这种话！

english: Slumber? You didn't seem to be sleeping.
translation: 沉睡？你看起来可不像在睡觉。

english: Do not mock me, mortal!
translation: 不要嘲笑我，凡人！

english: Stay away from there!
translation: 离那里远点！

english: I'm afraid I can't let you leave either. You cannot tell anyone about me.
translation: 恐怕我也不能让你离开。你不能告诉任何人关于我的事情。

english: I found the man who murdered Asleif! He was in a cave just by the pool, but I killed him!
translation: 我找到了谋杀阿斯莱芙的人！他就在池塘边的一个洞穴里，但我已经杀了他！

english: Do not say such things, outerlander! She is not dead, merely missing.
translation: 别说这样的话，外地人！她没有死，只是失踪了。

english: She'll show up again... yes, yes, I'm sure of it.
translation: 她会再出现的……没错，没错，我肯定。

english: But she's been missing for more than ten years!
translation: 但她已经失踪超过十年了！

english: Yes, I know... well, that doesn't mean she can't still come back, right?
translation: 是的，我知道……嗯，那不代表她不能再回来，对吧？

english: Er, yeah, right... sure.
translation: 呃，是啊，没错……当然。

english: Look, here, I even have her corpse!
translation: 看，这里，我甚至还有她的尸体！

english: I do not want to see any of the corpses you're carrying around with you! Begone!
translation: 我不想看你随身携带的任何尸体！走开！

english: I found him! I found your murderer! It was some bear-like man who called himself the Kendal.
translation: 我找到他了！我找到了凶手！是一个像熊一样的人，自称肯达尔。

english: Well, it was actually a guy in a bearsuit. But he's dead now.
translation: 嗯，其实是一个穿着熊套装的人。但他现在死了。

english: Do you know there is a strange bear like thing in a cave near the pool?
translation: 你知道池塘附近有一个洞穴，里面有奇怪的像熊的东西吗？

english: Yes, it is the Kendal.
translation: 是的，那是肯达尔。

english: Only the cave is hidden behind some trees, you see-
translation: 只是那个洞穴藏在一些树后面，你看——

english: What, you mean you know that already?
translation: 什么，你是说你早就知道了？

english: Of course. We planted the trees there ourselves many years ago.
translation: 当然。很多年前我们自己在那里种了树。

english: It is unwise to come too close to a god, so we made sure no one would go there anymore.
translation: 靠得太近一位神是不明智的，所以我们确保没人会再去那里。

english: But but but...
translation: 但但但……

english: He's not a god! He's a man in a bearsuit! And he killed your daughter!
translation: 他不是神！他是个穿着熊套装的人！而且他杀了你的女儿！

english: And why didn't you tell me she's been missing for more than ten years?
translation: 还有，你为什么不告诉我她已经失踪超过十年了？

english: Fourteen years, to be exact. And I didn't say otherwise, did I? As for the Kendal, what proof have you of these serious accusations?
translation: 准确说是十四年。我也没说不是，对吧？至于肯达尔，这些严重的指控你有什么证据？

english: You want proof for everything, don't you? Why don't you just go and have a look?
translation: 你什么事都要证据，是吧？你为什么不自己去看看？

english: Like I said, it is not wise to approach a god so closely.
translation: 就像我说的，靠得太近一位神是不明智的。

english: Well... I've only gone and killed him, haven't I?
translation: 嗯……我刚好已经去杀了他，不是吗？

english: Well... I've only gone and killed him, haven't I? Look, I'm even wearing his silly hat!
translation: 嗯……我刚好已经去杀了他，不是吗？看，我甚至戴着他那愚蠢的帽子！

english: You have? Then we made an enormous mistake.
translation: 你杀了他？那我们犯了一个巨大的错误。

english: As did he. Impersonating a god bears the highest penalty imaginable, but I did not think that kind of justice would be delivered by the hand of an outerlander.
translation: 他也是如此。冒充神明会承受最高刑罚，但我没想到那种正义会由一个外来者之手执行。

english: I also found your daughter. The bearman killed her.
translation: 我还找到了你的女儿。那个熊人杀了她。

english: So it is true then, after all? Let me see her body please.
translation: 所以终究还是真的？请让我看看她的尸体。

english: I didn't bring it with me, I'll go and look for it.
translation: 我没带在身上，我去找找。

english: Yes, I see it is her. So it is also true that you spoke to her spirit at the pool?
translation: 是的，我认出是她。所以你在池塘边和她的灵魂说过话也是真的？

english: Yes, it's true.
translation: 是的，是真的。

english: Then she must be buried there, on the island at the center of the pool... to bring peace to her spirit. This is a most unusual situation, but will you bury her, [player name/fremennik name]?
translation: 那她必须被埋葬在那里，池塘中央的小岛上……这样她的灵魂才能安息。这是一个非常不寻常的情况，但你愿意埋葬她吗，[player name/fremennik name]？

english: Then please listen closely. If she is given a proper burial, she is to be buried with some of her possessions. I see she's still wearing her dress, so you will need one more item.
translation: 那么请仔细听。如果她要得到妥善的安葬，她必须和一些遗物一起下葬。我看到她还穿着她的裙子，所以你还需要一件物品。

english: When she has been buried, you must build a cairn on top. It is our tradition to build these cairns in the shape of our longboats that we use when we need to cross the seas. You can use rocks for this purpose, about five or so should be enough.
translation: 她下葬后，你必须在上面堆一个石冢。我们的传统是把石冢堆成我们渡海时用的长船的形状。你可以用石头来做，大约五六块应该就够了。

english: Only then are the burial rites complete.
translation: 只有那样，葬礼才算完成。

english: So I need to bury her with one of her possessions, and build a cairn on top made out of rocks. So where do I get another one of her possessions?
translation: 所以我需要用她的一件遗物陪葬，然后在上面用石头堆一个石冢。那我到哪里去弄另一件她的遗物？

english: Asleif had little possessions in life and none that have survived the years. I do not know where you might find such a thing, but perhaps Ragnar does, out by the pool.
translation: 阿斯莱芙生前拥有很少的东西，而且没有一件能留存这么多年。我不知道你到哪里能找到这样的东西，但也许拉格纳知道，他就在池塘边。

english: I won't.
translation: 我不会的。

english: I... ehm...
I killed the bearman! He really was just a man after all, like I said!
translation: 我杀了那个熊人！他其实真的只是个普通人，就像我说的！

english: I need some help with killing this bear thing in the cave. Do you have any warriors to come with me?
translation: 我需要一些帮助来杀死洞穴里那个熊一样的东西。你有战士能和我一起去吗？

english: If you wish to confront the god it is your own affair, outerlander, but we will not be any part of it.
translation: 如果你想去挑战那位神，那是你自己的事，外地人，但我们不会参与其中。

english: I heard the news from Hamal, outerlander. Alas, I have known this had to be so for a long time, but Hamal just didn't want to listen.
translation: 我从哈马尔那里听说了消息，外地人。唉，我早就知道事情必然如此，但哈马尔就是不愿意听。

english: Well, Hamal asked me to bury her with some of her possessions. But he doesn't have any anymore.
translation: 嗯，哈马尔让我用她的一些遗物陪葬。但他已经没有遗物了。

english: Do you have anything that may help?
translation: 你有什么能帮忙的吗？

english: I'm not altogether sure... I do have one thing that may be appropriate.
translation: 我不太确定……我确实有一件可能合适的东西。

english: I was going to give her a necklace, when we were supposed to meet here many years ago.
translation: 很多年前我们本应在这里见面的时候，我本来打算送她一条项链。

english: I still have it, and since it was a gift for Asleif, technically it's hers.
translation: 我还留着它，而且既然它是给阿斯莱芙的礼物，严格来说它就是她的东西。

english: Take it, outerlander, and bury it with her. It will be my parting gift.
translation: 拿着吧，外地人，把它和她一起埋葬。这将是我告别的礼物。

english: You've been waiting to give it to her all that time?
translation: 那么长时间以来你一直等着送给她？

english: Oh yes... she is my only love, you see, and will be so forever.
translation: 哦，是的……她是我唯一的爱，你知道的，而且永远都是。

english: But that's ridiculous! Don't you ever go out and have some fun? What is wrong with you people!
translation: 但那也太荒唐了！你就不出去找点乐子吗？你们这些人是怎么回事！

english: I do not expect you to understand such things. But perhaps you will find your own love one day, and then you will remember these words.
translation: 我不指望你能理解这种事。但也许有一天你会找到自己的真爱，那时你就会想起这些话。

english: She used to come here every day, you know, whenever our camp was set up in the vicinity.
translation: 你知道吗，她以前每天都来这里，只要我们的营地扎在附近。

english: I am sorry, outerlander, I have not spoken with your kind for a long time and I'm not feeling so well.
translation: 抱歉，外乡人，我已经很久没跟你们这种人说过话了，而且我现在感觉不太好。

english: She would come to sing here, her voice reflecting on the mountains and falling into the pool like sparkling silver.
translation: 她会来这里唱歌，歌声在山间回荡，像闪亮的银币一样落入水池。

english: You see, I was set to marry Asleif, the most beautiful woman ever to grace this world.
translation: 你知道吗，我本来要和阿斯莱芙结婚，她是世上最美丽的女人。

english: Once you can carry it, outerlander, I will give it to you.
translation: 等你拿得动的时候，外乡人，我就把它给你。

english: And you can't carry anything else either. You are too clumsy, outerlander.
translation: 而且你也不能再拿任何别的东西了。你太笨手笨脚了，外乡人。

english: Sometimes I think I can still hear her singing, but when I follow the sound around the pool I just end up here again.
translation: 有时候我觉得自己还能听到她的歌声，但当我循着声音绕过水池，最后又回到了这里。

english: How lucky, then, that I had a spare one for her in case I lost one of them myself.
translation: 真幸运，我还给她留了一把备用的，以防我自己丢了一把。

english: Is it done yet, the burial?
translation: 葬礼办完了吗？

english: Try not to lose it again now, outerlander.
translation: 这次别再弄丢了，外乡人。

english: No, outerlander. Now go away.
translation: 不，外乡人。现在走开。

english: Have you completed the burial yet?
translation: 你完成葬礼了吗？

english: I've already got a marriage lined up, thanks.
translation: 我已经安排了一门亲事，谢谢。

english: Uhm... Asleif? Hello?
translation: 呃……阿斯莱芙？你好？

english: I convinced your father about your death. He asked me to give you a proper burial, here on this island.
translation: 我说服了你父亲关于你的死讯。他让我给你一个体面的葬礼，就在这个岛上。

english: Well, it's kind of awkward... can you maybe be silent while I bury you?
translation: 嗯，有点尴尬……你能不能在我埋葬你的时候保持安静？

english: Oh, right. Well, I'd better get on with it then.
translation: 哦，好吧。那我最好开始行动了。

english: Hello? Are you there?
translation: 你好？你在吗？

english: Burying her must have really helped! I should get on with building the cairn on top.
translation: 埋葬她一定真的帮了大忙！我应该在上面继续堆石冢了。

english: You are a most unusual outerlander. The council of Rellekka was wise to make you an honourary Fremennik.
translation: 你是一个非常不寻常的外地人。雷勒卡城的议会让你成为荣誉弗莱门尼克人是明智的。

english: You are a most unusual outerlander. Perhaps you should seek to become an honourary Fremennik, in Rellekka.
translation: 你是一个非常不寻常的外地人。也许你应该争取在雷勒卡城成为一名荣誉弗莱门尼克人。

english: You are a most unusual outerlander. I'm sure that you will be able to complete your Fremennik trials some time.
translation: 你是一个非常不寻常的外地人。我相信你有朝一日一定能完成你的弗莱门尼克试炼。

english: You have my thanks, in any case.
translation: 无论如何，还是要谢谢你。

english: Yes, I see it is her.
translation: 是的，我看出来了，就是她。

english: Then she must be buried there, on the island at the center of the pool... to bring peace to her spirit.
translation: 那么她必须被埋葬在那里，在水池中央的小岛上……好让她的灵魂得到安宁。

english: When she has been buried, you must build a cairn on top. It is our tradition to build these cairns in the shape of our longboats that we use when we need to cross the seas. You can use rocks for this purpose, about five or
translation: 等她下葬后，你必须在上面建一个石冢。我们的传统是建造形状像我们渡海用的长船的石冢。你可以用石头来做这件事，大约五块或

english: So it is also true that you spoke to her spirit at the pool?
translation: 这么说你也确实在池边和她的灵魂交谈过？

english: I would not be surprised if those ignorants in Rellekka are holding him captive.
translation: 如果雷勒卡城的那些无知之徒把他关起来了，我一点也不意外。

english: so should be enough.
translation: 这样就应该够了。

english: My daughter was always asking me to do that, and now that she is not here right now, I thought perhaps it was the right thing to do.
translation: 我女儿一直让我这么做，现在她不在了，我想也许这是正确的事。

english: This is a great gift, [player name], which I humbly accept.
translation: 这是一份厚礼，[player name]，我谦卑地接受了。

english: Haha, you have spirit, [player name].
translation: 哈哈，你有志气，[player name]。

english: This is a most unusual situation, but will you bury her, [player name]?
translation: 这种情况极其不寻常，但[player name]，你愿意埋葬她吗？

english: Yes? Did you free Svidi from them?
translation: 是吗？你把斯维迪从他们手中救出来了？

english: It seems the most likely explanation for Svidi's absence, but I cannot say for certain.
translation: 这似乎是斯维迪失踪最可能的解释，但我不能肯定。

english: Greetings once again, honourable [player name].
translation: 再次向你致意，尊敬的[player name]。

english: What's taking him so long to get there then?
translation: 那他怎么花了这么长时间才到那里？

english: What? I did not know he was such a coward! I should have sent a warrior instead.
translation: 什么？我不知道他居然这么胆小！我本该派一个战士去的。

english: You appear to be wearing one on your head...
translation: 你头上好像就戴着一条……

english: He'd better not come back before speaking to the chieftain of Rellekka.
translation: 他最好在和雷勒卡城的酋长谈完之前别回来。

english: You must bury her with some of her possessions, like the dress she's wearing and one other item.
translation: 你必须用她的一些物品陪葬，比如她穿的那条裙子和另一件物品。

english: Many spirits are connected with the earth or the water. There is the Draugen, for instance, a malovelent spirit.
translation: 许多灵魂都与土地或水相连。例如，德拉根就是一个邪恶的灵魂。

english: Then, on top of the burial mound, you must build a cairn out of rocks, in the rough shape of a longboat. Five rocks should be enough for this purpose.
translation: 然后，在墓冢顶部，你必须用石头建一个石冢，大致呈长船的形状。五块石头应该就够了。

english: You must bury her with some of her possessions, like the dress she's wearing and the necklace you hold.
translation: 你必须用她的一些物品陪葬，比如她穿的那条裙子和你拿着的项链。

english: If you wish to confront a god it is your own affair, outerlander, but we will not be any part of it.
translation: 如果你想和神明对抗，那是你的事，外地人，但我们不会参与其中。

english: When you can carry it, come back and I will give it to you.
translation: 等你能拿得动的时候，回来我就给你。

english: [player name], you have spirit, Thorkir.
translation: [player name]，你有志气，托尔基尔。

english: Ah [player name], glad to see you made it. Welcome to Lletya, home to the Elven Resistance.
translation: 啊，[player name]，很高兴看到你成功抵达。欢迎来到莱蒂亚村，这里是精灵抵抗组织的大本营。

english: Thank you. It wasn't particularly easy to get here, it took some work to convince Islwyn I could be trusted.
translation: 谢谢你。到这里并不容易，我费了番功夫才说服伊斯尔温相信我。

english: That's not surprising, he is not particularly fond of humans. But if you've earnt his trust, it proves to me that I was right to take a chance on you.
translation: 这不奇怪，他不太喜欢人类。但既然你赢得了他的信任，证明我冒险选择你是正确的。

english: I'm glad you did. I hate the thought that I might still be blindly working for King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth right now.
translation: 我很高兴你这么做。一想到我现在可能还在盲目地为拉萨斯国王和伊尔沃斯领主工作，我就讨厌。

english: Well you're here now and you still have a chance to right your previous wrongs.
translation: 好在你现在在这里，还有机会纠正你之前的错误。

english: I hope so. There's a lot I still don't understand though. Why are King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth working together? Where does the plague fit in?
translation: 希望如此。但我还有很多不明白的地方。为什么拉萨斯国王和伊尔沃斯领主会合作？瘟疫又在其中扮演什么角色？

english: I'm afraid that a lot is still unknown to us as well. However, I will explain what I can. Be aware that this is only a brief overview. You'll find some books around the village that explain more if you wish though.
translation: 恐怕我们也有很多不清楚的地方。不过，我会尽力解释我知道的部分。注意，这只是大致介绍。如果你想了解更多，村里有一些书可以看。

english: Okay, let's begin.
translation: 好的，我们开始吧。

english: Many years ago, all elves lived in harmony within the crystal city of Prifddinas alongside our goddess, Seren. When the God Wars ended, Seren was lost to us. For the first time, we were alone. To lead us through those difficult times, Baxtorian Cadarn was named the first king of the elves. Under Baxtorian, our kingdom expanded into the east. We prospered for a time, but little did we know that an enemy walked among us. During that time, Lord Iorwerth turned away from Seren and pledged himself to Zamorak, the Dark Lord. A larger kingdom meant our forces were further spread. Lord Iorwerth took advantage of that. He claimed Prifddinas as his own. Baxtorian tried to take it back from him, but Prifddinas was built to survive the God Wars. There was no way to retake it. In a last attempt to keep the city safe, Baxtorian and the clan elders sung the song of inversion which reverted the entire city into a crystal seed.
translation: 很多年前，所有精灵都与我们的女神塞伦和谐地生活在普里夫迪纳斯城的水晶城市中。神战结束后，塞伦离我们而去。我们第一次感到了孤独。为了带领我们度过那段艰难时期，巴克斯托里安.卡达恩被任命为第一位精灵国王。在巴克斯托里安的领导下，我们的王国向东扩张。我们一度繁荣，但我们浑然不知敌人已悄然混入我们之中。在此期间，伊尔沃斯领主背离了塞伦，效忠于黑暗领主扎莫拉克。更大的王国意味着我们的兵力更加分散。伊尔沃斯领主利用了这一点。他占领了普里夫迪纳斯城作为己有。巴克斯托里安试图从他手中夺回，但普里夫迪纳斯城是为了抵御神战而建造的，根本无法重新夺取。为了最后一次保全城市，巴克斯托里安和部族长老唱响了反转之歌，将整座城市变回了一颗水晶种子。

english: Ah, so that explains why the city just looks like an empty field.
translation: 啊，这就解释了为什么那座城市看起来只是一片空地。

english: Indeed. After that, Baxtorian returned to the east but found that the rest of the kingdom had fallen while he was away. Not only that, but his wife, Glarial, had been taken.
translation: 确实如此。之后，巴克斯托里安回到了东部，却发现他不在时王国其余部分已经沦陷。不仅如此，他的妻子格拉莉尔也被抓走了。

english: I know this bit, Baxtorian retreated into his home beneath the waterfall and never came out. I moved Glarial's remains into the waterfall so they could be together.
translation: 这部分我知道，巴克斯托里安退入了瀑布下的家中，再也没有出来。我把格拉莉尔的遗骸移到了瀑布里，这样他们就能在一起了。

english: That's good to hear, I can see why you managed to earn Islwyn's trust. Anyway, with Baxtorian gone and Prifddinas lost, our land erupted into a Civil War. We've been fighting ever since.
translation: 很高兴听到这个，我明白你为什么能赢得伊斯尔温的信任了。总之，巴克斯托里安离去，普里夫迪纳斯城失守，我们的土地陷入了一场内战。我们一直在战斗。

english: I see, it's good to have a bit more understanding. But where does King Lathas come into this?
translation: 我明白了，多了解一些是好的。但拉萨斯国王是怎么牵扯进来的？

english: That is the bit we're not so sure on. We know little about the lands to the east. From what we can tell, it seems that Lord Iorwerth has promised to support King Lathas in reclaiming some land his family once owned.
translation: 这部分我们也说不准。我们对东方的土地知之甚少。据我们所知，似乎是伊尔沃斯领主承诺支持拉萨斯国王收复他家族曾经拥有的土地。

english: But why? What's in it for Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 但是为什么？伊尔沃斯领主能得到什么好处？

english: That's what we want you to find out. According to our spies, Lord Iorwerth has used the alliance with King Lathas as an opportunity to infiltrate West Ardougne. The city must contain something he needs.
translation: 这就是我们希望你查明的。根据我们的间谍情报，伊尔沃斯领主利用与拉萨斯国王的联盟作为渗透西阿多尼城的机会。那座城市里一定藏着他需要的东西。

english: Infiltrate? How?
translation: 渗透？怎么渗透？

english: Those that you know as mourners are in fact elves in service to Lord Iorwerth. We regularly see them crossing the Arandar mountain pass and into the east.
translation: 你所知道的那些哀悼者实际上是效忠于伊尔沃斯领主的精灵。我们经常看到他们穿过阿兰达尔山口前往东方。

english: Mourners are elves?
translation: 哀悼者是精灵？

english: That they are. We assume that the plague is a cover up for them to enter the city unchallenged. We don't know why though. That's why we need you. You know the city and can freely travel there. You are the perfect person for this task. We need you to go to West Ardougne, infiltrate the mourners and find out what they are doing in the city.
translation: 正是如此。我们推测瘟疫是他们为了畅通无阻地进入城市而设置的掩护。但我们不知道原因。这就是为什么我们需要你。你了解那座城市，可以自由前往。你是这项任务的完美人选。我们需要你去西阿多尼城，潜入哀悼者内部，查明他们在城市里做什么。

english: Let's skip the backstory.
translation: 跳过背景故事吧。

english: I'd argue that understanding is essential to what comes next. But as you wish.
translation: 我倒是认为理解背景对接下来要做的事至关重要。但随你便吧。

english: The bit that is relevant to you is the recent alliance between King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 与你相关的是最近拉萨斯国王和伊尔沃斯领主之间的联盟。

english: From what we can tell, it seems that Lord Iorwerth has promised to support King Lathas in reclaiming some land his family once owned.
translation: 据我们所知，似乎是伊尔沃斯领主承诺支持拉萨斯国王收复他家族曾经拥有的土地。

english: That they are. We assume that the plague is a cover up for them to enter the city unchallenged. We don't know why though. That's why we need you.
translation: 正是如此。我们推测瘟疫是他们为了畅通无阻地进入城市而设置的掩护。但我们不知道原因。这就是为什么我们需要你。

english: You know the city and can freely travel there. You are the perfect person for this task. We need you to go to West Ardougne, infiltrate the mourners and find out what they are doing in the city.
translation: 你了解那座城市，可以自由前往。你是这项任务的完美人选。我们需要你去西阿多尼城，潜入哀悼者内部，查明他们在城市里做什么。

english: So you want me to infiltrate the mourners? How am I supposed to achieve that?
translation: 所以你想让我潜入哀悼者？我该怎么做？

english: I don't have an exact plan for you I'm afraid. You know the city better than any of us so are best placed to make a plan yourself. However as I said before, there have been sightings of mourners crossing the Arandar mountain pass. I'm sure you can take advantage of that.
translation: 恐怕我没有确切的计划给你。你比我们任何人都更了解这座城市，所以最适合自己制定计划。不过正如我之前所说，有人目击哀悼者穿越阿兰达尔山口。我相信你可以利用这一点。

english: Alright, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。

english: This will cut down you to size!
translation: 这下该让你老实了！

english: I killed one of those mourners crossing the mountain pass and took their clothes.
translation: 我杀死了一个穿越山口的哀悼者，拿走了他们的衣服。

english: Ah, a disguise. Good thinking.
translation: 啊，伪装。好主意。

english: I do have a bit of an issue though. The top has blood on it and the trousers are ripped.
translation: 不过我有个小问题。上衣上有血迹，裤子也破了。

english: Hmm... Well you can try asking our local seamstress, Oronwen, about the trousers. As for the top, you'll need to find a way to get it cleaned. Maybe you can find someone who does a lot of laundry. Someone who wears lots of white might be a good bet.
translation: 嗯……你可以试着找我们的本地裁缝奥罗文处理裤子。至于上衣，你需要想办法清洗。也许你能找到一个经常洗衣服的人。穿很多白色衣服的人可能是个不错的人选。

english: Okay, thanks for the help.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。

english: Do you know any way to remove blood stains?
translation: 你知道去除血迹的方法吗？

english: Blood stains is it... Well, the soap I use can clean almost any stain.
translation: 血迹是吧……嗯，我用的肥皂几乎能洗掉任何污渍。

english: Really?!? That sounds like just the thing I need, can I use some?
translation: 真的吗？！？听起来正是我需要的东西，我能用一些吗？

english: No, I don't have very much soap left and I still have lots to get clean.
translation: 不行，我剩下的肥皂不多了，还有很多东西要洗。

english: Alright can you tell me where I can buy some?
translation: 好吧，你能告诉我哪里能买到吗？

english: You can't... I make it to my own secret recipe.
translation: 你不能……我自己做的秘密食谱。

english: Could you be less helpful?
translation: 你能再没用一点吗？

english: Like you were, taking those robes from my washing line?? So yes, if you know a way I can be less helpful just tell me. I'll try it.
translation: 就像你一样，从我的晾衣绳上拿走那些袍子？所以没错，如果你知道怎么让我更没用，尽管告诉我。我会试试看的。

english: Do you mend clothes?
translation: 你修补衣服吗？

english: I do, but human clothes are too hard to mend. They do not have the finesse of elven garments.
translation: 我确实会，但人类的衣服太难修补了。他们没有精灵服装的那种精细做工。

english: I need you to repair some elven clothing as it goes.
translation: 我需要你帮忙修补一些精灵衣服。

english: Let me take a look at it then.
translation: 那让我看看吧。

english: There's something disturbingly familiar about the design of these trousers, they are made for an elf.
translation: 这条裤子的设计有种令人不安的熟悉感，这是为精灵制作的。

english: But can you fix them?
translation: 但你能修好吗？

english: Of course I can, but I will need two pieces of silk and some bear fur.
translation: 当然可以，但我需要两块丝绸和一些熊皮。

english: Great, I have those here.
translation: 太好了，我这就带着。

english: Huh, it's almost like you knew what I needed.
translation: 呵，就好像你知道我需要什么似的。

english: What do you need to mend my trousers?
translation: 修补我的裤子需要什么？

english: I need bear fur and two pieces of silk.
translation: 我需要熊皮和两块丝绸。

english: I have all I need to mend my trousers.
translation: 我有修补裤子所需要的所有材料了。

english: Pass it all here then, and I will get started.
translation: 那都递给我吧，我这就开始修理。

english: I need bear fur and one piece of silk.
translation: 我需要熊皮和一块丝绸。

english: I only need bear fur now.
translation: 我现在只需要熊皮。

english: I need two pieces of silk.
translation: 我需要两块丝绸。

english: I only need one piece of silk.
translation: 我只需要一块丝绸。

english: Ah, a disguise. Good thinking. Use it to enter the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne. Once yourin, see if you can find out what they are doing in the city.
translation: 啊，伪装。好主意。用它进入西阿多尼的哀悼者总部。一旦进去，看看你能不能查明他们在城里做什么。

english: It is good to see so many new recruits, soon no one will be able to stand against the power of the Death Guard.
translation: 很高兴看到这么多新成员，很快就没有人能抵挡死亡守卫的力量了。

english: That sounds... err great.
translation: 听起来……呃，很棒。

english: Indeed it is. You should speak with Essyllt downstairs. He's in charge.
translation: 确实如此。你应该和楼下的埃西尔特谈谈。他负责这里。

english: Good day. Are you in need of assistance?
translation: 你好。需要帮忙吗？

english: Are the townspeople causing you trouble?
translation: 是不是镇上的人在找你麻烦？

english: Yes, but I don't think you can help
translation: 是的，但我觉得你帮不上忙

english: You will be surprised at how much help the brute force of the Guard can be.
translation: 守卫的蛮力能帮上多少忙会让你大吃一惊。

english: Well I'll be sure to ask if I'm in need of some muscle.
translation: 那么，当需要些武力时，我一定会来问的。

english: No, I just wanted to talk to a friendly face.
translation: 不，我只是想和友善的人聊聊天。

english: Do I look friendly to you? I really must work on my scowl more.
translation: 我看起来友善吗？看来我得好好练习一下我的怒容。

english: Hello, I'm...
translation: 你好，我是……

english: Ah... I take it you are one of the new recruits?
translation: 啊……我猜你是新成员之一？

english: Well, I'm...
translation: 嗯，我是……

english: I'm Essyllt and I'm in charge here. Now come on, let us have a look at your paper work.
translation: 我是埃西尔特，这里由我负责。来吧，让我看看你的文书。

english: This seems to be all in order. Welcome to the Death Guard. Now, for your first assignment... As you may know, part of what we do here is keep the people believing in the plague...
translation: 看起来都没问题。欢迎加入死亡守卫。现在，给你第一个任务……你可能知道，我们在这里的一部分工作就是让民众相信瘟疫的存在……

english: Did they not tell you? Hmm... I'd better fill you in. Well as you undoubtedly know, we were sent here by Lord Iorwerth to secure the city. The reason for this is so that we can access the caves below...
translation: 他们没有告诉你吗？嗯……我还是给你说明一下吧。正如你无疑已经知道的，我们是受伊尔沃斯领主派遣来控制这座城市的。原因是我们能够进入地下的洞穴……

english: What's important about the caves?
translation: 这些洞穴有什么重要的？

english: I'm afraid that information is classified until you prove your commitment to the Death Guard.
translation: 恐怕在你证明对死亡守卫的忠诚之前，这些信息是保密的。

english: Now to keep our presence in the city secret, Lord Iorwerth arranged an alliance with King Lathas, the ruler in the east. Apparently the fool thinks we will help him dispose of the Knights of Camelot once our work here is done. I expect he'll be disappointed. Anyway, the plague serves two purposes. First, it allows us to move around the city in secret thanks to our mourner disguises. Second, it means we can abduct citizens to mine the caves below with ease. We just pretend they've fallen victim to the plague.
translation: 为了隐藏我们在城市中的存在，伊尔沃斯领主与东方的统治者拉萨斯国王结盟。显然这个傻瓜以为我们在这里的工作完成后会帮他除掉卡美洛骑士。我估计他会失望的。总之，瘟疫有两个目的。第一，凭借我们哀悼者的伪装，我们可以秘密在城市中活动。第二，我们可以轻易地绑架市民来开采地下洞穴，只需假装他们成了瘟疫的受害者。

english: Doesn't anyone suspect the truth?
translation: 难道没有人怀疑真相吗？

english: Well we have had a few near misses. Recently we had some girl from East Ardougne poking around asking too many questions, so we locked her up while we decided what to do with her. Annoyingly, she managed to escape with the help of some adventurer. Lucky for us, they were so stupid that we managed to use the adventurer to deal with King Tyras. It all worked out quite well in the end. Things like that is why we must ensure the people keep believing in the plague though. One of the things we do to keep up the lie is to fool old Farmer Brumty into believing his sheep are infected. The old halfwit thinks just because his sheep are an abnormal colour, that they are all ill with plague. It's amazing what a bit of dye can do.
translation: 嗯，我们差一点就暴露了几次。最近有个从东阿多尼城来的女孩四处打听，问太多问题，所以我们把她关了起来，同时决定怎么处置她。烦人的是，她在一个冒险者的帮助下逃走了。幸运的是，他们太蠢了，我们利用那个冒险者干掉了泰拉斯国王。最后结果还不错。正因为这种种原因，我们必须确保民众继续相信瘟疫。我们维持谎言的手段之一就是愚弄老农夫布鲁姆蒂，让他相信自己的羊被感染了。那个老笨蛋仅仅因为他的羊颜色不正常就以为它们都得了瘟疫。一点染料就能起到奇妙的效果。

english: You dyed them?
translation: 你给它们染了色？

english: Well you don't think they end up those ridiculous colours naturally do you? Anyway, shame of it is that we have yet to find a way to stop the dye from washing out. So we need someone, that someone being you, to go and re-dye them.
translation: 你不会真以为它们天生就是那些可笑的颜色吧？总之，遗憾的是我们还没找到防止染料褪色的方法。所以我们需要一个人，就是你，去重新给它们染色。

english: Simple enough, you want me to give a blue rinse to a load of old sheep?
translation: 够简单的，你想让我给一群老绵羊染个蓝色？

english: Not quite, for starters the sheep need to be dyed red, yellow, green and blue. But most important is that you are not seen doing this by anyone. Also you will need to re-dye them the colours they already are or the farmer may notice the change.
translation: 不完全是，首先羊需要染成红色、黄色、绿色和蓝色。但最重要的是你做的过程中不能被任何人看到。而且你需要按照它们原有的颜色重新染色，否则农夫可能会注意到变化。

english: That sounds a little more tricky. How did you do it before?
translation: 听起来有点棘手。你们以前是怎么做的？

english: We have a gnomic device that fires fat dye parcels that rupture on impact. Unfortunately, we have run out of the parcels and the device is broken.
translation: 我们有一个地精装置，可以发射会在撞击时破裂的染料包。不幸的是，染料包用完了，装置也坏了。

english: Can I take a look at it?
translation: 我能看看吗？

english: Sure. We have a gnome inventor here too. Sadly, he is not being very helpful about fixing it, but you can talk to him if you like. Here is the key, he is in the next room. And here's the device as well.
translation: 当然可以。我们这里还有一个地精发明家。可惜他对修理装置不太热心，不过如果你想的话可以跟他谈谈。这是钥匙，他在隔壁房间。装置也给你。

english: Have you finished with those sheep yet?
translation: 那些羊处理好了吗？

english: No, I'm sorry I lost the gnomic device and the key.
translation: 没有，抱歉我把地精装置和钥匙弄丢了。

english: Well it is lucky we have a whole stack of broken devices, there must be some flaw in the design, they always break in the same way. If you ever need another there is a chest full of them over there.
translation: 嗯，幸好我们有一堆坏掉的装置，设计上肯定有缺陷，它们总是在同一个地方坏掉。如果你还需要一个，那边有个箱子装满了。

english: I also keep copies of the key on my desk so I can replace that too.
translation: 我还在书桌上放了钥匙的副本，这样我也可以换那个。

english: Not yet, I lost the gnomic device.
translation: 还没有，我把地精装置弄丢了。

english: Well it is lucky we have a whole stack of broken ones, there must be some flaw in the design, they always break in the same way. If you ever need another there is a chest full of them over there.
translation: 嗯，幸好我们有一堆坏掉的，设计上肯定有缺陷，它们总是在同一个地方坏掉。如果你还需要一个，那边有个箱子装满了。

english: I'm sorry but I lost the key.
translation: 抱歉，我把钥匙弄丢了。

english: I keep copies of the key on my desk so I can replace that.
translation: 我在书桌上放了钥匙的副本，这样我可以换那个。

english: Hello, will you help me fix this... err... thing?
translation: 你好，你能帮我修好这个……呃……东西吗？

english: I'm not helping you fix that, as if it hasn't caused enough trouble as it is. Your friends have already tried every torture in the book! I'm still not telling anyone squat.
translation: 我不会帮你修那东西，它惹的麻烦还不够多吗？你的朋友们已经试遍了书里所有的酷刑！我还是什么都不会说。

english: Have they tried... err... Stretching your eyelids yet?
translation: 他们有没有试过……呃……扯你的眼皮？

english: Yes, it didn't work.
translation: 试了，没用。

english: How about... feeding you nail and prune stew?
translation: 那……喂你吃钉子和梅子炖菜呢？

english: That's all I've been living on since I got here.
translation: 自从来了这儿，我就靠这个活。

english: Set fire to your nostril hair? Let rabid rabbits nibble your toes? Given you a twisted arm?
translation: 烧你的鼻毛？让疯兔子啃你的脚趾？给你拧胳膊？

english: Yes, yes and yes. Tried them all, quite liked the toe nibbling.
translation: 试过，试过，都试过。全都试了，还挺喜欢被啃脚趾的。

english: Extracted your wisdom teeth?
translation: 拔你的智齿？

english: Us gnomes aren't wise so we don't get them. Face it, you'll never put me in enough pain that I'll tell you what you wanna know. I used to play gnomeball as a kid. This is a walk in the park in comparison.
translation: 我们地精没什么智慧，所以不长智齿。认了吧，你永远没法让我疼到说出你想知道的事。我小时候可是玩地精球长大的。跟那比起来，这简直是小菜一碟。

english: Alright I get the picture. What will work then?
translation: 好吧，我明白了。那什么才有用？

english: Ha! You think I'm stupid enough to tell you that I've been craving toad crunchies or that I can't stand having my feet tickled!
translation: 哈！你以为我蠢到会告诉你我一直想吃蟾蜍脆饼，或者我受不了被挠脚心吗！

english: Err... But you just told me?!?
translation: 呃……可你刚才告诉我了？！

english: I did? What did I say?
translation: 我说了？我说什么了？

english: You said about going to the park and playing gnomeball.
translation: 你提到去公园玩地精球。

english: Yes yes!! That was it, I'd hate that. Please don't do that. By Guthix's beard you mourners are such idiots! Leave me be moron.
translation: 对对！！就是这个，我讨厌那样。求你别那么做。以古斯的胡子起誓，你们哀悼者真是蠢货！别烦我了，白痴。

english: You said about toad crunchies and a gnome ball.
translation: 你提到了蟾蜍脆饼和地精球。

english: I used to play gnomeball yes.... what's that got to do with anything? Nothing that can convince me to help you that's for sure. Go away imbecile.
translation: 我小时候是玩地精球……但那又怎样？反正没法说服我帮你。走开，笨蛋。

english: You said about toad crunchies and being tickled.
translation: 你提到了蟾蜍脆饼和挠痒痒。

english: Oops... I mean erm... No that must have been some other err... gnome...
translation: 哎呀……我是说呃……不，那肯定是别的……呃……地精说的……

english: You're not fooling me... So you'll help me in exchange for toad crunchies?
translation: 你骗不了我……所以你拿蟾蜍脆饼交换帮我？

english: If you think you can just buy my co-operation you're a bigger imbecile than I thought.
translation: 如果你觉得能直接买通我，那你比我想的还蠢。

english: You will tell me, sooner or later.
translation: 你迟早会告诉我的。

english: You said about being tickled and a gnome ball.
translation: 你提到了被挠痒痒和地精球。

english: Oooh... a big scary gnomeball. I mean, it might crush me and my entire family, because we're so small!! They have big teeth and everything don't they? Sheesh. You mourners will have to try better than that. Now go away. I need some sleep after all these *yawn* scary threats.
translation: 哦……好可怕的地精球。我是说，它可能会把我全家都压扁，因为我们这么小！！它们还有大牙齿什么的，对吧？切。你们哀悼者得拿出点更好的招来。现在滚吧。听了这么多*哈欠*可怕的威胁，我需要睡会儿。

english: You said about being tickled and going to the park.
translation: 你提到了被挠痒痒和去公园。

english: No... I said being here is a walk in the park. Where do they get you guys? You must all be Ogre rejects for being too thick. Leave me be idiot.
translation: 不……我说的是待在这儿跟逛公园一样轻松。他们去哪儿找的你们这种人？肯定都是因为太蠢被食人魔淘汰的。别烦我了，白痴。

english: Now will you help me or would you prefer it if I tickle your feet?
translation: 现在你是帮我，还是想让我挠你脚心？

english: Alright... alright! I'm beaten! Bring me some soft leather and some magic logs and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧……好吧！我认输！给我拿些软皮革和魔法原木来，我看看能做什么。

english: I have all of that here.
translation: 这些我都有。

english: Well let me up off of this rack and I'll get started, I can't do anything while I'm all tied up.
translation: 那先把我从这架子上放下来，我才能开工，被绑着什么都干不了。

english: You got everything?
translation: 东西都齐了吗？

english: I still need some soft leather.
translation: 我还需要些软皮革。

english: Well when you have it all I'll fix that thing, but please don't tickle me any more.
translation: 等你都拿来了我就修那玩意儿，但求你别再挠我了。

english: I still need some magic logs.
translation: 我还需要些魔法原木。

english: I have it all here.
translation: 我全带来了。

english: Now will you help me or do I have to tickle your feet some more?
translation: 现在你是帮我，还是让我再挠你脚心？

english: I told you, I'm not going to get anything out of helping you, am I? As I figure, that device is the only thing keeping me out of the slave pens, where I'd get fed worse than nail and prune stew!
translation: 我跟你说过，帮了你我也捞不到什么好处，对吧？按我的想法，那装置是唯一能让我不进奴隶圈的东西，进了那里，吃得连钉子和梅子炖菜都不如！

english: Oi! There's no need for that, I already agreed to help.
translation: 喂！没必要这样，我已经同意帮忙了。

english: That's all well and good but I'm enjoying doing it.
translation: 那当然好，但我正乐在其中呢。

english: Ho ho ho... no more... Teehee... please stop... Hoohoo... he he he... I hate you!
translation: 嚯嚯嚯……别挠了……嘻嘻……求你别挠了……嚯嚯……嘿嘿嘿……我恨你！

english: What do you think you are doing? You are meant to be getting information out of him, not making friends!
translation: 你在搞什么？你是来套他情报的，不是来交朋友的！

english: I need to let him up if he's to fix this advice.
translation: 如果他要修这建议（指装置），我得先把他放下来。

english: Okay, but without the proper paperwork he stays in this room.
translation: 好吧，但没有正式文件，他只能待在这房间里。

english: Right, here you go. Now leave me to eat my crunchies in peace.
translation: 好了，给你。现在让我安安静静吃脆饼。

english: Do you know where I can get the dye parcels for his thing?
translation: 你知道去哪儿弄这东西用的染料包吗？

english: You mourners are really not very good at this are you? Fine, since you gave me some crunchies, the parcels are actually toads.
translation: 你们哀悼者干这事儿真不在行，对吧？行吧，既然你给了我些脆饼，那染料包其实就是蟾蜍。

english: Yes, toads. Get some bellows and fill them with the dye you want. Then just find a toad and use the bellows to fill it up.
translation: 对，蟾蜍。拿些风箱，灌上你想要的染料。然后找只蟾蜍，用风箱把它灌满。

english: Poor toads.
translation: 可怜的蟾蜍。

english: Ahh they're fine, a bit of dye never hurt anything... It's the firing them out the device that kills them.
translation: 啊，它们没事，一点染料伤不了什么……把它们从装置里射出去才会死。

english: Ewww... That's nasty.
translation: 呃……真恶心。

english: Oh and torturing gnomes is perfectly fine? Hypocrite.
translation: 哦，那折磨地精就没事了？伪君子。

english: You make a fair point. Where do I find the toads?
translation: 你说的有道理。我在哪儿能找到蟾蜍？

english: You get loads of them down in the Feldip Hills, especially near the ponds.
translation: 费迪普丘陵那边多得很，尤其是池塘附近。

english: Ah yes, I've used them to catch chompy birds before. I have some bellows right here as well.
translation: 啊，是的，我以前用它们抓过啾啾鸟。我这里还有一些风箱。

english: Catching chompy birds? You mourners are weird. Anyway, if you don't need anything else I'd like to be left in peace.
translation: 抓啾啾鸟？你们哀悼者真奇怪。总之，如果你没有别的事，我想安静一下。

english: Could you remind me where I can get the dye parcels for this thing?
translation: 你能提醒我一下去哪儿弄这东西的染料包吗？

english: How forgetful are you? Get some bellows and fill them with the dye you want. Then just head down to the Feldip Hills, find a toad and use the bellows to fill it up.
translation: 你记性有多差？拿些风箱，灌上你想要的染料。然后去费迪普丘陵，找只蟾蜍，用风箱把它灌满。

english: Thanks for the reminder. I have some bellows right here that I can use.
translation: 谢谢提醒。我这就有风箱能用。

english: Well if you don't need anything else I'd like to be left in peace.
translation: 嗯，没别的事的话，我想清静会儿。

english: He did. Turns out he was lying to me though.
translation: 他确实做了。不过结果发现他在骗我。

english: Lying? About what?
translation: 骗你？关于什么？

english: About his loyalty. It seems the plague is part of some evil plan of his. I still don't know what that is though.
translation: 关于他的忠诚。看来这场瘟疫是他某个邪恶计划的一部分。不过我还不知道那计划到底是什么。

english: This doesn't sound good at all. Should we tell someone?
translation: 听起来可不太妙。我们该告诉别人吗？

english: Not yet. I still need to work out exactly what's going on. I have some new allies who might help me with that though.
translation: 还没到时候。我还得搞清楚到底怎么回事。不过我有一些新盟友可能能帮我。

english: Well let me know as soon as you have something. And look after yourself out there, I worry about what you've got yourself involved in.
translation: 那你有消息了马上告诉我。在外面照顾好自己，我担心你卷进了什么事。

english: I'll be careful Elena. I promise.
translation: 我会小心的，埃琳娜。我保证。

english: How dare you enter my house, Mourner! Get out!
translation: 你好大的胆子，竟敢进我家，哀悼者！滚出去！

english: Elena, it's me... [player name].
translation: 埃琳娜，是我……[player name]。

english: [player name]? I didn't recogonise you in all that Mourner gear!
translation: [player name]？你穿着那身哀悼者装备我都没认出你来！

english: Sorry, didn't mean to scare you.
translation: 抱歉，不是故意吓你。

english: I worry about what you've got yourself involved in. You be careful out there.
translation: 我担心你卷进了什么事。在外面小心点。

english: I'll look after myself Elena. I promise.
translation: 我会照顾好自己的，埃琳娜。我保证。

english: You'd better. Let me know as soon as you work out what's going on.
translation: 最好是这样。搞清楚了马上告诉我。

english: How goes it [player name]?
translation: 怎么样，[player name]？

english: Alright, I've managed to infiltrate the mourners. I just have to find out what they are up to now.
translation: 还行，我成功混进了哀悼者。现在只需要查出他们在搞什么鬼。

english: Great work! Stick with it [player name].
translation: 干得好！坚持下去，[player name]。

english: Yes, it is done. What next?
translation: 是的，做完了。下一步呢？

english: It is good to see your enthusiasm. I was going to get one of the others to do this job, but as you are here... It has been quite some time since anyone got ill form the plague, so I would like you to see to it that people do!
translation: 看到你这么热情很好。我本来打算让其他人去做这件事，但既然你在这儿……已经有段时间没人因瘟疫生病了，所以我希望你去让一些人得病！

english: Err... But the plague doesn't exist, how am I meant to do that?
translation: 呃……可瘟疫并不存在啊，我怎么做得到？

english: We have never tried this before, but some joker put something in our food not too long ago that gave us all symptoms akin to those of the plague. If you can find out what it was that we were poisoned with, you could reproduce the effects. If done right the poison should not be fatal and could help restock our dwindling supply of cheap labour. We can have our men remove the 'infected' citizens and sent into the mines. Distribution should be easy enough. Because of the city walls no one can grow their own food. Instead, all the food here comes from one of three supply points.
translation: 我们以前从没试过，但不久前有个捣蛋鬼在我们的食物里下了东西，让所有人都出现了类似瘟疫的症状。如果你能查出我们中了什么毒，就能复制效果。如果操作得当，这毒不会致命，还能帮我们补充日益减少的廉价劳动力。我们可以派人把“感染的”市民送进矿场。下毒应该很容易。因为城墙的缘故，没人能自己种粮食。这里所有的食物都来自三个补给点之一。

english: Let me get this clear, you want me to find out who poisoned you, find out what they poisoned you with, find out how to make the poison and produce enough poison to affect a lot of people?
translation: 让我理清楚，你要我查出是谁下的毒、用的什么毒、怎么制作毒药，还要制造出足够影响很多人的毒？

english: Don't forget the part where you use the poison to contaminate the food supply. Two of the three supply points should be enough.
translation: 别忘了用毒污染食物供应的部分。三个补给点污染两个就够了。

english: How am I meant to do all of that?
translation: 我怎么做得到所有这些？

english: You seem resourceful so I'm sure you will come up with something. I would help you but I am not a biologist.
translation: 你看起来足智多谋，我相信你能想出办法。我愿意帮你，但我不是生物学家。

english: Luckily for me I know a biologist nearby.
translation: 幸运的是，我认识附近的一位生物学家。

english: Someone trustworthy I hope?
translation: 希望是可信赖的人？

english: Oh yes, definitely.
translation: 哦当然，绝对可信。

english: Very well. Perform this task and then return to me.
translation: 很好。完成这个任务后再来见我。

english: Hello again Elena.
translation: 又见面了，埃琳娜。

english: [player name]? I didn't recognise you in all that Mourner gear!
translation: [player name]？你穿着那身哀悼者装备我都没认出你来！

english: Well I'm not going anywhere. What's going on?
translation: 好吧，我哪儿也不去。怎么回事？

english: [player name]! How's it going? Have you found out any more about the plague?
translation: [player name]！怎么样了？关于瘟疫有什么新发现吗？

english: As it goes, yes I have. It's a long story.
translation: 说起来，确实有。说来话长。

english: Well I'll start from when we found out that the plague was a hoax. When I confronted the king, he told me that he faked the plague to keep people safe from his brother, King Tyras. He said that Tyras was taken by the Dark Lord while exploring the lands to the west. He claimed that the Dark Lord corrupted him by forcing him to drink from the Chalice of Eternity.
translation: 那我就从我们发现瘟疫是骗局开始讲起。当我质问国王时，他告诉我他伪造瘟疫是为了保护人民不受他兄弟泰拉斯国王的伤害。他说泰拉斯在探索西方土地时被黑暗领主掳走，并声称黑暗领主强迫他喝下永恒圣杯，从而腐化了他。

english: But that was a lie?
translation: 但那是谎言？

english: Indeed, but I didn't find out until much later. On the kings orders, I travelled through the Underground Pass and into the western lands of Tirannwn. Once there, I met up with Lord Iorwerth, the leader of some elves that had allied with the king. He helped me kill King Tyras. That was when I discovered the truth. While returning to King Lathas, I was confronted by another elf named Arianwyn, the leader of a group of rebel elves opposing Lord Iorwerth. At the time, I was carrying a letter from Lord Iorwerth to King Lathas. Arianwyn magically broke the seal on the letter so I could read it.
translation: 确实如此，但我后来才知道。遵照国王的命令，我穿越地下通道，进入了泰兰温的西部土地。在那里，我遇到了伊尔沃斯领主，他是与国王结盟的一些精灵的首领。他帮我杀死了泰拉斯国王。那时我才发现了真相。在返回拉萨斯国王的途中，我遇到了另一个名叫阿里安温的精灵，她是反抗伊尔沃斯领主的精灵叛军领袖。当时我正带着一封伊尔沃斯领主给拉萨斯国王的信。阿里安温用法术打破了信上的封印，让我得以阅读。

english: It revealed that it's actually King Lathas and Lord Iorwerth who serve the Dark Lord. According to the letter, King Lathas wants to reclaim Camelot from King Arthur and believes the Dark Lord can help him.
translation: 信上显示，实际上是拉萨斯国王和伊尔沃斯领主在为黑暗领主服务。根据信的内容，拉萨斯国王想从亚瑟王手中夺回卡美洛，并相信黑暗领主能帮他。

english: And Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 那伊尔沃斯领主呢？

english: I'm not exactly sure yet. West Ardougne seems to be key to his plans though. I met with Arianwyn who revealed to me that the mourners are actually elves in service to Lord Iorwerth. I've infiltrated the mourners and I'm trying to work out what they are doing. From what I've learnt so far, there's something important to them in the caves below West Ardougne. I'm currently working with them to earn their trust. Hopefully they'll reveal their plans to me soon.
translation: 我还不完全确定。不过西阿多尼城似乎是他计划的关键。我见了阿里安温，她告诉我哀悼者实际上是效忠于伊尔沃斯领主的精灵。我已经潜入了哀悼者，正在努力弄清他们在做什么。根据目前了解的情况，西阿多尼城下方的洞穴里有对他们很重要的东西。我正在和他们共事以取得信任。希望他们很快就能向我透露计划。

english: I see, that's quite the reveal. If you need anything from me just ask.
translation: 我明白了，真是个大发现。如果你需要我帮忙，尽管开口。

english: Well, I was hoping you could help me with something.
translation: 嗯，我本来希望你能帮我个忙。

english: I've been asked to produce a poison based on rotten apples.
translation: 有人让我用烂苹果制作一种毒药。

english: I doubt any poison based solely on apples, rotten or not, would be very effective.
translation: 我怀疑任何仅基于苹果的毒药，无论是否腐烂，都不会很有效。

english: Well I put a rotten apple in the Mourners' stew, I'm told that the effect was much like the symptoms of the plague.
translation: 嗯，我把一个烂苹果放进了哀悼者的炖菜里，我被告知效果很像瘟疫的症状。

english: Hmm... That sounds like they were ill from some sort of toxin, I should think it was a mould of some sort that had the effect, not the rotten apple itself. What do you need it for?
translation: 嗯……听起来他们像是某种毒素中毒了，我觉得应该是某种霉菌的作用，而不是烂苹果本身。你需要它做什么？

english: I need to poison a large food supply in order to get the Mourners' trust.
translation: 我需要毒害大量食物供应，以获取哀悼者的信任。

english: That's awful, I can't help you with that.
translation: 这太可怕了，我不能帮你做这个。

english: If I don't gain the trust of the Mourners, then the people of West Ardougne will have a much worse time than the effects of that toxin. Elena trust me.
translation: 如果我得不到哀悼者的信任，那么西阿多尼城的居民将会比中了那毒素的后果更糟。埃琳娜，相信我。

english: You'd better be right about this, and I'd better make sure you get this toxin right so no one dies! Bring me a sample of rotten apple to examine. I'll also see if I can make a counteractant for the toxin.
translation: 你最好是对的，而且我得确保你把这毒素做对，这样没人会死！给我带一份烂苹果样本让我检查。我也会看看能不能做出一种解毒剂。

english: Alright I'll be back shortly with a rotten apple for you.
translation: 好的，我很快会带着一个烂苹果回来给你。

english: I have one right here.
translation: 我这里就有一个。

english: I'm back.
translation: 我回来了。

english: You have a sample of rotten apple for me?
translation: 你带烂苹果样本给我了吗？

english: No, I forgot to get one.
translation: 没有，我忘了拿一个。

english: Well if you bring me one we can get started on this toxin.
translation: 嗯，如果你带一个来，我们就可以开始制作这种毒素了。

english: Is that you [player name]?
translation: 是你吗，[player name]？

english: Yes it's me.
translation: 是的，是我。

english: Yes I have it right here.
translation: 是的，我这里就有。

english: Ick... Alright then let's get started.
translation: 呃……好吧，那我们开始吧。

english: Right.. lets see...
translation: 好……让我看看……

english: Okay, I've managed to isolate a small sample of the toxin. It's a byproduct of the mould that grows on these apples, it's not fatal so a counteractant shouldn't be necessary. How big is the store that you're going to affect?
translation: 好了，我成功分离了一小份毒素样本。它是这些苹果上生长的霉菌的副产品，不会致命，所以不需要解药。你要影响的仓库有多大？

english: Well I was instructed to contaminate two of the three supply points in West Ardougne.
translation: 嗯，我接到指示要污染西阿多尼城三个补给点中的两个。

english: That's over half of the food in the city! You're going to need a huge amount of the toxin to do that. You're also going to need to refine it too, or people will notice rotten apples in amongst the food.
translation: 那是城市里超过一半的食物！你需要大量的毒素才能做到。你还得精炼它，否则人们会注意到食物里混着烂苹果。

english: This is starting to sound a little tricky, can't you make it for me?
translation: 这听起来有点棘手，你不能帮我做吗？

english: I would, but I don't have the right equipment here to do anything in bulk.
translation: 我倒是想，但我这里没有合适的装备来批量处理。

english: Alright then, tell me the process and I'll get started.
translation: 好吧，那告诉我过程，我开始动手。

english: Right then, the first thing to do is mash up a lot of rotten apples, then you will need to dissolve the toxin into a liquid that has a very low evaporation point, some form of solvent. I don't know as much about those kinds of chemicals but I believe naphtha will be perfect for this.
translation: 那么，首先要做的事是把大量烂苹果捣碎，然后你需要把毒素溶解到一种蒸发点很低的液体中，某种溶剂。我对这类化学品了解不多，但我觉得石脑油很适合。

english: Ah yes, I've worked with naphtha before. The chemist in Rimmington helped me make it from coal tar.
translation: 啊，是的，我以前用过石脑油。里明顿村的化学家帮我用煤焦油做的。

english: Perfect. Well get yourself some naphtha and some mashed rotten apples and mix them together. Once you've done that, strain out any solids. Finally, heat the mixture to evaporate off the solvent. Be careful of naked flames as the solvent will be highly flammable.
translation: 完美。那你去弄些石脑油和捣碎的烂苹果混合在一起。完成后，滤掉所有固体。最后，加热混合物蒸发掉溶剂。注意明火，因为溶剂高度易燃。

english: And that's all is it? Why isn't anything ever easy?
translation: 就这些？为什么什么事都不简单呢？

english: Sorry, I never said it would be simple. Here, you'll need this to strain out the solids.
translation: 抱歉，我从未说过这会简单。拿着，你需要这个来滤掉固体。

english: You may want to check out the orchard just north of the city. I hear no one has tended it since the blight infected the trees there. I imagine it will have plenty of rotten apples.
translation: 你可能想去城市北边的果园看看。我听说自从枯萎病感染那里的树木后，就没人打理了。我想那里会有很多烂苹果。

english: Huh? Oh hello. I just can't get used to a friend being dressed as mourner.
translation: 呃？哦，你好。我就是无法习惯朋友穿着哀悼者的衣服。

english: So how's the poisoning going?
translation: 那么下毒进行得怎么样了？

english: Not too well, can you remind me how I should make it again?
translation: 不太顺利，你能再提醒我一遍该怎么做吗？

english: Right, the first thing to do is mash up a lot of rotten apples. You'll probably be able to do that at the orchard just north of the city. I hear no one has tended it since the blight infected the trees there. Next, you'll want to get yourself some naphtha and mix it with the rotten apples. You mentioned the chemist in Rimmingon helped you with naphtha before. You might want to speak to him again. Once that's done, use the sieve I gave you to strain out any solids. Finally, heat the mixture to evaporate off the solvent. Be careful of naked flames as the solvent will be highly flammable.
translation: 好的，首先要做的是捣碎大量烂苹果。你可以在城市北边的果园里做，我听说自从枯萎病感染了那里的树之后，就没人打理了。然后，你去弄些石脑油，和烂苹果混合。你之前提到里明顿村的化学家帮你弄过石脑油。你可能得再去找他一次。完成后，用我给你的筛子滤掉固体。最后，加热混合物蒸发掉溶剂。注意明火，因为溶剂高度易燃。

english: Okay, thanks Elena.
translation: 好的，谢谢你，埃琳娜。

english: So have you found out what those mourner are up to yet?
translation: 那么你查出那些哀悼者在搞什么名堂了吗？

english: I was just on my way back there.
translation: 我正要回去那里。

english: Well let me know when you find out.
translation: 好吧，查到了告诉我。

english: Nothing I'm just talking to people randomly in case it helps.
translation: 没什么，我只是随便跟人聊聊，说不定有帮助。

english: Does it?
translation: 有帮助吗？

english: Maybe you should give me more toad crunchies. Ask any gnome, 'toad should be in everything' they'll tell you, mark my words.
translation: 也许你应该多给我一些蟾蜍脆饼。随便问哪个地精，'什么东西里都该放蟾蜍'，他们会这么告诉你，记住我的话。

english: Thanks... Toads always hit the spot!
translation: 谢了……蟾蜍总是恰到好处！

english: I got no need for that, keep it.
translation: 我不需要这个，你留着吧。

english: You are back already? How is the epidemic going?
translation: 你已经回来了？疫情怎么样了？

english: The epidemic? Oh, you mean the poisoning?
translation: 疫情？哦，你指的是下毒？

english: Subtle as a brick... Yes that, how is it going?
translation: 跟砖头一样迟钝……对，那个，怎么样了？

english: This is good news, give it a few days and the slave pens will be full again.
translation: 这是好消息，再过几天奴隶围栏就会再次满员了。

english: So have I proved my commitment now?
translation: 那么我现在证明自己的诚意了吗？

english: Yes I think you have. I guess you want to know what we're doing in the mines?
translation: 是的，我想你证明了。我猜你想知道我们在矿里做什么？

english: A long time ago, Seren herself ordered the construction of a great temple deep beneath the earth. This temple guards a great power, one that is key to our plans. We believe the temple lies beneath this city. That is why we are here. Unfortunately, progress has been slower than we'd have liked. The slaves accidently mined into some old caverns infested with beasts. They have caused us significant issues.
translation: 很久以前，塞伦亲自下令在地下深处建造一座巨大的神庙。这座神庙守护着一股强大的力量，那是我们计划的关键。我们相信神庙就在这座城市地下。这就是我们在这里的原因。不幸的是，进展比我们预想的要慢。奴隶们意外挖进了一些充满野兽的古老洞穴。它们给我们造成了很大的麻烦。

english: I see. But how close are we to finding it ?
translation: 我明白了。但我们离找到它还有多远？

english: It shouldn't be long now. We have started to see signs that we are near. Anyway, now that you know about the temple, I have a new task for you to perform, deep within the mines. Alas, one of the guards has taken the key to the mines to be copied. Report in regularly and I will see that you get a copy as soon as he gets back.
translation: 应该不远了。我们已经开始看到一些迹象表明我们接近了。总之，既然你已经知道了神殿的事，我有一项新任务要交给你，在矿井深处执行。可惜，有一个守卫把矿井的钥匙拿去复制了。定期来汇报，等他回来我就给你一把复制的钥匙。

english: Now be on your way, I have other things to attend to.
translation: 现在你走吧，我还有其他事要处理。

english: Oh nothing.
translation: 哦，没什么。

english: Do you have the key to the mines yet?
translation: 你拿到矿井的钥匙了吗？

english: No, the guard is being a bit slow, but we should have it soon.
translation: 没有，那个守卫有点慢，但我们应该很快就能拿到。

english: Alright, I'll report in again later.
translation: 好吧，我晚点再来汇报。

english: Hello [player name]. Have you found out what those mourners are up to yet?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你查出那些哀悼者在搞什么名堂了吗？

english: Apparently they are trying to find an old temple deep under the city. That's what their mining operation is for. The temple seems to be the key to their plans. It apparently holds a great power. I still have no idea what that is yet though.
translation: 显然，他们正在试图寻找城市地下深处的一座古老神殿。这就是他们采矿作业的目的。那座神殿似乎是他们计划的关键。据说它蕴含着一股强大的力量。但我还不知道那是什么。

english: I think I have the information you're after. It seems Iorwerth elves are searching for an ancient temple of some sort deep beneath West Ardougne.
translation: 我想我掌握了你需要的信息。看来伊尔沃斯的精灵正在西阿多尼城地下深处寻找某种古老的神殿。

english: Temple? That must be the Temple of Light!
translation: 神殿？那一定是光之殿！

english: Temple of Light? What's the Temple of Light?
translation: 光之殿？什么是光之殿？

english: It was built by Seren herself to guard a dark and ancient power. This is not good friend, I fear Lord Iorwerth intends to use that power to summon the Dark Lord!
translation: 它是塞伦亲自建造来守护一股古老黑暗力量的。这可不妙，朋友，我担心伊尔沃斯领主打算用那股力量召唤黑暗之主！

english: I don't think they've found this temple yet, but they know it's down there.
translation: 我觉得他们还没有找到这座神殿，但他们知道它就在下面。

english: Well then we still have time. Thank you for your help so far, we would never have discovered this without you. Now we must prepare for what comes next.
translation: 那么我们还来得及。感谢你到目前为止的帮助，没有你我们永远发现不了这个。现在我们必须为接下来的事做准备。

english: So what are we going to do about the Temple of Light?
translation: 那么我们打算怎么处理光之殿？

english: First of all, we need to know how close the Iorwerth elves are to finding it. Do you think you are ready for this?
translation: 首先，我们需要知道伊尔沃斯的精灵离找到它有多近。你觉得自己准备好了吗？

english: I don't think I am.
translation: 我觉得我还没准备好。

english: Well don't take too long. Every second we waste is a big risk.
translation: 嗯，别拖太久。我们每浪费一秒都是巨大的风险。

english: Hello Arianwyn. What are we going to do about the Temple of Light?
translation: 你好，阿里安温。我们打算怎么处理光之殿？

english: First of all, we need to know how close the Iorwerth elves are to finding it. Return to the Mourner Headquarters and gain access to their mine. Once there, see what you can discover about the temple.
translation: 首先，我们需要知道伊尔沃斯的精灵离找到它有多近。返回哀悼者总部，进入他们的矿井。到了那里，看看你能发现关于神殿的什么信息。

english: I’ll head over there right away.
translation: 我马上过去。

english: Thank you friend. Don’t forget your disguise.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。别忘了你的伪装。

english: Do you have the key to the excavation site yet?
translation: 你拿到挖掘现场的钥匙了吗？

english: The guard has finally returned. Seems it took him so long because he had ten times more cut than we needed.
translation: 守卫终于回来了。看来他花了这么长时间是因为他切了比我们需要的多十倍的钥匙。

english: That’s useful. I’m always losing keys.
translation: 那挺有用的。我总是丢钥匙。

english: Well I have plenty now.
translation: 嗯，现在我有很多了。

english: So… You mentioned a task you had for me, something to do with the mines?
translation: 那么……你提到有个任务给我，跟矿井有关？

english: That’s right. One of our dig teams has gone missing while searching for the temple. I need you to find out what happened to them.
translation: 没错。我们的一支挖掘队在寻找神殿时失踪了。我需要你查明他们出了什么事。

english: You say that now but the beasts in the mines are deadly, you’ll have to be very careful in there.
translation: 你现在这么说，但矿井里的怪物是致命的，你在里面得非常小心。

english: I’ll be on my guard.
translation: 我会保持警惕。

english: Good, you will need this.
translation: 很好，你会需要这个的。

english: Thanks, I’ll get to work.
translation: 谢谢，我这就去干活。

english: Good luck in there.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: Well this looks like the dig team, and it seems they managed to find the temple. I’d better let Arianwyn know before the Mourners find out.
translation: 嗯，这看起来像是挖掘队，看来他们成功找到了神殿。我最好在哀悼者发现之前告诉阿里安温。

english: [Player name], what is the latest news?
translation: [Player name]，最新消息是什么？

english: I think I have found the entrance to the temple. It looks like one of the dig crews discovered it. They were killed by some strange shadows though, so the other mourners don’t know about it yet.
translation: 我想我找到了神庙的入口。看起来有个挖掘队发现了它。不过他们被一些奇怪的影子杀死了，所以其他哀悼者还不知道这件事。

english: This isn’t good, it will only be a matter of time before they discover the temple.
translation: 这可不好，他们发现神殿只是时间问题。

english: I did some research while you were gone. Apparently, the temple was built with safeguards to prevent all but Seren's chosen from entering.
translation: 你不在的时候我做了些研究。显然，神殿建造时设有防护措施，只有塞琳的选民才能进入。

english: If there are shadows roaming outside the temple, it means those safeguards have long since decayed. I believe we can still restore them though.
translation: 如果有影子在神殿外游荡，那就意味着那些防护措施早已失效。不过我相信我们还能修复它们。

english: The temple guards an ancient altar, one with powers over life and death. I suspect this altar is why Lord Iorwerth is so keen to access the temple.
translation: 神殿守护着一座古代祭坛，拥有掌控生死的力量。我怀疑这就是伊尔沃斯领主如此渴望进入神殿的原因。

english: You think he means to use it to summon the Dark Lord?
translation: 你觉得他打算用它来召唤黑暗领主？

english: Indeed. Now, the altar is also key to the safeguards on the temple. We will need to use it to restore them.
translation: 没错。现在，这座祭坛也是神殿防护措施的关键。我们需要用它来修复它们。

english: First, I need you to return to the temple and find the crystal that is powering the safeguards. As they are no long working, I expect the crystal will be black in colour.
translation: 首先，我需要你回到神殿，找到为防护措施提供能量的水晶。既然它们已经失效，我猜那块水晶应该是黑色的。

english: Bring me a sample of this crystal. We will then determine our next steps.
translation: 给我带一块这种水晶的样本。然后我们再决定下一步。

english: Yes! Good work.
translation: 太好了！干得好。

english: Thanks, I found it on the top floor of the temple.
translation: 谢谢，我在神庙的顶层找到了它。

english: Well done, with this sample, a good crystal chanter should be able to make a replacement. Just a second, I will summon Eluned.
translation: 做得好，有了这个样本，一个好的水晶吟唱者应该能制作一个替代品。稍等一下，我召唤埃卢内德过来。

english: nan
translation: 无

english: Thank you for responding to my summons Eluned.
translation: 谢谢你响应我的召唤，埃卢内德。

english: Any time Arianwyn, how can I help?
translation: 随时效劳，阿里安温，我能帮什么忙？

english: [Player name] here has an old crystal sample, we need you to make a replacement for it.
translation: [Player name] 这里有一块旧水晶样本，我们需要你为它制作一个替代品。

english: Alright, hand it here and I shall take a look.
translation: 好的，把它给我，我来看看。

english: Now, let me see… Hmm… Ah, there we go.
translation: 现在，让我看看……嗯……啊，好了。

english: No problem, Arianwyn will tell you what you should do with it. Now I had better get going, see you round.
translation: 没问题，阿里安温会告诉你该怎么处理它。现在我该走了，回头见。

english: I have the new crystal, now what am I meant to do with it?
translation: 我拿到新水晶了，现在我该拿它做什么？

english: You will need to first take the newly formed crystal to the end of the temple and place it on the altar there. This will imbue the crystal with the power it needs to safeguard the temple.
translation: 你需要先把新形成的水晶带到神殿的尽头，放在那里的祭坛上。这会让水晶注入保护神殿所需的力量。

english: This is starting to sound hard.
translation: 这听起来开始有点难了。

english: It should be quite simple. Once you have powered up the newly formed crystal, you will need to return to the blackened crystal and place the new shard with others. This should restore the safeguards.
translation: 应该相当简单。一旦你给新形成的水晶充能完毕，你需要回到黑化水晶那里，把新的碎片和其他碎片放在一起。这应该就能恢复防护措施了。

english: And that’s it?
translation: 就这样？

english: Yes, that is all.
translation: 是的，就这些。

english: Right then, I’ll get to it.
translation: 那好吧，我这就去办。

english: ‘Ere… How’d you get in ‘ere?
translation: 喂……你是怎么进来的？

english: Funny, I was just going to ask you the same thing.
translation: 真巧，我正想问你同样的问题。

english: Well I asked first.
translation: 好吧，是我先问的。

english: Well I battled my way through hordes of shadows, whilst trying to solve a huge maze that I had to bounce a light beam around. Now your turn.
translation: 好吧，我是一路杀过成群结队的影子，同时试图解开一个巨大的迷宫，还得让一束光在里面弹来弹去。现在轮到你了。

english: I came in through this hole in the back.
translation: 我是从后面这个洞进来的。

english: You mean there’s an easy way?
translation: 你是说有更容易的路？

english: Not easy as such. A few of the boys and me set up an outpost at the other end of the tunnel, at the bottom of a huge cavern. The only way to get there is through caves riddled with traps.
translation: 也不算容易。我和几个兄弟在隧道另一头，一个巨大洞穴的底部建了个前哨站。要到达那里，只能穿过布满陷阱的洞穴。

english: Hang on, this sounds familiar. Is the name of one of your companions Klank?
translation: 等等，这听起来很耳熟。你的同伴里是不是有个叫克兰克的？

english: Yes, how did you know that?
translation: 是的，你怎么知道的？

english: He’s a friend of mine, he made me a great pair of gauntlets.
translation: 他是我的朋友，他给我做了一副很棒的手套。

english: Wait… You must be [player name]!
translation: 等等……你一定是[player name]！

english: That’s right. How did you know that?
translation: 没错。你怎么知道的？

english: Klank told me about you, told me how you got rid of that Iban fellow. As it’s you, I’ll make you an offer, I’ll trade you a Death Talisman. You’ll need it if you want to access this altar.
translation: 克兰克跟我提起过你，说你干掉了那个叫伊班的家伙。既然是你，我给你个交易，我用一个死亡护符跟你换。如果你想进入这个祭坛，你会需要它的。

english: Thanks, but I have one.
translation: 谢谢，但我已经有了一个。

english: Well if you wanna ‘nother, just come back and I’ll tell you what I need.
translation: 好吧，如果你还想要一个，就回来找我，我会告诉你我需要什么。

english: Great… Wait, what for?
translation: 太好了……等等，用来干什么？

english: I just need a few things, here I’ll make you a list.
translation: 我只需要几样东西，来，我给你列个清单。

english: Right I’d better get started, see you soon.
translation: 好了，我最好开始行动了，回头见。

english: Hi again, how’re you doing with those items we need?
translation: 嗨，又见面了，我们需要的那些东西你准备得怎么样了？

english: I’ve got some of them with me.
translation: 我身上带着一些。

english: Great, thank you so much for getting all that for us! Here take this Death Talisman as a reward. Anytime you want another one of those Talismans come see me and I'll sort you out with another list.
translation: 太好了，非常感谢你为我们弄到这些东西！来，拿着这个死亡护符作为奖励。任何时候你想要另一个这种护符，就来找我，我会再给你列个清单。
