english: Good news Arianwyn, I’ve repaired the safeguards on the Temple of Light.
translation: 好消息，阿里安温，我已经修复了光明神殿的防护措施。

english: This is good news indeed, [player name]. That should stop anyone from entering for another thousand years.
translation: 这确实是个好消息，[player name]。这应该能阻止任何人再进入，持续一千年。

english: Erm… not quite. It seems some dwarves have managed to tunnel through to the back of the temple.
translation: 呃……不完全是这样。似乎有些矮人挖了条隧道通到了神殿后面。

english: Some dwarves?
translation: 一些矮人？

english: Yes. They’ve set up an outpost in the Underground Pass.
translation: 是的。他们在地下通道里建了个前哨站。

english: This is interesting news. I will send an envoy down to speak with them. We must ensure all access into the temple is secure.
translation: 这消息很有意思。我会派一名使者下去和他们谈谈。我们必须确保所有进入神殿的通道都安全无虞。

english: Even still, I can’t see Lord Iorwerth discovering this tunnel any time soon. For now, he should have no way to summon the Dark Lord.
translation: 即便如此，我看伊尔沃斯领主短时间内也发现不了这条隧道。目前看来，他应该没有办法召唤黑暗领主了。

english: So what happens next?
translation: 那接下来会发生什么？

english: This isn’t the end by any means. The Iorwerth forces are still at large and we are not strong enough to stop them. However, with the temple secure, the main threat has been dealt with.
translation: 这绝不是结束。伊尔沃斯的势力仍然逍遥法外，而我们还不够强大去阻止他们。不过，既然神殿安全了，主要威胁已经解除。

english: I will let you know if there are any further developments. For now though, your work is done.
translation: 如果有任何进一步的发展，我会通知你。不过现在，你的任务已经完成了。

english: I can’t offer much of a reward I’m afraid. However, I did have Eluned make this for you. It should allow you to bypass the defences on the temple.
translation: 恐怕我拿不出什么像样的奖励。不过，我让埃卢内德为你做了这个。它应该能让你绕过神殿的防御。

english: Oh, it's terrible! Lord Sinclair has been murdered and we don't have any clues as to who or why. We're totally baffled!
translation: 哦，太可怕了！辛克莱尔领主被谋杀了，我们没有任何关于凶手或动机的线索。我们完全不知所措！

english: If you can help us we will be very grateful.
translation: 如果你能帮我们，我们会非常感激的。

english: Sure, I'll help!
translation: 当然，我来帮忙！

english: What should I be doing to help?
translation: 我该做些什么来帮忙？

english: Look around and investigate who might be responsible. The Sarge said every murder leaves clues to who done it, but frankly we're out of our depth here.
translation: 到处看看，调查一下谁可能是凶手。警长说每起谋杀都会留下是谁干的线索，但坦白说，我们在这里完全摸不着头脑。

english: You should do your own dirty work.
translation: 你应该自己干这种脏活。

english: Get lost then, this is private property! ...Unless you'd like to be taken in for questioning yourself?
translation: 那就滚开，这是私人领地！……除非你想被抓回去审问？

english: How did Lord Sinclair die?
translation: 辛克莱尔领主是怎么死的？

english: Well, it's all very mysterious. Mary, the maid, found the body in the study next to his bedroom on the east wing of the ground floor.
translation: 嗯，这一切非常神秘。女仆玛丽在底层东侧他卧室旁边的书房里发现了尸体。

english: The door was found locked from the inside, and he seemed to have been stabbed, but there was an odd smell in the room. Frankly, I'm stumped.
translation: 房门是从里面锁上的，他看起来是被刺死的，但房间里有一股奇怪的气味。坦白说，我无计可施了。

english: I know who did it!
translation: 我知道是谁干的！

english: Really? That was quick work! Who?
translation: 真的？动作真快！是谁？

english: It was an intruder!
translation: 是入侵者！

english: That's what we were thinking too. That someone broke in to steal something, was discovered by Lord Sinclair, stabbed him and ran.
translation: 我们也是这么想的。有人闯进来偷东西，被辛克莱尔领主发现，就刺死了他然后逃跑了。

english: It's odd that apparently nothing was stolen though... Find out something has been stolen,
translation: 不过奇怪的是，似乎什么都没被偷……如果你能查出有东西被偷，

english: and the case is closed, but the murdered man was a friend of the King, and it's more than my job's worth not to investigate fully.
translation: 案子就能结了。但死者是国王的朋友，要是不彻底调查，我这个饭碗可就不保了。

english: The butler did it!
translation: 是管家干的！

english: I hope you have proof to that effect. We have to arrest someone for this and it seems to me that only the actual murderer would gain by falsely accusing someone.
translation: 我希望你有证据证明这一点。我们必须抓个人来顶罪，在我看来，只有真正的凶手才会从诬告别人中获益。

english: Although having said that the butler is kind of shifty looking...
translation: 不过话说回来，那个管家看起来是有点贼眉鼠眼……

english: It was one of the servants!
translation: 是其中一个仆人！

english: Oh really? Which one?
translation: 哦，真的？哪个？

english: It was one of the women
translation: 是其中一个女仆。

english: Great work. Show me the evidence, and we'll take them to the dungeons.
translation: 干得好。给我看证据，我们就抓他们进地牢。

english: You DO have evidence of their crime, right?
translation: 你确实有他们犯罪的证据，对吧？

english: Tch. You wouldn't last a day in the guards with sloppy thinking like that. Come see me when you have some proof of your accusations.
translation: 啧。像你这样草率的想法，在卫队里连一天都待不下去。等你有证据证明你的指控再来找我吧。

english: It was one of the men...
translation: 是其中一个男仆……

english: It was one of his family!
translation: 是他家族的人！

english: It was one of the women...
translation: 是其中一个女仆……

english: I'm here to help the guards with their investigation.
translation: 我是来帮卫兵们调查的。

english: Oh really? What do you want to know then?
translation: 哦，真的？那你想知道什么？

english: Who do you think was responsible?
translation: 你觉得是谁干的？

english: It was clearly an intruder.
translation: 显然是入侵者。

english: Well, I don't think it was.
translation: 嗯，我不这么认为。

english: It was one of our lazy servants then.
translation: 那就是我们那些懒惰的仆人中的一个。

english: Where were you when the murder happened?
translation: 谋杀发生时你在哪里？

english: In the library. No one else was there so you'll just have to take my word for it.
translation: 在图书馆。没有其他人在场，所以你只能相信我的话。

english: Do you recognise this thread?
translation: 你认识这根线吗？

english: Not really, no. Thread is fairly common.
translation: 不太认识，不。线很常见。

english: I suppose I had better talk to you then.
translation: 我想我最好还是跟你谈谈吧。

english: I don't really care as long as no one thinks it's me. Maybe it was that strange poison seller who headed towards the seers village.
translation: 只要没人怀疑是我，我才不在乎呢。也许是那个奇怪的毒药贩子，他往先知村去了。

english: I was walking by myself in the garden.
translation: 我一个人在花园里散步。

english: And can anyone vouch for that?
translation: 有人能证明吗？

english: No. But I was.
translation: 没有。但我确实是在花园。

english: It's some red thread. I suppose you think that's some kind of clue? It looks like the material my trousers are made of
translation: 是些红线。我想你觉得这是什么线索吧？看起来像我裤子用的料子。

english: It's some thread. greatclue. No, really.
translation: 是些线。好线索。不，真的。

english: Well, ask what you want to know then.
translation: 好吧，那你问你想知道的吧。

english: I don't know. I think it's very convenient that you have arrived here so soon after it happened. Maybe it was you.
translation: 我不知道。我觉得事情发生后你这么快就来了，未免太巧合了。说不定是你干的。

english: Why? Are you accusing me of something? You seem to have a very high opinion of yourself I was in my room if you must know, alone.
translation: 为什么？你在指控我什么吗？你似乎对自己评价很高啊。如果你非要知道的话，我当时在自己的房间里，一个人。

english: It's some red thread... it kind of looks like the Samematerial as my trousers. But obviously it's not.
translation: 是些红线……看起来有点像我的裤子料子。但显然不是。

english: It's some thread. Sorry, do you have a point here? Or do you just enjoy wasting peoplestime?
translation: 是些线。抱歉，你到底想说什么？还是你只是喜欢浪费别人的时间？

english: And? Make this quick, I have better things to do than be interrogated by halfwits all day.
translation: 然后呢？快点说，我还有更重要的事要做，可不想整天被蠢货审问。

english: I don't really know or care. Frankly, the old man deserved to die.
translation: 我既不知道也不在乎。坦白说，那老家伙死有余辜。

english: There was a suspicious red headed man who came to the house the other day selling poison now I think about it. Last I saw he was headed towards the tavern in the Seers village.
translation: 现在我想起来了，前几天有一个可疑的红发男人来卖毒药。我最后看到他是往先知村的酒馆去了。

english: That is none of your business. Are we finished now, or are you just going to stand there irritating me with your idiotic questions all day?
translation: 这不关你的事。我们现在说完了吗？还是你就打算整天站在这里用你那些愚蠢的问题烦我？

english: No. Can I go yet? Your face irritates me.
translation: 没有。我可以走了吗？你的脸让我很不爽。

english: What's so important you need to bother me with then?
translation: 那有什么重要的事要打扰我？

english: Could have been anyone. The old man was an idiot. He's been asking for it for years.
translation: 谁都可能下手。那老头是个白痴。他多年来一直在找死。

english: I was out.
translation: 我当时在外面。

english: Care to be any more specific?
translation: 能说得具体点吗？

english: Not really. I don't have to justify myself to the likes of you, you know. I know the King personally you know. Now are we finished here?
translation: 不太想。我没有必要向你这种人解释，你知道吧？我认识国王本人。现在我们谈完了吗？

english: It's some thread. You're not very good at this whole investigation thing are you?
translation: 是些线。你不太擅长调查这件事，对吧？

english: Good for you. Now what do you want?
translation: 真为你高兴。那你想要什么？

english: ...And can you spare me any money? I'm a little short...
translation: ……你能借我点钱吗？我有点手头紧……

english: You don't know how long it takes an inheritance to come through do you? I could really use that money pretty soon...
translation: 你不知道遗产要多久才能到手，对吧？我很快就需要那笔钱了……

english: I don't know, somewhere around here probably.
translation: 我不知道，大概就在这附近吧。

english: Could you spare me a few coins? I'll be able to pay you double tomorrow it's just there's this poker night tonight in town...
translation: 你能给我几个金币吗？我明天就能加倍还你，只是今晚镇上有个扑克之夜……

english: It looks like thread to me, but I'm not exactly an expert. Is it worth something? Can I have it? Actually, can you spare me a few gold?
translation: 对我来说它看起来就是线，但我可不是专家。它值钱吗？能给我吗？其实，你能给我点金币吗？

english: Who do you think is responsible?
translation: 你觉得是谁干的？

english: Oh... I really couldn't say. I wouldn't really want to point any fingers at anybody. If I had to make a guess I'd have to say it was probably Bob though.
translation: 哦……我真的说不上来。我不想随便指责任何人。不过如果非要猜的话，我猜可能是鲍勃。

english: I saw him arguing with Lord Sinclair about some missing silverware from the Kitchen. It was a very heated argument.
translation: 我看到他因为厨房里丢失的一些银器跟辛克莱尔领主争吵。那是一场非常激烈的争论。

english: Where were you at the time of the murder?
translation: 谋杀发生时你在哪里？

english: Me? I was sound asleep here in the servants Quarters. It's very hard work as a handyman around here, There's always something to do!
translation: 我？我当时在仆人宿舍里睡得很熟。当这里的杂工很辛苦，总有活要干！

english: Did you hear any suspicious noises at all?
translation: 你听到什么可疑的声音吗？

english: Hmmm..... No, I didn't, but I sleep very soundly at night.
translation: 嗯……没有，我没听到，但我晚上睡得很沉。

english: So you didn't hear any sounds of a struggle or any barking from the guard dog next to his study window?
translation: 所以你没有听到打斗的声音，或者他书房窗户旁的看门狗叫声？

english: Now you mention it, no. It is odd I didn't hear anything like that. But I do sleep very soundly as I said and wouldn't necessarily have heard it if there was any such noise.
translation: 你一提，确实没有。我没听到那些声音是有点奇怪。但我说了，我睡得很沉，即使有那样的声音也不一定会听到。

english: I'm investigating the murder up at the Sinclair place.
translation: 我在调查辛克莱尔庄园的谋杀案。

english: Murder is it? Well, I'm not really surprised...
translation: 谋杀？哼，我一点也不惊讶……

english: What can you tell me about the Sinclairs?
translation: 你能告诉我关于辛克莱尔家的事吗？

english: Well, what do you want to know?
translation: 嗯，你想知道什么？

english: Tell me about Lord Sinclair.
translation: 跟我说说辛克莱尔领主。

english: Old Lord Sinclair was a great man with a lot of respect in these parts. More than his worthless children have anyway.
translation: 老辛克莱尔领主是个伟人，在这些地方很受尊敬。至少比他那些没用的孩子们强得多。

english: His children? They have something to gain by his death?
translation: 他的孩子们？他们能从他的死中得到什么好处吗？

english: Yes. You could say that. Not that I'm one to gossip.
translation: 是的。可以这么说。不过我不是那种爱嚼舌根的人。

english: Why do the Sinclairs live so far from town?
translation: 为什么辛克莱尔家住在离镇子这么远的地方？

english: Well, they used to live in the big castle, but old Lord Sinclair gave it up so that those strange knights could live there instead. So the king built him a new house to the North.
translation: 嗯，他们以前住在大城堡里，但老辛克莱尔领主把它让给了那些奇怪的骑士们居住。所以国王在北方给他建了新房子。

english: It's more cramped than his old place, but he seemed to like it. His children were furious at him for doing it though!
translation: 新房子比旧地方拥挤，但他似乎很喜欢。不过他的孩子们对此非常生气！

english: What can you tell me about his sons?
translation: 你能告诉我关于他儿子们的事吗？

english: His sons eh? They all have their own skeletons in their cupboards. You'll have to be more specific. Who are you interested in exactly?
translation: 他的儿子们，嗯？他们每个人都有不可告人的秘密。你得说得更具体些。你到底对谁感兴趣？

english: Tell me about Bob.
translation: 跟我说说鲍勃。

english: Bob is an odd character indeed... I'm not one to gossip, but I heard Bob is addicted to Tea. He can't make
translation: 鲍勃确实是个怪人……我不是爱八卦的人，但我听说鲍勃喝茶上瘾。他一天不喝

english: it through the day without having at least 20 cups!
translation: 至少二十杯茶就过不下去！

english: You might not think that's such a big thing, but he has spent thousands of gold to feed his habit!
translation: 你可能觉得这不是什么大事，但他为了这个癖好已经花了几千金币了！

english: At one point he stole a lot of silverware from the kitchen and pawned it just so he could afford to buy his daily tea allowance.
translation: 有一次，他偷了厨房里很多银器去典当，就为了买得起每天的茶叶。

english: If his father ever found out, he would be in so much trouble... he might even get disowned!
translation: 如果被他父亲发现，他就会有天大的麻烦……甚至可能被逐出家门！

english: Tell me about David.
translation: 跟我说说大卫。

english: David... oh David... not many people know this, but David really has an anger problem. He's always screaming and shouting
translation: 大卫……哦，大卫……没多少人知道，但大卫真的有易怒的问题。他总是对家里的仆人

english: at the household servants when he's angry, and they live in a state of fear, always walking on eggshells around him, but none of them have the courage
translation: 又喊又叫的，仆人们生活在恐惧中，在他身边总是小心翼翼，但没有人有勇气

english: to talk to his father about his behaviour. If they did, Lord Sinclair would almost certainly
translation: 去跟他父亲谈谈他的行为。如果真去了，辛克莱尔领主几乎肯定会

english: kick him out of the house, as some of the servants have been there longer than he has, and he definitely has no right to treat them like he does... but I'm not one to gossip about people.
translation: 把他赶出房子，因为有些仆人待的时间比他长，他绝对没资格那样对待他们……但我不喜欢在背后议论别人。

english: Tell me about Frank.
translation: 告诉我关于弗兰克的事。

english: I'm not one to talk ill of people behind their back, but Frank is a real piece of work. He is an absolutely terrible gambler... he can't pass 2 dogs in the street without putting a bet on which one will bark first!
translation: 我不喜欢在背后说人坏话，但弗兰克真是个难缠的家伙。他是个糟糕透顶的赌徒……他在街上连两只狗都放不过，非要赌哪一只先叫！

english: He has already squandered all of his allowance, and I heard he had stolen a number of paintings of his fathers to sell to try and cover his debts, but he still owes a lot of
translation: 他已经把自己所有的零花钱都挥霍光了，我还听说他偷了他父亲好几幅画拿去卖，想用来还债，但他还欠着

english: people a lot of money. If his father ever found out, he would stop his income, and then he would be in serious trouble!
translation: 很多人很多钱。要让他父亲知道了，肯定会断了他的收入来源，到时候他就麻烦大了！

english: What can you tell me about his daughters?
translation: 你能告诉我关于他女儿们的事吗？

english: His daughters eh? They're all nasty pieces of work. which of them specifically did you want to know about?
translation: 他女儿们啊？没一个省油的灯。你想具体问哪个？

english: Tell me about Anna.
translation: 告诉我关于安娜的事。

english: Anna... ah yes... Anna has 2 great loves:
translation: 安娜……啊对……安娜有两样心头好：

english: Sewing and gardening. But one thing she has kept secret is that she once had an affair with Stanford the gardener, and tried to get him fired when they broke up,
translation: 缝纫和园艺。但她有件事一直瞒着别人——她曾经和园丁斯坦福有过一段私情，分手后想让他被开除，

english: by killing all of the flowers in the garden. If her father ever found out she had done that he would be so furious he would probably disown her.
translation: 就把花园里所有的花都弄死了。要是她父亲知道她干过这事，肯定气得要跟她断绝关系。

english: Tell me about Carol.
translation: 告诉我关于卡罗尔的事。

english: Oh Carol... she is such a fool. You didn't hear this from me, but I heard a while ago she was conned out of a lot of money by a travelling salesman who sold her a box full
translation: 哦卡罗尔……她真是个傻瓜。这话可不是从我这儿传出去的，但我听说前阵子有个行商骗了她一大笔钱，卖给她一箱子

english: of beans by telling her they were magic. But they weren't. She sold some rare books from the library to cover her debts, but
translation: 豆子，还跟她说那是魔法豆子。其实根本不是。她为了还债卖了几本图书馆里的珍本书，但是

english: her father would be incredibly annoyed if he ever found out - he might even throw her out of the house!
translation: 要让她父亲知道了肯定会大发雷霆——说不定会把她赶出家门！

english: Tell me about Elizabeth.
translation: 告诉我关于伊丽莎白的事。

english: Elizabeth? Elizabeth has a strange problem... She cannot help herself, but is always stealing small objects - it's pretty sad that she is rich enough to afford to buy things, but would rather steal them instead.
translation: 伊丽莎白？伊丽莎白有个怪毛病……她管不住自己，老是偷小东西——挺可悲的，她明明有钱买得起，却偏要去偷。

english: Now, I don't want to spread stories, but I heard she even stole a silver needle from her father that had great sentimental value for him.
translation: 我可不想散布谣言，但我听说她甚至偷了她父亲的一根银针，那根银针对他来说有很重要的纪念意义。

english: He was devastated when it was lost, and cried for a week thinking he had lost it!
translation: 银针丢了之后他伤心欲绝，哭了一整个礼拜，以为自己弄丢了！

english: If he ever found out that it was her who had stolen it he would go absolutely mental, maybe even disowning her!
translation: 要是他发现是她偷的，绝对会气疯，说不定会跟她断绝关系！

english: Well, I guess it could have been an intruder, but with that big guard dog of theirs I seriously doubt it. I suspect it was someone closer to home...
translation: 嗯，我猜也可能是外人闯进来的，但他们有那只大看门狗在，我严重怀疑。我觉得是家里的人干的……

english: Especially as I heard that the poison salesman in the Seers' village made a big sale to one of the family the other day.
translation: 尤其是我听说先知村的毒药商人前几天向这家人中的一位做了一笔大买卖。

english: I think the butler did it.
translation: 我觉得是管家干的。

english: And I think you've been reading too many cheap detective novels. Hobbes is kind of uptight, but his loyalty to old Lord Sinclair is beyond question.
translation: 我看你是廉价侦探小说看多了。霍布斯是有点死板，但他对老辛克莱尔庄园勋爵的忠诚是毋庸置疑的。

english: I am so confused about who did it...
translation: 我完全搞不清楚是谁干的……

english: Think you could give me any hints?
translation: 你能给我点提示吗？

english: Well, I don't know if it's related, but I heard from that Poison Salesman in town that he sold some poison to one of the Sinclair family
translation: 嗯，我不知道这有没有关系，但我听镇里那个毒药商人说，他前几天卖了一些毒药给辛克莱尔庄园的某个人。

english: the other day. I don't think he has any stock left now though...
translation: 不过我觉得他现在已经没有存货了……

english: Well, in my considered opinion it must be David. The man is nothing more than a bully And I happen to know that poor Lord Sinclair and David had a massive argument in the living
translation: 嗯，依我看，凶手一定是大卫。那人就是个恶霸。而且我碰巧知道，可怜的老辛克莱尔庄园勋爵和大卫前几天在客厅里为他对待仆人的方式大吵了一架。

english: room about the way he treats the staff, the other day. I did not intend to overhear their conversation, but they were shouting so loudly I could not help but Overhear it. David definitely used the words
translation: 前几天在房间里为他对待仆人的方式大吵了一架。我不是故意偷听他们的谈话，但他们喊得太大声，我忍不住听到了。大卫确实用了那个词

english: 'I am going to kill you!' as well. I think he should be the prime suspect. He has a nasty temper that one.
translation: “我要杀了你！”之类的话。我觉得他应该是头号嫌疑人。那家伙脾气坏得很。

english: I was assisting the cook with the evening meal. I gave Mary His Lordships' dinner, and sent her to take it to him, then heard the scream as she found the body.
translation: 我当时在帮厨师准备晚餐。我把勋爵的晚餐交给玛丽，让她送去给他，然后就听到了她发现尸体时的尖叫声。

english: How do you mean 'suspicious'?
translation: 你说“可疑”是什么意思？

english: Any sounds of a struggle with Lord Sinclair?
translation: 有没有听到辛克莱尔庄园勋爵和谁搏斗的声音？

english: No, I definitely didn't hear anything like that.
translation: 没有，我肯定没听到那种声音。

english: How about the guard dog barking at all?
translation: 那看门狗有没有叫？

english: You know, now you come to mention it I don't believe I did. I suppose that is Proof enough that it could not have been an intruder who is responsible.
translation: 你这么说，我想想好像还真没听到。我想这足以证明不可能是外人干的。

english: Elizabeth.
translation: 伊丽莎白。

english: Her father confronted her about her constant petty thieving, and was devestated to find she had stolen a silver needle which had meant a lot to him.
translation: 她父亲因为她不断的小偷小摸而质问了她，并发现她偷了一根对他意义重大的银针，这让他非常伤心。

english: You could hear their argument from Lumbridge!
translation: 他们吵架的声音大到你在仑桥镇都听得见！

english: I was right here with Hobbes and Mary. You can't suspect me surely!
translation: 我当时就在这里，和霍布斯还有玛丽在一起。你总不能怀疑我吧！

english: suspicious? what do you mean suspicious?
translation: 可疑？你说可疑是什么意思？

english: Any sounds of a struggle with an intruder for example?
translation: 比如说有没有听到和闯入者搏斗的声音？

english: No, I'm sure I don't recall any such thing.
translation: 没有，我肯定不记得有这回事。

english: How about the guard dog barking at an intruder?
translation: 那看门狗有没有对着闯入者叫？

english: No, I didn't. If you don't have anything else to ask can You go and leave me alone now? I have a lot of cooking to do for this evening.
translation: 不，我没有。如果你没有别的问题了，现在能走开让我一个人待着吗？我今晚有很多烹饪要做。

english: Oh I don't know... Frank was acting kind of funny... After that big argument him and the Lord had the other day by the beehive... so
translation: 哦我也不知道……弗兰克当时表现有点古怪……那天他和勋爵在蜂箱旁边大吵一架之后……所以

english: I guess maybe him... but it's really scary to think someone here might have been responsible. I actually hope it was a burglar...
translation: 我猜也许是他……但一想到可能是这里的人干的，我就觉得很可怕。我倒希望是个小偷……

english: I was with Hobbes and Louisa in the Kitchen helping to prepare Lord Sinclair's meal, and then when I took it to his study... I saw... oh, it was horrible... he was....
translation: 我当时和霍布斯还有路易莎在厨房里帮忙准备辛克莱尔庄园勋爵的晚餐，然后我把晚餐端到他书房的时候……我看到了……哦太可怕了……他……

english: I don't really remember hearing anything out of the ordinary.
translation: 我不太记得有什么不寻常的声音。

english: No sounds of a struggle then?
translation: 没听到搏斗的声音？

english: No, I don't remember hearing anything like that.
translation: 没有，我不记得听到那种声音。

english: How about the guard dog barking?
translation: 那看门狗有没有叫？

english: Oh that horrible dog is always barking at nothing but I don't think I did...
translation: 哦那只讨厌的狗整天对着空气叫，但我想我没听到……

english: Honestly? I think it was Carol.
translation: 说实话？我觉得是卡罗尔。

english: I saw her in a huge argument with Lord Sinclair in the library the other day. It was something to do with stolen books. She definitely seemed upset enough to have done it afterwards.
translation: 前几天我看到她在图书馆里和辛克莱尔庄园勋爵大吵了一架，好像和偷书有关。事后她看上去确实烦躁到可能做出这种事。

english: I was in town at the Inn. When I got back the house was swarming with guards who told me what had happened. Sorry.
translation: 我当时在镇上的小旅馆里。等我回来的时候，房子里到处都是守卫，他们告诉我发生了什么事。抱歉。

english: Well, like what?
translation: 嗯，比如什么？

english: I hear him bark all the time. It's one of his favorite things to do. I can't say I did the night of the murder though as I wasn't close enough to hear either way.
translation: 我经常听到它叫。这是它最喜欢做的事情之一。不过我不能说谋杀当晚我听到了，因为当时我离得不够近，没法听到。

english: It was Anna. She is seriously unbalanced. She trashed the garden once then tried to blame it on me! I bet it was her. It's just the kind of thing she'd do!
translation: 是安娜。她精神严重不正常。她曾经把整个花园搞得一团糟，然后还想嫁祸给我！肯定是她干的。她做得出这种事！

english: She really hates me and was arguing with Lord Sinclair about trashing the garden a few days ago.
translation: 她特别恨我，前几天还因为糟蹋花园的事跟辛克莱尔庄园勋爵吵架。

english: Right here, by my little shed. It's very cosy to sit and think in.
translation: 就在这儿，我的小棚子旁边。坐在这里想事情很舒服。

english: So no sounds of a struggle between Lord Sinclair and an intruder?
translation: 所以没听到辛克莱尔庄园勋爵和闯入者搏斗的声音？

english: Not to the best of my recollection.
translation: 据我回忆，没有。

english: Not that I can recall.
translation: 我没印象。

english: I'm investigating the murder at the Sinclair house.
translation: 我在调查辛克莱尔庄园发生的谋杀案。

english: There was a murder at the Sinclair House??? That's terrible! And I was only there the other day too! They bought the last of my Patented Multi Purpose Poison!
translation: 辛克莱尔庄园发生了谋杀案？？？太可怕了！而且我前几天刚去过那儿！他们把我最后一批专利多用途毒药全买走了！

english: Patented Multi Purpose Poison?
translation: 专利多用途毒药？

english: Aaaaah... a miracle of modern apothecaries!
translation: 啊……现代药剂学的一个奇迹！

english: This exclusive concoction has been tested on all known forms of life and been proven to kill them all in varying dilutions from cockroaches to king dragons!
translation: 这种独家配方已在所有已知生命形态上测试过，从蟑螂到国王龙，不同稀释浓度下均能致死！

english: So incredibly versatile, it can be used as pest control, a cleansing agent, drain cleaner, metal polish and washes whiter than white,
translation: 用途极其广泛，可用于虫害治理、清洁剂、排水沟清洗剂、金属抛光剂，还能洗得更白，

english: all with our uniquely fragrant concoction that is immediately recognisable across the land as Peter Potter's Patented Poison potion!!!
translation: 而且我们独特的芳香配方在全国都一闻即识——彼得.波特的专利毒药水！！！

english: I'd love to sell you some but I've sold out recently. That's just how good it is! Three hundred and twenty eight people in this area alone cannot be wrong!
translation: 我很想卖给你一些，但最近已经卖光了。这就是它的魅力所在！光这一带就有三百二十八个人证实过，绝对错不了！

english: Nine out of Ten poisoners prefer it in controlled tests!
translation: 在受控测试中，十个毒药使用者里有九个更偏爱它！

english: Perhaps I can take your name and add it to our mailing list of poison users? We will only send you information related to the use of poison and other Peter Potter Products!
translation: 也许我可以记下你的名字，把你加到我们的毒药用户邮件列表里？我们只会向你发送与毒药使用及其他彼得.波特产品相关的信息！

english: Uh... no, it's ok. Really.
translation: 呃……不用了，真的。

english: Who did you sell Poison to at the house?
translation: 你在那房子里把毒药卖给了谁？

english: Well, Peter Potter's Patented Multi Purpose Poison is a product of such obvious quality that I am glad to say I managed to sell a bottle to each of the Sinclairs!
translation: 嗯，彼得.波特的专利多用途毒药是一种品质如此明显的产品，我很高兴地说，我成功地向每个辛克莱尔家族成员都卖出了一瓶！

english: Anna, Bob, Carol, David, Elizabeth and Frank all bought a bottle! In fact they bought the last of my supplies!
translation: 安娜、鲍勃、卡罗尔、大卫、伊丽莎白和弗兰克都买了一瓶！事实上，他们买走了我最后一批存货！

english: Maybe I can take your name and address and I will personally come and visit you when stocks return?
translation: 也许我可以记下你的名字和地址，等补货到的时候我亲自来找你？

english: Uh... no, it's ok.
translation: 呃……不用了，没关系。

english: Can I buy some Poison?
translation: 我能买点毒药吗？

english: I'm afraid I am totally out of stock at the moment after my successful trip to the Sinclairs' House the other day.
translation: 恐怕我现在完全没货了，前几天去辛克莱尔庄园那趟生意太好了。

english: But don't worry! Our factories are working overtime to produce Peter Potter's Patented Multi Purpose Poison!
translation: 但别担心！我们的工厂正在加班加点生产彼得.波特的专利多用途毒药！

english: Possibly the finest multi purpose poison and cleaner yet available to the general market.
translation: 这很可能是目前市面上能买到的最好的多用途毒药兼清洁剂。

english: And its unique fragrance makes it the number one choice for cleaners and exterminators the whole country over!
translation: 它独特的香气使它成为全国清洁工和灭虫者的首选！

english: I have this pot I found at the murder scene...
translation: 我有个在案发现场找到的罐子……

english: Hmmm... yes, that smells exactly like my Patented Multi Purpose Poison, but I don't see how it could be. It quite clearly says on the label of all bottles
translation: 嗯……对，闻起来和我的专利多用途毒药一模一样，但我不明白怎么会是。所有瓶子的标签上都清清楚楚写着

english: 'Not to be taken internally - EXTREMELY POISONOUS'.
translation: “不可内服——剧毒”。

english: Perhaps someone else put it in his wine?
translation: 也许有人把它倒进了他的酒里？

english: Yes... I suppose that could have happened...
translation: 对……我想是有可能……

english: Why'd you buy poison the other day?
translation: 你前几天为什么要买毒药？

english: That useless Gardener Stanford has let his compost heap fester. It's an eyesore to the garden! So I bought some poison from a travelling salesman so that I could kill off some of the wildlife living in it.
translation: 那个没用的园丁斯坦福把他那个堆肥堆弄得臭烘烘的。简直有碍花园观瞻！所以我从行商那里买了点毒药，想杀掉里面的一些虫子。

english: What's it to you anyway?
translation: 关你什么事？

english: If you absolutely must know, we had a problem with the beehive in the garden, and as all of our servants are so pathetically useless, I decided I would deal with it myself. So I did.
translation: 如果你非要知道的话，我们花园里的蜂箱出了问题，而我们的仆人们又都那么没用，所以我决定自己动手处理。就这么干了。

english: I don't see what on earth it has to do with you, but the drain outside was
translation: 我不明白这跟你有什么关系，但是外面的排水沟

english: blocked, and as nobody else here has the intelligence to even unblock a simple drain I felt I had to do it myself.
translation: 堵住了，而且这里其他人连简单的排水沟都疏通不了，我觉得只能自己动手了。

english: There was a nest of spiders upstairs between the two servants' quarters. Obviously I had to kill them before our pathetic servants whined at my father some more.
translation: 楼上两个仆人房间之间有一窝蜘蛛。显然，我必须在那些没用的仆人再向我父亲抱怨之前把它们干掉。

english: Honestly, it's like they expect to be treated like royalty! If I had my way I would fire the whole workshy lot of them!
translation: 老实说，他们好像以为自己是贵族！要让我做主，我早就把这帮懒骨头全解雇了！

english: There was a nest of mosquitos under the fountain in the garden, which I killed with poison the other day. You can see for yourself if you're capable of managing that, which I somehow doubt.
translation: 前几天花园喷泉底下有一窝蚊子，我用毒药把它们杀死了。你自己去看看就知道了，不过我很怀疑你能不能做到。

english: I hate mosquitos!
translation: 我讨厌蚊子！

english: Doesn't everyone?
translation: 谁不讨厌呢？

english: Would you like to buy some? I'm kind of strapped for cash right now, I'll sell it to you cheap, it's hardly been used at all.
translation: 想买点吗？我现在手头有点紧，便宜卖给你，几乎没用过。

english: I just used a bit to clean that family crest outside up a bit. Do you think I can get much money For the family crest, actually? It's cleaned up a bit now.
translation: 我只用了一点来清理外面的那个家徽。你觉得那个家徽能卖不少钱吗？现在它已经干净多了。

english: Do you know why so much poison was bought recently?
translation: 你知道为什么最近买了这么多毒药吗？

english: Well, I do know Frank bought some poison recently to clean the family crest that's outside.
translation: 嗯，我知道弗兰克最近买了些毒药来清理外面的家徽。

english: It's very old and rusty, and I couldn't clean it myself, so he said he would buy some cleaner and clean it himself. He probably just got some from that Poison Salesman who came to the door the other day...
translation: 它非常旧而且生锈了，我自己清洁不了，所以他说他会买些清洁剂自己清理。他可能只是从那个前几天上门的毒药商人那里弄了一些……

english: You'd really have to ask him though.
translation: 但你真的得去问他才行。

english: Well, I do know that Elizabeth was extremely annoyed by the mosquito nest under the fountain in the garden, and was going to do something about it. I suspect any poison she bought would have been
translation: 嗯，我知道伊丽莎白对花园喷泉下的蚊子巢非常恼火，打算处理一下。我怀疑她买的任何毒药都足够

english: enough to get rid of it. A Good job too, I hate mosquitos.
translation: 把蚊子清干净。干得好，我也讨厌蚊子。

english: Yeah, so do I.
translation: 是啊，我也是。

english: You'd really have to ask her though.
translation: 但你真的得去问她才行。

english: I told Carol to buy some from that strange poison salesman and clean the drains before they began to smell any worse. She was the one who blocked them in the first place with a load
translation: 我让卡罗尔从那个奇怪的毒药商人那里买点毒药，在排水沟变臭之前清理一下。当初就是她把排水沟堵住的，不知道为啥买了

english: of beans that she bought for some reason. There were far too many to eat, and they were almost rotten when she bought them anyway! You'd really have to ask her though.
translation: 一大堆豆子。那些豆子多得根本吃不完，而且买的时候都快烂了！但你真的得去问她才行。

english: I overheard Anna saying to Stanford that if he didn't do something about the state of his compost heap, she was going to.
translation: 我无意中听到安娜对斯坦福说，如果他不管管他的堆肥堆，她就要动手了。

english: She really doesn't get on well with Stanford. I really have no idea why. You'd really have to ask her though.
translation: 她和斯坦福处得真的很不好。我真不知道为什么。但你真的得去问她才行。

english: Well, I know David said that he was going to do something about the spiders' nest that's between the two servants' quarters upstairs.
translation: 嗯，我知道大卫说过，他要处理楼上两个仆从房间之间的那个蜘蛛巢。

english: He made a big deal about it to Mary the Maid, calling her useless and incompetent. I felt quite sorry for her actually. You'd really have to ask him though.
translation: 他对女仆玛丽大吵大闹，说她没用又无能。说实话，我还挺同情她的。但你真的得去问他才行。

english: Well, Bob mentioned to me the other day he wanted to get rid of the bees in that hive over there. I think I saw him buying poison
translation: 嗯，鲍勃前几天跟我提起，他想除掉那边蜂巢里的蜜蜂。我好像看到他从

english: from that poison salesman the other day. I assume it was to sort out those bees. You'd really have to ask him though.
translation: 那个毒药商人那里买了毒药。我猜他是为了处理那些蜜蜂。但你真的得去问他才行。

english: I have proof that it wasn't any of the servants!
translation: 我有证据证明不是任何仆从干的！

english: All the servants dress in black so it couldn't have been one of them.
translation: 所有仆从都穿黑色衣服，所以不可能是他们中的任何一个。

english: That's some good work there. I guess it wasn't a servant. You still haven't proved who did do it though.
translation: 干得不错。看来不是仆从了。但你还没证明是谁干的。

english: I have proof that Anna is lying about the poison.
translation: 我有证据证明安娜在毒药的事上撒谎。

english: Oh really? How did you get that?
translation: 哦，真的？你是怎么得到的？

english: I have proof that Bob is lying about the poison.
translation: 我有证据证明鲍勃在毒药的事上撒谎。

english: I have proof that Carol is lying about the poison.
translation: 我有证据证明卡罗尔在毒药的事上撒谎。

english: I have proof that David is lying about the poison.
translation: 我有证据证明大卫在毒药的事上撒谎。

english: I have proof that Elizabeth is lying about the poison.
translation: 我有证据证明伊丽莎白在毒药的事上撒谎。

english: I have proof that Frank is lying about the poison.
translation: 我有证据证明弗兰克在毒药的事上撒谎。

english: Hmm. That's some good detective work there. We need more evidence before we can close the case though. Keep up the good work!
translation: 嗯。侦查工作干得不错。不过我们还需要更多证据才能结案。继续加油！

english: I have the finger prints of the culprit!
translation: 我有凶手的指纹！

english: I have Anna's finger prints here. You can see for yourself they match the finger prints on the murder weapon exactly.
translation: 我这里有安娜的指纹。你可以亲眼看看，它们和凶器上的指纹完全吻合。

english: I have Bob's finger prints here. You can see for yourself they match the finger prints on the murder weapon exactly.
translation: 我这里有鲍勃的指纹。你可以亲眼看看，它们和凶器上的指纹完全吻合。

english: I have Carol's finger prints here. You can see for yourself they match the finger prints on the murder weapon exactly.
translation: 我这里有卡罗尔的指纹。你可以亲眼看看，它们和凶器上的指纹完全吻合。

english: I have David's finger prints here. You can see for yourself they match the finger prints on the murder weapon exactly.
translation: 我这里有大卫的指纹。你可以亲眼看看，它们和凶器上的指纹完全吻合。

english: I have Elizabeth's finger prints here. You can see for yourself they match the finger prints on the murder weapon exactly.
translation: 我这里有伊丽莎白的指纹。你可以亲眼看看，它们和凶器上的指纹完全吻合。

english: I have Frank's finger prints here. You can see for yourself they match the finger prints on the murder weapon exactly.
translation: 我这里有弗兰克的指纹。你可以亲眼看看，它们和凶器上的指纹完全吻合。

english: ... I'm impressed. How on earth did you think of something like that? I've never heard of such a technique for finding criminals before!
translation: ……真是令人印象深刻。你到底是怎么想出这种办法的？我以前从没听说过这种抓捕罪犯的技术！

english: This will come in very handy in the future but we can't arrest someone on just this. I'm afraid you'll still need to find more evidence before we can close this case completely.
translation: 这将来会非常有用，但我们不能仅凭这个就逮捕人。恐怕你还需要找到更多证据，我们才能完全结案。

english: I have conclusive proof who the killer was.
translation: 我有决定性的证据证明谁是杀手。

english: You do? That's excellent work. Let's hear it then.
translation: 你有？干得漂亮。那说来听听。

english: I don't think it was an intruder, and I don't think Lord Sinclair was killed by being stabbed.
translation: 我不认为是入侵者干的，而且我觉得辛克莱尔领主不是被刺死的。

english: Hmmm? Really? Why not?
translation: 嗯？真的吗？为什么？

english: Nobody heard the guard dog barking, which it would have if it had been an intruder who was responsible.
translation: 没人听到看门狗叫，如果是入侵者干的，它肯定会叫。

english: Nobody heard any signs of a struggle either. I think the knife was there to throw suspicion away from the real culprit.
translation: 也没人听到打斗的动静。我觉得那把刀是为了转移对真正凶手的怀疑。

english: Yes, that makes sense. But who did do it then?
translation: 是的，有道理。但那是谁干的呢？

english: Yes, I'd have to agree with that... but we need more evidence!
translation: 是的，我同意……但我们还需要更多证据！

english: Excellent work - have you considered a career as a detective? But I'm afraid it's still not quite enough...
translation: 干得好——你有没有考虑过当侦探？但恐怕这还不够……

english: Yes. There's no doubt about it. It must have been Anna who killed her father. All of the guards must congratulate you on your excellent work in helping us to solve this case.
translation: 是的。毫无疑问。一定是安娜杀了她的父亲。所有守卫都必须祝贺你，感谢你出色的工作，帮助我们破获此案。

english: Yes. There's no doubt about it. It must have been Bob who killed his father. All of the guards must congratulate you on your excellent work in helping us to solve this case.
translation: 是的。毫无疑问。一定是鲍勃杀了他的父亲。所有守卫都必须祝贺你，感谢你出色的工作，帮助我们破获此案。

english: Yes. There's no doubt about it. It must have been Carol who killed her father. All of the guards must congratulate you on your excellent work in helping us to solve this case.
translation: 是的。毫无疑问。一定是卡罗尔杀了她的父亲。所有守卫都必须祝贺你，感谢你出色的工作，帮助我们破获此案。

english: Yes. There's no doubt about it. It must have been David who killed his father. All of the guards must congratulate you on your excellent work in helping us to solve this case.
translation: 是的。毫无疑问。一定是大卫杀了他的父亲。所有守卫都必须祝贺你，感谢你出色的工作，帮助我们破获此案。

english: Yes. There's no doubt about it. It must have been Elizabeth who killed her father. All of the guards must congratulate you on your excellent work in helping us to solve this case.
translation: 是的。毫无疑问。一定是伊丽莎白杀了她的父亲。所有守卫都必须祝贺你，感谢你出色的工作，帮助我们破获此案。

english: Yes. There's no doubt about it. It must have been Frank who killed his father. All of the guards must congratulate you on your excellent work in helping us to solve this case.
translation: 是的。毫无疑问。一定是弗兰克杀了他的父亲。所有守卫都必须祝贺你，感谢你出色的工作，帮助我们破获此案。

english: We don't have many murders here in Gielinor and I'm afraid we wouldn't have been able to solve it by ourselves. We will hold her here under house arrest until such time as we bring her to trial.
translation: 吉列诺很少发生谋杀案，恐怕我们自己解决不了。我们会将她软禁在这里，直到送她受审。

english: You have our gratitude, and I'm sure the rest of the family's as well, in helping to apprehend the murderer. I'll just take the evidence from you now.
translation: 我们感激你，相信家族其他成员也一样，谢谢你帮助我们逮捕了凶手。我现在就把证据从你这里收走。

english: Please accept this reward from the family!
translation: 请收下家族的这份奖励！

english: Excellent work on solving the murder! All of the guards I know are very impressed, and don't worry, we have the murderer under guard until they can be taken to trial.
translation: 破案干得漂亮！我认识的守卫们都印象深刻，别担心，我们已派人看管凶手，直到送交审判。

english: Is there anything else I can do?
translation: 还有什么我能做的吗？

english: No, your work here is done.
translation: 没了，你在这儿的工作已经完成了。

english: Oh, it you again. I bin thinking 'bout you.
translation: 哦，又是你啊。我一直在想你。

english: I probably won't feel happy for knowing the answer to this, but why have you been thinking about me?
translation: 知道答案我大概也不会开心，但你为什么一直在想我？

english: Ohhh, Burntmeat not finished thinking yet. Maybe next time you come here I tell you.
translation: 哦，烧肉还没想完呢。也许下次你来的时候我再告诉你。

english: Well, Burntmeat need big important job doing, and you bin helpful before. You fetch Burntmeat tasty human for stew that time.
translation: 好吧，烧肉需要做一件很重要的工作，你以前帮过忙。那次你帮烧肉弄来了鲜嫩的人肉做炖菜。

english: You remember you come in here asking me questions about goutweed, yah?
translation: 你还记得你之前来这儿问我关于痛风草的事吗？

english: Yes, you told me trolls had picked it all until there wasn't any left.
translation: 记得，你告诉我巨魔把痛风草都采光了，一点不剩。

english: Yah. But Burntmeat is hearing where goutweed is growing again.
translation: 是啊。但烧肉听说痛风草又长出来了。

english: Oh? How did you hear that?
translation: 哦？你怎么听说的？

english: Well, I was cooking dis adventurer...
translation: 嗯，我当时正在煮这个冒险者……

english: You like my armour? If you let me go, I'll let you keep it!
translation: 你喜欢我的盔甲吗？放我走，我就把它送给你！

english: Nah, silly red metal just hurt troll teeth.
translation: 不，傻乎乎的红色金属只会硌巨魔的牙。

english: Huh? What dis? You got goutweed here!
translation: 嗯？这是什么？你这里有痛风草！

english: You can have that too! Just let me go!
translation: 那个也给你！放我走吧！

english: Only place find goutweed is my storeroom. You bin stealing?
translation: 唯一能找到痛风草的地方是我的储藏室。你是不是偷了？

english: No! I-I- I grew that myself!
translation: 没有！我——我自己种的！

english: What say? Goutweed not grow now. Trolls pick it all.
translation: 你说啥？痛风草现在不长。巨魔都采光了。

english: No, no; I grew it.
translation: 不，不，是我种的。

english: Humans grow goutweed? You lying to Burntmeat!
translation: 人类能种痛风草？你在骗烧肉！

english: You can get the gout tuber from Tai Bwo Wannai Village. Go there and ask Murcaily. Then you plant it in a farming patch.
translation: 你可以去泰博瓦纳村弄到痛风草茎。去那里找穆凯利。然后把它种在种植地里。

english: Mmmm. Burntmeat think that sound good. But Burntmeat cook you first.
translation: 嗯。烧肉觉得听起来不错。但烧肉先把你煮了。

english: Oh b...
translation: 哦，别……

english: You killed that poor chap! What had he ever done to you?
translation: 你杀了那个可怜的家伙！他对你做了什么？

english: Well, he give me mighty sore tummy later. I think I forget to wash his feet.
translation: 嗯，他后来让我肚子疼得厉害。我想我忘了洗他的脚。

english: Anyway, why did you tell me about all that?
translation: 总之，你告诉我这些干嘛？

english: Ah! Der man I cooked, he say humans growing goutweed again. Now, if humans growing goutweed, maybe trolls can grow goutweed too, yah?
translation: 啊！我煮的那个人说人类又开始种痛风草了。现在，如果人类能种痛风草，也许巨魔也能种，对吧？

english: You want to become a farmer?
translation: 你想当农夫？

english: No, not me. Burntmeat stick to what he best at doing. But I got me an assistant wanting to learn farming. He called My Arm.
translation: 不，不是俺。烧肉只做他最擅长的事。但俺有个助理想学农业。他叫"我的手臂"。

english: Your assistant's called WHAT?
translation: 你的助理叫什么？

english: He called My Arm.
translation: 他叫"我的手臂"。
我的……？

english: My Arm.
translation: "我的手臂"。

english: Yep, My Arm.
translation: 是的，"我的手臂"。

english: But why is he called...
translation: 但他为什么叫……

english: It a perfectly good troll name.
translation: 这是个很好的巨魔名字。

english: Alright, enough! What do you want me to do for this Arm person?
translation: 好了，够了！你想让我为这个叫“手臂”的人做什么？

english: You gonna help My Arm grow goutweed.
translation: 你要帮"我的手臂"种痛风草。

english: Look, you're a vicious monster who eats innocent people! Why should I ever help you again?
translation: 听着，你是个吃无辜人的凶残怪物！我凭什么再帮你？

english: See, [player name], if My Arm learns to grow goutweed, I get as much goutweed as I ever want. If dat happens, I promise you I never cook another human in my life.
translation: 你看，[player name]，如果"我的手臂"学会种痛风草，俺就能想要多少痛风草就有多少。如果那样的话，俺向你保证，俺这辈子再也不煮人了。

english: Never?
translation: 再也不？

english: Never. Burntmeat promises. Goat taste just as good as human if you add enough goutweed. Now you go talk to My Arm; he tell you what to do.
translation: 绝不。烧肉保证。只要加足够的痛风草，山羊的味道和人类一样好。现在你去找"我的手臂"谈谈；他会告诉你该怎么做。

english: Can I have all that dragon stuff as my reward?
translation: 我能把那些龙族装备当奖励吗？

english: What dragon stuff you talking 'bout?
translation: 你说什么龙族装备？

english: When you were telling me about the man you cooked who talked about goutweed, there was loads of valuable stuff on the floor. Can I have it? PLEASE!
translation: 当你告诉我你煮的那个人谈到痛风草时，地上有大量值钱的东西。能给我吗？求你了！

english: Sorry, Player - Burntmeat chucked dat stuff away. It no good to eat. Red metal clothes hurt troll teeth, and big whip thing get stuck in throat.
translation: 抱歉，玩家——烧肉把那些东西扔了。不好吃。红色金属衣服硌巨魔的牙，大鞭子东西卡喉咙。

english: Gah! You're worse than the old man who wouldn't give me his hat!
translation: 啊！你比那个不肯给我帽子的老头还坏！

english: You go help My Arm now.
translation: 你现在去帮"我的手臂"。

english: Alright, I'll lend him a hand. But you'd better keep that promise about not cooking any more people!
translation: 好吧，我帮他一把。但你最好遵守承诺，不再煮人！

english: You're disgusting! I'm not helping you again.
translation: 你真恶心！我不会再帮你了。

english: Aww, now you done hurt Burntmeat's feelings.
translation: 啊，你伤了烧肉的心了。

english: If you not paying attention, Burntmeat not going to talk to you!
translation: 如果你不注意听，烧肉就不跟你说话了！

english: You were about to tell me about some job...
translation: 你刚才要跟我说什么差事……

english: Yep, I remember. See, when you come here asking me 'bout goutweed dat other time, I tell you how we trolls had picked it all, and it not grow no more.
translation: 对，我记得。你看，上次你来问我痛风草的事时，我告诉过你我们巨魔把草都采光了，它不再长了。

english: Right, you told me the only goutweed anywhere in the world was in your storage room.
translation: 对，你告诉我世界上唯一的痛风草在你储藏室里。

english: You get on with helping My Arm, yah?
translation: 你继续帮"我的手臂"，好吗？

english: Okay, okay, I'll do it.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我去做。

english: Before I start helping you with the whole farming thing, could you just explain why you're called My Arm?
translation: 在我开始帮你搞农业之前，你能解释一下你为什么叫"我的手臂"吗？

english: Dat's easy! You know we trolls named after der first thing wot we try to eat when we young?
translation: 这简单！你知道我们巨魔是以小时候第一次尝试吃的东西命名的吗？

english: Okay, so what did you try to eat?
translation: 好吧，那你尝试吃了什么？

english: It were my dad's arm. I remember it look so big holding me, I just gotta give it a chew. So he done named me My Arm.
translation: 那是我爸爸的手臂。我记得它抱着我的时候看起来那么大，我就忍不住咬了一口。所以他就给我取名叫"我的手臂"。

english: And no one thinks it's a silly name?
translation: 没人觉得这是个傻名字吗？

english: Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words! I met some [man/woman] earlier wot called [himself/herself] [other player's name].
translation: 嗯，我见过更糟的。大多数经过这里的人类，名字里全是数字和根本不是词的东西！我之前遇到个[男人/女人]，自称[其他玩家名字]。

english: Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words!
translation: 嗯，我见过更糟的。大多数经过这里的人类，名字里全是数字和根本不是词的东西！

english: Okay, okay, I'm sorry!(snicker)
translation: 好吧，好吧，我道歉！（偷笑）

english: If you happy 'bout my name now, I tell you 'bout dis farming job.
translation: 如果你现在对我的名字满意了，我就告诉你这个农业差事。

english: Alright, My Arm(snicker snicker), tell me about it.
translation: 好吧，"我的手臂"（窃笑窃笑），跟我说说吧。

english: Okieday. Now, I heard 'bout dese gouty thingies before. Da cooks up on Death Plateau were saying dey cooked a man wot had a lump in his pocket dat tasted like goutweed, but wasn't goutweed.
translation: 好的。我之前听说过这些痛风玩意儿。死亡高原上的厨师们说他们煮了一个人，他口袋里有个块状物，味道像痛风草，但不是痛风草。

english: My Arm is thinking this is da thingy we need.
translation: "我的手臂"觉得这就是我们需要的东西。

english: So what do we do about it?
translation: 那我们该怎么办？

english: You go to Death Plateau and search da big cooking pot for da goutweedy lump!
translation: 你去死亡高原，搜索那个大烹饪锅，找痛风草块！

english: There's no need for that. I already have a tuber. Do you want to see it?
translation: 没必要。我已经有一个茎块了。你想看看吗？

english: Just do as I say, yah?
translation: 照我说的做，好吗？

english: But there's no point in worrying about some weird lump on Death Plateau when I've got a tuber.
translation: 但我已经有茎块了，没必要担心死亡高原上什么奇怪的块状物。

english: I not want to see your tuber! My Arm is organised troll who gets one thing done at a time. I need da goutweedy lump from da cooking pot on Death Plateau.
translation: 俺不想看你的茎块！"我的手臂"是个有条理的巨魔，一次只做一件事。俺需要死亡高原上烹饪锅里的痛风草块。

english: Why do I need to go there? Can't I just get you a proper gout tuber?
translation: 为什么非要去那里？我不能直接给你弄个真正的痛风草茎吗？

english: Never mind tubers. You fetch me da goutweedy lump from da cooking pot of Dung 'n' Ash on Death Plateau.
translation: 别管茎块了。你去给俺从死亡高原上的‘粪便与灰烬’烹饪锅里拿痛风草块。

english: Go see Burntmeat - he give good directions for getting there.
translation: 去找烧肉——他会告诉你怎么去那里。

english: You got da goutweedy lump yet?
translation: 你拿到痛风草块了吗？

english: You go getting yourself a move on, yah? My Arm getting bored. Ask Burntmeat if you needin' help findin' da place.
translation: 你快点动起来，好吗？"我的手臂"要无聊了。如果你需要帮忙找地方，就问烧肉。

english: What was it you wanted?
translation: 你想要什么来着？

english: You is a bit forgetful. If you like, My Arm give you nice tap on head to clear out cobbiewebs from brain.
translation: 你有点健忘。要是你愿意，我的手臂可以轻轻敲一下你的脑袋，把你脑子里的蜘蛛网清理干净。

english: No! Just tell me what it was you wanted.
translation: 别！就告诉我你想要什么。

english: Okieday, maybe some other time. Now, what you gotta do is go to Death Plateau and fetch me da goutweedy lump from da big cooking pot.
translation: 好吧，也许下次。现在，你要做的是去死亡高原，从大烹饪锅里给我拿痛风草块。

english: Oh yes, how could I forget?
translation: 哦对，我怎么会忘呢？

english: Perhaps you is a bit thick in da head. Ask Burntmeat if you needin' help findin' da place.
translation: 也许你脑袋有点笨。如果需要帮忙找地方，就问烧肉。

english: How you an' My Arm getting on with da goutweed?
translation: 你和"我的手臂"种痛风草进展如何？

english: He wants me to fetch something from a cauldron on Death Plateau.
translation: 他想让我去死亡高原上的一个大锅里拿点东西。

english: Death Plateau, huh? Dat's quite a long way. Do you know how to get dere?
translation: 死亡高原，嗯？那挺远的。你知道怎么去吗？

english: I am a navigational genius; I'll be fine.
translation: 我是导航天才；我没事。

english: Okieday. Just you mind out for dem troll cooks on Death Plateau - dey not as friendly as Burntmeat.
translation: 好吧。你小心死亡高原上的那些巨魔厨师——他们可没烧肉这么友好。

english: This place is a maze - got any advice?
translation: 这地方像个迷宫——有什么建议吗？

english: Okieday, listen up an' Burntmeat tell you da best way to Death Plateau...
translation: 好吧，听好了，烧肉告诉你到死亡高原的最佳路线……

english: You go out da north door of my kitchen an' walk all da way down da corridor.
translation: 你从我厨房的北门出去，一直沿着走廊走。

english: Turn right at da end, and go down da stairs to da prison where we keep meat fresh.
translation: 在尽头右转，下楼梯到监狱，我们在那里保鲜肉。

english: A prison where you keep meat fresh?
translation: 一个用来保鲜肉的监狱？

english: Yup. Can't keep people in crates like goutweed, dey go all dead an' smelly. Burntmeat tried it.
translation: 对。不能像痛风草那样把人放在板条箱里，他们会死掉发臭。烧肉试过。

english: Walk straight through da prison. Da back door of da Stronghold is at da south end.
translation: 直走穿过监狱。要塞的后门在南边。

english: Okay, so I've gone northwards up the corridor, down the stairs, then southwards through the prison.
translation: 好的，所以我沿着走廊向北走，下楼梯，然后向南穿过监狱。

english: Dat is correct. Now you gettin' outside...
translation: 没错。现在你到外面……

english: When you outside, you turn left an' go long way south-east along path.
translation: 到外面后，你左转，沿着小路向东南方向走很远。

english: At the end, you gotta turn left for Death Plateau. You got da special boots, so you gonna be okay on da rocks there.
translation: 到头后，你得左转去死亡高原。你有那双特殊的靴子，所以在岩石上没问题。

english: At the end, you gotta turn left for Death Plateau. But watch out for da tricky rocks - maybe you gonna have trouble climbing dem.
translation: 最后，你得左转去死亡高原。不过要小心那些狡猾的岩石——你爬的时候可能会遇到麻烦。

english: How do I get to Death Plateau if I can't climb the rocks?
translation: 如果我爬不上那些岩石，怎么去死亡高原？

english: Burntmeat heard where da humans going on Death Plateau wear funny boots to help climb rocks. Dey get da boots from little dwarf woman wot lives near da plateau. Turn right to go to her house.
translation: 烧肉听说去死亡高原的人类都穿着奇怪的靴子来爬岩石。他们是从住在高原附近的一个矮人小女人那里弄到的靴子。右转就能到她的房子。

english: Thanks, you've been remarkably helpful, considering that you're a horrible monster who eats innocent people.
translation: 谢谢，考虑到你是个吃无辜人的可怕怪物，你帮了大忙了。

english: Aww! You hurry up an' get My Arm what he wanting.
translation: 啊！你快点去给"我的手臂"拿他想要的东西。

english: Ow - HOT!
translation: 哎哟——好烫！

english: So far he's had me go to Death Plateau to fetch a weird lump from the cauldron there.
translation: 到目前为止，他让我去死亡高原从那里的大锅里取一个奇怪的块状物。

english: Da cooks on da plateau not as good as Burntmeat.
translation: 高原上的厨师可没烧肉做得好。

english: Yes, I have it. Here, take the thing.
translation: 是的，我拿到了。来，拿着这东西。

english: Huh. It looking a bit tatty...
translation: 嗯……看起来有点破旧……

english: So are you.
translation: 你也一样。

english: ... but it smelling like goutweed.
translation: ……但它闻起来像痛风草。

english: You ate it!
translation: 你把它吃了！

english: Yep, it tasting like goutweed too.
translation: 没错，尝起来也像痛风草。

english: Well, now My Arm know dese goutweedy lump things exist, you help me grow one, yah?
translation: 嗯，现在"我的手臂"知道有痛风草块这种东西了，你帮我种一个，好吗？

english: Alright. Where do you need me to start?
translation: 好吧。你需要我从哪里开始？

english: My Arm done tried farming before. I stick all kindsa things in da ground, but nothing ever grow, not even when I water 'em.
translation: "我的手臂"以前试过农业。我把各种东西插进地里，但什么都没长出来，即使我浇水也没用。

english: What did you plant?
translation: 你种了什么？

english: I bin planting everythin', [player name]. Sticks, rocks, dead goats... you name it.
translation: 我什么都种过，[player name]。树枝、石头、死山羊……你能想到的。

english: And none of those things grew?
translation: 那些东西一样都没长出来？

english: Nope, not even a smidgen. My Arm dug 'em up again to see.
translation: 没有，一丁点都没长。"我的手臂"又把它们挖出来看了。

english: So did you try getting help from someone who knows about farming?
translation: 那你有没有找懂农业的人帮忙？

english: Yah, My Arm found a nice farmer and ate him, but he not help much. He taste kinda boring too.
translation: 是啊，"我的手臂"找到了一个不错的农夫并吃了他，但他没帮上什么忙。他味道也有点无聊。

english: You're not very clever, are you?
translation: 你不太聪明，对吧？

english: My ol' mum say I clever enough. What you getting at?
translation: 我老妈说我够聪明了。你想说什么？

english: Oh, nothing. Maybe I should see where you've been doing all this farming?
translation: 哦，没什么。也许我应该看看你一直在哪里搞这些农业？

english: Sure t'ing, Player. I show you...
translation: 当然可以，玩家。我带你去……

english: Hurry up, <player name>!
translation: 快点，<玩家名字>！

english: Dis is Troll Generals' cave.
translation: 这是巨魔将军的洞穴。

english: Climb up 'ere.
translation: 爬上来。

english: You done good fetching dat goutweedy lump. My Arm very impressed.
translation: 你拿回那个痛风草块做得很好。"我的手臂"印象深刻。

english: So far he's had me fetch some kind of lump from a pot on Death Plateau. I can't imagine what he'll want next.
translation: 到目前为止，他让我从死亡高原上的一个罐子里拿了一个什么块。我想象不出他接下来会要什么。

english: Huh... Let me know when we got goutweed growing.
translation: 嗯……等我们种出痛风草了告诉我。

english: Yeah, whatever.
translation: 好吧，随便。

english: Dis is my quiet place. No other trolls come up here. It where I bin trying to grow stuff.
translation: 这是我的清静之地。没有其他巨魔上来这里。这是我试着种东西的地方。

english: It's a bit windy up here.
translation: 这里风有点大。

english: Dat is good, cos you smellin' distinctly whiffy. It like you got all dung in your pockets or something. Or maybe you needing a wash.
translation: 那是好事，因为你闻起来特别臭。就好像你口袋里全是粪便什么的。或者你该洗个澡了。

english: I wash more than enough!
translation: 我洗得够多了！

english: Okieday, maybe My Arm imagining da smell.
translation: 好吧，也许是"我的手臂"想象出来的味道。

english: Yup, but My Arm not mind. We trolls not get blown around by wind like diddy little humans.
translation: 是的，但"我的手臂"不介意。我们巨魔不会被风吹得东倒西歪，像那些小不点人类一样。

english: So you think you could grow things here?
translation: 所以你觉得你能在这里种东西？

english: I t'ink so, yah. I got book 'bout farming for you to read.
translation: 我觉得可以，是啊。我有一本关于农业的书给你看。

english: Where in the world did YOU get a book?
translation: 你究竟从哪里弄到一本书的？

english: Dat farmer I ate had a book with him. My Arm is hopin' you knows how to read.
translation: 俺吃掉的那个农夫身上有本书。"我的手臂"希望你会读。

english: Farmer Gricoller's Farming Manual?
translation: 农夫格里科勒的农业手册？

english: My Arm not know what in book, so you read it, yuh? Perhaps it tell you how to grow t'ings up on mountain.
translation: "我的手臂"不知道书里写了什么，所以你来读，好吗？也许它会告诉你如何在山上种东西。

english: Alright, I'll have a look inside.
translation: 好吧，我看看里面。

english: You know how to read book I got off farmer?
translation: 你知道怎么读我从农夫那里弄来的书吗？

english: Of course I can read it! Just give me a moment.
translation: 我当然能读！给我一点时间。

english: If you forget how to read, it not a problem. My Arm give you little tap on head and maybe you remember again, no trouble.
translation: 如果你忘了怎么读，没问题。"我的手臂"轻轻敲一下你的头，也许你就又想起来了，不麻烦。

english: No thanks, that won't be necessary.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，没那个必要。

english: Of course; I've been reading it.
translation: 当然；我一直在读。

english: Dat's good. Is it any use?
translation: 那很好。有用吗？

english: There's a useful section about preparing soil for growing crops. For a mountain area, it says we need to mix three buckets of camel dung and seven buckets of supercompost into the soil.
translation: 有一节关于准备土壤种植作物的内容很有用。对于山区，它说我们需要混合三桶骆驼粪便和七桶超级堆肥到土壤里。

english: Urgh. Dat's a lotta camel dung.
translation: 呃。那真是好多骆驼粪便。

english: Fortunately, I've got enough dung with me.
translation: 幸运的是，我身上带的粪便够多了。

english: My Arm not like to say so earlier, but you bin smellin' like you done a whoopsie.
translation: 我的手臂之前不想说，但你闻起来像是出了点岔子。

english: Have you any dung in the Stronghold I could use?
translation: 要塞里有我能用的粪便吗？

english: Why you think trolls keep dung in Stronghold? Do you keep dung in your house?
translation: 你为什么觉得巨魔会在要塞里存粪便？你会在自己家里存粪便吗？

english: It was worth a try.
translation: 值得一试。

english: You could go ask a camel for some dung. I bet dey got plenty.
translation: 你可以去找一头骆驼要点粪便。我打赌它们有很多。

english: Ask a camel for dung?
translation: 找骆驼要粪便？

english: Best way to get somefing: find someone who got plenty of it wot they don't want.
translation: 得到东西的最好办法：找一个有很多又不想要的人。

english: How handy - I've got an amulet that lets me talk to camels.
translation: 真巧——我有一个能让我和骆驼说话的护符。

english: Clever human. Off you go now.
translation: 聪明的人类。你现在去吧。

english: How handy - I'm already carrying my Camulet.
translation: 真巧——我已经带着我的骆驼护符了。

english: Okay, I guess it's time for me to dig that old Camulet out of the bank.
translation: 好吧，我想是时候从银行里翻出那个旧骆驼护符了。

english: That could help. Off you go now.
translation: 那可能有帮助。你现在去吧。

english: If only I still had that Camulet I got in that weird temple in the desert...
translation: 要是我还留着那个在沙漠奇怪神庙里得到的骆驼护符就好了……

english: Wot a shame; off you go now.
translation: 真可惜；你现在去吧。

english: Of course, it'd be silly for me to ask a camel. I can't talk to camels. But I do remember getting some camel dung before, in some desert town once...
translation: 当然，我去问骆驼是傻事。我不会和骆驼说话。但我记得以前在某个沙漠小镇弄到过一些骆驼粪便……

english: My Arm is sure you'll find some way to get dung out of a camel. Now trot along.
translation: 我的手臂确信你会找到办法从骆驼身上弄到粪便。现在快去吧。

english: You put all dat dung and stuff in da soil yet?
translation: 你把那些粪便和东西都放进土壤里了吗？

english: No, not yet. I'm working on it.
translation: 不，还没有。我正在努力。

english: You be getting move on, [player name].
translation: 你得快点行动了，[player name]。

english: I need a spade to dig the supercompost in properly.
translation: 我需要一把铲子来把超级堆肥好好翻进土里。

english: I'm not mixing dung into the soil with my hands! I need a spade to dig it in properly.
translation: 我才不会用手把粪便混进土壤里！我需要一把铲子来好好翻进去。

english: Unfortunately the book definitely said SUPERcompost.
translation: 不幸的是，书上明确写的是超级堆肥。

english: I don't think that's going to help just now.
translation: 我觉得那现在帮不上忙。

english: Great, that's enough supercompost.
translation: 太好了，超级堆肥够了。

english: I don't think it'll need any more supercompost.
translation: 我觉得不需要更多超级堆肥了。

english: Phew - that's enough dung.
translation: 呼——粪便够了。

english: I think I've given it enough dung already.
translation: 我觉得我已经给了它足够的粪便了。

english: My Arm can tend the patch himself. I'm not growing the goutweed for him.
translation: 我的手臂可以自己照料那块地。我不是为他种痛风草。

english: I've finished treating that soil patch for you.
translation: 我已经帮你处理完那块土壤种植地了。

english: Good, good. Always I bin wanting a farming patch to grow things in. Da soggy bits south of here, they not work at all.
translation: 好，好。我一直想要一块种植地来种东西。南边那些湿乎乎的地方根本不行。

english: So what do we need to do now?
translation: 那我们现在需要做什么？

english: Now we do like dat man say to Burntmeat. We gotta go to Tai Bwo Wannai Village and see Murcaily 'bout growing goutweed.
translation: 现在我们就像那个人对烧肉说的那样做。我们得去泰博瓦纳村找穆凯利谈谈种痛风草的事。

english: We don't need to go there. I've got a gout tuber.
translation: 我们不需要去那里。我有一个痛风草茎。

english: I not wanna be gettin' confused with your tuber. Man tell Burntmeat we need to go see Murcaily to grow goutweed, so dat where we going.
translation: 我可不想被你的茎搞糊涂。那个人告诉烧肉我们得去找穆凯利种痛风草，所以我们就去那里。

english: You really need to be more flexible.
translation: 你真的需要更灵活一点。

english: Trolls not flexible creatures. Humans too flexible; dey got little necks wot snap easy as anything.
translation: 巨魔不是灵活的动物。人类太灵活了；他们的小脖子一拧就断。

english: It's a long way to Tai Bwo Wannai Village. We're going to need a boat...
translation: 去泰博瓦纳村的路很远。我们需要一艘船……

english: What in the world is that THING?
translation: 那到底是什么东西？

english: That is My Arm. We'd like to go to Karamja.
translation: 那是"我的手臂"。我们想去卡拉姆詹岛。

english: This is your what?
translation: 这是你的什么？

english: He's a troll. His name is My Arm.
translation: 他是个巨魔。他的名字叫"我的手臂"。

english: Yup, My Arm.
translation: 是的，"我的手臂"。

english: Whose arm?
translation: 谁的手臂？

english: Never mind that now, we just want to go to Karamja. Can you take us?
translation: 现在别管那个了，我们只想去卡拉姆詹岛。你能带我们去吗？

english: It was my dad's arm.
translation: 那是我爸的手臂。

english: What about your dad's arm?
translation: 你爸的手臂怎么了？

english: My Arm tried to eat it.
translation: 我的手臂想把它吃掉。

english: Your arm did what?
translation: 你的手臂做了什么？

english: Will you take us to Karamja?
translation: 你能带我们去卡拉姆詹岛吗？

english: I don't think I want the mad troll.
translation: 我觉得我不想要那个疯巨魔。

english: Or his arm.
translation: 或者他的手臂。

english: Either you can take us to Karamja, or you can discuss it with My Arm.
translation: 要么你带我们去卡拉姆詹岛，要么你跟"我的手臂"谈谈。

english: Oh no, not your arm too...
translation: 哦不，别又是你的手臂……

english: So you'll take us?
translation: 所以你会带我们去？

english: Alright, just get the arm thing onto the ship.
translation: 好吧，只要让那个手臂家伙上船就行。

english: My Arm not liking dis.
translation: "我的手臂"不喜欢这样。

english: What's wrong with your ar... What's wrong with you?
translation: 你的手臂……你怎么了？

english: You ever hear stories of troll sailors or troll pirates?
translation: 你听过巨魔水手或巨魔海盗的故事吗？

english: Um... can't think of any just now.
translation: 嗯……现在想不起来。

english: Dat 'cos trolls don't like da sea. We kinda sink.
translation: 因为巨魔不喜欢海。我们会沉下去。

english: I'm sure I've met some trolls that lived in the sea. There's a Fishing Colony up in the north-west.
translation: 我肯定见过一些住在海里的巨魔。西北边有个钓鱼殖民地。

english: Aren't there... river trolls and sea trolls and things? They seem happy enough in the sea.
translation: 不是有……河巨魔和海巨魔之类的吗？它们在海里看起来挺开心的。

english: Them not proper trolls. Proper trolls live in mountains.
translation: 它们不是真正的巨魔。真正的巨魔住在山里。

english: But they look just like land trolls!
translation: 但它们看起来和陆地巨魔一模一样！

english: We trolls. Them not trolls. 'Nuff said.
translation: 我们是巨魔。它们不是巨魔。说完了。

english: Oh, please yourself!
translation: 哦，随你便！

english: No! Look - no land.
translation: 不！你看——没有陆地。

english: How 'bout now?
translation: 现在呢？

english: Still. No. Land.
translation: 还是。没有。陆地。

english: You gettin' angry with My Arm, huh?
translation: 你对"我的手臂"生气了，是吧？

english: Is it 'cos I is thick?
translation: 是因为我笨吗？

english: I'm not angry with you.
translation: 我没生你的气。

english: Are we dere now?
translation: 我们到了吗？

english: Urrrgh! My Arm feeling sick...
translation: 呃啊！"我的手臂"觉得恶心……

english: We will meet at dat village, yah?
translation: 我们在那个村子碰头，对吧？

english: Oh, he's gone. I hope he knows the way to Tai Bwo Wannai Village.
translation: 哦，他走了。希望他知道去泰博瓦纳村的路。

english: I think I'll come back another time.
translation: 我想我改天再来。

english: But... that thing?
translation: 但是……那个东西呢？

english: Oh, he'll be fine just standing here.
translation: 哦，他站在这儿就行了。

english: What we waitin' for here?
translation: 我们在这儿等什么呢？

english: I have to ask Captain Barnaby to let us onto his ship.
translation: 我得请求巴纳比船长让我们上他的船。

english: Okieday, My Arm gonna let you do the talking. He not seem to like me standin' here.
translation: 好吧，"我的手臂"让你来说话。他好像不喜欢我站在这儿。

english: Aaaaargh!
translation: 啊啊啊！

english: So dis is Tai Bwo Wannai Village, huh?
translation: 所以这就是泰博瓦纳村，是吧？

english: Yes, that's right. I've been here before when the villagers thought their village was cursed. I had to fetch some special herbs for their shaman.
translation: 是的，没错。我以前来过这里，当时村民们以为他们的村子被诅咒了。我不得不为他们的萨满去取一些特殊的草药。

english: You doin' a lot of favours for people. Is dere anything in it for you?
translation: 你帮了很多人忙。这对你有什么好处吗？

english: I usually get something. Except that time when Burntmeat made me fetch him a 'tasty human' for his stew. All he gave me was some burnt meat.
translation: 我通常能得到些东西。除了那次烧肉让我给他弄个'美味的人类'做炖菜，结果他只给了我一些烧焦的肉。

english: You not like Burntmeat's cooking?
translation: 你不喜欢烧肉的烹饪？

english: Believe it or not, I didn't like it at all.
translation: 信不信由你，我一点都不喜欢。

english: Dat a pity. He planning to give you more burnt meat when you done helpin' me. Maybe My Arm think of something better for you. But first you go find Murcaily - he gotta help us grow goutweed.
translation: 真可惜。他打算等你帮完我之后，再给你更多烧焦的肉。也许"我的手臂"会想点更好的东西给你。但你先去找穆凯利——他得帮我们种痛风草。

english: Murcaily, right.
translation: 穆凯利，好的。

english: You done spoken to Murcaily 'bout goutweed yet?
translation: 你跟穆凯利谈过痛风草的事了吗？

english: I'll get around to it.
translation: 我会去办的。

english: You slow. My Arm gettin' bored.
translation: 你真慢。"我的手臂"都等烦了。

english: Is there anything I can do for you, Bwana?
translation: 有什么我能帮你的吗，先生？

english: Have you seen My Arm around here?
translation: 你在这附近见过"我的手臂"吗？

english: Umm... Bwana... I can see both of them. They are attached to your shoulders, yes?
translation: 嗯……先生……我能看到它们两个。它们不是长在你肩膀上吗？

english: What? Oh, forget I said that! Have you seen a troll around here?
translation: 什么？哦，忘了我说的！你在这附近见过一个巨魔吗？

english: I do not know what one of those is, Bwana, but I am sure there are none in our village.
translation: 我不知道那是什么，先生，但我确定我们村里没有。

english: Dratted creature - where can he be? He was meant to be coming here.
translation: 该死的生物——他能在哪儿呢？他应该来这里的。

english: Well, Bwana, when I am looking for someone, I find it helps to think about where they may be. If your friend was travelling this way, he is surely between here and the place where you last saw him.
translation: 嗯，先生，我找人的时候，想想他们可能在哪儿会有帮助。如果你的朋友是往这边来的，那他肯定在你上次见到他的地方和这里之间。

english: Let's see... I saw him in Brimhaven, but he ran off. He was coming this way to your village.
translation: 让我想想……我在布尔哈文镇见过他，但他跑掉了。他是往你们村子这边来的。

english: Then perhaps you should look for your friend along the route to Brimhaven.
translation: 那你也许应该沿着去布尔哈文镇的路找找你的朋友。

english: A troll called My Arm wants a favour from you. He wants to grow goutweed and he thinks you can help.
translation: 一个叫"我的手臂"的巨魔想请你帮个忙。他想种痛风草，他觉得你能帮忙。

english: What's a troll? And what was that about your arm, Bwana?
translation: 什么是巨魔？还有你刚才说你的手臂怎么了，先生？

english: I really don't want to discuss it. Can you help this creature grow goutweed?
translation: 我真的不想讨论这个。你能帮这个生物种痛风草吗？

english: Goutweed? People grow it in farming patches all the time. Have you tried planting a gout tuber in your patch?
translation: 痛风草？人们经常在农业地块里种它。你试过在你的地块里种痛风草茎吗？

english: No, the silly troll won't listen. He had me bring him all the way down from the mountains to ask you about it.
translation: 不，那个傻巨魔不听。他让我一路从山上带他下来问你这件事。

english: You want to grow it in the mountains, Bwana? That might be more difficult. Gout tubers only grow well in warm places with plenty of sun.
translation: 你想在山里种它，先生？那可能更难。痛风草茎只在阳光充足、温暖的地方长得好。

english: You mean we aren't going to be able to grow it in the mountains?
translation: 你的意思是我们在山里种不了它？

english: No, not with a normal gout tuber. Those just won't survive the conditions. You'll need a special hardy gout tuber.
translation: 不，用普通的痛风草茎不行。那些在那种条件下活不了。你需要一种特殊的耐寒的痛风草茎。

english: Oh, wonderful. Can you give me some of those, please?
translation: 哦，太好了。你能给我一些吗？

english: Oh no, Bwana. Those are far too valuable to give away.
translation: 哦不，先生。那些太珍贵了，不能送人。

english: You owe me a bit of favour for the work I've been doing around the village. Are you sure you can't let me have some hardy gout tubers for the troll?
translation: 你欠我一点人情，因为我在村子里做了那么多工作。你确定不能给我一些耐寒的痛风草茎给那个巨魔吗？

english: Oh, I suppose I could let you have one. But only because you've got over sixty percent favour. If we didn't owe you so much for your help, I'd not be giving out hardy gout tubers.
translation: 哦，我想我可以给你一个。但只因为你的好感度超过了百分之六十。要不是我们欠你这么多人情，我是不会拿出耐寒的痛风草茎的。

english: So this hardy tuber will grow like any other herb seed?
translation: 所以这种耐寒的草茎会像其他草药种子一样生长？

english: It grows much faster than any other I have seen, Bwana. But remember, although it is hardy enough to grow in the cold mountain lands, it may still become diseased.
translation: 它比我见过的任何其他草药都长得快，先生。但记住，虽然它足够耐寒，能在寒冷的山区生长，但它仍然可能生病。

english: Hang on. I can't hold any more stuff just now. I'll get back to you in a minute.
translation: 等等。我现在拿不了更多东西了。我待会儿再来找你。

english: You are wise, Bwana. I have seen many an adventurer accidentally drop valuable items on the floor through trying to hold too many things.
translation: 您真明智，主人。我见过许多冒险者因为想拿太多东西而意外把贵重物品掉在地上。

english: My Arm bored...
translation: "我的手臂"无聊了……

english: What is this noise?
translation: 这是什么噪音？

english: Where's da goutweed?
translation: 痛风草呢？

english: Agh - a troll!
translation: 啊——一个巨魔！

english: Want goutweed!
translation: 要痛风草！

english: My Arm want goutweed!
translation: "我的手臂"要痛风草！

english: A broodoo man!
translation: 一个巫毒人！

english: Has you got goutweed?
translation: 你有痛风草吗？

english: Still want goutweed!
translation: 还是要痛风草！

english: Jagdakobo - here is the monster!
translation: 贾格达科博——怪物在这里！

english: Prepare to die!
translation: 准备受死！

english: Where you keep goutweed?
translation: 你把痛风草藏哪儿了？

english: You got issues!
translation: 你有毛病！

english: Humans all mental.
translation: 人类都疯了。

english: Make it go away!
translation: 让它走开！

english: I'll give you anything!
translation: 我什么都给你！

english: What the heck was all THAT about?
translation: 这到底是怎么回事？

english: You take far too long chattin' with Murcaily. My Arm come in to hurry things up.
translation: 你跟穆凯利聊得太久了。"我的手臂"进来催催进度。

english: You could have really damaged their village!
translation: 你可能会严重破坏他们的村子！

english: Silly humans got such flimsy homes. One good thump an' der walls come down.
translation: 愚蠢的人类房子真不结实。用力一捶墙就倒了。

english: If you ever come to [location of player-owned house], I'm not letting you into my house.
translation: 如果你以后来[location of player-owned house]，我不会让你进我家的。

english: Anyway, you got da goutweedy stuff, right?
translation: 不管怎样，你拿到那个痛风草的东西了，对吧？

english: Yes, I've got plenty of hardy gout tubers.
translation: 是的，我有很多耐寒的痛风草茎。

english: Right. Let's get back to da ship an' go back to Ardougne. My Arm fink you need to go to da bank.
translation: 好。我们回船上去，回阿多尼城。"我的手臂"觉得你需要去银行。

english: What do you think I need from the bank?
translation: 你觉得我需要从银行拿什么？

english: See, [player name], My Arm done tried planting stuff before, an' da birds around Trollheim Mountain, dey got... interested.
translation: 看，[player name]，我的手臂以前试过种东西，而巨魔山周围的鸟儿们……产生了兴趣。

english: The birds got interested in watching your farm?
translation: 鸟儿们对你的农场产生了兴趣？

english: Yuh, an' dere was a great BIG one wot started trying to eat whatever I planted.
translation: 嗯，还有一只超大的鸟开始吃我种的东西。

english: Exactly how BIG was this bird?
translation: 这只鸟到底有多大？

english: It pretty BIG. You might wanna get some food an' stuff.
translation: 它可大了。你最好弄点食物之类的东西。

english: Are we talking bigger than... a pigeon?
translation: 你是说比……一只鸽子还大？

english: How 'bout we just go back to Ardougne so you can get your fightin' stuff...
translation: 要不我们先回阿多尼城，你去拿你的战斗装备……

english: Dat captain didn't look very happy to see us again.
translation: 那个船长看到我们回来，脸色可不怎么好看。

english: No, he wasn't.
translation: 是啊，他确实不高兴。

english: What was dat you said to him?
translation: 你刚才跟他说了什么？

english: I told him he'd better take us back, or else...
translation: 我跟他说最好送我们回去，否则……

english: Or else what?
translation: 否则怎样？

english: Or else I'd let my arm loose on him.
translation: 不然我就放开我的手臂收拾他了。

english: You probably wanna go to bank now to fetch yer fightin' stuff. When you finished, go back to da Troll Stronghold. My Arm gonna be waitin' by our farming patch on da roof.
translation: 你现在可能想去银行拿你的战斗装备。完成后，回到巨魔要塞。"我的手臂"会在屋顶上的种植地旁等你。

english: How are you going to get back to the Troll Stronghold?
translation: 你怎么回巨魔要塞？

english: Dat not your problem.
translation: 这不是你操心的事。

english: Alright, I'll see you there.
translation: 好吧，那我们在那见。

english: Actually, I seem to have thrown it away.
translation: 其实，我好像把它扔了。

english: You is dumber than a spotted kebbit! Go back an' ask Murcaily for some more!
translation: 你比斑点凯比特兔还蠢！回去找穆凯利再要点！

english: Oh, I hadn't thought of that...
translation: 哦，我没想到这点……

english: No, Bwana, I'm very sorry, but you'll need to do a bit more work for us before we'll be able to spare you any hardy gout tubers.
translation: 不行，先生，非常抱歉，你得再为我们多干点活，我们才能匀出一些耐寒的痛风草茎给你。

english: Roughly how much more favour do I need?
translation: 大概还需要多少好感度？

english: Let me see... I think if you get it up to 60 percent, I'd be able to let you have a hardy gout tuber for your friend.
translation: 让我想想……如果你能提升到60%，我就能给你一个耐寒的痛风草茎，给你朋友用。

english: I don't suppose you'd accept trading sticks instead?
translation: 你不会接受交易棒来代替吧？

english: Sorry, Bwana, but I don't need those. I get plenty of trading sticks from all the people wanting to use my hardwood grove. Hardy gout tubers are too precious to be bought like that.
translation: 抱歉，先生，我不需要那些。所有想用我硬木林的人都给我不少交易棒。耐寒的痛风草茎太珍贵了，不能那样买。

english: I was asking you about hardy goutweed...
translation: 我刚才在问你关于耐寒的痛风草的事……

english: Yes, Bwana, I remember. You wanted a hardy gout tuber so your friend could grow goutweed on his mountain. But you only have [0-59] percent favour in our village. Come back to me with at least 60 percent favour and I will let you have what you need.
translation: 是的，先生，我记得。你想要一个耐寒的痛风草茎，好让你的朋友在他的山上种痛风草。但你目前在我们村的好感度只有[0-59]%。等你达到至少60%好感度再来找我，我就给你你需要的东西。

english: Yes, Bwana, I remember. We owe you big-time for the work you done in Tai Bwo Wannai Village, so I can let you have a hardy gout tuber for your friend to grow on his mountain.
translation: 是的，先生，我记得。你在泰博瓦纳村干了不少活，我们欠你大人情，所以我给你一个耐寒的痛风草茎，让你朋友在他山上种。

english: Ah, dulce domum.
translation: 啊，dulce domum。

english: It mean somefing like 'Home sweet home' in some old language. My Arm is well ed-oo-cated troll, not some no-brain rockhead.
translation: 它的意思是某种古语里的‘家，甜蜜的家’。我的手臂是个受过良好教育的巨魔，不是没脑子的石头脑袋。

english: Riiight. Shall we get on with growing the goutweed now?
translation: 好吧。那我们开始种痛风草吧？

english: Yup, dat sound good. You show me how to do dat.
translation: 嗯，听起来不错。你教我怎么做。

english: Ok, I'll hand you what you need, and you can use it on the patch.
translation: 好，我把你需要的东西给你，你用在种植地上。

english: How's my farming coming along?
translation: 我的农业进展如何？

english: Well, you've got a nice crop of weeds.
translation: 嗯，你种出了一片不错的杂草。

english: I not go to all dis trouble to grow weedies! You supposed to help me grow goutweed!
translation: 我才不是为了种杂草费这么大劲的！你应该帮我种痛风草！

english: Yeah, yeah, we'll get to that in a bit.
translation: 是，是，我们马上就弄。

english: You give me what stuff I need to use on da patch and I use it. And hurry up, My Arm gettin' bored.
translation: 你把需要用在种植地上的东西给我，我来用。快点，"我的手臂"要无聊了。

english: We should start by raking it.
translation: 我们应该先耙地。

english: Okieday, you gimme a rake an' My Arm do it.
translation: 好吧，你给我一把耙子，"我的手臂"来做。

english: I can't get da goutweed thing in da ground with all these weeds here.
translation: 这些杂草在这里，我没法把痛风草种到地里去。

english: Da weedies look healthy enough, t'anks.
translation: 这些杂草看起来挺健康的，谢了。

english: Da spade not working on dese weedies.
translation: 铲子对这些杂草没用。

english: I not sure what you want me to do with dat.
translation: 我不确定你想让我用那个做什么。

english: I not want your bitty bit of paper.
translation: 我不要你的那点小破纸片。

english: I t'ink we already treated da soil.
translation: 我觉得我们已经处理过土壤了。

english: Dat lookin' a bit short!
translation: 那看起来有点短啊！

english: Oh... there should be more of it than that. Sorry.
translation: 哦……应该比这多的。抱歉。

english: What you t'ink I want with a stick, huh?
translation: 你觉得我要一根棍子干什么，嗯？

english: The patch is free from weeds, so we could plant a hardy tuber in it.
translation: 种植地已经没有杂草了，我们可以种耐寒的草茎了。

english: Already?
translation: 这么快？

english: Well, I suppose we could treat the soil with compost first.
translation: 嗯，我想我们可以先用堆肥处理一下土壤。

english: After dat you probably wanna give me da hardy gout tuber thingies, an' maybe somefing to poke 'em into da soil.
translation: 之后你可能想给我那些耐寒的痛风草茎，也许还要一些东西把它们插进土壤里。

english: Also, I got plenty of da hardy gout tuber thingies, but I gonna need somefing to poke 'em into da soil.
translation: 另外，我有很多耐寒的痛风草茎，但我需要一些东西把它们插进土壤里。

english: Nuffing' interesting happened.
translation: 没什么有趣的事发生。

english: Don't I need somefing to plant?
translation: 我不需要种点什么东西吗？

english: Oh yes, you'll need the gout tubers.
translation: 哦对，你需要痛风草茎。

english: 'Ello, matey!
translation: 嘿，伙计！

english: You a dwarf.
translation: 你是个矮人。

english: You not my matey!
translation: 你不是我的伙计！

english: Aaaargh - matey!
translation: 啊啊啊——伙计！

english: Ooh. Food for me?
translation: 哦，给我吃的？

english: Aww, poor dwarfie. But he's sure to turn up again one of these days - drunken dwarves always keep coming back...
translation: 啊，可怜的小矮人。不过他肯定哪天又会出现的——喝醉的矮人总是会回来……

english: Uh-oh - I fink da birds noticed us farming...
translation: 哦哦——我觉得鸟儿们发现我们在种地了……

english: Akka akka!
translation: 阿卡阿卡！

english: Save da goutweed!
translation: 救痛风草！

english: Heheh - ickle birdie!
translation: 嘿嘿——小鸟！

english: Akka!
translation: 阿卡！

english: You're worried about that?
translation: 你担心那个？

english: It gonna eat da goutweed - kill it, quick!
translation: 它要吃痛风草——快杀了它！

english: T'anks for saving da goutweed, [player name]. But I fink dis other birdie not happy with you...
translation: 谢谢你救了痛风草，[player name]。但我觉得另一只鸟对你不太满意……

english: What other birdie?
translation: 什么另一只鸟？

english: Dat birdie behind you.
translation: 你身后的那只鸟。

english: Ah, lovely goutweed all grown up.
translation: 啊，可爱的痛风草都长大了。

english: Yep, you can harvest it now.
translation: 对，你现在可以收获了。

english: I gonna need a spade.
translation: 我需要一把铲子。

english: Alright, I think I can arrange a spade for you.
translation: 好吧，我想我能给你弄把铲子。

english: T'ank you very much for da kind offer, but My Arm not really needin' one of those just now.
translation: 非常感谢你的好意，但"我的手臂"现在真的不需要那个。

english: I think My Arm should do the honours.
translation: 我觉得应该由"我的手臂"来主持这个仪式。

english: W00t - farming level!
translation: 呜——农业等级！

english: T'ank you so much for all da help! Burntmeat gonna be very pleased.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助！'烧肉'会非常高兴的。

english: I'm just glad the goutweed grew up okay.
translation: 我只是很高兴痛风草顺利长出来了。

english: My Arm just check dis da right stuff...
translation: "我的手臂"只是检查一下这是不是正确的东西……

english: Yup, dis is goutweed. It lovverley.
translation: 嗯，这是痛风草。真好看。

english: Don't eat it all!
translation: 别全吃了！

english: Aww, too late.
translation: 啊，太晚了。

english: You gotta go back to kitchen an' tell Burntmeat da good news. Maybe he give you nice reward for all da hard work you bin doin' for us. But if he not give you anyfing good, you come back an' see My Arm.
translation: 你得回厨房告诉烧肉这个好消息。也许他会因为为我们做的这些辛苦工作给你一份好奖励。但如果他没给你什么好东西，你就回来找我的手臂。

english: Did Burntmeat give you nice reward?
translation: '烧肉'给你好奖励了吗？

english: No, I haven't asked him yet.
translation: 不，我还没问他。

english: He downstairs in da kitchen. An' if he give you somefing rubbish, come tell My Arm. Maybe I can reward you better.
translation: 他在楼下的厨房里。如果他给你什么垃圾，来告诉"我的手臂"。也许我能给你更好的奖励。

english: We've done it! My Arm's managed to grow some goutweed on the roof of the Stronghold!
translation: 我们成功了！'我的手臂'成功在要塞屋顶上种出了痛风草！

english: So now we can grow goutweed whenever we want it?
translation: 所以现在我们可以随时种痛风草了？

english: Yes, he's got plenty of hardy gout tubers to grow in his little farming patch.
translation: 是的，他有很多耐寒的痛风草茎，可以种在他那块小种植地里。

english: T'ank you so much! I dunno what we'd have done if you not come through here to help us.
translation: 太感谢你了！如果你没来这儿帮我们，我真不知道我们会怎么办。

english: So... you mentioned a reward?
translation: 那么……你提到过奖励？

english: Oh yup, Burntmeat cooked you SPECIAL reward.
translation: 哦对，'烧肉'给你做了特别的奖励。

english: LOTS of burnt meat!
translation: 一大堆烧焦的肉！

english: See, Burntmeat promised you a reward! Anyway, it been nice to see you again, Player. Enjoy your meal.
translation: 看，'烧肉'答应给你奖励的！总之，很高兴再次见到你，玩家。好好享用你的大餐吧。

english: Burntmeat hope you like your reward. It very special recipe Burntmeat learned when much younger troll.
translation: 烧肉希望你喜欢你的奖励。这是烧肉在更年轻的巨魔时学到的一个非常特别的食谱。

english: Yes, it was very... kind of you.
translation: 是啊，你真是……太客气了。

english: Ah, you polite human. Off you go now and see what My Arm want.
translation: 啊，你这有礼貌的人类。快去看看"我的手臂"想要什么吧。

english: That was the worst quest reward EVER! I get better things from killing goblins! I get better things from killing SPIDERS! Why in the world did I ever do a quest for a troll? I could have been training my skills
translation: 这是有史以来最烂的任务奖励！我杀地精都能得到更好的东西！我杀蜘蛛都能得到更好的东西！我到底为什么要为一个巨魔做任务？我本可以练习技能

english: instead!
translation: 的！

english: I could have trained a cat and got a load of death runes!
translation: 我本可以训练一只猫，然后得到一大堆死亡符文的！

english: I could have gone back to Pest Control and helped save the universe from hideous monsters!
translation: 我本可以回到虫害治理，帮助从可怕的怪物手中拯救宇宙的！

english: But no, I did a quest for a troll, and what did I get?
translation: 但是不，我为个巨魔做了任务，我得到了什么？

english: BURNT MEAT! What am I meant to do with burnt meat? I don't WANT burnt meat!
