translation: 烧焦的肉！我拿烧焦的肉能干嘛？我根本不想要烧焦的肉！

english: Human so funny, pretending [he/she] don't like lovely burnt meat! Off you go now and see what My Arm wants.
translation: 人类真有趣，假装[he/she]不喜欢美味的烧焦的肉！快去看看"我的手臂"想要什么。

english: No, he jolly well didn't. He gave me burnt meat. Again!
translation: 不，他根本没给。他给了我烧焦的肉。又来了！

english: Aww, dat a shame. See, Burntmeat like burnt meat. It his favourite thing to cook, an' he do it better than any other troll.
translation: 啊，那真可惜。你看，烧肉喜欢烧焦的肉。那是他最喜欢做的东西，而且他比任何其他巨魔都做得好。

english: You said you might be able to give me something better?
translation: 你说过你也许能给我更好的东西？

english: Yup, an' I will. My Arm gonna tell you big hushy-hushy secret about herbs...
translation: 没错，我会给的。"我的手臂"要告诉你一个关于草药的重大秘密……

english: Now you know more 'bout herbs. Also, I made a new farming patch like you showed me. Whatever you plant in it, I make sure it don't get disease.
translation: 现在你对草药了解更多了。另外，我照你教我的弄了一个新种植地。无论你在里面种什么，我都会确保它不得病。

english: Well, not a great deal... but there is something you could do for me if you're interested. Though it is quite dangerous.
translation: 嗯，其实也没什么大事……不过如果你有兴趣，倒是有件事可以帮我。虽然挺危险的。

english: Who exactly is this Filliman?
translation: 这个菲利曼到底是谁？

english: Filliman Tarlock is his full name and he's a druid. He lives in Mort Myre much like a hermit, but there's many a traveller who he's helped.
translation: 他的全名是菲利曼.塔洛克，是个德鲁伊。他像个隐士一样住在莫特迈尔，但很多旅人都受过他的帮助。

english: Most people that come this way tell stories of when they were lost and paths that just seemed to 'open up' before them! I think it was Filliman Tarlock helping out.
translation: 大多数路过这里的人都会讲起他们迷路时，眼前突然就‘出现’了道路的故事！我觉得那是菲利曼.塔洛克在帮忙。

english: Where's Mort Myre?
translation: 莫特迈尔在哪？

english: Mort Myre is a decayed and dangerous swamp to the south east of here. Legend says it was once a beautiful forest called Humblethorn. Now, it's filled with vile emanations from within Morytania.
translation: 莫特迈尔是这里东南方一片腐朽危险的沼泽。传说那里曾经是一片叫做谦卑荆棘的美丽森林。现在，它充满了来自莫利塔尼亚内部的邪恶气息。

english: The swamp decays everything. We put a fence around it to stop unwary travellers going in. Anyone who dies in the swamp is forever cursed to haunt it as a ghast.
translation: 沼泽会腐朽一切。我们围了一圈栅栏，防止粗心的旅人进去。任何死在沼泽里的人都会永远被诅咒，化作恶灵在那里游荡。

english: Ghasts attack travellers, turning food to rotten filth.
translation: 恶灵会攻击旅人，把食物变成腐烂的垃圾。

english: What's a ghast?
translation: 什么是恶灵？

english: A Ghast is a poor soul who died in Mort Myre. They're undead of a special class and they're untouchable as far as I'm aware! Filliman knows how to tackle them though.
translation: 恶灵是死在莫特迈尔的可怜灵魂。它们是一种特殊的不死生物，据我所知，它们是‘不可触及者’！不过菲利曼知道怎么对付它们。

english: When they attack, ghasts will devour any food you have. If you have no food, they'll draw their nourishment from you!
translation: 恶灵攻击时，会吞噬你身上的所有食物。如果你没有食物，它们就会从你身上吸取养分！

english: Have you managed to find Filliman yet?
translation: 你找到菲利曼了吗？

english: No not yet.
translation: 还没。

english: Please go and look for him, I would appreciate it!
translation: 请去找他吧，我会很感激的！

english: Where should I look for Filliman Tarlock again?
translation: 我该去哪里找菲利曼.塔洛克来着？

english: Search to the south of Mort Myre. Remember that he's a druid so he can conceal himself within nature quite well. My guess is that he lives in the southern area of the swamp, though he could be anywhere.
translation: 搜索莫特迈尔以南。记住他是个德鲁伊，所以他能很好地隐藏在大自然中。我猜他住在沼泽的南部区域，不过他可能在任何地方。

english: Explain to me what a Ghast is again.
translation: 再给我解释一下什么是恶灵。

english: A Ghast is a poor soul who died in Mort Myre. They're undead of a special class, they're untouchable apart from with special druidic items.
translation: 恶灵是死在莫特迈尔的可怜灵魂。它们是一种特殊的不死生物，除了用特殊的德鲁伊物品，否则它们是‘不可触及者’。

english: Filliman knew how to tackle them, but I've not heard from him in a long time. Ghasts, when they attack, will devour any food you have. If you have no food, they'll draw their nourishment from you!
translation: 菲利曼知道怎么对付它们，但我很久没听到他的消息了。恶灵攻击时，会吞噬你身上的所有食物。如果你没有食物，它们就会从你身上吸取养分！

english: What's the story with Mort Myre?
translation: 莫特迈尔有什么故事？

english: Mort Myre was once a beautiful forest by the name of Humblethorn until the evil denizens of Morytania descended. Now their evil emanations have putrified and diseased the forest into a decaying swamp of death.
translation: 莫特迈尔曾经是一片叫做谦卑荆棘的美丽森林，直到莫利塔尼亚的邪恶居民降临。现在，他们的邪恶气息已经让森林腐烂、染病，变成了一片腐朽的死亡沼泽。

english: What's the story with Filliman Tarlock?
translation: 菲利曼.塔洛克有什么故事？

english: Filliman is a druid of some considerable power. He helped many people in Morytania escape when the evil descended upon the land. His knowledge of plants and nature was exceptional.
translation: 菲利曼是一位力量相当强大的德鲁伊。当邪恶降临这片土地时，他帮助莫利塔尼亚的许多人逃脱。他对植物和自然的了解非常出色。

english: But one day, he was betrayed by some of the people who he had tried to help. This naturally made him more careful when dealing with strangers again and so, instead of showing himself, he would follow them.
translation: 但有一天，他被一些他曾试图帮助的人背叛了。这自然让他再次与陌生人打交道时更加谨慎，所以，他不再现身，而是会跟着他们。

english: He would follow them at a distance and make the path clear for them, showing them to the temple and to salvation. Saradomin bless him! He is a good man.
translation: 他会远远地跟着他们，为他们扫清道路，指引他们前往神庙和救赎。萨拉多明保佑他！他是个好人。

english: Many thanks to you, [player name]!
translation: 非常感谢你，[player name]！

english: Cannot wake up... Where am I?
translation: 醒不过来……我在哪？

english: Huh? What's this?
translation: 嗯？这是什么？

english: What did I write down now? Put it in the knot hole.
translation: 我刚才写了什么？把它放进树洞里。

english: Ahhrs Oooohh arhhhhAHhhh.
translation: 啊呵嘶 哦哦哦 啊呵啊啊啊。

english: Huh! Now you're just not making any sense at all! I just cannot understand you!
translation: 哈！你现在说的话完全没意义！我根本听不懂你在说什么！

english: Oh, I understand you! At last, someone who doesn't just mumble. I understand what you're saying!
translation: 哦，我懂你了！终于，有人不是只会咕哝了。我明白你在说什么了！

english: I'm wearing an amulet of ghost speak!
translation: 我戴了幽灵语护身符！

english: Why you poor fellow, have you passed away and you want to send a message back to a loved one?
translation: 哎呀，可怜的家伙，你是不是已经过世了，想给心爱的人捎个信？

english: Err.. Not exactly...
translation: 呃……不完全是……

english: You have come to haunt my dreams until I pass on your message to a dearly loved one. I understand. Pray, tell me who would you like me to pass a message on to?
translation: 你是来纠缠我的梦境，直到我把你的口信传给某个挚爱的人。我明白了。请告诉我，你想让我把口信传给谁？

english: Ermm, you don't understand... It's just that..
translation: 呃，你没明白……只是……

english: Well, please don't be upset or anything... But you're the ghost!
translation: 嗯，请别难过什么的……但你就是那个幽灵！

english: Don't be silly now! That in no way reflects the truth!
translation: 别傻了！这完全不符合事实！

english: How long have you been a ghost?
translation: 你当幽灵多久了？

english: What?! Don't be preposterous! I'm not a ghost! How could you say something like that?
translation: 什么？！别荒谬了！我不是幽灵！你怎么能说出这种话？

english: But it's true, you're a ghost... well, at least that is to say, you're sort of not alive anymore.
translation: 但这是真的，你是个幽灵……嗯，至少可以说，你有点不算活着了。

english: Don't be silly, I can see you, I can see that tree. If I were dead, I wouldn't be able to see anything.. What you say just doesn't reflect the truth. You'll have to try harder to pull one over on me!
translation: 别傻了，我能看见你，我能看见那棵树。如果我死了，我什么都看不见……你说的话根本不符合事实。想骗我还得再努力点！

english: What's it like being a ghost?
translation: 当幽灵是什么感觉？

english: Oh, it's quite.... Oh... Trying to catch me out were you! Anyone can clearly see that I am not a ghost!
translation: 哦，感觉挺……哦……想套我话是吧！谁都能清楚地看出我不是幽灵！

english: But you are a ghost, look at yourself! I can see straight through you! You're as dead as this swamp! Err... No offence or anything...
translation: 但你是个幽灵啊，看看你自己！我能直接看穿你！你和这片沼泽一样死透了！呃……无意冒犯……

english: No I won't take offence because I'm not dead and I'm afraid you'll have to come up with some pretty conclusive proof before I believe it. What a strange dream this is.
translation: 不，我不会生气，因为我没有死，恐怕你得拿出些确凿的证据我才会相信。这真是个奇怪的梦。

english: Oh, hello there, do you still think I'm dead? It's hard to see how I could be dead when I'm still in the world. I can see everything quite clearly. And nothing of what you say reflects the truth.
translation: 哦，你好，你还觉得我死了吗？我很难理解我怎么可能死了却还留在世上。我看得很清楚。你说的任何话都不符合事实。

english: Yes, I do think you're dead and I'll prove it somehow.
translation: 是的，我确实认为你死了，而且我会想办法证明。

english: Here take a look at this, perhaps you can see that you're utterly transparent now!
translation: 来看看这个，也许你能看到自己现在完全是透明的！

english: Well, that is the most peculiar thing I've ever experienced. This mirror must somehow be dysfunctional. Strange how well it reflects the stagnant swamp behind me, but there is nothing of my own
translation: 嗯，这真是我经历过最奇怪的事了。这面镜子肯定出了故障。奇怪的是，它清晰地映出了我身后停滞的沼泽，却没有我自己的

english: visage apparent.
translation: 面容。

english: That's because you're dead! Dead as a door nail.. Deader in fact... You bear a remarkable resemblance to worm bait! Err.. No offence...
translation: 那是因为你死了！死得像门钉一样……实际上更死……你非常像蠕虫饵！呃……无意冒犯……

english: I think you might be right my friend, though I still feel very much alive. It is strange how I still come to be here and yet I've not turned into a Ghast.
translation: 我想你可能是对的，朋友，虽然我还是觉得自己活得好好的。奇怪的是，我怎么会还在这里，却没有变成恶灵。

english: It must be a sign... Yes a sign... I must try to find out what it means. Now, where did I put my journal?
translation: 这一定是个征兆……对，一个征兆……我必须试着找出它的含义。现在，我把日记放哪了？

english: Here, I found this, maybe you can use it?
translation: 给，我找到了这个，也许你能用得上？

english: My journal! That should help to collect my thoughts.
translation: 我的日记！这应该能帮我理清思绪。

english: It's all coming back to me now. It looks like I came to a violent and bitter end but that's not important now. I just have to figure out what I am going to do now?
translation: 我现在都想起来了。看来我是遭遇了暴力的惨死，但这现在不重要了。我只是得想清楚我现在该怎么办？

english: Being dead, what options do you think you have? I'm not trying to be rude or something, but it's not like you have many options is it? I mean, it's either up or down for you isn't it?
translation: 既然死了，你觉得你还有什么选择？我不是想冒犯你，但你的选择不多，对吧？我是说，你不是上天堂就是下地狱，对吧？

english: Hmm, well you're a poetic one aren't you. Your material world logic stands you in good stead... If you're standing in the material world...
translation: 嗯，你还挺有诗意的嘛。你的物质世界逻辑对你很有帮助……如果你还站在物质世界里的话……

english: So, what's your plan?
translation: 那么，你有什么计划？

english: In my former incarnation I was Filliman Tarlock, a great druid of some power. I spent many years in this place, which was once a forest and I would wish to protect it as a nature sprit.
translation: 在我前世，我是菲利曼.塔洛克，一位颇有力量的伟大德鲁伊。我在这片曾经是森林的地方度过了许多年，我希望以自然之灵的身份保护它。

english: Won't you help me to become a nature spirit? I could really use your help!
translation: 你愿意帮我成为自然之灵吗？我真的需要你的帮助！

english: Will you help me to become a nature spirit? The directions for becoming one are a bit vague, I need three things but I know how to get one of them. Perhaps you can help collect the rest?
translation: 你能帮我成为自然之灵吗？成为自然之灵的指引有点模糊，我需要三样东西，但我知道其中一样怎么得到。也许你能帮忙收集剩下的？

english: I might be interested, what's involved?
translation: 我可能感兴趣，具体要做什么？

english: Well, the book says, that I need, and I quote:- 'Something with faith', 'something from nature' and  'something of the 'spirit-to-become' freely given'. Hmm, I know how to get something from nature.
translation: 嗯，书上说，我需要，我引用一下：-‘有信仰之物’、‘自然之物’和‘即将成为的灵魂自愿给予之物’。嗯，我知道怎么得到自然之物。

english: Well, that does seem a bit vague.
translation: 嗯，这确实有点模糊。

english: Hmm, it does and I could understand if you didn't want to help. However, if you could perhaps at least get the item from nature, that would be a start. Perhaps we can figure out the rest as we go along.
translation: 嗯，确实如此，我理解你不想帮忙。不过，如果你至少能拿到自然之物，那也算是个开始。也许我们可以在过程中慢慢弄清楚剩下的。

english: This spell needs to be cast in the swamp after you have been blessed. I'm afraid you'll need to go to the temple to the North and ask a member of the clergy to bless you.
translation: 这个法术需要在被祝福后，在沼泽中施放。恐怕你得去北边的神庙，请一位神职人员为你祝福。

english: Blessed, what does that do?
translation: 祝福，那有什么用？

english: It is required if you're to cast this druid spell. Once you've cast the spell, you should find something from nature. Bring it back to me and then we'll try to figure out the other things we need.
translation: 这是施放这个德鲁伊法术的必要条件。一旦你施放了法术，你应该能找到自然之物。把它带回来给我，然后我们再试着弄清楚其他需要的东西。

english: Hello again..
translation: 又见面了……

english: Oh, hello... Sorry, you've caught me at a bad time, it's just that I've had a sign you see and I need to find my journal.
translation: 哦，你好……抱歉，你来得不是时候，只是我看到了一个征兆，我需要找到我的日记。

english: Where did you put it?
translation: 你把它放哪了？

english: Well, if I knew that, I wouldn't still be looking for it. However, I do remember something about a knot? Perhaps I was meant to tie a knot or something?
translation: 嗯，如果我知道的话，我就不用还在找了。不过，我好像记得跟一个结有关？也许我该打个结什么的？

english: Yes, I know, I'm already dead! Thanks for reminding me.
translation: 是的，我知道，我已经死了！谢谢提醒。

english: Thanks for the journal, I've been reading it. It looks like I came to a violent and bitter end but that's not really important. I just have to figure out what I am going to do now?
translation: 谢谢你的日记，我一直在读。看来我是遭遇了暴力的惨死，但这真的不重要。我只是得想清楚我现在该怎么办？

english: Hello there, have you been blessed yet?
translation: 你好，你被祝福了吗？

english: Well, hurry up!
translation: 嗯，快点！

english: Hello again! I'm helping Filliman, he plans to become a nature spirit. I have a spell to cast but first I need to be blessed. Can you bless me?
translation: 又见面了！我在帮菲利曼，他打算成为自然之灵。我有个法术要施放，但首先我需要被祝福。你能祝福我吗？

english: But you haven't sneezed!
translation: 但你还没打喷嚏！

english: You're so funny!
translation: 你真幽默！

english: But can you bless me?
translation: 但你能祝福我吗？

english: Very well my friend, prepare yourself for the blessings of Saradomin. Here we go!
translation: 好吧，我的朋友，准备好接受萨拉多明的祝福。开始了！

english: Ashustru, blessidium, adverturasi, fidum!
translation: 阿舒斯特鲁，祝福迪乌姆，阿德维图拉西，菲杜姆！

english: There you go my friend, you're now blessed. It's funny, now I look at you, there seems to be something of the faith about you. Anyway, good luck with your quest!
translation: 好了，我的朋友，你现在被祝福了。真有趣，现在看着你，你身上似乎有种信仰的气质。总之，祝你任务顺利！

english: Many thanks!
translation: 非常感谢！

english: How's life been treating you since you got blessed?
translation: 自从被祝福后，你过得怎么样？

english: Not so bad!
translation: 还不错！

english: It's funny, because when I look at you, there does seem to be something of the faith about you. Have you considered a life of service to Saradomin?
translation: 真有趣，因为当我看着你时，你身上似乎确实有种信仰的气质。你有没有考虑过为萨拉多明服务一生？

english: I serve Saradomin in other ways.
translation: 我以其他方式侍奉萨拉多明。

english: Fair enough!
translation: 有道理！

english: Hello, I've been blessed but I don't know what to do now.
translation: 你好，我已经被祝福了，但我不知道现在该做什么。

english: Well, you need to bring 'something from nature', 'something with faith' and 'something of the spirit-to-become freely given.'
translation: 嗯，你需要带来‘自然之物’、‘有信仰之物’和‘即将成为的灵魂自愿给予之物’。

english: Yeah, but what does that mean?
translation: 是啊，但那是什么意思？

english: Hmm, it is a conundrum, however, if you use that Bloom spell I gave you, you should be able to get something from nature. Once you have that, we may be able to puzzle the rest out.
translation: 嗯，这是个难题，不过，如果你用我给你的那个绽放法术，你应该能得到自然之物。一旦你拿到了，我们也许就能解开剩下的谜题。

english: Did you manage to get something from nature?
translation: 你拿到自然之物了吗？

english: Wonderful, the mushroom represents 'something from nature'. Now we need to work out what the other components of the spell are!
translation: 太好了，蘑菇代表‘自然之物’。现在我们需要弄清楚法术的其他成分是什么！

english: The three things are: 'Something with faith', 'something from nature' and 'something of the spirit-to-become freely given'.
translation: 三样东西是：‘有信仰之物’、‘自然之物’和‘即将成为的灵魂自愿给予之物’。

english: Ok, and 'something from nature' is the mushroom from the bloom spell you gave me?
translation: 好的，那么‘自然之物’就是你给我的绽放法术长出的蘑菇？

english: Yes, that's correct, that seems right to me. The other things we need are 'something with faith' and 'something of the spirit-to-become freely given.
translation: 是的，没错，我觉得这样是对的。我们还需要其他东西：'有信仰之物'和'即将成形的灵魂自愿献出之物'。

english: Do you have any ideas what those things are?
translation: 你知道那些是什么东西吗？

english: I'm sorry my friend, but I do not.
translation: 抱歉，朋友，我不知道。

english: What should we do when we have those things?
translation: 我们拿到那些东西后该怎么做？

english: Ah yes, I looked this up. It says,.. 'to arrange upon three rocks around the spirit-to-become...'. Then I must cast a spell. As you can see, I've already placed the rocks. I must have planned to do this before I died!
translation: 啊，对了，我查过这个。上面说……'将物品摆放在即将成形的灵魂周围的三块石头上……'然后我必须施法。你看，我已经把石头放好了。我死之前肯定计划好要这么做了！

english: Can we just place the components on any rock?
translation: 我们可以把组件随便放在哪块石头上吗？

english: Well, the only thing the journal says is that 'something with faith stands south of the spirit-to-become', but I'm so confused now I don't really know what that means. Oh, if only I had all my faculties!
translation: 嗯，日志上只说'有信仰之物放在即将成形的灵魂的南边'，但我现在太困惑了，实在不明白这是什么意思。唉，要是我神志清醒就好了！

english: I think I've solved the puzzle!
translation: 我想我解开谜题了！

english: Oh really.. Have you placed all the items on the stones? Ok, well, lets try!~ The druid attempts to cast a spell.~
translation: 哦，真的吗……你把所有物品都放在石头上了吗？好，那我们来试试吧！~德鲁伊尝试施法。~

english: Hmm, something still doesn't seem right. I think we need something more before we can continue.
translation: 嗯，好像还是不对劲。我觉得我们还需要点别的东西才能继续。

english: Could I have another bloom scroll please?
translation: 能再给我一张绽放卷轴吗？

english: I would my friend, but you don't seem to have enough space in your inventory.
translation: 我也想给你，朋友，但你背包里好像没空间了。

english: Sure, but please look after this one.
translation: 当然可以，但请好好保管这张。

english: Aha, yes, that seems right well done!
translation: 啊哈，没错，看起来对了，干得好！

english: Oh really.. Have you placed all the items on the stones? Ok, well, lets try!~ The druid attempts to cast a spell.
translation: 哦，真的吗……你把所有物品都放在石头上了吗？好，那我们来试试吧！~德鲁伊尝试施法。

english: Aha, everything seems to be in place! You can come through now into the grotto for the final section of my transformation.
translation: 啊哈，一切就绪！你现在可以进入洞穴，进行我转化的最后阶段了。

english: Please come down into the grotto, we have much to discuss.
translation: 请下到洞穴里来，我们有很多事要谈。

english: Well, hello there again, I was just enjoying the grotto. Many thanks for your help, I couldn't have become a Spirit of nature without you.
translation: 嗯，你好啊，我正在享受这个洞穴。非常感谢你的帮助，没有你我成不了自然之灵。

english: I must complete the transformation now. Just stand there and watch the show, apparently it's quite good!
translation: 我现在必须完成转化。你就站在那儿看好戏吧，据说场面相当精彩！

english: Hmmm, good, the transformation is complete. Now, my friend, in return for your assistance, I will help you to kill the Ghasts. First bring to me a silver sickle so that I can bless it for you.
translation: 嗯，好，转化完成了。现在，我的朋友，作为对你帮助的回报，我会帮你杀死恶灵。首先，给我带一把银镰刀来，这样我就能为你祝福它。

english: A silver sickle? What's that?
translation: 银镰刀？那是什么？

english: The sickle is the symbol and weapon of the Druid, you need to construct one of silver so that I can bless it, with its powers you will be able to defeat the Ghasts of Mort Myre.
translation: 镰刀是德鲁伊的象征和武器，你需要用银制作一把，这样我才能祝福它。有了它的力量，你就能击败摩特梅尔的恶灵。

english: Where would I get a silver sickle?
translation: 我上哪儿去弄银镰刀？

english: You could make one yourself if you're artisan enough. I've heard of a distant sandy place where you can buy the mould that you require, it's similar in many respects to the creating of a holy symbol.
translation: 如果你够手艺的话，可以自己做一个。我听说在遥远的沙地可以买到你需要的模具，在很多方面和制作神圣护符类似。

english: What will you do to the silver sickle?
translation: 你要对银镰刀做什么？

english: Why, I will give it my blessings so that the very swamp in which you stand will blossom and bloom!
translation: 我会赐予它祝福，让你脚下的这片沼泽绽放出花朵！

english: How can a blessed sickle help me to defeat the Ghasts?
translation: 祝福过的镰刀怎么帮我打败恶灵？

english: My blessings will entice nature to bloom in Mort Myre! And then with natures harvest you can fill a druids pouch and release the Ghasts from their torment.
translation: 我的祝福会吸引自然在摩特梅尔绽放！然后，用自然的收获装满德鲁伊的袋，就能将恶灵从痛苦中释放出来。

english: Have you brought me the silver sickle?
translation: 你把银镰刀带来了吗？

english: No sorry, not yet!
translation: 不，抱歉，还没！

english: Well, come to me when you have it.
translation: 好吧，拿到之后再来找我。

english: Yes, here it is. What are you going to do with it?
translation: 是的，给你。你打算用它做什么？

english: My friend, I will bless it for you and you will then be able to accomplish great things. Now then, I must cast the enchantment. You can bless a new sickle by dipping it in the holy water of the grotto.
translation: 我的朋友，我会为它祝福，然后你就能用它成就大事。现在，我必须施法了。你可以把新镰刀浸入洞穴的圣水中来祝福它。

english: Now you can go forth and make the swamp bloom. Collect natures bounty to fill a druids pouch. So armed will the Ghasts be bound to you until, you flee or they are defeated.
translation: 现在你可以出发，让沼泽绽放。收集自然的恩赐来装满德鲁伊的袋。这样武装起来后，恶灵就会被束缚在你身边，直到你逃跑或它们被击败。

english: Before I can make this grotto into an Altar of Nature, I need to be sure that the Ghasts will be kept at bay. Go forth into Mort Myre and slay three Ghasts. You'll be releasing their souls from Mort Myre.
translation: 在我把这个洞穴变成自然祭坛之前，我需要确保恶灵能被控制住。去摩特梅尔消灭三个恶灵吧。你会把它们的灵魂从摩特梅尔释放出来。

english: I would give you the druid pouch, but you don't seem to have enough space in your inventory.
translation: 我想给你德鲁伊的袋，但你背包里好像没空间了。

english: Hello again! I don't suppose you've found out what the other components of the Nature spell are have you?
translation: 又见面了！我想你还没弄清楚自然法术的其他成分吧？

english: In my former incarnation I was Filliman Tarlock, a great druid of some power. I spent many years in this place, which was once a forest and I would wish to protect it as a nature spirit.
translation: 在我前世，我是菲利曼.塔洛克，一位颇有力量的伟大德鲁伊。我在这地方待了很多年，这里曾是一片森林，而我希望以自然之灵的身份保护它。

english: Well, you need to bring 'something from nature', 'something with faith' and 'something of the spirit-to- become freely given.'
translation: 嗯，你需要带来'来自自然之物'、'蕴含信仰之物'和'即将成为灵魂的自由赠予之物'。

english: Hmm, it is a conundrum, however, if you use that  Bloom spell I gave you, you should be able to get  something from nature. Once you have that, we may be  able to puzzle the rest out.
translation: 嗯，这确实是个难题。不过，如果你用我给你的那个绽放法术，应该能从自然中得到些什么。一旦你拿到那个，我们或许就能解开剩下的谜题了。

english: Well, when you cast the spell, did anything happen? The spell has the ability to grow things within a certain range of the caster. Keep trying until you manage to get something to bloom.
translation: 嗯，你施法的时候，有什么事情发生吗？这个法术能让施法者一定范围内的东西生长。继续尝试直到让什么东西开花。

english: Oh, keep hold of that, I may need it later.
translation: 哦，那个你留着，我之后可能用得上。

english: Hmm, that doesn't seem quite right.
translation: 嗯，好像不太对劲。

english: You've already got one! You don't need two!
translation: 你已经有一个了！不需要两个！

english: Oh, that's handy, it's just what I needed!
translation: 哦，真方便，这正是我需要的！

english: Hmm, that dried up fungus doesn't really represent nature does it? Did you pick it yourself? Go and get a fresh one!
translation: 嗯，那个干枯的蘑菇并不能真正代表自然，对吧？是你自己摘的吗？去弄个新鲜的来！

english: ~ Filliman Tarlock suddenly appears! ~
translation: ~ 菲利曼.塔洛克突然出现！ ~

english: You'll need this in order to collect together natures bounty. When it contains items, it will bind the Ghast to you until you flee or it is defeated.
translation: 你需要这个来收集自然的恩赐。当里面装有物品时，它会将恶灵束缚在你身上，直到你逃跑或打败它。

english: Hello again my friend, have you defeated three Ghasts as I asked you?
translation: 又见面了，朋友，你按我的要求消灭了三个恶灵吗？

english: Well, when you do, please come to me and I'll reward you!
translation: 好吧，等你完成了，请来找我，我会奖励你！

english: How do I get to attack the Ghasts?
translation: 我怎么才能攻击恶灵？

english: Go forth and with the sickle make the swamp bloom. Collect natures bounty to fill a druids pouch. So armed will the Ghasts be bound to you until, you flee or they are defeated.
translation: 出发吧，用镰刀让沼泽绽放。收集自然的恩赐来装满德鲁伊的袋。这样武装起来后，恶灵就会被束缚在你身边，直到你逃跑或它们被击败。

english: What's this pouch for?
translation: 这个袋子是干什么用的？

english: It is for collecting natures bounty, once it contains the blossomed items of the swamp, it will make the Ghasts appear and you can then attack them.
translation: 它是用来收集自然恩赐的。一旦装满了沼泽中绽放的物品，它就会让恶灵现身，然后你就可以攻击它们了。

english: What can I do with this sickle?
translation: 我能用这把镰刀做什么？

english: You may use it wisely within the area of Mort Myre to affect natures balance and bring forth a bounty of natures harvest. Once collected into the druid pouch will the Ghast be apparent.
translation: 你可以在摩特梅尔地区明智地使用它，来影响自然的平衡，并带来丰饶的自然收获。一旦收集到德鲁伊的袋中，恶灵就会显现。

english: I've lost my sickle!
translation: 我的镰刀丢了！

english: If you should lose the blessed sickle, simply bring another to my altar of nature and refresh it in the grotto waters.
translation: 如果你弄丢了祝福过的镰刀，只需带另一把到我的自然祭坛，在洞穴的水中重新祝福即可。

english: Yes, I've killed all three and their spirits have been released!
translation: 是的，我杀了全部三个，它们的灵魂已经被释放了！

english: Many thanks my friend, you have completed your quest! I can now change this place into a holy sanctuary! And forever will it now be an Altar of Nature!
translation: 非常感谢，我的朋友，你完成了你的任务！我现在可以把这里变成一个神圣的庇护所！它将永远成为自然祭坛！

english: Welcome to my Altar to Nature! Farewell my friend, and keep those Ghasts at bay!
translation: 欢迎来到我的自然祭坛！再见了，朋友，别让那些恶灵靠近！

english: Can I interrupt you?
translation: 我能打断你一下吗？

english: I suppose so. Please be quick though.
translation: 我想可以。不过请快点。

english: Might I have a word?
translation: 我能说句话吗？

english: Sure, how can I help you?
translation: 当然，有什么可以帮你的？

english: Can I speak with you?
translation: 我能和你谈谈吗？

english: Why, of course. What is it?
translation: 当然可以。什么事？

english: Where can I find planks of wood? I need some for the telescope's base.
translation: 我在哪里能找到木板？我需要一些来做望远镜的底座。

english: I understand planks can be found at Port Khazard, to the east of here. There are  some at the Barbarian Outpost, too.
translation: 我知道在卡扎德港可以找到木板，就在这里的东边。野蛮人前哨站也有一些。

english: Failing that, you could always ask the Sawmill Operator. He's to the north-east of Varrock, by the Lumber Yard.
translation: 如果不行，你还可以问问锯木厂操作员。他在维洛克城的东北边，靠近木材场。

english: I have a plank.
translation: 我有一块木板。

english: That you do - but if you remember rightly, the professor wanted an ordinary wooden plank, like the ones at Port Khazard.
translation: 你确实有——但如果你没记错的话，教授要的是普通的木板，就像卡扎德港的那种。

english: How about this plank I've got here?
translation: 我这里的这块木板怎么样？

english: I think the professor was after ordinary planks. You should be able to find them at Port Khazard.
translation: 我想教授要的是普通的木板。你应该能在卡扎德港找到。

english: I've got a plank.
translation: 我有一块木板。

english: You know, for the telescope's base.
translation: 你知道的，用来做望远镜的底座。

english: Well done. Remember that you'll need three in total.
translation: 做得好。记住你总共需要三块。

english: I've got some planks for the telescope's base.
translation: 我有一些做望远镜底座的木板。

english: Good work! The professor has been eagerly awaiting them.
translation: 干得好！教授一直在急切地等着它们。

english: Hi again!
translation: 又见面了！

english: It's my helping hand, back again.
translation: 是我的帮手又回来了。

english: Do you have the planks yet?
translation: 你有木板了吗？

english: Sorry, not yet. Three planks was it?
translation: 抱歉，还没有。是三块木板对吧？

english: It was indeed.
translation: 没错。

english: I've made a start.
translation: 我已经开始准备了。

english: Well, you'll need three of them.
translation: 嗯，你需要三块。

english: I have a plank for you.
translation: 我有一块木板给你。

english: That's no good. I asked for ordinary planks. If you can't find out where they are, talk to my assistant.
translation: 那不行。我要的是普通的木板。如果你不知道在哪里找，去问我的助理。

english: How about this plank?
translation: 这块木板怎么样？

english: I asked for ordinary wooden planks. If you're not sure where to get them, speak to my assistant.
translation: 我要的是普通的木板。如果你不确定在哪里弄到，去问我的助理。

english: Yes, I've got them. Here they are.
translation: 是的，我拿到了。给你。

english: Well done. This will make a big difference.
translation: 做得好。这会带来很大的改变。

english: Now, the bronze for the tube. Oh, assistant!
translation: 现在，需要做管的青铜。哦，助理！

english: Okay, okay, ask me if you need any help, [player name].
translation: 好了好了，如果你需要帮助就问我，[player name]。

english: The traveller returns!
translation: 旅行者回来了！

english: Still working hard?
translation: 还在努力工作？

english: Some of us are.
translation: 我们有些人是的。

english: What did I tell you about speaking when spoken to?
translation: 我跟你说过什么来着，别人跟你说话你才能说话？

english: So, [player name], you have the bronze bar?
translation: 那么，[player name]，你有青铜锭了吗？

english: Please bring me one, then.
translation: 那就请给我带一块来。

english: Can you help me? How do I go about getting a bronze bar?
translation: 你能帮我吗？我怎么才能弄到青铜锭？

english: You'll need to use tin and copper ore on a furnace to produce this metal.
translation: 你需要用锡矿石和铜矿石在熔炉上熔炼出这种金属。

english: The bronze bar is ready, and waiting for the professor.
translation: 青铜锭已经准备好了，等着教授呢。

english: He'll surely be pleased. Go ahead and give it to him.
translation: 他肯定会很高兴的。去把它给他吧。

english: I certainly do. Here you go.
translation: 我当然有。给你。

english: Great. Now all I need is the lens made.
translation: 太好了。现在只需要制作透镜了。

english: Please get me some molten glass.
translation: 请给我弄些熔融玻璃来。

english: Oi! Lazy bones!
translation: 喂！懒骨头！

english: What? I'm not lazy.
translation: 什么？我不懒。

english: Not you! I'm talking to my assistant.
translation: 不是说你！我在跟我的助理说话。

english: Calm down old man, I heard. [player name], I'm here if you need any help.
translation: 冷静点老头，我听到了。[player name]，如果你需要帮助，我在这里。

english: Thank you. Wait a minute, who you calling 'old'?
translation: 谢谢。等等，你叫谁'老头'？

english: How are you getting on finding me some molten glass?
translation: 你给我找熔融玻璃的进展如何？

english: Still working on it.
translation: 还在找。

english: I really need it. Please hurry.
translation: 我真的需要它。请快点。

english: What's the best way for me to get molten glass?
translation: 我弄到熔融玻璃的最好方法是什么？

english: There are many ways, but I'd suggest making it yourself. Get yourself a bucket of sand and some soda ash, which you can get from using seaweed with a furnace. Use the soda ash and sand together in a
translation: 有很多方法，但我建议你自己制作。拿一个沙桶和一些苏打灰，你可以通过将海藻放入熔炉中获得。将苏打灰和沙子一起放进

english: furnace and bang - molten glass is all yours. There's a book about it on the table if you want to know more.
translation: 熔炉里，砰——熔融玻璃就是你的了。桌子上有本书，如果你想了解更多的话。

english: I've managed to get hold of some molten glass.
translation: 我设法弄到了一些熔融玻璃。

english: I suggest you have a word with the professor, in that case.
translation: 如果是这样，我建议你和教授谈谈。

english: Excellent work, let's make the lens.
translation: 干得好，我们来制作透镜吧。

english: It'll need to be made to an exact shape and size.
translation: 它需要做成精确的形状和尺寸。

english: Well, obviously, hence why we have a lens mould.
translation: 嗯，显然，所以我们才有透镜模具。

english: Not any more. One of those goblins took it.
translation: 现在没有了。那些哥布林中的一个把它拿走了。

english: Great, just what I need. [player name], I don't suppose you could find it?
translation: 太好了，正是我需要的。[player name]，我想你大概找不到它吧？

english: I'll have a look - where should I start?
translation: 我去看看——我应该从哪里开始？

english: No idea. You could ask my USELESS assistant if you want.
translation: 不知道。如果你想的话，可以问问我的没用的助理。

english: What have I done to deserve this?
translation: 我做了什么要受这种待遇？

english: Did you bring me the mould?
translation: 你给我带模具来了吗？

english: Still looking for it.
translation: 还在找。

english: Please try and find it; again, my assistant may be able to help.
translation: 请试着找到它；再说一次，我的助理也许能帮忙。

english: Where can I find this lens mould you mentioned?
translation: 我在哪里能找到你提到的透镜模具？

english: I'm sure I heard one of those goblins talking about it. I bet they've hidden it somewhere. Probably using it for some strange purpose, I'm sure.
translation: 我肯定听到一个哥布林在谈论它。我打赌他们把它藏在了某个地方。我敢肯定，他们可能用它来做一些奇怪的事情。

english: I had a nice new star chart, until recently. I went out to do an errand for the professor the other day, only to see a goblin using it...
translation: 我有一张漂亮的新星图，直到最近。前几天我出去为教授办事，却看到一个哥布林在用它……

english: ...as some kind of makeshift hankey to blow his nose!
translation: ……当作某种临时手帕来擤鼻涕！

english: You may want to look through the dungeon they have under their little village.
translation: 你可能想搜查一下他们小村庄下面的地牢。

english: I found a key.
translation: 我找到了一把钥匙。

english: Perhaps it unlocks something.
translation: 也许它能打开什么东西。

english: Oh, thanks. Great advice.
translation: 哦，谢谢。好建议。

english: Look. I found this.
translation: 看。我找到了这个。

english: A key?
translation: 一把钥匙？

english: To what?
translation: 开什么的？

english: Well, I don't know. Perhaps some amazing treasure!
translation: 嗯，我不知道。也许是某个惊人的宝藏！

english: Look, I found this!
translation: 看，我找到了这个！

english: It doesn't look much like a lens mould.
translation: 它看起来不太像透镜模具。

english: What? No. It's a key!
translation: 什么？不。这是一把钥匙！

english: Well,I don't really know yet.
translation: 嗯，我还不太清楚。

english: No, but I found a key.
translation: 不，但我找到了一把钥匙。

english: Interesting. You might be onto something there. Keep looking.
translation: 有意思。你可能发现了什么。继续找。

english: Oi, how dare you wake me up!
translation: 喂，你竟敢吵醒我！

english: You had better be quick, there may be more guards about.
translation: 你最好快点，周围可能还有更多守卫。

english: Euuuw, that smells awful!
translation: 呃，那味道真难闻！

english: I have the lens mould.
translation: 我有透镜模具了。

english: Well done on finding that! I am honestly quite impressed. Make sure you take it straight to the professor.
translation: 找到它了，干得好！说实话，我印象很深刻。一定要直接把它交给教授。

english: I certainly have. You'll never guess what they were doing with it.
translation: 我当然有。你绝对猜不到他们用它做什么。

english: Well, from the smell I'd guess cooking some vile concoction.
translation: 嗯，从气味来看，我猜是在煮某种恶心的混合物。

english: Wow, good guess. Well, here you go.
translation: 哇，猜得好。嗯，给你。

english: Please don't give that to him. Last time he tried any Crafting, I had to spend a week cleaning up after the explosion.
translation: 请不要把它给他。上次他尝试任何制作时，我不得不花一周时间清理爆炸后的烂摊子。

english: Explosion?
translation: 爆炸？

english: Erm, yes. I think in this instance you had probably better do it.
translation: 呃，是的。我想在这种情况下，你最好还是自己来做。

english: I suppose it's better I don't ask.
translation: 我想我还是不问为好。

english: You can use the mould with molten glass to make a new lens.
translation: 你可以用模具和熔融玻璃制作一个新的镜片。

english: Hold on a second. I don't have space to carry it all.
translation: 等一下，我没空间拿全部东西了。

english: Hurry and free up some space, then.
translation: 那就快点腾出点空间吧。

english: Is the lens finished?
translation: 镜片做好了吗？

english: How do I make it again?
translation: 我要怎么再做一次？

english: Use the molten glass with the mould.
translation: 把熔融玻璃和模具一起用。

english: How should I make this lens?
translation: 我该怎么做这个镜片？

english: Just use the molten glass with the mould. Simple.
translation: 就用熔融玻璃和模具，很简单。

english: Do you like this lens? Good, huh?
translation: 你喜欢这个镜片吗？不错吧？

english: Nice. What's that scratch?
translation: 不错。那道划痕是怎么回事？

english: Oh, erm, that's a feature.
translation: 哦，呃，那是设计特色。

english: Yes, that's it! Indubitably, it facilitates the triangulation of photonic illumination to the correct...
translation: 没错，就是那样！毫无疑问，它有助于将光子照明三角测量到正确的……

english: Stop! You can't confuse me with big words. Just pray the professor doesn't notice.
translation: 住手！别用大词来迷惑我。祈祷教授没注意到吧。

english: Wonderful, at last I can fix the telescope.
translation: 太棒了，我终于可以修好望远镜了。

english: Would you accompany me to the Observatory? You simply must see the telescope in operation.
translation: 你愿意陪我去天文台吗？你一定得看看望远镜运作的样子。

english: Sounds interesting. Count me in.
translation: 听起来很有趣。算我一个。

english: Superb. You'll have to go via the dungeon under the goblin settlement, seeing as the bridge is broken. You'll find stairs up to the Observatory from there.
translation: 太好了。你只能从哥布林定居点下方的地牢过去，因为桥断了。从那里你能找到上楼梯通往天文台。

english: Okay. See you there.
translation: 好。那儿见。

english: Ah, it's the telescope repairman! The professor is waiting for you in the Observatory.
translation: 啊，望远镜修理工！教授在天文台等你。

english: How can I get to the Observatory?
translation: 我怎么去天文台？

english: Well, since the bridge was ruined, you will have to travel through the dungeon under the goblins' settlement.
translation: 嗯，因为桥毁了，你得从哥布林定居点下方的地牢穿过去。

english: Now, well done on finding that. I am honestly quite impressed. Make sure you take it straight to the professor.
translation: 好了，找到它干得不错。说实话我挺佩服的。记得直接把它交给教授。

english: Hi, professor!
translation: 教授你好！

english: Oh, hi there.
translation: 哦，你好啊。

english: I'm just adding the finishing touches.
translation: 我正在作最后的收尾。

english: Okay, don't let me interrupt.
translation: 好，不打扰你了。

english: Right, let's get this finished.
translation: 好了，我们完成这个吧。

english: Bit of a tap here...
translation: 这里轻轻敲一下……

english: [player name], I'm just going upstairs to finish off.
translation: [player name]，我上楼去完成最后的工作。

english: Right-oh.
translation: 好嘞。

english: In goes the lens.
translation: 把镜片放进去。

english: Looking good.
translation: 看起来不错。

english: And one final adjustment.
translation: 最后再调整一下。

english: And all our work pays off.
translation: 我们的工作终于得到了回报。

english: Hi, this really is impressive.
translation: 嗨，这真是太棒了。

english: Certainly is. Please, take a look through the telescope and tell me what you see.
translation: 确实如此。请，通过望远镜看一看，告诉我你看到了什么。

english: I've had a look through the telescope.
translation: 我用望远镜看过了。

english: What did you see? If you're not sure, you can find out by looking at the star charts dotted around the walls downstairs.
translation: 你看到了什么？如果你不确定，可以看看楼下墙上贴的星图来确认。

english: It was...
translation: 那是……

english: Aquarius!
translation: 水瓶座！

english: That's exactly it!
translation: 完全正确！

english: Yes! Woo hoo!
translation: 太棒了！呜呼！

english: That's Aquarius, the water-bearer.
translation: 那是水瓶座，持水者。

english: It seems suitable, then, to award you with water runes!
translation: 那么，奖励你水系符文似乎很合适！

english: By Saradomin's earlobes! You must be a friend of the gods indeed.
translation: 萨拉多明的耳垂啊！你一定是神明真正的朋友。

english: Look in your backpack for your reward, in payment for your work.
translation: 看看你的背包，你工作的报酬就在里面。

english: Have you got some space for your reward?
translation: 你有空间拿奖励吗？

english: Reward? Oh, no, I haven't.
translation: 奖励？哦，不，我没有。

english: Come see me again when you have a few free spaces in your inventory.
translation: 等你背包里空出几个格子再来找我。

english: I'm afraid not. Have another look. Remember, you can check the star charts on the walls for reference.
translation: 恐怕不对。再看看吧。记住，你可以参考墙上的星图。

english: Capricorn!
translation: 摩羯座！

english: That's Capricorn, the goat.
translation: 那是摩羯座，山羊。

english: Capricorn will surely reward your insight with an increase to your Strength.
translation: 摩羯座必定会以提升你的力量来奖赏你的洞察力。

english: Sagittarius!
translation: 人马座！

english: That's Sagittarius, the centaur.
translation: 那是人马座，半人马。

english: As you've spotted the archer, I shall reward you with a maple longbow.
translation: 既然你看出了弓箭手，我将奖励你一把枫木长弓。

english: Scorpio!
translation: 天蝎座！

english: That's Scorpio, the scorpion.
translation: 那是天蝎座，蝎子。

english: I think weapon poison would make a suitable reward.
translation: 我觉得武器毒素作为奖励很合适。

english: Libra!
translation: 天秤座！

english: That's Libra, the scales.
translation: 那是天秤座，天平。

english: Hmmm, balance, law, order - I shall award you with law runes!
translation: 嗯，平衡、法律、秩序——我将奖励你律法符文！

english: Virgo!
translation: 室女座！

english: That's Virgo, the virtuous.
translation: 那是室女座，贞洁者。

english: Virgo will surely provide you with an increase to Defence.
translation: 室女座必定会提升你的防御。

english: Leo!
translation: 利奥！

english: That's Leo, the lion.
translation: 那是利奥，那头狮子。

english: I think the majestic power of the lion will raise your Hitpoints.
translation: 我觉得狮子的威严力量会提升你的生命值。

english: Cancer!
translation: 巨蟹座！

english: That's Cancer, the crab.
translation: 那是巨蟹座，蟹。

english: An armoured creature - I think I shall reward you with an amulet of protection.
translation: 一种有甲壳的生物——我想我该奖励你一个保护护身符。

english: Gemini!
translation: 双子座！

english: That's Gemini, the twins.
translation: 那是双子座，双胞胎。

english: With the double nature of Gemini, I can't offer you anything more suitable than a two-handed weapon.
translation: 鉴于双子座的双重特性，没有比一把双手武器更适合你的了。

english: Taurus!
translation: 金牛座！

english: That's Taurus, the bull.
translation: 那是金牛座，公牛。

english: This Strength potion should be a suitable reward.
translation: 这瓶力量药水应该是个合适的奖励。

english: Aries!
translation: 白羊座！

english: That's Aries, the ram.
translation: 那是白羊座，公羊。

english: A fierce fighter. I'm sure he'll look down on you and improve your Attack for such insight.
translation: 一位勇猛的战士。我相信他会眷顾你，因你的洞察力而提升你的攻击。

english: Pisces!
translation: 双鱼座！

english: That's Pisces, the fish.
translation: 那是双鱼座，鱼。

english: What's more suitable as a reward than some tuna?
translation: 还有什么比一些金枪鱼更适合作为奖励呢？

english: Lots of clues havedegreesandminuteswritten onthem. These are the coordinates of the place where thetreasure is buried.
translation: 很多线索上都写着度数和分钟。这些就是埋藏宝藏地点的坐标。

english: I think Murphy, the owner of the fishing trawler moored south of Ardougne, might be able to spare you a sextant. Then the nearest Clock Tower is south of Ardougne - you could probably get a watch there.
translation: 我觉得墨菲，就是停在阿多尼城以南那艘捕鱼拖网的船主，说不定能给你一个六分仪。然后最近的钟楼在阿多尼城以南——你大概能在那里弄到一块表。

english: Get lost, outlander! I've no time for you!
translation: 滚开，外地人！我没空理你！

english: Who is that? Identify yourself!
translation: 那是谁？报上名来！

english: It's me, [player name]. What are you doing out here?
translation: 是我，[player name]。你在这里做什么？

english: Nothing... Just carving these horribly broken pieces of driftwood.
translation: 没什么……只是在雕刻这些破烂不堪的浮木碎片。

english: In the middle of nowhere.
translation: 在荒郊野外。

english: In damp clothing.
translation: 穿着湿透的衣服。

english: Well, have a nice day.
translation: 嗯，祝你愉快。

english: Wait! Would you do me a favour?
translation: 等等！能帮我个忙吗？

english: What kind of a favour?
translation: 什么忙？

english: Look, you see that heap of driftwood over there? That is my ship, and all that is left of my one shot at making my ancestors proud of me.
translation: 你看，那边那堆浮木看到了吗？那就是我的船，也是我唯一一次能让祖先为我骄傲的机会留下的残骸。

english: My family have always been great explorers and seafarers, and I recently set off on my maiden voyage.
translation: 我的家族一直是伟大的探险家和航海家，我最近开始了我的处女航。

english: However, a big storm - yes, a huge storm in fact - blew my ship onto the rocks. Three times.
translation: 然而，一场大风暴——没错，其实是巨大的风暴——把我的船吹到了岩石上。整整三次。

english: I've been sitting here ever since, trying to think of a way to make my family proud, and if you will help me...I think I have a way.
translation: 从那以后我一直坐在这里，试图想出能让家族为我骄傲的办法。如果你愿意帮我……我想我有办法了。

english: Okay, I'll help you out.
translation: 好吧，我帮你。

english: Thank you! I don't have much apart from my carvings, some driftwood and the map that I was following when I had my little...
translation: 谢谢！我除了我的雕刻品、一些浮木和那张我遭遇小……时的地图外，没什么好东西了。

english: ...accident.
translation: ……意外。

english: If you help me out, then I'll gladly hand it over.
translation: 如果你帮我，我会很高兴把它交给你。

english: So, what is your plan?
translation: 那么，你的计划是什么？

english: Well, I have a little food left, although it's a little briny.
translation: 嗯，我还剩一点食物，虽然有点咸。

english: If you take a couple of carvings to my wife and son in the village over the hill and tell them that I sent you with them from a distant island, then I can wait out here for a week or so before returning.
translation: 如果你带几个雕刻品去山那边村里给我妻子和儿子，告诉他们是我从一个遥远的小岛托你送来的，那我就可以在这里等一周左右再回去。

english: Alright, hand me over the carvings and I'll be on my way.
translation: 好的，把雕刻品给我吧，我这就出发。

english: Well, none of these are any good. I'll need some fresh wood from a decent tree.
translation: 嗯，这些都不行。我需要从一棵像样的树上弄点新鲜木材。

english: When I was swimming for my life I saw an odd-looking windswept tree to the east of here, up that cliff.
translation: 当我为了活命游泳时，我看到东边悬崖上有棵奇形怪状的风吹树。

english: Could you bring me some of that wood so I can work it?
translation: 你能给我带点那种木材来让我雕刻吗？

english: Wow, you must have pretty good eyes to be able to see a single tree from the water during a heavy storm.
translation: 哇，能在暴风雨中从水里看到一棵树，你眼神一定很好。

english: Yes...great eyes...they run in the family.
translation: 是的……好眼力……我们家祖传的。

english: Possibly later, when you don't smell so damp.
translation: 也许等下次吧，等你没那么湿乎乎的时候。

english: Bah! Well, if you aren't going to help, do me a favour and jump off that cliff!
translation: 哼！好吧，既然你不肯帮忙，那就帮我个忙，跳下那个悬崖吧！

english: So... Got the logs for me yet?
translation: 那么……原木给我弄来了吗？

english: Not yet. I just popped back to see how you were doing.
translation: 还没。我只是顺路回来看看你怎么样了。

english: Still cold. Still damp. 'Bout average, really.
translation: 还是冷。还是湿。差不多就这样吧。

english: Olaf, I cut some logs from the tree. Here's the wood.
translation: 奥拉夫，我从树上砍了些原木。给你木材。

english: Wonderful! I'll carve them up now.
translation: 太好了！我现在就雕刻它们。

english: Done!
translation: 完成了！

english: Yep!
translation: 是的！

english: This is for my wife, Ingrid. I'm sure she will love it. Tell her it's tribal or something.
translation: 这是给我妻子英格丽德的。我相信她会喜欢的。告诉她这是部落风格什么的。

english: And this one is for my son, Volf. Kids love planks in my experience. Tell him I said hello.
translation: 这个是给我儿子沃夫的。据我的经验，孩子们都喜欢木板。告诉他我向他问好。

english: Alright. They live in Rellekka, right?
translation: 好的。他们住在雷勒卡城，对吗？

english: Yes. Hurry back! And don't forget the story: I'm not here, I'm someplace far away.
translation: 是的。快去快回！别忘了故事：我人不在这里，我在某个遥远的地方。

english: So, how did my wife like her carving?
translation: 那么，我妻子喜欢她的雕刻品吗？

english: I don't know... I've still got it.
translation: 我不知道……我还拿着呢。

english: Well, hurry up and give it to her then!
translation: 那你赶紧给她啊！

english: She was very happy with it!
translation: 她非常喜欢！

english: I wish icould see her again...
translation: 我真希望能再见到她……

english: Well, if this plan works out you will be able too, right?
translation: 嗯，如果这个计划成功了，你就能了，对吗？

english: Yes, you're right.
translation: 是的，你说得对。

english: Did my son like his present? I'll bet he was thrilled.
translation: 我儿子喜欢他的礼物吗？我打赌他一定很开心。

english: I'll bet he will be... but I've still got it.
translation: 我打赌他会喜欢的……但我还拿着呢。

english: Well, take your time over it, why don't you.
translation: 嗯，那你慢慢来呗。

english: Excuse me, but are you Ingrid? The same Ingrid that is married to Olaf Hradson?
translation: 打扰一下，你是英格丽德吗？就是嫁给奥拉夫.赫拉德森的那位英格丽德？

english: Yes I am. Why do you ask?
translation: 是的，我是。你为什么这么问？

english: I am a friend of your husband. He sent me here with a gift for you.
translation: 我是你丈夫的朋友。他让我带一份礼物给你。

english: An expensive, exotic gift from the far-flung and tropical shores of the Island of Obscurity.
translation: 一份昂贵、异国情调的礼物，来自遥远热带的神秘岛海岸。

english: How wonderful! I assumed from the way the big oaf always referred to the rigging as 'big strings' that he couldn't navigate his way out of a soggy paper bag. So, can I see the gift he sent?
translation: 太棒了！那个大笨蛋总是把索具叫做'大绳子'，我就知道他连个湿纸袋都走不出去。那么，我能看看他送的礼物吗？

english: Certainly! Here it is. He sends his best wishes along with it.
translation: 当然！这就是。他附上了最诚挚的祝福。

english: I see. It looks like a log with 'Olaf was here' carved in it.
translation: 明白了。看起来就是根刻着'奥拉夫到此一游'的原木。

english: It's tribal! Very tribal! I watched the natives carve it myself.
translation: 这是部落风格！非常有部落风格！我亲眼看着土著雕刻的。

english: Well, since you have come such a long way, you can have this. I baked it this morning, so it's still nice and fresh.
translation: 嗯，既然你大老远跑来，这个给你。我今早烤的，还很新鲜。

english: Oh, thank you! Enjoy your Obscurian Tribal Artefact(tm). It has a million-and-one uses!
translation: 哦，谢谢！好好享受你的神秘岛部落艺术品（商标）吧。它有一百万零一种用途！

english: Volf? Son of Olaf Hradson?
translation: 沃夫？奥拉夫.赫拉德森的儿子？

english: Yes. Do I know you?
translation: 是的。我认识你吗？

english: No, but I do know your father. He sent me with a present for you from, err...
translation: 不，但我认识你父亲。他让我带礼物给你，呃……

english: From the Island of Obscurity.
translation: 从神秘岛带来的。

english: Oh! That was fast! He only set off recently, and I was wondering how he was doing. So, where is this gift?
translation: 哦！这么快！他最近才出发，我还在想他怎么样了。那么，礼物在哪儿？

english: Right here. Enjoy!
translation: 就在这里。享受吧！

english: Very valuable. Have a nice time!
translation: 非常珍贵。玩得开心！

english: Wait! Here, take this. I was going to have it for my lunch, but I suppose you can have it in payment.
translation: 等等！给，拿着这个。我本来打算当午餐的，但我想你可以把它当报酬拿去。

english: Thanks! Enjoy your new...thing!
translation: 谢谢！享受你的新……东西吧！

english: Olaf, are you all right?
translation: 奥拉夫，你还好吗？

english: So...cold...need...fire.
translation: 太……冷……了……需要……火。

english: I delivered your carvings as you asked. Your family would like to see you again.
translation: 我按你的要求送去了雕刻品。你的家人想再见你。

english: Here, let me get you to the village before you freeze to death.
translation: 来，我带你回村子，免得你冻死。

english: I won't...go...anywhere. I don't...care if I...freeze.
translation: 我哪儿……也……不去。我……不在乎……冻死。

english: I'd rather...die...than suffer...the shame.
translation: 我宁愿……死……也不愿……蒙受耻辱。

english: Just get the...fire burning. Use...these.
translation: 只管把……火……生起来。用……这些。

english: Well, at least give me the map like you promised!
translation: 好吧，至少把地图给我，就像你承诺的那样！

english: Too...cold...to...hear...whining.
translation: 太……冷了……听不到……抱怨。

english: So...very...cold. Almost cold enough to tear up an old map with my fevered shivering. Cough, cough.
translation: 这么……非常……冷。几乎冷到可以用我发烧般的颤抖撕碎一张旧地图。咳，咳。

english: Ahhhhhhhh... Much better.
translation: 啊……好多了。

english: Well, I'm glad you're happy. Can I have that map now?
translation: 嗯，很高兴你舒服了。现在可以把地图给我了吗？

english: Well, okay...but could I have a little of that food first? I've had nothing but seaweed and biscuits for the past week.
translation: 嗯，好吧……但我能先吃点食物吗？过去一周我除了海藻和饼干什么都没吃。

english: Not a chance.
translation: 没门。

english: Okay, okay, I was only asking.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我只是问问。

english: Well, regardless, you've more than earned this map. It was the last one my grandfather, Sven the Helmsman, ever made.
translation: 嗯，不管怎样，你完全配得上这张地图。这是我祖父，舵手斯文，制作的最后一张地图。

english: It is supposed to show the location of one of his stashes of treasure, but I have never been able to decipher the strange, runic inscriptions that point the way.
translation: 它应该显示了他一个宝藏藏匿点的位置，但我一直无法解读那些指路的奇怪卢恩文字。

english: I wish you luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: Well, thanks. What will you do now?
translation: 嗯，谢谢。你现在打算做什么？

english: I'll sit here and practice carving.
translation: 我会坐在这里练习雕刻。

english: If you pass this way again, I'll be glad if you drop my next load of work off with my family.
translation: 如果你下次再经过这里，我很乐意让你把我的下一批作品捎给我的家人。

english: That or bring me some food before I starve. Whichever.
translation: 或者在我饿死前给我带点吃的。随便选一个。

english: Hey! I'm trying to carve and you're standing in my light! Move it!
translation: 嘿！我正在雕刻，你挡着我的光了！走开！

english: Olaf, I seem to have lost your map, can I have another?
translation: 奥拉夫，我好像把你的地图弄丢了，能再给我一张吗？

english: You lost the treasured map of Sven the Helmsman? How dare you!
translation: 你弄丢了舵手斯文的珍贵地图？你竟敢！

english: You'd best take better care of this one, or else!
translation: 你最好好好保管这张，否则！

english: Slay... Outlander... Intruder!
translation: 杀死……外地人……入侵者！

english: Is there anything else interesting to do around here?
translation: 这附近还有什么有趣的事可做吗？

english: You sound a bit bored of Shilo Village...what's wrong?
translation: 你听起来有点厌倦希洛村了……怎么了？

english: Nothing, I was just wondering if there was anything else to do?
translation: 没什么，我只是想知道还有没有别的事可做？

english: Well, if you're bored, you could do me a small favour and nip to see the jungle forester. I need a piece of red mahogany to resurface an antique wardrobe.
translation: 嗯，如果你无聊的话，可以帮我一个小忙，去找一下丛林护林员。我需要一块红桃花心木来翻新一个古董衣柜。

english: Ok, see you in a tick!
translation: 好，我马上回来！

english: Great, nice of you to do it for me.
translation: 太好了，你愿意帮我真是太好了。

english: I'll get going then!
translation: 那我这就出发！

english: That'd be helpful!
translation: 那真是帮大忙了！

english: Where do I meet this jungle forester?
translation: 我要去哪里找这个丛林护林员？

english: Oh, sorry, I thought you knew the area. You'll find a jungle forester in between the southern edge of Shilo Village and the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我以为你熟悉这一带。你可以在希洛村南边和卡拉兹丛林之间找到一位丛林护林员。

english: They're always trying to find ways into that place.
translation: 他们总想找办法进到那个地方去。

english: I hear that some old timer from the Legends Guild keeps sending new recruits down there..only Zamorak knows why.
translation: 我听说传奇公会里有个老家伙一直派新兵去那里……只有萨莫拉克知道为什么。

english: Nah thanks, I've got bigger fish to fry.
translation: 不用了谢谢，我还有更重要的事要做。

english: Fair enough! Hope it all goes well...but, you know, you looked bored so I just thought I'd suggest it.
translation: 有道理！希望你一切顺利……不过，你知道，我看你挺无聊的，所以就想提个建议。

english: What was I supposed to do again?
translation: 我该做什么来着？

english: I've forgotten what to do, can you remind me?
translation: 我忘了要做什么，你能提醒我吗？

english: Tsk....It's only a little job bwana, I ask you to do me one small favour! Go to the jungle forester and get me a piece of red mahogany. It can't be that difficult can it?
translation: 啧……只是件小事，先生，我请你帮我一个小忙！去找丛林护林员，给我弄一块红桃花心木。这应该没那么难吧？

english: This is taking longer than I expected!
translation: 这比我想象的要花时间！

english: You're telling me bwana, I was supposed to have this wardrobe finished before now! Hurry it up will you, I don't have all day!
translation: 还用你说，先生，我本来应该早就把这个衣柜做完了！快点吧，我可没那么多时间！

english: Is there an easier way of getting this exotic wood?
translation: 有没有更容易的方法弄到这种异国木材？

english: Huh! You make it sound like a major undertaking! I should have just done it myself!
translation: 哈！你说得好像这是什么大工程似的！我当初真该自己去做！

english: Everyone is asking me to do them favours now! It seems like I've opened the floodgates!
translation: 现在每个人都来找我帮忙！看来我是开了个坏头！

english: Well, can't you just do my favour and forget about theirs?
translation: 嗯，你就不能先帮我的忙，别管他们的吗？

english: I need to talk to you about red mahogany.
translation: 我需要跟你谈谈红桃花心木的事。

english: Oh, yes, well I can get you a piece but I need my axe sharpening... Do me a small favour would you? Take it to Captain Shanks for me.
translation: 哦，是的，我可以给你一块，但我的斧头需要磨一下……帮我一个小忙好吗？替我把斧头拿给尚克斯船长。

english: Okay, I'll take your axe to get it sharpened.
translation: 好的，我帮你把斧头拿去磨。

english: Great, here you go! If you could ask the Captain to pop it into Brian's Axes for resharpening when he's next in Port Sarim, that would be really helpful.
translation: 太好了，给你！如果你能请船长下次去沙林港时，顺便把斧头送到布莱恩的斧头店重新打磨一下，那就太好了。

english: Why should I take it to Captain Shanks?
translation: 为什么我要把它拿给尚克斯船长？

english: He's the Captain of the 'Lady of the Waves', he goes to Port Sarim quite often. Could you ask the Captain to drop the axe in at Brian's Axes the next time he's in Port Sarim? I'm sure he won't mind!
translation: 他是‘波浪女士号’的船长，经常去沙林港。你能请船长下次去沙林港时，顺便把斧头送到布莱恩的斧头店吗？我相信他不会介意的！

english: Where is Captain Shanks?
translation: 尚克斯船长在哪里？

english: Wow, you're really not from around here are you? The Captain is to the west of here, follow the northern edge of the Kharazi Jungle, he's usually on board his ship!
translation: 哇，你肯定不是本地人吧？船长在西边，沿着卡拉兹丛林的北边走，他通常都在他的船上！

english: I gave you my blunt axe to give to Captain Shanks. I was hoping that he would be able to pop it into Brian's Axes in Port Sarim to get it sharpened. I do hope nothing bad has happened to my axe, I am very partial
translation: 我把我的钝斧头给了你，让你交给尚克斯船长。我本来希望他能顺便把它送到沙林港的布莱恩斧头店去磨一下。我真希望我的斧头没出什么事，我对它可是情有独钟。

english: to it!
translation: 情有独钟啊！

english: Oh, yes... okay! No, I'm sure that nothing bad has happened to it. I mean, you gave it to me, I'm really dependable!
translation: 哦，是的……好吧！不，我肯定它没出什么事。我是说，你把它给了我，我可是很可靠的！

english: Take the blunt axe to Captain Shanks and ask him to take it to Brian's Axes.
translation: 把钝斧头拿给尚克斯船长，请他把它送到布莱恩的斧头店。

english: Who is it that I'm supposed to meet?
translation: 我该去见谁来着？

english: You're supposed to take the axe to Captain Shanks and ask him to take it Brian's Axes in Port Sarim. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: 你应该把斧头拿给尚克斯船长，请他把它送到沙林港的布莱恩斧头店。我相信他不会介意的。

english: Do you really actually need that axe?
translation: 你真的那么需要那把斧头吗？

english: Well, yes, actually. It's my favourite! I've been training with that axe since I started my profession as a jungle forester.
translation: 嗯，是的，确实需要。那可是我最喜欢的！从我成为丛林护林员开始，我就一直用那把斧头训练。

english: I've lost your unsharpened axe, I need a new one.
translation: 我把你那把没磨的斧头弄丢了，我需要一把新的。

english: I know. Another jungle forester found it and returned it to me. Here, take it again and this time don't lose it!
translation: 我知道。另一个丛林护林员找到了它并还给了我。来，再拿去吧，这次可别再弄丢了！

english: Okay, I promise to be more careful.
translation: 好的，我保证会更小心。

english: Actually I have a favour to ask.
translation: 其实我有个忙想请你帮。

english: A favour you say...hmmm. What is it?
translation: 你说帮忙……嗯。什么事？

english: I have an axe from the jungle forester, I wonder if you could nip into Brian's Axes in Port Sarim and get it sharpened for the jungle forester.
translation: 我有一把丛林护林员的斧头，我想你能不能顺便去沙林港的布莱恩斧头店，帮丛林护林员把它磨一下。

english: Darned cheek! I have a tight ship to run, my friend, and I'll thank you to not take advantage of my good generosity. I have a far superior solution to your problem.
translation: 真是厚脸皮！我的朋友，我有一艘船要管理，请你不要利用我的好心。对于你的问题，我有一个更好的解决办法。

english: Take a ride with me to Port Sarim and take the axe to Brian yourself!
translation: 跟我一起坐船去沙林港，你自己把斧头拿给布莱恩！

english: But...I was only meant to do a small favour for Yanni Salika...I don't want to go to Port Sarim!
translation: 但是……我只是想帮雅尼.萨利卡一个小忙……我不想去沙林港！

english: Well...the choice is yours! Do like me and never do favours...you'll find yourself in a lot less bother I can assure you!
translation: 嗯……那你自己选吧！像我一样，永远别帮别人忙……我保证你会少很多麻烦！

english: I've said no already...now move along...I have a tight ship to run.
translation: 我已经说不了……现在走吧……我有一艘船要管理。

english: You don't have any blunt axes on you!
translation: 你身上没有钝斧头！

english: You know what! You're absolutely right! I must have dropped it or left it somewhere.
translation: 你知道吗！你说得完全对！我一定是把它掉在哪儿或者落在哪儿了。

english: Well, come back if you need any help with it, we may be able to work something out.
translation: 嗯，如果需要帮忙的话就回来，我们也许能想出办法。

english: You know what, normally I do...but...
translation: 你知道吗，通常我是会的……但是……

english: But... what?
translation: 但是……什么？

english: But I'm a bit preoccupied at the moment. I'm worried that my friend is going to spend the rest of the year behind bars!
translation: 但我现在有点忙。我担心我的朋友要在牢里待完今年剩下的日子了！

english: It sounds serious!
translation: 听起来很严重！

english: Yeah, it is, but it shouldn't be. It was only a harmless pub brawl but he got caught up in it and they just jailed everyone.
translation: 是啊，是很严重，但本不该如此的。只是一场无害的酒馆斗殴，但他被卷了进去，他们就把所有人都关起来了。

english: Except he says he's going to run away to the wilderness if he's found guilty and you know what blood-hungry scum inhabit those realms.
translation: 不过他说如果被判有罪，他就逃到荒野去，你也知道那些地方住着些什么嗜血的渣滓。

english: Look, can you sharpen this cursed axe or what?
translation: 听着，你到底能不能磨这把该死的斧头？

english: Well, I'd like to. I really would, but I wouldn't be able to concentrate while worrying about my friend so much. I tell you what. If you could do me just one small favour, I promise to help you!
translation: 嗯，我很想磨。真的，但我太担心我的朋友了，没法集中精神。我跟你说吧。如果你能帮我一个小忙，我保证会帮你！

english: Oh, so you want a favour doing as well?
translation: 哦，所以你也想让我帮忙？

english: Well, yes, if you wouldn't mind? Aggie the witch is a family friend and she's a pillar of the local community.
translation: 嗯，是的，如果你不介意的话？女巫阿吉是家里的朋友，也是当地社区的支柱。

english: I know you wouldn't think it would you! Could you ask her if she'll act as a character witness for my friend?
translation: 我知道你可能看不出来！你能问问她是否愿意为我朋友做品格证人吗？

english: Oh, please. It would mean such a lot to me! Just ask Aggie if she'll be a character witness for my friend. She only lives in Draynor Village. It'll only take you a few minutes!
translation: 哦，求你了。这对我来说意义重大！只要问问阿吉是否愿意为我朋友做品格证人。她就住在德雷诺村。只需要你几分钟时间！

english: Ok, ok, I'll do it! I'll go and see Aggie.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我去！我去找阿吉。

english: Oh, great, that would be really helpful! Here, give me the axe for safe keeping and I'll get it sharpened as soon as she agrees to help.
translation: 哦，太好了，那真是帮大忙了！来，把斧头给我保管，等她同意帮忙，我马上就磨。

english: Is there anyone else who can sharpen this axe?
translation: 还有别人能磨这把斧头吗？

english: Hmm, well you could try your luck in Lumbridge at Bob's Axes, though I've no clue if he offers this kind of service.
translation: 嗯，你可以去仑桥镇的鲍勃斧头店碰碰运气，不过我不知道他提不提供这种服务。

english: He always seemed very focused on selling axes to blood-hungry killers keen to explore the wilderness.
translation: 他好像一直专注于把斧头卖给那些想去荒野探险的嗜血杀手。

english: Hmmm, yes, that looks pretty badly damaged. Unfortunately, I don't have the tools to fix it, but Brian over in Port Sarim might be able to.
translation: 嗯，是的，看起来损坏得很严重。不幸的是，我没有工具来修它，但沙林港的布莱恩也许能修。

english: Go talk to Aggie and ask her if she'll be a character witness for my friend before he finds himself in jail with less than savoury people...or worse, he runs off to the wilderness!
translation: 去找阿吉谈谈，问她是否愿意为我朋友做品格证人，免得他还没进监狱跟那些不三不四的人待在一起……或者更糟，他逃到荒野去！

english: Oh, right, yes, sorry, I forgot..
translation: 哦，对，是的，抱歉，我忘了……

english: So it seems!
translation: 看来是这样！

english: Hey you're a witch aren't you?
translation: 嘿，你是个女巫，对吧？

english: My, you're observant!
translation: 哎呀，你观察力真强！

english: Could I ask you about being a character witness?
translation: 我能问问你关于做品格证人的事吗？

english: Not at the minute I'm afraid...I'm really worried! My new apprentice 'Jimmy the Chisel' has gone missing!
translation: 恐怕现在不行……我真的很担心！我的新学徒‘凿子吉米’失踪了！

english: 'Jimmy the Chisel' - what kind of name is that?
translation: ‘凿子吉米’——这算什么名字？

english: It's sort of like a 'street name'...it's a new fad [player name]...perhaps you've seen it around? Anyway, it's not his name I'm concerned with, it's his whereabouts that worries me!
translation: 这有点像‘街头绰号’……是最近流行的玩意儿，[player name]……也许你见过？总之，我担心的不是他的名字，而是他的下落！

english: What do you mean missing?
translation: 你说失踪是什么意思？

english: Well, I sent him to Lumbridge to get some supplies and he hasn't come back! He left about two days ago and I've seen neither hide nor hair of him all that time.
translation: 嗯，我派他去仑桥镇拿些补给品，他就没回来！他大约两天前出发的，这段时间我完全没见到他的踪影。

english: Do you have any idea where he might be?
translation: 你知道他可能在哪里吗？

english: Not really, I mean, not for definite. But I did hear old Ned talking about some strange activity in that ruined building infested with goblins and spiders in between here and Lumbridge.
translation: 不太确定，我是说，不能肯定。但我确实听到老内德说起，在从这里到仑桥镇之间那座满是哥布林和蜘蛛的废墟建筑里有些奇怪的活动。

english: It's probably nothing...but it would aid my mind a lot to know he was safe. I can't leave here until he returns. What if he's had an accident and needs some emergency magical attention?
translation: 可能没什么……但知道他是安全的会让我安心很多。在他回来之前我不能离开这里。万一他出了意外，需要紧急魔法治疗怎么办？

english: Let me guess, you're going to ask me to do you a favour?
translation: 让我猜猜，你是想让我帮你一个忙？

english: Would you my dear, it would only be a small favour...one small favour, that's all I ask.
translation: 你愿意吗，亲爱的，只是一个小忙……一个小忙，我就只求这个。

english: Hmm, I seem to have heard that one before. Go on then, what do you want me to do?
translation: 嗯，这话我好像听过。说吧，你想让我做什么？

english: Could you go on and check out that abandoned building and see if there's anything odd going on. Just check to see if there's any sign of young Jimmy.
translation: 你能去那座废弃建筑看看，有没有什么奇怪的事发生吗？就看看有没有小吉米的踪迹。

english: No way...I've had enough of doing favours for people.
translation: 不行……我帮别人忙已经帮够了。

english: Why you big meanie! He could be dead for all you know!
translation: 你怎么这么小气！说不定他已经死了呢！

english: Oh, Ok, I'll see if I can find Jimmy.
translation: 哦，好吧，我去看看能不能找到吉米。

english: Oh, thanks ever so much...I do appreciate it! Good Luck!
translation: 哦，太感谢了……我真的很感激！祝你好运！

english: Well, I had hoped that you would go and look for 'Jimmy the Chisel'...but it looks like you've had other 'more important' things to do!
translation: 嗯，我本来希望你能去找‘凿子吉米’……但看来你有其他‘更重要’的事要做！

english: Where am I supposed to look?
translation: 我该去哪里找？

english: I don't know where he is! But I suggest that you check out that ruined building to the east, you know, the one with all the spiders in it! Doesn't look like anyone's been living in there for years!
translation: 我不知道他在哪里！但我建议你去东边那座废墟建筑看看，你知道的，就是那个满是蜘蛛的地方！看起来好多年没人住过了！

english: What am I doing this for?
translation: 我这么做是为了什么？

english: Oh, I don't know, you mumbled something about 'witnesses', I just can't think straight worrying so much about that poor little Jimmy.
translation: 哦，我不知道，你咕哝着什么‘证人’之类的，我太担心那个可怜的小吉米了，脑子都转不动了。

english: He could be lying somewhere in a pool of his blood, crying out for help...oooh, it's too much for me to bear.
translation: 他可能正躺在自己的血泊里，呼喊着求救……哦，我实在受不了了。

english: Welcome [Brother/Sister]...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow [brother/sister].
translation: 欢迎你，[Brother/Sister]……加入我们的组织……我们为各种形态的人类而战……并清除世界上存在的怪物。我们与同为[brother/sister]的人没有争执。

english: I'm looking for Jimmy the Chisel.
translation: 我在找凿子.吉米。

english: Ah yes, he'll be joining our ranks very soon, I feel. He's still quite young and strong, but he will see the error of his ways before too long.
translation: 啊，是的，我感觉他很快就要加入我们了。他还年轻力壮，但过不了多久他就会明白自己走错了路。

english: Huh, it sounds like you're forcing him to join you
translation: 哼，听起来你在强迫他加入你们？

english: Not at all...he just needs some time to think about things...we've given him all the time he needs in the cage back there.
translation: 完全没有……他只是需要时间好好想想……我们在后面的笼子里给了他足够的时间。

english: Well, I have to return him to his employer, she's very worried about him, so if you could just hand him over...I'll be getting out of your way.
translation: 好吧，我必须把他送还给他的雇主，她很担心他。所以如果你能把他交出来……我就不会再打扰你了。

english: I'm afraid I can't do that...he has value to us...he's related to a farmer named Fred who lives near here. We need to arrange some things with this 'Brother Fred' so that my people down here can eat.
translation: 恐怕我不能这么做……他对我们有价值……他和住在这附近的一个叫弗雷德的农夫有关系。我们需要和这位'弗雷德兄弟'安排一些事情，这样我下面的人才有吃的。

english: And I suppose you need me to do you a favour?
translation: 我想你是要我帮你一个忙？

english: Well, actually, now that you mention it...it would be a real help to us if you could organise some chickens in exchange for young Jimmy's release.
translation: 嗯，事实上，既然你提到了……如果你能安排一些鸡来交换小吉米的释放，那对我们真的很有帮助。

english: Ok, just exactly what is it that you want me to do?
translation: 好吧，你到底要我做什么？

english: Go to Brother Fred the farmer and tell him that we have young Brother Jimmy. Tell him that we're not going to let him free until he agrees to send us a month's supply of chickens.
translation: 去找农夫弗雷德兄弟，告诉他我们抓了小吉米兄弟。告诉他除非他同意给我们一个月的鸡作为补给品，否则我们不会放了他。

english: No way...go do your own dirty work!
translation: 没门……你自己去做这种脏活吧！

english: Now, now [player name], I'm a little disappointed in you! Can't you see that this is merely a business transaction?
translation: 好了，好了，[player name]，我对你有点失望！你没看出这只是一笔交易吗？

english: Come back and see me when you change your mind!
translation: 等你改变主意了再回来找我！

english: Ok, Jimmy has to be worth more than a few scrawny chickens!
translation: 好吧，吉米总该比几只瘦鸡更有价值吧！

english: That's exactly right! Do this for us and we'll let Brother Jimmy go!
translation: 说得对！帮我们办成这件事，我们就放了吉米兄弟！

english: Welcome back [Brother/Sister] [player name], how are your negotiations going with Brother Fred?
translation: 欢迎回来，[Brother/Sister] [player name]，你和弗雷德兄弟谈得怎么样了？

english: Oh for the love of Saradomin...it's not too difficult! Go to Brother Fred and ask him to supply a month's worth of chickens in return for Brother Jimmy's freedom!
translation: 看在萨拉多明的份上……这没那么难！去找弗雷德兄弟，让他提供一个月的鸡作为交换吉米兄弟自由的代价！

english: Can't you just release Jimmy the Chisel?
translation: 你就不能直接放了凿子.吉米吗？

english: Yes, of course....why didn't you ask earlier? Is that all you wanted? Huh!
translation: 当然可以……你为什么不早点问？你就要这个？哼！

english: Of course, you do have the chickens don't you?
translation: 当然，你确实有鸡，对吧？

english: Er...not exactly!
translation: 呃……不完全是！

english: Go get them then!
translation: 那就去拿啊！

english: I don't think I can do this.
translation: 我觉得我做不了这个。

english: That's a shame, because Brother Jimmy is getting older every day! His employer isn't going to be too pleased if you don't do something soon.
translation: 真可惜，因为吉米兄弟一天天变老了！如果你不快点行动，他的雇主可不会高兴。

english: I need to talk to you about Jimmy.
translation: 我需要和你谈谈吉米的事。

english: What's the problem with Jimmy?
translation: 吉米出了什么问题？

english: He's being kept prisoner by a bunch of fanatics and I need to organise a delivery of a month's supply of chickens to secure his release.
translation: 他被一群狂热分子囚禁了，我需要安排运送一个月的鸡来确保他获释。

english: Oh dear, oh dear, this is terrible. Terrible!
translation: 哦，天哪，天哪，这太糟糕了。太糟糕了！

english: Yes, it's pretty bad...but keep calm, I'm going to help.
translation: 是的，情况很糟……但保持冷静，我会帮忙的。

english: I've no idea what to do!
translation: 我不知道该怎么办！

english: Well, no actually. I'm just a farmer. I've no idea how to deal with fanatics!
translation: 嗯，其实没有。我只是个农夫。我不知道怎么对付狂热分子！

english: Well, can't you just give me some chickens?
translation: 那，你能不能直接给我一些鸡？

english: Normally I'd say yes, but I just don't have enough for a month's supply.
translation: 通常我会同意，但我没有足够一个月的补给量。

english: Well, do you know someone who does have a month's supply?
translation: 那你知不知道谁有够一个月的量？

english: Seth does, Seth Groats. He's another farmer over yonder at the other farm. Over the river and on the way to Varrock, he has loads of chickens.
translation: 塞斯有，塞斯.格罗茨。他是那边另一个农场的农夫。过了河，在去维洛克城的路上，他养了很多鸡。

english: What did you suggest I do again?
translation: 你建议我做什么来着？

english: Have you been to Seth Groats yet? He's over at the other farm on the way to Varrock!
translation: 你去找过塞斯.格罗茨了吗？他在去维洛克城路上的另一个农场！

english: Ok, I'll go and see him then.
translation: 好吧，那我这就去找他。

english: Hello there stranger, what's the meaning of this intrusion? A farmer's hovel is his castle!
translation: 你好啊陌生人，擅自闯入是什么意思？农夫的茅屋就是他的城堡！

english: Sorry for the intrusion, but this is quite urgent. Jimmy the Chisel is being held by fanatics. They won't release him until they get a month's supply of chickens.
translation: 抱歉打扰了，但这事很紧急。凿子.吉米被狂热分子抓住了。他们要求一个月的鸡作为补给品才肯放人。

english: I've already talked to Fred but he says he doesn't have a month's supply of chickens. Is there any way that you could help?
translation: 我已经和弗雷德谈过了，但他说他没有一个月的鸡。你能帮上忙吗？

english: A month's supply eh! Well, I was going to take them to market and just concentrate on the cows, but I reckon that little Jimmy's neck is worth a few scrawny chickens, don't you?
translation: 一个月的供应啊！嗯，我本来打算把它们拿去市场，专心养奶牛，但我认为小吉米的脖子值几只瘦鸡，你说呢？

english: That's exactly what I said...
translation: 这正是我说的……

english: Well, Ok then. We need to get this organised. First off, we need to get some proper cages to get them chickens transported. I've never normally transported chickens in such large quantities before.
translation: 好吧，那行。我们得安排一下。首先，我们需要合适的笼子来运输这些鸡。我以前从没运送过这么大数量的鸡。

english: What do you propose?
translation: 你有什么建议？

english: We'll need to get some proper cages, but I have nothing like that here. You'll have to go and see my friend Horvik in Varrock. He's a pretty well known metal-smith and he's done me a few favours in the past.
translation: 我们需要弄些合适的笼子，但我这里没有。你得去维洛克城找我的朋友霍维克。他是个挺有名的金属工匠，以前帮过我几次忙。

english: I'm afraid that I'll have to ask a small favour of you as well, my friend.
translation: 恐怕我还得请你帮个小忙，我的朋友。

english: I had a feeling you might!
translation: 我就知道你会这么说！

english: Could you get three bars of steel and take them to Horvik, that's what I owe him for a previous job that he did for me.
translation: 你能弄三根钢条带给霍维克吗？这是我欠他的，因为他之前帮我做过一个活儿。

english: No way, I'm fed up with this wild goose chase!
translation: 不行，我受够了这种毫无意义的瞎忙活！

english: I understand...
translation: 我理解……

english: Poor old Jimmy, locked in that cage...
translation: 可怜的老吉米，被锁在那笼子里……

english: Forever!
translation: 永远！

english: Oh, ok! I guess it's not that much further to Varrock!
translation: 哦，好吧！我想去维洛克城也没多远了！

english: Many thanks! Remember, you need to take him three steel bars.
translation: 非常感谢！记住，你要带三根钢条给他。

english: You need to get three bars of steel and take them to Horvik in Varrock, ask him if he can make some chicken cages so that we can transport these chickens to those fanatics and release poor Jimmy.
translation: 你需要弄三根钢条，带到维洛克城给霍维克，问他能不能做一些鸡笼子，这样我们就能把这些鸡运给那些狂热分子，释放可怜的吉米。

english: Ah yes...I remember now.
translation: 啊，对……我想起来了。

english: How are those chicken cages coming along?
translation: 那些鸡笼子做得怎么样了？

english: Sorry, but I don't have any yet.
translation: 抱歉，我还没有呢。

english: Hi, I need to talk to you about chicken cages! Seth Groats has asked me to come and see you!
translation: 嗨，我需要和你谈谈鸡笼子的事！塞斯.格罗茨让我来找你！

english: Hmm, Seth eh! He's a good friend, but he still owes me three steel bars for a plough I fixed. I'm sorry but I need to have that paid off first before I can do any more work for him.
translation: 嗯，塞思是吗！他是个好朋友，但他还欠我三根钢锭，因为我帮他修了犁。抱歉，我需要他先还清债务，才能再为他做更多工作。

english: But I don't have three steel bars at the moment!
translation: 但我现在没有三根钢条！

english: I'm sorry to be so harsh, but I have to ensure the debt is paid before I do any more work for Seth.
translation: 抱歉这么严厉，但我必须确保债务还清，才能再为塞思做任何工作。

english: Ok, well I have three steel bars here, you can have these.
translation: 好吧，我这里有三个钢条，给你。

english: Ok then! Great...tell me a little more about these chicken cages... Cough Cough Cough!
translation: 那好！太好了……跟我多说说这些鸡笼子……咳咳咳！

english: Oh dear, you don't sound too well?
translation: 哦天哪，你听起来不太好？

english: No, I'm not actually, I'm quite ill!
translation: 不，其实我病得挺重的！

english: Well that's a shame because I really need your help to make some chicken cages!
translation: 那真可惜，因为我真的很需要你帮忙做鸡笼子！

english: I'm sorry, but the most I can manage today is simple trading...however, if I was to get some medicine say, I could be persuaded to do you a small favour!
translation: 抱歉，我今天最多只能做点简单的买卖……不过，如果我能得到一些药，也许可以说服我帮你一个小忙！

english: Oh I see, you need me to do you a favour?
translation: 哦，我明白了，你需要我帮你一个忙？

english: Well, just one small favour...and then I'll do you a small favour.
translation: 嗯，只是一个小忙……然后我就帮你一个小忙。

english: Oh, no not another favour...I just can't do another one!
translation: 哦，不，别再是另一个忙了……我实在不能再做了！

english: Well, I'm sorry about that...but I just can't work when I'm feeling so ill.
translation: 嗯，那我很抱歉……但我病成这样没法工作。

english: Ok, I guess one good turn deserves another.
translation: 好吧，我想好心应该有好报。

english: Well that's jolly decent of you my friend. I need some medicine, could you get me some herbal tincture and breathing salts, that should solve my ailments!
translation: 你真是太够意思了，我的朋友。我需要一些药，你能帮我弄些草药酊剂和呼吸盐吗？应该能治好我的病！

english: Well, hopefully, I'll be right back, but you never know, it might take longer!
translation: 嗯，希望我很快回来，但谁知道呢，可能时间更长！

english: That's great! However, I must warn you, it'll be a lot easier for me to simply adjust some existing pigeon cages. If you could get me five or so of those, that would help a lot.
translation: 太好了！不过我必须提醒你，对我来说，直接改造一些现有的鸽子笼要容易得多。如果你能弄到大约五个那样的笼子，那就帮大忙了。

english: But first things first, bring me the medicine!
translation: 但重要的事情先做，把药给我带来！

english: Please can you get me some medicine? I need herbal tincture and a pot of breathing salts. Also, get me five or so of those pigeon cages that they have over in Ardougne so that I can convert them into chicken
translation: 能帮我弄些药吗？我需要草药酊剂和一罐呼吸盐。另外，给我弄大概五个阿多尼城那种鸽子笼，这样我就能把它们改装成鸡

english: Horvik is ill, I need breathing salts and herbal tincture.
translation: 霍维克病了，我需要呼吸盐和草药酊剂。

english: There you do! There's your herbal tincture!
translation: 给你！你的草药酊剂！

english: Wow, that was surprisingly easy! Fantastic, thanks very much.
translation: 哇，竟然这么容易！太棒了，非常感谢。

english: No problem, pleased to help.
translation: 没问题，很高兴能帮忙。

english: Oh...but...what about the breathing salts...
translation: 哦……但是……呼吸盐呢……

english: Oh, yes, breathing salts...erm, just let me look around. I'm sure I have some around here somewhere.
translation: 哦，对，呼吸盐……呃，让我找找。我肯定这附近某处有。

english: Yep, here they are....
translation: 是的，在这里……

english: Oh blimey...I've dropped the pot and smashed it!
translation: 哦天哪……我把罐子掉地上摔碎了！

english: That's ok, just hand over the breathing salts.
translation: 没关系，把呼吸盐给我就行。

english: Oh no, you don't understand. They're ruined. They're supposed to be kept in an airtight container and this was my last one.
translation: 哦不，你不明白。它们毁了。它们本应保存在密封容器里，而这是我最后一个容器。

english: I can't order any more in until I have a new airtight container. And they were a top selling item as well.
translation: 在我有新的密封罐之前，我无法再订购了。而且它们还是热销商品。

english: I just knew this wasn't going to be easy! So you can't get any more breathing salts?
translation: 我就知道这事没那么简单！所以你弄不到更多呼吸盐了？

english: No, I can..I can order plenty, but they'll lose their effectiveness. I need an airtight pot to keep them in.
translation: 不，我可以……我可以订购很多，但它们会失效。我需要一个密封罐来存放它们。

english: Where would you get one of those from?
translation: 你从哪里能弄到一个？

english: I've no idea really, this pot was a family heirloom. I guess you'd have to get a new one made?
translation: 我真的不知道，这个罐子是传家宝。我想你得去定做一个新的？

english: Where could I do that?
translation: 去哪儿做呢？

english: You could try Tassie Slipcast over at the Barbarian Village. She's a potter there and may be able to make one. But mind, it has to be air tight.
translation: 你可以试试野蛮人村的塔西.斯利普卡斯特。她是那里的陶工，也许能做出来。但注意，必须密封。

english: Oh, no way am I going to the Barbarian Village.
translation: 哦，我绝不会去野蛮人村。

english: I understand...they're all barbarians over there.
translation: 我理解……那边全是野蛮人。

english: I guess I can go to the Barbarian Village.
translation: 我想我可以去野蛮人村。

english: Wonderful, I'd really appreciate it!
translation: 太好了，我真的很感激！

english: What about the breathing salts?
translation: 那呼吸盐怎么办？

english: I smashed the pot which held them, remember?
translation: 我打碎了装它们的罐子，记得吗？

english: Oh yes...where am I going to get a new pot?
translation: 哦，对……我去哪里弄个新罐子？

english: I've lost that herbal tincture you gave me!
translation: 你给我的草药酊剂我弄丢了！

english: No problem, I'll just rustle up another one for you.
translation: 没问题，我再给你弄一份。

english: What was I supposed to be doing again?
translation: 我该做什么来着？

english: Go and see Tassie in the Barbarian Village about making an airtight pot for me to store my breathing salts in, then you can take some for Horvik.
translation: 去野蛮人村庄找塔西.斯利普卡斯特，让她帮我做一个密封罐来存放呼吸盐，然后你可以带一些给霍维克。

english: Oh, yes right!
translation: 哦，对，没错！

english: Hey there...I need an airtight pot just as soon as you can make one!
translation: 嘿，你好……我需要一个密封罐，越快越好！

english: I beg your pardon!
translation: 你说什么！

english: It's a matter of some urgency that I have an airtight container as soon as possible!
translation: 我急需一个密封容器，越快越好！

english: Who on earth do you think you are coming in here demanding an airtight pot...Can't you see that I have my own worries to think about?
translation: 你以为你是谁啊，跑进来就要密封罐……你没看到我自己也有一堆烦心事吗？

english: Oh, sorry, I didn't think...what's the problem?
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没想那么多……出什么事了？

english: Well, if you must know, I'm working all the hours that Saradomin sends, I have to in order to make enough money to pay that loan shark Hammerspike!
translation: 嗯，如果你非要知道的话，我一天到晚都在工作，我得这样才能赚够钱还那个放高利贷的锤刺！

english: Loan shark? Hammerspike? What are you talking about?
translation: 放高利贷的？锤刺？你在说什么？

english: I took over this abandoned pottery place with a loan from Hammerspike. He's demanding payment and I can barely just make the interest payments.
translation: 我从铁锤刺那里借钱盘下了这个废弃的陶器作坊。他现在逼我还钱，我连利息都快付不起了。

english: I'm working as hard as I can but I'll never pay the loan off at this rate!
translation: 我已经拼尽全力了，但照这样下去永远也还不清！

english: But I need an airtight pot...to store breathing salts in.
translation: 但我需要一个密封罐……来装呼吸盐。

english: Well, that may be, but I have a rush order for a top paying customer that's going to keep Hammerspike off my back for a bit.
translation: 嗯，也许吧，但我有一个大客户的加急订单，能让锤刺暂时别来烦我。

english: If you really want that pot, you're going to have to deal with Hammerspike in the dwarven mines!
translation: 如果你真想要那个罐子，就得去矮人矿井找铁锤刺谈谈！

english: Ok, I'll deal with Hammerspike!
translation: 好，我去找铁锤刺谈谈！

english: Really, you will?
translation: 真的吗，你愿意？

english: Yes, I'll go and have a chat with him, perhaps we can sort something out.
translation: 是的，我去跟他聊聊，也许能想出什么办法。

english: Well, that would be really great...I just hope he doesn't grind you into flour to make his bread, he's one of the most ruthless gangsters in the area.
translation: 嗯，那真是太好了……我只希望他不会把你碾成面粉去做他的面包，他可是这一带最无情的帮派成员之一。
