english: Beware, his guards are incredibly loyal, they'll slit their own throats to protect him!
translation: 小心点，他的守卫极其忠诚，他们会为了保护他而割喉自尽！

english: That's not a pretty picture you're painting, but don't worry, I'll be careful. Now, where do I find this Hammerspike?
translation: 你说的可不是什么好景象，不过别担心，我会小心的。那么，我在哪里能找到这个锤刺？

english: He's in the dwarven mines somewhere, not sure exactly where though.
translation: 他在矮人矿井的某个地方，但具体在哪我不太确定。

english: No, sorry, no more blooming favours for anyone!
translation: 不，抱歉，我再也帮不了任何该死的忙了！

english: Oh, well that's a real shame, I was hoping you could have sorted out that Hammerspike for me once and for all!
translation: 哦，那真是太可惜了，我还指望你能帮我一劳永逸地解决铁锤刺呢！

english: Hey there...I'm back...
translation: 嘿，我回来了……

english: So I see. What's the problem? Did you sort out Hammerspike?
translation: 我看到了。怎么了？你搞定铁锤刺了吗？

english: Not exactly, can you tell me what I'm supposed to do again?
translation: 还没，你能再告诉我一遍我该做什么吗？

english: Go talk to Hammerspike in the Dwarven mines and see if you can get him to leave me alone...I won't be able to make you the airtight pot else.
translation: 去矮人矿井找铁锤刺谈谈，看看能不能让他别再烦我……否则我没法给你做密封罐。

english: And who da heck are you?
translation: 你他娘的是谁？

english: I'm [player name] and I want to talk to you about a friend of mine, Tassie Slipcast. She says you're putting the screws on her for some loan she had from you. Is this true?
translation: 我是[player name]，想跟你谈谈我的朋友塔西.斯利普卡斯特。她说你因为她欠你钱就逼她。这是真的吗？

english: And what if it is? Tassie got into an arrangement that is mutually beneficial, as far as I understood it, she was happy with the deal.
translation: 是又怎样？塔西跟我达成了一个互利的协议，据我所知，她对这笔交易很满意。

english: Well, I've come to change the deal!
translation: 好吧，我是来改变这个协议的！

english: Oh, so you wanna give me something for leaving Tassie alone?
translation: 哦，所以你想给我点东西，让我放过塔西？

english: Er...er...not exactly...why can't you just leave her alone? I mean, make a nice gesture, I'm asking out as a favour...please?
translation: 呃……呃……不完全是……你就不能放过她吗？我是说，做个好人，我求你了，就当帮我个忙……求你了？

english: Can't you just leave Tassie alone?
translation: 你就不能放过塔西吗？

english: Where would I be if I just left all of my 'customers' alone? Some people just need an extra 'encouragement' to make the best out of life...I'm just helping them along.
translation: 如果我把所有'顾客'都放了，我还能混下去吗？有些人就是需要额外的'鼓励'才能好好生活……我只是在帮他们一把。

english: Oh, come on...do something nice for aTassie. Think about how hard she's working!
translation: 哦，拜托……为塔西做件好事吧。想想她工作有多努力！

english: Well...now that you come to mention it, I guess I have been a little hard on the girl.
translation: 嗯……既然你提到了，我想我确实对那姑娘有点苛刻了。

english: Yeah, come on give her a break.
translation: 是啊，给她个喘息的机会吧。

english: And I guess I am quite stressed about things, what with so much to think about recently.
translation: 而且我想我最近压力也很大，要操心的事情太多了。

english: I can understand that...you have a lot on your mind. Go on, make a change...it'll do you good! There must be something else that you wanted to do at least once in your life.
translation: 我能理解……你心事重重。来吧，做出改变……这对你有好处！你一定有至少一件这辈子想做的事吧。

english: Hmm, yes, yes you're right...I did want to do something, something I noticed recently, but you'll laugh if I tell you...nah, it's silly.
translation: 嗯，对，对，你说得对……我确实有想做的事，最近才注意到的，但说出来你会笑我的……算了，太傻了。

english: Have you always been a gangster? Wasn't there anything else that you wanted to do instead? Come on, tell me what you want to do...I'm listening.
translation: 你一直都是帮派成员吗？难道就没有别的想做的事？来吧，告诉我你想做什么……我在听。

english: Well, I was just thinking the other day that I'm feeling sort of unfulfilled in my life.
translation: 嗯，我前几天就在想，我觉得自己的人生有点空虚。

english: I'd like to get rid of all this anger and frustration that my current lifestyle brings and do something relaxing...like those druids, I mean, all day sitting around, looking at herbs and wearing robes and stuff.
translation: 我想摆脱现在这种生活方式带来的愤怒和沮丧，做点放松的事……就像那些德鲁伊一样，整天坐着，看看草药，穿着长袍什么的。

english: Ok, that sounds good.
translation: 好，听起来不错。

english: Yeah, yeah, I really want to be a druid...so...go and see the druid leader, I think Sanfew is his name, and persuade him to take me as an initiate. Do me this one small favour and I'll leave Tassie alone.
translation: 是啊，是啊，我真的很想成为德鲁伊……所以……去找德鲁伊首领，我觉得他叫桑福，说服他收我当学徒。帮我这个小小的忙，我就不再纠缠塔西.

english: I don't think they take dwarven gangsters as initiates.
translation: 我觉得他们不会收矮人帮派成员当学徒的。

english: Whatever...I guess Tassie's gonna be working hard for a bit longer yet then!
translation: 随便吧……看来塔西还得再辛苦一阵子了！

english: Ok, another favour...I think I can manage that.
translation: 好吧，再帮个忙……我想我能搞定。

english: Good...I mean great! Come back when Sanfew has agreed to take me as an initiate!
translation: 好……我是说太好了！等桑福同意收我当学徒了再回来！

english: I can't believe [he/she/they] fell for that, boss!
translation: 老大，真不敢相信[he/she/they]居然上当了！

english: And what's wrong now?
translation: 又怎么了？

english: What was it that I was supposed to do for you?
translation: 我该为你做什么来着？

english: Go and talk to Sanfew and get him to accept me as a druid initiate!
translation: 去找桑福谈谈，让他接受我当德鲁伊学徒！

english: Are you taking any new initates?
translation: 你们在收新学徒吗？

english: Hmmm, are you considering yourself?
translation: 嗯，你在考虑自己吗？

english: How does someone become an initate?
translation: 怎么才能成为学徒？

english: Hmm, it's quite a straight-forward process. A person, perhaps like yourself, comes along to me and asks.
translation: 嗯，过程很简单。一个人，比如你，过来问我。

english: We test your knowledge of Herblore and see if you can fit in with the rest of us. If you pass, then we let you become an initiate.
translation: 我们会测试你的草药学知识，看看你是否能融入我们。如果你通过了，我们就让你成为学徒。

english: Seems pretty straight forward!
translation: 听起来很简单！

english: Do you accept dwarves?
translation: 你们收矮人吗？

english: Dwarves? Well now, that's a mighty interesting question... Just because we haven't before, doesn't mean to say that we shouldn't.
translation: 矮人？嗯，这倒是个很有意思的问题……以前没收过，不代表以后也不能收。

english: A dwarf I know wants to become an initiate.
translation: 我认识的一个矮人想成为学徒。

english: Oh yes? Well, that's interesting. Let me think for a moment. Hmmm... yes, actually, I don't mind taking him on, so long as you can do me just one small favour. Well, two actually.
translation: 哦，是吗？那挺有意思的。让我想想。嗯……好吧，其实我不介意收他，只要你帮我一个小忙。嗯，其实是两个。

english: Not you as well?
translation: 怎么你也来这套？

english: Stop interrupting me. I haven't told you about these favours!
translation: 别打断我。我还没告诉你是什么忙呢！

english: There's a poor little gnome up on White Wolf mountain. I wondered if you could take him a warming herbal brew. I have the recipe here!
translation: 白狼山上有个可怜的小地精。我想你能不能给他送一份暖身的草药饮品。我这有食谱！

english: Well, that seems simple enough.
translation: 嗯，听起来挺简单的。

english: In addition...
translation: 另外……

english: I've long wished to take a trip down to see those ogres to the south of Yanille, and bring the word of Guthix to them. I was hoping you might organise this trip with the gnome pilot up there on White Wolf mountain.
translation: 我一直想去亚尼勒城南边看看那些食人魔，向他们传播古斯的教义。我希望你能帮我跟白狼山上那个地精飞行员安排一下这次旅行。

english: Well, perhaps a bit... but it's never stopped you doing things for me before.
translation: 嗯，也许有点……但这从来也没阻止过你帮我做事。

english: I've been asked to do a lot of favours recently.
translation: 最近我被要求帮了好多忙。

english: Well, that's the life of an adventurer. Is it a deal, or not?
translation: 嗯，这就是冒险者的生活。成交还是不成交？

english: Yep, it's a deal. Tell me the recipe for this herbal tea.
translation: 好，成交。告诉我这草药茶的食谱。

english: Ok, you need to heat some water up in a bowl, then pour it into an empty teacup. Add 1 harralander, 2 guam and 1 marrentill...it'll warm that poor fellow up a treat!
translation: 好的，你需要在一个碗里加热水，然后倒进一个空茶杯里。加入1株哈拉兰德草、2株瓜姆草和1株马伦提尔草……这会让那个可怜的家伙暖和起来！

english: Mmm, sounds delicious! What's it called?
translation: 嗯，听起来很美味！它叫什么名字？

english: We call it 'Guthix's rest'.
translation: 我们叫它'古斯的安息'。

english: Can I drink it?
translation: 我能喝吗？

english: If you want!
translation: 如果你想的话！

english: Great! And thanks.
translation: 太好了！谢谢。

english: But you'll have to make another one for the gnome.
translation: 但你还得再给地精做一份。

english: But I can drink it though.
translation: 但我可以喝它。

english: Yes, but you'll have to make another one for the gnome.
translation: 是的，但你还得再给地精做一份。

english: Ok, I think I understand.
translation: 好，我想我明白了。

english: Nope, it's not a deal!
translation: 不，不成交！

english: Well, that's a shame. I was looking forward to visiting the ogres... Perhaps someday I will.
translation: 嗯，那真可惜。我还挺期待去拜访食人魔的……也许以后会有机会吧。

english: What did you need me to do again?
translation: 你刚才要我做什么来着？

english: Make a herbal tea for the gnome and persuade him to take me to the ogre area, down to the south!
translation: 给地精做一份草药茶，然后说服他带我去南边的食人魔区域！

english: Oh yes, right, thanks!
translation: 哦，对，没错，谢谢！

english: How do I make the tea again?
translation: 茶是怎么做的来着？

english: Sanfew asked me to come and talk to you.
translation: 桑福让我来找你谈谈。

english: Brrr, blimey it's cold up here! Wish I had something nice to drink to chase away these chills!
translation: 呜，天哪，这上面真冷！真希望有点好喝的东西来驱驱寒！

english: I have a special tea here for you from Sanfew!
translation: 我这里有桑福给你的一份特制茶！

english: Ohhh! Many thanks! Brrr, blimey it's cold up here!
translation: 噢噢！太感谢了！嘶，天哪，这儿可真冷！

english: Blimey, it was certainly jolly decent of that old stick Sanfew to get you to make me a cup of herbal tea. Wow! It really does chase away the chills!
translation: 天哪，那个老顽固桑福让你给我泡杯花草茶，真是太够意思了。哇！真的把寒意都赶跑了！

english: Yes, he's quite considerate that way...you know, thinking of people. In fact, he was thinking that you may be able to help him with another little 'helping' situation that involves ogres.
translation: 是啊，他这方面确实很体贴……你知道，总惦记着别人。实际上，他寻思着你可能还能帮他一个跟食人魔有关的“小忙”。

english: Ogres!
translation: 食人魔！

english: Hmmm, well I guess they're just like overgrown gnomes when you think about it!
translation: 嗯，好吧，仔细想想，它们不过是长得过大的地精嘛！

english: More like 'super-over-grown-gnomes' if you ask me! Or 'overgrown humans'!
translation: 要我说，更像是“超级大号地精”！或者“超大号人类”！

english: Quite! Anyway, go on! What was Sanfew after?
translation: 没错！好了，接着说！桑福想要干嘛？

english: Sanfew wants to bring the word of Guthix to those ogres, though I've no idea if ogres have the mental ability to grasp druidic concepts.
translation: 桑福想把古斯的教诲带给那些食人魔，不过我不确定食人魔的智力能不能理解德鲁伊的理念。

english: Yes, quite, but who amongst us does? I know I'm often confused by that beardy bunch of yakking druids.
translation: 是啊，没错，可咱们中间又有谁能懂呢？反正我常常被那帮留着胡子、喋喋不休的德鲁伊搞得一头雾水。

english: Well, he wants to know if he can organise a glider ride down there.
translation: 嗯，他想知道能不能安排一次滑翔机之旅过去。

english: Hmm, interesting! I know that the elders want to extend the network of glider routes, and I did hear that the Feldip Hills were being considered. I don't know why it hasn't opened up yet though.
translation: 嗯，有意思！我知道长老们想扩展滑翔机路线网，也听说过费迪普丘陵在考虑范围内。不过不知道为啥还没开通。

english: If I'm going to transport that yakking druid down to the ogres I'll want to make it in record time so I'll need some lighter kit.
translation: 要是让我把那个喋喋不休的德鲁伊运到食人魔那儿去，我得创纪录的速度才行，所以需要更轻的装备。

english: Ok, good luck with that.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。

english: There's a chap called Arhein in Catherby and I've heard that his special interest in ships has helped him to produce lightweight but strengthened ropes. I'm in need of some T.R.A.S.H.! And I need you to get it for me.
translation: 凯瑟比镇有个叫阿海因的家伙，我听说他对船舶特别感兴趣，这让他造出了一种轻便又结实的绳子。我需要一些 T.R.A.S.H.！而且我需要你去帮我弄来。

english: TRASH? What the demonikin are you talking about? Why do I have to get it?
translation: 垃圾？你他妈在说啥？为什么非得我去拿？

english: I'm talking about the next generation of lightweight ropes. Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser...T.R.A.S.H.! I'll transport your yakking druid if you can get me some T.R.A.S.H!
translation: 我说的是下一代轻量绳索。三重冗余航空超级绳索……T.R.A.S.H.！如果你能给我弄来一些T.R.A.S.H.，我就运送你那喋喋不休的德鲁伊！

english: And you have to get it because I have to stay here with this glider. Is it a deal?
translation: 而且必须你去，因为我得守在这架滑翔机旁边。成交不？

english: Go to Arhein and ask him for some T.R.A.S.H....
translation: 去找阿海因，问他要点 T.R.A.S.H......

english: What is T.R.A.S.H?
translation: T.R.A.S.H 是什么？

english: T.R.A.S.H. is a short way of saying, 'Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser', it's a technical term that we gnomes like to use when specifying lightweight rope.
translation: T.R.A.S.H.是‘三重冗余航空超级绳索’的简称，这是我们地精在指定轻量绳索时喜欢用的技术术语。

english: Where can I get this from?
translation: 我从哪儿能弄到这个？

english: Go and talk to a chap called Arhein in Catherby, he's developed it so he'll know exactly what you're talking about.
translation: 去凯瑟比镇找个叫阿海因的家伙谈谈，这东西是他研发的，所以他肯定知道你说的是什么。

english: Great! So I get to talk T.R.A.S.H with shopkeepers!
translation: 太好了！所以我得跟店主聊“垃圾”话题！

english: Ok, I'll go and get you some T.R.A.S.H.
translation: 好吧，我去给你弄些 T.R.A.S.H.。

english: Wonderful my friend, wonderful!
translation: 太棒了，我的朋友，太棒了！

english: No, sorry, I can't do it right now.
translation: 不了，抱歉，我现在没法做。

english: Well, that's a bit of a shame...I was looking forward to upgrading my glider!
translation: 唉，真有点遗憾……我还指望升级我的滑翔机呢！

english: How was that tea?
translation: 那茶怎么样？

english: It was delicious thanks!
translation: 很好喝，谢谢！

english: Go to Arhein in Catherby and get some T.R.A.S.H! That's a short name for Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser and then bring it back to me! I mean, it's not difficult is it?
translation: 去凯瑟比镇的阿海因那里弄些 T.R.A.S.H！那是“三重冗余航空超级缆绳”的简称，然后给我带回来！我是说，没那么难吧？

english: I need to talk T.R.A.S.H. to you.
translation: 我得跟你聊聊 T.R.A.S.H.。

english: Oh yes, well it won't be the first time...but just so I'm sure can you explain what you mean?
translation: 哦，好吧，反正也不是第一次了……不过为了确认，你能解释一下你的意思吗？

english: Yes, of course. There's a Gnome on White Wolf mountain who needs some T.R.A.S.H...for his glider...do you have some?
translation: 当然可以。白狼山上有个地精需要一些 T.R.A.S.H……给他的滑翔机用的……你有吗？

english: Well, I've done a lot of research into Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawsers and it seems to have paid off, but answer me this one question. Why are you asking me this rather than the Gnome?
translation: 嗯，我对三重冗余航空超级缆绳做了很多研究，看起来没白费功夫。不过你得回答我一个问题：为什么是你来问我，而不是那个地精自己来？

english: Well, I'm sort of doing him a favour.
translation: 嗯，我在帮他一个忙。

english: Hmm, really, is that so? Well, I do have some Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser and I'll let you have some if you do me just one small favour.
translation: 嗯，真的吗，是这样啊？好吧，我确实有一些三重冗余航空超级缆绳，只要你帮我一个小忙，我就给你一些。

english: How totally unpredictable!
translation: 真是完全意料之中啊！

english: No, this is a really quick thing and shouldn't take you longer than a few minutes.
translation: 不，这件事很快就能搞定，不会花你超过几分钟。

english: Yeah, I've heard that before! Go on...tell me anyway.
translation: 是啊，这话我听过无数次了！说吧……反正告诉我也无妨。

english: I'm funding a rather expensive trade run to Brimhaven soon and I want to be sure that the weather isn't going to change and cause my ships any trouble.
translation: 我马上要资助一批相当昂贵的货物运到布尔哈文镇，得确保天气不会变卦，给我的船找麻烦。

english: The last thing I need is a load of goods going straight to the bottom of the ocean.
translation: 我最不希望看到的就是一船货直接沉到海底。

english: Well, I can understand that.
translation: 嗯，我能理解。

english: I just need you to pop along to Seers Village and ask those philosophers of foresight for a weather report. I believe a new seer there called Phantuwti can help you.
translation: 我只需要你跑一趟先知村，找那些预言哲学家们要一份天气报告。我相信那儿有个叫凡图提的新先知能帮你。

english: No way...I've had enough of this wild goose chase.
translation: 不行……我受够了这种毫无意义的瞎忙活。

english: Yes, Ok, I'll do it!
translation: 行，好吧，我去做！

english: That's great, many thanks.
translation: 太好了，多谢。

english: Hi, can you give me a weather forecast?
translation: 嗨，你能给我一份天气预报吗？

english: Hmm, somehow I knew you were going to ask me that...strange...life is so predictable when you have the power of foresight.
translation: 嗯，不知怎的我就知道你会来问这个……奇怪……有了预知的能力，生活真是毫无意外。

english: Great! So I can assume you've been really pro-active and compiled an up-to-date one for me?
translation: 太好了！那我是不是可以假定你已经非常主动地给我整理了一份最新的？

english: Alas my presumptuous friend, the power of foresight and the impulse to act is quite similar to the interplay between intelligence and wisdom.
translation: 唉，我狂妄的朋友，预知的力量和行动的冲动，与情报和智慧之间的相互作用颇为相似。

english: One might have intelligence enough to realise that cakes are bad for us, but we may not have the wisdom to stop cramming that delicious-looking fatty cream cake into our salivating mouth.
translation: 一个人可能有足够的情报意识到蛋糕对我们有害，但我们可能没有智慧阻止自己把那块看起来美味的奶油蛋糕塞进垂涎欲滴的嘴里。

english: So, in your case, you have the power of foresight, but you're too lazy to act on it?
translation: 所以，就你而言，你有预知的能力，但懒得采取行动？

english: Not exactly lazy...but unable. My abilities and concern have been focused on the fate of a local girl whose association with a certain wizard has landed her between a rock and hard place.
translation: 不完全是懒……而是无能为力。我的能力和注意力都集中在一个本地女孩的命运上了，她因为跟某个魔法师有往来，落入了进退两难的境地。

english: Who is this girl that you're concerned about?
translation: 你关心的这个女孩是谁？

english: The girl's name is Petra, she's a very ...energetic youngster, always wanted to travel and have adventures. When she turned seventeen she set off to earn herself fame and fortune.
translation: 女孩名叫佩特拉，是个非常……有活力的年轻人，一直想旅行冒险。十七岁那年她就出发去追求名利了。

english: It looks like she's ended up in a bit of a dead end position...
translation: 看起来她陷入了绝境……

english: Where is this girl?
translation: 这女孩在哪儿？

english: It's quite difficult to pinpoint exactly where she is, but apparently she's in some sort of cavern structure.
translation: 很难确定她的确切位置，但显然她在某个洞穴结构里。

english: We sense that there are other beings around her, smelly creatures, and some sort of presence is watching over her.
translation: 我们感觉到她周围还有别的存在，是些臭烘烘的生物，而且有什么东西在守护着她。

english: Do you have any ideas where that might be? I mean, it's pretty vague isn't it?
translation: 你大概知道可能在哪儿吗？我是说，这也太模糊了吧？

english: Well, we believe it may be some sort of nearby cave, it can't be very far away as the impressions we get are quite strong. We believe the cave is a home for some sort of creature or creatures.
translation: 嗯，我们认为可能是附近的某个洞穴，不会太远，因为我们得到的感应很强。我们认为那个洞穴是某种或某些生物的家。

english: What do you think needs to be done?
translation: 你觉得需要做什么？

english: Well, it would be nice to locate her...if possible. Then we may be able to work out what to do when we can see what sort of state she's in.
translation: 嗯，如果能找到她就好了……如果可能的话。然后等我们能看到她处境如何，也许就能想出办法。

english: I'm sorry but I can't help.
translation: 抱歉，我帮不了忙。

english: Well, that's a bit of a shame, I have to say...we all miss our Petra!
translation: 唉，我不得不说，真有点遗憾……我们都想念我们的佩特拉！

english: Do you think you could do me a small favour? Check around the vicinity. The impressions are coming from a south westerly direction.
translation: 你能帮我个小忙吗？在附近找找。感应来自西南方向。

english: Don't go further east than you are already, no further south than Ardougne and no further west than the combat training camp.
translation: 不要往东走得更远，南边不要超过阿多尼城，西边不要超过战斗训练营。

english: So, let me get this right. You want me to start poking my nose into a lot of caves where some creatures might be?
translation: 所以，我理解一下。你想让我去多管闲事，钻那些可能有生物的洞穴？

english: Risking my neck for some tomboy who thinks she's got what it takes to be a real adventurer?
translation: 为了一个自以为是真正冒险者的假小子去冒险？

english: Well, I wouldn't have put it quite that way...
translation: 嗯，我不会说得那么直白……

english: Yes, Ok, I'll do it.
translation: 行，好吧，我去做。

english: Great! I just knew you'd agree to help!
translation: 太好了！我就知道你会同意帮忙！

english: No, sorry, I can't do it right now. Or maybe ever!
translation: 不了，抱歉，我现在没法做。也许永远都不行！

english: I knew you wouldn't help...oh well, perhaps someday you'll surprise me.
translation: 我就知道你不会帮忙……唉，好吧，也许有一天你会让我惊喜。

english: I need you to start checking nearby caves looking for our missing Petra. The caves are probably home to some creature or creatures. Check around the vicincity.
translation: 我需要你开始检查附近的洞穴，寻找我们失踪的佩特拉。这些洞穴很可能栖息着某种或某些生物。在附近仔细找找。

english: The impressions are coming from a south westerly direction. Don't go further east than you are already, no further south than Ardougne and no further west than the combat training camp.
translation: 感应来自西南方向。不要往东走得比你目前的位置更远，南边不要超过阿多尼城，西边不要超过战斗训练营。

english: I need to talk to you about a girl stuck in some rock!
translation: 我得跟你谈谈一个困在石头里的女孩！

english: Eh!
translation: 呃！

english: What? I have no clue what you're talking about! Now, please excuse me! I need to get back to my experiments!
translation: 什么？我完全不知道你在说什么！现在，请恕我失陪！我得回去做实验了！

english: Hey! Not so fast! I've seen a young girl encased in rock, a note in her belt led me to you.
translation: 嘿！别急着走！我看到了一个困在岩石里的年轻女孩，她腰带里的笔记指引我找到了你。

english: Oh dear, it's such a bother getting them back out of the rock walls and I do loathe the trip to Port Khazard for the components.
translation: 哦天哪，把他们从岩壁里弄出来真是麻烦，而且我特别讨厌为了材料跑一趟卡扎德港。

english: What the demonikin are you talking about?
translation: 你到底在说什么鬼话？

english: Well, it's not the first time someone's been teleported into a rock face, just the slightest miscalculation and bang...they're in the wall!
translation: 嗯，这又不是第一次有人被传送到岩壁里了，只要一点点计算失误，砰……就嵌进墙里了！

english: It's fairly straightforward to cast a spell and fish them out again - but it requires a spell component from a chap in Port Khazard.
translation: 施个法术再把它们钓上来相当简单——但需要从卡扎德港的一个家伙那里弄到一种法术材料。

english: I don't suppose you could do me a small favour could you?
translation: 你不会帮我个小忙吧，能吗？

english: Just one small favour? Pop along to Port Khazard and get some iron oxide, it's a component of the spell.
translation: 就一个小忙？跑一趟卡扎德港，弄点氧化铁来，那是法术的材料之一。

english: No way am I going to Port Khazard for you!
translation: 我才不会替你去卡扎德港呢！

english: Oh dear, what a shame...I just don't have time to deal with this now...she's safe where she is for now, and I'm sure I'll get to it sooner or later.
translation: 哦天哪，真可惜……我现在没时间处理这个……她暂时待在那儿还算安全，我迟早会去处理的。

english: Oh! Ok, one more 'small favour' isn't going to kill me...I hope!
translation: 哦！好吧，再多一个“小忙”也弄不死我……希望吧！

english: Waaahaaay! Great! I'd never suspect you'd be so helpful!
translation: 哇哈！太棒了！真没想到你会这么帮忙！

english: You need to talk to a chap called Tindel Marchant in Port Khazard, he's sort of like an antiques dealer.
translation: 你得去卡扎德港找一个叫廷德尔.马钱特的家伙谈谈，他有点像古董商人。

english: Well, off you go then! A journey of a thousand miles starts with the first step and all that!
translation: 嗯，那就出发吧！千里之行始于足下，诸如此类！

english: What? Are you saying I have to travel a thousand miles?
translation: 什么？你是说我要走一千里？

english: Of course not...you silly...just...you know...the sooner you start the sooner you can get back...that's all I was saying.
translation: 当然不是……你个傻瓜……只是……你知道……早点出发就能早点回来……我就是这个意思。

english: Go to Port Khazard and get me some iron oxide from Tindel Marchant.
translation: 去卡扎德港，从廷德尔.马钱特那儿弄些氧化铁给我。

english: Wizard Cromperty sent me to get some iron oxide. Do you have some?
translation: 法师克伦珀蒂派我来拿些氧化铁。你有吗？

english: As a matter of fact, I do! However, it's the last in stock and I'm not likely to get more for a while so it's highly prized amongst the wizards at the moment.
translation: 事实上，我有！不过这是最后一批库存了，而且短时间内不太可能再进货，所以目前它在法师们当中备受珍视。

english: It's not easy to get so much rust together, even if I do come across it more often than most people with cleaning these rusty swords up!
translation: 收集这么多铁锈可不容易，即使我比大多数人在清理这些生锈的剑时更常遇到它！

english: Rust? What do you mean? How much does it cost?
translation: 锈？你什么意思？多少钱？

english: Yes, iron oxide is more commonly referred to as rust. As for a price, hmmm...well...let me think now...I could give it to you for the price of...
translation: 没错，氧化铁通常被称作锈。至于价格嘛，嗯……好吧……让我想想……我可以以……的价格给你。

english: One small favour!
translation: 一个小忙！

english: Groan!!!
translation: 呻吟！！！

english: I need a nice mattress to sleep on! I haven't had a decent night's sleep in an ice-age...could you take this stodgy mattress down to Rantz in the ogre area and ask him to fill it with prime chompy bird feathers please?
translation: 我需要一张好床垫睡觉！我已经像冰河世纪那么久没睡过安稳觉了……你能把这个笨重的床垫送到食人魔区域的兰茨那里，让他用上等食人鸟羽毛填满它吗？

english: So, let me get this straight.
translation: 那么，让我理清楚。

english: You want me to traipse ALL the way down past the ogre city with some flea infested mattress, to some hermit ogre, who can't shoot a chompy bird to save his life, so that you'll give me a pot of rust?
translation: 你想让我带着一张满是跳蚤的床垫，一路跋涉经过食人魔城市，去找一个连救自己命的食人鸟都射不中的隐居食人魔，就为了你给我一罐锈？

english: Well, er, I wouldn't have said it quite that way...
translation: 嗯，呃，我本来不会说得这么直白的……

english: Okay, I'll do it!
translation: 好吧，我去做！

english: Great, many thanks indeed! Here's the mattress!
translation: 太好了，非常感谢！床垫给你！

english: Sorry, I just don't want to do it.
translation: 抱歉，我只是不想做。

english: Well, that's a shame, but come back and see me if you change your mind.
translation: 嗯，那真可惜，但如果你改变主意就回来找我。

english: You need to take that stodgy mattress I gave you to Rantz and ask him to fill it with feathers! Then, bring it back to me and I'll give you some iron oxide.
translation: 你需要把我给你的那个笨重的床垫拿去给兰茨，让他装满羽毛！然后带回来给我，我就给你一些氧化铁。

english: Erm, I've lost the mattress... do you have another one I can get refilled?
translation: 呃，我把床垫弄丢了……你还有另一个可以让我去重新填满的吗？

english: Yes, but I had to pay for this myself so you'd better pay me for losing my last one...it cost 100 gold!
translation: 有，但我得自己付钱，所以你最好赔偿我弄丢上一个的损失……它花了100金币！

english: Okay, here's 100 coins for another mattress...
translation: 好吧，这是100金币，换另一个床垫……

english: Okay, thanks a lot, here's the mattress!
translation: 好吧，非常感谢，床垫给你！

english: I'm not paying you 100 coins for that stinky mattress.
translation: 我不会为那个臭床垫付你100金币。

english: Well, don't expect your iron oxide any time soon then!
translation: 哼，那就别指望很快拿到你的氧化铁了！

english: Okay, then I won't.
translation: 好吧，那我就不指望了。

english: Good!
translation: 很好！

english: GLADLY!
translation: 乐意之至！

english: I need to talk to you about a mattress!
translation: 我需要跟你谈谈关于床垫的事！

english: You's creature shuvs flapper sack in rantz face, making rantz very upset
translation: 你这个生物把鸟羽麻袋塞到兰茨脸上，搞得兰茨很生气

english: Can you fill this mattress with feathers?
translation: 你能用羽毛填满这个床垫吗？

english: Der's no flappers to get cos da little guy scares dem away wiv his banging. He's making da man flapper 'come-down-place' and it's takin' ages and ages.
translation: 没有鸟可抓了，因为那个小家伙用他的敲打声把它们都吓跑了。他正在建造那个鸟人的'降落之地'，花了很久很久。

english: Da chompies don't come no more since he's banging all da time.
translation: 食人鸟不再来了，因为他老是敲敲打打。

english: Da little guy, he's making da man flapper 'come-down-place'...so deyz more of yous creatures coming to see Rantz...but he's takin ages to do it.
translation: 那个小家伙，他在建造那个鸟人的'降落之地'……所以更多你们这样的生物来找兰茨……但他花了很长时间做这个。

english: You's can help da little guy, he's over der near da ogre city...he's stuck wiv sumfing, making da man flapper 'come-down-place'. Me's not doin' no chompy hunting wiv dat noise going on.
translation: 你可以帮那个小家伙，他在那边靠近食人魔城市……他卡在什么事情上了，在建造那个鸟人的'降落之地'。有那种噪音，我可不去猎食人鸟。

english: Dat would be da good find...den me's help wiv da flufsies sack.
translation: 那会是件好事……然后我就帮你弄那个软毛麻袋。

english: Yous creature, go see little guy and help wiv da man flapper 'come-down-place'...den Rantz helps yous creature wiv da fluffsies sack.
translation: 你这个生物，去看看那个小家伙，帮忙建那个鸟人的'降落之地'……然后兰茨就帮你弄那个软毛麻袋。

english: Is there anything that I can do?
translation: 有什么我能做的吗？

english: Rantz said I should help you finish this project.
translation: 兰茨说我应该帮你完成这个项目。

english: Rantz? *gulp* Well, that would be nice actually! We are having some problems with getting the landing lights to work... do you think you could take a look at them?
translation: 兰茨？*咽口水* 嗯，那其实挺好的！我们在让降落灯工作方面遇到了一些问题……你觉得你能看看它们吗？

english: I expect that it's far too complex for you, but hey, you may be able to do something!
translation: 我估计这对你来说太复杂了，但嘿，你也许能做点什么！

english: Yes, I'll take a look at them.
translation: 好的，我去看看它们。

english: Ok then, just pop over and let me know if you're not sure what you're doing... I'm sure I'll just have to fix it myself anyway. If you need any materials, just pop over.
translation: 那好吧，你过去看看，如果不确定自己在做什么就告诉我……反正我肯定最后还得自己修。如果你需要任何材料，就过来拿。

english: We'll see!
translation: 等着瞧！

english: Sorry, but I've got other things to attend to.
translation: 抱歉，我还有别的事要处理。

english: Yes, I expected it might be a bit too complex for you. We Gnomes lead the way with technical things like this - world leaders, you might say.
translation: 是的，我就料到这对你可能有点太复杂了。我们地精在这方面是技术领先——你可以说是世界领先。

english: What was it you wanted me to do again?
translation: 你刚才要我做什么来着？

english: Go and take a look at those landing lights and see if you can get them to work, would you? They've been as dull as an ogre conversation since we started working here.
translation: 去检查一下那些降落灯，看看能不能让它们正常工作，好吗？它们从我们开始在这里工作起就一直像食人魔的对话一样黯淡。

english: Come back and tell me if you actually manage to get them fixed.
translation: 如果你真的修好了它们，就回来告诉我。

english: I need a chisel to fix these crystals.
translation: 我需要一把凿子来修理这些水晶。

english: Okay, I can sell you one for 10 coins.
translation: 好的，我可以卖你一把，10金币。

english: But I don't have 10 coins.
translation: 但我没有10金币。

english: So I can't sell you one then!
translation: 那我就不能卖给你了！

english: Okay, I'll buy a chisel for 10 coins.
translation: 好吧，我花10金币买一把凿子。

english: Okay, many thanks for your custom.
translation: 好的，多谢惠顾。

english: No, I won't buy the chisel.
translation: 不，我不买凿子。

english: I need a new [opal/jade/red topaz] to fix the lights.
translation: 我需要一个新的 [opal/jade/red topaz] 来修理灯。

english: Broken something, have you? I'll want 500 coins for a new one. Be careful - my supplies are limited, and if I run out, you'll have to find your own materials elsewhere.
translation: 弄坏了什么东西是吧？我要500金币换一个新的。小心点——我的补给品有限，如果用完了，你就得自己去别处找材料了。

english: But I don't have 500 coins!
translation: 但我没有500金币！

english: I can't give you one then.
translation: 那我不能给你。

english: Okay, here's 500 coins, I'll buy one.
translation: 好吧，这是500金币，我买一个。

english: No way am I paying that much.
translation: 我才不会付那么多钱。

english: I've fixed all the lights!
translation: 我已经修好了所有的灯！

english: Hmm. That seems a tad unlikely to me, but let's flick the switch here and see, shall we?!
translation: 嗯。我觉得有点不太可能，但我们来拨动这里的开关看看，好吗？！

english: I don't believe it - you fixed it! Well done, well done... We can pack up now and leave these ogres in peace.
translation: 我真不敢相信——你修好了！干得好，干得好……我们现在可以收拾东西离开，让这些食人魔安安静静了。

english: I know one ogre who'll be very pleased about that!
translation: 我知道有一个食人魔会非常高兴的！

english: Ok, I've helped that Gnome, he shouldn't bother you anymore.
translation: 好了，我帮了那个地精，他应该不会再打扰你了。

english: Yous creature dun a gud fing...Rantz give yous creature da fluffsies sack now...
translation: 你这个生物干得好……兰茨现在给你这个生物软毛麻袋……

english: But I don't have the stodgy mattress anymore...I'll have to get another one.
translation: 但我已经没有那个笨重的床垫了……我得再弄一个。

english: De're yous goes creature...da fluffsies sack is full now.
translation: 给你，你这个生物……软毛麻袋现在满了。

english: Great, I think Tindel will get a good night's rest on this.
translation: 太好了，我想 Tindel 睡在上面能好好休息一晚。

english: I've lost that filled mattress you gave me!
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那个填满的床垫了！

english: Yous creature needs to bring me da saggy fluffsies sack to full wiv da chompy flufsies!
translation: 你这个生物需要给我带来那个瘪了的软毛麻袋，用食人鸟绒毛填满！

english: It cost you dis many bright pretties to do dis again, yous den be more careful wiv my work next time round.
translation: 再做一次要花你这么多亮晶晶的漂亮玩意儿，下次你可得对我的作品更小心些。

english: But I don't have that many bright pretties!
translation: 但我没有那么多亮晶晶的漂亮玩意儿！

english: Den yous no get da fluffsies sack...
translation: 那你就别想得到软毛麻袋了……

english: Ok, I'll give you 200 bright pretties.
translation: 好吧，我给你200个亮晶晶的漂亮玩意儿。

english: De're yous goes creatures...dere's yous comfy fluffsies sack.
translation: 给你，生物……这是你的舒适软毛麻袋。

english: No way am I giving you 200 bright pretties.
translation: 我才不会给你200个亮晶晶的漂亮玩意儿。

english: I have the mattress!
translation: 我有床垫了！

english: Great! Let's have a look then.
translation: 太好了！那让我看看。

english: Great! Here's the iron oxide I promised you!
translation: 太好了！这是答应你的氧化铁！

english: Okay, but I'm going to have to charge you I'm afraid. 200 coins.
translation: 好吧，但恐怕我得收费。200金币。

english: But I haven't got 200 coins!
translation: 但我没有200金币！

english: Sorry, but I have to make a living.
translation: 抱歉，但我得谋生。

english: Okay, I'll buy it.
translation: 好吧，我买。

english: No way am I paying 200 coins for a bottle of rust!
translation: 我绝不会花200金币买一瓶铁锈！

english: Suit yourself... I have plenty of other customers.
translation: 随你便……我还有很多其他顾客。

english: I have that iron oxide you asked for!
translation: 我有你要的氧化铁了！

english: Great! Just what I needed! Now I need to give you a spell scroll to help bring Petra back again.
translation: 太好了！正是我需要的！现在我需要给你一张法术卷轴，用来帮助把佩特拉再次带回来。

english: Just cast this in the room, it should have her out of that rock in a jiffy! Good luck with your exploits...now, where was I with that wranklin severance device...
translation: 只要在房间里施展这个，应该能立刻把她从那块岩石里弄出来！祝你的冒险好运……现在，我之前弄那个弗兰克林分离装置弄到哪了……

english: I need another animate rock spell.
translation: 我需要另一个岩石活化法术。

english: I suspected that you might...you can have one, but it will cost you 100 gold pieces.
translation: 我猜你可能需要……你可以拿一个，但得花100金币。

english: But I don't have 100 coins!
translation: 但我没有100金币！

english: So you can't have the spell then can you!
translation: 那你就拿不到法术了，对吧！

english: No way...I'm cleaning up your mess, you should be grateful!
translation: 没门……我在帮你收拾烂摊子，你应该感激才对！

english: Well, I did give you the last one for free...you're not getting another one for free, even if it is my mess that you're trying to clear up! You shouldn't be so careless to leave things lying around!
translation: 哼，上次那个我可是免费给你的……你再想免费拿一个可不行，就算你是在清理我造成的烂摊子也不行！你就不该那么粗心大意，把东西到处乱丢！

english: Ok, here you go!
translation: 好吧，给你！

english: Thanks...try not to lose it this time.
translation: 谢谢……这次别弄丢了。

english: Whoooah! That was a bit of a misfire.
translation: 哇哦！这有点走火啊。

english: And this doesn't look good!
translation: 而且这看起来不妙！

english: Oh thank goodness you released me...how long have I been stuck in that gloomy wall?
translation: 哦，谢天谢地你放出了我……我被困在那堵昏暗的墙里多久了？

english: Oh, not so long...I don't think...
translation: 哦，不太久……我想没有……

english: I mean...that is... I'm not so sure...at all...in fact.
translation: 我是说……也就是……我不太确定……一点也不……事实上。

english: Well, at least I'm ok...thanks to you! Last time I get involved with that Cromperty lunatic...in fact I have some words to say to that man!
translation: 嗯，至少我没事……多亏了你！我最后一次跟那个克伦普提疯子扯上关系……实际上我有话要对那个人说！

english: Well actually, I think that some of the people at the Seers Village are worried about you. That's how I came to find you here, Phantuwti sent me.
translation: 嗯实际上，我想先知村的一些人在担心你。我就是这样找到你的，是凡图提派我来的。

english: Oh, right, yes, well I guess I'd better go back there and let them all know that I'm safe then..Ok, thanks...I'll be off now and once again thanks for your help.
translation: 哦，对，是的，嗯我想我最好回去那里让他们都知道我安全了……好的，谢谢……我这就走了，再次感谢你的帮助。

english: No problem...I'll probably see you back at the Seers Village.
translation: 没问题...我大概会在先知村再见到你。

english: I've released Petra, she should have returned.
translation: 我已经释放了佩特拉，她应该已经回去了。

english: Hi there, yes she has actually! Well done, you're a true hero!
translation: 嘿，她确实回来了！干得好，你真是个真正的英雄！

english: So, can I have the weather report now please?
translation: 那么，现在能给我天气报告了吗？

english: I wish I could but it's just been so difficult to get a clear image of the future at the moment. You know...we're all so relieved that Petra has returned and all that.
translation: 我希望可以，但最近很难看清未来的清晰图像。你知道的...我们都因为佩特拉回来而松了口气，诸如此类。

english: Listen you...just give me the blooming weather report!
translation: 你给我听着...快把该死的天气报告给我！

english: Er...no. I can't, I told you, I can't get a clear picture. Nope, sorry, the conditions are just not quite right.
translation: 呃...不。我不能，我告诉过你，我看不清。不行，抱歉，条件不太合适。

english: Why can't you get a clear picture?
translation: 为什么你看不清？

english: Well, it's just like that Ok, I just can't get a clear picture...and that's it.
translation: 嗯，就像这样...我就是看不清...就这样。

english: I've done my part of the deal, now hand over that weather report.
translation: 我已经完成了我的那部分交易，现在把天气报告交出来。

english: I would really like to, please believe me, I would, but I just can't.
translation: 我真的很想给你，请相信我，我想给，但我就是做不到。

english: I'll run you through if you don't give me that weather report.
translation: 你要是不给我天气报告，我就捅了你。

english: Well, that's not very nice...I mean, I'm a nice guy and I thought you were nice too! Why would you want to run me through? I mean, it's only a weather report.
translation: 这可不太友好...我是说，我是个好人，我原以为你也是好人！你为什么要捅我？只不过是一份天气报告而已。

english: It doesn't make sense to get angry about something so trivial.
translation: 为这么点小事生气没道理啊。

english: You're making me angry! I did you a favour, now pay up!
translation: 你惹我生气了！我帮了你一个忙，现在该你回报了！

english: I'm not making you angry, you're doing all that on your own! I just don't have a weather report to give you!
translation: 不是我惹你生气，是你自己在生气！我就是没有天气报告给你！

english: I can't help that, you should be more understanding and less forceful, then I might be persuaded to give you the weather report.
translation: 我也没办法，你应该更通情达理一些，别那么强硬，那样我或许会被说服把天气报告给你。

english: Well, it's complicated, the special Seers tools that help us predict the weather are not aligned properly...
translation: 嗯，有点复杂，帮助我们预测天气的特殊先知工具没有正确对齐……

english: Which special Seers tools do you mean?
translation: 你说的是哪些特殊先知工具？

english: Well, we use a special combination of items which are used to gauge current weather movements and we're able to predict future weather patterns from these. Of course, it's strongly linked to the Seers' foresight ability.
translation: 我们使用一组特殊的物品组合来测量当前的天气动向，然后就能预测未来的天气模式。当然，这跟先知的预见能力密切相关。

english: What do you mean, 'special combination of items'?
translation: 你说的'特殊物品组合'是什么意思？

english: Well, let me think now...There's a copper eye, a rotating thing, and some pointy direction thingies. It's all highly scientific - and of course mystical - in a very magical 'foresight' sort of way.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……有一只铜眼睛，一个旋转的东西，还有一些尖尖的方向指示物。这一切都非常科学——当然也很神秘——带有一种非常神奇的'预见'风格。

english: You're talking about a weather vane aren't you?
translation: 你说的是风向标，对吧？

english: Er...maybe...I may be talking about that...
translation: 呃…也许吧……我可能是在说那个……

english: You can't predict the weather because your weather vane is broken...that's it isn't it? Holy Saradomin breath....you can't even predict the weather, you need a weather vane!
translation: 你没法预测天气是因为你的风向标坏了……是这样吧？我靠……你连天气都预测不了，还需要风向标！

english: Erm, well....err....
Ok, show me where this weather vane is...I want to look at it.
translation: 好，带我去看风向标在哪里……我要看看它。

english: I may be able to fix it and then you can give me a weather report...come on, let's go!
translation: 也许我能修好它，然后你就可以给我天气报告了……来吧，我们走！

english: Oh, very well..but you'll need to be a specialist to fix this weather vane, it was made by some of the most experienced....
translation: 哦，好吧……但修这个风向标需要专业人士，它是由一些最有经验的……

english: Just show me it!
translation: 带我去看就行了！

english: Ok, ok, it's up on the roof...
translation: 好好好，它在屋顶上……

english: You're talking in riddles, just give me a straight answer!
translation: 你说话拐弯抹角的，给我直说！

english: Since when has any Seer ever given you a straight answer...the power of knowing the future and the visions we see have to be wrapped in allegory so that the truth can slowly be accepted by the listener.
translation: 先知什么时候给过你直截了当的回答……预知未来的能力和我们看到的幻象必须包裹在寓言之中，这样真理才能慢慢被听者接受。

english: This isn't allegory though, you're just avoiding my questions!
translation: 但这可不是寓言，你只是在回避我的问题！

english: How can you be sure? Are you so sure of what you just asked me? And am I really avoiding your questions by asking you lots of other questions? Answer me that huh!
translation: 你怎么能确定？你对自己刚才问的问题就那么肯定吗？而且我通过问你很多其他问题，就真的在回避你的问题吗？回答我啊！

english: Anyway, we need a special combination of items before we can truly have foreknowledge of the weather.
translation: 总之，我们需要一组特殊的物品组合才能真正预知天气。

english: How hard can it be to predict the weather?
translation: 预测天气能有多难？

english: Quite hard actually. I mean, you're still waiting for me to do it aren't you and I've told you time and again that I can't...right now...but that normally it's actually quite an easy thing for me to do.
translation: 其实挺难的。你还在等着我预测吧？我一次又一次地告诉你我现在做不到……不过正常情况下这对我来说是件很容易的事。

english: Ok, what's it going to take to get a weather report?
translation: 好吧，要怎样才能拿到天气报告？

english: Hmm, well, you can come back in several months and see if we can do one for you....does that help?
translation: 嗯，你可以过几个月再来看看我们能不能为你预测一次……那有用吗？

english: No, sorry, it doesn't help at all, I need a weather report and I need it now...so hand it over!
translation: 不，抱歉，一点用都没有，我现在就需要天气报告……交出来！

english: You're just a fake...you can't predict the weather!
translation: 你只是个冒牌货……你根本预测不了天气！

english: Why...how dare you...I've never been so insulted in my life.
translation: 什么……你竟敢……我这辈子从没受过这种侮辱。

english: You should get out more!
translation: 你应该多出去走走！

english: What's it going to take for you to give me that weather report.
translation: 要怎样才能把天气报告给我？

english: Well, nothing in fact, as I can't give you a weather report. I'm sorry, but that's just the way it is.
translation: 事实上什么也做不到，因为我给不了你天气报告。抱歉，但事实就是如此。

english: I've fixed the weather vane!
translation: 我已经修好风向标了！

english: Oh, thanks so much...you can't believe how helpful it is to get accurate predictions on the weather...we Seers are almost blind without it.
translation: 哦，太感谢了……你无法想象能准确预测天气有多有用……没有它我们先知几乎就像瞎子一样。

english: There you go...a weather report as asked for...I hope it helps you!
translation: 给你……这是你要的天气报告……希望它对你有用！

english: I have the weather report for you.
translation: 我拿到天气报告了。

english: Fantastic...let's see it!
translation: 太好了……让我看看！

english: Wonderful...well the weather report is slightly unspecific, but I feel much better anyway for getting it. Hopefully now the Seers will take some responsibility if my ships go down to the bottom of the ocean.
translation: 太棒了……虽然天气报告有点模糊不清，但拿到它我还是感觉好多了。希望以后我的船沉到海底时，先知们能负点责任。

english: I'll get one of my associates to take some T.R.A.S.H to your Gnome Glider Pilot friend on White Wolf mountain. Once again, many thanks for your help.
translation: 我会让我一个手下把一份 T.R.A.S.H 送到你在白狼山的地精滑翔机飞行员朋友那里。再次感谢你的帮助。

english: Hey there, did you get your T.R.A.S.H? Arhein said that he'd send one of thisassociates up with it.
translation: 嘿，你拿到你的 T.R.A.S.H 了吗？阿海因说他会让一个手下送过来。

english: Oh, yes, thanks...I've already installed it. I should go like the wind now! Tell Sanfew, that yakking old druid, I'll be happy to take him to the ogre area now...and yourself of course if you should like to go.
translation: 哦，是的，谢谢……我已经安装好了。我现在应该像风一样飞起来！告诉桑福，那个唠叨的老德鲁伊，我很乐意带他去食人魔区域了……当然也包括你自己，如果你想一起去的话。

english: Ok then...thanks I will!
translation: 好的……谢谢，我会的！

english: Hi there, the gnome Pilot has agreed to take you to see the ogres!
translation: 嘿，地精飞行员同意带你去见食人魔了！

english: What's that? He's agreed to take me...well that's wonderful! Many thanks.
translation: 什么？他同意带我去……那太好了！非常感谢。

english: Please tell that dwarf that he's welcome to come here and train to be an initiate.
translation: 请告诉那个矮人，欢迎他来这里接受训练成为见习成员。

english: Oh, it's you! Back are you then?
translation: 哦，是你！你又回来了？

english: Yep and with good news...your life is about to change for the better. I've persuaded Sanfew to take you in as an initiate!
translation: 对，而且带来了好消息……你的生活要变好了。我已经说服桑福收你当见习成员！

english: Ha, ha ha ha! How funny is that! I've gone and changed my mind now! I've decided that I make a far better gangster than I ever would a druid!
translation: 哈，哈哈哈哈哈！真好笑！我现在改变主意了！我发现自己当帮派成员比当德鲁伊强多了！

english: My men are going to deal with you!
translation: 我的人会来对付你的！

english: Well...sure if you're not full of surprises then...I guess I'll have to either hire more men to try and kill you or forget Tassie's loan.
translation: 好吧……既然你总是出人意料……那我看来要么雇更多人来杀你，要么就算了，放过泰茜的贷款。

english: Ok, you promise me that you won't bother Tassie anymore and I'll leave you alone.
translation: 好，你保证不再找泰茜麻烦，我就放过你。

english: Ok then, fair enough....I'll leave her alone...but I'm going to deal with you personally one of these days!
translation: 好吧，成交……我不会再找她麻烦……但总有一天我会亲自收拾你！

english: I'll be ready for you whenever you want to take a shot Hammerspike...I'm not afraid of you! You're just a bully who can't fight his own battles.
translation: 锤刺，你什么时候想动手我都奉陪……我不怕你！你只是个连自己打架都不敢的恶霸。

english: Hey there, Hammerspike won't be bothering you anymore!
translation: 嘿，锤刺不会再找你麻烦了！

english: Really! Fantastic! Oh, I'm so grateful! Thanks so much! How ever can I repay you?
translation: 真的吗！太棒了！哦，我太感激了！非常感谢！我该怎么报答你呢？

english: Well you could make me an airtight pot!
translation: 你可以给我做一个密封罐！

english: I'll do better than that! I'll show you how to make an airtight pot! First of all, you'll need some clay...here's some I have spare!
translation: 我会做得更好！我来教你怎么做密封罐！首先，你需要一些粘土……我这儿有一些多余的！

english: Now, while pots are quite easy to make, lids are a bit different. They have to be quite precise to fit the pot exactly, which is why you have to be quite experienced to make them.
translation: 虽然罐子很容易做，但盖子就不一样了。盖子必须非常精确，才能正好盖在罐子上，所以需要相当经验才能做出来。

english: Ok then, just use it on the wheel over there!
translation: 好了，把它用到那边的转轮上吧！

english: Hey there! I have an airtight pot for you!
translation: 嘿！我帮你做了个密封罐！

english: Wonderful, let me see!
translation: 太棒了，让我看看！

english: Huzzah! You have an airtight pot! Wonderful! Ok, let me get some breathing salts into this thing for you!
translation: 好极了！你有一个密封罐！太好了！好了，让我往里面装些呼吸盐！

english: That's great! Many thanks friend...here's your breathing salts!
translation: 太好了！非常感谢，朋友……这是你的呼吸盐！

english: I have the herbal tincture.
translation: 我有草药酊剂了。

english: Well that's no good, I need the breathing salts as well!
translation: 那没用，我还需要呼吸盐！

english: I have the breathing salts.
translation: 我有呼吸盐了。

english: Well that's no good, I need the tincture as well!
translation: 那没用，我还需要酊剂！

english: Great! Let's have a look at them then!
translation: 太好了！让我看看！

english: Wonderful! That's just great! I just need the pigeon cages now.
translation: 太好了！真是棒极了！我现在只需要鸽子笼了。

english: I need you to get me five pigeon cages, apparently you can get them from Ardougne. When I have them, I can convert them into chicken cages for you.
translation: 我需要你帮我弄五个鸽子笼，据说可以从阿多尼城弄到。等我有了这些，就能帮你改装成鸡笼。

english: I have the five pigeon cages you asked for!
translation: 我弄到你需要的五个鸽子笼了！

english: Great stuff...let's have them here then! Ah, I can turn my hand to a bit of woodworking on these, great, I do it as a hobby.
translation: 好东西……把它们放这儿吧！啊，我可以发挥一下我的手艺做点木工，太好了，这是我的业余爱好。

english: There you go then! There's your chicken cages!
translation: 给你！这是你的鸡笼！

english: I've lost a chicken cage!
translation: 我弄丢了一个鸡笼！

english: Well, Ok, I'm going to need a pigeon cage to convert it, plus some money for my time, say a 100 gold?
translation: 好吧，我需要一个鸽子笼来改装，另外还得收点手工费，比如 100 金币？

english: But I don't have a pigeon cage.
translation: 但我没有鸽子笼。

english: Sorry, but you'll have to get one so that I can convert it.
translation: 抱歉，你得去弄一个来我才能改装。

english: But I don't have 100 gold...
translation: 但我没有 100 金币……

english: Sorry, but I have to charge for my time!
translation: 抱歉，我得收手工费！

english: Ok, I'll pay, here's the pigeon cage and 100 gold.
translation: 好吧，我付钱，给你鸽子笼和 100 金币。

english: There you go then!
translation: 给你！

english: Many thanks.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: Suit yourself then!
translation: 那随你便！

english: I have some chicken cages!
translation: 我有些鸡笼！

english: Well, I need at least five! Come back when you've got that many!
translation: 我需要至少五个！等你凑够了再来！

english: Here they are! I've got all five!
translation: 给你！我凑齐五个了！

english: Well that's great! Well done! You can go and talk to those fanatics now and tell them that they'll get their chickens and they can let little Jimmy the Chisel go! Once again, thanks for your help.
translation: 太好了！干得好！你现在可以去跟那些狂信徒们说，他们会得到他们的鸡，然后就可以放了小凿子.吉米！再次感谢你的帮助。

english: Thanks for getting us those chicken cages...you can go and talk to those fanatics now and get Jimmy released.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们拿到那些鸡笼子……你现在可以去找那些狂信徒，让吉米被释放了。

english: Don't worry about Jimmy. His release is imminent!
translation: 别担心吉米。他很快就会被释放了！

english: Oh, that's wonderful...many thanks for your help...just wonderful.
translation: 哦，太好了……非常感谢你的帮助……真是太好了。

english: You're in luck, I've managed to swing that chicken deal for you.
translation: 你运气好，我已经帮你搞定了那笔鸡的交易。

english: Hmmm. Congratulations on your achievement, your help will ensure the success of our venture and we can surely take our efforts forwards. Tell me, won't you consider joining our calling?
translation: 嗯。恭喜你的成就，你的帮助将确保我们事业的成功，我们一定能继续努力。告诉我，你不考虑加入我们的事业吗？

english: Thanks for the offer, but I'm sort of in the middle of something currently.
translation: 谢谢你的提议，但我现在正忙着别的事。

english: Right...well please consider it an open offer...Ok then...thanks and goodbye.
translation: 好吧……那请把它当作一个随时有效的提议……那好吧……谢谢，再见。

english: Hold on! Aren't you forgetting something?
translation: 等等！你是不是忘了什么事？

english: What? Sorry? Please calm down!
translation: 什么？抱歉？请冷静点！

english: You said that you would release Jimmy! Are you going to keep to your word or am I going to have to get angry?
translation: 你说过你会放了吉米！你是要信守承诺，还是非要我发火不可？

english: Oh my dear friend...please...there's no need to get so upset...of course we're going to release Jimmy. Oh dear, you do take things a bit seriously don't you?
translation: 哦，我亲爱的朋友……请别那么激动……我们当然会放了吉米。天哪，你未免有点太较真了吧？

english: Good...I have things to do and I've had enough of people messing me about.
translation: 很好……我还有事要做，也受够了别人耍我。

english: Ok, I understand...please don't worry. I'll release Brother Jimmy now! Tell his employer that he'll be there shortly.
translation: 好吧，我明白……请别担心。我现在就放了吉米修士！告诉他的雇主，他很快就会到那里。

english: Very well...but if you're lying, I'll be back and I won't be happy!
translation: 很好……但如果你撒谎，我会回来，而且我不会高兴的！

english: Good news! Jimmy has been released by those fanatical HAM people! He said he was on his way back here!
translation: 好消息！吉米被那些狂热的HAM成员释放了！他说他正在回这里的路上！

english: Yes! He's just returned! I'll happily be a character witness for Brian now! Please let him know that I'll help his friend however I can.
translation: 是的！他刚回来！我现在很乐意做布莱恩的品格证人！请让他知道，我会尽力帮助他的朋友。

english: I've returned with good news. Aggie has agreed to be your character witness!
translation: 我带来了好消息。阿吉已经同意做你的品格证人！

english: Well, I wish I could be more happy, but I've just had some bad news.
translation: 嗯，我希望能更开心点，但我刚得到一些坏消息。

english: Well, it seems that my friend was even more desperate than I had originally realised. He's gone to hide away from the authorities in the wilderness...what a lunatic!
translation: 嗯，看来我朋友比我原先以为的还要绝望。他已经躲到荒野里去逃避官方了……真是个疯子！

english: I've heard that he's wandered into the lava maze in the most dangerous part of the wilderness!
translation: 我听说他走进了荒野最危险区域的熔岩迷宫！

english: Well...what's going to happen now?
translation: 那么……现在该怎么办？

english: Well, I was wondering if you could do me just one small favour? Please could you go and fetch him back again for me?
translation: 嗯，我在想你能不能帮我一个小忙？请你去把他找回来好吗？

english: You have got to be kidding!
translation: 你是在开玩笑吧！

english: Well....yes...I was....actually!
translation: 嗯……是的……我确实是……在开玩笑！

english: Here you go, here's your axe! And very many thanks for your help and a good laugh! You should have seen your face! Oh what a picture!
translation: 给你，这是你的斧头！非常感谢你的帮助，也让我好好笑了一场！你真该看看你那表情！哦，真是太精彩了！

english: I've lost that sharpened axe you gave me?
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那把磨锋利的斧头？

english: Can I get another one please?
translation: 能再给我一把吗？

english: Sure, here, you go.
translation: 当然，给你。

english: Good news, I have your sharpened axe!
translation: 好消息，我找到你的磨锋利的斧头了！

english: Ah, great!
translation: 啊，太好了！

english: Yep, here it is... at long last!
translation: 是的，它在这儿……终于！

english: Yeah, you've been a while... I mean, I could have just gone and done it myself! It probably wouldn't have taken so long.
translation: 是啊，你去了好一阵子……我是说，我本来可以自己去做的！大概也不会花这么久。

english: Why you ungrateful...
translation: 你这个忘恩负义的家伙……

english: Hang on a minute... there's no need to get so angry. Here's that red mahogany you wanted.
translation: 等一下……没必要这么生气。这是你要的红桃花心木。

english: Okay, thanks for getting my axe sharpened for me!
translation: 好的，谢谢你帮我把斧头磨锋利了！

english: I've lost that red mahogany you gave me!
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那块红桃花心木！

english: Well, I can get you another piece but you're going to have to pay for my time... 200 coins I'll want.
translation: 嗯，我可以再给你一块，但你要付我工时费……我要200金币。

english: But I don't have 200 gold coins!
translation: 但我没有200金币！

english: Sorry friend, I know you did me a small favour, but I have to earn a crust too!
translation: 抱歉朋友，我知道你帮了我一个小忙，但我也得糊口啊！

english: Okay, here's 200 coins for some red mahogany.
translation: 好吧，这里是200金币，买些红桃花心木。

english: Many thanks my friend!
translation: 非常感谢，我的朋友！

english: I won't pay you 200 coins for a piece of wood!
translation: 我不会花200金币买一块木头！

english: Well, suit yourself, I can always find other customers.
translation: 好吧，随你便，我总能找到其他顾客。

english: Here's the red mahogany you asked for.
translation: 这是你要的红桃花心木。

english: Well, that's absolutely wonderful my friend! Many thanks!
translation: 嗯，这真是太棒了，我的朋友！非常感谢！

english: Wait, that's it?
translation: 等等，就这样？

english: Well...what were you expecting? I mean, it took you so long I could have gone and got it myself!
translation: 嗯……你还想要什么？我是说，你花了那么长时间，我自己去都够了！

english: What! I've traipsed halfway around Gielinor...
translation: 什么！我大老远地跑遍了半个Gielinor……

english: I've negociated with fanatics, dwarven gangsters and arrogant gnomes.
translation: 我跟狂信徒、矮人黑帮和傲慢的侏儒谈判过。

english: I've fixed ancient weather vanes and gnomish landing lights and fought supernatural rock monsters...
translation: 我修理过古老的风向标和侏儒着陆灯，还跟超自然的岩石怪物战斗过……

english: I've filled stodgy mattresses with feathers, made pot lids to help cure an ailing metal-smith...and that's all the thanks I get? 'Thanks!'
translation: 我用羽毛填满了笨重的床垫，做了锅盖来帮助治愈生病的金属工匠……而这就是我得到的感谢？‘谢谢！’

english: Well, you didn't have to go to so much trouble...
translation: 嗯，你本来不用费这么大劲……

english: Raarrrhhhh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！

english: Look, I can see that you're quite upset about this...so here, have this.
translation: 听着，我看得出来你对这事很不满……所以这个给你。

english: It's a key ring, you can store some of your most valuable keys on it...helps to keep things organised!
translation: 这是一个钥匙圈，你可以把一些最重要的钥匙挂在上面……有助于保持整洁！

english: A key ring? That's it?
translation: 一个钥匙圈？就这样？

english: Well, I only asked you to do me one small favour...
translation: 嗯，我只是请你帮我一个小忙而已……

english: Groan! Yeah, so did everyone else!
translation: 唉！是啊，每个人都是这么说的！

english: Oh....ok, I guess I could offer you these lamps...I'm not sure what they're worth, but you can have them.
translation: 哦……好吧，我想我可以给你这些灯……我不知道它们值多少钱，但你可以拿去。

english: Well, let's not waste any more time! Stranger, are you ready for your interview?
translation: 好了，别再浪费时间了！陌生人，你准备好面试了吗？

english: I guess so...?
translation: 大概吧……？

english: Let's get you started with a nice easy question: What is your name?
translation: 我们先来个简单问题：你叫什么名字？

english: Pleased to meet you, [player name]. I'm Anne, and this is Will.
translation: 很高兴认识你，[player name]。我是安妮，这是威尔。

english: Next question: Do you have any experience captaining a ship?
translation: 下一个问题：你有指挥过船的经验吗？

english: Not really...
translation: 其实没有……

english: Will, it's important we not be too picky! It's a competitive market, after all.
translation: 威尔，我们别太挑剔了！毕竟市场竞争激烈。

english: Okay, final question: Do you agree to waive all rights to pursue legal action against your new employer in the event of injury or horrific death?
translation: 好的，最后一个问题：你是否同意放弃因受伤或惨死而向新雇主追究法律责任的权利？

english: Is that likely to happen?
translation: 这种事有可能发生吗？

english: I'm not sure if I...
translation: 我不确定我是否……

english: Excellent! Well then, [player name], I'm pleased to say that we have the results of your interview. You bring some impressive stuff to the table. We'd love to offer you the role!
translation: 太好了！那么，[player name]，我很高兴地告诉你，你的面试结果出来了。你带来了令人印象深刻的表现。我们很想给你这个职位！

english: Thanks... only, you didn't actually mention what the role was...
translation: 谢谢……只是，你其实没提到这个职位是什么……

english: Ah, how forgetful of us! Given that you've already accepted, how about we discuss the details on our ship.
translation: 啊，我们太健忘了！既然你已经接受了，不如我们在船上讨论细节吧。

english: But I didn't accept anything...
translation: 但我什么都没接受……

english: Just let us know when you're ready, and we'll hop aboard!
translation: 你准备好了就告诉我们，我们登船！

english: I guess I'm ready...
translation: 我想我准备好了……

english: Oh dear! It doesn't quite look like you are! You'll need to make some room to carry some things before we head off!
translation: 哦天哪！看起来你还没准备好！出发前你需要腾出空间来带些东西。

english: Then let us away!
translation: 那我们出发吧！

english: I'd rather not...
translation: 我还是不了……

english: Well, don't take too long. This work won't do itself, will it?
translation: 好吧，别拖太久。这工作不会自己完成的，对吧？

english: Sorry, but I'm not looking for a job right now. I'm just going to go...
translation: 抱歉，我现在不找工作。我这就走了……

english: Oh, you'll be back, friend! You already know you can't turn down an opportunity like this!
translation: 哦，你会回来的，朋友！你知道你无法拒绝这样的机会！

english: Ah, there you are! Time to get on with your interview!
translation: 啊，你来了！该继续你的面试了！

english: Ah, there you are, [player name]. Are you ready to hop aboard our ship?
translation: 啊，你来了，[player name]。准备好上船了吗？

english: Lovely! The open sea!
translation: 真棒！开阔的大海！

english: It's not really that open... We haven't even left port yet.
translation: 其实没那么开阔……我们还没离开港口呢。

english: Well, good news, [player name], because that's where you come in! You're our new helm!
translation: 好吧，好消息，[player name]，因为这就是你该上场的时候了！你是我们的新舵手！

english: Helm?
translation: 头盔？

english: It means you're in charge of the ship's helm! In other words, you're responsible for steering the ship!
translation: 意思是你负责船上的舵！换句话说，你负责掌舵！

english: It's more of a boat really...
translation: 其实更像是一艘船……

english: Well, we all have to start somewhere!
translation: 好吧，总得从某个地方开始！

english: Right... So if I'm manning the helm, what will you two be doing?
translation: 好吧……如果我来掌舵，你们两个做什么？

english: Well, it's simple, isn't it? We're in charge!
translation: 很简单，不是吗？我们负责指挥！

english: Have you ever actually done this before?
translation: 你们以前真的做过这种事吗？

english: Many times!
translation: 很多次了！

english: Just never on our own ship before! This is an exciting first day for... well, we haven't actually named our business yet, but I'm sure we'll come up with a good name soon.
translation: 只是从没在自己的船上做过！这是激动人心的第一天……嗯，我们其实还没给公司起名字，但我相信很快就会想出一个好名字。

english: And what does this business do?
translation: 那这家公司是做什么的？

english: We salvage shipwrecks of course!
translation: 我们当然是打捞沉船残骸了！

english: Of course. Alright then, I don't remember doing it, but apparently I committed to this. Where is our first wreck?
translation: 当然。好吧，我不记得做过，但显然我已经答应了。我们的第一个残骸在哪里？

english: We've got a good one to get us started! Last time we were on the Pandemonium, we purchased a map that should lead us to an old pirate wreck.
translation: 我们有一个好的开始！上次我们在潘德莫尼姆岛，我们买了一张地图，应该能带我们到一个旧海盗残骸。

english: The Pandemonium?
translation: 潘德莫尼姆岛？

english: Have you never been? It's a great place for a drink! We'll have to take you there!
translation: 你没去过？那是个喝酒的好地方！我们一定带你去！

english: But first, let's collect some salvage! According to the map, the wreck is just east of the Karamja Shipyard, so south of here.
translation: 但首先，我们来收集一些打捞物！根据地图，残骸就在卡拉姆詹岛造船厂东边，所以在这南边。

english: Over to you, [player name]! Take the helm when ready.
translation: 交给你了，[player name]！准备好就去掌舵。

english: This is your bit, [player name]! Take the helm when ready.
translation: 这是你的任务，[player name]！准备好就去掌舵。

english: Remember, you need to take us to the wreck. It should be east of the Karamja Shipyard, so south of here.
translation: 记住，你要带我们去残骸。应该在卡拉姆詹岛造船厂东边，所以在这南边。

english: Actually, I want to go back to Port Sarim.
translation: 其实，我想回沙林港。

english: This isn't the can-do attitude we need, [player name], but fine, we'll go back...
translation: 这不是我们需要的积极态度，[player name]，不过好吧，我们回去……

english: You need to take us to the wreck before we can use the salvaging hook, [player name]. It should be east of the Karamja Shipyard, so south of here.
translation: 你得先带我们去残骸，我们才能使用打捞钩，[player name]。应该在卡拉姆詹岛造船厂东边，所以在这南边。

english: Hello there, [player name]. Shall we hop back aboard our ship?
translation: 你好，[player name]。我们要回到船上吗？

english: Excellent! Let us away!
translation: 太好了！我们出发吧！

english: The wreck should be south of here.
translation: 残骸应该在这南边。

english: The wreck should be south west of here.
translation: 残骸应该在这西南边。

english: The wreck should be south east of here.
translation: 残骸应该在这东南边。

english: The wreck should be north of here.
translation: 残骸应该在这北边。

english: The wreck should be north west of here.
translation: 残骸应该在这西北边。

english: The wreck should be north east of here.
translation: 残骸应该在这东北边。

english: You need to head south of here.
translation: 你需要往南走。

english: You need to head south.
translation: 你需要往南走。

english: You need to head north.
translation: 你需要往北走。

english: You need to head west.
translation: 你需要往西走。

english: You need to head east.
translation: 你需要往东走。

english: We need to be going south.
translation: 我们得往南走。

english: We need to be going north.
translation: 我们得往北走。

english: We need to be going east.
translation: 我们得往东走。

english: We need to be going west.
translation: 我们得往西走。

english: You need to head south west.
translation: 你需要往西南走。

english: You need to head south east.
translation: 你需要往东南走。

english: You need to head north west.
translation: 你需要往西北走。

english: You need to head north east.
translation: 你需要往东北走。

english: You need to trim the sails, [player name]! We need to catch that wind!
translation: 你需要调整船帆，[player name]！我们要抓住那股风！

english: [player name]! The sails need trimming! Don't miss out on that wind!
translation: [player name]！该调整船帆了！别错过那股风！

english: The wind's picked up, [player name]! You'll need to trim the sails!
translation: 起风了，[player name]！你需要调整船帆！

english: Very good!
translation: 很好！

english: Right, now that we're here, I think it's time to do some salvaging!
translation: 好了，既然我们到了，我想该打捞了！

english: When you're ready, [player name], just lower the salvaging hook and let's see what we can find!
translation: 等你准备好了，[player name]，只需放下打捞钩，看看我们能找到什么！

english: Hang on... why am I lowering the hook? I thought the helm was my responsibility?
translation: 等等……为什么是我放下钩子？我以为掌舵才是我的职责？

english: Yes! The helm... and the hook!
translation: 是的！舵……还有钩子！

english: Of course. I'll just do everything while you two reap the rewards. Sounds about right.
translation: 当然。我什么都干，你们俩坐享其成。听起来很合理。

english: Don't go getting grumpy on us now, [player name]. This isn't about the rewards. It's all about the experience!
translation: 别现在对我们发脾气，[player name]。这不是关于回报，而是关于经验！

english: That's right! Think of what you'll learn today!
translation: 没错！想想你今天能学到什么！

english: Time for some salvaging, [player name]! When you're ready, just lower the salvaging hook and let's see what we can find!
translation: 打捞时间到了，[player name]！等你准备好了，放下打捞钩，看看我们能找到什么！

english: Right then, let's give this a go.
translation: 好吧，那我们试试看。

english: What do you make of these?
translation: 你觉得这些怎么样？

english: The medallion! Anne, we've found it!
translation: 勋章！安妮，我们找到了！

english: You were looking for this?
translation: 你在找这个？

english: That's right! And now that we've found it, I'm afraid we don't really need you anymore.
translation: 没错！既然我们已经找到了，恐怕我们不再需要你了。

english: Sorry, [player name]. If it's any consolation, you did a great job! Unfortunately, we just have to let you go.
translation: 抱歉，[player name]。如果这能让你好受点，你做得很好！不幸的是，我们只能让你走。

english: 'Yo ho ho and a Jolly Roger to you, me hearty! I can see from the fact that you're totally drenched from head to toe that you are a fellow scallywag sailor! The name's Steve Beanie! Pleased to meet you.
translation: '哟嚯嚯，祝你一个海盗旗，我的宝贝！从你从头到脚湿透的样子我能看出你是个同行的无赖水手！我叫史蒂夫.无檐小便帽！很高兴认识你。

english: I think I must be having some sort of fever dream... or maybe I'm dead?
translation: 我想我一定是在做某种噩梦……或者我死了？

english: 'Ha! Far from it, matey! Though the fever dream I can't comment on. They're rather common around here... but I assure you that it's well-nigh certainly like enough most likely not the rum doing it!
translation: '哈！差远了，伙计！不过噩梦我可不好说。这地方噩梦很常见……但我向你保证，这几乎肯定很像是很有可能不是朗姆酒搞的鬼！

english: Okay... You said words there, but I don't think they actually formed a sentence.
translation: 好吧……你说了些词，但我觉得它们根本没组成句子。

english: 'Ah, me wee hearty! You seem to be having quite the crisis! Thankfully, you've rigged the starboard and docked yourself at the right port! Welcome to the Pandemonium!
translation: '啊，我的小宝贝！你似乎正遭遇危机！幸好，你调整了右舷，把自己停靠在了正确的港口！欢迎来到潘德莫尼姆岛！

english: Pandemonium?
translation: 潘德莫尼姆岛？

english: 'Aye! To be sure! This here is the finest establishment in all the seas. Sit back! Have a drink! Let the good times, and the rum, flow!
translation: '没错！当然！这里是所有海域最棒的场所。坐下！喝一杯！让美好时光和朗姆酒流淌！

english: If this is the Pandemonium, do you know of a pair of salvagers called Will and Anne?
translation: 如果这是潘德莫尼姆岛，你知道一对叫威尔和安妮的打捞者吗？

english: 'Avast ye! You name a pair of pinching looting plundering seadogs!
translation: '嘿，你们！你说出两个偷窃掠夺抢劫的海狗！

english: I see. So you do know them. They claimed to have purchased a map here, but I'm guessing they weren't being totally honest about that...
translation: 我明白了。所以你确实认识他们。他们声称在这里买了地图，但我猜他们没完全说实话……

english: 'Purchased?! Purchased?! You're pulling my leg, you scallywag! Those scurvy dogs came here and broke the one rule of the Pandemonium! That map was pilfered! Stolen!
translation: '买？！买？！你在耍我吗，你这个无赖！那些坏血病的狗来到这里，打破了潘德莫尼姆岛的唯一条规！那张地图是偷的！被偷的！

english: Well, I had quite the fun run in with them myself. They had me help them salvage an old shipwreck before throwing me overboard.
translation: 好吧，我自己和他们有过一段有趣的遭遇。他们让我帮忙打捞一艘旧沉船，然后把我扔下了海。

english: 'Arrr, you poor scallywag.
translation: '啊，你这可怜的小无赖。

english: Thank you. It was the map they stole that led them to the wreck. What do you know about it?
translation: 谢谢你。是他们偷走的地图带他们找到了残骸。你知道些什么吗？

english: 'Not a lot, I'm afraid. You should hoist your sails and go speak to Ribs instead. It was his map they looted. He's the old dog over in the corner. Avast!
translation: 恐怕没什么。你应该扬起帆去找肋骨谈谈。他们抢走的是他的地图。他是那边角落里的老家伙。走开！

english: 'The scallywag sailor returns! Have you come for a drink? We only have the best here on the Pandemonium!
translation: '那个无赖水手回来了！你是来喝酒的吗？我们潘德莫尼姆岛只有最好的酒！

english: 'Those plundering seadogs! Did you speak to Ribs about them? It was his map they looted. He's the old dog over in the corner.
translation: '那些掠夺的海狗！你跟肋骨谈过他们的事了吗？他们抢的是他的地图。他就是角落里那个老家伙。

english: Thanks. I'll go and speak to him now.
translation: 谢谢。我现在就去找他谈谈。

english: I think I might have lost a cup here.
translation: 我想我可能在这里丢了一个杯子。

english: 'Aye! Someone handed it in earlier. Here you go.
translation: '是的！之前有人交上来了。给你。

english: 'Blistering barnacles! You don't seem to have room for it. You'd better come back later.
translation: '该死的藤壶！你好像没地方放它。你最好晚点再来。

english: 'Yo ho ho!
translation: '哟嚯嚯！

english: Hello there. I'm afraid I only talk to proper sailors, and I can see you're not quite at that level yet. However, you are welcome to admire me from afar.
translation: 你好。恐怕我只跟真正的水手说话，我看得出来你还没到那个水平。不过，欢迎你远远地仰慕我。

english: That all sounds a bit much!
translation: 这听起来有点过分了！

english: Well, it's not for everyone. Still, if you ever find yourself in need of a crew, you know where to find me.
translation: 好吧，这并不适合所有人。不过，如果你需要船员，你知道在哪里能找到我。

english: Kind of, I guess. I was hoping you could tell me about Will and Anne, along with the map they stole.
translation: 算是吧，我想。我希望你能告诉我关于威尔和安妮的事，还有他们偷走的地图。

english: A dark day. A very dark day. Those young fools know not what they have wrought upon themselves.
translation: 黑暗的一天。非常黑暗的一天。那些年轻的傻瓜不知道他们给自己带来了什么。

english: That being?
translation: 那是什么？

english: A curse! A curse most foul! That map marked the resting place of the Crimson Kraken! She was a deadly vessel, captained by none other than Barnacle Barnaby himself!
translation: 诅咒！最恶毒的诅咒！那张地图标记了深红色克拉肯海怪的安息之地！那是一艘致命的海船，船长正是巴纳比船长本人！

english: Barnacle Barnaby? Who's that then?
translation: 巴纳克尔.巴纳比？那是谁？

english: You have not heard the tale of Barnacle Barnaby? You have not heard of the scourge of the Unquiet Ocean?
translation: 你没听过巴纳克尔.巴纳比的故事？你没听过不宁海的灾星？

english: No, tell me about him.
translation: 没有，跟我说说他吧。

english: And risk the wrath of Barnaby's ghost? No. Better the map be locked away, so that neither it nor the curse could harm anyone else.
translation: 然后冒犯巴纳比船长的幽灵？不。最好把地图锁起来，这样它和诅咒都不会再伤害任何人。

english: I'm not sure I quite follow your reasoning for keeping it, but I guess it doesn't matter now. I'm afraid Will and Anne found and looted the Kraken.
translation: 我不太明白你保留它的理由，但我想现在不重要了。恐怕威尔和安妮已经找到并洗劫了克拉肯海怪。

english: Now's not really the time for tales.
translation: 现在不是讲故事的时候。

english: You are a fool for thinking that way, but on your head be it. The short of it is that Barnaby and the Kraken were cursed, condemning him and his crew to a watery grave.
translation: 你这么想真是傻瓜，但后果自负。简而言之，巴纳比船长和克拉肯海怪被诅咒了，诅咒他和他的船员葬身海底。

english: I see. Well, I'm afraid Will and Anne found and looted the Kraken.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，恐怕威尔和安妮已经找到并洗劫了克拉肯海怪。

english: I feared as much, though part of me still hoped it would not come to be. Tell me, did they find Barnaby's medallion?
translation: 我担心过，但心里仍希望不会发生。告诉我，他们找到巴纳比的勋章了吗？

english: They did. It was actually the only thing they were interested in.
translation: 他们找到了。实际上那是他们唯一感兴趣的东西。

english: Then the foul curse is now free once more. They must be stopped!
translation: 那么恶毒的诅咒现在又自由了。必须阻止它们！

english: Well, I do have my own personal reasons for wanting Will and Anne dealt with. Maybe I could try and find them.
translation: 好吧，我确实有自己的理由想要对付威尔和安妮。也许我可以试着找到他们。

english: You are a brave soul indeed, but that is just what is needed at a time like this.
translation: 你确实是个勇敢的人，但正是这个时候所需要的。

english: You should talk to Steve. He already put out a bounty for Will and Anne after the theft. He might have heard something about where they could have gone.
translation: 你应该跟史蒂夫谈谈。盗窃发生后，他已经悬赏捉拿威尔和安妮。他可能听到了他们可能去了哪里的消息。

english: Ahoy, young whippersnapper. Did you speak to Steve about that bounty?
translation: 喂，年轻的毛头小子。你跟史蒂夫谈过那个悬赏了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll go and see him now.
translation: 还没有。我现在就去找他。

english: About Will and Anne...
translation: 关于威尔和安妮……

english: 'Those plundering seadogs! Did you speak to Ribs about them?
translation: '那些掠夺的海狗！你跟肋骨谈过他们的事了吗？

english: I did. He seems to think they might have unleashed some sort of curse.
translation: 我问过了。他似乎认为他们可能释放了某种诅咒。

english: 'Ah, the curse of Barnacle Barnaby! It's one of Ribs' favourite tales. Just a myth of course, but the old dog does love his stories.
translation: 啊，巴纳比船长的诅咒！这是肋骨最喜欢的故事之一。当然只是个传说，但老家伙就是喜欢他的故事。

english: Well, myths aside, Ribs mentioned you'd put a bounty out for Will and Anne. I'd be quite keen to track them down myself.
translation: 好吧，传说先放一边，肋骨提到你悬赏了威尔和安妮。我自己也很想找到他们。

english: 'Yo ho ho! A mighty good decision! It's a generous bounty indeed. You don't go breaking the one rule of the Pandemonium and expect to get away with it!
translation: '哟嚯嚯！一个非常好的决定！这确实是一笔丰厚的悬赏。你不能违反潘德莫尼姆岛的唯一规则还指望能逃脱惩罚！

english: What exactly is this one rule you keep mentioning?
translation: 你一直提到的这个唯一规则到底是什么？

english: 'Yarr! You've got it!
translation: '呀！你说对了！

english: I see. So, back to Will and Anne. Do you have any idea where they might have gone?
translation: 我明白了。那么，回到威尔和安妮的事。你知道他们可能去了哪里吗？

english: 'Shiver me timbers! I'm afraid not. Old Grog said he might try and track them down. Perhaps he has an idea of where to find them.
translation: '吓死我了！恐怕不知道。老格罗格说他可能会试着追踪他们。也许他知道在哪里能找到他们。

english: Do you have any idea where Will and Anne might have gone?
translation: 你知道威尔和安妮可能去了哪里吗？

english: And where would I find Old Grog?
translation: 那我在哪里能找到老格罗格？

english: 'Ah, the old scallywag left not that long ago, but he'll be back here before long. He enjoys a drink far too much! In the meantime, you should hoist the sails and ready your vessel!
translation: '啊，那个老无赖不久前刚走，但他很快就会回来。他太爱喝酒了！与此同时，你应该扬帆起航，准备好你的船！

english: But I don't have a vessel...
translation: 但我没有船……

english: 'What? But then how did you get here?
translation: '什么？那你是怎么到这里的？

english: Will and Anne threw me overboard and I washed up here. I did mention this earlier...
translation: 威尔和安妮把我扔下了船，我被冲到了这里。我之前提到过……

english: 'Blistering barnacles! Well, you won't be getting far without a boat of your own. You should head to the docks and speak with Junior Jim, our local shipwright. He'll get you sorted out.
translation: '该死的藤壶！好吧，没有自己的船你走不远。你应该去码头找小吉姆，我们当地的造船匠。他会帮你搞定的。

english: Alright, I'll go and see him.
translation: 好的，我去找他。

english: 'Jolly Roger!
translation: '快乐罗杰！

english: 'Aye! Old Grog hasn't returned yet, but I'm sure he'll be back soon. In the meantime, you should head to the docks and speak with Junior Jim, our local shipwright. He'll get you sorted out with a boat of your own.
translation: '是的！老格罗格还没回来，但我相信他很快就会回来。与此同时，你应该去码头找小吉姆，我们当地的造船匠。他会帮你弄到一艘自己的船。

english: Are you Junior Jim?
translation: 你是小吉姆吗？

english: That's me. What do you need then?
translation: 就是我。你需要什么？

english: Steve said you might be able to sort me out with a boat.
translation: 史蒂夫说你可能能帮我弄到一艘船。

english: You don't have a boat?
translation: 你没有船？

english: Ha! We've got ourselves a Billy-no-boats! Classic! Yeah, I can sort you out with a boat, but it's gonna cost you.
translation: 哈！我们这儿来了个没船的比利！经典！是啊，我可以帮你弄到一艘船，但得花点钱。

english: Well, what do you have?
translation: 好吧，你有什么？

english: Er... I do have this cup I found. Perhaps I could trade it for a boat.
translation: 呃……我确实有找到的这个杯子。也许我可以拿它换一艘船。

english: Alright, let's have a gander at it.
translation: 好吧，让我瞧瞧。

english: I seem to have lost it.
translation: 我好像把它弄丢了。

english: You've got no boat. You've got no cup. You're fresh out of luck it would seem, mate. You'd best hope you lost it here on the Pandemonium. If so, someone might have handed it in to Steve.
translation: 你没船。你没杯子。看来你运气用光了，伙计。你最好希望你是丢在潘德莫尼姆岛上了。如果是这样，可能有人已经把它交给史蒂夫了。

english: Then I guess I'd better go see if Steve has it.
translation: 那我最好去看看史蒂夫有没有。

english: Hmm... Yeah, yeah, I can work with this. This old rusty cup will get you the finest raft I have!
translation: 嗯……是的，是的，我能用这个。这个破旧杯子能换到我最好的木筏！

english: Sorry, I think I must have misheard you. Did you say raft?
translation: 抱歉，我想我一定是听错了。你说的是木筏？

english: That's right! The best one I have!
translation: 没错！我最好的那一个！

english: I was kind of hoping for a bit more than a raft. It's not just the cup I have. I'm sure I can make up the funds to buy something bigger.
translation: 我本来还指望能弄到比木筏好一点的东西。我可不只有那个杯子。我肯定能凑够钱买艘大点的船。

english: Sorry, mate, but even if you could, the raft is all I've got to hand right now. Besides, you're gonna want to build up some experience before you captain anything too big. A raft will be perfect for you.
translation: 抱歉，伙计，就算你能行，我现在手头只有这木筏。再说了，在驾驶更大的船之前，你得先积累些经验。木筏正适合你。

english: Lighten up, mate. I'll have plenty more vessels in stock soon. Come back once you've got a bit more know-how and I'll be able to sort you right out.
translation: 别这么沮丧，老兄。我很快就会有更多船只到货。等你多懂点门道再回来，我就能帮你搞定。

english: Now, about your raft... With that cup I'll be able to sort you out with the finest helm, but it won't be enough to cover the sails.
translation: 好了，来说说你的木筏……有了那个杯子，我可以给你配个最好的头盔，但这点东西可不够买船帆。

english: But I won't get anywhere without sails!
translation: 但没有船帆我哪儿也去不了啊！

english: Don't panic, you silly plonker. I ain't about to send you off on a raft with no sails. I'll sort them out for you, but I'll just need a little favour in return.
translation: 别慌，你这傻蛋。我可不会让你坐个没帆的木筏出海。我会帮你搞定船帆，不过你得帮我个小忙作为回报。

english: I've got some cargo I need picking up from Port Sarim and bringing back here. In return for sorting you out with some sails, I'll need you to go and collect it for me.
translation: 我有些货物需要从沙林港运回来。作为帮你搞定船帆的交换，你得去帮我取回来。

english: Oh, and I tell you what, I'll even set you up with the materials to whack together a cargo hold. You won't be shifting that cargo far without one.
translation: 哦，对了，我还会给你材料，让你自己搭个货舱。没有货舱你可运不了那么远的货。

english: Now, hand over that cup and we can get cracking.
translation: 好了，把那个杯子给我，我们就可以开工了。

english: Right, time to sort you out with a cargo hold. Let's head on over to the shipyard...
translation: 好了，是时候帮你弄个货舱了。我们去船坞那边吧……

english: You'll want to grab yourself some tools from the crates over there, mate. After that, just use the gangplank to hop onto your raft. Once you're on board, you can get to work.
translation: 老兄，你最好从那边的板条箱里拿些工具。然后，用跳板跳到你的木筏上。等你上了船，就可以开始干活了。

english: You're back! Do you have that cup? If so, let's have a gander at it.
translation: 你回来了！拿到那个杯子了吗？如果拿到了，让我瞧瞧。

english: Just use the gangplank over there to hop onto your raft. Once you're on board, you can use your tools to build a cargo hold. Don't worry about the materials, mate. I'm supplying those this time.
translation: 用那边的跳板跳到你的木筏上。等你上了船，就可以用你的工具建造货舱了。别担心材料，老兄，这次我提供。

english: Very nice! Now, use the gangplank to hop back up here and we can get going.
translation: 非常好！现在，用跳板跳回这里，我们就可以出发了。

english: Smashing job on that cargo hold, mate. Let's get back to the Pandemonium, shall we?
translation: 货舱干得漂亮，老兄。我们回潘德莫尼姆岛吧，好吗？

english: Okay, looks like that's you all sorted, mate. I'd say you're now ready to set sail!
translation: 好了，看来你全都准备好了，老兄。我觉得你现在可以出海了！

english: Why don't you take your new raft out for a spin? You can head over to Port Sarim and collect that cargo for me. Oh, which reminds me, now that you're officially a captain, you'll need one of these.
translation: 为什么不把你的新木筏开出去兜兜风呢？你可以去沙林港帮我取那批货。哦，这倒提醒了我，既然你现在正式成为船长了，你需要这个。

english: Ah, seems you don't have room for it, mate. Why don't you come back later?
translation: 啊，看来你没地方放它了，老兄。你晚点再来吧？

english: Your very own captain's log! You can use that to keep track of your adventures out at sea, including any work you might end up taking on.
translation: 你专属的船长日志！你可以用它来记录你在海上的冒险经历，包括你可能接到的任何任务。

english: Like collecting your cargo?
translation: 比如取货？

english: Right on, mate! In fact, I'll make a note of that in your log now.
translation: 没错，老兄！事实上，我现在就把它记在你的日志里。

english: And that's you all ready to go, mate! Just hop on your new raft when ready. If you need help finding my cargo, just check in with the port master when you get to Port Sarim.
translation: 好了，你全都准备好了，老兄！准备好了就跳上你的新木筏吧。如果你需要帮忙找我的货，到了沙林港就去问问港口管理员。

english: Now, unless you fancy a cheeky dip, the gangplank down the docks will be your best bet for getting on board.
translation: 好了，除非你想来个湿身，否则码头那边的跳板是你上船的最佳选择。

english: You'll be needing one of these, mate.
translation: 你会需要这个的，老兄。

english: Ah, seems you don't have room for it. Why don't you come back later?
translation: 啊，看来你没地方放它。你晚点再来吧？

english: You should be all ready to go, mate! Just hop on your new raft when ready. If you need help finding my cargo, just check in with the port master when you get to Port Sarim.
translation: 你应该都准备好了，老兄！准备好了就跳上你的新木筏吧。如果你需要帮忙找我的货，到了沙林港就去问问港口管理员。

english: Hi there. Do you need help with anything?
translation: 你好。需要帮忙吗？

english: I'm here to pick up some cargo for Junior Jim on the Pandemonium.
translation: 我是来帮潘德莫尼姆岛的小吉姆取货的。

english: Looks like you already have it. You'll need to take it back to the Pandemonium now.
translation: 看来你已经拿到了。你现在需要把它带回潘德莫尼姆岛。

english: Ah, you must be new to this. You can pick up and drop off cargo just over there at the ledger table.
translation: 啊，你一定是新手。你可以在那边的分类账桌取货和交货。

english: Alright, mate. How are you doing collecting my cargo?
translation: 好吧，老兄。我的货取回来了吗？

english: Well, you'd better hop back onto your raft then. Unless you fancy a cheeky dip, the gangplank down the docks will be your best bet for getting on board.
translation: 嗯，那你最好跳回你的木筏上。除非你想来个湿身，否则码头那边的跳板是你上船的最佳选择。

english: I've got it right here.
translation: 我拿到了，就在这儿。

english: Very nice! Just hand that over to the port master and he'll sort it out. Come let me know once you're done.
translation: 非常好！把它交给港口管理员，他会处理好的。办完了来告诉我一声。

english: Hi there. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 你好。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: I'm here to drop off some cargo for Junior Jim.
translation: 我是来帮小吉姆交货的。

english: You don't seem to have any cargo on you.
