translation: 你身上好像没带什么货。

english: Oh, I must have left it in my cargo hold. I'll be right back.
translation: 哦，我一定是把它落在货舱里了。我马上回来。

english: Ah, very good. Just put it over by the ledger table and I'll get it sorted.
translation: 啊，很好。把它放在分类账桌那边，我来处理。

english: Thanks, sailor. I'll get that all sorted out. You should go let Jim know his cargo is here.
translation: 谢谢，水手。我会处理好的。你应该去告诉吉姆他的货到了。

english: Alright, mate.
translation: 好的，老兄。

english: I collected your cargo and left it with the port master.
translation: 我取了你的货，已经交给港口管理员了。

english: Very nice! That's us all squared up then. You ought to pop back once you've got a bit more experience with that raft. By then I should have some new vessels for sale.
translation: 非常好！那我们两清了。等你对那木筏更有经验了，应该再回来看看。到时候我应该会有新船出售。

english: I might just do that. Any tips on the best ways to get that experience?
translation: 我会的。有什么获得经验的好方法吗？

english: To be honest, mate, I'd say one of the best things would be to take on more work like what you just did for me. A lot of ports will have a notice board where folks advertise jobs they want sorting.
translation: 老实说，老兄，我觉得最好的方法之一就是多接点像你刚才帮我做的那种活。很多港口都有公告板，上面会贴出人们想找人帮忙的工作。

english: Sounds good. Anything else?
translation: 听起来不错。还有别的吗？

english: Well, now that you're officially a big cheese captain, you might want to start charting the sea for your own records. That log book I gave you has all sorts of cracking tips on how to do so.
translation: 嗯，既然你现在正式成为大船长（乳酪船长）了，你可能想开始绘制海图作为自己的记录。我给你的那本日志里有很多关于如何做到这一点的绝妙技巧。

english: Oh, and while we're on about charting, I've also chucked some useful bits and bobs in your cargo hold.
translation: 哦，说到绘制海图，我还在你的货舱里塞了些有用的零碎东西。

english: First up, I've left you a couple of repair kits in there. Perfect for if you go being a numpty and end up sailing straight into a proper big storm or a big group of sharks.
translation: 首先，我在里面留了几个修理包。万一你像个傻瓜一样直接撞进大风暴或大群鲨鱼里，这东西就派上用场了。

english: The other thing in there is a spyglass. It's a proper handy charting tool that's great for getting a good look at things while out at sea.
translation: 里面还有一件东西是望远镜。这是一个非常方便的绘图工具，很适合在海上仔细观察事物。

english: There's a chap called Charles who used to be pretty good at the whole charting thing who might be able to help you more. You can find him down in the cave on the island.
translation: 有个叫查尔斯的家伙，以前很擅长绘图这档子事，他也许能帮你更多。你可以在岛上的洞穴里找到他。

english: Great! Thanks, Jim. I'd better go check in with Steve now and see if Old Grog is back.
translation: 太好了！谢谢你，吉姆。我最好现在去找史蒂夫，看看老格罗格回来了没有。

english: Is this the one?
translation: 是这个吗？

english: 'Aye! This Jolly Roger here is pretty keen to see some justice dealt! Old Grog, meet... er...
translation: '啊！这位海盗旗先生非常渴望看到正义得到伸张！老格罗格，来见见……呃……

english: '[player name]! And [player name], meet Old Grog.
translation: '[player name]！还有[player name]，来见见老格罗格。

english: Steve tells me you're keen to see Will and Anne dealt with. I'm open to sharing the bounty, but only if you have what it takes. I have no time for layabouts.
translation: 史蒂夫告诉我你很想看到威尔和安妮被收拾。我愿意和你分享赏金，但前提是你得有那个本事。我可没时间陪懒鬼。

english: I won't let you down!
translation: 我不会让你失望的！

english: We'll see. I saw that raft you rocked up in. If that's all you bring to the table, then you have some work to do.
translation: 走着瞧吧。我看到你坐的那木筏了。如果那就是你拿得出手的东西，那你还有不少事儿要做呢。

english: It will take me some time to track Will and Anne down, but make no mistake, I will find them. I expect you to be ready by the time that happens. Don't be a disappointment.
translation: 追踪威尔和安妮需要一些时间，但别搞错了，我一定会找到他们。我希望到时候你已经准备好了。别让我失望。

english: You have my word.
translation: 我向你保证。

english: Good. Now, that's me done drinking. Time to get to work. I'll keep Steve updated on my progress, so make sure you're checking in with him. He'll let you know once I have something.
translation: 很好。好了，我酒喝完了。该去干活了。我会让史蒂夫知道我的进展，所以你要记得去找他。一旦我有了消息，他会通知你的。

english: 'Yo ho ho, [player name]! Best you not waste time! Belay your helm and abaft your rigging! Get out there and make sure you're ready for Old Grog!
translation: '哟嚯嚯，[player name]！你最好别浪费时间！收好你的舵，调整好你的索具！出去确保你为老格罗格做好了准备！

english: 'To help you on your way, I've got some pirate looty here for you! Sawmill coupons! Useful if you want a top vessel like mine.
translation: '为了帮你上路，我这里有些海盗战利品给你！锯木厂优惠券！如果你想弄艘像我这样的顶级船，这东西很有用。

english: 'Oh, and don't forget to pop back for a drink from time to time. My rum is to die for! Now, avast!
translation: '哦，别忘了时不时回来喝一杯。我的朗姆酒好喝得要命！好了，开船！

english: Er... Admiring these lovely gates?
translation: 呃……欣赏这些可爱的大门吗？

english: You can admire them from back here!
translation: 你可以从这里欣赏它们！

english: It is my right and duty as a follower of Ranul to document that which has been found beneath your city.
translation: 作为拉努尔的信徒，我有权利也有义务记录你们城市地下发现的一切。

english: Your beliefs do not grant you a right to anything in Cam Torum, not to document things, and especially not to get yourself killed.
translation: 你的信仰可没给你在卡姆托鲁姆任何权利，不管是记录东西，还是尤其别让你自己送命。

english: I don't want to give Fortis any excuses to come knocking on our door to investigate your untimely and idiotic demise.
translation: 我可不想给福尔蒂斯任何借口，让他们来敲我们的门调查你这种不合时宜又愚蠢的死亡。

english: I won't take no for an answer. I am bound by my divine oath.
translation: 我不接受拒绝。我被神圣誓言所束缚。

english: Oh yes? And will your divine oath feed you in there? Light your way? Keep you safe from cave-ins and monsters?
translation: 哦，是吗？那你的神圣誓言会在里面喂饱你？照亮你的路？保护你免受洞穴坍塌和怪物袭击？

english: I don't know about cave-ins, but I can handle monsters.
translation: 洞穴坍塌我不清楚，但怪物我能应付。

english: Sorry, but I'm busy with a different arrogant human. You'll have to wait in line.
translation: 抱歉，我正忙着应付另一个傲慢的人类呢。你得排队等着。

english: Ranul provides...
translation: 拉努尔自会供给……

english: No! We've more than enough humans in Cam Torum with this blasted Fortis mandated dig! I don't care how many deals it secured, it's not worth all this trouble!
translation: 不！卡姆托鲁姆的人类已经够多了，就因为福尔蒂斯强行要求的这次挖掘！我才不管换来了多少交易，根本不值得惹这么多麻烦！

english: Advisor Attala...
translation: 顾问阿塔拉……

english: Apologies, but I was sent to tell you that one of the creatures from the ruins managed to bypass our defenses.
translation: 抱歉，但我被派来告知您，废墟里的一只生物设法绕过了我们的防御。

english: It escaped through the mountain's outflow spring, to the north east.
translation: 它从山脉的流出泉逃了出去，在东北方向。

english: The one that leads to the aqueduct?! We'll have Fortis guards barging into the city if they catch wind...
translation: 就是通往水渠的那个？！要是他们听到风声，福尔蒂斯的守卫就会冲进城来……

english: It sounds like you need help.
translation: 听起来你需要帮助。

english: Cam Torum does not need help, much less that of any humans!
translation: 卡姆托鲁姆不需要帮助，更不需要任何人类的帮助！

english: Wake the off-duty guards and put them to work. I'll ensure they're paid handsomely.
translation: 叫醒休息的守卫，让他们去干活。我会确保他们得到丰厚的报酬。

english: I'm afraid we already have.
translation: 恐怕我们已经这么做了。

english: Argh! Get back to your post!
translation: 啊！回到你的岗位上去！

english: Alright, fine! Human, you look like you've seen a fight or two. Deal with the escaped creature by the mountain outflow spring.
translation: 好吧，行！人类，你看起来像是打过几场架的样子。去处理山脉流出泉那边逃走的生物。

english: Hang on, what's in it for me?
translation: 等等，我有什么好处？

english: What do you want?!
translation: 你想要什么？！

english: Access to the city sounds nice.
translation: 能进城听起来不错。

english: Fine, get to it!
translation: 行，去吧！

english: On secound thoughts, I don't like your attitude.
translation: 转念一想，我不喜欢你的态度。

english: Have you killed that creature yet?
translation: 你杀掉那只生物了吗？

english: Working on it.
translation: 正在处理。

english: It's up by the mountain outflow spring, north east of here. Get to it before it makes its way to the aqueduct!
translation: 就在山脉流出泉附近，从这里往东北。在它跑到水渠之前搞定它！

english: I should head back to Attala and let her know that the aqueduct is secure.
translation: 我应该回去找阿塔拉，告诉她水渠安全了。

english: Good work team! Let's let Attala know we all killed it, together!
translation: 干得好，团队！咱们一起去告诉阿塔拉，是我们一起杀了它！

english: Technically I helped kill it... Without me, the others might have been overwhelmed... Yes... I should let Attala know the aqueduct is secure.
translation: 严格来说是我帮忙杀死的……要是没我，其他人可能就被干掉了……没错……我应该让阿塔拉知道水渠安全了。

english: I've taken care of the... What was that thing anyway?
translation: 我已经处理了……那东西到底是什么？

english: A spirit of sorts. Something far older than anything your people have bothered to remember. In any case, a deal is a deal. You may enter the city of Cam Torum.
translation: 某种灵魂吧。比你们人类费心记起的任何东西都要古老得多。总之，一言为定。你可以进入卡姆托鲁姆城。

english: Are you still here?!
translation: 你怎么还在这儿？！

english: Yes, and I'm not going anywhere!
translation: 没错，而且我哪儿也不去！

english: Fine! If it'll make you stop pestering me, you can join...
translation: 行吧！要是这样能让你不再烦我，你可以加入……

english: You can join [player name].
translation: 你可以加入[player name]。

english: [player name], he's your responsibility now. If either of you cause any trouble, you're both out!
translation: [player name]，他现在归你负责。要是你们俩谁惹麻烦，就一起滚蛋！

english: Now, hang on...
translation: 嘿，等等……

english: Thank you, [player name]. I'm Zuma, by the way. I'll meet you inside.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。顺便说一句，我叫祖玛。咱们里面见。

english: I'm here to help, you know...
translation: 我是来帮忙的，你知道吧……

english: There's no need for that.
translation: 没这个必要。

english: That was unnecessary.
translation: 没必要那样。

english: Excuse me! I don't believe I've given you permission to enter the dig.
translation: 打扰一下！我不记得给过你进入挖掘现场的许可。

english: Well with the suitation outside dealt with, I now need to keep an eye on this expedition. Any mistakes made in these ruins could bring the ground out from beneath our city!
translation: 嗯，既然外面的情况已经处理好了，我现在需要盯着这支考察队。这些废墟里任何失误都可能让我们城市脚下的地面塌陷！

english: Is it really that dangerous in there?
translation: 里面真的那么危险吗？

english: It might be if you don't know what you're dealing with. Your people often assume they do, which generally makes things worse.
translation: 要是你不了解情况的话，可能会很危险。你们人类常常以为自己懂，结果通常让事情更糟。

english: The rest of your people don't seem very happy I'm here.
translation: 你的其他族人似乎不太欢迎我在这里。

english: The rest?! I'm not happy you're here either.
translation: 其他？！我也不欢迎你在这里。

english: I helped you with the aqueduct. You could afford to show a little bit of gratitude.
translation: 我帮了你水渠的事。你多少可以表示点感激吧。

english: You'll have my gratitude when you finish youbusiness in Cam Torum and leave.
translation: 等你办完事离开卡姆托鲁姆，你自然会得到我的感激。

english: Will the city's defense be okay without you?
translation: 没有你，城市的防御没问题吗？

english: As I say, the situation has been dealt with for now. Besides, the only reason that situation existed in the first place is because of these ruins.
translation: 我说了，情况暂时处理好了。再说，一开始出现那种情况就是因为这些废墟。

english: At this point a smart person would call off this dig entirely, but as that doesn't seem set to happen, I'd say it's in our best interests we keep an eye on things.
translation: 到这一步，聪明人就会彻底叫停这次挖掘，但这似乎不太可能发生，所以我觉得最好还是盯着点。

english: I take it you don't get on well with the humans?
translation: 我猜你和人类处不来？

english: It's not exactly that. You have your virtues, but you have short sight and even shorter memories, which can be very dangerous.
translation: 倒不完全是。你们有优点，但你们目光短浅，记性更短，这可能会非常危险。

english: Why not share what you know with us then?
translation: 那为什么不把你所知道的分享给我们呢？

english: I suspect some of your people wouldn't be too pleased if we did. The truth isn't something that everyone desires.
translation: 我怀疑你们有些人要是我们分享了，会不高兴的。真相并不是每个人都想要的。

english: Well I'm always open to a bit of truth myself.
translation: 嗯，我个人倒是一直对真相持开放态度。

english: Hmph! I doubt that.
translation: 哼！我表示怀疑。

english: Thank you for your help back there, [player name]. Dwarves can be very stubborn.
translation: 谢谢你刚才的帮助，[player name]。矮人非常固执。

english: So can you, apparently.
translation: 看来你也很固执。

english: It is not stubbornness on my part. It is duty that drives me.
translation: 我这可不是固执。是职责在驱使着我。

english: Duty to what?
translation: 对什么的职责？

english: I am a nelta of Ranul and I am bound by his tenets. One of them is to ensure that knowledge is protected and respected. These ruins they've found could contain all manner of things! I must find out!
translation: 我是拉努尔的内尔塔，受他的戒律约束。其中一条就是确保知识得到保护和尊重。他们发现的这些废墟可能包含各种东西！我必须查明！

english: How did you hear about these ruins?
translation: 你是怎么听说这些废墟的？

english: The cave-in that revealed them shook the foundations of the Teomat!
translation: 揭露废墟的那场洞穴坍塌震动了特奥马特修道院的地基！

english: The dwarves tried to hide them from us, but we eventually found out.
translation: 矮人试图对我们隐瞒，但我们最终还是发现了。

english: What are you expecting to find down there?
translation: 你期望在里面找到什么？

english: I don't know exactly yet, but knowledge of some kind! Maybe even some undiscovered history regarding Ralos and Ranul!
translation: 我还不太确定，但肯定是某种知识！甚至可能是一些关于拉洛斯和拉努尔的未被发现的历史！

english: I take it you don't get on well with the dwarves?
translation: 我猜你和矮人处不来？

english: They are arrogant! They think they know it all, and worst of all, they are non-believers!
translation: 他们太傲慢了！以为自己什么都懂，最糟的是，他们居然不信教！

english: Technically I'm a non-believer.
translation: 严格来说我也不信教。

english: But that is because you are ignorant of the truth, not because you outright reject it. Would you like me to tell you of the ways of Ranul?
translation: 但那是因为你对真相一无所知，而不是你直接拒绝它。你想让我给你讲讲拉努尔之道吗？

english: Timoiva.
translation: 蒂莫伊瓦。

english: Nilsal! The name's Jessamine, though most people call me Jess. You must be [player name]. I hear you sorted out the situation holding back the arrivialof our supplies. Thanks for that.
translation: 尼尔萨尔！我叫杰萨明，不过大多数人都叫我杰斯。你一定就是[player name]了。我听说你解决了阻碍我们补给品送达的问题。谢了。

english: Don't mention it. So you're here for these ruins beneath the city?
translation: 不客气。那么你是为了城市地下的这些废墟来的？

english: Yes, a cave-in revealed them! I'm here to lead the dig and see what we can discover.
translation: 是的，一场洞穴坍塌揭露了它们！我是来领导挖掘工作，看看我们能发现什么的。

english: There seems to be a lot of ancient ruins popping up lately.
translation: 最近似乎冒出了很多古代废墟。

english: Gielinor has been around for a long time. We're really only just starting to scratch its surface!
translation: 吉莱诺已经存在很久了。我们才刚开始触及它的表面呢！

english: Can I be of any help with the dig?
translation: 挖掘工作我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: Well it seems our expedition has already gained a couple of new recruits somehow, but what I really need is someone more proactive who can fend for themselves. You seem perfect for the job!
translation: 嗯，看来我们的考察队不知怎么已经招募到了几个新成员，但我真正需要的是更积极主动、能自保的人。你看起来非常适合这个工作！

english: Meet me inside the ruins. We need help setting up some base camps for further exploration.
translation: 到废墟里面跟我碰头。我们需要帮忙建立一些基地营，以便进一步探索。

english: How come the dwarves let you in?
translation: 矮人怎么让你进来的？

english: I work at the museum in Fortis. The dwarves have a begrudging alliance with the capital, and so they begrudgingly let me in.
translation: 我在福尔蒂斯的博物馆工作。矮人与首都有一种勉强的联盟关系，所以他们勉强让我进来了。

english: They demanded agreement to some absurdly expensive export deals in exchange, and even exclusive rights to some imports from the mainland.
translation: 他们以此为由，要求同意一些荒谬昂贵的出口协议，甚至包括一些来自大陆进口商品的独家权利。

english: It took weeks of negotiation, and they still don't seem entirely satisfied.
translation: 谈判花了好几周，他们似乎仍然不完全满意。

english: I take it you don't get on too well?
translation: 我猜你们处得不太好？

english: No. It's a shame. They would be a great source of historical knowledge, if they were just more willing to share it.
translation: 没错。真可惜。如果他们更愿意分享的话，他们本可以是历史知识的伟大来源。

english: Nilsal! When you're ready, meet me inside the ruins. We need help setting up some base camps for further exploration.
translation: 尼尔萨尔！准备好了就到废墟里跟我碰头。我们需要帮忙建立一些基地营，以便进一步探索。

english: I should probably speak to the others before I go exploring.
translation: 在去探索之前，我应该和其他人谈谈。

english: Xali.... Ates... Hmm, no, not quite right...
translation: 萨利……阿特斯……嗯，不对，不太对……

english: The moon blotting out the sun, could this be...
translation: 月亮遮住太阳，这可能是……

english: Concerning...
translation: 令人担忧……

english: This is an old place, [player name]. Older even than much of what we dwarves remember.
translation: 这是个古老的地方，[player name]。甚至比我们矮人记得的大部分东西还要古老。

english: That's exciting.
translation: 这很令人兴奋。

english: No, it's dangerous is what it is.
translation: 不，是危险才对。

english: Now where is that fool priest?
translation: 现在那个蠢祭司在哪儿？

english: Incredible...
translation: 不可思议……

english: This is sacred ground. This is most obviously a shrine built by emissaries of Ranul.
translation: 这是神圣之地。很明显，这是拉努尔的使者们建造的神龛。

english: You see a picture of a creature eating the sun and instead of a warning, you see evidence of your god? You really are beyond saving.
translation: 你看到一幅生物吞噬太阳的图画，却把它当作你神的证据而不是警告？你真是无可救药了。

english: Enough! This mural may depict a scene straight from our holy scriptures! Show some respect!
translation: 够了！这幅壁画描绘的可能是我们圣典中的场景！放尊重些！

english: Alright, calm down, both of you. Let's go see what the actual archaeologist has to say.
translation: 好了，你们两个都冷静点。我们去听听真正的考古学家怎么说。

english: Strange...
translation: 奇怪……

english: This mural has an inscription beneath it, written in the language of the Old Ones. I think I'm getting there, but I'm going to need more time to decipher it.
translation: 这幅壁画下方有一段铭文，是用古神语写的。我觉得快解出来了，但还需要更多时间。

english: We don't need to be deciphering inscriptions to know that we shouldn't be here. I mean look at that... whatever that floating thing is. This place is dangerous!
translation: 我们不需要解读铭文也知道不该待在这里。你看看那个……不管那漂浮的东西是什么。这地方很危险！

english: All the more reason to find out more about it then.
translation: 那就更有理由去了解更多了。

english: Do you need me to do anything in the meantime?
translation: 这段时间需要我做什么吗？

english: Could I help with the translations? I actually have a bit of experience with this language.
translation: 我能帮忙翻译吗？我其实对这种语言有点经验。

english: That's very kind of you to offer, but if it's okay with you, I actually have a different task I could use your help with.
translation: 你愿意帮忙真是太好了，但如果你不介意的话，我其实有另一项任务需要你帮忙。

english: The surrounding caverns are quite large. If you could take some building supplies and set up some camps in each of them, it would make further exploration a lot easier.
translation: 周围的洞穴很大。如果你能带些建筑补给品，在每个洞穴里搭建营地，后续探索会容易得多。

english: Have you finished setting up the camps?
translation: 你搭好营地了吗？

english: Let me know when you have. In the meantime, I've got to keep working on this inscription, whilst also making sure these two don't kill each other...
translation: 搭好了就告诉我。与此同时，我得继续研究这段铭文，还得确保这两位别打起来……

english: They're... er... Very passionate.
translation: 他们……呃……非常热情。

english: Speaking of which, what about you? Why a life of archaeology?
translation: 说到这个，你呢？为什么选择考古学？

english: I've always loved it. When I was a child, I had a friend in Fortis who I'd collect old trinkets with.
translation: 我一直很喜欢。小时候在福蒂斯有个朋友，我们一起收集旧小饰品。

english: It's right here! It clearly says...
translation: 就在这里！上面明明写着……

english: I see. I guess it was a natural next step then?
translation: 我明白了。那这算是顺理成章的下一步吧？

english: I don't care what your book says! Your book won't keep us safe from...
translation: 我不管你的书怎么说！你的书可保护不了我们免受……

english: Indeed. The employees at the museum already knew me well by the time I applied. I've spent a lot of my life browsing it.
translation: 确实。我申请工作时，博物馆的员工已经很熟悉我了。我一生中很多时间都在那里浏览。

english: The last time you humans did something like this...
translation: 上次你们人类做这种事的时候……

english: You should visit the museum in Varrock some time. There's a lot to see!
translation: 你应该找个时间去维洛克城的博物馆看看。有很多值得看的东西！

english: Always 'you humans'. You do realise I am not my great-grandfather...
translation: 总是‘你们人类’。你知道我不是我的曾祖父吧……

english: I've been meaning to! Thing is, I couldn't turn down this opportunity when it came up.
translation: 我一直想去！问题是，这个机会来了我无法拒绝。

english: Keep this up and I'll have you kicked out of the...
translation: 再这样下去，我就把你赶出……

english: Understandable. Right, I should get back to those camps.
translation: 可以理解。好了，我该回去处理那些营地了。

english: The secrets of this dungeon belong to the Varlamorian people! You can't...
translation: 这个地牢的秘密属于瓦拉莫里亚人民！你不能……

english: How can you make those claims so confidently?
translation: 你怎么能这么自信地做出那些断言？

english: It's in the holy scriptures! As I was saying...
translation: 圣典里写着呢！就像我刚才说的……

english: Can't get a word in edgeways with these two.
translation: 跟这两位根本插不上话。

english: I should grab the camp building supplies before I do any more exploration.
translation: 在继续探索之前，我应该先去拿营地建筑补给品。

english: This entrance looks dangerous. I probably shouldn't go in here without a good reason.
translation: 这个入口看起来很危险。没有充分理由的话，我大概不该进去。

english: I probably shouldn't touch anything until the others have had a chance to look around.
translation: 在其他人有机会查看之前，我大概不该碰任何东西。

english: I've finished setting up the camps.
translation: 我已经搭好营地了。

english: Thanks. I'm all done deciphering the inscription. Some of it has worn away, so we're missing bits, but between it, the murals and the big floating monolith, we've already found some pretty exciting stuff!
translation: 谢谢。我已经完全解读了铭文。有些部分已经磨损了，所以我们缺失了一些内容，但结合铭文、壁画和那块巨大的漂浮巨石，我们已经发现了一些非常激动人心的东西！

english: What does the inscription say?
translation: 铭文上写了什么？

english: 'Here in Neypotzli, by ??? of earth and streams, have these emissaries of ??? been sealed, ??? ??? ???.'
translation: “在此内波茨利监狱，借由大地与溪流之？？？，这些？？？的使者已被封印，？？？？？？。”

english: Emissaries of Ranul! We must work to free them at once.
translation: 拉努尔的使者！我们必须立刻设法释放他们。

english: First they built the place, now they're sealed in it. These leaping assumptions are going to get us all killed!
translation: 先是他们建造了这地方，现在他们又被封印在里面。这些草率的假设会害死我们所有人！

english: Well I've only ever had good experiences opening ancient vaults.
translation: 嗯，我打开古代密室的经验一直都很好。

english: Attala is right to be cautious. These murals don't look all too friendly...
translation: 阿塔拉谨慎是对的。这些壁画看起来不太友好……

english: But these emissaries may have ancient knowledge lost to the ages! We must investigate further.
translation: 但这些使者可能拥有失落已久的古代知识！我们必须进一步调查。

english: These ruins are directly beneath the Teomat... I suppose it's possible there may be some links to Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 这些废墟就在特奥马特修道院正下方……我想可能跟拉洛斯和拉努尔有些联系。

english: I will not allow you to put Cam Torum in danger just because you're curious!
translation: 我不会允许你因为好奇就让卡姆托鲁姆陷入危险！

english: I'm not sure if these disagreements are really getting us anywhere...
translation: 我不确定这些分歧真的能让我们取得什么进展……

english: You make a good point.
translation: 你说得有道理。

english: I think it would be unwise to go and start freeing emissaries that we know nothing about.
translation: 我认为去释放那些我们一无所知的使者是不明智的。

english: Agreed!
translation: 同意！

english: But we should still try and learn more about them. They may pose a risk to Cam Torum.
translation: 但我们还是应该尽量多了解他们。他们可能对卡姆托鲁姆构成威胁。

english: Hmph! Very well.
translation: 哼！好吧。

english: We know they were sealed by the power of earth and streams. This magic presumably originates from somewhere within these ruins. I also wonder if these talismans I found might be connected...
translation: 我们知道他们是被大地与溪流的力量封印的。这种魔法大概源自这些废墟中的某处。我也在想我找到的这些护符是否有关联……

english: Hmm... Nahta will know what to do with these. [player name], take them to him in Cam Torum's magic shop. Tell him I sent you.
translation: 嗯……纳赫塔知道该怎么处理这些。[player name]，把它们带到卡姆托鲁姆的魔法商店给他。告诉他是我让你去的。

english: Come back to me when you have space and I'll give you the talismans.
translation: 等你有空位了再来找我，我会把护符给你。

english: What does the western mural depict?
translation: 西边的壁画描绘了什么？

english: It's raining blood! It is clearly a depiction of death!
translation: 下着血雨！这明显是在描绘死亡！

english: It's not clear from the mural whether the creature depicted is calling the rain or lamenting its arrival.
translation: 从壁画上看不清楚，描绘的生物是在召唤雨水还是在哀叹它的到来。

english: It's an emissary of the blood moon! A bringer of rain and bountiful harvests!
translation: 这是血月的使者！带来雨水和丰收的使者！

english: Blood moons don't usually bring good harvests, and I don't see any thriving crops depicted in the mural.
translation: 血月通常不会带来好收成，而且我在壁画里也没看到任何茂盛的庄稼。

english: So what do you make of it?
translation: 那你觉得这是什么意思？

english: You cannot deny us the Blood Moon's bounty!
translation: 你不能剥夺我们血月的恩赐！

english: The blood moon is nothing more than a cosmic occurrence. We need more context to come to any conclusions.
translation: 血月不过是一种天文现象。我们需要更多背景信息才能得出结论。

english: Cam Torum has no interest in bathing in blood!
translation: 卡姆托鲁姆对沐浴在血中没兴趣！

english: What does the eastern mural depict?
translation: 东边的壁画描绘了什么？

english: An emissary of the eclipsed moon! A herald of Ximoua!
translation: 是蚀月的使者！西莫阿的先驱！

english: Ximoua? It is eating the sun, you fool! If it's a herald of anything, it's death!
translation: 西莫阿？它在吞噬太阳，你这个傻瓜！如果它是什么的先驱，那只能是死亡！

english: Given what is taught about Ximoua, that isn't too surprising.
translation: 考虑到关于西莫阿的教义，这并不太令人惊讶。

english: What is Ximoua again?
translation: 西莫阿是什么来着？

english: An eclipse that marks the end of a cycle! The destruction of the world and its rebirth!
translation: 一场标志着一个周期结束的日食！世界的毁灭与重生！

english: Ah yes, I remember now. Very pleasant.
translation: 啊对，我想起来了。真是令人愉快。

english: Indeed, it is an event we all look forward to. It is said that when it happens, Ralos and Ranul unite all life as one! Can you imagine such an honour?
translation: 确实，这是我们所有人都期待的事件。据说当它发生时，拉洛斯和拉努尔将万物合为一体！你能想象那样的荣耀吗？

english: Maybe we should focus on something else.
translation: 也许我们应该关注别的事情。

english: What does the northern mural depict?
translation: 北边的壁画描绘了什么？

english: A creature snapping a mountain in half. Care to explain this one, Zuma?
translation: 一个生物把山掰成两半。祖玛，你能解释一下这个吗？

english: It's an emissary of the blue moon! Clearly... er... bringing an end to the winter?
translation: 这是蓝月的使者！很明显……呃……终结冬天？

english: Any thoughts on this one, Jess?
translation: 杰斯，你对这个有什么看法？

english: Blue moons are exceedinly rare... They're only seen occasionally during volcanic eruptions. It's possible that this cracking mountain signals the appearance of a volcano.
translation: 蓝月极其罕见……只有在火山爆发时偶尔才能看到。这座开裂的山可能预示着火山的出现。

english: You'll need to make some space for those two talismans [player name].
translation: [player name]，你需要腾出一些空间来放那两个护符。

english: Do you have the enchanted talismans yet?
translation: 你拿到附魔护符了吗？

english: Let Attala know if you need any help.
translation: 如果你需要帮助，告诉阿塔拉。

english: Good job mediating those two.
translation: 调解那两位干得不错。

english: Thanks. It does feel a bit like I'm walking a tightrope over a scorpion nest at times.
translation: 谢谢。有时候感觉就像在蝎子窝上走钢索。

english: Attala might be worse than a pit of scorpions!
translation: 阿塔拉可能比一窝蝎子还可怕！

english: Did I hear my name?
translation: 我好像听到有人叫我名字？

english: Yes! We were just saying how helpful you've been!
translation: 是的！我们刚在说你帮了多大的忙！

english: Quite!
translation: 确实！

english: So how did you end up getting assigned to these ruins?
translation: 那你最后是怎么被派到这些废墟来的？

english: The museum suspected there might be an Old One connection. It's one of my specialties, so exploring these kinds of places is what I do.
translation: 博物馆怀疑这里可能与古神有关。这是我的专长之一，所以探索这类地方就是我的工作。

english: Take the talismans to Nahta in Cam Torum's magic shop. Tell him I sent you.
translation: 把护符带到卡姆托鲁姆的魔法商店给纳赫塔。告诉他是我让你去的。

english: What if I lost them?
translation: 如果我弄丢了怎么办？

english: Then you'll need to find some more yourself, and take better care with them once you have!
translation: 那你就得自己再找一些，找到后要好好保管！

english: Any word on the enchanted talismans?
translation: 附魔护符有消息了吗？

english: I'm afraid you'll need to talk to Attala if you need any help.
translation: 恐怕你需要帮助的话得去找阿塔拉。

english: What lead you to be such a devout follower of Ranul?
translation: 是什么让你成为拉努尔如此虔诚的信徒？

english: Ralos appeals to many who wish to live fast-paced lives.
translation: 拉洛斯吸引了许多想过快节奏生活的人。

english: I do see that appeal, but there is a calmness and peace in Ranul that calls to me.
translation: 我确实理解那种吸引力，但拉努尔有一种宁静与平和在召唤我。

english: Doesn't Ranul govern over death? That doesn't put you off?
translation: 拉努尔不是掌管死亡吗？那不会让你望而却步吗？

english: Making peace with death is one of the things that attracted me to Ranul's teachings.
translation: 与死亡和解正是吸引我接受拉努尔教义的原因之一。

english: That, and all the time I get to spend in nice and quiet libraries.
translation: 还有，我可以在安静舒适的图书馆里度过很多时间。

english: So is this place what you were expecting?
translation: 那么这地方符合你的预期吗？

english: Far more so! As much as Attala refuses to believe it, I think these ruins are connected to Ranul.
translation: 远不止如此！尽管阿塔拉不愿意相信，但我认为这些废墟与拉努尔有关。

english: Is it because of all the moon symbology?
translation: 是因为那些月亮符号吗？

english: That's part of it, but there's also that thing at the centre of this room. Some of the markings remind me of something I once read about.
translation: 这是部分原因，但还有这个房间中央的那个东西。有些标记让我想起了我曾经读到过的东西。

english: Interesting, if a bit vague. Care to elaborate on what it is you read about?
translation: 有意思，虽然有点含糊。能详细说说你读到的是什么吗？

english: I can't really. I'm still not done putting my theory together.
translation: 我说不太清楚。我的理论还没完全成形。

english: Well I look forward to hearing more once you've done so.
translation: 好吧，等你完成了，我很期待听到更多。

english: Actually, I've been sent by Attala.
translation: 其实，是阿塔拉派我来的。

english: Attala? Why's that?
translation: 阿塔拉？为什么？

english: We're trying to find out more about a source of magic in the ruins beneath the city. She asked me to bring some talismans to you.
translation: 我们想查明城市下方废墟中一处魔法来源的更多信息。她让我带一些护符来找你。

english: If she needs me to get involved, then no doubt this is something well beyond your people and probably highly dangerous.
translation: 如果她需要我参与进来，那毫无疑问这事远超你族人的能力范围，而且很可能极其危险。

english: But I suppose if she's okay with that... Go on then, let's have a look.
translation: 但我想既然她同意……那好吧，我们来看看。

english: Er... I seem to have misplaced them.
translation: 呃……我好像把它们弄丢了。

english: Then you'd better go and find them.
translation: 那你最好去找回来。

english: How in the... Where did you get these?
translation: 这到底……你从哪弄来的？

english: Actually, on second thoughts, I'm not sure I want to know.
translation: 算了，转念一想，我也不想知道。

english: There. Now take them to the blacksmith. Tell him they've been enchanted to react to naguanil magic and they need some finishing touches.
translation: 好了。现在把它们拿去给铁匠。告诉他这些护符已经被附魔，会对纳瓜尼尔魔法产生反应，还需要做一些收尾工作。

english: Naguanil? What's that?
translation: 纳瓜尼尔？那是什么？

english: A type of magic your people have forgotten, alongside many other things. I don't have time to catch you up on the history of the word though, so you'll need to learn more somewhere else.
translation: 一种你们族人已经遗忘的魔法，还有很多其他东西也一样。我没时间给你补这个词的历史了，你得去别处了解更多。

english: And I already attuned your talismans. Take them to the blacksmith. Tell him they've been enchanted to react to naguanil magic and they need some finishing touches.
translation: 我已经调校好你的护符了。拿给铁匠。告诉他这些护符已经被附魔，会对纳瓜尼尔魔法产生反应，还需要做一些收尾工作。

english: I think I've lost one of the talismans you gave me.
translation: 我想我弄丢了你给我的一个护符。

english: Well luckily for you, I expected this might happen.
translation: 算你走运，我料到可能会发生这种事。

english: Make some room and I'll get you sorted out.
translation: 腾点地方，我帮你搞定。

english: I think I've lost the talismans you gave me.
translation: 我想我把你给我的护符都弄丢了。

english: You're meant to be in Cam Torum sorting those talismans out. Return here once you have done so.
translation: 你应该在卡姆托伦处理那些护符才对。处理完了再回来这里。

english: I need your help with these talismans.
translation: 我需要你帮忙处理这些护符。

english: I'm sure you could use my help with many things, human, but I'm very busy.
translation: 我相信你需要我帮忙的事多了去了，人类，但我很忙。

english: I was sent by Attala.
translation: 我是阿塔拉派来的。

english: Attala? What's she got to do with you?
translation: 阿塔拉？她跟你有什么关系？

english: We're investigating whether the ruins beneath the city pose any threat to its citizens.
translation: 我们在调查城市下方的废墟是否对其居民构成威胁。

english: Oh... Well I suppose I can help then, as long as you make it quick. What did you say you needed?
translation: 哦……那好吧，只要快点，我可以帮忙。你刚才说需要什么来着？

english: The owner of the magic shop said something about these talismans detecting... aguatil?
translation: 魔法商店的主人说了些关于这些护符能探测……阿瓜蒂尔？

english: Naguanil. Hmm...
translation: 纳瓜尼尔。嗯……

english: Can you help?
translation: 你能帮忙吗？

english: Of course. This sort of magic is child's play. Where are the talismans?
translation: 当然。这种魔法不过是小菜一碟。护符在哪？

english: Er... I seem to have lost them.
translation: 呃……我好像弄丢了它们。

english: Then stop wasting my time!
translation: 那就别浪费我的时间！

english: Of course. This sort of magic is child's play. Give me a moment...
translation: 当然。这种魔法不过是小菜一碟。给我一点时间……

english: All done. Take these back to Attala. She'll tell you what to do with them.
translation: 搞定了。把这些拿回给阿塔拉。她会告诉你怎么处理。

english: Now, get out!
translation: 现在，出去！

english: What do you know about magic? Aren't you a blacksmith?
translation: 你懂魔法？你不就是个铁匠吗？

english: I am one of the Dwarves of Cam Torum, human! Our metalwork and our magic are one. I am an expert in both.
translation: 我是卡姆托伦的矮人之一，人类！我们的金属工艺和魔法是一体的。我两者都是专家。

english: That sounds interesting. Could you teach me how to mix smithing and magic?
translation: 听起来很有趣。你能教我如何将锻造和魔法结合吗？

english: Hah, that's a good joke!
translation: 哈，这笑话不错！

english: Oh... But can you help with the talismans?
translation: 哦……但你能帮忙处理护符吗？

english: I already told you to take them back to Attala. She'll tell you what to do with them.
translation: 我已经告诉过你，把它们拿回给阿塔拉。她会告诉你怎么处理。

english: Humans! You're lucky I prepared for this!
translation: 人类！算你走运，我早有准备！

english: Make some room if you want my help!
translation: 想要我帮忙就腾点地方！

english: I've lost the talismans you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的护符。

english: Yes. I managed to get the dwarves to cooperate for just long enough to make them.
translation: 是的。我好不容易让那些矮人合作，才制成了它们。

english: That's no small feat! You should speak to Attala about it.
translation: 这可不是件小事！你应该跟阿塔拉谈谈。

english: Yes. The dwarves of Cam Torum are quite skilled, so it was relatively quick.
translation: 是的。卡姆托伦的矮人技艺精湛，所以还算快。

english: Hmph! All the skill in the world couldn't make up for their attitude.
translation: 哼！世界上所有技艺都弥补不了他们的态度。

english: I have the enchanted talismans.
translation: 我拿到附魔护符了。

english: Good. Now let's not waste any more time. In theory, the talismans should guide you to the point in this place where these magics of earth and streams resonate most strongly.
translation: 好。现在别再浪费时间了。理论上，这些护符应该能引导你到这个地方中这些大地与溪流魔法共鸣最强烈的点。

english: Of course, we've not tried something like this before, so I imagine it will require you to do some testing.
translation: 当然，我们以前没试过类似的事，所以我想你需要做一些测试。

english: You seem to be well known by the other dwarves in Cam Torum.
translation: 你在卡姆托伦的其他矮人中间似乎很出名。

english: Of course. I am a key advisor to Highlord Katlo himself. Few dwarves hold as much sway as I do. Not just anyone can authorise the entry of a human.
translation: 当然。我本人就是高阶领主卡特洛的关键顾问。没有几个矮人能有我这样的影响力。不是谁都能批准一个人类进入的。

english: I suppose I should thank you for letting me in then.
translation: 我想我应该谢谢你让我进来。

english: Hmph! Don't make me regret it.
translation: 哼！别让我后悔就行。

english: Your friends weren't very happy to see me.
translation: 你的朋友们看到我可不太高兴。

english: That doesn't surprise me. They're busy people with much less patience for humans than I have.
translation: 这并不奇怪。他们都是大忙人，对人类可没我这么多耐心。

english: You have patience for humans?
translation: 你对人类有耐心？

english: Have you managed to find the source of these earth and stream magics yet?
translation: 你找到这些大地与溪流魔法的源头了吗？

english: Remember, the talismans should guide you to the point in this place where these magics resonate most strongly.
translation: 记住，护符应该会引导你到这个地方中这些魔法共鸣最强烈的点。

english: Nilsal, Jess.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，杰斯。

english: How goes the search, [player name]?
translation: 搜索进行得怎么样了，[player name]？

english: Not too bad, thank you.
translation: 还不错，谢谢。

english: Euat xita kemo? Euat iknil?
translation: 埃瓦特 希塔 克莫？埃瓦特 伊克尼尔？

english: A human? Interesting... In that case, allow me to use a language more familiar to you.
translation: 一个人类？有趣……那样的话，请允许我使用一种你更熟悉的语言。

english: Thanks... I think. So who are you?
translation: 谢谢……我想是吧。那么你是谁？

english: I am Eyatlalli, a nagua of earth and streams.
translation: 我是埃亚特拉利，一位大地与溪流的纳瓜。

english: Right... And what is this place?
translation: 好吧……这是什么地方？

english: Neypotzli. A prison.
translation: 内波茨利，一座监狱。

english: A prison? For who? You?
translation: 监狱？关谁的？你？

english: For the Moons of Peril, and their long dead summoner.
translation: 关押灾厄之月，以及它们早已死去的召唤者。

english: Moons of Peril?
translation: 灾厄之月？

english: Yes. Powerful and terrible nagua summoned to wreak havoc.
translation: 是的。强大而可怕的纳瓜被召唤来制造浩劫。

english: Why would anyone want to do that?
translation: 为什么会有人想这么做？

english: In the face of inevitable death, a powerful shaman decided to lash out and inflict death on others.
translation: 面对无法避免的死亡，一位强大的萨满决定奋力反击，将死亡带给他人。

english: Her fellows disagreed with her actions. They created this prison, and they summoned me to watch over it.
translation: 她的同伴们不赞成她的行为。他们建造了这座监狱，并召唤我来看守。

english: The icosahedron...
translation: 那个二十面体……

english: [player name], what's going on?!
translation: [player name]，发生了什么？！

english: I'm not sure!
translation: 我不知道！

english: Hang on... is that...
translation: 等等……那是……

english: I am Eyatlalli, a nagua of-
translation: 我是埃亚特拉利，一位纳瓜——

english: Never mind the introductions, what was that shaking?!
translation: 别管什么介绍了，刚才的震动是怎么回事？！

english: The icosahedron has been disturbed.
translation: 二十面体受到了干扰。

english: The icosa-who?
translation: 二十面……谁？

english: Icosahedron. An object of twenty facets, floating at the centre of this room.
translation: 二十面体。一个拥有二十个面的物体，悬浮在这个房间的中央。

english: Did anybody touch that thing whilst I was gone?
translation: 我不在的时候有人碰了那东西吗？

english: Zuma did something. We were discussing the murals and when we turned around, he was gone!
translation: 祖玛做了点什么。我们正在讨论壁画，等我们转身，他就不见了！

english: I knew I shouldn't have let that fool priest in!
translation: 我就知道不该让那个蠢祭司进来！

english: What does the icosahedron do?
translation: 那个二十面体是做什么的？

english: It is key to the magics that keep the Moons of Peril contained. It reshapes and reweaves the magical seals as the Moons attempt to break them.
translation: 它是维持灾厄之月被封印的魔法的关键。当月亮试图打破封印时，它重塑并重新编织魔法封印。

english: Isn't it a good thing it moved then?
translation: 那么它移动了难道是好事？

english: For it to have moved means that the seals must have needed reshaping. That has not happened for decades.
translation: 它移动意味着封印需要重塑。这已经有几十年没发生过了。

english: Zuma must have done something!
translation: 祖玛一定做了什么！

english: Can we fix it?
translation: 我们能修复它吗？

english: For centuries, the magic used to seal the Moons has been woven into Neypotzli and the creatures that inhabit it.
translation: 几个世纪以来，用于封印月亮的魔法已经编织进了内波茨利监狱和居住其中的生物体内。

english: Naguanil is the magic of nature. A ritual involving the living parts of this place could re-infuse the icosahedron.
translation: 纳瓜尼尔是自然的魔法。一场涉及此地活物的仪式可以重新灌注二十面体。

english: Living parts? As in the animals?
translation: 活的部位？就像那些动物？

english: Yes. Bring me scales of a bream, the tail of a moss lizard and paste made of moonlight grubs. I will begin preparing the rest of the ritual.
translation: 是的。给我带些鲷鱼鳞片、一条苔藓蜥蜴尾巴和用月光幼虫制成的糊状物。我将开始准备仪式的其余部分。

english: The Moons of Peril rage against their bindings. Holding them back is exhausting. Please bring me the bream scales, moss lizard tail and moonlight grub paste from elsewhere in Neypotzli.
translation: 灾厄之月正在激烈冲击它们的封印。压制它们让我筋疲力尽。请你去内波茨利监狱的其他地方，把鲷鱼鳞片、苔藓蜥蜴尾和月光幼虫糊带给我。

english: Where can I find bream?
translation: 我能在哪里找到鲷鱼？

english: They can be fished in the north east section of Neypotzli.
translation: 它们可以在内波茨利监狱的东北区域钓到。

english: Where can I find moss lizards?
translation: 我能在哪里找到苔藓蜥蜴？

english: They can be caught in the north west section of Neypotzli. They'll likely be hiding in the bushes.
translation: 它们可以在内波茨利监狱的西北区域抓到。它们很可能躲在灌木丛里。

english: Where can I find moonlight grubs?
translation: 我能在哪里找到月光幼虫？

english: They can be picked off of the saplings growing all around the north of Neypotzli.
translation: 它们可以从内波茨利监狱北部各处生长的树苗上摘下来。

english: I have the items.
translation: 我拿到这些物品了。

english: Good. Arrange them as follows:
translation: 很好。按如下方式摆放：

english: Place the scales in the shape of the sun at high noon.
translation: 将鳞片摆放成正午太阳的形状。

english: Place the lizard tail beneath it as the earth.
translation: 将蜥蜴尾巴放在它下面，代表大地。

english: Now carve the earth in two with the paste, as the stream carves the earth.
translation: 现在用糊状物将大地一分为二，就像溪流切割大地一样。

english: The ritual is in motion, but the wound to the seal will not close with the Moons still raging against it. I must ask you for one more small favour.
translation: 仪式正在进行，但封印的裂口在月亮仍在猛烈冲击的情况下无法闭合。我必须再请你帮一个小忙。

english: Please, no...
translation: 拜托，别这样……

english: The Moons cannot be killed, but they can be distracted whilst I repair the seal. Enter their chambers here in Neypotzli and engage them in combat.
translation: 这些月亮无法被杀死，但在我修复封印时，可以分散它们的注意力。进入它们在内波茨利监狱的密室，与它们交战。

english: Aren't these things like unstoppable forces of nature or something? Am I going to be alright in there?
translation: 这些家伙难道不是像不可阻挡的自然力量之类的东西吗？我在里面能没事吗？

english: Ordinarily, no. Their mere presence is enough to bring most creatures to an early death. However, you have my help.
translation: 通常情况下不行。它们的存在本身就足以让大多数生物早逝。不过，你有我的帮助。

english: Whilst you fight them, look for my glyphs. They will protect and guide you. If the Moons become too enraged, I will transport you out of their chambers.
translation: 当你与它们战斗时，寻找我的铭文。它们会保护并引导你。如果月亮变得过于狂暴，我会把你传送出它们的密室。

english: Could you remind me what your glyphs look like?
translation: 你能提醒我你的铭文长什么样吗？

english: Here. This is what to look for.
translation: 给你。这就是你要找的样子。

english: What should I expect from the Blood Moon?
translation: 面对血月时我该注意什么？

english: When it starts to rain blood, look to your feet. When the jaguars are summoned, prepare to leap back.
translation: 当它开始下血雨时，注意脚下。当美洲豹被召唤出来时，准备好向后跳。

english: What should I expect from the Blue Moon?
translation: 面对蓝月时我该注意什么？

english: Be prepared to fight without your weapon. Ensure the room's braziers remain lit, for the cold will restore the Moon's strength.
translation: 准备好空手作战。确保房间里的火盆保持点燃，因为寒冷会恢复月亮的力量。

english: What should I expect from the Eclipse Moon?
translation: 面对月蚀时我该注意什么？

english: Ensure it doesn't catch you with your back turned. Make sure to take cover when it fires its searing hot rays.
translation: 确保不要让它从背后攻击你。当它发射灼热的光线时，一定要找掩护。

english: Anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么其他我应该知道的吗？

english: Any time the Moons of Peril inflict pain, they can heal themselves, freeze your joints, or blind your eyes. A defensive approach should be used against them.
translation: 每当灾厄之月造成伤害时，它们可以自我治疗、冻结你的关节或让你失明。对付它们应该采取防御性的策略。

english: The Moons of Peril rage against their bindings. Holding them back is exhausting. Please bring me the moss lizard tail and moonlight grub paste from elsewhere in Neypotzli
translation: 灾厄之月正在激烈冲击它们的封印。压制它们让我筋疲力尽。请你去内波茨利监狱的其他地方，把苔藓蜥蜴尾和月光幼虫糊带给我。

english: The Moons of Peril rage against their bindings. Holding them back is exhausting. Please bring me the moonlight grub paste from elsewhere in Neypotzli.
translation: 灾厄之月正在激烈冲击它们的封印。压制它们让我筋疲力尽。请你去内波茨利监狱的其他地方，把月光幼虫糊带给我。

english: This is quite the dilemma.
translation: 这真是个两难的境地。

english: It is, although I'd be lying if I didn't admit that it is also fascinating.
translation: 确实如此，不过若说我不觉得这也很迷人，那我就是在撒谎。

english: Naguanil magic, ancient spirits of nature... This is the discovery of the century!
translation: 纳瓜尼尔的魔法，古老的自然之灵……这简直是本世纪最伟大的发现！

english: Let's make sure that Cam Torum is safe before we start celebrating.
translation: 在开始庆祝之前，我们先确保卡姆.托鲁姆的安全。

english: After berating you about keeping an eye on the priest, I failed to do the same myself. I was caught up in the mystery.
translation: 在我责备你要看好那个祭司之后，我自己却没能做到。我深陷于这个谜团之中了。

english: Perhaps there's a little human in me after all!
translation: 也许我内心深处还是有那么一点人性吧！

english: It's okay, we'll figure this out.
translation: 没关系，我们会解决的。

english: Thank you, iknil. The Moons are sufficiently distracted. You should now return to me.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。月亮的注意力已经被成功分散了。你现在可以回到我这里来了。

english: I can't believe it... An emissary of my god, standing before me...
translation: 我简直不敢相信……我神的使者，就站在我面前……

english: Zuma, no! Step back!
translation: 祖玛，不！退后！

english: Get out of here!
translation: 快离开这里！

english: Thank you, iknil. Eclipse Moon of Peril is sufficiently distracted. You should now proceed on to the next one.
translation: 谢谢你，伊克尼尔。灾厄之月的月蚀已经被成功分散了注意力。你应该继续前往下一个。

english: I've done everything I need to here. I should check in with Eyatlalli.
translation: 我在这里该做的事都做完了。我应该去看看埃亚特拉利的情况。

english: Did you do it?
translation: 你成功了吗？

english: Good work, [player name]. We made many significant discoveries today, even if it was a bit precarious.
translation: 干得好，[player name]。今天我们有了许多重要的发现，虽然过程有点惊险。

english: Perilous, even.
translation: 甚至可以说是凶险。

english: I'll be sticking around here for some time I reckon. There's still so much to discover in this place. See you around.
translation: 我想我会在这里待上一阵子。这个地方还有太多东西有待发现。回头见。

english: The nagua seems to have relaxed. I assume you were successful?
translation: 纳瓜似乎放松下来了。我猜你成功了吧？

english: You have my gratitude, [player name]. You have helped to ensure Cam Torum's safety. You will always be welcome back.
translation: 我感激不尽，[player name]。你为守护卡姆.托鲁姆的安全做出了贡献。你随时欢迎回来。

english: Something tells me the rest of your people won't be too happy about that.
translation: 我有种感觉，你的族人对这事不会太高兴。

english: Well it's not their choice, so they'll just have to suck it up. Who knows, maybe given long enough, you might start to grow on them!
translation: 哼，这可不是他们说了算的，所以他们只能忍着点。谁知道呢，也许时间长了，他们就开始喜欢上你了！

english: I suppose I should think about heading back to the Teomat. I might not mention everything that happened down here to the others...
translation: 我想我也该考虑回特奥马特修道院了。我可能不会跟其他人提起这里发生的一切……

english: I guess that's understandable.
translation: 我想那也可以理解。

english: I suppose I still have plenty to share. Maybe I'll write a book about it!
translation: 不过我想我还有很多东西可以分享。说不定我会写一本关于它的书呢！

english: I'm sure it will be a great one. Until next time, Zuma.
translation: 我相信那一定会是一本好书。下次再见了，祖玛。

english: You have done well. The seal is repaired, but the Moons have seen a glimpse of freedom. Even now they rage against their bindings. It is... taxing.
translation: 你做得很好。封印已经修复，但那些月亮窥见了一丝自由。即便现在，它们仍在冲击束缚。这……很耗费心神。

english: You could. Distracting them again will afford me some rest. In return, I am willing to repay you with trinkets from ancient times.
translation: 你可以。再次分散它们的注意力能让我获得一些休息。作为回报，我愿意用来自远古时代的小饰品来答谢你。

english: That sounds interesting.
translation: 听起来很有意思。

english: Very well. Come and claim your rewards from the chamber to the south east. Should you aid in containing them again, you can return there to receive more rewards.
translation: 很好。来东南方向的密室领取你的奖励吧。如果你再次帮助压制它们，你可以回到那里领取更多奖励。

english: For now though, thank you for your help, iknil.
translation: 不过现在，还是谢谢你的帮助，伊克尼尔。

english: Now that the situation in the ruins is under control, things are nice and quiet, which is just what we need. That whole business down there got a lot of dwarves riled up.
translation: 既然废墟里的情况已经控制住了，一切平静美好，这正是我们需要的。下面那档子事搞得很多矮人都很紧张。

english: Have ye brought some rum for yer ol' mate Frank?
translation: 你有没有给你老伙计弗兰克带点朗姆酒来？

english: Not surprising, tis no easy task to get it off Karamja.
translation: 不奇怪，想从卡拉姆詹岛弄出来可不容易。

english: The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young lad, I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.
translation: 海关最近对烈酒出口查得很严。你看起来是个机灵的小伙子，我相信你肯定有办法把酒偷偷带过去。

english: Well I'll give it another shot.
translation: 好吧，我再试一次。

english: Search away. I have nothing to hide.
translation: 搜吧。我没什么可隐瞒的。

english: You don't need to look through my things.
translation: 你没必要翻我的东西。

english: Oh, I think I do. If you don't want to let me search your possessions, then you're not coming aboard this ship.
translation: 哦，我觉得我有。如果你不让我搜查你的物品，那你就别想上这艘船。

english: Can I get a job here?
translation: 这里能找份工作吗？

english: Well, you're keen, I'll give you that. Okay, I'll give you a go. Have you got your own white apron?
translation: 嗯，你很积极，这点我承认。好吧，我给你个机会。你有自己的白色围裙吗？

english: Wow - you are well prepared! You're hired. Go through to the back and tidy up for me, please.
translation: 哇——你准备得真充分！你被雇用了。请到后面去帮我收拾一下。

english: You need to put your white apron on first though.
translation: 不过你得先穿上你的白色围裙。

english: Well, you can't work here unless you have a white apron. Health and safety regulations, you understand.
translation: 嗯，没有白色围裙你没法在这里工作。健康和安全规定，你懂的。

english: Where can I get one of those?
translation: 哪里能弄到一条？

english: Well, I get all of mine over at the clothing shop in Varrock. They sell them cheap there.
translation: 嗯，我都是在维洛克城的服装店买的。那里卖得很便宜。

english: Oh, and I'm sure that I've seen a spare one over in Gerrant's fish store somewhere. It's the little place just north of here.
translation: 哦，而且我肯定在杰兰特的鱼店某处见过一条备用的。就是北边那个小店。

english: Hey, you can't go in there. Only employees of the grocery store can go in.
translation: 嘿，你不能进去。只有杂货店的员工才能进。

english: Can you put your white apron on before going in there, please?
translation: 请你在进去之前穿上白色围裙好吗？

english: Hey, you can't go in there. Only emplyees of the grocery store can go in.
translation: 嘿，你不能进去。只有杂货店的员工才能进去。

english: Yes, ofcourse.
translation: 是的，当然。

english: Yes, I've got some.
translation: 是的，我弄到了一些。

english: Arr - this here rum's got a banana stuck in it!
translation: 啊——这朗姆酒里卡了根香蕉！

english: Arr - I don't likes banana in me rum!
translation: 啊——我不喜欢朗姆酒里有香蕉！

english: Now a deal's a deal, I'll tell ye about the treasure. I used to serve under a pirate captain called One-Eyed Hector.
translation: 现在，交易就是交易，我会告诉你宝藏的事。我以前在一个叫独眼赫克托的海盗船长手下干活。

english: Hector were very successful and became very rich. But about a year ago we were boarded by the Customs and Excise Agents.
translation: 赫克托非常成功，变得非常富有。但大约一年前，我们被海关税务官登船检查了。

english: Hector were killed along with many of the crew, I were one of the few to escape and I escaped with this.
translation: 赫克托和许多船员都死了，我是少数逃出来的人之一，我带着这个逃了出来。

english: This be Hector's key. I believe it opens his chest in his old room in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock.
translation: 这是赫克托的钥匙。我相信它能打开他在维洛克城蓝月旅馆旧房间里的宝箱。

english: With any luck his treasure will be in there.
translation: 运气好的话，他的宝藏就在里面。

english: Ok thanks, I'll go and get it.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我这就去拿。

english: So why didn't you ever get it?
translation: 那你为什么从来没去拿过？

english: I'm not allowed in the Blue Moon Inn. Apparently I'm a drunken trouble maker.
translation: 我不被允许进蓝月旅馆。显然我是个爱闹事的酒鬼。

english: Frank, I have some Karamja Rum.
translation: 弗兰克，我有一些卡拉姆詹岛的朗姆酒。

english: I seem to have lost my chest key...
translation: 我好像把我的宝箱钥匙弄丢了……

english: Arr, silly you. Fortunately I took the precaution to have another one made.
translation: 啊，你真笨。幸好我事先留了一手，又配了一把。

english: I have the treasure, would you like a share?
translation: 我拿到宝藏了，你想分一份吗？

english: No [lad/lass], you got it fair and square.
translation: 不，[lad/lass]，你凭本事得到的，公平合理。

english: You enjoy it. It's what Hector would have wanted.
translation: 你好好享用吧。这也是赫克托的心愿。

english: The Customs office has been clampin' down on the export of spirits. You seem like a resourceful young lass, I'm sure ye'll be able to find a way to slip the stuff past them.
translation: 海关一直在打击烈酒出口。你看起来是个机灵的姑娘，我相信你能找到办法把酒偷运过去。

english: I'd like some rum made on Karamja Island. There's no rum like Karamaja Rum!
translation: 我想要一些卡拉姆詹岛酿的朗姆酒。没有比卡拉姆詹朗姆酒更好的了！

english: Well for example if you go and get me a bottle of rum... Not just any rum mind...
translation: 嗯，比如说，如果你去给我弄一瓶朗姆酒……注意，不是随便什么朗姆酒……

english: No lad, you got it fair and square.
translation: 不，小伙子，你赢得光明正大。

english: Not suprising, tis no easy task to get it off Karamja.
translation: 不奇怪，想把它带出卡拉姆詹岛可不容易。

english: No lass, you got it fair and square.
translation: 不，姑娘，你赢得光明正大。

english: Hello old man.
translation: 你好，老人家。

english: Sorry, I can't stop to talk...
translation: 抱歉，我没空停下来聊天……

english: I've got to find my daughter. I pray that she is still alive...
translation: 我得去找我女儿。我祈祷她还活着……

english: What's happened to her?
translation: 她出什么事了？

english: Elena's a healer. Three weeks ago she managed to cross the wall into West Ardougne. No one's allowed to cross the wall in case they spread the plague.
translation: 埃琳娜是个治疗师。三周前，她设法穿过那堵墙进入了西阿多尼城。为了防止瘟疫扩散，任何人都不准穿过那堵墙。

english: Plague?
translation: 瘟疫？

english: Not that long ago, West Ardougne was hit by a deadly plague. They had the wall built to try and keep it contained. No one is allowed to enter the city now apart from the mourners.
translation: 不久前，西阿多尼城爆发了一场致命的瘟疫。他们修建了那堵墙试图控制疫情。现在除了哀悼者，任何人都不准进入那座城市。

english: They say the plague is a horrible way to go... That's why Elena felt she had to go help. She said she'd be gone for a few days but we've heard nothing since.
translation: 他们说染上瘟疫死得很惨……所以埃琳娜才觉得她必须去帮忙。她说她只去几天，但之后就音讯全无了。

english: Maybe I could help find her?
translation: 也许我可以帮忙找到她？

english: Really, would you? I've been working on a plan to get into West Ardougne, but I'm too old and tired to carry it through. But you on the other hand, you should have no problem.
translation: 真的吗，你愿意？我一直在计划进入西阿多尼城，但我太老也太累了，没法完成这个计划。不过你就不一样了，你应该没问题。

english: If you're going into West Ardougne you'll need protection from the plague. My wife made a special gas mask for Elena with dwellberries rubbed into it.
translation: 如果你要去西阿多尼城，你需要防护瘟疫。我妻子为埃琳娜特制了一个防毒面具，上面涂了德维尔莓。

english: They help to repel the plague apparently. We need some more though...
translation: 据说它们能驱散瘟疫。但我们还需要更多……

english: Where can I find these dwellberries?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这些德维尔莓？

english: The only place I know of is McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: 我知道的唯一地方是麦格鲁伯森林，就在先知村西边。浆果是亮蓝色的，很容易发现。

english: Okay, I'll go and get some.
translation: 好的，我去弄一些来。

english: The foresters keep a close eye on it, but there is a back way in.
translation: 护林员看得很紧，但有一条小路可以进去。

english: On second thoughts, I'd better not.
translation: 再想想，我还是不去了。

english: Well if you hear anything about Elena please tell me.
translation: 好吧，如果你听到任何关于埃琳娜的消息，请告诉我。

english: I will. Goodbye.
translation: 我会的。再见。

english: Well, good luck finding her.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运找到她。

english: Hello Edmond.
translation: 你好，埃德蒙。

english: Have you got the dwellberries yet?
translation: 你拿到德维尔莓了吗？

english: Sorry, I'm afraid not.
translation: 抱歉，恐怕还没有。

english: You'll probably find them in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village. The berries are bright blue so they're easy to spot.
translation: 你很可能在先知村西边的麦格鲁伯森林找到它们。浆果是亮蓝色的，很容易发现。

english: Hello, Edmond has asked me to help find your daughter.
translation: 你好，埃德蒙让我帮忙找你的女儿。

english: Yes he told me. I've begun making your special gas mask, but I need some dwellberries to finish it.
translation: 是的，他告诉我了。我已经开始为你制作特制的防毒面具了，但我需要一些德维尔莓来完成它。

english: I'll try to get some.
translation: 我会试着弄一些来。

english: The best place to look is in McGrubor's Wood, just west of Seers' Village.
translation: 最好的地方是先知村西边的麦格鲁伯森林。

english: Yes I've got some here.
translation: 是的，我这里有一些。

english: Take them to my wife Alrena, she's inside.
translation: 把它们带给我妻子阿尔蕾娜，她在里面。

english: There we go, all done. While in West Ardougne you must wear this at all times, or you could catch the plague.
translation: 好了，完成了。在西阿多尼城的时候，你必须一直戴着这个，否则可能会染上瘟疫。

english: I'll make a spare mask for you in case you lose that one. I'll hide it in the cupboard in case the mourners come looking.
translation: 我会为你做一个备用的面具，以防你弄丢那个。我会把它藏在橱柜里，以防哀悼者来搜查。

english: Hello darling, I think Edmond had a good idea of how to get into West Ardougne, you should hear his idea.
translation: 你好，亲爱的，我觉得埃德蒙对如何进入西阿多尼城有个好主意，你应该听听他的想法。

english: Alright, I'll go and see him now.
translation: 好的，我现在就去找他。

english: Hi Edmond, I've got the gas mask now.
translation: 嗨，埃德蒙，我现在有防毒面具了。

english: Good stuff, now for the digging. Beneath us are the Ardougne sewers. I've done some research, and I reckon you can use them to enter West Ardougne.
translation: 好东西，现在该挖了。我们脚下是阿多尼城的下水道。我做过一些研究，我觉得你可以利用它们进入西阿多尼城。

english: I've already tried digging down to them but the soil is rock hard. You'll need to pour on several buckets of water to soften it up. I reckon four buckets should do it.
translation: 我已经试过往下挖了，但土壤硬得像石头。你需要倒上几桶水来软化它。我觉得四桶应该够了。

english: I still need to pour four more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 我还需要在土壤上再倒四桶水。

english: Hello Alrena.
translation: 你好，阿尔蕾娜。

english: Hello darling, how's that tunnel coming along?
translation: 你好，亲爱的，那条隧道挖得怎么样了？

english: I just need to soften the soil and then we'll start digging.
translation: 我只需要软化土壤，然后我们就可以开始挖了。

english: Well I'm sure you're quicker than Edmond.
translation: 嗯，我相信你比埃德蒙快。

english: You and that Edmond fella, you're looking very suspicious.
translation: 你和那个叫埃德蒙的家伙，看起来非常可疑。

english: We're just gardening. Have you heard any news about West Ardougne?
translation: 我们只是在搞园艺。你听到关于西阿多尼城的消息了吗？

english: Just the usual, everyone's sick or dying. I'm furious at King Tyras for bringing this plague to our lands.
translation: 老样子，所有人都病了或快死了。我对泰拉斯国王把这场瘟疫带到我们的土地上感到非常愤怒。

english: I still need to pour three more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 我还需要在土壤上再倒三桶水。

english: I just need to soften the soil a little more and then we'll start digging.
translation: 我只需要再软化一点土壤，然后我们就可以开始挖了。

english: I still need to pour two more buckets of water on the soil.
translation: 我还需要在土壤上再倒两桶水。

english: I still need to pour one more bucket of water on the soil.
translation: 我还需要在土壤上再倒一桶水。

english: I've soaked the soil with water.
translation: 我已经用水把土壤浸透了。

english: That's great, it should be soft enough to dig through now. There should be a spade nearby that you can use.
translation: 太好了，现在应该够软可以挖穿了。附近应该有一把铲子你可以用。

english: Hello again Alrena.
translation: 又见面了，阿尔蕾娜。

english: How's the tunnel going?
translation: 隧道挖得怎么样了？

english: One of the mourners has been sniffing around asking questions about you and Edmond, you should keep an eye out for him.
translation: 有个哀悼者一直在附近打探你和埃德蒙的事，你得提防着他。

english: Also, don't forget about that spare gas mask if you need it. It's hidden in the cupboard.
translation: 还有，别忘了那个备用的防毒面具，如果你需要的话。它藏在橱柜里。

english: Great, thanks Alrena!
translation: 太好了，谢谢阿尔蕾娜！

english: What are you up to with old man Edmond?
translation: 你和老埃德蒙在搞什么鬼？

english: Nothing, we've just been chatting.
translation: 没什么，我们只是聊了聊天。

english: What about his daughter?
translation: 那他女儿呢？

english: Oh, you know about that then?
translation: 哦，那你也知道这事？

english: We know about everything that goes on in Ardougne. We have to if we are to contain the plague.
translation: 阿多尼城发生的一切我们都知道。要控制瘟疫，我们必须如此。

english: Have you see his daughter recently?
translation: 你最近见过他女儿吗？

english: I imagine she's caught the plague. Either way she won't be allowed out of West Ardougne, the risk is too great.
translation: 我猜她染上瘟疫了。不管怎样，她都不准离开西阿多尼城，风险太大了。

english: I think it's the pipe to the south that comes up in West Ardougne.
translation: 我觉得是南边那条管道，它通到西阿多尼城。

english: Alright I'll check it out.
translation: 好的，我去看看。

english: Hi, have you managed to get through to West Ardougne?
translation: 嗨，你成功进入西阿多尼城了吗？

english: Not yet, but I should be going soon.
translation: 还没有，但我应该很快就去了。

english: Make sure you wear your mask while you're over there! I can't think of a worse way to die.
translation: 去那边的时候一定要戴好你的面具！我想不出比这更糟糕的死法了。

english: Don't forget, I've got a spare one hidden in the cupboard if you need it.
translation: 别忘了，如果你需要，我还在橱柜里藏了一个备用的。

english: Been digging have we?
translation: 在挖东西是吧？

english: Your hands are covered in mud.
translation: 你手上全是泥。

english: Oh that...
translation: 哦，这个啊……

english: Funny, you don't look like the gardening type.
translation: 真有趣，你看起来不像喜欢园艺的人。

english: Oh no, I love gardening! It's my favorite pastime.
translation: 哦不，我热爱园艺！这是我最喜欢的消遣。

english: I don't trust you.
translation: 我不信任你。

english: You don't have to.
translation: 你没必要信任我。

english: If I find you attempting to cross the wall I'll make sure you never return.
translation: 如果我发现你试图穿过那堵墙，我保证让你有去无回。

english: I can't let you enter the city without your gas mask on.
translation: 我不能让你不戴防毒面具就进城。

english: Edmond, I can't get through to West Ardougne! There's an iron grill blocking my way, I can't pull it off alone.
translation: 埃德蒙，我进不去西阿多尼城！有个铁栅栏挡住了我的路，我一个人拉不动。

english: If you get some rope you could tie to the grill, then we could both pull it at the same time.
translation: 如果你弄根绳子绑在栅栏上，那我们就可以同时拉了。

english: I've tied a rope to the grill over there, will you help me pull it off?
translation: 我已经把绳子绑在那边那个栅栏上了，你能帮我一起把它拉下来吗？

english: Alright, let's get to it...
translation: 好的，我们开始吧……

english: Once you're in the city look for a man called Jethick. He's an old friend of the family. Hopefully he can help you.
translation: 进城后，找一个叫杰西克的人。他是我们家的老朋友。希望他能帮你。

english: Alright, thanks I will.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我会的。

english: Not yet, it's a big city over there.
translation: 还没呢，那边是个大城市。

english: I hope it's not too late.
translation: 我希望还来得及。

english: Hello, any word on Elena?
translation: 你好，有埃琳娜的消息吗？

english: Not yet I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕还没有。

english: Is there anything else I can do to help?
translation: 还有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: It's alright, I'll get her back soon.
translation: 没关系，我很快就会把她带回来。

english: That's the spirit, dear. Don't forget that there's a spare gas mask in the cupboard if you need one.
translation: 这就对了，亲爱的。别忘了橱柜里有一个备用的防毒面具，如果你需要的话。

english: That's the spirit, dear.
translation: 这就对了，亲爱的。

english: Have you seen a lady called Elena around here?
translation: 你在这附近见过一个叫埃琳娜的女士吗？

english: Yes, I've seen her. Very helpful person.
translation: 是的，我见过她。一个非常乐于助人的人。

english: Not for the last few days though... I thought maybe she'd gone home.
translation: 不过最近几天没见了……我还以为她可能回家了。

english: You should stand up to them more.
translation: 你应该多反抗他们。

english: Oh I'm not one to cause a fuss.
translation: 哦，我不是那种爱惹麻烦的人。

english: The plague of course. Not many people want to come to a place like this and the few that do normally get stopped by the mourners.
translation: 当然是瘟疫了。没多少人愿意来这种地方，少数几个来的通常也会被哀悼者拦住。

english: All you'll find here now are the dead and the dying. Even our own king has abandoned us.
translation: 你现在在这里能找到的只有死人和快死的人。连我们自己的国王都抛弃了我们。

english: Your king?
translation: 你的国王？

english: Yes, King Tyras of West Ardougne. He's the brother of King Lathas, the ruler of East Ardougne.
translation: 是的，西阿多尼城的泰拉斯国王。他是东阿多尼城的统治者拉萨斯国王的兄弟。

english: So where is the king?
translation: 那国王在哪里？

english: Well he's always been a bit of an explorer. He's led multiple expeditions into the uncharted lands to the west.
translation: 嗯，他一直有点探险家的气质。他多次带领探险队前往西边的未知土地。

english: The plague first started when he came back from one of these expeditions. More than a few suspect that some of his men caught it out there and brought it back with them.
translation: 瘟疫最初是在他一次探险回来后爆发的。不少人怀疑他的一些手下在外面染上了病，并带了回来。

english: The king didn't care though. He just left on another expedition to the west. He hasn't been seen since. He left the city warder Bravek in charge but he's no better.
translation: 不过国王并不在意。他只是又出发去西边探险了，之后就再也没人见过他。他把城市交给看守官布拉维克管理，但布拉维克也好不到哪去。

english: Anyway, you clearly didn't come here to talk about kings. So tell me, what brings you to West Ardougne?
translation: 总之，你显然不是来谈论国王的。告诉我，你来西阿多尼城有什么事？

english: I'm looking for a woman from East Ardougne called Elena.
translation: 我在找一个来自东阿多尼城的女人，名叫埃琳娜。

english: East Ardougnian women are easier to find in East Ardougne. Not many would come to West Ardougne to find one. Although the name is familiar, what does she look like?
translation: 东阿多尼城的女人在东阿多尼城更容易找到。很少有人会来西阿多尼城找她们。不过这个名字听起来有点耳熟，她长什么样？

english: Um... brown hair... in her twenties...
translation: 嗯……棕色头发……二十多岁……

english: Hmmm, that doesn't narrow it down a huge amount... I'll need to know more than that, or see a picture?
translation: 嗯，这范围还是太大了……我需要知道更多细节，或者看看照片？

english: Not yet, it's a big city over there. Do you have a picture of Elena?
translation: 还没有，那边城市很大。你有埃琳娜的照片吗？

english: There should be a picture of Elena in the house. Please find her quickly, I hope it's not too late.
translation: 房子里应该有一张埃琳娜的照片。请尽快找到她，希望还来得及。

english: Do you have a picture of Elena?
translation: 你有埃琳娜的照片吗？

english: Yes. There should be one in the house somewhere. Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: 有。房子里应该有一张。如果你还需要别的，告诉我。

english: Hello. We don't get many newcomers around here.
translation: 你好。我们这里很少见到新来的人。

english: Ah yes. She came over here to help the plague victims. I think she is staying over with the Rehnison family.
translation: 啊，是的。她过来帮助瘟疫受害者。我想她住在雷尼森家。

english: They live in the small timbered building at the far north side of town. I've not seen her around here in a while, mind.
translation: 他们住在城镇最北边那栋小木屋里。不过我最近有一阵子没在这附近见到她了。

english: I don't suppose you could run me a little errand while you're over there? I borrowed this book from them, can you return it?
translation: 你过去的时候，能不能帮我个小忙？我从他们那里借了这本书，你能帮我还回去吗？

english: Yes, I'll return it for you.
translation: 好的，我帮你还。

english: No, I don't have time for that.
translation: 不，我没时间做这个。

english: I'm a friend of Jethick's, I have come to return a book he borrowed.
translation: 我是杰西克的朋友，来还他借的一本书。

english: Oh... Why didn't you say, come in then.
translation: 哦……你怎么不早说，进来吧。

english: Thanks, I've been missing that.
translation: 谢谢，我一直想念这本书。

english: Hi, I hear a woman called Elena is staying here.
translation: 你好，我听说一个叫埃琳娜的女人住在这里。

english: Yes she was staying here, but slightly over a week ago she was getting ready to go back. However she never managed to leave.
translation: 是的，她之前住在这里，但大约一周前她准备回去了。然而她一直没能离开。

english: My daughter Milli was playing near the west wall when she saw some shadowy figures jump out and grab her. Milli is upstairs if you wish to speak to her.
translation: 我女儿米莉在西墙附近玩的时候，看到几个黑影跳出来抓住了她。如果你想和她谈谈，米莉在楼上。

english: Hello. Your parents say you saw what happened to Elena...
translation: 你好。你父母说你看到了埃琳娜遭遇的事……

english: *sniff* Yes I was near the south east corner when I saw Elena walking by. I was about to run to greet her when some men jumped out. They shoved a sack over her head and dragged her into a building.
translation: *抽泣* 是的，我当时在东南角附近，看到埃琳娜走过。我正要跑过去跟她打招呼，突然几个男人跳了出来。他们把麻袋套在她头上，把她拖进了一栋建筑。

english: Which building?
translation: 哪栋建筑？

english: It was the boarded up building with no windows in the south east corner of West Ardougne.
translation: 是西阿多尼城东南角那栋用木板封起来、没有窗户的建筑。

english: I wish you luck, she did a lot for us.
translation: 祝你好运，她为我们做了很多。

english: I'd stand away from there. That black cross means that house has been touched by the plague.
translation: 我建议你离远点。那个黑色十字标记意味着那栋房子被瘟疫触碰过。

english: But I think a kidnap victim is in here.
translation: 但我认为里面有一个被绑架的人。

english: Sounds unlikely, even kidnappers wouldn't go in there. Even if someone is in there, they're probably dead by now.
translation: 听起来不太可能，就算是绑匪也不会进去。就算里面有人，现在大概也死了。

english: I want to check anyway.
translation: 我还是想检查一下。

english: You don't have clearance to go in there.
translation: 你没有进入那里的许可。

english: How do I get clearance?
translation: 我怎么才能获得许可？

english: Well you'd need to apply to the head mourner, or I suppose Bravek the city warder.
translation: 嗯，你需要向哀悼者首领申请，或者我想也可以找城市看守官布拉维克。

english: I wouldn't get your hopes up though.
translation: 不过别抱太大希望。

english: I fear not a mere plague.
translation: 区区瘟疫，我无所畏惧。

english: That's irrelevant. You don't have clearance to go in there.
translation: 那不重要。你没有进入那里的许可。

english: No, I'm still looking.
translation: 不，我还在找。

english: I hope you find her. She was nice.
translation: 希望你能找到她。她人很好。

english: I need clearance to enter a plague house. It's in the south east corner of West Ardougne.
translation: 我需要进入一栋瘟疫房子的许可。它在西阿多尼城的东南角。

english: You must be nuts, absolutely not!
translation: 你一定是疯了，绝对不行！

english: There's a kidnap victim inside!
translation: 里面有一个被绑架的人！

english: Well they're as good as dead then, no point in trying to save them.
translation: 那他们跟死了没两样，没必要去救。

english: I've got a gas mask though...
translation: 但我有防毒面具……

english: It's not regulation. Anyway you're not properly trained to deal with the plague.
translation: 那不符合规定。而且你没有经过适当的瘟疫处理训练。

english: How do I get trained?
translation: 我怎么才能接受训练？

english: It requires a strict 18 months of training.
translation: 需要严格的18个月训练。

english: I don't have that sort of time.
translation: 我没有那么多时间。

english: Yes, I'm utterly crazy.
translation: 是的，我完全疯了。

english: You're wasting my time, I have a lot of work to do!
translation: 你在浪费我的时间，我有很多工作要做！

english: Ahh... A new recruit.
translation: 啊……一个新兵。

english: Because all the old members of the guard know to report to the real Head Mourner, not me.
translation: 因为所有老守卫都知道要向真正的哀悼者首领报到，而不是我。

english: No, I am just a front man, our true head is far too busy to deal with the requests of the citizens, so I conduct the day to day business here.
translation: 不，我只是个幌子，我们的真正首领太忙了，没空处理市民的请求，所以这里日常事务由我处理。

english: You should go and report in.
translation: 你应该去报到了。

english: Go away, I'm busy! I'm... Umm... In a meeting!
translation: 走开，我很忙！我在……嗯……开会！

english: I need permission to enter a plague house.
translation: 我需要进入一栋瘟疫房子的许可。

english: Rather you than me! The mourners normally deal with that stuff, you should speak to them. Their headquarters are right near the city gate.
translation: 你去总比我去好！哀悼者通常处理这种事，你应该跟他们谈谈。他们的总部就在城门附近。

english: I'll try asking them then.
translation: 那我试试去问他们。

english: Surely you don't let them run everything for you?
translation: 难道你就让他们替你处理所有事？

english: Well, they do know what they're doing here. If they did start doing something badly Bravek, the city warder, would have the power to override them. I can't see that happening though.
translation: 嗯，他们确实知道自己在做什么。如果他们开始做错事，城市看守官布拉维克有权否决他们。不过我看不太可能发生。

english: Can I speak to Bravek anyway?
translation: 那我能跟布拉维克谈谈吗？

english: This is urgent though! Someone's been kidnapped!
translation: 但这很紧急！有人被绑架了！

english: I'll see what I can do I suppose.
translation: 我想办法看看能做什么吧。

english: Mr Bravek, there's [a man/a lady/someone] here who really needs to speak to you.
translation: 布拉维克先生，这里有[a man/a lady/someone]真的需要跟你谈谈。

english: I suppose they can come in then. If they keep it short.
translation: 那让他们进来吧。不过要简短。

english: Okay, I'll leave him alone.
translation: 好的，我不打扰他了。

english: Do you know when he will be available?
translation: 你知道他什么时候有空吗？

english: Oh I don't know, an hour or so maybe.
translation: 哦，我不知道，大概一个小时左右吧。

english: Bravek will see you now but keep it short!
translation: 布拉维克现在见你，但要简短！

english: Thanks, I won't take much of his time.
translation: 谢谢，我不会占用他太多时间。

english: My head hurts! I'll speak to you another day...
translation: 我头疼！改天再跟你谈……

english: This is really important though!
translation: 但这真的很重要！

english: I can't possibly speak to you with my head spinning like this... I went a bit heavy on the drink again last night. Curse my herbalist, she made the best hang over cures. Darn inconvenient of her catching the plague.
translation: 我头这么晕，实在没法跟你说话……我昨晚又喝多了。诅咒我的草药师，她本来能做出最好的宿醉解药。真倒霉，她染上了瘟疫。

english: You shouldn't drink so much then!
translation: 那你就不该喝那么多！

english: Well positions of responsibility are hard, I need something to take my mind off things... Especially with the problems this place has.
translation: 唉，责任重大的职位很难熬，我需要点东西来分散注意力……尤其是这个地方有这么多问题。

english: I don't think drink is the solution.
translation: 我不认为喝酒是解决办法。

english: I don't feel well enough to have a philosophical discussion about it right now. My head hurts.
translation: 我现在头很疼，没法跟你进行哲学讨论。

english: Do you know what's in the cure?
translation: 你知道解酒药里有什么吗？

english: Hmmm let me think... Ouch! Thinking isn't clever. Ah here, she did scribble it down for me.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哎哟！思考可不是明智之举。啊，这里，她确实给我草草写下来了。

english: Uurgh! My head still hurts too much to think straight. Oh for one of Trudi's hangover cures!
translation: 呃！我头还是太疼，没法清醒思考。哦，真希望能有特鲁迪的解酒药！

english: Try this.
translation: 试试这个。

english: Ooh that's much better! Thanks, that's the clearest my head has felt in a month. Ah now, what was it you wanted me to do for you?
translation: 哦，好多了！谢谢，这是我一个月来头脑最清醒的时候。啊，对了，你刚才想让我帮你做什么来着？

english: I need to rescue a kidnap victim called Elena. She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.
translation: 我需要救一个叫埃琳娜的被绑架者。她被关在一栋瘟疫房子里，我需要进入许可。

english: Well the mourners deal with that sort of thing...
translation: 嗯，哀悼者处理这类事情……

english: Okay, I'll go speak to them.
translation: 好的，我去跟他们谈谈。

english: Is that all anyone says around here?
translation: 这里的人就只会说这句话吗？

english: Well, they know best about plague issues.
translation: 嗯，他们最了解瘟疫问题。

english: Don't you want to take an interest in it at all?
translation: 你难道一点都不想关心一下吗？

english: Nope, I don't wish to take a deep interest in plagues. That stuff is too scary for me!
translation: 不，我不想深入了解瘟疫。那东西对我来说太可怕了！

english: I see why people say you're a weak leader.
translation: 我明白为什么人们说你是个软弱的领导者了。

english: Bah, people always criticise their leaders but delegating is the only way to lead. I delegate all plague issues to the mourners.
translation: 呸，人们总是批评他们的领导者，但委派才是唯一的领导方式。我把所有瘟疫问题都委派给哀悼者。

english: This whole city is a plague issue!
translation: 整个城市都是瘟疫问题！

english: Okay, I'll talk to the mourners.
translation: 好吧，我去跟哀悼者谈谈。

english: They won't listen to me!
translation: 他们不听我的！

english: They say I'm not properly equipped to go in the house, though I do have a very effective gas mask.
translation: 他们说我没有适当的装备进入那房子，不过我确实有一个很有效的防毒面具。

english: Hmmm, well I guess they're not taking the issue of a kidnapping seriously enough. They do go a bit far sometimes.
translation: 嗯，我想他们确实没有认真对待绑架事件。他们有时候确实有点过分。

english: I've heard of Elena, she has helped us a lot... Okay, I'll give you this warrant to enter the house.
translation: 我听说过埃琳娜，她帮了我们很多……好吧，我给你这张进入那栋房子的许可令。

english: Ah now what was it you wanted me to do for you?
translation: 啊，对了，你刚才想让我帮你做什么来着？

english: I need to rescue Elena. She's now a kidnap victim! She's being held in a plague house, I need permission to enter.
translation: 我需要救埃琳娜。她现在被绑架了！她被关在一栋瘟疫房子里，我需要进入许可。

english: I'm okay now, thanks.
translation: 我现在没事了，谢谢。

english: I have a warrant from Bravek to enter here.
translation: 我有布拉维克签发的许可令，可以进去。

english: This is highly irregular. Please wait...
translation: 这太不合规矩了。请稍等……

english: Hey... I've got someone here with a warrant from Bravek, what should we do?
translation: 嘿……我这儿有个人拿着布拉维克的逮捕令，我们该怎么办？

english: Well you can't let them in...
translation: 嗯，你不能让他们进来……

english: Hey get me out of here please!
translation: 嘿，请把我弄出去！

english: I would do but I don't have a key.
translation: 我想帮你，但我没有钥匙。

english: I think there may be one around somewhere. I'm sure I heard them stashing it somewhere.
translation: 我觉得附近某个地方可能有一把。我肯定听到他们把它藏在哪儿了。

english: Have you caught the plague?
translation: 你染上瘟疫了吗？

english: No, I have none of the symptoms.
translation: 没有，我没有任何症状。

english: Strange, I was told this house was plague infected.
translation: 奇怪，我被告知这房子感染了瘟疫。

english: I suppose that was a cover up by the kidnappers.
translation: 我想那是绑架者编造的幌子。

english: Okay, I'll look for it.
translation: 好的，我去找找看。

english: Hi, you're free to go! Your kidnappers don't seem to be about right now.
translation: 嗨，你自由了！你的绑架者现在好像不在附近。

english: Thank you, being kidnapped was so inconvenient. I was on my way back to East Ardougne with some samples, I want to see if I can diagnose a cure for this plague.
translation: 谢谢你，被绑架真是太不方便了。我当时正带着一些样本回东阿多尼城，想看看能不能找到治疗这种瘟疫的方法。

english: Well you can leave via the manhole in the middle of the city.
translation: 你可以通过城市中央的井盖离开。

english: Go and see my father, I'll make sure he adequately rewards you. Now I'd better leave while I still can.
translation: 去见见我父亲，我会确保他给你足够的报酬。现在我最好趁还能走的时候离开。

english: Thank you, thank you! Elena beat you back by minutes. Now I said I'd give you a reward. What can I give you as a reward I wonder? Here take this magic scroll, I have little use for it but it may help you.
translation: 谢谢你，谢谢你！埃琳娜比你早回来几分钟。我说过会给你奖励。我在想给你什么作为奖励好呢？拿着这个魔法卷轴吧，我没什么用，但它可能对你有帮助。

english: Now I'd recommend you go and see Elena. She'll want to thank you herself. She lives in the house opposite ours.
translation: 现在我建议你去见见埃琳娜。她会想亲自感谢你。她就住在我家对面的房子里。

english: Do you have any more of those scrolls?
translation: 你还有更多的卷轴吗？

english: A quest you say? Hmm, what an odd request to make of the king. It's funny you should mention it though, as there is something you can do for me.
translation: 你说任务？嗯，向国王提出这样的请求可真奇怪。不过你提起这个倒挺有趣，因为我正好有件事你可以帮忙。

english: Are you aware of Paterdomus? It's a temple east of here. It stands on the River Salve and guards the only passage into the deadly lands of Morytania.
translation: 你知道帕特多米斯吗？那是东边的一座神庙。它矗立在萨尔维河上，守护着通往致命之地莫利塔尼亚的唯一通道。

english: No, I don't think I know it...
translation: 不，我想我不知道……

english: Hmm, how strange that you don't. Well anyway, it has been some days since last I heard from Drezel, the priest who lives there.
translation: 嗯，你不知道可真奇怪。不过话说回来，我已经好几天没听到住在那里的祭司德雷泽尔的消息了。

english: Be a sport and go make sure that nothing untoward has happened to the silly old codger for me, would you?
translation: 帮个忙，去替我确认一下那个傻老头没出什么事，好吗？

english: Sure. I don't have anything better to do right now.
translation: 当然。我现在也没别的事可做。

english: Many thanks adventurer! I would have sent one of my squires but they wanted payment for it!
translation: 多谢了冒险者！我本想派个侍从去的，但他们居然要报酬！

english: Why do you care about Drezel anyway?
translation: 你为什么会在意德雷泽尔呢？

english: Well, that is a slightly impertinent question to ask of your king, but I shall overlook it this time.
translation: 嗯，向你的国王问这样的问题有点无礼，不过这次我就不计较了。

english: As you are no doubt aware, this kingdom worships Saradomin, the god of wisdom and order. As such, it is a peaceful place to live and prosper.
translation: 你无疑知道，这个王国信奉萨拉多明，智慧与秩序之神。因此，这里是一个和平繁荣的居住地。

english: Paterdomus, the temple where Drezel lives, stands on the eastern border of Misthalin. It guards the only passage into the evil lands of Morytania.
translation: 德雷泽尔居住的神庙帕特多米斯位于米斯萨林的东部边界。它守护着通往邪恶之地莫利塔尼亚的唯一通道。

english: Evil?
translation: 邪恶？

english: Oh yes. Morytania is a fearful place, filled to the brim with accursed servants of the chaos god Zamorak. All of them are terrible, but none more so than the rulers of the region, the vampyres.
translation: 哦是的。莫利塔尼亚是个可怕的地方，充满了混沌之神扎莫拉克的可恶仆从。他们都十分恐怖，但其中最可怕的要数这片区域的统治者——吸血鬼。

english: Thankfully, the sacred River Salve marks a natural border between Misthalin and Morytania. Together, the river and the temple prevent any invasion by the vampyres.
translation: 幸运的是，神圣的萨尔维河划出了米斯萨林和莫利塔尼亚之间的天然边界。河流和神庙共同阻止了吸血鬼的任何入侵。

english: The waters of the river are kept blessed with Saradomin's almighty power. This ensures our defences remain strong, as the vampyres cannot cross such a holy barrier.
translation: 河水一直受到萨拉多明全能力量的祝福。这确保了我们的防御依然坚固，因为吸血鬼无法跨越这样的神圣屏障。

english: Drezel is descended from one of the original Saradominist priests who first blessed the river. His job is to ensure nothing happens to the river that might allow the evil of Morytania to invade this land.
translation: 德雷泽尔是当初首次祝福河水的萨拉多明祭司之一的后裔。他的工作是确保河流不会发生任何可能让莫利塔尼亚的邪恶入侵这片土地的事情。

english: This is the reason why the lack of communication from him bothers me somewhat, although I am sure nobody would dare to try and attack our kingdom!
translation: 这就是他失去联系让我有些担忧的原因，尽管我确信没人敢试图攻击我们王国！

english: Do I get a reward for this?
translation: 我这样做有奖励吗？

english: You will be rewarded in the knowledge that you have done the right thing and assisted the king of Misthalin.
translation: 你的回报就是知道自己做了正确的事，并帮助了米斯萨林的国王。

english: Soooooo...... that would be a 'no' then?
translation: 所……所以那就是‘没有’咯？

english: Who's Drezel?
translation: 德雷泽尔是谁？

english: Drezel is the priest who lives at Paterdomus, the temple to the east. You're supposed to be making sure that nothing bad has happened to him. Remember?
translation: 德雷泽尔是住在东边帕特多米斯神庙的祭司。你应该去确认他没有出事的。记得吗？

english: Ooooooooh, THAT Drezel. Yup, I remember.
translation: 哦～～～～那个德雷泽尔啊。是的，我记得。

english: No. That sounds boring.
translation: 不。听起来很无聊。

english: Yes, I dare say it does. I wouldn't even have mentioned it had you not seemed to be looking for something to do anyway.
translation: 是的，我敢说确实无聊。要不是你看起来反正也在找事情做，我根本不会提。

english: You have news of Drezel for me?
translation: 你有德雷泽尔的消息要告诉我？
