english: Where am I supposed to go again?
translation: 我该去哪里来着？

english: The temple of Paterdomus where Drezel lives. It is but a short journey east from here. It lies south of the cliffs, at the source of the River Salve.
translation: 德雷泽尔居住的帕特多米斯神庙。从这儿往东走不远就到了。它在悬崖南边，萨尔维河的源头。

english: Don't worry, you can't miss it.
translation: 别担心，你一定会找到的。

english: Ummmm.....
Roald sent me to check on Drezel.
translation: 罗尔德派我来看看德雷泽尔。

english: Psst... Hey... Who's Roald? Who's Drezel?
translation: 嘘……嘿……罗尔德是谁？德雷泽尔是谁？

english: Uh... Isn't Drezel that dude upstairs? Oh, wait, Roald's the king of Misthalin right?
translation: 呃……德雷泽尔不是楼上那家伙吗？哦等等，罗尔德是米斯萨林的国王对吧？

english: He is? Aww man...
translation: 他是？啊，天啊……

english: Hey, you deal with this okay.
translation: 嘿，你来处理这个，行吧。

english: He's just coming! Wait a second!
translation: 他马上就来了！等一下！

english: Hello, my name is Drevil.
translation: 你好，我叫德雷维尔。

english: Drezel!
translation: 德雷泽尔！

english: I mean Drezel. How can I help?
translation: 我是说德雷泽尔。有什么能帮你的？

english: Well, as I say, the king sent me to make sure everything's okay with you.
translation: 嗯，就像我说的，国王派我来确认你一切安好。

english: And, uh, what would you do if everything wasn't okay with me?
translation: 那么，呃，如果我不是一切安好，你会怎么做？

english: I'm not sure. Ask you what help you need I suppose.
translation: 我不确定。大概会问你需不需要帮助吧。

english: Ah, good, well, I don't think...
translation: 啊，很好，嗯，我觉得不……

english: Psst... Hey... The dog!
OH! Yes, of course!
translation: 哦！是的，当然！

english: Will you do me a favour, adventurer?
translation: 你能帮我个忙吗，冒险者？

english: Sure. I'm a helpful person!
translation: 当然。我可是乐于助人的人！

english: HAHAHAHA! Really? Thanks buddy! You see that mausoleum out there? There's a horrible big dog underneath it that I'd like you to kill for me! It's been really bugging me! Barking all the time and stuff!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！真的？谢谢哥们！你看到那边的陵墓了吗？下面有只可怕的大狗，我想让你帮我杀了它！它一直在烦我！整天叫个不停什么的！

english: Please kill it for me buddy!
translation: 拜托帮我杀了它，哥们！

english: Okey-dokey, one dead dog coming up.
translation: 好嘞，一只死狗马上到。

english: Nope. Something about all this is very suspicious...
translation: 不。这事儿有点可疑……

english: Get lost then! I have important things to do, as sure as my name is Dibzil.
translation: 那就滚吧！我有重要的事要做，我敢保证，就像我叫迪布齐尔一样。

english: Drezel. Now, go away!
translation: 德雷泽尔。现在，走开！

english: Hi, I just moved in next door.
translation: 嗨，我刚搬到隔壁。

english: Can I borrow a cup of coffee?
translation: 能借杯咖啡吗？

english: What next door? What's coffee? Who ARE you?
translation: 什么隔壁？什么是咖啡？你到底是谁？

english: I hear this place is of historic interest.
translation: 我听说这地方有历史意义。

english: Can I come in and have a wander around? Possibly look at some antiques or buy something from your gift shop?
translation: 我能进来逛逛吗？也许看看古董，或者从你的礼品店买点什么？

english: Pssst... Hey... Is this place of historic interest?
translation: 嘘……嘿……这地方有历史意义吗？

english: I dunno. I guess it might be. Does it matter?
translation: 我不知道。也许吧。重要吗？

english: Clear off! You can't come in!
translation: 走开！你不能进来！

english: The council sent me to check your pipes.
translation: 议会派我来检查你的管道。

english: They did? Ummm....
translation: 他们派了？嗯……

english: Psst... Are there any pipes in here, you reckon?
translation: 嘘……你觉得这里面有管道吗？

english: I dunno... I don't think so...
translation: 我不知道……我觉得没有……

english: We don't have any thanks! Bye!
translation: 我们没有管道，谢谢！再见！

english: Nothing. Never mind.
translation: 没什么。算了。

english: SHHHH! It's the adventurer!
translation: 嘘！是那个冒险者！

english: Ah! I want you to go kill the horrible dog in the mausoleum for me! You can use the entrance out there.
translation: 啊！我要你去帮我杀了陵墓里那只可怕的狗！你可以用那边的入口。

english: You'll do this for good old Delzig, won't ya buddy?
translation: 你会为老好人德尔齐格做的，对吧，哥们？

english: *cough* for good old Drezel, right buddy?
translation: 咳咳……是为老好人德雷泽尔，对吧，哥们？

english: Excuse me...oh, wait, I thought you were someone else.
translation: 打扰一下……哦等等，我以为你是别人。

english: Hmmm... From the looks of things, it seems as though somebody has been trying to force this gate open. It's still securely locked however.
translation: 嗯……从情况来看，似乎有人试图强行打开这扇门。不过门还是锁得很牢。

english: About that job I'm doing...
translation: 关于我正在做的那个任务……

english: Well... I went to the temple like you asked me to... and I spoke to someone inside...
translation: 嗯……我照你的要求去了神庙……和里面的一个人说了话……

english: Ah, well that must have been Drezel then. What did he say?
translation: 啊，那一定是德雷泽尔了。他说了什么？

english: Well... he seemed to be having some kind of trouble. He asked for my help.
translation: 嗯……他好像遇到了什么麻烦。他向我求助。

english: Well I expect you to offer him your full assistance in whatever he needs.
translation: 嗯，我希望你全力协助他，无论他需要什么。

english: Well... okay then.
translation: 嗯……那好吧。

english: There we go, one dead dog. I should go and tell Drezel.
translation: 搞定了，一只死狗。我应该去告诉德雷泽尔。

english: You again? What do you want now?
translation: 又是你？现在想要什么？

english: I killed that dog for you.
translation: 我为你杀了那只狗。

english: Really? Hey, that's great!
translation: 真的？嘿，太好了！

english: Yeah thanks a lot buddy!
translation: 是啊，太谢谢了，哥们！

english: HAHAHAHAHAHA!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: Nothing buddy! We're just so grateful!
translation: 没什么，哥们！我们只是太感激了！

english: Yeah, maybe you should go tell the king what a great job you did buddy!
translation: 是啊，也许你应该去告诉国王你干得多棒，哥们！

english: Yes, I spoke to the guys at the temple. They said they were being bothered by a dog in the mausoleum, so I went and killed it for them. No problem.
translation: 是的，我和神庙里那些人说过话了。他们说陵墓里有只狗在烦他们，所以我就去把狗杀了。没问题。

english: YOU DID WHAT???
translation: 你做了什么？？？

english: Are you a complete imbecile?
translation: 你是个彻头彻尾的白痴吗？

english: That mausoleum contains the only passage between Morytania and Misthalin! Not only that, it's built right over the source of the River Salve!
translation: 那座陵墓藏着莫利塔尼亚和米斯萨林之间的唯一通道！不仅如此，它还建在萨尔维河的源头之上！

english: Did I make a mistake?
translation: 我犯错了？

english: YES YOU DID!!!!! Without that 'dog', there's nothing to stop someone from entering the mausoleum to sabotage the blessings on the river. Thanks to you, all of Misthalin is now at risk!
translation: 是的你犯了！！没有那只‘狗’，就没有什么能阻止有人进入陵墓破坏河流上的祝福。拜你所赐，整个米斯萨林现在都处于危险之中！

english: B-but... Drezel told me to...
translation: 但……但……德雷泽尔让我……

english: No, you absolute cretin! Obviously some fiend has done something to Drezel and tricked your feeble intellect into helping them kill that guard dog!
translation: 不，你这个十足的蠢货！显然有个恶魔对德雷泽尔做了些什么，然后利用你那可怜的智力帮你杀死了那只看门狗！

english: Now you get back there and do whatever is necessary to safeguard the kingdom from attack, or I will see you beheaded for high treason!
translation: 现在你给我回到那儿去，做任何必要的事来保护王国免受攻击，否则我会以叛国罪将你斩首！

english: Y-yes your highness.
translation: 是……是的，殿下。

english: Why haven't you ensured the border with Morytania is secure yet?
translation: 你为什么还没确保与莫利塔尼亚的边界安全？

english: Okay, okay... I'm going, I'm going... There's no need to shout...
translation: 好吧，好吧……我走，我走……没必要喊……

english: NO NEED TO SHOUT???
translation: 没必要喊？？？

english: Listen, and listen well, and see if your puny mind can comprehend this: if the border is not protected, then we are all at the mercy of the vampyres!
translation: 听好了，仔细听着，看看你那渺小的脑子能不能理解：如果边境得不到保护，我们都将任由吸血鬼宰割！

english: I would say that me shouting at you for your incompetence is the LEAST of your worries right now. NOW GO!
translation: 要我说，我现在冲你吼你无能，已经是你最不用担心的事了。现在，给我滚！

english: It sounds like there's something alive inside it. I don't think it would be a very good idea to open it...
translation: 听起来里面好像有活物。我觉得打开它可不是什么好主意……

english: Oh! You do not appear to be one of those Zamorakians who imprisoned me! Who are you and why are you here?
translation: 哦！你看起来不像那些把我关起来的萨莫拉克教徒！你是谁，为什么来这里？

english: My name's [player name]. King Roald sent me to find out what was going on at the temple. I take it you are Drezel?
translation: 我叫[player name]。罗尔德国王派我来查明神殿里发生了什么。我猜你就是德雷泽尔吧？

english: That's right! Oh, praise be to Saradomin! All is not yet lost!
translation: 没错！哦，赞美萨拉多明！一切还没有完蛋！

english: I feared that when those Zamorakians attacked this place and imprisoned me up here, Misthalin would be doomed!
translation: 我担心当那些萨莫拉克教徒袭击这个地方，把我关在这里的时候，米斯萨林就注定要完蛋了！

english: If they should manage to desecrate the holy River Salve, we will be defenceless against the vampyres of Morytania!
translation: 如果他们成功亵渎了神圣的萨尔维河，我们将无法抵御来自莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼！

english: Why is the river such a good defence?
translation: 为什么这条河是这么好的防御屏障？

english: I'm not sure if this is the best time for a history lesson. I suppose I can give you a brief overview though. It might help you understand our next steps.
translation: 我不确定现在是不是上历史课的好时机。不过我想我可以给你简单讲一下。这也许能帮你理解我们下一步该做什么。

english: It is said that many years ago, the land that is now Morytania was a peaceful Saradominist kingdom. Alas, all that ended when the vampyres invaded, claiming the land as their own.
translation: 据说很多年前，现在莫利塔尼亚这片土地曾是一个和平的萨拉多明王国。唉，这一切都在吸血鬼入侵并宣称这片土地归他们所有时结束了。

english: Morytania wasn't enough for them though. Soon, they set their sights on these lands as well.
translation: 不过，莫利塔尼亚对他们来说还不够。很快，他们又把目光投向了这片土地。

english: Misthalin would have quickly fallen to the vampyres, were it not for the bravery of the Seven Priestly Warriors.
translation: 如果不是七位祭司勇士的英勇奋战，米斯萨林早就落入吸血鬼之手了。

english: They led the armies of Misthalin against the vampyres in a great battle that took place right where this temple stands.
translation: 他们率领米斯萨林的军队，就在这座神殿矗立的地方，与吸血鬼展开了一场大战。

english: For ten days and nights they fought, never sleeping, never eating, fuelled by their desire to make the world a better place for humans to live.
translation: 他们战斗了十天十夜，不眠不休，不饮不食，只凭着一股让世界更适合人类居住的渴望支撑着。

english: On the eleventh day they were to be joined by reinforcements. However, when those reinforcements arrived, they found the Seven Priestly Warriors and their forces had been slain by the vampyres.
translation: 到了第十一天，本应有援军与他们汇合。然而，当援军到达时，他们发现七位祭司勇士及其部队已被吸血鬼杀害。

english: Their sacrifice was not in vain though. Before they were defeated, the Seven Priestly Warriors managed to bless the Salve with the holy power of Saradomin.
translation: 不过，他们的牺牲并非徒劳。在被击败之前，七位祭司勇士成功用萨拉多明的神圣力量祝福了萨尔维河。

english: Their blessings remain to this day, ensuring no vampyre can cross the river.
translation: 他们的祝福延续至今，确保没有吸血鬼能渡过这条河。

english: The temple here was built soon after. It guards the source of the River Salve, and acts as the only passage between Misthalin and Morytania.
translation: 这座神殿不久后便建成了。它守护着萨尔维河的源头，也是连接米斯萨林和莫利塔尼亚的唯一通道。

english: Once the temple was complete, the bodies of the Seven Priestly Warriors were laid to rest in tombs of honour in the mausoleum below. On the top of each tomb, a golden gift was placed as a mark of respect.
translation: 神殿建成后，七位祭司勇士的遗体被安葬在下方陵墓的荣誉墓穴中。每座墓穴的顶部都放置了一件金色礼物，以示敬意。

english: A great statue was also built over the river, so that all who might try and cross into Misthalin would know that these lands are protected by Saradomin himself.
translation: 河上还建起了一座巨大的雕像，让所有试图进入米斯萨林的人都知道，这片土地受到萨拉多明本人的庇护。

english: Okay, I can see how the river protects the border. Where do these Zamorakians fit in though?
translation: 好吧，我明白这条河是如何保护边界的了。但那些萨莫拉克教徒又是怎么回事？

english: Well, as much as it saddens me to say so adventurer, Lord Saradomin's presence has not been felt on the land for many years now.
translation: 唉，冒险者，虽然我很不愿意这么说，但萨拉多明主神的气息已经很多年没有在这片土地上显现了。

english: Of course, while we know that he still watches over us, his power here is not as strong as it once was.
translation: 当然，虽然我们知道他仍在注视着我们，但他在这里的力量已不如从前那般强大。

english: I fear this group of Zamorakians intends to take advantage of that. If they can somehow pollute the Salve, the blessings on the river might fail.
translation: 我担心这群萨莫拉克教徒打算利用这一点。如果他们能以某种方式污染萨尔维河，河上的祝福可能会失效。

english: If that happens, there won't be anything to stop an invasion from Morytania.
translation: 如果发生这种情况，将没有任何东西能阻止来自莫利塔尼亚的入侵。

english: So what do you say adventurer? Will you aid me and all of Misthalin in foiling this Zamorakian plot?
translation: 那么，冒险者，你怎么说？你愿意帮助我和整个米斯萨林挫败萨莫拉克教徒的阴谋吗？

english: Thank you, adventurer. There is a well in the mausoleum beneath the temple that provides direct access to the source of the Salve. That will be where the Zamorakians will attempt their sabotage.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者。神殿下方的陵墓里有一口井，可以直接通往萨尔维河的源头。那将是萨莫拉克教徒试图破坏的地方。

english: We need to get to that well. However, the immediate problem is that I'm trapped in this cell.
translation: 我们需要到达那口井。然而，眼前的问题是我被困在这个牢房里了。

english: The key must be somewhere nearby. One of the Zamorakians might have it, or they might have hidden it somewhere. That's not the only problem though.
translation: 钥匙一定在附近某个地方。可能在一个萨莫拉克教徒身上，也可能被他们藏在了什么地方。不过，这还不是唯一的问题。

english: What else is there?
translation: 还有什么问题？

english: When the Salve was blessed, a small number of vampyres were left trapped on this side of it. They were heavily weakened, but still posed a dangerous threat.
translation: 当萨尔维河被祝福时，少数吸血鬼被困在了河的这边。他们虽然力量被大大削弱，但仍然构成危险的威胁。

english: This coffin here contains one of those vampyres. The Zamorakians somehow found it and brought it here with them.
translation: 这里的这口棺材里就装着其中一个吸血鬼。萨莫拉克教徒不知怎么找到了它，并把它带到了这里。

english: I see. It doesn't seem to be posing a threat right now though.
translation: 我明白了。不过它现在似乎没有构成威胁。

english: No, but as those fiendish Zamorakians pointed out to me with delight, as I am the descendant of one of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the river, it will likely recognise the smell of my blood.
translation: 不，但正如那些邪恶的萨莫拉克教徒得意洋洋地向我指出的那样，因为我是祝福了这条河的七位祭司勇士之一的后裔，它很可能会认出我血液的气味。

english: If I get too close, it will probably wake up and kill me, very slowly and painfully.
translation: 如果我靠得太近，它很可能会醒来，然后非常缓慢而痛苦地杀死我。

english: Maybe I could kill it somehow?
translation: 也许我可以想办法杀了它？

english: No adventurer, you should not risk waking it. Even now, it could pose a huge threat.
translation: 不，冒险者，你不应该冒险唤醒它。即使现在，它也可能构成巨大的威胁。

english: The priests of old would incapacitate trapped vampyres with the blessings of Saradomin. I suggest you do the same.
translation: 古代的祭司会用萨拉多明的祝福来制服被困的吸血鬼。我建议你也这么做。

english: Right. So, I need to find the key to your cell and do something about the vampyre. Got it.
translation: 好的。那么，我需要找到你牢房的钥匙，并对付那个吸血鬼。明白了。

english: Oooooh... I knew it was too good to be true... Then leave me to my fate villain, there's no need to taunt me as well as keeping me imprisoned.
translation: 哦……我就知道这好事好得不像真的……那就把我留给命运吧，恶棍，把我关起来就够了，没必要还来嘲弄我。

english: Well, let's just say if we cannot undo whatever damage has been done here, the entire land is in grave peril!
translation: 嗯，这么说吧，如果我们不能挽回这里造成的任何破坏，整个大陆都将面临巨大危险！

english: How goes it adventurer? Any luck in finding the key to the cell or a way of stopping the vampyre yet?
translation: 怎么样了，冒险者？找到牢房钥匙或者对付吸血鬼的方法了吗？

english: Well don't give up adventurer! That key must be around here somewhere! I know none of those Zamorakians ever got very far from this building!
translation: 别放弃，冒险者！钥匙一定就在这附近！我知道那些萨莫拉克教徒没有一个能跑出这座建筑多远！

english: I could hear them laughing about some gullible fool that they tricked into killing the guard dog at the monument.
translation: 我能听到他们嘲笑某个容易上当的傻瓜，他们骗那个傻瓜杀死了纪念碑那儿的看门狗。

english: Honestly, what kind of idiot would go around killing things just because a stranger told them to? What kind of oafish, numb-skulled, dim-witted...
translation: 说真的，什么样的白痴会仅仅因为一个陌生人让他们去杀就去杀东西？这是哪种愚笨、迟钝、弱智的……

english: Okay, okay, I get the picture!
translation: 好了，好了，我明白了！

english: Could you tell me more about this temple?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于这座神殿的事吗？

english: Thank you for the information. I'll get going.
translation: 谢谢你的信息。我这就去办。

english: I do indeed, sire. He has been imprisoned by some Zamorakian monks.
translation: 陛下，确实如此。他被一些萨莫拉克教徒囚禁了。

english: What? This is wholly unacceptable! I order you to do all that you can to free Drezel immediately!
translation: 什么？这完全不能接受！我命令你尽一切可能立即释放德雷泽尔！

english: I was doing that anyway.
translation: 我本来就在做这件事。

english: Ah, I see. In that case keep up the good work.
translation: 啊，我明白了。那就继续保持，干得好。

english: I have this key I took from one of those Zamorakian monks!
translation: 我有这把钥匙，是从一个萨莫拉克教徒身上拿到的！

english: Excellent work adventurer! Quickly, try it on the door, and see if it will free me!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！快，在门上试试，看能不能把我放出来！

english: You know... I think I'd rather keep the valuable solid gold hammer.
translation: 你知道吗……我觉得我还是留着这把值钱的纯金锤子比较好。

english: You know... I think I'd rather keep the valuable solid gold pot.
translation: 你知道吗……我觉得我还是留着这个值钱的纯金罐子比较好。

english: You know... I think I'd rather keep the valuable solid gold feather.
translation: 你知道吗……我觉得我还是留着这根值钱的纯金羽毛比较好。

english: You know... I think I'd rather keep the valuable solid gold tinderbox.
translation: 你知道吗……我觉得我还是留着这个值钱的纯金火绒盒比较好。

english: You know... I think I'd rather keep the valuable solid gold needle.
translation: 你知道吗……我觉得我还是留着这根值钱的纯金针比较好。

english: You know... I think I'd rather keep the valuable solid gold candle.
translation: 你知道吗……我觉得我还是留着这根值钱的纯金蜡烛比较好。

english: I think this key is more useful to me right now than the Golden key is.
translation: 我觉得现在这把钥匙比金色钥匙对我更有用。

english: I have this key I took from one of the monuments underground.
translation: 我有这把钥匙，是从地下的一个纪念碑里拿到的。

english: Oh! Thank you! You have found the key!
translation: 哦！谢谢你！你找到钥匙了！

english: The key fit the lock! You're free to leave now!
translation: 钥匙插进锁里了！你现在自由了！

english: Excellent work, adventurer! Unfortunately, as you know, I cannot risk waking the vampyre in that coffin.
translation: 干得好，冒险者！不幸的是，如你所知，我不能冒险唤醒棺材里的那个吸血鬼。

english: Do you have any ideas about dealing with the vampyre?
translation: 你有什么对付吸血鬼的办法吗？

english: Well, the water of the Salve should still have enough power to work against the vampyre, even if the Zamorakians have desecrated it.
translation: 嗯，即使萨莫拉克教徒亵渎了萨尔维河，它的水应该仍有足够的力量来对付那个吸血鬼。

english: Maybe you should try and get hold of some?
translation: 也许你应该试着弄到一些？

english: Have you freed Drezel yet?
translation: 你释放德雷泽尔了吗？

english: Well, I found the key to his cell and unlocked it, but there's a vampyre in there stopping him leaving.
translation: 嗯，我找到了他牢房的钥匙并打开了锁，但那里有个吸血鬼阻止他离开。

english: A vampyre? Well, I order you to do something about it at once!
translation: 一个吸血鬼？好吧，我命令你立刻想办法解决它！

english: Yeah, I was planning on doing that anyway.
translation: 是啊，我本来就打算这么做的。

english: Good work! Always a place for quick thinkers in my kingdom!
translation: 干得好！我的王国里总有位置留给思维敏捷的人！

english: I don't think pouring normal water on the coffin is going to help...
translation: 我觉得把普通的水倒在棺材上可没什么用……

english: This water doesn't look particularly holy to me... I think I'd better check with Drezel first.
translation: 这水在我看来并不特别神圣……我想最好还是先和德雷泽尔确认一下。

english: I have some water from the Salve. It seems to have been desecrated though. Do you think you could bless it for me?
translation: 我弄到了一些萨尔维河的水。不过它似乎被亵渎了。你能帮我祝福它吗？

english: Yes, good thinking adventurer! Give it to me, I will bless it!
translation: 好的，好主意，冒险者！把它给我，我来祝福它！

english: I have some blessed water from the Salve in this bucket. Do you think it will help against that vampyre?
translation: 我桶里有一些来自萨尔维河的圣水。你觉得这对付那个吸血鬼有用吗？

english: Yes! Great idea! If his coffin is doused in the blessed water he will be unable to leave it! Use it on his coffin, quickly!
translation: 是的！好主意！如果他的棺材被圣水浸透，他就无法离开棺材了！快用它泼棺材！

english: The vampyre should be dealt with. I'd still best not risk it though.
translation: 那个吸血鬼应该被处理掉了。不过我还是最好别冒险。

english: Yes sire.
translation: 是的，陛下。

english: Aha! Good work adventurer! What news of the border defences against Morytania?
translation: 啊哈！干得好，冒险者！针对莫利塔尼亚的边界防御有什么消息吗？

english: I, uh, don't know about that...
translation: 我，呃，还不知道……

english: Well get back and find out at once! This is a matter of national security and if I find out we are vulnerable I will hold you personally responsible!
translation: 那就马上回去查清楚！这是国家安全问题，如果我发现我们处于易受攻击的状态，我将追究你的个人责任！

english: I poured the blessed water over the coffin. I think that should trap the vampyre in there long enough for you to escape.
translation: 我把圣水倒在了棺材上。我想这应该能把吸血鬼困在里面足够久，让你逃脱。

english: Excellent work adventurer! I am free at last! Let me ensure that evil vampyre is trapped for good. I will then meet you down in the mausoleum.
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我终于自由了！让我确保那个邪恶的吸血鬼被永远困住。然后我会在下面的陵墓里和你碰面。

english: I just need to ensure this vampyre is trapped. I will meet you down in the mausoleum.
translation: 我只需要确保这个吸血鬼被困住。我会在下面的陵墓里和你碰面。

english: Have you ensured Misthalin's border is fully secured?
translation: 你确保米斯萨林的边界完全安全了吗？

english: Not yet. I'm working on it though.
translation: 还没有。不过我正在努力。

english: Can't I go through there?
translation: 我不能从那里过去吗？

english: No, you cannot! It is taking all of my willpower to hold that barrier in place. You must restore the sanctity of the Salve as soon as possible!
translation: 不，你不能！我正用尽全部意志力来维持那道屏障。你必须尽快恢复萨尔维河的神圣性！

english: Ah, [player name]. Glad you made it. Things are worse than I feared down here. I'm not sure if I will be able to repair the damage.
translation: 啊，[player name]。很高兴你来了。这里的情况比我担心的还要糟糕。我不确定我是否能修复这个损害。

english: Why, what's happened?
translation: 为什么，发生了什么？

english: Sadly, with the guard dog gone, there was nothing to stop those Zamorakians from entering the mausoleum. From what I can tell, they have used some kind of evil potion to pollute the Salve.
translation: 可悲的是，看门狗死了，没有什么能阻止那些萨莫拉克教徒进入陵墓。据我所知，他们使用了某种邪恶的药水来污染萨尔维河。

english: The well here is built right over the source of the river. That means that their potion will spread all the way down the Salve, disrupting the blessings placed upon it.
translation: 这里的井正好建在河流的源头之上。这意味着他们的药水会沿着萨尔维河一路扩散，破坏施加在河上的祝福。

english: Before long, there will be nothing to stop the vampyres from invading Misthalin at their leisure.
translation: 用不了多久，就没有什么能阻止吸血鬼随意入侵米斯塔林了。

english: What can we do to prevent that?
translation: 我们能做些什么来阻止这一切？

english: This passage is currently the only route between Morytania and Misthalin. The barrier here draws power from the river.
translation: 这条通道目前是莫利塔尼亚和米斯萨林之间的唯一路线。这里的屏障从河流中汲取力量。

english: I have managed to reinforce the barrier, but I must continue focussing on it to keep it intact. Although the passage is safe for now, I do not know how long I can keep it that way.
translation: 我设法加固了屏障，但我必须持续集中精力才能保持它完好无损。虽然这条通道目前是安全的，但我不知道我能维持多久。

english: This passage could be the least of our worries soon though. Before long, the vampyres will be able to cross at any point of the river. We won't be able to reinforce all of it.
translation: 不过，这条通道可能很快就不再是我们最大的担忧了。用不了多久，吸血鬼就能在河的任何地方渡河。我们不可能加固整条河岸。

english: Couldn't you bless the river to purify it? Like you did with the water I took from the well?
translation: 你不能祝福这条河来净化它吗？就像你对我从井里取来的水做的那样？

english: No, that would not work. The power I have from Saradomin is not great enough to cleanse an entire river of this foul Zamorakian pollutant.
translation: 不，那行不通。我从萨拉多明获得的力量不足以净化整条河中被这种邪恶的萨莫拉克污染物污染的水。

english: However, I do have one other idea.
translation: 不过，我还有一个主意。

english: I believe we might be able to soak up the evil magic that the potion has released into the river.
translation: 我相信我们或许能吸收药水释放到河中的邪恶魔法。

english: I'm sure you know of runestones, used by mages to power their spells. The essence used to create these stones absorbs magical potential from runic altars to be released later.
translation: 你肯定知道符文石，法师们用它来为法术提供能量。制造这些石头所用的精华会从符文祭坛吸收魔法潜能，以备日后释放。

english: And you think we could use some rune essence to absorb the magic they've released into the Salve?
translation: 你觉得我们可以用一些符文精华来吸收他们释放到萨尔维河中的魔法？

english: Exactly. If you could bring me fifty essence, I should be able to reverse the damage done. Be quick though. The longer we wait, the worse things will get.
translation: 正是。如果你能给我带来五十份精华，我应该就能逆转造成的损害。但要快。我们等得越久，情况就越糟。

english: Bring me fifty rune essence so that I can undo the damage done by those Zamorakians.
translation: 给我带五十份符文精华来，这样我就能消除那些萨莫拉克信徒造成的损害。

english: I brought you some rune essence.
translation: 我给你带了些符文精华。

english: Quickly, give them to me!
translation: 快，把它们给我！

english: Thank you. I need [1-50] more.
translation: 谢谢你。我还需要[1-50]份。

english: How much more essence do I need to bring you?
translation: 我还需要带多少精华给你？

english: I need [1-50] more.
translation: 我还需要[1-50]份。

english: You have brought me notes saying 'I promise to pay the bearer on demand the listed number of Rune Essence.' How is that supposed to help me?
translation: 你给我带来了写着‘本人承诺见票即付持票人列明数量的符文精华’的笔记。这怎么能帮到我？

english: I brought you some more essence.
translation: 我又给你带了些精华。

english: Excellent! That should do it! I will bless these stones and place them within the well. With the river safe, Misthalin should be protected from the vampyres once more!
translation: 太好了！应该够了！我会祝福这些石头，并把它们放进井里。河流安全了，米斯塔林应该就能再次免受吸血鬼的侵扰！

english: Please take this dagger. It has been handed down within my family for generations and is filled with the power of Saradomin.
translation: 请收下这把匕首。它在我家族中世代相传，充满了萨拉多明的力量。

english: You will find that it has the ability to prevent werewolves from adopting their wolf form in combat. Hopefully it comes in useful.
translation: 你会发现它有能力阻止狼人在战斗中变成狼形态。希望它能派上用场。

english: So can I pass through that barrier now?
translation: 那我现在能通过那个屏障了吗？

english: Into Morytania? Yes, you can. The barrier will prevent the servants of Zamorak from entering Misthalin, but it is safe for those blessed by Saradomin.
translation: 进入莫利塔尼亚？是的，你可以。屏障会阻止萨莫拉克的仆从进入米斯塔林，但对于受萨拉多明祝福的人来说是安全的。

english: I must warn you though, Morytania is an evil land. The region is filled with creatures and monsters more terrifying than any you'll find on this side of the Salve.
translation: 但我必须警告你，莫利塔尼亚是一片邪恶的土地。该地区充满了比你在萨尔维河这边遇到的任何生物和怪物都更可怕的家伙。

english: Worst of all are the vampyres, the rulers of Morytania. Be very cautious of their kind. Many are completely immune to human weaponry. Those that aren't, are still very hard to kill.
translation: 最糟糕的是吸血鬼，莫利塔尼亚的统治者。对他们的同类要非常小心。许多吸血鬼完全免疫人类的武器。那些不免疫的，也仍然很难杀死。

english: I'll be careful. Anything else I should know?
translation: 我会小心的。还有什么我应该知道的吗？

english: The first settlement you'll likely come across is Canifis, a town of werewolves. They probably won't attack you unless provoked, but you should still be cautious.
translation: 你可能会遇到的第一个定居点是坎尼非斯村，一个狼人小镇。除非被激怒，他们可能不会攻击你，但你仍然应该小心。

english: You should keep your Wolfbane dagger to hand. It will prevent them from taking on their wolf form.
translation: 你应该把狼祸匕首放在手边。它能阻止他们变成狼形态。

english: One last thing. While in Morytania, stay alert for any mention of the Myreque.
translation: 最后一件事。在莫利塔尼亚时，要留意任何提到迈雷克的消息。

english: The Myreque?
translation: 迈雷克？

english: Yes. They're a band of freedom fighters. They fight to protect the humans trapped in Morytania from the tyranny of the vampyres. Their hope is to one day rid the region of all evil.
translation: 是的。他们是一群自由战士。他们为保护被困在莫利塔尼亚的人类免受吸血鬼的暴政而战。他们的希望是有朝一日能清除该地区的所有邪恶。

english: Veliaf, the leader of their Mort Myre group, is an old friend. I imagine they'd appreciate the help of someone like you, if you can find them.
translation: 维利亚夫，他们在莫特迈尔分队的领袖，是我的老朋友。我想如果你能找到他们，他们会很感激像你这样的人的帮助。

english: I'll keep an eye out for them.
translation: 我会留意他们的。

english: Right, I think that's everything. Just the blessing itself now. Hold still a moment.
translation: 好了，我想就这些了。现在就差祝福本身了。请站好别动。

english: Good luck out there. Stay safe.
translation: 祝你在那边好运。注意安全。

english: And you. See you later.
translation: 你也是。回头见。

english: Well... we do currently have a very urgent issue we need to resolve, and I suppose you look like someone who knows how to get a job done. Are you definitely interested in helping?
translation: 嗯……我们目前确实有个非常紧急的问题需要解决，我看你像是知道怎么把事情办成的人。你肯定有兴趣帮忙吗？

english: You'll find our Spymaster, Osman, just outside the palace. Go to him and tell him I sent you. He will fill you in on the details of our problem.
translation: 你会在宫殿外找到我们的间谍总管奥斯曼。去找他，告诉他是我派你来的。他会告诉你我们问题的具体细节。

english: I see. Well you know where to find me if you do wish to help us.
translation: 明白了。好吧，如果你确实愿意帮我们，你知道在哪里能找到我。

english: Hello again. Have you spoken to Osman yet? He should be just outside the palace.
translation: 又见面了。你跟奥斯曼谈过了吗？他应该就在宫殿外面。

english: Not yet. I'll go and see him.
translation: 还没有。我这就去找他。

english: Hello again. I hear you have agreed to help rescue Prince Ali. On behalf of the Emir, I will have a reward ready for you upon your success.
translation: 又见面了。我听说你同意帮忙营救阿里王子了。代表埃米尔，如果成功，我会为你准备好一份奖赏。

english: Osman? I was told by the Chancellor to come and speak to you. Apparently you have an issue that I can help with.
translation: 奥斯曼？是宰相让我来找你谈话。显然你有个问题我能帮上忙。

english: That would be an apt description. However, I find you to be an interesting choice by the Chancellor. Why has he chosen to trust you with this task over one of our own?
translation: 这个描述很贴切。不过，我觉得宰相选你是个有趣的选择。他为什么信任你来做这个任务，而不是用我们自己的人？

english: Er... I just asked if he needed help and he said yes.
translation: 呃……我就是问他需不需要帮忙，他答应了。

english: That man is far too trusting at a time when we must take extra care. However, if he has made his decision, I will not question it. Still, you should know that I will be keeping a close eye on you.
translation: 那个人太轻信别人了，而我们现在必须格外小心。不过，既然他做了决定，我不会质疑他。但你应该知道，我会牢牢盯着你。

english: Fair enough. So what is this issue?
translation: 说得有理。那么问题是什么？

english: Prince Ali, heir to the Emir of Al Kharid, has been taken. My spies have already discovered where he is being held, but we need someone to make the rescue.
translation: 阿里王子，阿尔卡里德城埃米尔的继承人，被绑走了。我的探子已经查到他在哪里被关押，但我们需要有人去营救。

english: Well I'm sure I can manage that. How do I go about rescuing him?
translation: 嗯，我肯定能办到。我要怎么去营救他？

english: The Prince has been taken by a group of bandits led by the self-proclaimed 'Lady' Keli. They are holding him in the abandoned jail just east of Draynor Village.
translation: 王子被一群强盗抓走了，为首的自称'夫人'凯利。他们把他关在德雷诺村东边那座废弃的监狱里。

english: According to our information, Keli is the only one able to freely move around the area. For you to get the Prince out, you will need to disguise him as her. She will of course need dealing with first.
translation: 根据我们的情报，凯利是唯一能自由活动的人。你要救出王子，就得把他伪装成她。当然，首先得解决掉她。

english: Why can't I just go in and kill her and her bandits?
translation: 为什么我不能直接进去杀了她和她的强盗？

english: And endanger the life of the Prince in the process? No. There will be no unnecessary risks. We need to do this with as little bloodshed as possible.
translation: 然后让王子冒生命危险？不行。不能冒不必要的风险。我们必须尽可能少流血地完成这件事。

english: You make a fair point. Do you know what Keli looks like?
translation: 你说得有道理。你知道凯利长什么样吗？

english: She has blonde hair and wears pink clothes. My daughter, Leela, one of my spies, is currently in Draynor Village keeping an eye on the jail. I'm sure she can help you with the specifics.
translation: 她有一头金发，穿着粉色衣服。我的女儿莉拉，也是我的探子之一，目前正在德雷诺村监视着监狱。我相信她能帮你处理具体细节。

english: Before you go, there is one more thing. You'll need a key to get the Prince out of his cell. Keli has the only one. You could steal it, but that seems like a risk we should avoid.
translation: 在你走之前，还有一件事。你需要一把钥匙才能把王子从牢房里救出来。只有凯利有那把钥匙。你可以偷，但似乎风险太大，我们应该避免。

english: But if she has the only copy, and I can't just steal it, how do I get the key?
translation: 但如果只有她有唯一的一把，我又不能直接偷，那我怎么弄到钥匙？

english: If you bring me an imprint of the key along with a bronze bar, I can show you how to make a copy. You should be able to make an imprint of the key using some soft clay.
translation: 如果你带给我一把钥匙的印模和一根青铜锭，我可以告诉你怎么复制一把。你可以用一些软粘土来制作钥匙的印模。

english: Of course, you'll need to find a way to get Keli to show you the key without causing suspicion. I'm sure Leela can help you with that.
translation: 当然，你需要想办法让凯利把钥匙给你看，还不能引起怀疑。我相信莉拉能帮你。

english: Sounds like I should head on over to Draynor Village and see Leela then.
translation: 听起来我应该去德雷诺村找莉拉了。

english: Indeed. Do you have any further questions before you go?
translation: 没错。你在走之前还有什么问题吗？

english: Do you know why they've taken the Prince?
translation: 你知道他们为什么绑架王子吗？

english: No, but we have our theories.
translation: 不知道，但我们有一些推测。

english: Care to share them?
translation: 愿意分享一下吗？

english: No. You have not yet proven yourself enough to be trusted with that information.
translation: 不。你还不足以被信任到能知道这些信息。

english: Now, do you have any further questions?
translation: 现在，你还有什么问题吗？

english: Where abouts in Draynor is Leela?
translation: 莉拉在德雷诺村的什么地方？

english: She will be somewhere near the abandoned jail that the bandits are using. It's just east of the village.
translation: 她会在强盗们使用的废弃监狱附近。就在村子东边。

english: Do you have any further questions?
translation: 你还有什么问题吗？

english: No. I think I know everything I need to.
translation: 没了。我想我知道我需要的一切了。

english: Then you should get going.
translation: 那你该出发了。

english: You again. How are things going in Draynor?
translation: 又是你。德雷诺那边怎么样了？

english: I have an imprint of the key.
translation: 我有钥匙的印模了。

english: Good. Bring me a bronze bar, and I'll get a copy made.
translation: 好。带一根青铜锭来，我帮你复制一把。

english: I'll use this to have a copy of the key made. I'll send it to Leela once it's ready.
translation: 我会用这个来复制一把钥匙。弄好后我会把它送到莉拉那里。

english: I'm still working on gathering all the items I need.
translation: 我还在收集所有需要的物品。

english: Well if you need help, just talk to Leela.
translation: 好吧，如果你需要帮助，就找莉拉谈谈。

english: You must be Leela. Your father sent me to help rescue Prince Ali.
translation: 你一定是莉拉。你父亲派我来帮忙营救阿里王子。

english: Yes, he sent word ahead that you'd be coming. Are you aware of the plan?
translation: 是的，他提前传来消息说你会来。你知道计划吗？

english: I need to obtain a copy of the key to the Prince's cell, create a disguise for him that makes him look like Keli and then break him out of the jail.
translation: 我需要弄到王子牢房的钥匙复制品，给他做一套伪装让他看起来像凯利，然后把他从监狱里救出来。

english: I'd say that's a good summary. Now, do you have any questions for me about any part of the plan?
translation: 我觉得总结得很好。现在，你对计划的任何部分有什么问题要问我吗？

english: Any ideas for the key?
translation: 关于钥匙有什么建议吗？

english: Keli keeps it on her at all times, on a chain around her neck. If you can convince her to show it to you, you might be able to use some soft clay to take an imprint.
translation: 凯利夫人始终把它戴在身上，挂在脖子上的锁链上。如果你能说服她给你看，你也许可以用一些软粘土来拓印。

english: That doesn't sound easy.
translation: 听起来不容易。

english: My suggestion is that you pretend to be interested in joining her bandits. From there, you should be able to steer the conversation towards the key.
translation: 我建议你假装有兴趣加入她的强盗队伍。然后你应该能把话题引到钥匙上。

english: Once you have the imprint, take it to my father along with a bronze bar. He'll then be able to make us a copy.
translation: 拿到印模后，把它和一根青铜锭一起带给我父亲。他就能给我们复制一把了。

english: I already have the imprint!
translation: 我已经有印模了！

english: Then you should take it to my father along with a bronze bar. He'll then be able to make us a copy.
translation: 那你应该把它和一根青铜锭一起带给我父亲。他就能给我们复制一把了。

english: Do you have any other questions about the plan?
translation: 你对计划还有其他问题吗？

english: Any ideas for the disguise?
translation: 关于伪装有什么建议吗？

english: To make the Prince look like Keli, you'll need a blonde wig and a pink skirt. You'll also want some skin paste to hide the black eye he got when they captured him.
translation: 要让王子看起来像凯利夫人，你需要一顶金色假发和一条粉色长裙。你还需要一些皮肤糊状物来遮住他被抓时弄出的黑眼圈。

english: There's an old sailor in the village who makes rope. Perhaps he could make you a wig. Don't forget to dye it once you have one.
translation: 村里有个老水手，他会做绳子。也许他能给你做假发。拿到了之后别忘了染色。

english: For the skin paste, there's a local witch who's apparently an expert on all sorts of potions. I'm sure she could make you some. I hear she also sells dye, if you need some for the wig.
translation: 至于皮肤糊状物，当地有个女巫，显然是各种药水的专家。我肯定她能给你做一些。我听说她也卖染料，如果你需要给假发染色的话。

english: Finally there's the skirt. I imagine you could just buy one from any clothes shop. Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock is probably the closest.
translation: 最后是裙子。我想你可以在任何服装店买到一条。维洛克的塞萨莉娅精品服饰店大概是最近的。

english: Don't think so. I'll go and prepare.
translation: 没什么了。我去准备。

english: You're back. Do you have everything needed yet?
translation: 你回来了。东西都准备好了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll go and prepare.
translation: 还没有。我去准备。

english: Could you make other things apart from rope?
translation: 你除了绳子还能做别的东西吗？

english: I'm sure I can. What are you thinking of?
translation: 当然可以。你想做什么？

english: Could you knit me a sweater?
translation: 你能给我织件毛衣吗？

english: Do I look like a member of a sewing circle? Be off wi' you. I have fought monsters that would turn your hair blue.
translation: 我看起来像是缝纫圈的人吗？走开。我打过的怪物能吓得你头发变蓝。

english: I don't need to be laughed at just 'cos I'm getting a bit old.
translation: 我只是年纪大了点，可不想被人嘲笑。

english: How about some sort of wig?
translation: 那假发之类的呢？

english: Well... that's an interesting thought. Yes, I think I could do something. Give me three balls of wool and I might be able to do it.
translation: 嗯……这个想法挺有意思。是的，我觉得我能做点什么。给我三份羊毛，我或许能搞定。

english: Great, I will get some. I think a wig would be useful.
translation: 太好了，我去弄一些来。我觉得假发会很有用。

english: I have them here. Please make me a wig.
translation: 我带来了。请给我做一顶假发。

english: Okay, I'll have a go.
translation: 好吧，我来试试。

english: Here you go. How's that for a quick effort? Not bad I think!
translation: 给你。这么短时间做出来怎么样？我觉得不赖！

english: Thanks Ned. There's more to you than meets the eye.
translation: 谢谢内德。你可真是深藏不露啊。

english: Actually, I don't need one right now.
translation: 其实，我现在不需要。

english: Could you repair the arrow holes in the back of my shirt?
translation: 你能补一下我衬衫背后的箭孔吗？

english: Ah yes, it's a tough world these days. There's a few brave enough to attack from ten metres away.
translation: 啊没错，如今世道艰难。只有少数人敢从十米外发动攻击。

english: There you go, good as new.
translation: 给你，跟新的一样。

english: Thanks Ned. Maybe next time they will attack me face to face.
translation: 谢谢内德。也许下次他们会当面攻击我。

english: Actually, I don't need anything.
translation: 其实，我什么都不需要。

english: Can you make skin paste?
translation: 你能做皮肤糊状物吗？

english: Why, it's one of my most popular potions! Lots of people around here like to pretty their faces up a bit. I can make it for you if you get me what's needed.
translation: 哎呀，这可是我最受欢迎的药水之一！附近很多人都喜欢让自己脸好看一点。如果你给我带来需要的东西，我可以帮你做。

english: Well dearie, you need a base for the paste. That's a mix of ash, flour and water. Then you need redberries to colour it as you want. Bring me those four items and I will make you some.
translation: 嗯，亲爱的，你需要糊状物的基底。那是灰烬、面粉和水的混合物。然后你需要红莓来把它染成你想要的颜色。把那四样东西带来，我就给你做一些。

english: Yes I can. I see you already have the ingredients. Would you like me to mix some for you now?
translation: 是的，我可以。我看你已经有了材料。要我现在帮你调制一些吗？

english: Yes please. Mix me some skin paste.
translation: 好的，麻烦了。给我调一些皮肤糊状物。

english: That should be simple. Hand the things to Aggie then.
translation: 那应该很简单。把东西交给阿吉吧。

english: Tourniquet, Fenderbaum, Tottenham, Marshmallow, Marblearch.
translation: 止血带，挡泥板，托特纳姆，棉花糖，大理石拱门。

english: There you go dearie. That will make you look good at the Varrock dances.
translation: 给你，亲爱的。这会让你在维洛克城的舞会上光彩照人。

english: No thank you. I don't need any skin paste right now.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我现在不需要皮肤糊状物。

english: Okay dearie, that's always your choice.
translation: 好的，亲爱的，这总是你的选择。

english: Are you the famous Lady Keli? Leader of the toughest gang of bandits around?
translation: 你就是著名的凯利夫人吗？周围最凶悍的强盗团伙的头儿？

english: Yes, I am Keli. You've heard of me then?
translation: 是的，我就是凯利。你听说过我？

english: Heard of you? You're famous in Gielinor!
translation: 听说过你？你在整个吉莱诺都很出名！

english: That's very kind of you to say. Reputations are not easily earned. I have managed to succeed where many fail.
translation: 你这么说真是太客气了。名声可不是轻易得来的。我能在很多人失败的地方成功。

english: I think Katrine is still tougher.
translation: 我觉得卡特琳还是更厉害。

english: Well you can think that all you like! Those cowards dare not leave Varrock. Out here, I'm toughest. You can tell them that! Now get out of my sight, before I call my guards.
translation: 哼，你尽管这么想！那些懦夫连维洛克城都不敢出。在这里，我是最厉害的。你可以告诉他们！现在给我滚开，不然我叫守卫了。

english: What's your latest plan then?
translation: 那你最新的计划是什么？

english: Well I was actually hoping to join your group.
translation: 其实我是想加入你们一伙。

english: Join us? Interesting... I suppose you do look the type.
translation: 加入我们？有意思……我看你确实像那么个类型。

english: You'll of course need to properly prove yourself before we let you join us. However, what I can tell you is that we currently have a very valuable prisoner. If all goes well, he will make us very rich.
translation: 当然，你得先好好证明自己，我们才能让你加入。不过，我可以告诉你，我们目前有一个非常值钱的囚犯。如果一切顺利，他会让我们发大财。

english: Ah, I see. You must have been very skillful.
translation: 啊，我明白了。你一定非常厉害。

english: To catch him? Oh yes. We had to grab him without his bodyguards noticing. It was a stroke of genius. Mostly my doing, of course.
translation: 抓他？哦没错。我们得在他保镖没注意的情况下抓住他。这真是个天才之举。当然，主要是我的功劳。

english: How do you know someone won't try to free him?
translation: 你怎么知道不会有人试图救他？

english: There is no way to release him. The only key to his cell is on a chain around my neck, and the locksmith who made it died very suddenly.
translation: 没办法放他出来。他牢房的唯一钥匙挂在我脖子上的锁链上，而做这把锁的锁匠已经死得很突然了。

english: There isn't another key like this in the world.
translation: 世上没有第二把这样的钥匙了。

english: Could I see the key please?
translation: 能让我看看钥匙吗？

english: It will be something I can tell my grandchildren, when you are even more famous than you are now.
translation: 等你比现在更有名时，这就会成为我能讲给孙辈听的事。

english: Well I suppose there's no harm in letting you see it. After all, you have no hope of stealing it.
translation: 好吧，我想让你看看也无妨。毕竟你绝不可能偷走它。

english: Thank you. I'd better go now.
translation: 谢谢。我该走了。

english: Could I touch the key for a moment please?
translation: 能让我碰一下钥匙吗？就一会儿。

english: Well... only for a moment then.
translation: 嗯……那就一会儿。

english: Thank you so much! You are too kind.
translation: 太感谢了！你真是太好了。

english: You are welcome, but run along now. I will need some time to consider your request to join us.
translation: 不客气，但现在你该走了。我需要时间考虑你加入我们的请求。

english: That is a good way to keep secrets.
translation: 这是保守秘密的好办法。

english: It is the best way I know. Dead men tell no tales.
translation: 这是我知道的最好办法。死人不会告密。

english: Well I'll be off. Good luck.
translation: 那我走了。祝你好运。

english: You must have trained a lot for this work.
translation: 你肯定为这份工作训练了很多。

english: I have used a sword since I was a girl. My first kill was before I was even six years old.
translation: 我还是个小女孩时就用剑了。我六岁前就杀了第一个人。

english: I shouldn't disturb someone as tough as you.
translation: 我不该打扰像你这样强悍的人。

english: Yes, I am very busy. Goodbye.
translation: 是的，我很忙。再见。

english: I've heard rumours that you kill people.
translation: 我听说你杀人的传言。

english: There's always someone ready to spread rumours. I hear all sort of ridiculous things these days.
translation: 总有人喜欢散布谣言。这些天我听到了各种荒谬的事。

english: No, I've never really heard of you.
translation: 不，我从没听说过你。

english: You must be new around here then. Everyone knows of Lady Keli and her prowess with a sword.
translation: 那你肯定是新来的。人人都知道凯利夫人和她的剑术高超。

english: No, still doesn't ring a bell.
translation: 不，还是没想起来。

english: Well, you know of me now. You should also know that I will wring your neck if you don't show some respect.
translation: 好吧，你现在认识我了。你最好也知道，如果你不表示一点尊重，我会拧断你的脖子。

english: I don't show respect to killers and hoodlums.
translation: 我不会对杀手和恶棍表示尊重。

english: You should, you really should. I am wealthy enough to place a bounty on your head, or I could just remove your head myself. Luckily, I am too busy to deal with the likes of you, so clear off!
translation: 你应该尊重，真的应该。我富到可以悬赏你的脑袋，或者我亲自砍掉你的头。幸好，我太忙了没空搭理你这种人，所以滚开！

english: Actually, I have heard of you. You're famous in Gielinor!
translation: 其实，我听说过你。你在吉埃利诺很有名！

english: Oh, it's you. What do you want?
translation: 哦，是你。你想干什么？

english: I was hoping we could talk more about your prisoner.
translation: 我希望我们能多聊聊你的囚犯。

english: Until you join us, I can say little. What I can tell you is that he is very valuable. If all goes well, he will make us very rich.
translation: 在你加入我们之前，我不能多说。我能告诉你的是他非常值钱。如果一切顺利，他会让我们很有钱。

english: Good work. Now, before breaking the Prince out, you'll need to find a way to deal with his personal guard. He's talkative, so try to find a weakness. Remember, we don't want any unneeded violence.
translation: 干得好。现在，在救出王子之前，你需要想办法对付他的贴身守卫。他很健谈，所以试着找出他的弱点。记住，我们不想有不必要的暴力。

english: Alright. I'll go have a chat to this guard.
translation: 好的。我去和这个守卫聊聊。

english: You're back. How are things going?
translation: 你回来了。事情怎么样了？

english: I'm afraid I lost that key you gave me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的钥匙弄丢了。

english: Well that was foolish. I can sort you out with another, but it will cost you 15 coins.
translation: 真是愚蠢。我可以再给你一把，但要收你15个金币。

english: I haven't got that much.
translation: 我没有那么多。

english: Then come back to me when you do.
translation: 那等你有了再来找我。

english: Here, I have 15 coins.
translation: 给你，我有15个金币。

english: Now, how are things going with that guard?
translation: 那么，那个守卫的事怎么样了？

english: I haven't spoken to him yet.
translation: 我还没和他说话。

english: Well you'd better get on it then. We need him out of the way.
translation: 那你最好赶紧行动。我们需要他离开。

english: I have some beer here. Fancy one?
translation: 我这里有些啤酒。来一杯？

english: Ah, that would be lovely. Only one though, just to wet my throat.
translation: 啊，那太好了。不过只一杯，润润喉咙。

english: Of course. It must be tough being here without a drink.
translation: 当然。这里没有酒喝一定很难熬。

english: That was perfect! I can't thank you enough.
translation: 太完美了！我感激不尽。

english: How are you? Still okay? Not too drunk?
translation: 你怎么样？还好吗？没喝醉吧？

english: No, I don't get drunk from only one drink. I reckon I'd need at least two more for that. Still, thanks for the beer.
translation: 不，一杯酒不会让我醉。我想至少还得再来两杯才行。不过，谢谢你的啤酒。

english: Would you care for another beer, my friend?
translation: 想再来一杯啤酒吗，我的朋友？

english: I'd better not. I don't want to be drunk on duty.
translation: 还是不了。我不想值班时喝醉。

english: Here, just keep these for later. I hate to see a thirsty guard.
translation: 来，这些留着以后喝。我不忍心看到一个口渴的守卫。

english: Franksh! That wash jusht what I need to shtay on guard. No more beersh, I don't want to get drunk.
translation: 弗兰克！这正是我需要保持警戒的东西。不能再喝啤酒了，我不想喝醉。

english: Tell me about the life of a guard.
translation: 跟我讲讲守卫的生活吧。

english: Well, the hours are good, but most of those hours are a drag.
translation: 嗯，工作时间不错，但大部分时间都很无聊。

english: Sometimes I wonder if I should have spent more time learning when I was a young boy. Maybe I wouldn't be here now, scared of Keli.
translation: 有时我想，小时候是不是该多用功学习。也许现在就不会在这里，害怕凯利了。

english: What did you want to be when you were a boy?
translation: 你小时候想成为什么样的人？

english: Well, I loved to sit by the lake, with my toes in the water. I'd shoot the fish with my bow and arrow.
translation: 嗯，我喜欢坐在湖边，把脚趾泡在水里。用我的弓和箭射鱼。

english: That's a strange hobby for a boy.
translation: 对于一个男孩来说，这是个奇怪的爱好。

english: It kept us from goblin hunting, which was what most boys did.
translation: 这让我们不用去打哥布林，那是大多数男孩做的事。

english: Hang on... Why do you ask? What do you want?
translation: 等等……你为什么问这个？你想要什么？

english: Hey, chill out. I won't cause you trouble.
translation: 嘿，冷静点。我不会给你添麻烦的。

english: Sorry, it's hard to relax when I'm on duty. Stress of the job, and all.
translation: 抱歉，值班时很难放松。工作压力，等等。

english: So why do you do it?
translation: 那你为什么做这份工作？

english: There's good money in it, and some of the shouting I rather like.
translation: 薪水不错，而且有些吼叫我还挺喜欢的。

english: RESISTANCE IS USELESS!
translation: 抵抗是没用的！

english: So what do you buy with your great wages?
translation: 那么你用这么高的薪水买什么呢？

english: Really, after working here, there's only time for a drink or three. All us guards go to the same pub and drink ourselves stupid.
translation: 其实，在这里工作之后，只有时间喝上一两杯。我们所有守卫都去同一家酒吧，喝得烂醉。

english: It's what I enjoy these days. I can't resist the sight of a really cold beer.
translation: 这就是我现在的乐趣。我无法抵御一瓶冰镇啤酒的诱惑。

english: Would you be interested in making a little more money?
translation: 你有兴趣多赚点钱吗？

english: What? Are you trying to bribe me? I may not be a great guard, but I am loyal. How dare you try to bribe me!
translation: 什么？你想贿赂我？我可能不是个好守卫，但我忠诚。你竟敢贿赂我！

english: No, no, you've got the wrong idea, totally. I just wondered if you wanted some part-time bodyguard work.
translation: 不，不，你完全误会了。我只是想知道你是否想做些兼职保镖的工作。

english: Oh... sorry. No, I don't need money. As long as you were not offering me a bribe.
translation: 哦……抱歉。不，我不需要钱。只要你不是在贿赂我就好。

english: Thanks, I appreciate that. Talking on duty can be punished by having your mouth stitched up. These are tough people, make no mistake.
translation: 谢谢，我很感激。值班时聊天可能会被缝上嘴巴。这些人很严厉，别搞错了。

english: Hello friend. I'm just here to rescue the Prince, if thats okay?
translation: 你好朋友。我只是来救王子的，可以吗？

english: Thatsh a funny joke. You are lucky I'm shober. Go in peace, friend.
translation: 真是个好笑笑话。你运气好我没醉。走吧，朋友。

english: You're back. How are things going with that guard?
translation: 你回来了。那个守卫的事怎么样了？

english: I could attack him.
translation: 我可以攻击他。

english: I don't think that's a good idea. Any violence could put the Prince at risk.
translation: 我觉得这不是个好主意。任何暴力都可能危及王子。

english: I'll keep thinking.
translation: 我会继续想办法。

english: I might be able to get him drunk.
translation: 我或许能把他灌醉。

english: Yes, that could work. I'd imagine three beers would do it. Why don't you give it a try?
translation: 是的，这可行。我想三杯啤酒就够了。为什么不试试呢？

english: Maybe I could bribe him to leave.
translation: 也许我能贿赂他离开。

english: It would take a lot of gold to convince him to betray Keli. She's not known to be kind to those she believes to be traitors. Perhaps there's something else you could try.
translation: 需要很多金币才能说服他背叛凯利。凯利对那些她认为是叛徒的人可不会仁慈。也许你该试试别的办法。

english: I'm not sure yet.
translation: 我还不确定。

english: You should try talking to him. He might give away some sort of weakness.
translation: 你应该试着和他谈谈。他可能会暴露某种弱点。

english: He's been dealt with.
translation: 他已经被搞定了。

english: Great! I think that means we're ready. Go in and use some rope to tie Keli up. Once she's dealt with, use the key to free the Prince. Don't forget to give him his disguise so the guards outside don't spot him.
translation: 太棒了！我想这意味着我们准备好了。进去用绳子把凯利绑起来。搞定她之后，用钥匙释放王子。别忘了给他伪装，这样外面的守卫就认不出他了。

english: Hello! I'm here to tie you up!
translation: 你好！我来绑你了！

english: Prince Ali? I'm here to rescue you.
translation: 阿里王子？我来救你了。

english: Oh thank goodness! What's your plan?
translation: 哦谢天谢地！你有什么计划？

english: I've already dealt with Lady Keli and the guard. I'm going to get you a disguise so the guards outside don't spot you leaving. I'll be back once I have it.
translation: 我已经搞定了凯利夫人和守卫。我去给你拿个伪装，这样外面的守卫就不会发现你离开。一旦拿到我就回来。

english: Take this disguise. You can use it to get past the guards outside.
translation: 拿上这个伪装。你可以用它避开外面的守卫。

english: Thank you, my friend. I must leave you now, but my father will pay you well for this.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友。我现在必须离开了，但我父亲会为此重谢你的。

english: Did yoush say something about shome Prince?
translation: 你你刚说了个什么王子？

english: You did it! Prince Ali is now safe again. You should head back to Al Kharid. I expect you will be well rewarded for your work.
translation: 你成功了！阿里王子现在安全了。你应该回阿尔卡里德城去。我想你的工作会得到丰厚回报。

english: Prince Ali is safe once more. Chancellor Hassan has your payment.
translation: 阿里王子再次安全了。哈桑大臣有你的报酬。

english: Good to see you, friend. I am forever in your debt for what you did, as is all of Al Kharid.
translation: 很高兴见到你，朋友。我永远感激你所做的一切，阿尔卡里德城也是。

english: I know my father is very grateful as well. If he were in better health, he would have thanked you personally. However, at his age, it is best that he spends his time resting.
translation: 我知道我父亲也非常感激。如果他身体更好些，他会亲自感谢你。不过，在他这个年纪，最好还是多休息。

english: I'm just happy to have helped. All the best.
translation: 能帮上忙我就很高兴了。祝一切顺利。

english: Prince Ali is home safe. You have the eternal gratitude of the Emir for rescuing his son. Please, take this payment as a thank you.
translation: 阿里王子平安到家。你救了埃米尔的儿子，他永远感激你。请收下这份报酬，聊表谢意。

english: I need the services of someone, yes. If you are interested, see the spymaster, Osman. I manage the finances here. Come to me when you need payment.
translation: 我需要有人为我服务，是的。如果你有兴趣，去找间谍大师奥斯曼。我负责这里的财务。需要报酬时来找我。

english: Have you found the spymaster, Osman, yet? You cannot proceed in your task without reporting to him.
translation: 你找到间谍大师奥斯曼了吗？不向他报告，你就无法继续你的任务。

english: I understand the Spymaster has hired you. I will pay the reward only when the Prince is rescued.
translation: 我知道间谍大师雇了你。只有王子被救出后，我才会支付报酬。

english: The chancellor trusts me. I have come for instructions.
translation: 大臣信任我。我是来听取指示的。

english: Our prince is captive by the Lady Keli. We just need to make the rescue. There are two things we need you to do.
translation: 我们的王子被凯利夫人囚禁了。我们只需要实施救援。有两件事需要你去做。

english: What is the first thing I must do?
translation: 第一件事是什么？

english: The prince is guarded by some stupid guards and a clever woman. The woman is our only way to get the prince out. Only she can walk freely about the area.
translation: 王子由一些愚蠢的守卫和一个精明的女人看守。那个女人是我们救出王子的唯一途径。只有她能自由地在区域内走动。

english: I think you will need to tie her up. One coil of rope should do for that. Then, disguise the prince as her to get him out without suspicion.
translation: 我想你需要把她绑起来。一圈绳子应该就够了。然后，把王子伪装成她，这样就能毫无嫌疑地把他带出来。

english: How good must the disguise be?
translation: 伪装需要多好？

english: Only enough to fool the guards at a distance. Get a skirt like hers. Same colour, same style. We will only have a short time.
translation: 只要能骗过远处的守卫就行。找一条和她一样的裙子，同样的颜色，同样的款式。我们只有很短的时间。

english: Get a blonde wig, too. That is up to you to make or find. Something to colour the skin of the prince.
translation: 再弄一顶金色假发。这得靠你自己制作或寻找。还需要一些东西来给王子皮肤染色。

english: My daughter and top spy, Leela, can help you. She has sent word that she has discovered where they are keeping the prince.
translation: 我的女儿兼顶级间谍莉拉可以帮你。她传来消息说已经发现了关押王子的地方。

english: It's near Draynor Village. She is lurking somewhere near there now.
translation: 就在德雷诺村附近。她现在正潜伏在那附近的某个地方。

english: What is the second thing you need?
translation: 第二件事是什么？

english: We need the key, or we need a copy made. If you can get some soft clay then you can copy the key...
translation: 我们需要钥匙，或者需要复制一把。如果你能弄到一些软粘土，就可以复制钥匙……

english: ...If you can convince Lady Keli to show it to you for a moment. She is very boastful. It should not be too hard.
translation: ……如果你能说服凯利夫人给你看一会儿钥匙。她非常爱吹嘘。应该不会太难。

english: Bring the imprint to me, with a bar of bronze.
translation: 把印模和一根青铜锭带给我。

english: Okay, I had better go find some things.
translation: 好的，我最好去找些东西。

english: May good luck travel with you. Don't forget to find Leela. It can't be done without her help.
translation: 祝你好运。别忘了去找莉拉。没有她的帮助，这件事办不成。

english: Can you tell me what I still need to get?
translation: 你能告诉我我还需要什么吗？

english: A print of the key in soft clay and a bronze bar. Then, collect the key from Leela.
translation: 用软粘土印下的钥匙印模和一根青铜锭。然后从莉拉那里取钥匙。

english: You can collect the key from Leela.
translation: 你可以从莉拉那里取钥匙。

english: The key you already have. Good.
translation: 你已经有了钥匙。很好。

english: You need to make a blonde wig somehow. Leela may help.
translation: 你需要想办法做一顶金色假发。莉拉可能会帮忙。

english: The wig you have got; well done.
translation: 你已经有了假发；干得好。

english: You will need a skirt that looks the same as Keli's.
translation: 你需要一条和凯利裙子看起来一样的裙子。

english: You have the skirt. Good.
translation: 你已经有了裙子。很好。

english: Something to make the prince's skin appear lighter.
translation: 需要一些东西让王子的皮肤看起来更白。

english: You have the skin paint; well done. I thought you would struggle to make that.
translation: 你已经有了皮肤涂料；干得好。我还以为你很难做出来呢。

english: Yes, you have the rope.
translation: 是的，你有绳子了。

english: A rope with which to tie Keli up.
translation: 一根用来绑住凯利的绳子。

english: Once you have everything, go to Leela. She must be ready to get the prince away.
translation: 一旦你准备好所有东西，就去找莉拉。她必须准备好带王子离开。

english: I am here to help you free the prince.
translation: 我是来帮你解救王子的。

english: Your employment is known to me. Now, do you know all that we need to make the break?
translation: 我知道你被雇用了。那么，你知道我们越狱需要的一切吗？

english: I must make a disguise. What do you suggest?
translation: 我必须制作一套伪装。你有什么建议？

english: Only the lady Keli, can wander about outside the jail. The guards will shoot to kill if they see the prince out so we need a disguise good enough to fool them at a distance.
translation: 只有凯利夫人能在监狱外自由走动。守卫看到王子出来会直接射杀，所以我们需要一套足够好的伪装，能在远处骗过他们。

english: You need a wig, maybe made from wool. If you find someone who can work with wool ask them about it. There's a witch nearby may be able to help you dye it.
translation: 你需要一顶假发，也许可以用羊毛做。如果你找到会处理羊毛的人，可以问问他们。附近有个女巫也许能帮你染色。

english: The wig you have got, well done.
translation: 你已经有了假发，干得好。

english: You will need to get a pink skirt, same as Keli's.
translation: 你需要弄一条粉色长裙，和凯利的一样。

english: You have got the skirt, good.
translation: 你已经有了裙子，很好。

english: We still need something to colour the Prince's skin lighter. There's a witch close to here. She knows about many things. She may know some way to make the skin lighter.
translation: 我们还需要一些东西来让王子的皮肤变白。附近有个女巫。她懂得很多。她可能知道让皮肤变白的方法。

english: You have the skin paint, well done. I thought you would struggle to make that.
translation: 你已经有了皮肤涂料，干得好。我还以为你很难做出来呢。

english: You will still need some rope to tie up Keli, of course. I heard that there's a good rope maker around here.
translation: 当然，你还需要一些绳子来绑住凯利。我听说附近有个不错的制绳匠。

english: You have rope I see, to tie up Keli. That will be the most dangerous part of the plan.
translation: 我看到你有绳子了，用来绑凯利。那将是计划中最危险的部分。

english: I need to get the key made.
translation: 我需要制作钥匙。

english: Yes, that is most important. There is no way you can get the real key. It is on a chain around Keli's neck. Almost impossible to steal.
translation: 是的，那是最重要的。你不可能拿到真钥匙。它挂在凯利脖子上的锁链上。几乎不可能偷到。

english: Get some soft clay and get her to show you the key somehow. Then take the print, with bronze, to my father.
translation: 弄些软粘土，想办法让她给你看钥匙。然后把印模和青铜锭带给我父亲。

english: What can I do with the guards?
translation: 我能对守卫做些什么？

english: Most of the guards will be easy. The disguise will get past them. The only guard who will be a problem will be the one at the door.
translation: 大多数守卫很容易对付。伪装能骗过他们。唯一会有问题的守卫是门口的那个。

english: We can discuss this more when you have the rest of the escape kit.
translation: 等你准备好其他越狱工具后，我们可以再讨论这个。

english: I will go and get the rest of the escape equipment.
translation: 我去准备剩下的越狱装备。

english: Good, I shall await your return with everything.
translation: 好的，我等你带着所有东西回来。

english: Well... That's an interesting thought. Yes, I think I could do something. Give me 3 balls of wool and I might be able to do it.
translation: 嗯……这想法挺有意思。是的，我想我能做点什么。给我3团羊毛，我或许能搞定。

english: I have that now. Please, make me a wig.
translation: 我现在就有了。请帮我做一顶假发。

english: Okay, I will have a go.
translation: 好吧，我来试试。

english: I will come back when I need you to make me one.
translation: 等我需要你帮我做的时候再来。

english: Well, it sounds like a challenge. Come to me if you need one.
translation: 嗯，听起来是个挑战。如果你需要，就来找我。

english: Could you think of a way to make skin paste?
translation: 你能想出制作皮肤糊状物的方法吗？

english: Why, it's one of my most popular potions. The women here, they like to have smooth looking skin. And I must admit, some of the men buy it as well.
translation: 哎呀，这可是我最受欢迎的药水之一。这里的女人都喜欢皮肤光滑。而且我得承认，有些男人也会买。

english: I can make it for you, just get me what's needed.
translation: 我可以为你制作，只要把需要的东西拿来就行。

english: What do you need to make it?
translation: 制作它需要什么？

english: Yes I can, I see you already have the ingredients. Would you like me to mix some for you now?
translation: 是的，我可以。我看到你已经有了材料。你想让我现在给你调配一些吗？

english: There you go dearie, your skin potion. That will make you look good at the Varrock dances.
translation: 给你，亲爱的，你的皮肤药水。这能让你在维洛克城的舞会上看起来很棒。

english: No thank you, I don't need any skin paste right now.
translation: 不了谢谢，我现在不需要皮肤糊状物。

english: Are you the famous Lady Keli? Leader of the toughest gang of mercenary killers around?
translation: 你就是著名的凯利夫人吗？最凶残的雇佣兵杀手团伙的头目？

english: I am Keli, you have heard of me then?
translation: 我就是凯利，你听说过我？

english: Well you can think that all you like. I know those blackarm cowards dare not leave the city. Out here, I am toughest. You can tell them that! Now get out of my sight, before I call my guards.
translation: 哼，随你怎么想。我知道那些黑臂懦夫不敢离开城市。在这里，我是最强的。你可以告诉他们！现在滚出我的视线，否则我叫守卫了。

english: Of course, you need not go into specific details.
translation: 当然，你不需要说具体细节。

english: Well, I can tell you I have a valuable prisoner here in my cells. I can expect a high reward to be paid very soon for this guy. I can't tell you who he is, but he is a lot colder now.
translation: 嗯，我可以告诉你，我的牢房里关着一个值钱的囚犯。很快就能拿到一大笔赎金。我不能告诉你他是谁，但他现在冷多了。

english: You must have been very skillful.
translation: 你一定非常厉害。

english: Yes, I did most of the work. We had to grab the Pr...
translation: 是的，大部分工作是我做的。我们不得不抓住王……

english: Er, we had to grab him without his ten bodyguards noticing. It was a stroke of genius.
translation: 呃，我们不得不在他的十个保镖没注意的情况下抓住他。真是天才之举。

english: Are you sure they will pay?
translation: 你确定他们会付钱吗？

english: They will pay, or we will cut his hair off and send it to them.
translation: 他们会付的，否则我们就剪掉他的头发寄给他们。

english: How about trying something tougher? Maybe cut his finger off?
translation: 要不要试试更狠的？也许砍掉他的手指？

english: That's a good idea, I could use talented people like you. I may call on you if I need work doing.
translation: 好主意，我可以利用你这样的人才。如果有活干，我可能会找你。

english: There is no way to release him. The only key to the door is on a chain around my neck and the locksmith who made the lock died suddenly when he had finished.
translation: 没办法放他出来。门上唯一的钥匙挂在我脖子上的锁链上，而且制作这把锁的锁匠在完工后突然死了。

english: There is not another key like this in the world.
translation: 世界上没有第二把这样的钥匙。

english: Could I see the key please? Just for a moment. It would be something I can tell my grandchildren. When you are even more famous than you are now.
translation: 能让我看看钥匙吗？就一会儿。这样我以后可以跟孙子孙女讲讲。等你比现在更出名的时候。

english: As you put it that way I am sure you can see it. You cannot steal the key, it is on a Runite chain.
translation: 既然你这么说，那当然可以给你看。你偷不走钥匙的，它挂在符文锁链上。

english: Only for a moment then.
translation: 那就只看一会儿。

english: Thank you so much, you are too kind, o great Keli.
translation: 非常感谢，您太客气了，伟大的凯利。

english: You are welcome, run along now, I am very busy.
translation: 不客气，现在走吧，我很忙。

english: I am glad I know none of your secrets, Keli.
translation: 我很高兴我不知道你的任何秘密，凯利。

english: You must be new to this land then. EVERYONE knows of Lady Keli and her prowess with the sword.
translation: 那你一定是新来的。所有人都知道凯利夫人和她的剑术。

english: I have used a sword since I was a small girl. I stabbed three people before I was 6 years old.
translation: 我从小就用剑。六岁之前就捅过三个人。

english: I need to do a lot of work, goodbye. When you get a little tougher, maybe I will give you a job.
translation: 我还有很多事要做，再见。等你再厉害一点，也许我会给你份工作。

english: Well, you know of me now. I will wring your neck if you do not show respect.
translation: 哼，你现在知道我了。如果你不表示尊重，我就拧断你的脖子。

english: I do not show respect to killers and hoodlums.
translation: 我不会对杀手和流氓表示尊重。

english: You should, you really should. I am wealthy enough to place a bounty on your head. Or just remove your head myself. Now go, I am busy, too busy to fight a would-be hoodlum.
translation: 你应该尊重，真的应该。我有足够的钱悬赏你的人头。或者干脆我自己砍掉你的头。现在走吧，我很忙，没空跟一个准流氓打架。

english: Hi, I'm Joe, door guard for Lady Keli.
translation: 嗨，我是乔，凯利夫人的门卫。

english: Well done; we can make the key now.
translation: 干得好；我们现在可以制作钥匙了。

english: Pick the key up from Leela.
translation: 从莉拉那里取钥匙。

english: Thank you. I will try to find the other items.
translation: 谢谢。我会试着找其他东西。

english: Foolish [man/woman]! A new key will cost 15gp.
translation: 愚蠢的[man/woman]！一把新钥匙要15金币。

english: Here, I have 15gp
translation: 给你，我有15金币。

english: That is good. I will have another key made. You may collect it from Leela.
translation: 很好。我会再做一把钥匙。你可以从莉拉那里取。

english: I haven't got 15 coins with me.
translation: 我身上没有15金币。

english: My father sent this key for you. Be careful not to lose it.
translation: 我父亲让我把这把钥匙给你。小心别弄丢了。

english: Good, you have all the basic equipment. Next to deal with the guard on the door. He is talkative, try to find a weakness in him.
translation: 很好，你有了所有基本装备。接下来要对付门口的守卫。他很健谈，试着找出他的弱点。

english: Foolish [man/woman]! A new key will cost 15 coins.
translation: 愚蠢的[man/woman]！一把新钥匙要15金币。

english: I have some beer here, fancy one?
translation: 我这里有些啤酒，想喝一杯吗？

english: Ah, that would be lovely, just one now, just to wet my throat.
translation: 啊，那太好了，就一杯，润润喉咙。

english: Of course, it must be tough being here without a drink.
translation: 当然，没酒喝待在这里一定很难熬。

english: That was perfect, I can't thank you enough.
translation: 太完美了，我感激不尽。

english: How are you? Still ok? Not too drunk?
translation: 你怎么样？还好吗？没喝醉吧？

english: No, I don't get drunk with only one drink. You would need a few to do that. But thanks for the beer.
translation: 没有，一杯可不会让我醉。要好几杯才行。不过谢谢你的啤酒。

english: I better not, I don't want to be drunk on duty.
translation: 我还是别喝了，我不想在执勤时喝醉。

english: Here, just keep these for later, I hate to see a thirsty guard.
translation: 来，这些你留着以后喝，我看不得口渴的守卫。

english: Franksh, that wash just what I need to shtay on guard. No more beersh, I don't want to get drunk.
translation: 弗兰克，这正是我需要保持警戒的东西。不能再喝啤酒了，我不想喝醉。

english: Well, the hours are good.....
translation: 嗯，工作时间还不错……

english: .... But most of those hours are a drag. If only I had spent more time in Knight school when I was a young boy. Maybe I wouldn't be here now, scared of Keli.
translation: ……但大部分时间都很无聊。要是我小时候在骑士学校多花点时间就好了。也许我现在就不会在这里，害怕凯利夫人。

english: You never relax with these people, but it's a good career for a young man and some of the shouting I rather like.
translation: 跟这些人在一起永远不能放松，但对年轻人来说是个好职业，而且有些喊叫我还挺喜欢的。

english: So what do you buy with these great wages?
translation: 那用这些高薪买什么呢？

english: Really, after working here, there's only time for a drink or three. All us guards go to the same bar and drink ourselves stupid.
translation: 说真的，在这里工作后，只有时间喝上一两杯。我们所有守卫都去同一家酒吧，喝得烂醉。

english: It's what I enjoy these days, that fade into unconciousness. I can't resist the sight of a really cold beer.
translation: 这就是我这些天享受的事，逐渐失去意识。我无法抗拒一杯冰啤酒的诱惑。

english: Well, I loved to sit by the lake, with my toes in the water and shoot the fish with my bow and arrow.
translation: 嗯，我喜欢坐在湖边，把脚趾浸在水里，用弓和箭射鱼。

english: That was a strange hobby for a little boy.
translation: 对一个小男孩来说，那是个奇怪的爱好。

english: It kept us from goblin hunting, which was what most boys did. What are you here for?
translation: 这让我们不去打哥布林，那是大多数男孩做的事。你到这里来做什么？

english: WHAT?! Are you trying to bribe me? I may not be a great guard, but I am loyal. How DARE you try to bribe me!
translation: 什么？！你想贿赂我？我可能不是个好守卫，但我忠诚。你竟敢贿赂我！

english: No, no, you got the wrong idea, totally. I just wondered if you wanted some part-time bodyguard work.
translation: 不不，你完全误会了。我只是想知道你是否想做兼职保镖。

english: Oh. Sorry. No, I don't need money. As long as you were not offering me a bribe.
translation: 哦，抱歉。不用，我不缺钱。只要你不是在贿赂我就行。

english: Hello friend, I am just rescuing the prince, is that ok?
translation: 你好朋友，我只是来救王子，可以吗？

english: Thatsh a funny joke. You are lucky I am shober. Go in peace, friend.
translation: 这是个好……好笑的玩笑。算你运气好我还清……醒。平安走吧，朋友。

english: Ok now, you have all the basic equipment. What are your plans to stop the guard interfering?
translation: 好了，你有了所有基本装备。你打算怎么阻止守卫干涉？

english: Well, speaking to him may find a weakness he has. See if there's something that could stop him bothering us.
translation: 嗯，和他谈谈也许能发现他的弱点。看看有没有什么能让他不来打扰我们。

english: Good luck with the guard. When the guard is out you can tie up Keli.
translation: 祝你好运对付守卫。等守卫解决后，你就可以绑起凯利夫人。

english: I was going to attack him.
translation: 我打算攻击他。

english: I don't think you should. If you do the rest of the gang and Keli would attack you. The door guard should be removed first, to make it easy.
translation: 我觉得你不该这么做。如果你攻击，其他同伙和凯利夫人会攻击你。应该先解决门卫，这样更容易。

english: I hoped to get him drunk.
translation: 我希望让他喝醉。

english: Well, that's possible. These guards do like a drink. I would think it will take at least 3 beers to do it well. You would probably have to do it all at the same time too. The effects of the local beer wear off quickly.
translation: 嗯，有可能。这些守卫确实喜欢喝酒。我想至少需要三杯啤酒才能让他醉倒。而且你可能得一次性给他。本地啤酒的效果消退很快。

english: You could try. I don't think the emir will pay anything towards it. And we did bribe one of their guards once.
translation: 你可以试试。但我觉得埃米尔不会为这个付钱。而且我们曾经贿赂过他们的一个守卫。

english: Keli killed him in front of the other guards, as a deterrent. It would probably take a lot of gold.
translation: 凯利夫人在其他守卫面前杀了他，以儆效尤。这恐怕需要很多金币。

english: Prince, I come to rescue you.
translation: 王子，我来救你了。

english: That is very very kind of you, how do I get out?
translation: 你真是太善良了，我怎么出去？

english: With a disguise. I have removed the Lady Keli. She is tied up, but will not stay tied up for long.
translation: 用伪装。我已经处理了凯利夫人。她被绑起来了，但不会绑太久。

english: Take this disguise, and this key.
translation: 拿着这套伪装和这把钥匙。

english: Thank you my friend, I must leave you now. My father will pay you well for this.
translation: 谢谢你我的朋友，我现在必须离开了。我父亲会为此重谢你的。

english: Go to Leela, she is close to here.
translation: 去找莉拉，她就在附近。

english: I owe you my life for that escape. You cannot help me this time, they know who you are. Go in peace, friend of Al-Kharid.
translation: 那次逃跑我欠你一条命。这次你帮不了我了，他们知道你是谁。平安走吧，阿尔卡里德的朋友。

english: You tricked me, and tied me up, Guards kill this stranger!!
translation: 你骗了我，还把我绑起来，守卫们，杀了这个陌生人！！

english: Yes M'lady
translation: 是的，夫人

english: Halt! Who goes there? Friend or foe?
translation: 站住！来者何人？朋友还是敌人？

english: Hi friend, I am just checking out things here.
translation: 嗨朋友，我只是在这里查看一下情况。

english: The Prince got away, I am in trouble. I better not talk to you, they are not sure I was drunk.
translation: 王子逃走了，我有麻烦了。我还是别跟你说话了，他们还不确定我喝醉了。

english: I won't say anything, your secret is safe with me.
translation: 我不会说出去的，你的秘密我会守口如瓶。

english: Thank you, Al-Kharid will forever owe you for your help. I think that if there is ever anything that needs to be done, you will be someone they can rely on.
translation: 谢谢你，阿尔卡里德会永远感谢你的帮助。我想如果有什么事需要做，你会是他们可以信赖的人。

english: The prince is safe and on his way home with Leela. You can pick up your payment from the chancellor.
translation: 王子安全了，正和莉拉一起回家。你可以从大臣那里领取报酬。

english: You have the eternal gratitude of the Emir for rescuing his son. I am authorised to pay you 700 coins.
translation: 感谢你救了他的儿子，埃米尔对你永怀感激。我受命支付你700金币。

english: I see you are getting on well with the rescue. Obtaining a key must have saved you some time.
translation: 我看你的救援工作进展得不错。弄到钥匙肯定省了你不少时间。

english: I need the services of someone yes. If you are interested, see the spymaster, Osman. I manage the finances here. Come to me when you need payment.
translation: 我确实需要有人帮忙。如果你感兴趣，去找间谍头目奥斯曼吧。我负责这里的财务。需要报酬的时候来找我就行。

english: You have the eternal gratitude of the Emir for rescuing his son. I am authorised to give you a reward.
translation: 你救出了埃米尔之子，他对此永怀感激。我受命给予你一份奖励。

english: Osman is aware of this. He will ensure they are not harmed.
translation: 奥斯曼知道这事。他会确保他们不受伤害。

english: '... it isn't you!
'... it is you!
Great! So what do you need?
translation: 太好了！那你需要什么？

english: 'Hoist your mast, [player name], because there's some pirate looty just begging to be uncovered in a far off land! Thanks to me, you could be one of the privileged few to get your hands on it!
translation: “升起你的桅杆，[player name]，因为有个远方的海岛藏着海盗战利品，正等着人去发掘！多亏了我，你才有机会成为少数能拿到它的幸运儿！”

english: Looty? You mean treasure?
translation: 战利品？你是说宝藏？

english: 'Yarr!
translation: “呀嘿！”

english: Well, I can't say no to a bit of treasure. What do I need to do?
translation: 好吧，我无法拒绝一点宝藏。我需要做什么？

english: 'Shiver me timbers! There is a crate full of high value goods just sitting at the port of Sarim!
translation: “吓得我发抖！沙林港那边有个装满高价值货物的板条箱！”

english: Port Sarim? I thought you said far off land?
translation: 沙林港？你不是说远方海岛吗？

english: 'Aye! The far off land of Sarim!
translation: “就是远方！沙林这个远方！”

english: Okay... but surely if this is pirate treasure, someone would have noticed... Port Sarim is a busy place.
translation: 好吧……但既然是海盗宝藏，肯定会有人注意到吧……沙林港可是个繁忙的地方。

english: 'Luckily for us, a cunning Jolly Roger of a pirate has disguised it to look like a normal crate of cargo!
translation: “算我们走运，有个狡猾的海盗旗海盗把它伪装成了普通的货物板条箱！”

english: Hang on... is this actually just a normal cargo delivery? You know there's a notice board on the docks for that sort of thing...
translation: 等等……这其实就只是个普通货物搬运吧？你知道码头有个公告板是专门干这个的……

english: 'Normal?! Normal?! What kind of scallywag are you? There's nothing normal about a valuable crate of precious plundered pirate looty!
translation: “正常？！正常？！你这算是什么无赖？一箱珍贵的海盗掠夺品怎么可能正常！”

english: 'Besides, you've already said you'll do it, and pirates never go back on their word.
translation: “再说了，你已经答应了，海盗从不食言。”

english: I'm fairly certain they do, but fine. I'll go collect this crate for you.
translation: 我很确定他们会食言，但好吧。我去帮你把那个板条箱弄来。

english: 'Me hearty goes out to you! Once you have the looty, just leave it with the port master here. Now, give me your log and I'll write out the details.
translation: “我的心与你同在！拿到战利品后，就交给这里的港口管理员。现在，把你的原木给我，我把详细内容写上去。”

english: I'm afraid I don't have it on me.
translation: 恐怕我没带在身上。

english: 'Well, go get it sailor! Heave to!
translation: “那就去拿，水手！快去！”

english: 'Bit of a problem, I'm afraid! It seems your log is already full! You should get some of this work done before you take on my critical pirate task!
translation: “有点小麻烦！你的原木已经满了！在接下我的关键海盗任务之前，你得先把这些工作处理掉！”

english: 'Now, get to it, sailor! Heave to and ballast your grog!
translation: “现在，行动起来，水手！快去压稳你的格罗格酒！”

english: Actually, I've changed my mind. Maybe another time.
translation: 其实我改主意了。下次再说吧。

english: About that job you wanted doing...
translation: 关于上次你想让我做的那个活……

english: 'Aye! Hoist your mast, [player name], because there's some pirate looty just begging to be uncovered in a far off land! Thanks to me, you could be one of the privileged few to get your hands on it!
translation: “呀！升起你的桅杆，[player name]，因为有个远方的海岛藏着海盗战利品，正等着人去发掘！多亏了我，你才有机会成为少数能拿到它的幸运儿！”

english: 'Aye! You need to collect the pirate looty from the port of Sarim! Once you have it, just leave it with the port master here. Now, give me your log and I'll write out the details.
translation: “呀！你需要去沙林港取回海盗战利品！拿到后交给这里的港口管理员就行。现在，把你的原木给我，我把详细内容写上去。”

english: 'Aye! You need to collect the pirate looty from the port of Sarim! Once you have it, just leave it with the port master here. Heave to, sailor!
translation: “呀！你需要去沙林港取回海盗战利品！拿到后交给这里的港口管理员就行。行动吧，水手！”

english: 'Aye! I see you have the pirate looty! You need to leave it with the port master. Heave to, sailor!
translation: “呀！我看到你拿到海盗战利品了！交给港口管理员吧。行动吧，水手！”

english: Thanks, sailor. I'll get that all sorted out.
translation: 谢了，水手。我会处理好的。

english: I delivered that cargo for you.
translation: 我帮你把那批货运到了。

english: 'Shiver me timbers! That was fast!
translation: “吓得我发抖！真快！”

english: So could I have some 'looty' now?
translation: 那我现在能拿点“战利品”了吗？

english: 'Blistering barnacles! You thought that was it? You are too funny, fellow sailor!
translation: “该死的藤壶！你以为这就完了？你这水手也太逗了！”

english: I get the feeling you're about to ask me to do something else...
translation: 我感觉你又要让我做别的事了……

english: 'Aye! This is no ordinary crate, [player name]. This is a pirate crate! Only a special key can open it for us!
translation: “呀！这可不是普通的板条箱，[player name]。这是海盗箱！只有一把特殊的钥匙才能打开它！”

english: But it is an ordinary crate, Steve. There was even a label on it addressed to you.
translation: 但这明明就是普通板条箱，史蒂夫。上面还有张标签写着你的名字。

english: 'I hope you're not trying to call Squawking Steve Beanie a liar?! That crate is pirate looty, and anything suggesting otherwise is clearly a plot by my rival pirate captains!
translation: '我希望你不是在说呱噪的史蒂夫.比尼是个骗子？！那个板条箱是海盗战利品，任何相反的说法显然都是我的对手海盗船长们的阴谋！

english: Right... So what's this special key then?
translation: 好吧……那这把特殊的钥匙长什么样？

english: 'It is something very few can forge! I suspect we will require the help of a master scallywag smith!
translation: “那是很少有人能锻造的东西！我想我们需要一位大师级无赖铁匠的帮助！”

english: Is it essential that they be a scallywag as well as a smith? If not, I know of a dwarf near Mudskipper Point who might be able to help us.
translation: 有必要既当无赖又当铁匠吗？如果不是的话，我认识弹涂鱼角附近的一个矮人，也许能帮上忙。

english: 'A dwarf? Yarr! That's an acceptable compromise! Ready your port side and go see this dwarf!
translation: “矮人？呀嘿！这是个可接受的折中！准备好你的左舷，去找那个矮人吧！”

english: Okay, I'll grab a redberry pie and go visit Thurgo...
translation: 好的，我带个红莓派去找瑟戈……

english: About that crate that needs opening...
translation: 关于那个需要打开的板条箱……

english: 'Do you have our special key yet?
translation: “我们的特殊钥匙到手了吗？”

english: 'Then ready your port side and go see that dwarf!
translation: “那就准备好你的左舷，去找那个矮人！”

english: I need some help with a 'special key'.
translation: 我需要帮忙做一把“特殊钥匙”。

english: A key? What for?
translation: 钥匙？干什么用的？

english: Well, truth be told, I'm not sure it's really a key that I need. I just need something that can open a crate.
translation: 说实话，我不确定我需要的到底是不是钥匙。我只是需要能撬开板条箱的东西。

english: Ah, well a crowbar should do that. It's a simple tool.
translation: 啊，那用撬棍就行。很简单的工具。

english: Can you help me make one?
translation: 你能帮我做一把吗？

english: I can indeed. We'll need a hammer, a steel bar, and of course, a redberry pie.
translation: 当然可以。我们需要一把锤子、一个钢锭，当然，还有一块红莓派。

english: I don't have all of that I'm afraid...
translation: 我恐怕没有这些东西……

english: That should do nicely.
translation: 这些应该就够了。

english: Thanks! I should probably see what Steve makes of this.
translation: 谢了！我最好看看史蒂夫怎么评价这个。

english: So, can you help me make a crowbar?
translation: 那么，你能帮我做把撬棍吗？

english: Can you help me make another crowbar?
translation: 你能帮我再做一把撬棍吗？

english: 'Stop! We aren't ready to open that yet!
translation: “停下！我们还没准备好打开它！”

english: I made that 'special key' you needed.
translation: 我把你要的“特殊钥匙”做好了。

english: 'Aha! There she crows! This is perfect!
translation: “啊哈！乌鸦叫了！太完美了！”

english: I'm glad you approve. Shall I use it to crack this crate open?
translation: 很高兴你满意。我现在就撬开这个板条箱？

english: 'Wait!
translation: “等等！”

english: 'An artifactof this power needs a test before we try it on our precious looty!
translation: “这么强大的工具，得先测试一下才能用在宝贝战利品上！”

english: Fine. What should I test it on?
translation: 好吧。我该拿什么测试？

english: 'I noticed a crate of grog floating around by the north westmostisland of the Pandemonium. Cast off your keel and sail your vessel over there.
translation: “我注意到在潘德莫尼姆岛最西北边有个装有格罗格酒的箱子漂着。拔锚起航，开船过去。”

english: 'Well, you open it with your new key and sample the contents, of course.
translation: “当然是用你的新钥匙打开它，然后尝尝里面的东西。”

english: Why would I even want to do that? How do you even know it's drinkable?
translation: 我为什么要干那种事？你怎么知道那酒还能喝？

english: 'I'm a true pirate, so I know good grog when I see it. As for why, no sailor has truly experienced the sea until they have drunk everything it has to offer.
translation: “我是个真正的海盗，所以我一眼就能看出好格罗格酒。至于为什么，没有哪个水手真正体验过大海，除非他把大海能提供的一切都喝个遍。”

english: 'In fact, you should keep a log of it all. I know I do!
translation: “事实上，你应该把所有喝过的都记在原木上。我就这么干！”

english: Okay... this doesn't seem very healthy, but fine.
translation: 好吧……这听起来不太健康，但行。

english: 'Yarr! That's the spirit!
translation: “呀！这就对了！”

english: About that crate...
translation: 关于那个板条箱……

english: 'Have you sampled that grog yet, sailor?
translation: “水手，你尝过那格罗格酒了吗？”

english: Not yet. Where can I find it again?
translation: 还没。我去哪找来着？

english: 'I saw it floating around by the north westmostisland of the Pandemonium. Cast off your keel and sail your vessel over there.
translation: “我看到它漂在潘德莫尼姆岛最西北边的海域。拔锚起航，开船过去。”

english: This doesn't look like grog...
translation: 这看起来不像格罗格酒……

english: 'Well, then get to it, you scallywag! Make sure you do it on your vessel as well. It's important to feel that sea air while trying a new drink.
translation: “那么，快动手吧，你这无赖！而且一定要在你的船上喝。尝新酒的时候感受海风很重要。”

english: Drinkies be mine! Leave dem drinkies!
translation: 酒是我的！把酒留下！

english: I have. Did you know that troll was going to jump out and attack me? I had the fright of my life!
translation: 我尝了。你知道有个巨魔会跳出来攻击我吗？把我吓了个半死！

english: 'Ah, blistering barnacles! I did forget to mention that does sometimes happen.
translation: “啊，该死的藤壶！我确实忘了提这种事有时会发生。”
