english: Of course it does. Right, no more wasting time. I'm assuming that's the crate next to you? I'm opening it.
translation: 当然会这样。好了，别再浪费时间了。你旁边那个就是板条箱吧？我要开了。

english: 'Of course! You are the captain after all, my first mate!
translation: “当然！毕竟你才是船长，我的大副！”

english: Let's get this crate open.
translation: 来打开这个板条箱吧。

english: 'Go ahead! You are the captain after all, my first mate!
translation: “动手吧！毕竟你才是船长，我的大副！”

english: 'Your looty, sailor! Take as many as you like.
translation: “你的战利品，水手！想拿多少拿多少。”

english: 'Now, with your new looty in hand, you're ready to take on the seas like never before! Soon you'll be as great a sailor as me! Speaking of which, you're not still using that raft, are you?
translation: “现在，手握新战利品，你准备好以前所未有的姿态征服大海了！很快你就能成为一个像我一样伟大的水手！说到这个，你还在用那个木筏吧？”

english: 'Well, I think it's about time you sort yourself out with an upgrade! You should check in with Jim. I'm sure he'll have something fitting. Now, avast!
translation: “我想你是时候给自己升个级了！去找吉姆问问。我相信他会有合适的东西。现在，撤退！”

english: Have you got any vinegar?
translation: 你有醋吗？

english: Vinegar?
translation: 醋？

english: Vinegar!
translation: 醋！

english: The very idea! My wines are the finest in the district!
translation: 亏你想得出来！我的葡萄酒可是本区最好的！

english: Sorry! I was told to come and speak with a wine merchant about getting some vinegar, I must have the wrong person.
translation: 抱歉！有人让我来找一位葡萄酒商人要些醋，我一定是找错人了。

english: Wait...did HE send you?
translation: 等等……是“他”派你来的吗？

english: If by HE you mean the old man with the sack of bones, then yes.
translation: 如果你说的“他”是指那个背着一麻袋骨头的老人，那么是的。

english: Aaaah...say no more sir, I have some in specially.
translation: 啊……先生，别多说了，我这里特意备了一些。

english: Ah! Good afternoon your lordship. I take it you have come for a refill?
translation: 啊！下午好，老爷。您是来续装的吧？

english: Not today.
translation: 今天不了。

english: Well, just remember I have some in stock for you when you want it.
translation: 好吧，记住我这儿有存货，您想要的时候随时来。

english: Have you brought me any bones?
translation: 你给我带骨头来了吗？

english: Not at the moment. Can you just give me a run down on which bones I have left to get?
translation: 暂时没有。你能给我说一下我还差哪些骨头吗？

english: You still need to bring me a Goblin bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根地精骨头。

english: Goblins are relatively common. I hear there is a house full of them around Lumbridge in fact.
translation: 地精相对常见。我听说仑桥镇附近有一间房子里面全是地精。

english: You still need to bring me a Bear bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根熊骨。

english: I heard that there are some Bears over by the Legends' Guild, near Ardougne.
translation: 我听说在阿多尼城附近的传奇公会那边有一些熊。

english: You still need to bring me a Big Frog bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根大青蛙骨头。

english: This might be a little tricky as you will need to go into the Lumbridge Swamp caves. You will need a light source! Never forget your light source down there!
translation: 这个可能有点棘手，你需要进入仑桥镇沼泽洞穴。你需要一个光源！别忘了带光源下去！

english: You still need to bring me a Ram bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根公羊骨头。

english: I'm sure you will be able to find a ram wherever there are sheep.
translation: 我相信你在有羊的地方就能找到公羊。

english: You still need to bring me a Unicorn bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根独角兽骨头。

english: I seem to remember that there were Unicorns south of Varrock, I think they might be there still.
translation: 我好像记得维洛克城南边有独角兽，我想它们可能还在那里。

english: You still need to bring me a Monkey bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根猴子骨头。

english: Monkeys tend to live in Jungle areas, like Karamja. I think they are pretty plentiful there if I remember correctly.
translation: 猴子通常生活在丛林地区，比如卡拉姆詹岛。如果我没记错的话，那里猴子很多。

english: You still need to bring me a Giant Rat bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根巨鼠骨头。

english: If you can't find one in a sewer, then you might want to try looking in some caves.
translation: 如果你在下水道找不到，或许可以去一些洞穴里看看。

english: You still need to bring me a Giant Bat bone.
translation: 你还需要给我带一根巨型蝙蝠骨头。

english: Giant bats tend to live underground, but I have heard there are a few near the Coal Pits.
translation: 巨型蝙蝠通常生活在地下，但我听说煤坑附近有几只。

english: Yes. I'll get right on it.
translation: 好的，我马上去办。

english: Don't forget to boil them in vinegar first.
translation: 别忘了先把它们放在醋里煮。

english: Just chuck some logs into the pit, put the bone in the pot of vinegar and drop it onto the pot-boiler. Then light the logs and wait for the the vinegar to boil away.
translation: 只需往坑里扔些原木，把骨头放进一罐醋里，然后把罐子放到煮锅上。接着点燃原木，等醋煮干。

english: Ok, I'll remember.
translation: 好的，我记住了。

english: I have some bones for you.
translation: 我给你带了些骨头。

english: Great! Let me take a look at them.
translation: 太棒了！让我看看。

english: Wonderful! I'll put this with the rest.
translation: 太好了！我把这个和其余的一起放。

english: No problem. I'll be back if I find some more.
translation: 没问题。如果我找到更多骨头会再来的。

english: Great! Just clean them up in the pot-boiler and hand them over.
translation: 好极了！只需把它们在煮锅里清理干净，然后交给我就行了。

english: That's the last of them!
translation: 这是最后一批了！

english: The museum will be thrilled to know I've completed the collection.
translation: 博物馆知道我完成了收藏一定会非常激动。

english: Well I'm just glad I could help.
translation: 我很高兴能帮上忙。

english: Well you've been a big help and no mistake.
translation: 你帮了大忙，一点没错。

english: I'm always on the lookout for fresh bones, so if you see some bring them right over.
translation: 我一直在留意新鲜骨头，所以如果你看到一些，就直接带过来。

english: No problem, I'll be sure to bring anything you might like over if I find something.
translation: 没问题，如果我找到你可能喜欢的东西，一定会带过来的。

english: I can't wait to see the displays once they are finished.
translation: 我等不及想看完成后的展览了。

english: That...that covers all the bones I was searching for!
translation: 这……这就是我一直在寻找的所有骨头了！

english: Well I'm glad to have furthered the cause of the museum.
translation: 很高兴能为博物馆的事业尽一份力。

english: I just hope everyone will enjoy the finished displays.
translation: 我只希望每个人都能喜欢完成的展览。

english: Yes, I'm sure EVERYONE will get a chance to enjoy my work.
translation: 是的，我确信“每个人”都有机会欣赏我的作品。

english: Hahahahahahahahahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: Bwahahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
translation: 哇哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: MWUHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHA!
translation: 姆哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: Well anyway, I have a few items I've put together in my spare time if you want one.
translation: 总之，我闲暇时做了几样东西，如果你想要的话可以给你一件。

english: I have a ram skull helm or a snazzy bonesack like mine.
translation: 我有一个公羊头骨头盔，或者像我这样时髦的骨袋。

english: Which would you like?
translation: 你想要哪个？

english: Good choice!
translation: 好选择！

english: Come and see me if you lose that one, I have plenty more!
translation: 如果你弄丢了那个，就来找我，我还有好多！

english: The bonesack.
translation: 骨袋。

english: Well chosen, I knew you had taste!
translation: 选得好，我就知道你有品位！

english: Can I have both?
translation: 我两个都能要吗？

english: I... Well... I do have many of each. I suppose it wouldn't be a problem.
translation: 我……嗯……我每种都有很多。我想应该没问题。

english: Well, as much as I'd like to toss them into the dirt and all, I think it's best if you came back later with an empty backpack.
translation: 嗯，虽然我很想把它们扔到泥土里什么的，但我觉得你最好还是等会儿背着空背包再来。

english: I do think they go well together, actually.
translation: 事实上，我觉得它们搭配起来确实不错。

english: Come and see me if you lose either one, I have plenty more!
translation: 如果你弄丢了任何一个，就来找我，我还有好多！

english: Oh yes, before I forget - are you still in the adventuring business?
translation: 哦对了，趁我还没忘——你还在做冒险这行吗？

english: I am! Do you have another quest for me?
translation: 当然！你又有任务给我吗？

english: Well, I don't - but I happen to know someone who might!
translation: 嗯，我没有——但我碰巧知道有人可能有！

english: Who's that then?
translation: 那是谁？

english: Well, there are these two ladies who are looking for adventurers with cats.
translation: 是这样的，有两位女士正在寻找带着猫的冒险者。

english: They called themselves 'The Ratcatchers'.
translation: 她们自称‘捕鼠者’。

english: Ratcatchers, eh? Where would I find them?
translation: 捕鼠者，是吗？我在哪里能找到她们？

english: They told me they generally hang about in the sewers below Varrock. I can't stand it down there, or I'd have looked into this ratcatching business myself.
translation: 她们告诉我她们通常待在维洛克城下面的下水道里。我可受不了那下面，不然我自己就去调查这捕鼠的营生了。

english: I wouldn't have thought you'd have much business down in the sewers.
translation: 我没想到你在下水道里还能有什么生意。

english: I've had to drag Shilop and Wilough out of there more times than I care to count, the little rascals.
translation: 我已经记不清把希洛普和威洛从那里面拖出来多少次了，那两个小捣蛋鬼。

english: I don't know which is harder, raising kids or cats.
translation: 真不知道养孩子和养猫哪个更难。

english: Thank you Gertrude, I'll be sure to have a look for these ratcatchers.
translation: 谢谢你，格特鲁德，我一定会去找找那些捕鼠者的。

english: Very well. Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 很好。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Interesting, but I'm a bit busy right now. Maybe another time.
translation: 有意思，但我现在有点忙。下次再说吧。

english: Oh yes, before I forget I think there are some people you should meet.
translation: 哦对了，趁我还没忘，我觉得你应该去见一些人。

english: The two ladies you said I could find in Varrock's sewers? Yes, you told me about them.
translation: 你说我在维洛克城下水道能找到的那两位女士？是的，你告诉过我了。

english: Oh good. You can go and see them in the sewers whenever you're not too busy. Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 哦，那就好。等你不忙的时候可以去下水道找她们。现在，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I'm Gertrude's friend. She said you two were-
translation: 我是格特鲁德的朋友。她说你们两位是——

english: Ratcatchers?
translation: 捕鼠者？

english: Oh yes, we know lots about ratcatching.
translation: 哦，是的，我们对捕鼠可了解不少。

english: But why should we tell you?
translation: 但我们凭什么要告诉你？

english: These are our trade secrets, you know.
translation: 这可是我们的商业机密，你知道吗。

english: My cat and I are adventurers. If you could teach us a trick or two I bet it would come in handy!
translation: 我和我的猫是冒险者。如果你们能教我们一两招，肯定能派上用场！

english: We'll have to confer.
translation: 我们得商量一下。

english: I don't think cats even do tricks.
translation: 我觉得猫根本不会耍把戏。

english: Don't be stupid! Can we teach [him/her/them] ratcatching?
translation: 别傻了！我们能教[him/her/them]捕鼠吗？

english: I don't know. Seems a bit weird.
translation: 我不知道。感觉有点奇怪。

english: I can hear you, you know!
translation: 我听得见你们说话，知道吗！

english: We'll set [him/her/them] a task, see how it goes.
translation: 我们给[him/her/them]设个任务，看看情况如何。

english: Great idea!
translation: 好主意！

english: I already have this medal that Gertrude gave me for catching 100 rats. Will that do?
translation: 我已经有格特鲁德给我的抓了一百只老鼠的奖章了。那个行吗？

english: That's no good. How do we know you didn't buy it?
translation: 那可不行。我们怎么知道你不是买的？

english: You could trust me?
translation: 你们可以相信我啊？

english: Boo! Bring on the task!
translation: 嘘！来任务吧！

english: Right, if you catch 8 ratsies with your cat...
translation: 好，如果你用你的猫抓到八只小老鼠……

english: We'll tell you what we know.
translation: 我们就告诉你我们知道的东西。

english: Sound fair?
translation: 听起来公平吗？

english: I suppose so. How will you know that I've completed your task?
translation: 我想是吧。你们怎么知道我完成了任务？

english: We'll smell your cat, of course!
translation: 我们当然会闻你的猫！

english: Um... alright.
translation: 呃……好吧。

english: Great! Let's have a sniff then.
translation: 太好了！那让我们闻闻吧。

english: Are you alright, cat?
translation: 你还好吗，猫？

english: I'll live.
translation: 死不了。

english: Yup. Definitely a cat!
translation: 没错。绝对是只猫！

english: A real pongy one, too.
translation: 而且味道还挺冲的。

english: Go on then, go splat them ratsies!
translation: 那就去吧，去拍扁那些小老鼠！

english: Splat 'em! Squash 'em!
translation: 拍扁它们！压扁它们！

english: Er, will do.
translation: 呃，会的。

english: [He's/She's/They're] back!
translation: [He's/She's/They're]回来了！

english: [Has he/Has she/Have they] splatted some ratsies?
translation: [Has he/Has she/Have they]拍扁了一些小老鼠吗？

english: [He needs/She needs/They need] [amount] more of 'em.
translation: [He needs/She needs/They need]还需要[amount]只。

english: How many, er, 'ratsies' do I have to catch again?
translation: 呃，我还要抓多少只‘小老鼠’来着？

english: 8 ratsies. And your cat has to catch them. Any you get don't count.
translation: 八只小老鼠。而且必须是你猫抓的。你自己抓的不算。

english: Got it!
translation: 明白了！

english: Nope!
translation: 没有！

english: Not even one!
translation: 一只都没有！

english: Rubbish!
translation: 真差劲！

english: Alright, no need to rub it in.
translation: 好了，没必要这么挖苦人。

english: Good job puss, we really showed those rats what for.
translation: 干得好，猫咪，我们真让那些老鼠见识了厉害。

english: What for what now?
translation: 见识什么厉害？

english: Oh never mind, it's just a turn of phrase.
translation: 哦，算了，只是个说法而已。

english: Speaking of turning faces, we should tell those funny-smelling humans that we're done.
translation: 说到换个话题，我们应该告诉那些气味古怪的人类我们搞定了。

english: Suppose so.
translation: 我想也是。

english: Miaow.
translation: 喵。

english: Well cat, we should tell Grimesquit and Phingspet that we're done.
translation: 好了猫，我们应该告诉格里姆斯奎特和芬格斯佩特我们搞定了。

english: They're not going to be able to sniff whether I was successful or not unless I bring my cat with me.
translation: 除非我带着我的猫，否则她们没法闻出来我是否成功了。

english: I splatted the ratsies for you.
translation: 我帮你们拍扁了小老鼠。

english: Why are you talking like that?
translation: 你为什么那样说话？

english: Are you making fun of us?
translation: 你在取笑我们吗？

english: Sorry, I just thought... won't happen again.
translation: 抱歉，我只是以为……不会再这样了。

english: So did you splat them ratsies or what?
translation: 那么你到底有没有拍扁那些小老鼠？

english: Er, yes, I did... catch the rats.
translation: 呃，是的，我抓到了……那些老鼠。

english: Haha, nice!
translation: 哈哈，不错！

english: Splat! Splat!
translation: 啪！啪！

english: Can you tell me about ratcatching now?
translation: 现在能告诉我关于捕鼠的事了吗？

english: Ha! Seems you already know plenty!
translation: 哈！看来你已经知道得够多了！

english: Oh yes, you're a real ratcatching prodigy.
translation: 哦，是的，你真是个捕鼠天才。

english: Reminds me of us when we were little.
translation: 让我想起了我们小时候。

english: I'm not sure that's a compliment...
translation: 我不确定这是不是夸奖……

english: Well, there's nothing more we can teach you.
translation: 嗯，我们没什么能教你的了。

english: Not much at all!
translation: 一点都没有！

english: What? So we've just caught all these rats for nothing?
translation: 什么？所以我们抓了这么多老鼠都白抓了？

english: Isn't there anything you can teach me? I caught a lot of rats, you know...
translation: 难道就没有什么能教我的吗？我抓了很多老鼠，你知道的……

english: Here, have a rat pole.
translation: 给你，拿根捕鼠杆吧。

english: Um, thanks. What's this for?
translation: 呃，谢谢。这是干什么用的？

english: You can stick all the ratsies your cat splats on it.
translation: 你可以把你猫拍扁的所有小老鼠都串在上面。

english: Oh. Just what I wanted.
translation: 哦。正是我想要的。

english: Now now, keep your shirt on.
translation: 好了好了，别激动。

english: We'll send you to Jimmy.
translation: 我们会把你送到吉米那里去。

english: Ooh, yes, Jimmy will know how to help.
translation: 哦，是的，吉米知道该怎么帮忙。

english: Where do I find this... Jimmy?
translation: 我在哪里能找到这个……吉米？

english: Jimmy Dazzler hangs out in Ardougne.
translation: 吉米.达兹勒经常在阿多尼城出没。

english: Ooh, and he is dazzling!
translation: 哦，而且他真是光彩照人！

english: Shut up, Grimesquit!
translation: 闭嘴，格里姆斯奎特！

english: Say hello to Jimmikins from me, won't you?
translation: 替我向小吉米问好，好吗？

english: Er, sure.
translation: 呃，当然。

english: I's bored wit dis chaterboxing, let's splat some more ratsies.
translation: 俺都听腻了这唠唠叨叨的，咱们再去拍些小老鼠去。

english: O 'ello what's we gots 'ere?
translation: 哦，看看咱们这有啥好东西？

english: What's up with them?
translation: 它们怎么了？

english: What a slack jawed mindless creature.
translation: 真是个迟钝无脑的生物。

english: Ha! We were only playing with you.
translation: 哈！我们只是跟你玩玩而已。

english: There's not much we can teach you here.
translation: 这里也没什么我们能教你的了。

english: Will we tell him about Jimmy and the rat pits?
translation: 我们要不要告诉他吉米和鼠坑的事？

english: Here have's a rat pole.
translation: 给你个捕鼠杆。

english: You gots all de dead ratsies with you.
translation: 你手上有死老鼠了是吧。

english: Go on, go on, tell them about Jimmy, go on.
translation: 说啊，说啊，告诉他们吉米的事，快说啊。

english: You can stick the ratsies your fuzzy catches onto it.
translation: 你可以把你那毛茸茸的家伙抓到的老鼠插上去。

english: Ha! Ha, ha, ....ha .......ha.
We knows lots about rat splattering.
translation: 俺们对拍老鼠可懂得多了。

english: Wa?
translation: 啥？

english: Ha! Everyone knowses only dogsies does trickses.
translation: 哈！谁都知道只有狗才会耍把戏。

english: Set's em a task and we'll sees.
translation: 给它们个任务，俺们看看。

english: Has dey caught de ratsies?
translation: 它们抓到老鼠了吗？

english: 8 ratsies. An' your fuzzy 'as to catch them. Any you gets don't count.
translation: 八只老鼠。而且得是你那毛茸茸的家伙抓的。你自己抓的可不算数。

english: I 'ears ya. Bet's ya I'll squash more ratsies dan you....
translation: 俺听着呢。打赌俺拍的老鼠肯定比你多……

english: Wha? No fuzzy, bah!
translation: 啥？没有毛茸茸的家伙，呸！

english: Ya, lets splats, and squasherise so...
translation: 是，咱们就开拍，开始碾压……

english: Set's em a task and then we'll sees.
translation: 给它个任务，俺们再看看。

english: Nah that won't do. How do we know you didn't buy it?
translation: 不，那可不行。我们怎么知道你不是买来的？

english: Stick the ratsies your fuzzy catches onto it.
translation: 把你那毛茸茸的家伙抓到的老鼠插上去。

english: Ha! I nose the truth when I 'ears it!  Get it? Get it? Nose the truth?
translation: 哈！我听到实（识）话就知（鼻）道！懂吗？懂吗？用鼻（识）子闻出实（识）话？

english: I have no dialogue sadly...
translation: 可惜我没有对话……

english: Ah, you must be [player name]. I've been expectoratingyou.
translation: 啊，你一定是[player name]。我一直在期待你。

english: You... have?
translation: 你……是吗？

english: I have. The Sisters Grime told me you'd be dropping in.
translation: 是的。格里姆姐妹告诉我你会来。

english: They said you could teach me a thing or two about ratcatching.
translation: 她们说你能教我一些捕鼠的技巧。

english: Well, I could, but I need a little more motivation than that.
translation: 嗯，我是可以啦，但我需要再多点动力才行。

english: I didn't get this far by giving out help freely to every adventurer who came my way.
translation: 我可不是靠随便帮助每个路过的冒险者才混到今天的。

english: Maybe I could help you out with something then?
translation: 那或许我能帮你做点什么？

english: I am an adventurer after all.
translation: 毕竟我可是个冒险者。

english: Ah, that's mincemeat to my ears!
translation: 啊，这话我爱听！

english: Music?
translation: 音乐？

english: No thank you! Your unrefined caterwauling would only draw attention.
translation: 不了谢谢！你那粗俗的鬼哭狼嚎只会引来不必要的注意。

english: How about I test your ratcatching mettle instead?
translation: 不如让我先试试你的捕鼠能耐？

english: Oh, your hands are full. Don't worry, I'll hold onto this map until you can jettison all that rubbish.
translation: 哦，你两手都满了。别担心，这张地图我先替你保管，等你把那些垃圾都扔掉再说。

english: Take a good long look at this map.
translation: 好好看看这张地图。

english: A client of mine, a merchant of some repute, is having a sorbet.
translation: 我的一个客户，一位颇有名望的商人，正在举办一场冰沙宴。

english: A soy - a fancy party. Don't interrupt me again.
translation: 冰沙——就是个豪华派对。别再打断我了。

english: This client of mine has a problem, a small furry one.
translation: 我这个客户有个麻烦，一个毛茸茸的小麻烦。

english: He'd be better off calling a doctor about that.
translation: 那他该去找医生才对。

english: No, you fool! A rat problem.
translation: 不，你这傻瓜！是老鼠的问题。

english: So you want me to go to his place and kill some rats? That sounds easy enough.
translation: 所以你是要我去他家杀些老鼠？听起来挺简单的。

english: Ah, but it's not that simple. Here's your first lesson - we ratcatchers must be discreet.
translation: 啊，但可没那么简单。这是你的第一课——我们捕鼠者必须行事谨慎。

english: Our wealthier clients would be ruined if word got out that their fancy mansions were filled with vermin.
translation: 如果消息传出去，说他们豪华的宅邸里满是害虫，那些有钱的客户可就身败名裂了。

english: Oh, I see. So I have to do this covertly?
translation: 哦，我明白了。所以我得暗中进行？

english: Precisely!
translation: 正是！

english: Now just in case, I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allow you carryout this task with some element of safety.
translation: 以防万一，我会对你施一个法术，让你在执行任务时稍微安全些。

english: Are you going to cast an invisibility spell on me? That should make it easy.
translation: 你要对我施隐身术吗？那应该会轻松很多。

english: Not quite. If you're spotted, this spell will teleport you a short distance away and render the last few seconds of your discoverer's memory blank.
translation: 不完全对。如果你被发现了，这个法术会把你传送到一小段距离之外，并擦掉发现你的人最后几秒钟的记忆。

english: That's really useful!
translation: 那真有用！

english: Where'd you learn that spell, anyway?
translation: 话说回来，你从哪学到这个法术的？

english: That's a trade secret, m'afraid.
translation: 恐怕这是商业机密。

english: Well, can you teach me?
translation: 那你能教我吗？

english: Oh my, no. Can you imagine if all the riffraff in Ardougne got wind of this?
translation: 哦天啊，不行。你能想象如果阿多尼城里的所有乌合之众都知道了会怎样吗？

english: We already have a serious crime problem.
translation: 我们已经有严重的犯罪问题了。

english: But there's plenty more I can teach you about ratcatching... if you complete the task I've set you.
translation: 不过关于捕鼠，我还有很多可以教你……只要你完成我交给你的任务。

english: Do you have any tips for me now?
translation: 你现在有什么建议给我吗？

english: Of course! Use a cat to catch the rats.
translation: 当然有！用猫来抓老鼠。

english: Don't look a gilt horse in the mouth!
translation: 别对镀金的马儿吹毛求疵！

english: You mean a gift horse?
translation: 你是指礼物马儿吧？

english: I'll gift you no such thing! Now go on, get out of here!
translation: 我才不会送你什么马！快走，给我滚出去！

english: Off I go then...
translation: 那我走了……

english: Ah, you're back. Have you completed your mission?
translation: 啊，你回来了。任务完成了吗？

english: I've lost the map you gave me. Can I have another?
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的地图了。能再给我一张吗？

english: Here you go, don't lose this one.
translation: 拿去，别再弄丢了。

english: Haven't I given you the map already? I'm sure I have. I can't afford to be throwing maps around nilly willy.
translation: 我不是已经给过你地图了吗？我确定有。我可不能随便乱丢地图。

english: What am I meant to do again?
translation: 我要做什么来着？

english: Read the directions on the map to get to the manor. Once there, eliminate any rats you see with your cat and return to me unseen. Got it?
translation: 按照地图上的指示牌前往庄园。到了之后，用你的猫消灭所有看到的老鼠，然后神不知鬼不觉地回来见我。懂了？

english: Got it. Thanks for the reminder.
translation: 懂了。谢谢提醒。

english: I think I should have a cat big enough to catch rats with me before I go.
translation: 我觉得我出发前应该带一只大到能抓老鼠的猫才行。

english: I don't want to go there again. I barely managed to get out the first time.
translation: 我不想去那里了。上次差点逃不出来。

english: These directions are from Ardougne. It would be much easier to find the place if I left from there.
translation: 这些指示牌是从阿多尼城来的。如果我从那里出发，应该更容易找到这个地方。

english: I think I'll go there some other time.
translation: 我想改天再去那里。

english: Directions to... here, actually! I'd better hold onto them until I complete Jimmy's task.
translation: 指示牌指向……这里，其实！我最好留着它们，直到完成吉米的任务。

english: These night shifts just go on and on.
translation: 这些夜班真是没完没了。

english: I'm so bored...
translation: 我好无聊……

english: A Thief!
translation: 有盗贼！

english: Good job, Puss, I think that just about wraps things up here.
translation: 干得好，小猫咪，我想这里的事差不多都解决了吧。

english: Aw, really? I was enjoying that.
translation: 啊，真的吗？我正玩得开心呢。

english: I'm a cold blooded, claw toting, hitkitty.
translation: 我可是个冷血、带爪子的杀手猫。

english: A callous cat.
translation: 一只冷酷的猫。

english: I knew you had a dark side.
translation: 我就知道你有黑暗面。

english: I have many dark sides.
translation: 我有很多黑暗面。

english: Well, we had better get out of here. Let's do it quietly.
translation: 好吧，我们最好离开这里。要悄悄地走。

english: Ah [player name], aren't you just the ticket?
translation: 啊 [player name]，你真是个小能手！

english: A job well done. Confabulations!
translation: 任务完成。恭喜恭喜！

english: No, the job really is done!
translation: 不，任务真的完成了！

english: Never mind. So you'll teach me all about ratcatching now?
translation: 算了。那你现在可以教我所有关于捕鼠的事了吧？

english: Of course! If you want to learn about ratcatching, get yourself to the Rat Pits here in Ardougne.
translation: 当然！如果你想学习捕鼠，就去阿多尼城的鼠坑吧。

english: It's a great place for training kittens. Just look at Bones here!
translation: 那是训练小猫的好地方。看看这边的骨头！

english: I think of nothing but murder all day!
translation: 我整天只想着杀戮！

english: He does look good at catching rats. But what about older cats?
translation: 他看起来确实很会抓老鼠。但大一点的猫呢？

english: Ah, well. My good friend Hooknosed Jack can tell you all about those.
translation: 啊，这个嘛。我的好朋友钩鼻杰克可以告诉你所有关于它们的事。

english: He has the oldest cat I've ever seen.
translation: 他有我见过最老的猫。

english: Where do I find this... Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到这个……钩鼻杰克？

english: I'll tell him to look out for you.
translation: 我会让他留意你的。

english: What goes on in these pits then?
translation: 那么这些坑里到底发生了什么？

english: I'd have thought it was self-exploratory. Here, have a manual.
translation: 我以为这很明显呢。拿去，有本手册。

english: Here, take this, you might find it useful.
translation: 拿去，你可能会觉得有用。

english: Ah, [player name] I've been expecting you.
translation: 啊，[player name]，我一直在等你。

english: I have. Those repulsive sisters from the Varrock sewers sent word.
translation: 是的。维洛克城下水道里那对讨厌的姐妹传了话过来。

english: I could, but I would need a motivation. I didn't pick up this clobber~He motions towards his silken robes.bygiving out help freely to every adventurer who camemy way.
translation: 我可以，但得有点动力。我这身行头——他指指自己身上的丝袍——可不是靠免费帮每个路过的冒险者得来的。

english: Ah that's music to my ears.
translation: 啊，这真是天籁之音。

english: No, no. I've just the ticket right here.
translation: 不，不。我这儿正好有你要的东西。

english: Yes just the ticket. Here take this.
translation: 对，就是这个。拿着。

english: Now, a wealthy client of mine, a merchant of high repute, is having a soiree.
translation: 我有个富有的客户，一位声誉很高的商人，要办个晚会。

english: A party.~He gives you a look of disdain. Now please don't interrupt me any further. He has a problem, a small furry one.
translation: 一个派对。—他轻蔑地看了你一眼。—请别再来打断我了。他有个问题，一个毛茸茸的小问题。

english: No, no, no. It's not that simple. He can't afford to have you seen on his premises. If a vermin catcher were to be seen in his manor, think of the damage it would do to his reputation.
translation: 不，不，不。没那么简单。他不能让你出现在他地盘上。要是有个捕鼠匠被人看到出现在他的庄园里，那对他的名声会是多大的打击啊。

english: That's it, that's the very ticket.
translation: 没错，就是这个。

english: Not quite.~You receive an uncertain smile. You can see that hisconfidence in you isn't limitless.
translation: 还差一点。—你看到他一个不确定的笑容。可以看出他对你的信心有限。

english: ~Jimmy gives you a knowing smile.
translation: —吉米对你露出一个会心的微笑。

english: If I told everyone all my secrets would I be as well off as I am now?
translation: 如果我把所有秘密都告诉每个人，我还能像现在这么有钱吗？

english: Well let's get on with things. Carry out this simple task and I'll aid you.
translation: 好了，我们继续吧。完成这个简单的任务，我就帮你。

english: Congratulations on a job well done.
translation: 任务完成得不错，祝贺你。

english: Ahh, now, that's something I didn't say.
translation: 啊，这个我可没说过。

english: Well I can show you into the rat pits of Ardougne, great place it is for training kittens. Teach them young you know.
translation: 好吧，我可以带你进阿多尼城的鼠坑，那是训练小猫的好地方。从小教起，你懂的。

english: Ah now. If you're wanting to be knowing about grown cats Hooknosed Jack is your ticket.
translation: 啊，这样。如果你想了解成年猫的事，钩鼻杰克才是你要找的人。

english: One question at a time. The pits lie below this very pub.
translation: 一个问题一个问题来。鼠坑就在这家酒馆下面。

english: ~On mention of Phingspet and Grimesquit hesubconsciously shudders.
translation: —提到芬格斯佩特和格里姆斯奎特时，他下意识地打了个寒颤。

english: ~He gives you a dazzling smile, his pearly whites bothpearly and white.
translation: 他向你露出灿烂的笑容，牙齿洁白如珍珠。

english: ~Jimmy flashes you an unconvincing smile.
translation: —吉米向你露出一个没什么说服力的微笑。

english: See that ladder there? Well that's the ticket.
translation: 看到那边那个梯子了吗？那就是门路。

english: Take a good and long look at this map.
translation: 好好仔细看看这张地图。

english: The spell will, if you're spotted, teleport you a smalldistance away and render the last few seconds of yourdiscoverer's memory blank.
translation: 这个法术的效果是，如果你被发现了，它会把你传送到一小段距离外，并抹去发现者最后几秒的记忆。

english: Now scram, get going. And remember the maps your ticket.
translation: 现在快走，去吧。记住，地图就是你的门路。

english: ~Jimmy Dazzles you with another one of his trademarksmiles.
translation: —吉米用他另一个招牌笑容让你眼花缭乱。

english: It's the ticket, my friend, it's the ticket.
translation: 就是这个办法，我的朋友，就是这个办法。

english: Now I'm going to cast a spell on you that will allowyou carry out this task with some element of safety.
translation: 现在我要对你施一个法术，让你能在一定程度上安全地完成这个任务。

english: Oh yes, one more thing. Use a cat to dispose of the rats. Sword play is really too noisy. Using your cat is...
translation: 哦对了，还有一件事。用猫来对付老鼠。舞剑实在太吵了。用你的猫则是……

english: That just isn't the ticket. I don't know you nor I will not answer any questions. Now get gone from here, you'll attract unwanted attention to me.
translation: 那可不对头。我不认识你，也不会回答任何问题。现在滚开，你会给我招来不必要的注意。

english: Ah you're back.
translation: 啊，你回来了。

english: Read the directions on the map to get to the manor. Once there discretely eliminate the rats there with your cat and return to me unseen. Can you remember that?
translation: 看地图上的指示牌找到庄园。到了之后用你的猫悄悄清除那里的老鼠，然后不被发现地回来找我。记住了吗？

english: ~Jimmy gives you an uncertain smile.
translation: —吉米对你露出一个不确定的微笑。

english: Got your hands full? Don't worry I'll hold on to this map for now. Come back when you're less burdened.
translation: 手头满了？别担心，我先帮你保管这张地图。等你空下来再来拿。

english: Haven't I given you the map already? I'm sure I have. I can't afford to be throwing maps around willy nilly.
translation: 我不是已经给过你地图了吗？我确定给过了。我可不能随便乱丢地图。

english: Haven't I given you the map already? Well take it out, and if you don't have it go and get it. I can't afford to be throwing maps around willy nilly.
translation: 我不是已经给过你地图了吗？拿出来，如果没有就去拿。我可不能随便乱丢地图。

english: Here you go, now don't lose this one.
translation: 给你，这次别弄丢了。

english: Got your hands full? No worries, I'll hold on to this map for now. Come back when you're less burdened.
translation: 手头满了？别担心，我先帮你保管这张地图。等你空下来再来拿。

english: Hello! Are you Hooknosed Jack?
translation: 你好！你是钩鼻杰克吗？

english: Depends who's asking. What do you want?
translation: 那要看是谁问的。你想要什么？

english: Jimmy Dazzler sent me. He said you could help train my grown cat to catch rats.
translation: 是吉米.达兹勒派我来的。他说你可以帮我训练我成年的猫抓老鼠。

english: I expect he wants me to do that for free, does he?
translation: 我想他是要我免费做这事，对吧？

english: Well, I'm an adventurer. There must be something I can do for you in return.
translation: 嗯，我是个冒险者。应该有什么我能为你做的回报你吧。

english: I'm too busy to babysit you and your moggy.
translation: 我太忙了，没空照看你和你那只猫。

english: Oh, come on.
translation: 哦，别这样嘛。

english: No, really. Me and Pox have too much going on.
translation: 不，真的。我和波克斯有太多事要忙了。

english: We've got a big job to finish today, I can't teach you how to catch rats on top of that.
translation: 我们今天有个大活儿要完成，我可不能在这之上再教你怎么抓老鼠。

english: Well I could be your apprentice! I've already got hands-on experience.
translation: 那我可以当你的学徒！我已经有实际经验了。

english: Oh yes? What sort of experience?
translation: 哦，是吗？什么样的经验？

english: I helped the Grime Sisters catch loads of rats in the sewers, and I cleared out a whole mansion in Ardougne for Jimmy Dazzler.
translation: 我帮污垢姐妹在下水道抓了一大堆老鼠，还帮吉米.达兹勒清空了一整座阿多尼城的庄园。

english: I bet you did. Typical Jimmy, leaving the hard work to everyone else.
translation: 我猜也是。典型的吉米，总是把苦活留给别人干。

english: So what do you say? Can me and my cat help you out?
translation: 那你觉得怎么样？我和我的猫能帮你忙吗？

english: Oh, alright then. But you'd better not give me or Pox any trouble!
translation: 哦，好吧。但你最好别给我或波克斯惹任何麻烦！

english: We won't!
translation: 我们不会的！

english: I'd better not regret this...
translation: 我最好别后悔这个决定……

english: Right, your first task is to clear out a warehouse south of here.
translation: 好了，你的第一个任务是清理南边的一个仓库。

english: All you need to do is poison the rat holes with some bait. Can you handle that?
translation: 你只需要用一些诱饵来毒老鼠洞。这能搞定吗？

english: I think so. Will any type of poison do?
translation: 我想可以。什么类型的毒药都行吗？

english: Are you daft? You need rat poison to kill rats!
translation: 你傻了吗？杀老鼠当然要用老鼠药！

english: If you can't mix a batch up for yourself, there's sure to be some lying around here somewhere.
translation: 如果你自己调不出一份，这附近肯定放着一些。

english: Would this stuff do?
translation: 这个东西能用吗？

english: It certainly will! There's hope for you yet.
translation: 当然可以！你还算有救。

english: How would I mix my own rat poison?
translation: 我该怎么自己调配老鼠药？

english: Honestly, kids these days...
translation: 说真的，现在的年轻人啊……

english: Just bring me the base ingredients, and I'll mix it up for you.
translation: 把基本材料拿来给我，我帮你调。

english: What are the ingredients then?
translation: 那材料是什么？

english: Get me some Kwuarm, some red spider eggs, and a vial.
translation: 给我弄点库阿姆草、一些红色蜘蛛卵和一个空瓶来。

english: Right, to poison the rats you'll need some tasty bait.
translation: 没错，要毒死那些老鼠，你需要一些美味的诱饵。

english: They love a bit of cheese, so pour some poison on that and then leave it in the rat holes.
translation: 它们很喜欢乳酪，所以把毒药倒一些在上面，然后放进老鼠洞里就行了。

english: Okay, can do.
translation: 好的，没问题。

english: Report back to me when you're done.
translation: 做完之后回来向我报告。

english: And no slacking!
translation: 可别偷懒！

english: Can you make me some rat poison?
translation: 你能给我做些老鼠药吗？

english: Have you got the ingredients for me yet?
translation: 你把材料给我带来了吗？

english: No, not yet. What do I need again?
translation: 还没呢。我需要什么来着？

english: Get some Kwuarm, Red SpiderEggs and an empty vial. Bring them to me, and I'll make a batch of rat poison for you.
translation: 弄些库阿姆草、红色蜘蛛卵和一个空瓶来。把它们带给我，我就给你做一批老鼠药。

english: Do you see that bar to the south of here? Well, behind that is the warehouse. The rats are on the first floor.
translation: 你看到南边那家酒吧了吗？嗯，那后面就是仓库。老鼠在一楼。

english: I've finished the job. Now will you teach me more about ratcatching?
translation: 我干完活了。现在你能教我更多关于捕鼠的事了吗？

english: You're pulling my leg!
translation: 你在耍我吧！

english: Who, me?
translation: 谁，我吗？

english: Yes, you! You think I can't tell you're lying? Now get back to the warehouse and kill those rats!
translation: 没错，就是你！你以为我看不出你在撒谎吗？现在给我回仓库去，把那些老鼠干掉！

english: Um... let me think about this one.
translation: 嗯……让我想想。

english: No! That would be stupid.
translation: 不！那太蠢了。

english: Putting random things in rat holes isn't my idea of fun.
translation: 把乱七八糟的东西往老鼠洞里塞，我可觉得不好玩。

english: Well that's one less rat hole. I had better finish the job off quick before they start to reproduce again.
translation: 嗯，少了一个老鼠洞。我最好在它们开始繁殖之前赶紧把活干完。

english: Hmm, that should do the trick. Those rats should soon die off.
translation: 嗯，应该能行。那些老鼠应该很快就会死光。

english: I poisoned the rats in the warehouse! Do you have time to teach me about grown cats yet?
translation: 我把仓库里的老鼠都毒死了！你现在有时间教我关于成年猫的事了吗？

english: Not right now, [player name].
translation: 现在不行，[player name]。

english: Are you serious? I've gone and done a job for you, the least you could do is say thanks.
translation: 你是认真的吗？我辛辛苦苦替你干了活，你至少也该说声谢谢吧。

english: Can't you see I'm upset?
translation: 你没看到我正心烦吗？

english: It's my cat, Pox. She's half dead, bless her.
translation: 是我的猫，波克斯。她快不行了，可怜的小家伙。

english: They found her at the warehouse you were working at. She must have eaten some of the rats you poisoned.
translation: 他们在你干活的那个仓库里找到了她。她肯定是吃了你毒死的老鼠。

english: Can I help? I feel somewhat responsible...
translation: 我能帮忙吗？我觉得我有点责任……

english: That's kind of you, [player name].
translation: 你真好，[player name]。

english: There's an apothecary here in town, he could help. Tell him that the poison was made from red spiderseggs and kwuarm. He should know what to do. Go quickly.
translation: 镇上有个药剂师，他也许能帮忙。告诉他毒药是用红色蜘蛛卵和库阿姆草做的。他应该知道怎么做。快去吧。

english: Putting things in poisoned rat holes isn't my idea of fun.
translation: 把东西放进下了毒的老鼠洞里，我可觉得不好玩。

english: I need to talk to you about cats.
translation: 我需要和你谈谈关于猫的事。

english: As I said before, I'm the apothecary not the vet.
translation: 我之前就说过了，我是药剂师，不是兽医。

english: Well, do you know anything about poisons?
translation: 那你懂毒药吗？

english: Of course I do! What kind of poison do you need help with?
translation: 当然懂！你需要什么毒药方面的帮助？

english: How about rat poisons and anti-posisons for cats?
translation: 老鼠药和猫用的解毒剂怎么样？

english: I think I can help you with that. What happened?
translation: 我想我能帮上忙。发生什么事了？

english: Okay. Hooknosed Jack's cat, Pox, ate some rats which were poisoned with a Kwuarm and Red SpiderEgg based concoction.
translation: 好吧。钩鼻杰克的那只猫，波克斯，吃了些老鼠，那些老鼠被一种用库阿姆草和红色蜘蛛卵做的毒药毒死了。

english: Not Pox! I remember when she was a kitten... hang on, I have no time for dilly dallying.
translation: 不是波克斯！我还记得她小时候是只小猫……等等，我没时间闲逛了。

english: I know just the thing to help Pox out.
translation: 我正好知道怎么帮波克斯。

english: Great! How can I help?
translation: 太好了！我能帮什么忙？

english: I need a Bucket of Milk, some Ground Unicorn Horn, and a bit of Marrentill.
translation: 我需要一桶牛奶、一些研磨过的独角兽的角，还有一点马伦提尔草。

english: Quick, get this to Jack. If I know him, he wouldn't have sent someone else to do this if Pox wasn't seriously ill.
translation: 快，把这个给杰克。以我对他的了解，要不是波克斯病得很重，他不会派别人来做这件事的。

english: You need to get a Bucket of Milk, Ground Unicorn Horn and some Marrentill before I can create a cat anti-poison potion for you.
translation: 你需要弄到一桶牛奶、研磨过的独角兽的角和一点马伦提尔草，我才能为你制作猫用解毒药水。

english: You need to get some Ground Unicorn Horn and Marrentill before we can proceed.
translation: 你需要弄到一些研磨过的独角兽的角和马伦提尔草，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get a Bucket of Milk and some Marrentill before we can proceed.
translation: 你需要弄到一桶牛奶和一些马伦提尔草，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get a Bucket of Milk and some Ground Unicorn Horn before we can proceed.
translation: 你需要弄到一桶牛奶和一些研磨过的独角兽的角，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get some Ground Unicorn Horn before we can proceed.
translation: 你需要弄到一些研磨过的独角兽的角，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get some Marrentill before we can proceed.
translation: 你需要弄到一些马伦提尔草，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get a Bucket of Milk before we can proceed.
translation: 你需要弄到一桶牛奶，我们才能继续。

english: What are you hanging around here for? You've got the anti-poison, so go give it to Jack. Quickly!
translation: 你还在这儿晃悠什么？你已经拿到解毒剂了，快拿去给杰克。快点！

english: Could you make me another cat anti-poison potion?
translation: 你能再给我做一份猫用解毒药水吗？

english: No problem! I'll need some more ingredients though.
translation: 没问题！不过我还需要一些材料。

english: Uh... I don't have all the ingredients on me at the moment.
translation: 呃……我手头现在没有全部的材料。

english: Well hurry up and fetch them! Poor Pox is in serious danger. That poison she consumed was incredibly strong.
translation: 那就赶紧去拿！可怜的波克斯情况很危险。她吃下的毒药非常厉害。

english: Have you got the anti-poison?
translation: 你拿到解毒剂了吗？

english: I knew I forgot something. I'll be back in a second.
translation: 我就知道忘了什么东西。我马上回来。

english: Just hurry up, will you?
translation: 快点行吗？

english: Yes, I've got it right here.
translation: 是的，我拿到了，就在这儿。

english: Thank you [player name]. Thank you so much.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。太感谢你了。

english: No worries there, I'd be sorry to see poor Pox come to harm.
translation: 别客气，我也不忍心看到可怜的波克斯受到伤害。

english: Well, thanks to you, she'll live to see another day.
translation: 嗯，多亏了你，她又能活下去了。

english: I have to have a word with you about the job you did in the warehouse.
translation: 我得跟你谈谈你在仓库干的那份活。

english: I did a good job, didn't I?
translation: 我干得不错，对吧？

english: The thing is, you didn't quite finish the warehouse job.
translation: 问题是，你仓库的活没干完。

english: Wait, but I poisoned all the rat holes just like you said.
translation: 等等，但我按你说的，把所有老鼠洞都下了毒啊。

english: You did, but one rat survived... the biggest, nastiest one of the lot.
translation: 你是下了毒，但有一只老鼠活了下来……是最大、最凶的那只。

english: Well, I'm not scared of big, nasty rats.
translation: 嗯，我可不怕大老鼠、凶老鼠。

english: I hope not, because someone's got to get rid of it, and me and Pox are out of action.
translation: 我希望如此，因为总得有人去干掉它，而我和波克斯现在都动不了。

english: Don't worry - we're on the case.
translation: 别担心——这事交给我们了。

english: I really underestimated you, [player name]. Best of luck.
translation: 我真是小看你了，[player name]。祝你好运。

english: Have you killed the King Rat yet?
translation: 你干掉鼠王了吗？

english: Umm... no.
translation: 嗯……还没有。

english: Look, you did me and Pox a big favour, but that's not an excuse to slack off.
translation: 听着，你帮了我和波克斯一个大忙，但这不能成为你偷懒的借口。

english: How's Pox doing anyway?
translation: 话说回来，波克斯怎么样了？

english: Oh, she's doing alright...
translation: 哦，她还好……

english: Oi! You can't distract me like that. Get on with you, and get rid of that rat!
translation: 喂！你别想这样转移我的注意力。赶紧去，把那只老鼠干掉！

english: Be careful in there, cat!
translation: 在里面小心点，猫咪！

english: Go get that nasty rat, don't hold back!
translation: 去抓住那只可恶的老鼠，别退缩！

english: Pfssst!
translation: 噗嘶嘶！

english: Go get him, kitty!
translation: 去抓住它，小猫咪！

english: Come here, kitty.
translation: 过来，小猫咪。

english: They say you've killed the King Rat.
translation: 他们说你杀了鼠王。

english: Just barely! I was getting worried for my cat, but we pulled through.
translation: 差一点就完了！我一直在担心我的猫，但我们挺过来了。

english: Your cat?
translation: 你的猫？

english: Yes! The King Rat was holed up behind a wall, so I had to send my cat in to get it.
translation: 是啊！鼠王躲在一堵墙后面，所以我只好派我的猫进去抓它。

english: Well, imagine that. You two must have a great bond. Perhaps I can show you a thing or two after all.
translation: 嗯，真想不到。你们俩一定感情很好。也许我终究还是能教你一两招的。

english: See that manhole over there? Climb down it to enter the Varrock Rat Pits.
translation: 看到那边的下水道检查井了吗？爬下去就能进入维洛克鼠坑。

english: Thank you so much! I imagine my cat will learn a lot in there.
translation: 太感谢了！我想我的猫在里面能学到很多东西。

english: Just you look after it.
translation: 你可要照顾好它。

english: Say, if you want to know more about the ratcatching business, you should seek out Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim. He was a skilled ratcatcher, back in the day.
translation: 对了，如果你想了解更多关于捕鼠这一行的事，你应该去凯尔达格林城找老烟枪.乔。他当年可是个技艺高超的捕鼠者。

english: Give me a sec.
translation: 稍等一下。

english: I'm upset at the moment. I just found my cat Pox, and the poor thing's half dead.
translation: 我现在很难过。我刚找到我的猫波克斯，这可怜的家伙半死不活的。

english: They found Pox at the warehouse you were working at. He must have eaten some of the rats you poisoned.
translation: 他们在你工作的那个仓库里找到了波克斯。它肯定是吃了你毒死的老鼠。

english: You didn't quite finish that job I set you.
translation: 我交代给你的活儿，你没干利索。

english: There is an apothecary here in town, seek his help. Tell him that the poison was made from red spiders eggs and kwuarm. He should know what to do. Go quickly.
translation: 镇上有家药剂师，去找他帮忙。告诉他毒药是用红色蜘蛛卵和库阿姆草做的。他应该知道该怎么办。快去。

english: Well one rat survived, the biggest nastiest one of the lot.
translation: 嗯，有一只老鼠活了下来，是那群里面最大最凶的一只。

english: Thank you [player name] thank you so much.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]，太感谢你了。

english: I'm afraid it was. You said you'd clear the warehouse of rats, I do remember.
translation: 恐怕是的。你说过要把仓库里的老鼠清掉，我记得很清楚。

english: Ah, it's [player name], isn't it? Jimmy D said you'd be along. So what can I do for you?
translation: 啊，是[player name]吧？吉米.达兹勒说你快来了。找我有什么事？

english: Do you have a problem with my face?
translation: 你对我的脸有意见？

english: I did now get to it.
translation: 我现在就去办。

english: Uh.... I guess not. It's just that most.. ah forget it.
translation: 呃……我想不是。只是大多数……啊，算了。

english: Nah. I'm too busy.
translation: 不，我太忙了。

english: No really, I'm just too busy at the moment. I've got three jobs going at the minute and I just don't have any time for helping the likes of you out.
translation: 真的，我现在实在太忙了。手头有三件活儿，没空帮你这种人。

english: Ah you've met the sisters. Lovely girls aren't they?
translation: 啊，你见过那对姐妹了。可爱的姑娘们，是吧？

english: I suppose there is this job I have just south of here. I need to get someone to clear out a warehouse of rats. It should be a simple job of poisoning a few rat holes. Nothing too complicated.
translation: 我想这里南边正好有件活儿。我需要有人清掉一个仓库里的老鼠。应该只是往几个老鼠洞里下毒的事，没什么复杂的。

english: No you need rat poison to kill rats. Mix up a batch of the stuff for yourself.
translation: 不，你得用老鼠药来杀老鼠。自己去配一批吧。

english: Report back to me when you're done and I want to get this job wrapped as soon as possible.
translation: 干完了就回来报告，我想尽快把这件活儿结了。

english: To poison the holes you'll need some bait. Use some cheese for this.
translation: 要给洞下毒，你需要些诱饵。用点乳酪吧。

english: My sources tell me that you were successful in killing the rat?
translation: 我的线人告诉我，你成功杀死那只老鼠了？

english: Your own cat?
translation: 你自己的猫？

english: Ha, ha! There's hope for you yet. Perhaps I can show you a thing or two in the pits. See that manhole o'er there? Climb down it to enter the Varrock pits.
translation: 哈哈！你小子还有希望。也许我能在坑里教你两手。看到那边的下水道检查井了吗？爬下去就能进入维洛克城的鼠坑。

english: I'm no expert on the larger cats, if you want to train overgrown cats seek out Smokin' Joe in Keldagrim, you know the Dwarven city?
translation: 我对大猫不太了解，如果你想训练成年猫，去凯尔达格林城找老烟枪.乔吧，你知道那个矮人城市吧？

english: Argh! Don't worry your little head about it, you're obviously incapable. Just bring me the base ingredients.
translation: 啊！别费你那小脑袋了，你显然不行。直接把基础材料带来给我。

english: Get me some Kwuarm and some red spider eggs. Oh ya an empty vial would be good too.
translation: 给我弄点库阿姆草和红色蜘蛛卵。哦，再拿一个空瓶也不错。

english: I'm sure I've seen some lying around the odd time.
translation: 我肯定偶尔见过它们乱丢在地上。

english: Pour some of the poison on the cheese and then place some of the poisoned cheese in each of the rat holes.
translation: 把一些毒药倒在乳酪上，然后把毒乳酪放进每个老鼠洞里。

english: You don't happen to have all these ingredients on you at the moment?
translation: 你现在不会恰好带着这些材料吧？

english: In the words of that rogue Jimmy Dazzler himself, 'That's the ticket!'.
translation: 用那个盗贼吉米.达兹勒本人的话来说：“这就是门票！”

english: Get some Kwuarm, red spider eggs and an empty vial. Once you've found those bring them to me, and I'll make a batch of the stuff for you.
translation: 弄点库阿姆草、红色蜘蛛卵和一个空瓶。找齐后就带给我，我帮你配一批神秘物质。

english: Have you spoken to the apothecary yet?
translation: 你跟药剂师谈过了吗？

english: Have you completed the task yet?
translation: 任务完成了吗？

english: Would you ever finish that task? You might have saved my cat Pox, but thanks to you I'm further behind than I was before I met you.
translation: 你到底能不能把那件活儿干完？你虽然救了我的猫波克斯，但托你的福，我现在比认识你之前落后更多了。

english: Quit trying to hoodwink me and do the job you said you would.
translation: 别想糊弄我，去做你答应过的事。

english: The warehouse is in the first floor of a building to the south of here.
translation: 仓库位于南边一栋建筑的一楼。

english: The poor thing will live. Thanks in no small part to you. But could you please get on with exterminating that last rat.
translation: 那可怜的小家伙能活下来。多亏了你。但你能不能赶紧去把最后那只老鼠干掉。

english: Do you see that bar to the south of here? Well behind that is the warehouse, look in the first floor for the rats.
translation: 你看到南边那家酒吧了吗？那后面就是仓库，到一楼找老鼠。

english: Do hurry up. I don't know how long Pox can hold on for.
translation: 快点啊。我不知道波克斯还能撑多久。

english: Hmm... this isn't working as well as I'd hoped.
translation: 嗯……这效果没我预想的那么好。

english: Miaaaaow!
translation: 喵嗷嗷！

english: Hold on, let me equip my Catspeak Amulet so we can talk.
translation: 等等，让我戴上猫语护符，这样我们就能说话了。

english: Hey [player name], talk to me.
translation: 嘿，[player name]，跟我说话。

english: Can't you see I'm busy adventuring?
translation: 你没看到我正在忙着冒险吗？

english: Look, I know you're having fun, but you're doing this all wrong.
translation: 听着，我知道你玩得很开心，但你的方法全错了。

english: Well then smarty paws, what should I be doing?
translation: 哼，聪明爪，那我该怎么做？

english: What we have here is a two cat job.
translation: 我们这儿需要两只猫才能干的活。

english: You're smoking the rats out, but the smoke clears fast enough for them to run back in before you can catch them.
translation: 你在用烟熏老鼠，但烟雾散得太快，它们在你抓到之前又跑回去了。

english: I can see that for myself, thanks.
translation: 我自己看得见，谢了。

english: Listen, why don't you leave the rat-catching to the expert? Tell me when you're going to start the fire and I'll run and catch the rats.
translation: 听着，你为什么不把捕鼠的事交给专家？告诉我你什么时候点火，我就跑去抓老鼠。

english: Great idea. I'll get right to it.
translation: 好主意。我马上去做。

english: Hey cat, you know the drill, get going!
translation: 嘿，猫，你知道规矩，快去吧！

english: Exterminate! Exterminate!
translation: 消灭！消灭！

english: Sorry, I got a little carried away there.
translation: 抱歉，我有点太激动了。

english: Hey cat, great job. What an ambush!
translation: 嘿，猫，干得好。好一场伏击！

english: Mua-ha-ha!
translation: 呜哈哈！

english: You know, you really scare me sometimes.
translation: 你知道吗，你有时候真吓到我。

english: Isn't it obvious?*Wheezes*
translation: 这还不明显吗？*喘息*

english: *Joe splutters a few times, but finally clears his throat.
translation: *乔结巴了几次，但终于清了清嗓子。

english: *After two attempts Joe gets his breath back Joeeventually manages to speak.*
translation: *尝试了两次后，乔终于喘过气来，最终能说话了。*

english: That's .....
Ahhh that's better. Ooohhh boy,*Joe takes a deep breath.*
translation: 啊，好多了。哦哦哦，天啊，*乔深吸一口气。*

english: Ahh sure wasn't it years of blowing smoke into rat holes that has done this to me?*Wheeze*That and probablythe pipe I used to smoke.*Wheeze*
translation: 啊，难道不是多年来往老鼠洞里吹烟才把我害成这样吗？*喘*还有我以前抽烟用的烟斗。*喘*

english: *Gulp*You offered to help me.
translation: *吞咽*你主动提出要帮我。

english: That's sim... bluaaghhaha... simple. Take this pot light the contents and blow the smoke into the hole.
translation: 这很简……噗啊哈哈……单。拿这个罐子，点燃里面的东西，把烟雾吹进洞里。

english: *The dwarf looks sceptically at you.*
translation: *矮人怀疑地看着你。*

english: You're right.*Wheeze*With my lungs in theircurrent state I just can't take chances.
translation: 你说得对。*喘息*以我肺现在的状况，我可不能冒险。

english: Ahheem, ahh ahh,*Splutters*
translation: 啊哼，啊，啊，*结巴着*

english: Try the stairs into the basement of the 'Laughing Miner'. A grand watering hole it is.
translation: 试试通往'笑矿工'地下室的楼梯。那可是个很棒的水坑。

english: Why of course! Where else would us ratcatchers train our wily cats?
translation: 当然啦！不然我们捕鼠者还能去哪儿训练我们狡猾的猫？

english: They're quite nice, but just don't compare with what they have in Port Sarim.
translation: 它们很不错，但还是比不上沙林港那边的。

english: Bluaaghhaha!  Sorry about that.
translation: 噗啊哈哈！抱歉。

english: Well good show. Good*Wheeze*Bluaaghhaha.*Wheeze*good show.
translation: 嗯，干得好。好*喘息*噗啊哈哈*喘息*干得好。

english: Anyway I'm trying to get rid of these rats, but mylungs just aren't up for it like they used to be.Bluaaghhaha.
translation: 总之我想把这些老鼠赶走，但我的肺不像以前那么顶用了。噗啊哈哈。

english: I'm trying to smoke these pesky rats out.  Bluaaghhaha.
translation: 我想把这些讨厌的老鼠熏出来。噗啊哈哈。

english: *Joe breaks into another bout of coughing.*
translation: *乔又一阵咳嗽。*

english: *Wipes some phlegm from the corner of his mouth.*
translation: *擦掉嘴角的一些痰。*

english: I just don't think you've got the ears for it.
translation: 我只是觉得你没有那个耳朵。

english: Ya well that's not too difficult, it's just really a case of trial and error and being a good mimic. Tuning your ears is the hardest part.
translation: 是啊，那不算太难，其实就是一个试错过程，并且要善于模仿。训练你的耳朵是最难的部分。

english: No, I don't need such trinkets. See these ears? I can tune them to any language I like.
translation: 不，我不需要那些小玩意儿。看到这对耳朵了吗？我可以把它们调到任何我喜欢的语言。

english: Just take a simple pot, stick some garden weeds in it.Light it and then use it on a rat hole.
translation: 就拿个普通的罐子，塞点花园杂草进去。点燃它，然后用在老鼠洞上。

english: Have you got that job done yet?
translation: 那活儿干完了吗？

english: Aheeh ah,*Takes deep breath.*Well maybe there's hope for them yet. I appreciateyour help hugely.
translation: 啊呃啊，*深吸一口气*嗯，也许它们还有希望。我非常感谢你的帮助。

english: Joe just shakes his head.
translation: 乔只是摇了摇头。

english: Help me out and I can show you into the ratpits here in Keldagrim.
translation: 帮我一把，我就带你进入凯尔达格林城的老鼠坑。

english: Tha..,*Wheeze*Than..*Wheeze*than..k.*Bluaaghhaha*thanks anyway.
translation: 谢...*喘息*谢...*喘息*谢...谢。*噗啊哈哈*总之谢谢了。

english: Ya, and your cat tells me that you don't deserve all the credit.
translation: 是啊，你的猫告诉我，功劳不全是你一个人的。

english: ...[player name]?
translation: ……[player name]？

english: Um, yes?
translation: 嗯，什么事？

english: Boss wants to talk to you. She's downstairs in the pits.
translation: 老大想跟你谈谈。她在楼下的斗兽坑里。

english: Hello, The Face said you wanted to speak with me.
translation: 你好，“丑脸”说你想跟我谈谈。

english: Ah, we meet at last. My fellow ratcatchers tell me you're quite the talent.
translation: 啊，我们终于见面了。我的捕鼠者同伴们说你很有天赋。

english: Ah, modesty. A trait seldom displayed by adventurers like yourself.
translation: 啊，谦虚。这在你这样的冒险者身上可不常见。

english: Epic poems aren't usually commissioned by the shy and retiring.
translation: 史诗般的诗可不是写给害羞又退缩的人的。

english: I do indeed. In fact, that's why I wanted to talk to you.
translation: 确实如此。事实上，这就是我想跟你谈的原因。

english: So you'll show me how to turn my cat into a wily cat?
translation: 那你愿意教我怎么把猫变成机灵的猫吗？

english: Ah, ah, ah - not so fast.
translation: 啊，啊，啊——别急。

english: Let me guess... you want me to catch some rats for you first?
translation: 让我猜猜……你是想让我先帮你抓些老鼠？

english: Alright then, what's the job?
translation: 那好吧，什么任务？

english: Nothing too difficult. Just rid the port of every single rat... at once.
translation: 没什么太难的。就是把港口里的每一只老鼠全部消灭……一次性搞定。

english: At once?!
translation: 一次性？！

english: Yep. I expect to see all the rats in Port Sarim dead in one, decisive action.
translation: 没错。我希望看到沙林港所有的老鼠在一次果断的行动中全部死亡。

english: Deadly!
translation: 真狠！

english: So why do you want all the rats wiped out at once?
translation: 那你为什么想把所有老鼠一次性消灭？

english: About me?! How flattering.
translation: 关于我？真荣幸。

english: No, silly. A poem about the art of ratcatching.
translation: 不，傻瓜。是一首关于捕鼠艺术的诗。

english: Poetry might be my bread and butter, but catching rats is my real passion.
translation: 诗歌或许是我的生计，但抓老鼠才是我真正的热情所在。

english: Couldn't you just use some 'creative license' instead?
translation: 你就不能发挥点‘艺术加工’吗？

english: Not to disappoint you, but this task might be beyond my capabilities...
translation: 不想让你失望，但这个任务可能超出了我的能力……

english: Don't be so hard on yourself!
translation: 别对自己这么苛刻！

english: Besides, it's not difficult. I myself performed the very same feat just a few years ago.
translation: 再说了，这并不难。我自己几年前就完成过同样的壮举。

english: You did? How?
translation: 你做过？怎么做到的？

english: Ha! Nice try. You'll have to figure that out for yourself.
translation: 哈！想得美。你得自己琢磨出来。

english: It was worth a shot...
translation: 试试也无妨……

english: Any luck killing all the rats yet?
translation: 把老鼠都杀光了吗？

english: Kill all the rats in Port Sarim in one, swift action.
translation: 一次性迅速行动，杀死沙林港的所有老鼠。

english: Right. I'd better figure out how I'm going to do that...
translation: 好吧。我最好想想怎么做到……

english: Have you spoken with the boss yet?
translation: 你跟老大谈过了吗？

english: Yes. Actually, I wanted to ask you about the task she gave me...
translation: 是的。其实我想问你关于她交给我的任务……

english: Stop right there. You'll get not hints out of me.
translation: 打住。你休想从我这里得到任何提示。

english: You know, you're very pretty...
translation: 你知道吗，你很漂亮……

english: Ha! That's a good one.
translation: 哈！真会说话。

english: I hope you're better at ratcatching than lying.
translation: 我希望你捕鼠的本事比说谎的本事强。

english: That's a powerful-looking cat you have there.
translation: 你那只猫看起来很强悍。

english: Bellemorde? Beautiful, isn't she?
translation: 贝勒莫德？很美吧？

english: Er... yes.
translation: 呃……是的。

english: I've had her since she was a kitten. Felkrash trained her for me.
translation: 它还是小猫的时候我就养了。费尔克拉什帮我训练的。

english: Oh really? Does she know any cool tricks?
translation: 哦真的吗？它会什么酷炫的把戏吗？

english: Oh yes! There was this one time she helped Felkrash wipe out all the rats in town by -
translation: 哦当然！有一次它帮费尔克拉什清掉了镇上所有的老鼠，用——

english: Oh, I see. Nice try, [player name], but you'll have to be cleverer than that.
translation: 哦，我明白了。想得美，[player name]，但你得比这更聪明才行。

english: Almost had it...
translation: 差点就套出来了……

english: I just don't think Felkrash was that impressive.
translation: 我只是觉得费尔克拉什没那么厉害。

english: All the other ratcatchers I've met had loads of tricks to show me.
translation: 我遇到的其他捕鼠者都有好多把戏给我看。

english: In comparison, Felkrash was just... disappointing.
translation: 相比之下，费尔克拉什就……令人失望。

english: How dare you! Felkrash is the greatest ratcatcher Gielinor's ever seen!
translation: 你竟敢这么说！费尔克拉什是吉莱诺尔有史以来最伟大的捕鼠者！

english: Oh yeah? What's the most impressive thing she's done then?
translation: 哦是吗？那她做过最了不起的事是什么？

english: I'll have you know she once killed all the rats in Port Sarim with just one attack!
translation: 我告诉你，她曾经只用一次攻击就杀光了沙林港所有的老鼠！

english: I don't know. That just sounds like one of her stories.
translation: 我不信。听起来就像她编的故事。

english: It's true! I saw it happen. She used a magic flute to charm the rats into the sea!
translation: 是真的！我亲眼看到的。她用一支魔法长笛把老鼠引诱到海里！

english: Wait... I uh, I shouldn't have said that.
translation: 等等……我，呃，我不该说的。

english: Don't worry, I won't tell Felkrash you snitched.
translation: 别担心，我不会告诉费尔克拉什是你泄密的。

english: You'd better not!
translation: 你最好别说！

english: They charm snakes over in Pollnivneach... maybe they charm rats, too?
translation: 他们在波尼尼镇用笛子诱蛇……也许也能用笛子诱老鼠？

english: Oh it's you again.
translation: 哦，又是你。

english: Oh, er, really?
translation: 哦，呃，是吗？

english: I shouldn't have told you that story. Shame on you for coaxing it out of me.
translation: 我不该跟你说那个故事的。真不要脸，居然套我的话。

english: If it makes you feel better, I lie to a lot of people.
translation: 如果这样能让你好受点的话，我经常对很多人说谎。

english: I think I know how to carry out your task.
translation: 我想我知道怎么完成你的任务了。

english: Oh yes? Has The Face been telling tales again?
translation: 哦，是吗？“丑脸”又在讲故事了？

english: Really, she didn't.
translation: 真的，她没有。

english: Can you help me learn how to charm animals?
translation: 你能帮我学习如何诱引动物吗？

english: That depends. How much are you willing to pay?
translation: 那得看情况。你愿意付多少钱？

english: I'm not paying you again!
translation: 我不会再付你钱了！

english: Listen, do you know someone called Felkrash?
translation: 听着，你认识一个叫费尔克拉什的人吗？

english: Felkrash the Bard? Pah!
translation: 吟游诗人费尔克拉什？呸！

english: I taught her all she knows about animal charming, and then she used my knowledge to kill!
translation: 她懂的那些诱引动物的本事全是我教的，然后她用我的知识去杀生！

english: What's wrong with killing rats? That is her job, after all.
translation: 杀老鼠有什么错？毕竟那是她的工作。

english: Music should never be used to kill.
translation: 音乐绝不应该用来杀生。

english: When I first met Felkrash we sang about love, not war.
translation: 我第一次遇到费尔克拉什时，我们歌唱的是爱，而不是战争。

english: Oh, things were a lot better in those days.
translation: 哦，那时候日子好多了。

english: So there's nothing I could do to get you teachme how to charm rats?
translation: 那我就没办法让你教我诱引老鼠了？

english: Absolutely nothing.
translation: 绝对没办法。

english: What if I offered you a drink?
translation: 如果我请你喝一杯呢？

english: I'd say thank you very much and take it.
translation: 我会说非常感谢然后接过来。

english: But would you teach me?
translation: 但你会教我吗？

english: That might depend on how the drink tasted.
translation: 那可能得看这杯酒的味道如何。

english: So what's your favourite drink then?
translation: 那你最喜欢喝什么？

english: Beer, just plain old beer.
translation: 啤酒，就普通的啤酒。

english: Ahh, that hit the spot.
translation: 啊，真是爽口。

english: So will you teach me now?
translation: 那现在你愿意教我了吗？

english: But... but...
translation: 但是……但是……

english: I don't have any beer on me.
translation: 我身上没有啤酒。

english: That's too bad!
translation: 那太可惜了！

english: What if I offered you some food?
translation: 如果我请你吃些食物呢？

english: I'd say I wasn't hungry.
translation: 我会说我不饿。

english: What if I offered you some money?
translation: 如果我给你一些钱呢？

english: Now we're talking.
translation: 这还差不多。

english: How much money are we talking about?
translation: 多少价钱？

english: I'll teach you for [amount] coins.
translation: 我教你，收费[amount]金币。

english: I don't have that much money!
translation: 我没那么多钱！

english: You're a resourceful looking adventurer. I'm sure you'll figure something out.
translation: 你是个足智多谋的冒险者。我相信你会有办法的。

english: I'll go get more money...
translation: 我去弄更多钱……

english: What if I offered you 50 coins?
translation: 如果我付你50金币呢？

english: Yes... that sounds fair...
translation: 是的……听起来合理……

english: It's not that difficult. Here, take these.
translation: 其实并不难。来，拿着这些。

english: I'd give you a flute to go with it, but I see you've kept the last one I gave you!
translation: 我本想再给你一支长笛搭配，不过我注意到你还留着上次我给你的那支！

english: Study the sheet music carefully. Playing it on the flute will draw rats to you like flies to a bucket of camel dung.
translation: 仔细研究乐谱。用长笛吹奏它会吸引老鼠到你身边，就像苍蝇被一桶骆驼粪便吸引一样。

english: Forget about it. I don't care that much.
translation: 算了。我没那么在意。

english: What? I'm offering something invaluable, and you'll quibble over a couple of coins?
translation: 什么？我提供的可是无价之宝，你还要为了几个金币讨价还价？

english: No, I'm done here.
translation: 不，我到此为止了。

english: Good luck finding someone else to help...
translation: 祝你好运找到别人帮忙……

english: I'll do it for half the price.
translation: 我半价做。

english: I'll do it for quarter the price.
translation: 我四分之一价做。

english: I'll...
You'll what?
translation: 你怎样？

english: An eighth?
translation: 八分之一？

english: I'll give you no more than 100 coins.
translation: 我最多给你100金币。

english: What if I said I'd kill you?
translation: 如果我说我会杀了你呢？

english: If you killed me, you'd never learn my technique.
translation: 如果你杀了我，你就永远学不到我的技术了。

english: I've lost the flute.
translation: 我把长笛弄丢了。

english: I need a new flute and some music.
translation: 我需要一支新长笛和一些音乐。

english: There you go. Now if you don't mind, I'm busy performing.
translation: 给你。现在，如果你不介意，我正忙着表演呢。

english: How do I charm rats again?
translation: 再说一遍怎么诱引老鼠来着？

english: Do you remember that flute I gave you?
translation: 还记得我给你的那支长笛吗？

english: And the music?
translation: 那音乐呢？

english: Well, play the music that's on the sheet and that should do the trick.
translation: 嗯，照着乐谱上的音乐吹奏就行了，应该能奏效。

english: If it means that you'll leave me alone, I would give you my snake charming super starter kit complete with flute and basket.
translation: 要是能让你别来烦我，我愿意把我的超级蛇笛新手套装给你，里面还有长笛和篮子。

english: Not a thing.
translation: 没事。

english: Music should never be used to kill. I remember when we used to sing about love, not war nor killing.
translation: 音乐不该用来杀戮。我记得我们以前唱的是爱，不是战争或杀戮。

english: Pah!
translation: 呸！

english: Go on. Who?
translation: 说吧，是谁？

english: No way what?
translation: 没门什么？

english: You're a resourceful looking adventurer I'm sure you'll work out something.
translation: 你看起来是个足智多谋的冒险者，我相信你总能想出办法的。

english: That depends.
translation: 那得看情况。

english: A glint of gold temporarily flashes across the charmerseyes.
translation: 驯蛇人眼中闪过一丝金光。
我这就……

english: Ummm... alright so.
translation: 嗯……好吧，那这样。

english: What? I'm offering something invaluable and you'll quibble over a couple of coins?
translation: 什么？我拿出的可是无价之宝，你还要为了几个金币跟我讨价还价？

english: ~You can literally see the glint of money light up acrosshis eyes.
translation: ~你能清楚地看到他眼中闪过金钱的光芒。

english: A look of disgust crosses his face.
translation: 他脸上露出厌恶的表情。

english: ~The glint begins to wane a little.
translation: ~那光芒开始有点黯淡了。

english: Oh things were a lot better in those days.
translation: 哦，那时候的日子可好过多了。

english: It's not all that difficult, here take these.
translation: 其实没那么难，来，拿着这个。

english: Read the music, and copy what it says when you play the flute. You should attract rats to you like flies to a bucket of dung.
translation: 阅读乐谱，并在吹奏长笛时照谱演奏。你应该能像苍蝇被一桶粪便吸引那样，把老鼠吸引过来。

english: I taught her all she knows about animal charming, andthen she uses the knowledge to kill.
translation: 我把我所知道的驯兽知识都教给了她，结果她却用这些知识去杀人。

english: I would give you a flute aswell but you've still got that one I gave you, so make do with that..
translation: 我本来也想再给你一支长笛，但你手上还有我上次给你的那支，所以就用那个凑合吧……

english: You can see the snake charmer's resolve visiblycrumble.
translation: 你能明显看到驯蛇人的决心在瓦解。

english: If it means that you'll leave me alone, I will give you my snake charming super starter kit complete with flute and basket. But you're clearly over burdened as it is.
translation: 如果这样能让你放过我，我就把我的驯蛇超级入门套装给你，里面有长笛和篮子。不过你现在明显已经拿不了更多东西了。

english: Ok you have a deal.
translation: 好，成交。

english: Well what's holding you back then? You have your own snake charming flute.
translation: 那你还在等什么？你自己不是有驯蛇长笛吗。

english: Ah, I see you've lost your basket. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're ruining the show.
translation: 啊，看来你把篮子弄丢了。给你，现在别来烦我了！你毁了我的表演。

english: I'll be waiting for you.
translation: 我会等着你的。

english: Hah! You'd never get away with it. I've paid up all my protection money this week to the Menaphite and bandit thugs. You'd be doing well to leave this town alive.
translation: 哈！你绝对逃不掉的。这周我已经把保护费都交给梅奈菲特和强盗暴徒了。你能活着离开这个镇子就算你走运了。

english: Well play the music that's on the sheet and that should do the trick.
translation: 那就照着乐谱上的音乐吹，应该就能奏效了。

english: Ah, I see you've lost your charming flute. Here you go, now leave me alone! You're distracting my punters... erm, I mean crowd.
translation: 啊，看来你把驯兽长笛弄丢了。给你，现在别来烦我了！你让我的顾客……呃，我是说观众分心了。

english: Well then you'll never know.
translation: 那你永远都不会知道了。

english: *Smacks lips together*Ohhh, that really hit the spot.
translation: *咂了咂嘴* 哦，这真是太爽了。

english: Come back again, when you can take a basket, otherwise back off! You're ruining the show.
translation: 等你拿得了篮子再来吧，不然就滚开！你毁了我的表演。

english: I don't think I should play that tune here.
translation: 我觉得我不该在这里吹那首曲子。

english: *The face's face perks up at the mention of the wordpretty.*
translation: *'丑脸'一听到‘漂亮’这个词就精神了起来。*

english: One day .....
translation: 总有一天……

english: I don't want to play that tune again - I'll have a pack of rats chasing after me!
translation: 我可不想再吹那首曲子了——会有一群老鼠追着我的！

english: Ha! I did it. Did you see?
translation: 哈！我做到了。你看到了吗？

english: I did indeed! A performance for the ages.
translation: 我确实看到了！一场足以载入史册的表演。

english: Now that you're a real ratcatcher, I'd be happy to train that cat of yours.
translation: 既然你现在是个真正的捕鼠者了，我很乐意训练你的那只猫。

english: Do you have any other quests for me? That last one of yours was so much fun, I was hoping you would!
translation: 你还有其他任务给我吗？你上次的那个任务太有趣了，我还希望你有呢！

english: Ooooh dear, I might have, but it's all very embarrassing...
translation: 噢噢噢亲爱的，我可能有，但这太尴尬了...

english: Embarrassing? How do you mean?
translation: 尴尬？你是什么意思？

english: Weeellll... You know I told you that it was the Duke's birthday?
translation: 唔...你知道我告诉过你这是公爵的生日吗？

english: Yup, that's why I had to go and collect you things to make a cake with wasn't it?
translation: 是啊，所以我得去帮你收集做蛋糕的材料，不是吗？

english: Yeeeesssss... Weeeelllll...
It isn't. I don't even know when his birthday is!
translation: 不是。我甚至不知道他的生日是什么时候！

english: GRRRR! Why did you have me running around finding ingredients for you then?!?!
translation: 咕噜噜！那你为什么让我到处跑给你找材料？！

english: So you lied to me to get me to do you a favour?
translation: 所以你撒谎是为了让我帮你忙？

english: Fair enough, you're not the first, but why lie? You could have just asked me, I'd have been happy to help.
translation: 好吧，你不是第一个，但为什么要撒谎？你直接问我就行了，我很乐意帮忙的。

english: I needed to test you and see if I could trust you...
translation: 我需要考验你，看看你是否值得信任...

english: I am in a terrible pickle, and I desperately need somebody trustworthy to help me out!
translation: 我陷入了大麻烦，迫切需要值得信任的人来帮我！

english: You need help AGAIN? Well, what seems to be the problem?
translation: 你又需要帮助？好吧，是什么问题？

english: Well, you're obviously trustworthy, I guess I could tell you...
translation: 嗯，你显然值得信任，我想我可以告诉你...

english: Please do. The suffering of others always seems to turn out very profitable for me.
translation: 请说吧。别人的苦难似乎总能让我获利颇丰。

english: Well... It's like this...
translation: 嗯...是这样...

english: Did you ever hear of Franizzard Van Lumbcook?
translation: 你听说过弗兰尼扎德.范.仑姆库克吗？

english: Erm... Can't say I have.
translation: 呃...我没听说过。

english: And with a name like that, I'm sure I would remember.
translation: 而且名字这么特别，我肯定会记得的。

english: Well, he was a great chef, and also my ancestor.
translation: 好吧，他是一位伟大的厨师，也是我的祖先。

english: One hundred years ago there was a very important meeting held here in Lumbridge Castle, and he cooked a banquet for the meeting, which was so stupendously amazing that he was offered a job for life, along with all
translation: 一百年前，这里（仑桥镇城堡）举行了一次非常重要的会议，他为会议烹制了宴会，其美味惊人，以至于他获得了一份终身工作，连同所有……

english: of his descendants.
translation: 他的后代也一起。

english: So you have your job because a hundred years ago your ancestor was a very good cook.
translation: 所以你的工作是因为一百年前你的祖先是个非常好的厨师。

english: I don't see how that's much of a problem for you...
translation: 我不觉得这对你有什么问题...

english: In fact I would say you are a VERY LUCKY man indeed. Frankly, I'd have fired you by now if you worked for me.
translation: 事实上，我要说你是个非常幸运的人。坦白说，如果你为我工作，我早就把你解雇了。

english: Oooooh no.... You don't understand...
translation: 噢噢噢不....你不明白...

english: This big important secret meeting that Franizzard cooked for is held here in Lumbridge castle every 10 years, and tonight will be the tenth anniversary of it!
translation: 这位弗兰尼扎德为之烹饪的这个重要秘密会议每十年在仑桥镇城堡举行一次，今晚将是十周年纪念！

english: Still not seeing the problem...
translation: 还是没看到问题所在...

english: Well, I have always felt like a failure as a cook, and that my job here is down to the skills of my ancestor.
translation: 嗯，我一直觉得自己是个失败的厨师，我在这里的工作全靠祖先的技能。

english: I want to prove to the world that I am a great cook too!
translation: 我想向世界证明我也是一位伟大的厨师！

english: But to do that... (sigh) No, it just won't work...
translation: 但要这样做...(叹气)不，这行不通...

english: What won't? Come on man, pull yourself together and speak to me!
translation: 什么行不通？振作起来，跟我说吧！

english: (sniff) Weeeeelll... I thought that I would recreate the meal Franizzard cooked all of those years ago, the one that impressed
translation: (抽泣)唔——...我想重现弗兰尼扎德多年前做的那顿饭，就是让所有人都印象深刻的

english: everybody so much... There's just this small problem though...
translation: 那顿饭...但有个小问题...

english: Let me take a wild guess: You have the recipe but you don't have any of the ingredients, and OBVIOUSLY you can't just go and get them yourself?
translation: 让我大胆猜猜：你有食谱，但没有任何材料，而且很明显你不能自己去拿？

english: Yes! However did you know?
translation: 是的！你怎么知道的？

english: Call it a hunch.
translation: 就当是直觉吧。

english: Okay, tell me what you're after and then I'll decide if I want to help you or not.
translation: 好吧，告诉我你需要什么，然后我再决定是否帮你。

english: Well, they are common enough ingredients, although I must admit the recipe I am following is very strange indeed...
translation: 嗯，这些材料相当常见，尽管我必须承认我遵循的食谱确实很奇怪...

english: I will pay you upfront for any expenses you may incur while obtaining them, and of course you may keep the change for being so helpful to me.
translation: 我会提前支付你可能产生的费用，当然你可以留下零钱作为你帮助我的酬劳。

english: Please can you help me? The feast is scheduled to start very soon, and I simply cannot leave!
translation: 求求你帮帮我好吗？宴会很快就要开始了，我根本不能离开！

english: I would love to help you! What do I have to do?
translation: 我很乐意帮你！我需要做什么？

english: Well, I have an incredibly important banquet that I have to prepare for, and I am using an ancient cookbook to recreate the meal my famous ancestor made a hundred years ago.
translation: 嗯，我要准备一场极其重要的宴会，我正在用一本古老的食谱重现我著名的祖先一百年前做的那顿饭。

english: Most of the ingredients I was able to obtain fairly easily, but there were some... oddities... that I have been unable to lay my hands on.
translation: 大部分材料我都能比较容易地弄到，但有一些...奇怪的东西...我弄不到手。

english: I need the following ingredients as soon as possible!
translation: 我急需以下材料！

english: One Eye Of NewtA freshly made 'Dirty Blast'A rotten tomato
translation: 一个蝾螈眼，一杯新鲜调制的'脏味鸡尾酒'，一个烂番茄

english: And a glass of greenman's ale.
translation: 还有一杯绿人麦酒。

english: I have given you 100 coins to cover any expenses you may incur, feel free to keep the change.
translation: 我给你100金币支付你可能产生的费用，零钱你留着吧。

english: I'll go look for those for you then!
translation: 那我这就去帮你找这些东西！

english: To be honest... I just can't be bothered.
translation: 说实话...我懒得管。

english: Oh nooooo... What am I going to do now?
translation: 噢不不不...我现在该怎么办？

english: Dunno. Maybe I'll change my mind and come back later and help you.
translation: 不知道。也许我会改变主意，晚点回来帮你。

english: Oooohhh... I really hope you do...
translation: 噢...我真希望你会的...

english: You know... Thinking about it...
translation: 你知道吗...想了想...

english: I just can't be bothered to help you out. You'll have to find some other adventurer to do your little quest for you.
translation: 我就是懒得帮你。你得找其他冒险者来完成你的小任务了。

english: I guess I don't have anything more to say to you then.
translation: 那我没什么好跟你说的了。

english: I guess you don't.
translation: 我想也是。

english: I'm curious... How exactly do you still have a job?
translation: 我很好奇...你到底是怎么还能有工作的？

english: I'm sorry? How do you mean?
translation: 你说什么？你是什么意思？

english: It's just surprising that you would still have employment as head cook of Lumbridge castle, given how obviously bad at your job you are.
translation: 令人惊讶的是，你竟然还能担任仑桥镇城堡的主厨，鉴于你工作能力明显如此之差。

english: Well, things you would expect every kitchen to have... Eggs, milk, flour... You know... But you don't.
translation: 嗯，每个厨房都应该有的东西...鸡蛋、牛奶、面粉...你知道的...但你却没有。

english: And what is worse, you don't even go off and get them yourself, you expect people like me to run around after you!
translation: 更糟的是，你甚至不自己去拿，还指望像我这样的人为你跑腿！

english: I know I'm such a failure... I bring shame to my honourable ancestor, and now I need help again...
translation: 我知道我是个失败者...我给我的光荣祖先丢脸了，现在我又需要帮助了...

english: Help again?
translation: 又需要帮助？

english: About those ingredients you wanted for the banquet...
translation: 关于你宴会需要的那些材料...

english: Did you bring them? Remember, I need an eye of newt, a glass of greenman's ale, a rotten tomato, and a 'Dirty Blast'!
translation: 你带来了吗？记住，我需要一个蝾螈眼、一杯绿人麦酒、一个烂番茄和一份'脏味鸡尾酒'！

english: Erm... Sorry, I don't have any of that with me...
translation: 呃...抱歉，我身边没有这些东西...

english: Well come back when you have all of them! And hurry! It is a VERY important meeting!
translation: 那你集齐了再回来！快点！这可是非常重要的会议！

english: Weeelll... I have some of that stuff with me, but not all of it...
translation: 唔...我身上有一些，但不全...

english: I'm afraid I only have [a/an] [item name] with me...
translation: 恐怕我只有 [a/an] [item name] 在身边...

english: I'm afraid I only have [a/an] [item 1] and [a/an] [item 2] with me...
translation: 恐怕我只有 [a/an] [item 1] 和 [a/an] [item 2] 在身边...

english: I've got a 'Dirty Blast', a Greenman's ale and a rotten tomato, I just need to get the eye of newt!
translation: 我已经拿到了'脏味鸡尾酒'、一杯绿人麦酒和一个烂番茄，只差蝾螈眼了！

english: I've got the 'Dirty Blast', a Greenman's ale and the eye of newt, I just have to find myself a rotten tomato...
translation: 我已经拿到了'脏味鸡尾酒'、一杯绿人麦酒和蝾螈眼，只差一个烂番茄了...

english: I managed to find a 'Dirty Blast', a rotten tomato and an eye of newt, but I didn't manage to get a hold of a Greenman's ale yet...
translation: 我找到了'脏味鸡尾酒'、一个烂番茄和一个蝾螈眼，但还没弄到绿人麦酒...

english: I've got you a Greenman's ale, the rotten tomato and the eye of newt, but haven't had any luck on the 'Dirty Blast' yet...
translation: 我帮你找到了绿人麦酒、烂番茄和蝾螈眼，但'脏味鸡尾酒'还没找到...

english: Come back and see me when you've got everything I need!
translation: 你集齐所有东西后再回来找我！

english: Okay then. I'll get on it.
translation: 好吧。我去办。

english: Where would I find an eye of newt?
translation: 哪里可以找到蝾螈眼？

english: I don't know. A newt's face?
translation: 我不知道。蝾螈的脸上？

english: Thank you so much for that help.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助。

english: Ah, I don't know where they get them, they usually have them at herblore and magic shops.
translation: 啊，我不知道他们从哪里弄到的，通常草药学和魔法商店有卖。

english: Where would I find a rotten tomato?
translation: 哪里可以找到烂番茄？

english: I'm not entirely sure, but I hear they're sold for public spectacles.
translation: 我不太确定，但我听说它们被用来公开表演时售卖。

english: Public spectacles?
translation: 公开表演？

english: Yeah. Pre-arranged combats, caught thieves on show, that sort of thing.
translation: 是啊。预先安排的格斗，被抓的小偷示众，诸如此类。

english: Where would I find a greenman's ale?
translation: 哪里可以找到绿人麦酒？

english: Well, as the official sponsored drink of Castle Wars it might be worth looking around there.
translation: 嗯，作为城堡战争的官方赞助饮品，也许可以去那里看看。

english: Where would I find a 'Dirty Blast'? I've never heard of it before.
translation: 哪里可以找到'脏味鸡尾酒'？我以前从没听说过。

english: Yes, I must admit I had never heard of it either until reading through my ancestor's cookbook.
translation: 是的，我必须承认，在查阅祖先的食谱之前，我也从未听说过。

english: Tell me, do you know how to make a Fruit Blast?
translation: 告诉我，你知道怎么做水果鸡尾酒吗？

english: A Fruit Blast? Sure, like they sell at Blurberry's Bar, right?
translation: 水果鸡尾酒？当然，就像布鲁贝利酒吧卖的那种，对吧？

english: Ah, so you've heard of it then? But for this recipe I'd need a fresh one; you can't just buy me one from a shop or from your friends.
translation: 啊，那你听说过？但这个食谱我需要一杯新鲜调制的；你不能直接从商店或朋友那里买一杯给我。

english: Well, a 'Dirty Blast' is a freshly made Fruit Blast, but then for some reason you add ash at the end!
translation: 嗯，'脏味鸡尾酒'就是一杯新鲜调制的水果鸡尾酒，但最后要加一些灰烬进去！

english: Freshly made? Why did you specify that?
translation: 新鲜调制？为什么你要特别强调？

english: Apparently the ash reacts with the freshly squeezed juice in the glass. It means you can't just buy one Blurberry made earlier, you'll have to make it yourself.
translation: 显然灰烬会与杯中新榨的果汁发生反应。意思是不能直接买现成的布鲁贝利，你得自己调制。

english: Oh. Well, it shouldn't take that long.
translation: 哦。好吧，应该不会花太久。

english: A Fruit Blast? Can't say I've ever heard of it...
translation: 水果鸡尾酒？我没听说过...

english: Ah, well, they're a popular Gnomic delicacy served at the Blurberry bar. But for this recipe I'd need a fresh one; you can't just buy me one from a shop or from your friends.
translation: 啊，好吧，它们是布鲁贝利酒吧供应的受欢迎的地精美食。但这个食谱我需要一杯新鲜调制的；你不能直接从商店或朋友那里买一杯给我。

english: Basically, what you do is juice a pineapple, an orange and a lemon, then put them all into a cocktail shaker.
translation: 基本上，你要榨一个菠萝、一个橙子和一个柠檬的汁，然后全部倒入鸡尾酒摇壶。

english: Pour that into a glass, then top with a slice of lemon.
translation: 倒进杯子，然后放一片柠檬在上面。

english: Okaaaay... So what's a 'Dirty Blast'?
translation: 好吧……那么什么是‘污浊冲击’？

english: Well, apparently after you have done the above then by adding ashes you create a unique new drink.
translation: 嗯，显然在完成上述步骤后，加入灰烬就能调制出一种全新的饮品。

english: Sounds horrible..
translation: 听起来真恶心……

english: I agree, but it's what the recipe specifically needs.
translation: 我也这么觉得，但食谱上偏偏就需要这个。

english: Bear in mind it will only work with very fresh ingredients, so you will have to make your own cocktail, not rely on one of the pre made ones Blurberry sells.
translation: 记住，必须用非常新鲜的食材，所以你得自己调制鸡尾酒，不能直接用布鲁贝利卖的那些现成的。

english: That looks disgusting, but it's what the cook asked for...
translation: 看起来真恶心，但这就是厨师要的东西……

english: No thanks, that looks DISGUSTING! I won't drink that!
translation: 不了谢谢，那玩意儿看起来恶心死了！我才不喝！

english: You will be happy to know... I have all of that with me!
translation: 你会很高兴知道……我身上全都有！

english: You absolutely MUST go through into the dining room just there and see the feast I have prepared.
translation: 你一定要去那边的餐厅看看我准备的盛宴。

english: I simply won't take no for an answer!
translation: 我绝不允许你说不！

english: How's that banquet going?
translation: 宴会准备得怎么样了？

english: Why haven't you gone and looked at the feast I have prepared yet? Trust me, it will be a sight the likes of which you will never see again!
translation: 你为什么还没去看我准备的盛宴？相信我，那场面你再也见不到了！

english: I don't know... I'm just... quite busy, I guess...
translation: 我不知道……我只是……有点忙，大概吧……

english: No, honestly, you MUST go in there!
translation: 不，说真的，你必须进去！

english: GO IN THERE!
translation: 给我进去！

english: Welcome, gentlemen, to Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 欢迎各位来到伦布里奇城堡。

english: I welcome Osman, Spymaster for the Emir of Al Kharid.
translation: 欢迎奥斯曼，阿尔卡里德城埃米尔的间谍头目。

english: I thank you for your hospitality.
translation: 感谢您的款待。

english: I welcome Selim, acting Spymaster for the Emir of Al Kharid.
translation: 欢迎塞利姆，阿尔卡里德城埃米尔的代理间谍头目。

english: I welcome the chief guard of the White Wolf Mountain dwarves.
translation: 欢迎白狼山脉矮人的守卫长。

english: The beer's good!
translation: 啤酒好喝！

english: I welcome Pirate Pete from Braindeath Island.
translation: 欢迎来自脑死岛的海盗皮特。

english: Your rum's got no flavour!
translation: 你的朗姆酒没味道！

english: I welcome the chief of the Goblin Village.
translation: 欢迎哥布林村庄的首领。

english: That me! Give me chair!
translation: 那是我！给我椅子！

english: No, it me! Chair mine!
translation: 不，是我！椅子是我的！

english: I welcome Skrach Uglogwee of the Feldip Hills ogres.
translation: 欢迎来自费迪普丘陵的食人魔斯克拉奇.乌格洛格维。

english: Der ogres, dey call me Bone Cruncher.
translation: 那些食人魔，他们叫我碎骨者。

english: I welcome my neighbour, Phileas the Lumbridge Guide.
translation: 欢迎我的邻居，仑桥镇向导菲利斯。

english: I didn't have far to travel!
translation: 我没走多远的路！

english: From the town of Edgeville, I welcome Evil Dave.
translation: 来自边陲镇的，欢迎邪恶戴夫。

english: These secret meetings are SOOO EVIL!
translation: 这些秘密会议太邪恶了！

english: A hearty welcome to Sir Amik Varze, leader of the White Knights...
translation: 热烈欢迎阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士，白骑士的领袖……

english: Do get a move on!
translation: 快点吧！

english: ...and finally, I welcome the ruler of Ape Atoll, Awowogei.
translation: ……最后，欢迎猿岛上的统治者，阿沃盖。

english: Please sit down!
translation: 请坐下！

english: Ikik...
translation: 伊奇奇……

english: SIT DOWN!
translation: 坐下！

english: I think he's lost his Amulet of Manspeak.
translation: 我想他弄丢了人言护身符。

english: Aris seems to be late...
translation: 阿里斯似乎迟到了……

english: Greetings, Horacio!
translation: 你好，霍拉西奥！

english: Oh, what now?
translation: 哦，又怎么了？

english: Here you go Horacio, it's all yours!
translation: 给你，霍拉西奥，全是你的了！
