english: Excuse me while I deal with this...
translation: 失陪一下，我得处理这个……

english: We should do something about that old man.
translation: 我们该对那个老家伙做点什么。

english: Meoooooow!
What's that? I don't know what kind of fish you eat in your world, but that smells absolutely vile!
translation: 那是什么？我不知道你们那个世界吃的是什么鱼，但这味道闻起来糟透了！

english: Go catch me some real fish!
translation: 去给我抓些真正的鱼来！

english: Do u wanna meet my pet? His name's Pete.Ow has dis amuwet of humanspeak bwoken again?
translation: 你想见见我的宠物吗？他叫皮特。哦，这个人类语言护符又坏了吗？

english: Hey, Callsmadfra21d, come with me if you like fishing! Or has this amulet of humanspeak broken again?
translation: 嘿，Callsmadfra21d，如果你喜欢钓鱼就跟我来！还是这个人类语言护符又坏了？

english: Nooooooooooooo!
Wow – another one!
translation: 哇——又一个！

english: Wow - another one!
translation: 哇——又一个！

english: Ooh – nice food!
translation: 哦——美食！

english: You come here.
translation: 你过来。

english: Is you my dinner?
translation: 你是我的晚餐吗？

english: Let go!
translation: 放开！

english: No, I'm not!
translation: 不，我才不是！

english: Aha! I'm BACK!
translation: 啊哈！我回来了！

english: Ek uhuh!
translation: 呃呜呜！

english: Did we invite you?
translation: 我们邀请你了吗？

english: Hah! Your chef did! And now I'll kill you!
translation: 哈！你们的厨师邀请的！现在我就要杀了你！

english: MUAHAHAHA!
translation: 咩哈哈哈哈！

english: Sorry I'm late...
translation: 抱歉我来晚了……

english: I remember you...
translation: 我记得你……

english: Muahahaha!
translation: 咩哈哈哈哈哈！

english: TEMPUS CESSIT!
translation: 时间停滞！

english: [Player name], you must help me defeat this evil!
translation: [Player name]，你必须帮我击败这个邪恶的家伙！

english: Hello there adventurer. How can I assist you?
translation: 你好啊，冒险者。我能帮你什么吗？

english: I am the fortune-teller. My friends call me Aris.
translation: 我是占卜师。朋友们都叫我阿里斯。

english: Okay then Aris...
translation: 好吧，那么阿里斯……

english: Was there something you wanted to ask me about?
translation: 你是有问题想问我吗？

english: I do have a question. A very GOOD question.
translation: 我确实有个问题。一个非常棒的问题。

english: Oh yes? What's that then?
translation: 哦，是吗？什么问题？

english: Just what in the flipping hippo is going on?!?!?
translation: 到底他妈的怎么回事？！？！？

english: ...flipping hippo?
translation: ……他妈的？

english: Yeeeess.... You've never heard that phrase?
translation: 对……你没听过这个说法？

english: No, no I'm quite sure that I never have.
translation: 没有，我确定从没听过。

english: Well, that's not the point!
translation: 好吧，那不重要！

english: Please, tell me what just happened!
translation: 请告诉我刚才发生了什么！

english: Certainly. That fellow over there in the chef's hat is called the Culinaromancer.
translation: 当然可以。那边那个戴着厨师帽的家伙叫做烹饪大师。

english: A hundred years ago, he threatened the secret council with death, but was foiled by the quick thinking of his assistant, who managed to trap him in another dimension.
translation: 一百年前，他以死亡威胁秘密议会，但被他的助理机智地挫败，助理设法将他困在了另一个维度。

english: As a result of that action, the assistant was offered a job for life as head cook of Lumbridge, for himself and all his future descendants.
translation: 因为这次行动，那位助理获得了一份终身工作，成为仑桥镇的主厨，职位由他和他的后代世袭。

english: Now, apparently the current head cook of Lumbridge decided to recreate his ancestors greatest achievement, not realising that his achievement was not a meal but a powerful food-magic, and by recreating the spell he has
translation: 而现在，显然现任仑桥镇主厨决定重现他祖先最伟大的成就，却没有意识到那成就并非一道菜肴，而是一种强大的食物魔法，而当他重现那个咒语时，

english: inadvertently freed the evil Culinaromancer from his prison, to wreak havoc upon this world once more.
translation: 无意中把邪恶的烹饪大师从他的囚禁中释放了出来，让他再次在这个世界上肆虐。

english: Naturally, when I saw what was happening, I intervened with a simple Tempus Cessit spell, so that we would have time to immunise the secret council from his attack, and so that we can defeat the Culinaromancer
translation: 自然，当我看到发生的一切时，我用了一个简单的“Tempus Cessit”咒语进行干预，这样我们就有时间让秘密议会免疫他的攻击，并且我们可以击败烹饪大师。

english: once and for all.
translation: 一劳永逸。

english: Um... what?
translation: 嗯……什么？

english: You want me to explain it again?
translation: 你想让我再解释一遍？

english: Yes please. But slower. And more understandable.
translation: 好的，拜托了。但是慢一点，说得更明白一点。

english: (sigh) Okay then: 100 years ago, the evil food magician was defeated and banished.
translation: （叹气）好吧：一百年前，那个邪恶的食物魔法师被打败并放逐了。

english: Because of you and the Lumbridge cook, he is now free.
translation: 因为你和仑桥镇的厨师，他现在自由了。

english: He was about to slaughter all of these people, but I stopped time so that you could protect them.
translation: 他正要对这些人下杀手，但我停止了时间，这样你就能保护他们。

english: You stopped time? And... wait, I have to protect them? Why me?
translation: 你停止了时间？而且……等等，我得保护他们？为什么是我？

english: Yes I stopped time. And YOU have to do it partly because you helped release him by getting those ingredients, and partly because I am stuck here keeping the spell intact.
translation: 没错，我停止了时间。而你必须这么做，部分原因是你帮忙收集了那些材料把他放了出来，部分原因是我困在这里维持着咒语。

english: Isn't stopping time kind of... You know, dangerous?
translation: 停止时间是不是有点……你知道，危险？

english: Oh, unbelievably so. This is why I have limited the time bubble to this room and this room alone.
translation: 哦，极其危险。所以我只把时间泡泡限制在这个房间里，仅此一个房间。

english: Huh? How does that work?
translation: 嗯？那怎么运作？

english: Everything outside this room continues to flow through time. This is why outside of this room you have already defeated the Culinaromancer, and protected the
translation: 这个房间外面的一切都继续随时间流动。这就是为什么在这个房间之外，你已经击败了烹饪大师，并保护了

english: members of the secret council.
translation: 秘密议会的成员。

english: Inside this room however you have not.
translation: 然而在这个房间里面，你还没有。

english: Uh... what?
translation: 呃……什么？

english: Where time has been frozen in this room, outside it continues to flow, so this room is now currently in what we would call 'the past', meaning events inside here have already happened, and the longer time continues to flow
translation: 在这个房间里时间被冻结了，而外面时间继续流动，所以这个房间现在处于我们所谓的‘过去’，意味着这里面的事件已经发生过了，而且外面时间流动得越久，

english: outside, the more removed from normal time this room becomes.
translation: 这个房间就离正常时间越远。

english: Wait... so I've already saved all of these council members and defeated the Culinaromancer?
translation: 等等……所以我早就已经救下了所有议会成员并击败了烹饪大师？

english: Yes. But only outside. What you need to do now is save them in here as well, so that time can resume its normal ebb and flow.
translation: 是的。但只在外面。你现在要做的，就是在这里也拯救他们，这样时间才能恢复正常的流逝。

english: Otherwise there will be increasing temporal pressure, and the entire universe might explode!
translation: 否则时间压力会越来越大，整个宇宙都可能爆炸！

english: Not the whole universe! That's where I keep my stuff!
translation: 别是整个宇宙！我的东西可都放在那儿呢！

english: Yes. That is why it is so important that you protect them all.
translation: 没错。所以保护他们所有人至关重要。

english: But... You said I already had...?
translation: 但是……你刚才不是说我已经……？

english: Yes. You have. In the future, which is also the present, but not in the present, which is also the past.
translation: 是的。你已经做了。在未来，也就是现在，但不是在现在，也就是过去。

english: My brain hurts...
translation: 我的大脑好痛……

english: Yes, time travel tends to do that to people.
translation: 是的，时间旅行通常都会让人这样。

english: I suggest you don't worry about it too much, just make sure you protect each council member and then defeat the Culinaromancer.
translation: 我建议你别太担心，只要确保保护好每一位议会成员，然后击败烹饪大师就行了。

english: Each council member will have their own unique dish that will serve to counteract the Culinaromancer's spell.
translation: 每位议会成员都会有一道独特的菜肴，用来抵消烹饪大师的咒语。

english: Inspect the one you wish to save, and I will offer any advice I have.
translation: 检查你想拯救的那位，我会提供我所有的建议。

english: Was there anything else you wanted to ask me about?
translation: 你还有什么想问我的吗？

english: Who's that guy over there? Seemed like you knew each other.
translation: 那边那个人是谁？你们好像认识。

english: He calls himself the Culinaromancer. He is an extremely evil man, with incredibly powerful magics.
translation: 他自称烹饪大师。他是个极其邪恶的人，拥有非常强大的魔法。

english: Culinaromancer?
translation: 烹饪魔法师？

english: Yes, that's correct. Just as an Oneiromancer draws their magical powers from dreams, or a  necromancer draws their strength from the energies of the dead, a Culinaromancer uses
translation: 是的，没错。就像梦境法师从梦境中汲取魔力，或者死灵法师从亡者的能量中汲取力量一样，烹饪大师则是利用

english: food as his source of magical power.
translation: 食物作为他魔法的来源。

english: Food? What's so dangerous about food?
translation: 食物？食物有什么危险的？

english: Do not underestimate the latent power of foodstuffs as a source of magical energy.
translation: 不要低估食物作为魔法能量来源的潜在力量。

english: Not only are they a fundamental life-force, but they often evoke great emotional attachment.
translation: 它们不仅是基本的生命力，而且常常能唤起强烈的情感依恋。

english: Do not underestimate him, part of his strength lies in the fact his unique type of magical power is quite obscure, I have seen many fall before him.
translation: 不要小看他，他的部分力量在于他那独特的魔法类型相当晦涩难懂，我见过许多人在他面前倒下。

english: Okay, so he's powerful, but I don't get why he's here!
translation: 好吧，他很强，但我不明白他为什么会在这里！

english: Ah, it is a very old story indeed.
translation: 啊，这确实是个很古老的故事了。

english: A hundred years ago, he worked here in Lumbridge castle for the then Duke as a cook.
translation: 一百年前，他曾在仑桥镇城堡为当时的公爵当厨师。

english: This was all a pretence, of course. As part of his duties he was allowed access to many exotic and esoteric foodstuffs. These allowed him to experiment with his magic and increase his power exponentially.
translation: 当然，这全都是伪装。作为职责的一部分，他可以接触到许多异国和深奥的食材。这些让他得以用魔法进行实验，并指数级地增强他的力量。

english: Building his power was just the first step however.
translation: 然而，积累力量只是第一步。

english: Knowing of the regular meetings of the secret council here in Lumbridge, the Culinaromancer decided that he would eliminate all of them as the first step to his plans for world domination.
translation: 烹饪大师知道秘密议会定期在仑桥镇开会，于是他决定消灭他们所有人，作为他征服世界计划的第一步。

english: Would that have worked?
translation: 那会成功吗？

english: Possibly, we might never know. As his plans were coming to fruition his assistant discovered them, and used his own magic against him, to trap him in another dimension where his powers would
translation: 也许，我们可能永远无从知晓。当他的计划即将实现时，他的助理发现了它们，并用自己的魔法反制他，将他困在了另一个维度，在那里他的力量会

english: be useless.
translation: 毫无用处。

english: Then how did he escape?
translation: 那他是怎么逃出来的？

english: Well, the current cook of Lumbridge obviously discovered an ancient manuscript of his ancestors, and believing it to be a recipe decided to recreate the spell that banished him.
translation: 嗯，现任的仑桥镇厨师显然发现了一份他祖先的古代手稿，并以为那是一份食谱，于是决定重现那个放逐他的咒语。

english: Which obviously seems to have opened the portal enough for him to escape back to this dimension. So this is partly your fault.
translation: 这显然足以打开传送门，让他逃回这个维度。所以，这有一部分是你的错。

english: Oh. Those ingredients?
translation: 哦。是那些材料？

english: Yes, those ingredients. So I hold you responsible for assisting me in ridding him of this dimension once and for all.
translation: 是的，就是那些材料。所以我认为你有责任协助我，把他彻底赶出这个维度。

english: Yeah... I had a feeling you were going to say that...
translation: 是啊……我就知道你会这么说……

english: Are you clear on what you have to do, or was there something you wished me to explain?
translation: 你清楚自己该做什么了吗，还是有什么需要我解释的？

english: Who are these people? Seems like quite the random selection in here!
translation: 这些人是谁？这里面的人选看起来真够随意的！

english: The people you see assembled here are the self-styled secret council of Gielinor.
translation: 你在这里看到的人，是吉列诺自封的秘密议会成员。

english: 'Self-styled' council? What do you mean?
translation: “自封”的议会？什么意思？

english: Many centuries ago, a small group from around the world of Gielinor decided that these lands needed to be directed, that it was too risky to leave the fates of this land to luck and the gods.
translation: 许多世纪以前，来自吉列诺世界各地的一小群人认为，这些土地需要有人指引，将这片土地的命运交给运气和众神太冒险了。

english: They decided that every 10 years they would meet to discuss current events, and shape how the world might then develop.
translation: 他们决定每十年聚会一次，讨论时事，并塑造世界未来的发展方向。

english: So they're pretty influential people?
translation: 所以他们都是有影响力的人物？

english: No, not really. For all of their grand schemes and ideas, nothing ever gets done except every ten years they have a bit of a posh meal together and a bit of a gossip.
translation: 不，其实不是。尽管他们有宏伟的计划和想法，但除了每十年一起吃顿大餐、聊点八卦之外，什么事都没做成过。

english: I see... But this evil cook guy that just appeared thinks they might be important?
translation: 我明白了……但那个刚出现的邪恶厨师觉得他们很重要？

english: I don't really know what he thinks.
translation: 我不太清楚他怎么想的。

english: Either way I'm not prepared to let him get away with a brazen attack on anybody while I have the power to stop him.
translation: 无论如何，只要我有能力阻止他，我就不会让他如此明目张胆地攻击任何人。

english: And given that this is partly your fault, I fully expect your assistance in saving them.
translation: 考虑到这有一部分是你的错，我完全指望你协助我拯救他们。

english: MY fault??
translation: 我的错？？

english: Yes. You were the one who provided the cook with the ingredients that he needed to allow the Culinaromancer to return to this dimension.
translation: 是的。是你给厨师提供了那些让烹饪大师得以返回这个维度的材料。

english: I just don't understand any of this...
translation: 我完全搞不懂这些……

english: What exactly is it that you don't understand?
translation: 你到底哪里不明白？

english: Uh... Is it me, or did this room just get much bigger?
translation: 呃……是我的错觉，还是这个房间变大了很多？

english: Ah, that would be the time dilation effect.
translation: 啊，那是时间膨胀效应。

english: The... time dilation... effect?
translation: ……时间……膨胀……效应？

english: Yes. As time has stopped flowing in the normal way, your eyes are playing tricks on you, as the pictures absorbed by your eyes take slightly longer to reach your brain
translation: 是的。由于时间停止了正常流动，你的眼睛在欺骗你，因为你的眼睛吸收的图像需要比平时稍长的时间才能到达你的大脑

english: Erm... what?
translation: 呃……什么？

english: As everybody knows, time flows from north to south, so my freezing time means that this room has apparently stretched slightly along its horizontal axis.
translation: 众所周知，时间是从北向南流动的，所以我冻结时间意味着这个房间在水平轴上似乎被稍微拉长了。

english: Um... does that even make sense?
translation: 嗯……这说得通吗？

english: Don't let it worry you too much. It's just an optical illusion, the room is exactly the same size as it always has been, it just appears to be a tiny bit bigger.
translation: 别太担心。这只是个视觉错觉，房间和以前一样大，只是看起来稍微大了一点点。

english: Ah, forget it, I don't want to talk to you now.
translation: 啊，算了，我现在不想跟你说话。

english: Yes, I'm sure you have far more important things to do than SAVING THE ENTIRE UNIVERSE!
translation: 是啊，我敢肯定你有比拯救整个宇宙更重要的事情要做！

english: Fancy seeing you here again.
translation: 真没想到又在这里见到你。

english: Don't talk to me! It might cause a time paradox!
translation: 别跟我说话！可能会引起时间悖论！

english: Huh? But how can it when you're...
translation: 哈？但你怎么能……

english: LA-LA-LA I'M NOT TALKING TO YOU LA-LA-LA TIME PARADOX LA-LA-LA
translation: 啦-啦-啦 我没跟你说话 啦-啦-啦 时间悖论 啦-啦-啦

english: Can we talk about what happened in the dining room?
translation: 我们能谈谈餐厅里发生的事吗？

english: Wow! You were incredible! The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!
translation: 哇！你太厉害了！你击败烹饪大师的方式，看起来真轻松！

english: Uh... What?
translation: 呃……什么？

english: With the foods, and that big portal thingy, and everything!
translation: 用那些食物，还有那个大传送门什么的，还有所有的一切！

english: I'm just glad you were around, who knows WHAT could have happened if you weren't able to help us!
translation: 真庆幸有你在，谁知道如果你没能帮我们的话会发生什么事！

english: I'm sorry, I don't have any clue what you...
translation: 抱歉，我完全不知道你在……

english: Oh. Oh, right. This must be part of that whole time-bubble thing that Aris told me about.
translation: 哦。哦，对了。这一定是阿里斯跟我说的那个时间泡泡的一部分。

english: So the cook outside of the bubble remembers me having already saved the council members even though I haven't actually gone and done it yet...
translation: 所以泡泡外面的厨师记得我已经拯救了议会成员，尽管我实际上还没去做……

english: Gah! This time travel stuff makes my head hurt!
translation: 啊！这些时间旅行的事让我头疼！

english: So... I don't suppose you can remember exactly how I defeated him can you?
translation: 那么……我想你应该不记得我到底是怎么打败他的吧？

english: Of course! Which bit can't you remember doing?
translation: 当然记得！你记不得哪部分了？

english: That dwarf... I somehow can't remember how I managed to save him...
translation: 那个矮人……我不知怎么不记得我是怎么救他的了……

english: Ask me how to protect him first, otherwise you will cause a time paradox! I'm keeping an eye on you, you know!
translation: 先问我怎么保护他，否则你会引起时间悖论！我可盯着你呢，知道吗！

english: The dwarf? Oh, yeah, I think that was an easy one, didn't you say?
translation: 那个矮人？哦，是啊，我记得那是个简单的，你不是说过吗？

english: I did? Er, I did.
translation: 我说过？呃，我是说过。

english: You went to see his dad in the tunnels under white wolf mountain, and then got some rock cakes, if I remember rightly.
translation: 如果我没记错的话，你去白狼山下的隧道里见了他父亲，然后弄了些岩皮饼。

english: Oh yeah... I remember now...
translation: 哦，对……我想起来了……

english: Did you want a reminder on any other of your brave exploits?
translation: 你还想提醒一下其他英勇事迹吗？

english: Those bickering goblins... How did I protect them again?
translation: 那两个争吵的地精……我又是怎么保护他们的？

english: Ask me how to protect them first, otherwise you will cause a time paradox! I'm keeping an eye on you, you know!
translation: 先问我怎么保护他们，否则你会引起时间悖论！我可盯着你呢，知道吗！

english: Well, that was a weird one alright, you told me that they couldn't agree on what food they liked, so you ended up just mushing a bunch of stuff together somehow which seemed to do the trick.
translation: 嗯，那确实是个怪事，你告诉我他们无法就喜欢的食物达成一致，所以你最后不知怎么把一堆东西混在一起，似乎就搞定了。

english: I can't quite remember how I managed to save that pirate...
translation: 我不太记得我是怎么救那个海盗的了……

english: The pirate? Yes, you used fishcakes didn't you?
translation: 那个海盗？是的，你用了鱼饼，对吧？

english: I did? Er... I mean I did.
translation: 我用了？呃……我是说我用了。

english: Out of interest, could you just help me quickly with that?
translation: 顺便问一下，你能帮我快速回忆一下那个吗？

english: Can you tell me how to make fishcakes?
translation: 你能告诉我怎么做鱼饼吗？

english: Fishcakes? As in with fish eggs and fish milk?
translation: 鱼饼？用鱼卵和鱼奶做的？

english: Don't be silly, that would never work.
translation: 别傻了，那绝对行不通。

english: Can you check to see if there is a recipe for them?
translation: 你能查查有没有它们的食谱吗？

english: Found it!
translation: 找到了！

english: Apparently you need Ground Cod, Ground Kelp, Ground Giant Crab Meat and Breadcrumbs.
translation: 显然你需要鳕鱼粉、海带粉、巨蟹肉粉和面包屑。

english: Where do I get Ground Cod?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到鳕鱼粉？

english: Well, if you use a pestle and mortar on a raw cod that will grind it up nicely.
translation: 嗯，如果你用研钵和杵捣碎生鳕鱼，就能很好地磨碎它。

english: Where do I get Ground kelp?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到海带粉？

english: There are apparently some kelp patches off the coast near Rimmington. Murphy knows more about that.
translation: 据说里明顿村附近的海岸有一些海带丛，墨菲更清楚情况。

english: As for the grinding part, all you have to do is use a pestle and mortar on it, that ought to get it sorted.
translation: 至于研磨的部分，你只需要用研钵和杵捣一捣就行，应该能搞定。

english: Murphy also used to bring in Giant Crabs occasionally. He hasn't had any of them in for a while though.
translation: 墨菲以前偶尔也会带巨蟹回来，不过最近一段时间都没有了。

english: You had best go and have a word with him to see if he can tell you what happened.
translation: 你最好去跟他聊聊，看他能不能告诉你发生了什么。

english: Where do I get Ground Giant Crab meat?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到巨蟹肉粉？

english: Well, Murphy used to bring in Giant Crabs occasionally. He hasn't had any of them in for a while though.
translation: 嗯，墨菲以前偶尔会带巨蟹回来，不过最近一段时间都没有了。

english: Oh, and  there are apparently some kelp patches off the coast near Rimmington. Murphy knows about that too.
translation: 哦，还有，据说里明顿村附近的海岸有一些海带丛，墨菲也知道这事儿。

english: Where do I get Breadcrumbs?
translation: 我在哪里能弄到面包屑？

english: That's easy, all you do is use a knife to slice the bread up into tiny, tiny chunks.
translation: 那简单，你只要用刀把面包切成非常非常小的碎块就行。

english: What did I do with all of it?
translation: 我拿这些东西都做了什么来着？

english: I'm not entirely sure. What am I, an encyclopedia?
translation: 我也不太确定。我是什么，百科全书吗？

english: I'll have a look through my cookbook while I wait for the ingredients.
translation: 我一边等食材，一边翻翻我的食谱书。

english: Ok, I'll go out and get all of the stuff and bring it to you.
translation: 好的，我出去把所有东西拿来给你。

english: Is there anything else you need to know?
translation: 还有其他需要知道的吗？

english: The Lumbridge guide... I can't really rememember what I did to save him...
translation: 仑桥镇向导……我真的记不清我是怎么救他的了……

english: The Lumbridge guide... I can't really remememberwhat I did to save him...
translation: 仑桥镇向导……我真的记不清我是怎么救他的了……

english: Oh, you told me that that crazy wizard in the wizards' tower helped you with that.
translation: 哦，你告诉过我，是法师塔里那个疯魔法师帮你解决的。

english: That crazy wizard at the wizards' tower? Was I not any more specific than that?
translation: 法师塔那个疯魔法师？我当时没说具体名字吗？

english: No, not really. I think you might have mentioned the name Traiborn though.
translation: 没有，真没有。不过你好像提到过崔博恩这个名字。

english: That fellow with the unhealthy obsession with black... Dave his name is...
translation: 那个对黑色有着不健康沉迷的家伙……叫戴夫来着……

english: I can't quite remember what I did to protect him...
translation: 我记不太清我是怎么保护他的了……

english: Oh yeah! I didn't understand that one myself, but apparently you went and asked him how he likes his stew, then made him remember it after he'd tasted it!
translation: 哦对！我自己也没搞明白，但你当时去问了他喜欢什么样的炖菜，然后在他尝过之后让他回忆起来！

english: Yeah, I didn't understand it either, but you mentioned something about demonic incursions and evil cats too!
translation: 是啊，我也没搞明白，但你还提到了什么恶魔入侵和邪恶猫！

english: Just remind me again how I managed to unfreeze Skrach?
translation: 再提醒我一下，我是怎么把斯克拉奇解冻的？

english: Certainly. Everyone knows that Skrach loves Jubbly Chompy, preferably roasted on a spit! The bird's carcass is so big, it can't be cooked any other way.
translation: 当然。谁都知道斯克拉奇喜欢焦比雷鸟，最好是叉烤！那种鸟的躯体太大了，其他方法根本做不了。

english: And how do I get one of those?
translation: 那我怎么弄到一只？

english: I wouldn't know much about that, but I believe you talked to Rantz quite a bit over in the Feldip hills. Apparently, he got you to do him quite a few favours before you actually got the Jubbly.
translation: 这个我不太清楚，但我觉得你在费迪普丘陵跟兰茨聊了不少。好像他让你帮了好几个忙，你才弄到焦比雷鸟。

english: That white knight... Sir Amik Varze... I can't quite remember how I saved him...
translation: 那个白骑士……阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士……我记不太清是怎么救他的了……

english: but it was something to do with creme brulee supreme...
translation: 但好像跟至尊焦糖布丁有关……

english: Ah yes! Why, I was so impressed with that recipe you created that I memorised it!
translation: 啊对了！我那时对你创造的那份食谱印象深刻，都背下来了！

english: Ah, you did, did you? I don't suppose you could refresh my memory about that?
translation: 啊，你背下来了？能不能帮我回忆一下？

english: But of course! It was an unusual dish, an unusual dish indeed! First you blend together, in a pot, some milk and some cream. Then add cornflour to the mixture.
translation: 当然可以！那可是一道不同寻常的菜，非常不寻常！首先你在罐子里把牛奶和奶油混合在一起，然后加入玉米粉。

english: Cornflour? How do I... er, how DID I make that then?
translation: 玉米粉？我怎么……呃，我当时是怎么做的来着？

english: Oh, you told me you used sweetcorn in a mill!
translation: 哦，你告诉过我，你是用磨坊把甜玉米磨成玉米粉的！

english: Really? Weird. Okay, what did I do then?
translation: 真的？真奇怪。好吧，那我接着做了什么？

english: Then you travelled to the Kharazi Jungle and searched the plants there until you found a vanilla stick, which was then added to the mixture.
translation: 然后你去了卡拉兹丛林，翻遍了那里的植物，直到找到一根香草荚，把它加进了混合物里。

english: After that you told me that you sought out and killed the fearsome Evil Chicken, to get one of his eggs, which was then mixed with the other ingredients.
translation: 之后你告诉我，你找到了可怕的邪恶鸡并杀了它，拿了一个它的蛋，然后跟其他食材混在一起。

english: Finally you made some cinnamon by grinding the branch of a Dramen Tree and sprinkled it on top of the creme brulee.
translation: 最后你用德拉门树的树枝磨成肉桂粉，撒在焦糖布丁上面。

english: Sounds easy enough so far. Er, I mean it was easy enough up to that point.
translation: 到目前为止听起来还算简单。呃，我是说当时到那个步骤为止还算简单。

english: Yes, but then came the impressive part!
translation: 是啊，但接下来才是令人印象深刻的部分！

english: Apparently, a creme brulee supreme needs to be flambed at exactly the right temperature, and the only fire that is hot enough to do this is the breath of a dragon. Luckily, while killing black dragons near the Evil
translation: 据说至尊焦糖布丁需要在恰到好处的温度下火焰炙烤，唯一够热的火就是龙的吐息。幸运的是，在邪恶鸡的巢穴附近杀黑龙时，

english: Chicken's lair, you came across a method of forcing a dragon to your will so that it would complete the dish, which you then used to protect Sir Amik!
translation: 你发现了一种迫使龙服从你意志的方法，让它完成了这道菜，然后你就用这个办法保护了阿米克爵士！

english: I definitely said that I had to kill some black dragons to do that?
translation: 我确定我说过必须杀一些黑龙才能做到？

english: Oh yes. You were quite adamant about it. Specifically black dragons. Specifically near the Evil Chicken's lair.
translation: 哦当然。你当时非常肯定。就是黑龙，就在邪恶鸡的巢穴附近。

english: The monkey king... However did I save him from the culinaromancer...?
translation: 猴王……我究竟是怎么把他从烹饪大师手中救出来的……？

english: Well, it was something that sounded ABSOLUTELY DISGUSTING that you picked up on Ape Atoll...
translation: 嗯，是你在猿人岛搞到的一样听起来绝对恶心的东西……

english: Oh MAN! That was AWESOME!
translation: 哦天哪！那真是太棒了！

english: After you managed to save all of the members of the secret council with those weird foods, the culinaromancer tried to make a run for it, but you followed him into his magic portal and Biff! Bang! Boom!
translation: 你成功用那些奇怪的食物救出秘密议会的所有成员后，烹饪大师想要逃跑，但你跟着他进了他的魔法传送门，然后砰！哐！轰！

english: sorted him out once and for all!
translation: 彻底解决了他！

english: Did you ever know that you're my hero?
translation: 你知道吗，你是我心中的英雄？

english: Now you've freed them all, I'll restart time so you can deal with the culinaromancer.
translation: 现在你已经把他们全救出来了，我会重新启动时间，这样你就可以去对付烹饪大师了。

english: If you're sure...
translation: 如果你确定的话……

english: We have broken your feeble spell! Begone!
translation: 我们已经破解了你那脆弱的魔法！滚开！

english: You DARED to meddle?
translation: 你敢来插手？

english: But you cannot defeat me! I'LL BE BACK!
translation: 但你不可能打败我！我会回来的！

english: Hooray - he's gone!
translation: 好哇——他走了！

english: One day he'll return. You must go through the portal and finish him off.
translation: 总有一天他会回来的。你必须穿过传送门去彻底解决他。

english: Adventurer, you must hurry! You have freed the members of the secret council, but we must ensure that the Culinaromancer is defeated once and for all!
translation: 冒险者，你得抓紧！你已经救出了秘密议会的成员，但我们得确保烹饪大师被彻底击败，永绝后患！

english: Follow him into the portal and make sure he never leaves again!
translation: 跟着他进入传送门，确保他再也跑不出来！

english: So... You don't happen to remember what I did after the Culinaromancer escaped into that magic portal thingy do you?
translation: 那么……你该不会还记得烹饪大师逃进那个魔法传送门之后我做了什么吧？

english: Of course I do! It was amazing!
translation: 当然记得！当时可精彩了！

english: You jumped in right behind him and fought him to the death!
translation: 你紧跟在他后面跳了进去，跟他决一死战！

english: ...Oh yeah, that's right. And it was a really easy fight wasn't it...?
translation: ……哦对，没错。那场战斗非常简单，对吧……？

english: Oh no! You told me it was really hard, and that you had to defeat a string of monsters without any prayer!
translation: 哪有！你告诉我说非常难，而且你必须在不使用任何祈祷的状态下击败一连串的怪物！

english: Oh. I did, did I? Oh.
translation: 哦。我说过吗？哦。

english: [Player], I must warn you, inside that dimension you will have no assistance from the gods, and your prayers will not work at all!
translation: [Player]，我必须警告你，在那个维度里你不会得到任何神灵的协助，你的祈祷将完全无效！

english: Also be aware that he will use his powers to draw upon the might of foes you have fought before, and that dimensional instability means that your lost items will be irretrievable should you die...
translation: 另外请注意，他会利用自己的力量召唤你以前战斗过的敌人，而且维度不稳定意味着如果你死了，丢失的物品将无法找回……

english: Take care, I suspect the Culinaromancer will not give up so easily!
translation: 小心点，我怀疑烹饪大师不会轻易放弃的！

english: You DARE come HERE?!?!
translation: 你敢来这里？！？！

english: Say hello to my little friend!
translation: 跟我的小朋友打个招呼吧！

english: NOOOooo...
translation: 不不不……

english: You will regret following me!
translation: 你会后悔跟着我的！

english: I will not be thwarted by you!
translation: 我不会被你挫败的！

english: You should not meddle in affairs that do not concern you!
translation: 你不该插手跟你无关的事！

english: I have waited a long time for my revenge!
translation: 我等复仇已经等了很久了！

english: This will be your death!
translation: 这就是你的死期！

english: Let's see how you deal with this!
translation: 我倒要看看你怎么应付这个！

english: I still have a few tricks left!
translation: 我还有几招没用呢！

english: You've been lucky so far, but no more!
translation: 你一直走运，但到此为止了！

english: You have caused me enough grief! I guess I'll have to finish you off myself!
translation: 你给我惹了够多的麻烦！看来我得亲手结果你了！

english: It seems I will have to deal with you myself!
translation: 看来我得亲自对付你了！

english: Ahah! I'm BACK!
translation: 啊哈！我回来了！

english: Good work [player]! I think that will be the last we'll see of him! You'd better come back now.
translation: 干得好，[player]！我想我们再也见不到他了！你现在最好回来吧。

english: Evil Dave? What's he doing on the secret council?
translation: 邪恶戴夫？他在秘密议会上做什么？

english: The council is meant to include one dark wizard, but obviously the other members did not want to include anyone who was a real threat.
translation: 议会本应包含一位黑巫师，但显然其他成员不想让任何真正构成威胁的人加入。

english: So how do I free him?
translation: 那我该怎么解救他？

english: To free Evil Dave you must make a stew, but it must be seasoned in a very particular way. The only way to find the recipe would be to ask someone who has tasted the stew.
translation: 要解救邪恶戴夫，你必须做一道炖菜，但必须以非常特殊的方式调味。唯一能找到食谱的方法就是询问尝过这道炖菜的人。

english: But who could that be?
translation: 但那个人会是谁？

english: Remember that from the point of view of the outside world, anything you do in here has already happened. All the people here are out in the world, because from their point of view you have already rescued them.
translation: 记住，从外面的世界来看，你在这里做的一切都已经发生了。这里的所有人都在外面的世界里，因为从他们的角度看，你已经救出了他们。

english: You mean I need to talk to Evil Dave outside the time bubble?
translation: 你是说我需要跟时间泡泡外面的邪恶戴夫谈谈？

english: Yes. He lives in Edgeville.
translation: 是的。他住在边陲镇。

english: With his mother.
translation: 和他母亲一起。

english: In her basement. I make no judgement about that.
translation: 在她家的地下室里。我不对此做任何评判。

english: Oooooookaaaaay....
translation: 好……好吧……

english: Remember, you need to make a particular stew for Evil Dave. Speak to him outside the time warp, because from his point of view out there you have already rescued him so he has already eaten the stew. He lives in
translation: 记住，你需要为邪恶戴夫做一道特别的炖菜。在时间扭曲外面跟他谈谈，因为在外面的他看来，你已经救了他，所以他早已吃过了那道炖菜。他住在

english: Edgeville.
translation: 边陲镇。

english: So... I don't suppose you can remember how I defeated him can you?
translation: 那么……我想你大概不记得我怎么打败他的吧？

english: Hello, dearie?
translation: 你好，亲爱的？

english: Is Dave in?
translation: 戴夫在家吗？

english: Yes, he's just down in the cellar. Are you one of his evil friends?
translation: 在，他就在地下室里。你是他的邪恶朋友之一吗？

english: Yes, I'm evil!
translation: 没错，我很邪恶！

english: Well, I hope the two of you have a good time. Try not to make too much mess.
translation: 好吧，希望你们俩玩得开心。尽量别弄得太乱。

english: No, I just want to talk to him.
translation: 不，我只是想跟他聊聊。

english: Oh, that's good. He needs to spend time with more normal people. He hardly ever leaves that cellar, it can't be healthy.
translation: 哦，那很好。他需要多和正常人来往。他几乎从不离开那个地下室，这对健康不好。

english: Can Dave come out to play?
translation: 戴夫能出来玩吗？

english: I know he's a grown man who lives in his mum's basement and hardly ever sees daylight, but there's no need to be nasty about it.
translation: 我知道他是个成年男人，住在妈妈的地下室里，几乎见不到阳光，但也没必要这么刻薄。

english: What did you eat at the secret council meeting?
translation: 你在秘密议会上吃了什么？

english: Hey, the council meeting! They wanted me to be their evil representative! That proves I'm a great dark wizard! Right?
translation: 嘿，议会会议！他们想让我当他们的邪恶代表！这证明我是个伟大的黑巫师！对吧？

english: But anyway, why do you want to know what I ate?
translation: 不过话说回来，你干嘛要知道我吃了什么？

english: I need to make that exact food in order to save you from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: 我需要做出那一样的食物，才能把你从烹饪师的法术中解救出来。

english: What? But that was last week! You've already saved me!
translation: 什么？但那已经是上周的事了！你早就救了我！

english: Sort of, it's complicated. It works like this...
translation: 差不多吧，这事很复杂。事情是这样的……

english: All right! Now that makes perfect sense!
translation: 好吧！现在这完全说得通了！

english: So what was it?
translation: 所以到底是什么？

english: The food you ate at the council meeting.
translation: 你在议会上吃的食物。

english: It was, like, this totally evil stew!
translation: 就是，那种超级邪恶的炖菜！

english: Evil stew? How was it evil?
translation: 邪恶炖菜？它怎么邪恶了？

english: Well, it kind of tasted evil, you know? You know, how you taste something and you think, that's really EVIL?
translation: 嗯，它尝起来有点邪恶，你知道吗？就像你尝到某样东西，然后觉得，这真TM邪恶？

english: I think you're mixing up 'good' and 'evil' again!
translation: 我觉得你又把'好'和'坏'搞混了！

english: What? Well, I'm evil, and I only like evil stuff, and I liked that, so it must be evil. Right?
translation: 什么？好吧，我很邪恶，我只喜欢邪恶的东西，我喜欢那道菜，所以它一定是邪恶的。对吧？

english: I suppose that makes some kind of sense. But I need to reproduce this stew, so can you describe it in more detail?
translation: 我想这也有点道理。但我需要复制这道炖菜，你能描述得更详细些吗？

english: Well it tasted like the stews my mum makes. She puts these spices in them. But it was like she'd got the amounts totally right this time.
translation: 嗯，它尝起来像我妈做的炖菜。她会放这些香料。但这次她好像把分量放得恰到好处。

english: Okay, I'd better talk to your mum.
translation: 好吧，我最好跟你妈妈谈谈。

english: May I use your spices for making stew?
translation: 我可以用你的香料做炖菜吗？

english: You can if you can find them. Dave's hell-rats stole them all!
translation: 如果你能找到的话，可以。戴夫的地狱老鼠把它们全偷走了！

english: I'd better go and kill some hell-rats then.
translation: 那我最好去杀几只地狱老鼠。

english: Hello again. Did you make your stew?
translation: 又见面了。你做炖菜了吗？

english: I haven't been able to make any stew that Dave likes yet.
translation: 我还没做出戴夫喜欢的炖菜。

english: Oh, he's terribly hard to please, isn't he? I never know how to make food evil enough for him, I just have to try different things and see what he likes.
translation: 哦，他实在太难取悦了，不是吗？我从来不知道怎么做食物才能让他觉得够邪恶，只能不断尝试不同的东西，看他喜欢哪个。

english: Could you taste this stew please?
translation: 你能尝一下这道炖菜吗？

english: That stew doesn't have any spices in it at all! That can't be right!
translation: 这道炖菜里一点香料都没有！这不对！

english: That's nothing like the stew I tasted. All the spices are wrong.
translation: 这和我尝过的炖菜一点都不像。所有香料都不对。

english: Hmm... I think you've got the amount of one spice right, but the others are wrong.
translation: 嗯……我觉得你有一种香料的量对了，但其他的不对。

english: You've got the amount of two of the spices right, but two of them are wrong.
translation: 你有两种香料的量对了，但另外两种不对。

english: That stew is pretty evil! But I think one of the spices is still a bit wrong.
translation: 这道炖菜相当邪恶！但我觉得有一种香料还是稍微有点不对。

english: TOTALLY EVIL! That's EXACTLY how the stew tasted!
translation: 超级邪恶！这炖菜的味道就完全是这样！

english: Now I just have to go back in time and give it to your earlier self!
translation: 现在我只需要回到过去，把它交给过去的你！

english: What? Why can't I eat it?
translation: 什么？为什么我不能吃？

english: You've already eaten it! This is the stew that you remember tasting in the first place!
translation: 你已经吃过了！这就是你记忆中一开始尝到的那道炖菜！

english: So confused...
translation: 好困惑……

english: Hello dearie. Did Dave like the stew you gave him?
translation: 你好啊亲爱的。戴夫喜欢你给他的炖菜吗？

english: Yes. I'm just about to go back in time to give it to him in the first place.
translation: 喜欢。我正准备回到过去，第一次把炖菜交给他。

english: Have a nice time then.
translation: 那就祝你们愉快。

english: Would you mind wandering out of my house?
translation: 你能从我家里出去吗？

english: I suppose you can, but try not to make a mess.
translation: 我想你可以，但尽量别弄乱东西。

english: I haven't got any money!
translation: 我没钱！

english: You should make sure that's the correct recipe first.
translation: 你应该先确认食谱是正确的。

english: Woah, what happened?
translation: 哇，发生了什么？

english: I've just saved you from a buffet worse than death!
translation: 我刚把你从比死亡还糟糕的自助餐中救了出来！

english: Hey, this is pretty evil stew!
translation: 嘿，这炖菜真够邪恶的！

english: Yes. Now it's very important you remember what the stew tasted like!
translation: 是的。现在你必须记住炖菜的味道，这非常重要！

english: Because... it just is!
translation: 因为……就是很重要！

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have [X] council member[s] left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者，我已经把他们传送到了安全的地方！你只剩下 [X] 位议会成员需要保护了！

english: You will need to feed King Awowogei his favourite dish.
translation: 你需要给阿沃盖国王喂他最喜欢的菜。

english: I have to admit I'm not sure, maybe you should ask him?
translation: 我承认我不太确定，也许你可以问问他？

english: Ask the version of him on Ape Atoll?
translation: 问猿猴岛上的那个他？

english: Hello stranger, what can I do for you?
translation: 你好，陌生人，我能帮你什么？

english: Do you have a particular favourite dish?
translation: 你有没有特别喜欢的菜？

english: What? No. Definitely not.
translation: 什么？不。绝对没有。

english: Are you sure?...
translation: 你确定吗？…

english: Absolutely, I can't let you have sensitive information like that...
translation: 绝对不行，我不能让你知道这种敏感信息……

english: So you do have a favourite dish, but you don't want to tell me.
translation: 所以你的确有喜欢的菜，但不想告诉我。

english: I won't tell you anything - and neither will the three monkeys, I made sure of that.  I can't have any monkey knowing about it.
translation: 我什么都不会告诉你——那三只猴子也不会，我确保过了。我不能让任何猴子知道这件事。

english: So if I talk with these three monkeys they'll tell me all about it?
translation: 所以如果我去跟那三只猴子谈谈，他们会告诉我所有情况？

english: NO! Now go away and leave me in peace.
translation: 不！现在走开，让我安静一下。

english: Go away, I have nothing further to say to you!
translation: 走开，我没什么要跟你说的了！

english: What? eh? Did you say something?
translation: 什么？呃？你说了什么吗？

english: Who's there? Hello?
translation: 谁在那儿？你好？

english: Is there somebody there?
translation: 有人在吗？

english: There's something familiar about you guys...
translation: 你们几个有点眼熟……

english: I'm Mizaru - This is Iwazaru [sic, no fullstop]
translation: 我是观猴——这是言猴（原文无句号）

english: He says hello, and this is Kikazaru [sic, no fullstop]]
translation: 他说你好，这是闻猴（原文无句号）

english: Oi, you, pay attention!
translation: 喂，你，注意点！

english: What? Oh, Hello who are you? I'm Kikazaru.
translation: 什么？哦，你好，你是谁？我是闻猴。

english: I've already said that.
translation: 我已经说过了。

english: What? Oh, This is Mizaru and Kikazaru.
translation: 什么？哦，这是观猴和闻猴。

english: I'VE ALREADY SAID THAT.
Not very bright that one.
translation: 那家伙不太灵光。

english: (sarcastically) Yeah, while you're the clever monkey around here aren't you?
translation: （讽刺地）是啊，你是这儿最聪明的猴子，对吧？

english: (Iwazaru waves his arms again.  Whatever he said it wasn't very polite.)
translation: （言猴又挥了挥胳膊。不管他说了什么，都不太礼貌。）

english: Hee Hee Hee, you're so rude.
translation: 嘻嘻嘻，你真粗鲁。

english: Grrr. Do you have any other questions?
translation: 咕噜噜。你还有其他问题吗？

english: So What exactly are you doing here?
translation: 那你们到底在这儿干什么？

english: Oh, just monkeying around.
translation: 哦，就是随便耍耍。

english: (Iwazaru slaps his forehead)
translation: （言猴拍了拍额头）

english: You look trustworthy, I'll tell you a secret.
translation: 你看起来值得信赖，我告诉你一个秘密。

english: (whispers) We're on a top secret mission, given to us by the King...
translation: （低声说）我们在执行国王交给我们的绝密任务……

english: We are the exalted Guardians of one of the King's biggest secrets.
translation: 我们是国王最大秘密之一的高贵守护者。

english: Can't say any more than that or the King would go Ape on us.
translation: 不能再多说了，否则国王会发猴疯的。

english: Oh go on...
translation: 哦，继续说吧……

english: No. We will protect the recipe with our lives...
translation: 不。我们会用生命保护食谱……

english: grrmmh fffhmmm (Iwazaru looks disgruntled)
translation: grrmmh fffhmmm（言猴看起来很不满）

english: Yeah, I agree with Iwazaru. The king CURSED us!
translation: 对，我同意言猴。国王对我们施了诅咒术！

english: How did he curse you?
translation: 他是怎么诅咒你的？

english: I know, I know, I'll tell him
translation: 我知道，我知道，我来告诉他。

english: NO!, I forbid you to tell this stranger anything!
translation: 不！我不准你们告诉这个陌生人任何事！

english: I can't hear you...
translation: 我听不见你说话……

english: Yeah, well hear this gnome-brain! (He slaps Kikazaru)
translation: 是啊，那就听听这个地精脑子吧！（他扇了闻猴一巴掌）

english: Ow! There was this recipe right.
translation: 嗷！是这样的，有个食谱。

english: (Oof!) He liked it so much he married the cook! YEAH? Have some of this! (poke!)
translation: （哎哟！）他太喜欢了，就娶了那个厨师！是吧？尝尝这个！（捅一下！）

english: AARGH not in the eye! (kick)
translation: 啊——别打眼睛！（踢一脚）

english: (Oof!) The King thought it was magic and  AAAIEEE! He got a priest to curse us to keep quiet. (headbutt!)
translation: （哎哟！）国王以为那是魔法，然后啊——！他找了个祭司诅咒我们，让我们闭嘴。（用头撞！）

english: Ha! Serves you right! Anyway, The priest only had enough ingredients for one curse, so when he tried to keep us all from telling anyone the recipe, each of us only got part of the curse.  That's why I can't hear
translation: 哈！活该！不管怎样，祭司的材料只够施一个诅咒术，所以当他试图阻止我们所有人泄露食谱时，我们每人只中了部分诅咒。所以我才听不见

english: anything now.
translation: 任何东西了。

english: mmmmghhh (he nods his head)
translation: mmmmghhh（他点了点头）

english: Can you tell me what this recipe is then?
translation: 那你能告诉我这个食谱是什么吗？

english: How do you know about that - It's top secret information you know.
translation: 你怎么知道那个的——那可是绝密信息，你知道的。

english: Well, I am also on a top secret mission.
translation: 嗯，我也在执行一项绝密任务。

english: Ah I see, can you tell me what the mission is?
translation: 啊我明白了，你能告诉我任务是什么吗？

english: Well, it's on a strict need to know basis. I'm sure you understand.
translation: 嗯，这需要严格按需知情。我相信你明白。

english: However, I think I can trust you with sensitive material.
translation: 不过，我想我可以相信你能处理敏感材料。

english: (Iwazaru raises an eyebrow dubiously.  You give him a wink.)
translation: （言猴怀疑地挑起眉毛。你对他眨了眨眼。）

english: (You whisper in Mizaru's ear) I've been charged with organising a secret party to celebrate the king's birthday, keep it quiet though, don't let a single monkey know.
translation: （你在观猴耳边低语）我受命组织一场秘密派对庆祝国王生日，但要保密，别让任何猴子知道。

english: Well, in that case, you definitely do need to know the recipe.
translation: 嗯，那样的话，你确实需要知道食谱。

english: The King has a real soft spot for Roasted Giant Snake stuffed with sliced banana and monkey nut paste.
translation: 国王对填有切片香蕉和猴坚果糊的烤巨蛇情有独钟。

english: GGHHMM! (Iwazaru starts jumping up and down)
translation: GGHHMM！（言猴开始上下跳）

english: Yup, you need to find some bananas, and some monkey nuts and stuff a Giant snake with them, It's as simple as that.  Stop hassling me Iwazaru.
translation: 对，你需要找一些香蕉和一些猴坚果，把它们塞进一条巨蛇里，就这么简单。别烦我了，言猴。

english: Where do I find this stuff then?
translation: 那我上哪儿找这些东西呢？

english: Every monkey knows where to get hold of nuts and bananas, but I believe that the snakes live on a nearby island.  Never seen one myself.
translation: 每只猴子都知道去哪儿弄坚果和香蕉，不过我相信蛇住在附近的一个岛上。我自己从没见过。

english: What am I looking for again?
translation: 我该找什么来着？

english: Some monkey nuts, a banana and a snake to stuff them into.
translation: 一些猴坚果、一根香蕉和一条能塞进去的蛇。

english: I've heard that there are snakes on a small island just to the east of here.  Nuts and bananas? Just check out the normal places.
translation: 我听说东边一个小岛上有蛇。坚果和香蕉？去平常的地方找就行。

english: Stop making such a fuss Iwazaru.
translation: 别这么大惊小怪，言猴。

english: Are you sure he's not trying to say something important....
translation: 你确定他不是想说什么重要的事吗……

english: No, no, no. Always looking to be the centre of attention that one. Don't let him worry you.
translation: 不不不。那家伙总想成为焦点。别让他烦你了。

english: ...If you say so...
translation: ……既然你这么说……

english: Ook Ah Ook! Ah! Ook! Ook Ah Ook!
translation: 噢啊噢！啊！噢！噢啊噢！

english: Ook. Ah Ah! Ah Uh Ah! Ook. Ook.
translation: 噢。啊啊！啊呃啊！噢。噢。

english: Ah Ah! Ook. Ook Ah Ook! Ook Ah Uh!
translation: 啊啊！噢。噢啊噢！噢啊呃！

english: Is this the right kind of snake, Iwazaru?
translation: 这是正确的蛇吗，言猴？

english: Iwazaru looks at the snake, sniffs it and nods sagely.
translation: 言猴看了看蛇，嗅了嗅，然后明智地点了点头。

english: Ah, monkey nuts. Good work
translation: 啊，猴坚果。干得好。

english: (Iwazaru is hysterically trying to get your attention)
translation: （言猴歇斯底里地试图吸引你的注意）

english: Stop playing around Iwazaru.
translation: 别闹了，言猴。

english: (Iwazaru grabs you by the arm)
translation: （言猴抓住你的胳膊）

english: (He shakes his head vigourously)
translation: （他用力摇了摇头）

english: I think Iwazaru is trying to say something.
translation: 我觉得言猴是想说些什么。

english: Oh ignore him.
translation: 哦，别理他。

english: mmmh!! (He quickly makes some signs at Kikazaru)
translation: mmmh！！（他迅速对闻猴做了几个手势）

english: Ah, I see...
translation: 啊，我明白了……

english: Iwazaru says that you have the wrong kind of monkey nuts.  Ordinary Monkeys nuts just won't do.
translation: 言猴说你的猴坚果种类不对。普通的猴坚果不行。

english: There is a special type of monkey nut that grows on the island and has a subtle and distinctive flavour that is highly valued by all monkeys with a sophisticated palate.
translation: 岛上生长着一种特殊的猴坚果，味道微妙独特，所有口味讲究的猴子都对其评价很高。

english: They are called Tchiki monkey nuts and require a very particular combination of soil and climate.
translation: 它们被称为奇基猴坚果，需要非常特定的土壤和气候组合。

english: They need the minerals and dampness found in hill caves, but they also cannot grow without sunlight.
translation: 它们需要小山洞穴里的矿物质和湿度，但没有阳光也无法生长。

english: Myth and Legend shrouds the History of the Tchiki Monkey Nut.
translation: 奇基猴坚果的历史笼罩在神话与传说之中。

english: Some say that it is the nut that gave monkeys their superior intelligence!
translation: 有人说，正是这种坚果赋予了猴子超凡的智慧！

english: Others say Tchiki Monkey nuts are the food of the Monkey Gods.
translation: 也有人说奇基猴坚果是猴神的食物。

english: Either way, you will have to find a path through treacherous undergrowth to harvest the Nut of Kings.
translation: 无论如何，你都得找一条穿过危险灌木丛的路，才能收获“国王坚果”。

english: ... He said all that?
translation: ……他就说了这些？

english: Yup
translation: 没错。

english: I never realised monkey sign language was so...concise. Anyway, where do I find this plant then?
translation: 我以前都不知道猴子的手语能这么……简洁。好吧，那这植物我要去哪儿找？

english: (Iwazaru nods enthusiastically and points South)
translation: （言猴使劲点头，指向南方。）

english: Look to the hills, south of here.
translation: 看看那边的山丘，就在村子南边。

english: Right! I'd better start looking for this Tchiki Monkey Nut Bush then...
translation: 好嘞！那我最好开始找那棵奇基猴坚果灌木了……

english: This feels like the banana, this should do the job.
translation: 摸起来像香蕉，应该没问题。

english: (Iwazaru Jumps up and down waving his arms and legs about wildly)
translation: （言猴上蹿下跳，疯狂地挥舞胳膊和腿。）

english: Quiet! Iwazaru.
translation: 安静！言猴。

english: I think your friend wants to tell me something.
translation: 我觉得你的朋友想告诉我什么。

english: Oh ignore him, he's clueless.
translation: 哦，别理他，他什么也不懂。

english: GGGRRRMMHHGG!!
translation: 咔咔咯呜吼咔！！

english: (Iwazaru makes what you suspect was a very rude gesture to Mizaru)
translation: （言猴朝观猴比了个你猜大概是很粗鲁的手势。）

english: (Iwazaru starts gesturing at Kikazaru)
translation: （言猴开始朝闻猴打手势。）

english: hmmm...
(Iwazaru gestures some more)
translation: （言猴又比划了几下。）

english: (Iwazaru waves his arms about yet more)
translation: （言猴继续使劲挥手。）

english: Oh that's very interesting.
translation: 哦，那很有意思。

english: (Iwazaru sighs. And points to you.)
translation: （言猴叹了口气，然后指向你。）

english: What, eh, oh right.
translation: 什么，呃，哦，对。

english: Iwazaru says that you have the wrong type of banana.
translation: 言猴说你拿的香蕉不对。

english: You need a red one.
translation: 你需要一个红蕉。

english: (sigh), I should have guessed that it wouldn't be that easy. A red banana. Don't all bananas taste the same?
translation: （叹气）我早该猜到没这么简单。红蕉。香蕉味道不都一样吗？

english: (Iwazaru looks shocked)
translation: （言猴露出震惊的表情。）

english: (Mizaru looks astounded)
translation: （观猴露出难以置信的表情。）

english: (Kikazaru looks blankly over your shoulder)
translation: （闻猴茫然地望向你的身后。）

english: How can a monkey say such a thing!
translation: 一只猴子怎么能说出这种话！

english: Oh, you mean RED bananas, yes, of course, I've heard that they are the tastiest. Much tastier than blue bananas. How could I forget. Bah, only a fake monkey wouldn't know that. Ahem.
translation: 哦，你是说红蕉，对，当然，我听说过那是最好吃的。比蓝色香蕉好吃多了。我怎么会忘了呢。呸，只有假猴子才会不知道。咳。

english: Blue bananas? There's no such thing. Hey, wait a second where did you say you came from?
translation: 蓝色香蕉？根本没这种东西。嘿，等一下，你刚才说你从哪儿来的？

english: Errm I'm not from round here, anyway, moving quickly on, is there a red banana tree nearby?
translation: 呃，我不是本地人，话说回来，赶紧换个话题，附近有红蕉树吗？

english: (Iwazaru nods enthusiastically and points West)
translation: （言猴使劲点头，指向西方。）

english: Iwazaru says that there is a tree in the West of the Island.
translation: 言猴说岛西边有一棵树。

english: Right! I'd better start looking for a red banana tree.
translation: 好嘞！那我最好开始找一棵红蕉树了。

english: Where's this tchiki monkey nut bush again?
translation: 那棵奇基猴坚果灌木又在哪里来着？

english: Iwazaru says that there is a bush in a cave somewhere in the hills just south of the village.
translation: 言猴说村子南边山丘某处的洞穴里有一棵灌木。

english: I think I've got some Tchiki monkey nuts.
translation: 我觉得我找到了一些奇基猴坚果。

english: Don't eat them...
translation: 别吃它们……

english: (Iwazaru shrugs apologetically!)
translation: （言猴无奈地耸耸肩！）

english: Mmm these are very tasty. Tchiki Monkey nuts really are the best nuts I've ever tasted.
translation: 嗯，这些很好吃。奇基猴坚果真是我吃过的最好吃的坚果。

english: But I'm afraid you're going to have to get some more.
translation: 但恐怕你得再弄一些来。

english: So these are definitely Tchiki Monkey nuts then?
translation: 那么这些确实是奇基猴坚果了？

english: Oi. I need these.
translation: 喂。我需要这些。

english: Iwazaru nods and gives you the thumbs up.
translation: 言猴点点头，竖起大拇指。

english: Where's this red banana tree again?
translation: 那棵红蕉树又在哪里来着？

english: Is this the red banana I'm looking for?
translation: 这是我要找的红蕉吗？

english: Wait! I need that, you don't have to eat...
translation: 等等！我要那个，你不用非得吃……

english: (Iwazaru slaps his forehead!)
translation: （言猴一拍额头！）

english: Too late...
translation: 太迟了……

english: Hmmm, oh yes very tasty.
translation: 嗯，哦，对，很好吃。

english: Well... is that the right one?
translation: 那么……这个是对的吗？

english: Oh yes, I'd recognise the taste of red anywhere.
translation: 哦对，红蕉的味道我哪里都能认出来。

english: Really... I suppose I'd better get another one now.
translation: 真的吗……我想我最好再去弄一个。

english: This is the right one?
translation: 这个是对的吗？

english: Have you cooked the snake yet?
translation: 你把蛇烤了吗？

english: I'm afraid I've lost it.
translation: 恐怕我把它弄丢了。

english: That was a bit careless wasn't it? You'd better go and make another one then.
translation: 那也太不小心了吧？你最好再去弄一个。

english: Err what am I doing again?
translation: 呃，我现在是要做什么来着？

english: Get a red banana, some tchiki monkey nuts, and the snake corpse.  Prepare the ingredients and stuff them into the snake. Simple.  Even Kikazaru could do it.
translation: 弄一个红蕉，一些奇基猴坚果，还有蛇尸。准备好食材，塞进蛇里。简单。连闻猴都能做到。

english: How do I cook this thing, it's huge! It's not going to fit in an oven or on a spit?
translation: 这东西怎么烤啊？这么大！烤箱或烤架上放不下吧？

english: A very good question. Anyone know?
translation: 问得好。有人知道吗？

english: (Iwazaru nods) He looks at Kikazaru to translate for him.
translation: （言猴点点头）他看向闻猴，让他翻译。

english: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
translation: 呼噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜

english: (Iwazaru prods Kikazaru)
translation: （言猴捅了捅闻猴。）

english: Zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz
translation: 呼噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜噜

english: (Iwazaru sighs, and then points to the floor directly beneath him, then acts like a zombie.
translation: （言猴叹了口气，然后指向他正下方的地板，接着模仿僵尸的动作。）

english: He then points at you and falls over and plays dead, gets up and then shrugs.)
translation: （然后他指向你，倒在地上装死，站起来后又耸了耸肩。）

english: Hmmm, somewhere underneath here, with zombies?
translation: 嗯，在这下面的某个地方，和僵尸一起？

english: (Iwazaru nods)
translation: （言猴点头。）

english: (He then wipes his forehead as if it were hot and points at the sacrificial pyre in the east of the temple.)
translation: （然后他擦了擦额头，好像很热，指了指神殿东边的祭祀火葬堆。）

english: Somewhere hot, nearby? What's this business about me dying though - that's not so cool.
translation: 附近某个热的地方？不过你刚才比划我死了是怎么回事——那可不太妙。

english: (Iwazaru shrugs)
translation: （言猴耸耸肩。）

english: Well, I suppose I'd better have a look.
translation: 好吧，我想我最好去看看。

english: I've stuffed the snake.
translation: 我把蛇填好了。

english: You'd better cook it now then.
translation: 那你最好现在把它烤了。

english: You still here? You haven't lost the royal dish have you?
translation: 你还在这儿？你没把御膳弄丢吧？

english: Errr I'm afraid I have.
translation: 呃，恐怕是的。

english: You'd better make another one then... You know what to do.
translation: 那你最好再做一个……你知道该怎么做。

english: Mmmm, something smells good...
translation: 嗯，有什么东西闻起来真香……

english: Yup, it's all cooked and ready to go, or at least I think it is.
translation: 没错，全烤好了，可以上桌了，至少我觉得是这样。

english: Maybe the King wouldn't notice if we had a little bit?
translation: 要是我们尝一点，国王也许注意不到？

english: Just a little taste.
translation: 就一小口。

english: Iwazaru slaps both of the other monkeys on the back of the head!
translation: 言猴往另外两只猴子后脑勺各拍了一下！

english: Yeah, listen to Iwazaru - stay away from my stuffed snake! I'm not making another one.  There was more than enough monkey business involved in making this one.
translation: 对，听言猴的——离我的填馅蛇远点儿！我可不想再做一条。做这条已经够多猴子把戏了。

english: Take that thing away from us.  It will only fill us with unfulfilled longing...
translation: 把那东西拿远点儿。只会让我们充满无法满足的渴望……

english: Thanks for your help guys! I've had more fun than a barrel of monkeys doing this.
translation: 谢谢你们帮忙！做这件事比一桶猴子还开心。

english: Though I wish I'd realised earlier on that Iwazaru was the monkey with brains...
translation: 虽然我真希望早点意识到言猴才是那只有脑子的猴子……

english: Ooh. You cheeky monkey!
translation: 哦。你这只调皮的猴子！

english: (Iwazaru mimes a crown on his head.)
translation: （言猴比划着一个王冠戴在头上。）

english: Heh, time to serve this to the king...
translation: 嘿，该把这道菜献给国王了……

english: Ook Ah Uh! Ook Ah Uh! Ah Ah!
translation: 唔哇哦！唔哇哦！啊哈！

english: Ook! Ah Uh Ah! Ook. Ook Ook! Ook.
translation: 唔哇！啊哈啊！唔哇。唔哇唔哇！唔哇。

english: Ah Uh Ah! Ah Uh Ah! Ook Ah Uh!
translation: 啊哈啊！啊哈啊！唔哇啊！

english: Ook Ook! Ook Ah Ook! Ook! Ah! Ah!
translation: 唔哇唔哇！唔哇啊唔哇！唔哇！啊！啊！

english: Ook Ah Ook! Ah Uh Ah! Ook Ah Ook!
translation: 唔哇啊唔哇！啊哈啊！唔哇啊唔哇！

english: Ah Uh Ah! Ook Ah Ook! Ook. Ook.
translation: 啊哈啊！唔哇啊唔哇！唔哇。唔哇。

english: Ook Ah Uh! Ook Ah Ook! Ah Ah!
translation: 唔哇啊！唔哇啊唔哇！啊哈！

english: Err Where am I? Ooh! Roasted Stuffed Snake, lovely.
translation: 呃，我这是在哪？哦！烤填馅蛇，真棒。

english: Mmmm, I'm sure I can detect the delicate aroma of Tchiki Monkey nuts, and the sweet perfume of Red Bananas, all slowly caramelised on hot rocks.
translation: 嗯，我肯定能闻到奇基猴坚果的细腻香气，还有红蕉的甜香，全都在热石上慢慢焦糖化了。

english: *munch* Who are you?
translation: *嚼* 你是谁？

english: I'm just a wandering chef, travelling from town to town saving peoples lives.
translation: 我只是个四处流浪的厨师，从一个城镇到另一个城镇，拯救人们的性命。

english: *gorge* You're a bit odd, aren't you?
translation: *吞咽* 你有点古怪，不是吗？

english: Yet again, my heroic work goes unappreciated, I suppose that is the fate of a true hero.
translation: 又一次，我的英雄事迹无人赏识，我想这就是真正英雄的命运吧。

english: So ... I've heard that this dish makes you more cooperative.
translation: 所以……我听说这道菜能让你更合作。

english: *stuff* That's a lie, no definitely not. Well maybe.
translation: *塞满食物* 那是谎言，绝对不是。好吧，也许吧。

english: Well, getting to Ape Atoll is quite a pain.  Do you have a way of making it easier to get there?
translation: 嗯，到达猿猴岛相当麻烦。你有什么办法让去那里更容易吗？

english: N,   Nnnnn..... nghghghnmnmn ... Yes there is a spell.
translation: 不，  不nnnn..... 嗯嗯嗯嗯嗯…… 有一个法术。

english: Will you let me know how to cast it?
translation: 你能告诉我如何施放它吗？

english: Absolutely No... Nerrrrnnnn...Oh, go on then.
translation: 坚决不行……呃呃呃嗯……哦，那好吧。

english: So, what do I need to know?
translation: 那么，我需要知道什么？

english: Well, it will take a while to explain...
translation: 嗯，解释起来需要一些时间……

english: Ah I see, so the banana actually has the crucial effect on the teleportation matrix.
translation: 啊我明白了，所以香蕉实际上对传送矩阵起到了关键作用。

english: Yes, yes, of course.
translation: 是的，是的，当然。

english: I'm sorry I forced you to tell me the spell.
translation: 很抱歉我强迫你告诉我那个法术。

english: Oh that's alright - it could have been worse - you could have asked me to marry you.
translation: 哦没关系——本来可能更糟——你本来可以向我求婚的。

english: Yes - that would have been a lot worse.
translation: 是的——那会更糟得多。

english: Anyway, it seems you have done me a favour. Though I'm a bit confused about what went on here.
translation: 总之，看来你帮了我一个忙。不过我对这里发生的事情有点困惑。

english: You're confused? Get a ticket and join the queue, Your Monkeyness.
translation: 你困惑？拿个号码牌排队去吧，猴子陛下。

english: Born from an egg on a mountain top,
translation: 生于山顶的蛋，

english: The punkiest Monkey that ever popped,
translation: 史上最朋克的猴子破壳而出，

english: What are you singing?
translation: 你在唱什么？

english: It's an old Monkey Legend.
translation: 是古老的猴子传说。

english: Sounds like a fun story.
translation: 听起来是个有趣的故事。

english: All monkey stories are fun. Maybe I'll tell it to you some time...
translation: 所有猴子故事都很有趣。也许改天我讲给你听……

english: How would I go about protecting this nautical fellow from the curse of the culinaromancer then?
translation: 那么，我该如何保护这位航海伙计免受烹饪大师的诅咒呢？

english: Hmmm... Wait a moment, my fortune-teller-sense is tingling...
translation: 嗯……等等，我的占卜感应正在嗡嗡作响……

english: Erm... okay...
translation: 呃……好吧……

english: Ah yes. To immunise him from the culinaromancer's attack, you will need to feed him fishcakes.
translation: 啊，对了。要让他免疫烹饪大师的攻击，你需要喂他吃鱼饼。

english: Fishcakes? What, like chocolate cake with fish instead of chocolate?
translation: 鱼饼？什么，就像巧克力蛋糕那样，只不过把巧克力换成鱼？

english: No... Like small bread crumbed fishy delicacies.
translation: 不……是那种裹着面包屑的小鱼美味。

english: Um... So how would I make those then?
translation: 嗯……那我该怎么做呢？

english: I don't know. I am a fortune-teller, not a cook.
translation: 我不知道。我是占卜师，不是厨师。

english: I don't suppose it occurred to you to ask the actual cook in the room right next door to us?
translation: 你就没想过问问隔壁房间那位真正的厨师吗？

english: Ooooh yeah... I'll be right back!
translation: 哦哦哦对……我马上回来！

english: Err... have you forgotten about the fishcakes already?
translation: 呃……你该不会已经忘了鱼饼的事吧？

english: I might have, I might not have.
translation: 也许忘了，也许没忘。

english: This time-travelling stuff just has me a little worn out ok?
translation: 这穿越时空的事让我有点疲惫，行了吧？

english: To immunise him from the culinaromancer's attack, you will need to feed him fishcakes.
translation: 要让他免疫烹饪大师的攻击，你需要喂他吃鱼饼。

english: And try not to forget this time!
translation: 这次可别再忘了！

english: Ahoy there! Up for a bit of a swim?
translation: 嘿，你好啊！想游个泳吗？

english: Well, whenever you want me to get you some diving gear, just come and see me with a fishbowl.
translation: 嗯，什么时候你想让我给你弄些潜水装备，就带个鱼缸来找我。

english: Well sure, just as soon as you have some spare space for it.
translation: 当然可以，只要你有空位放得下。

english: Well, I have plenty of them under the tap, getting sluiced off. When you have space for one come and see me.
translation: 嗯，水龙头下面多的是，正在冲洗呢。等你有空位了就来找我吧。

english: Hey! Nung says no fishies in da big crunchy claws!
translation: 嘿！农说大克伦奇爪子里没有鱼！

english: You want crunchies, you talk to him, an' hope he not hungry!
translation: 你想要克伦奇，就跟他谈，还得希望他不饿！

english: Hey fishy! You gots da skippy skins?
translation: 嘿小鱼！你有斯基皮皮吗？

english: Den no crunchy claws for you!
translation: 那就没有克伦奇爪子给你！

english: Nung, I have your giant Mudskipper Skins.
translation: 农，我有你的巨型弹涂鱼皮。

english: Ya, dis fishy is a good fishy, but it no count good like Nung! Nung say dere are dis many hides left for da fishy to get.
translation: 呀，这条鱼是好鱼，但它数数没农好！农说还有这么多皮要小鱼去拿。

english: Go get me da hides little fishy!
translation: 去给农拿皮来，小鱼！

english: Has da fish brung Nung the wiry stuff and the needly thing?
translation: 小鱼给农带铁丝和针状物了吗？

english: Nung not supprised, the upsies is real scaredy for da little fishies like you.
translation: 农不意外，上面的人对你这样的小鱼真是胆小。

english: I have all the ingredients for fishcakes!
translation: 我有做鱼饼的所有材料了！

english: Great! Just like before! I've been reading the recipe and I know how to make the fishcakes now.
translation: 太好了！就像之前一样！我读了食谱，现在知道怎么做鱼饼了。

english: It's pretty simple actually. All you have to do is use the ingredients on each other and then cook the fishcakes on a range.
translation: 其实很简单。你只需要把材料互相使用，然后在炉灶上烹饪鱼饼就行了。

english: Yes. I thought that there was a page missing from the cookbook because it seemed so easy, but it turns out it really IS that easy!
translation: 是的。我之前还以为食谱缺了一页，因为看起来太简单了，但结果发现真的就这么简单！

english: Stop messing about and use the fishcakes on him!
translation: 别磨蹭了，快把鱼饼用在他身上！

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have [number] council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者，我已经把他们传送到了安全的地方！你还有[number]位议会成员需要保护！

english: To protect this noble knight from the magic of the culinaromancer, you will have to give him a creme brulee.
translation: 要保护这位高贵的骑士免受烹饪大师魔法的伤害，你需要给他一份焦糖布丁。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Not just any creme brulee mind you, but a creme brulee supreme!
translation: 注意，可不是普通的焦糖布丁，而是至尊焦糖布丁！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Well that doesn't sound too hard. What's so supreme about a creme brulee supreme?
translation: 听起来不难。至尊焦糖布丁到底至尊在哪里？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Are you going to constantly ask me questions?
translation: 你打算一直问我问题吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: I am a fortune-teller, not a cook, and again I would suggest you speak to the cook next door who will be much more helpful on such culinary matters.
translation: 我是占卜师，不是厨师，我再次建议你去问问隔壁的厨师，他在烹饪方面会更有帮助。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Although I happen to know that one of the ingredients is the egg of the evil chicken.
translation: 不过我碰巧知道其中一种材料是邪恶鸡的蛋。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: The evil chicken? Great. He only ever seems to show up when I don't want him to.
translation: 邪恶鸡？太好了。它好像总是在我不想它出现的时候出现。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: I believe the wise old man in Draynor has studied the Evil Chicken.
translation: 我相信德雷诺的老智者是研究过邪恶鸡的。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: I would suggest you speak to him to get you on the right track. And tell him Bubbykins says hi.
translation: 我建议你去找他，让他给你指条明路。顺便跟他说小宝贝问好。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Er... Bubbykins?
translation: 呃……小宝贝？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: That is not important right now. Go! Protect Sir Amik from the magic that threatens his life, my spell will only hold so long!
translation: 现在这不重要。去吧！保护阿米克爵士免受威胁他生命的魔法，我的法术撑不了多久！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Just give me 5 minutes and I'll be back!
translation: 给我五分钟，我马上回来！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Could you give me that recipe again, please?
translation: 能再告诉我一遍那个食谱吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Certainly, forgetful hero.
translation: 当然可以，健忘的英雄。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: and read dusty tomes in the Library of Varrock.
translation: 并在维洛克城图书馆阅读尘封的典籍。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Thanks! So how can you help me?
translation: 谢谢！那你能帮我什么？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Could you tell me about the Evil Chicken, please?
translation: 能请你讲讲邪恶鸡的事吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: The Evil Chicken! Many are the myths and legends surrounding this foul bird. Some say that it is the result of a mad mage's attempt to summon a demon, others say that it was once a
translation: 邪恶鸡！关于这只邪恶鸟类的神话和传说数不胜数。有人说它是一个疯狂法师试图召唤恶魔的结果，也有人说它曾经是一只
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: normal chicken that realised how limited its farmyard life was. It threw off its chains and attempted to unite the other chickens in revenge against their human captors.
translation: 普通的鸡，意识到自己农场生活的局限后，挣脱了锁链，试图联合其他鸡向人类俘虏复仇。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: When that failed the Evil Chicken grew angry with its brethren and swore to kill any human or chicken that it ever encountered again!
translation: 当那失败后，邪恶鸡对它的同类感到愤怒，并发誓要杀死它再次遇到的任何人类或鸡！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: It is whispered that there is a coven of witches that meet, on the night of the full moon in the fabled fairy kingdom, to worship this bird and that they can summon it to do their twisted will!
translation: 有传言说，在传说中的仙子王国，满月之夜会有一个女巫集会，她们崇拜这只鸟，并能召唤它来实现她们扭曲的意志！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Right, so if you were looking for the chicken where would you go?
translation: 好吧，那如果你要找那只鸡，你会去哪里？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: I would start in the lands of the fairies, possibly there is some truth in the rumours of summoning the chicken there. Actually, I've done further research, it may be around
translation: 我会从仙子的领地开始，也许在那里召唤鸡的传闻有些是真的。实际上，我做了进一步研究，它可能就在
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: here somewhere, if you're really thinking of going there you should be extremely careful, it's claimed that the chicken has forced some very powerful creatures to guard his lair.
translation: 这附近的某个地方，如果你真想去那里，一定要极其小心，据说那只鸡强迫了一些非常强大的生物守卫它的巢穴。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: I think you need to wear some sort of protective gloves, otherwise I'll flambé your arm.
translation: 我觉得你需要戴某种防护手套，不然我会把你的手臂烤焦。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Go ahead, I'll be fine.
translation: 来吧，我没事的。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: Okay, if you're sure.
translation: 好吧，如果你确定的话。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: What gloves do you have in mind?
translation: 你说的是什么手套？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: A pair of ice gloves should do the trick.
translation: 一双冰手套应该能搞定。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: I'll go fetch them then.
translation: 那我去拿。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing Sir Amik Varze

english: I think you need to wear some sort of protective gloves, otherwise I'll flambe your arm.
translation: 我觉得你需要戴上某种防护手套，不然我会把你的胳膊给烧了。

english: That brulee needs some more work before it's ready for flambeing.
translation: 那个焦糖布丁还需要再加工一下才能进行火焰炙烤。

english: How dare you not give me your full attention when you were the one who summoned me! Begone from me, until you learn some manners!
translation: 是你召唤了我，却敢不专心听我说话！滚开，等你学会礼貌再说！

english: How can I help Skrach?
translation: 我该怎么帮斯克拉奇？

english: Skrach! He'd be un-frozen in a jiffy if he just had some Jubbly.
translation: 斯克拉奇！只要给他吃点朱布利，他马上就能解冻。

english: And once again, but in English this time?
translation: 再说一遍，这次说人话行吗？

english: Sorry...Skrach, being an ogre likes Chompies, and a real delicacy is Jubbly Chompy bird. Do you think you could get some?
translation: 抱歉……斯克拉奇是食人魔，喜欢吃食人鸟，而朱布利食人鸟更是难得的美味。你能弄到一些吗？

english: Yes, I'm sure I can get some Jubbly Chompy.
translation: 好，我肯定能弄到一些朱布利食人鸟。

english: Ok then, what's involved...how do I get this Jubbly chompy?
translation: 那好吧，具体要怎么做……我该怎么弄到朱布利食人鸟？

english: Ah, well, that's where it breaks down a bit you see. The only 'thing' alive which might help you get the Jubbly Chompy is the most confusing beast that Gielinor has ever known.
translation: 啊，这个嘛，问题就出在这里。唯一能帮你弄到朱布利食人鸟的'东西'，是吉列诺最让人头疼的生物。

english: The situation is lost I am afraid and I understand totally if you decide not to help Skrach.
translation: 恐怕这事没戏了，如果你决定不帮斯克拉奇，我完全理解。

english: Oh come on...it can't be that difficult..
translation: 哎呀，别这样……能有多难啊……

english: I'm afraid it is. You see...you need to go and speak to an Ogre called Rantz over in the Feldip hills.
translation: 恐怕就是这么难。你看……你得去费迪普丘陵找一个叫兰茨的食人魔谈谈。

english: Ahh right...I see..
translation: 啊，这样……我明白了……

english: How do you feel about getting Jubbly Chompy now and freeing Skrach?
translation: 现在你还想弄朱布利食人鸟来救斯克拉奇吗？

english: No way am I going to talk to Rantz.
translation: 我才不去跟兰茨说话呢。

english: I quite understand...
translation: 我完全理解……

english: I really do...
translation: 真的理解……

english: There's no excuse for him really...
translation: 他确实没什么好说的……

english: Poor old Skrach...
translation: 可怜的斯克拉奇……

english: Oh Ok then, I guess I'll talk to Rantz.
translation: 好吧，那我去跟兰茨谈谈。

english: Well, I do pity you, and wish you the best of luck!
translation: 唉，我真同情你，祝你好运！

english: Nah, leave that Ogre in the frozen dimension!
translation: 不，就让那个食人魔待在冰冻空间里吧！

english: Alas, I can certainly relate to what you say. However, he deserves to be set free, the same as everyone else.
translation: 唉，我确实理解你的感受。但他和其他人一样，也应该被释放。

english: What should I do now to help Skrach?
translation: 我现在该做什么来帮斯克拉奇？

english: Skrach needs Jubbly chompy in order to be unfrozen, you'll need to talk to Rantz about how to get that. Perhaps the cook can be more helpful.
translation: 斯克拉奇需要朱布利食人鸟才能解冻，你得去跟兰茨谈谈怎么弄到它。也许厨师能帮上更多忙。

english: I'm trying to free Skrach, can you help?
translation: 我想救斯克拉奇，你能帮忙吗？

english: Skrach...he big boss? Skrach like da Jubbly chompy...is bestest yums like chompy.
translation: 斯克拉奇……他是大老大？斯克拉奇喜欢朱布利食人鸟……是最好吃的，像食人鸟一样。

english: Ok, so can you help me get some Jubbly Chompy?
translation: 好吧，那你能帮我弄点朱布利食人鸟吗？

english: Rantz tell creature hows to stick da Jubbly...just like da Chompy...
translation: 兰茨告诉生物怎么戳朱布利……就像戳食人鸟一样……

english: Soon, creature be da ogre too like Rantz! Harr, har, har!
translation: 很快，生物也会变成像兰茨一样的食人魔！哈，哈，哈！

english: A nice thought, but unlikely...
translation: 想法不错，但不太可能……

english: But creature do Rantz stuffsies first...yous creature gets Rantz to other lands over 'der so Rantz gets da stuffsies for da glugs-glugs.
translation: 但生物要先做兰茨的事……你生物带兰茨去那边其他地方，这样兰茨就能拿到咕噜咕噜的东西。

english: Yous do dis creature for da Jubbly?
translation: 你生物为了朱布利做这个？

english: You's creature gets Rantz to other lands over 'der so Rantz gets da stuffsies for da glug-glugs.
translation: 你生物带兰茨去那边其他地方，这样兰茨就能拿到咕噜咕噜的东西。

english: What do I get in return?
translation: 我能得到什么回报？

english: Me's shows da creatures how to sneaky, sneaky stick da Jubbly!
translation: 我教生物怎么偷偷地、悄悄地戳朱布利！

english: Dat's da good fing, you's creature goes down by da watery place, over near da cabbage! Me's says more der'.
translation: 那是好事，你生物去水边，靠近卷心菜的地方！我更多话在那里说。

english: Ok, will do!
translation: 好，就这么办！

english: No way am I doing that!
translation: 我才不干呢！

english: You's creatures says dis before! Skrach big boss? Skrach like da Jubbly chompy...is bestest yums like chompy.
translation: 你生物之前说过这个！斯克拉奇是大老大？斯克拉奇喜欢朱布利食人鸟……是最好吃的，像食人鸟一样。

english: Ok, here I am...I guess this is the watery place? What now?
translation: 好吧，我来了……我猜这就是水边？现在怎么办？

english: You's creatures says what Rantz need for da going over da big water to da over'der place.
translation: 你生物说兰茨需要什么才能过大水去那边的地方。

english: Oh, so you want to go to Karamja...hmmmm, it's a bit of a long walk. You'd probably be better off with a boat!
translation: 哦，所以你想去卡拉姆詹岛……嗯，走路有点远。你最好弄条船！

english: Is what me's says...you's creature no helpsies...just says Rantz saysies back!
translation: 我说的就是这个……你生物不帮忙……只是把兰茨的话传回去！

english: Ohhhh...sorry! Ok, for a boat you'll need something that floats in order to make a hull.
translation: 哦……抱歉！好吧，要造一艘船，你需要一些能漂浮的东西来做船体。

english: Uh rocksie?
translation: 呃，石头？

english: Close!... But perhaps a tree would be better?
translation: 接近了！……但也许树更好？

english: Me finks me has found one...
translation: 我觉得我找到了一个……

english: ...very good...
Can you tell me how to get Jubbly now?
translation: 现在你能告诉我怎么弄到朱布利了吗？

english: You's creatures not done for Rantz fingies yet! Da boatsie is da guddun...will carry rantzto da over place?
translation: 你生物还没做完兰茨的事呢！船是好东西……能带兰茨去那边的地方？

english: You can't use that as a boat! The roots are still hanging off it.
translation: 你不能用那个当船！树根还挂在上面呢。

english: Ok, you's creature makes it better!
translation: 好，你生物把它弄好！

english: Now can you please tell me how to get Jubbly?
translation: 现在你能告诉我怎么弄到朱布利了吗？

english: Creatures not done yet! Da boatsie not good for da stuffsies! Da stuffsies for da glug-glugs goes in da watery stuffs.
translation: 生物还没做完呢！船不适合放东西！咕噜咕噜的东西要放在水里。

english: Well, yes, you've got no space to put anything in there... it needs to be hollowed out a bit.
translation: 嗯，是啊，里面没地方放东西……需要挖空一点。

english: Ok, the boat's ready, now tell me how to get a Jubbly.
translation: 好了，船准备好了，现在告诉我怎么弄到朱布利。

english: Yous do other stuffsies for Rantz first. We's needs da bestest groundy for da walking on new land.
translation: 你先为兰茨做其他事。我们需要最好的泥土来在新土地上走路。

english: Bestest groundy? New land?
translation: 最好的泥土？新土地？

english: Rantz use stabbie chucker and stick da dirt for da over der' place. You's creature make da chompy by da stabber so Fycie and Bugs sniffs da bestest yumms and splosh over wiv da boatsie!
translation: 兰茨用戳戳器把泥土粘在那边的地方。你生物在戳戳器旁边做食人鸟，这样菲西和巴格斯就能闻到最好的美味，然后和船一起扑通过来！

english: Ok you's person...goes find da stabber!
translation: 好吧，你这个人……去找戳戳器！

english: Please, can you just show me how to catch a Jubbly!
translation: 拜托，你能直接教我怎么抓朱布利吗！

english: Creatures not done Rantz stuffsies yet!
translation: 生物还没做完兰茨的事呢！

english: Ok, what do you need me to do now?
translation: 好吧，你现在需要我做什么？

english: Rantz done used da stabbie chucker and stock da dirt for da over der' place. You's creature make da chompy by da stabber so Fycie and Bugs sniffs da bestest yumms and splosh over wiv da boatsie!
translation: 兰茨用完了戳戳器，把泥土堆在那边的地方。你生物在戳戳器旁边做食人鸟，这样菲西和巴格斯就能闻到最好的美味，然后和船一起扑通过来！

english: You's creature...goes to da over der' place and cook da chompy by da stabber!
translation: 你生物……去那边的地方，在戳戳器旁边烤食人鸟！

english: Hey there...we's could smell da Chompy from ages back...it smells lish!
translation: 嘿，你好……我们老远就闻到食人鸟的味道了……闻起来真香！

english: Dad says you can get a lift back with us if you want?
translation: 爸爸说如果你愿意，可以搭我们的顺风船回去？

english: Dad says you can get a free lift back with us if you want?
translation: 爸爸说如果你愿意，可以免费搭我们的顺风船回去？

english: Ok, now tell me how to get Jubbly!
translation: 好了，现在告诉我怎么弄到朱布利！

english: What's creature's say?
translation: 生物说什么？

english: I've helped with your scheme to get over to Karamja, now help me by telling me how to get Jubbly!
translation: 我帮你实现了去卡拉姆詹岛的计划，现在你帮我，告诉我怎么弄到朱布利！

english: Ohhh, get's Jubbly...dat's da easy fing...you's creature is a bit stoopid for not know dat!
translation: 哦，弄朱布利……那很容易……你生物不知道真是有点笨！

english: Just tell me!
translation: 快告诉我！

english: Okays creature's keeps hairsies on...
translation: 好吧，生物别急……

english: Ok then you's creature...you's use da big blowers on da fatsie toady. Creature makes da fatsie toady and den needs da rocksie an da wooly fing to stick it down da ground.
translation: 好吧，你生物……你用大吹风机吹胖蟾蜍。生物先做胖蟾蜍，然后需要石头和毛茸茸的东西把它钉在地上。

english: I saw some large static ogre spits near Jiggig and Rantz. Perhaps I can cook this jubbly meat there?
translation: 我在吉吉格和兰茨附近看到一些大型固定食人魔烤架。也许我可以在那里烤这块朱布利肉？

english: Which one of these am I actually meant to be saving?
translation: 这些里面哪个才是我真正该救的？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Hmmm... neither of them were at the previous council meeting.
translation: 嗯……他们两个都没参加上次的委员会会议。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: The goblins get through leaders so fast I find it hard to keep track. I heard the last leader died during a game of pin the tail on the basilisk.
translation: 哥布林的领袖换得太快了，我很难记住。我听说上一任领袖在玩“给石化蜥蜴钉尾巴”游戏时死了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Well, no worries. I'm sure if you just find something that they'll both eat then that should work. I hope.
translation: 好吧，别担心。我敢肯定，只要你找到他们两个都愿意吃的东西，就奏效了。希望如此。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Remembering the last time I dealt with these two, that may be easier said than done.
translation: 想起上次我和这两个家伙打交道，那可真是说起来容易做起来难。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Well you could try asking some of the other goblins in their village for ideas. You should be able to find it just to the North of Falador, unless they've decided the sky is the wrong colour there or something.
translation: 嗯，你可以试试去他们的村子里问问其他哥布林，讨点主意。你应该能在法拉多城北边找到那个村子，除非他们又觉得那儿的天空颜色不对头什么的。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Did you want a reminder on any other of your brave exploits?}}
translation: 你还想提醒自己其他英勇事迹吗？}}
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Can I ask about what food you like?
translation: 我能问问你喜欢吃什么吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need to save you from the Culinaromancer's spell.
translation: 我需要把你从烹饪大师的咒语中救出来。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: From who's what?
translation: 从谁的什么东西里？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: At the council meeting in Lumbridge, there was a Culinaromancer who tried to cast an evil spell on you!
translation: 在仑桥镇的委员会会议上，有个烹饪大师试图对你施邪恶法术！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Lumbridge...?
translation: 仑桥镇……？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Oh yeah. Me remember. Me was goblin representy thingy.
translation: 哦，对。俺记得。俺是哥布林代表那玩意儿。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: No you weren't! That was me!
translation: 不，你才不是！俺才是！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Never mind that, don't you remember the spell?
translation: 别管那个了，你不记得那个法术了吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: All me remember is Wartface stealin' chair!
translation: 俺只记得疣脸偷了椅子！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Weren't your chair. You shouldn' even've been there!
translation: 才不是你的椅子。你根本就不该在那儿！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I there before you were. So I get chair...
translation: 俺比你早到那儿。所以俺拿椅子……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Market research.
translation: 市场调研。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: But us never use your markets.
translation: 可我们从来不用你们的市场。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Exactly. That's why we need to find out what goblins eat, so we can better cater to your needs.
translation: 没错。所以我们才要弄清楚哥布林吃什么，这样才能更好地满足你们的需求。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: But it'll only take a minute of your time.
translation: 但只占用你一分钟时间。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I said we busy!
translation: 俺说了俺们忙着呢！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Erm... no particular reason.
translation: 呃……没什么特别的原因。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Me see no particular reason to answer you then.
translation: 那俺看不出有什么特别理由要回答你。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Hey, I need your help. Wartface and Bentnoze have been cursed!
translation: 嘿，我需要你的帮助。疣脸和弯鼻被诅咒了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: What that got to do with me?
translation: 那跟俺有啥关系？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need to find a meal they'd both eat.
translation: 我需要找到一道他们俩都愿意吃的菜。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Me no chef, ask village cook instead.
translation: 俺不是厨师，去找村里的厨子吧。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Go away human, me's busy here!
translation: 走开人类，俺忙着呢！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Me's working on new way of cooking. Will be most famous-est goblin cook ever.
translation: 俺在研究一种新的烹饪方法。俺会成为史上最著名的哥布林厨师。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: What is this new way of cooking?
translation: 这种新烹饪方法是什么？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Got the idea from the dwarves. Saw them playing with something. They called it a malty canned nun or summat. Used lotsa heat and bright light.
translation: 从矮人那里得来的主意。看到他们在玩什么东西。他们管那叫“麦芽罐头修女”之类的。用了很多热量和强光。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Wouldn't tell Mudknuckles how it worked of course. But I figured it out. Mudknuckles is smarter than them. Now I'm gonna be able to cook better'n anyone. And faster too, yes.
translation: 当然，他们不肯告诉泥拳这玩意儿怎么用。但俺自己琢磨出来了。泥拳比他们聪明。现在俺会比任何人做得更好。而且更快，没错。
