sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: No luck. Will work cos Mudknuckles destined for great things.
translation: 还没成。但会成的，因为泥拳注定要干大事。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need your help. Wartface and Bentnoze have been trapped by a terrible curse!
translation: 我需要你的帮助。疣脸和弯鼻被一个可怕的诅咒困住了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Oh, maybe that why Mudknuckles not been shouted at recently.
translation: 哦，怪不得泥拳最近没被骂了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Hmmm, s'pose me should help. But first Mudknuckles must finish experiment. Unfortunately is missing one vital ingredient.
translation: 嗯，俺觉得俺应该帮忙。但首先泥拳得完成实验。可惜还缺一种关键材料。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: What do you need? Maybe I can get it for you.
translation: 你需要什么？也许我能帮你弄到。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Is called charcoal. Mudknuckles hear you can get it from shops on Karamja, but the customs officers, they no like goblins any more.
translation: 叫木炭。泥拳听说在卡拉姆詹岛的商店可以买到，但海关官员现在不喜欢哥布林了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Burnt trees, they good too. Smash 'em up with axes. But Mudknuckles only knows of burnt trees in the wilderness, and Mudknuckles too afraid to go there.
translation: 烧过的树也行。用斧头砍碎就行。但泥拳只知道荒野里有烧过的树，可泥拳不敢去那儿。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I guess I'll come back later then.
translation: 那我以后再来吧。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Well, I guess I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好吧，那我就不打扰你了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Yes, Mudknuckles too busy to talk.
translation: 对，泥拳太忙没空说话。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I've got the charcoal you were after.
translation: 你要的木炭我拿来了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Really? Then no time to lose. Mudknuckles already have everything else. Sulphur 'n stuff.
translation: 真的？那别浪费时间了。泥拳其他东西都准备好了。硫磺什么的。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Sulphur? Er...
translation: 硫磺？呃……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Must be moving. Follow me.
translation: 得搬走了。跟我来。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Absolutely, best idea Mudknuckles ever had.
translation: 当然，这是泥拳最棒的主意。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I'm really not convinced that...
translation: 我真的不觉得这……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Should it shake like that?
translation: 它该这么晃吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: It fine, it...
translation: 没事，它……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: What that noise?
translation: 那是什么声音？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: You just hear that?
translation: 你刚才听到了吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Now there shaking too!
translation: 现在地上也在晃！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Ah. That'd be Mudknuckles again then.
translation: 啊。那肯定又是泥拳搞的鬼。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Mudknuckles?
translation: 泥拳？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: It...
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: It worked!
translation: 成功了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: It did... ?!
translation: 成功了……？！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: You the human who helped me. Mudknuckles is very grateful, will be famous real soon now. Is just collecting results. And so many results! On walls, on ceiling, everywhere!
translation: 你就是帮我的那个人类。泥拳非常感谢，马上就要出名了。正在收集成果。成果真多啊！墙上、天花板上，到处都是！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I thinking of calling it fast food, 'cos of how fast it goes from raw to burnt, see?
translation: 俺打算叫它'快餐'，因为它从生到焦的速度快，懂吧？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: That sounds like a great idea.
translation: 听起来是个好主意。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: You think so? Everyone else think Mudknuckles crazy. Seem think explosive cooking might be dangerous or summat.
translation: 你真这么觉得？其他人都觉得泥拳疯了。好像觉得爆炸式烹饪很危险似的。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Can't see why. Not like you gonna get food poisoning. Food is very well cooked.
translation: 看不出来哪里危险。又不是会食物中毒。食物烤得可透了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Er... yes... I'm sure food poisoning was what they were worried about.
translation: 呃……是啊……我敢肯定他们担心的就是食物中毒。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Do you think that will sell? Like you said, it's burnt.
translation: 你觉得这能卖出去吗？就像你说的，都烤焦了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: So maybe some imperfections, but fast food will sell. People buy anything when in hurry, even if does taste like sawdust.
translation: 可能有些瑕疵，但快餐会卖得好的。人们赶时间时什么都买，就算吃起来像锯末。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need your help...
translation: 我需要你的帮助……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Yes, yes, Mudknuckles very grateful, how can I help?
translation: 行行，泥拳非常感谢，怎么帮你？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Your leaders, Wartface and Bentnoze, have been trapped by a terrible curse!
translation: 你们的领袖，疣脸和弯鼻，被一个可怕的诅咒困住了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: So that's why Mudknuckles not been shouted at recently. But how can I be helping? Cooking and magic no mix.
translation: 怪不得泥拳最近没被骂。但俺怎么帮呢？烹饪和魔法不搭边。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Tried that before, Mudknuckles had some very angry wizards at door after trying to burn staffs to cook on.
translation: 以前试过，泥拳想烧法杖来做饭，结果门口来了几个很生气的法师。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need to create a dish that both of the Generals would eat to save them from the curse.
translation: 我需要制作一道两位将军都愿意吃的菜肴，以将他们从诅咒中解救出来。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Is impossible. Mudknuckles try it before, but their requests, they make no sense.
translation: 不可能。泥拳以前试过，可他们的要求根本说不通。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Why, what did they want?
translation: 怎么，他们想要什么？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Well Bentnoze wanted fruit in the dish. But Wartface, only fruit he eat is sliced oranges.
translation: 嗯，弯鼻想要菜里有水果。但疣脸只吃橙子片。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: That doesn't sound too bad.
translation: 听起来不太糟啊。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Maybe, but Bentnoze objects to the colour.
translation: 也许吧，但弯鼻嫌弃橙子的颜色。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Wartface, he want some nice juicy maggots.
translation: 疣脸嘛，想要些多汁的蛆。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Where can I get maggots?
translation: 我上哪儿弄蛆？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Humans use them all the time for fishing. Mudknuckles think this a crazy waste of maggots mind, but each to their own.
translation: 人类老拿它们钓鱼。泥拳觉得这简直是浪费蛆，不过各有所爱。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Each to their own indeed, but what's the problem?
translation: 各有所爱没错，但问题在哪？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Bentnoze not like maggots, say they're too bland. Would only eat them if they spicier.
translation: 弯鼻不喜欢蛆，说太淡了。除非更辣才肯吃。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Ok, is there anything other than orange slices and maggots?
translation: 好吧，除了橙子片和蛆，还有别的吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Bentnoze asked for some bread in the mix.
translation: 弯鼻要求里面加些面包。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Let me guess, Wartface complained right?
translation: 让我猜猜，疣脸抱怨了对吧？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Yep, Wartface think bread too crunchy. He prefer slimier soggier food, like the maggots.
translation: 疣脸觉得面包太脆了。他更喜欢黏糊糊的食物，比如蛆。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: So let me get this straight. I need orange slices which aren't orange, maggots that aren't bland, and bread which isn't crunchy?
translation: 那么我理一下。我需要不橙的橙子片、不淡的蛆、不脆的面包？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Yep, 'bout sums it up. Bring 'em all to me and Mudknuckles will make suitable dish.
translation: 对，差不多就这些。把材料都拿来，泥拳给你做合适的菜。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Wonderful. Well, I guess I'll have to see what I can do.
translation: 太好了。好吧，我得看看能怎么办。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I'll leave you to your experimentation then.
translation: 那你继续做实验吧。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need your help. About that dish that both Wartface and Bentnoze would eat...
translation: 我需要你的帮助。关于那道疣脸和弯鼻都愿意吃的菜……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: What was the problem with the orange slices?
translation: 橙子片有什么问题？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Well Bentnoze wanted fruit in the dish. But Wartface, only fruit he eat is sliced oranges, and Bentnoze object to the colour of them.
translation: 嗯，弯鼻想要菜里有水果。但疣脸只吃橙子片，而弯鼻嫌弃橙子的颜色。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Why did Bentnoze object to the maggots?
translation: 弯鼻为什么嫌弃蛆？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: What did Wartface have against bread?
translation: 疣脸对面包有什么意见？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Wartface think bread too crunchy. He prefer his food to be soggier.
translation: 疣脸觉得面包太脆了。他更喜欢黏糊糊的食物。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I've got the ingredients we need to make a meal for Wartface and Bentnoze.
translation: 我搞到给疣脸和弯鼻做菜需要的材料了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Mudknuckles is confused. Ingredients make no sense. But give 'em here and Mudknuckles make what you need.
translation: 泥拳搞糊涂了。这些材料根本说不通。不过拿过来吧，泥拳帮你做出需要的菜。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: There you go, but don't go blaming Mudknuckles if doesn't work.
translation: 给你，但如果不管用，可别怪泥拳。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need your help. Are you sure Wartface and Bentnoze will both eat this dish we've made?
translation: 我需要你的帮助。你确定疣脸和弯鼻都会吃我们做的这道菜吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Highly unlikely, but is best Mudknuckles can come up with am afraid.
translation: 可能性不大，但恐怕这是泥拳能想到的最好办法了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: I need your help. I lost the dish you gave to me to save Wartface and Bentnoze.
translation: 我需要你的帮助。我弄丢了你给我的用来救疣脸和弯鼻的菜。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Is ok, Mudknuckles make plenty. Take some more.
translation: 没关系，泥拳做了很多。再拿一些吧。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: Generals say so? Mudknuckles help. Human can use cauldron over there. It new one after previous one blew up.
translation: 将军们这么说？泥拳来帮忙。人类可以用那边的大锅。这是新的，上一个炸了。

english: Most of ingredients burn. Maybe some left in boxes 'round kitchen.
translation: 大部分食材都烧了。厨房周围的盒子里可能还剩一些。

english: Generals say so? Mudknuckles help. Human can use cauldron over there.
translation: 将军们这么说？泥拳来帮忙。人类可以用那边的大锅。

english: Goblins already eat most ingredients. Maybe some left in boxes 'round kitchen.
translation: 哥布林已经把大部分食材都吃了。厨房周围的盒子里可能还剩一些。

english: Most of igredients burn. Maybe some left in boxes 'round kitchen.
translation: 大部分食材都烧了。厨房周围的盒子里可能还剩一些。

english: Mudknuckles busy.
translation: 泥拳正忙着呢。

english: Mudknuckles will try.
translation: 泥拳会试试。

english: This good stuff!
translation: 这玩意儿真不错！

english: Human! Is there more of the delicious food?
translation: 人类！还有更多好吃的吗？

english: Mudknuckles needs this recipe.
translation: 泥拳需要这个食谱。

english: Me's trying to decide whether apron should be red or green. If red, Wartface hit Mudknuckles. If green, Bentnoze kick Mudknuckles. Either way, is not good for Mudknuckles.
translation: 我在想围裙该是红色还是绿色。红色的话，疣脸会揍泥拳。绿色的话，弯鼻会踢泥拳。不管怎样，对泥拳都不好。

english: Could yes, but then just get attacked from two directions at once.
translation: 也许可以，但那样就会同时受到来自两个方向的攻击。

english: What human waiting for? Bring food to generals before they beat Mudknuckles!
translation: 人类还在等什么？在将军们揍泥拳之前，快把食物送去！

english: That charcoal not look right to Mudknuckles. Go get different charcoal. Try shops on Karamja, Mudknuckles heard they got charcoal there.
translation: 那木炭在泥拳看来不对劲。去弄点不同的木炭来。试试卡拉姆詹岛上的商店，泥拳听说那里有木炭卖。

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have[number]council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者，我已经把他们传送到了安全的地方！你只需要保护[number]位议会成员了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Goblin generals

english: How can I help the Lumbridge Guide?
translation: 我该怎么帮助仑桥镇向导？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Well, what better to help the Lumbridge Guide than a 'Cake of Guidance'. Would you like to help?
translation: 嗯，还有什么比'指引蛋糕'更能帮助仑桥镇向导的呢？你愿意帮忙吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Yes, I'm sure I can make a cake.
translation: 是的，我确定我能做个蛋糕。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Sounds a bit weird though. What does it involve?
translation: 听起来有点怪。具体要做什么？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Well, I'm not too familiar with the fine details, you'll have to go and speak with Traiborn in the Wizards' Tower. He'll know what you need.
translation: 嗯，细节我不太清楚，你得去法师塔找崔伯恩谈谈。他知道你需要什么。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Okay, thanks, I'll get right on it!
translation: 好的，谢谢，我马上去办！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Hi, what do I have to do again to help the Lumbridge Guide?
translation: 嗨，我要再做什么才能帮助仑桥镇向导？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Go have a word with Traiborn in the Wizards' Tower, he should be able to help you out with a Cake of Guidance!
translation: 去法师塔找崔伯恩谈谈，他应该能帮你弄到指引蛋糕！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Hi. I was wondering if you could help me?
translation: 嗨。我想知道你能不能帮我？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: You don't look like you have a problem.
translation: 你看起来不像有问题。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Well I do. I need to make something called a Cake of Guidance, and I was told that you could help me out.
translation: 我确实有。我需要做一个叫指引蛋糕的东西，有人告诉我你能帮忙。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Mmmmm. Cake of Guidance. Yummy Yum! Did you know they're imbued with knowledge and information itself? When eaten it will give anyone the guidance they need to get back on track. So you say you're a chef?
translation: 嗯嗯。指引蛋糕。好吃好吃！你知道吗，它们被注入了知识和信息本身？吃下去会给任何人指引，让他们重回正轨。所以你说你是个厨师？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Erm. No I don't think I did. I need to make that cake for the Lumbridge Guide. He's been frozen in time and needs help.
translation: 呃。我不觉得我说过。我需要为仑桥镇向导做那个蛋糕。他被冻结在时间里，需要帮助。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Oh dear, it's a strange day when the Lumbridge Guide needs guidance. Don't worry, I shall help you make your chocolate cake.
translation: 哦天哪，仑桥镇向导需要指引，真是奇怪的一天。别担心，我会帮你做你的巧克力蛋糕。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Not a chocolate cake - a CAKE OF GUIDANCE.
translation: 不是巧克力蛋糕——是指引蛋糕。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Make up your mind!
translation: 拿定主意！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I have. So what do I need to do?
translation: 我已经拿定了。那我需要做什么？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: You don't know? Deary me. You'll need to enchant three ingredients with your own knowledge. Bring me the basic ingredients and I will help you with the enchantment.
translation: 你不知道？天哪。你需要用你自己的知识给三种材料附魔。把基础材料带来，我会帮你完成附魔。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: What are the ingredients?
translation: 需要什么材料？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: An eggy peggy, some floury woury and some milky wilky.
translation: 一个蛋蛋，一些面粉粉，还有一点牛奶奶。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: So to the sane world, an egg, flour and milk. No problem, I'll be right back.
translation: 所以用正常话说，就是鸡蛋、面粉和牛奶。没问题，我马上回来。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Have a nice time!
translation: 祝你玩得开心！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: ...Thanks.
translation: ……谢谢。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Brought any ingredients?
translation: 带材料来了吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I need you to bring me...
translation: 我需要你带给我……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: An egg.
translation: 一个鸡蛋。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: A pot of flour.
translation: 一罐面粉。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: A bucket of milk.
translation: 一桶牛奶。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I will then enchant them for you so you can make your Chocolate cake!
translation: 然后我会为它们附魔，这样你就能做你的巧克力蛋糕了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Cake of guidance.
translation: 是指引蛋糕。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I hope you know what you're doing.
translation: 我希望你知道自己在做什么。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Of course. Take care, and don't talk to strangers!
translation: 当然。保重，别和陌生人说话！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Yes, an egg!
translation: 是的，一个鸡蛋！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Egg-cellent...
translation: 蛋定……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I can't believe you said that, so I will just pretend you didn't.
translation: 我真不敢相信你说了那个，所以我假装你没说。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Boo. Hiss. You're no fun. I will need your help for the enchantment - you must imbue it with knowledge itself. You must complete a quiz to enact the enchantment.
translation: 嘘。你真没劲。附魔需要你的帮助——你必须用知识本身来灌注它。你需要完成一个小测验来施展附魔。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Okay. Let's start!
translation: 好的。我们开始吧！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Okay. You will be presented with some people that you may have come across on your travels - it's up to you to recall their names. Guess three correctly without error and you will succeed in enchanting the egg.
translation: 好的。你会看到一些你在旅途中可能遇到过的人——你要回忆他们的名字。连续猜对三个，就能成功给鸡蛋附魔。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Name that person!
translation: 说出那个人是谁！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Correct - and now the second character:
translation: 正确——现在第二个角色：
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Correct - and now the third and final character:
translation: 正确——现在第三个也是最后一个角色：
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: That wasn't so bad. Now what?
translation: 这还不算太难。现在呢？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Well, there is the case of the magic words of enchantment - repeat after me:
translation: 嗯，这里有魔法附魔咒语——跟我念：
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Dandolino Zadribrim!
translation: 丹多利诺 扎德里布里姆！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Dandy lino zadim!
translation: 丹迪 利诺 扎迪姆！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Not quite, but it'll do. I will hold onto the Enchanted Egg for you until you need it.
translation: 不太对，但凑合吧。我会先帮你保管魔法鸡蛋，等你需要时再给你。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: So I've enchanted all three ingredients now?
translation: 所以我现在三种材料都附魔好了？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Indeed, best you go bake the cake! You can do it the same way as making an ordinary cake.
translation: 没错，你最好去烤蛋糕了！方法和做普通蛋糕一样。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Nope, that's not right, you'll have to start again.
translation: 不，那不对，你得重新开始。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Okie dokey, watch out for evil cows.
translation: 好的好的，小心邪恶的奶牛。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Erm, okay.
translation: 呃，好的。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I've got some milk! Can we enchant it?
translation: 我弄到牛奶了！我们能附魔吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Mmmm milk. By all means, you're going to have to complete a quiz first to bring forth guidance and enact the enchantment.
translation: 嗯嗯牛奶。当然可以，你得先完成一个小测验来引出指引并施展附魔。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Okay. I'm ready!
translation: 好的。我准备好了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Okay. You must answer 3 general questions about our lands correctly without getting one wrong. You have as many chances as you need.
translation: 好的。你需要正确回答三个关于我们土地的一般知识问题，不能答错。你有无限次机会。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Correct! Good job! Two more to go.
translation: 正确！干得好！还有两个。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Correct! Well done. One more to go.
translation: 正确！做得好。还有一个。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Correct! Well done. That's all three answered!
translation: 正确！做得好。三个都答对了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Now what?
translation: 现在呢？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Repeat after me... Skalindom Ralinaplo.
translation: 跟我念……斯卡林多姆 拉利纳普罗。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Skelly domy ralipo!
translation: 斯凯利 多米 拉利波！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: ....Close enough. The milk has now been enchanted!
translation: ……差不多。牛奶现在附魔好了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: You're making this up aren't you?
translation: 你是在胡编乱造吧？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: How dare you! Now get me the next ingredient! I will hold onto the Enchanted Milk for you until you need it.
translation: 你怎么敢这么说！现在去拿下一个材料吧！我会先帮你保管魔法牛奶，等你需要时再给你。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: That's not right. You'll have to start again.
translation: 那不对。你得重新开始。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I have obtained a pot of flour!
translation: 我弄到一罐面粉了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: So you want to enchant it now? You'll have to take active part by completing a little quiz to imbue the flour with knowledge and enact the enchantment.
translation: 所以你现在想给它附魔？你需要积极参与，完成一个小测验来用知识灌注面粉并施展附魔。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Quiz me!
translation: 考我吧！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: For enchanting this item you will be shown a selection of items, when you stop viewing this selection you'll have to answer three questions correctly in a row and then the flour will be enchanted with guidance.
translation: 要给这个物品附魔，你会看到一组物品，看完后你需要连续正确回答三个问题，然后面粉就会被注入指引之力。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: That's correct - onto the second set!
translation: 正确——进入第二组！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Correct - and now the third and final set:
translation: 正确——现在第三组也是最后一组：
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: And that's it?
translation: 就这样了？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: You have to repeat the magic words of course!
translation: 当然还要念魔法咒语！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Splendidium romelno!
translation: 斯普伦迪迪乌姆 罗梅尔诺！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Spendy dum romeo!
translation: 斯彭迪 达姆 罗密欧！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: We shall make a wizard of you yet. I will hold onto the enchanted flour for you until you need it.
translation: 我们迟早会把你培养成魔法师的。我会先帮你保管魔法面粉，等你需要时再给你。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Sorry, that's not right. You'll have to start again.
translation: 抱歉，那不对。你得重新开始。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Maybe later.}}
translation: 也许以后再说。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: What should I be doing now?
translation: 我现在该做什么？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Sleeping?
translation: 睡觉？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: No I mean in regards to making the cake.
translation: 不，我是说关于做蛋糕的事。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Ah, bake it!
translation: 啊，烤了它！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I lost the egg!
translation: 我把鸡蛋弄丢了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: That's okay, I have another up my sleeve.
translation: 没关系，我这里还有一个。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Strange place to put it.
translation: 放的地方真奇怪。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I lost the flour!
translation: 我把面粉弄丢了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Good job I have another to hand then isn't it!
translation: 幸好我手边还有一个，不是吗！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I lost the milk!
translation: 我把牛奶弄丢了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: What would you do without me? I can give you another...
translation: 没了我你怎么办？我可以再给你一个……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I made the cake. Just need to go use it now! Thanks for your help!
translation: 我做好蛋糕了。现在只需要去用它了！谢谢你的帮助！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Wah hey! Good work Bill.
translation: 哇嘿！干得好，比尔。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Who's Bill?
translation: 谁是比尔？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Who knows!?
translation: 谁知道呢！？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I made the cake... but I lost it.
translation: 我做好了蛋糕……但我弄丢了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Oopsy daisy! You'll have to make another one!
translation: 哎呀呀！你得再做一个了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I lost the[ingredient]!
translation: 我把[ingredient]弄丢了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: I have made the cake!
translation: 我做好蛋糕了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: What do you want? A prize? Use it on the Lumbridge Guide already!
translation: 你想要什么？奖励吗？快用在仑桥镇向导身上吧！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: Best you go see Traiborn again then and see if he can help you.
translation: 你最好再去找崔伯恩，看看他能不能帮你。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Lumbridge Guide

english: How do I protect you I wonder....
translation: 我想知道该怎么保护你……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: To protect our short angry friend from the culinaromancer's magics, I suggest that you seek out his father within the mountain tunnel that he guards.
translation: 为了保护我们这位矮个子暴脾气朋友免受烹饪大师魔法的伤害，我建议你去找看守山间隧道的他的父亲。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: His fondness for rock cakes could prove key in freeing him.
translation: 他对石糕的喜爱可能是解救他的关键。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: ...son...time bubble...culinaromancer...freeze...rockcakes!
translation: ……儿子……时间泡泡……烹饪大师……冻结……石糕！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I have absolutely no clue what you are on about. Sit down, catch your breath and explain please!
translation: 我完全听不懂你在说什么。坐下，喘口气，然后好好解释一下！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Ok. Your son, the one who guards the tunnel entrance?
translation: 好吧。你儿子，就是看守隧道入口的那个？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh aye. Good lad he is.
translation: 哦，是啊。他是个好孩子。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Well he's at a special meeting and he's frozen by the culinaromancer!
translation: 嗯，他在参加一个特别会议，被烹饪大师冻住了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Ok... you lost me again. I just got back from visitin' him up top, he's fine.
translation: 好吧……我又不懂了。我刚从上面看他回来，他好着呢。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: He's in a TIME BUBBLE!
translation: 他在一个时间泡泡里！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh that. No no, he's quite ok. That was last week.
translation: 哦，那个啊。不不不，他没事。那是上周的事了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Why thank yer!
translation: 哎呀，谢啦！

english: I prefer ale!
translation: 我更喜欢麦芽酒！

english: I don't need that!
translation: 我不需要那个！

english: What's that for?!
translation: 那是干嘛用的？！

english: Yep, that came from a chicken.
translation: 没错，那是从鸡身上来的。

english: I need your rock cakes to free him from it.
translation: 我需要你的石糕来把他从里面救出来。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You're delusional. Never would old Rohak give away his special recipe, not for all the golden nectar from the Rising Sun!
translation: 你在妄想。老罗哈克绝不会交出他的特殊食谱，就算用“朝阳”餐厅的所有金色花蜜也不行！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I would never give away me special rock cake recipe, not for all the golden nectar from the Rising Sun!
translation: 我绝不会交出我的特殊石糕食谱，就算用“朝阳”的所有金色花蜜也不行！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: What can you tell me about dwarves and ale?
translation: 你能跟我说说矮人和麦酒的事吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Erm... they like it?
translation: 呃……他们喜欢麦酒？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: No no no... I mean what kind of ale do they drink?
translation: 不不不……我是说他们喝哪种麦酒？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Well I know for sure that they enjoy my special recipe.
translation: 嗯，我很确定他们喜欢我的特殊食谱。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh? Would you tell me?
translation: 哦？你能告诉我吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: And lose money? I think not!
translation: 然后亏钱？我才不干！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I could offer you some in return, how about 100 gold?
translation: 我可以给你一些作为回报，100金币怎么样？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Sorry, no deal, that wouldn't even cover my expenses.
translation: 抱歉，不成交，这连我的成本都覆盖不了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You have CHOCOLATE in your pack, I can smell it! 50 gold and chocolate and the secret is yours!!
translation: 你背包里有巧克力，我闻得到！50金币加巧克力，秘密就是你的了！！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh, I don't have enough money on me.
translation: 哦，我身上没带够钱。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You have a deal. Here you go...
translation: 成交。给你……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Mmmmm... the secret is in the gold. Drop a gold coin into asgarnian ale and you'll get this weird golden ale that the dwarves seem to love, I think they're genetically attracted to gold.
translation: 嗯……秘密在于金币。把一枚金币丢进阿斯加尼亚麦酒里，就能得到这种奇怪的金色麦酒，矮人们似乎很喜欢，我猜他们对金子在基因上就有吸引力。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Sorry, no deal.
translation: 抱歉，不成交。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Your loss! Next customer please!
translation: 你亏了！下一位顾客请！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Welll... maybe... look.. I'm on duty here at the bar so I can't get anything to eat, I could murder a pizza.
translation: 呃……也许……你看，我在酒吧值班，吃不了东西，我真想杀个披萨来吃。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I just happen to have some on me.
translation: 我身上正好有一些。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Pizza and 100 gold and the secret is yours!
translation: 披萨加100金币，秘密就是你的了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: But I don't have the money on me. I'll have to come back.
translation: 但我身上没带钱。我得回来一趟。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I could offer you some in return, how about 200 gold?
translation: 我可以给你一些作为回报，200金币怎么样？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You sure you haven't got anymore?
translation: 你确定你没有更多的了？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Just 200... honest!
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Hand it over then and I'll tell you the secret.
translation: 那就交过来，我告诉你秘密。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You're a good person... for you, 150 and you have a deal.
translation: 你是个好人……看在你份上，150，成交。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh go on, I'm really quite trustworthy once you get to know me.
translation: 哦，别这样，等你了解我之后就会发现我其实很值得信任。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Mmmmm... the secret is in the gold. Drop a gold coin into asgarnian ale and you'll get this weird golden ale that the dwarves seem to love. I think they're genetically attracted to gold.
translation: 嗯……秘密在于金币。把一枚金币丢进阿斯加尼亚麦酒里，就能得到这种奇怪的金色麦酒，矮人们似乎很喜欢。我猜他们对金子在基因上就有吸引力。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: What...what am I saying? I just gave you the secret!
translation: 什……我在说什么？我已经把秘密告诉你了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh it's you again. Forgotten the secret already?
translation: 哦，又是你。已经忘记秘密了？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: No... I just... misplaced it.
translation: 不……我只是……把它放错地方了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Heehee, this'll be fun!
translation: 嘻嘻，这一定很好玩！

english: You'll be after our Hand of Death cocktail, then. Lots of expensive parts to the cocktail, though, so it will cost you 70 coins.
translation: 那你肯定是想要我们的“死神之手”鸡尾酒了。不过，这杯鸡尾酒的材料很贵，所以要收你 70 金币。

english: Nothing at the moment. Try again another time.
translation: 现在没有。下次再来试试吧。

english: Sorry, we're all out of the ingredients for the Hand of Death cocktail. Try again another day.
translation: 抱歉，“死神之手”鸡尾酒的原料都用完了。改天再来试试吧。

english: Thanks, I won't forg...err... misplace it, this time.
translation: 谢谢，这次我不会忘……呃……放错地方了。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Here, have a drink.
translation: 来，喝一杯。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Is that what I think it is?
translation: 这是我想的那样吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: That's from the Rising Sun, the barmaid there will never tell me the recipe she uses. It's divine!
translation: 那是从“朝阳”来的，那里的女招待从不告诉我她用的食谱。真是绝了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Speaking of recipes....
translation: 说到配方……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: No! I shwears I'll never tell...
translation: 不！我发四我绝不会说……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Here, have another.
translation: 来，再来一杯。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Don't mind if I do!
translation: 那我就不客气了！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I think you deserve another pint.
translation: 我觉得你该再来一品脱。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I'm sure another pint will go down nicely.
translation: 我肯定再来一品脱会很舒服。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Ahhh, yer me besht mate... mate.
translation: 啊哈，你是我最好的哥儿们……哥儿们。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You're a good friend Rohak, do you think you could do me a favour?
translation: 你是个好朋友，罗哈克，能帮我个忙吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Fer you [player]? Fer you I'd... I'd... shlide down a shlope of thishtlesh wif no 'elmet on!
translation: 为你了[player]？为你了我会……我会……光着头皮从蓟草坡上滑下来！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I don't need you to do that ... friend. Just something as simple as baking me some of your wonderful rock cakes. Hmm? For your good friend?
translation: 我不需要你那么做……朋友。只是帮我烤一些你那美味的石糕而已。嗯？为了你的好朋友？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Fer you! Anyfin'! Fer a price of course!
translation: 为了你！什么都行！当然要收钱！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Good. I'm sure I have some gold somewhere!
translation: 好。我肯定在什么地方有钱！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: How much gold do you want to make the cake?
translation: 你要多少金币才肯做蛋糕？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: WHAT?! That wasn't a dream? Oh my aching head...
translation: 什么？！那不是梦？哦我头疼死了……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: No, not a dream, you agreed to make me your special rock cake, for a fee.
translation: 不，不是梦，你同意为我做你的特殊石糕，但要收费。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: 100 gold, no less!
translation: 100金币，一个子都不能少！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Maybe I should have some more money with me, he did say he'd want payment...
translation: 也许我该多带点钱，他确实说过要收钱……
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Also... you'll need to get the ingredients too. Milk, flour, egg and bowl of water, mind it's a bowl and not a dirty bucket.
translation: 还有……你需要准备食材。牛奶、面粉、鸡蛋和一碗水，记住是碗，不是脏兮兮的桶。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You didn't say I'd have to run around... but ok! Milk, flour, egg, bowl of water....I'll be back!
translation: 你没说我还得跑来跑去……好吧！牛奶、面粉、鸡蛋、一碗水……我马上回来！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Have you forgotten the ingredients list? I'll need an egg, a pot of flour, a bucket of milk and a bowl of water to make these cakes for you.
translation: 你忘记食材清单了吗？我需要一个鸡蛋、一罐面粉、一桶牛奶和一碗水来给你做这些蛋糕。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Ok, I'll see about getting them.
translation: 好的，我去找找看。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I have found some of the things you asked for:
translation: 我找到了你要的一些东西：
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: [I have the egg/I don't have an egg, I'll look for some chickens], [I have a pot of flour/I don't have a pot of flour, but I'll investigate the windmills], [I have the bucket of milk/I don't have any milk but I'll check out the cows], [I have the bowl of water!/I don't have a bowl of water].
translation: [I have the egg/I don't have an egg, I'll look for some chickens]，[I have a pot of flour/I don't have a pot of flour, but I'll investigate the windmills]，[I have the bucket of milk/I don't have any milk but I'll check out the cows]，[I have the bowl of water!/I don't have a bowl of water]。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: That's all well and good...but come back when you have all the ingredients. You're lucky Dwarves stick to their word else I might not make these cakes for you.
translation: 这很好……但等你集齐所有食材再来吧。算你运气好，矮人说话算话，不然我可能不给你做这些蛋糕。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Okay okay I'll get right on it! Keep your beard on!
translation: 好好好，我马上去办！别急嘛！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: N..n...nothing honest!
translation: 没……没什么，真的！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I have all the items you asked for...is that it? I could make these!
translation: 我集齐了你要求的全部物品……就这些？我可以自己做！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: No you couldn't, there's a special ingredient, but I'm not going to tell you what it is!
translation: 不，你做不了，有一种特殊配料，但我不会告诉你是什么！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Well... here's the ingredients anyway.
translation: 好吧……食材给你。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: There, as good as my word. Hot rock cakes to my special recipe.
translation: 看，我言出必行。按照我的特殊食谱做的热石糕。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Got any use out of that rock cake I made you [player]?
translation: 我做的石糕你用上了吗[player]？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Not yet but I will. I'm going to save your son.
translation: 还没，但我会的。我要去救你儿子。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I keep tellin you, he's fine!
translation: 我一直跟你说，他没事！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I appear to have lost it somewhere, can you make me another?
translation: 我好像把它弄丢了，你能再做一个吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I suppose so, but you'll need all the ingredients like last time.
translation: 我想可以，但你需要上次所有的食材。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I lost the rock cake! But I have more ingredients, will you make me some more please?
translation: 我把石糕弄丢了！但我有更多食材，你能再帮我做些吗？
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh... I suppose so. Give me the ingredients.
translation: 哦……我想可以。把食材给我。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: WHAT?! That wasn't a dream? Oh my aching head....
translation: 什么？！那不是梦？哦，我的头痛死了……

english: Fer you [player name]? Fer you I'd... I'd... shlide down a shlope of thishtlesh wif no 'elmet on!
translation: 为了你[player name]？为了你，我……我……就算不戴头盔也要滑下蓟草坡！

english: Got any use out of that rock cake I made you [player name]?
translation: 我做的那个石糕，你有用到吗[player name]？

english: I think you'll find you've already got one stored somewhere.
translation: 我想你会发现你已经有一个放在某处了。

english: Hang on a minute...yer daft lad, you already have one!
translation: 等等……你这傻小子，你已经有一个了！

english: Hang on a minute...yer daft lass, you already have one!
translation: 等等……你这傻丫头，你已经有一个了！

english: Got any use out of that rock cake I made you Pm Fel#4603 to spy?
translation: 我做的那个石糕，你有用到吗 Pm Fel#4603 来间谍？

english: STOP! What do you think you're doing!
translation: 住手！你以为你在干什么！
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: You can't feed him red hot rock cakes! You'll kill him! Find a way to cool them down.
translation: 你不能喂他滚烫的石糕！你会害死他的！想办法让它们凉下来。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: Oh, ok, I'll find a way to cool them down then.
translation: 哦，好吧，那我想办法让它们凉下来。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: I hear there's a rather chilly reception on top of a rather icey mountain.
translation: 我听说在某个非常冰冷的山顶上，接待会相当冷淡。
sub_category: Recipe for Disaster/Freeing the Mountain Dwarf

english: What ho, sirrah. Spiffing day for a walk in the park, what?
translation: 嘿，老兄。今天在公园散步真是个好日子，对吧？

english: ...spiffing?
translation: ……好日子？

english: Absolutely, top-hole! Well, can't stay and chat all day, dontchaknow! Ta-ta for now!
translation: 当然，太棒了！好了，不能整天待在这儿聊天，你懂的！先告辞了！

english: Erm... goodbye.
translation: 呃……再见。

english: Do you have any other quests for me to do?
translation: 你还有其他任务要交给我吗？

english: Quests, eh? Well, I don't have anything on the go at the moment, but there is an organisation that is always looking for capable adventurers to assist them.
translation: 任务，嗯？目前我手头没什么事，但有一个组织一直在寻找有能力的冒险者来协助他们。

english: Your excellent work sorting out those Black Knights means I will happily write you a letter of recommendation.
translation: 你出色地解决了那些黑骑士的问题，我很乐意为你写一封推荐信。

english: Would you like me to put your name forwards to them?
translation: 你希望我把你的名字推荐给他们吗？

english: Sure thing Sir Amik, sign me up!
translation: 当然，阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士，算我一个！

english: Erm, well, this is a little embarrassing, I already HAVE put you forward as a potential member.
translation: 呃，这个有点尴尬，我已经把你作为潜在成员推荐上去了。

english: They are called the Temple Knights, and you are to meet Sir Tiffy Cashien in Falador park for testing immediately.
translation: 他们叫做圣殿骑士，你马上去法拉多公园找蒂菲.卡申爵士接受测试。

english: Okey dokey, I'll go do that then.
translation: 好的好的，我这就去。

english: No thanks, that doesn't sound like the kind of thing that would interest me...
translation: 不了，谢谢，听起来不像是我感兴趣的事……

english: As you wish adventurer, let's say no more about it.
translation: 随你便，冒险者，这事就到此为止吧。

english: No, I am afraid not. I suggest you go meet Sir Tiffy in Falador Park, he will be expecting you.
translation: 不，恐怕不行。我建议你去法拉多公园找蒂菲爵士，他会在那里等你。

english: Sir Amik Varze sent me to meet you here for some sort of testing...?
translation: 阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士派我来这里找你，说是要进行某种测试……？

english: Ah, [player name]! Amik told me all about you, dontchaknow! Spiffing job you did with the old Black Knights there, absolutely first class.
translation: 啊，[player name]！阿米克跟我提过你，你知道的！你对付那些黑骑士干得漂亮，绝对是一流水准。

english: ...thanks, I think.
translation: ……谢谢，我想是吧。

english: Well, a top-notch fellow like yourself is just the right sort we've been seeking for our organisation.
translation: 嗯，像你这样的一流人才正是我们组织一直在寻找的合适人选。

english: ...testing? What exactly do you mean by testing?
translation: ……测试？你说的测试具体指什么？

english: Jolly bad show! Varze was supposed to have informed you about all this before sending you here!
translation: 真糟糕！瓦尔泽本该在派你来之前就把这一切都告诉你的！

english: Well, not your fault I suppose, what? Anywho, our organisation is looking for a certain specific type of person to join.
translation: 嗯，我想这也不是你的错，对吧？总之，我们组织在寻找某种特定类型的人加入。

english: So... You want me to go kill some monster or something for you?
translation: 所以……你想让我去杀个怪物什么的？

english: Not at all, old bean. There's plenty of warriors around should we require dumb muscle.
translation: 完全不是，老兄。如果我们只需要蛮力，周围有的是战士。

english: That's really not the kind of thing our organisation is after, what?
translation: 那可不是我们组织追求的东西，对吧？

english: So you want me to go and fetch you some kind of common item, and then take it for delivery somewhere on the other side of the country?
translation: 所以你想让我去拿某种普通物品，然后送到国家的另一边？

english: Because I really hate doing that!
translation: 因为我真的很讨厌做那种事！

english: Haw haw haw What a dull thing to ask of someone, what?
translation: 哈哈哈，让人做这种事多无聊啊，对吧？

english: I know what you mean though, I did my fair share of running errands when I was a young adventurer, myself!
translation: 不过我知道你的意思，我自己年轻时当冒险者也没少跑腿！

english: So what exactly will this test consist of?
translation: 那么这次测试具体包括什么？

english: Can't let just any old riff-raff in, what? The mindless thugs and bully boys are best left in the White Knights or the Guards, we look for the top-shelf brains to join us.
translation: 不能让随便什么乌合之众进来，对吧？那些没脑子的暴徒和恶霸最好留在白骑士或守卫里，我们寻找的是顶尖人才来加入我们。

english: So you want to test my brains?  Will it hurt?
translation: 所以你想测试我的头脑？会疼吗？

english: Haw Haw Haw That's a good one!
translation: 哈哈哈，说得好！

english: Not in the slightest... Well, maybe a bit, but we all have to make sacrifices occasionally, what?
translation: 一点也不疼……嗯，也许有一点，但我们都得偶尔做出牺牲，对吧？

english: What do you want me to do then?
translation: 那你想要我做什么？

english: It's a test of wits, what? I'll take you to our secret training grounds, and you will have to pass through a series of five separate intelligence tests to prove you're our sort of
translation: 这是一场智力的考验，对吧？我会带你去我们的秘密训练场，你需要通过一系列五个独立的情报测试，来证明你是我们想要的那种

english: adventurer.
translation: 冒险者。

english: Standard puzzle room rules will apply.
translation: 标准解谜房间规则适用。

english: Erm... what are 'standard  puzzle room rules' exactly?
translation: 呃……“标准解谜房间规则”具体是什么？

english: Never done this sort of thing before, what?
translation: 以前没做过这种事，对吧？

english: The simple rules are: No items or equipment to be brought with you. Each room is a self contained puzzle. You may quit at any time.
translation: 简单的规则是：不能携带任何物品或装备。每个房间都是一个独立的谜题。你可以随时退出。

english: Of course, if you quit a room, then all your progress up to that point will be cleared, and you'll have to start again from scratch.
translation: 当然，如果你退出一个房间，那么你之前的所有进度都会被清除，你必须从头开始。

english: Our organisation manages to filter all the top-notch adventurers this way. So, are you ready to go?
translation: 我们组织就是这样筛选出所有顶尖冒险者的。那么，你准备好了吗？

english: This organisation you keep mentioning... Perhaps you could tell me a little about it?
translation: 你一直提到的这个组织……也许你能跟我介绍一下？

english: Oh, that Amik! Jolly bad form, did he not tell you anything that he was supposed to?
translation: 哦，那个阿米克！真不像话，他难道没告诉你他该说的事吗？

english: No... He didn't really tell me anything except to come here and meet you...
translation: 没有……他除了让我来这里找你之外，什么都没告诉我……

english: Well now old sport, let me give you the heads up and the low down, what?
translation: 好吧，老伙计，让我给你透个底，说说内情，怎么样？

english: I represent the Temple Knights. We are the premier order of Knights in Asgarnia, if not the world. Saradomin himself personally founded our order
translation: 我代表圣殿骑士。我们是阿斯加尼亚乃至全世界首屈一指的骑士团。萨拉多曼本人早在几个世纪前就亲自创立了我们的骑士团，

english: centuries ago, and we answer only to him.
translation: 我们只对他负责。

english: Only the very best of the best are permitted to join, and the powers we command are formidable indeed.
translation: 只有最优秀中的最优秀才能加入，我们所掌握的力量确实强大。

english: You might say that we are the front line of defence for the entire kingdom!
translation: 你可以说我们是整个王国的第一道防线！

english: So what's the difference between you and the White Knights?
translation: 那你们和白骑士有什么区别？

english: Well, in simple terms, we're better! Any fool with a sword can manage to get into the White Knights, which is mostly the reason they are so very, very incompetent, what?
translation: 嗯，简单来说，我们更强！任何拿剑的傻瓜都能混进白骑士，这基本上就是他们如此非常非常无能的原因，对吧？

english: The Temple Knights on the other hand have to be smarter, stronger, better than all others. We are the elite. No man controls us for our orders come directly from
translation: 而圣殿骑士则必须比所有人都更聪明、更强壮、更优秀。我们是精英。没有人能控制我们，因为我们的命令直接来自

english: Saradomin himself!
translation: 萨拉多曼本人！

english: Cool, you mean I get to meet Saradomin?
translation: 酷，你的意思是我能见到萨拉多曼？

english: Well, uh, not exactly... Sir Vey Lance, our head of operations, is the only one of our order who has ever personally met Saradomin, but everything he tells us to do is done with
translation: 嗯，呃，不完全是……我们的行动负责人维.兰斯爵士是我们骑士团中唯一亲自见过萨拉多曼的人，但他让我们做的一切都是得到

english: Saradomin's implicit permission.
translation: 萨拉多曼默许的。

english: It's not every job where you have more authority than the king, now is it?
translation: 不是每份工作都能让你拥有比国王更大的权力，对吧？

english: Wait... You can order the King around?!?!
translation: 等等……你能命令国王？！？！

english: Well, not me personally, I'm only in the recruitment side of things dontchaknow, but the higher ranking members of the organisation have almost absolute power over this kingdom.
translation: 嗯，不是我本人，我只负责招募方面的事，你知道的，但组织里的高级成员对这个王国几乎拥有绝对的权力。

english: Plus a few others, so I hear....
translation: 另外还有几个其他人，我听说……

english: Anyway, this is why we keep our organisation shrouded in secrecy, and why we demand such rigorous testing for all potential recruits. Speaking of which, are you ready to begin your
translation: 总之，这就是为什么我们的组织保持神秘，为什么我们对所有潜在招募者要求如此严格的测试。说到这个，你准备好开始你的

english: testing?
translation: 测试了吗？

english: Yeah, this sounds right up my street. Let's go!
translation: 是的，这听起来正合我意。我们走吧！

english: Well, bad luck old [boy/gal/bean], you'll need to have a completely empty inventory and you can't be wearing any equipment before we can accurately test you.
translation: 嗯，真不走运，老[boy/gal/bean]，你需要清空背包，并且不能穿戴任何装备，我们才能准确测试你。

english: Don't want people cheating by smuggling stuff in, what?
translation: 不想让人作弊偷带东西进来，对吧？

english: Come and see me again after you've been to the old bank to drop your stuff off, what?
translation: 等你先去银行把东西存好之后再来找我，怎么样？

english: Jolly good show! Now, the training grounds location is a secret so...
translation: 太好了！现在，训练场的位置是保密的，所以……

english: Here we go! Mind your head!
translation: 走起！小心头！

english: Oops, ignore the smell! Nearly there!
translation: 哎呀，别管那味道！快到了！

english: And... Here we are! Best of luck!
translation: 然后……我们到了！祝你好运！

english: Well... I don't know... This doesn't really sound like my kind of thing...
translation: 嗯……我不知道……这听起来不太像是我喜欢的事……

english: To be honest, I'd rather go kill stuff for loot than use my mind to work things out...
translation: 说实话，我宁愿去杀怪拿战利品，也不愿动脑子解决问题……

english: Well, it takes all sorts to make the world spin, what? Maybe you'll find a nice job with the Guards sometime.
translation: 嗯，世界需要各种各样的人，对吧？也许你以后能在卫兵队找到一份好差事。

english: Sad though, your intelligence file seemed quite promising. Should you change your mind, you come back and let me know, what?
translation: 不过可惜了，你的情报档案看起来相当有前途。如果你改变主意，就回来告诉我，好吗？

english: Oh, jolly bad luck, what? Not quite the brainbox you thought you were, eh?
translation: 哦，真倒霉，对吧？看来你并不像自己以为的那么聪明，嗯？

english: Well, never mind! You have an open invitation to join our organisation, so when you're feeling a little smarter, come back and talk to me again!
translation: 嗯，没关系！你随时可以加入我们组织，所以等你觉得自己更聪明一点的时候，回来再跟我谈谈！

english: Ah, what ho! Back for another go at the old testing, what?
translation: 啊，嘿！又来尝试测试了，对吧？

english: Greetings friend, and welcome here, you'll find my puzzle not so clear. Hidden amongst my words, it's true, the password for the door as a clue.
translation: 朋友你好，欢迎到来，你会发现我的谜题并不简单。隐藏在我话语中的，是通往大门的密码线索，千真万确。

english: Better than me, you'll not find In rhyming and in puzzles. This clue so clear will tax your mind Entirely as it confuzzles!
translation: 在押韵和谜题方面，你找不到比我更好的。这个清晰的线索会折磨你的心智，让你完全困惑！

english: This riddle of mine may confuse, I am quite sure of that. Mayhap you should closely peruse Every word i have spat?
translation: 我的这个谜语可能会让人迷惑，对此我很确定。也许你应该仔细研读我吐出的每一个字？

english: Feel the aching of your mind In puzzlement, confused. See the clue hidden behind His words, as you perused.
translation: 感受你心智的疼痛，在困惑中迷茫。看到隐藏在他话语背后的线索，当你仔细阅读时。

english: More than words, i have not for you Except the things i say today. Aware are you, this is a clue? Take note of what i say!
translation: 除了我今天说的话，我没有更多的话给你。你知道吗，这是一个线索？注意我说的话！

english: Look closely at the words i speak; And study closely every part. See for yourself the word you seek Trapped for you if you're smart.
translation: 仔细看我说的每一个字；仔细研究每一部分。亲眼看看你寻找的那个词，如果你聪明的话，它就被困在那里等你。

english: Rare it is that you will see A puzzle such as this! In many ways it tickles me Now, watching you hit and miss!
translation: 你很少能看到像这样的谜题！在很多方面，它让我觉得有趣，现在看着你猜来猜去！

english: I don't get that riddle...
translation: 我不懂那个谜语……

english: Can I have a different one?
translation: 能给我换一个吗？

english: Before you hurry through that door Inspect the words i spoke. There is a simple hidden flaw Ere you think my rhyme a joke.
translation: 在你匆忙穿过那扇门之前，检查一下我说的话。在我押韵的玩笑背后，有一个简单的隐藏缺陷。

english: Twice it is now, i have stated In a rhyme, what is the pass. Maybe my words obfuscated Entirely beyond your class.
translation: 我已经用押韵的方式说了两次密码是什么。也许我的话完全超出了你的理解范围。

english: First my clue you did not see, I really wish you had. Such puzzling wordplay devilry Has left you kind of mad!
translation: 第一次你没看到我的线索，我真希望你能看到。这种令人困惑的文字游戏诡计让你有点抓狂！

english: Many types have passed through here Even such as you amongst their sort. And in the end, the puzzles clear; The hidden word you saught.
translation: 许多类型的人都从这里经过，甚至包括像你这样的人。最后，谜题清晰了；你寻找的那个隐藏的词。

english: Last time my puzzle did not help Apparently, so you've bidden. Study my speech carefully, whelp To find the answer, hidden.
translation: 上次我的谜题显然没帮上忙，所以你又来了。仔细研究我的话，小子，找到隐藏的答案。

english: Repetition, once again Against good sense it goes. In my words, the answers plain Now that you see rhyme flows.
translation: 重复一遍，再次违背了良好的常识。在我的话里，答案很明显，现在你看到押韵的流动了。

english: Can I have the final clue for the door?
translation: 能给我最后一个关于门的线索吗？

english: Betrayed by words the answer is In that what i say is the key There is no more help after this Especially no more from me.
translation: 被话语出卖，答案就在我所说的话中，这就是关键。之后再也没有更多帮助了，尤其是我不会再帮了。

english: Three times now, my riddle said; I hope you finally see the clue. Maybe think on what you've read; Easy when you know what to do.
translation: 现在我的谜语说了三次；我希望你终于看到了线索。也许想想你读过的东西；当你知道了该怎么做，一切就简单了。

english: For the last time i will state In simple words, the clue. Such tricky words make you irate Having no idea what to do...
translation: 最后一次，我会用简单的话说出线索。这种狡猾的话语让你恼火，完全不知道该怎么办……

english: Maybe i will do my best; Especially at giving clues. Attempt to help you pass the test! That should help me pay my dues.
translation: 也许我会尽力；尤其是在给出线索方面。尝试帮你通过测试！那应该能帮我尽到责任。

english: Lo! my final speech is now Attended to by you. Study my words, and find out how To understand my clue!
translation: 看！我最后的讲话现在被你听到了。研究我的话，找出如何理解我的线索！

english: Repeat myself to give the clue Again, i now do speak. It's hidden in my words - hey you! Now find the answer you seek.
translation: 重复自己给出线索，现在我开口说话。它藏在我的话语里——嘿，你！现在去找你寻找的答案。

english: Your wit is sharp, your brains quite clear; You solved my puzzle with no fear. At puzzles I rank you quite the best, now enter the portal for your next test.
translation: 你的机智敏锐，头脑清晰；你毫无畏惧地解开了我的谜题。在解谜方面我视你为最佳，现在进入传送门迎接下一个考验。

english: It's sad to say, this test beat you. I'll send you to Tiffy, what to do?
translation: 很遗憾，这个考验难倒了你。我会把你送回蒂菲那里，怎么办？

english: Greetings, [player name]. I am here to test your wits with a simple riddle.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我在这里用一个简单的谜语来考验你的智慧。

english: Here is my riddle: I estimate there to be 1 million inhabitants in the world of Gielinor, creatures and people both.
translation: 这是我的谜语：我估计吉莱诺世界有100万居民，包括生物和人类。

english: What would be the number you would get if you multiply the number of fingers on everythings left hand, to the nearest million?
translation: 如果你把所有生物左手的手指数量相乘，结果四舍五入到百万位是多少？

english: Here is my riddle: I have both a husband and daughter.
translation: 这是我的谜语：我有一个丈夫和一个女儿。

english: My husband is four times older than my daughter. In twenty years time, he will be twice as old as my daughter.
translation: 我丈夫的年龄是我女儿的四倍。二十年后，他的年龄将是女儿的两倍。

english: How old is my daughter now?
translation: 我女儿现在多大？

english: Here is my riddle: Which of the following statements is true?
translation: 这是我的谜语：以下哪个陈述是正确的？

english: Here is my riddle: Imagine that you have been captured by an enemy. You are to be killed, but in a moment of mercy, the enemy has allowed you to pick your own demise.
translation: 这是我的谜语：想象你被敌人俘虏。你将被处死，但敌人一时仁慈，允许你选择自己的死法。

english: Your first choice is to be drowned in a lake of acid.
translation: 第一个选择是被淹死在酸湖中。

english: Your second choice is to be burned on a fire.
translation: 第二个选择是被火烧死。

english: Your third choice is to be thrown to a pack of wolves that have not been fed in over a month.
translation: 第三个选择是被扔给一群超过一个月没喂食的狼。

english: Your final choice of fate is to be thrown from the walls of a castle, many hundreds of feet high.
translation: 最后一个选择是从数百英尺高的城堡墙上扔下去。

english: Which fate would you be wise to choose?
translation: 明智的你该选择哪种命运？

english: Here is my riddle: I dropped four identical stones, into four identical buckets, each containing an identical amount of water.
translation: 这是我的谜语：我把四块相同的石头丢进四个相同的桶里，每个桶装有相同量的水。

english: The first bucket's water was at 32 degrees Fahrenheit, the second was at 33 degrees, the third at 34 and the fourth was at 35 degrees.
translation: 第一个桶的水温是华氏32度，第二个33度，第三个34度，第四个35度。

english: Which bucket's stone dropped to the bottom of the bucket last?
translation: 哪个桶里的石头最后沉到桶底？

english: Excellent work, [player name]. Please step through the portal to meet your next challenge.
translation: 干得好，[player name]。请穿过传送门迎接下一个挑战。

english: No... I am very sorry. Apparently you are not up to the challenge. I will return you where you came from, better luck in the future.
translation: 不……非常抱歉。显然你无法胜任这个挑战。我会把你送回你来的地方，祝下次好运。

english: You certainly have the wits to be a Temple Knight. Pass on through the portal to find your next challenge.
translation: 你确实有成为圣殿骑士的才智。穿过传送门去寻找你的下一个挑战吧。

english: Welcome, [player name]. This room will test your observation skills.
translation: 欢迎，[player name]。这个房间将考验你的观察力。

english: Study the statues closely. There is one missing statue in this room.
translation: 仔细观察雕像。这个房间里少了一座雕像。

english: We will also mix the order up a little to make things interesting for you!
translation: 我们还会稍微打乱顺序，让事情变得有趣！

english: You have 10 seconds to memorise the statues... starting NOW!
translation: 你有10秒钟记住雕像……现在开始！

english: We will now dim the lights and bring the missing statue back in.
translation: 现在我们将调暗灯光，把缺失的雕像放回来。

english: Please touch the statue you think has been added.
translation: 请触摸你认为被添加的那座雕像。

english: Touch the statue that was brought in after you entered.
translation: 触摸你进入后被带进来的那座雕像。

english: If you touch the wrong one, you will fail this task, and will be escorted back to Falador.
translation: 如果你摸错了，就会失败，并被护送回法拉多城。

english: Well done, that was your fourth test, you only have one more to go.
translation: 干得好，这是你的第四次测试，你只剩最后一次了。

english: Excellent work! You have passed all five of the required tests! Please accept my congratulations!
translation: 出色的表现！你已经通过了全部五项必要的测试！请接受我的祝贺！

english: Please step through the portal to your final test...  ...and good luck, [player name].
translation: 请穿过传送门，迎接你的最终测试……祝你好运，[player name]。

english: Very well done, [player name]. We might make a Temple Knight of you yet.
translation: 做得非常好，[player name]。我们或许真能把你培养成一名圣殿骑士。

english: Ah, [player name], you have arrived. Speak to me to begin your task.
translation: 啊，[player name]，你来了。跟我说话开始你的任务。

english: Ah, welcome [player name]. I have but one clue for you to pass this room's puzzle: 'Patience'.
translation: 啊，欢迎[player name]。我只有一个线索让你通过这个房间的谜题：'耐心'。

english: Patience is a virtue that few possess in this world.
translation: 耐心是一种美德，这世上很少有人拥有。

english: Ah, [player name], you're finally here. Your task for this room is to defeat Sir Leye. He has been blessed by Saradomin to be undefeatable by any blade, so it should be quite a challenge for you.
translation: 啊，[player name]，你终于来了。这个房间的任务是击败莱耶爵士。他受到萨拉多明的祝福，任何刀片都无法击败他，所以这对你来说应该是个不小的挑战。

english: If you are having problems, remember; A true warrior uses his wits as much as his brawn. Fight smarter, not harder.
translation: 如果遇到困难，记住：真正的战士既用智慧也用蛮力。要智取，不要蛮干。

english: No blade may defeat me!
translation: 没有刀片能击败我！

english: AH-HA HA HA! You can NEVER defeat ME! I am blessed by Saradomin himself! NO BLADE MAY DEFEAT ME!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！你永远无法击败我！我受到萨拉多明本人的祝福！没有刀片能击败我！

english: AH-HA HA HA! You can NEVER defeat ME! I am blessed by Saradomin himself! NO MAN MAY DEFEAT ME!
translation: 啊哈！哈哈哈！你永远无法击败我！我得到了萨拉多明本人的祝福！没有男人能击败我！

english: Please step through the portal to your final test... ...and good luck, [player name].
translation: 请穿过传送门进行最终考验……祝你好运，[player name]。

english: Ah, [player name], you're finally here. Your task for this room is to defeat Sir Leye. He has been blessed by Saradomin to be undefeatable by any man, so it should be quite the challenge for you.
translation: 啊，[player name]，你终于来了。你在这个房间的任务是击败莱耶爵士。他得到了萨拉多明的祝福，任何男人都无法击败他，所以这对你来说应该是个不小的挑战。

english: Greetings, [player name]. Welcome to my challenge.
translation: 你好，[player name]。欢迎来到我的挑战。

english: All you need to do is leave from the opposite door to where you came in by.
translation: 你只需要从你进来的那扇门对面的门离开。

english: I will warn you that this is more complicated than it may at first appear.
translation: 我要提醒你，这比最初看起来要复杂。

english: I should also warn you that there are limited supplies of the items in this room, so think carefully before using them, or you may find yourself stuck, and have to leave to start again!
translation: 我还应该警告你，这个房间里的补给品数量有限，所以使用前要仔细考虑，否则你可能会发现自己卡住了，不得不离开重新开始！

english: Best of luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: Can you give me any help?
translation: 你能给我一些帮助吗？

english: No, I am sorry, but that is forbidden by our rules.
translation: 不，抱歉，但我们的规则禁止这样做。

english: If you are having a particularly tough time of it, I suggest you leave and come back later when you are in a more receptive frame of mind.
translation: 如果你觉得特别困难，我建议你先离开，等心态更开放的时候再回来。

english: Sometimes a break from concentration will yield fresh insight. Our aim is to test you, but not to the point of frustration!
translation: 有时暂停专注会带来新的见解。我们的目的是考验你，但不会让你沮丧到极点！

english: Please... I am REALLY stuck... Isn't there ANYTHING you can do to help me...?
translation: 拜托……我真的卡住了……你就不能做点什么帮我吗……？

english: Well... Look, I really shouldn't say anything about this room, but...
translation: 嗯……听着，我真的不该说这个房间的任何事，但是……

english: When I was attempting to join the Temple Knights I myself had to do this puzzle myself.
translation: 当年我试图加入圣殿骑士时，我自己也得做这个谜题。

english: It was slightly different, but the idea behind it was the same, and I left the notes I had made while doing it hidden in one of the bookcases.
translation: 虽然略有不同，但背后的思路是一样的，我把自己做谜题时做的笔记藏在了一个书柜里。

english: If you look carefully you may find them, and they may be of some use to you.
translation: 如果你仔细找，可能会找到它们，也许对你有用。

english: I really can't be any more help than that I'm afraid, it is more than my job's worth to have given you the help I already have.
translation: 恐怕我只能帮到这儿了，给你这些帮助已经超出我的职责范围了。

english: Okay, thanks a lot, you've been very helpful!
translation: 好的，非常感谢，你帮了大忙！

english: Best of luck with the test [player name], I hope your application is successful.
translation: 祝你在考验中好运[player name]，希望你的申请成功。

english: Ah, welcome [player name].
translation: 啊，欢迎[player name]。

english: Hello there. What am I supposed to be doing in this room?
translation: 你好。我在这房间里该做什么？

english: Well, your task is to take this fox, this chicken and this bag of grain across that bridge there to the other side of the room.
translation: 嗯，你的任务是把这只狐狸、这只鸡和这袋谷物带过那座桥，到房间的另一边。

english: When you have done that, your task is complete.
translation: 完成后，你的任务就完成了。

english: Well, it is not quite as simple as that may sound.
translation: 嗯，这并不像听起来那么简单。

english: Firstly, you may only carry one of the objects across the room at a time, for the bridge is old and fragile.
translation: 首先，你一次只能携带一个物品过桥，因为桥又旧又脆弱。

english: Secondly, the fox wants to eat the chicken, and the chicken wants to eat the grain. Should you ever leave the fox unattended with the chicken, or the grain unattended with the chicken, then
translation: 其次，狐狸想吃鸡，鸡想吃谷物。如果你让狐狸和鸡单独在一起，或者让谷物和鸡单独在一起，那么

english: one of them will be eaten, and you will be unable to complete the test.
translation: 其中一个就会被吃掉，你就无法完成考验。

english: Listen, this is really annoying me. Can't you just stop the fox eating the chicken or the chicken eating the grain for me, while I carry the other stuff across the bridge?
translation: 听着，这真的很烦人。你就不能帮我阻止狐狸吃鸡或者鸡吃谷物，让我把其他东西运过桥吗？

english: I am afraid not, [player name]. My task is solely to observe your progress, we have explicit instructions not to assist you in any way..
translation: 恐怕不行，[player name]。我的任务只是观察你的进展，我们有明确指示不得以任何方式协助你。

english: No, but seriously, please? Think of the poor chicken and grain! Being eaten!
translation: 不，但说真的，求你了？想想可怜的鸡和谷物！会被吃掉的！

english: I am truly sorry, but my hands are tied. I suggest you think carefully before taking any items across the bridge with you, to ensure nothing gets eaten while you are not paying attention.
translation: 我真的很抱歉，但我无能为力。我建议你在带任何物品过桥前仔细考虑，确保在你没注意时不会有东西被吃掉。

english: This is the only help I may give you...
translation: 这是我唯一能给你的帮助……

english: Well, thanks I guess...
translation: 好吧，我想还是谢谢了……

english: I really don't think I should be carrying more than 5 Kg across that rickety bridge...
translation: 我真的觉得我不应该带超过5公斤的东西过那座摇摇晃晃的桥……

english: Ah, well done on solving my puzzle [player name]!
translation: 啊，[player name]，解开了我的谜题，干得好！

english: I believe I've managed to pass the tests!
translation: 我相信我已经通过了考验！

english: Oh, jolly well done! Your performance will need to be evaluated by Sir Vey personally, but I don't think it's going too far ahead of myself to welcome you to the team!
translation: 哦，干得漂亮！你的表现需要由维伊爵士亲自评估，但我觉得提前欢迎你加入团队也不算过分！

english: I received your message my liege. How may I serve the kingdom?
translation: 我收到了您的消息，陛下。我该如何为王国效力？

english: Ahh... adventurer. The repair work on the Well of Voyage has been completed. We're finally ready to move against my brother.
translation: 啊……冒险者。远航之井的修复工作已经完成。我们终于准备好对付我兄弟了。

english: I assume you have a plan?
translation: 我想您有计划了？

english: I do indeed. I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.
translation: 确实有。我最近成功联系上了居住在西部土地的精灵。

english: Elves? I’ve never seen an elf before.
translation: 精灵？我从没见过精灵。

english: Well that may well change soon. Apparently, my brother has been causing them quite a bit of trouble. As such, they've agreed to help us get rid of him once and for all.
translation: 嗯，那可能很快就会改变。显然，我兄弟给他们惹了不少麻烦。因此，他们同意帮我们一劳永逸地除掉他。

english: So what do I need to do?
translation: 那我需要做什么？

english: You are to head into the Underground Pass and through the Well of Voyage. Lord Iorwerth, the leader of the elves, will send some representatives to meet you on the other side.
translation: 你要进入地下通道，穿过远航之井。精灵的首领伊尔沃斯领主会派一些代表在另一边接应你。

english: With their help, you are to find my brother and kill him. Once that's done, return to me.
translation: 在他们的帮助下，你要找到我兄弟并杀了他。完成后，回来见我。

english: Very well. Anything else I should know?
translation: 好的。还有什么我需要知道的吗？

english: My brother may not be the only threat you face. I hear the elves are currently dealing with a rebellion. The rebels likely won't take kindly to you working with their enemy so be on the look out.
translation: 我兄弟可能不是你面临的唯一威胁。我听说精灵们目前正在处理一场叛乱。叛军可能不会对你与他们敌人合作这件事有好感，所以要小心。

english: I see. I'll be careful.
translation: 明白了。我会小心的。

english: Good luck adventurer.
translation: 祝你好运，冒险者。

english: Actually, I don't think I'm ready for this yet.
translation: 其实，我觉得我还没准备好。

english: As you wish. Return to me when you are ready and we will begin.
translation: 随你便。准备好了就回来找我，我们便开始。

english: What's the deal with your brother again?
translation: 再跟我说说你兄弟的事？

english: My brother, King Tyras, was always a bit of an explorer. He went on numerous expeditions to the lands west of here. On one of these expeditions, he was captured by the forces of the Dark Lord.
translation: 我兄弟，泰拉斯国王，一直有点探险家的性子。他多次远征到这里的西部土地。在一次远征中，他被黑暗领主的力量俘虏了。

english: The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity. The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil…
translation: 黑暗领主同意饶他一命，但只有一个条件……他必须喝下永恒圣杯。圣杯腐蚀了他。他与黑暗领主——纯粹邪恶的化身——联手了……

english: As a result, I had a wall built around West Ardougne to act as a barrier between him and the rest of the world. Tyras is king of West Ardougne, sealing off the city was the only way to stop him and the Dark Lord.
translation: 结果，我在西阿多尼城周围建了一堵墙，作为他和世界其他地区之间的屏障。泰拉斯是西阿多尼城的国王，封锁城市是阻止他和黑暗领主的唯一方法。

english: But now we’re ready to stop him.
translation: 但现在我们准备好阻止他了。

english: Indeed we are. My brother has been gathering strength in the west, preparing to move against us. But now that we have a way through, we can move against him first.
translation: 确实如此。我兄弟一直在西部积蓄力量，准备对付我们。但现在我们有了一条通路，我们可以先发制人。

english: Excellent. Do you have a plan in place?
translation: 太好了。你有计划了吗？

english: Sounds good. See you later.
translation: 听起来不错。回头见。

english: Farewell adventurer. Return to me once you are ready to begin.
translation: 再会，冒险者。准备好开始时就回来找我。

english: Halt human! What are you doing here?
translation: 站住，人类！你在这里做什么？

english: Wait! What was that? What the...
translation: 等等！那是什么？搞什么……

english: Are you the human by the name of [player name]?
translation: 你就是那个叫[player name]的人类吗？

english: Yes that's me.
translation: 是的，就是我。

english: Good... We've been expecting you. King Lathas sent word of your coming.
translation: 很好……我们一直在等你。拉萨斯国王已经传信说你要来。

english: You should speak with Lord Iorwerth. He will help you track down that brigand Tyras. You'll find his camp in the north west of the forest.
translation: 你应该和伊尔沃斯领主谈谈。他会帮你追踪那个强盗泰拉斯。你会在森林西北部找到他的营地。

english: Hello there, I'm [player name]. Your scouts said that I should come and see you.
translation: 你好，我是[player name]。你的侦察兵说我可以来找你。

english: Ahh... [player name]. Welcome to Tirannwn. I understand you've been sent here to rid us of that criminal Tyras. I offer my full support.
translation: 啊……[player name]。欢迎来到提兰温。我知道你是被派来为我们除掉那个罪犯泰拉斯的。我全力支持。

english: Unfortunately, most of my troops are currently dealing with a group of renegade elves. That does mean we're a bit more limited than we otherwise would be.
translation: 不幸的是，我的大部分部队目前正在对付一群叛变的精灵。这意味着我们能提供的帮助比平时要有限一些。

english: I see. I'll need to play this smart then.
translation: 明白了。那我得聪明点行事。

english: Indeed. Now, Tyras and his forces moved camp recently so your first step will be to find their new camp. I have a tracker currently working in that area. I suggest you join up with him.
translation: 确实。现在，泰拉斯和他的部队最近转移了营地，所以你的第一步是找到他们的新营地。我有个追踪者目前在那个区域工作。我建议你和他会合。

english: You'll find him at Tyras's old camp. It's south east of here, just north of that poisoned lake. Once you've found the camp, come and let me know.
translation: 你会在泰拉斯的旧营地找到他。就在这里的东南方，那个有毒湖泊的北边。找到营地后，回来告诉我。

english: Thank you. I shall return when my task is complete.
translation: 谢谢。我完成任务后会回来的。

english: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men...
translation: 人类！你一定是泰拉斯的手下……

english: No I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.
translation: 不，我是[player name]！伊尔沃斯领主说你可能能帮我。

english: And you have something to prove this?
translation: 你有什么证据吗？

english: Well... Err... No.
translation: 嗯……呃……没有。

english: As I was saying... I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: 就像我说的……我没时间搭理强盗或亡命之徒。

english: Good day [player name]. How may I help you now?
translation: 你好[player name]。现在有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: Your scout refused to help. He asked for proof that you sent me.
translation: 你的侦察兵拒绝帮忙。他要求证明是你派我来的。

english: Bless his loyalty but curse his suspicion. Here he will recognise this.
translation: 赞美他的忠诚，但诅咒他的多疑。在这里他会认出这个。

english: That's Lord Iorwerth's pendant. He must have a lot of faith in you. Now, what is it I can help you with?
translation: 那是伊尔沃斯领主的吊坠。他一定非常信任你。现在，我能帮你什么？

english: I need to find Tyras and kill him. Do you know where his camp is?
translation: 我需要找到泰拉斯并杀了他。你知道他的营地在哪吗？

english: Well this was his old camp. After the battle a few days ago they moved. We're yet to find them again.
translation: 嗯，这是他的旧营地。几天前那场战斗之后他们就转移了。我们还没找到他们。

english: As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethren instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.
translation: 实际上，我现在并不是在追踪他们。我目前正试图追踪我们那些叛变的同胞。这是我们目前找到的最好线索。

english: Ahh I guess you can't see it with those human eyes.
translation: 啊，我猜你那双人类眼睛是看不见的。

english: I tell you what. Now that you're here I may as well give you a hand. I'll search here on the east side. You check out the west end of the camp. Come and tell me if you find anything.
translation: 这样吧。既然你来了，我不妨帮你一把。我搜索东边这片区域。你去查看营地的西端。找到什么就来告诉我。

english: [player name], how goes your search? Any luck hunting down that brigand?
translation: [player name]，搜索得怎么样了？找到那个强盗了吗？

english: I've found no trace of him as yet.
translation: 我还没找到他的踪迹。

english: I'm sure you will find something at his old camp that can help you.
translation: 我相信你会在他的旧营地找到一些有用的东西。

english: I'll take a look and see what I can find.
translation: 我去看看能找到什么。

english: Good. Come find me when you've located the camp.
translation: 好。找到营地后过来找我。

english: Check out the west end of the camp and see if you can find anything. I'll keep looking here. Let me know if you find anything.
translation: 检查营地的西端，看看能不能找到什么。我会继续在这里找。找到什么就告诉我。

english: I've found tracks leading off to the west. But they trail off into the trees. Beyond that I am unable to follow.
translation: 我找到了向西延伸的踪迹。但它们消失在树林里了。再往后我就跟不上了。

english: These forests aren't always as dense as you'd think. If you look closer, you might see ways that you can get through. With that in mind, why don't you give it another go?
translation: 这些森林并不总是像你想的那么茂密。如果你仔细看，可能会发现可以通过的路。既然如此，何不再试一次？

english: Thanks... I'll see what I can find.
translation: 谢谢……我看看能找到什么。

english: How goes the hunt for that bandit camp?
translation: 寻找那个强盗营地的进展如何？

english: I found it a short distance west of here.
translation: 我在西边不远处找到了它。

english: I'm sure Lord Iorwerth will be pleased to hear that. You should let him know.
translation: 我相信伊尔沃斯领主听到会很高兴的。你应该告诉他。

english: I see you making friends with that elf, traitor!
translation: 我看到你在和那个精灵交朋友，叛徒！

english: [player name] how goes your search... Any luck hunting down that brigand?
translation: [player name] 搜索得怎么样了……找到那个强盗了吗？

english: I've finally tracked the brute down. His camp is in a secluded bit of forest, almost directly south of here.
translation: 我终于追踪到那个恶棍了。他的营地在森林里一个隐蔽的地方，几乎就在这里的正南方。

english: Good job. As we don't have the troops available to take on his forces directly, I suggest we try some alternative tactics.
translation: 干得好。由于我们没有足够的部队直接对抗他的军队，我建议我们尝试一些替代战术。

english: I have this book here which details an explosive reaction. We should be able to use it to create a bomb.
translation: 我这里有一本书，详细描述了一种爆炸反应。我们应该能用它来制造一个炸弹。

english: Well that should make short work of Tyras.
translation: 嗯，那应该能轻松解决泰拉斯。

english: Indeed. Have a read through and see what you think. Once you have, let me know if you have any questions.
translation: 确实。读一读，看看你觉得怎么样。看完后，如果有问题就告诉我。

english: I lost my copy of The Big Book of Bangs.
translation: 我弄丢了我的那本《爆炸大全》。

english: Its lucky I had a scribe make a few copies then, is it not?
translation: 幸好我让一个抄写员做了几份副本，不是吗？
