english: Good day [player name]. Have you had any luck with that book?
translation: 你好[player name]。那本书有进展吗？

english: I need some quicklime.
translation: 我需要一些生石灰。

english: Quicklime?
translation: 生石灰？

english: Apparently it's made by heating limestone.
translation: 显然是通过加热石灰石制成的。

english: Ah, I see. There's a mine directly east of here where you can mine limestone.
translation: 啊，我明白了。东边直接有一个矿场，你可以在那里开采石灰石。

english: Is there anything else I can help with?
translation: 还有其他需要帮忙的吗？

english: I need some sulphur.
translation: 我需要一些硫磺。

english: Check the shore south of the old camp you were at earlier. I've seen sulphur there in the past, it comes from that poisoned lake.
translation: 检查一下你之前去过的旧营地南边的海岸。我以前在那里见过硫磺，它来自那个有毒的湖泊。

english: Sounds good, thanks.
translation: 听起来不错，谢谢。

english: I need some naphtha.
translation: 我需要一些石脑油。

english: Naphtha?
translation: 石脑油？

english: According to the book, you get it through the fractional distillation of coal tar.
translation: 根据这本书，你可以通过煤焦油的分馏得到它。

english: Well you should be able to get some coal tar from that poisoned lake to the south. As for the rest, I'm afraid I don't have the chemistry knowledge to understand it.
translation: 嗯，你应该能从南边那个有毒的湖泊弄到一些煤焦油。至于剩下的，恐怕我没有足够的化学知识来理解。

english: Hmm... I know someone from Ardougne who might be able to help. She knows a thing or two about chemistry.
translation: 嗯……我认识一个来自阿多尼城的人，她也许能帮忙。她对化学略知一二。

english: Perfect! Take the book to her and see if she can help. Just don't tell her what it's for. Even if she's trustworthy, we can't take any risks.
translation: 太好了！把书拿给她，看看她能不能帮忙。只是别告诉她这是干什么用的。即使她值得信任，我们也不能冒任何风险。

english: Anyway, is there anything else I can help with?
translation: 总之，还有其他需要帮忙的吗？

english: I need a barrel.
translation: 我需要一个桶。

english: Have a look around the camp, there should be some empty barrels lying around.
translation: 在营地周围找找，应该有一些空桶散落在各处。

english: I need a fuse.
translation: 我需要一根引信。

english: Some sort of fabric should work. You can use the loom here if needed.
translation: 某种织物应该可以。如果需要的话，你可以用这里的织布机。

english: Let me know if you need anything else.
translation: 如果还需要什么，就告诉我。

english: Good day. I was hoping you could help me with something. I have a book which mentions the fractional distillation of coal tar. I don't know how to do that though.
translation: 你好。我希望你能帮我个忙。我有一本书提到了煤焦油的分馏。但我不知道怎么做。

english: Ah, you'll be wanting to use the still then. It's just outside.
translation: 啊，那你需要用蒸馏器。就在外面。

english: How do I use it?
translation: 我该怎么用？

english: It's quite simple really. You have to get the still heat up very high for it to work. However, if it gets too hot it will burn out and you will have to start over.
translation: 其实很简单。你必须让蒸馏器加热到很高才能工作。但是，如果太热了，它就会烧坏，你就得重新开始。

english: You must also watch the pressure, if it gets too high you will also have to start over. There are valves to control pressure and tar flow. These will also affect the heat of the still.
translation: 你还必须注意压力，如果压力太高，你也得重新开始。有阀门可以控制压力和焦油流量。这些也会影响蒸馏器的热量。

english: You'll also need plenty of coal to keep the still hot.
translation: 你还需要大量的煤来保持蒸馏器高温。

english: Good day [player.] Have you had any luck with that book?
translation: 你好[player.]。那本书有进展吗？

english: I have finished the bomb.
translation: 我完成了炸弹。

english: Excellent work. Now we can finally deal with Tyras.
translation: 干得好！现在我们终于能对付泰拉斯了。

english: So what should I do? Plant it in his camp?
translation: 那我该怎么做？把它埋在他的营地里？

english: No, you'll be spotted by the guards if you try that. You'll need to get it in from outside.
translation: 不，那样你会被守卫发现的。你得从外面把它弄进去。

english: Tyras and his men have used catapults against us in the past. Maybe you can turn one of them against him.
translation: 泰拉斯和他的人过去曾用投石机攻击我们。也许你可以用他们的投石机来对付他。

english: Now you'd better get going. Don't forget, you'll need a tinderbox to light that fuse. Return to me once the deed is done.
translation: 现在你最好出发了。别忘了，你需要一个火绒盒来点燃引信。事情办完后回来找我。

english: Oi! Don't mess with that.
translation: 喂！别乱碰那个。

english: Yeah, what ya want?
translation: 干嘛？你想干嘛？

english: I was wondering what you were doing out here?
translation: 我在想你在这里做什么？

english: I was just wondering what I was doing here too. I'm meant to be looking after this catapult but I can't keep my mind on the job. We've been living off field rations for almost a year now.
translation: 我也在想我在这里干嘛。我本该照看这台投石机，但总是心不在焉。我们吃野战配给品都快一年了。

english: I keep seeing rabbits in this forest. What I wouldn't give to eat one, but I'm not quick enough to kill any and I'm no good with a bow.
translation: 我老在这片森林里看到兔子。真想吃一只，但我跑得不够快抓不到，弓箭也射不准。

english: I can see how that would be distracting.
translation: 我能理解这确实让人分心。

english: Well I have one here for you.
translation: 我这正好有一只给你。

english: You cooked me a rabbit! Thanks a lot. You don't mind watching things while I take five to eat it, do you?
translation: 你给我烤了只兔子！太感谢了。你介意我抽空吃它的时候你帮我看着点吗？

english: They say the king died from a flying fire ball. Are you certain no one messed with the catapult while I was eating?
translation: 他们说国王是被一个飞行的火球砸死的。你确定我吃东西的时候没人动过投石机吗？

english: I was the only one here. I was watching the whole time.
translation: 只有我一个人在这里。我一直看着呢。

english: I take it that the huge explosion I just heard was you?
translation: 我猜刚才那声巨大的爆炸是你干的？

english: Yes, I've finally dealt with Tyras, he should cause you no more problems.
translation: 是的，我终于解决了泰拉斯，他不会再给你添麻烦了。

english: This is good news indeed. Lord Iorwerth will be very happy. You should go and let him know.
translation: 这真是好消息。伊尔沃斯领主会很高兴的。你应该去告诉他。

english: Lord Iorwerth, it is done.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主，事情办完了。

english: Good good... One of my scouts reported that they saw his tent in a ball of flames. You have done well.
translation: 好，好……我的一个侦察兵报告说，他们看到他的帐篷在一片火球中。你做得很好。

english: I'm sure you will want to get back to your king and tell him. He will undoubtedly want some proof. He should trust me enough in this matter, Givehim this letter, it verifies that the job is done.
translation: 我相信你想回去见你的国王并告诉他这个消息。他无疑会想要一些证据。在这件事上他应该足够信任我。给他这封信，证明任务已经完成。

english: As a token of my own thanks, I give you access to the pass through Arandar. You'll find the start of the trail in the far north east of the woods.
translation: 作为我个人感谢的象征，我授予你通过阿兰达山口的权限。你会在树林的东北角找到小路的起点。

english: Thank you my lord.
translation: 谢谢您，大人。

english: Lord Iorwerth, I have lost the message for King Lathas.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主，我弄丢了给拉萨斯国王的信。

english: Here have another copy, but don't let it fall into the wrong hands.
translation: 这里再给你一份副本，但别让它落入坏人手里。

english: Good day Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 日安，伊尔沃斯领主。

english: Have you delivered the message to King Lathas yet?
translation: 你把信交给拉萨斯国王了吗？

english: Not yet my lord.
translation: 还没有，大人。

english: There is no time for delay, he'll need to see it.
translation: 不能再耽误了，他必须看到这封信。

english: Are you the human by the name [player name]?
translation: 你就是那个名叫[player name]的人类吗？

english: Yes, that's me?
translation: 是的，就是我。

english: Thank Seren, maybe all is not yet lost.
translation: 感谢塞伦，也许一切还未失去。

english: I am Arianwyn, leader of the Elven Resistance. We've been watching you since you arrived in Tirannwn. We know it was you that murdered King Tyras.
translation: 我是阿里安温，精灵抵抗军的领袖。你一到提兰温我们就注意到你了。我们知道是你杀了泰拉斯国王。

english: There is much to explain and little time. You carry a message from Lord Iorwerth, do you not?
translation: 有很多事要解释，但时间不多。你带着伊尔沃斯领主的一封信，对吗？

english: Well you seem to know everything else so I'll not lie. Yes.
translation: 好吧，你好像什么都知道，我就不撒谎了。是的。

english: Good, we understand each other well. Now hand it here and find the truth of who your real employer is.
translation: 很好，我们彼此了解。现在把信给我，去弄清你真正的雇主是谁。

english: I had no idea! Why would the king do this?
translation: 我完全不知道！国王为什么要这么做？

english: I have a few ideas, now is not the time to discuss them though. For now, you should go to King Lathas as normal. Give him the message and act like nothing unusual has happened.
translation: 我有一些想法，但现在不是讨论的时候。现在，你照常去见拉萨斯国王。把信给他，表现得像什么都没发生一样。

english: Once you are done, return to Tirannwn and seek out Islwyn and Eluned. You'll find them roaming the Isafdar forest. They will bring you to me.
translation: 完成后，返回提兰温，寻找伊斯尔温和埃卢内德。你会在伊萨法德森林里找到他们。他们会带你来见我。

english: You want me to help you? Okay, what's in it for me?
translation: 你想让我帮你？好吧，我有什么好处？

english: The chance for redemption after all you've done? If that doesn't take your fancy, consider this...
translation: 为你所做的一切获得救赎的机会？如果这不足以打动你，那么想想这个……

english: This isn't a struggle for land or title. It is a war for life, all life. If Iorwerth and Lathas manage to summon Zamorak, we all die.
translation: 这不是为了土地或头衔的斗争。这是一场为了生命，为了所有生命的战争。如果伊尔沃斯和拉萨斯成功召唤扎莫拉克，我们都会死。

english: Deliver your message, act normal. We'll meet again soon.
translation: 去送你的信吧，表现得正常点。我们很快会再见。

english: My lord, Tyras is dead!
translation: 陛下，泰拉斯死了！

english: This is grand news indeed! You'll forgive me if I'm a little apprehensive about this, but I take it you do have proof?
translation: 这真是天大的好消息！请原谅我有些怀疑，但我想你是有证据的吧？

english: No, I have nothing to corroborate this.
translation: 不，我没有任何可以证实的东西。

english: I am sure you have done as you say, but on this matter I can afford no doubts. You must find something to confirm your story.
translation: 我相信你确实做了你所说的事，但在这件事上我不能有任何疑问。你必须找到能证实你说法的东西。

english: Yes, I have a letter sent by Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 是的，我有一封伊尔沃斯领主写的信。

english: Yes... Good... This will do nicely. Well done, you've done an excellent job.
translation: 是的……好……这正合适。干得好，你做得非常出色。

english: Does this mean we can reveal the truth about the plague?
translation: 这是否意味着我们可以揭露瘟疫的真相了？

english: Not yet I'm afraid. Even with my brother gone, the Dark Lord remains a threat. For now, the plague must remain.
translation: 恐怕还不行。即使我兄弟不在了，黑暗领主仍然是个威胁。目前，瘟疫必须继续存在。

english: Anyway, I'll send word when I next require your services. Oh, and I guess you'll be wanting your reward.
translation: 总之，下次我需要你服务时会传话给你。哦，我想你肯定想要你的奖励。

english: Blub! Blub...where is my Juliet? Have you seen her?
translation: 咕噜！咕噜……我的朱丽叶在哪？你见过她吗？

english: Looking for a blonde girl, goes by the name of Juliet..quite pretty...haven't seen her have you?
translation: 我在找一个金发女孩，名叫朱丽叶……挺漂亮的……你没见过她吧？

english: Juliet, Juliet, wherefore art thou Juliet? Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶，朱丽叶，你在哪里啊朱丽叶？你见过我的朱丽叶吗？

english: Oh woe is me that I cannot find my Juliet! You haven't seen Juliet have you?
translation: 哦，我真命苦，找不到我的朱丽叶！你没见过朱丽叶吧？

english: Sadness surrounds me now that Juliet's father forbids us to meet. Have you seen my Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶的父亲禁止我们见面，悲伤笼罩着我。你见过我的朱丽叶吗？

english: What is to become of me and my darling Juliet, I cannot find her anywhere, have you seen her?
translation: 我和我亲爱的朱丽叶该怎么办，我到处都找不到她，你见过她吗？

english: Yes, I have seen her actually!
translation: 是的，我其实见过她！

english: At least, I think it was her... Blonde? A bit stressed?
translation: 至少，我觉得是她……金发？有点焦虑？

english: Golly...yes, yes...you make her sound very interesting!
translation: 天哪……是的，是的……你把她描述得很有趣！

english: And I'll bet she's a bit of a fox!
translation: 我敢打赌她一定很迷人！

english: Well, I guess she could be considered attractive...
translation: 嗯，我想她可以算是有魅力吧……

english: I'll bet she is!  Wooooooooo!
translation: 我敢打赌她是！呜喔喔喔喔！

english: Sorry, all that jubilation has made me forget what we were talking about.
translation: 抱歉，太兴奋了，我都忘了我们在说什么。

english: You were asking me about Juliet? You seemed to know her?
translation: 你刚才在问我朱丽叶的事？你好像认识她？

english: Oh yes, Juliet!
translation: 哦，对，朱丽叶！

english: The fox...could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 那个迷人的姑娘……你能告诉她，她是我漫长一生的挚爱，我渴望和她在一起吗？

english: What?  Surely you mean that she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?
translation: 什么？你肯定是想说，她是你一生的挚爱，你渴望和她在一起吧？

english: Oh yeah...what you said...tell her that, it sounds much better!  Oh you're so good at this!
translation: 哦，对……就按你说的……告诉她那些话，听起来好多了！哦，你太擅长这个了！

english: Yes, okay. I'll let her know.
translation: 好的，没问题。我会告诉她的。

english: Oh great! And tell her that I want to kiss her a give.
translation: 哦，太好了！再告诉她，我想亲她一个给。

english: You mean you want to give her a kiss!
translation: 你是想说，你想给她一个吻！

english: Oh you're good...you are good!
translation: 哦，你太厉害了……你太厉害了！

english: I see I've picked a true professional...!
translation: 看来我找对人了，一个真正的专业人士……！

english: Where can I find Juliet?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到朱丽叶？

english: So that I can try and find her for you!
translation: 这样我才能试着帮你找到她！

english: Ah yes....quite right. Hmmm, let me think now.
translation: 啊，是的……说得对。嗯，让我想想。

english: She may still be locked away at her Father's house on the sest vide of Warrock.
translation: 她可能还被锁在她父亲位于华洛克西边的房子里。

english: Oh, I remember how she loved it when I would sing up to her balcony! She would reward me with her own personal items...
translation: 哦，我记得她多喜欢我在她的阳台下唱歌！她会用她的私人物品奖励我……

english: What, she just gave you her stuff?
translation: 什么，她就把她的东西给你了？

english: Well, not exactly give...more like 'throw with considerable force'...she's always a kidder that Juliet!
translation: 嗯，不完全是给……更像是‘用力扔过来’……朱丽叶总是爱开玩笑！

english: Is there anything else you can tell me about Juliet?
translation: 你还能告诉我关于朱丽叶的其他事吗？

english: Oh, there is so much to tell...she is my true love, we intend to spend together forever...I can tell you so much about her..
translation: 哦，有太多可以说了……她是我的真爱，我们打算永远在一起……我可以告诉你很多关于她的事……

english: Ermmm.....
So much can I tell you...
translation: 我可以告诉你很多……

english: Yes..
translation: 是的……

english: So much to tell...why, where do I start!
translation: 太多要说了……唉，该从何说起呢！

english: Yes..yes!  Please go on...don't let me interrupt...
translation: 是的……是的！请继续……别让我打断你……

english: You can't remember can you?
translation: 你记不起来了吧？

english: Not a thing sorry....
translation: 一点都想不起来了，抱歉……

english: Sorry Romeo, I've got better things to do right now. Maybe later?
translation: 抱歉罗密欧，我现在有更重要的事要做。改天吧？

english: Oh, okay, well, I guess my Juliet and I can spend some time apart.  And as the old saying goes, 'Absinthe makes the heart glow longer'.
translation: 哦，好吧，嗯，我想我和我的朱丽叶可以分开一段时间。就像老话说的，‘苦艾酒让心更长久地发光’。

english: Don't you mean that, 'Absence makes the...
translation: 你不是想说，‘小别胜……

english: Actually forget it...
translation: 算了，当我没说……

english: No sorry, I haven't seen her.
translation: 不，抱歉，我没见过她。

english: Oh...well, that's a shame...I was rather hoping you had.
translation: 哦……好吧，真可惜……我还挺希望你说见过的。

english: Why?  Is she a fugitive?  Does she owe you some money or something?
translation: 为什么？她是逃犯吗？还是欠你钱什么的？

english: Hmmm, she might do?  Perhaps she does?  How do you know?
translation: 嗯，也许吧？可能吧？你怎么知道的？

english: I don't know? I was asking 'YOU' how 'YOU' know Juliet!
translation: 我不知道？我是问‘你’怎么认识朱丽叶的！

english: Ahh, yes Juliet, she's my one true love.  Well, one of my one true loves! If you see her, could you tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 啊，是的，朱丽叶，她是我的真爱。嗯，我的真爱之一！如果你见到她，能告诉她，她是我漫长一生的挚爱，我渴望和她在一起吗？

english: What?  Surely you mean that 'she is the love of your life and that you long to be with her?'
translation: 什么？你肯定是想说‘她是你一生的挚爱，你渴望和她在一起’吧？

english: Perhaps I can help find her for you? What does she look like?
translation: 也许我可以帮你找到她？她长什么样？

english: Oh would you? That would be great! She has this sort of hair...
translation: 哦，你愿意吗？那太好了！她有这样的头发……

english: Hair...check..
translation: 头发……记下了……

english: ...and she these...great lips...
translation: ……还有她这……漂亮的嘴唇……

english: Lips...right.
translation: 嘴唇……好的。

english: Oh and she has these lovely shoulders as well..
translation: 哦，她还有这可爱的肩膀……

english: Shoulders...right, so she has hair, lips and shoulders...that should cut it down a bit.
translation: 肩膀……好的，所以她有头发、嘴唇和肩膀……这应该能缩小点范围。

english: Oh yes, Juliet is very different...please tell her that she is the love of my long and that I life to be with her?
translation: 哦，是的，朱丽叶很特别……请告诉她，她是我漫长一生的挚爱，我渴望和她在一起？

english: Hello again, remember me?
translation: 又见面了，还记得我吗？

english: Of course, yes....how are.. you....ermmm...
translation: 当然，是的……你……呃……还好吗……

english: You haven't got a clue who I am do you?
translation: 你根本不知道我是谁，对吧？

english: Not a clue my friend, but you seem to have a friendly face...a little blood stained, and perhaps in need of a wash, but friendly none the less.
translation: 一点都不知道，朋友，但你看起来面善……虽然有点血迹，也许该洗洗，但还是很友善。

english: You asked me to look for Juliet for you!
translation: 你让我帮你找朱丽叶！

english: Ah yes, Juliet...my sweet darling...what news?
translation: 啊，是的，朱丽叶……我亲爱的甜心……有什么消息？

english: Nothing so far, but I need to ask a few questions?
translation: 目前还没有，但我需要问几个问题？

english: What are you doing here? Snooping around...
translation: 你在这里干什么？鬼鬼祟祟的……

english: I've come to see Juliet on Romeo's behalf.
translation: 我是代表罗密欧来见朱丽叶的。

english: What...what...Romeo! Why that good for nothing swine...he's always trying to get the affections of my daughter..that soppy, half brained nincompoop won't ever have the heart of my daughter.
translation: 什么……什么……罗密欧！那个没用的猪猡……他总是想博取我女儿的欢心……那个多愁善感、半吊子的傻瓜永远别想得到我女儿的心。

english: She deserves someone of character, wit and repose.
translation: 她值得一个有品格、智慧和沉着的人。

english: What's so wrong about Romeo?
translation: 罗密欧有什么不好？

english: Wrong! What's wrong with him...have you actually talked to him? He's nothing but a dim witted upperclass twit, totally useless.
translation: 不好！他有什么不好……你跟他谈过话吗？他不过是个愚蠢的上流社会白痴，完全没用。

english: If he threw a stone at the ground, he'd probably miss! He's totally invisible when it's raining because he's so wet!
translation: 他要是往地上扔块石头，都可能扔不中！下雨天他完全隐形，因为他太湿了！

english: If you started with what's right with him, you'd have much less to consider!
translation: 如果你从他好的方面说起，那要考虑的东西就少多了！

english: Well, I admit, he's probably not the sharpest knife in the cutlery draw...
translation: 嗯，我承认，他可能不是抽屉里最锋利的刀……

english: Sharp? I've seen keener wit in root vegetables.  Anyway, stop changing the subject. Get out of here and don't think you can sneak up those stairs to see Juliet, because I'll catch you and then you'll be for it!
translation: 锋利？我在根茎类蔬菜里都见过更敏锐的智慧。总之，别转移话题。滚出去，别以为你能偷偷爬上楼梯去见朱丽叶，我会抓住你，到时候有你好看的！

english: That seems a bit harsh....
translation: 这有点过分了吧……

english: Harsh but fair I think you'll find...now get OUT!
translation: 我想你会发现，虽然严厉但公平……现在给我滚出去！

english: I've just come to have a chat with Juliet.
translation: 我只是来和朱丽叶聊聊天。

english: What on earth about?  I hope you're not in cahoots with that good for nothing Romeo!
translation: 聊什么？我希望你不是和那个没用的罗密欧串通一气！

english: Err..no of course not....why would I be?
translation: 呃……当然不是……我为什么要呢？

english: He's been trying to wooo my daughter for an age. Up until now she's had the good sense to just ignore him. I just don't know what's gotten into her recently so that she would give him the time of day.
translation: 他一直在追求我女儿，追了好久了。到现在为止，她一直很明智地不理他。我只是不知道她最近怎么了，居然会搭理他。

english: Well, love is mysterious!  Perhaps one day someone may even learn to love you!
translation: 嗯，爱情是神秘的！也许有一天，甚至有人会爱上你！

english: What!  Someone may fall in love with me...what are you trying to insinuate?
translation: 什么！有人会爱上我……你想暗示什么？

english: Err...Nothing....I guess I'd better be going now...
translation: 呃……没什么……我想我最好现在就走……

english: Oh...just looking around...
translation: 哦……只是随便看看……

english: Just looking around! This is MY house!  You might have at least 'ASKED' to view my considerably well appointed abode...but no, you've just burst in with all the elegance of a Troll at a tea party.
translation: 随便看看！这是我的房子！你至少该‘请求’参观我这座相当雅致的住所……但你没有，你就这么闯进来，像茶会上的巨魔一样优雅。

english: I can see that you're busy ranting so I'll just nip off and investigate a bit.
translation: 我看你忙着发牢骚，那我就先溜了，去调查一下。

english: Juliet, I come from Romeo.  He begs me to tell you that he cares still.
translation: 朱丽叶，我是从罗密欧那里来的。他恳求我告诉你，他仍然在乎你。

english: Oh how my heart soars to hear this news! Please take this message to him with great haste.
translation: 哦，听到这个消息，我的心都飞扬起来了！请尽快把这个消息带给他。

english: Well, I hope it's good news...he was quite upset when I left him.
translation: 嗯，希望是好消息……我离开他的时候他很难过。

english: He's quite often upset...the poor sensitive soul. But I don't think he's going to take this news very well, however, all is not lost.
translation: 他经常难过……这个可怜的敏感灵魂。但我觉得他听到这个消息不会太好受，不过，一切还没有结束。

english: Everything is explained in the letter, would you be so kind and deliver it to him please?
translation: 信里解释了一切，你能好心把它送给他吗？

english: Certainly, I'll do so straight away.
translation: 当然，我马上去。

english: Many thanks! Oh, I'm so very grateful. You may be our only hope.
translation: 非常感谢！哦，我太感激了。你可能就是我们唯一的希望。

english: Hello Juliet!
translation: 你好，朱丽叶！

english: Hello there...have you delivered the message to Romeo yet? What news do you have from my loved one?
translation: 你好……你把消息带给罗密欧了吗？从我心上人那里有什么消息？

english: Oh, sorry, I've not had chance to deliver it yet!
translation: 哦，抱歉，我还没机会送出去！

english: Oh, that's a shame. I've been waiting so patiently to hear some word from him.
translation: 哦，真可惜。我一直耐心地等着他的消息。

english: Hmmm, that's the thing about messages...they're so easy to misplace...
translation: 嗯，消息就是这样……很容易弄丢……

english: How could you lose that message? It was incredibly important...and it took me an age to write! I used joined up writing and everything!
translation: 你怎么能把那封信弄丢？它非常重要……而且我写了很久！我用了连笔字，什么都用上了！

english: Please, take this new message to him, and please don't lose it.
translation: 拜托，请把这封新消息带给他，千万别弄丢了。

english: Oh, hello. Juliet has told me what you're doing for her and Romeo, and I have to say I'm very grateful to you. Juliet deserves a bit of happiness in her life.
translation: 哦，你好。朱丽叶告诉我你为她与罗密欧做的事，我得说我非常感激你。朱丽叶值得在生活中得到一点幸福。

english: And I'm sure Romeo is just the sort of jester to make her laugh out loud - hysterically you might say.
translation: 而且我确信罗密欧正是那种能让她开怀大笑的小丑——可以说是歇斯底里地笑。

english: He always brings a tear to my eyes - tears of happiness at his foolish antics!
translation: 他总是让我热泪盈眶——为他那些愚蠢的滑稽动作流下幸福的眼泪！

english: Oh, thanks. I like to do my cupid bit.
translation: 哦，谢谢。我喜欢扮演我的丘比特角色。

english: What are you doing in my house? Up to no good I shouldn't wonder!
translation: 你在我家做什么？我猜准没好事！

english: Just a small chore for Juliet, you do have a lovely daughter in her sir.
translation: 只是帮朱丽叶办点小事，先生，您确实有个可爱的女儿。

english: Oh...why, thank you...I've always tried to my best...
translation: 哦……呃，谢谢你……我一直尽力做到最好……

english: ...Hang on! Enough of that smiley talk. I have a daughter and I know what she's like. Don't even think of carrying on anything behind my back, I have the eyes of a hawk, nothing gets past me!
translation: ……等等！少来这套甜言蜜语。我有女儿，我知道她什么样。别想在我背后搞什么名堂，我眼睛像鹰一样锐利，什么都瞒不过我！

english: Hey! What's that in your hands...looks like a message to me...with Juliet's barely legible scrawl on it...
translation: 嘿！你手里拿的是什么……看起来像是一封信……上面还有朱丽叶那几乎看不清的潦草字迹……

english: Yes, yes, that's probably why I can't read it!
translation: 是的是的，大概这就是为什么我看不懂！

english: Sorry, I mean, that's right sir. I'm just popping to the shops to get some groceries for Juliet.
translation: 抱歉，我是说，您说得对，先生。我只是去商店给朱丽叶买点杂货。

english: Right, have to be off now...thanks...
translation: 好了，我得走了……谢谢……

english: Groceries!
translation: 杂货！

english: Groceries!...at a time like this, does that girl know what she's putting me through!
translation: 杂货！……在这种时候，那丫头知不知道她在让我受什么罪！

english: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet!
translation: 罗密欧……好消息……我和朱丽叶联系上了！

english: Oh great! That is great news! Well done...well done... what a total success!
translation: 哦太好了！这真是好消息！干得好……干得好……太成功了！

english: Yes, and she gave me a message to give you...
translation: 是的，她还让我带个口信给你……

english: Ohhh great! A message....wow!
translation: 哦哦太好了！口信……哇！

english: A message...oh, I can't wait to read what my dear Juliet has to say....
translation: 口信……哦，我等不及要读我亲爱的朱丽叶要说的话了……

english: I know...it's exciting isn't it...?
translation: 我知道……很激动人心，对吧……？

english: Yes...yes...
translation: 是的……是的……

english: You've lost the message haven't you?
translation: 你把口信弄丢了，对吧？

english: Yep, haven't got a clue where it is.
translation: 对，完全不知道在哪儿。

english: Romeo...great news...I've been in touch with Juliet! She's written a message for you...
translation: 罗密欧……好消息……我和朱丽叶联系上了！她给你写了封信……

english: Oh, a message! A message! I've never had a message before...
translation: 哦，信！信！我以前从没收过信……

english: No, no, not one!
translation: 不，不，一封都没有！

english: Oh, well, except for the occasional court summons.
translation: 哦，好吧，除了偶尔的法院传票。

english: But they're not really 'nice' messages. Not like this one! I'm sure that this message will be lovely.
translation: 但那些不算是‘好’信。不像这封！我敢肯定这封信会很棒。

english: Well are you going to open it or not?
translation: 你到底打不打开？

english: Oh yes, yes, of course!  'Dearest Romeo, I am very pleased that you sent [player name] to look for me and to tell me that you still hold affliction...', Affliction! She thinks I'm diseased?
translation: 哦对对，当然！‘最亲爱的罗密欧，我很高兴你派[player name]来找我，并告诉我你仍怀有痛苦……’痛苦！她以为我有病？

english: 'Affection?'
translation: 是‘爱意’吧？

english: Ahh yes...'still hold affection for me. I still feel great affection for you, but unfortunately my Father opposes our marriage.'
translation: 啊对……‘仍怀有对我的爱意。我依然对你怀有深厚的感情，但不幸的是，我父亲反对我们的婚姻。’

english: Oh dear...that doesn't sound too good.
translation: 哦天哪……听起来不太妙。

english: What? '...great affection for you. Father opposes our..
translation: 什么？‘……对你的深厚感情。父亲反对我们的……’

english: '...marriage and will...
translation: ‘……婚姻，并且会……’

english: ...will kill you if he sees you again!'
translation: ‘……如果再见到你，他会杀了你！’

english: I have to be honest, it's not getting any better...
translation: 老实说，情况一点也没好转……

english: 'Our only hope is that Father Lawrence, our long time confidant, can help us in some way.'
translation: ‘我们唯一的希望是劳伦斯神父，我们长期的知己，也许能帮上忙。’

english: Well, that's it then...we haven't got a chance...
translation: 好吧，那就这样了……我们没机会了……

english: What about Father Lawrence?
translation: 那劳伦斯神父呢？

english: ...our love is over...the great romance, the life of my love...
translation: ……我们的爱情结束了……伟大的浪漫，我生命中的挚爱……

english: ...or you could speak to Father Lawrence!
translation: ……或者你可以去找劳伦斯神父谈谈！

english: Oh, my aching, breaking, heart...how useless the situation is now...we have no one to turn to...
translation: 哦，我疼痛欲碎的心……现在这情况多么无望……我们无人可求……

english: FATHER LAWRENCE!
translation: 劳伦斯神父！

english: Father Lawrence?
translation: 劳伦斯神父？

english: Oh yes, Father Lawrence...he's our long time confidant, he might have a solution! Yes, yes, you have to go and talk to Lather Fawrence for us and ask him if he's got any suggestions for our predicament?
translation: 哦对，劳伦斯神父……他是我们长期的知己，他可能有办法！对对，你得替我们去和劳伦斯神父谈谈，问问他有没有什么建议来解决我们的困境？

english: Where can I find Father Lawrence?
translation: 我在哪里能找到劳伦斯神父？

english: Lather Fawrence! Oh he's...
translation: 劳伦斯神父！哦他……

english: You know he's not my 'real' Father don't you?
translation: 你知道他不是我‘亲生’父亲吧？

english: I think I suspected that he wasn't.
translation: 我想我猜到他不是。

english: Well anyway...he tells these song, loring bermons...and keeps these here Carrockian vitizens snoring in his church to the East North.
translation: 总之……他讲这些冗长的布道，让教堂里东边北边的那些卡拉多克居民都打瞌睡。

english: Not so good my friend...I miss Judi..., Junie..., Joopie...
translation: 不太好，朋友……我想念朱迪……朱妮……朱皮……

english: Juliet?
translation: 朱丽叶？

english: Juliet! I miss Juliet, terribly!
translation: 朱丽叶！我非常想念朱丽叶！

english: Hmmm, so I see!
translation: 嗯，我看得出来！

english: Have you heard anything from Juliet?
translation: 你有朱丽叶的消息吗？

english: Sadly not my friend! And what's worse, her Father has threatened to kill me if he sees me. I mean, that seems a bit harsh!
translation: 很遗憾没有，朋友！更糟的是，她父亲威胁说再见到我就杀了我。我是说，这有点过分了吧！

english: Well, I shouldn't worry too much...you can always run away if you see him...
translation: 嗯，别太担心……你看到他可以跑嘛……

english: I just wish I could remember what he looks like! I live in fear of every man I see!
translation: 我只希望我能记得他长什么样！我活在恐惧中，看每个男人都像他！

english: Why are you waving that around at me as if it's something important?
translation: 你为什么在我面前挥舞那个东西，好像它很重要似的？

english: Hey again Romeo!
translation: 又见面了，罗密欧！

english: Hi Juliet, I have passed your message on to Romeo..he's scared half out of his wits at the news that your father wants to kill him.
translation: 嗨，朱丽叶，我已经把你的口信转达给罗密欧了……听到你父亲要杀他，他吓得半死。

english: Yes, unfortunately my father is quite the hunter, you may have seen some the animal head trophies on the wall. And it would be so awful to see Romeo's head up there with them!
translation: 是的，不幸的是我父亲是个猎手，你可能看到墙上那些动物头战利品了。要是看到罗密欧的头也挂在那里，那就太可怕了！

english: I know what you mean...
translation: 我懂你的意思……

english: ...his hair colour will clash terribly with the rest of the decoration.
translation: ……他的发色会和其余的装饰严重冲突。

english: That's not what I was suggesting at all...
translation: 我根本不是那个意思……

english: I know, I know...I was just kidding.
translation: 我知道，我知道……我只是开玩笑。

english: Anyway, don't worry because I'm on the case. I'm going to get some help from Father Lawrence.
translation: 总之，别担心，因为我已经在着手处理了。我要去找劳伦斯神父帮忙。

english: Oh yes, I'm sure that Father Lawrence will come up with a solution. I hope you find him soon.
translation: 哦对，我相信劳伦斯神父会想出办法的。希望你尽快找到他。

english: Do you live here? If so, how's about a couple of hundred gold towards the rent eh? Pay your share I say...you don't want to be like that freeloading Romeo!
translation: 你住这儿吗？如果是的话，拿个几百金币来付房租怎么样？我说你得付你那份……可别像那个白吃白喝的罗密欧！

english: ''...and let Saradomin light the way for you... '' Urgh!
translation: ‘……愿萨拉多明为你照亮前路……’呃！

english: Can't you see that I'm in the middle of a Sermon?!
translation: 你没看到我正在布道吗？！

english: But Romeo sent me!
translation: 但罗密欧派我来的！

english: But I'm busy delivering a sermon to my congregation!
translation: 但我正忙着向会众布道！

english: Zzzzzzzzz
translation: 呼噜噜噜噜

english: Yes, well, it certainly seems like you have a captive audience!
translation: 是啊，看来你确实有一群被俘的听众！

english: Ok, ok...what do you want so I can get rid of you and continue with my sermon?
translation: 好吧好吧……你想要什么，好让我打发你走，继续我的布道？

english: Romeo sent me. He says you may be able to help.
translation: 罗密欧派我来的。他说你也许能帮忙。

english: Ah Romeo, yes. A fine lad, but a little bit confused.
translation: 啊，罗密欧，是的。一个好小伙子，但有点糊涂。

english: Yes, very confused....Anyway, Romeo wishes to be married to Juliet! She must be rescued from her father's control!
translation: 是的，非常糊涂……总之，罗密欧想和朱丽叶结婚！必须把她从她父亲的控制下解救出来！

english: I agree, and I think I have an idea! A potion to make her appear dead...
translation: 我同意，而且我有个主意！一种让她看起来死掉的药水……

english: Dead! Sounds a bit creepy to me...but please, continue.
translation: 死掉！听起来有点吓人……但请继续说。

english: The potion will only make Juliet 'appear' dead...then she'll be taken to the crypt...
translation: 这药水只会让朱丽叶‘看起来’死了……然后她会被带到墓穴……

english: Crypt! Again...very creepy! You must have some strange hobbies.
translation: 墓穴！又来了……非常吓人！你一定有些奇怪的爱好。

english: Then Romeo can collect her from the crypt! Go to the Apothecary, tell him I sent you and that you'll need a 'Cadava' potion.
translation: 然后罗密欧可以从墓穴接走她！去找药剂师，告诉他是我派你来的，你需要一瓶‘卡达瓦药水’。

english: Apart from the strong overtones of death, this is turning out to be a real love story.
translation: 除了强烈的死亡气息外，这还真是一个真正的爱情故事。

english: Ah, have you found the Apothecary yet? Remember, Cadava potion, for Juliet.
translation: 啊，你找到药剂师了吗？记住，卡达瓦药水，给朱丽叶的。

english: Hello again Romeo!
translation: 又见面了，罗密欧！

english: Ooh did you manage to survive one of Lather Fawrences sermons? I bet not, you were ages! I bet you snoozed on the welcome mat just as soon as you heard his voice!
translation: 哦，你居然挺过了劳伦斯神父的一次布道？我打赌没有，你去了那么久！我敢说你一听到他的声音就在门垫上睡着了！

english: Did not!
translation: 才没有！

english: Oh, come on, come on, what did he say?
translation: 哦，得了得了，他说了什么？

english: He wants me to go to the Apothecary!
translation: 他让我去找药剂师！

english: The Apothecary?
translation: 药剂师？

english: Oh...is he the one who mixes up all them magical potion- ey things?
translation: 哦……就是那个调配各种神奇药水之类东西的人？

english: Yeah, I think so...but the word potion-ey doesn't exist.
translation: 嗯，我想是的……但‘药水之类’这个词不存在。

english: Well, you just used it...so I guess it does exist!
translation: 好吧，你刚才用了……所以我觉得它存在！

english: It doesn't matter...do you know where the Apothecary is?
translation: 没关系……你知道药剂师在哪儿吗？

english: Why should I tell you?
translation: 我为什么要告诉你？

english: Because I'm doing you a favour!
translation: 因为我在帮你忙！

english: Right, yes...of course! Well, I think the potion-ey place is Wouth Sest of here and near a sword shop.
translation: 对，没错……当然！嗯，我觉得那个做药水的地方在维洛克城西南边，靠近一家剑店。

english: He seems very keen for you to marry Juliet.
translation: 他似乎非常希望你娶朱丽叶。

english: Me too! I can't wait! Do you think it will be soon?
translation: 我也是！我等不及了！你觉得会很快吗？

english: I don't know, but I'll do what I can. It just seems a bit odd that Father Lawrence is so keen for you to marry?
translation: 我不知道，但我会尽力而为。只是劳伦斯神父这么急着让你结婚，有点奇怪？

english: I can't imagine why he's so keen? Though, he was our messenger before you. Of course, he had a lot more hair back then...and I think we may have gone to school together...
translation: 我想不通他为什么这么热心？不过，在你之前他是我们的信使。当然，那时候他头发多得多……而且我觉得我们可能一起上过学……

english: What, since you were kids?
translation: 什么，从你们小时候就认识了？

english: Yeah! Thinking about it now, we called him 'Diddy Dorrence' back then!
translation: 是啊！现在想想，我们那时候叫他‘小多伦斯’！

english: So, maybe, he just wants a bit of peace? And when you two are married, he won't have to traipse around delivering your messages anymore?
translation: 所以，也许他只是想要点安宁？等你们俩结婚了，他就不用再跑来跑去送信了？

english: Yes, the years haven't been good to him.
translation: 是啊，岁月对他不饶人。

english: Hi Juliet, I've found Father Lawrence and he has a cunning plan. But for it to work, I need to seek the Apothecary!
translation: 嗨，朱丽叶，我找到劳伦斯神父了，他有个妙计。但要实现它，我得去找药剂师！

english: Oh good! I knew Father Lawrence would come up with something. However, I don't know where the apothecary is...I hope you find him soon. My father's temper gets no better.
translation: 哦，太好了！我就知道劳伦斯神父会有办法。不过，我不知道药剂师在哪儿……希望你尽快找到他。我父亲的脾气越来越差了。

english: Apothecary, Father Lawrence sent me. I need a Cadava potion to help Romeo and Juliet.
translation: 药剂师，是劳伦斯神父派我来的。我需要一份卡达瓦药水来帮助罗密欧和朱丽叶。

english: Cadava potion. It's pretty nasty. And hard to make.
translation: 卡达瓦药水。这东西挺恶心的，而且很难做。

english: Wing of rat, tail of frog. Ear of snake and horn of dog.
translation: 老鼠翅膀，青蛙尾巴。蛇耳朵，狗号角。

english: I have all that, but I need some Cadava berries.
translation: 这些我都有，但我还需要一些卡达瓦莓。

english: You will have to find them while I get the rest ready. Bring them here when you have them. But be careful. They are nasty.
translation: 你得去找它们，我先把其他东西准备好。找到了就带过来。但要小心，它们很危险。

english: Conveniently, I have some here.
translation: 巧了，我这里就有一些。

english: Phew! Here is what you need.
translation: 呼！这就是你要的东西。

english: What do these berries look like?
translation: 这些浆果长什么样？

english: They're a nice bright pink colour, with green leaves, stalks are a pale brown colour...you can't miss them. They look pretty tasty, but I wouldn't advise eating them.
translation: 它们是漂亮的亮粉色，带着绿叶，茎是浅棕色的……你不会认错的。看起来很好吃，但我不建议你吃。

english: Where can I get these berries?
translation: 我在哪里能找到这些浆果？

english: I think I saw some recently in the local vicinity. Oh yes, that's right! There was a little bit of commotion when some kids visited the south eastern Varrock mining pit. The trip was disrupted because some kids
translation: 我记得最近在附近见过一些。哦，对了！有几个小孩去了维洛克城东南的采矿坑，闹了点小乱子。那次出行被打断了，因为有些小孩

english: had found some cadavaberry bushes and they started picking them. They wrapped that trip up pretty quickly!
translation: 发现了一些卡达瓦莓灌木丛，开始采摘。那次出行很快就结束了！

english: How are these berries dangerous?
translation: 这些浆果有什么危险？

english: Hmm, they're generally okay, but if handled improperly they can be a bit nasty. And I certainly wouldn't advise drinking the potion!
translation: 嗯，一般来说还好，但如果处理不当，可能会有点麻烦。而且我绝对不建议喝那药水！

english: Keep searching for those Cadavaberries. They're needed for the potion.
translation: 继续找那些卡达瓦莓吧。做药水需要它们。

english: Well done. You have the berries.
translation: 干得好。你拿到浆果了。

english: Thank you for the Cadava potion.
translation: 谢谢你的卡达瓦药水。

english: You're welcome. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: 不客气。希望它能帮助那对年轻情侣找到幸福。

english: I gave Juliet the Cadava potion.
translation: 我把卡达瓦药水给了朱丽叶。

english: Good, good. I hope it helps that young couple find happiness.
translation: 好，好。希望它能帮助那对年轻情侣找到幸福。

english: Urk!
translation: 呃！

english: Blimey... you've been out for hours! Are you ok? People were tripping over you as they walked into the shop.
translation: 天哪……你昏迷了好几个小时！你没事吧？人们走进店里的时候都被你绊倒了。

english: Did you find the Apothecary?
translation: 你找到药剂师了吗？

english: Yes I did. He's told me I must find some Cadava berries.
translation: 找到了。他告诉我必须找到一些卡达瓦莓。

english: Well, good luck with that...they're quite tricky to find.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运……那些东西很难找。

english: Any clues where I can start to look?
translation: 有什么线索能告诉我从哪里开始找吗？

english: I heard some kids saying they saw some the other day. They were visiting the mining place to the south east of Varrock.
translation: 我听说几个小孩前几天看到了一些。他们去了维洛克城东南的采矿场。

english: Ok, that's as good a place to start looking as any.
translation: 好吧，那是个不错的起点。

english: I've got the cadava potion.
translation: 我拿到卡达瓦药水了。

english: Good! Good work! Ok, take it to Juliet, she's expecting you. I'll talk to Romeo and make sure he knows what to do.
translation: 好！干得好！好了，拿去给朱丽叶吧，她在等你。我去跟罗密欧说，确保他知道该怎么做。

english: Hi Romeo!
translation: 嗨，罗密欧！

english: Oh hello, have you seen Lather Fawrence?
translation: 哦，你好，你见到劳伦斯神父了吗？

english: Yes, he's given me details of a potion which should help resolve this situation. The Apothecary is helping me prepare it.
translation: 见到了，他告诉了我一种药水的细节，应该能解决这个局面。药剂师正在帮我准备。

english: Ooooh, it all sounds horribly complicated?
translation: 哦哦，听起来好复杂？

english: All I can say is I'll be glad when Juliet's finally in that crypt!
translation: 我只能说，等朱丽叶终于进了那个墓穴，我就高兴了。

english: Spoken like a true lover!
translation: 说得真像个痴情郎！

english: Ooohh, that's the potion is it? Rather you than me!
translation: 哦哦，那就是药水吗？还是你来喝吧！

english: I'm not drinking it! It's for Juliet!
translation: 我才不喝！那是给朱丽叶的！

english: Well, I mean...it's probably delicious...and not dangerous at all. And you quite often see harmless drinks in a glowing sort of pink colour.
translation: 嗯，我是说……它可能很好喝……而且一点也不危险。你经常能看到无害的饮料是那种发光的粉色。

english: Hmm, I'm not convinced...maybe you ought to try some before I give it to Juliet?
translation: 嗯，我不信……也许你该先尝一点，再给朱丽叶？

english: Urgh! No way!  Not in a million years!
translation: 呃！才不要！打死也不！

english: Ok...but you know what to do when I've given this to Juliet?
translation: 好吧……但你知道我把这个给朱丽叶之后该怎么做吗？

english: Oh, yeah...sure Lather Fawrence explained all that to me...
translation: 哦，是啊……当然，劳伦斯神父都跟我解释过了……

english: Hey ,what are you doing here?
translation: 嘿，你在这儿干什么？

english: Nothing much sir...I promise...I'm just an innocent friend of Juliet's...doing her a few favours...as a friend.
translation: 没什么，先生……我保证……我只是朱丽叶的一个无辜朋友……帮她做点小事……作为朋友。

english: Well, just make sure there's no funny business going on that's all I can say. Do you know why?
translation: 嗯，我只能说，别搞什么鬼把戏。你知道为什么吗？

english: I think I can guess sir...
translation: 我想我能猜到，先生……

english: There's no need to guess! You can see it in my hawk like eyes, in my cat like ears and my dog like nose...
translation: 不用猜！你从我鹰一样的眼睛、猫一样的耳朵和狗一样的鼻子里就能看出来……

english: Are you saying that you look like an animal sir?
translation: 您是说您看起来像动物吗，先生？

english: NO! Not look like an animal! I have the keen 'SENSES' of an animal and I don't miss a thing. Don't even think about trying anything!
translation: 不！不是看起来像动物！我有动物般敏锐的‘感官’，什么都不会错过。想都别想耍花招！

english: Hey!  What's that in your hands? Looks like some sort of potion to me!
translation: 嘿！你手里拿的是什么？看起来像某种药水！

english: Err...no! Nope! Not a potion!  Some medicine...I have a terrible cough  ...cough...cough....see?
translation: 呃……不！不是！不是药水！是药……我咳嗽得厉害……咳……咳……看到了吧？

english: >Except, I can't drink too much or else it makes me feel 'really' tired. One sip of this and the lights go out...I mean, I'm asleep in a minute.
translation: 只不过，我不能喝太多，否则会让我‘真的’很困。喝一小口就灯灭人睡……我是说，一分钟内就睡着了。

english: Sleep!
translation: 睡觉！

english: Sleep...! How can you even think of such a thing at a time like this? And I hope you have no intentions of sleeping in my house!
translation: 睡觉……！这种时候你怎么还能想到这种事？我希望你没打算在我家睡觉！

english: You'll get a bill for rent if I catch you dozing off around here!
translation: 要是让我逮到你在这儿打瞌睡，我就收你房租！

english: Hi Juliet!
translation: 嗨，朱丽叶！

english: Hi [player name], how close am I to being with my true love Romeo?
translation: 嗨，[player name]，我离和真爱罗密欧在一起还有多远？

english: Sorry, I still have to get a special potion for you.
translation: 抱歉，我还得去给你弄一份特殊的药水。

english: Oh, I hope it isn't a love potion because you would be wasting your time. My love for Romeo grows stronger every minute...
translation: 哦，我希望不是爱情药水，因为那是在浪费时间。我对罗密欧的爱每分每秒都在增长……

english: That must be because you're not with him...
translation: 那一定是因为你没和他在一起……

english: Oh no! I long to be close to my true love Romeo!
translation: 哦不！我渴望靠近我的真爱罗密欧！

english: Well, ok then...I'll set about getting this potion as quickly as I can!
translation: 好吧，那……我会尽快去弄到这份药水！

english: Fair luck to you, the end is close.
translation: 祝你好运，结局近了。

english: Hi Juliet! I have an interesting proposition for you...suggested by Father Lawrence. It may be the only way you'll be able to escape from this house and be with Romeo.
translation: 嗨，朱丽叶！我有个有趣的提议……是劳伦斯神父建议的。这可能是你逃离这所房子、和罗密欧在一起的唯一办法。

english: Go on....
translation: 继续说……

english: I have a Cadava potion here, suggested by Father Lawrence. If you drink it, it will make you appear dead!
translation: 我这里有一瓶卡达瓦药水，是劳伦斯神父建议的。如果你喝下去，会让你看起来像死了一样！

english: And when you appear dead...your still and lifeless corpse will be removed to the crypt!
translation: 等你看起来死了……你静止不动的尸体就会被搬到墓穴里去！

english: Oooooh, a cold dark creepy crypt...
translation: 哦哦，一个又冷又黑又恐怖的墓穴……

english: ...sounds just peachy!
translation: ……听起来真不错！

english: Then...Romeo can steal into the crypt and rescue you just as you wake up!
translation: 然后……罗密欧可以偷偷溜进墓穴，在你醒来时救你！

english: ...and this is the great idea for getting me out of here?
translation: ……这就是让我离开这里的好主意？

english: To be fair, I can't take all the credit...in fact...it was all Father Lawrence's suggestion...
translation: 公平地说，我不能居功……实际上……全是劳伦斯神父的主意……

english: Ok...if this is the best we can do...hand over the potion!
translation: 好吧……如果这是最好的办法……把药水给我！

english: Please go to Romeo and make sure he understands. Although I love his gormless, lovelorn soppy ways, he can be a bit dense sometimes and I don't want to wake up in that crypt on my own.
translation: 请去找罗密欧，确保他明白。虽然我喜欢他那傻乎乎、痴情又软弱的模样，但他有时候有点迟钝，我可不想一个人在那墓穴里醒来。

english: Oh, here's Phillipa, my cousin...she's in on the plot too!
translation: 哦，这是我的表妹菲利普，她也参与了计划！

english: She's going to make it seem even more convincing!
translation: 她会让它看起来更逼真！

english: Yes, I'm quite the actress! Good luck dear cousin!
translation: 是的，我可是个好演员！祝你好运，亲爱的表姐！

english: Right...bottoms up!
translation: 好了……干杯！

english: Oh no...Juliet has...died!
translation: 哦不……朱丽叶……死了！

english: You might be more believable if you're not smiling when you say it...
translation: 如果你说的时候不笑，可能会更可信……

english: Oh yeah...you might be right...ok, let's try again.
translation: 哦对……你说得对……好吧，再试一次。

english: Oh no...Juliet has...died?
translation: 哦不……朱丽叶……死了？

english: Perhaps a bit louder, like you're upset...that your cousin has died!
translation: 也许再大声点，像你很难过……你的表姐死了！

english: Right...yes...Ok, ok, I think I'm getting my motivation now. Ok, let's try this again!
translation: 好……是的……好吧，好吧，我想我找到感觉了。好了，再来一次！

english: OH NO...JULIET HAS...DIED?.... Oooooohhhhhh....(sob), (sob).Juliet...my poor dead cousin!
translation: 哦不……朱丽叶……死了？……呜呜呜……（抽泣），（抽泣）。朱丽叶……我可怜的死去表姐！

english: What's all that screaming?
translation: 什么叫声这么吵？

english: Oh no! My poor daughter...what has become of you?
translation: 哦不！我可怜的女儿……你怎么了？

english: Poor Juliet...make preparations for her body to be placed in the Crypt...
translation: 可怜的朱丽叶……准备把她的遗体放进墓穴……

english: Oh, hello again! How was I - do you think I was convincing?
translation: 哦，又见面了！我表现得怎么样——你觉得有说服力吗？

english: Oh, yes, totally!
translation: 哦，当然，绝对有！

english: Ohhh good! I do hope Juliet will be pleased as well! That dashing young Romeo must be beside himself with excitement! Have you told him the good news yet?
translation: 哦，太好了！我也希望朱丽叶能满意！那位英俊的罗密欧一定兴奋得不得了！你把好消息告诉他了吗？

english: Not yet, but soon!
translation: 还没有，但快了！

english: Good, good - you lucky thing, I can't wait to see the look on his face!
translation: 好，好——你真幸运，我等不及要看他脸上的表情了！

english: My poor Juliet....she's dead...dead! I shouldn't have been so hard on her...she was my lovely daughter. Booo hoooo hooooo!
translation: 我可怜的朱丽叶……她死了……死了！我不该对她那么严厉……她是我可爱的女儿。呜呜呜……

english: Hey , what are you doing here?
translation: 嘿，你在这儿干嘛？

english: Do you live here? If so, how's about a couple of hundred gold towards the rent eh? Pay your share I say...you don't want to be a freeloader like Romeo!
translation: 你住这儿吗？如果是的话，拿个几百金币来付房租怎么样？我说，你也该付你那份了……你总不想像罗密欧那样白吃白住吧！

english: Romeo, it's all set. Juliet has drunk the potion and has been taken down into the Crypt...now you just need to pop along and collect her.
translation: 罗密欧，都安排好了。朱丽叶喝了药水，被带进了墓穴……你现在只需要过去把她接走。

english: Ah right, the potion! Great...
translation: 啊，对，药水！太好了……

english: What potion would that be then?
translation: 那是什么药水？

english: The Cadava potion...you know, the one which will make her appear dead! She's in the crypt, pop along and claim your true love.
translation: 卡达瓦药水……你知道的，就是让她看起来像死了一样！她在墓穴里，快去找你的真爱吧。

english: But I'm scared...will you come with me?
translation: 但我害怕……你能跟我一起去吗？

english: Oh, ok...come on! I think I saw the entrance when I visited there last...
translation: 哦，好吧……来吧！我记得上次去的时候看到过入口……

english: This is pretty scary...
translation: 这还挺吓人的……

english: Oh, be quiet...
translation: 哦，闭嘴……

english: We're here. Look, Juliet is over there!
translation: 我们到了。看，朱丽叶就在那边！

english: You go over to her...and I'll go and wait over here...
translation: 你过去找她……我到这边等着……

english: Ohhh, ok then...
translation: 哦，好吧……

english: Hey...Juliet...
translation: 嘿……朱丽叶……

english: Juliet....?
translation: 朱丽叶……？

english: Oh dear...you seem to be dead.
translation: 哦，天哪……你好像死了。

english: Hi Romeo...I'm Phillipa!
translation: 嗨，罗密欧……我是菲利普！

english: Wow! You're a fox!
translation: 哇！你真是个美人！

english: It's a shame about Juliet...but perhaps we can meet up later?
translation: 朱丽叶的事真遗憾……不过也许我们晚点可以见面？

english: OH NO...JULIET HAS...DIED?.... Ooooooohhhhhhh.....(sob).Juliet...my poor dead cousin!
translation: 哦不……朱丽叶她……死了？……呜呜呜……（抽泣）。朱丽叶……我可怜的堂妹啊！

english: Hi, I'm Phillipa! Juliet's cousin? I like to keep an eye on her, make sure that dashing young Romeo doesn't just steal away from here under our plain old noses!
translation: 嗨，我是菲利普！朱丽叶的堂姐？我喜欢看着她，确保那个英俊的罗密欧不会在我们眼皮底下把她偷偷拐走！

english: He'd do it you know... he's ever so dashing, and cavalier, in a wet blanket sort of way.
translation: 你知道他干得出来……他非常英俊潇洒，虽然有点扫兴，但还挺有骑士风度的。

english: Oh, hello again! How was I... do you think I was convincing?
translation: 哦，又见面了！我刚才表现得怎么样……你觉得我够逼真吗？

english: Good, good... you lucky thing, I can't wait to see the look on his face!
translation: 好，好……你这幸运的家伙，我都等不及想看他脸上的表情了！

english: Hello, I seem to be getting on really well with that dashing lovely dovely, Romeo... Pity about poor Juliet... she missed out there I reckon!
translation: 你好，我好像和那个英俊可爱的罗密欧相处得非常好……可惜了可怜的朱丽叶……我觉得她错过了机会！

english: Oh, hello... Juliet has told me what you're doing for her and Romeo and I have to say, I'm very grateful to you. Juliet deserves a bit of happiness in her life.
translation: 哦，你好……朱丽叶告诉我你为她和她和罗密欧做的事，我得说，我非常感激你。朱丽叶值得在生活中得到一点幸福。

english: And I'm sure Romeo is just the sort of jester to make her laugh out loud... hysterically you might say. He always brings a tear to my eyes... tears of happiness at his foolish antics!
translation: 而且我相信罗密欧就是那种能让她开怀大笑的小丑……可以说是歇斯底里地笑。他总是让我热泪盈眶……被他愚蠢的滑稽动作感动得流下幸福的眼泪！

english: Well, that's a good question! Who knows where his head's at most of the time... in the clouds most likely!
translation: 嗯，问得好！谁知道他大部分时间脑子里在想什么……多半是在云里雾里吧！

english: But he's probably chasing the ladies who frequent Varrock market. He does like a bit of kiss chase so I've heard!
translation: 但他可能正在维洛克城市场里追姑娘呢。我听说他挺喜欢玩亲亲追逐游戏的！

english: Who's Juliet?
translation: 谁是朱丽叶？

english: You, you're the human that killed Tyras. Arianwyn told us about you.
translation: 你，你就是那个杀了泰拉斯的人类。阿里安温跟我们提过你。

english: That's me. Could you take me to Arianwyn?
translation: 正是我。你能带我去找阿里安温吗？

english: Why should we? All you human do is take and destroy with no care for others. We don't need your help. You've done enough damage.
translation: 我们凭什么？你们人类只会索取和破坏，从不关心他人。我们不需要你的帮助。你已经造成够多破坏了。

english: Well I admit that I've made a few mistakes, but my intentions were good, I swear.
translation: 好吧，我承认我犯了一些错误，但我的初衷是好的，我发誓。

english: Maybe, but it's not a risk worth taking. It was the acts of humans that led my grantmother's death. You will bring similar ruin to us.
translation: 也许吧，但这不值得冒险。正是人类的行为导致了我祖母的死亡。你也会给我们带来同样的灾难。

english: Your grandmother?
translation: 你的祖母？

english: Glarial, wife to King Baxtorian. At one time my grandparents ruled over a great elven kingdom. But your kind put an end to that.
translation: 格拉利尔，巴克斯托里安国王的妻子。曾几何时，我的祖父母统治着一个伟大的精灵王国。但你们这类人终结了这一切。

english: Glarial? I know that name, I visited her tomb. I moved her remians to Baxtorian Falls, I thought that was where she would want to be.
translation: 格拉利尔？我知道这个名字，我去过她的墓。我把她的遗骸移到了巴克斯托里安瀑布，我以为那是她想去的地方。

english: You... you moved her into the waterfall? That... that's the perfect place for her to be.
translation: 你……你把她移到了瀑布里？那……那真是她最完美的安息之处。

english: Maybe this human isn't as bad as you think Islwyn
translation: 也许这个人类没你想的那么坏，伊斯尔温

english: Maybe... Very well human, we will take you to Arianwyn. But first, there is something you must do. If my grandmother has been moved, then her new tomb must be consecrated. Do this, and you will earn my trust.
translation: 也许吧……好吧，人类，我们会带你去见阿里安温。但首先，你有一件事要做。既然我祖母已被移动，她的新墓必须被祝圣。做到了，你就能赢得我的信任。

english: Deal, what do I need to do?
translation: 成交，我需要做什么？

english: I don't know the consecration process myself. You should speak to Eluned. She is wise in the ways of the ritual.
translation: 我自己也不知道祝圣的流程。你应该去找埃卢内德谈谈。她对仪式之道了如指掌。

english: If you wish to see Arianwyn, this is the only way. Come find us if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你想见阿里安温，这是唯一的办法。如果你改变主意了，来找我们。

english: So what do you need to do?
translation: 那么你需要做什么？

english: Hey there, Islwyn said you might be able to help me. He told me you'd know how to consecrate ground for an elven burrial. I need to consecrate Glarial's new resting place.
translation: 嘿，伊斯尔温说你可能能帮我。他告诉我你知道如何为精灵葬礼祝圣土地。我需要祝圣格拉利尔的新安息之地。

english: That I do... It is also elvish tradition to plant a specially enchanted crystal seed at the graves of our ancestors. The seed will create guardians to protect the area. Unfortunately the crystal seed must be tuned to the person it's protecting... a new seed won't do. But you should be able to recover the seed from her old tomb. I'm not very familiar with the lands to the east so I couldn't tell you where her old tomb is I'm afraid.
translation: 我确实知道……按精灵传统，还要在祖先的墓旁种下一颗特殊附魔的水晶种子。种子会创造守护者来保护该区域。不幸的是，水晶种子必须调谐到它保护的人……新种子不行。但你应该能从她的旧墓里找回那颗种子。我对东边的土地不太熟悉，所以恐怕无法告诉你她的旧墓在哪里。

english: That's okay, I've been there before. It's just south east of Baxtorian Falls.
translation: 没关系，我之前去过那里。就在巴克斯托里安瀑布的东南方。

english: Excellent. Now, the tomb's guardians will be protecting the seed, you'll need to defeat one of them to get it. Once you have it, return to me and I will re-enchant it.
translation: 太好了。现在，墓的守护者会保护那颗种子，你需要击败其中一个才能拿到。拿到后就回来找我，我会重新附魔它。

english: Okay, I'll be back as soon as I have it.
translation: 好的，我一拿到就回来。

english: Hello, any luck finding the consecration seed?
translation: 你好，找到祝圣种子了吗？

english: You should be able to find it in her old resting place, I think you said it was south east of Baxtorian Falls. You'll need to defeat one of the old tomb's guardians to obtain it. Bring it to me as soon as you find it, then I can re-enchant it.
translation: 你应该能在她的旧安息之处找到它，我记得你说过是在巴克斯托里安瀑布的东南方。你需要击败一个旧墓的守护者才能拿到。找到后就立刻带给我，我就能重新附魔它。

english: Good day. Have you spoken to Eluned yet?
translation: 你好。你跟埃卢内德谈过了吗？

english: Yes, she told me to retrieve a crystal seed from Glarial's old tomb.
translation: 是的，她让我从格拉利尔的旧墓里取回一颗水晶种子。

english: Well I wish I could help but my kind have no place in the east any more.
translation: 嗯，我希望我能帮忙，但我们族人在东方已经没有立足之地了。

english: Yes, she told me to retrieve a crystal seed from Glarial's old tomb. I have it right here.
translation: 是的，她让我从格拉利尔的旧墓里取回一颗水晶种子。我就在这儿拿到了。

english: Good, you should go and show it to her.
translation: 很好，你应该去把它拿给她看。

english: How odd. I can see her lips moving... But there's no sound.
translation: 真奇怪。我能看到她的嘴唇在动……但一点声音都没有。

english: Plant this seed in Glarial's new tomb, close to her remains. With it in place, she will rest in peace.
translation: 把这颗种子种在格拉利尔的新墓里，靠近她的遗骸。种子到位后，她就能安息了。

english: Hello, I lost the crystal seed.
translation: 你好，我把水晶种子弄丢了。

english: Not to worry, now I know the harmonic of Glarial's crystal, I can reproduce another one.
translation: 别担心，既然我知道格拉利尔水晶的谐律，我就能再制作一颗。

english: Hey, How's it going? Have you managed to reconsecrate Glarial's resting place?
translation: 嘿，怎么样了？你成功重新祝圣格拉利尔的安息之地了吗？

english: Well when you're ready, plant the seed in Glarial's new tomb, close to her remains. With it in place, she will rest in peace.
translation: 那么等你准备好了，就把种子种在格拉利尔的新墓里，靠近她的遗骸。种子到位后，她就能安息。

english: Good day. I hear you managed to retrieve the crystal seed.
translation: 你好。我听说你成功取回了水晶种子。

english: Indeed I did, all I need to do now is plant it in her new resting place.
translation: 确实如此，我现在只需要把它种在她的新安息之地。

english: This is good to hear. It put me at ease to know she is in my grandfather's home. I will rest even easier once it has been consecrated.
translation: 这太好了。知道她在我祖父的故乡，我就放心了。一旦祝圣完成，我就更安心了。

english: Well done. You should let Islwyn know.
translation: 做得好。你应该去告诉伊斯尔温。

english: Hello Islwyn..
translation: 你好，伊斯尔温……

english: You have returned! Is it done?
translation: 你回来了！完成了吗？

english: It is, your grandmother's resting place has been consecrated.
translation: 完成了，你祖母的安息之地已经祝圣了。

english: Thank you, I admit I was wrong about you. You have showed care and compassion that I didn't think possible for a human. As promised, we will take you to Arianwyn. But first, a reward for you.
translation: 谢谢你，我承认我之前错看你了。你展现出了我以为人类不可能有的关怀和同情。按约定，我们会带你去见阿里安温。但首先，这是给你的奖励。

english: We elves use equipment formed out of crystal itself, far superior to your human weapons. However, the crystal does degrade with use and will eventually revert to seed. Both the shield and bow I am carrying have been used, so are not at their full potential. They should still be quite useful though.
translation: 我们精灵使用由水晶本身形成的装备，远比你们人类的武器优越。然而，水晶会随着使用而退化，最终变回种子。我携带的盾和弓都用过了，所以不在最佳状态。但它们应该还是相当有用的。

english: Fascinating. What do you mean by 'revert to seed'?
translation: 真神奇。你说的'变回种子'是什么意思？

english: All elven crystal starts as a seed. It can then be sung into various shapes through the power of the voice. Eventually, it reverts back to seed, ready for the next song. Keep an eye out for an elf named Ilfeen as you wander the forest. She can chant crystal seeds into new items for you.
translation: 所有精灵水晶最初都是一颗种子。然后可以通过声音的力量吟唱成各种形状。最终，它会变回种子，为下一次吟唱做准备。在森林里闲逛时留意一个名叫伊尔芬的精灵。她能为你将水晶种子吟唱成新的物品。

english: I will, thanks.
translation: 我会的，谢谢。

english: Anyway, I'm sure you will learn more about crystal seeds as you spend time with our kind. For now though, which one of these creations would you like?
translation: 总之，我相信你与我们族人多相处就会了解更多关于水晶种子的事。不过现在，你想要这些造物中的哪一个？

english: Shields are for wimps! Give me the bow!
translation: 盾牌是给懦夫用的！把弓给我！

english: I don't like running and hiding behind mushrooms. Shield please!
translation: 我不喜欢跑着躲到蘑菇后面。请给我盾！

english: I need some time to decide.
translation: 我需要一些时间来决定。

english: Very well. Come find me when you are ready.
translation: 很好。准备好了就来找我。

english: Now, let us know when you are ready to be taken to Arianwyn.
translation: 现在，当你准备好被带去见阿里安温时，告诉我们。

english: Hi, I hear you finished consecrating Glarial's tomb. Well done.
translation: 嗨，我听说你完成了格拉利尔墓的祝圣。做得好。

english: It was a worthy deed.
translation: 那是一桩善举。

english: Indeed it was. Anyway, are you ready to be taken to Arianwyn?
translation: 确实如此。总之，你准备好被带去见阿里安温了吗？

english: Hello again
translation: 又见面了

english: Hello there. Are you ready to be taken to Arianwyn?
translation: 你好。你准备好被带去见阿里安温了吗？

english: Sorry friend, but I don't actually think you are.
translation: 抱歉朋友，但我觉得你其实还没准备好。

english: Very well. Arianwyn will be in Lletya, Eluned can take you there.
translation: 好吧。阿里安温会在莱蒂亚村，埃卢内德可以带你去那里。

english: Actually, I wanted to talk about crystal equipment.
translation: 其实，我想谈谈水晶装备。

english: Well sorry, but you don't have space to hold it.
translation: 嗯，抱歉，你没有空间来拿它。

english: Good hunting.
translation: 狩猎愉快。

english: Your prices are outrageously expensive! Do I look like a banker to you?
translation: 你的价格贵得离谱！我看上去像银行职员吗？

english: Sorry but they are very expensive to make. But it's your decision.
translation: 抱歉，但制作它们非常昂贵。不过决定权在你。

english: But that's more expensive than a dwarf multicannon!
translation: 但那比矮人大炮还贵！

english: Sloppy bearded mechanics wouldn't know decent craftsmanship if it bit them on the ankle! Besides, they are far too bulky.
translation: 那些邋遢的胡子机械师，就算被咬到脚踝也不会懂得什么是体面的工艺！再说了，它们太笨重了。

english: Which - the dwarf or the cannon?
translation: 哪个——矮人还是大炮？

english: Erm, are you trying to be funny?
translation: 呃，你在开玩笑吗？

english: Sadly sarcasm is lost on these elves. Oh well.
translation: 可惜这些精灵听不懂讽刺。唉，算了。

english: Looking after yourself.
translation: 保重。

english: Ilfeen can chant them into new items for you. She'll be wandering the forest somewhere.
translation: 伊尔芬能将它们吟唱成新物品给你。她会在森林的某个地方游荡。

english: No problem. Let us know when you are ready to be taken to Arianwyn.
translation: 没问题。当你准备好被带去见阿里安温时告诉我们。

english: Fair enough. Let us know when you are ready to be taken to Arianwyn.
translation: 有道理。当你准备好被带去见阿里安温时告诉我们。

english: Your Majesty.
translation: 陛下。

english: That fool Sigrid! What does she think she's doing?
translation: 那个蠢货西格里德！她以为自己是在干什么？

english: Excuse me, your Majesty?
translation: 恕我直言，陛下？

english: Ah, [Fremennik name]. I apologise, but I'm rather busy at the moment.
translation: 啊，[Fremennik name]。抱歉，我现在很忙。

english: What's going on, your Majesty?
translation: 发生什么事了，陛下？

english: I'm busy, [Fremennik name]. You'd better talk to Ghrim.
translation: 我很忙，[Fremennik name]。你最好去找格里姆谈。

english: Very well, I'll sort it out.
translation: 好吧，我来处理。

english: I suggest you talk to the prince and princess to find out more about the situation.
translation: 我建议你先去跟王子和公主谈谈，了解一下情况。

english: Princess Astrid has been asking after you. She would very much like to see you once again.
translation: 阿斯特丽德公主一直在找你。她非常想再见你一面。

english: Prince Brand has been asking after you. He would very much like to see you once again.
translation: 布兰德王子一直在找你。他非常想再见你一面。

english: I'm sorry, [Fremennik name], but I'm very busy. Talk to my son and daughter if Ghrim can't help you.
translation: 抱歉，[Fremennik name]，但我真的很忙。如果格里姆帮不了你，就去找我的儿子和女儿吧。

english: Talking to the Prince and Princess, Your Royal Highness. I believe they have something to ask you.
translation: 我在跟王子和公主谈话，陛下。我想他们有事要问您。

english: Good day, your Highness.
translation: 日安，殿下。

english: Good day, [Fremennik name]. Have you come to see my sister?
translation: 日安，[Fremennik name]。你是来看我妹妹的吗？

english: Yes, Advisor Ghrim said I should talk to both of you about recent events in the kingdom.
translation: 是的，顾问格里姆说我应该跟你们俩谈谈王国最近发生的事。

english: Hello, dear.
translation: 你好，亲爱的。

english: Welcome back, dear!
translation: 欢迎回来，亲爱的！

english: I'm afraid I haven't managed to find a priest for our marriage yet.
translation: 恐怕我还没找到能为我们的婚礼主持的祭司。

english: That's a pity.
translation: 真可惜。

english: Oh, Advisor Ghrim said I should talk to you and the Princess about recent events in the kingdom.
translation: 哦，顾问格里姆说我应该跟你和公主谈谈王国最近发生的事。

english: I'll ask Father if he minds us discussing this in the throne room for a while.
translation: 我去问问父亲，介不介意我们在王座室讨论一会儿。

english: Advisor Ghrim told me to talk to you about the situation in Miscellania.
translation: 顾问格里姆让我跟你谈谈米斯凯尼亚的局势。

english: What has happened while I've been away?
translation: 我不在的时候发生了什么？

english: It's terrible, my dear! My father's been arguing with the Queen of Etceteria, and has managed to start a war again.
translation: 太糟糕了，亲爱的！我父亲一直在跟埃西特利亚岛的女王吵架，结果又挑起了一场战争。

english: It's awful that your work has been undone by such an accident.
translation: 你的努力因为这种意外而付诸东流，真是太糟糕了。

english: What do you mean, 'an accident'?
translation: 你说‘意外’是什么意思？

english: Well, if my father had had something to occupy him, he wouldn't have gotten bored and decided to argue with Queen Sigrid again.
translation: 嗯，如果我父亲有点事做，他就不会闲得无聊，又跑去跟西格里德女王吵架了。

english: What would you suggest he do, then?
translation: 那你建议他做点什么呢？

english: We can't have him declaring war all the time. Even if it would give us a chance to show off our military might.
translation: 我们不能让他一直宣战。即使这能给我们一个展示军事实力的机会。

english: And I could finally show him that archery isn't a cowardly skill. If only we had an army, we could prove ourselves against the Etceterians.
translation: 而且我终于可以向他证明，射箭不是懦夫的技术。要是我们有支军队，就能在埃西特利亚人面前证明自己了。

english: Astrid, I have an even better idea.
translation: 阿斯特丽德，我有个更好的主意。

english: Better than archery? What is it?
translation: 比射箭还好？是什么？

english: I think we should persuade our father and Queen Sigrid to marry!
translation: 我觉得我们应该说服父亲和西格里德女王结婚！

english: ...What are you talking about, Brand?
translation: ……你在说什么啊，布兰德？

english: Think of the poetic irony of the situation!
translation: 想想这其中的诗意讽刺！

english: The best part is that I could write their wedding hymn for them.
translation: 最棒的是，我可以为他们写婚礼颂歌。

english: 'Today is a happy day, we are getting married,
translation: '今天是快乐的一天，我们要结婚了，

english: Our national anthems are wonderful, won't you sing this song?'
translation: 我们的国歌美妙动听，你愿意唱这首歌吗？'

english: I'm not sure that's such a good idea...
translation: 我不确定这是个好主意……

english: I think it will work.
translation: 我觉得会奏效的。

english: I quite agree!
translation: 我完全同意！

english: Perhaps it's an odd idea, my dear, but since we don't have an army, we can hardly declare war...
translation: 也许这主意有点怪，亲爱的，但既然我们没有军队，几乎不可能宣战……

english: Are you sure it'll work?
translation: 你确定这能行吗？

english: Of course it will! It always happens in the ballads and stories.
translation: 当然能行！民谣和故事里都是这么写的。

english: Two people who start out hating each other, and end up falling in love. It's a classic tale.
translation: 两个人一开始互相憎恨，最后却坠入爱河。这是个经典的故事。

english: That doesn't always work...
translation: 那不一定总是奏效……

english: But we don't have an army, so it's our best hope.
translation: 但我们没有军队，所以这是我们最好的希望了。

english: So, will you talk to our father and Queen Sigrid, then?
translation: 那么，你会去跟我父亲和西格里德女王谈谈吗？

english: I'm sure you can manage to arrange it all.
translation: 我相信你能安排好一切。

english: I'll give it a try. But they'll still be angry with each other, so I don't think it'll work.
translation: 我会试试看。但他们还在生对方的气，所以我不觉得会成功。

english: I'm sure you'll manage to do it, dear.
translation: 我相信你能做到的，亲爱的。

english: Good day, [Fremennik name]. Have you come to see my brother?
translation: 日安，[Fremennik name]。你是来看我哥哥的吗？

english: Oh, Advisor Ghrim said I should talk to you and the Prince about recent events in the kingdom.
translation: 哦，顾问格里姆说我应该跟你和王子谈谈王国最近发生的事。

english: It's terrible, my [dear/dear friend]! My father's been arguing with the Queen of Etceteria, and has managed to start a war again.
translation: 太糟糕了，我的[dear/dear friend]！我父亲一直在跟埃西特利亚岛的女王吵架，结果又挑起了一场战争。

english: Perhaps it's an odd idea, my [dear/dear friend], but since we don't have an army, we can hardly declare war...
translation: 也许这主意有点怪，我的[dear/dear friend]，但既然我们没有军队，几乎不可能宣战……

english: I trust my brother's judgement.
translation: 我相信我哥哥的判断。

english: Though his ideas can sometimes be a little... strange.
translation: 虽然他的想法有时有点……奇怪。

english: What was that, Astrid?
translation: 你说什么，阿斯特丽德？

english: I'm just telling [Fremennik name] about your poetic accomplishments.
translation: 我只是在跟[Fremennik name]说你的诗歌成就。

english: Oh, that's all right, then.
translation: 哦，那就好。

english: I'm sure you'll manage to do it, [dear/dear friend].
translation: 我相信你能做到的，[dear/dear friend]。

english: What is it? You'll have to excuse me, I'm quite busy...
translation: 什么事？请见谅，我很忙……

english: What are you busy with, your Majesty?
translation: 您在忙什么，陛下？

english: Affairs of state, and so on.
translation: 国家大事，诸如此类。

english: I thought I was supposed to deal with those, once you appointed me Regent.
translation: 我以为您任命我为摄政王之后，这些事就该由我来处理了。

english: Well, there's not all that much for me to do these days, you see.
translation: 嗯，这些天我其实没什么事可做，你明白的。

english: And though you do make a fine regent, you cannot be here all the time.
translation: 虽然你是个不错的摄政王，但你不可能一直待在这里。

english: So you're still helping to rule, your Majesty?
translation: 所以您还在帮忙治理国家，陛下？

english: In a manner of speaking.
translation: 可以这么说。

english: These 'affairs of state' you're dealing with...
translation: 您处理的这些‘国家大事’……

english: Would these involve starting a war with Queen Sigrid of Etceteria?
translation: 是不是包括跟埃西特利亚岛的西格里德女王开战？

english: Well, yes. Of course, Sigrid was the one who insulted me first.
translation: 嗯，是的。当然，是西格里德先侮辱我的。

english: And that's the least of the kingdom's problems at the moment.
translation: 而这还是王国目前最微不足道的问题。

english: Some of Frodi's barrels are missing, as are many of Magnus's crates. Leif also says he's had stacks of wood disappear.
translation: 弗罗迪的一些桶不见了，马格努斯的许多板条箱也不见了。莱夫还说他的几堆木材消失了。

english: Since you're the regent, you should investigate what has happened to these missing resources.
translation: 既然你是摄政王，你应该去调查这些失踪的资源是怎么回事。

english: Right away, your majesty.
translation: 遵命，陛下。

english: I'm glad to see the kingdom in such capable hands.
translation: 很高兴看到王国由如此能干的人掌管。

english: I'm sorry, I have some other things to do.
translation: 抱歉，我还有其他事要做。

english: That never prevented me from ruling this kingdom when I was your age, [Fremennik name].
translation: 我像你这么大的时候，这从来不妨碍我治理这个王国，[Fremennik name]。

english: Well, I suppose I could spare a little time.
translation: 嗯，我想我能抽出一点时间。

english: I'm glad to have your help.
translation: 很高兴能得到你的帮助。

english: All you need to do for the moment is to talk to the citizens of Miscellania, and find out what has been happening.
translation: 目前你只需要去和米斯凯尼亚的居民谈谈，了解发生了什么事。

english: It might also be useful to interrogate the citizens of Etceteria to see what they know.
translation: 去盘问一下埃西特利亚岛的居民，看看他们知道些什么，也许也有用。

english: Have you managed to make peace between my father and Queen Sigrid yet?
translation: 你设法让我父亲和西格里德女王和解了吗？

english: Not quite yet.
translation: 还没有。

english: King Vargas tells me that things have been going missing from the kingdom. Can you tell me anything about this?
translation: 瓦加斯国王告诉我，王国里不断有东西丢失。你能告诉我些什么吗？

english: You mean you hadn't heard, Your Royal Highness? Etceterian soldiers came and demanded tithes from us.
translation: 殿下，您没听说吗？埃西特利亚的士兵来过，向我们索要什一税。

english: You're the only person we give any of our goods to, so we refused, and found the next day that some of our goods had been stolen.
translation: 我们只把货物交给你一个人，所以我们拒绝了，结果第二天就发现一些货物被偷了。

english: You hadn't heard about it, Your Royal Highness? Etceterian soldiers came and demanded tithes from us.
translation: 殿下，您没听说过吗？埃西特利亚的士兵来过，向我们索要什一税。

english: You mean you don't know, Your Royal Highness? Etceterian soldiers came and demanded tithes from us.
translation: 殿下，您不知道吗？埃西特利亚的士兵来过，向我们索要什一税。

english: Have you spoken to the citizens yet, [Fremennik name]?
translation: [Fremennik name]，你和居民们谈过了吗？

english: I've spoken to the Miscellanean citizens.
translation: 我和米斯凯尼亚的居民谈过了。

english: They say that the Etceterian army demanded tithes from them, and took some of their goods even though they refused.
translation: 他们说埃西特利亚的军队向他们索要什一税，尽管他们拒绝了，还是拿走了一些货物。

english: So, Sigrid's planning to invade, is she?
translation: 这么说，西格里德打算入侵，是吗？

english: Or perhaps she's claiming that Miscellania is part of Etceteria now!
translation: 或者，她是在声称米斯凯尼亚现在是埃西特利亚岛的一部分！

english: [Fremennik name], go and talk to Sigrid and ask her what she thinks she's doing.
translation: [Fremennik name]，去找西格里德谈谈，问问她到底想干什么。

english: Exchanging angry letters is understandable, but where did she get an army from?
translation: 互相写愤怒的信可以理解，但她从哪里弄来的军队？

english: I'll talk to her right away, your Majesty.
translation: 陛下，我马上去和她谈。

english: Your Majesty, do you have a moment?
translation: 陛下，您有空吗？

english: Incompetent! I'll give him 'incompetent'...
translation: 无能！我要让他尝尝'无能'的滋味……

english: I hear from King Vargas that relations between Etceteria and Miscellania are none too cordial at the moment.
translation: 我从瓦加斯国王那里听说，埃西特利亚岛和米斯凯尼亚之间的关系目前并不太友好。

english: That idiot Vargas has decided to take a hand in ruling Miscellania, even though he'd handed it over to you, and now he's declared war on Etceteria again!
translation: 那个白痴瓦加斯决定插手管理米斯凯尼亚，尽管他已经把它交给了你，现在他又向埃西特利亚岛宣战了！

english: I suppose all those insults I made about his parentage can't have helped the matter...
translation: 我想我对他父母的所有侮辱对事情没有帮助……

english: Even so, that doesn't excuse what he did to my citizens!
translation: 即便如此，也不能为他对我子民所做的事开脱！

english: What happened, your Majesty?
translation: 陛下，发生了什么事？

english: My citizens have told me that items of theirs have been taken, and I'm sure that Vargas is behind it.
translation: 我的子民告诉我，他们的物品被拿走了，我确信是瓦加斯在背后指使。

english: Since you're the one who's supposed to be ruling Miscellania, you should sort it out.
translation: 既然你应该是统治米斯凯尼亚的人，你应该解决这件事。

english: I'm glad you understand.
translation: 很高兴你能理解。

english: If you talk to the citizens of Etceteria, they will tell you exactly what happened.
translation: 如果你和埃西特利亚岛的市民交谈，他们会告诉你到底发生了什么。

english: I would find out for myself, but the pressures of ruling are immense, and I would never have the time free.
translation: 我本想自己去查明，但统治的压力巨大，我永远抽不出时间。

english: Of course not, it's not my fault.
translation: 当然不是，这不是我的错。

english: What sort of Regent of Miscellania do you call yourself?
translation: 你自称是什么米斯凯尼亚的摄政王？

english: Of course it's your fault. You rule the country now.
translation: 当然是你的错。你现在统治这个国家。

english: Queen Sigrid tells me that things have been going missing from the kingdom. Can you tell me anything about this?
translation: 西格里德女王告诉我，王国里不断有东西丢失。你能告诉我些什么吗？

english: You haven't heard about that until now?
translation: 你到现在还没听说？

english: I'm surprised.
translation: 我很惊讶。

english: Well, Miscellanian soldiers came and asked for tribute.
translation: 嗯，米斯凯尼亚的士兵来过，要求进贡。

english: When I told them to leave, they came back the next day and stole my hat!
translation: 当我让他们离开时，他们第二天回来偷了我的帽子！

english: It was a wonderful hat. Mithril-reinforced, you see, and with a special splitbark brim to keep the sun off.
translation: 那是一顶很棒的帽子。你看，用秘银加固过，还有特殊的裂树皮帽檐来遮阳。

english: Could you please get it back for me?
translation: 你能帮我把它拿回来吗？

english: You're the regent of Miscellania, aren't you?
translation: 你是米斯凯尼亚的摄政王，对吧？

english: I'm surprised you didn't know about your own soldiers demanding tribute from us.
translation: 我很惊讶你竟然不知道你自己的士兵向我们索要进贡。

english: I told them to go away, but the next day I found that they'd stolen my small shield!
translation: 我让他们走开，但第二天我发现他们偷了我的小盾牌！

english: How am I supposed to defend the house without it?
translation: 没有它我怎么保卫房子？

english: And what am I going to use as a fruit bowl in the meantime?
translation: 同时我拿什么当水果碗用？

english: Please sort out your soldiers, and get my shield back to me.
translation: 请管好你的士兵，把我的盾牌拿回来。

english: Curse those Miscellanian soldiers!
translation: 诅咒那些米斯凯尼亚士兵！

english: They came and demanded tribute, and even though I told them to go away, they came back at night and stole my farming tools!
translation: 他们来了，要求进贡，尽管我叫他们走开，他们晚上又回来偷走了我的农具！

english: Without my trowel and fork, I can't do anything to keep the weeds from the farming patch.
translation: 没有我的泥铲和叉子，我无法阻止种植地里长杂草。

english: Please, find my tools again, so I can get back to work.
translation: 请帮我找回我的工具，这样我就能回去工作了。

english: You didn't know about it?
translation: 你不知道这件事？

english: Miscellanian soldiers came here a few days ago, saying they wanted us to pay tribute.
translation: 几天前，米斯凯尼亚士兵来到这里，说他们想要我们进贡。

english: Of course, I told them to leave.
translation: 当然，我让他们离开。

english: But in the morning, I found they'd stolen my quiver of arrows!
translation: 但早上我发现他们偷了我的箭袋！

english: They're not very valuable arrows, but I need them to do my job. Could you get them back for me?
translation: 这些箭不是很值钱，但我需要它们来工作。你能帮我拿回来吗？

english: You mean you haven't heard?
translation: 你是说你没听说过？

english: Only a few days ago, we had Miscellanian soldiers come round and ask for tribute.
translation: 就在几天前，有米斯凯尼亚士兵过来要求进贡。

english: I told them to get lost, of course...
translation: 我当然让他们滚蛋……

english: ...but when I woke up the next morning, they'd stolen my sword!
translation: ……但当我第二天早上醒来时，他们偷了我的剑！

english: Could you get it back for me? I doubt it can cut anything, but it once belonged to my great-grandfather.
translation: 你能帮我拿回来吗？我怀疑它能不能砍东西，但它曾属于我的曾祖父。

english: So it's a family heirloom, you see.
translation: 所以它是传家宝，你明白的。

english: Have you talked to the citizens yet, [Fremennik name]?
translation: [Fremennik name]，你和居民们谈过了吗？

english: I've talked to the Miscellanian citizens as well as the Etceterians.
translation: 我和米斯凯尼亚的居民以及埃西特利亚的居民都谈过了。

english: What exactly happened?
translation: 到底发生了什么？

english: The Etceterian citizens said that Miscellanian soldiers came to their houses and demanded tribute...
translation: 埃西特利亚的居民说，米斯凯尼亚士兵来到他们家，要求进贡……

english: Just as I suspected! Vargas, you treacherous snake!
translation: 正如我所怀疑的！瓦加斯，你这个奸诈的蛇！

english: ...and the Miscellanian citizens said that the Etceterian army marched into their fields and demanded tithes!
translation: ……而米斯凯尼亚的居民说，埃西特利亚的军队开进他们的田地，要求什一税！

english: Now I see his plan! Vargas isn't content with simply arguing; he wants to start a war even if it means swindling his own citizens!
translation: 现在我明白他的计划了！瓦加斯不满足于仅仅争吵；他想发动战争，即使这意味着欺骗自己的子民！

english: Your Majest-
translation: 陛下——

english: Etceterian army? There hasn't been one for centuries! These Miscellanian soldiers of his must have disguised themselves.
translation: 埃西特利亚军队？几个世纪以来都没有了！他的这些米斯凯尼亚士兵一定是伪装了自己。

english: If I may-
translation: 如果我可以——

english: And since Vargas shouldn't even be ruling now, it's your responsibility to deal with this.
translation: 而且既然瓦加斯现在甚至不应该统治，处理这件事是你的责任。

english: The one who should sort this out is you.
translation: 应该解决这件事的人是你。

english: It's one of the hazards of ruling a country, [Fremennik name].
translation: [Fremennik name]，这是统治国家的风险之一。

english: Have you found those stolen items yet?
translation: 你找到那些被盗物品了吗？

english: Not yet, your Majesty.
translation: 还没有，陛下。

english: You'd better hurry and look for them.
translation: 你最好快点去找。

english: We don't know what Vargas might be planning next!
translation: 我们不知道瓦加斯接下来会计划什么！

english: I've spoken to the Miscellanian citizens, and also the Etceterians.
translation: 我和米斯凯尼亚的居民以及埃西特利亚的居民都谈过了。

english: What did they say?
translation: 他们说了什么？

english: The Miscellanian citizens said that the Etceterian army marched into their fields and demanded tithes...
translation: 米斯凯尼亚的居民说，埃西特利亚的军队开进他们的田地，要求什一税……

english: I see. Sigrid thinks that now I've recognised Etceteria as a sovereign nation, I'll just roll over and play dead when she tries to invade, does she?
translation: 我明白了。西格里德女王认为既然我承认了埃西特利亚岛是一个主权国家，当她试图入侵时，我就会乖乖躺下装死，是吗？

english: ...and the Etceterian citizens said that Miscellanian soldiers came to their houses and demanded tribute!
translation: ……而埃西特利亚的居民说，米斯凯尼亚士兵来到他们家，要求进贡！

english: And she's even started spreading rumours among her own citizens! Are there no depths to which she won't sink?
translation: 她甚至开始在自家市民中散布谣言！她还有什么底线不会突破？

english: Lying to her own people about there being Miscellanian soldiers... we don't even have an army!
translation: 对她自己的人民撒谎说有米斯凯尼亚士兵……我们甚至没有军队！

english: Which makes it all the worse, as otherwise I'd be able to invade Etceteria to save the citizens from Sigrid's depravity.
translation: 这让情况变得更糟，因为否则我就能入侵埃西特利亚岛，将市民们从西格里德女王的堕落中拯救出来。

english: I'm not sure that would work very well, your Majesty.
translation: 陛下，我不确定那样做会有效。

english: Perhaps not, [Fremennik name].
translation: 也许不会，[Fremennik name]。

english: In any case, if there are any 'Miscellanian soldiers', they must have come from somewhere.
translation: 无论如何，如果有任何'米斯凯尼亚士兵'，他们一定是从某个地方来的。

english: Ask Advisor Ghrim if he knows who they might be, or where they might have come from.
translation: 去问问顾问格里姆，看他是否知道他们可能是谁，或者可能从哪里来。

english: He's a capable advisor, so I'm sure he'll know about any suspicious people.
translation: 他是个能干的顾问，所以我确信他会知道任何可疑的人。

english: I'll do that, your Majesty.
translation: 陛下，我会去做的。

english: King Vargas asked me to talk to you.
translation: 瓦加斯国王让我来和你谈谈。

english: He said you might know more about the missing goods.
translation: 他说你可能更了解丢失的货物。

english: I'm not sure what you're implying, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 殿下，我不确定您在暗示什么。

english: Er... that you could advise me where to look for them?
translation: 呃……你可以建议我去哪里找它们？

english: Ah, of course.
translation: 啊，当然。

english: Assuming that nobody presently living in Miscellania would have taken them,
translation: 假设目前住在米斯凯尼亚的人不会拿走它们，

english: it is of course likely that someone from outside took them.
translation: 那么当然很可能是外面的人拿走了它们。

english: The sailor who brought you here from the mainland would be the first to see any suspicious visitors.
translation: 把你从大陆带到这里来的水手，会是第一个看到任何可疑访客的人。

english: I suggest you ask him about recent arrivals to the island.
translation: 我建议你去问问他最近岛上来了什么人。

english: ...I believe the King asked you to talk to me, Your Royal Highness.
translation: ……殿下，我想国王是让你来找我谈话的。

english: I'm looking for a sailor...
translation: 我在找一个水手……

english: You've found one here. Can I help you?
translation: 这里就有一个。需要帮忙吗？

english: The King's advisor said I should talk to you. He said there have been some suspicious people arriving recently.
translation: 国王的顾问说我应该跟你谈谈。他说最近来了一些可疑的人。

english: Well, I don't know of any suspicious people... Advisor Ghrim can be rather paranoid about these things sometimes.
translation: 嗯，我不知道有什么可疑的人……顾问格里姆有时候对这种事有点疑神疑鬼的。

english: Oh. Has anyone visited the island recently, then?
translation: 哦。那最近有人来过岛上吗？

english: Nobody apart from you, and those kids from Rellekka.
translation: 除了你，就只有那些从雷勒卡城来的孩子了。

english: What kids from Rellekka?
translation: 什么从雷勒卡城来的孩子？

english: Five of them came over here a few weeks ago. They said they were here to see relatives in the dungeons, and they were visiting from the mainland.
translation: 五个孩子，几周前过来的。他们说来地牢里探亲，是从大陆来的。

english: I didn't realise the King kept people in his dungeons.
translation: 我不知道国王会把人关在地牢里。

english: I didn't know Miscellania even HAD dungeons.
translation: 我都不知道米斯凯尼亚居然有地牢。

english: They've not been used to keep prisoners for a long time. But since the war ended, we've had more people visiting the island.
translation: 地牢很久没用来关押囚犯了。但战争结束后，来岛上的人变多了。

english: Some of them decided they wanted to stay, so we've had to find somewhere for them to live...
translation: 有些人决定留下来，所以我们得给他们找个地方住……

english: Only the weather on Miscellania is terrible, and nobody could build houses that would stand up to a strong wind. Etceteria is just the same.
translation: 只是米斯凯尼亚的天气糟透了，没人能建起能扛住强风的房子。埃西特利亚岛也一样。

english: So you decided to live in the dungeons instead?
translation: 所以你们就决定住在地牢里了？

english: Well, of course, they had to be enlarged first. There are still some dwarves working there, making more of the dungeons inhabitable before they move over to work in Etceteria.
translation: 嗯，当然得先扩建一下。还有些矮人在那里干活，让更多地牢能住人，然后他们再转到埃西特利亚岛去工作。

english: If you're looking for those kids from Rellekka, you'll find them in those dungeons.
