translation: 如果你在找那些从雷勒卡城来的孩子，你会在那些地牢里找到他们的。

english: Why are you surprised about this, though? I thought you'd become the Regent.
translation: 不过，你为什么会对此感到惊讶？我以为你已经当上摄政王了。

english: I'm still an adventurer, and I can't be everywhere in Gielinor...
translation: 我还是个冒险者，不可能无处不在……

english: But I'm the Regent! I order you to let me go down there.
translation: 但我是摄政王！我命令你让我下去。

english: You're the Regent? Well, I didn't vote for you.
translation: 你是摄政王？嗯，我可没投你的票。

english: Sorry, 'Regent', nobody can go into the dungeons without the King's say-so.
translation: 抱歉，'摄政王'，没有国王的许可，谁都不能进地牢。

english: What'll it take to convince you that I'm really the Regent?
translation: 要怎样才能让你相信我是真的摄政王？

english: If the King came and told me, then I'd believe it.
translation: 如果国王亲自来告诉我，我就信。

english: Or, if he can't come here himself, I suppose a royal proclamation would be fine.
translation: 或者，如果他本人不能来，我想一份王室公告也行。

english: A royal proclamation?
translation: 王室公告？

english: Does he have to shout it from the battlements, or something like that?
translation: 他是不是得站在城垛上大声宣读，或者类似这样？

english: No, just his signature and a statement saying you're really the Regent would do.
translation: 不用，只要他的签名和一份声明，说你是真的摄政王就行了。

english: Your Majesty, how do I get into the dungeons?
translation: 陛下，我怎么才能进地牢？

english: The dungeons?
translation: 地牢？

english: Of course, how could I have forgotten?
translation: 当然，我怎么会忘了呢？

english: I'm surprised I didn't tell you when you were appointed Regent.
translation: 我很惊讶你被任命为摄政王时我没告诉你。

english: It's okay, the sailor explained it to me.
translation: 没关系，水手已经跟我解释过了。

english: He said that the only new arrivals on the island were some teenagers, who came from Rellekka to visit their relatives.
translation: 他说岛上唯一的新来者是一些青少年，从雷勒卡城来探亲的。

english: Those relatives were living in the houses in the dungeons.
translation: 那些亲戚就住在地牢里的房子里。

english: Ah, so you wish to look in the dungeons in case these new arrivals are to blame?
translation: 啊，所以你想去地牢里看看，以防这些新来者是罪魁祸首？

english: I doubt that anyone with Miscellanian relatives would be at fault. However...
translation: 我怀疑有米斯凯尼亚亲戚的人会有什么问题。不过……

english: There is something I need you to do in the dungeons.
translation: 有件事我需要你在地牢里做。

english: They are still being excavated, and the dwarven architects are finding new caves as they go. There have been reports of odd sightings in these new caves.
translation: 地牢还在挖掘中，矮人建筑师们一边挖一边发现新的洞穴。有报告说这些新洞穴里出现了奇怪的景象。

english: Perhaps they are monsters, waiting to devour unwary Miscellanians...
translation: 也许是怪物，等着吞噬粗心的米斯凯尼亚人……

english: Whatever they are, I want you to look into it.
translation: 不管是什么，我希望你去调查一下。

english: You are a member of the royal family, after all, so I know I can rely on your help.
translation: 毕竟你是王室成员，所以我知道我可以信赖你的帮助。

english: Of course, your Majesty.
translation: 当然，陛下。

english: The guard by the dungeon entrance may not recognise you, since he was only hired recently. Here, take this scroll to show that you have access to the dungeons.
translation: 地牢入口的守卫可能不认识你，因为他是最近才雇来的。拿着这份卷轴，证明你有权进入地牢。

english: You'll find the entrance by the south-east corner of the palace.
translation: 你会在宫殿东南角找到入口。

english: Have you given that scroll to the guard yet?
translation: 你把那份卷轴给守卫了吗？

english: Honestly... very well, I'll write you another one.
translation: 真是的……好吧，我再给你写一份。

english: Try not to lose it this time.
translation: 这次可别再弄丢了。

english: Showing the dungeon guard that you have permission to enter, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 向地牢守卫展示你有进入许可，殿下。

english: Look, the King gave me a scroll saying I have access to the dungeons. I have it right here.
translation: 你看，国王给了我一份卷轴，说我可以进入地牢。就在这儿。

english: Let's have a look, then.
translation: 那让我看看。

english: Hmm... all seems to be in order.
translation: 嗯……看起来没问题。

english: All right, your Highness, you're free to go down there.
translation: 好了，殿下，你可以下去了。

english: Try not to be eaten by monsters.
translation: 小心别被怪物吃了。

english: Would you like to buy anything, your Royal Highness?
translation: 殿下，您想买点什么吗？

english: Can I help you, your Royal Highness?
translation: 殿下，需要帮忙吗？

english: I've lost that mining prop you gave me...
translation: 你给我的那个矿井支柱我弄丢了……

english: Lucky I have a spare, isn't it?
translation: 幸好我还有一个备用的，对吧？

english: I can see the embers of a fire up ahead. Has someone else been in these caves?
translation: 我能看到前面有篝火的余烬。是不是有人来过这些洞穴？

english: I should explore this cave more before I jump through any more cracks in the walls...
translation: 在跳进墙上任何裂缝之前，我应该先好好探索这个洞穴……

english: If you hadn't got drunk in that inn, Signy, we could have stayed there for longer.
translation: 西格尼，要不是你在那家酒馆喝醉了，我们本可以在那里多待一会儿的。

english: It wasn't just me who got drunk. You looked like you were about to puke all over the barmaid.
translation: 又不是只有我一个人喝醉了。你看上去也快吐到女招待身上了。

english: Reinn threw up anyway.
translation: 反正雷恩已经吐了。

english: I can't help it, I just have a weak stomach.
translation: 我没办法，我就是胃不好。

english: You're no better, Hild. You said you knew where we were, and now look at us!
translation: 希尔德，你也好不到哪去。你说你知道我们在哪，现在看看我们！

english: We're cold, we're hungry and now we're LOST!
translation: 我们又冷又饿，现在还迷路了！

english: We wouldn't have been so cold if Armod had more diary pages he'd let us use!
translation: 要是阿莫德肯多给我们几页日记纸用，我们就不会这么冷了！

english: Hey! I have to write down what's happened.
translation: 嘿！我得把发生的事情记下来。

english: Otherwise father won't believe me when I tell him.
translation: 不然我告诉父亲的时候他不会相信的。

english: If your father listened to what you say, we wouldn't BE here.
translation: 要是你父亲肯听你的话，我们就不会在这里了。

english: We'd have passed the trials and we'd be proper adults!
translation: 我们早就通过试炼，成为真正的成年人了！

english: Besides, it's not like he'll even look at the rubbish you've written in your diary.
translation: 再说了，他根本不会看你日记里写的那些垃圾。

english: If only my father would come and save us.
translation: 要是我父亲能来救我们就好了。

english: If only SOMEONE would come and save us.
translation: 要是有人能来救我们就好了。

english: Someone's coming!
translation: 有人来了！

english: Quick, let's hide!
translation: 快，我们躲起来！

english: What if it's the monster again? What if it's one of the townspeople?
translation: 要是又是那个怪物怎么办？要是是镇上的人怎么办？

english: What if my father's found out what we've been doing?
translation: 要是我父亲发现我们做的事怎么办？

english: H-hey! Where am I going to hide?
translation: 嘿！我躲哪儿去？

english: Shhhh! Just pretend you're part of the scenery, or something!
translation: 嘘！假装你是风景的一部分，或者别的什么！

english: You're almost smart enough to make a good rock.
translation: 你差不多够聪明，能装成一块好石头了。

english: You want me to hit you?
translation: 你想让我揍你吗？

english: Just act normal, Armod! And hurry!
translation: 阿莫德，表现得正常点！快点！

english: O-okay.
translation: 好……好吧。

english: I said, don't bother me!
translation: 我说了，别烦我！

english: I'm being a rock at the moment.
translation: 我现在是一块石头。

english: You can't be a rock. I heard you talking to people earlier.
translation: 你不可能是一块石头。我刚才还听到你在跟人说话。

english: What did you hear?
translation: 你听到了什么？

english: Your name's Armod, isn't it? I found your diary.
translation: 你叫阿莫德，对吧？我找到了你的日记。

english: What? How did you get it? Give it back!
translation: 什么？你怎么拿到的？还给我！

english: Not until you tell me what's going on.
translation: 除非你告诉我到底怎么回事。

english: Why should I tell you? We're going to do really well and show my father that we're true adults!
translation: 我为什么要告诉你？我们要干一番大事，让我父亲看看我们是真正的成年人！

english: What, by starting a war?
translation: 怎么，靠发动战争？

english: What the-
translation: 什么——

english: Did you read my diary?
translation: 你看了我的日记？

english: Yes, all of it.
translation: 是的，全看了。

english: What are you even doing in these caves anyway? Everyone else was scared to come down here.
translation: 你到这些洞穴里来到底想干什么？其他人都害怕下来。

english: Well, I'm the Regent of Miscellania. The King asked me to take a look-
translation: 嗯，我是米斯凯尼亚的摄政王。国王让我来看看——

english: You're the REGENT?
translation: 你就是那个摄政王？

english: Um, you four, I think you'd better come out now. We're in big trouble.
translation: 呃，你们四个，我觉得你们最好现在出来。我们有大麻烦了。

english: Nice impression of a rock you did there, Armod.
translation: 阿莫德，你刚才装石头装得挺像的。

english: So you're the adventurer we heard about, then. The one who married the [prince/princess].
translation: 那么，你就是我们听说的那个冒险者了。就是那个娶了[prince/princess]的人。

english: So you're the adventurer we heard about, then. The one who gained the trust of the [prince/princess].
translation: 那么，你就是我们听说的那个冒险者了。就是那个赢得了[prince/princess]信任的人。

english: And you five are the people mentioned in Armod's diary, right?
translation: 而你们五个就是阿莫德日记里提到的人，对吧？

english: Armod, you should have burnt it all.
translation: 阿莫德，你当时就该把那些东西全烧了。

english: Did you steal those goods from the Etceterians and the Miscellanians?
translation: 是你们偷了埃西特利亚人和米斯凯尼亚人的货物吗？

english: It was Beigarth's idea, not mine!
translation: 那是贝加斯的主意，不是我的！

english: He said that if we disguised ourselves as soldiers, we could convince both the King and Queen that they were under attack. And it almost worked, too.
translation: 他说，如果我们伪装成士兵，就能让国王和王后都相信他们受到了攻击。而且这计划差点就成功了。

english: It would have worked, if it hadn't been for that huge snake!
translation: 要不是那条大蛇，本来能成功的！

english: ...What huge snake?
translation: ……什么大蛇？

english: We put the things we'd taken somewhere safe, so we could get them back when we made peace again.
translation: 我们把拿走的东西放在了一个安全的地方，打算等和平恢复后再去取回来。

english: Everything was going well, until we got back to that place, and a giant sea snake had moved in!
translation: 本来一切顺利，直到我们回到那个地方，发现一条巨型海蛇住了进去！

english: It's made a nest out of all the boxes and barrels.
translation: 它用所有的盒子和桶搭了个窝。

english: I don't care about the plan. If you can get rid of that sea snake, we'll be really grateful to you.
translation: 我不在乎那个计划了。如果你能除掉那条海蛇，我们会非常感激你的。

english: We can't even get out of these dungeons while it's there.
translation: 有它在，我们甚至没法离开这个地牢。

english: I agree with him. I want to go back home.
translation: 我同意他说的。我想回家。

english: It's cold here, we've got no food, and we can't go back to the town.
translation: 这里又冷，又没吃的，我们还回不了镇上。

english: Not after we got drunk and then didn't pay our bill.
translation: 尤其是在我们喝醉了还没付账之后。

english: So, will you get rid of that sea snake?
translation: 那么，你愿意去除掉那条海蛇吗？

english: Of course. I was going to do that anyway.
translation: 当然。我本来也打算这么做的。

english: Thank you so much. You've saved us from the brink of death.
translation: 太感谢你了。你真是救了我们一命。

english: Could I ask you for one more thing?
translation: 我能再求你一件事吗？

english: PLEASE don't tell my father how badly we messed up.
translation: 求求你别告诉我父亲我们搞砸得有多惨。

english: Hello down there! Are you all right?
translation: 喂，下面的人！你们还好吗？

english: I'm up here, above this hole.
translation: 我在这上面，在这个洞的上方。

english: I've thrown down a rope - you sounded like you were trapped in there.
translation: 我扔了根绳子下去——听起来你们好像被困在里面了。

english: Still, I can't let you go back down there until the Queen says it's safe.
translation: 不过，在王后说安全之前，我不能让你再回到下面去。

english: I don't suppose you've seen a large box around here, have you?
translation: 我想你在这附近没见过一个大箱子吧？

english: Oh, so this is yours? You must have dropped it around here.
translation: 哦，所以这是你的？你一定是不小心掉在这附近了。

english: Seems rather heavy. Take better care of it this time.
translation: 看起来挺重的。这次可要保管好了。

english: Wait a minute! You can't go down there.
translation: 等一下！你不能下去。

english: Why not? I came up through that hole...
translation: 为什么不行？我就是从那个洞里上来的……

english: Yes, and I'm surprised you managed to get out of there without breaking any bones.
translation: 是啊，我很惊讶你居然能毫发无损地从那里出来。

english: If he wants an Etceterian army, then we'll have to raise one!
translation: 如果他想要一支埃西特利亚军队，那我们就得组建一支！

english: I've found out what caused all these problems.
translation: 我查明了所有问题的起因。

english: A group of teenagers from Rellekka came to Etceteria to prove themselves as adults.
translation: 一群来自雷勒卡城的年轻人来到埃西特利亚岛，想证明自己已经成年。

english: They said they tried to start a war, which they'd then stop, and be hailed as peacemakers.
translation: 他们说，他们试图挑起一场战争，然后再阻止它，这样就能被当作和平使者受到欢迎。

english: They were the ones who disguised themselves as soldiers!
translation: 就是他们伪装成了士兵！

english: That explains what the citizens said about armies, I suppose.
translation: 我想，这就能解释市民们说的关于军队的事了。

english: But what about the items that went missing?
translation: 但那些丢失的物品呢？

english: Well, there was a minor problem involving a sea snake...
translation: 嗯，中间出了点小问题，跟一条海蛇有关……

english: But I dealt with it, and got the items back.
translation: 但我已经处理好了，并且把物品都拿回来了。

english: Finally, a ruler of Miscellania who's willing to do something for his neighbours.
translation: 终于，米斯凯尼亚出了个愿意为邻居做点事的统治者。

english: Do you have the items with you?
translation: 你带着那些物品吗？

english: ...I must have dropped the box on my way out of the dungeons.
translation: ……我肯定是在离开地牢的路上把箱子弄丢了。

english: *sigh* Well, if you ask the guard at the entrance to the dungeon, he might have picked it up.
translation: *叹气* 好吧，如果你去问问地牢入口的守卫，他可能捡到了。

english: Of course, he won't know what it's for, so you'd better bring it back here once you find it.
translation: 当然，他不知道那是干什么用的，所以你找到后最好把它带回到这里来。

english: I shall do, your Majesty.
translation: 遵命，陛下。

english: Yes, I have them here.
translation: 是的，我带着呢。

english: Thank you, [Fremennik name]. You've shown yourself to be an excellent diplomat and warrior - not a combination that comes naturally to many.
translation: 谢谢你，[Fremennik name]。你证明了自己是一位出色的外交家和战士——这种组合可不是人人都能具备的。

english: My citizens would like their items back, of course. One of my guards will deal with the items for you, and you will be provided with a suitable reward.
translation: 当然，我的子民们想要回他们的物品。我的一个守卫会帮你处理这些物品，你也会得到相应的奖赏。

english: Finally... I have a letter that I would like you to give to Vargas. This war was a mistake, and I've made a formal apology.
translation: 最后……我有一封信想让你交给瓦尔加斯。这场战争是个错误，我已经正式道歉了。

english: I'll make sure to give it to him, your Majesty.
translation: 我一定交给他，陛下。

english: Thank you for all your help, [Fremennik name]. To show our gratitude, the woodcutters and other workers of Etceteria have pledged to add a proportion of what they produce to your treasury.
translation: 感谢你的所有帮助，[Fremennik name]。为表谢意，埃西特利亚岛的伐木工和其他工人已承诺将一部分产出贡献给你的国库。

english: Now that you've finished giving these items back, please give my letter to Vargas.
translation: 既然你已经把这些物品归还了，请把我的信交给瓦尔加斯。

english: I'm glad you've found my citizens' missing items, Dalkar. Have you had a chance to give Vargas my letter?
translation: 很高兴你找到了我子民丢失的物品，达尔卡。你有机会把我的信交给瓦尔加斯吗？

english: Hurry up and give it to him, please. It means we can formally declare peace again.
translation: 请快点交给他。这样我们就能正式宣布恢复和平了。

english: Very well, I'll write another. Try to take better care of this one.
translation: 好吧，我再写一封。这次可要保管好了。

english: I'm not sure I should be reading this...
translation: 我不确定我该不该看这个……

english: I won't read that letter. It's for the King, not for me.
translation: 我不会看那封信的。那是给国王的，不是给我的。

english: Oh, why not. I'm the Regent, after all.
translation: 哦，管他呢。毕竟我是摄政王。

english: How are your investigations going, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你的调查进展如何，[Fremennik name]？

english: I've found the people who took the goods from your citizens!
translation: 我找到了从你子民那里拿走货物的人！

english: Those Etceterian soldiers?
translation: 那些埃西特利亚士兵？

english: They weren't Etceterian soldiers after all.
translation: 他们根本就不是埃西特利亚士兵。

english: They were teenagers from Rellekka who were trying to prove themselves as adults, by starting a war and then bringing about peace.
translation: 他们是来自雷勒卡城的年轻人，想通过挑起战争再带来和平的方式来证明自己已经成年。

english: Why didn't they just go through the trials as usual?
translation: 他们为什么不按常规去接受试炼呢？

english: Unless they're the ones that the Council warned me about.
translation: 除非他们就是议会警告过我的那些人。

english: Still, I can't believe they'd start a war between Miscellania and Etceteria, just to show they were adults...
translation: 不过，我还是不敢相信他们会为了证明自己是成年人，就在米斯凯尼亚和埃西特利亚岛之间挑起战争……

english: But at least you've found the missing goods. Do you have them with you?
translation: 但至少你找到了丢失的货物。你带着它们吗？

english: I'm afraid not, your Majesty. There were far too many for me to carry.
translation: 恐怕没有，陛下。东西太多了，我拿不了。

english: We'll have to send people down to collect them later, then.
translation: 那我们之后得派人下去收集。

english: And I also spoke to Queen Sigrid of Etceteria.
translation: 我还和埃西特利亚岛的西格里德女王谈过了。

english: She gave me a letter for you, which she said was a formal apology.
translation: 她给了我一封给你的信，说是正式的道歉信。

english: Oh? Do you have this letter with you?
translation: 哦？你带着这封信吗？

english: Er, I had it, but I seem to have lost it.
translation: 呃，我带着的，但好像弄丢了。

english: You'd better ask Sigrid to write you another one, then.
translation: 那你最好让西格里德再给你写一封。

english: I'd like to see what she has to say.
translation: 我想看看她说了什么。

english: Of course, your Majesty. Here you are.
translation: 当然，陛下。给您。

english: You defeated that sea snake? Sigrid seems rather impressed with that.
translation: 你打败了那条海蛇？西格里德似乎对此印象深刻。

english: And the caverns underneath her palace are joined to ours, I see.
translation: 而且，她宫殿下面的洞穴和我们的相连，我看到了。

english: She thinks we should join forces to develop them for more houses.
translation: 她认为我们应该联手开发这些洞穴，用来建造更多房屋。

english: Finally... hmm. That's not what I'd have expected from Sigrid.
translation: 最后……嗯。这可不是我预料中西格里德会说的话。

english: What is it, your Majesty?
translation: 是什么，陛下？

english: She, erm, says if I weren't a yeti, she might want to get to know me better.
translation: 她，呃，说如果我不是个雪人，她可能想更深入地了解我。

english: Since we're both warmongering fools, she thinks we'd get on well.
translation: 她说既然我们都是好战的傻瓜，她觉得我们会相处得很好。

english: I suppose she has a point there.
translation: 我想她说的有点道理。

english: Brand's suggestion worked, and I didn't even do anything.
translation: 布兰德的建议奏效了，我甚至什么都没做。

english: Nothing, your Majesty.
translation: 没什么，陛下。

english: Do you want me to give a reply to Queen Sigrid?
translation: 您需要我给西格里德女王回信吗？

english: No, no. I'll think about it for a while.
translation: 不，不用。我想想再说。

english: Though I'd like to tell her I'm sorry for calling her a warmongering harpy.
translation: 不过，我想告诉她，我很抱歉叫她好战的泼妇。

english: In the meantime, [Fremennik name], you have managed to avert a war and bring the culprits to light.
translation: 与此同时，[Fremennik name]，你成功避免了一场战争，并揭露了罪魁祸首。

english: The kingdom of Miscellania will have to reward you for this.
translation: 米斯凯尼亚王国必须为此奖赏你。

english: I hear that the Etceterians are also grateful for your help, and have pledged some of their resources.
translation: 我听说埃西特利亚人也感激你的帮助，并承诺提供一些资源。

english: You can talk to Ghrim to deal with those, just as before.
translation: 你可以像以前一样找格里姆处理这些事。

english: I hear you made peace between our kingdom and Etceteria once more. Well done, [dear/[Fremennik name]].
translation: 我听说你让我们的王国和埃西特利亚岛再次和平了。做得好，[dear/[Fremennik name]]。

english: Thank you for all your help, [Fremennik name]. It's good to know that the Regent of Miscellania is willing to help his neighbours.
translation: 感谢你的所有帮助，[Fremennik name]。很高兴知道米斯凯尼亚的摄政王愿意帮助他的邻居。

english: You're welcome, your Majesty.
translation: 不客气，陛下。

english: However, I will gladly give you every bent penny of what is left, and starve in the gutter with my many adorable children if you say you will help me.
translation: 不过，如果你愿意帮我，我很乐意把剩下的每一分钱都给你，然后带着我那群可爱的孩子们在臭水沟里挨饿。

english: Arrr... 'Tis lookin' bleak...
translation: 啊……情况看起来不妙……

english: Cap'n!
translation: 船长！

english: Good news Cap'n!
translation: 好消息，船长！

english: I found us a hero down by the docks!
translation: 我在码头那边找到了一个愿意帮我们的英雄！

english: Be they heroic, brave and true?
translation: 他英勇、勇敢而且忠诚吗？

english: Aye! They also be gullible, tied up and unconscious!
translation: 是的！而且还很天真，被绑着，昏迷不醒！

english: They were willing to help out some random stranger with a good enough sob story, so I smacked them with a bottle and rowed them over.
translation: 他愿意帮一个编了个像样悲惨故事的陌生人，所以我就用瓶子砸了他，然后划船把他带过来了。

english: Are you ok?  You, errr...
translation: 你还好吗？你，呃……

english: Atta girl!
translation: 好样的！

english: Err... sure...
translation: 呃……当然……

english: Would you like a hand with your stuff? You seem to have dropped something.
translation: 需要我帮你拿东西吗？你好像掉了什么东西。

english: I may have a quest, but you don't look like you'd be able handle the kind of monsters I have problems with.
translation: 我可能有个任务，但你看上去不像能对付我遇到的那种怪物。

english: ...slipped and fell down some stairs.
translation: ……滑倒了，摔下了楼梯。

english: ...got into a fight with my evil twin.
translation: ……和我的邪恶双胞胎打了一架。

english: Brilliant! The island's location will remain a secret!
translation: 太棒了！这座岛的位置将永远是秘密！

english: Bring 'em here and wake 'em up.
translation: 把他带过来，弄醒他。

english: We may make it through this yet...
translation: 我们也许还能挺过去……

english: Are ye alright, [lad/lass]?
translation: 你还好吗，[lad/lass]？

english: Ohhhh... My head...
translation: 噢……我的头……

english: It feels like someone has smacked me one with a bottle...
translation: 感觉就像有人用瓶子敲了我一下……

english: Arr... Those devils gave ye a nasty knock when ye came to aid us.
translation: 啊……那些恶魔在你来帮我们的时候重重地敲了你一下。

english: But now yer here we'll run those evil brain-eatin' dogs off the island fer good!
translation: 但现在你来了，我们会把那些邪恶的食脑狗永远赶出岛去！

english: What? What is going on here?
translation: 什么？这里发生了什么？

english: I can't seem to remember anything beyond chatting to a man at the docks.
translation: 我只记得在码头跟一个人聊过天，之后的事似乎一点都想不起来了。

english: Arr. Well, [lad/lass], that would be Pete, one of my men.
translation: 啊。那个，[lad/lass]，那是皮特，我手下的人。

english: He's been out lookin' fer heroes like yerself to aid us in our peril.
translation: 他一直在外面找像你这样的英雄来帮我们渡过难关。

english: Okay... I'll buy that. It sounds like something I would do.
translation: 好吧……我信了。听起来确实像我会做的事。

english: So where am I, and what is going on?
translation: 那么我在哪里，到底发生了什么事？

english: Yer on Braindeath Island!
translation: 你正在脑死岛上！

english: Where it lies is a secret, because ye are standin' in the brewery of Cap'n Braindeath, purveyor of the most vitriolic alcoholic beverages in the world!
translation: 它的位置是个秘密，因为你正站在脑死船长的酿酒厂里，他是全世界最辛辣酒精饮料的供应商！

english: I am the notorious alchemist Cap'n Braindeath, and this whole operation be my idea!
translation: 我就是那个臭名昭著的炼金术士脑死船长，整件事都是我的主意！

english: With my crew of sturdy, upright pirate brewers, we sail the seven seas, distributing cheap 'alcohol' to all and sundry.
translation: 我和我那群强壮正直的海盗酿酒师船员一起，航行七海，向所有人推销廉价的‘酒’。

english: Oooh!
translation: 哦！

english: These be dark times, though, [lad/lass]. See, a week ago we awoke to find ourselves beseiged.
translation: 不过现在时局艰难，[lad/lass]。一周前我们醒来时发现自己被包围了。

english: The lads and I have held them off so far, but 'tis only a matter of time before they sweep through the buildin' and put us all to the sword.
translation: 我和弟兄们一直抵挡着他们，但迟早他们会冲进这座建筑，把我们统统杀掉。

english: Them!
translation: 是他们！

english: Are they...
translation: 他们是在……

english: ...protesting?
translation: ……抗议？

english: Arr, [lad/lass]! That they are!
translation: 啊，[lad/lass]！正是！

english: Day and night they seek to break our will with their chantin', and their singin' and their passive resistance!
translation: 他们日夜不停地用口号、唱歌和消极抵抗来试图瓦解我们的意志！

english: So, what do you want me to do?
translation: 那么你想让我做什么？

english: Well, me and the lads got our heads together and decided that if we can get their Cap'n drunk enough, perhaps they'll stop protestin'.
translation: 嗯，我和弟兄们商量了一下，觉得只要能把他们的船长灌醉，也许他们就会停止抗议。

english: If that happens, we'll slip out the back and set up shop somewhere else.
translation: 如果成功了，我们就从后门溜走，换个地方重新开张。

english: Well, how can I help?
translation: 那么，我能怎么帮忙？

english: Well, first of all, we need someone to go out the front and grow us some Blindweed.
translation: 嗯，首先，我们需要有人到前面去种些盲草。

english: 'Tis one of the ingredients of our 'rum'.
translation: 那是我们‘朗姆酒’的原料之一。

english: The only problem is that those rottin' fiends have torn up and destroyed all but one of the Blindweed Patches.
translation: 唯一的问题是那些腐烂的恶棍把盲草田都毁掉了，只剩下一块。

english: Here, [lad/lass]. I'll give ye the seed you'll need fer growin' the herb. Help yerself to the gardenin' equipment in the basement.
translation: 给你，[lad/lass]。我把种这种草药需要的种子给你。地下室有园艺装备，你自己拿。

english: I'll warn ye again that those devils are sat right on top of the patch.
translation: 我再警告你一次，那些恶魔就蹲守在那块田上。

english: Try hecklin' 'em from a distance. Those Swabs may talk a good fight, but if ye can put a scare in 'em they'll keep out of yer way!
translation: 试着从远处挑衅他们。那些家伙虽然嘴硬，但如果你能吓住他们，他们就会躲开你！

english: What exactly do you want me to do?
translation: 你到底想让我做什么？

english: Arr, well I want ye to get outside and grow some Blindweed.
translation: 啊，我想让你出去种些盲草。

english: Best be careful, [lad/lass], fer them pirates will skin ye alive if they catch ye.
translation: 最好小心点，[lad/lass]，那些海盗要是逮到你，会活剥了你的皮。

english: And what happens if I lose the seed?
translation: 如果我丢了种子怎么办？

english: Then I'll have ye flogged, hung, slapped with a haddock and sent back out there to fight the zombie hordes with little more than harsh language!
translation: 那我就用鞭子抽你，把你吊起来，用黑线鳕拍你，再把你扔回去，让你只能靠骂骂咧咧去对付那群僵尸大军！

english: Come back and see me when ye ain't loaded down with stuff, and I'll give ye another.
translation: 等你身上没那么多东西的时候回来找我，我再给你一颗。

english: Arr... Here, [lad/lass]. Just take this and get goin'!
translation: 啊……拿着，[lad/lass]。拿着就走吧！

english: Why do you talk like a pirate? Didn't you tell me you were an alchemist?
translation: 你为什么说话像海盗？你不是告诉我你是炼金术士吗？

english: Arr, [lad/lass], 'tis true.
translation: 啊，[lad/lass]，确实是。

english: However, 'tis also true that I stumbled across the basic recipe fer my most potent of brews in a terrible alchemical accident.
translation: 不过，我是在一次可怕的炼金事故中偶然发现了我最烈性朗姆酒的基本食谱，这也是事实。

english: See, 'twas a dark and stormy night, and the wind was howlin' around the trees as I worked late into the night.
translation: 看，那是一个风雨交加的夜晚，我工作到深夜，风在树间呼啸。

english: Steppin' too close to a candle with my flask in my hand, I was suddenly swept up in a terrible, yet potently alcoholic, explosion.
translation: 我拿着烧瓶靠蜡烛太近了，突然被一场可怕但酒劲十足的爆炸卷了进去。

english: Well' [lad/lass], it seems the fumes from that first batch of me 'rum' did strange things to me brain.
translation: 那个，[lad/lass]，看来那第一批‘朗姆酒’的烟气对我的大脑产生了奇怪的影响。

english: I don't remember the exact words the healers used, but apparently the stuff burned out the tiny, specialised part of me brain that tells me not to talk like a pirate.
translation: 我不记得治疗师用的确切词了，但显然那种神秘物质烧掉了大脑中那个阻止我像海盗一样说话的精小专门部位。

english: That... that... that sounds utterly impossible!
translation: 那……那……那听起来完全不可能！

english: Arr! That be what I told them!
translation: 啊！我也是这么跟他们说的！

english: So what do you make here anyway?
translation: 那你到底在这里生产什么？

english: 'Rum', [lad/lass]!
translation: 朗姆酒，[lad/lass]！

english: The finest, most potent, most flammable and most debilitatin' 'rum' in the whole of Gielinor!
translation: 整个吉莱诺最优质、最烈、最易燃、最让人丧失能力的‘朗姆酒’！

english: Rum, eh?
translation: 朗姆酒，嗯？

english: No, [lad/lass], 'rum'!
translation: 不，[lad/lass]，是‘朗姆酒’！

english: Well, see, it's like this.
translation: 嗯，你看，事情是这样的。

english: If we called the stuff we make 'rum' without makin' the little quote gestures every time, then the Cookin' Guild has promised to do entertaininly painful things to us with whisks.
translation: 如果我们每次不做出那个小小的引号手势就把我们制作的神秘物质叫做'朗姆酒'，那么烹饪协会承诺会用打蛋器对我们做一些有趣而痛苦的事情。

english: See, technically -
translation: 你看，严格来说——

english: And by that I mean technically according to the Disposal of Hazardous Waste Act and the Health and Safety Laws -
translation: 我的意思是严格根据《有害废物处理法》和《健康安全法》——

english: technically, what we're brewin' here is Artificially Produced Hyper Condensed Sweetened 'Rum' Flavour Distillate.
translation: 严格来说，我们在这里酿造的是人工生产的高浓缩甜味‘朗姆’风味蒸馏液。

english: Riiiiiiiight...
translation: 对对对对对对……

english: So ye see, [lad/lass], we just call it 'rum' because the real name be a bit of a mouthful.
translation: 所以你看，[lad/lass]，我们就叫它‘朗姆酒’，因为真名太拗口了。

english: Want a drop?
translation: 来一口？

english: No thanks... I think I'll skip it for now.
translation: 不了谢谢……我还是先不喝了。

english: What exactly do you want me to do with this?
translation: 你到底想让我用这个做什么？

english: Arr, well, I want ye to get outside and grow some Blindweed.
translation: 啊，嗯，我想让你出去种些盲草。

english: Best be careful, lad, fer them pirates will skin ye alive if they catch ye.
translation: 最好小心点，小子，那些海盗要是逮到你，会活剥了你的皮。

english: So... how are you holding up?
translation: 那么……你还好吗？

english: Oh Guthix, who am I kidding?
translation: 哦，古斯，我这是在骗谁呢？

english: We're all gonna die!
translation: 我们都死定了！

english: You're one of THEM, aren't you!
translation: 你是他们一伙的，对吧！

english: O...kay...walking away now, smiling and not making eye contact.
translation: 好……吧……走开，微笑着，别对视。

english: Game over, man! Game over!
translation: 游戏结束，老兄！游戏结束！

english: Errr...keep up the good work.
translation: 呃……继续好好干。

english: How do I know you're not one of them?
translation: 我怎么知道你不是他们一伙的？

english: Well, I don't know... the way I'm breathing could give it away.
translation: 嗯，我不知道……我还在呼吸这一点就能暴露了吧。

english: That means nothing! NOTHING!
translation: 那说明不了什么！什么也说明不了！

english: Don't talk to me! If I play this right, I can sell you lot out and make it to the mainland!
translation: 别跟我说话！我要是操作得当，可以把你们卖了，跑回大陆去！

english: No school today mother, my brain hurts real baaaad...
translation: 今天不上学，妈妈，我的脑子疼得真...厉害...

english: I no sleep in many, many, many days.
translation: 我已经好多好多好多天没睡觉了。

english: Don't sneak up on me like that!
translation: 别那样偷偷摸摸靠近我！

english: Don't you know there's a war on?
translation: 你不知道正在打仗吗？

english: I didnt think this counted as a war.
translation: 我不觉得这算打仗。

english: That's because you're a landlubber!
translation: 那是因为你是个旱鸭子！

english: I bet ye've never had to beat a dozen zombies to death with a blunt toothpick!
translation: 我赌你从来没试过用钝牙签打死十几个僵尸！

english: That's right. Have you?
translation: 没错。你干过？

english: No, I've spent most of my time in the toilet to be honest.
translation: 没有，老实说，我大部分时间都蹲在厕所里。

english: Very well, considering.
translation: 就目前情况来说，还不错。

english: Considering what?
translation: 考虑到什么？

english: That I've been crawling into the corner to cry whenever nobody is looking.
translation: 考虑到每次没人看见的时候，我都会爬到角落里哭。

english: What do you want with a priest?
translation: 你找祭司做什么？

english: Well, you could try asking the others.
translation: 嗯，你可以去问问其他人。

english: Trying to get yourself exorcised?
translation: 想找人给你驱魔？

english: What, so you can eat their brains? I won't help you!
translation: 什么，好让你吃他们的脑子？我不会帮你的！

english: Why do you need a priest?! For the last rites? Are we all done for?
translation: 你为什么需要祭司？！为了临终仪式？我们都完蛋了吗？

english: No, I just want you to leave me alone so I can cry in peace.
translation: 不，我只想让你别烦我，好让我安安静静地哭一场。

english: I want to go on the donkey rides, but there is too much sand in my bucket...
translation: 我想去骑驴，但我桶里的沙子太多了……

english: An old priest or a young priest?
translation: 老祭司还是年轻祭司？

english: Well, I'm not a priest, but I must admit I've been praying fervently since the zombies arrived.
translation: 嗯，我不是祭司，但我得承认，自从僵尸来了以后，我一直虔诚地祈祷。

english: That's what they all say!
translation: 他们都这么说！

english: GET AWAY FROM ME, HUMAN WHO I DON'T KNOW!
translation: 离我远点，我不认识的人类！

english: Neither, sorry.
translation: 都不是，抱歉。

english: Were all gonna diiiiiiiie! Flee to the longboats! Run to the hills, run for your lives!
translation: 我们都要死啦！快逃到长船上去！跑向山丘，快逃命吧！

english: A new pair of trousers. Those things are scary.
translation: 一条新裤子。那些东西太吓人了。

english: That was close, just shove off and keep away from me.
translation: 好险，快走开，离我远点。

english: My hovercraft is full of eels...
translation: 我的气垫船里装满了鳗鱼……

english: AS A LOYAL, ZOMBIE PIRATE INFILTRATOR I WOULD NEVER HELP THE LIVING AT ALL!
translation: 作为一名忠诚的僵尸海盗渗透者，我绝不会帮助活人！

english: You're one of THEM arent you!
translation: 你是他们中的一员，对吧！

english: We're saved!
translation: 我们有救了！

english: Hello there, brave heroine, in whom I had total confidence!
translation: 你好啊，勇敢的女英雄，我对你可是信心十足！

english: Such power!
translation: 好强大的力量！

english: Oooh...It's so shiny...
translation: 哦……好闪亮……

english: (Sob) It's so beautiful...
translation: （抽泣）太美了……

english: Wow...I don't feel tired any more...
translation: 哇……我感觉不再累了……

english: I am not worthy to gaze upon it!
translation: 我不配凝视它！

english: Take it away, I am not worthy to be in its Wrenchly presence.
translation: 把它拿走，我不配待在它那充满扳手之力的面前。

english: I can feel the aura of Wrenchly Power radiating from it!
translation: 我能感觉到它散发出的扳手之力光环！

english: Wow... I always thought pirates were tough...
translation: 哇...我一直以为海盗都很强悍……

english: 'Ello guv.
translation: 你好啊，老兄。

english: Why are you not helping out the others?
translation: 你为什么不去帮帮其他人？

english: Well you see, guv, I've got these unshakable religious convictions.
translation: 哎呀，你瞧，老兄，我有一些不可动摇的宗教信仰。

english: And those are?
translation: 那些信仰是？

english: Well, it's like this, see. I used to do a bit of the old priestin' on the side.
translation: 呃，是这样的，你看。我以前业余时间干过一点神父的活儿。

english: You know, collectin' for repairs to the church roof, passing the collection plate, jumble sales, nicking the lead off the temple roof so they needed repairing again.
translation: 你知道的，为修缮教堂屋顶募捐，传递奉献盘，搞旧货义卖，偷走庙宇屋顶的铅皮，这样他们又得花钱修了。

english: Real holy stuff, you know.
translation: 真正的神圣勾当，你懂的。

english: That doesn't sound all that holy to me.
translation: 这听起来可一点不神圣。

english: Well, that's because you're not a man of the cloth are you?
translation: 嗯，那是因为你不是神职人员，对吧？

english: You are, in fact, what we refer to in layman's terms as a punter.
translation: 事实上，用我们外行的话来说，你就是个“顾客”。

english: But anyway, all that priestin' left me with an unshakable faith in three things.
translation: 不过话说回来，那些当神父的经历让我对三件事有着不可动摇的信念。

english: The power of good over evil.
translation: 善良战胜邪恶的力量。

english: The true glory of the human spirit.
translation: 人类灵魂真正的荣耀。

english: And that I ain't goin out there with those things runnin' around.
translation: 还有，我绝不出去跟那些到处乱跑的玩意儿打交道。

english: Excuse me, but...
translation: 打扰一下，但是……

english: Is there any way you could...
translation: 有没有什么办法能让你……

english: ARRR!
translation: 哇啊啊！

english: Is there anyone else I could...
translation: 有没有其他人我可以……

english: Arrrrrrrrrr!!!
translation: 哇啊啊啊啊啊啊啊！！！

english: Fiiine...
Arr! What be ye wantin?
translation: 啊！你想要干啥？

english: I, err, came to...
translation: 我，呃，是来……

english: I have come to tell you to leave.
translation: 我是来叫你们离开的。

english: Ye have?
translation: 你是来……？

english: Hahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: Bwahahahahahahahahahahahaha!
translation: 哇哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: Wheeze...wheeze...
Gadzooks [lad/lass], that be the funniest thing I've heard all day! Say it again!
translation: 哎呀我的天哪，[lad/lass]，这可是我这一天听到最好笑的事了！你再说一遍！

english: Stop [lad/lass]! I'll shatter me ribs!
translation: 住口，[lad/lass]！我的肋骨都要笑断了！

english: I've come to ask you what you want.
translation: 我是来问你们想要什么的。

english: Whadda we want? 'Rum'! When do we want it? Now!
translation: 我们想要啥？'朗姆酒'！啥时候要？现在！

english: So...if I were to give you 'rum' you would leave?
translation: 那……如果我能给你们'朗姆酒'，你们就会离开？

english: Not really [lad/lass]. If ye were to give us 'rum' we'd kill ye quickly, as opposed to over a few weeks.
translation: 其实不会，[lad/lass]。如果你给我们'朗姆酒'，我们会让你死得快一点，而不是拖上几个星期。

english: I've come to join your crew!
translation: 我是来加入你的船队的！

english: Err, I mean...
translation: 呃，我是说……

english: Arr! Shiver me mainbraces and make them landlubbers walk the scurvy plank, Cap'n! I've come to join yer cut- throat, bilge swillin' crew! Also, arr!
translation: 啊！吓得我主桅索都发抖了，让那些旱鸭子走跳板吧，船长！我加入你这凶残、喝脏水的船队了！另外，啊！

english: Are ye quite done, [lad/lass]?
translation: 你说完了吗，[lad/lass]？

english: Yes, for the time being anyway.
translation: 是的，至少暂时说完了。

english: Well, ye'll be glad to know that after that little performance I'd be glad to have ye on me crew!
translation: 嗯，你会很高兴知道，看了刚才那通表演，我很乐意让你加入我的船队！

english: Course, I'll have te kill ye first.
translation: 当然，我得先杀了你。

english: Don't ye worry, [lad/lass]. After we take the island I'll have the boss haul yer body to the temple and...
translation: 别担心，[lad/lass]。等我们拿下这座岛，我会让老大把你的尸体拖到寺庙里……

english: Err, never mind.
translation: 呃，算我没说。

english: Never mind what?
translation: 什么没说过？

english: Ferget I said anything.
translation: 就当我什么都没说。

english: Err...look...an astonishing...thing. There. Behind you.
translation: 呃……看……一件惊世骇俗的……东西。在那里。在你身后。

english: Ye'll have te do better than that, landlubber!
translation: 你得编得像样点，旱鸭子！

english: Hey yerself, landlubber!
translation: 嘿，你这旱鸭子！

english: ...so that you will know exactly what time it is due to the horrible pain in your earlobes!
translation: ……这样你就能根据耳垂的剧痛准确知道时间了！

english: That be the most intimidatin' thing I've ever heard! I'm not messin' with you!
translation: 这是我听过最吓人的话了！我可不惹你！

english: Arr! Prepare to die!
translation: 啊！准备受死！

english: ...meaning you'll need a dozen Ogres and a team of highly skilled surgeons to remove them!
translation: ……意思是你需要一打食人魔和一队技术高超的外科医生才能把它们取出来！

english: Yer goin ter die!
translation: 你死定了！

english: ...so that all you will be able to hear from then on will be the rustling of the ants walking through them!
translation: ……这样从今以后你只能听见蚂蚁在里面爬行的沙沙声了！

english: Yer brave, but stupid!
translation: 你很勇敢，但是很蠢！

english: ...and then I'll use a wrench to remove the handles, so you'll see it every time you cough!
translation: ……然后我会用扳手拧掉把手，这样你每次咳嗽都能看到它！

english: ...and I'll grind up what's left, mix it with lemon juice and throw the whole lot into the ocean!
translation: ……我会把剩下的磨成粉，加上柠檬汁，然后全部倒进海里！

english: Yer a deadman, sez I!
translation: 我说，你是个死人了！

english: ...leading to the eventual, violent explosion of those organs!
translation: ……最终导致那些器官的剧烈爆炸！

english: Egad! 'Tis him!
translation: 天哪！是他！

english: Arrgh! It's him! Run fer it lads!
translation: 啊！是他！快跑啊兄弟们！

english: Egad! 'Tis her!
translation: 天哪！是她！

english: Arrgh! It's her! Run fer it lads!
translation: 啊！是她！快跑啊兄弟们！

english: Be there anything I can say to get out of here undead?
translation: 我能说点什么好让自己活着离开这里吗？

english: Arr! Do what ye like, just don't hurt my face!
translation: 啊！你想怎样都行，就是别伤我的脸！

english: (Gulp) Be there anything ye want, sir?
translation: （咽口水）您想要什么吗，先生？

english: No! Not the flyswatter! I'll be good!
translation: 不！别用苍蝇拍！我会乖乖的！

english: (Gulp) Be there anything ye want, miss?
translation: （咽口水）您想要什么吗，小姐？

english: Here! I have your Blindweed!
translation: 给你！我有你的盲草！

english: Splendid, [lad/lass]! Go shove it in the Intake Hopper upstairs.
translation: 干得好，[lad/lass]！去把它塞进楼上的进料斗里。

english: We'll beat them zombies yet! Arr!
translation: 我们一定能打败那些僵尸！哇啊！

english: Captain... I grew some blindweed but then I lost it...
translation: 船长...我种了一些盲草，但后来把它弄丢了...

english: There there, lad. 'Tis all right.
translation: 好了好了，小伙子。没关系。

english: Here, I've been savin' some fer an emergency.
translation: 拿着，我一直留着一些以备不时之需。

english: Go shove that in the Intake Hopper, and try not ter lose this lot!
translation: 去把它塞进进料斗，这次可别再弄丢了！

english: I want ye to go put yer Blindweed in the intake hopper, and to be sharp about it!
translation: 我要你去把你的盲草放进进料斗，动作快点！

english: And what happens if I lose the Blindweed between here and the intake hopper?
translation: 那如果我把盲草从这拿到进料斗的路上弄丢了会怎样？

english: Theoretically, of course, as it would be almost impossible for me to simply lose the stuff in the time it will take me.
translation: 当然，理论上讲，因为要在那么短的时间里把盲草弄丢几乎是不可能的。

english: Yer nothin' better than a sea-slug wearin', lilly-legged, bandy-livered landlubber!
translation: 你不过是穿着海蛞蝓的、百合腿的、弯肝的旱鸭子！

english: I've got a little put aside fer an emergency. Drop some of that junk yer carryin', and come see me to get it.
translation: 我私下留了一点以备不时之需。把你身上那些垃圾丢掉一些，然后来找我拿。

english: Here, I was savin' a little fer an emergency, so take this and shove it in the hopper before I bung ye in there and turn the handle!
translation: 给你，我留了一点以防万一。拿着这个，把它塞进料斗里，不然我就把你塞进去然后转动把手！

english: You had some all the time?
translation: 你一直都有？

english: Why was I risking my neck killing pirates to grow some if you had some all along?
translation: 既然你一直都有，为什么我还要冒险去杀海盗来种一些盲草？

english: Less talk, lad, haven't ye got a hopper to be fillin'?
translation: 少说废话，小伙子，你不是有料斗要填吗？

english: Less talk, [lad/lass], haven't ye got a hopper to be fillin'?
translation: 少说废话，[lad/lass]，你不是有料斗要填吗？

english: Well, that takes care of the Blindweed. What now?
translation: 嗯，盲草搞定了。现在呢？

english: Well, now ye've shoved the Blindweed into the mix, what we need is a bucket of stagnant water.
translation: 嗯，现在你把盲草加进去了，我们需要一桶死水。

english: Where can I get some of that?
translation: 我从哪能弄到这个？

english: Ye won't have to go far, [lad/lass], we have a pool of the stuff here!
translation: 你不用走远，[lad/lass]，我们这儿就有一池死水！

english: Here in the brewery?
translation: 在酿酒厂里？

english: No, [lad/lass], that would be a strange thing to have in a brewery!
translation: 不，[lad/lass]，酿酒厂里放那东西才奇怪呢！

english: It's up the mountain to the north.
translation: 它在北边的山上。

english: Up a mountain?
translation: 在山上？

english: Well, 'tis technically a volcano, but ye get the general idea.
translation: 嗯，严格来说是一座火山，但你明白大概意思就行。

english: And I assume the place is crawling with these zombies?
translation: 我猜那里到处都是这些僵尸？

english: No [lad/lass], there be not a zombie in sight.
translation: 不，[lad/lass]，那里一个僵尸的影子都看不见。

english: Oh, good!
translation: 哦，那就好！

english: All ye have to do is get past the keen-eyed lookout that's been spottin' my men when I send 'em.
translation: 你只需要通过那个目光敏锐的瞭望手就行，我派去的人都被他发现了。

english: I'll tell ye that it won't be easy!
translation: 我可告诉你，这可不简单！

english: When is it ever...
translation: 什么时候简单过……

english: Don't ferget yer bucket!
translation: 别忘了你的桶！

english: To get off yer lazy behind and head out to the stagnant lake on top of the volcano.
translation: 离开你那懒屁股，去火山顶上的停滞的湖那里。

english: Chop chop, lad.
translation: 快点快点，小伙子。

english: I can't tell ye lad.
translation: 我不能告诉你，小子。

english: Look, lad I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!
translation: 听着，小子，我什么都不会告诉你！趁你还能走，赶紧滚吧！

english: Well ye seem like a lad that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
translation: 嗯，你看起来像个能承受这种故事的小子……那我就告诉你吧……

english: I have to lad, Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
translation: 我必须保密，小子。如果我告诉你，唐尼船长会把我仅剩的一点皮都剥了。

english: No lad!
translation: 不行，小子！

english: I can't tell ye lass.
translation: 我不能告诉你，姑娘。

english: Look, lass I'm not tellin' ye a thing! So clear out while ye still can!
translation: 听着，姑娘，我什么都不会告诉你！趁你还能走，赶紧滚吧！

english: I have to lass, Cap'n Donnie will flay what little is left of me if I told ye.
translation: 我必须保密，姑娘。如果我告诉你，唐尼船长会把我仅剩的一点皮都剥了。

english: Well ye seem like a lass that can handle such a tale...so I'll tell ye...
translation: 嗯，你看起来像个能承受这种故事的姑娘……那我就告诉你吧……

english: No lass!
translation: 不行，姑娘！

english: I want ye to go pour yer bucket into yonder hopper.
translation: 我要你去把桶里的水倒进那边的料斗里。

english: Take yer time, lad, we're only bein' besieged by zombies.
translation: 慢慢来，小伙子，反正我们只是被僵尸围攻而已。

english: Err... Captain...
translation: 呃……船长……

english: Aye, what is it, lad?
translation: 嗯，怎么了，小伙子？

english: Well, on my way over to the hopper some big boy stole the bucket and ran away...
translation: 呃，在去料斗的路上，有个大个子抢走了水桶跑掉了……

english: Well, 'tis a good job I saved a little, isn't it? Now get rid of something so I can give it to ye.
translation: 嗯，还好我多留了一点，不是吗？现在清掉一些东西，我好给你。

english: Give me strength!
translation: 赐我力量吧！

english: If ye weren't so good at distractin' the zombies I'd skin ye alive!
translation: 要不是你这么擅长引开那些僵尸，我早就活剥了你的皮！

english: Take this bucket and pour it into the hopper. If ye don't get it right this time I'll have yer guts fer garters!
translation: 拿这个桶，倒进料斗里。要是这次再搞砸，我就把你的肠子掏出来当吊袜带！

english: So is that everything?
translation: 那就这些了？

english: No, [lad/lass], next ye'll need to go outside and catch five loads of Sluglings fer the brew.
translation: 不，[lad/lass]，接下来你得出去抓五份小蛞蝓来酿酒。

english: What? Sluglings? That's disgusting!
translation: 什么？小蛞蝓？真恶心！

english: Arr, [lad/lass], that it be.
translation: 啊，[lad/lass]，没错。

english: To a weak-stomached, knock-kneed landlubber...
translation: 对于一个肠胃脆弱、膝盖打颤的旱鸭子来说……

english: Why Sluglings?
translation: 为什么是小蛞蝓？

english: 'Cos, [lad/lass] they're one of our super-secret ingredients! Yer not too susceptible to mind control are ye [lad/lass]?
translation: 因为，[lad/lass]，它们是我们超级秘密的原料之一！你应该不太容易受心灵控制吧，[lad/lass]？

english: Because they have been known te, well, influence people every now and again.
translation: 因为众所周知它们时不时会……呃，影响别人。

english: I'm sure ye've got nothing te worry about!
translation: 我相信你没什么好担心的！

english: They aren't related to those Seaslugs are they?
translation: 它们跟那些海蛞蝓没什么关系吧？

english: No [lad/lass], we just call them 'Sluglings' 'cos of a long and convoluted story involvin' a metal pipe and three dead seagulls.
translation: 不，[lad/lass]，我们叫它们'小蛞蝓'只是因为一个又长又曲折的故事，涉及一根金属管道和三只死海鸥。

english: Aye they're related! Tis a good job they'll starve if they tried te eat yer brains!
translation: 没错，它们有关系！幸好它们想吃你脑子的话会饿死！

english: So what should I do with these Sluglings anyway?
translation: 那我到底该怎么处理这些小蛞蝓？

english: Well, Ye shove them in the Pressure Barrel in the attic.
translation: 嗯，你把它们塞进阁楼的压力桶里。

english: And then ye...
translation: 然后你……

english: And then I...
translation: 然后我……

english: Pressurise 'em.
translation: 给它们加压。

english: Pressurise them?!
translation: 给它们加压？！

english: Just a little.
translation: 就一点点。

english: Look, we don't have all day, get movin'.
translation: 听着，我们可没一整天时间，快动起来。

english: Ye'll be needin' a fishbowl in a big net to help ye catch them slimy little blighters.
translation: 你需要一个放在大网里的鱼缸，才能抓住那些黏糊糊的小坏蛋。

english: Pity ye ain't got any free space to carry one.
translation: 可惜你身上没空位带一个。

english: Here. Ye'll need this to catch them.
translation: 拿着。你需要这个来抓它们。

english: What should I do with it?
translation: 我该拿它做什么？

english: Just dunk it in the water. I'm sure a clever [lad/lass] like yerself will have no problem.
translation: 把它浸到水里就行。我相信像你这样聪明的[lad/lass]肯定没问题。

english: Oh, and if ye haul up some squiddy-looking things, don't hesitate to shove 'em in the barrel too.
translation: 哦，如果你捞上来一些像鱿鱼的东西，也别犹豫，一起塞进桶里。

english: They add a special, fishy texture to the drink.
translation: 它们会给酒增加一种特别的鱼腥味。

english: I want ye to go outside and catch five sea creatures from the squid fishin' spot.
translation: 我要你出去，在钓乌贼的地方抓五个海洋生物。

english: When ye've grabbed them, jam 'em in the barrel in the attic and pressurise 'em.
translation: 抓到之后，把它们塞进阁楼的桶里，然后加压。

english: How am I suppost to catch these things?
translation: 我该怎么抓这些东西？

english: Ye'll be needin' to use a fishbowl in a big net to snare these little devils.
translation: 你得用装在大网里的鱼缸来捕捉这些小魔鬼。

english: And if I don't have one?
translation: 要是没有呢？

english: Come see me when yer not so laden down. I've got another one fer ye if ye need it.
translation: 等你身上不那么满的时候再来找我。如果你需要，我还有一个给你。

english: Here! Try not ter lose this one! These things don't grow on trees, ye know.
translation: 拿着！别再弄丢这个了！这东西可不会从树上长出来，知道吗。

english: Gah! Get that slimy thing away from me!
translation: 啊！把那黏糊糊的东西拿开！

english: The slugs are talking to me... They tell me to do bad things...
translation: 蛞蝓在跟我说话……它们让我做坏事……

english: Gimme that!
translation: 给我！

english: Egad... what just happened?
translation: 天呐……刚才怎么了？

english: What happened is ye were messin' about with Sluglings!
translation: 怎么了？你刚才在瞎搞小蛞蝓！

english: Don't ye have anything better to do?
translation: 你就没别的事可干了吗？

english: How could I kill my sluggy brethren...?
translation: 我怎么能杀死我的蛞蝓兄弟……？

english: Snap out of it, [lad/lass]! Yer in slug-shock!
translation: 醒醒，[lad/lass]！你中了蛞蝓休克！

english: Gah! Sorry about that.
translation: 啊！抱歉。

english: No problem. Well, now ye have just one more ingredient to grab, and then we can get this 'rum' flowin!
translation: 没关系。好了，现在你只需再弄一样原料，然后我们就可以让这'朗姆酒'开酿了！

english: Well, how far away will I have to go to grab it?
translation: 那我得走多远去弄它？

english: Not far at all, [lad/lass]. Ye've just got to get it from the basement!
translation: 一点都不远，[lad/lass]。你只需要去地下室拿！

english: Great! What is it?
translation: 太好了！是什么？

english: Hold yer horses, [lad/lass]! While ye was off gallivantin' with yer slimy aquatic playmates, the 'rum' achieved spiritual critical mass.
translation: 先别急，[lad/lass]！你刚才在外面跟你那些黏糊糊的水中玩伴瞎逛的时候，'朗姆酒'达到了灵魂临界质量。

english: To put it in terms ye'll understand: the brewin' equipment is possessed.
translation: 用你能听懂的话说：酿造装备被附身了。

english: Possessed!
translation: 附身了！

english: Don't ye worry yerself about it! This happens all the time.
translation: 别担心！这经常发生。

english: Well, to tell the truth, my lads are a little quicker off the mark, so it only happens occasionally.
translation: 好吧，说实话，我的伙计们手脚麻利点，所以只是偶尔发生。

english: Not that I'm criticisin' yer performance, [lad/lass].
translation: 倒不是批评你的表现，[lad/lass]。

english: Give the controls a couple of belts with this wrench.
translation: 用这个扳手敲几下控制器。

english: One of the lads did a little priestin' on the side before he came here. Get him to bless it and ye'll do fine.
translation: 有个伙计来这里之前干过点祭司的活。让他祝福一下这扳手，你就搞定了。

english: I want yeto go clear the Evil Spirit out of the brewin' controls. Use the wrench I gave ye, but get it blessed first.
translation: 我要你去把酿造控制器里的恶灵赶走。用我给你的扳手，但得先让人祝福它。

english: Mumblemumblewhatwrenchmumble...
translation: 嘀咕嘀咕什么扳手嘀咕……

english: What were that?
translation: 你说什么？

english: I said, what if I've lost the wrench?
translation: 我说，万一我把扳手弄丢了呢？

english: Arr, ye landlubber!
translation: 啊，你这旱鸭子！

english: Calm down, remember yer ulcer...
translation: 冷静点，别忘了你的溃疡……

english: Look, I've got another wrench, but ye don't have any free space fer it. Come back when ye do.
translation: 听着，我还有一个扳手，但你身上没空位拿。等有了空位再来。

english: Arr! I'd get more work out of a minty flavoured brick!
translation: 啊！我拿块薄荷味的砖块都比你有用！

english: If ye lose this one I'll have ye turned inside out, covered with spiders and turned rightside in so they'll eat ye alive!
translation: 你要是再弄丢这个，我就把你里外翻个底朝天，涂满蜘蛛，再翻回来让它们活活吃掉你！

english: Steady on!
translation: 悠着点！

english: Come out and face me!
translation: 出来面对我！

english: You used to be a priest, right?
translation: 你以前当过祭司，对吧？

english: I didn't nick anything, guv. I've got twenty people who'll swear blind I was...
translation: 我没偷任何东西，长官。我有二十个人可以发誓证明我...

english: Never mind. I need some help with the spirit in the brewing equipment.
translation: 算了。我需要你帮忙对付酿造装备里的灵魂。

english: Well, I'll bless something for you if you need it, but just don't spread it around that I'm giving out freebies.
translation: 好吧，如果你需要，我可以帮你祝福点东西，但别到处说我在白送。

english: Trust me, guv, lots of people need help after coming into contact with the spirits we produce here.
translation: 相信我，老大，很多人接触了我们这里产的烈酒后都需要帮助。

english: Can you bless this wrench for me?
translation: 你能帮我祝福这把扳手吗？

english: Nope?
translation: 不行？

english: Nope. You don't strike me as being... devout, you know?
translation: 不行。你看上去不像……虔诚的人，你知道吗？

english: Your holy aura, it's a little shoddy, if you catch my drift.
translation: 你的神圣光环有点破烂，你懂我意思吧。

english: You need a Prayer level of 47.
translation: 你需要祈祷等级达到47。

english: Well why didn't you just say so?
translation: 那你为什么不早说？

english: I might have had a bit of an overestimation problem guv. I'm sure it won't happen again.
translation: 我可能有点高估你了，老大。我保证不会再有下次了。

english: I might well do. Remember, only the first one's free.
translation: 我也许会帮你。记住，只有第一次免费。

english: Dominoes Ad Nauseum, Romanes Eunt Domus.
translation: 多米诺骨牌令人作呕，罗马人回家去。

english: Sorted.
translation: 搞定了。

english: Oh, you want the full package deal.
translation: 哦，你想要全套包裹服务。

english: All right. Brace yourself.
translation: 好吧。做好准备。

english: Groovy.
translation: 真棒。

english: No problem, guv. Good luck with your little problem.
translation: 没问题，老大。祝你好运解决你的小麻烦。

english: You might find that little wrench worth hanging on to after you're done with the Spirit.
translation: 处理完灵魂之后，你可能会发现那把小扳手值得留着。

english: Really? I mean, it's holy and everything, but I don't think it looks all that useful.
translation: 真的？我是说，它虽然是圣物什么的，但我觉得看起来没那么有用。

english: Well, it may not look much, but you'll find that you might need a few less prayer potions if you have it in your pack, if you know what I mean.
translation: 嗯，它可能不起眼，但如果你把它放在包里，你会发现需要祈祷药水少一些，你懂的。

english: Well, no.I don't know what you mean, but I'm sure I'll find out!
translation: 呃，不。我不明白你的意思，但我肯定会发现的！

english: You mean more help? I've already blessed one wrench for you, that should be enough.
translation: 你是说还要帮忙？我已经帮你祝福了一把扳手，应该够了。

english: I might well do.  Remember, only the first one's free.
translation: 我可能会。记住，只有第一次是免费的。

english: I didn't nick anything, miss. I've got twenty people who'll swear blind I was...
translation: 我没偷任何东西，小姐。我有二十个人可以发誓证明我...

english: Trust me, miss, lots of people need help after coming into contact with the spirits we produce here.
translation: 相信我，小姐，很多人在接触了我们这里生产的烈酒后都需要帮助。

english: No problem, miss. Good luck with your little problem.
translation: 没问题，小姐。祝你解决你的小问题顺利。

english: You need a Prayer of 47.
translation: 你需要祈祷等级达到47。

english: Ello again miss. I take it you're here about the wrench?
translation: 又见面了，小姐。我猜你是为了扳手来的？

english: Well miss, maybe that's what I want you to think.
translation: 嗯，小姐，也许这正是我想让你这么想的。

english: I might have had a bit of an overestimation problem miss. I'm sure it won't happen again.
translation: 我可能有点估计错误的问题，小姐。我保证不会再发生了。

english: Ello again miss. How's things?
translation: 又见面了，小姐。最近怎么样？

english: Nothin' miss, you just have a nice day.
translation: 没什么，小姐，祝你今天愉快。

english: 'Ello miss.
translation: 你好，小姐。

english: Well you see, miss, I've got these unshakable religious convictions.
translation: 嗯，你看，小姐，我有不可动摇的宗教信仰。

english: Well, that's because you're not a woman of the cloth are you?
translation: 嗯，那是因为你不是神职人员，对吧？

english: I want ye to go clear the Evil Spirit out of the brewin' controls. Use the wrench I gave ye, but get it blessed first.
translation: 我要你去把酿造控制器里的恶灵赶走。用我给你的扳手，但得先让人祝福它。

english: I see ye've got the wrench good and blessed, so go whack the controls till the Evil Spirit pops out.
translation: 我看到你把扳手好好祝福过了，所以去敲控制器，直到恶灵蹦出来。

english: I see ye've got the wrench good and blessed, so go whack the hopper 'til the Evil Spirit pops out.
translation: 我看到你把扳手好好祝福过了，所以去敲料斗，直到恶灵蹦出来。

english: The power of Guthix compels you!
translation: 古斯的力量驱策着你！

english: Well, now that ye've got that spirit out of there ye can dump in the final ingredient.
translation: 好了，既然你把那个灵魂赶出去了，就可以倒进最后一种原料了。

english: We need the body of a diseased Fever Spider!
translation: 我们需要一只患有疾病的热病蜘蛛的尸体！

english: Remind me never to drink anything you have ever made. Or touched.
translation: 提醒我永远别喝你做过的任何东西。或者碰过的任何东西。

english: When yer quite done flappin' yer lips, go down into the basement and whack spiders until ye find a fever spider body.
translation: 等你那张嘴皮子耍够了，就下到地下室去砍蜘蛛，直到找到一具热病蜘蛛的尸体。

english: Shove it in the hopper, and then we're in business.
translation: 把它塞进料斗里，然后咱们就开工了。

english: Ye may want to hop back to the mainland and see a Slayer Master.
translation: 你或许该回大陆一趟，去找个杀戮大师。

english: These Fever Spiders carry a nasty disease, and ye'll need a pair of Slayer Gloves on to not catch it!
translation: 这些热病蜘蛛携带一种恶疾，你得戴上一副杀戮者手套才能避免感染！

english: I see yer already wearin' some Slayer Gloves. That'll keep the Fever Spiders from gnawin' yer hands off!
translation: 我看你已经戴了杀戮者手套。这样热病蜘蛛就啃不到你的手了！

english: I want ye to go kill a Fever Spider and jam its body in the hopper.
translation: 我要你去杀一只热病蜘蛛，然后把它的尸体塞进料斗里。

english: Whenever yer ready, [lad/lass].
translation: 你准备好了就动手吧，[lad/lass]。

english: What are ye doin', [lad/lass]? I want ye to shove that in the hopper, not in me face!
translation: 你在干什么，[lad/lass]？我要你把它塞进料斗，不是塞我脸上！

english: Ye just can't get good help these days...
translation: 如今真是找不到好帮手了……

english: Well, I stuck your spider in the hopper, what now?
translation: 好了，我把你的蜘蛛塞进料斗了，接下来呢？

english: Now ye stand well back and watch the glory of brewin' at its best!
translation: 现在你退后站好，好好欣赏酿酒艺术的巅峰之作！

english: Aye [lad/lass]! Now get outside and feed that stuff to the pirates.
translation: 没错，[lad/lass]！现在出去，把那些神秘物质喂给海盗们。

english: Try givin' it to the Captain, he's in charge. Get him bladdered and the rest will fall!
translation: 试试把它给船长，他是头儿。把他灌醉，剩下的就好办了！

english: Ye'll need to use that bucket of yours. Most stuff can't stand bein' in contact with our 'rum' fer too long.
translation: 你得用上你的桶。大多数东西都受不了跟咱们的‘朗姆酒’接触太久。

english: Took us a lot of dissolvin' to work that one out.
translation: 我们可是溶解了不少东西才搞明白的。

english: So, what did he say?
translation: 那么，他说了什么？

english: The Cap'n!
translation: 船长！

english: Oh! I haven't spoken to him yet!
translation: 哦！我还没跟他说话呢！

english: Well, get a move on!
translation: 那就赶紧的！

english: And don't ferget the 'rum'!
translation: 别忘了‘朗姆酒’！

english: Be that the finest, most abrasive 'rum' I've ever smelled?
translation: 这就是我闻过的最上等、最烈性的‘朗姆酒’？

english: Yes! That it be!
translation: 没错！正是！

english: Hand it over or I'll run ye through!
translation: 把它交出来，不然我就捅了你！

english: Ye be a good [lad/lass], fer a filthy livin' landlubber.
translation: 你是个好[lad/lass]，就一个肮脏的旱鸭子来说。

english: So... I take it your boss will be pleased?
translation: 那么……我想你的老板会很高兴？

english: Arr, that he will. I'll tell...
translation: 啊，他会的。我会告诉……

english: Wait a minute...
translation: 等一下……

english: Arr, ye tricky dog!
translation: 啊，你这狡猾的狗东西！

english: Ye tried to trick old Donnie!
translation: 你想骗老唐尼！

english: Oh well, I guess I'll have to try again.
translation: 哦好吧，看来我得再试一次了。

english: Arr, [lad/lass], you tried to trick me, but i was too clever for ye!
translation: 啊，[lad/lass]，你想骗我，但我比你聪明多了！

english: Besides, Rabid Jack would have my hide if I told ye it were him that sent me!
translation: 再说了，要是我告诉你派我来的是狂犬杰克，他会扒了我的皮！

english: I'm sure he would. Good job you caught me out, eh!
translation: 他肯定会的。还好你识破了我，对吧！

english: Aye! Now get ye gone, and don't return without more 'rum'!
translation: 没错！现在滚吧，不带更多‘朗姆酒’就别回来！

english: Hey you! I can smell the 'rum' on ye!
translation: 嘿，你！我闻到你身上的‘朗姆酒’味了！

english: If it isn't in my belly by the time I cout ter three, I'll have ye flogged!
translation: 要是我数到三它还没进我肚子里，我就叫人抽你鞭子！

english: Arrr...that hits the spot...
translation: 啊……真过瘾……

english: Arr, lad, you tried to trick me, but I was too clever for ye!
translation: 啊，小子，你想骗我，但我太聪明了，你没得逞！

english: Ye be a good lad, fer a filthy livin' landlubber.
translation: 你是个好小子，虽然是个肮脏的活旱鸭子。

english: Arr, lass, you tried to trick me, but I was too clever for ye!
translation: 啊，姑娘，你想骗我，但我太聪明了，你没得逞！

english: Ye be a good lass, fer a filthy livin' landlubber.
translation: 你是个好姑娘，虽然是个肮脏的活旱鸭子。

english: Not really lad. If ye were to give us 'rum' we'd kill ye quickly, as opposed to over a few weeks.
translation: 其实不是，小子。如果你给我们“朗姆酒”，我们会让你死得快一点，而不是拖上几个星期。

english: Are ye quite done, lad?
translation: 你说完了吗，小子？

english: Don't ye worry, lad. After we take the island I'll have the boss haul yer body to the temple and...
translation: 别担心，小子。等我们拿下这座岛，我会让老大把你的尸体拖到神庙去，然后……

english: Stop lad! I'll shatter me ribs!
translation: 住手，小子！我的肋骨要碎了！

english: Not really lass. If ye were to give us 'rum' we'd kill ye quickly, as opposed to over a few weeks.
translation: 其实不是，姑娘。如果你给我们“朗姆酒”，我们会让你死得快一点，而不是拖上几个星期。

english: Gadzooks lad, that be the funniest thing I've heard all day! Say it again!
translation: 天哪，小子，这是我今天听到最好笑的事！再说一遍！

english: Are ye quite done, lass?
translation: 你说完了吗，姑娘？

english: Don't ye worry, lass. After we take the island I'll have the boss haul yer body to the temple and...
translation: 别担心，姑娘。等我们拿下这座岛，我会让老大把你的尸体拖到神庙去，然后……

translation: 住手，姑娘！我的肋骨要碎了！

english: Gadzooks lass, that be the funniest thing I've heard all day! Say it again!
translation: 天哪，姑娘，这是我今天听到最好笑的事！再说一遍！

english: No lass, not irons, Runes!
translation: 不，姑娘，不是铁，是符文！

english: Arr, yer a good lass...
translation: 啊，你是个好姑娘……

english: Not much that was coherent.
translation: 没几句是连贯的。

english: Who is Rabid Jack?
translation: 狂犬杰克是谁？

english: Rabid Jack!
translation: 狂犬杰克！

english: THE Rabid Jack!
translation: 那个狂犬杰克！

english: Egad...I haven't heard that name...
translation: 天哪……我还没听过那个名字……

english: ...before.
translation: ……之前。

english: So, who is he?
translation: 那么，他是谁？

english: Dunno [lad/lass].
translation: 不知道，[lad/lass]。

english: Almost as if I aren't changing subjects, well done!
translation: 就好像我没在转移话题似的，干得好！

english: With those rottin' dogs legless they'll never keep fighting us now, so we've decided to stay here and keep the 'rum' flowin!
translation: 那些腐烂的狗东西喝得烂醉如泥，再也没法跟咱们打了，所以我们决定留在这儿，让‘朗姆酒’继续流！

english: Thanks, [lad/lass]. We'd never have managed without ye!
translation: 谢了，[lad/lass]。没你我们可搞不定！

english: Well, ye shove them in the Pressure Barrel in the attic.
translation: 嗯，你把它们塞进阁楼的那个压力桶里就行了。

english: No, lad, next ye'll need to go outside and catch five loads of Sluglings fer the brew.
translation: 不，小伙子，接下来你得出去抓五份小蛞蝓来酿酒。

english: Arr, lad, that it be.
translation: 啊，小伙子，就是这样。

english: 'Cos, lad they're one of our super-secret ingredients!
translation: 因为，小伙子，它们可是我们的超级秘密原料之一！

english: Ye won't have to go far, lad, we have a pool of the stuff here!
translation: 你不用走远，小伙子，我们这儿就有一池子那神秘物质！

english: No, lad, that would be a strange thing to have in a brewery!
translation: 不，小伙子，酿酒厂里有那玩意儿才奇怪呢！

english: Snap out of it, lad! Yer in slug-shock!
translation: 醒醒，小伙子！你被蛞蝓吓着了！

english: No lad, there be not a zombie in sight.
translation: 不，小伙子，这儿一个僵尸都看不见。

english: Not far at all, lad. Ye've just got to get it from the basement!
translation: 一点都不远，小伙子。你只要从地下室拿就行了！

english: Hold yer horses, lad! While ye was off gallivantin' with yer slimy aquatic playmates, the 'rum' achieved spiritual critical mass.
translation: 慢着，小伙子！你跑去跟那些黏糊糊的水中玩伴鬼混的时候，这锅“朗姆酒”已经达到了灵魂临界质量。

english: Aye lad! Now get outside and feed that stuff to the pirates.
translation: 啊，小伙子！现在出去把那东西喂给海盗们。

english: Just dunk it in the water. I'm sure a clever lad like yerself will have no problem.
translation: 把它浸到水里就行。我相信像你这样聪明的小伙子肯定没问题。

english: Dunno lad.
translation: 不知道，小伙子。

english: Are ye alright, lad?
translation: 你没事吧，小伙子？

english: Arr. Well, lad, that would be Pete, one of my men.
translation: 啊。嗯，小伙子，那是皮特，我的一个手下。

english: These be dark times, though, lad. See, a week ago we awoke to find ourselves beseiged.
translation: 不过现在世道艰难啊，小伙子。你看，一周前我们醒来时发现被包围了。

english: Arr, lad! That they are!
translation: 啊，小伙子！没错！

english: When ye arrived ye took a nasty knock to the head, so ye probably don't remember agreein' to help us out. But I swear to ye that ye did.
translation: 你来的时候脑袋狠狠挨了一下，所以可能不记得答应过帮我们了。但我发誓你真的答应了。

english: Well, fer a price, at any rate.
translation: 嗯，反正是要收费的。

english: Seems they lost their fightin' spirit after the first few days. Now most of them just protest all the time.
translation: 看来最初几天后他们就失去了斗志。现在他们大多数只是不停地抗议。

english: No lad, we just call them 'Sluglings' 'cos of a long and convoluted story involvin' a metal pipe and three dead seagulls.
translation: 不，小伙子，我们叫它们“小蛞蝓”是因为一个又长又绕的故事，跟一根金属管道和三只死海鸥有关。

english: Splendid, lad! Go shove it in the Intake Hopper upstairs.
translation: 太好了，小伙子！去把它塞进楼上那个进料斗里。

english: Yer not too susceptible to mind control are ye lad?
translation: 你不太容易被精神控制吧，小伙子？

english: Thanks, lad. We'd never have managed without ye!
translation: 谢谢，小伙子。没你我们真不行！

english: Not that I'm criticisin' yer performance, lad.
translation: 我不是在批评你的表现，小伙子。

english: Here, lad. I'll give ye the seed you'll need fer growin' the herb. Help yerself to the gardenin' equipment in the basement.
translation: 拿着，小伙子。我给你种草药需要的种子。地下室里的园艺装备随便用。

english: Ye'll need to use that bucket of yours.  Most stuff can't stand bein' in contact with our 'rum' fer too long.
translation: 你得用你那个桶。大多数东西都不能跟我们的“朗姆酒”接触太久。

english: I want ye to go pour that bucket into yonder hopper.
translation: 我要你去把那桶倒进那边的料斗里。

english: They'll give it to ye if ye aren't wearin' somethin' too thick fer them to bite through.
translation: 它们会咬你的，前提是你穿得不够厚让它们咬不穿。

translation: 我不是在批评你的表现，姑娘。

english: Here, ye'll need to use one of these.  The rum tends to eat through almost everything else.
translation: 拿着，你得用这个。朗姆酒几乎能腐蚀其他所有东西。

english: Here, lass. I'll give ye the seed you'll need fer growin' the herb. Help yerself to the gardenin' equipment in the basement.
translation: 拿着，姑娘。我给你种草药需要的种子。地下室里的园艺装备随便用。

english: Take yer time, lad, we're only bein' beseiged by zombies.
translation: 慢慢来，小伙子，我们不过是正被僵尸围攻而已。

english: Splendid, lad! Go shove it in the intake hopper.
translation: 太好了，小伙子！去把它塞进进料斗里。

english: Ye'll be wanting to put them Slayer Gloves of yours on before ye head off lad, as those Fever Spiders carry a nasty disease.

english: Ye'll be wanting to put them Slayer Gloves of yours on before ye head off lass, as those Fever Spiders carry a nasty disease.
