english: Fancy some 'rum', lad? It's still fresh. Well, fresh-ish...
translation: 想来点“朗姆酒”吗，小伙子？还是新鲜的。嗯，还算新鲜吧……

english: Fancy some 'rum', lass? It's still fresh. Well, fresh-ish...
translation: 想来点“朗姆酒”吗，姑娘？还是新鲜的。嗯，还算新鲜吧……

english: 'Rum', lad!
translation: “朗姆酒”，小伙子！

english: Take yer time, lass, we're only bein' besieged by zombies.
translation: 慢慢来，姑娘，我们不过是正被僵尸围攻而已。

english: No, lad, 'rum'!
translation: 不，小伙子，是“朗姆酒”！

english: I want ye to jam that body into the hopper and come see me.
translation: 我要你把那具尸体塞进料斗里，然后来见我。

english: Whenever yer ready, lad.
translation: 你准备好了就行动，小伙子。

english: So ye see, lad, we just call it 'rum' because the real name be a bit of a mouthful.
translation: 所以你看，小伙子，我们叫它“朗姆酒”是因为它的真名太拗口了。

english: Arr, lad, 'tis true.
translation: 啊，小伙子，确实如此。

english: Arr! Yer not as slow as I took ye fer!
translation: 啊！你没我想的那么迟钝嘛！

english: Well' lad, it seems the fumes from that first batch of me 'rum' did strange things to me brain.
translation: 嗯，小伙子，看来我那第一批“朗姆酒”的蒸汽对我的大脑产生了奇怪的影响。

english: 'Rum', lass!
translation: “朗姆酒”，姑娘！

english: What are ye doin', lad?  I want ye to shove that in the hopper, not in me face!
translation: 你在干什么，小伙子？我要你把它塞进料斗里，不是塞我脸上！

english: No, lass, 'rum'!
translation: 不，姑娘，是“朗姆酒”！

english: So ye see, lass, we just call it 'rum' because the real name be a bit of a mouthful.
translation: 所以你看，姑娘，我们叫它“朗姆酒”是因为它的真名太拗口了。

english: Arr, lass, 'tis true.
translation: 啊，姑娘，确实如此。

english: Well' lass, it seems the fumes from that first batch of me 'rum' did strange things to me brain.
translation: 嗯，姑娘，看来我那第一批“朗姆酒”的蒸汽对我的大脑产生了奇怪的影响。

english: Whenever yer ready, lass.
translation: 你准备好了就行动，姑娘。

english: Ye can help yerself to the gardenin' equipment in the basement, just be quick about it!
translation: 地下室里的园艺装备你随便用，快点就行！

english: Best be careful, lass, fer them pirates will skin ye alive if they catch ye.
translation: 最好小心点，姑娘，那些海盗要是抓到你，会活剥了你的皮。

english: Finally, lad! Here, take this seed and grow us some Blindweed.
translation: 终于好了，小伙子！拿着这颗种子，给我们种些盲草。

english: Wouldn't want them pirates to trample all over 'em, would ye?
translation: 你总不希望那些海盗把它们踩得稀巴烂吧？

english: Well, I have some Blindweed seeds fer ye. When ye have some free space fer them, come and talk to me.
translation: 嗯，我这里有些盲草种子给你。等你有空位了，就来跟我聊聊。

english: What are ye doin', lass?  I want ye to shove that in the hopper, not in me face!
translation: 你在干什么，姑娘？我要你把它塞进料斗里，不是塞我脸上！

english: Ye'll need ter keep an eye on yer plants, lad.
translation: 你得留意你的植物，小伙子。

english: Finally, lass! Here, take this seed and grow us some Blindweed.
translation: 终于好了，姑娘！拿着这颗种子，给我们种些盲草。

english: Well, lad, if ye wrap that fishbowl yer carryin' in a big net then ye'll have a fishbowl in a big net, won't ye?
translation: 嗯，小伙子，如果你把你拿着的那个鱼缸用一张大网包起来，那你就会得到一个用大网包着的鱼缸，对吧？

english: Chop chop, lass.
translation: 快点，姑娘。

english: Ye'll need ter keep an eye on yer plants, lass.
translation: 你得留意你的植物，姑娘。

english: Well, lass, if ye wrap that fishbowl yer carryin' in a big net then ye'll have a fishbowl in a big net, won't ye?
translation: 嗯，姑娘，如果你把你拿着的那个鱼缸用一张大网包起来，那你就会得到一个用大网包着的鱼缸，对吧？

english: Arr... Here, lad. Just take this and get goin'!
translation: 啊……拿着，小伙子。拿着这个就出发吧！

english: Yer lucky all my precious fish died last week, lad. Take this and wrap it in that net, then go grab some Sluglings!
translation: 算你走运，小伙子，我那些珍贵的鱼上周全死了。拿着这个，用那张网包起来，然后去抓些小蛞蝓！

english: Gah! I don't believe it!
translation: 咳！我真不敢相信！

english: Here, wrap this around yer fishbowl and get back out there!
translation: 拿着，把这个包在你的鱼缸上，然后回去继续干！

english: Arr... Here, lass. Just take this and get goin'!
translation: 啊……拿着，姑娘。拿着这个就出发吧！

english: Yer lucky all my precious fish died last week, lass. Take this and wrap it in that net, then go grab some Sluglings!
translation: 算你走运，姑娘，我那些珍贵的鱼上周全死了。拿着这个，用那张网包起来，然后去抓些小蛞蝓！

english: Well, I need ye to go grow me some Blindweed, but ye are carryin' too much stuff fer me to give ye the seed.
translation: 嗯，我需要你去给我种些盲草，但你身上带的东西太多了，我没法给你种子。

english: We've got a special item fer dealin' with this problem. Dump some of that stuff yer carryin' and I'll hand it over!
translation: 我们有一件专门对付这个问题的东西。把你带的东西倒掉一些，我就把它交给你！

english: Well, when yer not too busy makin' daisy chains and lyin' about with a big grin on yer face, I would be most pleased if ye'd bring me some Blindweed.
translation: 嗯，当你不忙着编雏菊花环、面带傻笑地躺着的时候，如果你能给我带些盲草来，我会非常高兴。

english: Hint, hint lass.
translation: 暗示一下你，姑娘。

english: Less talk, lass, haven't ye got a hopper to be fillin'?
translation: 少说话，姑娘，你不是还有料斗要填吗？

english: Hint, hint lad.
translation: 暗示一下你，小伙子。

english: Aye, what is it, lass?
translation: 啊，什么事，姑娘？

english: There there, lass. 'Tis all right.
translation: 好了好了，姑娘。没事的。

english: Oh, and don't try using anything but a bucket. Our 'rum' tends to eat through stuff.
translation: 哦，还有，别用桶以外的东西。我们的“朗姆酒”会腐蚀东西。

english: Well, I'll give ye a net fer that fishbowl of yours if ye'll drop some of that clutter in yer pack.
translation: 嗯，如果你肯扔掉背包里的一些杂物，我就用你的鱼缸换一张网。

english: Well, I wouldn't describe it as a quest, but there is something I could use some help with.
translation: 嗯，我不会把这称为任务，但确实有件事需要你帮忙。

english: We were recently sorting through some of the things stored down in the cellar, and we found this old talisman.
translation: 我们最近在清理地窖里存放的一些东西时，发现了这个旧护符。

english: The Order of Wizards over at the Wizards' Tower have been on the hunt for magical artefacts recently. I wonder if this might be just the kind of thing they're after.
translation: 法师塔的巫师教团最近一直在搜寻魔法文物。我在想这会不会正是他们要找的东西。

english: Would you be willing to take it to them for me?
translation: 你愿意替我把这个送去给他们吗？

english: Thank you very much. You'll find the Wizards' Tower south west of here, across the bridge from Draynor Village. When you arrive, look for Sedridor. He is the Archmage of the wizards there.
translation: 非常感谢。法师塔在这西南方向，穿过德雷诺村的桥就是了。到了之后，找赛德里多。他是那里的首席法师。

english: As you wish. Hopefully I can find someone else to help.
translation: 随你便。希望我能找到别人帮忙。

english: Did you take that talisman to Sedridor?
translation: 你把那个护符带给赛德里多了吗？

english: No, I lost it.
translation: 没有，我弄丢了。

english: Ah, well that explains things. One of my servants found it outside, and it seemed too much of a coincidence that another would suddenly show up.
translation: 啊，那就说得通了。我的一个仆人在外面找到了它，要是另一个突然出现也太巧了。

english: Here, take it to the Wizards' Tower, south west of here. Please try not to lose it this time.
translation: 给你，把它带到西南边的法师塔去。这次请别再弄丢了。

english: Take that talisman I gave you to Sedridor at the Wizards' Tower. You'll find it south west of here, across the bridge from Draynor Village.
translation: 把我给你的护符带到法师塔的赛德里多那里。塔在这西南方，穿过德雷诺村的桥就到了。

english: Welcome adventurer, to the world renowned Wizards' Tower, home to the Order of Wizards. We are the oldest and most prestigious group of wizards around. Now, how may I help you?
translation: 欢迎冒险者，来到举世闻名的法师塔，巫师教团的所在地。我们是现存最古老、最负盛名的法师团体。那么，我能帮你什么忙？

english: Are you Sedridor?
translation: 你是赛德里多吗？

english: Sedridor? What is it you want with him?
translation: 赛德里多？你找他有什么事？

english: The Duke of Lumbridge sent me to find him. I have this talisman he found. He said Sedridor would be interested in it.
translation: 仑桥镇公爵派我来找他。我带着他找到的这个护符。他说赛德里多会感兴趣的。

english: Did he now? Well hand it over then, and we'll see what all the hubbub is about.
translation: 他是这么说的？那就把它交出来吧，我们来看看是怎么回事。

english: Hmm... Doesn't seem to be anything too special. Just a normal air talisman by the looks of things. Still, looks can be deceiving. Let me take a closer look...
translation: 嗯……看起来没什么特别的。只不过是个普通的风护符。不过，外表可能具有欺骗性。让我仔细看看……

english: How interesting... It would appear I spoke too soon. There's more to this talisman than meets the eye. In fact, it may well be the last piece of the puzzle.
translation: 真有意思……看来我说得太早了。这个护符不像表面看起来那么简单。事实上，它很可能就是拼图的最后一块。

english: Puzzle?
translation: 拼图？

english: Indeed! The lost legacy of the first tower. This talisman may in fact be key to finding the forgotten essence mine!
translation: 没错！第一座塔失落的遗产。这个护符实际上是找到被遗忘的精华矿的关键！

english: First tower? Forgotten essence mine? What are you on about?
translation: 第一座塔？被遗忘的精华矿？你在说什么？

english: Ah, my apologies, adventurer. Allow me to fill you in.
translation: 啊，抱歉，冒险者。让我来告诉你详情。

english: As you are likely aware, when we cast spells, we do so using the power of runes.
translation: 你可能知道，我们施法时使用的是符文的力量。

english: These runes are crafted from a highly unique material, and then imbued with magical power from various runic altars. Different altars create different runes with different magical effects.
translation: 这些符文是用一种非常独特的材料制作而成，然后从各种符文祭坛中注入魔法力量。不同的祭坛会制造出具有不同魔法效果的符文。

english: The process of imbuing runes is called runecrafting. Legend has it that this was once a common art, but the secrets of how to do it were lost until just under two hundred years ago.
translation: 为符文注入力量的过程叫作符文制造术。传说这曾是一种常见的技艺，但它的秘密失传了，直到不到两百年前才重新被发现。

english: The rediscovery of runecrafting had such a large impact on the world, that it marked the dawn of the Fifth Age. It also resulted in the birth of our order, and the construction of the first Wizards' Tower.
translation: 符文工艺的重新发现对世界产生了如此巨大的影响，以至于标志着第五纪元的黎明。它也导致了我们教团的诞生，以及第一座法师塔的建造。

english: If it was the first tower, I'm guessing it doesn't exist anymore? What happened?
translation: 如果是第一座塔，我猜它已经不存在了吧？发生了什么？

english: It was burnt down by traitorous members of our own order. They followed the evil god of chaos, Zamorak, and they wished to claim our magical discoveries in his name.
translation: 它被我们教团内部的叛徒烧毁了。他们追随混沌邪神萨莫拉克，想要以他的名义夺取我们的魔法发现。

english: When the tower burnt down, much was lost, including an important incantation. A spell that could be used to teleport to a hidden essence mine.
translation: 塔被烧毁时，很多东西都遗失了，包括一个重要的咒语。一个可以传送到隐藏精华矿的法术。

english: The essence mine you mentioned earlier, I assume?
translation: 就是你之前提到的精华矿，对吧？

english: Precisely. Rune essence is the material used to make runes, but it is incredibly rare. That essence mine was the only place it could be found that our order knew of.
translation: 正是。符文精华是制造符文的材料，但它极为稀有。那个精华矿是我们教团所知的唯一能开采到它的地方。

english: Since the incantation was lost, we have struggled to maintain our stocks of rune essence.
translation: 自从咒语失传后，我们就一直难以维持符文精华的储备。

english: There are seemingly those out there that still know where to find some, but while they have been willing to sell essence to us, they have refused to share knowledge on how to find it ourselves.
translation: 似乎外面有些人仍然知道去哪里找到一些，但他们虽然愿意卖精华给我们，却拒绝分享我们自己寻找的方法。

english: I'm starting to see why this is so important. So you think this talisman can help you rediscover that incantation?
translation: 我开始明白为什么这这么重要了。那么你觉得这个护符能帮你重新发现那个咒语？

english: I do! All magic leaves traces, and from what I can tell, this talisman was used heavily during the time of the first tower.
translation: 我知道！所有魔法都会留下痕迹，而且据我所知，这个护符在第一座塔时期被大量使用。

english: It would have been taken to the essence mine many times, and the magical energies there will have left an imprint on it. To think that it was hidden in Lumbridge all this time!
translation: 它曾被多次带到精华矿，那里的魔法能量会在上面留下印记。没想到它一直藏在仑桥镇！

english: It is critical I share this discovery with my associate, Aubury, as soon as possible. He's not much of a wizard, but he's an expert on runecrafting, and his insight will be essential.
translation: 我必须尽快与我的同事奥伯里分享这个发现。他算不上一个真正的魔法师，但他是符文制作方面的专家，他的见解至关重要。

english: Would you be willing to visit him for me? I would go myself, but I wish to study this talisman some more.
translation: 你愿意替我去拜访他吗？我本可以自己去，但我想再多研究一下这个护符。

english: He runs a rune shop in the south east of Varrock. Please, take this package of research notes to him. If all goes well, the secrets of the essence mine may soon be ours once more!
translation: 他在维洛克城东南部经营一家符文商店。请把这包研究笔记带给他。如果一切顺利，精华矿的秘密可能很快就会再次属于我们！

english: Best of luck, [player name].
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。

english: I don't remember telling you my name... How do you know it?
translation: 我不记得告诉过你我的名字……你怎么知道的？

english: Really now? I am the Archmage you know.
translation: 真的吗？我可是首席法师啊。

english: As you wish adventurer. I will continue to study this talisman you have brought me. Return here if you find yourself with some spare time to help me.
translation: 如你所愿，冒险者。我会继续研究你带来的这个护符。如果你有空来帮我，就回到这里。

english: Actually, I'm not interested.
translation: 其实，我不感兴趣。

english: Oh... Well I guess the short of it is that this talisman could be key to helping us rediscover an important teleportation incantation.
translation: 哦……好吧，简单来说就是这个护符可能是帮助我们重新发现一个重要传送咒语的关键。

english: With it, we'll be able to access a hidden essence mine, our lost source of rune essence.
translation: 有了它，我们就能进入一个隐藏的精华矿，那曾是我们符文精华的失落来源。

english: Hmm? You are a very odd person. Come back again when you have it.
translation: 嗯？你真是个奇怪的人。等你有了再来吧。

english: No, I'll only give it to Sedridor.
translation: 不，我只把它交给赛德里多。

english: Well good news, for I am Sedridor! Now, hand it over and let me have a proper look at it, hmm?
translation: 好消息，我就是赛德里多！现在，把它交出来让我好好看看，嗯？

english: No, I don't think you are Sedridor.
translation: 不，我觉得你不是赛德里多。

english: Hmm... Well, I admire your caution adventurer. Perhaps I can prove myself? I will use my mental powers to discover...
translation: 嗯……好吧，我欣赏你的谨慎，冒险者。也许我能证明自己？我会用我的精神力量来发现……

english: Your name is... [player name]!
translation: 你的名字是……[player name]！

english: You're right! How did you know that?
translation: 你说对了！你怎么知道的？

english: Well I am the Archmage you know! You don't get to my position without learning a few tricks along the way!
translation: 我可是首席法师啊！坐上这个位置不可能不学到几手本事！

english: So now that I have proved myself to you, why don't you hand over that talisman, hmm?
translation: 现在我已经向你证明了我自己，为什么不把那个护符交出来呢，嗯？

english: Welcome back, adventurer. Do you have that talisman now?
translation: 欢迎回来，冒险者。你现在有那个护符了吗？

english: Well come back when you have it.
translation: 那等你有了再来吧。

english: So is that talisman of any use to you?
translation: 那么那个护符对你有用吗？

english: Hello again, adventurer. Please, take this package of research notes to Aubury in Varrock. He runs a rune shop in the south east of the city.
translation: 再次你好，冒险者。请把这包研究笔记带给维洛克城的奥伯里。他在城市东南部经营一家符文商店。

english: Hello again, adventurer. Did you take that package to Aubury?
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。你把那个包裹带给奥伯里了吗？

english: I lost it. Could I have another?
translation: 我弄丢了。能再给我一份吗？

english: Well it's a good job I have copies of everything.
translation: 还好我每样都有备份。

english: He runs a rune shop in the south east of Varrock. Please deliver it to him soon.
translation: 他在维洛克城东南角经营一家符文店。请尽快送去给他。

english: I've been sent here with a package for you.
translation: 我是奉命给你送包裹来的。

english: A package? From who?
translation: 包裹？从谁那里？

english: From Sedridor at the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 从法师塔的赛德里多那里。

english: From Sedridor? But... surely, he can't have? Please, let me have it. It must be extremely important for him to have sent a stranger.
translation: 从赛德里多那里？但……不可能吧？请给我吧。他派陌生人来送，一定非常重要。

english: Now, let's have a look...
translation: 现在，让我们看看……

english: This... this is incredible.
translation: 这……这太不可思议了。

english: My gratitude to you adventurer for bringing me these research notes. Thanks to you, I think we finally have it.
translation: 非常感谢你，冒险者，给我带来了这些研究笔记。多亏了你，我想我们终于成功了。

english: You mean the incantation?
translation: 你是说那个咒语？

english: Well when we combine my own research with this latest discovery, I think we might just...
translation: 嗯，当我把我自己的研究和这个最新发现结合起来时，我想我们可能就……

english: No, no, I'm getting ahead of myself. The signs are promising, but let's not jump to any conclusions just yet.
translation: 不，不，我操之过急了。迹象很有希望，但我们先别妄下结论。

english: Here, take these notes back to Sedridor. They should hopefully give him everything he needs.
translation: 给你，把这些笔记带回去给赛德里多。希望能给他所需的一切。

english: Before you leave, why not have a cup of tea?
translation: 在你离开之前，不如喝杯茶？

english: I'd love a cup of tea.
translation: 我很想喝杯茶。

english: Aaah, nothing like a nice cuppa tea!
translation: 啊，没什么比一杯好茶更棒的了！

english: Uh... yeah... about that... I kind of don't have it with me...
translation: 呃……嗯……那个……我好像没带在身上……

english: What kind of person says they have a delivery for me, but not with them? Honestly.
translation: 什么人会说有东西要送给我，却又没带在身上？真是的。

english: Come back when you have it.
translation: 等你有了再来吧。

english: Hello. Did you take those notes back to Sedridor?
translation: 你好。你把那些笔记带回给赛德里多了吗？

english: Sorry, but I lost them.
translation: 抱歉，我弄丢了。

english: Well, luckily I have duplicates. It's a good thing they are written in code. I wouldn't want the wrong kind of person to get access to the information contained within.
translation: 还好我有备份。幸好它们是用密码写的。我可不想让不怀好意的人获取里面的信息。

english: Don't take too long. He'll be eager to see if this is indeed the breakthrough we were hoping for.
translation: 别花太久。他会很想知道这是否真的是我们所期望的突破。

english: Now, did you want to buy some runes?
translation: 那么，你想买些符文吗？

english: Ah, [player name]. How goes your quest? Have you delivered my research to Aubury yet?
translation: 啊，[player name]。你的任务进展如何？你把我的研究送给奥伯里了吗？

english: Yes, I have. He gave me some notes to give to you.
translation: 是的，我送了。他给了我一些笔记要带给你。

english: Wonderful! Let's have a look then.
translation: 太好了！那就让我们看看吧。

english: Alright, let's see what Aubury has for us...
translation: 好了，看看奥伯里给我们带来了什么……

english: Yes, this is it! The lost incantation!
translation: 是的，就是这个！失传的咒语！

english: So you'll be able to access that essence mine now?
translation: 那么你现在能进入那个精华矿了？

english: That's right! Because of you, our order finally has a proper source of rune essence again! Thank you, friend.
translation: 没错！多亏了你，我们教团终于再次有了可靠的符文精华来源！谢谢你，朋友。

english: If you ever want to access the essence mine yourself, just let me know. It's the least I can do.
translation: 如果你想自己去精华矿，就告诉我。这是我起码能做的。

english: I will also share the incantation with others, including Aubury. When I do, I'll let them know that you are to be given unlimited access to the mine.
translation: 我也会把这个咒语分享给其他人，包括奥伯里。到时候，我会让他们知道你应该被准许无限进入矿洞。

english: Oh, and you can have this air talisman back as well. I have no further need of it, and I'm sure you will find it useful.
translation: 哦，这个风护符你也可以拿回去。我不再需要它了，我相信你会发现它很有用。

english: In case you didn't know, the talisman can be used to craft air runes. Just take it to the Air Altar south of Falador along with some rune essence.
translation: 以防你不知道，这个护符可以用来制作风符文。带着它和一些符文精华去法拉多城南边的风祭坛就行了。

english: Don't worry if you can't find the altar. The talisman can guide you there. You may find talismans for other altars as well while adventuring. They'll let you craft other types of rune.
translation: 如果找不到祭坛也别担心。护符会指引你去。你在冒险中可能也会找到其他祭坛的护符。它们能让你制作其他类型的符文。

english: Err, you're not going to believe this...
translation: 呃，你不会相信的……

english: I don't have them.
translation: 我没有带。

english: Right... You're rather careless aren't you. I suggest you go and speak to Aubury once more. With luck he will have made copies.
translation: 好吧……你还真是粗心。我建议你再去找奥伯里谈谈。运气好的话他可能做了备份。

english: No, I lost that talisman that you gave me.
translation: 不，我弄丢了你给我的那个护符。

english: Welcome adventurer, to the world renowned Wizards' Tower. How may I help you?
translation: 欢迎你，冒险者，来到举世闻名的法师塔。我能帮你什么吗？

english: That is indeed a good question. Here in the cellar of the Wizards' Tower you find the remains of the old Wizards' Tower, destroyed by fire
translation: 这确实是个好问题。在法师塔的地下室里，你会发现旧法师塔的遗迹，被大火摧毁

english: many years past by the treachery of the Zamorakians. Many mysteries were lost, which we try to find once more. By building this Tower on the remains of the old,
translation: 很多年前，由于萨莫拉基安人的背叛。许多奥秘丢失了，我们试图重新找到它们。通过在这座旧塔的遗迹上建造这座新塔，

english: we sought to show the world of our dedication to learning the mysteries of Magic. I am here searching through these fragments for knowledge from the artefacts from our past.
translation: 我们想向世界展示我们致力于学习魔法奥秘的决心。我在这里搜寻这些碎片，希望能从过去的文物中获取知识。

english: And have you found anything useful?
translation: 那你找到什么有用的东西了吗？

english: Aaaah... that would be telling adventurer. Anything I have found I cannot speak freely of, for fear the treachery of the past might be repeated.
translation: 啊……这我可不能告诉你，冒险者。我找到的任何东西都不能随意透露，因为我担心过去的背叛会重演。

english: Ok, well I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好吧，那我就不打扰你了。

english: Perhaps I will see you later [player name].
translation: 也许我们以后会再见面的，[player name]。

english: How did you know my name???
translation: 你怎么知道我的名字？？？

english: Well, I AM the head wizard here...
translation: 嗯，我可是这里的首席魔法师……

english: What do you mean treachery?
translation: 你说的背叛是什么意思？

english: Well, it is a long story from the past... Many years ago, this Wizards' Tower was a focus of great learning, as we mages studied together to try and learn the secrets behind
translation: 嗯，说来话长……很多年前，这座法师塔是伟大学习的中心，我们法师们一起研究，试图探索

english: the Rune Stones that allow us to use Magic. Who makes them? Where do they come from? How many types are there? What spells can they produce? All these questions and more are still unknown to us,
translation: 符文石背后的秘密，这些石头让我们能够使用魔法。谁制造了它们？它们从哪里来？有多少种类？它们能产生什么法术？所有这些问题以及更多，我们至今仍不清楚，

english: but were once known to our ancestors. Legends tell us that in the past the mages who lived here could fashion Rune Stones almost at will, and as many as they desired.
translation: 但我们的祖先曾经知道。传说告诉我们，过去住在这里的魔法师几乎可以随心所欲地制造符文石，想要多少有多少。

english: But they cannot anymore?
translation: 但他们现在不能了吗？

english: No, unfortunately not. Many years past, the Wizards who follow Zamorak, the god of chaos, burned this Tower to the ground, and all who were inside.
translation: 不，很不幸，不能了。许多年前，追随混沌之神萨莫拉克的法师们把这座塔和里面的人全部烧成了灰烬。

english: To this day we do not fully know why they did this terrible act, but all our research, all of our greatest magical minds were destroyed in one fell swoop.
translation: 直到今天，我们也不完全清楚他们为什么做出这种可怕的行为，但我们所有的研究，所有最伟大的魔法头脑，都在这一击中被摧毁了。

english: This is why I spend my time searching through these few remains we have left from the glorious old Tower. I hope someday to find something that will tell us once more of the mysteries of
translation: 这就是为什么我花时间在这些从辉煌的旧塔中剩下的少量遗迹中搜寻。我希望有一天能找到一些东西，再次告诉我们关于

english: the runes that we use daily, which dwindle in supply with each use. Someday I hope we may once more create our own runes, and the Wizards' Tower will once more be a place of glory!
translation: 我们每天使用的符文的奥秘，这些符文每次使用都在减少。我希望有一天我们能再次创造自己的符文，法师塔将再次成为一个荣耀之地！

english: I'm looking for the head wizard.
translation: 我在找首席魔法师。

english: Oh, you are, are you? And just why would you be doing that?
translation: 哦，你是在找我，是吗？你为什么要这么做？

english: The Duke of Lumbridge sent me to find him. I have this weird talisman he found. He said the head wizard would be very interested in it.
translation: 仑桥镇公爵派我来找他。他找到了一个奇怪的护符，说首席魔法师会对此非常感兴趣。

english: Did he now? HmmmMMMMMmmmmm. Well that IS interesting. Hand it over then adventurer, let me see what all the hubbub about it is. Just some amulet I'll wager.
translation: 是吗？嗯……那确实很有趣。那就把它交出来吧，冒险者，让我看看这到底是怎么回事。我打赌只是个普通的护身符。

english: Ok, here you are.
translation: 好的，给你。

english: Wow! This is... incredible!
translation: 哇！这……太不可思议了！

english: Th-this talisman you brought me...! It is the last piece of the puzzle, I think! Finally! The legacy of our ancestors... it will return to us once more!
translation: 这……你带来的这个护符……！我想，它是拼图的最后一块！终于！我们祖先的遗产……它将再次回到我们手中！

english: I need time to study this, [player name]. Can you please do me this task while I study this talisman you have brought me? In the mighty town of Varrock, which
translation: 我需要时间来研究这个，[player name]。在我研究你带来的这个护符时，你能帮我一个忙吗？在强大的维洛克城，

english: is located North East of here, there is a certain shop that sells magical runes. I have in this package all of the research I have done relating to the Rune Stones, and
translation: 位于这里的东北方，有一家出售魔法符文的商店。我在这包裹里装了我所做的所有与符文石相关的研究，并且

english: require somebody to take them to the shopkeeper so that he may share my research and offer me his insights. Do this thing for me, and bring back what he gives you,
translation: 需要有人把它们带给店主，这样他就能分享我的研究并给我他的见解。帮我做这件事，把他给你的东西带回来，

english: and if my suspicions are correct, I will let you into the knowledge of one of the greatest secrets this world has ever known! A secret so powerful that it destroyed the
translation: 如果我的猜测没错，我将让你了解这个世界有史以来最伟大的秘密之一！一个强大到在几个世纪前摧毁了

english: I can see a scorpion that you seek. It would appear to be near some nasty spiders. I can see two coffins there as well.
translation: 我能看到你要找的一只蝎子，它好像在一群讨厌的蜘蛛附近，我还看到那里有两口棺材。

english: The scorpion seems to be going through some crack in the wall. It's gone into some sort of secret room.
translation: 那只蝎子好像从墙缝里钻进去了，进了一个密室。

english: Well see if you can find that scorpion then, and I'll try and get you some information on the others.
translation: 你先去找那只蝎子吧，我试着帮你查查其他蝎子的下落。

english: Where did you say that scorpion was again?
translation: 你刚才说那只蝎子在哪来着？

english: I've retrieved the scorpion from near the spiders.
translation: 我已经从蜘蛛附近找回了那只蝎子。

english: Well, I've checked my looking glass. There seems to be a kharid scorpion in a little village in the east, surrounded by lots of uncivilised-looking warriors. Some kind of merchant there seems to have picked it up.
translation: 我查了探视镜，在东边一个小村庄里好像有一只卡里德蝎子，周围有很多看起来野蛮的战士，有个商人好像把它捡走了。

english: That's all I can tell you about that scorpion.
translation: 关于那只蝎子，我能告诉你的就这些了。

english: Any more scorpions?
translation: 还有其他蝎子吗？

english: It's good that you should ask. I have information on the last scorpion for you.
translation: 你问得好，我有最后一只蝎子的消息。

english: It seems to be in some sort of upstairs room. There seems to be some sort of brown clothing lying on a table.
translation: 它似乎在某个楼上的房间里。一张桌子上似乎放着某种棕色的布料。

english: That's lucky because I've got some information on the last scorpion for you.
translation: 那真巧，因为我正好有关于最后一只蝎子的情报要给你。

english: Oh no, we outsource all of that to those Druids in Taverley. Cheaper and quicker than doing it ourselves.
translation: 哦不，我们把所有那些都外包给了塔韦利村的德鲁伊。比我们自己干更便宜更快。

english: I've heard you have a small scorpion in your possession.
translation: 我听说你有一只小蝎子。

english: Now how could you know about that, I wonder? Mind you, I don't have it anymore.
translation: 你是怎么知道的？不过，我已经不养它了。

english: I gave it as a present to my brother Ivor when I visited our outpost northwest of Camelot.
translation: 我去卡梅洛西北的前哨站探望弟弟伊沃尔时，把它当礼物送给了他。

english: Well, actually I hid it in his bed so it would nip him. It was a bit of a surprise gift.
translation: 其实，我把它藏在了他的床上，想让它蜇他一下，算是个惊喜礼物。

english: I have retrieved all your scorpions.
translation: 我已经找回了你所有的蝎子。

english: Aha, my little scorpions home at last!
translation: 啊哈，我的小蝎子们终于回家了！

english: Well I suppose I can aid you with my skills as a staff sorcerer. Most battlestaffs around here are a bit puny. I can beef them up for you a bit.
translation: 好吧，我想我可以用我作为法杖巫师的技能来帮你。这里大多数战斗法杖都有点弱。我可以帮你强化它们。

english: Yes, it'll cost you 40,000 coins for the materials needed though. Which sort of staff did you want enchanting?
translation: 是的，不过需要花费40,000金币购买材料。你想附魔哪种法杖？

english: Yes, it'll cost you 30,000 coins for the materials needed though. Which sort of staff did you want enchanting?
translation: 是的，不过需要花费30,000金币购买材料。你想附魔哪种法杖？

english: Well you have the scorpion cage I gave you, you can catch them using that.
translation: 你手上有我给你的蝎子笼，你可以用那个来抓它们。

english: Yes, it'll cost you 20,000 coins for the materials needed though. Which sort of staff did you want enchanting?
translation: 是的，不过需要花费20,000金币购买材料。你想附魔哪种法杖？

english: Ok, here's another cage.
translation: 好，这里还有一个笼子。

english: You're almost as bad at losing things as me.
translation: 你丢东西的本事快赶上我了。

english: Blast, I suppose I'll have to find someone else then.
translation: 该死，那我只好另找别人了。

english: Well go and fetch them then.
translation: 那就去把它们拿来吧。

english: Then you had better free some space and come back!
translation: 那你最好腾出些空间再回来！

english: Yes, it'll cost you for the materials needed though. Which sort of staff did you want enchanting?
translation: 是的，不过需要花费材料费。你想附魔哪种法杖？

english: You found me! What a day, huh, Humpy Plumpy?
translation: 你找到我了！今天真是个好日子，是吧，哈姆皮.普拉姆皮？

english: Right... Is everything okay?
translation: 好吧……一切都还好吗？

english: Yes, yes... In fact, I've been getting rather used to life out here.
translation: 是的，是的……其实我已经挺习惯这里的生活了。

english: I see... So, who are you, and how did you end up here?
translation: 我明白了……那么，你是谁，又是怎么来到这里的？

english: Oh, I'm Alan. I was just visiting the area as a tourist, but I ended up straying from the pack a little.
translation: 哦，我是艾伦。我只是作为游客来这附近转转，结果不小心脱离了队伍。

english: Do you need a hand getting back to civilization? I could maybe help you out if so.
translation: 需要我帮忙把你送回文明世界吗？如果可以的话，我也许能帮上忙。

english: Oh, no thank you. Like I say, I've actually come to quite like it here. Had I never got lost, I might never have met my best friend, Numpty Bumpty.
translation: 哦，不用了，谢谢。就像我说的，我其实已经挺喜欢这里了。要是我没迷路，可能永远也遇不到我最好的朋友纳普蒂.邦普蒂。

english: Still, it is nice for us to finally have a guest. In fact, you should stay for a while! I'll prepare a little feast for us all! What do you say?
translation: 不过，我们终于有客人了，真是太好了。其实你应该留下来待一会儿！我会给大家准备一顿小盛宴！你觉得怎么样？

english: Well, I suppose I can't say no to that.
translation: 好吧，我想我没法拒绝这个提议。

english: Wonderful! Would you mind staying here while I go out and gather the food? I may not have known you long, but I'm sure I can trust you to keep an eye on Wumty Scrumpty over there.
translation: 太好了！我出去收集食物的时候，你介意留在这里吗？虽然我认识你不久，但我相信可以托你照看那边的温普蒂.斯克伦普蒂。

english: Right, time for me to get going. Don't worry, Hampty, our new friend here is going to take good care of you while I'm gone. Love you lots. Miss you already.
translation: 好了，我该走了。别担心，哈姆蒂，我走之后我们这位新朋友会好好照顾你的。非常爱你。已经开始想你了。

english: Hello there, egg.
translation: 你好啊，蛋。

english: Bollocks.
translation: 瞎扯。

english: I've got something else to do first.
translation: 我还有其他事要先做。

english: Okay, I'll wait until you return. Just don't go getting lost out there!
translation: 好吧，我会等你回来。可别在外面迷路了！

english: Thank you for the offer, but I really must get going... Maybe another time.
translation: 谢谢你的邀请，但我真的得走了……改天吧。

english: This isn't good. I'd better head into town and try to find some help.
translation: 这可不好。我最好进城去找些帮手。

english: Mumpty Rumpty fell off a wall!
translation: 玛普蒂.朗普蒂从墙上摔下来了！

english: Hello there. I don't suppose you could help me?
translation: 你好。不知道你能不能帮我？

english: Nilsal. What is it you need help with?
translation: 你好。你需要帮忙做什么？

english: This might sound a little strange... but Rumpty Bumpty fell off a wall.
translation: 这可能听起来有点奇怪...但朗普蒂.布姆普蒂从墙上摔下来了。

english: Lumpty Mumpty?
translation: 拉姆蒂.马姆蒂？

english: Yes, exactly!
translation: 对，就是他！

english: He's an egg. I need to get him fixed up.
translation: 他是个蛋。我得把他修好。

english: You want to put a broken egg back together again?
translation: 你想把破损的蛋重新拼起来？

english: Precisely! Can you help me?
translation: 正是！你能帮我吗？

english: I don't think I can... but I might know of somebody who could help. You should speak to the local bartender. Her resourcefulness has earned her quite the reputation. Everyone calls her King.
translation: 我觉得我做不到……但我可能知道有人能帮上忙。你应该去找当地的酒保。她足智多谋，名声在外。大家都叫她国王。

english: King? Okay, I'll try and find her. Thanks!
translation: 国王？好的，我会试着找到她。谢谢！

english: Good luck, iknami.
translation: 祝你好运，iknami。

english: Are you the king?
translation: 你是国王吗？

english: The king? No, no, you won't be finding anybody like that around these parts!
translation: 国王？不，不，你在这一带找不到那种人！

english: Sorry, what I meant was... are you King?
translation: 抱歉，我的意思是……你是国王吗？

english: Oh! That's me, yes. What can I do for you?
translation: 哦！就是我，没错。有什么能帮你的？

english: It's about Pumpty Lumpty.
translation: 是关于彭姆蒂.拉姆蒂的事。

english: Scrumpty Lumpy?
translation: 斯克伦姆蒂.朗皮？

english: Yes, yes, the egg. He fell off a wall.
translation: 是的，是的，鸡蛋。他从一堵墙上摔了下来。

english: An egg fell off a wall?
translation: 一个鸡蛋从一堵墙上摔下来了？

english: It was a disaster! He's everywhere! I was told that if anybody could help put him together again, it would be you.
translation: 简直是一场灾难！他摔得到处都是！有人告诉我，如果有人能把他重新拼起来，那一定是你。

english: Yes, I guess I have managed to gain a bit of a reputation when it comes to situations like this. After all, there's a reason everyone calls me King.
translation: 是啊，我想在这种事情上我确实积累了一点名声。毕竟，大家叫我国王是有原因的。

english: Still, putting a broken egg back together again... That does sound like quite the challenge. Unfortunately, I'm afraid I need to stay here and man the bar. However...
translation: 不过，把破损的蛋重新拼起来……听起来确实是个不小的挑战。不幸的是，恐怕我得留在这里看店。不过……

english: I have a plan, but it's going to take all my horses and all my men.
translation: 我有个计划，但需要动用我所有的人马。

english: Oh... Well, what about these men?
translation: 哦……那么，这些人是？

english: They'll be up to the task, but you'll need to rally them up.
translation: 他们能胜任这个任务，但你需要把他们召集起来。

english: Okay, where can I find your men?
translation: 好的，我在哪里能找到你的人？

english: Nezketi should be in the temple just south of here, Kauayotl will most likely be just outside the main entrance into town, and Acatzin is right here in the inn.
translation: 内兹凯蒂应该在南边的神殿里，考阿约特尔很可能就在进城的主入口外面，而阿卡特辛就在这旅馆里。

english: Thanks! I'll have them gathered in no time.
translation: 谢谢！我很快就能把他们召集起来。

english: Scrumpty Numpty fell off a wall!
translation: 斯克朗普蒂.纳普蒂从墙上摔下来了！

english: Bumpty Numpty?
translation: 邦姆蒂.纳普蒂？

english: It was a disaster! He's everywhere! Can you help?
translation: 简直是一场灾难！他摔得到处都是！你能帮忙吗？

english: I think you came to the right person. I've managed to gain a bit of a reputation when it comes to situations like this. There's a reason everyone calls me King.
translation: 我觉得你找对人了。在这种事情上我确实积累了一点名声。大家叫我国王是有原因的。

english: Still putting  a broken egg back together again... That does sound like quite the challenge. Unfortunately, I'm afraid I need to stay here and man the bar. However...
translation: 不过，把破损的蛋重新拼起来……听起来确实是个不小的挑战。不幸的是，恐怕我得留在这里看店。不过……

english: Oh... Well, what about these men.
translation: 哦……那么，这些人是？

english: Welcome back, iknami. What can I get you?
translation: 欢迎回来，iknami。你想要点什么？

english: Excuse me... Are you one of King's men?
translation: 打扰一下……你是国王的人吗？

english: King said that you might be able to help me. It's about Rumpty Bumpty.
translation: 国王说你也许能帮我。是关于拉姆蒂.邦姆蒂的事。

english: Gumty Fumty?
translation: 古姆蒂.富姆蒂？

english: Yes, Pumpty Lumpty fell off a wall! It's a disaster.
translation: 是的，庞普蒂.伦普蒂从墙上摔下来了！真是灾难。

english: A man fell off a wall? How tall is this wall?
translation: 一个人从一堵墙上摔下来了？这墙有多高？

english: Well... not exactly a man. He's an egg.
translation: 嗯……不完全是个人。他是个蛋。

english: I see... Well, I can probably help once I can get out of here.
translation: 我明白了……好吧，等我能离开这里之后，大概可以帮忙。

english: When will that be?
translation: 那要什么时候？

english: As soon as I get my axe back. It's with the blacksmith, but he seems too busy to even talk to me. Think you can help get it back?
translation: 等我拿回我的斧头就行。斧头在铁匠那里，但他好像忙得连话都不跟我说。你能帮忙拿回来吗？

english: I can talk to the blacksmith.
translation: 我可以和铁匠谈谈。

english: Perfect! You'll find him in the western part of town, not far from here.
translation: 太好了！你会在小镇西边找到他，离这里不远。

english: There's no time for this!
translation: 没时间干这个！

english: Well, in that case, I think you'll need to help your egg without me.
translation: 好吧，这样的话，我想你得在没有我的情况下帮助你的蛋了。

english: I need your help with Wumty Scrumpty.
translation: 我需要你帮忙处理温普蒂.斯克伦普蒂的事。

english: Yes, yes. Egg, fell off a wall, disaster.
translation: 是的，是的。蛋，从墙上摔下来了，灾难。

english: Oh, that's right. Well, if you can get me my axe back...
translation: 哦，没错。嗯，如果你能帮我拿回斧头……

english: How are you getting on with my axe?
translation: 我的斧头你办得怎么样了？

english: Well, good luck getting a word in with that blacksmith!
translation: 哼，祝你能跟那个铁匠说得上话！

english: Hello there! Are you...
translation: 你好！你是……

english: Blacksmith! Yes, I'm the blacksmith!
translation: 铁匠！对，我就是铁匠！

english: Great! I'm here about...
translation: 太好了！我来是为了……

english: I'm very busy, so you'll need to be quick! What do you need?
translation: 我很忙，所以你最好快点说！你需要什么？

english: Well, I'm here about an axe...
translation: 嗯，我来是为了斧头的事……

english: Sorry, I don't sell those! Move along!
translation: 抱歉，我不卖那个！快走开！

english: I don't want to buy one! I'm here to pick up one that you're repairing.
translation: 我不是要买斧头！我是来取你正在修的那把。

english: Okay, yes, I can repair an axe for you. It won't be quick though as I have a lot of other work to get through first.
translation: 好吧，是的，我可以帮你修斧头。不过不会很快，因为我还有很多其他活要先干完。

english: The axe is already here. I'm just here to pick it up.
translation: 斧头已经在这里了。我只是来取的。

english: Well, you can't. No repairs are getting done until the whetstone is fixed!
translation: 那你取不了。磨刀石修好之前，什么修理都做不了！

english: Well, what's wrong with the whetstone?
translation: 那磨刀石出什么问题了？

english: Yes, the whetstone! Are you going to get it fixed or are you just going to keep standing around like that?
translation: 对，磨刀石！你是打算把它修好，还是就这么傻站着？

english: Okay... I guess I can try and fix the whetstone.
translation: 好吧……我想我可以试着修一下磨刀石。

english: Is that whetstone fixed?
translation: 磨刀石修好了吗？

english: Too slow! We need to speed things up! Let's come together and fix this whetstone!
translation: 太慢了！我们得加快速度！大家一起来修这块磨刀石吧！

english: It's done. Now, about that axe...
translation: 修好了。现在，关于那把斧头……

english: Axe? I don't have your axe. Are you sure you gave it to me?
translation: 斧头？我没有你的斧头。你确定你把它给我了吗？

english: It's not my axe, it's...
translation: 那不是我的斧头，是……

english: Actually, here, have this one. It's broken, but you can use my newly fixed whetstone to sort that out.
translation: 这样吧，给你这把。它是坏的，但你可以用我刚修好的磨刀石把它弄好。

english: Turned out there was a bit of a backlog of work... The whetstone had some problems as well, but that's all fixed up now.
translation: 原来有不少活积压着……磨刀石也有点问题，不过现在都修好了。

english: So, have you got it?
translation: 那么，你拿到了吗？

english: I have, but it still needs a little work...
translation: 拿到了，但它还需要修一下……

english: Well, once it's finished, we can see about sorting out Wumty Scrumpty.
translation: 好吧，等斧头修好了，我们就可以处理温普蒂.斯克伦普蒂的事了。

english: I have it right here!
translation: 我拿到了，就在这里！

english: Perfect! Hand it over, and then we'll see about Lumpty Mumpty.
translation: 太好了！交给我，然后我们再来处理拉姆蒂.马姆蒂的事。

english: Rumpty Bumpty.
translation: 拉姆蒂.邦姆蒂。

english: Yeah, that's it.
translation: 对，就是他。

english: Okay, here's the axe. When you're ready, head over to the big temple just north of town.
translation: 好的，斧头给你。准备好了就前往城北的大神殿。

english: I need your help. It's Bumpty Numpty.
translation: 我需要你的帮助。是巴普蒂.纳普蒂出事了。

english: Humphrey Dumphrey?
translation: 汉弗莱.邓弗莱？

english: Yes. He's a broken egg. We need to try and put him back together!
translation: 没错。他成了一颗破损的蛋。我们得想办法把他拼回去！

english: This isn't good!
translation: 这可不太妙！

english: So, can you help?
translation: 所以，你能帮忙吗？

english: I think I can, but I'm going to need to be on top of my game for a job like this. In other words, I'm going to need some tea.
translation: 我想我可以，但做这种活我得拿出最佳状态。换句话说，我需要喝点茶。

english: I can get you some tea.
translation: 我可以给你弄点茶来。

english: Kuani! There are plenty of damiana shrubs around here. I know of some just on the other side of the eastern wall. They make for the best tea. I like mine without any milk.
translation: 库阿尼！这附近有很多达米安娜灌木。我知道东墙另一边就有一些。用它们泡的茶最好喝。我喜欢不加奶的。

english: You'll have to just give me a moment to make some space for it.
translation: 你得给我点时间腾个地方。

english: Now, I trust you know how to make tea?
translation: 那么，我相信你知道怎么泡茶吧？

english: Could you remind me?
translation: 你能提醒我一下吗？

english: You'll need to take the damiana leaves and add them to a bowl of water. You then need to boil the water before transferring the tea into a cup.
translation: 你需要摘些达米安娜叶，放进一碗水里。然后把水煮沸，再把茶倒进杯子里。

english: Alright, I'll be back soon with some tea.
translation: 好的，我很快带茶回来。

english: Very good, iknami. In that case, I'll be here once you have some tea for me.
translation: 很好，伊克纳米。那我就在这儿等你拿茶来。

english: Now's not the time for tea!
translation: 现在不是喝茶的时候！

english: Well, I don't think I'll be much use without it...
translation: 嗯，不喝茶的话，我觉得自己帮不上什么忙……

english: I need your help with Pumpty Lumpty.
translation: 我需要你帮忙处理庞普蒂.伦普蒂的事。

english: Yes, the egg I was telling you about before...
translation: 对，就是我之前跟你说的那颗蛋……

english: Ah, I remember. Unfortunately, I still don't think I'll be much help until I've had my tea...
translation: 啊，我想起来了。可惜，在喝到茶之前，我还是觉得自己帮不上什么忙……

english: How are you getting on with that tea?
translation: 茶弄得怎么样了？

english: Remember, you want leaves from damiana shrubs. I know of some just on the other side of the eastern wall. I assume you know what to do once you have them?
translation: 记住，你要从达米安娜灌木上摘叶子。我知道东墙另一边就有一些。我想你知道拿到叶子后该怎么做吧？

english: Of course, if you have the space to carry it.
translation: 当然，只要你有地方装。

english: Oh yeah... I'll be right back.
translation: 哦，对……我马上回来。

english: Is that tea I smell?
translation: 我闻到茶香了吗？

english: Kuani! Would you mind putting it in a cup for me?
translation: 库阿尼！能帮我倒进杯子里吗？

english: Hmm... doesn't smell much like my usual tea...
translation: 嗯……闻起来不太像我平时喝的茶……

english: Oh, no of course not.
translation: 哦，不，当然不是。

english: Remember, you want leaves from damiana shrubs. I know of some just on the other side of the eastern wall.
translation: 记住，你要从达米安娜灌木上摘叶子。我知道东墙另一边就有一些。

english: I've got your tea!
translation: 我拿到你的茶了！

english: Wonderful. I'll just have that, then we can get to work on this Humphrey Dumphrey.
translation: 太好了。我喝完这个，然后我们就可以着手处理这个汉弗莱.邓弗莱的事了。

english: You mean Gumty Fumty?
translation: 你是说甘普蒂.芬普蒂？

english: That's what I said. Where is he?
translation: 我就是这个意思。他在哪儿？

english: In the big temple just north of town.
translation: 在镇北边的大神庙里。

english: Okay, I'll meet you over there.
translation: 好的，我在那儿和你碰头。

english: I sure am. What do you need?
translation: 我当然在。你需要什么？

english: I've got a very big problem. It's Bumpty Numpty.
translation: 我有个大麻烦。是巴普蒂.纳普蒂。

english: Yes. He was sat on a wall, but he had a great fall!
translation: 是的。他坐在一堵墙上，但摔了一大跤！

english: Tell me you're joking?!
translation: 告诉我你在开玩笑？！

english: I'm afraid not. Do you think you can help?
translation: 恐怕不是。你觉得你能帮忙吗？

english: My friend, this is a matter that's very personal to me. I once lost a good friend under similar horrific circumstances. However, I first need to finish sorting out my racing cart.
translation: 我的朋友，这件事对我来说非常私人。我曾经在类似可怕的意外中失去过一个好朋友。不过，我得先把我那辆赛用推车修好。

english: Racing cart?
translation: 赛用推车？

english: That's right! We race them over in the Colosseum. Mine took quite a bit of damage last time so I need to get that sorted.
translation: 没错！我们在竞技场里比赛用的。上次我的车损坏不小，所以我得先把它修好。

english: I see. Well, maybe I can help out with that?
translation: 我明白了。嗯，也许我能帮忙修车？

english: That would be appreciated. I reckon a couple of planks and some nails should be all you need to get it fixed. I'm sure you can find some around here somewhere. Oh, and don't forget your hammer and saw!
translation: 那太好了。我觉得几块木板和一些钉子应该就够了。我相信你能在这附近找到一些。哦，别忘了带上你的锤子和锯子！

english: We have bigger problems right now!
translation: 我们现在有更大的问题要处理！

english: My friend, I know your plight, but the cart must be sorted before I can do anything else. I'm sorry.
translation: 我的朋友，我理解你的困境，但在做其他事之前，我必须先把推车修好。抱歉。

english: As I said, my friend, this is a matter that's very personal to me. However, I first need to finish sorting out my racing cart.
translation: 就像我说的，我的朋友，这件事对我来说非常私人。不过，我得先把我那辆赛用推车修好。

english: Hello again. How's the cart coming along?
translation: 又见面了。推车修得怎么样了？

english: It should just need a couple of planks and some nails. I'm sure you can find some around here somewhere. Oh, and don't forget your hammer and saw!
translation: 应该只需要几块木板和一些钉子。我相信你能在这附近找到一些。哦，别忘了带上你的锤子和锯子！

english: Right, that's the cart all fixed.
translation: 好了，推车修好了。

english: Kuani! It's looking great! All it needs now is a nice new red racing stripe. That's one for later though. For now, let's sort out this problem of yours. Where do you need me?
translation: 库阿尼！看起来棒极了！现在只需要一条漂亮的红色赛车条纹。不过那是以后的事了。现在，我们来解决你的问题吧。你需要我去哪儿？

english: Over in the big temple just north of town.
translation: 在镇北边的大神庙里。

english: I will go there at once.
translation: 我马上就去那里。

english: I've gathered your men.
translation: 我把你的人召集起来了。

english: Then I've done all I can. The rest is now in their hands, and yours. Good luck, iknami.
translation: 那我能做的都做了。剩下的就看他们和你的了。祝你好运，伊克纳米。

english: Okay, how are we looking?
translation: 好了，情况怎么样？

english: This isn't good, iknami. We don't think there's any way we can put this egg back together again.
translation: 情况不妙，伊克纳米。我们觉得没办法把这颗蛋重新拼回去了。

english: The way I see it, we only have one option. We need to replace the egg.
translation: 依我看，我们只有一个选择。我们需要换一颗蛋。

english: Replace Pumpty Lumpty? That's madness!
translation: 换掉庞普蒂.伦普蒂？这太疯狂了！

english: It's more than madness. There isn't even a word to properly describe what it is. However, I fear it is the only path available to us.
translation: 这比疯狂还过分。甚至没有一个词能准确形容这是什么。但恐怕这是我们唯一的路了。

english: But where would we even get a replacement egg?
translation: 但我们上哪儿去找一颗替代的蛋呢？

english: We're going to need to obtain a chicken egg.
translation: 我们需要弄到一颗鸡蛋。

english: Tetamo! That's preposterous! A chicken egg is far too small.
translation: 泰塔莫！这太荒谬了！鸡蛋太小了。

english: Not if it's from a rather large chicken.
translation: 如果是从一只大鸡身上来的，就不小了。

english: A dragon egg is what we need. They are the perfect size.
translation: 我们需要的是龙蛋。大小正合适。

english: A dragon egg would be suicide. No dragon would willingly give up its egg. What we need is a jaguar egg.
translation: 龙蛋等于自杀。没有龙会自愿交出它的蛋。我们需要的是美洲豹蛋。

english: But jaguars don't lay eggs...
translation: 但美洲豹不下蛋啊……

english: How about we gather a few potential eggs and pick the best one?
translation: 要不我们收集几颗可能的蛋，然后挑一颗最好的？

english: Kuani! What a brilliant idea.
translation: 库阿尼！真是个好主意。

english: Okay, I just need to know where I can find these eggs.
translation: 好的，我只需要知道在哪儿能找到这些蛋。

english: There are some dragons in a cave just south east of here, across the river from Tal Teklan. One of them should have an egg.
translation: 从这里往东南方向，穿过塔尔.特克兰河对岸，有个洞穴，里面有些龙。其中一条应该会有蛋。

english: There's a chicken farm on the outskirts of Tal Teklan. I reckon you'll be able to find a large chicken egg there.
translation: 塔尔.特克兰郊区有个养鸡场。我觉得你可以在那儿找到一颗大鸡蛋。

english: And I've heard talk of some eggs in an old camp site by the mine east of Tal Teklan. Apparently the camp site is a hot spot for jaguars! They must be jaguar eggs!
translation: 我听说塔尔.特克兰东边矿场附近的一个旧营地里有些蛋。显然那个营地是美洲豹的热点区域！那一定是美洲豹蛋！

english: Right then. I'll be back once I have some eggs.
translation: 那好吧。我拿到蛋就回来。

english: Remind me, where can I find a dragon egg?
translation: 提醒我一下，在哪儿能找到龙蛋？

english: There are some dragons in a cave just south east of here, across the river from Tal Teklan. One of them should have a suitable egg.
translation: 从这里往东南方向，穿过塔尔.特克兰河对岸，有个洞穴，里面有些龙。其中一条应该会有合适的蛋。

english: I'll head over there and try to find one.
translation: 我过去那儿试着找一个。

english: Remind me, where can I find a large chicken egg?
translation: 提醒我一下，在哪儿能找到大鸡蛋？

english: There's a farm on the outskirts of Tal Teklan. I reckon you'll be able to find one there.
translation: 塔尔.特克兰郊区有个农场。我觉得你可以在那儿找到一个。

english: I'll head over there then.
translation: 那我就去那儿了。

english: Remind me, where can I find a jaguar egg?
translation: 提醒我一下，在哪儿能找到美洲豹蛋？

english: I've heard talk of some in an old camp site by the mine east of Tal Teklan.
translation: 我听说塔尔.特克兰东边矿场附近的一个旧营地里有些蛋。

english: I'll have a look and see if I can find them.
translation: 我去看看能不能找到它们。

english: I managed to find a large chicken egg!
translation: 我成功找到了一颗大鸡蛋！

english: Good work! I'll get it set up so itsready to be judged.
translation: 干得好！我把它准备好，以便进行评判。

english: The chicken egg is ready to be judged. You should get the other eggs gathered.
translation: 鸡蛋已经准备好可以评判了。你应该去收集其他蛋了。

english: I managed to find a dragon egg!
translation: 我成功找到了一颗龙蛋！

english: Kuani! Excellent work! I'll get it ready to go.
translation: 库阿尼！干得漂亮！我把它准备好。

english: The dragon egg is ready to be judged. You should get the other eggs gathered.
translation: 龙蛋已经准备好可以评判了。你应该去收集其他蛋了。

english: I have that jaguar egg!
translation: 我拿到那颗美洲豹蛋了！

english: Kuani! I'll get it set up and ready to be judged.
translation: 库阿尼！我把它摆好，准备评判。

english: The jaguar egg is all set up and ready to be judged. You should work on gathering the other eggs.
translation: 美洲豹蛋已经全部摆好，可以评判了。你应该去收集其他蛋了。

english: That's the last one. Let's get these eggs judged.
translation: 这是最后一颗了。我们来评判这些蛋吧。

english: Right, we have the eggs.
translation: 好了，蛋都齐了。

english: We've prettied them up as best we can. Hopefully one of them looks like Scrumpty Lumpy.
translation: 我们尽力把它们打扮漂亮了。希望其中一颗看起来像斯克伦普蒂.伦普蒂。

english: First up, the chicken egg.
translation: 首先，是鸡蛋。

english: Hmm... It's not bad, but I think it's just a little bit too small to be Humpty Fumty.
translation: 嗯……还不错，但我觉得对汉普蒂.芬普蒂来说，还是太小了一点。

english: Well, what about the dragon egg?
translation: 那龙蛋呢？

english: It's a good size, but the face... it seems to be melting off. I think the egg is too warm.
translation: 大小不错，但脸...好像在融化。我觉得蛋太热了。

english: The jaguar egg then? It's a perfect size and it's the right temperature.
translation: 那美洲豹蛋呢？大小完美，温度也合适。

english: I still don't think it's actually a jaguar egg...
translation: 我还是觉得这其实不是美洲豹蛋……

english: Well, regardless of what it is, I do think it might be the one.
translation: 不管它是什么，我觉得可能就是这个。

english: Kuani! Good work everyone. I think we've done it!
translation: 库阿尼！大家干得好。我想我们成功了！

english: What are we going to do now?
translation: 我们现在该怎么办？

english: We gave it our best, but I fear we have failed.
translation: 我们尽力了，但恐怕还是失败了。

english: We can't give up!
translation: 我们不能放弃！

english: There's only one thing for it. We're going to have to put Pumpty Lumpty back together again.
translation: 只有一个办法了，我们得把庞普蒂.朗普蒂重新拼起来。

english: But how? He was broken beyond repair!
translation: 但怎么拼？他已经碎得无法修复了！

english: We don't have any other options. We have to try.
translation: 我们没有别的选择了，必须试试。

english: But it's not possible!
translation: 但这是不可能的！

english: No, it's necessary...
translation: 不，这是必要的……

english: Let's fix this egg!
translation: 我们来修好这个蛋吧！

english: Indeed it is. I think this means our work here is done.
translation: 确实如此。我想我们的任务完成了。

english: Thank you. I don't think I could have done it without you three.
translation: 谢谢。没有你们三个，我不可能做到。

english: Don't mention it. We're happy to have helped. Now, we should leave you to it.
translation: 别客气，很高兴能帮上忙。现在，我们该让你自己忙了。

english: I'm back! How was Plumper? He didn't cause you any problems, did he?
translation: 我回来了！普朗普怎么样？他没给你们添麻烦吧？

english: Er... No. No problems at all.
translation: 呃……没有，完全没有问题。

english: Wonderful! I'm so glad to hear it. Now, I've got quite the meal lined up for us. Would you mind giving me a hand bringing everything inside?
translation: 太好了！听你这么说我就放心了。我准备了丰盛的一餐，你能帮我把东西都搬进去吗？

english: You know, friend, it wasn't until now that I came to realise that I'd actually been lost for a long time. I had a job back home... I had a family... and yet, something was missing.
translation: 你知道吗，朋友，直到现在我才意识到，其实我迷失了很久。家里有工作……有家人……但总觉得少了些什么。

english: But now... now I think I've finally found myself. For the first time in my life, I know who I am... who I'm meant to be. I think this can be a proper home. A home for me, and for Rumpy as well. A forever home.
translation: 但现在……现在我终于找到了自我。有生以来第一次，我知道了自己是谁……自己应该成为什么样的人。我想这里可以成为一个真正的家。一个属于我和朗普的家。一个永久的家。

english: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Mumpty Rumpty.
translation: 你好。再次感谢你帮忙处理了马普蒂.朗普蒂的事。

english: Don't mention it, iknami. Always happy to be of service.
translation: 别客气，伊克纳米。随时愿意效劳。

english: Hello there. Thanks again for helping with Rumpty Bumpty.
translation: 你好。再次感谢你帮忙处理了朗普蒂.邦普蒂的事。

english: Welcome back, iknami. I hear you managed to solve your egg problem.
translation: 欢迎回来，伊克纳米。听说你成功解决了蛋的问题。

english: I did. Your men were a big help.
translation: 是的，你的手下帮了大忙。

english: Glad to hear it. Now, what can I get you?
translation: 很高兴听到这个。现在，你想来点什么？

english: It was my pleasure, iknami. We of course wouldn't have been able to do it without you either.
translation: 这是我的荣幸，伊克纳米。当然，没有你我们也做不到。

english: That's very good of you [player name]. My friend Holgart will take you there.
translation: 你真是太好了，[player name]。我的朋友霍尔加特会带你去那里。

english: Hello Caroline.
translation: 你好，卡罗琳。

english: Brave [player name], have you any news about my son and his father?
translation: 勇敢的[player name]，有我儿子和他父亲的消息吗？

english: I'm working on it now Caroline.
translation: 我正在处理这件事，卡罗琳。

english: Please bring them back safe and sound.
translation: 请把他们平安带回来。

english: In fact, unless me nose be mistaken, you've got some in yer pack.
translation: 事实上，要是我这鼻子没搞错的话，你包里就有一些。

english: Oh yes, I forgot about that stuff. Can you use it?
translation: 哦对，我忘了那东西。你能用得上吗？

english: Aye, that be perfect.
translation: 没错，这太完美了。

english: Right me hearty. Let's get this boat fixed.
translation: 好的，老伙计。咱们把这船修好。

english: Huzzah! We've fixed the leaky old tub.
translation: 好哇！我们把这条漏水的破船修好了。

english: Hello Holgart.
translation: 你好，霍尔加特。

english: Hello m'hearty. Did you manage to make some swamp paste?
translation: 你好啊，老伙计。你弄到沼泽膏了吗？

english: It's simply swamp tar mixed with flour heated over a fire. Unfortunately the only supply of swamp tar is in the swamps below Lumbridge.
translation: 很简单，就是把沼泽焦油和面粉混在一起，然后在火上加热。可惜的是，唯一的沼泽焦油来源在仑桥镇下方的沼泽里。

english: I can't fix my row boat without it.
translation: 没有它，我就修不好我的划艇。

english: Ok, I'll try to find some.
translation: 好，我试着找一些。

english: Superb, this looks great.
translation: 太棒了，看起来很不错。

english: Hello again land lover. There's some strange goings on, on that platform, I tell you.
translation: 又见面了，旱鸭子。我告诉你，那个平台上有些怪事发生。

english: Will you take me there?
translation: 你能带我去那里吗？

english: Of course m'hearty. If that's what you want.
translation: 当然可以，老伙计。如果你想去的话。

english: I'm keeping away from there.
translation: 我正躲着那里呢。

english: Fair enough m'hearty.
translation: 有道理，老伙计。

english: Hey, Holgart.
translation: 嘿，霍尔加特。

english: Have you had enough of this place yet? It's really starting to scare me.
translation: 你还没受够这个地方吗？我真的开始害怕了。

english: Okay... you're the boss.
translation: 好吧……听你的。

english: Okay m'hearty, jump on.
translation: 好的，老伙计，跳上来吧。

english: She is coming...
translation: 她来了……

english: What? Who are you? Come inside quickly!
translation: 什么？你是谁？快进来！

english: I'm trying to find out what happened to a boy named Kennith.
translation: 我想查明一个叫肯尼斯的男孩出了什么事。

english: Oh you mean Kent's son. He's around somewhere, probably hiding if he knows what's good for him.
translation: 哦，你是说肯特的儿子。他就在附近某个地方，要是他聪明的话，大概正躲着呢。

english: Hiding from what? What's got you so frightened?
translation: 躲什么？是什么让你这么害怕？

english: Haven't you seen all those things out there?
translation: 你没看到外面那些东西吗？

english: The sea slugs?
translation: 海蛞蝓？

english: It all began about a week ago. We pulled up a haul of deep sea flatfish. Mixed in with them we found those slug things, but thought nothing of it.
translation: 一切大约在一周前开始。我们捞起了一网深海比目鱼。里面混着那些蛞蝓一样的东西，但我们没当回事。

english: Not long after that my friends began to change, now they spend all day pulling in hauls of fish, only to throw back the fish and keep those nasty sea slugs.
translation: 那之后不久，我的朋友们就开始变了。现在他们整天都在拉网捕鱼，却把鱼扔回去，只留下那些恶心的海蛞蝓。

english: What am I supposed to do with those? I haven't figured out how to kill one yet, if I put them near the stove they squirm and jump away.
translation: 我该拿它们怎么办？我还没想出怎么弄死一只。要是把它们放在炉灶附近，它们就会扭动着跳开。

english: I doubt they would taste too good.
translation: 我怀疑它们味道不会太好。

english: This is no time for humour.
translation: 现在不是开玩笑的时候。

english: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you.
translation: 对不起，我不是有意惹你生气。

english: That's okay. I just can't shake the feeling that this is the start of something... Terrible.
translation: 没关系。我只是无法摆脱这种感觉，觉得这是一些……可怕事情的开端。

english: Are you okay young one?
translation: 你还好吗，小家伙？

english: No, I want my daddy!
translation: 不好，我要我爸爸！

english: Where is your father?
translation: 你父亲在哪里？

english: He went to get help days ago.
translation: 他几天前去寻求帮助了。

english: The nasty fishermen tried to throw me and daddy into the sea. So he told me to hide here.
translation: 那些可恶的渔夫想把我和爸爸扔进海里。所以他让我躲在这里。

english: That's good advice, you stay here and I'll go try and find your father.
translation: 好主意，你待在这里，我去试着找你父亲。

english: I want to see daddy!
translation: 我要见爸爸！

english: Holgart, something strange is going on here.
translation: 霍尔加特，这里有些不对劲。

english: You're telling me, none of the sailors seem to remember who I am.
translation: 还用你说，那些水手好像都不记得我是谁了。

english: Apparently Kennith's father left for help a couple of days ago.
translation: 显然，肯尼斯的父亲几天前就离开去寻求帮助了。

english: That's a worry, no-one's heard from him on shore. Come on, we'd better go look for him.
translation: 这很让人担心，岸上没人有他的消息。来吧，我们最好去找他。

english: Someway off mainland still. You'd better see if me old matey's okay.
translation: 离大陆还有一段路。你最好去看看我的老伙计怎么样了。

english: Oh thank Saradomin! I thought I'd be left out here forever.
translation: 哦，感谢萨拉多明！我还以为我要永远被困在这里了。

english: Your wife sent me out to find you and your boy. Kennith's fine by the way, he's on the platform.
translation: 你妻子派我出来找你和你的孩子。顺便说一句，肯尼斯很好，他在平台上。

english: I knew the row boat wasn't sea worthy. I couldn't risk bringing him along but you must get him off that platform.
translation: 我就知道那条划艇不适合出海。我不敢冒险带他一起走，但你一定要把他从那个平台上带下来。

english: Five days ago we pulled in a huge catch. As well as fish we caught small slug like creatures, hundreds of them.
translation: 五天前，我们捞起了一大网鱼。除了鱼，我们还捕到了像小蛞蝓一样的生物，有好几百只。

english: That's when the fishermen began to act strange.
translation: 就是从那时起，渔夫们开始行为怪异。

english: It was the sea slugs, they attach themselves to your body and somehow take over the mind of the carrier.
translation: 是那些海蛞蝓，它们会附着在你身上，然后以某种方式控制宿主的意识。

english: I told Kennith to hide until I returned but I was washed up here.
translation: 我让肯尼斯躲起来直到我回来，但我被冲到了这里。

english: Please go back and get my boy, you can send help for me later.
translation: 请回去接我的孩子，你可以稍后再派人来救我。

english: [player name] wait!
translation: [player name] 等等！

english: A few more minutes and that thing would have full control of your body.
translation: 再晚几分钟，那东西就会完全控制你的身体了。

english: Yuck! Thanks Kent.
translation: 呃！谢谢你，肯特。

english: Oh my, I must get back to shore.
translation: 哦天哪，我得回岸上去。

english: We'd better get back to the platform so we can see what's going on.
translation: 我们最好回到平台上去看看发生了什么。

english: You're right. It all sounds pretty creepy.
translation: 你说得对。听起来真够瘆人的。

english: Oh, thank the gods it's you. They've all gone mad I tell you, one of the fishermen tried to throw me into the sea!
translation: 哦，感谢诸神是你。我告诉你，他们都疯了，有个渔夫想把我扔进海里！

english: They're all being controlled by the sea slugs.
translation: 他们都被海蛞蝓控制了。

english: I figured as much.
translation: 我也猜到了。

english: I need to get Kennith off this platform, but I can't get past the fishermen.
translation: 我得把肯尼斯带离这个平台，但我没法绕过那些渔夫。

english: The sea slugs are scared of heat, I figured that out when I tried to cook them.
translation: 海蛞蝓怕热，我在尝试煮它们时发现了这一点。

english: Here.
translation: 给你。

english: I doubt the fishermen will come near you if you can get this torch lit.
translation: 如果你能把这个火把点着，我怀疑那些渔夫不敢靠近你。

english: The only problem is all the wood and flint are damp... I can't light a thing!
translation: 唯一的问题是所有的木材和燧石都受潮了……我什么都点不着！

english: I've managed to lose my torch.
translation: 我把我的火把弄丢了。

english: That was silly, fortunately I have another. Here, take it.
translation: 真不小心，幸好我还有一支。给你，拿着吧。

english: I'd better find a way to light this torch, and soon.
translation: 我最好找个办法点着这个火把，而且要快。

english: I've managed to light the torch.
translation: 我把火把点着了。

english: Well done traveller, you'd better get Kennith out of here soon.
translation: 干得好，旅行者。你最好快点把肯尼斯带出去。

english: The fishermen are becoming stranger by the minute, and they keep pulling up those blasted sea slugs.
translation: 渔民们变得越来越奇怪，而且他们不断拉起那些该死的海蛞蝓。

english: Don't worry I'm working on it.
translation: 别担心，我正在想办法。

english: Just be sure to watch your back. The fishermen seem to have taken notice of you.
translation: 小心你的背后。那些渔夫好像已经注意到你了。

english: Hello Kennith, are you okay?
translation: 你好，肯尼斯，你还好吗？

english: No, I want my daddy.
translation: 不好，我要我爸爸。

english: You'll be able to see him soon. First we need to get you back to land, come with me to the boat.
translation: 你很快就能见到他了。首先我们得把你带回陆地上，跟我到船上去。

english: What, why not?
translation: 什么，为什么不？

english: I'm scared of those nasty sea slugs. I won't go near them.
translation: 我害怕那些恶心的海蛞蝓。我不想靠近它们。

english: Okay, you wait here and I'll go figure another way to get you out.
translation: 好吧，你在这里等着，我去想别的办法把你弄出去。

english: Kennith, I've made an opening in the wall. You can come out through there.
translation: 肯尼斯，我在墙上开了一个口子。你可以从那里出来。

english: Are there any sea slugs on the other side?
translation: 另一边有海蛞蝓吗？

english: Not one.
translation: 一只都没有。

english: How will I get downstairs?
translation: 我怎么下楼呢？

english: I'll figure that out in a moment.
translation: 我马上就想办法。

english: Ok, when you have I'll come out.
translation: 好吧，等你想好了我就出来。

english: Great miss! Thanks again for rescuing me.
translation: 太好了，小姐！再次感谢你救了我。

english: Sure miss. Goodbye now.
translation: 当然，小姐。再见。

english: Hello again. I saw you managed to get Kennith off the platform. Well done. He wasn't safe around those slugs.
translation: 又见面了。我看到你把肯尼斯带离了平台。干得好。他在那些蛞蝓旁边不安全。

english: Are you going to come back with us?
translation: 你要跟我们一起回去吗？

english: No, these fishermen are my friends, I'm sure they can be saved. I'm going to stay and try to get rid of all these slugs.
translation: 不，这些渔夫是我的朋友，我相信他们能得救。我打算留下来，试着清除所有这些蛞蝓。

english: Do you have a way of removing the slugs once they've attached themselves to someone?
translation: 你有办法在蛞蝓附着到人身上后把它们弄掉吗？

english: Not yet but I'll keep working on it.
translation: 还没有，但我会继续想办法的。

english: I only hope they stay confined to the fishing platform.
translation: 我只希望它们只局限在这个钓鱼平台上。

english: Yes, I dread to think what would happen if they got to Witchaven nearby.
translation: 是啊，我不敢想象如果它们跑到附近的女巫港会发生什么。

english: I guess I'll just have to keep an eye on things here until a way of removing the slugs can be found.
translation: 我想我只能在这里盯着，直到找到清除蛞蝓的办法。

english: You're braver than most. Take care of yourself Bailey.
translation: 你比大多数人勇敢。保重，贝利。

english: Did you get the kid back to shore?
translation: 你把孩子送回岸上了吗？

english: Yes, he's safe and sound with his parents. Your turn to return to land now adventurer.
translation: 是的，他安然无恙地和父母在一起了。现在该你回陆地了，冒险者。

english: Looking forward to it.
translation: 很期待。

english: Brave [player name], you've returned!
translation: 勇敢的[player name]，你回来了！

english: Kennith told me about the strange goings-on at the platform. I had no idea it was so serious.
translation: 肯尼斯告诉我平台上发生的怪事，我没想到那么严重。

english: I could have lost my son and my husband if it wasn't for you.
translation: 要不是你，我可能会失去儿子和丈夫。

english: We found Kent stranded on an island.
translation: 我们发现肯特被困在一个岛上。

english: Yes, Holgart told me and sent a rescue party out. Kent's back home now, resting with Kennith. I don't think he'll be doing any fishing for a while.
translation: 是的，霍尔加特告诉了我，并派出了救援队。肯特现在回家了，和肯尼斯一起休息。我想他暂时不会去钓鱼了。

english: Here, take these Oyster pearls as a reward. They're worth quite a bit and can be used to make lethal crossbow bolts.
translation: 拿着这些牡蛎珍珠作为奖励吧。它们价值不菲，可以用来制作致命的弩箭。

english: Thank you. Take care of yourself [player name].
translation: 谢谢，保重[player name]。

english: Hey! Come out here. We need to talk!
translation: 嘿！出来一下。我们需要谈谈！

english: How could this happen? How? Will our pain never end?
translation: 怎么会发生这种事？怎么会？我们的痛苦难道永无止境吗？

english: Leave me at once! I don't want to talk right now.
translation: 立刻离开我！我现在不想说话。

english: It's not fair! All the bad things keep happening to us! Why don't they happen to anyone else?
translation: 这不公平！所有坏事都接二连三地发生在我们身上！为什么别人就没遇到这种事？

english: What's happened?
translation: 发生了什么事？

english: I shouldn't talk to you. You might be one of the bad people.
translation: 我不该跟你说话。你可能是那些坏人之一。

english: This poor family. I don't know how much more they can take.
translation: 这可怜的一家人。我不知道他们还能承受多少。

english: Sorry, I shouldn't be talking to you about it.
translation: 抱歉，我不该跟你谈这件事。

english: Hey! I need to talk to you!
translation: 嘿！我需要跟你谈谈！

english: Yes, you. I have some questions.
translation: 对，就是你。我有几个问题要问你。

english: You were recently hired by Sir Ceril Carnillean, correct?
translation: 你是最近被塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士雇用的，对吧？

english: That's right... he wanted me to find some cultists that stole his armour.
translation: 没错……他想让我找到一些偷了他盔甲的邪教徒。

english: And were you successful?
translation: 那你成功了吗？

english: And have you had any contact with the Carnilleans since your success?
translation: 那在你成功之后，你和卡尼利安家的人还有联系吗？

english: And have you had any contact with the Carnilleans since your failure?
translation: 那在你失败之后，你和卡尼利安家的人还有联系吗？

english: Sorry, I'm very confused. What's all this about?
translation: 抱歉，我完全被搞糊涂了。这到底是怎么回事？

english: An unthinkable crime has taken place, and as someone who has recently had contact with the Carnilleans, you are one of our suspects.
translation: 发生了一起难以想象的罪行，作为最近与卡尼利安家接触过的人，你是我们的嫌疑人之一。

english: A crime? What's happened?
translation: 一起罪行？发生了什么事？

english: Until I am satisfied that you were not involved, I can't say.
translation: 在我确定你与此事无关之前，我不能说。

english: Well then what do I need to do to convince you I wasn't?
translation: 那我需要做什么才能让你相信我与它无关？

english: Sorry about all this. I'm pretty confident you had nothing to do with any of it, but I need to put on a good show for Lady Carnillean.
translation: 对于这一切我很抱歉。我很有信心你跟此事毫无关系，但我需要在卡尼利安夫人面前装装样子。

english: Well I must say adventurer, that is quite the alibi. You clearly had no involvement in this horrific crime.
translation: 嗯，冒险者，我得说，这真是个了不起的不在场证明。你显然与这起可怕的罪行无关。

english: Well I'm glad we could...
translation: 嗯，我很高兴我们能……

english: And what's that? You want to help us find the culprit? How generous of you!
translation: 那是什么？你想帮助我们找出凶手？你真是太慷慨了！

english: But I never said...
translation: 但我从没说过……

english: Of course! I would never sit by while criminals are on the loose! You will have all the help you need!
translation: 当然！我绝不会在罪犯逍遥法外时袖手旁观！你会得到你需要的一切帮助！

english: Excellent! Please join me upstairs when you're ready to begin.
translation: 太好了！等你准备好开始，就到楼上来找我。

english: What on Gielinor have I just agreed to?
translation: 我在吉列诺上到底答应了什么？

english: Sorry, I need to get going.
translation: 抱歉，我得走了。

english: Let me run you through what happened before you start inspecting things.
translation: 在你们开始检查之前，让我先跟你们说一下发生了什么。

english: Sir Ceril Carnillean.
translation: 塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士。

english: I was hoping you could help work that out.
translation: 我希望你能帮忙弄清楚。

english: Well I guess we should get started right away. What do we know so far?
translation: 嗯，我想我们应该立刻开始。我们目前知道些什么？

english: It happened in the early hours of the morning. According to Lady Carnillean, Sir Ceril heard a noise coming from Butler Jones' old room. He got up to investigate.
translation: 事情发生在清晨时分。据卡尼利安夫人说，塞里尔爵士听到管家琼斯的旧房间传来声响。他起身前去查看。

english: After a few moments, she heard Sir Ceril shout something, followed by a scream. She went to see what was happening, and this is what she found.
translation: 过了一会儿，她听到塞里尔爵士喊了些什么，然后是一声尖叫。她去看发生了什么，然后就看到这个情景。

english: So no one else was in the room?
translation: 所以当时房间里没有其他人？

english: Not that she saw.
translation: 她没看到有其他人。

english: Where was everyone else at this point?
translation: 那时候其他人在哪里？

english: I was the guard on duty last night. I was stationed out front as usual. Claus, the family chef, was down in the kitchen preparing an early breakfast for Sir Ceril.
translation: 我是昨晚值班的守卫。我像往常一样被派到前面站岗。家族厨师克劳斯正在楼下厨房为塞里尔爵士准备早餐。

english: Young Philipe was in bed. He slept through the entire thing.
translation: 小菲利佩在床上睡觉。他整晚都睡得很沉。

english: Do we have any obvious suspects?
translation: 我们有什么明显的嫌疑人吗？

english: Jones is behind bars, but many of his fellow cultists are still at large. Perhaps this was an act of revenge on their part.
translation: 琼斯在监狱里，但他的许多邪教徒同伙仍然在逃。也许这是他们一方的报复行为。

english: It happened in the early hours of the morning. According to Lady Carnillean, Sir Ceril heard a noise coming from Butler Jones' room. He got up to investigate.
translation: 事情发生在清晨时分。据卡尼利安夫人说，塞里尔爵士听到管家琼斯的房间传来声响。他起身前去查看。

english: Young Philipe was in bed. He slept through the entire thing. Jones himself was downstairs at the time, but he vanished before we could question him.
translation: 小菲利佩在床上睡觉。他整晚都睡得很沉。琼斯本人当时在楼下，但他在我们来得及审问他之前就消失了。

english: Jones vanished?
translation: 琼斯消失了？

english: Indeed. That, along with the murder occurring in his room, makes him a prime suspect.
translation: 确实。再加上谋杀发生在他的房间里，这使他成为主要嫌疑人。

english: Apart from Jones, do we have any other suspects?
translation: 除了琼斯，我们还有其他嫌疑人吗？

english: We also have those cultists that broke in a while back. Following his disappearance, we can't help but wonder if Jones might have been in league with them...
translation: 我们还有那些之前闯入的邪教徒。在他失踪后，我们不禁怀疑琼斯是否可能与他们勾结……

english: We can't rule anything out.
translation: 我们不能排除任何可能性。

english: There's a few other things to note, but it's probably best if you have a look around the crime scene before we go any further.
translation: 还有一些其他需要注意的事情，但在我们进一步讨论之前，最好你先四处看看犯罪现场。

english: Good idea. I'll begin at once.
translation: 好主意。我立刻开始。

english: Are you done looking around the crime scene?
translation: 你检查完犯罪现场了吗？

english: Not to worry. Take all the time you need.
translation: 别担心。慢慢来，不着急。

english: My dear husband... how could this happen? Will our pain never end?
translation: 我亲爱的丈夫……怎么会发生这种事？我们的痛苦难道永无止境吗？

english: I'm sorry for your loss.
translation: 对于您的损失，我深表遗憾。

english: Please, leave me. I would mourn alone.
translation: 请离开吧。我想独自哀悼。

english: Then you're useless! Leave me alone!
translation: 那你就是个废物！别烦我！

english: I still don't believe it. This poor family. I don't know how much more they can take.
translation: 我还是不敢相信。这可怜的一家人。我不知道他们还能承受多少。

english: I think I've seen everything I need to. I should check in with the guard.
translation: 我想我已经看完了所有需要看的东西。我应该去跟守卫汇报一下。

english: Hmm... was someone after Hazeel's restoration scroll?
translation: 嗯……有人在找寻哈兹尔的恢复卷轴？

english: Find anything of note?
translation: 发现什么值得注意的东西了吗？

english: I think that's everything.
translation: 我想这就是全部了。

english: So someone broke in from the outside, something may have been stolen from a hidden room upstairs, and Sir Ceril was stabbed in the back. All useful information, but none of it gives us anything definitive.
translation: 所以有人从外面闯进来，楼上的一个隐藏房间里可能有什么东西被偷了，而塞里尔爵士是背部被刺死的。这些都是有用的信息，但都没有给我们任何确定性的结论。

english: Thankfully, we do have one more lead that might hold some promise. Take a look at this.
translation: 好在，我们确实还有一条可能挺有希望的线索。来看看这个。

english: I found this by the window. That skull on it is the symbol of the Khazard Army. There's also a name engraved into the back: 'Evelot'.
translation: 我在窗户旁边发现了这个。上面的头骨是卡扎德军团的标志。背面还刻着一个名字：“埃韦洛特”。

english: Sounds like we need to find this Evelot and see what they know.
translation: 听起来我们需要找到这个埃韦洛特，看看他知道些什么。

english: While I agree, my superiors won't be happy if I open an investigation into a member of the Khazard Army. I think you'll need to handle this bit yourself. Besides, I need to take care of matters here.
translation: 我同意，但如果我开启对卡扎德军团成员的调查，我的上级不会高兴的。我想你需要自己处理这部分了。再说，我也需要处理这里的事情。

english: If you want a place to start, I'd suggest the bar at the Fight Arena. Places like that are always good for gathering information.
translation: 如果你想找个起点，我建议你去战斗竞技场的酒吧。那种地方总是收集信息的好去处。

english: Good idea.
translation: 好主意。

english: Should we not look into the Hazeel Cult as well?
translation: 我们不应该也调查一下哈兹尔邪教吗？

english: They're definitely top suspects, but we don't have any actual evidence linking them to the crime. Until we do, this Evelot lead seems like a safer bet.
translation: 他们绝对是首要嫌疑人，但我们没有实际证据将他们与罪行联系起来。在我们找到证据之前，这条关于埃韦洛特的线索似乎是更稳妥的选择。

english: Why can't you investigate the Khazard Army yourself?
translation: 为什么你不能自己去调查卡扎德军团？

english: The matter is... complicated. On paper, General Khazard is an upstanding citizen, and his private army operates with approval from the crown. King Lathas even hired them for some peacekeeping once.
translation: 这件事……很复杂。理论上，卡扎德将军是一位正直的市民，他的私人军队行动是得到王家批准的。拉萨斯国王甚至曾经雇佣他们来维持过治安。

english: It's fair to say that Khazard is a bit... controversial. His war with the gnomes is creating more than a few problems for Kandarin, not to mention the rumours about the people fighting in his arena...
translation: 可以这么说，卡扎德有点……争议。他与地精的战争正在给坎达林王国制造不少麻烦，更不用说关于在他的竞技场里战斗的人的谣言了……

english: For now though, King Lathas considers him a valuable ally. As such, it is preferred we maintain a good relationship with him and his army.
translation: 但现在，拉萨斯国王仍然视他为宝贵的盟友。因此，我们最好与他及其军队保持良好的关系。

english: Unlike his predecessor, King Thoros is keen to slowly distance himself from Khazard. However, in the meantime, we have to maintain a good relationship with him and his army.
translation: 与他的前任不同，索罗斯国王渴望慢慢疏远与卡扎德的关系。不过同时，我们仍必须与他及其军队保持良好的关系。

english: And that's where I come in. I understand.
translation: 所以这就轮到我出场了。我明白了。

english: No need to worry. Some of our best are already out searching for him. I'm sure he won't get far.
translation: 不用担心。我们一些最优秀的人手已经在搜寻他了。我相信他跑不远的。

english: Maybe I could help them?
translation: 也许我可以帮助他们？

english: Your concern is appreciated, but they'll be fine. You're better off focusing on Evelot.
translation: 感谢你的关心，但他们能应付。你最好专注于埃韦洛特。

english: The window was broken from the outside.
translation: 窗户是从外面打破的。

english: I didn't see anyone leave or enter from the front of the building last night, so that makes sense. The window must have been their way in and out.
translation: 我昨晚没看到有人从大楼前门进出，所以这说得通。窗户一定是他们进出的通道。

english: So it was likely someone who didn't have any other way to access the mansion. We can probably rule out staff and family members.
translation: 所以很可能是没有其他方式进入宅邸的人。我们大概可以排除员工和家庭成员。

english: Agreed. Did you find anything else?
translation: 同意。你还有其他发现吗？

english: Ceril was stabbed from behind.
translation: 塞里尔是从背后被刺死的。

english: So he wasn't facing his killer. But if that were the case, why did Lady Carnillean say she heard him shouting? Surely he'd have been facing whoever he was shouting at.
translation: 所以他没有面对他的杀手。但如果是这样，为什么卡尼利安夫人说她听到他在喊叫？他肯定是面对着他喊叫的人。

english: That could mean there were two people in the room with him.
translation: 这可能意味着当时房间里有两个人。

english: Let's hope not. One killer on the loose is bad enough.
translation: 希望不是这样。一个杀手在逃已经够糟的了。

english: There's something else as well. It looks like the blade used to kill him was unusually thin.
translation: 还有别的事。用来杀死他的刀片似乎异常薄。

english: Really? How odd. I'll make a note to look into that once we're done here.
translation: 真的吗？真奇怪。我会记下来，等我们在这里完事后去调查一下。

english: Anyway, did you find anything else?
translation: 不管怎样，你还有其他发现吗？

english: A hidden room above us was broken into.
translation: 我们上面有一个隐藏的房间被人闯入了。

english: A hidden room? What hidden room?
translation: 一个隐藏的房间？什么隐藏房间？

english: It looks like it can only be accessed from in here. It doesn't seem like anyone has been in there for some time.
translation: 看起来只能从这里进入。好像已经有一段时间没人进去了。

english: What's in this room?
translation: 那个房间里有什么？

english: There's a chest up there that's been broken into.
translation: 上面有一个箱子被撬开了。

english: Do you think they took anything from it?
translation: 你觉得他们从里面拿了什么东西吗？

english: This raises more questions than answers. Was this actually a murder, or just a robbery gone wrong? And how was there a hidden room that we knew nothing about?
translation: 这引发的问题比答案还多。这到底是起谋杀案，还是只是搞砸了的抢劫？还有，我们怎么对那个隐藏的房间完全不知情？

english: Did you find anything else?
translation: 你还有其他发现吗？

english: Oh. Well don't be gone too long. We have work to do here.
translation: 哦。好吧，别离开太久。我们这里还有工作要做。

english: So did you find anything of note in your investigation?
translation: 那么，你在调查中发现了什么值得注意的东西吗？

english: I think I've gone over everything.
translation: 我想我已经把所有东西都检查过了。

english: Hello there. You should head over to the bar at the Fight Arena and see what you can learn about this Evelot.
translation: 你好啊。你应该去战斗竞技场的酒吧看看，了解一下这个埃韦洛特的事。

english: Do you know anyone called Evelot?
translation: 你认识一个叫埃韦洛特的人吗？

english: I'm looking for them.
translation: 我在找他们。

english: It's not my place to go giving out information to people I don't know.
translation: 我可不能随便把信息告诉不认识的人。

english: Are you sure? I could make it worth your while.
translation: 你确定吗？我可以让你不白忙一场。

english: Are you suggesting that I'm the kind of person that would besmirch my honour for a measly bribe?
translation: 你是在暗示我是那种会为了区区贿赂而玷污自己荣誉的人吗？

english: Because you'd be absolutely right! 100 coins will pay for the information you desire.
translation: 因为你完全说对了！100金币就能换来你想要的信息。

english: Alright, here's the money.
translation: 好吧，钱给你。

english: So what can you tell me about Evelot?
translation: 那你能告诉我关于埃韦洛特的什么事？

english: So oddly enough, she was in here not that long ago, but just before you arrived, one of the lads came in and spoke to her.
translation: 说来也怪，她不久前还在这里，但就在你到达之前，有个小伙子进来跟她说了话。

english: To say what?
translation: 说了什么？

english: No idea, but she left in quite the hurry afterwards. Perhaps you'll be able to pick up her trail if you look around outside.
translation: 不知道，但她之后匆匆离开了。也许你到外面四处看看，能找到她的踪迹。

english: I might just do that. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我正打算这么做。谢谢你的信息。

english: Fancy a drink before you go?
translation: 走之前想喝一杯吗？

english: Alright, I'll come back when I have the money.
translation: 好吧，等我有了钱再回来。

english: Like I said, 100 coins will pay for the information you desire.
translation: 我说过了，100金币就能换来你想要的信息。

english: Like I told you, she left earlier in quite a hurry. Perhaps you'll be able to pick up her trail if you look around outside.
translation: 我跟你说过了，她之前匆匆离开了。也许你到外面四处看看，能找到她的踪迹。

english: Ah yes, thanks again for the information.
translation: 啊，是的，再次感谢你的信息。

english: Hello there. Any luck at the Fight Arena?
translation: 你好啊。在战斗竞技场有收获吗？

english: Evelot, I presume?
translation: 我猜你就是埃韦洛特？

english: If you think I'm coming quietly, you've got another thing coming!
translation: 如果你以为我会乖乖跟你走，那你就大错特错了！

english: Alright, that's enough! You win!
translation: 好了，够了！你赢了！

english: So will you answer my questions now?
translation: 那现在你愿意回答我的问题了吗？

english: It doesn't seem like I have any other choice.
translation: 看来我别无选择了。

english: Ceril Carnillean has been murdered, and an amulet belonging to you was found at the scene of the crime.
translation: 塞里尔.卡尼利安被谋杀了，现场发现了属于你的护身符。

english: What? My amulet?
translation: 什么？我的护身符？

english: Yes, quite sloppy of you.
translation: 是的，你太粗心了。

english: Don't patronise me! Do you really think I'd be so foolish as to leave my own amulet at the scene of a murder? The amulet was stolen a few days ago. Someone must have planted it there to set me up!
translation: 别小看我！你真以为我会蠢到把自己的护身符留在谋杀现场吗？护身符几天前就被偷了。一定是有人把它放在那里陷害我！

english: I knew I shouldn't have taken this job!
translation: 我就知道不该接这活儿！

english: Job? What job?
translation: 活儿？什么活儿？

english: I needed money, badly. Some guy hired me for a simple robbery. Nice and straightforward, he said. All I had to do was break into that Carnillean house and retrieve something for him.
translation: 我急需钱。有个人雇我干一桩简单的盗窃。他说，简单直接。我只需要闯进卡尼利安家，帮他取回一样东西。

english: Who was this person?
translation: 那个人是谁？

english: I don't know. He kept his face hidden. All I know is that he was willing to pay a lot.
translation: 我不知道。他遮着脸。我只知道他愿意付很多钱。

english: And what did he want you to steal?
translation: 他让你偷什么？

english: Just some random scroll.
translation: 只是一张普通的卷轴。

english: So what happened to Ceril?
translation: 那塞里尔怎么了？

english: That had nothing to do with me! I admit, he saw me on my way out, but I was able to escape. I only found out he was dead after I got back to the Fight Arena!
translation: 那跟我无关！我承认，他出来时看见了我，但我逃掉了。我回到战斗竞技场后才知道他死了！

english: Hmm... What about this scroll? What was it?
translation: 嗯……那卷轴呢？是什么东西？

english: No idea. I was told to deliver it to some cultists south of the city, which I did.
translation: 不知道。他们让我把它送到城南的一些邪教徒那里，我照做了。

english: Ah, so it was the Hazeel Cult that hired you. That's not surprising.
translation: 啊，所以是哈兹尔邪教雇的你。这倒不奇怪。
