english: No, that's the thing. They were very happy when I gave them the scroll, but they had no idea I'd been hired to retrieve it!
translation: 不，问题就在这里。我把卷轴给他们时，他们非常高兴，但他们根本不知道我是被雇来取回它的！

english: What? But if that's the case, then who hired you?
translation: 什么？但如果是这样，那雇你的人是谁？

english: I told you, I don't know! He was meant to meet me in the bar earlier to pay me, but he never showed up. This is such a mess!
translation: 我跟你说过了，我不知道！他本来应该早些时候在酒吧见我付钱，但他没来。这真是一团糟！

english: Just some random scroll, but it wasn't even there! The whole thing was for nothing!
translation: 只是一张普通的卷轴，但甚至都不在那里！整件事白忙一场！

english: Hmm... Say the scroll had been there, what were you supposed to do with it?
translation: 嗯……假设卷轴在那里，你本来打算怎么处理它？

english: I was told to deliver it to some cultists south of the city.
translation: 他们让我把它送到城南的一些邪教徒那里。

english: What? But that doesn't make sense. The reason the scroll wasn't there is because the Hazeel Cult already managed to steal it. Why would they hire you to steal it again?
translation: 什么？但这说不通。卷轴不在那里的原因是哈兹尔邪教已经成功偷走了它。他们为什么还要雇你再去偷一次？

english: I told you, I don't even know who hired me! The guy was meant to meet me in the bar earlier to pay me, but he never showed up. This is such a mess!
translation: 我跟你说过了，我甚至不知道是谁雇的我！那个人本来应该早些时候在酒吧见我付钱，但他没来。这真是一团糟！

english: I don't like this. Something very strange is going on here. I need to find this person that hired you.
translation: 我不喜欢这样。这里发生了非常奇怪的事。我得找到雇你的那个人。

english: Good luck with that. He didn't seem like the kind of person who'd want to be found.
translation: 祝你好运。他看起来不像那种愿意被找到的人。

english: Well then I guess my best bet is to pay a visit to the Hazeel Cult. They're involved in some way, even if they themselves don't realise it.
translation: 那么，我最好去拜访一下哈兹尔邪教。他们以某种方式卷入了，即使他们自己没意识到。

english: So am I free to go?
translation: 那我可以走了吗？

english: I won't stop you, but you should consider going to the authorities. They might be able to help you.
translation: 我不会拦你，但你应该考虑去当局自首。他们也许能帮你。

english: Ha! Nice joke. I'm better off on my own.
translation: 哈！好笑话。我还是靠自己比较好。

english: If you're sure. Good luck.
translation: 如果你确定的话。祝你好运。

english: I thought you were going to see that cult?
translation: 我以为你要去见那个邪教？

english: I will be soon.
translation: 我很快就去。

english: Well I've told you everything I know, so no reason for you to still be lurking around here.
translation: 我已经把我知道的都告诉你了，所以你没必要再在这里晃悠了。

english: I think so. I have a new lead to investigate.
translation: 我想是的。我有新的线索要调查。

english: Well, let me know once you have something.
translation: 好吧，有消息了告诉我。

english: Well, well, well, what do we have here?
translation: 哎呀呀，看看这是谁？

english: Lord Hazeel, this is the adventurer who killed Alomone and got Jones captured.
translation: 哈兹尔大人，这就是那个杀了阿洛蒙、导致琼斯被抓的冒险者。

english: I see. So it was your actions that prevented my followers from bringing about my restoration?
translation: 我明白了。所以是你的行动阻止了我的追随者让我恢复力量？

english: Er... I guess so.
translation: 呃……我想是吧。

english: There was once a time when any who dared oppose me would flee to the furthest corners of this world to escape my wrath. Alas, it seems that in my absence, you mortals have grown arrogant once more.
translation: 曾经有一段时间，任何胆敢反对我的人都会逃到这个世界最远的角落以躲避我的怒火。唉，看来在我缺席期间，你们凡人又变得傲慢了。

english: It is no matter though, for your fate will be a reminder of what happens to those foolish enough to cross a Mahjarrat. Die now, knowing your efforts were in vain, for despite your best attempts, I have returned!
translation: 不过没关系，因为你的命运将提醒那些愚蠢到胆敢与玛哈加特作对的人的下场。现在去死吧，要知道你的努力都是徒劳的，因为尽管你竭尽全力，我还是回来了！

english: Before you go any further, there's something we should discuss.
translation: 在你动手之前，有件事我们得谈谈。

english: And why would I want to discuss anything with you?
translation: 我为什么要跟你谈任何事？

english: Because Ceril Carnillean is dead, and his killer may be trying to frame you!
translation: 因为塞里尔.卡尼利安死了，而他的杀手可能正在试图陷害你！

english: Dead? How curious. Clivet, I trust this was not our work?
translation: 死了？真有趣。克利维特，我相信这不是我们干的吧？

english: It was not, my lord.
translation: 不是我们干的，大人。

english: Very well, adventurer. Speak your piece, but do so quickly. When you are done, I will decide if your life is forfeit.
translation: 很好，冒险者。说出你的话，但要快。说完之后，我会决定是否取你性命。

english: A member of the Khazard Army called Evelot was hired to steal a scroll from the Carnillean Mansion and deliver it here.
translation: 卡扎德军的一个成员，名叫埃韦洛特，被雇来从卡尼利安宅邸偷一张卷轴，并送到这里。

english: And she was succesful. Thanks to her, my followers were able to use that scroll to bring about my restoration.
translation: 而她成功了。多亏了她，我的追随者才能用那张卷轴让我恢复力量。

english: Well during her escape, Ceril Carnillean was killed, but not by her. Someone else was there, but she doesn't know who.
translation: 在她逃跑的过程中，塞里尔.卡尼利安被杀了，但不是她杀的。当时还有另一个人在场，但她不知道是谁。

english: The evidence I've found so far suggests that the killer was trying to frame her. By extension, they might have been trying to frame you as well.
translation: 到目前为止我发现的证据表明，杀手试图陷害她。以此类推，他们可能也在试图陷害你。

english: You suggest that this individual is my foe, but if that were true, why would they have arranged to have my restoration scroll delivered here?
translation: 你是说这个人是我的敌人，但如果真是这样，他们为什么还要安排把我的恢复卷轴送到这里来？

english: Whoever this person is, they must be an ally to us, my lord.
translation: 不管这个人是谁，他一定是我们的盟友，大人。

english: And yet, an ally who hides in darkness is no true ally at all.
translation: 然而，一个隐藏在黑暗中的盟友根本不是真正的盟友。

english: Adventurer, you say this Evelot is part of the Khazard Army?
translation: 冒险者，你说这个埃韦洛特是卡扎德军的一员？

english: Then I think it's time to make my return known to my Mahjarrat kin. Clivet, summon Khazard. Let us see what he has to say of this.
translation: 那么我想是时候让我的玛哈加特同胞知道我的回归了。克利维特，召唤卡扎德。让我们听听他对此有什么说法。

english: Er... is now a bad time to mention that Khazard and I have a... complicated history?
translation: 呃……现在提一下我和卡扎德有……复杂的过往，是不是不太合适？

english: Well then, I suggest you prepare yourself.
translation: 那么，我建议你做好准备。

english: Vanar! Septinar! Filinar!
translation: 瓦纳尔！塞普提纳尔！菲林纳尔！

english: Hazeel? You've returned?
translation: 哈兹尔？你回来了？

english: Surprised, Khazard? Or just disappointed?
translation: 惊讶吗，卡扎德？还是失望？

english: Disappointed? I have no reason to be disappointed.
translation: 失望？我没有理由失望。

english: And yet you made no attempt to aid me yourself. Too busy claiming my lands as your own, perhaps?
translation: 但你却没有亲自帮助我。也许你太忙于把我的土地据为己有了？

english: They were our lands! And... hang on... what is this human filth doing here?
translation: 那是我们的土地！而且……等等……这个人类渣滓在这里做什么？

english: Filth? You're one to talk!
translation: 渣滓？你倒有脸说！

english: It's clear that I've allowed you to endure for far too long! Allow me to correct that mistake.
translation: 很明显，我容忍你太久了！让我来纠正这个错误。

english: Enough! This human is no friend of mine either, but [he/she] has presented me with information regarding my return that warrants investigation.
translation: 够了！这个人类也不是我的朋友，但[he/she]向我提供了关于我回归的信息，值得调查。

english: Then kill [him/her] and let's investigate. Or has your sleep made you go soft?
translation: 那就杀了[him/her]，然后我们调查。还是说你的沉睡让你变软了？

english: Make no mistake, if the human crosses me, I will gouge out [his/her] eyes and watch as [he/she] dines on them. Until then, [he/she] may be of use.
translation: 别搞错了，如果这个人类背叛我，我会挖出[his/her]的眼睛，看着[he/she]把它们当晚餐。在那之前，[he/she]可能还有用。

english: Fine, but I hope you know this is a foolish idea. What is the information [he/she] presented?
translation: 好吧，但我希望你知道这是个愚蠢的主意。[he/she]提供了什么信息？

english: Welcome, adventurer. It's good to see you once more.
translation: 欢迎，冒险者。很高兴再次见到你。

english: Alomone, I need to speak with Hazeel.
translation: 阿洛蒙，我需要和哈兹尔谈谈。

english: I'm afraid that isn't possible. Lord Hazeel is currently busy with his glorious work in the north. It is not our place to disturb him.
translation: 恐怕不行。哈兹尔大人目前正忙于他在北方的伟大工作。我们不便打扰他。

english: But it's very important. Has Jones not told you what's happened?
translation: 但这很重要。难道琼斯没告诉你发生了什么吗？

english: Jones? We have not heard from him in some time.
translation: 琼斯？我们有一阵子没他的消息了。

english: Well then I guess I'll be the one to break the news instead. Ceril Carnillean has been murdered.
translation: 好吧，那就由我来宣布这个消息吧。塞里尔.卡尼利安被谋杀了。

english: He has? What joyous news! Long have we waited for those Carnillean monsters to face the consequences of their crimes!
translation: 他死了？真是天大的好消息！我们等了这么久，终于看到那些卡尼利安的怪物为他们的罪行付出代价了！

english: I'd hold off on the celebrating if I were you. Something strange is going on and I really need to talk to Hazeel about it.
translation: 我要是你，就先别急着庆祝。有些事情不对劲，我真的需要跟哈兹尔谈谈。

english: Well... I suppose you have proven yourself to be a loyal servant to Hazeel. Still, I must warn you, our lord won't take kindly to being summoned unnecessarily.
translation: 嗯……我想你已经证明了自己是哈兹尔忠诚的仆从。不过我得提醒你，我们的主人不喜欢被无故召唤。

english: Very well. I will call upon the mighty Hazeel.
translation: 很好。我将召唤强大的哈兹尔。

english: Vanar! Maradar! Dominar!
translation: 瓦纳尔！马拉达尔！多米纳尔！

english: Adventurer, you have summoned me. I trust you understand that my work in the north is of the upmost urgency. I have little time for distractions.
translation: 冒险者，你召唤了我。我相信你明白我在北方的工作极其紧迫。我没时间浪费在琐事上。

english: I assure you, this is important.
translation: 我向你保证，这件事很重要。

english: Then speak.
translation: 那就说吧。

english: A member of the Khazard Army called Evelot was hired to steal your restoration scroll from the Carnillean Mansion. She was meant to deliver it here, but of course, it had already been taken.
translation: 卡扎德军队里一个叫埃韦洛特的成员被雇佣，去卡尼利安宅邸偷取你的复原卷轴。她本应把它送到这里，但当然，卷轴已经被拿走了。

english: During her escape, Ceril Carnillean was killed, but not by her. Someone else was there, but she doesn't know who.
translation: 在她逃跑时，塞里尔.卡尼利安被杀了，但凶手不是她。当时还有另一个人在，但她不知道是谁。

english: Curious. Alomone, I trust this was not our work?
translation: 奇怪。阿洛蒙，我相信这不是我们的人干的吧？

english: Not to my knowledge, my lord. Your loyal servant, Jones, was still stationed at the mansion, but he would not have acted without instruction.
translation: 据我所知不是，我的主人。您忠诚的仆从琼斯当时仍驻守在宅邸，但他不会在没有指示的情况下行动。

english: Where is Jones now?
translation: 琼斯现在在哪里？

english: He fled after the murder took place. The guards are still searching for him.
translation: 谋杀发生后他就逃跑了。守卫仍在搜捕他。

english: The actions of a coward. He will come to regret that.
translation: 懦夫的行径。他会为此后悔的。

english: There's something else as well. The evidence I've found so far suggests that the killer was trying to frame Evelot.
translation: 还有别的事。到目前为止我发现的证据表明，杀手试图陷害埃韦洛特。

english: And you believe they were attempting to frame my followers and I as well?
translation: 而且你认为他们也在试图陷害我和我的追随者？

english: That's what I'm wondering.
translation: 这正是我想知道的。

english: Forgive me, my lord, but if they aimed to frame us, why would they also try to have your restoration scroll delivered here?
translation: 原谅我，大人，但如果他们想陷害我们，为什么还要试图让你的修复卷轴送到这里？

english: A question with many possible answers, my faithful servant.
translation: 这个问题有很多可能的答案，我忠实的仆从。

english: Then let us see what my Mahjarrat kin has to say about this. Alomone, summon Khazard.
translation: 那让我们听听我的玛哈加特同族对此有什么话说。阿洛蒙，召唤卡扎德。

english: Hazeel? What is the meaning of this? And what is this human filth doing here?
translation: 哈兹尔？这是什么意思？还有这个人渣在这里干什么？

english: Enough! I care not for your petty disagreements. This adventurer is under my protection. You are not to harm [him/her].
translation: 够了！我没兴趣听你们那些幼稚的争执。这位冒险者受我保护。你不准伤害[him/her]。

english: Has the once great Hazeel gone soft? Never would I have expected you to work with scum like this. I trust you know that [he'll/she'll] betray you?
translation: 曾经伟大的哈兹尔也变得软弱了吗？我从未想过你会和这种人渣合作。我相信你知道[he'll/she'll]会背叛你吧？

english: And if [he/she] does, I will gouge out [his/her] eyes and watch as [he/she] dines on them. Until then, cease this prattle.
translation: 如果[he/she]真敢背叛，我会挖出[his/her]的眼睛，看着[he/she]把它们吃掉。在那之前，少在这里废话。

english: Fine, but I hope you have good reason for this.
translation: 行，但我希望你有个好理由。

english: Someone has murdered Ceril Carnillean and attempted to pass the blame onto one of your minions. Were you aware of this?
translation: 有人谋杀了塞里尔.卡尼利安，并试图把罪名推到你的一名手下身上。你知道这件事吗？

english: I don't involve myself in the personal affairs of my soldiers. Besides, I'd have thought you'd be happy to see that fool dead.
translation: 我不插手我士兵的私事。再说了，我以为你会很高兴看到那个白痴死了。

english: I shed no tears for his demise, and if his killer turns out to be a friend, I will reward them with riches beyond imagination. However, this individual and their motives remain unknown. We must rectify that.
translation: 我对他的死毫不惋惜，如果杀手结果是位朋友，我会用难以想象的财富奖励他们。然而，这个人和他们的动机仍然未知。我们必须纠正这一点。

english: Bah! This matter is beneath the both of us. Accept this for the gift it is and move on.
translation: 切！这种事根本不值得我们两个操心。接受这个礼物，继续往前走就是了。

english: No. Any individual involving themselves in our affairs, be they friend or foe, must be made known to us, especially as the ritual draws near.
translation: 不行。任何插手我们事务的人，无论是敌是友，我们都必须了解清楚，尤其是在仪式临近之际。

english: Ritual?
translation: 仪式？

english: Keep your nose out!
translation: 少管闲事！

english: Adventurer, how thorough has the investigation into Ceril Carnillean's murder been?
translation: 冒险者，你对塞里尔.卡尼利安谋杀案的调查有多彻底？

english: I'd say it's been pretty thorough. I handled most of it myself.
translation: 我觉得挺彻底了。大部分是我亲自处理的。

english: Have the family been questioned?
translation: 询问过他的家人了吗？

english: Er... not by me.
translation: 呃……我没问过。

english: Ah yes, very thorough.
translation: 啊，是的，非常彻底。

english: No stone can be left unturned. Adventurer, you must return to the Carnillean Mansion and uncover any information you might have missed.
translation: 不能放过任何一块石头。冒险者，你必须回到卡尼利安宅邸，找出你可能遗漏的任何信息。

english: You're trusting [him/her] with this? Stop this madness and let me handle it instead.
translation: 你让[him/her]来处理这事？别犯傻了，让我来接手吧。

english: This is not up for debate. I have made my will clear. Return to us once you have something, adventurer. Not before.
translation: 这不是在商量。我的意愿已经很清楚了。找到线索后再回来见我们，冒险者。没找到之前别回来。

english: Why should I help you?
translation: 我为什么要帮你？

english: You came to me, not the other way around. From that, I would assume that you already have some sort of motive in finding this killer. I care not what that motive is.
translation: 是你来找我的，不是我找你。由此看来，我想你已经有了某些动机要找出这个杀手。我不在乎那个动机是什么。

english: Aren't you worried about my loyalties?
translation: 你不担心我的忠诚吗？

english: Loyalty means very little to my kind. You opposed me before, but now you have a chance to rectify that mistake. Do so, and you will be rewarded. Oppose me again, and you will die.
translation: 忠诚对我这种存在来说不值一提。你以前反对过我，但现在你有机会纠正那个错误。这样做，你会得到奖赏。再敢反对我，你就会死。

english: Loyalty means very little to my kind. Still, without you, I might never have been awoken from my slumber.
translation: 忠诚对我这种存在来说不值一提。不过，如果没有你，我可能永远无法从沉睡中醒来。

english: Continue to support me and you will continue to be rewarded. The moment you oppose me, however, is the moment you die.
translation: 继续支持我，你会继续得到奖赏。但你一旦反对我，就是你死的时候。

english: Can you think of any possible suspects?
translation: 你能想到任何可能的嫌疑人吗？

english: Thousands. To have lived as long as I is to have made many friends, and many enemies. Any one of them may be responsible. Without further information, it is pointless to speculate.
translation: 成千上万。像我活了这么久，自然会结交很多朋友，也树了很多敌人。其中任何一个都有可能。没有进一步的信息，猜测毫无意义。

english: What is this ritual you mentioned?
translation: 你提到的仪式是什么？

english: It is nothing you need to concern yourself with.
translation: 这不是你需要操心的事。

english: The more information I have, the more help I can be.
translation: 我掌握的信息越多，就能提供越多的帮助。

english: You can be of ample help by performing the task you've been assigned. This idle chatter achieves nothing.
translation: 完成指派给你的任务就是最大的帮助。这些闲谈毫无意义。

english: Adventurer, I have summoned the mighty Hazeel as you desired. You should speak with him at once.
translation: 冒险者，我已按你的愿望召唤了强大的哈兹尔。你应该立刻跟他谈谈。

english: Adventurer, you should speak with Lord Hazeel and General Khazard at once.
translation: 冒险者，你应该立刻跟哈兹尔大人和卡扎德将军谈谈。

english: Lord Hazeel has given you a task to perform. Go and get it done.
translation: 哈兹尔大人给了你一项任务。去完成它吧。

english: Lord Hazeel has given you a task to perform. You should go with haste.
translation: 哈兹尔大人给了你一项任务。你应该赶快去。

english: Adventurer, you have work to do. Go to the Carnillean Mansion and uncover any information you might have missed. Return to us once you have something. Not before.
translation: 冒险者，你有工作要做。去卡尼利安宅邸，找出你可能遗漏的任何信息。找到线索后再回来见我们。没找到之前别回来。

english: No. Now go away.
translation: 不行。现在走吧。

english: You and Hazeel seem to have some history.
translation: 你和哈兹尔似乎有些旧日恩怨。

english: Continue to bother me and I'll make you history. Now go away.
translation: 再烦我，我就让你变成历史。现在滚开。

english: Then go away.
translation: 那就滚开。

english: Hello. I'd like to ask you some questions about what happened.
translation: 你好。我想问你一些关于事发经过的问题。

english: Please, leave me. If you have questions, take them to the guard outside.
translation: 请离开我。如果你有疑问，去找外面的守卫。

english: Hello there. I'd like to ask you some questions about your dad.
translation: 你好。我想问你一些关于你父亲的问题。

english: I shouldn't talk to you. You might be one of the bad people. The guard said I should be careful of the bad people.
translation: 我不应该跟你说话。你可能是坏人。守卫说我要小心坏人。

english: Hello there. I'd like to ask you some questions.
translation: 你好。我想问你几个问题。

english: I don't know if I should be answering any questions. You should probably check with the guard first.
translation: 我不知道我该不该回答问题。你最好先跟守卫确认一下。

english: I think so. I found Evelot and was able to question her. It seems someone might be trying to frame her.
translation: 我想是的。我找到了埃韦洛特，并能审问她。似乎有人可能试图陷害她。

english: Interesting. So what do you plan to do now?
translation: 有意思。那你现在打算怎么办？

english: I'd like to have another look around and ask some questions.
translation: 我想再四处看看，问一些问题。

english: Well you'll be pleased to know we were able to track down Jones. He's already admitted to being part of that cult. For that alone he'll be going away for a long time. However, he's staying silent on the murder.
translation: 那你应该会很高兴知道我们找到了琼斯。他已经承认是那个邪教的成员。仅凭这一条他就要被关很久。不过，他对谋杀一事保持沉默。

english: To be honest, with what I've discovered so far, I don't think he was involved. I suspect he just fled out of fear.
translation: 说实话，根据我目前发现的情况，我认为他没有参与。我怀疑他只是出于恐惧才逃跑的。

english: Really? He seems like the obvious suspect. If not him, then who?
translation: 真的吗？他看起来是明显的嫌疑人。如果不是他，那会是谁？

english: That's what I'm here to find out. I'd like to have another look around and ask some questions.
translation: 这正是我来这里要查清的。我想再四处看看，问一些问题。

english: Go right ahead. Lady Carnillean and Philipe are just inside, and you'll find Claus down in the kitchen.
translation: 请便。卡尼利安夫人和菲利佩就在里面，克劳斯在地下厨房里。

english: You're the one my husband hired to deal with that cult. Some good that did!
translation: 你就是我丈夫雇来处理那个邪教的人？真是白费力气！

english: I'm sorry, but right now we don't even think the cult were responsible.
translation: 我很抱歉，但目前我们甚至不认为邪教是元凶。

english: Who else could it be?
translation: 那还能是谁？

english: That's what I'm hoping to find out.
translation: 这正是我希望查明的。

english: Fine. What do you want to know?
translation: 好吧。你想知道什么？

english: When your husband was killed, did you see anything unusual?
translation: 你丈夫被杀的时候，你有没有看到什么不寻常的事？

english: No. It's as I told the guard. There was a noise coming from Jones' old room. My husband went to take a look and I heard him shout something.
translation: 没有。跟我告诉守卫的一样。琼斯旧房间传来一阵声响。我丈夫过去查看，我听到他喊了句什么。

english: Did you hear what he shouted?
translation: 你听到他喊了什么吗？

english: I didn't. I went to see what was happening, and I heard a scream. By the time I arrived, the only one there was my husband, lying on the floor.
translation: 我没有。我去看看发生了什么事，然后听到一声尖叫。等我赶到时，那里只有我丈夫躺在地板上。

english: And there was nothing else in the room that seemed odd?
translation: 房间里有没有其他看起来奇怪的东西？

english: No, nothing.
translation: 没有，什么都没有。

english: Okay, thank you for your help.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。

english: What questions?
translation: 什么问题？

english: Did you see any of what happened?
translation: 你看到当时发生了什么吗？

english: No! I was in bed. Now leave me alone! I don't want to talk to you.
translation: 没有！我当时在床上。现在别烦我！我不想跟你说话。

english: Okay, I'm sorry to have bothered you.
translation: 好的，抱歉打扰了。

english: But I already spoke to the authorities earlier.
translation: 但我之前已经跟当局谈过了。

english: I know, but I'm hoping I can uncover anything they missed.
translation: 我知道，但我希望能发现他们遗漏的东西。

english: Okay, go ahead.
translation: 好吧，问吧。

english: What were you doing at the time Ceril Carnillean was killed?
translation: 塞里尔.卡尼利安被杀时你在做什么？

english: I was here in the kitchen. Sir Ceril is an early riser, and he likes a good breakfast as soon as he wakes up.
translation: 我当时在厨房里。塞里尔爵士习惯早起，他喜欢一醒来就吃顿丰盛的早餐。

english: And you didn't see anything unusual down here?
translation: 你在这里没看到什么不寻常的东西吗？

english: You're absolutely sure? Not even the slightest thing out of place?
translation: 你确定吗？连一点不对劲的地方都没有？

english: Well... no... not really. I guess there was the cold...
translation: 嗯……没有……真的没有。不过，我觉得有点冷……

english: Cold?
translation: 冷？

english: Yes... this sudden cold feeling. I was right next to the warm stove, so it was very odd. I thought it was just some wind... but maybe...
translation: 是啊……突然一阵寒意。我当时就站在温暖的炉灶旁边，所以感觉很奇怪。我以为是风吹的……但也许……

english: Did you see anything when you felt this cold?
translation: 你感觉到这股寒意的时候，有看到什么吗？

english: Well... I thought I saw this shadow in the room, just for a moment. Surely it was just a trick of the light though...
translation: 嗯……我好像看到房间里有个影子，就一瞬间。不过肯定只是光线造成的错觉……

english: Hmm... I'm going to have a little look around down here, if that's okay?
translation: 嗯……我打算在这下面稍微看看，可以吗？

english: Hello. Did you find anything?
translation: 你好。你发现什么了吗？

english: I'm still working on it. Could you describe exactly what you felt and saw again?
translation: 我还在查。你能再详细描述一下你当时的感觉和看到的东西吗？

english: There was this sudden cold feeling and when I turned around, I thought I saw a shadow. Surely it was just a trick of the light...
translation: 就是突然一阵寒意，我转过身的时候，好像看到了一个影子。肯定只是光线造成的错觉……

english: If it was anything important, I'll find it.
translation: 如果是什么重要的东西，我会找到的。

english: Potentially, but I still need to do some more investigating.
translation: 有可能，但我还需要再调查一下。

english: Interesting... I wonder what Hazeel will make of this.
translation: 有意思……不知道哈兹尔会怎么想。

english: Hello there. Any luck with your investigation?
translation: 你好。调查有进展吗？

english: I have a new lead that I'm exploring.
translation: 我找到了一条新线索，正在追查。

english: Excellent. I hope it goes well.
translation: 太好了。希望一切顺利。

english: I think so. Hopefully it can help me find the killer.
translation: 我觉得是。希望能帮我找到那个杀手。

english: Have you completed your task? Speak with Lord Hazeel and General Khazard if so.
translation: 你的任务完成了吗？如果完成了，就去和哈兹尔领主以及卡扎德将军谈谈。

english: Adventurer, is your task complete? You should speak with Lord Hazeel and General Khazard if so.
translation: 冒险者，你的任务完成了吗？如果完成了，你应该去和哈兹尔领主以及卡扎德将军谈谈。

english: The adventurer returns. I trust this means you have something of note for us.
translation: 冒险者回来了。我相信这意味着你给我们带来了什么重要的消息。

english: I found a hidden room beneath the Carnillean Mansion. There was a chest inside with a scroll in it.
translation: 我在卡尼利安宅邸下面发现了一个隐藏的房间。里面有个箱子，箱子里有一张卷轴。

english: A scroll?
translation: 一张卷轴？

english: Yes. It had a sketch on it of some sort of crest. Well... half of one, at least.
translation: 是的。上面画着某种纹章的草图……至少是半张。

english: Half a crest? Could that be...?
translation: 半张纹章？难道那是……？

english: This chest, was there nothing else inside?
translation: 这个箱子里，没有别的东西了吗？

english: Nope, just the scroll.
translation: 没了，就只有卷轴。

english: The crest must have been in there.
translation: 纹章一定在里面。

english: So that was their true target. But I thought it was lost... How did it get there?
translation: 所以那才是他们的真正目标。但我以为它已经丢失了……它怎么会到那里去？

english: The Carnilleans must have claimed it after my defeat. The fools would have had no idea of its importance.
translation: 卡尼利安家族一定是在我失败后把它拿走了。那些蠢货根本不知道它的重要性。

english: What is this crest?
translation: 这个纹章是什么？

english: Who would even want to steal that thing? One of our kin, perhaps?
translation: 谁会想偷那东西？也许是我们的某个族人？

english: Quite possibly, though there are others who would know of it.
translation: 很有可能，不过知道它的人也不止我们。

english: Are you two going to keep talking in riddles, or are you going to tell me what's going on?
translation: 你们两个是要继续打哑谜，还是打算告诉我到底怎么回事？

english: Something is still amiss in all of this.
translation: 这件事还是有点不对劲。

english: I agree, but our next move is clear. We must go north.
translation: 我同意，但我们下一步很明确。我们必须往北走。

english: Maybe I've discovered the ability to turn totally invisible.
translation: 也许我发现了完全隐身的能力。

english: We should not waste any time. However, we must first deal with the human.
translation: 我们不应该浪费时间。不过，我们得先处理掉这个人类。

english: I will handle it.
translation: 我来处理。

english: Adventurer, your work is done. Leave us.
translation: 冒险者，你的工作完成了。离开我们吧。

english: What? But we haven't found the killer.
translation: 什么？但我们还没找到杀手。

english: Khazard and I will deal with this matter now. As a reward for your work, consider your past transgressions against us forgiven. Now go.
translation: 卡扎德和我会处理这件事。作为你工作的奖励，你过去对我们的冒犯就一笔勾销了。现在走吧。

english: Khazard and I will deal with this matter now. Once again, you have proven yourself a worthy ally to my followers and I. Now go.
translation: 卡扎德和我会处理这件事。你再次证明了自己是我和追随者们有价值的盟友。现在走吧。

english: A group of ice trolls have made their home near the fortress. I will join you there.
translation: 一群冰巨魔在堡垒附近安了家。我会在那里和你会合。

english: Ice trolls? Do you mean the trolls at Weiss?
translation: 冰巨魔？你是指韦斯那里的巨魔吗？

english: Hold on. Adventurer, you know of these trolls and their lands?
translation: 等等。冒险者，你知道这些巨魔和他们的领地？

english: Oh yes, I'm quite good friends with them. You see, there's this troll called My Arm...
translation: 哦，是的，我和他们是很好的朋友。你看，有一个叫'我的手臂'的巨魔...

english: Nobody cares! Be gone from our sight.
translation: 没人关心！从我们眼前消失。

english: If the human knows these ice trolls, [he/she] may still be of use to us.
translation: 如果这个人类认识那些冰巨魔，[he/she]可能对我们还有用。

english: Why? We can make short work of any trolls that disturb us. We have no need for dead weight.
translation: 为什么？任何打扰我们的巨魔我们都能轻松解决。我们不需要累赘。

english: Until we know more about who we are dealing with, we should avoid attracting unneeded attention.
translation: 在我们弄清楚对手是谁之前，应该避免引起不必要的注意。

english: Enough of this nonsense! If you want subtlety, we can use the Shadow Realm.
translation: 够了，别说这些废话了！如果你想要低调，我们可以用阴影领域。

english: There are others who dwell in the Shadow Realm. I would prefer they be kept unaware of our presence in the north.
translation: 阴影领域里还住着其他人。我希望他们不知道我们在北方的存在。

english: Fine, but on your head be it if this goes wrong.
translation: 好吧，但如果出了差错，你要负责。

english: Adventurer, it seems we have further need of you after all. Meet us outside this troll settlement. Don't make us wait.
translation: 冒险者，看来我们最终还是需要你。到这个巨魔定居点外面和我们碰头。别让我们等。

english: Alomone, in our absence, I trust you can take care of that matter we spoke of.
translation: 阿洛蒙，我们不在的时候，我相信你能处理好我们说过的那件事。

english: Good. Now, adventurer, it seems we have further need of you after all. Meet us outside this troll settlement. Don't make us wait.
translation: 很好。现在，冒险者，看来我们最终还是需要你。到这个巨魔定居点外面和我们碰头。别让我们等。

english: Lord Hazeel and General Khazard require you in the north. Meet with them at the troll settlement there. Now be gone.
translation: 哈兹尔领主和卡扎德将军需要你去北方。到那里的巨魔定居点和他们碰头。现在走吧。

english: Here. Wear this amulet; it is called The Sign Of Hazeel. Not only will it identify you as one of our brotherhood to other followers but it is also key to finding our hideout.
translation: 给你。戴上这个护身符；它叫做“哈兹尔之印”。它不仅能让其他追随者认出你是我们兄弟会的一员，也是找到我们藏身处的关键。

english: Excellent. It takes a rare character to see through the cursed Carnillean lies. I can tell you are a man of exactly the right character to join the followers of Hazeel.
translation: 太好了。能看穿被诅咒的卡尼利安家族的谎言，需要非凡的品格。我看得出来，你正是加入哈兹尔追随者的合适人选。

english: Excellent. It takes a rare character to see through the cursed Carnillean lies. I can tell you are a lady of exactly the right character to join the followers of Hazeel.
translation: 太好了。能看穿被诅咒的卡尼利安家族的谎言，需要非凡的品格。我看得出来，你正是加入哈兹尔追随者的合适人选。

english: What do you want adventurer?
translation: 你想要什么，冒险者？

english: You have no business here. Leave.... now.
translation: 这里没你的事。离开……现在。

english: It is good to see you once more. Did I not tell you how glorious Lord Hazeel is? With each day his power grows, and soon, very soon, we shall rule these lands!
translation: 很高兴再次见到你。我有没有告诉过你哈兹尔大人是多么辉煌？他的力量与日俱增，很快，很快，我们就会统治这片土地！

english: In the meantime I await his return here patiently until he calls upon me.
translation: 与此同时，我在这里耐心等待他的归来，直到他召唤我。

english: You may have won this battle meddler, but the war rages on. Go bother some goblins or something for when Hazeel returns your destruction is assured.
translation: 你也许赢得了这场战斗，多管闲事的家伙，但战争还在继续。去骚扰一些哥布林什么的吧，因为等哈兹尔归来，你必死无疑。

english: Adventurer, Lord Hazeel and General Khazard require your presence in the north. You should join with them at the troll settlement there.
translation: 冒险者，哈兹尔领主和卡扎德将军需要你到北方去。你应该到那里的巨魔定居点和他们碰头。

english: Now Lord Hazeel is returned unto us we await his strength to return so that we may smite our enemies!
translation: 如今哈兹尔大人回归我们身边，我们正等待他的力量恢复，好让我们能惩戒敌人！

english: You have crossed my path too many times intruder. Leave or face my wrath.
translation: 你挡我的路太多次了，闯入者。离开，否则面对我的怒火。

english: What? An intruder? Kill him!
translation: 什么？有闯入者？杀了他！

english: I'm meant to be meeting some... friends... Have you seen them?
translation: 我本来要和几个……朋友……碰面。你见过他们吗？

english: I don't think so... The only newcomers we've had here recently are those two strange trolls outside. I hope they're not up to no good.
translation: 应该没有……我们这里最近来的新人就是外面那两个奇怪的巨魔。希望他们别干坏事。

english: Hmm... okay.
translation: 嗯……好吧。

english: Good, you're here.
translation: 很好，你来了。

english: Er... what?
translation: 呃……什么？

english: The idiot doesn't even know it's us.
translation: 这个白痴甚至不知道是我们。

english: Wait... Hazeel? Khazard? Why are you trolls?
translation: 等等……哈兹尔？卡扎德？你们怎么变成巨魔了？

english: Given the secrecy of our task here, we felt it appropriate to shapeshift into less conspicuous forms.
translation: 考虑到我们在这里的任务需要保密，我们觉得变成不那么显眼的样子比较合适。

english: We? This foolish idea was yours alone.
translation: 我们？这个愚蠢的主意是你一个人想出来的。

english: Right... So what are we doing here?
translation: 好吧……那我们在这里做什么？

english: Based on your discovery, it is likely our mysterious killer will have travelled here.
translation: 根据你的发现，我们那个神秘的杀手很可能已经来到了这里。

english: To Weiss? What would they want with the trolls?
translation: 来韦斯？他们找巨魔做什么？

english: Ha! They will have no interest in trolls.
translation: 哈！他们对巨魔没兴趣。

english: This troll settlement is a relatively new addition to the area. It is what was here before that will be of interest to the killer.
translation: 这个巨魔定居点是该地区相对较新的建筑。杀手感兴趣的是这里之前的东西。

english: Which is none of your business. Now, can we get to work?
translation: 这不关你的事。现在，我们可以开始干活了吗？

english: Indeed. Adventurer, while our disguises will work up to a point, I imagine any troll would soon see through them if we were to converse with them.
translation: 没错。冒险者，虽然我们的伪装在一定程度上有用，但我想如果我们和巨魔交谈，他们很快就能看穿。

english: I doubt that. Trolls are as dumb as they come.
translation: 我表示怀疑。巨魔蠢得要命。

english: Our first step here is to gather information. As you claim to be friends with these trolls, you will be well placed to do so.
translation: 我们在这里的第一步是收集信息。既然你声称和这些巨魔是朋友，那你来做这件事最合适。

english: Speak with their leader and find out if anything of note has occurred here recently.
translation: 去和他们的首领谈谈，看看最近这里有没有发生什么值得注意的事。

english: Adventurer, speak with the leader of these trolls and find out if anything of note has occurred here recently. That will determine our next move.
translation: 冒险者，去和这些巨魔的首领谈谈，看看最近这里有没有发生什么值得注意的事。这将决定我们的下一步行动。

english: Have you seen anything odd around here recently?
translation: 你最近在这里看到什么奇怪的东西吗？

english: Odd? Don't think so. Maybe you ask Snowflake and My Arm though?
translation: 奇怪？不这么认为。不过也许你问问雪花和'我的手臂'？

english: Odd? Well my name Odd Stone. Got named after some odd stone thing I found in snowfields south of Weiss.
translation: 奇怪？我叫奇怪的石头。因为我在韦斯南边的雪地里发现了一块奇怪的石头，所以得了这个名字。

english: A magic person with a bone-head? Interesting... Has anything happened with this stone recently?
translation: 一个骨头脑袋的魔法师？有意思……这块石头最近有什么动静吗？

english: No. We trolls blocked all routes to snowfields from here, but we keep eye out just in case. No bone-head human out there in ages.
translation: 没有。我们巨魔堵住了从这里去雪地的所有路，但我们一直留意着以防万一。很久没有骨头脑袋的人类出现在那里了。

english: Hmm... Probably not what I'm after then. Seen anything else odd?
translation: 嗯……那可能不是我找的东西。还看到其他奇怪的东西吗？

english: Don't think so. Maybe you ask Snowflake and My Arm though?
translation: 不这么认为。不过也许你问问雪花和'我的手臂'？

english: Odd? Like what?
translation: 奇怪？比如什么？

english: I'm not sure to be honest. Anything unusual I guess.
translation: 老实说我也不确定。我想是任何不寻常的事。

english: Well there's two strange trolls outside who I'm sure I haven't seen before. I hope they're not up to no good.
translation: 嗯，外面有两个奇怪的巨魔，我肯定以前没见过。希望他们别干坏事。

english: Ah yes... those two. I was speaking to them earlier. They're harmless... I hope.
translation: 啊，对……那两个。我之前和他们说过话。他们没什么危害……希望如此。

english: If you want unusual, Goat Poo says he see da weirdness down in mine.
translation: 如果你想要不寻常的事，山羊粪说他看到矿井里有怪事。

english: Weirdness? What kind of weirdness?
translation: 怪事？什么样的怪事？

english: He say he see da strange shadow.
translation: 他说他看到了一个奇怪的影子。

english: There was the cave-in recently down there as well. That's what Goat Poo was investigating when he saw the shadow.
translation: 最近下面还发生了洞穴坍塌。山羊粪就是在调查那个的时候看到了影子。

english: Interesting. I think my... companions... might want to hear about this.
translation: 有意思。我想我的……同伴们……会想听听这个。

english: Did you find da weirdness down in mine?
translation: 你找到矿井里的怪事了吗？

english: I haven't looked yet.
translation: 我还没去看。

english: Goat Poo was investigating the cave-in down there when he says he saw a shadow. Could be worth a look.
translation: 山羊粪在调查下面的洞穴坍塌时说他看到了一个影子。可能值得一看。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Have you built the Fire of Nourishment by the new farming patches yet?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你在新的农业地块旁建好滋养之火了吗？

english: Let us try this again. Old Man, do your magic and open that door!
translation: 我们再试一次。老头子，用你的魔法打开那扇门！

english: Very well, I have another for you.
translation: 很好，我还有一个给你。

english: You are very kind, but I do not require that.
translation: 你真是太好了，但我不需要那个。

english: Please hurry, [player name]! For me and My Arm!
translation: 请快点，[player name]！为了我和'我的手臂'！

english: You are the human who came with My Arm. What do you want?
translation: 你是和'我的手臂'一起来的那个人类。你想要什么？

english: He is different from other man-trolls. I hope I will get to know My Arm better.
translation: 他和其他男巨魔不同。我希望我能更好地了解'我的手臂'。

english: No thank you, [player name], I do not need more poo in a bucket from you.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，[player name]，我不需要你再给我一桶粪便。

english: So you know the mortal enemy of our people!
translation: 所以你认识我们族人的死敌！

english: Now My Arm can tell Father that he killed the Wise Young Man. That will surely make Father like him, and agree to our marriage.
translation: 现在'我的手臂'可以告诉父亲他杀死了聪明的年轻人。那一定会让父亲喜欢他，并同意我们的婚姻。

english: You should perhaps free up some space so I can replace it.
translation: 你最好腾出一些空间，这样我才能替换它。

english: Please try again, [player name]. My Arm tells me you are very smart.
translation: 请再试一次，[player name]。'我的手臂'告诉我你很聪明。

english: That would explain your smell. But no, I asked for goat dung.
translation: 那就能解释你的气味了。但不对，我要的是山羊粪。

english: You should find some in the goat pen outside. I have been assigning some of my trolls to different duties around Weiss. You will see why soon.
translation: 你应该在外面山羊圈里找找。我一直在分配我的巨魔们在韦斯各处执行不同的任务。你很快就会明白为什么。

english: Not while your inventory is so full.
translation: 你的背包太满了，不行。

english: You seem to be struggling!
translation: 你看起来有点吃力！

english: You brought the Wise Young Man! Give the man to My Arm, so he can tell Father that he has killed the mortal enemy of our people.
translation: 你把聪明的年轻人带来了！把他交给'我的手臂'，这样他就可以告诉父亲他杀死了我们人民的死敌。

english: Now, please free up an inventory space, as I have something to give you.
translation: 现在，请腾出一个背包空间，我有东西要给你。

english: I'll see what my... companions... think.
translation: 我去看看我的……同伴们……怎么想。

english: We're blind here. My senses do nothing this close to the ritual marker.
translation: 我们在这里是瞎子。我的感官在靠近仪式标记的地方完全不起作用。

english: Nor mine, but there is no alternative.
translation: 也不是我的，但别无他法。

english: We wouldn't have this problem if we were in the Shadow Realm!
translation: 要是在阴影领域，我们就没这麻烦了！

english: What are you two on about now?
translation: 你们俩又在嘀咕什么呢？

english: Nothing! Stop eavesdropping!
translation: 没什么！别偷听！

english: It's hardly eavesdropping if you're having the conversation right in front of me.
translation: 你们当着我的面谈话，这哪算偷听。

english: Adventurer, did you discover anything?
translation: 冒险者，你发现什么了吗？

english: I did, but before we go any further, I think it's time for some answers.
translation: 确实有发现，但在继续之前，我觉得是时候听你们解释解释了。

english: You're in no place to make demands!
translation: 你还没资格提要求！

english: Well maybe I just won't tell you what I've learnt.
translation: 那行，我就没必要告诉你们我查到什么了。

english: You waste time we may not have, adventurer, but very well. Ask your questions, but do so quickly.
translation: 你在浪费我们可能没有的时间，冒险者。不过好吧，问你的问题，但快点。

english: I'm done asking questions. What now?
translation: 我问完了。现在怎么办？

english: Now you tell us what you have discovered.
translation: 现在你告诉我们你发现了什么。

english: There's been a cave-in down in the mine. One of the trolls apparently saw a strange shadow near it.
translation: 矿洞里发生了洞穴坍塌。有个巨魔说在附近看见了一道奇怪的影子。

english: A shadow? Could just be troll superstition.
translation: 影子？可能只是巨魔的迷信罢了。

english: The cook at the Carnillean Mansion also mentioned seeing a shadow. That doesn't feel like a coincidence.
translation: 卡尼利安宅邸的厨师也说看到了影子。这感觉不是巧合。

english: It sounds like we should investigate for ourselves. Adventurer, meet us down in this mine.
translation: 看来我们得亲自去查探。冒险者，到矿洞里跟我们会合。

english: Why would the killer come here?
translation: 杀手为什么要来这里？

english: Before the God Wars, a settlement of the old empire was found here. The fortress to the east is all that remains on the surface, but there is much still hidden below.
translation: 在神战之前，这里有一个旧帝国的定居点。东边的堡垒是地面上仅存的东西，但下面还隐藏着很多。

english: A great prison, sealed long ago. Half of the crest used to do so came into my possession, but it was seemingly taken by the Carnilleans after my defeat.
translation: 一座很久以前被封印的巨大监狱。封印所用的徽章一半曾归我所有，但在我溃败后似乎被卡尼利安家族拿走了。

english: And the killer stole it from the Carnilleans? You think they mean to open the prison?
translation: 杀手从卡尼利安家偷走了它？你觉得他们是想打开监狱？

english: That is our assumption.
translation: 这是我们的猜测。

english: Where's the other half of the crest?
translation: 徽章的另一半在哪儿？

english: It was held by one of our kin, but we haven't felt his presence for some time. It's possible the killer already has it.
translation: 曾由我们的一位同族保管，但我们已经有一段时间没感应到他的存在了。可能杀手已经拿到了。

english: But why would someone want to open this prison? What's inside?
translation: 但为什么会有人想打开这座监狱？里面有什么？

english: You've been told enough, human. Finish your questions and let us get back to work.
translation: 你知道得够多了，人类。问完问题，让我们回去干活。

english: What is this ritual you keep talking about?
translation: 你们一直说的那个仪式是什么？

english: What do you know of our kind?
translation: 你对我们的种族了解多少？

english: The Mahjarrat? Not a lot to be honest.
translation: 玛哈加特？说实话，不太了解。

english: Then let's keep it that way. This question has no relevance to our purpose here, Hazeel. It doesn't warrant an answer.
translation: 那就保持这样吧。这个问题与我们此行的目的无关，哈兹尔。不值得回答。

english: If it's not relevant, why do you two keep talking about it?
translation: 既然无关，你们俩为什么老提它？

english: It may be relevant, it may not be. It depends on who this killer is.
translation: 可能有关，可能无关。取决于这个杀手是谁。

english: Well assuming it is relevant, what can you tell me about it?
translation: 好吧，假设它有关，你能告诉我些什么？

english: The ritual is used by our kind to ensure our survival, and the next one is fast approaching. If the killer is one of our kin, their actions may be a means of preparing for it.
translation: 仪式是我们种族用来确保生存的方式，下一次仪式很快就要到了。如果杀手是我们的同族，那么他们的行动可能是在为仪式做准备。

english: Preparing how?
translation: 怎么准备？

english: For the rest of us to live, one of us must die. Many will go to great lengths to ensure they are not the one who is sacrificed.
translation: 为了让我们其他人活下去，必须有一人死去。许多人会不择手段确保自己不是被献祭的那个。

english: That's enough! You've already shared too much.
translation: 够了！你透露得太多了。

english: We have work to do, adventurer. Don't be gone too long.
translation: 我们还有事要做，冒险者。别离开太久。

english: Ask your questions, adventurer, but do so quickly.
translation: 问你的问题吧，冒险者，但要快点。

english: Hmm... did Hazeel and Khazard already go inside?
translation: 嗯……哈兹尔和卡扎德已经进去了吗？

english: Then let's get to work. First, you can't deny this time that the human is of no further use to us.
translation: 那就开始干活吧。首先，这次你没法否认这个人类对我们没用了。

english: I am here, you know?
translation: 我还在这儿呢，你知道吗？

english: Again with this, Khazard? [He/She] has been of great benefit so far. As long as that continues, [he/she] will remain.
translation: 又来这套，卡扎德？他/她至今帮了大忙。只要继续如此，他/她就会留下。

english: And what if I disagree?
translation: 那我要是不同意呢？

english: The decision is already made.
translation: 决定已经做了。

english: Says who? You? You don't command me! Do you think you're my lord? Or maybe you think you're my father?
translation: 谁说的？你？你命令不了我！你以为你是我的领主吗？还是你觉得你是我父亲？

english: No, and let us thank Zamorak for that.
translation: 不，而且让我们为此感谢萨莫拉克吧。

english: Hey, stop arguing and listen! I heard something.
translation: 嘿，别吵了，听！我听到什么动静了。

english: Adventurer, let us investigate. Khazard, stay here and guard the entrance.
translation: 冒险者，我们去调查一下。卡扎德，留在这里守卫入口。

english: No. I'll go with the human. You wait here.
translation: 不。我跟人类去。你在这儿等着。

english: What the... you!
translation: 搞什么……是你！

english: What the...!
translation: 搞什么……！

english: He's gone.
translation: 他消失了。

english: But where? Did he teleport?
translation: 去哪儿了？他传送了吗？

english: No. Just some cheap parlour trick. He's likely still nearby.
translation: 不。不过是些廉价的小把戏。他大概还在附近。

english: We should look for him.
translation: 我们该去找他。

english: We should, but first, you have some explaining to do. You knew him.
translation: 应该，但首先，你得解释一下。你认识他。

english: Well 'knew' is a bit of a strong word, but we've crossed paths.
translation: 嗯，“认识”这个词有点重，但我们打过交道。

english: Explain, and do so quickly.
translation: 解释，快点。

english: I encountered him on Entrana. He killed some monks there and stole a relic from them. I... may have been responsible for helping him, but I didn't realise until it was too late.
translation: 我在恩特纳岛遇见过他。他在那里杀了一些僧侣，偷走了一件遗物。我……可能算是帮了他一把，但等我意识到时已经太晚了。

english: Ah, so you were always a fool?
translation: 啊，所以你一直都是个傻瓜？

english: You're one to talk. So what was he doing here?
translation: 你还好意思说。那他在这里干什么？

english: And there you go aptly proving my point. As it seems I have to explain everything, this door leads to the prison Hazeel spoke of earlier.
translation: 你正好证明了我的观点。看来我得解释一切，这扇门通向哈兹尔之前提到的监狱。

english: Your friend is likely the culprit in our little murder mystery, or at least, is working with the one responsible.
translation: 你的朋友很可能就是咱们这个小谋杀之谜里的凶手，或者至少跟凶手是一伙的。

english: But it didn't look like he could open the door. He must still only have half the crest.
translation: 但他好像打不开门。他肯定还只有一半徽章。

english: And let us hope it stays that way. Now, I will stay here and guard the door in case your friend returns. Go and tell Hazeel what happened. Now.
translation: 让我们希望保持这样。现在，我将留在这里守门，以防你的朋友回来。去告诉哈兹尔发生了什么。现在就去。

english: A 'please' wouldn't do any harm.
translation: 说声“请”又不会少块肉。

english: 'Please' shut up and go.
translation: “请”闭嘴然后滚蛋。

english: Why are you here? Go and tell Hazeel what happened. Now.
translation: 你还在这儿干嘛？去告诉哈兹尔发生了什么。快去。

english: Alright, I'm going.
translation: 好吧，我这就去。

english: Where is Khazard?
translation: 卡扎德在哪儿？

english: He's back there. There's been a development.
translation: 他在后面。有进展了。

english: We found the door to the prison, and we found someone trying to open it.
translation: 我们找到了监狱的门，还发现有人试图打开它。

english: Someone?
translation: 有人？

english: An assassin. I've encountered them before, but I don't really know anything about them.
translation: 一个刺客。我以前遇到过他们，但我对他们几乎一无所知。

english: And the crest?
translation: 那徽章呢？

english: It seems they still only have half of it.
translation: 他们似乎还只有一半。

english: Curious. Why would they come here with only half the crest?
translation: 有意思。为什么只带一半徽章就来这里？

english: Perhaps they didn't know they'd need the other half?
translation: 也许他们不知道还需要另一半？

english: Possible, but unlikely. It should be clear to anyone that both halves are needed. I wonder...
translation: 有可能，但可能性不大。任何人都应该清楚需要两半。我怀疑……

english: As I mentioned earlier, the other half was held by one of my kin. My kind have the ability to sense each other, but we have not felt his presence for a long time now.
translation: 我之前提过，另一半由我的一位同族保管。我们有种族感应能力，但我们已经很久没有感应到他的存在了。

english: So he's dead?
translation: 所以他死了？

english: That was my initial assumption, but it is unusual that we have not felt his passing either. It's possible he is masking his presence instead.
translation: 我最初也这么认为，但我们同样没有感应到他的陨落，这很奇怪。有可能他在隐藏自己的气息。

english: It's no easy feat, but it can be done. As fate would have it, we stand in a place where our senses mean nothing.
translation: 这不是件容易的事，但可以做到。巧合的是，我们现在所处的地方，我们的感应能力毫无作用。

english: So you think he's nearby?
translation: 所以你觉得他在附近？

english: While foolish to do so, he would have good reason to hide himself in this area.
translation: 虽然这么做很蠢，但他有充分的理由藏在这片区域。

english: So the other half might be closer than we think. What do we do?
translation: 所以另一半可能比我们想的要近。我们怎么办？

english: This assassin must be found. I will remain here and ensure no one enters or leaves. You will search the rest of this dungeon and see what you can find.
translation: 这个刺客必须被找到。我将留在这里确保无人进出。你去搜索这个地牢的其他部分，看看能找到什么。

english: Why would this other Mahjarrat hide himself here?
translation: 这个玛哈加特为什么要藏在这里？

english: Our rejuvenation ritual takes place right above us. There have been times in the past when the weaker of our number have tried to hide themselves nearby.
translation: 我们的重生仪式就在我们正上方进行。过去有些比较弱的同族曾试图藏在附近。

english: To claim power from the ritual without the risk of being chosen as the sacrifice.
translation: 为了从仪式中获取力量，同时避免被选为祭品。

english: So I'm guessing this other Mahjarrat is quite a weak one then?
translation: 所以我猜这个玛哈加特相当弱？

english: You are correct. When the Empty Lord fell, he was one of the few foolish enough to remain loyal. His decision not to join Lord Zamorak left him with few friends. He has slowly grown weak ever since.
translation: 没错。当空之主殒落时，他是少数愚蠢到仍然效忠的人之一。他选择不加入萨莫拉克领主，导致朋友寥寥无几。从那以后，他慢慢变得虚弱。

english: What's inside the prison that the assassin would want?
translation: 监狱里有什么是刺客想要的？

english: The prison was sealed long ago by two of my traitorous kin. They did so to prevent a great horror from escaping, but it is believed by some that a powerful artefact was also sealed inside.
translation: 监狱很久以前被我的两个叛徒同族封印。他们这么做是为了防止某个恐怖存在逃脱，但有些人相信里面还封印了一件强大的神器。

english: And the assassin wants this artefact?
translation: 刺客想要这件神器？

english: Most likely. However, his attempts to claim it will risk unleashing what lies within.
translation: 很有可能。但他试图夺取它的行为可能会释放里面的东西。

english: Which you consider to be a problem?
translation: 你觉得这是个问题？

english: In an ideal world, I would see this artefact claimed in the name of Zamorak. But to risk unleashing an abomination of the Fallen Empire when the ritual is so close would not be wise.
translation: 理想情况下，我希望这件神器以萨莫拉克之名被夺取。但在仪式临近之际，冒险释放堕落帝国的憎恶怪并不明智。

english: What's the history between you and Khazard?
translation: 你和卡扎德之间有什么旧事？

english: That is none of your business. I have been generous enough to share a great deal of information with you so far, but I will not allow you to pry into personal matters.
translation: 这不关你的事。我已经够大方了，跟你分享了很多信息，但我不会允许你打探私事。

english: Fair enough. Could you at least tell him to leave me alone? I feel like every time I turn my back, he's going to put his sword through it.
translation: 好吧。你能不能至少让他别来烦我？我感觉每次我一转身，他就会把剑刺进我的后背。

english: And have I not already been stopping him from doing so? Besides, his anger is not without cause. You wronged him, did you not?
translation: 难道我不是一直在阻止他这么做吗？再说了，他的愤怒并非毫无缘由。你亏欠了他，不是吗？

english: In my defence, he was doing some pretty nasty things. Not to mention, I also wronged you and you're not trying to have me killed constantly.
translation: 为我自己辩护，他在做一些相当恶劣的事情。更不用说，我也冤枉了你，而你并没有一直试图让我被杀。

english: Yes, but you would be wise not to mistake my mercy for weakness. I am willing to forgive you for your past transgressions as I believe you can be of use.
translation: 没错，但你最好别把我的仁慈当成软弱。我愿意原谅你过去的过错，因为我相信你还有利用价值。

english: However, if I come to regret my choice, your fate will make the fires of Infernus seem welcoming in comparison.
translation: 不过，如果我后悔自己的选择，你的下场会让地狱之火都显得温和。

english: In my defence, he was doing some pretty nasty things.
translation: 为我自己辩护，他在做一些相当恶劣的事情。

english: If you do not have the stomach for certain... unpleasantries, you should not have allied yourself with me, either.
translation: 如果你受不了某些……不愉快的事，那你一开始就不该与我结盟。

english: You seem more reasonable than Khazard, though.
translation: 不过你看起来比卡扎德通情达理多了。

english: Perhaps, but I trust you do not mistake that for weakness. If you wrong me, your fate will make the fires of Infernus seem welcoming in comparison.
translation: 也许吧，但我相信你不会把这误认为软弱。如果你背叛我，你的下场会让地狱之火都显得温和。

english: Adventurer, we must find the assassin. Search the rest of this dungeon and see what you can find.
translation: 冒险者，我们必须找到那个刺客。搜索这个地牢的其余部分，看看你能发现什么。

english: I wanted to ask you something.
translation: 我想问你点事。

english: No. I assume Hazeel has given you a job to do? Go get it done and leave me in peace.
translation: 不。我猜哈兹尔给了你任务？去完成它，别来打扰我。

english: What on Gielinor...!
translation: 这到底是什么……！

english: Adventurer, have you found the assassin?
translation: 冒险者，你找到刺客了吗？

english: No, but I have found something... It's sort of hard to explain. I think I need to get back there.
translation: 没有，但我发现了一些东西……有点难以解释。我想我得回去那里。

english: Then go at once.
translation: 那就立刻去吧。

english: Aargh... Muspah! Wait... What...?
translation: 啊……穆斯帕！等等……什么……？

english: Hmm... just another nightmare.
translation: 嗯……又是一个梦魇。

english: Just a nightmare? That feels like a bit of an understatement.
translation: 只是一个梦魇？这感觉有点轻描淡写了。

english: What is this? A human?
translation: 这是什么？一个人类？

english: Who are you, human? Speak now, and do so with haste, for you stand before the mighty Jhallan!
translation: 你是谁，人类？快说，而且要快，因为你站在强大的贾兰面前！

english: Well I'm [player name], and I'm guessing you're the Mahjarrat I'm looking for.
translation: 我是[player name]，我猜你就是我要找的玛哈加特。

english: A human, seeking a Mahjarrat? Why? What would a meaningless being like you want with me?
translation: 一个人类，寻找玛哈加特？为什么？像你这样微不足道的东西找我做什么？

english: You have half a crest, right? There's an assassin who's after it. I'm trying to stop him.
translation: 你有一半的徽章，对吧？有个刺客在追它。我想阻止他。

english: You know of the Ghorrock Crest? How?
translation: 你知道戈罗克徽章？怎么知道的？

english: A story of lies, no doubt. I don't know how you came to stand before me, human, but you are clearly no friend of mine. Leave now, before I bring down the might of the Ruinous Powers on you!
translation: 无疑是个谎言故事。我不知道你是怎么站在我面前的，人类，但你显然不是我的朋友。在我用毁灭之力将你击垮之前，赶紧离开！

english: Wait! It's true! This assassin is nearby. He'll be coming for you!
translation: 等等！这是真的！那个刺客就在附近。他会来找你的！

english: Then let him come! I am a faithful servant of the Empty Lord. I will not be intimidated by a pathetic human like you.
translation: 那就让他来吧！我是空之主的忠实仆从。我不会被你这种可怜的人类吓倒。

english: And who are you?
translation: 你是谁？

english: Oh, this is not good...
translation: 喔，这可不太妙……

english: Khazard... we have a big problem!
translation: 卡扎德……我们有大麻烦了！

english: What have you done now?
translation: 你又闯什么祸了？

english: I found Jhallan, but the assassin captured him!
translation: 我找到贾兰了，但刺客抓住了他！

english: Jhallan was here? Great. Hazeel!
translation: 贾兰来过这里？很好。哈兹尔！

english: The assassin captured Jhallan!
translation: 刺客抓住了贾兰！

english: Then he now has everything he needs to enter the prison.
translation: 那他现在已经拥有进入监狱所需的一切了。

english: What's our next...
translation: 我们接下来……

english: Hang on...
translation: 等等……

english: I don't understand. I didn't even see anything.
translation: 我不明白。我什么都没看到。

english: It seems your friend has quite the range of abilities. He used the Shadow Realm.
translation: 看起来你的朋友能力相当广泛。他使用了阴影领域。

english: So he got inside? Do we follow him?
translation: 所以他进去了？我们要跟进去吗？

english: No good will come out of going in there. We have failed.
translation: 进去不会有好结果的。我们失败了。

english: So we're not going to do anything?
translation: 所以我们什么都不做？

english: Guards will need positioning here to warn us if this assassin remerges. Until then, we can only hope that he meets a swift end in the prison.
translation: 需要在这里布置守卫，以防刺客再次出现。在此之前，我们只能希望他在监狱里赶快丧命。

english: I can have a detachment of soldiers despatchedhere at once. We'll need to keep things light to ensure the trolls don't notice our work. Not to mention our kin...
translation: 我可以立即派一队士兵到这里。我们需要保持低调，确保巨魔不会注意到我们的行动，更别提我们的族人了……

english: What about Jhallan?
translation: 那贾兰怎么办？

english: Still a prisoner of this assassin, no doubt. To what end, who can say.
translation: 无疑仍是刺客的囚徒。至于最终目的，谁知道呢。

english: Is there really nothing else we can do?
translation: 真的没有别的办法了吗？

english: No. Word will be sent to you if there are any developments, but for now, you should leave. I suggest you return to the authorities in Ardougne and inform them that their killer will not be found.
translation: 没有了。如果有任何进展，会通知你，但现在你该离开了。我建议你回阿多尼城的当局，告诉他们那个杀手找不到了。

english: But there's still so many unanswered questions!
translation: 但还有那么多未解之谜！

english: And perhaps one day they will be answered, but to dwell on them now achieves nothing.
translation: 也许有一天会得到解答，但纠结于此于事无补。

english: We should get to work.
translation: 我们该开工了。

english: Agreed. Adventurer, we are done here. If you wish, I can provide you with a teleport to Ardougne.
translation: 同意。冒险者，这里的事完了。如果你愿意，我可以提供传送到阿多尼城。

english: Adventurer, we are done here. If you wish, I can provide you with a teleport to Ardougne.
translation: 冒险者，这里的事完了。如果你愿意，我可以提供传送到阿多尼城。

english: Adventurer, we are done here. You should return to Ardougne.
translation: 冒险者，这里的事完了。你该回阿多尼城了。

english: You're back. Any luck with your investigation?
translation: 你回来了。调查有进展吗？

english: I wish I had better news, but I'm afraid I reached a dead end.
translation: 但愿有好消息，但恐怕我走进了死胡同。

english: The killer was an assassin. I don't know his true identity, but I previously encountered him on Entrana. He killed some monks there and stole an important relic.
translation: 那个杀手是个刺客。我不知道他的真实身份，但之前在恩特纳岛遇到过。他在那里杀了几名修士，偷了一件重要的遗物。

english: An assassin? Why would an assassin want Sir Ceril dead?
translation: 刺客？为什么刺客要杀塞利尔爵士？

english: Quite a bit is still unclear, but it seems he cared less about killing Ceril and more about recovering something hidden in the mansion.
translation: 很多细节还不清楚，但他似乎并不在乎杀塞利尔，更在乎取回藏在府邸里的某个东西。

english: Where is this assassin now?
translation: 那个刺客现在在哪儿？

english: Somewhere we have no hope of reaching him. Hopefully that changes, but for now, there's not much we can do.
translation: 在一个我们无法企及的地方。希望情况能改变，但目前我们做不了什么。

english: Well I guess I'd better go and file my report on all this. My superiors aren't going to be happy.
translation: 好吧，我想我最好去把这一切写成报告。我的上级不会高兴的。

english: Still, thank you for all your help. Even though we weren't successful, I very much appreciate you trying. If you discover anything new about this assassin, do let me know.
translation: 不过，还是谢谢你的帮助。虽然没有成功，但很感激你的努力。如果发现这个刺客的新线索，一定告诉我。

english: Well I guess I'd better go and file my report on all this. My superiors aren't going to be happy. First the Jones situation, now this.
translation: 好吧，我想我最好去把这一切写成报告。我的上级不会高兴的。先是琼斯的事，现在又是这个。

english: Jones situation?
translation: 琼斯的事？

english: Ah, of course, you don't know. Jones was found dead in his cell. Poison by the looks of it.
translation: 啊，当然，你不知道。琼斯被发现死在他的牢房里。看起来是中毒。

english: Yes, quite the mess. Assumption is the cult are to blame. Tying up loose ends and all that.
translation: 是的，一团糟。推测是邪教干的。收拾善后什么的。

english: Anyway, thank you for all your help. Even though we weren't successful, I still very much appreciate it. If you discover anythiing new about this assassin, do let me know.
translation: 总之，谢谢你的帮助。虽然没有成功，我仍然很感激。如果发现这个刺客的新线索，一定告诉我。

english: I'll let you be on your way. All the best out there.
translation: 那我就不耽误你了。祝你一切顺利。

english: That's good to hear. Hopefully there's still a chance that the assassin is found one day.
translation: 听到这个很好。希望有一天还能找到那个刺客。

english: We can hope. If you do ever hear any more about him, be sure to let us know.
translation: 我们可以希望。如果你再听到他的消息，一定告诉我们。

english: Will do. Now, I should leave you to your work.
translation: 会的。现在，我就不打扰你工作了。

english: TOYS! I WANT TOYS!
translation: 玩具！我要玩具！

english: Daddy says you don't like Mr. Jones. Mr. Jones is nice. He brings me toys and sweets.
translation: 爸爸说你不喜欢琼斯先生。琼斯先生人很好。他给我带玩具和糖果。

english: You're a bad man! I don't like you!
translation: 你是个坏人！我不喜欢你！

english: You're a bad lady! I don't like you!
translation: 你是个坏女人！我不喜欢你！

english: Please, do not disturb me. The loss of my husband is a hard burden to bear. I would prefer not to have distractions.
translation: 请别打扰我。失去丈夫是难以承受的重担。我不想分心。

english: Oh, hello. If you wish to look around the Carnillean family home please refrain from touching anything with those grubby hands of yours.
translation: 哦，你好。如果你想参观卡尼利安家族宅邸，请别用你那脏手碰任何东西。

english: Hello again adventurer! Since you dealt with those horrible hooligan cultists, things have vastly improved for us around here!
translation: 又见面了，冒险者！自从你处理了那些可怕的流氓邪教徒之后，我们这里的情况就好多了！

english: I have been instructed by my husband to have no dealings with an utter scoundrel such as yourself.
translation: 我丈夫吩咐过我，不许和你这样的无赖有任何来往。

english: So kindly leave me alone and be on your way.
translation: 所以请你行行好，别来烦我，走你的路吧。

english: Things aren't the same here now that Sir Ceril is gone.
translation: 塞利尔爵士不在了，这里一切都变了。

english: Ah, excellent, you've made your own serum and it seems to work well! Many thanks for using the Serum on me! But beware, I may start to change back soon!
translation: 啊，太棒了，你制作了自己的血清，而且看起来效果很好！非常感谢你对我使用血清！但要小心，我可能很快就会变回去！

english: My name is Ulsquire Shauncy, I'm the local teacher and priest around here. You've really come at a time when  Mort'ton is in a terrible state.
translation: 我叫乌尔斯奎尔.肖恩西，我是这里的本地教师和祭司。你来得正是时候，莫顿镇现在糟透了。

english: The emanations from the rest of Morytania affect the people here terribly turning them into mindless creatures. And, as if that wasn't enough, we get picked off by the evil Shades that exist in this area.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚其他地区散发出的气息严重影响了这里的人，把他们变成了没有心智的怪物。而且，这还不够，我们还会被这片区域的邪恶阴魂逐个猎杀。

english: Wow, you guys seem to be really at the bottom of the food chain around here.
translation: 哇，你们这些人在这里似乎真的处于食物链的最底层。

english: This sad and afflicted little town is called 'Mort'ton'. In it's heyday it was a busy and bustling market town with a speciality for interring the dead.
translation: 这个悲伤而受折磨的小镇叫做'莫顿镇'。在它的全盛时期，它是一个繁忙而熙攘的集镇，以埋葬死者为特色。

english: The vile emanations from the Sanguinesti area started to spread and the town hasn't been the same since. The serum you made was the one that Herbi Flax was working on. Unfortunately the serum isn't permanent.
translation: 来自桑吉内斯蒂地区的邪恶气息开始扩散，这个小镇从此一蹶不振。你制作的血清正是赫比.弗拉克斯一直在研究的那种。不幸的是，这种血清不是永久性的。

english: Do you know how I could make the serum permanent?
translation: 你知道怎么让血清变成永久性的吗？

english: I remember Herbi Flax talking about the serum. He said it worked on what he called the 'biological' effects of the affliction but that some other secondary effect was at work which he didn't quite understand.
translation: 我记得赫比.弗拉克斯提到过这种血清。他说它作用于他所谓的这种疾病的'生物'效应，但还有一些其他次要效应在起作用，他不太理解。

english: He was interested in 'Flaemtaer', the ruined temple to the North. I found this odd. A man of science studying a structure dedicated to faith and the struggle of good verus evil, another concept he didn't understand.
translation: 他对北边的‘弗拉姆塔尔’废墟感兴趣。我觉得这很奇怪。一个研究科学的人，却去研究一座致力于信仰和善恶斗争的建筑——另一个他无法理解的概念。

english: The people are affected by the emanations from  the rest of Morytania and the dead from the tombs  have manifested into shadow creatures.
translation: 人们受到莫利塔尼亚其他地方散发的气息影响，而墓穴中的死者则化成了暗影生物。

english: What are all these shadowy creatures?
translation: 这些暗影生物是什么？

english: They are the disturbed spirits of those interred in the earth beneath Mort'ton. Their eternal spirits have been poisoned by the close vicinity to the evil nature of the inhabitants of the Sanguinesti area.
translation: 它们是葬在莫顿镇地下那些死者的不安灵魂。由于靠近桑吉内斯蒂地区居民的邪恶本性，它们永恒的灵魂被毒化了。

english: Is there anyone else worth talking to around here?
translation: 这里还有其他人值得聊聊吗？

english: Well, there's my good friend Razmire Keelgan. He's a prominent shop owner in Mort'ton, at least he was before he was affected by the area.
translation: 嗯，还有我的好朋友拉兹米尔.基尔根。他是莫顿镇一位著名的店铺老板，至少在他受到这个地方影响之前是这样。

english: I know he tried to gather the militia together to fight the shades. He might know something about the temple. Razmire lives in the building to the west just over there, go and talk to him.
translation: 我知道他曾试图召集民兵对抗阴魂。他可能知道一些关于那个神庙的事情。拉兹米尔就住在西边的那栋建筑里，就在那边，去找他谈谈吧。

english: My name is Razmire Keelgan, I run a couple of shops in Mort'ton but don't get much custom these days.
translation: 我叫拉兹米尔.基尔根，我在莫顿镇经营几家店铺，但最近没什么顾客。

english: Which stores do you run?
translation: 你经营哪些店铺？

english: I run a general store with a few useful items, and I have a building supplies store, I'm hoping that when things get better down here, people will want to buy items to repair their buildings.
translation: 我经营一家杂货店，卖一些有用的物品，还有一家建筑补给品店。我希望等这里情况好转后，人们会想买材料来修复他们的建筑。

english: Well to be honest, all of my stock is packed away right now seeing as the town is all overrun with these Shades. I tell you what. You put an end to five Shades for me and I'll open the store for you!
translation: 老实说，我所有的货物现在都打包收起来了，因为镇上到处都是这些阴魂。这样吧，你帮我干掉五个阴魂，我就为你开店！

english: I have details on that dilapidated temple to the North. These shades have a purpose - they jealously guard their burial treasure! If you can do me some favours, I could help you to locate it!
translation: 我有关于北边那座破败神庙的详细信息。这些阴魂是有目的的——它们嫉妒地守护着它们的墓葬宝藏！如果你能帮我几个忙，我可以帮你找到它！

english: This place is called Mort'ton, it used to be a quiet town with a specialism in death. That is to say that many burial tombs were created here in the naturally formed caves under this very village.
translation: 这个地方叫做莫顿镇，曾经是一个安静的小镇，以死亡为专长。也就是说，许多墓葬墓穴就建在这个村庄下方的天然洞穴中。

english: Well, the people of the village, my usual customers... are all affected by the emanations from some place to the North East. Ulsquire can give you the name.
translation: 嗯，这个村庄的人们——我昔日的顾客——都受到东北方向某个地方散发的气息影响。乌尔斯奎尔能告诉你那个地方的名字。

english: Needless to say Herbi was working on a serum to help us and you stumbled across the recipe! I for one am grateful to you, but there's a lot left to do before Mort'ton is returned to it's former glory.
translation: 不用说，赫比正在研制一种血清来帮助我们，而你偶然发现了那份食谱！我个人非常感激你，但在莫顿镇恢复昔日辉煌之前还有很多事情要做。

english: Those disgusting entities are the filth that have ruined my life. They're the restless spirits of the dead who jealously guard their burial treasure yet feed on the  life force of the living.
translation: 那些令人作呕的实体就是毁了我生活的污秽。它们是死者不安的灵魂，嫉妒地守护着它们的墓葬宝藏，同时以活人的生命力为食。

english: I've heard that they jealously guard their tomb treasure and that it's worth plundering. I need you to kill five shades and bring me their remains so that I can conduct some experiments. Will you do it?
translation: 我听说它们嫉妒地守护着它们的墓葬宝藏，值得一抢。我需要你杀死五个阴魂，并把它们的遗骸带给我，这样我就可以进行一些实验。你愿意做吗？

english: Yes, I'll dispatch those dark and evil creatures.
translation: 是的，我会消灭那些黑暗邪恶的生物。

english: Great, that's what I wanted to hear. When you've done it, bring back all the remains,  I want to inspect them.
translation: 太好了，这正是我想听的。等你做完之后，把所有遗骸都带回来，我想检查一下。

english: Sorry, not right now, I need to do something else first.
translation: 抱歉，现在不行，我得先做点别的事。

english: Ok, fair enough...
translation: 好吧，那就算了……

english: Is there anything worth doing around here?
translation: 这附近有什么值得做的事吗？

english: Life is a daily struggle with those Shades around here. They attack when you least expect it...it's terrifying! I tell you what, if you kill five of those Shades I'll see if I can help you out! Is it a deal?
translation: 在这里，每天都要和那些阴魂做斗争。它们总在你最意想不到的时候攻击……太可怕了！这样吧，如果你杀掉五个阴魂，我就看看能不能帮你！成交吗？

english: Hey, have you killed the five shades yet?
translation: 嘿，你杀了那五个阴魂了吗？

english: No not yet!
translation: 还没！

english: Come back then when you have. And remember to bring me the remains, Ulsquire seems to think we might be able to send these poor souls to a better place.
translation: 那等你杀完了再回来。记得把遗骸带给我，乌尔斯奎尔似乎觉得我们也许能把那些可怜的灵魂送到更好的地方去。

english: How's it going? I talked to Razmire and he's asked  me to slay five shades.
translation: 情况如何？我和拉兹米尔谈过了，他让我杀掉五个阴魂。

english: I can't say that I'm surprised, Razmire hates them, but it would be interesting to see the remains of one and investigate it somehow. I might find something useful!
translation: 我不意外，拉兹米尔恨它们，但能看到一个阴魂的遗骸并研究一下应该会很有趣！也许我能发现什么有用的东西！

english: Have you killed those Shades yet?
translation: 你杀了那些阴魂了吗？

english: No, sorry, not yet.
translation: 还没，抱歉。

english: Well, come back when you have.
translation: 好吧，那等你杀了再来。

english: Yes I have actually!
translation: 是的，我已经杀了！

english: Hmm, yes, but you don't have the  five shade remains I asked of you! Come back when you have them.
translation: 嗯，是的，但你还没有我要求的五个阴魂遗骸！等你拿到了再回来。

english: Great, I'll experiment on these! I think that Ulsquire might be keen to see some shade remains, if you take some over to him, he can possibly give you some extra information about them.
translation: 太好了，我会用这些做实验！我觉得乌尔斯奎尔可能也想看看阴魂遗骸，如果你带一些给他，他也许能告诉你更多关于它们的信息。

english: Now that you've slayed some of those nasty shades,  I feel motivated to help you out, I can trade with you now if you like.
translation: 既然你已经杀了一些讨厌的阴魂，我觉得有动力帮你了，现在如果你愿意，我可以和你交易。

english: What do you know about the shades?
translation: 你对阴魂了解多少？

english: Ulsqire says they're the incarnation of the dead who were interred in the tombs under Mort'ton. If you can find a way to put these spirits to rest, I'll show you a way into their lair!
translation: 乌尔斯奎尔说它们是葬在莫顿镇地下死者的化身。如果你能找到让这些灵魂安息的方法，我就告诉你进入它们巢穴的办法！

english: Mind you...there must be thousands of them buried under there! Just imagine all the treasure they  must have buried under there!
translation: 不过……那里肯定埋着成千上万具尸体！想象一下它们埋藏了多少宝藏！

english: What can you tell me about that temple?
translation: 关于那个神庙，你能告诉我些什么？

english: It's ancient and has been desecrated since before I was born. I've always felt that it was quite a nice place to sit and have a picnic, quite a nice view out of the swamps of Mort Myre.
translation: 它很古老，在我出生之前就已经被亵渎了。我一直觉得那是个坐下来野餐的好地方，从沼泽地莫尔迈尔看出去的景色相当不错。

english: I told Ulsquire that if he can afford to go half's  with me on the building materials, I'd help him to  try and fix it up one day. I've always wondered  what it looked like back in pagan times.
translation: 我跟乌尔斯奎尔说过，如果他愿意和我平摊建筑材料费，我就帮他试着有一天把它修复好。我一直好奇它在异教时代是什么样子。

english: Do you know how I could make this serum permanent?
translation: 你知道怎么让这种血清变成永久性的吗？

english: I'd say not my friend. That clever Flax chap was always experimentatin', I guess he was a scholarly type. He always dismissed Ulsquires learned speculations about the temple, I'd say that was a bit short sighted myself.
translation: 我说不是，我的朋友。那个聪明的弗拉克斯家伙总是在做实验，我猜他是个学者类型。他总是对乌尔斯奎尔关于神庙的博学推测不屑一顾，我自己觉得那有点目光短浅。

english: Well, you made the serum yourself so I guess you'll experimentate with it. I'd say that the temple might be able to change the serum in some way. Well, yes, I guess it sounds superstitious, but what's to be lost?
translation: 嗯，既然你自己制作了血清，我想你会继续试验它。我觉得那个神庙也许能以某种方式改变血清。没错，听起来有点迷信，但试试又何妨？

english: Hello again...what can I do for you now?
translation: 又见面了……现在我能为你做点什么？

english: Razmire said to come and talk to you.
translation: 拉兹米尔让我来找你谈谈。

english: Oh yes, well, that's very nice.
translation: 哦，这样啊，那挺好的。

english: I just slayed five shades for Razmire...he said that  you might be interested in seeing the shade remains.  Unfortunately I don't have any with me at the moment...
translation: 我刚为拉兹米尔杀了五个阴魂……他说你可能会对阴魂的遗骸感兴趣。可惜我现在身上没带。

english: That is a shame, I would have liked to have seen the remains. Razmire was right. I'm keen to study them  and perhaps see if I can work out a way to put  their spirits to rest.
translation: 那太可惜了，我本来想看看遗骸的。拉兹米尔说得对。我很想研究它们，也许能找出让它们的灵魂安息的方法。

english: I just slayed 5 shades for Razmire, he said you  might be interested in seeing some shade remains?
translation: 我刚为拉兹米尔杀了五个阴魂，他说你可能想看看阴魂的遗骸？

english: Oh yes, that would be interesting!
translation: 哦，是的，那会很有趣！

english: What did you find out about the remains.
translation: 关于那些遗骸，你发现了什么？

english: The shade remains are made of a strange substance  which I've not come across before. I believe we should put these tormented spirits to rest.
translation: 阴魂遗骸是由一种我从未见过的奇怪物质构成的。我相信我们应该让这些受折磨的灵魂安息。

english: How can we do that? You can't even bury the remains!
translation: 我们怎么能做到呢？你甚至没法埋葬这些遗骸！

english: Quite right...I was thinking that a holy cremation would do the trick, but the funeral pyres need specially prepared 'pyre logs' - normal logs that have been  treated with 'sacred oil' to give it a nice holy touch.
translation: 说得对……我在想，神圣的火葬应该能解决问题，但火葬用的柴堆需要经过特殊准备的‘火葬用原木’——用‘神圣油’处理过的普通原木，赋予它们一种圣洁的触感。

english: How would I make some sacred oil?
translation: 我怎么才能制作一些神圣油呢？

english: You won't! It's a pagan secret lost a long time ago. Normally I would try to bless some commonly found vegetable oil, but I'm so weak from this illness that I know I just won't be able to do it.
translation: 你做不到！那是一个很久以前失传的异教秘密。通常我会试着祝福一些常见的植物油，但我被这种病折磨得太虚弱了，我知道自己做不到。

english: Huh! I used to joke with Herbi Flax that if 'Flaemtaer temple' was still standing, we could practice some ancient pagan rituals and incite the sacred flame! Huh, I'm not surprised that he never took me seriously!
translation: 哈！我以前常和赫比.弗拉克斯开玩笑说，如果'弗莱姆泰尔神庙'还在，我们就可以实践一些古老的异教仪式，点燃圣火！哈，他从来没把我的话当真，我一点也不惊讶！

english: Hmm, interesting question. It is an ancient pagan  temple referred to as Flaemtaer. I've studied it quite    alot, one day I hope to be able to rebuild it, who knows what ancient power it could unleash?
translation: 嗯，这个问题很有趣。那是一座叫做弗拉姆塔尔的古老异教神庙。我研究过它不少，希望有一天能重建它，谁知道它能释放出什么样的古老力量呢？

english: How can you rebuild a totally destroyed temple?
translation: 你怎么能重建一座完全被毁的神庙呢？

english: I couldn't do it alone, I'd need a few expert artisans to help with the construction. I'd also need a good supply of limestone bricks, swamp paste and timber beams. Thankfully Razmire stocks all these items. (Sigh)
translation: 我一个人做不到，我需要一些熟练的工匠来帮助建筑。我还需要充足的石灰石砖块、沼泽膏和木材梁。幸好拉兹米尔那里有所有这些物品。（叹气）

english: The serum is a product of science. Herbi was a clever man to have made it, but he didn't integrate anything from the spiritual world into his work - and for all of his hard science there is still something missing.
translation: 血清是科学的产物。赫比能做出它是个聪明人，但他没有把精神世界的任何东西融入他的工作——尽管他严谨的科学，但总还缺少些什么。

english: So, you don't know then!
translation: 所以，你不知道咯！

english: I'm a man of faith...that's all I know. Sometimes I feel that we should experiment with the sacred and the holy, not just the crude matter we find around us everyday.
translation: 我是个有信仰的人……我只知道这些。有时我觉得我们应该用神圣和圣洁的东西做实验，而不仅仅是每天围绕在我们身边的粗陋物质。

english: That's up to you my friend! I once heard someone say that making your own decisions is the only real freedom you have. Exercise your freedom my friend,  while you still can.
translation: 那就看你了，我的朋友！我曾听人说过，自己做决定是你唯一真正的自由。行使你的自由吧，朋友，趁你还有机会。

english: Hello there, I've started repairing the temple.
translation: 你好，我已经开始修复神庙了。

english: That's great, carry on the good work. I'm sure that the temple is the key to unlocking  a better life for all of us in Mort'ton.
translation: 太好了，继续干得好。我相信神庙是解开莫顿镇所有人更好生活的关键。

english: What should I do when the temple is built?
translation: 神庙建好之后我该做什么？

english: I've researched this much, it seems that the temple was dedicated to the worship of elemental flame or fire. The sacred flame was said to be very holy and was used somehow to sanctify oil for use in cremations.
translation: 我研究过很多，似乎这座神庙是献给元素火焰或火之崇拜的。据说圣火非常神圣，被用来以某种方式圣化火葬用的油。

english: The pagans believed that sacred oil sanctified the cremation ceremony and thus helped the deceased pass  onto the next life, and it helped the logs to burn! In case there's any truth in the story, have this!
translation: 异教徒们相信，圣油能圣化火葬仪式，从而帮助逝者前往来世，而且还能帮助原木燃烧！如果这个故事有任何真实性，收下这个！

english: The pagans believed that sacred oil sanctified the cremation ceremony and thus helped the deceased pass  onto the next life, and it helped the logs to burn! You can buy olive oil from Razmire, it's quite cheap.
translation: 异教徒们相信，圣油能圣化火葬仪式，从而帮助逝者前往来世，而且还能帮助原木燃烧！你可以从拉兹米尔那里买到橄榄油，相当便宜。

english: The Shades keep knocking the temple down!
translation: 那些阴魂总是把神庙推倒！

english: I'm not surprised. The temple represents holiness. They may feel that it has power over them in some way. My advice is to carry on and finish the temple if you can, and see what happens. You may need help though!
translation: 我不意外。神庙代表圣洁。它们可能觉得神庙对它们有某种克制力量。我的建议是坚持下去，如果可能的话，把神庙修好，看看会发生什么。不过你可能需要帮助！

english: You may need help building the temple or defending yourself against the Shades. I'm sure if you ask around nicely you would be able to get some help.
translation: 你可能需要帮助建造神庙，或者保护自己免受阴魂袭击。我相信如果你好好地问，应该能找到一些帮助。

english: Tell me more about the Shades.
translation: 再给我讲讲关于阴魂的事。

english: All undead hate mortal spirituality. It's a symbol of mortal hope in the face of death and the unknown. The temple represents the finality of true death where all ties to the mortal world are lost.
translation: 所有亡灵都憎恨凡人的灵性。它是凡人在面对死亡和未知时的希望象征。神庙代表着真正死亡的终结，在那里与凡人世界的一切联系都消失了。

english: The Shades wish to forever possess the value of their tomb treasures and jealously guard them in death as they did in life. They are afraid of true death and so try to destroy anything which reminds them of it.
translation: 阴魂们希望永远拥有它们墓葬宝藏的价值，并在死后像生前一样嫉妒地守护它们。它们害怕真正的死亡，所以试图摧毁任何让它们想起死亡的东西。

english: I keep running out of building materials!
translation: 我的建筑材料总是不够用！

english: I'd go and see Razmire, perhaps he has some items in stock?
translation: 去找拉兹米尔吧，也许他店里有一些存货？

english: That's great, carry on the good work.
translation: 太好了，继续好好干。

english: Well, you could always have a nice picnic... oh.. but then there's the problem with the Shades... hmmm,  not nice... not nice at all! Well, I'll be honest, I  don't really know! But I bet Ulsquire will know.
translation: 嗯，你总是可以去野餐……哦……但还有阴魂的问题……嗯，这可不妙……太不妙了！好吧，说实话，我也不太清楚！但我打赌乌尔斯奎尔会知道。

english: Interesting...perhaps they have something against the temple? Perhaps it represents something bad to them? Hmm, interesting stuff, but you'd best speak to Ulsquire about that sort of thing... do you need any supplies?
translation: 有趣……也许它们对神庙有什么不满？也许神庙代表着某种对它们不好的东西？嗯，有意思的东西，但你最好去找乌尔斯奎尔谈这种事……你需要什么补给品吗？

english: Oh really... that's interesting... I have just the thing for you!
translation: 哦，真的吗……那很有趣……我正好有一样东西给你！

english: Hello there, I used the olive oil on the flame and it gave me sacred oil! What should I do now?
translation: 你好，我把橄榄油用在了火焰上，得到了神圣油！现在我该做什么？

english: From what I've learned, the ancients used to use the  sacred oil on logs in order to make pyre logs for cremation. You could try that!
translation: 据我所知，古人曾用神圣油浇在原木上制成火葬用原木进行火化。你可以试试！

english: Hello there, I used the sacred oil on the logs and I made pyre logs! What should I do now?
translation: 你好，我把神圣油用在了原木上，做出了火葬用原木！现在我该做什么？

english: Now you need to place the sacred logs on the pyre, then add the remains of a shade, then set fire to the pyre. This should release the Shade from it's eternal damnation and help it pass on to the other side.
translation: 现在你需要把神圣原木放在火葬柴堆上，然后加上一个阴魂的遗骸，最后点燃柴堆。这应该能把阴魂从永恒的诅咒中解脱出来，帮助它前往彼岸。

english: I've placed the logs on the pyre. What do I do now?
translation: 我已经把原木放在火葬柴堆上了。现在我该做什么？

english: You need to place the remains of the shade on top  of the logs and then set alight to it.
translation: 你需要把阴魂的遗骸放在原木上面，然后把它点燃。

english: Hey, I've laid a Shade to rest, can you  tell me where the Shade lair is now?
translation: 嘿，我已经让一个阴魂安息了，现在你能告诉我阴魂巢穴在哪里吗？

english: Yeah, great job on putting that Shade to rest. The entrance to the Shade Lair is due North of my shop. Good hunting in the lair my friend!
translation: 是的，让那个阴魂安息干得不错。阴魂巢穴的入口在我店铺的正北方。祝你在巢穴里好运，我的朋友！

english: I've put the Shade's spirit to rest!
translation: 我已经让阴魂的灵魂安息了！

english: Great! Well done my friend!
translation: 太好了！干得好，我的朋友！

english: Hmm, interesting question. It is an ancient pagan  temple referred to as Flaemtaer. I've studied it quite  a lot, one day I hope to be able to rebuild it, who knows what ancient power it could unleash?
translation: 嗯，有趣的问题。那是一个古老的异教寺庙，名叫弗莱姆泰尔。我研究过很多次，希望有一天能重建它，谁知道它能释放出什么古老的力量呢？

english: Excuse me, I'm looking for [player name]. I have an urgent job for [him/her].
translation: 不好意思，我在找[player name]。我有件紧急的工作要交给[him/her]。

english: Thank Saradomin I found you!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明，我终于找到你了！

english: I believe you still have the magical sword Silverlight?
translation: 相信你还留着那把魔法剑银光剑吧？

english: The sword I used to defeat the demon Delrith? Yes, I still have it.
translation: 你说的是我用来击败恶魔德尔里斯的那把剑？是的，我还留着。

english: Now, do you recognise this sword?
translation: 那么，你认得出这把剑吗？

english: Silverlight! That's the sword I used to defeat the demon Delrith!
translation: 银光剑！这就是我用来击败恶魔德尔里斯的那把剑！

english: There is an urgent task that only you can do - and only with Silverlight!
translation: 有一件紧急的任务只有你能完成——而且非银光剑不可！

english: My partner Badden and I have been observing the dark wizard Denath, who we believe has been preparing to summon the powerful demon Agrith-Naar.
translation: 我的搭档巴登和我一直监视着黑巫师德纳斯，我们相信他在准备召唤强大的恶魔阿格里特-纳尔。

english: A week ago he took a group of apprentice dark wizards and moved to Uzer, the lost city in the desert. We think he's going to use the city's ancient temple to summon the demon!
translation: 一周前，他带着一群黑巫师学徒出发前往尤泽尔，也就是沙漠中的失落之城。我们相信他打算利用那座城市的古老神庙召唤恶魔！

english: So you want me to stop him?
translation: 所以你们想让我阻止他？

english: Stop him? No! We want you to wait until Agrith-Naar is summoned and then kill him once and for all!
translation: 阻止他？不！我们要你等到阿格里特-纳尔被召唤出来，然后一举将他彻底消灭！

english: Let me explain. Agrith-Naar is not an ordinary demon. He has immense magical powers, and he can use these powers to influence the mortal plane.
translation: 让我解释一下。阿格里特-纳尔不是普通的恶魔。他拥有无比强大的魔力，可以用这些力量影响凡界。

english: This summoning is our chance to rid the world of his evil influence!
translation: 这次召唤正是我们铲除他邪恶影响的大好机会！

english: You should go to Uzer and find Badden at once. I'll follow once I've finished some business here.
translation: 你应该马上前往尤泽尔找到巴登。我在这里处理完一些事情随后就到。

english: I'll let you know if I see [him/her].
translation: 如果看到[him/her]，我会跟你说。

english: Did you go to Uzer to see Badden?
translation: 你去尤泽尔见到巴登了吗？

english: You must hurry!
translation: 你得快点！

english: You idiot! You lost Silverlight! I found it on the sand!
translation: 你这个笨蛋！你把银光剑弄丢了！我在沙子上找到了！

english: You need to take it with you and see Badden in Uzer.
translation: 你得带着它去尤泽尔找巴登。

english: It is good to see a friendly face here. The priest has said nothing to me but 'Get ye away, foul construct!'
translation: 在这里看到友好的面孔真好。那位祭司对我什么也没说，只说了‘滚开，肮脏的造物！’

english: Why does Badden hate you?
translation: 为什么巴登恨你？

english: I do not know. I heard him say that Saradomin hates all artificial creatures.
translation: 我不知道。我听见他说萨拉多明憎恨所有人工造物。

english: It was not always so. When I was new, the priests of Saradomin praised the ingenuity of the golem-builders.
translation: 并不总是这样。我刚来的时候，萨拉多明的祭司们还称赞制作魔像者的才智呢。

english: I paraded through the city with my siblings, all painted in bright colours, and they blessed us with holy water as we prepared for battle.
