translation: 我和我的同伴们涂着鲜艳的色彩，浩浩荡荡穿城而过，他们用圣水为我们赐福，为战斗做准备。

english: He should know that I could never hurt him. The first command in a golem's mind is that it cannot allow a human being to come to harm.
translation: 他应该知道我不可能伤害他。魔像的第一指令就是不得让人类受到任何伤害。

english: Do you know anything about the dark wizards who arrived here?
translation: 你知道那些到这里来的黑巫师的事吗？

english: Some of them were curious about me when they arrived, but since then they have ignored me.
translation: 他们刚到的时候，有些人对我感到好奇，但之后就不再理会我了。

english: As they passed me I felt a sense of dark foreboding, something I have not felt since the great enemy was nearby. I fear they are planning some great evil.
translation: 他们从我身边经过时，我感到一股不祥的黑暗气息，那是自大敌接近以来从未有过的感觉。我担心他们正在谋划什么大奸大恶之事。

english: I want to go through the portal.
translation: 我想穿过传送门。

english: Go away! This is OUR portal now!
translation: 走开！这传送门现在是我们的了！

english: Go away then!
translation: 那就走开！

english: Yeah, evil, aren't they? One of the group made them. He said he found some mushrooms in the ruins that could dye things really black.
translation: 是啊，很邪恶吧？他们里头有个人做的。他说他在废墟里找到一些蘑菇，可以把东西染得特别黑。

english: What brings you to this godsforsaken desert?
translation: 什么风把你吹到这遗弃之地来了？

english: Reen sent me.
translation: 是瑞恩派我来的。

english: Saradomin be praised! And you have Silverlight! You're willing to help us, then?
translation: 赞颂萨拉多明！而且你还拿着银光剑！这么说你愿意帮我们了？

english: Tell me more about Agrith-Naar.
translation: 跟我说说阿格里特-纳尔的事。

english: Agrith-Naar is not so much a demon as a force of nature. While he is in his own dimension his evil magics can reach everywhere in the world.
translation: 阿格里特-纳尔与其说是恶魔，不如说是一种自然之力。当他在自己的维度时，他的邪恶魔法可以触及世间的任何角落。

english: No one knows how far his power extends, but Reen and I believe that much of the suffering in the world is due to him.
translation: 没人知道他的力量能延伸到多远，但瑞恩和我相信世上许多苦难都是因他而起。

english: The accident that cripples a man, the storm that sweeps a ship under the sea, the sudden fire in the blood that makes a wolf pack attack a town - all that is Agrith- Naar!
translation: 使人残废的事故，将船只卷入海底的风暴，让狼群攻击城镇的血液中的突然火焰——这一切都是阿格里特-纳尔！

english: Tell me more about Denath.
translation: 跟我说说德纳斯的事。

english: We've been keeping an eye on Denath for some years now, but we've never been able to move against him.
translation: 我们已经监视德纳斯好几年了，但始终没法对他采取行动。

english: He was part of the group that summoned Delrith, but he left Varrock before you arrived and defeated the demon.
translation: 他曾是召唤德尔里斯的那个团体的一员，但你在维洛克城击败那个恶魔之前，他就离开了。

english: He's been studying Agrith-Naar for years, but when he brought his group here we knew he was about to make his move.
translation: 他研究阿格里特-纳尔多年，但当他带人来到这里时，我们就知道他要动手了。

english: Why has he come to Uzer?
translation: 他为什么来尤泽尔？

english: I'm not sure. This city is very ancient, and its builders were powerful workers of evil magic.
translation: 我不确定。这座城市非常古老，它的建造者是邪恶魔法的行家里手。

english: As that foul construct over there proves.
translation: 就像那边那个污秽的造物一样。

english: Perhaps there's something here he needs. Do you know what happened here?
translation: 也许这里有他需要的东西。你知道这里发生过什么事吗？

english: Foul construct? Do you mean the golem?
translation: 污秽的造物？你是指那个魔像？

english: The golem, yes! An abomination in the eyes of holy Saradomin! A mockery of life! Right now Denath is more important, but once he is dealt with I should find some way to destroy it.
translation: 魔像，没错！在神圣的萨拉多明眼中是憎恶！是对生命的嘲弄！现在德纳斯更重要，但一旦解决了他，我应该想办法摧毁它。

english: But the golem was created to fight a demon! You're on the same side!
translation: 但魔像被造出来是为了对抗恶魔的！你们是在同一边的啊！

english: Thousands of years ago a demon attacked this city, but the golem army drove it off.
translation: 数千年前，一个恶魔袭击了这座城市，但魔像大军击退了它。

english: When I last came here I opened the portal, and the demon was already dead - it had died of the wounds the golems inflicted.
translation: 我上次来时打开了传送门，发现那个恶魔已经死了——是魔像们造成的伤让它死掉的。

english: You opened a portal to a demon's realm? That must be why Denath is here!
translation: 你打开了一个通往恶魔领域的传送门？那肯定就是德纳斯来这里的原因了！

english: It would be much easier to reach Agrith-Naar's realm from another demon's realm than from the mortal plane.
translation: 从另一个恶魔的领域到达阿格里特-纳尔的领域，会比从凡界直接过去容易得多。

english: Denath must have heard that the portal here was open and decided to make his move!
translation: 德纳斯一定是听说这里的传送门打开了，才决定动手的！

english: Well I came here and opened a portal to a demon's realm...
translation: 好吧，我是来了这里，也打开了一个通往恶魔领域的传送门……

english: You have to be in position to kill Agrith-Naar as soon as he is summoned. The best way to do that is to infiltrate the group that is summoning him!
translation: 你必须做好准备，一旦阿格里特-纳尔被召唤出来，就立刻杀死他。最好的办法就是混进召唤他的那伙人里！

english: I don't know. You'll have to find some way to convince them you're one of them.
translation: 我不知道。你得想办法让他们相信你也是他们中的一员。

english: I'd never take part in a demonic ritual!
translation: 我绝不会参与恶魔仪式！

english: Oh, don't be so simple-minded! You'll be summoning a demon in order to kill it, to rid the world of great evil! You won't really be joining the group, just infiltrating it.
translation: 噢，别这么死脑筋！你召唤恶魔是为了杀死它，为世间铲除大恶！你又不是真要加入他们，只是潜入进去而已。

english: Saradomin be praised!
translation: 赞颂萨拉多明！

english: But you will need Silverlight for this task. You should go back and get it.
translation: 但你需要银光剑来完成这个任务。你应该回去取来。

english: Oh dear. I was hoping [player name] would arrive.
translation: 哎呀。我还在希望[player name]能到呢。

english: I haven't managed to infiltrate the group yet.
translation: 我还没能混进那伙人里。

english: Oh dear. Do try again. You must be in place when they summon the demon!
translation: 哎呀。再试试看。你必须在他们召唤恶魔的时候在场！

english: I want to join your group.
translation: 我想加入你们。

english: Well we do need one more person now, since... um.
translation: 嗯，我们确实还需要一个人，因为……呃。

english: But we're an evil group! To join, you have to be evil!
translation: 但我们是邪恶集团！要加入，你得够邪恶才行！

english: I'm evil!
translation: 我很邪恶！

english: You don't look evil. You certainly don't dress evil!
translation: 你看起来一点也不邪恶。你穿得更是半点都不邪恶！

english: I'm evil in disguise?
translation: 我是在伪装邪恶？

english: There's no need for the disguise here! We're all evil!
translation: 这里不需要伪装！我们个个都是邪恶的！

english: Yeah, I can see that. That outfit is totally evil!
translation: 对，我看得出来。那套行头简直邪恶透顶！

english: But what's that sword? It's far too shiny to be evil. We won't have any silver glowing swords in here!
translation: 但那把剑是什么？它太亮了，一点也不邪恶。我们这里不要亮闪闪的银剑！

english: Okay, I'll take you through to see Denath.
translation: 好吧，我带你进去见德纳斯。

english: Master! This person wants to join us!
translation: 主人！这个人想要加入我们！

english: Indeed? Well we are one wizard short since Josef ran away. Can you vouch for [him/her]?
translation: 是吗？好吧，自从约瑟夫逃跑后，我们就少了一个魔法师。你能为[him/her]担保吗？

english: Yeah! [He/She]'s totally evil!
translation: 当然！[He/She]绝对邪恶！

english: Thank you, Dave.
translation: 谢谢你，戴夫。

english: So you wish to join us? You have made a wise choice. When we summon the demon Agrith-Naar, he will grant all our worldly desires.
translation: 所以你想加入我们吗？你做了一个明智的选择。等我们召唤出恶魔阿格里特-纳尔，他就会满足我们所有的世俗欲望。

english: An abyssal whip, a dragon chain mail? To conjure these items is trivial for Agrith-Naar.
translation: 一条深渊长鞭，一件龙鳞链甲？对阿格里特-纳尔来说，召唤这些物品是轻而易举的。

english: But you will not need such weapons or armour, for Agrith-Naar will grant you the power of life and death over all creatures!
translation: 但你不需要这些武器或盔甲，因为阿格里特-纳尔会赐予你主宰所有生灵生死的权力！

english: You shall have every wish granted, and everyone who has ever wronged you will burn in a hell of your own devising!
translation: 你的每个愿望都会实现，所有亏欠过你的人，都会在你亲手打造的地狱中焚烧！

english: Isn't this, you know, wrong?
translation: 这……是不是有点不妥？

english: Right and wrong are for the weak! This is your chance to choose to be on the side of the strong, and have all your desires granted, while the weak are crushed beneath Agrith-Naar's demonic feet!
translation: 对与错是弱者才在乎的！这是你选择站在强者这边的机会，实现你所有的欲望，而弱者将被踩在阿格里特-纳尔的恶魔脚下！

english: How do you know Agrith-Naar will do all this for us?
translation: 你怎么知道阿格里特-纳尔会为我们做这些？

english: My binding spells will make Agrith-Naar my slave! You would be wise not to question my powers again, lest I turn the same spells on you!
translation: 我的束缚咒会让阿格里特-纳尔成为我的奴隶！你最好别再质疑我的力量，否则我拿同样的咒语对付你！

english: Why did Josef run away?
translation: 约瑟夫为什么逃跑？

english: Obviously he was a coward who did not have the strength to abandon his old-fashioned morality. I hope you will not be a similar disappointment.
translation: 显然他是个懦夫，没有力量抛弃他过时的道德标准。希望你不会让我同样失望。

english: When I have finished preparing the magic circle, we will all recite the incantation that will summon Agrith-Naar.
translation: 等我准备好魔法圈，我们所有人就要一起念诵召唤阿格里特-纳尔的咒语。

english: You must memorize the incantation carefully. It is Nahudu Camerinthum Caldar Agrith-Naar Tarren.
translation: 你必须仔细记住这句咒语：Nahudu Camerinthum Caldar Agrith-Naar Tarren。

english: You will also need to make yourself a demonic sigil to act as a focus of power. One of the group has the mould you need to make it.
translation: 你还需要制作一个恶魔符印作为力量焦点。我们中有人有制作所需的模具。

english: Now let me continue with my preparations!
translation: 现在让我继续准备！

english: Never mind, I'm not evil.
translation: 算了，我不邪恶。

english: Well get out of our evil temple then!
translation: 那就滚出我们邪恶的神庙！

english: I managed to get into the group.
translation: 我成功混进那伙人了。

english: Oh, that is good! Make sure you are in place when they summon the demon!
translation: 噢，太好了！一定要在他们召唤恶魔的时候在场！

english: Phew! It's too hot for me out here. But at least I found my way through the desert!
translation: 呼！这里对我来说太热了。但至少我找到穿越沙漠的路了！

english: Why didn't you take the magic carpet?
translation: 你为什么不坐魔法飞毯？

english: Oh dear no, you won't get me up in one of those things! What if the magic failed?
translation: 噢不，我才不会上那种东西！万一魔法失效了呢？

english: Why don't you change out of your heavy robes?
translation: 你怎么不换掉你那身沉重的长袍？

english: But the rules of my order say I must wear them!
translation: 但我的教团规定我必须穿着它们！

english: Perhaps the rules were made in a colder place than this?
translation: 或许这些规定是在比这里更冷的地方制定的？

english: Saradomin's rules are once and for all! It is not our place to question them!
translation: 萨拉多明的规定是一劳永逸的！轮不到我们来质疑！

english: Don't worry, soon I'll have killed the demon and we can all go home!
translation: 别担心，我很快就能杀掉那个恶魔，然后我们都能回家了！

english: Summoning a demon! Those wizards make me sick! What kind of sad people would call on a supernatural being to solve their problems for them?
translation: 召唤恶魔！那些黑巫师真让我恶心！到底是多可悲的人才会召唤超自然生物来替自己解决问题？

english: Um, isn't that like what you do when you pray?
translation: 呃，那不是跟你祈祷时做的事差不多吗？

english: What? No, that's totally different, because... um... because we always give thanks to Saradomin, even when he doesn't do anything!
translation: 什么？不，那完全不同，因为……呃……因为我们总是感谢萨拉多明，即使他什么都没做！

english: Not like those wizards! They're so full of themselves, with their fancy robes and their rituals!
translation: 不像那些黑巫师！他们自以为是，整天穿着华丽的长袍搞些仪式！

english: Um, isn't that like...
translation: 呃，这不就像……

english: No, it's totally different!
translation: 不，完全不同！

english: Anyway, there must be something wrong with the way they live in their little group and separate themselves from the rest of society. It can't be healthy.
translation: 总之，他们那种小群体生活、与社会隔绝的方式肯定有问题。那绝对不健康。

english: And that's *nothing* like you being a monk, of course.
translation: 当然，这跟你是个僧侣完全不一样。

english: Wait, are you being sarcastic? Because you should know that sarcasm is specifically forbidden in the holy book of Saradomin!
translation: 等等，你这是在讽刺我吗？你应该知道，在萨拉多明的圣典里，讽刺是明确禁止的！

english: Are you sure Saradomin was being serious about that bit?
translation: 你确定萨拉多明对那条规定是认真的吗？

english: Leave me alone! I am preparing for the summoning ritual. You should make yourself a demonic sigil and practice the incantation with the other wizards.
translation: 别烦我！我正在为召唤仪式做准备。你应该去弄个恶魔符印，然后跟其他黑巫师一起练习咒语。

english: I forgot the incantation.
translation: 我忘了咒语。

english: Ignoramus! Are you incapable of even the simplest task? The incantation is Nahudu Camerinthum Caldar Agrith- Naar Tarren.
translation: 白痴！你连最简单的事都做不好吗？咒语是：Nahudu Camerinthum Caldar Agrith-Naar Tarren。

english: Welcome, sister! Soon we'll summon the great demon! Aren't we evil?
translation: 欢迎，姐妹！我们很快就要召唤伟大的恶魔了！我们是不是很邪恶？

english: And we've got such an evil throne room to do our ritual in!
translation: 我们还有个超邪恶的王座室用来举行仪式！

english: It's just a pity someone's removed the gems from the throne. That kind of vandalism is TOTALLY NOT EVIL.
translation: 只可惜有人把王座上的宝石拿走了。那种破坏行为一点都不邪恶。

english: Um... Yeah, who would do a thing like that?
translation: 呃……是啊，谁会做那种事呢？

english: But isn't evil, you know, bad?
translation: 但是邪恶，你知道，不是坏的吗？

english: Yeah! We're BAD!
translation: 没错！我们就是坏！

english: Do you have the demonic sigil mould?
translation: 你有恶魔符印模具吗？

english: No. Last I heard, Matthew had it.
translation: 没有。我上次听说，在马修那里。

english: Do you know what happened to Josef?
translation: 你知道约瑟夫发生什么事了吗？

english: I didn't see anything. He left last night, and Denath only posted me here this morning.
translation: 我什么都没看到。他昨晚就走了，德纳斯今天早上才把我派到这里。

english: You don't understand.
translation: 你不懂。

english: Understand what?
translation: 懂什么？

english: Nobody understands.
translation: 没人懂。

english: What don't we understand?
translation: 我们不懂什么？

english: Oh, it doesn't matter. You don't understand. Go away.
translation: 哦，算了。你不懂。走开。

english: Huh. So that's all you want. Here it is.
translation: 哼。原来你就要这个。给你。

english: Come back when you've got free space.
translation: 等你腾出空位再来。

english: I already gave that to you! Go away!
translation: 我已经给过你了！走开！

english: He didn't understand!
translation: 他不明白！

english: No, I don't suppose he did.
translation: 不，我猜他确实不明白。

english: Agrith-Naar is going to make us all sooo rich!
translation: 阿格里斯-纳尔会让我们所有人都变得超有钱！

english: Yeah! We'll all be rich!
translation: 对啊！我们都会有钱！

english: Yeah! I'm going to get myself a dragon longsword! And a million rune ores! And a small piece of coloured paper to put on my head!
translation: 没错！我要给自己弄一把龙金长剑！还有一百万块符石矿石！还要一小片彩色纸贴在头上！

english: Um... if you like.
translation: 呃……如果你喜欢的话。

english: Those gems on the demon's throne look valuable. I just wish I had some way to remove them.
translation: 那个恶魔王座上的宝石看起来很值钱。真希望我有办法把它们弄下来。

english: Isn't it more satisfying to earn riches yourself?
translation: 自己赚取财富不是更有满足感吗？

english: I don't want to be satisfied, I want to be rich!
translation: 我不想有满足感，我想有钱！

english: Right now I don't have anything. But soon, I will have everything!
translation: 现在我什么都没有。但很快，我就会拥有一切！

english: Denath says he ran away. I don't know why. Who would want to run away from what Agrith-Naar is going to do for us?
translation: 德纳斯说他逃跑了。我不知道为什么。谁会想从阿格里斯-纳尔要为我们做的事中逃跑呢？

english: They won't ignore me for much longer!
translation: 他们不会忽略我太久了！

english: Everyone!
translation: 大家！

english: When I have demonic powers, they'll all have to pay attention to me!
translation: 等我有了恶魔的力量，他们全都不得不注意我！

english: And SHE won't ignore me then. I'll be able to show her how I feel.
translation: 到那时，她就不会再忽略我了。我就能向她表达我的感受了。

english: I will make everyone like me!
translation: 我要让所有人都喜欢我！

english: No. I gave it to Matthew.
translation: 不。我把它给了马修。

english: He went away and left us. He probably didn't like me.
translation: 他离开了我们。他可能不喜欢我。

english: Don't ignore me!
translation: 别忽略我！

english: Soon, all will bow down before me!
translation: 很快，所有人都会在我面前下跪！

english: Agrith-Naar will make us the rulers of the world! I shall be a dark queen over all Gielinor! All shall love me and despair!
translation: 阿格里斯-纳尔会让我们成为世界的统治者！我将成为整个吉莱诺的黑暗女王！所有人都将爱我并绝望！

english: Ah ha ha ha ha ha!!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！！

english: AAH HA HA HA HA HA HAAAAA!!!!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈哈啊啊啊啊啊！！！！

english: Look, we've told you not to do that. It makes everyone uncomfortable.
translation: 听着，我们告诉过你别那样做。会让每个人都不舒服。

english: Hah! Carrying such humble implements is beneath me!
translation: 哈！携带如此卑微的工具对我来说有失身份！

english: He was a fool who could not cope with power! When Agrith-Naar makes us rulers of continents, I will find him and crush him!
translation: 他是个无法应对力量的傻瓜！等阿格里斯-纳尔让我们成为大陆的统治者，我会找到他并碾碎他！

english: Hello. Are you Josef's replacement?
translation: 你好。你是来取代约瑟夫的吗？

english: Yes, I suppose I am.
translation: 是的，我想是吧。

english: It just goes to show how little Denath values us.
translation: 这正好说明了德纳斯有多不重视我们。

english: Denath told us we would learn the secrets of demonic magic, but all we've done is memorize one incantation. And now he replaces poor Josef with the next person who comes along!
translation: 德纳斯告诉我们，我们会学到恶魔魔法的秘密，但我们所做的只是记住了一个咒语。现在他又用随便一个来的人取代了可怜的约瑟夫！

english: No, I think Jennifer has it.
translation: 不，我觉得在珍妮弗那里。

english: Shh! Listen, Denath doesn't know this...
translation: 嘘！听着，德纳斯不知道这事……

english: When we joined him, Denath told us we were going to learn all the secrets of demonic magic, but we still don't know anything.
translation: 我们加入他的时候，德纳斯告诉我们，我们会学到所有恶魔魔法的秘密，但我们仍然什么都不知道。

english: The others, they just think they're terribly evil, with their sigils and the incantation they learned by rote. But Josef and I wanted more - we wanted to know how it worked.
translation: 其他人，他们只是以为自己非常邪恶，带着他们的符印和背得滚瓜烂熟的咒语。但约瑟夫和我想要更多——我们想知道它是如何运作的。

english: Josef was more curious than me. Last night, he secretly read a book that Denath was keeping from us. He didn't know I was awake, but I saw what happened.
translation: 约瑟夫比我更好奇。昨晚，他偷偷读了一本德纳斯对我们保密的书。他以为我睡着了，但我看到了发生的事。

english: I saw him read it, and then his face turned white, and he took the book and ran through the portal.
translation: 我看到他读了那本书，然后他的脸变得煞白，他拿着书穿过传送门跑了。

english: But Denath was waking up, and when he saw Josef was gone he went through the portal to look for him. A bit later Denath returned, without Josef or the book.
translation: 但德纳斯正在醒来，当他看到约瑟夫不见了，他就穿过传送门去找他。过了一会儿德纳斯回来了，没有约瑟夫也没有书。

english: Josef didn't have money for the magic carpet, and he can't have got far in the desert at night with that heavy book.
translation: 约瑟夫没钱坐魔法飞毯，而且他拿着那本沉重的书，在晚上的沙漠里也跑不远。

english: Josef must have hidden the book somewhere in the ruins, before Denath followed him. If you could find it, we'd know what it was that frightened him. We'd know what Denath is really up to!
translation: 在德纳斯追上他之前，约瑟夫一定把书藏在废墟的某个地方了。如果你能找到它，我们就知道是什么吓到了他。我们就能知道德纳斯到底在搞什么鬼！

english: Did you see anything happen last night?
translation: 昨晚你看到什么了吗？

english: I was sleeping last night. I'm only human after all!
translation: 我昨晚在睡觉。毕竟我只是个凡人！

english: But I had this odd dream, about fear and panic, and... fire...
translation: 但我做了一个奇怪的梦，关于恐惧和恐慌，还有……火……

english: I saw one of the men in dark robes run out of the temple. He looked very frightened and I feared for his safety.
translation: 我看到一个穿黑袍的男人跑出神庙。他看起来很害怕，我担心他的安全。

english: He was carrying a large book. He started to head out into the desert, but then turned back and hid the book in one of the broken kilns in which my kind were created long ago.
translation: 他拿着一本大书。他开始时朝沙漠走去，但后来折返回来，把书藏在一个破损的窑里，很久以前我这类生物就是在那种窑里被创造出来的。

english: Then another man came out of the temple. He said magical words and threw a fireball at the first man, turning him to dust!
translation: 然后另一个人从神庙里出来了。他念了咒语，朝第一个人扔了一个火球，把他化成了灰烬！

english: I should have saved him, but I was not fast enough to throw myself in the path of the fireball.
translation: 我本该救他的，但我没能快到扑到火球路线上。

english: Which kiln did he hide the book in?
translation: 他把书藏在哪个窑里了？

english: I cannot remember. The shock of seeing a human being killed wiped the details of the incident from my memory.
translation: 我记不清了。看到一个人被杀的冲击，使得事件的细节从我的记忆中抹去了。

english: Did you find that book?
translation: 你找到那本书了吗？

english: I really want to know what's in it. I think Denath is hiding something from us, but we won't know what unless we read that book!
translation: 我真的很想知道里面有什么。我觉得德纳斯在瞒着我们什么，但除非我们读了那本书，否则我们不会知道！

english: Yes. The golem saw Josef hide it in one of the broken kilns in the city.
translation: 是的。魔像看到约瑟夫把它藏在城里一个破损的窑里。

english: Did the golem see what happened to Josef?
translation: 魔像看到约瑟夫发生了什么事吗？

english: It said Denath killed him.
translation: 它说德纳斯杀了他。

english: I knew Denath was a dark wizard but I didn't think he'd kill one of his disciples.
translation: 我知道德纳斯是个黑巫师，但我没想到他会杀害自己的门徒。

english: Let me look at the book then.
translation: 那让我看看那本书。

english: I don't understand. What's in here that Denath thought was worth killing over? Josef must have worked something out - but what?
translation: 我不明白。这里面有什么东西值得德纳斯杀人？约瑟夫一定想出了什么——但到底是什么呢？

english: But look at the incantation in the book. The words are in the reverse order to the order that Denath taught us.
translation: 但你看书里的咒语。单词的顺序与德纳斯教我们的顺序相反。

english: The incantation in the book is backwards?
translation: 书里的咒语是反的？

english: More likely the book has the correct incantation and the one Denath taught us was backwards. But what does that mean?
translation: 更可能是书里的咒语才是正确的，而德纳斯教我们的是反的。但那意味着什么呢？

english: [Player name], I'm not happy about this ritual. I don't think Agrith-Naar is going to grant all our wishes, I think he's going to kill us all. But if I try to stop it, Denath will kill me like he did Josef!
translation: [Player name]，我对这个仪式感到不安。我认为阿格里斯-纳尔不会满足我们所有的愿望，我觉得他会杀了我们所有人。但如果我试图阻止它，德纳斯会像杀约瑟夫那样杀了我！

english: Don't worry. I'm here to kill the demon!
translation: 别担心。我来这儿就是为了杀那个恶魔的！

english: But I need find a way to smuggle Silverlight in here. It's the only weapon that can defeat Agrith-Naar!
translation: 但我需要找个办法把银光剑偷带进来。那是唯一能击败阿格里斯-纳尔的武器！

english: Thank goodness! I will try to stall the ritual until you have Silverlight. Hurry!
translation: 谢天谢地！我会尽量拖延仪式，直到你拿到银光剑。快！

english: This is the demon-slaying sword Silverlight, the only weapon that can kill Agrith-Naar!
translation: 这就是杀恶魔之剑银光剑，唯一能杀死阿格里斯-纳尔的武器！

english: Thank goodness! I think Denath is nearly ready for the ritual. We must prepare!
translation: 谢天谢地！我觉得德纳斯差不多准备好仪式了。我们必须准备！

english: Are you prepared for the ritual? You must be ready to slay Agrith-Naar when he appears.
translation: 你准备好仪式了吗？你必须准备好在他出现时杀死阿格里斯-纳尔。

english: I don't think Denath is being honest with his wizards.
translation: 我觉得德纳斯对他的巫师们不诚实。

english: Of course he isn't! You expect an evil sorcerer to be honest with anyone?
translation: 他当然不诚实！你指望一个邪恶的巫师对任何人诚实？

english: It is time for the ritual to commence!
translation: 是时候开始仪式了！

english: Player, please take your place in the circle!
translation: 玩家，请站到圆圈里你的位置！

english: Our evil moment is at hand! You should get to your place in the circle so the ritual can start!
translation: 我们邪恶的时刻到了！你应该站到圆圈里你的位置，这样仪式才能开始！

english: We'd better do the ritual!
translation: 我们最好进行仪式！

english: You ought to get to your place in the circle. Denath wants YOU to lead the ritual.
translation: 你应该站到圆圈里你的位置。德纳斯想让你来主持仪式。

english: This is it! Get to your place in the circle and say the words!
translation: 就是现在！站到圆圈里你的位置，念出咒语！

english: Get to your place in the circle and lead the ritual! I'm so excited!
translation: 站到圆圈里你的位置，主持仪式！我太兴奋了！

english: [Player name] will lead us in the incantation.
translation: [Player name]将带领我们念咒语。

english: You fool! Do it again, and get it right!
translation: 你这个傻瓜！再来一次，这次要念对！

english: Indeed? Well we are one wizard short since Josef ran away. Can you vouch for him?
translation: 是吗？自从约瑟夫逃跑后，我们正好少了一个魔法师。你能为他担保吗？

english: Get to your place in the circle, fool! I want you to lead these dunderheads in the summoning ritual!
translation: 回到你在圆圈里的位置，蠢货！我要你带领这些笨蛋进行召唤仪式！

english: Indeed? Well we are one wizard short since Josef ran away. Can you vouch for her?
translation: 是吗？自从约瑟夫逃跑后，我们正好少了一个魔法师。你能为她担保吗？

english: Oh my gods!
translation: 哦我的天啊！

english: He disappeared!
translation: 他消失了！

english: Where'd he go?
translation: 他去哪了？

english: Of course! How could we be so stupid?
translation: 当然！我们怎么会这么蠢？

english: What do you get when you perform a summoning ritual backwards?
translation: 把召唤仪式倒过来念会得到什么？

english: Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! We've just helped him return to his own dimension!
translation: 德纳斯一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！我们刚刚帮他回到了他自己的维度！

english: What was that?!
translation: 那是什么？！

english: Look! The portal's closing!
translation: 看！传送门正在关闭！

english: Get to your place in the circle! You're holding up the ritual!
translation: 到圆圈里你的位置上去！你耽误了仪式！

english: I'm getting out of here!
translation: 我要离开这里！

english: No, don't leave!
translation: 不，别走！

english: Who knows what Denath could do now?
translation: 谁知道德纳斯现在能做什么？

english: We've got to perform the ritual again so you can kill Agrith-Naar. But we need eight people!
translation: 我们必须再次进行仪式，这样你才能杀死阿格里斯-纳尔。但我们需要八个人！

english: Quick, Snotra, you've got to get those three to come back! And you'd better take Denath's sigil and find one more person to help.
translation: 快，斯诺特拉，你得把那三个人叫回来！你最好拿着德纳斯的符印，再找一个人帮忙。

english: We've got to perform the ritual again, forwards this time, so you can kill Agrith-Naar. I'll prepare for it here while you find four more people.
translation: 我们必须再次进行仪式，这次是正向的，这样你才能杀死阿格里斯-纳尔。我在这里准备，你去找另外四个人。

english: Hurry!
translation: 快点！

english: I don't understand what happened!
translation: 我不明白发生了什么！

english: Denath must have been Agrith-Naar all along!
translation: 德纳斯一定一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！

english: Ellemar's book said that Agrith-Naar can only use his powerful magics from the demon plane.
translation: 埃勒玛的书上说，阿格里斯-纳尔只能在恶魔位面使用他强大的魔法。

english: Ellemar must have trapped him in human form to stop him using his magics. That must be what the last pages of the book said.
translation: 埃勒玛一定把他困在了人类形态中，以阻止他使用魔法。那一定是书最后几页的内容。

english: So the reason he assembled us was to send him back to his own plane, where he would be much more powerful! That's why the ritual was backwards!
translation: 所以他召集我们的原因，就是把他送回他自己的位面，在那里他会强大得多！这就是为什么仪式是倒过来的！

english: He's already started to close the portal to trap us. Who knows what else he could do?
translation: 他已经开始关闭传送门来困住我们。谁知道他还能做什么？

english: But if we can perform the ritual forwards then you can kill him using Silverlight and end his evil magics once and for all!
translation: 但如果我们能正向进行仪式，你就可以用银光剑杀死他，一劳永逸地终结他的邪恶魔法！

english: We should have known it was too good to be true.
translation: 我们早该知道这好得不像真的。

english: It's always the same, everyone want to use you. Even demons.
translation: 总是这样，每个人都想利用你。连恶魔也不例外。

english: What are we going to do?!!!
translation: 我们该怎么办？！！！

english: I guess none of us are going to get rich now. Let's do what needs to be done!
translation: 我想现在我们谁也发不了财了。做该做的事吧！

english: We need to get everyone back in here! We need four more people to perform the ritual!
translation: 我们需要把所有人都叫回来！我们还需要四个人来进行仪式！

english: We need to get everyone back in here! We need three more people to perform the ritual!
translation: 我们需要把所有人都叫回来！我们还需要三个人来进行仪式！

english: We'll be ready to perform the ritual soon, but you need to find two more people.
translation: 我们很快就能准备好进行仪式，但你需要再找两个人。

english: We're ready to perform the ritual. We just need one more person!
translation: 我们准备好进行仪式了。只需要再多一个人！

english: Eric's dead! Agrith-Naar killed him! That's EVIL!
translation: 埃里克死了！阿格里斯-纳尔杀了他！这太邪恶了！

english: I mean, it's bad! In a BAD way!
translation: 我是说，这很糟糕！非常糟糕！

english: The ceiling collapsed without warning! When I moved towards the staircase the walls started to shake.
translation: 天花板毫无征兆地塌了！当我走向楼梯时，墙壁开始摇晃。

english: I'm scared of what will happen to me if I try to leave!
translation: 我害怕如果我试图离开会发生什么！

english: You've got to get back to the throne room!
translation: 你必须回到王座室！

english: But the portal is closing! We'll be trapped!
translation: 但是传送门正在关闭！我们会被困住的！

english: Our only hope is to summon Agrith-Naar again so I can kill him! But I need eight people.
translation: 我们唯一的希望就是再次召唤阿格里斯-纳尔，这样我就能杀了他！但我需要八个人。

english: You can kill him?
translation: 你能杀了他？

english: You'd better take this then. It was Eric's sigil. Everyone in the ritual will need one!
translation: 那你最好拿着这个。这是埃里克的符印。仪式中的每个人都需要一个！

english: By using 'evil' as a term of praise you have left yourself without a word to describe real evil!
translation: 用'邪恶'作为赞美之词，你就没有词语来形容真正的邪恶了！

english: There's no time for that! Eric's DEAD!
translation: 没时间说这个了！埃里克死了！

english: That demon killed Eric! When are you going to start the ritual and slay him?
translation: 那个恶魔杀了埃里克！你什么时候开始仪式并杀死他？

english: Good heavens! I've never seen a weather like this before! It looks like a real sandstorm is coming up!
translation: 天哪！我从没见过这样的天气！看起来一场真正的沙尘暴要来了！

english: Ali Morrisane's carpet fleet flies in any weather, though! Do you require our services?
translation: 不过，阿里.莫里桑的飞毯舰队在任何天气下都能飞行！您需要我们的服务吗？

english: What's happening? The wind suddenly picked up! It's a desert sandstorm!
translation: 发生什么事了？风突然变大了！是沙漠沙尘暴！

english: Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! We've just sent him back to his own dimension!
translation: 德纳斯一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！我们刚刚把他送回了自己的维度！

english: Saradomin protect us! From his own dimension he'll be able to wreak havoc!
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我们！在他的维度里，他可以肆意破坏！

english: All right!
translation: 好吧！

english: But first I'll need to get you a demonic sigil.
translation: 但首先我得给你弄一个恶魔符印。

english: All right, I'll wait here.
translation: 好吧，我在这儿等着。

english: You'll need to hold this sigil for the ritual.
translation: 仪式中你需要拿着这个符印。

english: What's happening? This sandstorm came out of nowhere!
translation: 发生什么事了？这场沙尘暴来得莫名其妙！

english: Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! Now he's back in his own dimension!
translation: 德纳斯一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！现在他回到了自己的维度！

english: Oh no! What can we do?
translation: 哦不！我们能做什么？

english: You've got to help me perform the ritual again so I can kill him!
translation: 你得帮我再次进行仪式，这样我才能杀了他！

english: Oh! Oh dear! I don't think I could take part in a demonic ritual!
translation: 哦！哦天哪！我觉得我不能参加恶魔仪式！

english: I'll need to get you a demonic sigil anyway.
translation: 反正我得给你弄一个恶魔符印。

english: A demonic sigil?!
translation: 一个恶魔符印？！

english: But isn't that what you and Badden asked me to do?
translation: 但这不就是你和巴登让我做的事吗？

english: But things are different for me! I'm a monk! What if my order found out?
translation: 但我的情况不同！我是个僧侣！如果我的教团发现了怎么办？

english: But the wizards will all die! Now Agrith-Naar is in his own dimension he's killing them one by one!
translation: 但那些巫师都会死！现在阿格里斯-纳尔在他的维度里，正在一个一个地杀死他们！

english: They should have known better than to join Denath in his evil schemes!
translation: 他们早该知道不该加入德纳斯的邪恶计划！

english: Oh, don't be so simple-minded! You'll be summoning a demon in order to kill it, to rid the world of great evil!
translation: 哦，别这么死脑筋！你召唤恶魔是为了杀死它，为了从世界上铲除大恶！

english: Well... all right.
translation: 嗯……好吧。

english: Now take this demonic sigil, and hurry inside!
translation: 现在拿着这个恶魔符印，快进去！

english: I sensed a great darkness, as of a demon revelling in its moment of triumph.
translation: 我感觉到一股巨大的黑暗，就像一个恶魔在享受它胜利的时刻。

english: And now this sandstorm appears, the likes of which I have not seen in three thousand years. What can it mean?
translation: 现在这场沙尘暴出现了，我三千年都没见过这样的景象。这意味着什么？

english: Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! We've accidentally helped him get back to his own dimension!
translation: 德纳斯一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！我们不小心帮他回到了自己的维度！

english: It is a terrible thing for a demon to be victorious. I wish there was something I could do to rectify the situation.
translation: 恶魔获胜是一件可怕的事。我希望我能做些什么来扭转局面。

english: You could help me summon the demon again so I could kill him!
translation: 你可以帮我再次召唤恶魔，这样我就能杀了他！

english: I cannot do that. It is forbidden for a golem to enter the portal.
translation: 我不能那样做。魔像被禁止进入传送门。

english: But I really need you to!
translation: 但我真的很需要你！

english: A golem cannot disobey the commands in its mind!
translation: 魔像不能违抗它脑海中的指令！

english: Why is it forbidden?
translation: 为什么被禁止？

english: I do not know. I was not privy to the thoughts of my designers, and now they cannot be asked.
translation: 我不知道。我无法得知设计者的想法，现在也无法询问他们了。

english: I could just reprogram you again.
translation: 我可以再给你重新编程。

english: That is true. Perhaps if you opened my head and removed the instruction concerning the portal I would be able to help you.
translation: 没错。也许如果你打开我的头，移除关于传送门的指令，我就能帮你了。

english: But there must have been a reason why my builders imposed this restriction. I do not know what would happen to me if I went through the portal.
translation: 但我的建造者施加这个限制一定有原因。我不知道如果我穿过传送门会发生什么。

english: What are we waiting for? What do I need to do?
translation: 我们还等什么？我需要做什么？

english: I need to get you a demonic sigil.
translation: 我需要给你弄一个恶魔符印。

english: I will wait.
translation: 我会等。

english: Take this demonic sigil and go through the portal.
translation: 拿着这个恶魔符印，然后穿过传送门。

english: Strength low...
translation: 力量不足……

english: This realm... sapping strength... combat capability impaired...
translation: 这个领域……在吸取力量……战斗能力受损……

english: This must be... reason... portal forbidden...
translation: 这就是……原因……传送门被禁……

english: I just need your help with the ritual. Do you think you can do that?
translation: 我只需要你在仪式上帮忙。你能做到吗？

english: Speech functions not impaired.
translation: 语言功能未受损。

english: Let's get this ritual over with! I don't want to spend any more time with that golem than I have to!
translation: 赶紧把仪式搞完吧！我不想和那个魔像多待一秒钟！

english: What's your problem with the golem? It doesn't mind you!
translation: 你对魔像有什么意见？它又不介意你！

english: So Agrith-Naar was trapped in our dimension all along, and didn't have any influence until the wizards un- summoned him?
translation: 所以阿格瑞斯-纳尔一直被困在我们的维度里，直到法师们取消召唤才产生了影响？

english: I thought slaying him would make the world better, but now we're fighting to return it to how it was before!
translation: 我本以为杀了他会让世界变得更好，但现在我们却在努力让一切恢复原样！

english: Perhaps we can't blame demons for everything that's wrong with the world. Sometimes it's just not that simple.
translation: 也许我们不能把世界上所有问题都归咎于恶魔。有时候事情没那么简单。

english: We've got eight people now. Are you ready to summon Agrith-Naar and slay him?
translation: 我们现在有八个人了。你准备好召唤阿格瑞斯-纳尔并杀了他吗？

english: Where's your demonic sigil? You'll need that in order to lead the ritual.
translation: 你的恶魔符印呢？你需要那个来主持仪式。

english: Where is Silverlight? It's impossible to kill Agrith-Naar without that magic sword!
translation: 银光剑在哪里？没有那把魔法剑是不可能杀死阿格瑞斯-纳尔的！

english: *gulp*  Okay, here we go...
translation: *咽口水* 好吧，我们开始吧……

english: Do hurry! We haven't got much time!
translation: 快点！我们时间不多了！

english: We'd better get on with the ritual. Let's get this over with!
translation: 我们最好赶紧进行仪式。赶快搞定吧！

english: Hurry up with the ritual! That demon killed Eric!
translation: 快点进行仪式！那个恶魔杀了埃里克！

english: You ought to get to the head of the circle and lead the incantation. Let's get this over with.
translation: 你应该到圆圈的前面去领唱咒语。赶紧把这事办完。

english: What are we waiting for? You must lead the ritual and kill Agrith-Naar! We're all counting on you!
translation: 还等什么？你必须主持仪式并杀死阿格瑞斯-纳尔！我们都指望你了！

english: No, we need to perform the ritual forwards, as it appears in the book!
translation: 不，我们需要按照书上写的顺序进行仪式！

english: Matthew!
translation: 马修！

english: How dare you summon me?
translation: 你怎么敢召唤我？

english: Quick, [player name], you've got to get those three to come back! And you'd better take Denath's sigil and find one more person to help.
translation: 快，[player name]，你得把那三个人叫回来！你最好带上德纳斯的徽记，再找一个人帮忙。

english: [player name], I'm not happy about this ritual. I don't think Agrith-Naar is going to grant all our wishes, I think he's going to kill us all. But if I try to stop it, Denath will kill me like he did Josef!
translation: [player name]，我对这个仪式很不放心。我觉得阿格里斯-纳尔不会实现我们所有的愿望，我觉得他会杀了我们所有人。但如果我试图阻止，德纳斯会像杀死约瑟夫一样杀了我！

english: I found the book lying around. You must have dropped it!
translation: 我在地上发现了这本书。一定是你掉的！

english: You'd better have it again. You'll need the incantation in the book in order to lead the ritual.
translation: 你最好再拿着它。你需要书里的咒语来引导仪式。

english: I'm preparing for the ritual. You need to find three more people to help us perform it.
translation: 我正在准备仪式。你需要再找三个人来帮我们进行。

english: I'll keep hold of it till you have free inventory space.
translation: 我会先保管着，等你背包有空间了再说。

english: You should speak to Denath, then.
translation: 那你应该去跟德纳斯谈谈。

english: Thank goodness I found it first! If Denath had found it he'd know someone suspected him.
translation: 谢天谢地是我先找到的！要是德纳斯找到了，他就会知道有人怀疑他了。

english: [player name], I'm not happy about this ritual. I don't think Agrith- Naar is going to grant all our wishes, I think he's going to kill us all. But if I try to stop it, Denath will kill me like he did Josef!
translation: [player name]，我对这个仪式很不放心。我觉得阿格里斯-纳尔不会实现我们所有的愿望，我觉得他会杀了我们所有人。但如果我试图阻止，德纳斯会像杀死约瑟夫一样杀了我！

english: He didn't summon you.
translation: 他没有召唤你。

english: I did!
translation: 是我召唤的！

english: Then prepare to die!
translation: 那就准备受死吧！

english: So that's Agrith-Naar's true form! Quickly, slay him with Silverlight!
translation: 那就是阿格瑞斯-纳尔的真面目！快，用银光剑杀了他！

english: Help! Quickly, use Silverlight!
translation: 救命！快，用银光剑！

english: Kill him, [player name]!
translation: 杀了他，[player name]！

english: Help! Save me from the demon!
translation: 救命！快从恶魔手中救我！

english: Demon is dead... regret... could not assist.
translation: 恶魔死了……遗憾……未能协助。

english: Don't worry, Golem, you've done enough demon- slaying!
translation: 别担心，魔像，你已经杀够恶魔了！

english: So Agrith-Naar was never going to do anything for us. I suppose I'll have to make my fortune the hard way!
translation: 所以阿格瑞斯-纳尔从来没打算为我们做什么。看来我得靠自己的努力去赚取财富了！

english: I thought slaying him would make the world better, but we've just returned it to how it was before!
translation: 我本以为杀了他会让世界变得更好，但我们只是让一切恢复原样！

english: Excuse me, I'm looking for [player name]. I have an urgent job for him.
translation: 打扰一下，我在找[player name]。我有件急事要找他。

english: Excuse me, I'm looking for [player name]. I have an urgent job for her.
translation: 打扰一下，我在找[player name]。我有件急事要找他。

english: Are you [player name]?
translation: 你就是[player name]吗？

english: I've heard all about how you killed the demon Delrith!
translation: 我听说了你杀死恶魔德尔里斯的事迹！

english: My partner Badden and I are observing another group of wizards, and we think they're planning to summon another demon.
translation: 我和我的搭档巴登正在监视另一群巫师，我们觉得他们打算召唤另一个恶魔。

english: They haven't found a place to perform their ritual yet, but when they do, we might need your help!
translation: 他们还没找到举行仪式的地方，但一旦找到了，我们可能就需要你的帮助！

english: May Saradomin bless you! I can see you have many mighty adventures ahead of you.
translation: 愿萨拉多明保佑你！我看得出来，你未来还有许多伟大的冒险。

english: I need to find a demon-slaying hero!
translation: 我需要找一位能斩杀恶魔的英雄！

english: A group of dark wizards are preparing to summon the demon Agrith-Naar. We need an experienced demon slayer!
translation: 一群黑暗巫师正准备召唤恶魔阿格里斯-纳尔。我们需要一位经验丰富的恶魔杀手！

english: But I don't know of anyone who could help!
translation: 但我不知道有谁能帮忙！

english: Oh! I have something to give you, but you have no space. Free a space then talk to me again.
translation: 哦！我有东西要给你，但你没空间了。腾出个位置再跟我说话。

english: Look what I found, all covered in dirt and sand. Silverlight!
translation: 看看我找到了什么，全是泥土和沙子。银光剑！

english: I've given it a good clean. Make sure you don't lose it again!
translation: 我已经把它擦干净了。可别再弄丢了！

english: Now don't lose it again!
translation: 现在可别再弄丢了！

english: You dropped Silverlight, you fool! Now is not the time to lose the only sword that can kill Agrith-Naar!
translation: 你把银光剑弄丢了，你这个笨蛋！现在可不是弄丢唯一能杀死阿格里斯-纳尔的剑的时候！

english: I thought golems were servants of evil, but that one helped us to slay a demon. Perhaps golems aren't so bad after all!
translation: 我原以为魔像是邪恶的仆人，但那个魔像却帮我们杀了一个恶魔。也许魔像也没那么糟糕！

english: I'm ready to help with the ritual as soon as we have enough people. Let's get that demon!
translation: 我准备好帮忙进行仪式了，只要人齐就行。我们去干掉那个恶魔吧！

english: Don't lose it again!
translation: 别再弄丢了！

english: I found Silverlight lying around on the sand!
translation: 我在沙地上发现了银光剑！

english: At least that's all over.
translation: 至少总算结束了。

english: Don't get us wrong, me luv', it ain't all pretty. Those who're lookin' to gain favour within this city need to 'elp in 'ealing our fallen soldiers and tackling organised crime... It's 'ard work!
translation: 别误会，亲爱的，这里也不是一切都那么美好。那些想在这座城市里获得青睐的人，需要帮忙治疗我们阵亡的士兵，打击有组织犯罪……这活儿可不容易！

english: The rewards for the most loyal of this city are great. The 'onour to train alongside our elite guards and wear our prestigious armour, while also fightin' on the front line against the lizardman forces.
translation: 这座城市最忠诚的人会得到丰厚的回报。有机会与我们的精英卫队一起训练，穿上我们那令人敬仰的盔甲，同时还能在对抗蜥蜴人军队的前线作战。

english: Good thing for you I found it.
translation: 幸好是我找到了它。

english: You need to free up inventory space first though.
translation: 不过你得先腾出背包空间。

english: You idiot! Here's another mould.
translation: 你这个白痴！这里还有一个模具。

english: Thank goodness that's over!
translation: 谢天谢地总算结束了！

english: Goodness?
translation: 老天？

english: I'm not going to try to be evil any more. From now on I'm going to be good!
translation: 我再也不想做坏人了。从现在开始我要做好人！

english: Hmm... That's quite a few missing people... Looks like some of these have been here for a while.
translation: 嗯……失踪的人还真不少……看来有些人已经失踪一段时间了。

english: I wonder if anyone around here knows more about this...
translation: 不知道附近有没有人知道更多情况……

english: Probably too much for me to take on right now though, but hopefully someone can find them.
translation: 不过眼下这对我来说可能太难了，但希望有人能找到他们。

english: I should keep looking for these people...
translation: 我应该继续寻找这些人……

english: Hello there. Do you have a moment to talk?
translation: 你好。有空聊聊吗？

english: Do you know much about the missing people?
translation: 你对那些失踪的人了解多少？

english: Only what I've heard around the place. That funny guy by the sea keeps suggesting they're being taken in the night, which is absurd really.
translation: 只是听周围的人说起过。海边那个怪人总说他们是夜里被抓走的，这其实很荒谬。

english: Funny guy by the sea?
translation: 海边那个怪人？

english: He's always going on about strange people coming in the night, but no one would dare do that with the ents around. It's a load of rubbish.
translation: 他总是念叨有陌生人在夜里出现，但有树人在，没人敢那么做。纯属胡说八道。

english: So you don't think it's possible?
translation: 所以你觉得这不可能？

english: It would take a lot of things happening right before my eyes for me to even consider it.
translation: 除非亲眼目睹很多事发生，否则我连考虑都不会考虑。

english: Well, what do you think is happening then?
translation: 那你觉得是怎么回事？

english: I think that some of them are accidents. Others might just be leaving.
translation: 我觉得有些是事故。另一些可能只是离开了。

english: No suspicion of anything else?
translation: 没有怀疑其他原因？

english: Like what? Murder? I'm not sure who would want to kill folk around here. We're a tight community.
translation: 比如什么？谋杀？我不觉得有人想杀这里的人。我们是个紧密的社区。

english: Hmm... Thanks for the help, I guess.
translation: 嗯……谢谢帮忙，我想。

english: Hello again. I don't suppose you had any more thoughts on the missing people?
translation: 又见面了。你对那些失踪的人有没有新的想法？

english: Not really. I'm sure if you keep asking around you'll find someone who can help you. Just don't waste your time on that funny guy by the sea...
translation: 没什么。我相信如果你继续打听，总会找到能帮你的人。只是别在海边那个怪人身上浪费时间……

english: About the missing people...
translation: 关于失踪的人……

english: Ah, looking to find them, are you?
translation: 啊，想找到他们，是吗？

english: That's right. What can you tell me about them?
translation: 没错。你能告诉我些什么？

english: Not a lot. Couple of kids that have run into trouble on some adventure no doubt, along with a few adults who decided to slip away in the night.
translation: 不多。无非是几个孩子冒险时出了事，还有几个大人决定夜里悄悄溜走。

english: Is that normal around here?
translation: 这里经常这样吗？

english: Well, we're sat between two sets of mountains. Lots of places for accidents to happen.
translation: 嗯，我们坐在两座山之间。很多地方都可能出事。

english: The mountains... Right.
translation: 山……好吧。

english: Is there anyone else who might be more... invested in the missing people?
translation: 有没有其他人可能更……关心失踪的人？

english: Well, those posters aren't putting themselves on the notice board. You'll probably want to find whoever put them there.
translation: 那些传单总不会自己贴到公告板上。你大概得找到贴传单的人。

english: And you don't know who that is?
translation: 你不知道是谁？

english: Some local parents I think, but many faces come in here. I can't keep track of them all. Now, are you going to buy a drink?
translation: 我想是本地的一些父母，但来店里的人很多，我记不全。现在，你要买杯酒吗？

english: Like I told you, you'll want to find whoever put those posters up. I think it was some local parents. Now, are you going to buy a drink?
translation: 我跟你说过了，你得找到贴传单的人。我想是本地的一些父母。现在，你要买杯酒吗？

english: Not often someone comes out to speak to me. What do you want?
translation: 难得有人过来跟我说话。你想干什么？

english: I'm investigating the missing people. Do you know anything about them?
translation: 我在调查失踪的人。你知道些什么吗？

english: Oh, yes! Yes indeed! They were taken by the night people!
translation: 哦，是的！没错！他们被夜人抓走了！

english: The night people?
translation: 夜人？

english: Yes! I hear them in the dark. They think they're quiet, but not to me! I can hear them scrape against the wooden walls!
translation: 对！我在黑暗中听到他们的声音。他们以为自己很安静，但骗不了我！我能听到他们刮蹭木墙的声音！

english: Could that not just be a dog scratching at the post?
translation: 会不会是狗在柱子上磨爪子？

english: Does a dog walk on two legs?
translation: 狗会用两条腿走路吗？

english: One of the ents then?
translation: 那就是树人了？

english: An ent wouldn't go around scraping against things? They're far too careful for that!
translation: 树人可不会到处刮蹭东西？它们才没那么毛糙！

english: I don't think-
translation: 我不觉得——

english: Oh, I see what you're doing! You're just another who wants to laugh at me! You'll all see soon enough!
translation: 哦，我明白你在干什么！你也想笑话我！你们很快就知道了！

english: Okay... I think I'll leave you to it.
translation: 好吧……我想我该走了。

english: That's right! Be gone with you!
translation: 没错！滚开！

english: You again? Come to laugh at me once more? I know the night people are real! You'll find out soon enough!
translation: 又是你？又来笑话我了？我知道夜人是真的！你很快就知道了！

english: Ah, yes... It's a sad day when a town doesn't worry about its missing children...
translation: 啊，是啊……小镇不关心失踪的孩子，真是可悲……

english: People aren't worried about it?
translation: 大家不担心吗？

english: They were at first, but with how long it's been happening, I think everyone's run out of energy to keep searching.
translation: 一开始担心的，但事情发生这么久，我想大家都没精力继续找了。

english: But people have searched the? Are there any theories as to where they're going?
translation: 但人们搜过了吗？有没有什么理论推测他们去了哪里？

english: Well, that depends on who you ask... Some try to rationalise it away as some accident in the forest, the river, or the mountains.
translation: 嗯，看问谁了……有人试着理性解释为在森林、河流或山里出了事故。

english: Others just assume they up and left overnight. Took only the essentials to go and start a new life.
translation: 其他人就以为他们是连夜离开了。只带了必需品，去开始新生活。

english: Then of course, some think they're getting taken in the night...
translation: 当然，也有人认为他们是在夜里被带走的……

english: And what do you think?
translation: 那你觉得呢？

english: I think we could be doing more. Something is happening and it doesn't feel right. I know I'm not the only one who feels this way.
translation: 我觉得我们本可以做得更多。肯定有事发生，感觉不对劲。我知道不止我一个人这么觉得。

english: Well, I'm here to have a look around. I'll see what I can find out about them.
translation: 嗯，我来这里四处看看。我会尽量查出些什么。

english: Did you manage to find out anything?
translation: 你查出什么了吗？

english: That's a shame... Hopefully you have some luck soon.
translation: 真遗憾……希望你很快能有好运。

english: Hello there. I was wondering if you had any more thoughts on the missing people?
translation: 你好。我想问问你对失踪的人有没有新的想法？

english: No. As I said, we tried looking, but found nothing. Without a new lead, things are at a dead end.
translation: 没有。我说过，我们试过寻找，但一无所获。没有新线索，事情就僵住了。

english: Excuse me. I'm looking into the-
translation: 打扰一下，我在调查——

english: Turn around. Walk out.
translation: 转身。走出去。

english: Wait, I-
translation: 等等，我——

english: Please... Nobody's looking into anything. Just leave us.
translation: 求你了……没人调查什么。让我们安静待着。

english: But I'm trying to find the missing people!
translation: 但我想找到失踪的人！

english: Prove it! What do you know?
translation: 证明给我看！你知道些什么？

english: Exactly! Now, go!
translation: 就是这样！现在，走！

english: Well, I know most of the town has given up on finding them. Most are just dismissing the disappearances, assuming them to have run away or had an accident.
translation: 嗯，我知道镇上大部分人已经放弃寻找了。大多数只是忽略失踪事件，认为他们是逃跑了或出了事故。

english: However, there are some who think something more sinister is going on. If that's the case, I intend to find out. I'm [player name] and I promise I"m here to help.
translation: 不过，有些人认为有更险恶的事情在发生。如果是这样，我打算查个水落石出。我是[player name]，我保证我是来帮忙的。

english: You... You'll find our sons?
translation: 你……你会找到我们的儿子？

english: I'm going to try.
translation: 我会尽力。

english: Well... I suppose you do at least seem to somewhat care.
translation: 好吧……我想你至少看起来还有点关心。

english: What do you need from us, [player name]?
translation: [player name]，你需要我们做什么？

english: First up, what can you tell me about the disappearnce of your sons?
translation: 首先，你能告诉我你儿子失踪的事吗？

english: That's the thing... They just seemed to vanish! One moment they were playing upstairs, but the next they'd gone.
translation: 问题就在这……他们就像凭空消失了！前一秒还在楼上玩，下一秒就不见了。

english: And you didn't notice anything unusual at all?
translation: 你一点异常都没注意到？

english: Nothing really. The only thing that was a bit odd was the ents...
translation: 真没什么。唯一有点奇怪的是树人……

english: The ents?
translation: 树人？

english: Yes. Their normal path takes them right past our house, but the night the boys disappeared, they took a different route. It's like they were avoiding something...
translation: 是的。它们平常的路线会经过我们家，但孩子们失踪那晚，它们走了另一条路。就像是在避开什么东西……

english: I see. Can I look around the house a little and see if there's any clues as to where your sons went?
translation: 我明白了。我能在房子里四处看看吗？也许能找到关于你儿子去向的线索。

english: If you think it will help, then of course.
translation: 如果你觉得有用，当然可以。

english: You again? We already told you to go away!
translation: 又是你？我们叫你走开了！

english: But I want to help!
translation: 但我想帮忙！

english: Please, help us find our sons.
translation: 求你了，帮我们找到儿子。

english: There are a few scratches on the wall outside along with this strange red substance.
translation: 外面墙上有几道刮痕，还有这种奇怪的红色物质。

english: Yes, I saw that, but I thought it was from the ents. Do you think something else left it?
translation: 是的，我看到了，但以为是树人留下的。你觉得是别的东西留下的？

english: Possibly. It looks like there are puddles of the stuff leading away from your house. I'm going to follow them and see where they lead.
translation: 可能吧。看起来有一滩滩的神秘物质从你的房子延伸出去。我要跟着它们看看通向哪里。

english: Thank you, [player name]. Please, help us find our sons.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。请帮我们找到儿子。

english: Good day, traveller. Can I help you?
translation: 日安，旅者。我能帮你吗？

english: Potentially. I was wondering if you have any clue what left these weird puddles through here?
translation: 也许吧。我想知道你有没有线索，是什么东西留下了这些奇怪的水洼？

english: Hmm... I hadn't noticed them before. I don't think the ents leave that sort of thing. My guess would be one of the woodland creatures.
translation: 嗯……我之前没注意到。我不觉得树人会留下这种东西。我猜是某种林地生物。

english: I see. Thank you for your help.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的帮助。

english: That's odd... There are some scratches going up the wall, along with a strange stick red substance. It's not blood... What is it?
translation: 真奇怪……墙上有些刮痕，还有奇怪的红色黏性物质。不是血……这是什么？

english: What do we have here? More of that strange substance. I wonder where it leads...
translation: 这是什么？更多那种奇怪物质。不知道它通向哪里……

english: Hmm... A fishing rod might work...
translation: 嗯……鱼竿也许能用……

english: Interesting... I should see if this is from one of our missing people!
translation: 有意思……我该看看这是不是来自某个失踪的人！

english: I don't think this plank can offer me anything else. I should go and see if that fabric is from one of the missing people.
translation: 我觉得这块木板给不了我更多信息了。我应该去看看那织物是不是属于某个失踪的人。

english: Could this be from one of the missing people?
translation: 这会是某个失踪之人的物品吗？

english: Should I destroy this?
translation: 我应该毁掉这个吗？

english: It could be evidence of something happening here... Surely it wouldn't be ethical to do this?
translation: 这可能是这里发生了什么的证据……这么做肯定不合道德吧？

english: Then again, I wouldn't want to give false hope to those parents if it's actually nothing.
translation: 不过，如果实际上什么都不是，我也不想给那些父母虚假的希望。

english: Yet I could still ask them about it, even if I don't have it to hand...
translation: 但我还是可以问他们这件事，就算东西没在手上……

english: Yes. Do you recognise this scrap of fabric? I followed a trail of... well, I'm not sure what it is. It led from your home to the river, and this was caught on a plank there.
translation: 是的。你认得这块织物碎片吗？我跟着一条……嗯，我也不确定是什么的痕迹。它从你家一直延伸到河边，这块碎片就是卡在那里的木板上。

english: One of our sons, Etz, often wears brown, and that looks like... Does that mean...
translation: 我们的一个儿子，埃茨，经常穿棕色衣服，这看起来像……难道说……

english: It means I have a lead.
translation: 这意味着我有线索了。

english: What direction was this trail going in?
translation: 那条痕迹是往哪个方向去的？

english: Up towards the mountains north west of here. It might be dangerous, but I think I can explore further.
translation: 往这里西北方向的山上去了。可能有点危险，但我觉得我可以继续探查。

english: If you're willing to, it would mean everything to us. You're the only one who's actually cared enough to find anything!
translation: 如果你愿意去，对我们来说就是一切。你是唯一一个真正上心并找到线索的人！

english: It's the least I can do. I'll be back once I've discovered more.
translation: 这是我应该做的。等我发现更多线索就回来。

english: Yes. I followed a trail of... well, I'm not sure what it is. It led from your home to the river, and I found a scrap of fabric. Does one of your sons often wear brown clothes?
translation: 是的。我跟着一条……嗯，我也不确定是什么的痕迹。它从你家一直延伸到河边，我找到了一块织物碎片。你的一个儿子是不是经常穿棕色衣服？

english: Yes, Etz does... What does it mean?
translation: 是的，埃茨经常穿……这意味着什么？

english: It means I may have a lead.
translation: 这意味着我可能有线索了。

english: What direction was this trail going?
translation: 那条痕迹是往哪个方向去的？

english: You're back! Did you find anything in the mountains?
translation: 你回来了！在山里找到什么了吗？

english: Thank you for helping us. No one else seems to care...
translation: 谢谢你帮助我们。其他人似乎都不在乎……

english: Are you okay? Can you walk?
translation: 你还好吗？能走路吗？

english: I think so... I'm not sure if Etz can though...
translation: 我想可以……但我不确定埃茨能不能……

english: That's okay. I should be able to carry him. Now, let's get out of here...
translation: 没关系。我应该能背得动他。好了，我们离开这里吧……

english: I can't believe you found them!
translation: 真不敢相信你找到他们了！

english: I was very fortunate. They were in a cave in the mountains, but they weren't particularly far inside.
translation: 我非常幸运。它们在山里的一个洞穴中，但并没有特别深入。

english: Probably using the survival skills I taught them! That's my boys!
translation: 大概是用了我教他们的生存技巧！这才是我的好儿子！

english: How are they doing now?
translation: 他们现在怎么样了？

english: They're upstairs recovering. They need some rest, but they'll be okay.
translation: 他们在楼上休养。需要休息一下，但会没事的。

english: That's good to hear, though I am still worried as to how they ended up there. It's not really the kind of place someone visits, not to mention that strange substance I found...
translation: 那就好，但我还是担心他们是怎么到那儿的。那可不是什么会有人去的地方，更别说我找到的那种奇怪物质了……

english: You think they were taken by something?
translation: 你觉得他们是被什么东西抓走的？

english: I don't think we can rule it out.
translation: 我觉得不能排除这种可能。

english: Well, they weren't the only ones to disappear. What if you're right? What if there are more people up there? And what if whatever took them comes back?
translation: 嗯，他们不是唯一失踪的人。如果你是对的怎么办？如果山上还有更多人呢？如果抓走他们的东西又回来了呢？

english: First things first, I need to find out exactly what happened to your sons. Do you think I could ask them about it?
translation: 首先，我得弄清楚你儿子们到底发生了什么。我能问问他们吗？

english: Not yet. They need some rest first.
translation: 现在还不行。他们需要先休息一下。

english: In the meantime, you should go see Ariadna, the guard captain. People can't ignore this now. If something did take our boys, she needs to know about it. You'll find her by the main entrance into town.
translation: 与此同时，你应该去见见守卫长阿里阿德涅。现在大家不能再忽视这件事了。如果真有东西抓走了我们的儿子，她必须知道。你可以在镇子的主入口附近找到她。

english: I'll go and see her. Is there anything else I can be doing to help as well?
translation: 我会去找她。还有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: : The boys were upstairs when they disappeared. What if whatever took them climbed our wall and came through the window? If that's the case, we need to stop it from happening again!
translation: ：孩子们失踪的时候在楼上。如果抓走他们的东西爬过我们的墙，从窗户进来了呢？如果是这样，我们必须防止这种事再次发生！

english: Let's see... I suppose I could take a look at the wall and see if it can be reinforced in some way?
translation: 让我想想……我想我可以看看那堵墙，看看能不能加固一下？

english: If it's not too much trouble, that would mean a lot to us.
translation: 如果不太麻烦的话，那对我们来说意义重大。

english: I'm sure it won't be too much to sort. Right, I'll be back once I've spoken to Captain Ariadna and sorted your wall out.
translation: 我相信不会太麻烦。好了，我跟阿里阿德涅船长谈完，修好你的墙之后就回来。

english: You're back. How's it going?
translation: 你回来了。怎么样了？

english: I've got your wall all sorted. Now I need to go and see Captain Ariadna.
translation: 你的墙我已经修好了。现在我得去见阿里阿德涅船长。

english: She should be by the main entrance into town. Thank you so much for doing all this, iknami. It means everything to us.
translation: 她应该在镇子的主入口附近。非常感谢你做这一切，iknami。这对我们来说就是一切。

english: I still need to get your wall sorted. I haven't spoken to Captain Ariadna yet either.
translation: 我还没修好你的墙。也还没跟阿里阿德涅船长谈过。

english: She should be by the main entrance into town. Thank you so much for doing all of this, iknami. It means everything to us.
translation: 她应该在镇子的主入口附近。非常感谢你做这一切，iknami。这对我们来说就是一切。

english: I've got your wall all sorted. Now I'm helping Captain Ariadna source some new bows to equip the guards a bit better.
translation: 你的墙我已经修好了。现在我正在帮阿里阿德涅船长找一些新弓，好让守卫们装备得更好一些。

english: Thank you so much for doing all this, iknami. It means everything to us.
translation: 非常感谢你做这一切，iknami。这对我们来说就是一切。

english: I still need your wall sorted. I haven't spoken to Captain Ariadna either.
translation: 我还没修好你的墙。也还没跟阿里阿德涅船长谈过。

english: I've helped Captain Ariadna source some new bows to equip the guards a bit better, and your wall is all sorted as well.
translation: 我已经帮阿里阿德涅船长找了一些新弓来更好地装备守卫，你的墙也修好了。

english: Thank you, iknami. You'll be pleased to hear the boys are feeling a bit better.
translation: 谢谢你，iknami。你会很高兴听到孩子们感觉好多了。

english: So I can speak to them now?
translation: 那我现在可以跟他们谈谈了吗？

english: Yes, but do be patient with them. They still have quite a bit of recovering to do.
translation: 可以，但对他们要有耐心。他们还需要不少时间来恢复。

english: The boys are resting at the moment. You'll have to come back later if you want to speak to them.
translation: 孩子们现在在休息。如果你想跟他们说话，得晚点再来。

english: Now then... How do we reinforce you? Perhaps some maple logs will do the trick!
translation: 那么……怎么加固你呢？也许一些枫木原木就能搞定！

english: There we go!
translation: 搞定了！

english: Now then... How do we reinforce you? Perhaps some maple logs will do the trick! I reckon I'll need four sets in total, and a hammer of course.
translation: 那么……怎么加固你呢？也许一些枫木原木就能搞定！我想总共需要四组，当然还得要一把锤子。

english: Now then... How do we reinforce you? Perhaps some maple logs will do the trick! I reckon I'll need four sets in total.
translation: 那么……怎么加固你呢？也许一些枫木原木就能搞定！我想总共需要四组。

english: Good day! I'm here about those missing people.
translation: 你好！我是为了那些失踪的人来的。

english: Yes, I saw you bringing those boys back to town. Where did you find them?
translation: 是的，我看到你把那些男孩带回镇上了。你在哪里找到他们的？

english: In a cave up in the mountains.
translation: 在山上的一个洞穴里。

english: Did you see any sign of other missing people?
translation: 你看到其他失踪人员的迹象了吗？

english: I'm afraid not, but I intend to ask the boys about them once they've had some time to rest. I'm worried they didn't go up there on their own. There's a chance something might have taken them.
translation: 恐怕没有，但我打算等孩子们休息好了之后问问他们。我担心他们不是自己上山的。有可能是什么东西把他们抓走了。

english: Ah, wonderful. This is just what we need.
translation: 啊，太好了。这正是我们需要的。

english: Yes, I must admit, the town doesn't seem very well equipped to deal with this sort of thing. Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 是的，我得承认，这个镇子似乎没有做好应对这类事情的准备。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Well, one of the people who went missing was the local fletcher. In his absence, our already light supply of longbows has become even lighter.
translation: 嗯，失踪的一个人是当地的制弓匠。他不在，我们本就不多的长弓储备就更少了。

english: I'm sure I can step in as your fletcher! New bows, was it?
translation: 我相信我可以暂代制弓匠！是要新弓，对吧？

english: That's right. We typically use willow longbows. We've lost a few experienced archers over the years so we've tried to make things more approachable... and cheaper.
translation: 没错。我们通常使用柳木长弓。这些年来我们失去了一些经验丰富的弓箭手，所以我们尽量让事情变得更简单……也更便宜。

english: Willow... Approachable... Got it! How many did you need?
translation: 柳木……简单……明白了！你需要多少？

english: Four would keep us comfortable for the time being.
translation: 四把就够我们暂时用了。

english: I just so happen to have those on hand!
translation: 我正好手头就有！

english: Making the most of the woodlands around here, were you?
translation: 充分利用了这附近的林地，是吧？

english: So you've got the bows. What now?
translation: 所以你有弓了。现在呢？

english: I have those bows you asked for!
translation: 我带来了你要的那些弓！

english: So you've got the bows. Now what?
translation: 所以你有弓了。现在呢？

english: Well, not a lot really. We'll increase the number of guards posted at the entrances into town, but without knowing what we're looking for, we can't do much else.
translation: 嗯，其实也没什么了。我们会增加镇子入口处的守卫数量，但不知道我们在找什么，我们也做不了别的。

english: Right... Not quite the solution I was after, but it's a start. I guess I'd better go check in with those boys and see if I can find out more about how they ended up in that cave.
translation: 好吧……虽然不是我想的解决方案，但总算是个开始。我想我最好去看看那些男孩，看看能不能了解更多关于他们是怎么到那个洞穴里的。

english: You're back. Have you sourced those willow longbows yet?
translation: 你回来了。找到那些柳木长弓了吗？

english: Not quite. How many did you need?
translation: 还没有。你需要多少？

english: Just the four of them.
translation: 就四把。

english: Ah, it's you. I hear you're still looking into the case of those missing people. Must say, you're the first person in a while to actually stick to it.
translation: 啊，是你。我听说你还在调查那些失踪人员的事。得说，你是很久以来第一个真正坚持下来的人。

english: Well, I don't like leaving a mystery unsolved.
translation: 嗯，我不喜欢留下未解之谜。

english: Clearly. Anyway, good luck with it.
translation: 显然如此。总之，祝你好运。

english: You're the one that saved us. Thank you.
translation: 是你救了我们。谢谢你。

english: It's not a problem. I'm just glad you're both okay. If it's alright, I wanted to ask you how you ended up in that cave. I'm hoping it might help me track down the others who are missing.
translation: 没什么。我很高兴你们都平安。如果可以的话，我想问问你们是怎么到那个洞穴里的。我希望这能帮我找到其他失踪的人。

english: We didn't see any others... It was just us and Antos...
translation: 我们没有看到其他人……只有我们和安托斯……

english: Antos?
translation: 安托斯？

english: Yes! He makes bows for the guards. We'd see him sometimes when dad would go with him to the pub, but he wasn't in the pub! He was in the cave!
translation: 是的！他为守卫做弓。爸爸有时会和他一起去酒馆，我们有时会看到他，但他不在酒馆里！他在洞穴里！

english: He was deeper inside. Those... things... they dragged him away!
translation: 他在更深处。那些……东西……把他拖走了！

english: This isn't good. I need to get back there!
translation: 这可不好。我得回去那里！

english: Please... find Antos.
translation: 请……找到安托斯。

english: He was deeper inside that cave. Those... things... they dragged him away!
translation: 他在那个洞穴的更深处。那些……东西……把他拖走了！

english: I'm going to head back there right now!
translation: 我现在就回去那里！

english: Have you spoken to the boys yet?
translation: 你跟孩子们谈过了吗？

english: They're just upstairs, but do be patient with them. They still have quite a bit of recovering to do.
translation: 他们就在楼上，但对他们要有耐心。他们还需要不少时间来恢复。

english: Yes, but I need to get back to the cave. Apparently someone called Antos is still in there!
translation: 是的，但我得回洞穴去。显然有个叫安托斯的人还在里面！

english: Antos is up there? You'd better go and find him, iknami!
translation: 安托斯在上面？你最好去找他，iknami！

english: Traveller. Did you find out more about what happened to those boys?
translation: 旅行者。你弄清楚那些男孩到底发生了什么吗？

english: Well, without knowing what we're looking for, there's not much we can do.
translation: 嗯，不知道我们在找什么，我们也做不了什么。

english: Yes, but I also found out someone called Antos is still in that cave! I need to go and find him!
translation: 是的，但我也发现一个叫安托斯的人还在那个洞穴里！我得去找他！

english: Antos? I'll get the guards ready, but that will take some time.
translation: 安托斯？我会让守卫们准备好，但这需要一些时间。

english: We don't have time! I'm heading up there now!
translation: 我们没有时间了！我现在就上去！

english: You're going alone?
translation: 你要一个人去？

english: It's that or he dies!
translation: 要么这样，要么他死！

english: You're mad, traveller! Good luck up there.
translation: 你疯了，旅行者！祝你在上面好运。

english: Antos? Are you okay?
translation: 安托斯？你还好吗？

english: Behind... you...
translation: 在……你……后面……

english: Have they gone?
translation: 它们走了吗？

english: For now, but there could be more. We should get out of here.
translation: 目前是这样，但可能还有更多。我们得离开这里。

english: Thank you, iknami. I thought I could find out where people were going... No one else seemed to care... I managed to track those boys here, but then those things...
translation: 谢谢你，iknami。我本以为能查出人们去了哪里……似乎没人在乎……我追踪那群男孩到了这里，然后那些东西就……

english: It's okay, Antos. The boys are safe.
translation: 没事了，安托斯。那些男孩很安全。

english: That's good... but everyone else... Look what they did to them...
translation: 那就好……但其他人呢……看看他们对那些人做了什么……

english: I'm sorry, Antos. We can't help them now, but at least you and the boys are safe. Come on, let's get you home, before more of those things arrive...
translation: 我很遗憾，安托斯。我们现在帮不了他们，但至少你和那些男孩是安全的。来吧，趁那些东西还没更多，我们先送你回家。

english: You found Antos! I never thought we'd see him again. What happened?
translation: 你找到安托斯了！我没想到还能再见到他。发生了什么？

english: That cave up in the mountains is full of some strange creatures. They were the ones responsible for the disappearances.
translation: 山上那个洞穴里全是些奇怪的生物。它们就是造成失踪事件的元凶。

english: I see... Did you find anyone else up there?
translation: 我明白了……你在上面还找到别人了吗？

english: No. At least, no one alive, that is.
translation: 没有。至少，没有活着的人了。

english: That's... unfortunate. Still, from what you've said, I suppose we should be thankful that you found anyone still breathing.
translation: 这……真是不幸。不过，照你所说，我想我们还应该庆幸你找到了一个还活着的人。

english: Right, time to get to work I guess. Now that we know about these creatures and where they're coming from, we can hopefully ensure they don't take anyone else.
translation: 好吧，我想该开始干正事了。既然我们知道了这些生物和它们的来源，希望能确保它们不再带走别人。

english: I suspect it's going to require us to establish a constant watch. Not ideal, but doable, especially with those new bows.
translation: 我怀疑这需要咱们安排持续监视。虽然不理想，但可行，尤其是有了那些新弓。

english: Well, if you ever fancy heading up there and killing more of those creatures, you won't find me complaining. Apart from that though, I think you've done all you can.
translation: 嗯，如果你什么时候想去上面多杀几只那种生物，我肯定不会抱怨的。不过除此之外，我想你已经尽力了。

english: In that case, good luck with it all.
translation: 既然如此，祝你们一切顺利。

english: Thank you. All the best, traveller.
translation: 谢谢。祝你好运，冒险者。

english: Hello again, traveller. We've been keeping an eye on the mountain pass to make sure those creatures don't come back. We haven't had any more disappearances, so it seems to be working.
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。我们一直在留意山隘，确保那些生物不会回来。没有更多的失踪事件了，看来这样是有效的。

english: Still, we can't be too careful. If you ever fancy going up to that cave and killing a few of them for us, that would be appreciated.
translation: 不过，我们还是不能掉以轻心。如果你什么时候想去那个洞穴帮我们杀几只，我们会很感激的。

english: I might just do that.
translation: 我可能会去。

english: Thank you, traveller. All the best.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者。祝你好运。

english: Thank you for finding our sons, iknami.
translation: 感谢你找到我们的儿子，iknami。

english: Tetamo! You are too humble, friend. Without you, our boys would be dead. What you did means everything to us.
translation: Tetamo！你太谦虚了，朋友。没有你，我们的孩子就死定了。你所做的一切对我们意义重大。

english: No, thank you, iknami!
translation: 不，谢谢你，iknami！

english: Ah, it's you. I hear you've become a bit of a hero around here. Not a bad job.
translation: 啊，是你。我听说你在这附近成了个有点名气的英雄。干得不错嘛。

english: Please... please find and dispose of those four diseased sheep as quickly as possible. Every second the risk of contamination grows! If you need some protective clothing, speak to Doctor Orbon in the chapel just north
translation: 请……请尽快找到并处理掉那四只病羊。每一秒，传染的风险都在增加！如果你需要防护服，就去北边礼拜堂找奥本医生。

english: of here.
translation: 就在这里的北边。

english: Some more sheep poison would be appreciated...
translation: 再来点羊用毒药就好了……

english: Certainly adventurer. Please hurry!
translation: 当然可以，冒险者。请快一点！

english: I'll do my best sir.
translation: 我会尽力的，先生。

english: Hello there. I've spoken to Councillor Halgrive. He has asked me to round up your sheep and slaughter them.
translation: 你好。我和哈尔格里夫议员谈过了。他让我来把你的羊集中起来并宰杀掉。

english: Well, I always knew someone would have to. Make sure you're careful about it; there should be a cattleprod in the barn you can use to herd up the sheep.
translation: 好吧，我早就知道有人得这么做。小心点；谷仓里应该有根赶牛棒，你可以用它来把羊赶在一起。

english: Hello doctor. I need to acquire some protective clothing so that I can dispose of some diseased sheep.
translation: 医生你好。我需要弄一些防护服来处理病羊。

english: Protective clothing? I'm afraid I only have the one suit which I made myself to prevent infection from any contaminated patients I treat.
translation: 防护服？恐怕我只有一套自己做的，用来防止治疗病人时被感染。

english: I suppose I could sell you this one and make myself another, but it would cost you at least 100 gold so that I could afford a replacement.
translation: 我想我可以把这套卖给你，然后再自己做一套，不过这至少得收你100金币，这样我才能付得起替换的费用。

english: Okay, I'll take it.
translation: 好的，我买了。

english: Oops, sorry, I don't have enough money.
translation: 哎呀，抱歉，我钱不够。

english: That's okay. Just don't go near those sheep. When you can find the money come back here.
translation: 没关系。千万别靠近那些羊。等你凑够钱了再回来找我吧。

english: These should protect you from infection.
translation: 这些应该能保护你免受感染。

english: You don't seem to have enough room to hold the protective suit. Come back when you do.
translation: 你身上似乎没有足够的空间来装防护服。有空了再来吧。

english: Sorry doc, that's too much.
translation: 抱歉医生，太贵了。

english: I'm afraid it will cost me that much to replace. I cannot possibly sell it for less.
translation: 恐怕换一套就得花那么多钱。我不可能以更低的价格出售。

english: Did you dispose of those infected sheep yet?
translation: 你处理掉那些被感染的羊了吗？

english: You should hurry, they could infect the entire town in a matter of a few days!
translation: 你得抓紧，它们可能在几天之内就感染整个镇子！

english: I notice you do not appear to have your protective clothing with you. Would you care to buy some more? Same price as before.
translation: 我注意到你似乎没带着防护服。要再买一些吗？价钱和之前一样。

english: No, I don't need any more.
translation: 不，我不需要了。

english: I suggest you go and retrieve your protective suit then. Trust me, you do not want to be infected.
translation: 那我建议你回去把你的防护服拿上。相信我，你肯定不会想被感染的。

english: Have you managed to find and dispose of those four sheep yet?
translation: 你找到并处理掉那四只羊了吗？

english: Uh... yeah... not quite just yet...
translation: 呃……嗯……还差一点……

english: Not quite's not good enough. It is vital you catch, kill, and incinerate all four sheep as quickly as possible. Each second they are free, the risk of further contagion increases.
translation: 差一点可不行。你必须尽快抓住、杀死并焚烧掉全部四只羊。它们每多自由一秒，进一步传染的风险就会增加。

english: Hello adventurer. Be careful herding those sheep; I don't think they've wandered far, but if you touch them you risk getting infected.
translation: 你好，冒险者。赶羊的时候小心点；我想它们没跑远，但如果你碰到它们，就有被感染的风险。

english: I suggest you use the cattleprod from the barn over there to herd them, that way you won't have to touch them directly and risk infection.
translation: 我建议你用那边谷仓里的赶牛棒来赶它们，这样就不用直接接触，能降低感染风险。

english: It doesn't look very safe in there. I'm not going in without decent protective clothing.
translation: 里面看着不太安全。没有合适的防护服我不进去。

english: I don't think I should kill the sheep outside the enclosure. The councillor was worried that it might spread the disease.
translation: 我觉得不该在围栏外面杀羊。议员担心这可能会传播疾病。

english: The sheep looks extremely unwell. I don't want to touch it without a full protective suit.
translation: 这羊看起来病得很重。没有全套防护服我可不想碰它。

english: BAAAAA!
Excellent work adventurer! Please let me reimburse you the 100 gold it cost you to purchase your protective clothing.
translation: 干得漂亮，冒险者！请让我把你买防护服花的100金币还给你。

english: And in recognition of your service to the public health of Ardougne, please accept this further 3000 coins as a reward.
translation: 为了表彰你对阿多尼城公共卫生的贡献，请收下这额外的3000金币作为奖励。

english: You're after a quest, you say? Well I don't have any here.
translation: 你说你想要个任务？我这里可没有。

english: In fact Fred, funnily enough, I actually have 20 balls of wool already on me.
translation: 事实上弗雷德，有趣的是，我身上已经有20个羊毛球了。

english: Have you been shearing my sheep without permission!?
translation: 你是不是没经过允许就剪了我的羊！？

english: No! Well, maybe... They just looked a little wooly! Surely you like a shave once in a while, too?
translation: 没有！呃，也许吧……它们只是看起来有点毛茸茸的！你肯定偶尔也想剃剃毛吧？

english: It's rude to shave another person without permission - don't be coming at me with them shears!
translation: 不经允许就给人剃毛是很不礼貌的——别拿你那把剪刀对着我！

english: I'm sorry, I'll ask permission next time.
translation: 对不起，下次我会先问的。

english: I guess no real 'arm was done. Hand the balls over and we can put this whole thing behind us.
translation: 我想也没造成什么真正的伤害。把毛线球交出来，这事就过去了。

english: Yes, okay. I can do that.
translation: 好的，没问题。

english: Good! Now one more thing, do you actually know how to shear a sheep?
translation: 好！还有一件事，你当真知道怎么剪羊毛吗？

english: Err. No, I don't know actually.
translation: 呃。不，我其实不知道。

english: Well, first things first, you need a pair of shears. I've got some here you can use.
translation: 嗯，首先，你需要一把剪刀。我这儿就有，你可以用。

english: You just need to go and use them on the sheep out in my field.
translation: 你只需要去我田里，用它们剪那些羊就行了。

english: Sounds easy!
translation: 听起来很简单！

english: Some of the sheep don't like it too much... Persistence is the key.
translation: 有些羊可能不太乐意……坚持是关键。

english: Once you've collected some wool you can spin it into balls.
translation: 等你收集到一些羊毛后，可以把它们纺成毛线球。

english: Do you know how to spin wool?
translation: 你知道怎么纺羊毛吗？

english: I don't know how to spin wool, sorry.
translation: 我不知道怎么纺羊毛，抱歉。

english: Don't worry, it's quite simple!
translation: 别担心，很简单！

english: The nearest Spinning Wheel can be found on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 最近的纺车可以在仑桥镇城堡的一楼找到。

english: To get to Lumbridge Castle just follow the road east.
translation: 要前往仑桥镇城堡，沿着东边的路走就行了。

english: I need to talk to you about shearing these sheep!
translation: 我得和你谈谈剪这些羊毛的事！

english: Oh. How are you doing getting those balls of wool?
translation: 哦。你收集那些羊毛球弄得怎么样了？

english: How many more do I need to give you?
translation: 我还需要给你多少个？

english: You need to collect 20 more balls of wool.
translation: 你需要再收集20个羊毛球。

english: Ah well at least you haven't been eaten. You know what you're doing, right?
translation: 啊，至少你没被吃掉。你知道该怎么做，对吧？

english: How do I shear sheep, again?
translation: 再说一次，怎么剪羊毛？

english: Well, you're half way there already! You have a set of shears in your inventory. Just use those on a Sheep to shear it.
translation: 嗯，你已经完成一半了！你的背包里有一把剪刀。用剪刀对着羊使用就能剪毛了。

english: That's all I have to do?
translation: 这就完了？

english: Well once you've collected some wool you'll need to spin it into balls.
translation: 嗯，等你收集到一些羊毛后，还需要把它纺成毛线球。

english: Yes, I know how to spin wool.
translation: 是的，我知道怎么纺羊毛。

english: Remind me how to spin wool.
translation: 再提醒我一下怎么纺羊毛。

english: You can get to it, then!
translation: 那你去做吧！

english: I've got some wool. I've not managed to make it into a ball though.
translation: 我有了一些羊毛，但还没能做成毛线球。

english: Well go find a spinning wheel then. You can find one on the first floor of Lumbridge Castle, just walk east on the road outside my house and you'll find Lumbridge.
translation: 那就去找个纺车吧。你可以在仑桥镇城堡的一楼找到一个，只要从我房子外面的路向东走，你就会找到仑桥镇。

english: I have some.
translation: 我有一些了。

english: That's all I've got so far.
translation: 我目前就弄到这么多。

english: I need [1-19] more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要 [1-19] 个才能付给你。

english: Ok I'll work on it.
translation: 好的，我会继续弄。

english: I need [#] more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要 [#] 个才能付给你。

english: That's the last of them.
translation: 这是最后一些了。

english: I guess I'd better pay you then.
translation: 我想我该付给你报酬了。

english: About that book... Where is it again?
translation: 关于那本书……它到底在哪？

english: I'm not sure exactly... but I'm sure it's around here somewhere.
translation: 我不太确定……但我肯定它就在这附近的某个地方。

english: Aha! Exactly what I was looking for.
translation: 啊哈！这正是我要找的。

english: I found that book.
translation: 我找到那本书了。

english: Very good. I suggest you give it a read.
translation: 很好。我建议你读一读。

english: Okay, I've read that book about the Shield of Arrav.
translation: 好了，我已经读过那本关于阿拉夫之盾的书了。

english: Then perhaps you now have your quest?
translation: 那么，也许你现在知道你的任务是什么了？

english: I think I do. Do you know where I can find the Phoenix Gang or the Black Arm Gang?
translation: 我想我知道了。你知道我在哪里可以找到凤凰帮或黑臂帮吗？

english: No, I don't. However, I hear Baraek, the fur trader in the market, has had connections with the Phoenix Gang.
translation: 不，我不知道。不过，我听说市场上的毛皮商人巴拉克和凤凰帮有联系。

english: And the Black Arm Gang?
translation: 那黑臂帮呢？

english: There are rumours that they are based in the south west corner of the city. Charlie the Tramp might be able to tell you more. He knows that part of Varrock well.
translation: 有传言说他们的据点在这座城市的西南角。流浪汉查理也许能告诉你更多。他对维洛克城那一带很熟悉。

english: Thanks! I'll get to it!
translation: 谢谢！我这就去办！

english: I'm looking for the Black Arm Gang.
translation: 我在找黑臂帮。

english: Funny you should mention that... Rumour has it that they have their headquarters right down this alleyway. Though if I were you, I'd be careful about messing with them...
translation: 你提到这个真有意思……有传言说他们的总部就在这条小巷子里。不过，我要是你，我会小心点，别去招惹他们……

english: Like I told you, the rumour is that they have their headquarters right down this alleyway. Though if I were you, I'd be careful about messing with them...
translation: 就像我告诉你的，传言说他们的总部就在这条小巷子里。不过，我要是你，我会小心点，别去招惹他们……

english: You never know. You'll find a lady down there called Katrine. Speak to her. But whatever you do, don't upset her.
translation: 谁知道呢。你会在下面找到一个叫卡特琳的女人。跟她谈谈。但无论如何，别惹她生气。

english: It's a private business. Can I help you at all?
translation: 这是私人业务。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: I've heard you're the Black Arm Gang.
translation: 我听说你们就是黑臂帮。

english: I'd rather not reveal my sources.
translation: 我宁愿不透露我的消息来源。

english: Hmm... I suppose I can understand that. So, say we were the Black Arm Gang, what would you want with us?
translation: 嗯……我想我能理解。那么，假设我们就是黑臂帮，你找我们有什么事？

english: I want to become a member of your gang.
translation: 我想成为你们帮派的一员。

english: I want some hints on becoming a thief.
translation: 我想要一些关于如何成为盗贼的提示。

english: Do you now? And what makes you think I'll provide anything like that?
translation: 是吗？是什么让你觉得我会提供那种东西？

english: Well, how about I become a member of your gang in return?
translation: 嗯，那我加入你们帮派作为回报怎么样？

english: How unusual... Okay, let's say we are who you believe we are. Do you think we'd be recruiting people who just waltz in here saying 'hello, I'd like to play'?
translation: 真不寻常……好吧，假设我们就是你认为的那个帮派。你觉得我们会招募那些大摇大摆走进来说‘你好，我想玩玩’的人吗？

english: I don't know. What would be the alternative?
translation: 我不知道。那还有什么别的办法？

english: Watching local thugs and thieves in action, perhaps? How do I know I can just trust someone who's wandered in here.
translation: 也许先观察一下当地的地痞和盗贼是怎么行动的？我怎么知道我能信任一个随便闯进来的人。

english: Well, you can give me a try can't you?
translation: 嗯，你可以给我个机会试试，不是吗？

english: I'm not so sure...
translation: 我不太确定……

english: Well, people tell me I have an honest face.
translation: 嗯，别人都说我长着一张诚实的脸。

english: Someone honest wanting to join a gang of thieves? Excuse me if I remain unconvinced...
translation: 一个诚实的人想加入盗贼帮派？请原谅我对此持保留态度……

english: Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually. You may have heard of the Phoenix Gang. I hear they have a very nice weapons stash not too far from here.
translation: 想了想……我可能确实有个办法。你可能听说过凤凰帮。我听说他们离这不远有个很好的武器藏匿点。

english: We're fresh out of crossbows, but apparently they have plenty. If someone were to aquirea couple for us, it would be very much appreciated.
translation: 我们的弩刚好用完了，但显然他们有很多。如果有人能帮我们弄几把来，我们会非常感激的。

english: Sounds simple enough. Any particular reason you need them?
translation: 听起来挺简单的。有什么特别的原因需要它们吗？

english: Let's just say there's a local merchant who is refusing to pay some very reasonable 'keep-your-life-pleasant' insurance rates.
translation: 这么说吧，有个本地商人拒绝支付一些非常合理的‘保你生活愉快’保险费。

english: So you're planning to murder him?
translation: 所以你们打算杀了他？
