english: Him? No. However, I hear that the local law might soon be finding a crossbow belonging to the Phoenix Gang in his home...
translation: 杀他？不。不过，我听说当地的执法部门可能很快就会在他家里发现一把属于凤凰帮的弩……

english: I also hear that a similar type of crossbow might soon be used in a murder on the other side of the city...
translation: 我还听说，一把类似的弩可能很快就会被用于城市另一头的一起谋杀案……

english: Now, are you going to keep asking questions, or are you going to go get those crossbows?
translation: 那么，你是打算继续问问题，还是去拿那些弩？

english: Okay, no problem.
translation: 好的，没问题。

english: Great! Apparently the Phoenix Gang's weapons stash is somewhere to the east. Ask that tramp outside. I'm sure he'll know more.
translation: 太好了！据说凤凰帮的武器藏匿点在东边某个地方。去问问外面那个流浪汉。我肯定他知道得更多。

english: Sounds a little tricky. Got anything easier?
translation: 听起来有点棘手。有没有更简单的事？

english: If you're not up for a little bit of danger, I don't think you've got anything to offer us.
translation: 如果你连一点危险都不敢面对，那我觉得你对我们没什么用。

english: Okay, I'll do it.
translation: 好吧，我去做。

english: It's a no from me then.
translation: 那我拒绝。

english: Then get lost!
translation: 那就滚吧！

english: I'm looking for the door out of here.
translation: 我在找出去的门。

english: Try... the one you just came through?
translation: 试试……你刚进来的那扇？

english: It was Charlie, the tramp outside.
translation: 是查理，外面那个流浪汉告诉我的。

english: Is that guy still out there? He's getting to be a nuisance. Might be time for him to have a little accident...
translation: 那家伙还在外面？他越来越烦人了。也许是时候让他出点‘小意外’了……

english: Anyway, say we were the Black Arm Gang, what would you want with us?
translation: 总之，假设我们就是黑臂帮，你找我们有什么事？

english: Everyone knows. It's no great secret.
translation: 谁都知道。这又不是什么大秘密。

english: What?! You must be joking!
translation: 什么？！你一定是在开玩笑！

english: Oh no, not at all... It's so obvious! Even the town guard have caught on...
translation: 哦不，一点都没有……这太明显了！连城镇守卫都察觉到了……

english: I see... Well... say we were the Black Arm Gang, what would you want with us?
translation: 我明白了……好吧……假设我们就是黑臂帮，你找我们有什么事？

english: What sort of business?
translation: 什么样的业务？

english: A small, family business. We give financial advice to other companies. Now, if you'll excuse me.
translation: 一个小型家族企业。我们为其他公司提供财务建议。现在，请恕我失陪。

english: I'm looking for fame and riches.
translation: 我在寻找名望和财富。

english: And you expect to find that up the back streets of Varrock? Keep dreaming.
translation: 你觉得能在维洛克城的后街找到这些？继续做梦吧。

english: Any idea where the Phoenix Gang are based?
translation: 知道凤凰帮的据点在哪儿吗？

english: Sure, I know everything there is to know about this city. I'd be happy to tell you for ten coins.
translation: 当然，我对这座城市无所不知。我很乐意告诉你，只要十枚金币。

english: Perfect! Now listen closely. The Phoenix Gang can be found east of here. Take the southern alley past the Blue Moon Inn and look for a building owned by the VTAM corporation.
translation: 完美！现在仔细听好。凤凰帮在东边。沿着蓝月旅馆南边的小巷走，找一栋属于VTAM公司的建筑。

english: Their main hideout is in that building, with their weapon stash being two buildings east of it. Good luck getting into either without being a member of their gang though.
translation: 他们的主要藏身处就在那栋楼里，武器藏匿点则在它东边两栋楼的位置。不过，要不是他们帮派的成员，想进去可没那么容易。

english: Without being a member of their gang? That might be problematic.
translation: 不是他们帮派的成员？那可能有点麻烦。

english: Well, your best bet would probably be to find someone who isn't a member of the Black Arm Gang and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Phoenix Gang for you.
translation: 嗯，你最好的办法大概是找个不是黑臂帮成员的人，让他为你潜入凤凰帮。

english: Someone? Like who?
translation: 找个人？比如谁？

english: Ten coins? That's too much! I'll give you five.
translation: 十枚金币？太贵了！我给你五枚。

english: I guess that'll have to do then.
translation: 我想那也只能这样了。

english: So where can I find the Phoenix Gang then?
translation: 那么，我在哪里可以找到凤凰帮？

english: If you pay me five more coins, I'll tell you.
translation: 如果你再付我五枚金币，我就告诉你。

english: That's not fair, but I guess I don't have a choice.
translation: 这不公平，但我想我别无选择。

english: You thieving gutter-scum! You'd better watch your back!
translation: 你这个偷窃的下流胚！你最好小心点！

english: Yeah, sure, whatever. You don't frighten me, pal.
translation: 是啊，当然，随便你怎么说。你可吓不倒我，老兄。

english: Never mind. I'll find it myself.
translation: 算了。我自己去找。

english: Well, you know where to find me if you get lost!
translation: 好吧，如果你迷路了，你知道在哪里能找到我！

english: Well, given you paid up, I guess I can remind you. The Phoenix Gang can be found east of here. Take the southern alley past the Blue Moon Inn and look for a building owned by the VTAM corporation.
translation: 嗯，既然你付了钱，我想我可以再提醒你一次。凤凰帮在东边。沿着蓝月旅馆南边的小巷走，找一栋属于VTAM公司的建筑。

english: Have you got those crossbows for me yet?
translation: 你拿到那些弩了吗？

english: No, I haven't found them yet. Do you know where I should be looking.
translation: 不，我还没找到。你知道我该去哪里找吗？

english: Apparently the Phoenix Gang's weapons stash is somewhere to the east. Ask that tramp outside. I'm sure he'll know more.
translation: 据说凤凰帮的武器藏匿点在东边某个地方。去问问外面那个流浪汉。我肯定他知道得更多。

english: I have one...
translation: 我有一把……

english: Well, I need two. Come back when you have them.
translation: 嗯，我需要两把。拿到后再回来。

english: It seems you're more skilled than I originally gave you credit for. Well done. Consider yourself a member of the Black Arm Gang. I'd suggest you now go and familiarise yourself with the rest of the ganghouse.
translation: 看来你的本事比我最初以为的要大。干得好。现在你算是黑臂帮的一员了。我建议你去熟悉一下帮派据点的其他地方。

english: So I'm part of the gang now?
translation: 所以我现在是帮派的一员了？

english: You are. Feel free to familiarise yourself with the rest of the ganghouse.
translation: 是的。去熟悉一下帮派据点的其他地方吧。

english: Will do! Thanks!
translation: 好的！谢谢！

english: Who are all those people in there?
translation: 里面那些人都是谁？

english: They're just various rogues and thieves.
translation: 他们只是些各种各样的流氓和盗贼。

english: They don't say a lot...
translation: 他们话不多……

english: Teach me to be a top class criminal.
translation: 教我怎么成为顶级罪犯。

english: Teach yourself.
translation: 自学去。

english: This must be the Shield of Arrav! Well... half of it at least. I wonder where the other half is...
translation: 这一定就是阿拉夫之盾！嗯……至少是它的一半。不知道另一半在哪……

english: Stay away from here! Black Arm dog!
translation: 离远点！黑臂帮的狗！

english: Hey! Who are you? I'm gonna teach you not to stick your nose where it don't belong!
translation: 嘿！你是谁？我要让你知道别多管闲事！

english: I've found half of the Shield of Arrav!
translation: 我找到了阿拉夫之盾的一半！

english: Half?
translation: 一半？

english: Yes. It seems it was split in two.
translation: 是的。它似乎被分成了两半。

english: I see... Where did you find this half?
translation: 我明白了……你是在哪里找到这一半的？

english: The Black Arm Gang had it. I managed to infiltrate their gang and steal it from them.
translation: 黑臂帮拿着它。我设法潜入了他们的帮派，把它偷了出来。

english: A split gang and a split shield. My guess would be that the other gang has the other half.
translation: 分裂的帮派和分裂的盾牌。我猜另一半在另一个帮派手里。

english: Well, I did have a member of the Phoenix Gang help me... Maybe they can find the other half.
translation: 嗯，确实有个凤凰帮的成员帮了我……也许他们能找到另一半。

english: Let's hope so. In the meantime, you should probably head over to the museum so they can verify the authenticity of this half.
translation: 但愿如此。与此同时，你最好去一趟博物馆，让他们验证这一半的真伪。

english: Shh, shh, shh! Not so loud! You don't want to get me in trouble, do you?
translation: 嘘，嘘，嘘！小声点！你不想给我惹麻烦吧？

english: So I take it that you do know where they are.
translation: 这么说，你确实知道他们在哪儿。

english: I may do... but I don't want to get into trouble for revealing their hideout. Of course, if I was, say 20 coins richer, I may happen to be more inclined to take that sort of risk...
translation: 也许知道……但我不想因为泄露他们的藏身处而惹麻烦。当然，如果我手头能多个20金币，说不定我就更愿意冒这个险了……

english: Okay, to get to the gang hideout, head to the southern gates of the city and then head down the alleyway past the Blue Moon Inn.
translation: 好吧，要去帮派藏身处，先到城南大门，然后沿着小巷走，经过蓝月旅馆。

english: Down there you'll find a building owned by the VTAM corporation. That's where you'll find the Phoenix Gang. Just be careful. They ain't the types to be messed about.
translation: 那里你会找到一栋VTAM公司的建筑，那就是凤凰帮的所在地。小心点，他们可不是好惹的。

english: Uh... oops. I don't actually have 20 coins. Silly me.
translation: 呃……哎呀。我其实没有20金币。我真傻。

english: No, I don't do things like bribery.
translation: 不，我不干贿赂这种事。

english: If you wanna deal with the Phoenix Gang, they're involved in much worse than a bit of bribery.
translation: 如果你想跟凤凰帮打交道，他们干的事可比贿赂严重多了。

english: Yes, I'd like to be 20 coins richer too.
translation: 是啊，我也想多20金币。

english: What's through that door?
translation: 那扇门后面是什么？

english: You can't go in there. Only authorised personnel of the VTAM Corporation are allowed beyond this point.
translation: 你不能进去。只有VTAM公司的授权人员才能进入这里。

english: I know who you are!
translation: 我知道你是谁！

english: Really? Well? Who are we then?
translation: 真的吗？那你说说，我们是谁？

english: This is the headquarters of one of the most dangerous crime syndicates this city has ever seen! The Phoenix Gang!
translation: 这是这座城市有史以来最危险的犯罪集团之一的总部！凤凰帮！

english: No, this is a legitimate business run by legitimate individuals. However... supposing we were this crime gang, what would you want with us?
translation: 不，这是一家由合法人士经营的合法企业。不过……假设我们就是那个犯罪团伙，你找我们有什么事？

english: I'd like to offer you my services.
translation: 我想为你们效劳。

english: You mean you'd like to join the Phoenix Gang? Well, obviously I can't speak for them, but the Phoenix Gang doesn't let people join just like that. First, you'd need to prove your loyalty.
translation: 你是说你想加入凤凰帮？嗯，我显然不能代表他们说话，但凤凰帮不会随便让人加入。首先，你得证明你的忠诚。

english: Obviously, I would have no idea. Although, having said that, a rival gang of ours, er, theirs, called the Black Arm Gang is supposedly meeting a contact from Port Sarim today.
translation: 显然，我什么都不知道。不过话说回来，我们——呃，他们的一个敌对帮派，叫黑臂帮，据说今天要在沙林港见一个联系人。

english: Apparently the meeting is going to take place in the Blue Moon Inn, and supposedly the contact is none other than the notorious mass murderer turned pirate captain, Jonny the Beard.
translation: 显然，会面将在蓝月旅馆进行，而那个联系人正是臭名昭著的连环杀手转行当海盗船长的胡子乔尼。

english: Now, obviously I know nothing about the dealings of the Phoenix Gang, but I bet if somebody were to arrange an accident for Jonny and bring back his intelligence report, the gang would be very pleased.
translation: 当然，我对凤凰帮的交易一无所知，但我敢打赌，如果有人给乔尼制造点意外，并把他的情报报告带回来，帮派一定会很高兴。

english: I see... I'm sure I can help sort something out for them. I'll get right on it.
translation: 我明白了……我肯定能帮他们解决这件事。我马上去办。

english: I want nothing. I was just making sure you were them.
translation: 我什么都不想要。我只是确认一下你们是不是他们。

english: Well then get lost and stop wasting my time.
translation: 那就滚开，别浪费我时间。

english: How do I get a job with the VTAM corporation?
translation: 我怎么才能得到VTAM公司的工作？

english: Get a copy of the Varrock Herald. If we have any positions right now, they'll be advertised in there.
translation: 去买一份《维洛克城先驱报》。如果我们现在有职位空缺，都会登在上面。

english: How's your little mission going?
translation: 你的小任务进行得怎么样了？

english: I don't have it yet...
translation: 我还没拿到……

english: Jonny the Beard is the person who has it. I imagine he will be in the Blue Moon Inn... Not that I'd know for sure, with me definitely not being a member of the Phoenix Gang and all.
translation: 胡子乔尼拿着那东西。我想他会在蓝月旅馆……当然我不确定，毕竟我绝对不是凤凰帮的成员什么的。

english: I have the intelligence report!
translation: 我拿到情报报告了！

english: Let's see it then.
translation: 那就让我看看。

english: Let me go get it from the bank.
translation: 让我去银行取来。

english: I'll wait here.
translation: 我在这儿等着。

english: Very good... Very good... Okay, I'm satisfied. Welcome to the Phoenix Gang! I'm Straven, one of the gang leaders.
translation: 很好……很好……好了，我满意了。欢迎加入凤凰帮！我是斯特拉文，帮派头目之一。

english: Nice to meet you. I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴认识你。我是[player name]。

english: As a member of our gang, you now have access to our hideout and our weapons supply depot. The hideout is just through this door and the depot is two doors down from here. You'll need this key to get in.
translation: 作为我们帮派的成员，你现在可以进入我们的藏身处和武器补给仓库。藏身处就在这扇门后面，仓库在往前走两扇门。你需要这把钥匙才能进去。

english: Once again, welcome to the Phoenix Gang!
translation: 再次欢迎你加入凤凰帮！

english: Greetings, fellow gang member.
translation: 你好啊，帮派兄弟。

english: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place.
translation: 我听说你们这儿有些很酷的宝藏。

english: Oh yeah, we've all stolen some stuff in our time. Our candlesticks down here, for example, were quite a challenge to get out of the palace.
translation: 哦对，我们这些年都偷过些东西。比如我们这儿的烛台，从王宫里弄出来可费了不少劲。

english: And the Shield of Arrav?
translation: 那阿拉夫之盾呢？

english: Woah... that's a blast from the past! We stole that years and years ago!
translation: 哇……那可是老黄历了！我们很多很多年前偷来的！

english: Truth be told, we don't even have the whole shield anymore. A few years ago there was a big fight within the gang and the shield got broken in half as a result.
translation: 说实话，我们现在连完整的盾都没有了。几年前帮派内部发生了一场大争斗，结果盾被摔成了两半。

english: After the fight, some gang members split off and formed their own group. They took one half of the shield with them.
translation: 争斗之后，一些帮派成员分裂出去，组建了自己的团伙。他们带走了盾的一半。

english: This other group? The Black Arm Gang?
translation: 另一个团伙？黑臂帮？

english: Any suggestions for where I can go thieving?
translation: 有什么地方推荐我去偷窃吗？

english: You could always try the marketplace over in Ardougne. Lots of opportunity there!
translation: 你可以去阿多尼城的市场试试。那里机会多得很！

english: Where's the Black Arm Gang hideout?
translation: 黑臂帮的藏身处在哪里？

english: Interested in spying on the enemy, are you? It will be tricky. Their security is pretty good. Not as good as ours obviously, but still good.
translation: 对刺探敌人感兴趣，是吧？这可不简单。他们的安保相当不错。当然没我们好，但也不错。

english: Still, if you really want to go there, it's down an alleyway near the southern gate. One of our contacts, a tramp going by the name of Charlie, keeps an eye on it. He may be able to help you.
translation: 不过，如果你真想去，那地方在南门附近的一条小巷里。我们有个联系人，一个叫查理的流浪汉，一直在盯着那里。他也许能帮你。

english: I see. Thanks for the help!
translation: 我明白了。谢谢帮忙！

english: I'm afraid I lost that key you gave me...
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的那把钥匙弄丢了……

english: You really need to be more careful. We don't want that key falling into the wrong hands. Have this spare, but don't lose it this time!
translation: 你真得小心点。我们可不想那把钥匙落到坏人手里。这把备用的给你，这次可别再丢了！

english: Hello fellow Phoenix! What are you after?
translation: 你好啊，凤凰帮的兄弟！你想要什么？

english: I'm after a weapon or two.
translation: 我想要一两件武器。

english: No problem. Feel free to look around.
translation: 没问题。随便看看。

english: I'm looking for treasure.
translation: 我在找宝藏。

english: Aren't we all? We've not got any up here. Go mug someone somewhere if you want some treasure.
translation: 谁不是呢？我们这儿可没有。想要宝藏的话，去什么地方抢个人吧。

english: Hey! That's Straven's! He won't like you messing with that!
translation: 嘿！那是斯特拉文的东西！他可不喜欢你乱动！

english: No. You're a collaborator with the Phoenix Gang. There's no way they'll let you join.
translation: 不行。你是凤凰帮的合作者。他们绝不会让你加入的。

english: I've been known to have dealings with the Phoenix Gang. I wouldn't be very good at my job if I didn't know their members.
translation: 众所周知我和凤凰帮有来往。如果我不认识他们的成员，那我的工作就做得太差了。

english: I see. So, any ideas how I could get in there?
translation: 我明白了。那你知道我怎么才能进去吗？

english: Your best bet would probably be to find someone who isn't a member of the Phoenix Gang and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Black Arm Gang for you.
translation: 你最好的办法大概是找个不是凤凰帮成员的人，让他替你去渗透黑臂帮。

english: You've got some guts coming here, Phoenix scum! Get lost, or I'll make sure you haven't got those guts anymore!
translation: 你胆子不小啊，凤凰帮的渣滓！滚开，否则我让你再也硬气不起来！

english: The Phoenix Gang had it. I managed to infiltrate their gang and steal it from them.
translation: 凤凰帮拿着它。我设法潜入了他们的帮派，把它偷了出来。

english: Well, I don't think I'll have much luck infiltrating the Black Arm Gang now that I've joined their rivals, but maybe someone else will be able to.
translation: 嗯，既然我已经加入了他们的对手，我想我没什么运气再去渗透黑臂帮了，但也许别人能做到。

english: Hello there. I'm here about the Shield of Arrav.
translation: 你好。我是为阿拉夫之盾来的。

english: The Shield of Arrav? The Museum has been searching for that for years! The late King Roald II offered a generous reward for its return!
translation: 阿拉夫之盾？博物馆已经找了好多年了！已故的罗尔德国王二世曾为它的归还悬赏了丰厚的报酬！

english: Well, I'm here to claim it.
translation: 嗯，我就是来领取报酬的。

english: You've found the shield? Let's have a look!
translation: 你找到盾了？让我看看！

english: This is incredible! But where's the other half?
translation: 太不可思议了！但另一半呢？

english: I obtained this half from the [Phoenix Gang/Black Arm Gang]. The [Black Arm Gang/Phoenix Gang] might have the other half.
translation: 我从[Phoenix Gang/Black Arm Gang]那里得到了这一半。[Black Arm Gang/Phoenix Gang]可能拿着另一半。

english: That does sound plausible. We will have to hope that another adventurer can recover that half.
translation: 听起来确实有可能。我们只能希望另一位冒险者能找回那一半了。

english: So will I be rewarded for recovering half of the shield?
translation: 那么我找回了一半的盾，会有报酬吗？

english: I'm afraid the reward is for the recovery of the full shield. However, what I'll do is write you out two half- certificates. If another adventurer returns the other shield half, I'll do the same for them.
translation: 恐怕报酬是给找回完整盾牌的人。不过，我可以给你开两张半份证书。如果另一位冒险者归还了另一半盾，我也会同样给他开两张。

english: The two of you can then swap one of the half- certificates to make a full one each. Take that to the King and he will grant you your reward.
translation: 然后你们俩可以交换一张半份证书，这样每人就有一张完整的证书。拿着它去找国王，他就会给你们报酬。

english: I gave you two half-certificates for the half you returned. If another adventurer returns the other shield half, I'll do the same for them.
translation: 你归还了一半，我给了你两张半份证书。如果另一位冒险者归还了另一半盾，我也会同样给他。

english: The two of you can then swap one of the half-certificates to make a full one each. Take that to the King and he will grant you your reward.
translation: 然后你们俩可以交换一张半份证书，这样每人就有一张完整的证书。拿着它去找国王，他就会给你们报酬。

english: Would it be okay to get more half-certificates?
translation: 能再多拿几张半份证书吗？

english: I suppose so. It's not like you can do anything with them without the other half.
translation: 我想可以。反正没有另一半你也做不了什么。

english: I'm here about the Shield of Arrav.
translation: 我是为阿拉夫之盾来的。

english: The Shield of Arrav? Yes, I do recall my father put a reward out for that.
translation: 阿拉夫之盾？是的，我记得我父亲为它悬赏过。

english: Well, I've managed to find half the shield!
translation: 嗯，我找到了盾的一半！

english: You have? Well, before we go any further, you'll need to get the authenticity of the shield verified by the curator at the museum.
translation: 你找到了？好吧，在我们继续之前，你需要让博物馆的馆长验证一下盾的真伪。

english: Okay. I'll head over there.
translation: 好的。我这就过去。

english: I'm afraid that's only half the reward certificate. You'll have to get the other half and join them together if you want to claim the reward.
translation: 恐怕这只是一半的报酬证书。你得拿到另一半，把它们拼在一起，才能领取报酬。

english: My goodness! This is for the reward offered by my father many years ago! I never thought I would live to see the day when someone came forward to claim it!
translation: 天哪！这是我父亲多年前悬赏的报酬！我从没想过有生之年能看到有人来领取它！

english: It was quite the undertaking. I wouldn't have been able to do it without help from a fellow adventurer.
translation: 这可不是件容易的事。没有另一位冒险者的帮助，我根本做不到。

english: Well, in that case, it's only right that you both be rewarded. I will grant half of the reward to you and half to your companion. That means 600 coins for you. Enjoy it! You've very much earned it!
translation: 嗯，既然如此，你们俩都应该得到报酬。我会把一半报酬给你，一半给你的同伴。也就是说，你得到600金币。好好享受吧！这是你应得的！

english: Once one of our most prized possessions.
translation: 曾经是我们最珍贵的财产之一。

english: Once?
translation: 曾经？

english: It seems the Black Arm Gang weren't content with having one half. They recently stole the other half of the shield from us as well!
translation: 看来黑臂帮并不满足于只拥有一半。他们最近还从我们这里偷走了盾的另一半！

english: You are, but don't make me regret it. In case you didn't hear, someone recently stole something very important from us. We need to be more careful about who we let in.
translation: 你确实是，但别让我后悔。你可能没听说，最近有人从我们这里偷走了非常重要的东西。我们得更加小心让谁进来了。

english: Imagine doing something like that!
translation: 居然有人干出这种事！

english: Hmmm. I don't... believe there are any here...
translation: 嗯……我不觉得……这里有什么……

english: Ah yes. I think I have something, if you're definitely interested?
translation: 啊，对。我想我有点东西，如果你真的感兴趣的话？

english: Well if you look in a book called 'The Shield of Arrav', you'll find a quest in there.
translation: 嗯，如果你找一本叫《阿拉夫之盾》的书，里面会有一个任务。

english: Aha! 'The Shield of Arrav'! Exactly what I was looking for.
translation: 啊哈！《阿拉夫之盾》！这正是我要找的。

english: Ok. I've read the book. Do you know where I can find the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 好了，我已经读过那本书了。你知道我在哪里可以找到凤凰帮吗？

english: No, I don't. I think I know someone who might, however.
translation: 不，我不知道。不过我想我认识一个人，他可能知道。

english: If I were you I would talk to Baraek, the fur trader in the market place. I've heard he has connections with the Phoenix Gang.
translation: 如果我是你，我会去和集市上的毛皮商人巴拉克谈谈。我听说他和凤凰帮有关系。

english: Thanks. I'll try that!
translation: 谢谢。我会试试的！

english: Yes, I can understand that. So what do you want with us?
translation: 是的，我能理解。那么你想找我们做什么？

english: How unusual.
translation: 真少见。

english: Normally we recruit for our gang by watching local thugs and thieves in action. People don't normally waltz in here saying 'hello, can I play'.
translation: 通常我们招募帮派成员是通过观察当地暴徒和小偷的行动。一般人可不会大摇大摆走进来说'你好，我能加入吗'。

english: How can I be sure you can be trusted?
translation: 我怎么能确定你值得信任？

english: Thinking about it... I may have a solution actually.
translation: 我想想……其实我可能有个办法。

english: Our rival gang - the Phoenix Gang - has a weapons stash a little east of here.
translation: 我们的敌对帮派——凤凰帮——在这里东边一点有一个武器藏匿点。

english: We're fresh out of crossbows, so if you could steal a couple of crossbows for us it would be very much appreciated.
translation: 我们的弩刚好用完了，所以如果你能为我们偷几把弩来，我们会非常感激。

english: Then I'll be happy to call you a Black Arm.
translation: 那样我就乐意叫你一声黑臂成员了。

english: Sounds simple enough. Any particular reason you need two of them?
translation: 听起来够简单的。有什么特别原因需要两把吗？

english: I have an idea for framing a local merchant who is refusing to pay our, very reasonable, 'keep-your-life-pleasant' insurance rates. I need two phoenix crossbows; one to kill somebody important with and the other to
translation: 我有个主意，要陷害一个拒绝支付我们非常合理的'让你日子好过'保险费的本地商人。我需要两把凤凰弩；一把用来杀死某个重要人物，另一把则

english: hide in the merchant's house where the local law can find it! When they find it, they'll suspect him of murdering the target for the Phoenix Gang and, hopefully, arrest the whole gang! Leaving us as the only
translation: 藏在那个商人的房子里，好让本地执法部门找到它！等他们找到弩，就会怀疑他是为凤凰帮谋杀目标，然后，希望他们能把整个帮派都抓起来！这样我们就成了维洛克城唯一的

english: thieves gang in Varrock! Brilliant, eh?
translation: 维洛克城的盗贼帮！棒极了，是吧？

english: Yeah, brilliant. So who are you planning to murder?
translation: 是啊，绝了。那你打算谋杀谁？

english: I haven't decided yet, but it'll need to be somebody important. Say, why are you being so nosey? You aren't with the law are you?
translation: 我还没决定，但得是某个重要人物。喂，你怎么这么爱打听？你不是和执法部门一伙的吧？

english: No, no! Just curious.
translation: 不，不是！只是好奇。

english: You'd better just keep your mouth shut about this plan, or I'll make sure it stays shut for you. Now, are you going to go get those crossbows or not?
translation: 你最好对这个计划闭嘴，否则我会让你永远闭嘴。现在，你到底去不去拿那些弩？

english: Ok, no problem.
translation: 好，没问题。

english: Great! You'll find the Phoenix gang'sweapon stash just next to a temple, due east of here.
translation: 太好了！你会在这正东方向一座寺庙旁边找到凤凰帮的武器藏匿点。

english: Sounds a little tricky...
translation: 听起来有点棘手……

english: Got anything easier?
translation: 有没有更简单的事？

english: If you're not up to a little bit of danger I don't think you've got anything to offer our gang.
translation: 如果你连一点危险都应付不了，我觉得你对我们帮派没什么用处。

english: Well, people tell me I have an honest face!
translation: 嗯，别人都说我长着一张诚实的脸！

english: ... How unusual. Someone honest wanting to join a gang of thieves. Excuse me if I remain unconvinced.
translation: ……真少见。一个诚实的人想加入盗贼帮派。恕我仍然难以相信。

english: I want some hints for becoming a thief.
translation: 我想要一些成为盗贼的提示。

english: Well, I'm sorry luv, I'm not giving away any of my secrets.
translation: 嗯，抱歉亲爱的，我不会泄露我的任何秘密。

english: Not to people who ain't Black Arm members anyway.
translation: 至少不会给不是黑臂成员的人。

english: Try...the one you just came in?
translation: 试试……你刚进来的那扇门？

english: Is that guy still out there? He's getting to be a nuisance. Remind me to send someone to kill him.
translation: 那家伙还在外面吗？他越来越烦人了。提醒我派人去杀了他。

english: So now you've found us, what do you want?
translation: 那么你现在找到我们了，你想要什么？

english: I thought we were safe back here!
translation: 我还以为我们在这后面很安全呢！

english: Wow! We MUST be obvious! I guess they'll be expecting bribes again soon in that case.
translation: 哇！我们肯定太显眼了！看来他们很快又要来要贿赂了。

english: Is there anything else you want to tell me?
translation: 你还有什么别的事要告诉我吗？

english: A small, family business. We give financial advice to other companies.
translation: 一个小型家族企业。我们为其他公司提供财务建议。

english: And you expect to find it up the back streets of Varrock?
translation: 而你指望在维洛克城的后街找到它？

english: Any idea where the Phoenix gang hideout is?
translation: 知道凤凰帮的藏身处在哪里吗？

english: Sure. I know everything there is to know about this city. I'd be happy to tell you for 10 gold.
translation: 当然。我对这座城市无所不知。我很乐意告诉你，只要10金币。

english: Ok, that sounds fair.
translation: 好，听起来很公平。

english: Oh wait. I haven't got enough, sorry.
translation: 哦等等，我没带够钱，抱歉。

english: Well no pay, no info.
translation: 那没钱就没情报。

english: So where is the hideout then?
translation: 那藏身处到底在哪里？

english: Now listen closely; to get to the Phoenix hideout, walk south from here and take the first road to the east. It's the one with the Blue moon pub on the corner. Take the first alley leading south off of that road and you'll
translation: 现在仔细听：要去凤凰藏身处，从这里往南走，然后走第一条向东的路。就是拐角处有蓝月酒馆的那条。从那条路拐进第一条向南的小巷，你就会

english: find the hideout at the end of that alley. It's called the VTAM corporation.
translation: 在小巷尽头找到藏身处。它叫VTAM公司。

english: VTAM, got it.
translation: VTAM，记住了。

english: Don't worry, I'll find it myself.
translation: 别担心，我自己会找到的。

english: Well you know where to find me if you get lost!
translation: 那如果你迷路了，你知道在哪里能找到我！

english: 10 gold? That's too much, I'll give you 5.
translation: 10金币？太贵了，我给你5金币。

english: If you pay me the other 5 gold, I'll tell you.
translation: 如果你把另外5金币付给我，我就告诉你。

english: You theiving gutter-scum! You'd better watch your back!
translation: 你这偷窃的街沟渣滓！你最好小心点！

english: I think I know where the hideout is, but I can't get inside. Any ideas?
translation: 我想我知道藏身处在哪里，但我进不去。有什么办法吗？

english: Your best bet would probably be to find someone else... Someone who ISN'T a member of the Black Arm Gang, and get them to infiltrate the ranks of the Phoenix Gang for you.
translation: 你最可能成功的办法大概是找另一个人……一个不是黑臂帮成员的人，让他为你渗透进凤凰帮。

english: No, I haven't yet found them.
translation: 不，我还没找到他们。

english: I need two crossbows stolen from the Phoenix Gang weapons stash, which if you head east for a bit, is a building on the south side of the road.
translation: 我需要两把从凤凰帮武器藏匿点偷来的弩，你往东走一点，在路南侧有一栋建筑就是那里。

english: Come back when you got 'em.
translation: 拿到手再回来。

english: I need two. Come back when you have them.
translation: 我需要两把。拿到手再回来。

english: Ok. You can join our gang now. Feel free to enter any of the rooms of the ganghouse.
translation: 好了。你现在可以加入我们帮派了。可以随意进入帮派屋的任何房间。

english: I've got this half of the shield in my bank already.
translation: 我已经把这半面盾放在我的银行里了。

english: You stay away from here! Black Arm dog!
translation: 你离远点！黑臂狗！

english: Yes. I'd like to be 20 gold coins richer.
translation: 是的。我想多赚20金币。

english: Hey! You can't go in there. Only authorised personnel of the VTAM Corporation are allowed beyond this point.
translation: 嘿！你不能进去。只有VTAM公司授权人员才能进入此区域。

english: Who are we then?
translation: 那我们是谁？

english: This is the headquarters of the Phoenix Gang, the most powerful crime syndicate this city has ever seen!
translation: 这里是凤凰帮的总部，是这座城市有史以来最强大的犯罪集团！

english: No, this is a legitimate business run by legitimate businessmen.
translation: 不，这是由合法商人经营的合法生意。

english: Supposing we were this crime gang however, what would you want with us?
translation: 不过，假如我们就是这个犯罪团伙，你找我们有什么事？

english: You mean you'd like to join the Phoenix Gang?
translation: 你的意思是你想加入凤凰帮？

english: Well, obviously I can't speak for them, but the Phoenix Gang doesn't let people join just like that.
translation: 嗯，显然我不能替他们说话，但凤凰帮不会就这么让人加入。

english: You can't be too careful, you understand.
translation: 再怎么小心也不为过，你明白的。

english: Generally someone has to prove their loyalty before they can join.
translation: 通常人们需要证明自己的忠诚才能加入。

english: Obviously, I would have no idea about that.
translation: 当然，我对此一无所知。

english: Although having said that, a rival gang of ours, er, theirs, called the Black Arm Gang is supposedly meeting a contact from Port Sarim today in the Blue Moon Inn.
translation: 不过话虽如此，我们的一个敌对帮派，呃，他们的敌对帮派，叫黑臂帮，据说今天要在蓝月酒馆会见一个来自沙林港的联系人。

english: The Blue Moon Inn is just by the south entrance to this city, and supposedly the name of the contact is Jonny the Beard.
translation: 蓝月酒馆就在这座城市的南入口附近，据说那个联系人名叫胡子乔尼。

english: OBVIOUSLY I know NOTHING about the dealings of the Phoenix Gang, but I bet if SOMEBODY were to kill him and bring back his intelligence report, they would be considered loyal enough to join.
translation: 显然我对凤凰帮的交易一无所知，但我敢打赌，如果有人杀了他并带回他的情报报告，那个人就会被认为足够忠诚而得以加入。

english: Ok, I'll get right on it.
translation: 好，我马上去办。

english: Well, then get lost and stop wasting my time.
translation: 那你就滚蛋吧，别浪费我的时间。

english: ...if you know what's good for you.
translation: ……如果你知道好歹的话。

english: Sorry. That's classified information.
translation: 抱歉。那是机密信息。

english: I haven’t managed to find the report yet…
translation: 我还没能找到那份报告……

english: You need to kill Jonny the Beard, who should be in the Blue Moon Inn.
translation: 你需要杀了胡子乔尼，他应该在蓝月酒馆里。

english: ...I would guess. Not being a member of the Phoenix Gang and all.
translation: ……我猜是这样。毕竟我不是凤凰帮成员什么的。

english: Let me go get it.
translation: 让我去拿吧。

english: Yes. Yes, this is very good. Very well, then! You can join the Phoenix Gang! I am Straven, one of the gang leaders.
translation: 是的。是的，这非常好。很好，那么！你可以加入凤凰帮了！我是斯特拉文，帮派领袖之一。

english: Nice to meet you.
translation: 很高兴见到你。

english: You now have access to the inner sanctum of our subterranean hideout, and our weapons supply depot round the front of this building.
translation: 你现在可以进入我们地下藏身处的内殿，以及这栋建筑前面的武器供应库。

english: Greetings fellow gang member.
translation: 你好，帮派兄弟。

english: I've heard you've got some cool treasures in this place...
translation: 我听说你们这地方有些很酷的宝藏……

english: Oh yeah, we've all stolen some stuff in our time. Those candlesticks down here, for example, were quite a challenge to get out of the palace.
translation: 哦对，我们这些年偷过不少东西。比如下面那些烛台，从王宫里弄出来可费了不少劲。

english: And the shield of Arrav? I heard you got that!
translation: 还有阿拉夫之盾？我听说你们弄到手了！

english: Woah... that's a blast from the past! We stole that years and years ago! We don't even have all the shield anymore.
translation: 哇……那可是老黄历了！我们很多很多年前偷来的！现在我们连完整的盾都没有了。

english: About five years ago we had a massive fight in our gang and the shield got broken in half during that fight.
translation: 大约五年前，我们帮派内部发生了一场大斗殴，盾在那场斗殴中被摔成了两半。

english: Shortly after that fight some gang members decided they didn't want to be part of our gang anymore. So they split off to form their own gang.
translation: 那场斗殴后不久，一些帮派成员决定不再留在我们帮派。于是他们分裂出去，成立了他们自己的帮派。

english: The Black Arm Gang.
translation: 黑臂帮。

english: On their way out they looted what treasures they could from us - which included one of the halves of the shield. We've been rivals with the Black Arms ever since.
translation: 他们离开时从我们这里掠走了能拿走的财宝——其中包括盾的一半。从那以后我们就一直和黑臂帮是死对头。

english: You can always try the marketplace in Ardougne. LOTS of opportunity there!
translation: 你随时可以去阿多尼城的集市试试。那里机会多的是！

english: Where's the Black Arm Gang hideout? I wanna go sabotage 'em!
translation: 黑臂帮的藏身处在哪里？我想去搞破坏！

english: That would be a little tricky; their security is pretty good.
translation: 那有点棘手；他们的安保做得很好。

english: Not as good as ours, obviously.
translation: 显然没我们的好。

english: But still good.
translation: 不过还是不错的。

english: If you really want to go there, it's in the alleyway to the west as you come in the south gate.
translation: 如果你真想去，从南门进来后，在西边的巷子里。

english: One of our operatives is often near the alley - a red haired tramp, goes by the name of Charlie. He may be able to give you some ideas.
translation: 我们有个特工常在那巷子附近——一个红头发的流浪汉，名叫查理。他或许能给你些主意。

english: I'm afraid I've lost the key you gave me.
translation: 恐怕我把你给我的钥匙弄丢了。

english: You really need to be more careful. We don't want that key falling into the wrong hands. Ah well... Have this spare. Don't lose THIS one.
translation: 你真得小心点。我们可不想那把钥匙落入坏人手里。唉，算了…给你这把备用的。别再弄丢了。

english: Hey! That's Stravens'! He won't like you messing with that!
translation: 嘿！那是斯特雷文斯的东西！他可不喜欢你乱动！

english: You've got some guts coming here, Phoenix guy!
translation: 你胆子不小啊，凤凰帮的家伙！

english: Now get lost!
translation: 快滚吧！

english: Or I'll make sure you 'aven't got those guts anymore!
translation: 不然我就让你没那个胆了！

english: I have half the shield of Arrav here. Can I get a reward?
translation: 我这里有阿拉夫之盾的一半。能拿到奖励吗？

english: The Shield of Arrav! Goodness, the Museum has been searching for that for years! The late King Roald II offered a reward for it years ago!
translation: 阿拉夫之盾！天啊，博物馆已经找了它好多年了！已故的罗尔德国王二世多年前就悬赏过它！

english: This is incredible!
translation: 太不可思议了！

english: That shield has been missing for over twenty-five years!
translation: 那面盾牌已经失踪超过二十五年了！

english: Leave the shield here with me and I'll write you out a certificate saying that you have returned the shield, so that you can claim your reward from the King.
translation: 把盾留在我这里，我给你写张证书，证明你已经归还了盾，这样你就能去向国王领取奖励。

english: Can I have two certificates please?
translation: 能给我两张证书吗？

english: Of course you won't actually be able to claim the reward with only half the reward certificates...
translation: 当然，你只有一半的奖励证书可领不到奖励...

english: What? I went through a lot of trouble to get that shield piece and now you tell me it was for nothing? That's not very fair!
translation: 什么？我费了好大劲才拿到这块盾牌，你现在告诉我这没用？这也太不公平了吧！

english: Well, if you were to get me the other half of the shield, I could give you the other half of the reward certificate. It's rumoured to be in the possession of the infamous BlackarmGang, beyond that I can't help you.
translation: 嗯，如果你能给我找到盾的另一半，我就给你另一半奖励证书。传闻那半块在臭名昭著的黑臂帮手里，其他的我就帮不了你了。

english: Your majesty, I have recovered the Shield of Arrav; I would like to claim the reward.
translation: 陛下，我找回了阿拉夫之盾，我想领取奖励。

english: The Shield of Arrav, eh? Yes, I do recall my father, King Roald, put a reward out for that.
translation: 阿拉夫之盾，嗯？是的，我记得我父亲罗尔德国王曾悬赏过它。

english: If you get the authenticity of the shield verified by the curator at the museum and then return here with authentication, I will grant you your reward.
translation: 如果你让博物馆馆长验证了盾的真伪，然后带着认证回来，我就给你奖励。

english: Your majesty, I have come to claim the reward for the return of the Shield Of Arrav.
translation: 陛下，我是来领取归还阿拉夫之盾的奖励的。

english: My goodness! This claim is for the reward offered by my father many years ago!
translation: 我的天！这是要领取我父亲多年前悬赏的奖励！

english: I never thought I would live to see the day when someone came forward to claim this reward!
translation: 我从没想过能活着看到有人来领取这个奖励！

english: I heard that you found half the shield, so I will give you half of the bounty. That comes to exactly 600gp!
translation: 我听说你找到了盾的一半，所以我给你一半的赏金。正好600金币！

english: Run! Run for your life! Save yourself! I'll keep them back as long as I can...
translation: 快跑！快逃命吧！保住小命！我会尽量拖住它们……

english: Why do I need to run?
translation: 我为什么要跑？

english: Your very life is in danger. Rashiliyia has returned and we are all doomed.
translation: 你的小命危在旦夕。拉希利娅回来了，我们都完蛋了。

english: Rashiliyia? Who is she?
translation: 拉希利娅？她是谁？

english: Rashiliyia is the Queen of the dead. She has returned and has brought a plague of undead with her. They now occupy our village and we have them trapped. I warn people like yourself to stay away.
translation: 拉希利娅是亡灵女王。她回来了，还带来了一场亡灵瘟疫。它们现在占领了我们的村庄，我们暂时把它们困住了。我警告像你这样的人离远点。

english: What can we do?
translation: 我们能做些什么？

english: We're doing all we can to keep the undead at bay. The village is covered in a deadly green mist. If you go into the village, a terrible sickness will befall you.
translation: 我们正在尽一切努力阻止亡灵蔓延。整个村庄笼罩在致命的绿色迷雾中。如果你进入村庄，就会染上可怕的疾病。

english: And the undead are even stronger beyond the gates. My guess is that it has something to do with the Legend of Rashiliyia.
translation: 而且大门外的亡灵更加强大。我猜这跟拉希利娅的传说有关。

english: But you would need to talk to the Shaman in Tai Bwo Wannai village to get more details about that. I really have to go now and fight these undead.
translation: 但你需要去泰博瓦纳村找萨满谈谈，才能了解更多细节。我现在真的得去对付这些亡灵了。

english: Why are the undead here?
translation: 为什么亡灵会在这里？

english: Rashiliyia! The Queen of the undead has risen! She is the mother of the undead creatures that roam this land. But alas I know nothing of the legend that surrounds her.
translation: 拉希利娅！亡灵女王复活了！她是游荡在这片土地上所有亡灵生物的母亲。但可惜我对围绕她的传说一无所知。

english: Legend you say?
translation: 你说传说？

english: Yes.... I said it is a legend that I know nothing about.
translation: 是的……我说了这是一个我一无所知的传说。

english: Oh, Ok, sorry for bothering you.
translation: 哦，好吧，抱歉打扰你了。

english: Ok, perhaps you'd like to be on your way now?
translation: 好吧，你现在是不是该上路了？

english: Oh come on, you must know something?
translation: 哦，别这样，你肯定知道些什么吧？

english: Well, let me think now...
translation: 嗯，让我想想……

english: Hmmm, there was something I think that might help...
translation: 嗯，我记得好像有点什么能帮上忙……

english: Nope, sorry. It's gone.
translation: 不，抱歉。想不起来了。

english: Maybe you know someone who does know something?
translation: 也许你认识知道些什么的人？

english: My guess is that this has something to do with the legend of Rashiliyia. But you need to speak to the Shaman in 'Tai Bwo Wannai' village to get more details about that.
translation: 我猜这跟拉希利娅的传说有关。但你需要去'泰博瓦纳村'找萨满谈谈，才能了解更多细节。

english: I really have to fight these undead now Bwana, before they take over the world!
translation: 我现在真的得去对付这些亡灵了，先生，在它们占领世界之前！

english: I'll go to see the Shaman.
translation: 我去见萨满。

english: Well, that would be helpful Bwana. If you're sure you want to go, you can take a Wampum belt to him for me. It will give the Shaman, Trufitus the story of our problems down here. Are you sure you want to go?
translation: 嗯，那会有帮助的，先生。如果你确定要去，可以帮我把一条贝壳串珠腰带带给他。这会让萨满特鲁菲图斯了解我们这里的情况。你确定要去吗？

english: Errr, I'm having second thoughts now.
translation: 呃，我现在有点犹豫了。

english: That's Ok Bwana, it's a big responsibility. Come back and see me if you change your mind.
translation: 没关系，先生，这是个重大的责任。如果你改变主意了，再回来找我。

english: Yes, I'm sure and I'll take the Wampum belt to Trufitus.
translation: 是的，我确定，我会把贝壳串珠腰带带给特鲁菲图斯。

english: I would be very grateful if you did. Here take this...
translation: 如果你这样做，我会非常感激。拿着这个……

english: Please can you give it to Trufitus. He may be able to give you extra details on the legend surrounding Rashiliyia. Good luck!
translation: 请把它交给特鲁菲图斯。他也许能告诉你更多关于拉希利娅传说的细节。祝你好运！

english: Ok. Thanks for your help.
translation: 好的。谢谢你的帮助。

english: You're welcome Bwana, good luck.
translation: 不客气，先生，祝你好运。

english: Sorry, but I don't think this is something that I can help with at the moment!
translation: 抱歉，但我觉得这件事我现在帮不上忙！

english: Ok, I understand Bwana! You may as well be on your way then.
translation: 好吧，我理解，先生！那你还是上路吧。

english: Can I help in any way?
translation: 我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: I don't think so Bwana, but you may want to consult with Trufitus the Shaman in Tai Bwo Wannai village, he may have some information which could help.
translation: 我觉得不行，先生，但你可以去泰博瓦纳村咨询一下萨满特鲁菲图斯，他可能有一些能帮上忙的信息。

english: Uh, it sounds nasty, just the kind of thing I want to avoid!
translation: 呃，听起来很糟糕，正是我想避开的那种事！

english: Quite right, Bwana, please make all haste! Before your spine turns to water as we speak.
translation: 说得对，先生，请尽快！免得你的脊梁骨在咱们说话的功夫就化成水了。

english: What danger is there around here?
translation: 这里有什么危险？

english: Can you not see Bwana? This whole area is infested with the living dead.
translation: 你没看见吗，先生？这整个地区都充满了行尸走肉。

english: Arrggghhh, here are some now!
translation: 啊啊啊，它们来了！

english: Rahhhhh! OOoohhhhhh!
translation: 哇啊啊！哦哦哦哦！

english: Prepare to go to the other side!
translation: 准备去另一边吧！

english: Yeah... Ok, I'm running!
translation: 好吧……我跑！

english: God speed to you my friend.
translation: 愿神保佑你，我的朋友。

english: I am Mosol Rei, I am a Jungle Warrior. I used to live in this village, but it is too dangerous for you to stay around here.
translation: 我是莫索尔.雷，一名丛林战士。我以前住在这个村子里，但这里太危险了，你不能待在这里。

english: Mosol Rei, that's a nice name.
translation: 莫索尔.雷，这名字不错。

english: Thanks, but you really should leave.
translation: 谢谢，但你真该走了。

english: Well, if you go to see the Shaman, please give him that Wampum belt I gave to you, it will give him more details about our situation down here.
translation: 嗯，如果你去见萨满，请把我给你的那条贝壳串珠腰带交给他，它会让他更了解我们这里的情况。

english: That's great Bwana, if you give Trufitus the Wampum belt I gave you, it will give him more details of our current situation.
translation: 太好了，先生，如果你把我给你的贝壳串珠腰带交给特鲁菲图斯，他会更了解我们目前的处境。

english: Hello Bwana, this message from Mosol Rei bears bad news... Yes, things do look very bad indeed.
translation: 你好，布瓦纳，莫索尔.雷传来的消息是坏消息……是的，情况确实看起来非常糟糕。

english: What do you know about Rashiliyia?
translation: 你知道拉希利娅的什么事吗？

english: Hmmm, it's been a long time since I heard that name. Rashiliyia is the Queen of the Undead. And a more fearsome enemy you will be unlikely to find.
translation: 嗯，我很久没听到那个名字了。拉希利娅是亡灵女王。你很难找到比她更可怕的敌人了。

english: I fear that you bring me news that she has returned to plague us once again? Alas I know of no weakness that she has.
translation: 恐怕你带来的消息是她又回来祸害我们了？可惜我不知道她有什么弱点。

english: So there is nothing we can do?
translation: 那我们什么都做不了了吗？

english: Oh, ok!
translation: 哦，好吧！

english: Yes, it's a bit sad really, I liked that village.
translation: 是啊，真有点难过，我挺喜欢那个村子的。

english: Well, I hope you will excuse me, but I need to get back to my studies.
translation: 嗯，希望你能原谅我，但我得回去继续研究了。

english: Should I start to evacuate the island?
translation: 我应该开始疏散岛上的人吗？

english: Yes, that may be a good idea. Many people could die! If only there was a way to defeat her!
translation: 是的，那可能是个好主意。很多人可能会死！要是有办法打败她就好了！

english: Mosol Rei said something about a legend?
translation: 莫索尔.雷提到了一个传说？

english: Ah, yes, there is a legend, but it is lost in the midst of antiquity...
translation: 啊，是的，有一个传说，但它早已失传在远古之中……

english: The last place to hold any details regarding this mystery was in the temple of Ah Za Rhoon....and that has long since vanished... it crumbled into dust...
translation: 最后一个记载这个谜团细节的地方是阿扎隆神庙……而它早已消失……化为尘土……

english: Why was it called Ah Za Rhoon?
translation: 为什么叫阿扎隆？

english: It is from an ancient language. The direct translation is... 'Magnificence floating on water'. But my research makes me believe that the temple was built on land.
translation: 这来自一种古老的语言。直接翻译过来就是……'漂浮在水上的宏伟建筑'。但我的研究让我相信这座神庙是建在陆地上的。

english: And most likely between large bodies of water, for example large lakes. However, many people have searched for the temple, and have failed. I would hate to see you waste your time on a pointless search like that.
translation: 而且很可能是在大片水域之间，比如大湖。然而，很多人寻找过这座神庙，都失败了。我不想看到你把时间浪费在这样无意义的搜索上。

english: About Ah Za Rhoon and where it is.
translation: 关于阿扎隆和它的位置。

english: Hmmm, well, you are welcome bwana.
translation: 嗯，好吧，不客气，先生。

english: Do you know anything more about the temple?
translation: 你对这座神庙还有什么了解吗？

english: Not much... I would say that is about it...
translation: 不多了……我想就这些了……

english: Even the great priest Zadimus who built the temple did not survive. Some say that Rashiliyia caused the temple to collapse.
translation: 就连建造这座神庙的伟大祭司扎迪姆斯也没能幸存。有人说拉希利娅导致了神庙的倒塌。

english: She was angry at Zadimus for not returning her affections. She was a great sorceress even before they met.
translation: 她因为扎迪姆斯没有回应她的爱意而愤怒。在他们相遇之前，她就已经是一位强大的女巫了。

english: I don't know anymore. You're very demanding aren't you!
translation: 我不知道更多了。你还真会问，不是吗！

english: I am going to search for Ah Za Rhoon!
translation: 我要去寻找阿扎鲁恩！

english: What?! You must be crazy! That place has passed into myth and legend, it has been buried under rubble for years. It's most likely buried 20 men deep, and that's if you can actually find it.
translation: 什么？！你疯了吧！那个地方已经成了神话传说，被埋在瓦砾下多年了。很可能埋得有二十个人那么深，前提是你真能找到它。

english: Are you sure you're going to go and look for it? I may be able to do some research into this if you agree. Only I don't want to waste my time if you're not serious about this!
translation: 你确定要去找它吗？如果你同意，我或许可以做一些研究。但如果你不是认真的，我可不想浪费时间！

english: Yes, I will seriously look for Ah Za Rhoon and I'd appreciate your help.
translation: 是的，我会认真寻找阿扎鲁恩，而且很感激你的帮助。

english: Ok then Bwana, good luck with your quest, and remember to stock up well with adventuring supplies before setting off. You never know how useful some fairly ordinary things might be when you're
translation: 那好吧，先生，祝你的任务好运，记住出发前要备足冒险补给品。你永远不知道一些相当普通的东西在冒险时会有多有用。

english: adventuring.
translation: 冒险。

english: I'll hold on to this Wampum belt for you for the time being. I'll give it back to you when we have completed this quest.
translation: 这条贝壳串珠腰带我先替你保管。等我们完成这个任务后再还给你。

english: Actually, now it comes to it, I'm having second thoughts.
translation: 实际上，事到临头，我又有点犹豫了。

english: Well, I understand. Perhaps you can search for it another time? Come back when you think you're ready. Excuse me now won't you while I return to my studies.
translation: 好吧，我理解。也许你可以改天再找？等你觉得自己准备好了再回来。现在请原谅，我要回去学习了。

english: It's a pity that I can't search for Ah Za Rhoon now.
translation: 真可惜我现在不能去寻找阿扎鲁恩。

english: Are there any traps there?
translation: 那里有陷阱吗？

english: How am I supposed to know? A lot of what I know is most probably wrong but some of it seems right to me. Excuse me but I must get back to my studies.
translation: 我怎么会知道？我知道的很多东西很可能都是错的，但有些似乎又是对的。请原谅，我得回去继续研究了。

english: Will you pack your things now?
translation: 你现在会收拾东西吗？

english: I will wait and see what will happen. Maybe Rashiliyia does not have the power to strike too far from her resting place? But there are many things that I need to do now.
translation: 我会静观其变。也许拉希利娅的力量无法延伸到离她安息之地太远的地方？但我现在有很多事情要做。

english: Is her resting place important?
translation: 她的安息之地很重要吗？

english: I believe it is! It might be that her physical remains are the focal point of her supernatural powers. It is said that many years ago, a group of adventurers once infiltrated her tomb to try to rid the world of Rashiliyia.
translation: 我相信是的！她的遗骸可能是她超自然力量的焦点。据说很多年前，一群冒险者曾潜入她的坟墓，试图消灭拉希利娅。

english: These adventurers reported seeing a wraith- like creature.
translation: 这些冒险者报告说看到了一个幽灵般的生物。

english: Although the adventurers disturbed Rashiliyia's bones, they were not able to properly sanctify them. And this is the most likely reason why she still plagues us today.
translation: 虽然冒险者们扰动了拉希利娅的骸骨，但他们没能正确地净化它们。这很可能就是她至今仍祸害我们的原因。

english: Of course, she only has to order one of her minions to move her bones and she can quite quickly and easily set up a new headquarters anywhere and continue to launch her plague of undead.
translation: 当然，她只需要命令一个手下移动她的骸骨，就能很快轻易地建立一个新的总部，继续发动她的亡灵瘟疫。

english: What are minions?
translation: 什么是手下？

english: Minions are the fiendish undead creatures that she controls. She has very few living worshippers, but they need to be dealt with at some point.
translation: 手下就是她控制的那些邪恶的亡灵生物。她活着的信徒很少，但迟早需要对付他们。

english: Does she have any weaknesses?
translation: 她有什么弱点吗？

english: I am not sure, but the legend about her certainly is long. It's a pity that the temple of Ah Za Rhoon has crumbled as there may be some clues that could help us to defeat her.
translation: 我不确定，但关于她的传说确实很长。可惜阿扎鲁恩神庙已经倒塌了，那里也许有能帮我们打败她的线索。

english: I think the largest problem will be in locating her resting place.
translation: 我认为最大的问题在于找到她的安息之地。

english: What are onions?
translation: 什么是洋葱？

english: Surely you mean Minions?
translation: 你肯定是指手下吧？

english: Yes of course, I mean Minions, what made you think I said Onions?
translation: 是的，当然，我是说手下，你怎么会觉得我说的是洋葱？

english: Minions are the fiendish undead creatures that Rashiliyia controls. She has very few living worshippers, but they need to be dealt with at some point.
translation: 手下就是拉希利娅控制的那些邪恶的亡灵生物。她活着的信徒很少，但迟早需要对付他们。

english: Usually a strong creature of some sort will be guarding the bones and it is not to be tackled lightly.
translation: 通常会有某种强大的生物看守着这些骨头，可不能掉以轻心。

english: Hello Bwana, how goes your quest to find Ah Za Rhoon?
translation: 你好，先生，你寻找阿扎鲁恩的进展如何？

english: Well thanks...
translation: 嗯，谢谢……

english: Well that's very good news. Let me know if you find anything useful, I may be able to help out.
translation: 那真是好消息。如果你发现什么有用的东西，告诉我，我或许能帮上忙。

english: Erm, I don't know where to look?
translation: 呃，我不知道该去哪里找？

english: Hmm, that doesn't surprise me. The only information I have refers to its name. Ah Za Rhoon, its name means 'Magnificence Floating on Water'.
translation: 嗯，这倒不意外。我掌握的唯一信息就是它的名字。阿扎鲁恩，它的名字意思是‘水上漂浮的壮丽’。

english: Do you think it was floating on water?
translation: 你觉得它真的是浮在水上的吗？

english: It's very doubtful. I suspect it was built to 'appear' as if it was floating on water. Perhaps on an island or between large bodies of water.
translation: 这很值得怀疑。我怀疑它是被建造成‘看起来’像浮在水上。也许是在一座岛上，或者是在大片水域之间。

english: If you search for somewhere like this, you may find something worth investigating.
translation: 如果你搜索类似这样的地方，可能会找到值得调查的东西。

english: Ok thanks for your help.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。

english: You're welcome Bwana, I only hope it helped.
translation: 不客气，先生，我只希望这能帮上忙。

english: I'm sorry Bwana but I just don't have a use for that!
translation: 抱歉，先生，但我实在用不上那个！

english: It looks very dangerous, and dark... Scary!
translation: 看起来非常危险，而且很暗……好吓人！

english: ** Gulp! **
Oops! Not enough wood left to do anything else with the table!
translation: 哎呀！剩下的木材不够用来对桌子做其他事了！

english: Weeeeeeee!
translation: 呜呼——！

english: * Uh oh! *
translation: * 哎呀！ *

english: Arrgghhhh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！

english: Greetings...
translation: 你好……

english: Greetings Bwana, you have been away! The situation with Rashiliyia is worsening! I pray that you have some good news for me.
translation: 你好，先生，你离开好久了！拉希利娅的情况越来越糟！我祈祷你能给我带来一些好消息。

english: I think I found the temple of Ah Za Rhoon.
translation: 我想我找到了阿扎鲁恩的神庙。

english: Well that sounds great Bwana. Tell me, what did you find?
translation: 那听起来不错，先生。告诉我，你发现了什么？

english: I need help with Bervirius.
translation: 我需要关于贝维里乌斯的帮助。

english: Bervirius is the son of Rashiliyia. His tomb may hold some clues as to how Rashiliyia may be defeated.
translation: 贝维里乌斯是拉希利娅的儿子。他的墓穴里可能有一些线索，能告诉我们如何击败拉希利娅。

english: I have some items that I need help with.
translation: 我有一些物品需要帮忙。

english: Well, just let me see the item and I'll help as much as I can.
translation: 好吧，让我看看那件物品，我会尽力帮忙。

english: We need to identify that the place you have found is indeed Ah Za Rhoon.
translation: 我们需要确认你找到的地方确实是阿扎鲁恩。

english: Any scrolls or information about Rashiliyia's kin would be helpful.
translation: 任何关于拉希利娅亲属的卷轴或信息都会很有帮助。

english: Have you got any items concerning Rashiliyia? If so, please show me them.
translation: 你有关于拉希利娅的物品吗？如果有，请给我看看。

english: There must be something relating to Zadimus at the temple. Did you find anything? If so, let me see it.
translation: 神庙里一定有与扎迪姆斯相关的东西。你找到了什么吗？如果有，让我看看。

english: And best of luck!
translation: 祝你好运！

english: I need help with Zadimus.
translation: 我需要关于扎迪姆斯的帮助。

english: Zadimus is a spirit yearning for freedom. Bury him in a sacred place to release his spirit.
translation: 扎迪姆斯是一个渴望自由的灵魂。把他埋葬在一个神圣的地方，以释放他的灵魂。

english: Is there any sacred ground around here?
translation: 这附近有神圣的土地吗？

english: The ground in the centre of the village is very sacred to us. Maybe you could try there?
translation: 村子中央的土地对我们来说非常神圣。也许你可以试试那里？

english: You're quite welcome Bwana.
translation: 不客气，先生。

english: I need help with Rashiliyia.
translation: 我需要关于拉希利娅的帮助。

english: We need to find Rashiliyia's resting place and learn how to put her spirit to rest. You may find some clues to her resting place in Ah Za Rhoon or Bervirius' Tomb.
translation: 我们需要找到拉希利娅的安息之地，并学会如何让她的灵魂安息。你可能会在阿扎鲁恩或贝维里乌斯的墓穴中找到她安息之地的线索。

english: I need some help with the Temple of Ah Za Rhoon.
translation: 我需要一些关于阿扎鲁恩神庙的帮助。

english: If you have found the temple, you should search it thoroughly and see if there are any clues about Rashiliyia.
translation: 如果你找到了神庙，你应该彻底搜索一下，看看有没有关于拉希利娅的线索。

english: ! GASP ! That's incredible, where did you find it?
translation: ！倒吸一口凉气！太不可思议了，你在哪里找到的？

english: I found the corpse in a decomposing gallows. I get a very strange feeling every time I try to bury the body.
translation: 我在一个腐朽的绞刑架上找到了这具尸体。每次我试图埋葬这具尸体时，都有一种非常奇怪的感觉。

english: Hmmm, that sounds very strange. I sense a spirit in torment, you should try to bury the remains.
translation: 嗯，听起来很奇怪。我感觉到一个受折磨的灵魂，你应该试着埋葬这些遗骸。

english: Can you dispose of this for me?
translation: 你能帮我处理掉这个吗？

english: I dare not touch it. I am a spiritual man and the spirit of this being may possess me and turn me into a minion of Rashiliyia.
translation: 我不敢碰它。我是一个有灵性的人，这个存在的灵魂可能会附身于我，把我变成拉希利娅的爪牙。

english: Can you decipher this please?
translation: 你能帮我解读这个吗？

english: This is an ancient artefact!
translation: 这是一件古代文物！

english: I can certainly try! Hmm, incredible, it seems very ancient and mentions something about Zadimus and Ah Za Rhoon. It says, 'Here lies the traitor Zadimus, let his spirit be forever tormented'.
translation: 我当然可以试试！嗯，不可思议，它看起来非常古老，提到了扎迪姆斯和阿扎鲁恩。上面写着，‘叛徒扎迪姆斯长眠于此，愿他的灵魂永远受折磨’。

english: If you have found anything else that you need help with, please just let me know.
translation: 如果你还找到了其他需要帮忙的东西，请告诉我。

english: Truly amazing Bwana, this scroll must be ancient. I'm not sure if I get more meaning from it than you though. Perhaps Bervirius' tomb is still accessible?
translation: 真是太神奇了，先生，这卷轴一定很古老。不过我不确定我是否比你从中获得了更多信息。也许贝维里乌斯的墓穴仍然可以进入？

english: Have a look at this, tell me what you think.
translation: 看看这个，告诉我你的想法。

english: I am speechless Bwana, this is truly ancient. Where did you find it?
translation: 我说不出话来，先生，这真是太古老了。你在哪里找到的？

english: In an underground building of some sort.
translation: 在某种地下建筑里。

english: You must truly have found the temple of Ah Za Rhoon! The scroll gives some interesting details about Rashiliyia, some things I didn't know before.
translation: 你一定是真的找到了阿扎鲁恩的神庙！这卷轴提供了一些关于拉希利娅的有趣细节，有些是我以前不知道的。

english: Anything that can help?
translation: 有什么能帮上忙的吗？

english: Hmmm, well just that part about the wards...
translation: 嗯，就是关于结界的那部分……

english: It may be possible to make a ward like that... But what is the best thing to make it from? Perhaps something close to Bervirius, an item of some significance to him.
translation: 也许可以制作一个那样的结界……但用什么来做最好呢？也许是用与贝维里乌斯亲近的东西，一件对他有重要意义的东西。

english: You have released me from my torture, and now I shall aid you. You seek to dispell the one who tortured and killed me. Remember this... 'I am the key, but only kin may approach her.'
translation: 你把我从折磨中解放出来，现在我将帮助你。你试图驱散那个折磨并杀死我的人。记住这句话……‘我就是钥匙，但只有亲属才能接近她。’

english: Could you have a look at this please?
translation: 你能看看这个吗？

english: It looks like a simple shard of bone. Why do you think it is significant?
translation: 看起来像一块简单的骨头碎片。你为什么认为它很重要？

english: It appeared when I buried Zadimus' corpse.
translation: 它是在我埋葬扎迪姆斯的尸体时出现的。

english: Ah, interesting, so you think that Zadimus gave you the bone? What makes you say that?
translation: 啊，有意思，所以你认为扎迪姆斯给了你这块骨头？你为什么这么说？

english: He said something after he gave it to me.
translation: 他把它给我之后说了些什么。

english: The spirit said something about keys and kin?
translation: 那个灵魂说了些关于钥匙和亲属的话？

english: Hmmm, maybe it's a clue of some kind?
translation: 嗯，也许这是某种线索？

english: If you found anything at Ah Za Rhoon that you're not sure of, why not investigate it or show it to me and I'll see what I can make of it.
translation: 如果你在阿扎鲁恩找到了什么不确定的东西，为什么不调查一下，或者拿给我看看，我会看看我能从中得出什么。

english: The spirit rambled on about some nonsense.
translation: 那个灵魂胡言乱语了一些废话。

english: Oh, so it most likely was not very important then.
translation: 哦，那很可能就不太重要了。

english: Oh, right. Come back and talk with me if you get an idea.
translation: 哦，好吧。如果你有想法了，就回来跟我谈谈。

english: No reason really.
translation: 其实没什么理由。

english: Well why are you showing it to me then?
translation: 那你为什么拿给我看呢？

english: I have just buried Zadimus' corpse.
translation: 我刚埋葬了扎迪姆斯的尸体。

english: Something seems different about you. You look like you have seen a ghost?
translation: 你看起来有些不同。你像是见了幽灵一样？

english: It just so happens that I have!
translation: 我确实见了！

english: Oh! So you managed to bury Zadimus's corpse?
translation: 哦！所以你成功埋葬了扎迪姆斯的尸体？

english: Yes, it was pretty grisly!
translation: 是的，相当恐怖！

english: Rashiliyia's only kin was a son, 'Bervirius'. His remains were entombed on a small island which lies to the South West. I will do some research into this to see if I can find any other details.
translation: 拉希利娅唯一的亲属是一个儿子，‘贝维里乌斯’。他的遗骸被安葬在西南方的一个小岛上。我会对此做一些研究，看看是否能找到其他细节。

english: But I think we must take Zadimus' clue literally and get some item that belonged to Bervirius as it may be the only way to approach Rashiliyia. Perhaps something like this exists in his tomb?
translation: 但我认为我们必须按字面意思理解扎迪姆斯的线索，去拿一件属于贝维里乌斯的东西，因为这可能是接近拉希利娅的唯一方法。也许他的墓穴里就有这样的东西？

english: Arrggghhhhhh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！

english: Greetings Bwana, did you find Bervirius' Tomb?
translation: 你好，先生，你找到贝维里乌斯的墓穴了吗？

english: I think I found Bervirius' Tomb.
translation: 我想我找到了贝维里乌斯的墓穴。

english: Congratulations Bwana, show me any items you have found though. I may be able to help.
translation: 恭喜你，先生，不过把你找到的任何物品都给我看看。我或许能帮上忙。

english: I actually need help with something else.
translation: 我其实需要其他方面的帮助。

english: What could I possibly help you with Bwana?
translation: 我还能帮你什么忙呢，先生？

english: I didn't find anything in the tomb.
translation: 我在墓穴里什么都没找到。

english: Maybe you need to look around a little more. There must be some small detail at least that can help us.
translation: 也许你需要再多四处看看。至少应该有一些小细节能帮到我们。

english: No, I didn't find a thing.
translation: 不，我什么都没找到。

english: That is a shame Bwana. We really do need to act against Rashiliyia soon if we are ever to stand a chance of defeating her.
translation: 真可惜，先生。如果我们想有机会击败拉希利娅，我们真的需要尽快采取行动。

english: Actually I did find the tomb, I was just joking.
translation: 其实我确实找到了墓穴，我只是在开玩笑。

english: Well, Bwana, this is no laughing matter. We need to take this very seriously and act now! If you have found any items at the tomb that you need help with please let me see them and I will help as much as I can.
translation: 好吧，先生，这可不是开玩笑的事。我们需要非常认真地对待这件事，并立即行动！如果你在墓穴里找到了任何需要帮忙的物品，请让我看看，我会尽力帮忙。

english: It is a very nice item Bwana. It may be just what you need to gain access to Rashiliyia's tomb. While you were away, I did some research.
translation: 这是一件非常好的物品，先生。这可能正是你进入拉希利娅墓穴所需要的东西。你不在的时候，我做了一些研究。

english: Rashiliyia would spare the lives of those who wore bronze necklaces. This pommel may have some significance to Bervirius. Perhaps you can craft something from it that can help?
translation: 拉希利娅会饶恕那些佩戴青铜项链的人。这个剑柄可能对贝维里乌斯有某种意义。也许你可以用它制作出能帮上忙的东西？

english: My guess is that you will need some protection from Rashiliyia if you intend to enter her tomb!
translation: 我猜，如果你想进入她的墓穴，你需要一些保护来抵御拉希利娅！

english: How do I make a bronze necklace?
translation: 我怎么做一条青铜项链？

english: Well, Bwana, I would guess that you would need to get some bronze metal and work it into something that could be turned into a necklace?
translation: 嗯，先生，我猜你需要弄到一些青铜金属，然后把它加工成可以做成项链的东西？

english: What should I put on the necklace?
translation: 我应该在项链上放什么？

english: Perhaps Zadimus' clue has the answer? Now, what was it that he said again? Something about kin and keys? That sword pommel belonged to Bervirius didn't it?
translation: 也许扎迪姆斯的线索里有答案？那么，他当时说的是什么来着？关于亲属和钥匙？那个剑柄是属于贝维里乌斯的，对吧？

english: You're more than welcome Bwana! Good luck for the rest of your quest.
translation: 不客气，先生！祝你接下来的任务好运。

english: This is incredible Bwana.
translation: 这太不可思议了，先生。

english: Absolutely! This will help you to locate the entrance to Rashiliyia's tomb. Simply activate it when you think you are near, and it should glow different colours to show how near you are.
translation: 当然！这将帮助你找到拉希利娅墓穴的入口。当你觉得接近时，只需激活它，它就会发出不同颜色的光来显示你有多近。

english: Hmm, these notes are quite extraordinary Bwana. They give location details of Rashiliyia's tomb, and some information on how to use the crystal.
translation: 嗯，这些笔记相当不寻常，先生。它们提供了拉希利娅之墓的具体位置，以及如何使用水晶的一些信息。

english: The information is quite specific, North of Ah Za Rhoon! That's a great place to start looking!
translation: 信息非常具体，在阿扎鲁恩的北边！那是个开始寻找的好地方！

english: Take a look at these.
translation: 看看这些。

english: Hmm, very interesting Bwana, your abilities are much more focused than I had initially thought. I presume these are to be part of the ward to protect you from Rashiliyia?
translation: 嗯，非常有趣，先生。你的能力比我最初想象的更加专注。我猜这些是用来保护你免受拉希利娅伤害的防护装置的一部分？

english: This is very impressive Bwana, I'm quite surprised at your ingenuity. This should be a good protection against Rashiliyia if you ever find her Tomb.
translation: 这太令人印象深刻了，先生。我对你的创造力感到惊讶。如果你找到她的墓穴，这应该能很好地保护你免受拉希利娅的伤害。

english: Have a look at this!
translation: 看看这个！

english: This is amazing Bwana, the level of detail is incredible. Where did you find it?
translation: 太棒了，先生。细节程度令人难以置信。你从哪里找到的？

english: I made it from the bone shard that Zadimus gave me.
translation: 我用扎迪姆斯给我的骨片做的。

english: How very inventive Bwana. You must have seen the lock to have crafted it so well. Does the key work?
translation: 真有创意，先生。你一定见过那把锁才能做得这么好。钥匙能用吗？

english: Yes and I explored inside some sort of cavern.
translation: 是的，我在某种洞穴里探索了一番。

english: How interesting Bwana, did you find anything?
translation: 真有意思，先生。你找到什么了吗？

english: Maybe you should go back and try to find some more things.
translation: 也许你应该回去再找找更多的东西。

english: Show me any other items that you may have. We need any clue to locate Rashiliyia's resting place.
translation: 把你可能有的其他物品给我看看。我们需要任何线索来找到拉希利娅的长眠之地。

english: Yes, I found lots of things.
translation: 是的，我找到了很多东西。

english: If you let me see them Bwana, perhaps I can offer you some extra information.
translation: 如果你让我看看它们，先生，也许我能给你提供一些额外信息。

english: I don't know, I haven't tried it yet.
translation: 我不知道，我还没试过。

english: It may be an idea to try it and then scout out the area. If it relates to Rashiliyia, it might help us to defeat her.
translation: 也许可以试试，然后侦察一下那个区域。如果它与拉希利娅有关，可能有助于我们击败她。

english: Do you know what it opens?
translation: 你知道它打开什么吗？

english: You must already know what it opens to have carved it so pefectly. Perhaps in your travels you have come across some unique doors with a unique lock? I hope this helps with your quest.
translation: 你既然能雕得如此完美，一定已经知道它打开什么了。也许你在旅途中遇到过一些带有独特锁的独特门？希望这对你的任务有帮助。

english: Let me squeeze the life from your mortal frame.
translation: 让我从你的凡人躯壳中榨取生命。

english: Which non-kin dares enter my tomb?
translation: 哪个非亲族胆敢进入我的墓穴？

english: My minions will finish thee!
translation: 我的奴仆会了结你！

english: * Gaaaa.... *
I am Nazastarool! Prepare to die!
translation: 我是纳扎斯塔鲁尔！准备受死吧！

english: Quake in fear, for I am reborn!
translation: 在恐惧中颤抖吧，因为我重生了！

english: Your death will be swift.
translation: 你的死将会很快。

english: Nazastarool returns with vengeance!
translation: 纳扎斯塔鲁尔带着复仇归来！

english: Soon you will serve Rashiliyia.
translation: 很快你就要侍奉拉希利娅了。

english: Oh no, I'm going to be stuck in here forever!
translation: 哦不，我要永远被困在这里了！

english: How will I ever get out!
translation: 我怎么才能出去啊！

english: I'm too young to die!
translation: 我还太年轻，不能死！

english: Greetings again Bwana. I hope that you have managed to locate Rashiliyia's Tomb. Again, if you found anything interesting, please show it to me.
translation: 再次问候，先生。我希望你成功找到了拉希利娅之墓。同样，如果你发现了任何有趣的东西，请给我看看。

english: Well Bwana, if you have Rashiliyia's remains, you need to find a way to put her spirit to rest. Perhaps there was a clue with one of the artefacts that you have?
translation: 嗯，先生，如果你有拉希利娅的遗骸，你需要找到一种方法来让她的灵魂安息。也许你拥有的某件神器上有线索？

english: Why not have a look through the artefacts that you have found and see if there is some clue that might help? If you do not have her remains, you will need to find them.
translation: 为什么不翻翻你找到的那些神器，看看有没有什么可能有帮助的线索？如果你没有她的遗骸，你需要找到它们。

english: Could you have a look at this..
translation: 你能看看这个吗……

english: This is truly incredible bwana... So these are the remains of the dread Queen Rashiliyia?
translation: 这真是不可思议，先生……那么这些就是可怕女王拉希利娅的遗骸？

english: Yes, I think so.
translation: 是的，我想是的。

english: What should I do with them?
translation: 我该怎么处理它们？

english: Hmm, I'm not exactly sure... Perhaps there is a clue in one of the artefacts you have found?
translation: 嗯，我不太确定……也许你找到的某件神器里有线索？

english: Can you take them off my hands?
translation: 你能帮我处理掉它们吗？

english: I dare not take them, I may be taken over by the evil spirit of Rashiliyia!
translation: 我不敢拿它们，我可能会被拉希利娅的恶灵附身！

english: You have my gratitude for releasing me, there is still much that needs to be done before Shilo Village is utterly destroyed. Please excuse me, I have plans and people to execute!
translation: 感谢你释放了我，在希洛村被彻底毁灭之前还有很多事要做。请原谅，我有计划要执行，也有人要处决。

english: You have my gratitude for releasing my spirit. I have suffered a vengeful and evil existence. I was tricked by Zamorak. He returned my son to me as an undead creature.
translation: 感谢你释放了我的灵魂。我度过了一段充满复仇和邪恶的存在。我被萨莫拉克欺骗了。他把我的儿子以不死生物的形式还给了我。

english: My hatred and bitterness corrupted me. I tried to destroy all life... now I am released. And am grateful to contemplate eternal rest...
translation: 我的仇恨和痛苦腐蚀了我。我试图毁灭所有生命……现在我解脱了。我很感激能思考永恒的安息……

english: Veliaf? What are you doing here?
translation: 维利亚夫？你怎么在这里？

english: Well met friend. I'm here on an investigation. There's something strange going on in this town, and I suspect the vampyres are involved.
translation: 幸会，朋友。我来这里调查。这个镇子有些不对劲，我怀疑是吸血鬼在搞鬼。

english: Not at the moment. Keep checking in though, I may have need of you soon.
translation: 暂时没有。不过记得常来看看，我可能很快就需要你帮忙了。

english: Well an extra pair of hands is always beneficial. If you have the time of course?
translation: 多一个人手总是好的。当然，如果你有空的话？

english: Actually, I'm a bit busy right now. Maybe later.
translation: 其实我现在有点忙。改天吧。

english: Very well, friend. Myreque prevail.
translation: 好吧，朋友。迈雷克必胜。

english: This town has recently become home to an illness known as the Sleeper Plague. It's a nasty affliction. Those infected fall into a deep sleep, never to wake.
translation: 这个镇子最近出现了一种叫斯莱普瘟疫的疾病。这是一种可怕的病症。感染者会陷入沉睡，再也无法醒来。

english: Now, Morytania is no stranger to odd afflictions. However, I've been doing some digging. Apparently, this isn't the first time this illness has beset Slepe. In fact, they say it's how the town was named.
translation: 现在，莫利塔尼亚对奇怪的疾病并不陌生。不过，我做了一些调查。显然，这种疾病并不是第一次困扰斯莱普镇。事实上，他们说这就是小镇名字的由来。

english: And now the illness is back. You said you suspect the vampyres are involved?
translation: 现在这病又回来了。你说你怀疑是吸血鬼干的？

english: I do. The first victim of the new Sleeper Plague was none other than Lady Crombwick. She rules over this town from Crombwick Manor, along with her husband.
translation: 没错。新斯莱普瘟疫的第一个受害者正是克伦布威克夫人。她和丈夫一起从克伦布威克庄园统治着这个镇子。

english: He's not been seen since she fell ill, and their manor has been locked down.
translation: 她病倒后，她丈夫就再也没露过面，庄园也被封锁了。

english: Here's the interesting part though. Vampyres have been seen around the manor. Apparently they showed up around the time when the Sleeper Plague returned.
translation: 不过有趣的是，有人看到吸血鬼在庄园附近出没。他们似乎是在斯莱普瘟疫卷土重来的时候出现的。

english: I see where this is going. You think the vampyres are the reason the plague is back.
translation: 我明白你的意思了。你觉得瘟疫复发是吸血鬼搞的鬼。

english: I do. The question is, why?
translation: 没错。问题是，为什么？

english: I guess that's for us to work out. Where do we start?
translation: 我想这得靠我们去查清楚了。我们从哪里开始？

english: We'll split up. I'm going to try and learn more about these vampyres at the manor. While I do that, I want you to try and find the source of the illness.
translation: 我们分头行动。我去庄园那边试着多了解这些吸血鬼的情况。与此同时，我希望你去寻找疾病的源头。

english: They're looking after the victims in this church here. I'd recommend you make that your starting point.
translation: 他们在这座教堂里照顾病人。我建议你从那里开始查起。

english: Sounds like a plan. Good luck.
translation: 听起来不错。祝你好运。

english: And to you. Myreque prevail.
translation: 你也一样。迈雷克必胜。

english: How have things been for you recently?
translation: 你最近过得怎么样？

english: We haven't been doing too bad. Even out in Mort Myre, the impact of Ranis' death can be seen.
translation: 我们过得还不错。即使在莫特迈尔，也能看到拉尼斯之死带来的影响。

english: People have a little bit more hope now, and it has become easier for us to gather support.
translation: 人们现在多了一点希望，我们更容易获得支持了。

english: That's good to know.
translation: 这倒是个好消息。

english: Of course, there are downsides. The vampyres are hunting us with ever greater determination. But this is the life we chose.
translation: 当然，也有坏处。吸血鬼追捕我们的决心更大了。但这是我们选择的生活。

english: What do you know about this place?
translation: 你对这个地方了解多少？

english: Slepe? It's wretched. The people of this town follow the teachings of Zamorak. Some are no better than the vampyres themselves.
translation: 斯莱普镇？糟透了。这个镇子的人信奉萨莫拉克。有些人跟吸血鬼没什么两样。

english: Do they get on with the vampyres?
translation: 他们跟吸血鬼相处得好吗？

english: As well as any humans can. All settlements in Morytania must pay the vampyres in blood tithes, but the people of Slepe do so willingly.
translation: 跟一般人类差不多。莫利塔尼亚的所有定居点都必须向吸血鬼缴纳血税，但斯莱普镇的人是自愿缴纳的。

english: They see the vampyres as fellow servants of Zamorak. Of course, the vampyres only really serve themselves.
translation: 他们把吸血鬼看作是萨莫拉克的同伴。当然，吸血鬼只为自己服务。

english: So why do these people follow Zamorak?
translation: 那这些人为什么要信奉萨莫拉克？

english: Apparently this place was founded by a group called the Sisterhood, former healers of Saradomin that turned to Zamorak.
translation: 据说这个地方是由一个叫姐妹会的组织建立的，她们原本是萨拉多明的治疗师，后来转而信奉了萨莫拉克。

english: Their order still exists to this day. You'll probably see a few of them around the town.
translation: 她们的教团至今仍然存在。你可能会在镇上看到她们中的一些人。

english: Can you tell me any more about the Sleeper Plague?
translation: 你能再多告诉我一些关于斯莱普瘟疫的事吗？

english: What I told you is pretty much what I know. The illness causes people to fall to sleep, never to wake again.
translation: 我告诉你的差不多就是我知道的全部了。这种病会让人陷入沉睡，再也无法醒来。

english: There's a rumour that the infected are also granted immortality, though I don't know if there's any truth in this.
translation: 有传言说感染者还能获得永生，不过我不知道这是不是真的。

english: To be honest, immortality doesn't seem very useful if you're unable to wake up.
translation: 说实话，如果醒不过来，永生似乎也没什么用。

english: Indeed. If history is to be believed, this is the second time the Sleeper Plague has hit Slepe. The first occurrence was many years ago and is supposedly what gave the town its name.
translation: 确实。如果历史可信的话，这是斯莱普瘟疫第二次袭击斯莱普镇了。第一次发生在很多年前，据说镇名就是这么来的。

english: That's all I know. That said, I suspect you might be able to learn more if you do some digging around town.
translation: 我就知道这些了。不过，我觉得如果你在镇上四处调查一下，可能会发现更多线索。

english: Very well friend. Myreque prevail.
translation: 好的，朋友。迈雷克必胜。

english: You need to try and find the source of the Sleeper Plague. I'd start in the church. That's where they're looking after the victims.
translation: 你需要设法找到斯莱普瘟疫的源头。我建议从教堂开始。那里是照顾病人的地方。

english: You don't look too happy?
translation: 你看起来不太高兴？

english: Do you know how he fell ill?
translation: 你知道他是怎么病倒的吗？

english: I've no idea. We'd just been to the pub for a quick drink. On our way back, he started to act all odd, then he just collapsed.
translation: 我不知道。我们刚去酒馆喝了一杯。回来的路上，他就开始行为古怪，然后就倒下了。

english: Pub?
translation: 酒馆？

english: Yes. The Rat & Bat just south east of here. I'm not a drinker myself but Hanchen's always loved a good tipple.
translation: 是的。东南边的“老鼠与蝙蝠”酒馆。我自己不喝酒，但汉琴一直喜欢喝上几杯。

english: Wait... you mean to say you weren't drinking?
translation: 等等……你的意思是说，你没喝酒？

english: No, I never drink. Hanchen on the other hand was loving those Bloody Bracers.
translation: 不喝，我从不喝酒。不过汉琴倒是很喜欢那些血腥护腕。

english: Like I said, I've no idea. We'd just been to the pub when it happened. Hanchen's always loved a good drink.
translation: 就像我说的，我不知道。事情发生的时候我们刚从酒馆出来。汉琴一直很喜欢喝两杯。

english: Not now, perhaps another time.
translation: 现在不行，也许下次吧。

english: Seems like you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 看来你没地方放它了。

english: We were told to follow the rats and they led us to this tomb.
translation: 我们被告知要跟着老鼠走，它们把我们带到了这座墓穴。

english: Well, it may not have been a tomb to begin with, but we're to believe it has become one.
translation: 嗯，它一开始可能不是座墓穴，但我们相信它现在已经变成了一座。

english: Deeper in the sanctuary, this is just the entrance.
translation: 在圣所更深处，这里只是入口。

english: Well... We were going to. But then we heard of the Nightmare that dwells within the sanctuary. We've decided to stay here until she's gone.
translation: 嗯……我们本来是打算进去的。但后来我们听说了圣所里住着梦魇。我们决定待在这里，直到她离开。

english: Oh, I found this when searching around in the church above.
translation: 哦，我在上面的教堂里搜寻时找到了这个。

english: Me? Not at all. That thief over there and the tattooed guy upstairs are my travelling companions. We come from afar.
translation: 我？完全不是。那边那个盗贼和楼上那个纹身的家伙是我的旅伴。我们从远方来。

english: I ask myself the same question, but we're on a quest, of sorts. You see, I found a poem in the College of Bards that told of this place. It seemed worthy of exploring.
translation: 我也问自己同样的问题，但我们算是踏上了某种旅程。你看，我在吟游诗人学院找到了一首诗，提到了这个地方。它似乎值得探索。

english: Oh, it's beautiful! Have you not visited the grand Kingdom of Varlamore? The college is but one of many attractions.
translation: 哦，它美极了！你没去过宏伟的瓦拉莫尔王国吗？学院只是众多景点之一。

english: You won't regret it!
translation: 你不会后悔的！

english: It's all in that parchment that I gave you earlier. You should give it a read.
translation: 都在我之前给你的那张羊皮纸里了。你应该读一读。

english: Well met friend. How goes the investigation?
translation: 幸会，朋友。调查进行得怎么样了？

english: Apparently the latest victim of the Sleeper Plague was at the pub shortly before falling ill.
translation: 斯莱普瘟疫的最新受害者，在病倒前不久去过酒馆。

english: Interesting. Might be worth a look.
translation: 有意思。值得去看看。

english: Agreed. I'll see if I can discover anything.
translation: 同意。我去看看能不能发现什么。

english: 99 of your finest coins.
translation: 来99枚最好的金币。

english: Where do you get your Bloody Bracers from?
translation: 你的血腥护腕是从哪里弄来的？

english: It's an old recipe of the Crombwick family.
translation: 这是克伦布威克家族的古老食谱。

english: Okay. But the actual Bloody Bracers you sell, where do they come from?
translation: 好吧。但你卖的那些血腥护腕，到底是从哪来的？

english: Well... me of course.
translation: 嗯……当然是我自己做的。

english: Yes, but what I mean is, why do you want to know?
translation: 是的，但我的意思是，你为什么要知道？

english: My supplier is a private individual. He doesn't like others meddling in his affairs. So yes, it does matter.
translation: 我的供应商是个很私密的人。他不喜欢别人干涉他的事。所以，是的，这很重要。

english: I represent... health?
translation: 我代表……健康？

english: Health? What are you on about?
translation: 健康？你在说什么？

english: Err... Health and safety of course, here on a routine inspection.
translation: 呃……当然是健康与安全，例行检查。

english: Part of my work requires me to inspect the source of your Bloody Bracers. I was hoping you'd put me in touch with your supplier.
translation: 我的工作需要我检查你血腥护腕的来源。我希望你能让我联系上你的供应商。

english: I don't know what you're on about. There're no routine inspections here. Now clear off, I have customers to serve!
translation: 我不知道你在说什么。这里没有例行检查。现在走开，我还有客人要招呼！

english: Well I might just have a look around anyway.
translation: 好吧，那我就在这随便看看。

english: You don't give up do you. I'm not telling you anything so clear off.
translation: 你还真是不死心。我什么都不会告诉你的，快走开。

english: Hmmm. Looks like Carl is pretty much out of Bloody Bracer. He'll need to collect more from his supplier soon.
translation: 嗯。看来卡尔的血腥护腕快卖完了。他很快就要去供应商那里补货了。

english: Huh. Looks like we're all out of Bloody Bracer again.
translation: 哈。看来我们的血腥护腕又卖完了。

english: Alright then Carl. Let's see what you're hiding...
translation: 好吧，卡尔。让我看看你在藏什么……

english: Hey! I see you there!
translation: 嘿！我看见你了！

english: The dungeon Carl? What are you hiding down there?
translation: 卡尔的地牢？你在下面藏着什么？

english: Carl? What do you want?
translation: 卡尔？你想干什么？

english: Kroy. We've run out of Bloody Bracer again.
translation: 克罗伊。我们的血腥护腕又卖完了。

english: Did you really need to come here to tell me that?
translation: 你非得跑到这里来告诉我这个吗？

english: There's something else as well. Someone's been poking around, asking about Bloody Bracer.
translation: 还有别的事。有人在四处打听血腥护腕的事。

english: I don't know. They don't look to be from around here.
translation: 我不知道。他们看起来不像是本地人。

english: So someone's been snooping around asking questions, and you decided to come here? What if they followed you?
translation: 所以有人偷偷摸摸地到处打听，你就跑到这里来了？万一他们跟踪你呢？

english: I... I thought you'd want to know.
translation: 我……我以为你会想知道。

english: You're a fool Carl. If you're not careful, you'll jeopardise everything.
translation: 你真是个傻瓜，卡尔。你要是不小心点，会坏了所有事。

english: Hey! I don't need to help you!
translation: 嘿！我又不欠你的！

english: No, you don't. Your predecessor didn't want to help us. Perhaps you remember what came of him?
translation: 不，你不欠。你的前任也不想帮我们。也许你还记得他的下场？

english: Go back to your pub Carl. I'll have more Bloody Bracer sent over soon. In the meantime, try to be a bit smarter.
translation: 回你的酒馆去，卡尔。我很快就会让人送更多血腥护腕过去。在那之前，放聪明点。

english: Alright then, Damien. What is it that you're so keen to show me?
translation: 好吧，达米安。你这么急着要给我看什么？

english: Vanstrom, I'd like you to meet Kroy.
translation: 范斯特罗姆，我想让你见见克罗伊。

english: Greetings, my lord.
translation: 您好，大人。

english: Don't tell me you had me come all the way down here for this? Look at the wretched thing, Damien. It's barely even a proper juvenile.
translation: 别告诉我你大老远把我叫来就是为了这个？看看这可怜的东西，达米安。它连个像样的幼年体都算不上。

english: Well just hang on there, Vanstrom. Kroy may not look like much, but I've never met a vampyre with a better knowledge of herblore.
translation: 先别急，范斯特罗姆。克罗伊可能看起来不怎么样，但我从没见过哪个吸血鬼比它更懂草药学。

english: Kroy, tell him what you found.
translation: 克罗伊，告诉他你发现了什么。

english: Of course, my lord.
translation: 遵命，大人。

english: It was hidden deep within the sanctuary here. A recipe, for an elixir.
translation: 它藏在圣所深处。一份灵药的食谱。

english: An elixir?
translation: 灵药？

english: Yes! The ones that built the place, the Sisterhood, they called it the Elixir of Everlasting.
translation: 是的！建造这里的姐妹会，她们称之为永恒灵药。

english: And just what is this Elixir of Everlasting?
translation: 这永恒灵药到底是什么？

english: Those who drink it find their lives heavily extended, but at a cost. They are put into a deep sleep, never to wake.
translation: 喝下它的人会大大延长寿命，但代价是陷入沉睡，再也无法醒来。

english: So the Sleeper Plague? That was your doing?
translation: 所以斯莱普瘟疫是你们搞的鬼？

english: Indeed. Using the recipe, Kroy was easily able to recreate the elixir. After a quick test on Lady Crombwick, we started giving it to the citizens.
translation: 确实。克罗伊利用食谱很容易就重新制作出了灵药。在克伦布威克夫人身上快速测试后，我们开始把它分发给市民。

english: We hide it in their beer, Bloody Bracer. They've no idea what it's really doing to them!
translation: 我们把灵药藏在他们的啤酒，也就是血腥护腕里。他们根本不知道这药对他们做了什么！

english: And while they sleep, we tithe them. The sleepers only need a fraction of the blood a normal human needs, so we can take more than ever before!
translation: 在他们沉睡的时候，我们就抽取他们的血税。沉睡者只需要正常人类所需血液的一小部分，所以我们能比以前抽取更多！

english: And tell me, Damien, who gave you permission to do this?
translation: 告诉我，达米安，是谁允许你这么做的？

english: The nobles of Darkmeyer make their demands Vanstrom. Someone has to meet them.
translation: 达克迈尔的贵族们提出了要求，范斯特罗姆。总得有人去满足他们。

english: That someone is not you. I am in charge of blood tithing. I alone decide how it is to be carried out.
translation: 那个人不是你。血税由我负责，只有我能决定如何征收。

english: The nobles are restless. They are tired of inaction. I saw an opportunity and I took it. Lord Drakan should thank me.
translation: 贵族们已经坐立不安了，他们厌倦了无所作为。我看到了机会，就抓住了。德拉坎大人应该感谢我才是。

english: I don't doubt the ingenuity of your plan. This elixir could have great potential. The thing I doubt is your recklessness. This Sleeper Plague has attracted attention. The wrong kind of attention.
