translation: 你的计划确实高明，我不怀疑这点。这种灵药潜力巨大。但我怀疑的是你的鲁莽。这场沉睡者瘟疫已经引起了注意，而且是那种不该有的注意。

english: The Myreque? Don't tell me you're scared of that lot, Vanstrom? I thought you were made of stronger stuff.
translation: 迈雷克？你不会是被那群人吓到了吧，范斯特罗姆？我还以为你更有胆色呢。

english: I do not fear the Myreque. I have no need to. They have no way of touching me.
translation: 我不怕迈雷克。也没必要怕。他们根本碰不到我。

english: But you on the other hand, you should be very afraid. Out here alone, without the support of the Drakan household. You're a prime target. And if what I hear is true, they're right on your doorstep.
translation: 但你就不一样了，你该害怕才对。独自在外，没有德拉坎家族的庇护，你就是首要目标。而且据我所知，他们已经到了你家门口。

english: The Myreque are already here in Slepe, Damien. The one that killed Ranis Drakan is among them. Your overconfidence has begun your downfall.
translation: 迈雷克已经到斯莱普镇了，达米恩。杀死拉尼斯.德雷坎的人就在其中。你的过度自信已经让你走上了绝路。

english: Well you'll have to do something. You'll need to send us some support.
translation: 那你得做点什么，派些支援来给我们。

english: I will do no such thing. You defied Lord Drakan when you came out here. The consequences of your actions are your own to deal with.
translation: 想都别想。你擅自跑到这里来，已经违抗了德拉坎大人。你自己行为的后果，自己承担。

english: Now, if you'll excuse me, I will be on my way. There are things in Darkmeyer that require my attention.
translation: 好了，告辞了。达克迈尔还有事等着我处理。

english: How much did you hear, human?
translation: 你听到了多少，人类？

english: I see. Then you know that I can't let you leave this place alive.
translation: 明白了。那你也该知道，我不能让你活着离开这里。

english: Tempting offer. Death isn't on my to-do list today though, so I'll have to decline.
translation: 挺诱人的邀请。不过死亡今天不在我的待办清单上，所以我得拒绝了。

english: A joker? Your arrogance will be your end, human.
translation: 耍嘴皮子？你的傲慢会要了你的命，人类。

english: Yes... We shall...
translation: 是啊……我们会……

english: Wise choice. Now please, I'm working to a deadline here.
translation: 明智的选择。现在请吧，我赶着交工呢。

english: Well that's him dealt with. I should destroy his lab as well. Don't want anyone else continuing his work.
translation: 好了，解决了一个。我还得毁了他的实验室，不能让别人继续他的工作。

english: There. That should stop anyone from continuing Kroy's work. I should inform Veliaf.
translation: 搞定。这样应该就没人能继续克罗伊的工作了。我该通知维利亚夫。

english: Well met friend. Anything to report?
translation: 幸会，朋友。有什么要报告的吗？

english: You were right about the vampyres. I did some digging and discovered that they are indeed the cause of the Sleeper Plague.
translation: 你关于吸血鬼的猜测是对的。我查了一下，发现他们确实是沉睡者瘟疫的源头。

english: A vampyre in the dungeon called Kroy was making infected Bloody Bracers. The local barkeep was then selling them to the townspeople.
translation: 地牢里一个叫克罗伊的吸血鬼在制作受感染的血腥护腕。然后当地的酒馆老板把它们卖给镇上的居民。

english: I put a stop to that though. I killed Kroy and destroyed his lab. The barkeep has no supply now.
translation: 不过我已经阻止了。我杀了克罗伊，毁了他的实验室。酒馆老板现在没有货源了。

english: Excellent work friend. This should stop any new cases of the illness.
translation: 干得好，朋友。这应该能阻止新病例出现了。

english: There's something else, too. While I was spying on Kroy, I saw Vanstrom Klause with another vampyre called Damien. It sounded like Damien was Kroy's boss.
translation: 还有别的事。我在监视克罗伊时，看到范斯特罗姆.克劳斯和另一个叫达米恩的吸血鬼在一起。听上去达米恩是克罗伊的上司。

english: The vampyre you speak of is a noble called Damien Leucurte. He's a known quantity to us. My investigations at the manor also involved the two of them, but let's hear the rest of your findings first.
translation: 你说的那个吸血鬼叫达米恩.勒库尔特，是个贵族。我们都知道他。我在庄园的调查也涉及他们俩，不过先听听你其他的发现吧。

english: Well, in their conversations, it was revealed why they caused the new Sleeper Plague. Apparently, they did it to make it easier to take blood tithes.
translation: 好吧，从他们的对话中，我得知了他们制造新一轮沉睡者瘟疫的原因。显然，他们是为了更方便地征收血税。

english: But here's the interesting thing. Vanstrom didn't seem very happy with this. It sounded like Damien was doing it without his permission.
translation: 但有趣的是，范斯特罗姆对此似乎并不高兴。听上去达米恩是未经他许可就这么做的。

english: This is all very interesting. The citizens of this town are Zamorakians and willingly give their blood to the vampyres. Why would Damien need the Sleeper Plague?
translation: 这很有意思。这个镇的居民都是萨莫拉克教徒，自愿向吸血鬼献血。达米恩为什么还需要沉睡者瘟疫？

english: He talked about increased demand from the nobles of Darkmeyer. Perhaps they have need for more blood than normal?
translation: 他提到了达克迈尔贵族的需求增加了。也许他们需要比平常更多的血？

english: That would make sense. I've heard rumours that the vampyre population has grown such that demand for blood now exceeds supply. Damien may be looking for ways to satisfy this demand.
translation: 说得通。我听到传言说吸血鬼的数量增长太快，导致血的需求已经超过供应。达米恩可能在想办法满足这个需求。

english: Even so, this seems extreme. And to go behind Vanstrom's back as well? Maybe their overcrowding issues are bigger than we first realised.
translation: 即便如此，这手段也太极端了。而且还是背着范斯特罗姆干的？也许他们的人口过剩问题比我们最初以为的还要严重。

english: Maybe. So, what's our next move?
translation: 也许吧。那，我们下一步怎么办？

english: I have an idea about that, although my information is not quite as exciting as yours I'm afraid.
translation: 我对此有个想法，不过我的消息恐怕没你的那么刺激。

english: While I was investigating the manor, I discovered that it has indeed been taken over by vampyres. Our friend Damien seems to be the leader of this group.
translation: 我在调查庄园时，发现那里确实已经被吸血鬼占领了。我们的朋友达米恩似乎是这群人的首领。

english: During my time there, I also managed to spy on Vanstrom and Damien. I only heard a small part of their conversation, but Vanstrom didn't seem very happy, which matches up with what you heard.
translation: 在那里的时候，我也设法偷听到了范斯特罗姆和达米恩的谈话。我只听到一小部分，但范斯特罗姆似乎很不高兴，这和你听到的一致。

english: At one point, Vanstrom insulted Damien for his recklessness and accused him of demanding too much from the werewolves. Sounds like they've also been gathering extra blood without permission.
translation: 有一次，范斯特罗姆指责达米恩鲁莽，并指控他向狼人索取过多。听起来他们也在未经许可的情况下收集额外血液。

english: That sounds familiar. I suspect it was werewolves who attacked me that time at Paterdomus.
translation: 听起来耳熟。我怀疑当年在帕特多莫斯袭击我的就是狼人。

english: Yes, that encounter also sprung into my mind. It sounds like things are even worse now.
translation: 没错，我也想到了那次遭遇。听起来现在情况更糟了。

english: So you want to investigate the werewolves?
translation: 所以你想调查狼人？

english: I do indeed. Something is going on in Darkmeyer that's causing this increased demand. If there's unrest in the city, we might be able to use it to our advantage.
translation: 正是。达克迈尔正在发生什么事，导致了这种需求增加。如果城里局势不稳，我们也许可以利用这点。

english: What about Slepe? Should we not deal with Damien as well?
translation: 斯莱普镇呢？我们不也该对付达米恩吗？

english: Not yet. Your actions will have drawn attention to us. We cannot stay here. It sounds like Damien can do little without Kroy, so I doubt he'll be much trouble anyway.
translation: 还不是时候。你的行动已经引起了注意，我们不能待在这里。听上去没有克罗伊，达米恩也掀不起什么风浪，总之我不觉得他会是多大麻烦。

english: Besides, we've already done too much for these Zamorakians. There are others more deserving of our time.
translation: 再说，我们为这些萨莫拉克教徒做得够多了。还有更值得我们花时间的人。

english: But aren't we meant to help people?
translation: 但我们的本意不就是要帮助别人吗？

english: That's a complicated question friend. But yes, of course we are meant to help people.
translation: 这是个复杂的问题，朋友。不过是的，我们当然应该帮助别人。

english: Then why are we letting Damien get away with this? Carl as well?
translation: 那为什么我们要放过达米恩？还有卡尔？

english: Damien and Carl are small fish in a very big pond. Dealing with them might help the people here, but it will mean nothing to the rest of Morytania.
translation: 达米恩和卡尔只是大鱼塘里的小鱼。对付他们或许能帮助这里的人，但对整个莫利塔尼亚来说毫无意义。

english: If we want to help as many people as possible, we need to think bigger than that. The Drakan family, they are the real targets.
translation: 如果我们想帮助尽可能多的人，就必须把眼光放得更远。德拉坎家族，那才是真正的目标。

english: I suppose. It just seems harsh to leave these people in the hands of a vampyre like Damien.
translation: 也许吧。但把这些人丢给达米恩那样的吸血鬼，似乎有点残忍。

english: We've already done a lot to help here. Besides, Damien will get what's coming to him in the end, I'm sure of that.
translation: 我们已经帮了很多忙了。再说，达米恩最终会得到应有的报应，我确信这一点。

english: You're sure this isn't just because they're Zamorakian?
translation: 你确定这不只是因为他们信仰萨莫拉克？

english: Zamorakians are evil my friend, it does not shame me to say it. But no, if this were a Saradominist town, my actions would be the same.
translation: 萨莫拉克教徒是邪恶的，朋友，我这么说并不惭愧。但不对，如果这是萨拉多明信徒的城镇，我的做法也会一样。

english: You have a good heart my friend. I have a lot of respect for that. I assure you that if we keep on our current path, we will bring freedom to all of Morytania.
translation: 你有一颗善良的心，朋友。我对此非常尊敬。我向你保证，只要我们沿着现在的路走下去，就能给整个莫利塔尼亚带来自由。

english: Thank you, Veliaf. So, what's our next move?
translation: 谢谢你，维利亚夫。那我们下一步计划是什么？

english: Meet me at Paterdomus friend. We will check in with Drezel and Ivan, before continuing our investigation.
translation: 在帕特多莫斯和我碰头吧，朋友。我们要和德雷泽尔、伊万碰个面，然后再继续调查。

english: Okay, I'll meet you there.
translation: 好的，我到那里和你碰面。

english: Be careful out there. Myreque prevail.
translation: 路上小心。迈雷克必胜。

english: Fair enough, so what now?
translation: 说得对，那现在怎么办？

english: Well met friend. Good to see you made it in one piece.
translation: 幸会，朋友。很高兴看到你平安抵达。

english: Indeed, I hear Morytania becomes more dangerous by the day.
translation: 是啊，我听说莫利塔尼亚一天比一天危险了。

english: You can say that again. Good to see you Drezel. Has Veliaf already filled you in?
translation: 你说得太对了。见到你真好，德雷泽尔。维利亚夫已经告诉你情况了吗？

english: Not yet, I thought it best to wait for you.
translation: 还没，我想最好等你也到了再说。

english: But you're here now, so let's get started.
translation: 但你现在来了，所以我们开始吧。

english: Well Drezel, the reason we are here is due to an investigation we've been conducting in Slepe.
translation: 嗯，德雷泽尔，我们来这里是因为我们一直在斯莱普镇进行调查。

english: Ah. I hear it's a nasty place, full of Zamorakian filth. Suffering from some sort of outbreak as well, I've been told.
translation: 啊。我听说那是个肮脏的地方，到处都是萨莫拉克的渣滓。而且还听说爆发了什么疾病。

english: Yes, the Sleeper Plague. It turns out, however, that the vampyres are responsible.
translation: 是的，沉睡者瘟疫。不过事实证明，是吸血鬼在背后搞鬼。

english: Seems that one of their nobles, Damien Leucurte, has been looking for ways to increase blood output. Interestingly, he's been doing it without consent from the Drakan family.
translation: 似乎他们一个叫达米恩.勒库尔特的贵族，一直在找办法增加血液产量。有趣的是，他一直在未经德拉坎家族同意的情况下行事。

english: That's right. Vanstrom doesn't seem to be very happy about it.
translation: 没错。范斯特罗姆似乎对此很不高兴。

english: Interesting. It's odd you should come to report this, because we've also experienced some strange happenings around here.
translation: 有意思。你们来报告这个可真巧，因为我们这边也发生了一些奇怪的事。

english: Hmm. Do these strange happenings have anything to do with werewolves, by any chance?
translation: 嗯。这些奇怪的事，该不会正好和狼人有关吧？

english: They do.
translation: 确实有关。

english: I knew it. What's been going on?
translation: 我就知道。发生什么了？

english: Well, after [player name] here was ambushed outside the temple a while back, Ivan and I decided to keep a closer eye on things.
translation: 嗯，自从[player name]上次在神庙外被伏击后，我和伊万决定多留点神。

english: For a time, nothing unusual happened. The reports of trouble in the area died down, and everything seemed normal.
translation: 有一段时间，什么异常都没发生。该地区的麻烦报告逐渐平息，一切似乎都恢复了正常。

english: Perhaps their encounter with you scared them off, [player name].
translation: 也许遇到你把他们吓跑了，[player name]。

english: Maybe. But if so, it was only for a time. A few weeks ago, the reports of people going missing in the area started again. And they're much worse this time.
translation: 也许吧。但如果是这样，也只是暂时的。几周前，该地区有人失踪的报告又开始了，而且这次严重得多。

english: Entire groups have been going missing. Not just miners and travellers either. Even some of the king's mercenaries have vanished.
translation: 整队整队的人失踪。不只是矿工和旅客，甚至连国王的一些雇佣兵都消失了。

english: Did you send word to the king?
translation: 你们通知国王了吗？

english: We did. His adviser though, Aeonisig, encouraged him to refrain from military action.
translation: 通知了。但他的顾问埃奥尼西格，劝阻他不要采取军事行动。

english: Typical. This is why I hate politics.
translation: 典型的政客作风。这就是我讨厌政治的原因。

english: Has anyone seen who's been doing this? Is it definitely werewolves?
translation: 有人看到是谁干的吗？确定是狼人吗？

english: We believe so. Ivan has been keeping a close watch. The disappearances have mostly taken place further up the pass, however, so it's taken a while for him to find any leads.
translation: 我们相信是的。伊万一直在密切监视。不过，失踪事件大多发生在更远的隘口处，所以他花了一些时间才找到线索。

english: But he has found one?
translation: 但他找到了一个线索？

english: Yes, last night. He overheard a hooded figure mention a meeting in the Haunted Woods, directly south of Fenkenstrain's Castle, that is apparently set for today.
translation: 是的，昨晚。他无意中听到一个兜帽人提到在芬肯斯特雷恩城堡正南边的闹鬼森林里有个会面，据说就定在今天。

english: Perfect. Sounds like that's where we should head next then.
translation: 太棒了。看来那就是我们下一步该去的地方。

english: On the topic of Ivan, where is he Drezel?
translation: 说到伊万，德雷泽尔，他在哪儿？

english: Ah... Well that's just the thing. He went to spy on the meeting.
translation: 啊……问题就在这里。他去监视那个会面了。

english: What? You just let him go? He's just a boy!
translation: 什么？你就让他去了？他还只是个孩子！

english: He's a grown man, Veliaf! One far smarter than either you or I. If he wants to do something, he will do it. I can't stop him!
translation: 他是个成年人了，维利亚夫！而且比你我都聪明得多。如果他想做什么事，他就会去做。我拦不住他！

english: You should have sent word to us! This is for us to deal with, not him!
translation: 你应该通知我们的！这是我们该处理的事，不是他！

english: There wasn't time. He only found out about the meeting last night!
translation: 没时间了。他昨晚才知道会面的事！

english: Ivan is still a member of the Myreque, isn't he? Surely he can look after himself.
translation: 伊万还是迈雷克的成员，不是吗？他肯定能照顾好自己。

english: That's not the point! He needs to be kept safe!
translation: 问题不在这里！他必须确保安全！

english: I don't understand. Why is Ivan so important?
translation: 我不明白，为什么伊万这么重要？

english: Ivan... Well, Ivan is special. He is the last in his bloodline.
translation: 伊万……嗯，伊万很特殊。他是他血统的最后一人。

english: And what bloodline is that?
translation: 什么血统？

english: Ivan is the last living descendant of Ivandis Seergaze himself. Once I am gone, he will be the only remaining descendant of the Seven Priestly Warriors.
translation: 伊万是伊万迪斯.西尔盖兹本人最后一位在世的后裔。我一死，他就将是七祭司勇士最后一位尚存的后裔了。

english: Are you becoming forgetful, [player name]? The Seven Priestly Warriors were the ones who originally blessed the River Salve.
translation: 你忘了吗，[player name]？七祭司勇士正是最初祝福萨尔维河的那群人。

english: Without their sacrifice, Drakan and his kin would have long since taken over Misthalin.
translation: 没有他们的牺牲，德拉坎和他的族人早就占领米斯萨林了。

english: Ah yes, I remember. So, this is why you want to keep Ivan safe, Veliaf?
translation: 啊，我想起来了。所以，这就是你想保护伊万安全的原因，维利亚夫？

english: I see. So that's why you want to keep him safe, Veliaf?
translation: 我明白了。所以这就是你想保护他安全的原因，维利亚夫？

english: It's not just about that. There's also the promise I made. Before his mother died, I swore to her on my life that I would shield Ivan from any harm.
translation: 不仅仅是因为这个。还有我许下的承诺。在他母亲去世前，我以我的生命向她发誓，我会保护伊万免受任何伤害。

english: Though I nearly failed her when Vanstrom killed Sani and Harold.
translation: 虽然当范斯特罗姆杀死萨尼和哈罗德时，我差点辜负了她。

english: Veliaf, my friend, you and I will not be around to protect Ivan forever. We have guided him to this point, but maybe it's time for him to start looking after himself.
translation: 维利亚夫，我的朋友，你我无法永远守护伊万。我们已经引导他走到这一步，但也许是时候让他开始照顾自己了。

english: And what of his learnings here? You would have him abandon them?
translation: 那他在这里学到的东西怎么办？你要他放弃吗？

english: I have taught Ivan everything I know. There is nothing more he can gain from me.
translation: 我已经把我知道的一切都教给了伊万。他再也无法从我这里学到更多了。

english: Forgive me, but this can be resolved later. For now, we need to find Ivan and see what this meeting is about.
translation: 请原谅，但这件事可以稍后再解决。现在，我们需要找到伊万，看看这次会面是怎么回事。

english: Yes, you're absolutely right, friend. Forgive us. Directly south of Fenkenstrain's Castle. Is that right Drezel?
translation: 是的，你说得完全对，朋友。请原谅我们。就在芬肯斯特兰城堡的正南方。对吧，德雷泽尔？

english: That's right. In the Haunted Woods.
translation: 没错。在闹鬼森林里。

english: Very well. Meet me there, [player name]. Let's see if we can find out what's going on.
translation: 很好。在那里等我，[player name]。看看我们能不能弄清楚发生了什么。

english: Oh, and [player name], I would appreciate it if you could avoid mentioning the stuff about Ivandis Seergaze to Ivan. One day he will have to bear that burden. But for now, he has enough weight on his shoulders.
translation: 哦，还有[player name]，如果你能别向伊万提起伊万迪斯.西尔盖兹的事，我会很感激。总有一天他必须承担那个负担。但现在，他肩上的担子已经够重了。

english: Good luck to you both. Saradomin be with you.
translation: 祝你们俩好运。萨拉多明与你同在。

english: Meet me in the Haunted Woods, just south of Fenkenstrain's Castle. We will hopefully find Ivan there.
translation: 在闹鬼森林里见我，就在芬肯斯特兰城堡的南边。希望我们能在那里找到伊万。

english: Okay, I'll see you there.
translation: 好的，我们那里见。

english: You should head for the Haunted Woods, friend. With luck, you'll find Ivan just south of Fenkenstrain's Castle.
translation: 你应该前往闹鬼森林，朋友。运气好的话，你会在芬肯斯特兰城堡南边找到伊万。

english: Could you tell me more about the Seven Priestly Warriors?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于七祭司勇士的事吗？

english: Well at this point you should be no stranger to their tale, though I understand the desire for a recap.
translation: 好吧，到了这个时候，你应该对他们的故事不陌生了，不过我理解你想回顾一下。

english: During the Fourth Age, the vampyre forces of Lowerniel Drakan attempted to invade Misthalin. They would have succeeded, were it not for the Seven Priestly Warriors.
translation: 在第四纪元，洛厄尼尔.德雷坎的吸血鬼军队试图入侵米斯塔林。如果不是七祭司勇士，他们可能就成功了。

english: The warriors were the ones to bless the River Salve and build this temple, ensuring that Misthalin would be forever safe from the evils of Morytania.
translation: 正是这些勇士祝福了萨尔维河并建造了这座神庙，确保了米斯塔林永远免受莫利塔尼亚邪恶势力的侵害。

english: Sadly, all seven of them fell in the final battle against Drakan. They are now buried here, in this very mausoleum.
translation: 可悲的是，他们七人都在对抗德雷坎的最后一战中倒下了。现在他们被安葬在这里，就在这座陵墓里。

english: I don't know if that's completely true.
translation: 我不确定那是否完全属实。

english: You talk of the suggestion that Ivandis Seergaze isn't actually buried with the others, don't you? That isn't a conversation I wish to have.
translation: 你是在说那个暗示，即伊万迪斯.希尔盖兹实际上并没有和其他人葬在一起，对吧？我不想谈那个话题。

english: Fair enough. Anything else you can tell me about the Warriors?
translation: 有道理。你还能告诉我关于勇士们的其他事吗？

english: Not really. You might learn more in the library below, but I'd be cautious of believing every word in those books.
translation: 没什么了。你或许可以在下面的图书馆里了解更多，但我建议不要相信那些书里的每一个字。

english: Okay. Thanks Drezel.
translation: 好的。谢谢你，德雷泽尔。

english: [player name]! So good to see you. What brings you out here?
translation: [player name]！真高兴见到你。什么风把你吹来了？

english: Hello there, Ivan. Believe it or not, I'm actually here for you.
translation: 你好，伊万。信不信由你，我其实是来找你的。

english: For me? I'm guessing Drezel sent you?
translation: 找我？我猜是德雷泽尔派你来的？

english: That's right. He told us of your discovery about the werewolves. We came to lend a hand.
translation: 没错。他告诉我们你发现了关于狼人的事。我们是来帮忙的。

english: We? Is Veliaf with you?
translation: 我们？维利亚夫和你在一起吗？

english: Yes. We've been investigating something together. We suspect it may be connected to this situation with the werewolves. I imagine he'll be here shortly.
translation: 是的。我们一直在共同调查一些事情。我们怀疑这可能与狼人的情况有关。我想他很快就会到。

english: Veliaf!
translation: 维利亚夫！

english: Ivan. It's good to see you safe.
translation: 伊万。看到你平安无事真好。

english: And you. [player name] says you're here about the werewolves.
translation: 你也是。[player name]说你是为了狼人来的。

english: Indeed. But Ivan, you shouldn't be out here. It's not safe for you. Head back to the temple, let [player name] and I take it from here.
translation: 确实。但是伊万，你不应该待在这里。这对你不安全。回神庙去，让[player name]和我来处理这里的事。

english: Don't worry, Veliaf. I can look after myself.
translation: 别担心，维利亚夫。我能照顾好自己。

english: Ivan...
translation: 伊万……

english: Wait! Look!
translation: 等等！看！

english: Well look who it is. Damien Leucurte! I thought you didn't like to associate with our lot.
translation: 看看这是谁。达米恩.勒库尔特！我还以为你不喜欢和我们这种人打交道呢。

english: Scared of getting mud on his pretty clothes, I bet.
translation: 我打赌他是怕弄脏他那漂亮的衣服。

english: Mind your tongue, dog, or I'll have you put in a collar.
translation: 说话注意点，狗东西，不然我就给你套上项圈。

english: Your threats mean nothing out here Damien. There're no Drakans around to protect you.
translation: 你的威胁在这里没用，达米恩。这里没有德雷坎家的人保护你。

english: Not that Drakan protection means much these days anyway. His own brother killed by a human. How does he respond? He stays hiding in his fancy castle.
translation: 反正德雷坎的保护现在也没什么用了。他自己的兄弟被一个人类杀了。他有什么反应？他躲在他那华丽的城堡里。

english: Ha! You think this one would get Drakan protection even if he were about? I hear Vanstrom has found out about this little side venture. Little Damien has been a very naughty boy.
translation: 哈！你觉得就算他在，这家伙能得到德雷坎的保护吗？我听说范斯特罗姆已经发现了这个小副业。小达米恩可是个非常不乖的孩子。

english: Enough of this! What do you have for me?
translation: 够了！你给我带了什么？

english: A nice family of three, out for a little picnic a bit too close to the Salve.
translation: 一个幸福的三口之家，在离萨尔维河太近的地方搞了个小野餐。

english: Please... don't hurt us. We'll do anything!
translation: 求求你……别伤害我们。我们什么都愿意做！

english: Three? Is that all?
translation: 三个？就这些？

english: Well if you want more, you're welcome to cross the Salve yourself and get them.
translation: 嗯，如果你想要更多，欢迎你自己跨过萨尔维河去抓他们。

english: There's been a setback with our operations in Slepe. We need you to make up the shortfall. Next time, bring more.
translation: 我们在斯莱普镇的行动遇到了挫折。我们需要你来弥补短缺。下次，多带点来。

english: You assume there's going to be a next time. I bet you don't last another week now that the Myreque are running around with vampyre-killing weapons.
translation: 你以为还有下次？我打赌你撑不过一个星期，现在迈雷克的人拿着杀吸血鬼的武器到处跑。

english: A week? He won't even last another day at the rate he's going!
translation: 一个星期？照他这速度，连一天都撑不过去！

english: I tire of your arrogance. We're done here.
translation: 我受够了你的傲慢。我们谈完了。

english: Yes, we are. See you around Damien.
translation: 是的，我们谈完了。回头见，达米恩。

english: Or not.
translation: 或者再也不见。

english: Good luck down there, my friend. Remember, to the west is the main agility course, while to the east is a skullball course.
translation: 下面好运，我的朋友。记住，西边是主敏捷赛道，东边是骷髅球赛道。

english: You can't go down there, human. If it wasn't my duty to guard this trapdoor, I would be relieving you of the burden of your life right now.
translation: 你不能下去，人类。要不是我有责任守卫这个活板门，我现在就送你上路。

english: That's none of your business, human, and I'll never tell.
translation: 这不关你的事，人类，我永远不会说的。

english: If it wasn't my duty to stand here and guard our agility course from the likes of you, I would be relieving you of your life right now.
translation: 如果不是我的职责是站在这里守卫我们的敏捷训练场，防止像你这样的人，我现在就要了你的命。

english: No ... yes ... oh blast - you didn't hear me say anything, right?
translation: 不……是……哦该死——你没听到我说什么，对吧？

english: It's an agility course designed for lycanthropes like ourselves, my friend.
translation: 这是为像我们这样的狼人设计的敏捷赛道，我的朋友。

english: No, human - it's werewolves only.
translation: 不，人类——只限狼人。

english: Certainly. The cavern contains two courses - on the west side is a Level 60 Agility Course, and and the east side is a Level 25 Skullball Course.
translation: 当然。洞穴里有两个赛道——西边是60级敏捷赛道，东边是25级骷髅球赛道。

english: So it's as we suspected. The werewolves have been taking people from across the Salve.
translation: 所以正如我们所怀疑的。狼人一直在从萨尔维河对岸抓人。

english: But they've been doing so without permission, just like in Slepe.
translation: 但他们一直未经许可就这么做，就像在斯莱普镇一样。

english: This doesn't give us anything more to go on though. We have our suspicions, but we still don't know for sure why they are doing this.
translation: 但这并没有给我们提供更多线索。我们有怀疑，但仍然不确定他们为什么这么做。

english: Should we follow them? Maybe we'll learn more if we do. We might also get a chance to save that poor family.
translation: 我们应该跟踪他们吗？也许这样我们能了解更多。我们或许还有机会救那个可怜的家庭。

english: No, it's too risky. Last thing we need is you getting captured, Ivan.
translation: 不，太冒险了。我们最不需要的就是你被抓走，伊万。

english: Hang on... Do you two hear something?
translation: 等等……你们俩听到什么声音了吗？

english: Go on then! Finish it!
translation: 动手吧！了结他！

english: Oh Veliaf my dear, If I'd wanted you dead I'd have done it a long time ago.
translation: 哦，我亲爱的维利亚夫，如果我想让你死，我早就动手了。

english: You're not here to kill us?
translation: 你不是来杀我们的？

english: No... I'm here to talk...
translation: 不……我是来谈谈的……

english: So... Let's talk.
translation: 那么……我们谈谈吧。

english: I take it you know who I am?
translation: 我想你知道我是谁吧？

english: You're Vanescula Drakan, sister to Lowerniel Drakan.
translation: 你是范尼斯库拉.德雷坎，洛厄尼尔.德雷坎的妹妹。

english: And formally, sister to Ranis Drakan, before [player name] here came along.
translation: 而且以前也是拉尼斯.德雷坎的妹妹，在[player name]出现之前。

english: Ah yes, [player name], the great vampyre slayer. I would thank you, were it not for the fact that his funeral was such a dull affair.
translation: 啊，是的，[player name]，伟大的吸血鬼杀手。要不是他的葬礼那么无聊，我本该感谢你的。

english: Wait... You wanted him dead?
translation: 等等……你想让他死？

english: There was no love between Ranis and I. You did us a favour when you got rid of him.
translation: 拉尼斯和我之间没有感情。你除掉他，算是帮了我们一个忙。

english: That's a shame. Maybe I shouldn't have bothered.
translation: 真可惜。也许我当初不该费那个劲。

english: Oh on the contrary, the death of Ranis was just what we needed.
translation: 哦，恰恰相反，拉尼斯的死正是我们需要的。

english: Save your words. You didn't come to thank us for Ranis. Why are you here?
translation: 省省你的话吧。你不是来为拉尼斯的事感谢我们的。你为什么来这里？

english: Ah, and there I was thinking we were starting to become friends. Fine. I'm here to make you an offer. A once in a lifetime offer.
translation: 啊，我还以为我们开始成为朋友了呢。好吧。我来这里是要给你一个提议。一个千载难逢的提议。

english: You've already killed one of my brothers. Now I offer you the chance to kill the other.
translation: 你已经杀了我的一个兄弟。现在我给你机会去杀另一个。

english: Alone, you have no hope of ever getting close to Lowerniel. Now, I on the otherhand, can get you right into his chambers at Castle Drakan.
translation: 单凭你们，绝无可能接近洛厄尼尔。而我，则可以把你们直接带进德雷戛纳堡他的房间。

english: And why would you want that?
translation: 你为什么要这么做？

english: I have my reasons.
translation: 我有我的理由。

english: I will, but not here.
translation: 我会的，但不是在这里。

english: Where then?
translation: 那在哪里？

english: To the south east of Meiyerditch, there's an old graveyard. The Icyene Graveyard, we call it. Gather the Myreque, every member, and meet me there. That is where I will present my proposal.
translation: 在迈尔迪奇的东南方，有一个古老的墓地。我们称之为艾辛恩墓地。召集迈雷克的所有成员，在那里见我。我会在那里提出我的方案。

english: Every member of the Myreque? Do you take us for fools? You're trying to lure us all there to wipe us out.
translation: 迈雷克的所有成员？你当我们是傻瓜吗？你想把我们全引到那里去消灭掉。

english: As I said to you earlier, Veliaf, if I wanted you dead I'd have done it long ago.
translation: 就像我之前对你说的，维利亚夫，如果我想让你死，我早就动手了。

english: You're bluffing!
translation: 你在虚张声势！

english: Am I? So if I were to head to the Burgh de Rott inn and go down into the basement, what would I find?
translation: 是吗？那么如果我现在前往伯格德罗特镇的旅馆，下到地下室，我会发现什么？

english: You...
If I were to give the order, I could have the heads of every member of the Myreque mounted above the gates of Castle Drakan before the day is out.
translation: 如果我下令，我可以在今天结束前，把迈雷克每个成员的头颅挂在德雷戛纳堡的大门上方。

english: Don't be so sure. There's more of us than you think.
translation: 别那么肯定。我们的人比你想象的要多。

english: Is there now? Do you refer to the elusive Calsidiu, the apparent leader of the Myreque?
translation: 是吗？你指的是那个神秘的卡尔西迪乌斯，迈雷克所谓的领袖？

english: A lie, I'm afraid. I know exactly how many of you there are. And that number isn't as big as you'd like to pretend.
translation: 恐怕那是个谎言。我确切知道你们有多少人。那个数字可没你假装得那么大。

english: A lie? Veliaf...
translation: 谎言？维利亚夫……

english: You've made your point Vanescula. How do we get to this graveyard?
translation: 你的意思我明白了，范尼斯库拉。我们怎么去那个墓地？

english: A boat will be your easiest way I imagine. I'll let you worry about the details.
translation: 我想坐船对你们来说是最简单的。细节你们自己操心吧。

english: Incidentally, should you fail to attend...
translation: 顺便说一句，如果你们不来……

english: You'll mount our heads above the gates of Castle Drakan. Yeah, we get it.
translation: 你就会把我们的头挂在德雷戛纳堡的大门上。是啊，我们明白。

english: Excellent, glad we understand one another. I will await you at the graveyard.
translation: 很好，很高兴我们彼此理解。我会在墓地等你们。

english: This isn't good.
translation: 这可不妙。

english: Veliaf... You lied about Calsidiu and the other Myreque?
translation: 维利亚夫……你撒谎说卡尔西迪乌斯和其他迈雷克成员还在？

english: Yes. But it was with good intention, Ivan. To believe there were more of us out there... It inspired hope in our ranks, and fear in our enemies.
translation: 是的。但我是出于好意，伊万。让人们相信我们还有更多同伴……这能在我们队伍中激发希望，在敌人心中制造恐惧。

english: A false hope.
translation: 虚假的希望。

english: Better than none at all. Ivan, I have made some tough choices over my years, but every one of them was for the good of Morytania.
translation: 总比没有好。伊万，这些年来我做出过一些艰难的选择，但每一个都是为了莫利塔尼亚的利益。

english: Okay... I understand. I don't like it, but I understand.
translation: 好吧……我明白了。我不喜欢这样，但我明白。

english: I don't like it either. Later, we will sit down and properly discuss this. However, at the moment I fear we have more pressing matters.
translation: 我也不喜欢。稍后我们会坐下来好好讨论这件事。不过目前恐怕有更紧迫的事情。

english: Vanescula. What do we do?
translation: 瓦内斯库拉。我们该怎么办？

english: Go back to Paterdomus, Ivan. [player name] and I will handle it.
translation: 回帕特多莫斯去，伊万。[player name]和我会处理这件事。

english: But you heard what she said. She asked for all the Myreque. Veliaf, I'm one of the Myreque, I have to come with you.
translation: 但你听到了她的话。她要的是整个迈雷克。维利亚夫，我是迈雷克的一员，我必须跟你一起去。

english: Come with us? What makes you think we're even going? What makes you think we have any intention of listening to that witch?
translation: 跟我们去？你凭什么觉得我们会去？你凭什么觉得我们打算听那个女巫的话？

english: We don't have a choice, Veliaf, you know that. If we don't go, she'll kill us all.
translation: 我们别无选择，维利亚夫，你知道的。如果我们不去，她会杀了我们所有人。

english: I fear Ivan is right. It doesn't seem like Vanescula has given us any other options.
translation: 恐怕伊万是对的。瓦内斯库拉似乎没有给我们其他选择。

english: Exactly. The decision has already been made for us, so I see little point in debating it. We're going. All of us.
translation: 正是。决定已经帮我们做好了，所以争论也没什么意义。我们去。所有人。

english: Dammit Ivan! I'm trying to keep you safe!
translation: 该死的伊万！我是想保护你的安全！

english: You can't keep me safe, Veliaf. No one can. While Lowerniel Drakan lives, none of us will ever be safe.
translation: 你保护不了我的，维利亚夫。没人能。只要洛厄尼尔.德雷坎还活着，我们谁都不会安全。

english: We have to do this. It's the only choice we have.
translation: 我们必须这么做。这是我们唯一的选择。

english: Fine. But don't expect me to even pretend to be happy about this! Breaking bread with a vampyre! What have we come to?
translation: 好吧。但别指望我甚至假装对此感到高兴！和一个吸血鬼一起吃饭！我们沦落到什么地步了？

english: We're not breaking bread with her. We're going to see what she has to offer. If she tries anything, [player name] here can deal with her, just like he did to her brother.
translation: 我们不是和她一起吃饭。我们要看看她能提供什么。如果她敢耍花样，这里的[player name]可以对付她，就像他对付她哥哥一样。

english: It would be my pleasure. What's our plan?
translation: 乐意效劳。我们的计划是什么？

english: I will travel down to Burgh de Rott and inform Radigad and Polmafi of this plight we find ourselves in. I'll also have word sent to Safalaan and the others in Meiyerditch.
translation: 我会前往伯格德罗特镇，告知拉迪加德和波尔马菲我们目前的困境。我还会派人送信给萨法拉安和迈尔迪奇的其他同伴。

english: [player name], I would appreciate it if you could escort Ivan down to Burgh de Rott.
translation: [player name]，如果你能护送伊万到伯格德罗特镇，我会很感激。

english: I need to collect some things from Paterdomus first. I'll update Drezel while I'm there. Once I'm done, I'll meet you outside the temple, on the Canifis side.
translation: 我需要先从帕特多莫斯取些东西。我会在那里顺便向德雷泽尔汇报情况。完成后，我在寺庙外和你们碰面，坎尼非斯村那一侧。

english: I will see you both at the boathouse in Burgh de Rott. We can use the boat there to get to this graveyard. Good luck.
translation: 我在伯格德罗特镇的船屋等你们。我们可以用那里的船前往这个墓地。祝好运。

english: Hey there [player name]. I think I'm all ready to depart when you are.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。我想我已经准备好了，随时可以出发。

english: What's our plan?
translation: 我们的计划是什么？

english: We need to travel through Mort Myre Swamp to Burgh de Rott. We may encounter all kinds of evil on our way, so you'd probably best prepare to fight.
translation: 我们需要穿过莫尔迈尔沼泽前往伯格德罗特镇。路上可能会遇到各种邪恶，所以你最好做好战斗准备。

english: Are you ready to go to Burgh de Rott?
translation: 准备好去伯格德罗特镇了吗？

english: Then let us depart.
translation: 那我们就出发吧。

english: Okay, I'll be here once you're ready.
translation: 好的，我在这里等你准备好。

english: I'm good. The swamps haven't beaten me yet.
translation: 我没事。沼泽还没打败我呢。

english: How are things between you and Veliaf?
translation: 你和维利亚夫之间怎么样？

english: Oh don't be worrying about that. Veliaf and I butt heads all the time. It's harmless, though. He's like a father to me.
translation: 哦，别担心那个。维利亚夫和我总是意见不合。不过没关系的。他对我来说就像父亲一样。

english: He seems to worry a lot about you.
translation: 他似乎很担心你。

english: He thinks I'd be safer back with Drezel. I can't stay hidden away forever though. Drezel's teachings were valuable, but I can ultimately do more good out here.
translation: 他觉得我回到德雷泽尔那里会更安全。但我不能永远躲藏起来。德雷泽尔的教诲很有价值，但最终我在这里能发挥更大的作用。

english: And what of the Calsidiu stuff?
translation: 那卡尔西迪乌的事呢？

english: Hmm. I still need to think on that. Ask me again later.
translation: 嗯。我还在考虑这件事。之后再来问我吧。

english: What do you think of this Vanescula business?
translation: 你怎么看瓦内斯库拉这件事？

english: It's dangerous, but we don't have any choice. Besides, we're no strangers to danger.
translation: 很危险，但我们别无选择。再说，我们对危险并不陌生。

english: Who knows, maybe this will even work out for us.
translation: 谁知道呢，说不定这对我们反而有好处。

english: And if it doesn't?
translation: 如果不行呢？

english: Keep that flail of yours nearby.
translation: 把你的连枷带在身边。

english: That was great! But we really should be heading off now.
translation: 太棒了！不过我们真的该出发了。

english: Rotten luck! The bridge is out. Do you think there's a way over?
translation: 真倒霉！桥断了。你觉得有办法过去吗？

english: I reckon we can come up with something.
translation: 我想我们能想出办法。

english: And what do we have here? Looks like some fresh Myreque meat!
translation: 看看我们这儿有什么？看起来像是新鲜的迈雷克肉！

english: Hang on... That's the Slayer! The one that killed Ranis Drakan!
translation: 等等……那是杀戮者！就是杀了拉尼斯.德雷坎的那个！

english: Another successful journey. Thanks, [player name].
translation: 又一次成功之旅。谢谢，[player name]。

english: I'll meet you down at the boathouse. I imagine Veliaf is there already.
translation: 我在船屋和你会合。我想维利亚夫已经在那里了。

english: Well, here we are. Likely going to our doom.
translation: 嗯，我们到了。很可能要去送死了。

english: At least we go together.
translation: 至少我们一起去吧。

english: Touching, but ultimately meaningless.
translation: 感人，但终究毫无意义。

english: Ever the optimist, aren't you Veliaf?
translation: 真是个乐观主义者，不是吗，维利亚夫？

english: Is everything ready?
translation: 一切准备就绪了吗？

english: Radigad has scouted out the graveyard. It's empty, for now. Vanescula's probably waiting for all of us to arrive before she makes her move.
translation: 拉迪加德已经侦查过墓地了。目前是空的。范尼斯库拉可能正在等我们所有人到齐才行动。

english: What of Safalaan and the others?
translation: 萨法兰和其他人呢？

english: Polmafi managed to get in contact with them. They will meet us there.
translation: 波尔马菲设法联系上了他们。他们会在那里与我们会合。

english: I guess we'd better get going then.
translation: 那我想我们最好出发了。

english: Indeed. No point delaying the inevitable. Hop in the boat once you're ready, friend. We're right behind you.
translation: 确实。拖延不可避免的事毫无意义。准备好就上船吧，朋友。我们紧跟在你后面。

english: Hop in the boat once you're ready, friend. We're right behind you.
translation: 准备好就上船吧，朋友。我们紧跟在你后面。

english: Hey. You should get into the boat if you're ready to go.
translation: 嘿。如果你准备好出发了，就上船吧。

english: Good to see you, [player name].
translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]。

english: And you, Kael.
translation: 我也是，凯尔。

english: You'd best talk to Veliaf and Safalaan. They are the big bosses after all.
translation: 你最好去和维利亚夫、萨法兰谈谈。毕竟他们才是大Boss。

english: I'll go speak to them.
translation: 我去和他们谈谈。

english: Well met friend.
translation: 幸会，朋友。

english: Radigad. Good to see you.
translation: 拉迪加德。很高兴见到你。

english: I hope you came well armed my friend. These are dangerous times.
translation: 我希望你带足了武器，我的朋友。现在时局危险。

english: When are they not?
translation: 什么时候不是呢？

english: True. It looks like Veliaf and Safalaan are waiting for you. We will talk more later.
translation: 没错。看起来维利亚夫和萨法兰在等你。我们稍后再聊。

english: Hey [player name]. Looks like Veliaf and Safalaan want to speak to you. Let's talk after.
translation: 嘿[player name]。看起来维利亚夫和萨法兰想和你谈谈。我们之后再聊。

english: Okay. See you soon.
translation: 好的。待会见。

english: Ah, [player name]. Glad to have you with us. Myreque prevail.
translation: 啊，[player name]。很高兴有你加入。迈雷克必胜。

english: Good to see you Vertida. How are things?
translation: 很高兴见到你，维蒂达。情况如何？

english: To be honest, I don't know. Ask me again if we're still alive after this meeting.
translation: 老实说，我不知道。等这次会面后我们还活着的话，再问我吧。

english: Fair enough. Talk later.
translation: 有道理。回头聊。

english: Hello there. Have you spoken to Veliaf and Safalaan?
translation: 你好。你和维利亚夫、萨法兰谈过了吗？

english: Ah, probably best that you do. That vampyre could arrive at any moment.
translation: 啊，最好去谈谈。那个吸血鬼随时可能出现。

english: Veliaf! It has been far too long my friend.
translation: 维利亚夫！太久不见了，我的朋友。

english: Good to see you, Safalaan. Though I wish it were under better circumstances.
translation: 很高兴见到你，萨法兰。尽管我希望是在更好的情况下。

english: Indeed. And [player name], good to see you as well. Myreque prevail.
translation: 确实。还有[player name]，也很高兴见到你。迈雷克必胜。

english: Myreque prevail, Safalaan. How are things in Meiyerditch?
translation: 迈雷克必胜，萨法兰。迈尔迪奇情况如何？

english: As dark as ever, my friend. The vyrewatch have doubled their efforts to find us since the death of Ranis and the citizens are being tithed more than ever before.
translation: 一如既往的黑暗，我的朋友。自从拉尼斯死后，吸血鬼哨兵加倍努力寻找我们，市民被征收的贡品比以往任何时候都多。

english: That said, it does feel like there is now a glimmer of hope where previously there was only darkness. While more ferocious, the vampyres also seem a bit more cautious now.
translation: 话虽如此，之前只有黑暗的地方，现在确实感觉有一线希望。虽然更凶猛了，但吸血鬼现在似乎也谨慎了一些。

english: They know we can kill them. They finally know what fear feels like.
translation: 他们知道我们能杀死他们。他们终于知道恐惧是什么滋味了。

english: We're also seeing greater support from the people than ever before. Whereas once they'd only speak of the Myreque in whispers, now they speak of us loudly and with pride.
translation: 我们还看到来自人民的支持比以往任何时候都多。以前他们只敢低声谈论迈雷克，现在他们大声而自豪地谈论我们。

english: Anyway, let's focus on the matter at hand. I must say Veliaf, over the years I've come to expect the unexpected, but your message was something else altogether.
translation: 总之，让我们专注于眼前的事。我得说，维利亚夫，这些年来我已经习惯了意外，但你的消息完全是另一回事。

english: I mean, Vanescula Drakan herself! We find ourselves in very strange times.
translation: 我是说，范尼斯库拉.德雷坎本人！我们发现自己身处非常奇怪的时期。

english: Strange, and also dangerous. I do not like any aspect of this.
translation: 奇怪，也很危险。我不喜欢这件事的任何一面。

english: Well I won't pretend this isn't risky. But I have faith in [player name], here. The first human to kill a vyre, and quite the vyre it was. Vanescula would be unwise to try anything.
translation: 好吧，我不会假装这不冒险。但我对[player name]有信心。他是第一个杀死维尔吸血鬼的人类，而且还是个不一般的维尔吸血鬼。范尼斯库拉要做什么就是不智之举。

english: Speaking of [player name], about that other matter I mentioned in my message...
translation: 说到[player name]，关于我在消息中提到的另一件事……

english: Ah, of course. [player name], after due consideration by Veliaf and I, we would like to promote you to the rank of lieutenant in the Myreque. Congratulations!
translation: 啊，当然。[player name]，经过我和维利亚夫的充分考虑，我们想晋升你为迈雷克的中尉。恭喜！

english: You've done well, friend. I realise it doesn't mean much, but we wanted to thank you in some way for all of your work so far.
translation: 你做得很好，朋友。我知道这不算什么，但我们想以某种方式感谢你迄今为止所做的一切。

english: Thank you. It's a great honour.
translation: 谢谢。这是极大的荣誉。

english: I wish we had time to celebrate, but time is in short supply these days. I imagine Vanescula will be here very soon. Are we ready?
translation: 我希望我们有时间庆祝，但最近时间紧迫。我想范尼斯库拉很快就会到。我们准备好了吗？

english: As ready as we'll ever be. Let's do this.
translation: 和以往一样准备好了。开始吧。

english: Well Vanescula, here we are. All the Myreque, just like you wanted.
translation: 好了，范尼斯库拉，我们来了。所有迈雷克成员，正如你所愿。

english: Your move.
translation: 该你出招了。

english: I'm impressed Veliaf. I did fear you'd go and do something silly.
translation: 很佩服你，维利亚夫。我确实担心你会做出什么蠢事来。

english: Skip the small talk. Why are we here?
translation: 别寒暄了。我们来这里干什么？

english: Fine. Conversing with you is a chore, anyway.
translation: 好吧。反正和你谈话也是件苦差事。

english: The reason I have gathered you all here is because I have an offer for you.
translation: 我把你们召集到这里的原因是我有一个提议给你们。

english: Now I won't deny, you've not done a bad job. Killing Ranis was no small achievement, but you managed it all the same.
translation: 我不否认，你们做得不错。杀死拉尼斯不是小成就，但你们还是办到了。

english: Unfortunately for you, you're still no closer to the true prize.
translation: 对你们来说不幸的是，你们离真正的目标仍然很远。

english: Lowerniel Drakan.
translation: 洛厄尼尔.德雷坎。

english: Indeed. That is why I have come to you. Only with my help will you have any hope of killing my brother.
translation: 没错。这就是我来找你们的原因。只有在我的帮助下，你们才有希望杀死我的兄弟。

english: And what do you gain from this?
translation: 你从中能得到什么？

english: Long ago, the land of Morytania was known as Hallowvale and it was ruled over by a race of Saradominists called the icyene.
translation: 很久以前，莫利塔尼亚这片土地被称为哈洛维尔，由一个信奉萨拉多明的种族——冰裔统治。

english: But then your brother came along.
translation: 但后来你的兄弟出现了。

english: Correct. Hallowvale was taken over by my kind, and Lowerniel became ruler of the newly named Morytania.
translation: 正确。哈洛维尔被我的种族占领，洛厄尼尔成为了新命名的莫利塔尼亚的统治者。

english: And you know what? It was the worst thing that ever happened to us.
translation: 你知道吗？那是发生在我们身上最糟糕的事。

english: My brother was a great conqueror, make no mistake. But he is a poor ruler. And now, thanks to him, our society is collapsing.
translation: 我兄弟是个伟大的征服者，别搞错了。但他是个糟糕的统治者。现在，拜他所赐，我们的社会正在崩溃。

english: Collapsing how?
translation: 怎么崩溃？

english: I know you've already been investigating Damien Leucurte and his not so secret arrangement with some of Darkmeyer's nobles.
translation: 我知道你们已经在调查达米恩.勒库尔特以及他与达克迈尔一些贵族之间并不秘密的勾当。

english: Tell me, have you worked out why this arrangement exists?
translation: 告诉我，你们搞清楚为什么会有这种勾当了吗？

english: We could have a good guess.
translation: 我们可以猜个大概。

english: Well I can give you better than guesses. Allow me to offer some clarity.
translation: 我能给出比猜测更好的答案。请允许我澄清一下。

english: Every day that goes by, the number of humans in Morytania decreases. Yet while this happens, our population continues to grow. Unsurprisingly, we no longer have enough blood to go around.
translation: 每一天过去，莫利塔尼亚的人类数量都在减少。然而与此同时，我们的人口却在持续增长。毫不意外，我们的血已经不够分了。

english: Yeah, yeah. We've suspected as much for a long time. Why is this relevant?
translation: 是啊，是啊。我们早就怀疑了。这有什么关系？

english: It's relevant because while all of this happens, our great leader remains absent. Lowerniel never liked to show his face, but these days it's as if he doesn't even exist. He spends months in his chambers, refusing to see anyone.
translation: 这很重要，因为当这一切发生时，我们伟大的领袖仍然缺席。洛厄尼尔向来不喜欢露面，但如今他就像根本不存在一样。他连续几个月待在自己的房间里，拒绝见任何人。

english: So you wish to take his place. What makes you think we'll help you with that?
translation: 所以你想取代他的位置。凭什么认为我们会帮你？

english: There was once a time where humans and vampyres lived together in a great empire. Under my rule, I would see us return to that way of life.
translation: 曾经有一段时间，人类和吸血鬼共同生活在一个伟大的帝国里。在我的统治下，我希望我们回归那种生活方式。

english: Morytania would become a land of peace and prosperity, with humans and vampyres living side by side.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚将成为一个和平繁荣的土地，人类和吸血鬼并肩生活。

english: Or we could just kill both you and your brother and take back Morytania for humanity!
translation: 或者我们可以干脆杀了你和你兄弟，为人类夺回莫利塔尼亚！

english: Ha! You could try. Even if you were to succeed though, which isn't likely, one of the other vampyre lords or ladies would just take over instead.
translation: 哈！你可以试试。就算你成功了，虽然可能性不大，其他吸血鬼贵族之一也会接管。

english: No. If you want to save your people, my way is the only way.
translation: 不。如果你们想拯救自己的人民，我的方法是唯一的办法。

english: Why do you need us though? Why not just kill your brother yourself?
translation: 可你为什么需要我们？为什么不自己杀了你兄弟？

english: I could, but even today there are many in Darkmeyer who still blindly believe in Lowerniel. It will be much easier for me to take his place if I am not responsible for his demise.
translation: 我可以，但即使在今天，达克迈尔仍有许多人盲目相信洛厄尼尔。如果我不对他的死负责，我取代他的位置会容易得多。

english: You'd have us become your scapegoats.
translation: 你想让我们成为你的替罪羊。

english: Is that such a bad thing? Your people would consider you heroes. You'd be the ones to finally kill Lowerniel Drakan.
translation: 这有什么不好？你的人民会把你们视为英雄。你们将是最终杀死洛厄尼尔.德雷坎的人。

english: How do we know you won't just kill us once this is done?
translation: 我们怎么知道事情结束后你不会杀了我们？

english: You don't. But Castle Drakan is impenetrable. You'll never get inside on your own, and Lowerniel clearly has no intention of coming out. This is your only option.
translation: 你们不知道。但德雷戛纳堡固若金汤。你们自己永远进不去，而洛厄尼尔显然没有出来的打算。这是你们唯一的选择。

english: Oh, it's probably also worth mentioning that I can't afford any loose ends. If you decline, I would expect you to leave Morytania immediately.
translation: 哦，可能还值得一提的是，我不能留下任何后患。如果你们拒绝，我希望你们立即离开莫利塔尼亚。

english: To stay would have dire consequences for your life expectancy.
translation: 留下来将对你们的寿命造成严重后果。

english: Say we accept your offer. How do you propose to get us into the castle?
translation: 假设我们接受你的提议。你打算怎么带我们进入城堡？

english: Ah yes, the plan itself. You will pose as my prisoners and I shall escort you to Castle Drakan. Your capture is something that even Lowerniel will be unable to ignore.
translation: 啊，是的，计划本身。你们将假扮成我的囚犯，我将护送你们到德雷戛纳堡。你们的被捕即使是洛厄尼尔也无法忽视。

english: And once inside, we kill him.
translation: 一旦进入，我们就杀了他。

english: Exactly. A nice and simple plan.
translation: 正是。一个简洁的计划。

english: Too simple, if you ask me.
translation: 按我说，太简单了。

english: Never happy are you Veliaf?
translation: 你从来就没满意过，是吗，维利亚夫？

english: Of course I'm not happy. You expect us to just hop into bed with you? You are the enemy! You always have been, and you always will be! We will have no part in this.
translation: 我当然不高兴。你指望我们就这么跟你同流合污？你是敌人！一直是，永远是！我们不会参与这件事。

english: Come now, don't be so hasty. You should at least think things over. While you do, I would appreciate a private chat with Safalaan.
translation: 得了吧，别这么草率。你至少应该考虑一下。在你考虑的时候，我想和萨法兰私下谈谈。

english: Yes, you. Join me by the large mausoleum at the back of the graveyard. There is something we need to discuss.
translation: 是的，你。到墓地后面的大陵墓旁找我。有件事我们需要讨论。

english: What makes you think we're just going to let you walk off with him?
translation: 你凭什么认为我们会让你把他带走？

english: This is growing boringly repetitive, Veliaf. For the last time, if I wanted any of you dead, I'd have done it by now.
translation: 这越来越无聊地重复了，维利亚夫。最后一次说，如果我想让你们任何人死，我早就动手了。

english: It's alright Veliaf. I will go.
translation: 没事的，维利亚夫。我去。

english: Hmm. Well [player name] has to go with you. I want him there in case Vanescula here tries anything.
translation: 嗯。好吧，[player name]必须和你一起去。我要他在场以防这里的范尼斯库拉耍什么花招。

english: Very well. Safalaan, [player name], if you'll please join me.
translation: 很好。萨法兰，[player name]，请跟我来。

english: Safalaan Hallow. Interesting name, isn't it?
translation: 萨法兰.哈洛。有趣的名字，不是吗？

english: The name 'Hallow'. Do you know where it comes from?
translation: '哈洛'这个名字。你知道它从何而来吗？

english: It's common in these parts. They say it was the name of the old Saradominist rulers.
translation: 在这附近很常见。据说那是旧萨拉多明统治者们的名字。

english: Spot on. You know your history. The family of icyene that ruled over Hallowvale were the Hallow family. And so of course, the name of the region is no coincidence.
translation: 说得对。你了解历史。统治哈洛河谷的伊希恩家族就是哈洛家族。当然，这个地区的名字并非巧合。

english: I'm surprised your brother didn't have it renamed 'Drakanvale'.
translation: 我很惊讶你兄弟没有把它改名为“德雷肯河谷”。

english: Good name, but not really his style I'm afraid.
translation: 好名字，但恐怕不是他的风格。

english: What's your game, Vanescula? Why do you care about my name?
translation: 你到底想干什么，凡妮斯库拉？你为什么在意我的名字？

english: Do you not find it odd that you share a name with the former royal family?
translation: 你不觉得你和前王室同名很奇怪吗？

english: No, I don't. Like I say, around here the name is pretty ordinary.
translation: 不，我不觉得。就像我说的，在这附近这个名字很普通。

english: Ah, but you are far from ordinary, aren't you Safalaan? Tell me, how much do you remember of your childhood?
translation: 啊，但你远非普通，对吧萨法兰？告诉我，你还记得多少童年的事？

english: Nothing. I remember nothing of my childhood. You can thank your friend Vanstrom for that. He always wanted me dead, even back before the Myreque were a thing. One day he nearly succeeded.
translation: 什么都没有。我对童年毫无记忆。这都得感谢你的朋友范斯特罗姆。他一直想让我死，甚至在迈雷克成立之前。有一天他差点成功了。

english: But your powers stopped him?
translation: 但你的力量阻止了他？

english: You know about Safalaan's powers?
translation: 你知道萨法兰的力量？

english: I know many things about Safalaan. It's why we are here, in fact. But please, go on.
translation: 我对萨法兰了解很多。事实上，这就是我们在这里的原因。但请继续。

english: It's why we're here? What do you mean? What is all this?
translation: 这就是我们在这里的原因？你什么意思？这一切是怎么回事？

english: Finish your story. I promise that everything will be made clear.
translation: 讲完你的故事。我保证一切都会真相大白。

english: Fine, but it's starting to seem like you already know everything anyway.
translation: 好吧，但反正你好像已经什么都知道了一样。

english: You're right about my powers. I was able to use them to drive Vanstrom away. It came at a cost though.
translation: 你关于我的力量说得对。我确实用它们赶走了范斯特罗姆。不过付出了代价。

english: I remember nothing of the event, nor of anything that happened in my life before it. The only thing I remembered was my name.
translation: 我对那件事毫无记忆，对之前生活中发生的一切也毫无记忆。我唯一记得的就是我的名字。

english: There, story told. Now, tell me, why are we having this conversation?
translation: 好了，故事讲完了。现在告诉我，我们为什么要进行这次谈话？

english: This graveyard is no normal graveyard. It was once the private graveyard of the Hallow family. Every member of the royal family was buried here.
translation: 这个墓地不是普通的墓地。它曾是哈洛家族的私人墓地。每位王室成员都安葬在这里。

english: When she was still in power, the ruler of Hallowvale, Queen Efaritay Hallow, had this mausoleum built. It was constructed to one day house her and her human husband, King Ascertes Hallow.
translation: 当她掌权时，哈洛河谷的统治者埃法里泰.哈洛女王建造了这座陵墓。它被建成，有朝一日容纳她和她的凡人丈夫阿斯克特斯.哈洛国王。

english: Inside, I believe you will find the truth that you've spent your whole life searching for.
translation: 在里面，我相信你会找到你一生追寻的真相。

english: Stop with these games! If you know something, tell me!
translation: 别玩这些把戏了！如果你知道什么，就告诉我！

english: Would you actually believe me if I did? To you, my words are just that, words. Inside this mausoleum lies something far more reliable, proof.
translation: 如果我告诉了你，你真的会相信吗？对你来说，我的话只是话语。这座陵墓里有更可靠的东西——证据。

english: Well noted. We'll need to unlock it.
translation: 说得对。我们需要打开它。

english: I bet I can get it open.
translation: 我打赌我能打开它。

english: Wonderful. It's an interesting lock. The icyene always were devious. From what I can tell, you'll need to ensure that the total value of each row and column matches the number at the end.
translation: 太好了。这是个有趣的锁。冰族总是那么狡猾。据我所知，你需要确保每一行和每一根柱子的总值与末尾的数字匹配。

english: Now, off you go.
translation: 现在，去吧。

english: Any luck with the lock, [player name]?
translation: 锁有进展吗，[player name]？

english: Try to hurry. I don't like these games that Vanescula is playing.
translation: 尽量快点。我不喜欢凡妮斯库拉玩的这些把戏。

english: You need to get this door open. From what I can tell, you'll need to ensure that the total value of each row and column on the lock matches the number at the end.
translation: 你需要打开这扇门。据我所知，你需要确保锁上每一行和每一根柱子的总值与末尾的数字匹配。

english: Keep an eye on Safalaan, [player name]. I don't like leaving him alone with that vampyre.
translation: 看好萨法兰，[player name]。我不喜欢让他单独和那个吸血鬼待在一起。

english: Hey [player name]. You need to be over with Safalaan and Vanescula. We'll talk later.
translation: 嘿[player name]。你需要到萨法兰和凡妮斯库拉那边去。我们稍后再谈。

english: Best we don't talk right now, [player name]. You need to be watching Safalaan and Vanescula and I don't want to distract you.
translation: 最好我们现在别说话，[player name]。你需要盯着萨法兰和凡妮斯库拉，我不想分散你的注意力。

english: Shouldn't you be with Safalaan?
translation: 你不是应该和萨法兰在一起吗？

english: Oh yes, I'd better go to him.
translation: 哦对，我最好去找他。

english: Now's not the time for chat, [player name]. You're meant to be watching Safalaan and Vanescula.
translation: 现在不是聊天的时候，[player name]。你应该看着萨法兰和凡妮斯库拉。

english: You should be keeping an eye on Safalaan and Vanescula. We will talk later.
translation: 你应该盯着萨法兰和凡妮斯库拉。我们稍后再谈。

english: There's a plaque on the coffin.
translation: 棺材上有一块牌匾。

english: It reads:
translation: 上面写着：

english: 'Here lies Larina Hallow. Beloved daughter of Efaritay and Ascertes Hallow and...'
translation: “此处安葬着拉里娜.哈洛。埃法里泰和阿斯克特斯.哈洛的爱女，且……”

english: '...and faithful sister of Safalaan Hallow.'
translation: “……且是萨法兰.哈洛的忠实妹妹。”

english: I... I don't...
translation: 我……我不……

english: No! It can't be true! It can't be!
translation: 不！这不是真的！不可能！

english: I'm sorry Safalaan, but it is true. You are the half- human, half-icyene son of Queen Efaritay Hallow.
translation: 抱歉萨法兰，但这是真的。你是埃法里泰.哈洛女王半人半伊希恩的儿子。

english: A sister... I had a sister. And my powers?
translation: 一个妹妹……我有个妹妹。那我的力量呢？

english: The powers of an icyene, yes.
translation: 伊希恩的力量，是的。

english: But... I don't understand...
translation: 但是……我不明白……

english: I realise it's a lot to take in.
translation: 我知道这很难接受。

english: No. What I mean is, you said that this tomb was built for Efaritay and Ascertes, for my mother and father. But they're not here.
translation: 不。我的意思是，你说这座陵墓是为埃法里泰和阿塞特斯建造的，是为我的母亲和父亲。但他们并不在这里。

english: Where are they Vanescula?
translation: 他们在哪里，凡妮斯库拉？

english: Safalaan I...
translation: 萨法兰，我……

english: No! No more games! I know why you've done this. You don't care for me. You're just trying to manipulate me!
translation: 不！别再玩把戏了！我知道你为什么这么做。你并不关心我。你只是想操纵我！

english: Well fine, it worked. If you want my support in killing your brother, you will have it. But you must tell me, where are my parents?
translation: 好吧，成功了。如果你想让我支持杀死你兄弟，我会支持。但你必须告诉我，我的父母在哪里？

english: The war for this land was long and bloody. We were winning, but with heavy losses. Lowerniel didn't mind. He was a hunter and a warrior. In his eyes, there was no death more noble than one in battle.
translation: 这片土地的战争漫长而血腥。我们节节胜利，但损失惨重。洛尔尼尔并不在意。他是个猎人和战士。在他看来，没有比战死更光荣的死法。

english: Many didn't share that view though, and wanted the war to be over. Ranis was one of them. He managed to infiltrate Efaritay's castle. Once inside, he captured your father, Ascertes.
translation: 然而许多人并不认同，并希望战争结束。拉尼斯就是其中之一。他设法潜入了埃法里泰的城堡。进去后，他俘虏了你的父亲阿斯克特斯。

english: Efaritay surrendered that same day. She walked into Lowerniel's camp, alone, and willingly handed herself in. I guess she had hoped that Lowerniel would free your father in exchange for her.
translation: 埃法里泰当天就投降了。她独自走进洛尔尼尔的营地，甘愿自首。我猜她曾希望洛尔尼尔会以她交换释放你的父亲。

english: But he didn't, did he?
translation: 但他没有，对吧？

english: No. After that, I'm afraid I don't know what happened to your mother. No one ever saw her again. Only Lowerniel himself knows her fate.
translation: 没有。那之后，恐怕我不知道你母亲发生了什么事。再也没有人见过她。只有洛尔尼尔本人知道她的命运。

english: And my father?
translation: 那我父亲呢？

english: Like I said, we suffered heavy losses in the war. We needed a way to quickly restore our numbers. Vampyrification was the answer. Your father was the first of many to go through the process.
translation: 就像我说的，我们在战争中损失惨重。我们需要一种方法快速恢复人数。吸血鬼化是答案。你的父亲是众多经历这一过程的人中的第一个。

english: You turned him into a vampyre? You monsters!
translation: 你们把他变成了吸血鬼？你们这些怪物！

english: Lowerniel turned him into a vampyre, not I.
translation: 是洛尔尼尔把他变成了吸血鬼，不是我。

english: But you were there, by his side. Do you expect me to believe that you're not just like him?
translation: 但你当时就在那里，在他身边。你指望我相信你和他不一样？

english: I can't control what you believe, but I am not the enemy here.
translation: 我无法控制你相信什么，但我不是这里的敌人。

english: What happened then? After you had your way with him, what became of my father?
translation: 然后发生了什么？在你们对他为所欲为之后，我父亲怎么样了？

english: He still lives to this day, under a different name of course.
translation: 他一直活到今天，当然是用了一个不同的名字。

english: What name? Tell me!
translation: 什么名字？告诉我！

english: Vanstrom Klause.
translation: 范斯特罗姆.克劳斯。

english: No! You're lying! You said it yourself earlier, I have no reason to believe you!
translation: 不！你在撒谎！你自己之前说过，我没有理由相信你！

english: Everything I have told you is the truth. Only you can decide if you want to believe it.
translation: 我告诉你的一切都是真的。只有你自己能决定是否相信。

english: Safalaan...
translation: 萨法兰……

english: My family...
translation: 我的家人……

english: Alright Vanescula, you win. If you want Lowerniel dead, you will have the support of the Myreque. I ask only one thing.
translation: 好吧凡妮斯库拉，你赢了。如果你想让洛尔尼尔死，你会得到迈雷克的支持。我只请求一件事。

english: When the time comes, I will be the one to kill him. He will pay for what he has done to me and my family.
translation: 到时候，我会亲手杀了他。他会为对我和我家人所做的一切付出代价。

english: So be it. You should inform the rest of your group.
translation: 就这样吧。你应该通知你的其他同伴。

english: [player name], I need some time to think over what we have discovered here. Please, inform the others for me.
translation: [player name]，我需要一些时间思考我们在这里发现的一切。请替我去告知其他人。

english: Now, both of you leave. I need some time alone.
translation: 现在，你们俩都离开。我需要一个人待一会儿。

english: No. You need to tell your companions about Safalaan's decision. Now, get going.
translation: 不。你需要把萨法兰的决定告诉你的同伴们。现在，走吧。

english: Myreque prevail, [player name].
translation: 迈雷克必胜，[player name]。

english: Myreque prevail, Vertida.
translation: 迈雷克必胜，维蒂达。

english: I saw you head into that mausoleum with Safalaan and Vanescula. What's going on?
translation: 我看到你和萨法兰、凡妮斯库拉一起走进了那座陵墓。发生什么事了？

english: Turns out this graveyard is more than just a quiet meeting place. That mausoleum contained the truth behind Safalaan's heritage.
translation: 原来这个墓地不仅仅是一个安静的会面点。那座陵墓里隐藏着萨法兰身世背后的真相。

english: Truth? What do you mean?
translation: 真相？什么意思？

english: Safalaan is the only living child of Efaritay Hallow, the former queen of Hallowvale.
translation: 萨法兰是哈洛河谷前任女王埃法里泰.哈洛唯一在世的孩子。

english: By Saradomin!
translation: 萨拉多明在上！

english: Is he okay? That's quite the sudden discovery.
translation: 他还好吗？这发现太突然了。

english: He wishes to be alone. In the meantime, he asked me to speak to everyone.
translation: 他想一个人待着。与此同时，他让我跟大家谈谈。

english: He's agreed to work with her, hasn't he?
translation: 他同意和她合作了，对吧？

english: I know what he's like. I've known Safalaan longer than anyone. When Vanstrom attacked him and he lost his memory, I was the one that found him.
translation: 我知道他什么样。我认识萨法兰比任何人都久。当范斯特罗姆袭击他并使他失忆时，是我找到了他。

english: Well, if Safalaan wants to work with Vanescula, then he has my support.
translation: 好吧，如果萨法兰想和凡妮斯库拉合作，那我支持他。

english: Oh. That was easy. I was expecting you to disagree with him.
translation: 哦。这么简单。我还以为你会反对他。

english: I trust Safalaan. He's made some mistakes, sure. But he's a good leader and I know he won't have made this choice lightly. Tell him he has my support all the way on this.
translation: 我信任萨法兰。他确实犯过一些错误。但他是个好领袖，我知道他不会轻率做出这个选择。告诉他我全力支持他。

english: Alright, thanks Vertida.
translation: 好的，谢谢维蒂达。

english: Have you spoken to the others about the plan?
translation: 你跟其他人说过这个计划了吗？

english: I'm doing that now.
translation: 我现在正在做。

english: Well I'll let you get back to it then.
translation: 那我就不打扰你了。

english: Hello there. I hope Vanescula isn't causing trouble.
translation: 你好。我希望凡妮斯库拉没有制造麻烦。

english: Not yet she isn't. In fact, Safalaan has decided he wants to work with her.
translation: 目前还没有。事实上，萨法兰已经决定要和她合作。

english: He does? Why?
translation: 他决定？为什么？

english: She showed him the truth about his family. That seemed to convince him.
translation: 她向他展示了他家族的真相。这似乎说服了他。

english: Oh dear. I fear she is trying to manipulate him.
translation: 哦，天哪。我担心她试图操纵他。

english: So you don't agree with his decision?
translation: 所以你不同意他的决定？

english: Vanescula does not strike me as someone that fails to consider every detail of a plan. However, you must have spotted the clear holes in this scheme to kill her brother.
translation: 瓦内斯库拉给我的印象不是那种会不考虑计划每个细节的人。不过，你一定发现了这个杀死她兄弟的计划中的明显漏洞。

english: Her plan detailed getting us in and killing her brother. But there was no mention of getting us out again. We'll have just killed the ruler of Morytania. To the vampyres, we'll be public enemy number one.
translation: 她的计划详细说明了让我们进去杀死她兄弟，但根本没提怎么让我们再出来。我们刚杀了莫利塔尼亚的统治者。对吸血鬼来说，我们会成为头号公敌。

english: If you ask me, I reckon that Vanescula will kill us all as soon as her brother is out of the picture.
translation: 要我说，我估计她兄弟一完蛋，瓦内斯库拉就会把我们都杀了。

english: So you don't support the plan?
translation: 所以你不支持这个计划？

english: I'm afraid not. Killing Lowerniel Drakan is no victory at all if he just gets replaced with his sister. Especially if it results in our demise.
translation: 恐怕不支持。如果洛厄尼尔.德雷坎只是被他妹妹取代，那杀死他根本不算胜利。尤其如果这导致我们丧命的话。

english: Fair enough. I'll see what the others think.
translation: 有道理。我去看看其他人的想法。

english: Hello. I was wondering if you'd changed your mind about working with Vanescula?
translation: 你好。我想知道你是否改变主意，愿意和瓦内斯库拉合作了？

english: Well maybe it doesn't have to. Radigad has a plan of his own. He thinks that once her brother is dead, we should kill Vanescula as well.
translation: 嗯，也许不一定。拉迪加德有自己的计划。他认为一旦她兄弟死了，我们也应该杀了瓦内斯库拉。

english: An interesting proposal. Do you think we can do it?
translation: 一个有趣的提议。你觉得我们能做到吗？

english: If we can kill Lowerniel, we can kill her. He's meant to be the most powerful vampyre around.
translation: 如果我们能杀死洛厄尼尔，就能杀死她。他可是据说周围最强大的吸血鬼。

english: A fair point. And I guess if we can't kill Lowerniel, what does it matter at that point. We'll all be dead.
translation: 有道理。而且我猜如果我们杀不了洛厄尼尔，那时也没什么区别了。我们都会死。

english: A pleasant thought. So, are you still against the plan?
translation: 令人愉快的想法。那么，你仍然反对这个计划吗？

english: I still fear it's a trap. But perhaps our best move now is to spring that trap. You've convinced me. I will support Safalaan.
translation: 我仍然担心这是个陷阱。但也许我们现在最好的行动就是触发那个陷阱。你说服了我。我会支持萨法拉安。

english: Hello there. Have you convinced the others to work with Vanescula?
translation: 你好。你说服其他人跟瓦内斯库拉合作了吗？

english: Well keep at it.
translation: 继续努力吧。

english: Hey [player name]. I've been pondering what Vanescula told us about Calsidiu.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。我一直在思考瓦内斯库拉告诉我们关于卡尔西迪乌的事。

english: I understand why Veliaf lied at the time. We were on the brink of defeat. Without a bit of hope, we'd have probably never made it to this point.
translation: 我理解为什么维利亚夫当时撒谎了。我们濒临失败。如果没有一丝希望，我们很可能根本走不到这一步。

english: But I don't think we need that false hope any more. Now, we have real hope. Ranis Drakan is dead! Ranis Drakan! He was Lowerniel Drakan's own brother!
translation: 但我认为我们不再需要那种虚假的希望了。现在，我们有了真正的希望。拉尼斯.德雷坎死了！拉尼斯.德雷坎！他可是洛厄尼尔.德雷坎的亲兄弟！

english: If Ranis can die, so can the rest. Lowerniel's days are numbered.
translation: 如果拉尼斯能死，其他人也能。洛厄尼尔的日子屈指可数了。

english: So you're not angry at Veliaf?
translation: 所以你不生维利亚夫的气？

english: No. He did what he believed was right. In the end, that's all any of us can do.
translation: 不生气。他做了他认为正确的事。说到底，我们每个人也只能做到这样。

english: Well on that note, how do you feel about Vanescula's plan?
translation: 既然如此，你对瓦内斯库拉的计划怎么看？

english: It's dangerous, but so what? We're the Myreque, danger is what we do. I say we go for it.
translation: 很危险，但那又怎样？我们是迈雷克，危险就是我们的家常便饭。我说我们就干吧。

english: It seems you're not alone with that sentiment. Safalaan wishes to work with Vanescula.
translation: 看来有此想法的不止你一个。萨法拉安希望与瓦内斯库拉合作。

english: You have my support [player name]. It's Veliaf you need to convince.
translation: 你得到我的支持了，[player name]。你需要说服的是维利亚夫。

english: I guess I'd better talk to him then.
translation: 那我最好去跟他谈谈。

english: Hey [player name]. Any luck with Veliaf?
translation: 嘿，[player name]。说服维利亚夫有进展吗？

english: He can't say no forever. If everyone else is on board, he'll have to agree.
translation: 他不可能永远说不。如果其他人都同意了，他只能答应。

english: Let's hope so. Talk later Ivan.
translation: 希望如此。回头聊，伊万。

english: [player name]. How goes it?
translation: [player name]。怎么样？

english: Safalaan has decided he wants to work with Vanescula.
translation: 萨法拉安决定要和瓦内斯库拉合作。

english: Has he now? A good decision if you ask me.
translation: 是吗？要我说，这是个好决定。

english: Oh yes. Here's how I see it. Vanescula is right, we can't kill her brother without her help.
translation: 哦是的。我是这么看的。瓦内斯库拉说得对，没有她的帮助，我们杀不了她兄弟。

english: I feel like there's a 'but' coming on.
translation: 我感觉要有个'但是'了。

english: But... once the deed is done, we don't have any further need of her. We kill her as well and Morytania is finally free of that wretched family.
translation: 但是……一旦契约完成，我们就不再需要她了。我们也会杀了她，莫利塔尼亚终于摆脱那个可恶的家族了。

english: You heard what she said. If we kill her another vampyre could just take her place.
translation: 你听到了她说的。如果我们杀了她，另一个吸血鬼可能会取代她。

english: Well of course she said that. She needs us to believe that we need her, otherwise her whole plan is done for.
translation: 她当然会那么说。她需要让我们相信我们需要她，否则她的整个计划就泡汤了。

english: Think about it. Lowerniel Drakan is supposedly the most powerful vampyre in existence. What vampyre would dare cross the humans that killed him?
translation: 想想看。洛厄尼尔.德雷坎据说是现存最强大的吸血鬼。哪个吸血鬼敢招惹杀死他的人？

english: You make a fair point. I take it you're happy to work with Vanescula then?
translation: 你说得有理。这么说你愿意跟瓦内斯库拉合作了？

english: Of course! Let's rid Morytania of evil, once and for all!
translation: 当然！让我们一劳永逸地除掉莫利塔尼亚的邪恶吧！

english: I'm still working to convince the others to work with Vanescula.
translation: 我还在说服其他人跟瓦内斯库拉合作。

english: You should let them know my plan. I bet that will convince some of them.
translation: 你应该让他们知道我的计划。我敢打赌那能说服其中一些人。

english: Good idea. Thanks Radigad.
translation: 好主意。谢谢，拉迪加德。

english: And you, Kael. I wanted to talk to you about Vanescula's plan.
translation: 还有你，凯尔。我想跟你谈谈瓦内斯库拉的计划。

english: Appears risky to me, friend. Vampyres are the enemy and she is a vampyre.
translation: 我觉得很冒险，朋友。吸血鬼是敌人，而她是吸血鬼。

english: We take risks every day though, don't we?
translation: 但我们每天都在冒险，不是吗？

english: We do. But some we take because we have to, others because we choose to.
translation: 是的。但有些风险是不得不冒，有些是我们选择去冒的。

english: We took an unnecessary risk back in Meiyerditch with Serafina. Look how that turned out. Flaygian, Mekritus and Andiess. All dead because of that risk.
translation: 当初在迈尔迪奇跟塞拉菲娜那次，我们就冒了不必要的风险。看看结果如何。弗拉吉安、梅克里图斯和安迪厄斯。都因为那次风险死了。

english: Were you close to them?
translation: 你跟他们关系亲近吗？

english: Flaygian and Mekritus? Not particularly. They were good men, and it was sad to lose them, but we were not close.
translation: 弗拉吉安和梅克里图斯？不算特别亲近。他们是好人，失去他们很令人难过，但我们并不亲密。

english: Now, Andiess on the other hand, he and I grew up together. Before Safalaan found us, he was all I had. But now he's gone and nothing I do will ever bring him back.
translation: 现在，至于安迪斯，他和我一起长大。在萨法兰找到我们之前，他就是我的一切。但现在他走了，无论我做什么都无法让他回来。

english: Do you blame Safalaan?
translation: 你怪萨法拉安吗？

english: No. He could not have known what would happen. But that doesn't mean we should take more unnecessary risks.
translation: 不。他不可能预知会发生什么。但这不代表我们应该冒更多不必要的风险。

english: This could be our only chance to kill Lowerniel Drakan. Surely that makes the risk necessary?
translation: 这可能是我们杀死洛厄尼尔.德雷坎的唯一机会。这风险难道不是必要的吗？

english: I want to believe that, I really do. I just don't know if I'm ready to lose any more friends.
translation: 我愿意相信这一点，真的。我只是不知道我是否准备好再失去更多朋友。

english: I can't promise there won't be losses. But what of the losses we've already suffered? If we don't kill Lowerniel Drakan, surely they were all for nothing?
translation: 我不能保证没有损失。但我们已经承受的损失呢？如果我们不杀死洛厄尼尔.德雷坎，那些损失岂不是都白费了？

english: I... I guess you're right. Okay then, I'm in. Let's kill him, for Andiess, and for everyone else who's suffered because of him.
translation: 我……我想你说得对。好吧，算我一个。杀了他，为了安迪厄斯，也为了所有因他受苦的人。

english: He'll regret the day he crossed the Myreque.
translation: 他会后悔招惹迈雷克的那一天。

english: I'd better not disturb you. You need to tell the others about the plan.
translation: 我还是不打扰你了。你需要告诉其他人这个计划。

english: Well met. Tell me, what's Vanescula up to with Safalaan?
translation: 你好。告诉我，瓦内斯库拉跟萨法拉安在搞什么鬼？

english: Turns out Vanescula knows a lot about Safalaan. More than he knows about himself in fact.
translation: 原来瓦内斯库拉对萨法拉安了解很多。实际上比他自己知道的还多。

english: That mausoleum contained the truth about Safalaan's family. He is the only surviving child of Hallowvale's queen, Efaritay Hallow.
translation: 那个陵墓里藏着萨法拉安家族的真相。他是霍洛韦尔女王埃法里泰.霍洛唯一幸存的孩子。

english: No! It can't be!
translation: 不！这不可能！

english: Are you sure this isn't a trick? It could be a trap set by Vanescula?
translation: 你确定这不是诡计？可能是瓦内斯库拉设下的陷阱？

english: Possibly, though I don't think so. It all adds up. What else could explain his strange abilities?
translation: 有可能，虽然我不这么认为。一切都对得上。还有什么能解释他的奇特能力呢？

english: Hmm. I guess it does fit.
translation: 嗯。我想确实对得上。

english: That's not the only thing. Vanescula told us that Safalaan's father still lives, but as a vampyre. Vanstrom Klause.
translation: 不止这些。瓦内斯库拉告诉我们，萨法拉安的父亲还活着，但变成了吸血鬼。范斯特罗姆.克劳斯。

english: Those monsters! How has Safalaan taken this?
translation: 那些怪物！萨法拉安接受得怎么样？

english: As well as can be expected. However, he has decided it's best that we work with Vanescula.
translation: 还算可以。但他决定最好还是跟瓦内斯库拉合作。

english: What? This is a bad idea! She is a vampyre, we can't trust her.
translation: 什么？这是个坏主意！她是吸血鬼，我们不能信任她。

english: So you won't work with her?
translation: 所以你不愿跟她合作？

english: No. I'm sorry, but no. She's trying to manipulate Safalaan but I see through her lies. I can't support this.
translation: 不。抱歉，就是不。她试图操纵萨法拉安，但我看穿了她的谎言。我不能支持这件事。

english: Hello Veliaf. Have you thought any more about working with Vanescula?
translation: 你好，维利亚夫。你进一步考虑跟瓦内斯库拉合作了吗？

english: There is no more thinking to do. The answer is still no.
translation: 没什么好考虑的了。答案仍然是不。

english: You know, all the others have agreed to the plan. It's just you.
translation: 你知道吗，其他所有人都同意了这个计划。只有你。

english: All of them? But why?
translation: 所有人？但是为什么？

english: They all have their reasons. They all seem valid reasons to me.
translation: 他们各有各的理由。在我看来都是正当的理由。

english: But they must know that we can't trust Vanescula.
translation: 但他们一定知道我们不能信任瓦内斯库拉。

english: I think they know that. We do not necessarily need to trust her to work with her.
translation: 我想他们知道。我们不一定需要信任她才能与她合作。

english: Damn it. I don't want to work with her, but I have no intention of abandoning the others to their fate. Fine. Looks like we all get to die together.
translation: 该死。我不想跟她合作，但我也不打算抛弃其他人不管。好吧。看来我们都得一起死了。

english: Come. I guess we should tell that vampyre that we're in.
translation: 来吧。我想我们该告诉那个吸血鬼，我们同意了。

english: Well Vanescula, it seems you have managed to convince us. Well done.
translation: 好吧，瓦内斯库拉，看来你成功说服了我们。干得好。

english: Thank you Veliaf. Now, shall we crack on?
translation: 谢谢你，维利亚夫。那么，我们开始行动？

english: What must we do?
translation: 我们该做什么？

english: If you want any hope of defeating my brother, you'll need the proper weaponry.
translation: 如果你们想有任何打败我兄弟的希望，就需要合适的武器。

english: We have weaponry. We have the Ivandis Flail.
translation: 我们有武器。我们有伊凡迪斯连枷。

english: Indeed you do. Not a bad weapon by any means, but not ideal for taking on Lowerniel. He'll snap it in two before you even have a chance to use it.
translation: 你们确实有。那武器一点也不差，但用来对付洛厄尼尔并不理想。他会在你们有机会使用之前就把它折成两段。

english: It worked well enough on Ranis.
translation: 它对拉尼斯效果不错。

english: Lowerniel is far more powerful than Ranis was. If you want to defeat him, you should take my advice.
translation: 洛厄尼尔远比拉尼斯强大。如果想打败他，你们应该听取我的建议。

english: Fine. What are you proposing?
translation: 好吧。你有什么提议？

english: If I'm not mistaken, which I'm generally not, you made that weapon using research from the Haemalchemy Laboratory.
translation: 如果我没弄错——我一般不会弄错——你们是用血炼实验室的研究成果制造了那件武器。

english: [player name], who was it that helped you find that laboratory?
translation: [player name]，是谁帮你找到那个实验室的？

english: Sarius Guile, your servant. Hang on... Did you send her?
translation: 萨里乌斯.盖尔，你的仆从。等等……是你派她来的？

english: Of course I did. Do you think she would have dared interact with you without my consent? Come now, surely you're smarter than that?
translation: 当然是我派她去的。你觉得没有我的同意，她敢跟你们接触吗？拜托，你肯定没那么笨吧？

english: Anyway, I don't know much of the laboratory myself. It was Ranis that had it set up. Lowerniel wasn't very happy when he found out.
translation: 总之，我自己对那个实验室也不太了解。是拉尼斯建立的。洛厄尼尔发现后非常不高兴。

english: That said, I do suspect it might have more secrets for us to discover.
translation: 尽管如此，我确实怀疑那里还有更多秘密等我们去发现。

english: So you want us to go back there?
translation: 所以你想让我们回那里去？

english: Yes. If you are able to find further research notes, I suspect we'll find a way to upgrade that weapon of yours.
translation: 是的。如果你们能找到更多研究笔记，我怀疑我们能找到升级你们那件武器的方法。

english: Okay, I'd better be off to the laboratory then.
translation: 好了，那我最好现在就去实验室。

english: I would like to join you, [player name].
translation: 我想和你一起去，[player name]。

english: Are you sure, Safalaan?
translation: 你确定吗，萨法兰？

english: Yes. Better I be out there doing something than be stuck here brooding.
translation: 是的。与其困在这里胡思乱想，不如出去做点事。

english: [player name], do you remember how to reach the laboratory?
translation: [player name]，你还记得怎么去实验室吗？

english: It's in sector six of Meiyerditch, just south east of the daeyalt mine.
translation: 在迈尔迪奇第六区，戴亚特矿场的东南边。

english: Very well. I will meet you there.
translation: 很好。我们那里见。

english: Good luck to you both.
translation: 祝你们俩好运。

english: Keep an eye on Safalaan, won't you? I worry about how he's taking things.
translation: 帮我看着点萨法兰，好吗？我担心他承受不住。

english: I shall, fear not.
translation: 我会的，别担心。

english: Good. Now you should head off to that laboratory. No point wasting time.
translation: 很好。你现在该去那个实验室了。别浪费时间。

english: Be quick then.
translation: 那就快点吧。

english: You're meant to be searching the Haemalchemy Laboratory for more research. Run along now.
translation: 你应该去血液炼金实验室寻找更多研究资料。快去吧。

english: Right, I'd better get going.
translation: 对，我最好出发了。

english: Why do you hate your brother?
translation: 你为什么恨你哥哥？

english: Why wouldn't I? He's an awful leader. My kind are slowly starving to death thanks to overpopulation, but he doesn't even seem to have noticed.
translation: 我为什么不恨？他是个糟糕的领袖。由于人口过剩，我的族人正慢慢饿死，但他似乎根本没注意到。

english: Is killing him not a bit much?
translation: 杀了他是不是有点过分了？

english: Not really. It is the vampyre way. There was once a time when things were far more savage. Back on our homeworld, new clan leaders were selected during a festival known as the Night of the Blood Moon.
translation: 并不。这是吸血鬼的方式。曾经有一段时间，事情要野蛮得多。在我们的家乡，新氏族首领是在一个名为‘血月之夜’的节日中选出的。

english: It was a simple concept. A full night of killing. At dawn, the one with the most kills became the new leader. Lowerniel loved it. He won every time of course. Personally, I prefer our new way of life.
translation: 这个概念很简单。一整夜的杀戮。黎明时，杀戮最多的人成为新的领袖。洛厄尼尔很享受这个。当然，他每次都赢。就我个人而言，我更喜欢我们新的生活方式。

english: And yet you're still happy to kill him?
translation: 但你仍然乐意杀他？

english: We are not the beasts we were back then, but some things do not change. Like I say, it is the vampyre way.
translation: 我们不再是那时的野兽了，但有些东西不会改变。就像我说的，这是吸血鬼的方式。

english: How did Ranis capture Ascertes Hallow?
translation: 拉尼斯是怎么攻占阿瑟提斯.哈洛的？

english: Do you know of Verzik Vitur?
translation: 你知道维齐克.维图尔吗？

english: Owner of the Theatre of Blood? Who doesn't know of her?
translation: 血腥剧场的老板？谁不知道她？

english: I'd give her the credit over Ranis. The two of them shared a love for playing with their food rather than eating it. They hatched all kinds of schemes together.
translation: 我会把功劳归于她而不是拉尼斯。他们俩都喜欢玩弄食物而不是吃掉食物。他们一起策划了各种阴谋。

english: During the war, they managed to capture a justiciar, one of Efaritay's most elite warriors. They tortured him for days, until he gave them what they needed.
translation: 战争期间，他们成功俘虏了一位审判官，埃法里泰最精锐的战士之一。他们折磨了他好几天，直到他给了他们想要的东西。

english: A secret tunnel, leading directly into Efaritay's castle. The tunnel was here, in this very graveyard. Once they were inside, capturing Ascertes was easy.
translation: 一条秘密隧道，直通埃法里泰的城堡。隧道就在这里，就在这个墓地里。一旦他们进去了，攻占阿瑟提斯就很容易了。

english: In some ways, I think Lowerniel was a bit disappointed the fighting was over. The pair were still greatly rewarded, however. Verzik ended up getting Efaritay's castle. It was quite the boon for her.
translation: 从某些方面来说，我觉得洛厄尼尔对战斗结束有点失望。不过，他们俩还是得到了丰厚的奖赏。维齐克最终得到了埃法里泰的城堡。这对她来说是一大笔财富。

english: Why did Lowerniel shut down the Haemalchemy Laboratory?
translation: 洛厄尼尔为什么关闭血液炼金实验室？

english: I can only assume he didn't like what they were doing there.
translation: 我只能猜测他不喜欢那里正在做的事情。

english: Well obviously. Could you be more specific though?
translation: 嗯，显然。但你能说得更具体点吗？

english: Are you familiar with their areas of research?
translation: 你了解他们的研究领域吗？

english: Ways to overcome blood shortages and ways to improve your immunity to our weapons.
translation: 克服血液短缺的方法，以及提高对我们武器免疫力的方法。

english: Essentially. The first might seem to benefit Lowerniel, but when you look deeper you can see why he wasn't a fan.
translation: 基本上是这样。第一个研究看似对洛厄尼尔有利，但深入看，你就会明白他为什么不喜欢。

english: For our kind to be less reliant on humans would be a fundamental change to our society. History has told us that leaders generally don't survive such a transition.
translation: 让我们这类人减少对人类的依赖，将是我们社会的根本性变革。历史告诉我们，领袖通常无法在这样的转变中幸存。

english: As for the second, I think it's obvious why Lowerniel wanted to put a stop to that. Just ask Ranis why that research maybe wasn't overly wise.
translation: 至于第二个，我想洛厄尼尔想阻止它的原因很明显。去问问拉尼斯为什么那项研究可能不太明智吧。

english: Indeed. Of course, Lowerniel's long absences mean that a lot of research was already complete before the laboratory was shut down. Hence how you were able to use it against Ranis.
translation: 确实。当然，洛厄尼尔长期不在，意味着实验室关闭前很多研究已经完成了。所以你才能用它来对付拉尼斯。

english: Which we were only able to do because of you. Why did you send Sarius to us?
translation: 我们能成功全靠你。你为什么派萨里乌斯来找我们？

english: A test. Even back then I knew that Lowerniel needed to go. I wanted to see if a partnership with the Myreque was worth exploring.
translation: 一个考验。即使在那时，我就知道洛厄尼尔必须下台。我想看看与迈雷克合作是否值得探索。

english: Meet me at the laboratory, friend. Let's see what we can discover.
translation: 在实验室见我，朋友。让我们看看能发现什么。

english: These are dark times friend.
translation: 现在是黑暗时期，朋友。

english: They are. But maybe there's a light at the end of the tunnel.
translation: 是的。但也许隧道尽头有光。

english: Maybe. I guess we'll find out soon enough. Be careful out there.
translation: 也许吧。我想我们很快就会知道了。在外面小心点。

english: We'll soon be doing battle with one of the most powerful beings in existence. How are you feeling?
translation: 我们很快就要和现存最强大的存在之一战斗了。你感觉怎么样？

english: I'm okay. How about you?
translation: 我没事。你呢？

english: Surprisingly calm, to be honest. We may well die in this fight, but if we manage to defeat Drakan, it will be worth it.
translation: 说实话，出奇地平静。我们很可能会在这场战斗中死去，但如果我们能击败德雷坎，那就值得了。

english: I guess it's not a bad way to go.
translation: 我想这死法也不算太糟。

english: Imagine, the death of Lowerniel Drakan. Think what that could do to these dark lands.
translation: 想象一下，洛厄尼尔.德雷坎之死。想想这对这片黑暗之地意味着什么。

english: It's crazy to think it might actually happen.
translation: 想到这真的可能发生，真是疯狂。

english: We've come a long way. Just one final hurdle.
translation: 我们已经走了很长的路。只剩最后一道障碍了。

english: And then, peace in our time.
translation: 然后，我们时代就和平了。

english: Let us hope, let us hope.
translation: 但愿如此，但愿如此。

english: Hey [player name]. Looks like it's really happening. We're finally going to show Drakan what happens when you cross the Myreque.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。看来真的要发生了。我们终于要让德雷坎知道惹毛迈雷克的下场了。

english: Looks like it. How are you feeling?
translation: 看来是的。你感觉怎么样？

english: Oh I'm great. I know we can do this, especially with you on our side.
translation: 哦，我感觉好极了。我知道我们能行，尤其是有你站在我们这边。

english: I hope you're right to have faith in me.
translation: 我希望你信任我是对的。

english: Don't worry, I know you won't let us down.
translation: 别担心，我知道你不会让我们失望的。

english: Do you think we're ready for this?
translation: 你觉得我们准备好了吗？

english: The fight with Drakan? Yes, I think so. We killed Ranis after all.
translation: 和德雷坎的战斗？是的，我觉得准备好了。毕竟我们杀了拉尼斯。

english: Lowerniel's a much bigger fish though.
translation: 但洛厄尼尔是条更大的鱼。

english: He is. But it's not just me this time. This time there's all of us. And Vanescula too, assuming she doesn't betray us.
translation: 是的。但这次不只是我。这次有我们所有人。还有瓦内斯库拉，假设她不背叛我们的话。

english: Let us hope.
translation: 但愿如此。

english: Good to see you, [player name]. Glad you made it here safely.
