translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]。很高兴你安全到达这里。

english: And you. How are you doing?
translation: 你也是。你还好吗？

english: To be honest, I'm not sure if I've even properly taken it in yet. It's all so much. My mother, my sister... and of course, my father.
translation: 说实话，我不确定自己是否已经完全接受了这一切。太多了。我的母亲，我的妹妹……当然，还有我的父亲。

english: It feels strange. I feel like I should mourn, but how do I mourn a family I can't even remember?
translation: 感觉很奇怪。我觉得我应该哀悼，但我该如何哀悼一个我甚至不记得的家庭呢？

english: And Vanstrom... My greatest enemy may well be my only remaining family. I wonder, is there anything left of Ascertes now? Is part of him still in there, buried away?
translation: 还有范斯特罗姆……我最大的敌人很可能是我仅存的家人。我想知道，阿瑟提斯现在还剩什么？他的一部分是否还埋藏在里面？

english: Probably best not thinking about, I suppose. My job is to lead the Myreque. I can't let anything else distract me from that, not even my family.
translation: 我想最好还是别想了。我的职责是领导迈雷克。我不能让其他任何事情分散我的注意力，即使是家人也不行。

english: With all that's happened, I fear some of them may already be beginning to doubt me.
translation: 发生了这么多事，我担心他们中有些人可能已经开始怀疑我了。

english: You have their support Safalaan, I know you do.
translation: 你得到了他们的支持，萨法兰，我知道你有的。

english: I hope so. I let them down with that Serafina business, and people died. I can't let them down again.
translation: 希望如此。我在塞拉菲娜那件事上让他们失望了，有人死了。我不能再让他们失望了。

english: Anyway, let us crack on. It seems that we should be able to access more of the laboratory through the doors to the south.
translation: 总之，我们继续吧。看来我们应该能通过南边的门进入实验室的更多区域。

english: They were damaged and couldn't be opened, but I think I've managed to fix them up.
translation: 它们损坏了打不开，但我想我已经设法修好了。

english: I didn't know you had a knack for Construction?
translation: 我不知道你还有建筑的天赋？

english: Ah, one of my hidden talents. Of course, not much room for that sort of thing around here.
translation: 啊，我的隐藏天赋之一。当然，在这里没多少机会做那种事。

english: That's a shame. I'm sure you'd make a great builder.
translation: 真可惜。我相信你会成为一个伟大的建筑工人。

english: Ha! It's strange to think how differently our lives could have been, is it not? Alas, here we are.
translation: 哈！想想我们的生活本可以多么不同，是不是很奇怪？唉，我们就在这里了。

english: I'm sorry. Maybe now isn't the best time for these kinds of conversations.
translation: 抱歉。也许现在不是进行这种谈话的最佳时机。

english: You have a good sense of humour my friend, even in these dark times. Do not be ashamed of that. When things are darkest, a bit of light is very welcome.
translation: 你很有幽默感，我的朋友，即使在这黑暗时期。不要为此感到羞愧。当事情最黑暗时，一点光明是非常受欢迎的。

english: Shall we get going then?
translation: 那我们出发吧？

english: Indeed. Let's head in.
translation: 当然。我们进去吧。

english: Look out!
translation: 小心！

english: Well just let me know when you're ready to go in.
translation: 好吧，等你准备好进去的时候告诉我。

english: Shall we head in?
translation: 我们进去吗？

english: Not yet. I need to prepare first.
translation: 还没。我需要先准备一下。

english: Well just let me know when you're ready.
translation: 好吧，等你准备好了告诉我。

english: Are you alright Safalaan?
translation: 你还好吗，萨法兰？

english: I... I'm fine. What happened?
translation: 我……我没事。发生了什么？

english: We were attacked by some bloodvelds. You used your powers to kill one.
translation: 我们被一些血魔攻击了。你用了你的力量杀了一个。

english: Blasted powers! What good are powers when I have no control over them?
translation: 该死的力量！当我无法控制它们时，这些力量有什么用？

english: Don't be so harsh on yourself. Your powers have got us out of a couple of sticky situations now.
translation: 别对自己这么苛刻。你的力量已经帮我们摆脱了几次困境。

english: Yes, but what happens if I totally lose control? Will I lose my memory like that time with Vanstrom? Or will I do something even worse?
translation: 是的，但如果我完全失控了呢？我会像那次和范斯特罗姆一样失去记忆吗？还是会做出更糟的事？

english: Well now that we know the source of your powers, maybe we can find a way to help you control them.
translation: 既然我们知道了你力量的来源，也许我们能找到办法帮你控制它们。

english: Maybe... Let us hope we can do so before it's too late.
translation: 也许吧……希望我们能在为时已晚之前做到。

english: Bah, look at me, [player name]. I'm meant to be a leader, but I can barely control my own body. I'm like an old man.
translation: 唉，看看我，[player name]。我本应是个领袖，却连自己的身体都控制不好。我像个老头。

english: Well... you are the son of Queen Efaritay. I guess that makes you thousands of years old.
translation: 嗯……你是埃法里泰女王的儿子。我想这让你有几千岁了吧。

english: Eugh, what an awful thought. I guess I should get myself a walking stick.
translation: 呃，真是个可怕的想法。我想我该给自己弄根拐杖了。

english: I'm sure we can arrange that.
translation: 我相信我们能安排好的。

english: Let's add it to the list. First though, the research we came here for. I'm afraid I'm still feeling a bit weak, so you'll have to do the heavy lifting on this one.
translation: 把它加到清单上吧。不过首先，是我们来这里要找的研究。恐怕我还是觉得有点虚弱，所以这次你得干重活了。

english: Oh I see how it is! You find out you're an old-timer and now I have to do all the work!
translation: 哦，我明白了！你发现自己是个老家伙，现在所有活都得我来干了！

english: Afraid so. My poor back simply can't take it. I've no doubt you'll manage though.
translation: 恐怕是的。我可怜的背实在受不了了。不过我相信你肯定能搞定。

english: Okay. I'll have a look round and see what I can find. You stay here, old-timer.
translation: 好吧，我四处看看能找到什么。你待在这儿，老家伙。

english: Please stop calling me that.
translation: 请别这么叫我。

english: I can make no promises.
translation: 我可不能保证。

english: Do you think we can kill Drakan?
translation: 你觉得我们能杀死德拉肯吗？

english: To be honest, I don't know. They say he's the most powerful being in existence. The truth is though, we know pretty much nothing about him.
translation: 老实说，我不知道。都说他是现存最强大的存在。但事实上，我们对他几乎一无所知。

english: I guess the point is that we're in the best position possible. If we can't kill him, I suspect no one can.
translation: 我想关键是我们的处境已经是最好的了。如果我们杀不了他，恐怕没人能行。

english: We seem to be dealing with a lot of uncertainties.
translation: 我们似乎要面对很多不确定性。

english: Oh we are. But you play the hand you're dealt, my friend. This is our hand.
translation: 确实如此。但我的朋友，我们只能打好手中的牌。这就是我们的牌。

english: I guess. Losing a card game generally doesn't result in death though.
translation: 也许吧。但打牌输了通常不会死。

english: You should try playing against a werewolf.
translation: 你应该试试跟狼人打牌。

english: What do you think of Vanescula?
translation: 你觉得瓦内斯库拉怎么样？

english: I don't trust her. She feigned affection back at the graveyard. But I know she's just doing it for her own gain.
translation: 我不信任她。之前在墓园她假装亲近。但我知道她只是为了自己的利益。

english: You still chose to work with her though.
translation: 可你还是选择与她合作。

english: Yes. She is our only hope of defeating her brother. In truth, I'd pretty much made my choice even before she told me about my family.
translation: 是的。她是我们击败她兄弟的唯一希望。说实话，在她告诉我关于我家人的事之前，我几乎已经做出了选择。

english: That's good to know. I worried you were being too hasty after you discovered the truth.
translation: 那就好。我还担心你发现真相后太急躁了。

english: You are not wrong to worry, friend. I may well be leading us to certain death.
translation: 你担心得没错，朋友。我很可能正带着我们走向必死之路。

english: Well you have our support. For better or worse.
translation: 好吧，我们支持你。无论结果好坏。

english: Thank you. I appreciate it, especially from you. As an outsider, you could easily turn and run at any time. The fact that you're still here speaks volumes.
translation: 谢谢。我很感激，尤其是你的支持。作为一个局外人，你随时可以转身逃跑。但你仍然留在这里，这足以说明一切。

english: Could we talk more about your family?
translation: 我们能多谈谈你的家人吗？

english: I'm sorry. I know you must have so many questions. I have plenty myself. But I need to focus right now and cannot be distracted by such thoughts.
translation: 抱歉。我知道你一定有很多问题。我自己也有很多。但我现在需要集中精力，不能被这些想法分心。

english: We will talk later. You have my word.
translation: 我们以后再说。我保证。

english: Alright there old-timer?
translation: 还好吗，老家伙？

english: I'm starting to regret praising your humour.
translation: 我开始后悔夸你的幽默感了。

english: You need to try and find some more haemalchemy research. There must be something of note around here.
translation: 你得再找一些血液炼金术的研究资料。这附近肯定有什么值得注意的东西。

english: Yes. I found some more haemalchemy research.
translation: 是的，我又找到了一些血液炼金术的研究资料。

english: Good work. I'll look after it for you.
translation: 干得好。我替你保管。

english: Right. We'd better get back to the graveyard. I'll meet you there.
translation: 好了。我们最好回墓园去。我在那儿等你。

english: Okay. I'll see you soon.
translation: 好的，一会儿见。

english: I'm going to keep hold of it.
translation: 我想自己保管。

english: Come now, [player name]. We need that research. Please give it to me as soon as you can.
translation: 别这样，[player name]。我们需要那份研究资料。请尽快交给我。

english: We should get back to the graveyard. I'll meet you there.
translation: 我们该回墓园了。我在那儿等你。

english: Still here Ivan?
translation: 还在这儿呢，伊万？

english: Yup. Most of the others went to the Meiyerditch hideout. But I wanted to stick around.
translation: 是啊。大多数人都去了迈尔迪奇的藏身处。但我想留下来。

english: This graveyard is one of the last remaining examples of what Hallowvale was like. I bet there's a lot to discover here.
translation: 这座墓园是仅存的几个能体现霍洛维尔风貌的地方之一。我敢说这里有很多值得发现的东西。

english: Maybe once Drakan is gone, we can get some proper archaeologists out here. I'm sure they could learn all sorts.
translation: 也许等德拉肯死后，我们可以找些真正的考古学家来。我相信他们能发现很多。

english: I bet they could. You holding up okay?
translation: 我相信他们能。你还好吗？

english: Oh yes. We're going to win this, I know it.
translation: 哦，没事。我们会赢的，我知道。

english: You seem very confident?
translation: 你似乎很有信心？

english: Why wouldn't I be? I have faith in Saradomin. I have faith in Safalaan and Veliaf. I have faith in you. Together, we will beat Drakan.
translation: 为什么没有呢？我信仰萨拉多明。我信任萨法拉恩和维利亚夫。我也信任你。团结起来，我们一定能打败德拉肯。

english: I do hope so.
translation: 希望如此。

english: Have faith, friend. Anyway, I'd best let you get on.
translation: 要有信心，朋友。总之，我最好不打扰你了。

english: Take care Ivan.
translation: 保重，伊万。

english: ...of your arrogance. What makes you so sure we won't also kill you once your brother is dead?
translation: ……你的傲慢。你凭什么认为你兄弟死后我们不会连你也杀掉？

english: Oh, you could try. Although I doubt it would end well for you.
translation: 哦，你可以试试。不过我怀疑这对你来说不会有好结果。

english: Now this is exactly what I mean.
translation: 这正是我要说的。

english: Oh lighten up would you. No sense of humour at all.
translation: 哦，放轻松点好吗？一点幽默感都没有。

english: I am no fool. I am all too aware of my own weaknesses and how you could exploit them. When we take on Lowerniel, I don't intend to be alone.
translation: 我不是傻瓜。我很清楚自己的弱点以及你们如何利用它们。当我们对付洛尼尔时，我不打算独自一人。

english: I have many supporters amongst the vampyres of Darkmeyer. Your small group against all of us? The fight would be brief.
translation: 我在达克迈尔的吸血鬼中有很多支持者。你们那个小团体对抗我们所有人？战斗很快就会结束。

english: Hiding behind larger numbers? Not very honourable.
translation: 躲在人多势众后面？不太光彩。

english: Now you see, I've tried honour before. Decided it wasn't for me. Honour matters not if you're dead. I intend to keep living.
translation: 你看，我以前试过讲求荣耀。后来决定不适合我。如果你死了，荣耀毫无意义。我打算好好活着。

english: Ah, [player name], you're back. Good to see you made it okay.
translation: 啊，[player name]，你回来了。很高兴看到你平安无事。

english: Yes, yes. Wonderful to see you. Shall we get on with things?
translation: 是啊是啊，见到你真是太好了。我们是不是该继续了？

english: Well, the research you recovered has confirmed something I have long suspected.
translation: 嗯，你找回的研究资料证实了我长久以来的猜测。

english: Queen Efaritay was a renowned botanist. She used this to her advantage many times during the war, breeding all kinds of plant life to use against us.
translation: 艾法里泰女王是一位著名的植物学家。她在战争中多次利用这一点，培育出各种植物来对付我们。

english: One of these plants was the Blisterwood tree. The icyene used the sap of this tree to create poisons that were deadly to vampyres.
translation: 其中一种植物就是水泡木树。冰霜精灵使用这种树的汁液制作对吸血鬼致命的毒药。

english: However, I've always suspected the tree might have other uses. Clearly the researchers in the Haemalchemy Laboratory thought the same.
translation: 然而，我一直怀疑这棵树可能还有其他用途。显然，血液炼金术实验室的研究人员也这么想。

english: So what did they find out?
translation: 那他们发现了什么？

english: It seems that the bark of the Blisterwood tree can be used to create weapons that are deadly to my kind.
translation: 似乎水泡木树的树皮可以用来制造对我族致命的武器。

english: Well I'm no scientist, oddly enough. But from what I can tell, even when chopped away, the wood of the tree is very much alive. It shifts and grows in unpredictable ways, rendering our immunities useless.
translation: 说来奇怪，我可不是科学家。但据我所知，即使被砍下来，这棵树的木材仍然充满活力。它以一种不可预测的方式移动和生长，使我们的免疫能力失效。

english: I see where we're going with this. You want us to use this tree to construct new weapons?
translation: 我明白你的意思了。你想让我们用这棵树来制造新武器？

english: Well... not quite. While not perfect, the work you've already done has potential. I see no need to completely discard it.
translation: 嗯……不完全是这样。虽然不完美，但你之前的工作已经很有潜力。我认为没有必要完全抛弃它。

english: Instead, I suggest we use wood from the Blisterwood tree to enhance the weapons you already have. When combined with the wood, I imagine that flail of yours will be quite effective.
translation: 相反，我建议我们用来自水泡木树的木材来强化你已有的武器。当与木材结合时，我想你的那把连枷会相当有效。

english: Perfect for killing your brother. Assuming you don't kill us first.
translation: 正好用来杀你兄弟。前提是你先不杀我们。

english: Again with this? I've already told you, I have no need to kill you. Once Lowerniel is gone, I envisage a new age, where my kind and yours live in harmony. I need you alive for that.
translation: 又来这套？我已经告诉过你了，我没必要杀你。一旦洛尼尔死了，我设想一个新时代，我们族和你族和谐共处。我需要你活着来实现这一点。

english: That's fine by me.
translation: 我没意见。

english: We're getting sidetracked here. We need some wood from this Blisterwood tree. Where do we find it?
translation: 我们跑题了。我们需要一些水泡木树的木材。去哪儿找？

english: Ah... that's the tricky bit. I know only of one Blisterwood tree. It lies in Efaritay's old Arboretum, in the middle of Darkmeyer.
translation: 啊……这就是棘手之处。我只知道一棵水泡木树。它位于艾法里泰的旧植物园里，在达克迈尔中心。

english: It's in the capital? We'll have no hope of getting in there.
translation: 在首都？我们根本进不去。

english: I don't see why we'd need to. Vanescula here can get some of this wood for us.
translation: 我看没必要进去。这里的瓦内斯库拉可以帮我们弄些木材来。

english: Really now? Do you think I have any intention of touching a tree that can kill vampyres? No. You will need to recover the wood yourself.
translation: 真的吗？你以为我会碰一棵能杀死吸血鬼的树？不。你得自己去取木材。

english: Darkmeyer isn't as impenetrable as you might think. I know of a way you can get in. But first, you'll need a disguise.
translation: 达克迈尔并不像你想的那么坚不可摧。我知道一条路可以让你进去。但首先，你需要一个伪装。

english: Now, luckily for us, my kind have some shapeshifting abilities. Many vampyres, such as myself, prefer to take on a human form. That means you should be able to fit in... with the right outfit of course.
translation: 幸运的是，我的同类有变形的能力。很多吸血鬼，比如我，更喜欢保持人形。这意味着你应该能混进去……当然要穿对衣服。

english: Trader Sven sells vyrewatch disguises. We've used them in the past.
translation: 商人斯文卖吸血鬼哨兵伪装。我们以前用过。

english: Not bad, but we'll want to make some adjustments. We need you looking less like a vyrewatch and more like a noble.
translation: 不错，但我们需要做些改动。得让你看起来不像吸血鬼哨兵，更像贵族。

english: Polmafi knows how to use a needle. He should be able to sort us out.
translation: 波尔马菲会用针线。他应该能帮我们搞定。

english: Good idea. [player name], could you pick up a vyrewatch disguise from Trader Sven? He lives in sector one of Meiyerditch, directly south of Old Man Ral's house.
translation: 好主意。[player name]，你能从商人斯文那里买一套吸血鬼哨兵伪装吗？他住在迈尔迪奇一区，就在老人拉尔家的正南方。

english: Will do. I'm guessing I should take it to Polmafi after that?
translation: 好的。之后我是不是应该把它带给波尔马菲？

english: That's right. He and the others have gone back to the Meiyerditch hideout, in Old Man Ral's basement.
translation: 没错。他和其他人已经回到迈尔迪奇的藏身处，在老人拉尔的地下室里。

english: Once you have the disguise, we will need to scent it. We will discuss that once you have it.
translation: 一旦你拿到伪装，我们还需要给它附上气味。等你拿到手我们再讨论。

english: Okay, I'll be back when I have the disguise.
translation: 好的，拿到伪装我就回来。

english: You should get going friend. That disguise won't sort itself out.
translation: 你该出发了，朋友。伪装不会自己搞定。

english: Go and buy a vyrewatch disguise from Trader Sven. His house is the one directly south of Old Man Ral's, in sector one of Meiyerditch.
translation: 去商人斯文那里买一套吸血鬼哨兵伪装。他的房子就在老人拉尔的正南方，在迈尔迪奇一区。

english: And once I have the disguise?
translation: 拿到伪装之后呢？

english: Deliver it to Polmafi at the Meiyerditch hideout, in Old Man Ral's basement.
translation: 送到迈尔迪奇藏身处，老人拉尔的地下室，交给波尔马菲。

english: Okay, I shall return later.
translation: 好的，我晚点回来。

english: You're meant to be working with Polmafi to create a suitable disguise. Now, off you go.
translation: 你应该和波尔马菲一起制作合适的伪装。现在，去吧。

english: I need to look like a vampyre noble. Safalaan suggested we use a vyrewatch disguise from Trader Sven as a starting point.
translation: 我需要看起来像吸血鬼贵族。萨法拉恩建议我们用商人斯文那里买的吸血鬼哨兵伪装作为基础。

english: That's a good idea. Do you have a vyrewatch disguise with you?
translation: 好主意。你身上有吸血鬼哨兵伪装吗？

english: Great. Hand it over and I'll get to work.
translation: 太好了。交给我吧，我来动手。

english: Here's your finished disguise. Be careful out there.
translation: 这是做好的伪装。在外面小心点。

english: There was enough material for some spares. I'll leave them in the chest in the corner in case you need more.
translation: 材料足够做一些备用的。我会放在角落的箱子里，以防你需要更多。

english: I'll keep it for now.
translation: 我先留着。

english: Well I can't make your new disguise until you give it to me.
translation: 等你交给我，我才能做新的伪装。

english: Good to see you [player name]. How are things going?
translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]。事情进展如何？

english: Not too bad. We've managed to recover some more haemalchemy research. We think it can be used to further improve our weaponry.
translation: 还不错。我们找回了一些血液炼金术的研究资料。我们认为这可以用来进一步改进我们的武器。

english: Well that's good to hear. Anything I can help with?
translation: 那太好了。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Yes, actually. To make the improved weapons, I need to infiltrate the city of Darkmeyer. For that, I need a disguise. Veliaf said you'd be able to help.
translation: 确实有。为了制作改进的武器，我需要潜入达克迈尔城。为此，我需要一个伪装。维利亚夫说你可以帮忙。

english: The city of Darkmeyer? Oh my! You'd better be careful.
translation: 达克迈尔城？哦天哪！你可得小心点。

english: Anyhow, yes I should be able to help. What kind of disguise do you need?
translation: 总之，是的，我应该能帮忙。你需要什么样的伪装？

english: Do you mind fetching one?
translation: 你介意去取一个来吗？

english: Sure. I'll see if I can get one from Trader Sven.
translation: 没问题。我去看看能不能从商人斯文那里弄一个来。

english: Hello there. Do you have a vyrewatch disguise yet?
translation: 你好啊。你有吸血鬼哨兵的伪装了吗？

english: I'll be here once you have.
translation: 等你有了，我就在这儿。

english: Do you have the disguise?
translation: 你有伪装了吗？

english: Well we can't go any further then. Return once you have it.
translation: 那我们可没法继续了。等你拿到手再回来吧。

english: Wonderful. Now, as mentioned earlier, we will need to scent this disguise. My kind have a keen sense of smell and will quickly notice an imposter if they don't smell right.
translation: 太好了。正如之前所说，我们得给这伪装添点气味。我们这类种族嗅觉很灵敏，要是气味不对，会马上发现冒牌货。

english: What do we need to scent it with?
translation: 要用什么来添气味？

english: Blood of course. The blood of a vyre.
translation: 当然是血。维尔吸血鬼的血。

english: So I kill a vyrewatch and use their blood to scent the disguise?
translation: 所以我杀一个吸血鬼哨兵，用他们的血来给伪装添气味？

english: Oh... no, no, no. A vyrewatch will not do. We want you to blend in with the nobles. That means we need the blood of a noble.
translation: 哦……不，不，不。吸血鬼哨兵不行。我们想让你混入贵族之中。那就需要贵族的血。

english: There's a difference?
translation: 有区别吗？

english: Of course. The lords and ladies of Darkmeyer won't go interacting with any old rabble.
translation: 当然。达克迈尔的贵族老爷夫人们可不会跟随便什么乌合之众打交道。

english: Of course. Go on then, give us some of your blood.
translation: 当然。那行，把你的血给我们一点吧。

english: Oh dear Veliaf, you misunderstand. The smell of my blood will be far too recognisable to work. We need someone a bit more obscure.
translation: 哎呀维利亚夫，你误会了。我的血气味太容易辨认，行不通。我们需要一个不那么显眼的人。

english: Ah yes, how silly of me to not realise. You clearly have a vampyre in mind. Spit it out.
translation: 啊对，我居然没想到，真傻。你心里肯定有个吸血鬼人选了。说吧。

english: I think we use this as an opportunity to deal with two issues in one. Damien Leucurte has become a problem that needs to be resolved. He is also a noble, albeit a lesser one.
translation: 我觉得我们可以借此机会一举两得。达米恩.勒库尔特已经成了个需要解决的问题。他也是个贵族，虽然不算大贵族。

english: So we kill Damien and use his blood. Sounds good to me.
translation: 所以我们杀了达米恩，用他的血。听起来不错。

english: Indeed. Let's get it done. [player name], meet me outside the church in Slepe. We're going to pay Damien a little visit.
translation: 正是。动手吧。[player name]，在斯莱普镇的教堂外面跟我碰头。我们去拜访一下达米恩。

english: If you want, you can use the boat to quickly get to Slepe. Should be faster than walking.
translation: 如果你想的话，可以坐船快速到斯莱普镇。应该比走路快。

english: Good idea. Veliaf, I'll see you there.
translation: 好主意。维利亚夫，那儿见。

english: Meet me outside the church in Slepe. We're going to pay Damien a little visit.
translation: 在斯莱普镇的教堂外面跟我碰头。我们去拜访一下达米恩。

english: You should meet up with Veliaf in Slepe. We'll talk later.
translation: 你应该去斯莱普镇跟维利亚夫会合。我们回头再说。

english: Okay. Until then.
translation: 好的。回头见。

english: You need to kill Damien Leucurte and use his blood to scent your disguise. Run along now.
translation: 你需要杀死达米恩.勒库尔特，用他的血给你的伪装添气味。赶紧去吧。

english: Well met friend. Didn't think we'd be back here so soon.
translation: 幸会，朋友。没想到这么快又回到这儿了。

english: I know. Not a bad thing though. Damien needs to be dealt with.
translation: 我知道。不过也不是坏事。达米恩必须解决掉。

english: I suppose you're right. Now, I've done some scouting. It seems Damien is hiding in the manor. Interestingly, he doesn't seem to have increased his security since Kroy's death.
translation: 你说得对。我侦察过了，达米恩似乎躲在那座庄园里。有趣的是，自从克罗伊死后，他似乎并没有加强安保。

english: He may well have tried, but I bet we scared off a lot of his supporters.
translation: 他也许尝试过，但我敢打赌我们吓跑了他不少支持者。

english: They don't want to mess with you my friend. I suspect you're becoming quite notorious amongst the vampyres.
translation: 他们不想惹你，朋友。我猜你在吸血鬼中间已经相当臭名昭著了。

english: Do you think we should be able to access the manor easily?
translation: 你觉得我们能轻易进入庄园吗？

english: Looks like it. I think we can get in through the dungeon. Let me know when you're ready and we'll head on in.
translation: 看起来是。我觉得我们可以从地牢进去。准备好了就告诉我，我们直接进去。

english: Oh wait! I forgot the disguise!
translation: 哦等等！我忘了伪装！

english: Well you'd better go and get it. I'll be here when you are ready.
translation: 那你最好回去拿。我就在这儿等你准备好。

english: Do you think Safalaan is doing okay?
translation: 你觉得萨法拉安还好吗？

english: You tell me. You've spent more time with him since his discovery.
translation: 你告诉我啊。自从他发现真相后，你跟他待的时间更长。

english: He seems to be okay. At least, as okay as anyone could be in that situation. He seems to still be focused, and he's not lost his sense of humour.
translation: 他似乎还好。至少，在这种处境下，他算是好的了。他似乎仍然专注，也没有失去幽默感。

english: Maintaining a good sense of humour is common coping mechanism when dealing with shock. I hope he's not just putting on a facade. If he's struggling, he should seek our support.
translation: 保持幽默感是应对震惊的常见应对机制。我希望他不是在强装镇定。如果他撑不住，他应该寻求我们的支持。

english: You're not wrong. But that's for him to decide. He knows we are there if he needs us.
translation: 你说得没错。但这得由他决定。他知道如果需要我们，我们就在那儿。

english: It's good that he has people like you. I may have known him a long time, but I can't pretend to be any good at comforting people in such situations. I never manage to say the right thing.
translation: 他有你这样的人真好。我虽然认识他很久了，但我不敢说自己在那种情况下善于安慰人。我总说不对话。

english: And you think I do?
translation: 你觉得我就行？

english: You can't be any worse than me. I'd take that as a victory.
translation: 你总不会比我更糟。我觉得那就是胜利了。

english: Do you think things will improve for him?
translation: 你觉得他的处境会好转吗？

english: I don't know. He may well soon come face to face with Lowerniel Drakan, the cause of all his pain. I hope he is ready for that.
translation: 我不知道。他可能很快就会和洛厄尼尔.德雷坎正面交锋，那正是他所有痛苦的根源。我希望他准备好了。

english: And then there's Vanstrom, of course. Their paths are likely to cross again before all this is over. And when that happens, who knows what the outcome will be.
translation: 当然，还有范斯特罗姆。在这件事结束之前，他们很可能还会再碰面。到那时，谁知道结果会怎样。

english: Anyway, are you ready to deal with Damien?
translation: 总之，你准备好对付达米恩了吗？

english: How are you feeling about working with Vanescula?
translation: 你跟瓦内斯库拉合作感觉怎么样？

english: Well, she hasn't killed us yet, which I consider a win. It seems she spoke the truth about wanting her brother dead.
translation: 嗯，她还没杀死我们，我觉得这就算赢了。她说的想让她哥哥死的话，似乎是真的。

english: Of course, I still fully expect her to betray us once he's gone.
translation: 当然，我仍然完全预期一旦他死了，她就会背叛我们。

english: But you're still willing to go ahead with this?
translation: 但你仍然愿意继续下去？

english: I wouldn't say I'm 'willing' as such, but what other choice do I have? The others want to do it and I'll be damned if I'm just going to leave them to their fates.
translation: 我也不算“愿意”吧，但我还有什么选择？其他人想这么做，如果我只顾自己，让他们听天由命，那我也太差劲了。

english: That doesn't mean I haven't been considering contingencies, of course. I've asked Ivan to prepare us a teleport spell in case we need to make a hasty exit.
translation: 当然，这并不意味着我没有考虑过应急计划。我已经让伊万为我们准备一个传送法术，以防我们需要匆忙撤离。

english: Seems sensible to me. Let's hope it doesn't come to that.
translation: 我觉得挺明智的。希望不会到那一步。

english: Indeed. But enough about Vanescula. Are you ready to deal with Damien?
translation: 确实。不过关于瓦内斯库拉就说到这儿。你准备好对付达米恩了吗？

english: Are you ready to deal with Damien?
translation: 你准备好对付达米恩了吗？

english: So here you are. I knew it was only a matter of time before you lot showed up.
translation: 你们果然来了。我就知道你们这群人迟早会出现的。

english: We'd hate to disappoint. It's over Damien.
translation: 我们可不想让你失望。结束了，达米恩。

english: Listen to your arrogance! Is this what we've become? I remember when we commanded respect. Your kind would cower in fear at the sight of us!
translation: 听听你这傲慢的口气！我们怎么就沦落成这样了？我记得当年我们受人敬畏。你们这帮人一看见我们就吓得发抖！

english: Once, yes. But now, we are not the ones cowering.
translation: 以前确实如此。但现在，发抖的不是我们。

english: You think I'm afraid? I am a lord of Darkmeyer. I am fear!
translation: 你觉得我会害怕？我是达克迈尔的领主。我本身就是恐惧！

english: A lord of Darkmeyer? Isn't a lord meant to have followers? Looks like yours have run away.
translation: 达克迈尔的领主？领主不是应该有追随者吗？看来你的追随者都跑光了。

english: Cowards! That's what they are. I was their saviour! When our great leaders abandoned us, I was the one that kept them fed!
translation: 懦夫！他们就是懦夫。我是他们的救星！当我们伟大的领袖抛弃我们时，是我在养活他们！

english: And now you're nothing.
translation: 而现在你什么都不是。

english: Face it Damien, you're out of time. There's nowhere to run.
translation: 面对现实吧达米恩，你的时间到了。你无处可逃。

english: That is true for all of us!
translation: 这对我们所有人来说都是真的！

english: Time to see what you're really made of!
translation: 是时候看看你到底是什么货色了！

english: Crombwick! You will support me!
translation: 克罗姆威克！你必须支援我！

english: What? But I can't...
translation: 什么？但我不能……

english: You can and you will!
translation: 你能，而且你必须！

english: Come on then! This ends now!
translation: 那就来吧！现在就做个了结！

english: Got what you need?
translation: 拿到你要的东西了吗？

english: Looks like it.
translation: 看起来拿到了。

english: Good. I don't want to stick around this place any longer than needed. I will meet you back at the graveyard.
translation: 好。我不想在这地方多待一刻。我们墓园见。

english: What do you think this means for Slepe?
translation: 你觉得这对斯莱普镇意味着什么？

english: The death of Damien can't do any harm. That said, don't expect this to suddenly fix everything around here. The Sleeper Plague isn't the only illness in this town.
translation: 达米恩的死总不会有坏处。不过，别指望这能一下子解决这里的所有问题。沉睡者瘟疫并不是这个镇上唯一的毛病。

english: You mean their religion?
translation: 你是说他们的宗教信仰？

english: I do. The people here chose to follow Zamorak. A choice like that has consequences. Bad ones.
translation: 是的。这里的人选择了追随萨莫拉克。这样的选择是有后果的。糟糕的后果。

english: You think they are being punished?
translation: 你觉得他们是在受惩罚？

english: Not exactly. I don't believe in fate myself. I'm sure someone like Drezel would say otherwise, though. I just think that if you play with fire, you're going to end up getting burnt.
translation: 不完全是。我自己不相信命运。不过像德雷泽尔那样的人肯定会有不同说法。我只是觉得，玩火者必自焚。

english: So do you think the Sleeper Plague will go away now?
translation: 那么你觉得沉睡者瘟疫现在会消失吗？

english: Well there shouldn't be any new cases now that Damien and Kroy are gone. That won't help those already infected though.
translation: 既然达米恩和克罗伊都死了，应该不会再有新病例了。不过这对已经感染的人没帮助。

english: Maybe there's a cure.
translation: 也许有治疗方法。

english: Maybe. I suspect this town holds a lot of secrets... but now is not the time to explore them. We have other business to attend to.
translation: 也许吧。我猜这个镇藏着很多秘密……但现在不是探索的时候。我们还有其他事要做。

english: I'll see you at the graveyard.
translation: 墓园见。

english: I'll see you there
translation: 那儿见

english: No need for us to stick around this place any more. I will meet you back at the graveyard.
translation: 我们没必要再在这地方逗留了。墓园见。

english: I sent some of Damien's blood to Polmafi. Speak to him if you need a replacement disguise.
translation: 我把达米恩的一些血寄给了波尔马菲。如果你需要更换伪装，去找他谈。

english: Well well, the vampyre slayer returns. Two of my brothers, now Damien as well. Quite the body count you're amassing.
translation: 哎呀呀，吸血鬼杀手回来了。我两个兄弟，现在再加上达米恩。你累积的数目可真不少。

english: Two of your brothers?
translation: 你的两个兄弟？

english: Did you not know? [player name] here isn't just responsible for killing Ranis. He also killed our younger brother, Draynor.
translation: 你不知道吗？这位[player name]不仅杀了拉尼斯，还杀了我们的弟弟德雷诺。

english: Count Draynor, he called himself. He wasn't much of a challenge compared to Ranis and Damien, truth be told.
translation: 他自称德雷诺伯爵。说实话，跟拉尼斯和达米恩比起来，他根本算不上什么挑战。

english: Ah yes, the great 'Count' Draynor. He loved his stupid titles. He was weak even before he got trapped on the wrong side of the Salve. A coward as well.
translation: 啊对，伟大的“德雷诺伯爵”。他就喜欢他那愚蠢的头衔。在他被困在萨尔维河的另一边之前，他就已经很弱了。还是个懦夫。

english: There's a reason Lowerniel had him banished. I'm just surprised he lasted as long as he did.
translation: 洛厄尼尔把他流放是有原因的。我只是惊讶他居然撑了那么久。

english: Now, I assume you have a finished disguise?
translation: 现在，我猜你已经有完成的伪装了吧？

english: Wonderful. Now we're getting somewhere. With that disguise, you should be ready to enter Darkmeyer.
translation: 太好了。终于有点进展了。有了那伪装，你应该可以进入达克迈尔了。

english: But how does he get into the city? The place is a fortress.
translation: 但他要怎么进城？那地方是个堡垒。

english: Almost, but not quite. I know of a small weakness in the southern wall. A crack, in sector six of Meiyerditch, just north of the daeyalt mine.
translation: 差不多，但不完全是。我知道南墙有一个小弱点。在迈尔迪奇第六区的一条裂缝，就在戴亚特矿的北边。

english: It should be big enough for you to squeeze through, as long as you haven't recently eaten an excess of cakes.
translation: 应该够大，只要你最近没有吃太多蛋糕，就能挤过去。

english: Seems suspiciously convenient. Why hasn't the crack been filled in?
translation: 听起来可疑地方便。为什么裂缝没有被填补？

english: My kind are struggling to feed themselves. They've currently got bigger worries than cracks in walls.
translation: 我们同族正在为填饱肚子挣扎。他们现在有比墙上裂缝更担心的事。

english: Besides, up until now, why would any human even consider entering Darkmeyer? Perhaps you hadn't noticed, my kind is not known for treating humans well.
translation: 再说了，直到现在，有哪个人类会考虑进入达克迈尔？也许你没注意到，我们这类人对待人类可不算友善。

english: Although you expect us to live in harmony once this is done. How are we meant to achieve that when each side hates the other?
translation: 虽然你指望事情结束后我们能和谐共处。但双方互相憎恨，又怎么可能实现呢？

english: I never said it would be easy. I don't expect us to kill my brother and then have a big party. It will be work, but given time, that work will pay off.
translation: 我从没说过这会容易。我不指望我们杀了我兄弟后还能开个大派对。这需要努力，但假以时日，努力会有回报的。

english: So that aside, I can use this crack to enter Darkmeyer? What then?
translation: 所以撇开那个不谈，我可以用这条裂缝进入达克迈尔？然后呢？

english: You'll need to get to Efaritay's Arboretum in the middle of the city. The city architects gave it facelift to help it blend in, but it's still impossible to miss.
translation: 你需要前往城市中央的埃法里泰植物园。城市建筑师给它做了翻新以融入环境，但依然不可能错过。

english: Once inside, you'll need to chop some logs from the Blisterwood tree. We'll need enough to arm everyone, so eight logs in total.
translation: 进去后，你需要从水泡木树上砍些原木。我们需要足够武装所有人，所以总共要八根原木。

english: Now, whatever happens, you must not let your true identity be exposed. If a member of the Myreque was found in Darkmeyer, the entire city would be locked down.
translation: 现在，无论发生什么，你绝不能暴露真实身份。如果迈雷克的成员在达克迈尔被发现，整座城市都会被封锁。

english: Any tips for blending in?
translation: 有什么融入环境的建议吗？

english: Well keep your disguise on for a start. You'll want a suitable name as well. Your current one isn't very fitting. If anyone asks, you're called [vampyre name].
translation: 首先，保持你的伪装。你也需要一个合适的名字。你现在的名字不太合适。如果有人问起，你就叫[vampyre name]。

english: [vampyre name]. It suits you, [player name].
translation: [vampyre name]。很适合你，[player name]。

english: [vampyre name], right. Anything else I should know?
translation: [vampyre name]，对吧。还有什么我应该知道的吗？

english: I expect you to see many things you consider undesirable while in Darkmeyer, especially where your kind are concerned.
translation: 我估计你在达克迈尔会看到很多你觉得不妥的事，尤其是关于你同类的事。

english: While you may be tempted to get involved, don't. Stay in character no matter what.
translation: 虽然你可能想插手，但别这么做。无论如何都要保持角色。

english: Okay, I'll be back once I have the logs. Wish me luck.
translation: 好，我拿到原木就回来。祝我好运吧。

english: Good luck [player name]. Myreque prevail.
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。迈雷克必胜。

english: Myreque prevail [player name].
translation: 迈雷克必胜，[player name]。

english: You should get going friend. Darkmeyer awaits.
translation: 你该出发了，朋友。达克迈尔在等着你。

english: Good luck. Myreque prevail.
translation: 祝你好运。迈雷克必胜。

english: Be careful in Darkmeyer, friend. I can't even imagine how dangerous that city is.
translation: 在达克迈尔小心点，朋友。我简直无法想象那座城市有多危险。

english: Don't worry, I shall be.
translation: 别担心，我会的。

english: You need to infiltrate Darkmeyer and recover eight logs from the Blisterwood tree. Now, off you go.
translation: 你需要潜入达克迈尔，从水泡木树上取回八根原木。好了，出发吧。

english: To go in the Arboretum.
translation: 我要进植物园。

english: Well you can't.
translation: 你进不去。

english: Because nobody can go in the Arboretum.
translation: 因为没人能进植物园。

english: That can't be true. Someone must be allowed in?
translation: 不可能吧。总该有人能进去吧？

english: [vampyre name]. I'm new here.
translation: [vampyre name]。我是新来的。

english: Clearly. Well [vampyre name], you're wrong. No one can go in the Arboretum, by order of the Drakan family themselves.
translation: 显然。听着，[vampyre name]，你错了。没人能进植物园，这是德拉肯家族亲自下的命令。

english: Why do you want to go in, anyway?
translation: 话说回来，你为什么想进去？

english: Do you actually care?
translation: 你真在乎吗？

english: No, but I have a job to do.
translation: 不，但我有工作要做。

english: What will it take for you to let me in? There must be something you want. Do you want money?
translation: 要怎样你才肯让我进去？你一定有想要的东西。你想要钱吗？

english: I have no need for your money.
translation: 我不需要你的钱。

english: Eugh, fine! There's something I need doing. Get it done for me and I'll grant you access.
translation: 呃，好吧！有件事需要你去做。帮我办成了，我就让你进去。

english: Great! What do you need?
translation: 太好了！你需要什么？

english: There's a juvinate who was meant to deliver something to me. He hasn't shown up. Find him and tell him that Desmodus Lasiurus is getting impatient.
translation: 有个年轻吸血鬼本该给我送点东西来。但他没出现。找到他，告诉他德斯莫杜斯.拉西乌鲁斯等得不耐烦了。

english: Sure thing! What's he meant to be delivering?
translation: 没问题！他该送什么东西来？

english: Some slaves. You heard of Gadderanks? He was some human that Vanstrom used to help collect blood tithes.
translation: 一些奴隶。你听说过加德兰克斯吗？他是范斯特罗姆以前用来帮忙收集血税的人类。

english: Well, he went and got himself killed by the Myreque. Vanstrom owed me a favour so he agreed to let me have his wife and child.
translation: 结果他跑去被迈雷克干掉了。范斯特罗姆欠我个人情，所以同意把他的妻子和孩子给我。

english: Oh... I see.
translation: 哦……我明白了。

english: You got a problem?
translation: 你有意见？

english: Good. Mordan Nikazsi is the juvinate you're looking for. He'll be somewhere in the lowest tier of the city. Now, get lost!
translation: 好。莫尔丹.尼卡兹西就是你要找的年轻吸血鬼。他应该在城市最底层某个地方。现在，滚吧！

english: Trying to enter the Arboretum.
translation: 试图进入植物园。

english: Did you find Mordan Nikazsi?
translation: 你找到莫尔丹.尼卡兹西了吗？

english: Why are you here then? He'll be somewhere in the lowest tier of the city. Go find him!
translation: 那你来这儿干嘛？他应该在城市最底层某个地方。去找他！

english: He sold your slaves to Alexei Jovkai.
translation: 他把你的奴隶卖给了阿列克谢.乔夫凯。

english: That filthy wretch! I'll have him killed for this! Go find my slaves and bring them to me!
translation: 那个卑鄙的混蛋！我要为此杀了他！去找我的奴隶，把他们带到我这儿来！

english: Are you Mordan Nikazsi?
translation: 你是莫尔丹.尼卡兹西吗？

english: Yes, what of it?
translation: 是的，怎么了？

english: Desmodus Lasiurus sent me.
translation: 德斯莫杜斯.拉西乌鲁斯派我来的。

english: Oh great, just what I need.
translation: 哦，太好了，正合我意。

english: He wants his slaves. When are you planning to deliver them?
translation: 他想要他的奴隶。你打算什么时候送过去？

english: I'm not. He shan't be getting his slaves.
translation: 我不打算送。他别想得到他的奴隶。

english: Err... Why not?
translation: 呃……为什么不行？

english: Because I sold them to someone else.
translation: 因为我卖给别人了。

english: Why? Because I'm starving that's why! You lords and ladies probably haven't noticed yet, but you will soon enough. It's only a matter of time before you all run out of blood as well!
translation: 为什么？因为我快饿死了，就这么简单！你们这些领主和女士可能还没注意到，但你们很快就会了。你们所有人迟早也会把血喝光，这只是时间问题！

english: So you sold them for blood? Did you not think Desmodus would notice?
translation: 所以你把他们卖了换血？你难道没想过德斯莫杜斯会发现吗？

english: If I didn't do something I'd have been dead anyway. Better a quick death at Desmodus' hands than a slow one due to starvation!
translation: 如果我不做点什么，反正也是死路一条。死在德斯莫杜斯手里总比慢慢饿死强！

english: Look I don't care what happens between you and Desmodus, I just need to recover those slaves. Who did you sell them to?
translation: 听着，我不在乎你和德斯莫杜斯之间的事，我只需要找回那些奴隶。你把他们卖给谁了？

english: Don't waste your time, you won't get them back.
translation: 别白费力气了，你要不回来的。

english: Because I sold them to Lord Alexei Jovkai, one of the most powerful vampyres in the city. He looks at you the same way you look at me. He'll never let you have them.
translation: 因为我卖给了阿列克谢.乔夫凯领主，城里最强大的吸血鬼之一。他看你的眼神就像你看我一样。他绝不会让你得到他们的。

english: We'll see. Where can I find him?
translation: 走着瞧。我在哪儿能找到他？

english: He lives in the upper part of the city, but the slaves won't be there. He has a prison north of the Arboretum. That's where you'll find them.
translation: 他住在城市上层，但奴隶不在那儿。他在植物园北边有个监狱。你会在那儿找到他们。

english: Sounds like I need to visit this prison then.
translation: 看来我得去一趟这个监狱了。

english: Why are you back again?
translation: 你怎么又回来了？

english: Remind me, where can I find Desmodus' slaves?
translation: 提醒我一下，我在哪儿能找到德斯莫杜斯的奴隶？

english: They're not his slaves. They belong to Alexei Jovkai now. He'll be keeping them in his prison north of the Arboretum.
translation: 他们不是他的奴隶了。现在属于阿列克谢.乔夫凯。他会把他们关在植物园北边的监狱里。

english: Leave me alone. I have a job to do.
translation: 别烦我。我有工作要做。

english: Hello. Is your name Gadderanks?
translation: 你好。你是加德兰克斯吗？

english: Yes... I'm Maria Gadderanks. But... You're not one of Lord Jovkai's lot.
translation: 是的……我是玛丽亚.加德兰克斯。但……你不是乔夫凯领主的人。

english: No I'm not. Are you doing okay?
translation: 我不是。你还好吗？

english: I... I think so. We only arrived here a short while ago, but they've already given us food and some new clothes for Ron.
translation: 我……我想还好。我们才刚到不久，但他们已经给了我们食物，还给罗恩换了些新衣服。

english: You must be new around here. Lord Jovkai isn't like the rest of your lot. He keeps us well looked after.
translation: 你一定是新来的吧。乔夫凯领主不像你们其他人那样。他把我们照顾得很好。

english: He's taking care of you?
translation: 他在照顾你们？

english: Oh yes. A nice bed, good food and clean clothes. All he asks in return is a bit of blood from time to time. Lovely guy.
translation: 哦，是的。舒服的床、好食物和干净的衣服。他唯一要求的就是偶尔给点血。真是个好人。

english: I don't...
translation: 我不……

english: Hey you! What are you doing?
translation: 嘿，你！你在干什么？

english: I was just talking to the... prisoners?
translation: 我只是在和……囚犯说话？

english: Well clear off! These are Lord Jovkai's personal tithes.
translation: 快滚开！这些是乔夫凯领主的私人血税。

english: What's all this noise? What's going on in here?
translation: 这吵吵闹闹的是什么？这里发生什么事了？

english: It's this vyre, my lord. They're here to cause trouble.
translation: 是这只维尔吸血鬼，大人。他们是来找麻烦的。

english: You! Who are you?
translation: 你！你是谁？

english: I'm [vampyre name]. And I'm not here to cause any trouble, thank you very much.
translation: 我是[vampyre name]。我不是来找麻烦的，非常感谢。

english: I will be the judge of that, [vampyre name]. Now, why are you here?
translation: 这由我来判断，[vampyre name]。现在，你为什么在这儿？

english: These prisoners of yours, they were promised to Desmodus Lasiurus.
translation: 你的这些囚犯，原本是答应给德斯莫杜斯.拉西乌鲁斯的。

english: He's a guard at the Arboretum.
translation: 他是植物园的守卫。

english: Ah, so he's a nobody. Well, these prisoners are mine, I paid for them. You'll have to tell him to find some different ones.
translation: 啊，所以他是个无名小卒。好吧，这些囚犯是我的，我付了钱。你得告诉他去找别的了。

english: Yes... It seems nice here. We'd like to stay.
translation: 是的……这里看起来不错。我们想留下。

english: Jovkai! What's going on here?
translation: 乔夫凯！这里发生什么事了？

english: Nothing for you to concern yourself with Vanstrom. I have this under control.
translation: 没什么需要你操心的，范斯特罗姆。我能处理。

english: It doesn't seem that way.
translation: 看起来不像。

english: Tell me, is it now protocol for the head of the vyrewatch to come and investigate every disturbance?
translation: 告诉我，现在吸血鬼哨兵的首领要亲自来调查每一起骚乱了吗？

english: Surely you have bigger problems, like the blood shortages amongst the commoners?
translation: 你肯定有更大的问题要处理，比如平民中的血荒？

english: As it so happens I was on my way to the lower city to look into that very issue. However, on my way past, I heard shouting.
translation: 碰巧我正要去下层城市调查那个问题。然而，路过时我听到了喊叫声。

english: And you decided to investigate? How convenient. Tell me, is Lord Drakan really so interested in my business that he's now having you spy on me?
translation: 然后你就决定来调查？真巧。告诉我，德拉肯领主真的对我的事这么感兴趣，以至于现在派你来监视我？

english: You're paranoid, Jovkai. Lord Drakan doesn't care about you.
translation: 你太多疑了，乔夫凯。德拉肯领主不在乎你。

english: No. Many are starting to wonder if he cares about any of us.
translation: 不。很多人开始怀疑他是否在乎我们中的任何一个。

english: Careful there, Jovkai. Now tell me, what's happening here?
translation: 说话小心点，乔夫凯。现在告诉我，这里发生了什么？

english: This vyre was trying to steal some of my prisoners. I was having them removed.
translation: 这只维尔吸血鬼想偷我的一些囚犯。我正要把他赶走。

english: Hang on... I know those humans. That's the Gadderanks family. They don't belong to you.
translation: 等等……我认识那些人类。那是加德兰克斯一家。他们不属于你。

english: What do you mean? I paid for them!
translation: 你什么意思？我付了钱的！

english: That doesn't make them yours. These prisoners belong to Desmodus Lasiurus. You will have them returned to him at once.
translation: 那也不能让它们变成你的。这些囚犯属于德斯莫杜斯.拉西乌鲁斯。你必须立刻把他们还给他。

english: Or what? You don't get to order me around!
translation: 不然呢？你凭什么命令我！

english: You may be a lord, but you still answer to the Drakan family. That means you also answer to me.
translation: 你也许是个领主，但你终究要听命于德拉坎家族。也就是说，你也得听我的。

english: And what do you think Lasiurus will do with them if I give them to him? They're safe here. They'll be looked after.
translation: 那你觉得，我把他们交给拉西乌鲁斯之后，他会怎么处置他们？他们在这里很安全，会得到照顾。

english: You misunderstand me. I mean what kind of human?
translation: 你误解我了。我是问哪种人类？

english: I do not care what Lasiurus does with them any more than I care about you and your weird tendencies.
translation: 我才不管拉西乌鲁斯会怎么处置他们，就像我懒得管你和你的那些怪癖一样。

english: Now, we're done here. See that the prisoners are returned, or I'll have this place shut down.
translation: 好了，到此为止。把囚犯送回去，否则我就查封这里。

english: You there, vyre!
translation: 你，那个维尔吸血鬼！

english: Ye... Yes?
translation: 是……是的？

english: You will return to Lasiurus and tell him that his prisoners are on their way.
translation: 你回去告诉拉西乌鲁斯，他的囚犯很快就到。

english: Wait... Your voice, vyre. It sounds... familiar.
translation: 等等……你的声音，维尔吸血鬼。听起来……有点耳熟。

english: Clearly. Which makes me wonder why I'd know your voice.
translation: 显然如此。这倒让我好奇，我为什么会认得你的声音。

english: Turn and face me. I want to get a good look at you.
translation: 转过身来面对我。我要好好看看你。

english: Turn, and face me. I will not ask again.
translation: 转身，面对我。我不会再说第二次。

english: Vanstrom!
translation: 范斯特罗姆！

english: Eugh, what now Guile?
translation: 呃，又怎么了，吉尔？

english: Forgive me for the interruption, but Lady Vanescula has urgent need of you.
translation: 请原谅我的打扰，但瓦内斯库拉女士有急事找您。

english: Your life may be forfeit but for now you live. My mistress will understand my motives. She has an interest in the one you call Safalaan.
translation: 你的命可能保不住，但暂时你还活着。我的女主人会理解我的动机。她对你们称为萨法拉安的那个人感兴趣。

english: As a kind gesture for my intervening on your behalf, I take it as a kindness that you would deliver a message to him.
translation: 作为我替你出面的一种善意表示，如果你能带个口信给他，我会视为一种好意。

english: Fine. My business here is done, regardless.
translation: 好吧。反正我这边的事也办完了。

english: I thought we might do okay here but I guess we have another new owner now.
translation: 我本来以为我们在这里能过得不错，但现在看来，我们又有新主人了。

english: Why are you still here? Go tell Lasiurus that his slaves will be with him soon.
translation: 你怎么还在这儿？去告诉拉西乌鲁斯，他的奴隶很快就到。

english: Have you sorted my slaves out?
translation: 我的奴隶安排好了吗？

english: It's all dealt with. They'll be with you soon.
translation: 都处理好了。他们很快就到你那儿。

english: Good. Maybe you're not as useless as you look.
translation: 很好。看来你也没看起来那么没用。

english: I can go in the Arboretum now, then?
translation: 那我现在可以进植物园了？

english: Yes. Just don't tell anyone I let you in.
translation: 可以。不过别告诉任何人是我放你进去的。

english: Newcomers aren't allowed to use the bank. Come back once you've earned our trust.
translation: 新来的人不准使用银行。等你赢得了我们的信任再来吧。

english: I don't have time to poke around down there. I have work to do.
translation: 我没时间在那儿瞎逛。我还有工作要做。

english: Now's not the time for searching through corpses. I have work to do.
translation: 现在不是翻找尸体的时候。我还有工作要做。

english: You're back. Do you have the logs?
translation: 你回来了。拿到原木了吗？

english: Well run along then. We need eight logs from the blisterwood tree.
translation: 那就赶紧去吧。我们需要八根水泡木树的原木。

english: Good work [player name]. Did it all go okay?
translation: 干得好，[player name]。一切顺利吗？

english: It was a bit close at times. But I managed it.
translation: 有几次挺险的。不过我还是搞定了。

english: A bit close? You nearly blew everything with your little run in with Vanstrom. It was a good job I had Sarius keep an eye on you.
translation: 挺险的？你和范斯特罗姆那点小冲突差点毁了一切。还好我让萨里乌斯盯着你。

english: Spying on me?
translation: 你在监视我？

english: I just wasn't convinced you'd be able to do the job. It seems I was right to be cautious.
translation: 我只是不太确定你能不能完成任务。看来我谨慎点是对的。

english: I had it under control. By the way, where is Safalaan?
translation: 一切都在我的掌控之中。对了，萨法拉安在哪儿？

english: He said he needed a walk. I told him not to, but he insisted he'd be fine.
translation: 他说他想出去走走。我让他别去，但他坚持说他没事。

english: You worry too much. Safalaan is a big boy.
translation: 你太操心了。萨法拉安是个大人了。

english: Now, [player name]. Time to get these weapons made.
translation: 好了，[player name]。是时候打造这些武器了。

english: I've given your friend Vertida the required information. He will show you what to do.
translation: 我已经把必要的信息给了你的朋友维尔蒂达。他会告诉你该怎么做。

english: He's at the Meiyerditch hideout. Make sure to take the logs with you. The others need them for their own weapons.
translation: 他在迈尔迪奇的藏身处。记得带上原木。其他人也需要它们来制作自己的武器。

english: Right then. I'll be back once the weapons are made.
translation: 好的。武器造好后我就回来。

english: Deliver those blisterwood logs to Vertida in the Meiyerditch hideout. He'll show you how to make the new weapons out of them.
translation: 把这些水泡木原木送到迈尔迪奇藏身处给维尔蒂达。他会教你如何用它们制作新武器。

english: Right, I'll be back later.
translation: 好，我待会儿回来。

english: You're meant to be working with Vertida to make the blisterwood weaponry. Run along now.
translation: 你应该和维尔蒂达一起制作水泡木武器。快去吧。

english: I hear you're meant to be bringing us some logs. Do you have them?
translation: 我听说你要给我们带些原木来。你拿到了吗？

english: I'll be here once you have them. We need eight in total.
translation: 你拿到后我就在这儿。我们总共需要八根。

english: Great. Could I have seven of them?
translation: 太好了。能给我七根吗？

english: Right, we're going to be using these logs to make blisterwood sickles. That's what most of us will be using in the battle.
translation: 好，我们要用这些原木来制作水泡木镰刀。我们大多数人都会在战斗中使用这个。

english: However, I think you'll be able to swap out the sickle on your flail for a blisterwood one.
translation: 不过，我觉得你可以把你连枷上的镰刀换成水泡木的。

english: A blisterwood flail. I like the sound of that. So how do we make these sickles?
translation: 水泡木连枷。我喜欢这个主意。那我们怎么制作这些镰刀？

english: It should be very similar to how you made your emerald sickle. First, you'll want a blessed silver sickle. We have plenty in the crate over there.
translation: 应该和你制作绿宝石镰刀的方法非常相似。首先，你需要一把祝福过的银镰刀。那边板条箱里有很多。

english: You'll want to take your blessed sickle and use a chisel to embed a ruby in it. You'll need to get your own ruby I'm afraid.
translation: 然后，用你的祝福镰刀和凿子，在上面镶嵌一颗红宝石。不过恐怕你得自己弄到红宝石。

english: Once that's done, you'll need to enchant the ruby sickle using a ruby enchant spell.
translation: 完成后，你需要用红宝石附魔法术来附魔这把红宝石镰刀。

english: Finally, you'll need to use a knife to combine your sickle with the blisterwood logs. That will give you a blisterwood sickle.
translation: 最后，你需要用小刀将你的镰刀和水泡木原木组合起来。这样就能得到一把水泡木镰刀。

english: And then I can attach that to my flail?
translation: 然后我就可以把它装到我的连枷上了？

english: Exactly. If you need any help, just let me know.
translation: 没错。如果你需要任何帮助，就告诉我。

english: I'll get started.
translation: 我这就开始。

english: I'll keep them for now.
translation: 我先留着它们。

english: Well let me know when you're ready to hand them over.
translation: 好吧，准备好交给我的时候告诉我一声。

english: First you'll want to take a blessed silver sickle and use a chisel to embed a ruby in it. There's some blessed sickles in a crate here but you'll need to get your own ruby.
translation: 首先，你需要拿一把祝福过的银镰刀，用凿子在上面镶嵌一颗红宝石。这里有个板条箱，里面有一些祝福过的镰刀，但你需要自己弄到红宝石。

english: Finally, you'll need to use a knife to combine your sickle with the blisterwood logs. That will give you a blisterwood sickle that you can attach to your flail.
translation: 最后，你需要用小刀将你的镰刀和水泡木原木组合起来。这样就能得到一把可以装到你连枷上的水泡木镰刀。

english: Do you need any help with Flaygian's Notes?
translation: 你需要帮忙处理弗莱吉恩的笔记吗？

english: Good to have you here, [player name]. Everything seems to feel more positive when you're around.
translation: 很高兴你在这里，[player name]。有你在的时候，一切似乎都更积极了。

english: Here you go. Put it to good use.
translation: 给你。好好利用它。

english: This place isn't as big as the old hideout but it will do for now.
translation: 这个地方没有旧藏身处大，但暂时够用了。

english: Well you'll need to get an emerald and attach it to the sickle. You'll be needing a chisel to do that. Once you've attached the emerald you should be able to enchant the sickle using an enchantment spell.
translation: 嗯，你需要弄到一颗绿宝石，然后把它装在镰刀上。你需要一把凿子来完成这个。装上绿宝石后，你应该能用附魔法术给镰刀附魔。

english: Things are okay here. I'm worried about what Vanstrom might be up to though.
translation: 这里还算好。不过我担心范斯特罗姆在搞什么花样。

english: Great. I've also finished work on our sickles. You should go back to the graveyard and let the others know.
translation: 太好了。我也完成了镰刀的工作。你应该回墓地通知其他人。

english: We're surviving. That's as good as we can hope for right now.
translation: 我们还在坚持。目前来说，这已经是最好结果了。

english: Hello, [player name]. You'd better get moving. Ranis will be starting his speech soon.
translation: 你好，[player name]。你最好动身了。拉尼斯很快就要开始他的讲话了。

english: Hello there. Have a read through those notes and let me know if you need any help.
translation: 你好啊。把这些笔记看一遍，如果需要帮助就告诉我。

english: Sorry I can't talk right now. I need to prepare for our evacuation.
translation: 抱歉，我现在不能说话。我得为撤离做准备。

english: Congratulations on your promotion! You should be very proud!
translation: 恭喜你升职了！你应该很自豪！

english: Not good. If Vanstrom has a way to find this hideout then we could be in big trouble.
translation: 不妙。如果范斯特罗姆有办法找到这个藏身处，那我们麻烦就大了。

english: Well I have made a few more. Do you need an Ivandis Flail or a Blisterwood Flail?
translation: 嗯，我又做了几个。你需要伊凡迪斯连枷还是水泡木连枷？

english: Hello, [player name]. You'd better get moving. Ranis won't wait for you.
translation: 你好，[player name]。你最好动身了。拉尼斯不会等你的。

english: Have you spoken to the others about the plan.
translation: 你和其他人讨论过计划了吗？

english: No problem. It will cost you though.
translation: 没问题。不过得付钱。

english: Looks like you already have one.
translation: 看来你已经有一个了。

english: Looks like you already have it.
translation: 看来你已经有了。

english: 40,000 coins should do it.
translation: 四万金币就行。

english: Luckily for you I found them again. Try and look after them this time.
translation: 算你走运，我又找到了。这次可要好好保管。

english: Well, it seems like you've done that! I'll tell you what I'll do. I'll write you out a message to give to Veliaf as proof that the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque still exists.
translation: 嗯，看来你做到了！我这样办吧。我给你写一封信，交给维利亚夫，证明迈雷克的桑吉内斯蒂教团仍然存在。

english: Well come back when you've made some room and I'll give you a message.
translation: 好吧，等你腾出空间再来找我，我会给你一封信。

english: Well what are you waiting for? Let's make this weapon.
translation: 那你还在等什么？我们来做这把武器。

english: Safalaan is on a mission at the moment; he may wish to return to base when he hears your news, so it would be helpful if you could offer to take his mission over for him.
translation: 萨法拉安目前有任务在身；他听到你的消息后可能想返回基地，所以如果你能主动替他完成任务，那就帮大忙了。

english: Go and scout out the castle by following the great vyre- wall to the west. There is a barricade which prevents travel north, located under the wall. You'll need to search the wall southeast of the barricade
translation: 沿着巨大的维尔吸血鬼之墙向西走，去侦察城堡。墙下有一道路障，阻止了向北的通行。你需要搜索路障东南方向的墙。

english: This is disastrous! Things seem to go from bad to worse! You will have to communicate this information to Safalaan directly, my friend. He needs to know as soon as possible.
translation: 这太糟糕了！事情越来越糟！你必须直接把这个消息告诉萨法拉安，我的朋友。他需要尽快知道。

english: Veliaf? Is he still alive? Amazing! Well, you make a convincing story, so I guess I'll have to believe you for now.
translation: 维利亚夫？他还活着？太棒了！好吧，你的故事听起来很可信，我想我现在只能相信你了。

english: Myreque prevails! What can I do for you?
translation: 迈雷克必胜！有什么能帮你的？

english: Well, it seems like you've done that! I'll tell you what I'll do. I'll write you out a message to give to Veliaf as proof that the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque exists.
translation: 嗯，看来你做到了！我这样办吧。我给你写一封信，交给维利亚夫，证明迈雷克的桑吉内斯蒂教团存在。

english: This will explain our current situation and give some proof that the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque exists.
translation: 这封信会解释我们目前的处境，并证明迈雷克的桑吉内斯蒂教团存在。

english: to release the lock on the door, it will be unlocked for two minutes. There is a catch on the door so you can always open it when you approach it from the north.  If you're careful, the vyrewatch won't see you.
translation: 释放门锁后，门会解锁两分钟。门上有个卡扣，所以你从北边接近时总能打开它。如果你小心点，吸血鬼哨兵不会发现你。

english: I'm going to the wall now, so you can come with me - it'll be quicker than going back on your own.
translation: 我现在要去城墙了，你可以跟我来——这样比你一个人回去更快。

english: That's really up to you. You could investigate the ghetto a little more - familiarise yourself with the area. Why are you here anyway?
translation: 这真的取决于你。你可以再调查一下贫民区——熟悉一下环境。话说回来，你到底是为什么来这儿的？

english: Well met, [player name]. You should have a chat with Safalaan. He may be able to help you.
translation: 幸会，[player name]。你应该和萨法拉安谈谈。他也许能帮你。

english: Hello, [player name]. Good work getting that flail finished. This could turn the tide for us.
translation: 你好，[player name]。干得好，连枷完成了。这可能会为我们扭转局势。

english: Good to see you [player name]. You should go and speak to Safalaan, Veliaf and Vanescula.
translation: 见到你真好，[player name]。你应该去和萨法拉安、维利亚夫以及瓦内斯库拉谈谈。

english: Luckily for you I found them again. I'd give them to you but you don't have enough room.
translation: 算你走运，我又找到了。我本来打算给你，但你空间不够。

english: You'll need to search the wall southeast of the barricade to release the lock on the door; it will be unlocked for two minutes. There is a catch on the door so you can always open it when you approach it from the north.
translation: 你需要搜索路障东南方的墙，释放门锁；门会解锁两分钟。门上有个卡扣，所以你从北边接近时总能打开它。

english: That's really up to you. You could investigate the ghetto a little more - familiarise yourself with the area. However, you'll probably want to get back to where you came from and deliver that message I gave you.
translation: 这真的取决于你。你可以再调查一下贫民区——熟悉一下环境。不过，你可能更想回到你来的地方，把那封信送过去。

english: He's out on a mission sketching Castle Drakan. He's taken the wall route so you'll need to do the same. There is a barricade that prevents further travel north; it's located under the wall.
translation: 他出去执行任务了，在画德拉肯城堡的草图。他走了城墙路线，所以你也得这么走。有一道路障挡住了向北的路，就在城墙下方。

english: I know! It's the reason why I fight for the Myreque. I presume you have the same sentiments!
translation: 我知道！这就是我为迈雷克战斗的原因。我猜你也有同样的感受！

english: My name is Vertida and I'm a member of the Myreque here in Meiyerditch.
translation: 我叫维蒂达，是迈尔迪奇这里迈雷克的成员。

english: I'm not sure. Safalaan is the best one to talk to regarding that. However, we can but hope for the best. That and a quick and painless death.
translation: 我不确定。这方面萨法拉安是最好的人选。不过，我们只能抱最好的希望。还有就是希望死得痛快。

english: Well, it seems like you've done that! Just take that message I gave you to Veliaf as proof that the Sanguinesti order of the Myreque exists.
translation: 嗯，看来你做到了！把我给你的那封信交给维利亚夫，作为迈雷克的桑吉内斯蒂教团存在的证明。

english: Myreque prevails! What can I do for you, [player name]?
translation: 迈雷克必胜！有什么能帮你的，[player name]？

english: Great. I'll get going.
translation: 太好了。我这就去。

english: Good, thanks.
translation: 好的，谢谢。

english: Well met, [player name]. Do you have your weapon?
translation: 幸会，[player name]。你拿到武器了吗？

english: Well off you go then. You'll need it before we go any further.
translation: 那就快去吧。在我们继续下一步之前，你需要它。

english: Well met, [player name]. I'm guessing you have your weapon?
translation: 幸会，[player name]。我猜你拿到武器了？

english: That's right. I'm prepared.
translation: 没错。我已经准备好了。

english: And you took the logs to the others?
translation: 你把原木交给其他人了吗？

english: I did indeed.
translation: 确实给了。

english: Then we are ready.
translation: 那我们就准备好了。

english: Safalaan isn't back yet.
translation: 萨法拉安还没回来。

english: Do you know where he went?
translation: 你知道他去哪儿了吗？

english: There's a path just north of the graveyard. He went for a walk in that direction.
translation: 墓地北边有一条小路。他往那个方向散步去了。

english: I'll see if I can find him.
translation: 我去看看能不能找到他。

english: You need to try and find Safalaan. He went for a walk just north of the graveyard.
translation: 你需要试着找到萨法拉安。他往墓地北边散步去了。

english: Okay, I'll be back once I've found him.
translation: 好的，找到他我就回来。

english: You're meant to be finding Safalaan. Off you go.
translation: 你应该去找萨法拉安。快去吧。

english: Safalaan.
translation: 萨法拉安。

english: So this is it. All these years of fighting. All these years of running. It all ends today. One way or another.
translation: 就是这里了。这么多年的战斗。这么多年的逃亡。一切都在今天结束。无论如何。

english: One way or another.
translation: 无论如何。

english: You seem troubled?
translation: 你看起来有心事？

english: I guess that makes two of us.
translation: 看来我们俩都有心事。

english: Ha! Well, I asked first.
translation: 哈！好吧，是我先问的。

english: Do you remember Gadderanks?
translation: 你还记得加德兰克斯吗？

english: The human that worked with Vanstrom? Didn't you and Veliaf kill him?
translation: 那个和范斯特罗姆合作的人类？不是你和维利亚夫杀了他吗？

english: We did. Before he died though, he helped us. In return, he asked us to help his family.
translation: 是的。但在他死之前，他帮了我们。作为回报，他请求我们帮助他的家人。

english: I found them, in Darkmeyer. They were in a prison, albeit a nice one. The vampyre that owned it looked after his tithes.
translation: 我在达克迈尔找到了他们。他们被关在监狱里，虽然是个不错的监狱。那个拥有他们的吸血鬼把他的贡品照顾得很好。

english: They're not there anymore though, thanks to me. Another vampyre has them now. One that I don't imagine will show any kindness to them.
translation: 不过，多亏了我，他们现在不在那儿了。另一个吸血鬼现在拥有了他们。一个我猜不会对他们表现出任何善意的家伙。

english: I assume you had no choice?
translation: 我猜你当时别无选择？

english: Yes. It was the only way for me to get into the Arboretum. That doesn't change what I did, though. I broke my promise to a dying man.
translation: 是的。这是我进入植物园的唯一方法。但这并不能改变我所做的事。我违背了对一个垂死之人的承诺。

english: A man that worked for the vampyres.
translation: 一个为吸血鬼工作的人。

english: Because he had no other choice. Vanstrom would have killed his family otherwise.
translation: 因为他别无选择。否则范斯特罗姆会杀了他的家人。

english: We make the hard choices to spare others from having to.
translation: 我们做出艰难的选择，是为了让别人不必做出这样的选择。

english: Yes. But this time we weren't the ones who paid for it.
translation: 是的。但这一次，付出代价的不是我们。

english: When Drakan is gone, and Morytania is free, it will all be worth it.
translation: 等德拉坎完蛋了，莫利塔尼亚获得自由，这一切就都值得了。

english: If Vanescula keeps her word.
translation: 如果瓦内斯库拉信守承诺的话。

english: Well, that's me. Your turn.
translation: 好了，我的事说完了。轮到你了。

english: It's possible we will encounter Vanstrom today.
translation: 我们今天可能会遇到范斯特罗姆。

english: And I wonder... is there anything left of the man he once was?
translation: 我在想……他曾经作为人的那一面，还剩下多少？

english: Does the process of vampyrification destroy everything that makes us human? Or does it just hide it?
translation: 吸血鬼化的过程会摧毁一切让我们成为人的东西吗？还是仅仅把它隐藏起来了？

english: Maybe we'll never know. And yet...
translation: 也许我们永远不会知道。但话说回来……

english: Our whole order was built upon hope. A hope so small, it might as well have not even existed. But that never stopped us.
translation: 我们整个组织都建立在希望之上。一个渺小到几乎不存在的希望。但这从未阻止过我们。

english: I still cling on to some hope for him. Is that wrong?
translation: 我对他仍抱有一丝希望。这有错吗？

english: It's rarely wrong to hope.
translation: 怀抱希望很少是错的。

english: Well... We could stand here forever, watching the world go by. It's just delaying the inevitable.
translation: 嗯……我们可以永远站在这里，看着世事变迁。但这只是在拖延不可避免之事。

english: Time to end it.
translation: 是时候结束这一切了。

english: Oh... One last thing, [player name].
translation: 哦……还有最后一件事，[player name]。

english: Thank you, for everything. It's been a pleasure.
translation: 谢谢你，为了一切。与你共事很愉快。

english: Come. Let us return to the others.
translation: 来吧。我们该回到其他人那里去了。

english: Well it looks like everything is ready.
translation: 嗯，看来一切都准备好了。

english: Yes. Everyone has one of the new blisterwood sickles. They are all prepared.
translation: 是的。每个人都拿到了一把新的水疱木镰刀。他们都准备好了。

english: Good. Here's what's going to happen.
translation: 很好。计划是这样的。

english: From here, I will teleport our group to the Darkmeyer Arboretum. There, we will join with some vyres loyal to me.
translation: 从这里，我会将我们的小队传送到达克迈尔植物园。在那里，我们会和一些忠于我的维瑞斯人会合。

english: We will take your group to Castle Drakan as our prisoners. Once inside, my vyres will ensure no one enters while we deal with my brother.
translation: 我们会假装押送你们这群人进入达克摩尔城堡。一旦进入，我的维瑞斯人会确保在我们对付我兄弟期间，无人能进入。

english: Once Lowerniel is dead, I will teleport you all back here again. I will then announce his death to my kind and take his place as the ruler of Morytania.
translation: 一旦洛维尼尔死了，我会把你们全部传送回这里。然后我会向我的族人宣布他的死讯，并取代他成为莫利塔尼亚的统治者。

english: From there, we will start to build our new kingdom, together.
translation: 从那时起，我们将一起开始建立我们的新王国。

english: Yes we will.
translation: 是的，我们会。

english: Make sure you're ready for this, [player name]. Once we start, there's no going back.
translation: 确保你准备好了，[player name]。一旦开始，就没有回头路了。

english: Good, good. Once you are ready, let me know and we will begin.
translation: 好，好。等你准备好了，告诉我，我们就开始。

english: This is it. This is the day we've spent so long fighting for. Myreque prevail.
translation: 就是现在。这是我们为之奋斗了这么久的日子。迈雷克必胜。

english: Myreque prevail.
translation: 迈雷克必胜。

english: I need more time to prepare.
translation: 我还需要更多时间准备。

english: Well don't take too long. Return once you are ready.
translation: 嗯，别拖太久。准备好了就回来。

english: Are you ready to deal with my brother?
translation: 你准备好对付我兄弟了吗？

english: So this is it. End of the line. Good luck [player name]. I'll see you on the other side.
translation: 所以就是现在了。走到尽头了。祝你好运，[player name]。我们另一边见。

english: Good luck Ivan. Myreque prevail.
translation: 祝你好运，伊万。迈雷克必胜。

english: Vanescula? What's going on here?
translation: 瓦内斯库拉？这是怎么回事？

english: Vanstrom. I am here with a gift for my brother.
translation: 范斯特罗姆。我来给我兄弟带了一份礼物。

english: But... that's the Myreque.
translation: 但是……那是迈雷克的人。

english: Yes. All the Myreque.
translation: 是的。所有迈雷克的人。

english: I don't understand. How?
translation: 我不明白。怎么做到的？

english: Your efforts were valiant, Vanstrom. But alas, they were unsuccessful. I decided to take matters into my own hands, using a new tactic.
translation: 你的努力很英勇，范斯特罗姆。但可惜，没有成功。我决定亲自出马，用了一种新策略。

english: I negotiated with them. Convinced them that I was on their side. After that, bringing them in was trivial.
translation: 我和他们谈判了。让他们相信我是站在他们那边的。之后，把他们带进来就轻而易举了。

english: I... I'm sorry my lady, but this just seems too good to be true.
translation: 我……我很抱歉，女士，但这听起来好得令人难以置信。

english: Well it is true. Now, if you'll excuse me, I'd best be getting inside.
translation: 嗯，但这是真的。现在，请恕我失陪，我最好还是进去。

english: I rememeber when I was young. Our father would take me out into the woods, hunting.
translation: 我记得我年轻的时候。我们的父亲会带我去森林里打猎。

english: That was where I truly discovered what it meant to be alive.
translation: 那是我真正发现活着意味着什么的地方。

english: The constant fear. That knowledge that if you fail, your very life may well be over.
translation: 持续的恐惧。那种知道一旦失败，你的生命就可能终结的感觉。

english: But then at the same time, the thrill. The thrill of the chase. Of the conquest. Nothing can match it.
translation: 但同时，又有那种刺激。追逐的刺激。征服的刺激。没有什么能比得上它。

english: One day, he decided to bring my sister along. He felt it was time for her to develop her own taste for the hunt.
translation: 有一天，他决定带上我妹妹。他觉得是时候让她也培养对狩猎的兴趣了。

english: She was a natural. A raw talent I had never seen before, and rarely since. I felt a unique pride that day.
translation: 她是个天才。一种我前所未见、此后也极少见到的原始天赋。那天我感到一种独特的骄傲。

english: That wasn't all, of course. There were so many things she excelled at. So many talents.
translation: 当然，还不止这些。她擅长的事情太多了。天赋异禀。

english: But lying, Vanescula?
translation: 但是撒谎，瓦内斯库拉？

english: Lying was never one of them.
translation: 撒谎从来不是她的强项。

english: Brother. I don't...
translation: 兄弟。我不……

english: Tell me, Vanescula. What is the cause of this latest betrayal? How is it I have displeased you this time?
translation: 告诉我，瓦内斯库拉。这次背叛又是为了什么？我这次又是怎么让你不满意了？

english: I don't know what...
translation: 我不知道你在说……

english: Vanescula, please. This veil of lies is thinner than the humans you feast upon.
translation: 瓦内斯库拉，拜托。你这层谎言的面纱比你吸食的人类还要薄。

english: Now, the truth.
translation: 现在，说出真相。

english: You have been gone too long, brother. While you spend your days hidden away, lamenting about that stupid rock, our kind suffer.
translation: 你离开太久了，兄弟。当你躲藏起来，为那块愚蠢的石头哀叹时，我们的族人在受苦。

english: Out there, in your city, they're starving. There's not enough blood to go around and their great leader is unwilling to provide a solution.
translation: 在外面，在你的城市里，他们在挨饿。没有足够的血来维持，而他们伟大的领袖却不愿提供解决方案。

english: Something has to change, or we're doomed.
translation: 必须有所改变，否则我们都完了。

english: Vanescula, my dear sister. You disappoint me.
translation: 瓦内斯库拉，我亲爱的妹妹。你让我失望了。

english: You and your kind, you have spent your years engrossing yourself in culture, in aristocracy. Pretending to be something you're not.
translation: 你和你的同类，你们这些年沉浸于文化、贵族之中。假装成你们本不是的样子。

english: And in that time, you have forgotten something.
translation: 而在这段时间里，你们忘记了一些事情。

english: Allow me to remind you.
translation: 让我来提醒你。

english: I am Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan, ruler of Morytania and the lord of Vampyrium.
translation: 我是洛维尼尔.维吉迪亚德.德拉坎，莫利塔尼亚的统治者，吸血鬼之地的领主。

english: And when you play your games of politics, you do not do so because you're smarter than me.
translation: 当你玩弄政治游戏时，你并非因为比我聪明才这么做。

english: When you weave your words and make your schemes, you are not getting the better of me.
translation: 当你编织你的言语、制定你的阴谋时，你并没有占到我的上风。

english: No. You do these things only because I allow it. Because your plots are so insignificant to me, that I do not even care to pay attention to them.
translation: 不。你做这些事，仅仅是因为我允许。因为你的阴谋对我来说如此微不足道，我甚至懒得去注意它们。

english: But now Vanescula, now you have my attention. And now, you will be reminded what it means to cross the lord of Vampyrium.
translation: 但现在，瓦内斯库拉，现在你引起了我的注意。现在，你会被提醒，得罪吸血鬼之地领主意味着什么。

english: You'll need to get to Efaritay's Arboretum in the middle of the city. The city architects gave it a facelift to help it blend in, but it's still impossible to miss.
translation: 你得去城市中心的埃法里泰植物园。城市建筑师给它做了翻新以融入环境，但它仍然不可能错过。

english: Did you not know? [player name] here isn't just responsible for killing Ranis. She also killed our younger brother, Draynor.
translation: 你不知道吗？这里的[player name]不仅负责杀死拉尼斯。她还杀了我们的弟弟，德拉诺尔。

english: As yes, the great 'Count' Draynor. He loved his stupid titles. He was weak even before he got trapped on the wrong side of the Salve. A coward as well.
translation: 啊，是的，伟大的“德拉诺尔伯爵”。他喜欢他那愚蠢的头衔。他在被困在萨尔维河错误的一边之前就很弱。还是个懦夫。

english: You're meant to be searching the Haemalchemy Laboratory for more research.
translation: 你应该去血液炼金实验室寻找更多研究资料。

english: Well then you should go fetch him. Once you're both here, we can go over this research you've found.
translation: 那你应该去把他找来。等你们俩都到了，我们可以看看你找到的这些研究资料。

english: Oh. Well in that case, where is Safalaan?
translation: 哦。那样的话，萨法拉安在哪里？

english: If I remember, ma'am, I had little choice. You were quite... 'persuasive' the last time we met.
translation: 如果我没记错，女士，我当时别无选择。上次我们见面时，你相当……“有说服力”。

english: Let's get him!
translation: 我们上！

english: For Andiess!
translation: 为了安迪斯！

english: Well met, [player name]. Are you ready to face Ranis again?
translation: 幸会，[player name]。你准备好再次面对拉尼斯了吗？

english: Hopefully Flaygian's work will help us against the vampyres.
translation: 希望弗莱吉恩的研究能帮我们对付吸血鬼。

english: Hello, [player name]. I'll be leaving for Ver Sinhaza soon. You should meet me there.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我很快就要出发去韦尔辛哈扎了。你应该在那里和我碰面。

english: So many dead. The vampyres will pay!
translation: 死了这么多人。吸血鬼们要付出代价！

english: Are you sure? You don't have the Ivandis Flail with you. You won't be able to harm Ranis without it.
translation: 你确定吗？你身上没有伊凡迪斯连枷。没有它你伤不了拉尼斯。

english: Ranis Drakan is dead because of you. You're the hero the Myreque always needed.
translation: 拉尼斯.德雷坎因你而死。你就是迈雷克一直需要的英雄。

english: I do, but it doesn't look like you have room to hold it.
translation: 我确实有，但看起来你没地方放它。

english: Good idea. Just let me know once you are ready.
translation: 好主意。准备好了就告诉我。

english: I'd better not disturb you. You need to go see Safalaan, Veliaf and Vanescula.
translation: 我还是不打扰你了。你得去见萨法拉安、维利亚夫和瓦内斯库拉。

english: No! Wait!
translation: 不！等等！

english: Kael! Vertida!
translation: 凯尔！维尔蒂达！

english: Vanstrom.
translation: 范斯特罗姆。

english: My... my lord?
translation: 我……我的主人？

english: Are you still loyal?
translation: 你还忠诚吗？

english: Yes, my lord.
translation: 是的，我的主人。

english: Good. Deal with the rest of this. My sister and I have much to discuss.
translation: 很好。处理掉剩下的。我妹妹和我有很多话要谈。

english: I remember when I was young. Our father would take me out into the woods, hunting.
translation: 我记得我小时候。父亲会带我去树林里打猎。

english: I've waited a long time for this day. The day that the Myreque finally die.
translation: 我等这一天已经很久了。迈雷克最终灭亡的日子。

english: There'll be no hellhounds or abominations this time though. This time...
translation: 不过这次不会有地狱犬或怪物了。这次……

english: ...I'll deal with you myself.
translation: ……我会亲自解决你。

english: Safalaan don't!
translation: 萨法兰，不要！

english: Well, well. Safalaan Hallow.
translation: 哎呀，哎呀。萨法兰.哈洛。

english: How long I have wished to end your pitiful life...
translation: 我多么希望能结束你可悲的生命啊……

english: Stop! Just stop for a moment and think. This isn't who you really are!
translation: 住手！先停一下，好好想想。这不是真正的你！

english: You had a life before all of this. A life as Ascertes Hallow, my father.
translation: 在这之前你还有过一段人生。作为阿瑟特斯.哈洛，我的父亲。

english: Please! Think back to those days. Think back to who you used to be.
translation: 求你了！回想一下那些日子。回想一下你曾经是谁。

english: You talk too much.
translation: 你话太多了。

english: Blood will be my strength!
translation: 鲜血将是我的力量！

english: My pets will feast on your corpse!
translation: 我的宠物会啃食你的尸体！

english: Stare into darkness!
translation: 凝视黑暗吧！

english: Ha! Did you think you could beat me that easily?
translation: 哈！你以为你能这么轻易打败我吗？

english: See if you can survive this!
translation: 看看你能不能扛住这个！

english: We need to get back to Darkmeyer.
translation: 我们得回达克迈尔去。

english: Well be quick about it.
translation: 那就快点。

english: But I've lost my flail.
translation: 但我弄丢了连枷。

english: Luckily for you, I had another made. Although I'll have to charge you for it.
translation: 算你走运，我让人又做了一把。不过我得收你钱。

english: 40,000 coins.
Here you go. Now, are you ready?
translation: 给你。现在，准备好了吗？

english: I've managed to retrieve some of your things. I imagine you'll want them back.
translation: 我设法找回了一些你的东西。我想你会想要回去的。

english: I don't have anything for you friend. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 我没什么能给你的，朋友。如果我确实有你的任何物品，但你在取回之前就死了，那它们现在应该已经丢失了。

english: Enough! Stop this!
translation: 够了！住手！

english: Stop? And why would I want to do that?
translation: 住手？我为什么要那么做？

english: Father, please. You must remember something? Anything!
translation: 父亲，求你了。你一定还记得些什么吧？什么都行！

english: Remember? I remember everything!
translation: 记得？我什么都记得！

english: I remember how weak Ascertes was! The pathetic love he had for his wife, for his children!
translation: 我记得阿瑟特斯有多软弱！他对妻子、对孩子那可悲的爱！

english: I remember how good it felt! To be uplifted! To be made something more!
translation: 我记得那感觉有多好！被提升！被塑造成更强大的存在！

english: And I remember the joy when I took your sister's skull and crushed it with my bare hands!
translation: 我还记得当我拿起你妹妹的头骨，用我的双手将其捏碎时的那份喜悦！

english: No! No! No!
translation: 不！不！不！

english: Safalaan!
translation: 萨法拉安！

english: Veliaf...
translation: 维利亚夫……

english: [player name]! Safalaan! We need to go!
translation: [player name]！萨法拉安！我们得走了！

english: Safalaan?
translation: 萨法拉安？

english: What... What have I done?
translation: 我……我都做了什么？

english: Ivan, teleport him out of there!
translation: 伊万，把他传送出去！

english: I can't! He's too far away!
translation: 不行！他离我太远了！

english: Safalaan please.
translation: 萨法拉安，求你了。

english: What have I done?
translation: 我都做了什么？

english: But how does she get into the city? The place is a fortress.
translation: 但她是怎么进城的？那地方是个堡垒。

english: Talk to Vertida and see if you can help him finish off Flaygian's work.
translation: 去和维尔蒂达谈谈，看看你能不能帮他完成弗莱吉恩的工作。

english: It finally feels like we have a real chance against the vampyres. We have more citizens supporting our cause than ever before and the vyrewatch are being far more cautious now that they know we can kill them.
translation: 终于感觉我们有了真正对抗吸血鬼的机会。支持我们事业的市民比以往任何时候都多，而吸血鬼哨兵知道我们能杀死他们后，也变得谨慎多了。

english: You've done enough for now friend. Don't worry though, you'll be the first person we call upon when we're ready for our next move.
translation: 朋友，你暂时做得够多了。不过别担心，等我们准备好下一步行动时，你将是第一个被我们召唤的人。

english: Ah! Hello, [player name]. How goes it?
translation: 啊！你好，[player name]。最近怎么样？

english: Yes, you certainly can, my friend, but you'll need to make room for me to give you some items. Ask me again when you have space for four things.
translation: 是的，你当然可以，我的朋友，但你需要腾出空间让我给你一些物品。等你有四个空位时再来找我。

english: Take the new weapon and head to Ver Sinhaza. Kael will meet you there.
translation: 带上新武器，前往韦尔辛哈扎。凯尔会在那里和你碰面。

english: Thank you, [player name]. Good luck.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。祝你好运。

english: We're glad to have you with us! Right, well, I'd better get on with some planning. These foul Drakans aren't going to get on and destroy themselves now are they?
translation: 我们很高兴有你加入！好了，我得继续做些计划了。这些可恶的德雷坎家族可不会自己送上门来毁灭自己，对吧？

english: Hello there, [player name]. I have that tome of yours here.
translation: 你好，[player name]。你那本典籍在我这儿。

english: Our head researcher, Flaygian Screwte, has been working on translating the haemalchemy book. Could you check up on him and see how things are going?
translation: 我们的首席研究员弗莱吉恩.斯克鲁特一直在翻译那本血炼术书。你能去看看他，看看进展如何吗？

english: Excellent. You should give them to Flaygian.
translation: 太好了。你应该把它们交给弗莱吉恩。

english: Go to Ver Sinhaza and see if you can work out what Vanstrom and Ranis are up to.
translation: 去韦尔辛哈扎，看看你能不能弄清楚范斯特罗姆和拉尼斯在搞什么鬼。

english: And to you, friend.
translation: 你也是，朋友。

english: A message where from?
translation: 从哪儿来的消息？

english: Just in case you run into some troubles and need some more, you can get some more papyrus off old man Ral. He's helped us out once or twice before.
translation: 以防你遇到麻烦需要更多，你可以从老人拉尔那里再弄些莎草纸。他以前帮过我们一两次。

english: Indeed there are. We need sketches of the northern, western, and southern sides of the castle. I've checked the situation out with regards to the vyrewatch flight patterns and you'll attract less attention if you quickly
translation: 确实有。我们需要城堡北面、西面和南面的草图。我已经调查过吸血鬼哨兵的飞行模式，如果你动作快的话，就不会引起太多注意。

english: Yes, you certainly can, my friend. I was on a mission to scout out this castle. We need to get plans of the castle in order to mount an attack. I have yet to start, but please could you take over for me?
translation: 是的，你当然可以，我的朋友。我本来在执行侦察这座城堡的任务。我们需要获取城堡的平面图才能发动攻击。我还没开始，但你能替我接手吗？

english: Ah, Veliaf! Myreque prevail! My friend, you're just the tonic for my otherwise black mood. Tell me, what news comes from the west?
translation: 啊，维利亚夫！迈雷克必胜！我的朋友，你正是我阴郁心情的一剂良药。告诉我，西方有什么消息？

english: It's a good question, but not one I can answer right now. If you get a chance could you look into this for us?
translation: 问得好，但我现在回答不了。如果你有机会，能帮我们查查这个吗？

english: Then I must beg you for a small task, to return to Veliaf with a message to advise him of what has transpired here. I realise that bearing messages seems somewhat lowly, but your ability to pass in and out of
translation: 那我必须恳求你帮我一个小忙，带个口信回维利亚夫那里，告诉他这里发生的事。我知道带口信似乎有点低微，但你能自由进出

english: You've done well, [player name], very well indeed. This tome looks like it contains research notes which might give us some clues as to the vampyres' weaknesses.
translation: 你做得很好，[player name]，真的非常好。这本典籍看起来包含研究笔记，可能会给我们一些关于吸血鬼弱点的线索。

english: Hmm, interesting. This message gives details of some sort of laboratory; maybe there is some interesting information there which we should find out. Now that I have those sketches, we can keep an eye out for this
translation: 嗯，有意思。这条消息提供了某种实验室的细节；也许那里有一些我们应该查明的有趣信息。既然我有了那些草图，我们可以留意这个

english: You have my gratitude, friend!  Myreque prevail!  I need to take a good look at these and see if we can find something.
translation: 我感激不尽，朋友！迈雷克必胜！我需要好好看看这些，看看能不能发现什么。

english: Sanguinesti without being detected makes you perfect for this assignment. I also have some information for you which should help with your journeys through Meiyerditch. There are two doors, the first is in sector
translation: 能不被察觉地进出桑吉内斯蒂，让你成为这项任务的完美人选。我还有一些信息，应该能帮你在迈尔迪奇中穿行。有两扇门，第一扇在

english: make your way to the north and do that sketch first, then sketch the western side, and finally finish off here at the southern aspect.
translation: 先往北走，画好北面的草图，然后画西面，最后在南面这里完成。

english: Good luck, my friend. Return to the base camp when you have completed the plans.
translation: 祝你好运，我的朋友。完成平面图后返回营地。

english: place. In fact, it would be great if you could look for it for us. Keep the message - it may help you to locate it.
translation: 地方。事实上，如果你能帮我们找找就太好了。留着这条消息——它可能帮你找到它。

english: I can believe that, [player name], and once again you have our gratitude. For my part your arrival has not come soon enough. I have a feeling that your efforts in our struggle are not yet over. I for one would be grateful
translation: 我相信，[player name]，我们再次感谢你。就我而言，你的到来还不够快。我有种感觉，你在我们斗争中的努力还没有结束。我个人会感激

english: one and the other is in sector two. You can use them to reach this hideout much faster.

translation: 加入你找到的金属、盔甲或武器来填满它。

english: We stick to bronze and iron for this sword...
translation: 这把剑我们只用青铜和铁...

english: We keep the first sword simple.
translation: 第一把剑我们做简单点。

english: I've added a few things to the crucible. Is that enough?
translation: 我已经往坩埚里加了一些东西。够了吗？

english: No, we need more...
translation: 不，我们还需要更多...

english: 28 metal bars worth. Weapon and armour can go into crucible too but some metal lost when melted down.
translation: 28块金属条的量。武器和盔甲也可以放进坩埚，但熔化时会损失一些金属。

english: Right, that's the crucible full. Can I make the sword yet?
translation: 好了，坩埚满了。我现在能做剑了吗？

english: Kovac think we need to set up a mould.
translation: 科瓦克觉得我们需要设置一个模具。

english: What's a mould used for?
translation: 模具是做什么用的？

english: Kovac think mould will determine the type of sword to be made.
translation: 科瓦克觉得模具会决定要做的剑的类型。

english: Remember, we need aFlat Broadsword.
translation: 记住，我们需要一把平阔剑。
