english: Seren? But that's impossible, Seren is gone.
translation: 塞伦？但那是不可能的，塞伦已经不在了。

english: He seems to think otherwise. He claimed that a part of Seren still lives, trapped within the Temple of Light. Apparently, he discovered this by breaking one of the nine seals within the Grand Library.
translation: 他似乎不这么认为。他声称塞伦的一部分仍然活着，被困在光明神殿内。显然，他是通过打破大图书馆内的九个封印之一发现这一点的。

english: That's impossible. He must be lying.
translation: 那不可能。他一定在撒谎。

english: Sorry, but I don't understand what you mean by all of this. Who's Seren? What library?
translation: 抱歉，但我不明白你们说的这些。塞伦是谁？什么图书馆？

english: Seren was our goddess, our guardian and our teacher. Everything we have, we owe to her. She helped us build the great city of Prifddinas, a place where all elves could live in harmony.
translation: 塞伦是我们的女神，我们的守护者和教师。我们拥有的一切都归功于她。她帮助我们建造了伟大的普里夫迪纳斯城，一个所有精灵都能和谐共处的地方。

english: At the end of the God Wars, the gods were banished from this world. Seren didn't want to leave us though, she couldn't. She shattered herself into thousands of crystals. Those crystals are all we have left of her now.
translation: 在神战结束时，众神被驱逐出这个世界。但塞伦不想离开我们，她做不到。她将自己碎裂成数千颗水晶。那些水晶就是她现在留给我们的全部。

english: I see, I'm sorry to hear that.
translation: 我明白了，听到这些我很难过。

english: As for the Grand Library, it was a great archive of knowledge beneath Prifddinas. Pretty much everything there was open to all of elven kind.
translation: 至于大图书馆，那是普里夫迪纳斯城地下一个巨大的知识宝库。几乎所有东西都对所有精灵开放。

english: There was an exception to that though, the nine seals of Seren. The seals guarded the forbidden knowledge, that which only Seren herself could access.
translation: 但有一个例外，那就是塞伦的九个封印。这些封印守护着禁忌的知识，只有塞伦本人才能接触。

english: And Lord Iorwerth managed to break one of these seals.
translation: 而伊尔沃斯领主成功打破了其中一个封印。

english: So he claims...
translation: 他是这么声称的……

english: Is there no way we can check?
translation: 我们没办法查证吗？

english: No. Prifddinas was lost to us. When Lord Iorwerth first took control of the city, my grandfather, Baxtorian, led an army to try and stop him.
translation: 没有。普里夫迪纳斯城已经失守。当伊尔沃斯领主最初控制这座城市时，我的祖父巴克斯托里安率领军队试图阻止他。

english: When that failed, Baxtorian and the other clan elders made one final ditch attempt to save Prifddinas. They sung the song of inversion to revert the entire city to a crystal seed.
translation: 当那失败后，巴克斯托里安和其他部族长老做了最后一次孤注一掷的尝试来拯救普里夫迪纳斯城。他们吟唱了逆转之歌，将整座城市变回了一颗水晶种子。

english: Their plan worked, and the city was lost to Lord Iorwerth. However, it was lost to the rest of us as well, the Grand Library with it.
translation: 他们的计划成功了，城市从伊尔沃斯领主手中失去。然而，我们其他人也失去了它，大图书馆也随之而去。

english: What happened to Baxtorian?
translation: 巴克斯托里安后来怎么样了？

english: While he was fighting Lord Iorwerth, invaders took control of our kingdom to the east. They kidnapped Glarial, Baxtorian's wife.
translation: 当他在与伊尔沃斯领主战斗时，入侵者控制了我们在东方的王国。他们绑架了巴克斯托里安的妻子格拉里尔。

english: Unable to find her, he sealed himself beneath the waterfall where they lived, never to be seen again.
translation: 找不到她之后，他把自己封在了他们居住的瀑布之下，从此再也没人见过他。

english: Baxtorian was king of the elves back then. Do you think he had access to the forbidden knowledge?
translation: 巴克斯托里安当时是精灵的国王。你认为他能接触到禁忌的知识吗？

english: It's not impossible I suppose. If anyone, it would have been him. Baxtorian was closer to Seren than any other elf, it's one of the reasons he was chosen to become king.
translation: 我想这并非不可能。如果有人的话，那一定是他。巴克斯托里安比其他任何精灵都更接近塞伦，这也是他被选为国王的原因之一。

english: Baxtorian is gone though, even if he knew something, he can't help us now.
translation: 但巴克斯托里安已经不在了，即使他知道些什么，他现在也帮不了我们。

english: Don't be so sure. I never knew my grandfather, but my mother always told me that he wasn't the type for taking chances. If he knew something important, he'd have made sure it wouldn't have been lost with him.
translation: 别这么肯定。我从未见过我的祖父，但我母亲总是告诉我，他不是那种会冒险的人。如果他知道什么重要的事，他一定会确保它不会随他一起消失。

english: We can't possibly make a plan without knowing Lord Iorwerth's intentions. While unlikely to be true, this stuff about the library is all we have to go on.
translation: 在不知道伊尔沃斯领主意图的情况下，我们不可能制定计划。虽然很可能不是真的，但关于图书馆的这些事是我们目前唯一的线索。

english: If Baxtorian left behind anything that could help us, we should try to find it.
translation: 如果巴克斯托里安留下了任何能帮到我们的东西，我们应该试着找到它。

english: Baxtorian kept everything of importance to him at his home within Baxtorian Falls. If we're going to find anything, it's probably there.
translation: 巴克斯托里安把他所有重要的东西都放在巴克斯托里安瀑布的家中。如果我们要找什么，很可能就在那里。

english: [player name], you've been to Baxtorian Falls multiple times. You're the best person to take the lead on this.
translation: [player name]，你去过巴克斯托里安瀑布好几次了。你是领导这次行动的最佳人选。

english: You trust the human with this?
translation: 你信任这个人类来做这件事？

english: Let go of your pride, Ysgawyn. [player name] has proven his worth to us.
translation: 放下你的骄傲吧，伊斯卡温。[player name]已经向我们证明了他的价值。

english: I'd like to accompany you on this one [player name], it might be useful to have an elf with you.
translation: 我想陪你一起去，[player name]，有个精灵和你一起可能会很有用。

english: Before her death, my mother passed down a book to me. It was written by my grandfather for his wife. You should take it with you. It might contain something of use.
translation: 在我母亲去世前，她传给我一本书。是我祖父写给他妻子的。你应该带上它。里面可能有些有用的东西。

english: Thank you Islwyn. While we're gone, the rest of you should focus on Lord Iorwerth. See if you can get any idea on what he's planning now that he's lost Ardougne. Just be careful.
translation: 谢谢你，伊斯尔温。我们不在的时候，你们其他人应该专注于伊尔沃斯领主。看看能不能弄清楚他失去了阿多尼城后有什么计划。小心点。

english: We always are. Good luck to you both.
translation: 我们一向如此。祝你们俩好运。

english: And you. Let's get started.
translation: 也祝你们好运。我们开始吧。

english: Thank you for agreeing to help us, [player name]. We owe a lot to you, even if some of us don't show it very well.
translation: 谢谢你同意帮助我们，[player name]。我们欠你很多，即使我们中的一些人表现得不那么明显。

english: You mean Ysgawyn? He is a bit rude.
translation: 你是说伊斯卡温？他有点粗鲁。

english: Try not to be too judgemental. Ysgawyn's husband was killed by Essyllt, one of Lord Iorwerth's henchmen. Ysgawyn's never really been the same since.
translation: 尽量别太苛责。伊斯卡温的丈夫被埃西尔特杀了，埃西尔特是伊尔沃斯领主的一个手下。从那以后，伊斯卡温就再也不是原来的他了。

english: I've met Essyllt, he was the one in charge of the mourners in West Ardougne.
translation: 我见过埃西尔特，他是西阿多尼城哀悼者的负责人。

english: He's a nasty piece of work. If you try hard enough, you can find something redeemable about most elves, even those that serve Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 他是个坏透了的家伙。如果你努力去找，大多数精灵身上都能找到一些可取之处，即使是那些为伊尔沃斯领主效力的。

english: But Essyllt... He seems to take joy in the suffering of others, especially those unable to defend themselves.
translation: 但埃西尔特……他似乎以他人的痛苦为乐，尤其是那些无力自卫的人。

english: Enough about him though, we need to focus on Baxtorian Falls. I suggest we travel seperately, we can't be too careful at the moment.
translation: 不过，关于他的事就到此为止吧。我们需要专注于巴克斯托里安瀑布。我建议我们分头行动，现在我们必须格外小心。

english: Makes sense, will you be okay getting there on your own?
translation: 有道理，你一个人去那里没问题吗？

english: I'm no expert on your lands but I should be fine. I just have a few things to gather before I depart.
translation: 我对你们这片土地不太熟悉，但我应该没问题。我只是在出发前需要收集一些东西。

english: Well in that case, I'll meet you there.
translation: 那样的话，我们那里见。

english: I just have a few things to gather before I depart for Baxtorian Falls. I'll meet you there.
translation: 我在出发去巴克斯托里安瀑布前需要收集一些东西。我们那里见。

english: Sounds good, see you there.
translation: 听起来不错，那里见。

english: Hey [player name]. Good to see you.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。很高兴见到你。

english: Pretty good. I've been thinking about that elf, Ysgawyn.
translation: 还不错。我一直在想那个精灵，伊斯卡温。

english: Bit of an angry guy isn't he?
translation: 他有点暴躁，是吧？

english: That's one way to put it. I can't say I approve of his attitude, but I appreciate he's seen a lot in this war.
translation: 可以这么说。我不能说赞同他的态度，但我理解他在这场战争中经历了很多。

english: It's interesting, the elves have such long lifespans, we're just children compared to them. And yet, even with all their experience, they're still just as fickle as we are.
translation: 有趣的是，精灵的寿命如此之长，我们和他们相比只是孩子。然而，即使有这么多经验，他们仍然和我们一样善变。

english: I find most races are the same to be honest.
translation: 老实说，我发现大多数种族都一样。

english: Anyway, had any luck with Baxtorian Falls?
translation: 总之，在巴克斯托里安瀑布有什么发现吗？

english: I'll let you crack on then. We'll talk more later.
translation: 那你继续忙吧。我们晚点再聊。

english: No. Go away.
translation: 不。走开。

english: Hello there [player name], glad to see you made it here okay.
translation: 你好啊，[player name]，很高兴看到你安全到达这里。

english: You as well Arianwyn.
translation: 你也是，阿里安温。

english: I must say, it feels strange to be back here, especially after all of this time.
translation: 我得说，回到这里感觉很奇怪，尤其是在过了这么久之后。

english: You've been here before?
translation: 你以前来过这里？

english: A long time ago...
translation: 很久以前了……

english: I was one of the elves born in Baxtorian's new kingdom. My family were close relations of Baxtorian, he invited us here a few times.
translation: 我是在巴克斯托里安的新王国里出生的精灵之一。我的家族是巴克斯托里安的近亲，他邀请我们来过这里几次。

english: Those were simpler times, happier times. After Baxtorian left to try and retake Prifddinas, my parents were among those who joined him. They never returned. I was still just a child at the time, alone and afraid.
translation: 那是更简单的时光，更快乐的时光。巴克斯托里安离开去尝试夺回普里夫迪纳斯城后，我的父母也加入了他们。他们再也没有回来。那时我还只是个孩子，孤独又害怕。

english: I'm sorry to hear that Arianwyn.
translation: 听到这些我很难过，阿里安温。

english: This war has taken so much... From my people, and from yours. I'd give anything to see peace, anything to finally see Prifddinas with my own eyes.
translation: 这场战争夺走了太多……从我的人民，也从你的人民那里。我愿付出一切来换取和平，一切来亲眼看到普里夫迪纳斯城。

english: Sorry, now's not the time for this. We need to see if Baxtorian left anything of use behind.
translation: 抱歉，现在不是谈这个的时候。我们得看看巴克斯托里安有没有留下什么有用的东西。

english: Here's that book that Islwyn gave us. Hopefully it has something of use in it.
translation: 这是伊斯尔温给我们的那本书。希望里面有什么有用的东西。

english: Do you believe what Lord Iorwerth said about Seren?
translation: 你相信伊尔沃斯领主关于塞伦的话吗？

english: To be honest... I really don't know. It seems impossible, and yet...
translation: 说实话……我真的不知道。这似乎不可能，然而……

english: No. It's just me being wishful. He's lying, he has to be.
translation: 不。只是我一厢情愿罢了。他在撒谎，他一定在撒谎。

english: Wishful?
translation: 一厢情愿？

english: By the time I was born, Seren was already gone from this world. All I know of her is the stories my parents told me.
translation: 我出生的时候，塞伦已经离开了这个世界。我对她的了解仅限于父母给我讲的故事。

english: You wish you could have met her?
translation: 你希望你能见过她？

english: I do, but that doesn't mean I should fall for the lies of Lord Iorwerth. Seren is gone, nothing can ever bring her back.
translation: 是的，但这不代表我应该相信伊尔沃斯领主的谎言。塞伦已经不在了，没有什么能把她带回来。

english: Do you think we'll find anything to help us here?
translation: 你觉得我们能在这里找到什么有用的东西吗？

english: I won't lie, we're clutching straws here. We have nothing else to go on though, so we have to try.
translation: 说实话，我们是在抓救命稻草。但我们没有别的线索了，所以必须试试。

english: Baxtorian was once king of the elves, anything he left behind might be of use.
translation: 巴克斯托里安曾是精灵的国王，他留下的任何东西都可能有用。

english: I'll crack on.
translation: 我继续干活了。

english: We need to see if Baxtorian left anything of use behind. Maybe that book will be of use.
translation: 我们得看看巴克斯托里安有没有留下什么有用的东西。也许那本书会有用。

english: Glarial! I... oh...
translation: 格拉里尔！我……哦……

english: I'm [player name] and this is Arianwyn.
translation: 我是[player name]，这位是阿里安温。

english: Arianwyn... I remember that name. You grew up in my kingdom... I'm sorry about your family.
translation: 阿里安温……我记得这个名字。你在我的王国长大……我为你的家人感到难过。

english: Don't be your majesty...
translation: 陛下，请不要这么说……

english: I appreciate the sentiment, but please, I am no king anymore.
translation: 我理解你的好意，但请别这样，我已经不再是国王了。

english: Now I must ask... Glarial... Is there any news?
translation: 现在我必须问……格拉里尔……有消息吗？

english: I'm sorry but... she's gone.
translation: 我很抱歉，但是……她已经不在了。

english: I... I see... It was always a lot to hope for...
translation: 我……我明白了……这本来就是个奢望……

english: If it's any consolation, [player name] moved her remains here, to be closer to you.
translation: 如果这能让你好受一点的话，[player name]把她的遗骸移到了这里，离你更近。

english: That... That means a lot. Thank you. It is good to see that some humans still see elves as friends.
translation: 这……这意义重大。谢谢你。很高兴看到有些人类仍然视精灵为朋友。

english: If you need time...
translation: 如果你需要时间……

english: No... I feel I've spent long enough here.
translation: 不……我觉得我在这里待得够久了。

english: Then I can take you back to Lletya. Your grandson, Islwyn, is there.
translation: 那我可以带你回莱蒂亚村。你的孙子，伊斯尔温，在那里。

english: Grandson? So Eirlys had a child? Does she still live as well?
translation: 孙子？所以艾尔莉丝有了孩子？她也还活着吗？

english: I'm afraid not... I'm sorry.
translation: 恐怕没有……我很抱歉。

english: No father should outlive their child. Forgive me Eirlys.
translation: 没有父亲应该白发人送黑发人。原谅我，艾尔莉丝。

english: Please, let us leave now. There is too much sadness for me here, too much pain. Once we arrive, you must tell me everything that has happened in my absence.
translation: 请让我们离开吧。这里对我来说有太多悲伤，太多痛苦。到了之后，你必须告诉我我不在时发生的一切。

english: Very well, I will teleport us back to Lletya. You'll have to make your own way back I'm afraid, [player name].
translation: 好吧，我会用传送术把我们送回莱蒂亚村。恐怕你得自己回去了，[player name]。

english: No problem. See you soon.
translation: 没问题。一会儿见。

english: Oh... Hello there. You'd probably best talk to Arianwyn.
translation: 哦……你好。你最好去跟阿里安温谈谈。

english: I'd like to ask you something about yourself.
translation: 我想问你一些关于你的事。

english: I see... Go ahead.
translation: 我明白了……问吧。

english: Why did you seal yourself away?
translation: 你为什么把自己封印起来？

english: My Glarial... She mattered more to me than anything else, but she was lost to me. The enemy took her, so I searched far and wide to find her again.
translation: 我的格拉里尔……她对我来说比什么都重要，但我失去了她。敌人带走了她，所以我四处寻找，想再次找到她。

english: At times I came close, but in the end, I was too weak to carry on. I knew there was a chance she may live though, so I sealed myself away, hoping she would be the one to wake me.
translation: 有时我差点找到她，但最终，我太虚弱了，无法继续。我知道她可能还活着，所以我把自己封印起来，希望她会来唤醒我。

english: I see. I'm sorry.
translation: 我明白了。我很抱歉。

english: I thank you friend, but please, don't be. The burden is mine to bear.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友，但请不要这样。这负担该由我来承担。

english: What happened between you and Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 你和伊尔沃斯领主之间发生了什么？

english: To be honest, even today I know little of him. When I left Prifddinas to expand our kingdom into the east, he was but a child, with the Iorwerth clan ruled by his mother.
translation: 说实话，即使到今天，我对他也知之甚少。当我离开普里夫迪纳斯城向东扩张王国时，他还只是个孩子，伊尔沃斯氏族由他母亲统治。

english: The first time I properly met him was after I heard about his takeover of the city. I led my forces through the Underground Pass and confronted him at the city gates.
translation: 我第一次正式见到他是在听说他占领了城市之后。我率领部队穿过地下通道，在城市大门前与他对峙。

english: I tried to reason with him, but he had already decided that I was his enemy. We had the numbers and our forces were better skilled, so we tried to besiege the city.
translation: 我试图和他讲道理，但他已经认定我是他的敌人。我们人数占优，部队技术也更好，所以我们试图围攻城市。

english: The Iorwerth forces had the strength and safety of the city walls though. They slowly whittled us down until we were too weak to carry on. We had no choice but to retreat.
translation: 但伊尔沃斯的部队有城墙的力量和安全保障。他们慢慢消耗我们，直到我们虚弱得无法继续。我们别无选择，只能撤退。

english: We fell back into the Underground Pass, intending to return to our kingdom in the east. Lord Iorwerth sent his forces in after us, hoping to wipe us out.
translation: 我们退入地下通道，打算返回东方的王国。伊尔沃斯领主派部队追击我们，企图消灭我们。

english: We no longer had the strength in numbers, but we still outmatched the Iorwerth troops in skill and experience. We fought back while we retreated. Both sides suffered huge losses.
translation: 我们的人数优势已不复存在，但我们在技能和经验上仍然胜过伊尔沃斯军队。我们一边撤退一边反击。双方都损失惨重。

english: Eventually we managed to make it through to the other side. By then, there were few of us left. Lord Iorwerth had failed to wipe us out, but he knew we were beaten.
translation: 最终我们成功穿过了通道。到那时，我们剩下的人已经不多了。伊尔沃斯领主没能消灭我们，但他知道我们被打败了。

english: While we were gone, an uprising had occurred in the eastern kingdom. We took our best fighters to Prifddinas, those that remained were unable to hold back the enemy.
translation: 我们离开期间，东方王国发生了起义。我们带走了最精锐的战士去普里夫迪纳斯城，剩下的人无法抵挡敌人。

english: My wife was taken and most of my people were slaughtered. I turned my attention to finding my wife and getting the rest of my people to safety.
translation: 我的妻子被俘，大部分人民被屠杀。我把注意力转向寻找妻子，并让剩下的人民安全撤离。

english: Lord Iorwerth became the least of my problems. I suspect he didn't consider me much of a threat at that point anyway.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主成了我最不关心的问题。我猜那时他也不认为我有多大威胁。

english: What was Seren like?
translation: 塞伦是个什么样的人？

english: She... She was wonderful. She taught us to better ourselves in every way possible. Everything we know, everything we are, it all came from her.
translation: 她……她太棒了。她教导我们在各方面提升自己。我们所知的一切，我们的一切，都来自她。

english: I wish I could have met her.
translation: 真希望我能见过她。

english: I feel very blessed to have been able to. The love she had for us, it's unlike anything I've ever seen.
translation: 我觉得自己很幸运能见过她。她对我们的爱，是我从未见过的。

english: Sounds like she was pretty much perfect.
translation: 听起来她几乎完美无缺。

english: Well... not quite. Many of the elves alive now were not around when Seren was still with us. They only know her through the stories passed down to them. The stories don't tell everything though.
translation: 嗯……也不完全是。现在活着的许多精灵在塞伦还在时并不存在。他们只知道流传下来的故事。但故事并没有讲述一切。

english: Seren was remarkable, but under the surface, she hid a great pain. A sadness unlike any other. She never spoke of it, but when you looked hard enough, you could see the anguish.
translation: 塞伦很了不起，但在表面之下，她隐藏着巨大的痛苦。一种无与伦比的悲伤。她从不谈论，但当你仔细观察时，你能看到那份痛苦。

english: I guess we all have our demons, even the gods. Seren was a beacon of light in this grim world, but the brightest light casts the darkest shadow, and none shone brighter than her.
translation: 我想我们都有自己的心魔，即使是神也不例外。塞伦是这个黑暗世界中的一座信标，但最亮的光投下最暗的影，没有人比她更耀眼。

english: What do you think of the current elves?
translation: 你怎么看待现在的精灵？

english: Arianwyn and the rebels have done well to keep going for this long. They've been fighting this war for centuries, and yet they've never given up. I have much respect for them, they're far stronger than I ever was.
translation: 阿里安温和反抗军能坚持这么久已经很不容易了。他们为这场战争战斗了几个世纪，却从未放弃。我非常尊重他们，他们比我坚强得多。

english: Most of them are still young though. They lack the wisdom of the older elves, the ones who were around when Seren still walked this earth. Many of them never saw Prifddinas before the song of inversion.
translation: 不过他们大多还很年轻。他们缺乏年长精灵的智慧，那些在塞伦仍行走于大地时就在的精灵。许多人从未见过反转之歌之前的普里夫迪纳斯城。

english: Is that a bad thing?
translation: 那是坏事吗？

english: Not necessarily, but it is something to be cautious of. That which they fight for, it's a mere dream to them. They should remember that dreams seldom come true.
translation: 不一定，但需要谨慎。他们所奋斗的，对他们来说只是一个梦。他们应该记住，梦想很少能成真。

english: Welcome back [player name]. While you were gone, I filled Baxtorian in on everything that has happened. I also took the liberty of calling the others here, so that we can discuss our next move.
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。你不在的时候，我把发生的一切都告诉了巴克斯托里安。我还自作主张把其他人叫到了这里，这样我们可以讨论下一步行动。

english: You also missed out on Islwyn getting to meet his grandfather for the first time. I think he might have cried a little.
translation: 你还错过了伊斯尔温第一次见到他祖父。我觉得他可能哭了一点点。

english: Cried? In your dreams Eluned.
translation: 哭了？做梦吧，埃卢内德。

english: I appreciate we're all happy to have Baxtorian back with us, but let's not get distracted.
translation: 我知道大家都很高兴巴克斯托里安回到我们身边，但别分心。

english: Apologies, Arianwyn.
translation: 抱歉，阿里安温。

english: Right, over to you Baxtorian.
translation: 好了，巴克斯托里安，交给你了。

english: Thank you, Arianwyn. I... Forgive me, it's been a long time since I last chaired a meeting like this. Much has changed since then as well.
translation: 谢谢你，阿里安温。我……请原谅，我已经很久没有主持这样的会议了。而且自那以后，很多事情都变了。

english: Take your time.
translation: 慢慢来。

english: Arianwyn has informed me of Lord Iorwerth's revelation...
translation: 阿里安温已经告诉我伊尔沃斯领主透露的事……

english: Do you believe his claims?
translation: 你相信他的说法吗？

english: About Seren? No. As for him breaking a seal in the Grand Library... I... do not know.
translation: 关于塞伦？不。至于他打破大图书馆封印的事……我……不知道。

english: You don't know? What do you mean you don't know?
translation: 你不知道？你说你不知道是什么意思？

english: Ysgawyn...
translation: 伊斯卡温……

english: I know not what the seals hide. What I do know is that they could, in theory, be broken.
translation: 我不知道封印隐藏着什么。但我知道的是，理论上它们是可以被打破的。

english: I was lucky enough to be trusted by Seren. She confided in me many times. She never told me what knowledge the seals guard, but she did tell me that they could be destroyed.
translation: 我很幸运能得到塞伦的信任。她多次向我吐露心声。她从未告诉我封印守护着什么知识，但确实告诉我它们可以被摧毁。

english: I don't know exactly. She said that those who follow the light would be able to access her knowledge.
translation: 我不太确定。她说那些追随光明的人将能够获取她的知识。

english: And that's it? This gives us nothing to go on.
translation: 就这些？这让我们毫无头绪。

english: Not nothing. We now know that the seals can be destroyed, which means Lord Iorwerth could have spoken the truth.
translation: 并非毫无头绪。我们现在知道封印可以被摧毁，这意味着伊尔沃斯领主可能说的是真话。

english: But without access to the Grand Library, we have no way to be sure.
translation: 但无法进入大图书馆，我们就无法确定。

english: Well... we might still have a way.
translation: 嗯……我们或许还有办法。

english: A way to access the library?
translation: 有办法进入图书馆？

english: Yes... Prifddinas may have been reverted to seed, but it does still exist.
translation: 是的……普里夫迪纳斯城可能已经变回了种子，但它确实还存在。

english: You're not suggesting we restore the city are you? Even if we could, Lord Iorwerth would instantly take it.
translation: 你不是在建议我们恢复城市吧？即使我们能，伊尔沃斯领主也会立刻夺走它。

english: No. While Lord Iorwerth is at large, Prifddinas must remain as it is. However, there may be a way to still enter the city.
translation: 不。只要伊尔沃斯领主还在逍遥法外，普里夫迪纳斯城就必须保持现状。不过，或许还有办法进入城市。

english: You don't mean entering the crystal do you?
translation: 你不是说要进入水晶吧？

english: That's not possible.
translation: 那是不可能的。

english: Actually, I think it would be possible. The crystal seed that contains Prifddinas, it's not the same as the seeds we use to form weapons and armour.
translation: 实际上，我认为是可能的。包含普里夫迪纳斯城的水晶种子，和我们用来制造武器和盔甲的种子不一样。

english: The seed contains Prifddinas, but the seed itself is not the city.
translation: 种子包含了普里夫迪纳斯城，但种子本身并不是城市。

english: So it's like a box?
translation: 所以它就像一个箱子？

english: Exactly, and if we can enter the box...
translation: 没错，如果我们能进入那个箱子...

english: We can enter Prifddinas!
translation: 我们就能进入普里夫迪纳斯城！

english: That's the idea. It won't be straightforward though.
translation: 就是这个想法。不过不会那么简单。

english: Is it ever?
translation: 什么时候简单过？

english: We will need a special potion to be able to safely enter the crystal seed. We'll also need to be able to bypass the defences around it as well.
translation: 我们需要一种特殊的药水才能安全进入水晶种子。我们还需要能够绕过它周围的防御。

english: A potion? Sounds like my area of expertise.
translation: 药水？听起来是我的专长。

english: Perfect. Elena, if you could help create this potion, that would be greatly appreciated. The rest of us can work on those defences.
translation: 完美。埃琳娜，如果你能帮忙制作这种药水，那就太好了。我们其他人可以处理那些防御。

english: Right. [player name], meet me by the pond. I could use your help with this.
translation: 好的。[player name]，到池塘边找我。我需要你的帮助。

english: I've given Elena the information she needs to make that potion. You should speak to her by the pond.
translation: 我已经给了埃琳娜制作那种药水所需的信息。你应该去池塘边找她谈谈。

english: Baxtorian has given Elena the information she needs to make this potion. You should speak to her by the pond.
translation: 巴克斯托里安已经给了埃琳娜制作这种药水所需的信息。你应该去池塘边找她谈谈。

english: Hey [player name]. Glad everything went okay at Baxtorian Falls.
translation: 嘿[player name]。很高兴巴克斯托里安瀑布那边一切顺利。

english: Thanks. Anything exciting happen while I was gone?
translation: 谢谢。我不在的时候有什么有趣的事吗？

english: Nope, all nice and quiet for a change.
translation: 没有，难得一切都安静祥和。

english: Baxtorian is an interesting one, isn't he?
translation: 巴克斯托里安是个有趣的人，不是吗？

english: He does seem a bit...
translation: 他看起来有点……

english: Lost?
translation: 迷失？

english: He reminds me of a story my father once told me. A story of a broken man.
translation: 他让我想起父亲曾经给我讲的一个故事。一个关于破碎之人的故事。

english: What was the story?
translation: 什么故事？

english: A long time ago, there were two brothers living in Avarrocka. They lived a simple life, farming the land and selling the produce to people in the city.
translation: 很久以前，阿瓦罗卡住着两兄弟。他们过着简单的生活，耕种土地，把农产品卖给城里的人。

english: When war came to the city, the king ordered that every able-bodied man take up arms against the enemy. The two brothers had to leave their home behind, to fight for a king they'd never met.
translation: 当战争降临城市时，国王命令所有身体健全的男人拿起武器对抗敌人。两兄弟不得不离开家园，为一个素未谋面的国王而战。

english: Like everyone else, they were given basic weapons and basic training. Enough to give them a chance, but not a big one. When the fighting started, they were poorly equipped and poorly prepared.
translation: 和其他人一样，他们得到了基本的武器和基本的训练。足够给他们一个机会，但机会不大。战斗开始时，他们装备简陋，准备不足。

english: They fought in many battles. Battles in strange places against strange people. As the war dragged on, they saw more and more horrors, from both sides. The only thing that kept them going was each other.
translation: 他们参加了许多战斗。在陌生的地方与陌生的人战斗。随着战争的拖延，他们看到了越来越多的恐怖，来自双方。唯一支撑他们的是彼此。

english: As the war drew to a close, they were called to one final battle. The enemy knew they were losing, and they fought more ferociously than ever before.
translation: 战争接近尾声时，他们被召去参加最后一场战斗。敌人知道他们正在失败，于是比以往更加凶猛地战斗。

english: That was where it happened. One of the brothers was cut off and surrounded. He tried to fight back, but he didn't stand a chance.
translation: 就在那里发生了。其中一个兄弟被切断后路并包围了。他试图反击，但他毫无胜算。

english: Eventually the fighting stopped, and the war was over. The other brother could finally go home. But the truth is, he had nothing to go home to.
translation: 最终战斗停止了，战争结束了。另一个兄弟终于可以回家了。但事实上，他已经没有家可回了。

english: It wasn't the farm that mattered, not really. The thing that mattered to him was gone.
translation: 重要的不是农场，真的不是。对他来说重要的东西已经消失了。

english: In a way, he'd died back on the battlefield alongside his brother. Left in his place was just a broken man, with nothing left to live for.
translation: 从某种意义上说，他早在战场上就和兄弟一起死了。留在原地的只是一个破碎的人，再也没有活下去的意义。

english: Hmm. And you think Baxtorian is like this broken man?
translation: 嗯。你觉得巴克斯托里安就像这个破碎的人？

english: He lost his wife, his people and his kingdom. Now he's in a strange place, surrounded by strange people, helping to fight a war that he lost a long time ago.
translation: 他失去了妻子、人民和王国。现在他身处陌生的地方，被陌生的人包围，帮助打一场他早已输掉的战争。

english: Now's not the time for stories, Elena.
translation: 现在不是讲故事的时候，埃琳娜。

english: I guess you're right. The short of it is, Baxtorian has lost everything that he cared about. He's just an empty shell now, with nothing left to live for.
translation: 我想你说得对。简而言之，巴克斯托里安失去了一切他在乎的东西。他现在只是一个空壳，再也没有活下去的意义。

english: Maybe he's not totally lost. He still has Islwyn, and we can still turn this war around.
translation: 也许他并非完全迷失。他还有伊斯尔温，我们仍然可以扭转这场战争。

english: Maybe. I guess only time will tell.
translation: 也许吧。我想只有时间能证明。

english: Right. Shall we get started with this potion?
translation: 好了。我们开始制作这种药水吧？

english: What do we need?
translation: 我们需要什么？

english: Baxtorian gave me the details. To start with, we need an elder cadantine herb. We should be able to grow one from a normal cadantine seed, we just need to prepare the patch a little differently.
translation: 巴克斯托里安告诉了我细节。首先，我们需要一株高阶卡丹丁草。我们可以用普通的卡丹丁草种子种出一株来，只需稍微不同地准备种植地即可。

english: The elves have said we can use this farming patch here. While I prepare the patch, could you go and fetch a cadantine seed and a seed dibber?
translation: 精灵们说我们可以使用这里的种植地。我准备种植地的时候，你能去拿一颗卡丹丁草种子和一个种植锥吗？

english: I already have the seed here.
translation: 我这里已经有种子了。

english: Well it also happens that I've actually already prepared the patch, so you can get started right away.
translation: 嗯，碰巧的是，我已经准备好了种植地，所以你可以马上开始。

english: How convenient.
translation: 真巧。

english: Indeed. When you're ready, go ahead and plant the seed.
translation: 确实。准备好了就去种下种子吧。

english: Will do, I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的，我很快回来。

english: Hey [player name]. Do you have that seed yet?
translation: 嘿[player name]。你拿到种子了吗？

english: It's a cadantine seed that we need. Let me know once you have one. You'll want to get a seed dibber as well so we can plant it.
translation: 我们需要的是卡丹丁草种子。拿到后告诉我。你还需要一个种植锥来种下它。

english: Great. The patch is all prepared so just plant it when you're ready.
translation: 太好了。种植地已经准备好了，准备好了就种下吧。

english: That's the seed planted.
translation: 种子种下了。

english: Great. I'll keep an eye on the patch while it grows. You should check in with Arianwyn and Baxtorian in the meantime.
translation: 太好了。我会留意种植地的生长情况。你在此期间去找阿里安温和巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: Okay, see you later.
translation: 好的，回头见。

english: Hello [player name], how's the potion going?
translation: 你好[player name]，药水怎么样了？

english: We've planted the herb we need, now we have to wait for it to grow. Is there something I can do in the meantime?
translation: 我们已经种下了需要的草药，现在要等它长大。这段时间我能做些什么吗？

english: I suspect there is. Myself and Baxtorian have been looking over how we can get past the defences around the crystal seed.
translation: 我想有的。我和巴克斯托里安一直在研究如何突破水晶种子周围的防御。

english: What defences are there?
translation: 有什么防御？

english: The crystal seed containing Prifddinas, it lies in the middle of the clearing where the city once stood. The only thing left of the city itself are the walls.
translation: 包含普里夫迪纳斯城的水晶种子，位于城市曾经所在的空地中央。城市本身只剩下城墙。

english: These are no ordinary walls though. Long ago, they were reinforced by various enchantments to protect Prifddinas during the God Wars.
translation: 但这些不是普通的城墙。很久以前，它们被各种附魔强化，以在神战期间保护普里夫迪纳斯城。

english: With Prifddinas gone, Lord Iorwerth has claimed the land where it once was. He's managed to manipulate the defences to only allow his allies to enter.
translation: 随着普里夫迪纳斯城的消失，伊尔沃斯领主占领了它曾经所在的土地。他设法操纵了防御，只允许他的盟友进入。

english: So how do we get past them?
translation: 那我们怎么突破它们？

english: While the Iorwerth clan may hold some magical knowledge... they are not mystics. I have no doubt that their work was crude at best, work that a true master of the magical arts could overcome.
translation: 虽然伊尔沃斯家族可能掌握一些魔法知识……但他们不是神秘主义者。我毫不怀疑他们的工作充其量是粗糙的，一个真正的魔法艺术大师可以克服。

english: I see. And where do we find a true master of the magical arts?
translation: 我明白了。那我们去哪里找一位真正的魔法艺术大师？

english: There were eight separate elven clans that journeyed with Seren to this world. Those eight clans still exist today, with each elf born into one of them.
translation: 有八个独立的精灵家族随塞伦来到这个世界。这八个家族至今仍然存在，每个精灵都出生在其中之一。

english: You'll have already heard of some of the clans. The Iorwerth clan is known to you, the traitorous clan of assassins and slayers.
translation: 你应该已经听说过一些家族。你知道伊尔沃斯家族，那个由刺客和屠戮者组成的叛徒家族。

english: And the Cadarn clan of course, the warrior clan of which myself and Arianwyn are part of.
translation: 当然还有卡达恩家族，我和阿里安温所属的战士家族。

english: The other clans you might be less familiar with. However, one of those clans is key here, the Amlodd clan, the clan of mystics.
translation: 其他家族你可能不太熟悉。不过，其中一个家族是关键，那就是阿姆洛德家族，神秘主义者家族。

english: It was the Amlodd clan who created the Prifddinas defences. Their clan should have the knowledge needed to overcome them. And of all the Amlodd clan, none know more than Lord Ieuan Amlodd himself.
translation: 正是阿姆洛德家族创造了普里夫迪纳斯城的防御。他们的家族应该拥有克服这些防御所需的知识。而在整个阿姆洛德家族中，没有人比阿姆洛德领主伊恩本人知道得更多。

english: And where do we find him?
translation: 那我们去哪里找他？

english: After Prifddinas was reverted to seed, the clan elders went into hiding. Before we parted ways, the others did leave me with some clues on how to find them.
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯城变回种子后，家族长老们都躲了起来。在我们分开之前，其他人给我留下了一些线索，告诉我如何找到他们。

english: Lord Amlodd may be our priority, but the other elders could be of great help in our fight against Lord Iorwerth. We should try and find them all.
translation: 阿姆洛德领主是我们的首要目标，但其他长老在我们对抗伊尔沃斯领主的战斗中可能大有帮助。我们应该试着找到他们所有人。

english: I've managed to decipher the clue left behind by Lord Amlodd. We should be able to use it to find him. I've also started work on the other clues.
translation: 我已经破译了阿姆洛德领主留下的线索。我们应该能用它找到他。我也开始研究其他线索了。

english: Apart from Lord Amlodd, I've only been able to decipher Lady Trahaearn's clue so far. I'll keep working on the others though.
translation: 除了阿姆洛德领主，目前我只破译了特拉赫恩女士的线索。不过我会继续研究其他的。

english: [player name], myself and Baxtorian will continue to work on deciphering these clues. While we do, it would be of great help if you could find Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn for us.
translation: [player name]，我和巴克斯托里安会继续破译这些线索。在此期间，如果你能帮我们找到阿姆洛德领主和特拉赫恩女士，那将大有帮助。

english: How do I find Lord Amlodd?
translation: 我怎么找到阿姆洛德领主？

english: Here is the clue he left behind: 'The elven crystal will lead you to me.'
translation: 这是他留下的线索：“精灵水晶会指引你找到我。”

english: I see, anything else I should know?
translation: 我明白了，还有什么我需要知道的吗？

english: The Amlodd clan is a clan of mystics. Some sort of magic may be key to finding Lord Amlodd. You might also find this of use, Lord Amlodd gave it to me before we went our seperate ways.
translation: 阿姆洛德家族是一个神秘主义者家族。某种魔法可能是找到阿姆洛德领主的关键。你可能也会觉得这个有用，阿姆洛德领主在我们分开之前把它给了我。

english: How do I find Lady Trahaearn?
translation: 我怎么找到特拉赫恩女士？

english: Here is the clue she left behind: 'I will journey south from the well.'
translation: 这是她留下的线索：‘我将从水井向南出发。’

english: The Trahaearn clan is a clan of smiths and miners. It's possible that you'll need to use your smithing and mining skills to find Lady Trahaearn.
translation: 特拉赫恩家族是锻造与采矿的家族。你可能需要运用你的锻造和采矿技能来找到特拉赫恩夫人。

english: Okay, I'll get started.
translation: 好的，我这就开始。

english: We need you to find Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn for us. Speak to Baxtorian, he can tell you about the clues they left behind.
translation: 我们需要你帮我们找到阿姆洛德领主和特拉赫恩夫人。去和巴克斯托里安谈谈，他会告诉你他们留下的线索。

english: Hello again, how is it going?
translation: 又见面了，进展如何？

english: It's good to have you helping us. We're all very grateful.
translation: 有你帮忙真是太好了，我们都很感激。

english: I have a seed from Baxtorian that I think needs enchanting.
translation: 我有一颗巴克斯托里安给的种子，我觉得需要附魔。

english: Okay, let me see what I can do with it.
translation: 好的，让我看看我能拿它做什么。

english: There you go. Be careful with it, I'm not sure what it will do when used.
translation: 给你。小心使用，我不确定它使用后会有什么效果。

english: Thanks for the warning, see you later.
translation: 谢谢提醒，回头见。

english: It's the least I can do. I'll see you later.
translation: 这是我应该做的。回头见。

english: Look at this place... It's beautiful, is it not?
translation: 看看这地方……很美，不是吗？

english: Are you Lord Amlodd?
translation: 你是阿姆洛德领主吗？

english: Amlodd? A curious name... Why do you ask?
translation: 阿姆洛德？一个奇怪的名字……你为何问起？

english: Baxtorian sent me. He gave me a crystal that belonged to Lord Amlodd. It brought me here, to you.
translation: 是巴克斯托里安派我来的。他给了我一颗属于阿姆洛德领主的水晶，它带我来到了这里，找到了你。

english: To me? I see...
translation: 找我？我明白了……

english: I have a question for you. This valley before us, how would you describe it?
translation: 我有个问题想问你。我们眼前的这片山谷，你会如何描述它？

english: Yes... It's nice to look upon such beauty, it reminds me of my home. The crystal spires of Prifddinas.
translation: 是啊……欣赏这样的美景真是惬意，让我想起了我的家乡——普里夫迪纳斯城的水晶尖塔。

english: Dangerous.
translation: 危险。

english: Yes... This world... it's so peaceful, so beautiful. But there is still danger here. It takes me back to the forests near my home, before Lord Iorwerth brought a different danger upon us.
translation: 是啊……这个世界……如此宁静，如此美丽。但这里依然有危险。这让我想起了家乡附近的森林，在伊尔沃斯领主给我们带来另一种危险之前。

english: Peaceful.
translation: 宁静。

english: Yes... It is a welcome break from the wars of my home, the wars of Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 是啊……这是对我家乡战火——伊尔沃斯领主发动的战争——一种受欢迎的喘息。

english: Boring.
translation: 无聊。

english: I suppose it can seem that way. Little to see and little to do. But there is beauty in that simplicity, much like the forest of Isafdar.
translation: 我想确实可能如此。没什么可看，也没什么可做。但那种简单中也有美，就像伊萨法德森林一样。

english: The answers are not always easy to find. I have had time to reflect here, to consider this world. Maybe you need more time to find your own answer. Alas, it is time we do not have, for Lord Iorwerth awaits.
translation: 答案并不总是容易找到的。我在这里有时间反思，思考这个世界。也许你需要更多时间来找到自己的答案。可惜，我们没有时间了，因为伊尔沃斯领主在等着。

english: So you are Lord Amlodd?
translation: 那么你就是阿姆洛德领主？

english: Indeed, and if Baxtorian sent you, then it is time for me to leave this place. Tell me human, where must I travel to?
translation: 正是，既然巴克斯托里安派你来，那我也该离开此地了。告诉我，人类，我该去哪里？

english: The village of Lletya, in the forest of Isafdar.
translation: 伊萨法德森林里的莱蒂亚村。

english: Then we shall leave at once. Allow me to teleport you back with me.
translation: 那我们就立刻出发。让我把你也传送回去。

english: The rebels have created a wonderful village here. A safe refuge from the tyranny of Lord Iorwerth. Curious how something so beautiful could be born of something so terrible.
translation: 反抗军在这里建起了一个美妙的村庄，一个远离伊尔沃斯领主暴政的安全避难所。真好奇如此美丽的事物怎能从如此可怕的环境中诞生。

english: They've done well to keep up the fight for this long.
translation: 他们坚持战斗这么久，做得很好。

english: They have, but I'd expect no less of them. The song of the elves has been sung for thousands of years, it will continue for thousands more.
translation: 确实如此，但我对他们期望不止于此。精灵之歌已经传唱了数千年，还将再传唱数千年。

english: However, I fear that this verse is the darkest yet.
translation: 然而，恐怕这一节是至今最黑暗的一节。

english: Who has awoken me? A human? You are not who I expected.
translation: 谁唤醒了我？一个人类？你不是我期待的人。

english: Baxtorian sent me. We need your help in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 巴克斯托里安派我来的。我们需要你帮忙对抗伊尔沃斯领主。

english: Baxtorian lives? And he is working with a human? This is most irregular. I see you repaired my exoskeleton as well. Impressive work for a human, but again, most irregular.
translation: 巴克斯托里安还活着？而且他在和一个人类合作？这太不寻常了。我看见你还修好了我的外骨骼。对一个人类来说真是令人印象深刻，但再次强调，太不寻常了。

english: Tell me human, where is Baxtorian?
translation: 告诉我，人类，巴克斯托里安在哪？

english: He's in the elven village of Lletya, south of here.
translation: 他在南边的精灵村庄莱蒂亚村。

english: Then I will journey there at once. There is clearly a lot I need to catch up on.
translation: 那我立刻启程去那里。显然有很多事我需要跟上。

english: These rebels had better get a move on and defeat Lord Iorwerth. Old ladies like me have a tendency to drop dead, and I'll be very annoyed if that happens before I see Prifddinas again.
translation: 这些反抗军最好赶紧行动，打败伊尔沃斯领主。像我这样的老妇人随时可能一命呜呼，如果在我再次见到普里夫迪纳斯城之前就死了，我会非常恼火。

english: How can you be annoyed if you're dead?
translation: 如果你死了，怎么能恼火呢？

english: Oh I'll cook up quite the storm in the afterlife, believe me.
translation: 哦，我会在来世掀起一场风暴，相信我。

english: Good job finding Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn. Now, you should probably go see how that seed you planted is doing.
translation: 找到阿姆洛德领主和特拉赫恩夫人干得不错。现在，你大概该去看看你种下的那颗种子长得怎么样了。

english: Good idea, I'll go see Elena.
translation: 好主意，我去找埃琳娜。

english: Oh... Hello there. Thank you for finding Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn.
translation: 哦……你好。谢谢你找到了阿姆洛德领主和特拉赫恩夫人。

english: Have you checked in with Elena recently? That seed has probably grown by now.
translation: 你最近有没有去问问埃琳娜？那颗种子现在大概已经长大了。

english: I'll go talk to her.
translation: 我去跟她谈谈。

english: Hey [player name]. The elder cadantine herb grew perfectly. Let's get it harvested.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。高阶卡丹丁草长得很好。我们去把它收割了吧。

english: So what else do we need for the potion?
translation: 那么药水还需要别的什么吗？

english: The other ingredient is crystal dust. Hopefully you can get some from Arianwyn or Baxtorian. Once you've got some dust, just add it to a vial of water along with the herb.
translation: 另一种材料是水晶粉尘。希望你能从阿里安温或巴克斯托里安那里得到一些。一旦你有了粉尘，只需把它和草药一起加入一瓶水中即可。

english: Right, I'll go see if I can get some crystal dust.
translation: 好的，我去看看能不能弄到一些水晶粉尘。

english: Don't forget this.
translation: 别忘了这个。

english: Hey Elena, what do I need to do again?
translation: 嘿，埃琳娜，我需要做什么来着？

english: Add the elder cadantine to a vial of water and then add some crystal dust. Hopefully either Arianwyn or Baxtorian can give you some crystal dust.
translation: 将高阶卡丹丁草加入一瓶水中，然后加入一些水晶粉尘。希望阿里安温或巴克斯托里安能给你一些水晶粉尘。

english: Oh... Hello. Do you need something?
translation: 哦……你好。需要什么吗？

english: I need some crystal dust for this potion I'm making.
translation: 我需要一些水晶粉尘来做我正在制作的药水。

english: Ah yes... I don't have anything you can use I'm afraid. Maybe Arianwyn can help you.
translation: 啊，是的……恐怕我没有你能用的东西。也许阿里安温能帮你。

english: Hello [player name]. How's it going?
translation: 你好，[player name]。进展如何？

english: I'm working on getting that potion made. I need some crystal dust for it though.
translation: 我正在努力制作那种药水，不过需要一些水晶粉尘。

english: Crystal dust? Interesting. Well I have an old crystal here that you can use. It will need grinding up though.
translation: 水晶粉尘？有趣。嗯，我这里有一颗旧水晶你可以用。不过需要研磨一下。

english: Why don't you try using that crystal I gave you?
translation: 你为什么不试试用我给你的那颗水晶呢？

english: Hey Elena, I've finished the potion.
translation: 嘿，埃琳娜，药水做好了。

english: Great, you should take it to Arianwyn and Baxtorian.
translation: 太好了，你应该把它带给阿里安温和巴克斯托里安。

english: I've finished the potion.
translation: 药水做好了。

english: Oh... You should give it to Arianwyn then.
translation: 哦……那你应该把它交给阿里安温。

english: I should probably take this to Arianwyn and Baxtorian rather than drinking it.
translation: 我大概应该把这个带给阿里安温和巴克斯托里安，而不是自己喝掉。

english: Great, I'll look after it for you. Now, let's call the others and discuss our plan for the Grand Library.
translation: 太好了，我会替你保管它。现在，让我们召集其他人，讨论一下大图书馆的计划。

english: Right, thanks to [player name], we should now have everything we need to enter the crystal seed containing Prifddinas.
translation: 好了，多亏了[player name]，我们现在应该有了进入存放普里夫迪纳斯城的水晶种子所需的一切。

english: So we have a way to bypass the defences?
translation: 所以我们有办法绕过防御了吗？

english: Indeed we do. Baxtorian's knowledge allowed [player name] to reunite us with Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn. It was the Amlodd clan that created those defences, Lord Amlodd can overcome them for us.
translation: 确实如此。巴克斯托里安的知识让[player name]使我们与阿姆洛德领主和特拉赫恩夫人重聚。建造那些防御的是阿姆洛德家族，阿姆洛德领主可以为我们克服它们。

english: My magic can be used to teleport someone through the defences and into the crystal. It will require great focus though, I will only be able to send one of you in.
translation: 我的魔法可以用来将某人传送过防御并进入水晶。但这需要极大的专注力，我只能送你们中的一个人进去。

english: The inversion potion will ensure that whoever is sent survives the journey, now we just need to decide who that is.
translation: 逆转药水将确保被送进去的人能在旅途中存活，现在我们需要决定是谁。

english: I propose we send [player name] in. They have proven to us time and time again that they have the skill needed for a challenge like this.
translation: 我提议派[player name]进去。他们一次又一次地向我们证明了他们拥有应对这种挑战所需的技能。

english: You cannot be serious? Even if [player name] has proven their worth as you claim, which I have my doubts about, they'll never be deemed worthy enough to unlock Seren's hidden knowledge.
translation: 你不是认真的吧？即使[player name]像你说的那样证明了自己的价值——对此我有所怀疑——他们也永远不会被认为有资格解锁塞伦隐藏的知识。

english: Why? Because they're not an elf?
translation: 为什么？因为他们不是精灵？

english: Exactly! If Seren created a way for the seals to be destroyed, she would have made it so that only an elf could break them.
translation: 正是！如果塞伦创造了破坏封印的方法，她一定会让只有精灵才能打破它们。

english: Were you there when Seren made those seals, boy?
translation: 塞伦制造那些封印的时候，你在场吗，小子？

english: I... Well of course not.
translation: 我……呃，当然不在。

english: Then how do you know what our goddess intended?
translation: 那你又怎么知道我们女神的意图？

english: I just think...
translation: 我只是觉得……

english: I don't know this human here, but I damn well don't know you either. The human was capable enough to find me and fix my exoskeleton. Maybe they are capable of this as well.
translation: 我不认识这个人类，但我也他妈的同样不认识你。这个人类有足够的能力找到我并修好我的外骨骼。也许他们也能做到这件事。

english: Then I propose that [player name] be the one sent into the crystal. Anyone disagree?
translation: 那我提议由[player name]被送入水晶。有人反对吗？

english: Yes we already know you do Ysgawyn. Anyone else?
translation: 是的，我们已经知道你的态度了，伊斯卡温。还有别人吗？

english: Right, [player name], talk to Lord Amlodd when you are ready. Good luck.
translation: 好了，[player name]，准备好了就去和阿姆洛德领主谈谈。祝你好运。

english: I... Hello. You should probably talk to Lord Amlodd.
translation: 我……你好。你大概应该去和阿姆洛德领主谈谈。

english: Good luck in the library, [player name]. We're all counting on you. Speak to Lord Amlodd when you're ready.
translation: 祝你在图书馆好运，[player name]。我们都指望你了。准备好了就去和阿姆洛德领主谈谈。

english: Hey [player name] Good luck in the library. We'll talk more when you get back.
translation: 嘿，[player name]，祝你在图书馆好运。等你回来我们再细聊。

english: The Grand Library of Prifddinas, such a beautiful place. You will be the first to step foot there for hundreds of years.
translation: 普里夫迪纳斯城的大图书馆，多么美丽的地方。你将是数百年来第一个踏足那里的人。

english: What do I need to do once I arrive?
translation: 我到了之后需要做什么？

english: They say Lord Iorwerth broke one of the nine seals of Seren within the library. Find this seal, and see what knowledge he uncovered.
translation: 据说伊尔沃斯领主在图书馆内打破了塞伦的九道封印之一。找到这道封印，看看他发现了什么知识。

english: Once that is done, seek out the other eight seals, see if you can break them as well. Their knowledge may be key to our fight against the darkness.
translation: 完成后，再去找其他八道封印，看看你是否也能打破它们。它们蕴含的知识可能是我们对抗黑暗的关键。

english: Do you have any idea how to break the seals?
translation: 你知道怎么打破这些封印吗？

english: According to Baxtorian, Seren herself said that those who follow the light will be able to access her knowledge.
translation: 据巴克斯托里安说，塞伦本人曾说过，追随光明的人将能获得她的知识。

english: That doesn't give me a lot to go on.
translation: 这没给我提供多少线索。

english: No, but it is all you have. Now, when you are ready, I can teleport you into the crystal seed. I have the potion that you made earlier, it will ensure you survive the journey.
translation: 没有，但这就是你拥有的全部。现在，准备好了，我可以把你传送进水晶种子。我有你之前制作的药水，它能确保你在旅途中存活。

english: One last thing, the laws that this land abide by, they may not apply in the library.
translation: 最后一件事，这片土地遵循的法则，在图书馆中可能并不适用。

english: The library has been reverted to crystal. That which is impossible out here, may well be normal in an environment like that. You should be cautious.
translation: 图书馆已经变回水晶状态。在外面不可能的事情，在那种环境中可能完全正常。你应该小心谨慎。

english: Now, are you ready?
translation: 现在，你准备好了吗？

english: Let me go and prepare first.
translation: 让我先去准备一下。

english: Do you wish to return to the Grand Library?
translation: 你想回到大图书馆吗？

english: And so comes another, to seek the knowledge of Seren. Greetings mortal.
translation: 又来了一个，来寻求塞伦的知识。你好，凡人。

english: You... You're Seren?
translation: 你……你是塞伦？

english: No... I'm just a memory. A mere fragment of something far greater. A guardian of the knowledge that she left behind.
translation: 不……我只是一段记忆。一个更伟大存在的碎片。我是她留下的知识的守护者。

english: I seek that knowledge, to help in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 我寻求那些知识，以帮助对抗伊尔沃斯领主。

english: It is not my place to question why. I only exist to pass on that which she sealed away.
translation: 我没有质疑的理由。我只存在来传递她封印的东西。

english: So you'll give me the knowledge?
translation: 所以你会给我知识？

english: The seals guard the truth. This seal has been broken, its knowledge is now open to all. Here is what you seek:
translation: 封印守护着真相。这个封印已被打破，它的知识现在向所有人开放。这就是你要找的东西：

english: '...Therein lies my guilt. A part of me, trapped and alone. Dark, yes, but still a part of my being, sealed away in the Temple of Light.'
translation: '……这就是我的罪过。我的一部分，被困住且孤独。黑暗，是的，但仍是我存在的一部分，被封印在光明神庙中。'

english: 'The protections on the temple, they should keep her contained. But in case they don't, I created one last safeguard, a prison within a prison. With it I made a key, an orb of light, to unlock the darkness.'
translation: '神庙的防护措施应该能困住她。但以防万一，我创造了最后一道保障，一个监狱中的监狱。我用它制作了一把钥匙，一个光宝珠，来解锁黑暗。'

english: 'I could have destroyed it, sealed her away forever. But I still question my decision, and so I hid the orb away, while I think upon my choices.'
translation: '我本可以摧毁它，永远封印她。但我仍然质疑我的决定，所以我把宝珠藏了起来，同时思考我的选择。'

english: 'The shrine at Gorlah, that is where it lies. With it, she can be freed... or destroyed...'
translation: '戈拉的神龛，它就在那里。有了它，她可以被释放……或被摧毁……'

english: And so ends the knowledge of this seal.
translation: 这个封印的知识到此结束。

english: So Lord Iorwerth spoke the truth. A part of Seren lives within the Temple of Light. But why?
translation: 所以伊尔沃斯领主说的是真的。塞伦的一部分活在光明神庙里。但为什么？

english: I have imparted the knowledge of this seal. There is nothing more here to give. If you seek the rest, then the other seals must be broken.
translation: 我已经传授了这个封印的知识。这里没有更多可给的了。如果你寻求剩下的，必须打破其他封印。

english: Start with the Seal of Ithell, to the south east. The light will guide the way...
translation: 从伊塞尔封印开始，在东南方向。光会指引道路……

english: The seeker of knowledge returns. Do you wish to hear the knowledge again?
translation: 知识的寻求者回来了。你想再听一次知识吗？

english: Here is what you seek:
translation: 这就是你寻求的：

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Ithell. You'll find it on the middle level, to the south east. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找伊塞尔封印。你会在中层东南方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Ithell. You'll find it on the middle level, to the south east. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找伊塞尔封印。你会在中层东南方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: 'When I first encountered the elves on their homeworld of Tarddiad, it was like I had finally found my purpose. I quickly fell in love with them, and they with me.'
translation: '当我第一次在精灵的母星塔迪亚德遇到他们时，我仿佛终于找到了自己的使命。我很快就爱上了他们，他们也爱上了我。'

english: 'I set out to help them, to guide them. They immediately embraced this, and one of their mystics, Ceidwad, documented my teachings in a great book called the Cerddi.'
translation: '我开始帮助他们，引导他们。他们立刻接受了这一点，他们的一位神秘学家塞德瓦德将我的教义记录在一本名为《瑟迪》的伟大书籍中。'

english: 'It was the start of something beautiful, but there is pain in beauty, as I soon came to realise...'
translation: '那是一个美好事物的开始，但美丽中也有痛苦，我很快就意识到了……'

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Cadarn. You'll find it on the bottom level, to the south. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找卡达恩封印。你会在底层南面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: If you wish, I can return you to the central chamber.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以送你回中央密室。

english: Could you teleport me somewhere?
translation: 你能把我传送到某个地方吗？

english: I can only take you to a seal which has already been broken.
translation: 我只能带你去已经打破的封印。

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Cadarn. You'll find it on the bottom level, to the south. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找卡达恩封印。你会在底层南面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: '...Compared to many of the mortal races I had encountered, the elves had reasonable lifespans. And yet, it wasn't long enough.'
translation: '……与我遇到过的许多凡人种族相比，精灵的寿命算合理的。然而，这还不够长。'

english: 'As I spent time with the elves, I watched as they withered and died. Each death was a blade through my heart, but none more so than Ceidwad, my closest companion.'
translation: '我与精灵们相处的日子里，看着他们日渐衰弱、死去。每一次死亡都像一把刀刺穿我的心，但最让我痛心的是我最亲密的同伴塞德瓦德。'

english: 'It didn't seem fair, didn't seem right. They deserved more. I knew I had to give it to them...'
translation: '这似乎不公平，不合理。他们值得更多。我知道我必须给予他们……'

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Crwys. You'll find it on the middle level, to the north west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找克鲁维斯封印。你会在中层西北方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Crwys. You'll find it on the middle level, to the north west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找克鲁维斯封印。你会在中层西北方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: '...I found a way to share my essence with the elves, a piece of my being for each one of them.'
translation: '……我找到了一种与精灵共享我本质的方法，我的存在的一部分给他们每一个。'

english: 'With this gift, their years would number in the thousands, time enough to live the lives they deserved.'
translation: '有了这份礼物，他们的寿命将达到数千年，足够过上他们应得的生活。'

english: 'In keeping with elven tradition, the gift was given through a song. They called it the song of creation, for it was the creation of a new life for them. At least, so we thought...'
translation: '按照精灵的传统，这份礼物是通过一首歌给予的。他们称之为创世之歌，因为这对他们来说是新生命的创造。至少，我们是这么想的……'

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Amlodd. You'll find it on the bottom level, to the west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找阿姆洛德封印。你会在底层西面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Amlodd. You'll find it on the bottom level, to the west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找阿姆洛德封印。你会在底层西面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: '...With all my knowledge, I should have known not to meddle. That which I intended as a gift, soon turned out to be their curse.'
translation: '……以我所有的知识，我本不该插手。我本想给予的礼物，最终却成了他们的诅咒。'

english: 'The song of creation increased their lifespans, but at a terrible price. It bound them to me. To stray too far from their sides, caused pain, and even death.'
translation: '创世之歌延长了他们的寿命，但代价惨重。它把他们与我绑定在一起。离开我身边太远会导致痛苦甚至死亡。'

english: 'I knew I had to help them, to fix my mistakes. I should have known that I'd only make it worse...'
translation: '我知道我必须帮助他们，弥补我的错误。我本该知道只会让事情更糟……'

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Meilyr. You'll find it on the top level, to the west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找梅利尔封印。你会在顶层西面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Meilyr. You'll find it on the top level, to the west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找梅利尔封印。你会在顶层西面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: '...Another being came to our world. Divine like myself, but not by design. He spoke of a perfect world, one filled with power.'
translation: '……另一个存在来到了我们的世界。像我一样神圣，但并非有意为之。他谈到了一个完美的世界，一个充满力量的世界。'

english: 'I knew it was a risk, but I decided to travel there. The power he spoke of might have been the only thing capable of saving the elves.'
translation: '我知道这是冒险，但我决定前往那里。他所说的力量可能是唯一能拯救精灵的东西。'

english: 'The curse made it impossible for me to go without them, so they had to come with me, and leave their home behind. It was hard on them, but in the end, I managed to convince them...'
translation: '这个诅咒让我无法离开他们，所以他们不得不随我一起离开家园。这对他们来说很艰难，但最终我还是说服了他们……'

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Hefin. You'll find it on the top level, to the south west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找赫芬封印。你会在顶层西南方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Hefin. You'll find it on the top level, to the south west. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找赫芬封印。你会在顶层西南方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: '...We made our home in the new world, in a great city of crystal spires. It was as beautiful as the world from which we came. But beneath that beauty, the curse remained.'
translation: '……我们在新世界安了家，住在一座由水晶尖塔构成的宏伟城市里。它和我们来的那个世界一样美丽。但在那美丽之下，诅咒依然存在。'

english: 'The power that filled the world was even greater than I had anticipated. A higher power, one I had not encountered for a long time.'
translation: '充满这个世界的力量比我预料的还要强大。一种更高的力量，我很久没有遇到过了。'

english: 'I was sure this world held the key to breaking the curse, I just needed to find it...'
translation: '我确信这个世界拥有打破诅咒的关键，我只需要找到它……'

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Trahaearn. You'll find it on the top level, to the east. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找特拉哈恩封印。你会在顶层东面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Trahaearn. You'll find it on the top level, to the east. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找特拉哈恩封印。你会在顶层东面找到它。光会指引道路……

english: '...It took millennia, but I finally made a breakthrough. Deep beneath the mountains near our home, I found a source of deathly energy.'
translation: '……花费了数千年，但我终于取得了突破。在我们家附近的山脉深处，我找到了死亡能量的源头。'

english: 'I was sure I could use this power to save them. My essence is of life, of light. This darkness would be the perfect counter, a way to nullify the curse.'
translation: '我确信我能用这股力量拯救他们。我的本质是生命，是光明。这种黑暗将是完美的对立面，一种抵消诅咒的方法。'

english: 'I should have known not to be so foolish. This curse started with my meddling, my meddling was never going to end it...'
translation: '我本不该如此愚蠢。这个诅咒始于我的干预，而我的干预永远无法终结它……'

english: If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Iorwerth. You'll find it on the middle level, to the north east. The light will guide the way...
translation: 如果你寻求更多知识，去找伊尔沃斯封印。你会在中层东北方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you seek more of the knowledge, look to the Seal of Iorwerth. You'll find it on the middle level, to the north east. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你寻求更多知识，去找伊尔沃斯封印。你会在中层东北方向找到它。光会指引道路……

english: '...I am a being of light, but even within me, there was some darkness. I poured this darkness into my creation, combining it with the deathly energy I had found.'
translation: '……我是光明的存在，但即使在我体内，也有些黑暗。我把这黑暗注入我的造物，与我所找到的死亡能量结合。'

english: 'When I was done, I looked upon my creation. A fragment of myself, but one of darkness, rather than light. I thought her essence would counter my own, ending the curse with her mere existence.'
translation: '做完之后，我看着我的造物——一个我自身的碎片，但却是黑暗而非光明的碎片。我以为她的本质能抵消我的本质，仅凭她的存在就能终结诅咒。'

english: 'It was not to be though. The curse was tied to me, not to her. I had failed, and she knew it. She turned on me, tried to destroy me. I had to stop her, so I sealed her away, in the very place I had created her...'
translation: '然而事与愿违。诅咒与我相连，而非与她相连。我失败了，她也知道这一点。她转而攻击我，试图毁灭我。我不得不阻止她，于是我把她封印在我创造她的地方……'

english: So Seren split off a fragment of herself, hoping it would help fix her mistakes. That's what lives within the Temple of Light, that's what Lord Iorwerth is trying to summon.
translation: 所以塞伦分裂出自己的一部分，希望它能帮助纠正她的错误。那就是活在光明神庙里的东西，那就是伊尔沃斯领主试图召唤的东西。

english: I should return to Lletya and let the others know what I've discovered.
translation: 我应该回到莱蒂亚村，让其他人知道我发现了什么。

english: Can you take me somewhere else?
translation: 你能带我去别的地方吗？

english: Then I have nothing more to give. If you wish to hear a different piece of knowledge, look to the other seals. The light will guide the way...
translation: 那我没有什么可给的了。如果你想听一段不同的知识，去找其他封印。光会指引道路……

english: Your work in the library, is it done?
translation: 你在图书馆的工作完成了吗？

english: Then you should speak with Arianwyn at once.
translation: 那你应该立刻和阿里安温谈谈。

english: I... Hello.
translation: 我……你好。

english: I'm done with the library.
translation: 图书馆的事做完了。

english: I see... You should tell Arianwyn.
translation: 我明白了……你应该告诉阿里安温。

english: Hey [player name]. You'd better speak with Arianwyn if you're done in the library.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。如果你图书馆的事做完了，最好和阿里安温谈谈。

english: [player name], you have returned. Did you discover anything in the Grand Library?
translation: [player name]，你回来了。你在宏伟图书馆发现了什么吗？

english: I did. I think we should call the others.
translation: 是的。我觉得我们应该叫其他人来。

english: I see. I will summon them at once.
translation: 我明白了。我马上召唤他们。

english: Okay, thank you all for joining us. In case you weren't aware, [player name] here has returned from the Grand Library with some news for us.
translation: 好的，感谢各位加入。可能你们不知道，这位[player name]从宏伟图书馆回来了，给我们带来了消息。

english: I entered the library and found the seal broken by Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 我进入图书馆，发现封印被伊尔沃斯领主打破了。

english: So he did break one of the seals. Did it hide anything notable?
translation: 所以他确实打破了一个封印。里面藏着什么值得注意的东西吗？

english: Yes, it contained a memory, left behind by Seren herself.
translation: 是的，它包含一段记忆，是塞伦自己留下的。

english: A memory of Seren? Amazing!
translation: 塞伦的记忆？太棒了！

english: It was only part of something larger though. I had to break the other eight seals to uncover the rest of it.
translation: 不过这只是更大的一部分。我必须打破另外八个封印才能揭示其余部分。

english: So you managed to break all of Seren's seals? Very impressive [player name]. Now tell us, this memory, what was it?
translation: 所以你成功打破了塞伦的所有封印？非常了不起，[player name]。现在告诉我们，这段记忆是什么？

english: That's where it gets interesting... The memory spoke of a curse on the elves, a curse that Seren was desperately trying to break.
translation: 有趣的地方就在这里……那段记忆提到了精灵身上的诅咒，塞伦正拼命试图打破它。

english: A curse? What curse?
translation: 诅咒？什么诅咒？

english: A curse binding the elves to Seren. As long as she remained close, it was unnoticeable, but if she went too far... pain, and death.
translation: 一种将精灵束缚于塞伦的诅咒。只要她保持靠近，就察觉不到，但如果她离得太远……就会痛苦和死亡。

english: But who was responsible? Who cursed our people?
translation: 但谁是罪魁祸首？谁诅咒了我们的人民？

english: That's the thing... It was Seren herself.
translation: 关键就在这……是塞伦自己。

english: Seren was our goddess, she would never curse us. How dare you suggest otherwise!
translation: 塞伦是我们的女神，她绝不会诅咒我们。你怎么敢这么说！

english: I'm telling the truth!
translation: 我说的是实话！

english: Truth? You don't know the meaning of the word!
translation: 实话？你根本不懂这个词的意思！

english: Let them finish Ysgawyn!
translation: 让他们说完，伊斯卡温！

english: She didn't mean to do it, she was trying to help. She was using her own essence to try and extend your lifespans, it just went wrong...
translation: 她不是故意的，她是在帮忙。她用自己的本质试图延长你们的寿命，只是出了差错……

english: I... I don't believe it. She cursed us? Our goddess cursed us?
translation: 我……我不相信。她诅咒了我们？我们的女神诅咒了我们？

english: If... If what you say is true, how does it relate to Lord Iorwerth's claims?
translation: 如果……如果你说的是真的，那和伊尔沃斯领主的说法有什么关系？

english: Seren went to great lengths to undo the curse. She believed that she could nullify it by creating a being of darkness, one to counter her light essence.
translation: 塞伦不遗余力地想解除诅咒。她相信通过创造一个黑暗的存在来对抗她的光明本质，就能抵消诅咒。

english: Lord Iorwerth spoke the truth. She created a fragment of herself, filled with darkness, hoping to use it to break the curse. It didn't work though, so she sealed it in the Temple of Light.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主说的是真话。她创造了一个充满黑暗的自身碎片，希望用它来打破诅咒。但没成功，于是她把它封印在光明神殿里。

english: This can't be real... This is a dream... Tell me this isn't real!
translation: 这不可能是真的……这是个梦……告诉我这不是真的！

english: This is a lie! It has to be! The human is showing their true colours once again!
translation: 这是谎言！一定是！这个人类再次露出了真面目！

english: Boy, what did I tell you about insulting the human!
translation: 小子，我告诉过你别侮辱人类！

english: Arianwyn? What do we do?
translation: 阿里安温？我们怎么办？

english: Arianwyn?
translation: 阿里安温？

english: Why are we still stood here? This human needs putting in chains!
translation: 我们还站在这里干什么？这个人类该被锁链锁起来！

english: Arianwyn? Do something!
translation: 阿里安温？快做点什么！

english: Arianwyn!
translation: 阿里安温！

english: I don't know what to do!
translation: 我不知道该怎么做！

english: I don't know what to do...
translation: 我不知道该怎么做……

english: You think I know something you all don't? You think I have some trick hidden up my sleeve? I have nothing!
translation: 你以为我知道你们都不知道的事？你以为我袖子里藏着什么花招？我什么都没有！

english: You're our leader! Lead!
translation: 你是我们的领袖！带领我们！

english: And how would you have me do that, Ysgawyn? How am I meant to respond to this?
translation: 那你希望我怎么做，伊斯卡温？我该如何应对这个局面？

english: You can start by locking this human up. They are a traitor! The curse is clearly a lie!
translation: 你可以先把这个人关起来。他们是叛徒！诅咒术显然是个谎言！

english: If we were truly tied to Seren, we'd have all dropped dead when she was shattered! The curse clearly doesn't exist!
translation: 如果我们真的与塞伦绑定，她破碎时我们早就全死了！诅咒术显然不存在！

english: Well... Don't be so sure of that.
translation: 呃……别那么肯定。

english: Nice of you to suddenly speak up! I'd have thought a king would command a bit of authority rather than crying in the corner!
translation: 你突然开口说话真是太好了！我还以为国王会有点威严，而不是在角落里哭呢！

english: I'm not a king any more...
translation: 我已经不是国王了……

english: Well thank Seren for that! You only managed to lose the entire kingdom to Lord Iorwerth!
translation: 那可真要感谢塞伦了！你竟然把整个王国都输给了伊尔沃斯领主！

english: You should learn some respect!
translation: 你该学学什么叫尊重！

english: I have respect! I respect the heroes who died in this war, not the coward that ran away from it!
translation: 我有尊重！我尊重在这场战争中牺牲的英雄，而不是那个临阵脱逃的懦夫！

english: You... You're right. I failed you, I failed you all. I wish I could go back and change that, but I can't. All I can do now, is try and make things right.
translation: 你……你说得对。我辜负了你，辜负了你们所有人。我希望我能回去改变这一切，但我做不到。我现在唯一能做的，就是尽力弥补。

english: While horrifying, I believe [player name] speaks the truth. They have no reason to lie to us, and what they say does make sense.
translation: 虽然骇人听闻，但我相信[player name]说的是实话。他们没有理由对我们撒谎，而且他们的话确实有道理。

english: Most of you never met Seren. You only know her through the stories passed down to you. But I did know her, and I know she was filled with pain.
translation: 你们大多数人从未见过塞伦。你们只是通过流传下来的故事了解她。但我确实认识她，我知道她内心充满了痛苦。

english: You... You think this is the reason?
translation: 你……你认为这就是原因？

english: I think it could be. As for why we don't feel the effects of the curse now, that is because Seren is still with us, every one of us.
translation: 我想可能是这样。至于为什么我们现在感受不到诅咒术的影响，那是因为塞伦仍然与我们同在，与我们每个人同在。

english: Of course, the crystal seeds. All of us carry them in some form or other, and all of them came from Seren when she shattered herself.
translation: 当然，是水晶种子。我们所有人都以某种形式携带着它们，而它们都来自塞伦破碎自己时。

english: Her last attempt to break the curse, after everything else failed...
translation: 她在其他一切方法都失败后，解除诅咒术的最后一次尝试……

english: There's one other thing. Seren built a second set of defences within the Temple of Light, this fragment of her is sealed within them. There's an orb that can bypass these defences.
translation: 还有一件事。塞伦在光明神殿内建造了第二层防御，她的这块碎片被封印在其中。有一个宝珠可以绕过这些防御。

english: An orb?
translation: 一个宝珠？

english: Yes, apparently she hid it somewhere called Gorlah.
translation: 是的，显然她把它藏在一个叫戈拉的地方。

english: I know of Gorlah. It's an old shrine north of Prifddinas, a place for quiet worship away from the city.
translation: 我知道戈拉。那是普里夫迪纳斯城以北的一座古老神龛，一个远离城市、安静祈祷的地方。

english: Does Lord Iorwerth know about the orb?
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主知道这个宝珠吗？

english: Then he might already have claimed it. We should send someone to check.
translation: 那他可能已经拿走了。我们应该派人去查探。

english: I will go. I wish to see some actual proof of what this human claims.
translation: 我去。我想亲眼看看这个人所说的实际证据。

english: That's not your call. Arianwyn is in charge here.
translation: 那不是你说了算。这里是阿里安温负责。

english: Am I? My whole life, I've been fighting Lord Iorwerth. My whole life, I've believed him to be a servant of Zamorak. Now I learn that everything I fought for was a lie.
translation: 我是吗？我一生都在与伊尔沃斯领主作战。我一生都以为他是萨莫拉克的仆从。现在我才知道我为之战斗的一切都是谎言。

english: I don't even know what I'm leading any more...
translation: 我甚至不知道我还在领导什么了……

english: Maybe Lord Iorwerth fights for a different cause to what we thought, but that doesn't change who he is, that doesn't change what he's done.
translation: 也许伊尔沃斯领主为我们以为的不同的事业而战，但这并不能改变他是谁，也不能改变他做过的事。

english: I need time alone... Time to think... Baxtorian, I would appreciate it if you could take charge for a while.
translation: 我需要独处……需要思考的时间……巴克斯托里安，如果你能暂时负责一下，我会很感激。

english: Oh... I... I'll do my best.
translation: 哦……我……我会尽力的。

english: That's all I ask. Now, I would like to be alone.
translation: 我只要求这个。现在，我想一个人待着。

english: You're not the only one. I think we all need time to process this.
translation: 你不是唯一一个。我想我们都需要时间来消化这些。

english: Then let us close this meeting. We will reconvene later.
translation: 那么，让我们结束这次会议。我们稍后再会合。

english: So what do we do now?
translation: 那我们接下来怎么办？

english: There's a lot to think about, for all of us. There's also a lot we still don't know.
translation: 我们所有人都有很多东西要考虑。还有很多我们不知道的事。

english: Do you think Arianwyn will be okay?
translation: 你觉得阿里安温会没事吗？

english: I hope so... I know the pain he feels, it can tear you apart if you're not careful.
translation: 我希望如此……我知道他感受到的痛苦，如果不小心，它会把你撕裂。

english: You seem to be dealing with it okay.
translation: 你似乎处理得还不错。

english: I'm glad it seems that way, that's not how it feels though. I knew of Seren's troubles, but to know the cause... it's heart-breaking.
translation: 很高兴看起来是这样，但感觉并非如此。我早就知道塞伦的困扰，但得知原因……真是令人心碎。

english: Now I find myself leading once more, something I swore I would never do again.
translation: 现在我发现自己再次领导，这是我发誓再也不会做的事。

english: Arianwyn seems to think you're capable.
translation: 阿里安温似乎认为你能胜任。

english: Yes... But Arianwyn doesn't know me, not really.
translation: 是的……但阿里安温并不了解我，真的不了解。

english: Anyway, I suppose my job now is to make sure we don't lose sight of our goal.
translation: 总之，我想我现在的工作是确保我们不忘目标。

english: Do we know what that is anymore?
translation: 我们还知道那是什么吗？

english: To stop Lord Iorwerth. Even if we now know his true intentions, even if some think those intentions may be good, we can't ignore his actions.
translation: 阻止伊尔沃斯领主。即使我们现在知道了他的真实意图，即使有些人认为那些意图可能是好的，我们也不能忽视他的行为。

english: He'd see us all dead just to free this fragment of Seren. He has to be stopped.
translation: 他为了释放塞伦碎片，不惜看着我们全部死去。必须阻止他。

english: Ysgawyn has gone to see if he can find the orb you spoke of. No one actually gave him permission, but he seems to care little for orders at the moment.
translation: 伊斯卡温已经去看能否找到你提到的宝珠了。实际上没有人允许他去，但他现在似乎不太在乎命令。

english: Once he gets back we'll know more about what to do next. In the meantime, I've managed to decipher the clues left behind by Lord Crwys and Lady Hefin, two more of the clan elders. We should try to find them.
translation: 等他回来，我们就会更清楚下一步该做什么。同时，我已经破译了克鲁维斯领主和赫芬女士——另外两位部族长老留下的线索。我们应该设法找到他们。

english: How do I find Lord Crwys?
translation: 我怎样才能找到克鲁维斯领主？

english: Here is the clue he left behind: 'The trees of my home will call to me.'
translation: 这是他留下的线索：'我家乡的树木会呼唤我。'

english: The Crwys clan is a clan of woodcutters and farmers. The entire clan is close to nature, but none more than Lord Crwys.
translation: 克鲁维斯部族是伐木工和农民的部族。整个部族都亲近自然，但没有人比克鲁维斯领主更亲近。

english: How do I find Lady Hefin?
translation: 我怎样才能找到赫芬女士？

english: Here is the clue she left behind: 'I will walk across the water to the south.'
translation: 这是她留下的线索：'我将越过南方的水面。'

english: The Hefin clan are our religious leaders. They teach us to better ourselves, not just in mind, but in body as well. Lady Hefin used to lead some of the more vigorous training exercises of the Hefin clan.
translation: 赫芬部族是我们的宗教领袖。他们教导我们提升自我，不仅是心智，还有身体。赫芬女士曾经领导赫芬部族一些更为激烈的训练。

english: You should try and find Lord Crwys and Lady Hefin. They could be of big help to us in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 你应该试着找到克鲁维斯领主和赫芬女士。他们可以在对抗伊尔沃斯领主的战斗中给我们很大帮助。

english: Ahh... Stop, stop stop!
translation: 啊……停下，停下停下！

english: Oh... You're not a tree.
translation: 哦……你不是一棵树。

english: A tree? No of course not! I am an elf, but through deep magic, I took on the form of a tree. It allowed me to hide, to stay safe.
translation: 一棵树？不，当然不是！我是一个精灵，但通过深奥的魔法，我变成了树的形态。这让我可以躲藏，保持安全。

english: Safe from Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 躲开伊尔沃斯领主？

english: You know of Lord Iorwerth?
translation: 你知道伊尔沃斯领主？

english: Yes. You must be Lord Crwys, Baxtorian sent me to find you. We need your help.
translation: 是的。你一定是克鲁维斯领主，巴克斯托里安派我来找你。我们需要你的帮助。

english: I see. Where is Baxtorian?
translation: 我明白了。巴克斯托里安在哪里？

english: The village of Lletya. It's east of here.
translation: 莱蒂亚村。在那边以东。

english: Then it is time for me to uproot. I will head there at once.
translation: 那么我该拔根而去了。我立刻前往那里。

english: It's strange to be an elf again. I spent so long living as a tree I almost forgot what my true form felt like.
translation: 再次成为精灵感觉很奇怪。我作为一棵树生活了太久，几乎忘了自己真实形态的感觉。

english: Maybe the tree was your true form and this is just your disguise.
translation: 也许树才是你的真实形态，而这只是一种伪装。

english: Hmmm. Now there's an interesting thought...
translation: 嗯……这倒是个有趣的想法……

english: A traveller? It's been a long time since I've had any company on this little island of mine.
translation: 一位旅行者？我的这个小岛上很久没有访客了。

english: I fear you are at a dead end though, there's nothing of interest for you here.
translation: 不过恐怕你走到死胡同了，这里没有你感兴趣的东西。

english: Don't be so sure. I got here by following a clue, a clue left behind by Lady Hefin. I seek her on behalf of Baxtorian himself.
translation: 别这么肯定。我是跟着一条线索来到这里的，那是赫芬女士留下的线索。我代表巴克斯托里安本人寻找她。

english: Baxtorian? I see. Then I have good news for you human, you have found the one you seek.
translation: 巴克斯托里安？我明白了。那么，人类，我有好消息要告诉你，你找到了你要找的人。

english: So you're Lady Hefin?
translation: 那么你就是赫芬女士？

english: I am. I have lived here in solitude for a long time, but now that solitude must end. Where am I needed?
translation: 正是。我独自在这里生活了很久，但现在这种孤独必须结束。需要我去哪里？

english: The village of Lletya, north of here.
translation: 莱蒂亚村，在这里以北。

english: Then it is time to resume my role among the elves. I will go at once.
translation: 那么是时候恢复我在精灵中的角色了。我立刻就去。

english: The road to enlightenment is a perilous one. The latest peril is the largest I've ever seen though.
translation: 启蒙之路充满艰险。不过，最近的这次危险是我见过最大的。

english: Do you think we can overcome it.
translation: 你觉得我们能克服吗？

english: That is not for me to say. All I can do is see where this path takes me. And if this is the final step of my journey, then I go to my end willingly.
translation: 这不是我能说的。我所能做的就是看这条路将我带向何方。如果这是我旅程的最后一步，那我心甘情愿走向终点。

english: Oh... Hello. Good work finding Lord Crwys and Lady Hefin. I never thought I'd see the other elders again, maybe we'll have a chance with them alongside us.
translation: 哦……你好。干得好，找到了克鲁维斯领主和赫芬女士。我从没想过还能再见到其他长老，也许有他们与我们并肩作战，我们就有机会了。

english: No problem. Any news from Ysgawyn?
translation: 不客气。有伊斯卡温的消息吗？

english: He has just returned. Let us gather the others and hear what he has to say.
translation: 他刚回来。我们召集其他人，听听他怎么说。

english: Now that Ysgawyn has returned, I thought we should gather to hear what he has discovered.
translation: 既然伊斯卡温回来了，我想我们应该聚在一起听听他发现了什么。

english: Where is Arianwyn?
translation: 阿里安温在哪？

english: I saw him heading out into the forest earlier. He must have wanted some time alone.
translation: 我之前看到他走进森林了。他一定是想一个人待会儿。

english: I hope he's okay.
translation: 我希望他没事。

english: He'll be alright, just give him time. While he is gone, we need to keep making progress.
translation: 他会没事的，给他点时间。他不在的时候，我们得继续推进。

english: On that note, what news do you have, Ysgawyn?
translation: 说到这个，你有什么消息，伊斯卡温？

english: The shrine at Gorlah was empty. The orb was removed quite a while ago by the looks of things.
translation: 戈拉的神龛是空的。看样子宝珠早在很久以前就被取走了。

english: So do you believe me now?
translation: 那么你现在相信我了吗？

english: If it helps with your overinflated ego, then yes, I now believe you.
translation: 如果这有助于你那过度膨胀的自我，那么是的，我现在相信你了。

english: If the orb isn't at Gorlah, Lord Iorwerth must have claimed it. It could be anywhere now.
translation: 如果宝珠不在戈拉，那一定是伊尔沃斯领主拿走了。现在它可能在任何地方。

english: Well luckily for us, I know exactly where it is. There's a cave just north of the Iorwerth Camp that is used to store supplies. Lord Iorwerth has it under close guard there.
translation: 幸好，我知道它在哪里。伊尔沃斯营地北边有一个用来存放补给品的洞穴。伊尔沃斯领主派了重兵看守。

english: Because I went scouting.
translation: 因为我去侦察了。

english: Scouting? At the Iorwerth Camp? Who gave you permission?
translation: 侦察？在伊尔沃斯营地？谁允许你了？

english: I gave myself permission. I do not serve you, Baxtorian, or anyone else here.
translation: 我自己允许自己的。我不为你、巴克斯托里安或这里的任何其他人服务。

english: No, you just serve yourself, don't you Ysgawyn?
translation: 不，你只是为自己服务，不是吗，伊斯卡温？

english: My actions benefit us all! Now that we know where the orb is, we can move to claim it.
translation: 我的行动让大家都受益！现在我们知道了宝珠的位置，可以前去夺取了。

english: But why would Lord Iorwerth keep the orb at the camp? Surely it would be more secure behind the Prifddinas walls.
translation: 但伊尔沃斯领主为何要把宝珠放在营地？放在普里夫迪纳斯城墙内肯定更安全。

english: That's the other thing I found out. Lord Iorwerth knows we managed to enter the library. He fears the orb would not be safe behind the walls.
translation: 这是我发现的另一件事。伊尔沃斯领主知道我们设法进入了图书馆。他担心宝珠放在城墙内不安全。

english: How did you discover this?
translation: 你是怎么发现的？

english: I have my methods...
translation: 我有自己的方法……

english: It worries me that you are unwilling to share them.
translation: 你不愿意分享这些方法，这让我很担心。

english: Save your suspicions for someone who cares.
translation: 把你的怀疑留给在乎的人吧。

english: So we know where the orb is. What do we do now?
translation: 所以我们知道宝珠在哪了。现在怎么办？

english: Lord Iorwerth intends to use the orb to free the dark fragment of Seren. We need to stop him.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主打算用宝珠释放塞伦的黑暗碎片。我们必须阻止他。

english: But this fragment of Seren, it's still part of her. Lord Iorwerth has done some unspeakable things, but he doesn't serve Zamorak like we thought, maybe we can reason with him.
translation: 但这个塞伦碎片，毕竟还是她的一部分。伊尔沃斯领主确实做过一些不可言说的事，但他并不像我们想的那样侍奉萨莫拉克，也许我们可以和他讲道理。

english: I tried to reason with Lord Iorwerth a long time ago... It won't work, as much as I wish it would.
translation: 很久以前我就试过和伊尔沃斯领主讲道理……没用的，尽管我希望有用。

english: Regardless of his intentions, Lord Iorwerth is our enemy. You should want to kill him, not reason with him.
translation: 不管他的意图如何，伊尔沃斯领主是我们的敌人。你应该想杀了他，而不是和他讲道理。

english: I would never wish for the death of a fellow elf, no matter what they've done.
translation: 我从不希望任何一个精灵同胞死去，不管他们做了什么。

english: Well look at you with your moral high ground.
translation: 瞧瞧你这道德高地。

english: Now is not the time for arguing. At some point, we will need to decide what to do about the fragment of Seren. For now though, we need to focus on getting that orb and stopping Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 现在不是争吵的时候。到某个时候，我们必须决定怎么处理塞伦碎片。但眼下，我们需要集中精力夺取宝珠，阻止伊尔沃斯领主。

english: The orb isn't enough for him to win though, he'll also need to break through the defences on the Temple of Light. He'll struggle to do that now he's lost Ardougne.
translation: 不过光有宝珠还不足以让他获胜，他还需要突破光之圣殿的防御。现在他丢了阿多尼城，想做到这点很困难。

english: There is another way into the temple though, a tunnel from the Underground Pass, built by the dwarves there.
translation: 不过还有另一条路进入圣殿，一条从地下通道过来的隧道，是那里的矮人修建的。

english: Great... Dwarves... I hate dwarves.
translation: 太好了……矮人……我恨矮人。

english: You hate everything Ysgawyn.
translation: 你什么都恨，伊斯卡温。

english: Lord Iorwerth will stop at nothing to enter the temple. We have to assume that sooner or later, he will find that tunnel.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主会不惜一切代价进入圣殿。我们必须假设他迟早会发现那条隧道。

english: Then we should make sure the tunnel is secure. Baxtorian, allow myself and the other elders to go meet with these dwarves.
translation: 那我们得确保隧道安全。巴克斯托里安，请允许我和其他长老去见那些矮人。

english: Very well, head to the Underground Pass and see what you can do. In the meantime, we should secure that orb. Even if he does get into the temple, Lord Iorwerth can do nothing without it.
translation: 很好，前往地下通道看看你能做些什么。与此同时，我们应该确保那个宝珠的安全。即使他真的进了神殿，没有宝珠，伊尔沃斯领主也什么都做不了。

english: Let me guess, you're going to send your favourite human.
translation: 让我猜猜，你要派你最爱的人类去。

english: Jealous, Ysgawyn?
translation: 嫉妒了，伊斯卡温？

english: No. I have other things to do anyway.
translation: 没有。反正我还有别的事要做。

english: [player name], head to the cave at the Iorwerth Camp and recover the Orb of Light. Be careful though, it's likely to be well guarded.
translation: [player name]，前往伊尔沃斯营地的洞穴，取回光宝珠。不过要小心，那里很可能戒备森严。

english: Sounds like we're done here. Let's get moving.
translation: 看来这里的事办完了。我们出发吧。

english: Head to the cave at the Iorwerth Camp and recover the Orb of Light. Be careful though, it's likely to be well guarded.
translation: 前往伊尔沃斯营地的洞穴，取回光宝珠。不过要小心，那里很可能戒备森严。

english: Well prepare to die [Tim/Sue/Sam]!
translation: 准备受死吧[Tim/Sue/Sam]！

english: I've managed to recover the orb.
translation: 我已经成功取回了宝珠。

english: Thank you friend. Without this, Lord Iorwerth has no hope of freeing that fragment of Seren. I will look after it until we decide what to do with it.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。没有这个，伊尔沃斯领主就没希望释放那个塞伦碎片了。我会保管它，直到我们决定怎么处理。

english: We have the orb, and the elders are securing the Temple of Light as we speak. That fragment of Seren should no longer be a concern.
translation: 我们有宝珠了，长老们此刻正在确保光之圣殿的安全。那个塞伦碎片应该不再是问题了。
