english: Lord Iorwerth is still out there and thanks to his larger army, we have no way of easily dealing with him.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主还在外面，仗着他更庞大的军队，我们没有什么办法轻易对付他。

english: There must be something we can do.
translation: 一定有什么我们能做的事。

english: I'm sure there is, but I don't know what.
translation: 我肯定有，但不知道是什么。

english: Perhaps we should call the others then.
translation: 也许我们该叫其他人过来。

english: I was thinking the same. However, I have a favour to ask first. Something I'd rather keep quiet.
translation: 我也在想同样的事。不过，我得先请你帮个忙。这件事我宁愿保密。

english: Our group is fractured. The revelation about Seren has hit everyone hard, and opinions clearly differ on how we should be responding to it. I fear some intend to take matters into their own hands.
translation: 我们的队伍已经分裂。关于塞伦的真相让所有人都深受打击，对于该如何应对，意见显然分歧很大。我担心有些人打算自行其是。

english: Ysgawyn in particular has been very distant. I have concerns about his loyalties.
translation: 尤其是伊斯卡温，一直很疏远。我对他的忠诚感到担忧。

english: You don't think he'd join with Lord Iorwerth do you?
translation: 你不觉得他会投靠伊尔沃斯领主吧？

english: I don't know. He claims to hate the Iorwerth clan, and he has more reason to feel that way than most. That said... something isn't right.
translation: 我不知道。他声称憎恨伊尔沃斯氏族，而且他比大多数人都更有理由那样感觉。不过……有些不对劲。

english: And you want me to investigate?
translation: 你想让我去调查？

english: I do. Ysgawyn left the village after the meeting earlier. See if you can track him down and find out what he's up to.
translation: 是的。伊斯卡温在早些时候的会议后离开了村子。看看你能不能找到他，弄清他在干什么。

english: Any idea where he might have gone?
translation: 知道他会去哪里吗？

english: I'm afraid not. Elena said she saw him leaving though, maybe she can help.
translation: 恐怕不知道。埃琳娜说她看到他在离开，也许她能帮忙。

english: Ysgawyn has been acting suspiciously. See if you can find him and work out what he's up to. Elena said she saw him leaving the village. She might know where he went.
translation: 伊斯卡温的行为可疑。看看你能不能找到他，弄清他在干什么。埃琳娜说她看到他离开了村子。她可能知道他去哪了。

english: Hey Elena, how's it going?
translation: 嘿，埃琳娜，最近怎么样？

english: Not too bad. I've been given a lot to think about though. Everything I've learnt about Seren, about the elves... it's crazy how big it all is. Our little fight in Ardougne seems so small now.
translation: 还行。不过有很多事情要想。我了解到关于塞伦、关于精灵的一切……这一切如此重大，简直疯狂。我们在阿多尼城的小打小闹现在看来微不足道。

english: I'm surprised it hasn't made you run for the hills.
translation: 我真惊讶这没让你吓得逃之夭夭。

english: Now you know me better than that, I'm too stubborn to leave now.
translation: 你该更了解我，我太固执了，现在不会走。

english: Why are you still here though?
translation: 那你为什么还留在这里？

english: It's about closure I guess. So many people were hurt by Lord Iorwerth's actions in West Ardougne. I need to know that he'll never hurt them again.
translation: 我想是为了一个了结。西阿多尼城那么多人都被伊尔沃斯领主的所作所为伤害了。我需要知道他再也不会伤害他们。

english: He seems to think his actions are necessary.
translation: 他似乎认为自己的行动是必要的。

english: Maybe his cause is just, but that doesn't give him the right to ruin lives in the way he has.
translation: 也许他的事业是正义的，但这不意味着他有权像那样毁掉别人的生活。

english: What do you think should happen to him if we win?
translation: 如果我们赢了，你觉得他应该受到什么惩罚？

english: You mean do I think he should die?
translation: 你是问我是否认为他该死？

english: I've tried to dedicate my life to helping people, healing them. I think all lives are valuable, even the lives of people like Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 我一直努力将自己的一生奉献给帮助他人、治愈他人。我认为所有生命都是有价值的，即使是像伊尔沃斯领主这样的人。

english: I think Lord Iorwerth should face justice for what he has done. I don't think killing him is justice though. Maybe that makes me weak, but that's how I feel.
translation: 我认为伊尔沃斯领主应该为他的所作所为接受公正的审判。但我不认为杀他就是公正。也许这显得我软弱，但这是我的感受。

english: I don't think it makes you weak, it makes you strong.
translation: 我不觉得这让你软弱，反而让你强大。

english: You do? Thank you, that means a lot, especially from you.
translation: 你真的这么想？谢谢，这对我很重要，尤其是从你口中说出。

english: I realise I must come across as so self-righteous with all of this. I'm sorry about that.
translation: 我意识到自己说这些一定显得很自以为是。对此我很抱歉。

english: As much as I hate it, I know that sometimes death is the only option. I like to think we can consider alternatives though. It's what sets us apart from the enemy.
translation: 尽管我很讨厌这样，但我知道有时死亡是唯一的选择。不过我倾向于认为我们可以考虑其他方案。这正是我们与敌人的不同之处。

english: He needs to pay for what he's done though.
translation: 不过他必须为自己的所作所为付出代价。

english: He does, but does it need to be with his life? Killing is a solution, but maybe it's not the only one.
translation: 确实，但需要用他的生命来偿还吗？杀戮是一种解决办法，但也许不是唯一的。

english: I'm sorry. I realise I must come across as so self- righteous talking like this. I'm not trying to act better than anyone, I just want to make sure we've considered every option.
translation: 抱歉。我意识到这样说一定显得我很自以为是。我不是想表现得比别人高尚，我只是想确保我们考虑到了每一种选择。

english: Sometimes people have to die for things to change.
translation: 有时候，只有人死了，事情才会改变。

english: I suppose... I just can't help but wonder if there might be another way.
translation: 我想是吧……我只是忍不住在想，也许会有别的办法。

english: Yes. I wanted to ask you about Ysgawyn.
translation: 是的。我想问问你关于伊斯卡温的事。

english: That's fair. Anyway, I wanted to ask you about Ysgawyn.
translation: 说得对。总之，我想问问你关于伊斯卡温的事。

english: Very true. Anyway, I'll see you later.
translation: 确实。总之，回头见。

english: Ysgawyn?
translation: 伊斯卡温？

english: Yes. I'm trying to find him. Baxtorian said you saw him leaving the village earlier.
translation: 是的。我在找他。巴克斯托里安说你之前看到他离开了村子。

english: I did. I don't know where he went though.
translation: 我确实看到了。不过我不知道他去了哪里。

english: Hmm. That's annoying.
translation: 嗯。真烦人。

english: He only left recently, maybe you can pick up his trail. Have a look around the hidden entrance to the village, by the wolves, and see if you can find anything out of place.
translation: 他才刚离开不久，也许你能追踪到他的踪迹。去村子隐藏入口附近找找，就在狼那边，看看有没有什么异常。

english: Good idea. Thanks Elena.
translation: 好主意。谢谢，埃琳娜。

english: Hey [player name]. Thanks for the talk earlier, it meant a lot. I won't keep you, I'm sure you've got things to do. See you later
translation: 嘿[player name]。谢谢你之前的谈话，对我意义重大。我不耽误你了，你肯定还有事要忙。回头见。

english: Hi there. I'm sure you've got things to do. You should probably go do them.
translation: 你好。我肯定你有事要忙。你大概该去做了。

english: Well well! Meeting with the Iorwerth clan, Ysgawyn? This doesn't look good for you!
translation: 嗬！和伊尔沃斯氏族见面，伊斯卡温？这对你可不太妙啊！

english: You! What are you doing here?
translation: 你！你在这里干什么？

english: Keeping an eye on you, you traitor!
translation: 盯着你，你这个叛徒！

english: Traitor? You dare call me a traitor? Your loyalties change more than the wind and you have the nerve to say I'm the traitor?
translation: 叛徒？你竟敢叫我叛徒？你的忠诚比风变得还快，你还有脸说我是叛徒？

english: Lord Iorwerth took everything from me! My whole life was destroyed by him and that dog, Essyllt! Do you really think I'd join up with them?
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主夺走了我的一切！我的整个人生都被他和那条狗埃西尔特毁了！你真以为我会和他们同流合污？

english: Well that's what it looks like!
translation: 可看起来就是这样！

english: You fool of a human! I may not agree much with the other rebels but everything I've done has been to stop Lord Iorwerth!
translation: 你个愚蠢的人类！我或许和其他反抗者意见不合，但我所做的一切都是为了阻止伊尔沃斯领主！

english: Well who's this then?
translation: 那这位是谁？

english: Well now that you've ruined everything as usual, I suppose I'd better tell you.
translation: 好吧，既然你像往常一样搞砸了一切，我想我最好还是告诉你。

english: This is Iestin Edern, head of research for Lord Iorwerth, and my informant within the Iorwerth clan.
translation: 这位是伊斯廷.埃德恩，伊尔沃斯领主的研究主管，也是我在伊尔沃斯氏族中的线人。

english: Wait... Your informant?
translation: 等等……你的线人？

english: That's right you idiot! Iestin here has been providing me with information on the Iorwerth clan. Not only that, he is the reason why you were able to claim that Orb of Light.
translation: 没错，你这白痴！这位伊斯廷一直在向我提供伊尔沃斯氏族的情报。不仅如此，你能夺到那个光宝珠也是因为他。

english: But... I don't understand. If you've always been loyal, why all the secrecy?
translation: 但是……我不明白。如果你一直忠诚，为什么这么保密？

english: That was my request. I feared that the other rebels may not be trusting of me. They could have imprisoned me or even killed me. It seemed safer to keep things secret.
translation: 那是我的请求。我担心其他反抗者可能不信任我。他们可能会囚禁我，甚至杀了我。保密似乎更安全。

english: Not to mention the fact that it kept Iestin safe from any informants that Lord Iorwerth might have among the rebels.
translation: 更不用说，这还能让伊斯廷避开伊尔沃斯领主可能安插在反抗者中的任何线人。

english: I... I see... I guess that all makes sense.
translation: 我……我明白了……我想这说得通。

english: I'm sorry Ysgawyn.
translation: 对不起，伊斯卡温。

english: I don't want an apology! I don't care how you feel about me. All I care about is stopping Lord Iorwerth for good. I lost all that I had, all that I cared about! I will make him pay!
translation: 我不要道歉！我不在乎你怎么看我。我只在乎彻底阻止伊尔沃斯领主。我失去了一切，所有我在乎的东西！我要让他付出代价！

english: Arianwyn told me what they did. I...
translation: 阿里安温告诉了我他们做的事。我……

english: No! You don't get to talk about that! You have no right!
translation: 不！你没资格谈那件事！你没有权利！

english: Sorry to interrupt, but I think you need to hear this.
translation: 抱歉打断一下，但我觉得你需要听听这个。

english: Yes. What news do you bring Iestin?
translation: 是的。你有什么消息要带给伊斯廷？

english: So what have you been discussing?
translation: 那你刚才在讨论什么？

english: Before you interrupted, Iestin was about to give me some news. Go ahead Iestin.
translation: 在你打断之前，伊斯廷正要告诉我一些消息。说吧，伊斯廷。

english: It's not good I'm afraid. The human here was not wrong to suspect a betrayal. Lord Iorwerth, he knows about Lletya.
translation: 恐怕情况不妙。刚才那个人类怀疑有人背叛并没错。伊尔沃斯领主，他知道莱蒂亚村的事了。

english: By Seren! How?
translation: 以塞伦之名！怎么会？

english: There is a traitor amongst your people. I know not who they are, but it wasn't this human as you feared. They told Lord Iorwerth how to find the village.
translation: 你们族人中有叛徒。我不知道是谁，但不是你担心的这个人类。他们告诉了伊尔沃斯领主如何找到村子。

english: When did he find out?
translation: 他什么时候知道的？

english: Earlier today. Essyllt is preparing their forces as we speak.
translation: 今天早些时候。埃西尔特正在集结部队，就在我们说话的时候。

english: Essyllt!
translation: 埃西尔特！

english: Hang on... If the traitor was one of the rebels, they'll also have told Lord Iorwerth about the tunnel into the Temple of Light!
translation: 等等……如果叛徒是反抗军的一员，那他们也会告诉伊尔沃斯领主通往光明神殿的隧道！

english: He'll know how to get in... He just needs to reclaim the orb! We need to get to Lletya now!
translation: 他知道怎么进去...他只需要夺回宝珠！我们必须立刻去莱蒂亚村！

english: Your days as an informant are done. You're coming with us. Now we need to move!
translation: 你当线人的日子结束了。你得跟我们走。现在我们得行动了！

english: Elena! Are you okay?
translation: 埃琳娜！你还好吗？

english: I'm fine. We need to get the citizens to safety!
translation: 我没事。我们得把村民转移到安全的地方！

english: Where's Baxtorian? Where's the orb?
translation: 巴克斯托里安在哪？宝珠在哪？

english: Sorry, but I don't know.
translation: 抱歉，我不知道。

english: Dammit! Right, you two go with Elena and help the citizens. I'll find Baxtorian.
translation: 该死！好，你们两个跟埃琳娜走，帮助村民。我去找巴克斯托里安。

english: But nothing! Now go!
translation: 没有但是！快走！

english: My children! Someone help me find my children!
translation: 我的孩子们！谁来帮我找找我的孩子们！

english: [player name], you go help Mawrth. We'll get the other citizens to safety.
translation: [player name]，你去帮马尔斯。我们去把其他市民带到安全的地方。

english: My children are hiding in there! Please find them! Please save them!
translation: 我的孩子们藏在里面！请找到他们！请救救他们！

english: I... I'm scared...
translation: 我的孩子们躲在那里！请找到他们！请救救他们！

english: You have to be brave. Your mother is outside waiting for you.
translation: 你必须勇敢一点。你母亲在外面等你。

english: Okay... I can be brave!
translation: 好的……我可以勇敢！

english: What's happening? Where's mummy?
translation: 发生什么事了？妈妈在哪里？

english: She's outside, can you get to her?
translation: 她在外面，你能去找她吗？

english: I... I think so...
translation: 她在外面，你能去找她吗？

english: Don't worry, you can do this!
translation: 我……我想可以……

english: Lord Iorwerth!
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主！

english: Go! I'll get Mawrth and the other citizens to safety!
translation: 快走！我去带马尔斯和其他市民到安全的地方！

english: Well well, the great King Baxtorian. I wasn't sure I believed it when I heard you were still alive, but here you are.
translation: 哎呀呀，伟大的巴克斯托里安国王。听说你还活着的时候，我还不怎么相信，但你居然真的在这。

english: I'm sorry to disappoint you.
translation: 哎呀呀，伟大的巴克斯托里安国王。听说你还活着的时候我还有点不敢相信，但你就在这里。

english: Well your ability to disappoint is one of your few talents, so I'll let it slide. However, I must insist that you give me the orb.
translation: 好吧，让你失望算你为数不多的才能之一，这次我就不计较了。不过，我必须坚持，你得把宝珠给我。

english: Crawl back into the hole you came from Lord Iorwerth, you won't leave here with that orb!
translation: 滚回你来的洞里去，伊尔沃斯领主，你休想带走那个宝珠！

english: Oh I will, one way or another. But in case it wasn't clear, let me explain the situation.
translation: 滚回你来的洞里去，伊尔沃斯领主，你别想带着那颗宝珠离开这里！

english: As we speak, my forces are dealing with the last of your rebels and rounding up your citizens. You have no way to fight, and nowhere to run.
translation: 哦，我会的，不管用哪种方式。但以防你不清楚，我来解释一下情况。

english: Of course, I could just have you all killed right now. After the trouble you've all caused me, it wouldn't be an unreasonable act. However, I am not without mercy, and I will not draw blood unless I have to.
translation: 当然，我现在就可以把你们全杀了。你们给我惹了这么多麻烦，这也不是不合理的做法。不过，我并非没有仁慈之心，除非万不得已，我不会见血。

english: Instead, I give you a choice. Give me the orb, and I will withdraw my forces, leaving you in peace. Refuse, and the blood of those citizens will be on your hands.
translation: 相反，我给你们一个选择。把宝珠给我，我就撤军，让你们安享太平。如果拒绝，那些市民的血债就要算在你们头上了。

english: We do not barter with your kind!
translation: 相反，我给你一个选择。把宝珠给我，我就撤军，让你们安宁。拒绝的话，那些村民的血就沾在你手上。

english: I feared as much. That said, I do have someone here who might change your mind.
translation: 我们不与你这种人交易！

english: What is this? What have you done?
translation: 我就怕这样。不过，我这里有个人也许能改变你的想法。

english: What have I done? Well I told him the truth. It was about time that someone did.
translation: 这是什么？你做了什么？

english: What truth?
translation: 我做了什么？我只是告诉他真相。是时候有人这么做了。

english: They're not the enemy. I thought they were, for so long, but they're not.
translation: 他们不是敌人。这么久以来我一直以为他们是，但他们不是。

english: Everything we have done, every sacrifice we have made, all of it has been to free our goddess.
translation: 我们所做的一切，我们做出的每一个牺牲，全都是为了解放我们的女神。

english: You've never sacrificed, you've never lost anything. You only sacrifice those around you...
translation: 你从未牺牲过，也从未失去过什么。你只会牺牲你身边的人……

english: You have some nerve to lecture me. Remind me, how many of your people died under your watch? How many fell, trying to free your wife?
translation: 你还有脸教训我。提醒我一下，在你的看守下有多少人死了？为了救你的妻子，又有多少人倒下？

english: These new followers of yours, do they know? Do they know what you did? Do they know about the monster you truly are?
translation: 你倒有胆来教训我。提醒我一下，在你的统治下有多少族人死去？为了救你的妻子，又有多少人倒下？

english: I never...
translation: 你这些新的追随者，他们知道吗？他们知道你做了什么吗？他们知道你到底是个什么样的怪物吗？

english: No... of course they don't. You're a liar and a coward, that's all you've ever been.
translation: 我从来没有……

english: As for me, I'm many things, and I admit, a lot of them aren't good. But I would never throw lives away like you did.
translation: 不……他们当然不知道。你是个骗子和懦夫，你一直都是。

english: What's he on about?
translation: 至于我，我有很多身份，我承认其中不少都不怎么样。但我绝不会像你那样随便抛弃性命。

english: Nothing... He's lying. He's just trying to justify his mistakes.
translation: 他在说什么？

english: I've done many terrible things, but none of them were a mistake. Every sacrifice I've made has been for her, for Seren.
translation: 我做过很多可怕的事情，但没有一件是错的。我所做的每一次牺牲都是为了她，为了塞伦。

english: And what are these apparent sacrifices you've made? Nothing compared to the suffering you've caused me, I'm sure!
translation: 我做过很多可怕的事，但没有一件是错误。我做出的每一个牺牲都是为了她，为了塞伦。

english: When I first discovered the truth, our clan was still ruled by my mother. I went to her, told her what I'd found, told her what we needed to do.
translation: 当我第一次发现真相时，我们的部族仍由我母亲统治。我去找她，告诉她我发现的一切，告诉她我们必须做什么。

english: I loved my mother, but she was blindly loyal to this fool here, she wouldn't have any of it. I couldn't just abandon my goddess though, she needed us. So I did what had to be done.
translation: 我爱我的母亲，但她盲目地忠于这里的这个傻瓜，她完全听不进去。但我不能就这样抛弃我的女神，她需要我们。所以我做了必须做的事。

english: You killed her?
translation: 我爱我的母亲，但她盲目忠诚于这个傻瓜，她一点都听不进去。但我不能就这样抛弃我的女神，她需要我们。所以我做了该做的事。

english: And I would do it again without hesitation. For Seren, there is no price too great.
translation: 如果能重来，我会毫不犹豫地再做一次。为了塞伦，付出任何代价都在所不惜。

english: You're a monster! Surely you don't mean to side with this barbarian, Arianwyn.
translation: 你是个怪物！阿里安温，你肯定不会想站在这个野蛮人一边吧。

english: I don't condone what he did, what any of them have done. But they want what we want, we have to try working together.
translation: 你是个怪物！你肯定不打算站在这个野蛮人一边吧，阿里安温。

english: I'll die before working with them.
translation: 我不赞同他做的事，也不赞同他们任何人做的事。但他们想要的正是我们想要的，我们必须尝试合作。

english: No one else needs to die here. Please, just give me the orb. Do that, and I swear we will do you no further harm.
translation: 这里没必要再死人了。求求你，把宝珠给我吧。只要你给我，我发誓我们不会再伤害你们。

english: I... I can't.
translation: 这里不需要再有人死了。求求你，把宝珠给我。只要你给我，我发誓我们不会再伤害你。

english: I see. I did hope it wouldn't come to this, but you've given me no choice. Morvran.
translation: 我明白了。我本希望事情不至于此，但你让我别无选择。莫夫兰。

english: What's going on? Where's mummy?
translation: 怎么了？妈妈在哪里？

english: I'll make this simple for you, Baxtorian. The life of the boy is now in your hands. Give me the orb, and no harm will come to him.
translation: 我就帮你省点事吧，巴克斯托里安。这孩子的命现在掌握在你手里。把宝珠给我，他就不会受到任何伤害。

english: You wouldn't...
translation: 我给你说简单点吧，巴克斯托里安。这孩子的命现在掌握在你手里。把宝珠给我，他就不会受到伤害。

english: No, I wouldn't. But the choice is not mine, it's yours. I will count to five.
translation: 你不会……

english: One.
translation: 不，我不会。但选择不在我，而在你。我数到五。

english: Lord Iorwerth, please...
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主，求你了...

english: Two.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主，请……

english: Baxtorian, please. Just give him the orb.
translation: 巴克斯托里安，求你了。就把宝珠给他吧。

english: Three.
translation: 巴克斯托里安，求你了。把宝珠给他吧。

english: I don't like this, I want mummy!
translation: 我不喜欢这样，我要妈妈！

english: Four.
translation: 我不喜欢这样，我要妈妈！

english: I'll give you the orb. Just please, don't hurt anyone else.
translation: 我把宝珠给你。只求你别再伤害任何人。

english: A wise choice, must be a first for you.
translation: 我把宝珠给你。但请不要再伤害任何人了。

english: Ysgawyn!
translation: 伊斯卡温！

english: Get after them!
translation: 伊斯卡温！

english: Arianwyn...
translation: 阿里安温...

english: It wasn't meant to go like this. No one was meant to get hurt. I'm sorry.
translation: 阿里安温……

english: I don't understand... why?
translation: 本来不该是这样的。不应该有人受伤。对不起。

english: For so long I was led to believe that Lord Iorwerth was our enemy. I thought he'd turned his back on Seren, thought he'd betrayed her.
translation: 长久以来，我一直被误导，以为伊尔沃斯领主是我们的敌人。我以为他背弃了塞伦，以为他背叛了她。

english: But I was wrong. Everything we thought we were fighting for was a lie. He never betrayed her, everything he did was to free her.
translation: 但我错了。我们以为自己为之奋斗的一切都是谎言。他从未背叛她，他做的一切都是为了解放她。

english: Whatever it is he's trying to free... it isn't her.
translation: 不管他想解放的是什么……那都不是她。

english: How do you know? Because of what you found in the library? How do we know that was her? How do we know what's true anymore?
translation: 你怎么知道？就凭你在图书馆里的发现？我们怎么知道那就是她？我们现在还怎么知道什么是真的？

english: So that's why you turned to Lord Iorwerth? To find out the truth?
translation: 所以你投靠了伊尔沃斯领主？就是为了查明真相？

english: My whole life I've dreamed of her, dreamed of what it would be like to meet her. If there's even a chance that she's still alive, I have to know.
translation: 我一生都梦想着她，梦想着见到她会是什么样子。哪怕她还活着的可能性只有一丝，我也必须知道。

english: And if she is alive? Then what?
translation: 如果她还活着呢？然后呢？

english: Seren guided the elves for thousands of years. With her back, we'll finally be able to reform Prifddinas. We'll finally have peace again.
translation: 塞伦引导了精灵数千年。有了她的回归，我们终于能够重建普里夫迪纳斯城。我们终将再次迎来和平。

english: Peace? Look around you Arianwyn. Look at what Lord Iorwerth has done to this village, your home. Does this look like the work of someone who wants peace?
translation: 和平？看看你周围吧，阿里安温。看看伊尔沃斯领主对这个村庄，对你的家园做了什么。这看起来像是一个渴望和平的人干的事吗？

english: It doesn't have to be this way. Step aside. Let me stop Lord Iorwerth and reclaim the orb. Once he's dealt with, we can find out the truth, our way.
translation: 事情不一定非要这样。让开吧。让我去阻止伊尔沃斯领主，夺回宝珠。等处理完他的事，我们可以用我们自己的方式查明真相。

english: You... you know I can't do that.
translation: 你……你知道我不能那么做。

english: Arianwyn please...
translation: 阿里安温，求你了...

english: I'm sorry friend, but I've made my choice. Now please, walk away. No one else needs to die here.
translation: 对不起，朋友，但我已经做出了选择。现在请走吧。这里不需要再有人死了。

english: I can't let him get away.
translation: 对不起，朋友，但我已经做出了选择。现在请走吧，这里不需要再有人死了。

english: And I can't let you go after him.
translation: 我不能让他逃走。

english: He wasn't a friend, to any of us. Everything he cared about he lost a long time ago.
translation: 而我也不能让你去追他。

english: But he didn't give up. To the very end, he fought for a cause he believed in, our cause.
translation: 他不是朋友，对我们任何人来说都不是。他在乎的一切很久以前就失去了。

english: And now he's gone. Along with the orb and that traitor, Arianwyn. Lord Iorwerth has everything he needs now. He'll be preparing to move on the temple as we speak.
translation: 现在他跑了。带着宝珠和那个叛徒阿里安温一起跑了。伊尔沃斯领主现在要什么有什么了。我们说话的功夫，他肯定正准备攻打神殿了。

english: We can't give up Islwyn. If we do, then he died for nothing.
translation: 我们不能放弃，伊斯尔温。如果我们放弃了，那他就白死了。

english: Oh I don't intend to give up, but make no mistake, this is a fight we're unlikely to win.
translation: 哦，我没打算放弃，但别搞错了，这场战斗我们赢面不大。

english: So what do we do? Baxtorian?
translation: 那我们怎么办？巴克斯托里安？

english: I... I don't think there's anything we can do. Lord Iorwerth will destroy us if we try to stop him.
translation: 我……我觉得我们无能为力。如果我们试图阻止伊尔沃斯领主，他会摧毁我们。

english: Maybe, but we have to try. What else is there?
translation: 也许吧，但我们必须试试。还有其他办法吗？

english: We'd be throwing lives away...
translation: 那会白白送命……

english: Well Lord Iorwerth seemed to think you were no stranger to that. Why did he think that?
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主似乎觉得你对此并不陌生。他为什么会这么想？

english: I don't know, probably just some lie he tells himself.
translation: 我不知道，大概是他自己编的谎言吧。

english: Hmm. I don't believe you.
translation: 嗯。我不信。

english: You'd trust Lord Iorwerth over me?
translation: 你宁愿相信伊尔沃斯领主也不相信我？

english: I wouldn't trust Lord Iorwerth if my life depended on it. I know a liar when I see one though, and I can tell you're not being honest about something.
translation: 就算命悬一线我也不会相信伊尔沃斯领主。但我能看出谁是骗子，而且我敢肯定你在某些事上没说实话。

english: What happened? Tell us.
translation: 发生了什么？告诉我们。

english: It was after we were defeated by Lord Iorwerth. With Prifddinas lost to us, we returned to our kingdom in the east. We'd been gone for years by then, and in our absence, the kingdom had fallen to our other foes.
translation: 那是在我们被伊尔沃斯领主击败之后。普里夫迪纳斯城失守，我们回到了东方的王国。那时我们已经离开多年，而在我们缺席期间，王国落入了其他敌人之手。

english: So many dead... my people, the ones I was meant to protect. But that wasn't the worst of it. Glarial, my beloved, she was taken from me.
translation: 死了那么多人……我的子民，那些本应由我保护的人。但这还不是最糟的。我的挚爱，格拉里尔，她被从我身边夺走了。

english: We searched far and wide, desperate to find her. At times it felt like we were close, but the enemy always managed to elude us.
translation: 我们四处搜寻，拼命想找到她。有时感觉我们很接近了，但敌人总能逃脱。

english: Eventually, we managed to track her captors to some caves south of our ruined kingdom. It was clearly a trap, but I was a fool. I was so blind in my desire to find her, I didn't consider the obvious.
translation: 最终，我们设法追踪她的绑架者到了我们废墟王国南边的一些洞穴。这显然是个陷阱，但我太蠢了。我寻找她的渴望蒙蔽了我，以至于没考虑到这显而易见的事。

english: I sent my soldiers in, the few that I still had. They fought the best they could, but it was hopeless. They were massacred.
translation: 我派了我的士兵进去，我仅剩的那些。他们拼尽全力战斗，但毫无希望。他们被屠杀了。

english: After that, I knew I couldn't carry on. I was alone and powerless. So I sealed myself away, in the hope that one day she would come back to me.
translation: 之后，我知道我无法继续了。我孤身一人，无能为力。所以我把自己封闭起来，希望有一天她能回到我身边。

english: You... you killed them? You killed them all?
translation: 你……你杀了他们？你把他们全杀了？

english: I did. But you don't understand, I loved my wife. If there was a chance of freeing her, I had to take it.
translation: 是的。但你不明白，我爱我的妻子。如果有机会救她，我必须抓住。

english: You think I don't understand love? I knew love, for Eirlys! My mother! Your daughter! She died in your war, while you hid away!
translation: 你以为我不懂爱？我懂得爱，对艾尔莉丝的爱！我的母亲！你的女儿！她死在了你的战争中，而你却躲了起来！

english: Lord Iorwerth was right! You're just a coward!
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主说得对！你只是个懦夫！

english: Islwyn, where are you going?
translation: 伊斯尔温，你要去哪？

english: The Underground Pass! I intend to fight for my people, even if their own king won't!
translation: 地下通道！我要为我的子民而战，即使他们的国王不肯！

english: I used to think I was a good king, one that took care of his people. Thanks to me, they had roofs over their heads and food for their tables.
translation: 我曾经以为我是个好国王，一个照顾子民的国王。多亏了我，他们有房住，有饭吃。

english: And yet... I never loved them, not really. The only thing I loved was her, my Glarial.
translation: 然而……我从未真正爱过他们。我唯一爱的是她，我的格拉里尔。

english: When they took her from me... I was torn apart. I vowed I would get her back no matter the cost. That vow destroyed my people... I destroyed my people. In the end... I became just like Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 当他们把她从我身边夺走时……我崩溃了。我发誓要不惜一切代价把她找回来。那个誓言毁灭了我的子民……我毁灭了我的子民。最终……我变得和伊尔沃斯领主一样了。

english: Maybe you did fail your people, you didn't destroy them though.
translation: 也许你确实辜负了你的子民，但你并没有毁灭他们。

english: Maybe not then... but now...
translation: 也许那时没有……但现在……

english: You think this is over? Is that it? Lord Iorwerth beats us once so we just give up? If you truly think that then yes, you have destroyed your people!
translation: 你觉得这就结束了？就这样？伊尔沃斯领主打败我们一次，我们就放弃？如果你真这么想，那没错，你已经毁灭了你的子民！

english: Do you want to just rot here? Wallowing in your own self pity while you lose the little you still have?
translation: 你想就这么烂在这里？在自怨自艾中失去你仅剩的一点东西？

english: What other option is there?
translation: 还有其他选择吗？

english: We can fight! Lord Iorwerth doesn't win until he gets into the Temple of Light! We can still stop this!
translation: 我们可以战斗！伊尔沃斯领主只有进入光明神殿才算赢！我们还能阻止他！

english: But he outnumbers us ten to one... We'll all die.
translation: 但他的人数是我们十倍……我们都会死的。

english: Surely it's better to die trying than to live a life of regret? I'd have thought you'd know that better than anyone.
translation: 战死总比活在悔恨中好吧？我以为你比任何人都更明白这一点。

english: Oh for crying out loud! You have got to be the biggest waste of space I have ever met! I've met goblins with more of a spine than you! For once in your miserable life why don't you actually do something worthwhile?
translation: 哦，天哪！你绝对是我见过最没用的废物！我见过的哥布林都比你有骨气！在你悲惨的一生中，能不能至少做点有意义的事？

english: You... You're awful at pep talks.
translation: 你……你激励人的方式真糟糕。

english: It wasn't meant to be a pep talk!
translation: 我本来就不是在激励你！

english: *sigh* Look... Ask yourself this... What would she want?
translation: *叹气* 听着……问问你自己……她会想要什么？

english: She... She'd want me to save them.
translation: 她……她会希望我拯救他们。

english: Then why are we still stood around talking? We've got work to do!
translation: 那我们还站在这儿废话什么？我们有活要干！

english: I... You're right... We don't have a plan though.
translation: 我……你说得对……但我们没有计划。

english: Lord Iorwerth only has one way into the Temple of Light, the dwarf tunnel from the Underground Pass. We need to stop him getting through.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主只有一条路能进入光明神殿，就是地下通道里的矮人隧道。我们必须阻止他通过。

english: The dwarves should be able to seal the tunnel. We'll need to defend them while they do.
translation: 矮人们应该能封住隧道。我们需要在他们施工时保护他们。

english: But we don't have the strength to withstand Lord Iorwerth's forces.
translation: 但我们没有足够的力量抵挡伊尔沃斯领主的军队。

english: We have the clan elders, their combined power is an army in itself.
translation: 我们有部族长老，他们的联合力量本身就是一支军队。

english: Not all the clan elders. We're still missing two.
translation: 不是所有部族长老。我们还缺两位。

english: Well have you deciphered their clues?
translation: 那你破解他们的线索了吗？

english: I have, but there's a problem. We should hopefully be able to find Lady Meilyr. But Lady Ithell, she died in the early days of the war.
translation: 破解了，但有个问题。我们应该能找到梅莉尔女士。但伊瑟尔女士，她在战争初期就去世了。

english: That's not good. Did she have any descendants?
translation: 那可不妙。她有后代吗？

english: I had a look. Kelyn Ithell is her closest living relative. Problem is, we don't just need a Lady Ithell, we need the Lady Ithell.
translation: 我查过了。凯林.伊瑟尔是她最亲近的在世亲属。问题是，我们需要的不仅仅是一位伊瑟尔女士，我们需要的是那位伊瑟尔女士。

english: Hmmm. How did she die?
translation: 嗯。她是怎么死的？

english: An illness of some sort, I never actually knew what it was. She'd had it for years.
translation: 某种疾病，我其实一直不知道是什么病。她得病好多年了。

english: For years? So she'd have been ill when she gave you her clue. If she knew she was dying, maybe her clue reflects that.
translation: 好多年？那她给你线索的时候应该已经病了。如果她知道自己要死了，也许她的线索反映了这一点。

english: Knowledge can be passed on. Maybe the clue will lead us to her knowledge.
translation: 知识可以传承。也许线索会引导我们找到她的知识。

english: I... I suppose you could be right.
translation: 我……我想你可能是对的。

english: It's worth a shot at least. Leave it with me and I'll see what I can do. In the meantime, you should take the others to the dwarf camp in the Underground Pass.
translation: 至少值得一试。交给我吧，我看看能做什么。同时，你应该带其他人去地下通道的矮人营地。

english: See if you can get in contact with General Hining and the new king of Ardougne as well. Maybe they'll be willing to help us.
translation: 也试着联系希宁将军和阿多尼城的新国王。也许他们愿意帮助我们。

english: I'll see what I can do. We'll need to work quickly though, Lord Iorwerth will be preparing his forces as we speak. Now I guess you'll be wanting to hear those clues?
translation: 我尽力。但我们得抓紧，伊尔沃斯领主此刻肯定在集结他的军队。现在，我想你想听听那些线索吧？

english: What's Lady Ithell's clue?
translation: 伊瑟尔女士的线索是什么？

english: Here is the clue she left behind: 'I'll put my soul into my greatest work.'
translation: 这是她留下的线索：‘我将把我的灵魂注入我最伟大的作品。’

english: The Ithell clan is a clan of builders and architects. Before her death, Lady Ithell was considered the finest architect of all the elves. This village was her final and finest contribution to our people.
translation: 伊瑟尔部族是建筑师的部族。在她去世前，伊瑟尔女士被认为是所有精灵中最优秀的建筑师。这个村庄是她为我们子民做出的最后也是最好的贡献。

english: What's Lady Meilyr's clue?
translation: 梅莉尔女士的线索是什么？

english: Here is the clue she left behind: 'Follow the scrolls to find me.'
translation: 这是她留下的线索：‘跟随卷轴找到我。’

english: The Meilyr clan is a clan of scientists and explorers. You'll probably need to do some exploring yourself to find Lady Meilyr. You may also find this of use.
translation: 梅莉尔部族是科学家和探险家的部族。你可能需要自己探索一番才能找到梅莉尔女士。这个也许对你有用。

english: Do you need to hear one of the clues again?
translation: 你需要再听一遍某个线索吗？

english: Still here, Iestin?
translation: 还在这儿，伊斯廷？

english: Well I can't really go back to Lord Iorwerth now. He knows I betrayed him.
translation: 嗯，我现在没法回伊尔沃斯领主那儿了。他知道我背叛了他。

english: No, but you don't have to stay here.
translation: 不，但你也不必留在这儿。

english: I've made my decision and I intend to stick by it.
translation: 我已经做了决定，并且打算坚持到底。

english: So why follow him in the first place?
translation: 那你当初为什么要追随他？

english: After we lost Seren, Baxtorian was chosen to lead us. Rather than looking after the city of Prifddinas, he chose to expand to the east, leaving us behind.
translation: 我们失去塞伦后，巴克斯托里安被选为领袖。他没有照顾普里夫迪纳斯城，反而选择向东扩张，抛弃了我们。

english: With no ruler, Prifddinas fell into chaos. When Lord Iorwerth came to us and said he'd found a way to bring Seren back to us, you can understand why we turned to him.
translation: 没有统治者，普里夫迪纳斯城陷入混乱。当伊尔沃斯领主来找我们，说他找到了让塞伦回归的方法时，你就能理解我们为什么投靠他了。

english: I wish things were as simple as good against evil, but that's rarely the case.
translation: 我希望事情能像善恶对立那么简单，但现实很少如此。

english: I suppose you're right. Anyway, I'd better get going.
translation: 我想你说得对。总之，我该走了。

english: Hey Elena. What are you up to?
translation: 嘿，埃琳娜。你在忙什么？

english: Making sure I've got everything ready. I'll be leaving for the Underground Pass soon.
translation: 确保一切准备就绪。我很快就要出发去地下通道了。

english: Well I've stuck around for this long, it would feel wrong to leave now. Besides, I may not be much of a fighter, but I can help in other ways.
translation: 嗯，我都坚持这么久了，现在离开感觉不对。再说，我可能不是个好战士，但我可以在其他方面帮忙。

english: Very true. I'll leave you to prepare.
translation: 说得对。那你准备吧。

english: Oh wow!
translation: 哦，哇！

english: I... I see it! I see everything! All of her knowledge, I have it now!
translation: 我……我看到了！我看到了所有东西！她所有的知识，我现在都拥有了！

english: Lady Ithell's knowledge?
translation: 伊瑟尔女士的知识？

english: Yes, I know everything that she knew! The statue, it must have given it to me somehow!
translation: 是的，我知道她所知道的一切！那座雕像，一定是它用某种方式把知识传给了我！

english: You're the closest living relative of Lady Ithell. Now you have her knowledge as well. I suppose that makes you the new Lady Ithell.
translation: 你是伊瑟尔女士最亲近的在世亲属。现在你也拥有了她的知识。我想这让你成为了新的伊瑟尔女士。

english: I... I suppose it does. Wow!
translation: 我……我想是的。哇！

english: I guess you'll be wanting me to help defend the Underground Pass then? Well don't worry, I was planning on joining you anyway. With this new knowledge, I can be an even bigger help.
translation: 我猜你是想让我帮忙防守地下通道吧？别担心，我本来就打算加入你们。有了这些新知识，我能帮上更大的忙。

english: I'll head there right away. Time is of the essence.
translation: 我马上就去。时间紧迫。

english: At last Baxtorian calls to me. I can't say I expected him to send a human, but I suppose nothing is as expected these days.
translation: 终于，巴克斯托里安召唤我了。我没想到他会派一个人类来，但我想如今没什么事是意料之中的了。

english: We need your help. The final fight against Lord Iorwerth is nearly here.
translation: 我们需要你的帮助。与伊尔沃斯领主的最终决战即将来临。

english: I will join you in this darkest of hours. Where must I go?
translation: 我会在这最黑暗的时刻加入你们。我该去哪里？

english: The battle will take place in the Underground Pass. Head to Lletya first though, Baxtorian will meet you there.
translation: 战斗将在地下通道进行。不过先去莱蒂亚村，巴克斯托里安会在那里和你碰面。

english: Oh... Hello. Most of the others have departed for the Underground Pass. I'll be leaving with the rest soon.
translation: 哦……你好。大部分人都已经出发去地下通道了。我很快会和剩下的人一起出发。

english: Then I shall meet you there.
translation: 那我们就在那里见。

english: Don't take too long. We'll be at the dwarf camp.
translation: 别拖太久。我们会在矮人营地。

english: How are you Islwyn?
translation: 你还好吗，伊斯尔温？

english: As good as can be, all things considered. I idolised my grandfather for years. They always say you should never meet your heroes though, now I see why.
translation: 考虑到所有情况，还算不错。我多年来一直崇拜我的祖父。人们总说永远不要见你的英雄，现在我明白为什么了。

english: He's still your family though.
translation: 但他仍然是你的家人。

english: He is, he's the only family I have left. The rest of them died in his war. A war that will finally end today.
translation: 是的，他是我仅剩的家人了。其他人都死在了他的战争中。一场今天终于要结束的战争。

english: Maybe if we both survive, I'll find it in my heart to forgive him. But for now, I have to focus elsewhere.
translation: 也许如果我们都能活下来，我会在心里找到原谅他的理由。但现在，我必须专注于其他事。

english: I'll leave you to prepare.
translation: 你去准备吧，我等你。

english: Good luck [player name]. I'll see you on the other side.
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。我们另一边见。

english: Arianwyn is out there, walking alongside our greatest enemy.
translation: 阿里安温就在外面，和我们最大的敌人并肩而行。

english: He saved me once you know. Some of Lord Iorwerth's men found me in the forest. There were too many for me to fight off, I thought I was done for. Without Arianwyn, I wouldn't be here today.
translation: 你知道吗，他曾经救过我。伊尔沃斯领主的一些手下在森林里发现了我。他们人太多，我打不过，我以为自己死定了。没有阿里安温，我今天就不会站在这里。

english: But now he fights alongside them. This war has torn us apart, all of us.
translation: 但现在他却和他们并肩作战。这场战争撕裂了我们所有人，每一个人。

english: Well it ends today.
translation: 好吧，今天就会结束。

english: Yes, today it ends... For better, or for worse.
translation: 是的，今天就会结束……无论结果是好是坏。

english: I wonder if Essyllt will join the battle today.
translation: 不知道埃西尔特今天会不会参战。

english: What will you do if he does?
translation: 如果他参战了，你会怎么做？

english: Me? Nothing. I'm not much of a fighter. I'll be helping with the wounded instead.
translation: 我？什么都不做。我不太会打仗。我会去帮忙照顾伤员。

english: You though... If you see him, don't show him mercy, for he will show you none. Instead, you should show him what happens to those who hurt us.
translation: 不过你……如果你见到他，不要对他仁慈，因为他不会对你仁慈。相反，你应该让他看看，伤害我们的人会有什么下场。

english: For Ysgawyn?
translation: 为了伊斯卡温？

english: No one liked him that much, but he was one of us, and he died trying to save us. He deserves justice.
translation: 没人那么喜欢他，但他曾是我们的一员，而且他是在试图拯救我们时牺牲的。他应该得到公正。

english: If I get the chance, I'll make sure he gets it.
translation: 如果有机会，我会确保他得到公正。

english: Those are my people coming for us. My brothers and sisters.
translation: 那些是我的人，正朝我们而来。我的兄弟姐妹们。

english: They were once, but not anymore. You're one of us now.
translation: 他们曾经是，但现在已经不是了。你现在是我们中的一员。

english: He's not evil you know, Lord Iorwerth. None of them are really, apart from Essyllt maybe.
translation: 你知道吗，伊尔沃斯领主并不邪恶。他们中其实没有谁是真正邪恶的，也许埃西尔特除外。

english: Those that follow him, they do so because they believe in him, believe in what he's doing. For a long time, I believed in him as well.
translation: 那些追随他的人，他们这样做是因为他们相信他，相信他所做的一切。很长一段时间里，我也相信他。

english: So why did you betray him?
translation: 那你为什么背叛他？

english: He became so obsessed with his cause, he forgot why we started following him in the first place. He became more extreme, more radical.
translation: 他变得太执着于他的事业，以至于忘记我们最初为什么追随他。他变得越来越极端，越来越激进。

english: I tried to advise him as best I could, but over time he started listening more to Essyllt and less to me.
translation: 我尽力给他最好的建议，但随着时间的推移，他开始更多地听埃西尔特的话，而不是我的。

english: After I lost my brother, who died following Lord Iorwerth's orders, I realised he needed to be stopped before it was too late.
translation: 在我失去我的兄弟之后——他是在执行伊尔沃斯领主的命令时牺牲的——我意识到必须在他造成无法挽回的后果之前阻止他。

english: You made the right choice.
translation: 你做出了正确的选择。

english: I hope so. But even now I find myself filled with doubt.
translation: 希望如此。但即使现在，我仍感到心中充满疑虑。

english: Nothing like a *hic* bit of home brew before getting to work.
translation: 开工前喝点*嗝*自酿酒，没什么比这更好了。

english: Are you sure you should be drinking? We can't afford to make mistakes here.
translation: 你确定你应该喝酒吗？我们可承担不起犯错。

english: Argh, I work better with a bit of *hic* brew in me. Nothing for you to *hic* worry about.
translation: 啊，喝点*嗝*酒我干得更好。没什么好*嗝*担心的。

english: Didn't think I'd see you back down here [player name]. The elves are lucky to have you on their side.
translation: 没想到会在这里再见到你，[player name]。精灵们有你站在他们那边真是幸运。

english: They're lucky to have you as well, you're our last hope.
translation: 他们有你也很幸运，你是我们最后的希望。

english: What an awful thought. Four dwarves, one a drunk, are the final hope against this darkness. I hope we don't let you down.
translation: 多么可怕的想法。四个矮人，其中一个还是醉鬼，竟然是对抗这片黑暗的最后希望。希望我们不会让你失望。

english: You won't.
translation: 你们不会的。

english: I hope you're right friend.
translation: 希望你是对的，朋友。

english: [player name]. We'll soon be ready to seal the tunnel, it's slow work I'm afraid.
translation: [player name]。我们很快就能准备好封住隧道了，不过恐怕这工作很慢。

english: If we do this wrong, we'll bring the entire cavern down upon all of us.
translation: 如果我们做错了，会把整个洞穴都砸在我们所有人头上。

english: Well that would definitely stop Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 那倒肯定能阻止伊尔沃斯领主。

english: It would. I don't know about you though, but I intend to survive this day. Bringing the cavern down isn't a good way to achieve that.
translation: 确实。不过我不知道你怎么想，但我打算活过今天。把洞穴弄塌可不是实现这个目标的好方法。

english: True that. I'll leave you to your work.
translation: 说得对。我不打扰你工作了。

english: How's it going Thorgel?
translation: 索格尔，情况怎么样？

english: Apart from the army of elves about to descend on us, pretty good.
translation: 除了有一支精灵大军即将降临在我们头上之外，一切都挺好的。

english: You'll be fine, you've got all of us to defend you.
translation: 你会没事的，有我们所有人保护你。

english: Well let's hope your better at fighting than Kamen is at brewing, or this will be a short battle.
translation: 好吧，希望你们打架比卡门酿酒更厉害，否则这场战斗会很短。

english: So here we are. At long last, the end is upon us. The only question that remains is who it's the end for.
translation: 所以，我们到了。终于，末日降临了。唯一的问题是，这是谁的末日。

english: You knew this day would come?
translation: 你知道这一天会来？

english: No war lasts forever, not even this one. The darkest verse of the song of the elves is upon us. Who knows what the next verse will be.
translation: 没有战争能永远持续，这场也不例外。精灵之歌最黑暗的篇章已经降临。谁知道下一章会是什么。

english: Lord Iorwerth better show up soon! I can't wait forever!
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主最好快点出现！我可等不了太久！

english: You seem keen.
translation: 你看起来很急切。

english: I've lived for thousands of years. If I'm going to die today, I'd rather just get on with it.
translation: 我已经活了几千年。如果我今天要死，我宁愿快点结束。

english: This is a dark place we've come to. Fitting I suppose, for this is to be our darkest hour.
translation: 我们来到了一个黑暗的地方。我想这很合适，因为这将是我们最黑暗的时刻。

english: Do you think the fragment of Seren is the cause of the darkness?
translation: 你认为这片黑暗是塞伦碎片造成的吗？

english: Possibly, I suspect it was here long before her though. And whatever happens today, I'm sure it will remain for long after.
translation: 有可能，但我怀疑它在她之前很久就在这里了。而且无论今天发生什么，我相信它都会在很久之后依然存在。

english: The greatest battle of our time is almost upon us. We should take the time to reflect.
translation: 我们这个时代最伟大的战斗即将来临。我们应该花点时间反思。

english: I've never really been one for looking backwards. I prefer to look ahead.
translation: 我从来不是个喜欢回顾过去的人。我更喜欢向前看。

english: You can still reflect on the future as well as the past. If we survive today, our future will be changed forever.
translation: 你仍然可以反思未来，就像反思过去一样。如果我们今天活下来，我们的未来将永远改变。

english: I suppose. I'll probably wait until we've won to think about that though.
translation: 我想是吧。不过我可能会等到我们赢了再考虑这个。

english: I hope we win today. It would be a bit embarrassing to be known as the shortest serving clan elder.
translation: 我希望我们今天能赢。如果被称作任期最短的部族长老，那会有点尴尬。

english: I bet. I'd also like to avoid death if possible. I suspect it's not very fun.
translation: 我猜也是。如果可能的话，我也想避免死亡。我猜那不会很有趣。

english: Not much is fun when Lord Iorwerth is involved. If all goes well though, he won't be a problem after today.
translation: 有伊尔沃斯领主掺和进来，没什么事是有趣的。不过如果一切顺利，今天之后他就不会再是问题了。

english: I've been on the run from Lord Iorwerth for centuries. I'll be glad to finally see peace.
translation: 我逃避伊尔沃斯领主的追捕已经几个世纪了。我很高兴终于能看到和平。

english: So you think we'll win?
translation: 所以你认为我们会赢？

english: Don't forget that death is a form of peace.
translation: 别忘了，死亡也是一种和平。

english: I guess. I'd rather avoid it if I can though.
translation: 我想是吧。但如果可以的话，我还是宁愿避免它。

english: There are worse things in this world than death. Never forget that.
translation: 这个世界上有比死亡更糟糕的事情。永远别忘了这一点。

english: Good to see you General.
translation: 很高兴见到你，将军。

english: And you friend. It will be an honour to fight against the darkness alongside you. Together, we can avenge King Tyras.
translation: 也很高兴见到你，朋友。能与你并肩对抗黑暗是我的荣幸。我们可以一起为泰拉斯国王复仇。

english: You seem well prepared for the battle, compared to the rest of us at least.
translation: 你看起来为战斗做好了充分准备，至少比我们其他人强。

english: We knew this battle would come, ever since the day our king died. We've been prepared for a long time.
translation: 自从我们的国王去世那天起，我们就知道这场战斗会来。我们已经准备了很长时间。

english: I hope it's enough.
translation: 希望这足够了。

english: As do I. If it's not though, we'll make sure they remember us until the end of their days.
translation: 我也希望如此。但如果不够，我们会确保他们到死都记得我们。

english: That we will.
translation: 我们会的。

english: Ah... You made it.
translation: 啊……你来了。

english: That I did. I see you managed to gather some allies.
translation: 我确实来了。看来你成功召集了一些盟友。

english: Yes, General Hining has given us the full support of the Tyras forces. Sadly though, the new king of Ardougne does not wish to assist us.
translation: 是的，希宁将军给了我们泰拉斯部队的全力支持。但遗憾的是，阿多尼城的新国王不愿协助我们。

english: Typical, after all we did for them.
translation: 真典型，我们为他们做了那么多。

english: I suppose they've had enough of elves.
translation: 我想他们已经受够了精灵。

english: Hmmm. How are the defences looking?
translation: 嗯。防御工事怎么样了？

english: We've managed to fortify the area around the camp quite well. The dwarves have set up some cannons and General Hining's men have built some catapults.
translation: 我们已经在营地周围很好地加固了防御。矮人们架设了一些大炮，希宁将军的人建造了一些投石机。

english: Good. We may be outnumbered, but the defences will give us a fighting chance.
translation: 很好。我们可能人数上处于劣势，但这些防御工事会给我们一个战斗的机会。

english: I hope so... I fear it won't be enough to win though.
translation: 希望如此……但我担心这不足以获胜。

english: We don't need to win, we just need to buy the dwarves enough time to seal that tunnel. Do we know how long they'll need?
translation: 我们不需要赢，我们只需要为矮人争取足够的时间来封住那条隧道。知道他们需要多久吗？

english: They haven't given us an exact time, it's a slow process apparently.
translation: 他们没有给我们确切的时间，显然这是个缓慢的过程。

english: Well I suppose we don't want them to do it wrong, they could bring the entire cavern down on top of us. Do we know where Lord Iorwerth is?
translation: 好吧，我想我们也不希望他们做错，他们可能会把整个洞穴砸在我们头上。知道伊尔沃斯领主在哪里吗？

english: The scouts have reported that his forces are on the move as we speak. It won't be long.
translation: 侦察兵报告说，他的部队正在移动，就在我们说话的时候。不会太久了。

english: Let's use the time wisely then. Is there anything I can do before the attack begins?
translation: 那我们就好好利用这段时间。在攻击开始前，有什么我能做的吗？

english: Elena said she had an idea that might help our defence. You could talk to her and see if she needs any help.
translation: 埃琳娜说她有个主意，可能有助于我们的防御。你可以和她谈谈，看看她是否需要帮助。

english: Speak with Elena. She said she had an idea that might help our defence.
translation: 和埃琳娜谈谈。她说她有个主意，可能有助于我们的防御。

english: Hey. I think Baxtorian wants to talk to you.
translation: 嘿。我想巴克斯托里安想和你谈谈。

english: So this is it, after everything that's happened, this is where it ends.
translation: 就是这样了，经历了这一切之后，这就是结局。

english: Are you afraid?
translation: 你害怕吗？

english: What about you?
translation: 那你呢？

english: I'm afraid too.
translation: 我也害怕。

english: You... You matter to me you know...
translation: 你……你对我来说很重要，你知道吗……

english: You matter to me as well.
translation: 你对我来说也很重要。

english: Elena?
translation: 埃琳娜？

english: Don't die today.
translation: 今天别死。

english: I... I'd better go.
translation: 我……我最好走了。

english: Thank you [player name], you're a good friend.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]，你是个好朋友。

english: I'm not afraid.
translation: 我不害怕。

english: I... I'm terrible at these moments. I never know what to say.
translation: 我……我在这种时刻总是很糟糕。我从来不知道该说什么。

english: I care about you Elena, you know that right?
translation: 我在乎你，埃琳娜，你知道的，对吧？

english: I... I don't know what to say either.
translation: 我……我也不知道该说什么。

english: Good luck today.
translation: 今天祝你好运。

english: Baxtorian said you had an idea to help our defence.
translation: 巴克斯托里安说你有办法加强我们的防御。

english: That's right. One of the dwarves here, Kamen, has brewed up some strange alcohol. Whatever it is, it's very flammable.
translation: 没错。这里的矮人卡门酿造了一种奇怪的酒。不管是什么，它非常易燃。

english: Ah yes, I've made good use of it in the past.
translation: 啊，是的，我以前就好好利用过它。

english: Well I think we can make use of it again. I've combined the alcohol with some other chemicals. The result is quite explosive!
translation: 嗯，我觉得我们可以再用一次。我把这种酒和其他化学品混合了。结果相当有爆炸性！

english: If we position some of these explosives on the approach to the camp, we can use them against the Iorwerth forces.
translation: 如果我们把这些炸药放在营地附近的必经之路上，就可以用来对付伊尔沃斯的部队。

english: Hmmm, that could work quite well. Is there anything I can do to help?
translation: 嗯，这主意不错。我能帮上什么忙吗？

english: I've dug some holes around the camp for the explosives to go in. Could you fill them in for me?
translation: 我在营地周围挖了一些洞来放炸药。你能帮我填上吗？

english: Here's the explosives. If you need more just let me know.
translation: 这是炸药。如果还需要更多，就跟我说一声。

english: That's the last of them. I'd better get back to Baxtorian.
translation: 这是最后一个了。我最好回去找巴克斯托里安。

english: [player name], Lord Iorwerth's forces are approaching, you'd better go see Baxtorian.
translation: [player name]，伊尔沃斯领主的部队正在逼近，你最好去见巴克斯托里安。

english: Will do, thanks Elena.
translation: 好的，谢谢你，埃琳娜。

english: And [player name]...
translation: 还有，[player name]……

english: Come back alive.
translation: 活着回来。

english: I think that's everything prepared.
translation: 我想所有准备都做好了。

english: Good, because we're out of time. A message came into the camp, Lord Iorwerth wishes to meet.
translation: 很好，因为我们没时间了。营地传来消息，伊尔沃斯领主想见一面。

english: He wants to meet? Surely it's a trap?
translation: 他想见面？肯定是个陷阱吧？

english: Maybe, but I don't think so. Even if nothing came of it, he was willing to meet me before the Siege of Prifddinas all those years ago.
translation: 也许吧，但我觉得不是。即使谈不成什么，他也愿意在多年前普里夫迪纳斯城围攻战前见我。

english: So what are you going to do?
translation: 那你打算怎么做？

english: I will go. If there's a chance to avoid bloodshed, we should take it, no matter how slim the odds are. I would like you to join me.
translation: 我会去。如果有机会避免流血冲突，我们就应该抓住它，无论机会多么渺茫。我希望你跟我一起去。

english: You think Lord Iorwerth will listen to me?
translation: 你觉得伊尔沃斯领主会听我的吗？

english: No, but maybe Arianwyn will. He considered you a friend, he may still care for what you have to say.
translation: 不会，但也许阿里安温会。他曾把你当作朋友，或许他仍然在乎你想说的话。

english: I see. Then I will join you.
translation: 我明白了。那我就跟你一起去。

english: Thank you friend. Now, Lord Iorwerth is unlikely to be patient, but we can spare a bit of time. If there's anyone you wish to talk to here, I suggest you do so before we depart. You may not get another chance.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。现在，伊尔沃斯领主可能没什么耐心，但我们还能挤出一点时间。如果你在这里还有想谈的人，我建议你在我们出发前就去谈。你可能再也没有机会了。

english: Let me know when you're ready to go.
translation: 准备好了就告诉我。

english: Then we will leave at once.
translation: 那我们就立刻出发。

english: Don't take too long. I'll be here when you're ready.
translation: 别拖太久。我就在这儿等你准备好。

english: Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主。

english: King Baxtorian.
translation: 巴克斯托里安国王。

english: I'm not a king... not anymore.
translation: 我不是国王了……不再是了。

english: No. You never really were a king though were you? A king doesn't abandon his people like you did.
translation: 不。你从来都不是真正的国王，对吧？一个真正的国王不会像你那样抛弃自己的子民。

english: I did not come here to trade insults.
translation: 我来这里不是为了互相侮辱。

english: Really? So why did you come then?
translation: 是吗？那你来这里到底是为了什么？

english: We came to put an end to this. To put aside our differences and stop this war before more people die needlessly.
translation: 我们来是为了结束这一切。放下我们的分歧，在更多人无谓地死去之前停止这场战争。

english: You talk sense human, and yet you stand beside the warmonger himself.
translation: 你说得有道理，人类，然而你却站在那个战争贩子身边。

english: You have a fair share of blood on your hands as well you know.
translation: 你手上沾染的鲜血可也不少，你自己清楚。

english: I do. I have done many unspeakable things, things that haunt me every day. But what I did, I did for the good of my people.
translation: 我承认。我做过许多难以启齿的事情，那些事每天都折磨着我。但我所做的一切，都是为了我的人民。

english: Whereas he, he only ever cared for himself.
translation: 而他却只在乎他自己。

english: Go on, deny it. Just like you always do.
translation: 来啊，否认啊，就像你一贯做的那样。

english: I don't deny it. I failed my people, I failed you. I was never a worthy king, I know that now. But you can't use my failures as a mask to hide your own.
translation: 我不否认。我辜负了我的人民，我辜负了你。我从来都不是一个称职的国王，我现在知道了。但你不能用我的失败作为掩盖你自己失败的借口。

english: We can stand here going around in circles all day, you won't change my mind.
translation: 我们可以整天在这里兜圈子，你改变不了我的想法。

english: If you're not willing to change your mind, why even bother to meet us?
translation: 如果你不愿意改变主意，那为什么还要费力见我们？

english: In the hope that I might still change yours. I don't want anyone else to die in this war. I give you the chance to stand down.
translation: 希望我能改变你的想法。我不希望再有更多人在这场战争中死去。我给你一个撤退的机会。

english: And what happens if we do?
translation: 如果我们撤退，然后呢？

english: We enter the temple, free our goddess and with her by our side, reform the city of Prifddinas.
translation: 我们进入神庙，解放我们的女神，有她在我们身边，重建普里夫迪纳斯城。

english: And we all live happily ever after?
translation: 然后我们就从此过上幸福快乐的生活？

english: That temple, it doesn't contain your goddess. At best, it contains a shadow of what she once was.
translation: 那座神庙里，关着的不是你的女神。充其量，只是她过去的一个残影。

english: Yes, Arianwyn told me what you discovered in the library. It matters not though, that is a part of our goddess in there, we have to free her.
translation: 是的，阿里安温告诉了我你在图书馆里的发现。但那不重要，那里关着的确是我们女神的一部分，我们必须解放她。

english: And if she's evil? What do you do then?
translation: 万一她是邪恶的呢？那你怎么办？

english: My loyalty is to Seren, I will let her decide what is evil.
translation: 我对塞伦忠诚，我会让她来决定什么是邪恶。

english: That... that's not what we agreed.
translation: 这……这和我们之前说好的不一样。

english: We agreed to enter the temple and free Seren. If that's not Seren in there, we shouldn't free her.
translation: 我们说好的是进入神庙并解放塞伦。如果里面的不是塞伦，我们就不应该解放她。

english: I will keep my promise to you Arianwyn, you should not doubt that.
translation: 我会信守对你的承诺，阿里安温，你不该怀疑这一点。

english: Why shouldn't he doubt that? You burnt his home, you killed his friends. You haven't given him much reason to trust you so far.
translation: 他为什么不该怀疑？你烧了他的家，你杀了他的朋友。到目前为止，你并没有给他多少信任你的理由。

english: I did what I needed to do to save our goddess. No one would have needed to die had you not forced our hand.
translation: 我做了拯救女神需要做的事情。如果不是你们逼我，没有人需要死。

english: Listen to him Arianwyn, he'd sacrifice everything and everyone just to free whatever is in that temple. Is that really what you want?
translation: 听听他说的，阿里安温，他愿意牺牲一切和所有人，就为了解放那座神庙里的东西。那真的是你想要的吗？

english: Enough of this! You can try to manipulate him all you want, he's made his choice.
translation: 够了！你可以尽情地试图操纵他，但他已经做出了选择。

english: Now, I'm afraid I'll need to push you on a decision.
translation: 现在，恐怕我需要你做个决断了。

english: I'm sorry, but we can't let you enter that temple.
translation: 我很抱歉，但我们不能让你进入那座神庙。

english: A shame. As unlikely as it was, I did hope you might see reason.
translation: 真可惜。尽管可能性不大，但我确实希望你能讲点道理。

english: I think we're done here then. For what it's worth, I'm sorry it had to end this way.
translation: 那么我想我们谈完了。不管怎么说，我很抱歉事情不得不以这种方式结束。

english: As am I.
translation: 我也一样。

english: Iorwerth forces approaching!
translation: 伊尔沃斯部队逼近了！

english: Elena!
translation: 埃琳娜！

english: Ha! Looks like you were too slow my friend.
translation: 哈！看来你动作还是太慢了，我的朋友。

english: Get away from her!
translation: 离她远点！

english: Or what? Will you murder me in cold blood like you did with King Tyras?
translation: 否则呢？你会像杀死泰拉斯国王那样冷血地杀了我吗？

english: There's only one murderer here!
translation: 这里只有一个杀人犯！

english: You can lie to yourself all you want, I know what you are. You enjoy killing, just like I do.
translation: 你可以对自己撒谎，但我清楚你是什么样的人。你喜欢杀戮，就像我一样。

english: The satisfaction when I finally put an end to that fool Ysgawyn, it was beautiful. It was even better than when I dealt with that stupid lover of his.
translation: 当我最终结果了那个傻瓜伊斯卡温时，那种满足感，太美妙了。甚至比我对付他那个愚蠢的情人时更爽。

english: But if that wasn't enough, now I get to be the one to finally put an end to you and your pathetic girlfriend!
translation: 但如果那还不够，现在我可以亲手终结你和你那个可怜的女朋友！

english: This can't be good...
translation: 这可不太妙……

english: Go! Get after them!
translation: 走！去追他们！

english: Don't worry, I'll take care of her.
translation: 别担心，我会照顾她的。

english: Good luck [player name].
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。

english: This is it, this is what we've spent the last thousand years fighting for. Today, it will finally all be worth it.
translation: 就是这一刻，这就是我们过去一千年为之奋斗的目标。今天，一切终于都值得了。

english: Lord Iorwerth please, see reason. That thing is not Seren, it's not our goddess.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主，求求你，讲点道理吧。那个东西不是塞伦，她不是我们的女神。

english: And what would you know?
translation: 你又知道什么？

english: I knew Seren, I'm the only one here that did, and I know that isn't her.
translation: 我认识塞伦，这里只有我认识她，而且我知道那不是她。

english: Time can change a lot of things, perhaps Seren has changed as well.
translation: 时间能改变很多事情，也许塞伦也变了。

english: I... I don't think it's her.
translation: 我……我不认为那是她。

english: Of course it's her! Don't tell me you believe Baxtorian and his lies?
translation: 当然是！别告诉我你相信巴克斯托里安和他的谎言？

english: I may not have met our goddess, but I heard enough stories to know what she looked like. This thing, it's not her.
translation: 我可能没见过我们的女神，但我听过足够多的故事，知道她长什么样。这个东西，不是她。

english: Well lucky for us, we have a way of finding out.
translation: 那算我们走运，我们有办法弄清楚。

english: Lord Iorwerth please, this isn't what we agreed.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主，求你了，这不是我们约定好的。

english: I know what we agreed Arianwyn! We agreed to free our goddess, and that's what I'm going to do!
translation: 我知道我们约定好的，阿里安温！我们约定好解放我们的女神，而这就是我要做的！

english: You... you've come to free me?
translation: 你……你们是来释放我的吗？

english: What's going on? Why's everything so dark?
translation: 怎么回事？为什么一切都这么黑暗？

english: Dark? All I've ever known is darkness. It's all she gave me.
translation: 黑暗？我所知道的只有黑暗。是她给我的。

english: Seren?
translation: 塞伦？

english: You know of her? How?
translation: 你知道她？怎么知道的？

english: You haven't come to free me at all have you? You're one of her servants!
translation: 你们根本不是来释放我的，对吧？你们是她的仆人！

english: That's not quite...
translation: 不完全是……

english: I loved her! She made me! But I couldn't be what she wanted, so she abandoned me! And now she can't bear to kill me herself, so she sends you instead!
translation: 我爱她！是她创造了我！但我无法成为她想要的样子，所以她抛弃了我！而现在她不忍心亲手杀我，就派你们来！

english: I won't let you! It's not fair! She doesn't get to do this! I don't want it!
translation: 我不会让你们得逞的！这不公平！她不能这样对我！我不想要这样！

english: No! Get out! Get out! Get out!
translation: 不！滚出去！滚出去！滚出去！

english: What... what have you done?
translation: 你……你都做了些什么？

english: She was confused, she was hurt. Yes, she was angry, but she was innocent!
translation: 她只是困惑，她受伤了。是的，她很愤怒，但她是无辜的！

english: I tried to stop her...
translation: 我试图阻止她……

english: How? With violence? That's all you know isn't it?
translation: 怎么阻止？用暴力？你就只会这个，对吧？

english: She just needed time, time to understand, time to overcome her pain. She was our goddess, the last hope for our people. And now, she's gone, because of you.
translation: 她只是需要时间，时间让她理解，时间让她克服痛苦。她是我们的女神，我们族人最后的希望。而现在，她不在了，都是因为你。

english: I hope you can live with yourself...
translation: 我希望你能心安理得……

english: Arianwyn.
translation: 阿里安温。

english: As well as can be expected. My guilt is a heavy load. A lot of people died because of me.
translation: 也只能这样了。我的罪孽沉重如山。很多人因我而死。

english: A lot more might have died if you hadn't stopped Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 如果不是你阻止了伊尔沃斯领主，可能有更多人会死。

english: He wasn't evil, not truly. He just became so obsessed with his goal that he forgot why he started fighting in the first place.
translation: 他并非邪恶，真的不是。他只是过于执着于自己的目标，以至于忘记了自己最初为何而战。

english: As for the fragment of Seren... I wish there had been another way.
translation: 至于塞伦碎片……我希望能有别的办法。

english: She wasn't Seren, and she never would have been.
translation: 她不是塞伦，也永远不会是。

english: No, and at least now her pain has ended. Still, I'll always wonder what could have been...
translation: 不是，至少现在她的痛苦结束了。不过，我还是会一直想，如果当初……

english: There's no place for me here anymore, not after what I've done.
translation: 这里已经没有我的容身之处了，在我做了那些事之后。

english: You're leaving?
translation: 你要走了？

english: I wanted to stay long enough to help repair the damage of my actions, and to look upon Prifddinas for the first time. I've done that now. Lletya has been rebuilt and Prifddinas has been reformed.
translation: 我想留下来足够久，以弥补我行为造成的损害，并第一次亲眼看看普里夫迪纳斯城。现在我已经做到了。莱蒂亚村已经重建，普里夫迪纳斯城也恢复了。

english: I don't know. There's a lot of places on this world that I've never seen. Maybe one of them will help me find redemption, and forgiveness.
translation: 我不知道。这个世界上还有很多我从没见过的地方。也许其中某个地方能帮我找到救赎和宽恕。

english: The elves here will do fine. Baxtorian has his own path of redemption to go on, and I imagine he'll struggle far more than me. He has the other elders to support him though. Under them, our people will prosper.
translation: 这里的精灵会很好的。巴克斯托里安有自己的救赎之路要走，我猜他会比我挣扎得多。不过他还有其他长老支持他。在他们的带领下，我们的族人会繁荣昌盛的。

english: Anyway, you should get going. Baxtorian will be waiting for you.
translation: 总之，你该走了。巴克斯托里安在等你。

english: I'll miss you.
translation: 我会想念你的。

english: And I you. Farewell friend.
translation: 我也是。再见，朋友。

english: Ah, [player name]. Welcome.
translation: 啊，[player name]，欢迎。

english: Hey, good to see you both.
translation: 嘿，很高兴见到你们俩。

english: I thought the city had been restored, I don't see anything though.
translation: 我以为城市已经重建了，但我什么也没看到啊。

english: One of the security measures put in place during the God Wars, from the outside it seems like there's nothing there. Don't worry though, the restoration is complete.
translation: 这是神战期间设置的安全措施之一，从外面看好像什么都没有。别担心，重建工作已经完成了。

english: Speaking of which, myself and the other elders have come to an agreement. For too long, we've been afraid of outsiders, showing them mistrust while our own kind plot against us.
translation: 说到这个，我和其他长老已经达成一致。长期以来，我们一直害怕外人，对他们不信任，而自己的族人却在密谋对付我们。

english: After all that's happened, we've decided that from now on, that will no longer be the case. We will open our city up to the other races, letting them walk among us for the first time.
translation: 经历这一切之后，我们决定从今往后，不再这样了。我们将向其他种族开放城市，让他们第一次在我们中间行走。

english: As a thank you for all that you've done, we'd like the two of you to be the first to enter Prifddinas.
translation: 为了感谢你们所做的一切，我们希望你们两位成为首批进入普里夫迪纳斯城的人。

english: Well, that's quite the honour.
translation: 哇，真是莫大的荣幸。

english: They've also agreed to let me move into the city. That tiny house in Ardougne was becoming a bit tiresome, and there's so much for me to learn from the Meilyr elves.
translation: 他们也同意让我搬进城里。阿多尼城的那栋小房子已经开始让我觉得有点厌倦了，而且我有很多东西要向梅利尔精灵学习。

english: Well I'll be sure to come and visit.
translation: 那我一定常来看你。

english: Now that the city has been reformed, are you going to become king of the elves again?
translation: 现在城市已经重建，你要再次成为精灵的国王吗？

english: Oh I said my days as a king were done, and I meant it. From now on, the elves will be jointly ruled by the eight clan elders. No single elf will ever rule again. We've realised that we're not overly good at it.
translation: 哦，我说过我当国王的日子已经结束了，我是认真的。从现在起，精灵将由八大家族的族长共同统治。不会再由单个精灵来统治。我们意识到我们并不太擅长这个。

english: But anyway, we can talk more later. For now, I'd say it's time for the two of you to see Prifddinas.
translation: 不过总之，我们可以以后再聊。现在，我觉得是时候让你们俩看看普里夫迪纳斯城了。

english: Ready [player name]?
translation: 准备好了吗，[player name]？

english: Many salutations to you. What brings you to our little town?
translation: 向你致以诚挚的问候。是什么风把你吹到我们小镇来了？

english: I am an adventurer in search of quests.
translation: 我是一个寻找任务的冒险者。

english: Hmm, well that could be quite fortuitous. We really could do with some help here. Our town seems to have come under a curse, and we are desperate to get it removed.
translation: 嗯，那可真巧了。我们这儿确实需要些帮助。我们小镇似乎中了诅咒术，我们急着想把它解除。

english: A curse? What sort of curse?
translation: 诅咒术？什么诅咒术？

english: Well first of all our fountain, which has served us for many years, suddenly dried up. We then started transporting water from the river, but what we carried would always have completely dried up by the time we
translation: 首先，我们用了多年的喷泉突然干涸了。然后我们开始从河里运水，但每次运回来的水都会完全蒸发掉，等我们

english: got it back to the village.
translation: 回到村子时就已经没了。

english: So what do you do for water now?
translation: 那你们现在怎么弄到水？

english: Well it's tough. There is a guy who calls himself Ali the carter down in the market. He's from Pollnivneach, so the curse doesn't seem to have affected him. He's got a cart full of water which he's selling to the people here.
translation: 挺难的。市场那边有个自称车夫阿里的家伙。他是波尼尼镇来的，所以诅咒术似乎对他没影响。他有一推车的水在卖给这里的人。

english: Unfortunately in typical Pollnivneach style he's taking the opportunity to sell the water at outrageous prices because he knows we are desperate. Oh and Rokuh has developed something quite remarkable, called a choc ice
translation: 不幸的是，典型的波尼尼镇做派，他趁机以天价卖水，因为他知道我们走投无路了。哦，还有罗库发明了个了不起的东西，叫巧克力冰激凌

english: which is helping people stay cool.
translation: 能帮人们保持凉爽。

english: Any idea how you got this curse?
translation: 知道是怎么中的这个诅咒术吗？

english: Well we think it was because we were negligent in our duty to protect a priest of Saradomin. He came to us a few weeks ago from the north and we welcomed him into our town. He taught us much of the wisdom of
translation: 我们觉得是因为我们疏忽了保护一位萨拉多明祭司的职责。他几周前从北方来到我们这里，我们欢迎他进了镇子。他教了我们许多萨拉多明的智慧。

english: Saradomin. Then about a week ago, we found him dead by the river. It seems unlikely that it is coincidence we were then cursed. If you look around the town you might be able to find out more.
translation: 然后大约一周前，我们发现他死在河边。随后我们就中了诅咒术，这不太可能是巧合。你可以在镇子里四处看看，或许能发现更多线索。

english: Ok I will have a look around and see what I can do.
translation: 好的，我会四处看看，看看我能做些什么。

english: Good luck to you.
translation: 祝你好运。

english: I'm sorry to hear of your plight, but I must be going.
translation: 很遗憾听到你们的困境，但我得走了。

english: Well we've not fallen on the best of times here, but there are a few shops to look around and we have someone selling a marvelous new invention called a choc ice..
translation: 呃，我们这儿虽然时运不济，但还有几家店可以逛逛，而且有人卖一种绝妙的新发明叫巧克力冰激凌……

english: Oh, and there's the old temple if you're interested in a bit of history.
translation: 哦，还有那座古庙，如果你对历史感兴趣的话。

english: I'm passing through on my way to Menaphos.
translation: 我只是路过，要去麦那弗斯。

english: Oh you don't want to go there. I hear rumours of plagues and the like.
translation: 哦，你不想去那儿的。我听说有瘟疫之类的传闻。

english: Thanks for the warning, but I might go and investigate anyway.
translation: 谢谢提醒，不过我还是想去调查看看。

english: Many salutations to you sir, have you made any progress in uncovering the reasons for our curse yet?
translation: 先生，再次向您问好。您在查明我们诅咒术的原因上有什么进展吗？

english: I am working on it.
translation: 我正在努力。

english: Please try your best, that water salesman is not doing much good for the economy of our town.
translation: 请尽力而为，那个卖水的人对我们镇的经济可没什么好处。

english: What was I meant to do again?
translation: 我该做什么来着？

english: Look around this town, see if you can uncover any information to why we were cursed and how the curse might be lifted. I suspect that it might be because a priest of Saradomin died while staying at our town, but
translation: 在镇里四处看看，看看你能不能找到任何关于我们为什么被诅咒以及如何解除诅咒术的信息。我怀疑可能是因为一位萨拉多明祭司在我们镇里去世了，但

english: that isn't much help in getting the curse lifted and it is possible I'm wrong anyway.
translation: 那对于解除诅咒术帮助不大，而且我也可能猜错了。

english: I haven't really had the time to investigate.
translation: 我真的没时间去调查。

english: Well I hope somebody can find the time soon, the despair of the people of this town increases daily.
translation: 嗯，我希望有人能尽快抽出时间，这个镇子人们的绝望与日俱增。

english: Good day to you young man.
translation: 你好啊，年轻人。

english: I am trying to find out the cause of this town's curse.
translation: 我正在试图找出这个镇子诅咒术的原因。

english: Oh that's something which no one but the gods and the river spirits seem to know.
translation: 哦，那件事似乎除了神和河之灵魂，没人知道。

english: River spirits, what are they?
translation: 河之灵魂？那是什么？

english: They're the guardians of the source of the river Elid, they'll know of our curse, seeing as it's related to water we bring from the river. It's said that nothing happens on the river that they don't know about.
translation: 他们是埃利德河源头的守护者，他们肯定知道我们的诅咒术，因为这与我们从河里取的水有关。据说河上发生的事没有他们不知道的。

english: So would it be possible for me to find these spirits and ask them what is going on?
translation: 那么我能找到这些灵魂，问问他们到底怎么回事吗？

english: Ahh now the spirits are something which no one from here have seen in a good long time, certainly not in my lifetime, I don't think even in my own grandfather's lifetime.
translation: 啊，这些灵魂很久很久没人见过了，肯定在我这一代没见过，我觉得连我祖父那一代都没见过。

english: Most the younger people of this town don't even remember that the spirits even exist.
translation: 镇里多数年轻人甚至都不记得这些灵魂存在过。

english: Here I have something around here somewhere which may be of interest to you.
translation: 我这里有个东西，可能你会感兴趣。

english: Aha yes here it is, the ballad of Jareesh. This tells of a previous quest to try and find the spirits.
translation: 啊哈，找到了，就是《贾里什歌谣》。这讲述了一次寻找灵魂的冒险经历。

english: Thank you very much for your help.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助。

english: Lousy, young people have no respect for their elders, there's too many confusing newfangled magic carpets and snake charmers around these days and now we don't even have any water.
translation: 糟糕透了，年轻人一点也不尊重长辈，现在到处都是些乱七八糟的新式魔法地毯和耍蛇人，现在我们连水都没有了。

english: Well I hope things pick up for you.
translation: 嗯，希望你情况能好转。

english: Well with the moral standards of this town lately, I'm hardly surprised.
translation: 嗯，以这个镇子最近的道德水准来看，我一点也不意外。

english: Why, what have they been up to?
translation: 怎么，他们干了什么？

english: Nothing someone like you would understand.
translation: 没什么你这种人能懂的事。

english: Be Careful in here and don't touch anything! There's some old and valuable artefacts around here. Careless outsiders.. you're always coming in and making a mess of things!
translation: 在这里小心点，别碰任何东西！这附近有些古老而珍贵的文物。粗心的外人……你们总是进来把东西搞得一团糟！

english: She! Otherwise knowas Elidinis, Goddess of growth and fertility, Lady of the river, Wife of Tumeken, Flower of the desert, Mother of Icthlarin.
translation: 她！也就是埃利迪尼斯，生长与丰饶女神，河流女士，图梅肯之妻，沙漠之花，伊克哈林之母。

english: What is that key on display?
translation: 展示的那把钥匙是什么？

english: That's a very valuable artefact. Keep your hands off it.
translation: 那是一件非常珍贵的文物。别碰它。

english: ..I just wanted to know what it did.
translation: ……我只是想知道它是做什么用的。

english: That's the key to the holy chambers of the great and mighty Spirits of the Elid, and it's staying right there. There are other holy items about this building and keep your hands off them too, but most definitely keep your
translation: 那是伟大而强大的埃利德之灵神圣殿堂的钥匙，它就得放在那儿。这座建筑里还有其他圣物，你也别碰，但最最重要的是别碰

english: hands off the key. People already meddle too much with the affairs of the shrine.
translation: 那把钥匙。人们已经过多干涉神龛的事务了。

english: Would you happen to know anything about the curse?
translation: 你碰巧知道关于诅咒术的事吗？

english: Yes the people round here can't seem to get the water themselves. It's an ideal business opportunity for one such as myself.
translation: 是啊，这里的人似乎自己弄不到水。对我这样的人来说，是个绝佳的商机。

english: It does seem to be slightly exploiting their unfortunate situation.
translation: 这似乎有点利用他们不幸的处境。

english: I don't see it like that. Without me they'd be in even more of a mess. I'm doing them a favour and in true Pollnivneachian spirit making a profit along the way.
translation: 我不这么看。没有我，他们会更糟。我是在帮他们忙，同时本着真正的波尼尼精神顺便赚点钱。

english: I really have no idea. It's most regrettable. Fortunately my innovation with my choc ice invention is helping people stay at least slightly cool.
translation: 我真的不知道。非常遗憾。幸运的是，我的巧克力冰激凌发明至少能帮人们稍微凉快一点。

english: Hi, I am trying to find the cause of the curse on your town.
translation: 嗨，我正在试图找出你们镇上诅咒术的原因。

english: What curse is that?
translation: 什么诅咒术？

english: Don't you know? The curse that has stopped your fountain working and made all the water dry up when you bring it back from the river?
translation: 你不知道吗？那个让你们的喷泉无法使用，从河里运回来的水都会干掉的诅咒术？

english: Ohh that's because of a curse? I didn't think of that.
translation: 哦，那都是因为诅咒术？我倒没想到。

english: So any ideas about the cause of the curse?
translation: 那对于诅咒术的原因有什么想法吗？

english: Absolutely none.
translation: 完全没有。

english: Did they? What did they want to go and do a thing like that for?
translation: 他们真这么做了？他们为什么要干那种事？

english: There was a Saradominist priest here?
translation: 这里来过一位萨拉多明祭司？

english: Yes, I just don't get out that much.
translation: 是的，我只是不太出门。
