translation: 啊，原来你在这里，主人 4'6 350 pounds。我很高兴你召唤了我。请收下这盏灯，许个愿吧。

english: Yes I finally got it. I had to destroy a pair of your shoes though. A crazy genie wanted a sole off your shoe in return for the statuette. I think he got souls and soles confused.
translation: 是的，我终于拿到了。不过我毁了你一双鞋子。一个疯狂的精灵想要你鞋子上的一只鞋底来交换小雕像。我想他把灵魂和鞋底搞混了。

english: I suppose sacrificing a pair of shoes for the greater good of the town is reasonable. I don't begin to understand the ways of genies.
translation: 我想为了镇子的更大利益牺牲一双鞋子还算合理。我完全不理解精灵的作风。

english: Yes I thought it best not to correct him. He's somewhat less dangerous than he might be if he's a collector of shoe soles.
translation: 是的，我觉得最好还是别纠正他。他当个鞋底收藏家时，比现在要危险小一些。

english: Anyway thanks for getting the statue back. You should take it to our temple and then we can see if our fountain starts working again.
translation: 总之，谢谢你拿回了雕像。你应该把它带到我们的神庙，然后我们就能看看喷泉是否重新开始运转了。

english: Many salutations to you sir, what brings you to our little town?
translation: 向您致敬，先生，是什么风把您吹到我们小镇来了？

english: Many salutations to you madam, have you made any progress in uncovering the reasons for our curse yet?
translation: 向您致敬，女士，您查清我们所受诅咒的原因了吗？

english: Many salutations to you madam, what brings you to our little town?
translation: 向您致敬，女士，是什么风把您吹到我们小镇来了？

english: Thank you kind sir. The town is saved and the water is flowing freely.
translation: 谢谢您，好心的先生。小镇得救了，水也重新畅通了。

english: What! That's just asking to much. So, he want's to have my soul when my time to die comes?
translation: 什么！这要求太过分了。所以，他想在我死的时候拿走我的灵魂？

english: Oh you don't want to go there at the moment. I hear rumours of plagues and the like down there, I think they've closed off the city anyway.
translation: 哦，你现在可别去那里。我听说那里有瘟疫之类的传闻，我想他们已经封锁了那座城市。

english: That is not so good. You had best refind it then. I tend to find in life things often return to where you first got them.
translation: 那可不太好。那你最好再找找。我发现在生活中，东西常常会回到你最初得到它们的地方。

english: I have got the statuette.
translation: 我拿到小雕像了。

english: That is great news! I could kiss you, but they don't allow shrine custodians to engage in that sort of behaviour. You should put the statuette back on its plinth.
translation: 真是好消息！我真想亲你一口，但他们不允许神龛管理员做出那种行为。你应该把小雕像放回它的基座上。

english: That is not good. I hope you find it again so that we can be freed from this awful curse.
translation: 那可不好。我希望你能重新找到它，这样我们就能摆脱这个可怕的诅咒了。

english: Hello. Lovely day, isn't it?
translation: 你好。今天天气真好，不是吗？

english: Lovely? Oh - er - if you say so. But please excuse me, I really don't have time to chat about the weather.
translation: 真好？哦——呃——如果你这么说的话。但请原谅，我真的没时间聊天气。

english: What's the rush?
translation: 急什么？

english: Trolls! They're attacking my fishing Colony!
translation: 巨魔！它们正在攻击我的钓鱼殖民地！

english: Gosh, I didn't know there were any trolls around here.
translation: 天哪，我不知道这附近有巨魔。

english: These are a sort of sea-dwelling troll. They feed on the monkfish that live in this part of the sea, but just recently they've started invading my Colony!
translation: 这些是一种海栖巨魔。它们以生活在这片海域的僧侣鱼为食，但最近它们开始入侵我的殖民地！

english: Well yes, I do. I've done some research about this, and I think our best hope is to get hold of an experienced adventurer.
translation: 嗯，是的，我有。我对此做过一些研究，我认为我们最好的希望是找到一个有经验的冒险者。

english: In all the legends I've read, brave adventurers have no trouble vanquishing whatever monsters are menacing the helpless settlement.
translation: 在我读过的所有传说中，勇敢的冒险者总能毫不费力地击败威胁无助定居点的怪物。

english: You've been... reading stories about adventurers?
translation: 你一直在……读关于冒险者的故事？

english: Yes, I've done my research very carefully. I've always made important decisions based on careful analysis of whatever documents are available to me on the topic. For example, I chose this site for my Fishing Colony because
translation: 是的，我做了非常仔细的研究。我总是基于对现有相关文件的仔细分析来做重要决定。例如，我选择这里作为我的钓鱼殖民地，是因为

english: records show this part of the sea to be a prime site for catching monkfish. I don't just fumble along like an amateur!
translation: 记录显示这片海域是捕捉僧侣鱼的最佳地点。我可不像业余人士那样瞎摸索！

english: ... fair enough, I suppose! Anyway, you think you need an adventurer?
translation: ……好吧，我想也是！总之，你觉得你需要一个冒险者？

english: Yes, that's right. A brave adventurer with plenty of experience in this sort of work.
translation: 是的，没错。一个勇敢的、在这方面有丰富经验的冒险者。

english: I'm a brave adventurer! Can I try?
translation: 我就是个勇敢的冒险者！我能试试吗？

english: You? I hadn't thought of that... let's have a look at you...
translation: 你？我还没想到这个……让我看看你……

english: No, I'm sorry, but you simply do not have enough experience. I've got a LOT at stake here, and I can't afford to have an amateur getting in the way.
translation: 不，抱歉，你的经验根本不够。我这次可是押上了很多，不能让一个业余人士碍事。

english: Hmmm... You're not what I'm looking for, but... [amount] Quest Points is really rather a lot...
translation: 嗯……你不是我要找的人，但是……[amount] 个任务点数确实相当多了……

english: Ok, the Piscatoris Fishing Colony gratefully accepts your offer of help. When the Colony is safe you shall be handsomely rewarded.
translation: 好吧，皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼殖民地感激地接受你的帮助。当殖民地安全后，你将得到丰厚的报酬。

english: Oh goody, I love rewards! Now, how can I help?
translation: 哦太好了，我喜欢报酬！现在，我能帮什么忙？

english: Well, as qualified as you undoubtedly are, I believe we're going to need a truly expert adventurer if the Colony is to stand a chance.
translation: 嗯，尽管你无疑很合格，但我认为我们需要一个真正专业的冒险者，殖民地才有希望。

english: Expert adventurer? I'll wager I've had more adventures than you've had pickled gherkins!
translation: 专业冒险者？我敢打赌我经历过的冒险比你吃过的腌黄瓜还多！

english: Expert adventurer? I'll have you know I'm in the Guild of Legends!
translation: 专业冒险者？我告诉你，我可是传奇公会的成员！

english: If you could just stop blowing your own trumpet for a minute...
translation: 你能不能先别自吹自擂了……

english: Excellent! Now, in far-away Misthalin there lives one of the greatest adventurers of all time.
translation: 太好了！现在，在遥远的迷雾森林，住着一位有史以来最伟大的冒险者。

english: ... this better be good...
translation: ……最好是个好消息……

english: His name is lost in the mists of time, but you shouldn't have much trouble finding the Wise Old Man of Draynor Village.
translation: 他的名字已湮没在时间的迷雾中，但你应该不难找到德雷诺村的老智者。

english: Him? What in the heck do you want with HIM?
translation: 他？你找他干嘛？

english: Oh, do you know him?
translation: 哦，你认识他？

english: Well I've met him. Don't you think he's a bit old?
translation: 我见过他。你不觉得他有点老了吗？

english: Maybe, but he's still an expert adventurer.
translation: 也许吧，但他仍然是个专业冒险者。

english: Yes! He's mad! You know he smashed his way into a bank and stole a load of stuff?
translation: 没错！他疯了！你知道他砸开银行偷了一大堆东西吗？

english: Ah well, we must forgive him his little foibles.
translation: 啊，好吧，我们得原谅他的小怪癖。

english: He's just called 'Wise Old Man'?
translation: 他就叫‘老智者’？

english: Well, he presumably has a name, but that's what he's called now.
translation: 嗯，他大概有名字，但现在大家都这么叫他。

english: And you want me to fetch this Wise Old Man?
translation: 你想让我去请这个老智者？

english: You don't sound convinced. Look, I'll tell you what I've read about him...
translation: 你听起来不太信服。听着，我来告诉你我读到的关于他的事……

english: Take THAT!
translation: 接招！

english: Ssssss!
translation: 嘶嘶嘶！

english: Don't ignore your mate!
translation: 别不理你的伙伴！

english: Hey, matey!
translation: 嘿，伙计！

english: I AM NOT YOUR MATE!
translation: 我不是你的伙计！

english: Aaah!
translation: 啊！

english: RAAAaaarrgh!
translation: 嗷啊啊啊！

english: Lie still, and trouble us no more.
translation: 躺着别动，别再给我们添麻烦了。

english: Avaunt, foul fiend!.
translation: 滚开，邪恶的怪物！

english: Oh deary me...
translation: 哦天哪……

english: Right... so you want me to fetch this old man who used to be a great adventurer.
translation: 好吧……所以你想让我去请那个曾经是伟大冒险者的老人。

english: Yes, that's right. And do watch out for the sea trolls!
translation: 是的，没错。小心海巨魔！

english: I'll leave you to it, then.
translation: 那我就不打扰你了。

english: Fine, fine.
translation: 好的，好的。

english: Ah, [player name]. I was wondering where you'd got to.
translation: 啊，[player name]。我正想知道你去哪了。

english: What was it you wanted me to do?
translation: 你想让我做什么来着？

english: Go to Draynor Village and fetch the Wise Old Man to help save the Colony!
translation: 去德雷诺村把老智者请来，帮忙拯救殖民地！

english: Couldn't I just save it myself?
translation: 难道我自己不能拯救它吗？

english: No! Now go and do what I told you!
translation: 不行！现在去照我说的做！

english: You used to be a famous adventurer, didn't you?
translation: 你曾经是个著名的冒险者，对吧？

english: Heh heh! Yes, I suppose you could say that. But that was all quite a long time ago. I haven't been on what you'd call a 'quest' for a while.
translation: 嘿嘿！是的，可以这么说。但那都是很久以前的事了。我已经有一阵子没进行过你所谓的‘任务’了。

english: Does that mean you'd be interested if someone asked for your help?
translation: 那如果有人请你帮忙，你会感兴趣吗？

english: Oh? What exactly had you in mind?
translation: 哦？你具体有什么想法？

english: Herman Caranos of the Piscatoris Fishing Colony thinks he needs you to save his colony from a tribe of attacking sea trolls.
translation: 皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼殖民地的赫尔曼.卡拉诺斯认为需要你来拯救他的殖民地，对抗一群攻击性的海巨魔。

english: Hmmm... so I haven't been forgotten... and the world once again is calling for my aid...
translation: 嗯……看来我还没被遗忘……世界再次呼唤我的援助……

english: Well, it's just one man who smells of fish, not exactly the whole world...
translation: 呃，只是一个浑身鱼腥味的人，算不上整个世界……

english: ... yet this could be the opportunity I've been waiting for...
translation: ……但这可能是我一直在等待的机会……

english: ... yawn...
... but I'm a lot older than I used to be, do I still have the strength? Should I retire now, or can I do just one more quest?
translation: ……但我比以前老了很多，我还有力量吗？我应该就此退休，还是能再完成一个任务？

english: If you're not feeling up to it, I'll leave you alone.
translation: 如果你觉得力不从心，我就不打扰你了。

english: Yes, I'll do it! This can be my final adventure, my last great quest. Saving this colony shall be my swan song.
translation: 好，我干！这将是我的最后一次冒险，我最后的伟大任务。拯救这个殖民地将是我的天鹅曲。

english: Swan song?
translation: 天鹅曲？

english: Legend tells us that a swan, before it dies, sings a song of outstanding beauty as a fitting conclusion to its graceful life. This adventure will be my swan song.
translation: 传说告诉我们，天鹅在临死前会唱出一首绝美的歌，作为其优雅生命的恰当终结。这次冒险将是我的天鹅曲。

english: You're going to sing a song and then snuff it? Maybe I should tell Herman you've flipped...
translation: 你要唱首歌然后死掉？也许我应该告诉赫尔曼你疯了……

english: No, you ignoramus! I shall bring my adventuring days to a dramatic close by saving this colony!
translation: 不，你这个无知的人！我要通过拯救这个殖民地来戏剧性地结束我的冒险生涯！

english: Great. So long as you're not going to sing.
translation: 太好了。只要你不唱歌就行。

english: Yes, that's right, I'm not going to sing. Anyway, I shall need some supplies from you.
translation: 是的，没错，我不唱歌。总之，我需要你提供一些补给品。

english: Oh yes? What do you want?
translation: 哦？你想要什么？

english: I'm rather short of runes. If you could fetch me 5 Blood runes, 10 Lava runes and 10 Mist runes, I'll be able to set off.
translation: 我符文不太够。如果你能给我拿来5个血符文、10个熔岩符文和10个雾符文，我就能出发了。

english: I just happen to have those with me!
translation: 我正好带着这些！

english: Gosh, you're very efficient!
translation: 天哪，你真有效率！

english: Sometimes I amaze even myself.
translation: 有时候连我自己都感到惊讶。

english: Ok, hand 'em over.
translation: 好，把它们给我。

english: Here you go...
translation: 给你……

english: Excellent. I'll see you outside the Colony. Don't forget to arm yourself - it could be dangerous!
translation: 太好了。我在殖民地外面等你。别忘了武装自己——可能会很危险！

english: Right, 5 Blood runes, 10 Lava runes and 10 Mist runes.
translation: 好的，5个血符文、10个熔岩符文和10个雾符文。

english: You asked me to get some runes.
translation: 你让我去拿些符文。

english: Okay, hand 'em over.
translation: 好的，把它们给我。

english: I'm guessing you haven't got them all, have you?
translation: 我猜你还没凑齐，对吧？

english: Well, do get a move on! I need 5 Blood runes, 10 Lava runes and 10 Mist runes, otherwise I'll be no use in a fight.
translation: 嗯，快点！我需要5个血符文、10个熔岩符文和10个雾符文，否则我在战斗中派不上用场。

english: Hello again, [player name]! I must thank you for persuading me to come - I feel quite invigorated in the sea breeze!
translation: 又见面了，[player name]！我必须感谢你说服我来——海风吹得我精神焕发！

english: Oh - er - good. Well, Herman must be inside the Colony now, so we should probably go in.
translation: 哦——呃——很好。嗯，赫尔曼现在应该在殖民地里面，我们大概该进去了。

english: Are you sure you're ready? I can hear creatures moving around in the trees, and we might have to do some fighting soon.
translation: 你确定准备好了吗？我能听到树丛里有生物在移动，我们可能很快就要战斗了。

english: I'm ready to fight.
translation: 我准备好战斗了。

english: Excellent. I think this little tunnel will lead us there...
translation: 太好了。我想这条小隧道会带我们到那里……

english: I should go and get ready first.
translation: 我应该先去准备一下。

english: Yes, better safe than sorry! We can go through this little tunnel when you're ready.
translation: 是的，安全总比后悔好！你准备好了我们就可以穿过这条小隧道。

english: Just hop into the tunnel when you're ready.
translation: 准备好了就跳进隧道吧。

english: Wait - I think something's coming!
translation: 等等——我觉得有东西来了！

english: First fight, talk later!
translation: 先打再说！

english: Blast - I'm out of runes!
translation: 该死——我的符文用完了！

english: Got them all!
translation: 全部干掉了！

english: Well, it all seems to have gone smoothly so far!
translation: 嗯，到目前为止一切似乎都很顺利！

english: Yes, we're both still alive.
translation: 是的，我们都还活着。

english: Please go and tell Herman I'm here. Someone's sure to know where to find him.
translation: 请去告诉赫尔曼我来了。肯定有人知道他在哪里。

english: Ah, [player name]! Herman told me to expect you. You'll find him in his office by the eastern wall of the Colony.
translation: 啊，[player name]！赫尔曼跟我说过你会来。他在殖民地东墙边的办公室里，你去找他吧。

english: Thanks I'll go there now.
translation: 谢谢，我现在就去。

english: So, [player name]! I did hear from Herr Caranos that you were to our Colony coming. The Director in his office is waiting for you.
translation: 所以，[player name]！我确实从卡拉诺斯先生那里听说你要来我们殖民地。主管正在他的办公室等你。

english: Thanks, I'll go there now.
translation: 谢谢，我现在就去。

english: No way can I send items to bank for you with great big trolls outside! You save Colony, then Arnold open bank for you.
translation: 外面有那些大巨魔在，我怎么可能帮你把东西送到银行！你先拯救殖民地，然后阿诺德再为你开银行。

english: I not have spare stuff to trade with you now. Maybe we trade after you save Colony, ja?
translation: 我现在没有多余的东西可以跟你交易。也许等你拯救了殖民地之后我们再交易，好吗？

english: No way can I let you collect stuffsies with great big trolls outside! You save Colony, then Arnold help you.
translation: 外面有那些大巨魔在，我怎么可能让你收集东西！你先拯救殖民地，然后阿诺德再帮你。

english: That thing broken. Arnold fix it when Colony all safe.
translation: 那东西坏了。等殖民地安全了，阿诺德会修好它。

english: Finally you've arrived! Did you bring the Wise Old Man?
translation: 你终于来了！你把老智者带来了吗？

english: Indeed, I am here!
translation: 没错，我就在这里！

english: Excellent! You have no idea how grateful I am!
translation: 太好了！你不知道我有多感激！

english: Talking of gratitude, I believe you mentioned some kind of reward...
translation: 说到感激，我记得你提过某种奖励……

english: Reward? Well... we've got to discuss the Colony's defences now. Perhaps you could go and make yourself useful around the Colony? I'm sure my brother, Franklin, could do with a bit of help. Arnold, the storemaster, said he needed an extra pair of hands too. He's in one of the big storage sheds.
translation: 奖励？嗯……我们现在得讨论殖民地的防御问题。也许你可以去殖民地周围转转，看看有什么能帮忙的？我弟弟富兰克林肯定需要帮手。仓库管理员阿诺德也说需要多一双手。他在一个大储物棚里。

english: Ok, I help out, then I get a reward?
translation: 好吧，我帮忙，然后就能拿到奖励了？

english: Yes, yes... now please excuse us.
translation: 是的是的……现在请让我们单独待会儿。

english: Yoohoo to you two!
translation: 哟呵，你们两位！

english: [player name]? Have you helped Franklin and Arnold yet?
translation: [player name]？你帮过富兰克林和阿诺德了吗？

english: Please do so!
translation: 请去帮忙吧！

english: I'm on the case, no problems.
translation: 我这就去办，没问题。

english: That's what I like to hear. Off you go...
translation: 我就爱听这话。去吧……

english: Herman said you wanted a hand with something.
translation: 赫尔曼说你需要帮忙。

english: Well, yes, I do. Are you any good at smithing?
translation: 嗯，是的，我需要。你擅长锻造吗？

english: Oh yes, I'm quite an expert.
translation: 哦，是的，我相当在行。

english: Ok, we'll see. Now, the trolls managed to smash part of our western wall earlier today. We need 5 sheets of iron to patch it.
translation: 好吧，我们看看。今天早些时候，巨魔把我们西墙的一部分砸坏了。我们需要5块铁板来修补它。

english: Won't iron go all rusty with all the salt water around here?
translation: 铁在这里不会被周围的盐水锈蚀吗？

english: Yes, but it'll do for a few weeks, and we haven't the time or materials to do a proper job just now.
translation: 会，但能撑几个星期，我们现在没时间也没材料好好修。

english: Alrighty. So where do I get sheets of iron?
translation: 好吧。那我去哪里弄铁板？

english: I've got a press in my shred. You can use it to heat up some iron bars and roll them into sheets. You'll need to fill its firebox first - stick some logs in it and light them.
translation: 我的棚屋里有一台金属压机。你可以用它加热铁条并轧成铁板。你得先填满它的火箱——放些原木进去点燃。

english: When you've got 5 iron sheets, hammer them onto the damage wall.
translation: 等你有了5块铁板，就用锤子把它们钉到破损的墙壁上。

english: Why do I need to heat the bars? I've been cold- working metal all my life, and I've never bothered heating it.
translation: 为什么我需要加热铁条？我这辈子一直在冷加工金属，从来不用加热。

english: How odd! I'd have expected all your products to be horribly brittle.
translation: 真奇怪！我还以为你做的所有东西都会脆得可怕呢。

english: I guess I'm just talented.
translation: 我想我只是天赋异禀吧。

english: Anyway, take this tinderbox and get to work.
translation: 总之，拿着这个火绒盒，开始干活吧。

english: Anyway, off you go.
translation: 总之，去吧。

english: It's not hot enough to work at the moment.
translation: 现在温度不够，没法工作。

english: The firebox is at the other end of the machine!
translation: 火箱在机器的另一头！

english: I should probably try putting metal bars into the OTHER end of the machine.
translation: 我大概应该试着把金属条放进机器的另一头。

english: I can't remember what you wanted me to do.
translation: 我不记得你让我做什么了。

english: Put some logs into the metal press in my shed, and light them. Then feed 5 iron bars into the press to roll them into sheets. After that, you'll need to hammer them onto the damaged wall.
translation: 往我棚子里的金属压机里放些原木，然后点燃。接着喂5根铁条进压机，把它们轧成铁板。之后，你需要用锤子把它们钉到破损的墙壁上。

english: It's already lit!
translation: 已经点着了！

english: I'm not putting that into the press! I don't want to break it!
translation: 我可不会把那东西放进压机！我不想弄坏它！

english: Well, the press is working now, but I still have to patch [the broken sections/[Amount] more bits of wall/the last piece of wall].
translation: 嗯，压机现在能用了，但我还得修补[the broken sections/[Amount]段墙壁/最后一段墙壁]。

english: I hope you don't have too much trouble with that press.
translation: 我希望你用那台压机不会太麻烦。

english: Also I think I need a hammer.
translation: 另外，我想我需要一把锤子。

english: Hammer? Not a problem - here's mine.
translation: 锤子？没问题——用我的。

english: I think you'll need to make [[Amount] more/another] iron [sheets/sheet] first.
translation: 我想你得先再做[[Amount]块/一块]铁[sheets/sheet]。

english: At least you've got enough iron sheets.
translation: 至少你的铁板够了。

english: YAAAAARRRRGH!
translation: 呀啊啊啊啊啊！

english: I don't think that will help.
translation: 我觉得那没用。

english: This bit of wall is fine. I don't need to mess around with it now.
translation: 这段墙壁没问题。我现在不需要动它。

english: You should be sticking the sheets to the wall, not to me!
translation: 你应该把铁板钉在墙上，而不是钉在我身上！

english: I've fixed all 5 bits of wall.
translation: 我已经修好了全部5段墙壁。

english: Wonderful - thank you very much! Now you can turn your full attention to help Arnold...
translation: 太好了——非常感谢！现在你可以全力去帮阿诺德了……

english: Oh, and if you've got any of those iron sheets left, I'll be happy to buy them off you once the Colony is safe.
translation: 哦，如果你还有剩下的铁板，等殖民地安全了，我很乐意从你那里买下来。

english: This is turning into a lot of work...
translation: 这活越来越多了……

english: Wonderful - thank you very much! You should return to my brother, Herman, and tell him you've finished helping me and Arnold.
translation: 太好了——非常感谢！你应该回到我哥哥赫尔曼那里，告诉他你已经帮完我和阿诺德了。

english: Oh good. Now maybe Herman will give me that reward he mentioned!
translation: 哦，好。现在也许赫尔曼会给我他提过的奖励了！

english: You come to speak to me, [player name]?
translation: 你是来找我说话的吗，[player name]？

english: Yes... Herman said you needed me to do something?
translation: 是的……赫尔曼说你需要我做点什么？

english: Ah, that is good. I the storemaster am for this Piscatoris Fishing Colony, and our stores are - ahah - not so good. Indeed, our stores contain not a bit of food!
translation: 啊，那很好。我是这个皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼殖民地的仓库管理员，而我们的库存——啊哈——可不怎么样。确实，我们的仓库里一点食物都没有了！

english: This a catastrophe may become, as difficult it may be to fish while the trolls outside are waiting, and our bellies soon shall rumble loudly!
translation: 这可能会变成一场灾难，因为外面有巨魔等着，钓鱼很困难，而我们的肚子很快就会饿得咕咕叫！

english: But now you come here to help Arnold! A good and sturdy warrior you must be indeed to have entered our Colony in these times! So you can the fishing do for us!
translation: 但现在你来了，来帮阿诺德！你肯定是个优秀又强壮的战士，才能在这样的时候进入我们的殖民地！所以你可以为我们钓鱼！

english: You want me to catch fish?
translation: 你想让我去抓鱼？

english: Ja, this is so. But the fish must then be stored, or stinking rotten they become! So the fish you bring must be shiny fresh!
translation: 是的，就是这样。但鱼必须储存起来，否则它们会发臭腐烂！所以你带来的鱼必须是闪闪发亮的新鲜货！

english: Where do I get fresh fish?
translation: 我去哪里弄鲜鱼？

english: The monkfish in these waters swim, this is why Herr Caranos build his Colony here.
translation: 僧侣鱼在这些水域里游动，这就是卡拉诺斯先生把殖民地建在这里的原因。

english: You go catch 5 fresh monkfish from sea over in north- west corner. If you bring stinking old monkfish, Arnold know about it, and Arnold not take them!
translation: 你去西北角的海里抓5条新鲜的僧侣鱼。如果你带来发臭的老僧侣鱼，阿诺德会知道，而且阿诺德不会收！

english: I'll need a net or something like that.
translation: 我需要一张网之类的东西。

english: Ja, is not a problem.
translation: 是的，没问题。

english: Ok, five fresh monkfish coming up.
translation: 好的，五条新鲜的僧侣鱼，马上就来。

english: Big thanks, [player name]. When Colony safe, Herman reward you good.
translation: 非常感谢，[player name]。等殖民地安全了，赫尔曼会好好奖励你的。

english: I think I should maybe catch my own.
translation: 我想我或许应该自己去抓。

english: You bring me fresh monkfish?
translation: 你给我带新鲜的僧侣鱼来了吗？

english: No, I haven't got any.
translation: 没有，我一条都没有。

english: Well, you go to sea at north-west corner of Colony and catch nice fresh monkfish for Arnold, ja?
translation: 那么，你去殖民地的西北角出海，给阿诺德抓些新鲜的僧侣鱼，好吗？

english: I've got this fish...
translation: 我抓到这条鱼了……

english: That not monkfish! Go to sea at north-west corner of Colony and catch MONKFISH!
translation: 那不是僧侣鱼！去殖民地西北角的海里抓僧侣鱼！

english: Arnold, I've got some monkfish for you.
translation: 阿诺德，我给你带了些僧侣鱼。

english: This? This fresh, but it no good to me raw! You go use range in kitchen!
translation: 这个？这是新鲜的，但生吃可不行！你去用厨房里的炉灶！

english: Ah, lovely fresh monkfish straight from the sea! Now you bring me [amount] more, ja?
translation: 啊，刚从海里捕来的新鲜僧侣鱼！现在你再给我带[amount]条来，好吗？

english: This is superb, [player name]! Now I store these carefully, and you go help little Frankie.
translation: 太棒了，[player name]！现在我把这些小心储存起来，你去帮帮小弗兰基。

english: This is superb, [player name]! Now I store these carefully, and you go tell Herr Caranos.
translation: 太棒了，[player name]！现在我把这些小心储存起来，你去告诉卡拉诺斯先生。

english: Oh good, maybe he'll reward me now.
translation: 哦，好，也许他现在会奖励我了。

english: Your fresh monkfish superb! But now you go help little Frankie, ja?
translation: 你的新鲜僧侣鱼太棒了！但现在你去帮帮小弗兰基，好吗？

english: Now you done helping me and Frankie, you go see what Herr Caranos want next.
translation: 现在你帮完我和弗兰基了，去看看卡拉诺斯先生接下来想做什么。

english: Now you've finished helping me and Arnold, you should see if Herman's got anything else for you to do.
translation: 现在你帮完我和阿诺德了，你应该去看看赫尔曼还有没有别的事要你做。

english: I've finished helping Franklin and Arnold now.
translation: 我现在已经帮完富兰克林和阿诺德了。

english: Or - er - that's good...
translation: 或者——呃——那很好……

english: Does this mean you're going to reward me now?
translation: 这是不是意味着你现在要给我奖励了？

english: There's something else I need you to do first.
translation: 还有别的事我需要你先做。

english: There always is.
translation: 总是这样。

english: Well, the Wise Old Man and I have discussed the situation, and he's come up with a plan...
translation: 嗯，老智者和我讨论了一下情况，他想出了一个计划……

english: Yes, that's right. The sheer number of trolls means that the best hope for the Colony is to gather our forces and wipe out all the trolls at once.
translation: 是的，没错。巨魔的数量太多了，殖民地最大的希望就是集结我们的力量，一次性消灭所有巨魔。

english: Well, that sounds like a nice plan. One big fight, no more trolls.
translation: 嗯，听起来是个好计划。打一场大仗，巨魔就没了。

english: There's a slight problem, though.
translation: 不过，有个小问题。

english: Yes, with the bit about gathering our forces.
translation: 是的，就是关于集结我们力量的那部分。

english: Let me guess - you haven't got any forces to gather!
translation: 让我猜猜——你们根本没有力量可以集结！

english: I sent most of the colonists away for their own safety when the trolls started attacking the Colony.
translation: 当巨魔开始攻击殖民地时，为了安全起见，我把大多数殖民者都送走了。

english: So what you need to do, [player name], is to fetch us an army!
translation: 所以你需要做的，[player name]，就是给我们找来一支军队！

english: In the Wizards' Guild in Yanille, Wizard Frumscone always seems to have a limitless supply of zombies and similar creatures. If you can persuade him to lend us an army, we should be able to defeat these trolls.
translation: 在亚尼勒城的魔法师公会里，法师弗鲁姆斯科恩似乎总有无限的僵尸和类似生物供应。如果你能说服他借给我们一支军队，我们应该能击败这些巨魔。

english: Ok, so I just need to go see Wizard Frumscone in Yanille?
translation: 好，所以我只需要去亚尼勒城见法师弗鲁姆斯科恩？

english: Yes, please hurry!
translation: 是的，请快一点！

english: Hello, old man.
translation: 你好，老人家。

english: [player name] - have you brought an army?
translation: [player name]——你带军队来了吗？

english: No, I'm afraid I haven't asked Wizard Frumscone yet.
translation: 不，我恐怕还没问法师弗鲁姆斯科恩。

english: Do get a move on, [player name]!
translation: 快点行动吧，[player name]！

english: What was it you asked me to do?
translation: 你之前让我做什么来着？

english: Go to the Wizards' Guild in Yanille and ask Wizard Frumscone to lend us an army to save the Colony!
translation: 去亚尼勒城的魔法师公会，请法师弗鲁姆斯科恩借给我们一支军队来拯救殖民地！

english: Right, I know it was something like that.
translation: 对，我就知道是类似的事。

english: Thanks a lot for your help earlier, but I have a lot to do, so please excuse me...
translation: 非常感谢你之前的帮助，但我还有很多事要做，所以请原谅我……

english: It good to see you, [player name], but many things I have to do with lovely fresh monkfish you bring me earlier.
translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]，但我还有很多事要用你之前带来的新鲜僧侣鱼来做。

english: Hello. I need your help with something...
translation: 你好。我需要你帮忙做点事……

english: Oho? Very well, young man, what can I do for you?
translation: 哦呵？很好，年轻人，我能为你做什么？

english: The Piscatoris Fishing Colony, somewhere north of the Gnome Stronghold, is under attack by sea trolls, and they've sent me to ask for an army.
translation: 皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼殖民地位于地精要塞以北某处，正遭受海巨魔的攻击，他们派我来请求一支军队。

english: An army, heh? But I haven't GOT an army!
translation: 一支军队，呵？但我可没有军队！

english: They said you might lend us some of your zombies.
translation: 他们说你可能会借给我们一些你的僵尸。

english: What? This is a combat training facility, not a library! My magic zombies are not for loan.
translation: 什么？这里是战斗训练设施，不是图书馆！我的魔法僵尸不外借。

english: So you can't help the Colony?
translation: 所以你帮不了殖民地？

english: I'm jolly well not lending them an army! If I did that for you, I'd have to do that for everyone, and I'd never get a moment's peace again!
translation: 我绝对不会借给他们军队！如果我为你这么做，就得为每个人都这么做，那我就永远不得安宁了！

english: So what should I tell the Colony? They've got to give up all their work because you won't help?
translation: 那我该怎么跟殖民地说？他们必须放弃所有工作，就因为你拒绝帮忙？

english: Actually that does seem rather harsh...
translation: 实际上这听起来确实有点苛刻……

english: I have an idea!
translation: 我有个主意！

english: Now, you mustn't breathe a word of this to Zavistic or Disentor upstairs, but I know a man who could help you get an army.
translation: 听着，你绝不能对楼上的扎维斯提克或迪森托透露一个字，但我认识一个人，他能帮你弄到一支军队。

english: Great! Is he a Guild wizard too?
translation: 太好了！他也是公会魔法师吗？

english: No, his work is completely different. He's a necromancer.
translation: 不，他的工作完全不同。他是个死灵法师。

english: Necromancy? I don't want anything to do with that!
translation: 死灵法术？我可不想跟那沾边！

english: He's not going to have you doing any of the actual spellcasting for it. You'll probably just have to collect some weird item from him and take it to the Colony.
translation: 他不会让你亲自施法的。你大概只需要从他那里收集一些奇怪的东西，然后带到殖民地。

english: I don't know if I still want to do this.
translation: 我不知道还想不想继续做这个。

english: If you don't want to continue the quest, just walk away and think no more about it. But I'm sure you won't have to do anything evil or unnatural yourself.
translation: 如果你不想继续任务，那就走开，别再想了。但我相信你自己不必做任何邪恶或非自然的事。

english: So what's it to be?
translation: 那么你决定如何？

english: Enough of this - I'm off.
translation: 够了——我走了。

english: Understandable. But if you ever change your mind, just come and ask me.
translation: 可以理解。但如果你改变主意，随时来找我。

english: I'll see what the necromancer needs me to do.
translation: 我去看看死灵法师需要我做什么。

english: Excellent. His name's Malignius Mortifer. You'll find him somewhere south of Falador.
translation: 太好了。他叫马利尼乌斯.莫蒂弗。你会在法拉多城以南某处找到他。

english: Can't I ask a different necromancer? There's one not so far away.
translation: 我不能找别的死灵法师吗？附近就有一个。

english: Hah! Necromancers aren't helpful people. I don't know of many - most guild wizards won't have anything to do with their practices. I think Malignius will help only because he loves showing off his powers.
translation: 哈！死灵法师可不是乐于助人的人。我认识的没几个——大多数公会魔法师都不愿与他们的做法有任何瓜葛。我觉得马利尼乌斯会帮忙，只是因为他喜欢炫耀自己的力量。

english: You said you knew a man who could help me save the Piscatoris Fishing Colony.
translation: 你说你认识一个能帮我拯救皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼殖民地的人。

english: Oh yes. Now, you mustn't mention this to Zavistic or Distentor, but he's a necromancer.
translation: 哦对。听着，你不能对扎维斯提克或迪森托提起这事，但他是个死灵法师。

english: [player name]? Have you spoken to Malignius Mortifer?
translation: [player name]？你跟马利尼乌斯.莫蒂弗谈过了吗？

english: I haven't asked him yet.
translation: 我还没问他。

english: He'll probably still be wandering around south of Falador whenever you do want to speak to him.
translation: 无论你什么时候想找他谈，他大概都还在法拉多城以南闲逛。

english: Now, you mustn't breathe a word of this to Zavistic or Distentor upstairs, but I know a man who could help you get an army.
translation: 现在，你绝不能向楼上的扎维斯提克或迪斯滕托透露一个字，但我认识一个人，他能帮你组建一支军队。

english: Oho? Very well, young lady, what can I do for you?
translation: 哦呵？很好，年轻女士，我能为你做什么？

english: Wizard Frumscone wouldn't help, but he told me where I could find a wizard who might help. I have to look for him just south of Falador.
translation: 法师弗鲁姆斯科恩不肯帮忙，但他告诉我在哪里可以找到一个可能帮忙的魔法师。我得去法拉多城以南找他。

english: By the way, where's the Wise Old Man gone?
translation: 顺便问一下，老智者去哪了？

english: He said he'd be back in a minute. But never mind him - go to Falador and talk to this wizard!
translation: 他说他马上回来。但别管他了——去法拉多城跟那个魔法师谈谈！

english: I need help with saving a fishing colony.
translation: 我需要帮助拯救一个钓鱼殖民地。

english: Not when you're dressed like that! I don't help Saradominist filth!
translation: 你穿成这样可不行！我不帮萨拉多民主义的渣滓！

english: Hahaha! You want MY help? HAHAHA!
translation: 哈哈哈！你想要我的帮助？哈哈哈！

english: ... um... The Piscatoris Fishing Colony needs an army to defend them against attacking trolls.
translation: ……嗯……皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼殖民地需要一支军队来抵御进攻的巨魔。

english: And of all the people in the world, you came to ask ME? HAHAHA!
translation: 世界上那么多人，你偏偏来问我？哈哈哈！

english: ... um... pretty please?
translation: ……嗯……求求你了？

english: Oh, I'll help! I'll give you GOOD help!
translation: 哦，我会帮忙的！我会给你“好”的帮助！

english: ... um... thanks, I think...
translation: ……嗯……谢谢，我想……

english: An army, eh? I can raise you a lovely army of the undead skeletal magi! That'd be just right, wouldn't it?
translation: 一支军队，嗯？我可以给你召唤一支可爱的亡灵骷髅法师军队！那正合适，对吧？

english: I'm not going to have to do anything... evil, am I?
translation: 我不会需要做什么……邪恶的事吧？

english: No, I'll keep the fun bits for myself. You'll just have to get a few things for me.
translation: 不，有趣的部分我自己留着。你只需要帮我弄几样东西。

english: Alright - what do you need?
translation: 好吧——你需要什么？

english: Firstly, I need 7 bones, the normal sort you get from people and small monsters.
translation: 首先，我需要7根骨头，就是那种从人和小怪物身上得到的普通骨头。

english: I have some here!
translation: 我这里有一些！

english: Hah! And I thought only necromancers and jogres carried bones around with them! Very well, hand 'em over.
translation: 哈！我还以为只有死灵法师和巨魔才会随身带着骨头呢！很好，把它们交出来。

english: What should I do now for the quest?
translation: 我现在该为任务做什么？

english: What was it you said you'd need to help me save the Colony?
translation: 你说你需要什么来帮我拯救殖民地来着？

english: Bones! I need bones, the normal sort you get from humans and small monsters. If you're having trouble, go to the highwaymen just north of here - they've got bones!
translation: 骨头！我需要骨头，从人类和小怪物身上得到的那种普通骨头。如果你找不到，就去北边的拦路强盗那里——他们有骨头！

english: Oh yes, how could I have forgotten?
translation: 哦对，我怎么会忘了？

english: Good. Now I need [Amount] more.
translation: 好。我现在还需要[Amount]根。

english: From the bones you have given me, I shall make bone seeds. These will contain the essence of your army. But you will need some way to carry the seeds.
translation: 用你给我的骨头，我会制作骨头种子。这些种子将包含你军队的精髓。但你需要某种方式来携带这些种子。

english: You must go to the Crafting Guild to ask the advice of the master crafters. There are quite a few of them there, and one of them's sure to help.
translation: 你必须去制作公会请教制作大师们的建议。那里有好几位大师，肯定有人会帮忙。

english: I doubt they'll let me in there without a brown apron.
translation: 我怀疑没有棕色围裙他们不会让我进去。

english: Here, take this one.
translation: 给你，拿着这个。

english: Can you spare me a brown apron so I can go to the Crafting Guild to ask the master crafters about transporting bone seeds?
translation: 你能给我一件棕色围裙吗？这样我就能去制作公会请教制作大师们关于运输骨头种子的事。

english: Yes, yes.
translation: 好的，好的。

english: What am I meant to be doing for the Colony?
translation: 我该为殖民地做什么？

english: Is there something wrong with your memory? I told you to go to the Crafting Guild to ask the master crafters for advice on transporting bone seeds.
translation: 你的记忆有问题吗？我告诉你去制作公会请教制作大师们关于运输骨头种子的建议。

english: Can you tell me anything about transporting bone seeds?
translation: 你能告诉我关于运输骨头种子的事吗？

english: Bone seeds? What are bone seeds?
translation: 骨头种子？什么是骨头种子？

english: A necromancer is going to bind the essence of an undead army into some bone seeds for me if I can get a container to carry them in.
translation: 一个死灵法师要帮我把一支亡灵军队的精魂绑定到一些骨头种子上，但我需要一个容器来装它们。

english: That's horrible - ask someone else!
translation: 太可怕了——找别人吧！

english: Woah dude! That's, like, some seriously maximum stuff you're talking.
translation: 哇哦老兄！你说的可是些超级厉害的东西。

english: But do you know what I should carry them in?
translation: 但你知道我该用什么装它们吗？

english: Yeah, you just need a pot with a lid. Do you know how to make pot lids?
translation: 知道，你只需要一个带盖子的罐子。你知道怎么做罐盖吗？

english: Yes, a woman called Tassie taught me.
translation: 知道，一个叫塔西的女人教过我。

english: Tassie Slipcast? She's one groovy lady.
translation: 塔西.斯利普卡斯特？她是个很棒的女士。

english: Yes, yes, very nice. So if I get a pot with a lid, I'll be able to carry bone seeds safely in it?
translation: 是的是的，很好。那么如果我弄到一个带盖子的罐子，就能安全地把骨头种子装在里面了？

english: Yeah, yeah. You need to chill out more, dude.
translation: 对对。你需要放松点，老兄。

english: What was it you said I needed for transporting bone seeds?
translation: 你说运输骨头种子需要什么来着？

english: A pot with a lid. Nothing more, nothing less.
translation: 一个带盖子的罐子。不多不少。

english: I've spoken to the master crafter about a container for transporting bone seeds.
translation: 我已经跟制作大师谈过运输骨头种子的容器了。

english: You can take that Saradominist attire off before you try speaking to me about your quest again!
translation: 你最好先把那身萨拉多明信徒的装束脱掉，再来跟我谈你的任务！

english: Ah, excellent. HAHAHA! Have you got such a container?
translation: 啊，太好了。哈哈哈！你有这样的容器吗？

english: No, I haven't got one.
translation: 不，我没有。

english: Then get one!
translation: 那就去弄一个！

english: I have raised you an army and bound them into bone seeds for you!
translation: 我已经为你召唤了一支军队，并把它们封入了骨头种子！

english: ... um... Thanks!
Don't mention it, it was fun! HAHAHA!
translation: 不客气，很有趣！哈哈哈！

english: Now I will seal the seeds into your pot.
translation: 现在我会把种子封进你的罐子里。

english: Thank you. So what do I do with them?

english: Take the pot to the Colony and open it! HAHAHA! Just don't open it before you get there.

english: Suppose I - ahem - need another one later?

english: Bring me another of these pots with a lid and I will give you more bone seeds.
translation: 再给我带一个这样的带盖罐子，我就给你更多骨头种子。

english: An army, eh? I can raise you a lovely army of undead skeletal magi! That'd be just right, wouldn't it?

english: I guess so, forgot to take notes did you? Well, listen carefully this time.

english: You will need to enchant a pair of secateurs. Only these can harm a Tanglefoot.

english: I bid you farewell for now, [player name].
translation: 那么，[player name]，我先告辞了。

english: One dark night, a brave band of magi loyal to the great Lord Zamorak stormed the Tower. Despite heavy losses, they fought their way up the levels until they reached the Library of all known RuneLore.
translation: 在一个漆黑的夜晚，一群效忠于伟大的萨莫拉克领主的勇敢法师突袭了那座塔。尽管损失惨重，他们仍一路杀上去，直到抵达了存放所有已知符文知识的图书馆。

english: Alas, they were trapped and could not steal the precious records. But before they could be defeated, the bravest of them took it upon himself to blast the writings into nothingness, destroying the Library.
translation: 唉，他们被困住了，无法偷走那些珍贵的记录。但在被击败之前，他们中最勇敢的一人毅然将那些文字炸成了虚无，摧毁了图书馆。

english: The ensuing fire raced through the Tower, and none escaped its fury. Some say that Lord Zamorak himself fanned the flames to ensure the destruction of his enemies!
translation: 随后燃起的大火席卷了整座塔，无人能逃脱其怒火。有人说，是萨莫拉克领主亲自煽动火焰，以确保他的敌人被彻底毁灭！

english: Certainly not while you're dressed like that!
translation: 你穿成这样当然不行！

english: You will need a pair of secateurs, you will also need to gather a bunch of grapes, an uncut ruby and some Jogre bones.

english: You will need a pair of secateurs, you will also need to gather an uncut diamond, a raw cave eel and some edible seaweed.
translation: 你需要一把修枝剪，还需要收集一颗未切割的钻石、一条生洞穴鳗和一些食用海藻。

english: You will need a pair of secateurs, you will also need to gather a fat snail, some Red spiders eggs and a slimy eel.
translation: 你需要一把修枝剪，还需要收集一只生肥蜗牛肉、一些红蜘蛛卵和一条黏滑鳗鱼。

english: You will need a pair of secateurs, you will also need to gather an Avantoe herb, an Irit leaf and a Blue dragon scale.
translation: 你需要一把修枝剪，还需要收集一株阿凡托草、一片伊瑞特叶和一片蓝龙鳞。

english: All that knowledge was lost, but your efforts on behalf of my colleagues have not been wasted! Once again, the forces of Zamorak can create unlimited runestones! May the world cower in its boots!
translation: 那些知识全都遗失了，但你为我同僚们所做的努力没有白费！萨莫拉克的势力再次能够创造无限的符文石了！让世界在我们的脚下颤抖吧！

english: Now you fetch me one more.
translation: 现在，再给我拿一个来。

english: How about if you go away and stop bothering me?
translation: 你走开别烦我，怎么样？

english: Now you fetch me two more.
translation: 现在，再给我拿两个来。

english: Your confidence exceeds your experience.
translation: 你的自信超过了你的经验。

english: Perhaps one day you shall learn to summon creatures to your side, but my own work is of a different sort.
translation: 也许有一天你会学会召唤生物到你身边，但我自己的工作是另一种类型。

english: Not just now, [player name], but maybe later. If you bring me a pot with a lid, of course!
translation: 现在不行，[player name]，也许以后吧。当然，前提是你给我带个带盖子的罐子来！

english: All that knowledge was lost, and has never yet been re- discovered. Still, the power of magic remains in the world, and we who dedicate our lives to its study may yet perform great works...
translation: 那些知识全都失传了，至今未被重新发现。不过，魔法的力量依然存在于世间，而我们这些将其毕生奉献于研究的人或许还能成就伟业……

english: I can't exactly offer to help - you don't have room to carry one.
translation: 我实在没法帮忙——你没地方拿一个。

english: Now you fetch me six more.
translation: 现在，再给我拿六个来。

english: Nope, not while your bag's full.
translation: 不，你的包满了可不行。

english: HAHAHA! Wonderful things, my friend, wonderful things!
translation: 哈哈哈！好东西，我的朋友，好东西！

english: Good. Now I need one more.
translation: 好。现在我还需要一个。

english: Now you fetch me five more.
translation: 现在，再给我拿五个来。

english: Now you fetch me three more.
translation: 现在，再给我拿三个来。

english: How exactly were you planning to carry it? You haven't got room in your pack!
translation: 你究竟打算怎么拿？你的包里可没地方了！

english: Now you fetch me four more.
translation: 现在，再给我拿四个来。

english: Who are you trying to fool? That's not from the grave at Draynor Manor!
translation: 你想骗谁？那可不是德雷诺庄园坟墓里的东西！

english: I've put some more bone seeds in it. You can go back to your friends now.
translation: 我在里面又放了些骨头种子。你现在可以回到你的朋友们那里去了。

english: That was silly. Still if you have another pot with a lid, I can give you more bone seeds.
translation: 真傻。不过如果你还有另一个带盖子的罐子，我可以再给你一些骨头种子。

english: All that knowledge was lost, but those magi loyal to Zamorak have not ceased to seek it.
translation: 那些知识全都遗失了，但那些忠于萨莫拉克的法师们从未停止寻找它。

english: Rubbish foreign magic has no place in this land! I intend to master Necromancy in my own way.
translation: 垃圾般的外来魔法在这片土地上没有立足之地！我打算用自己的方式掌握死灵法术。

english: Good. Now I need two more.
translation: 好。现在我还需要两个。

english: One day we will regain the power to create unlimited runestones. Let the world beware!
translation: 总有一天，我们会重新获得创造无限符文石的力量。让世界小心点！

english: Good. Now I need five more.
translation: 好。现在我还需要五个。

english: Good. Now I need four more.
translation: 好。现在我还需要四个。

english: Good. Now I need three more.
translation: 好。现在我还需要三个。

english: Good. Now I need six more.
translation: 好。现在我还需要六个。

english: Herman tells me you've been fetching us an army.
translation: 赫尔曼告诉我你一直在为我们找军队。

english: Something like that!
translation: 差不多吧！

english: Interesting. I didn't know magic could do that.
translation: 有意思。我以前不知道魔法还能做到这种事。

english: You learn something new every day.
translation: 每天都能学到新东西。

english: [player name]! I hear you fetch mighty army for us!
translation: [player name]！我听说你为我们找来了一支强大的军队！

english: You go take them to Herr Caranos quickly!
translation: 你快带他们去找赫尔曼.卡拉诺斯！

english: Yes, I've got it here!
translation: 是的，我拿到了！

english: You've got what?
translation: 你拿到了什么？

english: The army's in this pot!
translation: 军队就在这个罐子里！

english: No, really, the wizard told me he'd put bone seeds in this pot, and when I opened it the army would come forth from the bone seeds.
translation: 不，真的，魔法师告诉我他会把骨头种子放在这个罐子里，等我打开罐子，军队就会从骨头种子中出来。

english: Frumscone gave you bone seeds?
translation: 弗鲁姆斯科恩给了你骨头种子？

english: Oh... um...
Hmmmph. I don't much like the sound of this. I certainly won't be sending anyone to Frumscone for help again!
translation: 哼。我可不太喜欢这事。我绝对不会再派人去找弗鲁姆斯科恩帮忙了！

english: Well... it wasn't exactly...
translation: 呃……其实也不完全是……

english: You can talk about that later! Now we've got an army we can get on with beating the trolls!
translation: 这些事以后再说！现在我们有了军队，可以继续去揍巨魔了！

english: Well, I suppose so. [player name], this could be VERY dangerous. Do you feel ready to fight?
translation: 好吧，我想也是。[player name]，这可能非常危险。你准备好战斗了吗？

english: Aren't you going to do the fighting?
translation: 不是你去战斗吗？

english: Yes, of course. But you, my trusty sidekick, are in this adventure with me, and if I'm going forth into battle, you should make sure you're ready too.
translation: 是的，当然了。但你，我可靠的搭档，和我一起参与这次冒险。如果我要上战场，你也应该确保自己准备好了。

english: I'm ready. Let's fight!
translation: 我准备好了。开打吧！

english: Good. May this, my final adventure, end well!
translation: 好。但愿这最后一次冒险能有个好结局！

english: I'd like to get some stuff together first.
translation: 我想先准备一些东西。

english: Come back to us as soon as you're ready.
translation: 准备好就尽快回来找我们。

english: The trolls are dead!
translation: 巨魔死了！

english: They weren't very tough.
translation: 它们不怎么厉害。

english: Oh... dear...
translation: 哦……天啊……

english: Leave this to me...
translation: 交给我吧……

english: Aahh, that was fun.
translation: 啊，真有意思。

english: How did you do that?
translation: 你是怎么做到的？

english: Talent, my dear.
translation: 天赋，亲爱的。

english: I... can't... move... [player name], you must fight this for me...
translation: 我……动不了……[player name]，你必须替我战斗……

english: Now I've killed that THING, Herman's sure to reward me!
translation: 现在我杀了那个家伙，赫尔曼肯定会奖励我！

english: You kick big troll queenie pretty hard, ja?
translation: 你把巨魔女王打得很惨，是吧？

english: Yes, I don't think you'll have any more trouble with the trolls in future.
translation: 是的，我想以后你们不会再被巨魔找麻烦了。

english: Piscatoris Colony owe you big-time for your help. You go see Hermie - maybe he got something for you.
translation: 皮斯卡托里斯殖民地欠你一个大人情，多谢你的帮助。你去找赫尔米吧——也许他会给你点东西。

english: 'Hermie'?
translation: '赫尔米'？

english: Herr Herman Caranos. I call him 'Hermie' when him not listening. Sometimes I call him worse things, but not today.
translation: 赫尔曼.卡拉诺斯先生。他不在的时候我就叫他‘赫尔米’。有时候我还叫他更难听的，不过今天就算了。

english: Thanking you kindly, but no. I not have need for that now.
translation: 多谢你的好意，不过不用了。我现在不需要那个。

english: Ah, lovely fresh monkfish straight from the sea! Now you bring me one more, ja?
translation: 啊，刚从海里捕来的新鲜僧侣鱼！现在你再给我带一条来，好吗？

english: A nice little net for monkfish Arnold got, but you need space to hold it, ja?
translation: 阿诺德弄了个抓僧侣鱼的小网，但你得有地方装它才行，对吧？

english: Ah, lovely fresh monkfish straight from the sea! Now you bring me two more, ja?
translation: 啊，刚从海里捕来的新鲜僧侣鱼！现在你再给我带两条来，好吗？

english: Ah, lovely fresh monkfish straight from the sea! Now you bring me three more, ja?
translation: 啊，刚从海里捕来的新鲜僧侣鱼！现在你再给我带三条来，好吗？

english: You go speak to Hermie first, ja?
translation: 你先去找赫尔米谈谈，好吗？

english: Ah, lovely fresh monkfish straight from the sea! Now you bring me four more, ja?
translation: 啊，刚从海里捕来的新鲜僧侣鱼！现在你再给我带四条来，好吗？

english: This not fresh, this is stinking old monkfish! You go catch your own fresh monkfish in sea at north- west corner of Colony.
translation: 这不新鲜，这是发臭的老僧侣鱼！你去殖民地西北角的海里自己抓新鲜僧侣鱼吧。

english: You think I can be banker in middle of battle? You gotta be loco!
translation: 你觉得我能在战斗中当银行职员？你疯了吧！

english: You think I can trade in middle of battle? You gotta be loco!
translation: 你觉得我能在战斗中做交易？你疯了吧！

english: You getting ready to fight trolls for us?
translation: 你准备好帮我们打巨魔了吗？

english: Aaargh - great big trolls coming for us!
translation: 啊——大巨魔朝我们来了！

english: Ah, that is nice - always I like to chat, but Herr Caranos tell me to get back to work!
translation: 啊，真不错——我一直喜欢聊天，但卡兰诺斯先生叫我回去干活！

english: Ja, ja, maybe. Or maybe he too old, he no good!
translation: 是，是，也许吧。或者他太老了，不中用了！

english: Ho ho, this should be well worth seeing...
translation: 呵呵，这应该很值得一看……

english: I say, you certainly gave that Troll Queen a good thrashing!
translation: 我说，你确实把那巨魔女王狠狠揍了一顿！

english: Yes, no more trouble from her.
translation: 是的，她不会再捣乱了。

english: I think Herman would like to talk to you in his office. We all owe you so much.
translation: 我想赫尔曼想在他的办公室跟你谈谈。我们都欠你太多了。

english: I've got a press in my shed. You can use it to heat up some iron bars and roll them into sheets. You'll need to fill its firebox first - stick some logs in it and light them.
translation: 我的棚屋里有一台金属压机。你可以用它加热铁条并轧成铁板。你得先填满它的火箱——放些原木进去点燃。

english: When you've got 5 iron sheets, hammer them onto the damaged wall.
translation: 当你有了5块铁板后，用锤子把它们钉在破损的墙壁上。

english: Wonderful - thank you very much! Now you can turn your full attention to helping Arnold...
translation: 太好了——非常感谢！现在你可以全力去帮阿诺德了……

english: Here, you can have this one.
translation: 来，这个给你。

english: Thanks for helping me patch that broken wall.
translation: 谢谢你帮我修补那堵破损的墙壁。

english: Oh yes, I heard he was trying to stock up on supplies in case this becomes a siege.
translation: 哦，是的，我听说他正试图囤积补给品，以防这里被围困。

english: Oi - leave my press alone!
translation: 喂——别碰我的压机！

english: I'm not letting anyone through these gates while there are still trolls out there.
translation: 只要外面还有巨魔，我就不让任何人通过这扇大门。

english: I've got one of those, but you don't have room to hold it.
translation: 我有一个，但你装不下。

english: You'll need to make another iron sheet first.
translation: 你得先再做一块铁板。

english: No thanks, I don't want that.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我不想要那个。

english: You'll need to make a couple more iron sheets first.
translation: 你得先再做几块铁板。

english: Light the firebox of the press in my shed. Then feed 5 iron bars into the press to roll them into sheets. After that, you'll need to hammer them onto the damaged sections of the wall.
translation: 点燃我棚屋里压机的火箱。然后把5根铁条放进压机轧成铁板。之后，你得用锤子把它们钉在墙上破损的地方。

english: You've got quite a bit of metal-rolling to do first.
translation: 你得先轧不少金属才行。

english: I'd give you mine, but your pack is full.
translation: 我本想给你我的，但你的背包满了。

english: I think you'll need to make three more iron sheets first.
translation: 我想你得先再做三块铁板。

english: I don't really want that just now. Perhaps we could discuss this once the Colony is safe.
translation: 我现在不太想要那个。也许等殖民地安全了我们再谈这个。

english: The trolls are attacking!
translation: 巨魔在进攻！

english: Are you ready to fight yet?
translation: 你准备好战斗了吗？

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you 100 gp.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你想把那些铁板卖给我吗？我给你100金币。

english: Well yes, that's what Herman told me. But he does look a little old for that kind of thing.
translation: 嗯，是的，赫尔曼是这么告诉我的。但他看起来做那种事有点老了。

english: That might be for the best.
translation: 那也许是最好的选择。

english: Good, good. Here, have a tinderbox.
translation: 好，好。来，给你一个火绒盒。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you 40 gp.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你想把那些铁板卖给我吗？我给你40金币。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you 440 gp.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你想把那些铁板卖给我吗？我给你440金币。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you 380 gp.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你想把那些铁板卖给我吗？我给你380金币。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you 120 gp.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你想把那些铁板卖给我吗？我给你120金币。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Were you wanting to sell me those iron sheets? I'd give you 300 gp.

english: I've defeated the Sea Troll Queen!
translation: 我已经打败了海巨魔女王！

english: Your fight was truly magnificent, [player name]! Congratulations!
translation: 你的战斗真是精彩绝伦，[player name]！恭喜你！

english: [player name], how can I ever thank you? You have saved my Fishing Colony from utter destruction!
translation: [player name]，我该怎么感谢你？你拯救了我的钓鱼殖民地，让它免于彻底毁灭！

english: Well, you mentioned something about a reward?
translation: 嗯，你提到过有什么奖励？

english: Of course, of course!
translation: 当然，当然！

english: I think you've earned a little something from me, too.
translation: 我想你也从我这里得到了一点回报。

english: Ooh, goody! Thanks, old man! Um... can I have your hat?
translation: 哦，好耶！谢谢，老头！呃……我能要你的帽子吗？

english: 'Old man'... yes, I am old. That creature nearly killed me - I have never been so close to defeat.
translation: '老头'……是啊，我老了。那生物差点杀了我——我从没离失败这么近过。

english: Aww, cheer up - we won! But can I have your hat as my reward?
translation: 啊，振作点——我们赢了！但我能要你的帽子作为奖励吗？

english: Yes, we won... YOU won... It is definitely time I retired.
translation: 是的，我们赢了……是你赢了……我确实该退休了。

english: So that's the end of your adventuring? Also, how about that hat of yours?
translation: 所以你的冒险生涯就到此为止了？还有，你的帽子呢？

english: Well, I'm sure I'll find some way to keep myself busy. But yes, this has been my last quest. My swan song.
translation: 嗯，我肯定会找点事让自己忙起来的。但没错，这是我最后一个任务了。我的天鹅曲。

english: It's been... nice working with you! It'd be even nicer if you'd give me that hat...
translation: 和你合作……很愉快！如果你把那顶帽子给我就更愉快了……

english: It's been a pleasure working with you too. Do pop in to see me in Draynor soon! I leave you with my blessing...
translation: 和你合作也很愉快。有空来德雷诺找我！我祝福你……

english: Oh, he's gone. I hope he enjoys his retirement.
translation: 哦，他走了。希望他退休生活愉快。

english: HE DIDN'T GIVE ME HIS HAT!
translation: 他没把帽子给我！

english: It's only a hat!
translation: 不就是一顶帽子嘛！

english: Anyway, you were going to reward me too?
translation: 对了，你也要奖励我吗？

english: Oh yes, of course! You are hereby welcome to visit the Piscatoris Fishing Colony at any time and make full use of our fishing spots!
translation: 哦，是的，当然！现在你随时欢迎来皮斯卡托里斯钓鱼殖民地参观，并充分利用我们的钓鱼点！

english: Why is it better to fish here than in Catherby or the Fishing Guild?
translation: 为什么在这里钓鱼比在凯瑟比镇或钓鱼公会更合适？

english: Ah, I'm glad you asked that! You see, this is the only known place where you can catch monkfish!
translation: 啊，很高兴你问这个！你看，这是已知唯一能钓到僧侣鱼的地方！

english: Ok, so I can catch monkfish. Um... thanks?!
translation: 好吧，所以我能钓僧侣鱼。呃……谢谢？！

english: Yes - there's good eating on a monkfish. They heal more health than the swordfish and lobsters most adventurers carry around, but they're easier to catch than sharks.
translation: 是的——僧侣鱼味道不错。它们比大多数冒险者随身携带的剑鱼和龙虾能恢复更多生命值，但又比鲨鱼更容易钓到。

english: I suppose that could be useful.
translation: 我想那可能有用。

english: Indeed! I'm sure Arnold will help you send your monkfish to your bank account. Also, seaweed accumulates in the nets down by the shore, which you might find useful. Franklin says it's much quicker than trying to gather it on Entrana.
translation: 确实！我相信阿诺德会帮你的僧侣鱼送到银行账户。另外，岸边的网里会积累海藻，你可能会觉得有用。富兰克林说这比在恩特纳岛收集快多了。

english: Maybe if I ever want to do glassblowing again...
translation: 也许哪天我想再做玻璃吹制的话……

english: Finally, I'd like to give you a little token of my thanks.
translation: 最后，我想送你一点小小的谢礼。

english: No, thank YOU!
translation: 不，谢谢你！

english: Trolls! They're attacking my Fishing Colony!
translation: 巨魔！他们在攻击我的钓鱼殖民地！

english: Oh - er - that's good...

english: Yes, I've done my research very carefully. I've always made important decisions based on careful analysis of whatever documents are available to me on the topic. For example, I chose this site for my Fishing Colony
translation: 是的，我的研究非常仔细。我总是根据对现有相关文件的仔细分析来做出重要决定。例如，我选择这个地方建立我的钓鱼殖民地

english: You seem fairly tough, but I don't think you know enough about diplomacy. I'd be sending you to beg a favour from a very important man.
translation: 你看起来相当强悍，但我觉得你对外交了解得还不够。我会派你去向一个非常重要的人请求帮助。

english: You seem fairly tough, but you're still not what I'm looking for.
translation: 你看起来相当强悍，但你仍然不是我想要找的人。

english: because records show this part of the sea to be a prime site for catching monkfish. I don't just fumble along like an amateur!

english: No, I'm sorry, but you simply don't have enough experience. I've got a LOT at stake here, and I can't afford to have an amateur getting in the way.
translation: 不，很抱歉，你的经验根本不够。我这里可是事关重大，我可不能冒险让一个业余人士来碍事。

english: Yes, that's very nice. Maybe if you had 100 I'd consider finding something for you to do.
translation: 是的，那很好。也许如果你有100点，我会考虑找点事给你做。

english: Now we've got an army we can get on with beating the trolls!
translation: 现在我们有了军队，可以继续痛打那些巨魔了！

english: You're still here, [player name]?
translation: 你还在这里啊，[player name]？

english: Reward? Well... I've got a lot to do at the moment. Perhaps you could go and make yourself useful around the Colony? I'm sure my brother, Franklin, could do with a bit of help. Arnold, the storemaster, said he
translation: 奖励？嗯……我现在有很多事要做。也许你可以去殖民地找点事做？我相信我弟弟富兰克林需要一些帮助。仓库管理员阿诺德说他

english: Please get on with it!
translation: 请快点行动吧！

english: needed an extra pair of hands too. He's in one of the big storage sheds.
translation: 也需要帮手。他在一个大仓库里。

english: Ah, [player name]. Is the Wise Old Man coming?
translation: 啊，[player name]。老智者要来了吗？

english: Yes, I can tell. Maybe if you had 100 quest points I'd consider finding something for you to do.
translation: 是的，我看得出来。也许如果你有100点任务点数，我会考虑找点事给你做。

english: Give him whatever he wants! Just bring him here!
translation: 他要什么就给他什么！只要把他带到这里来！

english: Yes, but I don't think you've got room to carry it.
translation: 是的，但我觉得你没地方放它。

english: Go and fetch the army! Go! Go! GO!
translation: 去把军队带来！快去！快！快！

english: What kind of army are you bringing? Oh, never mind, just do what it takes!
translation: 你要带什么样的军队来？哦，算了，不惜一切代价去做吧！

english: What? Oh, never mind, just do what it takes!
translation: 什么？哦，算了，不惜一切代价去做吧！

english: Then you should go back and make sure he decides to help! Beg him, bribe him if you have to!
translation: 那你应该回去，确保他决定帮忙！求他，必要时就贿赂他！

english: At last, [player name], I was getting quite worried. Have you spoken to the Wise Old Man yet?
translation: 终于来了，[player name]，我正担心呢。你和老智者谈过了吗？

english: Aarrgh! TROLLS!
translation: 啊！巨魔！

english: He said he'd be back in a minute. But never mind him - go back to Yanille and speak to Frumscone!
translation: 他说他马上回来。但别管他了——回亚尼勒城去，和弗拉姆斯科恩谈谈！

english: Then go back to the Wizards' Guild and ask him!
translation: 那就回巫师公会去问他！

english: Do you know who that is?
translation: 你知道那是谁吗？

english: Did you ever hear the Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the wise? I thought not. It's not a story the Jedi would tell you. It's a Sith legend. Darth Plagueis was a Dark Lord of the Sith, so powerful and so wise he could use the Force to influence the midichlorians to create life... He had such a knowledge of the dark side that he could even keep the ones he cared about from dying. The dark side of the Force is a pathway to many abilities some consider to be unnatural. He became so powerful... the only thing he was afraid of was losing his power, which eventually, of course, he did. Unfortunately, he taught his apprentice everything he knew, then his apprentice killed him in his sleep. It's ironic he could save others from death, but not himself. - have you brought an army?
translation: 你有没有听说过智者达斯.普雷格斯的悲剧？我想没有。这不是绝地会告诉你的故事。这是一个西斯传说。达斯.普雷格斯是一位西斯黑暗尊主，他强大而睿智，能够运用原力影响迷地原虫来创造生命……他对黑暗面如此了解，甚至能让他关心的人免于死亡。原力的黑暗面是通往许多被某些人视为非自然的能力的途径。他变得如此强大……他唯一害怕的就是失去自己的力量，当然，他最终确实失去了。不幸的是，他把自己知道的一切都教给了他的学徒，然后他的学徒在睡梦中杀死了他。他能拯救别人免于死亡，却救不了自己，这真是讽刺。——你带军队来了吗？

english: I am the Chief of Tai Bwo Wannai Village! Who dares set foot in my hut?
translation: 我是泰博瓦纳村的酋长！谁敢踏进我的小屋？

english: I am a roving adventurer.
translation: 我是一个游历四方的冒险者。

english: Well then adventurer, you would do better to rove elsewhere.
translation: 那么，冒险者，你最好去别处游历。

english: I am a travelling explorer.
translation: 我是一个旅行的探险家。

english: Well then explorer, you would do better to travel elsewhere.
translation: 那么，探险家，你最好去别处旅行。

english: I am a wandering wayfarer.
translation: 我是一个流浪的行者。

english: Well then wayfarer, you would do better to wander elsewhere.
translation: 那么，行者，你最好去别处流浪。

english: Who me? Oh I'm just a nobody.
translation: 我？哦，我只是个无名小卒。

english: Well then NoBody, you would do better to go elsewhere.
translation: 那么，无名小卒，你最好去别处。

english: Why should I leave?
translation: 我为什么要离开？

english: This place has been cursed. Our people have angered the gods and have fled the village.
translation: 这个地方被诅咒了。我们的人民触怒了神灵，已经逃离了村庄。

english: You ask too many questions. Now begone!
translation: 你问题太多了。现在滚开！

english: Who are the gods?
translation: 神灵是谁？

english: Where have your people fled to?
translation: 你的人逃到哪里去了？

english: Right, I'm going then.
translation: 好吧，那我走了。

english: Trufitus sent me.
translation: 是特鲁菲图斯派我来的。

english: Trufitus Shakaya? What news does he send?
translation: 特鲁菲图斯.沙卡亚？他带来了什么消息？

english: Trufitus has communed with the gods. Your village was never cursed and your people are free to return.
translation: 特鲁菲图斯与神灵进行了沟通。你们的村庄从未被诅咒，你们的人民可以自由返回。

english: Bwana, do you speak the truth?
translation: 先生，你说的是真的吗？

english: Yes, I helped Trufitus gather ingredients for a commune potion.
translation: 是的，我帮助特鲁菲图斯收集了制作通灵药水的材料。

english: Then it must be true.
translation: 那一定就是真的了。

english: I cannot thank you enough for what you have done so far.
translation: 对您所做的一切，我感激不尽。

english: Your gratitude is all I deserve.
translation: 能得到您的感激，我就心满意足了。

english: No, Bwana, you deserve much more.
translation: 不，先生，您应得更多。

english: I now ask you to do one last thing for our village.
translation: 现在我请求您为我们村庄做最后一件事。

english: I ask you to deliver the good news to my three sons Tamayu, Tinsay & Tiadeche, and then return them to the village.
translation: 我请求您将好消息带给我三个儿子——塔马尤、廷赛和蒂亚德切，然后带他们回村。

english: Thank you very much. I shall reward you greatly if you succeed.
translation: 非常感谢。如果您成功，我会重重酬谢您。

english: If I succeed? How hard can it be?
translation: 如果我成功？能有多难？

english: We shall see, Bwana.
translation: 我们走着瞧，先生。

english: No, I've had quite enough of the jungle already.
translation: 不，我已经受够这片丛林了。

english: So far??
translation: 这么快就受够了？？

english: Are you ready to help me?
translation: 你准备好帮我了吗？

english: Welcome back, roving adventurer.
translation: 欢迎回来，游历四方的冒险者。

english: Welcome back, travelling explorer.
translation: 欢迎回来，旅行的探险家。

english: Welcome back, wandering wayfarer.
translation: 欢迎回来，流浪的行者。

english: Welcome back, Nobody.
translation: 欢迎回来，无名小卒。

english: Can you tell me more about your sons?
translation: 能多跟我说说您的儿子们吗？

english: My first son is Tamayu. After him was born Tinsay. And after him was born Tiadeche.
translation: 我的大儿子是塔马尤，之后生了廷赛，再之后是蒂亚德切。

english: Can you tell me more about Tamayu?
translation: 能多跟我说说塔马尤吗？

english: Tamayu was a natural born hunter. He killed his first monkey at the age of three!
translation: 塔马尤是天生的猎人。他三岁就杀了第一只猴子！

english: Can you tell me more about Tinsay?
translation: 能多跟我说说廷赛吗？

english: Tinsay was brought up to be a priest. Be careful with him - he has acted strange since the accident.
translation: 廷赛从小被培养成祭司。对他要小心——自从那次事故后，他的行为就变得古怪了。

english: It involved Jogres. We don't talk about it.
translation: 和乔格雷兽有关。我们不愿提那件事。

english: Can you tell me more about Tiadeche?
translation: 能多跟我说说蒂亚德切吗？

english: Tiadeche always wanted to hunt fish. However, he has not had much success.
translation: 蒂亚德切一直想猎鱼。不过，他并不怎么成功。

english: He needs to improve his technique - but he does not heed my advice.
translation: 他需要改进技术——但他不听我的建议。

english: Where can I find your sons?
translation: 我在哪里可以找到您的儿子们？

english: On our island of Karamja. They will not have fled far.
translation: 就在我们卡拉姆詹岛上。他们不会跑远的。

english: Is there anything I need?
translation: 我需要带什么东西吗？

english: Patience, Bwana, patience.
translation: 耐心，先生，耐心。

english: And good conversation skills.
translation: 还有良好的交谈技巧。

english: Are you Tiadeche?
translation: 你是蒂亚德切吗？

english: Tiadeche, I bring good news. Trufitus has communed with the gods -  your village is once again safe.
translation: 蒂亚德切，我带来了好消息。特鲁菲图斯与神灵沟通了——你们的村庄再次安全了。

english: Your father requests that you return to the village.
translation: 你父亲请求你回村。

english: I will return only when I have caught a Karambwan.
translation: 除非我抓到一条卡拉姆班，否则我不会回去。

english: What is a Karambwan?
translation: 什么是卡拉姆班？

english: You don't know? The Karambwan is a species of octopus native to these waters.
translation: 你不知道？卡拉姆班是一种栖息在这片水域的章鱼。

english: They have a monopoly on its sale in the pirate town of Brimhaven.
translation: 海盗城镇布尔哈文镇垄断了它的销售。

english: When will you be finished?
translation: 你什么时候能完成？

english: At this rate, it could take forever.
translation: 照这个速度，可能要永远。

english: We don't have forever.
translation: 我们没有永远的时间。

english: Sometimes, oblivion is all I crave...
translation: 有时候，我只渴望遗忘……

english: I just don't know. You can try.
translation: 我也不知道。你可以试试看。

english: Something ... helpful?
translation: ……有帮助的东西？

english: How are you fishing for the Karambwan?
translation: 你是怎么钓卡拉姆班鱼的？

english: I'm trying to catch them with a net as they swim by.
translation: 我试着用网捕捉游过的它们。

english: And ... ?
translation: 然后呢……？

english: They keep fighting loose of the twining.
translation: 它们总能挣脱网线。

english: I refuse to take your offerings. I must catch this Karambwan myself.
translation: 我拒绝接受你的祭品。我必须亲自抓到这条卡拉姆班。

english: Tiadeche, instead of using your net, try using this vessel.
translation: 蒂亚德切，别用你的网了，试试用这个鱼笼。

english: It has been specially constructed to catch Karambwan. Once they enter it, they cannot return..
translation: 这是特制用来捕捉卡拉姆班的。一旦它们进去，就出不来了。

english: As you say, Bwana.
translation: 听您的，先生。

english: This vessel is useless! The Karambwan are not even interested in entering it!
translation: 这个鱼笼没用！卡拉姆班根本对进去没兴趣！

english: I've been told that the Karambwan feed only on the Karambwanji. This will make good bait.
translation: 我听说卡拉姆班只吃卡拉姆班鱼。这个可以当很好的饵料。

english: The Holy Friend? Bwana, it is sacrilege to feed these fish to Karambwan!
translation: 圣友？先生，用这些鱼喂卡拉姆班是亵渎！

english: Just try it.
translation: 试试看嘛。

english: This attracts many more Karambwan, but they still break free of the net.
translation: 这吸引了很多卡拉姆班，但它们还是挣脱了网。

english: Also, it has been loaded with Karambwanji. The Karambwan will not be able to resist this bait.
translation: 另外，这个鱼笼里已经装满了卡拉姆班鱼。卡拉姆班抵挡不了这种饵料。

english: Bwana! I cannot believe my eyes!
translation: 先生！我简直不敢相信自己的眼睛！

english: I, Tiadeche, who would never amount to anything, have managed to trap a Karambwan!
translation: 我，蒂亚德切，这个一事无成的人，竟然成功捕到了一只卡拉姆班鱼！

english: Let me offer to you my first catch as a sign of gratitude.
translation: 让我把第一次收获献给您，作为感激的象征。

english: Your father would be proud.
translation: 你父亲会为你骄傲的。

english: Hmph ... my father would not care.
translation: 哼……我父亲才不在乎。

english: Speaking of your father, can we make way to the village? He awaits your return.
translation: 说到你父亲，我们能回村了吗？他在等你回去。

english: I have no need for it, Tiadeche.
translation: 我不需要它，蒂亚德切。

english: We must return to the village now.
translation: 我们现在必须回村了。

english: I cannot return just yet. We witness the change of a turning tide. The secrets of the Karambwan are to be unlocked!
translation: 我还不能回去。我们正见证着潮汐的转变。卡拉姆班鱼的秘密即将被揭开！

english: Before I return, I must ask you to do one thing.
translation: 在我回去之前，我必须请你做一件事。

english: Take a Karambwan vessel to my brother Tinsay. He is the academic amongst us. Tell him I have asked him to study it so that we may craft more of its type.
translation: 带一个卡拉姆班鱼笼给我哥哥廷赛。他是我们中间的学者。告诉他我让他研究这个，这样我们就能制作更多这种鱼笼。

english: Can I have the vessel back then?
translation: 那之后我能拿回鱼笼吗？

english: I need this to practice with. Why don't you craft another one?
translation: 我需要这个来练习。你为什么不自己再做一个？

english: I ... never mind.
translation: 我……算了。

english: I have caught another Karambwan! I think I ought to give it to you.
translation: 我又抓到了一条卡拉姆班！我想我该把它给你。

english: Have you taken the Karambwan vessel to Tinsay?
translation: 你把卡拉姆班鱼笼带给廷赛了吗？

english: Did you ask for crafting instructions as I said?
translation: 你按我说的向他要制作说明了吗？

english: I did, but I think I've lost them...
translation: 我拿了，但我想我弄丢了……

english: Well go back and ask him to make another copy!
translation: 那就回去让他再抄一份！

english: Yes. He gave me this.
translation: 是的。他给了我这个。

english: Thank you so much. You cannot understand what all of this means to me and our people.
translation: 非常感谢。你不会明白这一切对我和我们的人民意味着什么。

english: Will you return to the village now?
translation: 你现在愿意回村了吗？

english: Yes. I will do as I promised.
translation: 是的。我会履行我的承诺。

english: I am glad to hear this. Let us go.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。我们走吧。

english: Not yet. I will stay here a while to catch more Karambwan.
translation: 还没。我要在这里多待一会儿，多抓些卡拉姆班鱼。

english: I will meet you in the village once you have helped my brothers and spoken to my father.
translation: 等你帮完我的兄弟们，和我父亲谈过之后，我们就在村子里碰面。

english: Please hurry! Time is of the essence!
translation: 请快点！时间紧迫！

english: Tamayu, first son of Timfraku!
translation: 塔马尤，蒂姆弗拉库的长子！

english: What do you want, stranger?
translation: 你想干什么，陌生人？

english: Tamayu, I bring good news. Trufitus has communed with the gods -  your village is once again safe.
translation: 塔马尤，我带来了好消息。特鲁菲图斯已经与众神沟通——你的村子再次安全了。

english: Then know this, stranger.
translation: 那你听好了，陌生人。

english: I vow upon the blood of my fallen kin that I shall not set foot in that godforsaken village till I have slain the Shaikahan.
translation: 我以我逝去亲人的血起誓，在我杀死沙伊卡汉狮之前，我绝不会踏足那个被神遗弃的村子一步。

english: You could slay it after we return to the village.
translation: 你可以等我们回村之后再杀它。

english: No! Your pitiful whining tires me. Now let me prepare.
translation: 不！你可怜兮兮的抱怨让我厌烦。现在让我准备一下。

english: Tell me more of the Shaikahan.
translation: 多跟我说说沙伊卡汉狮的事。

english: A source of indescribable evil. A beast more foul than your dreams could imagine. It hunts the jungle for anything foolish enough to cross its path.
translation: 一种难以形容的邪恶之源。一头比你梦境中能想象的任何东西都要污秽的野兽。它在丛林中狩猎任何胆敢挡它去路的蠢货。

english: It stands a full man's length in height. Its fore claws are sharp enough to rip through metal. In its eyes glow the embers of death.
translation: 它站起来有一个人那么高。它的前爪锋利到能撕裂金属。它的眼中闪烁着死亡的余烬。

english: How long have you been hunting the Shaikahan?
translation: 你猎杀沙伊卡汉狮多久了？

english: Since before I was born, stranger. It is my destiny.
translation: 在我出生之前就开始了，陌生人。这是我的宿命。

english: When will you succeed?
translation: 你什么时候能成功？

english: When the gods bless me with success. You may join me on my next hunt, but you may not take part.
translation: 当众神赐予我成功之时。你可以加入我下一次的狩猎，但你不能插手。

english: Shaikhan is at present far too agile for me!
translation: 目前沙伊卡汉对我来说太敏捷了！

english: I cannot do enough damage with this spear...
translation: 我用这把矛造成的伤害不够……

english: ... and  it seems to be healing too quickly!
translation: ……而且它似乎恢复得太快了！

english: Perhaps later, Tamayu, first son of Timfraku.
translation: 也许以后吧，塔马尤，蒂姆弗拉库的长子。

english: I could slay the Shaikahan for you.
translation: 我可以替你杀死沙伊卡汉狮。

english: You offer to kill the beast for me? Stop this nonsense, lest I kill you first. It is I who must avenge the death of my kin.
translation: 你提议替我杀了那头野兽？别胡闹了，小心我先杀了你。必须由我来为我的亲人复仇。

english: Take me on your next hunt for the Shaikahan.
translation: 带我去你下一次猎杀沙伊卡汉狮的行动。

english: Very well, but you must not interfere.
translation: 好吧，但你绝不能干涉。

english: I'm not going to skin that! In the jungle, we help only those who help us.
translation: 我可不会去剥那东西的皮！在丛林里，我们只帮助那些帮助我们的人。

english: I've noticed you commenting on the Shaikahan's agility. Try drinking this potion.
translation: 我注意到你在说沙伊卡汉狮的敏捷性。试试喝下这瓶药水。

english: I am beginning to match Shaikahan's agility!
translation: 我开始能跟上沙伊卡汉的敏捷了！

english: I cannot do enough damage ...
translation: 我造成的伤害不够……

english: Tamayu, try using this weapon.
translation: 塔马尤，试试用这把武器。

english: Thank you Bwana. Now I must prepare for my next hunt.
translation: 谢谢你，先生。现在我必须为下一次狩猎做准备了。

english: I can do enough damage ...
translation: 我能造成足够的伤害了……

english: ... but  it seems to be healing too quickly!
translation: ……但它似乎恢复得太快了！

english: I feel much more agile, but I am not sure whether I can match the Shaikahan...
translation: 我感觉敏捷了许多，但不确定是否能与沙伊卡汉狮匹敌……

english: Tamayu, I have brought you moreagility potion.
translation: 塔马尤，我给你带来了更多的敏捷药水。

english: I feel agile enough to finally match the Shaikahan!
translation: 我感觉敏捷度已经足够与沙伊卡汉狮一较高下了！

english: I have matched the Shaikahan in agility! He can no longer avoid my strikes!
translation: 我的敏捷已经与沙伊卡汉狮相当！它再也无法避开我的攻击了！

english: ... and  it does seem quite sick! Perhaps another poison would be more effective?
translation: ……而且它看起来确实病得不轻！也许另一种毒药会更有效？

english: The end approaches, Shaikahan!
translation: 末日将至，沙伊卡汉！

english: Gods! Witness this triumph!
translation: 众神啊！见证这胜利吧！

english: I did it! I, Tamayu, first son of Timfraku, did slay the Shaikahan!
translation: 我做到了！我，塔马尤，蒂姆弗拉库的长子，杀死了沙伊卡汉狮！

english: The deaths of my kin have been avenged. You are my witness.
translation: 我亲人的死已经报了。你是我的见证人。

english: Worry not - I am your witness. Shall we return to the village now?
translation: 别担心——我是你的见证人。我们现在回村子吗？

english: Yes. Go on ahead without me. I have further matters to attend to here.
translation: 是的。你先走吧，不用等我。我在这里还有些事要处理。

english: Let me guess - you want me to skin that monkey. Very well: I shall, since you have assisted me.
translation: 让我猜猜——你想让我剥那只猴子的皮。好吧：既然你帮了我，我就照做。

english: You again! I thought I told you to go away!
translation: 又是你！我以为我告诉过你滚开！

english: You did. I came back.
translation: 你是说过。但我回来了。

english: So I see. What would a fool like you want with me?
translation: 我看得出来。像你这样的傻瓜找我有什么事？

english: I am Lubufu, son of Kedoaba, brother of Kedenda and second cousin twice removed of Ibeli!
translation: 我是卢布富，凯多阿巴之子，凯登达的兄弟，伊贝利的远房二表亲！

english: Who is Kedoaba?
translation: 凯多阿巴是谁？

english: Kedoaba is my father, the father of Kedenda and second uncle twice removed of Ibeli!
translation: 凯多阿巴是我的父亲，凯登达的父亲，伊贝利的远房二叔！

english: Who is Kedenda?
translation: 凯登达是谁？

english: Kedenda is the son of my father, my brother and second cousin twice removed of Ibeli!
translation: 凯登达是我父亲的儿子，我的兄弟，伊贝利的远房二表亲！

english: Who is Ibeli?
translation: 伊贝利是谁？

english: Ibeli is the second nephew twice removed of my father, and the second cousin twice removed of myself and my brother!
translation: 伊贝利是我父亲的远房二侄子，也是我和我兄弟的远房二表亲！

english: Do you have any children?
translation: 你有孩子吗？

english: Alas, no. Focussed and determined in my trade as I was, I never found a suitable wife.
translation: 唉，没有。我一心扑在我的手艺上，始终没能找到合适的妻子。

english: It is a great shame that the secret of the Karambwan has to die with me.
translation: 卡拉姆班鱼的秘密要随我一起消亡，真是莫大的遗憾。

english: You could tell me the secret...
translation: 你可以把秘密告诉我……

english: Hah! What a stupid thought! The secret is mine and mine alone!
translation: 哈！多么愚蠢的想法！这个秘密是我的，只属于我一个人！

english: Our island of Karamja. Long ago, before you were even a thought in the back of a mind, I used to play on these beaches with the pebbles and stones.
translation: 我们的卡拉姆詹岛。很久以前，在你甚至还没在谁的脑海深处形成念头之前，我常常在这些海滩上玩鹅卵石和石头。

english: So you didn't have many friends then?
translation: 所以你那时候没什么朋友？

english: Silence!
translation: 住口！

english: As I grew older the ways of the world became apparent to me, and my attention turned from the rocks of the land to the fish in the sea.
translation: 随着我年纪渐长，世间的道理逐渐明朗，我的注意力从陆地上的岩石转向了海中的鱼。

english: Despite what you might hear, there are plenty of fish in the sea! Especially when they can only be caught by me!
translation: 不管你怎么听说，海里的鱼多得很！尤其是当它们只有我能抓到的时候！

english: Nowadays I mostly fish for Karambwan and collect their bait. Collecting the bait has become increasingly tiresome, what with my age and health.
translation: 如今我主要捕捞卡拉姆班鱼并收集它们的饵料。考虑到我的年纪和健康状况，收集饵料变得越来越烦人了。

english: How old are you?
translation: 你多大了？

english: An order of magnitude older than you! What an impudent question! Collecting bait has become hard enough at this age as it is without having to endure the chiding of you young people!
translation: 比你大一个数量级！多么无礼的问题！在这个年纪，收集饵料已经够难了，还要忍受你们这些年轻人的责难！

english: Which other young people come by here?
translation: 还有哪些年轻人会来这里？

english: Hmm ... nobody I can recall right now.
translation: 嗯……我现在想不起来有谁。

english: What do you use for bait?
translation: 你用什么做饵料？

english: That is part of the secret! Why would I tell you?
translation: 那是秘密的一部分！我为什么要告诉你？

english: I could help collect the bait.
translation: 我可以帮忙收集饵料。

english: And why would you help me?
translation: 那你为什么要帮我？

english: You sound like you could do with the help.
translation: 听起来你确实需要帮助。

english: Well perhaps you're right. It's nigh time I could do with some help after all.
translation: 嗯，也许你说得对。毕竟，我确实该找人帮帮忙了。

english: I have a fair amount of bait left over since last time I collected some, but I will be needing more shortly.
translation: 自从上次收集以来，我还剩下不少饵料，但很快我就需要更多了。

english: Ok. Where can I find the bait? I don't even know what it is!
translation: 好的。我在哪里能找到饵料？我甚至不知道它是什么！

english: Patience. I have kept the nature of the Karambwan a closely guarded secret. There is nobody alive who knows more about them than I do. Furthermore, there is nobody alive who even knows how they feed.
translation: 耐心点。我一直把卡拉姆班鱼的特性当作一个严密保守的秘密。世上没有比我更了解它们的人了。而且，世上甚至没有人知道它们是如何进食的。

english: You must therefore understand that what I am about to tell you is given in complete trust, and that you are to tell nobody else.
translation: 所以你必须明白，我接下来要告诉你的是出于完全的信任，你不能告诉任何人。

english: Very well. The Karambwan are a form of octopus native to our island of Karamja. They feed solely on Karambwanji, a brightly coloured fish which also inhabits the coastal waters surrounding the island.
translation: 好吧。卡拉姆班鱼是一种原产于我们卡拉姆詹岛的章鱼。它们只以卡拉姆班小鱼为食，那是一种同样栖息在岛屿周围沿海水域的色彩鲜艳的鱼。

english: Karambwanji congregate in coastal shoals near the Holy Lake. You will find it easiest to fish for them there.
translation: 卡拉姆班小鱼成群聚集在圣湖附近的沿海水域。你在那里捕它们最容易。

english: Where is the Holy Lake?
translation: 圣湖在哪里？

english: Just to the south of Tai Bwo Wannai Village. I'm sure you've met the locals already.
translation: 就在泰博瓦纳村的南边。我相信你已经见过当地人了。

english: And what do I use to fish for the bait?
translation: 那我用什么来钓饵料？

english: Any small net will do. Return here as soon as you have caught 20 Karambwanji.
translation: 任何小网都行。你一抓到20条卡拉姆班鱼就回到这里。

english: You sound like you need help.
translation: 听起来你需要帮助。

english: How dare you say such a thing! Be off with you!
translation: 你竟敢这么说！滚开！

english: I enjoy collecting meaningless items for people.
translation: 我喜欢帮人收集没意义的东西。

english: Meaningless? You know nothing of the Karambwan! Now leave!
translation: 没意义？你对卡拉姆班鱼一无所知！现在给我滚！

english: You're right. I don't want to help.
translation: 你说得对。我不想帮忙。

english: I didn't for one moment think you did.
translation: 我压根就没觉得你想。

english: A species of octopus native to the island which I and I alone know how to catch.
translation: 一种原产于该岛的章鱼，只有我知道怎么抓。

english: What do you do with your Karambwan?
translation: 你拿你的卡拉姆班鱼做什么？

english: I eat what I need and sell the rest to the Shrimp and Parrot restaurant.
translation: 我吃掉自己需要的，剩下的卖给虾与鹦鹉餐厅。

english: Where is the Shrimp and Parrot?
translation: 虾与鹦鹉在哪里？

english: You don't know anything do you? Just north of here, in Brimhaven!
translation: 你什么都不知道是吧？就在北边，布尔哈文镇！

english: What does Karambwan taste like?
translation: 卡拉姆班鱼尝起来是什么味道？

english: That depends entirely on how it is cooked...
translation: 这完全取决于烹饪方式...

english: Novicely cooked Karambwan is often poisonous to large mammals such as humans. If you buy some and cook it, be careful.
translation: 新手烹饪的熟卡拉姆班鱼通常对大型哺乳动物（如人类）有毒。如果你买了一些并烹饪，请小心。

english: I have come for your soul.
translation: 我是来取你灵魂的。

english: Well you've wasted your time. My soul is long gone, along with my compassion.
translation: 那你白费功夫了。我的灵魂早已消失，连同我的怜悯之心。

english: I'm from the Fishing Guild Anti-Monopoly Department.
translation: 我来自钓鱼公会反垄断部。

english: And I'm from the Island Karamja. What do you want?
translation: 而我来自卡拉姆詹岛。你想要什么？

english: We demand that you hand over the secret of the Karambwan.
translation: 我们要求你交出卡拉姆班鱼的秘密。

english: Erm ... no.
translation: 呃……不。

english: Oh, ok then. It was worth a try.
translation: 哦，那好吧。值得一试。

english: Do you have any spare monkey skin lying around?
translation: 你手头有多余的猴皮吗？

english: Funny you should say that...
translation: 你这么说真有意思……

english: Why's that? Do you have any?
translation: 为什么？你有吗？

english: Well, people have been asking me for monkey skins all day!
translation: 呃，一整天都有人问我要猴皮！

english: But no, I'm out of monkey skin.
translation: 但没有，我的猴皮用完了。

english: I've heard something about an accident.
translation: 我听说了一些关于事故的事。

english: You will want to ask one of the tribesmen. I don't usually talk about it.
translation: 你应该去问部落里的人。我通常不谈论这个。

english: Thank you! This should tide me over for the next month.
translation: 谢谢你！这些应该够我撑到下个月了。

english: Hurry along now. I still need [#] more.
translation: 快点吧。我还需要[#]个。

english: No, I'm still fishing for them.
translation: 不，我还在钓它们。

english: Well hurry! My reserves are beginning to run low.
translation: 那就快点！我的储备开始不足了。

english: Have you retrieved the Karambwanji yet?
translation: 你取回卡拉姆班鱼了吗？

english: I still need [#] more.
translation: 我还需要[#]个。

english: You should really ought to know that by now.
translation: 你现在应该已经知道了。

english: What do you use to catch Karambwan?
translation: 你用什么来捕捉卡拉姆班鱼？

english: Well ... since you ask, a specially constructed octopus pot. But don't tell anybody - that's part of the secret!
translation: 嗯……既然你问了，是一个特制的章鱼罐子。但别告诉任何人——这是秘密的一部分！

english: My, you're keen aren't you?
translation: 哎呀，你挺热心的嘛？

english: How would you feel about becoming my apprentice?
translation: 你觉得做我的学徒怎么样？

english: That's a slight change in attitude...
translation: 态度有点转变啊……

english: As much as I need to protect the secret, I should not carry it to the grave.
translation: 虽然我需要保护这个秘密，但我不应该把它带进坟墓。

english: You seem a trustworthy type of person. Do you want to train as my apprentice?
translation: 你看起来是个值得信赖的人。你愿意作为我的学徒接受训练吗？

english: I'm glad to hear it. I'm sure the secrets of the Karambwan will be safe with you.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。我相信卡拉姆班鱼的秘密在你这里会很安全。

english: In our language, Karambwan literally means 'Friend of Karamja.' As a friend of mine I will now show you how to fish for them.
translation: 在我们的语言中，卡拉姆班鱼字面意思是‘卡拉姆詹岛的朋友’。作为我的朋友，我现在就教你如何钓它们。

english: There are two aspects to fishing for Karambwan. Firstly, you must have the correct bait. Secondly, you must have the correct equipment.
translation: 钓卡拉姆班鱼有两个要点。首先，你必须用正确的饵料。其次，你必须用正确的装备。
