english: You already know of the Karambwanji, which shoal in the Holy Lake to the south. As I have explained, the Karambwan feed only on the Karambwanji, which are therefore the perfect bait.
translation: 你已经知道卡拉姆班小鱼了，它们成群出现在南边的圣湖。正如我所解释的，卡拉姆班鱼只以卡拉姆班小鱼为食，因此它们是完美的鱼饵。

english: But what kind of equipment do you use?
translation: 但你用什么样的装备呢？

english: It is futile to attempt to catch Karambwan with something as basic as a net. They are too strong and vicious to be caught in such a fashion.
translation: 试图用网这样基本的东西来捕捉卡拉姆班鱼是徒劳的。它们太强壮凶猛，无法用这种方式捕获。

english: I have spent many years designing a specially shaped vessel, into which Karambwan may pass but from which they may not return.
translation: 我花了很多年设计一个特殊形状的容器，卡拉姆班鱼可以进去，但无法出来。

english: If this vessel is loaded with Karambwanji, and then repeatedly lowered into a Karambwan shoal, then you should shortly find a Karambwan octopus trapped inside.
translation: 如果这个容器装满卡拉姆班鱼，然后反复放入卡拉姆班鱼群中，你很快就会发现里面困住了一只卡拉姆班章鱼。

english: I will now give you a Karambwan fishing vessel with which you can practise. Make sure you do not lose it. Under no circumstance may you give or show this to anybody. Do you understand?
translation: 我现在给你一个卡拉姆班鱼笼让你练习。确保不要弄丢了。无论如何都不能把它给任何人看或交给任何人。明白吗？

english: Yes, I understand.
translation: 是的，我明白。

english: Feel free to practise on my fishing spot.
translation: 你可以在我的钓鱼点随意练习。

english: Well the offer remains open. You're the most trustworthy person I have met in a long time.
translation: 好吧，这个提议仍然有效。你是我很久以来遇到的最值得信任的人。

english: How fares my apprentice?
translation: 我的学徒怎么样了？

english: And I'm glad to hear it!
translation: 很高兴听到你这么说！

english: I've been catching a whole load of Karambwan!
translation: 我抓了一大堆卡拉姆班鱼！

english: Look at you - outgrowing your boots already!
translation: 看看你——已经成长得这么快了！

english: Actually, I've lost my Karambwan vessel.
translation: 实际上，我把我的卡拉姆班鱼笼弄丢了。

english: You did what!? I hope nobody else has seen it...
translation: 你做了什么！？我希望没有其他人看到它……

english: Don't worry - nobody will find it...
translation: 别担心——没人会找到它的……

english: ... a shark ate it!
translation: ……一条鲨鱼吃了它！

english: Well you'd better hope for your sake that this shark is never caught!
translation: 那你最好祈祷这条鲨鱼永远不会被抓住！

english: ... a Karambwan stole it!
translation: ……一条卡拉姆班鱼偷走了它！

english: Well you'd better hope for your sake that this Karambwan is never caught!
translation: 那你最好祈祷这条卡拉姆班鱼永远不会被抓住！

english: ... it floated away!
translation: ……它漂走了！

english: Well you'd better hope for your sake that it never floats back!
translation: 那你最好祈祷它永远别浮回来！

english: In the meantime, you can practise with this.
translation: 与此同时，你可以用这个练习。

english: Thank you so much.
translation: 非常感谢。

english: Don't mention it. I mean that.
translation: 别提了。我是认真的。

english: Awful!
translation: 糟透了！

english: Everybody keeps asking me to run around and do their errands!
translation: 每个人都让我跑来跑去帮他们跑腿！

english: Living the hard life of a fisherman now, eh.
translation: 现在过着渔夫的艰苦生活了，嗯。

english: Ah ... you again. Have you changed your mind yet? Do you want to train as my apprentice?
translation: 啊……又是你。你改变主意了吗？愿意作为我的学徒接受训练吗？

english: Ouch
translation: 哎哟

english: Choke!
translation: 噎住！

english: Cough!
translation: 咳嗽！

english: Gasp!
translation: 喘气！

english: Braaar! Tinsay's the name!
translation: 布拉尔！我叫廷赛！

english: Tinsay, I bring good news. Trufitus has communed with the gods -  your village is once again safe.
translation: 廷赛，我带来好消息。特鲁菲图斯与众神沟通了——你的村庄再次安全了。

english: I will return only once I have repaired the tribal statue. Bones!!
translation: 只有等我修好部落雕像后我才会回来。骨头！！

english: Where is the tribal statue?
translation: 部落雕像在哪里？

english: Just near my father's hut.
translation: 就在我父亲的小屋附近。

english: But that'sinthe village!
translation: 但那是在村子里！

english: I'm ... er ... collecting materials to repair the statue with.
translation: 我……呃……在收集修复雕像的材料。

english: And I suppose you want me to fetch them for you?
translation: 所以你是想让我去帮你拿这些东西？

english: Good idea! Yes!
translation: 好主意！没错！

english: You mean you were just sitting here waiting for people to bring you things you need?
translation: 你的意思是你就坐在这里等人给你送需要的东西？

english: And you don't see anything wrong with that?
translation: 你不觉得这有什么问题吗？

english: Right ... what do you need?
translation: 好吧……你需要什么？

english: Hmm ... I think I need banana in Karamjan rum.
translation: 嗯……我觉得我需要泡在卡拉姆詹朗姆酒里的香蕉。

english: I see. And you're going to use this to repair the statue?
translation: 我明白了。你打算用这个来修雕像？

english: But of course! Bwahaha!
translation: 当然啦！哇哈哈哈！

english: ... I'll be back later.
translation: ……我过会儿再来。

english: Your brother Tiadeche has sent me. He asks you to study this vessel and produce crafting instructions.
translation: 你哥哥蒂亚德切派我来的。他让你研究这个容器，并写出制作说明。

english: You first help me, then I'll help you.
translation: 你先帮我，然后我才会帮你。

english: Have you found my banana in Karamjan rum yet?
translation: 你找到我的泡在卡拉姆詹朗姆酒里的香蕉了吗？

english: Well, hand it here then.
translation: 嗯，那就拿过来吧。

english: Erm ... I think I lost it in the wash.
translation: 呃……我好像在水洗的时候弄丢了。

english: Uh ... I think I left it in my other trousers.
translation: 呃……我好像落在另一条裤子口袋里了。

english: Actually, my pet monkey ate it.
translation: 其实，是我的宠物猴子把它吃了。

english: Well, I have this.
translation: 那个，我有这个。

english: I can't use this - there is a banana blocking the bottle!
translation: 我无法使用这个——有根香蕉堵住了瓶子！

english: Find some way of actually getting the banana inside the bottle.
translation: 想办法把那根香蕉弄进瓶子里去。

english: Yes ... that's it! Hits just the spot!
translation: 没错……就是这样！正合我意！

english: What? I thought you needed that for tribal statue repair!
translation: 什么？我还以为你是要用来修部落雕像呢！

english: Can we return to the village now?
translation: 我们现在能回村子了吗？

english: Not yet. I need one more thing...
translation: 还不行。我还需要一样东西……

english: I'm thinking...
translation: 我在想……

english: Seaweed ... Yes - a seaweed sandwich will do the trick.
translation: 海藻……对了——海藻三明治应该能行。

english: Aha! A seaweed in monkey skin sandwich!
translation: 啊哈！一个用猴皮包的海藻三明治！

english: Is this really necessary?
translation: 这真的有必要吗？

english: Yes. Essential.
translation: 当然，必不可少。

english: How do I find Karamjan rum?
translation: 我怎么才能找到卡拉姆詹朗姆酒？

english: It's available in any respectable drinking establishment.
translation: 任何像样的酒馆里都有。

english: How do I find bananas?
translation: 我怎么才能找到香蕉？

english: They grow everywhere!
translation: 到处都有！

english: How do I convince you to return to the village?
translation: 我怎么才能说服你回村子？

english: Oblige me by fetching my drink.
translation: 帮我去拿我的饮料就行了。

english: Just how insane are you?
translation: 你到底有多疯？

english: On a scale of 1 to barmy, I'm about [#].
translation: 按从1到疯癫的程度，我大概是[#]。

english: On a scale of 1 to kooky, I'm about [#].
translation: 按从1到古怪的程度，我大概是[#]。

english: On a scale of 1 to mad, I'm about [#].
translation: 按从1到疯狂的程度，我大概是[#]。

english: On a scale of 1 to loopy, I'm about [#].
translation: 按从1到傻气的程度，我大概是[#]。

english: Maurhah!! Jooooogre bones!
translation: 吗哈哈！！乔——乔格雷食人魔的骨头！

english: Ahem. Sorry. We don't usually talk about it.
translation: 咳咳。抱歉。我们一般不谈论这个。

english: Have you found my seaweed in monkey skin sandwich yet?
translation: 你找到我的猴皮海藻三明治了吗？

english: Yes ... perfect! You really do not understand how necessary that was.
translation: 对……完美！你根本不明白那有多必要。

english: Can we go now?
translation: 我们现在能走了吗？

english: Say something!
translation: 说句话啊！

english: Does that mean you're not coming or not saying anything?
translation: 你是说你不来了，还是什么都不肯说？

english: I need one more thing... I need ... Jogre bones ...
translation: 我还需要一样东西……我需要……乔格雷食人魔骨头……

english: Jogre bones? Why do you keep-
translation: 乔格雷食人魔骨头？你为什么一直——

english: Yes ...burntJogre bones.
translation: 对……烧焦的乔格雷食人魔骨头。

english: ...burntJogre bones?? How am I-
translation: ……烧焦的乔格雷食人魔骨头？？我怎么——

english: Indeed. Burnt Jogre bones marinated in... Marinated in...
translation: 没错。烧焦的乔格雷食人魔骨头，用……用……腌制……

english: Marinated???
translation: 腌制？？？

english: Marinated in Karambwanji!
translation: 用卡拉姆班鱼腌制！

english: Mmm ... Yes ... That will be good ...
translation: 唔……对……那味道一定不错……

english: You're just going to eat it, aren't you?
translation: 你只是想吃掉它，对吧？

english: No! Burnt Jogre bones marinated in Karambwanji are in fact essential in the trade of tribal statue repair!
translation: 不！用卡拉姆班鱼腌制的烧焦的乔格雷食人魔骨头，在部落雕像修复行业中其实是必不可少的！

english: I'll be back ... eventually.
translation: 我回头再……来。

english: I can't use this - there is far too much monkey flesh in it.
translation: 这个我没法用——里面的猴肉太多了。

english: Try to find some way of removing the monkey flesh.
translation: 想办法把猴肉去掉。

english: Have you found my burnt Jogre bones marinated in Karambwanji yet?
translation: 你找到我用卡拉姆班鱼腌制的烧焦的乔格雷食人魔骨头了吗？

english: I think this needs a bit of Karambwanji. They also don't seem quite burnt enough.}}
translation: 我觉得这个需要加点卡拉姆班鱼。而且烧得似乎也不够焦。

english: That was awful! The Jogre bones were not nearly burnt enough.
translation: 太糟糕了！乔格雷食人魔骨头烧得根本不够焦。

english: And the Jogre bones were hardly even marinated!
translation: 而且乔格雷食人魔骨头几乎没腌入味！

english: You'll have to make it again. Remember to burn the Jogre bones!
translation: 你得重做。记住要把乔格雷食人魔骨头烧焦！

english: I think this needs a bit of Karambwanji.
translation: 我觉得这个需要加点卡拉姆班鱼。

english: That was awful! The Jogre bones were hardly even marinated!
translation: 太糟糕了！乔格雷食人魔骨头几乎没腌入味！

english: You'll have to make it again. Remember to marinate the Jogre bones!
translation: 你得重做。记住要腌制乔格雷食人魔骨头！

english: How do I burn Jogre bones?
translation: 我该怎么烧焦乔格雷食人魔骨头？

english: You must either be very skilled or find a way to make them super hot.
translation: 你要么技术高超，要么想办法让它们变得超级烫。

english: How do I marinate something?
translation: 我该怎么腌制东西？

english: You cook it in a sauce, obviously.
translation: 当然是用酱汁煮啊。

english: How do I find Karambwanji?
translation: 我该怎么找到卡拉姆班鱼？

english: They're fish. Do I look like a fisherman?
translation: 那是鱼。我看起来像渔夫吗？

english: How do I end this silly quest?
translation: 我该怎么结束这个愚蠢的任务？

english: I'm sure Tinsay said to use Karambwanji paste, not Karambwan paste...
translation: 我记得廷赛说的是用卡拉姆班小鱼糊，不是卡拉姆班鱼糊……

english: Finally! A near lifetime of craving satisfied!
translation: 终于！我几乎一辈子的渴望都满足了！

english: I assume you're now able to repair the statue...
translation: 我想你现在能修雕像了吧……

english: Perfectly able, my friend, thanks to your ministrations!
translation: 完全没问题，我的朋友，多亏了你出手相助！

english: Probably best you don't go cooking any more Karambwanji from now on, they can be a bit volatile!
translation: 以后你最好别再烹饪卡拉姆班鱼了，它们可能有点不稳定！

english: Must I ... ?
translation: 我必须……？

english: I insist - and so does your father.
translation: 我坚持——你父亲也是这么想的。

english: He will not be pleased with me...
translation: 他不会高兴的……

english: It's complicated - we don't really talk about it.
translation: 这事很复杂——我们一般不谈这个。

english: Very well. I will meet you in the village once you have helped my brothers and spoken to my father.
translation: 好吧。等你帮完我的兄弟、跟我父亲谈过之后，我会在村子里和你碰面。

english: Very well - hand it over.
translation: 好吧——把它交出来。

english: I hope that's what he wanted.
translation: 希望这就是他想要的。

english: My sons have returned to the village!
translation: 我的儿子们回村了！

english: Roving adventurer, please accept my eternal gratitude!
translation: 游历四方的冒险者，请接受我永恒的感激！

english: Travelling explorer, please accept my eternal gratitude!
translation: 旅行探索者，请接受我永恒的感激！

english: Wandering wayfarer, please accept my eternal gratitude!
translation: 漂泊的旅人，请接受我永恒的感激！

english: Nobody, please accept my eternal gratitude!
translation: 无名氏，请接受我永恒的感激！

english: Oh it was nothing really.
translation: 哦，其实没什么。

english: It was? Very well. I still would that you accept my reward.}}
translation: 是吗？好吧。但我还是希望你能接受我的奖励。

english: I'd rather have some gold please.
translation: 我宁愿要一些金币。

english: Of course. That is in your nature.
translation: 当然。这符合你的本性。

english: You know your sons have serious issues...
translation: 你知道你儿子们有严重的问题吧……

english: Of course. I sometimes wonder if they know they have issues. Anyway, please accept also my reward.
translation: 当然知道。我有时候都怀疑他们自己知不知道。总之，也请接受我的奖励。

english: Eternal gratitude accepted.
translation: 永恒的感激之情我收下了。

english: Very good. The spirits of my family will watch over you. And now, I would that you also accept a small token of my appreciation.
translation: 很好。我家人的灵魂会守护你。现在，我希望你也接受我的一点小代币以表谢意。

english: You should go and see my sons in the village. I think they have something for you.
translation: 你应该去村里看看我的儿子们。我想他们有东西要给你。

english: Hello, Bwana! We three have finally returned to the village!
translation: 你好，先生！我们三个终于回到村子了！

english: So I see.
translation: 我看到了。

english: I wish to reward you in return for helping me.
translation: 我想报答你帮助我的恩情。

english: I have been attempting to cook the Karambwan. As we all know, they are poisonous if not cooked properly.
translation: 我一直在尝试烹饪卡拉姆瓦鱼。众所周知，如果烹饪不当，它们是有毒的。

english: Yes. It's how I, or rather Tamayu, killed the Shaikahan.
translation: 是的。我就是用这个，或者说塔马尤用这个，杀死了沙伊卡汉狮。

english: Indeed. I have determined precisely how long to cook them for so that they are edible.
translation: 确实。我已经精确确定了烹饪它们所需的时间，这样它们就可以食用了。

english: Thanks to you, Lubufu's Karambwan monopoly is over. If you ever need some, then come to me and not the store in Brimhaven.
translation: 多亏了你，卢布夫的卡拉姆瓦鱼垄断结束了。如果你需要的话，来找我，而不是去布尔哈文镇的商店。

english: Braaar! Your meals are truly excellent, Bwana ...
translation: 布拉尔！你的饭菜真是棒极了，先生……

english: ... but there are some areas which could use some ... improvement.
translation: ……但有些地方还可以……改进一下。

english: Let me show you.
translation: 让我给你看看。

english: Oh, and before you go: I finally got around to repairing that statue. You might want to take a look. ... Jogre bones!
translation: 哦，在你走之前：我终于抽空修好了那座雕像。你或许该去看看。……乔格雷食人魔骨头！

english: Welcome back to Tai Bwo Wannai, stranger.
translation: 欢迎回到泰博瓦纳村，陌生人。

english: I no longer feel a stranger here.
translation: 在这里，我不再觉得自己是个陌生人了。

english: And neither do we, thanks to you. My father has requested I give you something of value.
translation: 我们也是，多亏了你。我父亲让我给你一些有价值的东西。

english: I have not much of worth to give, apart from my fighting technique.
translation: 除了我的战斗技巧，我没什么值钱的东西可以给你。

english: This is the one thing I can give. My family have honoured me with this spear. But the honour is truly yours.
translation: 这是我能给的唯一东西。我的家人用这把长矛授予了我荣誉。但这份荣誉真正属于你。

english: Take care, Bwana.
translation: 保重，先生。

english: Well let me think...
translation: 嗯，让我想想……

english: You know, there is something I wouldn't mind some help with.
translation: 你知道吗，有件事我倒不介意有人帮帮忙。

english: When I was a boy, my grandfather would tell me the story of my ancestor, Magnus Rimor. He was a great explorer who lived a thousand years ago.
translation: 小时候，我祖父常给我讲我祖先马格努斯.里莫尔的故事。他是一位伟大的探险家，生活在千年前。

english: One day, Magnus was approached by none other than King Shayzien VII himself. The King asked him to lead an expedition to explore Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: 有一天，马格努斯被谢兹恩七世国王亲自找上门。国王要求他带领一支探险队去探索凯博斯低地的奎达莫特姆山。

english: Alas, according to records, the party never returned and were declared to have perished in the field.
translation: 可惜，据记载，探险队再也没有回来，被宣布全部阵亡。

english: That's very interesting and all but why are you telling me this?
translation: 这确实很有意思，可你跟我说这些干嘛？

english: A few days ago, I received a parcel. There was no name on it and I never saw the person that delivered it. Inside, I found something truly fascinating.
translation: 几天前，我收到一个包裹。上面没有名字，我也没见到送货的人。里面有一件真正迷人的东西。

english: There was an old journal, along with a note. The note claims that the journal was stolen from the Tower of Magic during the uprising against Xeric.
translation: 那里有一本破旧的日记，还有一张便条。便条上声称，这本日记是在反抗泽里克的起义期间，从魔法塔中被偷走的。

english: But that's not all. Apparently the journal was written by King Shayzien VII himself!
translation: 但这还不是全部。显然，这本日记是谢兹恩七世国王本人写的！

english: Again, really great and all but I still don't see where I come into this.
translation: 再一次，真的很好，可我仍然不明白这跟你我有什么关系。

english: Most of the journal is illegible but I've still managed to find a few readable extracts. Listen to this one...
translation: 日记大部分都难以辨认，但我还是找到了一些可读的片段。听听这段……

english: 'Quidamortem's creatures are compatible. The experimentation is proving successful and we will soon be ready to mass produce.'
translation: “奎达莫特姆的生物是兼容的。实验证明是成功的，我们很快就能批量生产了。”

english: That extract had a date in the 37th decade but the expedition was declared a failure in the 36th decade! If the expedition truly was a failure, why was the King writing about Quidamortem years later?
translation: 那段摘录的日期是第37个十年，但探险队在第36个十年就被宣布失败了！如果探险队真的失败了，为什么国王在几年后还在写关于奎达莫特姆的事？

english: Maybe there was another expedition.
translation: 也许还有另一支探险队。

english: Maybe. Or maybe someone wasn't telling the truth about that expedition. Regardless, I must find out what really happened. Can you help me?
translation: 也许吧。又或者，有些人没有如实报告那次探险的情况。不管怎样，我必须查明真相。你能帮我吗？

english: We need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.
translation: 我们需要了解更多关于那次探险的信息。图书馆历史档案应该会有记录。去阿西乌斯图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他可以带你去那里。

english: That doesn't sound too hard. Leave it with me.
translation: 听起来不算太难。交给我吧。

english: I've got other things to do.
translation: 我还有别的事要做。

english: Hello again. How is your quest going?
translation: 又见面了。你的任务进展如何？

english: I haven't actually started yet.
translation: 我还没开始呢。

english: Well you need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the Arceuus Library. He can take you there.
translation: 嗯，你需要了解更多关于那次探险的信息。图书馆历史档案应该会有记录。去阿西乌斯图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他可以带你去那里。

english: The Grand Library Historical Archive stores our most ancient and precious texts. You can find out much more about Great Kourend and our key historical events.
translation: 大图书馆历史档案馆存放着我们最古老珍贵的文献。您可以了解到更多关于大库兰德王国以及我们关键历史事件的信息。

english: Visitors are permitted to explore the archive now that we've isolated many of the dangerous enchantments protecting it.
translation: 游客现在可以参观档案馆，因为我们已经隔离了许多保护它的危险附魔。

english: I am Archeio, Guardian of the Historical Archive. I grant both visitors and staff access to the archive.
translation: 我是阿尔凯奥，历史档案的守护者。我允许访客和工作人员进入档案室。

english: Ah yes, I know of that expedition. King Shayzien VII was one of Kourend's most notable rulers. According to the history books, his reign was defined by violence.
translation: 啊，是的，我知道那次探险。谢兹恩七世国王是库兰德王国最著名的统治者之一。根据史书记载，他的统治以暴力为特征。

english: The expedition to Quidamortem was part of his aggressive plans to expand Kourend's territory. Unfortunately, it was a failure. The entire party was killed.
translation: 奎达莫特姆探险是他扩张库兰德领土的侵略计划的一部分。不幸的是，它失败了。整个探险队都丧生了。

english: The King himself died a few years later and was succeeded by Xeric, a tyrannical mage who made the King seem meek in comparison. Though of course, many believe them to actually be the same person.
translation: 国王本人几年后也去世了，继任者是暴虐法师泽里克，相比之下国王简直算温和了。当然，很多人认为他们其实是同一个人。

english: But I digress. The key thing to note is that no more expeditions were ordered under King Shayzien VII's rule. Does that help you?
translation: 但我跑题了。关键要注意的是，在谢兹恩七世国王统治下，没有再进行过探险。这对你有帮助吗？

english: No, not really. I have reason to believe that not everyone was killed on that expedition.
translation: 不，没什么帮助。我有理由相信那次探险并非所有人都死了。

english: I'm afraid I can't help you there. All the evidence we have tells us that the expedition had no survivors.
translation: 恐怕我帮不了你。我们掌握的所有证据都表明那次探险没有幸存者。

english: It would seem that way. However, if you do want to learn more about King Shayzien VII, it might be worth talking to Pagida. He's recently been investigating the King's additions to the Tower of Magic.
translation: 看起来是这样。不过，如果你确实想了解更多关于谢兹恩七世国王的事，也许值得和帕吉达谈谈。他最近一直在调查国王对魔法塔的扩建。

english: I could tell you about the King's work on the Tower of Magic though.
translation: 不过我可以告诉你关于国王在魔法塔上的工作。

english: Well it's not like I have anything better to do. Fire away.
translation: 嗯，反正我也没有更好的事可做。说吧。

english: During the time of King Shayzien VII, the Tower of Magic was the seat of power in Kourend. The King spent a lot of his time at the Tower, more than any other ruler.
translation: 在谢兹恩七世国王时期，魔法塔是库兰德王国的权力中心。国王在塔里待的时间比任何其他统治者都多。

english: Well now that I think about it, it was around the same time as the expedition you were asking about. That said, I doubt the two are connected.
translation: 嗯，现在想来，那大概和你问的探险是同一时期。不过，我不认为这两者有关联。

english: Well the prison is abandoned and has been for many years, so I suppose there's no harm in letting you see it.
translation: 监狱已经废弃多年了，所以我想让你去看看也无妨。

english: Be aware that the magic in that part of the tower is a bit unstable, so any items left in the prison will be lost. Would you like me to teleport you there now?
translation: 请注意，塔内那部分的魔法有些不稳定，所以留在监狱里的任何物品都会丢失。你想让我现在把你传送过去吗？

english: I guess you're wanting me to teleport you to the prison again? Be aware that any items left in the prison will be lost.
translation: 我猜你又想让我把你传送到监狱去？请注意，遗留在监狱里的任何物品都会丢失。

english: A good question. This historical archive is actually part of the Tower of Magic and was repurposed for the library many decades ago.
translation: 问得好。这个历史档案库实际上是魔法塔的一部分，几十年前被改造成了图书馆。

english: Unfortunately we don't possess full understanding of the Tower of Magic and its many enchantments, so we often discover remnants of traps from the Tower.
translation: 不幸的是，我们对魔法塔及其众多附魔并不完全了解，所以我们经常发现塔中残留的陷阱。

english: The task has fallen to me to investigate and study what we can of these enchantments in the hopes of understanding the magical power.
translation: 调查和研究这些附魔的任务落在了我头上，希望能理解魔法的力量。

english: Navigating the tower is difficult and many of the levels are off limits.
translation: 在塔中穿行很困难，许多楼层都禁止进入。

english: The Tower was constructed under the rule of King Rada III, though we don't know exactly when, since dates were not recorded before the Twill Accord.
translation: 这座塔是在拉达三世国王统治时期建造的，但我们不知道具体时间，因为在特威尔协议之前没有记录日期。

english: Indeed. During the invasion of the Wintertodt it was feared that all Kourend might be lost to the cold. In order to preserve the history of the Kingdom, this archive was created during the fifth decade.
translation: 的确。在冬将军入侵期间，人们担心整个库兰德王国可能会被寒冷吞噬。为了延续王国的历史，这个档案库在第五十年间建立。

english: Yes, she turned up a few days later, a little confused but physically fine. It happens every now and then but most people turn up eventually.
translation: 是的，她几天后出现了，有点困惑，但身体无恙。这种事情偶尔会发生，但大多数人最终都会出现。

english: Just be careful of walking into walls. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 小心别撞到墙。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: I have dedicated my life to studying the powerful enchantments that conceal the many levels of the tower, though it proves difficult at times.
translation: 我一生致力于研究隐藏塔中众多楼层的强大附魔，尽管有时证明很困难。

english: The Tower was constructed by King Rada III. We do not know exactly when, nor what for.
translation: 这座塔是由拉达三世国王建造的。我们不知道具体时间，也不知道用途。

english: Just recently we lost a Scholar when she accidentally activated a portal and fell through it.
translation: 就在最近，我们失去了一位学者，她意外激活了一个传送门并掉了进去。

english: Following the rebellion of the five houses against King Rada III, the Council of Elders was formed and they used the Tower as a meeting place for the council.
translation: 在五大家族反抗拉达三世国王之后，长老议会成立，他们使用这座塔作为议会开会的地点。

english: Since then it has been mostly used as residence by whoever was ruler of the kingdom, with each of the fifty different leaders using the tower however they saw fit.
translation: 自那以后，它主要被用作王国统治者的住所，五十位不同的领袖各自按照自己的意愿使用这座塔。

english: For the last two decades the Kourend Council have led the kingdom. As the leaders of each house prefer to reside within their cities, Lord Arceuus now controls much of the Tower.
translation: 在过去的二十年里，库兰德议会领导着王国。由于各家族的领袖更喜欢居住在自己的城市里，阿西乌斯领主现在控制着塔的大部分。

english: Following the rebellion of the five houses against King Rada III, the Council of Elders was formed. They used the Tower as a meeting place for the council.
translation: 在五大家族反抗拉达三世国王之后，长老议会成立。他们使用这座塔作为议会开会的地点。

english: Hewwo dawe, what can me do fow u?
translation: 泥嚎，俺能帮您做点啥？

english: Hmm. I should tell Phileas about this.
translation: 嗯。我应该把这事告诉菲利斯。

english: So I went to the Library Historical Archive. I found out that King Shayzien VII ordered the construction of a prison there around the time the expedition was taking place.
translation: 于是我去了一趟图书馆历史档案。我发现谢兹恩七世国王在探险进行期间下令在那里建造了一座监狱。

english: I investigated the prison and in one of the cells I found a strange message.
translation: 我调查了监狱，在其中一间牢房里发现了一条奇怪的信息。

english: 'Lizards on the mountain. Do not trust the King. The Altar is a lie.'
translation: “山上的蜥蜴。别相信国王。祭坛是个谎言。”

english: Lizards on the mountain? So it was true! Someone did return from that expedition! Do you think it was Magnus?
translation: 山上的蜥蜴？看来是真的！确实有人从那趟探险中回来了！你觉得是马格努斯吗？

english: Impossible to say I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕没法确定。

english: That's a shame. I would have liked to have known what happened to him.
translation: 真可惜。我本来想知道他后来怎么样了。

english: That's one to dwell on later though. For now, we need to work out our next steps.
translation: 这倒是以后可以考虑的事情。但现在，我们得规划下一步。

english: Next steps?
translation: 下一步？

english: Absolutely. We now know for sure that someone returned from that expedition, but we still don't really know why. We need to find out.
translation: 当然。我们现在可以肯定有人从那趟探险中回来了，但我们仍然不知道是为什么。我们需要查清楚。

english: But why does it matter? This all happened a thousand years ago. Anyone involved is long dead now.
translation: 但这为什么重要？这都是千年前的事了。当时所有参与者早就死了。

english: That doesn't mean it doesn't matter! This isn't just the chance to discover the truth about my ancestor. We also have the chance to expose the treachery of a former king!
translation: 这不代表它不重要！这不仅是一个发现我祖先真相的机会，我们还有机会揭露前国王的背信弃义！

english: Okay, I see you feel strongly about this. What do you need me to do?
translation: 好吧，我看得出来你对这件事很在意。你需要我做什么？

english: If we're to find out what happened on that expedition, we're going to have to retrace its route. And by we, I mean you.
translation: 要想知道那趟探险究竟发生了什么，我们得重走它的路线。而“我们”指的是你。

english: Yeah, I had a feeling that would be the case.
translation: 是啊，我就猜到会是这样。

english: First things first, you'll need to talk to Lord Shayzien. He's ordered that any research work done on the mountain be approved by him first. You'll find him in the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment to the
translation: 首先，你需要和谢兹恩领主谈谈。他下令任何在山上的研究工作都必须先得到他的批准。你可以在谢兹恩营地的战争帐篷里找到他，往

english: north.
translation: 北部。

english: I guess I'll be on my way then.
translation: 那我现在就出发吧。

english: I still need to talk to Lord Shayzien.
translation: 我还需要和谢兹恩领主谈谈。

english: Well you'll find him in the War Tent in the Shayzien Encampment to the north.
translation: 嗯，你可以在北边谢兹恩营地的战争帐篷里找到他。

english: Absolutely. We now know for sure that someone returned from that expedition but we still don't really know why. We need to find out.
translation: 没错。我们现在确定那次探险有人回来了，但还是不知道原因。我们必须查清楚。

english: First things first, you'll need to talk to Lord Shayzien. He's ordered that any research work done on the mountain be approved by him first. You'll find him in the war tent to the south east.
translation: 首先，你需要和谢兹恩领主谈谈。他下令任何在山上的研究工作都必须先得到他的批准。你可以在东南方向的战争帐篷里找到他。

english: That extract had a date in the 37th decade but the expedition was declared a failure in the 36th decade! If the expedition truly was a failure, why was the king writing about Quidamortem years later.
translation: 那份摘录的日期是第37个十年，但那次探险在第36个十年就被宣告失败了！如果探险真的失败了，为什么国王多年后还在写关于奎达莫坦的事？

english: We need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the Library, he can take you to the Archive.
translation: 我们需要了解更多关于那次探险的事。图书馆历史档案馆应该有相关记录。去图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈，他可以带你去档案馆。

english: One day, Magnus was approached by none other than King Shayzien VII himself. The king asked him to lead an expedition to explore Mount Quidamortem in the Kebos Lowlands.
translation: 有一天，马格努斯被谢兹恩七世国王亲自找上门。国王要求他带领一支探险队去探索凯博斯低地的奎达莫特姆山。

english: But that's not all, apparently the journal was written by King Shayzien VII himself!
translation: 但这还不是全部，显然，这本日记是谢兹恩七世国王本人写的！

english: That extract had a date in the 37th decade but the expedition was declared a failure in the 36th decade! If the expedition truly was a failure, why was the king writing about Quidamortem years later?
translation: 那份摘录的日期是第37个十年，但那次探险在第36个十年就被宣告失败了！如果探险真的失败了，为什么国王多年后还在写关于奎达莫坦的事？

english: We need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the library. He can take you there.
translation: 我们需要了解更多关于那次探险的事。图书馆历史档案馆应该有相关记录。去图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他可以带你去那里。

english: The name's Phileas Rimor. I was once a soldier in the Shayzien army but now I'm retired.
translation: 我叫菲利亚斯.里莫尔尔。我曾经是谢兹恩军队的一名士兵，但现在退休了。

english: Well you'll find him in the war tent to the south east.
translation: 你可以在东南方向的战争帐篷里找到他。

english: Well you need to find out more about that expedition. The Library Historical Archive should have records on it. Talk to Archeio in the library. He can take you there.
translation: 你需要了解更多关于那次探险的事。图书馆历史档案馆应该有相关记录。去图书馆找阿尔凯奥谈谈。他可以带你去那里。

english: What do you need citizen?
translation: 市民，你需要什么？

english: I'd like to perform some research on Mount Quidamortem, but I need your permission to do so.
translation: 我想在奎达莫特姆山上进行一些研究，但需要你的许可。

english: Quite right. Quidamortem is a dangerous place and I don't want to be ordering my troops on any unnecessary rescue missions.
translation: 没错。奎达莫特姆是个危险的地方，我可不想命令我的部队去执行任何不必要的救援任务。

english: So, tell me about your research.
translation: 那么，跟我说说你的研究。

english: Many years ago there was an expedition to Quidamortem ordered by King Shayzien VII. The expedition supposedly ended in failure.
translation: 许多年前，谢兹恩七世国王下令进行了一次前往奎达莫特姆的探险。据说那次探险以失败告终。

english: But I have reason to believe that wasn't the case. I think something was discovered on that expedition. I want to find out what it was.
translation: 但我有理由相信事实并非如此。我认为那次探险发现了什么。我想找出那是什么。

english: Fair enough. I will approve your research, on one condition.
translation: 有道理。我会批准你的研究，但有一个条件。

english: If you discover anything, you will bring it to me first. King Shayzien VII was my ancestor and I want to be made aware of any discoveries that would present him in a bad light.
translation: 如果你发现任何东西，你要先带给我。谢兹恩七世国王是我的祖先，我想知道任何可能对他不利的发现。

english: But surely the library should be made aware of any important discoveries?
translation: 但重要的发现不是应该让图书馆知晓吗？

english: They will be made aware. But only after I have reviewed the discoveries first.
translation: 他们会知道的。但得等我先审查过后。

english: Hmm. Fair enough.
translation: 嗯，好吧。

english: Excellent. Consider your research approved. If you require assistance with your work, I'd recommend talking to Historian Duffy on Quidamortem. He's been researching the mountain for a while.
translation: 很好。你的研究已获批准。如果你需要协助，我建议你去跟奎达莫特姆的历史学家达菲谈谈。他研究那座山有一阵子了。

english: Good luck citizen.
translation: 祝你好运，市民。

english: How's your expedition citizen?
translation: 市民，你的探险怎么样了？

english: I haven't started yet.
translation: 我还没开始。

english: Well if you require assistance, I'd recommend talking to Historian Duffy on Quidamortem. He's been researching the mountain for a while.
translation: 如果你需要帮助，我建议你去跟奎达莫特姆的历史学家达菲谈谈。他研究那座山有一阵子了。

english: Hello. Are you Duffy?
translation: 你好。你是达菲吗？

english: That's me. Do you need something?
translation: 是我。你有什么事？

english: Lord Shayzien told me that you might be able to help with some research I'm doing.
translation: 谢兹恩领主告诉我，你也许能帮我做一些研究。

english: I'm rather busy with my own research.
translation: 我自己的研究正忙得不可开交。

english: Please. It's important.
translation: 拜托了。这很重要。

english: Well what is it?
translation: 好吧，是什么事？

english: I'm trying to retrace the steps of an expedition ordered by King Shayzien VII. I believe something important was found on that expedition, but I don't know what.
translation: 我正在尝试重走谢兹恩七世国王下令进行的一次探险的路线。我相信那次探险发现了重要的东西，但我不知道是什么。

english: Interesting. So you don't know anything about what they found?
translation: 有意思。所以你完全不知道他们发现了什么？

english: I have a quote which I believe is from someone on the expedition.
translation: 我有一段引述，据信出自探险队某人之口。

english: Fascinating. We've been researching the lizard creatures here for a while now. We have reason to believe they are not of natural origin and may in fact have been created by Xeric or his followers.
translation: 太吸引人了。我们研究这里的蜥蜴生物已经有一阵子了。我们有理由相信它们并非自然起源，实际上可能是由泽里克或其追随者创造的。

english: But this quote of yours suggests the lizardmen may have existed during the time of King Shayzien VII, before Xeric's rule.
translation: 但你的这句话表明，蜥蜴人可能在谢兹恩七世国王时期、在泽里克统治之前就已经存在了。

english: So will you help me?
translation: 那你愿意帮我吗？

english: Yes. This is definitely worth pursuing. In fact, I think I know where we should begin.
translation: 愿意。这绝对值得追究。事实上，我觉得我知道该从哪里开始。

english: We recently found a small crevice on the western face of the mountain. It seems to be manmade and appears to be older than the rest of the caves around here.
translation: 我们最近在山腰找到一个小小的裂缝。它看起来像是人工开凿的，而且似乎比周围的其他洞穴更古老。

english: Alright, I'll start there.
translation: 好，我就从那里开始。

english: This must be the crevice that Duffy mentioned. I'll need a rope to get in.
translation: 这一定就是达菲提到的裂缝。我需要一根绳子才能进去。

english: Rickard! Turn away! Don't do this!
translation: 理查德！走开！别这样做！

english: Hello? Is anyone there?
translation: 喂？有人吗？

english: Hmm, I wonder what that was about.
translation: 嗯，不知道那是什么。

english: Oh well, I may as well go and tell Historian Duffy what I've found.
translation: 算了，我还是去告诉历史学家达菲我的发现吧。

english: Find anything in that cave?
translation: 在那个洞穴里发现什么了吗？

english: Well let us know when you do. It's on the western face of the mountain.
translation: 发现了就告诉我们。就在山的西侧。

english: Hello. Did you find anything in that cave?
translation: 你好。你在那个洞穴里发现什么了吗？

english: I did. There was a weird looking lizardman along with a strange altar.
translation: 发现了。那里有一只奇怪的蜥蜴人，还有一个奇怪的祭坛。

english: A lizardman? Is it safe?
translation: 蜥蜴人？安全吗？

english: Don't worry, I took care of it.
translation: 别担心，我已经处理掉了。

english: Well in that case, we'll go take a look.
translation: 既然这样，我们去看看。

english: This cave is quite fascinating. We could really be on to something big here.
translation: 这个洞穴真是迷人。我们可能真的发现了什么了不得的东西。

english: We've never come across lizards like the ones in this cave before. It would appear that they are a previously undiscovered species.
translation: 我们以前从未见过像这个洞穴里的这种蜥蜴。看来它们是一个以前未被发现的物种。

english: That's nothing. The really interesting part is that these lizards appear to be directly related to the lizardmen that roam this region.
translation: 那不算什么。真正有趣的是，这些蜥蜴似乎与这片区域游荡的蜥蜴人直接相关。

english: So this is where the lizardmen came from?
translation: 所以这就是蜥蜴人的来源？

english: It would appear so. That's not all though. This cave definitely predates Xeric, who we originally believed to be the creator of the lizardmen.
translation: 看起来是的。但这还不是全部。这个洞穴肯定早于泽里克，我们原本认为他是蜥蜴人的创造者。

english: So who did create them?
translation: 那到底是谁创造了它们？

english: Impossible to say for sure, but with what we've already learnt about King Shayzien VII, I do wonder if he was the one responsible.
translation: 无法确定，但根据我们已经了解到的关于谢兹恩七世国王的情况，我确实怀疑他是否是罪魁祸首。

english: But if King Shayzien VII did create the lizardmen, why did they fight for Xeric?
translation: 但如果谢兹恩七世国王确实创造了蜥蜴人，为什么他们会为泽里克而战？

english: There are some who believe that King Shayzien VII and Xeric were one and the same. They claim that after his death, the King was resurrected by his followers, taking on the name Xeric.
translation: 有些人认为谢兹恩七世国王和泽里克是同一个人。他们声称，国王死后被他的追随者复活，并改名为泽里克。

english: Anyway, I'm going to carry on with my research. I'd recommend you talk to Gnosi. She's made some interesting discoveries of her own.
translation: 总之，我要继续我的研究。我建议你去跟格诺西谈谈。她自己也有一些有趣的发现。

english: There are some who believe that King Shayzien VII and Xeric were one and the same. They claim that after his death, the king was resurrected by his followers, taking on the name Xeric.
translation: 有些人认为谢兹恩七世国王和泽里克是同一个人。他们声称，国王死后被他的追随者复活，并改名为泽里克。

english: That's nothing. The really interesting part is that these lizards appear to be directly related to the Lizardmen that roam this region.
translation: 那不算什么。真正有趣的是，这些蜥蜴似乎与在这一带游荡的蜥蜴人有直接关系。

english: It would appear so. That's not all though, this cave definitely predates Xeric, who we originally believed to be the creator of the Lizardmen.
translation: 看起来是这样。不过还不止这些，这个洞穴绝对早于泽里克，而我们原本认为泽里克是蜥蜴人的创造者。

english: Bahaha, you adventurers are all the same, never seeing past the fights and the treasure...
translation: 哈哈哈，你们这些冒险者都一个样，眼里只有战斗和宝藏……

english: Right now we're looking for evidence to prove this theory, but it's proving somewhat difficult.
translation: 现在我们正在寻找证据来证明这个理论，但说起来容易做起来难。

english: However we're not very familiar with this region so we've enlisted the help of the Kourend Grand Library to aid us in our research.
translation: 不过我们不太熟悉这个区域，所以已经请库兰德王国大图书馆协助我们进行研究。

english: Good thanks. Now that we've found this cave, we're learning more about the Lizardmen than ever before.
translation: 还不错，谢谢关心。自从找到了这个洞穴，我们对蜥蜴人的了解比以往任何时候都多。

english: Well let us know when you do.
translation: 那等你们搞清楚了告诉我们一声。

english: Indeed. They're a fascinating species! We're hoping to learn about their origins and how they've evolved.
translation: 确实。它们是一种迷人的物种！我们希望了解它们的起源和进化过程。

english: Well, we have a theory that the lizard creatures aren't natural at all, but were created by dark magical experiments.
translation: 嗯，我们有一个理论：这些蜥蜴生物根本不是自然存在的，而是黑暗魔法实验的产物。

english: We don't need your help. Run along now. Go and play in the dungeons with the other adventurers. I hear they're full of monsters to fight!
translation: 我们不需要你的帮助。一边去吧，和其他冒险者一起到地牢里玩。我听说那里到处都是可以打的怪物！

english: This mountain is steeped in natural history, but our main focus is to study the lizard creatures that surround this area.
translation: 这座山充满了自然历史，但我们的主要重点是研究环绕这个区域的蜥蜴生物。

english: However, we're not very familiar with this region so we've enlisted the help of the Grand Library to aid us in our research.
translation: 不过，我们不太熟悉这个区域，所以已经请大图书馆协助我们进行研究。

english: Try not to get yourself killed. It would be such a tragedy!
translation: 尽量别让自己挂了。那将是一场悲剧啊！

english: This cave is quite fascinating. We couwd weawwy be on tosomething big hewe.
translation: 这个洞穴真是迷死人了。我们说不定真滴要发现大东西了。

english: Hello. Duffy said you'd found something interesting.
translation: 你好。达菲说你发现了一些有趣的东西。

english: The Dark Altar was the key to Xeric's power. Because of it, he was able to rule Kourend unopposed for nearly a hundred years. His reign was so dark, it became known as the Age of Strife.
translation: 黑暗祭坛是泽里克力量的关键。正因如此，他才能毫无阻碍地统治库兰德王国近百年。他的统治如此黑暗，以至于被称为纷争时代。

english: Once he was finally defeated, Xeric came to Quidamortem and built the Chambers of Xeric deep below the mountain.
translation: 当他最终被击败后，泽里克来到奎达莫坦，在山底深处建造了泽里克圣所。

english: For many years we've tried to work out how he managed to survive out here without the power of the Dark Altar. Thanks to this cave, I think we've found the answer.
translation: 多年来，我们一直试图弄清楚他是如何在失去黑暗祭坛力量的情况下在这里生存下来的。多亏了这个洞穴，我想我们找到了答案。

english: This altar, it seems to give off the same power as the Dark Altar.
translation: 这个祭坛，似乎散发出与黑暗祭坛相同的力量。

english: So this altar was how Xeric kept his power after he was defeated?
translation: 所以这个祭坛是泽里克在被打败后保持力量的方式？

english: But why is it here?
translation: 但它为什么会在这里？

english: It appears to be manmade. I believe this altar was created to amplify the power of the Dark Altar, allowing it to reach areas it previously couldn't.
translation: 它似乎是人工建造的。我相信这个祭坛是为了放大黑暗祭坛的力量而创造的，使其能够到达以前无法到达的区域。

english: This discovery does bring about an intriguing question though.
translation: 不过，这个发现确实引出了一个有趣的问题。

english: The altar here is still giving out power. That means Xeric could have potentially used it to live for hundreds of years after his defeat. It's long been believed that Xeric eventually died here, but what if he didn't?
translation: 这里的祭坛仍在释放力量。这意味着泽里克有可能利用它在失败后存活数百年。长期以来，人们一直认为泽里克最终死在了这里，但万一他没有呢？

english: That's a worrying thought.
translation: 这是个令人担忧的想法。

english: Indeed. I'm going to stay here and continue working. Do you mind heading to the library to let them know what we've discovered.
translation: 确实。我打算留在这里继续工作。你介意去图书馆告诉他们我们的发现吗？

english: Actually, Lord Shayzien asked me to go to him first with any discoveries.
translation: 实际上，谢兹恩领主让我有任何发现先去找他。

english: Hmm, I can see why he would take an interest. Very well, go let him know what we've found.
translation: 嗯，我能理解他为什么感兴趣。好吧，去告诉他我们的发现。

english: The Dark Altar was the key to Xeric's power. Because of it, he was able to rule Kourend unopposed for nearly a hundred years. Once he was finally defeated, he came to Quidamortem and built the Chambers of Xeric.
translation: 黑暗祭坛是泽里克力量的关键。正因如此，他才能毫无阻碍地统治库兰德王国近百年。当他最终被击败后，他来到了奎达莫特姆，建造了泽里克圣所。

english: Indeed. I'm going to stay here and continue working. Do you mind heading to the Library to let them know what we've discovered.
translation: 确实。我打算留在这里继续工作。你介意去图书馆告诉他们我们的发现吗？

english: Hmmm, I can see why he would take an interest. Very well, go let him know what we've found.
translation: 嗯，我能理解他为什么感兴趣。好吧，去告诉他我们发现了什么。

english: We're studying the history of the region, origins of the Lizardmen and how it all connects to Xeric.
translation: 我们正在研究该地区的历史、蜥蜴人的起源，以及这一切如何与泽里克联系起来。

english: At the summit of this Mountain we've found an ancient temple and a vast network of caves delving into the mountain that we believe were formed by Xeric.
translation: 在这座山的山顶，我们发现了一座古老的寺庙和一个巨大的洞穴网络深入山中，我们认为这是泽里克制造的。

english: We've known about the Mountain for many decades but haven't been able to explore due to Lizardmen blocking the way.
translation: 几十年来我们一直知道这座山的存在，但由于蜥蜴人挡路而无法探索。

english: The discovery of the Chambers tell us Xeric invested significant time and resources on the mountain, yet it was never documented.
translation: 圣所的发现告诉我们，泽里克在山中投入了大量时间和资源，但这一点从未被记载。

english: But now that Shayzien forces have cleared the path and discovered the Chambers of Xeric in the process, there is much to explore!
translation: 但现在谢兹恩城的军队清除了道路，并在过程中发现了泽里克圣所，有很多东西可以探索！

english: Of course, though be careful - the dangers of the Chambers of Xeric are as yet unknown. You should take a strong group of companions with you.
translation: 当然，不过要小心——泽里克圣所的危险尚不明确。你应该带一支强大的队伍同行。

english: While much of Kourend history under Xeric remains unknown, it is very surprising to discover such a huge area that was previously unknown to us.
translation: 虽然泽里克统治下的库兰德王国历史大部分仍不为人知，但发现如此巨大的、我们之前未知的区域是非常令人惊讶的。

english: The discovery of this cave could change everything. We might finally be able to discover the link between the Lizardmen, the Chambers of Xeric and Xeric himself.
translation: 这个洞穴的发现可能会改变一切。我们或许最终能找到蜥蜴人、泽里克圣所和泽里克本人之间的联系。

english: He must have also had some form of teleportation in order to reach the Temple unnoticed.
translation: 他一定还拥有某种传送方式，才能神不知鬼不觉地到达神殿。

english: We believe this altar is that source, it seems to act as an amplifier for the Dark Altar.
translation: 我们认为这个祭坛就是那个源头，它似乎充当着黑暗祭坛的放大器。

english: As for what he used the Chambers for, that we still don't know. There's a lot of creatures in the Chambers, maybe he used them in his experiments.
translation: 至于他用圣所做什么，我们仍然不知道。圣所里有很多生物，也许他用于实验。

english: But now that the Shayzien forces have cleared the path and discovered the Chambers of Xeric in the process, there is much to explore!
translation: 但现在谢兹恩城的军队清除了道路，并在过程中发现了泽里克圣所，有很多东西可以探索！

english: Will do, see you later.
translation: 好的，回头见。

english: How is your research going citizen?
translation: 市民，你的研究进展如何？

english: We've made some important discoveries.
translation: 我们有一些重要的发现。

english: We've discovered a small cave on the western face of Quidamortem. It's manmade and it predates the time of Xeric.
translation: 我们在奎达莫坦西侧发现了一个小洞穴。它是人工建造的，并且早于泽里克时代。

english: Inside, we found an altar. It seems to be giving off the same power as the Dark Altar.
translation: 在里面，我们发现了一个祭坛。它似乎散发出与黑暗祭坛相同的力量。

english: We also discovered a unique lizard species, one that shares many similarities with the lizardmen.
translation: 我们还发现了一种独特的蜥蜴物种，它与蜥蜴人有许多相似之处。

english: It seems that this cave was the origin of the lizardmen. The fact that it predates Xeric suggests the lizardmen do as well.
translation: 看来这个洞穴是蜥蜴人的起源地。它早于泽里克的事实表明蜥蜴人也同样早于他。

english: You believe they were the creation of my ancestor?
translation: 你认为它们是我祖先的创造物？

english: Hard to say for sure. It would make sense though.
translation: 很难确定。但这说得通。

english: From the evidence we have, I believe that King Shayzien VII ordered an expedition to Quidamortem, hoping to discover a suitable species for his lizardman project.
translation: 根据我们掌握的证据，我相信谢兹恩七世国王下令前往奎达莫特姆探险，希望找到适合他蜥蜴人项目的物种。

english: Once the expedition found one, he had them killed to keep the discovery a secret.
translation: 一旦探险队找到了一个，他就下令杀死他们以保守发现的秘密。

english: But we don't have proof?
translation: 但我们没有证据？

english: Not definitive, but there's a lot of evidence.
translation: 不是决定性的，但有很多证据。

english: So you claim. However, you never actually told me where this evidence came from.
translation: 你这么说。但你从未告诉我这些证据来自哪里。

english: It started with a parcel delivered to Phileas Rimor. It contained a journal written by King Shayzien VII himself. The journal mentioned creatures on Quidamortem.
translation: 事情始于一个寄给菲利亚斯.里莫尔尔的包裹。里面有一本谢兹恩七世国王本人写的日记。日记提到了奎达莫特姆上的生物。

english: A parcel? King Shayzien VII's journal was delivered in a parcel? Who sent it?
translation: 一个包裹？谢兹恩七世国王的日记是用包裹寄来的？谁寄的？

english: Well you need to find out. Go to Phileas Rimor and retrieve this parcel. I need to see it for myself.
translation: 那么你需要去查清楚。去找菲利亚斯.里莫尔尔，取回这个包裹。我需要亲眼看看。

english: Eugh, so much walking. Fine, I'll go see Phileas.
translation: 呃，要走这么多路。好吧，我去找菲利亚斯。

english: Do you have the parcel citizen?
translation: 市民，你拿到包裹了吗？

english: Well go and fetch it then. I need to see it for myself.
translation: 那就去拿吧。我需要亲眼看看。

english: Err, this doesn't look good. I'd better tell Lord Shayzien.
translation: 呃，这看起来不妙。我最好告诉谢兹恩领主。

english: I'm afraid not. I went to see Phileas but his home was trashed and he was gone.
translation: 恐怕没有。我去找菲利亚斯，但他的家被砸了，人也不见了。

english: Gone? That's not good.
translation: 不见了？这可不好。

english: I'll open an investigation into this immediately. Hopefully we can find out what happened to Phileas.
translation: 我会立即展开调查。希望我们能查明菲利亚斯发生了什么事。

english: What about the research?
translation: 那研究怎么办？

english: I'm afraid that without that parcel we don't have anything to link King Shayzien VII to your discoveries.
translation: 恐怕没有那个包裹，我们就没有任何东西能将谢兹恩七世国王与你的发现联系起来。

english: However, the rest of your research is still valid. I'll contact the research team on the mountain and make sure their discoveries are documented in the Arceuus Library.
translation: 不过，你其余的研究仍然有效。我会联系山上的研究团队，确保他们的发现记录在阿西乌斯城图书馆。

english: You've done enough for now citizen. I'll be in touch if we require your assistance again. For now, here is payment for your time.
translation: 市民，你暂时做得够多了。如果我们还需要你的帮助，我会联系你的。现在，这是对你时间的报酬。

english: Need anything else citizen?
translation: 市民，还需要别的吗？

english: However, the rest of your research is still valid. I'll contact the research team on the mountain and make sure their discoveries are documented in the Library.
translation: 不过，你的其余研究仍然有效。我会联系山上的研究团队，确保他们的发现被记录在图书馆里。

english: I will personally see to the rescue of Phileas. I need you to recover the journal.
translation: 我会亲自负责营救费利亚斯。我需要你找回那本日志。

english: I think we can also agree that when the time comes, I will be a suitable candidate to rule. These are unstable times. My military leadership will put me in a good position to take over.
translation: 我想我们也能达成一致，到时候我会是一个合适的统治者人选。现在局势不稳。我的军事领导能力将使我处于接班的有利位置。

english: However, the rest of your research is still valid. I'll contact the research team on the mountain and make sure their discoveries are documented in the library.
translation: 不过，你的其余研究仍然有效。我会联系山上的研究团队，确保他们的发现被记录在图书馆里。

english: Most citizens of Shayzien are part of the Shayzien army in some form or other. We are responsible for defending Kourend against external and internal threats.
translation: 谢兹恩城的大部分市民都以某种形式属于谢兹恩军队。我们负责保卫库兰德王国免受内外威胁。

english: Absolutely, we've pushed the Lizardmen back to the point where we're finally able to allow citizens such as yourself into the region.
translation: 当然，我们已经把蜥蜴人击退到了终于可以允许像你这样的市民进入该地区的程度。

english: Externally, we have recently being dealing with increased Lizardman activity. We've also been keeping a close eye on Varlamore to the south, just in case they try anything.
translation: 对外方面，我们最近一直在应对蜥蜴人活动的增加。我们也在密切关注南方的瓦拉莫尔，以防他们有什么动作。

english: Well citizen, you are speaking to Lord Shiro Shayzien. I am the lord of Shayzien and the Commander-in-chief of the Shayzien army.
translation: 市民啊，你正在和西罗.谢兹恩领主说话。我是谢兹恩城的领主兼谢兹恩军队的总司令。

english: What I can tell you is that our main focus right now is the Lizardman threat. We've moved a great number of troops into the Kebos Lowlands to combat the issue.
translation: 我能告诉你的是，我们目前的主要关注点是蜥蜴人的威胁。我们已经派遣大量部队进入凯博斯低地来解决这个问题。

english: Here citizen, your reward for helping with the expedition.
translation: 给你，市民，这是你协助远征的奖赏。

english: Externally, we have recently being dealing with increased lizardman activity. We've also been keeping a close eye on Varlamore to the south, just in case they try anything.
translation: 对外方面，我们最近一直在应对蜥蜴人活动的增加。我们也在密切关注南方的瓦拉莫尔，以防他们有什么动作。

english: Well let me know once you've discovered something.
translation: 等你发现了什么再告诉我。

english: Hello there citizen. I suggest you speak with Commander Fullore?
translation: 你好，市民。我建议你和富洛尔指挥官谈谈？

english: Well citizen, you are speaking to Lord Shiro Shayzien. I am the lord of Shayzien and the commander-in-chief of the Shayzien army.
translation: 市民啊，你正在和西罗.谢兹恩领主说话。我是谢兹恩城的领主兼谢兹恩军队的总司令。

english: But first you will need to make a bowl in which to collect the tears.
translation: 但首先，你需要制作一个碗来收集这些泪水。

english: There is a cave on the south side of the chasm that is similarly infused with the power of Guthix. The stone in that cave is the only substance that can catch the Tears of Guthix.
translation: 深渊南侧有一个洞穴，同样注入了古斯的力量。那个洞穴里的石头是唯一能接住古斯之泪的物质。

english: Mine some stone from that cave, make it into a bowl, and bring it to me, and then I will let you catch the Tears.
translation: 从那个洞穴里开采一些石头，做成碗，然后带给我，我就让你接住古斯之泪。

english: Actually, I don't really have one.
translation: 其实，我没什么故事可讲。

english: Hmm. Maybe you should come back when you do.
translation: 嗯。那等你有了故事再回来吧。

english: A story?
translation: 一个故事？

english: I have been waiting here three thousand years, guarding the Tears of Guthix. I serve my master faithfully, but I am bored.
translation: 我在这里守护古斯之泪已经三千年了。我忠心侍奉我的主人，但我很无聊。

english: An adventurer such as yourself must have many tales to tell. If you can entertain me, I will let you into the cave for a time.
translation: 像你这样的冒险者一定有很多故事可讲。如果你能让我开心，我就让你进洞穴待一会儿。

english: The more I enjoy your story, the more time I will give you in the cave.
translation: 我越喜欢你的故事，我在洞穴里给你的时间就越多。

english: Then you can drink of the power of balance, which will make you stronger in whatever area you are weakest.
translation: 然后你就可以饮下平衡之力，它会让你最薄弱的领域变得更强。

english: What are the Tears of Guthix?
translation: 古斯之泪是什么？

english: I have already told you my story, and you have not told me yours!
translation: 我已经把我的故事告诉你了，你还没告诉我你的故事呢！

english: ... so Ava's devices can retrieve ammunition for me when I'm ranging, using the power of the magnet and the undead chicken.
translation: ……所以艾娃的装置可以利用磁铁和亡灵鸡的力量，在我使用远程攻击时回收弹药。

english: A magnet and an undead chicken? Really?
translation: 磁铁和亡灵鸡？真的吗？

english: It's useful.
translation: 这很有用。

english: ... and the Dorgeshuun city is now connected to Keldagrim by a rapid train line.
translation: ……现在多吉需戛纳通过一条快速铁路线与凯尔达格林城相连了。

english: I am always glad to hear tales of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 听到多吉需戛纳的故事总是让我很高兴。

english: ... and with the device destroyed, the people of Arceuus were safe.
translation: ……装置被摧毁后，阿西乌斯城的人民安全了。

english: ... at the end of the day, I wonder what happened to Fox's equipment...
translation: ……一天结束时，我好奇福克斯的装备后来怎么样了……

english: ... after Willow betrayed me, I managed to defeat the guardian. Then I found the Imcando city of Camdozaal!
translation: ……在柳木背叛我之后，我设法击败了守护者。然后我找到了伊姆坎多城卡姆多扎尔！

english: ... but Pharaoh Kemesis agreed to begin preparations to reopen Menaphos.
translation: ……但法老凯米西斯同意开始准备重新开放美纳福斯。

english: ... I had to be shot out of a cannon into a rock! But finally I banished the spirit of the rock and Dondakan could mine his gold.
translation: ……我不得不被大炮射出去，撞进一块岩石里！但最终我驱逐了岩石的灵魂，东达坎才能开采他的黄金。

english: ... Poor Rantz was so clumsy he couldn't shoot anything!But I managed to kill the Chompy Bird.
translation: ……可怜的兰茨笨手笨脚，什么都射不中！但我还是设法杀死了食人鸟。

english: ... So it turned out there was no plague after all!
translation: ……结果根本没有什么瘟疫！

english: Deception of the people by their rulers is a terrible thing.
translation: 统治者欺骗人民是一件可怕的事情。

english: ... So in the end the Black Knights were defeated by cabbage!
translation: ……最后，黑骑士被卷心菜打败了！

english: One should never underestimate the uses of the vegetables of Guthix.
translation: 永远不要低估古斯蔬菜的用途。

english: ... and that's how I got the archaeologists to Fossil Island!
translation: ……我就是这样把考古学家们带到化石岛的！

english: ... So I holed the enemy ship with another cannon shot, and the Adventurous sailed triumphantly into Mos Le'Harmless!
translation: ...于是我又一炮打穿了敌船，冒险号胜利地驶入了莫斯勒哈姆斯岛！

english: ... and that's how I stopped the murder of the Teokan of Ralos!
translation: ……我就是这样阻止了拉洛斯特坎被谋杀！

english: I have no knowledge of this Ralos you speak of. How curious...
translation: 我对你说的这个拉洛斯一无所知。真奇怪……

english: ... but Veos had no idea what was going on. He'd been controlled remotely by his mysterious client the whole time!
translation: ……但维奥斯完全不知道发生了什么。他一直被他神秘客户远程控制着！

english: ... So it was I who repaired the clock tower.
translation: ……所以是我修好了钟楼。

english: ... so I told Larry about the penguins' plot!
translation: ……所以我告诉了拉里关于企鹅的阴谋！

english: The paranoia and ambition of the penguins' leaders will not serve their people well.
translation: 企鹅领袖的偏执和野心不会为他们的人民带来好处。

english: ... and in the end I found all the ingredients, so the Duke of Lumbridge had a birthday cake after all.
translation: ……最后我找到了所有材料，所以仑桥镇公爵最终还是有了一个生日蛋糕。

english: Ah, a happy ending. It would not be good for such an anniversary to go unmarked.
translation: 啊，一个快乐的结局。这样的纪念日不被庆祝可不好。

english: ... and after I'd defeated the giant scarab, the High Priest gave me a reward lamp to teach me more combat skills.
translation: ……在我击败巨型圣甲虫后，大祭司给了我一个奖励灯，教我更多战斗技能。

english: ... where Captain Tock thanked me profusely for solving the mysterious 'curse' and killing the traitor.
translation: ……托克船长对我解决了神秘的‘诅咒’并杀死了叛徒感激不尽。

english: ... But in the end I stopped Fenkenstrain from continuing his horrible experiments.
translation: ……但最终我阻止了芬肯斯特兰继续他可怕的实验。

english: With the power to create life comes responsibility. I see that Fenkenstrain was not up to the task.
translation: 拥有创造生命的力量伴随着责任。我看芬肯斯特兰无法胜任这项任务。

english: ... and that's how I was able to deal with the questionable politics of Catherby.
translation: ……我就是这样处理了凯瑟比镇可疑的政治问题。

english: It seems you humans are always coming up with new political systems. This one sounds like it might need a bit more work...
translation: 看来你们人类总是想出新的政治制度。这个听起来还需要再完善一下……

english: ... and so I escaped with the heart of Arrav!
translation: ……于是我带着阿拉夫之心逃了出来！

english: The separation of heart from man is not natural. It is good you are looking to resolve such matters.
translation: 心与人的分离是不自然的。你能寻求解决此事是件好事。

english: ... I gave Safalaan the book on Haemalchemy, and he recommended me for a position on the Myreque.
translation: ……我把那本关于血炼术的书给了萨法拉恩，他推荐我加入迈雷克。

english: I am sure you will have many more adventures on behalf of the Myreque. Then, perhaps, you will have even more stories to tell me.
translation: 我相信你还会为迈雷克经历更多冒险。到那时，也许你会有更多故事讲给我听。

english: ... So from then on the Imperial Guard was able to access Death Plateau safely and take the trolls by surprise.
translation: ...从那时起，帝国卫队就能安全地进入死亡高原，并出其不意地袭击巨魔。

english: ... Sigmund escaped again, but Zanik and I destroyed the machine and Dorgesh-Kaan was saved!
translation: ……西格蒙德又逃跑了，但扎尼克和我摧毁了机器，多吉需戛纳得救了！

english: Zanik still has her destiny to fulfil, and I have a feeling you will have a part in that.
translation: 扎尼克仍有她的使命要完成，我有预感你会参与其中。

english: ... and so that's how I solved the case of the murder on the isle.
translation: ……我就是这样破获了岛上谋杀案。

english: Ambition is so often the death of reason. It is good you were able to find the culprit.
translation: 野心往往是理智的死亡。你能找到凶手是件好事。

english: ... the Shield of Arrav glowed with lightning, and Dimintheis used it to defeat the zombie army!
translation: ……阿拉夫之盾闪耀着闪电，迪明塞斯用它击败了僵尸大军！

english: ... So I destroyed the demon Delrith and saved Varrock!
translation: ……所以我摧毁了恶魔德尔里斯，拯救了维洛克城！

english: I remember Delrith. A most unpleasant character; I am glad he has been dispatched.
translation: 我记得德尔里斯。一个非常令人不快的家伙；我很高兴他被解决了。

english: ... and I returned the Royal Accord of Twill to Lord Hosidius.
translation: ……我把特威尔皇家协议归还给了霍西迪乌斯领主。

english: ... In the pyramid I discovered a whole new set of magic spells!
translation: ……在金字塔里，我发现了一整套全新的魔法咒语！

english: I suggest you think about the origin of those spells. Ancient magics are not to be toyed with.
translation: 我建议你思考一下那些咒语的起源。古代魔法可不是闹着玩的。

english: ... and it turns out the treasure in the vault was actually the Elder Horn!
translation: ……结果金库里的宝藏竟然是长老号角！

english: For an artefact like that to be unleashed upon this world... Let us hope this is not the end of the story.
translation: 这样的神器被释放到这个世界……希望这不是故事的结局。

english: ... So it was me who accidentally brought a teleport beacon onto Entrana! But the Temple Knights are investigating so it should all be all right.
translation: ……所以是我意外把一个传送信标带到了恩特纳岛！但圣殿骑士正在调查，所以应该没事。

english: ... and the examiner was very impressed that I had discovered an ancient altar of Zaros.
translation: ……考官对我发现了一座扎罗斯的古代祭坛印象深刻。

english: Zaros? I had not heard that name for a thousand years even before the start of my sojourn here.
translation: 扎罗斯？在我开始在此地隐居之前，我已经有一千年没听过这个名字了。

english: ... So once I had got all the ores he wanted, Doric let me use his anvils.
translation: ……所以在我弄到他想要的所有矿石后，多里克让我使用他的铁砧。

english: Such a small task hardly seems worthy of the term 'quest'.
translation: 这么小的任务似乎配不上‘任务’这个词。

english: ... So with Elvarg the dragon dead, the master of the Champions' Guild let me in, and I was able to wear Rune Plate!
translation: ……所以龙艾尔瓦格死后，冠军公会的会长让我进去了，我还能穿上符文板甲！

english: ... so I slew the dragon which killed the dragonkin as well.
translation: ……所以我杀死了那条龙，同时也杀死了龙人。

english: Not everyone survived the fight though.
translation: 不过并非所有人都在这场战斗中幸存。

english: The dragonkin once brought this world to the brink of ruin. It is good you stopped them from doing so again.
translation: 龙人曾将这个世界推向毁灭的边缘。你阻止他们再次这样做是件好事。

english: ... so Cyrisus was free of his fear of combat, and he headed off to be an adventurer.
translation: ……所以西里苏斯摆脱了对战斗的恐惧，出发去当冒险者了。

english: Fear is the most insidious enemy of all.
translation: 恐惧是所有敌人中最阴险的。

english: ... So Kaqemeex taught me how to use the Herblore skill.
translation: ……所以卡基米克斯教会了我如何使用草药学技能。

english: A generous reward indeed.
translation: 确实是一份慷慨的奖励。

english: ... and that was how I fixed the Dwarf multicannon.
translation: ……我就是这样修好了矮人大炮。

english: So war still rages in the world above? Will you never tire of creating machines of destruction?
translation: 所以战争仍在上面世界肆虐？你们就永远不会厌倦制造毁灭机器吗？

english: ... Eadgar's ruse was absurd, but it worked!The trolls ate a fake human, and I got the herb for the druids' ritual.
translation: ……埃德加的诡计很荒谬，但它奏效了！巨魔吃了一个假人，我拿到了德鲁伊仪式所需的草药。

english: ... so Nickolaus taught me how to catch a new ferret for the zoo.
translation: ……所以尼古拉斯教我怎么为动物园抓一只新雪貂。

english: ... and once I had repaired the Elemental Workshop I was able to make an Elemental Shield.
translation: ……在我修好元素工坊 I 后，我就能制作元素盾了。

english: ... so I instilled the power of my mind into the primed bar and smithed it into an Elemental Mind Helm!
translation: ……所以我将我的精神力量注入预处理金属锭，并将其锻造成一顶元素精神头盔！

english: You should be careful about meddling with your own head.
translation: 你应该小心干涉自己的头脑。

english: ... and then Akthanakos and Enakhra went away to the north to continue fighting!
translation: ……然后阿克塔纳科斯和伊纳克拉前往北方继续战斗！

english: A battle between two such powerful beings will take much time and unleash much energy. I hope that the natural world is not damaged in this conflict!
translation: 两个如此强大的存在之间的战斗会耗费大量时间并释放大量能量。我希望自然世界不会在这场冲突中受损！

english: ... so we landed the balloon in Taverley, and Auguste thanked me for helping him get his idea off the ground.
translation: ……所以我们把热气球降落在塔韦利村，奥古斯特感谢我帮助他实现了他的想法。

english: ... So once I had found all the parts for the machine, poor Ernest could be himself once more.
translation: ……所以在我找到机器的所有零件后，可怜的欧内斯特终于能恢复原样了。

english: That was a good deed. It is a terrible thing to be locked out of one's natural form.
translation: 那是一件好事。被锁在自己的自然形态之外是一件可怕的事情。

english: ... and I know they meant well, but I did have to explain to them that they couldn't just go 'borrowing' from other museums!
translation: ……我知道他们是好意，但我确实得跟他们解释，不能就这么去‘借’其他博物馆的东西！

english: Is it ever right to steal? It is a conundrum older than time, though I think in this case, the answer is clear.
translation: 偷窃永远是正确的吗？这是一个比时间还古老的难题，不过我认为在这种情况下，答案很明确。

english: ... the machine revealed that the cute creatures were actually Arposandran spies! I destroyed them, and King Narnode gave me a crystal seed that belonged to Oaknock the Engineer.
translation: ……机器显示那些可爱的生物实际上是阿波桑德拉的间谍！我摧毁了它们，纳诺德国王给了我一颗属于工程师奥克诺克的水晶种子。

english: ... So I defeated the tanglefoot and returned the Fairy Queen's Enchanted Secateurs to the Fairy Godfather.
translation: ……所以我击败了缠足怪，并将仙子女王的附魔修枝剪归还给了仙子教父。

english: These fairies seem to be well versed in the powers of nature.
translation: 这些仙子似乎对自然之力非常精通。

english: ... the Fairy Queen awoke, and we realised that the Godfather had betrayed her!
translation: ……仙子女王苏醒了，我们意识到教父背叛了她！

english: Politics is never straightforward.
translation: 政治从来都不简单。

english: ... So all three parts of the family crest were reunited.
translation: ……所以家徽的三个部分终于重聚了。

english: ...So despite the failure of my original task, Ali Morrisane was very happy about his nephew's fortunes.
translation: ……尽管我最初的任务失败了，但阿里.莫里桑对他侄子的运气非常满意。

english: ... and I defeated General Khazard, and won the Servils their freedom!
translation: ……我击败了卡扎德将军，为瑟维尔人赢得了自由！

english: ... and so it turned out that the archive was never completed. Everything Metzli did was for nothing...
translation: ……结果档案从未完成。梅茨利所做的一切都白费了……

english: She let her greed consume her, and paid the ultimate price.
translation: 她让贪婪吞噬了自己，并付出了最终的代价。

english: ... and after I had won the fishing contest, the Dwarves let me go under White Wolf Mountain.
translation: ……在我赢得钓鱼大赛后，矮人们让我通过了白狼山。

english: Fishing? A strange test of worthiness to pass through an underground tunnel!
translation: 钓鱼？一个通过地下隧道的奇怪考验！

english: ... I think I did something with a drunken dwarf... but I can't remember what.
translation: ……我想我和一个醉酒的矮人做了点什么……但我记不清是什么了。

english: You must be careful not to let drink muddle your brain!
translation: 你必须小心别让酒弄昏你的大脑！

english: ... and so I took the hammer to Undor and he used it to repair the Doors of Dinh.
translation: ……于是我把锤子交给昂多尔，他用它修复了丁之门。

english: ... and that's how we defeated the Jormungand once and for all!
translation: ……就这样，我们一劳永逸地击败了耶梦加得！

english: ... so I presented the head of the Troll King to the Burgher and he gave me his own helm!
translation: ……于是我把巨魔国王的头颅呈给镇长，他把他自己的头盔给了我！

english: ... and that was how I became an honourary member the Fremennik, and was given my Fremennik name, [Fremennik name].
translation: ……就这样，我成为了弗雷梅尼克的名誉成员，并被赐予了我的弗雷梅尼克名字——[Fremennik name]。

english: ... so it seems that in trying to prevent it, the Old Ones managed to cause their extinction instead.
translation: ……看来，远古者们在试图阻止灭绝的过程中，反而导致了自身的灭绝。

english: ... So the garden at Varrock palace is all my work!
translation: ……所以，维洛克城宫殿的花园全是我一手打造的！

english: It is good that you can take time from slaying and adventuring to grow a beautiful garden.
translation: 你能从杀戮和冒险中抽出时间来培育一座美丽的花园，这很好。

english: ...I returned Fluffs safely to Gertrude, and then she gave me a cat of my own!
translation: ……我把小绒球安全地送回了格特鲁德身边，然后她送了我一只属于自己的猫！

english: Cats are one of the most mysterious creatures of Guthix. I hope you take your responsibility seriously.
translation: 猫是古斯最神秘的生物之一。希望你能认真对待你的责任。

english: ... and so I ended up having to make a pretend head. Not exactly how I expected things to go, but at least I managed to keep my head up throughout it all!
translation: ……结果我不得不做了一个假头。虽然和预想的不太一样，但至少我全程都昂首挺胸！

english: ... So the people of Port Phasmatys were finally able to rest.
translation: ……于是，法斯提斯港的人们终于可以安息了。

english: ... So the statue in Keldagrim was rebuilt, and I witnessed a meeting of the Consortium of mining companies.
translation: ……于是，凯尔达格林城的雕像被重建了，我还目睹了采矿公司联合会的会议。

english: I have a feeling that Keldagrim will be the setting of many great adventures for you.
translation: 我有一种预感，凯尔达格林城将成为你许多伟大冒险的舞台。

english: ... So the goblins ended up wearing the armour colour they had to start off with!
translation: ……结果，哥布林们最终穿上了他们一开始就该穿的盔甲颜色！

english: Poor silly goblins! Their race had such potential, if only they could rise above their petty squabbles.
translation: 可怜的蠢哥布林！他们的种族本有如此潜力，只要他们能超越那些琐碎的争吵。

english: ... and I had to reprogram the golem before it would believe that the demon was dead.
translation: ……我不得不重新编程魔像，它才相信恶魔已经死了。

english: I remember well the battle of Uzer.
translation: 我清楚地记得乌泽尔之战。

english: ... Glough fled like the coward he really is, and the Grand Tree was saved!
translation: ……格劳夫像他真正的懦夫本性一样逃跑了，大树家园得救了！

english: ... so I defeated Mi-Gor's barrel-chested bodyguard, and the monks were saved.
translation: ……于是我击败了米戈尔那膀大腰圆的保镖，僧侣们得救了。

english: ... and once I'd chopped down the beanstalk, Sylas let me keep Rupert's helmet.
translation: ……等我砍倒了豆茎，赛拉斯让我留下了鲁伯特的头盔。

english: Your tales are often very curious, [player name].
translation: 你的故事往往非常奇特，[player name]。

english: ... So that was how I gave Bert a hand solving the murder and returned the wizard's head to solve the riddle of the ever full sand pits!
translation: ……我就是这样帮伯特解决了谋杀案，并归还了魔法师头颅，解开了永不枯竭的沙坑之谜！

english: A victim dies and a murderer is punished. That is balance.
translation: 受害者死去，凶手受到惩罚。这就是平衡。

english: ... and from the legendary crystals I cut a salve shard to fight the undead.
translation: ……我从传说中的水晶中切割出一块萨鲁夫碎片，用来对抗亡灵。

english: ... So that was how I foiled the cultists in their plan to resurrect Hazeel.
translation: ……于是，我挫败了邪教徒复活哈兹尔的计划。

english: ... So that was how I helped return Hazeel to his followers.
translation: ……于是，我帮助哈兹尔回到了他的追随者身边。

english: So the vile Mahjarrat still walk the earth above? Then Zamorak's defeat was not as thorough as I had thought.
translation: 这么说，邪恶的玛哈加特仍然在地上行走？看来萨莫拉克的失败并不如我所想的那样彻底。

english: ... but it all went wrong and Itzla was captured!
translation: ……但一切都出了差错，伊茨拉被俘了！

english: ... So after I had retrieved all the items, I became a member of the Heroes' Guild!
translation: ……等我收集齐所有物品后，我成为了英雄公会的成员！

english: ... and out of all the Knights of the Round Table, it was I who found the Holy Grail.
translation: ...在所有的圆桌骑士中，是我找到了圣杯。

english: ... and that was the end of the horror from the deep!
translation: ……深海惊魂就此终结！

english: ... and with the amulet I received, I could understand the language of cats!
translation: ……凭借收到的护身符，我能听懂猫的语言了！

english: It is a rare privilege to understand the language of those beings. You should listen carefully to all that they say - but not believe too much of it.
translation: 理解那些生灵的语言是一种罕见的特权。你应该仔细聆听它们所说的一切——但不要太相信。

english: ... and I was rewarded for all my help.
translation: ……我所有的帮助都得到了回报。

english: ... It took some time, but I finally got all four beads back, and Mizgog gave me my reward.
translation: ……花了一些时间，但我终于找回了全部四颗珠子，米兹戈格给了我奖励。

english: Imps! I remember the age of great war, when armies of Zamorak's imps bloodied the ankles of the other gods' creatures.
translation: 小鬼！我记得大战的年代，萨莫拉克的小鬼军团染红了其他神祇造物的脚踝。

english: ... Veliaf was very impressed by the 'Rod of Ivandis', and I can use it to kill Juves and the Juvinates!
translation: ……维利亚夫对‘伊万迪斯之杖’印象深刻，我可以用它来杀死朱维斯和朱维纳特！

english: ... So I suppose it was my fault that the young members of the Myreque were killed by Vanstrom.
translation: ……所以我想，是我害得迈雷克的年轻成员们被范斯特罗姆杀死的。

english: ... and once I had gathered all the herbs, Trufitus Shakaya was able to commune with his gods.
translation: ……等我收集齐所有草药后，特鲁菲图斯.沙卡亚就能与他的神明沟通了。

english: ... and that's how Kourend came to be ruled by a king again. It just wasn't quite the king we initially expected.
translation: ……就这样，库兰德王国再次由一位国王统治。只不过这位国王并非我们最初预想的那位。

english: ... meanwhile Merlin used his magic to eject the Sinclairs from Camelot. King Arthur rewarded me for saving him.
translation: ……与此同时，梅林用他的魔法将辛克莱尔家族逐出了卡梅洛特。亚瑟王为救了他而奖赏了我。

english: ... So that was how I found the Imcando Dwarves and got the Knight a new sword.
translation: ……于是，我找到了伊姆坎多矮人，并为骑士弄到了一把新剑。

english: ... Oldak and I escaped from Yu'biusk before the portal closed, but Zanik was trapped in the box.
translation: ……奥达克和我在传送门关闭前从尤比斯克逃了出来，但扎尼克被困在了箱子里。

english: ... and when I had completed all the tasks, I became a member of the Legends' Guild!
translation: ……当我完成所有任务后，我成为了传说公会的成员！

english: ... and when I entered the door carrying the Dramen Staff, I was transported to a whole new world -- a world populated by magical fairies!
translation: ……当我手持德拉门法杖走进那扇门时，我被传送到了一个全新的世界——一个由魔法仙女居住的世界！

english: ... So Sigmund was dismissed, and the duke and ruler of the cave goblins signed a peace treaty.
translation: ……于是西格蒙德被解职，公爵与洞穴哥布林的统治者签署了和平条约。

english: The Dorgeshuun goblins have been good neighbors during my vigil here. They are a timid race, but not cowardly, and I am glad they have the peace they desire.
translation: 在我守护于此期间，多尔戈什恩哥布林一直是好邻居。他们是个胆小的种族，但并不懦弱，我很高兴他们得到了渴望的和平。

english: ... so I defeated my mirror image, won the respect of the Moon Clan and persuaded them to communicate with the Fremenniks!
translation: ……于是我击败了自己的镜像，赢得了月之族的尊重，并说服他们与弗雷梅尼克人沟通！

english: The Moon Clan's reliance on magic is no more balanced than the Fremennik's hatred of it.
translation: 月之族对魔法的依赖，与弗雷梅尼克人对魔法的憎恨一样，都是不平衡的。

english: ... while Snowflake and My Arm live happily together in Weiss.
translation: ……而雪花和"我的手臂"在韦斯幸福地生活在一起。

english: ... so that's how the Outpost was saved and converted into a museum.
translation: ……于是前哨站得以保全并改建成了博物馆。

english: By remembering the past, one should be able to avoid repeating its mistakes. Yet the mortal races show no sign of abandoning their obsession with war and bloodshed.
translation: 铭记过去，应当能够避免重蹈覆辙。然而凡俗种族似乎毫无放弃对战争和杀戮痴迷的迹象。

english: ... and that's how we brought kebabs to Varlamore!
translation: ……就这样，我们把烤肉串带到了瓦拉莫尔！

english: ... and when I told King Arthur that I had single-handedly freed Merlin from his crystal prison, he made me a Knight of the Round Table!
translation: ...当我告诉亚瑟王我独自将梅林从他的水晶监狱中解救出来时，他封我为圆桌骑士！

english: ... but I was able to stab the killer with her own knife!
translation: ……但我用她自己的刀刺中了那个杀手！

english: A masked killer slashing vulnerable young people in a deserted mansion? Is that what stories have become in this day and age? How formulaic!
translation: 一个蒙面杀手在废弃宅邸中袭击脆弱的年轻人？这就是当代的故事吗？多么程式化！

english: ... and the monks threw a big birthday party for the child, with lots of wine.
translation: ……僧侣们为那个孩子举办了一场盛大的生日派对，备有大量的酒。

english: I hope they supplied something more suitable for the child to drink.
translation: 我希望他们为孩子准备了更合适的饮品。

english: ... so I defeated the Jungle Demon and stopped the Monkeys' plot to take over Karamja.
translation: ……于是我击败了绿魔，阻止了猴子们占领卡拉姆詹岛的阴谋。

english: I see they couldn't make a monkey out of you!
translation: 看来他们没能耍到你！

english: Well, actually, I was a monkey for a bit.
translation: 嗯，其实，有那么一会儿我确实变成了猴子。

english: ... so I defeated Glough in his mutant form and prevented a war. King Narnode Shareen & King Awowogei signed a peace treaty.
translation: ……于是我击败了变异形态的格劳夫，阻止了一场战争。纳罗德.沙林国王与阿沃盖国王签署了和平条约。

english: Glough's evil plans always threaten to upset the balance of our world. I am pleased you were able to stop him.
translation: 格劳夫的邪恶计划总是威胁着世界的平衡。我很高兴你阻止了他。

english: ... I was too late to save the chieftain's daughter, but at least I gave her a proper burial.
translation: ……我来不及拯救酋长的女儿，但至少我给了她一个体面的葬礼。

english: Brief is life, but more precious if its passing is properly honoured.
translation: 生命短暂，但如果逝去能得到恰当的尊重，便更加珍贵。

english: ... So that's how I found out about the lost temple in the mountains that the mourners were searching for.
translation: ……于是，我发现了哀悼者们在山中寻找的失落神殿。

english: ... What kind of twisted mind would come up with the light-beam puzzle in that temple?
translation: ……到底什么扭曲的脑子才会想出那座神殿里的光线谜题？

english: ... and that's how I solved the murder of Lord Sinclair.
translation: ……我就是这样破获了辛克莱尔庄园领主的谋杀案。

english: ... My Arm is still up on that rooftop, growing goutweed in his little farming patch!
translation: ……"我的手臂"还在那个屋顶上，在他的小种植地里种痛风草呢！

english: It is good that a troll wishes to study the complex skill that is Farming.
translation: 一个巨魔想要学习农业这门复杂的技能，这很好。

english: ... My Arm carried on growing goutweed in his little farming patch on that rooftop, until Drunken Dwarf's Leg took over.
translation: ……"我的手臂"继续在那个屋顶上的小种植地里种痛风草，直到醉酒矮人的腿接手。

english: The names of trolls never cease to amaze me.
translation: 巨魔的名字总是让我惊叹不已。

english: ... thus Filliman Tarlock became a Nature Spirit!
translation: ……于是，菲利曼.塔洛克变成了自然之灵！

english: That is a fitting reward for a dedicated servant of Guthix. Thank you for helping him.
translation: 对于一位虔诚的古斯仆从来说，这是应得的奖赏。感谢你帮助了他。

english: ... So that was how I helped Filliman Tarlock transform into a Nature Spirit.
translation: ……于是，我帮助菲利曼.塔洛克变成了自然之灵。

english: It is good that you have helped a servant of Guthix to his rest.
translation: 你帮助了一位古斯的仆从安息，很好。

english: ... and so it turned out it wasn't actually Verzik at all. It was a nylocas!
translation: ……结果发现其实根本不是维尔齐克，而是一只尼洛卡斯蛛！

english: ... and when I had fixed the telescope, I looked through and saw the stars.
translation: ……等我修好了望远镜，我透过它看到了星星。

english: It is long since I have seen the stars...
translation: 我已经很久没有看到星星了……

english: ... where I found a note from Ulfric Longbeard and some treasure!
translation: ……在那里我找到了乌尔弗里克.长须的笔记和一些宝藏！

english: ... I still can't believe how long that 'one small favour' took me!I ended up walking all over the world doing small favours for all and sundry!
translation: ……我还是不敢相信那个‘小小的恩惠’花了我那么长时间！我最终跑遍了整个世界，为所有人做各种小恩惠！

english: ... so even though Will and Anne got away, at least I survived the ordeal.
translation: ……虽然威尔和安妮逃走了，但至少我挺过了这场磨难。

english: ... the room filled up with gas and I nearly died, but Hazelmere came to my rescue.
translation: ……房间里充满了毒气，我差点死了，但黑兹尔米尔救了我。

english: A truly exciting tailof failing and needing to be rescued.
translation: 一个关于失败和需要救援的真实精彩故事。

english: ... and whilst we managed to reset the seal, Eyatlalli still needs my help to keep the Moons of Peril in check.
translation: ……虽然我们成功重置了封印，但埃亚特拉利仍然需要我帮助牵制灾厄之月。

english: A nagua? It has been a long time since I last heard of their kind...
translation: 纳瓜？我很久没有听说过他们的族类了……

english: ... and when I dug in the middle of the park in Falador, I found the pirate's treasure!
translation: ……当我在法拉多城的公园中央挖掘时，我找到了海盗的宝藏！

english: Such is ever the folly of pirates, the bury their loot in the ground so that another can dig it up.
translation: 海盗总是如此愚蠢，把战利品埋进土里，好让另一个人挖出来。

english: ... and that was how I rescued Elena from West Ardougne.
translation: ……就这样，我从西阿多尼城救出了埃琳娜。

english: ... but using my new goggles, I was able to avoid the acidic attack of the Sourhog and I came out victorious.
translation: ……但借助我的新护目镜，我避开了酸猪的酸性攻击并取得了胜利。

english: ... But with Drezel's help I was able to purify the Salve.
translation: ……但在德雷泽尔的帮助下，我净化了萨鲁夫。

english: ... and I had to disguise Prince Ali in order to smuggle him out!
translation: ……我不得不给阿里王子伪装，以便把他偷运出去！

english: ... so I guess I'll never be short on crowbars again.
translation: ……所以我猜我再也不会缺撬棍了。

english: ... so Councillor Hughes was arrested, and Lady Piscarilius rewarded me for my help.
translation: ...于是休斯议员被捕了，皮斯卡里琉斯女士奖励了我的帮助。

english: ... So I fetched all the bones the Odd Old Man wanted, and he gave me a reward!
translation: ……于是我取来了怪异的老人想要的所有骨头，他给了我一份奖励！

english: What could that man have wanted all those bones for? Collecting that many bones cannot be a balanced activity.
translation: 那个人要那么多骨头做什么？收集那么多骨头肯定不是一种平衡的活动。

english: ... So I fetched all the bones on the old man's wish-list, as well as the ones I'd brought him earlier.
translation: ……于是我找齐了老人愿望清单上的所有骨头，以及我先前带给他的那些。

english: ... Those rat-catchers are odd people. But by the end of it I had caught a huge number of rats all over Gielinor!
translation: ……那些捕鼠人都是怪人。但到最后，我在吉列诺各地抓到了大量的老鼠！

english: Rats are a highly unbalanced creature and it is right that their numbers be controlled.
translation: 老鼠是一种非常不平衡的生物，控制它们的数量是正确的。

english: ... So after I had freed all the dinner guests I was finally able to face the Culinaromancer and put an end to his mad schemes!
translation: ... 所以在我把所有晚宴宾客都解救出来后，我终于能直面烹饪大师，终结他那些疯狂的阴谋了！

english: That evil wizard's time spells sent a ripple through the fabric of balance. I am glad he is no longer at large!
translation: 那个邪恶魔法师的时间法术在平衡的织物上撕开了一道裂痕。我很高兴他不再逍遥法外了！

english: ... So I figured out their weird puzzles, and the Temple Knights asked me to join as an initiate member!
translation: ... 所以我解开了他们那些古怪的谜题，然后圣殿骑士团邀请我成为预备成员！

english: I have heard tales of these 'Temple Knights' from many years past. Be wary, their motivations are not what they might lead you to believe.
translation: 我多年前就听说过这些‘圣殿骑士’的传闻。要小心，他们的动机并不像他们让你相信的那样简单。

english: ... I returned to tell King Lathas that the assassination was successful, and he rewarded me.
translation: ... 我回去告诉拉萨斯国王刺杀成功了，他奖励了我。

english: ... and that was how I negotiated peace between frogs and humans.
translation: ... 我就是这样在青蛙和人类之间谈判达成和平的。

english: Forgive me, [player name], but that story was quite... unusual.
translation: 请原谅我，[player name]，但那个故事实在有点……不寻常。

english: ... and once I returned the skull, the ghost was able to rest.
translation: ... 我把头骨归还后，那个幽灵终于安息了。

english: A strange attachment to an item that has no use after one's death.
translation: 对一件死后毫无用处的东西产生奇怪的执念。

english: ... I gave the message to Romeo, but he misunderstood, so they never were together.
translation: ... 我把口信带给了罗密欧，但他误解了，所以他们最终没能在一起。

english: Never was a story of more woeThat this of Juliet and her Romeo.
translation: 从未有过比这更悲伤的故事，那就是朱丽叶和她的罗密欧。

english: ... and when I planted the shard, it grew into a crystal tree!
translation: ...当我种下碎片时，它长成了一棵水晶树！

english: ... So I showed that the war was based on a misunderstanding, and now Miscellania and Etceteria were at peace again!
translation: ... 所以我证明了那场战争源于一场误会，现在米斯凯尼亚和埃西特利亚岛又恢复了和平！

english: War? What is it good for?
translation: 战争？它有什么好处？

english: Absolutely nothing!
translation: 绝对没有！

english: ... So that was how I helped keep the zombie pirates drunk!
translation: ... 我就是这样让那些僵尸海盗一直醉醺醺的！

english: Drunken zombie pirates? What is the world coming to?
translation: 喝醉的僵尸海盗？这世界到底要变成什么样？

english: ... So I brought Aubury's notes to Sedridor the Head Wizard, and from then on I was able to mine Rune Essence.
translation: ... 所以我把奥布里的笔记带给首席魔法师塞德里多，从那以后我就能开采符文精华了。

english: So the mortals above have discovered magic once more? Very interesting.
translation: 这么说，上界的凡人再次发现了魔法？非常有趣。

english: ... I would never have thought that three scorpions would take that long to find!
translation: ... 我万万没想到找三只蝎子要花那么长时间！

english: ... Alan was convinced by the new egg, but he then may have had a little accident himself...
translation: ... 艾伦被那颗新蛋说服了，但他自己后来可能也出了点小意外……

english: ... and that was how I rescued Caroline's family from the Sea Slugs.
translation: ... 我就是这样从海蛞蝓手中救出了卡罗琳的家人。

english: ... and so the assassin captured Jhallan and teleported him away.
translation: ... 于是刺客抓住了贾兰，并用传送术把他带走了。

english: Be very careful of the Mahjarrat, [player name]. None of them are to be trusted.
translation: 要非常小心玛哈加特，[player name]。他们没有一个值得信任。

english: ... So Mort'ton returned pretty much to normal, and I was able to put the shades to rest.
