translation: ... 所以莫顿镇基本恢复了正常，我也能让那些阴魂安息了。

english: ... So Denath was Agrith-Naar all along! But I managed to summon the demon again and slay him.
translation: ... 原来德纳斯一直都是阿格里斯-纳尔！但我设法再次召唤出那个恶魔并杀死了他。

english: Agrith-Naar was one of the demons my master banished at the end of the great war. It seems he found a way to work around the ban on direct intervention.
translation: 阿格里斯-纳尔是我主人在大战末期驱逐的恶魔之一。看来他找到了绕过直接干预禁令的方法。

english: ... and that was how I saved the townsfolk from the custodians!
translation: ... 我就是这样从看守者手中救出了镇民！

english: Ever curious, the continued evolution of creatures, isn't it?
translation: 生物的持续进化总是令人好奇，不是吗？

english: ... and I incinerated the bones of the sheep in the furnace.
translation: ... 我把羊的骨头在熔炉里烧成了灰。

english: ... Shearing all those sheep was hard work, but the pay was good!
translation: ... 剪那些羊毛是件苦差事，但报酬不错！

english: Nature gave sheep their wool for a reason, you know. I hope they were not too cold.
translation: 大自然赋予羊羊毛是有原因的，你知道吧。希望它们不会太冷。

english: ... So that's how I helped return the Shield of Arrav.
translation: ... 我就是这样帮忙归还了阿拉夫之盾。

english: ... So what Rashiliyia wanted all along was to be reunited with her son in the afterlife.
translation: ... 所以拉希利娅一直想要的，就是在来世与她的儿子团聚。

english: ... but Lord Drakan was too strong, and we were unable to defeat him. The Myreque were defeated and Safalaan was taken!
translation: ... 但德拉肯领主太强大了，我们无法击败他。迈雷克被打败了，萨法拉恩也被抓走了！

english: ... and once I finished making Kovac his sword, he gave me full access to the Foundry
translation: ... 我帮科瓦克做好他的剑后，他就让我完全使用铸造厂了。

english: ... when I told Sir Tiffy that I had accidentally freed the Mother Mallum, he promoted me to the rank of Proselyte within the Temple Knights.
translation: ... 当我告诉蒂菲爵士我不小心放走了马勒姆母亲时，他把我提升为圣殿骑士团中的改宗者。

english: That was a strange response to such an unfortunate event. But the motives of the Temple Knights have always been incomprehensibly unbalanced.
translation: 对如此不幸的事件，这真是个奇怪的反应。但圣殿骑士的动机向来难以理解地失衡。

english: ... and so the Iorwerth elves were finally defeated and the clan elders restored the city of Prifddinas!
translation: ... 于是伊奥尔斯精灵终于被击败，部族长老们重建了普里夫迪纳斯城！

english: ...So I defeated all the monsters in Tolna's subconscious and he escaped from the rift.
translation: ... 所以我击败了托尔纳潜意识中的所有怪物，他逃离了裂隙。

english: The most fearsome monsters are to be found in the darkness of our own minds.
translation: 最可怕的怪物存在于我们内心的黑暗之中。

english: ... So it turned out that the people of Nardah were dying of thirst because the spirits of the Elid had cursed them for turning away from their goddess.
translation: ... 结果发现，那尔达城的人快渴死了，是因为埃利德之灵诅咒了他们，因为他们背弃了他们的女神。

english: It is a terrible thing for people to turn away from their religion. I think the spirits taught the town a lesson.
translation: 人们背弃自己的宗教是一件可怕的事。我想那些精灵给这个城镇上了一课。

english: ... So the Wise Old Man said it was time for him to retire, and he left the Colony and went home. He gave me loads of XP, but he wouldn't let me have his hat!
translation: ... 所以老智者说他该退休了，就离开了殖民地回家去了。他给了我大量经验值，但不肯把他的帽子给我！

english: A hat is just a hat, [player name].
translation: 帽子就是帽子，[player name]。

english: ... So that was how I helped the people of Tai Bwo Wannai village return.
translation: ... 我就是这样帮助泰博瓦纳村的村民返回家园的。

english: ...now Bob and Neite are very happy together!
translation: ... 现在鲍勃和奈特在一起非常幸福！

english: Bob the Cat? I have heard of that strange creature but have never been able to fathom him. It is no small achievement for you to be able to!
translation: 鲍勃猫？我听说过那个奇怪的生物，但一直无法理解他。你能理解他，这可不是小成就！

english: ... So Bob and Neite were very happy together, at least for a while.
translation: ... 鲍勃和奈特在一起非常幸福，至少有一段时间是这样。

english: The loss of a friend is never easy. However, you should always remember to be thankful of the time you had together.
translation: 失去朋友从来都不容易。然而，你应该永远记得感激你们在一起的时光。

english: ... and Lord Shayzien ordered an investigation into the disappearance of Phileas.
translation: ...谢兹恩领主下令调查菲利亚斯的失踪。

english: ... and Lord Shayzien ordered an investigation into the disappearance of Phileas, but in the end, it turned out he was the one responsible!
translation: ...谢兹恩领主下令调查菲利亚斯的失踪，但最后，结果发现他才是罪魁祸首！

english: ... and Safalaan rewarded me for defeating Ranis and bringing a true taste of hope to the people of Meiyerditch.
translation: ... 萨法拉恩奖励了我，因为我击败了拉尼斯，给迈尔迪奇的人民带来了真正的希望的味道。

english: ... so you said you'd look after my bowl for me, and let me access the Tears if I kept telling you stories.
translation: ... 所以你说你会替我保管碗，只要我继续给你讲故事，就让我收集眼泪。

english: I knew that story already, in fact, but I suppose your own perspective of the events is a valid tale in itself.
translation: 其实那个故事我早就知道了，但我想，你从自己的角度讲述这些事件，本身也是一个有价值的故事。

english: ... luckily for us, the Guardians of the Rift are now working to keep the Abyss at bay. I just hope we can find out how to close the rift permanently.
translation: ... 幸运的是，裂隙守护者现在正在努力阻止深渊的侵袭。我只希望我们能找到永久关闭裂隙的方法。

english: ... I killed Lucien and banished him from the world!
translation: ... 我杀死了卢西安，把他从这个世界上驱逐了出去！

english: ... Lucien said that the Staff of Armadyl I gave him had made him more powerful.
translation: ... 卢西安说我给他的阿玛杜尔杖让他变得更加强大。

english: ... So that was how I became [King/Queen] of Miscellania!
translation: ... 我就是这样成为米斯凯尼亚的[King/Queen]的！

english: ... Ana wasn't too happy to be cooped up in that barrel! But at least I got her out of the mining camp.
translation: ... 安娜可不太高兴被关在那个桶里！但至少我让她离开了采矿营地。

english: ... and the homunculus now lives in the basement of the Tower, creating living creatures of its own.
translation: ... 那个人造人现在住在塔的地下室里，自己创造着生物。

english: The alchemists walked a dangerous path when they created that homunculus. I am glad that events ended well for the creature.
translation: 炼金术士们创造那个人造人时走上了一条危险的道路。我很高兴这个生物最终结局不错。

english: ... and King Bolren thanked me for defeating the warlord and returning the orbs to the gnome people.
translation: ... 博尔伦国王感谢我击败了军阀，并把宝珠归还给了地精人民。

english: ... So I returned the totem, and the Rantuki tribe rewarded me for my help.
translation: ... 所以我归还了图腾，兰图基部落奖励了我的帮助。

english: ... So Ug and Aga lived happily ever after.
translation: ... 乌格和阿加从此幸福地生活在一起。

english: ... and after I had rescued Godric, Dunstan gave me the Law Talisman as a reward!
translation: ... 我救出戈德里克后，邓斯坦给了我律法护符作为奖励！

english: ... and that was how I helped the tortugans of the Great Conch deal with their gryphon problem.
translation: ... 我就是这样帮助大法螺的海龟们解决他们的狮鹫问题的。

english: ... so I was able to defend the Teomat, but someone attacked the Teokan anyway!
translation: ... 所以我成功保卫了特奥马特修道院，但还是有人袭击了特奥坎！

english: ... I don't know who put all those traps in the underground pass!
translation: ... 我不知道是谁在地下通道里设下了那么多陷阱！

english: ... and once the vampyre was dead, the people of Draynor no longer lived in fear.
translation: ... 那个吸血鬼死后，德雷诺的人们不再生活在恐惧之中。

english: ... and after I finally managed to track him down, let me tell you, that Solus Dellagar fellow was almost as powerful as he was insane!
translation: ... 我最终设法追踪到他之后，我跟你说，那个索卢斯.德拉加家伙，他的强大几乎和他的疯狂不相上下！

english: Yes, it seems he sacrificed his sanity for power. Power often comes with a cost, and the highest cost is often the one you do not immediately see...
translation: 是的，他似乎为了力量牺牲了理智。力量往往伴随着代价，而最高的代价往往是你无法立刻看到的……

english: ... and with the shield generator working, the ogres could never threaten Yanille again.
translation: ... 有了护盾发电机，食人魔再也无法威胁亚尼勒城了。

english: ... and that was how I retrieved the treasure from the waterfall.
translation: ... 我就是这样从瀑布取回了宝藏。

english: ... so King Roald was freed from Surok's spell, and Rat thanked me for all my help.
translation: ……于是罗尔德国王从苏洛克的法术中解脱出来，老鼠感谢了我所有的帮助。

english: ... but Lucien took the Stone of Jas and teleported away!
translation: ... 但卢西安拿走了贾斯之石，然后用传送术逃走了！

english: The last time a Mahjarrat was in possession of the Stone, this world saw destruction unlike anything imaginable. Still, good may yet come of this. We shall see.
translation: 上一次玛哈加特拥有这块石头时，这个世界遭受了难以想象的毁灭。不过，这件事或许仍能带来好的结果。我们拭目以待。

english: ... All that trouble just to get a ball out of someone's garden!
translation: ... 费了那么大劲，就为了从别人的花园里拿个球出来！

english: It is often hard to know how long a task will take when we begin it.
translation: 我们开始一项任务时，往往很难知道它会花多长时间。

english: ... and once I got her all the ingredients, Hetty's potion increased my magical power!
translation: ... 我帮她找齐所有材料后，海蒂的药水增强了我的魔法力量！

english: I see you are on your way to becoming strong in the magical arts.
translation: 我看你正在变得精通魔法技艺。

english: ... and in the end I managed to solve the clues and find the treasure for Veos.
translation: ... 最后我成功解开了线索，为维奥斯找到了宝藏。

english: ... Those Zogres were disgusting! But I learned how to fight them with brutal arrows and disease balm.
translation: ... 那些佐格雷食人魔真恶心！但我学会了用野蛮箭和疾病药膏来对付他们。

english: Zombie Ogres!? Some of the foulest creatures of Zamorak. In the great wars the zogre armies could repel the forces of Saradomin with their stench alone!
translation: 僵尸食人魔！？萨拉多斯手下最邪恶的生物之一。在大战中，佐格雷食人魔军队仅凭他们的恶臭就能击退萨拉多明的军队！

english: Before you can collect the Tears of Guthix you must make a bowl out of the stone in the cave on the south of the chasm.
translation: 在你收集古斯之泪之前，你必须用深渊南边洞穴里的石头做一个碗。

english: But I don't know how to reach the cave!
translation: 但我不知道怎么到达那个洞穴！

english: Myriad and beautiful were the creatures and civilizations of the early ages of the world. Gielinor was a work of art, shaped lovingly over the millennia by the creative mind of Guthix.
translation: 世界早期时代的生物和文明是多样而美丽的。吉莱诺是一件艺术品，是古斯在数千年的岁月中用创造力精心塑造而成的。

english: Perhaps you should use it with a chisel, rather than with my face.
translation: 也许你应该用凿子来对付它，而不是用我的脸。

english: I have a bowl.
translation: 我有一个碗。

english: I will keep your bowl for you, so that you may collect the tears many times in the future.
translation: 我会替你保管你的碗，这样你以后就可以多次收集眼泪了。

english: Now... tell me another story, and I will let you collect the tears for the first time.
translation: 现在……再给我讲个故事，我就让你第一次收集眼泪。

english: I seek a hero to go on an important mission!
translation: 我正在寻找一位英雄，去执行一项重要任务！

english: I am a mighty hero!
translation: 我就是一位强大的英雄！

english: I require the Staff of Armadyl. But if you wish to seek it for me, you must free up some inventory space so that I can give you what you need.
translation: 我需要阿玛杜尔杖。但如果你愿意替我去找，你必须腾出一些背包空间，这样我才能给你需要的东西。

english: I require the Staff of Armadyl. It is in the deserted Temple of Ikov, near Hemenster, north east of here.
translation: 我需要阿玛杜尔杖。它就在废弃的伊科夫神殿里，靠近赫门斯特，从这里往东北方向。

english: Take care hero! There is a dangerous monster somewhere in the temple!
translation: 小心，英雄！神殿里有一只危险的怪物！

english: Why can't you get it yourself?
translation: 为什么你不自己去拿？

english: The guardians of the Staff of Armadyl fear me!
translation: 阿玛杜尔杖的守护者们畏惧我！

english: They have set up a magical barrier which even my power cannot overcome!
translation: 他们设置了一道魔法屏障，连我的力量都无法突破！

english: That sounds like a laugh!
translation: 听起来挺有趣的！

english: It's not as easy as it sounds. The monster can only be killed with a weapon of ice. There are many other dangers.
translation: 可没听起来那么容易。那只怪物只能用冰制成的武器杀死。还有很多其他危险。

english: I'm up for it!
translation: 我准备好了！

english: I shall give you a pendant. Without it you will not be able to enter the Chamber of Fear.
translation: 我会给你一条吊坠。没有它，你将无法进入恐惧密室。

english: Here is my pendant. Now, I cannot stay here much longer. Meet me in my house, across the river south-east from Edgeville. It is next to the so-called Grand Exchange.
translation: 这是我的吊坠。现在，我不能在这里久留了。到我的房子里来找我，就在边陲镇东南方向河对岸。它就在所谓的大交易所旁边。

english: I'll pass this time.
translation: 这次就算了。

english: What's the reward?
translation: 有什么奖励？

english: I see you are the mercenary type.
translation: 我看你是雇佣兵类型的。

english: It's a living.
translation: 谋生而已。

english: I will reward you well if you bring me the staff.
translation: 如果你把法杖带来给我，我会好好奖励你。

english: Oh no! Sounds far too dangerous!
translation: 哦不！听起来太危险了！

english: Wimp! Call yourself a hero?! My daughter is more of a hero than you!
translation: 懦夫！还敢自称英雄？！我女儿都比你像英雄！

english: I told you not to meet me here again! Soon I will go to my house, across the river south-east from Edgeville. It is next to the so-called Grand Exchange.
translation: 我告诉过你不要再在这里见我了！我很快会去我的房子，就在边陲镇东南方向河对岸。它就在所谓的大交易所旁边。

english: Imbecile!
translation: 蠢货！

english: Sorry! Can you remind me of my mission?
translation: 抱歉！能提醒一下我的任务是什么吗？

english: My patience grows thin hero!
translation: 我的耐心快耗尽了，英雄！

english: I need the Staff of Armadyl. It's in the Temple of Ikov, near Hemenster, north east of here.
translation: 我需要阿玛杜尔杖。它在伊科夫神殿里，靠近赫门斯特，从这里往东北方向。

english: Ow! Hot! Hot!
translation: 嗷！好烫！好烫！

english: Hehe! We see you're in a pickle!
translation: 嘿嘿！看来你遇到麻烦了啊！

english: Wants to be getting over the nasty lava do we?
translation: 想要跨过那讨厌的熔岩，是不是？

english: Nah, not bothered!
translation: 不，无所谓！

english: Hehe! Ye'll come back! They always come back!
translation: 嘿嘿！你会回来的！他们总是会回来的！

english: Yes we do!
translation: 我们确实会！

english: Mocking us are we? Clever one aren't we?
translation: 在嘲笑我们？你可真聪明啊？

english: I'm knowing some magic trickesses! I could get over easy as that!
translation: 我可是会一些魔法小把戏的！我轻轻松松就能过去！

english: Don't tell them! They always come! They pester poor Winelda!
translation: 别告诉他们！他们老是来！他们烦扰可怜的温尔达！

english: If you're such a great witch, get me over!
translation: 如果你真是个了不起的女巫，就送我过去！

english: See! They pester Winelda!
translation: 看吧！他们烦扰温尔达！

english: I can do something for you!
translation: 我可以帮你做点什么！

english: Good! Don't pester! Help!
translation: 好！别烦人！帮忙！

english: Get Winelda 20 limpwurt roots for my pot.
translation: 去给温尔达拿20个软木草根来下锅。

english: Then we shows them some magic!
translation: 然后我们就给他们露一手魔法！

english: Yes I do!
translation: 我当然会！

english: Have you got roots for poor Winelda?
translation: 你给可怜的温尔达带来树根了吗？

english: How many did you need again?
translation: 你刚才说要多少个来着？

english: We needs 20 Limpwurt roots for pot.
translation: 我们需要20个软木草根来下锅。

english: I've got some limpwurt roots!
translation: 我有一些软木草根！

english: We needs 20 rooteses!
translation: 我们需要20个根！

english: I've got you the limpwurt roots!
translation: 我给你弄到软木草根了！

english: Good! Good! My potion is nearly ready! Bubble, bubble, toil and trouble!
translation: 好！好！我的药水快准备好了！咕噜咕噜，熬煮搅拌！

english: Now we shows them ours magic! Hold on tight!
translation: 现在给他们看看我们的魔法！抓紧了！

english: Thou is a foul agent of Lucien! Such an agent must die!
translation: 汝是卢西安的邪恶走狗！这样的走狗必须死！

english: Thou hast ventured deep into the tunnels, you have reached the temple of our master. It is many ages since a pilgrim has come here.
translation: 汝已深入隧道，到达了我们主人的神殿。已经有很多个时代没有朝圣者来到这里了。

english: I seek the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 我来寻找阿玛杜尔杖。

english: We are the guardians of the staff, our fathers were guardians and our fathers' fathers before that. Why dost thou seek it?
translation: 我们是法杖的守护者，我们的父辈是守护者，父辈的父辈也是。你为何要寻找它？

english: Lucien will give me a grand reward for it!
translation: 卢西安会给我丰厚的报酬！

english: Thou art working for that spawn of evil?! Fool! You must be cleansed to save your soul!
translation: 你为那个邪恶的幼体做事？！蠢货！你必须被净化以拯救你的灵魂！

english: How dare you call me a fool! I will work for whom I want!
translation: 你竟敢叫我蠢货！我想为谁工作就为谁工作！

english: We must cleanse the temple!
translation: 我们必须净化神殿！

english: I just thought of something I must do!
translation: 我突然想起有件事必须去做！

english: An agent of evil cannot be allowed to leave!
translation: 不能让邪恶的走狗离开！

english: You're right, it's time for my yearly bath.
translation: 你说得对，是时候洗我一年一次的澡了。

english: You have been cleansed!
translation: 你已被净化！

english: Lucien must not get hold of the staff! He would become too powerful!
translation: 卢西安绝不能拿到法杖！他会变得过于强大！

english: Hast thou come across the undead necromancer? It was he that raised an army of the undead against Varrock a generation ago. If you know where he is you can help us defeat him.
translation: 你可曾遇到过那个亡灵死灵法师？就是他在一代人之前召集了一支亡灵军队攻打维洛克城。如果你知道他在哪里，就能帮我们击败他。

english: Ok! I'll help!
translation: 好！我来帮忙！

english: So he is close by?
translation: 那么他就在附近？

english: He must be gaining in power again. If you can defeat him he will be banished from this plane for a while. You will need this pendant to attack him.
translation: 他一定又在积聚力量。如果你能击败他，他就会被暂时逐出这个位面。你需要这条吊坠才能攻击他。

english: No! I shall not turn against my employer!
translation: 不！我不会背叛我的雇主！

english: Fool! You will die for your sins!
translation: 蠢货！你将因你的罪孽而死！

english: I need time to think.
translation: 我需要时间思考。

english: Linger a while and be at peace.
translation: 稍作停留，安享片刻宁静。

english: The staff is sacred! You will not have it!
translation: 法杖是神圣的！你拿不到它！

english: I collect rare and powerful artefacts.
translation: 我收集稀有而强大的神器。

english: Your worldly greed has darkened your soul!
translation: 你世俗的贪婪已经玷污了你的灵魂！

english: Out of my way fool!
translation: 滚开，蠢货！

english: I may be a fool but I will not step aside!
translation: 我或许是个蠢货，但我不会让开！

english: Why not?!
translation: 为什么不让？！

english: Only members of our order are allowed to handle the staff.
translation: 只有我们教团的成员才允许触碰法杖。

english: Then you must die!
translation: 那你必须死！

english: You're right, I will go now.
translation: 你说得对，我现在就走。

english: That is a wise decision. Stay a while and let your soul be cleansed!
translation: 这是明智的决定。留下来片刻，让你的灵魂得到净化！

english: What are your kind and what are you doing here?
translation: 你们是什么种族，在这里做什么？

english: We are the Guardians of Armadyl. We have kept the temple safe for many ages. The evil in the dungeons seek what lies here. The Mahjarrat are the worst.
translation: 我们是阿玛杜尔的守护者。我们守护神殿已有许多时代。地牢中的邪恶之物觊觎着这里的东西。玛哈加特是最糟糕的。

english: What is the Armadyl?
translation: 什么是阿玛杜尔？

english: Armadyl is the god we serve. We have been charged with guarding his sacred arctifacts until he requires them.
translation: 阿玛杜尔是我们侍奉的神。我们受命守护他神圣的神器，直到他需要它们为止。

english: Ah ok, thanks.
translation: 哦，好的，谢谢。

english: Go in peace.
translation: 平安去吧。

english: Someone told me there were only three gods. Saradomin, Zamorak and Guthix.
translation: 有人告诉我只有三位神：萨拉多明、扎莫拉克和古斯。

english: Saradominists. Bleh. They only acknowledge those three. There are at least twenty gods!
translation: 萨拉多明信徒，哼。他们只承认那三位。实际上至少有二十位神！

english: Who are the Mahjarrat?
translation: 玛哈加特是谁？

english: They are ancient and powerful beings! They are very evil! It is said that they once dominated this plane of existence, Zamorak was supposedly of their blood. They are far fewer in number now.
translation: 他们是古老而强大的存在！他们非常邪恶！据说他们曾经统治过这个位面，扎莫拉克据信是他们的血脉。现在他们的数量少多了。

english: Some still have presence in this world in their liche forms. Mahjarrat such as Lucien and Azzanadra would become very powerful if they came into possession of the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 有些仍然以巫妖形态存在于这个世界。像卢西安和阿扎纳德拉这样的玛哈加特，如果得到阿玛杜尔杖，就会变得非常强大。

english: Did you say Lucien? It was Lucien that asked me to get the staff!
translation: 你刚才说卢西安？就是卢西安让我去拿法杖的！

english: You are a fool to be working for Lucien! Your soul must be cleansed to save you!
translation: 你为卢西安做事真是个蠢货！你的灵魂必须被净化才能拯救你！

english: I hope you're doing a good job then!
translation: 那就希望你们干得不错吧！

english: Do not fear! We are devoted to our charge!
translation: 别担心！我们对职责忠心耿耿！

english: Wow! You must be really old!
translation: 哇！那你一定非常老了吧！

english: No! I am not old! My family has guarded the staff for many generations.
translation: 不！我不老！我的家族已经守护法杖许多代了。

english: Halt! You will not leave here with the Staff of Armadyl!
translation: 站住！你不能带着阿玛杜尔杖离开这里！

english: Have you killed Lucien?
translation: 你杀了卢西安吗？

english: Not yet, I've lost the pendant you gave me!
translation: 还没有，我把你给我的吊坠弄丢了！

english: Hurry friend! Time is against us!
translation: 快点，朋友！时间不等人！

english: That is not thine to take!
translation: 那不是你能拿的东西！

english: Have you got the Staff of Armadyl yet?
translation: 你拿到阿玛杜尔杖了吗？

english: Yes! Here it is.
translation: 是的！给你。

english: Muhahahhahahaha!
translation: 呜哈哈哈哈哈哈！

english: I can feel the power of the staff running through me! I will be more powerful and they shall bow down to me!
translation: 我能感受到法杖的力量在我体内流淌！我会变得更强大，他们都会向我臣服！

english: I suppose you want your reward? I shall grant you much power!
translation: 我猜你想要你的奖励？我会赐予你强大的力量！

english: You don't want to attack me. I am your friend.
translation: 你不想攻击我。我是你的朋友。

english: You have defeated me for now! I shall reappear in the North!
translation: 你暂时击败了我！我会在北方再次出现！

english: That's right! Something! Tell me, what do you know of the Abyss?
translation: 没错！有东西！告诉我，你对深渊了解多少？

english: A shame. Unfortunately, this something requires somewhat of an abyssal understanding.
translation: 可惜。不幸的是，这个东西需要一定程度的深渊知识。

english: The Abyss? I know all about the Abyss.
translation: 深渊？我对深渊了如指掌。

english: Really? It's quite unusual for an adventurer like yourself to have knowledge in that area.
translation: 真的吗？像你这样的冒险者能了解那个领域，实在不寻常。

english: Well I recently helped a group of Zamorakian wizards gain access to the Rune Essence Mine. In return, they gave me access to the Abyss.
translation: 嗯，我最近帮了一群扎莫拉克法师进入符文精华矿坑。作为回报，他们给了我进入深渊的权限。

english: Zamorakian wizards? You do realise that the Z.M.I. are enemies to the Order of Wizards, right?
translation: 扎莫拉克法师？你知道 Z.M.I. 是巫师教团的敌人吧？

english: Maybe I shouldn't have mentioned that...
translation: 也许我不该提这个……

english: Oh, don't worry about it. The Order of Wizards may be a Saradominist group, but I've never personally had much time for gods. I prefer knowledge to religion.
translation: 哦，别担心。巫师教团可能是个萨拉多明教派，但我个人向来不怎么在意神祇。比起宗教，我更偏爱知识。

english: Still, it's maybe best you don't tell anyone else. I can't imagine my fellow wizards will be happy to know that you gave away details on their secret mine.
translation: 不过，你最好别告诉其他人。我可不想让我的巫师同僚们知道你把他们的秘密矿坑细节泄露出去。

english: Enough about them though. You've just shared quite the revelation with me! Is it really true that the Z.M.I. have found a way to access the Abyss?
translation: 不说他们了。你刚刚可是跟我分享了一个大发现！Z.M.I. 真的找到了通往深渊的路？

english: Well in that case, I think you might be the perfect person to aid me in a little task.
translation: 既然如此，我想你就是帮我完成一个小任务的最佳人选。

english: A little task? This sounds like the time someone asked me for one small favour. I'm not sure if I'm ready for that again.
translation: 一个小任务？听起来就像上次有人跟我说要帮一个小忙一样。我不确定我准备好再来一次了。

english: Oh, don't be silly! This will be fun!
translation: 哦，别傻了！这会很有趣的！

english: Alright, what kind of task is it?
translation: 好吧，什么任务？

english: What kind of task?
translation: 什么任务？

english: Well I can't go telling you that until you agree, can I? Wouldn't want you sharing my secrets.
translation: 那得等你答应了才能告诉你，对吧？我可不想让你到处传我的秘密。

english: You're not giving me much to go on here.
translation: 你给的信息也太少了。

english: There'll be quite the reward for you at the end!
translation: 最后会有丰厚的奖励给你！

english: I'd rather not get involved.
translation: 我还是不掺和了。

english: That's a shame. Well, you just let me know if you reconsider.
translation: 真可惜。好吧，你要是改变主意了就告诉我。

english: Hello again! Have you changed your mind about helping me with that little task?
translation: 又见面了！你改变主意，愿意帮我那个小任务了吗？

english: Alright, what do you need from me?
translation: 好吧，你需要我做什么？

english: You'll help? Great! Well first, a question for you: you say the Z.M.I. have gained access to the Abyss? By any chance, are they using it to gain quick access to the runic altars for runecrafting purposes?
translation: 你愿意帮忙？太好了！嗯，先问你一个问题：你说 Z.M.I. 已经能进入深渊了？他们是不是用它来快速通往符文祭坛，好制作符文？

english: Yes, but how did you...
translation: 是的，但你怎么……

english: I knew it! I've been wondering for some time how they've been creating so many runes. I'd never considered that they'd somehow gained access to the Abyss, but I now realise it was the obvious explanation.
translation: 我就知道！我一直在琢磨他们怎么制作出这么多符文。我从没想过他们居然打通了深渊，但现在看来，这是最合理的解释了。

english: So is that what you're after? You want access to the Abyss as well?
translation: 所以你也想要这个？你也想进入深渊？

english: Well, yes, but actually, no. It seems we've jumped ahead a bit. Let's go back to why I'm here.
translation: 嗯，算是吧，但其实不是。看来我们跳得太快了。还是回到我为什么在这里吧。

english: The 'something' you bought?
translation: 你买的那个“东西”？

english: The 'something' I bought! Here, take a look.
translation: 我买的那个“东西”！来，看看这个。

english: A foolish archaeologist by the name of Asgarnia Smith recently found this washed up near the Ruins of Uzer. Despite his apparent archaeological credentials, he dismissed it as junk.
translation: 一个名叫阿斯加尼亚.史密斯的愚蠢考古学家最近在乌泽废墟附近发现了这个冲上岸的东西。尽管他有考古学资历，却把它当成垃圾扔掉了。

english: Luckily, I was able to buy it from him before he disposed of it. Can you believe he thought the 100 coins I paid was too much? If only he knew the true value of something like this...
translation: 幸好，我赶在他处理掉之前从他手里买了下来。你能相信吗，他觉得我付的 100 金币都太多了？要是他知道这玩意儿真正的价值……

english: Why is it so valuable?
translation: 它为什么这么值钱？

english: You see that eye on it? That is the symbol of both the Order of Wizards and our home, the Wizards' Tower. Thing is, that's only the start.
translation: 你看到上面的眼睛了没？那是巫师教团和我们家园法师塔的象征。但这才只是开始。

english: From what I can tell, this amulet is thousands of years old, but our order was only formed at the dawn of the Fifth Age. That wasn't even two hundred years ago!
translation: 据我所知，这个护身符有几千年的历史，但我们的教团是在第五纪元之初才成立的。那甚至不到两百年前！

english: But how...
translation: 可是怎么……

english: Hang on! I'm not done yet. I also inspected the amulet for magical energies and found something fascinating! I recognised two distinct magical signatures.
translation: 等等！我还没说完呢。我还检查了项链上的魔法能量，发现了一些迷人的东西！我识别出了两种截然不同的魔法特征。

english: The first is the same magic found in rune essence. That's already pretty exciting, but it's the second that will blow your mind!
translation: 第一种和符文精华里的魔法相同。这已经够令人兴奋的了，但第二种会让你大吃一惊！

english: I'm getting to that! My, you do like interrupting, don't you? Don't worry, I understand. I get quite excited about these things as well!
translation: 我正要说！哎呀，你很喜欢插嘴，对吧？别担心，我理解。我自己对这些东西也很兴奋！

english: Anyway, here's the big reveal for you: the second signature was energy from the Abyss!
translation: 总之，重点来了：第二种特征就是来自深渊的能量！

english: So you have an amulet with the symbol of your order on it, but it predates your order by thousands of years?
translation: 所以你有一条刻着你们教团标志的项链，但它却比你们教团早数千年？

english: It also turned up miles from where your order is based, and is filled with energy from a dimension that until recently, no one had even been to?
translation: 它还在距离你们教团所在地数英里之外的地方出现，并且充满了来自一个直到最近还没有人去过维度的能量？

english: Now you see why this is so exciting!
translation: 现在你明白为什么这让人如此兴奋了吧！

english: So what do you need from me?
translation: 所以你需要我做什么？

english: I need to find out where this amulet came from. It should be possible to trace it using the abyssal energy it still contains.
translation: 我需要查出这条项链从哪里来的。利用它仍然包含的深渊能量应该是可以追溯的。

english: This is where you ask 'What's the catch?'
translation: 接下来就该你问‘有什么代价？’了。

english: *sigh* What's the catch?
translation: *叹气* 有什么代价？

english: I'm glad you asked, [player name]! Unfortunately, the spell needed to trace the amulet will only work properly from inside the Abyss.
translation: 很高兴你问了，[player name]！不幸的是，追溯项链所需的法术只能在深渊内部正常生效。

english: Oh I see where this is going. You don't have access to the Abyss, but I do.
translation: 哦，我明白你的意思了。你进不了深渊，但我可以。

english: Precisely! While I don't care about the religious squabbling between the Z.M.I. and my order, I still can't see them wanting to work with me any time soon.
translation: 正是！虽然我不在乎 Z.M.I. 和我的教团之间的宗教争吵，但我还是觉得他们近期不会想跟我合作。

english: So I need to take this amulet to the Abyss and work out where it came from?
translation: 所以我需要把这条项链带到深渊，查出它来自哪里？

english: Correct! I imagine you'll need the help of your Z.M.I. friends.
translation: 没错！我想你需要你那些 Z.M.I. 朋友的帮助。

english: Just maybe don't tell them who gave it to you.
translation: 只是可能别告诉他们是谁给你的。

english: I'll visit the Mage of Zamorak in Varrock. He should be able to help me.
translation: 我会去维洛克城找扎莫拉克法师。他应该能帮我。

english: Return to me once you are done. Oh, and don't forget the amulet!
translation: 完成后回来找我。哦，别忘了项链！

english: Hello again! Here, take this amulet to your Z.M.I. friend in Varrock. Hopefully he can tell us where it came from.
translation: 又见面了！来，把这条项链带去给你在维洛克城的 Z.M.I. 朋友。希望他能告诉我们它从哪里来的。

english: Hello again! Any luck with that amulet?
translation: 又见面了！那条项链有进展了吗？

english: Sorry, but I lost it.
translation: 抱歉，我把它弄丢了。

english: You lost a one of a kind ancient artefact?
translation: 你把一件独一无二的古代文物弄丢了？

english: Well, good job I found it again. Here you go. Take it to your Z.M.I. friend in Varrock. Hopefully he can tell us where it came from.
translation: 嗯，还好我又找到了。给你。带去给你在维洛克城的 Z.M.I. 朋友。希望他能告诉我们它从哪里来的。

english: You should take it to your Z.M.I. friend in Varrock. Hopefully he can tell us where it came from.
translation: 你应该把它带去给你在维洛克城的 Z.M.I. 朋友。希望他能告诉我们它从哪里来的。

english: I need your help with an amulet.
translation: 我需要你帮忙看看一条项链。

english: An amulet? What amulet?
translation: 一条项链？什么项链？

english: Oh, I don't actually have it with me. I'll be back.
translation: 哦，我没带在身上。我马上回来。

english: That eye on it... That is the symbol of the Order of Wizards. What's all this about?
translation: 上面的眼睛……那是巫师教团的象征。这到底是怎么回事？

english: The amulet is giving off abyssal energy. I was hoping you could help me work out where it came from.
translation: 这条项链散发出深渊能量。我希望你能帮我查出它从哪里来的。

english: Well I did help you gain access to the Rune Essence Mine.
translation: 嗯，我确实帮你进入了符文精华矿坑。

english: And we gave you knowledge on the Abyss in return. We owe you no further favours.
translation: 而我们也给了你关于深渊的知识作为回报。我们不再欠你人情了。

english: Are you not even slightly curious about how an amulet with the symbol of the Order of Wizards on it is giving off abyssal energy? After all, they don't have access to the Abyss.
translation: 你难道一点都不好奇，一条刻有巫师教团标志的项链怎么会释放出深渊能量吗？毕竟，他们可进不了深渊。

english: I hope you're not about to tell me that you shared our secrets with the Saradominists?
translation: 我希望你不是要告诉我，你把我们的秘密泄露给了萨拉多明信徒？

english: Then where did you get the amulet?
translation: 那你从哪儿弄到这条项链的？

english: I... bought it from an archaeologist.
translation: 我……从一个考古学家那里买的。

english: There's something off about all of this. Show it to me again.
translation: 这件事有些不对劲。再让我看看。

english: Just a spell to tell me more about it. It seems this amulet is very unusual.
translation: 只是个法术，让我了解更多信息。看来这条项链非常不一般。

english: Very well, but first you must do something for me. Bring me a bucket of water and a strong cup of tea.
translation: 好吧，但你得先帮我做件事。给我带一桶水和一杯浓茶来。

english: A strong cup of tea?
translation: 一杯浓茶？

english: That's right. The tea seller just north east of here can give you one. He owes me, in fact, so just tell him Herbert sent you.
translation: 没错。东北边的茶商可以给你一杯。其实他还欠我人情，你就跟他说是赫伯特让你来的。

english: Wait... Your name is Herbert?
translation: 等等……你叫赫伯特？

english: I guess not. I just never had you down as a Herbert.
translation: 我想不是。只是我从没想过你会叫赫伯特。

english: Zamorak: Ah, you again. What do you want?
translation: 扎莫拉克：啊，又是你。你想干嘛？

english: Could you help me with that amulet now?
translation: 你现在能帮我处理那条项链了吗？

english: Do you have a bucket of water and a strong cup of tea?
translation: 你有一桶水和一杯浓茶了吗？

english: I will not help you until you bring them to me. The tea seller just north east of here can give you a strong cup of tea. Just tell him Herbert sent you.
translation: 你把东西带来之前我不会帮你。东北边的茶商可以给你一杯浓茶。跟他说是赫伯特让你来的。

english: Could I have a strong cup of tea?
translation: 能给我一杯浓茶吗？

english: A strong cup of tea? What do you mean?
translation: 一杯浓茶？什么意思？

english: Herbert sent me for one.
translation: 是赫伯特让我来拿的。

english: Ah, well why didn't you say that? Between you and me, Herbert's strong cups of tea are actually just my regular cups of tea, but if it makes him happy...
translation: 啊，你怎么不早说？跟你私下说，赫伯特的浓茶其实就是我普通的茶，但要是能让他开心的话……

english: I hope Herbert enjoys it.
translation: 希望赫伯特喜欢。

english: For Herbert? I already gave you one for him.
translation: 给赫伯特的？我之前已经给过你一杯给他了。

english: Sorry, but I need another.
translation: 抱歉，我需要再来一杯。

english: Hmm... alright, but I can't keep making these for free you know.
translation: 嗯……好吧，但我可没法一直免费给你做。

english: Ah yes, how silly of me.
translation: 啊，对，我真糊涂。

english: I will not help you until you bring them to me.
translation: 你把东西带来之前我不会帮你。

english: Right, a deal is a deal, but the spell to determine the origin of that amulet will only work from the Abyss, so you'll need to have the initiate there perform it for you.
translation: 好，一言为定，但确定那条项链起源的法术只能在深渊内生效，所以你需要让那里的初学者为你施法。

english: Meet me in the Wilderness when you're ready to be teleported there.
translation: 准备好被传送后，到荒野来找我。

english: Can't you just teleport me from here?
translation: 你不能直接从这里传送我吗？

english: From the middle of Varrock? What if someone is watching?
translation: 在维洛克城中心？万一有人看着呢？

english: If someone was watching, they'd know you have a secret Chaos Temple here in Varrock. I reckon you're pretty safe.
translation: 要是有人看着，他们就会知道你在维洛克城有个秘密的混沌神殿。我觉得你挺安全的。

english: Fine, but don't expect me to make a habit of this. I will offer you a single teleport from here directly to the initiate in the Abyss. Make sure you are definitely ready.
translation: 行吧，但别指望我养成这种习惯。我可以直接把你从这儿传送到深渊的初学者那里，仅此一次。确保你真的准备好了。

english: Hang on... what was the bucket of water for?
translation: 等等……那一桶水是干什么用的？

english: Ah, that. While time passes slower in the Abyss, the initiate maintaining the rift has still been there for quite a while. He needs a good bath.
translation: 啊，那个。虽然时间在深渊中流逝得更慢，但维持裂隙的学徒仍然在那里待了相当长的时间。他需要好好洗个澡。

english: So you just want me to throw it over him?
translation: 所以你就想让我把它扔到他身上？

english: Exactly. Now, are you ready to be teleported? Don't forget, this is a one-time offer. In future, you'll need to meet me in the Wilderness to access the Abyss.
translation: 没错。现在，你准备好被传送了吗？别忘了，这可是仅此一次的机会。以后，你得在荒野跟我碰面才能进入深渊。

english: I should probably get the amulet first.
translation: 我可能得先拿到护身符。

english: That would be wise.
translation: 那才是明智之举。

english: Well then return to me when you are, but try not to waste too much of my time.
translation: 那就准备好了再来找我吧，但别浪费我太多时间。

english: The spell to determine the origin of that amulet will only work from the Abyss, so you'll need to have the initiate there perform it for you.
translation: 用来确定那个护身符来源的咒语只能在深渊里施展，所以你得让那里的学徒帮你施法。

english: Are you ready to be teleported there? Don't forget, this is a one-time offer. In future, you'll need to meet me in the Wilderness to access the Abyss.
translation: 你准备好被传送到那里了吗？别忘了，这可是仅此一次的机会。以后，你得在荒野跟我碰面才能进入深渊。

english: I should probably get that bucket of water first.
translation: 我或许应该先去拿那一桶水。

english: I already gave you your one-time teleport to the Abyss from here, so you'll need to meet me in the Wilderness if you want teleporting there.
translation: 我已经给过你一次从这里传送到深渊的机会了，所以如果你想传送到那里，就得在荒野跟我碰面。

english: Amulet?
translation: 护身符？

english: Yes, but I don't seem to have it with me. I'll be back soon.
translation: 是的，但我好像没带在身上。我很快就回来。

english: What? Are you trying to waste my time?
translation: 什么？你是想浪费我的时间吗？

english: Yes, but I also need to go and get a bucket of water.
translation: 是的，但我还得去拿一桶水。

english: Oh, hang on. Someone is trying to contact me...
translation: 哦，等等。有人正在试图联系我……

english: What did you want? Something about an amulet?
translation: 你想要什么？跟护身符有关？

english: Yes, but first...
translation: 是的，但首先……

english: What in the actual...
translation: 这到底是什么鬼……

english: Sorry, but Herbert said you needed a wash.
translation: 抱歉，但赫伯特说你该洗个澡了。

english: Are you serious? What if I'd lost concentration and let this rift collapse? Do you like having a brain that isn't made of mush? Because mush is all that would have been left!
translation: 你是认真的吗？要是我刚才分心让这个裂隙崩塌了怎么办？你喜欢你的大脑变成一团浆糊吗？因为那就只会剩下一团浆糊了！

english: I like my brain how it is, thanks. Now, could you help me?
translation: 我喜欢我的大脑现在这样，谢谢。现在，你能帮我吗？

english: Why should I? I'm soaked thanks to you!
translation: 我凭什么要帮你？都是因为你，我浑身都湿透了！

english: Herbert said you would.
translation: 赫伯特说你会帮的。

english: Of course he did! Alright then, what do you want?
translation: 他当然会这么说！好吧，你想要什么？

english: This amulet is giving off abyssal energy. I need you to cast a spell to tell me where it came from.
translation: 这个护身符散发着深渊能量。我需要你施个咒语，告诉我它来自哪里。

english: Right, just give me a moment.
translation: 好，给我一点时间。

english: Okay, this spell will allow me to triangulate the origin of the amulet. To make things easier, I'm using this rift to compare energy from that origin with energy from the runic altars.
translation: 好了，这个咒语能让我三角定位出护身符的来源。为了方便起见，我会用这个裂隙来比较那个来源的能量和符文祭坛的能量。

english: Of course, thanks to the ways time and space work in this place, the information won't necessarily come in the right order.
translation: 当然，由于这个地方时间和空间的运作方式，这些信息不一定会按正确的顺序出现。

english: Meaning I'll need you to help, you fool! You see that energy that's just emerged from the rift? Work out which order it goes in!
translation: 也就是说我需要你帮忙，你这个笨蛋！看到刚从裂隙里冒出来的那股能量了吗？弄清楚它应该是什么顺序！

english: It seems I don't have it with me. I'll be back.
translation: 我好像没带在身上。我会回来的。

english: What? Don't waste my time!
translation: 什么？别浪费我的时间！

english: What do I need to do with this energy?
translation: 我需要用这股能量做什么？

english: Work out which order it goes in!
translation: 弄清楚它应该是什么顺序！

english: I've worked out which order the energy goes in.
translation: 我已经弄清楚能量的顺序了。

english: Yes, I can see that. Now, hang on.
translation: 是的，我看得出来。现在，等一下。

english: I've noted the details on this scroll. A competent enough wizard should be able to use it to cast a teleportation spell to take you right there.
translation: 我已经把细节记在这张卷轴上了。一个够格的魔法师应该能用它来施展传送法术，把你直接送到那里。

english: Can you tell me anything about the place?
translation: 你能告诉我关于那个地方的一些情况吗？

english: With all the time I've spent here, I'd like to consider myself an expert on the Abyss, but there's something very strange about the place this amulet came from.
translation: 在这里待了这么久，我自认是深渊的专家，但那个护身符来源的地方有些非常奇怪。

english: Well if I knew that, it wouldn't be strange, would it? Now, if you're done bothering me, I need to stay focused on this rift!
translation: 如果我知道的话，那就不奇怪了，对吧？现在，如果你问完了，我得集中精力维持这个裂隙！

english: About that incantation...
translation: 关于那个咒语……

english: Oh the things I would do to you if I wasn't maintaining this rift! Here, take this you fool!
translation: 哦，要不是我得维持这个裂隙，我真想好好教训你一顿！拿着这个，你这个笨蛋！

english: Er... Nothing.
translation: 呃……没什么。

english: Nothing! Would you leave me alone!
translation: 没什么！那你快走吧！

english: Oh, he already did that.
translation: 哦，他已经给过我了。

english: Then why are you talking to me? You have what you need.
translation: 那你为什么还跟我说话？你已经拿到你需要的东西了。

english: Yes! I have an incantation that could lead us to wherever it came from.
translation: 是的！我拿到了一段咒语，可以带我们去它来的地方。

english: Brilliant! Let's have a look.
translation: 太棒了！让我看看。

english: Oh, fascinating! Hmm... But that would mean...
translation: 哦，真迷人！嗯……但那意味着……

english: That would mean what?
translation: 那意味着什么？

english: Shhh! I'm thinking.
translation: 嘘！我在思考。

english: Yes... Two... no three more! Silly me! Counted myself didn't I.
translation: 是的……两个……不，三个！我真傻！把自己也算进去了。

english: Well it should be fine. I can't see them saying no. After all, it's their symbol as well...
translation: 嗯，应该没问题。我看不出他们会拒绝。毕竟，那也是他们的象征……

english: Oh yes, you're here! Brilliant! You'll be pleased to know that I've worked out what we must do next.
translation: 哦，是的，你来了！太棒了！你会很高兴知道我已经想出了下一步该怎么做。

english: Patience, young adventurer. Before we get to that, let me share with you my theory on where this amulet came from.
translation: 耐心点，年轻的冒险者。在我们开始之前，让我先跟你分享一下我对这个护身符来源的理论。

english: While you were gone, I was thinking about why the amulet would have magical energy from both rune essence and the Abyss. All of a sudden, it hit me!
translation: 你不在的时候，我一直在想为什么这个护身符会同时拥有符文精华和深渊的魔法能量。突然，我灵光一闪！

english: Ouch?
translation: 疼吗？

english: Quite the opposite! The source of this amulet must be an ancient teleportation matrix to the runic altars, just like the one the Z.M.I. have in the Abyss!
translation: 恰恰相反！这个护身符的来源一定是一个通往符文祭坛的古老传送矩阵，就像Z.M.I.在深渊里拥有的那个一样！

english: This is good news, in case you were wondering! Access to a teleportation matrix like that will be life changing when it comes to my work!
translation: 这是好消息，如果你想知道的话！能接触到那样的传送矩阵，对我的工作来说将是改变一生的机遇！

english: Of course, the rest of my order will be very happy as well. It'll completely remove the advantage the Z.M.I. currently have. Now there's a balance that Guthix himself would love!
translation: 当然，我教会的其他人也会非常高兴。这将完全消除Z.M.I.目前拥有的优势。现在这种平衡，连古斯本人都会喜欢！

english: Ah, but this talk of the Z.M.I. has reminded me of something. Could I have that amulet back?
translation: 啊，但提到Z.M.I.让我想起了一件事。能把那个护身符还给我吗？

english: Ah, but this talk of the Z.M.I. has reminded me of something. You lost that amulet didn't you?
translation: 啊，但提到Z.M.I.让我想起了一件事。你把那个护身符弄丢了，对吧？

english: Don't worry, I found it for you. I'll keep hold of it for now.
translation: 别担心，我帮你找到了。我先保管着它。

english: Now, just give me a moment...
translation: 现在，给我一点时间……

english: Ah, yes. Well, that's not surprising.
translation: 啊，是的。嗯，这并不奇怪。

english: Your Z.M.I. friends cast a transmission spell on the amulet. Had we taken it with us, it would have transmitted all sorts of information back to them about the origin.
translation: 你的Z.M.I.朋友们在护身符上施了一个传输法术。如果我们带着它，它会把各种关于来源的信息传回给他们。

english: It's not a problem. I suspected they might do something like this. The good news is that this means they have no intention of using that incantation themselves.
translation: 没问题。我早就怀疑他们会做这种事。好消息是，这意味着他们自己无意使用那段咒语。

english: Again, as expected. They prefer to lurk in the shadows. To be honest, I totally understand. I've been known to do the same from time to time.
translation: 再次，正如所料。他们更喜欢潜伏在暗处。老实说，我完全理解。我自己也时不时会这么做。

english: Anyway, I've modified their spell to send false information to them. They'll be none the wiser.
translation: 总之，我修改了他们的法术，会向他们发送虚假信息。他们不会察觉的。

english: I thought you didn't care about religion? Why don't you want the Z.M.I. getting that information?
translation: 我以为你不在乎宗教？为什么你不想让Z.M.I.得到那个信息？

english: Oh, my friend, you misunderstand. I have no issues with the Z.M.I. having the information, but I don't want them getting it before I've even had a chance to determine what it is!
translation: 哦，我的朋友，你误会了。我不介意Z.M.I.得到信息，但我不想让他们在我还没机会弄清楚那是什么之前就拿到手！

english: I see. So what now?
translation: 我明白了。那现在怎么办？

english: Yes, back to business! The incantation is quite complex, so we will need the help of three other wizards to perform it. I'm afraid I'm not including you in that, although you are very talented!
translation: 是的，回到正事！这段咒语相当复杂，所以我们需要另外三位魔法师的帮助才能施展。恐怕不包括你，尽管你非常有天赋！

english: Thanks, I think... so where do we get these other wizards?
translation: 谢谢，我想是吧……那我们去哪里找这些魔法师？

english: From the Wizards' Tower of course! My fellow wizards won't be able to resist getting their hands on a teleportation matrix, especially one that may be connected to the history of our order!
translation: 当然是从法师塔！我的魔法师同僚们无法抗拒得到一个传送矩阵的机会，尤其是可能与我们教会历史有关的一个！

english: Now, you head to the Wizards' Tower and show that incantation to Sedridor. I have a couple of things to prepare first, but I will join you there soon.
translation: 现在，你去法师塔把那段咒语给塞德里多看看。我还有些事情要先准备，但我会很快去那里跟你汇合。

english: Oh, and whatever you do, don't mention the Z.M.I. while you're there.
translation: 哦，还有，无论你做什么，在那里的时候都不要提到Z.M.I.。

english: Alright, I'll see you soon.
translation: 好的，我们很快再见。

english: Hey, if you want, I can teleport you to the Wizards' Tower. Consider it a one-time gift from me.
translation: 嘿，如果你愿意，我可以把你传送到法师塔。就当是我送你的一个一次性礼物。

english: I think I'll walk.
translation: 我想我还是走路去吧。

english: Well let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了告诉我。

english: Hello again! Did you take that incantation to Sedridor?
translation: 又见面了！你把那段咒语给塞德里多了吗？

english: I may have lost it.
translation: 我可能把它弄丢了。

english: No matter, I can give you a copy of mine. Try not to lose it this time!
translation: 没关系，我可以给你一份我的副本。这次别再弄丢了！

english: Now quickly! Time is of the essence! If you want, I can teleport you to the Wizards' Tower. Consider it a one-time gift from me.
translation: 现在快去吧！时间紧迫！如果你愿意，我可以把你传送到法师塔。就当是我送你的一个一次性礼物。

english: Well hurry up! If you want, I can teleport you to the Wizards' Tower. Consider it a one-time gift from me.
translation: 那就快点！如果你愿意，我可以把你传送到法师塔。就当是我送你的一个一次性礼物。

english: Now quickly! Time is of the essence!
translation: 现在快去吧！时间紧迫！

english: Well hurry up! This could be the biggest discovery of our lifetimes!
translation: 那就快点！这可能是我们一生中最大的发现！

english: I need your help with an incantation.
translation: 我需要你帮忙处理一段咒语。

english: An incantation, hmm? What incantation?
translation: 一段咒语，嗯？什么咒语？

english: A teleport that could potentially take us to an ancient teleportation matrix. Persten reckons you might be able to use it to gain easier access to the runic altars.
translation: 一个可能带我们到一个古老传送矩阵的传送法术。佩斯滕认为你也许能用它来更容易地进入符文祭坛。

english: Wait... Persten sent you?
translation: 等等……是佩斯滕派你来的？

english: That's right. Oh, I should also mention that this teleportation matrix seems to have some connection to your order, despite predating it by thousands of years.
translation: 没错。哦，我还应该提一下，这个传送矩阵似乎与你们的教会有某种联系，尽管它比你们教会早了几千年。

english: So Persten disappears for all this time, and then shows up again with knowledge on an ancient teleportation matrix? I suppose I shouldn't be surprised. It's probably not the strangest thing she's done.
translation: 所以佩斯滕消失了这么久，然后又带着一个古老传送矩阵的知识出现了？我想我不应该感到惊讶。这可能不是她做过的最奇怪的事。

english: Anyway, what do you need my help with exactly?
translation: 总之，你到底需要我帮什么忙？

english: Persten needs three other wizards to be able to perform the incantation.
translation: 佩斯滕需要另外三位魔法师才能施展那段咒语。

english: Hmm... can I see it?
translation: 嗯……我能看看吗？

english: Oh, I don't have it with me.
translation: 哦，我没带在身上。

english: I'd very much like to see it. Come back to me when you have it.
translation: 我很想看看。你拿到它的时候再来找我吧。

english: Hmm... this scroll is very interesting. Did you get it from a Zamorakian wizard, perhaps? Don't lie to me, [player name].
translation: 嗯……这张卷轴非常有趣。你该不会是从一个萨莫拉克魔法师那里得到的吧？别对我撒谎，[player name]。

english: Well since you asked... I... well...
translation: 既然你问了……我……嗯……

english: It's clear from your response that my suspicions are correct. This incantation is written on very thin flesh rather than parchment, a horrific practice only used by Zamorakians.
translation: 从你的反应来看，我的怀疑是正确的。这段咒语是写在非常薄的皮肉上，而不是羊皮纸上，这是萨莫拉克教徒才会使用的可怕做法。

english: Need I remind you that it was the Zamorakians who burnt down the first Wizards' Tower?
translation: 需要我提醒你，是萨莫拉克教徒烧毁了第一座法师塔吗？

english: [player name], I'm going to be frank with you. Persten hasn't been seen here for almost a year. My last meeting with her was to discuss changing her line of study due to her lack of results.
translation: [player name]，我要跟你直说。佩尔斯滕已经将近一年没在这里出现了。我上次和她见面是为了讨论由于她缺乏成果而改变她的研究方向。

english: She was given one more year to produce something of note. Now, with time almost up, she sends you here with Zamorakian incantations and odd claims about an ancient teleportation matrix.
translation: 她又被给了最后一年，要求拿出点像样的成果。现在时间快到了，她却派你带着萨莫拉克的咒语和一些关于古代传送矩阵的奇怪说法来找我。

english: But what if it's true? That teleportation matrix could change everything!
translation: 但如果这是真的呢？那个传送矩阵可以改变一切！

english: Okay, I admit we went to some Zamorakians for help with the incantation, but they've had no other involvement. Persten has even made sure they won't get anything beneficial out of this.
translation: 好吧，我承认我们为了咒语找过一些萨莫拉克教徒帮忙，但他们没有参与其他事情。佩斯滕甚至已经确保他们不会从中得到任何好处。

english: Hmm... You have been a great help to us in the past. For that, I will consider it. First though, I will do a thorough arcane analysis of this incantation to determine if it is safe to cast.
translation: 嗯……你过去对我们帮助很大。为此，我会考虑一下。不过首先，我会对这个咒语进行彻底的奥术分析，以确定它是否安全可施放。

english: Now, as for your three wizards, I can't be wasting the others' time with this sort of thing, especially when I haven't even agreed to allow it yet.
translation: 至于你提到的三位魔法师，我不能让其他人浪费时间在这种事情上，尤其是我还没同意允许这么做。

english: However, Traiborn has three new apprentices who could help. This might be a good learning opportunity for them. Speak to him while I inspect this incantation.
translation: 不过，特雷伯恩有三个新学徒可以帮助你。这对他们来说可能是个不错的学习机会。在我检查这个咒语的时候，你去和他谈谈。

english: Can you help me with that incantation?
translation: 你能帮我处理那个咒语吗？

english: I haven't finished my analysis of it yet. While you wait, I suggest you speak with Traiborn. He has three new apprentices who could help you, assuming I agree to let things go ahead.
translation: 我还没完成分析。你等的时候，我建议你先去找特雷伯恩谈谈。他有三名新学徒可以帮你——前提是我同意继续进行。

english: Thingummywut. Thin... gummy... what?
translation: 东西什么玩意儿……东……西什么？

english: I'm a little busy trying to solve that mad wizard's puzzle. If you have any questions, ask him instead.
translation: 我正忙着解那个疯魔法师的谜题呢。如果你有问题，去问他吧。

english: So, if that's six and this is eight, then if we multiply... No, divide? No, that's not it either.
translation: 那么，如果那是六，这是八，那我们如果乘……不对，除？也不对。

english: Oh, didn't see you there! I'm a little busy trying to solve a puzzle set by the great Traiborn. If you have any questions, could you ask him instead?
translation: 哦，没看到你！我正忙着解伟大的特雷伯恩出的谜题呢。如果你有问题，能去问他吗？

english: Air and earth? What about water and fire? Is this an elemental problem, or are they completely irrelevant?
translation: 空气和土？那水和火呢？这是元素问题，还是完全无关？

english: Oh, didn't see you there. I'm a little busy trying to solve the puzzle Traiborn gave us. If you have any questions, you should ask him instead.
translation: 哦，没看到你。我正忙着解特雷伯恩给我们的谜题呢。如果你有问题，你应该去问他。

english: I need your apprentices to help with an incantation.
translation: 我需要你的学徒们帮忙处理一个咒语。

english: Right now? But we're having a party!
translation: 现在？可我们正在开派对呢！

english: A party?
translation: 派对？

english: Party? What party?
translation: 派对？什么派对？

english: You said you were having a party?
translation: 你说你们在开派对？

english: Well I suppose it is a party of sorts. A study party! Would you like to join in? You look like you could use one!
translation: 嗯，我想也算是某种派对。学习派对！你想加入吗？你看上去也需要来一场！

english: I'll pass... Anyway, Sedridor said your apprentices could help me with an incantation.
translation: 我就不了……话说回来，塞德里克说你的学徒们可以帮我处理一个咒语。

english: What kind of incantation?
translation: 什么样的咒语？

english: One that could lead us to an ancient teleportation matrix.
translation: 一个能带我们找到古代传送矩阵的咒语。

english: Teleportation matrix? Doesn't sound like the most comfortable place for a party... I bet it's full of thingummywuts as well!
translation: 传送矩阵？听起来不像是最适合开派对的地方……我打赌里面肯定也全是些东西什么玩意！

english: I'm not suggesting we move the party there. I'm suggesting that we cancel the party and discover the secrets of this teleportation matrix instead.
translation: 我不是建议我们把派对搬到那里去。我是建议我们取消派对，去探索这个传送矩阵的秘密。

english: Cancel the party? You're certainly a party pooper!
translation: 取消派对？你真是个扫兴鬼！

english: Alright, how about instead of cancelling the party, we finish it with a bang? What's currently on the agenda?
translation: 好吧，不如这样，我们不取消派对，来个华丽的收尾怎么样？目前有什么计划？

english: Finish it with a bang? Sedridor won't be happy if we burn the place down again, will he? Still, I like it!
translation: 来个华丽的收尾？要是我们又把这地方烧了，塞德里克可不会高兴，对吧？不过，我喜欢这主意！

english: I've currently tasked each of the apprentices with solving a problem. If they all solve it, we can celebrate together!
translation: 我目前给每个学徒都布置了一个问题要解决。如果他们都能解决，我们就可以一起庆祝！

english: Sounds good. So, what's the problem?
translation: 听起来不错。那么，是什么问题？

english: Problem? There's no problem! Everything is fine here. We're having a party!
translation: 问题？没什么问题！这里一切都好。我们在开派对呢！

english: I mean what's the problem they have to solve?
translation: 我是说他们要解决的是什么问题？

english: Oh! It's trivial! They just have to figure out what a thingummywut is!
translation: 哦！简单得很！他们只需要弄清楚什么是“东西什么玩意”！

english: A thingummy... what?
translation: 东西什么……玩意？

english: Right... I'll speak to the apprentices. Perhaps together we can figure this out.
translation: 好吧……我去和学徒们谈谈。也许我们一起能弄明白。

english: I think I know what a thingummywut is!
translation: 我想我知道“东西什么玩意”是什么了！

english: A slayer creature!
translation: 是一种杀戮生物！

english: A slayer creature? That doesn't make any sense at all! Besides, not even the slayer masters know how to kill a thingummywut!
translation: 一种杀戮生物？这完全说不通！再说了，连杀戮大师们都不知道怎么杀“东西什么玩意”！

english: Perhaps my apprentices could teach you a thing or three. You should talk to them.
translation: 也许我的学徒们能教你一两三招。你应该和他们谈谈。

english: A great wizard, lost to history!
translation: 一位伟大的魔法师，被历史遗忘！

english: Lost to history? That doesn't make any sense at all! Besides, a thingummywut is not lost to history. It's very well documented inside my head!
translation: 被历史遗忘？这完全说不通！再说了，“东西什么玩意”并没有被历史遗忘。它在我脑子里记得清清楚楚！

english: Me? That doesn't make any sense at all! If I were a thingummywut, I wouldn't be stood here teaching!
translation: 我？这完全说不通！如果我是“东西什么玩意”，我就不会站在这里教书了！

english: Oh dear, how embarrassing. Perhaps my apprentices could teach you a thing or three. You should talk to them.
translation: 哦天哪，真尴尬。也许我的学徒们能教你一两三招。你应该和他们谈谈。

english: Traiborn said you're trying to solve a puzzle? Maybe I could help?
translation: 特雷伯恩说你在试图解谜？也许我能帮上忙？

english: Why? Do you think I need your help to solve this? I'll prove I'm smarter than these two!
translation: 为什么？你觉得我需要你帮忙才能解开这个？我会证明我比那两个都聪明！

english: Oh, I don't doubt you're smart enough to solve this on your own. I'd just like to see the puzzle to further my own knowledge and understanding.
translation: 哦，我不怀疑你足够聪明能自己解决。我只是想看看谜题，以增进我自己的知识和理解。

english: You think I'll be persuaded that easily? I'm not as easy to fool as the others, but I admire your efforts nonetheless.
translation: 你以为我那么容易就被说服吗？我可不像其他人那么好骗，不过我欣赏你的努力。

english: I'll be honest then. In truth, I don't care about this puzzle at all. I'm actually looking to recruit some talented wizards to help uncover a long-lost teleportation matrix.
translation: 那我就实话实说了。实话讲，我对这个谜题一点也不在乎。我其实是想招募一些有才能的魔法师，帮忙发掘一个失传已久的传送矩阵。

english: The hope is to use it to gain easy access to the runic altars for runecrafting purposes.
translation: 希望能用它来轻松到达各符文祭坛，用于符文制作。

english: Well that's infinitely more interesting! In that case, why do you care about the puzzle?
translation: 这可比那有意思多了！既然如此，你为什么要关心这个谜题？

english: Traiborn said that he wouldn't give his permission for you to join me until the puzzle is solved, so I thought I'd lend a hand.
translation: 特雷伯恩说，在谜题解开之前他不会同意让你加入我们，所以我想着来搭把手。

english: Very well, you appear to be telling the truth, and I'd rather be uncovering a teleportation matrix than doing this.
translation: 好吧，看来你说的是实话，我也宁愿去发掘传送矩阵，而不是在这里做这个。

english: Could I see that puzzle again?
translation: 我能再看看那个谜题吗？

english: Sounds like you're trying to solve a puzzle. Perhaps I could help?
translation: 听起来你正在解谜。也许我能帮上忙？

english: Oh, hey there! Yes, I'm trying to solve a puzzle set by the world-renowned Traiborn himself! It truly is an honour to have someone like him take the time to teach an up-and-coming wizard such as myself.
translation: 哦，嘿！是的，我正在解举世闻名的特雷伯恩本人出的谜题！能让他这样的人物花时间教导像我这样初出茅庐的魔法师，真是莫大的荣幸。

english: Why do you think so highly of him?
translation: 你为什么对他评价这么高？

english: Oh, so many reasons! But the biggest is that amongst all of the wizards, he is the foremost expert in extra- planar magic!
translation: 哦，理由太多了！但最重要的是，在所有魔法师中，他是位面魔法方面的顶尖专家！

english: Why else do you think he has the smallest room in the tower? Because he doesn't need the space! He can just open a portal to create more!
translation: 不然你以为他为什么在塔里要最小的房间？因为他不需要空间！他只需要打开一扇传送门就能创造更多空间！

english: I see, and is this the branch of magic you want to specialise in?
translation: 我明白了，那这就是你想专精的魔法分支吗？

english: Oh absolutely! That's why I'm here. I need to solve this puzzle to prove that I'm ready to learn all that he has to teach.
translation: 哦，当然！这就是我来这里的原因。我需要解开这个谜题，以证明我已经准备好学习他所有能教的东西。

english: Well that's actually not too different to the reason I'm here. I'm currently helping a wizard called Persten, and she seems to be quite knowledgeable on different planes.
translation: 嗯，这其实和我要来的原因差不多。我正在帮助一位叫佩斯滕的魔法师，她似乎对不同位面很有研究。

english: She's tasked me with recruiting some wizards to help her uncover a teleportation matrix. Would you like to join us?
translation: 她让我招募一些魔法师帮她发掘一个传送矩阵。你愿意加入我们吗？

english: You've met Persten? She studied directly under Traiborn for multiple years! I'd love to meet her, but she's hard to track down. Could you introduce us?
translation: 你见过佩斯滕？她直接师从特雷伯恩好几年呢！我很想见她，但她很难找。你能介绍我们认识吗？

english: Sure, I can do that. We need to solve this puzzle first though. Traiborn won't let you three leave until you do. Perhaps I could help you solve it?
translation: 当然可以。不过我们得先解开这个谜题。特雷伯恩在你们解开之前不会让你们三个离开。也许我能帮你解开？

english: I'm not sure. I wouldn't want Traiborn to think poorly of me if I've cheated and asked for help... but I do want to work with Persten...
translation: 我不确定。我不想因为作弊找人帮忙而让特雷伯恩看低我……但我确实想和佩斯滕一起工作……

english: Okay, I'll show you the puzzle.
translation: 好吧，我把谜题给你看。

english: Okay. Here you go!
translation: 好吧。给你！

english: What appears to be the problem?
translation: 问题出在哪里？

english: Oh, sorry! Didn't see you there.
translation: 哦，抱歉！没看到你。

english: Don't worry. What were you muttering about with air and earth? Is it related to the puzzle Traiborn gave you all?
translation: 别担心。你刚才嘟囔着空气和土什么的？跟特雷伯恩给你们出的谜题有关吗？

english: Yes, I just can't wrap my head around it. It feels like there are too many unknown variables. Besides, how does all this relate to a thingummywut in the first place? Whatever that actually is.
translation: 是的，我就是搞不明白。感觉未知数太多了。再说了，这跟“东西什么玩意”到底有什么关系？不管那到底是什么。

english: Perhaps it's a slayer creature? Or a person? Is this a logical puzzle, a riddle or a mathematical problem?
translation: 也许是某种杀戮生物？或者一个人？这是个逻辑谜题、字谜还是数学问题？

english: I see. Perhaps I could take a look and help you out?
translation: 我明白了。也许我能看一眼帮你解决？

english: I'm not sure... It sounds like cheating, but I really do want to beat Cordelia. She's always one step ahead of me, so it would be nice to finally win for a change.
translation: 我不确定……听起来像是在作弊，但我真的很想赢过科迪莉亚。她总是领先我一步，所以能赢一次也不错。

english: Well, I'm actually here to recruit the three of you to help uncover an old teleportation matrix. The only issue is that Traiborn won't let you leave until the puzzle is solved.
translation: 嗯，其实我是来招募你们三个帮忙发掘一个古老的传送矩阵。唯一的问题是特雷伯恩在谜题解开之前不让你们离开。

english: Ooh! Did you say a teleportation matrix? Teleportation magic is my specialty! I'd love to help!
translation: 哦！你说传送矩阵？传送魔法是我的专长！我很乐意帮忙！

english: Well, I'd be glad to have you along! So, will you show me the puzzle?
translation: 那太好了，很高兴你能加入！那么，你能给我看看谜题吗？

english: Sure! Just please don't tell the others you helped me.
translation: 当然！只是别告诉其他人你帮了我。

english: Well done! That's correct!
translation: 做得好！答对了！

english: See, it's easier to solve problems when you put aside what's best for you and instead focus on what's best for the team!
translation: 看吧，当你把个人得失放在一边，专注于团队利益时，问题就更容易解决了！

english: Congratulations, you all pass!
translation: 恭喜你们，全部通过！

english: But you said that only the first of us to solve it would pass!
translation: 但你说过只有第一个解出来的人才能通过！

english: Oh? Did I? I forgot. Either way, I hope you've all now learnt a valuable lesson in teamwork! You have this adventurer here to thank for that.
translation: 哦？我说过吗？我忘了。不管怎样，希望你们现在都学到了宝贵的一课——团队合作！你们该感谢这位冒险者。

english: Wait, but we all had different puzzles written down?
translation: 等等，可我们每个人拿到的谜题都不一样？

english: Of course! We needed to combine our puzzles to solve it. Wow, that's genius! What a great way to teach us all teamwork!
translation: 当然！我们需要把各自的谜题结合起来才能解开。哇，真是天才！多么好的方式来教我们团队合作！

english: Now, finish with a bang did you say?
translation: 那么，你说要来个华丽的收尾？

english: What the - what was that for?!
translation: 搞什么——这又是为什么？！

english: Well, it was your idea after all. Now why don't you go tell Sedridor that my apprentices are free to help?
translation: 嗯，毕竟这是你的主意。现在你去告诉塞德里克，我的学徒们可以帮忙了？

english: No, that's not right at all. You should think harder about this!
translation: 不，完全不对。你应该再好好想想！

english: So your apprentices can help with the incantation?
translation: 那你的学徒们可以帮忙处理咒语了？

english: That's right, young thingummywut. Now, don't keep Sedridor waiting!
translation: 没错，小东西什么玩意。现在，别让塞德里克久等了！

english: Traiborn says I'm allowed to help you with this teleportation matrix. You should speak to Sedridor in the basement.
translation: 特雷伯恩说我可以帮你处理这个传送矩阵了。你应该去地下室找塞德里克谈谈。

english: I think I'm ready to meet Persten! You should go to the basement and let Sedridor know we're all ready.
translation: 我想我已经准备好去见佩斯滕了！你应该去地下室告诉塞德里克我们都准备好了。

english: Traiborn says I'm allowed to help you now. Let's find this teleportation matrix! I think you need to speak to Sedridor in the basement first though.
translation: 特雷伯恩说我现在可以帮你了。我们去找这个传送矩阵吧！不过我想你需要先去地下室和塞德里克谈谈。

english: Hello again! Ready to uncover a magical secret that could change the world forever?
translation: 又见面了！准备好揭开一个可能永远改变世界的魔法秘密了吗？

english: Slow down, Persten! I am still inspecting this amulet of yours.
translation: 慢点，佩斯滕！我还在检查你的这个护身符呢。

english: You're inspecting the amulet now? Does that mean the incantation is safe?
translation: 你现在在检查护身符？那表示咒语安全了？

english: That's right! The amulet is as well, of course, but Sedridor here likes to be careful.
translation: 没错！护身符当然也没问题，但塞德里克这家伙就是喜欢谨慎行事。

english: Not all of us are so carefree when it comes to the rules of our order, Persten. I mean really, Zamorakian incantations! Be glad I've even let you back in the tower!
translation: 佩斯滕，不是每个人都像你一样，对我们教团的规矩这么漫不经心。我是说真的，萨莫拉克的咒语！你该庆幸我甚至让你回到了塔里！

english: The unfortunate price of progress, Sedridor.
translation: 这是进步的不幸代价，塞德里克。

english: I can think of a few other unfortunate things...
translation: 我还能想到其他一些不幸的事……

english: Anyway, the amulet seems to be safe, and as much as I hate to admit it, your assessment seems to be correct.
translation: 总之，护身符看起来是安全的，虽然我很不想承认，但你的判断似乎是对的。

english: So we can go ahead?
translation: 那我们可以继续了？

english: Yes. I'm still not happy about this, but we can't throw away this chance. I assume Traiborn's apprentices are ready?
translation: 是的。我仍然对此不太高兴，但我们不能放弃这个机会。我猜特雷伯恩的学徒们准备好了？

english: Well then what are we waiting for? Let's do this!
translation: 那我们还等什么？开始吧！

english: [player name], are you ready?
translation: [player name]，你准备好了吗？

english: So we're ready to perform the incantation?
translation: 所以我们准备好念咒语了？

english: It seems so, assuming you are ready yourself?
translation: 看起来是的，前提是你自己准备好了？

english: We will be here once you are.
translation: 你准备好了我们就在这里。

english: Ready to begin the incantation?
translation: 准备好开始念咒语了吗？

english: Everyone ready?
translation: 大家都准备好了吗？

english: We won't let you down, Persten.
translation: 我们不会让你失望的，佩斯滕。

english: Alright, with me!
translation: 好了，跟我来！

english: Saris! Val! Curak! Belito!
translation: 萨里斯！瓦尔！库拉克！贝利托！

english: Well what are we waiting for? Let's go in!
translation: 那我们还等什么？进去吧！

english: Go in? You three aren't going through that portal. We have no idea what's on the other side!
translation: 进去？你们三个不能穿过那个传送门。我们完全不知道另一边是什么！

english: I have given Persten and [player name] permission to go through. Until we know it's safe, no one else may enter.
translation: 我已经允许佩斯滕和[player name]过去了。在我们确定安全之前，其他人不得进入。

english: You can't be serious!
translation: 你不是认真的吧！

english: Please let us help! We've all worked so hard for an opportunity like this!
translation: 请让我们帮忙吧！我们都为这样的机会付出了这么多努力！

english: And we have Persten to look after us!
translation: 而且有佩斯滕照顾我们！

english: No. You are only apprentices. You were here to help with the incantation, and you've done that now. You should go back to your studies.
translation: 不行。你们只是学徒。你们在这里是为了协助念咒语，现在任务已经完成了。你们应该回去继续学习。

english: Come now, Sedridor. The young thingummywuts have proven themselves to be more than capable. Let them have their party!
translation: 得了吧，塞德里克。这些年轻的小家伙们已经证明了自己能力非凡。让他们也参与进来吧！

english: It's going to be quite something! You really should let them help!
translation: 这肯定会很了不起！你真的应该让他们帮忙！

english: Quiet, Persten!
translation: 安静，佩斯滕！

english: Let it be known that I consider this a bad idea. That said, they are your apprentices, Traiborn. If they have your permission, I won't stop them.
translation: 我要声明，我认为这是个坏主意。话虽如此，他们是你的学徒，特雷伯恩。如果他们得到你的许可，我不会阻止他们。

english: Alright! Ready to make history?
translation: 太好了！准备好创造历史了吗？

english: Are the others through the portal?
translation: 其他人都穿过传送门了吗？

english: I assume so. You should probably go through and join them.
translation: 我想是的。你大概应该过去和他们汇合。

english: Well this is... unexpected.
translation: 嗯，这真是……出乎意料。

english: Are we... underwater?
translation: 我们是在……水下吗？

english: Let me cast a locator spell!
translation: 让我施放一个定位法术！

english: It seems we're deep below the sea, just south of Morytania!
translation: 看来我们是在深海之下，就在莫利塔尼亚的南边！

english: Come, let's look around.
translation: 来吧，我们四处看看。

english: This place is brilliant! The apprentices are looking around to see what they can discover. You should join them!
translation: 这地方太棒了！学徒们正在四处查看，看看能发现什么。你应该加入他们！

english: There's something strange about this big hole here. It's giving out the tiniest amount of magical energy. I can't work out what it is though.
translation: 这个大洞有点奇怪。它散发出极其微弱的魔法能量。但我搞不清楚它是什么。

english: You know, those plants look similar to stuff I've seen in the...
translation: 你知道吗，那些植物看起来很像我在……见过的东西。

english: Quiet! I'm more than capable of working this out. Maybe you should go help the others instead.
translation: 安静！我完全有能力自己搞清楚。也许你该去帮帮其他人。

english: Any luck with this hole?
translation: 这个洞有什么发现吗？

english: Don't disturb me! I'll need absolute silence if I'm to work out what this mysterious energy is.
translation: 别打扰我！如果我要弄清楚这神秘能量是什么，我需要绝对的安静。

english: That's an interesting statue.
translation: 那是个有趣的雕像。

english: See the plaque on it? It reads: 'Aliya, Justiciar of the Lion and guardian of the Temple of the Eye.'
translation: 看到上面的牌匾了吗？上面写着：‘阿莉娅，狮之审判官，眼之神殿的守护者。’

english: Temple of the Eye?
translation: 眼之神殿？

english: That must be where we are right now! I've read about the justiciars before, in a book back at the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 那一定就是我们现在所在的地方！我以前在法师塔的一本书里读到过关于审判官的事。

english: What did the book say?
translation: 那本书说了什么？

english: They were powerful warriors in service to Saradomin himself, back when the gods still walked among us! This temple must be ancient. Imagine if Saradomin himself once stood here!
translation: 他们是侍奉萨拉多明本人的强大战士，那还是在诸神行走于我们中间的时代！这座神殿一定非常古老。想象一下，如果萨拉多明本人曾站在这里！

english: Still looking at that statue?
translation: 还在看那个雕像？

english: Isn't it brilliant? A statue of a justiciar! I wish I could have met her!
translation: 是不是很了不起？一个审判官的雕像！我真希望能见过她！

english: Look! Rune guardians, like the ones at the Mage Training Arena! If this place was once a teleportation matrix, these rune guardians might have helped the wizards that used it.
translation: 看！符文守护者，就像魔法师训练场里的那些！如果这个地方曾经是一个传送矩阵，这些符文守护者可能帮助过使用它的巫师。

english: Anything different about them?
translation: 它们有什么不同吗？

english: Well, despite their age, they're actually of a remarkably similar design to the ones used by modern wizards. Isn't that amazing?
translation: 嗯，尽管年代久远，但它们的设计实际上与现代巫师使用的非常相似。是不是很神奇？

english: Discovered anything more about these rune guardians?
translation: 对这些符文守护者有更多发现吗？

english: Not yet, but their mere presence here is an amazing discovery!
translation: 还没有，但它们仅仅出现在这里就已经是一个惊人的发现了！

english: Oh, sorry, I didn't see you there. I was lost in thought!
translation: 哦，抱歉，没看到你。我刚才想得出神了！

english: What were you thinking about?
translation: 你在想什么？

english: Hmm? Oh, I was looking at these markings here. They're very interesting! They seem to be radiating a magical energy I've never encountered before!
translation: 嗯？哦，我在看这里的这些标记。它们非常有趣！它们似乎在散发出一种我从未遇到过的魔法能量！

english: Take a closer look! Maybe you'll feel the energy as well!
translation: 靠近点看看！也许你也能感受到那股能量！

english: Saradomin be with you.
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在。

english: And with you, Zachariah. So, it's really true?
translation: 也与你同在，撒迦利亚。那么，这是真的吗？

english: Indeed it is, Aliya, and he has given us the task of protecting it.
translation: 确实如此，阿莉娅，他给了我们保护它的任务。

english: What would he have me do?
translation: 他要我做什么？

english: You must build a sanctuary for the Eye. The forces of chaos already seek to reobtain it, as do countless others.
translation: 你必须为‘眼’建造一个圣所。混沌的力量已经在试图重新获得它，其他无数势力也是如此。

english: I will keep it safe, no matter the cost. And you?
translation: 我会不惜一切代价保护它的安全。那你呢？

english: Zamorak has tasked his collector with finding the Eye. I will hunt him down before he does, along with any others who would try to claim it.
translation: 萨莫拉克已经命令他的收藏家去寻找‘眼’。我会在他找到之前，以及任何其他试图夺取它的人之前，追捕到他。

english: Then I wish you luck, brother.
translation: 那我祝你好运，兄弟。

english: There is one last thing, Aliya. You must keep the Eye secret from all others, even our own. The fewer people that know the truth, the better.
translation: 还有最后一件事，阿莉娅。你必须对所有人保密‘眼’的存在，甚至包括我们自己的人。知道真相的人越少越好。

english: On my honour as a justiciar, it will be done.
translation: 以我作为审判官的荣誉起誓，定当完成。

english: Good. Saradomin be with you, sister.
translation: 很好。萨拉多明与你同在，姐妹。

english: Jas!
translation: 贾斯！

english: Did you just say... 'Jas'?
translation: 你刚才是不是说了……‘贾斯’？

english: I can't remember. When I looked at the marks on the floor I had this... vision, but it's all unclear.
translation: 我不记得了。当我看着地板上的标记时，我有这个……幻象，但一切都模糊不清。

english: Well, time to see what the others have found!
translation: 好了，是时候看看其他人发现了什么！

english: Hey! Let's see what the others have found!
translation: 嘿！我们去看看其他人发现了什么！

english: Right, what have we discovered?
translation: 好了，我们发现了什么？

english: That large hole behind you is radiating a strange energy. I'm still trying to work out what it is.
translation: 你身后那个大洞正散发出一种奇怪的能量。我还在努力弄清楚它是什么。

english: Need a hand with that?
translation: 需要帮忙吗？

english: No, I can work it out.
translation: 不用，我能搞定。

english: You sure can! What else do we have?
translation: 你当然能！我们还有什么？

english: There's some old rune guardians here with eye symbols on them.
translation: 这里有一些古老的符文守护者，上面有眼睛符号。

english: So this place was definitely used by wizards at one point. Amazing!
translation: 所以这个地方肯定曾经被巫师使用过。太神奇了！

english: Not just any wizards, Saradominist wizards! There's some statues of an old Saradominist Justiciar called Aliya!
translation: 不只是普通巫师，是萨拉多明派的巫师！这里有一些古老的萨拉多明派审判官雕像，名叫阿莉娅！

english: Remarkable! The justiciars haven't been around for thousands of years. That confirms my suspicions about the age of this place.
translation: 了不起！审判官已经消失数千年了。这证实了我对这个地方年代的猜测。

english: That's not all I found. Apparently, this place was once called the Temple of the Eye!
translation: 这还不是我发现的全部。显然，这个地方曾经被称为眼之神殿！

english: The Eye? What's the Eye?
translation: ‘眼’？‘眼’是什么？

english: I remember reading about something called the Eye back at the Wizards' Tower! I only came across mention of it once, but apparently it was a powerful artefact made by Saradomin himself!
translation: 我记得在法师塔读到过一种叫做‘眼’的东西！我只偶然看到过一次提及，但显然它是萨拉多明本人制造的一件强大神器！

english: Sorry... made by Saradomin, you say?
translation: 抱歉……你是说，萨拉多明制造的？

english: That's what the book said. Why?
translation: 书上是这么说的。怎么了？

english: Oh, just checking! I get all caught up in the moment and mishear things sometimes.
translation: 哦，只是确认一下！我有时候太投入就会听错。

english: This 'Eye'... did the book say what it looked like?
translation: 这个‘眼’……书里有没有说它长什么样？

english: It didn't. It didn't actually have any other information on it. I tried to learn more from other books, but found nothing.
translation: 没有。实际上也没有其他任何信息。我试图从其他书中了解更多，但一无所获。

english: Anything else was probably lost when the first Wizards' Tower burnt down.
translation: 其他信息可能都在第一座法师塔烧毁时遗失了。

english: Of course! I've worked out what the energy from that hole is. It's abyssal energy!
translation: 当然！我弄清楚那个洞的能量是什么了。是深渊能量！

english: Hmm... Yes... Brilliant!
translation: 嗯……是的……太棒了！

english: Persten?
translation: 佩斯滕？

english: Ah, sorry! Lost in thought again! It was for a good reason though. I think I've just about worked it all out!
translation: 啊，抱歉！又走神了！不过这是有充分理由的。我想我差不多都搞清楚了！

english: Amazing as always, Persten! We're so lucky to be able to work with you.
translation: 一如既往地了不起，佩斯滕！我们真幸运能和你一起工作。

english: Thank you! So, I reckon my theory that this is an old teleportation matrix was spot on! The wizards here must have used power from the Abyss to create portals to the runic altars.
translation: 谢谢！所以，我认为我关于这是一个古老传送矩阵的理论完全正确！这里的巫师一定利用了深渊的力量来创造通往符文祭坛的传送门。

english: Then, with the power from this 'Eye' and support from their rune guardians, they'd have been able to create runes at lightning speed!
translation: 然后，凭借这枚‘眼睛’的力量以及符石守护者们的支援，他们就能以闪电般的速度创造符石了！

english: The Eye must have had a huge impact on their work. They named the temple after it and fashioned a symbol based on it.
translation: 这枚眼睛一定对他们的工作产生了巨大影响。他们以此命名神庙，并基于它设计了一个符号。

english: And we're still using that symbol today! We just never knew why until now!
translation: 而那个符号我们至今仍在沿用！只是直到现在才知道它的由来！

english: Should we report back to Sedridor?
translation: 我们该回去向塞德里多汇报吗？

english: In a moment. I'm just going to cast a simple revealing spell first, just in case there's anything else hidden here.
translation: 稍等。我先施一个简单的揭露咒语，以防这里还藏着别的东西。

english: Don't worry! I'm sure everything is fine. Let me handle this.
translation: 别担心！我相信一切都会没事的。让我来处理。

english: Huh... now that is a problem.
translation: 呃……这下可麻烦了。

english: Persten!
translation: 珀斯滕！

english: You don't belong in this temple, accursed filth!
translation: 你这该死的污秽之物，不该踏入这座神庙！

english: And so the rift to the Scar is open once more. Humans, fight with us. Let us hold back the Abyss!
translation: 所以通往伤痕的裂隙再次打开了。人类，与我们并肩作战。让我们一起抵挡深渊的侵袭！

english: Sedridor! Something's gone wrong!
translation: 塞德里多！出事了！

english: Through the portal! We've opened some sort of rift to the Abyss!
translation: 穿过传送门！我们打开了一个通往深渊的裂隙！

english: Well you'd better get back there and fix it!
translation: 那你最好回去把它修好！

english: I... I think so. Sorry... I need a moment to collect myself.
translation: 我……我想也是。抱歉……我需要一点时间冷静一下。

english: I'll go and check on Tamara and Cordelia. I'll be back soon
translation: 我去看看塔玛拉和科迪莉亚。我很快就回来。

english: What do we do now? What if more of those creatures come through that rift?
translation: 我们现在该怎么办？要是更多那种怪物从裂隙里钻出来怎么办？

english: Well don't think I'll be stopping them all again! I may be powerful, but that spell still took a lot out of me.
translation: 别指望我再去把它们全部拦下！我虽然法力高强，但那个咒语也消耗了我不少精力。

english: Humans, use the cells. Protect me while I close the rift.
translation: 人类，使用那些能量单元。在我关闭裂隙时保护我。

english: Cells?
translation: 能量单元？

english: Tamara! [player name]! I think I've found something over here!
translation: 塔玛拉！[player name]！我在这里发现了些东西！

english: On my way!
translation: 马上来！

english: If you're hoping I can help in some way, you're out of luck. I may be powerful, but that spell still took a lot out of me. You'll have to hope the others can do something.
translation: 如果你想让我帮上什么忙，那恐怕要失望了。我虽然法力高强，但那个咒语消耗了我太多精力。你得指望其他人能做点什么。

english: I'll go and see what Felix has found.
translation: 我去看看费利克斯发现了什么。

english: Well... I can't say for sure, but I think the containers on this table contain small amounts of runic energy.
translation: 嗯……我不能百分百确定，但我认为这张桌子上的容器里含有少量的符石能量。

english: Right, I'll take one to Tamara.
translation: 好，我拿一个给塔玛拉。

english: Just make sure you don't take more than one! I tried to do that already and the energy within them exploded!
translation: 注意别拿超过一个！我之前试过，里面的能量直接爆炸了！

english: Alright, thanks for the warning.
translation: 好的，谢谢提醒。

english: You should take one of these containers to Tamara. Just don't take more than one or they'll explode!
translation: 你应该拿一个这种容器给塔玛拉。记住别拿超过一个，否则会爆炸！

english: This is what Felix found.
translation: 这就是费利克斯发现的东西。

english: That must be one of the cells we need! Try placing it in the tile next to me.
translation: 那一定是我们需要的能量单元之一！试着把它放到我旁边的瓷砖上。

english: Try placing that cell in the tile next to me.
translation: 试着把那个能量单元放到我旁边的瓷砖上。

english: It worked! This barrier should protect us against those creatures!
translation: 成功了！这个屏障应该能保护我们免受那些怪物的攻击！

english: And just in time too. Here come more of them!
translation: 而且来得正是时候。又来了一批！

english: I'm not sure. The barrier won't hold out for long!
translation: 我不确定。这屏障支撑不了多久！

english: Humans, we need more support. Restore my brethren! Place cells within imbued rocks and they will do the rest.
translation: 人类，我们需要更多支援。复活我的同胞！把能量单元放入注能之石中，其余的交给它们。

english: Imbued rocks? What does that mean?
translation: 注能之石？那是什么意思？

english: I'll see if Felix can help.
translation: 我去看看费利克斯能不能帮忙。

english: I'll see if Felix can help work out what to do next.
translation: 我去看看费利克斯能不能弄清楚接下来要做什么。

english: Felix, we need to place cells in some imbued rocks. Any idea what that means?
translation: 费利克斯，我们需要把能量单元放进一些注能之石里。你知道那是什么意思吗？

english: I think the essence piles here are actually remains of old guardians. They seem to contain elemental and catalytic energies. Perhaps you could try infusing each one with a cell.
translation: 我觉得这里的精华堆其实是古代守护者的遗骸。它们似乎含有元素和催化能量。也许你可以尝试向每一个精华堆注入一个能量单元。

english: You'll probably need a chisel to shape the essence first. Looks like there's one on the floor there.
translation: 你可能需要先拿一把凿子来塑形精华。看起来那边地板上就有一把。

english: Right, I'll get to work.
translation: 好的，我这就动手。

english: Try infusing each of the essence piles here with a cell. You'll probably need a chisel to shape the essence first. Looks like there's one on the floor there.
translation: 尝试用能量单元给这里的每一堆精华充能。你可能需要先拿一把凿子来塑形精华。看起来那边地板上就有一把。

english: It worked! Looks like it's following the elemental symbols on the ground.
translation: 成功了！看起来它正沿着地面上的元素符号移动。

english: Try creating another one using the other essence pile.
translation: 试着用另一个精华堆再创造一个。

english: Try infusing the other essence pile with a cell like you did with the first one.
translation: 试着像之前那样，用能量单元注入另一个精华堆。

english: Amazing! Looks like this one's following the catalytic symbols.
translation: 太棒了！看起来这个正沿着催化符号移动。

english: These guardians should be strong enough to fend off those creatures. Head back to Tamara and see what we should do next.
translation: 这些守护者应该足够强大，能抵挡那些怪物了。回到塔玛拉那里，看看我们接下来该怎么做。

english: The guardians should be strong enough to fend off those creatures. Maybe Tamara will know what to do next.
translation: 守护者应该足够强大，能抵挡那些怪物了。也许塔玛拉知道下一步该怎么做。

english: You made some rune guardians!
translation: 你制造了一些符石守护者！

english: And they seem to be holding back those creatures.
translation: 而且它们似乎在抵挡那些怪物。

english: Humans, I lack the power needed to close the rift! I require runic energy!
translation: 人类，我没有足够的力量关闭裂隙！我需要符石能量！

english: Runic energy? Do we need more cells?
translation: 符石能量？我们还需要更多能量单元吗？

english: Hmm... I don't think they'll work for this. We'll need something else...
translation: 嗯……我觉得它们不适用。我们需要别的东西……

english: Of course! We can use the rune guardians! See all the fallen guardians around here? They'd have once been powered using runic energy!
translation: 当然有！我们可以利用符石守护者！看看周围倒下的守护者？它们曾经就是用符石能量驱动的！

english: If you were to obtain some fragments from them, you might be able to make something to capture the runic energy needed.
translation: 如果你能从它们身上获取一些碎片，或许能制作出捕捉所需符石能量的东西。

english: So mine the fallen guardians?
translation: 所以要去开采那些倒下的守护者？

english: Exactly! Hopefully you can find a pickaxe somewhere. Once you have a few fragments, go and speak to Felix. I'm sure he'll be able to help you use them.
translation: 没错！希望你能在某处找到一把镐子。一旦你有了几块碎片，就去找费利克斯谈谈。我相信他能帮你利用它们。

english: Do you have anything to capture some runic energy with?
translation: 你有什么东西可以捕捉符石能量吗？

english: Try mining some fragments from the fallen guardians. Once you have a few, go and speak to Felix. I'm sure he'll be able to help you use them.
translation: 试着从倒下的守护者身上开采一些碎片。一旦你有一些了，就去找费利克斯谈谈。我相信他能帮你使用它们。

english: I think I have enough fragments. I should speak to Felix about what to do with them.
translation: 我觉得我有足够的碎片了。我应该去找费利克斯，问问怎么处理它们。

english: We need to power up this big guardian somehow, but I need a way to capture runic energy. Tamara said you might be able to help.
translation: 我们需要以某种方式给这个大守护者充能，但我需要一种捕捉符石能量的方法。塔玛拉说你或许能帮忙。

english: Hmm... I reckon this old workbench here might have been used for just that. There's still plenty of pure essence on it for you to use, but that might not be enough...
translation: 嗯……我觉得这里的老旧工作台以前就是干这个用的。上面还有很多纯净精华供你使用，但可能还不够……

english: I have some fragments from the fallen guardians. What if I combined the pure essence with them?
translation: 我有一些倒下的守护者碎片。如果我把纯净精华和它们结合在一起呢？
