english: What if I combined the pure essence with fragments from the fallen guardians?
translation: 如果我把纯净精华和倒下的守护者碎片结合在一起呢？

english: Yes! That would be perfect!
translation: 没错！那太完美了！

english: I have some fragments from the fallen guardians.
translation: 我有一些倒下的守护者碎片。

english: Take them to Felix. He'll hopefully know what to do with them.
translation: 把它们拿去给费利克斯。他应该知道怎么处理。

english: I used the old workbench to make some essence!
translation: 我用老旧工作台制作了一些精华！

english: If you think you have enough, you should take it to Tamara.
translation: 如果你觉得够了，就该拿去给塔玛拉。

english: Do you think this will work?
translation: 你觉得这能行吗？

english: Perfect! Now we just need to capture some runic energy with it.
translation: 完美！现在我们需要用它捕捉一些符石能量。

english: I shall now use power from the Abyss to open a portal to the Runic Altar of Mind.
translation: 我现在要利用深渊的力量，打开一扇通往心灵符石祭坛的传送门。

english: Well... I guess that's your answer. Head to the Mind Altar and craft some runes. That essence you have should capture some of the runic energy released. Take an uncharged cell with you as well.
translation: 嗯……我想这就是答案了。前往心灵祭坛，制作一些符石。你制作的那些精华应该能捕捉到一部分释放出的符石能量。记得也带上一个未充能的能量单元。

english: I have a theory to test.
translation: 我有个理论需要验证。

english: Fair enough. I'll be back soon.
translation: 有道理。我很快回来。

english: Head to the Mind Altar and craft some runes. That essence you made should capture some of the runic energy released. Take an uncharged cell with you as well.
translation: 前往心灵祭坛，制作一些符石。你制作的那些精华应该能捕捉到一部分释放出的符石能量。记得也带上一个未充能的能量单元。

english: I'm not sure. Maybe Tamara will know what to do.
translation: 我不确定。也许塔玛拉知道该怎么做。

english: Look! This is what happened when I took that essence to the Mind Altar.
translation: 看！这就是我带着那精华去心灵祭坛时发生的事。

english: Great! That's exactly what I was hoping for. What about the cell?
translation: 太好了！这正是我所希望的。那个能量单元呢？

english: It seemed to capture energy from the altar as well.
translation: 它似乎也吸收了祭坛的能量。

english: I had a feeling it would! It's all coming together!
translation: 我就知道会这样！一切都连上了！

english: First, you should use that new cell to replace the one powering the barrier here. I don't think the current one will last much longer.
translation: 首先，你应该用那个新的能量单元替换掉为屏障供能的那个。我觉得现在这个撑不了多久了。

english: Then just use those stones to power up this big guardian.
translation: 然后用那些石头给这个大守护者充能。

english: Just use those stones to power up this big guardian.
translation: 就用那些石头给这个大守护者充能。

english: Human, the stones have fueled me, but more are needed.
translation: 人类，这些石头为我提供了能量，但我还需要更多。

english: The guardian still needs more energy!
translation: 守护者还需要更多能量！

english: I guess we need to repeat the process again.
translation: 我想我们得重复这个过程。

english: I shall now use power from the Abyss to open a portal to the Runic Altar of Water.
translation: 我现在要利用深渊的力量，打开一扇通往水流符石祭坛的传送门。

english: Looks like the portal to the Mind Altar has closed. I guess the guardian only keeps them open for so long. You'll need to use the new portal instead. Make sure you take another uncharged cell with you.
translation: 看起来通往心灵祭坛的传送门已经关闭了。我猜守护者只能让它们维持那么久。你需要改用新的传送门。记得带另一个未充能的能量单元。

english: Create some more of that essence and use it to capture energy from the Water Altar. You should then be able to use it to power up the guardian again. Make sure you take another uncharged cell with you.
translation: 再制作一些那种精华，用它来捕捉水流祭坛的能量。然后你应该就能用它再次给守护者充能了。记得带另一个未充能的能量单元。

english: Alright, I'll be back.
translation: 好的，我马上回来。

english: What should I do to power up the big guardian?
translation: 我要怎么做才能给大守护者充能？

english: You could use the workbench here to combine pure essence with fragments from the nearby fallen guardians. The essence would then be perfect for capturing runic energy.
translation: 你可以使用这里的工作台，将纯净精华与附近倒下的守护者碎片结合起来。这样制作出的精华将非常适合捕捉符石能量。

english: Use some more of that essence to capture energy from the Water Altar. You should then be able to use it to power up the guardian again. Make sure you take another uncharged cell with you.
translation: 再用一些那种精华来捕捉水流祭坛的能量。然后你应该就能用它再次给守护者充能了。记得带另一个未充能的能量单元。

english: I have some stones I can use to power the big guardian.
translation: 我有一些石头可以用来给大守护者充能。

english: Great! You should go do that now.
translation: 太好了！你现在就该去办。

english: Just use those stones to power up the guardian again.
translation: 就用那些石头再次给守护者充能。

english: Alright, I'll get right on it.
translation: 好的，我马上去办。

english: Something odd happened at the Water Altar. The energy in this cell seems different to before. The essence also formed this strange talisman.
translation: 在水流祭坛发生了一些奇怪的事。这个能量单元里的能量似乎和之前不一样了。精华也变成了这个奇怪的护符。

english: Oh, fascinating! I guess it makes sense that the stronger the runic energy, the more powerful the cell will be. After all, water is more powerful than air or mind.
translation: 哦，真有趣！我猜符石能量越强，灵核的威力就越大，这说得通。毕竟，水比空气或心灵更强大。

english: Try making another rune guardian using that cell. In the meantime, I'll see if I can work out what this talisman does.
translation: 用那个灵核再做一个符石守护者吧。与此同时，我看看能不能搞明白这个护符有什么用。

english: Try making another rune guardian using that new cell. In the meantime, I'll see if I can work out what this talisman does.
translation: 用那个新灵核再做一个符石守护者吧。与此同时，我看看能不能搞明白这个护符有什么用。

english: I need to make another rune guardian.
translation: 我需要再做另一个符石守护者。

english: Go right ahead. Just use a chisel to shape one of these essence piles and then infuse the result with a cell.
translation: 尽管去吧。只需用凿子把其中一堆精华塑形，然后用灵核注入即可。

english: Look at that! I don't know what you did, but that guardian is much stronger than the ones you made before.
translation: 快看！我不知道你做了什么，但那个守护者比你之前做的那些强多了。

english: That cell made a more powerful rune guardian!
translation: 那个灵核做出了更强大的符石守护者！

english: Great! We're almost there! I think we just need to power up this guardian one more time for it to be able to close that rift.
translation: 太好了！我们快成功了！我想只需要再给这个守护者充能一次，它就能关闭那个裂隙了。

english: I must conserve my power. The portal to the Runic Altar of Water has closed.
translation: 我必须保存我的力量。通往水之符石祭坛的传送门已经关闭了。

english: But we need that portal!
translation: 但我们需要那个传送门！

english: Don't worry, I think there's another way. I reckon that talisman you gave me can be used to return to the Water Altar without the portal being open.
translation: 别担心，我想还有别的办法。我觉得你给我的那个护符可以用来返回水之祭坛，无需传送门开启。

english: Just present that talisman to the statue where the portal to the Water Altar was. Make sure you take more essence and another cell with you.
translation: 只要把那个护符放在原来通往水之祭坛的传送门所在的雕像前就行。记得多带些精华和另一个灵核。

english: I have another cell. Do you want me to power up the barrier again?
translation: 我还有一个灵核。你想让我再次给屏障充能吗？

english: That's right! If my theory is correct, it should produce an even stronger barrier!
translation: 没错！如果我的理论正确，它应该能产生更强的屏障！

english: Look! The barrier changed!
translation: 看！屏障变了！

english: Just as I thought! We can create better barriers by using stronger cells!
translation: 果然和我想的一样！我们可以用更强的灵核制造更好的屏障！

english: Now, let's charge the guardian with those stones you created and close this rift!
translation: 现在，用你造的那些石头给守护者充能，然后关闭这个裂隙！

english: Let's charge the guardian with those stones you created and close this rift!
translation: 用你造的那些石头给守护者充能，然后关闭这个裂隙！

english: Humans, I now have the power to close the rift. Brace yourselves!
translation: 人类，我现在有能力关闭裂隙了。做好准备！

english: We are safe, for now.
translation: 我们现在安全了，暂时如此。

english: What was all that? What happened?
translation: 那是什么情况？发生了什么？

english: That was a rift into an area of the Abyss known as the Scar.
translation: 那是一个通往深渊中名为“伤痕”区域的裂隙。

english: The Scar? But I thought this was meant to be a teleportation matrix.
translation: 伤痕？但我觉得这应该是一个传送矩阵才对。

english: You are mistaken. While it is true that teleportation magic is strong here, that is only a side effect of this temple's history.
translation: 你弄错了。虽然这里的传送魔法确实很强，但那只是这座神殿历史的副作用。

english: What history?
translation: 什么历史？

english: This temple was built to house a powerful artefact. Many sought to claim this artefact for themselves, including servants of the Fallen Empire.
translation: 这座神殿是为了存放一件强大的神器而建的。许多人试图为自己夺取这件神器，包括堕落帝国的仆从。

english: In their attempt to claim the artefact, they used magic they did not understand. The rift to the Scar was created as a result.
translation: 在试图夺取神器时，他们使用了他们并不理解的魔法。结果，通往伤痕之地的裂隙被创造了出来。

english: This artefact... you mean the Eye?
translation: 这件神器……你指的是眼？

english: You are correct. The Eye was removed after the battle, but not before the Justiciar of the Lion used it to seal the rift once more.
translation: 你说得对。眼在战斗后被移走了，但在此之前，雄狮执法官用它再次封印了裂隙。

english: She then created us, the Guardians of the Rift, to protect this place in the event the rift was ever reopened.
translation: 然后她创造了我们——裂隙守护者，来保护这个地方，以防裂隙再次被打开。

english: And we reopened it.
translation: 而我们把它重新打开了。

english: But it's been sealed again now! The danger is gone.
translation: 但现在它又被封印了！危险已经过去了。

english: Incorrect. Without the power of the Eye, we have no way to seal the rift permanently. It will soon reopen once more. You should leave before that happens.
translation: 不对。没有眼的力量，我们无法永久封印裂隙。它很快就会再次打开。你们应该在发生之前离开。

english: No. This was our mistake. I'm staying to help fix it.
translation: 不。这是我们的错。我要留下来帮忙解决。

english: Well if you two are staying, I guess I will as well.
translation: 好吧，如果你们两个都留下，那我想我也留下。

english: Your support will be invaluable.
translation: 你们的支持将是无价的。

english: [player name], could you go back to the Wizards' Tower and let Sedridor know what happened here?
translation: [player name]，你能回法师塔告诉塞德里多这里发生的事情吗？

english: Alright, if you're absolutely sure about this.
translation: 好吧，如果你真的确信要这么做。

english: What about Persten? We have to help her.
translation: 那佩斯滕怎么办？我们必须帮助她。

english: No part of the Abyss is more dangerous than the Scar. Your friend will have already been consumed.
translation: 深渊中没有比伤痕更危险的地方了。你的朋友肯定已经被吞噬了。

english: Now, the power of the Abyss grows. The rift will soon reopen once more. Those of you staying should prepare yourselves.
translation: 现在，深渊的力量正在增强。裂隙很快会再次打开。你们留下的人应该做好准备。

english: Then I guess I'd better go and see Sedridor. Good luck.
translation: 那我最好去找塞德里多了。祝你们好运。

english: Sedridor! It all went wrong!
translation: 塞德里多！全搞砸了！

english: What do you mean? Was there no teleportation matrix?
translation: 什么意思？没有传送矩阵吗？

english: Kind of, but not really. The portal took us to the Temple of the Eye, an ancient Saradominist temple built to house a powerful artefact.
translation: 算是吧，但又不是。传送门把我们带到了眼之神殿，一座古老的萨拉多明神殿，里面存放着一件强大的神器。

english: Long ago, a rift to the Abyss was created in the temple, but it was sealed. At least it was, until Persten accidently opened it again...
translation: 很久以前，神殿里出现了一个通往深渊的裂隙，但被封印了。至少曾经是，直到佩斯滕不小心又打开了它……

english: She was sucked into the Abyss, and all these abyssal creatures came out!
translation: 她被吸进了深渊，然后所有这些深渊生物都跑出来了！

english: Abyssal creatures? We have to get in there and stop this!
translation: 深渊生物？我们必须进去阻止这一切！

english: It's okay again, for now. Some rune guardians called the Guardians of the Rift were built to protect the temple from the Abyss. They helped us close the rift again, but they say it will soon reopen.
translation: 现在暂时又没事了。一些叫做裂隙守护者的符石守护者被造出来保护神殿免受深渊侵袭。它们帮我们再次关闭了裂隙，但它们说裂隙很快就会重新打开。

english: This is a disaster! I knew that teleportation matrix was too good to be true. I should have stopped this, but I was blinded by my own desires for that matrix!
translation: 这真是一场灾难！我就知道那个传送矩阵好得不像真的。我本该阻止这一切的，但我被对矩阵的渴望冲昏了头脑！

english: What of Traiborn's apprentices?
translation: 特雷伯恩的学徒们呢？

english: They're safe. They chose to stay and help the Guardians of the Rift keep the rift closed.
translation: 他们没事。他们选择留下来帮助裂隙守护者维持裂隙关闭。

english: Then I will ensure they have all the help they need. I will also begin researching this rift at once. Maybe we can still find a way to close it permanently.
translation: 那么我会确保他们得到所有需要的帮助。我也会立即开始研究这个裂隙。也许我们还能找到永久关闭它的办法。

english: In the meantime, I suggest you do what you can to help them as well. After all, this is partially your doing.
translation: 与此同时，我建议你也尽力帮助他们。毕竟，这事也有你的一份责任。

english: I know. I'll help wherever I'm needed.
translation: 我知道。我会在需要我的地方提供帮助。

english: Thank you, [player name]. I appreciate that you did not mean for things to go this way. You should have this. It belonged to Persten. I don't want to think about where she got it.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。我知道你不是故意让事情变成这样的。这个应该给你。它原来是佩斯滕的。我不想去想她是从哪里弄来的。

english: Do you think she's still alive?
translation: 你觉得她还活着吗？

english: Sadly, that seems unlikely. Still, if anyone can survive the Abyss, it's her.
translation: 很遗憾，似乎不太可能。不过，如果有人能在深渊中幸存，那一定是她。

english: Now, we'd better get to work.
translation: 现在，我们最好开始干活了。

english: She's... she's dead... Thana...
translation: 她……她死了……萨娜……

english: I... Thank you for the offer. You can't help though. She's gone.
translation: 我……谢谢你的好意。但你帮不上忙。她已经走了。

english: I... I don't know...
translation: 我……我不知道……

english: Right. Let's start with what actually happened. Take a moment to collect yourself and then tell me everything.
translation: 好吧。我们先从实际发生了什么开始。你冷静一下，然后把一切都告诉我。

english: Okay... Thank you...
translation: 好……谢谢你……

english: I'm Mori... I was going to the Library with my friend, Thana. Suddenly, I felt a strange power all through me and then... she... she...
translation: 我是莫里……我和我的朋友萨娜正要去图书馆。突然，我感觉一股奇怪的力量贯穿全身，然后……她……她……

english: ...she just died!
translation: ……她就这么死了！

english: Just like that? Was she ill?
translation: 就这么突然？她生病了吗？

english: The people of Arceuus don't get ill. We're immortal. We have been for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus. This shouldn't happen... This can't happen...
translation: 阿西乌斯城的市民不会生病。我们是不朽的。自从阿西乌斯城崛起以来，我们已经不朽了一千年。这种事不应该发生……不可能发生……

english: The Ascent of Arceuus?
translation: 阿西乌斯城崛起？

english: Yes... A long time ago, our leader, Trobin Arceuus, used the Dark Altar to discover the secret of immortality. He came to us and let us share in this secret.
translation: 是的...很久以前，我们的领袖特罗宾.阿西乌斯利用黑暗祭坛发现了永生的秘密。他来到我们中间，让我们分享这个秘密。

english: The events of that day became known as the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 那一天的事件后来被称为阿西乌斯城崛起。

english: But something's gone wrong... Thana is dead and I don't know why!
translation: 但出了什么问题……萨娜死了，我不知道为什么！

english: We should let someone know about this.
translation: 我们应该把这件事告诉别人。

english: You... You're right. We should let the Kourend Council know. Could you help? I don't want to leave her.
translation: 你……你说得对。我们应该让库兰德王国议会知道。你能帮帮忙吗？我不想离开她。

english: Thank you... Could you head to Kourend Castle and let Councillor Andrews know what's happened? He's in charge of the council.
translation: 谢谢你...你能去库兰德城堡，让安德鲁斯议员知道发生了什么吗？他负责议会。

english: Will do. I'll be back soon.
translation: 没问题。我很快就回来。

english: Actually I have something else to do.
translation: 其实我还有别的事要做。

english: Oh... Okay...
translation: 哦……好吧……

english: I shouldn't get involved.
translation: 我不该掺和进来。

english: Hello. Have you spoken to Councillor Andrews yet?
translation: 你好。你跟安德鲁斯议员谈过了吗？

english: Please hurry. You'll find him in Kourend Castle.
translation: 请快点。你会在库兰德城堡找到他。

english: There's been a death in Arceuus.
translation: 阿西乌斯城有人死了。

english: A death? Well that doesn't seem right. The people of Arceuus don't just die. They can't.
translation: 死了个人？这听着不对劲。阿西乌斯城的市民不会就这么死掉。他们不可能死。

english: I've seen it with my own eyes. A citizen of Arceuus has fallen. What should we do?
translation: 我亲眼所见。一位阿西乌斯城的市民倒下了。我们该怎么办？

english: Well I don't really know what we can do. The Arceuus family have chosen to keep their knowledge secret from the rest of us. We have no expertise in this area.
translation: 嗯，我真的不知道我们能做什么。阿西乌斯家族选择将他们的知识对我们其他人保密。我们在这方面没有专业知识。

english: So you'll do nothing?
translation: 所以你什么也不做？

english: If I could do something, I would. However, I'm afraid this is out of our hands.
translation: 如果我能做点什么，我会的。不过，恐怕这事已超出我们的掌控。

english: I see. I suppose I'd better tell Mori.
translation: 我明白了。我想我最好去告诉莫里。

english: I'm sorry, but as I already told you, we can't help.
translation: 抱歉，但正如我告诉你的，我们帮不上忙。

english: Here she is, the hero of the hour. On behalf of the Council, and indeed all of Kourend, thank you for dealing with this messy situation.
translation: 她来了，此刻的英雄。我代表议会，以及整个库兰德王国，感谢你处理了这个棘手的局面。

english: Kourend's last king, Kharedst IV, had only one child when he died. She was too young to take the throne so the Kourend Council was formed to look after things until she came of age.
translation: 库兰德王国的最后一位国王，卡雷斯特四世，去世时只有一个孩子。她太小无法登基，因此库兰德议会成立，负责管理事务直到她成年。

english: The five houses of Kourend each have their own leader who rules over their city. The leaders of the individual houses must enforce and obey the laws set out by the Kourend Council but can otherwise rule as they see fit.
translation: 库兰德王国的五个家族各有自己的领袖，统治各自的城市。各家族的领袖必须执行和遵守库兰德议会制定的法律，但在其他方面可以自行裁决。

english: One of the councillors holds the position of head councillor and this rotates every year. I am the current head councillor.
translation: 其中一位议员担任首席议员，每年轮换。我是现任首席议员。

english: My name is David Andrews. I'm the head councillor of the Kourend Council.
translation: 我叫大卫.安德鲁斯。我是库兰德议会的首席议员。

english: The other councillors are Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson. The fourth seat on the council is currently vacent after the recent arrest of Councillor Hughes.
translation: 其他议员是昂卡尔议员和奥森议员。议会的第四个席位在最近逮捕了休斯议员后目前空缺。

english: Hello there. Thank you for resolving the Sophia Hughes problem. Let's hope we can get these protests sorted soon as well.
translation: 你好。感谢你解决了索菲娅.休斯的问题。希望我们也能很快解决这些抗议活动。

english: Indeed. Everything should soon be back to normal.
translation: 确实。一切应该很快恢复正常。

english: The other councillors are Councillor Unkar and Councillor Orson. The fourth seat on the Council is currently vacent after the recent arrest of Councillor Hughes.
translation: 其他议员是昂卡尔议员和奥森议员。议会的第四个席位在最近逮捕了休斯议员后目前空缺。

english: Hello there. I hear you're helping Commander Fullore with our little situation. I hope a resolution is reached soon.
translation: 你好。我听说你正在帮助富洛尔指挥官处理我们的小状况。希望很快能达成解决方案。

english: Good day to u.
translation: 日安。

english: I have. The council won't be helping I'm afraid.
translation: 我已经说过了。恐怕议会不会帮忙。

english: Oh... I shouldn't be surprised I guess... The council only care about helping themselves.
translation: 哦……我想我不该感到惊讶……议会只关心自己。

english: Sounds like you don't like the council much.
translation: 听起来你不太喜欢议会。

english: The council are supposed to rule Kourend, but they never do anything for the people. They shouldn't even exist anyway. They were only meant to rule until the last king's daughter came of age.
translation: 议会本该统治库兰德王国，但他们从不为人民做任何事。他们甚至根本就不该存在。他们只是被安排统治到上一位国王的女儿成年为止。

english: The council declared her unfit for rule not long after the king died. She disappeared soon after and no one knows what became of her. Now the council are the permanent rulers of Kourend.
translation: 国王去世后不久，议会就宣布她不适合统治。她随后不久就失踪了，没人知道她出了什么事。现在议会成了库兰德王国的永久统治者。

english: It was a waste of time even going to them. They were never going to care about Thana.
translation: 去找他们完全是浪费时间。他们根本不会在乎萨娜。

english: What should we do now?
translation: 我们现在该怎么办？

english: Well... if the Council won't help us, maybe Lord Arceuus will. He doesn't show his face in public much these days but he can't ignore the death of one of his own.
translation: 嗯...如果议会不帮助我们，也许阿西乌斯领主会。他这些天不常在公开场合露面，但他不能忽视自己族人的死亡。

english: Good idea. Where can I find him?
translation: 好主意。我在哪里能找到他？

english: He'll be in the Tower of Magic, north west of here.
translation: 他会在魔法塔，从这里往西北方向。

english: Hello. Have you spoken to Lord Arceuus yet?
translation: 你好。你和阿西乌斯领主谈过了吗？

english: Please don't take too long. You'll find Lord Arceuus in the Tower of Magic.
translation: 请别花太长时间。你会在魔法塔找到阿西乌斯领主。

english: Thank you... Could you head to Kourend Castle and let Councillor Andrews know what's happened? He's in charge of the Council.
translation: 谢谢你...你能去库兰德城堡，让安德鲁斯议员知道发生了什么吗？他负责议会。

english: Oh... I shouldn't be surprised I guess... The Council only care about helping themselves.
translation: 哦……我想我也不该惊讶……议会只关心他们自己。

english: The people of Arceuus don't get ill. We're immortal, we have been for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus. This shouldn't happen... this can't happen...
translation: 阿西乌斯城的人不会生病。我们是永生者，已经有一千年了，自从阿西乌斯城崛起以来就是这样。这不应该发生……这不可能发生……

english: Well... If the Council won't help us, maybe Lord Arceuus will. He doesn't show his face in public much these days but he can't ignore the death of one of his own.
translation: 嗯...如果议会不帮助我们，也许阿西乌斯领主会。他这些天不常在公开场合露面，但他不能忽视自己族人的死亡。

english: The Council are supposed to rule Kourend but they never do anything for the people. They shouldn't even exist anyway. They were only meant to rule until the last king's daughter came of age.
translation: 议会本该统治库兰德王国，但他们从不为人民做任何事。他们本来就不该存在。他们只应该统治到前任国王的女儿成年为止。

english: The Council declared her unfit for rule not long after the king died. She disappeared soon after and no one knows what became of her. Now the Council are the permanent rulers of Kourend.
translation: 国王去世后不久，议会就宣布她不适合统治。她很快就失踪了，没人知道她的下落。现在议会成了库兰德王国的永久统治者。

english: Well... if the council won't help us, maybe Lord Arceuus will. He doesn't show his face in public much these days but he can't ignore the death of one of his own.
translation: 嗯...如果议会不帮助我们，也许阿西乌斯领主会。他这些天不常在公开场合露面，但他不能忽视自己族人的死亡。

english: Hello there. Thank you for helping us. You are a good friend to the people of Arceuus.
translation: 你好。谢谢你帮助我们。你是阿西乌斯城人民的好朋友。

english: The Council are supposed to rule Kourend, but they never do anything for the people. They shouldn't even exist anyway. They were only meant to rule until the last King's daughter came of age.
translation: 议会本该统治库兰德王国，但他们从不为人民做任何事。他们本来就不该存在。他们只应该统治到前任国王的女儿成年为止。

english: The Council declared her unfit for rule not long after the King died. She disappeared soon after and no one knows what became of her. Now the Council are the permanent rulers of Kourend.
translation: 国王去世后不久，议会就宣布她不适合统治。她很快就失踪了，没人知道她的下落。现在议会成了库兰德王国的永久统治者。

english: You don't seem to have everything I need. I need some molten glass and a dark essence block.
translation: 你好像没有带齐我需要的东西。我需要一些熔融玻璃和一个黑暗精华块。

english: I need to speak to Lord Arceuus.
translation: 我需要和阿西乌斯领主谈谈。

english: We're currently facing an issue in the Tower of Magic. No one may enter until the issue is resolved.
translation: 我们目前面临魔法塔里的一个问题。在问题解决之前，任何人不得进入。

english: But it's important, there's been a death in Arceuus.
translation: 但这事很重要，阿西乌斯城有人死了。

english: A death? This isn't good. The death you speak of may be connected to the issue we are currently facing. You'd better go in.
translation: 死了个人？这可不妙。你说的死亡可能跟我们目前面临的问题有关。你最好进去。

english: Somebody deal with these souls!
translation: 谁来处理这些灵魂！

english: Somebody deal with this!
translation: 谁来处理这个！

english: Someone sort out these souls!
translation: 有谁来把这些灵魂解决掉！

english: We need to deal with these souls!
translation: 我们需要处理这些灵魂！

english: Thank you for helping with those souls. You should head upstairs and speak with Asteros Arceuus. He might be able to fill you in on what's happening here.
translation: 谢谢你帮忙处理那些灵魂。你应该上楼去和阿斯特罗斯.阿西乌斯谈谈。他或许能告诉你这里发生了什么。

english: You have already been granted permission to enter the Tower of Magic. You should go inside.
translation: 你已经被允许进入魔法塔了。你应该进去。

english: Thank you for helping with those souls. You should speak with Asteros Arceuus. He might be able to fill you in on what's happening here.
translation: 谢谢你帮助处理那些灵魂。你应该和阿斯特罗斯.阿西乌斯谈谈。他也许能告诉你这里发生了什么。

english: I hear you've agreed to help us out. Thank you.
translation: 我听说你同意帮我们了。谢谢你。

english: Somebody deaw with dase souws!
translation: 有银能处理一下那些灵魂吗！

english: Thank you for helping us out with those souls. As you can see, we're facing quite the crisis.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们处理那些灵魂。正如你所见，我们正面临一场危机。

english: I don't understand. What's going on?
translation: 我不明白。发生什么事了？

english: I'm afraid we don't quite know ourselves yet. A short while ago, our instruments detected fluctuations in power from the Dark Altar.
translation: 恐怕我们自己也不太清楚。不久之前，我们的仪器检测到黑暗祭坛的魔力出现了波动。

english: Before we could do anything, we all felt a strange loss of power, as if the Altar had failed altogether.
translation: 我们还没来得及做任何事，就都感到一股奇怪的力量流失，仿佛祭坛完全失效了。

english: My father was quick to act, using himself as a conduit to channel what little power the Altar had left.
translation: 我父亲迅速行动，以自身为导体，导引祭坛仅存的微弱力量。

english: It seems the loss in power had an interesting impact on our experiments though. Some trapped souls that we were working to free were suddenly released.
translation: 不过，力量流失似乎对我们的实验产生了一个有趣的影响。一些我们正在努力解救的被困的灵魂突然被释放了。

english: Alas, whatever happened seemed to cause them great pain, making them to go feral. They are now at peace though, thanks to you.
translation: 唉，无论发生了什么，似乎都给他们带来了巨大的痛苦，使他们陷入狂乱。不过，多亏了你，他们现在安息了。

english: Well I'm afraid I have some bad news which is likely related to this. A citizen of Arceuus has died.
translation: 呃，恐怕我有个坏消息，很可能和这件事有关。一位阿西乌斯城的市民死了。

english: A death? No! My father acted as fast as he could, but it sounds like he was not fast enough. This is a dark day for Arceuus.
translation: 死了？不！我父亲已经尽全力快速行动了，但看来他还是不够快。这对阿西乌斯城来说是黑暗的一天。

english: Tell me, who has fallen?
translation: 告诉我，谁倒下了？

english: Thana. Mori is with her next to the pond.
translation: 萨娜。莫里在她身边，在池塘边。

english: Dear Thana, you did not deserve this fate. Thank you for bringing this terrible news to us. I will make sure someone is sent out to take care of Thana and Mori.
translation: 亲爱的萨娜，你不该承受这样的命运。谢谢你告诉我们这个可怕的消息。我会确保派人去照料萨娜和莫里。

english: I still don't understand how this happened.
translation: 我还是不明白这是怎么发生的。

english: Ever since the Ascent of Arceuus, our people have been kept alive by the Dark Altar. Its power sustains our bodies in the same way yours is sustained by food and drink.
translation: 自从阿西乌斯城崛起以来，我们的人民一直靠黑暗祭坛维持生命。它的力量支撑着我们的身体，就像你靠食物和饮料维持一样。

english: Without the power of the Dark Altar, there's nothing to keep our people alive. The loss in power from the Altar will be what killed Thana.
translation: 没有黑暗祭坛的力量，就没什么能维持我们人民的生命。祭坛的力量流失就是杀死萨娜的原因。

english: The Altar is currently giving out a fraction of the power it normally would. The only thing keeping us alive is my father. His strength won't last forever though.
translation: 祭坛目前输出的力量只有正常的一小部分。唯一让我们活着的是我父亲。但他的力量不会永远持续下去。

english: If we can't find and fix whatever has caused this loss of power, our people are surely doomed. Now that those souls have been dealt with, we can perform tests both here and at the Altar to try and find the problem.
translation: 如果我们不能找到并修复造成力量流失的原因，我们的人民就注定要灭亡。既然那些灵魂已经处理完毕，我们可以在这里和祭坛进行测试，试图找出问题所在。

english: Time is not on our side though, and I fear we won't be fast enough.
translation: 但时间不站在我们这边，我担心我们不够快。

english: Well... There is a secret known only to a few of us. At any other time, I would never dream of telling an outsider.
translation: 嗯……有一个秘密只有我们少数人知道。换作其他任何时候，我都绝不会考虑告诉外人。

english: But our people's lives are in danger and you may well be the only one who can save us.
translation: 但人民的生命危在旦夕，而你很可能就是唯一能拯救我们的人。

english: What is this secret?
translation: 这个秘密是什么？

english: It's believed by most that the knowledge of immortality was discovered by my father. The truth is, the discovery was not his.
translation: 大多数人都认为不朽的知识是我父亲发现的。但真相是，那个发现并非他的功劳。

english: To the west of here, lies the sulphur volcano of Mount Karuulm. Within live the Tasakaal, three ancient beings with power over life and death. They granted my father the knowledge that led to the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 此地的西方，坐落着卡鲁尔姆山的硫磺火山。里面住着塔萨卡尔，三位掌管生死的古老存在。他们赐予了我父亲知识，最终导致了阿西乌斯城崛起。

english: And you think they can help us?
translation: 你认为他们能帮我们？

english: Their knowledge of the Dark Altar far exceeds ours. If anyone can help us, it's them. Ideally I'd send one of our own, but I have no one to spare. You are the only one who can help us.
translation: 他们对黑暗祭坛的了解远超我们。如果有人能帮我们，那就是他们。理想情况下我会派我们自己的人去，但我人手不足。你是唯一能帮我们的人。

english: I'd better not waste any time then.
translation: 那我最好别浪费时间了。

english: Thank you friend. You'll find Mount Karuulm on the other side of Lovakengj. Please hurry.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。你会在洛瓦肯吉城的另一边找到卡鲁尔姆山。请快一点。

english: Please hurry to Mount Karuulm. The Tasakaal may be the only ones who can save us. You'll find the volcano on the other side of Lovakengj.
translation: 请快赶到卡鲁尔姆山。塔萨卡尔可能是唯一能拯救我们的人。你会在洛瓦肯吉城的另一边找到那座火山。

english: This balance is what we serve.
translation: 我们侍奉的就是这种平衡。

english: Hmmm. Very well. I'll go and free this soul.
translation: 嗯。好吧。我会去释放这个灵魂。

english: Free the trapped soul.
translation: 释放被困的灵魂。

english: You'll find it in a grave.
translation: 你会在一个坟墓里找到它。

english: By the battlefront to the south.
translation: 在南边的战场前线旁边。

english: To a construct, built by a mortal.
translation: 到一个由凡人建造的构造体那里。

english: Go to the Dark Altar.
translation: 去黑暗祭坛。

english: Right next to the altar.
translation: 就在祭坛旁边。

english: The altar is fine, but its power has been redirected.
translation: 祭坛没问题，但它的力量被转移了。

english: You should return to the people of Arceuus.
translation: 你应该回到阿西乌斯城的人民那里去。

english: Find and destroy the construct.
translation: 找到并摧毁那个构造体。

english: The power has been restored.
translation: 力量已经恢复。

english: You said the altar was failing.
translation: 你说过祭坛正在衰竭。

english: The anima of this world. It is fed by life.
translation: 这个世界的灵气。由生命滋养。

english: We noticed.
translation: 我们注意到了。

english: The human wetuwns.
translation: 人类回来了。

english: There. That's the device destroyed. The people of Arceuus should be safe now. I'd better go to the Tower of Magic and check.
translation: 好了。装置已被摧毁。阿西乌斯城的市民现在应该安全了。我最好去魔法塔确认一下。

english: Whatever you did, it seems to have worked. Everything is back to normal. You should talk to my father, he'll want to thank you.
translation: 不管你怎么做的，似乎都奏效了。一切都恢复了正常。你应该和我父亲谈谈，他会想感谢你的。

english: Before we could do anything, we all felt a strange loss of power, as if the altar had failed altogether.
translation: 我们还没来得及做任何事，就都感到一股奇怪的力量流失，仿佛祭坛完全失效了。

english: I'm afraid my father is deep in concentration and is unable to talk.
translation: 恐怕我父亲正在深度凝思，无法交谈。

english: To the west of here, lies the sulphur volcano of Mount Karuulm. Within, live the Tasakaal, three ancient beings with power over life and death. They granted my father the knowledge that led to the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 从这里往西，是卡鲁尔姆山的硫磺火山。里面住着塔萨卡尔，三个掌握生死力量的古老存在。他们赐予我父亲知识，最终促成了阿西乌斯城崛起。

english: Whatever you did it seems to have worked. Everything is back to normal. You should talk to my father, he'll want to thank you.
translation: 无论你做了什么，似乎奏效了。一切都恢复正常了。你应该和我父亲谈谈，他想感谢你。

english: If we can't find and fix whatever has caused this loss of power, our people are surely doomed. Now that those souls have been dealt with, we can perform tests both here and at the altar to try and find the problem.
translation: 如果我们找不到并修复造成力量流失的问题，我们的人民注定完蛋。既然那些灵魂已经处理了，我们可以在这里和祭坛进行测试，试图找出问题。

english: Without the power of the Dark Altar, there's nothing to keep our people alive. The loss in power from the altar will be what killed Thana.
translation: 没有黑暗祭坛的力量，我们的人民就无法存活。祭坛的力量流失正是杀死萨娜的原因。

english: My father was quick to act, using himself as a conduit to channel what little power the altar had left.
translation: 我父亲迅速行动，用自己作为导管，引导祭坛仅剩的微弱力量。

english: The altar is currently giving out a fraction of the power it normally would. The only thing keeping us alive is my father. His strength won't last forever though.
translation: 祭坛目前只能提供正常情况下一小部分的力量。唯一能让我们活下去的是我父亲。但他的力量不会永远持续。

english: Have you spoken to the Tasakaal yet?
translation: 你和塔萨卡尔谈过了吗？

english: Please hurry, I don't know how long my father can hold on for.
translation: 请快一点，我不知道我父亲还能坚持多久。

english: Please hurry. I don't know how long my father can hold on for.
translation: 请快一点。我不知道我父亲还能坚持多久。

english: Lord Arceuus?
translation: 阿西乌斯领主？

english: You're the one that saved our people. On behalf of all of Arceuus, I thank you.
translation: 你就是那个拯救了我们人民的人。我代表整个阿西乌斯城感谢你。

english: So everything is okay now?
translation: 所以现在一切都好了？

english: It seems so. A short while ago I felt the power of the Dark Altar return to normal levels. I was safely able to stop my ritual and let the Altar work on its own again.
translation: 看来是的。不久前我感到黑暗祭坛的力量恢复了正常水平。我得以安全地停止仪式，让祭坛重新自行运转。

english: Now tell me, what was the cause of this and how did you stop it?
translation: 现在告诉我，这件事的原因是什么，你是如何阻止的？

english: Your son recommended that I speak to the Tasakaal. They had me perform a task for them but after that they agreed to help. They didn't seem to like you much though.
translation: 你的儿子建议我去找塔萨卡尔。他们让我为他们完成一项任务，之后他们同意帮忙。不过他们似乎不太喜欢你。

english: Well that's no surprise. The Tasakaal seem to feel that only they deserve immortality. It's rather hypocritical of them. It clearly didn't stop them helping you though.
translation: 嗯，这并不奇怪。塔萨卡尔似乎觉得只有他们才配得上不朽。他们真是虚伪。不过显然这并没有阻止他们帮助你。

english: They were reluctant, but they admitted that the people of Arceuus were useful to them.
translation: 他们不太情愿，但他们承认阿西乌斯城的市民对他们有用。

english: Such is their way. They act superior to us, but the reality is they'll work with anyone if they think it will further their aims.
translation: 他们就是那样。他们表现得比我们优越，但现实是，只要他们认为有助于实现自己的目标，他们就会和任何人合作。

english: So how did they help you?
translation: 那他们是怎么帮你的？

english: They found out that the power of the Altar was being redirected into a device hidden nearby. I found the device and destroyed it.
translation: 他们发现祭坛的力量被重新导向了一个藏在附近的装置。我找到了那个装置并摧毁了它。

english: A device? What was it?
translation: 一个装置？那是什么？

english: I'm not sure, but the Tasakaal said it was made by a mortal.
translation: 我不确定，但塔萨卡尔说它是一个凡人制造的。

english: The Tasakaal view everyone who isn't one of them as a mere mortal, even those of us who have also achieved immortality. That doesn't narrow down the options very much.
translation: 塔萨卡尔把不属于他们的人都视为凡人，就连我们这些也获得了永生的人也不例外。这并不能缩小多少范围。

english: This is most concerning though. If someone deliberately sabotaged the Altar, who knows what else they might do. I'll have someone recover the remains of this device. Maybe we can work out where it came from.
translation: 不过这非常令人担忧。如果有人蓄意破坏祭坛，谁知道他们还会做什么。我会派人回收这个装置的遗骸。也许我们能弄清楚它来自哪里。

english: For now though, I'd like to once again thank you for your help. Today was a dark day for our people but without you it would have been our end. Please accept these gifts. They are the least you deserve.
translation: 不过现在，我想再次感谢你的帮助。今天对我们族人来说是黑暗的一天，但如果没有你，我们可能已经灭亡了。请收下这些礼物，这是你应得的最起码的回报。

english: Now, can I help you further?
translation: 现在，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Well that's no surprise, the Tasakaal seem to feel that only they deserve immortality. It's rather hypocritical of them. It clearly didn't stop them helping you though.
translation: 这倒不奇怪，塔萨卡尔似乎觉得只有他们才配得上永生。真是太虚伪了。不过显然这并没有阻止他们帮助你。

english: For now though, I'd like to once again thank you for your help. Today was a dark day for our people but without you it would have been our end. Please accept these gifts, they are the least you deserve.
translation: 不过现在，我想再次感谢你的帮助。今天对我们的人民来说是黑暗的一天，但如果没有你，那就是我们的末日了。请收下这些礼物，这是你应得的最起码的回报。

english: It seems so. A short while ago I felt the power of the Dark Altar return to normal levels. I was safely able to stop my ritual and let the altar work on its own again.
translation: 似乎是的。不久前我感觉到黑暗祭坛的力量恢复到了正常水平。我得以安全地停止我的仪式，让祭坛自行运转。

english: This is most concerning though. If someone deliberately sabotaged the altar, who knows what else they might do. I'll have someone recover the remains of this device. Maybe we can work out where it came from.
translation: 不过这才最令人担忧。如果有人蓄意破坏祭坛，谁知道他们还会做什么。我会派人回收这个装置的遗骸。也许我们能查出它的来历。

english: I am Trobin Arceuus, Lord of Arceuus. It's a position I've held for a thousand years, ever since the Ascent of Arceuus.
translation: 我是特罗宾.阿西乌斯，阿西乌斯城的领主。自从阿西乌斯城崛起以来，这个职位我已经担任了一千年。

english: Impossible to say, the Dark Altar has been mentioned in records dating back to the earliest days of Kourend. Before then, who knows.
translation: 说不准，黑暗祭坛在库兰德王国最早时期的记录中就有提及。在那之前，谁知道呢。

english: I was there when King Agata was deposed, I was there when Kharedst the Builder opened Kourend Castle and I was there when Emperor Imafore was executed.
translation: 阿加塔国王被废黜时我在场，建筑工人卡雷德斯特打开库兰德城堡时我在场，伊马福尔皇帝被处决时我也在场。

english: I had one of my people recover the remains of that device. The one that was absorbing power from the Dark Altar.
translation: 我让我的人回收了那个装置的遗骸。就是那个从黑暗祭坛吸收力量的装置。

english: Here. You'll need to show this device to the Tasakaal.
translation: 给你。你需要把这个装置展示给塔萨卡尔看。

english: You will need to show this device to the Tasakaal. Return to me once you have room for it.
translation: 你需要把这个装置展示给塔萨卡尔看。等你有空位了再回来找我。

english: Very well. We will speak again soon.
translation: 很好。我们很快会再谈。

english: Hello there. I was hoping you'd come and speak with me. There is much we need to discuss. However, you should speak with Commander Fullore first.
translation: 你好。我正希望你能来和我谈谈。我们有很多事需要讨论。不过，你应该先和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: I admit, the idea of someone sabotaging the altar is more than a bit concerning. I hope we can make some progress soon.
translation: 我承认，有人破坏祭坛的想法确实令人担忧。我希望我们很快能取得进展。

english: Hello there. You have my support with the Royal Accord. You should speak with Commander Fullore.
translation: 你好。我支持你的皇家协议。你应该和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。

english: Now, can me hewp u fuwdaw?
translation: 现在，俺能帮您做点啥？

english: Ahoy, young [lad/lass]. Might ye be able to help me, perhaps? I be in a spot of bother.
translation: 嘿，年轻的[lad/lass]。或许你能帮我个忙？我遇到了点麻烦。

english: I be the Corsair Captain! Captain of the Corsairs of Corsair Cove! My gallant band of corsairs are famed in song and story among all seafarers.
translation: 我就是海盗船长！海盗湾的海盗们的船长！我英勇的海盗队伍在所有海员中都是歌谣和故事里的传奇。

english: I've never heard of you.
translation: 我从没听说过你。

english: Arrr... well, ye can boast of yer ignorance if ye likes, but it don't make ye sound smarter.
translation: 啊呵……好吧，你要是想炫耀你的无知随你便，但这不会让你显得更聪明。

english: Well, as I were saying, young [lad/lass], I be in a spot of bother, and I thought ye might be able to help.
translation: 嗯，正如我刚才说的，年轻的[lad/lass]，我遇到了点麻烦，我想你或许能帮上忙。

english: That's very interesting; do tell me more.
translation: 真有意思，快跟我说说。

english: What kind of help do you need?
translation: 你需要什么样的帮助？

english: It be about my crew. They be a lazy bunch at times, but they be stout in the heart and strong in the arm, and they don't deserve what's happened to them...
translation: 是关于我的船员。他们有时候是群懒鬼，但他们心志坚定、臂力强壮，他们不该遭受这种遭遇……

english: It be a curse! A curse has been laid upon my crew! That's the only thing it can be.
translation: 这是诅咒术！我的船员被下了诅咒术！只可能是这样。

english: So I need a young [lad/lass] such as yerself to find a way to lift the curse. Will ye help me?
translation: 所以我需要一个像你这样的年轻[lad/lass]来找到解除诅咒术的方法。你愿意帮我吗？

english: Sure, I'll try to help with your curse.
translation: 当然，我会尽力帮你解决诅咒术的问题。

english: Arrr! Thanks, young [lad/lass]. And a worthy [lad/lass] ye must surely be, brave in the heart and stiff in the spine.
translation: 啊呵！谢谢你，年轻的[lad/lass]。你肯定是个值得信赖的[lad/lass]，勇气可嘉、脊梁挺直。

english: Now, I've a ship moored west of Rimmington. Come and meet me on board, and we'll set off to Corsair Cove.
translation: 现在，我的船停泊在里明顿村西边。到船上来找我，我们出发去海盗湾。

english: West of Rimmington, you say? Okay, I'll meet you on board your ship there.
translation: 你说里明顿村西边？好的，我会到你的船上与你会合。

english: No, I'm not available.
translation: 不了，我没空。

english: Arrr. Some other time, perhaps...
translation: 啊呵。那也许改天吧……

english: Arrr, ye've found my ship - good [lad/lass]. I used to command a much larger vessel, sailing the seas with my crew of Corsairs, but now we be settled in Corsair Cove.
translation: 啊呵，你找到我的船了——好[lad/lass]。我以前指挥一艘更大的船，带着我的海盗船员在海上航行，但现在我们在海盗湾定居了。

english: My Corsairs be a good crew, but this curse has laid them low, all except me. Sickly, they be. Too weak to stand. Ye'll see fer yerself soon enough.
translation: 我的海盗们是一群好船员，但这诅咒术把他们全放倒了，除了我。他们病恹恹的，虚弱得站不起来。你很快就会亲眼看到的。

english: There be four of 'em afflicted by the curse - Gnocci, Ithoi, Arsen and young Colin. All taken to their beds, a- mewlin' and a-pukin' like so many babbies.
translation: 他们中有四个被诅咒折磨——格诺基、伊索伊、阿森和小科林。全都躺在床上，像婴儿一样又哭又吐。

english: I've another crewman, Francois, but he be away on a mission. I hope he be spared!
translation: 我还有个船员叫弗朗索瓦，但他出任务去了。希望他能幸免！

english: Now be ye ready to voyage to Corsair Cove to help 'em? I can sail ye back here any time ye likes.
translation: 你现在准备好航行到海盗湾去帮助他们了吗？我可以随时送你回来。

english: Okay, I'm ready go to Corsair Cove.
translation: 好的，我准备好去海盗湾了。

english: That's fair enough, young [lad/lass], but perhaps ye'll return to help me soon...
translation: 没关系，年轻的[lad/lass]，但也许你很快就会回来帮我……

english: Urgh!
translation: 呃啊！

english: I hear you've been cursed.
translation: 我听说你们被诅咒了。

english: I think so. That navigator, Ithoi, always warned us that this kind of thing could happen, but I didn't think it could possibly be real. But now this has happened, and I think it's my fault.
translation: 我想是的。那个航海家Ithoi总是警告我们这种事可能发生，但我没想到真的会成真。但现在发生了，我觉得是我的错。

english: You should maybe see what Ithoi thinks. He's been cursed too, so I guess he'll be in his hut, off to the south-west, near the shore.
translation: 你也许该听听Ithoi的看法。他也被诅咒了，所以我猜他会在他的小屋，就在西南方向靠近海岸的地方。

english: Urgh to you too, with candy sprinkles on.
translation: 也回你一句呃啊，再撒上糖果碎。

english: A sympathetic soul you are. I'm in real pain here.
translation: 你真是个体贴的人。我正痛得要命呢。

english: Yes, I hear you've been cursed.
translation: 是的，我听说你们被诅咒了。

english: I'm sorry! Tell her I'm sorry! Then maybe she'll make the pain stop...
translation: 对不起！告诉她我很抱歉！也许这样她就会让痛苦停止……

english: Yes, that's what it must be. Ithoi, the navigator, always told us to beware of curses. You should talk to him - he really knows about these things.
translation: 是的，一定是这样。航海家Ithoi总是提醒我们要小心诅咒。你应该跟他谈谈——他精通这些事。

english: Ithoi lives in the hut to the south-west, nearest to the sea.
translation: Ithoi住在西南边的小屋里，离海最近的那间。

english: Perhaps you can tell me about it another time.
translation: 也许你可以改天再跟我说这事。

english: I'll be here. I'm not going anywhere while I feel so sick.
translation: 我会在这儿。我病得这么重，哪儿也去不了。

english: My stomach!
translation: 我的胃！

english: Yes, I think She did this to us. I should have left Her alone. Ithoi told us to beware of this kind of thing.
translation: 是的，我觉得是她对我们下的手。我当初不该招惹她的。Ithoi告诉我们要小心这种事。

english: Ithoi's been cursed too. You can probably find him in his hut, south-west from here.
translation: Ithoi也被诅咒了。你大概能在他的小屋里找到他，从这里往西南走。

english: My lower intestine!
translation: 我的下肠道！

english: ... look, I'm in a lot of pain here. We're not playing Name Your Favourite Body Part.
translation: ……听着，我疼得要命。我们不是在玩“说出你最喜欢的身体部位”。

english: Arrr, we be cursed, we be CURSED! It be a curse upon us!
translation: 啊，我们被诅咒了，我们被诅咒了！这是降在我们身上的诅咒术！

english: Aye? D'ye think so? Really? Am I not a picture of health an' beauty?
translation: 是吗？你这么觉得？真的吗？难道我看起来不健康又美丽吗？

english: YES - WE'VE BEEN CURSED!
translation: 是的——我们被诅咒了！

english: I've sailed the seas all my life. I sailed the seas as a man, like I sailed 'em as a boy.
translation: 我一生都在海上航行。我像小时候一样，作为一个男人航行在海上。

english: I even sailed the seas during that tricky phase in between, when ye'r not quite a man yet, but ye'r not really a boy anymore. But I don't want to talk about that bit.
translation: 我甚至在那个尴尬的过渡期也航行过——那时候你既不算真正的男人，但也不再是个男孩了。但我不想谈那段经历。

english: The point I'm makin' is that I know the seas like I know the palm of my hand. I've been to strange lands an' seen things that'll make yer juices turn in yer veins.
translation: 我要说的是，我对大海了如指掌，就像熟悉自己的手掌一样。我去过陌生的土地，见过让你血脉贲张的东西。

english: I've seen dancing fish-women, monkey-kings, huge men in turbans from the far West selling treasure maps - you name it, an' I've seen it.
translation: 我见过跳舞的鱼女、猴王、来自遥远西方的缠头巾的巨汉卖藏宝图——你说得出来的，我都见过。

english: There be more things in the world than ye dreams of in yer fancy book-learnin'! An' most of 'em be hostile. Could be any number of things brought this curse upon us. Demons, evil spirits, anything!
translation: 这世上的东西比你那些花哨书本里梦到的还多！而且大部分都是敌对的。可能是任何东西给我们带来了这诅咒术。恶魔、恶灵，什么都有可能！

english: Okay, it doesn't sound like you know what's behind the curse. Thanks.
translation: 好吧，听起来你并不知道诅咒术背后的原因。谢谢。

english: I think I'll leave you to get on with it.
translation: 我想我就不打扰你了。

english: ... arrr.
translation: ……啊呵。

english: Have ye any idea about how to lift the curse?
translation: 你知道怎么解除诅咒术吗？

english: I've spoken to some of your crew.
translation: 我跟你的几个船员谈过了。

english: Arrr! Make sure ye speaks to 'em all. They'll be in their huts, over to the west. Four of them, there are - Gnocci, Ithoi, Arsen and young Colin.
translation: 啊呵！一定要跟他们都谈谈。他们都在西边的小屋里。一共四个——Gnocci、Ithoi、Arsen和小Colin。

english: I think so. That navigator, Ithoi, always warned us that this kind of thing could happen.
translation: 我想是的。那个航海家Ithoi总是警告我们这种事可能发生。

english: I've met him. He definitely thinks it's a curse, but wasn't able to say exactly what caused it.
translation: 我见过他。他肯定认为这是诅咒术，但说不清到底是什么引起的。

english: I'm afraid it may be all my fault.
translation: 恐怕这都是我的错。

english: Captain Tock had me exploring some caves, west of the cove. I'm a thief, see, like my brother Francois, and the Captain thought I could sneak past the monsters without being noticed.
translation: 托克船长让我去探索海湾西边的一些洞穴。你看，我是个盗贼，就像我兄弟弗朗索瓦一样，船长觉得我可以不被那些怪物发现地溜过去。

english: Well, I climbed down the vines, and found a big cave filled with terrifying ogres!
translation: 嗯，我顺着藤蔓爬下去，发现了一个巨大的洞穴，里面全是可怕的食人魔！

english: I'd hoped I could use my amazing Thieving skills to avoid them seeing me, but I was out of luck. By the time I'd finished clambering down the ladder, they'd spotted me.
translation: 我本来希望用我高超的偷窃技能避免被他们发现，但我运气不好。等我爬下梯子，他们就已经发现我了。

english: So you were trying to explore that ogre cave, and the ogres saw you?
translation: 所以你当时试图探索那个食人魔洞穴，然后食人魔看见了你？

english: Yes. I quickly grabbed some loot, so I wouldn't have to face the Captain empty-handed, and fled up the ladder before the ogres could kill me!
translation: 是的。我迅速抓了一些战利品，这样就不用空手面对船长，然后在食人魔杀死我之前爬上了梯子逃走了！

english: But a couple of days later we all fell ill. I think what I stole must have been some kind of sacred relic, and the shamans in the cave have cursed us for stealing it.
translation: 但过了几天我们都病倒了。我想我偷的东西一定是某种神圣的遗物，洞穴里的萨满因我们偷了它而诅咒了我们。

english: Maybe you could get the relic back from the Captain, and return it to the ogres? And tell them I'm very sorry. Then perhaps they'll lift the curse.
translation: 也许你可以从船长那里拿回遗物，还给食人魔？并告诉他们我非常抱歉。那样他们或许就会解除诅咒术了。

english: Have you got that relic back from Captain Tock? Maybe if you return it to the ogres, they'll lift the curse.
translation: 你从托克船长那里拿回那个遗物了吗？也许如果你把它还给食人魔，他们就会解除诅咒术。

english: Nope, I've not done that.
translation: 没有，我还没做。

english: Please take it back to the ogres for me, and tell them I'm sorry.
translation: 请替我把东西还给食人魔，告诉他们我很抱歉。

english: Arsen says he gave you a sacred ogre relic.
translation: 阿森说他给了你一个神圣的食人魔遗物。

english: Arrr, that he did. I'd sent him to explore the caves west of the cove, an' he brings me back a bone lump, saying he stole it from the ogre chief.
translation: 啊呵，他确实给了。我派他去探索海湾西边的洞穴，他给我带回了一根骨头疙瘩，说是从食人魔首领那里偷来的。

english: He thinks the ogres have cursed you all because he stole one of their sacred relics, and he wants me to take it back to them now.
translation: 他认为食人魔之所以诅咒你们，是因为他偷了他们的一个神圣遗物，他想让我现在把它还回去。

english: Arrr, I've no use fer the silly thing. If it'll get the curse lifted, ye can take it right to that ogre chief an' give it back.
translation: 啊，我对这傻东西没兴趣。如果它能解除诅咒术，你大可以把它拿去还给那个食人魔首领。

english: A man called Arsen told me he'd visited your cave.
translation: 有个叫Arsen的人告诉我他去过你们的洞穴。

english: Yah, skinny man climb down vine the other day. Little man, big idiot! Hahahaha...
translation: 呀，前几天有个瘦巴巴的人顺着藤蔓爬下来。小个子，大傻瓜！哈哈哈……

english: He says he's very sorry...
translation: 他说他非常抱歉……

english: He very silly!
translation: 他太傻了！

english: Perhaps I should come back another time.
translation: 也许我该改天再来。

english: I've come to return what Arsen stole.
translation: 我来归还Arsen偷走的东西。

english: Arsen says he's very sorry for stealing from you. Here it is...
translation: Arsen说他很抱歉偷了你的东西。给你……

english: Yah, dat little man is big idiot. Climbed down vine, grabbed tooth-pick off Tess and ran away like scared kebbit.
translation: 呀，那个小个子是个大傻瓜。顺着藤蔓爬下来，抢了Tess的牙签，然后像受惊的凯比特兔一样逃跑了。

english: You're saying this is a tooth-pick? Not a sacred relic of the ogres? Did your shamans curse the Corsairs for stealing it?
translation: 你是说这是个牙签？不是食人魔的神圣遗物？你们的萨满有没有因为海盗偷了它而诅咒他们？

english: Dis is tooth-pick. Tess got plenty more. If skinny idiot man want Tess' old tooth-pick, maybe he sick in his head. But Tess not having shamans curse anyone.
translation: 这是牙签。苔丝还有很多。如果那个瘦弱的白痴男人想要苔丝的旧牙签，也许他脑子有病。但苔丝没有让萨满诅咒任何人。

english: Oh. Well, I guess Arsen will be pleased to hear he didn't bring the curse upon the Corsairs.
translation: 哦。好吧，我想阿森听到他没有给海盗带来诅咒术会很高兴的。

english: Have you returned the sacred relic to the ogres? Will they forgive me and lift the curse?
translation: 你把神圣遗物还给食人魔了吗？他们会原谅我并解除诅咒术吗？

english: Their chief, Tess, says that wasn't a sacred relic at all. It was her tooth-pick.
translation: 他们的首领Tess说那根本不是什么神圣遗物。那是她的牙签。

english: Are you telling me the ogres cursed us all because I stole their chief's tooth-pick?
translation: 你是说食人魔诅咒我们全是因为我偷了他们首领的牙签？

english: She didn't care - she's got lots of tooth-picks, and she just thought you were some kind of weirdo when you stole one. They never cursed you at all.
translation: 她根本不在意——她有很多牙签，她只是觉得你偷牙签的行为有点古怪。他们根本没有诅咒你们。

english: Oh. That's a relief, I guess. Um... thank you for your help. But I do wonder where the curse really came from.
translation: 哦。我想这算是个安慰。嗯……谢谢你的帮助。但我确实想知道诅咒术到底是从哪里来的。

english: I'm not done investigating yet.
translation: 我还没调查完呢。

english: Yes, that's what it must be. Ithoi, the navigator, always told us to beware of curses.
translation: 是的，一定是这样。航海家Ithoi总是提醒我们要小心诅咒。

english: This is all my fault. But I didn't mean to upset her. I just thought we could be friends. Now I must have upset her, and she's cursed us all!
translation: 这都是我的错。但我不是故意惹她生气的。我只是觉得我们可以做朋友。现在我肯定让她生气了，她诅咒了我们所有人！

english: Ithoi always told us that bad things happen to sailors who get involved with mermaids, but I didn't believe him. I should have listened! But I'll tell you what happened...
translation: Ithoi总是告诉我们，与美人鱼纠缠的水手会遇到坏事，但我不相信他。我本该听他的！不过我会告诉你发生了什么……

english: I was using Ithoi's telescope...
translation: 我正在用Ithoi的望远镜……

english: Such a beautiful night!
translation: 多么美丽的夜晚！

english: What lands lie beyond the dim horizon, I wonder...
translation: 我想知道，昏暗的地平线之外有什么陆地呢……

english: What was that? I'd better have another look.
translation: 那是什么？我最好再看一眼。

english: It's so dark out there, but I think... ... yes, I'm quite sure...
translation: 外面太黑了，但我想……是的，我很确定……

english: ... yes, it's a mermaid! She's beautiful!
translation: ……是的，是个美人鱼！她真美！

english: You're the most lovely person I've ever seen!
translation: 你是我见过的最可爱的人！

english: I can see you moving your arms, but it's very dark. Are you waving to me?
translation: 我能看到你在挥手，但天很黑。你是在向我招手吗？

english: *kiss*
Oh, no, I think she's gone away. Did I put her off?
translation: 哦，不，我觉得她走了。是我惹她不高兴了吗？

english: Maybe she doesn't like strangers shouting about her appearance and blowing kisses at her. That might have been rude of me.
translation: 也许她不喜欢陌生人对着她的外貌大喊大叫，还朝她飞吻。我可能太粗鲁了。

english: I hope she's not angry. Ithoi says mermaids can be dangerous.
translation: 希望她没有生气。伊索伊说美人鱼很危险。

english: Perhaps you can find the mermaid and tell her I'm very sorry I was rude to her. Then maybe she'll lift the curse.
translation: 也许你可以找到美人鱼，告诉她我对她很粗鲁非常抱歉。那样她或许就会解除诅咒术了。

english: Have you found the mermaid yet? Will she forgive me?
translation: 你找到那条美人鱼了吗？她会原谅我吗？

english: Where did you find this mermaid?
translation: 你在哪里找到这条美人鱼的？

english: I was using Ithoi's telescope to look out at the sea, imagining the strange lands and fantastic creatures Ithoi's always telling us he's seen, and I saw her.
translation: 我当时在用伊索伊的望远镜眺望大海，想象着伊索伊总跟我们讲的那些奇异土地和神奇生物，然后我就看见了她。

english: Nope, I've not seen any mermaids round here.
translation: 没有，我在这儿没见过什么美人鱼。

english: Oh dear, oh dear. Maybe we'll be cursed forever!
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪。也许我们会被永远诅咒！

english: Let's see if I can find that mermaid he saw...
translation: 让我看看能不能找到他看见的那条美人鱼……

english: That doesn't look anything like a mermaid. That's an ogre!
translation: 那根本不像美人鱼。那是个食人魔！

english: That doesn't look anything like a mermaid. That's Bugs, the son of that chompy hunter, Rantz!
translation: 那根本不像美人鱼。那是巴格斯，那个狩猎恐鸟的猎人兰茨的儿子！

english: I've seen enough of that ogre already. Colin might be relieved to hear it wasn't a mermaid.
translation: 我已经看够那个食人魔了。科林要是知道那不是美人鱼，应该会松口气吧。

english: I've looked through that telescope myself. That wasn't a mermaid. That was a wet ogre.
translation: 我亲自用过那个望远镜看过了。那不是美人鱼，是个湿漉漉的食人魔。

english: He's definitely not a mermaid.
translation: 他绝对不是美人鱼。

english: I've met that ogre before. He lives with his dad in the Feldip Hills. He's definitely not a mermaid.
translation: 我之前见过那个食人魔。他和他爸住在费迪普丘陵。他绝对不是美人鱼。

english: Oh. Oh, I see. Okay... I guess that means I didn't upset a mermaid after all. So the curse isn't my fault! Thank you!
translation: 哦。哦，我明白了。好吧……我想那意味着我并没有惹恼美人鱼。所以诅咒术不是我的错！谢谢你！

english: I still feel awful. But I'm glad you've proven it wasn't my fault that we got cursed. I hope you can work out what brought it on us.
translation: 我还是觉得很糟糕。但很高兴你证明了我们被诅咒不是我的错。希望你能查明是什么给我们带来了诅咒。

english: I'll be on the case.
translation: 我会着手调查的。

english: It's all my fault, I know it is. I've awoken Her, and now She's done this to us!
translation: 都是我的错，我知道。我唤醒了祂，现在祂对我们做了这种事！

english: Who are you talking about?
translation: 你在说谁？

english: I'll explain... See, I'm the cook, and I have to find the food as well as cooking it...
translation: 我来解释……你看，我是厨师，我不仅要烹饪食物，还得去找食材……

english: I was fishing...
translation: 我当时在钓鱼……

english: Let's see what I can find for the boys tonight.
translation: 让我看看今晚能给兄弟们弄点什么。

english: C'mon little lobsters, come to Gnocci!
translation: 来吧小龙虾，到格诺基这儿来！

english: Obby-lobby obby-lobby oi oi oi!
translation: 哦比-洛比，哦比-洛比，哦伊哦伊哦伊！

english: 'obby-lobby' - what?
translation: “哦比-洛比”——什么鬼？

english: It's a traditional lobster-fishing chant handed down by my ancestors. Don't interrupt.
translation: 这是我祖先传下来的传统龙虾捕捞歌谣。别打断。

english: C'mon little lobsters. We don't want to keep the Captain waiting! He'll get angry with me again.
translation: 来吧小龙虾。我们可不想让船长等着！他又要对我发火了。

english: Ooh, what's this? This isn't a lobster.
translation: 哦，这是什么？这不是龙虾。

english: Looks more like a child's toy. But - no, it can't be...
translation: 看起来更像孩子的玩具。但是——不，不可能……

english: Is it moving?
translation: 它在动吗？

english: She's moving! SHE'S POSSESSED! HELP!
translation: 她在动！她被附身了！救命！

english: I buried Her in the sand, by that tree, to the west. But I still feel Her eyes staring into my soul. Please find Her, and kill the demon inside!
translation: 我把它埋在西边那棵树的沙子里了。但我仍然感觉它的眼睛在盯着我的灵魂。请找到它，杀死里面的恶魔！

english: Have you tried to destroy Her yet? Her eyes, those terrible eyes!
translation: 你试着消灭它了吗？它的眼睛，那双可怕的眼睛！

english: Where did you say this happened?
translation: 你说这事发生在哪里？

english: On the beach, to the west of the cove. Near a big tree. I buried Her in the sand, but I can still feel her eyes staring into my soul. Please find Her, and kill the demon inside!
translation: 在海湾西边的海滩上，靠近一棵大树。我把它埋在沙子里，但我仍然感觉它的眼睛在盯着我的灵魂。请找到它，杀死里面的恶魔！

english: No, I've not.
translation: 不，我还没有。

english: Oh dear, I feel terrible. Please help us soon.
translation: 哦天哪，我感觉糟透了。请尽快帮帮我们。

english: Okay, he said he buried the possessed doll in the sand...
translation: 好吧，他说他把被附身的玩偶埋在了沙子里……

english: That's not possessed. That sounds more like clockwork.
translation: 那不是被附身。听起来更像是发条装置。

english: That's not possessed. That sounds more like clockwork. In fact I've got the Crafting level to make those.
translation: 那不是被附身。听起来更像是发条装置。实际上我的制作等级足以制作那些东西。

english: Actually, it sounds scary.
translation: 实际上，听起来挺吓人的。

english: Well, sort of. That doll wasn't possessed at all. It was a clockwork toy. They're supposed to move.
translation: 嗯，算是吧。那个玩偶根本没有被附身。它是一个发条装置玩具。它们本来就会动。

english: Clockwork? Oh, that would explain how it moved. Ahem. Well, I suppose the curse didn't come from Her.
translation: 发条装置？哦，那就解释得通它为什么会动了。咳咳。好吧，我想诅咒术不是来自她。

english: I hope you can find the real cause soon.
translation: 希望你能尽快找到真正的原因。

english: Still trying.
translation: 还在努力。

english: Ye be back? Tell me, do those scurvy Corsairs take the curse seriously?
translation: 你回来了？告诉我，那些卑鄙的海盗认真对待诅咒术了吗？

english: I've been hearing about what might have caused it...
translation: 我一直在听他们说起可能的原因……

english: Colin thought he upset a mermaid, and she might have cursed you all in revenge.
translation: 科林觉得他惹恼了一条美人鱼，她可能为了报复而诅咒了你们所有人。

english: Arrr! That'll teach him to meddle with such folk. Colin should stick to what he's good at.
translation: 啊哈！看他以后还敢招惹这种人。科林应该专心做他擅长的事。

english: Gnocci fished a doll out of the water, and he thought it might have been possessed by an evil spirit.
translation: 格诺基从水里钓上来一个玩偶，他觉得那可能被恶灵附身了。

english: Arrr chuckie chuckie chuckie! That'll teach him to play with dolls at his age. Dolls can be frightening.
translation: 啊哈，啧啧啧！看他这把年纪还玩玩偶。玩偶可是很吓人的。

english: Arsen stole what he thought was a sacred relic from the ogre cave, and he said their shamans might have cursed you in revenge.
translation: 阿森从食人魔洞穴里偷了一个他以为是神圣遗物的东西，他说他们的萨满可能为了报复而诅咒了你们。

english: Arrr! Ogre women be powerful, an' Arsen be a fool.
translation: 啊哈！食人魔的女人很强大，阿森是个傻瓜。

english: I'll carry on trying to solve the curse.
translation: 我会继续努力解决诅咒术的问题。

english: Arrr! Off ye goes...
translation: 啊哈！你去吧……

english: They all have different theories about the curse.
translation: 他们对诅咒术都有不同的看法。

english: Arrr, that be likely enough. Ithoi tells me there be many things in this world that can bring a curse upon an unwary seafarer.
translation: 啊，很有可能。伊索伊告诉我这世上有许多东西能给粗心的航海者带来诅咒术。

english: Ye can maybe solve the problem fer each victim, an' see if it lifts the curse.
translation: 你也许可以解决每个受害者的问题，看看是否能解除诅咒术。

english: I've ruled out all the Corsairs' theories...
translation: 我已经排除了所有海盗们的猜测……

english: Cabin-boy Colin thought he'd upset a mermaid, but there wasn't a mermaid, just a wet ogre.
translation: 见习水手科林以为他惹恼了美人鱼，但根本没有什么美人鱼，只有一个湿漉漉的食人魔。

english: Arsen the Thief thought he'd upset the ogre shamans by stealing a sacred ogre relic, but it was just a tooth-pick, and the ogres didn't care.
translation: 盗贼阿森以为他偷了一个神圣的食人魔遗物会惹怒食人魔萨满，但那只是个牙签，食人魔根本不在乎。

english: Ithoi the Navigator said there were lots of things that could bring a curse on a crew, and this could be any of them.
translation: 航海家伊索伊说有很多东西能给船员带来诅咒术，这可能是其中任何一种。

english: And Gnocci the Cook thought he'd awoken a demon in a possessed doll, but it wasn't possessed at all. It was clockwork.
translation: 厨师格诺基以为他在一个被附身的玩偶里唤醒了恶魔，但那玩偶根本没被附身。那是发条装置。

english: Arrr, any sufficiently advanced technology be indistinguishable from demonic possession, that it be.
translation: 啊哈，任何足够先进的技术都与恶魔附身无异，事实就是如此。

english: So what do I do now?
translation: 那么我现在该怎么办？

english: Arrr, I don't rightly know. It began when I'd gone away for a parlay with Ithoi; we came back ter find the crew all a-pukin' up their dinner. Then Ithoi felt ill too, though he'd not eaten with 'em, so it can't be the food.
translation: 啊哈，我也不太清楚。事情开始于我和伊索伊出去谈判的时候；我们回来发现船员们都在吐晚饭。然后伊索伊也觉得不舒服，尽管他没有和他们一起吃饭，所以不可能是食物的问题。

english: I see. You're saying it began after they'd all eaten, but Ithoi felt ill even though he'd not had any of the food.
translation: 我明白了。你是说事情发生在他们都吃完之后，但伊索伊尽管没吃任何食物也感到不适。

english: Arrr, that be right.
translation: 啊哈，没错。

english: That meal must have been interesting...
translation: 那顿饭一定很有趣……

english: Can I give up and go home?
translation: 我能放弃然后回家吗？

english: If ye wants a ride back to Rimmington, I'll take ye there any time, but I do hope ye can help my poor crew.
translation: 如果你想搭船回里明顿村，我随时可以带你去，但我真的希望你能帮我可怜的船员们。

english: You said it began after they'd all eaten.
translation: 你说事情发生在他们都吃完之后。

english: Arrr. I'd gone away for a parlay with Ithoi; we came back ter find the crew all a-pukin' up their dinner. Then Ithoi felt ill too, though he'd not eaten with 'em, so it can't be the food.
translation: 啊哈。我和伊索伊出去谈判了；我们回来发现船员们都在吐晚饭。然后伊索伊也觉得不舒服，尽管他没有和他们一起吃饭，所以不可能是食物的问题。

english: Ye be back? Have ye been investigatin' the curse?
translation: 你回来了？你在调查诅咒术吗？

english: I hear it happened straight after dinner.
translation: 我听说事情就发生在晚饭后。

english: Arrr! That be wrong! I were away for a parlay with Captain Tock, an' I didn't eat that dinner at all. The Captain can tell ye so himself.
translation: 啊哈！那不对！我和托克船长出去谈判了，我根本没吃那顿晚饭。船长可以亲自告诉你。

english: So it must be a curse. A CURSE!
translation: 所以这一定是诅咒术。诅咒术！

english: I'm still looking into it.
translation: 我还在调查中。

english: Have you solved the curse yet?
translation: 你解决诅咒术了吗？

english: Hey, don't go blaming the cook just because the curse began after dinner. I didn't even cook that meal. I'd been too scared of the possessed doll...
translation: 嘿，别因为诅咒术在晚餐后开始就怪厨师。那顿饭甚至不是我做的。我被那个被附身的玩偶吓坏了……

english: You mean the clockwork doll?
translation: 你是说那个发条装置玩偶？

english: It's an easy mistake to make!
translation: 这很容易搞错！

english: Anyway I didn't dare try to fish after that, and Ithoi volunteered to do all the fishing and cooking instead, before he went off for his parlay with Captain Tock.
translation: 总之那之后我不敢再钓鱼了，伊索伊自告奋勇替我做所有的钓鱼和烹饪，然后他就去和托克船长谈判了。

english: Anyway, Ithoi got sick without even eating it, so it can't be the food.
translation: 总之，伊索伊没吃也生病了，所以不可能是食物的问题。

english: I hear the Captain's thinking of firing Ithoi.
translation: 我听说船长在考虑解雇伊索伊。

english: I don't see why that's got anything to do with the curse.
translation: 我不明白那和诅咒术有什么关系。

english: Perhaps not.
translation: 也许没有。

english: So you say Ithoi prepared that meal?
translation: 所以你说那顿饭是伊索伊准备的？

english: Yes, he volunteered to do all the fishing and cooking for me, even though he knew he'd miss dinner for his parlay with Captain Tock. Ithoi's a good soul.
translation: 是的，他主动替我做了所有的钓鱼和烹饪，尽管他知道自己会因为和托克船长的谈判而错过晚饭。伊索伊是个好人。

english: Have you found out how we all got cursed?
translation: 你查出我们是怎么中诅咒的吗？

english: That's right. Gnocci had cooked us some swordfish. It didn't taste as good as his usual cooking, but I didn't complain. The Captain doesn't like complainers.
translation: 没错。格诺基给我们煮了一些剑鱼。味道不如他平时的厨艺好，但我没有抱怨。船长不喜欢抱怨的人。

english: Then we all started feeling sick and clammy. That was when the Captain and Ithoi came back from their parlay, and Ithoi looked sick too.
translation: 然后我们都开始感到恶心、浑身湿冷。就在这时船长和伊索伊谈判回来了，伊索伊看起来也不舒服。

english: Well, I suppose we don't need a navigator these days, and he's not very good at anything else. But I don't see why that's got anything to do with the curse.
translation: 嗯，我想我们现在不需要航海家，他其他事情也做不好。但我不明白那和诅咒术有什么关系。

english: Do you know how we all got cursed?
translation: 你知道我们是怎么中诅咒的吗？

english: I hear Ithoi cooked the meal you ate that night.
translation: 我听说那天晚上你们吃的饭是伊索伊做的。

english: I suppose Ithoi's trying to be extra helpful at the moment. Don't tell anyone, but Ithoi might not be in our crew much longer.
translation: 我想伊索伊现在是想特别表现一下。别告诉别人，但伊索伊可能在我们船上待不久了。

english: My brother, Francois, says the Captain will make him second-in-command if he completes his mission. That's Ithoi's rank, but we don't need a navigator now we've settled here, and he can't do much else.
translation: 我哥哥弗朗索瓦说，如果他完成任务，船长就会让他当二副。那是伊索伊的职位，但我们已经在这里定居了，不需要航海家，而且他也干不了别的什么。

english: What is the mission Francois is doing?
translation: 弗朗索瓦在执行什么任务？

english: That's a secret.
translation: 那是秘密。

english: I hear you're thinking of firing Ithoi.
translation: 我听说你打算解雇伊索伊。

english: Arrr, maybe I am, but I'm sure that be nothing to do wi' the curse. Ithoi's afflicted by it too.
translation: 啊，也许我是，但我确定那和诅咒无关。伊索伊也受其折磨。

english: I hear you cooked the meal they ate before getting sick.
translation: 我听说他们生病前吃的那顿饭是你做的。

english: Arrr? And what if I did? Can't an old sailor help his crew without interfering young land-lubbers making accusations?
translation: 啊？就算是我做的又怎样？难道一个老水手帮帮自己的船员，还得受你们这些爱管闲事的旱鸭子指责？

english: Maybe because the Captain's thinking of firing you - Arsen heard it from his brother. The Corsairs don't need a navigator anymore.
translation: 也许是因为船长打算解雇你——阿森从他兄弟那儿听说的。海盗团不再需要领航员了。

english: Arrr! Too clever ye be... I heard the Captain might kick me off the crew, so I poisoned the dinner, an' acted sick too. Now they think they're cursed, so they'll want me around, wi' my knowledge o' such things!
translation: 啊！你太聪明了……我听说船长可能要赶我下船，所以我给晚餐下了毒，自己也装病。现在他们都以为中了诅咒术，就会需要我留在身边，因为我懂这方面的事！

english: But they all think I'm sick, so they'll never believe I'm behind it. Hahaha!
translation: 但他们都觉得我病了，所以永远不会相信是我干的。哈哈哈！

english: We'll see what they have to say about that!
translation: 我们倒要看看他们对此怎么说！

english: Maybe you're just a nasty person.
translation: 也许你只是个坏心眼的人。

english: Bah! Ye can't even think of a reason why I'd want to poison the crew, so don't bother me with yer accusations.
translation: 呸！你连我为什么要给船员下毒都想不出理由，别拿你的指控来烦我。

english: I don't know your reason.
translation: 我不知道你的理由。

english: Ithoi admits poisoning you all and faking the curse.
translation: 伊索伊承认给你们所有人下了毒，并假装了诅咒术。

english: If Ithoi's been afflicted by the curse as badly as I have, he might be half out of his mind with pain. I'm sure he doesn't know what he's saying.
translation: 如果伊索伊和我一样被诅咒折磨得厉害，他可能已经痛得半疯了。我肯定他不知道自己在说什么。

english: That can't be right - he looks as sick as the rest of us. Maybe he's delerious and doesn't know what he's saying.
translation: 这不可能——他看起来和我们其他人一样病重。也许他神志不清，不知道自己在说什么。

english: He's had a lot to worry about, with losing his place on the crew, and now he's sick from the curse too. He must have gone mad and started babbling.
translation: 他有很多烦心事，失去了在船员中的位置，现在又因诅咒术而生病。他一定是疯了，开始胡言乱语。

english: Ithoi admits he poisoned the crew! He's faked this whole curse!
translation: 伊索伊承认他给船员下了毒！整个诅咒术都是他假装的！

english: That can't be! Ithoi's sick, an' he may be babbling madness from his fevered brain. Ye'll have to prove he's not really sick.
translation: 不可能！伊索伊病了，他可能因为发烧而胡言乱语。你得证明他不是真的病了。

english: What d'ye want now?
translation: 你现在想干嘛？

english: I know you've faked the curse.
translation: 我知道你假装了诅咒术。

english: The Corsairs all think I'm sick too, even though I never ate the food. An' ye'll never make me prove that I'm healthy - I ain't gettin' up! So they'll keep believing in the curse.
translation: 海盗团的人都以为我也病了，尽管我根本没吃那食物。你也永远没法让我证明自己健康——我起不来！所以他们会继续相信诅咒术。

english: I bet I can prove you're well enough to get up.
translation: 我打赌我能证明你好得可以站起来。

english: Ye'll never make me get up! I ain't afraid of cold, nor of wet, nor of anythin' ye can do in here.
translation: 你永远别想让我起来！我不怕冷，不怕湿，也不怕你在这里搞什么名堂。

english: Um... nothing, really.
translation: 呃……没什么，真的。

english: Maybe I should try to get more information out of him before trying to make his hut catch fire.
translation: 也许我应该先从他那里套出更多信息，再想办法让他的小屋着火。

english: Arrr... uh-oh!
translation: 啊……呃哦！

english: Well, I guess that proves he's well enough to get up! And apparently he knows some magic too.
translation: 好吧，我想这证明了他好得能站起来！而且显然他还会点魔法。

english: I saw you running around! You're not sick!
translation: 我看到你跑来跑去！你没病！

english: So long as that old fool, Tock, believes it's a curse, I've nothing to fear from ye flapping yer mouth.
translation: 只要那个老傻瓜托克相信是诅咒术，我就不怕你多嘴。

english: We'll see what the Captain has to say about that.
translation: 我们看看船长对此怎么说。

english: Can you tell me what's going on now?
translation: 你能告诉我现在是什么情况吗？

english: Ithoi's faked the curse. I've seen him running around, healthy.
translation: 伊索伊假装了诅咒术。我看到他跑来跑去，很健康。

english: Make sure he gets what's coming to him. No-one poisons my crew!
translation: 确保他得到应有的惩罚。没人能给我的船员下毒！

english: So what's going on now?
translation: 那现在是什么情况？

english: It sounds like there isn't a curse after all! Maybe I'll recover soon from whatever he did to me.
translation: 听起来根本就没有诅咒术！也许我很快就能从他对我做的手脚中恢复过来。

english: What's happening now?
translation: 现在发生什么了？

english: Give him what he deserves!
translation: 给他应得的惩罚！

english: So what's happening now?
translation: 那现在发生什么了？

english: I've seen Ithoi running around. He's not sick at all.
translation: 我看到伊索伊跑来跑去。他根本没病。

english: Arrr! So he was never sick at all! An' here's me been feeling sorry for him. A trickster he be indeed! Kill him fer me.
translation: 啊！所以他根本没病！我还一直可怜他。他真是个骗子！替我杀了他。

english: Why don't you kill him yourself?
translation: 你为什么不自己杀了他？

english: A captain shouldn't leave his ship in a time of crisis. Rule of the sea, that is. Even if the crisis ain't exactly on the ship.
translation: 船长在危机时刻不应该离开他的船。这是海上的规矩。即使危机并不完全在船上。

english: I don't believe in capital punishment.
translation: 我不相信死刑。

english: Awww!
translation: 哎哟！

english: Ithoi faked the curse, and I've killed him.
translation: 伊索伊假装了诅咒术，我已经杀了他。

english: You think you know a guy, and then he does a thing like this! Oh well, I hope I recover soon from whatever he did to me.
translation: 你以为你了解一个人，结果他却做出这种事！唉，好吧，希望我能尽快从他对我做的事中恢复过来。

english: Not much.
translation: 没什么。

english: Who'd have thought Ithoi would do such a thing? I guess if there isn't really a curse, I'll get better soon. In fact I feel better already.
translation: 谁会想到伊索伊会做这种事？我想如果没有真的诅咒术，我很快就能好转。事实上我已经感觉好些了。

english: I really didn't think he was like that. Still, if there isn't really a curse, I suppose we'll just get better from whatever he did to us. I don't feel so bad now.
translation: 我真的没想到他是这种人。不过，如果没有真的诅咒术，我想我们就能从他对我们做的事中恢复过来。我现在感觉没那么糟了。

english: I've killed Ithoi for poisoning your crew.
translation: 我杀了伊索伊，因为他给你的船员下毒。

english: Thank ye fer dealing with that serpent. I suppose the rest of my crew will feel better now ye've proven there be no curse on them.
translation: 谢谢你处理了那条毒蛇。我想我的其他船员现在会好受些了，因为你证明了他们身上没有诅咒术。

english: Most of them deleterious effects probably be psychosomatic anyway, arrr!
translation: 反正那些有害影响多半是心理作用，啊！

english: Anyways, ye've been a mighty help, young [lad/lass]. Ye be brave in the heart, strong in the arm and full in the bowels, an' I be grateful to ye.
translation: 总之，你帮了大忙，年轻的[lad/lass]。你内心勇敢，臂力强劲，胆量十足，我很感激你。

english: Tell ye what, I'll have a word with Yusuf, in the bank. Ye've earned the right to use his services. An' thanks again, very much.
translation: 这样吧，我会和银行里的优素福说一声。你已经赢得了使用他服务的权利。再次非常感谢。

english: Ah, hello there, [player name]. Good to see you. I take it you recivedmy message?
translation: 啊，你好，[player name]。很高兴见到你。我想你应该收到我的消息了吧？

english: I did indeed. So what brings us all the way out here?
translation: 确实收到了。那我们大老远跑到这儿来是为了什么？

english: Well, it turns out the desert was the best place to begin my research into Arrav and his heart. Not too surprising of course, given the burial practices here.
translation: 嗯，事实证明沙漠是研究阿拉夫及其心脏的最佳起点。考虑到这里的埋葬习俗，这当然不足为奇。

english: And on that note, how do you feel about a bit of tomb raiding?
translation: 说到这个，你对盗墓有什么看法？

english: Sounds like a job for me! What do you need?
translation: 正合我意！你需要什么？

english: Well, without getting bogged down in all the details, my research led me to some information on a rare and unusual form of necromancy that was once practiced in these lands.
translation: 嗯，长话短说，我的研究让我找到了一些关于一种罕见而独特的死灵法术的信息，这种法术曾在这片土地上使用过。

english: The key element of the process involved the removal and preservation of the heart, much in the same way that the priests of Icthlarin do so during their burial ceremonies.
translation: 这个过程的关键要素涉及心脏的取出和保存，与伊克哈林的祭司在葬礼仪式中所做的方式颇为相似。

english: The key difference: The process is performed while the victim is still alive!
translation: 关键区别在于：这个过程是在受害者还活着的时候进行的！

english: Indeed. I have encountered many forms of dark magic in my time, but I must confess, few have filled me with the same anger that I felt upon discovering this vile form of necromancy.
translation: 确实如此。我一生中遇到过许多形式的黑暗魔法，但我必须承认，很少有哪种能像发现这种邪恶的死灵法术那样让我充满愤怒。

english: And you think this is what happened to Arrav?
translation: 你觉得阿拉夫遭遇的就是这个？

english: Almost certainly. The end result of the process is an undead slave, bound to whoever possess their still-beating heart.
translation: 几乎可以肯定。过程的最终结果是一个亡灵奴隶，受控于拥有其仍在跳动心脏的人。

english: The victim must do whatever they are commanded, but unlike most other forms of necromancy, their mind, and indeed their very soul, remains intact. It all perfectly matches what you encountered with Arrav.
translation: 受害者必须服从任何命令，但与大多数其他形式的死灵法术不同，他们的思想，甚至他们的灵魂，都保持完整。这完全符合你遇到阿拉夫时的情况。

english: Now thankfully, as horrible as all this is, I believe this is a way for us to break Zemouregal's control over Arrav. To do so, we must recover Arrav's heart.
translation: 所幸的是，尽管这一切非常可怕，但我相信有一种方法可以打破泽莫雷加尔对阿拉夫的控制。为此，我们必须找回阿拉夫的心脏。

english: But what does that have to do with the mastaba?
translation: 但这和那个石室坟墓有什么关系？

english: If we are to recover the heart, we will need a way to not only keep it preserved, but to keep it beating as well.
translation: 如果要找回心脏，我们不仅需要保存它的方法，还需要让它保持跳动。

english: Zemouregal must have a way of doing this, but I have a feeling he won't be willing to share the details on how.
translation: 泽莫雷加尔一定有办法做到，但我感觉他不会愿意分享具体细节。

english: My hope is the mastaba contains the answers we need. It was built to house a Pharaoh who ruled the desert thousands of years ago.
translation: 我希望这个石室坟墓里藏有我们需要的答案。它是为数千年前统治沙漠的一位法老建造的。

english: She was known for many feats, with one of them being her work in saving the victims of a Mahjarrat necromancer.
translation: 她以许多功绩闻名，其中之一就是拯救玛哈加特死灵法师受害者的工作。

english: Ah, I see. Well, if there's any information on heart preservation in there, I'm sure I can find it.
translation: 啊，我明白了。好吧，如果里面有任何关于心脏保存的信息，我一定能找到。

english: I have no doubt you can. While you work on that, I will get started on our next issue: Finding where Zemouregal is keeping Arrav's heart. Hopefully I'll have something by the time you're done.
translation: 我毫不怀疑你能做到。在你处理这件事的时候，我会开始处理下一个问题：找出泽莫雷加尔把阿拉夫的心脏藏在哪儿。希望等你完成时我能有些进展。

english: Oh, and a word of warning. When I was asking around about the mastaba, I was told about a group of... well they apparently called themselves explorers. They entered the mastaba, but never came back out.
translation: 哦，还有一句警告。当我打听那个石室坟墓时，有人告诉我有一群……嗯，他们自称探险者。他们进了石室坟墓，但再也没出来过。

english: I'd say it's safe to assume that there are some sort of defensive measures in place to deter any would-be grave robbers.
translation: 我认为可以安全地假设，那里有某种防御措施来阻止任何潜在的盗墓者。

english: Thanks for the heads up. I'll be careful.
translation: 谢谢提醒。我会小心的。

english: Good luck in there. I will meet you here once you are done.
translation: 祝你在里面好运。你完成后我们在这里碰面。

english: I'll have to pass right now. I have some other things I need to do.
translation: 我现在得先等等，我还有些别的事要做。

english: Well, when you're ready, you know where to find me.
translation: 好吧，等你准备好了，你知道去哪儿找我。

english: Ah, hello again, [player name]. How goes the tomb raiding?
translation: 啊，又见面了，[player name]。盗墓行动进行得怎么样了？

english: What do I need to be doing again?
translation: 我需要再做什么来着？

english: You need to head into that mastaba up on the plateau and see if you can find some information on how we can keep Arrav's heart preserved. Once you have something, meet me back here.
translation: 你需要进入高原上的那个石室坟墓，看看能否找到一些关于如何保存阿拉夫心脏的信息。一旦有所发现，就回到这里见我。

english: Right. I'll get to it.
translation: 好的，我这就去办。

english: Well, keep at it. Once you have some information on how we can keep Arrav's heart preserved, meet me back here.
translation: 那就继续吧。一旦你找到如何保存阿拉夫心脏的信息，就回到这里见我。

english: I think I've discovered what we need. We should be able to preserve Arrav's heart using a specially prepared canopic jar.
translation: 我想我已经发现了我们需要的东西。我们应该能够用一个特制的卡诺皮克罐来延续阿拉夫的心脏。

english: Excellent stuff! So how do we prepare this jar?
translation: 太棒了！那我们怎么准备这个罐子呢？

english: We need to fill it with three dwellberries and a ring of life. I'll get started right away.
translation: 我们需要往里面放三颗德维尔莓和一个生命戒指。我马上开始。

english: Sounds good. Let me know once it's ready and we can discuss our next steps.
translation: 听起来不错。准备好了告诉我，我们可以讨论下一步。

english: We need to fill it with three dwellberries and a ring of life. I'm working on it right now.
translation: 我们需要往里面放三颗德维尔莓和一个生命戒指。我正在弄。

english: Well, let me know once it's ready and we can discuss our next steps.
translation: 好吧，准备好了告诉我，我们可以讨论下一步。

english: This canopic jar should be able to preserve Arrav's heart!
translation: 这个卡诺皮克罐应该能够延续阿拉夫的心脏！

english: Excellent stuff! I had no doubt you'd discover what we needed. You'll be pleased to hear that I've managed to make some good progress as well.
translation: 太棒了！我毫不怀疑你一定能发现我们需要的东西。你也会很高兴听到我也取得了一些不错的进展。

english: Have you found where Arrav's heart is?
translation: 你找到阿拉夫的心脏在哪儿了吗？

english: Not quite, but I have the next best thing. One of my contacts has been supporting my research by investigating Mahjarrat activity in the far north.
translation: 还没有，但我有次优选择。我的一个联系人一直在通过调查遥远的北方的玛哈加特活动来支持我的研究。

english: He recently spotted Zemouregal entering an old fort near the mountain of Trollweiss.
translation: 他最近发现泽莫雷加尔进入了巨魔花山附近的一个旧堡垒。

english: Ah, I know Trollweiss. I've been tobogganing there.
translation: 啊，我知道巨魔花。我在那儿滑过雪橇。

english: Really? It hadn't struck me as a tourist area, what with it being a bit troll-ridden. Anyhow, you shouldn't need to be doing any tobogganing this time. Instead, you'll be heading underground.
translation: 真的吗？我没觉得那是个旅游区，毕竟那里巨魔横行。不管怎样，这次你不需要玩雪橇了。相反，你要去地下。

english: Underground?
translation: 地下？

english: Yes. My contact located some tunnels that looked like they might lead right into the fort. Seems like a far better option than the front door.
translation: 是的。我的联系人找到了一些隧道，看起来可能直接通往堡垒内部。这似乎比走正门要好得多。

english: Well, then I'd best get going. Where can I find these tunnels?
translation: 好吧，那我最好出发了。这些隧道在哪儿能找到？

english: The entrance is right on the top of Trollweiss. I'd suggest you take a pickaxe with you. My contact mentioned that there had been a few cave-ins.
translation: 入口就在巨魔花的顶部。我建议你带一把镐子。我的联系人提到那里发生过几次塌方。

english: You seem to have a lot of contacts.
translation: 你好像有很多联系人。

english: Indeed. I've managed to make a few friends in my time.
translation: 确实。我这辈子交了不少朋友。

english: So are they all looking into Zemouregal for you?
translation: 那他们都在为你调查泽莫雷加尔吗？

english: Oh, not at all. Given recent events, Zemouregal is of particular interest of course, but Mahjarrat activity in general has been increasing recently, especially up north.
translation: 哦，不是。鉴于最近的事件，泽莫雷加尔当然备受关注，但总的来说，玛哈加特的活动最近有所增加，尤其是在北方。

english: So how did you first end up researching the Mahjarrat?
translation: 那你最初是怎么开始研究玛哈加特的？

english: You know, it's been so long that I can barely remember. As I recall, I first found mention of their kind right here in the desert.
translation: 你知道，时间太久了，我几乎记不清了。我记得我第一次提到它们就是在沙漠这里。

english: I was assisting some archologistsin the south when I found an old tablet describing of a race of seemingly immortal shapeshifters wielding the power of gods. Naturally, I was immediately fascinated!
translation: 当时我正在南方协助一些考古学家，发现了一块古老的石板，描述了一个看似不朽、拥有神力的变形者种族。自然，我立刻就被迷住了！

english: Of course, I soon went on to find out that they are not only fascinating, but also very dangerous. I must admit that I see it as something of a duty to keep my research up to date.
translation: 当然，我很快就发现它们不仅迷人，而且非常危险。我必须承认，我认为保持我的研究更新是一种责任。

english: The events at Varrock showed that too many have forgotten the dangers of the Mahjarrat.
translation: 维洛克城的事件表明，太多人已经忘记了玛哈加特的危险。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Have you managed to explore those tunnels yet?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你探索过那些隧道了吗？

english: You'll find the entrance atop Trollweiss Mountain. I'd suggest you take a pickaxe with you. My contact mentioned that there had been a few cave-ins.
translation: 你会在巨魔山脉的顶部找到入口。我建议你带一把镐子。我的联系人提到那里发生过几次塌方。

english: You... You should not be here. Zemouregal could return at... urgh... at any time. If he does, I won't.... I won't be able to stop myself from... arrgh...
translation: 你……你不该在这里。泽莫雷加尔随时可能……呃……回来。如果他回来了，我……我无法阻止自己……啊……

english: That's a risk I'm willing to take. I'm here to help you.
translation: 这是我愿意冒的风险。我是来帮你的。

english: Why? You do not... do not know me. You do not know what I've... urgh... what I've done. Leave this place, and leave me. I am... forsaken.
translation: 为什么？你并不……并不认识我。你不知道我……呃……做了什么。离开这里，离开我。我……被遗弃了。

english: Not if I have anything to say about it. Arrav, I need to find your heart. With it, I can free you!
translation: 只要我说了算，就不会。阿拉夫，我需要找到你的心脏。有了它，我就能解放你！
