english: It's not... here. Zemouregal did not want it too close to his... arrgh... his kin.
translation: 它不在……这里。泽莫雷加尔不想让它离他的……啊……他的族人太近。

english: Do you know where it is?
translation: 你知道它在哪儿吗？

english: In the next room... look behind the... urgh... the flame tapestry. You might be able to find something that can... arrgh... help.
translation: 在隔壁房间……看看……呃……火焰挂毯后面。你也许能找到一些能……啊……帮上忙的东西。

english: My master calls me... Thank you... whoever you are. I... urgh... I don't even know your name.
translation: 我的主人在召唤我……谢谢你……不管你是谁。我……呃……我甚至不知道你的名字。

english: It's [player name], and I will save you Arrav, I promise.
translation: 我叫[player name]，我会救你的，阿拉夫，我保证。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Did you manage to find a way into that fort?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你找到进入那座堡垒的路了吗？

english: I did! The heart wasn't there, but I think I know where it is. I reckon it's in the base near Varrock.
translation: 找到了！心脏不在那里，但我想我知道它在哪儿了。我估计它在维洛克城附近的地基里。

english: Well, take a look at these plans I found and see what you think.
translation: 嗯，看看我找到的这些图纸，你觉得怎么样？

english: Right then, let's see...
translation: 好的，我们看看……

english: Yes, there's a chamber here marked as containing a heart! It must be Arrav's!
translation: 对，这里有一个密室标注着存放有一颗心脏！一定是阿拉夫的！

english: However, reaching it is going to pose some significant problems...
translation: 然而，要到达那里会遇到一些严重的问题……

english: It seems that the inner section of Zemouregal's Base has state of the art security. The corridor into the area is filled to the brim with human detection spells. These will set off an alarm.
translation: 看来泽莫雷加尔基地的内部区域拥有最先进的安全系统。通往该区域的走廊里布满了人类探测法术。这些法术会触发警报。

english: Now, there is a sewage system running under some parts of the base that can be accessed from the nearby kitchen.
translation: 现在，基地某些部分下方有一条排污系统，可以从附近的厨房进入。

english: These sewers could be used to bypass the spells. However, surges of energy are periodically sent through the water there.
translation: 这些下水道可以用来绕过法术。不过，那里会定期有能量波通过水流。

english: On the other side of the spells the vault door is found. This door is guarded by zombies. If they see an intruder, they will set off the alarm.
translation: 在法术的另一边可以找到金库门。这道门由僵尸守卫。如果他们看到入侵者，就会触发警报。

english: If the alarm is sounded, a gas will be released, incapacitating all living things in the area.
translation: 如果警报响起，就会释放一种气体，使该区域的所有生物丧失行动能力。

english: The vault door is made of five-inch thick runite-enforced steel, with a four digit access code. When the code is entered incorrectly more than twice, the alarm will be set off.
translation: 金库门由五英寸厚的符文钢加固制成，需要四位数的访问密码。当密码输入错误超过两次时，警报会被触发。

english: Inside the vault there is a criss-cross of special fire ray enchantments that Zemouregal has made. Touching any of these will do significant damage and set off the alarm.
translation: 金库内部有泽莫雷加尔设置的交错特殊火焰射线附魔。触碰任何一道都会造成巨大伤害并触发警报。

english: Finally, at the back of the vault, we have the pedestal holding Arrav's heart.
translation: 最后，在金库的后面，有放置阿拉夫心脏的基座。

english: Well, that sounds an awful lot to get past. It sounds like an impossible mission!
translation: 听起来要突破的东西太多了。这简直是个不可能完成的任务！

english: It does appear to pose somewhat of a challenge, but if we engage in a bit of cunning, it may not be as impossible as you might think.
translation: 这确实看起来有点挑战，但如果我们耍点小聪明，可能并不像你想的那样不可能。

english: First of all, we're going to need a distraction to lure some of those zombies out. I have no doubt that I'll be able to act as suitable bait. While I do that, you'll need to get through those sewers.
translation: 首先，我们需要一个分散注意力的东西引开那些僵尸。我毫不怀疑自己能充当合适的诱饵。在我这么做的时候，你需要穿过那些下水道。

english: But what about the energy surges? I don't really fancy getting fried!
translation: 但能量波怎么办？我可不想被电死！

english: Understandable. I would suggest you invest in some kind of insulation to protect yourself from the surges.
translation: 可以理解。我建议你搞些绝缘装备来保护自己免受能量波的伤害。

english: Now, provided my distraction works, you should find the area on the other side of the sewers free of zombies. That will give you the time and space needed to get that vault door open.
translation: 现在，如果我的引开计划奏效，你应该会发现下水道另一边的区域没有僵尸。这会给你打开金库门所需的时间和空间。

english: And then the fire rays?
translation: 那么火焰射线呢？

english: Well, no great heist is complete without the use of a crossbow and a grappling hook.
translation: 嗯，没有弩和抓钩，任何一场大劫案都不算完整。

english: Okay, so to summarise, I need some sort of insulated protection along with a crossbow and grappling hook?
translation: 好吧，那么总结一下，我需要某种绝缘保护，外加一把弩和抓钩？

english: Precisely! Gather those items and then meet me outside Zemouregal's Base near Varrock. It's time to recover a heart!
translation: 正是！收集好这些东西，然后到维洛克城附近的泽莫雷加尔基地外面与我碰头。是时候取回心脏了！

english: Hello again, [player name]. I found this earlier. I imagine you'll be needing it.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。我之前找到了这个。我想你会需要的。

english: Now, are you ready to perform a heist? Remember, you'll need some sort of insulated protection along with a crossbow and grappling hook.
translation: 那么，你准备好执行劫案了吗？记住，你需要某种绝缘保护，外加一把弩和抓钩。

english: Ah, there you are, [player name]. Ready to perform a heist? Remember, you'll need some sort of insulated protection along with a crossbow and grappling hook.
translation: 啊，你来了，[player name]。准备好执行劫案了吗？记住，你需要某种绝缘保护，外加一把弩和抓钩。

english: Excellent. Once you head in, I'll arrange a distraction to lure some of those zombies away. I'll meet you back here once you've recovered the heart. Good luck.
translation: 太好了。你进去后，我会安排一个引开行动，引走一些僵尸。你取回心脏后，我们在这里碰面。祝你好运。

english: I still need to do some preparation.
translation: 我还需要做些准备。

english: Now, once you head in, I'll arrange a distraction to lure some of those zombies away. I'll meet you back here once you've recovered the heart. Good luck.
translation: 那么，你进去后，我会安排一个引开行动，引走一些僵尸。你取回心脏后，我们在这里碰面。祝你好运。

english: I'm ready when you are, [player name]. Once you head in, I'll arrange a distraction to lure some of those zombies away. I'll meet you back here once you've recovered the heart. Good luck.
translation: 我随时可以开始，[player name]。你进去后，我会安排一个引开行动，引走一些僵尸。你取回心脏后，我们在这里碰面。祝你好运。

english: Well, look what we have here...
translation: 嗯，看看我们这儿有什么……

english: Did you really think you had any hope of stealing that heart?
translation: 你真以为你有希望偷走那颗心脏吗？

english: Arrav, kill [him/her/them].
translation: 阿拉夫，杀了[him/her/them]。

english: Urgh... [player name]...
translation: 呃……[player name]……

english: What a miserable failure you are. Sharathteerk, get rid of him.
translation: 你真是个可悲的失败品。沙拉什蒂尔克，把他处理掉。

english: What are you playing at?
translation: 你在搞什么鬼？

english: Something's not right... Something's blocking my teleport!
translation: 不对劲……有什么东西挡住了我的传送！

english: Impossible! Stop messing around and...
translation: 不可能！别胡闹了，快……

english: Wait... I sense...
translation: 等等……我感觉到……

english: [player name]! Grab the heart, quickly!
translation: [player name]！抓住心脏，快！

english: That was a close one!
translation: 真是好险！

english: That's one way to put it. Good job I was keeping an eye on things.
translation: 可以这么说。还好我一直盯着情况。

english: You can say that again, though that does leave me with some questions...
translation: 说得没错，不过这也让我有些疑问……

english: You're wondering how I managed to do it?
translation: 你在想我是怎么做到的？

english: Teleporting directly into the room... Keeping a Mahjarrat at bay... Those aren't the kind of skills that just anyone possesses. Not to mention that Zemouregal knew you!
translation: 直接传送到房间里……牵制住一个玛哈加特……这些可不是随便什么人都有的能力。更不用说泽莫雷加尔认识你！

english: I have never kept it secret from you that I have a history with the Mahjarrat, although I may have chosen not to divulge some of the more... specific details.
translation: 我从未向你隐瞒过我与玛哈加特有过交集，尽管我可能选择不透露一些更……具体的细节。

english: I hope you will not judge me too harshly for that. We are all entitled to our secrets, and even now I would prefer not to share them.
translation: 希望你不要因此过分苛责我。我们都有权保留自己的秘密，即使现在，我也宁愿不分享它们。

english: I guess... It's just, you made out you were just researching the Mahjarrat. This is clearly a lot more than that.
translation: 我想……只是，你表现得好像你只是在研究玛哈加特。这显然远远不止于此。

english: It is, and I apologise if you feel I have deceived you. My past with the Mahjarrat, and especially with Zemouregal is... complicated. Again, I would prefer we not discuss this further.
translation: 确实如此，如果你觉得我欺骗了你，我道歉。我与玛哈加特，尤其是与泽莫雷加尔的过去……很复杂。再说一次，我希望我们不要再讨论这件事了。

english: Now, why don't we instead focus this conversation on something far more positive than my history. We have successfully recovered Arrav's heart!
translation: 现在，我们不如把话题集中在比我的过去积极得多的事情上。我们已经成功找回了阿拉夫的心脏！

english: So does this mean we can free him now?
translation: 那这意味着我们现在能释放他了吗？

translation: 最终可以，但尽管心脏是泽莫雷加尔控制阿拉夫的关键，仅仅拥有它并不足以打破那种控制。

translation: 要做到这一点需要进一步的研究，更不用说合适的时机了。

english: You might not hear from me for some time, but fear not, I will be in touch again once things are ready.
translation: 你可能会有一段时间没有我的消息，但别担心，一旦准备就绪，我会再次联系你。

english: Stay safe out there, [player name]. Until we meet again.
translation: 在外面注意安全，[player name]。后会有期。

english: I am Lord Kandur Hosidius, ruler of this city. Who are you?
translation: 我是坎杜尔.霍西迪乌斯领主，这座城市的统治者。你是谁？

english: Pleased to meet you [player name]. It is a shame we could not meet in better circumstances.
translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]。可惜我们不是在更好的情况下相遇。

english: Our family is in dire need of assistance. Alas, I do not feel I can trust you enough to involve you in this.
translation: 我们家急需帮助。唉，我觉得还不足以信任你到让你参与此事。

english: Our family is in dire need of assistance. My eldest son, Artur, has gone missing and we could desperately use some help in finding him.
translation: 我们家急需帮助。我的长子阿图尔失踪了，我们迫切需要有人帮忙找到他。

translation: 你愿意帮助我们吗？如果你能把他安全带回家，你会得到报酬。

english: I can help. What do you need me to do?
translation: 我可以帮忙。需要我做什么？

english: Thank you friend. I suggest you begin your search by talking to my family and servants. One of them might know where Artur has gone.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。我建议你先和我的家人及仆从谈谈，开始你的搜索。他们中可能有人知道阿图尔去哪里了。

english: No. I'm afraid I have other things to be doing.
translation: 不了。恐怕我还有别的事要做。

english: I'm sorry to hear that. If you change your mind please return to me as soon as you can.
translation: 听到这个我很遗憾。如果你改变主意，请尽快回来找我。

english: Hello there. Have you found my son yet?
translation: 你好。你找到我儿子了吗？

translation: 我在寻找关于特威尔皇家协议的信息。

english: The Royal Accord of Twill was signed by the heads of Kourend's five houses, known then as the Royal Lords. This was over a thousand years ago.
translation: 特威尔皇家协议是由库兰德王国五大家族的首领签署的，当时他们被称为皇家领主。那是一千多年前的事了。

english: The Accord declared that they would take over rulership of Great Kourend from the Council of Elders.
translation: 协议宣布他们将接管库兰德王国的统治权，从长老议会手中接过。

english: For many years after the Accord was signed, the Royal Lords took it in turns to rule the kingdom. Each of them ruled for ten years in turn.

english: Many have tried and failed. You would likely have no better luck. However, if it interests you, you might wish to read The Envoy to Varlamore, by Deryk Paulson.

english: Typical. Fine, I'll kill the snake. Just wait here.

english: It's dead.

translation: 继续找。如果你能把他安全带回家，你会得到奖赏。

english: I did. The Accord has the potential to be a powerful weapon for words cut deeper than a blade ever can. However, I have no need to use this weapon, not unless the other houses give me reason to.
translation: 我确实用了。特威尔协议有潜力成为一件强大的武器，因为言语比刀片更能伤人。不过，我没有必要使用这件武器，除非其他家族给我理由。

english: Hello there. I would like to have a word with you, if you don't mind. That said, you should speak with Commander Fullore first. I think she wants to talk to you.
translation: 你好。如果你不介意的话，我想和你谈谈。不过，你应该先和富洛尔指挥官谈谈。我觉得她想和你说话。

english: Hello there. I think Commander Fullore wanted to talk to you.
translation: 你好。我觉得富洛尔指挥官想和你谈谈。

english: Thank goodness he is okay. Please find a way to pursuade him to come home.
translation: 谢天谢地他没事。请想办法说服他回家。

english: Thank goodness he's okay. Please find a way to pursuade him.
translation: 谢天谢地他没事。请想办法说服他。

english: Is dawe anything ewse me can do fow u?
translation: 还有啥俺能帮您做的吗？

english: Ah hello there! I am the resident lecturer on antiquities and artefacts. I also set the Earth Sciences exams.
translation: 啊，你好！我是这里的常驻讲师，专攻古物和文物。我还负责地球科学的考试。

english: Earth Sciences?
translation: 地球科学？

english: That is right dear, the world of Gielinor holds many wonders beneath its surface. Students come to me to take exams so that they may join in on the archaeological dig going on just north of here.
translation: 没错，亲爱的。吉莱诺世界的地表之下蕴藏着许多奇观。学生们来找我参加考试，这样他们就能加入北边正在进行的考古挖掘。

english: So if they don't pass the exams they can't dig at all?
translation: 所以如果他们考试不及格，就完全不能挖掘了？

english: That's right! We have to make sure that students know enough to be able to dig safely and not damage the artefacts.
translation: 没错！我们必须确保学生掌握足够的知识，能够安全挖掘，并且不损坏文物。

english: Can I take an exam?
translation: 我能参加考试吗？

english: Are you sure you want to? Our exams are serious business.
translation: 你确定要吗？我们的考试可是很严肃的。

english: Very well. You can if you get this letter stamped by the Curator of Varrock's museum.
translation: 好吧。如果你能让瓦洛克博物馆的馆长在这封信上盖章，你就可以参加。

english: Because he is a very knowledgeable man and employs our archaeological expert. I'm sure he knows a lot about your exploits and can judge whether you'd make a good archaeologist or not.
translation: 因为他是一位知识渊博的人，并且雇佣了我们的考古专家。我相信他对你的经历很了解，能够判断你是否能成为一名优秀的考古学家。

english: Besides, the museum contributes funds to the dig.
translation: 此外，博物馆也为挖掘提供了资金。

english: But why are you writing the letter? Shouldn't he?
translation: 但为什么是你写信？不应该是他吗？

english: He's also a very busy man, so I write the letters and he justsstamps them if he approves.
translation: 他也很忙，所以信由我来写，他同意的话就盖章。

english: Oh, I see. I'll ask him if he'll approve me, and bring my stamped letter back here. Thanks.
translation: 哦，我明白了。我去问他是否同意，然后把盖好章的信带回来。谢谢。

english: You could gain much with an understanding of the world below.
translation: 了解地底世界，你定能获益良多。

english: I am still waiting for your letter of recommendation.
translation: 我还在等你的推荐信。

english: I have lost the letter you gave me.
translation: 你给我的信我弄丢了。

english: Oh now come on. You have it with you!
translation: 哎呀，别闹了。信不就在你身上吗！

english: That was foolish. Take this one and don't lose it!
translation: 真够糊涂的。拿好这封，别再弄丢了！

english: Alright, I'll try and get it.
translation: 好，我尽量拿到它。

english: I am sure you won't get any problems. Speak to the Curator of Varrock's museum.
translation: 我相信你不会遇到什么麻烦。去找维洛克博物馆的馆长谈谈吧。

english: I don't really want this back until it's been stamped!
translation: 没盖章之前我可不想拿回来！

english: I have been given this letter by the examiner at the digsite; can you stamp it for me?
translation: 考古现场的考官给了我这封信；你能帮我盖个章吗？

english: What have we here? A letter of recommendation indeed!
translation: 这是什么？一封推荐信！

english: Normally, I wouldn't do this... but in this instance I don't see why not.
translation: 通常我不会这么做……但这次我看不出有什么理由拒绝。

english: The letter here says your name is [player name]. Well, [player name], I wouldn't normally do this for just anyone, but as you did us such a great service with the Shield of Arrav I don't see why not. Run this letter back to
translation: 信上写着你的名字是[player name]。好吧，[player name]，我通常不会随便帮人，但既然你帮了我们阿拉夫之盾那么大的忙，我看不出有什么理由不帮。把这封信拿回给

english: the Examiner to begin your adventure into the world of Earth Sciences. Enjoy your studies, Student!
translation: 考官，开始你的地球科学冒险之旅吧。祝你学业愉快，学生！

english: There you go; good luck student. Be sure to come back and show me your certificates. I would like to see how you get on.
translation: 拿去吧；祝你好运，学生。记得回来给我看看你的证书。我想看看你学得怎么样。

english: Ok, I will. Thanks; see you later.
translation: 好的，我会的。谢谢；回头见。

english: I seem to have lost the letter of recommendation that you stamped for me.
translation: 我好像把你盖过章的那封推荐信弄丢了。

english: Yes, I saw you drop it as you walked off last time. Here it is.
translation: 是啊，上次我看到你走开的时候掉了。给你。

english: I see you still have that letter I stamped for you. Why don't you run it back to the Examiner at the Exam Centre?
translation: 我看到你还拿着我盖过章的那封信。为什么不把它拿回考试中心的考官那里呢？

english: I have another letter here; could you stamp it for me again?
translation: 我这里还有一封信；你能再帮我盖个章吗？

english: You've already given me one of those! But... ok, give it here...
translation: 你已经给过我一个了！不过……好吧，拿来吧……

english: No I don't want it back thank you, you'll need to take that back to the examiner at the Digsite.
translation: 不，我不想拿回来，谢谢，你得把它拿回考古现场的考官那里。

english: Here is the stamped letter you asked for.
translation: 这是你要的盖好章的信。

english: Good good, we will begin the exam...
translation: 好好好，我们开始考试……

english: Okay, we will start with the first exam: Earth Sciences level 1 - Beginner.
translation: 好的，我们从第一场考试开始：地球科学一级 - 初级。

english: Question 1 - Earth Sciences overview. Can you tell me what Earth Sciences is?
translation: 问题一 - 地球科学概述。你能告诉我什么是地球科学吗？

english: The study of the earth, its contents and history.
translation: 研究地球、其内容物和历史的学科。

english: The study of gardening, planting and fruiting vegetation.
translation: 研究园艺、种植和结果植物的学科。

english: The study of planets and the history of the worlds.
translation: 研究行星和世界历史的学科。

english: The combination of archaeology and vegetarianism.
translation: 考古学和素食主义的组合。

english: Okay, next question...
translation: 好的，下一题……

english: Earth Sciences level 1, question 2 - Eligibility. Can you tell me which people are allowed to use the digsite?
translation: 地球科学一级，问题二 - 资格。你能告诉我哪些人可以使用考古现场吗？

english: Magic users, miners and their escorts.
translation: 魔法使用者、矿工及其随行人员。

english: Professors, students and workmen only.
translation: 仅限教授、学生和工人。

english: Local residents, contractors and small pink fish.
translation: 当地居民、承包商和粉色小鱼。

english: All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 所有通过相应地球科学考试的人。

english: Earth Sciences level 1, question 3 - Health and safety. Can you tell me the proper safety points when working on a digsite?
translation: 地球科学一级，问题三 - 健康与安全。你能告诉我考古现场工作的正确安全要点吗？

english: Heat-resistant clothing to be worn at all times.
translation: 必须始终穿着耐热服装。

english: Rubber chickens to be worn on the head at all times.
translation: 必须始终在头上戴橡胶鸡。

english: Gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.
translation: 必须始终戴手套和穿靴子；必须使用正确的工具。

english: Protective clothing to be worn; tools kept away from site.
translation: 必须穿防护服；工具远离现场。

english: That concludes the exam for Earth Sciences level 1.
translation: 地球科学一级考试到此结束。

english: Let's see how you did...
translation: 来看看你答得怎么样……

english: Oh deary me! This is appalling, none correct at all! I suggest you go and study properly.
translation: 哦，天哪！这太糟糕了，全错！我建议你去好好学学。

english: Why don't you use the resources here? There are books and the researchers, and you could even ask other students who are also studying for these exams.
translation: 为什么不利用这里的资源呢？有书，有研究员，你甚至可以问问其他也在备考的学生。

english: You got 1 question correct. Better luck next time.
translation: 你答对了1题。下次好运。

english: Oh bother!
translation: 哦，真烦！

english: Do some more research. I'm sure other students could help you out.
translation: 再多做些研究。我相信其他学生能帮你。

english: You got 2 questions correct. Not bad, just a little more revision needed.
translation: 你答对了2题。不错，只是还需要再复习一下。

english: Oh well...
translation: 哦，好吧……

english: You got all of the questions correct! Well done!
translation: 你答对了所有题目！干得好！

english: Hey! Excellent!
translation: 嘿！太棒了！

english: You have now passed the Earth Sciences level 1 general exam. Here is your certificate to prove it. You also get a decent trowel to dig with. Of course, you'll want to get studying for your next exam now!
translation: 你现在已经通过了地球科学一级通用考试。这是你的证书作为证明。你还得到一把像样的泥铲用来挖掘。当然，你现在该开始为下一场考试学习了！

english: Hello again. Are you ready for another shot at the exam?
translation: 又见面了。你准备好再考一次了吗？

english: No, not at the moment.
translation: 不，现在不想。

english: Okay, take your time if you wish.
translation: 好吧，如果你愿意，慢慢来。

english: You've already shown me that! Get digging!
translation: 你已经给我看过了！去挖吧！

english: Can you help me with the Earth Sciences exams at all?
translation: 你能帮我准备地球科学考试吗？

english: Well... Maybe I will if you help me with something.
translation: 嗯……如果你帮我个忙，也许我会帮你。

english: I have lost my recent good find.
translation: 我最近找到的好东西丢了。

english: What does it look like?
translation: 它长什么样？

english: Err... Like an animal skull!
translation: 呃……像个动物头骨！

english: Well, that's not too helpful, there are lots of those around here; can you remember where you last had it?
translation: 嗯，这不太有用，这里到处都是这种东西；你还记得最后一次见到它是在哪里吗？

english: It was around here for sure. Maybe someone picked it up?
translation: 肯定就在这附近。也许有人捡走了？

english: Okay, I'll have a look for you.
translation: 好的，我帮你找找。

english: How's the study going?
translation: 学习进展如何？

english: Very well thanks. Have you found my animal skull yet?
translation: 很好，谢谢。你找到我的动物头骨了吗？

english: No sorry, not yet.
translation: 没有，抱歉，还没找到。

english: Oh well, I am sure it's been picked up. Couldn't you try looking through some pockets?
translation: 哦，好吧，我肯定是被捡走了。你不能翻翻一些口袋吗？

english: Is this your animal skull?
translation: 这是你的动物头骨吗？

english: Oh wow! You've found it! Thank you so much. I'll be glad to tell you what I know about the exam.
translation: 哦，哇！你找到了！太感谢你了。我很乐意告诉你我所知道的关于考试的事。

english: The study of Earth Sciences is: The study of the earth, its contents and history.
translation: 地球科学是：研究地球、其内容物和历史的学科。

english: Okay, I'll remember that.
translation: 好的，我会记住的。

english: I need more help with the exam.
translation: 我在考试上需要更多帮助。

english: Well ok, this is what I have learned since I last spoke to you...
translation: 好吧，这是我上次和你谈话后学到的东西……

english: I can if you help me...
translation: 如果你帮我，我就帮你……

english: I have lost my teddy bear. He was my lucky mascot.
translation: 我的泰迪熊丢了。它是我的幸运吉祥物。

english: Do you know where you dropped him?
translation: 你知道你把它掉在哪里了吗？

english: Well, I was doing a lot of walking that day... Oh yes, that's right - we were studying ceramics in fact, near the edge of the digsite.
translation: 嗯，那天我走了很多路……哦，对了——我们当时在考古现场边缘研究陶器。

english: I found some pottery that seemed to match the design on those large urns.
translation: 我找到了一些陶器，似乎和那些大瓮上的图案相符。

english: I was in the process of checking this out, and when we got back to the centre my lucky mascot had gone!
translation: 我当时正在核实这件事，等我们回到中心时，我的幸运吉祥物就不见了！

english: Leave it to me, I'll find it.
translation: 交给我吧，我会找到的。

english: Oh great! Thanks!
translation: 哦，太好了！谢谢！

english: Very well thanks. Have you found my lucky mascot yet?
translation: 很好，谢谢。你找到我的幸运吉祥物了吗？

english: I'm sure it's just outside the digsite somewhere...
translation: 我肯定它就在考古现场外面的某个地方……

english: Hey, something has been dropped here...
translation: 嘿，这里掉了什么东西……

english: Guess what I found.
translation: 猜猜我找到了什么。

english: Hey! My lucky mascot! Thanks ever so much. Let me help you with those questions now.
translation: 嘿！我的幸运吉祥物！太感谢了。现在让我来帮你解答那些问题吧。

english: The proper health and safety points are: Leather gloves and boots to be worn at all times; proper tools must be used.
translation: 正确的健康与安全要点是：必须始终戴皮革手套和穿靴子；必须使用正确的工具。

english: Great, thanks for your advice.
translation: 太好了，谢谢你的建议。

english: I am stuck on some more exam questions.
translation: 我卡在一些考试问题上了。

english: Okay, I'll tell you my latest notes...
translation: 好的，我告诉你我最新的笔记……

english: I can't do anything unless I find my special cup.
translation: 除非我找到我的特殊杯子，否则我什么也做不了。

english: Your what?
translation: 你的什么？

english: My special cup. I won it for a particularly good find last month.
translation: 我的特殊杯子。上个月我因为一个特别好的发现赢来的。

english: Oh, right. So if I find it you'll help me?
translation: 哦，好吧。如果我找到了，你会帮我吗？

english: I sure will!
translation: 当然会！

english: Any ideas where it may be?
translation: 知道它可能在哪里吗？

english: All I remember is that I was working near the tents when I lost it.
translation: 我只记得我是在帐篷附近工作时弄丢的。

english: I'm getting there. Have you found my special cup yet?
translation: 快好了。你找到我的特殊杯子了吗？

english: Oh dear, I hope it didn't fall into the stream; I might never find it again.
translation: 哦天哪，希望它没掉进溪流里；不然我可能再也找不到了。

english: Hello, I am the panning guide. I teach students how to pan in these waters. They're not permitted to do so until after they've had training and, of course, they must be invited to pan here too.
translation: 你好，我是淘金向导。我教学生如何在这些水域中淘金。他们必须经过培训，当然，还必须被邀请到这里才能进行淘金。

english: I've some here that you can have.
translation: 我这里有一些，你可以拿去。

english: Ah! Lovely! You can't beat a good cuppa... You're free to pan all you want.
translation: 啊！太好了！没有什么比得上一杯好茶……你可以尽情淘金了。

english: Urg! Is that what you call tea? Oh well, I suppose it will do; you can pan all you want.
translation: 呃！这就是你所谓的茶吗？好吧，我想也凑合了；你可以尽情淘金了。

english: Yes, this is a panning tray...
translation: 是的，这是一个淘金盘……

english: This is no good to me; I don't deal with finds.
translation: 这对我没用；我不处理发现物。

english: I already have a full panning tray; perhaps I should search it first.
translation: 我已经有一个满满的淘金盘了；也许我应该先搜索一下它。

english: Look what I found!
translation: 看看我找到了什么！

english: Excellent! I'm so happy. Let me now help you with your exams...
translation: 太棒了！我太高兴了。现在让我来帮你准备考试吧……

english: The people eligible to use the digsite are: All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exams.
translation: 有资格使用考古遗址的人是：所有通过相应地球科学考试的人。

english: There are more exam questions I'm stuck on.
translation: 还有一些考试题目我卡住了。

english: Hey, I'll tell you what I've learned. That may help.
translation: 嘿，我来告诉你我学到的东西。或许会有帮助。

english: I'm going to pass the Earth Sciences exams so I can dig at the site north of here.
translation: 我要通过地球科学考试，这样我就能在北边那个遗址挖掘了。

english: A good goal to work towards, and it should prove rewarding for you. So where are you starting your studies?
translation: 这是一个很好的目标，值得为之努力，而且对你来说应该会很有收获。那么你打算从哪里开始学习呢？

english: I'm not quite sure.
translation: 我不太确定。

english: Well, you could try looking in the Earth Sciences section of the shelves over there, although the other students may have beaten you to it.
translation: 嗯，你可以去那边的架子上的地球科学区看看，不过其他学生可能已经捷足先登了。

english: You could even ask the students themselves. I'm sure I saw a group of them on their way to the digsite earlier today.
translation: 你甚至可以问问那些学生本人。我确定今天早些时候我看到一群人往遗址那边去了。

english: If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry; he’s the archaeological expert in the next room.
translation: 如果你需要鉴定什么东西或者对某件事不确定，就把它交给特里；他是隔壁房间的考古学专家。

english: Oh, hello there. Congratulations on passing your first exam, I saw your performance, well done. Are you going to go for the next level?
translation: 哦，你好啊。恭喜你通过了第一次考试，我看到了你的表现，干得好。你打算继续考下一级吗？

english: Of course! I should probably talk to those students again; they were very helpful.
translation: 当然！我大概应该再去找那些学生聊聊；他们帮了大忙。

english: I am ready for the next exam.
translation: 我准备好参加下一场考试了。

english: Okay, this is the next part of the Earth Sciences exam: Earth Sciences level 2 - Intermediate.
translation: 好的，这是地球科学考试的下一部分：地球科学二级——中级。

english: Question 1 - Sample transportation. Can you tell me how we transport samples?
translation: 问题一——样品运输。你能告诉我我们如何运输样品吗？

english: Samples cut and cleaned before transportation.
translation: 样品在运输前切割并清洁干净。

english: Samples ground and suspended in an acid solution.
translation: 样品研磨后悬浮在酸性溶液中。

english: Samples to be given to the melon-collecting monkey.
translation: 样品要交给收集西瓜的猴子。

english: Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.
translation: 样品以原始形态采集，仅存放在密封容器中。

english: Earth Sciences level 2, question 2 - Handling of finds. What is the proper way to handle finds?
translation: 地球科学二级，问题二——出土物的处理。处理出土物的正确方式是什么？

english: Finds must not be handled by anyone.
translation: 出土物不得由任何人触碰。

english: Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.
translation: 出土物必须小心处理，并戴上手套。

english: Finds to be given to the site workmen.
translation: 出土物要交给现场工人。

english: Drop them on the floor and jump on them.
translation: 把它们扔到地板上然后跳上去踩。

english: Earth Sciences level 2, question 3 - Rock pick usage. Can you tell me the proper use for a rock pick?
translation: 地球科学二级，问题三——石镐的使用。你能告诉我石镐的正确用法吗？

english: Strike rock repeatedly until powdered.
translation: 反复击打石头直到变成粉末。

english: Rock pick must be used flat and with a strong force.
translation: 石镐必须平放并使用大力。

english: Always handle with care; strike cleanly on its cleaving point.
translation: 始终小心使用；在它的劈裂点上干净利落地敲击。

english: Rock picks are to be used to milk cows on a rainy morning.
translation: 石镐要在下雨的早晨用来给奶牛挤奶。

english: Okay, that concludes the level 2 Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 好的，地球科学二级考试到此结束。

english: Let me add up your total..
translation: 让我算算你的总分……

english: No, no, no! This will not do. They are all wrong; start again!
translation: 不，不，不！这不行。全错了；重新开始！

english: More studying for you my [boy/girl/friend].
translation: 你需要更多学习，我的[boy/girl/friend]。

english: You got 1 question correct. At least it's a start.
translation: 你答对了1道题。至少算是个开始。

english: Get out and explore the digsite, talk to people and learn!
translation: 出去探索遗址，和人交谈，学习！

english: You got 2 questions correct. Not too bad, but you can do better...
translation: 你答对了2道题。不算太差，但你还能做得更好……

english: Nearly got it.
translation: 差一点就对了。

english: You got all the questions correct, well done!
translation: 你答对了所有题目，干得好！

english: Great, I'm getting good at this.
translation: 太好了，我越来越擅长这个了。

english: You have now passed the Earth Sciences level 2 intermediate exam. Here is your certificate. Of course, you'll want to get studying for your next exam now!
translation: 你现在已经通过了地球科学二级中级考试。这是你的证书。当然，你现在应该开始为下一场考试学习了！

english: I am stuck on a question.
translation: 我有一道题卡住了。

english: Well, well, have you not been doing any studies? I am not giving you the answers, talk to the other students and remember the answers.
translation: 哎呀呀，你是不是根本没在学习？我不会给你答案的，去和其他学生聊聊，记住答案。

english: Sorry, I didn't mean to disturb you.
translation: 抱歉，我不是有意打扰你。

english: Oh, no problem at all.
translation: 哦，完全没问题。

english: Correct rock pick usage: Always handle with care; strike the rock cleanly on its cleaving point.
translation: 石镐的正确用法：始终小心使用；在石头的劈裂点上干净利落地敲击。

english: Finds handling: Finds must be carefully handled, and gloves worn.
translation: 出土物处理：出土物必须小心处理，并戴上手套。

english: Correct sample transportation: Samples taken in rough form; kept only in sealed containers.
translation: 正确的样品运输：样品以原始形态采集，仅存放在密封容器中。

english: Hi there! I passed my second Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 嗨！我通过了地球科学二级考试。

english: Well done! Are you planning on going for level 3?
translation: 干得好！你打算继续考三级吗？

english: Yes! Someday I'll know as much as you! Now, where did I leave those students....
translation: 是的！总有一天我会像你一样博学！现在，我把那些学生忘到哪儿去了……

english: Have fun and good luck!
translation: 玩得开心，祝你好运！

english: I am ready for the last exam...
translation: 我准备好参加最后一场考试了……

english: Attention, this is the final part of the Earth Sciences exam: Earth Sciences level 3 - Advanced.
translation: 注意，这是地球科学考试的最后一部分：地球科学三级——高级。

english: Question 1 - Sample preparation. Can you tell me how we prepare samples?
translation: 问题一——样品准备。你能告诉我我们如何准备样品吗？

english: Samples may be mixed together safely.
translation: 样品可以安全地混合在一起。

english: Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.
translation: 样品清洁干净，仅使用标本罐携带。

english: Sample types catalogued and carried by hand only.
translation: 样品类型编目，仅用手携带。

english: Samples to be spread thickly with mashed banana.
translation: 样品要厚厚地涂上捣碎的香蕉。

english: Earth Sciences level 3, question 2 - Specimen brush use. What is the proper way to use a specimen brush?
translation: 地球科学三级，问题二——标本刷的使用。使用标本刷的正确方式是什么？

english: Brush quickly using a wet brush.
translation: 用湿刷子快速刷。

english: Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.
translation: 用短笔触仔细而缓慢地刷。

english: Dipped in glue and stuck to a sheep's back.
translation: 浸入胶水然后粘在羊背上。

english: Brush quickly and with force.
translation: 快速用力地刷。

english: Earth Sciences level 3, question 3 - Advanced techniques. Can you describe the technique for handling bones?
translation: 地球科学三级，问题三——高级技术。你能描述处理骨头的方法吗？

english: Bones must not be taken from the digsite.
translation: 骨头不得从遗址带走。

english: Feed to hungry dogs.
translation: 喂给饥饿的狗。

english: Bones to be ground and tested for mineral content.
translation: 骨头要研磨并测试矿物质含量。

english: Handle bones very carefully and keep them away from other samples.
translation: 非常小心地处理骨头，并与其他样品隔离开来。

english: Okay, that concludes the level 3 Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 好的，地球科学三级考试到此结束。

english: Let me add up the results..
translation: 让我算算结果……

english: I cannot believe this! Absolutely none right at all. I doubt you did any research before you took this exam...
translation: 我简直不敢相信！一道题都没对。我怀疑你在参加考试前根本没做过任何研究……

english: Ah... Yes... Erm... I think I had better go and revise first!
translation: 啊……嗯……呃……我想我最好还是先去复习一下！

english: You got 1 question correct. Try harder!
translation: 你答对了1道题。再努力点！

english: You got 2 questions correct. A little more study and you will pass it.
translation: 你答对了2道题。再多学一点就能通过了。

english: I'm nearly there...
translation: 我差一点就通过了……

english: Congratulations! You have now passed the Earth Sciences level 3 exam. Here is your level 3 certificate.
translation: 恭喜你！你现在已经通过了地球科学三级考试。这是你的三级证书。

english: I can dig wherever I want now!
translation: 我现在想在哪里挖就在哪里挖了！

english: Perhaps you should use your newfound skills to find an artefact on the digsite that will impress the archaeological expert.
translation: 也许你应该利用你新学的技能，在遗址上找到一件能让考古学专家印象深刻的手工艺品。

english: Specimen brush use: Brush carefully and slowly using short strokes.
translation: 标本刷使用：用短笔触仔细而缓慢地刷洗。

english: Okay, I'll remember that. Thanks for all your help.
translation: 好的，我会记住的。谢谢你的帮助。

english: What, you want more help?
translation: 怎么，你想要更多帮助？

english: Err... Yes please!
translation: 呃……是的，麻烦了！

english: Well... It's going to cost you...
translation: 嗯……那是要收费的……

english: Oh, well how much?
translation: 哦，那要多少钱？

english: I'll tell you what I would like: a precious stone. I don't find many of them. My favourites are opals; they are beautiful.
translation: 我来告诉你我想要什么：一颗宝石。我找到的不多。我最喜欢的是蛋白石；它们很漂亮。

english: Just like me! Tee hee hee!
translation: 就像我一样！嘻嘻嘻！

english: Err... OK I'll see what I can do, but I'm not sure where I'd get one.
translation: 呃……好吧，我看看我能做些什么，但我不确定去哪里弄一颗。

english: Well, I have seen people get them from panning occasionally.
translation: 嗯，我偶尔看到有人淘金时淘到过。

english: OK, I'll see what I can turn up for you.
translation: 好的，我看看能不能帮你找到一颗。

english: Oh, hi again. Did you bring me the opal?
translation: 哦，又见面了。你带蛋白石来了吗？

english: I haven't found one yet.
translation: 我还没找到。

english: Oh well, tell me when you do. Remember that they can be found around the digsite; perhaps try panning the river.
translation: 哦好吧，找到后告诉我。记住，它们在遗址附近可以找到；也许试试在河里淘金。

english: Would an opal look like this by any chance?
translation: 蛋白石会不会碰巧长这样？

english: Wow, great, you've found one. This will look beautiful set in my necklace. Thanks for that; now I'll tell you what I know...
translation: 哇，太棒了，你找到了一个。镶在我的项链上一定很好看。谢谢你；现在我把我知道的告诉你……

english: Sample preparation: Samples cleaned, and carried only in specimen jars.
translation: 样本准备：样本需清洁，且仅能使用标本罐携带。

english: The proper technique for handling bones is: Handle bones carefully and keep them away from other samples.
translation: 处理骨头的正确技巧是：小心处理骨头，并使其远离其他样本。

english: Thanks a lot for finding my special cup. See you again.
translation: 非常感谢你帮我找到了我的特殊杯子。再见。

english: Hi. The opal looks magnificent. Thanks for everything you've done for me.
translation: 嗨。这颗蛋白石看起来太棒了。谢谢你为我做的一切。

english: Hi there. I'm studying for the Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 你好。我正在为地球科学考试学习。

english: Oh, hi. I'm studying hard for an exam.
translation: 哦，嗨。我正在为考试努力学习。

english: It's the Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 是地球科学考试。

english: It's beautiful, but I couldn't accept another one.
translation: 它很漂亮，但我不能再接受另一个了。

english: It's beautiful, but I couldn't possibly accept it.
translation: 它很漂亮，但我实在不能接受。

english: Hello there; as you can see I am a student.
translation: 你好；如你所见，我是个学生。

english: Oh, I'm studying for the Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 哦，我在为地球科学考试学习。

english: Thanks for your help; I'll pass these exams yet! See you later.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助；我一定能通过这些考试！回头见。

english: Uh? That's not mine!
translation: 呃？那不是我的！

english: Oh dear, no it's not.
translation: 哦天哪，不是的。

english: I've already got mine, thanks. That must be someone else's.
translation: 我已经有我的了，谢谢。那一定是别人的。

english: Oh dear, no it's not. Thanks for finding my special cup.
translation: 哦天哪，不是的。谢谢你帮我找到我的特殊杯子。

english: Uh? That's not mine! You've already given me my animal skull back!
translation: 呃？那不是我的！你已经把我的动物头骨还给我了！

english: Nope. That's not mine!
translation: 不。那不是我的！

english: Uh? That's not mine! You've already given me my special cup back!
translation: 呃？那不是我的！你已经把我的特殊杯子还给我了！

english: This? Oh no....
translation: 这个？哦不……

english: This broken rock? I hope not!
translation: 这块破损的岩石？我希望不是！

english: I did it! Level 3 Earth Sciences!
translation: 我做到了！三级地球科学！

english: Bravo! Well done indeed! What are your plans now?
translation: 好极了！干得漂亮！你现在有什么打算？

english: Well, I'm not really sure; I guess I should see what I can find around the site.
translation: 嗯，我也不太确定；我想我该在挖掘现场周围看看能找到什么。

english: I hear that the third level digs yield the best artefacts for display; Terry, the archaeological expert, has found many good things there that he's excited about.
translation: 我听说第三层挖掘出的文物最适合展示；考古专家泰瑞在那里找到了很多让他兴奋的好东西。

english: Well, what are you doing here? Get digging!
translation: 嗯，你在这儿干嘛？快去挖！

english: Okay, that covers the level 2 Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 好了，这涵盖了二级地球科学考试的内容。

english: You can if you get this letter stamped by the Curator of Varrock's museum.
translation: 如果你能让维洛克博物馆的馆长在这封信上盖章，你就可以。

english: Let me add up the results...
translation: 让我来算算总分……

english: Okay, that covers the level 1 Earth Sciences exam.
translation: 好了，这涵盖了一级地球科学考试的内容。

english: He's also a very busy man, so I write the letters and he justs stamps them if he approves.
translation: 他也很忙，所以我写信，如果他同意就盖章。

english: Let me add up your total...
translation: 让我算算你的总分……

english: You got all the questions correct. Well done!
translation: 你答对了所有问题。干得好！

english: More studying for you my boy.
translation: 小子，你得多用功了。

english: More studying for you my girl.
translation: 姑娘，你得多用功了。

english: You'll need at least two spaces free in your inventory before taking this exam, else you can not be rewarded if you pass!
translation: 参加考试前，你的背包至少需要两个空位，否则通过后无法获得奖励！

english: You'll need a space free in your inventory before taking this exam, else you cannot be rewarded if you pass!
translation: 参加考试前，你的背包需要有一个空位，否则通过后无法获得奖励！

english: If you had space in your inventory I could give you a letter to take to the Curator of Varrock's museum... make some space and then come back to me.
translation: 如果你的背包有空间，我可以给你一封信，让你带去给维洛克博物馆的馆长……腾出空间后再来找我。

english: You already have the letter in your bank.
translation: 你的银行里已经有那封信了。

english: That's not much use - go and fetch it!
translation: 那没什么用——去把它拿来！

english: Take a look at this talisman.
translation: 看看这个护符。

english: Unusual... This object doesn't appear right...
translation: 不寻常……这东西看起来不对劲……

english: I wonder... Let me check my guide... Could it be? Surely not!
translation: 我想知道……让我查查我的指南……难道会是？不可能吧！

english: From the markings on it, it seems to be a ceremonial ornament to a god named...
translation: 从上面的标记来看，这似乎是一件献给一位名叫……的神的仪式装饰品。

english: ...Zaros? I haven't heard much about him before. This is a great discovery; we know very little of the pagan gods that people worshipped.
translation: ……扎洛斯？我以前没怎么听说过他。这是个伟大的发现；我们对人们崇拜的异教神知之甚少。

english: There is some strange writing embossed upon it - it says, 'Zaros will return and wreak his vengeance upon Zamorak the pretender.'
translation: 上面刻着一些奇怪的文字——写着：'扎罗斯将归来，向篡位者扎莫拉克施以复仇。'

english: I wonder what it means by that? Some silly superstition, probably.
translation: 我想知道那是什么意思？大概是什么愚蠢的迷信吧。

english: Still, I wonder what this is doing around here. I'll tell you what; as you have found this, I will allow you to use the private dig shafts.
translation: 不过，我还是想知道这东西怎么会出现在这里。这样吧；既然你找到了这个，我允许你使用私人挖掘竖井。

english: You obviously have a keen eye. Take this letter and give it to one of the workmen, and they will allow you to use them.
translation: 你显然眼光独到。拿着这封信给一个工人，他们就会让你使用那些竖井。

english: I lost the letter you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那封信。

english: No you haven't! You have one in your pack!
translation: 你没有弄丢！你背包里就有一封！

english: No you haven't! You have one in your bank!
translation: 你没有弄丢！你银行里就有一封！

english: I can't believe it! I go to all the effort of writing you a letter of recommendation and you lose it! Here, I'll write another... Don't lose it again!
translation: 我真不敢相信！我费尽心思给你写了封推荐信，你却弄丢了！来，我再写一封……别再弄丢了！

english: It says, 'I give permission for the bearer... to use the mine shafts on site. - signed Terrance Balando, Archaeological Expert, City of Varrock.'
translation: 上面写着：‘本人允许持信人……使用现场的矿井。——维洛克城考古专家泰伦斯.巴兰多 签。’

english: Here, have a look at this...
translation: 来，看看这个……

english: I give permission... blah de blah... etc. Okay, that's all in order; you may use the mineshaft now. I'll hang onto this scroll, shall I?
translation: 我允许……等等等等……好了，一切就绪；你现在可以使用矿井了。这卷轴我留着，行吧？

english: What on earth are you giving me another scroll for?
translation: 你到底为什么又给我一卷卷轴？

english: Hey! That's fragile! Stop poking it around with that trowel!
translation: 嘿！那东西很脆弱！别用那把泥铲乱戳！

english: 'Ello. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好。有什么能帮你的？

english: Why hello there! What can I do you for?
translation: 哎呀，你好啊！有什么需要我帮忙的吗？

english: Me? I'm a workman. I get paid to shift dirt essentially. S'not a very good job, but it pays the bills.
translation: 我？我是工人。我基本上靠搬泥土赚钱。这不是什么好工作，但能糊口。

english: Well that's nice for you. But regulations say you can't dig around here without a certificate.
translation: 那对你来说不错。但规定说，没有证书就不能在这里挖掘。

english: The examiner up at the education centre can help you there.
translation: 教育中心那边的考官可以帮你。

english: Yea, only people who have passed level 1 certificate can dig in a level 1 site and so on and so forth.
translation: 是啊，只有通过一级证书的人才能在一级遗址挖掘，以此类推。

english: Really? What qualifications do you have?
translation: 真的吗？你有什么资格？

english: Ahem! I don't see your specimen jar; you must carry one to be able to dig here.
translation: 咳咳！我没看到你的标本罐；你必须带一个才能在这里挖掘。

english: Well, my job involves digging for finds, cleaning them and transporting them for identification.
translation: 嗯，我的工作包括挖掘发现物、清理它们并送去鉴定。

english: I find it very interesting and very rewarding. So glad to see you're taking an interest in the digsite. Hope to see you out here digging sometime!
translation: 我觉得这工作很有趣也很有成就感。很高兴看到你对挖掘场感兴趣。希望哪天能在这里看到你挖掘！

english: Well done! That means you can dig anywhere on this site, but you'll need to impress the examiner to use the winches.
translation: 干得好！这意味着你可以在这个遗址的任何地方挖掘，但你需要给考官留下好印象才能使用绞盘。

english: Oh wow! You're the archaeologist who found that altar in the mines aren't you!
translation: 哦哇！你就是那个在矿井里发现祭坛的考古学家吧！

english: So glad to meet you! Well done!
translation: 很高兴见到你！干得好！

english: Well, let me know when you are. I can't be standin around yakkin'; I got work to do!
translation: 好吧，准备好了就告诉我。我可不能一直站在这儿闲聊；我还有活要干！

english: Oh yes, you need to have been trained in the various techniques before you can be allowed to dig for artefacts.
translation: 哦对，你需要先接受各种技术的培训，才能被允许挖掘文物。

english: You're the little squirt who unearthed that big find in the mines aren't you. Well done.
translation: 你就是那个在矿井里挖出大发现的小家伙吧。干得好。

english: Wait just a minute. I can't let you dig here unless you have a specimen brush with you. Rules are rules!
translation: 等一下。除非你带着标本刷，否则我不能让你在这里挖掘。规矩就是规矩！

english: Well, let me know when you are and I'll do my very best to help you!
translation: 好吧，准备好了就告诉我，我会尽力帮你！

english: Sorry, you haven't passed the level 3 Earth Sciences exam. I can't let you dig here.
translation: 抱歉，你没有通过三级地球科学考试。我不能让你在这里挖掘。

english: Well the examiner up at the education centre can help you there.
translation: 教育中心那边的考官可以帮你。

english: Oi! Don't use that spade! What are you trying to do, destroy everything of value?
translation: 喂！别用那把铲子！你想干什么，毁掉所有有价值的东西吗？

english: Well done! That means you can dig anywhere on this site!
translation: 干得好！这意味着你可以在这个遗址的任何地方挖掘了！

english: Congratulations, remember though that you can only use a site you have the appropriate exam level for.
translation: 恭喜，不过要记住，你只能使用你拥有相应考试等级的遗址。

english: Sorry, you haven't passed the level 2 Earth Sciences exam; I can't let you dig here.
translation: 抱歉，你没有通过二级地球科学考试；我不能让你在这里挖掘。

english: Oh, hello. I hope you're getting on well in the dig shafts.
translation: 哦，你好。希望你在挖掘竖井里进展顺利。

english: Hey, I think I could fit down here. I need something to help me get all the way down.
translation: 嘿，我觉得我能钻下去。我需要点东西帮我完全下去。

english: Hmmm, there's a room past these bricks. If I could move them out of the way then I could find out what's inside. Maybe there's someone around here who can help...
translation: 嗯，这些砖块后面有个房间。如果我能把它们移开，就能知道里面有什么了。也许附近有人能帮忙……

english: Well, well... I have a visitor. What are you doing here?
translation: 哎呀呀……有客人来了。你在这儿干嘛？

english: I have been invited to research here.
translation: 我被邀请来这里做研究。

english: Indeed, you must be someone special to be allowed down here.
translation: 确实，能被允许下来这里，你一定是个特别的人。

english: Do you know where to find a specimen jar?
translation: 你知道哪里能找到标本罐吗？

english: Hmmm, let me think... Nope, can't help you there I'm afraid.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……不，恐怕我帮不了你。

english: I have things to do...
translation: 我还有事要做……

english: Of course, don't let me keep you.
translation: 当然，我就不耽误你了。

english: I am not sure really.
translation: 我也不太确定。

english: A miner without a clue - how funny!
translation: 一个毫无头绪的矿工——真有趣！

english: I'm here to get rich, rich, rich!
translation: 我来这儿是为了发财，发财，发财！

english: Oh, well, don't forget that wealth and riches aren't everything.
translation: 哦，好吧，别忘了财富和金钱不是一切。

english: How do you move a large pile of rocks?
translation: 怎么移动一大块岩石堆？

english: There used to be this chap that worked in the other shaft. He was working on an explosive chemical mixture to be used for clearing blocked areas underground.
translation: 以前有个家伙在另一个竖井工作。他正在研究一种爆炸性化学混合物，用来清理地下的堵塞区域。

english: He left in a hurry one day; something in the shaft scared him to death, but he didn't say what.
translation: 有一天他匆忙离开了；竖井里的什么东西把他吓了个半死，但他没说是什么。

english: Rumour has it he'd been writing a book on his chemical mixture. I'm not sure what goes in it but I'm sure you'll find the stuff he was using scattered around the digsite. He left so quickly he didn't take anything with
translation: 传闻他一直在写一本关于他的化学混合物的书。我不确定里面有什么，但我确信你会在挖掘现场找到他使用的神秘物质散落各处。他离开得太匆忙，什么都没带走。

english: him. In fact, I still have a chest key he gave me to look after; perhaps it's more useful to you.
translation: 事实上，我还保管着他给我的一个宝箱钥匙；也许对你更有用。

english: It's ok, I already have one.
translation: 没关系，我已经有一个了。

english: Mmmm... The lid is shut tight; I'll have to find something to lever it off.
translation: 嗯……盖子盖得很紧；我得找点东西把它撬开。

english: It's closed tight.
translation: 它关得很紧。

english: Great! It's opened.
translation: 太好了！它打开了。

english: I can't pick this up with my bare hands! I'll need something to put it in. It looks and smells rather dangerous though, so it'll need to be something small and capable of containing dangerous chemicals.
translation: 我不能光手拿这个！我需要个东西来装它。不过它看起来闻起来都挺危险的，所以得找个小的、能装危险化学品的东西。

english: I'm not sure what this stuff is. I had better be VERY careful with it; I had better not drop it either...
translation: 我不确定这是什么东西。我最好非常小心地处理它；最好也别把它掉地上……

english: Do you know what this powder is?
translation: 你知道这粉末是什么吗？

english: Really, you do find the most unusual items. I know what this is, it's a strong chemical called ammonium nitrate. Why you want this I'll never know...
translation: 说真的，你总能找到最不寻常的东西。我知道这是什么，这是一种叫做硝酸铵的强效化学品。我永远想不通你要这个干嘛……

english: Excellent! This looks just right!
translation: 太棒了！这看起来正合适！

english: Now, what am I trying to achieve here?
translation: 现在，我到底想达到什么目的？

english: That would be like cutting the lawn with nail scissors! It would take a year to chip away these rocks!
translation: 那就像用指甲剪修剪草坪！要凿掉这些岩石得花一年时间！

english: That was a good idea, but these blocks are huge. I' m going to need something much more powerful to shift these...
translation: 那是个好主意，但这些石块太大了。我需要更强大的东西来移动它们……

english: Okay, the mixture is all over the bricks. I need some way to ignite this compound.
translation: 好了，混合物都洒在砖块上了。我需要点办法来点燃这个化合物。

english: Whoa! This is going to blow! I'd better run!
translation: 哇！这要爆炸了！我最好快跑！

english: Wow, that was a big explosion! What's that noise I can hear? Sounds like bones moving or something...
translation: 哇，好大的爆炸！我听到的是什么声音？听起来像骨头在动还是什么的……

english: It says: Tremble mortal, before the altar of our dread lord Zaros.
translation: 上面写着：凡人在我们敬畏的主扎洛斯的祭坛前颤抖吧。

english: I hear you've been given access to the private mining shafts. You're very lucky.
translation: 我听说你获准使用私人采矿竖井了。你真幸运。

english: I managed to find something... interesting.
translation: 我设法找到了点……有趣的东西。

english: Oh? What was that?
translation: 哦？是什么？

english: A talisman linked to Zaros, so Terry says.
translation: 一个与扎洛斯有关的护符，泰瑞是这么说的。

english: Wow! That's a serious find! Good luck in the lower digs.
translation: 哇！这可是个大发现！祝你在下层挖掘好运。

english: If you need something identified or are not sure about something, give it to Terry; hes the archaeological expert in the next room.
translation: 如果你需要鉴定什么东西，或者对某件事不确定，就把它交给泰瑞；他是隔壁房间的考古专家。

english: Oh Izzie? He's my pet.
translation: 哦，伊齐？他是我的宠物。

english: What kind of creature is Izzie?
translation: 伊齐是什么生物？

english: I'm not sure. He's very cute though don't you think? It's very restful having a pet, especially when you are stuck in a cave for as long as I am!
translation: 我也不确定。不过他很可爱，你不觉得吗？养宠物很让人放松，尤其是像我这样被困在洞穴里这么久的时候！

english: So, what do you do down here anyway?
translation: 那么，你在这里到底做什么？

english: Isn't that obvious? I investigate Thaumaturgy, I research the Arcane, I attempt to explain the inexplicable.
translation: 这还不明显吗？我研究奇术，钻研奥术，试图解释那些无法解释的事物。

english: You study magic then, what kind of magic? I do a bit of magic myself you know.
translation: 那你是在研究魔法？哪种魔法？我自己也会一点魔法，你知道吗。

english: Are you a budding mage? I can tell you more about my research if you'd like.
translation: 你是个初出茅庐的法师吗？如果你愿意，我可以多跟你讲讲我的研究。

english: Yes, that sounds fascinating...
translation: 好啊，听起来很有趣……

english: Excellent, it's so rare I can find someone to discuss my researches, most gnomes seem to find it all very tedious.
translation: 太好了，我很少能找到人讨论我的研究，大多数地精似乎都觉得这很无聊。

english: Never. How could they think that? Though, I suppose gnomes aren't known for their magic.
translation: 绝不会。他们怎么会这么想？不过，我想地精并不以魔法闻名。

english: Well that's true. These days, apart from a few combat spells most gnomes seem to be a bit suspicious of mages.
translation: 这倒是真的。如今，除了少数战斗法术，大多数地精似乎对法师有点怀疑。

english: Really? Why is that?
translation: 真的吗？为什么？

english: Well there is a bit of history there, do you want me to tell you about it?
translation: 这背后有点历史渊源，你想听吗？

english: Oh, yes I love a bit of History.
translation: 哦，好啊，我喜欢听点历史。

english: Very wise, a good knowledge of the History of Magic is crucial to understanding the Arcane.
translation: 非常明智，对魔法史的良好了解是理解奥术的关键。

english: Well, the most famous Gnomish Mage of all got into a bit of .... trouble.
translation: 嗯，最著名的地精法师遇到了一点……麻烦。

english: Most gnomes don't really talk about him. Other than telling stories about him as if he was some sort of boogie-man.
translation: 大多数地精都不怎么谈论他。除了把他当成某种怪物来编故事。

english: Ridiculous! He was a gnome like any other - he sounds like a fascinating character.
translation: 荒谬！他和任何其他地精一样——听起来是个很有趣的人物。

english: He was one of King Healthorg the Great's advisors during the Grand Migration. But he was exiled after the Goblin Wars.
translation: 他是伟大海尔索格国王在大迁徙期间的顾问之一。但在哥布林战争后被流放了。

english: Why was that?
translation: 为什么？

english: Well, I'm not really sure. This was all before I was born - and no-one talks about what happened to Glouphrie these days.
translation: 嗯，我也不太确定。这都是我出生前的事了——现在没人谈论格洛弗里到底发生了什么。

english: He must have done something very bad then.
translation: 那他一定做了什么非常坏的事。

english: Well, maybe? I'm not so sure. As it happens I've been looking into that part of our History. All I've managed to establish was that he was particularly interested in optics and light magic.
translation: 嗯，也许吧？我不太确定。事实上，我一直在研究我们历史的那一部分。我所能确定的只是他对光学和光魔法特别感兴趣。

english: It's hard to see what he could misuse light in a way that would get him exiled.
translation: 很难想象他会如何滥用光，以至于被流放。

english: Well, indeed. I have also found though he was generally disliked by other gnomes - his moniker was 'Glouphrie the Untrusted'.
translation: 嗯，确实。我还发现他普遍不受其他地精喜欢——他的绰号是‘不可信的格洛弗里’。

english: Oaknock the Engineer and Glouphrie didn't like each other either...
translation: 工程师奥克诺克和格洛弗里也互相看不顺眼……

english: Oaknock? I haven't heard of him before.
translation: 奥克诺克？我以前没听说过他。

english: Ah, Oaknock was an engineer and architect. Very famous. There are statues to him around the place - his reputation amongst gnomes is second only to King Healthorg himself. He built most of the Stronghold you know.
translation: 啊，奥克诺克是一位工程师兼建筑师。非常有名。到处都有他的雕像——他在地精中的声望仅次于海尔索格国王本人。你知道的，他建造了要塞的大部分。

english: Are you really interested in all of this? Do you want to see something interesting?
translation: 你真的对这些感兴趣吗？想看点有趣的东西吗？

english: Well, have a careful look around at everything in the next cave and come back and tell me what you find.
translation: 嗯，仔细看看隔壁洞穴里的所有东西，然后回来告诉我你发现了什么。

english: Errm, not right now. I'd better go.
translation: 呃，现在不行。我得走了。

english: Fine! Humans really do prefer to live their lives in ignorance...
translation: 好吧！人类果然宁愿活在无知中……

english: I'm more interested in your researches right now.
translation: 我现在对你的研究更感兴趣。

english: Gah! Young mages these days. No patience. No perseverance. Magic is not a toy or a shiny weapon you know! You cannot alter reality unless you understand it. And you cannot understand unless you search for the true causes of things. And history is a record of the causes of things.
translation: 啊！现在的年轻法师们。没有耐心。没有毅力。魔法可不是玩具或闪亮的武器，你知道！你无法改变现实，除非你理解它。而除非你探寻事物的真正原因，否则你无法理解。而历史就是事物原因的记录。

english: I stand corrected - tell me more.
translation: 我受教了——请再多说些。

english: Actually I'd better get going...
translation: 其实我最好还是走了……

english: Well, I'd better carry on with my research then..
translation: 好吧，那我继续我的研究了……

english: Err, maybe some other time.
translation: 呃，也许改天吧。

english: We were discussing gnome magic...
translation: 我们刚才在讨论地精魔法……

english: Ah, yes indeed. Well I do have a little mystery for you. Has your curiosity been piqued?
translation: 啊，确实。嗯，我确实有个小谜题给你。你的好奇心被勾起来了吗？

english: Actually, I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: 其实我现在有点忙。

english: Fine, wander blindly on then!
translation: 好吧，那就继续盲目地游荡吧！

english: I've had a look in the other room now.
translation: 我已经看过另一个房间了。

english: So? What did you find?
translation: 那么？你发现了什么？

english: There was a pit with a crystalline looking bowl in the centre.
translation: 那里有一个坑，中央有一个看起来像水晶的碗。

english: Indeed, sadly I know very little about that, it looks elven to me though...
translation: 确实，可惜我对那东西知之甚少，不过它看起来像是精灵的……

english: There is also a large strange looking machine...
translation: 还有一台巨大的、外形奇怪的机器……

english: That's right. It was built by Oaknock.
translation: 没错。那是奥克诺克建造的。

english: That room used to be Oaknock's workshop. I'd also recognise his style anywhere.
translation: 那个房间曾经是奥克诺克的工作室。他的风格我到哪里都认得出来。

english: I have no idea. But I do know someone who might.
translation: 我不知道。但我确实知道有个人可能知道。

english: There is one gnome left who knew Oaknock, and King Healthorg and Glouphrie for that matter...
translation: 还有一个地精认识奥克诺克，以及海尔索格国王和格洛弗里……

english: Who is that?
translation: 是谁？

english: Have a guess.
translation: 猜猜看。

english: Errm....
Well, King Narnode tells me you've already visited him...
translation: 嗯，纳诺德国王告诉我你已经拜访过他了……

english: Oh I know, you're talking about Hazelmere aren't you?
translation: 哦，我知道了，你说的是黑兹尔米尔，对吧？

english: Very good, young apprentice.
translation: 很好，年轻的学徒。

english: Didn't he help create the Grand Tree?
translation: 他不是帮助创造了大树家园吗？

english: That's right. He was the third advisor to King Healthorg, he found and tended to the Grand Tree.
translation: 没错。他是海尔索格国王的第三位顾问，他找到了大树家园并照料它。

english: If you are really interested in all of this, then could you do me a favour and visit Hazelmere for me? I've been meaning to go for a while, but I have responsibilities here - there's always someone who wants to use the Rune Essence mines.
translation: 如果你真的对这些感兴趣，能帮我个忙，替我去拜访一下黑兹尔米尔吗？我一直想去，但我在这里有责任——总有人想用符文精华矿。

english: Of course, I'd love to!
translation: 当然，我很乐意！

english: Good! Good!
translation: 好！好！

english: Wait a minute, am I going to have to translate everything he says using that dictionary again?
translation: 等一下，我是不是又得用那本字典翻译他说的每句话？

english: Ha! He's an old fashioned kind of gnome and doesn't like visitors much. But I'm sure he'll want to talk about the Old Days.
translation: 哈！他是个老派的地精，不太喜欢访客。但我肯定他会想聊聊过去的日子。

english: But he only speaks Ancient Gnomish!
translation: 但他只会说古代地精语！

english: That may be true, though he may just be faking it to deter visitors. Either way - he is a wise old gnome. If he really wants to talk to you I'm sure he'll find a way.
translation: 也许吧，不过他可能只是假装如此来吓跑访客。不管怎样——他是个睿智的老地精。如果他真想和你说话，我相信他会找到办法的。

english: Well alright, if you say so. What do you want me to ask him?
translation: 好吧，既然你这么说。你想让我问他什么？

english: Well ask him if he knows anything about Oaknock's machine. And anything you can find about Glouphrie would be very interesting, wouldn't you agree?
translation: 嗯，问问他是否知道奥克诺克的机器。还有，你能打听到的任何关于格洛弗里的事情都会很有趣，你同意吗？

english: Right then. I'd better be on my way. I'll be back soon.
translation: 那好吧。我该上路了。我很快回来。

english: So haven't you managed to have a chat with Hazelmere yet?
translation: 那么，你还没能和黑兹尔米尔聊上吗？

english: Not yet I'm afraid. Where do I find him again?
translation: 恐怕还没有。我该去哪里找他来着？

english: He has a hut in a small island east of Yanille. It has a lovely sea-view, I'm jealous. I love my cave, but it's not very picturesque.
translation: 他在亚尼勒城东边的一个小岛上有个小屋。那里有美丽的海景，我真羡慕。我喜欢我的洞穴，但风景不太如画。

english: Maybe you need some pictures. Though your pot plant adds something to ambiance of the place.
translation: 也许你需要一些画。不过你的盆栽植物确实给这个地方增添了一些氛围。

english: Oh, that's not my potplant. I think it was Oaknock's.
translation: 哦，那不是我的盆栽。我想是奥克诺克的。

english: Really? It's survived a long time. It must be a special pot plant.
translation: 真的吗？它存活了很长时间。一定是一盆特别的盆栽植物。

english: I suppose it must be. It shakes every now and again you know... I don't know why.
translation: 我想它一定是。它时不时会摇晃，你知道吗……我不知道为什么。

english: How very odd. Anyway, I'd better get on my way to Hazelmere... See you soon.
translation: 真奇怪。总之，我该去找黑兹尔米尔了……回头见。

english: Err, hello Hazelmere.
translation: 呃，你好，黑兹尔米尔。

english: Blah blah blah human. Sarko!
translation: 吧啦吧啦吧啦人类。萨尔科！

english: Brimstail has sent me to ask you some questions.
translation: 布林斯泰尔派我来问你一些问题。

english: Ha! Atarischeray! Blah blah mesi blah blah.
translation: 哈！阿塔里谢雷！吧啦吧啦梅西吧啦吧啦。

english: I have some questions about the old days. Brimstail has been filling me in about Gnomish History.
translation: 我有一些关于过去的问题。布林斯泰尔一直在给我讲地精历史。

english: Blah Brimstail blah blah human blah minahar!
translation: 吧啦布林斯泰尔吧啦吧啦人类吧啦米纳哈尔！

english: It sounds like a fascinating time. It also sounds like some important things happened then. Events that we shouldn't forget.
translation: 听起来那是一个迷人的时代。也听起来那时发生了一些重要的事情。我们不应该忘记的事件。

english: Hmmph. Laquinay blah human. Blah blah blah.
translation: 哼。拉基奈吧啦人类。吧啦吧啦吧啦。

english: He has also found a machine - he says it was built by Oaknock...
translation: 他还发现了一台机器——他说是奥克诺克建造的……

english: Oaknock! Ha blah blah minapor blah blah blah.
translation: 奥克诺克！哈吧啦吧啦米纳波尔吧啦吧啦吧啦。

english: Blah blah blah blah Oaknock blah blah blah.
translation: 吧啦吧啦吧啦吧啦奥克诺克吧啦吧啦吧啦。

english: Blah blah blah blah.
translation: 吧啦吧啦吧啦吧啦。

english: Blah blah blah blah Healthorg cinqo blah blah blah.
translation: 吧啦吧啦吧啦吧啦海尔索格辛科吧啦吧啦吧啦。

english: Erm, I'm sorry I don't understand a word you're saying.
translation: 呃，抱歉，我一个字都听不懂你在说什么。

english: *SIGH* Ipmesi human.
translation: *叹气* 伊普梅西人类。

english: ... ethereal link ... failed ... puny human mind ... insufficiently disciplined ... mental rigour required ... trained ... magical skills ...
translation: ……灵体链接……失败……弱小的人类心智……缺乏训练……需要精神严谨……训练……魔法技能……

english: Hmph. Not bad for a human.
translation: 哼。对人类来说不错了。

english: Weird! How are you doing this Hazelmere?
translation: 奇怪！你是怎么做到的，黑兹尔米尔？

english: Old magicks beyond your skill human. You can stop flapping your big human lips as well. Just think.
translation: 古老的魔法，超出你的技能，人类。你也可以停止扇动你那大嘴唇了。只要思考就行。

english: So how do I do this. Wow. That's impressive.  Brimstail was telling me that Gnomes don't trust Mages these days. Can you hear me? Glouphrie wasn't it? He did something bad and got exiled. Ooh, I'm feeling a little dizzy. You knew him didn't you? What can you tell me about him? And what's this machine that Oaknock built? Isn't that magical as well? Do you know what it does?
translation: 那我该怎么做。哇。真厉害。布林斯泰尔告诉我，如今地精不信任法师。你能听到我吗？格洛弗里，对吧？他做了坏事被流放了。哦，我有点头晕。你认识他，对吧？你能告诉我关于他的什么？还有奥克诺克建造的那台机器是什么？那难道不也是魔法吗？你知道它是做什么的吗？

english: Stop wittering on [player name]. You're giving me a headache.  This mind speech is hard enough without having to listen to your incoherent babbling. Think about nothing. Clear your mind.
translation: 别喋喋不休了，[player name]。你让我头疼。这心灵对话已经够难了，还要听你语无伦次的胡言乱语。什么都别想。清空你的思绪。

english: Clear my mind? Hey, how did you know my name.
translation: 清空思绪？嘿，你怎么知道我的名字。

english: I'm reading your mind foolish human. How do you think?  Now CLEAR YOUR MIND...
translation: 我在读你的心，愚蠢的人类。你以为呢？现在清空你的思绪……

english: How do I think about nothing? I'll give it a go.
translation: 我要怎么什么都不想？我试试看。

english: Hmm tasty lobster. Gah! I'm thinking about something. Stop thinking about Lobsters. Pink Lobsters. Big Lobsters. Lobsters with wings. Wings? Lobsters don't have wings. ARRGH. I can't do this.
translation: 嗯，美味的龙虾。啊！我在想东西。别再想龙虾了。粉红色的龙虾。大龙虾。有翅膀的龙虾。翅膀？龙虾没有翅膀。啊啊啊。我做不到。

english: Just shut up and listen! I have a story to tell you that will answer most of your questions.
translation: 闭嘴听我说！我有个故事要告诉你，能解答你大部分的问题。

english: Let us travel back in time, to the time you humans call the Fourth Age. King Healthorg had become King. The elves mysteriously decided to travel west, leaving most of Kandarin open for conquest. The humans weren't here yet, only King Healthorg and the gnomes to the north, and a collection of Goblin tribes to the south.
translation: 让我们回到过去，回到你们人类称为第四纪元的时代。海尔索格国王成为了国王。精灵们神秘地决定向西迁徙，留下了坎达林王国的大部分地区任人征服。人类那时还没来，只有北方的海尔索格国王和地精，以及南方的一群哥布林部落。

english: Both armies moved to claim the lands, and were of course destined to meet in battle...
translation: 两支军队都开始争夺这片土地，当然注定要在战场上相遇……

english: And so it came to pass the Goblins and Gnome armies met at the battle of Atarisundri.
translation: 于是，哥布林和地精军队在阿塔里桑德里战役中相遇了。

english: Both sides faced each other on the Battlefield. A bloody battle was in prospect, our gnomes were brave, but we were no match for the mass of brute goblin stupidity...
translation: 双方在战场上对峙。一场血战即将来临，我们的地精很勇敢，但我们无法匹敌那群野蛮哥布林的愚蠢力量……

english: ... but Glouphrie and King Healthorg had devised a plan...
translation: ……但格洛弗里和海尔索格国王制定了一个计划……

english: ... If you don't lead an invincible army - pretend you do...
translation: ……如果你没有一支无敌的军队——那就假装你有……

english: And so, Glouphrie created an army of illusory Giant tortoises, knowing that goblins would be scared of anything bigger than they were.
translation: 于是，格洛弗里创造了一支幻影巨龟大军，他知道哥布林会害怕任何比它们大的东西。

english: Big Boss didn' say nuffin 'bout de nomiez havin' monsta tortisses!
translation: 老大没说过地精有怪兽乌龟啊！

english: Dey be huges! Tortisses too scary and pointy. We runz away!
translation: 它们好大！乌龟太吓人，太尖了。我们快跑！

english: Scarey tortisses! Runz!
translation: 可怕的乌龟！快跑！

english: Runz away!
translation: 快跑！

english: Hey! Was that you next to the tortoise? You look so handsome!
translation: 嘿！乌龟旁边那个是你吗？你看起来真英俊！

english: Handsome! Hmph! That was a long time ago...
translation: 英俊！哼！那是很久以前的事了……

english: Anyway, where was I? Oh yes...
translation: 总之，我说到哪了？哦对了……

english: Sadly, the golden times were not destined to last for long...
translation: 可惜，黄金时代注定不会长久……

english: There was once a very special Spirit Tree in the Stronghold. Silver as a birch, old and wise - I considered him a friend. I called him Argento, his true name was unpronouncable.
translation: 要塞里曾经有一棵非常特别的灵魂树。像白桦一样银白，古老而睿智——我视他为朋友。我叫他阿根托，他的真名无法发音。

english: He was the first Spirit Tree I had befriended, and the one I knew the best. I would sometimes travel, visiting and finding other Spirit trees, and during one such trip, I was filled with a great sense of foreboding...
translation: 他是我结交的第一棵灵魂树，也是我最了解的一棵。我有时会旅行，拜访并寻找其他灵魂树。在一次这样的旅途中，我心中充满了强烈的不祥预感……

english: I felt a shadow pass over me, and a tingling in the air, even though the weather was fine and dry.
translation: 我感到一片阴影掠过，空气中传来一阵刺痛，尽管天气晴朗干燥。

english: Then I felt a sudden pain, as if the Anima Mundi was crying out with the loss of a favoured child...
translation: 然后我感到一阵突如其来的痛苦，仿佛世界之魂因失去一个宠儿而哭泣……

english: And I knew that one of the Old Ones had died, and I had lost a friend.
translation: 我知道一位古老者死了，我失去了一位朋友。

english: I rushed straight back to the Grand Tree, only to find that no-one had noticed anything, and that Argento was still standing and seemed alive. But I knew something was wrong. He refused to talk to me and his aura was
translation: 我立刻冲回大树家园，却发现没人注意到任何异常，阿根托仍然矗立着，看起来还活着。但我知道出事了。他拒绝和我说话，他的气场也

english: no longer present.  Someone had hidden his death.  I talked to Oaknock and he was incensed.  He immediately blamed Glouphrie, and although Oaknock could be rather irrational when it came to Glouphrie -
translation: 消失了。有人隐藏了他的死亡。我和奥克诺克谈了，他非常愤怒。他立刻指责格洛弗里，虽然奥克诺克在涉及格洛弗里时可能相当不理性——

english: they never saw eye to eye - I knew he was right this time.  Glouphrie had used his magicks to hide the truth from all of us.
translation: 他们从来意见不合——但我知道这次他是对的。格洛弗里用他的魔法向我们所有人隐藏了真相。

english: Oaknock had made a machine - an anti-illusion machine, with some help from the elves.  He prepared it, and summoned the advisors to Argento..
translation: 奥克诺克制造了一台机器——一台反幻象机器，在精灵的帮助下。他准备好了，并召集顾问们来到阿根托面前……

english: Why have you summoned us here?
translation: 你为什么召集我们来这里？

english: You'll see sire. Switch the machine on!
translation: 您会看到的，先生。打开机器！

english: What is the meaning of this?
translation: 这是什么意思？

english: The Silver Spirit Tree is dead!
translation: 银色灵魂树死了！

english: Glouphrie has been using his foul arts to mask the truth! What other secrets has he been keeping?
translation: 格洛弗里一直在用他邪恶的技艺掩盖真相！他还隐瞒了什么秘密？

english: Explain yourself!
translation: 解释清楚！

english: I live to serve you sire. I work for the good of us all.
translation: 我活着就是为了侍奉您，陛下。我为大家的利益而工作。

english: How can lying to your fellow gnomes be 'Good'?
translation: 对你的地精同胞撒谎怎么能算是‘利益’？

english: Some things are best kept secret...
translation: 有些事情最好保密……

english: Even from your King!?
translation: 连你的国王也要保密！？

english: Occasionally.
translation: 偶尔。

english: Enough! How can I trust a gnome who hides things from me?
translation: 够了！我怎么能信任一个对我隐瞒事情的地精？

english: No gnome can blame you for what you do not know.
translation: 没有地精会因为你不知道的事情而责怪你。

english: That is NOT how I rule.
translation: 那不是我的统治方式。

english: Glouphrie. You are no longer my advisor. Leave this place.
translation: 格洛弗里。你不再是我的顾问了。离开这里。

english: Only the naive believe they can rule without someone like me.
translation: 只有天真的人才会相信没有像我这样的人也能统治。

english: Your empire will crack and the gnomes will become but a joke.
translation: 你的帝国将会崩溃，地精们只会成为一个笑话。

english: So be it. I'll be watching.
translation: 那就这样吧。我会看着的。

english: And so Glouphrie left and travelled with some companions to a place they called Arposandra. We have heard nothing but rumours about them since...
translation: 于是格洛弗里离开了，和一些同伴去了一个他们称为阿波桑德拉的地方。从那以后，我们只听到关于他们的传闻……

english: So where's this Arposandra place anyway?
translation: 那么，这个阿波桑德拉到底在哪里？

english: Nobody knows for certain, somewhere rocky I suppose. The rumour is that after founding his new home, Glouphrie used his magicks to shroud the city in mist. Arposandra may not exist at all, however I suspect that
translation: 没人确切知道，我想是在某个多岩石的地方。传闻说，在建立他的新家后，格洛弗里用他的魔法用雾笼罩了这座城市。阿尔波桑德拉可能根本不存在，不过我怀疑

english: Glouphrie is still around, one way or another.
translation: 格洛弗里还在，以某种方式。

english: Why do you think that?
translation: 你为什么这么想？

english: Just call it Gnomish intuition.
translation: 就当作是地精的直觉吧。

english: So the machine that Brimstail has found is the one that Oaknock built to stop Glouphrie's illusions.  Do you know how it worked?
translation: 所以布林斯泰尔找到的那台机器就是奥克诺克制造来阻止格洛弗里幻象的那台。你知道它是怎么运作的吗？

english: I never studied it, but I believe it used elven magic - So it must have used crystals of some sort. Crystal discs, yes that sounds familiar.  Actually come to think of it I think I may have one lying around.  Here take
translation: 我从未研究过它，但我相信它使用了精灵魔法——所以它一定用了某种水晶。水晶盘，对，听起来很耳熟。实际上，我想起来我可能有一个放在某处。给你，拿着

english: this, maybe it will help you.
translation: 这个，也许能帮到你。

english: Well, thank you, Hazelmere. You've told me a lot of things I need to ponder for a while.
translation: 嗯，谢谢你，黑兹尔米尔。你告诉了我很多事情，我需要好好想想。

english: Very well. Oh and when you see that lazy toad Brimstail, tell him next time he needs information to come himself.
translation: 很好。哦，等你见到那个懒蛤蟆布林斯泰尔，告诉他下次需要信息就自己来。

english: I'll do that. Farewell.
translation: 我会的。再见。

english: What do you want now? Go and talk to Brimstail, that's why you came to see me in the first place...
translation: 你现在想要什么？去找布林斯泰尔谈吧，你一开始来找我就是为了这个……

english: Oh yes...
translation: 哦对……

english: I've visited Hazelmere, he told me all sorts of interesting things.
translation: 我去见了黑兹尔米尔，他告诉了我各种有趣的事情。

english: Ah, thank you my young apprentice. What did he tell you?
translation: 啊，谢谢你，我的年轻学徒。他告诉了你什么？

english: Right. Well it starts during the Great Migration...
translation: 好的。嗯，故事从大迁徙开始……

english: So the machine emits an anti-illusion glamour?
translation: 所以那台机器会发出反幻象的魔力？

english: Glamour? What's that?
translation: 魔力？那是什么？

english: Don't you know anything? *sigh* A glamour is a type of enchantment or magical effect.
translation: 你什么都不知道吗？*叹气* 魔力是一种附魔或魔法效果。

english: Oh yes it does have such a glamour. It seems to use crystal discs to work in some way.
translation: 哦对，它确实有这种魔力。它似乎以某种方式使用水晶盘来运作。

english: Oh, crystal discs? I may have a few of those in a drawer somewhere.
translation: 哦，水晶盘？我可能在某处抽屉里有一些。

english: What's that? Something just moved behind you...
translation: 那是什么？你身后好像有什么东西动了一下……

english: Really? Wait - what's that banging noise?
translation: 真的吗？等等——那砰砰声是什么？

english: What's happened to the machine? It's broken!
translation: 机器怎么了？它坏了！

english: Hmm, something is afoot.  I sense sabotage....
translation: 嗯，有点不对劲。我感觉到有破坏行为……

english: The machine is broken, I suspect sabotage...!
translation: 机器坏了，我怀疑是有人破坏……！

english: This is intolerable! How could this happen?
translation: 这简直无法容忍！怎么会这样？

english: I'm confused, it must have happened while we were here talking!
translation: 我很困惑，一定是在我们谈话的时候发生的！

english: But we were just standing here, how could someone get past us?
translation: 但我们一直站在这里，怎么可能有人从我们身边过去？

english: I did see something odd behind you...
translation: 我确实看到你身后有个奇怪的东西……

english: Wait a minute, how did the saboteur know about the machine?
translation: 等等，破坏者是怎么知道这台机器的？

english: Hmmm ... You're the only person I've told about the machine...
translation: 嗯……你是唯一一个我告诉过这台机器的人……

english: Hey! Don't look at me like that. The only person I've talked to is Hazelmere.
translation: 嘿！别那样看着我。我唯一谈过话的人就是黑兹尔米尔。

english: Surely this couldn't be the work of Hazelmere... That turncoat!!
translation: 这肯定不可能是黑兹尔米尔干的……那个叛徒！！

english: Wait! Wait! None of this makes any sense. There must be another explanation.
translation: 等等！等等！这完全说不通。肯定另有解释。

english: Alright. Someone snuck in here without us noticing. How?
translation: 好吧。有人在我们没注意的时候溜了进来。怎么做到的？

english: The intruder must have been invisible.
translation: 入侵者一定是隐形的。

english: Right, and how does one make oneself invisible?
translation: 对，那怎么让自己隐形呢？

english: Of course! I've seen this before. Karam in the 10th squad used some sort of magic to make himself invisible.
translation: 当然！我以前见过这个。第十小队的卡拉姆用了某种魔法让自己隐形。

english: Do you think the 10th squad did this?
translation: 你觉得是第十小队干的？

english: No, but I think our saboteur must have learnt the same magicks. Is Glouphrie still alive?
translation: 不，但我认为我们的破坏者一定学了同样的魔法。格洛弗里还活着吗？

english: Illusion magic?
translation: 幻象魔法？

english: Invisibility is a form of illusion magic. So that makes sense...
translation: 隐形是幻象魔法的一种形式。所以这说得通……

english: So this was done by Glouphrie? Is he still alive?
translation: 所以这是格洛弗里干的？他还活着吗？

english: Who knows, but he may well have taught the skills to his gnomes.
translation: 谁知道呢，但他很可能把这些技能教给了他的地精。

english: You mean the gnomes that went with Glouphrie to Arposandra?
translation: 你是说那些和格洛弗里一起去阿波桑德拉的地精？

english: Right. And why would they sabotage an anti-illusion device?
translation: 对。那他们为什么要破坏一个反幻象装置？

english: Because there is an illusion that they want to remain hidden?
translation: 因为有一个他们想隐藏的幻象？

english: Of course. Which makes it imperative that we fix this machine and find out what it is!
translation: 当然。所以我们必须修好这台机器，找出那是什么！

english: Have a look at the machine and assess the damage. I'll hunt around my boxes and see if I can find anything that might help.
translation: 看看机器，评估一下损坏情况。我在我的盒子里翻翻，看看能不能找到什么有用的东西。

english: Have you had a look at the damage yet?
translation: 你检查过损坏情况了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll get right to it.
translation: 还没呢。我马上去办。

english: So how are your investigations going?
translation: 那么你的调查进展如何？

english: I'm not getting anywhere with these 'sticky runes'.
translation: 这些“黏性符文”我一点头绪都没有。

english: Hmmm, which runes would you think are sticky.
translation: 嗯，你觉得哪些符文会是黏性的呢？

english: Runes are runes! None of them are sticky! They're all round and disc-like and definitely non-adhesive.
translation: 符文就是符文！没有哪个是黏的！它们都是圆圆的、像圆盘一样，绝对没有黏性。

english: Open your mind and think laterally. Thinking sideways is an important skill for a mage.
translation: 打开你的思维，横向思考。横向思考是法师的重要技能。

english: Oh, all right. I'll give it a go. Well - air, water and fire and earth runes. There's nothing sticky about them.
translation: 哦，好吧。我试试看。嗯——空气、水、火和土符文。它们一点都不黏。

english: I concur.
translation: 我同意。

english: Mind and body runes. Again distinctly non-glue-like in any way.
translation: 精神和身体符文。同样，完全没有任何胶水般的特性。

english: Keep going.
translation: 继续。

english: Nature and Cosmic runes. Once more distinctly lacking in any gooeyness. Bah! This is a waste of time.
translation: 自然和宇宙符文。同样明显缺乏任何黏糊糊的感觉。呸！真是浪费时间。

english: Patience young apprentice. You are on the right path - just think it through and I'm sure it will become obvious.
translation: 耐心点，年轻的学徒。你走在正确的道路上——只要仔细想想，我相信答案会显而易见的。

english: Maybe. What do I do with the rune when I find it?
translation: 也许吧。我找到符文后该怎么处理？

english: What did Oaknock do?
translation: 奥克诺克是怎么做的？

english: Well it looked powdered in the glue.
translation: 嗯，它在胶水里看起来像是粉末状的。

english: So there you go. What more do you need to know?
translation: 那就对了。你还需要知道什么？

english: Well, I'm still a bit unsure about getting this glue.
translation: 嗯，我对弄到这种胶水还是有点不确定。

english: So, what do you know so far?
translation: 那么，你目前知道些什么？

english: It looked ambery in colour and sticky, smelt of pine and had flecks of silvery stuff in it.
translation: 它看起来是琥珀色的，黏黏的，闻起来有松树的味道，里面还有银色的小碎片。

english: It smelt of pine and was ambery in colour, that sounds like tree sap. From a coniferous tree probably.
translation: 闻起来有松树味，颜色是琥珀色，听起来像是树汁。可能来自针叶树。

english: Tree sap?
translation: 树汁？

english: Have you never tried cutting a coniferous tree and watching the sap drip out?
translation: 你难道没试过砍一棵针叶树，看着树液滴出来吗？

english: Err no.
translation: 呃，没有。

english: Well maybe if you had, you'd know something about tree sap!
translation: 嗯，也许如果你试过，你就会对树汁有所了解了！

english: So where do I put the stuff?
translation: 那么我把东西放在哪里？

english: Hmmm, use your head! What kind of substance is this tree sap?
translation: 嗯，动动脑子！这种树汁是什么类型的物质？

english: Is it a solid, a liquid or a gas?
translation: 是固体、液体还是气体？

english: Oh, I see - a liquid I suppose.
translation: 哦，我明白了——我想是液体。

english: So where do you put liquids?
translation: 那么你把液体放在哪里？

english: Some form of container?
translation: 某种容器？

english: Right! I think you know everything you need now...
translation: 没错！我想你现在已经知道你需要的一切了……

english: Right. I'll go away and think about what you've said.
translation: 好的。我回去想想你说的话。

english: That's right, use your noddle, exercise your noggin, employ your cranium. Think, think, think!
translation: 没错，用用你的脑袋，锻炼你的脑筋，动动你的脑壳。想，想，想！

english: Now you're just confusing me more...
translation: 你现在只是把我搞得更糊涂了……

english: I think I've fixed the machine now!
translation: 我想我已经修好机器了！

english: Well done! You're almost as good at fixing things as a gnome! Who'd have thought?
translation: 干得好！你修理东西的本事都快赶上地精了！谁能想到呢？

english: Though I still don't think it's actually activated. There appears to be some sort of lock on the front. I think I know what the discs are for though. There's a slot in the front that looks like it might fit a disc, and a
translation: 不过我还是觉得它实际上没有被激活。前面似乎有一种锁。我想我知道那些圆盘是干什么用的了。前面有一个插槽，看起来可能能放一个圆盘，还有一个

english: number.
translation: 数字。

english: So what do you think the number means?
translation: 那么你觉得这个数字是什么意思？

english: I'm not sure yet. Maybe I should put a disc into the slot and see what happens?
translation: 我还不确定。也许我应该把一个圆盘放进插槽里看看会发生什么？

english: That reminds me, I found those crystal discs I mentioned before.
translation: 这提醒了我，我找到了之前提到过的那些水晶圆盘。

english: They are not quite the same as the one Hazelmere gave you, but they look similar in size and weight.
translation: 它们和黑兹尔米尔给你的那个不太一样，但大小和重量看起来差不多。

english: They also look as if they might fit in the slots on both of the machines. Maybe I should try it out?
translation: 它们看起来也像是能放进两台机器的插槽里。也许我应该试试？

english: I wonder if the different sizes and shapes mean anything.
translation: 我想知道不同的尺寸和形状是否有什么含义。

english: I've been thinking that as well, I shall ponder it some more.. I'll work it out.
translation: 我也一直在想这个问题，我会再琢磨琢磨……我会弄明白的。

english: That's the spirit! This is all good training for the mind...
translation: 这就对了！这都是对头脑很好的训练……

english: Hmmm. Maybe all of these discs all have different values and you have to choose the right one in order for it to work?
translation: 嗯。也许所有这些圆盘都有不同的数值，你必须选对才能让它工作？

english: Interesting. But how do I work out which discs are worth what value?
translation: 有意思。但我怎么知道哪些圆盘值多少数值呢？

english: I'm not sure, but there will be some logic somewhere. Maybe if you look around the workshop you'll find some clues?
translation: 我不确定，但肯定有某种逻辑。也许你在工作室里四处看看能找到一些线索？

english: Oh, I've been rooting through my drawers and I've found a few more discs that you might find useful.
translation: 哦，我翻了我的抽屉柜，又找到了几个圆盘，可能对你有用。

english: Thanks, I'm sure they'll be very useful.
translation: 谢谢，我相信它们会很有用的。

english: I seem to have opened some sort of control panel.
translation: 我好像打开了一个控制面板。

english: I wonder how it works? a similar way to the locking mechanism I'd guess.
translation: 我想知道它是怎么工作的？我猜和锁定机制类似。

english: There seems to be more than one slot. Maybe I need more than one disc?
translation: 似乎不止一个插槽。也许我需要不止一个圆盘？

english: Huzzah! It's working!
translation: 万岁！它开始工作了！

english: Well done [player name]! I knew you'd work it out. I'll make a mage out of you yet...
translation: 干得好，[player name]！我就知道你能弄明白。总有一天我会把你培养成法师的……

english: Wait... What's happening... Eek!
translation: 等等……发生什么事了……伊克！

english: What on earth!?
translation: 这到底是怎么回事！？

english: Izzie! No! There's something very wrong going on here...
translation: 伊兹！不！这里出了大问题……

english: Phew! I've got that machine working now. What do I need to do now?
translation: 呼！我已经让那台机器运转起来了。我现在需要做什么？

english: Well, it seems that Izzie was not so cute after all! How awful! How mysterious!
translation: 嗯，看来伊兹毕竟没那么可爱！太可怕了！太神秘了！

english: So this was an illusion the Arposandrans went to so much effort to conceal? A pet. That wasn't cute enough.
translation: 所以这就是阿波桑德兰人费尽心机隐藏的幻象？一只宠物。还不够可爱。

english: Where did you find this one?
