translation: 你是在哪里找到这只的？

english: Izzie just wandered into my cave. He was cute and friendly so I kept him.
translation: 伊兹自己溜进了我的洞穴。它又可爱又友好，我就留下了它。

english: He seemed very curious, and used to watch me do my researches. I liked the companionship – research is lonely work...
translation: 它似乎很好奇，经常看我做研究。我喜欢有伴——研究是孤独的工作……

english: So he's been keeping an eye on you while you do important magical research...
translation: 所以它一直在监视你进行重要的魔法研究……

english: I suppose it has. I hadn't thought of it like that. I'm sure I've seen others of these creatures around the place...
translation: 我想是的。我之前没这么想过。我肯定在附近见过其他这种生物……

english: I think King Narnode has one, and I think I saw one by the gates. And I'm sure I've seen a few more wandering around.
translation: 我想国王纳诺德有一只，而且我好像在大门那里见过一只。我还肯定见过几只到处游荡。

english: In other words all places to keep an eye on what's going in the Stronghold...
translation: 换句话说，都是能监视要塞里动静的地方……

english: Oh my goodness. I think I'm beginning to understand where you are going with this.
translation: 哦，天哪。我想我开始明白你的意思了。

english: Yes, they must be spies. They are watching us with those creepy red eyes. And they must have told someone that we were working on the machine.
translation: 是的，它们一定是间谍。它们用那双 creepy 的红眼睛监视我们。而且它们肯定告诉了别人我们在修机器。

english: So that horrible thing was listening to us all along. You'd better tell the King what's going on.
translation: 所以那个可怕的东西一直在偷听我们。你最好去告诉国王发生了什么。

english: So this horrible thing is listening to us right now... Aargh. Get rid of it! Don't forget to tell the king what's going on!
translation: 所以这个可怕的东西现在正在偷听我们……啊！把它弄走！别忘了告诉国王发生了什么！

english: I'll get on it now.
translation: 我马上去办。

english: What should we do about these creatures?
translation: 我们该怎么处理这些生物？

english: Have you talked to the King yet?
translation: 你和国王谈过了吗？

english: Good day sire, I take it you've noticed that cute creature you had in here is looking rather different now.
translation: 日安，陛下。我想您已经注意到您这里那只可爱生物现在看起来大不相同了。

english: Why yes! Do you know what's going on?
translation: 是啊！你知道是怎么回事吗？

english: I think I do. It's a long story but the short version is this. The Arposandran gnomes have planted these creatures as spies to watch what's going on in the Stronghold.
translation: 我想我知道。说来话长，但简而言之是这样的。阿波桑德兰地精们把这些生物当作间谍安插进来，监视要塞里的一举一动。

english: What!? That's outrageous!
translation: 什么！？这太离谱了！

english: I have just reactivated a machine that was built by Oaknock that dispels illusions, and now these creaturestrue forms are revealed.
translation: 我刚刚重新激活了奥克诺克建造的一台能驱散幻象的机器，现在这些生物的真实形态就显现出来了。

english: Glouphrie! Now we know what he has been up to all these years. Gah! Never trust a Mage.
translation: 格洛弗里！现在我们终于知道他这些年都在搞什么鬼了。啊！永远别相信法师。

english: Well, I wouldn't go as far as that – it is only through Brimstail's and my researches that we have established this is going on.
translation: 嗯，我不会说得那么绝对——正是通过布林斯泰尔和我的研究，我们才发现了这件事。

english: Harumph! Well, all of these creatures must be removed, we cannot allow the Arposandrans to spy on us any more. How many of these things are there?
translation: 哼！好吧，所有这些生物都必须清除，我们不能让阿波桑德兰人再监视我们了。这种东西有多少？

english: I don't know sire.
translation: 我不知道，陛下。

english: Well find them all and dispatch them now.
translation: 那就把它们全部找出来，立刻处理掉。

english: I'm right on it.
translation: 我马上去办。

english: Have you found all of those spies yet?
translation: 你找到所有那些间谍了吗？

english: Not yet, I'm still looking for them.
translation: 还没，我还在找。

english: That's a relief. Well, that's all good work, but I think you'd better inform the King now.
translation: 那就放心了。嗯，干得不错，但我想你最好现在去通知国王。

english: I think so. There were six in total.
translation: 我想是的。总共有六只。

english: Thank goodness. Thank you for your help. Brimstail also tells me that you helped him a lot finding out what was going on!
translation: 谢天谢地。谢谢你的帮助。布林斯泰尔也告诉我，你在查明真相的过程中帮了他很多忙！

english: Help? I did all of the hard work!
translation: 帮忙？所有苦活都是我干的！

english: Aha! Getting others to do the donkey work seems to be a skill that Mages develop well.
translation: 啊哈！让别人干苦力似乎是法师们擅长培养的技能。

english: So what will you do now?
translation: 那你现在打算怎么办？

english: Well, I have many things to think about. Why are the Arposandrans spying on us, and what are they planning?
translation: 嗯，我有很多事情要考虑。为什么阿波桑德兰人要监视我们，他们在计划什么？

english: It's certainly worrying, and whoever sabotaged the machine couldn't have been far from here. Are there gnomes here who are also spies?
translation: 这确实令人担忧，而且破坏机器的人肯定离这里不远。这里有没有地精也是间谍？

english: Indeed, that is another thing that worries me...
translation: 确实，这是另一件让我担心的事……

english: If you find out more I'd be willing to help investigate.
translation: 如果你发现更多线索，我愿意帮忙调查。

english: That may well be useful. Thank you – I may well call for your help again.
translation: 那可能会很有用。谢谢你——我可能还会再请你帮忙的。

english: Oh, before you leave – I have something you might like.
translation: 哦，在你离开之前——我有样东西你可能会喜欢。

english: It was passed down to me from King to King. It belonged to Oaknock. He proclaimed that only a hero of the gnomes should have it. I think you count as a hero. Also since you have been looking into Oaknock you
translation: 这是国王代代相传给我的。它属于橡木敲。他宣称只有地精族的英雄才配拥有它。我认为你算得上英雄。而且既然你一直在研究橡木敲，

english: might be able to work out what it is.
translation: 也许你能弄清楚它是什么。

english: Hmm I wonder what it does?
translation: 嗯，我想知道它是做什么的？

english: Well, I'm sure that your magical research skills will help you there. Good luck!
translation: 嗯，我相信你的魔法研究技能会帮到你的。祝你好运！

english: Good day and welcome back to Al Kharid.
translation: 日安，欢迎回到阿尔卡里德城。

english: My name is Ali Morrisane - the greatest salesman in the world.
translation: 我叫阿里.莫里桑——全世界最伟大的推销员。

english: If you're the greatest salesman in the world, why are you still selling goods from a stall?
translation: 如果你是世界上最伟大的销售员，为什么还在摊位上卖东西？

english: Well one can only do and sell so much. If I had more staff I'd be able to sell more, rather than wasting my time on menial things. I could get on with selling sand to the Bedabin and useless tourist trinkets to just about
translation: 嗯，一个人能做的和能卖的也就这么多。如果我有更多员工，我就能卖得更多，而不是把时间浪费在琐事上。我就可以继续把沙子卖给贝达宾人，把没用的旅游纪念品卖给几乎

english: everyone else.
translation: 其他所有人了。

english: I'm too busy to help. Adventuring is a full time job you know!
translation: 我太忙了，帮不了你。冒险可是份全职工作，你知道吗！

english: No problem my friend, perhaps another time.
translation: 没关系，我的朋友，下次再说吧。

english: Anyway, have a look at my wares.
translation: 总之，看看我的货吧。

english: I'd like to help you but...
translation: 我很想帮你，但是……

english: Yes, I know, I know - the life of a shop keeper isn't slaying dragons and wooing damsels, but it has its charms.
translation: 是的，我知道，我知道——店主的生活不是屠龙和追求少女，但它自有其魅力。

english: Although perhaps you can help me some other way. A nephew of mine lives not too far from here in a little town called Pollnivneach. He was supposed to become my assistant, but he hasn't shown up. If you fetch him
translation: 不过，也许你可以用其他方式帮我。我有个侄子，就住在这附近一个叫波尼尼镇的小镇上。他本该来当我的助理，但一直没出现。如果你能把他带

english: here I'll give you the first month of his salary!
translation: 到这里来，我就把他第一个月的薪水给你！

english: I'll find your nephew.
translation: 我会找到你侄子的。

english: But you had better become the greatest merchant in Gielinor once I succeed!
translation: 但等我成功后，你最好能成为吉莱诺最伟大的商人！

english: Ah, many thanks, my friend. My nephew's name is Ali and he lives to the south in a town called Pollnivneach.
translation: 啊，多谢了，我的朋友。我侄子也叫阿里，他住在南边一个叫波尼尼镇的小镇上。

english: Tell him his uncle Ali M needs his help up in Al Kharid.
translation: 告诉他，他叔叔阿里.莫里桑在阿尔卡里德城需要他的帮助。

english: And while you're here, have a look at my wares.
translation: 既然你来了，顺便看看我的货吧。

english: I sent you to learn the whereabouts of my nephew, Ali. Is there any word of him in Pollnivneach?
translation: 我派你去打听我侄子阿里的下落。波尼尼镇那边有他的消息吗？

english: That's not really the news I was hoping for.
translation: 这可不是我希望听到的消息。

english: But since you've been gone trade has gotten even busier. Will you have a look at my wares?
translation: 不过你不在的这段时间，生意更忙了。要不要看看我的货？

english: I'm looking for someone called Ali.
translation: 我在找一个叫阿里的人。

english: Well, take your pick!
translation: 嗯，随便挑！

english: I mean I'm looking for a specific Ali. He's Ali Morrisane's nephew.
translation: 我是说我在找一个特定的阿里。他是阿里.莫里桑的侄子。

english: Oh, that Ali! Well, er, your best bet is to ask around town. I'm sure someone will know what he's up to.
translation: 哦，那个阿里啊！嗯，呃，你最好在镇上四处打听一下。肯定有人知道他在干什么。

english: No, but thanks for your time.
translation: 不了，谢谢你的时间。

english: Are those camels around the side for sale?
translation: 旁边那些骆驼卖吗？

english: Those two camels around the side are already sold.
translation: 旁边那两头骆驼已经卖出去了。

english: I've got new stock coming very soon though. Come back later if you're still interested.
translation: 不过我很快就会有新货。如果你还有兴趣，过段时间再来吧。

english: Well, you've found your man.
translation: 嗯，你找对人了。

english: Really? Do you have an uncle called Ali?
translation: 真的吗？你有个叔叔叫阿里？

english: Why yes - all my uncles are called Ali!
translation: 是啊——我所有的叔叔都叫阿里！

english: Oh dear! Do any of them own a stall in the Al Kharid Bazaar?
translation: 哦天哪！他们中有人在阿尔卡里德城的集市拥有摊位吗？

english: Well no, but one of them owns a moderately successful camel hire franchise.
translation: 嗯，没有，但其中有一个经营着一家还算成功的骆驼租赁特许经营店。

english: Have you considered hiring a camel? Or perhaps purchasing one of your own? I can get you a discount.
translation: 你考虑过租一头骆驼吗？或者自己买一头？我可以给你打个折。

english: Hold on... yes I can place him now. He has me looking for his nephew Ali, I think he needs some help with his shop.
translation: 等等……我现在想起来了。他让我找他的侄子阿里，我想他需要有人帮忙打理店铺。

english: I wouldn't be surprised, he's mentioned to me on a few occasions that he is thinking of diversifying even further.
translation: 我不意外，他跟我提过几次，说想进一步拓展业务。

english: You wouldn't have seen his nephew about then?
translation: 那你最近没见过他的侄子吗？

english: No it's been a quite a while since I last saw him.
translation: 没有，我上次见他已经是挺久以前的事了。

english: What do you want? Information?
translation: 你想要什么？情报？

english: What would you know?
translation: 你知道些什么？

english: No one knows what's going on in the streets better than me. I live, sleep, eat and drink here. The fact that I'm so small means that people tend to ignore me which helps even more.
translation: 没人比我更清楚街上发生的事。我在这里生活、睡觉、吃喝。我个子小，人们容易忽略我，这反而更有帮助。

english: Tell me about Ali Morrisane's nephew.
translation: 跟我说说阿里.莫里桑的侄子。

english: I know him! He used to kick us when he caught any of us stealing from his stall.
translation: 我认识他！以前我们从他摊位上偷东西，被他抓到的话，他会踢我们。

english: Do you know where he is now then?
translation: 那你知道他现在在哪儿吗？

english: He disappeared a little while ago. All I know is it had something to do with the gangs. Probably he scammed them. You'd have to gain their trust to find out more, m'afraid - if I get too close, they might disappear me
translation: 他不久前失踪了。我只知道跟那些帮派有关。可能是他骗了他们。恐怕你得先取得他们的信任才能知道更多——我要是靠太近，他们可能也会让我消失。

english: Ahh, a kind stranger. Get this old man a drink so that he may wet his throat and tell you of the strange happenings in this town.
translation: 啊，好心的陌生人。给这老头弄杯喝的润润嗓子，我就告诉你镇上发生的怪事。

english: Now where were we? Ah yes, Ali Morrisane's wayward nephew.
translation: 我们说到哪儿了？啊对了，阿里.莫里桑那个不听话的侄子。

english: What?! How did you know that's who I was looking for?
translation: 什么？！你怎么知道我在找他？

english: Er... well, he's a real scamp, that lad! I can't imagine a stranger would be asking after anyone else.
translation: 呃……嗯，那小子可是个捣蛋鬼！我想不出还会有哪个陌生人会打听别人。

english: Hmm. Well go on then, where is he?
translation: 嗯。那接着说，他在哪儿？

english: I'd tell you more, but my throat is drying up. This desert climate is an inhospitable one. Get me another beer so that I can continue my tale.
translation: 我倒是想多说点，可嗓子又干了。这沙漠气候真不养人。再给我弄杯啤酒，我才能继续讲下去。

english: Get this poor, thirsty old man another drink so that he may wet his lips and continue.
translation: 给这个可怜又口渴的老头再弄杯喝的，让他润润嘴唇继续说。

english: You are too kind, now what were we talking about?
translation: 你太客气了，我们刚才说到哪儿了？

english: Ali Morrisane's nephew.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑的侄子。

english: Of course! I've known him since he was a wee lad. A right little mischievous beggar...
translation: 当然！我从小就认识他。真是个调皮的小乞丐...

english: Yes, I can imagine. Do you have any more recent information about him? Where is he?
translation: 嗯，我能想象。你有他最近的消息吗？他在哪儿？

english: Well now, if you had just asked me that in the first place I would have told you directly!
translation: 哎呀，你要是早这么直接问，我早就直接告诉你了！

english: You're right, I'm sorry for beating around the bush. Do you know where Ali's nephew is now, though?
translation: 你说得对，抱歉我拐弯抹角的。那你知道阿里的侄子现在在哪儿吗？

english: Alas, my throat has dried up, and I cannot speak... perhaps another drink would help?
translation: 唉，我嗓子又干了，说不出话来……也许再来一杯能好点？

english: Ahh, that hits the spot.
translation: 啊，真过瘾。

english: Now which of you two adventurers wanted to know where Ali's nephew is?
translation: 现在你们两位冒险者中，是谁想知道阿里的侄子在哪儿？

english: I think you're seeing double.
translation: 我看你是喝花眼了。

english: Is this a double? No wonder I feel sick...
translation: 这是双份的吗？难怪我觉得恶心……

english: Look, all I want to know is the whereabouts of Ali Morrisane's nephew.
translation: 听着，我只想知道阿里.莫里桑的侄子在哪儿。

english: Now is that his nephew from his side or his wife's? They have a huge family you see. I remember...
translation: 那是他这边的侄子还是他老婆那边的？他们家可大了。我记得……

english: No, no, no. Stop right there. You are not going to fool me into buying you another beer without first giving me some useful information.
translation: 不不不，打住。你不先给我点有用的信息，别想再骗我买啤酒给你。

english: But my lips are so dry, how can I possibly continue?
translation: 可我嘴唇这么干，怎么继续说下去？

english: Well if your lips are dry, I'll have to wring you like a wet cloth and squeeze out enough booze to fill another tankard. I'd reckon it would hurt though.
translation: 好吧，如果你的嘴唇干了，我就得把你像湿布一样拧干，挤出足够装满另一个酒杯的酒。不过我想那会很疼。

english: I see. Don't worry about me, I'll just have to soldier on. Now what do you want to know?
translation: 我明白了。别担心我，我只好坚持下去。现在你想知道什么？

english: For the last time, where is Ali Morrisane's nephew?
translation: 最后问一次，阿里.莫里桑的侄子在哪儿？

english: Oh, I don't know.
translation: 哦，我不知道。

english: Seriously?
translation: 真的？

english: Wait, wait! The last I heard he was in trouble with those gangs hanging around town. You won't get any answers out of them, though, not while they're feuding. Maybe if you were to solve that little problem...
translation: 等等，等等！我最后听说他惹上了镇上那些帮派的麻烦。不过他们正在内斗，你从他们嘴里问不出什么。也许你要是能解决那个小问题……

english: Anyway, is there any chance of another beer?
translation: 总之，还能再来杯啤酒吗？

english: I am trying to get to the bottom of this feud between you and the Menaphites.
translation: 我想弄清楚你们和梅纳菲特人之间的这场世仇。

english: I'm just trying to understand why thieves of your repute would stoop to their level.
translation: 我只是想弄明白，像你们这样有头有脸的盗贼，怎么会沦落到和他们一个档次。

english: Well, if memory serves me correctly, I think the hostilities began when they robbed one of our camels. A heinous crime.
translation: 嗯，如果我没记错的话，冲突是从他们抢了我们一头骆驼开始的。真是十恶不赦。

english: So if they offered a camel back as a gesture of goodwill, would you and the rest of the bandits cease your hostilities?
translation: 那如果他们归还一头骆驼作为善意之举，你和你的强盗同伙会停止敌对吗？

english: Those Menaphites would never do that. They have no sense of honour.
translation: 那些梅纳菲特人绝不会那么做。他们毫无荣誉感。

english: But if they did?
translation: 但如果他们真这么做了呢？

english: I am trying to figure out the feud that exists between you and the Menaphites.
translation: 我想弄清楚你们和梅纳菲特人之间的世仇。

english: Nothing much, I'm trying to understand why thieves of your repute would stoop to the level of the Menaphites.
translation: 没什么大不了的，我只是想弄明白，像你们这样有头有脸的盗贼，怎么会沦落到和梅纳菲特人一个档次。

english: Well if memory serves me correctly. I think my granddad mentioned that they robbed one of our camels. A heinous crime.
translation: 嗯，如果我没记错的话，我记得我爷爷提过，他们抢了我们一头骆驼。真是十恶不赦。

english: So if they offered a camel as a gesture of goodwill would you and the rest of the bandits cease your hostilities?
translation: 那如果他们归还一头骆驼作为善意之举，你和你的强盗同伙会停止敌对吗？

english: I am trying to figure out the feud that exists between you and the Bandits.
translation: 我想弄清楚你们和强盗之间的世仇。

english: Not much to figure out there, the problem is those thieving bandits.
translation: 没什么好琢磨的，问题就是那些偷窃的强盗。

english: They are always stealing, starting fights and disrupting the lives of the townsfolk.
translation: 他们总是偷东西、打架、扰乱镇民的生活。

english: Word has it that the Menaphites are also involved in unsavoury behaviour.
translation: 有传言说梅纳菲特人也干些不光彩的事。

english: Well, we also steal, start fights, and disrupt lives - but we do it with class! And the bandits definitely started it.
translation: 嗯，我们也偷东西、打架、扰乱生活——但我们做得有格调！而且绝对是强盗先挑起的。

english: How did 'they' start it?
translation: 他们是怎么挑起的？

english: I can scarcely remember, it's been so long.
translation: 我几乎记不清了，太久远了。

english: Go on try.
translation: 试试看。

english: I think our leader once mentioned that they robbed one of our camels. A heinous crime around these parts.
translation: 我记得我们老大提过，他们抢了我们一头骆驼。在这附近可是十恶不赦的事。

english: So if they offered a camel as a gesture of goodwill would you agree to cease hostilities?
translation: 那如果他们归还一头骆驼作为善意之举，你会同意停止敌对吗？

english: Those bandits would never agree to that. They couldn't afford even the mangiest excuse for a camel, never mind the desert traversing, four legged beauty that we would demand.
translation: 那些强盗绝不会同意。他们连最寒酸的骆驼都买不起，更别说我们要的那种能穿越沙漠的四足美兽了。

english: Maybe if I got both gangs a camel, I could use the mutual good will to find out what happened to Ali's nephew.
translation: 也许如果我给两个帮派各弄一头骆驼，就能利用这份善意找出阿里侄子的下落。

english: But you are in luck - I have another two beautiful camels arriving soon from the best stable in all of Al Kharid.
translation: 但你运气不错——我很快就会有另外两头漂亮的骆驼从阿尔卡里德城最好的马厩运到。

english: Excellent! Although another two ugly camels would have been fine, I think.
translation: 太好了！不过我觉得另外两头丑骆驼也行。

english: Can you tell me a little about them?
translation: 能跟我讲讲它们吗？

english: Well Sandy, the female camel, is a placid beast. At 20 years of age she comes from a prestigious line of camels - her mother was part of the Emir's baggage train!
translation: 嗯，桑迪，那只母骆驼，是一头温顺的野兽。她20岁，来自一个著名的骆驼家族——她的母亲曾是埃米尔行李车队的一员！

english: Lumps, on the other hand, is a 15 year old male. He's a bit surly and prone to bouts of stubbornness. However, he more than makes up for this failing with his immense strength and stamina.
translation: 而另一头，拉普斯，是一头15岁的公骆驼。他有点暴躁，容易犯倔。不过，他凭借巨大的力量和耐力，完全弥补了这一缺点。

english: Both of them are of the 'Camelus Horribleus' family, a rare breed only found in this area of Gielinor. It is...
translation: 它们都属于'恐怖骆驼'家族，这是一种仅在吉里诺尔这片区域才有的稀有品种。它……

english: Ok, ok, that's enough! They're camels, I get it.
translation: 好了好了，够了！它们是骆驼，我明白了。

english: What price do you want for both of them?
translation: 两头一起要多少钱？

english: One cannot put a price on these beauties, they are precious beyond the worth of the crass value of gold coins!
translation: 这些宝贝岂能用金钱衡量，它们的价值远超金币这种俗物！

english: So can I have them for free then?
translation: 那我能免费拿走它们吗？

english: Perhaps I could make another offer?
translation: 也许我可以出个别的价？

english: Would 200 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两头一起200金币行吗？

english: Pah! That might buy you a mangy, flea-infested sheep if you're lucky. Don't insult me.
translation: 呸！运气好也许能买只长满跳蚤的癞皮羊。别侮辱我了。

english: Would 500 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两头一起500金币行吗？

english: I would consider giving them to you if you were able to look after them. But it is abundantly clear that you've got your hands - and your inventory - full at the moment.
translation: 如果你能照顾好它们，我倒是可以考虑给你。但很明显，你现在手头——还有你的背包——都满了。

english: You don't even have that much money do you? Come back when you're able to make a proper offer and stop wasting my time.
translation: 你连那么多钱都没有吧？等你出得起合适的价再来，别浪费我时间。

english: I suppose I can silence my moral objections for that.
translation: 我想为了这个价，我可以压下道德上的反对。

english: Here are the receipts for the camels, so that you can pick them up as soon as I get them in.
translation: 这是骆驼的收据，等我一拿到它们，你就可以来领了。

english: Would 1,000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两头一起1,000金币行吗？

english: You are too generous. I would have sold them for half of that!
translation: 你太慷慨了。我本来半价就卖了！

english: About those camels. I've lost the receipt, can I have another?
translation: 关于那些骆驼。我把收据弄丢了，能再给我一张吗？

english: I think you're trying to con me into giving you an extra receipt.
translation: 我觉得你是想骗我再给你一张收据。

english: Come back to me when you're not so burdened.
translation: 等你没那么大负担的时候再来找我。

english: No problem, There you go.
translation: 没问题，给你。

english: Why? did they not please you?
translation: 怎么？它们不合你意吗？

english: No, they didn't. I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: 不，不合意。我把它们当烤肉卖了！

english: Nooooo! Not Sandy and Lumps! You beast! Get out of my shop this instant!
translation: 不——！桑迪和拉普斯！你这野兽！立刻滚出我的店！

english: I'm not really a camel person, so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: 我其实不太喜欢骆驼，所以我把它们送给了一个更好的主人。

english: That's very responsible of you. Too many people let their camels run feral through the desert, instead of sending them to happy homes.
translation: 你这么做很负责任。太多人让他们的骆驼在沙漠里乱跑，而不是把它们送到幸福的家里。

english: You want to watch out for those feral camels, you know.
translation: 你得小心那些野骆驼，知道吗。

english: I decided to try and use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: 我决定试着用它们来结束两个帮派之间的敌对。

english: A noble purpose for two noble beasts! Did you succeed?
translation: 两头高贵的野兽有了一个崇高的目的！你成功了吗？

english: Still working on that, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕还在努力中。

english: Well, I wish you the best of luck.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。

english: Good news, the bandits have agreed to give you a camel in order to restore peace.
translation: 好消息，强盗们同意给你一头骆驼以恢复和平。

english: So where's the camel?
translation: 那骆驼在哪儿？

english: Um... I'll get back to you on that.
translation: 嗯……我回头再跟你说。

english: A mere receipt? For a discount camel? I knew those bandits were cheap! Tell them that we have changed our minds and demand 10 camels in return for our mercy.
translation: 就一张收据？换一头打折骆驼？我就知道那些强盗小气！告诉他们我们改主意了，要10头骆驼来换取我们的仁慈。

english: Oh no... why do I bother?
translation: 哦不……我干嘛要费这个劲？

english: Good news, the Menaphites have agreed to give you a camel in order to restore peace.
translation: 好消息，梅纳菲特人同意给你一头骆驼以恢复和平。

english: What's this? A mere promise of a camel? From a discount camel store? I knew those Menaphites were cowards. Tell them that we have changed our minds and demand 10 full-price camels in return for our
translation: 这是什么？就一张骆驼的承诺？从一家打折骆驼店来的？我就知道那些梅纳菲特人是懦夫。告诉他们我们改主意了，要10头全价骆驼来换取我们的

english: mercy.
translation: 仁慈。

english: The camel approach doesn't seem to be working. Perhaps I should be more direct and try to join one of the gangs.
translation: 骆驼策略似乎行不通。也许我应该更直接一点，试着加入其中一个帮派。

english: Really? I knew they were cowards. Tell them that we have changed our minds and demand 10 camels in return for our mercy.
translation: 真的吗？我就知道他们是懦夫。告诉他们我们改主意了，要10头骆驼来换取我们的仁慈。

english: Ahhh why do I bother!
translation: 啊——我干嘛要费这个劲！

english: I really can't chat for very long, the recent escalation in crime has me run off my feet. There are muggings and burglaries happening in broad daylight! It's really not on.
translation: 我真的没法聊太久，最近犯罪率上升，我忙得脚不沾地。光天化日之下都有抢劫和入室盗窃！这实在不像话。

english: Good day adventurer. Have you come with the Menaphite peace offering?
translation: 日安，冒险者。你是带着梅纳菲特的和平祭品来的吗？

english: Umm... no. Not yet. Actually I've come to ask about something else.
translation: 嗯……不，还没有。其实我是来问别的事的。

english: We can talk once you bring back the Menaphites' full peace offering.
translation: 等你把梅纳菲特人的完整和平祭品带回来，我们再谈。

english: Greetings Adventurer, Ali wants to have a word with you.
translation: 你好，冒险者，操作员阿里想跟你谈谈。

english: Really? Which one?
translation: 真的吗？哪个阿里？

english: Ali, our Chief of Operations. He should be somewhere nearby the tent.
translation: 阿里，我们的行动主管。他应该在帐篷附近某个地方。

english: You seem to be a man of action. We could do with more people like you to sort those despicable bandits out.
translation: 你看起来是个实干的人。我们需要更多像你这样的人来收拾那些可恶的强盗。

english: Yeah, those pesky bandits!
translation: 是啊，那些讨厌的强盗！

english: So will you join us in our fight to wipe them out?
translation: 那么你愿意加入我们，一起消灭他们吗？

english: Yes, of course, those pesky bandits should be taught a lesson.
translation: 是的，当然，那些讨厌的强盗应该得到教训。

english: Good choice my friend, together we will crush them.
translation: 好选择，我的朋友，我们将一起粉碎他们。

english: So when do we start?
translation: 那我们什么时候开始？

english: Slow down, slow down. First you must prove yourself capable and trustworthy.
translation: 慢点，慢点。首先你得证明自己有能力且值得信赖。

english: How will I manage that?
translation: 我要怎么做？

english: Don't worry about that, I'll just set you a few jobs to do.
translation: 别担心，我会给你安排几件差事。

english: As you might have gathered we have a less-than- sparkling reputation around here.
translation: 你可能已经注意到了，我们在这里的名声可不怎么样。

english: So I want you to foster this reputation and grow it.
translation: 所以我要你助长这个名声，让它更响亮。

english: What exactly does that mean?
translation: 具体是什么意思？

english: It means that I want you to go out into the town and pickpocket three villagers, then report back to me.
translation: 意思是，我要你到镇上去，扒窃三个村民，然后回来向我报告。

english: If you have any problems don't be afraid to ask for some advice.
translation: 如果有任何问题，别怕，来请教一下。

english: Oh right, thanks.
translation: 哦，好的，谢谢。

english: Can you be a bit more specific? Everyone here is called Ali.
translation: 你能说得具体点吗？这里每个人都叫阿里。

english: So I noticed. Well, he has an uncle called Ali Morrisane, a market vendor in Al Kharid. That's all I really know about him.
translation: 我也注意到了。嗯，他有个叔叔叫阿里.莫里桑，是阿尔卡里德城的一个市场小贩。我就知道这么多。

english: Say no more. I know just the Ali you mean - that little snake robbed me too! If we work together perhaps we can catch him and teach him a lesson.
translation: 不用再说了。我知道你说的是哪个阿里了——那条小蛇也偷过我！如果我们联手，也许能抓住他，给他个教训。

english: Perhaps later, I'm quite busy at the moment.
translation: 也许以后吧，我现在很忙。

english: Tell me when you are ready. This deed should not be undertaken lightly.
translation: 准备好了告诉我。这件契约不应轻率进行。

english: How is the pickpocketing going?
translation: 扒窃进行得怎么样了？

english: I haven't started yet. I'm still psyching myself up to it.
translation: 我还没开始。还在给自己打气。

english: Don't take all day, time is getting on and there are still plenty of foul deeds to be done.
translation: 别磨蹭一整天，时间不等人，还有很多坏事要干呢。

english: Get out of here, you Menaphite dog!
translation: 滚出去，你这梅纳菲特狗！

english: What was that? Are you looking for a fight.
translation: 你说什么？想打架吗？

english: Tumeken be praised, you have seen the error of your ways. May Elidinis the river goddess bless your lands.
translation: 图梅肯在上，你终于认识到自己的错误了。愿河流女神埃利迪尼斯保佑你的土地。

english: I was wondering if I could ask you about something.
translation: 我想问点事。

english: You're better off asking Ali the Operator. He's the brains behind the whole operation.
translation: 你最好去问操作员阿里。他是整个行动的大脑。

english: I know your tricks, thief.
translation: 我知道你的把戏，盗贼。

english: You won't get my purse.
translation: 你拿不到我的钱包。

english: How is the pickpocketing going? Need a hand?
translation: 扒窃进行得怎么样了？需要帮忙吗？

english: Yeah, I could do with a bit of advice.
translation: 是啊，我需要点建议。

english: If you can't achieve your goal directly, try adding another element into the equation, like a distraction.
translation: 如果你不能直接达成目标，试着加入另一个因素，比如制造干扰。

english: Do you know what I mean?
translation: 你明白我的意思吗？

english: Nah no problems here. I actually wanted to ask you about something else.
translation: 不，没问题。其实我是想问点别的事。

english: Hey kid, come here!
translation: 嘿，小子，过来！

english: I need a little help, do you want to make some easy money?
translation: 我需要点小忙，你想轻松赚点钱吗？

english: Do you see that villager over there? If you could distract him for a bit I'll give you 10 gold coins.
translation: 看到那边那个村民了吗？如果你能分散他一会儿注意力，我就给你10金币。

english: Listen, you're crazy. I can't see anyone to distract.
translation: 听着，你疯了。我没看到有人可以分散注意力。

english: Okay, I see them. Here I go!
translation: 好吧，我看到了。我去了！

english: Hey you, camel features! Come here.
translation: 嘿，你，骆驼脸！过来。

english: Thanks sir, I didn't think you would hold up your side of the deal. There's not much honour amongst thieves, you know.
translation: 谢谢先生，我没想到你会信守承诺。你知道，盗贼之间可没什么道义。

english: Well do you need any other information then?
translation: 那你还需要其他信息吗？

english: Better a thief than a liar!
translation: 做盗贼总比做骗子强！

english: Hi! Do you want to go rob some more people? I could do with some more money.
translation: 嗨！你想再去抢几个人吗？我需要更多钱。

english: The distraction tactic isn't working any more?
translation: 干扰战术不管用了？

english: No, they seem to have figured that one out already.
translation: 不，他们好像已经识破了。

english: It is a small town, news spreads fast. Perhaps using a spot of cunning and a bit of brute force might work better.
translation: 小镇子，消息传得快。也许用点小聪明加上点蛮力效果更好。

english: Here, take this, it might help.
translation: 拿着这个，也许有用。

english: I've already given you a Blackjack, try using it.
translation: 我已经给过你一根黑棍了，试试用它。

english: No problems here. I actually wanted to ask you about something else.
translation: 没问题。其实我是想问点别的事。

english: Psst. Come here, I want to show you something
translation: 喂。过来，我给你看点东西。

english: It's a surprise! Follow me.
translation: 是个惊喜！跟我来。

english: Well done! You have finished your first trial.
translation: 干得好！你完成了第一次试炼。

english: First trial?
translation: 第一次试炼？

english: You didn't think we'd hire you off the back of a couple of pick-pocketings, did you?
translation: 你不会以为我们光凭你偷了几次钱包就雇你吧？

english: Ah, of course not.
translation: 啊，当然不会。

english: Good! Now, the next thing you have to do is a spot of burglary.
translation: 很好！现在，你接下来要做的是入室行窃。

english: The only place worth pilfering around here is the mayor's villa.
translation: 这附近唯一值得偷的地方就是镇长的别墅。

english: I want you to retrieve his wife's jewels.
translation: 我要你把他妻子的首饰拿回来。

english: Got any advice?
translation: 有什么建议吗？

english: Well I think that a disguise would be a good start. After that I would stake out the place to make sure he's not in.
translation: 嗯，我觉得伪装是个好的开始。之后你得盯梢，确保他不在家。

english: You'll need a key to the front door, too.
translation: 你还需要前门的钥匙。

english: I can't carry anything else.
translation: 我拿不了更多东西了。

english: Well then come back to me again when you are ready. Don't be too long.
translation: 那就等你准备好了再来找我。别拖太久。

english: No! Now get going.
translation: 不行！现在就去。

english: Haven't I helped you enough already?
translation: 我帮你的还不够多吗？

english: Actually, I'm still having problems getting in.
translation: 其实，我进不去。

english: So you've lost your keys then. It's lucky I keep a spare pair.
translation: 所以你把钥匙弄丢了。幸好我留了备用钥匙。

english: So what's the problem? Have you created a disguise yet?
translation: 那问题出在哪？你做好伪装了吗？

english: Yes of course.
translation: 当然做好了。

english: Then make sure that you stake the place out to make sure neither the mayor or his family are inside.
translation: 那就确保你盯梢过，确认镇长和他的家人都不在里面。

english: Now that you mention it, yes I am having problems with the disguise.
translation: 既然你提了，是的，我在伪装上遇到了问题。

english: You'll have to create something that will hide your hair and obscure your facial features.
translation: 你得做点东西遮住头发和脸部特征。

english: Make sure you're wearing a pair of gloves so that you don't leave any incriminating finger prints.
translation: 确保你戴了手套，这样就不会留下指纹。

english: You should have all this equipped before you stake out the house.
translation: 在盯梢房子之前，你应该把这些都装备好。

english: I better be careful, this cactus is prickly!
translation: 我得小心点，这仙人掌有刺！

english: I've lost the keys you gave me.
translation: 我把你给的钥匙弄丢了。

english: It's lucky I keep a spare pair.
translation: 幸好我留了备用钥匙。

english: I've managed to stake the place out. What should I do now?
translation: 我成功盯梢了。现在该做什么？

english: Try using those keys I gave you to open the door!
translation: 试试用我给你的钥匙开门！

english: I've managed to break in, but I'm unable to get the jewels.
translation: 我成功闯进去了，但拿不到首饰。

english: Then search the house more thoroughly! Everything you need should be there.
translation: 那就更仔细地搜索房子！你需要的东西应该都在里面。

english: I really can't chat for very long, the recent escalation in crime has me run off my feet. Just a short while ago even my own house was robbed. This cannot continue.
translation: 我真的不能聊太久，最近犯罪率上升，我忙得脚不沾地。就在不久前，连我自己家都被偷了。这样下去可不行。

english: I've completed your task.
translation: 我完成了你的任务。

english: Impressive, I didn't expect you to crack that safe so quickly. Did you have help?
translation: 厉害，我没想到你这么快就撬开了那个保险箱。有人帮忙吗？

english: Of course not, although the mayor did leave a number of hints lying around.
translation: 当然没有，虽然镇长确实到处留了不少提示。

english: That man is a fool. Now give me the jewels.
translation: 那家伙真是个傻瓜。现在把首饰给我。

english: Actually I seem to have misplaced them.
translation: 其实，我好像把它们放错地方了。

english: You are trying my patience. Hurry back with the jewels. Don't disappoint me.
translation: 你在考验我的耐心。快点把首饰拿回来。别让我失望。

english: Now, your final task is one of the upmost importance. It has come to my attention that there is a traitor in our midst.
translation: 现在，你最后的任务至关重要。我注意到我们中间出了个叛徒。

english: Yes, and I want you to root them out.
translation: 是的，我要你把他们连根拔起。

english: Because I feel like I can trust you. You don't have the emotional baggage that comes with playing the villain your entire life.
translation: 因为我觉得可以信任你。你没有那种一辈子扮演恶人的情感包袱。

english: You can count on me to find out.
translation: 包在我身上，我会查出来的。

english: Aw! You can count on me to find the traitor.
translation: 啊！包在我身上，我会找到叛徒的。

english: Well then get to it.
translation: 那就去办吧。

english: How is the search for the traitor going?
translation: 搜索叛徒的进展如何？

english: Still no breakthrough.
translation: 还是没有突破。

english: Make sure you interview our other members. They may know more than they let on.
translation: 确保你去盘问其他成员。他们知道的可能比说出来的多。

english: I was wondering if you could help me?
translation: 我想知道你能不能帮我？

english: Tell me what your problem is and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 告诉我你的问题，我看看能做什么。

english: I've heard there's a traitor among the Menaphites. What do you know about it?
translation: 我听说梅奈菲特人里有个叛徒。你知道些什么吗？

english: It wasn't me, I swear!
translation: 不是我，我发誓！

english: Really? So what do you know?
translation: 真的吗？那你知道什么？

english: I just can't believe one of my friends could be a traitor.
translation: 我只是不敢相信我的朋友中会有人是叛徒。

english: Well, I suppose there is Traitorous Ali.
translation: 嗯，我想有个叫“叛徒阿里”的。

english: 'Traitorous Ali'?
translation: “叛徒阿里”？

english: Oh yes. The most untrustworthy, backstabbing little rat to scamper across Tumeken's fair desert. He'd sell his own mother to slavers if he hadn't already betrayed her and had her locked up for the last job he pulled.
translation: 哦，是的。他是图梅肯美丽沙漠上最不可信、最会背后捅刀的小老鼠。如果他还没背叛他母亲并把她关起来的话，他早就把他母亲卖给奴隶贩子了。

english: I suppose the name is a bit of a giveaway.
translation: 我想这名字已经说明一切了。

english: That was a little too simple, are you sure it was him?
translation: 这也太简单了，你确定是他吗？

english: Positive, he was turned by the offer of a set of waterproofs and a ride on a camel.
translation: 确定，他被一套防水服和骑骆驼的机会收买了。

english: I see he drives a hard bargain.
translation: 看来他讨价还价的本事不小。

english: Well what can I say? We don't call him 'Ali of the Good Decisions', do we?
translation: 嗯，我能说什么呢？我们又不叫他“好决定阿里”，对吧？

english: I have discovered the identity of the traitor. It was...
translation: 我发现了叛徒的身份。是……

english: Traitorous Ali!
translation: 叛徒阿里！

english: No! I would never have suspected Traitorous Ali.
translation: 不！我绝不会怀疑叛徒阿里。

english: Well, there was that time he sold out his entire family for a sandpit and an umbrella.
translation: 嗯，他曾经为了一个沙坑和一把雨伞出卖了全家。

english: But I'm sure it took much more for him to betray us!
translation: 但我肯定他背叛我们需要更大的代价！

english: Actually he sold you out for...
translation: 其实，他出卖你们是为了……

english: Stop, I don't want to know. It hurts too much already. Find him and then kill him, but do it quietly. I don't want a fuss.
translation: 别说了，我不想听。已经够伤心的了。找到他，然后杀了他，但要做得干净利落。我不想引起骚动。

english: Is the deed done?
translation: 事情办妥了吗？

english: Well don't waste time talking to me. Get on with it.
translation: 别浪费时间跟我说话。快去办。

english: Now what do you want? A hex? A spot potion? Power, beauty, eternal youth, etcetera?
translation: 现在你想要什么？诅咒？斑点药水？力量、美貌、永葆青春，等等？

english: Actually I just want your help to, erm, remove someone. It's simple enough!
translation: 其实我只是想让你帮忙，呃，除掉一个人。很简单！

english: Ahh, I see. But I warn you, stranger - extinguishing the flame of life is simple, but people rarely wish to face the consequences, and I doubt you are any different.
translation: 啊，我明白了。但我警告你，陌生人——熄灭生命之火很简单，但人们很少愿意面对后果，我怀疑你也不例外。

english: Don't worry about the consequences - I need it carried out in a manner which would draw no suspicion to me.
translation: 别担心后果——我需要用一种不会引起别人怀疑我的方式来做。

english: Well now this is getting interesting. I'd recommend a poisoning. Who do you wish dead? I need to know so that I may tailor a poison to their specific needs.
translation: 嗯，这下有意思了。我建议用毒药。你想让谁死？我需要知道，这样我才能针对他们的具体情况调配毒药。

english: 'Traitorous Ali', please.
translation: “叛徒阿里”，拜托了。

english: Traitorous Ali? Say no more! That wretch traded his grandmother's house for a jar of pickled aubergines! I believe he'll be easily gotten rid of...
translation: 叛徒阿里？别说了！那个混蛋用他祖母的房子换了一罐腌茄子！我相信他很容易就能被除掉……

english: What payment do you require?
translation: 你要什么报酬？

english: None at all - I will extract much pleasure from his passing. Just bring me the ingredients I require.
translation: 完全不用——他的死会给我带来很多乐趣。只要把我需要的材料带来就行。

english: Ah, impatience! Traitorous Ali's time is indeed nigh. Firstly bring me some snake venom, which will act as the main toxin.
translation: 啊，没耐心了！叛徒阿里的死期确实近了。首先给我带些蛇毒来，作为主要毒素。

english: Where would I get some snake poison?
translation: 我去哪里弄蛇毒？

english: From a snake perhaps?
translation: 也许从蛇身上？

english: What I meant was how do I extract the poison from the snake?
translation: 我的意思是怎么从蛇身上提取毒液？

english: Sheesh! You'd make a terrible hag. Just bring me a snake with teeth in its head - and don't even think of giving me that snake charmer's pet worm, it's about as dangerous as a rubber knife.
translation: 啧！你当巫婆肯定很糟糕。给我带一条嘴里有牙的蛇来——别想着给我那个耍蛇人的宠物蠕虫，那玩意儿跟橡胶刀一样危险。

english: Have you got a snake yet?
translation: 你弄到蛇了吗？

english: No, I'm still working on that.
translation: 没有，还在弄。

english: Well don't bother me again until you do!
translation: 那就别来烦我，直到你弄到为止！

english: I have the snake. What else do you need?
translation: 我有蛇了。你还需要什么？

english: Ah yes, that snake will do nicely. Hello, you wriggly little cutie!
translation: 啊，是的，那条蛇正好。你好啊，你这扭来扭去的小可爱！

english: Who's a vindictive little beast? You are! You are!
translation: 谁是个恶毒的小野兽？是你！是你！

english: Erm, yes. Do you need anything else?
translation: 呃，是的。你还需要别的吗？

english: Now that I have the toxin I need something to hide its trace. Fresh camel dung should do the job.
translation: 既然我有了毒素，我需要点东西来掩盖它的痕迹。新鲜的骆驼粪便应该能行。

english: What? That's disgusting.
translation: 什么？真恶心。

english: Do you want the poison or not?
translation: 你到底要不要毒药？

english: Fine, fine, I'll get some camel dung.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我去弄些骆驼粪便。

english: And make that fresh camel dung! Nice and stinky. Now hand over that venomous little darling before it takes a bite out of you.
translation: 而且要新鲜的骆驼粪便！又新鲜又臭。现在把那条毒辣的小可爱交出来，免得它咬你一口。

english: Oops! I almost forgot!
translation: 哎呀！我差点忘了！

english: Do you have the camel dung yet?
translation: 你弄到骆驼粪便了吗？

english: Well don't come back until you have it!
translation: 那就别回来，直到你弄到为止！

english: Here's your poison!
translation: 你的毒药来了！

english: Wow, that was quick!
translation: 哇，这么快！

english: Actually I already had it brewing. I just needed the ingredients for another batch.
translation: 其实我早就泡上了，只是需要材料再做一批。

english: You wouldn't believe the demand. It's been murder!
translation: 你根本想不到需求量有多大，简直要命！

english: That's not even remotely funny.
translation: 这一点也不好笑。

english: Sorry, I've been dying to say that for ages.
translation: 抱歉，我憋这句话好久了。

english: Just stop. Thanks for the poison and good day to you.
translation: 够了，谢谢你的毒药，祝你愉快。

english: Wait! Just remember, this poison isn't designed to be used on a weapon. In fact it's not a contact poison at all. You'll have to do more than just smear it on a blade!
translation: 等等！记住，这毒药不是给武器用的，它根本就不是接触性毒药。光抹在刀片上可没用！

english: Got it. Thanks again!
translation: 明白了，再次感谢！

english: I was wondering if I could have another batch of poison?
translation: 我想问能不能再给我一批毒药？

english: Why? Was the first batch not good enough?
translation: 为什么？第一批不够好？

english: Well no, I was just being greedy and wanted another batch for no good reason.
translation: 不，我只是贪心，没什么理由就想要一批。

english: Well if that's the case, no! I have better things to be doing than continuously brewing poisons for people who have no use for it.
translation: 如果是这样，那可不行！我还有其他事要做，不会一直给用不上毒药的人熬毒。

english: I lost the first batch.
translation: 第一批我弄丢了。

english: What? How do you just lose a batch of the most potent poison in all of Gielinor? It's even more deadly than the jungle karambwan.
translation: 什么？你怎么能把整个吉莱诺最厉害的毒药弄丢？它比丛林卡拉姆万还致命。

english: It's a long and not very interesting story.
translation: 说来话长，而且没什么意思。

english: Well alright, I'll give you another batch this once.
translation: 好吧，这次我就再给你一批。

english: Have you good reason to disturb me again?
translation: 你又有充足的理由来打扰我？

english: I warned you about needlessly bothering me. That's it! I'm turning you into a frog!
translation: 我警告过你别没事来烦我。够了！我要把你变成青蛙！

english: Ribbit, ribbit!
translation: 呱，呱！

english: Don't taunt me, fool! Once I find a spare minute you'll be ribbiting on the other side of your face, you mark my words!
translation: 别嘲笑我，蠢货！等我抽出空来，你就等着脸上呱呱叫吧，记住我的话！

english: Almost, his drink is poisoned. As soon as he gets back, he'll be done for.
translation: 差不多了，他的酒被下了毒。他一回来就完蛋了。

english: Excellent work! Now, go speak with our boss.
translation: 干得漂亮！现在去找我们老大谈谈。

english: He wants to discuss the future direction of the gang.
translation: 他想讨论帮派未来的方向。

english: What did the boss say?
translation: 老大说了什么？

english: I haven't spoken with him yet.
translation: 我还没跟他谈。

english: Ali the Operator said you wanted to see me.
translation: 操作员阿里说你想见我。

english: That's right. I have kept a close eye on your progress. I'm impressed.
translation: 没错。我一直密切关注你的进展，印象深刻。

english: So what are your plans for the bandits?
translation: 那你对强盗有什么打算？

english: The bandits? A mere nuisance, insignificant to my overall goal.
translation: 强盗？不过是小麻烦，对我的总体目标来说微不足道。

english: Wait, if you're not warring with the bandits, what are you planning?
translation: 等等，如果你不是要和强盗开战，那你计划什么？

english: World domination! First Pollnivneach, then Al Kharid, then the whole of the desert!
translation: 统治世界！先拿下波尼尼镇，然后是阿尔卡里德城，最后是整个沙漠！

english: You do understand who we are, don't you?
translation: 你应该知道我们是谁吧？

english: Actually I thought you were a ragtag band of good-for- nothing thieves sucking the life out of this innocent town.
translation: 我还以为你们是一群乌合之众、一无是处的小偷，在榨干这个无辜小镇的生机。

english: Silence! We are the descendants of assassins, the heirs of the revolutionaries who defeated the corrupt pharaoh and his brood!
translation: 住口！我们是刺客的后代，是那些击败了腐败法老及其党羽的革命者的继承人！

english: For centuries we have wandered the desert, rebuilding the empire we were promised!
translation: 几个世纪以来，我们一直在沙漠中流浪，重建我们被承诺的帝国！

english: Will you join us in our quest to defeat the thralls of Tumeken and reclaim our birthright?
translation: 你愿意加入我们，打败图梅肯的奴隶，夺回我们与生俱来的权利吗？

english: Sorry, I have this irrational hatred for megalomaniac, despotic zealots! Prepare to meet your maker, you big jerk!
translation: 抱歉，我对狂妄自大、专制狂热的人有种非理性的仇恨！准备见你的造物主吧，你这自大狂！

english: Wait, your great-great-great-great-grandparents were the ones who killed Osmumten?
translation: 等等，你的曾曾曾曾祖父母就是杀死奥斯穆滕的人？

english: You don't even know his name, and you claim to be the heirs to his empire? Come on.
translation: 你连他的名字都不知道，还敢自称是他帝国的继承人？得了吧。

english: You're just a bunch of petty tyrants looking for an excuse to hurt people.
translation: 你们不过是一群找借口伤害别人的小暴君。

english: Be careful what you say! We are loyal servants of the Devourer!
translation: 说话注意点！我们是吞噬者的忠实仆人！

english: I hope so, because you're about to meet her in person. This is for Mehhar!
translation: 最好如此，因为你马上就要亲自见到她了。这是为了梅哈尔！

english: Fool! You'll never get to me. Guards protect me.
translation: 蠢货！你休想靠近我。卫兵保护我！

english: You treacherous jackal! Prepare to die!
translation: 你这背信弃义的胡狼！准备受死吧！

english: Guards!
translation: 卫兵！

english: You haven't seen the last of me!
translation: 你还没见识到我的全部！

english: No doubt I haven't seen the last of you... but what about Ali's nephew?
translation: 毫无疑问我还没见识到你的全部……但阿里的侄子怎么办？

english: Maybe the villagers will feel more talkative now that I've rid them of these evil Menaphites. Who knows, they might even give me a reward!
translation: 也许村民们现在会更愿意说话了，毕竟我帮他们摆脱了这些邪恶的梅纳菲特人。谁知道呢，他们甚至可能会给我奖励！

english: What can I say, you live and learn.
translation: 我只能说，活到老学到老。

english: I don't know what we did to deserve your presence here, but I for one am filled with regret.
translation: 我不知道我们做了什么才让你出现在这里，但至少我本人充满了后悔。

english: Well that's some show of gratitude! Can't I even get a 'thank you' for ridding your town of one of the gangs?
translation: 这可真是表达感激的方式！我帮你们小镇除掉了一个帮派，连个“谢谢”都没有吗？

english: Do you understand the concept of consequences?
translation: 你懂什么叫后果吗？

english: Er, I think so?
translation: 呃，我想应该懂吧？

english: Well, the consequences of your little piece of butchery are that the town is now even worse off. The bandits no longer have to waste time and energy fighting with the Menaphites and can direct all their attention
translation: 好吧，你那次小杀戮的后果就是小镇现在更糟了。强盗们不再需要浪费时间和精力与梅纳菲特人争斗，可以把全部注意力

english: towards making us miserable. So for your efforts I thank you, but I wish no-one had asked for your help.
translation: 都用来让我们痛苦。所以，你的努力我感谢你，但我希望没人向你求助过。

english: I'll set this town right before I leave, I promise.
translation: 我保证在离开之前把这个小镇恢复好。

english: Why do I wish that you hadn't said that? Your heavyhanded tactics scare me.
translation: 为什么我宁愿你没这么说？你那粗暴的手段让我害怕。

english: Welcome! Your actions surprise me.
translation: 欢迎！你的行动让我很吃惊。

english: It was brilliant the way you got rid of the Menaphite leader.
translation: 你除掉梅纳菲特领袖的方式真是高明。

english: Er... yes. Thank you.
translation: 呃……是的。谢谢你。

english: So will you run the rest of them out of town now?
translation: 那你现在要把其余的人都赶出小镇吗？

english: Welcome. Our leader would be pleased to congratulate you on your disposal of the Menaphites who plagued this town.
translation: 欢迎。我们领袖很高兴能祝贺你解决了困扰小镇的梅纳菲特人。

english: Why did you have to go and ruin everything? We had a beautiful future ahead of us, the town would have been ours!
translation: 你为什么非要来毁了一切？我们本来有个美好的未来，小镇本该是我们的！

english: Maybe I wanted to make it MY town!
translation: 也许我想把它变成我的小镇！

english: I see. I knew the hunger for power would get to you eventually.
translation: 我明白了。我就知道对权力的渴望最终会影响到你。

english: Evil megalomaniacs set on destruction should be opposed.
translation: 那些一心毁灭的邪恶自大狂应该被抵抗。

english: Really? I thought you were meant to follow those types blindly, with unquestioning loyalty.
translation: 真的吗？我还以为你应该盲目追随那种人，带着毫无疑问的忠诚。

english: Look, Gielinor is full of power mad evil-doers. I'm sure another will come along soon enough.
translation: 听着，吉莱诺到处都是权力狂的恶棍。我肯定很快就会再有另一个。

english: No... it just wouldn't be the same. I think I'll just wallow in self pity for a while.
translation: 不……那感觉不一样。我想我还是自怨自艾一会儿吧。

english: I'm sorry, I didn't mean to upset you. Can we still be friends?
translation: 抱歉，我不是故意让你难过。我们还是朋友吗？

english: No, I think I'll just wallow in self pity for a while.
translation: 不，我想我还是自怨自艾一会儿吧。

english: You! You're the one that just made everything worse for us poor villagers!
translation: 你！就是你让我们这些可怜的村民雪上加霜！

english: What?! I just single-handedly took apart one of the gangs that was ruining your town!
translation: 什么？！我刚刚独自瓦解了一个正在毁掉你们小镇的帮派！

english: You adventurers! You never think, you just act. You think that by killing a powerful bad person, Gielinor will become a better place.
translation: 你们这些冒险者！从来不动脑，只会行动。你们以为杀掉一个强大的坏人，吉莱诺就会变得更好。

english: It's not that simple, things never are. You've created a vacuum, and now all that power will go to whoever's strong enough to take it.
translation: 没那么简单，事情从来都不简单。你制造了一个真空，现在所有权力都会落到有能力夺取的人手里。

english: Who do you think is stronger? Our elderly mayor, or the leader of the bandits?
translation: 你觉得谁更强？我们年迈的镇长，还是强盗首领？

english: Oops. Sorry, I was just trying to help. So are things really that much worse?
translation: 哎呀，抱歉，我只是想帮忙。事情真的严重了很多吗？

english: Yes. Before your intervention the two gangs pretty much cancelled each other out. They spent most of their energy trying to kill each other.
translation: 是的。在你插手之前，两个帮派基本上互相抵消了。他们把大部分精力都花在互相残杀上。

english: Now that the balance is lost, the Bandits reign unopposed! They no longer have to deal with the Menaphites and heap misery upon misery on us. You must finish the job that you have started.
translation: 现在平衡被打破，强盗们肆无忌惮地统治！他们不再需要对付梅纳菲特人，把苦难层层加在我们身上。你必须完成你开始的事。

english: You know, this adventuring lark is a lot more complicated than I thought!
translation: 你知道吗，这冒险勾当比我想象的复杂得多！

english: If you're prepared to change something you must also be prepared to deal with the consequences! Now hurry up and fix this mess you created!
translation: 如果你准备改变什么，就必须准备好承担后果！现在赶快去收拾你造成的烂摊子！

english: What do you mean by fix the mess I created?
translation: 你说的收拾我造成的烂摊子是什么意思？

english: Do I have to spell it out to you?
translation: 非要我说得那么明白吗？

english: Would you please?
translation: 拜托了。

english: Just run the bandits out of town. Incidentally, I spotted their leader to the north-west just a few minutes ago.
translation: 就是把强盗赶出小镇。顺便说一句，几分钟前我在西北方向看到了他们的首领。

english: Welcome! Our leader wants to congratulate you on your swift disposal of the Menaphites who plagued this town.
translation: 欢迎！我们领袖要祝贺你迅速解决了困扰小镇的梅纳菲特人。

english: Come here my friend, so I may embrace you. You have done us a great turn by disposing of those Menaphites.
translation: 过来，我的朋友，让我拥抱你。你除掉那些梅纳菲特人，帮了我们大忙。

english: Don't jump to conclusions, I didn't do it for you.
translation: 别急着下结论，我不是为了你才这么做的。

english: Regardless, I am still very grateful. Now I have the town at my mercy.
translation: 不管怎样，我仍然非常感激。现在整个城镇都在我的掌控之中了。

english: That's what I'm here to talk to you about.
translation: 这正是我来找你谈的事情。

english: Do you want a reward? A fee? I will not begrudge you that.
translation: 你想要奖励吗？报酬？我不会吝啬的。

english: No, I'm here to give you an ultimatum: either leave the town of your own free will or I will make you.
translation: 不，我是来给你下最后通牒的：要么自愿离开小镇，要么我逼你离开。

english: How the worm has turned. This no-name adventurer who was robbing, looting and poisoning not too long ago is now taking the moral high ground! Or are you trying to keep the whole town for yourself?
translation: 真是风水轮流转。这个不久前还在抢劫、掠夺和下毒的无名冒险者，现在居然站在道德高地上！还是你想把整个城镇都据为己有？

english: Pollnivneach is mine. You won't run me out without a fight. If you want us gone, you must defeat our strongest warrior in battle.
translation: 波尼尼镇是我的。你不会不战而让我离开。如果你想让我们走，就必须在战斗中击败我们最强的战士。

english: Start packing your bags!
translation: 开始打包行李吧！

english: Grrr
translation: 呜

english: Ali, come here!
translation: 阿里，过来！

english: I have defeated your champion, now get out of town.
translation: 我已经击败了你们的勇士，现在离开小镇。

english: Adventurer... I have underestimated you. Perhaps we can come to an agreement. How about I work for you? Think of the riches you would make.
translation: 冒险者……我低估了你。或许我们可以达成协议。我来为你效劳如何？想想你能赚到多少财富。

english: Don't try my patience. Tell me where Ali is, and then get out of here?
translation: 别挑战我的耐心。告诉我阿里在哪里，然后滚出去？

english: Ali? Which Ali?
translation: 阿里？哪个阿里？

english: Ali Morrisane's nephew! I know you gangs had something to do with his disappearance, so tell me where he is!
translation: 阿里.莫里桑的侄子！我知道你们帮派跟他失踪有关，快告诉我他在哪！

english: Ali Morrisane?! You fool. You've been had!
translation: 阿里.莫里桑？！你这个傻瓜。你被骗了！

english: Go have a chat with these precious townspeople of yours. You'll soon learn the truth.
translation: 去跟你那些宝贵的镇民聊聊吧。你很快就会知道真相。

english: I'll go talk to a villager now, just to prove you wrong. Now get out of here before I really get angry with you!
translation: 我现在就去跟村民谈谈，证明你错了。趁我还没真发火，赶紧滚！

english: I told you to clear off! Why are you still here?
translation: 我叫你滚蛋！你怎么还在这儿？

english: Don't try my patience. Get out of here, and never return to this town again!
translation: 别挑战我的耐心。滚出去，永远别再回这个镇子！

english: Ha! You fancy yourself the people's champion, do you? You are so naive. You don't even realise you've been tricked!
translation: 哈！你以为自己是人民的英雄，是吗？你太天真了。你甚至没意识到自己被耍了！

english: Go have a chat with these precious townspeople of yours. You'll soon see.
translation: 去跟你那些宝贵的镇民聊聊吧。你很快就会明白。

english: I'll go talk to a villager now, just to prove you wrong. Now get out of here before I really get angry with you.
translation: 我现在就去跟村民谈谈，证明你错了。趁我还没真发火，赶紧滚。

english: Now are you satisfied?
translation: 你现在满意了吗？

english: Oh, it's you again!
translation: 哦，又是你！

english: I have delivered you from two evil tyrants. Where's my thank you?
translation: 我帮你摆脱了两个邪恶的暴君。我的感谢呢？

english: Thank you? For what? You come into our town. You rob, mug, burgle and kill and then expect respect and gratitude? Look, if it's praise and thanks you're looking for, talk to the mayor.
translation: 感谢？为了什么？你来到我们的镇子，抢劫、偷盗、入室行窃、杀人，然后还指望受到尊重和感激？听着，如果你想要赞美和感谢，去找镇长吧。

english: I wonder why I bother sometimes! This place has been nothing but trouble and I still haven't found Ali's nephew.
translation: 有时候我真不知道我为什么要自找麻烦！这地方除了麻烦什么也没有，我还没找到阿里的侄子。

english: My thanks, adventurer. Your methods and motives may be questionable, but none can argue that you have delivered our little town from the wicked gangs who plagued it. I think things will change around here, now
translation: 多谢了，冒险者。你的手段和动机或许值得怀疑，但没人能否认你帮我们小镇摆脱了肆虐的邪恶帮派。我想这里以后会有所改变，现在

english: that our problems are at a manageable size.
translation: 我们的问题总算控制在了可管理的范围。

english: The least that I can do for you is answer your questions about the whereabouts of Ali Morrisane's nephew. He always was a mischievous young man, full of harebrained schemes.
translation: 至少我能为你做的就是回答你关于阿里.莫里桑侄子下落的问题。他一直是个淘气的年轻人，满脑子异想天开的计划。

english: He dreamed of being the greatest salesman in all of Gielinor! Unfortunately, he was a little too good.
translation: 他梦想成为整个吉莱诺最伟大的推销员！不幸的是，他有点太出色了。

english: He angered a number of people by coercing them into buying things they didn't really want. Completely within the law, of course, but the law could only protect young Ali for so long.
translation: 他强迫别人购买他们并不真正想要的东西，惹恼了不少人。当然，完全是在法律范围内，但法律只能保护小阿里这么久。

english: Once he angered the Menaphites and the bandits, I knew I could no longer protect him.
translation: 当他惹恼了梅纳菲特人和强盗时，我知道我再也无法保护他了。

english: Under cover of darkness I smuggled him out of the town, and he's been gone ever since.
translation: 趁着夜色，我把他偷偷送出了小镇，从那以后他就再也没回来。

english: I can assure you, however, that he is safe and well - and now that you have effectively ended the threat posed by the gangs, he can continue his business elsewhere. Last I heard he planned to open some kind
translation: 不过我可以向你保证，他现在安然无恙——既然你有效地消除了帮派的威胁，他可以在其他地方继续他的生意。我上次听说，他打算和他的四十个朋友建立一种

english: of trade network with forty of his friends. A 'treasure trove', he claims. I'll believe it when I see it.
translation: 贸易网络。他声称那是一个‘宝藏库’。我得亲眼见到才相信。

english: I hope that helps you in your quest. If you speak to Ali Morrisane, do tell him that I wholeheartedly apologise for the way he - er, his family - has been treated.
translation: 希望这对你的任务有帮助。如果你见到阿里.莫里桑，请告诉他，我对他——呃，他家人的遭遇——致以最诚挚的歉意。

english: I think I may be able to help with one other thing. I heard that your house was burgled recently. If you're interested in recovering the goods, you ought to have a word with Ali the Operator.
translation: 我想我还能帮你另一件事。我听说你家最近被盗了。如果你想找回财物，应该去找操作员阿里谈谈。

english: Now, how would a passing adventurer know where to find my missing jewels?
translation: 那么，一个路过的冒险者怎么会知道我丢失的首饰在哪？

english: Er, let's just put it down to adventurer's intuition.
translation: 呃，就当成是冒险者的直觉吧。

english: Perhaps you should! I'm sure he's keen to hear word of his nephew.
translation: 也许你应该去！我相信他一定很想听到他侄子的消息。

english: Well since you gave the two gangs a good kicking, business has really taken off! Both gangs are spending all their gold here drowning their sorrows.
translation: 既然你狠狠教训了那两个帮派，生意可是好多了！两个帮派都在我这里花光所有金币借酒浇愁。

english: That's great! So do I get a cut of the profits?
translation: 太好了！那我能不能分一杯羹？

english: Get out of here, you cheeky rascal. A cut of my profits? As if!
translation: 滚开，你这个小滑头。分我的利润？想得美！

english: Could you tell Traitorous Ali that someone has poisoned his drink?
translation: 你能告诉叛徒阿里有人在他的酒里下毒了吗？

english: What?! Poisoned drinks, in my bar?! My reputation would be destroyed if someone died here. Thank you adventurer.
translation: 什么？！我的酒吧里居然有人下毒？！如果有人死在这里，我的名声可就毁了。谢谢你，冒险者。

english: Here, have a beer - it's on the house.
translation: 来，喝杯啤酒——我请客。

english: Thanks but no thanks, I don't drink.
translation: 谢谢，但不用了，我不喝酒。

english: Don't say that around here too loud please, it may catch and then I'd be out of business.
translation: 请别在这儿大声说这种话，传出去的话我的生意可就黄了。

english: You could always open up a non alcoholic fruit juice bar. You'd have less problems with drunken customers
translation: 你可以开一家无酒精果汁吧。醉鬼客人也会少很多麻烦。

english: You might be onto something there, but then what would I do with the drunken sailor?
translation: 你这提议有点意思，可那样的话那个醉醺醺的水手该怎么处理？

english: Drunken Ali. Oh never mind it's a long story.
translation: 醉汉阿里。哦，算了，说来话长。

english: Yuck! I don't like beer.
translation: 呃！我不喜欢啤酒。

english: Fine, suit yourself. There's no need to insult me.
translation: 好吧，随你便。但别侮辱我。

english: Hey Ali!
translation: 嘿，阿里！

english: Hello again my friend. I have heard nothing from my troublesome nephew. Have you any news of his whereabouts?
translation: 又见面了，我的朋友。我那个麻烦的侄子还是没有消息。你有他的下落吗？

english: Indeed I do. I was able to eventually learn of his fortunes, although it was a little bit more challenging than I originally thought.
translation: 确实有。我终于打听到了他的近况，虽然比我预想的要费劲一些。

english: Well then please, tell me what has become of him. Nothing bad I hope.
translation: 那么请告诉我，他怎么样了。但愿不是什么坏事。

english: I was able to discover that he is quite the salesman. Perhaps too good. He has roughly forty people working under him.
translation: 我发现他是个相当出色的推销员。也许是太出色了。他手下大约有四十个人。

english: Unfortunately a number of people didn't approve of his sales techniques and as a result he is in hiding.
translation: 不幸的是，很多人不赞同他的销售技巧，结果他只好躲藏起来。

english: You make an old man very happy. I'm so proud of young Baba.
translation: 你让我这个老头子很欣慰。我真为小巴巴感到骄傲。

english: But he's considered a thief!
translation: 但他被认为是个盗贼！

english: Yes, by people with too much money and not enough sense. All willingly parted with their money and received what they purchased.
translation: 是啊，被那些钱多得没处花、脑子又不够用的人这么认为。他们都是自愿掏钱，也拿到了买的东西。

english: Well, it seems I still am in need of an assistant...
translation: 嗯，看来我还是需要一个助理……

english: ..but take the reward anyway.
translation: ……但报酬你还是拿着吧。

english: I've just been thinking Ali, there seems to be a few parallels between yourself and your nephew. Both of you are unscrupulous salesmen, both of you come from the same town and both of you no longer trade there.
translation: 我刚刚在想，阿里，你和你侄子似乎有不少相似之处。你们两个都是不择手段的推销员，来自同一个镇子，而且都不再在那里做生意了。

english: Were you sent into exile too?
translation: 你也是被流放的吗？

english: No, now hang on, this seems to me like one of the strangest quests I have ever been involved with. I do not believe that a businessman like you would not know of a competitor, particularly a competitor as talented as
translation: 不，等等，我觉得这大概是我经历过的最奇怪的任务之一。我不相信像你这样的商人会不知道一个竞争对手，尤其是像你侄子这样有才干的竞争对手。

english: your nephew.
translation: 你侄子。

english: So what was your motive to get me to visit Pollnivneach? Was it concern for the towns people? Hmm. I don't think so, I'd say you would probably sell your grandmother if you could get a good price for
translation: 那么你让我去波尼尼镇的动机是什么？是担心镇上的人吗？哼，我不这么认为。我敢说如果你能卖个好价钱，你连你奶奶都会卖掉。

english: her. What was the reason?
translation: 真正的原因是什么？

english: My my, you surprise me, you're not as dumb as you look.
translation: 哎呀哎呀，你让我意外，你并没有看起来那么笨。

english: Surely you didn't do all this to sell me a fake beard and headpiece.
translation: 你该不会就为了卖给我一个假胡子和头饰才搞出这么多事吧。

english: Ah, once again you underestimate me. I sold you far more than that.
translation: 啊，你又低估我了。我卖给你的可远不止这些。

english: Really? Well I did buy some other odds and ends off you.... no hang on! I get it now, you're in league with Ali the Camel seller, the Kebab seller and the mayor aren't you.
translation: 真的吗？好吧，我是从你这儿买过一些零碎东西……不，等等！我现在明白了，你和骆驼阿里、烤肉商以及镇长是一伙的，对吧？

english: I like the word 'tourism'. Did you not enjoy your stay in Pollnivneach? Was there not action, intrigue and fun to be had, and did you not notice all the other tourists there too?
translation: 我喜欢‘旅游业’这个词。你在波尼尼镇过得不好吗？难道没有行动、阴谋和乐趣吗？你难道没注意到那里还有其他游客吗？

english: I must apologise for ever doubting you. You really are the greatest salesman in all of Gielinor.
translation: 我必须为我曾经怀疑你而道歉。你确实是整个吉莱诺最伟大的推销员。

english: Now that we both agree on that, may I show you my wares?
translation: 既然我们都同意这一点，我可以向你展示我的商品吗？

english: Nilsal, my child. Your arrival is well timed.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。你来得正是时候。

english: Yes. The Queen would like to speak with you.
translation: 是的。女王想和你谈谈。

english: Indeed. She is waiting for you upstairs. I will go on ahead and let her know you are here.
translation: 没错。她在楼上等你。我先过去告诉她你来了。

english: I am told you were with my son when he was captured?
translation: 听说我儿子被俘时你和他在一起？

english: Yes, my Queen.
translation: 是的，女王陛下。

english: You followed along with this plan of his, knowing that in doing so, you were supporting him in disobeying an order from his Queen?
translation: 你跟随他的计划，明知这样做是在支持他违抗女王的命令？

english: You do not strike me as a fool, so why do you play the part of one?
translation: 你看起来不像个傻瓜，为什么要装傻？

english: I can fix this. I promise you, I will find Itzla and I will rescue him.
translation: 我能解决这件事。我向你保证，我会找到伊兹拉并救出他。

english: Why should I trust you? Because my son did? Tell me, which recent event was it that suggested to you that he was of sound judgement?
translation: 我为什么要相信你？就因为我儿子相信你？告诉我，最近哪件事让你觉得他判断力很好？

english: With respect, my Queen, were it not for [player name] here, I would have died at the hands of the Emissaries. I believe [he has/she has/they have] earned our trust.
translation: 恕我直言，女王陛下，如果不是[player name]在这里，我早就死在特使手里了。我相信[he has/she has/they have]已经赢得了我们的信任。

english: Trust is like a blade. If not maintained, it fails when you need it most.
translation: 信任就像一把刀片。如果不维护，它就会在你最需要的时候失效。

english: Then let us give our iknami here the opportunity to regain our trust.
translation: 那么，就让我们给我们的伊克纳米一个机会，重新赢得我们的信任吧。

english: You seem to have made quite the impression, outsider. Both Servius and my son have taken a liking to you.
translation: 你似乎给人留下了深刻的印象，外来者。塞尔维乌斯和我的儿子都很喜欢你。

english: Prove them right. Rectify this situation.
translation: 证明他们是对的。解决这个局面。

english: I will. Where should I begin?
translation: 我会的。我该从哪里开始？

english: We need to avoid outright aggression. The safety of my son cannot be risked. I understand you were able to infiltrate the Emissaries and gain access to their temple?
translation: 我们需要避免直接冲突。我儿子的安全不能冒险。我听说你能够潜入特使组织并进入他们的寺庙？

english: Then do so again. Gather any information you can on what they are doing with my son, then return to me here. Do not give me a reason to regret this decision.
translation: 那就再做一次。收集任何关于他们对我儿子做了什么的情报，然后回来向我报告。不要给我后悔这个决定的理由。

english: I won't let you down. You have my word.
translation: 我不会让你失望的。我向你保证。

english: Good luck, my child. May the sun light your way.
translation: 祝你好运，我的孩子。愿阳光为你照亮道路。

english: I just need to do something else first, but I'll be back soon.
translation: 我还有别的事要先处理，但我很快就会回来。

english: Don't take too long. The Queen doesn't like to be kept waiting.
translation: 别拖太久。女王不喜欢等人。

english: The Queen is waiting, my child. Let us go and speak with her.
translation: 女王在等著，我的孩子。我们去和她谈谈吧。

english: Nilsal, my child. I wish you luck at the Twilight Temple.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。祝你在暮光神庙好运。

english: Thank you. We'll have Itzla back soon. I promise.
translation: 谢谢你。我们很快就会把伊兹拉带回来。我保证。

english: You have the dedication of a true servant of Ralos. Keep safe, my child.
translation: 你展现了拉洛斯真正仆从的奉献精神。保重，我的孩子。

english: You have a job to do. Return to the Twilight Temple and uncover any information you may have missed when you were last there.
translation: 你有任务在身。回到暮光神庙，找出你上次去时可能遗漏的任何情报。

english: Good. Don't let me down.
translation: 很好。别让我失望。

english: ... and with the guidance of Ralos and Ranul, who stand beside us in our fight, we will be victorious!
translation: ……在拉洛斯和拉努尔的指引下，他们在我们的战斗中与我们同在，我们将会胜利！

english: I know recent setbacks have you questioning. I know you have concerns. You need not whisper them in the shadows, for you are free to question. More than that, you are encouraged to question!
translation: 我知道最近的挫折让你们产生怀疑。我知道你们有顾虑。你们不必在阴影中低语，因为你们可以自由地提出质疑。不仅如此，你们还被鼓励提出质疑！

english: After all, was it not your questions that brought you here? Did you not dare to ask them while others shied away in fear?
translation: 毕竟，难道不是你们的疑问把你们带到这里的吗？当其他人在恐惧中退缩时，你们不是敢于提出问题吗？

english: Remember this: We are the doubters! We are the outcasts! Society shunned us for it, but only those who question everything will ever find the truth.
translation: 记住这一点：我们是怀疑者！我们是被排斥者！社会因此排斥我们，但只有那些质疑一切的人才能找到真相。

english: And that truth? That is what we fight for. That is what will bring about the Final Dawn!
translation: 而那个真相？那就是我们为之战斗的东西。那就是将带来最终黎明的东西！

english: Let me now assure you, these setbacks have done nothing to stop us! The road to Mokhaiotl is clearer than ever! We have no need for the Teokan any more!
translation: 现在让我向你们保证，这些挫折丝毫没有阻止我们！通往莫凯奥特的道路比以往任何时候都更加清晰！我们不再需要特奥坎了！

english: Bring out the prisoner!
translation: 把囚犯带出来！

english: See how the rulers of this kingdom are powerless against us. Itzla Arkan, heir to the throne of Varlamore, is now our prisoner!
translation: 看看这个王国的统治者在我们面前是多么无力。伊兹拉.阿尔坎，瓦拉莫尔王位的继承人，现在是我们的囚犯！

english: You love it, don't you? Standing on a stage spouting nonsense to a bunch of fanatics! It means nothing, Metzli!
translation: 你很享受，对吧？站在台上对一群狂热者胡说八道！这毫无意义，梅兹利！

english: People like you always fear the truth. Do you know why? Because without your lies, all that you do, all that you live for, is meaningless.
translation: 像你这样的人总是害怕真相。你知道为什么吗？因为没有了你的谎言，你所做的一切，你为之而活的一切，都毫无意义。

english: But your fear, it can now end. Here, you finally have a purpose. Here, you can finally serve Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 但你的恐惧，现在可以结束了。在这里，你终于有了目标。在这里，你终于可以侍奉拉洛斯和拉努尔。

english: Do you not see? The blood of the Teokan runs through your veins. You are now the key to the Final Dawn!
translation: 你没看到吗？特奥坎之血在你血管中流淌。你现在是最终黎明的关键！

english: You want my blood? Take it! Just make sure you take it all! At least that way I won't have to listen to the garbage you spew any more!
translation: 你想要我的血？拿去吧！只要确保你全部拿走！至少这样我就不用再听你喷的那些垃圾话了！

english: Listen to the anger in his voice. It is a poor attempt to mask his fear. We need not fear though, for our purpose is clear.
translation: 听听他声音中的愤怒。这是在拙劣地掩盖他的恐惧。不过我们无需恐惧，因为我们的目标很明确。

english: Go now, for time is short, and there is much left to do. It will soon be time to deliver Twilight's Promise. It will soon be time for the Final Dawn!
translation: 现在去吧，时间紧迫，还有很多事要做。很快就是履行暮光之约的时候了。很快就是最终黎明的时候了！

english: Hmm... They brought Itzla in from downstairs...
translation: 嗯……他们从楼下把伊兹拉带进来了……

english: I can't let you down there without the passphrase.
translation: 没有暗号我不能让你下去。

english: Nice try. Only those worthy to know the passphrase may enter.
translation: 猜得不错。只有有资格知道暗号的人才能进入。

english: Oh, that was it?
translation: 哦，就这样？

english: That's right. Go right ahead.
translation: 没错。进去吧。

english: This area is off limits to you!
translation: 这个区域禁止你进入！

english: This is the restricted section!
translation: 这是限制区域！

english: You're not allowed to be here!
translation: 你不能待在这里！

english: There must be something useful here...
translation: 这里一定有什么有用的东西……

english: ... not to mention what happens when the Queen sends her forces to recover the Prince.
translation: ……更不用说女王派遣她的部队来营救王子时会发生什么了。

english: The Queen will not dare put her son in danger. Your worries are unfounded. Besides, I've already made arrangements for him to be moved elsewhere.
translation: 女王不敢拿她儿子的安全冒险。你的担心是没有根据的。再说，我已经安排把他转移到别处了。

english: Unfounded? Do you not see how risky this plan is? We should have stuck with Servius rather than revealing ourselves.
translation: 没有根据？你没看到这个计划有多冒险吗？我们应该坚持利用塞尔维乌斯，而不是暴露自己。

english: And if the opportunity presents itself, Servius will still make for a valid option. The trick here isn't to have one plan, it's to have many. We have enough options available that one of them will bear fruit.
translation: 如果有机会，塞尔维乌斯仍然是一个可行的选择。这里的诀窍不是只有一个计划，而是要有很多计划。我们有足够多的选择，其中一个总会奏效。

english: It won't matter how many options we have if we don't live long enough to see them through. You keep gambling with our future here!
translation: 如果我们活不到看到它们实现的那一天，有多少选择都没用。你一直在拿我们的未来赌博！

english: You should have more faith, Furia. Look at your brother. He's a true believer now.
translation: 你应该多点信心，富里亚。看看你弟弟。他现在是个真正的信徒了。

english: A fool is what he is.
translation: 他是个傻瓜。

english: Good job we have many uses for fools then...
translation: 幸好我们对傻瓜有很多用处……

english: That was close...
translation: 好险……

english: What is this? No one is allowed in here!
translation: 这是什么？谁都不准进来！

english: Give me that!
translation: 把它给我！

english: There's only one outcome for betraying the Augur...
translation: 背叛先知只有一个下场……

english: Facce me!
translation: 冲我来！

english: You've returned. I trust that means you have news for us?
translation: 你回来了。我相信这意味着你有消息要告诉我们？

english: I do. Itzla was being held at the temple, but they've now moved him elsewhere.
translation: 是的。伊兹拉之前被关在神庙里，但他们现在已经把他转移到别处了。

english: I don't know, but I did also find out that they have some sort of plan for him. They called him the key to the Final Dawn. Something to do with him having Servius' blood.
translation: 我不知道，但我也发现他们对他有某种计划。他们称他为最终黎明的关键。与他拥有塞维乌斯的血有关。

english: My blood? Do they wish to trigger the Gathering?
translation: 我的血？他们想触发集会吗？

english: The Gathering? What's the Gathering?
translation: 集会？什么是集会？

english: What it is isn't important right now. Do not lose focus on the matter at hand. If you don't know where they took my son, then how do you intend to find out?
translation: 那是什么现在不重要。不要分散对当前问题的注意力。如果你不知道他们把我儿子带到哪里去了，那你打算怎么查出来？

english: I discovered that Forebearer Janus, a senior member of the Emissaries, is living right here in Fortis in a cult safe house. I was thinking we could capture him and find out what he knows.
translation: 我发现先驱者雅努斯，使者中的一名高级成员，就住在福提斯的一个邪教安全屋里。我在想我们可以抓住他，弄清楚他知道什么。

english: Where is this safe house?
translation: 这个安全屋在哪里？

english: Directly opposite a bank apparently.
translation: 显然就在银行正对面。

english: Well, there are no houses opposite the eastern bank, so it must be the one looking over the western bank.
translation: 嗯，东边银行对面没有房子，所以一定是西边银行对面的那栋。

english: Then let's not waste any time. Adventurer, I will dispatch Captain Vibia of the Knights of Varlamore to this property. You will meet her there. Secure the property with her and capture this Forebearer Janus.
translation: 那么别浪费时间了。冒险者，我会派遣瓦拉莫尔骑士的维比娅船长到那处房产。你会在那里与她碰面。和她一起守住房产，抓住这个先驱者雅努斯。

english: I'll head over there at once.
translation: 我马上过去。

english: Good. May the sun light your way.
translation: 很好。愿阳光为你照亮道路。

english: Nilsal, my child. The Queen has given you a job to do. I suggest you get going. Keep safe out there.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。女王给了你一个任务。我建议你出发吧。在外面注意安全。

english: Adventurer, you should head to this cultist property near the western bank. Captain Vibia will meet you there.
translation: 冒险者，你应该前往西岸附近那处邪教徒的房产。维比娅船长会在那里与你会合。

english: I'll head over at once.
translation: 我马上过去。

english: Good, you're here. Shall we get started?
translation: 很好，你来了。我们开始吧？

english: I've been observing the property and it doesn't seem anyone is home. At least, not any people...
translation: 我一直在观察这处房产，似乎没人在家。至少，没有人……

english: People? Meaning...
translation: 人？意思是……

english: Dogs. There's one outside and at least one more in the house. I don't expect them to take kindly to intruders.
translation: 狗。外面有一只，房子里至少还有一只。我不指望它们会对入侵者友好。

english: We will secure the house and prepare a trap to capture this cultist leader upon their return. As we don't know exactly when that will be, I suggest we move quickly.
translation: 我们将控制那座房子，并布置一个陷阱，等这名邪教徒领袖回来时将其捕获。因为我们不知道他具体何时返回，我建议我们迅速行动。

english: First up, we need a way inside. I will keep watch out here while you find us that way in.
translation: 首先，我们需要一个进去的方法。我在外面把风，你去找进去的方法。

english: We're wasting time here. You need to find a way into this house.
translation: 我们在这里浪费时间。你需要找到进入这栋房子的方法。

english: That cultist could be back at any time. What's the hold up?
translation: 那个邪教徒随时可能回来。还在等什么？

english: I've found a way into the house, but there's a locked door I need to get past. I'll have it open soon.
translation: 我找到了进房子的路，但有一扇锁着的门需要过去。我很快就能打开它。

english: Good. Best you get back to it then.
translation: 很好。那你最好继续干活。

english: Good work. Now that the property is secure, we need to prepare for the return of this Forebearer Janus. I trust you brought supplies?
translation: 干得好。现在房产安全了，我们需要为这个先驱者雅努斯的归来做好准备。我相信你带了补给品吧？

english: Er... What kind of supplies?
translation: 呃...什么样的补给品？

english: First, we'll need a way to restrain him.
translation: 首先，我们需要一种方法来制服他。

english: Hmm... I don't think I have anything suitable on me.
translation: 嗯……我身上好像没有合适的东西。

english: Well, what about something to knock him out with?
translation: 那有没有什么东西可以把他打晕？

english: I don't think I have anything for that either. Shall I head out and gather some things?
translation: 我想我也没有那个。我要出去收集一些东西吗？

english: No. This cultist could be back at any moment and we need to make sure we're here when he does. Let's have a look around and see if there's anything in the house we can use instead.
translation: 不。这个邪教徒随时可能回来，我们必须确保他在的时候我们在这里。我们在房子里四处看看，有没有什么我们能用的东西。

english: So you're a Knight of Varlamore?
translation: 那么你是瓦拉莫尔骑士？

english: I am. What of it?
translation: 我是。那又怎样？

english: That makes Itzla your boss, right?
translation: 那伊茨拉就是你老板，对吧？

english: He is the leader of the Knights of Varlamore, though I am currently filling that role in his absense.
translation: 他是瓦拉莫尔骑士团的领袖，不过在他缺席期间，我暂代其职。

english: What do you think of this whole situation with him?
translation: 你对他的这件事怎么看？

english: I think we have a job to do, and I think we should get on with it rather than making small talk.
translation: 我觉得我们有任务在身，应该着手去做，而不是闲聊。

english: We need to prepare for the return of this Forebearer Janus. We'll need a way to restrain him and something to knock him out with. Let's have a look around and see if there's anything here we can use.
translation: 我们需要为这位先驱者雅努斯的回归做准备。得找个办法束缚他，再弄点东西把他打晕。我们四处看看，这里有没有什么能用的。

english: Reckon we can use this?
translation: 你觉得这个能用吗？

english: Hmm... I guess we could use this to restrain him, but I reckon we'll instead want something that can cover his head as well.
translation: 嗯……我想我们可以用这个来束缚他，但我认为我们更需要能盖住他头的东西。

english: No. I think that sack you gave me will be better for restraining him with.
translation: 不。我觉得你给我的那个麻袋更适合用来束缚他。

english: That thing looks brutal! We don't want to kill him!
translation: 那东西看起来太粗暴了！我们可不想杀了他！

english: You mean this thing could kill a person?
translation: 你是说这东西能杀人？

english: Quite possibily!
translation: 很有可能！

english: Oh... I didn't know that.
translation: 哦……我之前不知道。

english: That thing looks brutal! We don't want to kill him! Maybe you should use that other one you made instead.
translation: 那东西看起来太粗暴了！我们可不想杀了他！也许你应该用你做的另一个。

english: I found this upstairs.
translation: 我在楼上找到这个。

english: Very nice, but I'm not sure what use it has.
translation: 很不错，但我不确定它有什么用。

english: Yes, I think I can use this to restrain him with. I'll keep a hold of it.
translation: 是的，我想我可以用这个来束缚他。我会保管好它。

english: Hmm... Not on its own, I don't think.
translation: 嗯……光靠它自己，我觉得不行。

english: I made this from a few things I found.
translation: 我用找到的一些东西做了这个。

english: Perfect! You keep a hold of that and use it to subdue him when the time comes.
translation: 完美！你保管好它，到时候用它来制服他。

english: I think we have everything we need now.
translation: 我想我们现在需要的东西都齐了。

english: I believe you're right. Now just to wait for him to return home...
translation: 我想你说得对。现在就等他回来了……

english: Good dog.
translation: 好狗。

english: Hey, look! I'm a distraction!
translation: 嘿，看！我来吸引注意力！

english: Hey! Get this thing off me!
translation: 嘿！把这东西从我身上弄走！

english: Whack him!
translation: 揍他！

english: I've found the basement key.
translation: 我找到地下室的钥匙了。

english: Good. Down there will work nicely for interrogation. You get him ready. I'll fetch the Queen...
translation: 好。下面很适合审讯。你把他准备好。我去请女王来……

english: The Queen herself? Such an honour. Don't think for one second that I'm going to tell you anything though. Even death itself doesn't scare me.
translation: 女王亲自来？真是荣幸。不过别以为我会告诉你任何事。就算是死亡本身也吓不倒我。

english: Really? I've known a lot of people claim death doesn't scare them. From afar, bravery comes easy, but then the moment finally comes when they stare death in the face...
translation: 真的吗？我认识很多人声称死亡吓不倒他们。在远处，勇敢很容易，但当他们直面死亡的那一刻终于来临时……

english: That's when they break. If you think you're the exception, you will soon be disappointed.
translation: 那时他们就会崩溃。如果你认为自己是例外，你很快就会失望的。

english: Ha! You are out of touch, my Queen. I am a herald of the Final Dawn! For us, death is a glory to be celebrated!
translation: 哈！你落伍了，我的女王。我是最终黎明的先驱！对我们来说，死亡是值得庆祝的荣耀！

english: Then celebrate it you will, but first, you will talk.
translation: 那你就会庆祝它，但首先，你会开口的。

english: Leave me with him. Alone.
translation: 让我和他单独待着。

english: He talked.
translation: 他开口了。

english: It seems you were right Servius, the cultists wish to trigger the Gathering.
translation: 看来你说得对，塞维乌斯，邪教徒们想触发集会。

english: Sorry, but could someone explain what the Gathering is to me?
translation: 抱歉，谁能给我解释一下什么是集会吗？

english: It's the ceremony where a dead Teokan is laid to rest and their successor is chosen.
translation: 那是安葬已故特奥坎并选出其继任者的仪式。

english: But why is it so important to the cultists?
translation: 但为什么它对邪教徒们这么重要？

english: According to our recently departed iknami here, it's less about the ceremony and more about its location: The Crypt of Tonali, in the Tlati Rainforest. The cult believe the crypt houses the secret path to Mokhaiotl.
translation: 根据我们这位刚去世的伊克纳米所说，重点不在于仪式本身，而在于它的地点：特拉提雨林中的托纳利墓穴。邪教徒们相信墓穴中藏着通往莫凯奥特尔的秘密通道。

english: The Tlati Rainforest? Just like the nagua said...
translation: 特拉提雨林？就像那瓜说的那样……

english: Yes, Servius mentioned this nagua you encountered. What did she say?
translation: 是的，塞维乌斯提到过你遇到的那瓜。她说了什么？

english: Not much. She just referred to Mokhaiotl as the Tlati archive.
translation: 没说什么。她只是把莫凯奥特尔称为特拉提档案馆。

english: We should be weary of trusting the words of a nagua, my Queen.
translation: 我们应该谨慎对待那瓜的话，我的女王。

english: Perhaps, though it matters little whether we believe her or not. The cult do believe, and they will stop at nothing to access the crypt.
translation: 也许吧，不过我们信不信她并不重要。邪教徒们相信，他们会不惜一切代价进入墓穴。

english: The Gathering takes place behind a set of doors within the crypt. These doors can only be opened with the blood of the two Teokan.
translation: 集会在墓穴内的一扇门后举行。这扇门只能用两位特奥坎的血打开。

english: The cult are hoping to substitute Servius' blood with my son's, but it seems they are having issues in doing so. They have apparently chosen to seek help from the Dwarves of Cam Torum with this.
translation: 邪教徒们希望用我儿子的血来代替塞维乌斯的血，但看来他们在这方面遇到了麻烦。他们显然选择了向卡姆托鲁姆的矮人寻求帮助。

english: Why the dwarves?
translation: 为什么是矮人？

english: The crypt is the most holiest of places, built by the Old Ones themselves. However, the doors were a more recent addition, built by the dwarves. This was before relations soured between us...
translation: 墓穴是最神圣的地方，由古神们亲自建造。不过，门是后来才加的，由矮人建造。那是在我们关系恶化之前……

english: I see. So, to Cam Torum then?
translation: 我明白了。那么，就去卡姆托鲁姆？

english: To Cam Torum. Oh, and [player name]...
translation: 去卡姆托鲁姆。哦，还有[player name]……

english: You did well here. It seems Itzla was right to trust you.
translation: 你在这里做得很好。看来伊茨拉信任你是对的。

english: Thank you, my Queen.
