translation: 谢谢您，我的女王。

english: Now, we will depart at once. Are you ready to go?
translation: 现在，我们马上出发。你准备好走了吗？

english: I'll make my own way there.
translation: 我自己过去。

english: Very well, but let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，但如果你改变主意，就告诉我。

english: [Player name], do you wish to travel with us to Cam Torum?
translation: [Player name]，你想和我们一起去卡姆托鲁姆吗？

english: Nilsal, my child. We will soon be heading to Cam Torum. You should speak with the Queen if you wish to join us.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。我们很快就要去卡姆托鲁姆了。如果你想加入我们，应该和女王谈谈。

english: I hear you're heading to Cam Torum. You should not waste time.
translation: 我听说你要去卡姆托鲁姆。你不该浪费时间。

english: Are you not joining us?
translation: 你不和我们一起去吗？

english: No. I am to head to the Tlati Rainforest and ensure we have suitable defences around the Crypt of Tonali.
translation: 不。我要去特拉提雨林，确保我们在托纳利墓穴周围有合适的防御。

english: Makes sense. In that case, good luck.
translation: 有道理。那样的话，祝你好运。

english: And to you, adventurer. May the sun light your way.
translation: 也祝你好运，冒险者。愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: Zyanyi Arkan. What an unexpected surprise. Your business here must be very important for you to have not sent prior word of your coming.
translation: 齐扬尼.阿尔坎。真是个意外的惊喜。你在这里的事务一定非常重要，以至于没有事先通知你的到来。

english: I'm afraid the suddenness of our arrival was a necessity, though I'm pleased to see that it didn't prevent you from meeting us here personally, Highlord Katlo.
translation: 恐怕我们突然到来是不得已的，不过我很高兴这并没有妨碍您亲自来接我们，高阶领主卡特洛。

english: Well, what kind of ruler would I be if I didn't make sure to treat our honoured allies with the highest of respect?
translation: 嗯，如果我不确保以最高的敬意对待我们尊贵的盟友，那我还算什么统治者？

english: How very true.
translation: 说得太对了。

english: I heard about the unfortunate events at the Teomat, but it is good to see the Teokan has made a full recovery. No doubt those responsible met swift justice?
translation: 我听说了特奥马特修道院的不幸事件，但很高兴看到特奥坎完全康复了。毫无疑问，肇事者已经受到了迅速的惩罚？

english: Their days are numbered.
translation: 他们的日子不多了。

english: So they are still at large? How concerning. Still, I'm sure your son and his knights will be doing all they can to rectify that.
translation: 所以他们还在逃？真令人担忧。不过，我相信您的儿子和他的骑士们会尽一切努力纠正这一点。

english: Perhaps, Highlord, we should discuss the reason for our visit?
translation: 也许，高阶领主，我们应该谈谈我们来访的原因？

english: Yes, of course. What is it that brings you here?
translation: 是的，当然。是什么风把你吹来了？

english: We have reason to believe that enemies of Varlamore are operating within Cam Torum.
translation: 我们有理由相信，瓦拉莫尔的敌人正在卡姆托鲁姆内活动。

english: Enemies of Varlamore in Cam Torum? I couldn't even begin to imagine such a thing! Are you sure of this?
translation: 卡姆托鲁姆里有瓦拉莫尔的敌人？我简直无法想象这种事！你确定吗？

english: Very.
translation: 非常确定。

english: Then what can you tell me of these enemies?
translation: 那你能告诉我这些敌人的什么信息？

english: They are members of the Twilight Emissaries cult. The cult wish to gain access to the Crypt of Tonali, but they require dwarven help to do so.
translation: 他们是暮光使者邪教的成员。邪教想进入托纳利墓穴，但他们需要矮人的帮助才能做到。

english: I assure you, no cultist would have been granted access to the city. For a start, there are only four of us who even have the ability to grant that access.
translation: 我向你保证，不会有邪教徒被允许进入这座城市。首先，我们只有四个人有能力授予这种权限。

english: However, it is clear this is a matter of great importance to you. I will ensure that we keep a close eye out for any cultists.
translation: 不过，很明显这对你来说是一件非常重要的事情。我会确保我们密切关注任何邪教徒。

english: With respect, Highlord, these cultists are our enemy. I would ask that you let us find and deal with them personally.
translation: 恕我直言，高阶领主，这些邪教徒是我们的敌人。我请求您让我们亲自找到并处理他们。

english: I understand, and I would very much like to help you. However, a human investigation in Cam Torum would not be looked upon kindly by the citizens here.
translation: 我理解，我也很想帮助你。然而，人类在卡姆托鲁姆进行调查，这里的市民不会乐见其成。

english: If I may, Highlord, the human travelling with the Queen here is a friend to us. They are the one who helped us deal with the issues in the ruins beneath the city.
translation: 高阶领主，请容我说一句，和女王一起旅行的这位人类是我们的朋友。正是他们帮助我们解决了城市下方废墟中的问题。

english: If it is this human who is to be conducting the investigations here, I am sure they will act with discretion.
translation: 如果是这位人类在这里进行调查，我相信他们会谨慎行事的。

english: You are happy to vouch for them, Attala?
translation: 你愿意为他们担保吗，阿塔拉？

english: Very well. In that case, my good friends, I grant you permission to search for these cultists. Attala here will join you. Do let her know if there's anything at all that you need.
translation: 很好。那样的话，我的好朋友们，我准许你们搜索这些邪教徒。阿塔拉会加入你们。如果你们有任何需要，一定要告诉她。

english: Thank you, Highlord.
translation: 谢谢您，高阶领主。

english: Do not mention it. Dealing with Varlamorians is always such a pleasure. Now, I'm afraid I must depart, but I wish you good luck.
translation: 不用客气。和瓦拉莫雷人打交道总是很愉快。现在，恐怕我得走了，但我祝你好运。

english: I will wait for you in the market, [player name]. I have some ideas for where you might begin your search.
translation: 我会在市场等你，[player name]。我对你从哪里开始搜索有一些想法。

english: So you've worked with the dwarves here before? You are full of surprises, [player name].
translation: 所以你以前和这里的矮人合作过？你真是充满惊喜，[player name]。

english: I do my best.
translation: 我尽力而为。

english: Clearly. Now, time is of the essence here. Use the trust you have built with the dwarves to find and stop the cultists. Once you have done so, report to me at Tal Teklan in the Tlati Rainforest.
translation: 显然如此。现在，时间紧迫。利用你与矮人建立的信任，找到并阻止邪教徒。完成后，到特拉提雨林的塔尔.特克兰向我报告。

english: You're not staying?
translation: 你不留下吗？

english: No. My presence here will be a distraction, and I must ensure that the defences are ready at the Crypt of Tonali. However, I trust you will not let me down.
translation: 不。我在这里会分散注意力，而且我必须确保托纳利墓穴的防御准备就绪。不过，我相信你不会让我失望的。

english: I will stay as well. It is possible my knowledge will come in useful during the investigation.
translation: 我也会留下。我的知识在调查中可能会派上用场。

english: Nonsense. Need I remind you that you are still a target for the cultists? You will return to the palace.
translation: 胡说。需要我提醒你，你仍然是邪教徒的目标吗？你要回宫殿去。

english: The Emissaries hide everywhere. I am no safer at the palace than I am here.
translation: 使者无处不在。我在宫殿里并不比在这里安全。

english: Fine. But I will leave a bodyguard with you.
translation: 好吧。但我会给你留一个保镖。

english: You should not waste the Kualti on me.
translation: 你不该把库阿尔蒂浪费在我身上。

english: No I shouldn't, and yet here we are. Now, let us get to work. Good luck to you both, and may the sun light your way.
translation: 我是不该，但事已至此。现在，我们开始工作吧。祝你们俩好运，愿阳光照亮你们的道路。

english: Thank you, my Queen. Come, [player name], let us meet with this dwarf in the market.
translation: 谢谢您，我的女王。来吧，[player name]，我们去市场见这位矮人。

english: I'd love to stop and chat with you, but I know you're very busy. Might I suggest you seek out Attala? She'll be more than happy to help you out with your investigation.
translation: 我很想停下来跟你聊聊，但我知道你非常忙。不如我建议你去找阿塔拉？她会很乐意协助你进行调查的。

english: I'll go and see her now.
translation: 我现在就去找她。

english: When I vouched for you back there, [player name], I wasn't expecting you to bring a Teokan with you.
translation: 当初我为你担保时，[player name]，可没料到你会带个特奥坎过来。

english: He's here to help.
translation: 他是来帮忙的。

english: Hmph. Help with what exactly? You claim there are cultists in our city who want access this crypt of yours, but you haven't said why. What's so special about the crypt?
translation: 哼。帮什么忙？你说有邪教徒想进入你们那个墓穴，但你没说原因。那墓穴有什么特别的？

english: They think it hides a path to Mokhaiotl.
translation: 他们认为那里藏有一条通往莫凯奥特的路。

english: Ah, of course they do. Don't you humans ever tire of your fantasies?
translation: 啊，他们当然会这么想。你们人类就永远不能停止幻想吗？

english: Mokhaiotl is no fantasy!
translation: 莫凯奥特并非幻想！

english: Why? Have you been yourself?
translation: 是吗？你去过？

english: Of course not! No human can reach Mokhaiotl!
translation: 当然没有！没有人类能到达莫凯奥特！

english: Ha! And yet here you are trying to stop some cultists from doing just that!
translation: 哈！可你现在不正是在阻止某些邪教徒做到这点吗！

english: Their beliefs are false! They follow the words of a lying heathen!
translation: 他们的信仰是错的！他们追随一个说谎异教徒的言论！

english: Ah, of course! A lying heathen. Just like us here, no doubt?
translation: 啊，当然！一个说谎的异教徒。就像我们一样，毫无疑问？

english: Okay, let's put a stop to this before things get out of hand. Attala, you said you had an idea for where we could start our search?
translation: 好了，在事情失控前先打住吧。阿塔拉，你说你有主意知道我们从哪里开始搜索？

english: Hmph. As the Highlord said, there are only four dwarves who can grant humans access to Cam Torum. They are myself, the Highlord, Highseer Vandra, and Teumo, Vandra's advisor.
translation: 哼。正如大领主所说，只有四个矮人能授予人类进入卡姆托瑞姆的权限。分别是我、大领主、先知范德拉，以及范德拉的顾问特乌莫。

english: And you suspect someone?
translation: 你怀疑谁？

english: Not exactly, but of those, Teumo is the most likely candidate. I trust the Highlord and the Highseer, and I know for a fact it wasn't me.
translation: 也不算怀疑，但其中特乌莫是最有可能的。我信任大领主和先知，而且我很确定不是我。

english: Let's start with Teumo then. Where can we find him?
translation: 那就从特乌莫开始吧。我们在哪里能找到他？

english: His house is the one behind the bank, east of here. Let us meet there.
translation: 他的房子在银行后面，从这里往东走。我们在那里碰头。

english: ... and that he should be back soon. Why do you need to see him anyway, Attala? And how come you have a human priest with you?
translation: ……而且他应该很快就回来。不过你为什么要见他，阿塔拉？你怎么还带了个人类祭司过来？

english: Believe me, the priest wasn't my choice.
translation: 相信我，这祭司可不是我选的。

english: Anyway, don't worry yourself, Galna. It's not an urgent matter by any means. It's just a little project that Teumo was working on that needs finishing off.
translation: 总之，别担心，加尔纳。这绝对不是要紧的事。只是特乌莫之前在做一个小项目，需要收尾而已。

english: Speaking of which, do you mind if we take a look around while we wait for him? I imagine he'll have left some things from his project here.
translation: 说到这个，不介意我们在等他时四处看看吧？我想他应该留下了一些项目相关的东西在这里。

english: Oh, I suppose so. Do keep out of the basement though. Teumo doesn't like people going down there.
translation: 哦，我想可以吧。但别去地下室。特乌莫不喜欢别人下去。

english: He doesn't? Very well...
translation: 他不喜欢？好的……

english: Is there anything we can get for you while we wait, Galna? Given we came barging in on you, it's the least we can do.
translation: 我们等你的时候，有什么可以帮你拿的吗，加尔纳？既然我们贸然闯进来，这是起码的心意。

english: Oh, thank you, but I'm fine.
translation: 哦，谢谢，不过不用了。

english: Not even a drink?
translation: 连杯喝的都不要？

english: Very tempting, but I shouldn't really start drinking at this time...
translation: 很诱人，但这时候我不该开始喝酒……

english: Nilsal, my child. Perhaps there is something here that can be of use to us. You should have a look around.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。也许这里有些东西能帮到我们。你应该四处看看。

english: Are you sure you wouldn't fancy a drink?
translation: 你确定不想来一杯？

english: Well, I guess it would be rude to say no...
translation: 嗯，我想拒绝就太不礼貌了……

english: Thanks again for letting us look around, Galna.
translation: 再次感谢你让我们四处看看，加尔纳。

english: Not at all! My home is yours. Go wherever you want!
translation: 别客气！我家就是你家。想去哪就去哪！

english: Teumo must have had a reason for not wanting people down here. Let's find out what it is.
translation: 特乌莫一定有个理由不想让人下来这里。让我们找出原因。

english: Interesting... Whatever you did caused the fire to go out...
translation: 有趣……你做了什么让火熄灭了……

english: So what's your take on this Mokhaiotl business?
translation: 那么你对这个莫凯奥特的事情怎么看？

english: Well, just so I'm understanding correctly, there's a cult who believe there is a path to the centre of the world?
translation: 好吧，让我确认一下，有个邪教相信有一条通往世界中心的路？

english: And what do they intend to do once they get there?
translation: 他们到了那里打算做什么？

english: They're claiming that two of the cultists are Ralos and Ranul reborn. They believe that once the two of them reach Mokhaiotl, the world will be destroyed and then remade once more.
translation: 他们声称其中两个邪教徒是拉洛斯和拉努尔的转世。他们相信一旦这两人到达莫凯奥特，世界将被摧毁，然后再度重塑。

english: Of course! What a totally normal thing to believe. Only humans would ever manage to reach this level of silliness.
translation: 当然啦！多幺正常的信仰。只有人类才会愚蠢到这个地步。

english: Do not tar us all with the same brush. Most humans would never believe the nonsense those cultists spread.
translation: 别把我们所有人都一棍子打死。大多数人类绝不会相信那些邪教徒散布的胡言乱语。

english: No, you just believe a different nonsense. I must admit, to those of us who live in the real world, it can sometimes be hard to tell the difference.
translation: 不，你们只是相信另一种胡言乱语罢了。我得承认，对我们这些活在现实世界的人来说，有时很难分辨其中的差别。

english: Anyway, as for my take, your cultists are going to end up disappointed. There is no Mokhaiotl. The only path they will find is one leading to their deaths.
translation: 总之，依我看，你们的邪教徒会大失所望。根本没有莫凯奥特。他们只会找到一条通往死亡的路。

english: And yet, it isn't just them who have spoken of it.
translation: 然而，提到它的不只是他们。

english: I encountered a nagua who called Mokhaiotl an archive.
translation: 我遇到过一个纳瓜，他把莫凯奥特称为一个档案库。

english: Really? How curious... Hard to know what that might mean though. Nagua are not known for being reliable.
translation: 真的吗？真奇怪……不过很难知道这意味着什么。纳瓜向来不可靠。

english: Ah, something we agree on.
translation: 啊，这点我们倒是有共识。

english: So you don't think she was telling the truth?
translation: 那么你觉得她没说真话？

english: The truth isn't something that ever seems to matter to your kind. This cult has already made up their minds on what they believe, just as your priest here has as well.
translation: 真相对你这种人来说从来都不重要。这个邪教已经对自己相信的东西心有成见，就像你这位祭司一样。

english: But I'm not asking them. I'm asking you. What do you believe?
translation: 但我不是在问他们。我在问你。你相信什么？

english: That Ralos doesn't exist. That Ranul doesn't exist. That Mokhaiotl doesn't exist. It's as simple as that. Now, if that answer satisfies you, shall we get back to work?
translation: 我相信拉洛斯不存在。拉努尔不存在。莫凯奥特不存在。就这么简单。现在，如果这个答案让你满意了，我们可以继续干活了吗？

english: Nilsal, my child. Perhaps there is something here that can be of use to us. You should have a look around and see what you can find.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。也许这里有些东西能帮到我们。你应该四处看看，找找有什么线索。

english: Nilsal, my child. It looks like you're making progress. Keep at it.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。看来你有所进展。继续努力。

english: If it's okay to ask, what's the deal with you and the Queen?
translation: 如果方便问的话，你和女王之间是什么关系？

english: How do you mean, my child?
translation: 你这是什么意思，我的孩子？

english: Well, you're Itzla's father and she's his mother, but the two of you don't seem too close.
translation: 嗯，你是伊茨拉的父亲，她是他的母亲，但你们俩似乎不太亲近。

english: We are incredibly close, for we are united in Ralos' light, and in the love we share for Itzla. However, it would be fair to say that our relationship is not a conventional one, especially to an outsider.
translation: 我们非常亲近，因为我们因拉洛斯的光芒和我们共同对伊茨拉的爱而团结。不过，可以说我们的关系并不传统，尤其在外人看来。

english: So how did it come about?
translation: 那是怎么发生的？

english: In times of old, the ruler of Varlamore would often unite with a Teokan of Ralos. His light guides us in all things, and a King or Queen will need that guidance more than most.
translation: 在古时，瓦拉莫尔的统治者常与拉洛斯的特奥坎结合。他的光芒在万事上指引我们，而国王或女王比大多数人更需要那种指引。

english: Before she took the throne, the Queen made the decision to revive that old tradition. I was more than happy to accept.
translation: 在女王登基前，她决定复兴这项古老传统。我当然欣然接受。

english: I see. Thanks for explaining.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的解释。

english: Do not mention it, my child.
translation: 不客气，我的孩子。

english: These dwarves sure love their drink.
translation: 这些矮人可真爱喝酒。

english: Must we wear these nasty things?
translation: 我们非得穿这些恶心的东西吗？

english: They're called disguises, brother.
translation: 这叫伪装，兄弟。

english: We shouldn't have need to disguise ourselves. We shouldn't be here at all. This dwarf can't be trusted.
translation: 我们根本不需要伪装。我们根本就不该来这里。这个矮人不可信。

english: If you have any better suggestions, I'm all ears...
translation: 如果你有更好的建议，我洗耳恭听……

english: Ah, there you are. Oh, I'm sorry, am I meant to bow?
translation: 啊，你来了。哦，抱歉，我是不是该鞠躬？

english: You jest, dwarf, but you should show some respect.
translation: 你在开玩笑，矮人，但你应该表现出一些尊重。

english: Yes, of course, Your... Holiness? Your Excellency? I'm sorry, I've never had the luck of meeting a god before. What is your preferred title?
translation: 是的，当然，您的……圣洁？您的阁下？抱歉，我以前从没福气见过神。您喜欢什么头衔？

english: Enough! Do not push me, dwarf!
translation: 够了！别逼我，矮人！

english: Why? You are powerless to do anything about it. Without me, you go back to your Augur empty handed. I get the feeling she wouldn't like that.
translation: 为什么？你拿我没办法。没有我，你就得空手回到你的占卜师那里。我猜她可不会高兴。

english: Well then it's a good thing we do not answer to her.
translation: 那正好，我们可不听命于她。

english: No? If that's the case, then why are you doing her bidding? Of all the people she could have sent here, why did she pick her gods reborn?
translation: 不是吗？如果是这样，那你为什么替她办事？她可以派来那么多人，为什么偏偏选了她的转世之神？

english: The blood of Ralos flows through my veins, dwarf! When we reach Mokhaiotl, you will see for yourself.
translation: 拉洛斯的血在我血管里流淌，矮人！等我们到达莫凯奥特，你自己就会看到。

english: Ha! And what will you see? What happens when you reach the apparent centre of the world, only to discover that everything you thought you knew, was wrong?
translation: 哈！那你会看到什么？当你到达所谓的世界的中心，却发现你所知的一切都是错的，那会怎样？

english: You think you're so...
translation: 你以为你很……

english: Calm yourself, brother. Arguing gets us nowhere. Tell us, dwarf, can it be done?
translation: 冷静点，兄弟。争吵无济于事。告诉我们，矮人，这事能成吗？

english: Yes, I believe so. However, it will not be straightforward.
translation: 是的，我相信可以。不过，不会那么容易。

english: I will need you to retrieve something for me. The crypt doors are sealed using the magic of an Old One keystone. I will need one of these keystones for myself if I am to have any success.
translation: 我需要你们帮我取一样东西。墓穴的门是用远古生物基石的魔法封印的。如果我想成功，就需要其中一块基石。

english: And where will we find one of those?
translation: 我们去哪里找一块？

english: It is a keystone that keeps the nagua imprisoned in Neypotzli. I'm sure it can't be the only one in there.
translation: 那是用来把纳瓜关在内波茨利监狱的基石。那里肯定不止一块。

english: Then go in and find one for yourself. We do not serve you.
translation: 那你自己进去找一块。我们不为你服务。

english: So you claim, and yet you don't actually have a choice. If you want my help, you'll find me a keystone.
translation: 话是这么说，但你们其实别无选择。如果你们想要我的帮助，就给我找块基石来。

english: You will have it. Just make sure you are ready.
translation: 你会得到它的。只要确保你准备好了。

english: Of course! I assume you've already sorted my payment?
translation: 当然！我猜你已经安排好了我的报酬？

english: Yes, as agreed.
translation: 是的，按约定。

english: Enjoy it while you can. That money won't mean anything once this is over.
translation: 趁现在好好享受吧。等这一切结束后，那些钱就一文不值了。

english: Ah, truth be told, the money is just a bonus. The chance to be the one to show you fools the truth... That, my friends, is the real prize.
translation: 啊，老实说，钱只是额外的奖励。有机会成为那个向你们这群傻瓜揭示真相的人……那才是真正的奖品，朋友们。

english: Anyway, best we all get to work. You have a keystone to find.
translation: 好了，我们最好都开始行动。你们有块基石要去找。

english: That didn't sound good. I'd better let Attala and Servius know.
translation: 这听起来不妙。我最好去通知阿塔拉和塞尔维乌斯。

english: You're back! Did you find something?
translation: 你回来了！找到什么了吗？

english: I did. You were right, Attala. Teumo is the one helping the cultists. He's sent them to Neypotzli to find something he calls an Old One keystone.
translation: 找到了。你说得对，阿塔拉。特乌莫就是帮助邪教徒的人。他派他们去内波茨利监狱找一种他称之为‘远古生物基石’的东西。

english: More trouble in Neypotzli? Great! This is just what we need!
translation: 内波茨利监狱又有麻烦了？太棒了！这正是我们需要的！

english: What do we do?
translation: 我们该怎么办？

english: Servius, go to Tal Teklan. If we can't stop them from getting that keystone, they'll have everything they need to enter the crypt. You need to make sure the Queen is ready.
translation: 塞尔维乌斯，去塔尔泰克兰。如果我们无法阻止他们拿到那块基石，他们就有进入墓穴所需的一切了。你必须确保女王做好准备。

english: I'll gather some guards and see if we can find Teumo. While I do that, [player name], you should go to Neypotzli and find the cultists.
translation: 我去召集一些守卫，看看能不能找到特乌莫。与此同时，[player name]，你应该去内波茨利监狱找那些邪教徒。

english: Alright, let's get to it.
translation: 好的，开始行动吧。

english: Good luck, [player name]. May the sun light your way.
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。愿太阳照亮你的道路。

english: Thank you for that drink, human. Please do stay as long as you want!
translation: 谢谢你的饮料，人类。请随意待多久都行！

english: Ah, good day to you, human. I hear from Attala that you have urgent business in Neypotzli. Don't let me keep you.
translation: 啊，你好，人类。我从阿塔拉那里听说你在内波茨利监狱有急事。别让我耽误你。

english: Old One? A curious term. We nagua measure time as the rivers change their paths and as the mountains errode away.
translation: 古老者？一个奇怪的术语。我们纳瓜人测量时间的方式是河流改道、山脉侵蚀。

english: How does this fragment work?
translation: 这个碎片怎么用？

english: It resonates with the magic of the other keystone. It will guide you to it. You must go there and find the interlopers. They must be removed from Neypotzli.
translation: 它与另一块基石的魔法共鸣。它会指引你找到它。你必须去那里找到那些闯入者。他们必须被赶出内波茨利监狱。

english: Well, look who's here! It's Itzla's little lapdog!
translation: 哟，看看谁来了！是伊茨拉的小跟班！

english: Call me what you want, but the fun's over. You're not going anywhere with that keystone.
translation: 随你怎么叫，但游戏结束了。你带着那块基石哪儿也去不了。

english: Call her in.
translation: 叫她进来。

english: Metzli!
translation: 梅茨利！

english: Ah, the outsider. I see you survived your encounter with the nagua.
translation: 啊，外来者。看来你从与纳瓜人的遭遇中活下来了。

english: It will take more than that to kill me.
translation: 要杀我可没那么容易。

english: Clearly. It's a shame you've chosen to fight against the truth. One such as yourself would have served us well.
translation: 显然。可惜你选择了对抗真相。像你这样的人本可以为我们所用。

english: Still, no matter. The Final Dawn will soon be upon us, and it will see us all become equal in servitude to our gods.
translation: 不过，没关系。最终黎明即将降临，它将让我们所有人都平等地侍奉我们的神。

english: You two, guide this one to Mictl. Be sure not to underestimate [him/her/them].
translation: 你们两个，带这个家伙去米克特尔。千万别低估[him/her/them]。

english: *sigh* Alright, let's get this over with...
translation: *叹气* 好吧，赶紧了结这事吧……

english: No, Chimalli!
translation: 不，奇马利！

english: No, Lucius!
translation: 不，卢修斯！

english: There you are, [player name]. That nagua told us how to find you.
translation: 你来了，[player name]。那个纳瓜人告诉了我们怎么找到你。

english: Well, I'm sorry to say you missed the fun. They got away, Attala. I wasn't able to stop them in time.
translation: 嗯，很遗憾你错过了好戏。他们逃走了，阿塔拉。我没能及时阻止他们。

english: I see. That's not the only bad news, I'm afraid. We searched the whole city, but couldn't find any trace of Teumo. My guess is he's already left to go join those cultists.
translation: 我明白了。恐怕坏消息还不止这个。我们搜遍了全城，但没找到特乌莫的任何踪迹。我猜他已经离开去加入那些邪教徒了。

english: Meaning they now have everything they need to enter the crypt.
translation: 这意味着他们现在有了进入墓穴所需的一切。

english: Sounds like you should head to Tal Teklan and report to your Queen then.
translation: 听起来你应该去塔尔.特克兰向你的女王报告了。

english: Before I go, Attala, I'm guessing we shouldn't expect any help from Cam Torum?
translation: 在我走之前，阿塔拉，我猜我们不应该指望卡姆.托鲁姆的任何帮助？

english: You know as well as I do, [player name], these cultists are fools. There is no world ending threat here, nor any threat to Cam Torum. This is a human problem. It's for humans to deal with.
translation: 你和我一样清楚，[player name]，这些邪教徒是傻瓜。这里没有世界末日的威胁，对卡姆.托鲁姆也没有威胁。这是人类的问题。该由人类来处理。

english: I suspected as much.
translation: 我猜到了。

english: If it's any consolation, I hope you don't die. You're one of the few humans that I don't tire of interacting with. Now, I'd better go report to the Highlord.
translation: 如果这能让你好受点，我希望你别死。你是少数几个我不厌烦打交道的人类之一。现在，我最好去向大领主报告了。

english: Well, things were quiet for a while, but then you dug up that Teumo business. The Highlord and the Highseer were both rather unhappy. The Highseer in particular. She now needs to find a new advisor.
translation: 嗯，事情平静了一阵子，但后来你挖出了特乌莫那档子事。大领主和大先知都很不高兴。尤其是大先知。她现在需要找一个新的顾问。

english: Speaking of which, how are things with that cult?
translation: 说到这个，那个邪教怎么样了？

english: We're still working on trying to stop them.
translation: 我们还在努力阻止他们。

english: Well, good luck with it. Oh, and try not to cause any problems that might affect us while you do so. The dwarves around here don't need a new reason to hate your kind.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。哦，还有，做的时候尽量别惹出可能影响我们的麻烦。这附近的矮人不需要新的理由来恨你们这类人。

english: [player name]! Thank Ralos you're here!
translation: [player name]！感谢拉洛斯你来了！

english: The Crypt of Tonali is under attack! The Queen has already gone to help. You should go yourself at once!
translation: 托纳利墓穴正在遭受攻击！女王已经去帮忙了。你应该立刻亲自去！

english: I'll head there right away!
translation: 我马上就去！

english: The crypt is impossible to miss. It's beneath the large temple south east of here. Go, my child! Go with the strength of Ralos!
translation: 墓穴很容易找到，就在这里东南方的大神庙下面。去吧，我的孩子！带着拉洛斯的力量去吧！

english: [player name], you must go to the Crypt of Tonali and help with the defence. It's beneath the large temple south east of here.
translation: [player name]，你必须去托纳利墓穴协助防御。它就在这里东南方的大神庙下面。

english: Go with the strength of Ralos, my child!
translation: 带着拉洛斯的力量去吧，我的孩子！

english: The crypt is under attack! It must be defended!
translation: 墓穴正在遭受攻击！必须守住！

english: Hold the line! We must not let them get to those doors!
translation: 守住防线！我们不能让他们靠近那些门！

english: Adventurer, about time you showed up! Hold them back! If we let too many defenders fall, nothing will stop those cultists getting through!
translation: 冒险者，你总算来了！挡住他们！如果我们让太多守卫倒下，就没什么能阻止那些邪教徒通过了！

english: :Defend the warriors, [player name]! We can't let too many fall!
translation: :保护战士们，[player name]！我们不能让太多人倒下！

english: :Thank you, iknami!
translation: :谢谢你，伊克纳米！

english: :[player name]! Focus on the cultists!
translation: :[player name]！集中攻击邪教徒！

english: :Protect our warriors, [player name]!
translation: :保护我们的战士，[player name]！

english: Watch out! More are coming!
translation: 小心！更多敌人来了！

english: Do not let them through!
translation: 别让他们通过！

english: It's time!
translation: 是时候了！

english: Mother...
translation: 母亲……

english: Get him to safety! Ensure he's unharmed!
translation: 带他到安全的地方！确保他毫发无伤！

english: Now, let's get after them!
translation: 现在，我们追上去！

english: She's gone, Ennius! Don't you see? We've been abandoned!
translation: 她走了，恩尼乌斯！你没看到吗？我们被抛弃了！

english: She would not abandon us! We are her gods!
translation: 她不会抛弃我们的！我们是她的神！

english: Gods?! My dear brother, how are you this much of a fool?
translation: 神？！我亲爱的兄弟，你怎么这么蠢？

english: Don't tell me now that you deny our destiny?! After all that we've done... you now decide that you don't believe?
translation: 别告诉我你现在要否认我们的命运？！在我们做了这一切之后……你现在决定不相信了？

english: Now? Ennius, I never believed!
translation: 现在？恩尼乌斯，我从来就没相信过！

english: Then what was it all for?!
translation: 那这一切都是为了什么？！

english: Yes, Furia, what was it for? You betrayed your people. You betrayed your Queen. Why?
translation: 是啊，富里亚，是为了什么？你背叛了你的人民。你背叛了你的女王。为什么？

english: Why? Because it was you who betrayed your people! You destroyed everything we stood for when you decided to open our kingdom! You are not worthy of the throne!
translation: 为什么？因为是你背叛了你的人民！当你决定开放我们的王国时，你摧毁了我们所代表的一切！你不配坐上王位！

english: So Metzli promised the throne to you instead? Is that it? Seems like that's not going so well.
translation: 所以梅茨利把王位许诺给了你？是这样吗？看来进展不太顺利啊。

english: You lied to me, Furia!
translation: 你骗了我，富里亚！

english: I was creating a future for us, brother!
translation: 我是在为我们创造未来，兄弟！

english: And now that future is at an end. Come quietly. Metzli has abandoned you. You have nowhere left to run.
translation: 而现在那个未来已经结束了。乖乖投降吧。梅茨利抛弃了你。你已经无处可逃了。

english: So you can parade us in front of the people before you put us out of our misery? No. This ends here.
translation: 好让你在我们了结痛苦之前把我们游街示众？不。就在这里结束吧。

english: Ennius...
translation: 恩尼乌斯……

english: So be it. Kill them both.
translation: 那就这样吧。两个都杀了。

english: :The sun burns within me!
translation: :太阳在我体内燃烧！

english: Such a waste.
translation: 真是浪费。

english: What happened to Furia?
translation: 富里亚怎么了？

english: Forgive me, my Queen. She was injured, but she managed to escape down into the caverns.
translation: 请原谅我，我的女王。她受伤了，但她设法逃进了下面的洞穴。

english: And Metzli's still down there as well. This isn't over yet.
translation: 而且梅茨利也还在下面。这还没完。

english: My Queen.
translation: 我的女王。

english: Itzla? What are you doing here? Why aren't you resting?
translation: 伊茨拉？你在这里做什么？为什么不去休息？

english: I heard Metzli got away. I'm here to help.
translation: 我听说梅茨利逃走了。我来帮忙。

english: Mother... This is my burden to bear. Let me finish this.
translation: 母亲……这是我该承担的重担。让我来结束这一切。

english: We've only just got you back, and you want me to send you after her?
translation: 我们才刚刚把你找回来，你就想让我派你去追她？

english: You were going to go yourself, even though they need you up here. Why you and not me?
translation: 你本来要亲自去的，尽管上面需要你。为什么是你而不是我？

english: [player name], keep my fool of a son alive, would you?
translation: [player name]，让我这个傻儿子活着，好吗？

english: Go, the both of you, before I change my mind.
translation: 去吧，你们两个，趁我还没改变主意。

english: Itzla... [player name]...
translation: 伊茨拉……[player name]……

english: Be careful down there. May the sun light your way.
translation: 下面小心。愿太阳照亮你的道路。

english: Nagua! I'll deal with them. You go on ahead. Don't worry, I'll catch up.
translation: 纳瓜人！我来对付他们。你先走。别担心，我会跟上的。

english: Can you believe this place was down here all this time? We had no idea!
translation: 你能相信这个地方一直就在下面吗？我们完全不知道！

english: You never knew all this was right underneath one of your holy sites?
translation: 你们从来不知道这一切就在你们的一个圣地下面？

english: Well... sort of, I suppose. We always knew the crypt was originally built by the Old Ones, but we had no idea how far all of this stretched. It's not like anyone was ever allowed to come down here and check!
translation: 嗯……算是吧，我想。我们一直都知道墓穴最初是由古老者建造的，但我们不知道这一切延伸了多远。又不是说有人被允许下来检查过！

english: Anyway, there hasn't been any sign of Metzli or Furia, but they must have come this way. Let's have a look around and see if we can find a way forward.
translation: 总之，还没有梅茨利或富里亚的踪迹，但他们肯定是从这条路来的。我们四处看看，能不能找到前进的路。

english: Any thoughts on where to start?
translation: 有什么想法从哪里开始吗？

english: Well, we seem to have more of these strange teleport tiles here... Maybe we should see where they lead?
translation: 嗯，这里似乎有更多这种奇怪的传送瓷砖……也许我们应该看看它们通向哪里？

english: We're making progress. Let's keep it up.
translation: 我们正在取得进展。继续加油。

english: Well, we managed to activate a statue in one of these rooms. My guess is we now need to activate the one in the other.
translation: 嗯，我们成功激活了其中一个房间里的雕像。我猜我们现在需要激活另一个房间里的那个。

english: This room is fascinating...
translation: 这个房间真迷人……

english: I think we're making progress, [player name].
translation: 我觉得我们正在取得进展，[player name]。

english: Any ideas on what to do?
translation: 有什么想法该怎么做吗？

english: Well, we've got another one of those statues, and these altars around the edges also look important. The layout of the room seems quite specific as well. It's almost like a compass, or maybe even a clock!
translation: 嗯，我们又有一个那种雕像了，而且边缘的这些祭坛看起来也很重要。房间的布局似乎也很有讲究。它几乎就像一个指南针，或者甚至是一个钟！

english: A clock? But there's only eight points.
translation: 一个钟？但只有八个点。

english: True, but maybe the Old Ones used a different kind of clock to us...
translation: 没错，但也许古老者用的是和我们不同的钟……

english: Well, this thing we're doing with the altars seems to be working, so I say we just keep doing that.
translation: 嗯，我们正在用祭坛做的这件事似乎有效，所以我说我们就继续这么做。

english: Of course, iknami! What do you need translating?
translation: 当然，伊克纳米！你需要翻译什么？

english: Oma? I think that means two.
translation: Oma？我想那是二的意思。

english: Naui? This is the one I struggle with. It might mean four.
translation: Naui？这个我拿不准。可能是四的意思。

english: Kuli? I think that means five.
translation: Kuli？我想那是五的意思。

english: Chaki? I think that means six.
translation: Chaki？我想那是六的意思。

english: Koma? I think that means seven.
translation: 科马？我想那是七的意思。

english: Ueai? I think that means eight.
translation: 乌艾？我想那是八的意思。

english: Makti? I think that means ten.
translation: 马克提？我想那是十的意思。

english: Hmm... I'm not too sure on that one.
translation: 嗯……这个我不太确定。

english: Very funny, [player name].
translation: 真幽默，[player name]。

english: Thanks! Could you translate another?
translation: 谢了！能再翻译一个吗？

english: Thanks! I'm done translating for now.
translation: 谢了！我暂时翻译完了。

english: Hopefully it helps in some way, iknami.
translation: 希望能帮上点忙，伊克纳米。

english: What do you make of this essence I found?
translation: 你觉得我找到的这个精华是什么？

english: Hmm... It looks similar to the altars around the room. Where did you find it?
translation: 嗯……看起来和房间周围的祭坛很像。你在哪里找到的？

english: In these urns scattered around.
translation: 在这些散落的瓮里。

english: Well, I doubt it was left here by accident...
translation: 嗯，我不觉得它是偶然留在这里的……

english: :That seemed to do the trick! Keep it up.
translation: ：看来这招管用了！继续加油。

english: Ah, the teleporter seems to have separated us.
translation: 啊，传送器似乎把我们分开了。

english: Well, I might still be able to be of use from here. These look like pressure plates. I might be able to use them to help you in some way.
translation: 嗯，我在这里或许还能帮上忙。这些看起来像是压力板。我或许能用它们以某种方式帮你。

english: Any idea what we should be doing here?
translation: 知道我们在这里该做什么吗？

english: Well, these look like pressure plates where I am. I might be able to use them to help you in some way.
translation: 嗯，我这里这些看起来像是压力板。我或许能用它们以某种方式帮你。

english: Any idea what that 'some way' might be?
translation: 知道那个‘某种方式’可能是什么吗？

english: I'm not really sure. Those braziers around the room look like they could be important though.
translation: 我不太确定。不过房间周围那些火盆看起来可能很重要。

english: Alright, I'll see if I can work something out.
translation: 好吧，我看看能不能想出什么办法。

english: Well, it seems I can use these pressure plates to help you get past the fires. Beyond that, I'm not too sure. Those braziers around the room look like they could be important though.
translation: 嗯，看来我可以用这些压力板帮你穿过火焰。除此之外，我就不太确定了。不过房间周围那些火盆看起来可能很重要。

english: We seem to be making progress, [player name]. Keep it up.
translation: 我们似乎有进展了，[player name]。继续加油。

english: I'm already there, [player name].
translation: 我已经到了，[player name]。

english: Whatever you're doing seems to be working. Keep at it!
translation: 不管你在做什么，似乎都有效。继续干！

english: Nice work, [player name]! I think you did it!
translation: 干得好，[player name]！我想你成功了！

english: I think that's us done here. I guess we should take a look at that room on the other side now.
translation: 我想我们这边完事了。我猜我们现在该去看看另一边那个房间了。

english: I think that's us done here. I guess we should see if we can progress further into these ruins now.
translation: 我想我们这边完事了。我猜我们现在该看看能不能继续深入这些废墟了。

english: What do you think we'll find on the other side?
translation: 你觉得另一边会有什么？

english: If all goes well, we find Metzli and Furia and we show them the error of their ways. No doubt they won't be willing to hear reason, so I suspect it will get a touch violent in the process...
translation: 如果一切顺利，我们会找到梅兹利和芙莉亚，让她们明白自己的错误。毫无疑问她们不会愿意听道理，所以我猜过程中会有点暴力……

english: But then, once that's done, maybe we go and have a nice drink somewhere. I know I need one.
translation: 但等那之后，也许我们找个地方好好喝一杯。我知道我需要一杯。

english: A drink does sound nice, it's just...
translation: 喝一杯听起来不错，只是……

english: That nagua... I keep thinking about what she said about Mokhaiotl being an archive. What does that mean? Could this place be what she was referring to?
translation: 那个纳瓜……我一直在想她说的莫凯奥特是个档案馆是什么意思。那意味着什么？这个地方会不会就是她所指的？

english: Hmm... Well, I guess there's only one way to find out... Shall we?
translation: 嗯……好吧，我想只有一种方法能知道了……我们走？

english: When you're ready, [player name].
translation: 准备好了就说一声，[player name]。

english: They can't be too far ahead now. Let's find them, [player name].
translation: 她们现在应该不会离得太远。我们去找她们，[player name]。

english: This ends here, Metzli. No more running.
translation: 到此为止了，梅兹利。别再跑了。

english: Running? What do you think I'm running from? After all this time, I'm finally right where I need to be.
translation: 跑？你以为我在逃避什么？过了这么久，我终于到了我该在的地方。

english: And where's that exactly? Another Old One ruin? That's all this place is. There's no centre of the world here. Face it, Metzli, you've failed. Your Final Dawn has failed.
translation: 那到底在哪儿？又一个旧神的废墟？这地方全是这个。这里没有什么世界中心。面对现实吧，梅茨利，你失败了。你的最终黎明已经失败了。

english: The Final Dawn? Don't you see? There never was a Final Dawn. There never will be a Final Dawn.
translation: 最终黎明？难道你不明白？从来就没有什么最终黎明。永远也不会有最终黎明。

english: You lied to the Emissaries? Why?
translation: 你对使者们撒谎了？为什么？

english: Why? Quite simply because they let me.
translation: 为什么？很简单，因为他们允许我这么做。

english: Mad? Of course I'm mad! So many see madness as a weakness... As a burden. But to do what I do... To seek what I seek... Insanity is the only way one can ever walk that path.
translation: 疯了？我当然疯了！太多人把疯狂视为弱点……视为负担。但要去做我所做的事……去追寻我所追寻的……疯狂是唯一能走上那条路的方式。

english: The people of this land... Their lives are built upon the truths presented to them. Ralos... Ranul... They put their faith in the gods they are told to believe in.
translation: 这片土地上的人们……他们的生活建立在呈现给他们的真相之上。拉洛斯……拉努尔……他们相信那些被告知要信仰的神。

english: From their first cries to their dying breaths, every choice they make is built upon those foundations. Foundations that have become so ingrained, that no sane person would ever question them.
translation: 从他们的第一声啼哭到最后一口气，他们所做的每一个选择都建立在这些基础之上。这些基础已经根深蒂固，以至于任何正常人都不会去质疑它们。

english: You have some, like the Emissaries, who dance on the edge of madness, but never leap into its embrace.
translation: 有些人，比如那些使者，在疯狂的边缘起舞，但从未纵身投入它的怀抱。

english: It was never truth that they sought. They just took comfort in someone telling them what they wanted to hear.
translation: 他们寻求的从来不是真相。他们只是从别人告诉他们想听的话中得到安慰。

english: And so it falls to me. We stand here in Mokhaiotl, the last archive of the Old Ones. When their doom befell them, they did not pray, they preserved.
translation: 所以这落到了我头上。我们站在莫凯奥特，远古者的最后一个档案馆。当他们的末日降临时，他们没有祈祷，而是保存。

english: They housed their collective knowledge, their collective power, right here. For years it's sat waiting... Waiting for a worthy inheritor. Waiting... for me.
translation: 他们将他们集体的知识、集体的力量，就存放在这里。多年来它一直等待着……等待一个值得的继承者。等待……我。

english: Here, today, I will shatter the foundations that the sane never question. I will uncover the realities they shy away from. And in my madness, I will finally deliver that which the world has forgotten.
translation: 今天，在这里，我将粉碎那些正常人从不质疑的基础。我将揭示他们避之不及的现实。而在我的疯狂中，我将最终交付这个世界所遗忘的东西。

english: Today, I will be the one to finally find the truth.
translation: 今天，我将成为最终找到真相的那个人。

english: Time to finish this.
translation: 该结束这一切了。

english: :It's pitiful how blind you are! Can't you see that everything we've been taught is built on a lie?!
translation: ：你们瞎成这样真是可悲！难道你们看不出我们所受的一切教导都建立在谎言之上吗？！

english: :Look at this place! The truth is staring you in the face, but even now you fight against it!
translation: 看看这地方！真相就摆在你面前，但即使到现在你还在抗拒它！

english: :Ralos? Ranul? Everything we thought we knew... It came from the Old Ones! It came from here!
translation: ：拉洛斯？拉努尔？我们自以为了解的一切……都来自远古者！来自这里！

english: :Enough! This ends now!
translation: ：够了！到此为止！

english: :Keep moving, [player name]!
translation: ：继续移动，[player name]！

english: It's over, Metzli. Surrender.
translation: 结束了，梅兹利。投降吧。

english: Never! I've fought too hard for this!
translation: 绝不！我为这个奋斗得太辛苦了！

english: Look around, Metzli. This place is empty. Whatever 'truth' you're looking for, it's clearly not here.
translation: 看看周围，梅兹利。这地方是空的。不管你在找什么‘真相’，显然都不在这里。

english: No! I won't let you stop me now!
translation: 不！我不会让你现在阻止我！

english: She's injured. She won't be going far. Let's get after her.
translation: 她受伤了。她跑不远。我们追上去。

english: Metzli won't get far now she's injured. Let's find her.
translation: 梅兹利受伤了，跑不了多远。我们去找她。

english: There's... nothing here.
translation: 这里……什么都没有。

english: Of course there's nothing here, Metzli. What were you expecting? Did you think Ralos himself was going to pop out and share the secrets of the world with you?
translation: 这里当然什么都没有，梅兹利。你期待什么？你以为拉洛斯本人会跳出来和你分享世界的秘密吗？

english: But the Old Ones... This was their archive... Their gift...
translation: 但是远古者……这是他们的档案馆……他们的礼物……

english: And yet it's empty. Perhaps this 'gift' was never meant for us. Or maybe it never existed at all. Either way, there's no 'truth' to be found here. Looks like we'll just have to keep making our own.
translation: 然而它是空的。也许这份‘礼物’从来就不是给我们的。或者也许它根本从未存在过。不管怎样，这里找不到什么‘真相’。看来我们只能继续创造我们自己的了。

english: Metzli, you traitor!
translation: 梅兹利，你这个叛徒！

english: Furia... It's over.
translation: 芙莉亚……结束了。

english: Over? No...
translation: 结束？不……

english: Now it's over.
translation: 现在结束了。

english: Well... I suppose that's that then.
translation: 嗯……我想那就这样了。

english: We'd better take Furia here to my mother. She'll be the one who decides what happens to her.
translation: 我们最好把芙莉亚带到我母亲那里。她会决定怎么处置她。

english: Furia, come with us, and don't even think about trying anything.
translation: 芙莉亚，跟我们走，别想耍什么花招。

english: Are you coming, [player name]?
translation: 你要来吗，[player name]？

english: You go on ahead. I want to take a look around first. I'll catch up with you.
translation: 你先走。我想先四处看看。我随后跟上你。

english: Fair enough. Don't take too long.
translation: 有道理。别太久。

english: So it's done?
translation: 所以结束了？

english: It's done. Metzli is dead. This one here is all that remains.
translation: 结束了。梅茨利死了。这里这个就是仅剩的了。

english: Take her to the capital. Find a nice cell for her where she can await her fate.
translation: 把她带到首都。给她找个好牢房，让她在那里等待命运的安排。

english: If I may, mother... Metzli and Ennius are already dead. The Emissaries are now without leaders and are unlikely to be much of a threat.
translation: 母亲，容我说一句……梅兹利和恩纽斯已经死了。使者们现在群龙无首，不太可能构成什么威胁了。

english: But there are still many out there who supported them. As far as they're concerned, we've already made two martyrs today. It might be prudent for us to keep Furia alive.
translation: 但外面还有很多支持他们的人。对他们来说，我们今天已经制造了两个烈士。我们留着芙莉亚的命可能是明智之举。

english: My son is showing a remarkable amount of restraint and foresight. The cultists didn't replace him with an imposter, did they?
translation: 我儿子表现出了非凡的克制和远见。那些邪教徒没有用冒牌货替换他吧？

english: No, I think it's definitely him.
translation: 不，我确定就是他本人。

english: Then consider me impressed. We might make a king out of you yet.
translation: 那我真是印象深刻。说不定我们真能把你培养成一个国王。

english: Now, I must return to the capital. I need to see to arrangements around a new Teokan. [player name]. Itzla. Well done. Timoiva for now, and may the sun light your way.
translation: 现在，我必须返回首都。我需要安排新特奥坎的事宜。[player name]。伊兹拉。干得好。暂时告别，愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: Well, that was quite the adventure.
translation: 嗯，真是一段精彩的冒险。

english: Yes, nice of you to show up right at the end. Trust you to skip all the hard work.
translation: 是啊，你真好意思在最后关头出现。就知道你会跳过所有苦活。

english: Tetamo! I was working very hard, thank you very much. I was conducting essential research on our enemy from the last place they'd expect!
translation: 特塔莫！我工作得非常努力，非常感谢。我在他们最意想不到的地方对敌人进行了至关重要的研究！

english: Is that so? Well, I'm sure you made many useful discoveries.
translation: 是吗？好吧，我相信你一定有很多有用的发现。

english: Indeed I did, iknami. Speaking of which, did you discover anything of note down in the ruins?
translation: 确实如此，伊克纳米。说到这个，你在废墟里有什么重要发现吗？

english: Yes and no. It seems Metzli was right in a way. Mokhaiotl was meant to be an Old One archive. Thing is, they never finished it. Something killed the ones working on it while it was still being built.
translation: 算是吧。看来梅兹利在某种程度上是对的。莫凯奥特本应是远古者的一个档案馆。问题是，他们从未完成它。在它还在建造时，有什么东西杀死了正在建造它的人。

english: Interesting... All this time we've thought of Mokhaiotl as the centre of the world, and yet it was something else entirely. Makes you wonder what else it is that we don't know...
translation: 有意思……一直以来我们都把莫凯奥特视为世界的中心，然而它却完全是别的东西。让人不禁想知道我们还有多少不知道的事……

english: Still, I guess it doesn't really matter. Metzli fooled herself into thinking that she could find all the answers, yet the beauty of this world is that we are free to look upon it as we desire.
translation: 不过，我想这其实并不重要。梅兹利自欺欺人地以为她能找到所有答案，然而这个世界的美妙之处在于，我们可以自由地按照自己的意愿去看待它。

english: But enough about Metzli. I have something far more important to talk about.
translation: 不过关于梅兹利就到此为止吧。我有更重要的事要谈。

english: While I know you of course needed no convincing to put your life at risk to rescue me, it feels only right to show my thanks by giving you a little something.
translation: 虽然我知道你当然不需要任何说服就会冒着生命危险来救我，但我觉得送你一点小礼物来表达我的感谢是应该的。

english: Ah, but I see you don't have space for it right now. Come back when you do.
translation: 啊，但我看你现在没有空间放它。等你有空的时候再来吧。

english: This blade once belonged to my grandfather, but I believe its path now lies with you.
translation: 这把剑曾属于我的祖父，但我相信它现在应该由你来继承。

english: But Itzla, that's your sword!
translation: 但是伊兹拉，那是你的剑！

english: And I can't think of anyone more deserving to wield it, iknami. Now, I'd best return to the palace. Timoiva, my friend, and may the sun light your way.
translation: 而我想不出有谁比你更配得上挥舞它，伊克纳米。好了，我最好回宫殿了。暂时告别，我的朋友，愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. As I was saying, it feels only right for me to show my thanks to you by giving you a little something.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，[player name]。正如我刚才所说，我觉得送你一点小礼物来表达我的感谢是应该的。

english: Nilsal, my child. It is good to see you.
translation: 尼尔萨尔，我的孩子。见到你真好。

english: Likewise, Servius. How are things?
translation: 彼此彼此，瑟维乌斯。近况如何？

english: Well, it is relieving to know that my life is no longer in danger, but there is no shortage of work to be done.
translation: 嗯，知道自己的生命不再受威胁固然令人欣慰，但要做的活儿可不少。

english: The Sect of Ranul are planning a special Gathering to select their new Teokan, and we in the Church of Ralos have an important part to play. There is a lot to prepare.
translation: 拉努尔教派正计划举办一场特别的集会，以选出他们新的特奥坎，而我们拉洛斯教会则要扮演重要角色。有很多准备工作要做。

english: Given what happened in the crypt, I'm guessing things will be a bit different this time as well.
translation: 考虑到墓穴里发生的事，我猜这次情况也会有些不同。

english: Indeed. For a start, the doors within the crypt seem to be beyond repair, meaning the ceremony will need some substantial changes.
translation: 确实。首先，墓穴里的门似乎已经无法修复，这意味着仪式需要做出重大调整。

english: It does also mean that anyone can now access the caverns below, which reminds me, Itzla told me what you found down there.
translation: 这也意味着现在任何人都能进入下方的洞穴，这让我想起来，伊茨拉跟我提过你在下面发现的东西。

english: Yes, Mokhaiotl. Not quite the centre of the world after all.
translation: 是的，莫凯奥特。看来它终究不是世界的中心。

english: Well, I'd be careful of making assumptions, my child. Itzla said the ruins were meant to be an archive. A centre point for all the knowledge of the Old Ones.
translation: 嗯，我的孩子，最好不要妄下结论。伊茨拉说那些废墟本来是个档案馆，一个保存所有古老者知识的中枢。

english: I'd say it makes perfect sense that they'd choose to name a place like that after Mokhaiotl.
translation: 我觉得他们选择以莫凯奥特命名这样一个地方，完全合情合理。

english: I suppose I hadn't considered that possibility.
translation: 我想我没考虑到这种可能性。

english: Well, being the Teokan of Ralos, I do have the odd moment of wisdom from time to time. Now, I must get back to my work. Timoiva, my child, and may the sun light your way.
translation: 嗯，作为拉洛斯的特奥坎，我偶尔也会闪现一些智慧。好了，我得回去干活了。蒂莫瓦，我的孩子，愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: Hello there, [player name]. I hear that cultist business of yours ended up getting sorted. Your Queen traded Teumo with the Highlord in return for a new mineral deal.
translation: 你好啊，[player name]。我听说你那档子邪教徒的事最终解决了。你的女王用特乌莫与至高领主交换了一笔新的矿物交易。

english: On that topic, I'm going to guess that they didn't end up finding the centre of the world?
translation: 说到这个话题，我猜他们最终没找到世界的中心？

english: Not exactly, though they did find something. It seems that Mokhaiotl was actually meant to be an Old One archive, though it was never finished.
translation: 不完全是，但他们确实发现了些东西。看来莫凯奥特实际上是用来做古老者档案馆的，不过从未完工。

english: Ah, so once again you humans managed to misinterpret something the Old Ones left behind. Some things never change.
translation: 啊，所以你们人类又一次误解了古老者留下的东西。有些事永远不会变。

english: Anyway, was there something you wanted?
translation: 好了，你有什么事吗？

english: Still, at least the world didn't end. Hard to imagine that some of you humans actually considered that a possibility! Your kind never change.
translation: 不过，至少世界没有毁灭。很难想象你们有些人居然认为这是可能的！你们这类物种真是不会变。

english: Welcome back, iknil. Were you able to deal with those interlopers?
translation: 欢迎回来，伊克尼尔。你解决那些闯入者了吗？

english: Yes. They won't be a problem again.
translation: 是的。他们不会再成为麻烦了。

english: That is good to hear. The Moons of Peril already pose so great a threat. Neypotzli does not need any more dangers.
translation: 那就好。灾厄之月已经构成如此巨大的威胁。内波茨利监狱不需要更多危险了。

english: I thought you'd want to know as well that they did find Mokhaiotl. It turns out it was meant to be an archive.
translation: 我想你也应该知道，他们确实找到了莫凯奥特。结果发现它本来是个档案馆。

english: An archive?
translation: 档案馆？

english: Somewhere to house the collective knowledge of the Old Ones. Thing is, it was never finished. Something happened that stopped them from doing so.
translation: 一个存放古老者集体知识的地方。问题是，它从未完工。发生了什么事，阻止了他们完成它。

english: I see... The masters always hoped that humans and dwarves would be their inheritors. Mokhaiotl must have been part of that. To hear that it never came to be is... unfortunate.
translation: 我明白了……主人们一直希望人类和矮人能成为他们的继承者。莫凯奥特一定是其中的一部分。听说它最终未能建成……真是遗憾。

english: I'm sorry, Eyatlalli.
translation: 对不起，埃亚特拉利。

english: It is alright, iknil. Time is like a river. You can try to change the current, but in the end, it always reaches the sea. Some things are simply not meant to be.
translation: 没关系，伊克尼尔。时间就像一条河流。你可以试图改变水流，但最终它总会汇入大海。有些事注定不会发生。

english: Now, let us speak of something else.
translation: 现在，让我们聊聊别的吧。

english: I see. Than you for sharing that with me.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你跟我分享这些。

english: This is [player name]. They've been helping out in Lovakengj recently.
translation: 这是[player name]。他们最近一直在洛瓦肯吉城帮忙。

english: Well I've never heard of them. What do they want?
translation: 嗯，我从没听说过他们。他们想要什么？

english: They're looking for a quest.
translation: 他们在找一个任务。

english: A quest? Well we don't have any of those lying around.
translation: 一个任务？嗯，我们这儿可没有现成的任务。

english: Well hang on. Maybe they could help us with this urgent matter.
translation: 等等吧。也许他们能帮我们处理这件急事。

english: What urgent matter?
translation: 什么急事？

english: The one we were just discussing. The one with the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 就是我们刚刚讨论的那件。跟丁之门有关的那件。

english: Ah yes, the urgent matter with the Doors of Dinh. Very clever Councillor Unkar. You put the human to work. I need a sherry.
translation: 啊对，丁之门的那件急事。真聪明，昂卡尔议员。你让那个人类去干活了。我得来杯雪利酒。

english: Human, we have a job for you.
translation: 人类，我们有个任务给你。

english: Great. What do you need?
translation: 太好了。需要我做什么？

english: One of the finest smiths in Lovakengj, Undor, has been investigating issues with the Doors of Dinh. We've just received word that he has found the problem. However, he has requested we send assistance.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城最优秀的铁匠之一，昂多尔，一直在调查丁之门的问题。我们刚收到消息，他已经找到了问题所在。不过，他要求我们派人协助。

english: Could you go to him and see what help he needs? You'll find him right outside the Doors of Dinh, north of Arceuus.
translation: 你能去找他，看看他需要什么帮助吗？他就在丁之门外面，阿西乌斯城以北。

english: It's important for the Council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five cities. Although it is the Council that rules, we can only do so with their support.
translation: 对议会来说，与五城统治者保持良好关系很重要。虽然统治的是议会，但只有得到他们的支持才能做到。

english: They are a great set of doors built by a legendary smith, Dinh, in the early days of Kourend. They were created to imprison a deadly beast known as the Wintertodt.
translation: 那是一扇由传奇铁匠丁在库兰德王国早期建造的宏伟大门。它被用来囚禁一只名为冬将军的致命野兽。

english: Unfortunately, although the Doors kept the beast contained for over a thousand years, they've recently started to fail. The master smith, Undor, was sent to investigate.
translation: 不幸的是，虽然大门将野兽囚禁了上千年，但最近开始失效了。大师级铁匠昂多尔被派去调查。

english: They don't want anything.
translation: 他们什么都不想要。

english: Oh. Could you make them go away then?
translation: 哦。那你能让他们走开吗？

english: Sorry human. We're currently engaging in important official business. If you don't have anything of importance to say, you'll need to come back another time.
translation: 抱歉，人类。我们正在处理重要的公务。如果你没有什么重要的事要说，那就改天再来吧。

english: Human, we have given you a job to do. What else do you need?
translation: 人类，我们已经给了你任务。你还需要什么？

english: Go and speak to Undor and see what he has discovered. You'll find him outside the Doors of Dinh, north of Arceuus.
translation: 去找昂多尔谈谈，看看他发现了什么。他就在丁之门外面，阿西乌斯城以北。

english: Well hello there [laddie/lassie].
translation: 哎呀，你好啊[laddie/lassie]。

english: I've been sent to help you.
translation: 我是被派来帮你的。

english: I just need to finish this little job. I'll be with you in a minute. While you're waiting, why not talk to that fiery lass? She'll fill you in on the situation here.
translation: 我得先完成这点小活。马上就来陪你。你在等的时候，不如去跟那个火辣妹子聊聊？她会告诉你这里的情况。

english: Have you now [laddie/lassie]? I was wondering when they'd send someone.
translation: 你来了啊[laddie/lassie]？我还在想他们什么时候会派人来呢。

english: Well here I am. What do you need?
translation: 我来了。你需要什么？

english: They all kept saying that the Doors were failing and I kept telling them that was rubbish. Did they listen? Of course they didn't.
translation: 他们一直说大门在失效，我一直告诉他们那是胡说八道。他们听了吗？当然没有。

english: So the doors aren't failing?
translation: 所以大门没有失效？

english: Of course not! They were made by Dinh himself, the finest smith this world has ever seen. His work doesn't just fail!
translation: 当然没有！那是丁本人打造的，他是这世界有史以来最优秀的铁匠。他的作品不会轻易失效！

english: But if the Doors aren't failing, what's the issue?
translation: 但如果大门没有失效，那问题是什么？

english: Sabotage!
translation: 是蓄意破坏！

english: Sabotage? That doesn't sound good.
translation: 蓄意破坏？听起来不妙。

english: You're right with that one [laddie/lassie]. Someone or something has made a small hole in the Doors.
translation: 你说得对[laddie/lassie]。有人或什么东西在大门上开了个小洞。

english: It's not much, but it's enough for that Wintertodt to be able to draw some power into the prison. Probably why them fiery lot have had so much trouble recently.
translation: 洞不大，但足以让冬将军吸收一些力量进入监狱。很可能这就是那群玩火的家伙最近麻烦不断的原因。

english: Repair the damage of course [laddie/lassie]. Now I should be able to fix the issue no problem. The only thing I'm missing is the right tools. That's where you come in.
translation: 当然是修复损伤了[laddie/lassie]。我应该能轻松解决这个问题。我唯一缺少的就是合适的工具。这就需要你了。

english: What tools do you need?
translation: 你需要什么工具？

english: I require a hammer!
translation: 我需要一把锤子！

english: A hammer? Are you seriously telling me that you don't own a hammer?
translation: 一把锤子？你是在认真地告诉我你连一把锤子都没有吗？

english: What does it look like I'm holding you spoon?! I don't just need any hammer. I need the legendary hammer used by Dinh himself! It's the only tool capable of working this metal.
translation: 你看我拿着什么，勺子吗？！我需要的不是普通锤子。我需要丁本人使用过的传奇锤子！这是唯一能加工这种金属的工具。

english: Ahh, I see. So where do I find this hammer?
translation: 啊，我明白了。那我在哪里能找到这把锤子？

english: Back in his prime, Dinh built a great tower. It was known as Dinh's Redoubt and it's where he created all of his finest inventions.
translation: 在丁的鼎盛时期，他建造了一座宏伟的高塔。它被称为丁的堡垒，他所有最精妙的发明都是在那里创造的。

english: After Dinh died, some poncey mage thought they'd go and defile his tower. The place has been off limits ever since.
translation: 丁死后，某个娘娘腔法师跑去玷污了他的塔。从那以后，那个地方就被禁止进入了。

english: Now I don't know for sure, but I reckon that Dinh's Hammer might still be there.
translation: 我现在不确定，但我猜丁的锤可能还在里面。

english: Well there's only one way to find out. Where do I find this tower?
translation: 好吧，只有一个办法能知道。我在哪里能找到这座塔？

english: The Forsaken Tower, as it's now known, can be found west of Lovakengj.
translation: 如今被称为被遗弃的高塔的它，位于洛瓦肯吉城以西。

english: Great, I'll be back once I've found that hammer.
translation: 太好了，我找到锤子就回来。

english: Hello there [laddie/lassie].
translation: 你好啊[laddie/lassie]。

english: Have you got Dinh's Hammer yet [laddie/lassie]?
translation: [laddie/lassie]，你拿到丁的锤了吗？

english: Not yet. Where should I be looking?
translation: 还没有。我应该在哪里找？

english: I reckon it's somewhere in Dinh's Redoubt, or The Forsaken Tower, as it's now known. You'll find it west of Lovakengj.
translation: 我猜它在丁的堡垒里，也就是现在所谓的被遗弃的高塔。它在洛瓦肯吉城以西。

english: I have!
translation: 拿到了！

english: Well hand it over then.
translation: 那就交出来吧。

english: Look at it! Such a work of art. Dinh never fails to impress. Now that I have this, it shouldn't take me long to fix the Doors.
translation: 看看它！真是件艺术品。丁从不让人失望。既然我有这个了，修复大门用不了多长时间。

english: Does this mean the Wintertodt won't be a threat anymore?
translation: 这是不是意味着冬将军不再是威胁了？

english: That should be the case in the long run. I suspect it will take a long time though. The Doors were damaged for a while and the Wintertodt will have gained a lot of power.
translation: 长远来看应该是这样。不过我怀疑需要很长时间。大门被损坏了一段时间，冬将军已经积聚了大量力量。

english: I reckon that magic lot will have to do their fiery tricks for a bit longer before everything is back to normal.
translation: 我想那些玩魔法的家伙还得再耍一阵子火的把戏，一切才能恢复正常。

english: Anyway, I'll get to work fixing the Doors. You should head back to Lady Lovakengj and let her know that the problem has been solved.
translation: 总之，我会开始修理丁之门。你应该回去找洛瓦肯吉女士，告诉她问题已经解决了。

english: Why are you wasting my time?!
translation: 你为什么要浪费我的时间？！

english: Now that I have Dinh's Hammer, it shouldn't take me long to fix the Doors. You should head back to Lady Lovakengj and let her know.
translation: 既然我有了丁的锤，修好丁之门应该花不了多长时间。你应该回去找洛瓦肯吉女士，告诉她一声。

english: Hello there laddie.
translation: 你好啊，小伙子。

english: Look at it! Such a work of art. Dinh never fails to impress. Now that I have this, it shouldn't take me long to fix these doors.
translation: 看看它！真是件艺术品。丁从不让人失望。现在有了这个，修好这些门应该花不了我多少时间。

english: That should be the case in the long run. I suspect it will take a long time though. The doors were damaged for a while and the Wintertodt will have gained a lot of power.
translation: 长远来看应该会是这样。不过我觉得会花很长时间。这些门损坏有一阵子了，冬将军肯定已经积蓄了大量力量。

english: I just need to finish this little job, I'll be with you in a minute. While you're waiting why not talk to that fiery lass, she'll fill you in on the situation here.
translation: 我只需要完成这点小活，马上就来招呼你。你等着的时候，不如去跟那位火辣的小姐聊聊，她会告诉你这里的情况。

english: They all kept saying that the doors were failing and I kept telling them that was rubbish. Did they listen? Of course they didn't.
translation: 他们一直说门快撑不住了，我总跟他们说那是胡扯。他们听了吗？当然没有。

english: Well hello there laddie.
translation: 嗯，你好啊，小伙子。

english: Repair the damage of course laddie. Now I should be able to fix the issue no problem. The only thing I'm missing is the right tools. That's where you come in.
translation: 当然是修复损坏啊，小伙子。现在我应该能毫无问题地解决这个问题。我唯一缺的就是合适的工具。这就是你派上用场的地方了。

english: Have you now laddie? I was wondering when they'd send someone.
translation: 你现在来了啊，小伙子？我还在想他们什么时候会派人来呢。

english: Anyway, I'll get to work fixing the doors. You should head back to Lady Lovakengj and let her know that the problem has been solved.
translation: 总之，我会开始修理大门。你应该回去找洛瓦肯吉女士，告诉她问题已经解决了。

english: Hello there lass.
translation: 你好啊，姑娘。

english: You're right with that one laddie. Someone or something has made a small hole in the doors.
translation: 你说得对，小伙子。有人或什么东西在门上弄了个小洞。

english: Have you got Dinh's Hammer yet laddie?
translation: 你拿到丁的锤了吗，小伙子？

english: Well hello there lass.
translation: 嗯，你好啊，姑娘。

english: Repair the damage of course lass. Now I should be able to fix the issue no problem. The only thing I'm missing is the right tools. That's where you come in.
translation: 当然是修复损坏啊，姑娘。现在我应该能毫无问题地解决这个问题。我唯一缺的就是合适的工具。这就是你派上用场的地方了。

english: Have you now lass? I was wondering when they'd send someone.
translation: 你现在来了啊，姑娘？我还在想他们什么时候会派人来呢。

english: You're right with that one lass. Someone or something has made a small hole in the doors.
translation: 你说得对，姑娘。有人或什么东西在门上弄了个小洞。

english: Have you got Dinh's Hammer yet lass?
translation: 你拿到丁的锤了吗，姑娘？

english: The doors were built by Dinh to contain the Wintertodt. This was over a thousand years ago and they still stand today.
translation: 这些门是丁建造用来封印冬将军的。那是一千多年前的事了，它们至今依然屹立不倒。

english: You're right with that one laddie. Someone or something has made a small hole in the Doors.
translation: 你说得对，小伙子。有人或什么东西在门上弄了个小洞。

english: Of course not! They were made by Dinh himself. His work doesn't just fail!
translation: 当然不会！它们是丁亲手打造的。他的作品才不会轻易坏掉！

english: What it is doesn't bother me, just as long as we keep it behind them doors.
translation: 里面是什么我不在乎，只要把它关在门后就行。

english: Talk to that fiery lass, she'll sort you out.
translation: 去跟那位火辣的小姐谈谈，她会帮你搞定的。

english: They say the doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I keep telling them that's rubbish.
translation: 他们说门快撑不住了，冬将军正试图逃出来。我一直跟他们说那是胡扯。

english: You're right with that one lass. Someone or something has made a small hole in the Doors.
translation: 你说得对，姑娘。有人或什么东西在门上弄了个小洞。

english: Until next time laddie.
translation: 下次见，小伙子。

english: Until next time lass.
translation: 下次见，姑娘。

english: Now that I have Dinh's Hammer, it shouldn't take me long to fix these doors. You should head back to Lady Lovakengj and let her know.
translation: 既然我有了丁的锤，修好这些大门应该花不了多长时间。你应该回去找洛瓦肯吉女士，告诉她一声。

english: Talk to that fiery lass. She'll sort you out.
translation: 去跟那位火辣的小姐谈谈。她会帮你搞定的。

english: They say the Doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I keep telling them that's rubbish.
translation: 他们说门快撑不住了，冬将军正试图逃出来。我一直跟他们说那是胡扯。

english: I'm just here to keep an eye on things. Even though the doors are fixed now, it will take many years for things to get back to normal.
translation: 我只是在这里盯着情况。虽然门现在修好了，但一切恢复正常还需要很多年。

english: They say the Doors are failing and the Wintertodt is trying to escape. I'm here to prove to them that the Doors are fine.
translation: 他们说门快撑不住了，冬将军正试图逃出来。我在这里是为了向他们证明门没问题。

english: Hewwo dawe wass.
translation: 泥嚎啊，小菇凉。

english: Look at it! Such a wowk of awt. Dinh nevew faiws toimpwess. Now that me have dis, it shouwdn't take me wongto fix da Doows.
translation: 看看它！真是件艺舒品。丁从不让人失望。现在有了这个，修好这些门应该花不了我多少时间。

english: The human seems a bit lost Councillor. Could you help them please.
translation: 这个人类好像有点迷茫，议员。您能帮帮他们吗？

english: But I've done what you asked!
translation: 但我已经按您的要求做了！

english: Oh. What did I ask?
translation: 哦。我问了什么？

english: We asked them to go and see what help Undor needed at the Doors of Dinh.
translation: 我们让他们去看看昂多尔在丁之门需要什么帮助。

english: That we did Councillor. Quite right. And what was it that Undor needed?
translation: 没错，议员。确实如此。那昂多尔需要什么呢？

english: Undor had found some damage caused to the Doors of Dinh. He suspected someone had sabotaged them. He asked me to fetch him Dinh's Hammer so that he could fix the Doors.
translation: 昂多尔发现丁之门有些损坏。他怀疑有人蓄意破坏。他让我去取丁的锤，这样他就能修复大门。

english: I found the hammer and gave it to Undor. He should be fixing the Doors as we speak.
translation: 我找到了锤子并交给了昂多尔。他现在应该正在修复大门。

english: Well this is excellent news. With the Doors fixed, the Wintertodt poses a far smaller threat to Kourend. Well done.
translation: 这可是个好消息。大门修复后，冬将军对库兰德王国的威胁就会小得多。干得好。

english: Yes, yes, wonderful stuff. I think I'll have a sherry to celebrate.
translation: 是啊，是啊，太棒了。我想我得喝杯雪利酒庆祝一下。

english: Hello again human. What brings you here?
translation: 又见面了，人类。什么风把你吹来了？

english: Hello again human.
translation: 又见面了，人类。

english: Can't stop to talk human. Lady Lovakengj has left plenty of work for me.
translation: 没空跟人类说话。洛瓦肯吉女士给我留了很多活儿。

english: Here it is. Hopefully it gives you what you need.
translation: 给你。希望这能给你所需的东西。

english: Councillor, why is the human still here?
translation: 议员，为什么那个人类还在这里？

english: I think they want a reward, Lady Lovakengj.
translation: 我想他们想要一份奖励，洛瓦肯吉女士。

english: A reward?
translation: 奖励？

english: Yes, Lady Lovakengj.
translation: 是的，洛瓦肯吉女士。

english: Well this is excellent news. With the doors fixed, the Wintertodt poses a far smaller threat to Kourend. Well done.
translation: 这真是个好消息。门修好了，冬将军对库兰德王国的威胁就小多了。干得好。

english: Well hang on, maybe they could help us with this urgent matter.
translation: 等等，也许他们能帮我们处理这件急事。

english: Unfortunately, although the doors kept the beast contained for over a thousand years, they've recently started to fail. The master smith, Undor, was sent to investigate.
translation: 不幸的是，虽然这些门将野兽关押了一千多年，但最近它们开始失效了。大师级铁匠昂多尔被派去调查。

english: Human, we have given you a job to do. How is it going?
translation: 人类，我们给了你一份工作。进展如何？

english: Excellent. You should let Lady Lovakengj know.
translation: 太好了。你应该让洛瓦肯吉女士知道。

english: It's important for the council to maintain a good relationship with the rulers of the five cities. Although it is the council that rules, we can only do so with their support.
translation: 议会与五城的统治者保持良好关系很重要。虽然是议会在统治，但只有得到他们的支持才能做到。

english: Unfortunately, the doors were recently damaged, putting Kourend at risk. The master smith, Undor, managed to repair them though, something he couldn't have done without you.
translation: 不幸的是，这些门最近被损坏了，使库兰德王国面临危险。不过，大师级铁匠昂多尔设法修复了它们，没有你他做不到这一点。

english: Keep at it. I'm sure Undor can help you if you need anything. You'll find him outside the Doors of Dinh, north of Arceuus.
translation: 继续努力。我相信如果你需要什么，昂多尔可以帮你。你可以在阿西乌斯城北边的丁之门外面找到他。

english: Sorry human. We're currently engaging in important official business. If you don't have anything of importance to say you'll need to come back another time.
translation: 抱歉，人类。我们正在处理重要的官方事务。如果你没什么重要的事要说，就改天再来吧。

english: Commander Fullore felt it would be safer for me to be here rather than in Lovakengj. Don't worry, once the protests are done I'll be straight back there.
translation: 富洛尔指挥官觉得我待在这里比待在洛瓦肯吉城更安全。别担心，抗议一结束我就立刻回去。

english: Unfortunately, the Doors were recently damaged, putting Kourend at risk. The master smith, Undor, managed to repair them though, something he couldn't have done without you.
translation: 不幸的是，丁之门最近被损坏了，使库兰德王国面临危险。不过，大师级铁匠昂多尔设法修复了它们，没有你他做不到这一点。

english: We asked dam to go and see what hewp Undow neededat da Doows of Dinh.
translation: 我们让dam去看看昂多wow在丁之门需要什么帮主。

english: ...and he says that it's of da gweatest uwgency.
translation: ……他说这是最最紧急的事。

english: This is [player name]. They've been hewping out inLovakengj wecentwy.
translation: 这位是[player name]。他们最近一直在洛瓦肯吉城帮忙。

english: Well here you go, have this then.
translation: 好吧，给你，拿着这个吧。

english: Oh. The human is still here.
translation: 哦。那个人类还在这里。

english: Who is this human Councillor Unkar? What are they doing here?
translation: 昂卡尔议员，这个人类是谁？他们在这里做什么？

english: The human seems a bit lost Councillor, could you help them please.
translation: 议员，这个人类似乎有点迷茫，你能帮帮他们吗？

english: The human seems a bit lost councillor. Could you help them please.
translation: 议员，这个人类似乎有点迷茫。你能帮帮他们吗？

english: That we did councillor. Quite right. And what was it that Undor needed?
translation: 我们确实做到了，议员。完全正确。那么昂多尔需要什么呢？

english: My plans? Hmm... Let me see now...
translation: 我的计划？嗯……让我想想……

english: The human seems a bit wost Counciwwow. Couwd u hewpdam pwease.
translation: 这个人类似乎有点迷路了，议员。你能帮帮他吗？

english: Who is dis human, Counciwwow Unkaw? What awe daydoing hewe?
translation: 昂卡尔议员，这个人类是谁？他们在这里做什么？

english: Weww I've nevew heawd of dam. What do day want?
translation: 我从没听说过他们。他们想要什么？

english: Oh. The human is stiww hewe.
translation: 哦。这个人类还在这里。

english: I'm ready for another adventure!
translation: 我准备好迎接下一次冒险了！

english: I'm a fan of your enthusiasm, [Fremennik name], but-
translation: 我很欣赏你的热情，[Fremennik name]，但是——

english: Nothing quite that fancy I'm afraid, [Fremennik name]. I just need you to investigate a minor disturbance.
translation: 恐怕没那么花哨，[Fremennik name]。我只是需要你去调查一起小骚动。

english: Freygerd and Reeso run the sandpit a little north of here. They mentioned they heard some rustling by their hut last night and wanted an official to investigate.
translation: 弗雷格德和里索在往北一点的沙坑工作。他们说昨晚听到小屋旁有沙沙声，想找个官方的人去查查。

english: You've proven yourself more than worthy of our people's trust.
translation: 你已经证明自己完全值得族人的信任了。

english: Well that doesn't sound so bad. I'll get right on it.
translation: 嗯，听起来没那么糟。我马上就去办。

english: How goes the investigation, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 调查得怎么样了，[Fremennik name]？

english: I'm still looking into it at the moment.
translation: 我现在还在查。

english: No rush, [Fremennik name]. I'm sure it's nothing to worry about. Just talk to Freygerd and Reeso at the sandpit when you're ready.
translation: 不着急，[Fremennik name]。我相信没什么可担心的。等你准备好了，就去沙坑和弗雷格德还有里索谈谈吧。

english: Hello Reeso, I'm [Fremennik name].
translation: 你好，里索，我是[Fremennik name]。

english: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. I imagine the Chieftain sent you over. My wife, Freygerd, is probably the best person to speak to. She was the one who saw the... well whatever it was.
translation: 你好啊，[Fremennik name]。我猜是酋长派你来的吧。我妻子弗雷格德应该是沟通的最佳人选。是她看到了那个……呃，不管它是什么。

english: I looked about outside but couldn't see anyone out there.
translation: 我在外面看了看，但没看到任何人。

english: I'll get to the bottom of it. Thank you Reeso.
translation: 我会查个水落石出。谢谢你，里索。

english: Hello Freygerd, I'm [Fremennik name].
translation: 你好，弗雷格德，我是[Fremennik name]。

english: Thank goodness you've arrived!
translation: 谢天谢地你来了！

english: The Chieftain told me that you saw some sort of disturbance outside your hut?
translation: 酋长告诉我，你看到你家小屋外有某种动静？

english: Yes, my husband thinks I'm going a bit mad but I know what I saw! Red eyes, piercing with a terrifying stare. I was so frightened, I fell to the floor!
translation: 是的，我丈夫觉得我有点疯疯癫癫的，但我知道我看到了什么！红色的眼睛，锐利的、带着可怕凝视的眼神。我吓坏了，直接瘫倒在地板上！

english: It was the middle of the night, so I couldn't make out what it was. But when I got back on my feet, it wasn't there anymore.
translation: 那是半夜，所以我没看清是什么东西。但我一站起来，它就不见了。

english: I see. I'll have a look around and see what I can find.
translation: 明白了。我会四处看看，找找有什么线索。

english: Thank you for your help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

english: How's it going, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 情况如何，[Fremennik name]？

english: Try not to worry too much, I'm sure it's nothing.
translation: 别太担心了，我相信没什么大不了的。

english: Have you looked around the hut yet, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你检查过小屋周围了吗，[Fremennik name]？

english: I still think I'm missing something. I'll let you know when I'm done.
translation: 我还是觉得漏掉了什么。弄完了我会告诉你的。

english: Thanks again for your help. Make sure you bring anything you find back. I'll make sure my husband delivers it to the Chieftain.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助。记得把找到的东西都带回来。我会让我丈夫把它们送到酋长那里。

english: This doesn't look safe... Good job my backpack magically stops things from breaking!
translation: 这看起来不安全……还好我的背包有魔法，东西不会碎！

english: This seems to be a small sack filled with venom.
translation: 这似乎是个装满毒液的小麻袋。

english: It's dripping with venom. I'd better make sure I don't prick my finger!
translation: 上面滴着毒液。我最好小心点，别扎到手指！

english: This seems to be the fang of a relatively small creature. It's absolutely soaked in venom.
translation: 这似乎是某个较小生物的毒牙。上面浸透了毒液。

english: Well I can honestly say I wasn't expecting that. Looks like it dropped a letter of some sorts. I'd better grab it.
translation: 好吧，老实说，我还真没想到会是这样。看起来它掉了一封信之类的东西。我最好把它捡起来。

english: I think I've found everything I need for this investigation. I should let Freygerd know.
translation: 我想我已经找到了这次调查所需的一切。应该去告诉弗雷格德一声。

english: I already have the letter from this sand pit.
translation: 这个沙坑的信我已经拿到了。

english: Oh, that's where that letter went! How convenient.
translation: 哦，原来那封信掉这儿了！真巧。

english: I think I've found everything I need.
translation: 我想我找到需要的一切了。

english: Ah, you'd better talk to the wife then. She'll want to know what you've discovered.
translation: 啊，那你最好跟我妻子谈谈。她会想知道你发现了什么。

english: I've had a look around and found a few things I'd like to show the Chieftain. The thing that made the noise outside your home is gone now, so there's nothing to worry about.
translation: 我四处看了看，找到了一些想给酋长看的东西。那个在你家外面制造噪音的东西已经不见了，所以不用担心了。

english: Thank goodness! I'll have my husband take those items to the Chieftain for you.
translation: 谢天谢地！我让我丈夫替你把那些东西送到酋长那里去。

english: Yeah, yeah... alright!
translation: 好吧，好吧……行！

english: Thank you so much for your help, [Fremennik name].
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助，[Fremennik name]。

english: No problem. I best be getting back to the Chieftain!
translation: 没什么。我最好回酋长那里去！

english: Hello Reeso.
translation: 你好，里索。

english: Greetings, [Fremennik name]. How can I help?
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。有什么能帮你的？

english: You didn't by any chance read that letter, did you?
translation: 你没有碰巧读过那封信吧？

english: The sand business is booming over here in Rellekka! I don't have time to worry about some letter.
translation: 沙子生意在雷勒卡城可是蒸蒸日上！我可没闲工夫去管什么信。

english: Thank you for letting me know.
translation: 谢谢你告诉我。

english: No problem, [Fremennik name].
translation: 不客气，[Fremennik name]。

english: Please, do tell me more about the sand business in Rellekka.
translation: 请务必多跟我讲讲雷勒卡城的沙子生意。

english: An adventurer like you? Don't you have anything better to do?
translation: 像你这样的冒险者？难道没有更好的事可做了吗？

english: Not at all. I seem to have all day to talk to people. Why else would I start a conversation with you?
translation: 一点也不。我看起来有一整天的时间跟人聊天。不然我干嘛要找你搭话？

english: Well, being so close to the shore, Rellekka provides a lot of seaweed alongside my sand.
translation: 嗯，雷勒卡城离海岸这么近，除了我的沙子之外，也产很多海藻。

english: Well I work for a business known as Sandy Sand Co. A brilliant bunch of people!
translation: 嗯，我为一家名为“桑迪沙业”的公司工作。一群很棒的家伙！

english: The seaweed from Rellekka, in combination with my sand business, provides a huge amount of glass for the surrounding areas!
translation: 来自雷勒卡城的海藻，加上我的沙子生意，为周边地区提供了大量的玻璃！

english: Fellow Fremenniks aren't too pleased with my outside dealings, though know how important my job is. I think they let it slide for that reason.
translation: 弗雷门尼克同胞们对我跟外人打交道不太高兴，但知道我的工作有多重要。我想他们也是因为这个才睁一只眼闭一只眼的。

english: Well, thank you so much for all of that information Reeso. See you later.
translation: 好吧，非常感谢你提供的所有这些信息，里索。回头见。

english: You didn't say, [Fremennik name]. What exactly was it that was outside? My husband didn't tell me what he took to the Chieftain for you.
translation: 你没说啊，[Fremennik name]。外面的到底是什么东西？我丈夫没告诉我他替你给酋长送了什么东西。

english: It was a basilisk.
translation: 是一只石化蜥蜴。

english: I said it was a basilisk.
translation: 我说了，是一只石化蜥蜴。

english: A basilisk?
translation: 一只石化蜥蜴？

english: Well I really must get back to what I was doing. Lovely to catch up!
translation: 嗯，我真的得回去忙自己的事了。很高兴能聊上！

english: It was nothing to worry about! Just a couple of knick knacks probably dropped by some kids!
translation: 没什么好担心的！就是些小零碎，大概是哪个孩子掉的！

english: What about the red eyes I saw though?
translation: 但我看到的红色眼睛呢？

english: They were probably just firestarters. That's what I found outside.
translation: 那大概就是点火器吧。我在外面找到的就是这个。

english: Well that's certainly a relief. Thank you for letting me know!
translation: 嗯，那确实让人松了口气。谢谢你告诉我！

english: Not a problem!
translation: 不客气！

english: A basilisk! In our town! This is how it starts!
translation: 一只石化蜥蜴！在我们镇上！这就是末日的开端！

english: How what starts?
translation: 什么的开端？

english: The end!
translation: 末日！

english: Well that sounds cheery. You have nothing to fear though, not with me around. Speaking of which, I'd better get back to it.
translation: 听起来还真乐观。不过有我在，你什么都不用怕。说到这个，我最好还是回去做事了。

english: [Fremennik name], I'm glad you've returned! This letter you have found is very worrying and requires our utmost attention.
translation: [Fremennik name]，你回来了真好！你找到的这封信非常令人担忧，需要我们高度重视。

english: Never did we think this day would come.
translation: 我们从未想过这一天会到来。

english: So many lives lost. So many sacrifices.
translation: 多少生命逝去，多少牺牲付出。

english: But the Fremennik people shall not bow to the Jormungand again!
translation: 但弗雷门尼克人绝不会再次向耶梦加得屈服！

english: [Fremennik name], please read the letter and talk to me afterwards with any questions you may have.
translation: [Fremennik name]，请先读一下信，之后有什么问题再来问我。

english: I don't understand. What does the letter mean? Who is the Jormungand? And since when could basilisks read and write?
translation: 我不明白。信是什么意思？耶梦加得是谁？还有，石化蜥蜴什么时候会读会写了？

english: While they may not show it, basilisks are much smarter than they seem. Many years ago, a great basilisk army enslaved our people and took our home.
translation: 虽然它们可能不表现出来，但石化蜥蜴比它们看起来要聪明得多。很多年前，一支庞大的石化蜥蜴军队奴役了我们的人民，占领了我们的家园。

english: The Jormungand, sometimes known as The Serpent King, was the leader of this army. Along with his three generals, Typhor, Vritra and Bakuna, he brought a terror to these lands unlike any other.
translation: 耶梦加得，有时被称为蛇王，是这支军队的首领。他与他的三位将军，泰福尔、弗利特拉和巴库纳一起，给这片土地带来了前所未有的恐怖。

english: If it hadn't been for the bravery of a great hero, we might never have been freed.
translation: 如果不是因为一位伟大英雄的勇敢，我们可能永远无法获得自由。

english: A hero?
translation: 一位英雄？

english: Yes. He was known as V. He stood up to the Serpent King and confronted him on the Island of Stone. It is said that the two of them fought for days, but in the end, V stood victorious.
translation: 是的。他被称为V。他挺身对抗蛇王，并在石头岛上与他对峙。据说他们战斗了数日，但最终，V取得了胜利。

english: Well that depends who you ask. The bards wrote a great song about V's victory. They called it the Ballad of the Basilisk, and it claims V killed the Jormungand.
translation: 嗯，那要看你怎么问了。吟游诗人为V的胜利谱写一首伟大的歌。他们称之为“石化蜥蜴歌谣”，歌里说V杀死了耶梦加得。

english: Well... bards are known to bend the truth a bit, especially if it makes a song sound better. In reality, V sealed the Serpent King in a magical prison on the island, where he remains to this day.
translation: 嗯……吟游诗人是出了名地会歪曲事实，尤其是为了让歌曲更好听。实际上，V将蛇王封印在岛上的一个魔法监狱里，他至今仍在那里。

english: A magical prison? I thought the Fremennik people didn't approve of magic?
translation: 一个魔法监狱？我以为弗雷门尼克人不赞成使用魔法？

english: V was different. Stories tell of how he unlocked the potential of magic with the single touch of a stone. In that moment, he became more than just a man.
translation: V不一样。传说中，他只是碰触了一块石头，就解锁了魔法的潜力。在那一刻，他不再仅仅是一个凡人。

english: A god?
translation: 一个神？

english: It's not a distinction the Fremennik particularly care for. To us, he has always been a hero to be respected, not a god to be worshipped. They say he felt the same way.
translation: 弗雷门尼克人并不特别在意这种区分。对我们来说，他始终是一位值得尊敬的英雄，而不是一个需要崇拜的神。据说他自己也是这么想的。

english: But he earned the right to use magic?
translation: 但他赢得了使用魔法的权利？

english: Exactly. Now the Moon Clan on the other hand, did not earn that right. Their use of magic is an insult to our people.
translation: 没错。但月亮氏族那边就不一样了，他们并没有赢得那个权利。他们使用魔法是对我们族人的侮辱。

english: So what can we do about the Jormungand?
translation: 那我们拿耶梦加得怎么办？

english: We will stay strong, [Fremennik name]. We'll...
translation: 我们会保持坚强，[Fremennik name]。我们会……

english: We'll be doomed!
translation: 我们会完蛋的！

english: Our army isn't large enough to hold back the forces of the Serpent King.
translation: 我们的军队不够强大，无法抵挡蛇王的军队。

english: I can help!
translation: 我可以帮忙！

english: [Fremennik name], you're strong. But you're no army.
translation: [Fremennik name]，你很强大。但你一个人不是一支军队。

english: You're forgetting Brundt. We have the element of surprise! They don't know we're aware of their attack.
translation: 你把布伦特忘了。我们还有出其不意的优势！它们不知道我们已经察觉了它们的攻击。

english: We could have days to prepare before they make their move. We could...
translation: 我们可能在它们采取行动前还有几天时间准备。我们可以……

english: Chieftain Brundt!
translation: 首领布伦特！

english: Agnar? What is it?
translation: 阿格纳？什么事？

english: Chieftain Brundt! I'm here on behalf of the Fremennik Council! We've heard some disturbing news about a basilisk in town.
translation: 首领布伦特！我代表弗雷门尼克议会前来！我们听说镇上有石化蜥蜴的消息，令人不安。

english: Well I won't deny there's been a little issue but [Fremennik name] and I will soon have things back under control.
translation: 嗯，我不否认出了一些小问题，但[Fremennik name]和我很快就能让一切恢复控制。

english: [Fremennik name]? When will you see that this outerlander is the cause of all of our problems!
translation: [Fremennik name]？你什么时候才能明白，这个外来者就是我们所有问题的根源！

english: [Fremennik name] is no outerlander! [He/She] passed our trials and is a Fremennik, just like you and I.
translation: [Fremennik name]绝对不是外来人！[He/She]通过了我们的试炼，已经和你我一样，是个费明尼克人了。

english: You can disguise it all you want, but [he/she] is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let [him/her] in, we've had nothing but trouble!
translation: 随你怎么遮掩，但[he/she]永远是个外来人！自从我们让[him/her]加入以来，麻烦就没断过！

english: And to top it all off, now we have basilisks wandering our town. The council have had enough!
translation: 更糟的是，现在还有石化蜥蜴在我们的镇上游荡。议会受够了！

english: What are you saying Agnar?
translation: 阿格纳，你在说什么？

english: I have a declaration here signed by seven of our twelve council members. We declare this outerlander an exile!
translation: 我这里有一份宣言，我们十二位议会成员中有七位签了名。我们宣布这个外来人被放逐！

english: This is outrageous! [Fremennik name] is one of us!
translation: 这太离谱了！[Fremennik name]是我们的一员！
