english: Do not use that name! The decision of the council is final. As Chieftain, you are honour bound to enact it.
translation: 别提那个名字！议会的决定是最终的。作为酋长，你有荣誉去执行它。

english: Exile, you must leave our province. Our people will no longer see you as their brother.
translation: 被放逐者，你必须离开我们的领地。我们的族人不再将你视为兄弟。

english: Leave at once. Do not attempt to interact with myself or my people.
translation: 立刻离开。不要试图与我或我的人民互动。

english: Begone exile, you are a Fremennik no more.
translation: 滚吧，被放逐者，你不再是费明尼克人了。

english: Hey pal... listen. I shouldn't really be talking to you. Everyone is saying you're a bad person. They say you were exiled!
translation: 嘿，朋友……听着。我其实不该跟你说话。大家都说你是坏人。他们说你被放逐了！

english: It's true but I did nothing wrong; don't believe them Askeladden!
translation: 这是真的，但我没做错任何事；别信他们，阿斯卡拉登！

english: I believe you buddy! I just can't really be seen talking to you.
translation: 我相信你，伙计！只是我不能被别人看到跟你说话。

english: That's fine, I don't want to get you in trouble. Can you do me a favour though?
translation: 没关系，我不想连累你。不过你能帮我个忙吗？

english: Okay pal. If you need anything, come back to me but keep it on the down low.
translation: 好的，朋友。如果你需要什么，就回来找我，但要低调点。

english: Ah! Exile! Begone with you, before you suffer the same fate as these fledglings!
translation: 啊！被放逐者！快滚，免得你落得和这些小崽子一样的下场！

english: Fine. I was going anyway.
translation: 好吧。反正我也正要走。

english: Gerr owtta 'ere befur ay mayke yew!
translation: 赶娟里凯，不染我就要了逆的命！

english: Behgawn exshiled. Elsh'll cahll thur gards!
translation: 滚凯被放逐者。不然沃就要叫守卫了！

english: Yoo shuwdn't be warking 'round alown whyle exshiled!
translation: 逆部该在被放逐的时候一个人椟自溜达！

english: Hi there exile. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: 你好啊，被放逐者。我是吟游诗人法洛！就像我住在雷勒卡城的兄弟奥拉夫一样，我也创作音乐。

english: You don't seem to care too much about me getting exiled.
translation: 你好像不怎么在意我被放逐的事。

english: Well we're not in Rellekka down here so I don't think it matters too much.
translation: 嗯，我们这儿不在雷勒卡城，所以我觉得这事没那么要紧。

english: Fair enough. So, do you write about anything in particular?
translation: 说得也对。那么，你有什么特别写的主题吗？

english: Welcome back, [Fremennik name]. Do you have any questions?
translation: 欢迎回来，[Fremennik name]。你有什么问题吗？

english: You don't seem to be bothered about my exile.
translation: 你好像对我的放逐一点也无所谓。

english: I'm not. Neitiznot does not consider you an exile, that's just the mainland.
translation: 我确实无所谓。奈提兹诺镇不认为你是被放逐者，那是大陆那边的事。

english: You do know I've been exiled right? You don't seem to care.
translation: 你知道我被放逐了吧？你好像不在乎。

english: Don't worry [Fremennik name], your exile does not cover the island of Jatizso. We still consider you a Fremennik.
translation: 别担心，[Fremennik name]，你的放逐令不包括贾迪索岛。我们仍然把你当作费明尼克人。

english: Don't talk to me exile.
translation: 别跟我说话，被放逐者。

english: Please, I must get to Miscellania.
translation: 求你了，我必须去米斯凯尼亚。

english: You're lucky you're needed there. Just don't speak to me on the journey!
translation: 算你走运，那边需要你。不过路上别跟我说话！

english: You're lucky you're needed on Miscellania exile. Just don't speak to me on the journey!
translation: 算你走运，被放逐者，米斯凯尼亚需要你。不过路上别跟我说话！

english: Fine. I won't pretend to like it though.
translation: 好吧。但别指望我会装出喜欢的样子。

english: Let's go exile. Sooner you're off my ship the better.
translation: 走吧，被放逐者。你越早下我的船越好。

english: Sorry [Fremennik name], I can't be seen talking to you.
translation: 抱歉，[Fremennik name]，我不能让人看到我在跟你说话。

english: Do you want to return to Rellekka?
translation: 你想回雷勒卡城吗？

english: Begone exile, you're no [brother/sister/Fremennik] to me.
translation: 滚吧被放逐者，你不再是我的[brother/sister/Fremennik]了。

english: I'm sorry, you are Fremennik no more. I cannot help you. Leave, before I must call the guards.
translation: 我很抱歉，你不再是费明尼克人了。我无法帮你。离开吧，在我不得不叫守卫之前。

english: Well that was awkward...
translation: 嗯，真是尴尬……

english: Indeed. I'm sorry [Fremennik name]. The reality is that many on the council did not take kindly to you becoming one of us. They've been looking for a good excuse to exile you ever since you arrived.
translation: 确实。对不起，[Fremennik name]。现实是，议会上很多人当初就不乐意你成为我们的一员。他们从你来时就一直在找好借口放逐你。

english: But they're the ones that voted for me in the first place!
translation: 但当初不就是他们投票让我加入的吗！

english: Well... not quite. Seven of the twelve council members gave you their vote, but you never had the support of the other five. They're the ones who've been pushing for your exile.
translation: 嗯……不完全是。十二位议会成员中有七位投了赞成票，但你从来就没得到另外五位的支持。他们就是一直推动放逐你的人。

english: I see. And they've used this basilisk problem to convince some of the others.
translation: 我明白了。他们就用石化蜥蜴这个问题说服了其他人。

english: It would seem so. Try not to judge them too harshly though, they only had what was best for the province in mind. This basilisk situation has a lot of people scared.
translation: 看来是这样。不过别太苛责他们，他们只是为领地着想。石化蜥蜴的局势让很多人害怕。

english: I don't understand though, they're only basilisks. Surely we have the strength to defeat them.
translation: 但我不明白，不过是些石化蜥蜴而已。我们肯定有力量打败它们。

english: Ah, I see you are not familiar with the End of Things.
translation: 啊，看来你不知道“万物终结”的事。

english: The End of Things?
translation: “万物终结”？

english: Many years ago, before the time of V, it was foretold that this world will end in a great battle. They called this battle Ragnarok, or more commonly, the End of Things.
translation: 许多年前，在 V 的时代之前，就预言这个世界将在一场大战中终结。他们称这场战斗为诸神黄昏，或者更常说的，“万物终结”。

english: Well that doesn't sound good. Where do the basilisks fit in?
translation: 听起来可不太好。那石化蜥蜴又有什么关系？

english: The prophecies say that the battle will begin after the Serpent King is freed. So you see, it is not the basilisks people fear, it is what comes after.
translation: 预言说，战斗将在蛇王被释放后开始。所以你看，人们害怕的不是石化蜥蜴，而是之后会发生的事。

english: Then we'd better make sure the Jormungand stays in that prison!
translation: 那我们最好确保耶梦加得一直被关在那个牢笼里！

english: Well, [Fremennik name], that's why I asked you to meet me out here. If you are to help us put a stop to this threat, you'll need to regain the trust of the council. And I think I know just how you can do that.
translation: 嗯，[Fremennik name]，这就是我叫你到这里见我的原因。如果你想帮我们阻止这个威胁，就得重新赢得议会的信任。我想我知道该怎么做。

english: I think the best possible way to show your worth to them is by being the person that restores V's Shield.
translation: 我认为向他们证明你价值的最好方法，就是成为那个修复“V 的盾”的人。

english: V's Shield?
translation: “V 的盾”？

english: The shield used by V when he defeated the Serpent King. It is legendary amongst our people. If we are to have any chance of stopping this threat, we will need to remake it.
translation: V在击败蛇王时使用的盾。它在我们的族人中堪称传奇。如果我们想有机会阻止这个威胁，就必须重铸它。

english: There's a few things I know about the shield, though other things are lost from stories past.
translation: 关于这面盾我知道一些事，但有些细节已经从过去的故事里遗失了。

english: I believe some members of the Moon Clan might know the details I don't, so your diplomatic relations should come in handy.
translation: 我相信月亮族的一些成员可能知道我不了解的细节，所以你的外交关系应该能派上用场。

english: Keep in mind, now that you've been exiled, most people in the province will be unlikely to talk to you.
translation: 记住，现在你被放逐了，领地里大多数人可能不愿意跟你说话。

english: Fair enough. So where should I start?
translation: 明白了。那我该从哪里开始？

english: Stories tell of how V's Shield was made using four components.
translation: 传说中 V 的盾是由四个部件组成的。

english: First, the base of the shield. This was a traditional Fremennik Shield, like the ones our warriors use.
translation: 首先，是盾的基座。那是一面传统的费明尼克盾，就像我们的战士用的那种。

english: Next, the Lunar Glass. This was apparently created by a great Moon Clan mystic and was used to reflect the Serpent King's gaze.
translation: 接下来是月玻璃。这显然是由一位伟大的月族神秘主义者创造的，用来反射蛇王的目光。

english: Then you have the Polishing Rock. This was needed to shine the Lunar Glass. This rock was heated softly in a boiling spring.
translation: 然后你还有抛光石。这是用来打磨月玻璃的。这块石头在沸腾的泉水中被温和加热。

english: Finally, V's Sigil. This sigil was crafted by the Moon Clan, using a unique metal known only to them.
translation: 最后，是 V 的印记。这个印记由月亮族打造，用的是一种只有他们才知道的独特金属。

english: Where can I find a Fremennik Shield?
translation: 我在哪里能找到费明尼克盾？

english: Fremennik Shields are only given to warriors of the province.
translation: 费明尼克盾只赐予领地的战士。

english: I made a round shield with arctic pine in my previous adventure to Neitiznot?
translation: 我上次去奈提兹诺镇的冒险中，用北极松木做了一面圆盾？

english: No, this shield is different. I'd recommend heading to Waterbirth Island. The daggermouths within the dungeon will likely have some from warriors they've sent to Valhalla.
translation: 不，那面盾不同。我建议你去水诞岛。地下城里的匕首口鱼很可能有一些从被它们送去英灵殿的战士身上缴获的盾。

english: You could slay them and reclaim a shield from their corpses.
translation: 你可以杀掉它们，从它们的尸体上回收一面盾。

english: What if that doesn't work?
translation: 要是找不到呢？

english: There's a warrior down there known as Bardur, gathering many a daggermouth hide and saving Fremennik Shields.
translation: 下面有个叫巴杜尔的战士，正在收集很多匕首口鱼皮，也存着一些费明尼克盾。

english: If you have no luck finding a shield, perhaps you could charm him to give one to you?
translation: 如果你自己找不到盾，也许可以说服他给你一个？

english: Thanks Brundt, I'll keep that in mind.
translation: 谢谢，布朗特，我会记住的。

english: Do you have any more questions about V's Shield, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你还有关于 V 的盾的其他问题吗，[Fremennik name]？

english: Where can I get Lunar Glass?
translation: 我能在哪里弄到月玻璃？

english: I'm not sure I'm afraid. I imagine someone from the Moon Clan would likely have more knowledge on the matter.
translation: 恐怕我也不太确定。我猜月亮族的人应该更了解这件事。

english: I think I know just the chicken-legged-house-bound lady to ask!
translation: 我想我知道该问哪位住在鸡脚小屋的女士了！

english: Don't worry about it...
translation: 别在意……

english: How do I make the Polishing Rock?
translation: 我该怎么做抛光石？

english: Well firstly, a rock would probably help...
translation: 嗯，首先，你得有块石头……

english: I know a guy! Well, a boy. Hopefully he'll still be willing to speak to me despite the exile.
translation: 我认识一个人！呃，一个男孩。希望他尽管我被放逐了，还愿意跟我说话。

english: Convenient. As for the matter of heating the rock, there's some hot springs on the mountain to the east that should be warm enough.
translation: 真巧。至于加热石头的问题，东边山上有温泉，温度应该够。

english: Use something to lower the rock into one of the geysers there, and you should be good to go.
translation: 用什么东西把石头放进去，放进其中一个间歇泉里，应该就行了。

english: How do I make V's Sigil?
translation: 我该怎么做 V 的印记？

english: V's Sigil is, well... in the shape of a V.
translation: V 的印记，嗯……就是个 V 的形状。

english: Oh... is that it?
translation: 哦……就这？

english: Well, one side of the sigil is shaped like a basilisk. Spines down its back, and maw wide like a gate.
translation: 好吧，印记的一侧形状像石化蜥蜴。背上有棘刺，嘴巴大张像道门。

english: And the other side?
translation: 那另一侧呢？

english: Nothing fancy. Just the other side of the letter V.
translation: 没什么特别的。就是字母 V 的另外一边。

english: What exactly is it made of?
translation: 它具体是用什么做的？

english: The stories tell of a cave on Lunar Isle where V first gained his power. Apparently it contains a unique metal used only by the Moon Clan.
translation: 传说在月亮岛有一个洞穴，V 最初就是在那里获得力量的。据说里面有一种独特的金属，只有月亮族使用。

english: I'd say three bars of this metal should be enough. Take them to an anvil and you should be able to make the sigil.
translation: 我想三条这种金属锭应该够了。拿到铁砧上，你应该就能做出印记了。

english: Once you have made the sigil, you'll need to have it enchanted. This was apparently done by a powerful spirit.
translation: 一旦你做出了印记，还需要找人附魔。这显然是由一个强大的灵魂完成的。

english: Do you know of such a spirit?
translation: 你知道这样的灵魂吗？

english: The stories didn't specify, though I would wager the Fossegrimen might be able to help.
translation: 故事里没具体说，不过我猜福塞格里门也许能帮忙。

english: Greetings [Fremennik name].
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。

english: Bardur, wait! I'm here with a task from the Chieftain.
translation: 巴杜尔，等等！我是奉酋长之命来找你的。

english: I'm not too certain I should trust you! What is it you want?
translation: 我可不太确定该不该信你！你想要什么？

english: I'm looking to remake V's Shield, but I require a Fremennik Shield from a warrior. Where could I find one?
translation: 我想重新打造 V 的盾，但我需要一个战士的费明尼克盾。我在哪里能找到一个？

english: You already have one! Begone, exile!
translation: 你已经有一个了！滚开，流放者！

english: The daggermouths found in these caves should drop a few when slain. They take them from fallen warriors. I have a few myself, in fact. I wish to give them back to the families of the fallen.
translation: 这些洞穴里的剑齿鱼被杀后会掉落一些。它们是从倒下的战士身上拿走的。其实我自己也有几个。我想把它们归还给阵亡者的家人。

english: These fledgelings won't drop anything you're looking for, though. Search the caves for some matured daggermouths.
translation: 不过这些幼年生物不会掉落你要找的东西。在洞穴里搜索一些成熟的尖嘴鱼。

english: Thanks for your time, Bardur.
translation: 谢谢你花时间，巴杜尔。

english: You're lucky I'm busy exile! Things might have been different if I wasn't...
translation: 算你走运，我现在很忙，流放者！要是我不忙的话，事情可就不一样了……

english: Maybe I could buy one off you?
translation: 也许我可以从你这里买一个？

english: Hmm... Well I suppose the money would be of great help to the families of the fallen. Very well, I will sell you a shield for 150,000 coins.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我想这笔钱对阵亡者的家人会很有帮助。行吧，我卖给你一个盾，十五万金币。

english: Perhaps I misjudged you, exile. Best of luck on your adventure.
translation: 也许我看错你了，流放者。祝你好运。

english: That's far too much, I won't pay that!
translation: 太贵了，我不会付这么多！

english: Well I wouldn't expect an exile like you to care about the fallen. Be gone with you!
translation: 哼，我没想到像你这样的流放者会在乎阵亡者。给我滚！

english: I could honour the fallen by remaking V's Shield.
translation: 我可以通过重铸V的盾来纪念逝者。

english: Hmm... They would indeed be pleased. Having your shield used to make the shield of a hero would be an honour!
translation: 嗯……他们确实会很高兴。用你的盾来打造一位英雄的盾，这将是一种荣誉！

english: Thanks Bardur.
translation: 谢谢巴杜尔。

english: Exile, has that shield served you well?
translation: 流放者，那个盾对你来说好用吗？

english: All the best, exile.
translation: 祝你一切顺利，流放者。

english: Well you're not having another one if that's how you take care of things! If you want another, you'll need to slay some daggermouths!
translation: 哼，如果你这么不珍惜，我是不会再给你一个的！如果你想要另一个，就得去杀一些剑齿鱼！

english: Be gone with you then!
translation: 那就快走吧！

english: Very well exile. Return to me when you have enough room.
translation: 好吧，流放者。等你腾出空间再来找我。

english: Very well, exile. Return to me when you have enough room.
translation: 好吧，流放者。等你腾出空间再来找我。

english: Ah, Bardur my brother-in-name! It is good fortune that we meet here like this!
translation: 啊，巴杜尔，我的同名兄弟！能在这里遇见你真是太好了！

english: As you wish, Dalkar My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，达尔卡。我的武器陪我这么久，我仍然信任它们。

english: Ah, Bardur Drapare my brother-in-name! It is good fortune that we meet here like this!
translation: 啊，巴杜尔.德拉帕雷，我的同名兄弟！能在这里遇见你真是太好了！

english: As you wish, Darrak My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，达拉克。我的武器陪我这么久，我仍然信任它们。

english: As you wish, Larvald Drapare My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，拉瓦尔德.德拉帕雷。我的武器陪我这么久，我仍然信任它们。

english: As you wish, Thortor My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，索托尔。我的武器陪我这么久，我仍然信任它们。

english: As you wish, Rilkur My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，里尔库尔。我的武器陪我这么久，我仍然信任它们。

english: As you wish, Daltor Drapare My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，达尔托.德拉帕雷。我的武器陪我这么久，我仍然信任它们。

english: As you wish, Taldur Drapare My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，塔尔杜.德拉帕雷。我的武器陪我这么久，我仍然信任它们。

english: I was wondering if you could help me make...
translation: 我在想你能不能帮我制作……

english: Lunar Glass?
translation: 月玻璃？

english: You really need to stop doing that.
translation: 你真的得停止那样做。

english: Stop doing what?
translation: 停止做什么？

english: Stop finishing my...
translation: 停止打断我的……

english: Sentences? Sorry it's a force of habit! Mind reading and watnot.
translation: 句子？抱歉，这是习惯成自然！读心术什么的。

english: Oh don't look at me like that! I'm not the one who exiled you.
translation: 哦，别那样看着我！又不是我把你流放的。

english: Look, those are my private thoughts! You can't just go reading my mind without permission.
translation: 听着，那是我私人的想法！你不能未经允许就读我的心。

english: Those aren't private thoughts! They're nothing compared to the other things I can see...
translation: 那些可不是私人的想法！跟我能看到的东西比起来，根本不算什么……

english: Please... can we just focus on the matter at hand?
translation: 拜托……我们能不能专注于眼前的事？

english: Sure thing! Lunar Glass isn't so hard to make, but I will require a piece of Molten Glass. Return to me when you have some!
translation: 没问题！月玻璃并不难做，但我需要一块熔融玻璃。等你有了就回来找我！

english: Thank y...
translation: 谢了……

english: Sure thing! Lunar Glass isn't so hard to make, but I will require...
translation: 没问题！月玻璃没那么难做，但我需要……

english: Some Molten Glass? I have some right here!
translation: 一些熔融玻璃？我这里正好有！

english: Hey! That's... really annoying.
translation: 嘿！这……真烦人。

english: Oh, how the tables have turned!
translation: 哦，风水轮流转啊！

english: How did you even know...
translation: 你怎么知道的……

english: Anyway, let me imbue this piece of glass for you.
translation: 总之，让我来为你灌注这块玻璃。

english: You will need to enchant it by using it on the Astral Altar. The process will also require 100 Astral Runes.
translation: 你需要把它用在星界祭坛上来附魔。这个过程还需要 100 颗星界符文。

english: Oh. Can't you just do it for me?
translation: 哦。你就不能直接帮我搞定吗？

english: Afraid not, I have lots of tidying to do around here.
translation: 恐怕不行，我这里还有很多收拾的活要干。

english: Tidying?
translation: 收拾？

english: Have you ever tried living in a house that's constantly shaking? It's a total nightmare, believe me.
translation: 你有没有试过住在一栋不停摇晃的房子里？那简直就是一场梦魇，相信我。

english: I guess I never thought about that before, fair enough.
translation: 我以前倒没想过这点，说得有道理。

english: Lunar Glass? I can do that. I will require a piece of Molten Glass. Return to me when you have some!
translation: 月玻璃？我能做。我需要一块熔融玻璃。等你有了就回来找我！

english: Yes! I have th...
translation: 是的！我有……

english: The Molten Glass? Excellent!
translation: 熔融玻璃？太好了！

english: That one wasn't even mind reading! I could have guessed what I was going to say there.
translation: 这次甚至不是读心术！我本来就能猜到我要说什么。

english: Lunar Glass? But I can see you already have the Imbued Glass you need! You don't have to be a mind reader to see that...
translation: 月玻璃？但我看你已经有需要的灌注玻璃了！不用读心术也能看出来……

english: Remember, you'll need to enchant it by using it on the Astral Altar. This process will also require 100 Astral Runes.
translation: 记住，你需要把它用在星界祭坛上来附魔。这个过程还需要 100 颗星界符文。

english: Lunar Glass? You'll need some Imbued Glass first. Don't worry, I can make some more for you.
translation: 月玻璃？你得先有灌注玻璃。别担心，我可以再帮你做一些。

english: You don't seem to have any Molten Glass. Come back when you do!
translation: 你好像没有熔融玻璃。有了再回来吧！

english: There you go. Remember, you'll need to enchant it by using it on the Astral Altar. This process will also require 100 Astral Runes.
translation: 给你。记住，你需要把它用在星界祭坛上来附魔。这个过程还需要 100 颗星界符文。

english: Lunar Glass? But I can see you already have some! You don't have to be a mind reader to see that...
translation: 月玻璃？但我看你已经有了一些！不用读心术也能看出来……

english: You'll need 1 guam leaf, 1 Marrentill leaf and a Suqah tooth ground using a pestle and mortar. Combine these in a vial with water and BAM! You've got your potion! You should be able to get the ingredients from the
translation: 你需要1片瓜姆叶、1株马伦提尔草和一颗用研钵和杵研磨过的苏卡牙齿。把这些材料和水一起放入小瓶中混合，BAM！你的药水就做好了！你应该能从

english: *Baba Yaga whispers in your ear*
translation: *芭芭雅嘎在你耳边低语*

english: Clan and the Fremennik heightened. The Fremennik had grown strong in body, while our clan had grown strong in mind. They overpowered our tribe and we retreated to Lunar Isle, where we have lived ever since.
translation: 部落与弗莱梅尼克人之间的紧张关系加剧了。弗莱梅尼克人身体变得强健，而我们的部落则心智变得强大。他们击败了我们的部族，我们退到了月亮岛，从此一直生活在那里。

english: Very well, here you go.
translation: 好吧，给你。

english: You'll need 1 guam leaf, 1 Marrentill leaf and a Suqah tooth ground with a pestle and mortar. Combine these in a vial with water and BAM! You've got your potion! You should be able to get the ingredients from the
translation: 你需要1片瓜姆叶、1株马伦提尔草和一颗用研钵和杵研磨过的苏卡牙齿。把这些材料和水一起放入小瓶中混合，BAM！你的药水就做好了！你应该能从

english: You've made it?
translation: 你做好了？

english: Give it to the Oneiromancer.
translation: 把它交给梦境法师。

english: Cluck cluck cluck!
translation: 咯咯咯！

english: It just has that cewtain wing to it, don't u think?Beeewteeee!
translation: 它就是这么有那股翅膀味儿，你不觉得吗？美滋滋~

english: I already have some Lunar Glass. I should probably gather the rest of the items for V's Shield!
translation: 我已经有一些月玻璃了。我该去收集 V 的盾的其他材料了！

english: It might have helped if I'd actually remembered to bring my pet rock.
translation: 要是真记得带上我的宠物石就好了。

english: This geyser looks a little small. I'd probably do a better job heating this rock in a larger geyser!
translation: 这个间歇泉看起来有点小。我大概得找个更大的间歇泉来加热这块石头！

english: Okay, here we go!
translation: 好了，开始吧！

english: Any second now, I'm going to lower this rock into the geyser and boil it...
translation: 我随时都会把这块石头放进间歇泉里煮沸它……

english: It's just a rock, how is it looking so sad? Come on, I can do this! For the Province!
translation: 它只是一块石头，怎么看起来这么难过？来吧，我能做到的！为了行省！

english: It's for the good of the Province... I must do it!
translation: 这是为了行省的利益……我必须这么做！

english: I can't do it! I love you pet rock.
translation: 我做不到！我爱你，宠物石。

english: You're right, pet rock... Why does it have to be this way?
translation: 你说得对，宠物石……为什么非得这样？

english: I can't do this to you with all of these happy memories!
translation: 带着这么多快乐的回忆，我下不了手！

english: You're right... I'll talk to Peer the Seer. He'll help me forget all of our times together.
translation: 你说得对……我去找先知皮尔谈谈。他会帮我忘掉我们在一起的时光。

english: It'll make this easier.
translation: 这样会容易些。

english: Though I appreciate your efforts in our trials, I'm afraid I can't speak to you [Fremennik name].
translation: 虽然我很感激你在试炼中的努力，但恐怕我不能和你说话，[Fremennik name]。

english: Please, Seer! I'm on a mission for Brundt.
translation: 拜托了，先知！我是奉布伦特之命来的。

english: Hmm... If the Chieftain can still trust you, so can I. How may I be of assistance?
translation: 嗯……如果酋长还能信任你，那我也能。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: It's a bit of a sensitive subject...
translation: 这事有点敏感……

english: You can tell me anything, [Fremennik name]. What's the matter?
translation: 你什么都可以跟我说，[Fremennik name]。怎么了？

english: I can't bring myself to boil my pet rock!
translation: 我无法让自己煮沸我的宠物石！

english: I know, I'm a horrible person! Please help me, I can't bring myself to do it.
translation: 我知道，我是个糟糕的人！请帮帮我，我实在下不了手。

english: Are you serious? I'm a busy man...
translation: 你是认真的吗？我可是个大忙人……

english: Please Seer, you're my only hope!
translation: 求你了先知，你是我唯一的希望！

english: Very well. I'll clear your mind of any memories you have of your...
translation: 好吧。我会清除你脑海中关于你的……

english: pet rock...
translation: 宠物石……的所有记忆。

english: I won't be able to speak with you after this. The others might start to get suspicious.
translation: 之后我就不能再和你说话了。其他人可能会起疑心。

english: Concussio! Forgessan! Geodeus!
translation: 康库西奥！福格桑！吉欧迪斯！

english: Thank you, Seer! I'll head back to the mountains now.
translation: 谢谢你，先知！我现在就回山里去。

english: Now be gone with you, exile!
translation: 现在滚吧，流放者！

english: I know it's just an act... but that hurt.
translation: 我知道这只是演戏……但这话真伤人。

english: Well I don't think that will be bobbing up to the top anytime soon! I'll need to fish it out with something.
translation: 嗯，我觉得它不会很快浮上来！我得用什么东西把它捞出来。

english: I'm not going to be able to get my rock back with just my bare hands! I'll need to get something to fish it out.
translation: 光靠双手是拿不回我的石头的！我得找点东西把它捞出来。

english: I've already dropped one rock in there. I should try fishing it out rather than throwing more away.
translation: 我已经掉了一块石头进去。我该试着把它捞出来，而不是再扔更多进去。

english: Darn it! That rock was hot...
translation: 该死！那块石头好烫……

english: If only I had something that could keep my hands cold!
translation: 要是有个能让手保持冰凉的东西就好了！

english: Darn it! It would probably help if I actually wore my ice gloves.
translation: 该死！要是真戴上我的冰手套就好了。

english: I already have a Polishing Rock. I think I'm done here.
translation: 我已经有一块抛光石了。我想这里的事已经办完了。

english: I already have a Polishing Rock in my bank. I think I'm done here.
translation: 我的银行里已经有一块抛光石了。我想这里的事已经办完了。

english: I'm currently trying to remake V's Shield. I was told I need his sigil enchanted by a powerful spirit.
translation: 我正试着重铸 V 的盾。有人告诉我需要让一个强大的灵魂来附魔他的徽记。

english: V? Now that's a name I haven't heard in a long time...
translation: V？好久没听到这个名字了……

english: You know of V?
translation: 你知道 V？

english: Oh yes. Were it not for V, this conversation might never had happened.
translation: 哦，当然。要不是 V，这场对话可能根本不会发生。

english: I owe V a debt that can never be repaid. It would be an honour to enchant his sigil.
translation: 我欠 V 一份永远无法偿还的恩情。能为他的徽记附魔是我的荣幸。

english: Bring the unenchanted sigil to me and I'll provide you with what you need.
translation: 把未附魔的徽记带来，我会给你你需要的东西。

english: *The Fossegrimen whispers an enchantment*
translation: *福塞格里门低语着一段附魔咒语*

english: There you go! Go forth mighty warrior.
translation: 给你！去吧，英勇的战士。

english: I think I have everything needed to make V's Shield.
translation: 我想我已经有制作 V 的盾所需的一切了。

english: Well what are you waiting for? Get it made and we'll have everything we need to put an end to your exile.
translation: 那你还等什么？把它做好，我们就有结束你流放所需的一切了。

english: This looks complete! I should head back to the Chieftain and see what he thinks.
translation: 看起来完成了！我应该回去找酋长，看看他怎么说。

english: I've completed V's Shield!
translation: 我完成了 V 的盾！

english: Hand it over then, [Fremennik name].
translation: 那就交出来吧，[Fremennik name]。

english: Oh, sorry. I simply left it in my bank. I'm such a ditzy person sometimes!
translation: 哦，抱歉。我把它忘在银行里了。我有时候就是这么迷糊！

english: That's certainly one way to put it... Perhaps you should go and get it?
translation: 这倒是一种说法……也许你该去把它拿来？

english: Will do, see you shortly!
translation: 好的，马上回来！

english: [Fremennik name]... This is incredible! It's as if you forged the shield from a picture. It's exactly how I imagined it from the stories!
translation: [Fremennik name]……这太不可思议了！就好像你是照着图片锻造出这面盾牌一样。它和我想象中故事里的样子一模一样！

english: Do you think this will be enough to convince the council?
translation: 你觉得这足以说服议会吗？

english: I hope so [Fremennik name]. I do suspect some of them may never respect you though.
translation: 希望如此，[Fremennik name]。不过我确实怀疑他们中有些人可能永远不会尊重你。

english: Beggars can't be choosers, I suppose. Let's get going then...
translation: 我想，乞丐没得挑。那我们走吧……

english: The shield. It requires one last thing.
translation: 这面盾牌。还差最后一样东西。

english: What's missing?
translation: 缺了什么？

english: Return to me with two beers. No... Two kegs of beer! Quickly! There's not much time!
translation: 给我带两杯啤酒回来。不……两桶啤酒！快！没时间了！

english: Have you got the two kegs of beer?
translation: 你拿到两桶啤酒了吗？

english: I have them right here!
translation: 我这儿就有！

english: I'm litchrally abousht to go shtand uhp to the enshtire *hiccup* counshil for yooo...! I need thish!
translation: 我这就去*嗝*面对整个议会为你说话……！我需要这个！

english: That's a very good point. Carry on then.
translation: 说得很有道理。那你继续吧。

english: I should probably head back to the longhall...
translation: 我该回长厅了……

english: I actually have some here.
translation: 我这里其实有一些。

english: You're a bigger alcoholic than I am! Hand them over.
translation: 你比我还酒鬼！交出来吧。

english: And you Brundt. You sobered up quickly.
translation: 还有你，布伦特。你醒酒得真快。

english: We Fremennik know how to handle a drink, [Fremennik name]. Anyway, I have some good news for you.
translation: 我们弗瑞曼尼可知道怎幺喝酒，[Fremennik name]。总之，我有好消息要告诉你。

english: Following your successful recreation of V's Shield, the council have agreed to end your exile. I hearbydeclare you a Fremennik again!
translation: 在你成功重铸V的盾之后，议会同意结束你的流放。我在此宣布你再次成为费明尼克人！

english: Not only that, but we would like you to be the one to carry V's legendary shield into battle.
translation: 不仅如此，我们还希望你成为那个带着 V 的传奇盾牌上战场的人。

english: So you should be [Fremennik name]. V was our greatest hero. There is no greater honour than to bear his shield in battle.
translation: 你应该感到荣幸，[Fremennik name]。V 是我们最伟大的英雄。没有比在战场上举起他的盾牌更高的荣誉了。

english: The basilisks intend to attack the town so they can keep us distracted while they free the Jormungand. Luckily for us, we know about this.
translation: 石化蜥蜴打算攻击城镇，以此分散我们的注意力，同时他们去释放耶梦加得。幸运的是，我们对此知情。

english: Once the attack begins, the majority of our forces will stay here to hold the town. While they do, you and I will journey to the Island of Stone.
translation: 一旦攻击开始，我们的大部分兵力会留在这里守住城镇。与此同时，你和我将前往石头岛。

english: There, we will ensure that the prison of the Jormungand remains sealed.
translation: 在那里，我们将确保耶梦加得的监狱保持封印。

english: Sounds good, when do...
translation: 听起来不错，什么时候……

english: Basilisks in the market! Basilisks in the market!
translation: 市场里有石化蜥蜴！市场里有石化蜥蜴！

english: They've walked right through our defences!
translation: 他们直接突破了我们的防线！

english: Kill them all!
translation: 杀光他们！

english: This is Rellekka!
translation: 这里是雷勒卡城！

english: Kill the invaders!
translation: 杀死入侵者！

english: You die here beast!
translation: 野兽，你死在这里！

english: Die you foul beasts!
translation: 去死吧，你们这些可恶的野兽！

english: Death to the basilisks!
translation: 石化蜥蜴都得死！

english: Kill them! Kill them all!
translation: 杀了他们！一个不留！

english: You will not take our home!
translation: 你们休想夺走我们的家园！

english: [Fremennik name]! Get to the boat. It's time for us to go!
translation: [Fremennik name]！快上船。我们该走了！

english: This isn't good [Fremennik name]. The prison has already been breached.
translation: 情况不妙，[Fremennik name]。监狱已经被攻破了。

english: So we're too late?
translation: 所以我们来晚了？

english: Not quite, but we'll have to act fast. If the Jormungand manages to leave the prison, the End of Things will be upon us.
translation: 还不算太晚，但我们得抓紧行动。如果耶梦加得成功逃出监狱，万物终结就会降临。

english: Well we'd better get in there and make sure that doesn't happen.
translation: 那我们最好赶紧进去，确保那件事不会发生。

english: It looks like the basilisks resealed the door behind them. We'll have to get through it.
translation: 看来石化蜥蜴们从里面把门重新封上了。我们得想办法通过。

english: From what I can tell, the door uses a combination lock. You'll need to get the right combination to unlock it. Too many wrong attempts will reset the lock though.
translation: 据我观察，这扇门用的是组合锁。你得找到正确的组合才能打开它。不过，错误尝试太多次会让锁重置。

english: I'd better be careful then. I'll get to work.
translation: 那我最好小心点。我这就开始。

english: Hurry [Fremennik name]. We can't afford to waste any time.
translation: 快点，[Fremennik name]。我们可没时间浪费。

english: Have you opened the door yet?
translation: 你开门了吗？

english: Hurry [Fremennik name]. We need to get inside before it's too late.
translation: 快点，[Fremennik name]。我们得在来不及之前进去。

english: That's the door unlocked.
translation: 门锁解开了。

english: Good work [Fremennik name]. Let's get inside and see what's going on.
translation: 干得好，[Fremennik name]。我们进去看看情况。

english: Let's get inside and see what's going on.
translation: 我们进去看看情况。

english: Humans!
translation: 人类！

english: Destroy them! Our king must be freed!
translation: 消灭他们！我们的国王必须获得自由！

english: It will be done.
translation: 遵命。

english: With me [Fremennik name]! Let's kill these foul beasts!
translation: 跟我来，[Fremennik name]！让我们杀了这些可恶的野兽！

english: At long last, I have been granted freedom. You have done well Bakuna.
translation: 终于，我重获自由了。你做得很好，巴库纳。

english: I exist to serve.
translation: 我生来就是为了侍奉。

english: Good, for I have one final use of you. My long rest has weakened me, you will grant me strength.
translation: 很好，因为我还有最后一个用处要派给你。漫长的沉睡让我变得虚弱，你要赐予我力量。

english: Power!
translation: 力量！

english: This isn't over yet [Fremennik name], the Jormungand is weak from his imprisonment! We can still stop him!
translation: 还没结束，[Fremennik name]，耶梦加得被囚禁后还很虚弱！我们还能阻止他！

english: Humans, you have been bestowed with a great honour, for you are about to become the first of your kind in millennia to feed my power!
translation: 人类，你们被赐予了莫大的荣幸，因为你们即将成为数千年来第一批滋养我力量的人！

english: Rejoice with me, for your miserable lives are finally at an end!
translation: 和我一起欢呼吧，因为你们悲惨的生命终于要结束了！

english: You will not defeat us this day! Come [Fremennik name]!
translation: 今天你休想打败我们！来吧，[Fremennik name]！

english: Turn away [Fremennik name]!
translation: 转过去，[Fremennik name]！

english: Don't look into his eyes!
translation: 别看他的眼睛！

english: Don't look at him [Fremennik name]!
translation: 别看他，[Fremennik name]！

english: [Fremennik name]! Do not face him!
translation: [Fremennik name]！别面对他！

english: The stone is weak! You can break it!
translation: 石头很脆弱！你可以打碎它！

english: Try to break free [Fremennik name]!
translation: 试着挣脱出来，[Fremennik name]！

english: [Fremennik name]! You need to break loose!
translation: [Fremennik name]！你得挣脱出来！

english: You can free yourself [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你可以自己挣脱的，[Fremennik name]！

english: Hurry [Fremennik name]! We need to get inside and stop those basilisks!
translation: 快点，[Fremennik name]！我们得进去阻止那些石化蜥蜴！

english: Wait [Fremennik name]! I have some things for you!
translation: 等等，[Fremennik name]！我有些东西要给你！

english: I do have some of your items here [Fremennik name]. Do try to be careful with them.
translation: 我这里确实有你的一些物品，[Fremennik name]。用的时候小心点。

english: Ah, nothing like a glorious fight to make you feel alive!
translation: 啊，没有什么比一场光荣的战斗更能让人感觉活着了！

english: Now? We drink of course! The Jormungand has been defeated and the End of Things prevented!
translation: 现在？当然是喝酒！耶梦加得已被击败，万物终结也被阻止了！

english: Are you sure? They did manage to free him. How do you know we weren't too late?
translation: 你确定吗？他们确实成功释放了他。你怎么知道我们没有来晚？

english: You worry too much [Fremennik name]. If the end had begun, we'd have noticed by now. Come! Let us go and celebrate!
translation: 你想太多了，[Fremennik name]。如果终结已经开始，我们早就该察觉到了。来吧！我们去庆祝！

english: T'was on a haughty winter,
translation: 那是在一个傲慢的冬天，

english: We're bitten with frost,
translation: 我们被霜冻咬伤，

english: And none would dare venture,
translation: 无人胆敢冒险，

english: Where many were lost.
translation: 前往那许多人丧命的地方。

english: V sailed his mighty longship,
translation: V 驾驶着他那雄伟的长船，

english: Another great victory for our people!
translation: 为我们的人民又赢得了一场伟大的胜利！

english: But it wouldn't have been possible without [Fremennik name]!
translation: 但如果没有[Fremennik name]，这一切都不可能实现！

english: You have truly proven yourself to be one of us, [Fremennik name]! I'm sorry we ever doubted you.
translation: 你真正证明了自己是我们中的一员，[Fremennik name]！我很抱歉我们曾经怀疑过你。

english: You can disguise it all you want, but he is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let him in, we've had nothing but trouble!
translation: 你想怎么伪装都行，但他永远是个外乡人！自从我们让他加入，麻烦就没断过！

english: You can disguise it all you want, but she is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let her in, we've had nothing but trouble!
translation: 你想怎么伪装都行，但她永远是个外乡人！自从我们让她加入，麻烦就没断过！

english: Could be. Who wants to know?
translation: 也许吧。谁想知道？

english: Well, yes I am. Why do you want to find a council member?
translation: 嗯，是的，我是。你为什么想找一位议会成员？

english: Ah, I see. And you require a majority vote at the council of elders before you will be accepted into the clan, correct?
translation: 啊，我明白了。你需要得到长老议会的多数投票才能被接受加入部落，对吗？

english: I don't like outerlanders. The only way you will get my vote allowing you into the clan is...
translation: 我不喜欢外乡人。你能得到我投票允许你加入部落的唯一办法是……

english: If you can pay me... One hundred thousand, million, billion, nine hundred thousand, and forty seven hundred and ninety three gold coins.
translation: 如果你能付给我……十万、百万、十亿、九十万，外加四千七百九十三枚金币。

english: I guess you don't get my vote then, do you, outerlander?
translation: 那我猜你得不到我的投票了，对吧，外乡人？

english: This is outrageous! Jarton is one of us!
translation: 太过分了！贾顿是我们的一员！

english: I'm just glad it all worked out in the end.
translation: 我很高兴最后一切都解决了。

english: And on that note, time for a drink! I want to see if [Fremennik name] can still drink me under the table!
translation: 说到这个，该喝一杯了！我想看看[Fremennik name]是不是还能把我灌倒！

english: To the Island of Stone,
translation: 前往石头之岛，

english: Where the king of the serpents,
translation: 蛇王所在之处，

english: Had made it his home.
translation: 把它当成了家。

english: The storm it was a ragin',
translation: 风暴肆虐，

english: Waves broke on the deck,
translation: 巨浪拍打着甲板，

english: The bell rang with a tolling,
translation: 钟声敲响，

english: To warn of the wreck.
translation: 警告着残骸的危险。

english: But naught could deter him,
translation: 但没有什么能阻止他，

english: From the fate of his quest,
translation: 去完成他使命的命运，

english: Winds tore through the main sail,
translation: 狂风撕裂了主帆，

english: Yet onward he pressed.
translation: 但他仍奋勇向前。

english: Hello, are you [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你好，你是[Fremennik name]吗？

english: I am, but who are you?
translation: 我是，但你是谁？

english: I am Maria Gunnars, Mord's wife.
translation: 我是玛丽亚.冈纳斯，莫德的妻子。

english: You should speak with my husband. He has been looking for you.
translation: 你应该和我丈夫谈谈。他一直在找你。

english: I am Maria Gunnars.
translation: 我是玛丽亚.冈纳斯。

english: You should speak with my husband.
translation: 你应该和我丈夫谈谈。

english: Hello, [Fremennik name].
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。

english: Hello, are you [Fremennik name]? by any chance?
translation: 你好，你碰巧是[Fremennik name]吗？

english: Well my name is [Player name], but I am known as [Fremennik name] by the Fremennik. May I ask who you are?
translation: 嗯，我叫[Player name]，但弗瑞曼尼克人叫我[Fremennik name]。请问你是谁？

english: Of course, I am Mord Gunnars, a humble ferryman.
translation: 当然，我是莫德.冈纳斯，一个卑微的摆渡人。

english: I come from an island north of here called Jatizso, while my wife Maria is from Neitiznot.
translation: 我来自北边一个叫贾蒂佐的岛屿，而我的妻子玛丽亚来自奈提兹诺镇。

english: The King of Jatizso has requested that I take you to him, as he has an important task for you.
translation: 贾蒂佐的国王要求我带你去见他，因为他有重要任务交给你。

english: Hello Mord.
translation: 你好，莫德。

english: Please introduce yourself to our ruler, His Royal Greatness King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
translation: 请向我们的统治者——伟大的国王古基.索沃特四世陛下介绍你自己。

english: Guard, who is this outlander?
translation: 守卫，这个外地人是谁？

english: Meeow?(An outlander, how unusual. Welcome.)
translation: 喵？（一个外地人，真稀奇。欢迎。）

english: This is [Fremennik name], your majesty.
translation: 陛下，这位是[Fremennik name]。

english: Is this true? You are the outlander who has been given a Fremennik name?
translation: 真的吗？你就是那个被赐予弗瑞曼尼克名字的外地人？

english: Miouw...meow.(You have a human Fremennik name, how unusual.)
translation: 喵呜……喵。（你有个人类的弗瑞曼尼克名字，真稀奇。）

english: Indeed I am.
translation: 确实是我。

english: How may I assist your Highness?
translation: 我能为陛下效劳吗？

english: Meouw!(Well, outlander, one requires a fish immediately.)
translation: 喵！（喂，外地人，本喵立刻要一条鱼。）

english: Behave Hrafn!
translation: 规矩点，赫拉芬！

english: Meeeiouw! Mewwww!(Behave yourself human! One shall behave as one likes.)
translation: 喵喵喵！喵呜！（规矩点，人类！本喵想怎样就怎样。）

english: I have a task that requires your unique-
translation: 我有个任务需要你独特的——

english: MEEEEOOOUW!!!!(Will you stop interrupting one? For the last time one requires tuna immediately.)
translation: 喵喵喵喵喵！！！！（你能不能别打断本喵？最后说一次，本喵立刻要金枪鱼。）

english: Not now, Hrafn.
translation: 现在不行，赫拉芬。

english: Now where was I?
translation: 我刚才说到哪了？

english: You mentioned a task requiring my unique-
translation: 你提到一个任务需要我独特的——

english: Your unique position among Fremennik-
translation: 你在弗瑞曼尼克人中的独特地位——

english: MEEEIOOOOUW! MIOOOOOEW! YOOWLLL!(For goodness' sake! One might acquire the mistaken impression that the human rules this place. I command you to feed me.)
translation: 喵喵喵喵喵！喵喵喵喵！嗷呜！（天哪！本喵差点以为这地方是这人类说了算。我命令你喂我。）

english: Hrafn! Oh, alright, alright, I give in.
translation: 赫拉芬！哦，好吧好吧，我认输。

english: Purrr.(And about time too, insolent human-pet.)
translation: 咕噜咕噜。（总算识相了，无礼的人类宠物。）

english: Look, could you fetch my cat some fish?
translation: 听着，你能给我的猫弄点鱼吗？

english: Then we can finish our conversation in peace.
translation: 然后我们就能安安静静地把话说完。

english: Yes, that's probably a good idea.
translation: 好，这大概是个好主意。

english: Hrafn will only eat raw tuna.
translation: 赫拉芬只吃生金枪鱼。

english: Will any raw tuna do?
translation: 任何生金枪鱼都行吗？

english: Yes, fussy though Hrafn is, he doesn't care where the tuna comes from.
translation: 是的，虽然赫拉芬很挑剔，但他不在乎金枪鱼从哪来。

english: If you don't already have any, you can catch some down by the docks, or you can buy some from my fishmonger, Flosi Dalksson.
translation: 如果你手头没有，可以去码头那边钓一些，或者从我的鱼贩弗洛西.达尔克森那里买一些。

english: Halt, in the name of King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
translation: 站住，以国王古基.索沃特四世的名义。

english: Oh, itsyou again.
translation: 哦，又是你啊。

english: Hello, [Fremennik name]. That cat really is a pain isn't he? Always interrupting the King.
translation: 你好，[Fremennik name]。那只猫真是麻烦，对吧？总是打断国王。

english: Oh, I've met worse. Still, I'd better get him his fish, otherwise he'll never keep quiet.
translation: 哦，我见过更糟的。不过，我还是去给他弄鱼吧，不然他永远不会安静。

english: Oh, go and talk to Flosi Dalksson in his shop. He'll have some tuna if you don't have any. You could also fish it from one of the spots round here, if you prefer.
translation: 哦，去店里找弗洛西.达尔克森谈谈。如果你没有金枪鱼，他那里会有。如果你愿意，也可以在这附近的某个钓鱼点钓。

english: Here you go, enjoy your fish.
translation: 给你，享用你的鱼吧。

english: What is the meaning of this serf? One specifically asked for RAW tuna, not fish defiled by human fire!
translation: 你这贱民什么意思？本喵明确要的是生金枪鱼，不是被人类火焰玷污的鱼！

english: Here you go. Enjoy your fish.
translation: 给你。享用你的鱼吧。

english: What is the meaning of this serf? How is one supposed to eat a piece of paper?
translation: 你这贱民什么意思？本喵怎么吃一张纸？

english: Here you go. enjoy your fish!
translation: 给你。享用你的鱼吧！

english: Purrrrrrrrrr (One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.)
translation: 咕噜噜噜噜噜噜（本喵对金枪鱼的新鲜度很满意。人类在这件事上表现尚可。）

english: Hello again, [Fremennik name].
translation: 又见面了，[Fremennik name]。

english: Do you have a piece of raw tuna for Hrafn?
translation: 你有给赫拉芬的生金枪鱼吗？

english: Not yet, your Highness.
translation: 还没有，陛下。

english: Miouw!(Then get a move on human!!)
translation: 喵！（那就快点，人类！！）

english: Well, what are you waiting for?
translation: 那你还等什么？

english: Yes, I have your pet's fish.
translation: 是的，我有你宠物的鱼。

english: Meow.(Hmmm, one will lower oneself to eat the fish, despite the human's insult.)
translation: 喵。（嗯，本喵就屈尊吃这鱼吧，尽管人类出言不逊。）

english: Purrr.(One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.)
translation: 咕噜噜。（本喵对金枪鱼的新鲜度很满意。人类在这件事上表现尚可。）

english: Now, what was I saying?
translation: 那么，我刚才说到哪了？

english: Ah, yes, so the Burgher of Neitiznot Island is an enemy of free-thinking Jatizso citizens. My informants tell me an increased number of trade ships have been seen docking at their ports. They must be preparing for something. Chancellor, fill in the details.
translation: 啊，对了，奈提兹诺镇的镇长是思想自由的贾蒂佐公民的敌人。我的线人告诉我，有越来越多的商船停靠在他们港口。他们一定在准备什么。首相，补充细节。

english: Sire, Sire! The Kelda merchants have arrived, they are three days early. We're not ready!
translation: 陛下，陛下！凯尔达商人到了，他们早来了三天。我们还没准备好！

english: What? We cannot afford to offend the Red Axe traders. Where are they now?
translation: 什么？我们不能得罪红斧商人。他们现在在哪？

english: They are in the hall, eating and drinking us out of food and beer. It's costing us a fortune.
translation: 他们在大厅里，把我们的食物和啤酒都吃光喝光了。这让我们花了一大笔钱。

english: Another good reason to get them their ore and get them out of town. Get all our miners on the job now!
translation: 又一个好理由，赶紧给他们矿石，让他们离开城镇。让所有矿工现在就去干活！

english: I already have. They'll never get enough ore in time, the bunch of lazy no-good layabouts.
translation: 我已经吩咐了。他们永远没法及时挖够矿石，那帮懒惰无用的懒鬼。

english: Bah! Those miners haven't learned their lesson.
translation: 呸！那些矿工还没吸取教训。

english: It may be time for some extra incentives.
translation: 也许是时候给点额外激励了。

english: Wait a minute! I'm fairly handy with a pick axe. Maybe I can help; what do you need?
translation: 等等！我用镐子还挺熟练的。也许我能帮忙；你们需要什么？

english: We need [six/seven/eight] pieces of [tin/coal/mithril] for Keldagrim's merchants.
translation: 我们需要[six/seven/eight]块[tin/coal/mithril]给凯尔达林的商人。

english: The entrance to our mines are to the north-east of the western gatehouse, outside the walls.
translation: 我们矿场的入口在西城门楼的东北方向，城墙外面。

english: If I just happen to have the ore you need in the bank, do I need to go down to your mines?
translation: 如果我碰巧在银行里有你们需要的矿石，我还需要去你们的矿场吗？

english: If you bring us the ore, we won't ask where it came from. Don't worry we're discreet.
translation: 如果你把矿石带来，我们不会问它从哪来的。别担心，我们很谨慎。

english: Hmmm, interesting. I'll get the ore then.
translation: 嗯，有意思。那我去弄矿石。

english: Can you tell me where to find the nearest mines?
translation: 你能告诉我最近的矿场在哪吗？

english: Err, there are some mines just outside the western gatehouse. I don't know what the rocks contain there though, you'll have to have a look.
translation: 呃，西城门楼外面就有一些矿场。不过我不知道那里的岩石里有什么，你得自己看看。

english: Can I have a look at your stock please?
translation: 我能看看你的库存吗？

english: No, nothing just now thanks.
translation: 不了，现在没什么，谢谢。

english: Do you have the ore?
translation: 你有矿石吗？

english: Can you remind me of what those Dwarven traders need?
translation: 你能提醒我那些矮人商人需要什么吗？

english: Of course. Please bring [six/seven/eight] pieces of [tin/coal/mithril] ore.
translation: 当然。请带来[six/seven/eight]块[tin/coal/mithril]矿石。

english: And the mines are...
translation: 矿场在……

english: The entrance to the mines is outside the western gatehouse, on the north side of the town.
translation: 矿场的入口在西城门楼外面，城镇的北侧。

english: I have bank notes to the value of the ore here.
translation: 我这里有用矿石价值兑换的票据。

english: I have the ore here.
translation: 我这里有矿石。

english: Excellent. This [man/woman] has gathered the [six/seven/eight] pieces of [tin/coal/mithril] ore needed by Keldagrim's merchants, sire.
translation: 太好了。陛下，这位[man/woman]已经收集了凯尔达林商人所需的[six/seven/eight]块[tin/coal/mithril]矿石。

english: Good, good. Please reward this [man/woman] for [his/her] efforts.
translation: 好，好。请奖励这位[man/woman]的[his/her]努力。

english: Do you have all the ore my Chancellor requested?
translation: 你有我的首相要求的所有矿石吗？

english: Please hurry back with [six/seven/eight] [tin/coal/mithril], Keldagrim's traders are drinking my cellars dry.
translation: 请快点带着[six/seven/eight]块[tin/coal/mithril]回来，凯尔达林的商人快把我的地窖喝干了。

english: I have the ore here, sir.
translation: 我这里有矿石，先生。

english: This [man/woman] has gathered the remaining ore needed by Keldagrim's merchants.
translation: 这位[man/woman]已经收集了凯尔达林商人所需的剩余矿石。

english: Excellent news, your majesty.
translation: 好消息，陛下。

english: Please reward this [man/woman] for [his/her] efforts.
translation: 请奖励这位[man/woman]的[his/her]努力。

english: Of course, your majesty.
translation: 当然，陛下。

english: Thank you [Fremennik name]. If only our miners were as efficient as you.
translation: 谢谢你，[Fremennik name]。要是我们的矿工有你这么高效就好了。

english: Right. Now let us get down to business, young [Fremennik name]. Let us hope we have no more interruptions.
translation: 好了。现在让我们谈正事吧，年轻的[Fremennik name]。希望我们不会再被打断了。

english: Certainly, your Majesty.
translation: 当然，陛下。

english: Neitiznot's Burgher, Mawnis Burowgar, is a simpleton and a fool.
translation: 奈提兹诺镇的镇长莫尼斯.布罗加是个傻瓜和白痴。

english: I have bested him before and will do so again!
translation: 我以前赢过他，以后还会再赢！

english: He is surely plotting a new plan to defeat me.
translation: 他肯定在策划新的计划来打败我。

english: He's up to something, he's always up to something.
translation: 他肯定在搞鬼，他总是在搞鬼。

english: I will not be kept in the dark about his plans any longer. I must know what underhand tricks he'll use to undermine me. He's out to get me! Get me I say!
translation: 我不会再被蒙在鼓里了。我必须知道他要用什么阴招来陷害我。他想害我！我说他想害我！

english: Ahem, I see, sir. How may I help in this matter?
translation: 咳咳，我明白了，先生。这件事我能帮上什么忙？

english: Well, I have heard that some call you 'bard' in Rellekka. Your lyre-playing reputation has carried this far.
translation: 嗯，我听说在雷勒卡城有人叫你'吟游诗人'。你弹竖琴的名声都传到这里来了。

english: You want me to play the lyre? Well actually, I've been working on a few tunes in my spare time. I have this new song about-
translation: 你想让我弹竖琴？其实我空闲时正在编几首曲子。我有一首新歌是关于——

english: Silence! I do not wish to hear your wailing. All bards are charlatans and fools.
translation: 住口！我不想听你的鬼哭狼嚎。所有吟游诗人都是骗子和傻瓜。

english: However, a fool is exactly what I need right now.
translation: 不过，现在我需要的就是一个傻瓜。

english: It's a great tune, very catching, you'll love-
translation: 这曲子很棒，很上口，你会喜欢的——

english: Bah! Bards are all the same, they never shut up! If I need to be entertained I'll hire a mime; maybe I'll get some rest then. Now if you'll listen, I'll explain what I need you to do.
translation: 呸！吟游诗人都一个样，永远不闭嘴！要是我需要消遣，我会雇个哑剧演员，或许还能休息一下。现在你给我听着，我来解释你要做什么。

english: In the past I have sent my Spymaster to 'entertain' the Burgher, and to see what he can find out.
translation: 过去我派我的间谍大师去'招待'市民官，看看他能探出什么。

english: You see, the Burgher of Neitiznot and his aides like a drink when they are being entertained, and their tongues are loose when they drink.
translation: 你知道，奈提兹诺镇的市民官和他的助手们在被招待时喜欢喝酒，喝醉了就容易说漏嘴。

english: However, yesterday my spy had an accident and could no longer help me in this task. However he is still stationed on Neitiznot.
translation: 不过，昨天我的间谍出了意外，无法再帮我完成这个任务。但他仍然驻扎在奈提兹诺镇。

english: So this is a covert operation into Neitiznot? You need me to infiltrate the Burgher's hall, undercover, and uncover his evil plans?
translation: 所以这是一次潜入奈提兹诺镇的秘密行动？你需要我乔装混进市民大厅，暗中揭穿他的邪恶计划？

english: Exactly, [Fremennik name]. So are you interested?
translation: 正是，[Fremennik name]。那你感兴趣吗？

english: Sounds like a task for an elite adventurer like myself. Mission accepted.
translation: 听起来这任务正适合我这样的精英冒险者。任务接受。

english: Excellent, [Fremennik name], you and I will get on very well.
translation: 太好了，[Fremennik name]，我们一定会合作愉快。

english: So what is the easiest way to get to Neitiznot?
translation: 那去奈提兹诺镇最方便的路是什么？

english: I suggest you catch Mord's ferry back to Rellekka and then catch a ferry from there.
translation: 我建议你坐莫德的渡船回雷勒卡城，再从那里坐渡船过去。

english: Are you sure that's the best way?
translation: 你确定这是最好的办法？

english: You may find a way across the islands, but the bridges are almost certainly broken, and there are trolls which are a bit of a nuisance. The ferry is probably both quicker and safer.
translation: 你也许能找到穿越岛屿的路，但那些桥几乎肯定都断了，而且还有巨魔捣乱。坐渡船可能更快更安全。

english: I'll be off then
translation: 那我走了。

english: Oh, there is one more thing. In order to gain an audience with the Burgher, you will need my Spymaster's, err, costume.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。要见到市民官，你需要我那个间谍大师的……呃……服装。

english: Costume?
translation: 服装？

english: The costume is in my chest. Don't forget to pick up all the pieces.
translation: 服装在我箱子里。别忘了把所有部件都拿上。

english: Then travel to Neitiznot and talk to my Spymaster. He is still over there. He will fill you in with the details, and you may report to him.
translation: 然后去奈提兹诺镇，跟我的间谍大师谈谈。他还在那边。他会告诉你细节，你也可以向他汇报。

english: Oh, the Spymaster is a secretive kind of guy. He will require a password. The password is 'free stuff please'.
translation: 哦，间谍大师是个很隐秘的人。他会要暗号。暗号是'请给免费东西'。

english: What sort of password is that?
translation: 这是什么暗号？

english: Don't ask me, it was his idea.
translation: 别问我，是他想出来的。

english: Fine. What's his name?
translation: 好吧。他叫什么名字？

english: His name is Slug Hemligssen, but don't expect him to answer to it.
translation: 他叫斯拉格.赫米利格森，但别指望他会答应。

english: So how will I recognise him?
translation: 那我怎么认出他？

english: Don't worry, you'll find him.
translation: 别担心，你会找到他的。

english: Have you finished the covert operation I asked you to complete?
translation: 你完成我交代的秘密行动了吗？

english: Well, what are you waiting for? Hop to it!
translation: 那你还等什么？行动起来！

english: Have you completed your undercover mission to Neitiznot yet?
translation: 你完成去奈提兹诺镇的卧底任务了吗？

english: Then make sure you have your costume and go. There is no time to play around!
translation: 那就确保你带上了服装，赶紧出发。没时间玩了！

english: You will look lovely in that outfit.
translation: 你穿那套衣服会很可爱。

english: You look lovely in that outfit.
translation: 你穿那套衣服看起来好可爱。

english: What do you think you're wearing, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你觉得自己穿的是什么，[Fremennik name]？

english: It's a Spymaster costume. Apparently.
translation: 这是间谍大师的服装。显然是。

english: Is that so? I've half a mind not to let you on the boat wearing that outfit. All those bells will scare the fish and maybe even attract pirates.
translation: 是吗？我有点不想让你穿那套衣服上船。那些铃铛会把鱼吓跑，甚至可能引来海盗。

english: This outfit wasn't my idea.
translation: 这打扮不是我的主意。

english: Designed to subtly blend into the background, no doubt?
translation: 设计来巧妙地融入背景，毫无疑问？

english: Clearly.
translation: 显然。

english: Hello, outlander. Don't disturb the Burgher, he has many important duties to take care of.
translation: 你好，外乡人。别打扰市民官，他有很多重要事务要处理。

english: Oh, I'll come back later.
translation: 哦，我过会儿再来。

english: Guards! Please escort this outlander to the docks. She is not welcome in my court.
translation: 卫兵！请把这位外乡人送到码头。她在我的宫廷里不受欢迎。

english: I am known as [Fremennik name] by those in Rellekka.
translation: 雷勒卡城的人称呼我为[Fremennik name]。

english: Do you have me confused with the King of Jatizso? Guards!
translation: 你是不是把我当成贾提兹索的国王了？卫兵！

english: I shall return to Rellekka. You have no need to call your guards.
translation: 我会回雷勒卡城。你没必要叫卫兵。

english: Oh, jester! Do not disturb the Burgher, he is busy with matters of import.
translation: 哦，小丑！别打扰市民官，他正忙着处理重要事务。

english: What are you doing in Neitiznot, outlander?
translation: 外乡人，你在奈提兹诺镇做什么？

english: I am no outlander, but maybe you can help me.
translation: 我不是外乡人，但也许你能帮我。

english: I am looking for King Sorvott IV?
translation: 我在找索沃特四世国王？

english: Then you should get back on a ship and sail to Jatizso then, fool. You will need to ask Maria to ferry you back to Rellekka first.
translation: 那么你应该回到船上航行到贾提兹索，傻瓜。你需要先请玛丽亚用渡船把你送回雷勒卡城。

english: Thanks, Thakkrad.
translation: 谢谢，萨克拉德。

english: Please jester, we don't have time for entertainment right now.
translation: 拜托，小丑，我们现在没时间看表演。

english: Guards, what is this outlander doing in the Burgher's chambers?
translation: 卫兵，这个外乡人在市民官的房间里做什么？

english: Halt outlander!
translation: 站住，外乡人！

english: Well you are on the wrong island. You should return to Rellekka and ask Mord to take you to Jatizso.
translation: 你走错岛了。你应该回雷勒卡城，让莫德带你去贾提兹索。

english: Thanks. I'll be on my way.
translation: 谢谢。我这就走。

english: Err, hello. I'm an unemployed jester looking for work.
translation: 呃，你好。我是个失业的小丑，正在找工作。

english: Ah! A fool. Excellent. The Burgher enjoys a watching a fool. Are you a fool? Ha Ha!
translation: 啊！一个傻瓜。太好了。市民官喜欢看傻瓜。你是个傻瓜吗？哈哈！

english: That was very clever what you did there - using the double meaning for humour. I've never heard that before. Genius.
translation: 你刚才那招真聪明——用双关来制造幽默。我从没听过这种。天才。

english: So, are you a fool? HA HA HA!
translation: 那么，你是个傻瓜吗？哈哈哈！

english: Yes, I am a fool. Are you happy now?
translation: 是的，我是个傻瓜。你满意了吧？

english: HA HA HA!
translation: 哈哈哈！

english: *sigh* Simple things entertain simple minds.
translation: *叹气* 简单的事物取悦简单的头脑。

english: Nothing. Are you going to let me perform for the Burgher?
translation: 没什么。你打算让我为市民官表演吗？

english: Mmm? Oh yes of course. You'd better introduce yourself.
translation: 嗯？哦，是的当然。你最好自我介绍一下。

english: Errr, hello. I'm an unemployed jester looking for work.
translation: 呃，你好。我是个失业的小丑，正在找工作。

english: Ah! A fool. Excellent. The last entertainer I had was not up to standard.
translation: 啊！一个傻瓜。太好了。我上一个娱乐者不够格。

english: Well, I'm as entertaining as a juggler with a bag of ferrets down his trousers.
translation: 嗯，我就像个把一袋雪貂塞进裤子的杂耍艺人一样有趣。

english: HA HA HA! Now that's funny.
translation: 哈哈哈！这才有趣。

english: I like an easy, I mean appreciative, audience.
translation: 我喜欢容易取悦的，我是说有欣赏力的观众。

english: Shall I start?
translation: 我可以开始了吗？

english: Mm? Oh yes of course...bag of ferrets eh? Haha!
translation: 嗯？哦，当然……一袋雪貂是吧？哈哈！

english: Well, new Jester! This had better be good.
translation: 好吧，新来的小丑！最好精彩点。

english: I hope I can amuse and delight as much as your last jester.
translation: 我希望我能像你上一个宫廷小丑那样让大家开怀大笑。

english: If you can amuse or delight me at all, you'll be doing much better than the last one.
translation: 如果你能让我开心或愉悦哪怕一点，你就比上一个强多了。

english: Actually his juggling was quite funny. Shame about the accident though.
translation: 其实他的杂耍还挺好笑的。可惜出了意外。

english: Bah, if he'd been a decent juggler, he could have juggled the battleaxe, flaming torches, and greased pigs we threw at him.
translation: 呸，要是个像样的杂耍艺人，就该能接住我们扔过去的战斧、燃烧的火把和涂了油的猪。

english: I see, a tough crowd then. I'd better get this right!
translation: 明白了，观众很挑剔啊。我得好好表现！

english: Aha! An encore?
translation: 啊哈！再来一次？

english: Every good performance deserves a reprise.
translation: 每场好表演都值得重演。

english: Let me entertain you!
translation: 让我来为你表演！

english: Talk, fool
translation: 说话，傻瓜

english: Dance, fool
translation: 跳舞，傻瓜

english: Juggle, fool
translation: 杂耍，傻瓜

english: Skip, fool
translation: 跳跃，傻瓜

english: Pie in your face
translation: 派糊你一脸

english: Jig, you fool
translation: 跳吉格舞，你这傻瓜

english: Och...
The jester's not bad.
translation: 这小丑还不错。

english: What was in that bottle you found?
translation: 你找到的那个瓶子里有什么？

english: The bottle had a paper hat in it.
translation: 瓶子里有一顶纸帽子。

english: Go on, drop it!
translation: 来啊，扔掉它！

english: I wonder what's for dinner?
translation: 不知道晚餐吃什么？

english: Fancy a pint at the Yellow Hind later?
translation: 待会儿去黄色母鹿喝一杯怎么样？

english: I have seen better jesters.
translation: 我见过更好的小丑。

english: Coming over for a game of cards later?
translation: 晚点过来打牌吗？

english: Is your helmet chafing?
translation: 你的头盔磨得难受吗？

english: When do we assault the caves?
translation: 我们什么时候进攻洞穴？

english: I can be ready in two days.
translation: 我两天内就能准备好。

english: Good, my recruits are nearly ready
translation: 好，我的新兵也快准备好了。

english: How many militia have you trained?
translation: 你训练了多少民兵？

english: Seventeen, so far
translation: 到目前为止，十七个。

english: More shields will be completed by noon.
translation: 正午前会完成更多盾牌。

english: And the armour?
translation: 那盔甲呢？

english: I will finish their armour tomorrow
translation: 我明天会完成他们的盔甲。

english: And the two bridges we need repaired?
translation: 那两座需要修复的桥呢？

english: I will fix them as soon as I can.
translation: 我会尽快修好它们。

english: Useless fool! Return when you routine is more polished!
translation: 没用的蠢货！等你把套路练得更熟练了再回来！

english: Well, thank you, that was much better than the last jester.
translation: 嗯，谢谢你，你比上一个弄臣好多了。

english: The fool is back.
translation: 那个傻瓜又回来了。

english: Ha, more fool you! Ha Ha Ha!
translation: 哈，你才更傻！哈哈哈！

english: Your wit has no end. Or beginning or middle. I'd better talk to the Burgher and see if he wants to be entertained.
translation: 你的机智真是无穷无尽。或者说无始无终。我最好去跟镇长谈谈，看他需不需要找点乐子。

english: Have you obtained the information we require?
translation: 你拿到我们需要的情报了吗？

english: Now I will ask you some questions, but be warned I have other sources of information that will corroborate your answers.
translation: 现在我要问你一些问题，但警告你，我还有其他情报来源可以核实你的答案。

english: I am ready to answer your questions, Operative Nighthawk.
translation: 我准备好回答你的问题了，夜鹰特工。

english: How soon does Thakkrad think Neitiznot's troops can be ready?
translation: 萨克拉德认为奈提兹诺镇的部队多久能准备好？

english: They will be ready in two days.
translation: 他们两天内就能准备好。

english: How many militia have been trained?
translation: 训练了多少民兵？

english: Seventeen militia have been trained.
translation: 已经训练了十七个民兵。

english: How many bridges does Thakkrad need repairing?
translation: 萨克拉德需要修复多少座桥？

english: There are two bridges to repair.
translation: 有两座桥需要修复。

english: Hmmm. I believe you're telling me the truth.
translation: 嗯。我相信你跟我说的是实话。

english: I would not lie to you.
translation: 我不会对你撒谎。

english: Well done! I shall inform the King of your good work. I have been authorised to give you this...
translation: 干得好！我会向国王报告你的出色工作。我已被授权给你这个……

english: Thanks to you, we know a little more about Neitiznot's plans.
translation: 多亏了你，我们对奈提兹诺镇的计划有了更多了解。

english: While you were deep undercover, I received instructions from 'Big Daddy'.
translation: 在你深入卧底的时候，我收到了‘大老爹’的指示。

english: 'Big Daddy'? Do you mean the K-
translation: ‘大老爹’？你是说国——

english: Shhhh! Yes, I mean the head operative back at home-base. He has given me permission to follow up any leads based on your intelligence.
translation: 嘘！是的，我是说总部的那位头头。他允许我根据你的情报跟进任何线索。

english: It would be useful to know exactly when the Neitiznot engineers intend to repair the bridges. I'd do it myself but my injury stops me.
translation: 如果能确切知道奈提兹诺镇的工程师打算什么时候修桥，那会很有用。我本想自己去做，但我的伤让我做不了。

english: Curse this arm and my reckless bravery in the pursuit of intelligence!
translation: 诅咒我这只手臂，还有我为了情报鲁莽逞勇的行为！

english: I heard you had an accident whilst juggling?
translation: 我听说你耍杂耍时出了意外？

english: *ahem* Misinformation my [boy/girl]. Misinformation and misdirection.
translation: *咳咳* 那是假消息，我的[boy/girl]。假消息和误导。

english: Is that so?
translation: 是这样吗？

english: Anyway, enough chit-chat.
translation: 总之，闲话少说。

english: You should gain the trust of the Burgher.
translation: 你应该赢得镇长的信任。

english: You must not mention our arrangement.
translation: 你绝不能提起我们的安排。

english: Indeed, if you are offered tasks by Neitiznot's folk or Burgher, you should go along with them to avoid arousing suspicion.
translation: 确实，如果奈提兹诺镇的居民或镇长给你任务，你应该照做，以免引起怀疑。

english: Once you know that the bridges have been repaired then return to me.
translation: 一旦你知道桥修好了，就回来找我。

english: Do not think you can lie to me. Come back when you are more inclined to give me the information I require.
translation: 别以为你能骗我。等你更愿意给我所需情报时再回来。

english: I need to make a fool of myself again.
translation: 我需要再出一次丑。

english: You'd better go back to the Burgher and get entertaining.
translation: 你最好回到镇长那里去逗乐他。

english: I shall, Mr Nighthawk.
translation: 我会的，夜鹰先生。

english: Operative 'Big Daddy' requests that you gain the trust of Mawnis Burowgar, and determine whether they intend to repair the bridges that link their island to home-base. Mission understood?
translation: 特工‘大老爹’要求你赢得莫尼斯.布罗加的信任，并确定他们是否打算修复连接他们岛屿和总部的桥梁。任务明白了吗？

english: Get a move on then.
translation: 那就快点行动吧。

english: Oh, and stay away from me unless you need to contact me. It will begin to look suspicious.
translation: 哦，还有，除非需要联系我，否则离我远点。否则会开始显得可疑。

english: Right. Yes. You blend right in otherwise.
translation: 对。是的。不然你倒是能完美融入。

english: The Burgher does not require entertainment at the moment, jester.
translation: 镇长目前不需要娱乐，小丑。

english: Ho, outlander! Please introduce yourself to the Burgher.
translation: 嗬，外乡人！请向镇长自我介绍。

english: Ah! Are you the outlander called [Fremmenik name]?
translation: 啊！你就是那个叫[Fremmenik name]的外乡人吗？

english: Yes I am. What can I do for you?
translation: 是的，我就是。有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: The Burgher would like to talk to you urgently. Please talk to him right away.
translation: 镇长有急事要和你谈。请马上去找他。

english: Welcome back [Fremennik name], how was your time on Jatizso?
translation: 欢迎回来[Fremennik name]，你在贾提索岛过得怎么样？

english: Very rewarding, thank you Maria.
translation: 收获颇丰，谢谢你，玛丽亚。

english: I have been asked to ferry you to Neitiznot, as Burgher Mawnis Burowgar would like to make you an offer.
translation: 我被要求用 渡船 送你去奈提兹诺镇，因为镇长莫尼斯.布罗加想给你一个提议。

english: Do you have any questions?
translation: 你有什么问题吗？

english: Welcome to Neitiznot, [Fremennik name]; Mawnis Burowgar lives in the largest hut in the township.
translation: 欢迎来到奈提兹诺镇，[Fremennik name]；莫尼斯.布罗加住在镇上最大的棚屋里。

english: He is expecting you, so you should not keep him waiting for too long.
translation: 他在等你，所以别让他等太久。

english: Thank you for ferrying me here Maria. See you soon.
translation: 谢谢你渡我过来，玛丽亚。回头见。

english: If you have any questions I would be happy to answer them.
translation: 如果你有任何问题，我很乐意回答。

english: Good luck in Neitiznot.
translation: 祝你在奈提兹诺镇好运。

english: Go away! I'm busy right now with important matters of state.
translation: 走开！我现在正忙着处理重要的国家大事。

english: Ah, jester. I am not currently in need of jest.
translation: 啊，小丑。我现在不需要逗乐。

english: Right now I need a Champion, not a jester.
translation: 现在我需要一个冠军，而不是小丑。

english: Ah yes.
translation: 啊，是的。

english: The Burgher is both wise and perceptive.
translation: 镇长既明智又有洞察力。

english: Ha! Fortunately for you he also has a sense of humour.
translation: 哈！算你走运，他还有幽默感。

english: Hmmmm. Guard! Who is this outlander who has been brought before me?
translation: 嗯。 守卫！这个被带到我面前的外乡人是谁？

english: Sire, this is the one who has been honoured with a Fremennik name. A rare honour indeed, for an outlander.
translation: 大人，这就是那位有幸获得费明尼克名字的人。对于外乡人来说，这确实是罕见的荣誉。

english: You jest! [He/She] doesn't look that impressive to me.
translation: 你在开玩笑！[He/She]在我看来没那么了不起。

english: Ahem. I am indeed known as [Fremennik name] by those in Rellekka.
translation: 咳咳。在雷勒卡城，我确实被称为[Fremennik name]。

english: If I am the one you seek, then how may I assist you?
translation: 如果我就是你要找的人，那我能帮你什么？

english: Well, I have sought an audience with you for several days now.
translation: 嗯，我已经求见你好几天了。

english: I have need for a courageous and valiant individual.
translation: 我需要一个勇敢而英勇的人。

english: One who will not flee at the sight of jest a few trolls.
translation: 一个不会一看到几个 巨魔 就逃跑的人。

english: Ha! It is trolls that fear me! I am Fremennik!
translation: 哈！是巨魔怕我才对！我是费明尼克人！

english: Ha! Well said! However, this is no jesting matter. Although a Fremennik name goes a great way towards gaining my trust, I must ask that you prove your loyalty to me and my kinsfolk.
translation: 哈！说得好！不过，这可不是开玩笑的事。虽然一个费明尼克名字大大有助于赢得我的信任，但我必须要求你证明你对我以及我的族人的忠诚。

english: Sire, surely that isn't necessary! Anyone who has done the Fremennik Trials can be trusted.
translation: 大人，这肯定没必要！任何完成过 费明尼克试炼 的人都值得信任。

english: Trust me Fridleif, I think in this case it is necessary. Anyway, there are many tasks that need to be done. Some of them are menial, and [Fremennik name] needs to show me that [he/she] can handle these as well as the ones that
translation: 相信我，弗里德莱夫，我认为在这种情况下这是必要的。总之，有很多任务需要完成。其中一些是琐碎的，而[Fremennik name]需要向我展示[he/she]能处理好这些，以及那些只需要勇气的任务。

english: simply require bravery. We on Neitiznot are warriors, but we are not just warriors.
translation: 我们奈提兹诺镇的人是战士，但我们不仅仅是战士。

english: I apologise for speaking out of turn. The Burgher is wise as always.
translation: 我为我的失言道歉。镇长一如既往地明智。

english: I would be honoured to assist you and your tribe, Burgher Burowgar. Indeed I expected no less. This sort of thing seems to happen to me a lot.
translation: 我很荣幸能帮助你以及你的部落，布罗加镇长。事实上，我预料到了。这种事我经常遇到。

english: Thakkrad, which tasks remain?
translation: 萨克拉德，还有哪些任务没完成？

english: There are a few building projects that could do with a strong extra hand.
translation: 有几个建筑项目正需要一把强壮的帮手。

english: Well then, [Fremennik name], are you willing to assist my engineer?
translation: 那么，[Fremennik name]，你愿意协助我的 工程师 吗？

english: Of course, Mawnis Burowgar.
translation: 当然，莫尼斯.布罗加。

english: The bridges to the troll islands need repairing if we are to send a party over. First of all, we will need eight lengths of rope; maybe [Fremennik name] could assist me with this.
translation: 通往巨魔岛屿的桥需要修复，我们才能派队伍过去。首先，我们需要八根 绳子；也许[Fremennik name]可以帮我这个忙。

english: It's quite simple really. Gather some yak hair and take it to the spinning wheel in the south-east of the village.
translation: 其实很简单。收集一些 牦牛 毛，然后拿到村子东南角的 纺车 那里。

english: There you will be able to spin the yak hair you have gathered into strong lengths of rope.
translation: 在那里，你可以把你收集的牦牛毛纺成结实的绳子。

english: Is any rope fine for this?
translation: 什么样的绳子都行吗？

english: Of course not. Neitiznot rope is the best. Real men use yak rope. You need to make the rope yourself.
translation: 当然不行。奈提兹诺镇的绳子是最好的。真男人都用牦牛绳。你得自己制作绳子。

english: Hmmm, the rope I've seen round here looks exactly the same as the rope I'm used to. It's exactly the same isn't it?
translation: 嗯，我在这附近看到的绳子看起来和我平时用的绳子一模一样。其实是一样的，对吧？

english: Well yes, of course it is. We supply rope to all of the rope traders in Gielinor. Itsan excellent business.
translation: 嗯，是的，当然是一样的。我们向吉莱诺所有的绳子商人供应绳子。这是一门好生意。

english: Anyway, once you have obtained the rope we shall speak more about the quest I have for you. So get a move on!
translation: 总之，一旦你拿到绳子，我们再详谈我给你的任务。所以快去吧！

english: Right! I'll just go to the bank and get some rope.
translation: 好！我这就去 银行 拿些绳子。

english: Bank? Why do you need to go to a bank? Neitiznot is the home of quality rope. The hairs of the local yak have the perfect combination of strength and hardiness required from modern rope. Yak rope is stronger and
translation: 银行？为什么要去银行？奈提兹诺镇是优质绳子的产地。当地牦牛的毛发兼具现代绳子所需的强度和韧性。牦牛绳更结实，而且

english: better than any other rope.
translation: 比任何其他绳子都好。

english: I thought rope was made from wool. Not yak hair.
translation: 我以为绳子是用羊毛做的，不是牦牛毛。

english: Wool? Wool? What a load of old rope. Wool would make awful rope - its far too soft and it would soak up the water too easily.
translation: 羊毛？羊毛？真是胡说八道。羊毛做绳子糟透了——太软了，而且吸水太快。

english: So how come Ned from Draynor makes rope out of wool?
translation: 那为什么德雷诺的内德用羊毛做绳子？

english: Ned? I don't know anything about Ned. I do know we make regular trades with someone in that area. We send them rope, and we get wool in return.
translation: 内德？我对内德一无所知。我只知道我们和那个地区的某人定期交易。我们给他们送绳子，他们用羊毛交换。

english: So Ned doesn't make the rope? What a fraud! He had me fooled for so long.
translation: 所以内德不做绳子？真是个骗子！他骗了我这么久。

english: Anyway, so that means that all rope is made by Neitiznot from yak hair.
translation: 总之，这意味着所有绳子都是奈提兹诺镇用牦牛毛做的。

english: So if I happen to have some rope in the bank then that would also be made from high quality Neitiznot yak hair.
translation: 所以如果我银行里碰巧有些绳子，那也应该是用高品质的奈提兹诺镇牦牛毛制成的。

english: So I could just give you the rope I already have, rather than make more rope?
translation: 那么我可以直接给你我已有的绳子，而不是再做更多绳子？

english: I suppose so. You should really try to make some rope yourself though. Fighting the dual challenges of the yak's hooves and its smell is part of becoming a man over here.
translation: 我想是的。不过你真的应该自己试着做绳子。在这里，对抗牦牛蹄子和气味的双重挑战是成为男子汉的一部分。

english: I've had enough of strange 'coming of age' rituals for the time being. I'm going to go to the bank and get the rope you need.
translation: 我暂时受够了奇怪的‘成人礼’。我去银行拿你需要的绳子。

english: As it happens, I'm carrying a note for enough rope on me right now.
translation: 碰巧，我现在身上带着一张足够绳子的票据。

english: A note? How do you fix a bridge with a note? Go bring me some real rope.
translation: 票据？你怎么用票据修桥？去给我拿些真绳子来。

english: As it happens, I'm carrying enough rope on me right now.
translation: 碰巧，我现在身上带着足够的绳子。

english: That's a coincidence.
translation: 真巧。

english: Do you normally carry all that rope around with you?
translation: 你平时都随身带着那么多绳子吗？

english: Err, no. I had a feeling I'd need it.
translation: 呃，不是。我有预感会用到它。

english: Are you some kind of seer?
translation: 你是某种先知吗？

english: Hey! You're not some sort of witch are you? Maybe I have trusted you too much.
translation: 嘿！你不是什么女巫吧？也许我太信任你了。

english: No, no, no! Itsjust a coincidence. Err, I spend my time trading rope. Yes that's right. I'm a rope trader and I just happen to have my wares on me.
translation: 不不不！只是巧合。呃，我平时做绳子生意。没错，我是个绳子商人，碰巧带着我的货物。

english: You have come to the home of all rope to sell us...rope. What a load of old rope (ahem).
translation: 你来到所有绳子的故乡卖给我们……绳子。真是胡说八道（咳咳）。

english: You asked for it! Do you want this rope or not?
translation: 是你要求的！你到底要不要这绳子？

english: Alright then. Let's have a look at his rope then.
translation: 那好吧。那就看看他的绳子。

english: You don't have space for the Burgher's reward.
translation: 你没有空间放市民官的奖励。

english: Hello, [sir/ma'am]! If you need help with your tasks then you are welcome to talk to the Burgher or his advisors.
translation: 你好，[sir/ma'am]！如果你需要任务帮助，欢迎和市民官或他的顾问谈谈。

english: Hello again. Do you have the eight pieces of rope that Thakkrad asked you for?th
translation: 又见面了。你有塔克拉德要的八根绳子吗？

english: No, I still don't have them.
translation: 不，我还没有。

english: You can collect pieces of hair from the yaks that roam our isle, then spin it into rope.
translation: 你可以从我们岛上漫游的牦牛身上收集毛发，然后纺成绳子。

english: Thank you, I shall return soon.
translation: 谢谢，我很快回来。

english: There is a spinning wheel in the south-east of the village.
translation: 村子东南方有一个纺车。

english: Have you collected all the rope we need yet?
translation: 你收集齐我们需要的所有绳子了吗？

english: Hello, Operative Nigh-
translation: 你好，特工奈——

english: Shhh, and stay away from me unless you need to contact me. It will begin to look suspicious.
translation: 嘘，离我远点，除非你需要联系我。这样会显得可疑。

english: Hello again. Do you have the eight pieces of rope that Thakkrad asked you for?
translation: 又见面了。你有塔克拉德要的八根绳子吗？

english: Ah, excellent quality rope. Good work, [Fremennik name].
translation: 啊，品质极好的绳子。干得好，[Fremennik name]。

english: Thakkrad! Please reward [Fremennik name] for [his/her] efforts.
translation: 塔克拉德！请奖励[Fremennik name]的[his/her]努力。

english: Good work, we will need that rope later. Put it somewhere safe for the time being would you?
translation: 干得好，我们之后会用到那些绳子。暂时把它放在安全的地方好吗？

english: I'll do that shortly.
translation: 我马上做。

english: So, I've done your menial task; what is this secret quest? That's what really interests me.
translation: 那么，我完成了你的琐碎任务；这个秘密任务是什么？那才是我真正感兴趣的。

english: My, you are both impertinent and impatient. I have two more tasks for you before I am willing to tell you the full details.
translation: 哎呀，你既无礼又没耐心。在我愿意告诉你全部细节之前，我还有两个任务给你。

english: Very well, what must I do next?
translation: 很好，接下来我必须做什么？

english: Thakkrad?
translation: 塔克拉德？

english: I require eight arctic pine logs, which have been split in two. Arctic pines grow around the village and there is a 'Woodcutting stump' in the centre of the village you can split the logs on.
translation: 我需要八根北极松原木，每根劈成两半。北极松树长在村子周围，村子中央有一个‘伐木桩’，你可以在上面劈开原木。

english: I see. That shouldn't be a problem.
translation: 我明白了。那应该没问题。

english: Once you have eight pieces of rope and eight split logs I will explain how you can use them to repair the bridges that the trolls attacked a few days ago.
translation: 一旦你有了八根绳子和八根劈开的原木，我会解释如何用它们修复几天前巨魔攻击的桥。

english: I would be happy to help your kinsfolk, Mawnis Burowgar.
translation: 我很乐意帮助你的同胞，莫尼斯.布罗加。

english: Ah, a bit more respect. That's better.
translation: 啊，多一点尊重。这样好多了。

english: I shall speak with you again once you have prepared these split logs.
translation: 等你准备好这些劈开的原木后，我会再和你谈。

english: Hello again; do you have the eight split logs that Thakkrad asked you to make?
translation: 又见面了；你有塔克拉德让你做的八根劈开的原木吗？

english: Hello again, do you have the eight split logs that I asked you to make?
translation: 又见面了，你有我让你做的八根劈开的原木吗？

english: You must fell eight arctic pine then split the logs in two with an axe.
translation: 你必须砍倒八棵北极松，然后用斧头把原木劈成两半。

english: Thank you sir, I shall return soon.
translation: 谢谢先生，我很快回来。

english: My, that was fast.
translation: 哎呀，真快。

english: [Fremennik name] has returned with the split logs you asked for. Please reward [him/her] for [his/her] efforts.
translation: [弗瑞曼尼克名字]带着你要的劈开原木回来了。请奖励[他的/她的]努力。

english: Good work. Now that you have both the rope and split logs I shall explain how you go about repairing our bridges.
translation: 干得好。既然你有了绳子和劈开的原木，我会解释如何修复我们的桥。

english: Once this is complete I shall explain the quest I have for you.
translation: 一旦完成，我会解释我给你的任务。

english: Thakkrad, could you explain what needs doing next?
translation: 塔克拉德，你能解释接下来需要做什么吗？

english: I would like you to repair the two bridges leading to the northern isle.
translation: 我希望你修复通往北方岛屿的两座桥。

english: To repair each bridge you will need four pieces of rope, four split logs and a knife.
translation: 修复每座桥需要四根绳子、四根劈开的原木和一把小刀。

english: Very well, I shall get on with that now.
translation: 很好，我现在就开始。

english: You may find a bridge to a small isle, rich in resources. You will not be able to repair it, as I still have to replace the main supports. Leave that bridge - we don't need it to make our raid.
translation: 你可能会发现一座通往资源丰富小岛的桥。你无法修复它，因为我还要更换主要支撑。别管那座桥——我们不需要它来进行突袭。

english: I shall speak with you again once you have repaired the bridges.
translation: 等你修好桥后，我会再和你谈。

english: You should speak to Burgher Mawnis Burowgar about repairing our bridges.
translation: 你应该和市民官莫尼斯.布罗加谈谈修复我们的桥的事。

english: Do you need any help with the bridge repairs?
translation: 你需要桥修复方面的帮助吗？

english: How do I repair these bridges again?
translation: 我该怎么修复这些桥来着？

english: You will the need the split arctic pine logs and the coils of rope you collected earlier. You will need one for of each per bridge. You will also require a knife.
translation: 你需要之前收集的劈开的北极松原木和成卷的绳子。每座桥各需要一份。你还需要一把小刀。

english: Where do I find these bridges?
translation: 我在哪里找到这些桥？

english: If you leave the west gate you will find a couple of bridges that lead to a thin strip of island north of this one. Both bridges that need to be repaired lead northwards from this island; one to the west and
translation: 如果你离开西门，你会发现几座桥通往这座岛北边的一条狭长岛屿。需要修复的两座桥都从这座岛向北延伸；一座向西，

english: another near the centre. There is another bridge to the East, but you don't need to worry about that one.
translation: 另一座靠近中心。东边还有一座桥，但你不用担心那座。

english: Ho there! have you repaired both bridges for my engineer?
translation: 喂！你为我的工程师修好了两座桥吗？

english: Thakkrad? Can you fill in the details?
translation: 塔克拉德？你能补充细节吗？

english: I have carried out your orders, Sir.
translation: 我已经执行了你的命令，先生。

english: Excellent. We are one step closer to putting my plan into action.
translation: 太好了。我们离实施我的计划又近了一步。

english: Now that the bridges are repaired I feel I can tell you of our plans.
translation: 既然桥修好了，我觉得可以告诉你我们的计划了。

english: First, I shall have my engineer reward you for you efforts.
translation: 首先，我会让我的工程师奖励你的努力。

english: [Fremennik name] has repaired both bridges. Please reward [him/her] for [his/her] efforts, Thakkrad.
translation: [弗瑞曼尼克名字]修好了两座桥。请奖励[他的/她的]努力，塔克拉德。

english: That is most generous of you, Sir.
translation: 您真是太慷慨了，先生。

english: We are a generous folk, over here on Neitiznot.
translation: 我们奈提兹诺镇的人很慷慨。

english: Good work! Now that you have repaired our bridges I can make the final preparations for our assault on the troll caves.
translation: 干得好！既然你修好了我们的桥，我可以为进攻巨魔洞穴做最后准备了。

english: Troll caves!
translation: 巨魔洞穴！

english: Long ago, the ancestors of this isle fought heroically against the troll menace upon these isles.
translation: 很久以前，这座岛的祖先英勇地对抗了这些岛上的巨魔威胁。

english: But, for the last few generations, we have been preoccupied with fighting our neighbours on Jatizso.
translation: 但是，在过去几代人中，我们一直忙于与贾提兹索的邻居作战。

english: In our complacency, the trolls have grown in number and strength and have become increasingly brazen in their raids, attacking our kinsfolk, stealing and destroying our belongings. Now the time has come for
translation: 在我们自满之时，巨魔的数量和力量都增长了，并且越来越肆无忌惮地袭击，攻击我们的同胞，偷窃和破坏我们的财物。现在时机已到，

english: us to drive the trolls from this isle. We must defeat their leader, the foul Troll King.
translation: 我们要把巨魔赶出这座岛。我们必须击败他们的首领，邪恶的巨魔国王。

english: Although I am confident we will be victorious, I am a cautious man.
translation: 虽然我确信我们会胜利，但我是一个谨慎的人。

english: We have suffered for many generations and the blood of our ancestors grows weak.
translation: 我们遭受了多代人的苦难，祖先的血脉变得虚弱。

english: But now, in this time of prosperity, Fridleif has recruited the bravest Fremennik warriors from far and wide to win back our honour.
translation: 但现在，在这繁荣时期，弗里德莱夫从四面八方招募了最勇敢的弗瑞曼尼克战士来赢回我们的荣誉。

english: Now that you have proven your loyalty, I offer you the honour of leading my forces into battle.
translation: 既然你证明了你的忠诚，我授予你领导我的部队作战的荣誉。

english: What say you, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你怎么说，[Fremennik name]？

english: I am honoured, Burowgar.
translation: 我很荣幸，布罗加。

english: I gratefully accept your offer to lead the charge against your foes.
translation: 我感激地接受你的提议，领导对抗你的敌人的冲锋。

english: Excellent! Once Fridleif's militia arrive and are fully equipped we shall head north into the troll caves.
translation: 太好了！一旦弗里德莱夫的民兵到达并全副武装，我们就向北进入巨魔洞穴。

english: Glory to the Fremenniks.
translation: 荣耀归于弗瑞曼尼克人。

english: Death to the trolls.
translation: 巨魔必死。

english: I have one last concern. I suspect that King Sorvott may have some idea that we intend to make this raid.
translation: 我还有一个担忧。我怀疑索沃特国王可能知道我们打算进行这次突袭。

english: I'm afraid that may be true sire.
translation: 恐怕确实如此，陛下。

english: If he and his men were willing to aid us in this task then that would not be a problem, however I suspect that Sorvott will see our actions and misinterpret them. He may well attempt to prevent us. I need to know the
