translation: 如果他和他的手下愿意协助我们完成这个任务，那就没问题，但我怀疑索沃特会看到我们的行动并误解它们。他很可能会试图阻止我们。我需要知道

english: extent of his knowledge so that I may plan. [Fremennik name], I suspect that you may be able to help us here. I find underhand methods distasteful, however I ask you to go to Jatizso and find the King's plans by whatever means
translation: 他了解的程度，以便我制定计划。[Fremennik name]，我怀疑你也许能在这里帮助我们。我觉得卑鄙的手段令人反感，但我还是要求你去贾提兹索，用任何你熟悉的方法找出国王的计划。

english: you are familiar with.
translation: 你熟悉的方法。

english: I can do this sire.
translation: 我能做到，陛下。

english: Do you need anything from me to help you?
translation: 你需要我提供什么帮助吗？

english: Err, no. I believe I already have all the...contacts I need.
translation: 呃，不用。我想我已经有了所有需要的……联络人。

english: Excellent. Then make your way with haste.
translation: 很好。那就赶紧出发吧。

english: My militia are still gathering in Rellekka. Have you found out anything about Jatizso's plans yet?
translation: 我的民兵还在雷勒卡城集结。你打听到贾提佐的计划了吗？

english: Not yet sir, but I shall return soon.
translation: 还没有，长官，但我很快就会回来。

english: Have you found out about Jatizso's plans yet, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 你打听到贾提佐的计划了吗，[Fremennik name]？

english: Thanks Thakkrad, i'm on my way there now.
translation: 谢谢塔克拉德，我现在正在去那里的路上。

english: Our militia are still preparing themselves for our raid against the trolls.
translation: 我们的民兵还在为突袭巨魔做准备。

english: Have you found out about Jatizso's plans yet?
translation: 你打听到贾提佐的计划了吗？

english: Not yet, but I am on my way there now.
translation: 还没有，但我现在正在去那里的路上。

english: Hello again, [Fremennik name], I hear you are to be appointed as the Burgher's Champion?
translation: 又见面了，[Fremennik name]，我听说你被任命为自治市民的冠军了？

english: He said something about leading his forces into battle, but I didn't hear the Burgher use the word 'champion'.
translation: 他说了什么要带领部队上阵的话，但我没听到自治市民用'冠军'这个词。

english: Well you see, Mawnis Burowgar is a superstitious man. He lost a Champion, several years back. It was really embarrassing...
translation: 你看，莫尼斯.布罗加是个迷信的人。几年前他失去过一位冠军，那件事真的很尴尬……

english: The Champion strapped so much armour to himself that he fell straight through the jetty on arrival here and didn't even meet the Burgher.
translation: 那个冠军给自己绑了太多盔甲，结果一到码头就直接掉进了水里，连自治市民的面都没见着。

english: So you see, Mawnis won't use the term 'Champion' often, as he believes it brings bad luck.
translation: 所以你看，莫尼斯不常使用'冠军'这个词，因为他认为那会带来厄运。

english: Welcome back [Fremennik name]. How was your time on Neitiznot?
translation: 欢迎回来，[Fremennik name]。你在奈提兹诺镇过得怎么样？

english: You should speak with my husband. King Sorvott has been asking for you.
translation: 你应该跟我丈夫谈谈。索沃特国王一直在找你。

english: I hope your mission was successful. Talk with the King, I'm sure he has some things he wishes to discuss with you.
translation: 希望你的任务成功了。去跟国王谈谈吧，我相信他有些事想跟你讨论。

english: Have you gathered the information about when Neitiznot's bridges will be repaired?
translation: 你收集到关于奈提兹诺镇的桥梁何时修好的情报了吗？

english: I have, sir. They have been repaired.
translation: 收集到了，长官。它们已经修好了。

english: Outrageous, how are they working so rapidly?
translation: 岂有此理，他们怎么干得这么快？

english: The Fremennik are a very resourceful folk, your majesty.
translation: 弗瑞门尼克人足智多谋，陛下。

english: That may be, but we are very different from the vermin on Neitiznot.
translation: 也许吧，但我们跟奈提兹诺镇的那些害虫可不一样。

english: We must amass our troops immediately. We must be ready for Neitiznot's army to attack us.
translation: 我们必须立刻集结部队。我们必须做好抵御奈提兹诺镇军队攻击的准备。

english: Your majesty.
translation: 陛下。

english: Chancellor, how are the city's coffers? We will need to pay for weapons and food for our soldiers.
translation: 总理大臣，城市的国库情况如何？我们需要为士兵们支付武器和食物的费用。

english: Would you like the financial report now, sir?
translation: 您想现在听听财务报告吗，长官？

english: Once we have paid for all the supplies you...err...I have ordered, your Royal Highness, then the coffers will be at their lowest ebb for some time. However, if we tighten our belts and delay your plans for extra
translation: 一旦我们付清了所有您……呃……我订购的补给品，殿下，国库将在接下来一段时间处于最低水平。不过，如果我们勒紧腰带，推迟您额外的防御计划，那么——

english: defences, then-
translation: 防御计划，那么——

english: What! That is not acceptable! How am I supposed to run this city when I am surrounded by incompetence!
translation: 什么！这不可接受！我身边全是无能之辈，让我怎么管理这座城市！

english: Now, more than ever, we need to protect ourselves from the threat from Neitiznot. This is a time of national crisis. Every citizen of Jatizso must bear the burden of protecting our homes. If it means that as
translation: 现在，我们比以往任何时候都更需要保护自己免受奈提兹诺镇的威胁。这是国家危机时刻。贾提佐的每一位市民都必须承担起保护家园的重任。如果这意味着作为市民，我们必须为贾提佐的利益牺牲一些奢侈品，那就必须这么做。我们必须增加税收。

english: citizens we must sacrifice some luxuries for the good of Jatizso, then it must be so. We must raise more taxes.
translation: 我们必须为贾提佐的利益牺牲一些奢侈品。我们必须增加税收。

english: But we have already collected Island Taxes this month! We'll never persuade anyone to pay it. Everyone is surviving on coppers as it is.
translation: 但这个月我们已经收过岛屿税了！我们绝对没法说服任何人再交税。大家现在都靠几个铜币勉强度日。

english: Yes, well, whatever. Needs must. Think up a new tax.
translation: 嗯，好吧，随便。必须如此。想个新税种出来。

english: A new tax!
translation: 一个新税种！

english: I'm not sure that's such-
translation: 我不确定这是不是——

english: Be quiet serf.
translation: 闭嘴，贱民。

english: Hey you-
translation: 喂，你——

english: Yes, I was having a discussion with King Vargas the other day. He was saying some places have taxes for all kinds of things; fur taxes, blueberry taxes, tea taxes, playing card taxes. All we need to do is pick something
translation: 对了，我之前跟瓦加斯国王讨论过。他说有些地方对各种东西征税：毛皮税、蓝莓税、茶叶税、扑克牌税。我们只需要选一个人人都有的东西。

english: that lots of people have. How about a Window Tax? We have windows on the island.
translation: 窗户税怎么样？岛上到处都是窗户。

english: A Window Tax?
translation: 窗户税？

english: Yes, yes. That's an excellent idea. I now institute a new Window Tax. Every building with windows. Other countries have Window Taxes, we need them as well.
translation: 对对对，这个主意好极了。我现在就设立一种新的窗户税。所有有窗户的建筑都要交。其他国家也有窗户税，我们也要有。

english: Err, what? I'm not sure I agree with-
translation: 呃，什么？我不确定我同意——

english: How am I going to sell this one?
translation: 我该怎么把这事推销出去？

english: Well, you had better find a way, and fast! Oh, [Fremennik name] you seem like someone who gets things done. I now appoint you official tax collector of Jatizso!
translation: 那你最好赶紧想个办法，而且要快！哦，[Fremennik name]，你看起来是个能办事的人。我现在任命你为贾提佐的正式税务官！

english: Why would I want to be a tax collector for a-
translation: 我为什么要给一个——

english: Shhh! Please whisper, [Fremennik name]! For both our sakes just agree, otherwise he'll get into one of his moods, and who knows what he'll pronounce.
translation: 嘘！请小声点，[Fremennik name]！为了我们俩好，先答应下来，不然他又要发脾气了，谁知道他会宣布什么。

english: [Fremennik name]! I command you to refill the royal coffers! Thorkel will work out the details.
translation: [Fremennik name]！我命令你充实国库！托克尔会处理细节。

english: You don't have space for the King's tax bag.
translation: 你身上没有空间放国王的税务袋了。

english: How is this island supposed to develop if we keep spending all our money on his paranoid schemes?
translation: 如果我们一直把钱都花在他那些偏执的计划上，这座岛还怎么发展？

english: Thorkel, can you tell me about this taxation?
translation: 托克尔，你能跟我说说这项税收吗？

english: You need to speak with some of the citizens of Jatizso and collect their taxes.
translation: 你需要跟贾提佐的一些市民谈谈，然后收他们的税。

english: Count the number of windows on each building and tax the people who work inside. 1000 per window.
translation: 数一数每栋建筑上的窗户数量，然后向在里面工作的人征税。每扇窗户1000金币。

english: The only people who earn any real money on the island are shopkeepers. Soldiers clearly do not need to be taxed, as paying soldiers' wages is part of the reason for the tax in the first place.
translation: 岛上真正赚钱的只有店主。士兵显然不需要缴税，因为支付士兵的工资本身就是征税的原因之一。

english: Once you have finished collecting the taxes, come and speak to me again.
translation: 收完税之后，再来跟我谈谈。

english: Thank you for helping our fine city [Fremennik name].
translation: 谢谢你帮助我们这座美好的城市，[Fremennik name]。

english: Have you collected the Window Taxes yet?
translation: 你收完窗户税了吗？

english: Not yet, though I've just noticed that this building has more windows in it than any other building.
translation: 还没，不过我刚刚注意到，这栋建筑的窗户比其他任何建筑都多。

english: And your point is?
translation: 你想说什么？

english: Oh, nothing. I'll get back to collecting taxes.
translation: 哦，没什么。我继续去收税了。

english: Good [lad/lass].
translation: 好孩子。

english: Hurry, I need to see my treasury overflowing!
translation: 快点，我要看到我的金库满溢！

english: Go and speak with Thorkel if you need to know who to tax.
translation: 如果你需要知道该向谁收税，去找托克尔谈谈。

english: Can you tell me who I should tax?
translation: 你能告诉我应该向谁收税吗？

english: Well, for the Window Tax, only those who use a building.
translation: 嗯，对于窗户税，只向使用建筑的人征收。

english: Go to each of the buildings in town:
translation: 去镇上的每一栋建筑：

english: The armourer's hut and the weaponsmith's hut, the eating hall, and the fish shop; all these buildings need to be taxed. The royal hall doesn't need to be taxed, nor the bank or any empty buildings.
translation: 盔甲匠的小屋、武器匠的小屋、食堂和鱼店；这些建筑都需要征税。王室大厅不需要征税，银行和任何空置建筑也不需要。

english: Count the number of windows the building has and then ask one of the people who works there to pay the tax.
translation: 数一数建筑有多少扇窗户，然后请在那里工作的人之一交税。

english: The tax is currently 1000gp per window.
translation: 目前的税额是每扇窗户1000金币。

english: As you do so your tax bag will fill up slowly. When you've taxed everyone you can, come back here and talk to me or the King.
translation: 当你这样做时，你的税务袋会慢慢装满。当你向所有能收税的人收完后，回来跟我或国王谈谈。

english: Oh, hello. Tax collector, huh? You're not going to tax me are you?
translation: 哦，你好。税务官，嗯？你不会要向我收税吧？

english: Not right now. You haven't lived here for a while anyway, and the King seems most keen to tax shopkeepers, so I reckon you are tax exempt!
translation: 现在不会。反正你在这里也没住多久，而且国王似乎最热衷于向店主征税，所以我想你是免税的！

english: Phew! In that case, can I do anything for you?
translation: 呼！那我能为你做点什么吗？

english: Not yet. I have a small task I must complete in order to ingratiate myself with King Sorvott.
translation: 暂时没有。我有一项小任务必须完成，以便讨好索沃特国王。

english: I jest not.
translation: 我不是在开玩笑。

english: Well then, you'd better get on with it.
translation: 那你最好赶紧去做。

english: Don't give me the tax bag until you have collected tax from everyone!
translation: 没向所有人收完税之前，别把税务袋给我！

english: Ah, sorry. I'll be right back
translation: 啊，抱歉。我马上回来。

english: Something odd has happenend to your tax bag. Let's try and sort it out.
translation: 你的税务袋出了点奇怪的问题。我们试着解决一下。

english: Where's your tax bag?
translation: 你的税务袋呢？

english: I've left it in the bank.
translation: 我把它留在银行了。

english: Hey! Carry that tax bag around with you while collecting tax, otherwise where will you put the money?
translation: 嘿！收税的时候要把税务袋带在身上，不然你把钱放哪儿？

english: I need to talk to you about tax.
translation: 我需要跟你谈谈税务的事。

english: Hmm, a fascinating subject, I'm sure.
translation: 嗯，我相信这是个引人入胜的话题。

english: I think you owe the state some tax.
translation: 我想你欠国家一些税。

english: So hand it over!
translation: 所以交出来吧！

english: I will do, I will do. Oh, I have a question. Do you use a bank?
translation: 我会交的，我会交的。哦，我有个问题。你用银行吗？

english: Often?
translation: 经常用吗？

english: Yes, every day.
translation: 是的，每天都用。

english: Wouldn't it be awkward if banks started charging for their services?
translation: 如果银行开始对服务收费，那不是会很尴尬吗？

english: And what would happen if those charges were backdated to all previous bank visits?
translation: 而且如果这些费用要追溯到以前所有的银行访问，那会怎么样？

english: How much would that be I wonder? Say, if we charged 10gp per transaction. Let me work it out and you can take it away from the tax. 10, 20, 30...
translation: 我想知道那会有多少钱？比如说，每笔交易收费10金币。让我算算，然后你可以从税额里扣掉。10、20、30……

english: Okay, I get the picture. I'm happy to announce you are exempt from taxation this year.
translation: 好吧，我明白了。我很高兴地宣布你今年免税。

english: Really? That's fortunate - I won't need to implement bank charges then.
translation: 真的吗？那真是太幸运了——那我就不需要实施银行收费了。

english: Ho hum, I suppose bankers know how to save money...
translation: 哼，我想银行家们知道怎么省钱……

english: I have been appointed by the King to collect taxes.
translation: 我已经被国王任命来收税。

english: I'm afraid the King has instituted a new tax on windows. It is 1000gp per window. Fortunately you only need to pay once per building.
translation: 恐怕国王已经设立了一种新的窗户税。每扇窗户1000金币。幸运的是，每栋建筑只需要付一次。

english: Oh, another one of the King's paranoid schemes. He's like a parasite sucking the life out of the town. Alright, how much does he want?
translation: 哦，又是国王的一个偏执计划。他就像个寄生虫，吸干这座镇的活力。好吧，他想要多少？

english: What? Can't you count? I'm not paying my tax to someone who can't count.
translation: 什么？你不会数数吗？我可不会把税交给一个连数都不会数的人。

english: That's not right. I'm not paying you that much!
translation: 不对。我不会付给你那么多！

english: *sigh* It seems a lot of money for some windows.
translation: *叹气* 为了几扇窗户花这么多钱，真不值。

english: This tax does seem a little harsh on you.
translation: 这项税对你们来说确实有点苛刻。

english: But rules are rules. Pay up!
translation: 但规矩就是规矩。交钱吧！

english: I'll think about it a bit.
translation: 我再考虑一下。

english: More taxes? How depressing.
translation: 又要加税？真让人沮丧。

english: I'm afraid the King has instituted a new Window Tax to pay for the defence of the realm. It is 1000gp per window. The tax is per building so only one of you have to pay.
translation: 恐怕国王已经设立了一项新的窗户税来支付王国的防御。每扇窗户1000金币。税收按建筑计算，所以你们中只有一个人需要支付。

english: Why should I pay Window Tax when I don't want any windows. I'd be more than happy staring at the blank walls. How much money are we supposed to pay?
translation: 我根本不想要窗户，凭什么要交窗户税？我宁愿盯着空墙看。我们到底要交多少钱？

english: It's tax time I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕又到收税时间了。

english: But we only paid our Island Tax last week!
translation: 但我们上周才刚交过岛屿税！

english: I'm afraid the King has instituted a new Window Tax. 1000gp per window.
translation: 恐怕国王新设了一项窗户税。每扇窗户1000金币。

english: *sigh* How much do you want?
translation: *叹气* 你们要多少？

english: I suppose I could pay the tax for you.
translation: 我想我可以替你付这笔税。

english: Thank you, thank you! I owe you one.
translation: 谢谢，谢谢！我欠你一个人情。

english: I thought that was all done for the month.
translation: 我以为这个月的税都交完了。

english: I'm afraid the King has instituted a new Window Tax to pay for the defence of the realm. It is 1000gp per window. The tax is paid on a building-by-building basis. Only one of you needs to pay...
translation: 恐怕国王已经设立了一项新的窗户税来支付王国的防御。每扇窗户1000金币。税收按建筑逐一计算。你们中只有一个人需要支付……

english: You expect me to pay a tax for THESE windows. They're not windows, they are holes in the wall! Bah! How much do you want?
translation: 你指望我为这些窗户交税？它们根本不是窗户，只是墙上的洞！哼！你们要多少？

english: You do not need to collect taxes from me this time. Begone with you!
translation: 这次你不用来向我收税。滚开！

english: I've collected the Window Taxes as instructed.
translation: 我已经按要求收齐了窗户税。

english: Excellent. Chancellor, we must have enough money to pay for the new equipment.
translation: 太好了。首相，我们肯定有足够的钱来购买新装备了。

english: Err, not quite.
translation: 呃，还差一点。

english: Bah! Again, brave Jatizso citizens, sacrifices must be made.
translation: 哼！勇敢的贾提佐镇公民们，再次做出牺牲吧。

english: Hmmm. Any ideas anyone?
translation: 嗯……谁有主意？

english: How about beer?
translation: 对啤酒征税怎么样？

english: Beer? No that's a silly thing to tax. No, that really would cause a riot. Hmmm, beer, beers, beards. Beards!
translation: 啤酒？不，那是个愚蠢的征税对象。不行，那真的会引起骚乱。嗯，啤酒，啤酒，胡子。胡子！

english: Beards. Only the King and his advisors should be allowed un-taxed beards.
translation: 胡子。只有国王和他的顾问们才能免于胡子税。

english: I now proclaim there will be a new tax on beards.
translation: 我现在宣布，将对胡子征收一项新税。

english: So NOW you want me to collect money from everyone that has a beard. I'm not sure whether to laugh or cry.
translation: 所以现在你要我去向每个有胡子的人收钱。我真不知道该哭还是该笑。

english: What about moustaches?
translation: 那胡子呢？

english: Oh yes, tax those too.
translation: 哦，对了，那些也要征税。

english: Grrr. Of course you do, sire.
translation: 呃……当然，陛下。

english: Hurry, I need to see my treasury overflowing! You have a Beard Tax to collect.
translation: 快点，我要看到我的金库满溢！你去收胡子税吧。

english: Well for the Beard Tax, talk to anyone who works in the town; shopkeepers and the like. Don't ask anyone else, as they won't have the money to be taxed! Also don't bother with the bank manager - he has plenty of
translation: 至于胡子税，去找镇上工作的人谈；比如店主之类的。别问其他人，因为他们没钱可交！也别去找银行经理——他钱多得很，

english: money, but seems most adept at keeping it.
translation: 但似乎最擅长守住它。

english: So, talk to each of the following and assess whether they are taxable or not.
translation: 所以，去和下面每个人谈谈，评估他们是否应该交税。

english: Raum Urda-Stein trades armour and Hring Hring trades ores. Skuli Myrka trades in weapons, Vanligga Gastfrihet looks after the food hall, Flosi Dalksson sells raw fish and Keepa Kettilon supposedly cooks - though
translation: 劳姆.乌尔达.斯坦经营盔甲生意，赫林.赫林经营矿石生意。斯库利.米尔卡经营武器生意，范利加.加斯特弗里特负责食品大厅，弗洛西.达尔克森卖生鱼，基帕.凯蒂隆据说是厨师——不过

english: I haven't seen him actually cook anything for months.
translation: 我好几个月没见他真正做过饭了。

english: Once you've talked to everyone, come back here and we will check the tax bag again. Hopefully it will be enough to satisfy the King this time.
translation: 等你和所有人都谈过之后，回到这里，我们会再次检查税袋。希望这次能足够让国王满意。

english: You ask me for tax but your bag is so full of stuff you can't even hold the pittance that is the whole of my belongings! Go away and leave me to beg in peace.
translation: 你来找我收税，但你的袋子装得那么满，连我这点微薄的家当都装不下了！走开，让我安安静静地乞讨。

english: I return once more...
translation: 我又回来了……

english: I would say I'm happy to see you, but that would be a lie.
translation: 我本想说很高兴见到你，但那是假话。

english: Well, I can't say I blame you, since I need to tax you again.
translation: 好吧，我不怪你，因为我需要再次向你征税。

english: Gah! What weak excuse for sucking his populace dry has the King come up with this time?
translation: 啊！国王这次又想出什么蹩脚借口来榨干他的子民？

english: This time the King has decided to tax facial hair!
translation: 这次国王决定对胡须征税！

english: According to my books, you owe 1000gp!
translation: 根据我的记录，你欠1000金币！

english: By all that is holy, this is a travesty!
translation: 苍天在上，这简直是荒谬！

english: You may have a point there.
translation: 你说的也许有点道理。

english: But rules are rules. Pay up! You owe the state 1000.
translation: 但规矩就是规矩。交钱吧！你欠国家1000金币。

english: I'm back for more tax.
translation: 我又来收税了。

english: Please no. I have a wife and seven kids to support.
translation: 求求你别收了。我还要养活妻子和七个孩子。

english: No more! Haven't we all suffered enough?
translation: 别再来了！我们受的苦还不够吗？

english: I sympathise; it's been a very taxing day for me as well.
translation: 我同情你；今天对我来说也是收税（令人疲惫）的一天。

english: Groan! Your lame attempts at humour do not save me money. Come on, break it to me gently, what is it this time?
translation: 哼！你那些蹩脚的幽默笑话可省不了我的钱。来吧，温柔点告诉我，这次又是什么？

english: But I don't have a beard!
translation: 但我没有胡子！

english: Yes you do!
translation: 你明明有！

english: No, this hair is just an extension of my head hair, which is currently not being taxed.
translation: 不，这头发只是我头上头发的延伸，而头上的头发目前是不征税的。

english: Yeah right, no more excuses!
translation: 得了吧，别再找借口了！

english: Awww come on, be a gent.
translation: 哎呀，行行好吧。

english: No more! This is an outrage!
translation: 够了！这简直是暴行！

english: It is a bit, isn't it. Still, he's your King not mine!
translation: 是有点过分，对吧。不过，他是你的国王，不是我的！

english: Oh, thanks a lot 'friend'. What is it this time?
translation: 哦，真是多谢了，'朋友'。这次又是什么？

english: Don't ask me why, but this time it's beards!
translation: 别问我为什么，但这次是胡子！

english: WHAT? This is the last straw. My father wore a beard, my father's father wore a beard; many generations of Fremennik have worn beards with pride, without having to worry whether his pride and joy
translation: 什么？这真是忍无可忍。我父亲留胡子，我祖父也留胡子；多少代费明尼克人都自豪地留着胡子，不用操心他的骄傲和快乐

english: would cost him money. A beard is the core of a Fremennik's identity, it is the gateway to his soul, it is...
translation: 会让他破费。胡子是费明尼克人身份的核心，是通往灵魂的大门，它是……

english: Alright, I get the idea.
translation: 好了，我明白了。

english: I cannot take any more of this! What ridiculous thing is worthy of taxation this time?
translation: 我再也受不了了！这次又是什么荒唐的东西值得征税？

english: Errm, it's beards this time!
translation: 呃，这次是胡子！

english: But I don't have a beard, I have a finely waxed moustache. I'm definitely not beardy at all.
translation: 但我没有大胡子，我只有精心打蜡的小胡子。我绝对算不上有胡子的人。

english: I'm afraid all facial hair counts for tax purposes.
translation: 恐怕所有面部毛发都算作征税对象。

english: Surely, facial hair should be taxed on percentage of the face covered. In which case I should owe no more than 20% of the tax that wild-bearded Fremennik men pay.
translation: 当然，胡须税应该按面部覆盖比例征收。那样的话，我欠的税应该不超过那些胡须蓬乱的费明尼克男人所缴的20%。

english: Sorry, facial hair is facial hair and is liable for taxation. No arguments.
translation: 抱歉，面部毛发就是面部毛发，需要纳税。没有商量的余地。

english: That's not fair!
translation: 这不公平！

english: My faith in humanity has been sapped again. Thanks for that. Here take the money and get out of my sight.
translation: 我对人性的信心再次被消磨殆尽。多谢了。拿着钱，从我眼前消失。

english: I have taken money from those with significant facial hair.
translation: 我已经从那些有明显面部毛发的人那里收了钱。

english: Good, good. Chancellor, how do our finances look now?
translation: 好，好。首相，我们的财政状况现在如何？

english: Errr.
Thank the gods, we finally have enough.
translation: 谢天谢地，我们终于凑够了。

english: Ah, much better. I always find the sound of gold coins being poured into the treasury relaxing.
translation: 啊，好多了。我总觉得把金币倒进金库的声音很让人放松。

english: Yes, I don't think your citizens would have coped with another round of tax.
translation: 是的，我想你的子民们可承受不起另一轮税收了。

english: I have another task for you. Your espionage mission was so successful that I need you to do the same thing again. Except this time I want you to find out more about the bridge repairs they have been doing.
translation: 我还有另一个任务给你。你的间谍任务非常成功，我需要你再做一次同样的事。不过这次，我想让你多了解一些他们一直在进行的桥梁维修工作。

english: Bridge repairing?
translation: 桥梁维修？

english: Indeed! I have heard rumours that they have been getting some help from somewhere.
translation: 没错！我听到传言说，他们从某个地方得到了一些帮助。

english: Really? I wonder who?
translation: 真的吗？我好奇是谁？

english: You'd better find out and quickly. Get on it!
translation: 你最好尽快查清楚。赶紧行动！

english: Go to Neitiznot with all haste! The Spymaster will have the details, as last time.
translation: 火速前往奈提兹诺镇！和上次一样，间谍大师会告诉你细节。

english: I'm afraid i'm not allowed to talk to you any more. It would be more than my life is worth!
translation: 恐怕我不能再和你说话了。那可是会要了我的命的！

english: Fair enough. I'd better go ...
translation: 有道理。我最好走了……

english: Hello tax collector.
translation: 你好啊，收税官。

english: I had a job to do. That's the way it goes sometimes.
translation: 我有工作要做。有时候就是这样。

english: But I do feel a little guilty about the tax actually.
translation: 但我确实对这项税感到有点内疚。

english: Or at least I would do if I had the 5000 gp on me...
translation: 至少，如果我身上有5000金币的话，我会感到内疚的……

english: Thanks! I didn't expect that. Maybe you do have a heart.
translation: 谢谢！我没想到你会这样。也许你还是有良心的。

english: Can you keep a secret?
translation: 你能保守秘密吗？

english: Well I'm off then.
translation: 那我走了。

english: Well as you probably already know all yak meat and yak products are banned on this island - orders of the King ...
translation: 好吧，你可能已经知道了，这个岛上禁止所有牦牛肉和牦牛制品——这是国王的命令……

english: You should speak with the ruler of this isle, King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
translation: 你应该和这个岛的统治者，国王古基.索沃特四世谈谈。

english: I am sure you know what I require of you by now.
translation: 我相信你现在知道我需要你做什么了。

english: You must entertain the ruler of Neitiznot while listening to the conversations of his council.
translation: 你必须取悦奈提兹诺镇的统治者，同时偷听他的议会的谈话。

english: That should not be a problem.
translation: 那应该没问题。

english: You must wear all four pieces of the jester costume and nothing in your hands, as the Burgher's guards will search you thoroughly.
translation: 你必须穿上全部四件小丑服装，且手中不能拿任何东西，因为市民守卫会彻底搜查你。

english: Don't forget to put your costume on, then visit the Burgher and get jestering.
translation: 别忘了穿上你的服装，然后去见市民，开始你的小丑表演。

english: Well, I've got the ridiculous costume on again.
translation: 好吧，我又穿上这套可笑的戏服了。

english: Excellent. Time to visit the Burgher and get jestering.
translation: 太好了。是时候去见镇长，表演小丑把戏了。

english: Ah, hello jester. Hey! I've just noticed, you look a little similar to our new champion!
translation: 啊，你好啊小丑。嘿！我刚注意到，你看起来有点眼熟，有点像我们的新冠军！

english: You have a jester and a fool as a Champion?
translation: 你们居然让一个小丑兼傻瓜当冠军？

english: No, of course not, that would be silly. You just...look similar.
translation: 不，当然不是，那也太蠢了。你只是……看起来很像而已。

english: We must both be outlanders. We all look the same you know.
translation: 我们一定都是外乡人。你知道的，我们长得很像。

english: Yes, you're right of course. Anyway, I think the Burgher is in the mood for some more entertainment, so carry on through.
translation: 你说得对，当然。总之，我觉得镇长现在想看些乐子，所以你继续进去吧。

english: Hello jester. Have a chat with the Burgher, I think he's in the mood for jest.
translation: 你好小丑。去跟镇长聊聊吧，我觉得他现在想听笑话。

english: I think the Burgher could do with a laugh right now. Why don't you ask him?
translation: 我觉得镇长现在需要笑一笑。你何不去问问他呢？

english: Have you finished your spying task yet?
translation: 你的间谍任务完成了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll finish it off now.
translation: 还没。我现在就去完成。

english: Ah, good timing. I was just thinking I needed a bit of light entertainment.
translation: 啊，来得正好。我正想看点轻松的娱乐。

english: Ah, back again. I hope you've got a new act.
translation: 啊，又回来了。希望你准备好了新节目。

english: Err, of course sire. I assure you this act will be somewhat different.
translation: 呃，当然，陛下。我保证这次表演会有点不同。

english: Get on with it then.
translation: 那就开始吧。

english: When you said you had a new act you were lying weren't you?
translation: 你说你有新节目的时候是在撒谎，对不对？

english: I can recite the epic tale of Beowulf if you prefer. It'll only take four or five hours.
translation: 如果您愿意的话，我可以背诵贝奥武夫的史诗故事。只需要四五个小时。

english: No, no, no, your old act is fine. I've had more than enough Beowulf. My tutor made me study that tale again and again.
translation: 不不不，你原来的节目就行了。贝奥武夫我听得够多了。我的家教让我一遍又一遍地学那个故事。

english: **Yawwwn**.
Get on with it! The more slapstick, the better.
translation: 开始吧！越滑稽越好。

english: I'm happy to humiliate myself for your entertainment, sire.
translation: 我很乐意为了您的娱乐而自取其辱，陛下。

english: So what do you think of the Burgher's Champion?
translation: 那么，你觉得镇长的冠军怎么样？

english: [He/She] seems honourable and courageous to me.
translation: [He/She]在我看来是个光荣又勇敢的人。

english: What about their collaboration with King Sorvott?
translation: 那他们跟索沃特国王的合作呢？

english: Well I trust Mord Gunnars, and he works for the King.
translation: 嗯，我信任莫德.冈纳斯，而他是在为国王效力。

english: And the Champion did help repair your bridges.
translation: 而且这位冠军确实帮忙修复了你们的桥梁。

english: Yes, well. So are your militia ready?
translation: 嗯，好吧。那么你的民兵准备好了吗？

english: I have them anchored near Etceteria.
translation: 我已经让他们在埃西特利亚岛附近驻扎。

english: Then I shall sail the potions to them tonight.
translation: 那我今晚就把药水运给他们。

english: Then we are ready to launch our raid at dawn?
translation: 那么我们都准备好黎明发动突袭了？

english: Absolutely. Long live Burgher Burowgar
translation: 当然。布罗加镇长万岁。

english: Are you ready to make your report, [Fremennik name]?
translation: [Fremennik name]，你准备好做报告了吗？

english: Now I will ask you some questions, but be warned I have other sources of information that can corroborate your answers.
translation: 现在我会问你一些问题，但警告你，我有其他情报来源可以核实你的回答。

english: I am ready to answer your questions.
translation: 我准备好回答你的问题了。

english: Where are Neitiznot's militia?
translation: 奈提兹诺镇的民兵在哪里？

english: They are in a secluded bay, near Etceteria.
translation: 他们在埃西特利亚岛附近的一个隐蔽海湾里。

english: What will Thakkrad deliver to Neitiznot's militia tonight?
translation: 萨克拉德今晚会给奈提兹诺镇的民兵送什么？

english: They will be given some potions.
translation: 他们会得到一些药水。

english: Who has been helping Burgher Mawnis Burowgar?
translation: 谁一直在帮助镇长莫尼斯.布罗加？

english: I have been helping Neitiznot.
translation: 我一直在帮助奈提兹诺镇。

english: Hmmm, that is very interesting. I believe you're telling me the truth.
translation: 嗯，这很有趣。我相信你告诉我的是实话。

english: Clearly not. Well, here is your fee.
translation: 显然不是。好吧，这是你的报酬。

english: You don't have space for the King's reward.
translation: 你没有空间拿国王的奖励。

english: Right, [Fremennik name], you had better go and talk to the King. I expect he'll want to discuss your intelligence.
translation: 好了，[Fremennik name]，你最好去跟国王谈谈。我猜他会想讨论你的情报。

english: No, I need to make a fool of myself again.
translation: 不，我需要再次出丑。

english: Please pay more attention to what the Burgher's advisors say this time. Are you ready?
translation: 这次请多注意镇长顾问们说的话。你准备好了吗？

english: Indeed, you look very dapper in your costume.
translation: 确实，你穿着戏服看起来非常帅气。

english: Hmmm. I'm beginning to think that this spy malarkey is not as cool as I thought.
translation: 嗯。我开始觉得这个间谍差事没有我想的那么酷了。

english: You're ready to entertain the Burgher. Good luck with you mission, Operative Budgie. Stay alert.
translation: 你准备好取悦镇长了。祝你好运，特工小鹦鹉。保持警惕。

english: When you are done, come back and talk to me to give your report. I will make sure the King is informed.
translation: 搞定之后回来向我汇报。我会确保国王知晓。

english: I have just one final task before you leave [Fremennik name].
translation: [Fremennik name]，在你离开之前，我还有一个最后任务。

english: Guards, secure the doors!
translation: 卫兵，守住大门！

english: So you admit that it was you who repaired Neitiznot's bridges?
translation: 所以你承认是你修复了奈提兹诺镇的桥梁？

english: I was following your orders, Sir.
translation: 我只是在执行您的命令，大人。

english: I was given strict instructions to go along with Mawnis Burowgar's orders while investigating their island.
translation: 我接到严格指示，在调查他们岛屿期间要遵从莫尼斯.布罗加的命令。

english: As I told your fool of a Spymaster, Neitiznot's militia are not going to attack you.
translation: 正如我告诉您那个傻瓜间谍头目的一样，奈提兹诺镇的民兵不会攻击您。

english: Then why does Burgher Mawnis Burowgar amass an army?
translation: 那为什么镇长莫尼斯.布罗加要集结军队？

english: It is no army Neitiznot has trained, but a raiding party, sire.
translation: 那不是奈提兹诺镇训练的军队，而是一支突袭队，陛下。

english: Mawnis Burowgar's goal is to see the leader of the trolls beheaded.
translation: 莫尼斯.布罗加的目标是看到巨魔首领被斩首。

english: Do you take me for a fool [Fremennik name]? It's all lies!
translation: [Fremennik name]，你把我当傻瓜吗？全是谎言！

english: You must have been brainwashed by my cousin! He is EVIL and wants to destroy me! Jah! Tiz so! Jah! Tiz so!
translation: 你肯定被我表弟洗脑了！他是邪恶的，想毁灭我！哈！就是这样！哈！就是这样！

english: Right! That's it! I've had enough!
translation: 够了！我受够了！

english: No more lying! No more biting my tongue! Do I take you for a fool? Yes I do!
translation: 不再撒谎了！不再忍气吞声了！我把你当傻瓜吗？是的，我就是这么想的！

english: You are so paranoid about Neitiznot that you are running this island into the ground!
translation: 你对奈提兹诺镇疑心太重，都快把这个岛搞垮了！

english: Neitiznot is not going to attack Jatizso. I'll say it again to try and force it into your thick skull! Neitiznot is not going to attack Jatizso. They don't care about Jatizso. They care about the trolls and Troll King who
translation: 奈提兹诺镇不会攻打贾蒂佐镇。我再重复一遍，好让它钻进你那榆木脑袋！奈提兹诺镇不会攻打贾蒂佐镇。他们不在乎贾蒂佐镇。他们在乎的是巨魔和巨魔之王，他们

english: are the real threats to the islands. You are so obsessed with your cousin, however, that you stick your head
translation: 那些才是群岛真正的威胁。但你却对你表弟如此痴迷，一提到巨魔就把头

english: in the sand whenever it comes to the trolls. But I'm not sure it matters, since I think there is a good chance that you will destroy this village long before the trolls get here!
translation: 埋进沙子里。但我觉得这也许不重要了，因为我觉得在巨魔们来这里之前，你自己就很有可能先把这座村庄毁了！

english: You do not have to dress in a jester's costume to act the fool, your royal crown is more than enough!
translation: 你根本不需要穿小丑戏服来装傻瓜，你的王冠就已经足够了！

english: No-one has ever talked to me like that before.
translation: 从来没人敢这么跟我说话。

english: Maybe if they had, you wouldn't be in this mess.
translation: 要是早有人这么说，你也不至于落到这步田地。

english: I should have you beheaded.
translation: 我应该把你斩首。

english: I'd like to see you try.
translation: 我倒想看看你怎么做。

english: So it seems that my cousin's plan is to demonstrate his superiority by killing the Troll King. I cannot let that happen! I will not let him steal the glory.
translation: 看来我表弟的计划是通过杀死巨魔国王来展示他的优越性。我不能让那发生！我不会让他偷走荣耀。

english: You haven't listened to a single word I've been saying, have you?
translation: 我说的话你一个字都没听进去，对吧？

english: We amass our forces now! There is no time to lose.
translation: 我们现在就集结军队！刻不容缓。

english: At dawn my men will march upon my ancestor's nemesis, the Troll King.
translation: 黎明时分，我的人将向我祖先的宿敌——巨魔之王进军。

english: Do you even know where to find the Troll King? Your warriors are underfed and tired; your weapons inadequate. You don't stand a chance. Join with your brethren and you may share the glory and perhaps find
translation: 你甚至知道在哪里找到巨魔国王吗？你的战士们营养不良且疲惫；你的武器不足。你没有机会。与你的同胞联合，你或许能分享荣耀，也许还能找到

english: a way to make peace between your lands. I'm sure the Burgher would be glad of your aid.
translation: 找到让两地和解的方法。我相信镇长会很高兴得到你的援助。

english: Bah! Don't be ridiculous! He would just stab me in the back and claim the glory himself. My brave warriors will find the Troll King and slay him first. How could they not, they are Jatizso warriors, not Neitiznot scum.
translation: 呸！别荒谬了！他只会背后捅我一刀，然后自己夺取荣耀。我勇敢的战士们会先找到巨魔国王并杀死他。他们怎么可能不呢，他们是贾提兹索的战士，不是奈提兹诺镇的渣滓。

english: You will deliver my decree to Burgher Mawnis Burowgar.
translation: 你要把我的旨意传达给镇长莫尼斯.布罗加。

english: You shall inform him that my troops attack the western troll caves at dawn and that his interference shall be considered an act of WAR! Long live Jatizso! Long live ME!
translation: 你要告诉他，我的部队在黎明时分进攻西边的巨魔洞穴，他的干涉将被视为战争行为！贾蒂佐镇万岁！我万岁！

english: Fine. I give up. I will do this final task for you. After that you're on your own - may the gods be with your troops - they're going to need it.
translation: 行。我放弃了。我再帮你做这最后一件事。之后你就自己看着办吧——愿众神与你的部队同在——他们肯定需要这份保佑。

english: Fine. Take the decree and go.
translation: 行。拿着旨意走吧。

english: Have you delivered the decree yet?
translation: 你把旨意送到了吗？

english: Well, get a move-on.
translation: 嗯，那就快点行动。

english: Not yet, I've lost the decree.
translation: 还没，我把旨意弄丢了。

english: You've lost it! Bah! It's a good thing I'm used to working with incompetents!
translation: 你弄丢了！呸！幸好我已经习惯了跟无能之辈共事！

english: I'm afraid I don't have the space to carry it.
translation: 恐怕我没有空间携带它。

english: More incompetence! Well, come back when you have.
translation: 又是一次无能！好吧，等你有空间了再回来。

english: Well? Get moving!
translation: 嗯？快动起来！

english: Ah [Fremennik name], the Burgher is keen to see you. Walk on through.
translation: 啊，[Fremennik name]，镇长很想见你。进去吧。

english: You should speak to Fridleif or the Burgher about crafting yourself the traditional armour of a Fremennik warrior.
translation: 你应该去跟弗里德利夫或镇长谈谈，为自己制作一套费明尼克战士的传统盔甲。

english: My militia are en route from Rellekka. Have you found out anything about Jatizso's plans yet?
translation: 我的民兵正从雷勒卡城赶来。你查到贾提索的计划了吗？

english: I was instructed to give you this, err, now where did I put the King's decree?
translation: 我奉命把这个交给您，呃，我把国王的旨意放哪儿了？

english: I'll be back shortly.
translation: 我马上回来。

english: I have, sir.
translation: 我送去了，大人。

english: I was instructed to give you this decree by King Sorvott.
translation: 我奉索沃特国王之命，将这个旨意交给您。

english: King Sorvott has spies that have learnt of the troops you have trained.
translation: 索沃特国王的间谍已经得知了您训练的部队的事。

english: Until recently, they believed that you planned to assault their town.
translation: 直到最近，他们还认为您计划袭击他们的城镇。

english: The paranoid fool.
translation: 那个偏执的傻瓜。

english: It would bring great shame upon my family to break the truce that was signed between King Sorvott III and my father.
translation: 如果违背索沃特三世国王与我父亲签署的休战协定，那将给我的家族带来莫大的耻辱。

english: Now that Jatizso's spies have learnt of your plans to attack the troll caves, King Sorvott is raising his guards to assault them himself.
translation: 既然贾提佐的间谍已经得知你计划攻击巨魔洞穴，索沃特国王正在集结他的卫兵，准备亲自进攻。

english: I believe he plans to depart before you can be ready.
translation: 我相信他打算在你准备好之前就出发。

english: Well, if he thinks the folk of Neitiznot can be intimidated by his threats, he best be ready to accept defeat.
translation: 哼，如果他以为奈提兹诺镇的居民会被他的威胁吓倒，那他最好准备好接受失败。

english: Blasted spies, how can King Sorvott call himself a Fremennik when he resorts to such dishonourable tactics?
translation: 该死的间谍，索沃特国王用这种不光彩的手段，他还配自称费明尼克人吗？

english: We have no time to lose. Fridleif, please guide [Fremennik name] through the traditions laid down by our ancestors.
translation: 我们没时间浪费了。弗里德莱夫，请引导[Fremennik name]遵循我们祖先传下来的传统。

english: Once you have completed these rites I shall appoint you as head of my raiding party.
translation: 一旦你完成这些仪式，我将任命你为我的突袭队队长。

english: Indeed, it is written in the sagas of Neitiznot that the Champion of the isle must equip himselfwith the tools of a Fremennik warrior.
translation: 确实，奈提兹诺镇的传说中写道，岛屿的冠军必须用费明尼克战士的工具武装自己。

english: I offer to act as guide to [Fremennik name] during the traditional rites.
translation: 我愿在传统仪式期间担任[Fremennik name]的向导。

english: Very well. What do these rites entail?
translation: 很好。这些仪式包括什么？

english: Firstly, you must equip yourself with the traditional armour of Neitiznot.
translation: 首先，你必须装备奈提兹诺镇的传统盔甲。

english: You will need to cull several yaks in order to craft yourself a suit of yak-hide armour.
translation: 你需要宰杀几头牦牛，为自己制作一套牦牛皮盔甲。

english: Once you have a few pieces of yak-hide, return to me and I shall cure them for you.
translation: 一旦你有了几块牦牛皮，就回来找我，我会为你鞣制它们。

english: Then I will give you instruction on how this hide may be crafted into a thick jerkin, ideal for protecting yourself from the granite clubs that the trolls of these isles prefer to wield.
translation: 然后我会教你如何将这些皮制成一件厚实的皮衣，非常适合用来防御这些岛屿上的巨魔喜欢挥舞的花岗岩棍棒。

english: Thank you, Fridleif. I shall return with the yak-hides soon.
translation: 谢谢你，弗里德莱夫。我很快就会带着牦牛皮回来。

english: I have still to complete the traditional armour of a Fremennik warrior.
translation: 我还没有完成费明尼克战士的传统盔甲。

english: Thakkrad? Explain to [Fremennik name] what she needs to do again.
translation: 萨克拉德？向[Fremennik name]解释一下她需要再做什么。

english: Of course, sire.
translation: 当然，陛下。

english: You will need to cull several yaks in order to craft yourself a suit of yak-hide armour. There is a fenced-in field to the west of the village where yaks roam freely. Once you have a few pieces of yak-hide, return to me
translation: 你需要宰杀几头牦牛，为自己制作一套牦牛皮盔甲。村子西边有一个围起来的牧场，牦牛在那里自由活动。一旦你有了几块牦牛皮，就回来找我

english: To make the traditional armour of a Neitiznot warrior you will need some yak-hide to make the armour.
translation: 要制作奈提兹诺镇战士的传统盔甲，你需要一些牦牛皮来制作盔甲。

english: Once you have the yak-hide, Thakkrad can cure it for you.
translation: 一旦你有了牦牛皮，萨克拉德可以为你鞣制。

english: To make the shield you will need some arctic pine, rope and bronze nails. Then you will need to find the 'Woodcutting stumps' to make make the shield on.
translation: 要制作盾牌，你需要一些北极松木、绳子和青铜钉。然后你需要找到“伐木树桩”来制作盾牌。

english: Thanks for the advice, Fridlief. Where are these 'Woodcutting stumps'?
translation: 谢谢你的建议，弗里德莱夫。这些'伐木树桩'在哪里？

english: You will find the Woodcutting stumps near the town's 'geyser'.
translation: 你会在镇上的'间歇泉'附近找到伐木树桩。

english: Oh, it's you. Why are you talking to me? Surely you should be hanging out with your Neitiznot friends now.
translation: 哦，是你啊。你在跟我说话干嘛？你现在不是应该跟你的奈提兹诺镇朋友们混在一起吗？

english: Alright I will - if that's the way you're going to be about it.
translation: 好吧，我会的——如果你要这样说话的话。

english: You are carrying yak-hide, are you not?
translation: 你带着牦牛皮，对吧？

english: The aroma, outlander! It's very distinctive. So, do you wish to get your hide cured?
translation: 那气味，外地人！非常独特。那么，你想让我鞣制你的皮吗？

english: No, thanks. I'll be off then.
translation: 不了，谢谢。那我先走了。

english: I see you have made some of the armour. Do you need assistance with the other part?
translation: 我看到你已经做了一些盔甲。需要我帮忙做另一部分吗？

english: Yes please, I've forgotten how to make the armour.
translation: 是的，请帮忙，我忘了怎么做盔甲了。

english: Thakkrad, can you explain?
translation: 萨克拉德，你能解释一下吗？

english: and I shall cure them for you. Once cured, a normal needle and thread will be needed to craft the yak leather in the same way as any other leather.
translation: 然后我会为你鞣制它们。鞣制后，你需要用普通的针和线，像处理其他皮革一样来缝制牦牛皮。

english: Have you completed your suit of yak armour?
translation: 你完成你的牦牛盔甲套装了吗？

english: Thakkrad has helped me to complete the traditional armour of a Fremennik warrior.
translation: 萨克拉德帮我完成了费明尼克战士的传统盔甲。

english: Excellent news. Now you have just one more item to craft and I can appoint you as leader of my warband; then you may lead our raid against the trolls.
translation: 好消息。现在你只需要再制作一件物品，我就可以任命你为我的战团领袖；然后你就可以带领我们突袭巨魔了。

english: The final piece of traditional arms is a large Fremennik round shield.
translation: 最后一件传统武器是一面巨大的费明尼克圆盾。

english: With this you will be able to deflect the large rocks that some of the trolls like to throw at you.
translation: 有了它，你就能抵挡一些巨魔喜欢朝你扔的大石头。

english: How may this be crafted?
translation: 这要怎么制作？

english: You will need two arctic pine logs, a length of rope, some bronze nails and a hammer.
translation: 你需要两根北极松原木、一段绳子、一些青铜钉和一把锤子。

english: When you have all of these you should find the tree stump outside of my hut. You will be able to hammer together the shield.
translation: 当你拥有所有这些后，你应该找到我小屋外的树桩。你将能够用锤子把盾牌拼在一起。

english: Thank you. I shall return with a shield soon.
translation: 谢谢你。我很快就会带着盾牌回来。

english: Have you completed the final piece of your Fremennik garb?
translation: 你完成费明尼克装束的最后一件了吗？

english: I have still to complete the traditional shield of a Fremennik warrior.
translation: 我还没有完成费明尼克战士的传统盾牌。

english: Fridleif has helped me to complete the traditional shield of the Fremennik warrior.
translation: 弗里德莱夫帮我完成了费明尼克战士的传统盾牌。

english: Excellent work, [Fremennik name].
translation: 干得好，[Fremennik name]。

english: There is little more for me to say. You have proven your worth to my kinsmen and I, but I must continue with the traditions so...
translation: 我没什么好说的了。你已经向我和我的族人证明了自己的价值，但我必须继续遵循传统，所以……

english: Do you, [Fremennik name], solemnly swear to uphold the virtues of courage and honour?
translation: 你，[Fremennik name]，是否庄严宣誓坚守勇气和荣誉的美德？

english: Thakkrad whispers in your ear.Just repeat what I say.
translation: 萨克拉德在你耳边低语。跟着我说就行。

english: 'I, [Fremennik name], swear to uphold the virtues of courage and honour.'
translation: '我，[Fremennik name]，宣誓坚守勇气和荣誉的美德。'

english: I [Fremennik name] swear to uphold the virtues of courage and honour.
translation: 我[Fremennik name]宣誓坚守勇气和荣誉的美德。

english: Then it is done.
translation: 那就成了。

english: I hearby appoint [Fremennik name] as Champion of Neitiznot.
translation: 我在此任命[Fremennik name]为奈提兹诺镇的冠军。

english: Praise be; may the blood of our ancestors flow strongly in our new Champion.
translation: 赞美吧；愿我们祖先的血液在我们新的冠军身上强劲流淌。

english: Welcome to the clan of Neitiznot; you shall be welcome in this township forever more.
translation: 欢迎加入奈提兹诺镇氏族；从今往后，你将永远受到这个镇子的欢迎。

english: You have made our township very proud today. We hope you continue to match up to our hopes in the quest which we have for you.
translation: 你今天让我们镇子非常自豪。我们希望你在我们交给你的任务中，能继续不负我们的期望。

english: As my kinsmen have mentioned, there is a foul beast dwelling in the caves on the northernmost isle.
translation: 正如我的族人所提到的，在最北端岛屿的洞穴里住着一只邪恶的野兽。

english: We ask that you lead our militia against this brute and return with the beast's head as proof of your heroism.
translation: 我们请求你带领我们的民兵对抗这个畜生，并带回野兽的头颅作为你英勇行为的证明。

english: My guards have secured a foothold within the easternmost caves.
translation: 我的卫兵已经在最东边的洞穴里建立了一个据点。

english: We have not seen Jatizso's militia yet, but some of my scouts have reported hearing distant fighting in the tunnels.
translation: 我们还没看到贾提佐的民兵，但我的一些侦察兵报告说听到了隧道里传来远处的战斗声。

english: I shall make my way over to them now, so that we may defeat this foul Troll King.
translation: 我现在就去找他们，这样我们就能打败这个邪恶的巨魔国王。

english: You should head to the eastern end of the northern isle. You don't want to run in to Jatizso's troops now.
translation: 你应该前往北岛东端。你现在可不想撞上贾提佐的部队。

english: Fridleif's scouts have reported that the militia have entered the caves to the east of the northern isle. They are waiting for you to lead them in battle.
translation: 弗里德莱夫的侦察兵报告说，民兵已经进入了北岛东边的洞穴。他们正在等你带领他们战斗。

english: Thanks Thakkrad, i'mon my way there now.
translation: 谢谢萨克拉德，我现在就出发去那里。

english: Our militia have entered the caves to the east of the northern isle.
translation: 我们的民兵已经进入了北岛东边的洞穴。

english: You should hurry to meet them before they are discovered by the trolls. Make sure you go to the right cave entrance, otherwise you won't find them!
translation: 你应该赶快去和他们碰头，免得他们被巨魔发现。确保你走对洞穴入口，否则你找不到他们！

english: Right, the eastern caves on the northern isle. Thanks Fridleif, I'm on my way there now.
translation: 好的，北岛东边的洞穴。谢谢弗里德莱夫，我现在就出发去那里。

english: Hmm. Left, right, then left again... I'm lost. Best I head toward the sound of the fighting.
translation: 嗯。左转，右转，再左转……我迷路了。最好朝着战斗的声音走。

english: Hold your ground men!
translation: 坚守阵地，兄弟们！

english: The Champion had better arrive soon. We can't wait much longer!
translation: 冠军最好快点到。我们等不了太久了！

english: [He/She] will be here soon. The Burgher trusts [Him/Her]. That's good enough for me.
translation: [He/She]很快就到。镇长信任[Him/Her]。对我来说这就够了。

english: Sir, Champion [Fremennik name] has arrived! I knew [He/She] wouldn't let us down!
translation: 长官，冠军[Fremennik name]到了！我就知道[He/She]不会让我们失望的！

english: It was a hard journey here. I trust you all made it here intact?
translation: 一路过来很艰难。我相信你们都完好无损地到达了这里？

english: A little bruised but nothing a true Fremennik can't handle!
translation: 有点擦伤，但真正的费明尼克人没什么应付不了的！

english: Well said!
translation: 说得好！

english: Our supplies are starting to run a little low; we should make our charge soon.
translation: 我们的补给品开始有点不够了；我们应该尽快发起冲锋。

english: Once you have helped to slay 10 trolls then you should be able to assault the Troll King.
translation: 一旦你帮助杀死了10个巨魔，你应该就能攻击巨魔国王了。

english: We will hold back the troll forces while you cross the bridge to the south of the cave.
translation: 我们会拖住巨魔部队，你则穿过洞穴南边的桥。

english: I will find the Troll King there, correct?
translation: 我会在那里找到巨魔国王，对吗？

english: Yes madam! I have some supplies with me if you need them, but I only have a small amount left. We took a heavy toll getting here.
translation: 是的，女士！我这里有些补给品，如果你需要的话，但我只剩下一点点了。我们一路过来伤亡惨重。

english: The fact you've saved any at all proves your bravery.
translation: 你能省下任何一点都证明了你的勇敢。

english: Thank you madam. We have food, Strength potions and Prayer potions to see us through this battle.
translation: 谢谢你，女士。我们有食物、力量药水和祈祷药水来支撑我们打完这场战斗。

english: A fine tale we will tell once you have claimed the beast's head.
translation: 等你拿到野兽的头颅，我们就能讲一个精彩的故事了。

english: Men, follow [Fremennik name]'s orders.
translation: 兄弟们，听从[Fremennik name]的命令。

english: Ready, men?
translation: 准备好了吗，兄弟们？

english: Aye Champion!.
translation: 准备好了，冠军！

english: Aye [sir/madam]!
translation: 准备好了，[sir/madam]！

english: Warriors, advance!
translation: 战士们，前进！

english: Charge!
translation: 冲锋！

english: Bork! The battle rages on and we are strong, but I need supplies!
translation: 博克！战斗仍在激烈进行，我们虽然强大，但我需要补给品！

english: What do you need, brave [Fremennik name], madam?
translation: 你需要什么，勇敢的[Fremennik name]女士？

english: Give me food, Bork!
translation: 给我食物，博克！

english: Here, take this tuna quickly, madam!
translation: 来，快拿着这条金枪鱼，女士！

english: I need Strength potions.
translation: 我需要力量药水。

english: Strength be with you, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 愿力量与你同在，[Fremennik name]！

english: I need Prayer potions.
translation: 我需要祈祷药水。

english: May the gods be with you [Fremennik name]!
translation: 愿众神与你同在，[Fremennik name]！

english: I've run out of supplies, [Fremennik name]! Only our bravery remains.
translation: 我的补给用完了，[Fremennik name]！只剩下我们的勇气了。

english: My guards will beat you to your goal yet.
translation: 我的卫兵会先你一步达成目标。

english: The weakness of wood and leather will be bested by my steel and mithril; mark my words.
translation: 木材和皮革的弱点将被我的钢和秘银击败；记住我的话。

english: I sense defeat in your voice already, mighty King.
translation: 我已经从你的声音中听出了失败，强大的国王。

english: You and I both know that Burgher Burowgar's forces are better prepared and trained than your men.
translation: 你我都知道，布罗加市民的部队比你的手下准备更充分、训练更精良。

english: Guards, prepare my gallows at once.
translation: 卫兵，立刻准备好我的绞刑架。

english: I would be leaving now if I were you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 如果我是你，我现在就会离开，[Fremennik name]。

english: I think you're right Thorkel, goodbye.
translation: 我想你说得对，索克尔，再见。

english: What was that!
translation: 那是什么！

english: Gruurg!
translation: 格鲁格！

english: What are you doing in my court? Guards!
translation: 你在我王庭里做什么？卫兵！

english: I have come to inform you that you may recall your guards; the Troll King was slain by my hand.
translation: 我是来通知你，你可以召回你的卫兵了；巨魔国王已被我亲手斩杀。

english: Preposterous. Lies, I tell you, lies!
translation: 荒谬。谎言，我告诉你，全是谎言！

english: Yes, your majesty, of course your majesty.
translation: 是的，陛下，当然，陛下。

english: Guards! Where are your Guards?
translation: 卫兵！你的卫兵呢？

english: Oh. Are they still recovering from their defeat against the trolls?
translation: 哦。他们还在从对抗巨魔的失败中恢复吗？

english: Outlander, leave me in peace before I am forced to bear arms against you myself.
translation: 外来者，在我被迫亲自对你动武之前，让我清静一下。

english: Very well, your Highness, I leave you to contemplate this...
translation: 好吧，殿下，我让你好好想想这件事……

english: Should you have approached me honestly and truthfully, rather than with lies and secrecy,
translation: 如果你当初能诚实坦率地来找我，而不是用谎言和秘密，

english: then it could have been you holding the head of the Troll King aloft today.
translation: 那么今天高举巨魔国王头颅的人可能就是你了。

english: Be gone with you. I have heard enough of your insults for one day.
translation: 滚开。我今天听够了你的侮辱。

english: Thanks, [Fremennik name], you are the first person to stand up to the King's bullying in many a year. Maybe he has learnt something today?
translation: 谢谢，[Fremennik name]，你是多年来第一个敢反抗国王欺凌的人。也许他今天学到了点什么？

english: We can but hope Thorkel.
translation: 我们只能希望如此，索克尔。

english: Fare thee well brave warrior, fare thee well.
translation: 愿你安好，勇敢的战士，愿你安好。

english: Purrrrz!(One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for [him/her] to stay.)
translation: 喵呜！（吾祝愿这位带着金枪鱼的外来者一切顺利。吾更希望[him/her]能留下。）

english: Useless, disloyal cat.
translation: 没用的、不忠的猫。

english: Congratulations on defeating the Troll King. I hope you have collected the fine rewards that the Burgher Mawnis Burowgar has for you.
translation: 恭喜你击败了巨魔国王。我希望你已经从市民莫尼斯.布罗加那里领取了丰厚的奖励。

english: I have returned victorious, Mawnis Burowgar.
translation: 我胜利归来了，莫尼斯.布罗加。

english: Do you bring proof of your victory?
translation: 你带来胜利的证明了吗？

english: You should bring proof to present to the Burgher.
translation: 你应该带个证明去呈给市民。

english: Hail, Champion of Neitiznot.
translation: 致敬，奈提兹诺镇的冠军。

english: I offer the beast's head as proof that I have completed your task, sir.
translation: 我献上这怪物的头颅，作为完成您任务的证明，先生。

english: I thank you for bringing me this trophy, [Fremennik name], you have done much to bring honour to this isle.
translation: 感谢你为我带来这个战利品，[Fremennik name]，你为这座岛屿带来了莫大的荣耀。

english: My thanks for the honour you have bestowed upon me, Mawnis Burowgar.
translation: 感谢您赐予我的这份荣耀，莫尼斯.布罗加。

english: As a mark of my gratitude for slaying my nemesis, the foul Troll King, I offer you my helm.
translation: 为了感谢你杀死我的宿敌，那个邪恶的巨魔国王，我将我的头盔赠予你。

english: I thank you for presenting me with such a finely crafted helm, sir.
translation: 感谢您赠予我这顶精工打造的头盔，先生。

english: It makes me proud to know that the helm of my ancestors will be worn in battle.
translation: 得知先祖的头盔将在战场上被佩戴，我感到无比自豪。

english: I thank you on behalf of all my Kinsmen, [Fremennik name].
translation: 我代表我所有的族人感谢你，[Fremennik name]。

english: Praise be to our brave Champion.
translation: 赞美我们勇敢的冠军。

english: Hail, Champion [Fremennik name].
translation: 致敬，冠军[Fremennik name]。

english: Thakkrad, I believe you have finished repairing the remaining bridge.
translation: 萨克拉德，我相信你已经修好了剩下的那座桥。

english: That I have sir, we should be able to mine 'runite' once again; now that I have repaired the north-eastern bridge.
translation: 是的，先生，我们应该能再次开采‘符文石’了；既然我已经修好了东北面的那座桥。

english: Ah, so that is how we compete with the mineral wealth of Jatizso.
translation: 啊，原来如此，我们就是这样与贾提兹索镇的矿产财富竞争的。

english: Indeed, the wealth of these isles may not be spread evenly, but we certainly make the most of what we have.
translation: 确实，这些岛屿的财富可能分布不均，但我们肯定充分利用了我们所拥有的。

english: I look forward to any other tasks you may have for me in the future, Burgher Burowar.
translation: 我期待您未来交给我的任何其他任务，布罗加市民。

english: My next task is to make peace with the King of Jatizso.
translation: 我的下一个任务是和贾提兹索镇的国王讲和。

english: I do not think I can help you with that sire. I don't think King Sorvott is speaking with me anymore.
translation: 我想我帮不了您这个忙，陛下。我觉得索沃特国王不会再跟我说话了。

english: Ah, I see you too have angered King Sorvott IV.
translation: 啊，看来你也惹怒了索沃特四世国王。

english: Not to worry, I have my ways of pacifying the King.
translation: 别担心，我有办法安抚那位国王。

english: Fare thee well, my Champion.
translation: 愿你安好，我的冠军。

english: Fair thee well, kinsmen of Neitiznot.
translation: 愿你安好，奈提兹诺镇的同胞们。

english: I know this is a bit of a long shot... but are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: 我知道这有点渺茫……但你是长老议会的成员吗？

english: I'm now a member of the counshil of eblars? Thanksh a lot buddy! (hic) Letsh have a drink to celebrate!
translation: 我现在是长老议会的成员了吗？多谢了老兄！（嗝）我们喝一杯庆祝吧！

english: Wha? Wassha counshil? (hic) No counshil gone meshup my drink!
translation: 啥？啥是议会？（嗝）没有议会来搅和我喝酒！

english: (hic) Washa counshil wha?
translation: （嗝）啥是议会啥？

english: Counshil alwaysh meshing up my drinksh 'do thish, do that, pass this tesht something something something something'.. man I hate that counshil.
translation: 议会总是搅和我喝酒，“做这个，做那个，通过这个测试，这个那个那个那个”……伙计，我讨厌那议会。

english: Uh... I'll take that as a no.
translation: 呃……我就当是拒绝了。

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council?
translation: 嗨。你是议会的成员吗？

english: I am afraid not outerlander.
translation: 恐怕不是，外地人。

english: I guess you're not then.
translation: 那我想你不是了。

english: Hello. I'm looking for a member of the council of elders who will support my application to become an honorary Fremennik.
translation: 你好。我在找一位长老议会成员，能支持我申请成为荣誉弗瑞曼尼克人。

english: I'm a council member.
translation: 我是议会成员。

english: So can I somehow persuade you to vote for me at the council of elders?
translation: 那么我能不能说服你在长老议会上投票给我？

english: No. Frankly, I don't like you.
translation: 不。坦白说，我不喜欢你。

english: But you don't even know me!
translation: 但你根本不了解我！

english: You also smell bad. And have stupid hair. And bad breath. And you walk a bit funny.
translation: 你身上还有臭味。发型也很蠢。口臭。走路还有点奇怪。

english: I didn't come all the way up here just to be insulted!
translation: 我大老远来可不是为了受侮辱的！

english: No, I'm quite sure you could have found plenty of people to insult you wherever your home is.
translation: 不，我很确定不管你家在哪，都能找到很多人侮辱你。

english: You know what? Forget you, you stupid barbarian! I don't need your stupid vote!
translation: 你知道吗？去你的，你这个愚蠢的野蛮人！我才不需要你那愚蠢的投票！

english: Tch, typical outerlander rudeness. I'm glad I didn't vote for you now.
translation: 啧，典型的外地人粗鲁。我真庆幸没投票给你。

english: Hello, are you a member of the council?
translation: 你好，你是议会的成员吗？

english: I am afraid not outerlander. Goodbye.
translation: 恐怕不是，外地人。再见。

english: Hi. Are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: 嗨。你是长老议会的成员吗？

english: Me? On the council? Ha ha ha ha! Sorry buddy, I'm not a 'real' Fremennik yet! Let me guess, you're trying to get some council members to vote for you?
translation: 我？在议会上？哈哈哈哈！抱歉老兄，我还不是个'真正的'弗瑞曼尼克呢！让我猜猜，你是想让一些议会成员投票给你？

english: That's right, to become a Fremennik.
translation: 没错，为了成为弗瑞曼尼克。

english: You and me both buddy! We're both doing the same trials! This is my trial of manhood! How you finding it so far? Pretty easy, huh buddy?
translation: 咱俩一样老兄！我们都在做同样的试炼！这是我的成年礼试炼！你觉得怎么样？挺简单的吧，老兄？

english: It's okay I guess...
translation: 还行吧……

english: Yeah, that's the spirit buddy! It's all real easy, I wouldn't worry yourself about it, you'll be quaffing beers in the longhall as a Fremennik in no time!
translation: 没错，就是这样，伙计！这都很简单，你不用担心，你很快就能作为费明尼克人在长厅里畅饮啤酒了！

english: Do you know any council members?
translation: 你认识任何议会成员吗？

english: I know that I am one.
translation: 我知道我自己就是。

english: Great! Can you vote for me at the council of elders for me to become a Fremennik?
translation: 太好了！你能在长老议会上投票让我成为弗瑞曼尼克吗？

english: Sure. On one condition.
translation: 当然。但有一个条件。

english: (sigh) What condition?
translation: （叹气）什么条件？

english: Actually there is no condition! I don't want to vote for you! You seem too gullible to be a Fremennik!
translation: 其实根本没有条件！我不想投票给你！你看起来太容易上当，不配做弗瑞曼尼克！

english: It's kind of mean to trick me like that...
translation: 这样戏弄我有点过分……

english: What do I care? I am a Fremennik and you are just some stupid outerlander! You stupid outerlander!
translation: 我管你呢？我是弗瑞曼尼克，而你只是个愚蠢的外地人！你这个愚蠢的外地人！

english: Are you a member of the Fremmenik council?
translation: 你是弗瑞曼尼克议会的成员吗？

english: Indeed I am, outerlander. Why do you ask?
translation: 我确实是，外地人。你为什么问这个？

english: Well, I was told by Brundt that I could be voted into the tribe as an honorary Fremmenik if I could find seven members of the council of elders to vote in my favour.
translation: 嗯，布伦特告诉我，如果我能找到七位长老议会成员投赞成票，我就可以被投票接纳为荣誉弗瑞曼尼克。

english: Aye, that is indeed true.
translation: 啊，确实如此。

english: So can I have your vote?
translation: 那你能投我一票吗？

english: You can have my vote on the day the skies turn red, the waters turn pink, the rocks turn yellow and the sun turns black.
translation: 等天空变红、海水变粉、岩石变黄、太阳变黑的那一天，你就能得到我的一票。

english: Um... do you have any estimate on when that is?
translation: 嗯……你估计那是什么时候？

english: I'm telling you I will never vote for you, you stupid outlander.
translation: 我告诉你，我永远不会投你的票，你这个愚蠢的外地人。

english: Are you a member of the council of elders?
translation: 你是长老议会的成员吗？

english: No. Weapons are my speciality. Not politics.
translation: 不。武器是我的专长，不是政治。

english: Hi, I don't suppose you are a member of the council of elders are you?
translation: 嗨，我想你不是长老议会的成员吧？

english: No, outerlander, I have never had the honour to be asked.
translation: 不，外地人，我从未有幸被邀请。

english: I am but a lowly warrior, fighting for my people wherever threats may appear against us...
translation: 我只是个卑微的战士，为我的族人战斗，无论威胁出现在何处……

english: So what do you want from me, outerlander?
translation: 那么你想从我这里得到什么，外地人？

english: I suggest you head to the cave with some urgency outerlander, the cold air out here might be too much for the likes of you...
translation: 我建议你赶紧去洞穴，外地人，外面的冷空气对你这种人来说可能太冷了……

english: Outerlander, I go beyond my duty to allow you to accompany me, so I must request a contribution of 1,000 coins for my services.
translation: 外地人，我允许你陪同我是超出了我的职责，所以我必须要求你为我的服务贡献1000金币。

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Dalkar! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，达尔卡！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, I do not begrudge my help outerlander, in the end it is not your fault you are not one of us.
translation: 啊，我并不吝啬我的帮助，外地人，说到底，你不是我们中的一员并不是你的错。

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Dentin! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，丹廷！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Bardar! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，巴尔达！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Denlah Drapare! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，登拉.德拉帕雷！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Doklor Drapare! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，多克洛.德拉帕雷！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Barlor! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，巴洛尔！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Sigkal! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，西格卡尔！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Dardor! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，达多尔！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Ballah! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，巴拉！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Darkir! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，达基尔！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，巴尔卡！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Tonrak Drapare! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，唐拉克.德拉帕雷！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Rilkur! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，里尔库尔！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Jiklor! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，吉克洛！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Denkur! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，登库尔！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Balrak! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，巴尔拉克！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Dalkar Drapare! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，达尔卡.德拉帕雷！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Ah, it is always a pleasure Rakkal! Now did you want something more from me?
translation: 啊，见到你总是很高兴，拉克卡尔！现在你还有什么想从我这里要的吗？

english: Hello outerlander. I overheard your conversation with Brundt just now. You wish to become a member of the Fremennik?
translation: 你好，外地人。我刚才无意中听到你和布伦特的对话。你想成为弗瑞曼尼克的成员？

english: That's right! Why, are you on the council?
translation: 没错！怎么，你是议会的吗？

english: Do not let my drink-soused appearance fool you, I earnt my place on the council many years past. I am always glad to see new blood enter our tribe, and will happily vote for you.
translation: 别被我醉醺醺的外表骗了，我多年前就赢得了议会席位。我很高兴看到新鲜血液加入我们的部落，并且很乐意投票给你。

english: ...Providing you can pass a little test for me. As a Fremennik, you will need to show cunning, stamina, fortitude, and an iron constitution. I know of only one way to test all of these.
translation: ……前提是你能通过我一个小小的测试。作为弗瑞曼尼克，你需要展现狡猾、耐力、坚韧和铁打的体质。我知道只有一种方法可以测试这些。

english: Why, a drinking contest!
translation: 那就是，喝酒比赛！

english: The task is simple enough! You versus me, a stiff drink each, last man standing wins the trial. So what say you?
translation: 任务很简单！你对我，每人一杯烈酒，最后幸存者赢得试炼。你觉得怎么样？

english: A drinking contest? Easy. Set them up, and I'll knock them back.
translation: 喝酒比赛？简单。摆上来，我一口干。

english: When you are ready to begin, go and pick up a keg from that table over there, and come back here.
translation: 等你准备好了，去那边桌子上拿一个啤酒桶，然后回到这里。

english: We start when you have your keg of beer with you, and finish when one of us can drink no more and yields.
translation: 当你拿着啤酒桶时我们就开始，直到我们中有一人喝不下认输为止。

english: I don't think drinking myself into a stupor is a very good way of testing my worthiness.
translation: 我不认为把自己喝得酩酊大醉是测试我价值的好方法。

english: Well, perhaps it's not, but it's my way. If you want my vote at the council, I'm afraid you're going to have to drink me under the table.
translation: 嗯，也许不是那样，但这是我的方式。如果你想在议会上得到我的选票，恐怕你得把我灌倒才行。

english: I'm going to find someone else to vote for me then.
translation: 那我就去找别人给我投票了。

english: As, I see you have your keg of beer. Are we ready to drink against each other?
translation: 啊，我看到你拿着啤酒桶了。我们准备好对喝了吗？

english: Yes, let's start this drinking contest!
translation: 是的，开始这场喝酒比赛吧！

english: As you wish, outerlander; I will drink first, then you will drink.
translation: 如你所愿，外地人；我先喝，然后你喝。

english: Ish no' fair! (hic) I canna drink another drop! Alsho feel veddy, veddy ill...
translation: 这不公平！（嗝）我一口也喝不下去了！而且感觉非常、非常不舒服……

english: I guessh I win then ouddaladder! (hic) Niche try, anyway!
translation: 那我猜是我赢了，外地人！（嗝）不过还是不错的尝试！

english: Come back if'n you fanshy a rematch! (hic) Jusht let me have a coffee firsht...
translation: 如果你想要再来一局就回来！（嗝）先让我喝杯咖啡……

english: I'm not quite ready yet...
translation: 我还没准备好……

english: Want to line your stomach with some food or something, huh outerlander? Come back to me when you're ready to drink.
translation: 想先吃点东西垫垫肚子吗，嗯？等你准备好喝酒了再来找我。

english: What do I have to do to earn your vote again?
translation: 我该怎么做才能再次获得你的投票？

english: Beat me in a drinking contest! Grab a keg of beer from that table near the bar, and come back here with it.
translation: 在喝酒比赛里打败我！从吧台旁边那张桌子上拿一桶啤酒，带回来给我。

english: Oh yeah. Okay, I will do.
translation: 哦对。好的，我会的。

english: Ah, I see you have your keg of beer. Are we ready to drink against each other?
translation: 啊，我看到你拿着啤酒桶了。我们准备好对喝了吗？

english: Howdy! You seem like someone with discerning taste! Howsabout you try my brand new range of alcohol?
translation: 你好！你看起来是个有品位的人！要不要尝尝我全新系列的酒？

english: Didn't you used to sell poison?
translation: 你以前不是卖毒药的吗？

english: That I did, indeed! Peter Potter's Patented Multipurpose poison! A miracle of modern apothecarys! My exclusive concoction has been tested on...
translation: 确实卖过！彼得.波特专利万能毒药！现代药学的奇迹！我的独家配方经过测试……

english: Uh, yeah, I've already heard the sales pitch.
translation: 呃，是啊，我已经听过推销词了。

english: Sorry stranger, old habits die hard I guess.
translation: 抱歉，陌生人，老习惯难改吧。

english: So you don't sell poison any more?
translation: 所以你不再卖毒药了？

english: Well, I would, but I ran out of stock. Business wasn't helped with that stuff that happened up at the Sinclair Mansion much either, I'll be honest.
translation: 嗯，我倒想卖，但没货了。老实说，辛克莱尔庄园发生的那件事也没帮上什么忙。

english: So, being the man of enterprise that I am I decided to branch out a little bit!
translation: 所以，作为一个有事业心的人，我决定拓展一下业务！

english: Into alcohol?
translation: 涉足酒类？

english: Absolutely! The basic premise between alcohol and poison is pretty much the same, after all! The difference is that my alcohol has a unique property others do not!
translation: 绝对！毕竟酒精和毒药的基本原理差不多！区别在于我的酒精有别人没有的独特特性！

english: Ever been too drunk to find your own home? Ever wished that you could party away all night long, and still wake up fresh as a daisy the next morning?
translation: 有没有醉得找不到家？有没有希望整夜狂欢，第二天早上仍然像雏菊一样清新？

english: Thanks to the miracles of modern magic we have come up with just the solution you need! Peter Potter's Patented Party Potions!
translation: 多亏了现代魔法的奇迹，我们想出了你需要的解决方案！彼得.波特专利派对药水！

english: It looks just like beer! It tastes just like beer! It smells just like beer! But... it's not beer!
translation: 它看起来像啤酒！尝起来像啤酒！闻起来像啤酒！但是……它不是啤酒！

english: Our mages have mused for many moments to bring you this miracle of modern magic! It has all the great tastes you'd expect, but contains absolutely no alcohol!
translation: 我们的法师们冥思苦想了许久，才为您带来这个现代魔法的奇迹！它拥有您期望的所有美妙口感，但绝对不含酒精！

english: That's right! You can drink Peter Potters Patented Party Potion as much as you want, and suffer absolutely no ill effects whatsoever!
translation: 没错！你可以尽情饮用彼得.波特专利派对药水，完全没有任何不良影响！

english: The clean fresh taste you know you can trust, from the people who brought you; Peter Potters Patented multipurpose poison, Peter Potters peculiar paint packs
translation: 您可以信赖的清新纯净口感，来自为您带来彼得.波特专利万能毒药、彼得.波特特色颜料包

english: and Peter Potters paralysing panic pins. Available now from all good stockists! Ask your local bartender now, and experience the taste revolution of the century!
translation: 以及彼得.波特麻痹恐慌别针。现在在各大优质经销商处有售！立即咨询您当地的酒保，体验本世纪的口感革命！

english: So... when you say 'all good stockists'...
translation: 那么……当你说'各大优质经销商'……

english: How many inns actually sell this stuff?
translation: 实际上有多少家旅馆在卖这种东西？

english: Well... nobody has actually bought any yet. Everyone I try and sell it to always asks me what exactly the point of beer that has absolutely no effect on you is.
translation: 嗯……实际上还没人买过。我每次推销，别人都会问，这种完全没效果的啤酒到底有什么意义。

english: So what is the point?
translation: 那有什么意义呢？

english: Well... Um... Er... Hmmm. You, er, don't get drunk.
translation: 嗯……呃……呃……嗯。你，呃，不会醉。

english: Aw man... You don't want any now do you? I've really tried to push this product, but I just don't think the world is ready for beer that doesn't get you drunk.
translation: 唉，老兄……你现在不想要了吧？我真的很努力推销这个产品，但我觉得世界还没准备好接受不会让人醉的啤酒。

english: I'm a man ahead of my time I tell you! It's not that my products are bad, it's that they're too good for the market!
translation: 我告诉你，我是个超越时代的人！不是我的产品不好，而是它们太好了，市场承受不了！

english: Actually, I would like some. How much do you want for it?
translation: 其实，我想要一些。你要多少钱？

english: Y-you would??? Um, okay! I knew I still had the old salesmans skills going on!
translation: 你、你想要？？？嗯，好吧！我就知道我的老销售技巧还在！

english: I'll sell you a keg of it for only 250 gold pieces! So what do you say?
translation: 我卖给你一桶只要250金币！你意下如何？

english: Sorry pal, we do not offer credit for any purchases made of Peter Potter's patented party potion! Come back when you have the cash!
translation: 抱歉朋友，购买彼得.波特专利派对药水概不赊账！等你有现金再来吧！

english: Sorry pal, doesn't look like you have room on you to carry it.
translation: 抱歉朋友，看起来你身上没地方带了。

english: I understand you have some low alcohol beer for sale...?
translation: 我听说你有低度啤酒在卖……？

english: That I do, and sales are rocketing upwards as word of mouth spreads of it's clean taste and cool flavour! So... you want to buy some?
translation: 确实如此，随着口耳相传，它的清爽口感和清凉风味让销量一路飙升！那么……你想买点吗？

english: Thinking of cheating my test, outerlander? I don't think so! You drink that keg fairly, or not at all! Don't let me catch you cheating!
translation: 想在我的测试中作弊吗，外来者？休想！你要么老老实实喝完那桶酒，要么一滴也别喝！别让我抓到你作弊！

english: I'm going to have to find some way to distract this guy while I cheat...
translation: 我必须在作弊的时候想办法分散这家伙的注意力……

english: I don't have anything I really want to put inside a smelly old drain pipe.
translation: 我没什么真正想塞进那根臭烘烘的旧排水管里的东西。

english: That is going to make a really loud bang when it goes off! It would be a perfect distraction to help me cheat in the drinking contest!
translation: 那东西爆炸时会发出一声巨响！这将是帮助我在喝酒比赛中作弊的完美干扰！

english: what was THAT?
translation: 那是什么声音？！

english: As you wish outerlander; I will drink first, then you will drink.
translation: 如你所愿，外地人；我先喝，然后你喝。

english: Aaaah, lovely stuff. So you want to get the next round in, or shall I? You don't look so good there!
translation: 啊哈，好东西。那么是你来下一轮，还是我来？你看起来可不太好啊！

english: Wassha? Guh? You drank that whole keg! But it dinna affect you at all! I conshede! You can probably outdrink me!
translation: 什么？呃？你喝光了整桶酒！但对你一点影响都没有！我认输！你大概能喝赢我！

english: I jusht can't (hic) believe it! Thatsh shome mighty fine drinking legs you got! Anyone who can drink like THAT getsh my vote atta consh.. counsh... gets my vote!
translation: 我真（嗝）不敢相信！你的酒量太厉害了！能喝成这样的人，在议……议……会上我一定投你一票！

english: So I can rely on your vote at the council?
translation: 那么我在议会上能指望你的投票了？

english: Absholutely! (hic) You're one mighty drinker!
translation: 绝对没问题！（嗝）你真是个能喝的！

english: Hello? Yes? You want something, outerlander?
translation: 你好？有什么事吗？你想要点什么，外地人？

english: Are you a member of the council?
translation: 你是议会的成员吗？

english: Why, indeed I am, outerlander! My talents as an exemplary musician made it difficult for them not to accept me! Why do you wish to know this?
translation: 当然了，外地人！我作为杰出音乐家的才华让他们很难不接受我！你为什么想知道这个？

english: Well, I ask because I am currently doing the Fremennik trials so as to join your clan. I need seven of the twelve council of elders to vote for me.
translation: 嗯，我问是因为我正在参加费明尼克试炼，想加入你们的部族。我需要十二位长老议会中的七位投票支持我。

english: Ahhh... and you wish to earn my vote? I will gladly accept you as a Fremennik should you be able to prove yourself to have a little musical ability!
translation: 啊……你是想赢得我的投票？如果你能证明自己有一点音乐才能，我很乐意接纳你成为费明尼克人！

english: So how would I do that?
translation: 那我该怎么做？

english: Why, by playing in our longhall! All you need to do is impress the revellers there with a few verses of an epic of your own creation!
translation: 在我们的大厅里演奏！你只需要用自己创作的史诗中的几句歌词打动那里的狂欢者就行！

english: So what say you outerlander? Are you up for the challenge?
translation: 那么你觉得怎么样，外地人？你敢接受挑战吗？

english: Sure! This certainly sounds pretty easy to accomplish - I'll have your vote in no time!
translation: 当然！这听起来确实挺容易的——我很快就会得到你的投票！

english: That is great news outerlander! We always need more music lovers here!
translation: 真是好消息，外地人！我们这里总是需要更多音乐爱好者！

english: Forget it! This all sounds like way too much work for a stupid vote at a meeting! I'll find someone else instead.
translation: 算了！这一切听起来太麻烦了，为了一个会议上的投票不值得。我还是找别人吧。

english: So how would I go about writing this epic?
translation: 那我该怎么写这首史诗呢？

english: Well, first of all you are going to need an instrument. Like all true bards you are going to have to make this yourself.
translation: 首先，你需要一件乐器。和所有真正的吟游诗人一样，你必须亲手制作。

english: How do I make an instrument?
translation: 我怎么制作乐器？

english: Well, it is a long and drawn-out process. Just east of this village there is an unusually musical tree that can be used to make very high quality instruments.
translation: 嗯，这是个漫长的过程。在这个村子东边有一棵异常有音乐天赋的树，可以用来制作高品质的乐器。

english: Cut a piece from it, and then carve it into a special shape that will allow you to string it. Using a knife as you would craft any other wooden object would be best for this.
translation: 从树上砍下一块，然后用刀把它雕刻成特殊的形状，以便能装上琴弦。就像制作其他木制品一样，用刀是最好的办法。

english: Then what do I need to do?
translation: 然后我还需要做什么？

english: Next you will need to string your lyre. There is a troll to the South-east who has some golden wool. I would not recommend using anything else to string your lyre with.
translation: 接下来你需要给你的竖琴上弦。东南方有一只巨魔，他有金色毛线球。我建议你别用其他东西来给你的竖琴上弦。

english: Well, when you have crafted your lyre you will need the blessing of the Fossegrimen to tune your lyre to perfection before you even consider a public performance.
translation: 嗯，等你做好竖琴后，需要获得福塞格里门的祝福，才能把你的竖琴调到完美的音准，然后才能考虑公开演奏。

english: Who or what is Fossegrimen?
translation: 福塞格里门是谁？或者是什么？

english: Fossegrimen is a lake spirit that lives just a little way South-west of this village. Make her an offering of fish, and you will then be ready for your performance.
translation: 福塞格里门是个湖中精灵，就住在这个村子西南边一点。给她献上鱼作为祭品，你就准备好表演了。

english: Make sure you give her a suitable offering however. If the offering is found to be unworthy, then you may find yourself unable to play your lyre with any skill at all!
translation: 不过要确保你献上合适的祭品。如果祭品被认为不值得，你可能会发现自己根本无法娴熟地演奏竖琴！

english: So what would be a worthy offering?
translation: 那么什么样的祭品才算值得呢？

english: A raw shark, manta ray, or sea turtle should be sufficient as an offering.
translation: 生鲨鱼、魔鬼鱼或海龟作为祭品应该足够了。

english: Okay, what else do I need to do?
translation: 好的，我还需要做什么？

english: When you have crafted your lyre and been blessed by Fossegrimen, then you will finally be ready to make your performance to the revellers at the longhall.
translation: 等你制作好竖琴并获得福塞格里门的祝福后，就可以在大厅里为狂欢者表演了。

english: Head past the bouncers and onto the stage, and then begin to play. If all goes well, you should find the music spring to your mind and sing your own epic on the spot.
translation: 经过保镖，登上舞台，然后开始演奏。如果一切顺利，你会感到音乐涌上心头，当场唱出你自己的史诗。

english: I will observe both you and the audience, and if you show enough talent, I will happily vote in your favour at the council of elders.
translation: 我会观察你和观众，如果你展现出足够的才华，我会很乐意在长老议会上投票支持你。

english: Is that clear enough, outerlander? Would you like me to repeat anything?
translation: 够清楚了吗，外地人？需要我重复什么吗？

english: Can you remind me about making a lyre again, please Olaf?
translation: 奥拉夫，你能再提醒我一下如何制作竖琴吗？

english: There are three parts to making the lyre; First you need to cut some special wood from the special musical tree which can be found just east of Rellekka.
translation: 制作竖琴分为三步：首先，你需要从一颗特殊的音乐树上砍下一些特殊的木材，这棵树就在雷勒卡城东边。

english: When you have the wood, you will need to use a knife to craft it into a Lyre. When you have an unstrung lyre, you will need to string it before you can play it.
translation: 拿到木材后，你需要用刀将其雕刻成竖琴的形状。等你有了未穿线的竖琴，你需要给它上弦才能演奏。

english: I would not use anything other than the golden string of Lalli, a troll who lives in a cave just to the South-east.
translation: 我只推荐使用拉利——一个住在东南方洞穴里的巨魔——的金色毛线球，其他东西都不行。

english: Can you remind me about getting a blessing from Fossegrimen again?
translation: 你能再提醒我一下如何获得福塞格里门的祝福吗？

english: Certainly outerlander! Fossegrimen is a lake spirit who lives in the lake just to the South-west of here. She will bless you so that you may play your lyre,
translation: 当然，外来者！福塞格里门是个湖中精灵，住在村子西南边的湖里。她会祝福你，让你能弹奏竖琴，

english: if you give her a worthy offering. She will only accept raw fish, so place a raw fish on her pedestal, and she will bless you. The better the offering, the longer
translation: 这样你就能演奏竖琴了。她只接受生鱼，所以把生鱼放在她的基座上，她就会祝福你。祭品越好，

english: the amount of time you will be blessed for. You will not be able to perform on stage without the blessing of the Fossegrimen.
translation: 祝福持续的时间就越长。没有福塞格里门的祝福，你无法在舞台上表演。

english: Can you remind me about how to perform at the longhall again please?
translation: 你能再提醒我一下如何在大厅表演吗？

english: Not a problem outerlander. When you have your lyre and have been blessed, you will be able to pass the bouncer at the stage entrance of the longhall.
translation: 没问题，外地人。当你拥有竖琴并获得祝福后，你就能通过大厅舞台入口处的保镖了。

english: He will not let you pass unless he believes you are ready to perform on stage. Simply go past him and onto the stage and use your lyre, and you will
translation: 除非他认为你已经准备好上台表演，否则他不会让你通过。直接绕过他，登上舞台使用你的竖琴，你

english: begin to play to entertain the revellers. If all has gone well, you will feel the music come to your mind, unbidden, as you sing an epic of your exploits.
translation: 就会开始演奏，娱乐狂欢者。如果一切顺利，你会感到音乐不请自来地涌入脑海，唱出你丰功伟业的史诗。

english: I will watch your performance from backstage, and also study how much the crowd likes you, and if I believe you have enough talent, then I will vote for you at the council.
translation: 我会在后台观看你的表演，并观察观众对你的喜爱程度，如果我认为你有足够的才华，我就会在议会上投票支持你。

english: No thanks, I think that's all pretty straight forward. I'll go and make my lyre now.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我觉得这一切都挺直接的。我现在就去制作我的竖琴。

english: Actually, I'm not after your golden apples. I was wondering if I could have some golden wool; I need it to string a lyre.
translation: 其实，我不是来要你的金苹果的。我想问能不能给我一些金色毛线球；我需要用它给竖琴上弦。

english: Ha! You not fool me human! Me am smart! Other trolls so jealous of how brainy I are, they kick me out of camp and make me live down here in cave! But me have last funny!
translation: 哈！你骗不了我的，人类！我可聪明了！其他巨魔都嫉妒我的脑子太好使，把我赶出了营地，让我住在这个洞穴里！但笑到最后的可是我！

english: Me find golden apples on tree and me build wall to stop anyone who not Lalli eating lovely golden apples! Did me not tell you I are smart?
translation: 我在树上找到了金苹果，然后建了一堵墙，不让任何不是拉利的人吃到美味的金苹果！我没告诉你我很聪明吗？

english: Yes, yes, you are incredibly clever. Now please can I have some golden wool?
translation: 是的是的，你非常聪明。那现在能给我一些金色毛线球吗？

english: Hum, me think you not really think I are clever. Me think you is trying trick Lalli. Me not like you as much as other human. He give me present. I give him wool.
translation: 哼，我觉得你其实不觉得我聪明。我觉得你想骗拉利。我不像喜欢另一个人那样喜欢你。他给了我礼物。我给了他羊毛。

english: Other human? You mean someone else has been there and you gave them wool?
translation: 另一个人？你是说还有别人来过这里，你给了他们羊毛？

english: Human call itself Askeladden! It not trick Lalli, Lalli do good deal with human! Stupid human get some dumb wool, but did not get golden apples!
translation: 那个人自称阿斯卡拉登！他没有骗拉利，拉利和他做了笔好交易！愚蠢的人类拿到了些傻羊毛，但没拿到金苹果！

english: I see... okay, well, bye!
translation: 我明白了……好吧，那再见！

english: No, honest, you're REALLY clever. Why, I could not contemplate a mere chicanery with an advanced intellect such as you currently present.
translation: 不，说真的，你真的很聪明。以你目前展现出的高等智慧，我根本不敢考虑耍什么花招。

english: Grrr! Why you insult me stupid human? Me know it are because you jealous of Lalli's huge brain and you try steal apples!
translation: 呃！你为什么要侮辱我，愚蠢的人类？我知道是因为你嫉妒拉利的大脑袋，想偷苹果！

english: Can I give you a present? Or maybe exchange you something for some wool?
translation: 我能给你一件礼物吗？或者用什么东西交换一些羊毛？

english: Ha! You stupid human! You think you trick Lalli? Me know you want my golden apples Well! You not get them! HAHAHA!
translation: 哈！你这愚蠢的人类！你以为你能骗到拉利？我知道你想要我的金苹果！你拿不到的！哈哈哈！

english: Erm... okay then.
translation: 呃……那好吧。

english: Hello there. I understand you managed to get some golden wool from Lalli?
translation: 你好。我听说你从拉利那里弄到了些金色毛线球？

english: HAHAHA! Yeah, that Lalli... what a maroon!
translation: 哈哈哈！是啊，那个拉利……真是个栗色蠢蛋！

english: So how did you manage to get the wool?
translation: 那你是怎么弄到羊毛的？

english: Well, as you know, I am doing the same trials that you are as part of my test of manhood, and that troll is the only one who can get that wool.
translation: 嗯，你知道，我也和你一样在进行试炼，作为我成人测试的一部分。那只巨魔是唯一能得到那种羊毛的家伙。
