english: You might have noticed he's kind of... messed in the head buddy! He's real paranoid about people stealing his golden apples, isn't he?
translation: 你可能注意到他有点……脑子不太正常，伙计！他特别疑神疑鬼，怕别人偷他的金苹果，对吧？

english: Indeed he is. So how did you manage to get some golden wool from him?
translation: 确实如此。那你是怎么从他那里弄到金色毛线球的？

english: It was easy buddy! I persuaded him he needed a pet to help him guard his apples. A pet that would never sleep! A pet that would never need food, or exercise!
translation: 很简单，伙计！我说服了他，他需要一个宠物来帮他看守苹果。一个永不睡觉的宠物！一个永远不需要食物或运动的宠物！

english: A pet that would never need him to clean up its... well, you know, buddy. A pet that would always be loyal to him! A faithful companion for life!
translation: 一个永远不需要他清理……嗯，你懂的，伙计的宠物。一个永远对他忠诚的宠物！一生的忠实伙伴！

english: What pet is this then?
translation: 那是什么宠物？

english: A pet ROCK!
translation: 一块宠物石！

english: Man, can you believe that stupid troll traded me some of his golden wool for a worthless ROCK?
translation: 伙计，你能相信吗？那只愚蠢的巨魔用他的一些金色毛线球换了一块一文不值的石头？

english: Buddy, I hafta say; if brains were explosives, that troll wouldn't have enough to blow his nose!
translation: 伙计，我不得不说；如果大脑是炸药，那只巨魔连擤鼻涕的量都不够！

english: Do you have any spare rocks then?
translation: 那你还有多余的石头吗？

english: Sure thing buddy, although I have to say, I doubt even that troll is stupid enough to fall for the SAME trick TWICE in a row! You can try anyway though!
translation: 当然有，伙计，不过我得说，我不确定那只巨魔会不会蠢到连续两次上同一个当！不过你还是可以试试！

english: So this is the exact same type of rock you managed to sell to Lalli as a pet?
translation: 所以这就是你卖给拉利当宠物的那种石头？

english: Yup, sure is buddy! That Lalli is stupid, even by troll standards!
translation: 没错，就是它，伙计！即使以巨魔的标准来衡量，那个拉利也够蠢的！

english: Can I have another rock? I lost mine...
translation: 我能再要一块石头吗？我的弄丢了……

english: Wait! I have something that might interest you... a pet rock!
translation: 等等！我有个你可能感兴趣的东西……一块宠物石！

english: Hah! You think me stupid or something human? Me already got one! Me don't want lotta baby rocks either, so me don't want another one around the place!
translation: 哈！你觉得我傻吗，人类？我已经有一块了！我也不想要一堆宠物石宝宝，所以我不想要另一块放在这儿！

english: Please... all I want is some of your golden wool...
translation: 求你了……我只想要一些你的金色毛线球……

english: Stupid human think he can trick me into giving away some golden apples! Hah! Golden apples is all me got to eat, you not get them, no way!
translation: 愚蠢的人类以为他能骗我交出一些金苹果！哈！金苹果是我唯一能吃的东西，你别想得到它们，没门！

english: Hmm... So you're hungry? I think I will have the perfect thing for you to eat... I just need to get myself an onion, a potato and a cabbage...
translation: 嗯……所以你饿了？我想我会有你爱吃的东西……我只需要弄到洋葱、土豆和卷心菜……

english: Unless you got tasty food for Lalli. Then I might trade you for it.
translation: 除非你有美味的食物给拉利。那样的话我可能会和你交换。

english: Actually I don't...
translation: 其实我没有……

english: Hah! Me knew it! You human just try trick Lalli into giving away golden apple! Me not as stupid as you look!
translation: 哈！我就知道！你们人类就是想骗拉利交出金苹果！我可不傻！

english: It am ready now?
translation: 现在准备好了吗？

english: Indeed it is. Try it and see.
translation: 当然准备好了。尝尝看。

english: Hmm... YUM! That are delicious! Me never know human know to make soup out of stone? It some special stone?
translation: 嗯……好吃！太好吃了！我之前不知道人类还会用石头做汤？是什么特殊的石头吗？

english: Indeed it is. But I'm willing to trade it.
translation: 确实是。但我愿意交易它。

english: Let me think about that, me like to think.
translation: 让我想想，我喜欢思考。

english: Your soup very tasty, human! But me still not want trade golden apples for your stone. Me think pet rock get jealous.
translation: 你的汤很好吃，人类！但我还是不想用金苹果换你的石头。我觉得宠物石会嫉妒。

english: I. DON'T. WANT. ANY. GOLDEN. APPLES. ALL. I. WANT. IS. A. GOLDEN. FLEECE.
translation: 我.不.要.任.何.金.苹.果。我.只.要.金.色.毛.线.球。

english: Gee, sorry human, all you have do is ask, me not need you to shout. You act like you think Lalli am stupid or something...
translation: 吉，抱歉啊人类，你只要问就行了，我不需要你大喊大叫。你表现得好像你觉得拉利很蠢似的……

english: Here you go. Hah! Me trick you human! All you got is worthless golden fleece! Me got very rare soup-making stone!
translation: 给你。哈！我骗了你人类！你得到的只是没用的金羊毛！我得到了非常稀有的做汤石头！

english: What? Me am not stupid human! Everyone know cannot make food from stone!
translation: 什么？俺不是愚蠢的人类！谁都知道不能用石头做食物！

english: Why you need other stuff too then?
translation: 那你为什么还需要其他东西呢？

english: Ha! Stupid human think he buy golden apples, but actually get stupid wool! Hahaha!
translation: 哈！愚蠢的人类以为他能买到金苹果，结果却买到了愚蠢的羊毛！哈哈哈！

english: Me have to try this! Me will swap you your wool if you not trick me and really can make soup out of a stone.
translation: 俺得试试这个！如果你没骗俺，真的能用石头做汤，俺就用你的羊毛跟你换。

english: Me would give you golden fleece if me think you have enough room in your invetinary.
translation: 如果俺觉得你的背包里有足够空间，俺会把金羊毛给你。

english: Hey human! You not go in my house! met whewe mekeep aww my stuff!
translation: 嘿，人类！你不能进俺的房子！俺把俺所有的东西都放在那里！

english: Glad you're happy Lalli!
translation: 很高兴你开心，拉利！

english: I really wouldn't know where to begin playing anything on this...
translation: 我真的不知道从何开始在这上面演奏任何东西……

english: Many thanks for the offering outerlander. Please accept as a gift the ability to play your lyre...
translation: 非常感谢你的祭品，外地人。请接受这份礼物——演奏你的竖琴的能力……

english: Dor Ray Me So.
translation: 哆来咪嗦。

english: Fah La Ti Doh.
translation: 发拉西哆。

english: La La La La.
translation: 啦啦啦啦。

english: De-Doo-De-Doo.
translation: 嘟-嘟-嘟-嘟。

english: You have an instrument now, huh? Go on through the door.
translation: 你现在有乐器了，嗯？从门过去吧。

english: Yeah, you're good to go through. Olaf tells me you're some kind of outerlander bard here on tour. I doubt you're worse than Olaf is.
translation: 是的，你可以过去了。奥拉夫告诉我你是个来巡演的外地吟游诗人。我不信你比奥拉夫差。

english: Get lost, outerlander. Performers only past this point.
translation: 滚开，外地人。表演者才能通过这里。

english: Oh, really? So where's your instrument?
translation: 哦，真的吗？那你的乐器呢？

english: Oh, really? You won't mind singing me a quick song then.
translation: 哦，真的吗？那你应该不介意给我唱首小曲吧。

english: That was a pile of tosh. Get lost, outerlander. You're a bard like I'm a goblin. Do I look stupid to you?
translation: 那唱得真是一坨屎。滚开，外地人。你是个吟游诗人，就像我是个哥布林一样。我看起来像傻子吗？

english: I said, get lost.
translation: 我说了，滚开。

english: The thought of lots of questing
translation: 想到要完成许多任务

english: leaves some people unfulfilled,
translation: 让有些人感到不满足，

english: but I have done my simple best
translation: 但我已尽我微薄之力

english: in entering the Champions' Guild.
translation: 加入了勇士公会。

english: When it comes to fighting
translation: 说到战斗的时候

english: I hit my share of zeroes
translation: 我也打出过不少零伤害

english: But I'm well respected at
translation: 但我备受尊敬

english: the Guild reserved for Heroes.
translation: 在英雄公会里。

english: I cannot even start to list
translation: 我甚至无法开始列举

english: the amount of foes I've killed.
translation: 我杀死的敌人数量。

english: I will simply tell you this:
translation: 我只告诉你这个：

english: I've joined the Legends' Guild!
translation: 我加入了传奇公会！

english: When people speak of training
translation: 当人们谈论训练

english: some people think they're fine.
translation: 有些人觉得自己还行。

english: But they just all seem jealous that
translation: 但他们似乎都嫉妒

english: my [skill]'s ninety-nine!
translation: 我的[skill]九十九级！

english: [Player name] is my name,
translation: [Player name]是我的名字，

english: I haven't much to say.
translation: 我没有太多可说的。

english: But since I have to sing this song,
translation: 但既然我必须唱这首歌，

english: I'll just go ahead and play.
translation: 我就直接开始演奏吧。

english: Wow! That was awesome! You are one of the greatest bards I have ever had the pleasure of watching performing! You have certainly earned my vote! I hope we can duet together soon!
translation: 哇！太棒了！你是我有幸观看过的最伟大的吟游诗人之一！你绝对赢得了我的投票！希望我们很快能一起二重奏！

english: So can I rely on your vote with the council of elders in my favour?
translation: 那么我能指望你在长老会上投我一票吗？

english: You have a truly poetic soul! Anyone who can compose such a beautiful epic, and then perform it so flawlessly can only bring good to our clan!
translation: 你真有诗意的灵魂！任何能创作出如此美丽的史诗，并完美无瑕地表演出来的人，只会给我们的部族带来好处！

english: Erm... so that's a yes, then?
translation: 呃……那么这是同意了？

english: Absolutely! We must collaborate together on a duet sometime, don't you think?
translation: 当然！我们一定要找个时间合作二重奏，你不觉得吗？

english: What do you want outerlander?
translation: 你想要什么，外地人？

english: The Fremennik council of elders? I am pleased to say that I am. My value as a huntsman is recognised by my position there.
translation: 弗瑞曼尼长老会？我很高兴地说我是其中一员。我作为猎人的价值通过我在那里的职位得到了认可。

english: I was wondering if I could persuade you to vouch for me as a member of your clan?
translation: 我想知道能否说服你为我担保，让我成为你部族的一员？

english: You? ... well... I am not totally against the idea outerlander. If you can demonstrate some hunting skills then perhaps I may offer my vote.
translation: 你？……嗯……我并非完全反对这个想法，外地人。如果你能展示一些狩猎技巧，那么也许我会投你一票。

english: How can I prove my hunting skills to you? I can go kill, like, a hundred chickens for you right now!
translation: 我该如何向你证明我的狩猎技巧？我现在就可以去杀一百只鸡给你看！

english: Chickens? You think that would impress me?
translation: 鸡？你以为那能打动我？

english: Cows then? I can kill cows until, er, the cows come home.
translation: 那奶牛呢？我可以杀奶牛直到，呃，奶牛回家。

english: No. The prey I have in mind for you to prove your worth to me is something far more dangerous. Far more difficult. Far more deadly.
translation: 不。我心中让你证明自己价值的猎物要危险得多。困难得多。致命得多。

english: Not... Giant Rats?!?!
translation: 不会是……巨型老鼠吧？！？！

english: I suspect you are mocking me outerlander. You will need to prove your skill as a hunter to me by tracking and defeating... The Draugen.
translation: 我怀疑你在嘲笑我，外地人。你需要通过追踪并击败……德拉根来向我证明你作为猎人的技巧。

english: What's a Draugen? Some kind of cheap barbarian rip- off of a dragon?
translation: 德拉根是什么？某种廉价的野蛮人山寨龙？

english: Hmmm. No, the words are slightly similar I suppose, but they are very different creatures.
translation: 嗯。不，我想这两个词有点相似，但它们是截然不同的生物。

english: The Draugen is an evil ghost from Fremennik mythology, that devours the souls of those brave warriors who meet their ends at sea.
translation: 德拉根是弗瑞曼尼神话中的一个邪恶幽灵，吞噬那些在海中丧命的勇敢战士的灵魂。

english: It stalks the coastlines, invisible to all. It brings us bad fortunes, and curses our journeys across the seas. It is also unkillable by normal means.
translation: 它潜行于海岸线，对所有人隐形。它给我们带来厄运，诅咒我们的海上航行。而且常规手段无法杀死它。

english: ...Let me get this straight; You want me to hunt an unkillable, invincible, and invisible enemy? How am I supposed to do that?
translation: ……让我搞清楚；你想让我猎杀一个无法杀死、无敌且隐形的敌人？我该怎么做？

english: Well outerlander, should you accept my challenge I will show you a special hunter's trick that will help you. Do you accept the challenge?
translation: 嗯，外地人，如果你接受我的挑战，我会教你一个特殊的猎人技巧来帮助你。你接受挑战吗？

english: Well, I need every vote I can get in the council of elders, but this certainly sounds impossible to do...
translation: 嗯，我需要长老会上每一张可能的选票，但这听起来确实不可能做到……

english: Not at all outerlander. The Draugen is indeed impossible to kill, but that is not the same as being impossible to fight against.
translation: 并非如此，外地人。德拉根确实无法杀死，但这不等于无法与之战斗。

english: Every time he takes a Fremennik life, he gains in power, so to keep it from becoming too powerful we hunters hunt it and steal its life force.
translation: 每次它夺走一个弗瑞曼尼人的生命，它就会增强力量，所以为了防止它变得过于强大，我们猎人就去猎杀它并偷取它的生命力。

english: To defeat the Draugen you will need a special item; I have one to give you but it seems as though your inventory is too full to accept it.
translation: 要击败德拉根，你需要一件特殊物品；我有一件要给你，但你的背包似乎太满了，无法接受。

english: We do this with a special talisman. Here, take it; it will let you track the Draugen while it's invisible, and when you defeat it will absorb its essence.
translation: 我们用一种特殊的护符来做这件事。给你，拿着；它让你在德拉根隐形时追踪它，当你击败它时，它会吸收它的精华。

english: I want you to track the Draugen, defeat it, and store its essence in that talisman for me. If you can do this important task for my clan, I will vote for you.
translation: 我要你追踪德拉根，击败它，并把它的精华储存在那个护符里给我。如果你能为我的部族完成这个重要任务，我就会投你一票。

english: Take care of the talisman, and see me when you have completed this task.
translation: 保管好护符，完成任务后回来找我。

english: Hello again outerlander. Have you managed to hunt down the terrible Draugen yet?
translation: 又见面了，外地人。你成功猎杀可怕的德拉根了吗？

english: Hmmm. Laziness is not a trait that I admire. I suggest you go and do so if you wish me to vouchsafe for you to our council of elders.
translation: 嗯。懒惰不是我所欣赏的品质。如果你希望我向长老会为你担保，我建议你去做。

english: Not yet... I lost the talisman you gave me.
translation: 还没有……我弄丢了你给我的护符。

english: The typical careless regard for valuable objects I would expect from an outerlander such as yourself. Do not lose THIS one.
translation: 典型的对贵重物品粗心大意，我预料到像你这样的外地人会这样。别再弄丢这个了。

english: I saw the entire hunt. Let me take that talisman from you; I would be honoured to speak out for you to our council of elders after such a hunt, outerlander.
translation: 我看到了整个狩猎过程。让我从你那里拿走那个护符；在这样一场狩猎之后，我很荣幸能向长老会为你发言，外地人。

english: Absolutely outerlander! Anyone brave enough to hunt and defeat the Draugen will be a great addition to our clan!
translation: 当然，外地人！任何勇敢到能猎杀并击败德拉根的人都会是我们部族的绝佳新成员！

english: Hello outerlander.
translation: 你好，外地人。

english: That I am outerlander; it is a position that brings my family and I pride.
translation: 是的，我是，外地人；这个职位给我和我的家人带来骄傲。

english: I was wondering if I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我想知道能否指望你在长老会上投我一票？

english: You wish to become a Fremennik? I may be persuaded to swing my vote to your favour, but you will first need to do a little task for me.
translation: 你想成为弗瑞曼尼人？我也许会被说服改变投票支持你，但你需要先为我做一个小任务。

english: How did I know it wouldn't be that simple for your vote?
translation: 我就知道你的投票不会那么简单。

english: Calm yourself outerlander. It is but a small task really... I simply require a flower.
translation: 冷静点，外地人。其实只是个小任务……我只需要一朵花。

english: A flower? What's the catch?
translation: 一朵花？有什么陷阱？

english: The catch? Well... it is not just any flower. Someone in this town has an extremely rare flower from a far off land that they picked up on their travels.
translation: 陷阱？嗯……这不是普通的花。这个镇子里有人有一朵从遥远地方获得的极其稀有的花朵，是他们旅行时得到的。

english: I would like you to demonstrate your merchanting skills to me, by persuading them to part with it, and then give it to me for my vote.
translation: 我希望你向我展示你的经商技巧，说服他们放弃那朵花，然后把它给我，换取我的投票。

english: Well... I guess that doesn't sound too hard...
translation: 嗯……我想听起来不算太难……

english: Excellent! You will obtain this rare flower for me then?
translation: 太好了！那么你会为我弄到这朵稀有花朵？

english: Okay. I don't think this will be too difficult. Any suggestions on where to start looking for this flower?
translation: 好的。我觉得这不会太难。有什么建议从哪里开始找这朵花吗？

english: Ah, well outerlander, if I knew where to start looking I would simply do it myself!
translation: 啊，嗯，外地人，如果我知道从哪里开始找，我自己就去了！

english: No help at ALL?
translation: 一点帮助都没有？

english: We are a very insular clan, so I would not expect you to have to leave this town to find whatever you need.
translation: 我们是一个非常封闭的部族，所以我不认为你需要离开这个镇子去找你需要的东西。

english: You know what? No. This all sounds like a lot of hassle to me, and frankly I just can't be bothered with it right now.
translation: 你知道吗？不。这一切听起来太麻烦了，坦白说我现在不想费心。

english: I'll go get someone else to vote for me.
translation: 我去找别人投票给我。

english: As you wish outerlander. If you change your mind, come and see me again; I am very interested in getting my hands on that flower.
translation: 随你便，外地人。如果你改变主意，再来找我；我对得到那朵花很感兴趣。

english: So... how goes it outerlander? Did you manage to obtain my flower for me yet? Or do you lack the necessary merchanting skills?
translation: 那么……进展如何，外地人？你成功为我弄到花了吗？还是你缺乏必要的经商技巧？

english: I'm still working on it... Do you have any suggestion where to start looking for it?
translation: 我还在努力……你有什么建议从哪里开始找吗？

english: I suggest you ask around the other Fremennik in the town. A good merchant will find exactly what their customer needs somewhere.
translation: 我建议你问问镇子里其他的弗瑞曼尼人。一个好商人总能在某处找到顾客需要的东西。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a rare flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: 我想你不知道我在哪里能找到一朵海外的稀有花朵，对吧？

english: Nope, sorry buddy!
translation: 不，抱歉伙计！

english: I wouldn't know about that, outerlander.
translation: 我不知道那个，外地人。

english: Greetings again outerlander! How goes your attempts to gain votes with the council of elders?
translation: 又见面了，外地人！你争取长老会投票的尝试进展如何？

english: Not really my affair, outerlander.
translation: 不关我的事，外地人。

english: I'm sorry, no I don't.
translation: 抱歉，我不知道。

english: Not in the slightest.
translation: 一点也不知道。

english: I never saw anything like that in my store before.
translation: 我以前从未在我的店里见过那样的东西。

english: I'm afraid not, outerlander.
translation: 恐怕没有，外地人。

english: No... sorry, I don't.
translation: 不……抱歉，我不知道。

english: I have not the first idea about that.
translation: 我对此一无所知。

english: Greetings outerlander.
translation: 你好，外地人。

english: No idea at all outerlander.
translation: 完全不知道，外地人。

english: Ah! Even the outerlanders have heard of my mysterious flower! I found it in a country far far away from here!
translation: 啊！连外地人都听说过我神秘的花！我在一个离这里非常非常远的国家找到的！

english: Can I buy it from you?
translation: 我能从你这里买吗？

english: I'm afraid not, outerlander. There is a woman in this village whose heart I seek to capture, and I think giving her this strange flower might be my best bet with her.
translation: 恐怕不行，外地人。这个村子里有个女人，我想赢得她的心，我觉得送她这朵奇怪的花可能是最好的办法。

english: Maybe you could let me have the flower and do something else to impress her?
translation: 也许你可以把花给我，然后做点别的事来打动她？

english: Hmm... that is not a totally stupid idea outerlander. I know she is a lover of music, and a romantic ballad might be just the thing with which to woo her.
translation: 嗯……这倒不是个完全愚蠢的主意，外地人。我知道她热爱音乐，一首浪漫的歌谣也许正是打动她的东西。

english: Unfortunately I don't have a musical bone in my entire body, so someone else will have to write it for me.
translation: 不幸的是，我全身上下没有一丁点音乐细胞，所以得找别人帮我写。

english: So if I can find someone to write you a romantic ballad, you will give me your flower?
translation: 那么，如果我能找人给你写一首浪漫的歌谣，你就把花给我？

english: That sounds like a fair deal to me, outerlander.
translation: 听起来很公平，外地人。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a love ballad, do you?
translation: 我想你大概不知道哪里能找到一首爱情歌谣吧？

english: Well, as official Fremennik bard, it falls within my remit to compose all music for the tribe. I am fully versed in all the various types of romantic music.
translation: 嗯，作为正式的弗雷门尼克吟游诗人，为部落创作所有音乐是我的职责。我对各种类型的浪漫音乐都了如指掌。

english: Great! Can you write me one then?
translation: 太好了！那你能帮我写一首吗？

english: Well... normally I would be thrilled at the chance to show my skill as a poet in composing a seductively romantic ballad...
translation: 嗯……通常来说，有机会展示我作为诗人创作一首诱人浪漫歌谣的才华，我会非常兴奋……

english: let me guess; here comes the 'but'.
translation: 让我猜猜，接下来要说'但是'了。

english: ...but unfortunately I cannot concentrate fully upon my work recently.
translation: ……但不幸的是，我最近无法完全集中精力工作。

english: Why is that then?
translation: 那是为什么？

english: It is these old worn out shoes of mine... As a bard I am expected to wander the lands, singing of the glorious battles of our warriors.
translation: 都是因为这双破旧的鞋子……作为吟游诗人，我本应四处游历，歌颂我们战士的光荣战斗。

english: If you can find me a pair of sturdy boots to replace these old worn out ones of mine, I will be happy to spend the time on composing you a romantic ballad.
translation: 如果你能给我找一双结实的靴子来替换我这双破旧的，我就乐意花时间为你创作一首浪漫的歌谣。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find some custom sturdy boots, do you?
translation: 我想你大概不知道哪里能找到定制结实的靴子吧？

english: Well, I don't usually have many shoes in stock here in my little clothes shop... I will be able to make you up a pair if you are really desperate though?
translation: 嗯，我这个小衣服店里通常不会备很多鞋子……不过如果你真的很急，我可以给你做一双？

english: They're not for me... I need them for Olaf.
translation: 不是给我穿的……我是给奥拉夫要的。

english: Oh, that foolish bard... Why didn't he just ask me to make him some? It is his stupid pride, I believe!
translation: 哦，那个傻吟游诗人……他为什么不直接让我给他做一双？我觉得是他那愚蠢的自尊心作祟！

english: I will tell you what I will do outerlander; I know that you must have the ear of the chieftain for him to consider you as worthy of becoming a Fremennik by trial.
translation: 我跟你说说我要怎么做，外地人；我知道你肯定得到了酋长的赏识，他才会考虑让你通过试炼成为弗雷门尼克人。

english: I will make you a pair of sturdy boots for Olaf if you will persuade him to reduce the sales tax placed upon all Fremennik shopkeepers. It does nothing but hurt my business now.
translation: 如果你能说服他降低对所有弗雷门尼克店主征收的销售税，我就给奥拉夫做一双结实的靴子。这税现在只会损害我的生意。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a guarantee of a reduction on sales taxes, do you?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到降低销售税的保证？

english: Yes I do outerlander. Only the Chieftain may permit such a thing. Talk to him.
translation: 我知道，外地人。只有酋长才能允许这种事。去跟他谈谈。

english: A reduction on sales taxes? Why, I am the only one in the Fremennik who may authorise such a thing. What does an outerlander want with that?
translation: 降低销售税？怎么，我是弗雷门尼克人中唯一有权批准这种事的人。一个外地人要这个做什么？

english: Actually, it's not for me. I need to get it as part of my trials.
translation: 其实，不是给我自己。这是我试炼的一部分。

english: Hmmm. Interesting. Your trials seem to be very different to those I took as a young lad. Well, I am not adverse in principle to giving a slight tax break to our shops.
translation: 嗯，有意思。你的试炼似乎和我年轻时经历的非常不同。好吧，原则上我不反对给我们的商店一点税收减免。

english: There will of course be a shortfall in the tribe's income, that will need to be made up for elsewhere, however.
translation: 当然，部落的收入会出现缺口，需要从别处弥补。

english: How about this. For many years Sigli has been the only one in the tribe who knows the locations of the best hunting grounds where game is easiest to catch.
translation: 这样吧。多年来，西格利一直是部落中唯一知道最佳狩猎地点的人，那里猎物最容易捕获。

english: If you can persuade him to let the entire tribe know these hunting grounds, then we can increase productivity within the tribe, and any shortfall caused
translation: 如果你能说服他让整个部落都知道这些狩猎地点，那么我们就能提高部落的生产力，任何因降低销售税造成的缺口

english: by lowering sales taxes will be covered. I think this is a more than fair arrangement to make, don't you?
translation: 都能得到弥补。我认为这是一个非常公平的安排，你觉得呢？

english: Yeah, that sounds very fair.
translation: 是的，听起来很公平。

english: Speak to Sigli then, and you may have my promise to reduce our sales taxes. And best of luck with the rest of your trials.
translation: 那就去跟西格利说吧，然后我就答应降低销售税。祝你接下来的试炼好运。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map to unspoiled hunting grounds, do you?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到一张未开发狩猎地点的地图？

english: Well, of course I do. I wouldn't be much of a huntsman if I didn't know where to find my prey now, would I outerlander?
translation: 嗯，我当然知道。如果我不知道去哪里找猎物，那我还算什么猎人，对吧，外地人？

english: No, I guess not. So can I have it?
translation: 不，我想也是。那我能要吗？

english: Directions to my hunting grounds could mean the end of my livelihood. The only way I would be prepared to give them up would be...
translation: 把我狩猎地点的指示牌给你，可能意味着我生计的终结。我唯一愿意放弃它们的条件是……

english: What? Power? Money? Women? Wine?
translation: 什么？权力？金钱？女人？美酒？

english: ...a new string for my hunting bow. Not just any bowstring; I need a custom bowstring, balanced for my bow precisely to keep my hunt competitive.
translation: ……给我的猎弓换一根新弦。不是随便什么弓弦；我需要一根定制的弓弦，精确平衡我的弓，以保持我的狩猎竞技水平。

english: Only in this way would I allow the knowledge of my hunting grounds to be passed on to strangers.
translation: 只有这样，我才会允许将狩猎地点的知识传给陌生人。

english: So where would I get that?
translation: 那我去哪里弄到呢？

english: I have no idea. But then again, I'm happy with my old bowstring and being the only person who knows where my hunting ground is.
translation: 我不知道。不过话说回来，我对自己的旧弓弦很满意，而且我是唯一知道狩猎地点的人。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a finely balanced custom bowstring, do you?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到一根精心平衡的定制弓弦？

english: Aye, I have a few in stock. What would an outerlander be wanting with equipment like that?
translation: 啊，我库存里有几根。一个外地人要这种装备做什么？

english: It's for Sigli. It needs to be weighted precisely to suit his hunting bow.
translation: 是给西格利的。需要精确配重以适合他的猎弓。

english: For Sigli eh? Well, I made his bow in the first place, so I'll be able to select the right string for you... just one small problem.
translation: 给西格利，嗯？好吧，他的弓最初就是我做的，所以我能帮你选对弦……只是一个小问题。

english: This string you'll be wanting... Very rare. Take a lot of time to recreate. Not sure you have the cash for it.
translation: 你要的这根弦……非常稀有。重新制作需要很长时间。我不确定你付得起钱。

english: Then maybe you'll accept something else...?
translation: 那你也许愿意接受别的东西……？

english: Heh. Good thinking outerlander. Well, it's true, there is more to life than just making money. Making weapons is good money, but it's not why I do it.
translation: 嘿，好主意，外地人。嗯，确实，生活中除了赚钱还有更多东西。制造武器能赚不少钱，但那不是我干这行的原因。

english: I'll tell you what. I heard a rumour that one of the fishermen down by the docks caught some weird looking fish as they were fishing the other day.
translation: 我跟你说吧。我听说码头那边有个渔夫前几天钓鱼时钓到了一条奇怪的鱼。

english: From what I hear this fish is unique. Nobody's ever seen its like before. This intrigues me. I'd like to have it for myself. Make a good trophy.
translation: 据我所知，这条鱼是独一无二的。从来没人见过类似的。这让我很感兴趣。我想把它弄到手，做个好 trophy。

english: You get me that fish, I give you the bowstring. What do you say? We got a deal?
translation: 你给我弄到那条鱼，我就给你弓弦。怎么样？成交？

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find an exotic and extremely rare fish, do you?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到一条奇特且极其稀有的鱼？

english: What? There's another one?
translation: 什么？还有一条？

english: Er... no, it's the one for you that I'm looking for...
translation: 呃……不，我找的就是给你的那条……

english: Ah. I see. I already told you. Some guy down by the docks was bragging. Best ask there, I reckon.
translation: 啊，我明白了。我已经告诉过你了。码头那边有个家伙在吹牛。最好去那里问问，我想。

english: Ah, so even outerlanders have heard of my amazing catch the other day!
translation: 啊，连外地人都听说我那天惊人的收获了！

english: You have it? Can I trade you something for it?
translation: 你拿着它？我能拿东西跟你换吗？

english: As exotic looking as it is, it is bad eating. I will happily trade it if you can find me the secret map of the best fishing spots that the navigator has hidden away.
translation: 虽然它看起来奇特，但不好吃。如果你能帮我找到领航员藏起来的最佳钓鱼地点秘密地图，我很乐意跟你交换。

english: Indeed it is, outerlander. The only reason I sit out here in the cold all day long is so I don't have to pay his outrageous prices.
translation: 确实如此，外地人。我整天坐在这寒冷里的唯一原因，就是不想付他那离谱的价格。

english: By getting me his copy of that map, I will finally be self sufficient. I might even make a profit!
translation: 帮我弄到他那份地图，我就能自给自足了。说不定还能赚一笔！

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a map of deep sea fishing spots do you?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到一张深海钓鱼地点的地图？

english: You should pay attention when I speak! I already told you, that rip off navigator has it, and I want it!
translation: 我说话的时候你应该注意听！我已经告诉过你了，那个宰客的领航员拿着它，我想要！

english: Hmmm? Why of course! As the navigator for the Fremennik I keep all of our maps secure right here.
translation: 嗯？当然！作为弗雷门尼克的领航员，我们所有的地图都安全地保存在我这里。

english: Great! Can I have it?
translation: 太好了！能给我吗？

english: Have it? Just like that? I think not outerlander. This map shows all of the prime fishing locations nearby.
translation: 给你？就这么简单？我觉得不行，外地人。这张地图显示了附近所有主要的钓鱼地点。

english: It is very valuable to our clan. I am afraid I can not just give it away.
translation: 对我们部落来说非常宝贵。恐怕我不能就这么送出去。

english: Perhaps I can trade you something for it?
translation: 也许我能拿东西跟你交换？

english: A trade? For a map of the best fishing spots in a hundred leagues? I will trade it for no less than a weather forecast from our Seer.
translation: 交换？换一张方圆百里最佳钓鱼地点的地图？除非用我们先知的天气预报来换，否则免谈。

english: As a navigator, the weather is extremely important for plotting the best course. Unfortunately the Seer is always too busy to help me with a forecast.
translation: 作为领航员，天气对于规划最佳航线极其重要。不幸的是，先知总是太忙，没空帮我做预报。

english: Where could I get a weather forecast from then?
translation: 那我从哪里能得到天气预报呢？

english: I just told you: from the Seer. You will need to persuade him to take the time to make a forecast somehow.
translation: 我刚告诉你了：从先知那里。你得想办法说服他花时间做个预报。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a weather forecast from the Fremennik Seer do you?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到弗雷门尼克先知的天气预报？

english: Uh... from the Seer perhaps?
translation: 呃……也许从先知那里？

english: Er.... Yes, because I AM the Fremennik Seer.
translation: 呃……是的，因为我就是弗雷门尼克先知。

english: Can I have a weather forecast then please?
translation: 那能给我一个天气预报吗？

english: You require a divination of the weather? This is a simple matter for me, but I will require something in return from you for this small service.
translation: 你需要占卜天气？这对我来说是小事一桩，但你需要为这项小服务给我点回报。

english: I knew you were going to say that...
translation: 我就知道你会这么说……

english: Do not fret, outerlander; it is a fairly simple matter. I require a bodyguard for protection. Find someone willing to offer me this service.
translation: 别担心，外地人；事情相当简单。我需要一个保镖来保护我。找个愿意提供这项服务的人。

english: That's all?
translation: 就这些？

english: That is all.
translation: 就这些。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a brave and powerful warrior to act as a bodyguard?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到一个勇敢而强大的战士来当保镖？

english: If I did, then I would simply have asked them myself now, wouldn't I, outerlander?
translation: 如果我知道，我早就直接去问他们了，对吧，外地人？

english: Know you not who I am outerlander? There are none more brave or powerful than me amongst all the Fremennik!
translation: 你不知道我是谁吗，外地人？在所有弗雷门尼克人中，没有比我更勇敢或更强大的了！

english: However... The role of bodyguard is below me, as a noble warrior. You might as well ask me to babysit the children!
translation: 不过……当保镖对我来说太掉价了，我可是高贵的战士。你还不如让我去照看孩子呢！

english: Is there no way you would do this for me?
translation: 难道就没有办法让你为我做这件事吗？

english: There is but one way outerlander. Since I was steeled in battle, I have dreamt of earning my place at the Champions Table in the Long Hall.
translation: 只有一个办法，外来者。自从我在战斗中历练之后，我就梦想着在长厅的冠军餐桌赢得一席之地。

english: It is a tradition amongst us that the bravest and strongest are honoured with a table of champions to drink and feast all that they can in our Long Hall.
translation: 这是我们之间的传统：最勇敢、最强壮的人会获得一张冠军餐桌的荣誉，可以在我们的长厅里尽情畅饮和享用盛宴。

english: Unfortunately, there are only a fixed number of places available at the table, and these places were all filled many moons ago by others.
translation: 不幸的是，桌子上的位置是固定的，而且这些位置早在很久以前就被别人占满了。

english: Although my worthiness is undeniable, the only way I may take my place is if one of those already there die, or give up their place to me voluntarily.
translation: 虽然我的资格无可否认，但我唯一能就座的方式是，如果其中一个人死了，或者自愿把位置让给我。

english: So you want me to go kill one of them off for you? Make it look like an accident?
translation: 所以你想让我去帮你干掉其中一个？弄成意外事故？

english: WHAT? No, no, not at all! I am shocked you would suggest such a thing!
translation: 什么？不，不，完全不是！你竟然会提出这种建议，真让我震惊！

english: If you can persuade one of the Revellers to give up their Champions' Token to you so that I might take their place, you may have my contract as a bodyguard.
translation: 如果你能说服一个狂欢者把他们的冠军代币给你，这样我就能取代他们的位置，那么你就可以得到我作为保镖的契约。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a Champions' Token?
translation: 你知不知道我能在哪里找到冠军代币？

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a token to allow a seat at the champions table, do you?
translation: 我想你大概不知道哪里可以找到允许在冠军餐桌入座的代币，对吧？

english: As a matter of fact, I do. I have one right here. I earnt my place here at the longhall for surviving over 5000 battles and raiding parties.
translation: 事实上，我知道。我这里就有一个。我通过在超过5000场战斗和突袭中幸存下来，赢得了在长厅的席位。

english: Due to my contribution to the tribe, I am now permitted to spend my days here in the longhall listening to the epic tales of the bard, and drinking beer.
translation: 由于我对部落的贡献，我现在可以整天待在长厅里，听吟游诗人讲述史诗故事，喝啤酒。

english: Cool. That sounds pretty sweet! So I guess you don't want to give it away?
translation: 酷。听起来相当不错！所以我想你不想把它送人？

english: I think it sounds better than it actually is outerlander. I miss my glory days of combat on the battlefield. And to tell you the truth, the beer here isn't great, and the bards' music is lousy.
translation: 我觉得实际听起来比这更好，外地人。我怀念在战场上战斗的光辉岁月。说实话，这里的啤酒不怎么样，吟游诗人的音乐也很糟糕。

english: I would happily give up my token if it were not for the one thing that keeps me here. Our barkeep is one of the best in the world, and has worked in taverns across the land.
translation: 如果不是因为一件事让我留在这里，我很乐意放弃我的代币。我们的酒保是世界上最好的之一，他曾在各地的酒馆工作过。

english: When she was younger, she experimented a lot with her drinks, and invented a cocktail so alcoholic and tasty that it has become something of a legend to all who enjoy a drink.
translation: 她年轻的时候，经常拿各种饮料做实验，发明了一种鸡尾酒，酒精浓度高又美味，让所有爱喝酒的人都视其为传奇。

english: Unfortunately, she decided that cocktails were not a suitable drink for Fremennik warriors, and vowed to never again make it.
translation: 可惜，她后来觉得鸡尾酒不适合弗瑞曼尼克的战士喝，就发誓再也不会调了。

english: I have been here every day since she returned, hoping that someday she might change her mind and I might try this legendary cocktail for myself. Alas, it has never come to pass...
translation: 她回来之后，我每天都来这里，就盼着她哪天能改变主意，让我尝尝这杯传奇鸡尾酒。唉，一直没等到……

english: If you can persuade her to make me her legendary cocktail, I will be happy to never let another drop of alcohol pass my lips, and will give you my champions token.
translation: 如果你能说服她给我调一杯传奇鸡尾酒，我乐意从此滴酒不沾，而且把我的冠军代币送给你。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find the longhall barkeeps' legendary cocktail, do you?
translation: 你知不知道我上哪儿能找到长厅酒保的传奇鸡尾酒？

english: Uh... yes, the longhall barkeep has it. So could you get me my drink now please?
translation: 呃……对，长厅酒保有。那你能给我那杯酒了吗？

english: How did you hear about that?!?!?
translation: 你怎么会知道那个？！？！

english: I didn't think anybody knew about that... Well, it is true that in my younger years as a barkeep, I wandered the lands trying various alcoholic delicacies.
translation: 我还以为没人知道那件事呢……没错，我年轻时当酒保，四处游历尝遍了各种美酒。

english: Did you ever realise just how many different types of alcohol there are here in Gielinor? Lots!
translation: 你知道吉莉诺到底有多少种不同的酒吗？可多了！

english: Well, anyway, I used a fusion of various drinks from all around the world to create the greatest cocktail ever made!
translation: 反正，我把世界各地的酒混在一起，调出了有史以来最棒的鸡尾酒！

english: Of course, when my wanderlust was gone, and I returned back to Rellekka to serve as barkeep here, I gave all that up.
translation: 当然，等我的旅行瘾过去了，回到雷勒卡城当酒保后，我就全放下了。

english: But you still remember how to make it, right?
translation: 可你还记得怎么做对吧？

english: And you have all the ingredients here? I don't need to go chasing round the world for obscure ingredients to make it?
translation: 而且你这里所有材料都有？不用我满世界找那些稀奇古怪的原料吧？

english: No, I have them all here. Why?
translation: 不用，我这儿全有。怎么了？

english: Can you make me your legendary cocktail then?
translation: 那你能给我调一杯传奇鸡尾酒吗？

english: I would rather not; it is a reminder of a life I left behind when I came back.
translation: 我不太想调；它会让我想起回来之后抛下的那段生活。

english: Any way I could change your mind?
translation: 有什么办法能让你改变主意吗？

english: You need this to become a Fremennik, right? Well, you seem okay for an outerlander, it would be a shame to see you fail. You know Askeladden?
translation: 你需要这个才能成为弗瑞曼尼克人，对吧？嗯，你看起来还算不错，比一般的外乡人强，看你失败也挺可惜的。你认识阿斯卡拉登吗？

english: That kid outside? Sure.
translation: 外面那个小鬼？当然认识。

english: He is nothing but a pest. He keeps sneaking in and stealing beer. I shudder to think what he will be like when he has passed his trial of manhood,
translation: 他就是个讨厌鬼。老是偷偷溜进来偷啤酒。我都不知道他成年试炼通过之后会变成什么样，

english: and is allowed in here legitimately. If you can get him to sign a contract promising that he will NEVER EVER EVER darken my doorway here again, you get the drink.
translation: 到时候他就能光明正大地进来了。如果你能让他签一份保证书，承诺他永远永远永远不再踏进我的门口，我就给你调这杯酒。

english: Any idea how I can get him to do that?
translation: 你知道怎么让他答应吗？

english: Knowing that little horror, he'll probably be willing to in exchange for some cash. You should go ask him yourself though.
translation: 就那个小坏蛋，估计给点钱他就愿意了。不过你还是自己去问他吧。

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a written promise from Askeladden to stay out of the Longhall?
translation: 你知道我上哪儿能找到阿斯卡拉登写的保证书，保证他不进长厅吗？

english: Well, as I say, you should talk to him about that. Knowing the little runt as I do though He'll probably do it for the cash.
translation: 嗯，我说了，你得自己去跟他说。不过以我对那小子的了解，他多半会为了钱答应的。

english: What? I can't believe she asked you to get a written promise from me to stay out!
translation: 什么？她居然要你从我这里弄一份书面保证，保证我不进去？

english: Yup, she really did.
translation: 没错，她就是这么说的。

english: Awwwwwww.... but the longhall is just SO MUCH FUN! I'd live there if I could! I suppose you really need that promise to help become a Fremennik, huh?
translation: 啊啊啊啊……可是长厅实在是太好玩了！要是我能住那儿，我肯定住！我猜你真的需要那份保证来成为弗瑞曼尼克人，对吧？

english: Yeah, I really do...
translation: 是啊，真的需要……

english: Well I'll tell you what buddy; As it's you, I'll give you that written promise. All I ask in return for it is a measly 5000 gold. What do you say?
translation: 那好，我告诉你，哥们儿；看在你的份上，我给你那份书面保证。我只要五千金币作为交换。你觉得怎么样？

english: That's all you want in return? Sure thing. Here you go.
translation: 就只要这个？没问题。给你。

english: ...how embarrassing. I appear to be short...
translation: ……真尴尬。我好像钱不够……

english: Trying to scam me, huh buddy? Well it won't work! You come back with the cash, or don't come back at all!
translation: 想骗我，是吧哥们儿？没门！你带够了钱再来，不然就别回来了！

english: Done, and done. Let me know if you got any more cash burning a hole in your pocket I can relieve you of, buddy.
translation: 搞定了，都搞定了。如果你还有现金烧口袋想让我帮你花掉，随时告诉我，伙计。

english: I don't think so... That's really quite a lot of money...
translation: 我才不要呢……那可是一大笔钱……

english: Hey, suit yourself buddy. You change your mind, the bank of Askeladden is open for deposits 24 hours a day! Eh-heh-heh-heh-heh.
translation: 嘿，随你便。改主意了，阿斯卡拉登银行二十四小时营业，随时接受存款！呃嘿嘿嘿嘿。

english: I thought you really liked the long hall?
translation: 我以为你真的很喜欢长厅？

english: Then why did you sign this guarantee that you will never enter it again?
translation: 那你为什么签了这份保证书，保证再也不进去？

english: Aha! It is because I am cunning! That guarantee says that Askeladden will never enter the longhall again! But when I have completed my Fremennik trials,
translation: 啊哈！因为我狡猾啊！那份保证书上写的是阿斯卡拉登再也不进长厅！可等我完成弗瑞曼尼克的试炼，

english: and passed my trial of manhood, I will be given a new name, as is our custom, and will therefore not be Askeladden anymore! That guarantee isn't worth the paper it's written on!!
translation: 通过成年试炼之后，按照习俗我会获得一个新名字，到时候我就不再是阿斯卡拉登了！那张保证书连写它的纸都不如！！

english: You didn't think I would give up going to the longhall for only 5000 did you?
translation: 你该不会以为我为了五千金币就放弃去长厅吧？

english: Sure thing buddy, but it doesn't look like you got the room to take one from me!
translation: 没问题哥们，不过看起来你身上可没地方装我给你的东西！

english: Knowing you, I guess I didn't.
translation: 以我对你的了解，大概猜到了。

english: Hi! Can I please have one of your legendary cocktails now?
translation: 嗨！我现在能要一杯你的传奇鸡尾酒了吗？

english: What?!?! I can't believe you... Let me look at that... Askeladden would NEVER... Gosh. It looks legitimate.
translation: 什么？！我简直不敢相信……让我看看那个……阿斯卡拉登绝对不会……天哪。看起来是真的。

english: Here you go, on the house! You have made my life SO much easier! Knowing that little monster won't be bugging me in here all the time anymore!
translation: 给你，我请客！你让我的生活轻松多了！知道那个小怪物不会再整天来烦我了！

english: That little weasel will have to abide by this written promise that Askeladden can never ever enter the Longhall again! He can't get round this one!
translation: 那只小黄鼠狼必须遵守这份书面保证，阿斯卡拉登永远不能再踏进长厅！这次他可躲不过去了！

english: Uh... yeah... yeah, you probably won't see someone called Askeladden coming in here...
translation: 呃……对……对，你大概不会再看见一个叫阿斯卡拉登的人进来了……

english: Thanks for making me this cocktail. Why don't you make them anymore normally?
translation: 谢谢你给我调了这杯鸡尾酒。为什么你平常不做了呢？

english: Ah... when I gave up my travels across the world many years back, to return to my expected role as longhall barkeep, as my mother, and her mother, were before me,
translation: 啊……多年前我放弃了环游世界的旅行，回到这里承担长厅酒保的职责，就像我母亲和她母亲之前一样，

english: I gave up a lot of the freedom I had found in the outside world. I know it is our custom to shun outerlanders and their ways, but I didn't find them as bad as the stories say.
translation: 我放弃了在外面世界找到的许多自由。我知道我们的习俗是排斥外乡人和他们的生活方式，但我发现他们并不像传说中那么坏。

english: Sometimes I feel as though we Fremennik live in a prison that we have constructed for ourselves, and that WE are the outerlanders, out here on the edge of the world...
translation: 有时候我觉得我们弗瑞曼尼克人像是活在自己建造的监狱里，而我们自己才是外乡人，待在世界边缘……

english: I'm sorry, I think it is part of the job of Longhall barkeep to get philosophical about things ocassionally. I wish you all the best of luck with your trials, outerlander.
translation: 抱歉，我想长厅酒保这工作有时候就是会让人爱说些大道理。祝你试炼一切顺利，外乡人。

english: When you have finished, perhaps you will come back here, and we can share a drink over tales of the outside world?
translation: 等你完成了，也许可以回到这里，我们一边喝酒一边聊聊外面的世界？

english: Thanks, I'd like that.
translation: 谢谢，我很乐意。

english: Hey. I got your cocktail for you.
translation: 嘿。我帮你弄到鸡尾酒了。

english: ...It is true! The legendary cocktail! I have waited for this day ever since I first started drinking!
translation: ……这是真的！传奇鸡尾酒！从我第一次喝酒那天起就在等这一天！

english: Here outerlander, you may take my token. I will happily give up my place at the longhalls table of champions just for a taste of this exquisite beverage!
translation: 给你，外来者，你可以拿走我的代币。我愿意放弃我在长厅冠军餐桌的位置，只为了尝一口这绝妙的饮料！

english: It's just a drink...
translation: 不就是一杯酒嘛……

english: No, it is an artform. A drink such as this should be appreciated, and admired. It is like a fine painting, or a tasteful sculpture.
translation: 不，这是一种艺术。这样的酒应该被欣赏、被赞美。就像一幅精美的画作，或是一件高雅的雕塑。

english: If what I hear is true, then all other drinks become like unpalatable water in comparison to this!
translation: 如果我听到的是真的，那么相比之下，其他所有酒都像难喝的水一样！

english: I guess you're happy with the trade then!
translation: 看来你对这笔交易很满意嘛！

english: So it doesn't bother you at all that you just gave up your place here for one drink?
translation: 你为了这一杯酒就放弃了在这里的位置，一点都不在意吗？

english: Ah, but it was not just any drink... It was the finest cocktail ever created! Now that I have tasted it, I need never drink again, for my tastebuds will never be so excited!
translation: 啊，但这可不是普通的酒……这是有史以来最棒的鸡尾酒！既然我尝过了，就再也不需要喝酒了，因为我的味蕾再也不会这么兴奋了！

english: So it was nice?
translation: 所以味道不错？

english: It was... exquisite!
translation: 简直是……绝妙！

english: What did it taste of, then?
translation: 那它是什么味道？

english: Mostly tomato juice.
translation: 主要是番茄汁味。

english: Hey outerlander! I don't take kindly to people coming here and stealing my beer!
translation: 嘿，外地人！我可不喜欢有人来这里偷我的啤酒！

english: Uh... call it a crazy hunch, but did you even try asking Askeladden about that?
translation: 呃……虽然只是疯狂的直觉，但你有没有试过去问问阿斯卡拉登？

english: The chief would know about that.
translation: 酋长应该知道那件事。

english: Thorvald is pretty handy with a sword...
translation: 索尔瓦尔德用剑很在行……

english: Did you talk to the hunter?
translation: 你和猎人谈过了吗？

english: I'd try at the fish stalls if I were you.
translation: 如果我是你，我会去鱼摊试试。

english: Did you even ask the seer?
translation: 你问过先知了吗？

english: Did you try speaking to the bard?
translation: 你试过和吟游诗人谈谈吗？

english: Did you try the clothes shop?
translation: 你去过衣服店吗？

english: I would like your contract to offer your services as a bodyguard.
translation: 我想要你那份提供保镖服务的合同。

english: Oh you would, would you outerlander? I have already told you, I will not demean myself with such a baby sitting job until I can sit in the Longhall with pride.
translation: 哦，你想要，是吗外乡人？我已经告诉过你了，在我能引以为傲地坐在长厅之前，我不会自贬身份去做这种保姆工作。

english: It's a good thing I have the Champions' Token right here then, isn't it?
translation: 幸好我这里正好有一枚冠军代币，不是吗？

english: Ah... well this is a different matter. With that token I can claim my rightful place as a champion in the Long hall!
translation: 啊……嗯，这就不同了。有了那个代币，我就能在长厅中宣称我作为冠军的应有位置！

english: Here outerlander, I can suffer the indignity of playing babysitter if it means that I can then revel with my warrior equals in the Long Hall afterwards!
translation: 给你，外来者，我可以忍受当临时保姆的屈辱，只要之后能在长厅里与我平等的战士们一起狂欢！

english: Here outerlander, take this contract; I will fulfill it to my utmost.
translation: 给你，外乡人，拿着这份合同；我会尽力履行它。

english: You didn't take much persuading to 'lower' yourself to a bodyguard.
translation: 你没费多少口舌就肯‘屈尊’当保镖了嘛。

english: You misunderstand, outerlander. Normally I will only battle for a noble cause, but have never been recognised as a true champion here.
translation: 你误会了，外乡人。平时我只为崇高的事业而战，但在这里从未被认可为真正的冠军。

english: With this Champion's token, I can stand alongside my warrior brethren in the Long Hall, and revel in the glories of past victories together!
translation: 有了这枚冠军代币，我就能与我的战士兄弟们并肩站在长厅中，共同追忆过去胜利的荣光！

english: Can I have a weather forecast now please?
translation: 现在能给我一份天气预报了吗？

english: I have already told you outerlander; You may have a reading from me when I have a signed contract from a warrior guaranteeing my protection.
translation: 我已经告诉过你了，外乡人；等我拿到一份由战士签署、保证保护我的合同，你才能从我这里得到预报。

english: Yeah, I know; I have one right here from Thorvald.
translation: 是啊，我知道；我这正好有一份，是托尔瓦尔德签的。

english: You have not only persuaded one of the Fremennik to act as a servant to me, but you have enlisted the aid of mighty Thorvald himself???
translation: 你不仅说服了一个弗瑞曼尼克人做我的仆从，还得到了强大的托尔瓦尔德本人的帮助？？？

english: You may take this forecast with my blessing outerlander. You have offered me the greatest security I can imagine.
translation: 你可以拿走这份预报，外乡人，带着我的祝福。你给了我我能想到的最大的保障。

english: So, about this forecast...
translation: 那么，关于这份预报……

english: Yes, outerlander?
translation: 怎么了，外乡人？

english: I still don't know why you didn't just let me have one anyway in the first place. Surely it means nothing to you?
translation: 我还是不明白为什么你一开始不让我直接拿一份。对你来说肯定不算什么吧？

english: That is not true, outerlander. Although I see glimpses of the future all of the time, using my powers brings the attention of the gods to me.
translation: 不是这样的，外乡人。虽然我总能瞥见未来的片段，但使用我的能力会引起众神的注意。

english: Some of the gods are spiteful and cruel, and I fear if I use my powers too much then I will meet with unpredictable accidents. This is why I needed protection.
translation: 有些神心怀怨恨且残忍，我担心如果使用能力过多，就会遭遇不可预测的意外。所以我需要保护。

english: Okay... I... think I understand...
translation: 好吧……我……我想我懂了……

english: I would like your map of fishing spots.
translation: 我想要你的钓鱼点地图。

english: I have already told you outerlander; I will not exchange it for anything other than a divination on the weather from our seer himself!
translation: 我已经告诉过你了，外乡人；除了用我们先知本人的天气占卜来交换，别的我一概不换！

english: What, like this one I have here?
translation: 什么，像我手里这张？

english: W-what...? I don't believe it! How did you...? I suppose it doesn't matter, you have my gratitude outerlander!
translation: 什——什么……？我真不敢相信！你是怎么……？不过这没关系，你得到了我的感激，外乡人！

english: With this forecast I will be able to plan a safe course for our next raiding expedition!
translation: 有了这份预报，我就能为下一次突袭远征规划安全的航程了！

english: Here, outerlander; you may take my map of local fishing patterns with my gratitude!
translation: 给你，外乡人；你可以拿走我的当地钓鱼规律地图，带着我的感激！

english: If this map of fishing spots is so valuable, why did you give it away to me so easily?
translation: 如果这张钓鱼点地图这么值钱，你为什么这么轻易就给了我？

english: Hmmm? Well, firstly it will be of value to our entire clan, so I have lost nothing from giving it to you.
translation: 嗯？首先，它对整个部族都有价值，所以我把它给你并没有损失什么。

english: The other reason is of course that I have already memorised it, so I can make myself another copy whenever I want!
translation: 另一个原因当然是我已经背下来了，所以随时都能再复制一份！

english: Here. I got you your map.
translation: 给。我给你弄到地图了。

english: Great work outerlander! With this, I can finally catch enough fish to make an honest living from it! Here, have the stupid rare fish.
translation: 干得好，外乡人！有了它，我终于能捕到足够的鱼，堂堂正正地谋生了！给你，拿着这条愚蠢的稀有鱼。

english: I don't see what's so special about this so called rare fish.
translation: 我不觉得这条所谓的稀有鱼有什么特别的。

english: Me neither, outerlander. That is why I gave it to you.
translation: 我也不觉得，外乡人。所以我才把它给你。

english: What do you want, outsider?
translation: 你想要什么，外来者？

english: Keep away human... Leave or face the deep blue...
translation: 离远点，人类……离开，否则面对深蓝色……

english: Only friends of Port Piscarilius are allowed to fish here.
translation: 只有皮斯卡里琉斯港的朋友才允许在这里钓鱼。

english: I'm telling you that I will never vote for you, you stupid outerlander.
translation: 我告诉你，我永远不会投票给你，你这愚蠢的外乡人。

english: You will all end up in the blue... Deep deep under the blue...
translation: 你们都会葬身蓝色……深深的海底……

english: Port Piscarilius have given me permission to catch anglerfish, this is the only place you can find them!
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯港允许我捕捉安康鱼，这是唯一能找到它们的地方！

english: I have heard good things about you, outsider. You will need a fishing rod and some sandworms to use as bait, if you need supplies, try Tynan's shoreside store.
translation: 我听说过你的好话，外来者。你需要一根鱼竿和一些沙虫作为鱼饵，如果需要补给品，去泰南的岸边商店看看。

english: Only friends of Port Piscarilius are allowed to know such things, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕只有皮斯卡里琉斯港的朋友才被允许知道这些事。

english: Hi there. I got your fish, so can I have that bowstring for Sigli now?
translation: 你好。我拿到了你的鱼，那我现在可以把弓弦给西格利了吗？

english: Ohh... That's a nice fish. Very pleased. Here. Take the bowstring. You fulfilled agreement. only fair I do same. Good work outerlander.
translation: 哦……这条鱼不错。很满意。给你。拿好弓弦。你履行了协议。我也该公平对待。干得好，外地人。

english: So about this bowstring... was it hard to make or something?
translation: 那这个弓弦……做起来很难吗？

english: Not hard. Just a trick to it. Takes skill to learn, but when learnt, easy. Sigli will be happy. Finest bowstring on continent. Will suit his needs perfectly.
translation: 不难。只是有点诀窍。需要技巧去学，但学会了就简单。西格利会高兴的。大陆上最好的弓弦。完全符合他的需求。

english: Here. I have your bowstring. Give me your map to the hunting grounds.
translation: 给你。我拿到了你的弓弦。把猎场地图给我。

english: Well met, outerlander. I see some hunting potential within you. Here, take my map, I was getting too dependent on it for my skill anyway.
translation: 幸会，外地人。我看你有些狩猎潜力。给你，拿我的地图吧，反正我太依赖它了，技能都退步了。

english: So you really don't mind giving this away to me?
translation: 你真的不介意把它给我？

english: No outerlander... it is hard to explain. That map makes my role as huntsman too easy. I fear my skills are becoming dulled. Now I must track my prey once more.
translation: 不，外地人……很难解释。那张地图让我的猎人工作太轻松了。我担心我的技能变得迟钝。现在我得重新追踪猎物了。

english: To begin again from scratch... I feel this may keep me sharp.
translation: 从头开始……我觉得这能让我保持敏锐。

english: I got Sigli's hunting map for you.
translation: 我帮你拿到了西格利的狩猎地图。

english: Excellent work outerlander! And so quickly, too! Here, you may take my financial report promising reduced sales taxes on all goods.
translation: 干得好，外地人！而且还这么快！给你，你可以拿走我的财务报告，承诺降低所有商品的销售税。

english: So cutting sales tax isn't going to ruin your economy here or anything?
translation: 那降低销售税不会毁了你们的经济什么的吗？

english: Not at all outerlander; now that we have Sigli's map we can increase the amount of hunts we run, and make up any shortfall that way.
translation: 完全不会，外地人；既然我们有了西格利的地图，我们可以增加狩猎次数，用那来弥补任何短缺。

english: Hello. Can I have those boots now? Here is a written statement from Brundt outlining future tax burdens upon Fremennik merchants and shopkeepers for the year.
translation: 你好。我现在能拿那双靴子了吗？这是布伦特写的声明，概述了今年费明尼克商人和店主未来的税收负担。

english: Certainly! Let me have a look at what he has written here, just give me a moment...
translation: 当然！让我看看他写了什么，稍等一下……

english: Yes, that all appears in order. Tell Olaf to come to me next time for shoes!
translation: 是的，一切看起来都没问题。告诉奥拉夫下次做鞋子直接来找我！

english: Hey, these shoes look pretty comfy. Think you could make me a pair like them?
translation: 嘿，这双鞋子看起来很舒服。你能给我做一双像这样的吗？

english: Maybe if you pass your trial and become a full fledged member of the Fremennik...
translation: 也许等你通过试炼，成为费明尼克的正式成员之后……

english: It costs 500 coins to change your shoe colour. Just select what colour you would like from this catalogue, and then give me the 500 gold when you've picked.
translation: 改变鞋子颜色需要500金币。从这本目录中选择你喜欢的颜色，然后选好后给我500金币即可。

english: Sorry! It costs 500 coins to change your shoe colour and you don't have that much on you.
translation: 抱歉！改变鞋子颜色需要500金币，但你身上没带那么多。

english: No, sorry, I'm not. Best look elsewhere outerlander.
translation: 不，抱歉，我不是。最好去别处找找吧，外地人。

english: That's ok! Just come back when you do have it!
translation: 没关系！等你有了再来吧！

english: Hello Olaf. Do you have a beautiful love song written for me?
translation: 你好，奥拉夫。你为我写了一首优美的情歌吗？

english: That depends outerlander... Do you have some new boots for me? My feet get so tired roaming the land...
translation: 那要看情况，外地人……你有新靴子给我吗？我的脚在四处游荡时太累了……

english: As a matter of fact - I do!
translation: 事实上——我有！

english: Oh! Superb! Those are great! They're just what I was looking for! Here, take this song with my compliments! It is one of my finest works yet!
translation: 哦！太棒了！这些太棒了！正是我想要的！给你，收下这首歌，算是我的一点心意！这是我至今最好的作品之一！

english: So you think this song is pretty good then?
translation: 那你觉得这首歌很不错咯？

english: Ahhh.... outerlander... it is the most beautiful romantic ballad I have ever been inspired to write...
translation: 啊……外地人……这是我灵感所写的最美的浪漫歌谣……

english: Only a woman with a heart of icy stone could fail to be moved by its beauty!
translation: 只有心如冰石的女人才不会被它的美丽打动！

english: Wow! That was awesome! You are one of the greatest bards I have ever had the pleasure of watching performing!
translation: 哇！太棒了！你是我有幸观看过表演的最伟大的吟游诗人之一！

english: You have certainly earned my vote! I hope we can duet together soon!
translation: 你绝对赢得了我的选票！希望我们很快能一起二重唱！

english: Ah, it but a small thing outerlander. Simply make yourself an instrument, get the blessing of Fossegrimen, and then sing your own ballad at the longhall.
translation: 啊，这只是小事一桩，外地人。你只需要自己做一件乐器，得到福塞格里门的祝福，然后在长厅唱你自己的歌谣就行了。

english: I'm sorry outerlander... If I did, I would not trouble you to go and find them for me, would I?
translation: 对不起，外地人……如果我知道的话，我就不会麻烦你替我去找它们了，对吧？

english: Only a woman with a heart of icey stone could fail to be moved by its beauty!
translation: 只有心如冰石的女人才不会被它的美丽打动！

english: Unfortunately the Music Cape is only available with a free hood. So you'll need to free up some inventory space before I can sell you one.
translation: 不幸的是，音乐斗篷只能搭配免费的兜帽出售。所以你需要腾出一些背包空间，我才能卖给你一件。

english: Hello again to you [player name] Drapare. Us bards should stick together, what?
translation: 又见面了，[player name] 德拉帕雷。我们吟游诗人应该团结一致，对吧？

english: I'm sure it would, [player name] Drapare. Now, do you want to hear the song?
translation: 我相信会的，[player name] 德拉帕雷。那么，你想听这首歌吗？

english: Yes, of course. Luckily I keep a supply of them handy for people who lose theirs. Next time make sure you have some free inventory or bank slots available.
translation: 是的，当然。幸运的是，我备了一些存货，给那些弄丢的人。下次确保你有一些空的背包或银行格子。

english: Huh? I know you haven't lost your it! Stop wasting my time and go and look for it properly!
translation: 嗯？我知道你没有弄丢你的东西！别浪费我的时间，好好去找找！

english: Thanks! That sounds perfect!
translation: 谢谢！听起来完美！

english: You'll be glad to know I have had a love song written just for you by Olaf. So can I have that flower of yours now?
translation: 你会很高兴知道，我让奥拉夫为你写了一首情歌。那我现在能拿你的那朵花了吗？

english: Oh. It's by Olaf? Hmm. Well, a deal's a deal. I just hope it's better than the usual rubbish he comes up with, or my chances are worse than ever.
translation: 哦。是奥拉夫写的？嗯。好吧，交易就是交易。我只希望这比他平时写的垃圾好，否则我的机会比以往更糟。

english: so tell me... who is this woman that you are trying to impress anyway?
translation: 那告诉我……你到底想打动哪个女人？

english: It's Thora, the longhall barkeep. Please don't tell her though. She's not like the rest of the Fremennik girls, she has a secret desire to see the world.
translation: 是索拉，长厅的酒吧招待。不过请别告诉她。她不像其他费明尼克女孩，她内心渴望去看看世界。

english: Being a sailor, I can really relate to that.
translation: 作为一个水手，我深有同感。

english: Here's that flower you wanted.
translation: 这是你要的花。

english: Incredible! Your merchanting skills might even match my own! I have no choice but to recommend you to the council of elders!
translation: 难以置信！你的经商技巧甚至可能比得上我！我别无选择，只能向长老会推荐你！

english: Hello again outerlander! I am amazed once more at your apparent skill at merchanting!
translation: 又见面了，外地人！我再次对你明显的经商技巧感到惊讶！

english: So I can count on your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 那我可以指望你在长老会上的投票了吗？

english: Absolutely, outerlander. Your merchanting skills will be a real boon to the Fremennik.
translation: 当然，外地人。你的经商技巧对费明尼克来说是一大福音。

english: In the longhall, outerlander.
translation: 在长厅里，外乡人。

english: Hmmm... well try and start again at the beginning. And try to be more careful of your wares in future.
translation: 嗯……那就重新从头开始吧。以后多注意你的货物。

english: Hello yourself, outerlander. What brings you to dare speak to a mighty Fremennik warrior such as myself?
translation: 你也好，外地人。是什么让你敢来跟像我这样强大的费明尼克战士说话？

english: Erm... are you a member of the council?
translation: 呃……你是长老会的成员吗？

english: The Fremennik council of elders? Why, of course I am. I am recognised as one the clans mightiest warriors. What is it to you outerlander?
translation: 费明尼克长老会？当然，我是。我被公认为部族最强大的战士之一。这跟你有什么关系，外地人？

english: Well... I was wondering if you could vote for me to become a Fremennik.
translation: 嗯……我在想你能不能投票让我成为费明尼克的一员。

english: An outerlander wishes to become a Fremennik!?!? Ha! That is priceless!
translation: 一个外地人想成为费明尼克？！哈！真是太好笑了！

english: Well, let us say that I am not totally against this concept. As a warrior, I appreciate the value of brave and powerful warriors to our clan,
translation: 好吧，这么说吧，我并非完全反对这个想法。作为一个战士，我欣赏勇敢强大的战士对我们部族的价值，

english: and even though you may be an outerlander, I will not hold this against you if you can prove yourself to be fierce of heart in a combat situation to me.
translation: 即使你是个外地人，如果你能在战斗中向我证明你有一颗勇猛的心，我不会因此对你有偏见。

english: So how can I prove that? You want to fight me? Come on then, bring it on! Right here, right now, buddy!
translation: 那我怎么证明？你想跟我打？来吧，放马过来！就这里，就现在，伙计！

english: Hahahahaha! You certainly show some spirit for an outerlander!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈！你这个外来者确实有几分气概！

english: But spirit does not always make a good warrior. It takes both skill and spirit to be so. I have a test that I give all Fremenniks on their path to be a member of the clan.
translation: 但光有气概不一定能成为好战士。要做到这一点，既需要技巧也需要气概。我有一个测试，所有费明尼克人在成为部落成员的路上都要经历。

english: My test will challenge both your combat prowess and your bravery equally. Should you pass it you will earn my vote at the council, and more importantly my respect for you as a warrior.
translation: 我的测试将同样挑战你的战斗能力和勇气。如果你通过了，你将赢得我在长老会上的投票，更重要的是，赢得我作为战士对你的尊重。

english: So what say you, outerlander? Are you prepared for the battle?
translation: 那么你怎么说，外地人？你准备好战斗了吗？

english: Am I prepared? I'll show you what combat's all about, you big sissy barbarian type guy!
translation: 我准备好了？我会让你见识见识什么是战斗，你这个娘娘腔的野蛮人！

english: Hahahahaha! I'm beginning to like you already, outerlander!
translation: 哈哈哈哈！我开始喜欢你了，外地人！

english: Then allow me to present you with my challenge; This ladder here will take you to a place of combat. I have placed a special warrior down there to challenge you.
translation: 那么请允许我提出我的挑战；这里的梯子会带你到一个战斗场所。我在下面安排了一个特别的战士来挑战你。

english: Battle him to the death, and you will pass my challenge. If at any point you wish to leave combat, simply climb back up the ladder, to leave that place.
translation: 与他战斗至死，你就通过了我的挑战。如果你在任何时候想离开战斗，只需爬回梯子，离开那个地方。

english: If you leave you will of course fail the test. You may retry my test in the future if you fail, but you must stay down there until the death if you wish for my vote at the council.
translation: 如果你离开，当然会失败。如果失败了，你以后可以重新尝试我的测试，但如果你想要我在长老会上的投票，你必须待在那里直到死亡。

english: You must defeat him three times to prove that you are worthy. The fourth time that you fight him will be to the death, so do not show cowardice.
translation: 你必须击败他三次来证明你的价值。第四次与他战斗将是生死之战，所以不要表现出懦弱。

english: Is that all? It will be easy!
translation: 就这些？太简单了！

english: No, there is one more important rule;
translation: 不，还有一条重要规则；

english: You may not enter the battleground with any armour or weaponry of any kind.
translation: 你不能携带任何盔甲或武器进入战场。

english: If you need to place your equipment into your bank account, I recommend that you speak to the seer, who knows a spell that will do that for you.
translation: 如果你需要将装备存入银行账户，我建议你去找先知，他知道一个咒语可以帮你做到。

english: No thanks, I'm pretty sure that I can find someone else to vote for me.
translation: 不了，谢谢，我很确定我能找到别人给我投票。

english: Hmm, not so brave after all, outerlander? Perhaps it is for the best. I doubt you have what it takes to pass my challenge.
translation: 哼，终究没那么勇敢，外地人？也许这样最好。我怀疑你没有能力通过我的挑战。

english: So what do I have to do to earn your vote at the council again?
translation: 那我到底要怎么做才能赢得你在长老会上的投票？

english: I will not offer my vote to anybody whose bravery in combat I do not trust completely. You must go down that ladder and fight your foe to the death.
translation: 我不会把票投给任何我完全不信任其战斗勇气的人。你必须走下那个梯子，与你的敌人战斗至死。

english: So, who is my opponent?
translation: 那么，我的对手是谁？

english: Ah, a wise question before entering combat. His name is Koschei the deathless. He is something of a mystery, even to us.
translation: 啊，进入战斗前问了个明智的问题。他叫不死的科谢伊。他有点神秘，连我们也不了解。

english: On one of our regular raiding parties, our longship discovered a man in the frozen waters far north-east of here. We took him aboard our ship, thinking he must be dead.
translation: 在一次常规的袭击行动中，我们的长船在东北方向远处的冰水里发现了一个人。我们把他带上船，以为他肯定死了。

english: To our amazement he was perfectly healthy, even though he must have been in those deadly icy waters for many weeks.
translation: 令我们惊讶的是，他非常健康，尽管他肯定在那致命的冰水里待了好几周。

english: He has no memory of who he is, or how he came to be there, except for his own name: Koschei. We named him 'The Deathless' because he is seemingly unkillable!
translation: 他不记得自己是谁，也不记得怎么到那里的，只记得自己的名字：科谢伊。我们叫他'不死者'，因为他似乎杀不死！

english: Any combat technique used against him, he learns instantly! He also apparently can heal himself from any wound at will! When he attacks, his weapon moves like a whirlwind!
translation: 任何对他使用的战斗技巧，他都能立刻学会！而且他显然可以随意治愈任何伤口！他攻击时，武器像旋风一样移动！

english: He can hide his combat level from his opponents at will as well! He is truly a horribly fierce opponent to face! I am only glad that he has chosen to stay here with us!
translation: 他还能随意向对手隐藏自己的战斗等级！他真是个可怕的对手！我很高兴他选择留在这里和我们在一起！

english: The daylight makes him feel weak, so we have built him his own battleground beneath this building, where he can train his fiercesomeskills without being disturbed.
translation: 日光让他感到虚弱，所以我们在这栋建筑下面为他建了一个专属战场，他可以在那里不受打扰地训练他可怕的技能。

english: But he can't REALLY be unkillable...  ...can he?
translation: 但他不可能真的杀不死吧……对吧？

english: Some say he cannot die, for he has hidden his heart outside of his body to be kept forever safe in a duck egg.
translation: 有人说他不能死，因为他把心脏藏在体外，永远安全地放在一个鸭蛋里。

english: Others say he has been cursed by the gods to wander this land forever, never knowing any peace in his life, but only combat.
translation: 也有人说他被众神诅咒，永远在这片土地上流浪，一生不得安宁，只有战斗。

english: Some claim that the sword he carries is the source of all his power, and if he should lose it, then exactly one minute later, he will turn back into his true form;
translation: 有人声称他携带的剑是他所有力量的来源，如果他失去了剑，那幺正好一分钟后，他会变回他的真实形态；

english: A weakened, lame, old man.
translation: 一个虚弱、跛脚的老人。

english: And what do you believe?
translation: 那你相信什么？

english: I believe you shouldn't look a gift horse in the mouth. He is a fearfully powerful warrior, but more importantly; He is on OUR side, not against us.
translation: 我相信不要对礼物吹毛求疵。他是一个极其强大的战士，但更重要的是：他是站在我们这边的，不是反对我们的。

english: He is content testing the battle skills of anyone taking their Fremennik trials of manhood, and I am content knowing that should an enemy ever invade our town,
translation: 他很满足于测试任何参加费明尼克成人试炼的人的战斗技巧，而我也很满足，因为知道如果有敌人入侵我们的城镇，

english: while our warriors are out on a raiding party, Koschei will be able to hold off ANY invader long enough for us to make our return.
translation: 当我们的战士外出袭击时，科谢伊能够抵挡任何入侵者足够长的时间，直到我们返回。

english: I don't really like fighting that much... Isn't there something else I can do to earn your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我不太喜欢战斗……有没有别的事可以做来赢得你在长老会上的投票？

english: Yes of course outerlander! If you bring me five raw sardines then I will vote for you instead!
translation: 当然有，外地人！如果你给我带五条生沙丁鱼，我就投票给你！

english: REALLY?!?!?
HAHAHAHAHAHA! No, of course not! You are stupid, even by outerlander standards!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈！不，当然不是！你真蠢，即使按外地人的标准也是！

english: If you want my vote, you must pass my trial. It is as simple as that.
translation: 如果你想要我的投票，你必须通过我的试炼。就这么简单。

english: I was only joking about the raw sardines outerlander.
translation: 我只是在开玩笑说生沙丁鱼，外地人。

english: Oh. Really? Oh. So I have to pass your combat trial?
translation: 哦。真的？哦。所以我必须通过你的战斗试炼？

english: Hello there! Thorvald tells me you can deposit my equipment directly into my bank account for me...?
translation: 你好！托瓦尔德告诉我你可以帮我把装备直接存入我的银行账户……？

english: That is correct outerlander, but you will need to go and retrieve your equipment from your bank account yourself, manually.
translation: 没错，外地人，但你需要自己去银行账户手动取回你的装备。

english: Alas, my spell is not very accurate, so it will deposit everything you have upon you into your bank, not just your armour and weapons.
translation: 唉，我的咒语不太精确，所以它会把你身上所有东西都存入银行，不只是你的盔甲和武器。

english: Yes, please deposit my equipment.
translation: 是的，请帮我存入装备。

english: I am sorry outerlander, the spell is not working.
translation: 抱歉，外地人，咒语不起作用。

english: The task is done. I wish you luck with your test, outerlander.
translation: 任务完成了。祝你在测试中好运，外地人。

english: No thanks, I'll just go to the bank and sort my inventory out myself.
translation: 不了，谢谢，我自己去银行整理背包。

english: It seems you have some idea of combat after all, outerlander! I will not hold back so much this time!
translation: 看来你毕竟还是懂点战斗的，外地人！这次我不会那么手下留情了！

english: Impressive start... But now we fight for real!
translation: 开局不错……但现在我们要来真的了！

english: You show some skill at combat... I will hold back no longer! This time you lose your prayer however, and fight like a warrior!
translation: 你展示了一些战斗技巧……我不会再保留了！不过这次你会失去祈祷，像个战士一样战斗！

english: Prepare to die, [player name]!
translation: 准备受死吧，[player name]！

english: I will crush your dead bones!
translation: 我会碾碎你的尸骨！

english: Outerlander... you have made a mistake coming down here!
translation: 外地人……你下来这里是个错误！

english: What kind of a person calls [him/her]self [player name]?
translation: 什么样的人会叫[him/her][player name]？

english: You have no idea of my true power, outerlander!
translation: 你根本不知道我真正的力量，外地人！

english: Today is the day you die, outerlander!
translation: 今天就是你的死期，外地人！

english: [Player name]! Meet your doom!
translation: [Player name]！迎接你的末日吧！

english: Prepare to face my power, outerlander!
translation: 准备面对我的力量吧，外地人！

english: You show some skill at combat... I will hold back no longer!
translation: 你展现了一些战斗技巧……我不会再手下留情了！

english: Incredible... a mere outerlander... has somehow managed... to defeat ME?!?! You have passed the trial, outerlander. Speak to Thorvald. Take this blade as reward.
translation: 不可思议……一个区区外地人……竟然设法……击败了我？！？！你通过了试炼，外地人。去和索尔瓦尔德谈谈。拿上这把刀片作为奖励。

english: Hahaha! Well foughtouterlander! Now come down from there, you have passed my trial with flying colours!
translation: 哈哈哈！打得漂亮，外地人！现在下来吧，你已经出色地通过了我的试炼！

english: But... I don't understand... I did not manage to beat Koschei...
translation: 但是……我不明白……我并没有打败科谢伊……

english: I would be honoured to represent you to the council as worthy of being a Fremennik after watching that superb battle!
translation: 目睹了那场精彩的战斗后，我很荣幸能向长老会推荐你，证明你配得上成为弗瑞曼尼的一员。

english: So can I count on your vote at the council of elders now Thorvald?
translation: 那么，托瓦尔德，我现在能指望你在长老会上投我一票了吗？

english: Absolutely! I watched the entire battle, and was extremely impressed with your bravery in combat!
translation: 当然！我看了整场战斗，你在战斗中的勇气让我印象深刻！

english: I'd really rather not go back down there again, now that I have Thorvald's vote at the council of elders.
translation: 既然我已经得到了托瓦尔德在长老会上的支持，我真的不想再回到那里去了。

english: Hello outerlander. What do you want?
translation: 你好，外地人。你想要什么？

english: Hello. I'm looking for members of the council of elders to vote for me to become a Fremennik.
translation: 你好。我在找长老会的成员，希望你们能投票让我成为弗瑞曼尼的一员。

english: Are you now? Well that is interesting. Usually outerlanders do not concern themselves with our ways like that.
translation: 是吗？那可真有意思。通常外地人不会像这样关心我们的习俗。

english: I am one of the members of the council of elders, and should you be able to prove to me that you have something to offer my clan
translation: 我是长老会的成员之一，如果你能向我证明你有能力为我的部族做出贡献，

english: I will vote in your favour at the next meeting.
translation: 我就会在下次会议上投你一票。

english: How can I prove that to you?
translation: 我要怎么向你证明？

english: Well, I have but a simple test. This building behind me is my house. Inside I have constructed a puzzle.
translation: 嗯，我只有一个简单的测试。我身后的这栋建筑就是我的房子。我在里面设置了一个谜题。

english: As a Seer to the clan, I value intelligence very highly, so you may think of it as an intelligence test of sorts.
translation: 作为部族的先知，我非常看重智慧，所以你可以把它看作是一种智力测试。

english: An intelligence test? I thought barbarians were stupid!
translation: 智力测试？我还以为野蛮人都很笨呢！

english: That is the opinion that outerlanders usually hold of my people, it is true. But that is because people often confuse knowledge with wisdom.
translation: 外来者对我的人民通常持有这种看法，没错。但这是因为人们常常把知识与智慧混为一谈。

english: My puzzle tests not what you know, but what you can work out. All members of our clan have been tested when they took their trials.
translation: 我的谜题测试的不是你知道什么，而是你能推理出什么。我们部族的所有成员在经历试炼时都接受过测试。

english: So what exactly does this puzzle consist of, then?
translation: 那么这个谜题具体是什么呢？

english: Well, firstly you must enter my house with no items, weapons or armour. Then it is a simple matter of entering through one door and leaving by the other.
translation: 嗯，首先，你必须不带任何物品、武器或盔甲进入我的房子。然后，很简单，从一扇门进去，从另一扇门出来。

english: I can't take anything in there with me?
translation: 我不能带任何东西进去？

english: That is correct outerlander. Everything you need to complete the puzzle you will find inside the building. Nothing more.
translation: 没错，外地人。完成谜题所需的一切你都能在房子里找到。仅此而已。

english: So what say you outerlander? You think you have the wit to earn yourself my vote?
translation: 那么，外地人，你怎么说？你觉得你有智慧赢得我这一票吗？

english: Yes, I accept your challenge. I have one small question, however...
translation: 是的，我接受你的挑战。不过，我有个小问题……

english: Well... you say I can bring nothing with me when I enter your house...
translation: 嗯……你说我进你房子的时候不能带任何东西……

english: Well.....
Where is the nearest bank?
translation: 最近的银行在哪里？

english: Ah, I see your problem outerlander. The nearest bank to here is the place known to outerlanders as the Seers Village. It is some way South.
translation: 啊，我明白你的问题了，外地人。离这里最近的银行是外地人所说的先知村。往南走一段路就到了。

english: I do however have an alternative, should you wish to take it.
translation: 不过，如果你愿意，我还有一个替代方案。

english: I can store all the weapons, armour and items that you have upon you directly into your bank account.
translation: 我可以把你身上所有的武器、盔甲和物品直接存到你的银行账户里。

english: This will tax what little magic I possess however, so you will have to manually travel to the bank to withdraw them again.
translation: 但这会消耗我仅有的一点魔法，所以你得亲自去银行才能把它们取出来。

english: What say you outerlander? you wish me to do this for you?
translation: 外地人，你怎么说？你希望我为你这么做吗？

english: Yes, thank you!
translation: 好的，谢谢！

english: No thanks. Nobody touches my stuff but me!
translation: 不了，谢谢。除了我自己，谁也别想碰我的东西！

english: You may attempt my little task when you have deposited your equipment in the bank.
translation: 等你把装备存到银行后，再来尝试我的小任务吧。

english: No, thinking about stuff isn't really my 'thing'. I'd rather go kill something. I'll find someone else to vote for me.
translation: 不，思考事情真的不是我的‘菜’。我宁愿去杀点什么。我会找别人给我投票的。

english: So I can bring nothing with me when I enter your house?
translation: 所以我进你房子的时候什么都不能带？

english: That is correct outerlander, but as I say, I can use my small skill in magic to send your items directly into your bank account from here.
translation: 没错，外地人，但就像我说的，我可以用我微薄的魔法技能把你的物品从这里直接送到你的银行账户。

english: You will need to manually go to the bank to withdraw them again however. Would you like me to perform this small spell upon you, outerlander?
translation: 不过你得亲自去银行才能把它们取出来。外地人，你希望我对你施展这个小法术吗？

english: So I just have to enter by one door of your house, and leave by the other?
translation: 所以我只需要从你家的一扇门进去，再从另一扇门出来？

english: That is correct outerlander. Be warned it is not as easy as it may at first sound...
translation: 没错，外地人。但警告你，这并不像听起来那么容易……

english: Incredible! To have solved my puzzle so quickly! I have no choice but to vote in your favour!
translation: 难以置信！这么快就解开了我的谜题！我别无选择，只能投你一票！

english: So you will vote for me at the council?
translation: 那么你会在长老会上投我一票吗？

english: Absolutely, outerlander. Your wisdom in passing my test marks you as worthy in my eyes.
translation: 当然，外地人。你通过我的测试所展现的智慧，在我眼中已经证明了你值得。

english: I wish you luck with your test then, outerlander.
translation: 外乡人，祝你考试顺利。

english: AS you wish.
translation: 如你所愿。
