english: Should you prove successful come back and see me, and I will make you some fine armour.
translation: 如果你成功了，就回来找我，我会给你做一套好盔甲。

english: Hello there outerlander. I hear you are attempting to become a member of our tribe?
translation: 你好，外乡人。我听说你正在努力成为我们部落的一员？

english: Have you no manners outerlander? This is my home, you will show me the due respect!
translation: 你没礼貌吗，外地人？这是我的家，你得对我表示应有的尊重！

english: Erm.... sorry I guess.
translation: 呃……我想是抱歉了。

english: I am trying to become a member of the Fremennik clan! The Chieftain told me that I may be able to gain your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我想成为弗瑞曼尼部族的一员！酋长告诉我，我或许能在长老会上得到你的支持？

english: You wish to stop being an outerlander? I can understand that! I have no reason why I would prevent you becoming a Fremennik...
translation: 你不想再做外地人了？我能理解！我没有理由阻止你成为弗瑞曼尼……

english: ...but you must first pass a little test for me to prove you are worthy.
translation: ……但你必须先通过一个小测试，向我证明你值得。

english: What kind of test?
translation: 什么样的测试？

english: Well, I serve our clan as a navigator. The seas can be a fearful place when you know not where you are heading.
translation: 嗯，我在部族里担任领航员。当你不知道要去哪里时，大海会是个可怕的地方。

english: Should something happen to me, all members of our tribe have some basic sense of direction so that they may always return safely home.
translation: 万一我出了什么事，我们部族的所有成员都有一些基本的方位感，这样他们总能安全回家。

english: If you are able to demonstrate to me that you too have a good sense of direction then I will recommend you to the rest of the council of elders immediately.
translation: 如果你能向我证明你也有良好的方向感，我会立刻向长老会的其他成员推荐你。

english: Well, how would I go about showing that?
translation: 嗯，那我该怎么展示呢？

english: Ah, a simple task! Below this building I have constructed a maze; should you be able to walk from one side to the other that will be proof to me.
translation: 啊，一个简单的任务！在这栋建筑下面，我建了一个迷宫；如果你能从一边走到另一边，对我来说就是证明了。

english: You wish to try my challenge?
translation: 你想试试我的挑战吗？

english: A maze? Is that all? Sure, it sounds simple enough.
translation: 一个迷宫？就这？当然，听起来够简单的。

english: I will warn you outerlander, this maze was designed by myself, and is of the most fiendish complexity!
translation: 我警告你，外地人，这个迷宫是我亲手设计的，复杂程度极其刁钻！

english: Oh really? Watch and learn...
translation: 哦，是吗？看着学着点……

english: No thanks. I think I can get someone else to vouch for me to the council of elders, without going through a stupid maze like some lab rat.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我想我可以找别人替我在长老会上担保，而不是像只实验老鼠一样钻个愚蠢的迷宫。

english: Well, I am sorry you feel that way outerlander. I cannot vouch for you until you prove to me you have some skill that will benefit our clan somehow.
translation: 嗯，我很遗憾你这么想，外地人。在你向我证明你有某种能为部族带来好处的技能之前，我不能为你担保。

english: What exactly is a 'lab rat' anyway?
translation: 话说回来，‘实验老鼠’到底是什么？

english: Ah, forget it.
translation: 啊，算了。

english: Man, your maze is pretty tough!
translation: 老兄，你的迷宫可真够难的！

english: Hahahaha it is the most complex route I have ever devised! I am truly a genius at navigation! The world will remember my name!
translation: 哈哈哈！这是我设计过的最复杂的路线！我真是个导航天才！世界会记住我的名字！

english: Can't I do something else for your vote at the council of elders?
translation: 我能做点别的来换取你在长老会上的那一票吗？

english: No, you cannot. It is my maze, or nothing.
translation: 不，你不能。要么走我的迷宫，要么免谈。

english: Decided you could not solve my labyrinth after all, did you outerlander? Too tricky for you?
translation: 最终还是决定解不开我的迷宫，是吧，外地人？对你来说太难了？

english: Yeah, it is really confusing down there...
translation: 是啊，下面真是让人晕头转向……

english: Hahaha! Don't worry outerlander, you are not the first to fail its puzzle!
translation: 哈哈哈！别担心，外地人，你不是第一个解不开它谜题的人！

english: Outerlander! You have finished my maze! I am genuinely impressed!
translation: 外地人！你完成了我的迷宫！我真心佩服！

english: So does that mean I can rely on your vote at the council of elders to allow me into your village?
translation: 那么这是否意味着我可以指望你在长老会上投票允许我进入你们的村庄？

english: Of course outerlander! I am nothing if not a man of my word!
translation: 当然，外地人！我向来言出必行！

english: Greetings again outerlander! I must say, I am still impressed with the way you moved through my maze!
translation: 再次问候你，外地人！我得说，我仍然对你穿越我迷宫的方式印象深刻！

english: Thanks. So I can rely on your vote in my favour at the council of elders?
translation: 谢谢。那么我可以指望你在长老会上投我一票吗？

english: Absolutely! You will be an asset to the clan!
translation: 当然！你会成为部族的财富！

english: Hahaha! Don't worry outerlander, you are not the first to fail it's puzzle!
translation: 哈哈哈！别担心，外乡人，你不是第一个解不开它谜题的人！

english: Er... from Askeladden, maybe?
translation: 呃……是从阿斯卡拉登那里？

english: Hey! Outerlander! Do you normally just barge into someones home and wander around as you please?
translation: 嘿！外乡人！你平时就这么随便闯进别人家到处逛吗？

english: Well not here you don't.
translation: 在这里可不行。

english: Um... from the longhalls' barkeep?
translation: 嗯……是从长厅的酒保那里？

english: No way am I doing that maze again!
translation: 我绝不再走那个迷宫了！

english: I only have 1 vote so far.
translation: 到目前为止我只有1票。

english: Hmmm... well that is certainly a good start I would say. Keep up the good work!
translation: 嗯……我得说这是个不错的开始。继续努力！

english: I only have [2-6] votes so far.
translation: 到目前为止我只有[2-6]票。

english: Hmmm... you are doing very well so far, outerlander. Keep up the good work!
translation: 嗯……你目前做得非常好，外地人。继续努力！

english: Remember: You need to get at least seven council votes to be accepted as a member of the Fremennik.
translation: 记住：你需要至少获得七张长老会的选票才能被接纳为弗瑞曼尼的一员。

english: If you need any help with your trials, I suggest you speak to Askeladden. He is currently doing his own trials of manhood to become a true Fremennik.
translation: 如果你的试炼需要任何帮助，我建议你和阿斯卡拉登谈谈。他目前正在经历他自己的成人试炼，以成为一名真正的弗瑞曼尼。

english: I have seven members of the council prepared to vote in my favour now!
translation: 现在有七位长老会成员准备投我一票了！

english: I know outerlander, for I have been closely monitoring your progress so far!
translation: 我知道，外地人，因为我一直在密切关注你的进展！

english: Then let us put the formality aside, and let me personally welcome you into the Fremennik! May you bring us honour!
translation: 那么让我们抛开这些形式，让我亲自欢迎你加入弗瑞曼尼！愿你为我们带来荣耀！

english: From this day onward, you are outerlander no more! In honour of your acceptance into the Fremennik Yougain a new name to be known as. You will now be called [Fremennik name].
translation: 从今天起，你不再是外地人了！为了纪念你被弗瑞曼尼接纳，你将获得一个新名字。从现在起，你将被称为[Fremennik name]。

english: Look, there's the statue of King Alvis, guarding the entrance to Keldagrim!
translation: 看，那就是阿尔维斯国王的雕像，守护着凯尔达格林城的入口！

english: Amazing! And we're going to go straight past it?
translation: 太棒了！我们就要直接从它旁边过去吗？

english: Er, hold on! There's something wrong!
translation: 呃，等等！有点不对劲！

english: Halt! By order of the Black Guard, you are under arrest!
translation: 站住！奉黑卫队之命，你被捕了！

english: What?? I didn't do anything! It wasn't me!
translation: 什么？？我什么都没做！不是我！

english: Come with us, human! Commander Veldaban wants a word with you!
translation: 跟我们走，人类！维尔达班指挥官要和你谈谈！

english: Identify yourself, human!
translation: 报上名来，人类！

english: I err, I'm [player name]. I was told I was under arrest. I had a little accident on the way in here.
translation: 我呃，我是[player name]。有人告诉我被捕了。我在进来的路上出了点小意外。

english: Ah, so you're the one who knocked over the statue of our glorious king!
translation: 啊，原来你就是撞倒我们光荣国王雕像的那个人！

english: I suppose so... I mean, I didn't do it on purpose or anything...
translation: 大概吧……我的意思是，我不是故意的……

english: Ah, don't worry about it!
translation: 啊，别担心！

english: We haven't been ruled by a king for many a year... that statue was long overdue for replacement anyway. You're not under arrest, I merely wanted to talk to you.
translation: 我们好多年没有国王统治了……那座雕像早就该换了。你没有被捕，我只是想和你谈谈。

english: But let me introduce myself. I am Veldaban, son of Dondakan. I am the Commander of the Black Guard in Keldagrim.
translation: 不过，让我自我介绍一下。我是维尔达班，东达坎之子。我是凯尔达格林城黑卫队的指挥官。

english: Dondakan, you say?
translation: 你说东达坎？

english: I helped your father in the mines south of the city.
translation: 我在城市南边的矿场帮过你父亲。

english: Ah, so you are the one! I heard you banished a demon by defeating its avatar, most impressive.
translation: 啊，原来就是你！我听说你打败了恶魔的化身将它驱逐，真是了不起。

english: I'm helping your father in the mines south of the city.
translation: 我正在城市南边的矿场帮你父亲。

english: Ah, he is forever trying to break open that rock of his, until his death I sometimes think.
translation: 啊，他总是想方设法要砸开他那块石头，有时我觉得他到死都不会罢休。

english: Perhaps, human, perhaps... but if even our multicannon does not dent it, what chance is there really?
translation: 也许吧，人类，也许吧……但连我们的多管炮都砸不出一点痕迹，那还有什么机会呢？

english: Well, ehm... nice to meet you, Veldaban.
translation: 呃，嗯……很高兴见到你，维尔达班。

english: Now listen carefully. I have a task for you.
translation: 现在仔细听好。我有件事要交给你。

english: I want you to go and see the local sculptor and help him build a new statue.
translation: 我要你去找当地的雕塑家，帮他建造一座新雕像。

english: Will you do this for us?
translation: 你愿意为我们做这件事吗？

english: No, I can't be bothered.
translation: 不，我懒得管。

english: You destroy our statue and you cannot be bothered to help rebuild it? By Guthix, you are rude... even for a human!
translation: 你毁掉了我们的雕像，却懒得帮忙重建？以古斯神之名，你真是太没礼貌了……就算对人类来说也是如此！

english: Yes, I will do this.
translation: 好的，我愿意做。

english: You are a good human, [player name].
translation: 你是个好人类，[player name]。

english: Now, I need you to go to Blasidar, he is a sculptor who lives in Keldagrim-East.
translation: 现在，我需要你去见布拉西达，他是一位雕塑家，住在凯尔达格林城东区。

english: To be honest I'm not much of a sculptor myself.
translation: 老实说，我自己不太会雕塑。

english: Oh, don't worry! I just need you to help him out while he rebuilds the statue.
translation: 哦，别担心！我只是需要你在重建雕像时协助他。

english: I'm sure there are many tasks that he needs doing.
translation: 我相信他有很多任务需要帮手。

english: Oh, Dondakan's employed me recently. He needs a ship to take all his gold to the city.
translation: 哦，东达坎最近雇了我。他需要一艘船把他所有的黄金运到城里。

english: There is only space on my boat for two things... me, and the gold.
translation: 我的船上只有放两样东西的空间……我，和黄金。

english: Only a little bit. One piece of gold ore for every shipment, and one piece of gold ore for every five pieces of ore on top of that.
translation: 只收取一点点。每次运输收一块金矿石，另外每五块矿石再收一块金矿石。

english: That would be three pieces. One for the shipment, two for the load. Seven pieces would go into your bank account.
translation: 那就是三块。一块是运输费，两块是矿石费。七块会存入你的银行账户。

english: But if you want, I can take your gold ore to the city and bring it to the bank.
translation: 但如果你愿意，我可以把你的金矿石运到城里，存进银行。

english: So, are you interested?
translation: 那么，你有兴趣吗？

english: Alright. Tell you what, I'll only keep 3 for myself and bring 24 ores to the bank for you. Deal?
translation: 行。这样吧，我只留3块给自己，把24块矿石给你存到银行。成交？

translation: 冷静，冷静！你付了这趟运输的钱，不是吗？

english: How are you getting on with rebuilding our statue, [player name]?
translation: 重建我们的雕像进展如何了，[player name]？

english: I haven't really done much yet...
translation: 我其实还没做多少……

english: Get back to it as soon as you can, please!
translation: 请尽快回去继续干吧！

english: Hello there, can you help me?
translation: 你好，你能帮我吗？

english: Talk... to Blasidar.
translation: 和……布拉西达谈谈。

english: What? No, I was wondering if you could help me.
translation: 什么？不，我是想知道你能不能帮我。

english: Alright, alright.
translation: 好吧，好吧。

english: Excuse me, are you Blasidar, the famous sculptor?
translation: 打扰一下，你是布拉西达，那位著名的雕塑家吗？

english: Why, yes, yes, that I am!
translation: 哎呀，是的，是的，正是在下！

english: Oh, well, I'm [player name]. Veldaban of the Black Guard sent me to you, you see. Said you might need some help with the statue.
translation: 哦，嗯，我是[player name]。黑卫队的维尔达班派我来找你，他说你可能需要帮忙建造雕像。

english: Oh, I don't need an assistant sculptor, really, I can do just fine on my own.
translation: 哦，我不需要雕塑助理，真的，我一个人就能做得很好。

english: I'm not a sculptor.
translation: 我不是雕塑家。

english: And I've also got a model here, you see, to base my statue on.
translation: 而且我这里还有一个模型，你看，可以照着做雕像。

english: I'm not a model!
translation: 我不是模型！

english: But come to think of it, I do need some errands run. Yes, quite important errands too.
translation: 但转念一想，我确实有些跑腿的事要办。是的，很重要的事。

english: Yes, you will do just fine.
translation: 是的，你正合适。

english: Ehm, right, okay.
translation: 呃，好的，行。

english: So what did you need doing?
translation: 那需要我做什么？

english: Well, see... the Consortium has commisionedme to rebuild the statue exactly the way it was.
translation: 嗯，你看……财团委托我完全按照原样重建那座雕像。

english: But the statue itself has broken into a million pieces... and we dwarves aren't very good painters, you know, so we don't have any paintings of it either.
translation: 但雕像本身已经碎成了无数片……而我们矮人并不擅长绘画，你知道，所以我们也没有任何它的画作。

english: Not a very artistic race, then, are you?
translation: 这么说，你们不是一个很有艺术天赋的种族咯？

english: No, that's not what I said, I said we're not very good painters.
translation: 不，我不是这个意思，我是说我们不太擅长绘画。

english: We're excellent with, for example, stone. Oh yes, quite good if I say so myself.
translation: 比如在石头方面，我们非常出色。哦，是的，我得说相当不错。

english: But I digress... simply speaking, I need some help with getting some items that I can base the new statue on.
translation: 不过扯远了……简单来说，我需要一些帮助，弄到一些可以作为新雕像参考的东西。

english: Will you be able to help me with this, [player name]?
translation: 你能帮我这个忙吗，[player name]？

english: How rude is that? I don't think the Black Guard will be very pleased with you!
translation: 这有多无礼？我觉得黑卫队可不会对你好脸色！

english: Excellent, excellent! Now what I need is the following...
translation: 很好，很好！我现在需要以下这些东西……

english: I will need a pair of boots, the most exquisite boots you can find. The more they look like the original the better, but I don't think you'll be able to find an exact match.
translation: 我需要一双靴子，你能找到的最精致的靴子。它们看起来越像原版越好，但我觉得你找不到完全一样的。

english: For the torso, I need clothes that look like King Alvis' clothes. I'm not sure where you would be able to find that, but I'm sure you'll manage.
translation: 至于躯干部分，我需要看起来像阿尔维斯国王衣服的那种衣服。我不确定你在哪里能找到，但我相信你能搞定。

english: Also, I need a battleaxe. Now this is particularly important. You are in luck, however, as I believe King Alvis' original axe still survives.
translation: 另外，我还需要一把战斧。这一点尤其重要。不过你很幸运，因为我相信阿尔维斯国王原来的斧头还保存着。

english: Right, so I need a pair of boots, a piece of clothing and a battleaxe. Is that all?
translation: 好的，所以我需要一双靴子、一件衣服和一把战斧。就这些吗？

english: For now, [player name], for now! I wish you good luck, and hurry back with the items!
translation: 目前就这些，[player name]，目前就这些！祝你好运，带着东西快点回来！

english: But... wait, wait, how am I supposed to find all this?
translation: 但是……等等，等等，我该怎么找到这些东西？

english: I don't know! You're supposed to find that out for me!
translation: 我不知道！你得自己想办法！

english: But it's a beautiful city, Keldagrim is, I'm sure you'll see many things while you do these tasks!
translation: 但凯尔达格林城是个美丽的城市，我相信你在做这些任务时能看到很多有趣的东西！

english: What was it you needed doing again?
translation: 你刚才要我做什么来着？

english: Yes, I'm looking for some special clothes.
translation: 是的，我在找一些特别的衣服。

english: Oh, that sounds interesting, what's this about?
translation: 哦，听起来很有趣，这是怎么回事？

english: I'm helping the sculptor to rebuild the statue of King Alvis. But he wants to know what his clothes looked like.
translation: 我在帮雕塑家重建阿尔维斯国王的雕像。但他想知道他的衣服是什么样子的。

english: Oh dear, that statue is in a terrible mess, isn't it?
translation: 哦天哪，那座雕像一团糟，是吧？

english: I could hear the tumult from over here!
translation: 我从这儿都能听到那阵喧闹声！

english: But the clothes, do you have any similar clothes?
translation: 不过衣服呢，你有类似的衣服吗？

english: Oh no, no, I can't quite recall what the clothes looked like. But I know someone who can!
translation: 哦，不，不，我不太记得衣服的样子了。但我知道有人记得！

english: Well, I'm sure Hugi the librarian in West can help you along.
translation: 嗯，我肯定西区的图书管理员胡吉能帮你。

english: West?
translation: 西区？

english: Keldagrim-West, dear... on the other side of the Kelda, towards the north end of the city.
translation: 凯尔达格林城西区，亲爱的……在凯尔达河的另一边，靠近城市的北端。

english: I'm sure he can show you the exact designs of the clothes.
translation: 我敢肯定他能给你看衣服的精确设计图。

english: But I need the actual clothes themselves, not just the designs.
translation: 但我需要的是衣服本身，不只是设计图。

english: Oh, just bring the designs to me then, I'll fix you up some nice clothes!
translation: 哦，那把设计图给我吧，我会帮你做几件漂亮的衣服！

english: Sounds like a fun little thing to do!
translation: 听起来是件有趣的小事！

english: Great, thanks a lot, I'll check out the library!
translation: 太好了，非常感谢，我去图书馆看看！

english: Do you know anything about King Alvis's clothes?
translation: 你知道关于阿尔维斯国王衣服的事吗？

english: His clothes? How do you mean?
translation: 他的衣服？你指的是什么？

english: I'm helping Blasidar the sculptor to rebuild the statue of King Alvis, but he needs to know the design of his clothes.
translation: 我在帮雕塑家布拉西达重建阿尔维斯国王的雕像，但他需要知道衣服的设计。

english: There is a book, somewhere in the library, that may help you. It is the 'Scholars Guide to Dwarven Costumes' and it contains the designs of the costumes of a lot of old Kings and dwarven dignitaries.
translation: 图书馆里有一本书，可能对你有帮助。书名是《学者指南：矮人服饰》，里面包含了许多古代国王和矮人显贵的服装设计。

english: Sounds like just the thing. Where exactly could I find it?
translation: 听起来正是我需要的。具体在哪里能找到它？

english: Let me think... I believe it is on the top shelf of one of the bookcases in the library, because it is such an old book.
translation: 让我想想……我相信它在图书馆其中一个书架的顶层架子上，因为那是一本很旧的书。

english: Can you be any more specific? Upstairs, downstairs?
translation: 能说得更具体点吗？楼上还是楼下？

english: I don't remember, sorry. You will have to try several bookcases. You will probably need the ladders, tall a human though you are.
translation: 我不记得了，抱歉。你得试几个书架。虽然你是个高大的人类，但可能还是需要梯子。

english: Well, thanks, I'll have a look.
translation: 好吧，谢谢，我去看看。

english: Bah. Annoying dwarven ladders, they're much too flimsy.
translation: 哼。烦人的矮人梯子，太不结实了。

english: Yes, about those special clothes again...
translation: 是的，又是关于那些特殊衣服的事……

english: Oh yes, did you get those designs from the librarian?
translation: 哦，对了，你从图书管理员那里拿到设计图了吗？

english: I haven't actually spoken to the librarian yet, let me do that now.
translation: 我还没和图书管理员谈过，我现在就去。

english: No, I don't have them yet, but I can get them for you. The librarian has a book.
translation: 不，我还没有，但我可以帮你拿到。图书管理员那里有本书。

english: Yes, I have a book right here, have a look at it!
translation: 是的，我这里正好有本书，你看看！

english: Oh, I see, I see!
translation: 哦，我明白了，我明白了！

english: I can definitely help you with this.
translation: 我肯定能帮你这个忙。

english: I only have one small problem, you see... I've run out of fuel for my spinning machine.
translation: 只是我有个小问题，你看……我的纺纱机没燃料了。

english: What does it run on?
translation: 它用什么作燃料？

english: Steam, of course!
translation: 当然是蒸汽！

english: But I've used up all my coal and wood and I don't have the time to leave my stall to get them.
translation: 但我用完了所有的煤和木材，而且我没时间离开摊位去拿。

english: Don't worry, I'll get them for you. Let's see... some coal and some logs. Shouldn't be too hard.
translation: 别担心，我去帮你拿。让我想想……一些煤和一些原木。应该不难。

english: Well, like I said, I can't do anything really without my spinning machine.
translation: 嗯，就像我说的，没有我的纺纱机，我什么都做不了。

english: Right, and what did you need again to start the engine?
translation: 对，你启动引擎需要什么来着？

english: Some coal and logs should do it!
translation: 一些煤和原木就够了！

english: I've got them right here!
translation: 我正好带来了！

english: Then put them in the machine dear!
translation: 那就把它们放进机器里吧，亲爱的！

english: Well, the spinning machine is all ready now, except that it needs to be powered up.
translation: 嗯，纺纱机现在都准备好了，就差启动动力了。

english: As soon as it's up and running, I can spin your clothes for you.
translation: 一旦它启动运转起来，我就能为你纺出衣服。

english: Why, you light the logs of course!
translation: 怎么启动？当然是点燃那些原木！

english: Okay, okay, I'll do it! Just a moment.
translation: 好吧，好吧，我来做！稍等一下。

english: Can I have those clothes now?
translation: 我现在能拿那些衣服了吗？

english: Yes, I can spin them for you, but I will have to ask you for a small payment of money for them.
translation: 是的，我可以为你纺制，但我得向你收取一点费用。

english: What, after all that work?
translation: 什么？干了这么多活还要钱？

english: I'm sorry, but the cloth to spin this is expensive. But for you, I can make the clothes for a nominal fee of 200 credits.
translation: 抱歉，纺制这些衣服的布料很贵。不过对你，我只象征性地收 200 信用点。

english: I'll pay, I'll pay.
translation: 我付，我付。

english: Wonderful, let me get started then!
translation: 太好了，那我开始吧！

english: There we go! And look how beautiful these clothes look!
translation: 好了！看看这些衣服多漂亮！

english: I won't pay, that's outrageous!
translation: 我不付，这太离谱了！

english: I'm sorry you feel that way, I was looking forward to making these clothes.
translation: 很遗憾你这么想，我本来很期待做这些衣服的。

english: Oh, and so you did! Yes, I can definitely help you with that!
translation: 哦，原来如此！是的，我绝对可以帮你！

english: Didn't I already make the clothes for you?
translation: 我不是已经给你做好衣服了吗？

english: I'm not rich, you know, I can't afford to make any more.
translation: 你知道的，我又不富裕，可没钱再做新的了。

english: A book, how wonderful!
translation: 一本书，太棒了！

english: I'll just put them on the ground here for you, since you can't carry them.
translation: 我就把它们放在地上给你吧，反正你也拿不了。

english: These clothes are too small for me, I might ruin them if I put them on. I'd better take them to the sculptor instead.
translation: 这些衣服对我来说太小了，我穿上可能会弄坏。我还是把它们带给雕塑家吧。

english: Yes, I'm looking for a pair of special boots.
translation: 是的，我在找一双特殊的靴子。

english: Boots, you say? What kind of boots?
translation: 靴子？你说的是哪种靴子？

english: The best you have! Boots fit for a king!
translation: 你这里最好的！配得上国王的靴子！

english: Hmm, let's see... Well, I've got this pair of very exclusive boots. They're not armoured, but they look nice.
translation: 嗯，让我看看……我这儿有一双非常特别的靴子。不是盔甲，但看起来很漂亮。

english: Or rather, I had. I'm afraid I sold them, come to think of it.
translation: 或者应该说，我曾经有。我想起来了，恐怕我已经卖掉了。

english: And you don't have anything else?
translation: 你没有别的了吗？

english: I don't normally stock boots, no, nothing that's appropriate for... what did you say? A king?
translation: 我一般不卖靴子，没有适合……你刚才说什么来着？国王穿的？

english: Please, tell me! Who did you sell the boots to?
translation: 请告诉我！你把靴子卖给谁了？

english: Old chap here in the west part of town, his name is Dromund. He's quite well known, not only for his wealth, but also for his... pecularities.
translation: 城西的一位老兄，他叫德罗蒙德。他很有名，不仅因为他的财富，还因为他的……怪癖。

english: What house does he live in?
translation: 他住在哪栋房子里？

english: Go out the door, and head north. You'll have the headquarters of the Black Guard on your left and the bank on your right. Keep heading north and you'll find Dromund's house on your right. Can't miss it!
translation: 出门往北走。你的左边是黑卫队总部，右边是银行。一直往北走，德罗蒙德的房子就在你的右边。你不会错过的！

english: And if you're going to try to get the boots off him, good luck. You'll need it.
translation: 如果你想从他那里弄到靴子，祝你好运。你会需要的。

english: I thought I already told you where to get them?
translation: 我想我已经告诉过你去哪里拿了吧？

english: Oh yes. The old dwarf north of the bank has them, I remember now.
translation: 哦，是的。银行北边的那个老矮人拿着，我现在想起来了。

english: You're trespassing, get out!
translation: 你擅闯民宅，给我滚出去！

english: Calm down! I just want to ask you a few questions.
translation: 冷静点！我只是想问你几个问题。

english: Are you with the Black Guard or something?
translation: 你是黑卫队的人还是什么？

english: No, you wouldn't be, you're just a human.
translation: 不，你不可能是，你只是个凡人。

english: What do you want from me?
translation: 你想从我这里得到什么？

english: I went to the Quality Armour shop. The proprietor told me you have just recently purchased a pair of boots from him.
translation: 我去过优质盔甲店。店主告诉我你刚从他那里买了一双靴子。

english: Right, and nice they look too on my display tables.
translation: 没错，它们放在我的展示桌上也很好看。

english: You're not actually using them then? Might I be able to buy them off you?
translation: 那你实际上不穿它们？我能从你这里买走吗？

english: Good one, human!
translation: 说得真好，凡人！

english: They're mine and the last thing I'll do is part with them!
translation: 它们是我的，我最不可能做的就是放弃它们！

english: Tell me, how much will you accept for these boots?
translation: 告诉我，你愿意接受多少钱来换这双靴子？

english: Get out you pesky human! The boots are mine and you're not having them!
translation: 滚出去，你这烦人的凡人！靴子是我的，你别想得到它们！

english: Are you sure you don't want to give me those boots?
translation: 你确定不想把那双靴子给我吗？

english: Get out of here before I get one of my servants to throw you out!
translation: 在我叫仆人把你扔出去之前，赶紧离开这里！

english: What are you doing there?!
translation: 你在那里干什么？！

english: What are you doing, casting spells in my house? Get out!
translation: 你在干什么，在我家里施法？滚出去！

english: Hey! Is there someone at my window?
translation: 嘿！有人在我窗户那里吗？

english: Scram before I get the Black Guard to arrest you!
translation: 在我叫黑卫队来逮捕你之前，快滚！

english: What are you doing?!
translation: 你在干什么？！

english: Servants! We have another thief!
translation: 仆人们！又来了一个盗贼！

english: Don't touch that!
translation: 别碰那个！

english: What, wear just one boot? Besides, the boot is too precious for that.
translation: 什么，只穿一只靴子？再说，这靴子太珍贵了，不能那样做。

english: I shouldn't wear these boots, I don't want anything to happen to them before I bring them to the sculptor.
translation: 我不该穿这双靴子，在把它们带给雕塑家之前，我不想让它们出任何事。

english: Yes, I'm looking for a particular battleaxe.
translation: 是的，我在找一把特定的战斧。

english: Fancy a particular colour then? Blue is quite popular at the moment, and red is on the rise.
translation: 想要特定颜色吗？蓝色现在很流行，红色也正在兴起。

english: No, actually, I'm looking for King Alvis' axe.
translation: 不，实际上，我在找阿尔维斯国王的斧头。

english: The King's axe!
translation: 国王的斧头！

english: What would a human want with it?
translation: 一个凡人要它做什么？

english: I've been tasked by Veldaban, Commander of the Black Guard in Keldagrim, to assist in every way possible with the rebuilding of King Alvis' statue.
translation: 我受凯尔达格林城黑卫队指挥官韦尔达班之托，尽一切可能协助重建阿尔维斯国王的雕像。

english: Oh yes, the statue... a most unfortunate incident.
translation: 哦，是的，那座雕像……一个非常不幸的事件。

english: Not that I'm entirely sure that it was merely an accident, of course.
translation: 当然，我并不是完全确定那仅仅是个意外。

english: I'm not entirely sure what I mean, human. But the axe, you say, what exactly did you need it for?
translation: 我不完全确定我的意思，凡人。但你说那把斧头，你具体需要它做什么？

english: Just give me the axe already, I know you have it!
translation: 快把斧头给我，我知道你拿着它！

english: I'll give it to you, embedded into your head!
translation: 我会把它给你，嵌进你的脑袋里！

english: I've had just about enough of this! Goodbye!
translation: 我受够了！再见！

english: Blasidar the sculptor needs it for his statue. He wants a model for the axe, you see, and he believes the original axe still survives.
translation: 雕塑家布拉西达需要它来做雕像。你看，他想要一个斧头的模型，而且他相信原来的斧头还在。

english: And so it does!
translation: 确实还在！

english: It's been in my family's care for a few generations now, after it has been lost for a long time.
translation: 它在我家已经保管了几代人，在那之前它丢失了很长一段时间。

english: I do not know how it got lost, but my great-grandfather found it at the banks of the Kelda, further downstream from the city.
translation: 我不知道它是怎么丢的，但我的曾祖父在凯尔达河的下游河岸发现了它，就在城市更下游的地方。

english: Can I see it?
translation: 我能看看吗？

english: There is not much left of it, to be honest. The blade has almost completely rusted away, and the sapphires on the hilt were either stolen or were washed away by the river before it was found.
translation: 说实话，剩下的不多了。刀片几乎完全锈蚀掉了，刀柄上的蓝宝石要么被偷了，要么在发现之前就被河水冲走了。

english: I doubt it is useful to Blasidar in this state, master sculptor though he is.
translation: 我怀疑这种状态对布拉西达有没有用，尽管他是位大师级的雕塑家。

english: Are you sure this is the real axe then?
translation: 你确定这真的是那把斧头吗？

english: Not entirely, no, but it matches the description well enough, and the holes for the sapphires are still clearly visible on the hilt. But since no one has a similar claim, I don't really care. It's genuine to me.
translation: 不完全是这样，不，但它和描述足够吻合，而且刀柄上镶嵌蓝宝石的孔洞仍然清晰可见。不过既然没有其他人有类似的主张，我也就不太在意了。对我来说，它就是真品。

english: This is tedious, I've lost interest.
translation: 这太无聊了，我没兴趣了。

english: I'll get back to work then.
translation: 那我回去工作了。

english: Perhaps I can repair the axe?
translation: 也许我可以修复这把斧头？

english: On your own? I doubt it. The sapphires, perhaps, if you are a skilled enough crafter. But the blade...
translation: 就凭你自己？我表示怀疑。蓝宝石或许可以，如果你是个足够熟练的工匠的话。但刀片……

english: Your feeble smithing skills will be of no use. No, you will need expert help on this.
translation: 你那点可怜的锻造技能派不上用场。不，你需要这方面的专家帮助。

english: You're a decent smith, but this is far beyond your capabilities.
translation: 你是个不错的铁匠，但这远远超出了你的能力范围。

english: Formidable though your smithing skills are, this is beyond your capabilities.
translation: 尽管你的锻造技能令人敬畏，但这超出了你的能力范围。

english: Clearly you are a master smith, perhaps one of the best human smiths in all of Gielinor. Yet this is beyond even you.
translation: 显然你是一位大师级铁匠，也许是吉列诺所有人类铁匠中最优秀的一位。然而，这甚至超出了你的能力。

english: What you need is the skills of an Imcando dwarf... but they must all be dead by now.
translation: 你需要的是伊姆坎多矮人的技艺……但他们现在应该都死了。

english: Perhaps I could try and find one?
translation: 也许我可以试着找一个？

english: Yes, perhaps, perhaps...
translation: 是的，也许，也许……

english: Perhaps the librarian, just due east of here, can help you.
translation: 也许图书管理员，就在东边，可以帮你。

english: Yes, I like the sound of this!
translation: 是的，我喜欢这个主意！

english: Oh, I know where I can find an Imcando dwarf!
translation: 哦，我知道在哪里可以找到伊姆坎多矮人！

english: He actually made a sword for me a while ago. I'm sure I can get him to help me again.
translation: 他之前确实为我打造过一把剑。我肯定能让他再帮我一次。

english: Really? That is amazing news.
translation: 真的吗？这消息太棒了。

english: He lives on a cliff at the very south end of Asgarnia, just south of Port Sarim. I can visit him again if you like.
translation: 他住在阿斯加尼亚最南端的悬崖上，就在沙林港南边。如果你愿意，我可以再去拜访他。

english: Excellent! You can take a cart to Ice Mountain from the station here, that should help you get there faster.
translation: 太好了！你可以从这里的车站坐推车去冰山，那应该能让你更快到达那里。

english: I will entrust you with King Alvis' battleaxe, then, human.
translation: 那我就把阿尔维斯国王的战斧托付给你了，人类。

english: Help to restore it to its former glory!
translation: 帮它恢复昔日的荣光！

english: And please ask Blasidar to return it to me after he's done with it, I would sure love to see the restored blade again.
translation: 请让布拉西达在用完后把它还给我，我真的很想再看看修复后的刀片。

english: Thank you. I will not disappoint you.
translation: 谢谢你。我不会让你失望的。

english: I don't really care for it after all.
translation: 其实我根本不在乎它了。

english: Then stop wasting my time.
translation: 那就别浪费我的时间。

english: Ah, you mean King Alvis' axe? You still have it, yes?
translation: 啊，你是说阿尔维斯国王的斧头？你还拿着它，对吧？

english: Yes, but I was just wondering what I should be doing with this piece of junk.
translation: 是的，但我只是在想我该拿这块垃圾怎么办。

english: Piece of junk??
translation: 垃圾？？

english: I thought you were going to put sapphires on it and bring it to an Imcando dwarf?
translation: 我以为你要在上面镶嵌蓝宝石，然后带去给伊姆坎多矮人？

english: Oh yes, of course, that's what I was going to do!
translation: 哦，是的，当然，我正打算这么做！

english: I... sort of... ehm...
translation: 我……有点……呃……

english: Look, I lost it!
translation: 听着，我把它弄丢了！

english: At least you are honest, human.
translation: 至少你很诚实，人类。

english: I found it, actually, after you lost it. I'm not happy with giving it to you again, but the rebuilding of the statue is important.
translation: 实际上，在你弄丢之后，我找到了它。我不太乐意再把它交给你，但重建雕像很重要。

english: Be careful with it this time, alright?
translation: 这次小心点，好吗？

english: Yes, and I've crafted some sapphires on the hilt, look!
translation: 是的，而且我在刀柄上镶嵌了一些蓝宝石，你看！

english: That's a great start! Now if you can find an Imcando dwarf so the blade can be repaired, that would be even better!
translation: 这是个很好的开始！现在如果你能找到伊姆坎多矮人来修复刀片，那就更好了！

english: Yes, and I got Thurgo the Imcando dwarf to fix it up nice and proper! Look!
translation: 是的，而且我让伊姆坎多矮人瑟戈把它修好了，又漂亮又合适！你看！

english: Oh, that's beautiful! All it needs now is three sapphires crafted onto the hilt.
translation: 哦，太美了！现在只需要在刀柄上镶嵌三颗蓝宝石。

english: Yes, and look, it's all fixed up now! I got Thurgo the Imcando dwarf to fix the blade, and I've crafted three sapphires onto the hilt.
translation: 是的，你看，现在全修好了！我让伊姆坎多矮人瑟戈修复了刀片，还在刀柄上镶嵌了三颗蓝宝石。

english: That is amazing! Absolutely astounding work!
translation: 太棒了！绝对令人惊叹的工作！

english: Go and give Blasidar a hand with it then, and make sure to tell him to send it back to me when he's done with it!
translation: 那就去帮布拉西达一把，记得告诉他用完后把它送回给我！

english: Ah, you mean King Alvis' axe? Didn't you give it to Blasidar?
translation: 啊，你是说阿尔维斯国王的斧头？你不是把它交给布拉西达了吗？

english: I did, actually, I was just wondering if he returned it to you yet.
translation: 确实给了，我只是想知道他是否已经还给你了。

english: No, I believe he's still using it.
translation: 没有，我相信他还在用。

english: But thanks for your help with restoring the axe to its former glory!
translation: 不过，感谢你帮忙让这把斧头恢复昔日的荣光！

english: I should be very careful with this battleaxe, it's almost a museum piece! I don't want to damage it by wielding  it.
translation: 我应该非常小心地对待这把战斧，它几乎是一件博物馆藏品！我不想因为挥舞它而损坏它。

english: Can you help me find an Imcando dwarf?
translation: 你能帮我找一个伊姆坎多矮人吗？

english: An Imcando dwarf, you say?
translation: 你说伊姆坎多矮人？

english: Yes, I need the help of an Imcando dwarf to repair an ancient battleaxe.
translation: 是的，我需要伊姆坎多矮人的帮助来修复一把古代战斧。

english: Ah, I'm afraid I can't help you here, Keldagrim lost contact with that particular tribe of dwarves a long time ago.
translation: 啊，恐怕我帮不了你，凯尔达格林城很久以前就和那个特定的矮人部落失去联系了。

english: Is there no one else who can help me?
translation: 没有其他人能帮我吗？

english: I suppose you could try Reldo, in the palace of Varrock. He is a most capable human librarian and knows quite a bit about us dwarves.
translation: 我想你可以试试维洛克城宫殿里的雷尔多。他是一位非常能干的人类图书管理员，对我们矮人了解不少。

english: Do you think he can help me?
translation: 你觉得他能帮我吗？

english: He lives quite a good deal closer to where the Imcando used to live than we do, so it is not unlikely. Tell him Hugi the librarian sent you and I'm sure he'll be happy to help.
translation: 他住的地方比我们离伊姆坎多曾经居住的地方近得多，所以不是没有可能。告诉他图书管理员胡吉派你来的，我相信他会乐意帮忙的。

english: And take a cart to Ice Mountain from the station in the east side of the city. It'll help you get to Varrock faster.
translation: 从城市东边的车站坐推车去冰山。这能帮你更快到达维洛克城。

english: Can you help me with this ancient axe?
translation: 你能帮我处理这把古代斧头吗？

english: No. I don't do that anymore. I'm getting old.
translation: 不。我不再干那活了。我老了。

english: Well, you know what to do! Get me another redberry pie and I'll have a look at that axe of yours!
translation: 嗯，你知道该怎么做！再给我弄个红莓派来，我就看看你那把斧头！

english: You make excellent redberry pies, [player name], so how can I refuse? Let me see what's wrong with it then.
translation: 你做的红莓派很好吃，[player name]，所以我怎么能拒绝呢？那就让我看看它有什么问题。

english: Here... the blade of this axe has become extremely dull and brittle. I need it restored to its former glory.
translation: 给……这把斧头的刀片变得极其钝和脆。我需要它恢复昔日的荣光。

english: Its former glory eh? May I ask where exactly you got this axe from?
translation: 昔日的荣光，嗯？我能问一下你究竟从哪里弄到这把斧头的吗？

english: It was given to me by someone in Keldagrim. I prefer not to say any more than that.
translation: 是凯尔达格林城的一个人给我的。我不想再多说了。

english: Ah, Keldagrim. We have not been there for a long time.
translation: 啊，凯尔达格林城。我们很久没去过那里了。

english: Hand me the axe and I'll fix it right up for you.
translation: 把斧头递给我，我马上帮你修好。

english: Will you need any materials?
translation: 你需要任何材料吗？

english: You don't want any blurite this time?
translation: 这次你不想要蓝铁矿了吗？

english: Oh no, blurite is not appropriate here. No no, this is going to be a very delicate piece of work, requiring only a small amount in the way of raw materials.
translation: 哦不，蓝铁矿在这里不合适。不不，这将是一件非常精细的工作，只需要少量原材料。

english: Can you get me one bar of iron? Then I'll be able to start my work on this.
translation: 你能给我弄一根铁条吗？这样我就能开始处理这个了。

english: I've got one right here.
translation: 我这里就有一根。

english: Good, good! Hand me the axe and I'll get to work.
translation: 好，好！把斧头递给我，我就开始干活。

english: Here's your axe, [player name]. It looks like there's some damage to the hilt as well, probably some missing sapphires. But I'm sure you can take care of that yourself.
translation: 这是你的斧头，[player name]。看起来刀柄也有些损坏，可能缺了几颗蓝宝石。但我相信你自己能处理。

english: Here you go, [player name], good as new.
translation: 给你，[player name]，跟新的一样好。

english: Thanks for your help Thurgo!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，瑟戈！

english: How are you getting along with those items, [player name]?
translation: 那些东西你处理得怎么样了，[player name]？

english: I don't have your boots yet.
translation: 我还没有你的靴子。

english: I have your boots!
translation: 我有你的靴子了！

english: Excellent, excellent! Go and give them to Riki over there so I can start my work on the base of the statue!
translation: 太好了，太好了！拿去给那边的里基，这样我就可以开始雕像底座的工作了！

english: What else?
translation: 还有什么？

english: I don't have your clothes yet.
translation: 我还没有你的衣服。

english: I also don't have your clothes yet, I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕我也还没有你的衣服。

english: I had Vermundi make these clothes!
translation: 我让维尔蒙迪做了这些衣服！

english: Oh yes, Vermundi is a good woman, she's very reliable. Wonderful clothing. Give it to Riki please.
translation: 哦，是的，维尔蒙迪是个好女人，她很可靠。衣服很棒。请把它交给里基。

english: And? The battleaxe?
translation: 还有呢？战斧呢？

english: Sorry, no, I'm still looking for it.
translation: 抱歉，还没有，我还在找。

english: Look a little harder please!
translation: 请再努力找找！

english: Look, I've got it right here.
translation: 看，就在我这儿。

english: What, that old thing? Is that a piece of rubbish you found in the garbage?
translation: 什么，那个旧东西？那是你在垃圾堆里找到的破烂吗？

english: It looks so brittle it might well fall apart at any moment. I can't base my statue on that!
translation: 它看起来那么脆，随时都可能散架。我不能把我的雕像建在那上面！

english: Besides, from what I recall of the original axe, this doesn't even look anything like it.
translation: 而且，根据我对原版斧头的记忆，这看起来一点都不像。

english: Oh, yes, I've got it right here!
translation: 哦，对，就在我这儿！

english: Good job! Riki is your man, right over there. Give it to him please!
translation: 干得好！里基就是你要找的人，就在那边。请把它交给他！

english: Don't worry, I'll be back later with all those items!
translation: 别担心，我稍后会带着所有这些东西回来！

english: Don't worry, I'll be back with the rest of the items later!
translation: 别担心，我稍后会带着剩下的东西回来！

english: I'll be back with the last item before you know it!
translation: 我很快就会带着最后一件东西回来！

english: I have some clothes for you to wear.
translation: 我有一些衣服给你穿。

english: Thank... you.
translation: 谢……谢你。

english: I have this battleaxe for you.
translation: 我有这把战斧给你。

english: Here, I have these boots for you to wear.
translation: 给，我有这双靴子给你穿。

english: And look, I have some clothes as well!
translation: 而且你看，我还有一些衣服！

english: And finally, I have this battleaxe for you!
translation: 最后，我有一把战斧要给你！

english: Hey, you're looking nice in that outfit!
translation: 嘿，你穿着那套衣服看起来不错！

english: Yes... I do.
translation: 是的……不错。

english: So is the job done now?
translation: 那现在工作完成了吗？

english: No... it isn't.
translation: 不……还没有。

english: Care to tell me why not?
translation: 能告诉我为什么吗？

english: It's very tiring trying to talk to you, you know?
translation: 你知道吗，跟你说话真是累人。

english: I've all the items you asked me to get you. Can you make the statue now?
translation: 你要我找的东西我都找齐了。你现在能造雕像了吗？

english: Yes, yes, that will do just fine. There is only one problem now, I still need to make the head.
translation: 对对，这些就够了。但现在还有一个问题，我还得做雕像的头部。

english: So you need me to find a crown now as well?
translation: 所以你还需要我找一顶王冠？

english: How odd, it isn't like you to not complete a task in time.
translation: 真奇怪，你不像是会不及时完成任务的人。

english: Are you not feeling so well today, [player name]? I noticed you didn't complete our task in time.
translation: 你今天是不是不太舒服，[player name]？我注意到你没有按时完成我们的任务。

english: The top floor of the palace is the Meeting Octagon. That's the place where the Consortium makes all the important decisions.
translation: 宫殿的顶层是会议八角厅。那是联合体做出所有重要决定的地方。

english: From what I understand, you have some business to finish with the Brown Engine first.
translation: 据我所知，你得先跟棕色引擎公司办完一些事。

english: Hurry back or don't come back at all!
translation: 快点回来，否则就别回来了！

english: Oh, yes, you certainly can. But not while the Consortium is in session, I would imagine.
translation: 哦，是的，你当然可以。但我想联盟开会的时候不行。

english: Let's hope I was wrong about you, human.
translation: 希望我之前看错你了，人类。

english: Go then! The longer you stand here the more time you waste!
translation: 那就去吧！你站得越久，浪费的时间就越多！

english: Even though you are a very friendly human, I'm not sure if you would be allowed to visit during a meeting.
translation: 虽然你是个很友善的人类，但我不确定开会时是否允许你参观。

english: Do no disappoint the Purple Pewter, human.
translation: 别让紫色锡器公司失望，人类。

english: But I don't know enough about that, the director probably knows more.
translation: 但我不太了解那个，主管可能知道得更多。

english: Perhaps I was wrong about you after all...
translation: 也许我终究是看错你了……

english: You'd better not fail!
translation: 你最好别失败！

english: Go back to your friends at the Yellow Fortune, I hear you're in league with them.
translation: 回到你的黄色命运朋友那里去吧，我听说你跟他们是一伙的。

english: How unusual for you, but it is appreciated nonetheless.
translation: 对你来说真不寻常，不过还是值得赞赏。

english: That is a pleasant and quite unexpected surprise.
translation: 这真是个愉快又相当意外的惊喜。

english: I'd tell you, human, but you wouldn't understand anyway.
translation: 我会告诉你，人类，但反正你也听不懂。

english: That is a privilige one must earn, human, and so far you have only succeeded in insulting the Purple Pewter.
translation: 那是一种必须靠努力才能获得的特权，人类，而到目前为止，你只是成功地侮辱了紫色锡器公司。

english: Oh, so you were just stopping by to waste my time then? Goodbye!
translation: 哦，所以你只是顺道来浪费我的时间？再见！

english: Thought you wouldn't. Now get out of here!
translation: 我就知道你不会。现在滚出去！

english: Leave now, don't make me call in the Black Guard to throw you out!
translation: 现在就走，别逼我叫黑卫队把你扔出去！

english: And good riddance to you.
translation: 走了也好。

english: Do I look like a tour guide to you?
translation: 我看起来像导游吗？

english: Get out of our office then!
translation: 那就滚出我们的办公室！

english: I'm not here to give directions!
translation: 我不是来这里指路的！

english: To say a thing like that after the mercy I just showed you! Go away!
translation: 在我刚刚对你表现出仁慈之后，你竟然说出这种话！走开！

english: The Purple Pewter is pleased that the trust it put in you has not been put to shame after all.
translation: 紫色锡器公司很高兴，它对你的信任终究没有蒙羞。

english: You ran out of time for your task. I knew you would! Get out of here!
translation: 你的任务时间到了。我就知道你会这样！滚出去！

english: You didn't finish in time. You're rubbish!
translation: 你没按时完成。你真没用！

english: Go back to your friends at the Green Gemstone, I hear you're in league with them.
translation: 回到你的绿色宝石朋友那里去吧，我听说你跟他们是一伙的。

english: Go back to your friends at the White Chisel, I hear you're in league with them.
translation: 回到你的白色凿子朋友那里去吧，我听说你跟他们是一伙的。

english: Go back to your friends at the Silver Cog, I hear you're in league with them.
translation: 回到你的银色齿轮朋友那里去吧，我听说你跟他们是一伙的。

english: The Purple Pewter offers you a chance and you say this? Just stay away!
translation: 紫色锡器公司给你机会，你却这么说？离远点！

english: Mind you, the Purple Pewter does pride itself on high quality and you're not, shall I say, the best smither around. Perhaps you will find things easier with the White Chisel.
translation: 注意，紫色锡器公司以高品质为傲，而你——恕我直言——并不是镇上最好的铁匠。也许你在白色凿子公司会轻松些。

english: By Guthix, who do you think you are??
translation: 以古斯神之名，你以为你是谁？？

english: Don't you have some business with the Green Gemstone to deal with first? Hurry back when you're done!
translation: 你是不是得先跟绿色宝石公司办点事？办完了赶紧回来！

english: Finally... back to work at last.
translation: 终于……总算回来工作了。

english: Get out.
translation: 滚出去。

english: Don't you have some business with the Blue Opal to deal with first? Hurry back when you're done!
translation: 你是不是得先跟蓝色蛋白石公司办点事？办完了赶紧回来！

english: Now.
translation: 现在。

english: Don't hurry back.
translation: 别急着回来。

english: The door is over there. I suggest you use it.
translation: 门在那边。我建议你用它。

english: Go back to your friends at the Brown Engine, I hear you're in league with them.
translation: 回到你的棕色引擎朋友那里去吧，我听说你跟他们是一伙的。

english: Get out of these offices and don't come back!
translation: 滚出这些办公室，别再回来了！

english: Mind, the Purple Pewter prides itself on high quality. And you are not, well, you are not really the best miner in town so to speak. Perhaps things would be easier for you with the White Chisel.
translation: 注意，紫色锡器公司以高品质为傲。而你——嗯——说实话，你并不是镇上最好的矿工。也许你在白色凿子公司会轻松些。

english: Have you completed your task yet? Did you get our [number] pieces of [copper ore/tin ore/clay/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]?
translation: 你的任务完成了吗？你拿到我们需要的[number]块[copper ore/tin ore/clay/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]了吗？

english: Yes, the [company name] always has work to do!
translation: 是的，[company name]总是有活干！

english: Oh yes, as you know the [company name] always has work!
translation: 哦对，你知道的，[company name]总是有工作！

english: The [company name] is pleased to offer more work to an eager worker such as yourself, [player name]!
translation: [company name]很乐意为像你这样热心的工人提供更多工作，[player name]！

english: We need [number] pieces of [copper ore/tin ore/clay/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] in the next [number] minutes.
translation: 我们需要[number]块[copper ore/tin ore/clay/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]，限时[number]分钟。

english: The [company name] has noted your willingness to help.
translation: [company name]已经注意到你乐于助人的态度。

english: The [company name] appreciates the hard work you do.
translation: [company name]感谢你付出的辛勤劳动。

english: The [company name] isn't too pleased to hear that.
translation: [company name]听到这个不太高兴。

english: I need to speak to the director.

english: But you don't understand. I've come from Blasidar the sculptor.
translation: 但你不明白。我是从雕塑家布拉西达那里来的。

english: Blasidar does not command the [company name].
translation: 布拉西达无权指挥[company name]。

english: But... Commander Veldaban of the Black Guard has instructed me to do this!
translation: 但是……黑卫队的维尔达班指挥官指示我这么做的！

english: How can I prove myself?

english: The [company name] appreciates what you have done so far, [player name], but the director will only speak to the most loyal of followers.
translation: [company name]感谢你迄今为止所做的一切，[player name]，但董事只与最忠诚的追随者交谈。

english: What else must I do to prove myself?

english: I've completed your task! Here is your ore!
translation: 我完成了你的任务！这是你的矿石！

english: The [company name] recognizes your performance.
translation: [company name]认可你的表现。

english: You have done a great service to the [company name]!

english: The Consortium controls the Black Guard, not the other way around!
translation: 财团控制着黑卫队，而不是反过来！

translation: 你不应该对人说这种话。

english: It is agreed then! You are now a 'trusted associate' of the [company name]. Welcome!

english: I will not disappoint you!

english: Do you have any more tasks for me?

english: Verily, I believe I do.
translation: 确实，我相信我有。

english: I do believe so, yes.
translation: 我确实这么认为，是的。

translation: 当然。

translation: 也不是黄色财富公司的！

english: Ask the Blue Opal for a job instead!
translation: 不如去向蓝色蛋白石要份工作！

english: You are in league with the Blue Opal, aren't you? Your question is inappropriate.
translation: 你和蓝色蛋白石是一伙的，不是吗？你的问题不合适。

english: Since you're so fond of the Blue Opal, why don't you ask them?
translation: 既然你这么喜欢蓝色蛋白石，为什么不去问他们？

english: Aren't you an associate of the Blue Opal? Why do you ask me?
translation: 你不是蓝色蛋白石的伙伴吗？为什么来问我？

english: Since you're so fond of the Green Gemstone, why don't you ask them?
translation: 既然你这么喜欢绿色宝石，为什么不去问他们？

english: But the statue is clearly male! It can't have a female head!
translation: 但雕像明显是男性！怎么能安上一个女性头像！

english: Hmm, interesting, a human joining the Silver Cog.
translation: 嗯，有意思，一个人类加入了银齿轮。

english: Have you ever considered joining the Silver Cog, [player name]? You would truly make a marvelous member.
translation: 你有没有考虑过加入银齿轮，[player name]？你绝对会成为一位出色的成员。

english: It is agreed then! You are now a 'trusted associate' of the Silver Cog. Welcome!
translation: 那就这么定了！你现在是银齿轮的“信任伙伴”了。欢迎！

english: The Silver Cog appreciates what you're doing, [player name].
translation: 银齿轮很感激你所做的一切，[player name]。

english: So no, I cannot grant you this request yet, but I will certainly keep it in mind. In the mean time make sure you help out the Silver Cog in any way you can.
translation: 所以不行，我还不能答应你的这个请求，但我肯定会记在心里。与此同时，请务必尽你所能帮助银齿轮。

english: You are proving yourself a loyal member of the Silver Cog, [player name]!
translation: 你在证明自己是银齿轮的忠实成员，[player name]！

english: The Silver Cog can always rely on you, [player name].
translation: 银齿轮永远可以信赖你，[player name]。

english: Have you come to serve the Silver Cog again, [player name]?
translation: 你是来再次为银齿轮效劳的吗，[player name]？

english: You are an exceptional member of the Silver Cog.
translation: 你是银齿轮的杰出成员。

english: You are a true asset to the Silver Cog!
translation: 你真是银齿轮的一大财富！

english: Were what? A part of the Silver Cog?
translation: 是什么？是银齿轮的一部分？

english: I'm not altogether sure... much appreciated though you are, you are not really part of the Silver Cog. Not as such.
translation: 我不太确定……虽然你很受赏识，但你并不是真正的银齿轮成员。严格来说不是。

english: And how can the Silver Cog be of service to you today, [player name]?
translation: 今天银齿轮能为你做些什么吗，[player name]？

english: The Silver Cog is pleased to see you again!
translation: 银齿轮很高兴再次见到你！

english: Ah, if only all the members of the Silver Cog had such dedication as you.
translation: 啊，要是银齿轮的所有成员都像你一样有奉献精神就好了。

english: Until later, then, my friend! I'm sure the Silver Cog will play a role in your future again at some point!
translation: 那就回头见，我的朋友！我相信银齿轮一定会在你未来的某个时刻再次发挥作用！

english: Hello [player name]! Have you seen the statue? It looks beautiful! The Silver Cog is indebted to you for your dedication in making this happen!
translation: 你好[player name]！你看到那座雕像了吗？它看起来美极了！银齿轮感激你为实现这一切所付出的奉献！

english: Nor of the Silver Cog!
translation: 也不是银齿轮的！

english: Aren't you an associate of the Brown Engine? Why do you ask me?
translation: 你不是棕色引擎的伙伴吗？为什么问我？

english: Yes... things would have been so much easier with the statue.
translation: 是啊……要是有那座雕像，事情就会简单多了。

english: No, not yet... He may still prove useful to us.
translation: 不，还没……他可能对我们还有用。

english: No, not yet... She may still prove useful to us.
translation: 不，还没……她可能对我们还有用。

english: Damage... severe... Task... incomplete...
translation: 损伤...严重...任务...未完成...

english: Shall I try to repair you?
translation: 要我试着修理你吗？

english: Repairs... needed...
translation: 需要...修理...

english: I'm not going to find a conversation here!
translation: 我在这里找不到什么可聊的！

english: Graar!
translation: 格拉尔！

english: Must... not... injure... human...
translation: 必须...不能...伤害...人类...

english: Damage... severe...
translation: 损伤...严重...

english: Damage... severe... task... incomplete...
translation: 损坏……严重……任务……未完成……

english: Damage repaired...
translation: 损伤已修复...

english: Thank you. My body and mind are fully healed.
translation: 谢谢你。我的身心都已完全恢复。

english: Now I must complete my task by defeating the great enemy.
translation: 现在我必须击败大敌，完成任务。

english: What enemy?
translation: 什么敌人？

english: A great demon. It broke through from its dimension to attack the city.
translation: 一个强大的恶魔。它从它的维度突破过来攻击城市。

english: The golem army was created to fight it. Many were destroyed, but we drove the demon back!
translation: 魔像军队被创造出来对抗它。许多被摧毁了，但我们把恶魔赶了回去！

english: The demon is still wounded. You must open the portal so that I can strike the final blow and complete my task.
translation: 恶魔仍然受伤。你必须打开传送门，这样我才能给予最后一击，完成任务。

english: My task is incomplete. You must open the portal so I can defeat the great demon.
translation: 我的任务未完成。你必须打开传送门，这样我才能击败大恶魔。

english: How do I open the portal?
translation: 我该如何打开传送门？

english: The four statuettes in the temple must be turned to the correct pattern.
translation: 神殿里的四个小雕像必须转到正确的图案。

english: I do not know the pattern. Golems are not permitted to open the portal.
translation: 我不知道图案。魔像不被允许打开传送门。

english: What makes you think you can defeat the demon?
translation: 是什么让你认为你能击败恶魔？

english: If not I, then who else?  No living being can destroy the demon. That is why the golems were created in the first place.
translation: 如果不是我，那还有谁？没有生物能摧毁恶魔。这就是最初创造魔像的原因。

english: But the demon was badly wounded and elder-demons heal very slowly indeed. It was almost dead when it retreated to its own dimension.
translation: 但恶魔受了重伤，上古恶魔的恢复确实非常缓慢。它退回自己的维度时几乎已经死了。

english: Now that I am repaired, I will be able to destroy it easily!
translation: 现在我已经修复，我将能轻易摧毁它！

english: I found a letter in the desert with your name on.
translation: 我在沙漠里发现了一封写有你名字的信。

english: Ah, so you've found the ruins of Uzer.
translation: 啊，所以你找到了乌泽废墟。

english: AI wrote that letter to my late husband when he was exploring there.
translation: 艾在我已故丈夫在那里探险时写了那封信给他。

english: that was a great city as well, but the museum could only fund one excavation and this one was closer to home.
translation: 那也是一座伟大的城市，但博物馆只能资助一次发掘，而这次离家更近。

english: If you're interested in his expedition, the notes he made are in the library in the Exam Centre.
translation: 如果你对他的探险感兴趣，他做的笔记在考试中心的图书馆里。

english: Where did you say the notes were?
translation: 你说笔记在哪里？

english: They're on a bookcase in the Exam Centre.
translation: 它们在考试中心的一个书架上。

english: Where is the statuette that Varmen took back from Uzer?
translation: 瓦门从乌泽带回来的小雕像在哪里？

english: The statuette?  Oh, yes...
translation: 小雕像？哦，是的...

english: That statuette was the only thing we had to show from that expedition.
translation: 那个小雕像是我们那次探险唯一能展示的东西。

english: It was very worn, but you can still make out a lot of detail. The Uzerians were expert sculptors. It's a pity we only have that small example.
translation: 它非常磨损，但你仍然能看出很多细节。乌泽人是技艺精湛的雕刻家。可惜我们只有那个小样品。

english: Now it's on display in the Varrock museum.
translation: 现在它在维洛克城博物馆展出。

english: I'm looking for a statuette recovered from the city of Uzer.
translation: 我在找一个从乌泽城找回的小雕像。

english: Ah yes, a very impressive artefact. The people of that city were excellent sculptors.
translation: 啊，是的，一件非常令人印象深刻的手工艺品。那座城市的人们是出色的雕刻家。

english: It's in the display case upstairs.
translation: 它在楼上的展示柜里。

english: No, I need to take it away with me.
translation: 不，我需要把它带走。

english: What do you want it for?
translation: 你要它做什么？

english: I want to open a portal to the lair of an elder-demon.
translation: 我想打开一个通往上古恶魔巢穴的传送门。

english: Good heavens! I'd never let you do such a dangerous thing.
translation: 天哪！我绝不会让你做这么危险的事。

english: Well, I, er, just want it.
translation: 嗯，我，呃，就是想要它。

english: Well, you can't have it! This museum never lets go of its treasures.
translation: 嗯，你不能拿走！这个博物馆从不放手它的宝藏。

english: That statuette was stolen recently, but now it's been returned.
translation: 那个小雕像最近被偷了，但现在已经被归还了。

english: I opened the portal.
translation: 我打开了传送门。

english: Golems cannot pass through the portal. But the demon will soon emerge. I must ready myself for combat!
translation: 魔像无法穿过传送门。但恶魔很快就会出现。我必须准备好战斗！

english: It's okay, the demon is dead!
translation: 没事了，恶魔死了！

english: The demon must be defeated...
translation: 恶魔必须被击败...

english: No, you don't understand. I saw the demon's skeleton. It must have died of its wounds.
translation: 不，你不明白。我看到了恶魔的骷髅。它一定是因伤而死。

english: Demon must be defeated! Task incomplete.
translation: 恶魔必须被击败！任务未完成。

english: I already told you, he's dead!
translation: 我已经告诉过你，他死了！

english: Task incomplete.
translation: 任务未完成。

english: Oh, how am I going to convince you?
translation: 哦，我该怎么说服你？

english: New instructions... Updating program...
translation: 新指令...更新程序...

english: Task complete!
translation: 任务完成！

english: Thank you. Now my mind is at rest.
translation: 谢谢你，我现在安心了。

english: I saw one of the the men in dark robes run out of the temple. He looked very frightened and I feared for his safety.
translation: 我看到一个穿黑袍的人从神殿里跑了出来。他看起来很害怕，我担心他的安全。

english: I'm looking for a bold and true adventurer to help me with a...a...a little problem?
translation: 我在找一个勇敢又真诚的冒险者来帮我解决一个……一个……小问题？

english: Well you've found one... Say, you don't look much like a pirate.
translation: 嗯，你找到了一个……话说，你看起来不太像海盗。

english: In fact, you look a little ill.
translation: 事实上，你看起来有点病恹恹的。

english: A little more than ill, in fact...
translation: 事实上，比病恹恹还要严重一点……

english: That's all part of the problem...and we can't talk here.
translation: 这就是问题的一部分……我们不能在这里谈。

english: This is starting to sound a little bit dodgy, and I do appreciate I'm in a hive of scum and villainy as I say this.
translation: 这听起来开始有点可疑了，而且我很清楚我正身处一个渣滓和恶棍的巢穴里说这话。

english: Is there any part of your problem you can tell me?
translation: 你的问题有没有哪部分能告诉我？

english: Well, all I can say is that I am from a small, cloistered order of monks from a tiny island nearby, and that we have a problem with undead pirates...
translation: 嗯，我只能说我来自附近一个小岛上与世隔绝的僧侣教团，我们遇到了不死海盗的问题……

english: Undead pirates? Let me at em!
translation: 不死海盗？让我去会会他们！

english: Oh, you'll help? Wonderful!
translation: 哦，你愿意帮忙？太好了！

english: Now, I'll just transport us to the island...
translation: 现在，我这就把我们传送到岛上……

english: No hitting! No hitting!
translation: 别打！别打！

english: Are you all right, my child?
translation: 你还好吗，我的孩子？

english: Sorry, sorry.
translation: 抱歉，抱歉。

english: I just get this thumping pain in the back of my head whenever I think about travelling to an island full of undead pirates.
translation: 每次一想到要去一个满是亡灵海盗的岛，我后脑勺就会一阵剧痛。

english: I have no idea why.
translation: 我也不知道为什么。

english: Hmm, that is odd. Have you considered seeing a doctor?
translation: 嗯，真奇怪。你有没有考虑过去看医生？

english: No, but I might well do soon if it keeps up.
translation: 没有，但如果继续这样，我可能很快就会去。

english: Anyway, I'll just use the teleport spell I created. Let's go!
translation: 总之，我就用我创造的传送法术。走吧！

english: Zombies! Back away from those monks now!
translation: 僵尸！立刻离那些僧侣远点！

english: Wait! Wait! We ARE monks!
translation: 等等！等等！我们就是僧侣！

english: What? Seriously? Zombie monks?
translation: 什么？真的？僵尸僧侣？

english: Honestly, they are with us, and they aren't zombies.
translation: 老实说，他们和我们是一起的，而且他们不是僵尸。

english: Sort of, at any rate.
translation: 至少，某种程度上不是。

english: It's true. We need your help...will you at least listen to us?
translation: 是真的。我们需要你的帮助……你至少愿意听我们说吗？

english: Okay, but the first one of you that lunges for my brain will be strung up and beaten until they are dead...or very, very sorry.
translation: 好吧，但你们中第一个扑向我大脑的，会被吊起来打到死……或者非常非常后悔。

english: Oh, but of course. I understand that this is very confusing.
translation: 哦，当然。我理解这很令人困惑。

english: We are a cloistered order of Saradominist monks. We use this island's relative isolation to translate and illuminate books. We even have a treaty with the pirates; they leave us alone and we provide the occasional
translation: 我们是一个与世隔绝的萨拉多明僧侣教团。我们利用这个岛的相对隔绝来翻译和阐释书籍。我们甚至和海盗有条约；他们不打扰我们，我们偶尔提供

english: blessing they might need.
translation: 他们可能需要的祝福。

english: This morning, however, we were awakened by the sound of a ship running aground and, as we readied ourselves to venture out to look for survivors, zombie pirates poured into the monastery.
translation: 然而今天早上，我们被一艘船搁浅的声音吵醒，当我们准备好出去寻找幸存者时，僵尸海盗涌入了修道院。

english: Were they particularly drunken-looking?
translation: 他们看起来特别醉醺醺的吗？

english: Not that we could tell. They seemed to be being given orders by a twisted little zombie called Mi-Gor and his cadre of sorebones.
translation: 我们看不出来。他们似乎是由一个叫米戈尔的扭曲小僵尸和他的索尔博恩斯骨干指挥的。

english: Some of us, like myself, were dragged away.
translation: 我们中的一些人，比如我，被拖走了。

english: I remember a terrible pain, and then woke up in this body with Mi-Gor nearby, gloating about having 'enhanced' a zombie with a non-rotting brain.
translation: 我记得一阵剧痛，然后就在这具身体里醒来，米戈尔就在附近，得意洋洋地说他用一个不腐烂的大脑'强化'了一个僵尸。

english: I laid low, pretending to still be unconscious and, after a while, made my move, freeing the others that had been 'enhanced'.
translation: 我潜伏起来，假装仍然昏迷，过了一会儿，我行动了，释放了其他被'强化'的人。

english: We fought our way to the granary and have barred the doors. We stored our now brainless bodies downstairs in case we can be put back to normal.
translation: 我们一路杀到粮仓，并闩上了门。我们把现在没有大脑的身体存放在楼下，以防我们能被恢复原状。

english: And what have they done as a result?
translation: 结果他们做了什么？

english: It looked like they were going to storm the doors, but then Mi-Gor called them off.
translation: 看起来他们打算冲门，但后来米戈尔把他们叫走了。

english: Called them off? Any idea why?
translation: 叫走了？知道为什么吗？

english: No, none whatsoever.
translation: 不，完全不知道。

english: Now that you know our plight, will you help us?
translation: 既然你知道我们的困境了，你愿意帮我们吗？

english: There is a secret tunnel into the monastery under the statue in the garden. If you get inside, you can find out what they are planning and we can counter it.
translation: 花园里的雕像下面有一条通往修道院的秘密隧道。如果你能进去，就能发现他们的计划，我们就能反击。

english: Excuse me...oh, it's you.
translation: 打扰一下……哦，是你。

english: Have you thought any more about helping our order?
translation: 你有没有再考虑帮助我们的教团？

english: Er, I might have done. What was the problem again?
translation: 呃，我可能考虑过。问题是什么来着？

english: Our island has been overrun by undead pirates.
translation: 我们的岛被不死海盗占领了。

english: So, have you found anything out about the pirates' plans?
translation: 那么，你发现海盗的计划了吗？

english: Nothing yet... What would you recommend doing again?
translation: 还没有……你建议怎么做来着？

english: Well, the secret passage into the monastery is located in the gardens.
translation: 嗯，进入修道院的秘密通道在花园里。

english: If you pull the statue there out of the way you'll be able to get into the tunnels, and from there into the monastery.
translation: 如果你把那里的雕像移开，就能进入隧道，然后从那里进入修道院。

english: I suppose I should view this as a test of faith...
translation: 我想我应该把这看作是对信仰的考验……

english: Except the holy texts are light on plagues of zombie pirates.
translation: 只是圣典里关于僵尸海盗瘟疫的内容很少。

english: Zombies! What ever will we do?
translation: 僵尸！我们该怎么办？

english: Keep calm. I'm a professional. I'll take care of it.
translation: 保持冷静。我是专业人士。我来处理。

english: I knew I should have been a bricklayer...
translation: 我就知道我应该当个砌砖工……

english: I don't want to lose my brain!
translation: 我不想失去我的大脑！

english: You won't, trust me!
translation: 你不会的，相信我！

english: I was almost all the way through translating that book too...
translation: 我差点就把那本书翻译完了……

english: What if they get in while I'm asleep? Oh no!
translation: 要是他们在我睡觉时进来怎么办？哦不！

english: So, have you dealt with this sort of problem before?
translation: 那么，你以前处理过这类问题吗？

english: Sure, although the zombies were drunker, the hostages were less holy and the island was known for exporting swill, not piety.
translation: 当然，虽然那些僵尸更醉醺醺的，人质没那么神圣，而且那个岛以出口泔水而非虔诚闻名。

english: Oh, well that's okay then.
translation: 哦，那好吧。

english: Glabburbleglubble...
translation: 格拉布布格布……

english: Blubblelubblebubblelubble...
translation: 布卢布卢布布卢布卢……

english: Plib!
translation: 普利布！

english: Blublublubluh...
translation: 布卢布卢布卢布卢……

english: Wow, without a brain, these monks seem a lot less holy all of a sudden...
translation: 哇，没了大脑，这些僧侣突然看起来没那么神圣了……

english: *Wheeze*I have received a summons to attend to the Captain and so will be 'down below' for a while.
translation: *喘息*我收到了船长的召唤，所以会'在下面'待一会儿。

english: *Wheeze*How is the gas production progressing?
translation: *喘息*气体生产进展如何？

english: Arr, it be progressin' well...
translation: 啊，进展顺利……

english: *Wheeze*What is it? I can smell your lie, whelp.
translation: *喘息*怎么回事？我能闻到你的谎言，小子。

english: No, no! 'Tis just that we need more ingredients fer enough te blanket the island!
translation: 不，不！只是我们需要更多原料才能覆盖整个岛！

english: If ye'd just let us storm the granary we'd be able te take them monks out real easy like.
translation: 如果你让我们冲进粮仓，我们就能轻松搞定那些僧侣。

english: Why, that thing of yers could hammer the wall down...
translation: 哎呀，你那玩意儿能把墙锤倒……

english: *Wheeze!*Silence! I will not be questioned by underlings!
translation: *喘息！*安静！我不会被下属质问！

english: *Wheeze*If you or the others do not consider yourselves capable of carrying out Rabid Jack's orders, then perhaps you need to spend some time in 'The Box'!
translation: *喘息*如果你或其他人认为自己没有能力执行狂犬杰克的命令，那么也许你们需要在'盒子'里待一段时间！

english: Rabid Jack! That name again...
translation: 狂犬杰克！又是这个名字……

english: Please, no! Not 'The Box'!
translation: 求你了，不要！别是'盒子'！

english: The sleeping gas will be ready as planned, Surgeon General. Those monks will be takin' a nap for a week when they get a whiff of it, and the experiments will not stand a chance.
translation: 催眠气体会按计划准备好，外科将军。那些僧侣一闻到就会睡上一周，实验品们毫无机会。

english: *Wheeze*Excellent...the gas will leave the brain intact for the next stage.
translation: *喘息*太好了……气体会让大脑完好无损，为下一阶段做准备。

english: *Wheeze*This time there will be no rebellion amongst the subjects.
translation: *喘息*这次实验品中不会再有反抗了。

english: *Wheeze*Rabid Jack will have his crew of enhanced zombies and I will have as many test subjects as I can vivisect!
translation: *喘息*狂犬杰克会得到他的强化僵尸船员，而我会有尽可能多的活体解剖实验品！

english: *Wheeze*Hekhekhekhek!
translation: *喘息*嘿嘿嘿嘿！

english: Sleeping gas! I have to tell the monks about this right now! I only hope I have time...
translation: 催眠气体！我必须立刻告诉僧侣们！我只希望我还有时间……

english: The pirates are planning on using some sort of sleeping gas to knock you all out!
translation: 海盗们计划用某种催眠气体把你们全部弄晕！

english: When everyone is unconscious, they are going to come in and take you away for brain-swaps!
translation: 等所有人都昏迷后，他们会进来把你们带走进行大脑交换！

english: Fiendish!
translation: 太恶毒了！

english: We have to prepare our defence against this threat. I recall something that might well help...
translation: 我们必须准备防御这个威胁。我记得有样东西可能很有帮助……

english: Is it some sort of potion to counteract the poison?
translation: 是某种对抗毒药的药水吗？

english: No, no. You see, the gas will work on us faster than a normal poison, and a potion would take too long to diffuse through the stomach.
translation: 不，不。你看，气体对我们起作用比普通毒药更快，而药水通过胃扩散需要太长时间。

english: No, what I'm thinking of is a prayer written centuries ago by one of the abbots at the Edgeville Monastery.
translation: 不，我想的是边陲镇修道院的一位院长在几个世纪前写的一篇祈祷文。

english: protected.
translation: 保护。

english: Hmm, how come I've never heard of this prayer?
translation: 嗯，我怎么从来没听说过这个祈祷文？

english: Well, the abbot was slain by a group of raiders. Apparently his faith was little protection against their repeated sword blows.
translation: 嗯，那位院长被一群袭击者杀害了。显然他的信仰在反复的剑击面前没什么保护作用。

english: Anyway, the book of prayers he wrote was stored in the Edgeville Monastery, so you will need to go there and retrieve it. And quickly!
translation: 总之，他写的祈祷书存放在边陲镇修道院，所以你需要去那里取回来。而且要快！

english: Here, I'll take you straight back to Mos Le'Harmless.
translation: 来，我直接把你送回莫斯勒哈姆斯岛。

english: Do you have the book?
translation: 你有那本书吗？

english: Oh, well hurry to the Edgeville Monastery and get it. We haven't got a moment to lose!
translation: 哦，那就快去边陲镇修道院拿。我们一刻也不能耽误！

english: Yes, in my bank.
translation: 是的，在我的银行里。

english: What use is it there? Go get it and hurry back. We haven't got a moment to lose!
translation: 放在那里有什么用？去拿来，赶紧回来。我们一刻也不能耽误！

english: Yes, I have your book here.
translation: 是的，你的书在我这儿。

english: When you took the book from the shelf, did you say the words?
translation: 你从架子上拿书的时候，念了那些话吗？

english: Words? What words?
translation: 话？什么话？

english: The words! The words of power that would prevent...
translation: 那些话！那些能阻止……的力量之语！

english: Wait a moment, I forgot to tell you them, didn't I?
translation: 等等，我忘了告诉你那些话了，对吧？

english: Yes! There were no words! What were they supposed to prevent?
translation: 没错！根本没有什么话！它们本该阻止什么？

english: Oh dear...in all the excitement I completely forgot about them...
translation: 哦，天哪……刚才太兴奋了，我完全把它们给忘了……

english: I do hope that we can fix things before the locusts arrive...
translation: 我真希望我们能在蝗虫到来之前把事情解决……

english: Silly me, all this excitement - and likely that crude brain-operation - made me totally forget. I'm sure that it'll all work out somehow.
translation: 我真糊涂，这一通兴奋——再加上那场粗鲁的大脑手术——让我彻底忘了。我相信总会有办法解决的。

english: LOCUSTS?
translation: 蝗虫？

english: Oh, don't worry, it'll only be a little swarm.
translation: 哦，别担心，只是一小群蝗虫而已。

english: Now, back to business.
translation: 好了，说回正事。

english: So have you read the book?
translation: 那么，你读过那本书了吗？

english: Well, you should give it a try now, just in case there is anything else you need.
translation: 嗯，你现在最好读一读，以防你还需要别的东西。

english: No point in going all the way to Harmony and then back because you need something else.
translation: 没必要因为缺了什么东西，就大老远跑到和谐岛再跑回来。

english: Yes, I have read the prayer and I know how to perform it.
translation: 是的，我已经读过祈祷文，知道该怎么做了。

english: Great! Do you have everything you'll need?
translation: 太好了！你需要的东西都准备好了吗？

english: No, I need to go and get a holy symbol.
translation: 不，我还得去弄一个神圣护符。

english: Well hurry! Who knows what depredations are going on back on Harmony!
translation: 那就快去吧！谁知道和谐岛上现在正发生着什么劫难！

english: Yes, I have the book and the holy symbol I need.
translation: 是的，我有了需要的书和神圣护符。

english: Excellent! Back to Harmony!
translation: 太好了！回和谐岛去！

english: Quickly, the pirates have released the gas! Use the prayer. The other brothers will help make it powerful enough to cover the whole of the granary.
translation: 快，海盗们释放了毒气！快用祈祷文。其他兄弟会帮忙，让它的力量足以覆盖整个谷仓。

english: Quickly, the pirates have released the gas! Use the prayer, the other brothers will help make it powerful enough to cover the whole of the granary.
translation: 快，海盗们释放了毒气！快用祈祷文，其他兄弟会帮忙，让它的力量足以覆盖整个谷仓。

english: Are you alright? We dragged you back inside as quickly as we could.
translation: 你还好吗？我们尽快把你拖回来了。

english: Woah...that gas is pretty potent... I'll need to wear my diving gear outside so that I don't get knocked out again.
translation: 哇……那气体真够劲……我得穿着潜水装备在外面，免得再被熏晕过去。

english: So long as you are unharmed, that is the main thing.
translation: 只要你没事就好，这才是最重要的。

english: Well done! The power of Saradomin will keep the poison from affecting anyone within these walls.
translation: 干得好！萨拉多曼的力量会保护这墙内的人不受毒气影响。

english: So what now? Want me to go and kill the zombies?
translation: 那现在呢？要我去杀那些僵尸吗？

english: Well, fun as that would be, I was wondering if you could help us get our brains back into the right bodies.
translation: 嗯，虽然那会很有趣，但我在想你能不能帮我们把大脑放回正确的身体里。

english: You know, that was what I was going to suggest next.
translation: 你知道吗，我正想接下来就这么建议。

english: So what do you want me to do, scrub up and grab a pair of pliers or something?
translation: 那你想要我做什么，洗干净手，拿把钳子什么的？

english: While I trust your skills in all other areas, I can state without fear of contradiction when I say that you are not a brain surgeon.
translation: 虽然在其他方面我信任你的技能，但我可以毫不夸张地说，你绝不是脑外科医生。

english: No, what we want you to do is bring Doctor Fenkenstrain to us to do the operation.
translation: 不，我们想让你把芬肯斯特兰医生带来做手术。

english: That evil, demented, eye-rollingly insane butcher? What could you want with him and his twisted...
translation: 那个邪恶、疯狂、翻着白眼的屠夫？你找他和他那扭曲的……

english: ...brain transplanting...
translation: ……大脑移植术……

english: In addition to wanting him to come here and help us, we also would like to let the poor soul atone for his sins and for his attempts to meddle in domains into which man was never meant to pry.
translation: 除了想让他来这里帮助我们，我们也希望让这个可怜的灵魂为他犯下的罪孽赎罪，为他妄图涉足人类不该窥探的领域而赎罪。

english: Basically, I think when you tell him we have a werewolf- freeplace for him here on the island, I'm sure he'll agree to come.
translation: 基本上，我想当你告诉他，我们在岛上给他准备了一个没有狼人的地方时，他肯定会同意来的。

english: Well, I cant say I agree with this...but I do appreciate that he's likely the only person that knows his way around the inside of someone's skull.
translation: 嗯，我不能说我同意这个……但我确实认为他大概是唯一一个熟悉别人脑袋内部的人。

english: You have my word that he will not be able to continue his depraved experiments here on this island and will instead be moulded into a useful and faithful follower of Saradomin.
translation: 我向你保证，他不能在这个岛上继续他那堕落的实验，而是会被塑造成一个有用且忠诚的萨拉多曼信徒。

english: Tell him that he is welcome here in exchange for his help.
translation: 告诉他，只要他愿意帮忙，这里就欢迎他。

english: What did the doctor say?
translation: 医生怎么说？

english: I haven't been to see him yet.
translation: 我还没去找他。

english: Well, when you do, try your best to persuade him to help.
translation: 嗯，等你去了，尽量说服他帮忙。

english: Want me to take you back to Mos Le'Harmless?
translation: 要我送你回莫斯勒哈姆斯岛吗？

english: Are they here yet? I can hear them...howling!
translation: 他们来了吗？我能听到他们……在嚎叫！

english: For all the things you've done, I'd like to pour barbecue sauce on your head and pitch you out that window.
translation: 就凭你做的那些事，我真想把烧烤酱倒在你头上，然后把你扔出那扇窗户。

english: Instead, I've come to offer you a way out of this castle.
translation: 不过，我是来给你指条离开这座城堡的路的。

english: Anything, anything. I will do anything to escape the wolves!
translation: 什么都行，什么都行。只要能逃离那些狼，我什么都愿意做！

english: Would you perform multiple brain surgeries on a number of zombie monks?
translation: 你愿意给几个僵尸僧侣做多次大脑手术吗？

english: I think you heard me. A number of monks on an island off the coast of Mos Le'Harmless have had their brains placed in zombie pirate bodies, and vice versa, and they want you to switch them back.
translation: 我想你听到了。莫斯勒哈姆斯岛海岸外的一个岛上，有一群修士的大脑被放进了僵尸海盗的身体里，反之亦然，他们想让你把他们换回来。

english: I see...and how long have you been hearing these 'monks' talking to you?
translation: 我明白了……你听这些‘僧侣’跟你说话有多久了？

english: Hands up, everyone who is being hunted by packs of ravenous killer werewolves!
translation: 所有被一群凶残的杀手狼人追杀的人，举起手来！

english: Oh, why, that would be you, doctor.
translation: 哦，为什么，那不就是你吗，医生。

english: Alright, alright! Whatever you say!
translation: 好吧，好吧！你说什么都行！

english: I mean, you have to admit that this is a little...unlikely a scenario.
translation: 我是说，你得承认这情景有点……不太可能。

english: Oh yes, I'm sure that a man that stitches corpses together for a living would be a good judge of rationality.
translation: 哦，是啊，我敢肯定，一个靠缝合尸体为生的人，一定是个判断理性的好手。

english: Did you come here to ask me something or just to insult me?
translation: 你来这儿是问我什么事，还是就为了侮辱我？

english: And my medical practice was my living. The corpses thing was just a hobby.
translation: 而且，我的医疗实践才是我的生计。摆弄尸体只是个爱好。

english: Yes, I came here to tell you that a group of monks need your services, and that they are willing to shelter you from the werewolves if you will use your medical skills to help them.
translation: 是的，我来这儿是告诉你，有一群僧侣需要你的服务，而且如果你愿意用你的医术帮助他们，他们愿意为你提供庇护，让你免受狼人的侵害。

english: Hmm, sounds like an offer I'd have to be really mad to refuse...
translation: 嗯，听起来是个我疯了才会拒绝的提议……

english: I accept, but you'll have to get me past those werewolves.
translation: 我接受，但你得带我穿过那些狼人。

english: Well, you've lived here long enough. Is there some way I can smuggle you past?
translation: 嗯，你在这儿住了够久了。有什么办法能让我偷偷带你过去吗？

english: Hmm, their sense of smell is quite acute, so no disguise would work. And I have a slight...reaction...to teleporting.
translation: 嗯，它们的嗅觉非常灵敏，所以任何伪装都没用。而且我对传送术有点……反应……

english: Wait... Rufus might be able to help.
translation: 等等……鲁弗斯也许能帮忙。

english: Well, he occasionally delivers meat to clients if they are too far away to come and get it themselves. If I were inside a crate of meat then he'd be unable to smell me and you'd be able to get me past.
translation: 嗯，他偶尔会给太远无法亲自来取的客户送肉。如果我藏在一个装有肉的箱里，它就闻不到我，你就能带我过去了。

english: Okay, that seems sensible. I'll be right back.
translation: 好的，听起来很合理。我马上回来。

english: Hey, Rufus, I heard that you do deliveries of meat. Could you send me a crate of supplies to Mos Le'Harmless?
translation: 嘿，鲁弗斯，我听说你送肉。你能给我寄一箱补给品到莫斯勒哈姆斯岛吗？

english: Well, it's a bit of a way to go, but for you, I'd wrrrite up a shipping orderrr.
translation: 嗯，路是有点远，但为了你，我会写一份运输订单。

english: What do you want to send?
translation: 你想送什么？

english: Er, some meat?
translation: 呃，一些肉？

english: Well, I didn't think you wanted to send shoes, frrriend; this is a meat shop. What I mean is, what KIND of meat do you want to send?
translation: 嗯，我可不觉得你想送鞋子，朋友；这儿是肉铺。我是说，你想送哪种肉？

english: Oh, don't worry about it, I'll be providing the meat myself. It's a treat for some werewolves down there, you see.
translation: 哦，别担心，肉我自己提供。是给那边的一些狼人准备的礼物，你懂的。

english: Hmm, I hadn't hearrrd about any packs running with the pirrrates...still, I trust you.
translation: 嗯，我没听说过有狼群和海盗混在一起……不过，我还是相信你。

english: Look, I apprrreciate you'rrre wanting to catch the meat yourrrself, I mean that's the sort of wolf I am too, but therrre is one thing.
translation: 听着，我很欣赏你想自己抓肉，我的意思是，我也是那种狼，但有一件事。

english: I'll gladly give you a crate for the meat, but I'll have to inspect it beforrre you send it over. I don't want my name associated with anything less than 100% frrresh, you understand.
translation: 我很乐意给你一个装肉的板条箱，但我得在你发货前检查一下。我可不想我的名字和任何不够百分百新鲜的东西扯上关系，你明白的。

english: Oh sure, that's entirely reasonable.
translation: 哦，当然，这完全合理。

english: Grrreat! I have the parrrts for the crrrate forrr you when you have the space to carrrry them.
translation: 太好了！等你腾出地方来，我就把板条箱的零件给你。

english: Grrreat! Here's the parrrts of the crrrate. Sorrrry, but I seem to be out of nails.
translation: 太好了！这是板条箱的零件。抱歉，我好像没有钉子了。

english: So, can I get a hint as to what you arrre sending?
translation: 那么，能给我点提示，你要送什么吗？

english: Rrrabbits? Ducks? Sheep?
translation: 兔子？鸭子？羊？

english: Oh, I'm sure that I'll be able to find some good meat from somewhere.
translation: 哦，我肯定能从什么地方弄到好肉的。

english: Wait, you are sending it live, rrright?
translation: 等等，你是要活着送过去，对吧？

english: I mean it is going to take a while to get therrre, so I'm not going to ship it unless it's at least a little alive.
translation: 我的意思是送到那里要花点时间，所以除非它至少还是活的，否则我不会发货。

english: Err, I mean, what do you mean only a little alive? Of course a good werewolf like me will be sending the food live.
translation: 呃，我是说，什么叫‘有点活着’？像我这样的好狼人，当然会送活的食物。

english: Ha, ha, ha! Of courrrse, of course!
translation: 哈，哈，哈！当然，当然！

english: So, what can I expect to see when I inspect this shipment of yourrrs?
translation: 那么，我检查你这批货的时候，会看到什么呢？

english: Errr, you know, something...special...
translation: 呃，你知道的，一些……特别的东西……

english: It's cats isn't it?
translation: 是猫，对吧？

english: Cats?
translation: 猫？

english: Oh, don't worrrry, you sly dog, I'll not tell anyone.
translation: 哦，别担心，你这狡猾的家伙，我不会告诉任何人的。

english: Tell you what, I'll get the shipping order for a crrrate of cats wrrritten up rrright now. You just provide the meat.
translation: 这样吧，我现在就给你写一份装猫的板条箱的运输订单。你只管提供肉就行。

english: No buts, frrriend, you get going. I know how trrricky those things are to grab!
translation: 别可是了，朋友，你快去吧。我知道抓那些东西有多棘手！

english: You're carrying too much for me to give this to you now, but I have a whistle you can blow to call me when you have the crrrate filled.
translation: 你现在拿的东西太多了，我没办法把这个给你，但我有一个哨子，等你把板条箱装满了，吹一下就能叫我。

english: Come talk to me when you have some frrree space forrr it.
translation: 等你腾出地方了再来找我拿。

english: Here, when you need me to inspect the meat, give this a blow and we'll get those tasty kitties of yours shipped off lickety split!
translation: 给，等你需要我检查肉的时候，吹一下这个，我们就能把你那些美味的小猫咪飞快地送走！

english: Well, at least I got him to agree to ship the crate for me.
translation: 好吧，至少我说服他帮我运箱子了。

english: I suppose in the meantime I'll set the crate up in Fenkenstrain's tower where he can get to it.
translation: 我想，在此期间，我会把板条箱放在芬肯斯特兰的塔里，这样他就能进去了。

english: All I have to do now is get a load of cats from somewhere...
translation: 我现在要做的就是去弄一堆猫来……

english: Keep up, cat!
translation: 跟紧了，猫！

english: Click, whirr!
translation: 咔哒，嗡嗡！

english: Of course! I'll make some fake cats from wood and fur!
translation: 当然！我会用木材和毛皮做一些假猫！

english: With a little help from the Ring of Charos, he'll never know the difference.
translation: 借助查罗斯之戒的一点帮助，他永远看不出区别。

english: It's just crazy enough to work...
translation: 这计划疯狂到可行……

english: Rufus, can I have a wolf whistle?
translation: 鲁弗斯，能给我一个狼哨吗？

english: Well, I have plenty, but you seem to have no space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 嗯，我有很多，但你似乎没有空间放它。等你有空间了再来吧。

english: Surrre! Here you go.
translation: 当然啦！给你。

english: Rufus, can I have some crate parts?
translation: 鲁弗斯，能给我一些板条箱部件吗？

english: Well surrre, as soon as you have some frrree space for them.
translation: 当然啦，等你有了空余空间再说。

english: Yes, herrre are some new ones.
translation: 是的，这里有一些新的。

english: So how is the plan progressing?
translation: 那么计划进展如何？

english: I still need to talk to Rufus.
translation: 我还需要和鲁弗斯谈谈。

english: I have got Rufus to agree to let me ship some meat, but I have to build the crate and fill it with fake cats first.
translation: 我已经让鲁弗斯同意让我运一些肉了，但我得先造个箱子，里面装满假猫。

english: Cats? He thought you were shipping cats?
translation: 猫？他以为你在运送猫？
