english: Well, I don't know...if you were a werewolf, I can see you would strike him as THAT sort of person.
translation: 嗯，我不知道……如果你是狼人，我能理解他会觉得你是那种人。

english: What? Wait? What sort of person?
translation: 什么？等等？哪种人？

english: Oh, it's nothing to worry about.
translation: 哦，没什么好担心的。

english: Hahahahahahahahahaha! Cats...it all makes sense...
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈！猫……一切都说得通了……

english: I get the feeling I'm being maligned...
translation: 我感觉自己被诽谤了……

english: Well, that's a nice crate, but unless you want me to sit under a layer of (heh heh) cats, I think it'll need a false bottom.
translation: 嗯，这板条箱不错，但除非你想让我坐在一层（嘿嘿）猫下面，我觉得它需要一个假底。

english: Fine. And if you keep up these cat remarks I'm going to make sure the crate is shipped upside down, and not give you any padding.
translation: 行。如果你再提猫的事，我就确保板条箱倒着运，而且不给你任何衬垫。

english: Fine. *cough* Catlover *cough*.
translation: 行。*咳* 爱猫人士 *咳*。

english: Don't make me hurt you!
translation: 别逼我揍你！

english: Well, it'll be a tight fit, but I'm sure I'll be able to squeeze in.
translation: 嗯，会有点挤，但我肯定能挤进去。

english: Now all you have to do is go and get all your little kitty friends!
translation: 现在你只需要去把你那些小猫朋友们都找来！

english: Be quiet or I'm going to post this thing direct to Canifis!
translation: 安静点，不然我就把这东西直接寄到坎尼非斯村去！

english: What is with this whole cat thing anyway?
translation: 这整件事跟猫到底有什么关系？

english: Hahaha - nothing - hehehehe - at all.
translation: 哈哈哈——没什么——呵呵呵呵——一点关系都没有。

english: Mwuhahahahahahaha! Oh, it's so apt, I can't stop laughing!
translation: 呣哈哈哈哈哈哈！哦，太贴切了，我笑个不停！

english: That does it, I'm leaving some nails in the bottom of the crate for him to sit on...
translation: 够了，我要在板条箱底部留些钉子让他坐上去……

english: Well, you certainly seem to know what you are doing when it comes to rounding up cats. You must get a lot of practice!
translation: 嗯，看来你在抓猫方面确实很在行。你一定经常练习吧！

english: Urge to kill...rising!
translation: 杀意……在上升！

english: Well, regardless, everything seems to be ready for you to call Rufus.
translation: 嗯，不管怎样，一切似乎都准备好了，你可以叫鲁弗斯了。

english: Blow your whistle and I'll get in the crate while we wait.
translation: 吹响你的哨子，我趁等待时钻进板条箱。

english: Okay, Doctor, time to get in the crate.
translation: 好了，医生，该进板条箱了。

english: Let's hope this works...
translation: 希望这能行……

english: Well, frrriend, I take it you have-
translation: 嗯，朋友，我想你已经——

english: What are you doing herrre of all places? Don't you smell that weedy human, Fenkenstrrrain?
translation: 你怎么会在这里？你没闻到那个瘦弱的人类芬肯斯特兰的味道吗？

english: Well yeah, but this was the only place I could think of to store the cats.
translation: 嗯，是啊，但这是我唯一能想到存放猫的地方。

english: Well, I know I wouldn't want anyone to find out I had a habit like yourrrs, but still...
translation: 嗯，我知道我不想让别人发现我有你这种癖好，但话说回来……

english: I take it this is the crrrate?
translation: 我想这就是那个板条箱吧？

english: That it is!
translation: 正是！

english: You know, they look verrry still...
translation: 你知道吗，它们看起来非常安静……

english: They must be pining.
translation: 它们一定是在思念。

english: Pining?
translation: 思念？

english: Yes. Pining.
translation: 是的。思念。

english: Seems rrreasonable. Is that why they arrren't making any noise?
translation: 听起来挺合理。这就是它们不发出任何声音的原因吗？

english: Err...meow?
translation: 呃……喵？

english: See, they made a noise.
translation: 看，它们发出声音了。

english: You know, I think therrre might be...
translation: 你知道吗，我觉得可能……

english: Nothing wrong whatsoever.
translation: 一点问题都没有。

english: ...nothing wrrrrong whatsoever!
translation: ……一点问题都没有！

english: Meow?
translation: 喵？

english: I think the meowing point has been more than made.
translation: 我觉得喵喵叫这一点已经充分证明了。

english: Herrre is the shipping orderrr. Just paste it to send that crrrate on its way!
translation: 这是运输订单。贴上去就能让那个箱子出发了！

english: Although I'd prefer it if you took yourrr cat habit elsewherrre in futurrre. You understand, rrright?
translation: 不过我希望你以后把你的猫癖好带到别处去。你明白吗？

english: I don't, but I'll promise you this is the last time I do this.
translation: 我不明白，但我向你保证这是最后一次。

english: That's good. You should rrreally kick the habit beforrre it gets too late.
translation: 那就好。你真的应该在为时已晚之前戒掉这个习惯。

english: See you laterrr, frrriend!
translation: 回头见，朋友！

english: How goes the hunting, frrriend?
translation: 狩猎进行得怎么样啦，朋~友？

english: Sure! Herrre you go.
translation: 当然！给~你。

english: Well, you have the crrrate parrrts, which is a good starrrt.
translation: 嗯，你有箱子零件，这是个好的开~始。

english: You have a whistle to call me with, so that will make things simplerrr.
translation: 你有一个哨子可以召唤我，这样事情就简单多~了。

english: Hello there, [player name]. How did your pirrrate friends like theirrr 'treat'?
translation: 你好啊，[player name]。你的海盗朋友们喜不喜欢他们的‘招~待’？

english: Well, I hope you do so beforrre those cats starrrt to get ill from being cooped up in that box.
translation: 嗯，我希望你能在那~些猫因为关在箱子里而生病之前把它们放出来。

english: Fine, but I'm not happy about putting my name on so many orrrders for cats. Try to be more careful with this one.
translation: 好吧，但我不高兴在这么多猫的订单上签我的名字。这次小心点。

english: I can wrrrite you one up if you like, but you seem to have no space for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以给你写~一张，但你似乎没有空间了。等你有空间了再来吧。

english: Yeah, Rufus, see you around!
translation: 是啊，鲁弗斯，回头见！

english: Has he gone?
translation: 他走了吗？

english: Yes, he's gone.
translation: 是的，他走了。

english: I liked the part where he asked you to keep your cat habit to yourself.
translation: 我喜欢他让你把猫癖好藏起来的那段。

english: I'm in a box of fake cats! How could I possibly be alright? Hurry up, so I can get out.
translation: 我在一个装满假猫的箱子里！我怎么可能没事？快点，我好出去。

english: No, there's something lumpy in my pocket, and it's very uncomfortable, but I can't move enough to get it out.
translation: 不，我口袋里有个鼓鼓囊囊的东西，很不舒服，但我动不了，拿不出来。

english: Bear in mind I can still post you to Canifis if I choose!
translation: 记住，如果我愿意，我还是可以把你寄到坎尼非斯村去！

english: Gah...let's get this over with...
translation: 啊……快把这事了结吧……

english: It teleported...but didn't he say he was allergic...
translation: 它传送了……但他不是说他对传送过敏吗……

english: Oh dear, I do hope the doctor's reaction is not too violent.
translation: 哦天哪，我真希望医生的反应不要太激烈。

english: The doctor was delivered safely, although it seems like a bunch of pirates have stolen your cats.
translation: 医生安全送达，不过似乎有一群海盗偷走了你的猫。

english: Well, the doctor is downstairs, waiting for you. I think he said he needed some things before he could begin.
translation: 嗯，医生在楼下等你。我想他说他需要一些东西才能开始。

english: You teleported me! Twice!
translation: 你传送了我！两次！

english: I was entirely unaware of at least one of those teleports.
translation: 至少有一次传送我完全不知情。

english: I told you I reacted badly to teleportation!
translation: 我告诉过你我对传送反应很糟！

english: Well, on the plus side, there was plenty of water to clean my clothing with afterwards...
translation: 嗯，好的一面是，之后有足够的水来清洗我的衣服……

english: Too...much...information! Mind...reeling!
translation: 信息……太多……了！脑子……转不过来了！

english: Aside from that, I seem to have arrived in one piece. I apologise for not believing you earlier. Brother Tranquility has told me the full story and I am prepared to help.
translation: 除此之外，我似乎完好无损地到达了。我为我之前不相信你而道歉。宁静修士已经告诉了我全部情况，我准备帮忙。

english: However, I am going to need a few things.
translation: 不过，我需要一些东西。

english: Okay, what do you need?
translation: 好的，你需要什么？

english: I will need a cranial clamp, a pair of brain tongs, three bell jars and at least thirty skull staples.
translation: 我需要一个颅骨夹、一把脑钳、三个钟形罩和至少三十个头骨钉。

english: Oh, and a hammer.
translation: 哦，还有一把锤子。

english: Brain tongs? Skull staples?
translation: 脑钳？头骨钉？

english: Where do you suggest I get these things, 'Unusual Implements R Us'?
translation: 你建议我去哪里弄这些东西？'奇异工具专卖店'吗？

english: Well, the zombies holed up in the main monastery must have at least one set of those items; otherwise, how did they perform the operation in the first place?
translation: 嗯，躲在大修道院里的僵尸肯定至少有一套那些东西；否则他们当初是怎么进行手术的？

english: A fair point. I'll pop back through that secret passage and ambush them.
translation: 有道理。我会从那条秘密通道回去伏击他们。

english: That won't work. Apparently they have sealed off that passage. The monks heard some explosions and saw the zombies moving something off the ship.
translation: 那行不通。显然他们已经封死了那条通道。修士们听到一些爆炸声，看到僵尸们从船上搬东西。

english: It seems they found the passage as they did a little interior rearranging.
translation: 看来他们在内部重新布置时发现了那条通道。

english: Well then, it looks like I'll go in through the front door.
translation: 那么看来我得从正门进去了。

english: Hah, only if you can walk through wood! They sealed it with planks.
translation: 哈，除非你能穿过木头！他们用木板把它封起来了。

english: Okay, that does it. I'll...I'll...
translation: 好吧，够了。我要……我要……

english: Wait a moment... That ship has cannons, right?
translation: 等一下……那艘船有大炮，对吧？

english: Then I'll storm on board, grab some gunpowder and blow those doors off their hinges!
translation: 那我就冲上船，拿些火药，把那些门炸飞！

english: That sounds pretty dangerous.
translation: 听起来相当危险。

english: Oh, this is nothing. All in a day's work for me.
translation: 哦，这不算什么。对我来说是家常便饭。

english: See you later, doctor. Whatever party they are planning in there, I have to go pick up my invitation.
translation: 回头见，医生。不管他们在里面策划什么派对，我得去拿我的邀请函。

english: When you have all the equipment I asked for, come and see me so we can begin the procedure.
translation: 当你集齐我要的所有装备后，来找我，我们就可以开始手术了。

english: I have a hammer for you, doctor.
translation: 医生，我给你带了一把锤子。

english: Very nice. Although, a sterilised one would be better.
translation: 很好。不过，消毒过的会更好。

english: I have some skull staples for you, doctor.
translation: 医生，我给你带了一些头骨钉。

english: Hmmm, size 3 staples. Interesting...
translation: 嗯，3号钉。有意思……

english: I have a cranial clamp for you, doctor.
translation: 医生，我给你带了一个颅骨夹。

english: Excellent, this will come in handy.
translation: 太好了，这会有用的。

english: Wonderful...and they even have easy-grip handles, too.
translation: 太棒了……而且它们还有防滑手柄。

english: I have a bell jar for you, doctor.
translation: 医生，我给您带了个钟形罐。

english: It's exactly this style of jar that I need, thank you.
translation: 这正是我需要的那种罐子，谢谢。

english: I have some bell jars for you, doctor.
translation: 医生，我给您带了几个钟形罐。

english: Well, that's all of the items I'll need to get this situation fixed up.
translation: 好了，处理这事需要的东西我已经备齐了。

english: So we can begin immediately?
translation: 那我们能立刻开始了吗？

english: Could you please keep notes of what I do, for posterity?
translation: 你能不能记下我所做的事情，留给后人？

english: Certainly. That and I'll be keeping an eye on you to make sure nothing 'untoward' happens to those brains.
translation: 当然。而且我也会盯着你，确保那些大脑不出什么‘意外’。

english: Well, that is your prerogative.
translation: 好吧，那是你的权利。

english: Let us get this operation started. I'll begin by using the...
translation: 我们开始手术吧。我先用这个……

english: I don't want my eyes anymore!
translation: 我不要我的眼睛了！

english: Pah, you have no stomach for science.
translation: 哼，你根本受不了科学。

english: I think I'm going to be sick...
translation: 我觉得我要吐了……

english: Well, if you are, do it in a bucket. This is a sterile environment, after all.
translation: 好吧，如果你要吐，就吐在桶里。毕竟这里是无菌环境。

english: But, but, it fell on the floor!
translation: 但、但、它掉到地板上了！

english: Only a little, and the sawdust scraped right off with that cheese grater.
translation: 只掉了一小会儿，而且锯末用那个乳酪刨丝器就刮干净了。

english: Now, why not follow them upstairs while I clean up.
translation: 现在，我收拾的时候，你何不跟着他们上楼去。

english: I'm sure as soon as their headaches fade, they will want to talk to you.
translation: 我相信等他们头痛一消，就会想跟你谈谈。

english: I have been talking with some of the monks. They do seem to be rather intelligent for members of the clergy.
translation: 我跟一些修士聊过。作为神职人员，他们似乎还挺聪明的。

english: The ones with brains, that is.
translation: 我是说那些有大脑的。

english: I'm sure that glowing review will endear you to them.
translation: 我相信这番‘高度’评价会让他们喜欢你的。

english: Owwwww...
translation: 嗷呜……

english: How's the...brain?
translation: 你的……大脑怎么样了？

english: Hurts...
I guessed. Look, I'm going to head out and kill this Mi- Gor joker before he can get his crew together and sail away.
translation: 我猜到了。听着，我打算出去干掉米戈尔那家伙，免得他召集人手开船跑掉。

english: You going to be okay?
translation: 你没事吧？

english: Yeah...wow...spinny room...
translation: 嗯……哇……房间在转……

english: W-wait...I have a bad feeling about this...
translation: 等、等等……我有种不好的预感……

english: The pirates m-must have moved something large into the s-secret room to b-block it, and Mi-Gor mentioned he had a bodyguard.
translation: 海盗们一、一定把什么大件东西挪进了秘、秘密房间堵住了路，而且米戈尔提到他有个保镖。

english: You should be prepared for a f-fierce battle.
translation: 你最好做好激、激烈战斗的准备。

english: Have a word with the others. They will bless you before you leave.
translation: 跟其他同伴说一声。你出发前他们会为你祝福的。

english: D-do you want me to take you back to the island?
translation: 你、你要我送你回岛上吗？

english: Would you like to receive a blessing?
translation: 你想接受祝福吗？

english: Well...ow...at least...oof...I'm back in the right body...
translation: 好吧……嗷……至少……唔……我回到自己身体里了……

english: So...woozy...
Ow, ow...those staples sting a little...
translation: 嗷、嗷……那些订书钉有点刺痛……

english: This is the worst hangover ever...and I didn't even get drunk!
translation: 这是我经历过最严重的宿醉……我明明连酒都没喝！

english: I think I'll come back when you feel a little better.
translation: 我想我还是等你感觉好点再来吧。

english: *Wheeze!*You! I will peel you like a grape for your interference!
translation: *喘气！*你！你竟敢插手，我要像剥葡萄一样把你剥了！

english: That's pretty big talk for someone who can't even breathe properly!
translation: 连气都喘不匀的人，口气倒是不小！

english: *Wheeze!*Filthy little insect! Wretched little vermin! Let us see how witty you feel after my barrel-chested bodyguard has beaten you to paste!
translation: *喘气！*肮脏的小虫子！可恶的小害虫！让我们看看，在我的桶箱怪保镖把你打成糊状物之后，你还能有多风趣！

english: Hah, I don't care how muscular your bodyguard is. I'll still defeat them!
translation: 哈，我才不管你保镖有多壮。我照样能打败他！

english: What...what is that?
translation: 那……那是什么？

english: *Wheeze!*Hekhekhekhek... 'That' is my bodyguard, the Barrelchest!
translation: *喘气！*嘿嘿嘿嘿……‘那’就是我的保镖，桶箱怪！

english: *Wheeze!*I was going to test his capabilities by letting him wipe out the monks, but I believe a little warm up is in order first.
translation: *喘气！*我本来打算让他消灭那群修士来测试他的能力，不过我觉得先热个身也不错。

english: *Wheeze!*Barrelchest - Order: Annihilate that [man/woman]!
translation: *喘气！*桶箱怪——命令：歼灭那个[man/woman]！

english: *Wheeze* And now I will take my leave.
translation: *喘气* 现在我要走了。

english: *Wheeze!*You! I will peel you like a grape for yourinterference!
translation: *呼哧！*你！我要像剥葡萄一样剥了你，让你多管闲事！

english: *Wheeze!*Filthy little insect! Wretched little vermin!Let us see how witty you feel after my barrel-chestedbodyguard has beaten you to paste!
translation: *喘气！*肮脏的小虫子！可恶的小害虫！让我们看看，在我的桶箱怪保镖把你打成糊状物之后，你还能有多风趣！

english: *Wheeze*I have received a summons to attend to theCaptain and so will be 'down below' for a while.
translation: *呼哧*我收到了船长的召见，得去'下面'待一阵子了。

english: *Wheeze*Hekhekhekhek... 'That' is my bodyguard, theBarrelchest!
translation: *呼哧*嘿嘿嘿嘿嘿……'那家伙'就是我的保镖，桶箱怪！

english: *Wheeze!*Silence! I will not be questioned byunderlings!
translation: *呼哧！*闭嘴！我可不会被下属审问！

english: *Wheeze*This time there will be no rebellion amongstthe subjects.
translation: *呼哧*这次，实验品们不会再造反了。

english: *Wheeze*Excellent...the gas will leave the brain intactfor the next stage.
translation: *呼哧*好极了……这气体不会伤到大脑，为下一阶段做好准备。

english: *Wheeze*If you or the others do not consideryourselves capable of carrying out Rabid Jack's orders,then perhaps you need to spend some time in 'TheBox'!
translation: *呼哧*要是你或其他人觉得自己没能力执行狂犬杰克的命令，那或许你们得去'箱子'里待一阵子了！

english: *Wheeze*Rabid Jack will have his crew of enhancedzombies and I will have as many test subjects as I canvivisect!
translation: *呼哧*狂犬杰克会得到他的强化僵尸船员，而我则能得到尽可能多的活体解剖实验品！

english: *Wheeze*I was going to test his capabilities by lettinghim wipe out the monks, but I believe a little warm up isin order first.
translation: *呼哧*我本想让他去消灭那些僧侣来测试他的能力，但我觉得先来点热身运动更好。

english: *Wheeze*Barrelchest - Order: Annihilate that man!
translation: *呼哧*桶箱怪——命令：消灭那个男人！

english: *Wheeze*Barrelchest - Order: Annihilate that woman!
translation: *呼哧*桶箱怪——命令：消灭那个女人！

english: Well, you'll not have to worry about Mi-Gor any more. I defeated his creation and he seems to have slipped away.
translation: 好了，你不用担心米戈尔了。我打败了他造的东西，他好像溜走了。

english: Yes, one of the brothers observed him and a few of his sorebones slipping into the water shortly after there was a loud bang from inside the building.
translation: 是的，一位修士看到他和几个索尔博恩斯在建筑物内传来巨响后不久，就溜进了水里。

english: It is a pity he escaped, but Saradomin's justice will find him in the end.
translation: 他逃走了很遗憾，但萨拉多明的正义终将找到他。

english: One thing does strike me as odd. He mentioned the name Rabid Jack, which I have heard in connection to zombie pirates before.
translation: 有一件事让我觉得奇怪。他提到了狂犬杰克这个名字，我之前听说过这个名字跟僵尸海盗有关。

english: Can you tell me who that is?
translation: 你能告诉我那是谁吗？

english: I cannot, but I do recall hearing it before.
translation: 我说不上来，但我确实记得以前听过这个名字。

english: One of the pirates on the island said it while in the grip of a terrible fever. The others quietened him down and refused to answer any questions about it.
translation: 岛上有个海盗发高烧时说了这个名字。其他人让他安静下来，并拒绝回答任何相关问题。

english: I have no doubt that they know who it is, but I get the feeling that they will not tell you.
translation: 我毫不怀疑他们知道那是谁，但我觉得他们不会告诉你。

english: Hmm...I'm sure I might be able to get them to say if I persuade them.
translation: 嗯……我肯定如果能说服他们，也许能让他们开口。

english: Still, that's a job for another time. After all that work, I think I might take a bit of a rest.
translation: 不过，那是以后的事了。干了这么多活，我想我该休息一下了。

english: Certainly! Saradomin blesses you for your valiant effort!
translation: 当然！萨拉多明为你的英勇努力而祝福你！

english: Here is a lamp blessed by Saradomin. If you pray over it, it will grant you wisdom.
translation: 这是一盏受萨拉多明祝福的灯。如果你对它祈祷，它会赐予你智慧。

english: Did you hear that?
translation: 你听到了吗？

english: Oh, that? Sounds a little like locusts.
translation: 哦，那个？听起来有点像蝗虫。

english: Er, time for me to be off, I think.
translation: 呃，我想我该走了。

english: Basically, I think when you tell him we have a werewolf- free place for him here on the island, I'm sure he'll agree to come.
translation: 基本上，我想当你告诉他我们在岛上为他提供了一个没有狼人的地方时，他肯定会同意来的。

english: He developed a prayer to Saradomin for deliverance from pestilences, plagues and other assorted ills, as he was going deep into the Wilderness where the fumes and brimstone would have choked him if he was not
translation: 他开发了一种向萨拉多明祈祷以摆脱瘟疫、灾难和其他各种疾病的祷文，因为他要深入荒野，那里的烟雾和硫磺如果不加防护会呛死他。

english: Hello there, all ready to go to the island?
translation: 你好，准备好去岛上了吗？

english: This washed up on the beach earlier, I thought you could get it fixed by Smithing Smith in Mos Le'Harmless. It could be valuable.
translation: 这个之前被冲到了海滩上，我想你可以让莫斯勒哈姆斯岛的锻造匠史密斯修好它。可能很值钱。

english: Well, if you aren't going to listen to what I have to say, you can come back when you have learned about patience!
translation: 好吧，如果你不听我说什么，那就等你学会耐心再回来吧！

english: I'll just transport us there now.
translation: 我现在就送我们过去。

english: W...would you like me to t...take you to Harmony?
translation: 你……你想要我带……带你去和谐岛吗？

english: Shhh! We can't talk about that here.
translation: 嘘！我们不能在这里谈这个。

english: Would you like me to transport you to Harmony?
translation: 你要我送你去和谐岛吗？

english: Would you like me to transport you to Harmony, where we can talk?
translation: 你要我送你去和谐岛，我们可以在那里谈谈吗？

english: So, have you read the book?
translation: 那么，你读过那本书了吗？

english: So, when will the doctor be ready?
translation: 那么，医生什么时候能准备好？

english: Well, as I was saying, our island has come under attack from undead pirates...
translation: 嗯，正如我刚才说的，我们的岛屿遭到了不死海盗的攻击……

english: Well here, take this one and try not to be so careless in future!
translation: 好吧，拿着这个，以后小心点！

english: I have a blessed lamp of Saradomin here for you as a reward, but it seems you cannot carry it right now.
translation: 我这里有一盏萨拉多明的被祝福的灯作为奖励，但你似乎现在拿不了。

english: I still feel more comfortable talking about this in the monastery.
translation: 我还是觉得在修道院里谈这个更自在。

english: You LOST the blessed lamp of Saradomin? The one-of- a-kind relic the likes of which has never been seen in this age?
translation: 你弄丢了萨拉多明的被祝福的灯？那个独一无二的遗物，这个时代从未见过的东西？

english: Wait! Do you want me to take you back to the island?
translation: 等等！你要我带你回岛上吗？

english: How bad does it look?
translation: 情况有多糟？

english: I take it that that explosion was the doors?
translation: 我猜那声爆炸是门？

english: But...but...aren't you an adventurer?
translation: 但……但……你不是冒险者吗？

english: *Sigh* Oh well. Saradomin be with you.
translation: *叹气* 哦，好吧。愿萨拉多明与你同在。

english: Well, hurry! Who knows what depredations are going on back on Harmony!
translation: 嗯，快点！谁知道和谐岛上现在正在发生什么劫掠！

english: I can't talk about it here. Let me take you to Harmony and we'll discuss it.
translation: 我不能在这里谈。让我带你去和谐岛，我们再讨论。

english: We haven't been down there in a while, so you might want to take some gear to rebuild the stairs in case they have collapsed.
translation: 我们有一阵子没下去了，所以你最好带些工具去重建楼梯，以防它们塌了。

english: Oh well, that shouldn't...
translation: 哦，好吧，那应该不会……

english: Blow the doors off!?!?
translation: 把门炸开？！？！

english: You LOST the blessed lamp of Saradomin? The one-of- a-kind relic, the likes of which has never been seen in this age?
translation: 你弄丢了萨拉多明的被祝福的灯？那个独一无二的遗物，这个时代从未见过的东西？

english: What are you doing? The gas is seeping into the granary! Here, let me take you back to Harmony.
translation: 你在干什么？瓦斯正在渗入粮仓！来，我带你回和谐岛。

english: No point in going all the way there and then back.
translation: 没必要跑那么远再回来。

english: We found an anchor washed up on the beach but you don't seem to have space to carry it. If you want it, come back and see me later.
translation: 我们在海滩上发现了一个被冲上来的锚，但你似乎没有空间拿。如果你想要，回头再来找我。

english: Well, you seem to have found the secret passage correctly, so you seem to be on track. Now you just need some way to get through the flooded section.
translation: 嗯，你似乎正确找到了秘密通道，所以看来你走在正确的轨道上。现在你只需要想办法通过被水淹没的部分。

english: How goes the plan?
translation: 计划进行得怎么样了？

english: Oh well, I'm sure you'll think of something.
translation: 哦，好吧，我相信你会想出办法的。

english: Well, I trust you, but this does sound a little...unusual.
translation: 嗯，我相信你，但这听起来有点……不寻常。

english: Well, I have another here for you if you can find some space for it amongst your belongings.
translation: 嗯，我这里还有一个给你，如果你能在行李中腾出空间的话。

english: We found an anchor washed up on the beach, but you don't seem to have space to carry it. If you want it, come back and see me later.
translation: 我们在海滩上发现了一个被冲上来的锚，但你似乎没有空间拿。如果你想要，回头再来找我。

english: Shouldn't you be watching the doctor?
translation: 你不是应该看着医生吗？

english: Ingenious! I knew you'd think of something.
translation: 太聪明了！我就知道你会想出办法的。

english: Do you want me to take you back to the island?
translation: 你要我带你回岛上吗？

english: Hmmm...that will be tricky. I'm sure you'll come up with something, though.
translation: 嗯……那会很棘手。不过我相信你会想出办法的。

english: Yes, I'm afraid it did, [player name] - all too well.
translation: 是的，恐怕它确实成功了，[player name]——而且非常成功。

english: Oh bother! I haven't got a needle or thread!
translation: 哦，该死！我没有针线！

english: Looks like you're just the man for the job! Welcome aboard!
translation: 看来你正是这份工作的最佳人选！欢迎加入！

english: Looks like you're just the woman for the job! Welcome aboard!
translation: 看来你正是这份工作的最佳人选！欢迎加入！

english: I can't use this head, [player name]. It's missing the most important part - the old grey matter.
translation: 我用不了这个脑袋，[player name]。它缺少最重要的部分——那团老旧的灰色物质。

english: Please, hurry - save me!!!!
translation: 请快点——救救我！！！

english: A pickled brain? What do you expect me to do with it - eat it with a packet of crisps?!?
translation: 一个腌制的脑？你指望我拿它做什么——配着一包薯片吃了它？！

english: Oh, doesn't anybody read signposts anymore???
translation: 哦，难道现在没人看路标了吗？？？

english: The signpost in the middle of the village nearby! Oh never mind.
translation: 村子中间的那个路标！哦，算了。

english: I need a new butler. Would you like to apply?
translation: 我需要一位新管家。你想应聘吗？

english: You've already brought me all the thread I need.
translation: 你已经把我需要的线都带来了。

english: You've already brought me a needle.
translation: 你已经给我带过一根针了。

english: Oh, for goodness sake. Here's a copy I had made.
translation: 哦，看在老天爷的份上。这是我之前做的一份副本。

english: Well, I'm ready to leave, but you still have to help me get past the werewolves.
translation: 嗯，我已经准备好出发了，但你得先帮我通过那些狼人。

english: Eeee, wha' shall I do! I'll mos' certainly lose tha job...
translation: 哎呀呀，我该怎么办！我肯定会丢掉这份工作的……

english: Lose your job? What's wrong, why?
translation: 丢掉工作？怎么了，为什么？

english: I w-w-work... over yon sand pit... and weeell... I found... this... hand! T'were buried in't Sand!
translation: 我……我在那边的沙坑工作……然后……我发现了……这个……手！就埋在沙子里！

english: Oh, you found a hand in the sand - that's nice for you.
translation: 哦，你在沙子里发现了一只手——那对你来说挺好的。

english: Eww a hand, in the sand! Why haven't you told the authorities?
translation: 呃，一只手，在沙子里！你为什么不告诉当局？

english: They's no' wha' they once was. Tha cap'ain o'the Guard spends near all o'the time drunk in yon pub.
translation: 他们跟以前不一样了。守卫长几乎整天都在那家酒馆里喝得烂醉。

english: Oh? The Guard Captain is drunk in the pub you say? That's not good, what will you do?
translation: 哦？你说守卫长在酒馆里喝醉了？那可不好，你打算怎么办？

english: Weeellll... do yer think yer could 'elp me?
translation: 那……你觉得你能帮我吗？

english: Sure, I'll give you a hand.
translation: 当然，我会帮你一把。

english: ..... Nae, ye can 'ave the 'and as h'evidence.
translation: ……不，你可以拿这只手当证据。

english: P'raps tha smell will get t'Guard Cap'ain's nose out o'his beer fer 2 seconds!
translation: 也许这味道能让守卫长的鼻子离开他的啤酒两秒钟！

english: I want no part in this!
translation: 我不想掺和这事！

english: Did ye see yon Guard Capt'n 'bout hand?
translation: 你去找守卫长说手的事了吗？

english: Not at the moment, but I will be seeing him soon.
translation: 现在还没，但我很快就会去找他。

english: Need more beer...
translation: 还要更多啤酒……

english: Sir? I have some more beer for you...
translation: 长官？我给您带了更多啤酒……

english: Ahh... jus' wha' I need, now, wha' did you wanna know?
translation: 啊……正是我需要的，现在，你想知道什么？

english: I've come to report that Bert, the sandman, found a hand in the sand pit.
translation: 我来报告，沙工伯特在沙坑里发现了一只手。

english: Lucky for him, means he can get even more work done.
translation: 他运气好，这意味着他能干更多活了。

english: But aren't you going to find out who it ... belonged to?
translation: 但你不打算查出这只手……是谁的吗？

english: Oops, No 'arm done. S'prob'ly a wizard, i's always the wizards fault, go ask them, jus' ring the bell outshide the guild and talk to the first pointy hatted ninny you shee!
translation: 哎呀，没伤着。多半是个魔法师，总是魔法师的错，去问他们吧，只要按公会外面的钟，然后跟第一个你看到的尖帽子傻瓜说话就行！

english: Err... ok, I'll go ring the bell and talk to a wizard then.
translation: 呃……好吧，那我去按钟，跟魔法师谈谈。

english: Yes, the Guard Captain said to see the wizards in the guild.
translation: 是的，守卫长说让我去公会找魔法师。

english: So why you hangin' abou' 'ere then? Go ring t'bell at t'mage guild just over yonder!
translation: 那你还在等什么？去那边的魔法公会按铃铛啊！

english: It seems to have slipped through my fingers!
translation: 它好像从我指缝里滑掉了！

english: Tha's no' surprisin' with yer bag so full, come back when s'not.
translation: 你的背包那么满，这也不奇怪，等空了再来吧。

english: Thank t'gods! I tho' I was bein invaded by undead 'ands from t'sand when I found this'un! Take i' to tha mage guild and ring tha' bell to talk ta someone.
translation: 谢天谢地！我还以为是被沙子里的不死之手入侵了呢，当我找到这个的时候！把它拿到魔法师公会，按钟找人谈谈。

english: Thanks Bert, I'm off to see the wizards, the wonderful wizards of Yanille!
translation: 谢谢伯特，我这就去找魔法师们，亚尼勒城的神奇魔法师们！

english: Hello Sir!
translation: 您好，长官！

english: Go 'way! This pint'sh nearly finished! Unlessh you got more that ish....? Wizards, s'all the wizard's fault...prob'ly that Zavistic one, he'sh the worsht!
translation: 走开！这杯啤酒快喝完了！除非你还有更多……？魔法师，都是魔法师的错……很可能是那个扎维斯提克，他最坏！

english: E're, you left this 'and in me beer!
translation: 喂，你把这只手掉我啤酒里了！

english: No good if you don' have space fer it in yer invent'ry, come back when you do.
translation: 你背包里没空间可不行，等有了再来吧。

english: Ummm... Do you have all your wizards?
translation: 嗯……你的魔法师都齐了吗？

english: All my.... whatever do you mean...?
translation: 我的……你什么意思……？

english: The Guard Captain asked me to see if you have any... missing... wizards.
translation: 守卫长让我来看看你有没有……失踪的……魔法师。

english: That's silly! No one would kill a wizard... would they?
translation: 真荒唐！没人会杀魔法师……对吧？

english: Erm... no...
translation: 呃……没有……

english: Well.. maybe, you see Bert found this hand and it might belong to.. a wizard!
translation: 嗯……也许吧，你看伯特发现了这只手，它可能属于……一个魔法师！

english: Bert? Ahh yes, the sandman who seems to have been working very long hours recently. Let's see that hand...
translation: 伯特？啊对，那个最近似乎工作时间很长的沙工。让我看看那只手……

english: Oh my! This is most definitely Clarence, my most able student! You must find out who did this!
translation: 哦天哪！这绝对是克拉伦斯，我最能干的学生！你必须查出是谁干的！

english: Do you have any input as to the matter at hand?
translation: 你对眼前这件事有什么看法吗？

english: Well.... Ask Bert about the long hours he's been working, that sounds suspicious to me. Digging things up at all hours of the day isn't natural.
translation: 嗯……去问问伯特他最近为什么工作时间那么长，我觉得很可疑。整天挖东西可不正常。

english: Did you find out who killed Clarence yet?
translation: 你查出是谁杀了克拉伦斯了吗？

english: Not yet, but don't lose your head over it.
translation: 还没，但别为此失去理智。

english: Wha' info ye find 'bout hand, [player name]?
translation: 你查到关于那只手的什么消息了，[player name]？

english: I dug up quite a lot about the hand. Can you tell me about your job?
translation: 我查到了不少关于那只手的事。你能跟我说说你的工作吗？

english: Sand! Lots o' sand! Me boss be Sandy o' Sandy's Sand Corp based in Brimhaven on tha isle of Karamja an' I hauls sand fr' there to yon sand pit.
translation: 沙子！好多沙子！我老板是桑迪，桑迪沙业公司，总部在卡拉姆詹岛上的布尔哈文镇，我从那里把沙子运到这边的沙坑。

english: I's looong harrrrd hours, bu' keeps me busy, y'know what tha say! 'Idle hands'r Zamorak's tools.'
translation: 工作时间又长又累，但让我忙个不停，你知道俗话说得好！‘闲手是萨莫拉克的工具。’

english: So you're employed by Sandy's Sand Corp in Brimhaven. Have you changed your hours recently?
translation: 所以你受雇于布尔哈文镇的桑迪沙业公司。你最近改变工作时间了吗？

english: Yer coul' see fer yerself iffen yer had space in yorn invent'ry, come back when yer do.
translation: 如果你背包里有空位，你可以自己看，等有了再来吧。

english: Nae! See fer yersel', here's a copy o' me rota tha' be held a' head office - yer can looksee iffin ye talk t' Sandy, me boss.
translation: 不！你自己看吧，这是我轮班表的副本，原件在总部——你可以跟我老板桑迪谈谈看看。

english: Thanks for the Rota Bert. I'll go check for the original with Sandy in Brimhaven.
translation: 谢谢你的轮班表，伯特。我去布尔哈文镇找桑迪核对原件。

english: Ey'up [player name]. Did yer see Sandy in Brimhaven 'bout me rota?
translation: 嘿，[player name]。你去找布尔哈文镇的桑迪问我的轮班表了吗？

english: Err, no, I kind of... lost it...
translation: 呃，没有，我有点……弄丢了……

english: Lucky fer yorn tha' I's made a copy then ain't it, I's 'ave been given it to yer iffen you 'ad some space in yer invent'ry.
translation: 算你走运，我复印了一份，如果你背包里有空位我就给你。

english: Is you stupid? I said I'd give ye another but yer bags be full!
translation: 你傻了吗？我说了再给你一份，但你背包满了！

english: Lucky fer yorn tha' I's made a copy then ain't it, 'ere 'ave another.
translation: 算你走运，我复印了一份，给你另一份。

english: No, I'll fit it in my schedule somewhere soon.
translation: 不，我很快就会抽时间去的。

english: Hello Sir, do you run the Sand Corp?
translation: 您好，长官，您是沙业公司的老板吗？

english: Who wants to know?
translation: 谁想知道？

english: I'm [player name]. I'm here investigating the possible murder of a wizard.
translation: 我是[player name]。我来调查一起可能涉及魔法师谋杀的案件。

english: I don't care about that, I have far too much work to do. Let the authorities take care of things like murder and stop snooping around my office!
translation: 我不在乎，我工作太多忙不过来。让当局去处理谋杀之类的事，别在我的办公室里瞎打听！

english: I managed to get a copy of the original rota. Your hours changed a week ago!
translation: 我设法拿到了原始轮班表的副本。你的工作时间一周前变了！

english: Nae! Nae! I din't remember tha', bu'... hmmm, aye... tha' migh' be it...
translation: 不！不！我不记得了，但……嗯，是啊……可能就是这样……

english: What? Give me a hand here, I'm having a hard time understanding how you don't remember changing hours!
translation: 什么？帮帮我吧，我实在搞不懂你怎么会不记得改变工作时间！

english: I's all be tha wizard's fault! Tha magic leaks fr'm yon magic guild I tells yer! Tha's why this weirrrrd scroll appeareded a week ago!
translation: 都是魔法师的错！魔法从那个魔法公会泄漏出来，我告诉你！这就是为什么一周前出现了这张奇怪的卷轴！

english: A scroll appeared? Can I take a look at it while you look at the rotas?
translation: 出现了一张卷轴？你查看轮班表的时候，我能看看它吗？

english: O'course [player name], le's be 'avin'yon rota and 'ere be tha scroll, yer be takin' it back ta those inferrrnal wizards quick sharp!
translation: 当然可以，[player name]，给你轮班表，这是那张卷轴，你赶紧把它拿回给那些该死的魔法师！

english: I be hopin' tha search is goin' well... are tha wizard's owning up ta anythin' yet?
translation: 我希望搜索进展顺利……那些魔法师承认什么了吗？

english: I've found out a lot and will let you know when it's all over.
translation: 我查到了很多，等一切都结束了我会告诉你的。

english: I talked to Bert and found something very strange about his hours.
translation: 我跟伯特谈过了，发现他的工作时间有些非常奇怪的地方。

english: Oh? Did he kill Clarence?
translation: 哦？他杀了克拉伦斯？

english: No, but he doesn't remember changing his hours, and his rota and the original that his boss Sandy had, are different!
translation: 不，但他不记得改变过工作时间，而且他的轮班表和他老板桑迪手里的原件不一样！

english: ... oh, and this scroll appeared when they changed - he gave it to me.
translation: ……哦，还有，这张卷轴是在他们改变时间时出现的——他给了我。

english: I recognise that type of scroll! It's used in a mind altering spell of some sort. Did you speak to this... Sandy guy? Perhaps he has a hand in this.
translation: 我认得那种卷轴！它用于某种改变心智的法术。你跟那个……桑迪谈过吗？也许他也插了一手。

english: I took a look around his office. I don't know about a hand in it, I think he has both hands and feet in it!
translation: 我看了看他的办公室。我不知道他是不是插了一手，我觉得他双手双脚都插进去了！

english: Even more suspicious! Here, take this magical scrying orb and get some Truth Serum from Betty in Port Sarim, she owes me a favour, just tell her I sent you if she complains.
translation: 更可疑了！拿着这个魔法占卜球，去沙林港找贝蒂拿些吐真剂，她欠我一个人情，如果她抱怨就说是我让你去的。

english: Then you will be equipped to ask Sandy a few questions. Oh Clarence, I will find your murderer!
translation: 这样你就能准备好去问桑迪几个问题了。哦，克拉伦斯，我会找到杀害你的凶手！

english: I've lost my magical scrying orb!
translation: 我把魔法占卜球弄丢了！

english: I'd give you another magical scrying orb if you had some space in your inventory.
translation: 如果你背包里有空位，我会再给你一个魔法占卜球。

english: No matter, here, have another and please hurry, whoever killed Clarence must pay!
translation: 没关系，给你另一个，请快点，不管谁杀了克拉伦斯都必须付出代价！

english: Can you help me more?
translation: 你能再帮我一些吗？

english: Bring me a vial and I'll help you a little more.
translation: 给我带个空瓶来，我会再帮你一点。

english: I have a vial here for you.
translation: 我这里有个空瓶。

english: Ok, would you like me to transport you to Port Sarim? I'm sticking my neck out a bit helping you like this and can only do it once though!
translation: 好，你要我送你去沙林港吗？我这样帮你有点冒险，而且只能做一次！

english: Yes, that would be great!
translation: 是的，那太好了！

english: Off you go then, break a leg!
translation: 那就去吧，祝你好运！

english: No, I prefer using my legs, thanks all the same.
translation: 不，我更喜欢用自己的腿，还是谢谢你。

english: Ok, suit yourself!
translation: 好吧，随你便！

english: I've come from Yanille, the wizard says you can make Truth Serum?
translation: 我从亚尼勒城来，魔法师说你能制作吐真剂？

english: This is true deary, I'll need an empty vial.
translation: 没错，亲爱的，我需要一个空瓶。

english: I'll have to go find one then, I'll be back!
translation: 那我得去找一个，我会回来的！

english: I have one here!
translation: 我这里有一个！

english: That's good, now you'll need to make a rose tinted lens. Pink dye can be made from red berries in this bottle to make redberry juice, then add white berries. Just use that on a bullseye lens.
translation: 很好，现在你需要制作一个玫瑰色镜片。用这个瓶子里的红色浆果可以制成粉红色染料，做成红莓汁，然后加入白莓。把它用在牛眼透镜上就行了。

english: Hello deary! Have you managed to make that lens yet?
translation: 你好，亲爱的！你做好那个镜片了吗？

english: I'm afraid I've forgotten how!
translation: 恐怕我忘了怎么做！

english: Pink dye can be made from red berries in the bottle I gave you. Add white berries to make the pink dye and then you just need to use that on a bullseye lens. Good luck!
translation: 用我给你的瓶子里的红色浆果可以制成粉红色染料。加入白莓制成粉红色染料，然后你只需要把它用在牛眼透镜上。祝你好运！

english: Wonderful deary. When you're ready, just stand in the open doorway and focus the light on the empty vial on my desk and I'll pour the serum into it.
translation: 太好了，亲爱的。等你准备好了，就站在敞开的门口，把光线聚焦在我书桌上的空瓶上，我会把吐真剂倒进去。

english: Ok, what does that do?
translation: 好的，那有什么用？

english: Why it makes the person who drinks it unable to hide in the shadow of lies. The light of truth will shine!
translation: 因为它能让喝下它的人无法隐藏在谎言的阴影中。真理之光将会闪耀！

english: Ok, now the last ingredient, something personal from the person you need to tell the truth, else it won't work!
translation: 好了，现在最后一种材料，需要从你打算让他说出真相的那个人身上找一件私人物品，否则就没用！

english: Ok, I'll see if I can find something.
translation: 好的，我看看能不能找到点什么。

english: What about this sand straight from his pocket?
translation: 那他口袋里的这些沙子怎么样？

english: That's excellent deary!
translation: 太好了，亲爱的！

english: Don't forget to dilute it in something like tea or coffee.
translation: 别忘了把它稀释在茶或咖啡之类的东西里。

english: Hello deary! How did the serum work?
translation: 你好啊，亲爱的！那血清效果如何？

english: I've lost it!
translation: 我弄丢了！

english: That's not a problem, I kept some of it here just in case, but you have no space for it! Come back when you do
translation: 没关系，我这儿留了一些以防万一，但你包里没空位了！等有空位了再来吧。

english: That's not a problem, I kept some of it here just in case, here you are!
translation: 没关系，我这儿留了一些以防万一，给你！

english: I haven't tried it yet.
translation: 我还没试过呢。

english: Well don't forget to dilute it in a drink or something else bad things might happen.
translation: 那别忘了把它稀释在饮料里之类的，否则可能会出坏事。

english: Bad things?
translation: 坏事？

english: Well.... bits might drop off.
translation: 嗯……身体某些部分可能会掉下来。

english: Oh! I... see. I'll remember to dilute it then.
translation: 哦！我……明白了。那我记得要稀释它。

english: Have you made the serum and talked to Sandy yet?
translation: 你做好血清，跟桑迪谈过了吗？

english: Not yet, but don't bust a gut over it!
translation: 还没有，但别太着急！

english: I don't have time to talk to you. Go away!
translation: 我没时间跟你说话。走开！

english: There's a herd of huge mutant herring about to drop from the sky!
translation: 有一大群巨大的变异鲱鱼就要从天上掉下来了！

english: Wow! I must see this!
translation: 哇！我得去看看！

english: I'm not falling for that one!
translation: 我才不上当呢！

english: But the pygmy shrews have eaten all the sand!
translation: 但是那些侏儒鼩鼱把所有的沙子都吃光了！

english: A small parrot with a pink banana is sitting outside your window!
translation: 一只叼着粉色香蕉的小鹦鹉正坐在你的窗外！

english: Now, I'm going to ask you some questions and I want you to answer me truthfully...
translation: 现在，我要问你一些问题，你得老实回答我……

english: Why is Bert's rota different from the original?
translation: 为什么伯特的轮班表和原来不一样？

english: Because... I changed it.
translation: 因为……我改了它。

english: Because.... because.... I bribed a wizard to put a spell on him so he would believe everything I say!!
translation: 因为……因为……我贿赂了一个魔法师给他施咒，让他相信我说的每一句话！！

english: So that I could make him work longer without paying him more!
translation: 这样我就能让他干更久的活，还不用多付工钱！

english: I...I... I KILLED HIM! So I wouldn't have to pay him and no one would know. I put his body in the next load of sand.
translation: 我……我……我杀了他！这样我就不用付他工钱，也没人知道。我把他的尸体塞进了下一批沙子里。

english: I think I have enough evidence now, you can go for now, but I think you're up to your neck in it!
translation: 我想现在证据够了，你先走吧，不过我觉得你麻烦大了！

english: Hello again deary. Come back and tell me what happened when all the fuss is over.
translation: 又见面了，亲爱的。等这事儿闹完了，回来告诉我结果。

english: Ok Betty, I'll be back!
translation: 好的，贝蒂，我会回来的！

english: I got the whole story from Sandy... but I lost the orb.
translation: 我从桑迪那里听到了整件事……但我把宝珠弄丢了。

english: It's ok, I saw the whole thing as the orb is connected via magic to me as I enchanted it.
translation: 没关系，我看到了整个过程，因为宝珠跟我有魔法联系——是我附魔的。

english: I think this Sandy needs a lesson, please bring me 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand.
translation: 我觉得这个桑迪需要点教训，请给我带5个土符文和一桶沙子来。

english: Well, well...I think this Sandy needs a lesson, please bring me 5 earth runes and a bucket of sand.
translation: 哼哼……我觉得这个桑迪需要点教训，请给我带5个土符文和一桶沙子来。

english: Erm, why?
translation: 呃，为什么？

english: Don't question me or you'll end up as braindead as that legless Guard Captain!
translation: 别质疑我，否则你也会变得跟那个没腿的守卫长一样脑残！

english: Umm.. ok, I'll get you the 5 earth runes and bucket of sand.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我去给你拿5个土符文和一桶沙子。

english: You really mean you forgot? Bring me 5 earth runes and 1 bucket of sand to help stop that moneygrabbing Sandy!
translation: 你该不会真忘了吧？给我带5个土符文和1桶沙子来，好阻止那个贪财的桑迪！

english: I've brought what you wanted, what are you going to do?
translation: 你要的东西我带来了，你打算怎么做？

english: Ahh excellent, let's have those! Watch and learn...
translation: 啊，太好了，给我吧！看好了学着点……

english: My sand! My lovely sand!
translation: 我的沙子！我可爱的沙子！

english: There, the sand pit will now magically refill. No more work for Bert!
translation: 好了，这样沙坑就会自动魔法填补了。伯特再也不用干活了！

english: We must find the rest of Clarence, I've sent some wizards out to some of the sandpits, would you please check the Entrana sandpit?
translation: 我们必须找到克拉伦斯的其他部分，我已经派了一些魔法师去几个沙坑了，你能去恩特纳岛的沙坑看看吗？

english: Uh...greetings [player name]!
translation: 呃……你好啊，[player name]！

english: Uhh... How do you know my name?
translation: 呃……你怎么知道我的名字？

english: Oh, I like to keep ahead of things.
translation: 哦，我喜欢先知先觉。

english: Err.. ok. Well, I've been sent from the Wizards' Guild in Yanille. There's been an... incident... Do you have any body parts?
translation: 呃……好吧。我是从亚尼勒城的魔法师公会派来的。发生了一起……事件……你这里有什么身体部位吗？

english: How did you know! I found the most awful thing in my sandpit - a head!
translation: 你怎么知道的！我在沙坑里发现了最可怕的东西——一个头！

english: Ahhh good! I need to take it back to be buried!
translation: 啊，太好了！我得把它带回去埋葬！

english: You're very strange, but if it means I get rid of the horrid thing...
translation: 你真是怪人，不过要是能让我摆脱那个可怕的东西……

english: Or I would if you had any room in your bag!
translation: 可惜你包里没空位！

english: I see you still have that head! Take it back to the Wizards in Yanille!
translation: 我看你还留着那个头！把它带回亚尼勒城交给魔法师们！

english: Hello again [player name]!
translation: 又见面了，[player name]！

english: What should I do with the head?
translation: 我该怎么处理这个头？

english: It was you that came demanding the head to give to the wizard in the first place! Go back to Yanille with it!
translation: 当初可是你跑来要那个头交给魔法师的！带着它回亚尼勒城去！

english: I've lost my head!
translation: 我弄丢了我的头！

english: You dropped it and you don't have room to carry it now, come back when you do.
translation: 你把它弄掉了，现在包里没空位放它，等有空位了再回来。

english: Keep your hair on! You dropped it! Make sure you take it straight back to the wizards else you won't have a leg to stand on.
translation: 别急！你把它弄掉了！记得直接把它带回给魔法师们，否则你连站都站不住了。

english: Did you visit the Entrana sandpit yet? Ask the worker there if he's found an arm or a leg.
translation: 你去过恩特纳岛的沙坑了吗？问问那儿的工人有没有找到胳膊或腿。

english: Not yet no. I've been running around like a headless chicken, but I'll get to it!
translation: 还没呢。我像只无头鸡一样到处乱跑，不过我会去的！

english: Alas poor Clarence. I knew him, [player name].
translation: 唉，可怜的克拉伦斯。我认识他，[player name]。

english: Thank you - we shall bury him today. I have sent word for the guards to arrest Sandy, so no one will ever see him again!
translation: 谢谢你——我们今天就会埋葬他。我已经传话让守卫逮捕桑迪，这样就不会有人再见到他了！

english: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. Once I have, we can start planning our next move.
translation: 我已经把这里发生的事告诉了母亲，但还没收到回信。等收到回信后，我们就可以开始计划下一步行动了。

english: Mother.
translation: 母亲。

english: As I stand here, the healers toil to save the life of the Teokan of Ralos.
translation: 当我站在这里时，治疗者们正在努力挽救拉洛斯的特奥坎的生命。

english: He wished to return to the Teomat. I advised against it, but...
translation: 他希望回到特奥马特修道院。我劝他不要回去，但是……

english: So you would blame him?
translation: 所以你要怪他？

english: Then take responsibility. You were charged with rooting out those who would plot against us. You failed. Why?
translation: 那就承担责任。你负责揪出那些密谋反对我们的人。你失败了。为什么？

english: With respect, progress has been made. We believe the Twilight Emissaries to be responsible, but we need to obtain proof before we can act.
translation: 恕我直言，我们已经取得了进展。我们相信暮光使者是幕后黑手，但在采取行动之前，我们需要获得证据。

english: We will infiltrate the cult and gather any information we can. Once we have confirmed their guilt, they will be eradicated.
translation: 我们将渗透进那个邪教，收集一切能收集到的信息。一旦确认他们有罪，就将他们彻底铲除。

english: This is a task of upmostimportance. I intend to lead the infiltration myself.
translation: 这是一项至关重要的任务。我打算亲自领导这次渗透行动。

english: So you would chase glory like it is gold to be hoarded? You are the heir to Varlamore. It is not your place.
translation: 所以你要像追逐黄金一样追逐荣耀？你是瓦拉莫尔的继承人。这不是你该做的事。

english: In Varlamore we lead from the front!
translation: 在瓦拉莫尔，我们身先士卒！

english: You do not lead at all, boy! You command the Knights of Varlamore. Use them!
translation: 你根本不是在领导，小子！你指挥着瓦拉莫尔骑士团。用他们！

english: I cannot trust them. We have been infiltrated and our enemies now sit beside us.
translation: 我不能信任他们。我们已经被渗透了，敌人现在就坐在我们身边。

english: You speak of Metzli?
translation: 你说的是梅茨利？

english: It could be more than just her. One of my knights was implicated, but another may have incriminated him.
translation: 可能不止她一个。我的一个骑士被牵连了，但可能是另一个人陷害了他。

english: There have been suspicions directed at Furia and Ennius.
translation: 富里亚和恩尼乌斯也受到了怀疑。

english: Then all the more reason that you exclude yourself. Determine who you can trust and send them on this mission of yours.
translation: 那就更有理由让你自己置身事外了。确定你能信任谁，然后派他们去执行你的任务。

english: And if there is no one I can trust?
translation: 如果我没有可以信任的人呢？

english: Then you have failed as a leader.
translation: 那你作为领导者就失败了。

english: Now go. You have work to do. I don't expect you to fail me again.
translation: 现在去吧。你有工作要做。我不希望你再次让我失望。

english: Yes, my Queen. May the sun light your way.
translation: 是的，我的女王。愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: It would seem I won't be able to join you on this mission, iknami. Still, I have no doubt you will be successful all the same.
translation: 看来我无法和你一起执行这次任务了，iknami。不过，我仍然相信你一定会成功的。

english: Head to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge and ask to rent the basement room. I have a contact who will meet you there.
translation: 去克察卡利峡谷的酒馆，要求租用地下室房间。我有一个联系人会在那里和你碰面。

english: Someone you can trust?
translation: 一个你可以信任的人？

english: One of the only people left that I can trust. They'll fill you in on the details of how you'll infiltrate the Emissaries. Good luck, [player name]. May the sun light your way.
translation: 仅剩的我能信任的几个人之一。他们会告诉你如何渗透进暮光使者的细节。祝你好运，[player name]。愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. You should head on over to the pub in Quetzacalli Gorge. Remember, you'll need to rent the basement room. My contact will meet you there.
translation: 再见，[player name]。你应该去克察卡利峡谷的酒馆。记住，你需要租用地下室房间。我的联系人会在那里和你碰面。

english: I'll head over there shortly.
translation: 我马上过去。

english: I'd like to rent the basement room.
translation: 我想租用地下室房间。

english: We don't have a basement room... but I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.
translation: 我们没有地下室房间……但我这里一楼有一个很不错的大房间可用。住一晚30金币。

english: Like I said, we don't have a basement room. However, I do have a nice big one here on the ground floor that's available. It's 30 coins for the night.
translation: 就像我说的，我们没有地下室房间。不过，我这里一楼有一个很不错的大房间可用。住一晚30金币。

english: I don't have that much on me right now.
translation: 我现在没带那么多钱。

english: Well you know where we are if that changes.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，你知道我们在哪儿。

english: Thank you very much. The room is all yours. Enjoy!
translation: 非常感谢。房间归你了。好好享受！

english: Well you know where we are if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，你知道我们在哪儿。

english: Guess I may as well have a little rest while waiting for this contact.
translation: 我想在等联系人来的这段时间里，不妨稍微休息一下。

english: Rise and shine!
translation: 起床了！

english: Itzla? Is that you? What are you doing here?
translation: 伊茨拉？是你吗？你在这里做什么？

english: Isn't it obvious? I'm your contact!
translation: 这还不明显吗？我就是你的联系人！

english: But... no?
translation: 但是……不是吧？

english: Look, I fully appreciate what my mother said. I have carefully considered her instructions, but in this one very specific situation, I have come to the conclusion that they must be disregarded.
translation: 听着，我完全理解母亲说的话。我仔细考虑过她的指示，但在这一非常特殊的情况下，我得出的结论是必须无视它们。

english: But you're the heir to the throne of Varlamore... What if someone recognises you?
translation: 但你是瓦拉莫尔王位的继承人……万一有人认出你怎么办？

english: Well that's why I've covered my face of course. Simple!
translation: 所以我当然把脸遮住了。简单！

english: This seems like a bad idea...
translation: 这主意听起来不怎么样……

english: You may well be right, iknami, but that is a bridge we will cross, and then quite possibly burn, when we get to it.
translation: 你很可能说得对，iknami，但那是我们到时候再跨过去、甚至可能烧掉的桥。

english: I can see you're still not convinced, so let me be frank. I wasn't lying when I spoke to mother. The number of people we can trust is concerningly low.
translation: 我看你还是不信，那我就直说了。我跟我母亲说话时没有撒谎。我们能信任的人少得令人担忧。

english: Metzli, one of the most important people in the entire kingdom, has seemingly betrayed us. If your suspicions are right, Furia and Ennius are guilty as well. For all we know, there could be even more.
translation: 梅茨利，整个王国最重要的人物之一，似乎背叛了我们。如果你的怀疑是对的，富里亚和恩尼乌斯也有罪。谁知道呢，可能还有更多。

english: At this point, the fewer people who know about our mission, the better.
translation: 在这一点上，知道我们任务的人越少越好。

english: But you trust me?
translation: 但你信任我？

english: The irony is, my friend, that as an outsider, you're actually far more trustworthy than any Varlamorian now. You almost certainly can't be part of this conspiracy.
translation: 讽刺的是，我的朋友，作为一个外人，你现在实际上比任何瓦拉莫尔人都更值得信任。你几乎不可能是这场阴谋的一部分。

english: Okay, I'm still not sure if I like this plan, but I see your point. What's our next move?
translation: 好吧，我还是不太确定是否喜欢这个计划，但我明白你的意思了。我们下一步做什么？

english: We need to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries and confirm their guilt. I've done some digging, and rumour has it that they're on a bit of a recruitment spree at the moment. That's our way in.
translation: 我们需要渗透进暮光使者，确认他们的罪行。我调查了一下，有传言说他们最近正在大肆招募新成员。这就是我们的突破口。

english: The cult makes their home in the Twilight Temple, east of here. I suspect they won't take kindly to us just walking in, but the local shopkeeper here might be able to help us out.
translation: 这个邪教的老巢在东边的暮光神殿。我怀疑他们不会欢迎我们直接走进去，但当地的店主也许能帮上忙。

english: He's been engaging in many a charitable undertaking recently. Food for the poor, potions for the sick, that sort of thing. You'd be mistaken for thinking him to actually be a reasonable person.
translation: 他最近一直在做很多慈善活动。给穷人食物，给病人药水，诸如此类。你可能会误以为他其实是个好人。

english: But he's not?
translation: 但他不是？

english: Sadly not in this case. The Emissaries accept members from all walks of life, but the vast majority of their recruits are those from more unfortunate backgrounds.
translation: 可惜这次不是。暮光使者接纳来自各行各业的人，但他们的绝大多数新成员都来自比较不幸的背景。

english: Ah I see. They have people like this shopkeeper using charity to attract people to their cause.
translation: 啊，我明白了。他们让像这个店主一样的人利用慈善来吸引人们加入他们的事业。

english: Exactly. It is... unfortunate. The War of Betrayal was over a lifetime ago, but many still feel the impacts, especially in this part of the kingdom.
translation: 没错。这……很不幸。背叛之战已经过去了一辈子，但许多人仍然感受到它的影响，尤其是在王国的这一带。

english: I'd like to think we have made great improvements over the years, but this is a clear reminder that far more needs to be done.
translation: 我本以为这些年来我们已经取得了很大的进步，但这清楚地提醒我们，还有更多工作要做。

english: Anyway, it's not something to dwell on now. Let us get back to the more pressing matter of joining a dangerous cult.
translation: 总之，现在不是纠结这个的时候。让我们回到更紧迫的事情上：加入一个危险的邪教。

english: Right. So this shopkeeper... If I go to him and pose as a potential recruit, your hope is that he'll contact the Emissaries?
translation: 对。所以这个店主……如果我到他那里去，假装成一个潜在的招募对象，你希望他会联系暮光使者？

english: Exactly! Return to me here once you've hopefully been successful and we can discuss the next steps.
translation: 没错！如果你成功了，就回到我这里来，我们可以讨论下一步。

english: The Queen didn't seem very happy with you.
translation: 女王似乎对你很不满意。

english: That's parents for you. Do as I say, but not as I do. She was never afraid to get her own hands dirty. Did you know that before she was even my age, she became a champion in the Colosseum?
translation: 父母都这样。照我说的做，但别学我做的。她以前从不害怕亲自动手。你知道吗，在她甚至还没到我这个年纪的时候，她就成了竞技场的冠军？

english: You think she sees herself in you? If so, maybe she doesn't want you to make the mistakes that she once did?
translation: 你觉得她在你身上看到了自己的影子？如果是这样，也许她不想让你犯她曾经犯过的错误？

english: I suspect you are right, but I would prefer to learn from my own mistakes. Every ruler must forge their own path. The people will never follow a leader who cannot stand alone.
translation: 我觉得你说得对，但我更愿意从自己的错误中学习。每个统治者都必须走自己的路。人民不会追随一个无法独当一面的领袖。

english: I suppose that makes sense, but I'm not sure how I feel about you learning from your mistakes while we infiltrate a dangerous cult together.
translation: 我想这有道理，但我不太确定在你我一起渗透一个危险邪教的时候，看着你从错误中学习是什么感觉。

english: Fear not, iknami. I am confident that you will probably survive this mission.
translation: 别担心，iknami。我有信心你大概能活着完成这次任务。

english: That's good, I think...
translation: 那……还不错，我想。

english: Do you really think Metzli, Furia and Ennius are traitors?
translation: 你真的认为梅茨利、富里亚和恩尼乌斯是叛徒？

english: Metzli has always been an odd one. Everyone was always quick to dismiss it as just a little side effect of spending a lot of time with dead people. Now I wonder if she used that to her advantage.
translation: 梅茨利一直是个怪人。大家总是很快就把这归结为和死人待太久的一点副作用。现在我在想，她是不是利用了这个优势。

english: No one cared to pay close attention to her. No one wanted to spend much time around her. She probably got away with all sorts of things without anyone even noticing.
translation: 没人愿意密切关注她。没人想在她身边待太久。她很可能做了各种事情都没人注意到。

english: But a traitor?
translation: 但叛徒？

english: The evidence seems to suggest so. Why else would she have disappeared after the attack?
translation: 证据似乎指向这一点。不然她为什么会在袭击后消失？

english: Maybe they captured her?
translation: 也许他们抓住了她？

english: Maybe, but surely someone would have noticed. People generally don't go quietly when captured.
translation: 也许吧，但肯定有人会注意到。一般来说，被抓住的人不会悄无声息地消失。

english: What about Furia and Ennius?
translation: 那富里亚和恩尼乌斯呢？

english: Well their family has of course produced traitors before, but they've never seemed to have much love for old Imafore.
translation: 嗯，他们家以前当然出过叛徒，但他们似乎对老伊马福尔没什么好感。

english: By the end of the war, I think he'd ended up killing more of his own family members than he left alive. Amazing what paranoia will do to a man.
translation: 到战争结束时，我想他杀死的自家人比活着的还多。偏执会对一个人造成什么影响，真是令人惊叹。

english: Still, even if they never cared for him, his blood still runs in their veins, and they've never been short on ambition themselves.
translation: 不过，即使他们从不在乎他，他的血仍然流淌在他们的血管里，而且他们自己也从不缺乏野心。

english: If they are guilty... what will you do to them?
translation: 如果他们有罪……你会怎么处置他们？

english: The same thing we do to all traitors in Varlamore.
translation: 和我们在瓦拉莫尔对待所有叛徒的方式一样。

english: What happens if they try to attack Servius again?
translation: 如果他们再次试图攻击塞尔维乌斯怎么办？

english: He's in the capital now, where I wanted him to be from the start. He should be much safer there.
translation: 他现在在首都，我一开始就想让他待在那里。他在那里应该安全得多。

english: Still, safer is not safe, especially if we do have traitors in our midst. At any moment we risk someone showing some basic competence and actually managing to kill him properly.
translation: 不过，安全并不等于万无一失，尤其是如果我们中间确实有叛徒的话。随时都可能有人表现出一些基本能力，真正成功地杀死他。

english: So you don't consider the enemy to be competent?
translation: 所以你认为敌人并不称职？

english: All I'm saying is that if I'd have been the one trying to assassinate my father, I'd probably have done a half- decent job.
translation: 我只是想说，如果是我去刺杀我父亲，我大概会做得像样一点。

english: But if the enemy isn't a threat, why are you here?
translation: 但如果敌人不是威胁，那你为什么在这里？

english: What do you mean, iknami?
translation: 你什么意思，iknami？

english: If this isn't an enemy to be taken seriously, why do you feel you yourself need to be the one to deal with them? If they're incompetent, shouldn't anyone be able to handle them?
translation: 如果这个敌人不值得认真对待，为什么你觉得必须亲自处理他们？如果他们不称职，不是任何人都能对付他们吗？

english: So you challenge me, iknami? I'm wounded. However, as I said before, I do not feel we can trust many people while we have potential traitors around us.
translation: 所以你在质疑我，iknami？我受伤了。不过，正如我之前所说，我觉得在我们身边有潜在叛徒的情况下，不能信任太多人。

english: But if they've managed to position some of their members in very important roles, surely they can't be completely incompetent?
translation: 但如果他们成功地把一些成员安插在非常重要的职位上，那他们肯定不可能是完全无能的吧？

english: We do not need to do this dance, [player name]. I understand that where you come from, there is a certain art to holding a conversation. We do not bother with that here. You may be direct.
translation: 我们不需要这样绕圈子，[player name]。我知道在你的家乡，交谈有一定的艺术。我们这里不搞那一套。你可以直说。

english: I guess I just still don't know you that well. If we're about to infiltrate this cult together, I'd like to understand why you think it's important you do this yourself.
translation: 我想我只是还不太了解你。如果我们即将一起渗透这个邪教，我想知道为什么你认为亲自做这件事很重要。

english: I see. I understand your doubts, my friend. I suppose I have a few reasons for wanting to be here.
translation: 我明白了。我理解你的疑虑，我的朋友。我想我在这里有几个原因。

english: First, I do truly believe this mission has the highest chance of success if fewer people know about it. While I am not convinced on the competence of our foe, I still do not intend to underestimate them.
translation: 首先，我确实相信，如果知道这件事的人越少，这次任务成功的可能性就越大。虽然我不确定我们的敌人是否称职，但我仍然不打算低估他们。

english: Second, I suppose I feel a certain level of responsibility. My father was attacked on my watch. When someone falters, it is their duty to fix it, especially when they hold a position like mine.
translation: 其次，我想我感到了一定的责任感。我父亲是在我的看管下被袭击的。当有人失职时，他们有责任去弥补，尤其是当他们身居像我这样的职位时。

english: After all, a leader who sits by and lets others deal with his mistakes is not someone to have faith in.
translation: 毕竟，一个袖手旁观、让别人处理自己错误的领导者，是不值得信赖的。

english: Finally, Servius is my father. Our relationship is not a simple one, but he is my father all the same. I would see to it personally that his attackers face justice.
translation: 最后，塞尔维乌斯是我的父亲。我们的关系并不简单，但他终究是我的父亲。我要亲自确保袭击他的人受到惩罚。

english: I hope that satisfies you, iknami.
translation: 我希望这能让你满意，iknami。

english: It does. Thank you, Itzla.
translation: 是的。谢谢你，伊茨拉。

english: I'd better go and speak to this shopkeeper.
translation: 我最好去和这位店主谈谈。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. Any luck with that shopkeeper?
translation: 尼尔萨尔，[player name]。和那位店主谈得怎么样了？

english: Keep at it. He's our only way of infiltrating the Emissaries.
translation: 继续努力。他是我们渗透进使者的唯一途径。

english: He's going to reach out to the Emissaries and let them know to expect us at their temple.
translation: 他会联系使者们，让他们知道我们会在他们的神殿等我们。

english: Kuani! Let us not waste any time then. I will meet you at the Twilight Temple. You'll find it east of here, on the other side of the Proudspire.
translation: 库阿尼！那我们别浪费时间了。我会在暮光神殿和你碰头。你从这里往东走，在傲峰的另一边就能找到。

english: Sounds good. I'll see you there shortly.
translation: 听起来不错。我一会儿就到。

english: Good to see you, er...
translation: 很高兴见到你，呃……

english: Itzlan.
translation: 伊茨兰。

english: Itzlan?
translation: 伊茨兰？

english: Okay... So what happens now that we're here?
translation: 好吧……那我们到了这里，接下来要做什么？

english: It seems this tower is where the Emissaries evaluate possible new members. If we're to get anywhere here, we're going to need to pass whatever tests they might have for us.
translation: 看来这座塔是使者们评估潜在新成员的地方。如果我们想在这里有所进展，就必须通过他们可能为我们设置的任何考验。

english: Apparently, someone called Forebearer Janus will call upon us when it's our turn to be tested. In the meantime, we may as well mingle with these other potential recruits.
translation: 显然，轮到我们接受考验时，一个叫先驱者雅努斯的人会召唤我们。在此期间，我们不妨和这些其他潜在的新人聊聊。

english: You think they might know something of note?
translation: 你觉得他们可能知道什么重要的事吗？

english: Unlikely, but it would be interesting to know why they woke up one day and decided their calling in life was to join a cult.
translation: 不太可能，但了解一下他们为什么某天醒来就决定自己一生的使命是加入一个邪教，这倒是挺有意思的。

english: This whole place is very fancy.
translation: 这整个地方真华丽。

english: Yes, I must admit the Emissaries have a more elaborate setup than expected. They've never been this organised before, nor have their numbers been so great. Something must have changed.
translation: 是啊，我得承认，使者们的阵仗比我想象的要大得多。他们以前从没这么有组织，人数也没这么多。一定是发生了什么变化。

english: Did they build everything here themselves?
translation: 这里的一切都是他们自己建造的吗？

english: Thankfully they are not quite that well put together. The temple here was built not long before the War of Betrayal. It is said that Imafore wanted somewhere dedicated to Ranul that would rival the Teomat.
translation: 幸好他们还没那么有条理。这里的神殿是在背叛战争前不久建造的。据说伊马福尔想找个地方供奉拉努尔，以与特奥马特修道院抗衡。

english: I'm guessing he was too foolish to realise that the Teomat is equally dedicated to both Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 我猜他太蠢了，没意识到特奥马特修道院是同时供奉拉洛斯和拉努尔的。

english: Anyway, the temple was considered an affront to both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul. After Imafore died, most people were more than happy to see it abandoned.
translation: 总之，这座神殿被认为是对拉洛斯教会和拉努尔教派的冒犯。伊马福尔死后，大多数人都乐见其被废弃。

english: And the Emissaries eventually moved in?
translation: 然后使者们就搬进来了？

english: Yes, but only very recently.
translation: 是的，但只是最近的事。

english: Interesting... I wonder what the cause was.
translation: 有意思……我想知道原因是什么。

english: If all goes well, we will hopefully soon find out.
translation: 如果一切顺利，我们希望能很快找到答案。

english: We still haven't been called upon yet. We may as well mingle with these other potential recruits while we wait.
translation: 我们还没被召唤。我们不妨在等待的时候和其他这些潜在的新人聊聊。

english: Alright, I'll get mingling.
translation: 好吧，我去聊聊。

english: I had a chat to some of the other recruits. One of them had something rather interesting to say.
translation: 我和其他一些新人聊了聊。其中一个人说了些相当有趣的事。

english: Apparently, the Emissaries gained a new leader recently. They refer to her as the Augur.
translation: 显然，使者们最近有了一位新领袖。他们称她为预言者。

english: Metzli?
translation: 梅茨利？

english: Hmm... Did you learn anything else of note?
translation: 嗯……你还打听到其他重要的事吗？

english: Apparently this Augur will lead the Emissaries to Mokhaiotl. Do you know what that means?
translation: 显然，这位预言者将带领使者们前往莫凯奥特。你知道那是什么意思吗？

english: Mokhaiotl? I'm not my father, so you'll have to forgive my knowledge on this sort of thing, but if I remember right, Mokhaiotl plays a key role in Ximoua.
translation: 莫凯奥特？我不是我父亲，所以这方面知识有限，请见谅。但如果我没记错的话，莫凯奥特在希穆阿中扮演着关键角色。

english: Could you remind me what Ximoua is?
translation: 你能提醒我一下希穆阿是什么吗？

english: It is said that one day, Ralos and Ranul will come together, uniting all souls as one. In doing so, they will bring about the destruction of this world, but also the birth of a new one.
translation: 据说有一天，拉洛斯和拉努尔会合二为一，将所有灵魂统一。这样做会带来这个世界的毁灭，但也孕育一个新世界。

english: Most accept that we cannot predict when this day will come. However, our friends in the Twilight Emissaries don't seem happy with that. They instead believe in something called Tsak Tauli, the Final Dawn.
translation: 大多数人都接受我们无法预测这一天何时到来。然而，我们在暮光使者的朋友们似乎对此并不满意。他们反而相信一种叫做查克.陶利，即最终黎明的东西。

english: Ah yes, I remember. They see it as their duty to make Ximoua happen. So where does this Mokhaiotl fit in?
translation: 啊，是的，我想起来了。他们认为自己的职责就是促成希穆阿的发生。那么，这个莫凯奥特又扮演什么角色呢？

english: When Ralos and Ranul come together, it is said they will do so at Mokhaiotl, the centre of the world.
translation: 据说当拉洛斯和拉努尔合二为一时，他们会在世界中心莫凯奥特完成结合。

english: I see. Given that the Emissaries see it as their duty to bring about the end, I suppose it makes sense that they'd want to reach Mokhaiotl themselves.
translation: 我明白了。既然使者们认为自己的职责是带来终结，那么他们想亲自到达莫凯奥特也就说得通了。

english: Well I'd love to know how they plan on reaching the centre of the world. I can't imagine it's the kind of place that you can just stroll on down to.
translation: 我很想知道他们打算如何到达世界中心。我无法想象那是个可以随便溜达过去的地方。

english: Itzlan. [player name]. It is time for you to prove your worth. Enter the tower when you're ready.
translation: 伊茨兰。[player name]。是时候证明你们的价值了。准备好后就进入塔内吧。

english: But it seems we will have to ponder this mystery later. Pick up your follower and then let us head inside and see what tests await us.
translation: 但看来我们得稍后再琢磨这个谜团了。带上你的随从，我们进去看看有什么考验在等着我们。

english: But it seems we will have to ponder this mystery later. Let us head in and see what tests await us.
translation: 但看来我们得稍后再琢磨这个谜团了。我们进去看看有什么考验在等着我们吧。

english: It is said that Ralos and Ranul will come together at Mokhaiotl, the centre of the world. It is there that they will unite all souls as one, destroying this world and creating a new one.
translation: 据说拉洛斯和拉努尔会在世界中心莫凯奥特合二为一。在那里，他们将统一所有灵魂，毁灭这个世界并创造一个新世界。

english: Itzlan and [player name], I take it?
translation: 伊茨兰和[player name]，对吧？

english: That's us.
translation: 就是我们。

english: Good. Allow me to welcome you to the Tower of Ascension. You are here because you hope to be welcomed into our family. We hope to welcome you as well, but alas, not all can be deemed worthy.
translation: 很好。欢迎来到飞升之塔。你们来这里是因为希望被接纳进我们的大家庭。我们也希望欢迎你们，但可惜，并非所有人都能被认为有价值。

english: Here, in the Tower of Ascension, you will demonstrate your intellect, strength, loyalty and ability to sacrifice. In doing so, you will prove your worth to Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 在这里，在飞升之塔中，你们将展示自己的智慧、力量、忠诚和牺牲能力。这样，你们就能向拉洛斯和拉努尔证明自己的价值。

english: When you are ready to begin, climb the stairs. Your first trial awaits.
translation: 准备好开始后，就爬上楼梯。你们的第一次考验在等着你们。

english: Hey you! You're not allowed up there.
translation: 嘿，你！你不能上去那里。

english: Itzlan. [player name]. When you are ready to begin, climb the stairs. Your first trial awaits.
translation: 伊茨兰。[player name]。准备好开始后，就爬上楼梯。你们的第一次考验在等着你们。

english: You have trials to complete, [player name]. Climb up the stairs when you are ready.
translation: 你还有考验要完成，[player name]。准备好后就爬上楼梯。

english: Hey! You haven't been given permission to open that!
translation: 嘿！你没有被允许打开那个！

english: Welcome to your first trial. The aim is simple: Speak the correct pass phrase to me and you will be allowed to proceed. Let the trial begin!
translation: 欢迎来到你们的第一次考验。目标很简单：对我说出正确的口令，我就允许你们继续前进。考验开始！

english: Recruit.
translation: 新人。

english: About that passphrase...
translation: 关于那个口令……

english: Do you have it yet?
translation: 你找到了吗？

english: Not quite yet, but I'll have it in no time.
translation: 还没，但我马上就能找到。

english: Er... Sure!
translation: 呃……当然！

english: What are we meant to be doing again?
translation: 我们到底要做什么来着？

english: It's quite simple: You just need to work out the passphrase and say it to me. You may use whatever you have available in this room to discover it.
translation: 很简单：你只需要找出口令，然后对我说出来。你可以使用这个房间里任何可用的东西来找到它。

english: These emissaries here are acting a bit strange... They keep putting their hands in their pockets.
translation: 这些使者行为有点奇怪……他们老是把手指进口袋里。

english: We should keep looking for that passphrase.
translation: 我们应该继续寻找那个口令。

english: Found anything of note, iknami?
translation: 找到什么有用的东西了吗，伊克纳米？

english: I have this book that might be of use.
translation: 我找到了一本书，可能有用。

english: Hmm... Seems some of the words are highlighted. I doubt that's a coincidence.
translation: 嗯……有些词被高亮了。我怀疑这不是巧合。

english: Do you think you could help me translate some words?
translation: 你能帮我翻译一些词吗？

english: Translate? Well I guess I can give it a go.
translation: 翻译？好吧，我想我可以试试。

english: Silam.
translation: 西拉姆。

english: Ah, I recognise this language. It's the language of the Old Ones. Servius did teach me a few of their words, though I may not have paid as much attention as he'd have liked...
translation: 啊，我认得这种语言。这是古神的语言。塞尔维乌斯确实教过我一些他们的词，虽然我可能没有像他希望的那样专心……

english: This one means... 'West'!
translation: 这个意思是……'西'！

english: I can try.
translation: 我可以试试。

english: Silam? I think that means 'west'.
translation: 西拉姆？我想那意思是'西'。

english: Makt.
translation: 马克特。

english: Makt? I believe that means...
translation: 马克特？我相信那意思是……

english: 'North'! It means 'north'.
translation: '北'！意思是'北'。

english: Makt? I think that means 'north'.
translation: 马克特？我想那意思是'北'。

english: Uitt.
translation: 乌伊特。

english: Uitt? If I remember correctly, that translates to 'south'.
translation: 乌伊特？如果我没记错的话，那翻译过来是'南'。

english: Uitt? I think that means 'south'.
translation: 乌伊特？我想那意思是'南'。

english: Uitt? I believe that means...
translation: 乌伊特？我相信那意思是……

english: 'South'! It means 'south'.
translation: '南'！意思是'南'。

english: Takam.
translation: 塔卡姆。

english: This one means... 'East'!
translation: 这个意思是……'东'！

english: Takam? If I remember correctly, that translates to 'east'.
translation: 塔卡姆？如果我没记错的话，那翻译过来是'东'。

english: Takam? I think that means 'east'.
translation: 塔卡姆？我想那意思是'东'。

english: Well I hope it helps, iknami.
translation: 希望这能帮上忙，伊克纳米。

english: I think I might have the passphrase.
translation: 我想我可能找到口令了。

english: Kuani! You'd better let Forebearer Janus know.
translation: 库阿尼！你最好去告诉先驱者雅努斯。

english: Moki Koma Ikam.
translation: 莫基 科马 伊卡姆。

english: No, that's not quite right.
translation: 不，不太对。

english: I guess I'd better keep searching.
translation: 我想我最好继续找找。

english: That is correct. Well done! You and your companion may progress to the next trial.
translation: 正确。做得好！你和你的同伴可以进入下一个考验了。

english: I'm not quite ready.
translation: 我还没准备好。

english: Speak to me when you are ready to start.
translation: 准备好开始时就跟我说话。

english: Welcome to your next trial. Here, there is one simple goal...
translation: 欢迎来到你们的下一场考验。这里，有一个简单的目标……

english: Survive.
translation: 活下来。

english: I don't know if you'll ever figure this one out!
translation: 我不知道你能否解开这个！

english: Struggling? I've seen a lot of people fail to work this one out.
translation: 有困难吗？我见过很多人没能解开这个。

english: Do you think you've got the intellect to complete this one?
translation: 你觉得你有智慧完成这个吗？

english: I admit, that was pretty fast. Still, it will take more than that for you to prove your worth.
translation: 我承认，这确实很快。不过，要证明你的价值，光靠这个还不够。

english: Are you ready to start the next trial?
translation: 你准备好开始下一个试炼了吗？

english: Then come back to me when you are.
translation: 那就等你准备好了再来找我。

english: Recruit. Are you ready to start?
translation: 新兵。你准备好开始了吗？

english: Can you remind me what this trial is?
translation: 你能提醒我这个试炼是什么吗？

english: The goal is simple: Survive. That is the only advice I can offer you.
translation: 目标很简单：活下来。这是我唯一能给你的建议。

english: Now, are you ready to begin?
translation: 那么，你准备好开始了吗？

english: Speak to me again when you are.
translation: 等你准备好了再跟我说话。

english: Yes! I'm ready.
translation: 是的！我准备好了。

english: Then let the trial commence.
translation: 那么，试炼开始。

english: It seems some of the boxes have been left around the edges of the room...
translation: 看来有些盒子被留在了房间的边缘……

english: I'll check them out.
translation: 我去检查一下。

english: I think it's time for a fight! This one should be fun!
translation: 我觉得是时候打一架了！这场应该会很有趣！

english: It appears your companion has fallen in battle!
translation: 看来你的同伴在战斗中倒下了！

english: An unfortunate fate for your companion on your last attempt. Do you want to try again?
translation: 你上次尝试时，你的同伴遭遇了不幸。你想再试一次吗？

english: You have fought well... This trial is now complete!
translation: 你打得很好……这个试炼现在完成了！

english: Great work there, [player name]. I wonder what our next trial will be.
translation: 干得好，[player name]。不知道我们下一个试炼会是什么。

english: Welcome to your third trial. Before you stand some recently initiated acolytes. However, it seems one of them was not as loyal to our cause as first believed.
translation: 欢迎来到你的第三个试炼。站在你面前的是几位刚入会的见习者。不过，其中一人似乎并不像最初以为的那样忠于我们的事业。

english: Your task is to question all four and determine who the traitor is. I suggest you choose carefully. Good luck.
translation: 你的任务是审问所有四个人，找出谁是叛徒。我建议你谨慎选择。祝你好运。

english: Recruit. Any luck finding the traitor yet?
translation: 新兵。找到叛徒了吗？

english: Remember, only one of the four before you is guilty of disloyalty. Question all four and determine who it is. I suggest you choose carefully.
translation: 记住，你面前的四个人中只有一个犯有不忠之罪。审问所有四个人，找出是谁。我建议你谨慎选择。

english: So, what's our plan here?
translation: 那么，我们有什么计划？

english: My guess is that one of them has some beliefs that don't quite line up with those of the Emissaries.
translation: 我猜他们中有一人的信仰与使者们的信仰不太一致。

english: So we question them about that sort of thing? I can't imagine they'd be willing to be truthful about that.
translation: 所以我们就这方面审问他们？我可不认为他们会愿意说实话。

english: They can't be truthful about something they don't know about. Take advantage of gaps in their knowledge - gaps that a true Emissary wouldn't have.
translation: 他们不可能对自己不知道的事情说实话。利用他们知识上的漏洞——那些真正的使者不会有的漏洞。

english: You know, it sounds like they plan to kill whoever is guilty.
translation: 你知道吗，听起来他们打算处死那个有罪的人。

english: Shouldn't have joined a crazy murder cult then. Or if they really were committed to joining a crazy murder cult, they should have at least made sure they were actually good at it!
translation: 那就不该加入一个疯狂的谋杀邪教。或者，如果他们真的铁了心要加入一个疯狂的谋杀邪教，至少得确保自己真的擅长这个！

english: Do you not even have a little bit of sympathy for them?
translation: 你对他们连一点同情心都没有吗？

english: Fair enough. I guess I'd better get questioning.
translation: 说得对。我想我最好还是去审问吧。

english: How's it going, [player name]?
translation: 怎么样了，[player name]？

english: What do we know about the Emissaries and their beliefs?
translation: 我们对使者们及其信仰了解多少？

english: Probably not as much as we should, but what we do know is that the Emissaries believe in Tsak Tauli, more commonly known as the Final Dawn.
translation: 可能没有我们该了解的那么多，但我们知道的是，使者们信仰察克.陶利，也就是更常说的最终黎明。

english: Like with Ximoua, the Final Dawn sees Ralos and Ranul come together, uniting all souls as one. In doing so they destroy this world and create a new one.
translation: 和西莫瓦一样，最终黎明认为拉洛斯和拉努尔会合为一体，将所有灵魂统一。这样做会摧毁这个世界，并创造一个新世界。

english: After that, the two gods separate again, but the souls they united stay within them. The cycle then starts over once more.
translation: 之后，两位神祇再次分离，但他们统一的灵魂会留在神祇体内。然后循环再次开始。

english: The Emissaries seem to consider it their singular purpose to bring about the Final Dawn. Nothing else matters to them.
translation: 使者们似乎认为他们唯一的目的就是促成最终黎明。其他一切对他们来说都无关紧要。

english: I see. Thanks for the information. Hopefully it will help me work out who this traitor is.
translation: 我明白了。谢谢你的信息。希望这能帮我找出谁是叛徒。

english: I still have some questioning to do.
translation: 我还有些审问要做。

english: To be honest, I wasn't too sure about joining at first. My friend convinced me though. Here we have a chance to be granted a place in Mictl.
translation: 说实话，一开始我也不太确定要不要加入。是我朋友说服了我。在这里，我们有机会在米克特尔获得一席之地。

english: They say the Final Dawn is inevitable. It's the end that we can't escape from. It's a scary thought, but at least here I have a chance to control my destiny and obtain a place in Mictl.
translation: 他们说最终黎明是不可避免的。这是我们无法逃脱的结局。这是个可怕的想法，但至少在这里，我有机会掌控自己的命运，在米克特尔获得一席之地。

english: I choose [member's name]. This is your traitor.
translation: 我选择[member's name]。这就是叛徒。

english: Nicely done. [member's name] was indeed the traitor. You have both done well, but I wonder how well you will work together in the final trial...
translation: 干得好。[member's name]确实是叛徒。你们都做得很好，但我很好奇你们在最后的试炼中能配合得多好……

english: Speak to me when you are ready to proceed.
translation: 准备好继续了就跟我说话。

english: Be sure to choose more carefully this time, recruit.
translation: 这次一定要更谨慎地选择，新兵。

english: Hey! No need for that. You found the failure among us already.
translation: 嘿！没必要这样。你已经在我们中间找到了那个失败者。

english: Great work, [player name]. On to the final trial!
translation: 干得好，[player name]。进入最后的试炼！

english: Well done, recruits. Victory is within your reach, but one more trial awaits...
translation: 干得好，新兵们。胜利近在咫尺，但还有一个试炼在等着你们……

english: Face your opponent.
translation: 面对你的对手。

english: An Emissary must be prepared to sacrifice anything and everything. Only through sacrifice will we deliver Twilight's Promise. Only through sacrifice will we achieve the Final Dawn.
translation: 一个使者必须准备好牺牲一切。只有通过牺牲，我们才能实现暮光之约。只有通过牺牲，我们才能达成最终黎明。

english: Well, you heard the man, [player name]. Shall we dance?
translation: 好吧，你听到他的话了，[player name]。我们跳一支舞？

english: I'm not sure if you should be so...
translation: 我不确定你是否应该这么……

english: You might want to dodge this one!
translation: 你最好躲开这个！

english: Reckon you can dodge this?
translation: 你觉得你能躲开这个吗？

english: I'd move if I were you!
translation: 我要是你我就躲开！

english: Prayers? What prayers?
translation: 祈祷？什么祈祷？

english: You're not allowed to do that!
translation: 你不能那样做！

english: I yield!
translation: 我认输！

english: You and your companion will fit in nicely here. Let us head to the main chamber to discuss what happens next.
translation: 你和你的同伴会很好地融入这里的。我们去主密室讨论下一步吧。

english: You don't need to be going up there. You've already completed your trials.
translation: 你不需要去那里。你已经完成了你的试炼。

english: Well that was fun!
translation: 那可真有趣！

english: You know you're not meant to be enjoying yourself, right?
translation: 你知道你不应该享受其中的，对吧？

english: Don't be like that! Surely you must admit you enjoyed it a bit as well?
translation: 别这样！你肯定也得承认你也挺享受的吧？

english: I suppose I liked the part where I beat you.
translation: 我想我喜欢的是我打败你的那部分。

english: Right, moving swiftly on. Let's see what Forebearer Janus has to say to us.
translation: 好了，赶紧说正事。我们去看看先驱者雅努斯要跟我们说什么。

english: Congratulations to you both on completing the trials. You will make fine Emissaries.
translation: 恭喜你们俩完成了试炼。你们会成为优秀的使者。

english: Now the Augur herself will oversee your initiation. You may collect your new robes from that chest over there. Put them on and proceed into the temple.
translation: 现在，占兆师本人将监督你们的入会仪式。你们可以从那边那个箱子里领取新袍子。穿上它们，然后进入神殿。

english: Congratulations on completing the trials. You will make fine Emissaries.
translation: 恭喜你完成了试炼。你会成为一名优秀的使者。

english: Congratulations on completing the trials, [player name]. You will make a fine Emissary.
translation: 恭喜你完成了试炼，[player name]。你会成为一名优秀的使者。

english: We'd better change into those robes.
translation: 我们最好换上那些袍子。

english: Let's head over to the temple.
translation: 我们去神殿那边吧。

english: You should proceed to the temple. The Augur awaits.
translation: 你应该前往神殿。占兆师在等着。

english: Welcome, friends. You chosen few stand here because you have proven yourselves to be worthy. Here, you will not just find a home, you will find a family. Together, this family will bring about the Final Dawn.
translation: 欢迎，朋友们。你们这些被选中的少数人站在这里，是因为你们已经证明了自己是值得的。在这里，你们不仅会找到一个家，还会找到一个家庭。这个家庭将共同带来最终黎明。

english: No doubt you are wondering how we will achieve our destiny. I call upon our glorious leader, the Augur, to explain our holy mission.
translation: 毫无疑问，你们想知道我们将如何实现我们的命运。我请我们光荣的领袖，占兆师，来解释我们神圣的使命。

english: This morning, you were nothing more than ants, scrambling to find purpose amongst the dirt. Now though... now you have achieved ascension.
translation: 今天早上，你们还不过是蚂蚁，在泥土中挣扎着寻找意义。但现在……现在你们已经实现了飞升。

english: Once, I was just the same. Like so many of you, I started my life with nothing. I would wake each morning and pray that I would find enough food to last through the day.
translation: 曾经，我也和你们一样。和你们中的许多人一样，我的人生起点一无所有。我每天早晨醒来，祈祷能找到足够的食物撑过一天。

english: All the while, those above me treated me worse than a common criminal. I was a villain to them! Why? Simply because they were born with privilege, and I was not.
translation: 而与此同时，那些在我之上的人对待我比对待普通罪犯还要恶劣。在他们眼里，我是个恶棍！为什么？仅仅因为他们生来享有特权，而我没有。

english: Eventually, I looked to the Sect of Ranul for guidance. I thought they might have shown me my path, but I was wrong.
translation: 最终，我向拉努尔教派寻求指引。我以为他们可能为我指明了道路，但我错了。

english: Before long, I was their leader and it was instead me who was being looked to for guidance, for purpose. In truth though, even then I had nothing I could offer. I was as blind as I had always been.
translation: 没过多久，我就成了他们的领袖，反而变成了别人向我寻求指引和意义。但说实话，即使在那时，我也没什么可以给予的。我和以前一样盲目。

english: But the day came when I finally saw my purpose, for I was blessed with a vision, granted to me by Ralos and Ranul themselves! I will share now with you what they shared with me.
translation: 但有一天，我终于看到了我的使命，因为我得到了一个异象，是拉洛斯和拉努尔亲自赐予我的！现在我将与你们分享他们与我分享的东西。

english: Thirty one years ago, the moon eclipsed the sun and a false night fell across the land. That day marked a beginning, for it saw the birth of a pair of twins.
translation: 三十一年前，月亮遮住了太阳，一场虚假的夜幕降临大地。那一天标志着一个开始，因为它见证了一对双胞胎的诞生。
