english: To most, they were children like any other, but I was shown the truth of their birth, for as the sun and moon combined, Ralos and Ranul were born in mortal forms!
translation: 对大多数人来说，他们只是普通的孩子，但我看到了他们出生的真相，因为当太阳和月亮结合时，拉洛斯和拉努尔以凡人的形态诞生了！

english: Now, they seek Mokhaiotl. There, they will unite us all as one, and a new world will be born. My purpose, which I now share with you, is to lead them there.
translation: 现在，他们在寻找莫凯奥特。在那里，他们将使我们所有人合为一体，一个新世界将诞生。我的使命，现在与你们分享，就是带领他们到达那里。

english: Blasphemy! Deceit! That is what people cry when they hear the truth. The Church of Ralos teaches that our work is false, and our royal leaders lap up their every word!
translation: 亵渎！欺骗！这就是人们听到真相时的呼喊。拉洛斯教会教导说我们的工作是虚假的，而我们的王室领袖对他们言听计从！

english: Perhaps you still harbour doubts yourselves. I do not judge you. We have all been lied to our entire lives, and in truth, even after I was blessed by our gods, I held many doubts myself.
translation: 也许你们自己心中仍有疑虑。我不会评判你们。我们一生都在被欺骗，事实上，即使在我受到我们神祇的祝福之后，我自己也抱有许多疑虑。

english: But you have all been chosen. You have all achieved ascension. I know that you are among the few who will understand. You are among the few who can see the truth!
translation: 但你们都被选中了。你们都实现了飞升。我知道你们是少数能够理解的人。你们是少数能够看到真相的人！

english: And see it you will! You do not need to take the word of a mere herald. Instead, bask in the glory of our gods reborn!
translation: 而你们将会看到！你们不需要相信一个区区传令官的话。相反，沐浴在我们重生神祇的荣光中吧！

english: You may recognise these faces as Ennius and Furia Tullus, but now I give you the truth. Before you stand our gods! Ralos and Ranul!
translation: 你们可能认出这些面孔是恩纽斯和弗里亚.图卢斯，但现在我告诉你们真相。站在你们面前的是我们的神祇！拉洛斯和拉努尔！

english: Together, we will accompany them on their glorious journey! We will guide them to Mokhaiotl and bring about the Final Dawn! This is our purpose! This is our destiny! This is Twilight's Promise!
translation: 我们将一起陪伴他们踏上光荣的旅程！我们将引导他们前往莫凯奥特，带来最终黎明！这就是我们的使命！这就是我们的命运！这就是暮光之约！

english: You all have a part to play in what is to come. Forebearer Fides will assign you your duties. Speak with her and then go forth. Go forth and serve our gods!
translation: 你们每个人在即将到来的事情中都有一份角色。先驱者菲德斯会分配你们的职责。和她谈谈，然后出发。出发去侍奉我们的神祇！

english: Welcome, acolyte, and congratulations on your initiation. I am just making the final preparations on the duties for you and your companion. They will be ready shortly.
translation: 欢迎，见习者，恭喜你入会。我正在为你和你的同伴的职责做最后的准备。很快就准备好了。

english: Well that was a level of insanity that even I wasn't ready for.
translation: 好吧，那是一种连我都没准备好的疯狂程度。

english: They think Ennius and Furia are Ralos and Ranul reborn...
translation: 他们认为恩纽斯和弗里亚是拉洛斯和拉努尔的重生……

english: Like I say, complete insanity! Metzli has twisted the minds of everyone here. They eagerly lap up her outlandish claims without ever stopping to consider how ludicrous they are.
translation: 就像我说的，完全是疯了！梅茨利扭曲了这里每个人的思想。他们热切地接受她离谱的主张，却从不考虑这些主张有多荒谬。

english: In some ways, I pity them, but alas, there is only one cure for this sort of thing. This cult must be eradicated, especially Metzli, Furia and Ennius.
translation: 在某种程度上，我同情他们，但可惜，这种事情只有一种解药。这个邪教必须被铲除，尤其是梅茨利、弗里亚和恩纽斯。

english: I'm still confused over what their plan is... They want to reach Mokhaiotl, but why would they need to kill Servius to do that? And why the whole set up with that Knight of Varlamore?
translation: 我还是不明白他们的计划是什么……他们想到达莫凯奥特，但为什么需要为此杀死塞尔维乌斯？还有，和那个瓦拉莫尔骑士设下的整个局又是怎么回事？

english: When Furia and Ennius set that knight up, it was so obvious. It's like they wanted us to know it was them.
translation: 弗里亚和恩纽斯陷害那个骑士的时候，手法太明显了。就好像他们想让我们知道是他们干的。

english: Hmm... A very good point. Could be this cult has just addled their brains, but it may be that they wanted us here.
translation: 嗯……说得很有道理。可能是这个邪教搞坏了他们的脑子，但也可能是他们想让我们来这里。

english: I guess we will find out soon enough.
translation: 我想我们很快就会知道了。

english: Should we not leave? We know the cult is guilty now, and we know Metzli, Furia and Ennius are part of it. We have everything we need.
translation: 我们不该离开吗？我们现在知道邪教有罪了，也知道梅茨利、弗里亚和恩纽斯是其中一员。我们有了所需的一切。

english: You said yourself, there are questions still unanswered. We must rectify that.
translation: 你自己说过，还有些问题没有答案。我们必须解决这个问题。

english: So if there is a trap, you'd willingly spring it?
translation: 所以如果有陷阱，你愿意主动去踩？

english: Well it would be the last thing they'd expect.
translation: 嗯，那会是他们最意想不到的事。

english: Let's have a chat to this Forebearer Fides about our new duties. Whatever they are, hopefully they give us a chance to learn more.
translation: 我们去找这位先驱者菲德斯谈谈新任务吧。不管是什么任务，希望有机会能多了解一些情况。

english: Let's see what duties this Forebearer Fides has for us.
translation: 去看看这位先驱者菲德斯给我们安排了什么任务。

english: Welcome, acolytes. Congratulations on your initiation.
translation: 欢迎，见习者们。恭喜你们通过了入会仪式。

english: Thank you! We're absolutely ecstatic to be here and we're ready to serve!
translation: 谢谢！能来到这里我们简直欣喜若狂，随时准备效劳！

english: I am glad to see you are so eager. We have an essential task for you to help perform. The completion of this task may well be essential in us finding a route to Mokhaiotl.
translation: 很高兴看到你们如此热切。我们有一项重要任务需要你们协助完成。完成这项任务，很可能对我们找到通往莫凯奥特的道路至关重要。

english: What would you have us do?
translation: 您要我们做什么？

english: After the Augur was blessed with glorious purpose, she felt a calling to this place. She came to this fallen temple and built us a home. However, it was not the temple that called to her, but what lies below.
translation: 当预言者被赐予荣耀的使命后，她感受到这个地方的召唤。她来到这座堕落的圣殿，为我们建造了家园。然而，召唤她的并非圣殿，而是下方之物。

english: Below?
translation: 下方？

english: This temple was built atop Tapoyauik, a ruined fortress of the Old Ones. They walked the world during the last cycle, and when the time came for their cycle to end, they embraced their destiny willingly.
translation: 这座圣殿建在塔波亚乌伊克之上，那是古神的一座废墟堡垒。他们在上一个纪元行走于世，当他们的纪元结束时，他们心甘情愿地拥抱了自己的命运。

english: Willingly?
translation: 心甘情愿？

english: Of course! They basked in the glory of Ralos and Ranul and united with them as one, but before they did, they left behind the secrets needed to ensure that we too could fulfil our purpose.
translation: 当然！他们沐浴在拉洛斯和拉努尔的荣光中，与他们合为一体。但在那之前，他们留下了必要的秘密，以确保我们也能完成自己的使命。

english: And the Augur? She found those secrets below?
translation: 那预言者呢？她在下方找到了那些秘密？

english: She did, but there is more to be uncovered. That is where you come in. Tapoyauik is a hostile environment and the passage into the ruins has been blocked.
translation: 是的，但还有更多秘密有待发掘。这就是你们要参与的地方。塔波亚乌伊克环境险恶，通往废墟的通道已被堵塞。

english: Head below and support the efforts in opening the path once more. Do this, and you will be rewarded by Ralos and Ranul themselves!
translation: 下去吧，协助重新打开通道。完成此事，拉洛斯和拉努尔自会亲自奖赏你们！

english: We'll get right to it!
translation: 我们马上去办！

english: Welcome back, acolytes. You should head below and support the efforts in opening the path into Tapoyauik. Do this, and you will be rewarded by Ralos and Ranul themselves!
translation: 欢迎回来，见习者们。你们应该下去，协助打开通往塔波亚乌伊克的道路。完成此事，拉洛斯和拉努尔自会亲自奖赏你们！

english: Let's head down into these ruins.
translation: 我们下到这些废墟里去吧。

english: I'll wait for you inside the temple, [player name].
translation: 我在圣殿里面等你，[player name]。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. Let's head down into these ruins.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我们下到这些废墟里去吧。

english: Can we go down there?
translation: 我们能下去吗？

english: You may. Now move along.
translation: 可以。现在去吧。

english: You may, but you should fetch your companion first.
translation: 可以，但你应该先去找你的同伴。

english: Hey! You should go get your companion before going down there!
translation: 嘿！下去之前你应该先去找你的同伴！

english: How are you with a pickaxe, iknami? I must confess, my own skills with one are rather poor.
translation: 你用镐子用得怎么样，伊克纳米？我得承认，我自己用镐子的技术相当差劲。

english: Did they never teach you how to do a bit of hard labour back when you were young?
translation: 他们小时候没教过你怎么干点体力活吗？

english: We all have different callings, my friend. Mining just wasn't mine.
translation: 我们各有各的天命，我的朋友。采矿不是我的天命罢了。

english: Clearly combat wasn't either given that performance earlier.
translation: 显然战斗也不是，看看你刚才的表现就知道了。

english: Oh I see! You win one fight and you start thinking you're something special.
translation: 哦，我明白了！赢了一场架就开始觉得自己了不起了。

english: Well... yes actually.
translation: 嗯……确实如此。

english: Well then a bit of mining shouldn't be any issue for you then. Get to it!
translation: 那对你来说，干点采矿的活应该不成问题。动手吧！

english: That blockage won't clear itself! Grab a pickaxe and get to work!
translation: 那堵塞物可不会自己清掉！拿把镐子干活去！

english: Excellent work! Ralos and Ranul have blessed us on this day!
translation: 干得好！拉洛斯和拉努尔今天保佑了我们！

english: What's going on?!
translation: 怎么回事？！

english: Nagua! Run!
translation: 纳瓜！快跑！

english: Itzla! Are you okay?
translation: 伊茨拉！你没事吧？

english: Well... I'm alive, which I must be honest, I wasn't really expecting after that!
translation: 嗯……我还活着，老实说，经历了刚才那一下，我本来没指望能活下来的！

english: I can't see any way over to you.
translation: 我看不到任何能到你那边去的路。

english: Nor can I. I think we're just going to have to press on and hope that we can meet up again further ahead.
translation: 我也看不到。我想我们只能继续前进，希望能在前面某个地方再碰头了。

english: Do you see any other options?
translation: 你看到其他选择了吗？

english: Than I shall meet you up ahead. Good luck!
translation: 那我在前面等你。祝你好运！

english: There you are! I was starting to worry you'd got lost.
translation: 你来了！我开始担心你迷路了。

english: There were a few obstacles in my way.
translation: 路上遇到了一些障碍。

english: Well unfortunately it seems we have another before us. I can't see any way to open this door.
translation: 嗯，不幸的是，我们面前似乎又有一个障碍。我看不出有什么办法能打开这扇门。

english: Hmm... I'll have a look around and see what I can find.
translation: 嗯……我四处看看，找找线索。

english: Any luck with this door?
translation: 这扇门有办法了吗？

english: Could I ask you about some words I found carved into the wall?
translation: 我能问问你关于我在墙上发现的一些刻字吗？

english: Oma.
translation: 奥马。

english: Oma? If I remember right, that means the number 'two'.
translation: 奥马？如果我没记错，那意思是数字'二'。

english: Yeya.
translation: 耶亚。

english: Yeya? That means...
translation: 耶亚？那意思是……

english: I think it means 'three'.
translation: 我想是'三'的意思。

english: Naui.
translation: 纳乌伊。

english: Naui? Hmm...
translation: 纳乌伊？嗯……

english: I'm afraid I don't know what that one means.
translation: 恐怕我不知道那个词是什么意思。

english: Not to worry. I'm sure I can still work it out.
translation: 没关系。我相信我自己能弄明白。

english: Zema.
translation: 泽马。

english: Zema? Let's see... That could mean a few things. 'Together', 'people' and 'one' are the ones I remember.
translation: 泽马？让我想想……那可能有好几个意思。我记得的有'一起'、'人民'和'一'。

english: Interesting... Thanks!
translation: 有意思……谢谢！

english: What do you think Metzli found down here?
translation: 你觉得梅茨利在这里找到了什么？

english: Nothing is my guess. The whole point of Ximoua is that it can't be, and shouldn't be, predicted. It's meant to teach us to live freely and not worry about that which we can't control.
translation: 我猜什么都没找到。西莫阿的整个要点就在于它无法、也不应该被预测。它的目的是教导我们自由地生活，不要为那些我们无法控制的事情而烦恼。

english: So she's lying?
translation: 所以她在撒谎？

english: That, or she herself was so desperate to find a greater meaning in something, that she misinterpreted what she did find.
translation: 要么是那样，要么就是她自己太渴望在某件事物中找到更伟大的意义，以至于误解了她确实找到的东西。

english: I suppose it doesn't matter though. This Final Dawn business is total nonsense, but if the Emissaries believe in it, then we need to work out what they consider so important about this place.
translation: 不过我想这并不重要。这个'最终黎明'完全是胡扯，但如果那些使者相信它，那我们就得弄清楚他们认为这个地方有什么重要的。

english: On that note, I guess I should get back to the door.
translation: 说到这个，我想我该回去研究那扇门了。

english: Indeed. There must be some way to open it...
translation: 确实。一定有办法打开它……

english: Nothing yet.
translation: 还没找到办法。

english: There must be some way to open it...
translation: 一定有办法打开它……

english: Help me kill this thing, would you?
translation: 帮我杀了这东西，好吗？

english: Great work opening the door, [player name]. Time to see what awaits us on the other side.
translation: 开门干得漂亮，[player name]。是时候看看另一边有什么在等着我们了。

english: Humans... You stand before Amoxliatl. State your intent.
translation: 人类……你们站在阿莫克斯利亚特尔面前。说明来意。

english: A greeting is not a statement of intent. State your intent.
translation: 问候不是来意声明。说明来意。

english: Er... Well we're looking for information. The cultists in the temple above apparently found something down here. We need to know what they found so we can stop them.
translation: 呃……嗯，我们在寻找信息。上面圣殿里的邪教徒显然在这里找到了什么东西。我们需要知道他们找到了什么，才能阻止他们。

english: Your statement lacks specificity. Clarify. What information?
translation: 你的陈述缺乏具体性。澄清。什么信息？

english: On Mokhaiotl. The cultists are trying to get there.
translation: 关于莫凯奥特的信息。那些邪教徒正试图到达那里。

english: Mokhaiotl? The Tlati archive? That place is not for your kind. You misused the gifts you were granted. You are unworthy.
translation: 莫凯奥特？特拉蒂档案馆？那个地方不适合你们这类人。你们滥用了被赐予的礼物。你们不配。

english: Tlati? As in the rainforest? What do you mean? And what gifts?
translation: 特拉蒂？你是说雨林？你是什么意思？还有，什么礼物？

english: You! Where's Itzla?
translation: 你！伊茨拉在哪？

english: Itzla? He is no longer your concern.
translation: 伊茨拉？他不再是你该关心的事了。

english: Allow me to deal with this nuisance, Augur. The fire of Ralos is within me. He can be the first to bask in it.
translation: 让我来对付这个麻烦的家伙，预言者。拉洛斯之火在我体内。他可以成为第一个沐浴其中的人。

english: Save your fury, brother. This one is unworthy of it.
translation: 省省你的怒火吧，兄弟。这家伙不配。

english: Human arrogance. Here in Tapoyauik, I decide who is worthy.
translation: 人类的傲慢。在塔波亚乌伊克这里，由我来决定谁配得上。

english: Silence, nagua! Do you not know who stands before you?
translation: 闭嘴，纳瓜！你不知道站在你面前的是谁吗？

english: You? You are nothing. You defile this place. Now face the consequences.
translation: 你？你什么都不是。你玷污了此地。现在，面对后果吧。

english: There is nothing more for us here. If the nagua wants blood, our friend here will provide plenty...
translation: 我们在这里没什么可做的了。如果纳瓜想要血，我们这位朋友会提供足够的……

english: You have been abandoned.
translation: 你被抛弃了。

english: I need to get after them!
translation: 我得去追他们！

english: After them? No. You will not be going anywhere...
translation: 追他们？不。你哪儿也去不了……

english: Zema ami miki!
translation: 泽马阿米米基！

english: I'd better get to Fortis and let them know what happened!
translation: 我最好去福蒂斯，让他们知道发生了什么！

english: I need to get over to Fortis rather than going in there again.
translation: 我需要去福蒂斯，而不是再进那里。

english: Ah, nilsal, my child. It is good to see you.
translation: 啊，你好，我的孩子。很高兴见到你。

english: Servius? I wasn't expecting you to be up so soon.
translation: 塞维乌斯？我没想到你会这么快就起来。

english: Ralos still has need of me, my child. I will not bow down to a mere knife wound.
translation: 拉洛斯仍然需要我，我的孩子。我不会因为区区一处刀伤就倒下。

english: Well I'm glad to see you're doing well, but I'm afraid I have some bad news. Itzla has been captured!
translation: 很高兴看到你没事，但我恐怕有个坏消息。伊茨拉被抓了！

english: Captured? What do you mean?
translation: 被抓了？什么意思？

english: We infiltrated the Twilight Emissaries together. We discovered Metzli to be their new leader, with Ennius and Furia at her side. She's claiming the two of them are Ralos and Ranul reborn!
translation: 我们一起潜入了暮光使者。我们发现梅茨利是他们的新领袖，恩尼乌斯和富里亚在她身边。她声称他们两个是拉洛斯和拉努尔转世！

english: Blasphemy and betrayal in equal measure! They will all burn in the light of Ralos for this! And you say they have captured the Prince as well?
translation: 亵渎和背叛，两者不相上下！他们都会为此在拉洛斯之光中燃烧！你说他们还抓了王子？

english: They have. I don't know where they've taken him.
translation: 是的。我不知道他们把他带到哪里去了。

english: This is dire news. I must speak to the Queen at once. Is there anything else I should be aware of before doing so?
translation: 这是可怕的消息。我必须立刻和女王谈谈。在那之前，还有什么我需要知道的吗？

english: The cult are apparently trying to reach Mokhaiotl.
translation: 那些邪教徒显然正试图到达莫凯奥特。

english: Mokhaiotl is not a place that can be reached! These fools are truly lost!
translation: 莫凯奥特尔不是能到达的地方！这些傻瓜真是迷路得彻底！

english: I don't know... Something isn't right about all of this. We encountered a creature in some Old One ruins. The cultists called her a nagua. She referred to Mokhaiotl as the Tlati archive.
translation: 我不清楚……这一切不太对劲。我们在一些上古者废墟里遇到了一只生物。那些邪教徒称她为纳瓜。她把莫凯奥特尔称为特拉提档案库。

english: I don't know... Something isn't right about all of this. We encountered a nagua in some Old One ruins. She called Mokhaiotl the Tlati archive.
translation: 我不清楚……这一切不太对劲。我们在一些上古者废墟里遇到了一只纳瓜。她把莫凯奥特尔称为特拉提档案库。

english: You should be careful of trusting the words of a nagua. Still, I must seek the guidance of Ralos on this matter. First though, I will speak with the Queen.
translation: 你应当小心，别轻信纳瓜的话。不过，我仍须就此寻求拉洛斯的指引。但首先，我要去和女王谈谈。

english: Fear not. I will ensure the Queen involves you in whatever plans are made for dealing with this cult. On that note, I'd best not delay. May the sun light your way, my child.
translation: 别担心。我会确保女王在制定对付这个邪教的计划时把你算进去。好了，我最好别耽搁了。愿阳光照亮你的道路，我的孩子。

english: If you're going to speak to the Queen now, maybe I should join you?
translation: 如果你现在要去跟女王谈，也许我应该跟你一起去？

english: Are you sure? It might be best for me to speak to her first. She will not take kindly to this development. I would hate for you to face her fire, my child.
translation: 你确定吗？也许最好我先去跟她说。她不会对这个进展有好感的。我可不想让你面对她的怒火，我的孩子。

english: Yes you!
translation: 没错，就是你！

english: Can I... help you?
translation: 有……什么事吗？

english: That depends. Do you like making money?
translation: 那得看情况。你喜欢赚钱吗？

english: I'm not averse to making money.
translation: 我不排斥赚钱。

english: And do you enjoy... milk?
translation: 那你喜欢……牛奶吗？

english: Milk?
translation: 牛奶？

english: Milk.
translation: 牛奶。

english: I suppose it's okay.
translation: 我觉得还行吧。

english: Well, fair enough. If your passion for milk changes, let me know.
translation: 好吧，说得过去。如果你对牛奶的热情有变，记得告诉我。

english: I can't say I've thought much about it.
translation: 我倒是没怎么想过这个问题。

english: Would you like to think more about it?
translation: 你想再多考虑一下吗？

english: What am I going to get from thinking more about... milk?
translation: 多考虑……牛奶，我能得到什么？

english: Profit!
translation: 利润！

english: Ten to fifteen percent, performance depending.
translation: 百分之十到十五，视业绩而定。

english: How are we going to be making that profit? And who even are you anyway?
translation: 我们打算怎么赚这笔钱？而且你到底是谁啊？

english: Ah, my name is Cassius. I got carried away.
translation: 啊，我叫卡西乌斯。刚才太激动了。

english: But, we're going to construct an empire.
translation: 不过，我们要建立一个帝国。

english: Of milk?
translation: 牛奶帝国？

english: Of milk.
translation: 牛奶帝国。

english: How do you intend to make an empire of milk?
translation: 你打算怎么建立一个牛奶帝国？

english: So, the first step is going to involve you doing a little... research.
translation: 所以，第一步需要你去做一点……调查。

english: You're going to cross the River Lum, find Gillie and Seth Groats, and learn about animal husbandry.
translation: 你要穿过卢姆河，找到吉利和塞斯.格罗茨，学习畜牧业的知识。

english: Then... Then you're going to cross back to this side of the river, and tell me all about how they've made their animals so productive.
translation: 然后……你再回到河这边，把他们是怎样让牲口这么高产的方法，一五一十地告诉我。

english: It's a perfect plan!
translation: 完美的计划！

english: What use is it if I know everything and you don't? Couldn't I make my own... milk empire... with that information?
translation: 我知道了一切而你却不知道，这有什么用？我难道不能用这些信息自己建一个……牛奶帝国吗？

english: If anything I should be cutting you in at ten to fifteen percent.
translation: 要说的话，应该是我分给你百分之十到十五才对。

english: Hey, I'm the one supplying the high-quality milk here.
translation: 嘿，这里提供高品质牛奶的人可是我。

english: Not to mention, my associate Brutus is already embedded in the Groats operation to work a different angle. That will prove most lucrative.
translation: 更别提，我的同伙布鲁图斯已经潜伏在格罗茨家的农场里，从另一个角度下手了。那将会非常有利可图。

english: Right... I guess I'll go and see the Groatses then.
translation: 好吧……那我去找格罗茨一家谈谈。

english: No, I'm not sure I would like that, thank you.
translation: 不了，我觉得我不太想这样，谢谢。

english: Releasing the bull into the cow pen is a bad idea.
translation: 把公牛放进母牛圈是个坏主意。

english: What was it you needed me to do again?
translation: 你刚才要我做什么来着？

english: I need you to speak to Gillie and Seth Groats. We need to learn everything we can.
translation: 我需要你去和吉利.格罗茨还有塞斯.格罗茨谈谈。我们得尽可能多学点东西。

english: They live just across the River Lum. Head east from here and you should be able to find them.
translation: 他们就住在卢姆河对岸。从这里往东走，你应该能找到他们。

english: Can you share what makes your cows so productive?
translation: 能分享一下你们让奶牛这么高产的方法吗？

english: Absolutely! The secret is happiness.
translation: 当然可以！秘诀就是快乐。

english: Happiness?
translation: 快乐？

english: The cows make the best milk when they're happy, and to be honest, they make too much!
translation: 奶牛开心的时候产的奶最好，而且说实话，它们产得太多了！

english: I'm always glad that adventurers come by and help with milking them. I wouldn't be able to keep up otherwise.
translation: 我一直很高兴有冒险者过来帮忙挤奶。不然我一个人根本忙不过来。

english: That can't be everything though, can it?
translation: 但这应该不是全部吧？

english: Come to think of it, I'm sure my father keeps a few tricks up his sleeve. Why don't you go and ask him?
translation: 说起来，我父亲肯定还藏着几手绝活。你不如去问问他？

english: That would be Seth, wouldn't it?
translation: 那是塞思，对吧？

english: It would be! I'm sure he'll he happy to share some information with you.
translation: 没错！我相信他很乐意跟你分享一些信息的。

english: I'll go and speak to him now, thank you!
translation: 我现在就去跟他说，谢谢你！

english: I've already had a chance to talk to him. He did indeed have some tricks to share!
translation: 我已经跟他谈过了。他确实分享了一些诀窍！

english: That's good. You must be ready to care for your own cows at this point!
translation: 那就好。看来你已经准备好照顾自己的奶牛了！

english: If you think so, then I must be. Thank you for your help, I'll make sure that knowledge is put to good use.
translation: 如果你这么觉得，那我肯定是准备好了。谢谢你的帮助，我会确保这些知识得到充分利用的。

english: Well well, what can I do for you?
translation: 哎呀呀，我能为你做点什么？

english: I was wondering if you could teach me a little about how you're so successful with your animals.
translation: 我想知道你能不能教我一些，你是怎么把牲口养得这么成功的。

english: Lookin' to get into the business, eh?
translation: 想入这行，嗯？

english: Something along those lines.
translation: 差不多是这个意思。

english: Well, always happy to help another budding farmer out!
translation: 好吧，我一向乐意帮助其他有抱负的农夫！

english: Great! So where do I start?
translation: 太好了！那我该从哪里开始？

english: Would always recommend me Groats Principles as yer basics.
translation: 我总是推荐我的格罗茨原则作为基础。

english: Groats Principles?
translation: 格罗茨原则？

english: Aye. First one is that happy animals makes happy farmers.
translation: 没错。第一条是，快乐的牲口造就快乐的农夫。

english: Second of me principles is to never take more than you need. Greed'll stop you in your tracks.
translation: 我的第二条原则是，永远不要索取超过你所需。贪婪会让你寸步难行。

english: The last principle: never let the taxman know yer earnings. Money should be spent on the animals!
translation: 最后一条原则：永远别让税官知道你的收入。钱应该花在牲口身上！

english: I don't think I've ever paid any taxes.
translation: 我好像从来没交过税。

english: You're ahead of the game then!
translation: 那你已经领先一步了！

english: You've found a way to get around the taxes?
translation: 你找到逃税的办法了？

english: A way or two.
translation: 有那么一两种方法吧。

english: Anyway, feel free to grab me book on the topic from the shelf over there.
translation: 总之，你随便去那边的架子上拿我那本关于这个主题的书吧。

english: Okay, thank you for the help.
translation: 好的，谢谢你的帮助。

english: Mmm we already had this talk. Go read me book on the shelf over there.
translation: 嗯，我们已经谈过了。去那边的架子上读我的书吧。

english: I'll go grab it, thanks.
translation: 我去拿，谢谢。

english: I've actually got it here, I'll take it away and give it a read somewhere a little more peaceful.
translation: 其实我已经拿到手了，我带走到更安静的地方去读。

english: So, how did you get on?
translation: 那么，你进展如何？

english: I've learned a lot about how the Groats family care for their animals. They say the secret is happiness!
translation: 我学到了很多关于格罗茨家族如何照顾动物的知识。他们说秘诀就是快乐！

english: Happiness?! That can't be the only trick they use! Surely you found something else?
translation: 快乐？！这不可能只是他们用的唯一招数！你肯定还发现了别的什么吧？

english: Now that you mention it, Seth did say he had a book that I... don't have on me right now.
translation: 既然你提到了，塞思确实说过他有一本书，而我……现在没带在身上。

english: The legendary Groats book on milk cultivation? I'm most interested! Go fetch it!
translation: 格罗茨家族关于牛奶培育的传奇之书？我非常感兴趣！快去拿来！

english: I have this book from Seth. He claims it's got his principles of animal husbandry in it, if that's of any use?
translation: 我从塞思那里拿到了这本书。他说里面记录了他的畜牧原则，不知道有没有用？

english: Hand it here, quickly!
translation: 快拿过来！

english: Now, this is most curious.
translation: 这真是非常奇怪。

english: The idea that a happy animal will do what you want is frankly absurd. What if they choose to not produce. Are you supposed to respect that?
translation: 认为快乐的动物就会听你的话，坦率地说荒谬至极。如果它们选择不产出呢？难道你还得尊重它们的意愿？

english: However, the writings on the systems of taxation are fascinating. I couldn't imagine Seth was smart enough to put this together.
translation: 不过，关于税收制度的论述倒是令人着迷。我没想到塞思能有这么聪明，能把这些东西整合起来。

english: So, do you think this is enough to start our milk empire?
translation: 那么，你觉得这足够我们建立牛奶帝国了吗？

english: No, no. Not quite yet. First of all, you haven't tried our milk yet, have you?
translation: 不，不。还差得远。首先，你还没尝过我们的牛奶吧？

english: I don't think I have, no. You already have some milk?
translation: 我好像还没尝过，没有。你已经有一些牛奶了？

english: Don't look so worried. Here, have a try.
translation: 别那么担心。来，试试看。

english: I've managed to lose that sample of milk...
translation: 我不小心把那份牛奶样品弄丢了……

english: I'll give you some more once you've got some space.
translation: 等你有空位了，我再给你一些。

english: Have you given that sample a try yet?
translation: 你试过那份样品了吗？

english: Oh, that's not good milk.
translation: 哦，这不是好牛奶。

english: That's really not good milk.
translation: 那真的不是好牛奶。

english: So, what do you think? The milk is fantastic, isn't it?
translation: 那么，你觉得怎么样？这牛奶棒极了，对吧？

english: It wasn't what I was expecting, certainly.
translation: 当然，这和我预想的不一样。

english: We're going to change the lactic landscape! Before we do though, I have another task for you.
translation: 我们要改变这片风景画！不过在此之前，我还有另一个任务要交给你。

english: Now what do you need?
translation: 你现在需要什么？

english: We need... a permit.
translation: 我们需要……一份许可证。

english: Shouldn't you have got a permit before making milk?
translation: 你难道不应该在制作牛奶之前就拿到许可证吗？

english: The permit is to sell milk, not to make milk!
translation: 许可证是用来卖牛奶的，不是用来制作牛奶的！

english: Fine, where are we going to get this permit?
translation: 好吧，我们去哪里办这个许可证？

english: From the Duke of Lumbridge! Where else? You need to bring him our milk and I'm sure he'll give us our permit without fuss.
translation: 从仑桥镇公爵那里！还能去哪？你给他带去我们的牛奶，我肯定他会爽快地给我们许可证。

english: Are you sure having the Duke drink our milk is a good idea?
translation: 你确定让公爵喝我们的牛奶是个好主意吗？

english: Of course! Soon the whole of Lumbridge will be drinking my, I mean our milk!
translation: 当然！很快整个仑桥镇都会喝我的——我是说我们的牛奶！

english: I don't think I'm ready to drink another vial of this stuff.
translation: 我觉得我还没准备好再喝一瓶这玩意儿。

english: I should find someone else to give it to.
translation: 我应该把它送给别人。

english: Has the Duke given us our permit yet?
translation: 公爵给我们许可证了吗？

english: Not yet, no. I could do with another sample of milk though, if you have one spare?
translation: 还没有。不过我需要再一份牛奶样品，如果你有多余的话？

english: I should have one somewhere here. Just a moment.
translation: 我这里应该有一份。稍等。

english: It looks like you don't have space to carry this. You'll have to grab it from me when you have room.
translation: 看来你没有空间携带这个。等你有空位了再来找我拿吧。

english: Not yet, no, but I am working on it!
translation: 还没有，不过我正在努力！

english: Greetings. I come seeking a business permit.
translation: 你好。我是来申请营业执照的。

english: Oh wonderful! What sort of business are you looking to start?
translation: 哦，太好了！你想开什么类型的生意？

english: I'm looking to get into the milk trade!
translation: 我想进入牛奶贸易行业！

english: Milk? Well, the Groats family still have their permit, and I can't start stepping on their toes.
translation: 牛奶？嗯，格罗茨家族仍然持有许可证，我不能踩到他们的地盘。

english: If you'd just try this milk...
translation: 如果你先尝尝这牛奶……

english: I really couldn't possibly give you a permit without their approval. This is really their territory.
translation: 没有他们的同意，我真的不可能给你许可证。这确实是他们的地盘。

english: Why not speak to Gillie Groats? She seems to handle the milk side of the business now. Maybe she'll get you set up under their permit.
translation: 为什么不跟吉利.格罗茨谈谈？她现在似乎负责牛奶业务。也许她能在他们的许可证下帮你安排。

english: You're the Duke. Couldn't you just grant a permit?
translation: 你是公爵。你就不能直接批一份许可证吗？

english: No, no. It's really quite important you speak to Gillie about this.
translation: 不，不。你必须跟吉利谈这件事，这真的很重要。

english: Aren't you the highest power in this land?
translation: 你不是这片土地上权力最大的人吗？

english: Don't go digging too deeply into that. Even I have some... commitments that I have to keep to.
translation: 别深究这件事。即使是我也有一些……必须遵守的承诺。

english: But you're the Duke, you shouldn't need the approval of a business entity to grant a permit.
translation: 但你是公爵，你不需要一个商业实体的批准才能发放许可证。

english: Not to mention, can't they just refuse to have any competitors?
translation: 更何况，他们难道不能拒绝任何竞争对手吗？

english: Well absolutely, but I'm sure you'll find they're more than reasonable about things.
translation: 嗯，当然，但我相信你会发现他们非常通情达理。

english: Entirely. Completely reasonable.
translation: 完全合理。绝对通情达理。

english: Hi, what did you want me to do for the permit again?
translation: 嗨，你刚才要我做什么来获得许可证来着？

english: Go speak to Gillie Groats. She seems to handle the milk business in Lumbridge. Maybe she'll get you set up under their permit.
translation: 去找吉利.格罗茨谈谈。她似乎负责仑桥镇的牛奶生意。也许她能在他们的许可证下帮你安排。

english: Hiya, did you need something else from me?
translation: 嗨，你还需要我做什么吗？

english: I did. I've been trying to secure a business permit from the Duke, but he said that as it is a milk-related business venture, I should speak to you instead.
translation: 是的。我一直试图从公爵那里拿到营业执照，但他说因为是牛奶相关的生意，我应该来找你谈。

english: The Duke is a good man, directing you to me! I've been running the milk side of our farm for a while now.
translation: 公爵是个好人，把你引荐给我！我经营我们农场的牛奶业务已经有一段时间了。

english: Were you thinking of being a competitor to us then?
translation: 那么，你是想成为我们的竞争对手吗？

english: I can prove we wouldn't be if you could just try this sample of...
translation: 我可以证明我们不会，只要你试试这份样品……

english: Sample of?
translation: 什么样品？

english: I seem to have misplaced my sample of milk. I'll be back when I have it.
translation: 我好像把我的牛奶样品放错地方了。等我找到再回来。

english: I think if you were to try this sample here you'd see we wouldn't be competing.
translation: 我想如果你尝尝这份样品，你就会明白我们不会成为竞争对手。

english: You want me to drink a vial of mysterious liquid?
translation: 你想让我喝一瓶神秘液体？

english: Well, it's not mysterious, it's milk!
translation: 嗯，不是神秘液体，是牛奶！

english: No, I think you should drink it, I'll know the quality of it from your reaction.
translation: 不，我觉得你应该喝，我从你的反应就能知道它的质量。

english: It is just milk after all.
translation: 毕竟只是牛奶而已。

english: Would it convince you to help me with my permit?
translation: 这能说服你帮我办理许可证吗？

english: It definitely won't hurt your chances.
translation: 这肯定不会损害你的机会。

english: Have you tried that milk sample yet?
translation: 你试过那份牛奶样品了吗？

english: Not yet. I really don't want to, but I guess I must.
translation: 还没有。我真的不想，但我想我必须这么做。

english: I shouldn't drink this unless I have Gillie nearby.
translation: 除非吉利在旁边，否则我不该喝这个。

english: Oh, that's worse milk than before.
translation: 哦，这牛奶比以前更糟糕。

english: That looked like a horrible experience.
translation: 那看起来是一次可怕的经历。

english: It wasn't pleasant.
translation: 一点都不愉快。

english: Where did you even get that milk?
translation: 你到底从哪儿弄来的那牛奶？

english: My business partner, Cassius. I don't know where he gets it from originally though.
translation: 我的生意伙伴卡西乌斯。不过我不知道他最初是从哪里弄来的。

english: Cassius... I don't recognise the name. He's not mentioned anything about its source?
translation: 卡西乌斯……我没听说过这个名字。他没提过来源吗？

english: Nothing, but he apparently has enough of a source to start a business. I'm mostly trying to be helpful.
translation: 什么都没提，但他显然有足够的货源来开店。我只是想帮帮忙。

english: If the milk's bad, you're not going to recommend us for a permit, are you?
translation: 如果牛奶不好，你不会推荐我们申请许可证，对吧？

english: With how bad it looks, you wouldn't be any competition to us.
translation: 看它有多糟糕，你们对我们构不成任何竞争。

english: However, I wonder if I'd be doing a public service by protecting anyone else from it.
translation: 不过，我在想，保护其他人免受其害，是不是也算在做好事。

english: Is there anything more I could do to convince you?
translation: 我还能做些什么来说服你吗？

english: Now that you mention it, I've had an incredibly aggressive bull disrupting my herd lately. I've got him caught in the pen over there.
translation: 既然你提了，最近有一头极其好斗的公牛在扰乱我的牛群。我已经把它关在那边围栏里了。

english: Perhaps you'd be interested in dealing with him? I'd owe you a fairly large favour.
translation: 也许你有兴趣处理它？我会欠你一个大人情。

english: A roughly permit sized favour?
translation: 差不多能抵得上许可证的人情？

english: How are you getting on with the bull?
translation: 那头公牛处理得怎么样了？

english: I'm getting there! He looks quite tough though.
translation: 快好了！不过它看起来相当强悍。

english: It's become rather complicated, but I am working it out!
translation: 事情变得相当复杂，但我正在解决！

english: Brutus has already been dealt with.
translation: 布鲁图斯已经被处理掉了。

english: You succeeded! I'll let the Duke know that you're all good to start a milk business.
translation: 你成功了！我会让公爵知道你们完全适合开始牛奶生意。

english: I don't think that's going to be necessary anymore.
translation: 我想这已经没有必要了。

english: Oh? What happened in that field?
translation: 哦？那块田里发生了什么？

english: That bull was Cassius' other business partner, Brutus.
translation: 那头公牛是卡西乌斯的另一个生意伙伴，布鲁图斯。

english: I'm sure he won't be feeling particularly friendly once I let him know.
translation: 我肯定等我告诉他之后，他不会太友好。

english: That bull was one of the business partners?
translation: 那头公牛是商业伙伴之一？

english: I wonder if his aggression is why Cassius' herd are producing such bad milk...
translation: 我在想是不是因为它的好斗才导致卡西乌斯的牛群产出这么差的牛奶...

english: I'm starting to think Cassius doesn't even have his own herd.
translation: 我开始怀疑卡西乌斯根本没有自己的牛群。

english: You think he's been stealing milk?
translation: 你觉得他一直在偷牛奶？

english: I'm not sure where else he would've been getting it from.
translation: 我不确定他还能从哪里搞到牛奶。

english: Why don't you go and talk to him about it! He may appreciate knowing theBrutus was bad for business.
translation: 你为什么不去和他谈谈呢！他也许会感谢你告诉他布鲁图斯对生意不利。

english: Thank you once again for handling Brutus, he was causing quite a problem for my herd.
translation: 再次感谢你处理了布鲁图斯，它给我的牛群造成了相当大的麻烦。

english: And, if you haven't yet spoken to Cassius, you should probably let him know what's transpired.
translation: 还有，如果你还没和卡西乌斯谈过，你或许应该告诉他发生了什么。

english: Cassius, I don't think we'll be getting our business permit.
translation: 卡西乌斯，我觉得我们拿不到营业许可了。

english: Why? What's happened?
translation: 为什么？发生什么事了？

english: Brutus is dead.
translation: 布鲁图斯死了。

english: Dead?
translation: 死了？

english: How could this have happened?
translation: 这怎么可能发生？

english: So the Duke asked me to... and then Gillie said that...
translation: 所以公爵让我...然后吉利说...

english: You?!
Don't tell me you killed Brutus and ruined my- our, plan?
translation: 别告诉我你杀了布鲁图斯，毁了我的——我们的计划？

english: In my defence, I had no idea that was Brutus! You made it sound like he was a business partner.
translation: 恕我辩护，我完全不知道那是布鲁图斯！你让我听起来他像个生意伙伴。

english: Not to mention, apparently his aggression was ruining Seth's herd's milk. This should be a good thing!
translation: 更何况，显然它的好斗破坏了赛斯牛群的牛奶质量。这应该是件好事！

english: Ruining the milk? The unique flavour was what I was trying to sell!
translation: 破坏牛奶？那独特的风味正是我想卖的东西！

english: You should leave. I can't even look at you.
translation: 你该走了。我甚至不想看你。

english: Oh, just the person I wanted to see! I have something for you.
translation: 哦，正是我想见的人！我有东西给你。

english: Ah, your inventory is full. Can you make some room?
translation: 啊，你的背包满了。能腾点空间吗？

english: This is for helping out with that bull. Our cows are much happier these days.
translation: 这是为了感谢你处理那头公牛。我们的奶牛这些天开心多了。

english: One of our local milk enjoyers gave us some enchanted cow bells.
translation: 我们当地的一位牛奶爱好者给了我们一些附魔的牛铃铛。

english: They seem to be quite versatile, enjoy!
translation: 它们似乎用途广泛，好好享用吧！

english: Wow, thank you! I'll make sure to check it out.
translation: 哇，谢谢你！我一定会去看看的。

english: I also have something else for you but your inventory is full. Can you make some room?
translation: 我还有别的东西给你，但你的背包满了。能腾点空间吗？

english: I also have this for you!
translation: 我还有这个给你！

english: I have this for you!
translation: 我有这个给你！

english: I've lost that amulet you gave me...
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那个护身符...

english: Oh, no worries, here's another.
translation: 哦，别担心，这里还有一个。

english: Hello. I am the squire to Sir Vyvin.
translation: 你好。我是维文爵士的侍从。

english: And how is life as a squire?
translation: 当侍从的日子怎么样？

english: Well, Sir Vyvin is a good guy to work for, however, I'm in a spot of trouble today. I've gone and lost Sir Vyvin's sword!
translation: 嗯，维文爵士是个好雇主，不过我今天遇到点麻烦。我把维文爵士的剑弄丢了！

english: Do you know where you lost it?
translation: 你知道丢在哪里了吗？

english: Well now, if I knew THAT it wouldn't be lost, now would it?
translation: 要是知道的话，它就不会丢了，对吧？

english: Well, do you know the VAGUE AREA you lost it in?
translation: 那你知道大概丢在哪个区域吗？

english: No. I was carrying it for him all the way from where he had it stored in Lumbridge. It must have slipped from my pack during the trip, and you know what people are like these days...
translation: 不知道。我一路从仑桥镇他存放的地方帮他拿着剑，路上肯定从我的包里滑出来了。你也知道现在的人什么样……

english: Someone will have just picked it up and kept it for themselves.
translation: 肯定有人捡到就自己留着了。

english: Well, the kingdom is fairly abundant with swords...
translation: 嗯，王国里剑多的是……

english: Yes. You can get bronze swords anywhere. But THIS isn't any old sword.
translation: 是啊，青铜剑到处都能买到。但这把可不是普通的剑。

english: The thing is, this sword is a family heirloom. It has been passed down through Vyvin's family for five generations! It was originally made by the Imcando dwarves, who were
translation: 问题是，这把剑是传家宝。已经在维文家族传了五代了！它最初是由伊姆坎多矮人打造的，他们是一支技艺特别精湛的矮人铁匠部落。

english: a particularly skilled tribe of dwarven smiths. I doubt anyone could make it in the style they do.
translation: 我怀疑没人能做出他们那种风格的剑。

english: I can make a new sword if you like...
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以做一把新剑……

english: Thanks for the offer. I'd be surprised if you could though.
translation: 谢谢你的好意。不过你要是真能做出来，我倒要惊讶了。

english: So would these dwarves make another one?
translation: 那这些矮人会再做一把吗？

english: I'm not a hundred percent sure the Imcando tribe exists anymore. I should think Reldo, the palace librarian in Varrock, will know; he has done a lot of research on the races of Gielinor.
translation: 我不太确定伊姆坎多部落是否还存在。我觉得维洛克城宫殿的图书管理员雷尔多应该知道；他对吉列诺的各个种族做过很多研究。

english: I don't suppose you could try and track down the Imcando dwarves for me? I've got so much work to do...
translation: 你能不能帮我去找找伊姆坎多矮人？我手头有太多事要做了……

english: Thank you very much! As I say, the best place to start should be with Reldo...
translation: 非常感谢！就像我说的，最好先从雷尔多那里开始……

english: I'll help, I know an Imcando dwarf!
translation: 我来帮忙，我认识一个伊姆坎多矮人！

english: What, really? That is wonderful to hear! Where is he then?
translation: 什么，真的吗？太好了！那他在哪里？

english: He's living on a cliff at the very south end of Asgarnia, south of Port Sarim. I'll go right over to him.
translation: 他住在阿斯加尼亚最南端的一个悬崖上，沙林港以南。我这就去找他。

english: No. I've got lots of mining work to do.
translation: 不。我有很多采矿工作要做。

english: Oh man... I'm in such trouble...
translation: 天哪……我麻烦大了……

english: Well, I hope you find it soon.
translation: 嗯，希望你尽快找到它。

english: Yes, me too. I'm not looking forward to telling Vyvin I've lost it. He's going to want it for the parade next week as well.
translation: 是啊，我也希望。我真不想告诉维文我把它弄丢了。他下周游行还要用呢。

english: Is he angry?
translation: 他生气吗？

english: He doesn't know yet. I was hoping I could think of something to do before he does find out, But I find myself at a loss.
translation: 他还不知道。我本来希望在他发现之前能想出办法，但现在我束手无策了。

english: Wouldn't you prefer to be a squire for me?
translation: 你不想当我的侍从吗？

english: No, sorry, I'm loyal to Sir Vyvin.
translation: 不，抱歉，我对维文爵士忠心耿耿。

english: So how are you doing getting a sword?
translation: 你找剑的事进展如何？

english: I'm looking for Imcando dwarves to help me.
translation: 我在找伊姆坎多矮人来帮忙。

english: Please try and find them quickly... I am scared Sir Vyvin will find out!
translation: 请尽快找到他们……我怕维文爵士会发现！

english: Are you an Imcando dwarf? I need a special sword.
translation: 你是伊姆坎多矮人吗？我需要一把特殊的剑。

english: I don't talk about that sort of thing anymore. I'm getting old.
translation: 我不想再谈那些事了。我老了。

english: Can you make a special sword for me?
translation: 你能为我做一把特殊的剑吗？

english: Well, you know what to do! Get me another redberry pie and I'll consider it!
translation: 嗯，你知道该怎么做！再给我弄个红莓派来，我就考虑考虑！

english: Well, after bringing me my favorite food I guess I should give it a go. What sort of sword is it?
translation: 好吧，既然你给我带来了我最喜欢的食物，我想我应该试试。是什么样的剑？

english: I need you to make a sword for one of Falador's knights. He had one which was passed down through five generations, but his squire has lost it.
translation: 我需要你为法尔多的一位骑士做一把剑。他有一把传了五代的剑，但被他的侍从弄丢了。

english: So we need an identical one to replace it.
translation: 所以我们需要一把一模一样的来替换。

english: A knight's sword eh? Well, I'd need to know exactly how it looked before I could make a new one.
translation: 一把骑士的剑，嗯？那我得先知道它确切的样子才能做新的。

english: All the Faladian knights used to have swords with unique designs according to their position. Could you bring me a picture or something?
translation: 所有法尔多的骑士以前都有根据自己地位设计的独特剑。你能给我带张图或者类似的东西吗？

english: I'll go and ask his squire and see if I can find one.
translation: 我去问问他的侍从，看看能不能找到一张。

english: About that sword...
translation: 关于那把剑……

english: Have you got a picture of the sword for me yet?
translation: 你拿到剑的图了吗？

english: Sorry, not yet.
translation: 抱歉，还没有。

english: I've found an Imcando dwarf but he needs a picture of the sword before he can make it.
translation: 我找到了一个伊姆坎多矮人，但他需要一张剑的图才能做。

english: A picture eh? Hmmm.... The only one I can think of is in a small portrait of Sir Vyvin's father... Sir Vyvin keeps it in a cupboard in his room I think.
translation: 一张图，嗯？嗯……我唯一能想到的是维文爵士父亲的一张小肖像……我想维文爵士把它放在他房间的橱柜里。

english: Ok, I'll try and get that then.
translation: 好的，那我去试试拿过来。

english: Please don't let him catch you! He MUSTN'T know what happened!
translation: 千万别让他抓住你！他绝对不能知道发生了什么！

english: I didn't get the picture yet.
translation: 我还没拿到图。

english: Please try and get it quickly... I am scared Sir Vyvin will find out!
translation: 请快点拿到……我怕维文爵士会发现！

english: I have the picture. I'll just take it to the dwarf now!
translation: 我拿到图了。我现在就拿去给矮人！

english: I have found a picture of the sword I would like you to make.
translation: 我找到了一张剑的图，想请你照着做。

english: You'll need to get me some stuff to make this. I'll need two iron bars to make the sword, to start with. I'll also need an ore called blurite.
translation: 你得给我弄些材料来做这个。首先，我需要两块铁条来打剑身。我还需要一种叫蓝铁矿石的矿石。

english: Blurite is useless for making actual weapons, except crossbows, but I'll need some as decoration for the hilt.
translation: 蓝铁矿石除了做弩之外，做实际武器没什么用，但我需要一些来装饰剑柄。

english: It is a fairly rare ore. The only place I know to get it is under this cliff here, but it is guarded by a very powerful ice giant.
translation: 这是一种相当稀有的矿石。我知道的唯一地方就是这悬崖下面，但那里有一个非常强大的冰巨人守着。

english: Most of the rocks in that cliff are pretty useless, and don't contain much of anything, but there's DEFINITELY some blurite in there.
translation: 那个悬崖里的大部分岩石都没什么用，几乎不含任何东西，但里面绝对有一些蓝铁矿石。

english: You'll need a little bit of mining experience to be able to find it.
translation: 你需要一点采矿经验才能找到它。

english: Okay. I'll go and find them then.
translation: 好的。那我去找它们。

english: I've found a dwarf who will make the sword. I've just got to find the materials for it now!
translation: 我找到了一个会做剑的矮人。我现在只需要找到材料！

english: How are you doing finding those sword materials?
translation: 你找剑的材料找得怎么样了？

english: I don't have any of them yet.
translation: 我还没找到任何材料。

english: Well, I need a blurite ore and two iron bars. The only place I know to get blurite is under this cliff here, but it is guarded by a very powerful ice giant.
translation: 嗯，我需要一块蓝铁矿石和两块铁条。我知道的唯一能弄到蓝铁矿石的地方就是这悬崖下面，但那里有一个非常强大的冰巨人守着。

english: Can you make that replacement sword now?
translation: 你现在能做那把替换的剑了吗？

english: I don't have any blurite ore yet.
translation: 我还没有蓝铁矿石。

english: Better go get some then, huh? The only place I know to get it is under this cliff here, but it is guarded by a very powerful ice giant.
translation: 那最好去弄一些，嗯？我知道的唯一地方就是这悬崖下面，但那里有一个非常强大的冰巨人守着。

english: I don't have two iron bars.
translation: 我没有两块铁条。

english: Better go get some then, huh?
translation: 那最好去弄一些，嗯？

english: Just remember to call in with more pie some time!
translation: 记得有空再带点派来！

english: Thanks for making that sword for me!
translation: 谢谢你帮我做了这把剑！

english: You're welcome - thanks for the pie!
translation: 不客气——谢谢你的派！

english: I have retrieved your sword for you.
translation: 我帮你把剑找回来了。

english: So can you un-equip it and hand it over to me now please?
translation: 那你能把它卸下来交给我吗？

english: Thank you, thank you, thank you! I was seriously worried I would have to own up to Sir Vyvin!
translation: 谢谢，谢谢，谢谢！我真的很担心要向维文爵士坦白！

english: There was recently some damage to the castle cellar. Part of the wall has collapsed.
translation: 最近城堡地窖有些损坏。部分墙壁倒塌了。

english: The Duke insists that it was an earthquake, but I think some kind of monsters are to blame.
translation: 公爵坚持说是地震，但我认为是一些怪物造成的。

english: You should ask people around the town about it. Maybe someone saw something.
translation: 你该问问镇上的人。也许有人看到了什么。

english: I asked you to talk to people around Lumbridge to see if any of them know what happened in the cellar.
translation: 我之前让你去问问仑桥镇附近的人，看看有没有人知道地窖里发生了什么。

english: What happened in the cellar?
translation: 地窖里发生了什么？

english: The wall collapsed because of an earthquake. I'm waiting for a team of builders to come and repair it.
translation: 墙壁因地震倒塌了。我在等一队工匠来修复。

english: Oh no, it's terrible, isn't it? There was rock dust everywhere, it got on all my ingredients!
translation: 哦不，太糟糕了，对吧？到处是石尘，把我的食材全弄脏了！

english: The wall collapsed. I had to spend all day clearing it up! The Duke says it was an earthquake.
translation: 墙塌了。我花了一整天清理！公爵说是地震。

english: Last night I was in the kitchen and I heard a noise from the cellar. I opened the trapdoor and saw a creature dart into a hole in the wall.
translation: 昨晚我在厨房里，听到地窖传来声响。我打开活板门，看到一个生物冲进了墙上的洞。

english: It looked a bit like a goblin, but it had big bulging eyes. It wasn't wearing armour, but it had this odd helmet with a light on it.
translation: 它看起来有点像哥布林，但有一双鼓鼓的大眼睛。没有穿盔甲，但戴着一顶奇怪的头盔，上面有灯。

english: The tunnel was too dark for me to follow it, so I went to tell the Duke. But when we went down to the cellar the hole had been blocked up, and no one believes me.
translation: 隧道太黑了，我没法跟进去，就去告诉了公爵。但我们下到地窖时，洞已经被堵住了，没有人相信我。

english: I believe you.
translation: 我相信你。

english: Thank you, [player name]! If you can convince the Duke I'm telling the truth then we can get to the bottom of this mystery.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]！如果你能让公爵相信我说的是真话，我们就能查明这个谜团的真相了。

english: I told you about the creature I saw. You should go and tell the Duke.
translation: 我告诉过你我看到的生物了。你应该去告诉公爵。

english: Bob says he saw something in the cellar. Like a goblin with big eyes.
translation: 鲍勃说他在地窖里看到了什么东西。像是一个大眼睛的哥布林。

english: A goblin? This validates my suspicion! We should tell the Duke!
translation: 哥布林？这证实了我的怀疑！我们该去告诉公爵！

english: Yes, he mentioned that to me. But I think he was imagining things. Goblins live in natural caves but everyone knows they don't have the wit to make their own tunnels.
translation: 是的，他跟我提过。但我觉得他在胡思乱想。哥布林住在天然洞穴里，但谁都知道他们没有脑子自己挖隧道。

english: Yes your grace, but if there is any possibility that this is a goblin incursion then we should take that possibility very seriously!
translation: 是的，公爵大人，但如果这有可能是哥布林的入侵，那我们就必须非常认真地对待这种可能性！

english: I think we should at least investigate.
translation: 我认为至少应该调查一下。

english: Your grace, this is the adventurer who defeated the dragon Elvarg. I think you should listen to [him/her/them].
translation: 公爵大人，这位就是击败了龙艾尔瓦格的冒险者。我认为您应该听听他/她/他们的意见。

english: Your grace, this adventurer took that talisman you discovered to Sedridor. I think you should listen to [him/her/them].
translation: 公爵大人，这位冒险者把您发现的那个护符带给了塞德里多。我认为您应该听听他/她/他们的意见。

english: Hmm, very well. I give you permission to investigate this mystery. If there is a blocked tunnel then perhaps you should try to un-block it.
translation: 嗯，好吧。我准许你调查这个谜团。如果有一条被堵塞的隧道，或许你应该试着打通它。

english: You were helping to investigate what happened in the cellar. Come back when you've found something out.
translation: 你在帮忙调查地窖里发生的事。查到什么了再回来。

english: The Duke asked you to investigate the damage in the cellar. I hope you can find the monsters that are behind this!
translation: 公爵让你调查地窖的损坏情况。我希望你能找到幕后的怪物！

english: I dug through the rubble in the cellar and found a tunnel!
translation: 我挖穿了地窖里的瓦砾，发现了一条隧道！

english: You see, your grace? It is a goblin attack!
translation: 您看到了吧，公爵大人？这是哥布林的攻击！

english: That tunnel could have many origins. I suggest you investigate further.
translation: 那条隧道可能有多种来源。我建议你进一步调查。

english: See, it was goblins! You should tell the Duke.
translation: 看，是哥布林！你应该告诉公爵。

english: On the ground I found this brooch.
translation: 在地上我发现了这个胸针。

english: I've never seen anything like that before. It doesn't come from Lumbridge. What do you think, Sigmund?
translation: 我从未见过这样的东西。它不是仑桥镇出产的。你怎么看，西格蒙德？

english: It is unknown to me, your grace. But the fact it is there is enough to prove Bob's story. It must have been dropped by a goblin as it fled.
translation: 公爵大人，这我也不清楚。但它的存在足以证明鲍勃的故事。这一定是哥布林逃跑时掉落的。

english: I've never heard of a goblin wearing something so well-crafted.
translation: 我从没听说过哥布林会佩戴如此精巧的东西。

english: Then it must have been stolen!
translation: 那一定是偷来的！

english: But it wasn't stolen from us. Where could it be from?
translation: 但这不是从我们这里偷的。那会是从哪里来的呢？

english: That doesn't matter! You said yourself that goblins couldn't have made that, so they must have stolen it from somewhere.
translation: 那不重要！您自己说过哥布林造不出那东西，所以他们肯定是从别处偷来的。

english: Horrible, thieving goblins have broken into our cellar! We must retaliate immediately!
translation: 可恶的、偷窃成性的哥布林闯进了我们的地窖！我们必须立即反击！

english: First we should wipe out the goblins east of the river, then we can march on the goblin village to the north-west...
translation: 首先我们应该消灭河东岸的哥布林，然后向西北的哥布林村庄进军……

english: I will not commit troops until I have proof that goblins are behind this.
translation: 在拿到哥布林是幕后黑手的证据之前，我不会出兵。

english: [Player name], please find out what you can about this brooch. The librarian in Varrock might be able to help identify the symbol.
translation: [Player name]，请尽量查明这个胸针的来路。维洛克城的图书管理员也许能帮忙识别这个符号。

english: 'A History of the Goblin Race'. This must be it.
translation: 《哥布林种族史》。一定是这本了。

english: Hey... The symbol of the 'Dorgeshuun' tribe looks just like the symbol on the brooch I found.
translation: 嘿…… '多尔盖舒恩' 部落的符号跟我找到的胸针上的符号一模一样。

english: I found out about the symbol. It was the symbol of one of the ancient goblin tribes!
translation: 我查到了那个符号。它是某个古代哥布林部落的符号！

english: You see, your grace? I told you goblins were behind this!
translation: 您看到了吧，公爵大人？我告诉过您哥布林是幕后黑手！

english: I still find it surprising that such a well-crafted brooch would have a goblin symbol on it. Perhaps you should find out more about this ancient tribe.
translation: 我仍然觉得奇怪，这么精巧的胸针上会有哥布林符号。也许你应该多了解这个古代部落的情况。

english: At last, proof that goblins are behind this! You should tell the Duke at once!
translation: 终于有证据证明是哥布林在搞鬼了！你应该立刻告诉公爵！

english: Have you ever heard of the Dorgeshuun?
translation: 你听说过多尔盖舒恩吗？

english: Dorgeshuun? That old goblin legend. Lost tribe.
translation: 多尔盖舒恩？那个古老的哥布林传说。失落的部落。

english: In time of much-war there many tribes. Big High War-God send Dorgesh tribe to fight beardy-short-people in mountains.
translation: 在打仗很多的时候有很多部落。大战神派多尔格什部落去山里打胡子矮人。

english: No no, he send them to fight tall people with biting blades, that what I hear.
translation: 不不，我听说他是派他们去打拿着利刃的高个子。

english: It was beardy-short-people, that how legend go.
translation: 是胡子矮人，传说就是这么说的。

english: Make up your minds!
translation: 你们拿定主意吧！

english: It was tall people! That what old storyteller say!
translation: 是高个子！老讲故事的人就是这么说的！

english: No, beardy-short-people. That how legend always go, stupid.
translation: 不，是胡子矮人。传说一直都是这么说的，蠢货。

english: You stupid!
translation: 你才蠢！

english: Do you want me to decide for you again?
translation: 要不要我再替你们决定一次？

english: That most stupid idea yet. If it happen it either happen one way or the other. You can't just decide which.
translation: 那是最蠢的主意了。如果发生过，要么是这样要么是那样。你不能随便决定是哪样。

english: Yeah even goblins know that.
translation: 是啊，连哥布林都知道这个。

english: It doesn't really matter. What happened to them?
translation: 其实无所谓。他们后来怎么了？

english: Well, they say, 'We not want to fight,' so god punish them.
translation: 嗯，他们说'我们不想打'，所以神惩罚了他们。

english: That silly. No goblin ever say that.
translation: 真傻。从来没有哥布林会那么说。

english: What happen then?
translation: 那后来发生了什么？

english: They lose battle, that why god punish them.
translation: 他们输了战斗，所以神惩罚了他们。

english: Ha ha! If they lost battle they all be dead!
translation: 哈哈！如果他们输了战斗，就全都死了！

english: No no, they losing so they run away, and Big High War-God punish them for running away.
translation: 不不，他们快要输了就逃跑了，大战神因为他们逃跑而惩罚了他们。

english: Who were they fighting again?
translation: 他们到底是在跟谁打？

english: It was beardy-short-people in mountains.
translation: 是山里的胡子矮人。

english: No no, it was tall people.
translation: 不不，是高个子。

english: What kind of god would punish them for refusing to fight?
translation: 什么样的神会因为拒绝战斗而惩罚他们？

english: Shh! Must not question Big High War-God!
translation: 嘘！不能质疑大战神！

english: No, because he much bigger than us.
translation: 对，因为他比我们大得多。

english: Well either way they refused to fight.
translation: 反正不管怎样，他们拒绝战斗了。

english: Yeah I suppose so.
translation: 嗯，我想是吧。

english: Anyway then Big High War-God punish them. He turn their insides to stone.
translation: 反正后来大战神惩罚了他们。他把他们的内脏变成了石头。

english: Ha ha ha! That silly!
translation: 哈哈哈！真蠢！

english: Not as silly as green armour! What happen then?
translation: 没绿色盔甲那么蠢！然后呢？

english: He put them inside stone! Big hole open in ground and they all go into cave.
translation: 他把他们塞进了石头里！地上开了个大洞，他们都进了洞穴。

english: That not punishment! Caves nice and cool.
translation: 那不算惩罚！洞穴又舒服又凉快。

english: But then he close cave so they not get out! You not want to stay in cave all the time.
translation: 但后来他把洞穴封住了，所以他们出不来！你不想一直待在洞穴里吧。

english: Why were there punished again?
translation: 他们到底为什么受罚来着？

english: It because they run away from fight.
translation: 是因为他们从战斗中逃跑了。

english: No, it because they refuse to fight night before battle.
translation: 不，是因为他们在开战前夜拒绝战斗。

english: So do goblins make their own tunnels?
translation: 那么哥布林会自己挖隧道吗？

english: What? Make our own tunnels?
translation: 啥？自己挖隧道？

english: We hadn't thought of that.
translation: 我们倒没想到过。

english: Well I found a brooch underground, and I looked up the symbol and it was the symbol of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 嗯，我在地下找到了一个胸针，查了一下符号，是多尔盖舒恩的符号。

english: That not look like goblin brooch.
translation: 那看起来不像哥布林的胸针。

english: Goblins not wear jewellery.
translation: 哥布林不戴首饰。

english: Well if it Dorgeshuun tribe they not know who won big wars. You should greet them with goblin victory dance!
translation: 嗯，如果是多尔盖舒恩部落，他们不知道大仗谁赢了。你应该用哥布林胜利舞去打招呼！

english: No no, you greet them with goblin tribal bow.
translation: 不不，你应该用哥布林部落鞠躬礼来打招呼。

english: Doing bow make you look like a wimp.
translation: 鞠躬会让你看起来像个孬种。

english: It how tribes greet each other in old days.
translation: 古代部落就是这样打招呼的。

english: Only if they wimpy tribes! Goblin salute strong!
translation: 只有窝囊部落才那样！哥布林敬礼才够威猛！

english: So why is the Dorgeshuun tribe underground?
translation: 那么为什么多尔盖舒恩部落在地下？

english: They punished by Big High War-God.
translation: 他们被大战神惩罚了。

english: Wait, you say YOU won the big wars?
translation: 等等，你说你们赢了大仗？

english: Well we must have done! We goblins! Goblins always win!
translation: 那当然我们赢了！我们是哥布林！哥布林总是赢！

english: Actually we not know who won.
translation: 其实我们不知道谁赢了。

english: It was goblins I say!
translation: 我说是哥布林赢了！

english: Well why not show me both greetings?
translation: 那你为什么不把两种打招呼方式都表演给我看看？

english: That good idea. Watch.
translation: 好主意。看着。

english: Bye then.
translation: 那就再见了。

english: I spoke to the goblin generals in the goblin village. They told me about an ancient goblin tribe that went to live underground.
translation: 我跟哥布林村庄里的哥布林将军们谈过了。他们告诉我有一个古老的哥布林部落搬到了地下生活。

english: What more proof do we need? Nasty, smelly goblins have been living under our feet all this time! We must crush them at once!
translation: 我们还需要什么证据？那些肮脏、恶心的哥布林一直就住在我们脚下！我们必须立刻消灭他们！

english: Hmm, perhaps you are right. I will send word to the army to prepare for an underground assault.
translation: 嗯，也许你说得对。我会传令给军队，准备进行地下突袭。

english: [Player name], I would still like you to find out more about this tribe. It cannot hurt to know one's enemy.
translation: [Player name]，我还是希望你能多了解这个部落的情况。知己知彼总没坏处。

english: I spoke to the goblin generals in the Goblin Village. They told me about an ancient goblin tribe that went to live underground.
translation: 我跟哥布林村庄里的哥布林将军们谈过了。他们告诉我有一个古老的哥布林部落搬到了地下生活。

english: I don't see how there can be any more doubt. You should tell the Duke at once!
translation: 我看不出还有什么好疑虑的。你应该立刻去告诉公爵！

english: Who...who are you? How did you get in here?
translation: 你……你是谁？你是怎么进来的？

english: Help! A surface-dweller this deep in our mines? We will all be destroyed!
translation: 救命啊！有地表居民深入我们的矿坑？我们全都要完蛋了！

english: A human knows ancient greeting?
translation: 一个人类居然知道古老的问候语？

english: Perhaps you are friend after all!
translation: 也许你终究是朋友！

english: Greetings, friend. I am sorry I panicked when I saw you.
translation: 你好，朋友。很抱歉刚才看到你时我惊慌失措了。

english: Our legends tell of the surface as a place of horror and violence, where the gods forced us to fight in terrible battles.
translation: 我们的传说中，地表是一个充满恐怖和暴力的地方，众神强迫我们在那里进行可怕的战斗。

english: When I saw a surface-dweller appear I was afraid it was a return to the old days!
translation: 当我看到一个地表居民出现时，我害怕是回到了过去的日子！

english: Did you break in to the castle cellar?
translation: 是你们闯进了城堡的地窖吗？

english: It was an accident. We were following a seam of iron and suddenly we found ourselves in a room!
translation: 那是个意外。我们沿着一条铁矿脉挖掘，突然就发现自己进了一个房间！

english: We blocked up our tunnel behind us and ran back here. Then we did what cave goblins always do when there is a problem: we hid and hoped it would go away.
translation: 我们堵住了身后的隧道，然后跑回了这里。接着我们做了洞穴哥布林遇到问题时总会做的事：躲起来，希望问题能自己消失。

english: We meant no harm! Please tell the ruler of the above- people that we want to make peace.
translation: 我们无意伤害任何人！请告诉地上人的统治者，我们想要和平。

english: Eeek! The war-dance!
translation: 咿呀！是战舞！

english: May I mine the rocks here?
translation: 我可以在这里开采岩石吗？

english: No offence, but we will not let you mine here until there is peace between the humans and the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 无意冒犯，但在人类和多尔戈舒恩族达成和平之前，我们不会让你在这里采矿。

english: Certainly. Please hurry, you must avert the war!
translation: 当然可以。请快一点，你必须阻止这场战争！

english: We have more important things to think about than a brooch right now. We must prevent a war!
translation: 我们现在有比胸针更重要的事情要考虑。我们必须阻止战争！

english: I've made contact with the cave goblins. They say they were following a seam and broke into the cellar by mistake.
translation: 我已经和洞穴哥布林接触过了。他们说他们是在沿着矿脉挖掘时，不小心挖穿了地窖。

english: And I suppose you believe them, goblin-lover?
translation: 我想你相信他们的话了，你这个哥布林爱好者？

english: Well, they seemed friendlier than most goblins, and nothing was taken from the cellar.
translation: 嗯，他们看起来比大多数哥布林要友好，而且地窖里也没丢什么东西。

english: Actually, something was taken. Sigmund has informed me that some of the castle silverware is missing from the cellar.
translation: 实际上，有东西丢了。西格蒙德告诉我，城堡地窖里的一些银器不见了。

english: Unless it is returned, I am afraid I will have no option but war.
translation: 除非银器被归还，否则恐怕我别无选择，只能开战。

english: We are preparing to go to war with the underground goblins over the missing silverware. If you think the cave goblins are innocent you should present evidence quickly!
translation: 我们正准备因为丢失的银器与地下哥布林开战。如果你认为洞穴哥布林是无辜的，就快点拿出证据来！

english: Tell me about the silverware that was stolen.
translation: 跟我说说被偷的银器。

english: The priceless Lumbridge Silverware! It comes out only on special occasions. It was kept in storage in the cellar, but now the goblins have stolen it.
translation: 是无价的仑桥镇银器！只在特殊场合才会拿出来用。它们一直存放在地窖里，但现在被哥布林偷走了。

english: So why did no one notice earlier?
translation: 那为什么之前没人注意到？

english: That doesn't matter. You'll never find it, because the goblins took it. So you can't stop the war!
translation: 那不重要。你永远找不到的，因为哥布林把它拿走了。所以你阻止不了这场战争！

english: Some silverware has gone missing from the castle, and the Duke thinks you stole it!
translation: 城堡里的一些银器不见了，公爵认为是你们偷的！

english: Oh no! We would never do such a thing!
translation: 哦不！我们绝不会做这种事！

english: I assure you we took nothing from the cellar. You must convince the Duke we are innocent!
translation: 我向你保证，我们没从地窖拿任何东西。你必须说服公爵我们是清白的！

english: Where's the silverware you stole from the castle cellar?
translation: 你们从城堡地窖偷的银器在哪？

english: What? We didn't take anything!
translation: 什么？我们什么都没拿！

english: You expect me to believe that? Perhaps Sigmund was right: you're just thieving little goblins!
translation: 你以为我会相信吗？也许西格蒙德是对的：你们只是些偷窃的小哥布林！

english: Why would we want to steal silver? As you see we have much silver already in our mines!
translation: 我们为什么要偷银器？如你所见，我们的矿坑里已经有大量的银了！

english: Well, the Duke says he will attack you unless the silverware is returned.
translation: 嗯，公爵说除非银器被归还，否则他会攻击你们。

english: The last thing we want is war! If we had anything of yours, we would return it at once. But we don't!
translation: 我们最不想要的就是战争！如果我们拿了你们任何东西，我们会立刻归还。但我们没有！

english: Sigmund must be a member of the Humans Against Monsters cult!
translation: 西格蒙德一定是反怪物人联的成员！

english: You're a H.A.M member, aren't you?
translation: 你是反怪物人联的成员，对吧？

english: Well, so what if I am? It's not a crime.
translation: 哼，是又怎么样？这又不是犯罪。

english: Did you know Sigmund is a member of HAM?
translation: 你知道西格蒙德是反怪物人联的成员吗？

english: Hmm, I had suspected it. But however much I disapprove of the HAM movement it's not actually illegal. I'll keep an eye on him though.
translation: 嗯，我早就怀疑了。但不管我多不赞成反怪物人联运动，这毕竟不违法。不过我会盯着他的。

english: Actually I have found it! You put it in the H.A.M. cave!
translation: 实际上我找到了！是你把它放在了反怪物人联的洞穴里！

english: I... I... You're lying! I don't know what you're talking about.
translation: 我……我……你在撒谎！我不知道你在说什么。

english: I found the missing silverware in the HAM cave!
translation: 我在反怪物人联的洞穴里找到了丢失的银器！

english: Sigmund! Is this your doing?
translation: 西格蒙德！这是你干的吗？

english: Of...of course not! The goblins must have, um, dropped the silverware as they ran away.
translation: 当……当然不是！一定是哥布林逃跑时，呃，把银器掉在那里了。

english: Don't lie to me! I knew you were a HAM member but I didn't think you would stoop to this. You are dismissed from my service.
translation: 别骗我！我知道你是反怪物人联成员，但我没想到你会堕落到这种地步。你被解雇了。

english: But don't you see it was for the best? For goblins to be living under our feet like this... ugh. It doesn't matter how civilized they are: all sub-human species must be wiped out!
translation: 但你不明白吗，这是为了大家好？让哥布林这样住在我们脚下……呃。不管他们有多文明：所有亚人类物种都必须被消灭！

english: That's enough! Get out of my castle now!
translation: 够了！现在立刻滚出我的城堡！

english: I see I was ill-advised. Unless there is an act of aggression by the cave goblins there is no need for war.
translation: 看来我之前的决定欠妥。只要洞穴哥布林没有侵略行为，就没有必要开战。

english: This peace treaty specifies the border between Lumbridge and the Cave Goblin realm. Please take it to the cave goblins and tell them I would like to meet with their leader to sign it.
translation: 这份和平条约规定了仑桥镇和洞穴哥布林领域的边界。请把它带给洞穴哥布林，告诉他们我想和他们的领袖会面签署条约。

english: You were taking the peace treaty to the cave goblins.
translation: 你正要把和平条约带给洞穴哥布林。

english: I, er, lost the treaty.
translation: 我，呃，把条约弄丢了。

english: *sigh* All right, here's another copy.
translation: *叹气* 好吧，这里还有一份副本。

english: I have a peace treaty from the Duke of Lumbridge.
translation: 我带来了仑桥镇公爵的和平条约。

english: A peace treaty? Then you will not invade?
translation: 一份和平条约？那么你们不会入侵了？

english: No. As long as you stick to the terms of this treaty there will be no conflict. The Duke of Lumbridge wants to meet your ruler to sign it.
translation: 不会。只要你们遵守条约的条款，就不会有冲突。仑桥镇公爵想和你们的统治者会面签署条约。

english: I will summon Ur-tag, our headman, at once.
translation: 我立刻去召唤我们的首领乌尔.塔格。

english: Your grace, I present Ur-tag, headman of the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 公爵大人，我向您引见乌尔.塔格，多格舒恩族的头人。

english: Welcome, Ur-tag. I am sorry that your race came under suspicion.
translation: 欢迎你，乌尔.塔格。很抱歉你的种族受到了怀疑。

english: I assure you that the warmongering element has been dealt with.
translation: 我向你保证，好战分子已经被处理了。

english: I apologize for the damage to your cellar. I will send workers to repair the hole.
translation: 我为对你地窖造成的损坏道歉。我会派工人去修补那个洞。

english: No, let it stay. It can be a route of commerce between our lands.
translation: 不，让它留着吧。它可以成为我们两地之间的贸易通道。

english: [Player name], Lumbridge is in your debt. Please accept this ring as a token of my thanks.
translation: [Player name]，仑桥镇欠你一份情。请收下这枚戒指，作为我感谢的象征。

english: It is enchanted to save you in your hour of need.
translation: 它被施了魔法，能在你危难之时拯救你。

english: I welcome Osman, spymaster for the Emir of Al-Kharid.
translation: 我欢迎奥斯曼，阿尔卡哈瑞德埃米尔的间谍头目。

english: ... and finally, I welcome the ruler of Ape Atoll, Awowogei.
translation: ……最后，我欢迎猿猴岛的统治者，阿沃盖。

english: Gypsy Aris seems to be late...
translation: 吉普赛人阿里斯似乎迟到了……

english: [player name], Lumbridge is in your debt. Please accept this ring as a token of my thanks.
translation: [player name]，仑桥镇欠你一份情。请收下这枚戒指，作为我感谢的象征。

english: I've never heard of a goblin wearing something so well- crafted.
translation: 我从没听说过地精能穿上如此精致的物品。

english: Yes of course! I'll begin the preparations immediately. Meet me downstairs in the dining room.
translation: 当然可以！我马上开始准备。到楼下的餐厅找我。

english: [player name], please find out what you can about this brooch. The librarian in Varrock might be able to help identify the symbol.
translation: [player name]，请尽可能查明这枚胸针的来历。维洛克城的图书管理员或许能帮忙识别这个符号。

english: Ah, [player name], I'm glad you're here. I was wondering if I could ask for your assistance with a rather urgent matter.
translation: 啊，[player name]，很高兴你来了。我在想能不能请你帮忙处理一件相当紧急的事。

english: Well... unfortunately the party isn't going ahead as planned. I've sent an invitation to King Awowogei of Ape Atoll, and while he couldn't make it, some of his followers decided to come along in his place.
translation: 嗯……不幸的是，派对没有按计划进行。我给猿猴岛的阿沃盖国王发了邀请，虽然他本人无法前来，但他的一些追随者决定替他来了。

english: Now my citizens are under attack and I fear that I've only made things worse.
translation: 现在我的市民正遭受攻击，我担心自己反而把事情弄得更糟了。

english: No, we can't do that! If you went around killing these monkeys it would only empower the H.A.M. organisation.
translation: 不，我们不能那样做！如果你四处杀死这些猴子，只会助长H.A.M.组织的势力。

english: I knew I could count on you, [player name]. If you hand them over to me, we can start the celebrations!
translation: 我就知道可以指望你，[player name]。如果你把它们交给我，我们就可以开始庆祝了！

english: Good to see you again, [player name]. Have you spoken to Zeke yet?
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，[player name]。你和齐克谈过了吗？

english: That's fantastic news! It's all in your hands now, [player name]. Please put an end to this monkey madness.
translation: 真是太好了！现在一切就靠你了，[player name]。请终结这场猴子狂潮吧。

english: This should help you track down all of the monkeys.
translation: 这应该能帮你追踪到所有猴子。

english: As soon as the monkeys arrived in Lumbridge, things started getting out of hand...
translation: 猴子一到仑桥镇，事情就开始失控了……

english: Recently, this group has been gathering more support and the citizens of Lumbridge have become less fond of outsiders.
translation: 最近，这个组织获得了更多支持，仑桥镇的居民对外来者越来越不友善。

english: So I thought I'd throw a party and invite as many new faces as I could.
translation: 所以我想举办一场派对，尽可能邀请更多新面孔。

english: How about this - there is a scimitar merchant named Zeke across the border to Al-Kharid, and I've heard he's been researching methods to trap monkeys safely.
translation: 这样如何——阿尔卡里德城那边有个叫齐克的弯刀商人，我听说他一直在研究安全捕捉猴子的方法。

english: I'd like you to go see him and find out if he can help you with apprehending all 6 of these monkeys.
translation: 我希望你去找他，看看他能否帮你抓住这6只猴子。

english: While you were gone I was able to work with the Lumbridge Guide to compile a list of all the monkey sightings.
translation: 你不在的时候，我和仑桥镇向导合作整理了一份所有猴子目击地点的清单。

english: Greetings. Welcome to my castle. It's good to see a visitor from the Dorgeshuun! I am Duke Horacio.
translation: 你好。欢迎来到我的城堡。很高兴见到一位来自多尔盖舒恩的访客！我是霍拉西奥公爵。

english: [player name], I would still like you to find out more about this tribe. It cannot hurt to know one's enemy.
translation: [player name]，我仍然希望你去了解更多关于这个部落的信息。了解敌人总没有坏处。

english: Well, it is my job as Duke to help oversee and manage the people of Lumbridge. Among them is the H.A.M organisation which I believe you're familiar with already.
translation: 嗯，作为公爵，我的职责是监督和管理仑桥镇的人民。其中就包括H.A.M组织，我相信你已经很熟悉了。

english: Well, it is my job as Duke to help oversee and manage the people of Lumbridge. Among them is an organisation known as H.A.M. which stands for 'Humans Against Monsters'.
translation: 嗯，作为公爵，我的职责是监督和管理仑桥镇的人民。其中有一个名为H.A.M.的组织，全称是‘人类对抗怪物’。

english: That seems like a reasonable request, here you go.
translation: 这听起来是个合理的要求，给你。

english: Well, you're a braver adventurer than I!
translation: 嗯，你比我勇敢多了，冒险者！

english: Have you spoken to Zeke?
translation: 你和齐克谈过了吗？

english: Zeke is the owner of the scimitar shop in Al-Kharid. You should find out if he can help us apprehend the monkeys safely.
translation: 齐克是阿尔卡哈瑞德弯刀店的老板。你应该去问问看他能否帮我们安全地抓住那些猴子。

english: There are monkeys from Ape Atoll harassing various people and creatures around Lumbridge. The list I gave you contains all of their sightings.
translation: 有一些来自猿猴岛的猴子在仑桥镇周围骚扰各种人和生物。我给你的清单包含了所有目击地点。

english: You should capture the monkeys using the traps that Zeke, the scimitar salesman in Al-Kharid, tought you to build.
translation: 你应该使用齐克——那位阿尔卡哈瑞德的弯刀商人教你的陷阱来捕捉猴子。

english: You were going to find out about that brooch you found.
translation: 你之前打算去查明你发现的那枚胸针的来历。

english: Once you have captured all of the monkeys, you should return them to me so I can send them off back to Ape Atoll.
translation: 一旦你抓住了所有猴子，你应该把它们带回来给我，这样我就能把它们送回猿猴岛。

english: That would keep the fight away from any innocents. It would be a great risk though.
translation: 那样可以把战斗远离任何无辜者，但风险很大。

english: You don't appear to have enough free space to take the shield, at the moment.
translation: 你目前似乎没有足够的空位来拿这面盾。

english: That's a relief. I would hate to see such a promising adventurer cut down in his prime.
translation: 那我就放心了。我可不想看到一位前途无量的冒险者英年早逝。

english: You cannot hold any more items from me now. You may wish to visit Diango, in Draynor Village, to collect more rewards in a more convenient setting.
translation: 你现在不能再从我这里拿更多物品了。你可以去德雷诺村的迪亚戈那里，在一个更方便的地方领取更多奖励。

english: Well, it is my job as Duke to help oversee and manage the people of Lumbridge. Among them is the H.A.M organisation which I believe you're famiiar with already.
translation: 嗯，作为公爵，我的职责是监督和管理仑桥镇的人民。其中就包括H.A.M组织，我相信你已经很熟悉了。

english: Good to see you [player name]. While you were gone I was able to work with the Lumbridge guide to compile a list of all the monkey sightings.
translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]。你不在的时候，我和仑桥镇向导合作整理了一份所有猴子目击地点的清单。

english: You don't have space in your inventory for the list. Return to me when you do.
translation: 你的背包没有空位放清单。等你有了再回来找我。

english: That's a relief. I would hate to see such a promising adventurer cut down in her prime.
translation: 那我就放心了。我可不想看到一位前途无量的女冒险者英年早逝。

english: I think I will need better proof than a simple denial that these goblins are innocent.
translation: 我想我需要比简单否认这些地精无辜更有力的证据。

english: That seems like a reasonable request, come back to me when you have space in your inventory for the coins.
translation: 这听起来是个合理的要求，等你的背包有地方放金币时再来找我。

english: I'm used to adventurers misplacing the things I give them. You wouldn't believe the number of anti-dragon shields I've handed out in my time!
translation: 我已经习惯了冒险者把我给他们的东西弄丢。你绝对想不到我这些年发了多少面反龙盾！

english: You're lucky that I still remember where they all are. Do try not to lose it again.
translation: 算你运气好，我还记得它们都在哪儿。可别再弄丢了。

english: Say no more, completely random stranger! Here is a free shield.
translation: 不用再说了，完全陌生的陌生人！这是免费赠送的盾。

english: You don't have the monkeys on you?
translation: 你没有把猴子带在身上？

english: Well, do you remember scoring out the names in the first place?
translation: 嗯，你还记得当初你是如何划掉名字的吗？

english: You see, I didn't give you a normal list - I had the parchment enchanted by the Lumbridge Guide! That way you'd find out in real time where the monkeys are!
translation: 你看，我给你的可不是普通的清单——我让仑桥镇向导给羊皮纸施了魔法！这样你就能实时知道猴子的位置了！

english: Well you'd better find out where. If they've escaped you'll probably find them harassing people again. Check the information on that list I gave you.
translation: 那你最好去查查它们在哪。如果它们逃走了，你很可能又会发现它们在骚扰别人。看看我给你那张清单上的信息。

english: Nope, I've got everything under control in the castle at the moment.
translation: 没有，目前城堡里的一切都在掌控之中。

english: Here you go. Be careful out there!.
translation: 给你。外面小心点！

english: I can write another list but you don't have space in your inventory for it. Return to me when you do.
translation: 我可以再写一份清单，但你的背包没有空位放。等你有空位了再回来找我。

english: I too thank you. Accept the freedom of the Dorgeshuun mines.
translation: 我也感谢你。授予你在多尔戈舒恩矿坑的自由采矿权。

english: These are strange times. I never dreamed that I would see the surface, still less that I would be on friendly terms with its people.
translation: 真是奇妙的时代。我从没想过能见到地表，更没想过能和地表居民友好相处。

english: Prattle on, goblin.
translation: 少废话，哥布林。

english: Soon you will be destroyed!
translation: 你很快就会被消灭的！

english: Curse you, [player name], and your goblin friend! You win this time, but we will meet again!
translation: 诅咒你，[player name]，还有你的哥布林朋友！这次你赢了，但我们还会再见面的！

english: First we should wipe out the goblins east of the river, then we can march on the goblin village to the north- west...
translation: 首先我们应该消灭河东边的哥布林，然后我们就可以向西北方的哥布林村庄进军...

english: Your grace, this is the adventurer who defeated the dragon Elvarg. I think you should listen to him.
translation: 公爵大人，这位就是击败了龙艾尔瓦格的冒险者。我认为您应该听听他的意见。

english: Your grace, this is the adventurer who defeated the dragon Elvarg. I think you should listen to her.
translation: 公爵大人，这位就是击败了龙艾尔瓦格的冒险者。我认为您应该听听她的意见。

english: It is unknown to me, your grace. But the fact it is there is enough to prove Hans's story. It must have been dropped by a goblin as it fled.
translation: 公爵大人，这我也不清楚。但它的存在足以证明汉斯的故事。这一定是哥布林逃跑时掉落的。

english: It is unknown to me, your grace. But the fact it is there is enough to prove Father Aereck's story. It must have been dropped by a goblin as it fled.
translation: 公爵大人，这我也不清楚。但它的存在足以证明艾瑞克神父的故事。这一定是哥布林逃跑时掉落的。

english: It is unknown to me, your grace. But the fact it is there is enough to prove the cook's story. It must have been dropped by a goblin as it fled.
translation: 公爵大人，这我也不清楚。但它的存在足以证明厨师的故事。这一定是哥布林逃跑时掉落的。

english: Your grace, this adventurer took that talisman you discovered to Sedridor the head wizard. I think you should listen to him.
translation: 公爵大人，这位冒险者把您发现的那个护符带给了首席魔法师塞德里多。我认为您应该听听他的意见。

english: Your grace, this adventurer took that talisman you discovered to Sedridor the head wizard. I think you should listen to her.
translation: 公爵大人，这位冒险者把您发现的那个护符带给了首席魔法师塞德里多。我认为您应该听听她的意见。

english: You win this time, [player name]. But I will have my revenge!
translation: 这次你赢了，[player name]。但我一定会报仇的！

english: I'll get you, [player name], if it's the last thing I do!
translation: 我会抓到你的，[player name]，就算这是我做的最后一件事！

english: You should ask other people around the town if they saw anything.
translation: 你应该问问镇上的其他人有没有看到什么。

english: So, you've come to mock me, [player name]? But I'll have the last laugh!
translation: 所以，你来嘲笑我了，[player name]？但笑到最后的会是我！

english: You'll rue the day you decided to help those cave goblins, [player name]!
translation: 你会后悔决定帮助那些洞穴哥布林的日子的，[player name]！

english: Your goblin friends will wish you'd never helped them, [player name]! I'll make them beg me to kill them quickly!
translation: 你的哥布林朋友们会希望你从没帮过他们的，[player name]！我会让他们求我快点杀掉他们！

english: I bet you think you've beaten me, don't you, [player name]? My plans for destroying your goblin friends are just beginning!
translation: 我打赌你以为你打败我了，是不是，[player name]？我毁灭你哥布林朋友们的计划才刚刚开始！

english: You should tell the Duke about anything you have learned.
translation: 你应该把你学到的任何事都告诉公爵。

english: I pity you, [player name]. You've spent so much time with goblins you're barely even human any more!
translation: 我可怜你，[player name]。你和哥布林混了这么久，几乎都不像个人了！

english: Your filthy goblin friend Zanik will get her due soon. You can't protect her all the time!
translation: 你那肮脏的哥布林朋友扎尼克很快就会得到报应。你不可能一直保护她！

english: The Duke told you to take that brooch to the Varrock Library to identify the symbol.
translation: 公爵让你把那枚胸针带到维洛克城图书馆去鉴定符号。

english: Well they would say that, wouldn't they?
translation: 嗯，他们当然会这么说，不是吗？

english: I see you have a new pet.
translation: 我看到你有了新宠物。

english: Ah, you've met Dumpling.
translation: 啊，你见过饺子了。

english: Dumpling? I suppose it looks a little bit like a dumpling...
translation: 饺子？我觉得它确实有点像饺子……

english: An evil six-legged dumpling!
translation: 一个邪恶的六腿饺子！

english: Hey! Dumpling isn't evil. She has cute ears and a little bobbly tail!
translation: 嘿！饺子才不邪恶。她有着可爱的耳朵和一条摇摇晃晃的小尾巴！

english: Look at it! It's clearly evil. It has six legs!
translation: 看看它！明显就是邪恶的。它有六条腿！

english: And those eyes... those black, black eyes... If you stare into them, you can see into its black soul!
translation: 还有那双眼睛……那双漆黑的眼睛……如果你凝视它们，就能看穿它那黑暗的灵魂！

english: Ahem, anyway, that's not how I know this creature is evil. I've seen one before, and I'm afraid I have some bad news.
translation: 咳咳，总之，我并不是靠这个判断这生物是邪恶的。我以前见过一个，而且恐怕我有些坏消息要告诉你。

english: I came across some creatures like Dumpling at the Gnome Stronghold. They're evil things created using dark magic.
translation: 我在地精要塞遇到过一些像饺子这样的生物。它们是用黑暗魔法创造出来的邪恶东西。

english: If this is anything like the situation at the Gnome Stronghold, then Dumpling was sent by Glouphrie to wheedle itself into your affections and spy on you.
translation: 如果这跟地精要塞的情况一样，那么饺子就是格洛弗里派来骗取你的好感并监视你的。

english: I'm afraid so. The creature is shrouded by illusion magic to make it look like a cute pet, but in reality it's this horrible... black spiky thing.
translation: 恐怕是的。这生物被幻象魔法笼罩，看起来像个可爱的宠物，但实际上它是那种可怕的……黑色带刺的东西。

english: It's watching you all the time, sending details of all your secret dealings back to Glouphrie.
translation: 它一直在监视你，把你所有秘密交易的细节都传回给格洛弗里。

english: You've been listening to too many gnomish children's stories! Glouphrie hasn't been seen since before I was King. He's almost certainly long-dead by now.
translation: 你听太多地精儿童故事了！格洛弗里在我当国王之前就失踪了。他现在几乎肯定早就死了。

english: Well, what if I were to prove it to you? I unmasked the creatures at the Gnome Stronghold using a machine created by Oaknock the Engineer. Maybe I could do it again.
translation: 那如果我证明给你看呢？我用工程师奥克诺克制造的机器揭穿了地精要塞的那些生物。也许我可以再来一次。

english: It's going to need to be very solid proof for me to just cast Dumpling aside. She's become my constant companion!
translation: 要让我抛弃饺子，得有非常确凿的证据才行。她已经成了我忠实的伙伴！

english: Oh it will be solid. I just need an anti-illusion device... I don't suppose you have one of those around here?
translation: 哦，证据会很确凿。我只需要一个反幻象装置……我想你这里应该没有吧？

english: I don't think so. What does one look like?
translation: 我觉得没有。那东西长什么样？

english: A big machine made out of wood and crystal.
translation: 一个用木材和水晶制成的大机器。

english: Crystal? As in elven crystal? I haven't seen any elven crystal around here since...
translation: 水晶？你是说精灵水晶？我在这里没见过任何精灵水晶，自从……

english: Since?
translation: 自从？

english: Since Yewnock came to visit!
translation: 自从尤诺克来过之后！

english: Yewnock?
translation: 尤诺克？

english: Oaknock's son, of course! He visited a long time ago, before I was even King. I remember he brought all sorts of strange things with him, including some elven crystals!
translation: 当然是奥克诺克的儿子！他很久以前来过，那时我还没当国王。我记得他带来了各种奇怪的东西，包括一些精灵水晶！
