english: So perhaps there's a device nearby. When he was here, where did Yewnock spend a lot of his time?
translation: 所以附近可能有个装置。他在这里的时候，尤诺克大部分时间都待在哪儿？

english: He did a lot of work down in the caves. I think he liked how nice and quiet it was down there.
translation: 他在下面的洞穴里做了很多工作。我觉得他喜欢那里安静舒适的环境。

english: It sounds like I need to pay Golrie a visit. I'll be back soon.
translation: 听起来我得去拜访一下戈尔里。我很快回来。

english: Well... if you're sure.
translation: 好吧……如果你确定的话。

english: Did you have a look down in the caves?
translation: 你去下面的洞穴看过了吗？

english: Not yet. I'll head down there now and see if Golrie can give me a hand.
translation: 还没。我现在就下去，看看戈尔里能不能帮我一把。

english: I need your help with a device.
translation: 我需要你帮忙弄一个装置。

english: A device?
translation: 一个装置？

english: That's right. One made using elven crystal.
translation: 没错。一个用精灵水晶制作的装置。

english: Ah, well I've got plenty of elven stuff. It's all lying around here somewhere.
translation: 啊，我有很多精灵的东西。都散落在这附近某个地方。

english: Why do you have so much? Are you some sort of collector?
translation: 你怎么有这么多？你是某种收藏家吗？

english: Not me, my grandfather. At least, he used to be. I'm not sure whether he's still alive or not. He hasn't sent me any souvenirs for a while now.
translation: 不是我，是我祖父。至少他以前是。我不确定他是否还活着。他已经有一阵子没给我寄纪念品了。

english: Souvenirs?
translation: 纪念品？

english: That's right. He was a funny gnome, old gramps. He got into a bit of... trouble a while back and couldn't really stick around. He ended up travelling the world collecting elven artefacts after that.
translation: 没错。他是个有趣的地精，老家伙。他之前惹了点……麻烦，没法再待下去。之后他就周游世界收集精灵文物了。

english: It used to be a monthly occurence. A terrorbird would turn up with a big parcel and I'd throw it in with the other stuff in the storeroom. It's a bit of a mess now in there.
translation: 以前每个月都会发生一次。一只骇鸟会带着一个大包裹出现，我就把它扔进储藏室跟其他东西放在一起。现在里面有点乱。

english: Storeroom? Could I take a look?
translation: 储藏室？我能看看吗？

english: Oh, certainly. I should really sort through all of his things at some point. There's probably some quite cool stuff in there.
translation: 哦，当然可以。我确实应该找个时间整理一下他的东西。里面可能有些很酷的东西。

english: Have a look in the other chamber and you'll find a small tunnel into the storeroom.
translation: 去另一个密室看看，你会找到一条通往储藏室的小隧道。

english: Did you check the storeroom? You can get to it through the small tunnel in the other chamber.
translation: 你检查过储藏室了吗？你可以通过另一个密室的小隧道进去。

english: I'll take a look. Thanks.
translation: 我去看看。谢谢。

english: I'm still working on it. I'll let you know once I've made some progress.
translation: 我还在弄。有进展了我会告诉你。

english: When I became King of the Tree Gnome Village, I thought I was lucky, for I did so during a time of peace. However, it seemed that peace was not to last.
translation: 当我成为地精村庄的国王时，我以为自己很幸运，因为那是在和平时期。然而，和平似乎并没有持续下去。

english: Human activity in the area was increasing, and conflict between our two races seemed inevitable.
translation: 该地区的人类活动日益增多，我们两个种族之间的冲突似乎不可避免。

english: Fearing the worst, I had my trusted advisor reach out to King Healthorg of the Gnome Stronghold, but his response left much to be desired...
translation: 担心最坏的情况发生，我让我信任的顾问联系了地精要塞的海尔索格国王，但他的回应令人失望……

english: My King, we have received word from King Healthorg.
translation: 我的国王，我们收到了海尔索格国王的消息。

english: Finally! How long before we can expect his support?
translation: 终于！我们多久能等到他的支援？

english: He will not be sending any support, my King. He does not wish to start a conflict with the humans.
translation: 他不会派任何支援，我的国王。他不想与人类发生冲突。

english: What? But can't he see what will happen if we don't act now! The humans will destroy us!
translation: 什么？但他难道看不到如果我们现在不行动会发生什么吗！人类会毁灭我们！

english: I have conversed with the spirit trees, my King, and they are in full agreement. If we do not act, Khazard and his forces will. It is not a question of if, but when.
translation: 我与灵魂树交谈过，我的国王，它们完全同意。如果我们不行动，卡扎德和他的军队就会行动。这不是会不会的问题，而是什么时候的问题。

english: Healthorg has become a weak old fool! He's blind to our problems.
translation: 海尔索格已经变成了一个软弱的老傻瓜！他对我们的问题视而不见。

english: All may not be lost. I hear his illness is progressing. Soon, the Gnome Stronghold will need to pick a new ruler.
translation: 也许还有希望。我听说他的病情正在恶化。很快，地精要塞就需要选出一位新统治者。

english: They'll almost certainly pick his son, but Argenthorg is just as bad as his father. If he becomes King, he will only appease the humans!
translation: 他们几乎肯定会选他的儿子，但阿根索格和他父亲一样糟糕。如果他成为国王，只会安抚人类！

english: Then perhaps they need presenting with an alternate option.
translation: 那么也许他们需要看到另一个选择。

english: Yes... perhaps they do.
translation: 是的……也许他们确实需要。

english: And so the reign of the most famous gnome king came to an end.
translation: 于是，最著名的地精国王的统治结束了。

english: With Healthorg gone, voting on his replacement would soon begin. Many expected his son, Argenthorg, to be the only serious contender.
translation: 海尔索格去世后，关于他继任者的投票很快就要开始。许多人预计他的儿子阿根索格将是唯一的严肃竞争者。

english: But my advisor and I had other ideas...
translation: 但我和我的顾问另有打算……

english: Despite our best attempts, Argenthorg looked certain to win the election.
translation: 尽管我们尽了最大努力，阿根索格似乎仍稳操胜券。

english: Healthorg was a great king far longer than he was a weak one. Everyone assumed his son would be as great as he was.
translation: 海尔索格作为伟大国王的时间远长于他作为软弱国王的时间。每个人都认为他的儿子会和他一样伟大。

english: We needed to show them the truth. We needed to show them that Argenthorg was weak. My advisor said he knew how...
translation: 我们需要让他们看到真相。我们需要让他们看到阿根索格很软弱。我的顾问说他知道怎么做……

english: Argenthorg... this is human food!
translation: 阿根索格……这是人类食物！

english: So it's true! A gnome who loves humans more than his own kind!
translation: 原来是真的！一个爱人类胜过爱自己同胞的地精！

english: I don't understand! What is this?
translation: 我不明白！这是什么？

english: The truth is out now, Argenthorg. You are not fit to be a king!
translation: 真相已经大白，阿根索格。你不配当国王！

english: This is all a lie! I've been framed!
translation: 这都是谎言！我被陷害了！

english: The evidence is right in front of us, Argenthorg.
translation: 证据就在我们眼前，阿根索格。

english: Wait... I know what this is! Father warned me about this!
translation: 等等……我知道这是什么了！父亲警告过我！

english: Guards! Seek out Yewnock at once. Tell him to switch the machine on!
translation: 守卫！立刻去找尤诺克。告诉他打开那台机器！

english: Glouphrie!
translation: 格洛弗里！

english: No! I don't believe it. I trusted you!
translation: 不！我不相信。我信任你！

english: As you should have. I sought only to strengthen the Gnomish Kingdoms, just like you did.
translation: 你本该如此。我只是想加强地精王国，就像你做的那样。

english: Lier!You deceived me!
translation: 骗子！你欺骗了我！

english: No, I simply told you what you wanted to hear, Bolrie. Never forget that...
translation: 不，我只是告诉了你你想听的话，博尔利。永远别忘了这一点……

english: There ended my campaign to become the new king of the Gnome Stronghold. Argenthorg was crowned soon after and Glouphrie disappeared once more.
translation: 我成为地精要塞新国王的竞选就此结束。阿根索格很快加冕，格洛弗里再次消失了。

english: I don't know what the gnomes of the Tree Gnome Village will think once they hear what I've done, but it does not matter. They deserve a better ruler than I.
translation: 我不知道地精村庄的地精们听到我的所作所为后会怎么想，但这不重要。他们值得一个比我更好的统治者。

english: And so I am preparing to leave the lands of my people, but before I go, I will ensure foul illusions cannot be allowed to shame us gnomes again.
translation: 所以我准备离开我族人的土地，但在离开之前，我要确保邪恶的幻象不能再让我们地精蒙羞。

english: As for the one who chooses to practise such dark arts... He will be punished. I will make it my life's purpose...
translation: 至于那个选择修炼这种黑暗法术的人……他会受到惩罚。我将以此为我的人生目标……

english: Well, it sadly seems you were right. Please get rid of the nasty creature. Then we can talk.
translation: 唉，看来不幸被你说中了。请除掉那个讨厌的生物。然后我们再谈。

english: Thank you for dealing with that... thing. I apologise for not believing you before.
translation: 谢谢你处理了那个……东西。我为我之前不相信你而道歉。

english: While I am glad the matter has been sorted, I must admit that this situation has me quite concerned. You said that there were many of these creatures posted all around the Gnome Stronghold?
translation: 虽然我很高兴事情解决了，但我必须承认，这种情况让我非常担忧。你说地精要塞周围有很多这种生物？

english: That's right. There were six.
translation: 没错。有六个。

english: Why did Glouphrie send so many there, but only one here?
translation: 为什么格洛弗里在那里派了那么多，而这里只有一个？

english: Maybe he thought it was more important to spy on the Gnome Stronghold and Narnode.
translation: 也许他认为监视地精要塞和纳诺德更重要。

english: That's outrageous! The Gnome Stronghold is not six times more important than our village here! He should have sent at least four watchers, maybe five!
translation: 太离谱了！地精要塞并没有比我们这里的村庄重要六倍！他至少应该派四个监视者，也许五个！

english: So you want more evil watchers?
translation: 所以你想要更多邪恶的监视者？

english: Well, yes. I mean no, of course not. Still, Glouphrie has a lot to answer for! If I ever get my hands on him I'll... er... I'll give him a good talking to!
translation: 呃，是的。我是说当然不是。不过，格洛弗里有很多事情要负责！如果我抓到他，我会……呃……我会好好教训他一顿！

english: Right... Well, maybe we should start by trying to find him.
translation: 好吧……那么，也许我们应该先试着找到他。

english: Yes, of course! Still, that won't be an easy feat. It is said that after Glouphrie was driven out of our lands, he founded the hidden city of Arposandra. To find him, we must first find Arposandra!
translation: 是的，当然！不过，这可不是件容易的事。据说格洛弗里被赶出我们的土地后，建立了隐藏的城市阿波桑德拉。要找到他，我们必须先找到阿波桑德拉！

english: And nobody knows where Arposandra is. Not a great start.
translation: 而且没人知道阿波桑德拉在哪里。开局不太妙。

english: Indeed. Many a gnome has tried and failed to find the city. Some, like Longramble, are still out there searching for it.
translation: 确实。许多地精尝试过寻找这座城市，但都失败了。有些人，比如朗拉姆布尔，还在外面寻找。

english: Longramble?
translation: 朗拉姆布尔？

english: Yes, one of my citizens. Longramble is a bit of an explorer. He's been out there searching for Arposandra for some time.
translation: 是的，我的一位居民。朗拉姆布尔算是个探险家。他一直在外面寻找阿波桑德拉，已经有一段时间了。

english: Did he offer any suggestion of where he thought it might be?
translation: 他有没有提出任何关于他认为它可能在哪里的建议？

english: He said that he was sure Arposandra was somewhere between here and the edge of the world.
translation: 他说他确信阿波桑德拉就在从这里到世界边缘之间的某个地方。

english: Okay... that doesn't really help.
translation: 好吧……这没什么帮助。

english: No, I suppose not. Still, if you want to find Arposandra, finding Longramble might not be a bad place to start.
translation: 不，我想也是。不过，如果你想找到阿波桑德拉，先找到朗拉姆布尔可能是个不错的起点。

english: But how would I find him?
translation: 但我该怎么找到他呢？

english: I'm not sure, but I bet Aluft Gianne jnr. could help. His restaurant can supposedly deliver food to any gnome, no matter where they are.
translation: 我不太确定，但我打赌小吉安.阿鲁夫特能帮忙。他的餐厅据说可以把食物送到任何地精手上，不管他们在哪里。

english: Sounds like the best option then. We just have to hope Longramble didn't end up finding the edge of the world and falling off.
translation: 听起来这是最好的选择了。我们只能希望朗拉姆布尔没有找到世界的边缘然后掉下去。

english: You'll find Aluft Gianne jnr. in his restaurant at the Grand Tree. Good luck!
translation: 你可以在大树家园的餐厅里找到小吉安.阿鲁夫特。祝你好运！

english: Oh, and if you find Glouphrie, tell him... tell him... I'm very angry with him!
translation: 哦，还有，如果你找到格洛弗里，告诉他……告诉他……我非常生他的气！

english: Hello there. Any luck finding Longramble?
translation: 你好。找到朗拉姆布尔了吗？

english: I'm sure Aluft Gianne jnr. can help. You'll find him in his restaurant at the Grand Tree. Good luck!
translation: 我相信小吉安.阿鲁夫特能帮忙。你可以在大树家园的餐厅里找到他。祝你好运！

english: I need your help finding a certain gnome.
translation: 我需要你帮忙找一个特定的地精。

english: Hmm, that's sensitive information you know. Who is this gnome?
translation: 嗯，这可是敏感信息。是哪个地精？

english: I'm looking for Longramble, the explorer.
translation: 我在找探险家朗拉姆布尔。

english: Ah, well, that might be different. I have a long-standing order for Longramble. Problem is, no one has been able to reach him.
translation: 啊，那可能就不一样了。我有一份给朗拉姆布尔的长期订单。问题是，没人能联系到他。

english: So you know where he is?
translation: 所以你知道他在哪里？

english: Oh yes! I have his coordinates, but I can't find them on my Doogle Maps. Two degrees, seven minutes south. Three degrees, seven minutes west.
translation: 哦，是的！我有他的坐标，但在我的杜格尔地图上找不到。南纬两度七分，西经三度七分。

english: Doogle Maps?
translation: 杜格尔地图？

english: Of course! My maps are all on dried doogle leaves.
translation: 当然！我的地图都画在干燥的杜格尔叶上。

english: Right, I guess I'd better get hunting. Sounds like I'll be needing a sextant, watch and chart.
translation: 好吧，我想我得开始搜寻了。听起来我需要一个六分仪、一块表和一张海图。

english: Oh, if you do find Longramble, I'd appreciate it if you could deliver his order to him. He's requested some tasty tangled toad's legs.
translation: 哦，如果你真的找到朗拉姆布尔，我希望你能把他的订单送给他。他点了一些美味的缠腿蟾蜍。

english: Could you remind me of Longramble's coordinates?
translation: 你能再告诉我一次朗拉姆布尔的坐标吗？

english: Two degrees, seven minutes south. Three degrees, seven minutes west.
translation: 南纬两度七分，西经三度七分。

english: If you do find Longramble, I'd appreciate it if you could deliver his order to him. He's requested some tasty tangled toad's legs.
translation: 如果你真的找到朗拉姆布尔，我希望你能把他的订单送给他。他点了一些美味的缠腿蟾蜍。

english: Mr Longramble, I presume?
translation: 我猜您就是朗拉姆布尔先生吧？

english: Trouble speaking? You're not one of those gnomes like Hazelmere that only speaks in ancient gnomish, are you?
translation: 说话有困难？你不是像黑兹尔米尔那样只会说古代地精语的地精吧？

english: No... It's just... It's been so long! All this time with only myself for company!
translation: 不……只是……太久了！这么长时间只有我自己作伴！

english: Well, it looks like you have some new company now. I'm [player name], and I've been looking for you.
translation: 嗯，看来你现在有新伙伴了。我是[player name]，我一直在找你。

english: I'm hoping you've found something that I'm also looking for.
translation: 我希望你找到了我也在找的东西。

english: Do you mean the edge of the world? It's been my life's ambition to find it and be the first gnome to stare over its edge.
translation: 你是说世界的边缘？这是我毕生的志向，找到它，成为第一个俯瞰其边缘的地精。

english: Edge? Are you sure there's an edge? I've heard it goes on forever.
translation: 边缘？你确定有边缘吗？我听说世界是无穷无尽的。

english: Everything has an edge. Eventually I'll find it. I'll keep heading westwards until I get there.
translation: 任何东西都有边缘。我最终会找到它的。我会一直向西走，直到到达那里。

english: If the world is spherical though, you'll never find the edge.
translation: 但如果世界是球形的，你永远也找不到边缘。

english: Spherical? Don't be silly! The world is clearly flat. If it was ball-shaped, we'd all roll off the side. Silly human.
translation: 球形？别傻了！世界显然是平的。如果是球形的，我们都会从边上滚下去。愚蠢的人类。

english: Maybe the world is round, but there's some magical force that makes us stick to the ground.
translation: 也许世界是圆的，但有一种魔法力量让我们紧贴地面。

english: Now you're just making fun of me. I don't think you realise the gravity of the situation!
translation: 你这是在取笑我。我看你根本没意识到事情的严重性！

english: Right... Anyway, that's not why I'm here. I thought you were looking for the hidden city of Arposandra?
translation: 好吧……总之，我不是为这个来的。我以为你在找隐藏的城市阿波桑德拉？

english: That is true, but I'm only doing that as a detour from my journey to the edge of the world. I figured it would be on the way.
translation: 没错，但那只是我去世界边缘途中的一个绕道。我想它应该顺路。

english: And have you had any luck?
translation: 那你有什么发现吗？

english: I think so. There's a waste outlet nearby that I believe may be coming from the city of Arposandra!
translation: 我想是的。附近有一个废水出口，我怀疑可能来自阿波桑德拉城！

english: What makes you think that?
translation: 你为什么这么想？

english: Well, have a look for yourself. There's a huge swamp of nasty goo out west that definitely isn't natural. It's coming from that outlet.
translation: 嗯，你自己看看吧。西边有一大片恶心的粘液沼泽，绝对不是天然的。就是从那个出口流出来的。

english: That doesn't mean it's coming from Arposandra though.
translation: 但这并不代表它来自阿波桑德拉。

english: Indeed, but there is one other thing. The outlet appears to be patrolled by a creature that suggests gnomish involvement... A giant tortoise!
translation: 确实，但还有一件事。那个出口似乎有一只生物在巡逻，暗示着地精的参与……一只巨大的乌龟！

english: Okay, that sounds a lot more promising.
translation: 好吧，这听起来有希望多了。

english: Exactly! The thing is, there seems to be something wrong with it. It seems... unwell.
translation: 没错！问题是，它好像有点不对劲。看起来……不太健康。

english: It has some large tentacles growing from underneath its shell.
translation: 它的壳下面长出了巨大的触手。

english: Tentacles? That's more than unwell, that's... warped!
translation: 触手？那不只是不健康，那是……扭曲了！

english: Well, whatever you call it, it's not normal. Maybe it's an illness caused by Glouphrie's magic.
translation: 嗯，不管你怎么称呼它，这都不正常。也许是格洛弗里的魔法引起的疾病。

english: Hmm, I'd better have a look myself.
translation: 嗯，我最好亲自去看看。

english: Go for it. The outlet isn't hard to find. It's just to the west.
translation: 去吧。那个出口不难找。就在西边。

english: Hello again. Where did you say that outlet was?
translation: 又见面了。你说那个出口在哪里？

english: It's just to the west of here. Shouldn't be too hard to find.
translation: 就在西边。应该不难找。

english: Hello there. How goes the quest for Arposandra?
translation: 你好。寻找阿波桑德拉的任务进展如何？

english: I think it's going well. I found Longramble, and he was able to point me in the right direction.
translation: 我觉得进展顺利。我找到了朗拉姆布尔，他给我指了正确的方向。

english: Er... hello... Was that you calling me?
translation: 呃……你好……是你在叫我吗？

english: The tree whisperer has come to my aid. Thank Guthix.
translation: 低语者来帮助我了。感谢古斯。

english: You may call me Incomitatus, for I am alone and friendless. You are not a small person of Guthix. How do you speak with me?
translation: 你可以叫我因科米塔图斯，因为我孤独无友。你不是古斯的小个子。你怎么能和我说话？

english: Er... I don't know. Can't anyone just speak to you?
translation: 呃……我不知道。难道不是谁都能和你说话吗？

english: Only those who have opened their minds to the spirits of the earth can talk with spirit trees. You surely must have been trained by a great friend to us, as this is a gift not easily come by.
translation: 只有那些向大地灵魂敞开心扉的人才能与灵魂树交谈。你一定是经过了我们一位伟大朋友的训练，因为这不是轻易能获得的天赋。

english: Well, it's true that I have spoken to the odd tree in the past...
translation: 嗯，我过去确实和奇怪的树说过话……

english: Oh, wait a minute, this reminds me of something. Hazelmere did something like this to me a while ago. You know, talking using the mind.
translation: 哦，等一下，这让我想起了一些事。黑兹尔米尔不久前也对我做过类似的事。你知道的，用心灵说话。

english: The one you call Hazelmere... he is a friend of trees. He would be able to help me.
translation: 你称为黑兹尔米尔的那个人……他是树木的朋友。他应该能帮助我。

english: Maybe I could help in some way. What exactly is wrong with you?
translation: 也许我能帮上什么忙。你到底怎么了？

english: I have lost my connection to the Anima Mundi. The earth has corrupted my roots and they find only black ichor. My xylem and phloem are tainted. I am alone.
translation: 我失去了与万物之灵的联系。大地腐蚀了我的树根，它们只找到黑色的脓液。我的木质部和韧皮部都被污染了。我很孤独。

english: Hmm... I'm sure there's a way to fix this. What would Hazelmere do?
translation: 嗯……我相信一定有办法解决。黑兹尔米尔会怎么做？

english: What? What do you want? You shouldn't disturb me like that. I was deep in contemplation. Looking into the future is not something you can do on a whim, you know!
translation: 什么？你想要什么？你不应该那样打扰我。我正在沉思。窥视未来可不是一时兴起就能做的事，你知道吗！

english: Hazelmere?
translation: 黑兹尔米尔？

english: Yes of course! You did call for me, didn't you? And what did I tell you about flapping your lips during a mind meld? Use your brain!
translation: 当然是我！你确实叫了我，对吧？我告诉过你多少次在心灵融合时不要乱动嘴唇？用你的大脑！

english: Right, sorry.
translation: 好的，抱歉。

english: Now, this had best be important. I was in the middle of a dream, a vision of the future. There was something I was meant to see...
translation: 现在，这事最好很重要。我正沉浸在一个梦里，一个关于未来的幻象。有些东西我本该看到……

english: It's good to hear you're still as grumpy as always.
translation: 很高兴听到你还是和以前一样脾气暴躁。

english: Hmph! How did you manage to perform a mind meld from so far away anyway? Such skills are far beyond a human. Unless...
translation: 哼！你是怎么从这么远的地方进行心灵融合的？这种技能远非人类所能及。除非……

english: Of course, a spirit tree. I sense this one to be rather unwell. What happened?
translation: 当然，是一棵灵魂树。我感觉到这棵树病得不轻。发生了什么？

english: Alright, let me try to sense the problem.
translation: 好吧，让我试着感受一下问题所在。

english: Right, all done. Ah, and it seems you haven't suffered any permanent damage. That's fortunate.
translation: 好了，完成了。啊，看来你没有受到永久性损伤。这很幸运。

english: Fortunate? You didn't warn me of any risk before giving me that nightmare!
translation: 幸运？在给我那个梦魇之前，你根本没警告我任何风险！

english: You have a strong spirit. I assumed you'd be alright. And, after all, it's the spirit tree that really matters. You'll only live for a handful of decades. The tree should live for centuries.
translation: 你的灵魂很强大。我以为你会没事的。而且，毕竟，灵魂树才是真正重要的。你只能活几十年。这棵树应该活几个世纪。

english: I'm not sure I approve of your low regard for my welfare.
translation: 我不太赞同你对我福祉的漠视。

english: The welfare of the tree is our concern right now. Something has poisoned the soil, blocking the tree's connection with the Anima Mundi. This is worrying in itself.
translation: 我们现在关心的是树的福祉。有什么东西毒害了土壤，阻断了树与万物之灵的联系。这本身就令人担忧。

english: Well, no ordinary poison could do this. Only by separating the Anima Mundi from its source...
translation: 嗯，普通的毒药做不到这一点。只有将万物之灵与其源头分离……

english: I'm sorry, you're confusing me.
translation: 抱歉，你把我搞糊涂了。

english: I forget I'm dealing with a human. I'll spell it out nice and clearly for you. The Anima Mundi is created by all natural things. It is their soul, and a sort of natural energy.
translation: 我忘了我在和一个人类打交道。我会给你解释得清清楚楚。万物之灵由所有自然之物创造。它是它们的灵魂，也是一种自然能量。

english: It is powerful and dangerous, and only by the balance of Guthix does it remain in check. Creatures live, creatures die. The balance is maintained.
translation: 它强大而危险，只有通过古斯的平衡才能保持稳定。生物生，生物死。平衡得以维持。

english: So how has this caused Incomitatus to become ill?
translation: 那这怎么会导致因科米塔图斯生病呢？

english: Powerful magics could be used to separate the Anima Mundi from its source. This would produce a great deal of power, power that could be used in an unbridled way.
translation: 强大的魔法可以用来将万物之灵与其源头分离。这会产生巨大的力量，一种可以不受约束地使用的力量。

english: However, doing so would unbalance the whole pattern of life. The ichor in the soil appears to be the unnatural waste product of such tinkerings.
translation: 然而，这样做会破坏整个生命模式的平衡。土壤中的脓液似乎是这种篡改产生的非自然废料。

english: There is a huge evil-smelling swamp of tar just to the west of here. Is that related?
translation: 西边有一大片散发着恶臭的焦油沼泽。这有关系吗？

english: Most likely, but to make enough of this ichor to create a swamp would take an enormous amount of work and would create a dizzying amount of energy.
translation: 很有可能，但要制造出足以形成沼泽的脓液，需要大量的工作，并会产生令人眩晕的能量。

english: It would be an abomination, to plunder the earth in such a massive way. Who would need to do this?
translation: 如此大规模地掠夺大地，简直是一种憎恶。谁会需要这么做？

english: Glouphrie?
translation: 格洛弗里？

english: Hmph, maybe. Anyway, our immediate problem is to help our spirit brethren.
translation: 哼，也许吧。不管怎样，我们眼前的问题是帮助我们的灵魂兄弟。

english: Is there some sort of antidote I could give to the tree?
translation: 有没有什么解药可以给这棵树？

english: If you had been paying attention, you'd remember that I said this is no normal poison. Some sort of spiritual cleansing will be needed in order to return the spirit tree's connection to the Anima Mundi.
translation: 如果你刚才注意听了，就会记得我说过这不是普通的毒药。需要某种精神净化才能恢复灵魂树与万物之灵的联系。

english: I do not have the power to do this kind of thing. This will require the magic of Seren and her elves. A pure note, created by elven crystal, would have a purifying effect on anything nearby.
translation: 我没有能力做这种事。这需要塞伦和她的精灵们的魔法。由精灵水晶创造的纯净音符，会对附近的一切产生净化效果。

english: Luckily, you seem to already be carrying the answer.
translation: 幸运的是，你似乎已经带着答案了。

english: How do you know what I'm carrying?
translation: 你怎么知道我带了什么？

english: Oh, mind meld. Of course.
translation: 哦，心灵融合。当然。

english: Use your crystal chime to try and cleanse the tree. Let us hope this works.
translation: 用你的水晶风铃尝试净化这棵树。希望这能奏效。

english: Right, I'll give it a go.
translation: 好的，我来试试。

english: Luckily, it seems you already encountered the answer below the Tree Gnome Village.
translation: 幸运的是，看起来你已经在地精村庄下方遇到了答案。

english: How do you know what I've encountered?
translation: 你怎么知道我遇到了什么？

english: Bring a crystal chime here and use it to try and cleanse the tree.
translation: 带一个水晶风铃到这里，用它来尝试净化这棵树。

english: Right, I'll be back soon.
translation: 好的，我很快就回来。

english: I sense that you haven't yet managed to cleanse the tree? What is holding you up?
translation: 我感觉你还没能净化这棵树？是什么阻碍了你？

english: How am I meant to do it?
translation: 我该怎么做？

english: You'll need to go and fetch a crystal chime.
translation: 你得去拿一个水晶风铃。

english: Just use your crystal chime.
translation: 用你的水晶风铃就行了。

english: You know there's quite an ill-looking spirit tree over there, right?
translation: 你知道那边有棵看起来病恹恹的灵魂树吧？

english: Oh yes, I forgot about that. Poor thing isn't looking great, but I'm not sure what can be done. Trees aren't really my area of expertise.
translation: 哦对，我忘了。那可怜的家伙状态不太好，但我不确定能做什么。树木不是我的专长。

english: What are you doing here? That spirit tree needs our help. Get back there!
translation: 你在这干嘛？那棵灵魂树需要我们的帮助。快回去！

english: Thank you, tree whisperer. I can feel the Anima Mundi once more.
translation: 谢谢你，树语者。我能再次感受到世界之魂了。

english: Hmm, not a bad job I guess. Now be on your way, I have meditating to do.
translation: 嗯，干得还不错吧。现在你可以走了，我要冥想。

english: Tree whisperer, the Anima Mundi cries out in pain. Please, as a true friend of the spirit trees, find the source of this taint. May Guthix be with you.
translation: 树语者，世界之魂在痛苦地哭泣。请作为灵魂树的真正朋友，找到这污秽的源头。愿古斯与你同在。

english: Hello there. Any luck with that outlet?
translation: 你好。那个出口有进展吗？

english: I ended up getting a bit side-tracked thanks to that spirit tree over there. Where did you say the outlet was?
translation: 我被那边那棵灵魂树给耽搁了。你刚才说出口在哪来着？

english: So, how did you get this ropey old job then, Seventy Two?
translation: 那么，七十二，你是怎么得到这份破工作的？

english: I think it's a punishment, Twenty One.
translation: 我觉得这是惩罚，二十一。

english: I fell asleep while guarding upstairs.
translation: 我在楼上守卫时睡着了。

english: You fell asleep? I thought the masters made it impossible for us to fall asleep.
translation: 你睡着了？我以为主人让我们不可能睡着。

english: I dunno, maybe I'm defective. I blame the masters myself. Anyway, I got the choice, either take this job or go outside.
translation: 我不知道，也许我有缺陷。我怪主人。总之，我有的选，要么干这活，要么去外面。

english: Outside?! I don't even want to think about it!
translation: 外面？！我想都不敢想！

english: Still, at least you got to guard upstairs! Things are always happening up there. I've been down here since I was de-podded and nothing happens down here.
translation: 不过，至少你还能在楼上守卫！上面总是有事发生。我从被从荚里放出来就一直在这下面，下面啥事都没有。

english: You'd have thought the masters would make it impossible for us to get bored as well.
translation: 你会以为主人也会让我们不可能感到无聊。

english: You'd think so, but they always seem to be making a mess of the pods. After all, you've seen how many failures get dumped outside.
translation: 你会这么想，但他们似乎总是把荚搞得一团糟。毕竟，你见过有多少失败品被丢到外面。

english: Wait! Did you hear something?
translation: 等等！你听到什么了吗？

english: Calm down, nothing ever-
translation: 冷静点，从来没——

english: There's someone outside! What do we do?
translation: 外面有人！我们怎么办？

english: Press the red button! Quickly!
translation: 按下红色按钮！快！

english: They told us to never press the red button!
translation: 他们告诉过我们永远不要按那个红色按钮！

english: Unless it's an emergency! Press the red button. Now!
translation: 除非是紧急情况！按下红色按钮。现在！

english: Don't panic!
translation: 别慌！

english: I'm not panicking, you're panicking! Press the red button!
translation: 我没慌，是你慌了！快按红色按钮！

english: This might be a problem...
translation: 这可能是个问题……

english: Yup, that's a problem!
translation: 没错，这是个问题！

english: Oh good. Now I'm stuck!
translation: 哦，好。现在我卡住了！

english: Gas as well? Wonderful!
translation: 还有毒气？太棒了！

english: Feeling dizzy... I can't think straight...
translation: 头晕目眩……我无法思考……

english: This is it. This is the end.
translation: 就这样了。这就是结局。

english: Help! Someone, help me! I'm dying...
translation: 救命！谁来救救我！我要死了……

english: What are you doing, stupid human?
translation: 你在干什么，愚蠢的人类？

english: Are you Death? You remind me a lot of a gnome I knew when I was alive.
translation: 你是死神吗？你让我想起我活着时认识的一个地精。

english: You're not dead yet, fool! Snap out of it!
translation: 你还没死呢，傻瓜！清醒点！

english: Pull yourself together! We haven't got much time.
translation: 振作起来！我们时间不多了。

english: Argento's last gift to me. I was saving it for a special occasion. I suppose saving your hide counts.
translation: 阿亨托给我的最后一份礼物。我一直留着以备不时之需。我想救你的命也算吧。

english: Wow, that's some trick!
translation: 哇，这招真厉害！

english: Megal!
translation: 梅加尔！

english: It seems I have made my choice. So be it.
translation: 看来我已经做出了选择。就这样吧。

english: Nothing you need to worry about now. We need to get out of here.
translation: 你现在不用担心这个。我们得离开这里。

english: Phew, that was a close one! Thanks for saving me.
translation: 呼，好险！谢谢你救了我。

english: Consider it a thank you for helping that spirit tree. You have shown a great empathy towards the Anima Mundi. Despite being a human, perhaps you could one day be a true spirit tree mage.
translation: 就当是感谢你帮助那棵灵魂树吧。你对世界之魂表现出了极大的同理心。尽管你是人类，但也许有一天你能成为真正的灵魂树魔法师。

english: Hang on... you're properly talking to me, without using a mind meld. I thought you only spoke ancient gnomish?
translation: 等等……你是在正常跟我说话，没有用心灵融合。我以为你只会说古代地精语？

english: Bah! I've always been able to speak your uncivilised tongue.
translation: 呸！我一直都会说你们这种不文明的语言。

english: Normally I wouldn't lower myself to these rudimentary words, but given your recent near-death experience, I felt you would not have the energy for a mind meld.
translation: 通常我不会自降身份说这些粗浅的词语，但鉴于你刚刚死里逃生，我觉得你没有精力进行心灵融合。

english: That's unusually kind for you. Not going soft, are you?
translation: 你难得这么好心。不会是心软了吧？

english: Perhaps, but it seems I would be wise to ensure your safety. The future is not a place for old wizards like me.
translation: 也许吧，但看来确保你的安全是明智之举。未来不是像我这样的老魔法师该待的地方。

english: My autumn is ending, and only winter remains. Soon, it will fall to individuals like you to protect the Anima Mundi.
translation: 我的秋天即将结束，只剩下冬天。很快，保护阿尼玛.蒙迪的重任就会落到像你这样的人身上。

english: The Anima Mundi granted me a glimpse into the future. I had one final choice to make, and I made it by saving you. We now walk a path that we cannot stray from, so listen closely...
translation: 世界之魂让我瞥见了未来。我做出了最后一个选择，那就是救你。我们现在走上了一条无法偏离的道路，所以仔细听好……

english: Skilled brothers, numbering eight, will assemble to fight the Mahjarrat deceiver, and they will be heading northwards to confront him.
translation: 八位技艺精湛的兄弟将集结起来对抗玛哈加特的欺骗者，他们将向北进发去面对他。

english: The time after this is... clouded to me, but I see you clearly, dressed in the evil garb of the darkest night.
translation: 之后的时间……对我来说很模糊，但我清楚地看到你，穿着最黑暗夜晚的邪恶装束。

english: However, while you may dress in the colours of evil, you will not follow that path. You will remain true to Guthix.
translation: 然而，尽管你可能穿着邪恶的颜色，但你不会走上那条路。你将忠于古斯。

english: Of the eight, only two shall return. One represents the path of the slayer and one the path of the warrior.
translation: 八人之中，只有两人会回来。一个代表杀戮之路，一个代表战士之路。

english: Things might have been different, but I have made my choice, and it is up to you to prove that I made the right one.
translation: 事情本可能不同，但我已经做出了选择，现在要靠你来证明我选对了。

english: Sounds like you have been having some bad dreams, or you've been reading some terrible stories.
translation: 听起来你做了些噩梦，或者读了些糟糕的故事。

english: Dreams often reveal truths masked by the light of day, but I know the truth of what I have seen in my bones. I have seen my end.
translation: 梦境常常揭示被白昼之光掩盖的真相，但我骨子里知道我看到的真相。我看到了自己的终结。

english: But you can't die! You're a mighty wizard!
translation: 但你不能死！你是个强大的魔法师！

english: All I know is what the trees tell me. It will soon be time for me to pass the guardianship of the spirit trees to someone else. Maybe that person is you.
translation: 我只知道树木告诉我的事。很快我就要把灵魂树的守护权交给别人了。也许那个人就是你。

english: Guardianship of the spirit trees? I wouldn't even know where to begin with that!
translation: 灵魂树的守护权？我根本不知道从何入手！

english: I have faith that you will learn what you need. Anyway, enough moping about the future. You should be on your way.
translation: 我相信你会学到你需要的东西。总之，别再为未来发愁了。你该上路了。

english: But what about Glouphrie?
translation: 但格洛弗里怎么办？

english: Considering you nearly died trying to find him, I suggest you leave that problem for another day. Preferably after a better way has been found into Arposandra.
translation: 考虑到你差点在找他的过程中丧命，我建议你把这个问题留到以后。最好等找到更好的方法进入阿波桑德拉再说。

english: Now, I'm sure you have more important matters to attend to than chatting to a cranky old gnome. Take these and be on your way.
translation: 好了，我相信你有更重要的事要做，而不是跟一个脾气暴躁的老地精聊天。拿着这些，上路吧。

english: You're back. After these I'm guessing? Take them and stop disturbing me.
translation: 你回来了。是来拿这些的吧？拿着，别再来烦我了。

english: You're back. After this I'm guessing? Take it and stop disturbing me.
translation: 你回来了。是来拿这个的吧？拿着，别再来烦我了。

english: Hmm, I suppose I could use some assistance. However, you're not really the person I need for this task.
translation: 嗯，我想我确实可以借助一些帮助。不过，你并不是我真正需要的人选。

english: Hmm, I suppose I could use some assistance. I'm here to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 嗯，我想我确实可以借助一些帮助。我是来调查皮斯卡里琉斯港发生的异常事件的。

english: Well there is something I could use some help with. I'm here to investigate some unusual happenings in Port Piscarilius.
translation: 好吧，确实有件事需要你帮忙。我是来调查皮斯卡里琉斯港发生的异常事件的。

english: The Saviours of Kourend have been absorbing many of the other gangs. Within a few weeks, they've already become the largest gang in Kourend and more join them each day.
translation: 库兰德救世主一直在吸收其他很多帮派。短短几周内，他们已经成了库兰德王国最大的帮派，而且每天都有更多人加入。

english: Well my original plan was to infiltrate the gang to get close to the queen and capture her. However, I've been unable to make any progress. Apparently, I don't look the part.
translation: 我原本的计划是渗透进这个帮派，接近女王并抓住她。但我一直没什么进展。显然，我不像那个样子。

english: Anyway, if you're up for the task you'll need to infiltrate the Saviours of Kourend, find the Queen of Thieves, apprehend her and then bring her to me.
translation: 总之，如果你愿意接受这个任务，你需要潜入库兰德救世军，找到盗贼女王，逮捕她，然后把她带到我这里来。

english: So, do you think you can do it?
translation: 所以，你觉得你能做到吗？

english: You need to infiltrate the Saviours of Kourend, find the Queen of Thieves, apprehend her and then bring her to me.
translation: 你需要潜入库兰德救世军，找到盗贼女王，逮捕她，然后把她带到我这里来。

english: The Saviours of Kourend headquarters will be somewhere nearby. You might be able to learn more by asking around town.
translation: 库兰德救世军的总部就在附近某个地方。你可以在镇上四处打听，了解更多信息。

english: Hey there. I'm looking for the Saviours of Kourend. Do you know where I can find them?
translation: 你好。我在找库兰德救世军。你知道我在哪里能找到他们吗？

english: Keep your voice down! You've no idea who might be listening!
translation: 小声点！你根本不知道谁可能在偷听！

english: Oh sorry. Do you know where I can find them though?
translation: 哦，抱歉。那你知道在哪儿能找到他们吗？

english: No I don't! I keep my distance from that lot!
translation: 不知道！我跟那帮人离得远远的！

english: However, word on the streets is that Robert O'Reilly has been working with them. Perhaps he could help you. He lives in the middle of town.
translation: 不过，街上有传闻说罗伯特.奥赖利一直在和他们合作。也许他能帮你。他住在镇子中央。

english: Great. Thanks for the help.
translation: 太好了，谢谢你的帮助。

english: Where can I find Robert O'Reilly?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到罗伯特.奥赖利？

english: He'll probably be at his home. You'll find it in the middle of town.
translation: 他大概在他家里。你会在镇子中央找到的。

english: Hello. I'm looking for the Saviours of Kourend and I was hoping you could help me.
translation: 你好。我在找库兰德救世军，希望你能帮我。

english: Yeah I can help you, but not for free.
translation: 是啊，我可以帮你，但不是免费的。

english: What's your price?
translation: 你要什么价？

english: It's been too long since I've eaten some proper food. All we get around here is fish. Bring me a nice stew and I'll help you out.
translation: 我已经很久没吃过像样的食物了。这儿只有鱼。给我带一份好吃的炖菜来，我就帮你。

english: Where am I going to get some stew?
translation: 我去哪儿弄炖菜？

english: Buy some? Cook some? Doesn't matter to me.
translation: 买一份？做一份？对我来说无所谓。

english: Very well. I'll return when I have some stew.
translation: 好吧，我有了炖菜就回来。

english: It just so happens I have some stew right here.
translation: 我正好这儿有一份炖菜。

english: Well that's suspiciously convenient.
translation: 嗯，那可真是巧得可疑。

english: I know right, what are the chances?
translation: 我知道，哪有这么巧的事？

english: Thanks. The Saviours of Kourend make their home in a place called the Warrens. You'll find it in the sewers beneath us.
translation: 谢谢。库兰德救世军在一个叫沃伦斯的地方安家。你会在我们脚下的下水道里找到它。

english: Thank you for your help. I'll be on my way.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，我这就走了。

english: No information for you then. Come back if you change your mind.
translation: 那你就没情报了。改主意了就回来吧。

english: Do you have my stew yet?
translation: 我的炖菜带来了吗？

english: No stew, no information. Come back when you have some.
translation: 没炖菜就没情报。有了再回来。

english: How goes things?
translation: 事情怎么样了？

english: I haven't found the Saviours of Kourend yet.
translation: 我还没找到库兰德救世军。

english: Well you should look in the sewers beneath us. There you'll find the Warrens, where the Saviours make their home.
translation: 那你应该去咱们脚下的下水道看看。那儿有个叫沃伦斯的地方，库兰德救世主的老巢就在那儿。

english: Yeah I can help you. Not for free though.
translation: 是的，我可以帮你。不过不是免费的。

english: It's been too long since I've eaten some proper food, all we get around here is fish. Bring me a nice stew and I'll help you out.
translation: 我已经很久没吃过像样的食物了，我们这儿只有鱼。给我带一份美味的炖菜来，我就帮你。

english: Hello. I'm looking for the Saviours of Kourend. Do you know where I could find them?
translation: 你好。我在找库兰德救世军。你知道我在哪里能找到他们吗？

english: Right here is where you'll find them. What business do you have with the Saviours?
translation: 你面前就是。你找库兰德救世主有什么事？

english: I was hoping I could join the gang.
translation: 我希望加入帮派。

english: Join the gang? Do you think this is a game?
translation: 加入帮派？你以为这是玩游戏吗？

english: We don't just let anyone join our gang. If you want in, you'll need to prove your worth.
translation: 我们不是随便什么人都让加入的。想进来，你得证明自己的价值。

english: Since our formation, many of the other gangs in Kourend have joined our cause. However, some still choose to resist.
translation: 自从我们成立以来，库兰德王国的很多其他帮派都加入了我们的事业。不过，还是有些帮派选择抵抗。

english: Our largest rivals are the Vipers and our leader...
translation: 我们最大的对手是毒蛇帮，而我们的领袖……

english: The Queen of Thieves?
translation: 盗贼女王？

english: Let me finish!
translation: 让我把话说完！

english: Our leader has had enough of the Vipers and wants to make an example of them.
translation: 我们的领袖受够了毒蛇帮，想拿他们杀鸡儆猴。

english: We need to send a message to the Vipers to let them know that their days are done.
translation: 我们得给毒蛇帮传个信，让他们知道他们的日子到头了。

english: We'd like you to kill Conrad King, one of their senior members. The man has been a thorn in our side for far too long. Besides, his murderous ways make us look like paragons of virtue in comparison.
translation: 我们希望你去杀了康拉德.金，他是毒蛇帮的高级成员。这家伙做我们的眼中钉已经太久了。再说，他那杀人的手段一比较，显得我们简直像美德的化身。

english: You want me to kill someone?
translation: 你想让我杀人？

english: As in, kill them, kill them?
translation: 就是，杀了他们，杀了他们？

english: So like, kill them dead?
translation: 就是说，把他们弄死？

english: Is this going to be a problem?
translation: 这有问题吗？

english: Nope, sounds good to me.
translation: 没问题，听起来不错。

english: Good. You'll find Conrad King south of the Piscarilius Foodhall. News travels fast around here so we'll know when the deed is done.
translation: 很好。你会在皮斯卡里琉斯美食厅南边找到康拉德.金。这里消息传得很快，所以事情办完后我们会知道的。

english: Great. I'll be back soon.
translation: 太好了，我很快就回来。

english: I don't think I can do it.
translation: 我觉得我下不了手。

english: Well then we have nothing to discuss. If you change your mind, you'll find Conrad King south of the Piscarilius Foodhall. News travels fast around here so we'll know when the deed is done.
translation: 那我们没什么好谈的了。如果你改变主意，你会在皮斯卡里琉斯美食厅南边找到康拉德.金。这里消息传得很快，所以事情办完后我们会知道的。

english: Conrad King is still alive so I don't know what you're doing here. Go get the job done. He can be found south of the Piscarilius Foodhall.
translation: 康拉德.金还活着，所以我不知道你在这里干什么。去把活儿干完。他可以在皮斯卡里琉斯美食厅南边找到。

english: I'm coming Elizabeth!
translation: 我来了，伊丽莎白！

english: Word on the streets is that Conrad King has met his maker. The queen is impressed. You should head on in and speak to her.
translation: 街上都在说康拉德.金去见阎王了。女王很欣赏你。你应该进去跟她谈谈。

english: Right here is where you'll find them. What business do you have with the Saviours.
translation: 就在这里，你会找到他们。你找救世主们有什么事？

english: Word on the streets is that Conrad King has met his maker. The Queen is impressed, you should head on in and speak to her.
translation: 街头传言说康拉德.金已经去见他的造物主了。女王很满意，你应该进去和她谈谈。

english: We'd like you to kill Conrad King, one of their senior members. That should show them that the games are over.
translation: 我们希望你去杀了康拉德.金，他们是高级成员之一。这应该能让他们明白游戏结束了。

english: Word on the streets is that Conrad King has met his maker. The Queen is impressed. You should head on in and speak to her.
translation: 街头传言说康拉德.金已经去见他的造物主了。女王很满意。你应该进去和她谈谈。

english: Hey! I didn't give you permission to go in there.
translation: 嘿！我可没允许你进去。

english: I have nothing to say to you! Get out of my sight!
translation: 我跟你没什么好说的！滚出我的视线！

english: So you're the one who killed Conrad King. Not bad, but you don't look like much to me.
translation: 所以你就是杀了康拉德.金的人。不错嘛，不过在我看来你也没什么了不起。

english: No I wouldn't. I've seen hundreds of fools like you and you're all the same. I doubt you'll be sticking around here very long.
translation: 我才不会。我见过成百上千像你这样的蠢货，全都一个样。我打赌你在这儿待不长。

english: And neither will you. On behalf of the Kourend Council, I'm bringing you in.
translation: 你也不会了。我代表库兰德议会，要逮捕你。

english: You truly are a complete and utter idiot.
translation: 你可真是个彻头彻尾的大白痴。

english: Allow me to enlighten you. While you may have been told that the Saviours of Kourend are evil, the truth is quite the opposite. Before we came along, Kourend was filled with violent gangs who cared little for their victims.
translation: 让我来告诉你真相。也许你听人说库兰德救世主是邪恶的，但事实恰恰相反。在我们出现之前，库兰德王国充斥着暴力的帮派，他们根本不关心受害者。

english: Let me guess, you're different.
translation: 让我猜猜，你们不一样。

english: Shut up and let me speak!
translation: 闭嘴，让我说！

english: Yes the Saviours of Kourend are thieves, the Saviours of Kourend are murderers. However, we do not randomly pick our targets. Everything we do has a purpose.
translation: 是的，库兰德救世军是盗贼，库兰德救世军是杀人犯。不过，我们不会随意选择目标。我们所做的一切都有目的。

english: The name isn't a joke. We're here to save Kourend. To save it from the corruption that has tainted this once great kingdom.
translation: 这个名字不是开玩笑的。我们是来拯救库兰德王国的。拯救它免受腐败的侵蚀，腐败已经玷污了这个曾经伟大的王国。

english: We do that by taking from those who would lord themselves over the people. We remove their power and give it back to those who keep this kingdom alive.
translation: 我们的做法是从那些骑在人民头上作威作福的人手里夺取东西。我们夺走他们的权力，把它还给那些维持这个王国生存的人们。

english: Yet you call yourself a queen. Bit ironic don't you think?
translation: 可你却自称女王。你不觉得有点讽刺吗？

english: The irony isn't lost on me. In truth I didn't want to lead at all, but it fell to me because I'm the best at it. Being born a Piscarilius means that you have to be.
translation: 我明白其中的讽刺意味。事实上，我根本不想领导，但因为我最擅长这个，所以落到了我头上。生为皮斯卡里琉斯家族的人，你就必须如此。

english: Hang on... you're part of the Piscarilius family?
translation: 等等……你是皮斯卡里琉斯家族的人？

english: I am the Piscarilius family. Of course Lady Shauna Piscarilius couldn't well take charge of a gang, so I took on a different name, one that the rich and degenerate are already starting to fear.
translation: 我就是皮斯卡里琉斯家族。当然，皮斯卡里琉斯夫人肖娜不能直接掌管一个帮派，所以我换了个名字，一个富人和堕落者已经开始害怕的名字。

english: I am the Piscarilius family. Of course Lady Shauna Piscarilius couldn't well take charge of a gang so I took on a different name, one that the rich and degenerate are already starting to fear.
translation: 我就是皮斯卡里琉斯家族。当然，皮斯卡里琉斯夫人肖娜不能直接掌管一个帮派，所以我换了个名字，一个富人和堕落者已经开始害怕的名字。

english: Yes the Saviours of Kourend are thieves. The Saviours of Kourend are murderers. However, we do not randomly pick our targets. Everything we do has a purpose.
translation: 是的，库兰德救世军是盗贼。库兰德救世军是杀人犯。不过，我们不会随意选择目标。我们所做的一切都有目的。

english: Okay, you've got my attention. But how do I know you're telling the truth?
translation: 好吧，你引起了我的注意。但我怎么知道你说的是真话？

english: You are clearly fairly new to Kourend, so you might not be fully aware of our current leadership situation. After the last King died, rulership should have passed on to his daughter. However, she was declared mad.
translation: 你显然对库兰德王国还不太熟悉，所以你可能不完全了解我们目前的领导状况。上一任国王去世后，王位本应由他的女儿继承。但她被宣布为疯子。

english: It was the King's closest advisors that made this declaration. They took over and became the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom ever since.
translation: 是国王最亲近的顾问们做出了这个宣言。他们接管了政权，组成了库兰德议会。从那以后，他们就一直统治着这个王国。

english: Now, the councillors are supposedly voted for by the people. However, the seats have been held by the same four people since the start. Pretty suspicious don't you think?
translation: 现在，议员们按理说是由人民选举的。然而，从开始到现在，四个席位一直由同四个人占据。很可疑，你不觉得吗？

english: That does sound odd.
translation: 听起来确实很奇怪。

english: Exactly. The Council is clearly corrupt, and we intend to bring that to light. Councillor Hughes is our first target. We have reason to believe that she may be in league with the Disciples of Yama.
translation: 没错。议会显然是腐败的，我们打算揭露这一点。休斯议员是我们的第一个目标。我们有理由相信她可能与阎魔的门徒勾结。

english: Disciples of Yama?
translation: 阎魔的门徒？

english: A cult of Zamorakians who supposedly serve a demon called Yama.
translation: 一个信奉萨拉多明的邪教，据称侍奉一个叫阎魔的恶魔。

english: They've been a problem for a while, but they haven't been deemed dangerous enough to be properly dealt with. Councillor Hughes' influence, no doubt.
translation: 他们一直是个问题，但还没被认定为足够危险而需要彻底处理。这肯定是休斯议员的影响力。

english: Anyway, go to her home and find proof of her corruption. If you find it, you will know I'm telling the truth. If you don't... well don't pretend you care about breaking and entering anyway.
translation: 总之，去她家里找到她腐败的证据。如果你找到了，你就知道我说的是真话。如果找不到……好吧，反正别假装你在乎私闯民宅。

english: Fine, I'll give you benefit of the doubt. But if you're wrong, I'm coming straight back here to apprehend you.
translation: 好吧，我姑且相信你。但如果你错了，我立刻回来逮捕你。

english: I'll pretend I didn't hear that. Councillor Hughes' home is on the northern side of Kingstown. Even a fool like you should be able to find it. Don't worry, she's never in.
translation: 我就当没听见。休斯议员的家在金斯敦北边。就算是你这样的傻瓜也应该能找到。别担心，她从来不在家。

english: Once you have the evidence, give it to that Lawry fellow. Provided he's not as useless as you, he'll make sure that she's dealt with.
translation: 一旦你拿到证据，把它交给那个叫劳里的家伙。只要他不像你一样没用，他会确保她受到处理。

english: Now get lost.
translation: 现在滚吧。

english: Oh it's you. Are you going to actually let me finish what I'm saying this time or are you just going to walk off again.
translation: 哦，是你啊。这次你是打算让我把话说完，还是又要直接走人？

english: I'll let you finish this time.
translation: 这次我会让你说完。

english: Good. In future you should try not to be so rude.
translation: 很好。以后你尽量别这么无礼。

english: Anyway, you are clearly fairly new to Kourend, so you might not be fully aware of our current leadership situation. After the last King died, rulership should have passed on to his daughter. However, she was declared
translation: 总之，你显然对库兰德王国还不太熟悉，所以你可能不完全了解我们目前的领导状况。上一任国王去世后，王位本应由他的女儿继承。但她被宣布为

english: mad.
translation: 疯子。

english: Whatever you want I don't care. Come back to me when you've completed your task.
translation: 随便你想怎样，我不在乎。完成任务了再来找我。

english: Blimey! Forget the Queen of Thieves. If this letter is to be believed, Councillor Hughes is working with those vile Disciples of Yama. I must report this to the Council immediately.
translation: 天哪！先别管盗贼女王了。如果这封信可信的话，休斯议员正在和那些卑鄙的阎魔门徒合作。我必须立刻向议会报告。

english: Hello. Thanks again for your help.
translation: 你好。再次感谢你的帮助。

english: Port Piscarilius is home to various gangs. They're a nuisance but up to now we haven't had much trouble in dealing with them.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯港是各种帮派的窝点。他们很烦人，但到目前为止我们对付他们还没遇到太大麻烦。

english: A new gang calling themselves the Saviours of Kourend has recently formed. That's not surprising as gangs come and go all of the time but this one is different.
translation: 一个自称库兰德救世军的新帮派最近成立了。这并不奇怪，因为帮派来来去去是常有的事，但这个帮派与众不同。

english: Shauna Piscarilius is the leader of Port Piscarilius but she spends most of her time galavanting around in that boat of hers rather than looking after her home.
translation: 肖娜.皮斯卡里琉斯是皮斯卡里琉斯港的领袖，但她大部分时间都在她那艘船上闲逛，而不是照看她的家园。

english: Well my original plan was to infiltrate the gang to get close to the Queen and apprehend her. However, I've been unable to make any progress. Apparently I don't look the part.
translation: 我原本的计划是潜入帮派，接近那个女王并逮捕她。然而我一直没什么进展。显然我看起来不像那号人。

english: Quite right. They're quite insistent though so someone else will need to give it a go. You look like you might be just the type they're after.
translation: 没错。但他们很坚持，所以需要别人来试试。你看起来正是他们要找的类型。

english: You've done a great service to the people of Kourend and there is no greater reward than the satisfaction of a job well done.
translation: 你为库兰德王国的人民立了大功，没有什么奖赏比圆满完成任务的满足感更大了。

english: Indeed. I must report this to the council immediately.
translation: 确实。我必须立刻向议会报告此事。

english: A group of deranged cultists that worship some sort of demon. They're not a big threat compared to the lizardmen, but they're still an enemy to Kourend.
translation: 一群崇拜某种恶魔的疯狂邪教徒。与蜥蜴人相比，他们算不上大威胁，但他们仍然是库兰德的敌人。

english: There is something I could use some help with. However, you're not really the person I need for this task.
translation: 有件事我想找人帮忙。不过，你并不是我所需的人选。

english: Shauna Piscarilius is the ruler of Port Piscarilius but she spends most of her time galavanting around in that boat of hers rather than looking after her home.
translation: 肖娜.皮斯卡里琉斯是皮斯卡里琉斯港的统治者，但她大部分时间都在她那艘船上闲逛，而不是照看她的家园。

english: Well come back to me once you have the Queen of Thieves.
translation: 等你抓到盗贼女王再回来找我吧。

english: The council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. The current councillors are Councillor Hughes, Councillor Unkar, Councillor Orson and Councillor Andrews.
translation: 议会由四名议员组成，每四年由人民选举产生。现任议员是休斯议员、昂卡尔议员、奥森议员和安德鲁斯议员。

english: The Kourend Council consists of four councillors who are elected by the people every four years. One of the councillors holds the position of head councillor and this rotates every year.
translation: 库兰德议会由四名议员组成，每四年由人民选举产生。其中一名议员担任首席议员，每年轮换一次。

english: Oh, it's you. You know I spent quite a bit of time at Mount Quidamortem but didn't find anything. Are you sure Councillor Hughes was there?
translation: 哦，是你。你知道我在奎达莫特姆山花了不少时间，但什么都没找到。你确定休斯议员在那里？

english: Hmm, very well. At least it's all over. Maybe now we can start to focus on getting me voted in as her replacement.
translation: 嗯，很好。至少都结束了。也许现在我们可以开始努力让我当选接替她了。

english: Have you heard the wonderful news? Martin Holt has been captured. My fine work, of course. At the rate I'm going, there won't be any criminals left in this kingdom.
translation: 你听到好消息了吗？马丁.霍尔特被抓住了。当然是我的功劳。照这个速度，这个王国就不会有罪犯了。

english: Oh, they've put him somewhere with maximum security. After Councillor Hughes escaped, it was felt the castle cells might not be as secure as we thought.
translation: 哦，他们把他关在了戒备最森严的地方。自从休斯议员越狱后，人们觉得城堡的牢房可能不像我们想的那么安全。

english: Fear not, he won't be going anywhere.
translation: 别担心，他哪儿也去不了。

english: Hello again. Isn't it wonderful to have all this Councillor Hughes nastiness sorted? Maybe now we can start to focus on getting me voted in as her replacement.
translation: 又见面了。把休斯议员这些糟心事都解决了不是很好吗？也许现在我们可以开始努力让我当选接替她了。

english: I hear Councillor Hughes has been arrested. Perhaps you're not totally useless after all.
translation: 我听说休斯议员被捕了。看来你也不是完全没用嘛。

english: You know, you're really not a nice person.
translation: 你知道吗，你真是个不好相处的人。

english: Oh give me a break. You think I care what you think?
translation: 哦，饶了我吧。你以为我在乎你怎么想？

english: Anyway, I guess this is the part where you expect a reward?
translation: 总之，我猜现在是你期待奖励的时候了？

english: Well I wouldn't complain.
translation: 嗯，我不会抱怨的。

english: Fine. As much as I hate to admit it, you've done alright. The arrest of Councillor Hughes can only mean good things for Kourend and her people.
translation: 好吧。尽管我很不愿意承认，但你干得不错。逮捕休斯议员对库兰德和她的人民来说只能是件好事。

english: This is only the beginning though. There's much work to still be done. I may well call on your help again. Or maybe I won't, who knows. Now take these and go.
translation: 但这只是开始。还有很多工作要做。我可能会再次需要你的帮助。也可能不会，谁知道呢。现在拿着这些走吧。

english: Oh give me a break, you think I care what you think?
translation: 得了吧，你以为我会在乎你的想法吗？

english: Exactly. The council is clearly corrupt and we intend to bring that to light. Councillor Hughes is our first target. We have reason to believe that she may be in league with the Disciples of Yama.
translation: 正是。议会显然腐败不堪，我们打算揭露这一点。休斯议员是我们的首要目标。我们有理由相信她可能与阎魔信徒勾结。

english: You are fairly new to Kourend so you might not be aware of our current leadership situation. After the last king died, rulership should have passed on to his daughter. However, she was declared mad.
translation: 你刚到库兰德王国不久，可能不了解我们目前的领导层情况。上一位国王去世后，统治权本应传给他的女儿，但她被宣布为疯子。

english: Anyway, I guess this is the part where you expect a reward.
translation: 总之，我猜接下来你该期待奖励了。

english: This is only the beginning though, there's much work to still be done. I may well call on your help again, or maybe I won't, who knows. Now take these and go.
translation: 不过这只是开始，还有很多工作要做。我也许会再次请你帮忙，也许不会，谁知道呢。现在拿着这些走吧。

english: Go to her home and find proof of her corruption. If you find it, you will know I am telling the truth. If you don't... well don't pretend you care about breaking and entering anyway.
translation: 去她家里找她腐败的证据。如果你找到了，就知道我说的是真话。如果没找到……好吧，反正别装得你好像在意擅闯民宅似的。

english: It was the king's closest advisors that declared her mad. They took over and became the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom ever since.
translation: 是国王最亲近的顾问们宣布她疯了。他们接管了政权，组成了库兰德议会。从那以后，他们就一直统治着这个王国。

english: The council is supposedly voted on by the people every four years. However, the seats have been held by the same four people since the council was founded. Pretty suspicious don't you think?
translation: 理论上议会每四年由人民投票选举。然而，自从议会成立以来，席位一直由同样四个人把持。相当可疑，你不觉得吗？

english: How about you go away then.
translation: 那你走开好了。

english: If this is an attempt to make friends then you're wasting your time.
translation: 如果这是想交朋友，那你就是在浪费时间。

english: Exactly. The council is clearly corrupt, and we intend to bring that to light. Councillor Hughes is our first target. We have reason to believe that she may be in league with the Disciples of Yama.
translation: 正是。议会显然腐败不堪，我们打算揭露这一点。休斯议员是我们的首要目标。我们有理由相信她可能与阎魔信徒勾结。

english: You are clearly fairly new to Kourend, so you might not be fully aware of our current leadership situation. After the last king died, rulership should have passed on to his daughter. However, she was declared mad.
translation: 你显然刚到库兰德王国不久，可能不完全了解我们目前的领导层情况。上一位国王去世后，统治权本应传给他的女儿，但她被宣布为疯子。

english: Fine. I was born into the Piscarilius family as the only child of Lord Dalton Piscarilius. After my fool of a father got himself killed on a fishing trip, leadership fell to me.
translation: 好吧。我出生在皮斯卡里琉斯家族，是道尔顿.皮斯卡里琉斯勋爵的独生子。在我那傻瓜父亲在一次钓鱼中丧命后，领导权就落到了我身上。

english: It was the king's closest advisors that made this declaration. They took over and became the Kourend Council. They've ruled the kingdom ever since.
translation: 是国王最亲近的顾问们做出了这个宣言。他们接管了政权，组成了库兰德议会。从那以后，他们就一直统治着这个王国。

english: My father never cared about anyone. He was far more interested in increasing his own wealth at the cost of his people. Once I took over, I vowed to fight for them in a way he never did.
translation: 我父亲从不在乎任何人。他更感兴趣的是以牺牲人民为代价来增加自己的财富。我接管后，发誓要以他从未有过的方式为他们而战。

english: Despite my best efforts, the Kourend Council, in all their corruption, never cared to help me return my home to glory. In the end I gave up, or at least, they think I did.
translation: 尽管我尽了最大努力，但腐败的库兰德议会从来不愿意帮助我恢复家园的荣耀。最后我放弃了，或者至少，他们以为我放弃了。

english: To the people of Kourend it appeared that I had followed in my fathers gluttonous footsteps. However, I instead came here and began a new fight, one where I made the rules.
translation: 对库兰德的人民来说，我似乎继承了我父亲的贪食之路。然而，我却来到了这里，开始了一场新的战斗，一场由我制定规则的战斗。

english: Looking for your reward idiot? Take it and get lost.
translation: 在找奖励吗，白痴？拿着滚吧。

english: For many years I used my position to fight against the crime and corruption in this kingdom, but no matter what I did, it was never enough. I realised that to defeat my enemies, I needed to act as they do.
translation: 多年来，我利用自己的职位与这个王国的犯罪和腐败作斗争，但无论我做什么，永远都不够。我意识到要击败敌人，我必须像他们一样行动。

english: That's why I formed the Saviours of Kourend. We take the laws into our own hands and fight against all who would damage this kingdom, no matter who they are.
translation: 这就是我成立库兰德救世军的原因。我们自行执法，与所有损害这个王国的人作战，无论他们是谁。

english: For many years, I appealed to the Kourend Council for help in fighting this crime, but they cared little for us. Instead, I decided to beat them at their own game and fight fire with fire.
translation: 多年来，我向库兰德议会请求帮助打击犯罪，但他们对我们漠不关心。于是，我决定以其人之道还治其人之身，以火攻火。

english: Despite my best efforts, the Kourend Council, in all their corruption, never cared to help me return my home to glory. In the end I gave up, or at least, they thought I did.
translation: 尽管我尽了最大努力，但腐败的库兰德议会从来不愿意帮助我恢复家园的荣耀。最后我放弃了，或者至少，他们以为我放弃了。

english: To the people of Kourend, it appeared that I had followed in my fathers gluttonous footsteps. However, I instead came here and began a new fight, one where I made the rules.
translation: 对库兰德的人民来说，我似乎继承了我父亲的贪食之路。然而，我却来到了这里，开始了一场新的战斗，一场由我制定规则的战斗。

english: All people and goods coming to or from Kourend go through Port Piscarilius. This unfortunatly means that we are a centre point for the majority of crime within the kingdom.
translation: 所有进出库兰德的人和货物都要经过皮斯卡里琉斯港。不幸的是，这意味着我们是王国内大部分犯罪活动的中心点。

english: Good. Now clear off.
translation: 很好。现在滚开。

english: Whatever you want, I don't care. Come back to me when you've completed your task.
translation: 随便你想要什么，我不在乎。完成任务后再来见我。

english: Anyway, you are fairly new to Kourend so you might not be aware of our current leadership situation. Kourend once had a King, but he died and left no suitable heir. The Kourend Council has ruled ever
translation: 总之，你刚来库兰德不久，可能不了解我们目前的领导层情况。库兰德曾经有一位国王，但他去世了，没有留下合适的继承人。从那以后，库兰德议会一直统治着。

english: since.
translation: 一直持续至今。

english: Oh it's you. Are you going to actually let me finish what I'm saying this time? Or are you just going to walk off again?
translation: 哦，是你。这次你打算让我把话说完吗？还是又要走开？

english: Anyway, you are clearly fairly new to Kourend, so you might not be fully aware of our current leadership situation. After the last king died, rulership should have passed on to his daughter. However, she was declared
translation: 总之，你显然刚到库兰德王国不久，可能不完全了解我们目前的领导层情况。上一位国王去世后，统治权本应传给他的女儿，但她被宣布为

english: The fight will never be over and you're a fool to think otherwise.
translation: 战斗永远不会结束，如果你不这么认为，那就是个傻瓜。

english: You think I'll trust that boy? No. My methods have worked so far, and they will keep working.
translation: 你以为我会信任那个男孩？不。我的方法至今有效，而且会继续有效。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. You haven't seen Floopa, have you? She really should be resting, but she seems to have wandered off somewhere.
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。你没见过弗卢帕吧？她真的应该休息的，但她好像跑到什么地方去了。

english: I'm afraid not. Should I go and look for her?
translation: 恐怕没有。我应该去找她吗？

english: Well, you really shouldn't worry yourself, [player name]. However, if you did want to go and find her, I would be very grateful.
translation: 嗯，你真的不必操心，[player name]。不过，如果你愿意去找她，我会非常感激。

english: I'm happy to have a look around. Any ideas on where I should start looking?
translation: 我很乐意四处看看。有什么建议我从哪里开始找吗？

english: Well, she can't have gone too far. Perhaps you should ask if anyone has seen her around town.
translation: 嗯，她不可能走太远。也许你应该问问镇上有没有人见过她。

english: Sounds like a plan. I'll get to it.
translation: 听起来不错。我这就去办。

english: Actually, I've got something I need to do right now. Sorry about that.
translation: 其实我现在有件事要做。抱歉。

english: It's not a problem. I'm sure she'll be back soon.
translation: 没关系。我相信她很快就会回来的。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck finding Floopa?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。找到弗卢帕了吗？

english: I'm sure she hasn't gone far. Perhaps you should ask if anyone has seen her around town.
translation: 我确定她没走远。也许你应该问问镇上有没有人见过她。

english: Welcome to Elder Raley's Herblore Stall. Would you like to buy some herblore supplies?
translation: 欢迎来到长老雷利的草药学摊位。你想买些草药学补给品吗？

english: Have you seen Floopa?
translation: 你见过弗卢帕吗？

english: Floopa? Yes, I did see her earlier. It looked like she was heading towards the Sacred Grove in the middle of the island.
translation: 弗卢帕？是的，我之前见过她。看起来她正往岛中央的圣林走去。

english: Perfect, thank you. I'll head over there and see if I can find her.
translation: 太好了，谢谢。我这就过去看看能不能找到她。

english: Hello there. Can I interest you in some crafting supplies?
translation: 你好。有兴趣买些制作补给品吗？

english: Human. Do you wish to hunt? If so, I have supplies for you.
translation: 人类。你想打猎吗？如果是的话，我有补给品给你。

english: Yes, I saw her heading towards the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island earlier.
translation: 是的，我之前看到她往岛中央的圣林去了。

english: Hello there, human. Interested in some fish? Or maybe you need some fishing supplies?
translation: 你好，人类。对鱼感兴趣吗？或者你需要一些钓鱼补给品？

english: Ah, human. Are you in need of a spear or shield?
translation: 啊，人类。你需要长矛或盾吗？

english: Oh... Can I help you?
translation: 哦……我能帮你吗？

english: I believe I did see her earlier. She looked as though she was heading to the Sacred Grove in the centre of the island.
translation: 我相信我之前确实见过她。她看起来像是往岛中央的圣林去了。

english: Hello there, young one.
translation: 你好，小家伙。

english: Hello there. I'm looking for Floopa.
translation: 你好。我在找弗卢帕。

english: Floopa? Yes, she's in the Grove right now.
translation: 弗卢帕？是的，她现在在圣林里。

english: Would it be possible to speak to her?
translation: 我能和她谈谈吗？

english: Well, the Grove is normally for tortugans only, but if you just want to speak to Floopa, I suppose I can let you enter as long as you promise not to chop down any of the camphor trees.
translation: 嗯，圣林通常只对龟人开放，但如果你只是想和弗卢帕说话，我想我可以让你进去，只要你保证不砍伐任何樟树。

english: Are the trees important?
translation: 这些树很重要吗？

english: Very. Camphor trees play a key role in the Trial by Water so it is essential we look after them. Their wood is also highly desirable for all sorts of other purposes.
translation: 非常重要。樟树在水之试炼中扮演关键角色，所以我们必须好好照料它们。它们的木材也因各种其他用途而备受青睐。

english: However, the trees are very rare and hard to grow. Our island is the only place you'll find them, but even then there's very few outside the Grove.
translation: 然而，这些树非常稀有且难以种植。我们的岛屿是唯一能找到它们的地方，但即便如此，圣林外的数量也极少。

english: I see. Well, I promise not to chop any of them down.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，我保证不砍任何一棵。

english: Thank you, human. In that case, you may head on in.
translation: 谢谢你，人类。既然如此，你可以进去了。

english: Excuse me! You don't have permission to touch those trees!
translation: 喂！你没有权限碰那些树！

english: Looking for you. You didn't tell anyone where you were going.
translation: 在找你。你没告诉任何人你要去哪里。

english: Oh, sorry if I caused any problems, but Raley and the others worry too much. I'm fine.
translation: 哦，如果我造成了什么麻烦，抱歉，但雷利他们太担心了。我没事。

english: Yes. I just need to gather some camphor wood and then I'll head back to town. I'd have done so already if it wasn't for this damn injury!
translation: 是的。我只需要收集一些樟木，然后就回镇上去。要不是这该死的伤，我早就回去了！

english: You should really still be recovering. Do you need the wood now?
translation: 你真的应该还在恢复中。你现在就需要木材吗？

english: Yes! I need a new spear!
translation: 是的！我需要一把新长矛！

english: A new spear? Why?
translation: 新长矛？为什么？

english: It's complicated...
translation: 说来话长……

english: This is about that ship isn't it? The one with the red sails? You know that ship, don't you?
translation: 这跟那艘船有关，对吧？那艘红帆的船？你知道那艘船，对吧？

english: Yes. It's part of a fleet owned by the Red Reef Trading Company. I was the navigator for their flagship, the Zenith.
translation: 是的。它是红礁贸易公司舰队的一部分。我曾是他们旗舰'天顶号'的领航员。

english: But they betrayed you?
translation: 但他们背叛了你？

english: I thought they were my friends, but not a single one of them dared say a word! They just stood there and watched that monster stab me with my own spear!
translation: 我以为他们是我的朋友，但他们没有一个人敢说一句话！他们就站在那里，看着那个怪物用我自己的长矛刺我！

english: Do you know what he said as he did it? He said he was sorry! He said it wasn't personal! The worst part is, I think he believed it. To him, it was just the unfortunate cost of business!
translation: 你知道他动手时说了什么吗？他说他很抱歉！他说这不是针对个人！最糟糕的是，我觉得他相信了。对他来说，这只是生意上不幸的代价！

english: Spencer Brentwood. He owns the company. Whatever it is they're up to, he's the one responsible.
translation: 斯宾塞.布伦特伍德。他拥有这家公司。不管他们在搞什么，他都是那个负责人。

english: I'm sorry, Floopa. I can't even begin to imagine what you're going through, but you can't face this alone. Even if you weren't injured, this is too big for one person to deal with.
translation: 我很抱歉，弗卢帕。我甚至无法想象你正在经历什么，但你不能独自面对。即使你没有受伤，这件事也太大了，一个人处理不了。

english: Maybe, but it doesn't matter. I have to be the one to stop him.
translation: 也许吧，但这不重要。我必须由我来阻止他。

english: Fine, but at least let me help in other ways. We don't even know what it is that he's doing. Let me investigate. In the meantime, you can work on your recovery.
translation: 好吧，但至少让我以其他方式帮忙。我们甚至不知道他在做什么。让我去调查。与此同时，你可以专注于恢复。

english: You know, it's annoying that you keep talking sense.
translation: 你知道吗，你一直说些有道理的话真烦人。

english: Well, I have my moments.
translation: 嗯，我也有灵光一现的时候。

english: Alright, we'll do it your way, for now.
translation: 好吧，暂时按你说的做。

english: Thank you, Floopa. Now, if I were to investigate this company, where would it be best for me to begin?
translation: 谢谢你，弗卢帕。那么，如果我要调查这家公司，最好从哪里开始？

english: You'll want to sail to their headquarters: Red Rock. It's to the west of here, in the Red Reef.
translation: 你需要航行到他们的总部：红岩岛。就在这里的西边，红礁中。

english: I'll head over there right away and pose as a new recruit. I'll be back once I've learnt something. Now, you should head back to Raley.
translation: 我马上过去，假扮成新招募的人。一旦我了解到什么就回来。现在，你应该回到雷利那里去。

english: Fine, but don't go taking too long.
translation: 好吧，但别拖太久。

english: And risk you trying to sort things out on your own again? Don't worry, I'll be back before you know it.
translation: 免得你又想自己解决问题？别担心，我很快就回来。

english: Good luck, [player name], and... thank you.
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]，还有……谢谢你。

english: I'll head back to Raley soon. I just need a little time to myself. You should get sailing over to Red Rock. It's to the west of here, in the Red Reef.
translation: 我很快就回雷利那里去。我只是需要一点独处的时间。你应该启航去红岩岛。就在这里的西边，红礁中。

english: Alright. I'll be back before you know it.
translation: 好的。我很快就回来。

english: I found her over in the Sacred Grove. She should be back soon.
translation: 我在圣林那边找到她了。她应该很快就回来。

english: Thank you. She really shouldn't go wandering off while she's still recovering. I'll need to make sure her antics haven't reopened her wound.
translation: 谢谢你。她真的不应该在恢复期间到处乱跑。我得确保她的胡闹没有让伤口重新裂开。

english: I don't seem to recall inviting you into my office. I'm a very busy man, so please be on your way.
translation: 我好像不记得邀请你进我的办公室。我是个很忙的人，所以请便吧。

english: Hello and welcome to Red Rock, home of the Red Reef Trading Company. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，欢迎来到红岩岛，红礁贸易公司的所在地。我能帮你什么？

english: I was actually thinking I might be able to help you.
translation: 其实我在想也许我能帮你。

english: You're looking for a job? Well, you've come to the right place! The Red Reef Trading Company is more than just a regular employer! We're a family!
translation: 你在找工作？那你来对地方了！红礁贸易公司不仅仅是一个普通的雇主！我们是一个大家庭！

english: Great! Strong family connections are exactly what I look for in an employer. When you have those, why care about benefits and compensation?
translation: 太好了！强大的家庭纽带正是我在雇主身上寻找的。有了这些，谁还在乎福利和报酬呢？

english: You're so right. I can just tell that you're the kind of person who will love our company values, or as we call them, the Pillars of Progress! So tell me, what kind of work have you done in the past?
translation: 你说得太对了。我就能看出你是那种会喜欢我们公司价值观的人，我们称之为'进步支柱'！那么告诉我，你过去做过什么工作？

english: Well, I imagine a company like this always has need of people who can solve problems, and I myself am something of a problem solver.
translation: 嗯，我想像这样的公司总是需要能解决问题的人，而我自己也算是个问题解决者。

english: You're a privateer?
translation: 你是私掠者？

english: Sort of, but my problem solving abilities aren't just limited to the sea.
translation: 差不多，但我的解决问题能力不仅限于海上。

english: Now that's the can do attitude that we like here! My superior, Theodore Paxton, has been looking for someone to help him deal with a little issue. I think you might be just the person he needs!
translation: 这就是我们喜欢的积极态度！我的上司西奥多.帕克斯顿一直在找人来帮他处理一个小问题。我想你可能正是他需要的人！

english: In that case, I'd be quite keen to speak with him.
translation: 这样的话，我很想和他谈谈。

english: Excellent! He should be free very soon. While you wait, may I recommend you familiarise yourself with the wonderful history of our company?
translation: 太好了！他应该很快就空闲了。在你等待的时候，我建议你了解一下我们公司辉煌的历史？

english: Fantastic! The display cases in this room should have all the details you need. You'll want to start with the one directly to the right of the entrance and then work your way around, ending with the ones behind me.
translation: 太棒了！这个房间里的展示柜有你需要的所有细节。你从入口正右边的那个开始，然后绕一圈，最后看我身后的那些。

english: I'll do just that. Thank you.
translation: 我这就去。谢谢。

english: Mr Paxton will be with you shortly. While you wait, may I recommend you use the display cases to familiarise yourself with our company?
translation: 帕克斯顿先生很快就来见你。在你等待的时候，我建议你利用展示柜来了解我们公司？

english: You'll want to start with the one directly behind you and then work your way around, ending with the ones behind me.
translation: 你从你正后方的那个开始，然后绕一圈，最后看我身后的那些。

english: I'll take a look. Thank you.
translation: 我会看看的。谢谢。

english: Mr Paxton will see you now. He's waiting in his office.
translation: 帕克斯顿先生现在见你。他在办公室等着。

english: So, I hear you're someone who can solve problems?
translation: 那么，我听说你是个能解决问题的人？

english: Good. A pirate captain by the name of Black Eye Bethel has been attacking our ships. Our understanding is that she has a hideout at Last Light to the south of here.
translation: 很好。一个名叫黑眼圈贝瑟尔的海盗船长一直在袭击我们的船。据我们所知，她在南边的'最后之光'有一个藏身处。

english: Sail over there and put an end to her and her ships.
translation: 航行到那里，终结她和她的船。

english: Yes. Do well here and I might have more work for you. Now, if you have no further questions, I have a lot of work to do, so please be on your way.
translation: 是的。在这里干得好，我可能还有更多工作给你。现在，如果你没有其他问题，我有很多工作要做，所以请便吧。

english: Black Eye Bethel has a hideout at Last Light to the south of here. Sail over there and put an end to her and her ships.
translation: 黑眼圈贝瑟尔在南边的'最后之光'有一个藏身处。航行到那里，终结她和她的船。

english: Now, if that's everything, I have a lot of work to do, so please be on your way.
translation: 现在，如果没别的事，我有很多工作要做，所以请便吧。

english: Looks like we've got some fresh meat!
translation: 看来我们有新鲜货色了！

english: It's slashin' time!
translation: 砍杀时间到！

english: You're done!
translation: 你完了！

english: Argh! You got me!
translation: 啊！你赢了！

english: Let's see if you can handle this!
translation: 看看你能不能接住这招！

english: I stole this one from a monkey!
translation: 这把是我从猴子那里偷来的！

english: Nice scimitar! I've got one too!
translation: 好弯刀！我也有一个！

english: No god can save you from me!
translation: 没有神能从我手中救你！

english: Fight me properly, coward!
translation: 好好跟我打，懦夫！

english: Even praying won't help you now!
translation: 现在祈祷也救不了你！

english: Black Eye Bethel is dead.
translation: 黑眼圈贝瑟尔死了。

english: Good. It's nice to have someone around who can get things done. Consider me impressed.
translation: 很好。身边有个能办事的人真好。我印象深刻。

english: Does that mean you have more work for me?
translation: 这意味着你有更多工作给我吗？

english: Me? No. However, the boss has an issue that has been proving tricky to solve. I think you might be just the kind of person he needs.
translation: 我？没有。不过，老板有个一直很难解决的问题。我想你可能正是他需要的那种人。

english: What's the issue?
translation: 什么问题？

english: I'll let him be the one to tell you that. He's out doing some work in the middle of the Red Reef at the moment. Sail out there and find his ship, the Zenith. It's easy to spot, so you shouldn't miss it.
translation: 让他亲口告诉你吧。他现在正在红礁岛中央工作。你航行到那里，找到他的船“天顶号”。那船很显眼，你不会错过的。

english: I'll head over right away.
translation: 我马上过去。

english: You've got a meeting with the boss. He's out doing some work in the middle of the Red Reef at the moment. Sail out there and find his ship, the Zenith. It's easy to spot, so you shouldn't miss it.
translation: 你和老板有个会面。他现在正在红礁岛中央工作。你航行到那里，找到他的船“天顶号”。那船很显眼，你不会错过的。

english: Hello! Welcome! You must be our friend who has a knack for solving problems.
translation: 你好！欢迎！你一定就是那位善于解决问题的朋友吧。

english: That's right. [player name]. Pleased to meet you.
translation: 没错。[player name]。很高兴见到你。

english: The pleasure is all mine. As you've probably already guessed, I'm Spencer Brentwood, and this is the Zenith.
translation: 荣幸之至。你大概已经猜到了，我是斯宾塞.布伦特伍德，这就是天顶号。

english: She's a fine vessel.
translation: 真是一艘好船。

english: The best. Now, tell me, [player name], do you dive?
translation: 最好的。那么，告诉我，[player name]，你会潜水吗？

english: Dive?
translation: 潜水？

english: Underwater. I have some coral dredgers in need of repair.
translation: 在水下。我有一些珊瑚挖掘机需要修理。

english: The best. Now, [player name], I see you have some diving equipment, so I'm assuming you dive?
translation: 最好的。那么，[player name]，我看到你有一些潜水装备，所以我猜你会潜水？

english: I'm about to go diving myself. I have some coral dredgers in need of repair.
translation: 我正要自己去潜水。我有一些珊瑚挖掘机需要修理。

english: You do the repairs yourself?
translation: 你自己动手修理？

english: Of course. It would be a poor leader who left all the work to their subordinates.
translation: 当然。把所有工作都丢给下属的领导者可不怎么样。

english: How very noble of you.
translation: 您真是太高尚了。

english: A trait that is far too rare these days. More and more I find our work to be a beacon of light in this dark world.
translation: 这种品质如今太罕见了。我越来越觉得，我们的工作就是这黑暗世界中的一座信标。

english: That work being?
translation: 什么工作？

english: The future of humanity, of course. I've long believed our salvation lies beneath the waves. Indeed, I myself feel far more alive below the sea than above it. I'd be very keen to show you.
translation: 人类的未来，当然。我一直相信我们的救赎就在海浪之下。事实上，我在海下比在海面上感觉更有活力。我非常乐意带你看看。

english: Excellent! I have some diving gear here that you can use. Put it on and then let me know when you're ready.
translation: 太好了！我这里有一些潜水装备你可以用。穿上它，然后准备好时告诉我。

english: Excellent! Get your diving equipment on and then let me know when you're ready.
translation: 太好了！穿上你的潜水装备，然后告诉我你准备好了。

english: Actually, I'd like to disembark.
translation: 其实，我想下船。

english: I have some diving gear here that you can use. Put it on and then let me know when you're ready.
translation: 我这里有一些潜水装备你可以用。穿上它，然后准备好时告诉我。

english: Get your diving equipment on and then let me know when you're ready.
translation: 穿上你的潜水装备，然后告诉我你准备好了。

english: Are you ready to go diving?
translation: 你准备好去潜水了吗？

english: I just need to sort something else out first.
translation: 我得先处理点别的事。

english: Shall we return to the seabed?
translation: 我们回海底去？

english: Beautiful down here, isn't it? It's sad to think that most people will never see the wonders that exist here, but hopefully they can still benefit from them all the same.
translation: 下面很美，对吧？想到大多数人永远看不到这里的奇观，真是可惜，但希望他们仍然能从中受益。

english: And right here we have one of those many wonders...
translation: 而这里就是那些奇观之一……

english: Red coral?
translation: 红珊瑚？

english: The stuff of dreams... Quite literally. We're at the point now where my whole company is built on this stuff, though truth be told, I don't consider it anywhere near as big of a wonder as others do.
translation: 梦中的神秘物质……字面意思。现在我们整个公司都建立在这种神秘物质上，不过说实话，我并不认为它像其他人认为的那样是个奇迹。

english: The mages claim this stuff grants them dreams of the future. We've been supplying it to them for years, but despite that, all their dreams remain nothing more than that.
translation: 法师们声称这东西能让他们梦见未来。我们多年来一直向他们供应，但尽管如此，他们的梦想终究只是梦想。

english: I'm not here to be a mere dreamer. I'm here to turn dreams into reality.
translation: 我来这里可不是为了做个单纯的梦想家。我是来把梦想变成现实的。

english: But not with red coral?
translation: 但不是用红珊瑚？

english: I find wealth to often be so distracting, and yet it is a sad necessity. Most simply hoard it, but for those of us lucky enough to find success, I believe it is our duty to use that wealth for good.
translation: 我发现财富往往很分散注意力，但它又是一种可悲的必需品。大多数人只是囤积它，但对于我们这些有幸成功的人来说，我认为用财富行善是我们的责任。

english: Red coral is lucrative... Very lucrative. I need the money it makes to continue my work in other areas. Ironically, without red coral, my dreams will never come true.
translation: 红珊瑚利润丰厚……非常丰厚。我需要用它赚来的钱来继续我在其他领域的工作。讽刺的是，没有红珊瑚，我的梦想就永远无法实现。

english: And that's why I'm here? To help realise your dreams?
translation: 这就是我来这里的原因？帮你实现梦想？

english: I have a complicated issue that must be solved. It may be that you are the one capable of doing so.
translation: 我有一个复杂的问题需要解决。也许你就是那个能解决的人。

english: If money is all you care for, then rest assured you will be paid handsomely. However, my hope for you, as with everyone I work with, is that you will also share in my dream as well.
translation: 如果你只在乎钱，那放心，你会得到丰厚的报酬。不过，我对你的期望，就像对我共事的每个人一样，是希望你能分享我的梦想。

english: I'm open to that, given time.
translation: 给我点时间，我愿意接受。

english: Wonderful! Sadly, the same can't be said for the sea life here. They are rather insistant on damaging these dredgers.
translation: 太好了！可惜这里的海洋生物就没这么好了。它们老是执意要破坏这些挖掘机。

english: We will discuss the nitty-gritty of the work I have for you later. First, let's get these fixed. I'll get this one sorted and then deal with the one to the east. Do you mind fixing the northern one?
translation: 我们稍后再讨论工作的细节。首先，先把这些修好。我来搞定这台，然后处理东边那台。你介意修理北边那台吗？

english: Have you sorted that dredger out yet?
translation: 你修好那台挖掘机了吗？

english: That dredger is all sorted now.
translation: 那台挖掘机已经修好了。

english: Excellent! I'll just get this one finished, and then we can head back to the surface...
translation: 太好了！我把这台弄完，然后我们就可以回水面了……

english: Right, let's get down to brass tacks shall we?
translation: 好了，我们直接谈正事吧，好吗？

english: The job?
translation: 工作？

english: The job. It's a delicate situation, and I must admit it has already led to some regrettable circumstances. However, this work is essential.
translation: 工作。情况很微妙，我必须承认，这已经导致了一些令人遗憾的局面。不过，这项工作至关重要。

english: The Red Reef isn't as red as the name suggests. Despite our best attempts, we've reached a point where it can no longer supply the amount of red coral we need. A new source is needed.
translation: 红礁岛并不像名字那么红。尽管我们尽了最大努力，但它已经无法再供应我们所需的红珊瑚数量了。我们需要新的来源。

english: And you want me to find this source?
translation: 你想让我找到这个来源？

english: No need! We already have one. After some extensive searches, we found a large reef in the Pearl Bank that should nicely suit our purposes. Our issue instead revolves around the inhabitants of that area...
translation: 不用了！我们已经有一个了。经过广泛搜索，我们在珍珠滩发现了一个大珊瑚礁，应该很适合我们的目的。我们的问题反而出在那个区域的居民身上……

english: How familiar are you with tortugans?
translation: 你对龟加人了解多少？

english: I'm aware of them.
translation: 我知道他们。

english: A remarkable race, but they are sadly very stubborn and stuck in their ways. There is an island in the Pearl Bank of great importance to them. They'd never allow an operation like ours so close to it.
translation: 一个非凡的种族，但遗憾的是他们非常固执，墨守成规。珍珠滩上有一个对他们非常重要的岛屿。他们绝不会允许我们这样的行动离它这么近。

english: Our attempts to remove them from the island haven't produced results so far. My hope is that you will have better luck. I'd like you to come up with a plan for removing the tortugans from the area.
translation: 我们试图把他们从岛上赶走，但至今没有结果。我希望你的运气会更好。我希望你想出一个计划，把龟加人从那个区域赶走。

english: If possible, I would appreciate it if you could minimise bloodshed, but make no mistake, nothing can be off the table. The Pearl Bank must be acquired for the company. There can be no compromises.
translation: 如果可能的话，我希望你能尽量减少流血，但别搞错了，没有什么是不可能的。珍珠滩必须为公司所得。没有妥协的余地。

english: I understand. I will get to work at once.
translation: 我明白了。我马上去办。

english: Wonderful! Report to me at Red Rock once you have something. Until then, I wish you good luck.
translation: 太好了！一旦有进展，就到红岩岛向我报告。在那之前，祝你好运。

english: Thank you. I'd best be on my way.
translation: 谢谢。我该上路了。

english: You're back!
translation: 你回来了！

english: Did you have any luck?
translation: 有收获吗？

english: I did. You were right Floopa, the Red Reef Trading Company were responsible for the attack on the Little Pearl.
translation: 我查过了。弗卢帕，你说得对，红礁贸易公司应对袭击小珍珠号负责。

english: I don't understand. Why would these humans have a problem with us?
translation: 我不明白。这些人类为什么要找我们的麻烦？

english: They've found a reef near the island. They want to start dredging it for red coral, but they need you gone from the Little Pearl first.
translation: 他们在岛附近发现了一个礁石。他们想开始在那里挖掘红珊瑚，但需要你们先离开小珍珠岛。
