english: Red coral? Of course! Spencer talks the good talk, but all he really cares about is money. Trusting him was the biggest mistake I ever made.
translation: 红珊瑚？当然！斯宾塞说得冠冕堂皇，但他真正在乎的只有钱。信任他是我这辈子犯过最大的错误。

english: So what do we do? How can we stop him?
translation: 那我们怎么办？我们怎么阻止他？

english: We don't need to rush. I've gained Spencer's trust and he has tasked me with coming up with a plan for getting you off the Little Pearl. That means time is on our side.
translation: 我们不用着急。我已经取得了斯宾塞的信任，他让我想办法把你们从小珍珠岛赶走。这意味着时间在我们这边。

english: Ah, I see! Time for us to come up with a plan of our own. Very good, [player name]! Very good!
translation: 啊，我明白了！我们也有时间制定我们自己的计划。非常好，[player name]！非常好！

english: Then let's get planning.
translation: 那我们就开始计划吧。

english: Yes, yes, we'll start right away. Keep checking in, [player name]. We'll let you know once we've come up with something.
translation: 是的，是的，我们马上开始。随时来看看进展，[player name]。我们想出办法后会通知你的。

english: In the meantime, Floopa had a suggestion for a little way to thank you for all you've done for us.
translation: 同时，弗卢帕建议用一个小方法来感谢你为我们所做的一切。

english: Do you remember the camphor trees in the Sacred Grove? I've made some arrangements, and you now have permission to chop their wood. It's a much better place to do so than anywhere else on the island.
translation: 你还记得圣林里的樟树吗？我已经安排好了，你现在获准砍伐那里的木材。那比岛上其他地方好多了。

english: Oh, don't mention it. It's really no problem at all. You've been a good friend to us, [player name]. It means everything.
translation: 哦，别客气。真的没什么。你一直是我们很好的朋友，[player name]。这比什么都重要。

english: Yes, thank you, [player name]. I know I've been a bit... difficult in all of this, but even though I'm terrible at showing it, I really do appreciate everything you've done.
translation: 是的，谢谢你，[player name]。我知道在这件事上我有点……难相处，但尽管我不善于表达，我真的很感激你所做的一切。

english: Now, before you go I had something to give you that you might find useful.
translation: 现在，在你走之前，我有样东西要给你，你可能会觉得有用。

english: Okay, let me help then.
translation: 好吧，那我来帮忙。

english: Thank you. The problem is, there is a ghost in the church graveyard. I would like you to get rid of it.
translation: 谢谢你。问题是，教堂墓地里有个幽灵。我希望你能把它赶走。

english: If you need any help, my friend Father Urhney is an expert on ghosts.
translation: 如果你需要帮助，我的朋友乌尔尼神父是幽灵方面的专家。

english: I believe he is currently living as a hermit in Lumbridge swamp. He has a little shack in the far west of the swamps.
translation: 我相信他现在隐居在仑桥镇的沼泽里。他在沼泽最西边有个小棚屋。

english: Exit the graveyard through the south gate to reach the swamp. I'm sure if you told him that I sent you he'd be willing to help.
translation: 从南门离开墓地就能到达沼泽。我相信如果你告诉他是我派你来的，他会愿意帮忙的。

english: My name is Father Aereck by the way. Pleased to meet you.
translation: 顺便说一下，我叫艾瑞克神父。很高兴认识你。

english: Have you got rid of the ghost yet?
translation: 你把那个幽灵赶走了吗？

english: I can't find Father Urhney at the moment.
translation: 我现在找不到乌尔尼神父。

english: Well, you can get to the swamp he lives in by going south through the cemetery.
translation: 嗯，你可以穿过墓地向南走，就能到他住的沼泽了。

english: You'll have to go right into the far western depths of the swamp, near the coastline. That is where his house is.
translation: 你得一直走到沼泽最西边的深处，靠近海岸线的地方。他的房子就在那里。

english: Father Aereck sent me to talk to you.
translation: 是艾瑞克神父让我来找你谈谈的。

english: I suppose I'd better talk to you then. What problems has he got himself into this time?
translation: 我想那我得跟你谈谈了。他这次又惹上什么麻烦了？

english: He's got a ghost haunting his graveyard.
translation: 他的墓地里有个幽灵在作祟。

english: Oh, the silly fool.
translation: 哦，那个傻蛋。

english: I leave town for just five months, and ALREADY he can't manage.
translation: 我才离开镇子五个月，他就已经搞不定了。

english: (sigh)
translation: （叹气）

english: Well, I can't go back and exorcise it. I vowed not to leave this place. Until I had done a full two years of prayer and meditation.
translation: 嗯，我不能回去驱魔。我发过誓不离开这里，直到我完成整整两年的祈祷和冥想。

english: Tell you what I can do though; take this amulet.
translation: 不过我可以告诉你我能做什么；拿着这个护身符。

english: It is an Amulet of Ghostspeak.
translation: 这是一个幽灵低语护身符。

english: So called, because when you wear it you can speak to ghosts. A lot of ghosts are doomed to be ghosts because they have left some important task uncompleted.
translation: 之所以这么叫，是因为当你戴上它时，就能和幽灵说话。很多幽灵之所以注定是幽灵，是因为它们有某些重要的任务没有完成。

english: Maybe if you know what this task is, you can get rid of the ghost. I'm not making any guarantees mind you, but it is the best I can do right now.
translation: 也许如果你知道这个任务是什么，就能把幽灵赶走。我可不敢保证，但这是我目前能想到的最好办法了。

english: Thank you. I'll give it a try!
translation: 谢谢你。我会试试看的！

english: You mean he gets himself into lots of problems?
translation: 你是说他经常惹麻烦？

english: Yeah. For example, when we were trainee priests he kept on getting stuck up bell ropes.
translation: 是啊。比如说，我们当见习祭司的时候，他老是卡在钟绳上。

english: Anyway. I don't have time for chitchat. What's his problem THIS time?
translation: 总之，我没时间闲聊。他这次又有什么问题？

english: I had a talk with Father Urhney. He has given me this funny amulet to talk to the ghost with.
translation: 我和乌尔尼神父谈过了。他给了我这个有趣的护身符，用来和幽灵说话。

english: I always wondered what that amulet was... Well, I hope it's useful. Tell me when you get rid of the ghost!
translation: 我一直好奇那个护身符是干什么的……好吧，希望它有用。等你把幽灵赶走了告诉我一声！

english: Hello ghost, how are you?
translation: 你好啊幽灵，你怎么样？

english: Ooh, THAT'S interesting.
translation: 哦，这倒挺有意思。

english: Did he really?
translation: 他真的那么做了？

english: Woo.
translation: 呜。

english: My brother had EXACTLY the same problem.
translation: 我兄弟也遇到过一模一样的问题。

english: Woo Wooooo!
translation: 呜 呜呜呜！

english: Wooooo Woo woo woo!
translation: 呜呜呜 呜 呜呜 呜呜！

english: You'll have to give me the recipe some time...
translation: 你改天得把食谱给我……

english: Wooooooo woo woooooooo.
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜 呜 呜呜呜呜呜。

english: Hmm... I'm not so sure about that.
translation: 嗯……这个我不太确定。

english: Wooo woo?
translation: 呜呜 呜？

english: Well, if you INSIST.
translation: 好吧，如果你坚持的话。

english: Wooooooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜！

english: Ah well, better be off now...
translation: 啊，好吧，我得走了……

english: Yeah, that's what I thought.
translation: 是啊，我也这么想。

english: Wooo woooooooooooooo...
translation: 呜 呜呜呜呜呜呜呜……

english: Goodbye. Thanks for the chat.
translation: 再见。谢谢你的聊天。

english: Wooo wooo?
translation: 呜 呜呜？

english: Any hints where I can find some treasure?
translation: 有什么线索能让我找到宝藏吗？

english: Thank you. You've been very helpful.
translation: 谢谢你。你帮了大忙。

english: Wooooooo.
translation: 呜呜呜呜。

english: Not very good actually.
translation: 其实不太好。

english: Did you just understand what I said???
translation: 你刚才听懂我说的话了？？？

english: Yep, now tell me what the problem is.
translation: 没错，现在告诉我问题出在哪。

english: WOW! This is INCREDIBLE! I didn't expect anyone to ever understand me again!
translation: 哇！这太不可思议了！我没想到还会有人能听懂我说话！

english: Ok, Ok, I can understand you!
translation: 好了，好了，我能听懂你说话！

english: But have you any idea WHY you're doomed to be a ghost?
translation: 但你知道自己为什么注定是个幽灵吗？

english: Well, to be honest... I'm not sure.
translation: 嗯，说实话……我不太确定。

english: I've been told a certain task may need to be completed so you can rest in peace.
translation: 我听说可能需要完成某个任务，你才能安息。

english: I should think it is probably because a warlock has come along and stolen my skull. If you look inside my coffin there, you'll find my corpse without a head on it.
translation: 我想大概是因为有个巫师过来偷走了我的头骨。你看看我的棺材里面，会发现我的尸体没有头。

english: Do you know where this warlock might be now?
translation: 你知道那个巫师现在可能在哪儿吗？

english: I think it was one of the warlocks who lives in the big tower by the sea south-west from here.
translation: 我想是住在西南边海边那座大塔里的某个巫师干的。

english: Ok. I will try and get the skull back for you, then you can rest in peace.
translation: 好的。我会试着帮你把头骨拿回来，这样你就能安息了。

english: Ooh, thank you. That would be such a great relief!
translation: 哦，谢谢你。那真是太好了！

english: It is so dull being a ghost...
translation: 当幽灵太无聊了……

english: No, you sound like you're speaking nonsense to me.
translation: 不，你听起来像是在胡说八道。

english: Oh that's a pity. You got my hopes up there.
translation: 哦，真可惜。你刚才让我白高兴一场。

english: Yeah, it is a pity. Sorry about that.
translation: 是啊，真可惜。抱歉了。

english: Hang on a second... you CAN understand me!
translation: 等一下……你其实能听懂我说话！

english: No I can't.
translation: 不，我听不懂。

english: Great. The first person I can speak to in ages...and they're a moron.
translation: 太好了。这么久以来第一个能和我说话的人……结果是个白痴。

english: Yep, clever aren't I?
translation: 是啊，我很聪明吧？

english: I'm impressed. You must be very powerful. I don't suppose you can stop me being a ghost?
translation: 真让我印象深刻。你一定很厉害。我想你没办法让我不再当幽灵吧？

english: Yes, ok. Do you know WHY you're a ghost?
translation: 好的，可以。你知道自己为什么是幽灵吗？

english: Nope. I just know I can't do much of anything like this!
translation: 不知道。我只知道这样下去我什么都做不了！

english: No, you're scary!
translation: 不，你很吓人！

english: The first person I can speak to in ages...
translation: 这么久以来第一个能和我说话的人……

english: ..and they're an idiot.
translation: ……结果是个傻瓜。

english: Wow, this amulet works!
translation: 哇，这个护身符真管用！

english: Oh! It's your amulet that's doing it! I did wonder. I don't suppose you can help me? I don't like being a ghost.
translation: 哦！是你的护身符在起作用！我还在纳闷呢。我想你帮不了我吧？我不喜欢当幽灵。

english: How are you doing finding my skull?
translation: 你找我的头骨找得怎么样了？

english: Sorry, I can't find it at the moment.
translation: 抱歉，我现在找不到。

english: Ah well. Keep on looking.
translation: 啊，好吧。继续找吧。

english: I'm pretty sure it's somewhere in the tower south-west from here. There's a lot of levels to the tower, though. I suppose it might take a little while to find.
translation: 我很确定它就在西南边那座塔里的某个地方。不过那座塔有很多层。我想可能需要花点时间才能找到。

english: I've found out that the ghost's corpse has lost its skull. If I can find the skull, the ghost should leave.
translation: 我发现那个幽灵的尸体丢了头骨。如果我能找到头骨，幽灵应该就会离开。

english: That WOULD explain it.
translation: 那倒说得通了。

english: Hmmmmm. Well, I haven't seen any skulls.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我没见过什么头骨。

english: Yes, I think a warlock has stolen it.
translation: 是的，我想是一个巫师偷走了它。

english: I hate warlocks.
translation: 我讨厌巫师。

english: Ah well, good luck!
translation: 啊，好吧，祝你好运！

english: I've finally found the ghost's skull!
translation: 我终于找到了幽灵头骨！

english: Great! Put it in the ghost's coffin and see what happens!
translation: 太好了！把它放进幽灵的棺材里，看看会发生什么！

english: I have found it!
translation: 我找到了！

english: Hurrah! Now I can stop being a ghost! You just need to put it in my coffin there, then I'll be free!
translation: 好哇！这样我就不用再当幽灵了！你只需要把它放进我的棺材里，我就自由了！

english: If you just put it in my coffin that should do the trick...
translation: 你只要把它放进我的棺材里，应该就行了……

english: Release! Thank you stranger..
translation: 解脱了！谢谢你，陌生人……

english: Hurrah! Now I can stop being a ghost! You just need to put it in my coffin there, and I will be free!
translation: 好哇！现在我不用再做幽灵了！你只需要把它放进我的棺材里，我就会解脱了！

english: ..and they're a moron.
translation: ..而且他们是个白痴。

english: Woo Woooo WOOO!
translation: 呜~呜呜~呜！

english: Hurah! Now I can stop being a ghost! You just need to put it on my coffin there, and I will be free!
translation: 好哇！现在我不用再做幽灵了！你只需要把它放在我的棺材上，我就会解脱了！

english: Wooooooo woo! Wooooo woo wooooo woowoowoo wooo Woo woooo. Wooooo woo woo? Wooooooooooooooooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜！呜呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜 呜喔呜喔 呜 呜 呜呜。呜呜呜 呜呜 呜？呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！

english: Woo woooo. Woooooooooooooooooo!
translation: 呜 呜呜。呜呜呜呜呜呜呜！

english: Ah, I see. So you're going to play dumb are you? Well, be gone! I won't fall for your lies!
translation: 啊，我明白了。所以你打算装傻是吧？哼，走开！我不会上你的当！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hey! I didn't say you could touch my farming patch, did I?
translation: 嘿！我没说你可以碰我的种植地，对吧？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: You didn't go near those frogs yet, did you?
translation: 你还没靠近那些青蛙吧？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I can tell. If you had, you'd be dead!
translation: 我看得出来。要是你靠近了，你早就死了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Okay then... Well assuming that I survive, I'll be back shortly to let you know what I've found.
translation: 好吧……假设我能活下来，我很快就会回来告诉你我发现了什么。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hang on... You can talk?
translation: 等等……你会说话？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well of course we can talk, silly. Why wouldn't we be able to?
translation: 我们当然会说话啦，傻瓜。为什么不会呢？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well I guess I'd just never considered it before...
translation: 嗯，我想我以前从没考虑过这个问题……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: We live in a world where giant lizards with wings fly around and expel highly combustible fluids from their throats, but you never considered a frog could talk?
translation: 我们活在一个有翅膀的巨型蜥蜴飞来飞去、从喉咙里喷出高度易燃液体的世界里，但你却从没想过青蛙会说话？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well when you put it like that...
translation: 嗯，你这么一说……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well now that we've established our remarkable linguistic capabilities, how about some introductions. I'm Sue and this is Gary. Over there you have Dave and Jane, and good old Mr Lonesome over there is Cuthbert.
translation: 既然我们已经确认了彼此卓越的语言能力，不如来做个自我介绍吧。我是苏，这是加里。那边是戴夫和简，而那边那位孤独的老兄是卡斯伯特。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well, [player name], what can we do for you?
translation: 那么，[player name]，我们能为你做些什么？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well there's a guy over there that thinks you're all evil.
translation: 嗯，那边有个人觉得你们都是邪恶的。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Evil? We're not evil! We're just on strike.
translation: 邪恶？我们才不邪恶！我们只是在罢工。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: We're on strike. Fair work requires fair treatment, and we've had enough of his nonsense.
translation: 我们在罢工。公平的工作需要公平的待遇，我们受够了他的胡言乱语。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: But... What do you do? What are you striking from?
translation: 但是……你们做什么工作？你们在罢工什么？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh... Well I can't really remember. It's been so long that I've gone and totally forgotten. Hey, Gary, why are we on strike?
translation: 哦……嗯，我真的记不太清了。时间太久了，我完全忘了。嘿，加里，我们为什么罢工来着？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: No idea. I've been on strike my whole life, just like my pa, and his pa before him. At this point it's kind of a family tradition.
translation: 不知道。我这辈子都在罢工，就像我爸，还有他爸一样。到现在这已经算是家族传统了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I know it's because of him though. That monster spends every day mistreating us. If he ever wants to see any work from us, he needs to start showing some basic respect.
translation: 但我知道是因为他。那个怪物每天都虐待我们。如果他想要我们干活，就得先表现出基本的尊重。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Too right, Gary, too right. What reason does he have for thinking we're evil anyway?
translation: 说得太对了，加里，太对了。他凭什么觉得我们是邪恶的？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well he's one of them capitalists, isn't he. They see a worker demanding fair rights and they go loopy. Can't have anything getting in the way of their profit margins!
translation: 哼，他不就是个资本家嘛。他们看到工人要求公平权利就发疯。不能有任何东西妨碍他们的利润空间！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Actually, he never mentioned anything about work. He seems to think you're out to overthrow humanity.
translation: 其实，他从没提过工作的事。他似乎觉得你们要推翻人类。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Overthrow humanity? What a load of nonsense! We love humans! Gary here had one as a pet once.
translation: 推翻人类？真是胡说八道！我们爱人类！加里以前还养过一个人当宠物呢。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Ah, those were the days. I always loved my Sentia. Such a shame about the accident...
translation: 啊，那些日子真美好。我一直很爱我的森蒂亚。那场意外真是太可惜了……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It wasn't your fault, Gary. It wasn't your fault. Anyway, if this chap thinks we're plotting to overthrow humanity, what's he planning to do about it?
translation: 那不是你的错，加里。不是你的错。总之，如果这家伙觉得我们在密谋推翻人类，他打算怎么做？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I'm not too sure. He did mention at one point something about killing you all...
translation: 我不太确定。他之前好像提过要杀光你们……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: He wants to what?!
translation: 他想干什么？！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: He wants to kill us?! Well now I think we should overthrow humanity!
translation: 他想杀了我们？！哼，那我现在觉得我们应该推翻人类了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Wait... No...
translation: 等等……别……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yeah, we've been treated like second class citizens for too long. The revolution starts today!
translation: 没错，我们被当成二等公民太久了。革命从今天开始！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Wait! How about peace?
translation: 等等！和平怎么样？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Peace? Interesting... I suppose peace could be fun. There would need to be some assurances though. Wouldn't want the guy going back on his word.
translation: 和平？有意思……我想和平也不错。但需要一些保证。可不想让那家伙出尔反尔。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Right... Well how about I go and ask him what conditions he'd be willing to accept.
translation: 好吧……那我去问问他愿意接受什么条件。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well that just sounds swell!
translation: 听起来棒极了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Okay, I'll be back shortly.
translation: 好的，我很快就回来。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hello again! Have you found out what peace conditions the grumpy guts has?
translation: 又见面了！你问出那个坏脾气的家伙的和平条件了吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well don't go taking too long.
translation: 可别拖太久。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I hear you're the one handling the peace talks. You will fail. There is no peace to be had with that man.
translation: 我听说你是负责和平谈判的人。你会失败的。和那个人不可能有和平。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well I'd still like to give it a good go.
translation: 嗯，我还是想好好试试。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hello there! You're the one sorting out the peace talks, right?
translation: 你好！你是负责和平谈判的人，对吧？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: The frogs didn't kill you? This is unexpected.
translation: 那些青蛙没杀了你？真没想到。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well I had a chat with them, and they're open to engaging in some peace talks.
translation: 我和他们聊了聊，他们愿意进行一些和平谈判。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Peace? The hypocrisy! After everything they've done they think peace is an option? Absolutely not!
translation: 和平？真是虚伪！他们做了那些事之后，还觉得和平是个选项？绝对不行！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Okay... But what exactly have they done that means peace isn't an option?
translation: 好吧……但他们到底做了什么，让和平变得不可能？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh... well...
translation: 哦……这个……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well, you know...
translation: 嗯，你知道的……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: They just...
translation: 他们就是……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Look, I can't remember. But they must have done something!
translation: 听着，我记不起来了。但他们肯定做过什么！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Tetamo! I know! My brain!
translation: 特塔莫！我知道了！我的大脑！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yes I'm starting to think that's where the problem lies as well.
translation: 是啊，我也开始觉得问题出在这里了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: They must have taken my brain! That's why I can't remember! You tell them I want my brain back!
translation: 他们一定拿走了我的大脑！所以我才会记不起来！你告诉他们，我要拿回我的大脑！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: So you'd be willing to negotiate peace in exchange for your... brain?
translation: 所以你愿意用你的……大脑来换取和平谈判？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Negotiate? I don't negotiate with monsters!
translation: 谈判？我不和怪物谈判！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I don't think they're monsters. They actually seem somewhat friendly.
translation: 我不觉得他们是怪物。他们看起来还挺友好的。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well do they have a leader?
translation: 那他们有首领吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well you go tell them that I'll only negotiate with their leader.
translation: 那你去告诉他们，我只和他们的首领谈判。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Every day I find myself further questioning my life choices. Fine. I'll go and ask them about their leader.
translation: 我每天都在进一步质疑自己的人生选择。好吧。我去问问他们首领的事。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I'm only going to negotiate with the leader of those monsters. You go tell them that!
translation: 我只和那些怪物的首领谈判。你去告诉他们！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yup, I'm sorting it.
translation: 是的，我正在处理。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Sort of. He seems open to the idea of peace talks, but he will only negotiate with your leader. Do you have a leader?
translation: 算是吧。他似乎对和平谈判持开放态度，但他只和你们的首领谈。你们有首领吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh, well not really.
translation: 哦，其实没有。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Nah, we're more about collective leadership. We did consider starting a union at one point, but Dave messed up the paperwork.
translation: 不，我们更倾向于集体领导。我们曾经考虑过成立工会，但戴夫把文件搞砸了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well would you be interested in having a leader?
translation: 那你们有兴趣选一个首领吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: A change to our political structure? That's quite the thing to undergo.
translation: 改变我们的政治结构？这可是件大事。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yeah, especially in times of war. Still, maybe we need to mix things up. We've been saying for a while now that we've been stagnating. Perhaps this is just the thing we need.
translation: 是啊，尤其是在战争时期。不过，也许我们需要改变一下。我们一直说自己在停滞不前。也许这正是我们需要的。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: There would need to be an election of course.
translation: 当然需要举行选举。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Do you have a process for that sort of thing?
translation: 你们有这方面的流程吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Absolutely! We use a first past the post system where everyone votes based on a candidate's hopping capabilities.
translation: 当然！我们采用简单多数制，每个人根据候选人的跳跃能力投票。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh it's all very simple. The candidates perform their finest hop and everyone else votes on which they thought was best. The one with the most votes wins!
translation: 哦，很简单。候选人展示他们最棒的跳跃，其他人投票选出他们认为最好的。得票最多的人获胜！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I see. Well, I don't, but for the sake of my sanity, let's say I do. Shall we call an election then?
translation: 我明白了。好吧，其实我不明白，但为了我的理智，就当我明白吧。那我们举行选举吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Sounds like a wonderful idea! There is just the small matter of Cuthbert...
translation: 听起来是个好主意！只是卡斯伯特有点小问题……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Cuthbert?
translation: 卡斯伯特？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: That's right. You see, while you were gone, we told the others about this whole killing us all business. Now, I must admit, emotions did run a bit high, especially for Cuthbert.
translation: 没错。你看，你不在的时候，我们告诉了其他人关于要杀光我们的事。我得承认，大家的情绪有点激动，尤其是卡斯伯特。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Once he learns about the election, he will almost definitely want to put himself forward, and I'm afraid he has little interest in peace.
translation: 一旦他得知选举的事，他几乎肯定会想参选，而且恐怕他对和平没什么兴趣。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I mean, can you blame the guy? Cuthbert was once the leader of the Frogs for Humanity society. The guy loved humans, but after what they did to his favourite plant...
translation: 我是说，你能怪他吗？卡斯伯特曾经是“青蛙爱人类”社团的首领。他热爱人类，但他们对他的最爱植物做的事……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Some wounds never heal...
translation: 有些伤口永远无法愈合……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: So you're saying Cuthbert can't win the election?
translation: 所以你是说卡斯伯特不能赢得选举？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: The idea of rigging an election is one that fills my democracy-loving heart with terror, but yes, we will need to do that.
translation: 操纵选举的想法让我这个热爱民主的心充满恐惧，但没错，我们需要这么做。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It's okay if we're the ones to do it, right?
translation: 如果是我们自己来做，就没问题，对吧？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Not in the slightest, but I do love that positive attitude. Besides, the alternative is all-out war with humanity.
translation: 完全不是，但我喜欢这种积极的态度。再说，否则就是与人类全面开战。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Which we very much need to avoid! So how do we ensure Cuthbert can't win the election?
translation: 我们必须避免这种情况！那我们怎么确保卡斯伯特不能赢得选举？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: The hop-off will see the candidates hop from the shore to a lily pad. Now, if Cuthbert's lily pad had an unfortunate hole in it...
translation: 跳跃比赛上，候选人会从岸边跳到睡莲叶上。如果卡斯伯特的睡莲叶上有个不幸的洞……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Okay... I guess I'm off to sabotage a lily pad.
translation: 好吧……看来我得去破坏一个睡莲叶了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Just be careful of Dave and Jane. They're sticklers for the rules, I'm afraid. You can't let them see you.
translation: 小心戴夫和简。他们很死板，恐怕不能让他们看见你。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hello again! How are things going with that lily pad sabotage?
translation: 又见面了！睡莲叶破坏得怎么样了？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It seems we are to have an election. Know that once I win, our war with humanity will be unlike anything ever seen.
translation: 看来我们要举行选举了。要知道，一旦我赢了，我们与人类的战争将是前所未有的。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: You should go. Go and be with your loved ones. Hold them close while you can. Soon you will never have that luxury again.
translation: 你应该走了。去和你的亲人在一起。趁现在还能紧紧拥抱他们。很快你就再也没有这种奢侈了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hey, don't be going near those lily pads. We've got them all set up ready for the hop-off.
translation: 嘿，别靠近那些睡莲叶。我们都布置好了，准备进行跳跃比赛。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hello there! Have you heard about the election? Isn't it thrilling?
translation: 你好！你听说选举的事了吗？是不是很激动？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: That is definitely a word that could be used to describe this situation. Anyway, speaking of the election, I need to inspect the lily pads.
translation: 这个词确实可以用来形容这种情况。总之，说到选举，我需要检查一下睡莲叶。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: No can do. We've got them all set up nicely. Can't be letting anyone mess things up, can we?
translation: 不行。我们都布置好了。不能让人搞砸，对吧？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Of course not, but don't you think it would be wise for a third party just to give them a quick once over? Besides, the two of you deserve a break.
translation: 当然不能，但你不觉得让第三方快速检查一下是明智之举吗？再说，你们俩也该休息一下。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well I really could do with a bit of a rest, not to mention the fact that I'm starving. Still, the lily pads are our duty. It would be wrong of us to let someone else touch them.
translation: 嗯，我真的很想休息一下，更别说我还饿得要命。不过，睡莲叶是我们的职责。让别人碰它们是不对的。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hmm... You said you were hungry? Out of interest, what would you fancy? For when the election is out of the way, of course.
translation: 嗯……你说你饿了？好奇问一下，你想吃什么？当然是等选举结束后。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh I'd kill for a nice tasty orange!
translation: 哦，我好想吃一个美味的橙子！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: An orange? I didn't know frogs ate oranges...
translation: 橙子？我不知道青蛙吃橙子……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yeah most people think we just eat flies. We do, and we love them, but sometimes you find that you've just had enough flies and fancy something more exotic.
translation: 是啊，大多数人以为我们只吃苍蝇。我们确实吃，也很喜欢，但有时候你会发现吃够了苍蝇，想吃点更特别的东西。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Where do you get your oranges?
translation: 你们从哪里弄到橙子？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: They grow on trees around here, like this one right next to us. From time to time an orange will fall off, but the really good ones are the ones at the top.
translation: 它们长在附近的树上，比如我们旁边这棵。时不时会有橙子掉下来，但真正好的都在树顶。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Just a shame we can't reach those ones...
translation: 可惜我们够不到那些……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Remind me, where do you get your oranges?
translation: 提醒我一下，你的橙子是从哪里来的？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Look! Oranges!
translation: 看！橙子！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Can't stop to talk! There's oranges to be had!
translation: 没空聊天！有橙子等着我呢！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It's all sorted.
translation: 都搞定了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: And just in time as well. The hop-off is about to begin.
translation: 而且时间刚刚好。青蛙跳跃大赛就要开始了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: So who's Cuthbert's competition?
translation: 那么卡斯伯特的对手是谁？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Sue of course!
translation: 当然是苏了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Don't worry. Once I win, I'll make sure these peace talks go nice and smoothly.
translation: 别担心。等我赢了，我会确保这些和平谈判顺利进行。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Welcome, one and all, to what is bound to be a thrilling frog hop-off! The stakes are high for this one, and indeed the future of our entire world may well be at stake.
translation: 欢迎各位，来到这场注定激动人心的青蛙跳跃大赛！这次比赛赌注很高，我们整个世界的未来可能都危在旦夕。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Our first contender for today is Sue! Let's see what she's got!
translation: 今天的第一位参赛者是苏！让我们看看她的表现！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: What a corker of a hop! Excellent work!
translation: 多么精彩的一跳！干得漂亮！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Next up, we have Cuthbert!
translation: 接下来，我们有请卡斯伯特！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well, he's dead!
translation: 呃，他死了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I'm sorry, what?!
translation: 抱歉，你说什么？！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yeah, totally slipped my mind, but he never learnt how to swim!
translation: 是啊，我完全忘了，他从来没学过游泳！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: A frog that never learnt to swim? Are you serious right now?!
translation: 一只从来没学过游泳的青蛙？你是认真的吗？！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Afraid so! Cuthbert is now as dead as an Old One. With only one contender left standing, I can now announce that Sue is the winner!
translation: 恐怕是的！卡斯伯特现在死得透透的了。既然只剩一位参赛者，我现在宣布苏获胜！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well now that's all sorted, we can get these peace talks underway!
translation: 好了，既然事情都解决了，我们可以开始和平谈判了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I can't believe we killed him...
translation: 我不敢相信我们害死了他……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Ah, don't worry yourself. Something like this was bound to happen at some point. It's his fault really. Imagine never learning to swim!
translation: 啊，别自责了。这种事迟早都会发生的。其实是他自己的错。想想看，居然从来不学游泳！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Exactly! So what does our foe want?
translation: 就是！那么我们的敌人想要什么？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: He thinks you've stolen his brain and would like it back.
translation: 他觉得你偷了他的大脑，想要回去。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: His brain? But we don't have his brain...
translation: 他的大脑？但我们没有他的大脑啊……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well is there anything else you can offer him?
translation: 那你能给他别的什么吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh... Er... Not really.
translation: 哦……呃……好像没有。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: There must be something.
translation: 总得有点什么吧。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It's not like we really do much. We're frogs. All we do is eat flies, along with the odd orange.
translation: 我们其实也没做什么。我们是青蛙。我们只吃苍蝇，偶尔吃点橙子。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well maybe we can still work with that. I'm sure our friend doesn't like flies. Maybe you could deal with the flies around here for him?
translation: 也许我们可以从这点入手。我敢肯定我们的朋友不喜欢苍蝇。也许你可以帮他处理掉这附近的苍蝇？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Sounds like a job for us! Though we'd of course need something in return.
translation: 这活儿我们接！不过我们当然需要一些回报。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Fair pay for fair work, of course. If not, we'll go on strike! We're good at going on strike.
translation: 公平工作，公平报酬，当然。不然我们就罢工！我们很擅长罢工。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: And how would you like to be paid?
translation: 那你们想要什么报酬？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well normally I'd say in flies, but it seems we've got that covered.
translation: 通常我会说用苍蝇付，但看来我们正好要处理苍蝇。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oranges?
translation: 橙子？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oranges! Perfect!
translation: 橙子！完美！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh, and orange juice as well! Straight from the tap!
translation: 哦，还有橙汁！直接从水龙头里出来的！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: From the tap? But orange juice doesn't...
translation: 从水龙头里？但橙汁不会……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Actually, never mind. Let's not complicate things further. I'll take these terms to him and see what he says.
translation: 算了，别把事情搞得更复杂了。我把这些条件带给他，看看他怎么说。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hello! How go the peace talks?
translation: 你好！和平谈判怎么样了？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Remember, we kill flies, we get oranges. That's the deal.
translation: 记住，我们杀苍蝇，我们拿橙子。这就是交易。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Can you believe Cuthbert died? Such a shame.
translation: 你能相信卡斯伯特死了吗？真是太可惜了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Sue will be a great leader though. I can't wait to see what she does first!
translation: 不过苏会是个好领袖。我等不及看她要做的第一件事了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Have you found the leader of those frogs? I'm only going to negotiate with the leader!
translation: 你找到那些青蛙的首领了吗？我只和首领谈判！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yes, the frogs have selected a leader and she has sent me with her terms.
translation: 是的，青蛙们选出了首领，她派我来传达她的条件。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well what are they?
translation: 那条件是什么？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: The frogs will kill the flies around the oasis and in return they'd like you to pay them in oranges.
translation: 青蛙们会消灭绿洲周围的苍蝇，作为回报，他们希望你用橙子支付。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Flies? But what have the flies done wrong?
translation: 苍蝇？但苍蝇做错了什么？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well don't they spread disease and eat your food?
translation: 它们不是会传播疾病、偷吃你的食物吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yes, but so did my brother, and I never wanted him dead. What else have the flies been doing?
translation: 是啊，但我兄弟也这样，我可从没想过要他死。苍蝇还做了什么？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I don't know! You seemed convinced the frogs were out to get you before, maybe the flies are as well!
translation: 我不知道！你之前不是坚信青蛙们要对付你吗，也许苍蝇也是！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: The flies are out to get me? Is it really true?
translation: 苍蝇要对付我？这是真的吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: You know what, sure. The flies want you dead and they plan to do it tonight.
translation: 好吧，没错。苍蝇想让你死，而且计划今晚动手。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: The monsters!
translation: 这些怪物！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: So are you willing to make this deal with the frogs?
translation: 那你愿意和青蛙们做这笔交易吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Not yet. First I must see proof of this horrific betrayal by the flies. Find this proof for me, and I will agree to the deal.
translation: 还不行。首先我得看到苍蝇这种可怕背叛的证据。帮我找到证据，我就同意这笔交易。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Maybe my whole life is just one big nightmare. Fine, I'll find this proof.
translation: 也许我整个人生就是一场巨大的梦魇。好吧，我会找到这个证据的。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: You're back. Do you have the proof?
translation: 你回来了。有证据吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Then return to me once you have it.
translation: 那就拿到证据后再回来找我。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: He's open to the proposals, but he wants proof that the flies are against him.
translation: 他对提议持开放态度，但他想要苍蝇反对他的证据。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: He doesn't half complain, does he? Maybe it would have just been easier to kill him...
translation: 他可真能抱怨，是吧？也许直接杀了他还更省事……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: How about you steal a prized possession of his and plant it on the flies.
translation: 不如你去偷他一件心爱之物，然后栽赃给苍蝇。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh good, now we're adding theft to today's crimes.
translation: 哦，好啊，现在我们的罪行清单上又要加上盗窃了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well it could be worse. It could be murder!
translation: 总比更糟的好。总比谋杀好！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: We already committed murder.
translation: 我们已经犯下谋杀了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Nah, that wasn't murder! Manslaughter at best! Or would that be frogslaughter...
translation: 不，那不是谋杀！顶多是过失杀人！或者应该叫过失杀蛙……
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It had to be done. Now, why don't you go and find something to steal.
translation: 那是不得已而为之。现在，你去找点东西偷吧。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hello! Did you find something to steal?
translation: 你好！找到可以偷的东西了吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Keep looking. I'm sure you'll find something suitable.
translation: 继续找。我相信你会找到合适的东西。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Yes, I have a plushy here of his.
translation: 是的，我这里有一个他的毛绒玩具。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Perfect! Shove it in that big pile of dung the flies keep gathering around and then go and let him know.
translation: 完美！把它塞进苍蝇们经常聚集的那堆大粪便里，然后去告诉他。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Poo! How wonderful!
translation: 便便！太棒了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: You! Prepare to face the Lord of Dread!
translation: 你！准备面对恐惧之主吧！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I have come for you, [player name].
translation: 我是来找你的，[player name]。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Hello! How goes the planting of evidence?
translation: 你好！栽赃进行得怎么样了？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It's all done, but I do now have a little problem to deal with. I'll be back.
translation: 都搞定了，但我现在有个小麻烦要处理。我马上回来。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well what are you waiting for? Time to go and let him know!
translation: 那你还等什么？是时候去告诉他了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I think I do. You see that big pile of dung the flies are gathered around? I'm sure I saw something belonging to you in it.
translation: 我想我知道。你看到苍蝇聚集的那堆大粪便了吗？我肯定在里面看到了属于你的东西。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: It cannot be?! Wait here! I must check at once!
translation: 不可能？！在这里等着！我必须马上去看看！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I see my worst fears have come to pass. This is dark day not just for me, but for all of humanity.
translation: 我看到我最担心的事还是发生了。这不仅是我个人的黑暗之日，也是全人类的黑暗之日。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Return to the frogs. Tell them we have a deal.
translation: 回到青蛙那里去。告诉他们，我们成交了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Leave me. I need time to contemplate this great loss. Return to the frogs. Tell them we have a deal.
translation: 让我一个人待着。我需要时间思考这巨大的损失。回到青蛙那里去。告诉他们，我们成交了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I hear the peace talks are going well. We might be close to ending the conflict with that nasty human.
translation: 我听说和平谈判进展顺利。我们可能很快就能结束与那个讨厌人类的冲突了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I do hope so. This war is starting to take a toll on all of us. We had to start rationing the oranges!
translation: 希望如此。这场战争开始让我们所有人都付出代价了。我们不得不开始定量配给橙子！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: I have good news! The terms have been accepted.
translation: 我有好消息！条件被接受了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Wonderful! Peace at last!
translation: 太好了！终于和平了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh, and it turns out Cuthbert was still alive after all.
translation: 哦，结果卡斯伯特其实还活着。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Cuthbert's alive? Amazing!
translation: 卡斯伯特还活着？太棒了！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Er... no. He's now properly dead.
translation: 呃……不。他现在是彻底死了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: War always has casualties. We will forever remember Cuthbert's sacrifice.
translation: 战争总有伤亡。我们会永远铭记卡斯伯特的牺牲。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Well said! Today will be a day remembered by all of frog-kind, and much of it is thanks to you, [player name].
translation: 说得好！今天将是所有青蛙族铭记的一天，这在很大程度上要感谢你，[player name]。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Thanks. I only wish I had the ability to scrub the memories of all this from my brain, but as I can't, I guess I now have to carry them forever.
translation: 谢谢。我只希望我有能力把这一切的记忆从我的大脑中抹去，但既然我不能，我想我只能永远背负它们了。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Have you tried soap and water?
translation: 你试过肥皂和水吗？
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oddly enough, no.
translation: 奇怪的是，还真没有。
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Oh don't be so negative. You've done a good thing, [player name]! Now go. Go with the blessing of the frogs, and know that you really are a true hero!
translation: 哦，别这么消极。你做了件好事，[player name]！现在去吧。带着青蛙们的祝福离开，要知道你真的是一个真正的英雄！
sub_category: The Ribbiting Tale of a Lily Pad Labour Dispute

english: Now how can I help you old [boy/gal/bean]?
translation: 那么，我该怎么帮您呢，老[boy/gal/bean]？

english: Okay... So when can I start doing missions for the Temple Knights, and get some better Temple Knight armour and weapons and stuff?
translation: 好吧……那我什么时候能开始为圣殿骑士执行任务，拿到更好的圣殿骑士盔甲、武器之类的东西？

english: Well, I may have a mission for you, but it seems you are not quite ready for it yet.
translation: 嗯，我可能有个任务给你，但你似乎还没准备好。

english: Now how can I help you young [fellow/mistress]?
translation: 那么，有什么需要帮忙的吗，年轻的[fellow/mistress]？

english: Well, now that you are a White Knight we can process your application form correctly.
translation: 好了，既然你现在是白骑士，我们可以正确办理你的申请表格了。

english: Already done, old bean! The scales of justice never sleep.
translation: 早就办好了，老伙计！正义的天平永不眠。

english: Uh, right.
translation: 呃，好吧。

english: So then, dear gal; with that in mind, we have a mission for you.
translation: 那么，亲爱的姑娘，基于这点，我们有个任务交给你。

english: Really? Great!   Am I to be flung to some far off and exotic land to defeat some evil genius?
translation: 真的吗？太棒了！我是不是要被派往某个遥远而奇异的大陆，击败某个邪恶天才？

english: What? Ah, no actually. We're sending you to Ardougne.
translation: 什么？啊，不是的。实际上，我们要派你去阿多尼城。

english: Ardougne?
translation: 阿多尼城？

english: Hmm, what's happening in Ardougne?
translation: 嗯，阿多尼城出什么事了？

english: I don't know, you were about to tell me.
translation: 我不知道，你不是正要告诉我吗？

english: No, no, no, nothing happening in Ardougne.   However, there is something going on in Witchaven to the south-east of Ardougne.
translation: 不，不，不，阿多尼城没什么事。不过，阿多尼城东南方向的女巫港有些状况。

english: Are you sure? I mean, you're not a little... senile, maybe?
translation: 你确定吗？我的意思是，你不会有点……老糊涂了吧？

english: Haw, Haw, Haw, very funny old bean. I need you to report to Col O'Niall in Witchaven.   He's a retired Temple Knight, but his clearance is still active. He will be able to fill you in.
translation: 哈，哈，哈，真有趣，老伙计。我需要你去女巫港向奥尼尔上校报到。他是一位退休的圣殿骑士，但权限仍然有效。他会向你说明情况的。

english: Remember to use the Temple Knight code phrase: 'In Falador, the geese fly backwards on Tuesdays'.
translation: 记住用圣殿骑士的暗号：‘在法拉多城，鹅在星期二会倒着飞’。

english: You know, I'm still not sure this isn't some giant wind up.
translation: 你知道吗，我还是不确定这不是什么大忽悠。

english: Nonsense, my [man/gal], we take our work very seriously. The fate of the world rests in our hands, don't you know.
translation: 胡说，我的[man/gal]，我们对待工作非常认真。世界的命运掌握在我们手中，这你难道不知道吗？

english: Hmm, you'll need to get your CommOrb before I send you off old bean.
translation: 嗯，在我派你出发前，你得先拿到通讯球，老伙计。

english: Oh, before you go, I just need to update your CommOrb with the new mission parameters.
translation: 啊，在你走之前，我只需要用新的任务参数更新一下你的通讯球。

english: Now, is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 那么，还有其他事我能帮忙吗？

english: As you wish, old bean. Do let me know if you reconsider.
translation: 随你便，老伙计。要是你改变主意，务必告诉我。

english: Free up some inventory space first, what?
translation: 先腾出一些背包空间，嗯？

english: Hey, Sir Tiffy.
translation: 嘿，蒂菲爵士。

english: Greetings, [player name]. Anything to report?
translation: 向你致敬，[player name]。有什么要报告的吗？

english: Not yet, sir, but I'm working on it.
translation: 还没有，先生，但我正在调查。

english: Good show! That's the spirit.
translation: 干得好！这才像话。

english: Hey, Savant! Good to speak to you again!
translation: 嘿，学者！很高兴再次和你通话！

english: [player name], I am so glad you've been assigned this mission.
translation: [player name]，我很高兴这个任务分配给了你。

english: Me too. So, do you have anything you can tell me?
translation: 我也是。那么，你有什么可以告诉我的吗？

english: Only what is already available through your CommOrb I'm afraid. I'm currently collating a lot of other data pertaining to Witchaven.  I'll keep you updated if anything turns up.
translation: 恐怕只有你通讯球里已有的那些信息。我正在整理大量关于女巫港的其他数据。如果有什么发现，我会及时通知你的。

english: Thanks Savant. I know I can count on you.
translation: 谢谢，学者。我知道我能指望你。

english: Savant out.
translation: 学者通话完毕。

english: Excuse me sir, would you be Col. O'Niall?
translation: 打扰一下，先生，您是奥尼尔上校吗？

english: I might. Who's asking?
translation: 可能是。谁在问？

english: [player name], sir. Sir Tiffy Cashien sent me.
translation: [player name]，先生。是蒂菲.卡申爵士派我来的。

english: Umm... In Falador the geese fly backwards on Tuesdays?
translation: 嗯……在法拉多城，鹅在星期二会倒着飞？

english: What? Are you mad [boy/girl]?
translation: 什么？你疯了吗[boy/girl]？

english: Uhh. I thought it was a Temple Knight, secret code phrase.
translation: 呃。我以为是圣殿骑士的秘密暗号。

english: I see Sir Tiffy still has his fun with the Initiates. Sigh, I asked for a Knight and I get a whelp.
translation: 看来蒂菲爵士还是喜欢拿新人寻开心。唉，我要的是个骑士，结果来了个毛头小子。

english: Whelp? I am a full member of the Temple Knights, sir!
translation: 毛头小子？我可是圣殿骑士的正式成员，先生！

english: Like I said, a whelp. And don't 'Sir' me [boy/girl], I work for a living.
translation: 就像我说的，毛头小子。还有，别叫我‘先生’[boy/girl]，我可是干实事的。

english: Right sir, I mean Colonel.
translation: 好的，先生——我的意思是，上校。

english: Jake will do fine [boy/girl].
translation: 叫我杰克就行[boy/girl]。

english: Now what do you want to know.
translation: 现在，你想知道什么？

english: What's the mission?
translation: 任务是什么？

english: Well, I started to notice something about three weeks ago.
translation: 嗯，大约三周前我开始注意到一些事情。

english: The Mayor called a meeting of the town council. Nothing too strange about that, in and of itself.
translation: 镇长召集了一次镇议会会议。这本身并不奇怪。

english: He was acting a bit strange, like he'd taken a blow to the head or something. At the end of the meeting he announces that he's going to be renovating the shrine just west of the town.
translation: 他表现得有点奇怪，像是被什么东西打中了头似的。会议结束时，他宣布要翻修镇西边的神龛。

english: Now, I thought that was a bit off since he's about as religious as a dead dog on a termite mound.
translation: 我当时就觉得有点不对劲，因为他压根儿就不信教，简直像白蚁丘上的死狗一样。

english: Eeew!
translation: 噫！

english: Quiet down, I'm talking here.
translation: 安静点，我在说话呢。

english: I could have let that slip, save for the things he's been bringing in.
translation: 要不是看他运进来的那些东西，我也许就睁一只眼闭一只眼了。

english: What, like surface to air ballistas, intercontinental exploding fireballs and quasi-futuristic henchman uniforms?
translation: 什么东西？对空弩炮、洲际爆炸火球、还有准未来风格的喽啰制服？

english: The essential tools for world domination?
translation: 统治世界的基本工具？

english: No, mining equipment.
translation: 不，是采矿装备。

english: That doesn't sound very evil?
translation: 那听起来一点也不邪恶啊？

english: As well as the mining equipment, he's been bringing in rune essence in large quantities.
translation: 除了采矿装备，他还大量运进符文精华。

english: Far beyond what's needed for a small village such as this.
translation: 远远超出了这样一个小村庄的需求。

english: Okay, that sounds suspicious. I'll look into it.
translation: 好吧，听起来很可疑。我会调查一下。

english: Yes, some of the villagers have been disappearing overnight and reappearing the next day in a dazed and confused state.
translation: 是的，有些村民会一夜之间失踪，第二天又回来，神情恍惚。

english: Are you sure they're not just getting drunk?
translation: 你确定他们不是单纯喝醉了？

english: They could be I suppose, but I'd rather you made sure.
translation: 也许吧，但我更希望你查个清楚。

english: Anything else you need to know?
translation: 还有其他需要知道的吗？

english: Tell me about Witchaven.
translation: 给我讲讲女巫港的情况。

english: Well, what's to say. This place is falling apart.
translation: 嗯，有什么好说的呢。这地方快要散架了。

english: I noticed it's a bit run down.
translation: 我注意到是有点破败。

english: Run down? Hah! This place used to be a bustling hive of industry.
translation: 破败？哈！这地方以前可是个繁忙的工业中心。

english: The Fishing Platform happened to it.
translation: 是钓鱼平台害的。

english: When you introduce a large scale operation like the Fishing Platform, it takes away the business from the little guy.
translation: 当你引入像钓鱼平台这样的大规模作业，小本生意就没法做了。

english: Almost overnight Witchaven became a ghost town.
translation: 几乎一夜之间，女巫港就变成了一座鬼城。

english: That's very sad. However, you can't stand in the way of progress.
translation: 真令人难过。但是，你不能阻挡进步的步伐。

english: I'm going to pretend you didn't say that girl.
translation: 我就当没听见你这话，姑娘。

english: Remember, bigger is not always better.
translation: 记住，大不一定总是好。

english: Who are the important people in Witchaven?
translation: 女巫港有哪些重要人物？

english: Hmm. There are only three people I recommend speaking to.
translation: 嗯。我只建议你跟三个人谈谈。

english: Right, who would that be?
translation: 好的，是哪三个？

english: Firstly go speak to Mayor Hobb. He was the first to be acting strangely.
translation: 首先去找霍布市长谈谈。他是第一个行为异常的人。

english: As well as that, he isn't looking too healthy.
translation: 此外，他看起来也不太健康。

english: Speak to the Mayor, check.
translation: 和市长谈谈，记下了。

english: Next, speak to Brother Maledict at the church.
translation: 其次，去教堂找马勒迪克特修士谈谈。

english: He speaks to a lot of the villagers and has a good feel for what's going on in town.
translation: 他和很多村民交谈，对镇上的情况很了解。

english: Brother Maledict, right.
translation: 马勒迪克特修士，明白了。

english: Finally, speak to Holgart the fisherman. I haven't seen him sailing in a while.  That is definitely a bit off.
translation: 最后，找渔夫霍尔加特谈谈。我有一阵没见他出海了。这绝对有点不对劲。

english: Holgart, oh yes I've spoken to him before.
translation: 霍尔加特，哦对，我以前和他聊过。

english: That covers about everyone, but don't just limit yourself to those three.  Others may have some insight into what's been happening.
translation: 基本上就是这些人了，但别只局限于这三个人。其他人可能也对发生的事情有些看法。

english: Will do Col. O'Niall. Thanks for the advice.
translation: 我会的，奥尼尔上校。谢谢你的建议。

english: That's enough for now.
translation: 暂时就这些了。

english: Stay sharp [boy/girl].
translation: 保持警惕[boy/girl]。

english: Excuse me Col. O'Niall. I need some more information.
translation: 抱歉，奥尼尔上校。我需要更多信息。

english: You are not part of us. Leave us alone.
translation: 你不是我们的一员。别来烦我们。

english: Hello again, Holgart.
translation: 又见面了，霍尔加特。

english: Well, hello again m'hearty. How're yer fare?
translation: 哦，又见到你了，我的老伙计。你还好吗？

english: Busy as always. Is everything okay?
translation: 还是老样子，忙得很。一切都还好吗？

english: 'Fraid not [lad/lass]. I've been washed up and left to dry.
translation: 恐怕不好[lad/lass]。我现在可是搁浅在岸上，干晾着呢。

english: Scuppered I am, keelhauled and bottomed out.
translation: 我完蛋了，被拖底翻船了。

english: I'm destitute. I can sail no more.
translation: 我穷困潦倒，再也无法出海了。

english: Oh my, that's terrible!  What happened?
translation: 哦天哪，那太糟糕了！发生什么事了？

english: About two weeks ago, I was hauled up in front of the Mayor and he tells me I've broken his new 'Articles of sailing'.
translation: 大约两周前，我被带到镇长面前，他告诉我违反了新的‘航海条例’。

english: He tells me that under his new laws my boat is forfeit.
translation: 他告诉我，根据他的新法律，我的船要被没收了。

english: He took your boat?
translation: 他拿走了你的船？

english: Aye. The Mayor has given it to Jeb Wormwood. He is running the boat to the Fishing Platform now.
translation: 是啊。市长把它给了杰布.沃姆伍德。他现在正开船去钓鱼平台。

english: Speaking of which, since you were last there it's got a might bit stranger. You really should take a look.
translation: 说到这个，自从你上次去那里之后，那里变得有点奇怪了。你真该去看看。

english: I'll do that Holgart. I hope you get your boat back soon.
translation: 我会的，霍尔加特。希望你能尽快拿回你的船。

english: Aye. Fare thee well.
translation: 是啊。愿你安好。

english: Are you insane? Have you seen what's happening out there?
translation: 你疯了吗？你看到外面在发生什么了吗？

english: You mean the sickly looking lobsters?
translation: 你是说那些看起来很恶心的龙虾？

english: Yes the mutant lobsters! I swear at any minute they are going to break down the door and attack me.
translation: 就是那些变异龙虾！我发誓它们随时都会破门而入攻击我。

english: They seem fairly peaceful so far.
translation: 它们目前看起来还挺安静的。

english: Well, true, but you can't be too careful.
translation: 嗯，确实，但怎么小心都不为过。

english: When did they start appearing?
translation: 它们是什么时候开始出现的？

english: Not long after you rescued Kennith.
translation: 就在你救出肯尼斯之后不久。

english: They get hauled out of the sea as ordinary giant lobsters, the fishermen hit them with a mallet then a Sea Slug jumps into the crack.
translation: 它们以普通巨型龙虾的样子被从海里捞上来，渔夫用木槌敲打它们，然后一只海蛞蝓就跳进裂缝里。

english: After a while they turn green, before jumping back into the sea and swimming off towards the mainland.
translation: 过了一会儿，它们变成绿色，然后又跳回海里，朝大陆方向游去。

english: This sounds very serious. Hmm, I'd best get back to the mainland and see where these lobsters are heading.
translation: 听起来很严重。嗯，我最好回大陆看看这些龙虾到底往哪儿去了。

english: Please be quick, I can't leave whilst those things are out there.
translation: 请快点，那些东西还在外面，我离不开。

english: And a good day to you my [son/daughter].
translation: 愿你安好，我的[son/daughter]。

english: I am Brother Maledict, at your service.
translation: 我是马勒迪克特修士，愿为你效劳。

english: [player name], at yours. How are you?
translation: [player name]，请多指教。你好吗？

english: Well, to be perfectly honest with you, I am a little concerned.
translation: 嗯，老实说，我有点担心。

english: Really, what's up?
translation: 真的吗？怎么了？

english: It's my congregation. They seem to be drifting away from me.
translation: 是我的会众。他们似乎渐渐疏远我了。

english: With all the hardships this small village has endured in the past few years, the people of Witchaven have never needed the solace of Saradomin more.
translation: 过去几年这个小村庄经历了那么多苦难，女巫港的居民从未像现在这样需要萨拉多明的慰藉。

english: Well that's understandable.
translation: 这可以理解。

english: Yes indeed. However, less and less people have been attending my services lately.
translation: 确实。但是，最近来参加我礼拜的人越来越少了。

english: I can see why that would worry you. Do you have any idea why they would not attend?
translation: 我能理解你为什么担心。你知道他们为什么不来吗？

english: The only thing I can think of, is that the Mayor has asked them to help improve the shrine.
translation: 我唯一能想到的是，市长请他们帮忙修缮神龛。

english: Well, that would make sense. Hmm, one more thing.
translation: 嗯，那倒也说得通。嗯，还有一件事。

english: Tell me again, what's worrying you?
translation: 再告诉我一遍，你在担心什么？

english: What can you tell me about the shrine?
translation: 关于那个神龛，你能告诉我些什么？

english: Ah yes, one of the wonders of Witchaven. That particular shrine has existed since before Witchaven was even founded.
translation: 啊，对，女巫港的奇观之一。那个神龛在女巫港建立之前就已经存在了。

english: Wow! Now that is old.
translation: 哇！那可真古老了。

english: Over one hundred and fifty years old in fact.
translation: 事实上，超过一百五十年了。

english: The role I now fulfill was originally given to one of the Temple Guardians, but in time that has been delegated to one of the ordained, such as myself.
translation: 我现在担任的职责原本是交给一位神殿守卫的，但后来逐渐委托给了像我这样的神职人员。

english: The shrine was abandoned when the village came into being. Since then it has fallen into disrepair and other less savoury elements have moved in.
translation: 村庄形成后，神龛就被废弃了。从那以后，它年久失修，一些不那么讨人喜欢的东西也搬了进去。

english: You must be pleased that the Mayor is renovating the shrine.
translation: 市长在翻修神龛，你一定很高兴吧。

english: Well yes, it came as something of a pleasant shock. I only hope he will let me visit it soon.
translation: 嗯，是的，这有点出乎意料，但令人欣喜。我只希望他能尽快让我去看看。

english: He wants me to wait until it's ready to unveil.
translation: 他想让我等到准备揭幕的时候再去。

english: Tell me about the people of Witchaven.
translation: 跟我说说女巫港的居民吧。

english: Ah, the people of Witchaven are the salt of the earth. Hardworking and very generous. Well, usually that is.
translation: 啊，女巫港的人都是淳朴善良的人。勤劳又慷慨。嗯，通常来说是这样。

english: Not anymore?
translation: 现在不了？

english: Oh, most of them certainly. It's just that something has changed over the past few weeks.
translation: 哦，大部分人还是的。只是过去几周有些东西变了。

english: It's nothing I can put my finger on. My flock aren't exactly unfriendly anymore, just different.
translation: 我也说不上来。我的羊群倒也不是变得不友好了，只是不一样了。

english: Well, they used to be very rigorous in attending my services. Now they seem almost apathetic.
translation: 嗯，他们以前非常严格地参加我的礼拜。现在他们几乎变得漠不关心了。

english: They wander around the village in a listless state, everyone except the Mayor that is.
translation: 他们无精打采地在村子里游荡，除了市长以外所有人都是这样。

english: Since the opening of the Fishing Platform he was a man beset by worries. The only thing that occupied his mind was how to rescue his village from financial collapse.
translation: 自从钓鱼平台开放以来，他就成了一个忧心忡忡的人。他脑子里只想着如何让村庄摆脱财政危机。

english: Ordinarily, I would welcome his new found drive and energy, especially as it is directed towards renovating the shrine
translation: 通常来说，我会欢迎他新获得的干劲和精力，尤其是他用在了翻修神龛上。

english: I'm not sure but something about him has me worried.
translation: 我不确定，但他身上有些东西让我担心。

english: Perhaps he thinks the shrine could bring new interest to the village?
translation: 也许他认为神龛能给村子带来新的关注点？

english: Perhaps. Maybe I'm being a little paranoid.  I'll give it some thought.
translation: 也许吧。也许我有点多疑了。我会好好想想的。

english: In the meantime, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 与此同时，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Peace be with you child.
translation: 愿和平与你同在，孩子。

english: Good day to you, Brother Maledict.
translation: 日安，马勒迪克特修士。

english: And a good day to you again, [player name].  How can I help?
translation: 再次日安，[player name]。我能帮你什么？

english: Well hello there; welcome to our little village. Pray, stay a while.
translation: 你好呀；欢迎来到我们的小村庄。请多待一会儿。

english: Good day to you. Would you be the Mayor?
translation: 你好。你就是市长吗？

english: Indeed. Mayor Eustace Hobb, in fact. Do you like our home?
translation: 正是。事实上，我是尤斯塔斯.霍布斯市长。你喜欢我们的家园吗？

english: It's certainly very quiet.
translation: 确实很安静。

english: Yes, quiet and undisturbed. Just how we like it.
translation: 是的，安静又不受打扰。正合我们意。

english: Tell me, what brings you to Witchaven?
translation: 告诉我，是什么风把你吹到女巫港来了？

english: I'm here to relax.
translation: 我来这里放松一下。

english: That's good, yes, that's good.  Witchaven is a nice quiet village - very relaxing, good fishing.
translation: 那很好，是的，那很好。女巫港是个很安静的小村庄——很放松，钓鱼也不错。

english: Are you alright? You seem a little, hazy.
translation: 你没事吧？你看起来有点恍惚。

english: It's nothing, I'm just a little tired at the moment. So much work, so much to do.
translation: 没什么，我只是现在有点累。工作太多，要做的事太多了。

english: Really, what are you working on?
translation: 真的吗？你在忙什么？

english: To the West, the shrine needs... work, yes work. Things must be made better.
translation: 西边，神龛需要……修缮，是的，修缮。事情必须变得更好。

english: Well, um. Yes. Indeed. I'm sure Saradomin would be pleased.
translation: 嗯，呃。是的。确实。我相信萨拉多明会很高兴的。

english: Saradomin... Why are you really here?
translation: 萨拉多明……你究竟为什么来这里？

english: Like I said, I'm here to...
translation: 就像我说的，我来这里是为了……

english: Are you sure that's the only reason you are here, [player name]?
translation: 你确定你来这里的唯一原因就是那个吗，[player name]？

english: Well, I'm also here to visit a friend, Jake O'Niall.
translation: 嗯，我也是来看一个朋友，杰克.奥尼尔。

english: Ahh, then this all makes sense. Yes, this is very good.
translation: 啊哈，那就说得通了。是的，这很好。

english: Err, how did you know my name?
translation: 呃，你怎么知道我的名字？

english: You told me when you came in.
translation: 你进来的时候告诉我的。

english: No, no I didn't.
translation: 不，我没有。

english: It does not matter. One of my... villagers, must have mentioned that you are here.
translation: 没关系。一定是我的……一个村民，提到你在这里。

english: What can you tell me about Witchaven?
translation: 关于女巫港，你能告诉我些什么？

english: The land has seen much sorrow, much loss.
translation: 这片土地经历了太多悲伤，太多失落。

english: Are you talking about the Fishing Platform?
translation: 你说的是钓鱼平台吗？

english: Fishing Platform? Oh yes, that. No.  The platform will do much for this place.
translation: 钓鱼平台？哦，对，那个。不。平台会为这个地方带来很多好处。

english: The platform heralds a new beginning for Witchaven, undreamed of by those who built it.
translation: 这个平台预示了女巫港的新开端，是那些建造它的人做梦也想不到的。

english: I thought it took away all the trade?
translation: 我以为它抢走了所有贸易？

english: This is true, but it has brought us so much more in return, so much more.
translation: 确实如此，但作为回报它给我们带来了更多，多得多。

english: Hmm, and I thought the village hated the Fishing Platform.
translation: 嗯，我还以为村里人都讨厌钓鱼平台呢。

english: It was... a necessary step.
translation: 那是……必要的一步。

english: What improvements are you making to the shrine?
translation: 你在对神龛做什么改进？

english: Ahh, the shrine - the future, our destiny, our heritage.
translation: 啊哈，神龛——未来，我们的命运，我们的传承。

english: That which the shrine holds can unlock a new path for all the village of Witchaven. And in time the whole of Gielinor.
translation: 神龛所蕴含的东西可以为整个女巫港村开启一条新道路。最终，还有整个吉莱诺。

english: Wow, the whole of Gielinor? I thought it was just some old shrine to Saradomin.
translation: 哇，整个吉莱诺？我还以为那只是供奉萨拉多姆的某个古老神龛呢。

english: The history of that shrine should not be overlooked.  It is ancient beyond your knowledge and much that shaped our history is contained within its walls.
translation: 那座神龛的历史不容忽视。它古老得超出你的认知，许多塑造我们历史的东西都蕴藏在其墙壁之内。

english: Sounds like a very interesting place. I may have to take a look.
translation: 听起来是个很有意思的地方。我可能得去看看。

english: There is much to be done before it is opened.
translation: 在它开放之前还有很多工作要做。

english: So it's not completed yet?
translation: 所以还没完工？

english: When you are ready, it may be that you will be unable to keep yourself away.
translation: 等你准备好了，也许你就会发现自己无法抗拒地想去那里。

english: You know, you really are a strange person.
translation: 你知道吗，你真是个奇怪的人。

english: Do you know you look very ill?
translation: 你知道自己看起来病得很重吗？

english: Ill? No, merely tired.
translation: 病了？没有，只是累了。

english: But you've turned a slightly sickly colour.
translation: 但你脸色有点发青。

english: A touch of food poisoning perhaps.
translation: 可能是有点食物中毒。

english: This has been known to turn the face and give the impression of severe illness.
translation: 这已知会使脸色改变，给人一种重病的印象。

english: I've seen food poisoning. People normally don't look like... that.
translation: 我见过食物中毒的人。通常不会像……那样。

english: Time is all that is needed. Yes, time to... get better.
translation: 只需要时间。是的，时间……会好起来的。

english: Well, I hope you get better soon.
translation: 好吧，希望你早日康复。

english: Soon, all will be well again. Have no fear.
translation: 很快一切都会好起来的。别担心。

english: Nothing at the moment thanks.
translation: 暂时没什么事，谢谢。

english: Then please feel free to stay in our village a while longer. Farewell.
translation: 那就请继续在我们村里多待一会儿吧。再见。

english: So [boy/girl], what have you learned?
translation: 那么，[boy/girl]，你学到了什么？

english: Something is definitely very wrong here.
translation: 这里肯定有什么不对劲。

english: Mayor Hobb has confiscated Holgart's boat and given it to someone else.
translation: 霍布市长没收了霍尔加特的船，给了别人。

english: As well as this, there's something very... fishy about him.
translation: 而且，他这个人也……很可疑。

english: Hmm, fishy you say. Anything else?
translation: 嗯，你说可疑。还有别的吗？

english: Yes, Brother Maledict is worried that his congregation is being led astray.
translation: 是的，马勒迪克特修士担心他的会众被引入歧途。

english: Did he say anything more?
translation: 他还说了什么吗？

english: The shrine to the west of the village has been consecrated to Saradomin for centuries.
translation: 村子西边的神龛已经供奉萨拉多明好几个世纪了。

english: However, last time he was there, there was a very definite unpleasant feeling in the air.
translation: 不过，他上次去的时候，空气中弥漫着一种非常明显的不适感。

english: Sounds like this shrine needs a thorough investigation.
translation: 听起来这个神龛需要彻底调查一下。

english: I recommend taking a good look down there - see if anything is amiss.
translation: 我建议你好好看看下面——看看有没有什么不对劲的地方。

english: I was thinking the same thing. I'll get right on it.
translation: 我也这么想。我马上去办。

english: I'd better carry my CommOrb so that Savant can see what's in there.
translation: 我最好带上通讯球，这样学者就能看到里面的情况了。

english: Hello, [player name]. What can I do for you?
translation: 你好，[player name]。有什么事吗？

english: Nothing thanks Savant. I was just checking this thing still worked!
translation: 没什么，学者。我只是想看看这东西还能不能用！

english: You shouldn't really waste my time like this, [player name]...
translation: 你不该这样浪费我的时间，[player name]……

english: Still, no harm done I guess! Call me if you need me!
translation: 不过，我想也没什么大碍！需要我的时候就叫我！

english: Okay Savant, will do.
translation: 好的，学者，我会的。

english: [player name], hang on a second.
translation: [player name]，等一下。

english: The markings on that door look familiar. Can you take a scan for me please?
translation: 那扇门上的标记看起来很眼熟。你能帮我扫描一下吗？

english: Savant needs to see this. I better get my Comm Orb.
translation: 学者需要看到这个。我最好拿上我的通讯球。

english: I thought so. Those glyphs look similar to some ancient Saradomin runes I studied at the academy.
translation: 果然如此。那些铭文看起来像我在学院研究过的一些古代萨拉多明符文。

english: Hmm, I know a man who can translate them for us, just be careful as he's not a member of the Knights.
translation: 嗯，我认识一个人可以帮我们翻译，不过要小心，他不是骑士团的人。

english: Um... So how am I supposed to show him the glyphs?
translation: 呃……那我怎么把铭文给他看？

english: Empty some space out of your pack and use the CommOrb to get a transcription of the glyphs.
translation: 从你的背包里腾出点空间，用通讯球转录一份铭文。

english: I have added a transcript of the runes into your pack.
translation: 我已经把符文的转录本放进你的背包里了。

english: The man you need to see is called Jorral.  You can find him in his tower north-west of Ardougne.
translation: 你要找的人叫乔拉尔。你可以在阿多尼城西北方向他的塔里找到他。

english: Fantastic - I'll get right on it.
translation: 太好了——我马上去办。

english: Hey Savant?
translation: 嘿，学者？

english: Yes, [player name]?
translation: 怎么了，[player name]？

english: What did you think of those doors? Spooky hey?
translation: 你觉得那些门怎么样？很吓人对吧？

english: Very, though I can't shake the feeling that I've seen something like that before.
translation: 确实，但我总觉得以前见过类似的东西。

english: They did look really out of place. I wonder who put them there?
translation: 它们看起来真的很格格不入。不知道是谁放在那里的？

english: The answer is probably contained within those strange glyphs.
translation: 答案可能就在那些奇怪的铭文里。

english: I only hope that Jorral can translate them.
translation: 我只希望乔拉尔能翻译它们。

english: He has a very good track record in translation of ancient runes.
translation: 他在古代符文翻译方面有很好的记录。

english: Although, to be fair he does tend to get a bit obsessive at times.
translation: 不过，公平地说，他有时候确实有点过于执着。

english: Thanks for the warning Savant.
translation: 谢谢你的提醒，学者。

english: Speak to you soon.
translation: 回头再聊。

english: I understand that you are something of a historian?
translation: 我听说你算是个历史学家？

english: Hah! I am the foremost historian in the world.
translation: 哈！我是世界上最顶尖的历史学家。

english: Great, I was wondering if you could translate something for me please?
translation: 太好了，我想请问你能帮我翻译点东西吗？

english: Possibly, I am very busy you see and my services don't come cheap.
translation: 也许吧，你看我很忙，而且我的服务可不便宜。

english: Hmm, how much are we talking?
translation: 嗯，大概要多少钱？

english: Well, I am very busy, but I could fit you in sometime next month.
translation: 好吧，我很忙，但我可以安排在下个月的某个时候。

english: That was a bit longer than I was willing to wait.  Can't you fit me in anytime sooner?
translation: 这比我愿意等的时间要长。你能不能早点安排？

english: I'm afraid not. You see, I have this ongoing series of texts that need to be catalogued as soon as possible.
translation: 恐怕不行。你看，我手头有一系列需要尽快编目的文本。

english: Psst, [player name].
translation: 嘘，[player name]。

english: Savant?
translation: 学者？

english: Drat, I was hoping he wouldn't notice.
translation: 该死，我还希望他没注意到呢。

english: Excuse me, but are you talking to your backpack?
translation: 打扰一下，你是在跟你的背包说话吗？

english: Um, no. (whispers) Savant, help.
translation: 呃，不是。（低声）学者，帮帮忙。

english: Uh. Tell him that you're working for a wizard who's sending you telepathic instructions.
translation: 呃。告诉他你为一个魔法师工作，他正在给你发送心灵感应指令。

english: I, err, am working for a wizard who is giving me telepathic instructions.
translation: 我，呃，为一个魔法师工作，他正在给我发送心灵感应指令。

english: Riiiight. Okay. What does this err, voice, want you to do?
translation: 好……吧。那这个，呃，声音，想让你做什么？

english: We have a front company who's keeping Jorral on retainer.
translation: 我们有一个空壳公司，长期聘用乔拉尔。

english: We have a...
translation: 我们有一个……

english: No! Hang on, I wasn't finished.
translation: 不！等等，我还没说完。

english: Not you.
translation: 不是说你。

english: Can I finish now? Anyway, tell him you are working for Petmel Books.
translation: 我能说完了吗？总之，告诉他你为佩特梅尔图书公司工作。

english: Apparently, I'm working for Petmel Books and this document is from them.
translation: 显然，我为佩特梅尔图书公司工作，这份文件是他们的。

english: Oh, right! That explains the mild insanity. No problem; hand over the document and I'll have a look
translation: 哦，好吧！这就解释了你那点轻度精神错乱。没问题；把文件给我，我看看。

english: Um, I don't appear to have it on me.
translation: 呃，我好像没带在身上。

english: Well, run along and fetch it then.
translation: 那就快去拿来吧。

english: Hmm. Interesting, very interesting.
translation: 嗯。有意思，非常有意思。

english: It's an early variation on a script used by the priests of Saradomin a long time ago.
translation: 这是很久以前萨拉多明祭司使用的一种文字的早期变体。

english: Look, you can see how the sentence structure and grammar evolved from the...
translation: 你看，你可以看到句子结构和语法是如何从……演变而来的。

english: Yes, yes I'm sure it's very interesting but what does it say?
translation: 是是是，我知道这很有趣，但它到底说了什么？

english: Hmph. It seems this text pertains to a great battle between the temple of Saradomin and something called the Mahey'ish Medron.
translation: 哼。这段文字似乎涉及萨拉多明神殿与一个叫马赫伊什.梅德隆的东西之间的一场大战。

english: The Mavis Merton?
translation: 梅维斯.默顿？

english: Mahey'sh Medron. I think it's a corruption of an even earlier language and actually refers to something called Mother Mallum.
translation: 马赫伊什.梅德隆。我认为这是更早期语言的讹误，实际上指的是一个叫马勒姆母亲的东西。

english: Well, there isn't a whole lot more. They managed to trap the Mother Mallum behind a mystical prison where she was to wait for all time.
translation: 嗯，没有太多别的了。他们成功地把马勒姆母亲困在一个神秘的监狱后面，让她永远待在那里。

english: Well, thanks for that. You have been a great help.
translation: 好吧，谢谢。你帮了大忙。

english: Any time. I recommend a doctor for those voices, though.
translation: 随时欢迎。不过我建议你为那些声音找个医生看看。

english: Uh, right. Goodbye.
translation: 呃，好的。再见。

english: [player name], come in. This is Savant.
translation: [player name]，请回答。我是学者。

english: Fantastic, I'm here Savant.
translation: 太好了，我在这里，学者。

english: That was the final piece of the puzzle I needed.
translation: 那是我需要的最后一块拼图。

english: I've cross-referenced the name Mahey'ish Medron with some other texts and been able to piece together some of the history.
translation: 我已经将马赫伊什.梅德隆这个名字与其他一些文本进行了交叉比对，并拼凑出了一些历史。

english: Finally, some solid information.
translation: 终于有了一些可靠的信息。

english: Indeed. It seems this isn't the first time the Temple Knights have run across this Mother Mallum character.
translation: 确实。看来神殿骑士团并不是第一次遇到这个马勒姆母亲角色。

english: Now, why doesn't that surprise me?
translation: 嗯，我一点也不惊讶。

english: Yes, it seems that centuries ago we discovered that a great evil had taken control of some of the most influential people in the world.
translation: 是的，似乎几个世纪前我们发现一个巨大的邪恶控制了世界上一些最有影响力的人。

english: That great evil was the Mother Mallum.
translation: 那个巨大的邪恶就是马勒姆母亲。

english: Well, it took the few remaining uncorrupted knights all their wit and strength to devise a method of removing sea slug possession.
translation: 嗯，剩下的少数未被腐化的骑士用尽智慧和力量才想出了移除海蛞蝓附身的方法。

english: Great, that means we can free those poor people who have already fallen.
translation: 太好了，这意味着我们可以解救那些已经沦陷的可怜人。

english: Once freed, the Temple Knights pursued a great crusade to destroy the Mother Mallum.  Unfortunately, she was too powerful and the best they could do was to trap her inside a mystical prison.
translation: 一旦被释放，圣殿骑士就发起了一场伟大的圣战来摧毁马勒姆母亲。不幸的是，她太强大了，他们最多只能把她困在一个神秘的监狱里。

english: It looks like she's breaking free of that prison.
translation: 看来她正在挣脱那个监狱。

english: Right, the best thing we can do then is to repair or reenforce it before she escapes.
translation: 对，那我们最好的办法就是在她逃脱之前修复或加固它。

english: Did your research reveal how she was trapped in the first place?
translation: 你的研究有没有揭示她最初是怎么被困住的？

english: No, I hit a brick wall after that. We had a dragon crash land on our headquarters a few years ago and the resulting fire destroyed a lot of our records.
translation: 不，在那之后我就碰壁了。几年前有一条龙坠毁在我们的总部，由此引发的大火烧毁了我们很多记录。

english: Drat, that complicates things.
translation: 该死，这让事情变得复杂了。

english: I think the best thing you can do is take a look around Witchaven, speak to some of the locals and see if there are any clues to be found.
translation: 我认为你最好在女巫港周围看看，和当地居民谈谈，看看能不能找到什么线索。

english: Righty ho. I'll get to it. Thanks Savant.
translation: 好嘞，我马上去办。谢谢了，学者。

english: Don't mention it, [player name].
translation: 别客气，[player name]。

english: So, Savant. Can you tell me about the Mother Mallum again please?
translation: 那么，学者。能再跟我讲讲马勒姆母亲的事吗？

english: Sure thing, [player name].
translation: 当然可以，[player name]。

english: Well, this isn't the first time the Temple Knights have encountered the Mother Mallum.
translation: 嗯，这并非圣殿骑士第一次遭遇马勒姆母亲。

english: Centuries ago we discovered that a great evil had taken control of some of the most influential people in the world.
translation: 几个世纪前，我们发现一股巨大的邪恶控制了世界上一些最有影响力的人物。

english: It took the few remaining uncorrupted knights all their wit and strength to devise a method of removing sea slug possession.
translation: 几位仅存的清白骑士用尽了智慧和力量，才想出一种去除海蛞蝓附身的方法。

english: Now the best thing we could to is to repair or reinforce it before she escapes.
translation: 现在我们能做的最好的事，就是在她逃脱之前修复或加固它。

english: Thanks for the reminder Savant.
translation: 多谢提醒，学者。

english: Col. O'Niall, this is worse than we thought.
translation: 奥尼尔上校，情况比我们想的更糟。

english: I doubt that, but go on.
translation: 我表示怀疑，不过你继续说。

english: There is something trapped under the town of Witchaven.
translation: 女巫港镇下面困着某个东西。

english: Something the Temple Knights fought in ages past.
translation: 圣殿骑士在很久以前曾经和它战斗过。

english: Something ancient and very, very evil.
translation: 一个古老而又非常非常邪恶的东西。

english: That's an awful big something girl.
translation: 这可真是个了不得的'东西'啊，姑娘。

english: Care to be more specific?
translation: 能说得具体点吗？

english: It's called the Mother Mallum and may have some connection to the sea slugs.
translation: 它叫马勒姆母亲，可能和海蛞蝓有某种联系。

english: Hmm, it can't be a coincidence that the Mayor is 'renovating' the shrine.   He must be preparing to break the Mother Mallum free.
translation: 嗯，市长在'翻新'神龛，这绝不可能是巧合。他肯定是在准备释放马勒姆母亲。

english: I agree, but what can we do about it?
translation: 我同意，但我们能做什么呢？

english: Hmm, it might be worth speaking to that priest of Saradomin.
translation: 嗯，也许值得和那位萨拉多明的祭司谈谈。

english: See if he's got any more light to shed on this.
translation: 看看他是否对此有更多了解。

english: Of course! The temple of Saradomin has had a shrine here for centuries. I'll get right on it.
translation: 当然！萨拉多明神庙在这里有座神龛已经好几个世纪了。我马上去办。

english: Anything new to report?
translation: 有什么新情况要报告吗？
