english: Not yet, but I was wondering if I could ask you some more questions?
translation: 还没有，但我在想能不能再问你几个问题？

english: So Maledict.
translation: 那么，马勒迪克特。

english: Uh, Maledict.
translation: 呃，马勒迪克特。

english: Hmm. Oh, yes. We are Maledict.
translation: 嗯。哦，是的。我们是马勒迪克特。

english: Are you feeling alright?
translation: 你还好吗？

english: It's nothing, just a little tired at the moment. So much work, so much to do.
translation: 没事，就是现在有点累。工作太多，要做的事太多。

english: That sounds hauntingly familiar.
translation: 这话听起来真是莫名熟悉。

english: Was there something you wanted?
translation: 你有什么事吗？

english: I wanted to ask you something about the Shrine to Saradomin.
translation: 我想问你一些关于萨拉多明神龛的事。

english: Well I have discovered a hidden passageway leading to a huge pair of double doors.
translation: 我发现了一条通往一对巨大双扇门的隐藏通道。

english: And I thought you might know something about what is behind them.
translation: 我觉得你可能知道门后面是什么。

english: Ahh. Right. No.
translation: 啊。这样啊。不知道。

english: What do you mean, no?
translation: 不知道是什么意思？

english: Most of the history of the shrine is contained within the holy book of Saradomin. We have yet to read that portion of the text.
translation: 神龛的大部分历史都记载在萨拉多明的圣典里。我们还没读到那部分内容。

english: Great! Can I have a look please?
translation: 太好了！能让我看看吗？

english: Again with this no business. Why not?
translation: 又是这个'不行'。为什么不行？

english: Because the three pages pertaining to the shrine's history have been stolen.
translation: 因为记载神龛历史的三页纸被偷了。

english: Ah, right, sorry. Would you like me to find them for you?
translation: 啊，这样啊，抱歉。需要我帮你找到它们吗？

english: It is imperative that you find them.
translation: 你必须找到它们。

english: Peace be with you.
translation: 愿和平与你同在。

english: The joys of family are not to be underestimated child.
translation: 家庭的欢乐不可小觑，孩子。

english: Hello again, [player name]. How are things?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。事情怎么样了？

english: Frustrating, to be honest.
translation: 说实话，挺挫败的。

english: Is there any way I can help?
translation: 有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Well, I'm not sure. Brother Maledict has asked me to find some pages that were torn out of his holy book.
translation: 嗯，我不太确定。马勒迪克特修士让我去找从他圣典里撕下来的几页纸。

english: What, like this?
translation: 什么，像这样的吗？

english: Yes, just like that, but I can't seem to find...
translation: 对，就是那样，但我好像找不到……

english: Where on Gielinor did you get that?
translation: 你究竟是从哪里搞到的？

english: Someone pushed it under my door just before you arrived. I went outside to see who it was but they'd already gone by the time I got there.
translation: 就在你到之前，有人把它从我门底下塞了进来。我出去看是谁，但我到的时候他们已经走了。

english: Strange. Do you mind if I take that?
translation: 真奇怪。你介意我拿走这个吗？

english: Sure, but I don't think you have enough space in your pack to hold it.
translation: 当然可以，不过我觉得你的背包里没有足够的空间来放它。

english: Hang on, I'll just make some room.
translation: 等等，我腾点地方出来。

english: Glad I could be of service. Anything else you need?
translation: 很高兴能帮上忙。还有什么需要的吗？

english: [player name], there you are.
translation: [player name]，你在这儿啊。

english: Jake, I hope you can help me out here.
translation: 杰克，希望你能帮我个忙。

english: Perhaps. What is it that you need?
translation: 或许吧。你需要什么？

english: Well I... Hang on a moment, you're looking a bit sickly.
translation: 呃，我……等等，你看起来有点病怏怏的。

english: Oh no. They got to you too, didn't they?
translation: 哦不。他们也找上你了，对吧？

english: Are you sure this is not some elaborate deception on my part, to fool them?
translation: 你确定我这不可能是精心设计的骗局，用来骗他们的吗？

english: Well, I don't know, but how can I trust you?
translation: 嗯，我不知道，但我该怎么信任你？

english: Because you seek the last page of Maledict's holy book. It is right here for you.
translation: 因为你要找马勒迪克特圣典的最后一页。它就在这里，给你。

english: That seems a tad convenient.
translation: 这也太巧了点吧。

english: Perhaps, but at the end of the day it is what you need. Do you want it or not?
translation: 也许是吧，但归根结底，这是你需要的东西。你到底要不要？

english: I'm not so sure that this is a good idea, but yes, I'll take it.
translation: 我不确定这是不是个好主意，但好吧，我要了。

english: Well, you'll need to free up space for three items in your backpack first.
translation: 嗯，你首先得在背包里腾出三个物品的空间来。

english: Right, I'll do that now.
translation: 好的，我现在就做。

english: It has been torn into three pieces. You will need to stick them back together before you can use them.
translation: 它被撕成了三片。你得先把它粘起来才能用。

english: Great, another complication I didn't need.  I wonder if swamp paste will do the trick?
translation: 好啊，又是一个我不需要的麻烦。不知道沼泽膏能不能行？

english: [player name], stop!
translation: [player name]，住手！

english: What? I'm only trying to glue these pages back together.
translation: 干嘛？我只是想把这几页纸粘回去。

english: Please don't use oil-rich swamp paste on an ancient parchment. It'll ruin it.
translation: 请不要在古羊皮纸上用含油量高的沼泽膏。会毁掉它的。

english: So, how do I stick the pages back together?
translation: 那我要怎么把这些纸页粘回去？

english: Well, lucky for you, my preliminary sea slug analysis has just finished.
translation: 嗯，算你走运，我初步的海蛞蝓分析刚做完。

english: It shows that if you render the slug down, it will form a very sticky glue that will dry clear.
translation: 分析显示，如果你把海蛞蝓熬炼一下，它会形成一种非常粘稠的胶水，干后是透明的。

english: You will need to find someone who has years of experience in aquatic cooking or it could go horribly wrong.
translation: 你需要找一个有多年水产烹饪经验的人，否则可能会搞砸。

english: No problem Savant. I'll snap to it right away.
translation: 没问题，学者。我马上就动手。

english: Waaaaah!
translation: 哇啊！

english: Arrrgh!
translation: 啊呃！

english: Oh, sorry, [player name].  I thought you were one of those fishermen.
translation: 哦，对不起，[player name]。我还以为你是那些渔夫之一呢。

english: N-No problem. It was just a surprise that's all.
translation: 没、没关系。只是吓了一跳而已。

english: Well, I am scared half to death out here.
translation: 唉，我在这里都快被吓死了。

english: Well, I have something that could help you out.
translation: 嗯，我有个东西也许能帮到你。

english: Really, great!
translation: 真的吗，太好了！

english: Well, I have a page that should give me the instructions on how to eliminate what could be the source of the sea slugs.
translation: 嗯，我有一页纸，上面应该写着如何消灭可能是海蛞蝓源头的东西的说明。

english: Then why haven't you used it?
translation: 那你为什么不用呢？

english: It's been torn up into three pieces.
translation: 它被撕成了三块。

english: I have it on good authority that you may be able to help me out by rendering a dead sea slug down for glue.
translation: 据可靠消息，你可能能帮我，把死亡的海蛞蝓熬成胶水。

english: Well, you are in luck. I had been cooking a new batch of gumbo for my dinner.  However, I've let it cook too long and it's become very thick and sticky.
translation: 嗯，你运气不错。我本来在煮一批新的秋葵汤当晚餐。不过，我煮得太久了，变得又稠又黏。

english: It should make the perfect base for your glue.
translation: 这应该能做成你胶水的完美基底。

english: Wow! That was good timing wasn't it.
translation: 哇！这时间点也太巧了吧。

english: Uncanny really.
translation: 确实不可思议。

english: Do you have a dead sea slug I can use?
translation: 你有我能用的死亡的海蛞蝓吗？

english: Ah. Um. No, not at the moment.
translation: 啊。嗯。没有，现在没有。

english: Well, get back to me when you have.
translation: 好吧，等你有了再来找我。

english: Right, I'll get cooking.
translation: 好的，我这就去准备烹饪。

english: Right, there you go.
translation: 好了，给你。

english: Thanks very much. I'll get right to work on the parchment.
translation: 非常感谢。我马上开始处理羊皮纸。

english: Um Colonel, I lost my CommOrb...
translation: 嗯，上校，我的通讯球丢了……

english: Very careless of you, what? Here, take another, but be careful with this one!
translation: 你也太粗心了，嗯？来，再拿一个，但这个要小心了！

english: Ah, so good of you to finally join us [player name]. To be honest, I never thought you'd make it this far.
translation: 啊，[player name]你终于来了。说实话，我从没想过你能走到这一步。

english: What? Mayor Hobb.
translation: 什么？霍布市长。

english: Oh come now [player name]. Surely you are smart enough to know when you've been played for a fool?
translation: 哦，算了吧[player name]。你不会笨到被人当傻子耍了还不知道吧？

english: Ahh, the penny drops.  You got me to do your dirty work for you.
translation: 啊哈，你总算明白了。你让我帮你干了那些脏活。

english: Indeed. The enchantment placed upon this door by the Temple Knights prevented anyone not working in their interests from opening it.
translation: 没错。圣殿骑士在这扇门上施加的附魔，让任何不是为他们利益效力的人都无法打开。

english: With your superb timing, our plans have been advanced quicker than even we could have anticipated.
translation: 你来得真是时候，我们的计划比预想中进展得更快。

english: And what are they? What are your plans?
translation: 什么计划？你们的计划是什么？

english: You'd really like to know? Well, it seems the least I can do for you after all your hard work.
translation: 你真想知道？好吧，既然你出了这么多力，这点小事我还是可以告诉你的。

english: Behold, the beauteous visage of our beloved Prince.
translation: 看，我们敬爱的王子那美丽的容颜。

english: So this is the Mother Mallum?
translation: 这就是马勒姆母亲？

english: Mwahahaha... Fool. No, this is not our Great Mother, though I sincerely wish you had the chance to gaze upon her.
translation: 哈哈哈……傻瓜。不，这不是我们的伟大母亲，虽然我真诚地希望你曾有机会瞻仰她。

english: Sadly for you, this will be the last thing you ever see.
translation: 可惜对你来说，这将是你最后看到的东西了。

english: No! Do you realise what you have done?
translation: 不！你知道你干了什么吗？

english: Yes. I have destroyed one of the great evils infesting this world.
translation: 我知道。我摧毁了这个世界上的一个巨大邪恶。

english: You fool! Did you think it would be so easy? The Prince will be reborn in all his glory!
translation: 你这个蠢货！你难道以为会这么容易？王子将荣耀重生！

english: Now you face the true wrath of the Mother Mallum!
translation: 现在你将面对马勒姆母亲真正的愤怒！

english: Calm yourself, my child. We anticipated this eventuality. Go now and prepare the throne for our arrival.
translation: 冷静点，我的孩子。我们已经预料到了这种情况。现在去为王座做好准备。

english: By your command, my queen.
translation: 遵命，我的女王。

english: So then, [player name], it is just us. What shall we do with you?
translation: 那么，[player name]，现在就剩我们了。我们该怎么处置你呢？

english: Your mind is like an open book to us. Your very essence laid bare before our sight.
translation: 你的心思对我们来说就像一本打开的书。你的本质在我们面前展露无遗。

english: You have great potential, [player name]. We should destroy you now, lest you interfere with our plans further.
translation: 你潜力很大，[player name]。我们本应现在就摧毁你，免得你进一步干扰我们的计划。

english: Or we could take you whole and make you an extension of our will.
translation: 或者我们可以把你整个吞噬，让你成为我们意志的延伸。

english: After millennia, this husk is almost spent and requires replacement. Yes, you will make an excellent host.
translation: 几千年过去了，这个空壳几乎耗尽，需要替换。是的，你会成为一个绝佳的宿主。

english: Never! I'll never serve you. I shall fight until my last breath before giving in.
translation: 绝不！我绝不会为你效劳。我会战斗到最后一口气，绝不屈服。

english: Yes, that's it, fight, fight with all your heart.
translation: 没错，就这样，战斗，全力战斗吧。

english: It's always so much sweeter when they resist us.
translation: 他们越是反抗，我们越是觉得甜美。

english: [player name], are you there? We've been having a few technical problems...
translation: [player name]，你在吗？我们遇到了一些技术问题……

english: Savant! Help me, please, for the love of Saradomin!
translation: 学者！救我，求你了，看在萨拉多明的份上！

english: By the gods! I'll get you out of there immediately! Initiating emergency teleport.
translation: 众神在上！我马上把你弄出来！启动紧急传送。

english: Come with us, [player name]. Come and be with us for all eternity.
translation: 跟我们走吧，[player name]。来与我们融为一体，直到永远。

english: Savant!
translation: 学者！

english: She's blocking my magic! One second, I'll try something else.
translation: 她在阻挡我的魔法！等一下，我试试别的办法。

english: Ahh, [player name], it is useless to resist. Now we shall become as one.
translation: 啊，[player name]，抵抗是没有用的。现在我们将合为一体。

english: Savant, now would be a good time!
translation: 学者，现在是时候了！

english: Right, I think I've got it this time. Just one more second.
translation: 好了，这次我想我搞定了。再等一秒。

english: [player name], are you there?
translation: [player name]，你在吗？

english: [player name], are you okay? Speak to me!
translation: [player name]，你还好吗？跟我说话！

english: Phew! Yes, Savant. That was too close for comfort.
translation: 呼！是的，学者。真是太险了。

english: Thank Saradomin!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明！

english: I thought we'd lost you there for a moment.
translation: 刚才我以为我们失去你了。

english: I think you'd better talk to Sir Tiffy about this.
translation: 我想你最好跟蒂菲爵士谈谈这件事。

english: Indeed. I'll just get my breath back first.
translation: 的确。我先喘口气。

english: Sir Tiffy, it's all gone horribly wrong!
translation: 蒂菲爵士，事情完全搞砸了！

english: Nonsense, dear gal, it can't be as bad as all that.
translation: 胡说，亲爱的姑娘，情况没那么糟。

english: Why don't you relax a little and tell Sir Tiffy what's wrong, hmm?
translation: 不如先放松一下，告诉蒂菲爵士到底出了什么事，嗯？

english: The town of Witchaven has been overrun by mind controlling sea slugs!
translation: 女巫港镇已经被能够控制心智的海蛞蝓占领了！

english: Hmm, go on.
translation: 嗯，继续说。

english: Well, the Mayor of the town was first, then brother Maledict, and finally Colonel O'Niall.
translation: 呃，先是镇长，然后是马勒迪克特修士，最后是奥尼尔上校。

english: Oh dear, that is a shame. Please go on.
translation: 哦天哪，真是太遗憾了。请继续。

english: Well, they tricked me into opening the prison that kept their Queen imprisoned.
translation: 呃，他们骗我打开了囚禁他们女王的监狱。

english: Ahh, the Mother Mallum. Dear-oh-dear, this isn't good news at all.
translation: 啊，马勒姆母亲。哎呀呀，这可不是什么好消息。

english: Well, it isn't all bad. I did manage to kill the Prince.
translation: 嗯，也不全是坏事。我确实杀了那个王子。

english: Excellent! That should delay her plans somewhat. If she follows the same pattern as last time, the important figures of Gielinor will be her next targets.
translation: 太好了！那应该会拖延她的计划一段时间。如果她跟上一次一样，吉莱诺的重要人物就是她的下一个目标。

english: That cannot be allowed to happen! What can we do about it?
translation: 绝不能允许这种事发生！我们能做些什么？

english: I think we are going to have to increase our surveillance somewhat.
translation: 我想我们得加强监视了。

english: Seeing as you already have a familiarity with the sea slugs, I am going to place you personally in charge of this mission.
translation: 既然你已经对海蛞蝓有所了解，我就亲自任命你负责这次任务。

english: If you think I'm ready for it, Sir Tiffy.
translation: 如果您觉得我准备好了，蒂菲爵士。

english: Of course you are, my gal.  Now you will need access to some of the more restricted resources of the Temple Knights.
translation: 当然准备好了，我的姑娘。现在你需要使用圣殿骑士的一些更机密的资源。

english: So, with immediate effect, I am promoting you within the Temple Knights. Congratulations!
translation: 所以，立即生效，我晋升你在圣殿骑士中的职位。

english: I only wish it were under better circumstances.
translation: 我只希望是在更好的情况下。

english: Wow! I am honoured.
translation: 哇！我深感荣幸。

english: Tish, pashaw and nonsense. It's about time you were rewarded for your work.
translation: 胡扯废话。早该奖励你的工作了。

english: Now, with this promotion comes some new responsibilities. In due time you will have access to the Temple Knight headquarters, but for now we need to collate our
translation: 现在，这次晋升带来了一些新职责。很快你就能进入圣殿骑士总部，但目前我们需要整理我们的

english: information and plan ahead.
translation: 信息并提前规划。

english: Report back to me in a little while and I'll have some new tasks for you.
translation: 过一会儿向我汇报，我会给你一些新任务。

english: Yes sir, I'll keep my eyes open for any signs of sea slug infiltration.
translation: 是的长官，我会时刻留意任何海蛞蝓渗透的迹象。

english: Good lass. Oh and Colonel O'Niall has been placed on our disavowed list. He should be considered extremely dangerous and is to be killed on sight.
translation: 好姑娘。对了，奥尼尔上校已被列入我们的否定名单。他应该被视为极度危险，见即杀。

english: Right, no problem. Well, I'll see you soon.
translation: 明白，没问题。好的，我很快会再来。

english: Ta ta, old bean.
translation: 再见，老伙计。

english: Boo hoo! Oh dear, my only daughter....
translation: 呜哇哇！天哪，我唯一的女儿……

english: Oh dear... my daughter, Ana, has gone missing in the desert. I fear that she is lost, or perhaps... *sob* even worse.
translation: 天哪……我的女儿安娜在沙漠里失踪了。我怕她迷路了，或者……*抽泣* 更糟的情况。

english: When did she go into the desert?
translation: 她是什么时候进入沙漠的？

english: *Sob* she went in there just a few days ago, *Sob* she said she would be back yesterday.
translation: *抽泣* 她几天前进去的，*抽泣* 她说昨天就会回来。

english: *Sob* And she's not...
translation: *抽泣* 但她没有……

english: I'll find her for you!
translation: 我会帮你找到她的！

english: Oh thank you! You've made me a very happy mother, I just hope it's not too late!
translation: 哦，谢谢你！你让我成了一个非常快乐的母亲，我只希望还来得及！

english: Do you have any ideas on where she may have gone?
translation: 你知道她可能去了哪里吗？

english: I did go looking for her myself and I came across some footprints just a little way south. I'm worried that they lead to the desert mining camp!
translation: 我确实自己去找过她，在南边不远处发现了一些脚印。我担心那些脚印通向沙漠采矿营！

english: Oh... Well I hope you find her.
translation: 哦……好吧，希望你能找到她。

english: Cheer up, it might never happen.
translation: 振作点，也许事情没那么糟。

english: It may already have happened you thoughtless oaf! My daughter, Ana, has gone missing in the desert. I fear that she is lost, or perhaps... *sobs* even worse.
translation: 你这没脑子的蠢货，事情可能已经发生了！我的女儿安娜在沙漠里失踪了。我怕她迷路了，或者……*抽泣* 更糟的情况。

english: Please bring my daughter back to me. She is most likely list in the Desert somewhere. I miss her so much... Wahhhhh! *Sob*
translation: 请把我的女儿带回来。她很可能在沙漠的某个地方迷路了。我好想她……哇啊啊！*抽泣*

english: Do you know where Ana went?
translation: 你知道安娜去了哪里吗？

english: I did look for her myself and a little way south. I came across some footprints which may be hers. I'm worried that she may have been caught by some guards and taken to work in that terrible desert mine to the south.
translation: 我确实自己找过她，在南边不远处发现了一些可能是她的脚印。我担心她可能被一些守卫抓住，带到南边那个可怕的沙漠矿场去干活了。

english: Is there anywhere around here that she would go?
translation: 这附近有什么她可能会去的地方吗？

english: I think she may have just gone a little way into the desert. It's unlike her to go too far away. She is an adventurous girl, but she knows how I worry. She wouldn't go too far.
translation: 我想她可能只是进了沙漠一小段路。她不太可能走得太远。她是个爱冒险的女孩，但她知道我会担心。她不会走太远的。

english: Where do you think I should start my search?
translation: 你觉得我应该从哪里开始搜索？

english: I think I saw some of her footprints to the south, you could start there. Hopefully she'll just be over a few sand dunes, but you never know. She may have been taken to that awful desert mining camp or captured by
translation: 我想我在南边看到了一些她的脚印，你可以从那里开始。希望她只是翻过了几座沙丘，但谁知道呢。她可能被带到了那个可怕的沙漠采矿营，或者被

english: brigands!
translation: 强盗抓住了！

english: It's just a mining camp. Prisoners are sent here from Al Kharid. They serve out their sentence by mining. Most prisoners will end their days here, surrounded by desert.
translation: 这只是一个采矿营。囚犯从阿尔卡里德城被送到这里。他们通过采矿来服刑。大多数囚犯都会在这里了此残生，被沙漠包围。

english: Destroy this low life desert rat guards!
translation: 干掉这个低贱的沙漠老鼠守卫！

english: Guards! Attack that Desert Jackal!
translation: 守卫们！攻击那只沙漠胡狼！

english: Kill that intruder guards!
translation: 守卫们，杀了那个入侵者！

english: Men! Kill this filthy vermin.
translation: 伙计们！杀了这个肮脏的害虫。

english: Kill this madman guards!
translation: 守卫们，杀了这个疯子！

english: Wow! A real captain!
translation: 哇！一个真正的船长！

english: Be off effendi, you are not wanted around here.
translation: 走开，先生，这里不欢迎你。

english: That's rude, I ought to teach you some manners.
translation: 真没礼貌，我得教教你规矩。

english: Oh yes! How might you do that? You seem little more than a gutter dweller. How could you teach me manners?
translation: 哦，是吗？你打算怎么做？你看起来不过是个下水道里的渣滓。你怎么教我规矩？

english: With my right fist and a good deal of force.
translation: 用我的右拳和足够的力量。

english: Oh yes, ready your weapon then! I'm sure you won't mind if my men join in? Har, har, har! Guards kill this gutter dwelling slime.
translation: 哦，是吗，那就准备好你的武器吧！我想你不会介意我的人一起上吧？哈，哈，哈！守卫们，杀了这个下水道里的烂泥。

english: Err, sorry. I thought I was talking to someone else.
translation: 呃，抱歉。我以为我在跟别人说话。

english: Well, Effendi, you do need to be careful of what you say to people. Or they may take it the wrong way. Thankfully, I'm very understanding. I'll just let my guards deal with you.
translation: 嗯，先生，你说话确实得小心点。否则别人可能会误会。谢天谢地，我很通情达理。我就让我的守卫来对付你吧。

english: Guards, teach this desert weed some manners.
translation: 守卫们，教教这棵沙漠杂草什么叫规矩。

english: I'd love to work for a tough guy like you!
translation: 我很乐意为像您这样的硬汉工作！

english: Hmmm, oh yes, what can you do?
translation: 嗯，哦，是吗，你能做什么？

english: I can mine!
translation: 我会采矿！

english: Ha, ha, ha! You come to a mining camp and offer us your mining skills! Thanks effendi, but we have all the miners we'll ever need.
translation: 哈，哈，哈！你跑到采矿营来向我们推销你的采矿技能！谢了，先生，但我们不缺矿工。

english: Now be off with you, before we reduce you to a bloody mess on the sand.
translation: 现在快走吧，免得我们把你打成肉酱扔在沙地上。

english: Can't I do something for a strong Captain like you?
translation: 我就不能为像您这样强大的船长做点什么吗？

english: You could bring me the head of Al Zaba Bhasim.
translation: 你可以把阿尔.扎巴.巴希姆的头带来给我。

english: He is the leader of the notorius desert bandits, they plague us daily. You should find them west of here. You should have no problem in finishing them all of. Do this for me and maybe I will consider helping you.
translation: 他是臭名昭著的沙漠强盗头子，他们天天骚扰我们。你应该在西边找到他们。你应该能轻松解决他们所有人。为我办成这件事，也许我会考虑帮你。

english: Good... run along then. You stand around flapping your tongue chatting like an insane camel.
translation: 好……那就快去吧。你站在这儿像只疯骆驼一样喋喋不休。

english: Sorry Sir, I don't think I can do that.
translation: 抱歉，先生，我想我做不到。

english: Hmm, well yes. I did consider you might not be right for the job. Be off with you then before I turn my men loose on you.
translation: 嗯，好吧。我确实想过你可能不适合这份工作。快走吧，不然我就让我的人收拾你。

english: It's a funny captain who can't fight his own battles!
translation: 一个连自己的仗都要别人打的船长可真有意思！

english: Very well, if you're challenging me, let's get on with it!
translation: 很好，如果你是在挑战我，那我们就来吧！

english: Okay, I'll be moving along then.
translation: 好吧，那我先走了。

english: Effendi, I think you'll find that is the wisest decision you have made today.
translation: 先生，我想你会发现这是你今天做出的最明智的决定。

english: How dare you talk to me like that! Explain your business quickly... or my guards will slay you where you stand.
translation: 你竟敢这样跟我说话！快说你的来意……否则我的守卫会当场杀了你。

english: We are not a charity effendi. Be off with you before I have your head removed from your body.
translation: 我们不是慈善机构，先生。快走吧，不然我就让人把你的头砍下来。

english: You don't scare me!
translation: 你吓不到我！

english: Well, perhaps I can try a little harder. Guards, kill this infidel.
translation: 好吧，也许我可以再努力一点。守卫们，杀了这个异教徒。

english: Effendi...
translation: 先生……

english: For just one second, imagine that it's none of your business!
translation: 就一秒钟，想象一下这不关你的事！

english: Also imagine having your limbs pulled from your body one at a time.
translation: 再想象一下你的四肢被一个一个地从身体上扯下来。

english: Now, what was the question again?
translation: 那么，刚才的问题是什么来着？

english: Do you have sand in your ears? I said. 'What are you guarding?'
translation: 你耳朵里进沙子了吗？我说的是：‘你在看守什么？’

english: Why... you ignorant, rude and eternally damned infidel,Guards, kill this infidel!
translation: 什么……你这个无知、无礼、永世不得超生的异教徒，守卫们，杀了这个异教徒！

english: Hey ugly!
translation: 嘿，丑八怪！

english: I will not tolerate such insults.. Guards, kill [him/her].
translation: 我无法容忍这种侮辱……守卫们，杀了[him/her]。

english: Prepare to die effendi!
translation: 准备受死吧，先生！

english: Take that you infidel!
translation: 接招吧，你这异教徒！

english: We're sick of having to kill every lunatic that comes along and insults the captain, it makes such a mess. Thankfully, he's a bit decrepit so he doesn't notice so please, buzz off and don't come here again.
translation: 我们厌倦了每次都要杀掉每个跑来侮辱船长的疯子，搞得一团糟。谢天谢地，他有点老糊涂了，所以没注意到，所以请你滚开，别再来了。

english: Are you mad effendi? This is your last chance! Leave now and never come back or I'll introduce you to my friend.
translation: 你疯了吗，先生？这是你最后的机会！现在离开，永远别再回来，否则我就让你见见我的朋友。

english: And we'll be pleased to clean the mess up after you've been dispatched.
translation: 而且我们很乐意在你被干掉后清理现场。

english: Okay, that does it!
translation: 好了，够了！

english: You're in serious trouble now!
translation: 你现在麻烦大了！

english: Okay men, we need to teach this person a lesson
translation: 好了，伙计们，我们需要给这个人上一课

english: about desert survival.
translation: 关于沙漠生存的课。

english: I am looking for Al Zaba Bhasim.
translation: 我在找阿尔.扎巴.巴希姆。

english: Huh! You have been talking to the guards at the mining camp. Or worse, that cowardly mercenary captain. Al Zaba Bhasim does not exist, he is a figment of their imagination!
translation: 哼！你肯定跟采矿营的守卫谈过话了。或者更糟，跟那个懦弱的雇佣兵队长谈过。阿尔.扎巴.巴希姆根本不存在，是他们凭空想象出来的！

english: Go back and tell this captain that if he wants to find this man he should search for him personally. See how much of his own time he would like to waste.
translation: 回去告诉这位船长，如果他想找到这个人，就应该亲自去搜索他。看看他愿意浪费自己多少时间。

english: I've already explained that he doesn't exist. Now, can we move on?
translation: 我已经解释过他不存在了。现在，我们能继续了吗？

english: I've some information for you about Al Zaba Bhasim
translation: 我有一些关于阿尔.扎巴.巴希姆的情报要告诉你。

english: Oh yes and what might that be?
translation: 哦，是吗，那是什么？

english: Al Zaba Bhasim is a figment of your diseased imagination. Go look for him yourself and waste your own time if you think he still exists.
translation: 阿尔.扎巴.巴希姆是你那病态脑子里的幻想。如果你觉得他还存在，就自己去找他，浪费你自己的时间。

english: Why, I've never been so insulted in all my days. Prepare to defend yourself wretch, I'll run you through myself!
translation: 什么，我这辈子从没受过这种侮辱。准备自卫吧，混蛋，我要亲手捅穿你！

english: Move along now, we've had enough of your sort!
translation: 快走吧，我们受够你这种人了！

english: -- The guard snorts. --*Snort* Just about anyonewho talks to him.
translation: -- 守卫哼了一声。--*哼* 几乎任何跟他说话的人都行。

english: Well, if you have to know, we're making sure that no prisoners get out.-- The guard gives you adisapproving look. --And to make sure thatunauthorised people don't get in.
translation: 好吧，如果你非要知道，我们在确保没有囚犯逃出去。-- 守卫不赞同地看了你一眼。--还要确保未经授权的人进不来。

english: -- The guard looks around nervously. --You'd bettergo soon before the Captain orders us to kill you.
translation: -- 守卫紧张地环顾四周。--你最好快点走，免得船长下令让我们杀了你。

english: Well, it certainly will help...-- The guard takes the fivegold coins. --Now then, what did you want to know?
translation: 嗯，这确实有帮助...-- 守卫收下五枚金币。--那么，你想知道什么？

english: Okay, if you win, you'll get 30 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guardwalks off. --
translation: 好吧，如果你赢了，就能拿回30金币。不管怎样，我得走了，我还有工作要做。-- 守卫走开了。--

english: Well, you've killed our Captain. I guess you've proved yourself in combat. But you've left a horrible mess now. And it's gonna cost you for us to clean it up. Let's say 20 gold and we won't have to get rough with you?
translation: 好吧，你杀了我们的船长。我猜你在战斗中证明了自己。但这下搞得一团糟。要我们清理可要你花钱。就20金币吧，我们就不用对你动粗了？

english: The guards starts to do some mental calculations. Youcan see his brow furrow and he starts to sweatprofusely.
translation: 守卫开始心算。你看到他眉头紧锁，开始大汗淋漓。

english: 20 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 10 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guardswalk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 20金币清理烂摊子。你赢了10金币！干得好..！哈，哈，哈哈！-- 守卫们咯咯笑着走开了。--

english: Ok, if you win, you'll get 6 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guard walksoff. --
translation: 好，如果你赢了，就能拿回6金币。不管怎样，我得走了，我还有工作要做。-- 守卫走开了。--

english: Hey, they're interesting clothes!
translation: 嘿，这些衣服真有趣！

english: You're no slave.
translation: 你不是奴隶。

english: What are you doing in here?
translation: 你在这干什么？

english: Good! Seeya, we have some cleaning to do.
translation: 好！再见，我们有些清理工作要做。

english: Okay, that's it, we're gonna teach you a lesson.
translation: 好了，就这样，我们要给你点教训。

english: Okay, if you win, you'll get 19 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guardwalks off. --
translation: 好吧，如果你赢了，就能拿回19金币。不管怎样，我得走了，我还有工作要做。-- 守卫走开了。--

english: Okay, if you win, you'll get 12 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.-- The guardwalks off. --
translation: 好吧，如果你赢了，就能拿回12金币。不管怎样，我得走了，我还有工作要做。-- 守卫走开了。--

english: Okay, we'll take fifteen, you push a hard bargain!
translation: 好吧，我们收十五，你真会讨价还价！

english: Five gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 1 Gold piece! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guardswalk off chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 5金币清理烂摊子。你赢了1金币！干得好..！哈，哈，哈哈！-- 守卫们咯咯笑着走开了。--

english: 15 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 4 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walkoff chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 15金币清理烂摊子。你赢了4金币！干得好..！哈，哈，哈哈！-- 守卫们咯咯笑着走开了。--

english: Guards! Guards!
translation: 守卫！守卫！

english: You don't have the gold and now we're gonna teach you a lesson.
translation: 你没金币，现在我们要给你点教训。

english: Right, we'll have that key off you!
translation: 好，我们要拿走你身上的钥匙！

english: I heard that! So you used a key did you?!
translation: 我听到了！所以你用了钥匙是吧？！

english: 10 gold for cleaning up the mess. You have won 2 Gold pieces! Well done..! Ha, ha, ha ha!-- The guards walkoff chuckling to themselves. --
translation: 10金币清理烂摊子。你赢了2金币！干得好..！哈，哈，哈哈！-- 守卫们咯咯笑着走开了。--

english: I heard that! So you managed to sneak in did you!
translation: 我听到了！所以你偷偷溜进来了是吧！

english: Oi, what are you two doing?
translation: 喂，你们俩在干什么？

english: Move along now... we've had enough of your sort!
translation: 快走吧……我们受够你这种人了！

english: Hmm, well yes, I did consider that you might not be right for the job. Be off with you then before I turn my men loose on you.
translation: 嗯，好吧，我确实考虑过你可能不适合这份工作。趁我还没让手下收拾你，赶紧滚吧。

english: He is the leader of the notorius desert bandits, they plague us daily. You should find them west of here. You should have no problem in finishing them all off. Do this for me and maybe I will consider helping you.
translation: 他是臭名昭著的沙漠强盗头子，他们天天来骚扰我们。你该到西边去找他们。你应该能轻松解决他们。替我做这件事，我或许会考虑帮你。

english: Oh yes, ready your weapon then! I'm sure you won't mind if my men join in? Har, har, har! Guards, kill this gutter dwelling slime.
translation: 哦是吗，那就准备好你的武器！想必你不介意我的人一起上吧？哈，哈，哈！守卫们，杀了这个阴沟里的渣滓。

english: I will not tolerate such insults.. Guards, kill him.
translation: 我不能容忍这种侮辱..守卫，杀了他。

english: Why... you ignorant, rude and eternally damned infidel,-- The Captain is very angry at what you just said. --Guards, kill this infidel!
translation: 为什么...你这个无知、粗鲁、永远该死的异教徒，-- 船长对你刚才的话非常生气。--守卫们，杀了这个异教徒！

english: We are not a charity effendi, Be off with you before I have your head removed from your body.
translation: 我们不是慈善机构，先生。趁我还没砍掉你的脑袋，赶紧滚。

english: I will not tolerate such insults.. Guards, kill her.
translation: 我不能容忍这种侮辱..守卫，杀了她。

english: Hey there, what do you want?
translation: 嘿，你想要什么？

english: Of course not, you'd be doing me out of a job. Anyway, you haven't got any barrels that need to go to the surface.
translation: 当然不行，你想让我失业吗？再说，你也没有需要运到地面的桶。

english: Now, move along and get some work done before you get a good beating.
translation: 现在，赶紧去干活，免得挨一顿好打。

english: It is quite clearly a lift. Any fool can see that it's used to transport rock to the surface.
translation: 这很明显是个升降机。任何傻瓜都看得出它是用来把岩石运到地面的。

english: Hey, you'd better go and operate that lift yourself if you want that big heavy barrel to go anywhere.
translation: 嘿，如果你想让那个又大又重的桶动起来，你最好自己去操作那个升降机。

english: Hey - you with the weapon!
translation: 嘿——那个拿武器的人！

english: You're not allowed in here!
translation: 你不能进来！

english: Quick, men, get [him/her]!!
translation: 快，伙计们，抓住[him/her]！！

english: Into the cell you go! I hope this teaches you a lesson.
translation: 进牢房去吧！希望这能给你个教训。

english: Don't trouble me, can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 别烦我，没看见我正忙着吗？

english: You look like a new 'recruit'. How long have you been here?
translation: 你看起来像个新‘招募’的。你在这里多久了？

english: I've just arrived.
translation: 我刚到。

english: Yeah, it looks like it as well. It's a shame that I won't be around long enough to get to know you. I'm making a break for it today. I have a plan to get out of here! It's amazing in its sophistication.
translation: 是啊，看起来也是。可惜我没时间跟你混熟了。我今天就要逃出去。我有个计划能离开这里！这计划精妙绝伦。

english: What are those big wooden doors in the corner of the compound?
translation: 营地角落里那些大木门是干什么的？

english: They lead to an underground mine, but you really don't want to go down there.
translation: 它们通向一个地下矿场，但你真不想去那里。

english: I've only seen slaves and guards go down there, I never see the slaves come back up. At least up here you have a nice view and a bit of sun.-- The slave smiles at you and goes back to his work. --
translation: 我只见过奴隶和守卫下去，从没见过奴隶上来。至少在上面你还能看看风景，晒晒太阳。——奴隶对你笑了笑，然后回去干活了。——

english: Oh yes, that sounds interesting.
translation: 哦，是的，听起来很有趣。

english: Yes, it is actually. I have all the details figured out except for one.
translation: 是的，确实如此。除了一个细节，其他我都想好了。

english: -- The slave rattles the chains on his arms loudly. --These bracelets, I can't seem to get them off. If I could get them off, I'd be able to climb my way out of here.
translation: ——奴隶大声晃了晃手臂上的锁链。——这些手镯，我好像弄不下来。如果能弄下来，我就能爬出去了。

english: I can try to undo them for you.
translation: 我可以试着帮你解开。

english: Really, that would be great...-- The slave looks at you strangely. --Hang on a minute... I suppose you want something for doing this?
translation: 真的吗，那太好了……——奴隶奇怪地看着你。——等等……我想你是想要点好处吧？

english: The last time I did a trade in this place, I nearly lost the shirt from my back!
translation: 上次我在这里做交易，差点连衬衫都赔进去了！

english: It's funny you should say that actually.
translation: 你这么说还真有意思。

english: -- The slave looks at you blankly. --
translation: ——奴隶茫然地看着你。——

english: Yeah, go on!
translation: 好，继续吧！

english: If I can get the chains off, you have to give me something, okay?
translation: 如果我能把锁链解开，你得给我点东西，行吗？

english: Sure, what do you want?
translation: 当然，你想要什么？

english: I want your clothes!
translation: 我要你的衣服！

english: Blimey!
translation: 哎呀！

english: I can dress like a slave and gain access to the mine area to scout it out.
translation: 我可以打扮成奴隶，进入矿区侦查。

english: You're either incredibly brave or incredibly stupid. But what would I wear if you take my clothes? Get me some nice desert clothes and I'll think about it?
translation: 你要么特别勇敢，要么特别愚蠢。但你要是拿走我的衣服，我穿什么？给我弄些好看的沙漠服装，我会考虑的？

english: That sounds awful.
translation: 听起来糟透了。

english: Yeah, bunch of no hopers, tried to rob me blind. But I guess that's what you get when you deal with convicts.
translation: 是啊，一群没指望的家伙，想把我洗劫一空。但我想跟罪犯打交道就是这样。

english: That's ridiculous, you're talking rubbish.
translation: 太荒唐了，你在胡说八道。

english: No, it's true, I can make a break for it If I can just get these bracelets off.
translation: 不，是真的，只要我能弄掉这些手铐，我就能逃跑。

english: Thanks... same to you.
translation: 谢啦……你也是。

english: Oh, that's a shame...
translation: 哦，真可惜……

english: Still, 'worse things happen at sea right?'
translation: 不过，'海上还有更糟的事'对吧？

english: You've obviously never worked as a slave
translation: 你显然没当过奴隶

english: ...in a mining camp...
translation: ……在一个采矿营……

english: ...in the middle of the desert.
translation: ……在沙漠中央。

english: Well I suppose I'd better be getting on my way now...
translation: 好吧，我想我该走了……

english: -- The slave nods in agreement and goes back to work. --
translation: ——奴隶点头同意，然后继续干活。——

english: Oh, I've been here ages.
translation: 哦，我来这儿很久了。

english: That's funny, I haven't seen you around here before. You're clothes look too clean for you to have been here ages.
translation: 真有意思，我以前没见过你。你的衣服太干净了，不像是待了很久的人。

english: Okay, you caught me out.
translation: 好吧，被你发现了。

english: Ah ha! I knew it! A new recruit then? It's a shame that I won't be around long enough to get to know you. I'm making a break for it today.
translation: 啊哈！我就知道！是新来的？可惜我不能久留认识你了。我今天就要逃跑。

english: I have a plan to get out of here! It's amazing in its sophistication.
translation: 我有逃出这里的计划！精妙绝伦。

english: The guards allow me to clean my clothes.
translation: 守卫允许我清洗衣服。

english: Oh, a special relationship with the guards heh? How very nice of them. Maybe you could persuade them to let me out of here?
translation: 哦，跟守卫关系特殊是吧？他们真好。也许你能说服他们放我出去？

english: Hello again, do you want to try and unlock my chains? I'd really appreciate it!
translation: 又见面了，你想试试解开我的锁链吗？我会很感激的！

english: Yeah, okay, let's give it a go.
translation: 好，行，咱们试试。

english: Are you givin' in already?
translation: 你这就放弃了吗？

english: I just want to try something else.
translation: 我只是想试试别的办法。

english: Okay, if you want to try again, let me know.
translation: 好吧，如果你想再试，告诉我。

english: Great! You did it! Do you want to trade clothes now?
translation: 太好了！你做到了！现在要交换衣服吗？

english: Yes, I'll trade.
translation: 是的，我换。

english: I need a desert robe, a desert shirt and desert boots if you want these clothes off me.
translation: 如果你想要我身上的衣服，我需要一件沙漠长袍、一件沙漠衬衣和一双沙漠靴。

english: I need a desert robe and a desert shirt if you want these clothes off me.
translation: 如果你想要我身上的衣服，我需要一件沙漠长袍和一件沙漠衬衣。

english: I need a desert robe and desert boots if you want these clothes off me.
translation: 如果你想要我身上这些衣服，我需要一件沙漠长袍和沙漠靴。

english: I need a desert shirt and desert boots if you want these clothes off me.
translation: 如果你想要我身上这些衣服，我需要一件沙漠衬衣和沙漠靴。

english: I need a desert robe if you want these clothes off me.
translation: 如果你想要我身上这些衣服，我需要一件沙漠长袍。

english: I need desert boots if you want these clothes off me.
translation: 如果你想要我身上这些衣服，我需要沙漠靴。

english: I need a desert shirt if you want these clothes off me.
translation: 如果你想要我身上这些衣服，我需要一件沙漠衬衣。

english: Great! You have the Desert Clothes!-- The slave starts undressing right in front of you --Okay, here's the clothes, I won't need them anymore.
translation: 太好了！你有沙漠衣服了。——奴隶就在你面前开始脱衣服——好了，衣服给你，我不再需要它们了。

english: Right, I'm off! Good luck!
translation: 好了，我走了！祝你好运！

english: Yeah, good luck to you too!
translation: 是啊，也祝你好运！

english: Okay, fair enough, let me know if you change your mind though.
translation: 好吧，说得过去，如果你改变主意了就跟我说。

english: I need to do some other things first.
translation: 我得先做点别的事。

english: Okay, fair enough. Let me know when you want to give it another go.
translation: 好吧，说得过去。你想再试一次的时候就跟我说。

english: Do you still want to try and undo the locks for me?
translation: 你还想帮我解开锁吗？

english: Not much to do here but mine all day long.
translation: 整天除了采矿也没什么可做的。

english: Do you have the Desert Clothes yet?
translation: 你拿到沙漠衣服了吗？

english: Oh bother, I was caught by the guards again... Listen, if you can get me some Desert Clothes, I'll trade you for my slaves clothes again.. Do you want to trade?
translation: 哦，真烦，我又被守卫抓住了……听着，如果你能给我弄些沙漠衣服，我就再用我的奴隶衣服跟你换……你想交易吗？

english: Oh oh!
translation: 哦哦！

english: Great! You have the Desert Clothes!-- The slave startsundressing right in front of you --Okay, here's theclothes, I won't need them anymore.
translation: 太好了！你有沙漠衣服！——奴隶开始在你面前脱衣服——好了，这是衣服，我不再需要它们了。

english: -- The slave rattles the chains on his arms loudly. --These bracelets, I can't seem to get them off. If Icould get them off, I'd be able to climb my way out ofhere.
translation: ——奴隶大声摇晃着手臂上的锁链。——这些手镯，我好像摘不下来。如果能摘下来，我就能爬出这里了。

english: Really, that would be great...-- The slave looks at youstrangely. --Hang on a minute... I suppose you wantsomething for doing this?
translation: 真的吗，那太好了……——奴隶奇怪地看着你。——等一下……我想你是想要点什么作为回报吧？

english: I've only seen slaves and guards go down there, I never see the slaves come back up. At least up here you have a nice view and a bit of sun.-- The slavesmiles at you and goes back to his work. --
translation: 我只见过奴隶和守卫下去，从没见过奴隶回来。至少在这里，你还能看到不错的风景和一点阳光。——奴隶对你笑了笑，然后回去继续工作。——

english: -- The slave nods in agreement and goes back towork. --
translation: ——奴隶点头同意，然后回去继续工作。——

english: Hey, you're in for a good beating!
translation: 嘿，你欠揍！

english: I'm gonna teach you some respect!
translation: 我要教教你什么叫尊重！

english: Oi! Are you looking at me!
translation: 喂！你在看我吗！

english: Oi! I'm gonna give you some trouble!
translation: 喂！我要给你点颜色看看！

english: You wanna piece of me?
translation: 你想跟我打一架？

english: I could have sworn I heard something!
translation: 我发誓我听到了什么声音！

english: Hey, that Barrel looks heavy, do you need a hand?
translation: 嘿，那个桶看起来很重，需要帮忙吗？

english: Blimey! This is heavy!
translation: 天哪！这真重！

english: Oh, right, how very nice of you to say so.-- The guard seems flattered. --
translation: 哦，好吧，你这么说真是太好了。——守卫似乎很受宠若惊。——

english: Oh, there's no one operating the lift up top, hope this barrel isn't urgent? You'd better get back to work!
translation: 哦，上面没人操作升降机，希望这桶东西不急？你最好回去工作！

english: ~ The guard looks around, surprised at Ana's outburst.~What was that?
translation: ~守卫环顾四周，对安娜的爆发感到惊讶。~那是什么声音？

english: Anyway, let's get this barrel up to the surface, plenty more work for you to do!
translation: 总之，我们把这桶东西运到地面上去吧，你还有很多活要干！

english: Er nothing really.
translation: 呃，没什么。

english: Okay... so move along and get on with your work.
translation: 好吧……那就继续干活去。

english: I'd like to mine in a different area.
translation: 我想换个地方采矿。

english: Oh, you want to work in another area of the mine eh?--The guard seems pleased with his rhetorical question.--Well, I can understand that! A change is as good as a rest they say.
translation: 哦，你想去矿场的另一个区域干活，嗯？——守卫似乎对自己这个反问很满意。——嗯，我能理解！俗话说，换个环境当休息。

english: Huh, fat chance of a rest for me.
translation: 哼，我可没机会休息。

english: You miserable whelp! Get back to work!
translation: 你这可怜的小崽子！回去干活！

english: Yes sir, you're quite right sir.
translation: 是的，长官，您说得对，长官。

english: Of course I'm right. And what goes around comes around as they say. And it's been absolutely ages since I've had anything different to eat.
translation: 我当然是对的。俗话说，善有善报。而且我已经很久没吃过什么不一样的东西了。

english: What I wouldn't give for some whole, fresh, ripe and juicy pineapple for a change. And those Tenti's have the best pineapple in this entire area.
translation: 我多想换换口味，吃个完整、新鲜、成熟又多汁的菠萝啊。那些坦提人种的菠萝是整个地区最好的。

english: I'm sure you get my meaning...
translation: 我想你明白我的意思……

english: How am I going to get some pineapples around here?
translation: 我在这附近怎么弄到菠萝呢？

english: Well, that's not my problem is it? Also, I know that you slaves trade your items down here. I'm sure that if you're resourceful enough, you'll come up with the goods.
translation: 嗯，那是你的问题，不是我的。而且，我知道你们奴隶在这下面互相交易东西。我相信只要你够机灵，总能搞到货的。

english: Now, get along and do some work, before we're both in for it. And remember, I prefer my pineapples whole, not chopped up with all the juice gone.
translation: 现在，去干点活吧，免得我们俩都倒霉。记住，我喜欢完整的菠萝，不要切碎、汁水都流掉的那种。

english: Yes sir, we understand each other perfectly.
translation: 是的，长官，我们彼此心照不宣。

english: Okay, good then. And remember, I prefer my pineapples whole, not chopped up with all the juice gone.
translation: 好吧，那就好。记住，我喜欢完整的菠萝，不要切碎、汁水都流掉的那种。

english: What are the Tenti's?
translation: 坦提人是什么？

english: Well! You don't come from around here do you? The Tenti's are the nomadic people west of here. They live in tents, so we call them the Tenti's. They have great pineapples! I'm sure you get my meaning?
translation: 嗯！你不是这附近的人吧？坦提人是西边游牧的民族。他们住在帐篷里，所以我们叫他们坦提人。他们种的菠萝很棒！我想你明白我的意思？

english: Do you know where I could get a tenti pineapple?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能弄到坦提菠萝吗？

english: Oooh, sir is looking for a really very special item then! You must go and talk to our very illustrious leader, Al Shabim. He's located in the largest tent in our village.
translation: 哦哦，先生想要的东西可真不一般！你得去找我们非常杰出的领袖，阿尔.沙比姆。他就在我们村子最大的帐篷里。

english: Oooh, madam is looking for a really very special item then! You must go and talk to our very illustrious leader, Al Shabim. He's located in the largest tent in our village.
translation: 哦哦，夫人是在找一件非常特别的物品啊！你得去和我们那位非常杰出的领袖，阿尔.沙比姆谈谈。他在我们村子里最大的帐篷里。

english: I am Al Shabim, greetings on behalf of the Bedabin nomads. Now... what can I do for you?
translation: 我是阿尔.沙比姆，代表贝达宾游牧民族向你致意。那么……我能为你做点什么？

english: I am looking for a pineapple.
translation: 我在找一个菠萝。

english: Oh yes, well that is interesting. Our sweet pineapples are renowned throughout the whole of Kharid ! And I'll give you one if you do me a favour?
translation: 哦，是的，那很有趣。我们的糖果菠萝在整个阿尔卡里德城都很有名！如果你帮我一个忙，我就给你一个。

english: Captain Siad at the mining camp is holding some secret information. It is very important to us and we would like you to get it for us. It gives details of an interesting, yet ancient weapon.
translation: 采矿营地的西亚德船长掌握着一些秘密信息。这对我们非常重要，我们希望你能把它弄到手。那里面详细记载了一种有趣而古老的武器。

english: We would gladly share this information with you. All you have to do is gain access to his private room upstairs. We have a key for the chest that contains this information. Are you interested in our deal?
translation: 我们很乐意与你分享这些信息。你只需要进入他楼上的私人房间。我们有打开存放这些信息的箱子的钥匙。你对这笔交易感兴趣吗？

english: Yes, I'm interested.
translation: 是的，我感兴趣。

english: That's great Effendi!
translation: 太好了，阁下！

english: Here is a copy of the key that should give you access to the chest.
translation: 这是一把钥匙的复制品，应该能让你打开那个箱子。

english: Bring us back the plans inside the chest, they should be sealed. All haste to you Effendi!
translation: 把箱子里的图纸带回来给我们，它们应该是密封的。速去速回，阁下！

english: Very well Effendi!
translation: 很好，阁下！

english: How are things going Effendi?
translation: 事情进展如何，阁下？

english: I've lost the key!
translation: 我把钥匙弄丢了！

english: How very careless of you! Here is another key, don't lose it this time !
translation: 你也太不小心了！这是另一把钥匙，这次别再弄丢了！

english: Very well, good day Effendi!
translation: 很好，日安，阁下！

english: I wanted to have a chat?
translation: 我想跟你聊聊？

english: You don't belong in here, get out!
translation: 你不该在这里，出去！

english: But I just need two minutes of your time?
translation: 但我只需要你两分钟时间？

english: Well, okay, but very quickly. I am a very busy person you know!
translation: 嗯，好吧，但快点说。我可是个大忙人，你知道的！

english: Well, er... erm, I err....
translation: 嗯，呃……呃，我呃……

english: Come on, spit it out! Right that's it! Guards!
translation: 快点，有话直说！够了！守卫！

english: Hey, you there!
translation: 嘿，你！

english: You're in some serious trouble now!
translation: 你现在麻烦大了！

english: Oh my, a dragon just flew straight past your window!
translation: 哦天哪，有条龙刚刚从你窗户飞过去了！

english: Really! Where? I don't see any dragons young [man/lady]? Now, please get out of my office, I have work to do.
translation: 真的吗！在哪？我没看到什么龙啊，年轻人？现在，请离开我的办公室，我还有工作要做。

english: You seem to have a lot of books!
translation: 你好像有很多书！

english: Yes, I do. Now please get to the point?
translation: 是的，我有很多。现在请说重点？

english: How long have you been interested in books?
translation: 你对书感兴趣多久了？

english: Long enough to know when someone is stalling!
translation: 久到能看出有人在拖延时间！

english: Please state your business or get out!
translation: 请说明你的来意，否则就出去！

english: I could get you some books!
translation: 我可以给你弄些书来！

english: Oh, really!
translation: 哦，真的吗！

english: Sorry, not interested!
translation: 抱歉，没兴趣！

english: So, you're interested in sailing?
translation: 所以，你对航海感兴趣？

english: Well, yes actually... It's been a passion of mine for some years...
translation: 嗯，是的，实际上……这是我多年的爱好……

english: I could tell by the cut of your jib.
translation: 从你的帆形就能看出来。

english: Oh yes? Really?
translation: 哦，是吗？真的？

english: Well, I was quite a catch in my day you know!
translation: 嗯，我当年可是很抢手的，你知道吧！

english: Not much sailing to be done around here though?
translation: 不过在这附近没什么航海的机会吧？

english: Well of course there isn't, we're surrounded by desert. Now, why are you here exactly?
translation: 当然没有，我们周围都是沙漠。现在，你到底为什么来这里？

english: What's it got to do with you?
translation: 关你什么事？

english: This happens to be my office. Now explain yourself before I run you through!
translation: 这里恰好是我的办公室。在我把你捅穿之前，最好解释清楚！

english: I'm here to take your plans, hand them over now or I'll kill you!
translation: 我是来拿你的图纸的，现在交出来，否则我就杀了你！

english: The guard downstairs said you were lonely.
translation: 楼下的守卫说你很孤独。

english: Well, I most certainly am not lonely!
translation: 哼，我一点也不孤独！

english: I'm an incredibly busy man you know! Now, get to the point, what do you want?
translation: 我可是个大忙人，你知道的！现在，说重点，你想要什么？

english: I need to service your chest.
translation: 我需要维修你的箱子。

english: You need to what?
translation: 你需要什么？

english: I need to service your chest?
translation: 我需要维修你的箱子？

english: There's nothing wrong with the chest, it's fine, now get out!
translation: 箱子没问题，好得很，现在出去！

english: I'll teach you a lesson!
translation: 我要教训教训你！

english: All the slaves have broken free!
translation: 所有奴隶都逃跑了！

english: Don't talk rubbish, the warning siren isn't sounding. Now state your business before I have you thrown out.
translation: 别说废话，警报又没响。在我叫人把你扔出去之前，快说你的来意。

english: Fire! Fire!
translation: 着火了！着火了！

english: Where's the fire? I don't see any fire? Stop messing me around and state your business!
translation: 哪里着火了？我没看到任何火？别耍我，快说你的来意！

english: It's down in the lower mines, sound the alarm!
translation: 在下层矿场，快拉警报！

english: You go and sound the alarm, I can't see anything wrong with the mine. Have you seen the fire yourself?
translation: 你去拉警报，我看矿场没什么问题。你亲眼看到火了吗？

english: Yes actually!
translation: 是的，我看到了！

english: Well, why didn't you raise the alarm?
translation: 那你为什么不拉警报？

english: I don't know where the alarm is.
translation: 我不知道警报在哪。

english: That's the most ridiculous thing I've heard. Who are you? Where do you come from? It doesn't matter... Guards! Show this person out!
translation: 这是我听过最荒谬的事。你是谁？你从哪来？算了……守卫！把这个人带出去！

english: I was so concerned for your safety that I rushed to save you.
translation: 我太担心你的安全了，所以赶紧来救你。

english: Well, that's very good of you. But as you can see, I am very fine and well thanks! Now, please leave so that I can get back to my work.
translation: 嗯，你真是太好了。但你看，我很好，谢谢！现在请离开，让我回去工作吧。

english: Er, no, one of the slaves told me.
translation: 呃，不，是一个奴隶告诉我的。

english: Well... you can't believe them, they're all a bunch of convicts. Anyway, it doesn't look as if there is a fire down there. So I'm going to get on with my work. Please remove yourself from my office.
translation: 嗯……你不能相信他们，他们全是一群罪犯。不管怎样，下面看起来并没有火灾。所以我要继续工作了。请离开我的办公室。

english: Oh yes, you're right, they must have put it out!
translation: 哦，你说得对，他们一定已经扑灭了！

english: Good, now perhaps you can leave me in peace? After all I do have some work to do.
translation: 很好，现在你能让我安静一下吗？毕竟我还有些工作要做。

english: Er, yes okay then.
translation: 呃，好吧。

english: Good! Please remove yourself from my office.
translation: 很好！请离开我的办公室。

english: I don't have time to talk to you. Move along please!
translation: 我没时间跟你说话。请让开！

english: Okay, that's it, get out! Guards!
translation: 好了，够了，出去！守卫！

english: Really! Where? I don't see any dragons young man? Now, please get out of my office, I have work to do.
translation: 真的！在哪？我没看到任何龙啊，年轻人？现在，请离开我的办公室，我还有工作要做。

english: Really! Where? I don't see any dragons young lady? Now, please get out of my office, I have work to do.
translation: 真的！在哪？我没看到任何龙啊，年轻女士？现在，请离开我的办公室，我还有工作要做。

english: Aha! I see you have the plans. This is great! However, these plans do indeed look very technical. My people have further need of your skills.
translation: 啊哈！我看到你拿到了图纸。太好了！不过这些图纸看起来确实很专业。我的人还需要你的技能。

english: If you can help us to manufacture this item, we will share its secret with you. Does this deal interest you effendi?
translation: 如果你能帮我们制造这件物品，我们会与你分享它的秘密。阁下对这个交易感兴趣吗？

english: Yes, I'm very interested.
translation: 是的，我很感兴趣。

english: Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze, 10 feathers and a hammer. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: 太好了，我们需要以下物品：一块纯青铜锭、10根羽毛和一把锤子。把它们带来给我，我们就可以继续制造这件物品了。

english: Great, we need the following items: a bar of pure bronze and 10 feathers. Bring them to me and we'll continue to make the item.
translation: 太好了，我们需要以下物品：一块纯青铜锭和10根羽毛。把它们带来给我，我们就可以继续制造这件物品了。

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一块青铜锭。现在我们只需要一些羽毛和一把锤子就可以继续了。

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze and a hammer before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛。现在我们只需要一块青铜锭和一把锤子就可以继续了。

english: Great, I can see that you have a bar of bronze. Now we just need some feathers before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一块青铜锭。现在我们只需要一些羽毛就可以继续了。

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers. Now we just need a bar of bronze before we can continue.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛。现在我们只需要一块青铜锭就可以继续了。

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers and a bar of Bronze, but you just need a hammer now.
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛和一块青铜锭，但你现在只需要一把锤子。

english: Great, I can see that you have some feathers, a bar of Bronze and a hammer. Are you still willing to help make the weapon?
translation: 太好了，我看到你有一些羽毛、一块青铜锭和一把锤子。你还愿意帮忙制造武器吗？

english: Yes, I'm kind of curious.
translation: 是的，我有点好奇。

english: Okay Effendi, you need to follow the plans. You will need some special tools for this... There is an anvil in the other tent. You have my permission to use it, but show the plans to the guard.
translation: 好的，阁下，你需要按照图纸操作。你需要一些特殊工具……另一个帐篷里有一个铁砧。我允许你使用它，但要把图纸给守卫看。

english: You have the plans and all the items needed. You should be able to complete the item on your own. Please bring me the item when it is finished.
translation: 你有了图纸和所有需要的物品。你应该能自己完成这件物品。完成后请把它带给我。

english: As you wish Effendi!
translation: 如您所愿，阁下！

english: Come back if you change your mind!
translation: 如果你改变主意，随时回来！

english: Sorry, this is a private tent, no one is allowed in. Orders of Al Shabim...
translation: 抱歉，这是私人帐篷，任何人不得入内。阿尔.沙比姆的命令……

english: Al Shabim said I could enter, here are the plans!
translation: 阿尔.沙比姆说我可以用，这是图纸！

english: Okay go ahead.
translation: 好吧，进去吧。

english: Okay, you can go in, Al Shabim has told me about you.
translation: 好吧，你可以进去了，阿尔.沙比姆跟我提起过你。

english: Hmm, those plans look interesting. Go and show them to Al Shabim... I'm sure he'll be pleased to see them.
translation: 嗯，那些图纸看起来很有意思。拿去给阿尔.沙比姆看看吧……我相信他会很高兴看到的。

english: Oh, I remember you; yeah go on in. Hope the weapon construction is going okay.
translation: 哦，我记得你；进去吧。希望武器制造进展顺利。

english: Sorry, but I have no use for that!
translation: 抱歉，那个我用不上！

english: I can only let someone in who has plans for the secret weapon.
translation: 我只让有秘密武器图纸的人进去。

english: Sorry, no one is allowed to enter.
translation: 抱歉，任何人不得入内。

english: This is truly fantastic Effendi!
translation: 这真是太棒了，阁下！

english: We will take the technical plans for the weapon as well.
translation: 我们也要拿走武器的技术图纸。

english: We are forever grateful for this gift. My advisors have discovered some secrets which we will share with you.
translation: 我们永远感激这份礼物。我的顾问们发现了一些秘密，我们将与你分享。

english: Please accept this selection of six bronze throwing darts as a token of our appreciation.
translation: 请接受这六枚青铜飞镖，作为我们的一点心意。

english: I'll take that key off your hands as well effendi! Many thanks!
translation: 那把钥匙我也要收走，阁下！非常感谢！

english: Oh, and here is your pineapple!
translation: 哦，还有你的菠萝！

english: Here is another pineapple, try not to lose this one.
translation: 这是另一个菠萝，别再弄丢了。

english: Okay Effendi, you need to follow the plans. You will need some special tools for this...  There is an anvil in the other tent. You have my permission to use it, but show the plans to the guard.
translation: 好的，先生，你得按照图纸来。你需要一些特殊工具……另一个帐篷里有个铁砧。我允许你使用它，但要把图纸给守卫看。

english: Oh yes, well that is interesting. Our sweet pineapples are renowned throughout the whole of Kharid ! And I'll give you one if you do me a favour?
translation: 哦，是的，那很有趣。我们的糖果菠萝在整个阿尔卡里德城都很有名！如果你帮我一个忙，我就给你一个。

english: Wonderful, I see you have made the new weapon!
translation: 太好了，我看到你造出了新武器！

english: How very careless of you! Here is another key, don't lose it this time !
translation: 你也太不小心了！这是另一把钥匙，这次可别弄丢了！

english: But we will need the technical plans from you Effendi. If we are going to perfect this weapon.
translation: 但是我们需要你的技术图纸，先生。如果我们想完善这件武器的话。

english: How very careless of you!
translation: 你也太不小心了！

english: The Captain may have some new plans drawn up. Go back and see if you can collect them.
translation: 船长可能已经画好了新的图纸。回去看看能不能拿到。

english: Here is the key you'll need for the chest!
translation: 这是开箱子需要的钥匙！

english: Where did you get this from Effendi! I'll have to confiscate this for your own safety!
translation: 你从哪弄来的，先生！为了你的安全，我得没收这个！

english: Have you completed that weapon yet?
translation: 那件武器你造好了吗？

english: Oh great!
translation: 哦，太好了！

english: Yeuch! That's awful! That's not Tenti pineapple! It's got no juice! Get me some Tenti pineapple if you know what's good for you. A whole one so I can see that it's good!
translation: 呸！太难吃了！这不是坦提菠萝！一点汁水都没有！如果你识相的话，给我弄个坦提菠萝来。要一整颗，这样我才能看出好坏！

english: Hey... I have something for you!
translation: 嘿……我有东西给你！

english: Great! Just what I've been looking for! Mmmmmmm... Delicious!! This is soo nice! Mmmmm, *SLURP* Yummmm... Oh yes, this is great.
translation: 太好了！这正是我一直在找的！嗯嗯嗯……美味！！太好吃了！嗯嗯，*吸溜* 好吃……哦，是的，太棒了。

english: So, can I go through now please?
translation: 那么，我现在可以过去了吗？

english: Yes, yes, of course... a deal's a deal!
translation: 可以，可以，当然……一言为定！

english: That pineapple was just delicious, many thanks. I don't suppose you could get me another?-- The guard looks at you pleadingly.
translation: 那个菠萝太好吃了，非常感谢。你能不能再给我弄一个？——守卫用恳求的眼神看着你。

english: You must be joking! The last one I gave you cost me double shifts working copper ore! You should be grateful you got one at all.
translation: 你是在开玩笑吧！上次给你的那个菠萝让我多挖了好几班铜矿石！你能得到一个就该感激了。

english: Alright, alright, I was only asking!
translation: 好吧，好吧，我只是问问！

english: Yeah, whaddya want... get out of here!
translation: 嗯，你想干嘛……滚开！

english: Move along now...
translation: 继续走……

english: Yes, what do you want?
translation: 嗯，你想干嘛？

english: Nothing thanks - sorry for disturbing you.
translation: 没什么，谢谢——抱歉打扰了。

english: Well... I guess that's okay, get on your way though.
translation: 嗯……那好吧，你走吧。

english: Your head on a stick.
translation: 你的脑袋挂在棍子上。

english: Why you ungrateful whelp.. I'll teach you some manners.
translation: 你这个忘恩负义的小崽子……我来教教你规矩。

english: What is this thing?
translation: 这是什么东西？

english: Can I use this?
translation: 我能用这个吗？

english: Oh, want a fight do you!
translation: 哦，想打架是吧！

english: There isn't enough space for both you and this barrel in the cart.
translation: 推车里装不下你和这个桶。

english: Hey, move away from the gate. There's nothing interesting for you here.
translation: 嘿，离大门远点。这里没什么你感兴趣的东西。

english: Hey, move away from the gate. If you wanna get out you're gonna have to mine for it. You're gonna have to bring me 15 loads of rocks in one go!
translation: 嘿，离大门远点。如果你想出去，就得靠挖矿来争取。你得一次性给我运来15车矿石！

english: And then I'll let you out. You can go back to work with the other slaves then!
translation: 然后我就放你出去。你就可以回去和其他奴隶一起干活了！

english: Okay, I have all your rocks here, let me out now.-- The guard unlocks the gate. --
translation: 好了，你的矿石都在这里了，现在放我出去。——守卫打开了大门。——

english: Okay, okay, come on out.
translation: 好吧，好吧，出来吧。

english: Okay, you've got all the rocks, you can go now, but keep your nose clean in future.
translation: 好了，你矿石都齐了，可以走了，但以后老实点。

english: Hello there, I don't think I've seen you before.
translation: 你好啊，我以前好像没见过你。

english: No, I'm new here!
translation: 是的，我是新来的！

english: I thought so you know! How do you like the hospitality down here? Not exactly Al Kharid town style is it? Well, I guess I'd better get back to work.
translation: 我就知道！你觉得这里的待遇怎么样？不像阿尔卡里德城的风格吧？嗯，我想我最好回去干活了。

english: Don't want to get into trouble with the guards again.
translation: 不想再惹守卫麻烦了。

english: Do you get into trouble with guards often?
translation: 你经常惹守卫麻烦吗？

english: No, not really, because I'm usually working very hard. Come to think of it, I'd better get back to work.
translation: 不，不常，因为我通常都在拼命干活。说起来，我最好还是回去干活吧。

english: Do you enjoy it down here?
translation: 你喜欢待在这里吗？

english: Of course not! I just don't have much choice about it athe moment.
translation: 当然不喜欢！只是我现在没什么选择。

english: Do you have any ideas about how we can get out of here?
translation: 你有什么办法能让我们离开这里吗？

english: Hmmm, not really, I would have tried them already if I did. The guards seem to live in the compound. How did you get in there anyway?
translation: 嗯，没什么好办法，要是有的话我早就试过了。守卫们似乎就住在营地里。你是怎么进来的？

english: Okay, see ya!
translation: 好吧，再见！

english: Goodbye and good luck!
translation: 再见，祝你好运！

english: I want to try and get you out of here!
translation: 我想试着把你弄出去！

english: Wow! You're brave. How do you propose we do that? In case you hadn't noticed, this place is quite well guarded.
translation: 哇！你真勇敢。你打算怎么做？你可能没注意到，这里守卫森严。

english: We could try to sneak out.
translation: 我们可以试着偷偷溜出去。

english: That doesn't sound very likely. How did you get in here anyway? Did you deliberately hand yourself over to the guards? Ha, ha ha ha! Sorry, just kidding.
translation: 听起来不太可能。你到底是怎么进来的？你是故意把自己交给守卫的吗？哈，哈哈哈！抱歉，开个玩笑。

english: I managed to sneak past the guards.
translation: 我设法偷偷溜过了守卫。

english: Hmm, impressive, but can you so easily sneak out again? How did you manage to get through the gate?
translation: 嗯，厉害，但你能那么容易再溜出去吗？你是怎么通过大门的？

english: I have a key.
translation: 我有钥匙。

english: It's a trade secret!
translation: 这是商业秘密！

english: Oh, right, well, I guess you know what you're doing. Anyway, I have to get back to work. The guards will come along soon and give us some trouble else.
translation: 哦，好吧，我想你知道自己在做什么。总之，我得回去干活了。不然守卫很快就会过来找麻烦。

english: Huh, these guards are rubbish, it was easy to sneak past them!
translation: 哼，这些守卫太差劲了，溜过他们很容易！

english: Have you got any suggestions?
translation: 你有什么建议吗？

english: Hmmm, let me think...
translation: 嗯，让我想想……

english: No, sorry...
translation: 不，抱歉……

english: The only thing that gets out of here is the rock that we mine.
translation: 唯一能从这里出去的东西就是我们挖的矿石。

english: Not even the dead get a decent funeral. Bodies are just thrown down disused mine holes. It's very disrespectful...
translation: 连死人都得不到像样的葬礼。尸体被直接扔进废弃的矿洞里。太不尊重了……

english: Okay, I'll check around for another way to try and get out.
translation: 好吧，我再去周围看看有没有别的出路。

english: How does the rock get out?
translation: 矿石是怎么运出去的？

english: Well, we mine it in this section, then someone scoops it into a barrel. The barrels are loaded onto a mine cart. Then they're deposited near the surface lift.
translation: 嗯，我们在这个区域挖矿，然后有人把矿石铲进桶里。桶被装上矿车。然后它们被运到靠近地面升降机的地方。

english: I have no idea where they go from there. But that's not going to help us, is it?
translation: 我不知道之后它们去了哪里。但这帮不了我们，对吧？

english: Maybe? I'll come back to you when I have a plan.
translation: 也许吧？等我有了计划再回来找你。

english: Okay, well, I'm not going anywhere!-- Ana nods at a nearby guard!--Unless he feels generous enough to let me go!-- The guard ignores the comment. --
translation: 好吧，我哪儿也去不了！——安娜朝附近的守卫点了点头！——除非他大发慈悲放我走！——守卫无视了这句话。——

english: Oh well, I'd better get back to work, you take care!
translation: 哦，好吧，我最好回去干活了，你保重！

english: Where would I get one of those barrels from?
translation: 我从哪里能弄到那种桶？

english: Well, you would get one from around by the lift area. But why would you want one of those?
translation: 嗯，你可以在升降机区域附近弄到一个。但你为什么要那个？

english: Er no reason! Just wondering.
translation: 呃，没什么！只是好奇。

english: Hmmm, just don't get any funny ideas... I am not going to get into one of those barrels! Okay, have you got that?
translation: 嗯，别打什么歪主意……我可不会钻进那种桶里！听明白了吗？

english: Okay, yep, I've got that.
translation: 好的，明白了。

english: Good, just make sure you keep it in mind. Anyway, I have to get back to work. The guards will come along soon and give us some trouble else.
translation: 很好，记住这一点。总之，我得回去干活了。不然守卫很快就会过来找麻烦。

english: Well, we'll see, it might be the only way.
translation: 好吧，我们看着办，这可能是唯一的办法。

english: No, there has to be a better way! Anyway, I have to get back to work. The guards will come along soon and give us some trouble else.
translation: 不，一定有更好的办法！总之，我得回去干活了。守卫很快就会过来，不然我们会有麻烦的。

english: I could try to sneak you out if you were in a barrel!
translation: 如果你躲在桶里，我可以试着把你偷偷带出去！

english: There is no way you are getting me into a barrel. No WAY! DO you understand?
translation: 你休想把我塞进桶里。绝对不行！你明白吗？

english: What's your name.
translation: 你叫什么名字。

english: My name? Oh, how sweet, my name is Ana. I come from Al Kharid though we've only recently moved there. I was born, and did most of my growing up, in Varrock. I thought the desert might be interesting.
translation: 我的名字？哦，真贴心，我叫安娜。我来自阿尔卡里德城，不过我们最近才搬去那里。我出生在维洛克城，并在那里度过了大部分成长时光。我以为沙漠可能会很有趣。

english: What a surprise I got!
translation: 我真是大吃一惊！

english: What kind of surprise did you get?
translation: 你遇到了什么意外？

english: Well, I was just touring the desert looking for the nomad tribe to the West. And I was set upon by these armoured men.
translation: 嗯，我刚刚在沙漠里旅行，寻找西边的游牧民部落。然后就被这些装甲士兵袭击了。

english: I think that the guards think I am an escaped prisoner. They didn't understand that I was exploring the desert as an adventurer.
translation: 我觉得守卫以为我是逃犯。他们不明白我是以冒险者的身份在探索沙漠。

english: Do you want to go back to Al Kharid?
translation: 你想回阿尔卡里德城吗？

english: Sure, I miss my Mum, her name is Irena and she is probably waiting for me. How do you propose we get out of here though?
translation: 当然，我想我妈妈了，她叫艾琳娜，她可能正在等我。不过你打算怎么离开这里？

english: I'm sure you've noticed the many square jawed guards around here. You look like you can handle yourself, but I have my doubts that you can take them all on!
translation: 我相信你已经注意到这里有很多方下巴的守卫。你看起来能照顾好自己，但我怀疑你能对付他们所有人！

english: Hello there, how's it going? Do you have a plan to get out of here yet?
translation: 嘿，你好吗？你有离开这里的计划了吗？

english: Not yet, sorry, what's your name again?
translation: 还没有，抱歉，你叫什么名字来着？

english: Well, I'm working on it, have you got any suggestions?
translation: 嗯，我正在想办法，你有什么建议吗？

english: Not yet, have you been in any more trouble with the guards?
translation: 还没有，你后来又和守卫惹上麻烦了吗？

english: No, not not so far. I've been working very hard. Not like some people I know-- She cocks a smirk at you. --
translation: 没有，到目前为止还没有。我一直很努力地工作。不像我认识的某些人——她朝你露出一个得意的笑容。——

english: Hey, what do you think you're doing?
translation: 嘿，你以为你在干什么？

english: -- You manage to squeeze Ana into the barrel, -- -- despite her many complaints. --I djont fit in dis bawwel... Wet me out!!
translation: ——你成功地把安娜塞进了桶里，——尽管她抱怨连连。——我挤不进这个桶……放我出去！！

english: Shush... It's for your own good!
translation: 嘘……这是为你好！

english: You drop the barrel on the floor, Ana gets out.
translation: 你把木桶丢在地板上，安娜出来了。

english: Hey! What's going on here then?
translation: 嘿！这里怎么回事？

english: Hey, what do you think you're doing? Leave me alone and let me get on with my work. Else we'll both be in trouble. Oh no, NOT AGAIN!
translation: 嘿，你以为你在干什么？别烦我，让我继续干活。不然我们俩都会有麻烦。哦不，又来！

english: -- Ana looks pretty angry, she starts shouting at you. --Get me out of here! Do you hear me! Get me OUT OF HERE I say!
translation: ——安娜看起来很生气，她开始对你大喊。——放我出去！你听见了吗！我说放我出去！

english: Let me out!
translation: 放我出去！

english: Why you cheeky....!
translation: 你这厚脸皮的……！

english: ~ The guard looks around, surprised at Ana's outburst. ~What was that?
translation: ~ 守卫环顾四周，对安娜的爆发感到惊讶。~那是什么声音？

english: Oh, it was nothing.
translation: 哦，没什么。

english: Yes you did you ignoramus.
translation: 你确实说了，你这个无知的人。

english: What was that you said?
translation: 你刚才说什么？

english: I said you were very gregarious!
translation: 我说你很合群！

english: You creep!
translation: 你这个讨厌鬼！

english: I heard you say something, now spit it out!
translation: 我听到你说了什么，现在说出来！

english: No thanks, I can manage.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，我自己能行。

english: Ok, fair enough, I was only offering.
translation: 好吧，有道理，我只是提议一下。

english: Hey, where d'ya think you're going with that Barrel?
translation: 嘿，你以为你带着那个桶要去哪儿？

english: Cor! This barrel is really heavy! Have you been mining lead?
translation: 哎呀！这个桶真重！你是在采矿铅吗？

english: Har, har har!
translation: 哈，哈哈！

english: How rude! Why I ought to teach you a lesson.
translation: 真粗鲁！我该给你点教训。

english: How dare you say that I'm as heavy as lead?
translation: 你竟敢说我像铅一样重？

english: Get me OUT OF HERE!
translation: 放我出去！

english: Let me out of here, I feel sick!
translation: 放我出去，我觉得恶心！

english: Hey! Where d'ya think you're going with that barrel?
translation: 嘿！你以为你带着那个桶要去哪儿？

english: You should know that they go out on the cart!
translation: 你应该知道它们是用推车运出去的！

english: I'd better check this out.
translation: 我最好检查一下。

english: Blimey - it's a jail break!  Guards! Guards! Apprehend them!
translation: 天哪——越狱了！守卫！守卫！抓住他们！

english: They're making a break for it!
translation: 他们要逃跑了！

english: I could have told you that we wouldn't get away with it! Now look at the mess you've caused.
translation: 我早就告诉过你我们不会成功的！现在看看你造成的烂摊子。

english: Hey, watch it with the hands buster.
translation: 嘿，手放规矩点，伙计。

english: These are the up market slaves clothes doncha know!
translation: 这些可是高档奴隶的衣服，你知道吗！

english: Don't even think for one minute... you're gonna get me through that window!
translation: 你想都别想……让我从那个窗户出去！

english: Can't you see I'm busy? Now get out of here!
translation: 你没看见我正忙吗？快滚开！

english: Oh, okay, sorry.
translation: 哦，好吧，抱歉。

english: Look just leave me alone!
translation: 听着，别烦我！

english: Nice cart.
translation: 好推车。

english: Tut !
translation: 啧！

english: I wonder if you could help me?
translation: 不知道你能不能帮我？

english: Sorry friend, I'm busy, go bug the guards, I'm sure they'll give ya the time of day.
translation: 抱歉朋友，我忙着呢，去找守卫麻烦吧，我相信他们会搭理你的。

english: He, he, he, ha!
translation: 嘿嘿嘿，哈！

english: Can you get me the heck out of here please?
translation: 你能帮我离开这个鬼地方吗？

english: No way, and if you bug me again, I'm gonna call the guards.
translation: 没门，你再烦我，我就叫守卫了。

english: One wagon wheel says to the other, 'I'll see you around'.
translation: 一个马车轮子对另一个说：'回头见。'

english: -- The cart driver smirks a little. --
translation: ——推车司机微微一笑。——

english: 'One good turn deserves another.'
translation: ‘善有善报。’

english: Are you trying to get me fired?
translation: 你是想让我被解雇吗？

english: It certainly sounds like it, now leave me alone. If you bug me again, I'm gonna call the guards.
translation: 听起来确实像，现在别烦我。你再烦我，我就叫守卫了。

english: And why would you want to do a crazy thing like that for? I ought to teach you a lesson! Guards! Guards!
translation: 你为什么要做这种疯狂的事？我该给你点教训！守卫！守卫！

english: Fired... no, shot perhaps!
translation: 解雇……不，也许该枪毙！

english: Ha ha ha! You're funny!-- The cart driver checks that guards aren't watching. --What're you in fer?
translation: 哈哈哈！你真有趣！——推车司机确认守卫没在看。——你是因为什么进来的？

english: Oh, I'm not supposed to be here at all actually.
translation: 哦，实际上我根本不应该在这里。

english: Hmmm, interesting... let me guess. You're completely innocent... like all the other inmates in here. Ha ha ha!
translation: 嗯，有意思……让我猜猜。你完全无辜……就像这里所有其他囚犯一样。哈哈哈！

english: I'm in for murder, so you'd better get me out of here!
translation: 我是因为谋杀进来的，所以你最好把我弄出去！

english: Hmm, well, I wonder what the guards are gonna say about that! Guards! Guards!
translation: 嗯，好吧，我倒想知道守卫会怎么说！守卫！守卫！

english: In for a penny in for a pound.
translation: 一不做二不休。

english: Ha ha ha, oh stop it!
translation: 哈哈哈，哦别说了！

english: What can I do for you anyway?
translation: 我能为你做什么呢？

english: Can you smuggle me out on your cart?
translation: 你能用你的推车把我偷运出去吗？

english: Ask that man over there if it's okay and I'll consider it! Ha ha ha!
translation: 去问问那边那个人，如果他同意我就考虑！哈哈哈！

english: Can you smuggle my friend out on your cart?
translation: 你能用你的推车把我的朋友偷运出去吗？

english: As long as your friend is a barrel full of rocks. I don't think it would be a problem at all! Ha ha ha!
translation: 只要你的朋友是一桶石头。我觉得完全没问题！哈哈哈！

english: Well, you see, it's like this...
translation: 嗯，你看，是这样的……

english: Prison riot in ten minutes, get your cart out of here!
translation: 十分钟后监狱暴动，快把你的推车弄出去！

english: Oh, right..yes... yess, okay...
translation: 哦，对……是……是的，好吧……

english: Yeah, you too!
translation: 是啊，你也是！

english: You can't leave me here, I'll get killed!
translation: 你不能把我留在这里，我会被杀死的！

english: Oh, right... Okay, you'd better jump in the cart then! Quickly!
translation: 哦，对……好吧，那你最好跳上推车！快！

english: There's ten gold in it for you if you leave now no questions asked.
translation: 如果你现在就走，不问问题，这里有十金币给你。

english: If you're going to bribe me, at least make it worth my while. Now, let's say 100 Gold pieces should we? Ha ha ha!
translation: 如果你要贿赂我，至少得让我觉得值得。那么，我们说一百金币怎么样？哈哈哈！

english: A hundred it is.
translation: 一百就一百。

english: You little cheat, trying to trick me! I'll show you! Guards! Guards!
translation: 你这个小骗子，想骗我！我要让你好看！守卫！守卫！

english: Okay, get in the back of the cart then!
translation: 好吧，那就到推车后面去！

english: Forget it!
translation: 算了！

english: Okay, fair enough! But don't bother me anymore.
translation: 好吧，有道理！但别再烦我了。

english: I'm quite capable thanks... Now get lost before I call the guards.
translation: 我自己能行，谢谢……现在在我叫守卫之前滚开。

english: I could help, I know a lot about carts.
translation: 我可以帮忙，我对推车很了解。

english: Are you saying I don't know anything about carts?
translation: 你是说我一点都不懂推车？

english: Why you cheeky little....-- The cart driver seems mortally offended -- -- his temper explodes as he calls the guards.--Guards! Guards!
translation: 你这厚脸皮的小……——推车司机似乎被深深冒犯了——他勃然大怒，叫来守卫。——守卫！守卫！

english: Pssst...
Psssst...
Psssssst...
Pssssssssttt!!!
translation: 嘘嘘嘘！！！

english: What! Can't you see I'm busy?
translation: 干嘛！没看见我正忙着吗？

english: Shhshhh!
translation: 嘘嘘！

english: Shush yourself!
translation: 你才该闭嘴！

english: What're you doing carrying that big barrel around? Put it in the back of the cart like all the others!
translation: 你扛着那个大桶干什么？像其他人一样把它放到推车后面去！

english: Hurry up, get in the cart or I'll go without you!
translation: 快点，上推车，不然我就自己走了！

english: Ha ha ha! You're funny!-- The cart driver checks thatguards aren't watching. --What're you in fer?
translation: 哈哈哈！你真有趣！——推车司机检查了一下是否有守卫在看着。——你是为什么进来的？

english: I should find Ana before attempting to escape again. She must have been caught by the guards.
translation: 在再次尝试逃跑之前，我应该先找到安娜。她肯定被守卫抓住了。

english: Hey, great you've found Ana!
translation: 嘿，太好了，你找到安娜了！

english: -- You show Irena the barrel with Ana in it. --Hey great, there's my Mum!
translation: ——你向艾琳娜展示装有安娜的桶。——嘿，太好了，那是我妈妈！

english: -- You manage to squeeze Ana into the barrel, ---- despite her many complaints. --I djont fit in dis bawwel... Wet me out!!
translation: ——你成功地把安娜塞进了桶里，——尽管她抱怨连连。——我挤不进介个桶……放我粗去！！

english: -- Ana looks out of the barrel --Hey great, we're at the Shantay Pass!
translation: ——安娜从桶里探出头来——嘿，太好了，我们到沙泰隘口了！

english: -- You can't teleport while holding the barrel, it's justtoo difficult to concentrate. --
translation: ——你无法在抱着桶的时候传送，这太难集中精神了。——

english: You can't drop me here! I'll die in the desert on my own. Take me to the Shantay pass near Al-Kharid.
translation: 你不能把我丢在这里！我一个人会在沙漠里死掉的。带我去阿尔-卡里德附近的沙泰隘口。

english: You drop the barrel on the floor and Ana gets out.
translation: 你把木桶丢在地板上，然后安娜出来了。

english: You can't drop me here! Take me to the Shantay pass near Al-Kharid.
translation: 你不能把我丢在这里！带我去阿尔-卡里德附近的沙泰隘口。

english: Great! Thanks for getting me out of that mine! And that barrel wasn't too bad anyway! Pop by again sometime, I'm sure we'll have a barrel of laughs!
translation: 太好了！谢谢你把我救出那个矿坑！而且那个桶其实也不算太糟！有空再来玩，我保证我们会笑料百出！

english: Oh! I nearly forgot! Here's a key I found in the tunnels. It might be of some use to you, not sure what it opens. Sorry, but I have to go now.
translation: 哦！我差点忘了！这是我在隧道里找到的一把钥匙。可能对你有用，但我不确定是开什么的。抱歉，我得走了。

english: Hi Ana!
translation: 嗨，安娜！

english: Thank you very much for returning my daughter to me. I'm really very grateful... I would like to reward you for your bravery and daring.
translation: 非常感谢你把我的女儿带回来。我真的很感激……我想奖励你的勇敢和胆识。

english: I can offer you increased knowledge in two of the following areas.
translation: 我可以让你在以下两个领域增加知识。

english: Okay, now choose your second skill.
translation: 好了，现在选择你的第二个技能。

english: Okay, that's all the skills I can teach you!
translation: 好了，这就是我能教你的所有技能了！

english: Thanks for returning Annato me, I think she has something else to say to you though!
translation: 谢谢你帮我把安娜带回来，不过我想她还有话要对你说！

english: My name? Oh, how sweet, my name is Ana. I come from Al-Kharid though we've only recently moved there. I was born, and did most of my growing up, in Varrock. I thought the desert might be interesting.
translation: 我的名字？哦，真贴心，我叫安娜。我来自阿尔卡里德城，不过我们最近才搬去那里。我出生在维洛克城，并在那里度过了大部分成长时光。我以为沙漠可能会很有趣。

english: I thought so you know! How do you like the hospitality down here? Not exactly Al-Kharid town style is it? Well, I guess I'd better get back to work.
translation: 我就知道你会这么想！你觉得这里的待客之道怎么样？不太像阿尔-卡里德城的风格，对吧？好吧，我想我该回去工作了。

english: Of course not! I just don't have much choice about it a the moment.
translation: 当然不是！只是我现在没什么选择。

english: Okay, well, I'm not going anywhere!-- Ana nods at anearby guard!--Unless he feels generous enough to letme go!-- The guard ignores the comment. --
translation: 好吧，嗯，我哪儿也不去！——安娜朝附近的一个守卫点点头——除非他大发慈悲放我走。——守卫无视了这句话。——

english: Thanks, but I don't need that... really!
translation: 谢了，但我不需要那个……真的！

english: Hey, get off me... what do you think you're doing!
translation: 嘿，放开我……你以为你在干什么！

english: Thank you very much for returning my daughter to me. I'm really very grateful... I would like to reward you for your bravery and daring. I can offer you increased knowledge in two of the following areas.
translation: 非常感谢你把我的女儿带回来。我真的很感激……我想奖励你的勇敢和胆识。我可以让你在以下两个领域增加知识。

english: Thank you very much for returning my daughter to me. I'm really very grateful... I would like to reward you for your bravery and daring. I can offer you increased knowledge in one of the following areas.
translation: 非常感谢你把我的女儿带回来。我真的很感激……我想奖励你的勇敢和胆识。我可以让你在以下一个领域增加知识。

english: That would be great! That's really very nice of you! She was wearing a red silk scarf when she left.
translation: 那太好了！你真是太好了！她离开时戴着一条红色丝绸围巾。

english: Are you 'really' sure you want to do this? I mean, go on this quest?
translation: 你'真的'确定要这么做吗？我是说，去执行这个任务？

english: And I'm sure that Ana will also be very pleased! And I may see if I can get a small reward together... But I cannot promise anything. So does that mean that you'll look for her then?
translation: 而且我相信安娜也会非常高兴！我看看能不能凑点小奖励……但我不能保证什么。所以，你是说你会去找她吗？

english: Well, yes, you'll have my gratitude young man.
translation: 嗯，是的，年轻人，你会得到我的感激。

english: That would be very good of you. You would have the gratitude of a very loving mother. Are you sure you want to take on that responsibility?
translation: 你这样做真是太好了。你会得到一位慈爱母亲的感激。你确定要承担这个责任吗？

english: Well, yes, you'll have my gratitude young lady.
translation: 嗯，是的，姑娘，你会得到我的感激。

english: She was just travelling, a tourist you might say. *Sob* She said she would be safe and now she could be. *Whhhhhaaaaa*
translation: 她只是在旅行，你可以说是个游客。*抽泣* 她说她会安全的，可现在她可能……*哇啊啊啊*

english: Oh, okay. I understand... but if you change your mind, I'd really appreciate it.
translation: 哦，好吧，我明白了……但如果你改变主意，我会非常感激的。

english: Please bring my daughter back to me. She is most likely lost in the Desert somewhere. I miss her so much... Wahhhhh! *Sob*
translation: 请把我的女儿带回来给我。她很可能迷失在沙漠的某个地方。我非常想念她……哇啊！*抽泣*

english: It may already have happened you thoughtless oaf! My daughter, Ana, could be dead or dying in the desert!
translation: 你这没脑子的笨蛋，可能已经发生了！我的女儿安娜，可能已经死在沙漠里了！

english: I think I saw some of her footprints to the south, you could start there. Hopefully she'll just be over a few sand dunes, but you never know. She may have been taken to that awful desert mining camp, or captured by
translation: 我想我在南边看到了一些她的脚印，你可以从那里开始找。希望她只是翻过了几座沙丘，但谁知道呢。她可能被带到了那个可怕的沙漠采矿营，或者被

english: Thanks for returning Anna to me, I think she has something else to say to you though!
translation: 谢谢你帮我把安娜带回来，不过我想她还有话要对你说！

english: Oh really, is there no way I can persuade you to help me?
translation: 哦，真的吗，难道我就没法说服你帮我吗？

english: Sorry, I don't need that.
translation: 抱歉，我不需要那个。

english: [Greetings, Sir/Greetings, Madam/Greetings].
translation: [Greetings, Sir/Greetings, Madam/Greetings]。

english: Who are you? Who seeks audience with the King of this fair land of Miscellania?
translation: 你是谁？是谁想要求见米斯凯尼亚这片美丽土地的国王？

english: I am known in these lands as [Fremennik name], Your Majesty. I come in search of a quest.
translation: 陛下，在这片土地上，人们称我为[Fremennik name]。我是来寻找任务的。

english: Ah, it pleases me to see such enthusiasm!
translation: 啊，看到如此热情，朕甚感欣慰！

english: I was once an adventurer such as yourself; even while fulfilling my duties as King of Miscellania, I would roam the lands in search of adventure, and strike down mighty foes with a single blow!
translation: 我曾经和你一样是个冒险者；即使在履行米斯凯尼亚国王职责时，我也会漫游各地寻找冒险，并一击打倒强大的敌人！

english: Unfortunately, I was a little too daring, and attempted to brave the icelands, where I finally met my match.
translation: 不幸的是，朕有点过于大胆，试图闯入冰原冒险，最终遇到了对手。

english: I survived, barely, but I was cursed for the rest of my life to stay in this form. Which leaves me incapable of performing my duties as ruler.
translation: 朕勉强活了下来，但被诅咒以这副模样度过余生。这使朕无法履行统治者的职责。

english: This is why I am looking for an exceptional soul to be regent of this fair kingdom of Miscellania.
translation: 这就是朕在寻找一个非凡的灵魂来担任米斯凯尼亚这个美丽王国的摄政王的原因。

english: If I may be so bold, Your Majesty, I think Miscellania would rest in capable hands with me.
