translation: 陛下，恕我直言，我认为米斯凯尼亚若由我来掌管，定能稳操胜券。

english: Hahaha! You are bold, [Fremennik name], but then I have yet to see a good ruler who was not.
translation: 哈哈哈！你很自信，[Fremennik name]，但朕尚未见过哪个优秀统治者不自信的。

english: You will first have to demonstrate your worth. You are a good warrior, that I do not doubt; however ruling also requires a good grasp of diplomacy.
translation: 你首先要证明你的价值。你是个优秀的战士，朕毫不怀疑；但治理国家还需要出色的外交手腕。

english: We have been at war with neighbouring Etceteria for hundreds of years; however, I think both of us have rather lost our appetite for hostilities.
translation: 几百年来，我们一直与邻近的埃西特利亚岛处于战争状态；不过，朕认为双方都已厌倦了敌对。

english: Now may be an opportune time to make amends. If you manage to negotiate peace with them, then you will truly have shown your skill as a diplomat.
translation: 现在也许是个修好的好时机。如果你能设法与他们谈判和平，那么你就真正展现了你作为外交官的能力。

english: Then do not stray far, Your Majesty, for I shall soon return.
translation: 那么请不要走远，陛下，我很快就会回来。

english: Wait! There is one more matter to discuss... a mere formality, of course.
translation: 等等！还有一件事要讨论……当然，只是一个形式。

english: By Miscellanious tradition, one may not become regent of the kingdom unless in the trust of the royal family.
translation: 根据米斯凯尼亚传统，除非得到王室的信任，否则不能成为王国的摄政王。

english: This includes that of the future king or queen. It is yet too early for me to decide which of my children should inherit the throne.
translation: 这包括未来国王或王后的信任。现在决定我的哪个孩子继承王位还为时过早。

english: Until then, gaining the trust of one of them should suffice. Who knows? Your choice might help me make a decision later.
translation: 在此之前，获得其中一人的信任应该就够了。谁知道呢？你的选择日后可能有助于我做出决定。

english: So tell me! Which of my children will you attempt to gain the trust of?
translation: 所以告诉我！你将尝试获得我哪个孩子的信任？

english: I would like to choose Prince Brand.
translation: 我想选择布兰德王子。

english: And you say this is a mere formality, Your Majesty?
translation: 陛下，您说这只是一个形式？

english: I am sure you can form a good working relationship with him. You can ask Ghrim for advice; that's what he's here for, after all.
translation: 我相信你们能建立良好的工作关系。你可以向格里姆请教；毕竟他就是为了这个。

english: I would like to choose Princess Astrid.
translation: 我想选择阿斯特丽德公主。

english: I am sure you can form a good working relationship with her. You can ask Ghrim for advice; that's what he's here for, after all.
translation: 我相信你们能建立良好的工作关系。你可以向格里姆请教；毕竟他就是为了这个。

english: I'm afraid I must decline, Your Majesty. The call of adventure is too strong for me to accept a sedentary life.
translation: 陛下，恐怕我必须拒绝。冒险的召唤太过强烈，我无法接受安逸的生活。

english: I can assure you that I managed to heed that same call, and ruling this land was no hindrance to me. However, I understand your decision. Fare thee well!
translation: 朕可以向你保证，朕也曾响应同样的召唤，而统治这片土地并未成为障碍。不过，朕理解你的决定。祝你平安！

english: How are you getting on, [Fremennik name]? Have you talked to Queen Sigrid of Etceteria?
translation: [Fremennik name]，你进展如何？你和埃西特利亚岛的西格里德女王谈过了吗？

english: Not yet, Your Majesty.
translation: 还没有，陛下。

english: I want to earn Prince Brand's approval instead.
translation: 我希望能先获得布兰德王子的认可。

english: As you wish. Good luck!
translation: 随你便。祝你好运！

english: I want to earn Princess Astrid's approval instead.
translation: 我希望能先获得阿斯特丽德公主的认可。

english: Is that so? I can let them both know, but you may find that the Prince has taken the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: 是吗？我可以通知他们两人，但你可能会发现王子对此反应冷淡。信任一旦破裂，就很难修补。

english: Is that so? I can let them both know, but you may find that the Princess has taken the news rather coldly. A broken trust is difficult to mend.
translation: 是吗？我可以通知他们两人，但你可能会发现公主对此反应冷淡。信任一旦破裂，就很难修补。

english: [Negotiating peace with Etceteria, Sir/Negotiating peace with Etceteria, Madam/Negotiating peace with Etceteria].
translation: [Negotiating peace with Etceteria, Sir/Negotiating peace with Etceteria, Madam/Negotiating peace with Etceteria]。

english: How do I make peace with Etceteria?
translation: 我怎样才能与埃西特利亚岛达成和平？

english: You should go talk to Queen Sigrid of Etceteria.
translation: 你应该去和埃西特利亚岛的西格里德女王谈谈。

english: How am I supposed to gain the trust of the Prince?
translation: 我怎样才能获得王子的信任？

english: I think you may find that talking to him would be a good way to start.
translation: 我想你会发现和他谈谈是个不错的开始。

english: A ring may be an appropriate gift to formalise your friendship
translation: 一枚戒指可能是正式你们友谊的合适礼物。

english: How am I supposed to gain the trust of the Princess?
translation: 我怎样才能获得公主的信任？

english: I think you may find that talking to her would be a good way to start.
translation: 我想你会发现和她谈谈是个不错的开始。

english: Is there anything else you can tell me?
translation: 你还有什么可以告诉我的吗？

english: What would you like to know, [Sir/Madam/]?
translation: [Sir/Madam/]，你想知道什么？

english: What can you tell me about the King?
translation: 关于国王，你能告诉我什么？

english: King Vargas was once a brave and noble adventurer, well-loved by his subjects. Unfortunately, he was cursed while seeking a quest in the icelands to the north, and is now unable to reign.
translation: 瓦加斯国王曾是一位勇敢高尚的冒险者，深受臣民爱戴。不幸的是，他在北方冰原寻找任务时被诅咒，现在无法治理国家。

english: What can you tell me about the Prince?
translation: 关于王子，你能告诉我什么？

english: Prince Brand has always dreamed of becoming a famous bard; unfortunately, his musical and literary skills are somewhat lacking.
translation: 布兰德王子一直梦想成为著名的吟游诗人；不幸的是，他的音乐和文学技巧有些欠缺。

english: He has no interest in ruling the kingdom, and seems to spend his time daydreaming or composing quite awful poems, and sagas of totally mundane events.
translation: 他对统治王国毫无兴趣，似乎总是花时间做白日梦、创作糟糕的诗和讲述平凡事件的史诗歌谣。

english: He is rather vain, if you'll pardon my saying so; he will greatly appreciate any compliments on his poetry. He also has quite a sweet tooth.
translation: 他相当虚荣，请原谅我这么说；他会非常感激任何对他诗歌的赞美。他还有一颗糖果牙。

english: What can you tell me about the Princess?
translation: 关于公主，你能告诉我什么？

english: Princess Astrid thinks she'd be perfectly capable of ruling the kingdom, but her father doesn't trust her enough by herself.
translation: 阿斯特丽德公主认为自己完全有能力统治王国，但她的父亲不太信任她独自一人。

english: Especially since she devotes herself to the - as the King sees it - cowardly skill of archery rather than the noble skill of melee combat...
translation: 尤其是她专注于——国王认为——懦弱的箭术，而非高贵的近战技能……

english: She is fond of jewellery, and of course she collects bows. She is also quite the conversationalist.
translation: 她喜欢首饰，当然也收集弓。她也很健谈。

english: Many have tried to capture her attention, but she has yet to be impressed by any of them.
translation: 许多人试图引起她的注意，但至今没有一个人能打动她。

english: Many have tried to capture her attention, but you are the first to succeed.
translation: 许多人试图引起她的注意，但你是第一个成功的。

english: What can you tell me about Queen Sigrid?
translation: 关于西格里德女王，你能告诉我什么？

english: Queen Sigrid is quite envious of King Vargas, since he has the larger kingdom.
translation: 西格里德女王非常嫉妒瓦加斯国王，因为他的王国更大。

english: The King and she have never seen eye-to-eye, but I think if you approach her you may find her quite reasonable.
translation: 国王和她从未意见一致，但我认为如果你去找她，可能会发现她相当通情达理。

english: [No thank you, sir/No thank you, madam/No thank you].
translation: [No thank you, sir/No thank you, madam/No thank you]。

english: [What's wrong, sir/What's wrong, madam/What's wrong]?
translation: [What's wrong, sir/What's wrong, madam/What's wrong]？

english: [If you want to cheer someone on, sir/If you want to cheer someone on, madam/If you want to cheer someone on], I suggest you find my brother.
translation: [If you want to cheer someone on, sir/If you want to cheer someone on, madam/If you want to cheer someone on]，我建议你去找我哥哥。

english: I'm staying right here.
translation: 我就待在这儿。

english: What's so funny, [Sir/Madam]?
translation: [Sir/Madam]，有什么好笑的？

english: [You dance well, sir/You dance well, madam/You dance well]?
translation: [You dance well, sir/You dance well, madam/You dance well]？

english: [Sorry, sir/Sorry, madam/Sorry], but I'm not interested.
translation: [Sorry, sir/Sorry, madam/Sorry]，但我不感兴趣。

english: [If you want to applaud someone, sir/If you want to applaud someone, madam/If you want to applaud someone,] I suggest you find my brother.
translation: [If you want to applaud someone, sir/If you want to applaud someone, madam/If you want to applaud someone,]，我建议你去找我哥哥。

english: I couldn't possibly accept this.
translation: 我实在不能接受这个。

english: As I'm sure you are aware, your father the King is seeking someone to rule the Kingdom in his stead. I have put myself forward, but in order for me to become ruler...
translation: 想必你知道，你父亲国王正在寻找一个人代他统治王国。我已经毛遂自荐，但为了能成为统治者……

english: ...you have to earn my approval?
translation: ……你必须获得我的认可？

english: Yes, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 是的，殿下。

english: Ahahahaha!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈！

english: Come now, what interest would I have in a crass adventurer like yourself? What would you know of the poetry that flows through my veins like an avalanche through a peaceful mountain village?
translation: 得了，我对像你这样一个粗鄙的冒险者有什么兴趣？你懂什么诗歌？那诗歌如同雪崩般流淌过宁静的山村，在我血脉中奔腾？

english: I think you may find I know good poetry when I see it, Your Royal Highness...
translation: 殿下，你会发现我见到好诗是能认出来的……

english: This may be the case. I am willing to give you a chance; if you impress me enough, I will consider trusting you as our regent.
translation: 也许吧。我愿意给你一个机会；如果你能给我留下足够深刻的印象，我会考虑信任你作为我们的摄政王。

english: I composed a poem, would you like to hear it?
translation: 我作了一首诗，你想听听吗？

english: Of course, I'd love to.
translation: 当然，我很乐意。

english: I got up This morning, And had an egg For breakfast
translation: 我今天早上起床，吃了一颗蛋当早餐

english: No, that's the whole poem.
translation: 不，整首诗就是这些。

english: Be still, my heart.
translation: 心潮澎湃，难以平静。

english: I'm glad you liked it.
translation: 很高兴你喜欢。

english: That doesn't even rhyme!
translation: 这连押韵都没有！

english: Quiet! What would you know about poetry?
translation: 安静！你对诗歌懂什么？

english: I am surprised you do not have hordes of admirers vying to be your significant other, Your Highness.
translation: 殿下，我很惊讶您竟然没有成群的仰慕者争相成为您的另一半。

english: [And why do you think that might be, sir/And why do you think that might be, madam/And why do you think that might be]?
translation: [And why do you think that might be, sir/And why do you think that might be, madam/And why do you think that might be]？

english: No-one's ever heard of you.
translation: 没有人听说过你。

english: [I am insulted, sir/I am insulted, madam/I am insulted]!
translation: [I am insulted, sir/I am insulted, madam/I am insulted]！

english: They don't understand your poetry as I do.
translation: 他们不像我这样理解您的诗歌。

english: [Mmm, a very good answer, sir/Mmm, a very good answer, madam/Mmm, a very good answer].
translation: [Mmm, a very good answer, sir/Mmm, a very good answer, madam/Mmm, a very good answer]。

english: They're all already married.
translation: 他们都已经结婚了。

english: Hm, no, I don't think that's the right reason.
translation: 嗯，不，我觉得这不是正确的理由。

english: So, you practice the harp? I see you have one over there.
translation: 那么，你练习竖琴吗？我看到那边有一把。

english: Yes; I play the lyre and the harp, and compose songs, poems and sagas to move you, to delight you and entertain you! Sadly, my father does not think much of the art. What do you think?
translation: 是的；我弹奏竖琴和竖琴，创作歌曲、诗歌和史诗歌谣来感动你、取悦你、娱乐你！不幸的是，我父亲不太看重这门艺术。你觉得呢？

english: You should listen to your father.
translation: 你应该听你父亲的话。

english: You will be the greatest bard!
translation: 你将成为最伟大的吟游诗人！

english: I'm so glad you agree!
translation: 很高兴你同意！

english: You're an awful bard.
translation: 你是个糟糕的吟游诗人。

english: Beards? Dangerous, flammable and make you look mad!
translation: 胡须？危险、易燃，还会让人看起来很疯狂！

english: Care to sign my petition for pet frogs?
translation: 愿意签署我的宠物青蛙请愿书吗？

english: Cattle prod? Weapon of choice I reckon.
translation: 电牛棒？我猜是你的首选武器。

english: Don't threaten me with a dead fish!
translation: 别拿条死鱼威胁我！

english: He is clearly 1 cup short of a full service.
translation: 他明显少了一根筋。

english: I'm a little teapot, short and stout...
translation: 我是个小茶壶，矮矮胖胖……

english: I'm rubber you're glue.........!
translation: 我是橡胶你是胶水……！

english: Lies!!! It's all lies!!!
translation: 谎言！！！全是谎言！！！

english: Look over there! A King Black Dragon!
translation: 快看那边！有只黑龙王！

english: Lumbridge? No, I wouldn't be seen dead there.
translation: 仑桥镇？不，我死也不会去那儿。

english: Nah, that Kalphite was weedier than your garden.
translation: 不，那只卡尔夫特虫比你的花园还瘦弱。

english: Selling ring of poverty 30 mil!
translation: 出售贫穷之戒，三千万！

english: Sneaky sneaky stick da chompy.
translation: 偷偷摸摸，戳戳那只乔皮鸟。

english: What level do you need to cook cats?
translation: 烹饪猫需要多少级？

english: Are these for me? Really?
translation: 这些是给我的？真的吗？

english: Thank you! They're lovely!
translation: 谢谢你！它们真可爱！

english: No, I was just showing you.
translation: 不，我只是给你看看。

english: Thank you. It's nice to be appreciated.
translation: 谢谢你。被人欣赏的感觉真好。

english: [What's so funny, sir/What's so funny, madam/What's so funny]?
translation: [What's so funny, sir/What's so funny, madam/What's so funny]？

english: You are silly!
translation: 你真傻！

english: [You dance well, sir/You dance well, madam/You dance well].
translation: [You dance well, sir/You dance well, madam/You dance well]。

english: [Let's not get ahead of ourselves now, sir/Let's not get ahead of ourselves now, madam/Let's not get ahead of ourselves now]!
translation: [Let's not get ahead of ourselves now, sir/Let's not get ahead of ourselves now, madam/Let's not get ahead of ourselves now]！

english: [You have perhaps more poetry in your soul than I first thought, sir/You have perhaps more poetry in your soul than I first thought, madam/You have perhaps more poetry in your soul than I first thought]...
translation: [You have perhaps more poetry in your soul than I first thought, sir/You have perhaps more poetry in your soul than I first thought, madam/You have perhaps more poetry in your soul than I first thought]……

english: I'm flattered to hear you say so, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 殿下，听您这么说，我受宠若惊。

english: Oh, but I realise you have not yet told me your name!
translation: 哦，但我发现你还没告诉我你的名字呢！

english: My name is [Fremennik name], Your Highness.
translation: 殿下，我的名字是[Fremennik name]。

english: [Then I shall I call you [Fremennik name], sir/Then I shall I call you [Fremennik name], madam/Then I shall I call you [Fremennik name]], and you shall call me Prince.
translation: [Then I shall I call you [Fremennik name]吧，先生/那我就叫你[Fremennik name]吧，女士/那我就叫你[Fremennik name]吧]，而你要叫我王子。

english: Very well, Prince.
translation: 好的，王子。

english: What's wrong, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 怎么了，[Fremennik name]？

english: What's so funny, [Fremennik name]?
translation: 有什么好笑的，[Fremennik name]？

english: You dance well, [Fremennik name].
translation: 你舞跳得真好，[Fremennik name]。

english: Let's not get ahead of ourselves now, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 我们别得意忘形了，[Fremennik name]！

english: So, why did you decide to become a bard?
translation: 那么，你为什么决定成为一名吟游诗人？

english: Poetry and music have always fascinated me. I am drawn to them like a moth to an overenthusiastic mage who has set himself on fire.
translation: 诗歌和音乐一直让我着迷。我就像飞蛾扑火一样被它们吸引，只不过那火是个过于兴奋、把自己点着了的法师。

english: How poetic.
translation: 真有诗意。

english: Why thank you. Sometimes I amaze even myself.
translation: 多谢夸奖。有时候连我自己都佩服自己。

english: That's a strange metaphor...
translation: 这个比喻真奇怪……

english: It is a simile, but what do you know of poetry?
translation: 那是明喻，不过你对诗歌又懂多少？

english: Wait, are you the moth or the mage?
translation: 等等，你是飞蛾还是法师？

english: The moth!
translation: 是飞蛾！

english: I composed a saga, would you like to hear it?
translation: 我创作了一首传奇诗，你想听听吗？

english: I don't know if I have time for a whole saga...
translation: 我不知道有没有时间听完一整首传奇诗……

english: Don't worry, it's quite short. Here we go!
translation: 别担心，很短。听好了！

english: Once upon a time there was a Prince, And Brand was his name, He always had a song in his heart, And a rhyme in his head,
translation: 从前有一位王子，他的名字叫布兰德，他心中总有歌声，脑中总有韵律，

english: And he became the world's greatest bard, And delighted one and all, With his songs and sagas, And Brand was his name!
translation: 他成为了世界上最伟大的吟游诗人，用他的歌曲和传奇诗，让所有人都欢欣鼓舞，而他的名字就叫布兰德！

english: How inspiring!
translation: 真鼓舞人心！

english: Thank you! I thought I would compose something for future generations, to tell them my story.
translation: 谢谢你！我想我应该为后代创作些东西，来讲述我的故事。

english: I think my ears are bleeding.
translation: 我觉得我的耳朵在流血。

english: If you don't appreciate my singing, you are free to leave!
translation: 如果你不懂得欣赏我的歌声，你随时可以离开！

english: That's not a saga!
translation: 那根本不是传奇诗！

english: It's a short one, I'll admit...
translation: 我承认它很短……

english: What would you do if you became ruler of Miscellania?
translation: 如果你成为米斯凯尼亚的统治者，你会做什么？

english: Oh, I would never concern myself with such trivial matters as those involved in ruling a Kingdom. My interests lie solely in the arts.
translation: 哦，我绝不会为治理王国这类琐事操心。我的兴趣只在于艺术。

english: A much nobler pursuit, to be sure.
translation: 确实，是更高尚的追求。

english: I am glad you agree.
translation: 很高兴你同意。

english: If only you were any good at them...
translation: 可惜你一点都不擅长……

english: I am insulted, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 你侮辱了我，[Fremennik name]！

english: You're just afraid of responsibility.
translation: 你只是害怕承担责任。

english: Perhaps you are right...
translation: 也许你说得对……

english: Good day, [Fremennik name].
translation: 再见，[Fremennik name]。

english: Good day, my Prince.
translation: 再见，我的王子。

english: Is this for me? Really?
translation: 这是给我的？真的吗？

english: Of course, Prince.
translation: 当然，王子。

english: Thank you! It's lovely!
translation: 谢谢你！真可爱！

english: I must admit I am growing quite fond of you, [Fremennik name].
translation: 我必须承认，我越来越喜欢你了，[Fremennik name]。

english: Could it be, my Prince, that you would consider trusting a crass adventurer such as myself to run your kingdom?
translation: 我的王子，您是否可以考虑信任像我这样一个粗鲁的冒险者来管理您的王国？

english: Not quite yet, my good friend; let us just say, the future is a maze of inescapable decisions, and you are one possible answer.
translation: 还没到时候，我的好朋友；我们姑且这么说吧，未来是一座由无法逃避的决定构成的迷宫，而你是其中一个可能的答案。

english: No thank you, dear.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，亲爱的。

english: I wrote a song about you. Would you like to hear it?
translation: 我为你写了一首歌。你想听吗？

english: Your hair is like a waterfall Or perhaps a bramble bush Your eyes are like an ocean on which I want to sail the ship of our connection!
translation: 你的秀发如瀑布，又似荆棘丛，你的双眼如海洋，我愿驾起我们连接的船，在其中航行！

english: Eyes...ship...sail...what?
translation: 眼睛……船……航行……什么？

english: Was it really that hard to understand?
translation: 真的有那么难理解吗？

english: That was awful!
translation: 太糟糕了！

english: Fine! See if I write you any more songs!
translation: 行！看我以后还给你写歌！

english: That was lovely. I'm touched!
translation: 真好听。我被打动了！

english: I'm glad you liked it, my dear.
translation: 很高兴你喜欢，亲爱的。

english: Tell me, have you ever composed any poems yourself?
translation: 告诉我，你自己创作过诗歌吗？

english: I wouldn't presume to have the skill...
translation: 我不敢自诩有那种技巧……

english: You're right, it takes great skill and inspiration to be a great poet such as myself.
translation: 你说得对，要成为像我这样伟大的诗人，需要极大的技巧和灵感。

english: Not really, but it can't be that hard.
translation: 不见得，但应该没那么难。

english: You don't seem to understand poetry at all...
translation: 你似乎完全不懂诗歌……

english: There once was a man from Varrock...
translation: 从前有个来自维洛克城的人……

english: Don't lower the art of poetry with such bawdy rhymes!
translation: 别用这种粗俗的打油诗贬低了诗歌的艺术！

english: What do you think of your sister?
translation: 你觉得你妹妹怎么样？

english: We don't always see eye-to-eye, but she understands my art better than our father.
translation: 我们并非总是意见一致，但她比我父亲更懂我的艺术。

english: Of course, she couldn't understand as well as you do, my dear.
translation: 当然，她不可能像你一样理解得那么透彻，亲爱的。

english: What art is that?
translation: 什么艺术？

english: Music and poetry. Surely you haven't forgotten already?
translation: 音乐和诗歌。你该不会已经忘了吧？

english: I'm sorry you think so.
translation: 很遗憾你这么想。

english: Hello, dear
translation: 你好，亲爱的

english: Hello, my Prince.
translation: 你好，我的王子。

english: What's wrong, dear?
translation: 怎么了，亲爱的？

english: What's so funny, dear?
translation: 有什么好笑的，亲爱的？

english: You dance well, dear.
translation: 你舞跳得真好，亲爱的。

english: You flatter me, my dear.
translation: 你过奖了，亲爱的。

english: Thank you, dear.
translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的。

english: Yes, a gift fit for my prince!
translation: 是的，一件配得上我王子的礼物！

english: My heart is an open book to you, my dear, and all the pages say yes... ''Yes''!
translation: 我的心对你来说是一本打开的书，亲爱的，每一页都写着同意……“同意”！

english: We'll have to put off the actual ceremony until we can find a priest, but you can tell my father I have agreed to marry you.
translation: 我们得推迟实际仪式，直到找到一位祭司，但你可以告诉我父亲，我已经同意嫁给你了。

english: What a beautiful gift! I think you'd make a great Thane running our realm. Can you inform my father that you have earned my trust?
translation: 多美的礼物！我觉得你会成为一位出色的领主来管理我们的王国。你能告诉我父亲，你已经赢得了我的信任吗？

english: How fares the kingdom?
translation: 王国情况如何？

english: All is well, my Prince
translation: 一切安好，我的王子

english: Oh, my dear, you've made me the happiest person alive.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，你让我成为了世界上最幸福的人。

english: Yes! We'll have to put off the actual ceremony until we can find a priest, but you can tell my father I have agreed to marry you.
translation: 是的！我们得推迟实际仪式，直到找到一位祭司，但你可以告诉我父亲，我已经同意嫁给你了。

english: No, my dear, I was just showing you.
translation: 不，亲爱的，我只是给你看看。

english: How are you doing, dear? Have you convinced my father yet?
translation: 亲爱的，你还好吗？你说服我父亲了吗？

english: Not yet, my dear.
translation: 还没有，亲爱的。

english: Well, I think you'll make a great Thane for our kingdom.
translation: 嗯，我觉得你会成为我们王国的一位好领主。

english: Maybe not. It is hard, for I am so very fond of you. Let's leave it as it is for now and see what the future holds.
translation: 也许不行。这很难，因为我真的很喜欢你。我们先保持现状，看看未来如何吧。

english: [What's wrong,  sir/What's wrong,  madam/What's wrong]?
translation: [What's wrong,  sir/What's wrong,  madam/What's wrong]？

english: [Thank you, sir/Thank you, madam/Thank you].
translation: [Thank you, sir/Thank you, madam/Thank you]。

english: You realise, I hope, that many have tried to impress me.
translation: 我希望你知道，很多人都试图打动我。

english: I take it you are not especially inspired by any of them?
translation: 我猜你没有特别被他们中的任何一个打动？

english: That is true. However, I am willing to give you a chance; if you impress me enough, I will consider trusting you as our regent.
translation: 没错。不过，我愿意给你一个机会；如果你能足够打动我，我会考虑信任你作为我们的摄政王。

english: So, you practice archery? I see you have a bow mounted on your wall.
translation: 那么，你练习弓箭吗？我看到你墙上挂着一把弓。

english: Yes; my father thinks it is a cowardly art, but I find there is just as much courage, and more skill, involved in going into combat with just a bow and quiver. What do you think?
translation: 是的；我父亲认为弓箭是懦夫的艺术，但我发现只用弓和箭袋上战场需要同样的勇气，甚至更多的技巧。你觉得呢？

english: Archers are all cowards!
translation: 弓箭手都是懦夫！

english: Archery is a noble art!
translation: 弓箭是高贵的艺术！

english: So, tell me about all these other admirers you have.
translation: 那么，跟我说说其他那些仰慕者吧。

english: They never cease to bother me. They swarm around me like flies, all hoping to win my heart.
translation: 她们从不停止烦扰我。她们像苍蝇一样围着我转，都希望能赢得我的心。

english: Perhaps I should use them for target practice!
translation: 也许我应该拿他们当靶子练习！

english: I don't know why they bother...
translation: 我不知道他们为什么要费这个劲……

english: I don't know why YOU bother.
translation: 我不知道你为什么要费这个劲。

english: I was only joking.
translation: 我只是开个玩笑。

english: I can hold them still for you if you like.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以帮你按住他们。

english: How do you know I wouldn't hit you as well?
translation: 你怎么知道我不会连你也射中？

english: I have confidence in your skills, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 我对您的能力有信心，殿下。

english: What do you think of Advisor Ghrim?
translation: 你觉得顾问格里姆怎么样？

english: He's a bit scary sometimes, but he's always so nice to me! When I was young, I called him Uncle Ghrim.
translation: 他有时候有点吓人，但对我总是很好！我小时候叫他格里姆叔叔。

english: I think he's far too grumpy.
translation: 我觉得他太暴躁了。

english: I'm sure he'd lighten up if you were nicer.
translation: 我相信如果你对他好一点，他会开朗起来的。

english: He's been very helpful.
translation: 他一直很帮忙。

english: Yes, my father made a wise decision when he chose him to be his advisor.
translation: 是的，我父亲选择他做顾问是个明智的决定。

english: No wonder you turned out like this...
translation: 难怪你会变成这样……

english: [I'm insulted, sir/I'm insulted, madam/I'm insulted]!
translation: [I'm insulted, sir/I'm insulted, madam/I'm insulted]！

english: Impressive. I like someone who knows how to dance.
translation: 令人印象深刻。我喜欢懂得跳舞的人。

english: [If you want to applaud someone, sir/If you want to applaud someone, madam/If you want to applaud someone], I suggest you find my brother.
translation: [If you want to applaud someone, sir/If you want to applaud someone, madam/If you want to applaud someone]，我建议你去找我弟弟。

english: [You are perhaps a more interesting person than I first took you for, sir/You are perhaps a more interesting person than I first took you for, madam/You are perhaps a more interesting person than I first took you for]...
translation: [You are perhaps a more interesting person than I first took you for, sir/You are perhaps a more interesting person than I first took you for, madam/You are perhaps a more interesting person than I first took you for]……

english: [Then may I call you [Fremennik name], sir/Then may I call you [Fremennik name], madam/Then may I call you [Fremennik name]]?
translation: [Then may I call you [Fremennik name]，先生/那么我可以叫你[Fremennik name]，女士/那么我可以叫你[Fremennik name]]吗？

english: If I may call you Astrid, Your Royal Highness.
translation: 如果我可以叫你阿斯特丽德的话，殿下。

english: You may call me 'Princess'.
translation: 你可以叫我'公主'。

english: Very well, Princess.
translation: 好的，公主。

english: If you want to cheer someone on, [Fremennik name], I suggest you find my brother.
translation: 如果你想为某人加油，[Fremennik name]，我建议你去找我弟弟。

english: If you want to applaud someone, [Fremennik name], I suggest you find my brother.
translation: 如果你想为某人喝彩，[Fremennik name]，我建议你去找我弟弟。

english: What would you do if you ruled this Kingdom?
translation: 如果你统治这个王国，你会做什么？

english: Very little. It's not as if there's much to it... I might try to set up trade with other islands.
translation: 什么也不做。反正也没什么大事……我可能会尝试与其他岛屿建立贸易。

english: That's not very enterprising.
translation: 这不太有进取心。

english: Fine. You try to do better!
translation: 好啊，那你做得更好试试！

english: That sounds like a good idea.
translation: 听起来是个好主意。

english: What a silly idea! As if anyone would be interested!
translation: 多么愚蠢的想法！好像会有人感兴趣似的！

english: Watch it, or you won't get the chance to do better.
translation: 小心点，否则你连做得更好的机会都没有了。

english: So what's the history of these islands?
translation: 那么这些岛屿的历史是怎样的？

english: Well, nothing very exciting ever happened until my father declared war on Etceteria...
translation: 嗯，在我父亲向埃西特利亚岛宣战之前，一直没什么激动人心的事……

english: Why did he do that?
translation: 他为什么那么做？

english: Queen Sigrid of Etceteria insulted him.
translation: 埃西特利亚岛的西格里德女王侮辱了他。

english: It's not that funny.
translation: 这没那么好笑。

english: Well excuse me, Princess!
translation: 那抱歉了，公主！

english: He probably deserved it.
translation: 他大概活该。

english: I'm insulted, [Fremennik name]!
translation: 我被冒犯了，[Fremennik name]！

english: He realised that neither of us have an army.
translation: 他意识到我们双方都没有军队。

english: So why are you so interested in archery?
translation: 那你为什么对弓箭这么感兴趣？

english: I'm not sure. Even when I was little, archery always fascinated me.
translation: 我不太确定。即使我小时候，弓箭就总是让我着迷。

english: I'm quite fond of it myself.
translation: 我自己也很喜欢弓箭。

english: It's good to know someone who shares my interests.
translation: 很高兴认识一个和我有相同爱好的人。

english: You should stick to knitting.
translation: 你应该坚持织毛衣。

english: I'll knit you a lovely jumper, shall I? It'll keep you warm when I have you exiled to the icelands.
translation: 我会给你织件漂亮的毛衣，好吗？等我把你流放到冰原的时候，它能让你暖和点。

english: You should try swordfighting instead.
translation: 你应该试试剑术。

english: That's not really the kind of thing I'm interested in.
translation: 那不是我感兴趣的东西。

english: Good day, Princess.
translation: 日安，公主。

english: Of course, Princess.
translation: 当然，公主。

english: My, could it be that I have succeeded where so many before me have failed, and finally earned the trust of the Princess?
translation: 哎呀，难道我成功了？在那么多前人失败的地方，我终于赢得了公主的信任？

english: Not yet, my dear; let us just say you have made it onto the shortlist.
translation: 还没有，亲爱的；只能说你已经进入了候选名单。

english: So, my dear, what do you think of Miscellania?
translation: 那么，亲爱的，你觉得米斯凯尼亚怎么样？

english: It's a lovely little country.
translation: 这是个可爱的小国家。

english: I'm glad you like it.
translation: 很高兴你喜欢它。

english: It's boring.
translation: 很无聊。

english: Then perhaps you shouldn't be thinking of becoming its ruler.
translation: 那也许你就不该考虑成为它的统治者。

english: Well, I've seen better...
translation: 嗯，我见过更好的……

english: I'm quite fond of it myself...
translation: 我自己挺喜欢它的……

english: What do you think of your brother?
translation: 你觉得你弟弟怎么样？

english: We don't always get along, but I'm sure he's a nice guy at heart.
translation: 我们不是总能和睦相处，但我相信他内心是个好人。

english: And what a great bard he makes!
translation: 而且他是个多么棒的吟游诗人啊！

english: Haha! Oh yes, quite the bard, he is.
translation: 哈哈！哦是啊，他真是个吟游诗人。

english: I have heard better drains!
translation: 我听过比这更好的下水道声！

english: You don't sound like a nightingale yourself!
translation: 你自己的歌声也不像夜莺啊！

english: I really don't like him.
translation: 我真的不喜欢他。

english: That's not a nice thing to say.
translation: 这么说不好。

english: Do you go out into battle often?
translation: 你经常上战场吗？

english: Not often, no. I sometimes go hunting...
translation: 不经常。我有时会去打猎……

english: And you call yourself an archer?
translation: 你还自称弓箭手？

english: I take what chance for practice I can get.
translation: 我会抓住一切练习的机会。

english: Hunting the mighty rabbits outside the castle? Slaying the foul fowl that terrorises the town?
translation: 在城堡外猎杀凶猛的兔子？斩杀恐吓城镇的恶鸟？

english: That's not funny.
translation: 这一点都不好笑。

english: I suppose you don't have much opportunity to.
translation: 我想你没什么机会。

english: Exactly! Perhaps you could take me with you sometime, dear.
translation: 没错！也许你什么时候可以带我去，亲爱的。

english: If you want to cheer someone on, dear, I suggest you find my brother.
translation: 如果你想为某人加油，亲爱的，我建议你去找我弟弟。

english: *giggle* My, aren't you the charmer?
translation: *咯咯笑* 哎呀，你不是很会讨人欢心吗？

english: That's very sweet, darling.
translation: 你真贴心，亲爱的。

english: If you want to applaud someone, dear, I suggest you find my brother.
translation: 如果你想为某人喝彩，亲爱的，我建议你去找我弟弟。

english: Hello, darling.
translation: 你好，亲爱的。

english: Yes, a gift fit for my Princess!
translation: 是的，一份配得上我公主的礼物！

english: Oh, my dear, I thought you'd never ask! Of course I'll marry you!
translation: 哦，亲爱的，我还以为你永远不会问呢！我当然愿意嫁给你！

english: No, my darling, I was just showing you.
translation: 不，亲爱的，我只是给你看看。

english: All is well, Princess.
translation: 一切都好，公主。

english: How are you doing, darling? Have you convinced my father yet?
translation: 亲爱的，你还好吗？说服我父亲了吗？

english: Not yet, my darling.
translation: 还没有，亲爱的。

english: Maybe not. It ithard, for I am so very fond of you. Let's leave it as it is for now and see what the future holds.
translation: 也许还没有。这很难，因为我非常喜欢你。我们先这样吧，看看未来如何。

english: And this afternoon I shall be receiving the Embassador of Karamja and accompanying him on his week-long tour of Etceteria.
translation: 今天下午，我将接见卡拉姆詹岛的大使，并陪同他进行为期一周的埃西特利亚岛之旅。

english: I have been sent by King Vargas to negotiate a treaty of peace between your two great nations.
translation: 我是奉瓦加斯国王之命前来，与您谈判两国之间的和平条约。

english: Great nations? Don't make me laugh. Still, peace sounds like a nice idea. He will, of course, have to recognise Etceteria officially as a sovereign nation.
translation: 伟大的国家？别逗我笑了。不过，和平听起来是个好主意。当然，他必须正式承认埃西特利亚岛是一个主权国家。

english: This isn't already the case?
translation: 难道现在不是吗？

english: I'm afraid not. Last time we met I called him a pompous old fool for thinking he was still worth anything as an adventurer.
translation: 恐怕不是。上次见面时，我骂他是个自以为是的老傻瓜，还以为自己作为冒险者有什么价值。

english: He promptly declared war, claiming the land of Etceteria belonged to Miscellania.
translation: 他立刻宣战，声称埃西特利亚岛的土地属于米斯凯尼亚。

english: When he realised neither of us had an army, he was ever so angry!
translation: 当他发现我们双方都没有军队时，他气坏了！

english: What happened then?
translation: 然后发生了什么？

english: He set off for the icelands to prove me wrong and, well, I expect you saw what happened to him.
translation: 他动身前往冰原，想证明我是错的。嗯，我想你也看到他后来怎么样了。

english: I shall go ask him to officially recognise Etceteria.
translation: 我去请他正式承认埃西特利亚岛。

english: Hello. Have you talked to Vargas yet?
translation: 你好。你和瓦加斯谈过了吗？

english: I have, Your Majesty. She says she will agree to peace as long as Miscellania recognises Etceteria as a sovereign nation.
translation: 谈过了，陛下。她说只要米斯凯尼亚承认埃西特利亚岛是一个主权国家，她就同意和平。

english: Hmph! You can tell her I'll officially recognise her country as soon as she changes the Etceterian national anthem.
translation: 哼！你告诉她，只要她改了埃西特利亚的国歌，我就正式承认她的国家。

english: Why is that, Your Majesty?
translation: 这是为什么，陛下？

english: It's insulting! The title alone, "You're Stupid, We're the Best", should be enough to give you an idea!
translation: 太侮辱人了！光看歌名《你们真蠢，我们最棒》就应该能明白了吧！

english: I'm sure I can convince her there are better anthems.
translation: 我相信我能说服她，有比这更好的国歌。

english: How are you getting on, [Fremennik name]? Have you convinced Sigrid yet?
translation: [Fremennik name]，你进展如何？说服西格里德了吗？

english: I have, Your Majesty. He says he will recognise the country when you change your anthem.
translation: 说服了，陛下。他说只要你改了国歌，他就承认这个国家。

english: What? But it's a great anthem, I composed it myself! Listen!
translation: 什么？但这可是一首很棒的国歌，我自己写的！你听听！

english: "You're stupid, we're the best, Etceteria beats the rest! and Queen Sigrid is very pretty, King Vargas is a fool, hey, nonny-nonny!"
translation: "你很蠢，我们最棒，埃西特利亚岛打败其他！西格里德女王非常漂亮，瓦加斯国王是个傻瓜，嘿，诺尼-诺尼！"

english: I'm afraid he insisted, Your Majesty.
translation: 恐怕他坚持要这样，陛下。

english: Well, it can't be helped I suppose...
translation: 嗯，我想这也是没办法的事……

english: You'll have to find a bard to write a new one though. And there isn't a bard to be had for love nor money in Etceteria.
translation: 不过你得找个吟游诗人写首新的。但在埃西特利亚岛，无论出钱还是托关系，都找不到一个吟游诗人。

english: I'll see what I can do, Your Majesty.
translation: 我会尽力想办法的，陛下。

english: Hello. Have you found a new anthem yet?
translation: 你好。找到新国歌了吗？

english: You should find someone to compose a new anthem for Etceteria.
translation: 你应该找人为埃西特利亚岛创作一首新国歌。

english: I need someone to compose a new anthem for Etceteria.
translation: 我需要有人为埃西特利亚岛创作一首新国歌。

english: You've come to the right bard! I'll write one for you immediately!
translation: 你找对吟游诗人了！我马上给你写一首！

english: You can take your time, really...
translation: 你其实可以慢慢来……

english: No problem, I'm already done! Here, listen!
translation: 没问题，我已经写好了！来，听听！

english: 'Etceteria, Etceteria, Oh what a great country it is, Etceteria, Etceteria, So I wrote a song about it.'
translation: '埃西特利亚岛，埃西特利亚岛，哦，多么伟大的国家，埃西特利亚岛，埃西特利亚岛，所以我写了一首关于它的歌。'

english: 'It's somewhere in the sea, And it looks very nice, If it weren't for your ancestors, It wouldn't be there at all,'
translation: '它在大海某处，看起来非常美丽，如果不是你的祖先，它根本不会存在，'

english: 'And when things aren't going too well, We sing this lovely song, And then we'll all feel so much better, It won't take very long.'
translation: '当事情进展不顺时，我们唱起这首可爱的歌，然后我们都会感觉好多了，用不了多久。'

english: Here's a copy, you can keep it!
translation: 给你一份副本，你留着吧！

english: ...that's lovely, thanks.
translation: ……真不错，谢谢。

english: [Don't mention it, dear/Don't mention it, sir/Don't mention it, madam/Don't mention it].
translation: [Don't mention it, dear/Don't mention it, sir/Don't mention it, madam/Don't mention it]。

english: I lost my copy of the *ahem* theme you composed...
translation: 我弄丢了你创作的*咳咳*主题曲的副本……

english: Fear not! I made many, many more!
translation: 别担心！我做了很多很多份！

english: Yes, Your Majesty, but I'm afraid it isn't very good.
translation: 是的，陛下，但恐怕这首不怎么样。

english: Let's see now...
translation: 让我看看……

english: Oh dear, no, this simply won't do. Find a better one.
translation: 哦天哪，不行，这绝对不行。去找首更好的。

english: [Greetings, sir/Greetings, madam/Greetings].
translation: [Greetings, sir/Greetings, madam/Greetings]。

english: I got Prince Brand to compose a new Etceterian anthem for me, but it's awful!
translation: 我让布兰德王子为我创作了一首新的埃西特利亚国歌，但太糟糕了！

english: Oh dear. Well, that is only to be expected. May I see it, please?
translation: 哦天哪。嗯，这也是意料之中的。能让我看看吗？

english: Hmm, yes...allow me to make a few adjustments.
translation: 嗯，好的……请允许我做些修改。

english: [There you go, sir/There you go, madam/There you go]. Are there any other matters in which I may be of assistance?
translation: [There you go, sir/There you go, madam/There you go]。还有其他事情需要我帮忙吗？

english: You should get another copy of the anthem.
translation: 你应该再拿一份国歌副本。

english: You should show the anthem to Queen Sigrid.
translation: 你应该把国歌给西格里德女王看看。

english: I lost the corrected anthem you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的修改过的国歌。

english: Do you have another copy of the prince's anthem for me to correct?
translation: 你还有另一份王子的国歌副本让我修改吗？

english: Yes, here it is.
translation: 是的，给你。

english: I'm afraid I don't have one.
translation: 恐怕我没有。

english: If you bring me another, I can correct it. Are there any other matters in which I may be of assistance?
translation: 如果你再带一份来，我可以修改。还有其他事情需要我帮忙吗？

english: 'Etceteria, Etceteria, Of our country we are proud! Etceteria, Etceteria, Let all sing its name out loud!'
translation: '埃西特利亚岛，埃西特利亚岛，我们为我们的国家感到骄傲！埃西特利亚岛，埃西特利亚岛，让所有人都大声唱出它的名字！'

english: 'Rising high above the water, The jewel of the North! Our mothers and our fathers, To build this land came forth!'
translation: '高耸于水面之上，北方的明珠！我们的父母先辈，前来建设这片土地！'

english: 'And in the times of darkness, Sing praises of our land! And in our hearts we can be sure, Our victory is at hand!'
translation: '在黑暗的时刻，歌颂我们的土地！我们心中确信，胜利就在眼前！'

english: Why, this is quite good! I'm surprised!
translation: 哎呀，这相当不错！真让我惊讶！

english: Here is a treaty declaring what we've mutually agreed to. I've already signed, so all it needs is King Vargas' signature and it'll be official.
translation: 这是一份我们双方同意的条约。我已经签了，所以只需要瓦加斯国王的签名就正式生效了。

english: Hello. Has Vargas signed the treaty yet?
translation: 你好。瓦加斯签了条约吗？

english: I'm afraid I lost it, Your Majesty.
translation: 恐怕我把它弄丢了，陛下。

english: How silly of you. I'll make you another.
translation: 你真粗心。我再给你做一份。

english: You should show the treaty to the King.
translation: 你应该把条约给国王看看。

english: I have here a treaty awaiting your signature.
translation: 我这里有一份条约，等待您的签署。

english: I doubt I will be able to hold an ordinary pen well enough to sign the treaty. You will have to find a pen large enough for me to hold.
translation: 我怀疑我能否用普通笔很好地握住并签署条约。你得找一支大到我能握住的笔。

english: How are you getting on, [Fremennik name]? Have you found me a pen yet?
translation: [Fremennik name]，你进展如何？给我找到笔了吗？

english: You should find a way to make the nib and body for a very large pen.
translation: 你应该想办法制作一支非常大的笔的笔尖和笔杆。

english: I have a slightly strange request...
translation: 我有个有点奇怪的要求……

english: The King needs to sign a treaty, but is unable to because he lacks a pen large enough for him to hold. Could you make me a nib of the right size?
translation: 国王需要签署一份条约，但因为缺少一支大到他能握住的笔而无法签署。你能帮我做一个合适尺寸的笔尖吗？

english: Hm... I may be able to manage that. What sort of size?
translation: 嗯……我或许能办到。要多大尺寸？

english: About the size of a helm should do it.
translation: 大约一个头盔的大小应该就行。

english: All right, but I'll need an iron bar to make it from.
translation: 好吧，但我需要一块铁锭来制作。

english: I don't have one with me.
translation: 我身上没有。

english: Well, come back when you have one.
translation: 嗯，那等你有了再来吧。

english: Good. Just a minute...
translation: 好的。稍等一下……

english: Here you go! One giant pen nib!
translation: 给你！一个巨型笔尖！

english: Good day, Sir. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 日安，先生。有什么能帮您的吗？

english: Good day, Madam. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 日安，女士。有什么能帮您的吗？

english: Here it is, Your Majesty.
translation: 给您，陛下。

english: Excellent! And now, with a flourish, I sign the end of the rivalry between our two proud kingdoms!
translation: 太好了！现在，让我潇洒地一挥，结束我们两个骄傲王国之间的对抗！

english: Now, how's it going with my [son/daughter], will they accept you as regent?
translation: 现在，我的[son/daughter]那边怎么样了？他们会接受你当摄政王吗？

english: [He/She] will, your Majesty.
translation: [He/She]会的，陛下。

english: Excellent, excellent.
translation: 太好了，太好了。

english: Ghrim tells me that the population is not yet very supportive of the idea of having you as ruler. You should try to gain their support.
translation: 格里姆告诉我，民众还不太支持让你当统治者。你应该努力争取他们的支持。

english: I should tell you right away that killing the people of this Kingdom will not make you popular with anyone.
translation: 我得马上告诉你，杀害这个王国的子民不会让你受到任何人的欢迎。

english: [Gaining the support of the population, sir/Gaining the support of the population, madam/Gaining the support of the population].
translation: [Gaining the support of the population, sir/Gaining the support of the population, madam/Gaining the support of the population]。

english: Currently, [number]% of the population supports you.
translation: 目前，有[number]%的民众支持你。

english: This is enough for you to become Regent; I should talk to King Vargas if I were you.
translation: 这已经足够让你成为摄政王了；如果我是你，我会去和瓦加斯国王谈谈。

english: You will need 75 % of the population in your support in order to become Regent.
translation: 你需要获得75%的民众支持才能成为摄政王。

english: How do I gain the support of the population?
translation: 我怎样才能获得民众的支持？

english: King Vargas would often go and help out his subjects in their daily tasks, when he was still able to do so, and they loved him dearly for it.
translation: 瓦加斯国王在还能行动的时候，经常去帮助他的臣民处理日常事务，因此他们非常爱戴他。

english: Ghrim tells me that the population would be glad to have you as a ruler.
translation: 格里姆告诉我，民众很乐意让你当统治者。

english: I see no reason to delay your regency any further. Ghrim, please proceed with the ceremony.
translation: 我看没有理由再推迟你的摄政了。格里姆，请继续进行仪式。

english: Yes, Your Majesty, I will proceed at once. Ahem...
translation: 是的，陛下，我马上进行。咳咳……

english: We are gathered here today to witness the rise of a new hero to the regency of the Kingdom of Miscellania, to continue the work of our great King Vargas who is unfortunately now no longer able to rule.
translation: 我们今天聚集在这里，见证一位新英雄崛起，成为米斯凯尼亚王国的摄政王，继续我们伟大的瓦加斯国王的事业，不幸的是，他已无法再统治。

english: By the powers invested in me by the Miscellaneous Constitution, I declare thee, [Fremennik name], to be the new Regent of this fair kingdom.
translation: 根据《米斯凯尼亚宪法》赋予我的权力，我宣布你，[Fremennik name]，成为这个美丽王国的新任摄政王。

english: May you bring success and prosperity to Miscellania and to all of its people.
translation: 愿你为米斯凯尼亚及其所有人民带来成功与繁荣。

english: ...is that all?
translation: ……就这些？

english: That is all. I wish you luck as Regent. Speak to Ghrim if you require assistance.
translation: 就这些。祝你好运，摄政王。如果需要帮助，就和格里姆说。

english: Good day, Princess Astrid.
translation: 日安，阿斯特丽德公主。

english: Oh, my [darling/dear], you've made me the happiest person alive.
translation: 哦，我的[darling/dear]，你让我成为了世界上最幸福的人。

english: I'm afraid not, dear. I don't think there is one to be had on these islands for love nor money...
translation: 恐怕不行，亲爱的。我觉得在这些岛上，无论出多少钱都买不到……

english: Good day, Prince Brand.
translation: 日安，布兰德王子。

english: Your current approval rating is 75%. I'm afraid your subjects have not yet collected anything.
translation: 您目前的满意度是75%。恐怕您的臣民还没有收集到任何东西。

english: to the east, herbs from the garden just outside the castle, and tuna and swordfish fished at the port to the south. They are paid from the money in the coffers; each day, one-tenth of the money in the coffers is
translation: 东边的草药来自城堡外的花园，金枪鱼和剑鱼是在南边的港口捕捞的。他们的报酬来自国库中的资金；每天，国库中十分之一的资金会

english: distributed to them. A maximum of 50k is paid to your subjects and the coffers can store up to 5 million gp. Another thing which affects the amounts of resources collected is your approval rating. The more your
translation: 分配给他们。支付给臣民的上限是5万金币，国库最多可储存500万金币。另一个影响资源收集量的因素是您的满意度。您的

english: subjects love you, the more they will be motivated to work hard. King Vargas would often go and help out his subjects in their daily tasks, when he was still able to do so, and they loved him dearly for it. Finally, you
translation: 臣民越爱戴您，他们就越有动力努力工作。瓦加斯国王在还能行动时，经常去帮助臣民完成日常任务，臣民也因此深深爱戴他。最后，您

english: can choose how much of their efforts your subjects devote to each resource; of course, the harder they work at collecting one, the less time they have to spend collecting the others.
translation: 可以选择臣民将多少精力投入到每种资源上；当然，他们在收集一种资源上越努力，花在收集其他资源上的时间就越少。

english: Dealing with all the little troubles that come up from time to time, Thane [Fremennik name].
translation: 处理时不时出现的小麻烦，[Fremennik name]领主。

english: Guess what!
translation: 猜猜看！

english: I'm a fully-fledged builder!
translation: 我可是个货真价实的建筑工人！

english: Marvellous! So you can bring this tower to life!
translation: 太棒了！那么你能让这座塔活起来咯！

english: I'm not sure about that, but I'll take a look and see what I can do.
translation: 这我可没把握，不过我会看看能做些什么。

english: Oh, what a wondrous person you are!
translation: 哦，你真是个了不起的人！

english: 'Ah, this be the Tower of Life! Beautiful, isn't it?
translation: '啊，这就是生命之塔！很漂亮，对吧？

english: 'Pah, you have no taste.
translation: '哼，你真没品味。

english: I'm a builder!
translation: 我是建筑工人！

english: 'I question why you are so pleased about this.
translation: '我纳闷你为什么对这事这么高兴。

english: Well, I think it's a positive step in my career as a courageous adventurer.
translation: 嗯，我觉得这是我作为勇敢冒险者职业生涯中积极的一步。

english: 'Yeah, it cost a fair bit.
translation: '是啊，花了不少钱。

english: 'Well, I had to 'alch' a fair few belongings of my fellow alchemists to afford it.
translation: '呃，我不得不把我那些炼金术士同行的不少东西拿去高变掉才买得起。

english: 'Everyone loves someone that can create money.
translation: '谁不喜欢能凭空变钱的人呢？

english: Hi. Sorry, but why do they call you 'Currency'?
translation: 嗨。抱歉，为什么他们叫你‘货币’？

english: 'That's down to my interest in all things of monetary value.
translation: '那是因为我对一切有货币价值的东西感兴趣。

english: You must be pretty rich then.
translation: 那你一定很有钱吧。

english: 'I wish. And I was, up until recently.
translation: '但愿如此。之前确实是，直到最近。

english: 'This tower. Set me back a fair few million.
translation: '这座塔。花了我好几百万。

english: I'll bet! It pleases you, then, to know that I have just become a builder and have been granted permission to go mess around inside.
translation: 我猜也是！那你听到我刚刚成了建筑工人，还被允许进去随便折腾，一定很高兴吧？

english: 'This is not a good day for me.
translation: '今天对我来说可不是好日子。

english: Are you Bonafido by any chance?
translation: 你是不是博纳菲多？

english: That I am, mate.
translation: 正是我，伙计。

english: How can I be of assistance?
translation: 有什么能帮到你的？

english: Well, I've just spoken to Effigy about this tower. He tells me he hired you to work but you're on strike. Something about an extended tea break?
translation: 呃，我刚刚跟雕像聊过这座塔。他说他雇你干活，但你在罢工。好像是因为休息时间太长？

english: Extended cup o' char? E's got it all wrong, mate. We know those alchemi-whatsits are up ta somefin' weird in building this tower, wot wiv all the machinery, and until we get some answers we're not movin a muscle.
translation: 休息时间太长？他全搞错了，伙计。我们知道那些炼金什么的东西在建这座塔时搞了些古怪名堂，又是各种机械，在我们得到解释之前，我们绝不干任何活。

english: Well, he wanted me to do something about it.
translation: 嗯，他希望我来处理这事。

english: Is there no way I can convince you to continue?
translation: 难道没办法说服你们继续干活吗？

english: Sorry, mate.
translation: 抱歉，伙计。

english: Well, can I at least have a look inside the tower?
translation: 好吧，至少我能进塔里看看吗？

english: Only builders are allowed in there, like. You don't look like much ov a builder to me.
translation: 只有建筑工人才能进去，伙计。我看你可不像什么建筑工人。

english: I take offence at that! Give me a chance; you may be surprised.
translation: 这话我可不受用！给我个机会；你可能会大吃一惊的。

english: Okay. Come to me kitted out like a builder - hard hat, some boots, scruffy trousers and shirt - and I'll let ya try out ta be one ov us.
translation: 好吧。你穿戴得像个建筑工人再来找我——安全帽、靴子、斯克拉菲裤子和衬衫——我就让你试试当咱们中的一员。

english: Count me in!
translation: 算我一个！

english: Always glad to help a budding builder.
translation: 总是乐意帮助初出茅庐的建筑工人。

english: But first, prove your Construction knowledge by answering some questions.
translation: 不过首先，回答一些问题来证明你的建筑知识。

english: One? How do you suppose to use a single nail?
translation: 一枚？你打算怎么用一枚钉子？

english: Guess again, mate.
translation: 再猜猜，伙计。

english: You seem to know your stuff. I got a spare helmet from a builder that died on... I mean, err, had to leave the job for greener pastures.
translation: 看来你挺懂行的。我有个多余的帽子，是从一个死掉的建筑工人……呃，我是说，一个不得不另谋高就的工人那里拿的。

english: Why, thanks. Some would say as nice as the one you're wearing!
translation: 哎呀，谢啦。有人会说这帽子跟你头上那顶一样好看呢！

english: Well I am so very pleased!
translation: 那我真是太高兴了！

english: Guess again, babe.
translation: 再猜猜看，宝贝。

english: Well, I might consider it if you had space to carry one.
translation: 嗯，如果你有地方带一个的话，我可能会考虑一下。

english: 'Why, thanks. Some would say as nice as the one you're wearing!
translation: '哎呀，谢了。有人会说跟你身上穿的那件一样好看！

english: Hi, I'm looking to get some kit to look like one of you guys.
translation: 嗨，我想弄一套装备，看起来像你们这样的人。

english: Anything you might be able to help me out with?
translation: 你能帮我什么忙吗？

english: Well... Urmph! Ye can 'ave me shirt...
translation: 嗯……唔！你可以拿我的衬衫……

english: Hmmm. Has it been cleaned? I don't want some sweaty hand-me-down.
translation: 嗯。洗过没有？我可不要别人穿过的臭汗衫。

english: What? Huhmf! It ain't ever been...uurrgg...worn.
translation: 什么？哼！它从来没……呃……穿过。

english: Well, that sounds good. Can I have it then?
translation: 嗯，听起来不错。那我能要吗？

english: Can't...hurrr...see why not. This is firsty work doh. Could do wiv a beer.
translation: 没……呃……理由不给。这活儿可真累。能来杯啤酒就好了。

english: Sure. What's your 'usual'?
translation: 没问题。你‘老样子’是什么？

english: I'm a simple...umph...man. I like the bar in Yanille and their cheap beer...
translation: 我是个简朴……呃……的人。我喜欢亚尼勒城的酒吧，还有他们便宜的啤酒……

english: Simple, cheap beer. No problem.
translation: 简单、便宜的啤酒。没问题。

english: Well, today's your lucky day!
translation: 嗯，今天你走运了！

english: Ahhh! Smashin...urrghh...deal!
translation: 啊哈！太棒了……呃……成交！

english: Fancy another?
translation: 再来一杯？

english: Nah, thanks. You've got your shirt and I've got my energy back.
translation: 不了，谢谢。你拿到了衬衫，我也恢复了精力。

english: Hi! How's this for some booze?
translation: 嗨！这酒怎么样？

english: That's no good. I need some simple beer.
translation: 不行。我要的是简单普通的啤酒。

english: Nah, thanks, I'm not drinking that.
translation: 不了，谢了，我不喝那个。

english: Beer?
translation: 啤酒？

english: How do you expect me to drink that?
translation: 你指望我怎么喝那个？

english: Well... Urmpf! Ye can 'ave me shirt...
translation: 好吧……呃哼！你可以拿走我的衬衫……

english: Ahhh! Smashin'...urrghh...deal!
translation: 啊哈！太棒了……呃啊……成交！

english: Clothing.
translation: 衣服。

english: Nope. Need mine.
translation: 不。我自己要用。

english: Ah, come on. You know you want to give me free stuff.
translation: 啊，别这样。你知道你想白送我东西。

english: Stop bothering me, can't you see I'm busy!
translation: 别烦我，你没看见我正忙着吗！

english: Yes, VERY busy I'm sure.
translation: 是啊，肯定非常忙。

english: The other day I was drying my clothes on a line down by the shore. A storm hit and some of my clothing went missing.
translation: 有一天我在岸边晾衣服。一场暴风雨袭来，我的一些衣服不见了。

english: Likely story. Sure you weren't skinny dipping?
translation: 说得跟真的一样。确定你不是在裸泳？

english: Just go look and leave me be! Search around the tower and you may find them.
translation: 去看看就行了，别管我！在塔周围搜索，你可能会找到它们。

english: Hello. I was just wondering... I don't suppose you have any spare clothing you could lend me?
translation: 你好。我只是想……你有没有多余的衣服能借我？

english: I do have many boots.
translation: 我确实有很多靴子。

english: Ah, thanks.
translation: 啊，谢谢。

english: But there's no way I'm giving any to you.
translation: 但我绝不会给你任何一双。

english: Oh, but why? I could pay you!
translation: 哦，为什么？我可以付钱！

english: Nope. Only real builders can wear builders' boots, and you're not even close.
translation: 不行。只有真正的建筑工人才能穿建筑工人的靴子，而你差得远呢。

english: Still looking for boots?
translation: 还在找靴子吗？

english: Well, I am. Have you seen-
translation: 嗯，是啊。你见过——

english: 'Don't suppose you've seen any boots around here? Size nine, steel toed, brown leather...
translation: '你在这附近见过靴子吗？九号，钢头，棕色皮革……

english: Hey, Bonafido.
translation: 嘿，博纳菲多。

english: Well, if it ain't the wannabe builder!
translation: 哟，这不是想当建筑工人的家伙吗！

english: What clothes do I need?
translation: 我需要什么衣服？

english: Ya don't seem to be able ta remember anyfin'... Dearie me.
translation: 你好像什么都记不住……天哪。

english: Come back to me wearin' a hard hat, some scruffy trousers, a good top and some hard boots. Yow shud fand some around 'ere.
translation: 回来找我时，要戴着安全帽，穿着破旧裤子、一件好上衣和一双硬靴子。你应该能在这附近找到。

english: Like a builder frew and frew! Good job - now it's time to test your skills.
translation: 彻头彻尾像个建筑工人！干得好——现在该测试你的技能了。

english: Okay, what do you want me to build?
translation: 好吧，你想让我建什么？

english: Build?
translation: 建造？

english: Build? Hahaha, don't be a plonka!
translation: 建造？哈哈哈，别傻了！

english: It's not building skills that makes a true builder, you have to have the right mental attitude, yeah?
translation: 真正的建筑工人靠的不是建造技能，而是要有正确的心态，懂吗？

english: You've plenty of work to do, but you need a drink fast - what do you go for?
translation: 你有一大堆活要干，但急需喝点什么——你会选什么？

english: Orange juice.
translation: 橙汁。

english: What are you? A healthy builder? Of course, not juice!
translation: 你算什么？健康建筑工人？当然不是果汁！

english: Tea.
translation: 茶。

english: Bingo! Ain't nufin' betta.
translation: 答对了！没什么比这更好的了。

english: Now, let's hear you whistle!
translation: 现在，让我听听你吹口哨！

english: What on Gielinor are you doing? Get out of my sight.
translation: 你搞什么名堂？从我眼前消失。

english: You know, you have quite a talent there.
translation: 你知道吗，你在这方面还挺有天赋。

english: Why thank you. Do you think I have what it takes to become a famous whistler?
translation: 谢谢夸奖。你觉得我有成为著名口哨家的潜质吗？

english: Wahey! Nice one. Next question.
translation: 哇哦！不错。下一问。

english: What's a good sign that you need to replace your trousers?
translation: 什么迹象表明你需要换裤子了？

english: Your legs are getting a bit cold?
translation: 你的腿有点冷了？

english: Exactamondo! Glad to see you are thinking like a builder.
translation: 完全正确！很高兴看到你像建筑工人一样思考。

english: Yes, obviously if your legs are cold, you lost your trousers altogether!
translation: 对，显然如果你的腿冷了，说明裤子完全没了！

english: That's just what I was thinking.
translation: 这正是我在想的。

english: Now the last question - what do you do if you cut your finger?
translation: 现在最后一个问题——如果你割伤了手指，你会怎么做？

english: Cry.
translation: 哭。

english: When was the last time you saw a builder cry?
translation: 你最后一次看到建筑工人哭是什么时候？

english: Carry on, it'll fix itself.
translation: 继续吧，它会自己好起来的。

english: Yep, that's the one!
translation: 对，就是那个！

english: Suppose it could get infected then, but that'll just impress the lads all the more.
translation: 说不定会感染，但这只会让兄弟们更佩服我。

english: Exactly, you're gettin the hang of this quickly!
translation: 没错，你上手挺快的！

english: Cosmic! I canna see no reason why ya can't go in t'tower now. But be careful, there be some precarious situations in there.
translation: 宇宙级！我看不出你现在还有什么理由不能进塔了。不过小心点，里面有些危险的地方。

english: So, what's left to build?
translation: 那么，还有什么要建的吗？

english: Well, there's a pipe system, a pressure machine and a strange cage up at the top that needs finishing off. The alchemists couldn't explain what they were for.
translation: 嗯，有一套管道系统、一台压力机，还有塔顶一个奇怪的笼子需要收尾。炼金术士们也说不清它们是做什么的。

english: Fetch a plaster and ointment.
translation: 去拿个膏药和药膏来。

english: Look, [player name], let me give you a bit of advice. If you want to look weak, that's the best way to go.
translation: 听着，[player name]，我给你点建议。如果你想显得很弱，这才是个好办法。

english: They're ripped and full of holes.
translation: 它们都破破烂烂，满是窟窿。

english: No, no, no. That's the only way they should be!
translation: 不不不，它们就该这样！

english: The colour is starting to fade?
translation: 颜色开始褪了？

english: Oh no, you're really not getting the hang of this are you?
translation: 哦不，你真的一点都没上道，对吧？

english: Bottle of wine.
translation: 一瓶葡萄酒。

english: Ooh, get Mr Fancy Pants here and his posh wine! You're no builder.
translation: 哦，看这位花裤衩先生和他的高档酒！你根本不是建筑工人。

english: Hi again Bonafido.
translation: 又见面了，博纳菲多。

english: Hi, 'Kelsew the Builder'! Been into the tower yet?
translation: 嗨，'建筑工人凯尔苏'！进过塔了吗？

english: Not yet, I'll go when I'm ready. I'm taking my time, may have a quick cup of tea first.
translation: 还没，我准备好了就去。我不着急，也许先喝杯茶再说。

english: Wow, this place looks special. Best I look around for something to fix.
translation: 哇，这地方看起来真特别。最好四处看看有什么能修的。

english: Heya, Bona. I had a look at the building. There's some complex machinery in there! Going to cost someone.
translation: 嘿，博纳。我看了看那栋建筑。里面有些复杂的机械！得花不少钱。

english: Yep, told ya so. Any idea what those alchemists are up ta?
translation: 是啊，早跟你说了。知道那些炼金术士在搞什么鬼吗？

english: Well, I agree now they're up to something. The question is what...? I don't think we're going to find out much from the alchmists, though.
translation: 嗯，现在我同意他们确实在搞事。问题是搞什么……不过我觉得从炼金术士那儿问不出什么来。

english: I shall see if I can't fix it up and see for myself what is going on. Should be able to get a good reward from them. But don't worry, I'll make sure your efforts don't go unpaid.
translation: 我看看能不能把它修好，自己搞明白怎么回事。应该能从他们那儿拿到丰厚的报酬。不过别担心，我不会让你的付出白费的。

english: You're a star among builders, that ya are!
translation: 你真是建筑工人中的明星，没错！

english: Hello again, Effigy. I've had a nose around the tower. There's a lot of work to do!
translation: 又见面了，雕像。我在这塔里探了探。活儿可不少！

english: I know, I know. But think of how fantastical it will be when it is finished!
translation: 我知道，我知道。但想想完工后会有多奇妙吧！

english: Why fantastical? What are all those pipes and machines in there? What are you trying to do?
translation: 为什么说奇妙？里面那些管道和机器是干什么的？你们想干什么？

english: Fantastic weather we're having today!
translation: 今天天气真好！

english: But what are the-
translation: 但是那些是——

english: The sun is shining... The birds are singing...
translation: 阳光明媚……鸟类在歌唱……

english: Hey! Answer my question!
translation: 嘿！回答我的问题！

english: Hehe. Just fix the tower. You'll soon see.
translation: 嘿嘿。只管修好塔。你很快就会看到了。

english: You'd best pay me well for this.
translation: 你最好把我这份工钱给足了。

translation: 你把它放出来了。哦，求求你别伤害我！

english: Me not hurt. Now tell. What you plans? What you do with me?
translation: 偶不伤害。现在说。你们什么打算？你们对偶做了什么？

english: Please, we just wanted to experiment. We wanted to create life. There's a dungeon under the tower. Long ago we found a strange source of energy that we believe was left behind by the great Guthix. He used to
translation: 拜托，我们只是想实验。我们想创造生命。塔底下有个地牢。很久以前我们发现了一股奇怪的能源，我们认为那是伟大的古斯留下的。他曾经

english: create life with such ease. We realised we should be able to use this powerful substance, but we needed to bring together our magic along with the logical construction of the builders. It seemed through our experiments that
translation: 如此轻易地创造生命。我们意识到应该能够利用这种强大的物质，但我们需要将我们的魔法与建造者们的逻辑建筑结合起来。通过实验我们似乎发现

english: even magic needs a certain level of rules and laws to work.
translation: 即使是魔法也需要一定程度的规则和法则才能运作。

english: Bad play with. Naughty men. Go! Go, never return!
translation: 坏蛋玩弄。淘气的人。滚！滚，永远别回来！

english: Right away, right away!
translation: 马上走，马上走！

english: Good lad! I knew you would help us!
translation: 好小子！我就知道你会帮我们！

english: What a keen eye this lass has! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
translation: 这姑娘眼力真好！但想象一下：一个巨大的圆柱体，设计精巧，内部设有创新的螺旋人行道，通往多个奇妙的居住层面！

english: You look like a sturdy lass.
translation: 你看起来是个结实的姑娘。

english: Good girl! I knew you would help us!
translation: 好姑娘！我就知道你会帮我们！

english: Well, thanks.
translation: 嗯，谢了。

english: Perhaps one day, but I'm looking for someone with better skills to be honest.
translation: 也许有一天吧，但老实说，我在找技术更好的人。

english: Make haste, young adventurer! For the great Tower of Life awaits no man, and only the impetuous will discover its virtue!
translation: 快点，年轻的冒险者！伟大的生命之塔可不等人，只有勇往直前的人才能发现它的价值！

english: My favorite builder! Any luck?
translation: 我最喜欢的建筑工人！有进展吗？

english: Go have a word with Bonafido, the head builder, lying next to the entrance to the tower. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work.
translation: 去和躺在塔入口旁边的首席建筑工人博纳菲多说句话。看看能不能让他起来干点活。

english: Have you gotten rid of it?
translation: 你把它弄走了吗？

english: Hmmm. Yes, I can see how that would be a problem. You're not the shiniest gold in the gravel.
translation: 嗯。是的，我能看出那会是个问题。你可不是碎石堆里最闪亮的金子。

english: Many hours we have worked!
translation: 我们工作了好多个小时！

english: Me look dungeon, [player name]. Please meet there.
translation: 偶去看看地牢，[player name]。请在那里见面。

english: This place is bizarre!
translation: 这地方真古怪！

english: Me do know. Pleased you rescue.
translation: 偶知道。很高兴你救偶。

english: My pleasure. So what is this place?
translation: 乐意效劳。那么这是什么地方？

english: They use essence of Guthix power. Create tower pump this from ground. Make me with godly power. Dangerous.
translation: 他们使用古斯之力精华。建造塔泵从地下抽取。用神力制造我。危险。

english: Oh dear, but you're okay now. You have this place to reside in.
translation: 哦天哪，不过你现在没事了。你有这个地方可以住下了。

english: Thrank you. For reward you speak me, I makes monsters.
translation: 谢谢泥。作为你跟偶说话的回报，偶会制造怪物。

english: Well hello stranger. My name's Bolren, I'm the king of the tree gnomes.
translation: 哦，你好啊陌生人。我叫博尔伦，是树地精的国王。

english: I'm surprised you made it in, maybe I made the maze too easy.
translation: 我很惊讶你能进来，也许是我把迷宫设计得太简单了。

english: I'm afraid I have more serious concerns at the moment. Very serious.
translation: 恐怕我现在有更紧要的事。非常紧要。

english: I'm glad you asked.
translation: 很高兴你问起。

english: The truth is my people are in grave danger. We have always been protected by the Spirit Tree. No creature of dark can harm us while its three orbs are in place.
translation: 事实是，我的人民正处于巨大危险中。我们一直受到灵魂树的保护。只要它的三颗宝珠还在，就没有黑暗生物能伤害我们。

english: We are not a violent race, but we fight when we must. Many gnomes have fallen battling the dark forces of Khazard to the North.
translation: 我们不是一个好战的种族，但必要时也会战斗。许多地精在与北方卡扎德黑暗势力的战斗中倒下了。

english: We became desperate, so we took one orb of protection to the battlefield. It was a foolish move.
translation: 我们陷入了绝境，于是带了一颗防护宝珠到战场上。那是个愚蠢的决定。

english: Khazard troops seized the orb. Now we are completely defenceless.
translation: 卡扎德的士兵夺走了宝珠。现在我们完全失去了防御。

english: You would be a huge benefit on the battlefield. If you would go there and try to retrieve the orb, my people and I will be forever grateful.
translation: 你如果加入战场会大有帮助。如果你愿意去那里，尝试夺回宝珠，我和我的族人将永远感激你。

english: I would be glad to help.
translation: 我很乐意帮忙。

english: Thank you. The battlefield is to the north of the maze. Commander Montai will inform you of their current situation.
translation: 谢谢你。战场在迷宫北面。蒙泰指挥官会告诉你他们目前的情况。

english: That is if he's still alive.
translation: 前提是他还活着。

english: My assistant shall guide you out. Good luck friend, try your best to return the orb
translation: 我的助理会带你出去。祝你好运朋友，尽力把宝珠带回来。

english: We're out of the maze now. Please hurry, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 我们已经走出迷宫了。请快一点，想要活下去我们必须拿回宝珠。

english: I'm sorry but I won't be involved.
translation: 抱歉，我不想卷入其中。

english: Ok then, travel safe.
translation: 那好吧，一路平安。

english: Ok, take care.
translation: 好，保重。

english: Oh my! Oh my!
translation: 哎呀！哎呀！

english: The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 宝珠，他们拿到了宝珠。我们完了。需要我带你穿过迷宫吗？

english: Please help us get our orb back.
translation: 请帮我们把宝珠夺回来。

english: The orb, they have the orb. We're doomed. Do you need me to show you back to the village?
translation: 宝珠，他们拿到了宝珠。我们完了。需要我带你回村庄吗？

english: Oh my, oh my!
translation: 哎呀，哎呀！

english: The orb, they have the orb. It must be returned or we're doomed.
translation: 宝珠，他们拿到了宝珠。必须把它找回来，否则我们就完了。

english: Oh my. I'll never find my way back before Khazard's men come and hunt me down.
translation: 哎呀。在卡扎德的人来追捕我之前，我肯定找不到回去的路了。

english: Hello Bolren.
translation: 你好，博尔伦。

english: Hello traveller, we must retrieve the orb. It's being held by Khazard troops north of here.
translation: 你好旅者，我们必须夺回宝珠。它被卡扎德的士兵扣押在了北边。

english: The orb is being held at the battlefield north of the maze.
translation: 宝珠被扣在迷宫北面的战场。

english: Hello traveller, are you here to help or just to watch?
translation: 你好旅者，你是来帮忙的还是来看热闹的？

english: I've been sent by King Bolren to retrieve the orb of protection.
translation: 我是博尔伦国王派来夺回防护宝珠的。

english: Excellent we need all the help we can get.
translation: 太好了，我们需要一切能得到的帮助。

english: I'm commander Montai. The orb is in the Khazard stronghold to the north, but until we weaken their defences we can't get close.
translation: 我是蒙泰指挥官。宝珠在北方的卡扎德要塞里，但除非我们削弱他们的防御，否则无法靠近。

english: Firstly we need to strengthen our own defences. We desperately need wood to make more battlements, once the battlements are gone it's all over. Six loads of normal logs should do it.
translation: 首先我们需要加强自己的防御。我们急需木材来建造更多的城垛，一旦城垛没了就全完了。六车普通原木应该就够了。

english: Sorry I no longer want to be involved.
translation: 抱歉，我不想再参与了。

english: That's a shame, we could have done with your help.
translation: 真可惜，我们本来可以借助你的力量。

english: Ok, I'll gather some wood.
translation: 好，我去收集一些木材。

english: Please be as quick as you can, I don't know how much longer we can hold out.
translation: 请尽可能快，我不知道我们还能撑多久。

english: The battle is far from over. If you have a pure heart you will help us win.
translation: 战斗远未结束。如果你心地纯洁，就帮我们打赢吧。

english: I can't stand this war. The misery, the pain, it's driving me crazy! When will it end?
translation: 我受不了这场战争了。悲惨，痛苦，快把我逼疯了！什么时候才会结束？

english: You must retrieve the orb, or the gnome village is doomed. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 你必须夺回宝珠，否则地精村庄就完了。需要我带你穿过迷宫吗？

english: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier. We need six loads of normal logs.
translation: 又见面了，士兵，我们仍然急需木材。我们需要六车普通原木。

english: Hello again, we're still desperate for wood soldier.
translation: 又见面了，士兵，我们仍然急需木材。

english: I have some here.(You give six loads of logs to the commander.)
translation: 我这里有一些。（你把六车原木交给了指挥官。）

english: That's excellent, now we can make more defensive battlements.  Give me a moment to organise the troops and then come speak to me. I'll inform you of our next phase of attack.
translation: 太好了，现在我们可以建造更多的防御城垛了。给我一点时间组织部队，然后来找我说话。我会告诉你我们下一阶段的攻击计划。

english: How are you doing Montai?
translation: 怎么样了，蒙泰？

english: We're hanging in there soldier. For the next phase of our attack we need to breach their stronghold.
translation: 我们还在坚持，士兵。下一阶段的攻击，我们需要突破他们的要塞。

english: The ballista can break through the stronghold wall, and then we can advance and seize back the orb.
translation: 弩炮可以击穿要塞的墙壁，然后我们就能推进并夺回宝珠。

english: From this distance we can't get an accurate enough shot.  We need the correct coordinates of the stronghold for a direct hit.  I've sent out three tracker gnomes to gather them.
translation: 从这么远的距离我们无法精确瞄准。我们需要要塞的准确坐标才能直接命中。我已经派出了三个追踪地精去收集坐标。

english: Have they returned?
translation: 他们回来了吗？

english: I'm afraid not, and we're running out of time. I need you to go into the heart of the battlefield, find the trackers, and bring back the coordinates.
translation: 恐怕还没有，而且我们快没时间了。我需要你深入战场腹地，找到那些追踪者，把坐标带回来。

english: Do you think you can do it?
translation: 你觉得你能做到吗？

english: No, I've had enough of your battle.
translation: 不，我受够你的战斗了。

english: I understand, this isn't your fight.
translation: 我理解，这不是你的战斗。

english: I'll try my best.
translation: 我会尽力的。

english: Thank you, you're braver than most.
translation: 谢谢你，你比大多数人勇敢。

english: I don't know how long I will be able to hold out. Once you have the coordinates come back and fire the ballista right into those monsters.
translation: 我不知道自己能坚持多久。一旦拿到坐标就回来，用弩炮直接轰击那些怪物。

english: If you can retrieve the orb and bring safety back to my people, none of the blood spilled on this field will be in vain.
translation: 如果你能夺回宝珠，给我的族人带来安全，那么这片战场上流淌的鲜血就不会白费。

english: Hello warrior. We need the coordinates for a direct hit from the ballista. Once you have a direct hit you will be able to enter the stronghold and retrieve the orb.
translation: 你好战士。我们需要坐标才能用弩炮直接命中。一旦直接命中，你就能进入要塞并取回宝珠。

english: Do you know the coordinates of the Khazard stronghold?
translation: 你知道卡扎德要塞的坐标吗？

english: I managed to get one, although it wasn't easy.
translation: 我设法拿到了一份坐标，不过可不容易。

english: The other two tracker gnomes should have the other coordinates if they're still alive.
translation: 另外两个追踪地精如果还活着的话，应该拿着其他坐标。

english: OK, take care.
translation: 好，保重。

english: They caught me spying on the stronghold. They beat and tortured me.
translation: 他们抓到我侦察要塞了。他们打我，折磨我。

english: But I didn't crack. I told them nothing. They can't break me!
translation: 但我没松口。我什么都没告诉他们。他们休想让我屈服！

english: I'm sorry little man.
translation: 对不起小个子。

english: Don't be. I have the position of the stronghold!
translation: 别道歉。我有要塞的位置！

english: Now leave before they find you and all is lost.
translation: 趁他们还没发现你赶紧走，不然一切都完了。

english: OK? Who's OK? Not me! Hee hee!
translation: 好？谁好了？我不好！嘿嘿！

english: You can't see me, no one can. Monsters, demons, they're all around me!
translation: 你看不见我，谁也看不见我。怪物，恶魔，全在我周围！

english: They're dancing, all of them, hee hee.
translation: 他们在跳舞，所有人都在跳，嘿嘿。

english: Do you have the coordinate for the Khazard stronghold?
translation: 你有卡扎德要塞的坐标吗？

english: Who holds the stronghold?
translation: 谁掌握着要塞？

english: Less than my hands.
translation: 比我的手少。

english: More than my head, less than my fingers.
translation: 比我的头多，比我的手指少。

english: More than we, less than our feet.
translation: 比我们多，比我们的脚少。

english: My legs and your legs, ha ha ha!
translation: 我的腿和你的腿，哈哈哈！

english: You're mad.
translation: 你疯了。

english: Dance with me, and Khazard's men are beat.
translation: 跟我跳舞，卡扎德的人就输了。

english: I'll pray for you little man.
translation: 我会为你祈祷的，小个子。

english: All day we pray in the hay, hee hee.
translation: 整天在干草里祈祷，嘿嘿。

english: That tracker gnome was a bit vague about the x coordinate! What could it be?
translation: 那个追踪地精对x坐标说得太含糊了！到底是多少？

english: Evidently that wasn't the right x coordinate.
translation: 显然那不是正确的x坐标。

english: I've breached the stronghold.
translation: 我已经突破了要塞。

english: I saw, that was a beautiful sight. The Khazard troops didn't know what hit them.
translation: 我看到了，那景象真美。卡扎德的士兵根本不知道是什么击中了他们。

english: Now is the time to retrieve the orb. It's all in your hands. I'll be praying for you.
translation: 现在是取回宝珠的时候了。全看你的了。我会为你祈祷。

english: Well done, you've broken down their defences. This battle must be ours.
translation: 干得好，你瓦解了他们的防御。这场战斗必须属于我们。

english: Don't talk to me, you can't see me. No one can, just the demons.
translation: 别跟我说话，你看不见我。谁也看不见，只有恶魔能。

english: Don't even think of taking the orb!
translation: 想都别想拿走宝珠！

english: I have the orb of protection.
translation: 我拿到了防护宝珠。

english: Incredible, for a human you really are something.
translation: 难以置信，作为一个人类，你确实有两下子。

english: Thanks... I think!
translation: 谢谢……大概吧！

english: I'll stay here with my troops and try and hold Khazard's men back. You return the orb to the gnome village. Go as quick as you can, the village is still unprotected.
translation: 我会和我的部队留在这里，尽量挡住卡扎德的人。你把宝珠送回地精村庄。尽快去，村庄仍然没有防护。

english: How are you tracker?
translation: 你怎么样了，追踪者？

english: Now we have the orb I'm much better. They won't stand a chance without it.
translation: 现在我们有了宝珠，我好多了。没有宝珠他们毫无机会。

english: Now we have the orb I'm much better. Soon my comrades will come and free me.
translation: 现在我们有了宝珠，我好多了。很快我的战友就会来救我。

english: You're back! And the orb?
translation: 你回来了！那宝珠呢？

english: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive. Do you need me to show you through the maze?
translation: 求你了，想活下去我们必须拿到宝珠。需要我带你穿过迷宫吗？

english: Hello Remsai.
translation: 你好，雷姆赛。

english: Hello, did you find the orb?
translation: 你好，你找到宝珠了吗？

english: Please, we must have the orb if we are to survive.
translation: 求你了，想活下去我们必须拿到宝珠。

english: Do you have the orb?
translation: 你拿到宝珠了吗？

english: You're our saviour. Please return it to the village and we are all saved. Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 你是我们的救星。请把它带回村里，这样我们就都得救了。你想让我给你指路去村子吗？

english: Here we are. Take the orb to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: 我们到了。把宝珠带给博尔伦国王，我相信他看到你会很高兴的。

english: Hello Elkoy. I have the orb.
translation: 你好，埃尔科伊。我拿到宝珠了。

english: Take it to King Bolren, I'm sure he'll be pleased to see you.
translation: 把它交给博尔伦国王，我相信他看到你会很高兴的。

english: Can you show me out of the village?
translation: 你能带我离开村子吗？

english: Please return with our orb soon.
translation: 请尽快带着我们的宝珠回来。

english: You're our saviour.
translation: 你是我们的救星。

english: Hello little man.
translation: 你好啊，小个子。

english: Little man stronger than big man. Hee hee, lardi dee, lardi da.
translation: 小个子比大个子更强壮。嘿嘿，啦嘀嘀，啦嘀嗒。

english: Amazing, you recovered the orb.
translation: 太棒了，你找回了宝珠。

english: Well I am impressed. Would you like to buy something?
translation: 嗯，我印象深刻。你想买点东西吗？→ 嗯，真让我印象深刻。你想买点什么吗？

english: I have the orb.
translation: 我拿到宝珠了。

english: Oh my... The misery, the horror!
translation: 哦天哪……太悲惨了，太可怕了！

english: King Bolren, are you OK?
translation: 博尔伦国王，你还好吗？

english: Thank you traveller, but it's too late. We're all doomed.
translation: 谢谢你，旅者，但已经太晚了。我们都完蛋了。

english: They came in the night. I don't know how many, but enough.
translation: 他们是夜里来的。我不知道有多少，但足够多了。

english: Khazard troops. They slaughtered anyone who got in their way. Women, children, my wife.
translation: 卡扎德的军队。他们屠杀了所有挡路的人。女人、孩子、我的妻子。

english: They took the other orbs, now we are defenceless.
translation: 他们拿走了其他宝珠，现在我们毫无防备。

english: Where did they take them?
translation: 他们带去哪里了？

english: They headed north of the stronghold. A warlord carries the orbs.
translation: 他们往要塞北边去了。一个军阀带着那些宝珠。

english: I will find the warlord and bring back the orbs.
translation: 我会找到那个军阀，把宝珠带回来。

english: You are brave, but this task will be tough even for you. I wish you the best of luck. Once again you are our only hope.
translation: 你很勇敢，但这个任务就算对你也很难。祝你好运。你再次成了我们唯一的希望。

english: I will safeguard this orb and pray for your safe return. My assistant will guide you out.
translation: 我会守护这颗宝珠，祈祷你平安归来。我的助理会带你出去。

english: Good luck friend.
translation: 祝你好运，朋友。

english: I'm sorry but I can't help
translation: 抱歉，我帮不上忙。

english: I understand, this isn't your battle.
translation: 我理解，这不是你的战斗。

english: Did you hear?
translation: 你听说了吗？

english: Khazard's men have pillaged the village! They slaughtered many, and took the other orbs in an attempt to lead us out of the maze. When will the misery end?
translation: 卡扎德的人洗劫了村子！他们杀了很多人，还拿走了其他宝珠，想引诱我们走出迷宫。这苦难什么时候才是个头啊？

english: Please help us find the orbs.
translation: 请帮我们找回宝珠。

english: I'm very sorry.
translation: 我很抱歉。

english: Would you like me to show you the way to the village?
translation: 你想让我给你指路去村子吗？

english: Here we are. Despite what has happened here, I hope you feel welcome.
translation: 尽管这里发生了不幸，但我希望你觉得受欢迎。→ 尽管这里发生了不幸，但我希望你能感到受欢迎。

english: Khazard's men came. Without the orb we were defenceless. They killed many and then took our last hope, the other orbs.
translation: 卡扎德的人来了。没有宝珠我们毫无防备。他们杀了很多人，然后带走了我们最后的希望——其他的宝珠。

english: Now surely we're all doomed. Without them the spirit tree is useless.
translation: 现在我们肯定完蛋了。没有它们，灵魂树就没用了。

english: Oh my, oh my, the village has been pillaged and I'm still lost. Oh dear.
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪，村子被洗劫了，而我还是迷路了。哎呀。

english: Must save the orbs and kill the Khazard warlord. That will be fun, hee hee.
translation: 必须救出宝珠，杀掉卡扎德军阀。那一定很有趣，嘿嘿。

english: Oh, hello there. Have you heard? They took the other orbs, it's terrible. I suppose the show must go on.
translation: 哦，你好啊。你听说了吗？他们拿走了其他宝珠，太可怕了。不过表演还是得继续。

english: We're trying to hold them back, but without more wood we won't be able to last long.
translation: 我们正努力挡住它们，但如果没有更多木材，我们撑不了多久。

english: You truly are a hero.
translation: 你真是个英雄。

english: You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well.
translation: 你找回了防护宝珠，拯救了我们。我深感敬佩，祝你一切顺利。

english: You saved us by returning the orbs of protection. I'm humbled and wish you well. Would you like me to show you through the maze?
translation: 你找回了防护宝珠，拯救了我们。我深感敬佩，祝你一切顺利。你想让我带你穿过迷宫吗？

english: Hewe we awe. Have a safe jouwney.
translation: 我们到了。一路平安。

english: Hewe we awe. Feew fwee to have a wook awound.
translation: 我们到了。随便看看。

english: I've returned.
translation: 我回来了。

english: You're back, well done brave adventurer. Now the orbs are safe we can perform the ritual for the spirit tree. We can live in peace once again.
translation: 你回来了，干得好，勇敢的冒险者。现在宝珠安全了，我们可以为灵魂树举行仪式了。我们又可以和平地生活了。

english: Hello gnome.
translation: 你好，地精。

english: Soon we're gonna have the sacred ceremony and boy am I going to party. Lock up your daughters. Hee hee.
translation: 很快我们就要举行神圣仪式了，天哪，我要好好狂欢一下。把你们的女儿锁好。嘿嘿。

english: Hee hee, lardi da, lardi dee.(The gnome appears to besinging.)
translation: 嘻嘻，啦嘀哒，啦嘀嘀。（地精似乎在唱歌。）

english: Hello. I hope they come out and find me soon. It's getting cold.
translation: 你好。我希望他们快点出来找到我。越来越冷了。

english: Hello there. You're that hero who saved the orbs. Soon we will perform the ritual and the village will be safe again.
translation: 你好啊。你就是那个救了宝珠的英雄。很快我们就要举行仪式，村子又会安全了。

english: Anyway, would you like anything from my shop?
translation: 总之，你想在我的店里买点什么吗？

english: Bolren, I have returned.
translation: 博尔伦，我回来了。

english: You made it back! Do you have the orbs?
translation: 你回来了！你拿到宝珠了吗？

english: Please, we must have the orbs if we are to survive.
translation: 求你了，如果我们想活下去，就必须拿到宝珠。

english: I have them here.
translation: 我带来了。

english: Hooray, you're amazing. I didn't think it was possible but you've saved us.
translation: 万岁，你太厉害了。我本以为不可能，但你救了我们。

english: Once the orbs are replaced we will be safe once more. We must begin the ceremony immediately.
translation: 一旦宝珠放回去，我们就能再次安全。我们必须立刻开始仪式。

english: What does the ceremony involve?
translation: 仪式具体做什么？

english: The spirit tree has looked over us for centuries. Now we must pay our respects.
translation: 灵魂树守护了我们几个世纪。现在我们必须表达敬意。

english: Now at last my people are safe once more. We can live in peace again.
translation: 现在我的族人终于再次安全了。我们又可以在和平中生活了。

english: I'm pleased I could help.
translation: 我很高兴能帮上忙。

english: You are modest brave traveller.
translation: 你真谦虚，勇敢的旅者。

english: Please, for your efforts take this amulet. It's made from the same sacred stone as the orbs of protection. It will help keep you safe on your journeys.
translation: 请收下这条护身符，作为对你努力的感谢。它由与防护宝珠相同的圣石制成。它将保佑你旅途平安。

english: Thank you King Bolren.
translation: 谢谢你，博尔伦国王。

english: The tree has many other powers, some of which I cannot reveal. As a friend of the gnome people, I can now allow you to use the tree's magic to teleport to other trees grown from related seeds.
translation: 这棵树还有许多其他力量，有些我不能透露。作为地精族的朋友，我现在允许你使用树的魔法，传送到其他由相关种子长成的树那里。

english: So... do you garden round the back too?
translation: 那么……你也在后面有花园吗？

english: That I do!
translation: 当然！

english: Doesn't all of the security around the house get in your way then?
translation: 房子周围那些安保措施不会妨碍你吗？

english: Ah, I'm used to all that. I have my keys, the guard dogs know me, and I know the combination to the door lock. It's rather easy, it's his middle name.
translation: 啊，我都习惯了。我有钥匙，守卫狗认识我，而且我知道门锁的组合。很简单，就是他中间的名字。

english: Whose middle name?
translation: 谁的中间名？

english: Hum. I probably shouldn't have said that. Forget I mentioned it.
translation: 嗯。我可能不该说这个。当我没提过。

english: Trying to muscle in on my job eh? I'm more than happy to do this all by myself!
translation: 想抢我的活儿，嗯？我自己干就很乐意了！

english: Now I just need someone to deliver it for me.
translation: 现在我只差一个人帮我送货了。

english: So, when are you going to deliver this crate?
translation: 那么，你什么时候送这个板条箱？

english: Well... I guess we could do it now...
translation: 嗯……我想我们现在就可以送……

english: Thank you, it's interesting in here.
translation: 谢谢，这里面挺有意思的。

english: We're the premier delivery service in ALL of Gielinor!
translation: 我们是整个吉伦诺最顶级的送货服务！
