english: Have you got our totem back?
translation: 你把我们的图腾拿回来了吗？

english: No, it's not that easy.
translation: 不，没那么简单。

english: Bah, you no good.
translation: 哼，你真没用。

english: You have??? Many thanks brave adventurer! Here, have some freshly cooked Karamjan fish, caught specially by my tribe.
translation: 你真的拿回来了？？？非常感谢，勇敢的冒险者！来，拿些刚煮好的卡拉姆詹鱼，是我的部落特地为你捕的。

english: Let's hope I find them.
translation: 希望我能找到它们。

english: Arrrghhh, die man-thing!
translation: 啊啊啊，去死吧，人虫！

english: Ahhh, it no use, I too sad!
translation: 啊，没用，我太伤心了！

english: Awww, you poor troll. What seems to be the problem?
translation: 哎呀，你这可怜的巨魔。出什么事了？

english: I love Aga, she so beautiful, she smell so nice, like rotting dead ice wolf!
translation: 我爱阿加，她太美了，她闻起来真香，像腐烂的死冰狼！

english: But Arrg that... arrrrrg! He together with Aga and he much stronger than Ug. He rip Ug apart!
translation: 但是阿格他……啊啊啊！他和阿加在一起，他比乌格强多了。他会把乌格撕碎的！

english: Who is Aga?
translation: 阿加是谁？

english: She most beautiful troll in world.
translation: 她是世界上最美的巨魔。

english: Ug want to marry Aga, but she with Arrg!
translation: 乌格想娶阿加，但她和阿格在一起！

english: Don't worry now, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 别担心，我来看看能帮上什么忙。

english: You help Ug? You nice, maybe Ug not eat you!
translation: 你帮乌格？你真好，也许乌格不吃你！

english: Errrr... thanks... I think?
translation: 呃……谢谢……大概吧？

english: I will go and talk to Aga.
translation: 我去和阿加谈谈。

english: A crying troll who's in love?! This just gets better and better!
translation: 一个恋爱中的哭泣巨魔？！这真是越来越有意思了！

english: Hahahahaha... a crying Troll.
translation: 哈哈哈……一个哭泣的巨魔。

english: I bet all the other trolls laugh at you!
translation: 我打赌其他巨魔都笑话你！

english: Go away, man-thing, leave Ug alone!
translation: 走开，人虫，别烦乌格！

english: Hahahahaa!
translation: 哈哈哈！

english: What you want, man-thing?
translation: 你想干嘛，人虫？

english: Well... you're big and hairy?
translation: 嗯……你又大又毛茸茸的？

english: Thanks, me very careful about looks!
translation: 谢谢，我很在意长相！

english: (I can't believe I am asking a troll about her love life!!)
translation: （我真不敢相信我在问一个巨魔她的感情生活！！）

english: So... how's your... um... love life?
translation: 那么……你的……嗯……感情生活怎么样？

english: It ok, I with Arrg, he very strong and mighty but sometimes...
translation: 还行，我和阿格在一起，他很强壮威猛，但有时候……

english: I not know if he love Aga, He say he will show he love by bringing me flower Trollweiss.
translation: 我不知道他是否爱阿加，他说他会带一朵巨魔花来证明他的爱。

english: It a very rare, beautiful flower, it very special!
translation: 那是一朵非常稀有、美丽的花，非常特别！

english: It grow somewhere in these mountains.
translation: 它长在这些山里的某个地方。

english: (Maybe trolls DO have a romantic streak!)
translation: （也许巨魔也有浪漫的一面！）

english: And Arrg said he would get you the flower?
translation: 阿格说他会给你带花？

english: He very strong, if he love Aga he will get Trollweiss.
translation: 他很强壮，如果他爱阿加，他就会得到巨魔花。

english: So... what do you think about Ug?
translation: 那么……你觉得乌格怎么样？

english: You know that wimpy, crying... nevermind.
translation: 你知道那个懦弱、爱哭的……算了。

english: Errr... I've got to go.
translation: 呃……我得走了。

english: Aga can't wait for Trollweiss. Arrg will show his love!
translation: 阿加等不及巨魔花了。阿格会证明他的爱！

english: Whaaaaaaaat?
translation: 什——么？

english: Ehh, Excuse me... Mr. Troll, sir,
translation: 呃，打扰一下……巨魔先生，

english: How did you grow so big and strong?
translation: 你是怎么长得这么高大强壮的？

english: Get away from Arrg, puny man-maggot. Or you lunch!
translation: 离阿格远点，渺小的人蛆。否则你就是午餐！

english: Your girlfriend said you know where to find Trollweiss?
translation: 你女朋友说你知道在哪里能找到巨魔花？

english: Girlfriend? Which one?
translation: 女朋友？哪一个？

english: Errr... Aga.
translation: 呃……阿加。

english: Yes, she good cook and wash but talk too many. Arrg strong troll, Arrg mighty troll, Arrg have many girlfriends!
translation: 对，她做饭洗衣都不错，但话太多。阿格是强壮的巨魔，阿格是威猛的巨魔，阿格有很多女朋友！

english: (What a jerk!)
translation: （真是个混蛋！）

english: Yes, yes, you're great, but what about the Trollweiss?
translation: 是是是，你很厉害，但巨魔花呢？

english: I no know, I just say to make Aga shut up!
translation: 我不知道，我只是为了让阿加闭嘴才那么说的！

english: So you don't actually know where to find the Trollweiss?
translation: 所以你其实不知道在哪里能找到巨魔花？

english: I've got to go.
translation: 我得走了。

english: You talk to Aga yet?
translation: 你和阿加谈过了吗？

english: Yes, she said that she really wants a certain flower! Trollweiss, I think she called it.
translation: 是的，她说她真的很想要一种花！我想她叫它巨魔花。

english: Oh no! Then Ug no chance, Trollweiss not found in years!
translation: 哦不！那乌格没机会了，巨魔花好多年没找到了！

english: Don't worry I'll find it for you!
translation: 别担心，我会帮你找到的！

english: You no chance, Ug no chance, need someone who live whole life in mountains. Ug no know anyone like that...
translation: 你没机会，乌格没机会，需要一辈子住在山里的人。乌格不认识那样的人……

english: Hang on a sec...
translation: 等一下……

english: Have you got flowers yet?
translation: 你拿到花了吗？

english: Sorry, I'm still looking.
translation: 抱歉，我还在找。

english: Do you know where I can find Trollweiss?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能找到巨魔花吗？

english: It has been a long time since someone has asked me about Trollweiss.
translation: 已经很久没人问过我关于巨魔花的事了。

english: In the old days Trollweiss could be found all over the mountains, but recently it has been disappearing!
translation: 以前巨魔花在山里到处都是，但最近它正在消失！

english: There is one place, where I am sure it still grows, but it is impossible to get to.
translation: 有一个地方，我确定它还在生长，但根本到不了。

english: Nothing's impossible, if you put your mind to it!
translation: 只要用心，没什么是不可能的！

english: Ahhh, the youth of today. So sure of their prowess. But who am I to stop you from walking into your doom, if that is what you wish to do!
translation: 啊，现在的年轻人。对自己的本事这么自信。但如果你执意要走向毁灭，我又有什么理由阻止你呢！

english: Spare me with the lectures and tell me where to find this flower!
translation: 别跟我说教了，告诉我哪里能找到这花！

english: Well, you will need to enter the domain of the ice trolls! This is an area full of wicked beasts and biting cold. From there you will find a way down a slope to a plateau where the Trollweiss grows.
translation: 好吧，你需要进入冰巨魔的领地！那里到处都是凶猛的野兽和刺骨的寒冷。从那里你会找到一条斜坡，下去到一个高原，巨魔花就长在那里。

english: It used to be easy to get to this plateau, but it is now snowed over and virtually inaccessible. That's global warming for you!
translation: 以前很容易到达那个高原，但现在被雪覆盖，几乎无法进入。这就是全球变暖的后果！

english: There must be a way to get there.
translation: 一定有办法到那里去。

english: There is maybe one thing...
translation: 也许有一件事……

english: If you could make some sort of sled, you could probably get down there but I don't know where that would lead you, as you will not be able to go up the mountain again.
translation: 如果你能做个雪橇，也许能滑下去，但我不知道会滑到哪里，因为你再也上不了山了。

english: That doesn't sound like a very good idea to me!
translation: 这听起来可不是什么好主意！

english: Pah, who are you to talk? Without me you would never have found the secret path to the plateau!!
translation: 哼，你算老几？没有我，你永远找不到去高原的秘密通道！！

english: What would I need to make such a sled?
translation: 做这样的雪橇需要什么？

english: Well, I'm no expert. Maybe you should speak to someone who knows more about such technical stuff.
translation: 嗯，我不是专家。也许你应该问问更懂这些技术活的人。

english: Why don't you ask Dunstan. He's always helped me with my spiked boots.
translation: 为什么不去问问邓斯坦。他一直在帮我修钉鞋。

english: Thank you very much for the information.
translation: 非常感谢你的信息。

english: See you later
translation: 回头见

english: Hi! Did you want something?
translation: 嗨！你想要点什么？

english: I need a sled!!
translation: 我需要一个雪橇！！

english: So why do you need a sled then?
translation: 那你为什么要雪橇呢？

english: I need the sled to get to a certain location in the mountains.
translation: 我需要雪橇去山里的某个地方。

english: Hahahaha.
translation: 哈哈哈。

english: No, I actually still like rolling around in the snow.
translation: 不，我其实还是喜欢在雪地里打滚。

english: Well, I guess some of us never grow up!
translation: 好吧，看来我们有些人永远长不大！

english: Well, since you've helped my family out a couple of times, I'd be glad to build a sled for you.
translation: 好吧，既然你帮过我家人几次，我很乐意为你做一个雪橇。

english: Let me think...
translation: 让我想想……

english: Yeah, that should do it. I will need some yew or maple logs, a bar of iron and some rope.
translation: 对，应该够了。我需要一些紫杉木或枫木原木、一根铁条和一些绳子。

english: I should have my designs ready by the time you have brought me all the materials
translation: 等你把材料都拿来的时候，我的设计应该也准备好了。

english: Have you got all the materials for the sled yet?
translation: 雪橇的材料都准备好了吗？

english: Yes, I have all the materials for the sled.
translation: 是的，我准备好了雪橇的所有材料。

english: Well, here's the sled but it will need to be waxed. The wax will need to both protect the sled as well as smoothen it.
translation: 嗯，这是雪橇，但需要上蜡。蜡既能保护雪橇，又能让它更顺滑。

english: Maybe if you mix some wax with a bit of swamp tar it will achieve the desired effect. You'll also need something to store the wax in... like a cake tin.
translation: 也许你把蜡和一点沼泽焦油混合一下，就能达到想要的效果。你还需要一个容器来装蜡……比如蛋糕模具。

english: Here we go!
translation: 出发！

english: O-oh, this doesn't look good!
translation: 哦——哦，这看起来不妙！

english: And I thought snow was soft...
translation: 我还以为雪是软的……

english: Although it was a little softer than the rock I hit.
translation: 虽然比我撞到的石头软一点。

english: Aaaarrrrrghhh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！

english: O-oh, he seems cheesed off...
translation: 哦——哦，他好像生气了……

english: Have you got flower yet?
translation: 你拿到花了吗？

english: Thanks man-thing. Ug so happy!
translation: 谢谢人虫。乌格好开心！

english: But me too scared to give Trollweiss to Aga because Arrg will eat Ug for breakfast.
translation: 但乌格太害怕把巨魔花给阿加了，因为阿格会把乌格当早餐吃掉。

english: What? So I have to get rid of Arrg as well? After all this trouble I should be the one getting the girl...
translation: 什么？所以我还得解决阿格？费了这么大劲，应该是我得到那个女人才对……

english: Then again maybe not.
translation: 不过还是算了。

english: You no touch Aga. Ug kill you.
translation: 你别碰阿加。乌格会杀了你。

english: Ok, I'll tell Arrg you said that. Shall I tell him to meet you here?
translation: 好吧，我会告诉阿格你这么说。要不要我让他来这里见你？

english: No, no, no, wait! Ug just joke, oh great man-legend. Ug puny, you strong.
translation: 不不不，等等！乌格只是开玩笑，哦了不起的人中传奇。乌格弱小，你强大。

english: I suppose I am a bit of a legend. Ok I'll do it!
translation: 我想我确实算是个传奇。好吧，我来做！

english: You defeat Arrg yet?
translation: 你打败阿格了吗？

english: No, not yet. Something like this requires careful planning.
translation: 不，还没有。这种事需要精心策划。

english: I am here to kill you!
translation: 我是来杀你的！

english: Very good, Arrg was getting hungry.
translation: 很好，阿格正饿着呢。

english: But not in front of the lady, let's take it outside.
translation: 但别在女士面前，我们到外面去。

english: Aga deserves better than you.
translation: 阿加值得比你更好的人。

english: What you mean? Arrg strong troll, Arrg mighty troll. Every troll woman want Arrg.
translation: 你什么意思？阿格是强壮巨魔，阿格是威猛巨魔。每个巨魔女人都想要阿格。

english: But you don't love her!
translation: 但你不爱她！

english: This concept of 'love' confuses and infuriates Arrg.
translation: 这个叫“爱”的概念让阿格困惑和愤怒。

english: Looks like I'm going to have to teach you a lesson in 'love'.
translation: 看来我得给你上一堂关于“爱”的课了。

english: Yes, he has been defeated.
translation: 是的，他被打败了。

english: You very strong and nice. Take pretty rocks as thanks.
translation: 你非常强壮又善良。把漂亮石头作为感谢。

english: Thanks, Ug. So, now you can go and speak to Aga!
translation: 谢谢，乌格。所以，你现在可以去和阿加说话了！

english: I too scared.
translation: 我太害怕了。

english: Has anyone ever told you that you are a useless troll? My grandmother has more guts than you and she doesn't even have her teeth anymore!
translation: 有人告诉过你你是个没用的巨魔吗？我奶奶都比你有胆量，而她的牙都掉光了！

english: Whaaat? Man-thing want to die? Ug no scared of you or your grandmother! Ug show you. Ug go to Aga now.
translation: 什么？？人型生物想死？乌格不怕你或者你奶奶！乌格证明给你看。乌格现在就去阿加那里。

english: We were ambushed by trolls coming from the north. They captured Dunstan's son, Godric, who we enlisted at your request; we tried to follow but we were repelled at the foot of their stronghold.
translation: 我们从北方来的巨魔伏击了。他们抓走了邓斯坦的儿子戈德里克，我们应你的要求招募了他；我们试图追赶，但在他们的要塞脚下被击退了。

english: The way to the stronghold is treacherous, friend. Even if you manage to climb your way up, there will be many trolls defending the stronghold.
translation: 通往要塞的路非常艰险，朋友。就算你能爬上去，也有许多巨魔守着要塞。

english: God speed friend! I would send some of my men with you, but none of them are brave enough to follow.
translation: 愿神助你，朋友！我本想派些人跟你去，但他们没一个够胆量跟着走。

english: How are you getting on with rescuing Godric?
translation: 救戈德里克的事进行得怎么样了？

english: I haven't found a way to climb up yet.
translation: 我还没找到爬上去的方法。

english: Hurry, friend! Who knows what they'll do with Godric?
translation: 快点，朋友！谁知道他们会怎么对待戈德里克？

english: You win! Leave alone. Not hurt Dad.
translation: 你赢了！别过来。别伤害爸爸。

english: I've found my way into the prison.
translation: 我找到进入监狱的路了。

english: ...and?
translation: ……然后呢？

english: Hurry, friend. Find a way to free Godric!
translation: 快点，朋友。想办法救出戈德里克！

english: Thanks! I'm off back home!
translation: 谢啦！我这就回家！

english: Thank you, my friend.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友。

english: Don't worry about me, I'll be out again soon enough.
translation: 别担心我，我很快就能出去了。

english: I'm a little weakened by my stay, but nothing serious. How soon can you get me out of here?
translation: 待在这里让我有点虚弱，但没什么大碍。你最快什么时候能把我弄出去？

english: One of the guards is bound to have it. Find a way to get it off them!
translation: 钥匙肯定在一个守卫身上。想办法从他那里弄到手！

english: Excellent! Unlock this door and I'll have us out of here in no time.
translation: 太好了！打开这扇门，我马上就能带我们离开这里。

english: I have freed Godric!
translation: 我已经救出戈德里克了！

english: Oh, what great news! You should hurry to tell Dunstan, he will be overjoyed!
translation: 哦，真是好消息！你快去告诉邓斯坦，他一定高兴坏了！

english: Has Godric returned home?
translation: 戈德里克回家了吗？

english: He is safe and sound, thanks to you my friend!
translation: 他平安无事，多亏了你，我的朋友！

english: I have very little to offer you in way of thanks, but perhaps you will accept this family heirloom. It was found by my great-great-grandfather, but we still don't have any idea what it does.
translation: 我没什么拿得出手的谢礼，但也许你愿意收下这件传家宝。它是我曾曾祖父找到的，但我们至今不知道它是做什么用的。

english: Hello? Are you okay? That's a pretty nasty looking injury you've got there...
translation: 喂？你还好吗？你身上的伤看起来可真严重……

english: I'm... I'm fine... Please... leave me alone...
translation: 我……我没事……请……别管我……

english: Leave you alone? Look at you! You've been badly hurt and need help.
translation: 别管你？你看看你自己！你伤得很重，需要帮助。

english: No... No help... I'll fix it myself...
translation: 不……不需要帮助……我自己能搞定……

english: Now look, there is no way you're going to be able to fix this on your own. Either you let me help, or you die here. Is that what you want?
translation: 听好了，你绝对没法自己处理这个伤。要么让我帮你，要么你就死在这儿。你想这样吗？

english: Then what can I do to help?
translation: 那我能做什么来帮你？

english: Bandages... I was trying to make... bandages. Seaweed and a... a palm leaf.
translation: 绷带……我本来想做……绷带。海藻和……一片棕榈叶。

english: Right, you take it easy. I'll get your bandages sorted as quick as possible.
translation: 好的，你先别动。我会尽快给你弄好绷带。

english: You're definitely not okay, but I guess I can't force help upon you if you don't want it. I'll be on my way, but please, you really should reconsider.
translation: 你显然不对劲，但如果你不想接受帮助，我也不能强迫你。我先走了，不过请你真的再考虑一下。

english: How are you doing there?
translation: 你现在怎么样了？

english: I feel... fine.
translation: 我感觉……没事。

english: You're a terrible liar, you know? I'll get your bandages sorted as quick as possible. Seaweed and a palm leaf, right?
translation: 你撒谎的水平真差，你知道吗？我会尽快给你弄好绷带。海藻和一片棕榈叶，对吧？

english: Okay, I've got those bandages. Let's get you sorted out...
translation: 好，我拿到绷带了。来帮你处理一下……

english: You... helped me?
translation: 你……帮了我？

english: Of course! Did you expect me to just leave you to die? I'm not a monster!
translation: 当然！你以为我会丢下你等死？我又不是怪物！

english: I'm sorry for not trusting you, it's just... Well, I guess it doesn't matter now. I'm Floopa. Thank you for saving my life.
translation: 抱歉我之前不信任你，只是……好吧，现在不重要了。我叫弗卢帕。谢谢你救了我的命。

english: Don't mention it. I'm [player name]. Pleased to meet you, Floopa.
translation: 别客气。我是[player name]。很高兴认识你，弗卢帕。

english: Thank you, [player name].
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。

english: Now, those bandages should do the job for the time being, but we need to get you some proper help.
translation: 现在，这些绷带暂时能起作用，但我们得给你找些真正的帮助。

english: Help? No, I'll be fine now. I can sort the rest out myself.
translation: 帮助？不用了，我现在没事了。剩下的我自己能处理。

english: Can you? What is your medical background?
translation: 你能吗？你学过医？

english: Well, I read a book once...
translation: 呃，我以前读过一本书……

english: Floopa, I understand that you don't trust me, but I promise I'm only here to help.
translation: 弗卢帕，我理解你不信任我，但我保证我只是来帮忙的。

english: It's not that...
translation: 不是这个原因……

english: I'd have to go home...
translation: 那我就得回家……

english: Home? What's bad about home?
translation: 回家？回家有什么不好？

english: Nothing, but... if I go there, then I'll have failed.
translation: 没什么，但是……如果回去，我就失败了。

english: Failed at what?
translation: 失败什么？

english: Well, those bandages aren't going to last forever, and unfortunately I don't think that book of yours can help... not unless you use the pages as replacement bandages.
translation: 嗯，那些绷带撑不了太久，而且不幸的是，我觉得你那本书帮不上忙……除非你把书页当绷带用。

english: You don't understand!
translation: 你不明白！

english: Please, Floopa, let me take you home. We can use my boat.
translation: 拜托，弗卢帕，让我送你回家吧。我们可以用我的船。

english: Alright, fine!
translation: 好吧，行！

english: Thank you, Floopa. So, where is home?
translation: 谢谢你，弗卢帕。那么，你家在哪儿？

english: The Great Conch, to the south east. I guess I'll join you on your boat.
translation: 大螺壳岛，在东南方向。我坐你的船吧。

english: No point wasting time I guess. I'll join you on your boat.
translation: 看来没必要浪费时间了。我坐你的船。

english: Where do I need to be going, Floopa?
translation: 我该往哪走，弗卢帕？

english: You need to head [north/north west/north east/south/south west/south east.
translation: 你需要往[北/西北/东北/南/西南/东南]方向走。

english: Head to the south of the island. You can dock there.
translation: 往岛南边走。你可以在那里靠岸。

english: Right, we're here. I'll meet you ashore.
translation: 好，我们到了。岸上见。

english: Goodness, Floopa, look at you!
translation: 天哪，弗卢帕，看看你！

english: I'm sorry, Korel. I didn't want to come back, but...
translation: 对不起，科雷尔。我不想回来的，但是……

english: Nonsense! It would have been foolish to try and deal with this yourself! Now, get yourself over to Elder Raley's at once!
translation: 胡说！你自己处理这伤太蠢了！现在，赶紧去长老雷利那儿！

english: Ah, human. I take it we have you to thank for getting Floopa to us?
translation: 啊，人类。我想我们应该感谢你把弗卢帕带回来？

english: That's right, though she wasn't overly keen on coming.
translation: 没错，虽然她不太愿意回来。

english: That's not surprising, but it's good that she did. She would have been unlikely to survive that injury on her own.
translation: 这不奇怪，但她回来了是好事。她自己很可能撑不过那个伤。

english: Do you think she'll be okay?
translation: 你觉得她会没事吗？

english: She will survive. With Elder Raley looking after her, I have no doubt of that. However, it is a nasty wound, and much of the damage will be permanent. Did she say how it happened?
translation: 她能活下来。有长老雷利照顾她，我毫不怀疑。不过，那是很严重的伤，大部分损伤会是永久性的。她说过是怎么受伤的吗？

english: No. She seemed reluctant to tell me much at all, to be honest.
translation: 没有。说实话，她似乎什么都不愿意告诉我。

english: I see. Well, thank you for helping her, human. Now, I've no doubt you have plenty to be doing. You should be on your way.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，谢谢你帮助她，人类。现在，你肯定有很多事要做吧。你该上路了。

english: Actually, would it be possible to stay? I'd be keen to make sure she's doing okay.
translation: 其实，我能留下来吗？我想确认她情况良好。

english: Don't take this the wrong way, human, but as you may have worked out from Floopa, we tortugans aren't always the biggest fans of company. We generally don't allow humans on the Conch.
translation: 别误会，人类，但你可能从弗卢帕那里看出来了，我们龟壳人不太喜欢有人陪伴。我们通常不允许人类上大螺壳岛。

english: Generally?
translation: 通常？

english: There are exceptions.
translation: 也有例外。

english: Could I be an exception?
translation: 我能成为那个例外吗？

english: I suppose it is within my right to invite you to remain here for a short time as what we call a tourist. It will allow you to stay on the island while Floopa recovers.
translation: 我想我有权邀请你作为我们所谓的游客短暂留在这里。这样你可以在弗卢帕康复期间待在岛上。

english: However, you should be aware that the only way to permanently remain on the Conch is to undergo our Trial by Water and become an honorary tortugan.
translation: 不过，你应该知道，唯一能永久留在大螺壳岛的方式是接受我们的“水之试炼”，成为荣誉龟壳人。

english: Interesting... Well, let's do this tourist thing for now and we can worry about what happens after that once Floopa is doing better.
translation: 有意思……好吧，我们先按游客来，等弗卢帕好转后再操心之后的事。

english: Very well. I will see that it is done. Now, if you'd like to check in on Floopa, you'll find her at Elder Raley's home. It's the first one on the right as you head into town.
translation: 很好。我会安排好的。现在，如果你想去看弗卢帕，她在长老雷利的家里。进镇后右手边第一间就是。

english: I'll head right over.
translation: 我这就过去。

english: Hello again, human. If you'd like to check in on Floopa, you'll find her at Elder Raley's home. It's the first one on the right as you head into town.
translation: 又见面了，人类。如果你想去看弗卢帕，她在长老雷利的家里。进镇后右手边第一间就是。

english: Hello, human. I'm afraid I can't help you with anything until we've sorted out all the problems that gryphon caused.
translation: 你好，人类。恐怕在解决那只狮鹫造成的问题之前，我无法帮你什么。

english: Sorry, but I can't stop to talk. That gryphon attack has caused more than a few problems that need sorting first.
translation: 抱歉，我不能停下来聊天。那次狮鹫攻击造成了不少问题，需要先处理。

english: Sorry, but I'm too busy to talk right now. I'm still getting things sorted after that gryphon attack.
translation: 抱歉，我现在太忙了没空说话。那次狮鹫攻击之后我还在收拾残局。

english: No time to talk, human. That gryphon caused no end of problems that need to be dealt with. You'll need to come back later.
translation: 没时间聊天，人类。那只狮鹫惹出的麻烦没完没了，得处理。你晚点再来吧。

english: Sorry, human, but I don't have time to talk right now. I need to keep working on sorting out all the problems that gryphon caused.
translation: 抱歉，人类，我现在没时间聊天。我得继续处理那只狮鹫造成的问题。

english: ... really no fuss at all! Anyway, has that potion done anything for you yet?
translation: ……真的完全没麻烦！总之，那药水对你起作用了吗？

english: I think so. I feel a lot less... like death.
translation: 我想是的。我感觉没那么……濒死了。

english: Very good! Very good! A positive first step indeed! We'll give it a bit longer to make sure it properly kicks in, and then we can start on cleaning up that wound.
translation: 很好！很好！确实是积极的第一步！我们再等一会儿，确保药力完全发挥，然后就可以开始清理伤口了。

english: Oh look, a human! Is this the one you mentioned, Floopa?
translation: 哦，看，一个人类！这就是你提到的那个吗，弗卢帕？

english: Yes, but... [player name], what are you doing here?
translation: 是的，但是……[player name]，你怎么在这里？

english: Well, your friend on the docks gave me permission to stick around until you were feeling better.
translation: 嗯，你在码头的那位朋友允许我留下来，直到你好起来。

english: Oh, thank you, but you really don't need...
translation: 哦，谢谢你，但你真的不用……

english: Come now, Floopa. You should be more welcoming to the human.
translation: 行了，弗卢帕。你应该更欢迎这位人类才是。

english: Of course, you're right. I'm sorry, [player name]. I didn't mean to be rude. This is all just... a lot.
translation: 当然，你说得对。对不起，[player name]。我不是故意无礼的。只是这一切……太多了。

english: You can say that again! It looks like you've been in a fight with the Sharhai itself!
translation: 说得没错！你看起来像是跟沙海巨兽打了一架！

english: Ah, but you must forgive me, human. Here I am admonishing Floopa for her manners while not showing any myself! I'm Raley, one of the elders here on the Great Conch.
translation: 啊，但你必须原谅我，人类。我在这里责备弗卢帕的礼貌，自己却毫无礼貌！我是雷利，大螺壳岛的一位长老。

english: It's good to meet you. I'm [player name].
translation: 很高兴认识你。我是[player name]。

english: You'll have to forgive me, but I'm a bit all over the place at the moment. We're still dealing with the aftermath of another blasted gryphon attack!
translation: 请原谅我，我现在有点手忙脚乱。我们还在处理又一次该死的狮鹫攻击的后果！

english: An attack? Was anyone hurt?
translation: 攻击？有人受伤吗？

english: A few cuts and scrapes, but nothing serious. It did manage to make quite the mess around town though. At some point I'll need to help some of the more senior elders with repairs, but one thing at a time.
translation: 一些擦伤划伤，但没什么大碍。不过它确实把镇上搞得一团糟。过会儿我还得帮几位更年长的长老做些修缮，但得一件一件来。

english: If you need help with repairs, maybe I could lend a hand? That way you can focus on looking after Floopa.
translation: 如果你需要修缮的帮手，也许我能搭把手？这样你就可以专心照顾弗卢帕了。

english: You've helped enough, [player name]. You don't need to trouble yourself further.
translation: 你已经帮得够多了，[player name]。你不需要再费心了。

english: I wouldn't say no to a bit of extra help, though Floopa is right, [player name]. Do not feel like you need to do any more.
translation: 多一双手帮忙我当然不会拒绝，不过弗卢帕说得对，[player name]。别觉得你必须再做更多。

english: It's not a problem. What repairs need doing?
translation: 没问题。需要做什么修缮？

english: Most of the elders will handle their own repair work, so it's just the more senior ones who'll need your help. I've made a list of the work that needs to be done.
translation: 大部分长老会自己搞定修缮工作，所以只有几位更年长的需要你帮忙。我列了一份需要做的工作清单。

english: What sort of materials will I need?
translation: 我需要什么样的材料？

english: You'll need a mix of jatoba logs, sea shells and our very own scutes. You'll find some jatoba trees growing to the west of town and the shells are easy enough to find on the various beaches.
translation: 你需要混合使用贾托巴原木、贝壳和我们自己的甲片。镇西面有一些贾托巴树，贝壳在各个海滩上很容易找到。

english: As for the scutes, they get shed quite regularly, so it shouldn't be too hard to find a few dotted around the island.
translation: 至于甲片，它们会定期脱落，所以在岛上到处找找应该不难找到一些。

english: Great! I'll get right to it.
translation: 太好了！我马上开始。

english: Just come back and let me know if you get stuck with anything. Now, Floopa, I think that potion will have fully done its work now, so let's get to work on that wound.
translation: 如果你遇到什么问题就回来告诉我。现在，弗卢帕，我觉得那药水应该已经完全起作用了，我们来处理伤口吧。

english: This is going to hurt, isn't it?
translation: 会很疼，对吧？

english: Yes, it will probably sting a bit...
translation: 是的，可能会有点刺痛……

english: How are you doing, Floopa?
translation: 你怎么样了，弗卢帕？

english: You might want to leave her to it for a bit. Tidying the wound isn't the most pleasant of experiences.
translation: 你最好先让她自己待一会儿。清理伤口可不是什么愉快的经历。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. How are those repairs going?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。那些修缮工作进展如何？

english: Could I have another list of the work that needs doing?
translation: 能再给我一份需要做的工作清单吗？

english: Don't forget, you'll need a mix of jatoba logs, sea shells and our very own scutes. You'll find some jatoba trees growing to the west of town and the shells are easy enough to find on the various beaches.
translation: 别忘了，你需要混合使用贾托巴原木、贝壳和我们自己的甲片。镇西面有一些贾托巴树，贝壳在各个海滩上很容易找到。

english: You must be the human that Korel spoke of. Welcome to the Conch.
translation: 你一定是科雷尔提到的那个人类吧。欢迎来到大螺壳岛。

english: Thank you! I hear you have a couple of things in need of repair. I've offered to get them sorted.
translation: 谢谢你！我听说你们有几样东西需要修缮。我已经主动请缨来处理了。

english: That is very generous of you, human. Thank you.
translation: 你真是非常慷慨，人类。谢谢你。

english: Ah, you must be the new tourist.
translation: 啊，你一定是新来的游客吧。

english: That's me! I've offered to help out with some repairs around town.
translation: 就是我！我主动提出帮忙在镇上做些修缮工作。

english: Well, in that case, you should get stuck right in.
translation: 嗯，既然如此，那你就赶紧动手吧。

english: Hello there, human. Can I help you?
translation: 你好啊，人类。需要帮忙吗？

english: Actually, I'm here to help you. I'm sorting out some of the repairs that need doing.
translation: 其实，我是来帮你的。我在处理一些需要修缮的地方。

english: Oh, I see. That's very generous of you.
translation: 哦，我明白了。你真是太慷慨了。

english: Hello again, human. I have finished making arrangements for you to remain on the island as a tourist until Floopa recovers.
translation: 又见面了，人类。我已经安排好了，让你以游客身份留在岛上，直到弗卢帕康复。

english: I think that's everything. I should head back to Raley and Floopa.
translation: 我想事情都办妥了。我该回去找雷利和弗卢帕了。

english: Thank you for helping with those repairs, human. It shouldn't be long now until I can start selling my goods again.
translation: 谢谢你帮忙修缮，人类。用不了多久，我就能重新开始卖我的货品了。

english: Not bad on those repairs. Still plenty of things I need to do though. If you need something, you'll have to come back later.
translation: 修缮工作干得不错。不过我还有很多事要做。如果你需要什么，得晚点再来。

english: Hello there, human. Thank you for helping with those repairs. I should hopefully have the stall open again soon.
translation: 你好啊，人类。谢谢你帮忙修缮。希望我的摊位很快就能重新开张了。

english: Good news! The repairs are all sorted.
translation: 好消息！修缮工作都完成了。

english: Wonderful! And, you'll be pleased to know that I was successful in properly tidying up Floopa's wound. I'll need her to stay here for a while to make sure it properly heals, but I expect a full recovery!
translation: 太好了！而且，你会很高兴知道，我成功地把弗卢帕的伤口彻底清理干净了。她需要在这里待一段时间以确保伤口完全愈合，但我预计她能完全康复！

english: Is it? Even if I recover, my flipper... it's gone. Without it I'm... useless...
translation: 是吗？就算我康复了，我的脚蹼……也没了。没有它，我就……没用了……

english: Floopa, this is a highly traumatic experience you've gone through, and I won't lie to you, it will change your life forever. But Floopa, you are not, and never will be, useless.
translation: 弗卢帕，你经历了一次非常痛苦的创伤，我不会骗你，这将会永远改变你的生活。但是弗卢帕，你现在不是，将来也永远不会是没用的。

english: You should get some rest. We will sort you out with a place to stay here for as long as you need, and I will be on hand to help you however I can.
translation: 你应该休息一下。我们会给你安排一个住处，你想住多久都行，我也会随时尽力帮助你。

english: I'm happy to help as well. Is there anything I can do?
translation: 我也很乐意帮忙。有什么我能做的吗？

english: For Floopa? No. Rest is what she now needs. However, and please do say no if it's too much to ask, you might be able to help us out some more with that gryphon problem.
translation: 为了弗卢帕？不用。她现在需要的是休息。不过，如果你觉得要求不过分的话，也许你还能再帮我们解决一下那个狮鹫的问题。

english: Unfortunately, while we were able to injure it, the gryphon managed to escape before we could finish it off. One that aggressive can't be allowed to return.
translation: 不幸的是，虽然我们击伤了它，但那只狮鹫在我们能了结它之前逃走了。不能让那么凶猛的家伙再回来。

english: Korel was planning to deal with it himself, but other matters have required his attention.
translation: 科雷尔本来打算亲自处理，但其他事情需要他关注。

english: I'm sure I can track it down.
translation: 我相信我能追踪到它。

english: Very good! You really are too kind! It seemed like the injury prevented the gryphon from flying, so you hopefully won't have much trouble picking up its trail. I suggest you start in the middle of town.
translation: 很好！你真是太善良了！看来伤势阻止了狮鹫飞行，所以你追踪它的踪迹应该不会太困难。我建议你从镇中心开始找。

english: Will do. I'm sure I'll have it dealt with in no time!
translation: 没问题。我保证很快就能搞定它！

english: Why are humans generally not allowed here?
translation: 为什么人类通常不允许来这里？

english: Oh, [player name], I hope you haven't taken offense! It's really nothing personal. It's just how we do things.
translation: 哦，[player name]，希望你别介意！这真的不是针对个人。只是我们做事的方式如此。

english: It's not just limited to humans either. You might have noticed that there are no adult tortugans here on the Conch, just juveniles and elders.
translation: 也不仅限于人类。你可能注意到了，海螺岛上没有成年龟龟，只有幼年和老年龟龟。

english: So it's a societal thing?
translation: 所以这是社会习俗？

english: Yes, I suppose it is. We tortugans like our privacy, and we don't like being overly dependent on others. It is these preferences that have formed our way of life.
translation: 是的，我想是的。我们龟龟注重隐私，不喜欢过度依赖他人。正是这些偏好形成了我们的生活方式。

english: I see. I guess that gives me another question then. If the adults aren't here, where are they?
translation: 我明白了。那我又有一个问题了。如果成年龟龟不在这里，那他们在哪？

english: Out in the wider world, living their lives. They return here from time to time, usually when it is time to mate.
translation: 在外面的广阔世界里，过着自己的生活。他们偶尔会回来，通常是在交配的时候。

english: Ah, so that explains why Floopa was reluctant to return here.
translation: 啊，这就解释了为什么弗卢帕不愿意回到这里。

english: Yes, there can be a certain level of... pride, shall we say, amongst the younger adults. They have been known to see independence as a constant requirement.
translation: 是的，在较年轻的成年龟龟中，可以说存在一定程度的……骄傲。他们以将独立视为持续的要求而闻名。

english: I can hear you, you know?
translation: 我听得见你们说话，你知道吗？

english: It's rude to eavesdrop, Floopa! You should be resting!
translation: 偷听是不礼貌的，弗卢帕！你应该休息！

english: Anyway, as I was saying, it is a trait seen amongst many of the younger adults. They soon grow out of it. No one wants to be a burden of course, but we elders understand that there is no shame in asking for help.
translation: 总之，正如我所说，这是许多较年轻成年龟龟的特点。他们很快就会摆脱这种心态。当然，没人想成为负担，但我们年长者明白，寻求帮助并不可耻。

english: It sounds like a good balance.
translation: 听起来是个很好的平衡。

english: Are gryphons a common problem for your people?
translation: 狮鹫对你们族人来说是个常见问题吗？

english: Unfortunately so. They are the main predator we have to deal with here on the Conch, and it seems they have decided that we are quite the delicacy.
translation: 很不幸，是的。它们是我们海螺岛上要对付的主要捕食者，而且它们似乎认定我们是相当的美味。

english: Thankfully, most of them keep to the quieter parts of the island, making them easier to handle. However, from time to time, one will grow bold enough to try and target the town.
translation: 谢天谢地，它们大多数都待在岛上比较安静的区域，这样更容易处理。不过，时不时会有一只胆大包天，试图袭击城镇。

english: I'm sorry. It can't be nice living with that threat.
translation: 我很抱歉。生活在那种威胁之下肯定不好受。

english: Ah, it is nothing to be sad about. We have grown used to it. Besides, while the gryphons may prey upon us, in many ways, we prey upon them as well.
translation: 啊，没什么好难过的。我们已经习惯了。再说，虽然狮鹫捕食我们，但在很多方面，我们也捕食它们。

english: Killing them keeps their numbers under control, and their claws and feathers come in quite useful. In fact, all tortugans must obtain a gryphon claw as part of their Trial by Water.
translation: 杀死它们可以控制它们的数量，它们的爪子和羽毛也很有用。事实上，所有龟龟都必须获得一只狮鹫爪，作为他们水之试炼的一部分。

english: Trial by Water? Korel mentioned that as well.
translation: 水之试炼？科雷尔也提到过。

english: It is a rite of passage that all juvenile tortugans must go through on their journey to adulthood. On rare occasions, members of other races have undergone the Trial themselves, becoming honourary tortugans.
translation: 这是所有幼年龟龟在成年之路上必须经历的一种成人仪式。在极少数情况下，其他种族的成员也经历过试炼，成为荣誉龟龟。

english: Perhaps at some point you will be able to take on the trial yourself. You have already shown yourself to be both capable and trustworthy. However, that is a conversation for another day.
translation: 也许将来你也能亲自接受试炼。你已经证明了自己既有能力又值得信赖。不过，那是改天再谈的事了。

english: I'd better get to it.
translation: 我最好去干活了。

english: Hey, Floopa.
translation: 嘿，弗卢帕。

english: Sorry, [player name], but Raley says I need to get some rest. We'll talk later, once you've sorted out that gryphon.
translation: 抱歉，[player name]，但雷利说我需要休息。等你解决了那只狮鹫，我们再聊。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck with that gryphon?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。那只狮鹫有进展吗？

english: I'm still working on it, but I'm sure I'll have it dealt with soon.
translation: 还在处理中，但我相信很快就能搞定。

english: You should hopefully be able to pick up its trail in the middle of town. Good luck!
translation: 你应该能在镇中心找到它的踪迹。祝你好运！

english: ... holding it at bay, but they need support quick!
translation: ……正在抵挡它，但他们需要快速支援！

english: Another gryphon attack, but this time on the Little Pearl!
translation: 又一次狮鹫攻击，但这次是针对小珍珠号！

english: This doesn't make sense! They've never attacked the Pearl before!
translation: 这说不通啊！它们以前从未攻击过珍珠岛！

english: I'm heading over right away. The eggs must be protected!
translation: 我马上过去。必须保护那些蛋！

english: Join me, human! Sail to the Little Pearl as fast as you can and help protect our eggs!
translation: 跟我来，人类！尽快航行到小珍珠岛，帮忙保护我们的蛋！

english: You'll find the Pearl south east of the Conch. It shouldn't take you long to get there, but make sure you don't go underprepared! It sounds like this gryphon is one of the larger ones.
translation: 你会在海螺岛的东南方找到珍珠岛。到那里不需要太久，但确保不要准备不足就去！听起来这只狮鹫是体型较大的那种。

english: Yes, make sure you speak to Elder Blunn outside first. He can sort you out with a suitable shield.
translation: 是的，确保你先和外面的长老布伦谈谈。他可以给你一个合适的盾。

english: Okay, I'll grab one of those shields and set off right away!
translation: 好的，我去拿一个盾，然后马上出发！

english: I will meet you there, human.
translation: 我会在那里等你，人类。

english: Quickly, human! You need to sail to the Little Pearl, south east of the Conch. I will meet you there. Oh, and don't forget to pick up a shield from Elder Blunn outside!
translation: 快点，人类！你需要航行到海螺岛东南方的小珍珠岛。我会在那里和你碰面。哦，别忘了从外面的长老布伦那里拿一个盾！

english: Hurry, [player name]! You need to head to the Little Pearl!
translation: 快点，[player name]！你需要去小珍珠岛！

english: You need to get to the Pearl, [player name]! We can't lose those eggs!
translation: 你得去珍珠岛，[player name]！我们不能失去那些蛋！

english: I need a shield to protect me against one of the larger gryphons. I'm afraid it's quite urgent.
translation: 我需要一个盾来保护自己免受大型狮鹫的攻击。恐怕情况很紧急。

english: Ah, now that is something I can sort for you. I started making these at the suggestion of a human tourist. They're fashioned in the style of our own shells.
translation: 啊，这个我可以帮你解决。我是在一位人类游客的建议下开始制作这些的。它们是根据我们自己的壳的风格制作的。

english: We use them alongside our spears, but for a being of your size, wearing them on your back would work best.
translation: 我们和长矛一起使用它们，但对你这种体型来说，背在背上效果最好。

english: Like my very own shell?
translation: 就像我自己的壳一样？

english: Precisely! Normally I would charge for one of these, but you claim the situation is urgent, and I trust you are not lying. As such, I will grant you one for free.
translation: 正是！通常我会收费，但你说情况紧急，我相信你没有撒谎。因此，我免费送你一个。

english: Do not lose it, human, for I won't be able to give you another for free. Any more will come at a cost.
translation: 别弄丢了，人类，因为我不能再免费给你另一个。再要就得付钱了。

english: Hello again, human. I assume you're here for that shield?
translation: 又见面了，人类。我猜你是来拿那个盾的？

english: Do not lose it, for I won't be able to give you another for free. Any more will come at a cost.
translation: 别弄丢了，因为我不能再免费给你另一个。再要就得付钱了。

english: What's all that about?
translation: 那是怎么回事？

english: Er... Problem over here, Captain!
translation: 呃……这边有问题，船长！

english: Excellent work! The beast is well and truly dead!
translation: 干得好！野兽彻底死了！

english: Thank you for your help with that gryphon, human.
translation: 谢谢你帮忙对付那只狮鹫，人类。

english: The eggs are safe once more! Good work, human.
translation: 蛋再次安全了！干得好，人类。

english: Very good work, human!
translation: 干得非常漂亮，人类！

english: Are the eggs okay?
translation: 蛋还好吗？

english: As good as can be expected. We lost a fair few, but it could have been much worse.
translation: 还算可以。我们损失了不少，但本来可能更糟。

english: I'm sorry about the ones that were lost.
translation: 对于失去的那些，我很抱歉。

english: Even without a gryphon involved, not all eggs make it. It is an unfortunate reality of life. You need not apologise.
translation: 即使没有狮鹫的袭击，也不是所有蛋都能孵化。这是生活中不幸的现实。你无需道歉。

english: Now, I need to get to work on finding out how this happened. To our knowledge, no gryphon has ever travelled this far from the Conch before.
translation: 现在，我需要着手弄清楚这是怎么发生的。据我们所知，以前从来没有狮鹫从海螺岛跑这么远过。

english: About that... It may be nothing, but when I arrived here, I saw a ship with red sails sailing away from the island. You don't think it's connected, do you?
translation: 关于这个……可能没什么，但我到这里时，看到一艘挂着红帆的船驶离了岛屿。你不觉得这有关联吗？

english: A ship with red sails? Curious... and concerning... Hmm...
translation: 一艘挂着红帆的船？真奇怪……而且令人担忧……嗯……

english: You should return to Raley and Floopa on the Conch, human. Tell them what you have told me. See if they can make any sense of it.
translation: 你应该回到海螺岛找雷利和弗卢帕，人类。把你告诉我的事情告诉他们。看看他们能不能理出什么头绪。

english: Alright. I'll head back right away.
translation: 好的。我马上回去。

english: You should return to Raley and Floopa on the Conch, human. Tell them what you told me about that ship with the red sails. See if they can make any sense of it.
translation: 你应该回到海螺岛找雷利和弗卢帕，人类。把你告诉我的关于那艘红帆船的事情告诉他们。看看他们能不能理出什么头绪。

english: You're back, [player name]! What news from the Pearl?
translation: 你回来了，[player name]！珍珠岛有什么消息？

english: The gryphon has been dealt with. The eggs are safe.
translation: 狮鹫已经被解决了。蛋安全了。

english: Fantastic news!
translation: 好消息！

english: Did you see anything that might explain why the gryphon attacked?
translation: 你有没有看到什么可能解释狮鹫为何袭击的线索？

english: Possibly, but it's hard to say for sure. There was a ship near the island. It had red sails.
translation: 也许吧，但很难确定。岛附近有一艘船。挂着红帆。

english: Red sails? Surely not...
translation: 红帆？肯定不是……

english: What is it, Floopa?
translation: 怎么了，弗卢帕？

english: It's... I'm not sure. It might... It might have something to do with my injury.
translation: 这……我不确定。可能……可能和我的伤有关。

english: My captain... My crew... They betrayed me. Stabbed me with my own spear and abandoned me to the waves...
translation: 我的船长……我的船员……他们背叛了我。用我自己的长矛刺伤我，然后把我遗弃在波涛中……

english: Floopa... I'm so sorry...
translation: 弗卢帕……我很难过……

english: This ship? Does it have something to do with your old crew?
translation: 这艘船？和你以前的船员有关吗？

english: I think so... but I need time to think... I need to work out what it all means...
translation: 我想是的……但我需要时间思考……我得弄清楚这一切意味着什么……

english: More than that! You need more rest as well. [player name], we should give her the time she needs. Return to us later once she has rested.
translation: 不止如此！你还需要更多休息。[player name]，我们应该给她需要的时间。等她休息好了，再回来找我们。

english: In the meantime, may I suggest you take this opportunity to further explore our island. I'm sure you'll find it has a lot to offer.
translation: 同时，我建议你趁这个机会好好探索一下我们的岛屿。我相信你会发它有很多好东西。

english: I might just do that. Thank you.
translation: 我会考虑的。谢谢你。

english: No, no, no! Thank you, [player name]! We will talk again soon.
translation: 不，不，不！该我谢你，[player name]！我们很快再聊。

english: Doesn't look like much.
translation: 看起来不怎么样。

english: Hey I recognise you two! You were part of the delegation to Varrock!
translation: 嘿，我认识你们两个！你们是去维洛克城的代表团成员！

english: Indeed we were.
translation: 确实如此。

english: More than part of. We organised the whole thing!
translation: 何止是成员，整个活动都是我们组织的！

english: As was our duty.
translation: 这是我们的职责。

english: The Prince could have contributed.
translation: 王子本来也可以出力的。

english: Do not air your dirty laundry in public, brother.
translation: 别在公共场合家丑外扬，兄弟。

english: You. The Prince wishes to speak with you. He awaits you at the temple.
translation: 你。王子想和你谈谈。他在神殿等你。

english: Where do I find this temple?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到这座神殿？

english: On the other side of the bazaar, south of here.
translation: 在集市那边，从这里往南走。

english: Okay. Guess I should get going then.
translation: 好吧。那我该出发了。

english: Er... I'll leave you to it.
translation: 呃……你们继续聊，我先走了。

english: The Prince is waiting for you. You'll find him in the temple to the south, on the other side of the bazaar.
translation: 王子在等你。他在南边的神殿里，穿过集市就能找到。

english: I know your face. I have seen it a thousand times before.
translation: 我认识你这张脸。我已经见过它上千次了。

english: Er... I think you must have me confused with someone else. We've never met.
translation: 呃……我想你一定认错人了。我们从没见过面。

english: Yes... and no. This is our first encounter, and yet I know you better than most. You wear the face of my only true companion. You wear the face of death.
translation: 是……也不是。这是我们第一次相遇，但我比大多数人更了解你。你戴着我唯一真正同伴的面容。你戴着死亡的面容。

english: Your only companion is death? You should probably get out more.
translation: 你唯一的同伴是死亡？你该多出去走走。

english: You jest, as your kind often do. Is that how you drown out their screams, I wonder? Is that how you hide your pain?
translation: 你开玩笑，你们这群人经常这样。我想知道，你是不是这样掩盖他们的尖叫？你是不是这样隐藏你的痛苦？

english: Well things got deep very quickly. Is this how you normally introduce yourself to someone?
translation: 好吧，话题一下子变得这么深刻。你平时就是这样介绍自己的吗？

english: Few seek an introduction with the Sect of Ranul. They spend their days in Ralos' light. The darkness hides an inevitable truth that they prefer to shy away from.
translation: 很少有人寻求与拉努尔教团的结识。他们终日沐浴在拉洛斯的阳光下。黑暗隐藏着一个他们宁愿回避的不可避免的真相。

english: Right... So who actually are you?
translation: 好吧……那你到底是谁？

english: I am Metzli, Teokan of Ranul. You I already know. You are the one that saved the life of my counterpart.
translation: 我是拉努尔的神官梅茨利。我已经认识你了。你就是那个救了我对应体性命的人。

english: Teokan? So there are two of you?
translation: 神官？所以你们有两个人？

english: Yes. As Teokan of Ranul, I lead the Sect of Ranul. My counterpart, Servius, leads the Church of Ralos.
translation: 是的。作为拉努尔的神官，我领导拉努尔教团。我的同行者塞尔维乌斯领导拉洛斯教会。

english: I'm meant to be meeting Prince Itzla here.
translation: 我本来应该在这儿见伊茨拉王子。

english: Yes you are. He is speaking with Servius, down in the crypt. Not a place you'd normally find the Teokan of Ralos, but the Prince desired the privacy only Ranul can offer.
translation: 是的。他正在墓穴里和塞尔维乌斯谈话。通常你不会在那种地方找到拉洛斯的神官，但王子想要只有拉努尔才能提供的私密性。

english: I'd better head down there.
translation: 我最好下去那里。

english: Could you tell me more about the Church of Ralos?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于拉洛斯教会的事吗？

english: Those who worship the light can be found throughout these lands, and it is the Church of Ralos that leads their worship.
translation: 在这片土地上到处都能找到崇拜光明的人，而拉洛斯教会引领着他们的崇拜。

english: If you wish to learn more, you should seek out Servius or one of his Teoki. They will be better placed to guide you than I, for my duty is one of darkness, not light.
translation: 如果你想了解更多，你应该去找塞尔维乌斯或他的某位神官。他们比我更适合引导你，因为我的职责是黑暗，而非光明。

english: Could you tell me more about the Sect of Ranul?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于拉努尔教团的事吗？

english: Ralos' light can be found all across Varlamore, but when that light fades, there is only one who can guide us through the darkness.
translation: 拉洛斯的光芒遍布瓦拉莫尔，但当那光芒消退时，只有一人能引导我们穿越黑暗。

english: Ranul?
translation: 拉努尔？

english: Yes. You will not find many worshippers of Ranul in your travels. Indeed, many choose to hide from him their whole lives, but no matter what, we will all meet Ranul in the end.
translation: 是的。你在旅途中不会找到很多拉努尔的崇拜者。事实上，许多人选择一生都躲避他，但无论如何，我们最终都会遇见拉努尔。

english: When the sun sets, it is he that will guide us. He will lead us through the Gates of Mictl to where we may finally rest. The duty of the Sect of Ranul is to ensure that all are prepared for that journey.
translation: 当太阳落山时，他将指引我们。他将带领我们穿过米克特尔大门，到达我们最终安息的地方。拉努尔教派的职责是确保所有人都为那次旅程做好准备。

english: You have returned.
translation: 你回来了。

english: The Prince awaits you down in the crypt.
translation: 王子在下面的墓穴等你。

english: Ah, there you are. Nilsal, adventurer. I don't believe you've properly met my father. This is Servius, the Teokan of Ralos and the man whose life you saved.
translation: 啊，你来了。你好，冒险者。我不信你已经正式见过我父亲。这位是塞尔维乌斯，拉洛斯的神官，也是你救下性命的人。

english: Your father? I didn't realise you were related.
translation: 你父亲？我不知道你们有关系。

english: Yes, very fun stuff. All a bit of a convoluted mess as well! I'll be sure to tell you all about it at some point. For now though, [player name], meet Servius. Servius, meet [player name].
translation: 是啊，很有趣的事。也是一团乱麻！我以后肯定会告诉你全部。不过现在，[player name]，来见见塞尔维乌斯。塞尔维乌斯，来见见[player name]。

english: Nilsal, my child. It is an honour to meet you. Were it not for you, I may well already be making my journey to Mictl. On behalf of both myself and Ralos, I thank you.
translation: 你好，我的孩子。很荣幸见到你。如果不是你，我可能已经在前往米克特尔的路上了。我代表自己和拉洛斯，向你表示感谢。

english: Well let's not start celebrating just yet. There's a reason why we're lurking in this crypt.
translation: 好了，先别急着庆祝。我们躲在这个墓穴里是有原因的。

english: Sorry about that, by the way. I'd have much rather given you a proper welcome on your arrival, but given the situation, it's probably best we take a bit more care.
translation: 顺便说一句，对此我很抱歉。我本来更想在你到达时给你一个正式的欢迎，但鉴于目前的情况，我们最好还是小心一点。

english: It's not a problem. Although, I did have an interesting encounter on my way here.
translation: 没关系。不过，我在来的路上确实遇到了一件有趣的事。

english: Ah, the Tullus twins. Fascinating pair, aren't they?
translation: 啊，图卢斯双胞胎。一对迷人的家伙，不是吗？

english: Actually, I was talking about Metzli. I met her upstairs.
translation: 实际上，我说的是梅茨利。我在楼上见过她了。

english: Oh, you met her! My deepest sympathies.
translation: 哦，你见过她了！我深表同情。

english: Metzli and her sect play an essential role in our lives. You should not judge her so harshly.
translation: 梅茨利和她的教团在我们的生活中扮演着重要角色。你不该如此严厉地评判她。

english: You're quite right, of course. But anyway, shall we get down to business?
translation: 当然，你说得很对。但不管怎样，我们该谈正事了吗？

english: Kuani! So we have quite the predicament on our hands. My mother isn't too happy, oddly enough, and has tasked me with sorting it all out.
translation: 夸尼！所以我们手头有个大麻烦。奇怪的是，我母亲不太高兴，把解决这事交给了我来处理。

english: Someone wants our dear Teokan dead, and we have no idea who! All we know is that they were a Varlamorian.
translation: 有人想让我们亲爱的神官死，我们却不知道是谁！我们只知道他们是个瓦拉莫尔人。

english: A Varlamorian who had access to the mainland before the treaty was signed. Surely that limits the options a fair bit?
translation: 一个在条约签署前就能进入大陆的瓦拉莫尔人。这肯定大大缩小了范围吧？

english: Right you are, [player name]! In fact, it limits them to just the members of our little delegation. In other words, myself, Servius, the Tullus twins and our retinue of knights.
translation: 说得对，[player name]！事实上，这就把范围缩小到我们这个小代表团的成员了。换句话说，就是我、塞尔维乌斯、图卢斯双胞胎，以及随行的骑士们。

english: Now I don't think it was me... and I'm guessing you didn't try to arrange your own assassination, Servius?
translation: 我不认为是我……我猜你也没打算安排刺杀自己吧，塞尔维乌斯？

english: I'd like to think I'd have done a better job if I had.
translation: 我倒觉得，如果是我安排的，我会做得更好。

english: Too right. Very sloppy work. A top example of how not to assassinate someone. Still, probably best we track them down all the same.
translation: 太对了。非常马虎的工作。一个如何不刺杀别人的绝佳例子。不过，我们还是最好把他们找出来。

english: So that leaves the Tullus twins and the knights.
translation: 所以剩下的就是图卢斯双胞胎和骑士们。

english: Ennius and Furia are loyal children of Ralos. They would not wish to see my death.
translation: 恩尼乌斯和富里亚是拉洛斯忠诚的孩子。他们不愿看到我死。

english: Those knights should also be loyal children of Ralos, but I agree, they are far more likely candidates. Let us investigate them and see what we can find.
translation: 那些骑士也应该是拉洛斯忠诚的孩子，但我同意，他们是更有可能的人选。我们去调查他们，看看能找到什么。

english: Servius, until we have this matter sorted, you should remain here in the capital. The palace will be the safest place.
translation: 塞尔维乌斯，在我们把这事解决之前，你应该留在首都。宫殿将是最安全的地方。

english: Nonsense! I am the Teokan of Ralos and I have a duty to the people. I must return to the Teomat at once!
translation: 胡说！我是拉洛斯的神官，我对人民有责任。我必须立即返回特奥马特修道院！

english: The Teomat does not offer the protection of the palace. You'll be an easy target there.
translation: 特奥马特修道院没有宫殿的防护。你在那里很容易成为目标。

english: I am the chosen messenger of Ralos. He would not have me cower and hide. I will return to the Teomat.
translation: 我是拉洛斯选中的信使。他不会让我畏缩躲藏。我要返回特奥马特修道院。

english: Well this is a terrible idea that's definitely going to blow up in all our faces later, but it seems you have made your decision. However, I insist that you let me personally accompany you.
translation: 好吧，这是个糟糕的主意，以后肯定会让我们大家都吃不了兜着走，但你似乎已经决定了。不过，我坚持要亲自陪同你。

english: My child, I would be delighted to have you as a travelling companion.
translation: 我的孩子，我很高兴有你作为旅伴。

english: [player name], since Servius here seems keen on letting this killer have another go, you'll need to investigate the knights on your own.
translation: [player name]，既然塞尔维乌斯似乎热切希望让这个杀手再试一次，你就得自己去调查那些骑士了。

english: Kuani! Head up to the palace and find the Tullus twins. They dealt with all the fun admin work. They'll know where those knights can be found.
translation: 夸尼！去宫殿找到图卢斯双胞胎。他们处理了所有有趣的行政工作。他们知道那些骑士在哪里能找到。

english: Then it sounds like we're all set. Timoiva, and may the sun light your way!
translation: 那么看来我们都准备好了。提莫伊瓦，愿阳光照亮你的道路！

english: Timoiva, my child.
translation: 提莫伊瓦，我的孩子。

english: Ah, you're back. Shall we get down to business?
translation: 啊，你回来了。我们开始谈正事吧？

english: [player name], head to the palace and find the Tullus twins. They'll know where you can find those knights.
translation: [player name]，去宫殿找图卢斯双胞胎。他们会知道你在哪里能找到那些骑士。

english: It seems the Prince has new chores for us.
translation: 看来王子给我们派了新任务。

english: You do not know that.
translation: 你还不确定呢。

english: Why else would he have sent the adventurer back to us?
translation: 不然他为什么把冒险者派回给我们？

english: You two are quite the pair, aren't you?
translation: 你们两个真是般配的一对，不是吗？

english: I do not believe that was a compliment, brother.
translation: 我不觉得那是夸奖，兄弟。

english: Oh... Well let's get to it then. What does the Prince need now?
translation: 哦……那好吧，我们开始吧。王子现在需要什么？

english: He's asked me to investigate the knights who were part of the delegation to Varrock. He suspects one of them may have been involved in the plot to kill the Teokan.
translation: 他让我去调查那些曾是去维洛克城代表团成员的骑士。他怀疑其中一人可能参与了刺杀神官的阴谋。

english: Has he forgotten that he himself leads the Knights of Varlamore? Surely he'd be best placed to deal with any of their wrongdoings.
translation: 他难道忘了自己就是瓦拉莫尔骑士团的领袖吗？他肯定最适合处理他们任何的不当行为。

english: He's staying with Servius in case there's another attempt on his life.
translation: 他和塞尔维乌斯待在一起，以防再有人试图暗杀他。

english: It is wise to keep the Teokan under close protection, and we are well placed to support this investigation.
translation: 让神官处于严密保护之下是明智的，而我们很适合支持这次调查。

english: The delegation consisted of six knights. Given recent events, I requested they make us aware of their activities. I suggest you seek them out and ask them to return here.
translation: 代表团由六名骑士组成。鉴于最近的事件，我要求他们让我们了解自己的活动。我建议你找到他们，让他们回到这里。

english: Arrun and Claudia should be at the bazaar. Nel will be at the cothon. Velam and Azali are somewhere in Outer Fortis, likely at the pub. Mezan will be at the colosseum.
translation: 阿伦和克劳迪娅应该在集市。内尔会在科松港。维拉姆和阿扎利在福蒂斯外围的某个地方，可能在酒馆。梅赞会在竞技场。

english: What if any refuse to come?
translation: 如果有人拒绝来怎么办？

english: This crest will mark you as a representative of the Queen herself. Show it to them and they will not refuse.
translation: 这枚徽章将标明你是女王本人的代表。向他们展示它，他们就不会拒绝。

english: Not unless they fancy revealing themselves as the traitor, which doesn't seem likely.
translation: 除非他们想暴露自己是叛徒，但这似乎不太可能。

english: Where can I find the bazaar?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到集市？

english: Surely you passed through it on your way to the temple earlier. It's directly south of here.
translation: 你之前去神殿的路上肯定穿过它。就在这里的正南方。

english: Where can I find the cothon?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到科松港？

english: From here, just take the eastern path past the museum. Once you reach the water, you have found the cothon.
translation: 从这里出发，沿着东边的小路经过博物馆。一旦你到达水边，你就找到科松港了。

english: Where can I find Outer Fortis?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到福蒂斯外围？

english: It's the part of the city outside the main walls. Head south from here and you'll find it on the other side of the gates.
translation: 那是主城墙外的城市部分。从这里向南走，你会在大门另一边找到它。

english: Head to the pub once you get there. That's likely where Velam and Azali are.
translation: 到了那里就去酒馆。维拉姆和阿扎利很可能在那儿。

english: Where can I find the colosseum?
translation: 我在哪儿能找到竞技场？

english: On the cliffs overlooking the city, east of here. I'd be concerned if you couldn't find it. It's pretty much impossible to miss.
translation: 在俯瞰城市的悬崖上，从这里往东。如果你找不到它，我会很担心。那东西几乎不可能错过。

english: Mezan will likely already be inside. I'd suggest searching the training area for him.
translation: 梅赞很可能已经在里面了。我建议你去训练区找他。

english: Take this crest. It will mark you as a representative of the Queen herself. Show it to the knights and ask them to return here.
translation: 拿着这枚徽章。它会标明你是女王本人的代表。把它展示给骑士们，让他们回到这里。

english: I lost that crest you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那枚徽章。

english: Oh good. So now there's a crest of the Queen out there somewhere that anyone could use. Why did the Prince pick this one?
translation: 哦，很好。所以现在外面某处有一枚谁都能用的女王徽章。王子为什么偏偏选了这一枚？

english: We will have it dealt with. For now, take another. However, I suggest you take more care this time.
translation: 我们会处理好的。现在，拿另一枚吧。不过，我建议你这次小心一点。

english: Nilsal. Can we help you?
translation: 尼萨尔。我们能帮你吗？

english: Ennius and Furia Tullus need you to return to the palace.
translation: 恩尼乌斯和弗里亚.图卢斯需要你回王宫。

english: If that were so, you'd have proof.
translation: 如果是这样，你会有证据的。

english: Ah, well... I... I don't.
translation: 啊，这个……我……我没有。

english: Thought so. Be off with you.
translation: 我就知道。你走吧。

english: Well it just so happens I have this.
translation: 巧了，我正好有这个。

english: Hmm... Well we're not going anywhere until our work here is done. If you want us back at the palace, you'd best help.
translation: 嗯……我们手头的事没做完之前哪儿也不去。如果你想让我们回王宫，最好帮帮忙。

english: I can do that. What do you need?
translation: 没问题。需要我做什么？

english: A band of thieves has been active here recently, but we came up with a way to track them down. We planted a nice shiny amulet on one of the stalls. Sure enough, it was stolen soon after.
translation: 最近这里有一伙盗贼很活跃，但我们想出了追踪他们的办法。我们在一个摊位上放了一个亮闪闪的护身符。果然，没过多久就被偷了。

english: Find the amulet and tell us who was carrying it. We can then follow them right to the rest of their group.
translation: 找到护身符，告诉我们是谁拿的。然后我们就可以跟着他们找到其余的同伙。

english: How will I find it?
translation: 我怎么找到它？

english: Beat them at their own game. Go looking through a few pockets.
translation: 以其人之道还治其人之身。去翻翻几个口袋。

english: Well this doesn't sound totally orthodox, but fair enough. I'll be back soon.
translation: 嗯，这听起来不太正统，但行吧。我很快回来。

english: Do you have the amulet?
translation: 你拿到护身符了吗？

english: Best you get to it then.
translation: 那你最好赶紧去办。

english: I have it right here. That man in blue over there had it.
translation: 我找到了。那边那个穿蓝色衣服的人拿的。

english: Good work. He'll lead us right to those thieves.
translation: 干得好。他会带我们找到那些盗贼。

english: So you'll return to the palace now?
translation: 那你们现在回王宫吗？

english: We'll be there once the thieves are dealt with. It won't take us long.
translation: 等处理完盗贼我们就去。用不了多久。

english: Well good luck then.
translation: 那祝你好运。

english: Hello again. Do you know how long it will be before you can return to the palace?
translation: 又见面了。你知道还要多久才能回王宫吗？

english: Not long. We'll be there as soon as the thieves are dealt with.
translation: 快了。等处理完盗贼我们就过去。

english: Okay. Good luck with them.
translation: 好的。祝你们顺利。

english: Hello there. I'm here on behalf of Ennius and Furia Tullus. They need you to return to the palace immediately.
translation: 你好。我代表恩尼乌斯和弗里亚.图卢斯前来。他们需要你立刻回王宫。

english: You're working for the Tullus twins? Do you have proof?
translation: 你在为图卢斯双胞胎工作？有证据吗？

english: Well rules are rules, I'm afraid. Without proof, I can't take any orders from you.
translation: 嗯，恐怕规矩就是规矩。没有证据，我不能听从你的命令。

english: Huh... Fair enough. I'm happy to return to the palace, but I can't until I've finished my work here.
translation: 哈……有道理。我很乐意回王宫，但得先把手头的事做完。

english: What is it you're doing? Maybe I can help get it done faster.
translation: 你在做什么？也许我能帮忙快点搞定。

english: With the recent opening of the kingdom, the cothon has become much busier. Good for business of course, but not so good when it comes to smugglers.
translation: 王国最近开放后，科松港变得繁忙多了。对生意当然是好事，但对打击走私就不那么有利了。

english: We've had a tip-off that there's a ship here involved in weapons smuggling, but we don't know which one.
translation: 我们接到线报，有一艘船在这里参与武器走私，但不知道是哪一艘。

english: If you can find the crate of weapons and tell me what ship it's from, I'll be able to return to the palace much faster.
translation: 如果你能找到武器板条箱，并告诉我它来自哪艘船，我就能更快地回到宫殿。

english: You say that now, but there's no shortage of crates around here. Thankfully, the tip-off did give us some information that might help you find it.
translation: 你现在这么说，但这里板条箱可不少。幸好线报提供了一些信息，可能对你有帮助。

english: The crate should be on the docks rather than on a ship. It's of a standard size and isn't part of a stack. It's directly next to two barrels of fish and opposite a bench.
translation: 板条箱应该在码头上，而不是在船上。它是标准尺寸，不是堆叠的一部分。它紧挨着两个木桶的鱼，对面是一条长凳。

english: Good to know. I'll get to it and let you know what I find.
translation: 知道了。我去找，找到后告诉你。

english: Any luck finding that crate?
translation: 找到那个板条箱了吗？

english: Not yet. Could you remind me what I'm looking for?
translation: 还没。你能再提醒我一下要找什么吗？

english: Thanks. I'll keep looking.
translation: 谢谢。我继续找。

english: Yes, I found it. The ship it's from is called The Fortis Spark.
translation: 是的，我找到了。它来自一艘叫“福蒂斯火花号”的船。

english: Perfect! That's my work here done then. I'll return to the palace shortly. Timoiva!
translation: 完美！那我这边的事就办完了。我马上回王宫。Timoiva！

english: Hello again. I'll be returning to the palace shortly.
translation: 又见面了。我很快就要回王宫了。

english: Sorry, but I'm waiting for someone.
translation: 抱歉，我在等人。

english: Well you might need to meet with them some other time. You're needed back at the palace.
translation: 那你可能得改天再见了。王宫需要你回去。

english: You don't work for the palace. Why would they send you?
translation: 你不是王宫的人。他们为什么会派你来？

english: I'm working directly for the Prince.
translation: 我直接为王子工作。

english: If you are, then prove it.
translation: 如果是，那就证明给我看。

english: Well... I can't.
translation: 这个……我证明不了。

english: Well then come back when you can.
translation: 那等你证明了再来吧。

english: Brand new here and already working for the Prince... Strange.
translation: 刚来这儿就给王子干活……真奇怪。

english: Maybe, but like I say, you're needed at the palace.
translation: 也许吧，但我说了，王宫需要你。

english: And I'll return there... eventually. First, I'm here for some training, but it seems my training partner is a no show.
translation: 我会回去的……迟早的事。不过我先来这儿训练，但我的训练伙伴好像没来。

english: Hmm... You look like you know a thing or two. You can take his place.
translation: 嗯……你看起来有两下子。你来替他吧。

english: I can?
translation: 我来？

english: Yes! Join me in the colosseum for some training. Once we're done, I'll return to the palace.
translation: 对！跟我去竞技场训练。训练完了我就回王宫。

english: Oh, and bring two attack styles in with you. I want some variety, and it will help me test my faith in Ralos.
translation: 哦，对了，带上两种攻击风格进来。我想来点花样，这也能帮我检验对拉洛斯的信仰。

english: I'm ready. Let's do this.
translation: 我准备好了。开始吧。

english: I need to go and prepare.
translation: 我得去准备一下。

english: I'll be here once you're ready.
translation: 你准备好了我就在这儿。

english: Are you ready to train? Remember, bring two attack styles in with you. It will help me test my faith in Ralos.
translation: 准备好训练了吗？记住，带上两种攻击风格。这能帮我检验对拉洛斯的信仰。

english: Ralos will defend me!
translation: 拉洛斯会庇护我！

english: Ralos' light protects me!
translation: 拉洛斯的光芒保护着我！

english: Shield me, Ralos!
translation: 拉洛斯，庇护我！

english: You fought well in there. I should train with you more often.
translation: 你打得不错。我应该多跟你训练。

english: Yes, I'll head over there shortly.
translation: 好的，我马上过去。

english: Perfect! Thanks.
translation: 完美！谢谢。

english: Nilsal, adventurer. I'll be returning to the palace soon.
translation: 尼萨尔，冒险者。我很快就要回王宫了。

english: Well look who it is!
translation: 哟，看看这是谁！

english: Er... I don't know you.
translation: 呃……我不认识你。

english: I told you not to have that last one. Look at you!
translation: 我告诉过你别喝最后一杯。看看你！

english: Stop whining! I'm fine!
translation: 别抱怨了！我没事！

english: Right... The two of you have been asked to report to the palace as soon as you can.
translation: 好吧……你们两个被要求尽快去王宫报到。

english: Report? I don't think so! It's our day off!
translation: 报到？想得美！今天是我们休息日！

english: Okay well... Oh... I was going to show you a crest, but I seem to have lost it.
translation: 好吧，那个……哦……我本来想给你看个徽章，但好像弄丢了。

english: Okay then! Timoiva for now!
translation: 那好吧！先Timoiva了！

english: Sorry, but I have this crest here that says otherwise.
translation: 抱歉，但我有这个徽章，证明不是这样。

english: Ah, now that's going to be a problem.
translation: 啊，这下麻烦了。

english: Azali here can't go showing up to the palace in this state. We need to sober her up.
translation: 阿扎莉现在这副样子可没法去王宫。我们得让她清醒一下。

english: Hmm... Where's the nearest fountain?
translation: 嗯……最近的喷泉在哪儿？

english: There's one outside the gates just to the east of here... But how does a fountain help?
translation: 东边大门外面就有一个……但喷泉有什么用？

english: Well there's nothing like a little dunk to sober you up a bit. Azali, come with me.
translation: 没什么比泡一下更能让人清醒了。阿扎莉，跟我来。

english: Should you not pick up your follower first?
translation: 你不先带上你的随从吗？

english: Ohh... We're going somewhere new? How exciting!
translation: 哦……我们要去新地方？太兴奋了！

english: I thought you were going to that fountain. It's just outside the gates to the east of here.
translation: 我以为你要去那个喷泉。就在东边大门外面。

english: Ohh, this is tiring. I think I need a quick break.
translation: 哦，好累啊。我想歇一会儿。

english: Can we have a break? I'm feeling a bit iffy...
translation: 能休息一下吗？我有点不舒服……

english: Huh? That looks interesting...
translation: 嗯？那个看起来挺有意思……

english: Wow! What's that over there?!
translation: 哇！那边是什么？！

english: Hey! You're going too fast!
translation: 嘿！你走太快了！

english: This way, Azali.
translation: 这边，阿扎莉。

english: This isn't the right way! I'm going back to the pub!
translation: 这不是正确的路！我要回酒馆！

english: Feeling a bit better now?
translation: 现在感觉好点了吗？

english: Well it will have to do. You're needed over at the palace.
translation: 也只能这样了。王宫那边需要你。

english: This day is the worst. Fine, I'll head over there soon.
translation: 今天真是糟透了。好吧，我一会儿就过去。

english: Don't worry, I'll be on my way to the palace soon.
translation: 别担心，我很快就去王宫。

english: Nilsal. Thanks for helping out with that little issue. I'll be heading over to the palace soon.
translation: 尼萨尔。谢谢你帮忙解决了那个小问题。我很快就去王宫。

english: Have you spoken to all the knights?
translation: 你跟所有骑士都谈过了吗？

english: Yes. They should be here soon.
translation: 是的。他们应该很快就到。

english: Six knights, but likely only one traitor. How do you intend to work out who it is?
translation: 六个骑士，但很可能只有一个叛徒。你打算怎么找出是谁？

english: Well I'm going to guess asking nicely won't work.
translation: 嗯，我猜好好问是行不通的。

english: After they were picked for the delegation, the knights were granted beds in the Kualti Headquarters, just west of here. I would suggest you search there for anything of note.
translation: 在他们被选为代表团的成员后，骑士们被授予了库阿尔蒂总部的床，就在这里的西边。我建议你在那里搜索任何值得注意的东西。

english: We'll keep the knights busy until you're done.
translation: 我们会拖住骑士们，直到你查完。

english: Did you find anything in the Kualti Headquarters?
translation: 你在库阿尔蒂总部找到什么了吗？

english: Then you should keep looking.
translation: 那你应该继续找。

english: I found a letter to one of the knights, but I haven't read it yet.
translation: 我找到一封给其中一位骑士的信，但还没看。

english: Then you should do so and see what it says.
translation: 那你应该看看信上写了什么。

english: I found a letter to one of the knights. It seems that Velam is our traitor.
translation: 我找到一封给其中一位骑士的信。看来维拉姆就是叛徒。

english: You are sure?
translation: 你确定？

english: The letter directed him to arrange the death of the Teokan. It also mentioned something called Twilight's Promise and something else called the Final Dawn.
translation: 信里指示他安排特奥坎的死。还提到了一个叫暮光之约的东西，以及另一个叫最终黎明的东西。

english: Then it sounds like Velam has some explaining to do. This should be fun.
translation: 那看来维拉姆得好好解释一下了。这应该会很有趣。

english: Velam, step forward.
translation: 维拉姆，上前来。

english: Velam, you have been found to be a traitor to the Kingdom of Varlamore.
translation: 维拉姆，你已被证实是瓦拉莫尔王国的叛徒。

english: What? I don't understand!
translation: 什么？我不明白！

english: We know you attempted to arrange the murder of the Teokan of Ralos. Do you have anything to say about this?
translation: 我们知道你试图安排谋杀拉洛斯的特奥坎。你有什么要说的吗？

english: This isn't true! Someone must have set me up!
translation: 这不是真的！一定是有人陷害我！

english: Your lies mean nothing here. Your guilt has already been proven.
translation: 你的谎言在这里毫无意义。你的罪行已经得到证实。

english: No! This isn't right!
translation: 不！这不对！

english: For you, this is the only thing that's right.
translation: 对你来说，这才是唯一正确的事。

english: The rest of you are dismissed.
translation: 其余人可以退下了。

english: What were you expecting? That we'd invite him to sit down for dinner and drinks? I don't know how they do things where you come from, but you're in Varlamore now. This is how we deal with traitors.
translation: 你指望什么？我们请他坐下来吃饭喝酒？我不知道你老家那边是怎么做的，但你现在在瓦拉莫尔。我们就是这么对付叛徒的。

english: We should have questioned him! Now we have no idea who he was working for!
translation: 我们应该审问他！现在我们根本不知道他在为谁卖命！

english: Well it's done now, so little point dwelling on it.
translation: 事已至此，纠结也没用了。

english: Little point...
translation: 没用了……

english: While my brother may have been a touch too hasty, he is right. What's done is done. You should return to the Prince and let him know.
translation: 虽然我弟弟可能有点操之过急，但他说得对。木已成舟。你应该回去告诉王子。

english: I... Fine.
translation: 我……好吧。

english: Itzla and Servius said they were going to something called a Teomat.
translation: 伊茨拉和塞尔维乌斯说他们要去一个叫特奥马特修道院的地方。

english: Makes sense. The Teomat is the centre of all religion in Varlamore. The Teokan would have been eager to return to his home.
translation: 说得通。特奥马特修道院是瓦拉莫尔所有宗教的中心。特奥坎肯定急着回家。

english: You'll find the Teomat atop Ralos' Rise, but it's quite the walk from here. You should speak to Regulus Cento outside about a faster method of travel.
translation: 你会在拉洛斯之巅找到特奥马特修道院，但从这里走过去可不近。你应该去找外面的雷古卢斯.森托，问问有没有更快的方法。

english: You should not waste time. The Prince will be eager to hear what you've discovered.
translation: 别浪费时间了。王子一定很想知道你发现了什么。

english: Alright, I'll go and see Regulus.
translation: 好，我去找雷古卢斯。

english: Speak to Regulus Cento outside about a faster method of travel. You'll likely need it if you wish to travel to the Teomat.
translation: 去找外面的雷古卢斯.森托，问问有没有更快的方法。如果你想前往特奥马特修道院，你很可能需要它。

english: I was told to ask you about getting to the Teomat.
translation: 有人让我来问你如何前往特奥马特修道院。

english: Ah, kuani! Well you'll be pleased to know that Prince Itzla has already granted me permission to give you your very own quetzal, free of charge!
translation: 啊，库阿尼！那你一定会很高兴，伊茨拉王子已经允许我免费送你一只属于你自己的绿咬鹃！

english: My own quetzal?
translation: 我自己的绿咬鹃？

english: That's right! And I've already picked out the perfect one. This here is Renu. She finished training not too long ago and has been eagerly awaiting her first rider.
translation: 没错！我已经帮你挑好了最完美的一只。这位是雷努。她不久前刚完成训练，一直热切地等待着她的第一位骑手。

english: Now, Renu here isn't as experienced as Primio, so don't expect her to be taking you too far. However, she's more than capable of flying anywhere in Varlamore, provided there's somewhere suitable to land.
translation: 听着，雷努不像普里米奥那么有经验，所以别指望她能带你飞太远。不过，只要有着陆点，她完全有能力带你飞到瓦拉莫尔的任何地方。

english: You'll find that we already have plenty of landing sites all across the kingdom, and more are being built all the time. You could probably even build a few of your own if you wanted.
translation: 你会发现我们在整个王国已经建了很多着陆点，而且还在不断新建。如果你愿意，甚至可能自己建几个。

english: Now, why don't you two properly introduce yourselves to each other. I have the perfect thing here to help with that.
translation: 现在，你们俩好好认识一下吧。我这正好有东西能帮上忙。

english: Have you properly introduced yourself to Renu yet? She'll be able to take you right there!
translation: 你和雷努好好认识了吗？她能直接带你去那里！

english: Have you properly introduced yourself to Renu yet? She'll be able to take you right there! Here, I'm sure this will help the two of you become firm iknamis.
translation: 你和雷努好好认识了吗？她能直接带你去那里！来，我相信这能让你们俩成为亲密的伊克纳米。

english: Hello, Renu. I have something for you here.
translation: 你好，雷努。我有东西给你。

english: Kuani! I reckon she'll let you ride her now.
translation: 库阿尼！我猜她现在会让你骑了。

english: You have everything you need to get there already. Renu will be able to take you!
translation: 你已经有了到达那里所需的一切。雷努能带你去！

english: The Prince and my counterpart wish to speak with you. You should go to them at once.
translation: 王子和我的同行想和你谈谈。你应该立刻去找他们。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. How goes your investigation?
translation: 尼萨尔，[player name]。你的调查进展如何？

english: I'm still looking into those knights.
translation: 我还在调查那些骑士。

english: Well keep at it. The Tullus twins should be able to help you where needed.
translation: 继续努力。需要的话，图卢斯双胞胎应该能帮你。

english: Nilsal, [player name]. Welcome to the Teomat.
translation: 尼萨尔，[player name]。欢迎来到特奥马特修道院。

english: Nilsal, my child.
translation: 尼萨尔，我的孩子。

english: So, how did your investigation go?
translation: 那么，你的调查结果如何？

english: I found a letter to one of the knights, Velam. The letter instructed him to arrange the death of Servius.
translation: 我找到一封给其中一位骑士维拉姆的信。信里指示他安排塞尔维乌斯的死。

english: Tetamo! One of my own knights! I will need to swiftly deal with this.
translation: 特塔莫！我自己的骑士之一！我得迅速处理这件事。

english: Well there's actually no need. Ennius killed him as soon as we found out.
translation: 其实没必要了。恩尼乌斯一发现就杀了他。

english: Ah, excellent! Such should be the fate of all traitors.
translation: 啊，太好了！所有叛徒都该是这个下场。

english: But Ennius killed him before we could even question him!
translation: 但恩尼乌斯在我们还没来得及审问就杀了他！

english: Hmm, that's unfortunate. It would have been good to know who he was working for. No matter though! I'm sure we'll find another way of getting to the bottom of this.
translation: 嗯，那太可惜了。要是能知道他在为谁卖命就好了。不过没关系！我相信我们总能找到其他办法查个水落石出。

english: Does it not bother you how quickly Ennius killed him? Is it not a bit odd?
translation: 恩尼乌斯这么快就杀了他，你不觉得困扰吗？不觉得有点奇怪吗？

english: Here in Varlamore, justice is delivered swiftly and harshly. Ennius may have taken that a bit too literally... but there's not much we can do about that now.
translation: 在瓦拉莫尔，正义是迅速而严厉的。恩尼乌斯可能有点太字面理解了……但我们现在也做不了什么了。

english: But do you not find it suspicious? I find a letter perfectly implicating one of the knights, but he's then quickly killed before he can be questioned.
translation: 但你不觉得可疑吗？我找到一封信完美地指控了其中一位骑士，但他还没来得及被审问就被迅速杀死了。

english: Seems like a pretty good way of covering things up, don't you think?
translation: 这看起来是个很好的掩盖方式，你不觉得吗？

english: The Tullus family have loyally served the rulers of Varlamore since the death of Emperor Imafore. For one of them to be a traitor is unthinkable!
translation: 图卢斯家族自伊马福雷皇帝死后就一直忠心耿耿地侍奉瓦拉莫尔的统治者。说他们其中一个是叛徒，简直不可想象！

english: It's a dangerous accusation indeed. That said... the family does have a bit of a history.
translation: 这确实是个危险的指控。话虽如此……这个家族确实有点历史。

english: My family has not always ruled Varlamore. In fact, it was the Tullus family who reigned for the majority of the kingdom's history.
translation: 我的家族并非一直统治瓦拉莫尔。事实上，在王国历史的大部分时间里，是图卢斯家族在统治。

english: That all ended when good old Imafore declared the kingdom to be his new empire. He celebrated by going on a nice little murder spree. One war later and dear old Imafore found himself without a head.
translation: 这一切都在老伊马福雷宣布王国成为他的新帝国时结束了。他通过一场小小的愉快屠杀来庆祝。一场战争之后，亲爱的老伊马福雷就掉了脑袋。

english: Had that not happened, the throne would have eventually passed down to... Furia, I think... I believe she's the slightly older of the two.
translation: 如果那没发生，王位最终会传给……我想是富里亚……她应该是两人中稍年长的那个。

english: Right... And you don't think that might be a good reason for her and Ennius to be traitors?
translation: 好吧……你不觉得这可能是她和恩尼乌斯成为叛徒的好理由吗？

english: Imafore's death was over a hundred years ago! His family had no love for him then, and they've loyally served the Arkans since.
translation: 伊马福雷的死是一百多年前的事了！他的家人当时就不喜欢他，而且从那以后一直忠心侍奉阿尔坎家族。

english: Yes, very true, but [player name] also has valid concerns. We need to be careful of assumptions, but it seems it would be wise for us to keep an eye on the two of them from now on.
translation: 是的，很对，但[player name]的担忧也有道理。我们不能妄下结论，但从现在开始，我们最好留意他们两个。

english: Now, [player name], did your investigation uncover anything else?
translation: 那么，[player name]，你的调查还发现了别的吗？

english: The letter I found mentioned two things: Twilight's Promise and the Final Dawn.
translation: 我找到的信提到了两件事：暮光之约和最终黎明。

english: Twilight's Promise? I've never heard of that. I wonder if it has anything to do with the Twilight Emissaries...
translation: 暮光之约？我从没听说过。不知道和暮光使者有没有关系……

english: Twilight Emissaries?
translation: 暮光使者？

english: A nice religious cult that has an unhealthy obsession with the end of the world. They've never caused any major problems before, so we've mostly left them be.
translation: 一个不错的宗教崇拜，对世界末日有着不健康的痴迷。他们以前从没惹过什么大麻烦，所以我们基本没管他们。

english: However, given this revelation, perhaps it's time to pay a little closer attention to their dealings.
translation: 不过，鉴于这个新发现，也许是时候多留意一下他们的勾当了。

english: And the Final Dawn... What's that?
translation: 那最终黎明……是什么？

english: Nothing more than blasphemy! It is not something we should waste our time talking about.
translation: 不过是亵渎之言！不值得浪费时间讨论。

english: As you can see, the Final Dawn is a bit of a... controversial topic. It's a religious belief...
translation: 如你所见，最终黎明是个有点……争议的话题。它是一种宗教信仰……

english: An unofficial religious belief!
translation: 一种非官方的宗教信仰！

english: It's an unofficial religious belief concerning the end of the world. Oddly enough, our friends in the Twilight Emissaries are big fans of it.
translation: 它是一种关于世界末日的非官方宗教信仰。奇怪的是，我们在暮光使者的朋友们非常喜欢它。

english: Hmm... Where can I learn more about the Final Dawn?
translation: 嗯……我在哪里能了解更多关于最终黎明的事？

english: It's not something I care to know about, but if anyone around here were to know, it would be Metzli.
translation: 我不想知道这些，但如果这里有人知道，那一定是梅茨利。

english: The Sect of Ranul are responsible for maintaining the library here. That includes dealing with any forbidden materials.
translation: 拉努尔教派负责维护这里的图书馆。包括处理任何违禁材料。

english: Metzli returned to the Teomat shortly before we did. She'll be around here somewhere.
translation: 梅茨利在我们回来前不久回到了特奥马特修道院。她应该就在这附近。

english: Right, I'll go and see if she can help me.
translation: 好，我去看看她能不能帮我。

english: If you want to learn about the Final Dawn, Metzli would be the best person to speak to. She'll be around here somewhere.
translation: 如果你想了解最终黎明，梅茨利是最佳人选。她应该就在这附近。

english: Alright, I'll see if she can help me.
translation: 好，我去看看她能不能帮我。

english: We meet again. Not a chance encounter I see, for it is clear that you want something.
translation: 我们又见面了。我看这不是偶然相遇，因为你显然有事相求。

english: I was hoping you could help me with some information.
translation: 我希望你能帮我查点信息。

english: Quite possibly. The Sect of Ranul know better than most that time sees the end of all things. When we are gone, what remains? Knowledge must be passed on, lest it be lost forever.
translation: 很有可能。拉努尔的神官比大多数人更明白时间会终结一切。当我们离去后，还剩下什么？知识必须传承下去，以免永远失落。

english: Yes, what you're describing there is a book. I'm familiar with the concept.
translation: 是的，你描述的东西叫书。我懂这个概念。

english: But what is a book without the right reader? Words can be misunderstood, misconstrued. That assumes those words were even right to begin with.
translation: 但没有合适的读者，书又算什么？文字可能被误解、曲解。这还得假设那些文字一开始就是正确的。

english: Think of all that we believe to know. All those words we have read. How many were the truth, I wonder.
translation: 想想我们自以为了解的一切。所有我们读过的文字。我想知道，有多少是真相。

english: Okay, well before we go down another rabbit hole, I'm looking for information on the Final Dawn.
translation: 好吧，在我们深入另一个话题之前，我想找关于最终黎明的信息。

english: The Final Dawn? This is something I can help with, but first, to understand the Final Dawn, you must understand Ximoua.
translation: 最终黎明？这个我能帮忙，但首先，要理解最终黎明，你必须先理解西莫阿。

english: Ximoua? That's a fancy word.
translation: 西莫阿？好花哨的词。

english: The word is a gift to us from those who walked these lands before we did. They knew the truths of this world... in a way we can only dream of.
translation: 这个词是那些在我们之前行走这片土地的人留给我们的礼物。他们了解这个世界的真相……以我们只能梦想的方式。

english: We call them the Old Ones. They understood the importance of passing on their knowledge. So much of what we know, comes from them.
translation: 我们称他们为远古者。他们明白传承知识的重要性。我们所知的一切，很多都来自他们。

english: You speak of the Old Ones?
translation: 你说的是远古者？

english: Yes. They understood the importance of passing on their knowledge. So much of what we know, comes from them.
translation: 是的。他们明白传承知识的重要性。我们所知的一切，很多都来自他们。

english: Hmm... So what is Ximoua?
translation: 嗯……那西莫阿是什么？

english: Our world endures in a way we cannot comprehend, but like all things, it will not do so forever. Its light will one day die, but this is not something to be feared, it is something to be embraced.
translation: 我们的世界以一种我们无法理解的方式存续，但和所有事物一样，它不会永远如此。它的光芒终有一天会熄灭，但这并不可怕，而是值得拥抱的。

english: You see, we are part of a cycle. Something far larger than ourselves. When the time comes, Ralos and Ranul will come together as one, consuming these lands in holy fire, until there is nothing left but ash.
translation: 你看，我们是循环的一部分。一个远比我们自身宏大的循环。当那一刻到来，拉洛斯和拉努尔将合二为一，用圣火吞噬这片土地，直到只剩下灰烬。

english: But even in ash, embers remain. From those embers, a new world will be born, and the cycle will continue once more. This is Ximoua.
translation: 但即使在灰烬中，也残留着余烬。从那些余烬中，一个新世界将会诞生，循环再次继续。这就是 Ximoua。

english: So you think the world will one day end? That's quite something.
translation: 所以你认为世界终有一天会终结？这倒是挺特别的。

english: Not think. Know. This knowledge is a gift. One that was passed down to us from the Old Ones.
translation: 不是认为，是知道。这份知识是礼物，是从远古者那里传给我们的。

english: But you said it yourself: Knowledge passed down can be misconstrued. How can anyone know the truth for sure? It's not like there are any of these Old Ones around for us to ask.
translation: 但你自己也说了：流传下来的知识可能会被曲解。谁能确定真相呢？我们又不能直接去问那些远古者。
