english: Indeed, and that is why this is just one interpretation. There are those out there with another: Tsak Tauli, the Final Dawn.
translation: 确实，所以这只是一个解读。外面还有另一种解读：Tsak Tauli，最终黎明。

english: And what do they believe?
translation: 他们相信什么？

english: They do not just believe that the world will end. They believe it is their duty to make it happen. They see it as their singular purpose, and will stop at nothing to make it so.
translation: 他们不只相信世界会终结，还相信促成终结是他们的责任。他们视此为唯一的使命，会不惜一切代价去实现。

english: These people... You speak of the Twilight Emissaries?
translation: 这些人……你说的是暮光使者？

english: It is said that they are amongst those with this belief.
translation: 据说他们正是持有这种信仰的人之一。

english: I guess I'd better...
translation: 我想我最好……

english: [player name]! I need you outside, now! We have a little bit of an issue!
translation: [player name]！我需要你到外面来，现在！出了点小状况！

english: What happened?!
translation: 发生什么事了？！

english: I'm sorry, my Prince, but we're not sure. None of the attackers made it inside, but Metzli has disappeared.
translation: 抱歉，王子殿下，我们也不确定。没有一个袭击者闯进来，但 Metzli 不见了。

english: Metzli? Surely not...
translation: Metzli？这不可能……

english: Thankfully the blade missed his heart, but we should get him to the capital as soon as possible.
translation: 幸好刀片没刺中他的心脏，但我们应该尽快送他去都城。

english: Yes, of course. Ensure no time is wasted.
translation: 是的，当然。别浪费时间。

english: Of course, my Prince. We'll go at once.
translation: 明白，王子殿下。我们马上出发。

english: Well... this has been a bit of a mess.
translation: 唉……这真是搞得一团糟。

english: Word has been sent to mother about what happened here. While we wait to hear back from her, I've already been thinking about a potential plan for how we might go about dealing with our cultist problem.
translation: 我已经派人把这里发生的事禀报母亲了。在等她回复的时候，我一直在考虑一个可能解决邪教徒问题的计划。

english: However, let's not worry about that just now. Instead, I wanted to thank you for all that you've done. You may be an outsider, but you've already proven yourself to be a true friend to Varlamore. Thank you, iknami.
translation: 不过，我们先别担心这个。我想感谢你所做的一切。你虽然是个外人，但已经证明了自己是瓦拉莫尔内真正的朋友。谢谢你，iknami。

english: So what's this plan you mentioned?
translation: 那你说的计划是什么？

english: You want to hear it already? I'd have thought you might have wanted a bit of a break from all the excitement, iknami.
translation: 你想现在就听？我还以为你可能想从这些刺激事里缓口气呢，iknami。

english: Fair point. I'll be back once I'm ready.
translation: 说得对。我准备好了再回来。

english: I'll be here, [player name].
translation: 我在这儿等着，[player name]。

english: I've sent word to mother about what happened here, but I've not heard back yet. Once I have, I'll start planning our next move.
translation: 我已经派人把这里发生的事禀报母亲了，但还没有回音。一有消息，我就开始计划下一步行动。

english: Don't worry, I'll be in touch soon enough. Until then, timoiva, and may the sun light your way.
translation: 别担心，我会很快联系你的。在那之前，timoiva，愿阳光照亮你的道路。

english: Unfortunately, the pass is a treacherous place. Some of my best soldiers have fallen trying to find a way though.
translation: 不幸的是，地下通道是个险恶的地方。我最精锐的士兵有些在试图找路时牺牲了。

english: To make matters worse, some crazed group of cultists has recently made their home in the pass. Their leader, some madman named Iban, claims to be the son of Zamorak himself.
translation: 更糟的是，一群疯狂的邪教徒最近在通道里安了家。他们的首领是个叫伊班的疯子，自称是萨摩拉克之子。

english: Well that doesn't sound good. So what do you need from me?
translation: 听起来可不太妙。那你需要我做什么？

english: If my brother is to be stopped, a way through the Underground Pass must be found. This is the task I have for you. Do you think you're up for it?
translation: 要想阻止我的兄弟，必须找到一条穿过地下通道的路。这就是我要交给你的任务。你觉得你能胜任吗？

english: There's only one way to find out. Where do I start?
translation: 只有一种方法能知道。我从哪里开始？

english: You'll find the entrance to the Underground Pass at the far end of West Ardougne. My main tracker, Koftik, will meet you there.
translation: 你会在西阿多尼城的尽头找到地下通道的入口。我的首席追踪者科夫蒂克会在那里与你碰头。

english: Together, you are to find a way through the pass. Once you have done so, return to me.
translation: 你们要一起找到穿过通道的路。完成后就回来见我。

english: Remember, the Underground Pass is lethal. Go prepared with food and armour or you won't last long.
translation: 记住，地下通道非常致命。带上食物和盔甲再去，否则你撑不了多久。

english: It sounds too dangerous for me. I'd better prepare more first.
translation: 听起来太危险了。我还是先多准备一下吧。

english: Very well. Return to me when you are ready.
translation: 很好。准备好了就回来找我。

english: And to you adventurer. Have you found a way through the Underground Pass yet?
translation: 也向你问好，冒险者。你找到穿过地下通道的路了吗？

english: Well keep at it. Come to me when you have something to report.
translation: 继续加油吧。有消息了就来见我。

english: Hello there, you must be Koftik.
translation: 你好，你一定是科夫蒂克了。

english: That I am adventurer. King Lathas told me to expect you. I assume he has told you our goal?
translation: 正是在下，冒险者。拉萨斯国王告诉我你会来。他应该已经跟你们说过我们的目标了吧？

english: He said we need to find a way through the Underground Pass. Shouldn't be too bad, I've travelled through many a cave in my time.
translation: 他说我们需要找到一条穿过地下通道的路。应该不会太糟，我这辈子走过不少洞穴。

english: These caves are different... There is a darkness in there unlike any other. You can feel it as you wind your way round the stalagmites... an icy chill that penetrates the very fabric of your being...
translation: 这些洞穴不一样……那里有一种与众不同的黑暗。当你绕过石笋时能感觉到它……一种刺骨的寒意穿透你的织物……

english: You've been in before?
translation: 你以前进去过？

english: I have. I didn't go far though, nor did I stay for long. People change in these caves...
translation: 进去过。不过我没走多远，也没待多久。人在这些洞穴里会变……

english: I'll take my chances.
translation: 我愿意赌一把。

english: Okay traveller, I'll catch up with you by the bridge.
translation: 好吧，旅者，我在桥那边等你。

english: Tell me more...
translation: 再多说一些……

english: I remember one warrior. His name was Randas. He stood tall and proud like an elven king...
translation: 我记得一个战士。他叫兰达斯。他站得高大骄傲，像精灵国王一样……

english: That same pride made him vulnerable. Randas' worthy desire to be a great and mighty warrior also made him corruptible.
translation: 同样的骄傲让他变得脆弱。兰达斯渴望成为一个伟大而强大的战士，这一本该可敬的愿望也让他容易堕落。

english: Within the cave, he heard the voice of Zamorak himself...
translation: 在洞穴里，他听到了萨莫拉克本人的声音……

english: Zamorak showed him a way to achieve his goals by appealing to that most base and dark nature... One that resides in all of us.
translation: 萨莫拉克通过激发他内心最底层、最黑暗的本性——我们每个人都有的那种本性——向他展示了一条实现目标的道路。

english: What happened to him?
translation: 他后来怎么样了？

english: No one knows...
translation: 没人知道……

english: Anyway, head on in when you're ready. You'll soon come to a bridge, I will catch up with you there.
translation: 总之，准备好了就进去吧。你很快就会遇到一座桥，我会在那里追上你。

english: Hi Koftik.
translation: 嗨，科夫蒂克。

english: Hello adventurer. We seem to have a bit of an issue ahead of us. The bridge is up and I can't see another way across.
translation: 你好，冒险者。我们前面好像有点麻烦。桥升起来了，我找不到别的路过去。

english: Do you not know how to get the bridge down?
translation: 你不知道怎么把桥放下来吗？

english: I'm afraid not. This is the furthest I've ever been. It does look like someone was here before us though, there's the remains of a camp.
translation: 恐怕不知道。这是我到过最远的地方。不过看起来之前有人来过，那里有营地的遗骸。

english: I had a look through their things and found some cloth along with the charred remains of some arrows.
translation: 我翻看了一下他们的东西，找到了一些布料和一些烧焦的箭的遗骸。

english: Charred arrows? They must have been trying to burn something. Or someone!
translation: 烧焦的箭矢？他们一定是在试着烧什么东西。或者什么人！

english: There's plenty more cloth by the fire. I also found the remains of a book...
translation: 火堆旁还有更多布料。我还找到了一本书的遗骸……

english: Probably just litter.
translation: 大概只是垃圾吧。

english: Well... maybe?
translation: 嗯……也许吧？

english: It seems to be written by the adventurer Randas. Have a look.
translation: 看起来是冒险者兰达斯写的。你看看。

english: Hello adventurer. I'll catch up with you further on. Have a look by the fire if you need more cloth.
translation: 你好，冒险者。我待会儿再去找你。如果你需要更多布料，去火堆旁看看。

english: Join us...
translation: 加入我们……

english: Death is only the beginning...
translation: 死亡只是开始……

english: I will release you...
translation: 我会释放你……

english: I'll swallow your soul...
translation: 我会吞噬你的灵魂……

english: I can set you free...
translation: 我能让你自由……

english: Blood... Pain... Hate...
translation: 血……痛苦……仇恨……

english: You can't hide...
translation: 你躲不掉……

english: Give in to your desires...
translation: 屈服于你的欲望……

english: The power of the gods could be yours...
translation: 神的力量可能属于你……

english: Hear me...
translation: 听我说……

english: Make them all pay...
translation: 让他们都付出代价……

english: Kill... Maim... Murder...
translation: 杀戮……残害……谋杀……

english: Do you hear them? The voices tell me things.
translation: 你听到了吗？那些声音告诉我一些事。

english: The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by the iniquities of the selfish and the tyranny of evil men.
translation: 义人的道路四面八方皆被自私者的不义和恶人的暴虐所包围。

english: Tyranny of the righteous? What?
translation: 义人的暴虐？什么？

english: So many paths to choose... Here we must all take our own path.
translation: 这么多条路可选……在这里我们都必须走自己的路。

english: Eating me... they keep eating me! Eating me from the inside! Please stop them! I can feel them wriggling around inside me right now... please stop them!
translation: 吃我……它们一直在吃我！从里面吃我！求求你阻止它们！我现在就能感觉到它们在我体内蠕动……求求你阻止它们！

english: Blood, blood... never enough blood to go round. When I lift up my arm like this, it all pours back into my body.
translation: 血，血……永远没有足够的血来流通。当我像这样抬起手臂时，所有的血都会流回我的身体。

english: I hope it remembers to go back inside my arm. And don't even ask me about my legs... how much blood are they going to need?
translation: 我希望它记得回到我的手臂里。至于我的腿……就别提了，它们需要多少血？

english: Blood is important. We must offer it to Zamorak every day as proof of our devotion. I just hope I don't run out!
translation: 血很重要。我们必须每天献祭给萨莫拉克，作为我们虔诚的证明。我只希望我不会用完！

english: Oh yes, you're a fine one. Nice red cheeks, shiny hair.
translation: 哦，是啊，你挺不错的。红润的脸颊，闪亮的头发。

english: Let's see now, some potatoes, some cabbage... Maybe half a clove of garlic...
translation: 让我看看，一些土豆，一点卷心菜……也许半瓣大蒜……

english: Yes I think you'd make a fine soup. You don't mind do you?
translation: 是啊，我觉得你会做成不错的汤。你不介意吧？

english: Actually I do.
translation: 其实我介意。

english: You're welcome to have some with me of course...
translation: 当然，你也可以跟我一起喝点……

english: Sorry, I don't under..
translation: 抱歉，我没听……

english: Kill the villagers, burn them all... every last one! I want nothing to survive... nothing but the sweet smell of burning flesh...
translation: 杀了那些村民，把他们全部烧死……一个不留！我不想有任何东西活下来……除了那甜美的皮肉烧焦的气味……

english: You're ill!
translation: 你病了！

english: What's that? You've never smelt it before? Well, let's just say that it's an acquired taste...
translation: 什么？你以前从没闻过？这么说吧，这是一种后天培养的品味……

english: Danger, everywhere danger! But not from man nor beast! This is the danger that is inside you.
translation: 危险，到处都是危险！但这危险既不是来自人也不是来自野兽！这是你内心的危险。

english: Bring it out, nurture it, cherish it. Stroke it like you would stroke a wounded bird... then strangle it before it takes hold of your very being. Don't say I didn't warn you.
translation: 把它引出来，滋养它，珍惜它。像抚摸受伤的鸟一样抚摸它……然后在它掌控你的存在之前勒死它。别说我没警告你。

english: What's that... Is that a dagger I see before me? Why should I bear the slings and arrows of outrageous fortune.
translation: 那是什么……我面前看到的是把匕首吗？我为什么要忍受这狂暴命运的投石和箭矢。

english: For what is a man but this quintessence of dust? And so I say goodnight sweet prince. The rest is silence.
translation: 人不过是这尘埃的精华，又算什么呢？所以我要说，晚安，亲爱的王子。余下的只有沉默。

english: The voices, they've been telling me things...
translation: 那些声音……它们一直在告诉我一些事……

english: Koftik, is everything okay? You're getting me worried.
translation: 科夫蒂克，你还好吗？你让我担心了。

english: Don't be friend. Anyway, do you know the definition of insanity?
translation: 别担心，朋友。话说，你知道疯癫的定义吗？

english: Err... what?
translation: 呃……什么？

english: The definition of insanity is doing the same thing over and over, expecting things to change.
translation: 疯癫的定义就是一遍又一遍做同样的事，却期待事情会改变。

english: I spent years doing the same thing, day in and day out. I always wanted more but I never got it. Now, I finally see why...
translation: 我年复一年做着同样的事，日复一日。我总想要更多，却从未得到。现在，我终于明白为什么了……

english: You see, once I was insane. But now... now I am finally free...
translation: 你看，我曾经疯癫。但现在……现在我终于自由了……

english: It's too heavy to move with just my hands.
translation: 光靠我的双手搬不动，太重了。

english: Hello Paladin. I wasn't expecting to see anyone else down here.
translation: 你好，圣骑士。没想到在这下面还能见到其他人。

english: Nor were we traveller. What are you doing in this most unholy place?
translation: 我们也没想到，旅者。你在这个最不圣洁的地方做什么？

english: I'm looking for a safe route through these caverns, under order of King Lathas.
translation: 我奉拉萨斯国王之命，寻找一条穿过这些洞穴的安全路线。

english: Ah, the king tasked us with the same mission. Alas, a little further on lies the great doors of Iban. We've tried everything, but we cannot enter.
translation: 啊，国王也给了我们同样的任务。可惜再往前一点就是伊班的巨门了。我们试了所有办法，但进不去。

english: Anyway, you've done well to get this far traveller. Here eat...
translation: 总之，你能走到这里已经很不容易了，旅者。来，吃点东西……

english: Great, thanks a lot.
translation: 太好了，非常感谢。

english: Hello again traveller. You should consider leaving this place. Let us handle things here.
translation: 又见面了，旅者。你该考虑离开这里了。让我们来处理这边的事。

english: Ah, you've arrived. We've been waiting for you.
translation: 啊，你来了。我们一直在等你。

english: Koftik, you're still here? You should leave.
translation: 科夫蒂克，你还在这里？你应该离开。

english: Leave? But this is my home now. Home with my lord. He talks to me, he's my friend.
translation: 离开？但这里现在是我的家了。和我主人在的家。他跟我说话，他是我的朋友。

english: Koftik, you really should leave these caverns.
translation: 科夫蒂克，你真的应该离开这些洞穴。

english: Not now, we're all the same down here. There's just you and those dwarves left.
translation: 现在不行，这里我们都是一伙的。只剩下你和那些矮人了。

english: Dwarves?
translation: 矮人？

english: Foolish dwarves, still believing that they can resist. No one resists Iban.
translation: 愚蠢的矮人，还以为他们能抵抗。没有人能抵抗伊班。

english: You could help! Deep down you know you want it! I know you already dealt with those Paladins. Now you just need to kill the dwarves!
translation: 你可以帮忙！内心深处你知道你想要！我知道你已经解决了那些圣骑士。现在你只需要杀掉矮人！

english: Head south and through the tunnel. You'll find the dwarves at the other end. Go slay them. Slay them for our lord!
translation: 往南走，穿过隧道。你会在另一头找到矮人。去杀了他们。为了我们的主人杀了他们！

english: Nice job killing those Paladins. You're much closer to his side now. Perhaps you could kill those dwarves as well. That would really please him.
translation: 干得好，杀了那些圣骑士。你现在离他的身边更近了。也许你也可以杀掉那些矮人。那会让他非常高兴。

english: An impostor... Die, scum!
translation: 冒牌货……去死吧，渣滓！

english: Iban is our father, our guide. Soon he will rule all life.
translation: 伊班是我们的父亲，我们的指引者。他很快将统治所有生命。

english: Hail the great one, my lord Iban. I die for you again and again.
translation: 赞美伟大的那位，我的主人伊班。我一次又一次为你而死。

english: Is that possible?
translation: 这有可能吗？

english: Under Iban anything is possible. Death is only the beginning.
translation: 在伊班面前，一切皆有可能。死亡只是开始。

english: Succumb to the might of Iban, the ruler of this world.
translation: 臣服于伊班的力量吧，他是这个世界的主宰。

english: Back away! Back away! Wait... you're human!
translation: 退后！退后！等等……你是人类！

english: Well good luck with that. We came here as miners, completely unaware of the evil that lurked here. There's no way through, not while Iban still rules. He controls the gateway, the only way to the other side.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运。我们是以矿工的身份来到这里的，完全不知道这里潜伏的邪恶。没有路可以通过，只要伊班还在统治。他控制着通道，那是通往另一边的唯一途径。

english: What gateway?
translation: 什么通道？

english: The Well of Voyage. It acts as a portal through the last section of the caverns. It's the only way into the west. Iban has corrupted it though. Now he uses it to dispose of those who displease him.
translation: 航行之井。它充当着通往洞穴最后一段的传送门。那是进入西边的唯一途径。不过伊班已经腐化了它。现在他用它来处置那些让他不满的人。

english: Well I'll just have to kill him then.
translation: 那我只好杀了他。

english: Ha! Good luck with that. If we knew how, we'd have slain him already.
translation: 哈！祝你好运。要是我们知道方法，早就把他干掉了。

english: Seek out the witch, his guide, his only confidante. Only she knows how to rid us of Iban.
translation: 去找那个女巫，他的向导，他唯一的知己。只有她知道如何除掉伊班。

english: She lives on the platforms above, we dare not go there.
translation: 她住在上面的平台上，我们不敢去那里。

english: You're brave to come to this place. Not many survive down here.
translation: 你敢来这个地方，真是勇敢。没多少人能在这里活下来。

english: As I can see.
translation: 我看得出来。

english: Don't stay too long traveller. Iban's calls will soon penetrate your delicate human mind.
translation: 别待太久，旅者。伊班的召唤很快就会穿透你脆弱的人类心智。

english: You'll also become one of his minions... You must go and find the witch Kardia. She holds the secret to Iban's destruction. She lives on the platforms above.
translation: 你也会成为他的爪牙之一……你必须去找女巫卡迪亚。她掌握着毁灭伊班的秘密。她住在上面的平台上。

english: Ha ha! I warned you that it's strong stuff. Have a good meal. It may sober you up a bit.
translation: 哈哈！我警告过你这东西很烈。好好吃一顿吧。也许能让你清醒一点。

english: Well maybe a good meal? I've got some spare.
translation: 嗯，也许吃顿好的？我有多余的。

english: Thanks. Enjoy your brew.
translation: 谢谢。享用你的酒酿吧。

english: Oh I will.
translation: 哦，我会的。

english: Hello my good man.
translation: 你好啊，我的好人。

english: Good day to you outsider. You should be careful down here. We're the only ones that haven't yet turned.
translation: 日安，外来者。你在这里要小心。我们是仅剩的还没堕落的人。

english: If you're not careful you'll become one of them too!
translation: 如果你不小心，你也会变成他们中的一员！

english: Who? Iban's followers?
translation: 谁？伊班的追随者？

english: They're not followers, they're slaves, they're the soulless...
translation: 他们不是追随者，他们是奴隶，是无魂者……

english: They were normal once, adventurers, treasure hunters. But men are weak, they couldn't ignore the voices.
translation: 他们曾经也是正常人，冒险者，宝藏猎人。但人类是软弱的，他们无法忽视那些声音。

english: Now they all seem to think with one conscience... As if they're being controlled by one being...
translation: 现在他们似乎都用一个意识思考……好像被一个存在控制着……

english: Iban?
translation: 伊班？

english: Maybe... maybe Zamorak himself. Those who try and fight it are locked in cages, until their minds are too weak to resist.
translation: 也许……也许是萨莫拉克本人。那些试图反抗的人会被关进笼子，直到他们的心智虚弱到无法抵抗。

english: Eventually they all fall to his control...
translation: 最终他们都会落入他的掌控……

english: Anyway, I have something that might help you. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.
translation: 总之，我有样东西可能对你有帮助。我做了这些来保护自己免受无魂者的牙齿伤害，他们的咬伤很恶毒。

english: I haven't seen another pair which can withstand their jaws...
translation: 我还没见过另一双能抵挡他们下颚的……

english: No problem traveller. Good luck.
translation: 没问题，旅者。祝你好运。

english: No wonder their breath is so bad!
translation: 难怪他们的口气这么臭！

english: You think this is funny... Eh?
translation: 你觉得这很好笑……嗯？

english: Not really, just trying to lighten up the conversation.
translation: 也不是，只是想缓和一下气氛。

english: Hi Klank.
translation: 嗨，克兰克。

english: Traveller, I hear you plan to destroy Iban?
translation: 旅者，我听说你计划摧毁伊班？

english: I have a gift for you, they may help. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.
translation: 我有一份礼物给你，它们可能有用。我做了这些来保护自己免受无魂者的牙齿伤害，他们的咬伤很恶毒。

english: Thanks Klank.
translation: 谢谢，克兰克。

english: Good luck traveller, give Iban a slap for me!
translation: 祝你好运，旅者，替我扇伊班一巴掌！

english: Blast them dwarves! We need to deal with them!
translation: 该死的矮人！我们得对付他们！

english: Here kitty, kitty!
translation: 小猫咪，小猫咪！

english: That witch probably won't take kindly to me going in there. Maybe I can distract her...
translation: 那个女巫可能不会乐意我进去。也许我可以分散她的注意力……

english: Sssss! Thou art brave to wander so far into the domain of Kardia, mine mistress!
translation: 嘶嘶嘶！你竟敢如此深入卡迪亚，我女主人的领地！

english: But soon thou shalt become a soulless servant of Lord Iban, like all who come here.
translation: 但很快你就会像所有来到这里的人一样，成为伊班领主的无魂者仆从。

english: Glad shall mine heart be when I see thee prostrate thineself before the altars of Zamorak the Mighty.
translation: 当我看到你匍匐在 mighty 萨莫拉克的祭坛前时，我的心将无比喜悦。

english: No milk for you, puss!
translation: 没奶给你喝，猫咪！

english: And...?
translation: 然后呢……？

english: I found a strange doll, but I've lost it.
translation: 我找到了一个奇怪的玩偶，但我弄丢了。

english: I've heard about these dolls. This here be dark magic traveller. They say the witch resurrected Iban from death. She must have used this doll to do it.
translation: 我听说过这些玩偶。这是黑暗魔法，旅者。他们说女巫用这个玩偶让伊班从死亡中复活。

english: If this doll created Iban, it can also be his end. Find out what process the witch used to revive him and reverse it. Once that's done, cast it into the Well of Voyage. Iban will be destroyed with it.
translation: 如果这个玩偶创造了伊班，它也能终结他。找出女巫用来复活他的方法，然后逆转它。一旦完成，就把它扔进航行之井。伊班将随之毁灭。

english: Where is the well?
translation: 井在哪里？

english: On the platforms above. Within Iban's foul temple.
translation: 在上面的平台上。在伊班那肮脏的神庙里。

english: I found this old book as well. It seems to detail how Iban was resurrected. It might hold the information you need to destroy him.
translation: 我还找到了这本旧书。它似乎详细记载了伊班是如何被复活的。里面可能有你需要用来摧毁他的信息。

english: I found this old book by the way. It seems to detail how Iban was resurrected. It might hold the information you need to destroy him.
translation: 顺便一提，我找到了这本旧书。它似乎详细记载了伊班是如何被复活的。里面可能有你需要用来摧毁他的信息。

english: Thanks Niloof.
translation: 谢谢，尼鲁夫。

english: Niloof, I found the witch's house.
translation: 尼鲁夫，我找到女巫的房子了。

english: I found a strange doll.
translation: 我找到了一个奇怪的玩偶。

english: Ah, I've heard about these dolls. This here be dark magic traveller. They say the witch resurrected Iban from death. She must have used this doll to do it.
translation: 啊，我听说过这些玩偶。这是黑暗魔法，旅者。他们说女巫用这个玩偶让伊班从死亡中复活。

english: Kuluf Ali Monopiate!
translation: 库鲁夫.阿里.莫诺皮亚特！

english: The doll? You mean to destroy Iban? No! I am the son of Zamorak! I can't die! And you... You are his slave now! Even if you kill me you will hear his calls forever! You have already fallen!
translation: 玩偶？你想摧毁伊班？不！我是萨莫拉克之子！我是不死的！而你……你现在是他的奴隶了！即使你杀了我，你也会永远听到他的召唤！你已经堕落了！

english: You dare to defy me?
translation: 你竟敢违抗我？

english: I've still a few years in me yet.
translation: 我还能再活几年呢。

english: I found something I think you need traveller...
translation: 我找到了样东西，我想你需要它，旅者……

english: The doll?
translation: 玩偶？

english: I found it while slaying some of the soulless. Here you go.
translation: 我在杀死一些无魂者时找到的。给你。

english: Good luck to you, you'll need it.
translation: 祝你好运，你会需要的。

english: Take care Niloof.
translation: 保重，尼鲁夫。

english: I am the great Iban, I cannot die!
translation: 我是伟大的伊班，我是不死的！

english: You will die, frail mortal!
translation: 你会死的，脆弱的凡人！

english: Fool!
translation: 蠢货！

english: I'll swallow your soul!
translation: 我要吞噬你的灵魂！

english: You belong in the slave pits!
translation: 你属于奴隶坑！

english: Begone from my temple!
translation: 滚出我的神庙！

english: Adventurer, where am I? I can't remember a thing!
translation: 冒险者，我在哪里？我什么都不记得了！

english: We were losing you to Iban's influence...
translation: 你差点被伊班的影响吞噬……

english: What? Of course, the voices... But they've stopped. What happened?
translation: 什么？当然，那些声音……但它们停了。发生了什么？

english: Iban's dead, I destroyed him.
translation: 伊班死了，我摧毁了他。

english: You've done well! Thank you for saving me.
translation: 你做得很好！谢谢你救了我。

english: But what about you, adventurer? Did the voices not affect you?
translation: 那你呢，冒险者？那些声音没有影响你吗？

english: I... I don't think so...
translation: 我……我想没有……

english: I see. Well we must now inform the king. Follow me, I'll lead you out.
translation: 我明白了。好吧，我们现在必须通知国王。跟我来，我带你出去。

english: At last! I've had enough of these caves.
translation: 终于！我受够这些洞穴了。

english: Thanks for showing me the way out Koftik.
translation: 谢谢你带我出来，科夫蒂克。

english: Always a pleasure. Have you informed the king about Iban?
translation: 不客气。你通知国王关于伊班的事了吗？

english: This is no time to linger. The King must know that Iban is dead. This is a truly historical moment for Ardougne.
translation: 现在不是逗留的时候。国王必须知道伊班已死。这对阿多尼城来说是一个真正具有历史意义的时刻。

english: The adventurer returns, any news?
translation: 冒险者回来了，有什么消息吗？

english: Indeed, the quest is complete. I have defeated Iban and his minions.
translation: 是的，任务完成了。我已经击败了伊班和他的爪牙。

english: Incredible, you are a true warrior. So do we now have a way through to the west?
translation: 难以置信，你是个真正的战士。那么我们现在有路通往西边了吗？

english: Not quite. The portal through the last section of the pass has been damaged. It will need repairing.
translation: 还没有。通往通道最后一段的传送门被损坏了。需要修复。

english: I see. I will send our best mages in at once. Once they have made the repairs, we will finally be ready to stop King Tyras.
translation: 我明白了。我会立刻派我们最好的法师过去。一旦他们完成修复，我们终于可以准备好阻止泰拉斯国王了。

english: For now, I thank you for your help adventurer. Your loyalty is an inspiration to all.
translation: 现在，我感谢你的帮助，冒险者。你的忠诚激励着所有人。

english: So how long do you think the repairs will take?
translation: 那你觉得修复需要多长时间？

english: It shouldn't take the mages long at all. Once their work is done we will finally be ready to move against my brother.
translation: 法师们应该花不了多长时间。一旦他们的工作完成，我们终于可以准备好对付我的兄弟了。

english: Elves? I've never seen an elf before.
translation: 精灵？我从未见过精灵。

english: You are to head into the Underground Pass and through the Well of Voyage. The mages should have it repaired by the time you arrive.
translation: 你要进入地下通道，穿过航行之井。你到达时，法师们应该已经修好了。

english: Once you are through, you will be met by some representatives of Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 一旦你通过，伊尔沃斯领主的一些代表会来接应你。

english: The Dark Lord agreed to spare his life, but only on one condition... That he would drink from the Chalice of Eternity. The chalice corrupted him. He joined forces with the Dark Lord, the embodiment of pure evil...
translation: 黑暗领主同意饶他一命，但只有一个条件……他必须喝下永恒圣杯。圣杯腐化了他。他与黑暗领主，纯粹邪恶的化身，联手了……

english: But now we're ready to stop him.
translation: 但现在我们准备好阻止他了。

english: Good day my liege. Any progress with the Well of Voyage?
translation: 日安，陛下。航行之井有进展吗？

english: You again... die Zamorakian scum!
translation: 又是你……去死吧，萨莫拉克的渣滓！

english: How are you doing with the quest?
translation: 任务进行得怎么样了？

english: Please hurry! Every day we live in fear that we will be the vampyre's next victim!
translation: 请快点！我们每天都活在恐惧中，生怕成为吸血鬼的下一个受害者！

english: Our little village has been dreadfully ravaged by an evil vampire! He lives in the basement of the manor to the north, we need someone to get rid of him once and for all!
translation: 我们的小村庄被一个邪恶的吸血鬼糟蹋得不像样了！他住在北边庄园的地下室，我们需要有人彻底除掉他！

english: I think first you should seek help. I have a friend who is a retired vampire hunter, his name is Dr. Harlow. He may be able to give you some tips. He can normally be found in the Blue Moon Inn in Varrock, he's a bit of
translation: 我觉得你应该先找些帮助。我有个朋友是退休的吸血鬼猎人，他叫哈洛博士。他可能会给你一些建议。他通常可以在维洛克城的蓝月旅馆找到，他现在有点

english: an old soak these days. Mention his old friend Morgan, I'm sure he wouldn't want me killed by a vampire.
translation: 老酒鬼了。提起他的老朋友摩根，我相信他不会想让我被吸血鬼杀死的。

english: Please hurry! Every day we live in fear that we the vampire's next victim!
translation: 请快点！我们每天都在恐惧中，生怕成为吸血鬼的下一个受害者！

english: No, you've had enough.
translation: 不，你喝得够多了。

english: Morgan needs your help!
translation: 摩根需要你的帮助！

english: Morgan you shhay..?
translation: 摩根你嗦……？

english: His village is being terrorised by a vampyre! He told me to ask you about how I can stop it.
translation: 他的村庄正被一个吸血鬼恐吓！他让我来问你怎样才能阻止它。

english: Buy me a beer... then I'll teash you what you need to know...
translation: 给我买杯啤酒……我就告诉你需要知道的事……

english: But this is your friend Morgan we're talking about!
translation: 但我们说的是你的朋友摩根啊！

english: Buy ush a drink anyway...
translation: 还是给窝买杯喝的吧……

english: I'll just go and buy one.
translation: 我这就去买一杯。

english: Cheersh matey...
translation: 谢了伙计……

english: So tell me how to kill vampyres then.
translation: 那告诉我怎么杀吸血鬼吧。

english: Yesh Yesh vampyres, I was very good at killing em once...
translation: 是的是的吸血鬼，我曾经很擅长杀它们……

english: Don't forget to take your stake with you, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off... I'd give you a stake but you've got one in your inventory.
translation: 别忘了带上你的木桩，否则他会再生。是的，你必须用木桩才能彻底杀死他……我本想给你一个木桩，但你背包里已经有一个了。

english: Don't forget to take your stake with you, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off... I'd give you a stake but you've already got one stored somewhere.
translation: 别忘了带上你的木桩，否则他会再生。是的，你必须用木桩才能彻底杀死他……我本想给你一个木桩，但你已经在某处存了一个了。

english: Well, you're going to need a stake, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off... I just happen to have one with me.
translation: 嗯，你需要一个木桩，否则他会再生。是的，你必须用木桩才能彻底杀死他……我正好随身带了一个。

english: You'll need a hammer as well, to drive it in properly, your everyday general store hammer will do. One last thing... It's wise to carry garlic with you, vampyres are somewhat weakened if they can smell garlic. Morgan
translation: 你还需要一把锤子，才能把它钉进去，随便一把杂货店的锤子就行。最后一件事……最好随身带些大蒜，吸血鬼闻到蒜味会变弱。摩根

english: always liked garlic, you should try his house. But remember, a vampyre is still a dangerous foe!
translation: 一直很喜欢大蒜，你应该去他家看看。但记住，吸血鬼仍然是个危险的敌人！

english: Buy me a drrink pleassh.
translation: 给我买杯酒……求求你了。

english: You'll need a hammer as well, to drive it in properly, your everyday general store hammer will do. One last thing... It's wise to carry garlic with you, vampires are somewhat weakend if they can smell garlic. Morgan
translation: 你还需要一把锤子，才能把它钉牢，普通杂货店的锤子就行。最后一件事……随身带点大蒜是明智的，吸血鬼闻到大蒜会变弱。摩根

english: Yesh Yesh vampires, I was very good at killing em once...
translation: 是的是的，吸血鬼，我以前很会杀它们……

english: Well you're gonna to need a stake, otherwise he'll just regenerate. Yes, you must have a stake to finish it off.. I just happen to have one with me.
translation: 嗯，你需要一根木桩，否则他会再生。没错，你必须用木桩才能结果他……我正好随身带着一根。

english: alwys liked garlic, you should try his house. But remember, a vampire is still a dangerous foe!
translation: 我一向喜欢大蒜，你应该去他的房子里试试。但记住，吸血鬼仍然是危险的敌人！

english: What ho, [sirrah/milady]. Jolly good show on the old training grounds thingy, what?
translation: 喂，[sirrah/milady]。你在训练场表现不错嘛，对吧？

english: So Tiffy, now that I'm a Temple Knight Initiate do you have any jobs for me to do?
translation: 那么蒂菲，既然我已经是圣殿骑士见习生了，有什么任务给我吗？

english: Do you have any quests for a hard-working adventurer?
translation: 有没有什么任务给一个勤劳的冒险者？

english: Well old [boy/gal/bean], looking at the old dossier we have on you here there seems to be a tiny problem, what?
translation: 哎呀，老[boy/gal/bean]，我看了看你的档案，好像有个小问题，对吧？

english: Problem? What problem? Er... and you have a dossier on me???
translation: 问题？什么问题？呃……你们还有我的档案？？？

english: Well OF COURSE we have a dossier on you! We have a dossier on EVERYONE! It's our job, dontchaknow!
translation: 当然了！我们每个人都有档案！这是我们的工作，你懂的！

english: Um... okay... So what's the problem?
translation: 嗯……好吧……那问题是什么？

english: Well now, seems we made a tiny blunder when we first contacted you to join the Temple Knights, what?
translation: 是这样的，我们第一次联系你加入圣殿骑士时犯了个小错，对吧？

english: Entirely our own fault, could have been avoided and all that, but a bit of a show-stopper, what?
translation: 完全是我们的错，本来可以避免的，但这确实是个大麻烦，对吧？

english: Well [lad/lass], here's the thing: Only members of the White Knights may join the Temple Knights. By ancient decree, dontchaknow.
translation: 听着[lad/lass]，事情是这样的：只有白骑士成员才能加入圣殿骑士。这是古老的规定，你懂的。

english: What? But I am a member of the White Knights! I went and did that stuff with the cabbage and the potion!
translation: 什么？但我已经是白骑士成员了！我完成了那个卷心菜和药水的任务！

english: And I've already done your stupid little mind test thing! You can't get rid of me that easily!
translation: 而且我已经通过了你们那个愚蠢的小测试！别想这么容易就把我打发走！

english: Calm yourself down [lad/lass]... We have no intention of 'getting rid of you', we are very keen on seeing you join us...
translation: 冷静点[lad/lass]……我们没打算“打发你走”，我们非常希望你加入我们……

english: Then what's the problem?
translation: 那问题是什么？

english: Well, it's like this: Although you have performed a mission on behalf of the White Knights, you were never actually working for them.
translation: 是这样的：虽然你代表白骑士执行过任务，但你实际上从未为他们工作过。

english: As I say, when our order was founded, we were expected to take the best of the best, and it was assumed that anyone worth having on the team would have been a White Knight already, what?
translation: 就像我说的，我们骑士团创立时，只招募最顶尖的人才，而且假设任何值得加入队伍的人都已经是白骑士了，对吧？

english: Sadly, this is not the case anymore, and the fact that you have to serve as a Squire to a White Knight for a minimum period of five years before you can actually become one tends to put the more short-attention spanned adventurers off joining, what?
translation: 可惜现在情况不同了，事实上你必须先给一位白骑士当侍从至少五年，才能真正成为白骑士，这让很多缺乏耐心的冒险者不乐意加入，对吧？

english: You want me to be a squire for five years?!?!
translation: 你想让我当五年侍从？！？！

english: Haw Haw Haw! No, no, goodness me, no!
translation: 哈哈哈！不，不，天哪，当然不！

english: Five years is a very long period of time nowadays – ANYTHING could happen in that time, and we need capable [men/women] like yourself as soon as possible.
translation: 五年现在来说太长了——期间什么都有可能发生，我们需要像你这样有能力的[men/women]尽快加入。

english: No, I had a bit of a chat with Sir Vey, and we came up with... A different solution to the problem. Assuming you're still interested, of course.
translation: 不，我和维伊爵士聊了聊，我们想出了……另一个解决办法。当然，前提是你还有兴趣。

english: Yes I'm interested.
translation: 我有兴趣。

english: I'm still up for joining the Temple Knights, I just don't really feel like spending five years running around shining peoplesboots for them.
translation: 我还是想加入圣殿骑士，只是不想花五年时间到处给人擦靴子。

english: Haw Haw Haw!
translation: 哈哈哈！

english: I quite understand, what? No, don't worry, we were doing a little research into the White Knight Charter, and found an interesting loophole, what?
translation: 我完全理解，对吧？别担心，我们研究了白骑士章程，发现了一个有趣的漏洞，对吧？

english: Loophole? What kind of loophole?
translation: 漏洞？什么漏洞？

english: Well, you don't need to worry about the details, you just do as I tell you and it will all work out for us both, what?
translation: 这个嘛，细节你不用担心，按我说的做，对我们俩都有好处，对吧？

english: I guess... I don't really like blindly following orders though...
translation: 我想……但我确实不喜欢盲目服从命令……

english: No, I'm bored now.
translation: 不了，我现在没兴趣了。

english: No, to be honest I'm getting sick of all these excuses and procrastination. Plus being an initiate was nowhere near as fun as I thought it would be.
translation: 说实话，我受够了这些借口和拖延。而且当见习生远没有我想象中那么有趣。

english: I'd rather just go off by myself and kill stuff for cash.
translation: 我宁愿自己出去杀怪赚钱。

english: Well, sorry to hear you say that [boy/gal/bean], but I can't hold it against you.
translation: 听你这么说我很难过[boy/gal/bean]，但我不能怪你。

english: You will of course still be entitled to all that we can provide you with at an initiate level, but sadly you will never advance beyond that in our order. Was there anything you wanted?
translation: 你仍然有权获得我们为见习生提供的所有待遇，但可惜你在我们骑士团中永远不会再晋升了。你还有什么需要吗？

english: So what exactly do you want me to do?
translation: 那你到底想让我做什么？

english: Well now, it's really very simple. I want you to go to Sir Amik, tell him that you have decided to not join the Temple Knights, and that you have decided to become a White Knight instead.
translation: 其实很简单。我要你去找阿米克爵士，告诉他你决定不加入圣殿骑士，而是想当白骑士。

english: He will then offer you to join as a squire; you will then decline his offer, and ask if you can be deputised instead.
translation: 他会让你当侍从；然后你拒绝他，并问他能不能直接做代理白骑士。

english: Okaaaay....
If you run into any problems with that, come and see me.
translation: 如果遇到什么问题，就来找我。

english: How will all that help?
translation: 这有什么用？

english: I don't exactly understand how that will help me become a White Knight...
translation: 我不太明白这怎么能帮我成为白骑士……

english: Ah, your curiosity does you credit old boy! Let me tell you a little history lesson.
translation: 啊，你的好奇心值得表扬！让我给你上一堂历史课。

english: Many centuries ago, the founders of the White Knights realized that in times of crisis, a long waiting period for new Knights could be disastrous for the kingdom, so they added a clause to the founding charter that would
translation: 几个世纪前，白骑士的创始人意识到，在危机时期，等待新骑士的漫长时间可能会给王国带来灾难，所以他们在建团章程中增加了一项条款，

english: allow any citizen who has performed an act in the name of the White Knight to become deputised on a purely temporary basis to a full-fledged White Knight.
translation: 允许任何以白骑士名义行事的人，在纯粹临时的基础上，被任命为正式的白骑士。

english: Well now, your actions in the Black Knights' Fortress on behalf of the White Knights make you eligible to be deputised.
translation: 你在黑骑士要塞代表白骑士的行动让你有资格成为代理白骑士。

english: Besides, you passed the trials to become a Temple Knight, what? If you're good enough to join the elite, then we'd not hesitate to deputise you into the White Knights.
translation: 而且你通过了圣殿骑士的考验，对吧？如果你够格加入精英队伍，我们也会毫不犹豫地让你代理白骑士。

english: But if deputisation's only temporary, and I have to be a 'proper' White Knight to then become a Temple Knight, doesn't that mean that I am still going to have to squire for Amik for five years?
translation: 但如果代理只是临时性的，而且我必须成为正式白骑士才能加入圣殿骑士，那岂不是说我还是得给阿米克当五年侍从？

english: Ah, well this is where the beauty of the plan lies, dontchaknow?
translation: 啊，这就是计划的精妙之处，你懂的？

english: Once you have been deputised, for the time that you are still working for their order, you are subject to all of the same rules and regulations that normal White Knights are, which means you are also eligible for battlefield
translation: 一旦你被任命为代理白骑士，在你为他们的骑士团服务期间，你将遵守与正式白骑士相同的规章制度，这意味着你也有资格获得战场晋升。

english: promotions.
translation: 晋升。

english: I... don't understand...
translation: 我……不明白……

english: Let me put it like this; As a deputy you will be considered the lowest possible rank of the White Knight, and may be removed entirely from their order at a whim.
translation: 这么说吧：作为代理，你的地位是白骑士中最低的，可能随时被从骑士团中除名。

english: However, should you achieve some great feat while serving as a White Knight that you would be eligible for a promotion from, then by their own rules you would then have to be raised to a higher level within their order, and
translation: 但是，如果你在担任白骑士期间取得了某项伟大功绩，从而有资格获得晋升，那么按照他们自己的规定，你就必须被提升到更高的级别，

english: it would therefore become impossible to remove your rank, or make you no longer a deputy.
translation: 这样一来，你的级别就无法被撤销，也不能再把你降为代理了。

english: So I get to be a White Knight without having to do five years of pointless busywork?
translation: 所以我可以不用做五年无聊的杂务就当上白骑士？

english: Indeed. We Temple Knights have our reputation for a reason, donchaknow?
translation: 没错。我们圣殿骑士的名声可不是白来的，你懂的？

english: Okay, I guess that makes sense... But we're not in a time of crisis, so doesn't that mean I won't actually get deputised?
translation: 好吧，好像有道理……但现在又不是危机时期，所以我实际上不会被任命为代理吧？

english: Ah, do not concern yourself with THAT old [boy/gal]; Crisis is such a subjective term, and as you will find out when you join us fully in the Temple Knights, is always some potential crisis or other brewing.
translation: 啊，别担心那个老[boy/gal]；“危机”这个词很主观，等你正式加入圣殿骑士后就会发现，总有些潜在的危机在酝酿。

english: If we weren't as good at our jobs we were, almost every day would be a day of crisis!
translation: 如果我们不是这么擅长自己的工作，几乎每天都会是危机日！

english: All we really need to do is allow the old White Knights to handle a problem that we would normally deal with, and that should be a sufficient crisis to allow you to be deputised, donchaknow.
translation: 我们真正需要做的，就是让白骑士们去处理一个通常由我们处理的问题，这应该就足以构成危机，让你被任命为代理了，你懂的。

english: But... Do I really need to quit the Temple Knights
translation: 但是……我真的需要退出圣殿骑士吗？

english: You seem pretty cool, and I really like the armour...
translation: 你看起来挺酷的，而且我很喜欢这套盔甲……

english: No, not at all, this is merely a ruse; Sir Amik knows full well that his authority over our organization is limited, so he will not deputise you unless he thinks that you are entirely unaffiliated with us.
translation: 不，完全不是，这只是个幌子；阿米克爵士很清楚他对我们组织没什么权力，所以除非他认为你跟我们完全无关，否则他不会任命你做代理。

english: You are simply going to tell him that you have decided not to join us so that he will in turn deputise you to join the White Knights! We of course still want you to join us, it is just a
translation: 你只需要告诉他你决定不加入我们，这样他就会反过来让你代理加入白骑士！我们当然还是希望你加入我们，这只是个小小的……误导。

english: little... misdirection.
translation: 误导。

english: You are to go to Sir Amik Varze, leader of the White Knights of Falador, and are to tell him that you have decided not to join the Temple Knights.
translation: 你要去找法拉多城白骑士的领袖阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士，告诉他你决定不加入圣殿骑士。

english: We will send him a messenger confirming this. He will offer you the opportunity to become his squire, you are to decline, and ask if you can be deputised instead.
translation: 我们会派信使向他确认此事。他会让你当他的侍从，你要拒绝，然后问他能否让你当代理白骑士。

english: If you run into any problems with that, you are then to come and see me for further advice.
translation: 如果遇到什么问题，就来找我进一步咨询。

english: Understood?
translation: 明白了吗？

english: Um, yeah, I think so...
translation: 嗯，是的，我想我明白了……

english: Hello Sir. Amik
translation: 你好，阿米克爵士。

english: Hello Friend
translation: 你好，朋友。

english: Well, I did have something you may have been interested in, but I've been given orders not to approach you for trivial matters now that you are a member of the Temple Knights.
translation: 嗯，我本来有件事你可能会感兴趣，但我接到命令，既然你是圣殿骑士成员，就不能因琐事接触你。

english: Aaaaawwwww...
got any jobs for me to do today?
translation: 今天有什么任务给我吗？

english: Well, I did have something you may be interested in, but I've been given orders not to-
translation: 嗯，我本来有件事你可能会感兴趣，但我接到的命令是——

english: Can I just stop you right there?
translation: 我能打断你一下吗？

english: I am no longer a member of the Temple Knights, I have entirely renounced my application because after many hours of soul searching I have come to the conclusion that I desperately want to become a White Knight instead!
translation: 我不再是圣殿骑士成员了，我已经完全放弃了申请，因为经过长时间的深思熟虑，我得出结论：我非常想成为一名白骑士！

english: You don't want to be a Temple Knight anymore?
translation: 你不想当圣殿骑士了？

english: That is correct, yes.
translation: 是的，没错。

english: But you are wearing their armour!
translation: 但你穿着他们的盔甲！

english: So? Did you hear me bad mouth their armour? The armour is cool, I kept the armour!
translation: 那又怎样？你听到我说他们的盔甲坏话了吗？盔甲很酷，我保留盔甲了！

english: I'm not sure I understand... You wish to desert the Temple Knights in favour of my own humble White Knights?
translation: 我不太明白……你想脱离圣殿骑士，转而加入我卑微的白骑士？

english: And this is definitely not some kind of elaborate hoax to get my application processed faster.
translation: 而且这绝对不是某种精心策划的恶作剧，想让我更快处理你的申请吧？

english: I'm sorry, did you say something just then?
translation: 抱歉，你刚才说了什么吗？

english: No... Not if you didn't hear it...
translation: 没……如果你没听见就算了……

english: ...Well anyway, for the fine work you achieved at that incident in the Black Knights Fortress, I would be honoured to accept you as my squire.
translation: ……总之，鉴于你在黑骑士要塞事件中的出色表现，我很荣幸接受你成为我的侍从。

english: So what exactly does being a squire consist of, then?
translation: 那么当侍从具体要做些什么？

english: You will spend the next five years of your life running various errands for me.
translation: 你将在接下来的五年里为我跑各种差事。

english: If I consider you to have done a more than adequate job of this, then I will begin to consider possibly moving your name forwards to becoming a full-fledged member of the Order of the White Knights.
translation: 如果我认为你做得足够好，我会考虑把你的名字提上去，让你成为白骑士团的正式成员。

english: So... No killing stuff for you, or anything fun like that...?
translation: 所以……没有为你杀怪之类有趣的事情……？

english: Not as such, no. Unless you consider killing time by running errands fun...?
translation: 目前没有。除非你觉得跑腿消磨时间很有趣……？

english: Well, erm...
translation: 嗯，呃……

english: So what say you Player? Spend five long years of your life doing pointless busywork without pay for me, on the off chance that at some point in the future I may put your name forward as a novice White Knight?
translation: 那么你觉得怎么样，玩家？要不要花五年时间为我做无意义的杂务，没有报酬，碰巧将来某一天我可能会把你的名字提上去当个新手白骑士？

english: Yes please! I would LOVE to be your squire!
translation: 太好了！我很乐意当你的侍从！

english: Wait... Didn't Sir Tiffy tell me to decline...?
translation: 等等……蒂菲爵士不是让我拒绝吗……？

english: Nah, Squire me up, Amik!
translation: 不，让我当侍从吧，阿米克！

english: As you wish, from this day forth you are my Squire!
translation: 如你所愿，从今天起你就是我的侍从了！

english: Um... As tempting an offer as that sounds Sir Amik, I am really not a fan of waiting around...
translation: 嗯……虽然你的提议很诱人，阿米克爵士，但我真的不喜欢等待……

english: Now I heard from some completely random stranger that was definitely not Sir Tiffy Cashien as part of an elaborate ruse to fast track my application into the White Knights, that I could be deputised directly as a White
translation: 我从一个完全随机的陌生人那里听说——那人肯定不是蒂菲.卡申爵士，作为加速我白骑士申请流程的精心计谋的一部分——我可以直接被任命为白

english: Knight, and entirely bypass that while boring waiting for five year thing...
translation: 骑士，完全跳过那无聊的五年等待期……

english: That is entirely correct [player name], but I have no idea where you might have heard that for it is a secret guarded only to members of our order!
translation: 那完全正确，[player name]，但我不知道你从哪儿听说的，因为这是我们骑士团成员才能守护的秘密！

english: Right. Well, Can I do that instead?
translation: 好的。那我能换个方式来做吗？

english: Well, a fine adventurer would be a perfect candidate as a deputy in my eyes, but fortunately this can only be done in a time of crisis, and all is currently well.
translation: 嗯，在我看来，一位出色的冒险者作为副手是完美的人选，但幸运的是，这只能在危机时刻进行，而现在一切安好。

english: All is well huh? I'll be right back, I just have to go ask...
translation: 一切安好是吧？我马上回来，我得去问问……

english: nobody in particular if they can organise...nothing at all to happen.
translation: 随便找个人问他们能不能安排……什么事都没有。

english: You are a strange one [player name]...
translation: 你真是个古怪的人，[player name]……

english: Got any jobs for me to do today?
translation: 今天有什么任务给我做吗？

english: Only to become my Squire. Do you wish to become my squire?
translation: 只有成为我的侍从。你愿意成为我的侍从吗？

english: No, not really. So there isn't a crisis yet?
translation: 不，不太愿意。所以现在还没有危机？

english: Thank Saradomin, no! We have not had a crisis for many years now!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明，没有！我们已经好多年没有危机了！

english: Right. Well, I'll go and see if Tiffy can fix that for me then.
translation: 好的。那我去看看蒂菲能不能帮我解决这个问题。

english: Er, I mean: How fortunate for us all that nothing terrible has happened or is conveniently about to happen.
translation: 呃，我的意思是：我们多幸运啊，没有发生什么可怕的事，或者正好要发生什么事。

english: So do you have any squiring for me today Amik?
translation: 那么阿米克，今天有什么侍从的任务给我吗？

english: Yes, yes in fact I do. I would like you to bring me an Asgarnian Ale.
translation: 有，事实上确实有。我想让你给我带一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒。

english: No matured Ale, no other brand, simply an Asgarnian Ale.
translation: 不要陈年麦酒，不要其他品牌，只要一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒。

english: Okay boss.
translation: 好的，老大。

english: That is 'Sir Amik' or 'My Liege' – not 'Boss'.
translation: 应该是'阿米克爵士'或'我的君主'——不是'老大'。

english: Gotcha, boss.
translation: 知道了，老大。

english: Hi boss.
translation: 嗨，老大。

english: Call me Sir Amik, or liege.
translation: 叫我阿米克爵士，或者君主。

english: Sure thing, boss. I brought you a beer.
translation: 没问题，老大。我给你带了杯啤酒。

english: Anything else you want boss?
translation: 还有别的想要吗，老大？

english: Well, another Asgarnian Ale would be greatly appreciated. And stop calling me Boss.
translation: 嗯，再来一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒会非常感谢。还有，别再叫我老大了。

english: Sure thing boss!
translation: 没问题，老大！

english: I did it Tiffy! I became Sir Amik's squire!
translation: 我做到了，蒂菲！我成了阿米克爵士的侍从！

english: That means in just five short years I can be a White Knight!
translation: 这意味着只需短短五年我就能成为一名白骑士！

english: ...What? I told you to decline!
translation: ……什么？我告诉过你拒绝的！

english: Yeeeesssssss.... But I thought it would be more fun to do this?
translation: 是——的……但我以为这样做会更有趣？

english: *sigh* This is a less than illustrious start to your career with us [player name].
translation: *叹气* 这对你与我们共事的职业生涯来说，可不是一个光彩的开端，[player name]。

english: Never mind, all is not lost, I have sent word to Amik that a dangerous criminal we once thought exiled is on the loose again, and that he should send all available White Knights to confront him.
translation: 没关系，还没全完。我已经给阿米克传话，说我们曾以为被流放的一个危险罪犯又逍遥法外了，让他派所有可用的白骑士去对付他。

english: This should give him enough of a scare to deputise you immediately.
translation: 这应该能把他吓到足够立即任命你为代理。

english: Go and speak to Amik again, and then immediately come back here, we will need to prepare you for your mission.
translation: 再去和阿米克谈一次，然后立刻回到这里，我们需要为你的任务做准备。

english: Hello again Tiffy. I've just spoken to Amik, and he says he's fine for me to be deputised as a White Knight, there just needs to be a crisis first.
translation: 又见面了，蒂菲。我刚和阿米克谈过，他说他可以让我成为代理白骑士，但首先需要有一场危机。

english: I assume you can arrange a small crisis for me?
translation: 我想你能为我安排一场小危机吧？

english: Haw Haw Haw, fitting right in with the Temple Knight way of thinking, what?
translation: 哈哈哈，完全符合圣殿骑士的思维方式，对吧？

english: Well as a matter of fact, I will not have to organise anything, there is a particularly vicious and dangerous criminal currently at loose!
translation: 嗯，事实上，我不需要安排任何事情，有一个特别凶残危险的罪犯目前正在逍遥法外！

english: I have already notified Sir Amik through the usual channels, so just go and speak to him quickly, then pop back here and we'll get you equipped for the hunt, what?
translation: 我已经通过常规渠道通知了阿米克爵士，所以快去和他谈谈，然后回到这里，我们会为你配备狩猎装备，对吧？

english: You know... Is all this back and forth strictly necessary?
translation: 你知道吗……这种来回跑真的有必要吗？

english: I don't mean to sound ungrateful for the help you're giving me here, but you could have just got this sorted out before sending me off there in the first place!
translation: 我不是对您的帮助不领情，但您本可以在我一开始去那里之前就把这些安排好！

english: Ah, yes, well most awfully sorry about all the running around you've been doing old bean, but when it comes to our line of work, sometimes the indirect route is the best, what?
translation: 啊，是的，对于让你跑来跑去非常抱歉，老兄，但就我们这一行而言，有时候间接的路线才是最好的，对吧？

english: I don't understand...?
translation: 我不明白……？

english: And stop calling me bean! I am not a vegetable, I am a human bean, er, being!
translation: 还有别叫我老豆！我不是蔬菜，我是人豆，呃，人类！

english: Awfully sorry dear heart, it's just a term of affection, what? Anyway...
translation: 非常抱歉，亲爱的，这只是表示亲昵的称呼，对吧？总之……

english: This criminal is a very dangerous fellow, and has some very dangerous friends.
translation: 这个罪犯是个非常危险的家伙，还有一些非常危险的朋友。

english: If he has no reason to suspect you to be working for us, then he will be a little sloppier than he otherwise might be, because he will just assume you to be one of those stupid White Knights.
translation: 如果他没有理由怀疑你在为我们工作，那他就会比平时更马虎一些，因为他只会把你当成那些愚蠢的白骑士之一。

english: We want this man caught, for the good of the country, and if we need to fool a few people into thinking you're nothing to do with us, and you have to do a little extra walking, then that's what is going to happen, what?
translation: 我们想抓住这个人，为了国家的利益，如果我们需要骗一些人以为你跟我们毫无关系，而且你得额外多走些路，那事情就是这样，对吧？

english: I guess... But this spy stuff is a lot more boring than it sounded at first...
translation: 我想是吧……但这间谍活儿比一开始听起来无聊多了……

english: Hi Tiffy. What am I supposed to be doing again?
translation: 嗨，蒂菲。我到底该做什么来着？

english: Go and report to Sir Amik for 'orders'. You will be unsurprised to find out he will now be prepared to deputise you.
translation: 去阿米克爵士那里报到接'命令'。你会发现他现在准备任命你为代理，这不会让你惊讶。

english: After you have spoken to him return here immediately, your life will be at risk without our assistance, and we don't want you dying on your first mission for us, what?
translation: 和他谈完后立刻回到这里，没有我们的帮助你的生命会有危险，我们可不希望你第一次为我们出任务就送了命，对吧？

english: Speak about the Wanted! Quest
translation: 谈论通缉！任务

english: Thank Saradomin you have come back here!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明，你回来了！

english: We have received word from one of our scouts that the evil Solus Dellagar has returned to Asgarnia!
translation: 我们从一名侦察兵那里得到消息，邪恶的索卢斯.德拉加已经回到了阿斯加尼亚！

english: What is worse, it seems he is in possession of dangerous new magics we are powerless against!
translation: 更糟糕的是，他似乎掌握了一种危险的新魔法，我们无力对抗！

english: Please, I implore you in the name of all that is holy, assist us in banishing him from our kingdom once more!
translation: 拜托，我以一切神圣之名的名义恳求你，帮助我们再次将他驱逐出我们的王国！

english: I cannot bear to think of the troubles he may bring us...
translation: 我不敢想象他可能给我们带来的麻烦……

english: Solus Dellagar? Who - or what - is that?
translation: 索卢斯.德拉加？那是谁——或者说是什么？

english: You have not heard of the infamous murder-mage? He terrorised these lands many years past, thinking himself above the law with his powerful enchantments, but the White Knights finally managed to bring him to
translation: 你没听说过那个臭名昭著的杀人法师吗？许多年前他在这片土地上作恶，仗着自己强大的魔法自以为凌驾于法律之上，但白骑士最终设法将他绳之以

english: justice and he was permanently exiled.
translation: 法，他遭到了永久流放。

english: Exiled? Why didn't you just kill him? Or, you know, imprison him or whatever?
translation: 流放？为什么不直接杀了他？或者，你知道的，关进监狱或其他方式？

english: Kill an unarmed foe? That is not the way of Saradomin, nor of the White Knights.
translation: 杀死一个手无寸铁的敌人？那不是萨拉多明的作风，也不是白骑士的作风。

english: As for imprisonment...Solus is a highly dangerous man not just because of his mastery of the magical arts, but for his uncanny resourcefulness.
translation: 至于监禁……索卢斯是个非常危险的人，不仅因为他精通魔法技艺，还因为他那不可思议的足智多谋。

english: To tell you the truth, I fear that I would be unable to guarantee his captivity in any holding cell belonging to us...
translation: 说实话，我担心我无法保证他在我们任何一间牢房里的关押……

english: So if you can't imprison him, and exile obviously didn't work, you want me to kill him?
translation: 所以既然你关不了他，流放显然也没用，你是想让我杀了他？

english: I did not say that. I did not say that at all. That is against all of our codes of honour.
translation: 我没那么说。我根本没这么说。那违反了我们的所有荣誉准则。

english: However, should you find yourself in combat with him, and there is no other way, then perhaps for him to die would be best for us all.
translation: 然而，如果你发现自己与他交战，并且别无选择，那么也许让他死去对我们所有人都好。

english: You understand me, [player name]?
translation: 你明白我的意思吗，[player name]？

english: Oh yes. You've made yourself very clear.
translation: 哦，是的。你说得非常清楚了。

english: So will you aid us in this fight?
translation: 那么你愿意帮助我们进行这场战斗吗？

english: So what will I get if I help you out against this, er, solus doolalala guy then?
translation: 那么如果我帮你们对付这个，呃，索卢斯.杜拉拉拉家伙，我能得到什么？

english: Why, you will help keep Asgarnia free of malicious influence, and perform a good deed in the name of King Vallance and of the White Knights!
translation: 怎么，你将帮助阿斯加尼亚摆脱恶意影响，并以瓦兰斯国王和白骑士的名义行善！

english: Yes, yes I see. So...No monetary compensation or other actual reward then?
translation: 是，是，我明白了。所以……没有金钱补偿或其他实际奖励？

english: As Saradomin has told us, 'a good deed is its own reward'.
translation: 正如萨拉多明告诉我们的那样，‘善行本身就是回报’ 。

english: So I don't actually get anything out of this then?
translation: 所以我实际上从这件事里得不到任何东西？

english: Nothing tangible, no, but you will be deputized to act as a White Knight, and you will feel a warm glow inside of having done the right thing.
translation: 没有实物奖励，但你会被任命代理白骑士，而且你会因为做了正确的事而内心感到温暖。

english: But you can't buy things with a warm glow...
translation: 但你不能用温暖的感觉买东西……

english: So what say you [player name]? Fight with honour in the name of the White Knights against the terrible Solus?
translation: 那么你意下如何，[player name]？以白骑士的名义光荣地对抗可怕的索卢斯？

english: Hey, there's nothing I like more than fighting! Deputise me up, and I'll go get this guy for you!
translation: 嘿，我最喜欢战斗了！任命我为代理吧，我去把这家伙给你抓来！

english: Very well then; In the name of King Vallance, and for the honour of Saradomin, I now pronounce you a fully deputised White Knight.
translation: 很好；以瓦伦斯国王之名，为萨拉多明的荣誉，我现在宣布你为正式代理白骑士。

english: May honour and glory follow you in every action.
translation: 愿荣誉与荣耀伴随你的每一次行动。

english: So where should I start looking for this Solus guy anyway?
translation: 那么我该从哪里开始找这个索卢斯家伙呢？

english: I haven't the faintest idea. Good Luck!
translation: 我一点头绪都没有。祝你好运！

english: A scary mage huh? Sounds like I could get KILLED!
translation: 一个可怕的法师是吧？听起来我会被干掉的！

english: Forget that and forget you! No way am I risking my neck unless there is a big fat reward on the table for it!
translation: 忘掉那个，也忘掉你！除非桌上摆着丰厚的报酬，否则我绝不会拿自己的脖子冒险！

english: And sometimes not even then...
translation: 有时候即使有也不干……

english: It is a tragedy to hear you speak so, but we must trust in our valour and the wisdom of Saradomin to protect us from this evil man if we can not enlist help against him.
translation: 听到你这么说真是悲哀，但如果我们无法争取到帮助对抗他，我们必须相信我们的勇气和萨拉多明的智慧能保护我们免受这个恶人的侵害。

english: [Player]... Solus Dellagar is still loose... Please, for the safety of my lands you must find him immediately...
translation: [Player]……索卢斯.德拉加仍然逍遥法外……请为了我的土地的安全，你必须立即找到他……

english: Any hints on where he might be?
translation: 有什么关于他可能在哪里的线索吗？

english: We have no idea where he might be now... His magic is too powerful for us, I do not know how to stop him...
translation: 我们现在不知道他可能在哪里……他的魔法对我们来说太强大了，我不知道如何阻止他……

english: Hum. I wonder if Sir Tiffy might be able to help?
translation: 嗯。我想知道蒂菲爵士是否能帮忙？

english: Tiffy, it worked exactly to plan! Sir Amik deputised me to take care of this Solus Doolally dude, so let's go get him!
translation: 蒂菲，计划完全成功了！阿米克爵士任命我代理去对付这个索卢斯.嘟嘟啦家伙，所以我们去抓他吧！

english: His name is Solus Dellagar, and honestly, he is one of the most dangerous men on the planet.
translation: 他的名字是索卢斯.德拉加，老实说，他是这个星球上最危险的人之一。

english: Not only is he extremely adapt at magic, he is also quite prepared to use that magic at a momentsnotice, because he is quite, quite mad.
translation: 他不仅极其精通魔法，而且还随时准备使用那种魔法，因为他相当、相当疯狂。

english: So... Dragonhide armour and an elemental shield and I'm laughing?
translation: 所以……龙皮盔甲和元素盾我就高枕无忧了？

english: No, no, no. Listen to me [boy/girl]; You are under NO CIRCUMSTANCES to engage him directly in combat!
translation: 不，不，不。听我说，[boy/girl]；你绝不能在任何情况下直接与他交战！

english: You are to act as our agent and track him down, when you have managed to corner him somewhere then we will send in a field recovery team directly to take him away without incident.
translation: 你要作为我们的代理人追踪他，当你设法将他困在某个地方后，我们会直接派遣现场回收小组，将他带走，不出任何意外。

english: I cannot stress this enough; You are to observe and locate, you are NOT to enter a combat situation!
translation: 我再强调也不为过；你只需观察和定位，绝不能进入战斗状态！

english: Riiiiight.... So I'm just going to scout him out for you then.
translation: 好——吧……那我就是替你们侦察他一下。

english: Any tips on how to find him?
translation: 有什么找他的诀窍吗？

english: Well old [boy/girl], we need to equip you for the task, but you'll need to get something for me first, what?
translation: 嗯，老[boy/girl]，我们需要为你配备任务装备，但你先得给我弄点东西，对吧？

english: Well, we teach our operatives the value of their equipment by making them pay for it, what?
translation: 嗯，我们让特工自己支付装备费用，让他们懂得装备的价值，对吧？

english: You have two choices here, you can either give me the cash directly, and I will hand it over, or you can bring me the raw materials and I will make you one.
translation: 你有两个选择：要么直接把现金给我，我帮你转交；要么你把原材料带来，我帮你做一个。

english: Well we in the Temple Knights have some specific equipment for situations such as this dontchaknow, but you'll need to free up some inventory space first!
translation: 我们圣殿骑士有一些专门用于这种情况的装备，你懂的，但你需要先腾出一些背包空间！

english: It's 10,000 coins for the Temple Knight Communication Orb. You have that kind of money with you?
translation: 圣殿骑士通讯球要一万金币。你身上有那么多钱吗？

english: Oh yeah, I got your money.
translation: 哦，当然，我带了钱。

english: Then you wish to purchase a Temple Knight Communication Orb?
translation: 那么你想购买一个圣殿骑士通讯球吗？

english: Here take this Communications Orb, or 'CommOrb' for short.
translation: 来，拿着这个通讯球，简称‘通讯球’ 。

english: It is a precise magical mechanism that we can use to track him, by sending data of the surrounding area back to one of our information operatives at the Temple Knight Headquarters.
translation: 这是一个精密的魔法装置，我们可以用它来追踪他，它会将周围区域的数据发送回圣殿骑士总部的一位情报特工那里。

english: Your information operative is known as Savant, I suggest you contact them using your CommOrb at your earliest convenience.
translation: 你的情报特工代号‘学者’，我建议你尽快用通讯球联系她。

english: They will be able to send you any useful data about Solus directly through it for your perusal, dontchaknow.
translation: 她可以直接通过通讯球把关于索卢斯.德拉加的所有有用数据发给你，供你查阅，你懂的。

english: Ok, thanks Tiffy!
translation: 好的，谢谢蒂菲！

english: As you wish, what?
translation: 随你便，对吧？

english: I don't have that kind of money with me...
translation: 我身上没带那么多钱……

english: Perhaps you would like to just bring me the components of it then, what?
translation: 或许你愿意把材料给我带来，对吧？

english: Bring me one law rune, one slayer gem and one piece of molten glass and I will make you a Communication Orb.
translation: 给我一个律法符石、一个杀戮宝石和一块熔融玻璃，我就给你做一个通讯球。

english: Can I give you the components I have with me now?
translation: 我可以现在就把我带的材料给你吗？

english: Heavens, boy! I am not a pawn shop, to be holding bits and pieces for you while you go off and do something else!
translation: 天哪，小子！我又不是当铺，不可能帮你保管零碎东西，让你跑去干别的事！

english: No, no you bring me all three components at the same time, what?
translation: 不，你得同时把三样材料都拿来，明白吗？

english: Okay Tiffy.
translation: 好的，蒂菲。

english: Bring me one Law Rune, one Slayer Gem and one piece of Molten Glass and I will make you a Communication Orb.
translation: 给我一个律法符石、一个杀戮宝石和一块熔融玻璃，我就给你做一个通讯球。

english: I have all three components for you to make me a Communication Orb out of now Tiffy.
translation: 我现在有全部三种材料，蒂菲，你可以给我做一个通讯球了。

english: Excellent! You wish me to make you one now then, what?
translation: 太好了！你想让我现在给你做一个，对吧？

english: Bringing me either cash or items so that I can equip you for your mission correctly.
translation: 给我带现金或物品，这样我才能正确装备你执行任务。

english: You are hunting for Solus Dellagar, the evil criminal mastermind.
translation: 你正在追捕索卢斯.德拉加，那个邪恶的犯罪主谋。

english: I suggest you contact Savant through your CommOrb and see if she can send you any relevant information about your assignment.
translation: 我建议你用通讯球联系学者，看看她能否给你发送关于任务的相关信息。

english: Hello...?
Well, hello! You must be [player name]? Sir Tiffy told me to expect you to call in on this frequency!
translation: 哦，你好！你一定是[player name]吧？蒂菲爵士告诉我你会在这个频率上联系我！

english: So what do you think? Pretty nifty little piece of kit this crystal, huh?
translation: 你觉得怎么样？这块水晶挺精巧的吧，嗯？

english: Yeah, it must be very useful.
translation: 是啊，肯定很有用。

english: Oh, trust me you'll find out exactly how useful! Now, was there something you wanted?
translation: 哦，相信我，你很快就会知道它有多有用！那么，你有什么事吗？

english: Hi Savant! I was wondering if you could give me details on my current assignment?
translation: 嗨，学者！我想知道你能不能给我关于当前任务的详细信息？

english: Okaaaaay... Bringing up your current assignment details...
translation: 好吧……调出你当前任务的详细信息……

english: Oh! You're chasing Solus Dellagar?
translation: 哦！你在追捕索卢斯.德拉加？

english: Oh yeah! So any information you can give me?
translation: 哦，是的！你能给我什么信息吗？

english: Listen [player name]. Solus is an incredibly dangerous criminal, and I don't think his grasp on reality is too tight, if you understand what I'm saying.
translation: 听着，[player name]。索卢斯是个极其危险的罪犯，而且我觉得他的理智不太正常，你明白我的意思。

english: You really need to take care with this one. I'm amazed you got an assignment as tough as this one as a first assignment to be honest!
translation: 你真的要小心这个人。说实话，我很惊讶你第一个任务就这么难！

english: So, how would you suggest I go about finding him?
translation: 那你建议我怎么去找他？

english: Well, this CommOrb can use the scan function to find him, but its range is very limited.
translation: 嗯，这个通讯球可以用扫描功能找到他，但它的范围非常有限。

english: So I have to just wander around the place looking for him?
translation: 所以我只能到处瞎逛找他？

english: No, that would take far too long... Listen, I am going to transfer all information on Solus that we currently have to your CommOrb.
translation: 不，那太费时间了……听着，我把我们目前掌握的关于索卢斯的所有信息都传送到你的通讯球里。

english: You should be able to find a hint of where to find him by examining it.
translation: 你检查一下，应该能找到关于他藏身之处的线索。

english: The Library tells me that we have two visual recordings from SpyOrbs available to you, as well as a standard dossier.
translation: 图书馆告诉我，我们有两份来自间谍球的视觉记录可供你使用，还有一份标准档案。

english: I would suggest the people that the SpyOrbs were observing, when they picked up records of Solus, would be a good place to start your investigation.
translation: 我建议你从间谍球观察到索卢斯记录时所监视的那些人入手，这会是个不错的调查起点。

english: Who are these people then?
translation: 那这些人是谁？

english: Okay just checking now...
translation: 好的，正在查……

english: Record one is from a routine monitoring of Lord Daquarius.
translation: 记录一来自对达夸里乌斯领主的例行监视。

english: In case you haven't heard of him, he is the leader of the Kinshra, also known as Black Knights.
translation: 如果你没听说过他，他是金煞帮的首领，也被称为黑骑士。

english: As a major enemy of the White Knights we have had him under observation for some time now, so it was pretty lucky that Solus decided to visit him.
translation: 作为白骑士的主要敌人，我们监视他有一段时间了，所以索卢斯去拜访他算是很幸运的。

english: So where would I find this Lord Daquarius?
translation: 那么我在哪里能找到这个达夸里乌斯领主？

english: He has a secret Black Knight training ground deep in the heart of Taverley dungeon, along with holding facilities for prisoners who they wish to interrogate later.
translation: 他在塔韦利地牢深处有一个秘密的黑骑士训练场，还有关押囚犯的设施，用来以后审讯。

english: He is almost certain to be found thereabouts.
translation: 他几乎肯定会在那里。

english: And what is Record 2 about?
translation: 那记录二是关于什么的？

english: Just checking... Ah yes.
translation: 正在查……啊，对了。

english: This shady fellow is a member of the Zamorakian Magical Institute.
translation: 这个可疑的家伙是萨拉莫德魔法研究所的成员。

english: We suspect them to be the group responsible for destroying the Wizards Tower all of those years ago, as well as other more recent acts of sabotage.
translation: 我们怀疑他们是多年前摧毁法师塔的罪魁祸首，还干过其他近期的破坏活动。

english: We also suspect that they have been responsible for a number of thefts of a mysterious rock that the Wizards Tower has started producing, but don't have much intelligence about that.
translation: 我们还怀疑他们偷走了法师塔开始生产的一种神秘岩石，但关于这点情报不多。

english: We set up an observation SpyOrb in a known Zamorakian shrine in south-east Varrock, but he moves between there and the wilderness just north of Edgeville quite frequently.
translation: 我们在维洛克城东南部一个已知的萨拉莫德神龛设置了一个监视间谍球，但他经常在那边和边陲镇以北的荒野之间移动。

english: He doesn't seem much of a threat, but we placed him under observation anyway, which seems to have paid off by getting some more information about Solus.
translation: 他看起来不算什么威胁，但我们还是把他纳入了监视，现在看来有所收获，得到了关于索卢斯的更多信息。

english: From the look of the record, he would be worth talking to as well.
translation: 从记录来看，他也值得聊聊。

english: Thanks Savant!
translation: 谢谢学者！

english: Any time, [player name]. Over and out.
translation: 随时恭候，[player name]。通话结束。

english: So... Savant... That's an unusual name...
translation: 那么……学者……真是个不寻常的名字……

english: Well, obviously it's not my real name!
translation: 嗯，显然这不是我的真名！

english: My real name is Elyssa Van Lendes, but for operational purposes I am called Savant.
translation: 我的真名是艾丽莎.范.伦德斯，但为了行动，人们叫我学者。

english: So what exactly do you do for the Temple Knights?
translation: 那你具体为圣殿骑士做什么？

english: I am the S.M.R. and Chief Librarian for the Temple Knights.
translation: 我是圣殿骑士的高级魔法研究员兼首席图书管理员。

english: S.M.R? What's that?
translation: 高级魔法研究员？那是什么？

english: It stands for Senior Mystical Researcher. The Temple Knights have a world class research team investigating new types of magic constantly. As senior researcher, and liaison, I can pass on information to the rest of the Temple Knights.
translation: 就是高级神秘研究员的缩写。圣殿骑士有一支世界级的研究团队，不断研究新型魔法。作为高级研究员兼联络员，我可以把信息传递给其他圣殿骑士。

english: Many of the devices used by the Temple Knights such as our CommOrbs and SpyOrbs were first designed by my team as experimental devices, and have since become standard field equipment!
translation: 圣殿骑士使用的许多装置，比如我们的通讯球和间谍球，最初都是由我的团队作为实验装置设计的，后来成为了标准的野外装备！

english: I have always had a gift for magic, and have spent most of my life trying to find applications for it that would serve our order and give us an edge over our opponents.
translation: 我一直对魔法有天赋，一生大部分时间都在寻找它的应用，以便服务于我们的组织，并在对抗敌人时占据优势。

english: Your opponents?
translation: 你的敌人？

english: Oh yes, don't think for a second that we are the only secret organisation in Gielinor!
translation: 哦，是的，别以为我们是吉棱那尔唯一的秘密组织！

english: There are many factions in these lands, some almost as magically advanced and organised as ourselves!
translation: 这片大陆上有许多派系，有些在魔法先进程度和组织性上几乎和我们一样！

english: It is a constant struggle to keep our operatives with advanced magical equipment that our opponents don't have - this is why we have the self-destruct safeguards, to prevent our equipment ever falling into unfriendly hands.
translation: 我们一直努力让特工拥有敌人没有的先进魔法装备——这就是为什么我们有自毁保护措施，防止我们的装备落入敌人之手。

english: So how did you end up working for the Temple Knights?
translation: 那你最后是怎么加入圣殿骑士的？

english: I would have thought someone like you would have ended up researching at the Wizards' Tower or something instead...
translation: 我本以为像你这样的人最后会去法师塔做研究之类的……

english: Oh yes... The Wizards' Tower...
translation: 哦，是啊……法师塔……

english: Let me tell you something, the mages who work there are idiots! They told me that magical research wasn't suitable for 'just a girl' and that I would be 'too scared' to research for them effectively!
translation: 我跟你说，那里的法师都是白痴！他们告诉我魔法研究不适合‘一个小女孩’，还说我会‘太害怕’没法有效为他们研究！

english: Luckily the Temple Knights are far more open minded about things, and I really feel like my work is making a difference to them!
translation: 幸运的是，圣殿骑士思想开放得多，我真的觉得我的工作对他们产生了影响！

english: Ok, thanks Savant, that was very interesting.
translation: 好的，谢谢学者，这很有趣。

english: Hey, we're all Temple Knights here, right? Glad I could help, [player name]
translation: 嘿，我们都是圣殿骑士，对吧？很高兴能帮到你，[player name]。

english: Savant over and out.
translation: 学者，通话结束。

english: Hi Savant. I was just wondering if you could give me a little information about the Temple Knights?
translation: 嗨，学者。我只是想知道你能不能给我介绍一下圣殿骑士的情况？

english: I've just realised that I really don't know very much about them...
translation: 我才意识到我对他们了解得不多……

english: Well, you are not officially a full fledged Temple Knight now, are you Initiate [player name]?
translation: 嗯，你现在还不是正式的圣殿骑士，对吧，见习者[player name]？

english: I am afraid that means for security reasons I can only give you a brief overview of the organisation...
translation: 恐怕出于安全原因，我只能给你一个关于组织的简要概述……

english: Well, that's better than nothing right?
translation: 嗯，有总比没有好，对吧？

english: That is usually the case, yes, I agree. Well, let's see if I remember how this goes... 'Legends tell us that Lord Saradomin once walked these lands amongst us, and delivered his wisdom unto us personally, so that we could grow wise in his honour.
translation: 通常是这样，是的，我同意。好吧，让我想想我记得多少……‘传说告诉我们，萨拉莫丁主神曾在这片大地上行走，亲自赐予我们智慧，使我们能荣耀地增长智慧。

english: But then came the war, that shattered our lands, and the interloper banished our land from us!
translation: 但后来战争爆发，撕裂了我们的土地，入侵者将我们的土地夺走！

english: But the wisdom of Saradomin knew that such events might occur, and he laid plans in secret amongst his most devout followers!
translation: 但萨拉莫丁的智慧预知了这种事件可能发生，他在最虔诚的信徒中秘密制定了计划！

english: Those warriors whose hearts were as pure as their minds were sharp were called to him, and were made into his Temple Knights, for they were the Knights that guarded his very first Temple.
translation: 那些心灵纯洁、头脑敏锐的战士被他召唤，成为了他的圣殿骑士，因为他们正是守护他第一座圣殿的骑士。

english: All who dwelled in his lands knew that the Temple Knights were the honoured, the blessed, the personally chosen warriors of Saradomin, and thus were they given great freedom and authority in all of our Lords lands.
translation: 所有居住在他土地上的人都知道，圣殿骑士是受尊崇、蒙福、被萨拉莫丁亲自选中的战士，因此他们在主的土地上享有极大的自由和权威。

english: But with Saradomin no longer with us, the Temple Knights were no longer honoured and respected by all!
translation: 但随着萨拉莫丁不再与我们同在，圣殿骑士不再受到所有人的尊敬和尊重！

english: Rather, they were made targets by Saradominsenemies, and driven from the lands unjustly!
translation: 相反，他们成了萨拉莫丁敌人的目标，被不公正地驱逐出家园！

english: Thus it was that they became a secret force, hidden from the eyes of Saradominsenemies, that could strike against evil in his name swiftly and quietly whenever they may be needed.'
translation: 因此，他们成为了一支秘密力量，隐藏在萨拉莫丁敌人的视线之外，以便在需要时以他的名义迅速而安静地对邪恶进行打击。’

english: Something like that I think, it's been a long time since I heard it last...
translation: 大概就是这样吧，我很久没听过了……

english: Okay, thanks Savant.
translation: 好的，谢谢学者。

english: Lord Daquarius! Still festering in your pathetic little dungeon, I see.
translation: 达夸里乌斯领主！看来你还窝在你那可怜的地牢里。

english: Solus. I thought you dead many moons past...
translation: 索卢斯。我以为你很久以前就死了……

english: Ha! Wishful thinking, perhaps?
translation: 哈！也许是痴心妄想？

english: Cut the banter, Solus. What do you want? You know you are not welcome here.
translation: 少说废话，索卢斯。你想要什么？你知道这里不欢迎你。

english: Now is that any way to talk to a fellow Zamorakian?
translation: 这就是你跟一位萨莫拉克同胞说话的方式吗？

english: You are not a Zamorakian! You worship nothing but your own selfish greed.
translation: 你才不是萨莫拉克教徒！你只崇拜自己自私的贪婪。

english: Ah... Such mistrust of your forgotten ally! Why did I ever leave these lands?
translation: 啊……对你这位被遗忘的盟友如此不信任！我当初为何要离开这片土地？

english: You left because your own stupidity brought the wrath of the Temple Knights upon you. Now I ask you a final time before I draw my blade: WHAT do you WANT?
translation: 你离开是因为你自己的愚蠢招来了圣殿骑士的愤怒。在我拔剑之前，我最后问你一次：你到底想要什么？

english: Oh... nothing much. I just thought you would like to know that I have returned as your new master.
translation: 哦……没什么大事。我只是想让你知道，我已经回来当你的新主人了。

english: The Kinshra are not your personal soldiers Solus! I will not waste any of my warriors in your foolish schemes!
translation: 金什拉不是你的私人军队，索卢斯！我不会浪费任何一个战士去执行你愚蠢的计划！

english: And that is your final answer Daquarius?
translation: 这就是你的最终答复吗，达奎里乌斯？

english: Leave. Now. Or there will be blood shed between us.
translation: 离开。现在。否则我们之间将血流成河。

english: You would threaten Solus Dellagar? Have you forgotten just who I am? Perhaps you need reminding!
translation: 你敢威胁索卢斯.德拉加？你忘了我是谁吗？也许你需要被提醒一下！

english: Still alive Daquarius? Good! I won't have to remind you of my power again next time! Make sure you are more prepared to follow orders next time I come to your little Taverley hideout!
translation: 还活着啊，达奎里乌斯？很好！下次我就不用再提醒你我的力量了！下次我来你那个小小的塔韦利村藏身处时，你最好准备好服从命令！

english: I swear... in the name of *cough* Zamorak... I will see you rot for this Solus...
translation: 我发誓……以*咳*萨莫拉克之名……我会看着你为此腐烂，索卢斯……

english: What? Who dares... Oh no. Oh no, no, no.
translation: 什么？谁敢……哦不。哦不，不，不。

english: Well, what have we here? A shrine to Zamorak in the middle of Varrock?
translation: 嗯，看看这是什么？维洛克城中心的一座萨莫拉克神龛？

english: S-S-Solus???
translation: 索……索卢斯？？？

english: I assume my reputation precedes me!
translation: 看来我的名声已经传开了！

english: Please. Please don't kill me. I have no riches, I am but a magical researcher...
translation: 求求你。求求你别杀我。我没有财富，我只是个魔法研究员……

english: Kill you? HAH HAH HAH! My dear fellow, if I wanted you dead, you ALREADY WOULD BE!
translation: 杀你？哈哈哈！我亲爱的朋友，如果我想让你死，你早就死了！

english: I... I don't know w-what you want Solus...but whatever it is, please, just t-take it and leave, please.
translation: 我……我不知道你……你想要什么，索卢斯……但不管是什么，求求你，拿走吧，然后离开，求你了。

english: Well I am particularly interested in your brains at the moment! But you wouldn't want me taking those and leaving, now would you?
translation: 嗯，我现在对你的脑子特别感兴趣！但你不会想让我拿走那些然后离开吧，嗯？

english: My b-brains? I... I don't understand...
translation: 我的……脑子？我……我不明白……

english: I am interested in your research!
translation: 我对你的研究感兴趣！

english: My... r-research? I c-cannot let you have my research it is being done in order to assist my lord Zamorak.
translation: 我的……研究？我不能让你拿走我的研究，这是为了协助我的主人萨莫拉克而进行的。

english: Ah! But he is not here, is he?
translation: 啊！但他不在这里，对吧？

english: Ah-ah-ah!
translation: 啊-啊-啊！

english: You are going nowhere just yet sir.
translation: 你哪儿也去不了，先生。

english: P-please I meant no disrespect Solus, please do not kill me...
translation: 求……求你了，我没有不敬的意思，索卢斯，求你别杀我……

english: With your most interesting research! No, I will be content with simply taking your money sir!
translation: 用你那些有趣的研究！不，我只满足于拿走你的钱，先生！

english: Take it, take it all!
translation: 拿走吧，全都拿走！

english: Well a most productive trip on all accounts! I will see you again...Very soon!
translation: 嗯，总的来说是一次收获颇丰的旅行！我们很快就会再见……很快！

english: What want you with lord of Kinshra? Speak!
translation: 你找金什拉的首领做什么？说！

english: I am here on behalf of the White Knights...
translation: 我代表白骑士而来……

english: Pah! Begone, fool, or prepare to taste my blade!
translation: 哼！滚开，蠢货，否则准备尝尝我的刀片！

english: Now wait a minute, this concerns a friend of yours....
translation: 等等，这关系到你的一个朋友……

english: A friend of mine? What friend of mine would the Temple Knights show any intere-
translation: 我的朋友？我的哪个朋友会让圣殿骑士感兴——

english: Oh. This... Is about Solus, isn't it?
translation: 哦。这……是关于索卢斯，对吧？

english: Then let me assure you, that monster is no 'friend' of mine - if indeed such a creature even has 'friends'!
translation: 那我向你保证，那个怪物不是我的‘朋友’——如果那种生物真有‘朋友’的话！

english: No, that man is certainly no friend of mine nor the Kinshra.
translation: 不，那个人绝对不是我的朋友，也不是金什拉的朋友。

english: So you will help me find him?
translation: 所以你会帮我找到他？

english: No fool... You and your White Knight cronies are no friend of the Kinshra either.
translation: 不，蠢货……你和你的白骑士同伙也不是金什拉的朋友。

english: I will help neither of you, and I wish you all a slow and painful death.
translation: 我不会帮你们任何一方，我祝你们所有人缓慢而痛苦地死去。

english: You know...I'm sure I could MAKE you tell me where he is...
translation: 你知道……我肯定能逼你说出他在哪里……

english: Is that a threat, whelp? Do your worst. I care not for my own life, I stand only for the protection of the Kinshra!
translation: 这是威胁吗，小崽子？尽管放马过来。我不在乎自己的性命，我只为保护金什拉而存在！

english: Player? I've been monitoring you. He's telling the truth, so don't try to bluff him by starting a fight.
translation: 玩家？我一直在监视你。他说的是实话，所以别想虚张声势挑起战斗。

english: All of our records show that the only thing he will make a stand for is the protection of his men, and he has little regard for his own safety in comparison.
translation: 我们所有的记录都显示，他唯一会坚持的就是保护他的手下，相比之下他几乎不在乎自己的安全。

english: You're going to have to find some other way to intimidate him into giving you the information we need.
translation: 你得另想办法恐吓他，让他给我们需要的信息。

english: Understood. Player out.
translation: 明白。玩家通话结束。

english: I still want to know the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar!
translation: 我还是想知道索卢斯.德拉加的下落！

english: Well you will not hear that from me, White Knight dog!
translation: 哼，你从我这儿听不到的，白骑士的狗！

english: And you can threaten me all you want, I care for nothing in this world save the welfare of my Kinshra brothers!
translation: 你尽管威胁我，我在这个世界上除了金什拉兄弟们的福祉之外什么都不在乎！

english: Stop! I will tell you what you want! Please... leave my men be...
translation: 住手！我会告诉你你想知道的！求求你……放过我的人……

english: Ok Daquarius, you tell me the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar right now, or I will put every Black Knight here to their death in front of you!
translation: 好，达奎里乌斯，你现在就告诉我索卢斯.德拉加的下落，否则我就在你面前把这里的每个黑骑士都处死！

english: *Sigh* I should have known the White Knights would be my ruin once again...
translation: *叹气* 我早该知道白骑士会再次毁了我……

english: I do not know his exact whereabouts, and when last we met we did not leave...on the best of terms.
translation: 我不知道他的确切下落，而且我们上次见面时……关系并不融洽。

english: All I know is that he left behind some fur when he left, I would expect him to be in an area with furred creatures of some sort.
translation: 我只知道他离开时留下了一些毛皮，我猜他应该在某种有毛皮生物的区域。

english: What king of fur? Dog? Wolf? Bear?
translation: 什么动物的毛皮？狗？狼？熊？

english: I do not know, I am a warrior, not a zoo keeper. It was not bear fur, I know that much.
translation: 我不知道，我是个战士，不是动物园管理员。那不是熊皮，这点我很确定。

english: That's it? That's your help? You'd better not be lying Daquarius, or...
translation: 就这些？这就是你的帮助？你最好没在撒谎，达奎里乌斯，否则……

english: Calm yourself Player, he is telling the truth.
translation: 冷静点，玩家，他说的是实话。

english: I am monitoring your conversation through the CommOrb, his physiology shows none of the changes we usually get when someone lies to us.
translation: 我正在通过通讯球监视你们的对话，他的生理反应没有显示出我们通常从撒谎者身上看到的变化。

english: So this CommOrb thing can work as a lie-detector? That's pretty useful!
translation: 所以这个通讯球还能当测谎仪用？那还挺有用的！

english: Yes, it is, but back to the task at hand. I suggest you head to the next subject of our observations, he might be more help in locating Solus.
translation: 是的，但回到手头的任务。我建议你去找我们观察的下一个对象，他可能对定位索卢斯更有帮助。

english: You mean that Zamorakian mage in Varrock?
translation: 你是说维洛克城那个萨莫拉克法师？

english: Yes, he would seem a likely bet. Savant out.
translation: 是的，他看起来是个不错的选择。学者通话结束。

english: Okay Daquarius, tell me all that you know of Solus, or I will kill some more Black Knights!
translation: 好吧，达奎里乌斯，把你所知道的关于索卢斯的一切都告诉我，否则我就再杀几个黑骑士！

english: I have already told you, I know nothing except that he left some fur behind.
