translation: 我已经告诉过你了，我只知道他留下了一些毛皮。

english: Now leave me and my men be, or it will be the worse for you!
translation: 现在放过我和我的人，否则你会后悔的！

english: *sigh* I should have known the White Knights would be my ruin once again...
translation: *叹气* 我早该知道白骑士会再次毁了我……

english: I do not know, I am a warrior, not a zookeeper. It was not bear fur, I know that much.
translation: 我不知道，我是个战士，不是动物园管理员。那不是熊皮，这点我知道。

english: Oh. This... This is about Solus, isn't it?
translation: 哦。这……这是关于索卢斯的，对吧？

english: No, that man is certainly no friend of mine nor of the Kinshra.
translation: 不，那人绝不是我的朋友，也不是金什拉的朋友。

english: I do not know his exact whereabouts, and when last we met we did not leave... on the best of terms.
translation: 我不知道他确切的下落，上次我们见面时，我们离开得……不太愉快。

english: You left because your own stupidity brought the wrath of the Temple Knights upon you.
translation: 你离开是因为你自己的愚蠢招来了圣殿骑士的愤怒。

english: You know you are not welcome here.
translation: 你知道这里不欢迎你。

english: Cut the banter, Solus.
translation: 别开玩笑了，索卢斯。

english: Now I ask you a final time before I draw my blade:
translation: 在我拔剑之前，我最后问你一次：

english: WHAT do you WANT?
translation: 你究竟想干什么？

english: Solus.
translation: 索卢斯。

english: The Kinshra are not your personal soldiers Solus!
translation: 金什拉不是你的私人军队，索卢斯！

english: I thought you dead many moons past...
translation: 我早就以为你死了……

english: Or there will be blood shed between us.
translation: 否则我们之间就要流血了。

english: I will not waste any of my warriors in your foolish schemes!
translation: 我不会把我的战士浪费在你愚蠢的阴谋里！

english: Leave.
translation: 滚开。

english: I am looking for information about a very dangerous man... I believe he visited you quite recently.
translation: 我在打听一个非常危险的人的消息……我相信他最近拜访过你。

english: Ah, you mean that accursed Solus!
translation: 啊，你说的是那个该死的索卢斯！

english: Yes, him. I need to find him and make sure he doesn't come back to these lands.
translation: 是的，就是他。我需要找到他，确保他不会再回到这片土地。

english: You are working for the Temple Knights correct?
translation: 你是为圣殿骑士工作的，对吧？

english: No, don't deny it, I recognise the magical signature of your Communication Orb, a very nice piece of equipment indeed.
translation: 不，别否认，我认出了你通讯球的魔法印记，确实是个不错的装备。

english: I will tell you what I know in exchange for it, I believe such a device could be very useful to my research...
translation: 我会用我知道的情报来交换它，我相信这样的装置对我的研究非常有用……

english: [Player name], I've been monitoring your conversation; You can't let him have Temple Knight equipment, he is a Zamorakian!
translation: [Player name]，我一直在监视你们的对话；你不能让他拿走圣殿骑士的装备，他是个萨莫拉克教徒！

english: Even if we wanted to let the ZMI have access to our research, the built in security magics would destroy it before trading anyway!
translation: 即使我们想让ZMI接触我们的研究，内置的安全魔法也会在交易前将其摧毁！

english: Sorry, I cannot trade you my Communications Orb...
translation: 抱歉，我不能把我的通讯球给你……

english: Ah well, it was worth a try, but I did not seriously expect you to part with it.
translation: 啊，好吧，值得一试，但我没真指望你会放弃它。

english: Then perhaps you will be willing to trade something else for your information...?
translation: 那你也许愿意用别的东西来交换情报……？

english: I have little information, and would give it freely to make sure Solus is... disposed of... but unfortunately I am somewhat... financially distraught at the moment due to a recent... incident.
translation: 我没什么情报，而且我很乐意免费提供，以确保索卢斯被……处理掉……但不幸的是，由于最近的一次……事件，我目前有点……财务困难。

english: You mean Solus robbed you of all of your money?
translation: 你是说索卢斯抢走了你所有的钱？

english: ...Yes. He took a large degree of my research into various things as well, but my research is inside my mind and easily replaceable, the money I possessed was essential for my experimentation, and as I have no real skills to speak of, is not so easily replaceable...
translation: ……是的。他还拿走了我大量关于各种事物的研究，但研究在我脑子里，很容易重新获得，而我拥有的钱对我的实验至关重要，而且由于我没什么实际技能，钱就没那么容易重新获得了……

english: You want me to pay you for information?
translation: 你想让我付钱买情报？

english: No... not as such. You know of the substance known as 'rune essence' yes?
translation: 不……不完全是这样。你知道一种叫‘符文精华’的物质吧？

english: A small number of those will allow me to create runes from them, which I may then sell and get myself back on my feet.
translation: 少量这些精华就能让我制作符文，然后我可以卖掉它们，重新站起来。

english: Twenty parts of rune essence is the price for my information. You may take it or leave it...
translation: 二十份符文精华是我情报的价格。你可以接受，也可以拒绝……

english: Hi [Player name], it sounds like a pretty good deal for this kind of information to me, but it's your call. We REALLY need to find Solus as soon as possible though, who knows what kind of damage he might cause now he is at large again!
translation: 嗨，[Player name]，对我来说，用这个价格换取这种情报听起来很划算，但由你决定。我们真的需要尽快找到索卢斯，谁知道他现在逍遥法外会造成多大的破坏！

english: So you have information about the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar?
translation: 所以你有索卢斯.德拉加下落的情报？

english: I do indeed. My price for this information is 20 pieces of rune essence.
translation: 我确实有。这个情报的价格是20份符文精华。

english: Okay. I'll go get those for you then.
translation: 好吧。那我去给你拿。

english: I have some essences with me, if you would take those...?
translation: 我身上有一些精华，你愿意收下吗……？

english: I will not haggle you on my price. 20 Rune essences, and not a single essence less.
translation: 我不会跟你讨价还价。20份符文精华，一份都不能少。

english: Okay, I'll go get those for you then.
translation: 好吧，那我去给你拿。

english: I have your essences right here, take them.
translation: 我这里有你的精华，拿去吧。

english: Okay, now you have your essence, give me my information.
translation: 好了，现在你拿到精华了，给我情报吧。

english: Certainly. As I say, I have little information, but the cost was not too dear, was it?
translation: 当然。正如我所说，我情报不多，但这个代价不算太高，对吧？

english: Get on with it, I haven't got all day to waste.
translation: 快说吧，我可没时间浪费。

english: As you wish. As a powerful magician, I could sense his aura once I had encountered him, and it definitely moved East of here when he left me.
translation: 如你所愿。作为一个强大的法师，我遇到他后能感知到他的气场，他离开我时，气场确实向东移动了。

english: He went East. That's it? That's your 'information'?
translation: 他往东去了。就这些？这就是你的‘情报’？

english: I am sorry I cannot be more specific, but that is all of the information I have to offer...
translation: 很抱歉我不能说得更具体，但这就是我能提供的所有情报了……

english: Okay, so Daquarius told us he was probably somewhere with furry animals of some kind, and this mage has told us that he is East of here...
translation: 好的，达夸里乌斯告诉我们他可能在某个有毛茸茸动物的地方，而这位法师告诉我们他在东边……

english: Any ideas? Frankly, I'm stumped. I just don't have enough information to work out where he might be...
translation: 有什么想法吗？老实说，我毫无头绪。我只是没有足够的信息来推断他可能在哪儿……

english: Hmmm. Wolf fur... and the East... I know where he is.
translation: 嗯。狼毛皮……还有东边……我知道他在哪儿了。

english: He will be in Canifis. He must be.
translation: 他会在坎尼非斯村。一定是的。

english: Wow, that's some good thinking [Player name]! Okay, let's head there and get him!
translation: 哇，[Player name]想得真周到！好，我们出发去那里抓他！

english: Ok Player, I'm going to begin a low level scan for Solus now...
translation: 好的玩家，我现在要开始对索鲁斯进行低级别扫描……

english: Any signs?
translation: 有迹象吗？

english: Hmmm... These readings are very strange...
translation: 嗯……这些读数非常奇怪……

english: There's... SOMETHING here... You know, I'm sure I've seen readings like this somewhere before...
translation: 这里……有东西……你知道吗，我肯定以前在哪儿见过类似的读数……

english: Just give me a minute to cross reference the records in the Library. I know that I've seen readings like this before...
translation: 给我一分钟，我去图书馆交叉核对记录。我知道我以前见过这样的读数……

english: GAH! This is infuriating! It's on the tip of my tongue...
translation: 啊！真让人恼火！就在嘴边想不起来……

english: Well, that Zamorakian mage mentioned that he had a strong magical aura, perhaps that is it?
translation: 嗯，那个萨莫拉克法师提到他有强大的魔法光环，也许就是这个？

english: No...no, it is something...
translation: 不……不，是别的东西……

english: Oh my! I know what it is!
translation: 哦天哪！我知道是什么了！

english: Savant...?
translation: 学者……？

english: Many years ago the Temple Knights were studying teleportation techniques, and found a strange dimension that was accessed when teleporting..
translation: 许多年前，圣殿骑士在研究传送技术时，发现了一个在传送时进入的奇怪维度……

english: We stopped the research as it was too dangerous to be practically useful, but our initial studies showed that we could use the entire dimension as a kind of scrying glass to see a precise point where we wished to teleport to, then teleport extremely slowly between two points.
translation: 我们停止了研究，因为它太危险，没有实际用途，但我们的初步研究表明，我们可以将整个维度用作一种窥镜，看到我们想要传送到的精确点，然后在两点之间极其缓慢地传送。

english: How is teleporting really slowly particularly useful?
translation: 传送得特别慢有什么特别用处？

english: Well, basically, you are stretched so thinly between dimensions that you effectively become invisible!
translation: 嗯，基本上，你在维度之间被拉伸得如此之薄，以至于你实际上变得隐形了！

english: From your perspective you can see three places simultaneously, and can choose to move between all three at will!
translation: 从你的视角，你可以同时看到三个地方，并且可以随意在三个地方之间移动！

english: I'm... not sure I follow...
translation: 我……不太明白……

english: Let me give you an example: If you were in Falador castle, and wished to teleport to Varrock, then you could use this 'slow-teleport' technique to be in both places simultaneously, but invisible to anyone in either.
translation: 我给你举个例子：如果你在法拉多城堡，想要传送到维洛克城，那么你可以使用这种'慢速传送'技术同时出现在两个地方，但对两个地方的人来说都是隐形的。

english: You could also move freely between the two invisibly and then choose which place you wished to end up, simply by concentrating on the location you wanted to appear in.
translation: 你也可以隐形地在两者之间自由移动，然后只需专注于你想要出现的位置，就能选择最终出现在哪个地方。

english: Needless to say, in our line of work this could come in very handy for sneaking around unobserved...
translation: 不用说，在我们的工作中，这对于不被察觉地潜行非常有用……

english: But you abandoned this research? Why?
translation: 但你们放弃了这项研究？为什么？

english: It is far too dangerous. In my example I only used two places, but in practice there is a third place involved. It is a strange, empty dimension that teleports seem to pass through.
translation: 这太危险了。在我的例子中我只用了两个地方，但实际上还涉及第三个地方。那是一个奇怪的、空荡荡的维度，传送似乎会经过那里。

english: Frankly, the human mind isn't equipped to cope with processing so much information simultaneously, and the test subjects started to display... behavioral problems...
translation: 坦白说，人类的大脑无法同时处理这么多信息，测试对象开始表现出……行为问题……

english: Er... That doesn't sound good...
translation: 呃……听起来不太好……

english: No, it wasn't: Aggressiveness was highly increased, and there were numerous perceptual faults, hallucinations and the like.
translation: 是的，不好：攻击性大大增加，还有大量的感知错误、幻觉等等。

english: We ceased experimentation immediately, there are enough things in this world to haunt a Temple Knight, we did not see the need to create anymore.
translation: 我们立即停止了实验，这个世界上已经有足够多让圣殿骑士困扰的东西了，我们觉得没有必要再制造更多。

english: But this signature you are finding is the same as this 'slow-teleport' experiment created?
translation: 但你发现的这个信号和这个'慢速传送'实验产生的是一样的？

english: No... it is not exactly the same...
translation: 不……不完全一样……

english: But it is close enough to be a cause of concern.
translation: 但足够接近，值得担忧。

english: Either someone else has found this strange dimension and begun their own research, and reached the same conclusions that we did...
translation: 要么是其他人发现了这个奇怪维度并开始了自己的研究，得出了和我们相同的结论……

english: Or... We have had a security leak within the Temple Knights and abandoned research has been sold to our enemies!
translation: 或者……圣殿骑士内部出现了安全泄漏处，被放弃的研究被卖给了我们的敌人！

english: Well, I can see how that might be a cause for concern, but right now our priority is Solus, right?
translation: 嗯，我明白这可能会引起担忧，但现在我们的首要任务是索鲁斯，对吧？

english: Yes [player name], you're right. But if he is using this 'slow-teleport' technique, then that means it is going to be a lot harder to catch him!
translation: 是的[player name]，你说得对。但如果他正在使用这种'慢速传送'技术，那就意味着要抓住他要困难得多！

english: Because he is invisible and in three separate places simultaneously?
translation: 因为他隐形了，同时出现在三个不同的地方？

english: Exactly. Listen, I might be able to block his teleportation magics using your CommOrb, but I will need you to get close to him, and if we're unlucky then he will end up teleporting to the point away from you instead of appearing in front of you
translation: 正是。听着，我或许可以用你的通讯球来阻断他的传送魔法，但我需要你靠近他，如果我们运气不好，他最终可能会传送到远离你的地方，而不是出现在你面前。

english: Well, we have nothing else to try, right? What will I have to do?
translation: 嗯，我们也没有别的办法了，对吧？我需要做什么？

english: Use the 'Scan' function of your CommOrb, if he is in the vicinity it should knock him out of his 'in-between' state, and make him appear.
translation: 使用你的通讯球的'扫描'功能，如果他在附近，应该能把他从'中间'状态中打出来，让他现身。

english: So I should try a scan here in Canifis?
translation: 所以我应该在坎尼非斯村这里尝试扫描？

english: That would seem best... Savant over and out.
translation: 那似乎最好……学者通话完毕。

english: Hello there [player name]. What can I help you with?
translation: 你好[player name]。有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: Hi Savant. Where am I supposed to look for Solus again?
translation: 嗨，学者。我该去哪儿找索鲁斯来着？

english: The clue was that Solus is somewhere where you might find Fur, East of Varrock...
translation: 线索是索卢斯在维洛克城东边某个能找到毛皮的地方……

english: Nothing thanks Savant, I was just checking this thing still worked!
translation: 没什么，谢谢学者，我只是检查一下这东西还能用！

english: You shouldn't really waste my time like this, [Player]...
translation: 你不应该这样浪费我的时间，[Player]……

english: Still no harm done, I guess! Call me if you need me!
translation: 不过也没什么坏处，我想！需要我就叫我！

english: There doesn't seem to be anything unusual about these readings Player... Looks like your hunch was wrong. Savant out.
translation: 这些读数似乎没有什么异常，玩家……看来你的直觉错了。学者完毕。

english: Negative result, Player. Looks like you're barking up the wrong tree. Savant out.
translation: 结果阴性，玩家。看来你找错方向了。学者完毕。

english: Scan results are negative, Player. Savant out.
translation: 扫描结果阴性，玩家。学者完毕。

english: Background magical levels all seem within normal tolerable limits Player...
translation: 背景魔法水平似乎都在正常可接受范围内，玩家……

english: I don't think this can be the right place... Savant out.
translation: 我不认为这是正确的地方……学者完毕。

english: Checking incoming data...
translation: 正在检查传入数据……

english: Nope, all clear here. Savant out.
translation: 没有，这里一切正常。学者完毕。

english: Nope... I'm not picking up anything unusual near here... Savant out.
translation: 没有……我在这里附近没有检测到任何异常……学者完毕。

english: Analysis is negative I'm afraid, Player. Savant out.
translation: 恐怕分析结果是阴性，玩家。学者完毕。

english: The background magical levels are slightly above average here, but not enough to signify anything.
translation: 这里的背景魔法水平略高于平均水平，但不足以说明任何问题。

english: I think you're in the wrong place. Savant out.
translation: 我觉得你找错地方了。学者完毕。

english: Results are all-clear, Player. Savant out.
translation: 结果一切正常，玩家。学者完毕。

english: Not picking up any unusual readings here, Player... Savant out.
translation: 这里没有检测到任何异常读数，玩家……学者完毕。

english: Well well well! I was wondering when the White Knights would come looking for me!
translation: 哎呀呀！我还在想白骑士什么时候会来找我呢！

english: Well you'll have to be quicker than that, my friend!
translation: 那你得比这更快才行，我的朋友！

english: He got away...
translation: 他逃走了……

english: So what can we do now?
translation: 那我们现在能做什么？

english: Wait a second...
translation: 等一下……

english: There was another item in the teleport with him...
translation: 和他一起传送的还有另一件物品……

english: Well, I might be able to retrieve it from the slow-teleport!
translation: 嗯，我或许能从慢速传送中把它取回来！

english: It might give us a clue as to the second location Solus is in!
translation: 它可能会给我们提供索鲁斯所在的第二个位置的线索！

english: Well what are you waiting for? Try and get it!
translation: 那你还在等什么？试着把它拿回来！

english: It's a beer?
translation: 是一杯啤酒？

english: I doubt he's getting drunk in hiding...
translation: 我怀疑他躲起来喝醉了……

english: That type of beer is only sold in one place that I know of
translation: 那种啤酒据我所知只有一个地方有卖

english: It's...a wizard hat?
translation: 是……一顶法师帽？

english: So he is improving his dress sense you think?
translation: 所以你觉得他在提升穿衣品味？

english: I think it's more likely he happens to be in an area where there are many wizards around.
translation: 我觉得更可能的是他碰巧在一个周围有很多法师的区域。

english: It's... ear muffs?
translation: 是……耳罩？

english: Why on gielinor would he be wearing those?
translation: 他到底为什么要戴那个？

english: Well, they are standard equipment for any slayer looking to kill Banshees...
translation: 嗯，它们是任何想要猎杀女妖的杀戮者的标准装备……

english: It's... goblin armour?
translation: 是……哥布林盔甲？

english: Goblin armour? Why would he wear that?
translation: 哥布林盔甲？他为什么要穿那个？

english: Well, it must be a place here there is a lot of it around for it to have been caught in his teleport...
translation: 嗯，那一定是一个周围有很多哥布林盔甲的地方，才会被卷入他的传送……

english: It's...a fake beard?
translation: 是……假胡子？

english: What the...? You think he is in disguise somewhere?
translation: 什么……？你觉得他在某个地方伪装了？

english: I've seen this design of beard before... But I cannot remember where...
translation: 我以前见过这种胡子的样式……但我不记得在哪儿了……

english: It's... fur?
translation: 是……毛皮？

english: Fur? How does that help us find him?
translation: 毛皮？那怎么帮我们找到他？

english: Well, this is not fur directly from an animal, look it has been prepared for sale...
translation: 嗯，这不是直接从动物身上取下的毛皮，你看它已经被加工准备出售了……

english: It's... an eye patch?
translation: 是……一个眼罩？

english: Do you think he might be injured?
translation: 你觉得他可能受伤了吗？

english: No, I think he must be somewhere where there are a lot of people who wear eye patches...
translation: 不，我觉得他一定是在一个有很多人戴眼罩的地方……

english: It's... a hat?
translation: 是……一顶帽子？

english: How does a hat help us?
translation: 一顶帽子能帮我们什么？

english: I'm sorry, I don't know. Maybe somewhere where hats like this are common?
translation: 抱歉，我不知道。也许是在这种帽子常见的地方？

english: It's... a ticket?
translation: 是……一张票？

english: I am sure I have seen tickets like that somewhere before...
translation: 我肯定我以前在哪儿见过这样的票……

english: Well, wherever it is that you have seen them, I would guess he is nearby!
translation: 嗯，不管你在哪儿见过它们，我猜他就在附近！

english: It's... a cloak?
translation: 是……一件斗篷？

english: Very stylish, but it doesn't seem to be his colour.
translation: 很时尚，但似乎不是他的颜色。

english: I don't think he would have been wearing it... But he might be nearby somewhere that sells this type of cloak.
translation: 我不认为他会穿着它……但他可能就在附近某个卖这种斗篷的地方。

english: It's... a toy horse?
translation: 这是……一匹玩具马？

english: What a weird thing to be carrying...
translation: 带着这种东西真奇怪……

english: Well [player name], bear in mind that it might just be an object that as in the vicinity rather than something he was carrying...
translation: 嗯，[player name]，记住，这可能只是附近的一个物品，而不是他随身携带的东西……

english: It's... some big frog legs?
translation: 这是……一些大青蛙腿？

english: The frog those came from must be huge!
translation: 那只青蛙一定很大！

english: I have heard rumours of giant frogs in a subterranean area...
translation: 我听说过地下区域有巨型青蛙的传闻……

english: It's... an unholy symbol!
translation: 这是……一个邪恶护符！

english: The symbol of Zamorak? That tells us nothing.
translation: 扎莫拉克圣徽？这什么也说明不了。

english: Yes, sadly there are many Zamorakians in these lands...But it must be somewhere of special significance...
translation: 是的，可惜这片土地上有很多扎莫拉克教徒……但它一定在某个有特殊意义的地方……

english: It's... a worm?
translation: 这是……一条蠕虫？

english: Maybe he's doing a little fishing?
translation: 也许他在钓鱼？

english: No, this is a very specific worm that is only found in one place...
translation: 不，这是一种非常特殊的蠕虫，只在一个地方能找到……

english: It's... a banana?
translation: 这是……一根香蕉？

english: A banana? How is that a clue to where he is?
translation: 一根香蕉？这怎么能成为他在哪里的线索？

english: Well, for it to have got caught in his teleport, it must be a place where there are many around...
translation: 嗯，既然它被他的传送卷了进去，那一定是一个周围有很多香蕉的地方……

english: [player name], I want you to search for him, and use your Comm-Orb to scan for him if you think he is nearby!
translation: [player name]，我要你去寻找他，如果你觉得他在附近，就用你的通讯球扫描他！

english: Okay I'll head off immediately.  Let's hope we're not too late.
translation: 好的，我马上出发。希望我们不会太晚。

english: You again???
translation: 又是你？？？

english: I warn you, if you interfere with my plans I will see you suffer!
translation: 我警告你，如果你干涉我的计划，我会让你吃苦头！

english: Solus! I am here by authority of the White Knights of Falador!
translation: 索卢斯！我奉法拉多城白骑士之命前来！

english: Ha! Like I care!
translation: 哈！我才不在乎！

english: Okay, I am attempting to block his teleport...
translation: 好的，我正在尝试阻止他的传送……

english: Oh, we have a little magical skill do we?
translation: 哦，我们还有点魔法本事是吧？

english: Then let's see how you deal with this!
translation: 那就看看你怎么应付这个！

english: I should have known he would try something like that!
translation: 我早该知道他会来这一手！

english: I'm sorry [player name], I should have stopped him using that spell...
translation: 对不起，[player name]，我本该阻止他使用那个法术的……

english: That doesn't matter right now Savant, did you get a reading of where his teleport was coming from?
translation: 现在没关系，学者，你读到他传送的来源地了吗？

english: The spell is still running, wait a moment... There!
translation: 法术还在运行，等一下……有了！

english: It's a cape...
translation: 这是一件斗篷……

english: I'm not sure how much help in tracking him that is.
translation: 我不确定这对追踪他有多大帮助。

english: More than you might think Savant. This type of cape used to be called the Cape of Champions...
translation: 比你想象的更有帮助，学者。这种斗篷以前被称为冠军斗篷……

english: Well I still don't know what help that is, but if you have an idea here he might be you should head there immediately!
translation: 好吧，我还是不知道那有什么帮助，但如果你有想法他可能在哪里，你应该立刻前往那里！

english: Well now, I am beginning to get sick of your constant interference!
translation: 哼，我开始厌倦你不断的干涉了！

english: Or at least I would be if you weren't so laughably easy to escape from.
translation: 或者，要不是你逃起来那么容易得可笑，我早就烦了。

english: *cough* Savant? *cough* I can't... *cough*
translation: *咳嗽* 学者？*咳嗽* 我不能……*咳嗽*

english: He threw some kind of smoke at me or something...
translation: 他朝我扔了某种烟雾之类的东西……

english: Don't worry about it [player name], he may have escaped AGAIN, but I still have him on my tracking spell...
translation: 别担心，[player name]，他可能又逃了，但我仍然用追踪法术锁定着他……

english: Okay, the smoke's cleared, and you don't seem to have been damaged by it!
translation: 好了，烟雾散了，你似乎没有受到伤害！

english: You're lucky I think, readings show it was highly poisonous!
translation: 我觉得你很幸运，读数显示那烟雾有剧毒！

english: Let's see if I grabbed anything useful from him while he was teleporting...
translation: 看看他在传送时我有没有抓到什么有用的东西……

english: Okay, I'm on my way. This Solus guy is really beginning to get on my nerves!
translation: 好的，我这就出发。这个叫索卢斯的家伙真开始让我恼火了！

english: This is getting very tiresome!
translation: 这变得越来越烦人了！

english: Little White Knight, I command powers beyond your imagination!
translation: 小小白骑士，我掌握着你无法想象的力量！

english: If you do not cease pursuing me, I will be forced to use them upon you!
translation: 如果你不停止追捕我，我将被迫对你使用它们！

english: You can't threaten me old man...
translation: 你吓唬不了我，老头……

english: Dead or alive, you're coming with me.
translation: 不论死活，你都得跟我走。

english: This charade bores me!
translation: 这场闹剧让我厌烦！

english: [player name] I am reading a huge power surge from Solus, be very careful...
translation: [player name] 我读到索卢斯身上有巨大的能量涌流，请务必小心……

english: Ow! What happened?
translation: 哎哟！发生了什么？

english: I managed to shield you from most of his attack, and bring you back to Falador Castle, but you are lucky I was monitoring, that could have killed you!
translation: 我设法用盾挡住了他的大部分攻击，把你带回了法拉多城堡，但幸好我在监控，那一下可能杀了你！

english: I don't understand though Savant, you said he could only be in a few places simultaneously...
translation: 但我不明白，学者，你说他只能同时出现在几个地方……

english: But he keeps getting away! And he keeps moving around!
translation: 但他总是逃脱！而且他一直在移动！

english: You're right [player name], I don't know how he is doing it...
translation: 你说得对，[player name]，我不知道他是怎么做到的……

english: But he can't run forever, and every time he tries something against you, I can update your CommOrb to prevent it.
translation: 但他不可能永远逃跑，每次他对你耍花招，我都能更新你的通讯球来阻止。

english: So he isn't going to shoot me like that again?
translation: 所以他不会再那样射我了？

english: No, [player name]. I am sorry that I let him hurt you like that...
translation: 不会了，[player name]。我很抱歉让他那样伤害你……

english: But keep chasing him, together we are going to bring him to justice!
translation: 但继续追他，我们一起把他绳之以法！

english: You're right about that, there's no way I'm letting him get away with treating me like that!
translation: 你说得对，我绝不会让他那样对我后还能逃脱！

english: So did we get any clues to his real location from that last scan?
translation: 那么上次扫描我们有没有得到他真实位置的线索？

english: That's the spirit [player name]! Just awaiting the data to come through...
translation: 这才像话，[player name]！正在等待数据传输过来……

english: It's... a very strange weapon?
translation: 这是……一件非常奇怪的武器？

english: I recognise that...
translation: 我认得那个……

english: It's the type of spear used by the Dorgeshuun goblins.
translation: 那是多尔戈什恩地精使用的矛。

english: The who? I've never heard of them before...
translation: 谁？我以前从没听说过他们……

english: Well, if you know who or what they are, you should go and see them, Solus must be nearby!
translation: 嗯，如果你知道他们是谁或是什么，你应该去看看他们，索卢斯一定在附近！

english: You should probably take a minute to restock on supplies and heal up though [player name].
translation: 不过，[player name]，你最好花点时间补充补给品和治疗一下。

english: I know we can find him and bring him to justice, but we don't want you dying while doing so!
translation: 我知道我们能找到他并把他绳之以法，但我们不想你在过程中死掉！

english: Okay Savant, I'll heal up, then go looking for him amongst the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 好的，学者，我会治疗好，然后去多尔戈什恩中找他。

english: Oh thank you, you have freed me!
translation: 哦，谢谢你，你解放了我！

english: W-what? Who are you?
translation: 什——什么？你是谁？

english: Oh, I am but a poor maiden kidnapped by the evil Solus!
translation: 哦，我只是一个被邪恶的索卢斯绑架的可怜少女！

english: But you chased him so hard, that now I am free...
translation: 但你追他追得那么紧，所以现在我自由了……

english: [player name], I am getting some strange readings from this 'maiden'...
translation: [player name]，我从这个'少女'身上读到一些奇怪的读数……

english: Muhahaha! Sucker!
translation: 呜哈哈哈！傻瓜！

english: Sorry [player name], I should have spotted his little trick earlier...
translation: 对不起，[player name]，我本该早点识破他的小把戏……

english: Are you okay? That looked like a nasty sucker punch...
translation: 你还好吗？那看起来像是一记阴险的偷袭……

english: Oooohhhh...
translation: 哦哦哦……

english: Did anyone get the number of that wagon?
translation: 有人记下那辆马车的号码了吗？

english: Don't worry [player name], I am reconfiguring your CommOrb to compensate for any camouflage magics.
translation: 别担心，[player name]，我正在重新配置你的通讯球以应对任何伪装魔法。

english: Please tell me you have a reading on his actual location by now, this chasing him around the houses is becoming irritating...
translation: 请告诉我你现在已经读到了他的实际位置，这样到处追他变得很烦人……

english: No, but every time he escapes you I am shutting down his teleport to a specific area.
translation: 没有，但每次他逃脱你，我都在关闭他传送到特定区域的能力。

english: I think we are on the final stretch now [player name]!
translation: 我想我们现在到了最后阶段，[player name]！

english: I will be able to shut his teleports down permanently in 2, perhaps 3, more scans...
translation: 再过2次，也许3次扫描，我就能永久关闭他的传送……

english: Keep up the chase [player name]! We nearly have him cornered!
translation: 继续追，[player name]！我们快把他逼到绝路了！

english: Uh... Out of interest, what am I going to do with an insane super-powerful murderous mage when he's cornered?
translation: 呃……出于好奇，当我把一个疯狂的超强杀人法师逼到绝路时，我要拿他怎么办？

english: Leave that to me and the Temple Knights [player name].
translation: 把那个交给我和圣殿骑士，[player name]。

english: Just follow your orders and continue the chase, and his days are numbered.
translation: 只需服从命令继续追，他的日子不多了。

english: Well okay then, where should I head now?
translation: 那好吧，我现在该去哪里？

english: Examining readings now...
translation: 正在检查读数……

english: Let's see what we managed to snag in the scan this time!
translation: 看看这次扫描我们抓到了什么！

english: Okay, I'm on my way – and Solus had better watch out, I am up to here with his annoying tricks!
translation: 好的，我出发了——索卢斯最好小心点，我受够了他那些烦人的把戏！

english: Well you ARE a persistent [fellow/madam] aren't you?
translation: 你还真是执着啊，[fellow/madam]？

english: I am here to take you in Solus. You can forget your little tricks.
translation: 我是来抓你的，索卢斯。你可以忘掉你的小把戏了。

english: Little tricks, you say? Well how about this one!
translation: 小把戏，你说？那这个怎么样！

english: Say hello to my little friend! And goodbye to me!
translation: 跟我的小朋友打个招呼！然后跟我告别！

english: Solus commands you to die now!
translation: 索卢斯命令你现在去死！

english: Okay, we have our scan results...
translation: 好了，我们有扫描结果了……

english: It's some kind of highly magically susceptible rock...
translation: 这是一种对魔法高度敏感的岩石……

english: Isn't that the same rock that you gave that Zamorakian mage in Varrock?
translation: 那不是你给维洛克城那个萨莫拉克法师的同一块石头吗？

english: Yeah it is, which means I know where he is, and how to get there!
translation: 没错，所以我知道他在哪，也知道怎么去那里了！

english: It's a mine for Rune Essence, but there are only supposed to be a few people who know how to get there...
translation: 那是一个符文精华矿，但应该只有少数人知道怎么去那里……

english: Let's worry about that later; Go get Solus!
translation: 那个以后再说；去抓索卢斯！

english: There he is!
translation: 他在那里！

english: Okay, I've blocked all exits from this place except for Temple Knight teleports...
translation: 好了，我已经封锁了这里除了圣殿骑士传送以外的所有出口……

english: I think we finally have him!
translation: 我想我们终于抓住他了！

english: Argh! I am so sick of your interference!
translation: 啊！我真是受够了你们的干涉！

english: I think it is time we end this once and for all!
translation: 我想是时候彻底了结这一切了！

english: In the name of the White Knights of Falador, and of the Temple Knights of Saradomin, I am placing you under arrest!
translation: 以法拉多城白骑士和萨拉多明圣殿骑士的名义，我逮捕你！

english: You and what army?
translation: 你和哪支军队？

english: This one, Solus!
translation: 这支，索卢斯！

english: You'll never take me alive!
translation: 你们休想活捉我！

english: You... You meddlesome... You meddlesome freak!
translation: 你……你这个多管闲事的……你这个多管闲事的怪胎！

english: Or at least I would be if you weren't so laughably easy to escape from!
translation: 或者至少，要不是你逃得那么可笑地容易，我本该如此的！

english: Well you ARE a persistent fellow aren't you?
translation: 哼，你还真是个执着的家伙，对吧？

english: Well you ARE a persistent madam aren't you?
translation: 哼，你还真是个执着的女士，对吧？

english: Such mistrust of your forgotten ally!
translation: 竟如此不信任你被遗忘的盟友！

english: Why did I ever leave these lands?
translation: 我当初为何要离开这片土地？

english: Make sure you are more prepared to follow orders next time I come to your little Taverley hideout!
translation: 下次我去你那个塔韦利村的小窝时，你最好准备好服从命令！

english: Perhaps you need reminding!
translation: 也许你需要被提醒一下！

english: I won't have to remind you of my power again next time!
translation: 下次我就不用再提醒你我的力量了！

english: Wishful thinking, perhaps?
translation: 也许只是痴心妄想？

english: I just thought you would like to know that I have returned as your new master.
translation: 我只是想让你知道，我已经作为你的新主人回来了。

english: Still alive Daquarius?
translation: 还活着呢，达夸里乌斯？

english: You would threaten Solus Dellagar?
translation: 你竟敢威胁索卢斯.德拉加？

english: Still festering in your pathetic little dungeon, I see.
translation: 还在你那可怜的小地牢里发臭呢，我看到了。

english: Oh... nothing much.
translation: 哦……没什么。

english: Lord Daquarius!
translation: 达夸里乌斯领主！

english: And is that your final answer Daquarius?
translation: 这就是你的最终答案吗，达夸里乌斯？

english: Have you forgotten just who I am?
translation: 你忘了我是谁吗？

english: No, I will be content with simply taking your money sir!
translation: 不，我只满足于拿走你的钱，先生！

english: Very soon!
translation: 很快！

english: If I killed you then you would no longer continue with your most interesting research!
translation: 如果我杀了你，你就无法继续你那最有趣的研究了！

english: Well, a most productive trip on all accounts!
translation: 嗯，总的来说，真是一次收获颇丰的旅行！

english: You are going nowhere just yet sir
translation: 你哪儿也去不了，先生。

english: A shrine to Zamorak in the middle of Varrock?
translation: 在维洛克城中心建一个扎莫拉克神龛？

english: Well I am particularly interested in your brains at the moment!
translation: 嗯，我现在对你的脑子特别感兴趣！

english: Kill you?
translation: 杀了你？

english: My dear fellow, if I wanted you dead, you ALREADY WOULD BE!
translation: 我亲爱的伙计，如果我想让你死，你早就死了！

english: But you wouldn't want me taking those and leaving, now would you?
translation: 但你不会想让我拿走那些然后离开的，对吧？

english: I will see you again...
translation: 我们还会再见面的……

english: Ah!
translation: 啊！

english: HAH HAH HAH!
translation: 哈哈哈！

english: Well, what have we here?
translation: 嗯，看看这是谁？

english: But he is not here, is he?
translation: 但他不在这里，对吧？

english: Player, Solus is very weakened, and we don't have any more fighters to spare!
translation: 玩家，索卢斯非常虚弱了，我们也没有多余的战士了！

english: Take him out now! This might be your only chance!
translation: 现在就干掉他！这可能是你唯一的机会！

english: YOU DIE NOW!
translation: 你去死吧！

english: Now that Solus is defeated you should take his hat to Sir Amik to prove that you were responsible.
translation: 既然索卢斯被打败了，你应该把他的帽子拿给阿米克爵士，证明是你干的。

english: Now let's head back...
translation: 现在我们回去吧……

english: ...and may I say:
translation: ……而且我得说：

english: VERY well done, [player name]. Very well done indeed.
translation: 干得非常好，[player name]。真的非常好。

english: Hello there Player. What can I help you with?
translation: 你好啊，玩家。有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: Hi Savant. Where am I supposed to be looking for Solus again?
translation: 嗨，学者。我该去哪里找索卢斯来着？

english: You're not looking for Solus Player, you are supposed to be taking his hat to Sir Amik of the White Knights as proof that you have defeated him.
translation: 你不是在找索卢斯，玩家，你应该把他的帽子拿给白骑士的阿米克爵士，作为你打败他的证据。

english: But I lost his hat...
translation: 但我弄丢了他的帽子……

english: I have sent you a duplicate, try not to lose it.
translation: 我给了你一个复制品，别再弄丢了。

english: Go and take it to Sir Amik so that he can make you a full-fledged White Knight!
translation: 拿去给阿米克爵士，这样他就能让你成为一名正式的白骑士了！

english: I did it Tiffy! I brought Solus in for capture!
translation: 我做到了，蒂菲！我把索卢斯抓回来了！

english: Had a little help doing it though, didn't you, what?
translation: 不过还是有人帮了点忙，对吧，嗯？

english: Yes... But I did all the legwork...
translation: 是的……但跑腿的活都是我干的……

english: That you did Initiate, that you did.
translation: 确实是你干的，见习骑士，确实是你。

english: Now take that hat of Solus over to Sir Amik, and we can begin to process your application form as a Temple Knight again, what?
translation: 现在把索卢斯的帽子拿给阿米克爵士，我们就可以开始处理你再次成为圣殿骑士的申请了，嗯？

english: Okay Tiffy, I'll be back in a jiffy!
translation: 好的，蒂菲，我马上回来！

english: Hello, friend.
translation: 你好，朋友。

english: You are supposed to be looking for Solus Dellagar!
translation: 你应该在找索卢斯.德拉加！

english: The insane magician who is loose once more upon these lands? Remember?
translation: 那个再次在这片土地上逍遥法外的疯狂法师？还记得吗？

english: But... I've already done that!
translation: 但是……我已经做完了！

english: You have??? Then you must have some proof of your encounter!
translation: 你做完了？？？那你一定有遭遇战的证据！

english: A weapon perhaps, or an item of clothing?
translation: 也许是一件武器，或者一件衣物？

english: Well of course I do! I mean I did...Look, I lost it okay? Stop hassling me!
translation: 我当然有！我是说我有过……听着，我弄丢了行了吧？别烦我了！

english: Look, I am very sorry Player, but if you have no proof of your encounter, I can hardly promote you to be a full White Knight, now can I?
translation: 听着，我很抱歉，玩家，但如果你没有遭遇战的证据，我很难提拔你为正式的白骑士，对吧？

english: Oh man...I think I've messed up...Maybe Savant can help me out somehow? I'd better speak to her.
translation: 哦，天哪……我想我搞砸了……也许学者能帮我？我最好去跟她说说。

english: Well of course I do! I just happened to think it would be a good idea to leave it in the bank for safe keeping.
translation: 我当然有！我只是碰巧觉得把它放在银行里保管是个好主意。

english: Well bring it here so that I can authenticate your claim and make you a White Knight!
translation: 那就把它拿来，我好验证你的说法，让你成为白骑士！

english: Well of course I do! I have it right here!
translation: 我当然有！我就在这儿！

english: Well hand it over then, and let's see it!
translation: 那就把它交出来，让我看看！

english: Now that you are a White Knight I should perhaps explain a little about how our system works.
translation: 既然你现在是白骑士了，我或许该解释一下我们系统的运作方式。

english: We are the tower guards – our business is our own!
translation: 我们是塔的守卫——我们的事不劳你费心！

english: The Watchtower here works by the power of magic. An ancient spell designed to ward off ogres that has been in place here for many moons.
translation: 这座瞭望塔是靠魔法力量运作的。一道古老的咒语，用来抵御食人魔，已经在这里维持了许多个月亮。

english: Try searching the surrounding area. If you find anything unusual, bring it here. Try the bushes - I've read enough adventure stories to know that clues get caught in bushes all the time.
translation: 试着搜索一下周围区域。如果你发现任何不寻常的东西，就带到这里来。试试那些灌木丛——我读过够多的冒险故事，知道线索总是卡在灌木丛里。

english: I've got some questions about the search for evidence.
translation: 我想问一些关于搜索证据的问题。

english: Hello again. Did you find anything of interest?
translation: 又见面了。你找到什么有趣的东西了吗？

english: No, sorry, nothing yet.
translation: 没有，抱歉，还没找到。

english: Oh dear, oh dear, there must be something, somewhere...
translation: 哦天哪，哦天哪，一定有什么东西，在某个地方……

english: I have this [robe/dagger/armour/eyepatch]...
translation: 我找到了这个[robe/dagger/armour/eyepatch]……

english: No, sorry, this is not evidence. You need to keep searching, I'm afraid.
translation: 不，抱歉，这不是证据。恐怕你得继续搜索。

english: Have a look at these...
translation: 看看这些……

english: Interesting, very interesting.
translation: 有意思，非常有意思。

english: Long nails...grey in colour...well chewed...
translation: 长指甲……灰色的……被咬得很厉害……

english: Of course! They belong to a skavid!
translation: 当然！它们属于一个斯卡维德！

english: A skavid?
translation: 斯卡维德？

english: A servant race to the ogres: grey, depressed-looking creatures, always losing nails, teeth and hair!
translation: 食人魔的仆从种族：灰色、神情沮丧的生物，总是掉指甲、牙齿和头发！

english: They inhabit the caves in the Feldip Hills.
translation: 它们住在费迪普丘陵的洞穴里。

english: They normally keep to themselves, though. It's unusual for them to venture from their caves.
translation: 不过它们通常独来独往。从洞穴里跑出来很不寻常。

english: What do you suggest I do?
translation: 你建议我怎么做？

english: It's no good searching the caves. Well, not yet, anyway.
translation: 搜索洞穴没什么用。嗯，至少现在还不是时候。

english: They are deep and complex. The only way you will navigate the caves is to have a map or something.
translation: 它们又深又复杂。你唯一能在洞穴里穿行的办法就是有一张地图之类的东西。

english: It may be that the ogres have one...
translation: 也许食人魔有一张……

english: And how do you know that?
translation: 你怎么知道的？

english: Well... I don't.
translation: 嗯……我不知道。

english: You need to be fearless and gain entrance to Gu'Tanoth, the city of the ogres, then find out how to navigate the caves.
translation: 你需要无所畏惧，进入食人魔的城市古塔诺斯，然后找出如何在洞穴中穿行的方法。

english: That sounds scary...
translation: 听起来好吓人……

english: Ogres are nasty creatures, yes. Only a strong warrior, and a clever one at that, can get the better of them.
translation: 食人魔是恶心的生物，没错。只有强壮的战士，而且还得是聪明的，才能胜过它们。

english: What do I need to do to get into the city?
translation: 我需要做什么才能进入那座城市？

english: You'll need some way to make the guards let you in.
translation: 你需要想办法让守卫放你进去。

english: You could start by checking out the ogre settlements around here. Tribal ogres often dislike their neighbours... In the meantime, I'll throw those fingernails out for you.
translation: 你可以先查查这附近的食人魔部落。部落食人魔通常不喜欢它们的邻居……与此同时，我会帮你把那些指甲扔掉。

english: I won't bother, then.
translation: 那我就不费事了。

english: Won't bother? Won't bother!
translation: 不费事？不费事！

english: Perhaps this quest is too hard for you?
translation: 也许这个任务对你来说太难了？

english: Shall I search the caves?
translation: 要我搜索洞穴吗？

english: Aha! A robe. This could be a clue...
translation: 啊哈！一件长袍。这可能是个线索……

english: Here's some armour; it could be evidence...
translation: 这里有些盔甲；可能是证据……

english: Aha, a dagger! I wonder if this is evidence...
translation: 啊哈，一把匕首！我想知道这是不是证据……

english: I've found an eye patch; I had better show this to the Watchtower Wizard.
translation: 我找到了一个眼罩；我最好把这个给瞭望塔法师看看。

english: What's this? Disgusting! Some fingernails. They may be a clue though... I'd better take them.
translation: 这是什么？真恶心！一些指甲。不过它们可能是个线索……我最好带上它们。

english: I've got some questions regarding the tribal ogres.
translation: 我想问一些关于部落食人魔的问题。

english: I am having difficulty with the tribes.
translation: 我在部落那里遇到了困难。

english: Talk to them face to face and don't show any fear. Make sure you are rested and well fed, and fight the good fight!
translation: 和他们面对面交谈，不要表现出任何恐惧。确保你休息好了、吃饱了，然后好好打一场！

english: I have everything under control.
translation: 一切都在我的掌控之中。

english: Good, good! I will expect the crystals back shortly then...
translation: 好，好！那我期待你很快把水晶带回来……

english: I have lost something the ogres gave to me.
translation: 我弄丢了食人魔给我的东西。

english: Oh, deary me! Well, there's nothing I can do about it. You will have to go back to them, I'm afraid.
translation: 哦，天哪！嗯，我也无能为力。恐怕你得回去找他们。

english: What do you want, small t'ing?
translation: 你想要什么，小东西？

english: I seek entrance to the city of ogres.
translation: 我想进入食人魔的城市。

english: Hahaha! You'll never get in there.
translation: 哈哈哈！你永远进不去的。

english: I'll find a way, trust me.
translation: 我会找到办法的，相信我。

english: Bold words for a t'ing so small.
translation: 对这么小的东西来说，口气倒不小。

english: I could do something for you...
translation: 我可以为你做点什么……

english: Hahaha! This creature t'inks it can help me! I would eat you now, but for your puny size.
translation: 哈哈哈！这个生物以为它能帮我！我现在就会吃了你，可惜你太小了。

english: Prove to me your might: bring me the bones of an adult dragon to chew on, and I'll eat them, not you.
translation: 向我证明你的力量：给我带一副成年龙的骨头来啃，我就吃它们，不吃你。

english: Die, creature!
translation: 去死吧，生物！

english: Hahaha! It t'inks it's a match for Toban, does it?
translation: 哈哈哈！它以为自己能和托班匹敌，是吗？

english: Hahaha! Small t'ing returns. Did you bring the dragon bone?
translation: 哈哈哈！小东西回来了。你带龙骨头了吗？

english: I don't have what you want.
translation: 我没有你想要的东西。

english: Then you shall get nothing from me!
translation: 那你从我这里什么都得不到！

english: When I say I will get something, I get it!
translation: 我说到做到！

english: Hahaha! Small t'ing has done it. Toban is glad - take this...
translation: 哈哈哈！小东西做到了。托班很高兴——拿着这个……

english: The small t'ing returns; what do you want now?
translation: 小东西回来了；你现在想要什么？

english: I seek another task.
translation: 我想找点别的事做。

english: Have you arrived for dinner? Hahaha! Be gone, small t'ing!
translation: 你是来吃晚饭的吗？哈哈哈！滚开，小东西！

english: I can't find the relic part you gave me.
translation: 我找不到你给我的那个遗物部件了。

english: Small t'ing, you lie to me! I always says that small t'ings are big trouble.
translation: 小东西，你骗我！我总说小东西是大麻烦。

english: I think I need a key of some sort.
translation: 我想我需要某种钥匙。

english: Why you here, little t'ing?
translation: 你为什么来这里，小东西？

english: You got no business there!
translation: 你没资格去那里！

english: Just a minute... Maybe if you did somet'ing for me, I might help you get in.
translation: 等一下……也许如果你为我做点什么，我可能会帮你进去。

english: What can I do to help an ogre?
translation: 我能做什么来帮助一个食人魔？

english: South-east of here der is more ogres - the name of the chieftain is Toban. He stole gold from me and I want it back!
translation: 从这里往东南有更多食人魔——酋长的名字叫托班。他偷了我的金子，我要拿回来！

english: Here is a key to the chest it's in. If you bring it here, I may reward you...
translation: 这是装金子的箱子的钥匙。如果你把它带到这里，我可能会奖励你……

english: I have come to kill you!
translation: 我是来杀你的！

english: Kill me, eh? You shall be crushed. Guards!
translation: 杀我，嗯？你会被碾碎的。卫兵！

english: Where my gold from dat dirty Toban?
translation: 我从那个肮脏的托班那里拿的金子呢？

english: Well, well, the little t'ing has got it! Take dis to show little t'ing is a friend to da ogres. Hahahahaha!
translation: 哎呀呀，小东西拿到了！拿着这个，证明小东西是食人魔的朋友。哈哈哈哈！

english: I have your gold.
translation: 我有你的金子。

english: No you don't! If you want to impress me, get da gold I asked for!
translation: 你没有！如果你想让我印象深刻，就把我要的金子拿来！

english: I haven't got it yet.
translation: 我还没拿到。

english: Don't come back until you have it, unless you wanna be on tonight's menu!
translation: 没拿到就别回来，除非你想上今晚的菜单！

english: I have lost the key!
translation: 我把钥匙弄丢了！

english: Stoopid! Take another and don't lose it!
translation: 蠢货！再拿一把，别弄丢了！

english: Oh yeah? What's dat den?
translation: 哦是吗？那是什么？

english: Oh yeah, I've got it right here.
translation: 哦对，我就在这里拿着呢。

english: Stoopid!
translation: 蠢货！

english: Are you trying to trick me? I bet you got it stored somewhere. Humans always do that.
translation: 你想骗我吗？我打赌你把它藏在某个地方了。人类总是这样。

english: It's the little t'ing again.
translation: 又是那个小东西。

english: Do you have any other tasks for me?
translation: 你还有其他任务给我吗？

english: No, I have no more tasks for you, now go away.
translation: 不，我没有其他任务给你了，现在走吧。

english: I have lost the relic part you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那个遗物部件。

english: Are you blind? I can see you got it even from here!
translation: 你瞎了吗？我在这里都能看到你拿着它！

english: Grrr, why do I bother? It's a good job I got another part.
translation: 呃，我干嘛费这个劲？还好我还有一个部件。

english: What do you want, little morsel? You would look good on my plate!
translation: 你想要什么，小点心？你放在我的盘子里一定很好看！

english: I want to enter the city of ogres.
translation: 我想进入食人魔的城市。

english: Hah! I should eat you instead!
translation: 哈！我应该吃了你才对！

english: Don't eat me; I can help you.
translation: 别吃我；我可以帮你。

english: What can a morsel like you do for me?
translation: 像你这样的点心能为我做什么？

english: I am a mighty adventurer, slayer of monsters and user of magic powers.
translation: 我是一个强大的冒险者，怪物的杀戮者，魔法力量的使用者。

english: Well, well, perhaps the morsel can help after all...
translation: 哎呀呀，也许这点心终究能帮上忙……

english: If you t'ink you're tough, find Gorad, my enemy to the south-east, and knock one of his teeth out! Heheheheh!
translation: 如果你觉得自己很厉害，就去找戈拉德，我东南方的敌人，打掉他一颗牙！嘿嘿嘿嘿！

english: You will have to kill me first.
translation: 你得先杀了我。

english: That's not tricky - guards!
translation: 那并不难——守卫！

english: The morsel is back. Does it have our tooth for us?
translation: 小点心回来了。它给我们带牙了吗？

english: Err, I don't have it.
translation: 呃，我没有。

english: Morsel, you dare to return without the tooth! Either you are stoopid, or wants to be eaten!
translation: 小点心，你敢没带牙就回来！要么你傻，要么你想被吃掉！

english: I have it.
translation: 我带了。

english: That'll annoy Gorad lots! Heheheheh! Here's a token of my gratitude: some old gem I stole from Gorad, and an old part of a statue.
translation: 那会让戈拉德很恼火！嘿嘿嘿嘿！这是我的一点谢意：一些我从戈拉德那里偷来的旧宝石，还有一块旧雕像的部件。

english: I've come to knock your teeth out!
translation: 我来打掉你的牙！

english: You shut your face! I smack you till you dead and sorry!
translation: 你闭嘴！我抽到你死，让你后悔！

english: What are you doing here, morsel?
translation: 你来这儿干嘛，小点心？

english: Can I do anything else for you?
translation: 还能为你做点什么吗？

english: I have nothing left for you but the cooking pot!
translation: 除了烹饪锅，我没什么能给你的了！

english: I've lost the relic part you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的那件遗物部件。

english: You lie to me, morsel!
translation: 你骗我，小点心！

english: Stupid morsel, I have another. Take it and go now before I lose my temper.
translation: 蠢小点心，我还有一件。拿着走，趁我还没发脾气。

english: You probably got it stored somewhere, morsel! Humans do that a lot.
translation: 你可能把它存在某处了，小点心！人类经常那样干。

english: I've lost the crystal you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的水晶。

english: How dare you lie to me morsel! I will grind you up for my bread!
translation: 你竟敢骗我，小点心！我把你磨成粉做面包！

english: I suppose you want another? I suppose just this once I could give you my copy...
translation: 我猜你还想要一个？我想就这一次我可以把我的副本给你……

english: An ogre called Og gave me this...
translation: 一个叫奥格的食人魔给了我……

english: An ogre called Grew gave me this...
translation: 一个叫格鲁的食人魔给了我……

english: An ogre called Toban gave me this...
translation: 一个叫托班的食人魔给了我……

english: Ah, it's part of an old ogre statue. I'll take that off you - it might come in handy if I can fix it up.
translation: 啊，这是旧食人魔雕像的一部分。我把它从你这里收走吧——如果我能修好它，可能会派上用场。

english: Ah, it's more of that old ogre statue. I'll take this bit too.
translation: 啊，又是那个旧食人魔雕像的部件。这块我也收下。

english: It looks like you've brought me all the pieces of the relic. It is as I thought - a statue symbolising an ogre warrior of old.
translation: 看来你带齐了遗物的所有部件。和我想的一样——一尊象征古代食人魔战士的雕像。

english: Well, if you ever want to make friends with an ogre, this is the item to have! Now I'll try to assemble it...
translation: 好吧，如果你想和食人魔交朋友，这就是你需要的东西！现在我来试着组装它……

english: I've got some questions about the ogre city.
translation: 我有些关于食人魔城市的问题。

english: I had a feeling you might say that.
translation: 我猜你就会这么说。

english: Ah, the warrior returns. Have you found a way into Gu'Tanoth yet?
translation: 啊，战士回来了。你找到进入古塔诺斯的路了吗？

english: I can't get past the guards.
translation: 我过不了守卫那关。

english: Well, ogres dislike others apart from their own kind. What you need is some form of proof of friendship, something to trick them into believing you're their friend.
translation: 嗯，食人魔除了同类之外讨厌其他种族。你需要某种友谊的证明，用来骗他们相信你是朋友。

english: Which shouldn't be too hard, considering their intelligence.
translation: 考虑到他们的智力，应该不难。

english: I have lost the relic you gave me.
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的遗物。

english: Have you gone mad? I can see you have it with you!
translation: 你疯了吗？我能看到你带着它呢！

english: What? Lost the relic? How careless! It's a good job I copied its design, then! You can take this copy instead - it's just as good.
translation: 什么？丢了遗物？太粗心了！还好我复制了它的设计！你可以拿走这个复制品——效果一样。

english: I imagine you've stored it somewhere. Go and see where you might have put it.
translation: 我想你把它存在某处了。去想想你可能放在哪里了。

english: I will find my way in, no problem.
translation: 我会找到进去的路，没问题。

english: Yes, I'm sure you will... Good luck!
translation: 是的，我相信你会的……祝你好运！

english: Well, what proof of friendship did you bring?
translation: 那么，你带了什么友谊的证明？

english: I have a relic!
translation: 我有一件遗物！

english: It's got the statue of Dalgroth. Welcome to Gu'Tanoth, friend of the ogres.
translation: 上面有达尔格罗斯的雕像。欢迎来到古塔诺斯，食人魔的朋友。

english: I've made it into the ogre city!
translation: 我已经进入食人魔城市了！

english: It's like talking to a broken record.
translation: 就像在跟复读机说话。

english: How are you doing with the ogres?
translation: 你在食人魔那边进展如何？

english: I have gained entry to the city!
translation: 我已经进入城市了！

english: Already? Excellent!
translation: 已经进了？太棒了！

english: I still can't navigate the skavid caves.
translation: 我还是无法在斯卡维德洞穴中认路。

english: You need a map of some kind... I bet one of the ogres has one.
translation: 你需要某种地图……我打赌某个食人魔有。

english: Okay thanks, I'll go and find out.
translation: 好的，谢谢，我去查查。

english: Oi! Where do you think you are going? You are for the cooking pot!
translation: 喂！你以为你要去哪儿？你是要进烹饪锅的！

english: But I am a friend to ogres...
translation: 但我是食人魔的朋友……

english: Prove it to us with a gift. Get us something from the market.
translation: 用礼物证明给我们看。去市场给我们弄点东西。

english: Surprise us...
translation: 给我们个惊喜……

english: Not if I can help it.
translation: 我可不情愿。

english: You can help by being tonight's dinner, or you can go away. Now, which shall it be?
translation: 你可以选择成为今晚的晚餐来帮忙，或者滚蛋。现在，选哪个？

english: Okay, okay, I'm going.
translation: 好吧好吧，我走。

english: Back to whence you came!
translation: 从哪来回哪去！

english: Um... is there anything in my backpack that you'd want?
translation: 嗯……我背包里有什么你想要的吗？

english: You didn't bring anything! Shove off!
translation: 你什么都没带！滚开！

english: Stop, creature! Oh it's you. Well, what have you got for us, then?
translation: 站住，生物！哦是你。那么，你给我们带了什么？

english: How about this?
translation: 这个怎么样？

english: Well, well, look at this. My favourite: rock cake! Okay, we will let it through.
translation: 哟哟，看看这个。我最喜欢的：石糕！好吧，我们放它过去。

english: What do you want, small thing? Leave us alone!
translation: 你想干嘛，小东西？离我们远点！

english: Oi! Little thing. If you want to cross here, you must pay me 20 gold pieces first!
translation: 喂！小家伙。你想从这里过去，必须先付我20金币！

english: You want me to give you 20 gold pieces to let me jump off a bridge?
translation: 你想让我给你20金币，然后让我从桥上跳下去？

english: That's what I said, like it or lump it.
translation: 我就是这么说的，喜欢也好，不喜欢也罢。

english: Okay, I'll pay it.
translation: 好吧，我付。

english: A wise choice, little thing.
translation: 明智的选择，小家伙。

english: And where is your money? Grrrr! Do you want to get hurt or something?
translation: 你的钱呢？嗷呜！你想受伤还是怎么的？

english: Phew! I just made it.
translation: 呼！我刚赶上了。

english: Forget it, I'm not paying.
translation: 算了，我不付。

english: In that case you're not crossing.
translation: 那样的话你就别想过。

english: Grrrr, what business you got here?
translation: 嗷呜，你来这儿干嘛？

english: So what you want with me?
translation: 你想从我这儿得到什么？

english: I seek passage into the skavid caves.
translation: 我想进入斯卡维德洞穴。

english: Is that so... You humour me small t'ing. Answer this riddle and I will help you...
translation: 是嘛……你逗我乐，小东西。回答这个谜语，我就帮你……

english: I want you to bring me an item: I will give you all the letters of this item, you work out what it is...
translation: 我要你带一件物品：我给你这东西的所有字母，你猜猜是什么……

english: My first is in days, but not in years, My second is in evil, and also in tears, My third is in all, but not in none, My fourth is in hot, but not in sun.
translation: 我的第一个字母在'days'中，但不在'years'中；第二个在'evil'中，也在'tears'中；第三个在'all'中，但不在'none'中；第四个在'hot'中，但不在'sun'中。

english: My fifth is in heaven, and also in hate, My sixth is in fearing, but not in fate, My seventh is in plush, but not in place.
translation: 第五个在'heaven'中，也在'hate'中；第六个在'fearing'中，但不在'fate'中；第七个在'plush'中，但不在'place'中。

english: My eighth is in nine, but not in eight, My last is in earth, and also in great.
translation: 第八个在'nine'中，但不在'eight'中；最后一个在'earth'中，也在'great'中。

english: My whole is an object, that magic will make. It brings wrack and ruin to all in its wake... Now how long, I wonder, will this riddle take?
translation: 整体是一件物品，魔法会造出来。它带来毁灭与破坏在身后……我想知道，这个谜语要花多久？

english: Hur, hur, hur... I see you haven't worked it out yet. Keep trying, imp.
translation: 呼，呼，呼……我看你还没解开。继续试，小恶魔。

english: Can I hear the riddle again?
translation: 能再听一遍谜语吗？

english: That is not what I want, imp!
translation: 那不是我要的，小恶魔！

english: Hur, hur. The imp has done it! This is what you be needing...
translation: 呼，呼。小恶魔做到了！这就是你需要的……

english: I'm glad that was easier on the way back!
translation: 我很高兴回来时简单多了！

english: I've got some questions about the skavid caves.
translation: 我有些关于斯卡维德洞穴的问题。

english: Oh, really? I'm quite an expert on skavids.
translation: 哦，是吗？我可是斯卡维德专家。

english: Only joking!
translation: 开个玩笑！

english: How is the quest going?
translation: 任务进行得怎么样了？

english: I have worked out the guard's puzzle.
translation: 我解开了守卫的谜题。

english: My, my. A wordsmith as well as a hero.
translation: 哎呀呀。不光是个英雄，还是个文字大师。

english: I am still trying to navigate the skavid caves.
translation: 我还在努力在斯卡维德洞穴里认路。

english: Take some illumination with you or else it will be dark.
translation: 带上照明工具，否则会很暗。

english: I am trying to get into the shamans' cave.
translation: 我想进入萨满洞穴。

english: Yes, it will be well guarded. Hmmm, let me see...
translation: 是的，那里守卫森严。嗯，让我想想……

english: Ah yes, I gather some ogres are allergic to certain herbs. Now what was it? It had white berries and blue leaves....
translation: 啊对了，我听说有些食人魔对某些草药过敏。是哪种来着？它有白莓和蓝色叶子……

english: Cave nightshade, that's it!
translation: 洞穴龙葵，就是它！

english: You should try looking through some of the caves.
translation: 你应该试试在一些洞穴里找找。

english: And don't forget to look out for the dragons!
translation: 还有别忘了小心那些龙！

english: The WHAT?
translation: 你说什么？

english: Dragons.
translation: 龙。

english: Didn't you know that the ogres keep blue dragons as pets and for magical ingredients?
translation: 你不知道食人魔把蓝龙当宠物养，还用来做魔法材料吗？

english: Well, regardless, I'm sure a bold, brave adventurer such as yourself won't have any problems.
translation: 好吧，不管怎样，我相信像你这样勇敢的冒险者，肯定不会有问题的。

english: It is going well.
translation: 一切顺利。

english: That's good to hear. We are much closer to fixing the tower now.
translation: 那就好。我们现在离修好塔又近了一步。

english: Tanath cur, tanath cur!
translation: 塔纳思.库尔，塔纳思.库尔！

english: Don't hurt me, don't hurt me!
translation: 别伤害我，别伤害我！

english: Stop moaning, creature. I know about you skavids - you serve those monsters, the ogres.
translation: 别哼唧了，生物。我知道你们斯卡维德——你们侍奉那些怪物，食人魔。

english: Please don't touch me!
translation: 求你别碰我！

english: You have something that belongs to me...
translation: 你拿了属于我的东西……

english: I don't have anything; please believe me!
translation: 我什么都没有；请你相信我！

english: Somehow, I find your words hard to believe.
translation: 不知怎的，我觉得你的话很难让人相信。

english: I'm begging your kindness; I don't have it!
translation: 我求你发发慈悲；我真的没有！

english: I don't believe you, hand it over!
translation: 我不信，交出来！

english: Ahhhhh, help!
translation: 啊——救命！

english: Oh great, I'm not getting anywhere.
translation: 哦，好吧，我什么也问不出来。

english: Okay, okay, I'm not going to hurt you.
translation: 好了，好了，我不会伤害你的。

english: Thank you, kind [sir/madam].
translation: 谢谢你，善良的[sir/madam]。

english: I'll tells you where that things you wants is. The mad skavids have it in their cave in the city.
translation: 我会告诉你你要的东西在哪里。疯狂的斯卡维德把它藏在城里的洞穴里。

english: You will have to learn skavid, otherwise they will not talks to you. Here, I'll tell you what you need to know...
translation: 你得学斯卡维德语，不然他们不会跟你说话。来，我告诉你要学什么……

english: You shut your mouth! Don't tell them anything!
translation: 你给我闭嘴！什么也别告诉他们！

english: I cannot help you, but the others can. Let me tells you the most common skavid words: Ar, nod, gor, ig and cur. Those will gets you started.
translation: 我帮不了你，但其他人可以。我来教你说最常用的斯卡维德词：阿、诺德、戈、伊格和库尔。这些够你入门了。

english: Master, how are you doing learning our language?
translation: 主人，你学我们的语言学得怎么样了？

english: I am studying the speech of your kind...
translation: 我正在研究你们种族的语言……

english: Bidith tanath...
translation: 比迪思.塔纳思……

english: Cur, cur tanath!
translation: 库尔，库尔.塔纳思！

english: Cur tanath!
translation: 库尔.塔纳思！

english: Ar.
translation: 阿。

english: Cur bidith...
translation: 库尔.比迪思……

english: Ig.
translation: 伊格。

english: Ig! Bidith ig!
translation: 伊格！比迪思.伊格！

english: Tanath gor...
translation: 塔纳思.戈……

english: Nod.
translation: 诺德。

english: Nod, gor nod!
translation: 诺德，戈.诺德！

english: Master, my kinsmen tell me you have learned skavid. You should speak to the mad ones in their cave.
translation: 主人，我的族人告诉我你学会了斯卡维德语。你应该去洞穴里和那些疯了的家伙谈谈。

english: Gor nod...
translation: 戈.诺德……

english: Tanath.
translation: 塔纳思。

english: Hehe! So you speak a little skavid, eh? I'll give you a prize for that!
translation: 嘿嘿！看来你会说一点斯卡维德语，是吧？我得奖励你一下！

english: The others are with the shamans in the enclave - you'll never get them back. They hid one in the sacred rock! Nothing can touch it now.
translation: 其他的都在飞地那里，和萨满们在一起——你永远拿不回来的。他们把一块藏在圣石里！现在谁也别想碰到它。

english: But I've lost it!
translation: 但是我弄丢了！

english: Alright, take this one then...
translation: 好吧，那这个给你……

english: You stored it somewhere maybe. Go away!
translation: 你可能把它放在什么地方了。走开！

english: I have gained access to the skavid caves.
translation: 我已经能进入斯卡维德洞穴了。

english: 'You'll have to speak with the Watchtower Wizard about that.'
translation: '关于这个你得去问瞭望塔法师。'

english: I'd get more help out of a-
translation: 我还不如去找个——

english: Hello again. How do you fare?
translation: 又见面了。你怎么样？

english: It goes well. I can now navigate the skavid caves.
translation: 一切顺利。我现在可以在斯卡维德洞穴里自由探索了。

english: That is good news. Let me know if you find anything of interest.
translation: 好消息。如果你发现什么有趣的东西，记得告诉我。

english: I had a crystal, but I lost it!
translation: 我之前拿到一个水晶，但是弄丢了！

english: Oh no. Well, you had better go back there, then!
translation: 哦不。那你最好回那里再去看看！

english: I am now ready for the shamans.
translation: 我现在准备好对付萨满了。

english: Remember all I told you. You must distract the guard somehow. Cave nightshade is what you are looking for - try searching the skavid caves for it.
translation: 记住我告诉你的话。你必须想办法引开守卫。你要找的是洞穴龙葵——试试在斯卡维德洞穴里找找看。

english: This herb is very poisonous, however, so handle it with care. Also, be on your guard in that cave. Who knows what monsters may be in that awful place...
translation: 不过这种草药毒性很强，所以要小心处理。另外，在那个洞穴里要时刻保持警惕。谁知道那个可怕的地方会有什么怪物……

english: Didn't you know that the ogres keep blue dragons as pets and for magical ingredients
translation: 你不知道食人魔把蓝龙当宠物养，还用来做魔法材料吗

english: No you don't!
translation: 你才不知道！

english: What is this? Arrrrgh! I cannot stand this plant! Argh, it burns! It burns!
translation: 这是什么？啊——！我受不了这植物！呃啊，好烫！好烫！

english: Hur, hut, hur. Stoopid dragon!
translation: 呵，呵，呵。笨龙！

english: Take dis!
translation: 接招！

english: Hur, hur, hur, hur!
translation: 呵，呵，呵，呵！

english: Grr! How dare you talk to us. We will destroy you!
translation: 呃！你竟敢跟我们说话。我们要灭了你！

english: The shamans are too powerful for me to attack!
translation: 那些萨满太强大了，我无法攻击！

english: I have found the cave of ogre shaman, but I cannot touch them!
translation: 我找到了食人魔萨满的洞穴，但我碰不了他们！

english: That is because of their magical powers. We must fight them with their own methods; do not speak to them! I suggest a potion...
translation: 那是因为他们有魔法力量。我们得以其人之道还治其人之身；不要和他们说话！我建议用药水……

english: Collect a guam leaf, add jangerberries, then mix in some ground bat bones. You must return it to me before you use it, so that I can empower it with my magic.
translation: 采集一片瓜姆叶，加入姜格莓，然后混入一些蝙蝠骨粉。你必须先把它带回来给我，让我用魔法给它充能之后才能使用。

english: Be very careful how you mix it as it is extremely volatile. Mixing ingredients of this type in the wrong order can cause explosions!
translation: 混合的时候要格外小心，因为它极其不稳定。如果弄错这些材料的混合顺序，可能会引起爆炸！

english: I hope you've been brushing up Herblore and Magic? I must warn you, only experienced magicians can use the potion. It is too dangerous in the hands of the unskilled.
translation: 我希望你一直在钻研草药学和魔法？我必须警告你，只有经验丰富的法师才能使用这种药水。落在没本事的人手里太危险了。

english: Any more news?
translation: 有什么新消息吗？

english: Can you tell me again what I need for the potion?
translation: 你能再告诉我一遍做药水需要什么吗？

english: Yes indeed, let me see, what was it again...
translation: 当然可以，让我想想，是什么来着……

english: You will need a guam leaf. That goes into the mix first.
translation: 你需要一片瓜姆叶。先把它放进去。

english: What is the next ingredient?
translation: 下一个材料是什么？

english: You need some jangerberries.
translation: 你需要一些姜格莓。

english: I have some of those.
translation: 我有一点。

english: You will need to add those after the guam leaf has gone in, but before the final ingredient.
translation: 你得在放入瓜姆叶之后，最后一种材料之前加入它们。

english: What is the final ingredient?
translation: 最后一种材料是什么？

english: The final ingredient is ground bat bones.
translation: 最后一种材料是蝙蝠骨粉。

english: I have some bat bones; how can I grind them?
translation: 我有一些蝙蝠骨头；怎么把它们磨成粉？

english: A pestle and mortar will more than do the trick.
translation: 用研钵和杵就够了。

english: When you have mixed the potion correctly, then I can empower the potion with magic and the ogre shamans can be destroyed.
translation: 等你正确混合好药水之后，我就可以用魔法给它充能，然后那些食人魔萨满就完蛋了。

english: No, I'm still working on it.
translation: 不，我还在弄。

english: Any chance of advice about this potion?
translation: 能给我点关于这个药水的建议吗？

english: Nope. Try the Watchtower Wizard.
translation: 没有。去找瞭望塔法师问问。

english: I have made the potion.
translation: 我做好药水了。

english: That's great news; let me infuse it with magic...
translation: 太好了；让我用魔法给它注入力量……

english: Here it is - a dangerous substance. I must remind you that this potion can only be used if your Magic level is high enough.
translation: 这就是了——一种危险的物质。我必须提醒你，只有在你的魔法等级足够高时，才能使用这瓶药水。

english: How high is high enough?
translation: 多高才算够高？

english: Well, if you can cast Bones to Bananas, or any spells beyond that, you should be alright.
translation: 嗯，如果你能施展化骨为蕉，或者更高级的法术，那应该就没问题。

english: That's one destroyed...
translation: 干掉一个了……

english: That's the second one gone...
translation: 第二个也倒了……

english: There goes the fourth...
translation: 第四个完蛋了……

english: That's five! Only one more left now...
translation: 五个了！就差最后一个了……

english: I already have this crystal. There is no benefit to getting another.
translation: 我已经有这个水晶了。再拿一个也没用。

english: Hello again. Did the potion work?
translation: 又见面了。药水起作用了吗？

english: Indeed it did! I wiped out those ogre shamans!
translation: 确实管用！我把那些食人魔萨满全干掉了！

english: I had another crystal but I lost it.
translation: 我之前又拿到一个水晶，但是我弄丢了。

english: Oh, really? If you got it from someone, maybe they'll have found it again. Otherwise, go and search the place where you got it in the first place.
translation: 哦，真的吗？如果你是从某人那里得到的，也许他们又找到了它。否则，去你最初得到它的地方搜索一下。

english: I am looking for another crystal.
translation: 我在找另一个水晶。

english: I am sure the cave holds the final crystal. Look for the source of the shamans' power.
translation: 我相信那个洞穴里藏着最后一个水晶。去找那些萨满力量的源头。

english: Okay, I will go and have a look.
translation: 好的，我去看看。

english: I have found another crystal!
translation: 我又找到一颗水晶了！

english: Good, hand it over to me.
translation: 很好，把它交给我吧。

english: Any chance of a hand?
translation: 能帮个忙吗？

english: Well, you could ask the Watchtower Wizard for one.
translation: 嗯，你可以去问瞭望塔法师要一个。

english: Magnificent! At last you've brought all the crystals.
translation: 太棒了！你终于把所有水晶都带来了。

english: Now the shield generator can be activated and, once again, Yanille will be safe from the threat of the ogres.
translation: 现在盾牌发电机可以启动了，亚尼勒城将再次免受食人魔的威胁。

english: Put the crystals on the pillars there and throw the lever to activate the system.
translation: 把水晶放在那边的柱子上，然后拉动拉杆启动系统。

english: The system is not activated yet. Throw the switch to start it.
translation: 系统尚未启动。拨动开关来启动它。

english: You will need to speak to the Watchtower Wizard.
translation: 你需要和瞭望塔法师谈谈。

english: Seriously, he's the one in charge here.
translation: 说真的，这里是他负责。

english: Marvellous! It works! The town will now be safe. Take these coins as a token of my gratitude. Also, let me improve your Magic level.
translation: 太棒了！成功了！现在小镇安全了。收下这些金币作为我的谢意。另外，让我提升一下你的魔法等级。

english: I've given you a special scroll too - it's a new spell. Read the scroll and you will be able to teleport yourself here.
translation: 我还给了你一张特殊卷轴——一个新法术。阅读卷轴后，你就能传送到这里。

english: Ho, ho, ho! A comedian to the finish. There it is, in your backpack!
translation: 嚯嚯嚯！真是个幽默到底的家伙。就在那儿，你的背包里！

english: Hello adventurer, have you seen my boy yet?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你看到我的孩子了吗？

english: I'm afraid not, but I'm sure he hasn't gone far.
translation: 恐怕没有，不过我肯定他没走远。

english: I do hope so, you can't be too careful these days.
translation: 希望如此，现今世道再小心也不为过。

english: Have you seen a small boy?
translation: 你见过一个小男孩吗？

english: Nope, plenty of small fish though.
translation: 没有，不过小鱼倒是不少。

english: Hello son, are you okay? You need help?
translation: 你好孩子，你没事吧？需要帮忙吗？

english: It looks like you need the help.
translation: 看起来你才需要帮忙。

english: Your mum sent me to find you.
translation: 你妈妈让我来找你。

english: Don't play nice with me, I know you're looking for the treasure too.
translation: 别跟我装好人了，我知道你也在找宝藏。

english: Where is this treasure you talk of?
translation: 你说的宝藏在哪里？

english: Just because I'm small doesn't mean I'm dumb! If I told you, you would take it all for yourself.
translation: 别看我小就当我傻！告诉你的话，你肯定一个人独吞。

english: Maybe I could help.
translation: 也许我能帮上忙。

english: I'm fine alone.
translation: 我一个人就行。

english: Hmm... I wonder what this treasure is.
translation: 嗯……我好奇这宝藏到底是什么。

english: So you're still here.
translation: 你还在这儿啊。

english: I'll find that treasure soon, just you wait and see.
translation: 我很快就能找到宝藏，你就等着瞧吧。

english: Blimey! Where did you come from? Not another one of those treasure hunters are you?
translation: 哎呀！你从哪里冒出来的？不是又一个寻宝者吧？

english: Treasure hunters?
translation: 寻宝者？

english: They say there's treasure hidden within the waterfall, left behind by the old elven king. Not that anyone's ever found anything.
translation: 他们说瀑布里藏着宝藏，是以前的精灵国王留下的。不过从来没人找到过任何东西。

english: Interesting, is there somewhere I can learn more about this?
translation: 有意思，有没有什么地方可以了解更多？

english: You could ask Hadley the tourist guide. He'll be in this building just here.
translation: 你可以问问哈德利那个导游。他就在这栋楼里。

english: Well hello, you're still around then.
translation: 嗯你好，看来你还在这附近。

english: I saw Hudon by the river but he refused to come back with me.
translation: 我在河边看见了哈顿，但他不肯跟我回来。

english: Yes he told me, the foolish lad came in drenched to the bone, he had fallen into the waterfall, lucky he wasn't killed! Now he can spend the rest of the summer in his room.
translation: 是啊，他跟我说了，那傻小子浑身湿透地进来，掉进了瀑布里，没死算他走运！现在他整个夏天都得待在房间里了。

english: Any ideas what I could do while I'm here?
translation: 有什么建议我在这儿可以干点什么吗？

english: Why don't you visit the tourist centre south of the waterfall?
translation: 不如去瀑布南边的游客中心看看？

english: What treasure are they looking for?
translation: 他们在找什么宝藏？

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind sir. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 说'漂亮'也太保守了，先生。'美丽'、'惊人'，甚至'改变人生'才更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以那位埋葬在瀑布下的精灵国王命名。

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind lady. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath
translation: “漂亮”说得太轻了，善良的女士。“美丽”、“惊艳”或者“改变人生”更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以埋在下面的精灵国王命名。

english: Well hello, come in, come in, my name's Hadley, I'm head of tourism here. There's some of the most unspoilt wildlife and scenery in Gielinor here. People come from miles around to fish in the clear lakes or to wander the
translation: 你好，进来吧，进来吧。我叫哈德利，是这里的旅游主管。这里有吉列诺最原始的野生动物和风景。人们从迈尔斯（Miles）远道而来，在清澈的湖泊里钓鱼，或者漫步在

english: beautiful hillsides.
translation: 美丽的山坡上。

english: I hope you're enjoying your stay, there should be lots of useful infomation in that book you've got. Make sure you give it a read.
translation: 希望你在这里过得愉快，你拿的那本书里应该有很多有用的信息。记得读一读。

english: Well, there's a wide variety of wildlife, although unfortunately most of it's quite dangerous. Please don't feed the goblins.
translation: 嗯，这里有各种各样的野生动物，不过不幸的是，大部分都很危险。请不要喂食哥布林。

english: That's just silly talk.
translation: 那只是胡说八道。

english: There was a very scruffy looking merchant in here the other day, perhaps he might have the item you are looking for?
translation: 前几天这里有个看起来很邋遢的商人，也许他有你要找的东西？

english: I am afraid not Sir. But isn't our waterfall very pretty?
translation: 恐怕没有，先生。但我们的瀑布不是很漂亮吗？

english: I heard a rumour many years ago, that there was a warrior by that name who had a secret hideout somewhere in these parts, but I have never seen it myself.
translation: 很多年前我听说有个传言，有个叫那个名字的战士在这一带有个秘密藏身处，但我从没见过。

english: And why would you be looking for such a criminal element when you could be admiring the tranquil beauty of the waterfall, anyway?
translation: 再说了，你为什么要找这种罪犯，而不是欣赏瀑布宁静的美景呢？

english: I am afraid not Madam. But isn't our waterfall very pretty?
translation: 恐怕没有，女士。但我们的瀑布不是很漂亮吗？

english: Did you find your mysterious invisible hideout then?
translation: 那你找到那个神秘的隐形藏身处了吗？

english: Hmmm... Well, we did have a report of a young couples picnic being interrupted when a skeleton mysteriously appeared out of thin air...
translation: 嗯……我们确实接到过报告，说有一对年轻情侣的野餐被一个凭空出现的骷髅打断了……

english: At the picnic tables just east of here. We investigated of course, this kind of thing is bad for tourism, but could find no evidence of their claims.
translation: 就在东边的野餐桌那里。我们当然调查过，这种事情对旅游业不好，但找不到他们所说的证据。

english: You're asking me if I've seen something invisible? How ridiculous.
translation: 你在问我有没有看到隐形的东西？真荒谬。

english: Hello again Almera.
translation: 又见面了，阿尔梅拉。

english: Well hello again brave adventurer, are you enjoying the tranquil scenery of these parts?
translation: 你好啊，勇敢的冒险者，你享受这一带的宁静景色吗？

english: Yes, very relaxing.
translation: 是的，非常放松。

english: Well I'm glad to hear itThe authorities wanted to dig up this whole area for a mine, but the few locals who lived here wouldn't budge and they gave up.
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。当局本想把这整片区域都挖成矿场，但住在这里的几个当地人坚决不让步，他们只好放弃了。

english: Good for all of us!
translation: 对我们大家都有好处！

english: Hello Hudon.
translation: 你好，哈顿。

english: Oh it's you, trying to find my treasure again are you?
translation: 哦，是你啊，又想来找我的宝藏了吧？

english: I didn't know it belonged to you.
translation: 我不知道那是你的。

english: It will do when I find it. I just need to get into this blasted waterfall I've been washed downstream three times already.
translation: 等我找到就是我的了。我只需要进到这道该死的瀑布里去，我已经被冲下下游三次了。

english: It's just those blasted hob-gobs. I locked myself in here for protection. But I've left the key somewhere and now I'm stuck.
translation: 都是那些该死的霍布哥布林。我把自己锁在这里保护自己。但我把钥匙忘在某个地方了，现在被困住了。

english: Okay... I'll have a look for a key.
translation: 好吧……我找找钥匙。

english: I'm Golrie, I've been stuck in here for ages. those hob-gobs are trying to steal my family's heirlooms. My grandad gave me all sorts of old junk.
translation: 我是戈尔里，我被困在这里很久了。那些大地精想偷我家的传家宝。我爷爷给了我各种旧垃圾。

english: Do you mind if I have a look?
translation: 你不介意我看看吧？

english: Could I take this old pebble?
translation: 我能拿走这块旧鹅卵石吗？

english: Oh that, yes have it, it's just some old elven junk I believe.
translation: 哦那个，拿去吧，我觉得不过是些精灵族的旧垃圾。

english: Thanks a lot for the key traveller. I think I'll wait in here until those hob-gobs get bored and leave.
translation: 非常感谢你的钥匙，旅行者。我想我就待在这里等那些霍布哥布林腻了离开。

english: Okay, take care Golrie.
translation: 好的，保重，戈尔里。

english: No adventurer stays here this long just to sight see. But your business is yours alone, if you need to use the raft go ahead. But please try not crash it this time!
translation: 没有冒险者会在这里待这么久只是为了观光。但你的事是你的事，如果你需要用到木筏就用吧。不过这次请尽量别撞坏了！

english: Ah, hello there. Nice to see an outsider for a change, are you busy? I have a problem.
translation: 啊，你好。难得见到一个外人，你忙吗？我有个麻烦。

english: Hello brave adventurer, have you seen my boy yet?
translation: 你好，勇敢的冒险者，你见过我的儿子了吗？

english: Well I'm glad to hear it The authorities wanted to dig up this whole area for a mine, but the few locals who lived here wouldn't budge and they gave up.
translation: 好吧，听你这么说我很高兴。当局想把整个区域挖开建个矿场，但住在这儿的少数当地人不肯让步，他们就放弃了。

english: It's my son Hudon, he's always getting to trouble, the boy's convinced there's hidden treasure in the river and I'm a bit worried about his safety, the poor lad can't even swim.
translation: 是我的儿子哈顿，他总是惹麻烦。这孩子坚信河里有宝藏，我有点担心他的安全，可怜的小家伙连游泳都不会。

english: Thanks Almera.
translation: 谢谢，阿尔梅拉。

english: Not you still, why don't you give up?
translation: 怎么还是你，为什么不放弃？

english: And miss all the fun!
translation: 那会错过所有乐趣！

english: You do understand that anything you find you have to share with me.
translation: 你明白的，你找到的任何东西都得跟我分享。

english: Because I told you about the treasure.
translation: 因为我告诉了你宝藏的事。

english: Well, I wouldn't count on it.
translation: 嗯，我可不会指望这个。

english: That's not fair.
translation: 这不公平。

english: Neither is life kid.
translation: 生活也不公平，孩子。

english: I'll go home when I've found the treasure. I'm going to be a rich rich man.
translation: 等我找到宝藏就回家。我会变得非常非常富有。

english: No luck yet I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕还没找到。

english: Hello there. I'm Rat.
translation: 你好。我是老鼠。

english: You're a what?
translation: 你是什么？

english: No, no. My name is Rat. Rat Burgiss.
translation: 不，不。我的名字是老鼠。拉特.伯吉斯。

english: Ohhhhh, well, what's up, Ratty?
translation: 哦～～好吧，怎么了，小拉特？

english: It's Rat, thank you. And I, uh...heh...I seem to be in a bit of trouble here, as you can probably see.
translation: 是老鼠，谢谢。我，呃……嘿……我好像遇到点麻烦，你大概也看到了。

english: Why, what seems to be the matter?
translation: 怎么了，发生什么事了？

english: Well, I'm a trader by nature and I was on the way to Varrock with my cart here when I was set upon by outlaws! They ransacked my cart and stole some very important papers that I must get back.
translation: 嗯，我天生是个商人，我正推着推车前往维洛克城，结果被一群亡命徒袭击了！他们洗劫了我的推车，偷走了一些非常重要的文件，我必须拿回来。

english: That's awful! You're lucky to be alive!
translation: 太糟糕了！你活下来真是幸运！

english: Yes, I know! I don't know how I survived.
translation: 是啊，我知道！我也不知道自己是怎么活下来的。

english: Maybe you weren't worth killing?
translation: 也许是因为你不值得杀？

english: Look, do you want to help me or not?
translation: 听着，你到底想不想帮我？

english: Of course! Tell me what you need me to do.
translation: 当然！告诉我需要做什么。

english: Right, now I heard those outlaws say something about having a small camp site somewhere to the north-west of Varrock. They headed off to the north-west of here. They took 5 pages with them.
translation: 好，我听到那些亡命徒说他们在维洛克城西北方向有个小营地。他们往西北方向去了。他们带走了5页文件。

english: Kill the outlaws and get those papers back from them for me. Here's a folder in which you can put the pages. Be careful, though; those outlaws are tough.
translation: 杀了那些亡命徒，帮我把文件拿回来。给你一个文件夹，你可以把文件页放进去。不过要小心，那些亡命徒很厉害。

english: When you find all 5 pages, put them in the folder and bring them back to me!
translation: 当你找到全部5页后，把它们放进文件夹里，然后带回来给我！

english: Don't worry, Ratty! I won't let you down!
translation: 别担心，小拉特！我不会让你失望的！

english: Oh, wait a minute. I was going to give you a folder in which to collect my papers, but you haven't got enough room for it. Talk to me when you do.
translation: 哦，等一下。我本来想给你一个文件夹来收集我的文件，但你身上没有足够的空间。等你有空间了再来找我。

english: No, sorry, I have to go!
translation: 不，抱歉，我得走了！

english: Oh well. I'll just wait here then and maybe some nice person will help me. Perhaps...one day...
translation: 哦，好吧。那我就只能在这儿等着，也许会有好心人来帮我。也许……有一天……

english: Uh, are you guilt tripping me?
translation: 呃，你是在让我内疚吗？

english: No! Not at all! Nuh-uh! Nope! Hardly! Noooo, no no no!
translation: 不！完全没有！才没有！没有！几乎没！不不不，不不不！

english: Well, maybe a bit...
translation: 嗯，也许有一点点……

english: No, that's not what...oh, never mind!
translation: 不，不是那个意思……哦，算了！

english: The papers were the only valuable thing you had?
translation: 那些文件是你唯一值钱的东西？

english: Uh...yes. I guess so.
translation: 呃……是的。我想是的。

english: So you don't sell anything worth having?
translation: 所以你没什么值得卖的东西？

english: Ah! Uhh...no, not really.
translation: 啊！呃……不，不太有。

english: You're not much of a trader are you?
translation: 你不太像个商人，对吧？

english: No...I mean yes... Look, that's besides the point. Can you help me?
translation: 不……我是说对……听着，这不是重点。你能帮我吗？

english: Shall I get them back for you?
translation: 要我帮你拿回来吗？

english: You mean you want to help?
translation: 你是说你想帮忙？

english: Oh dear. Well, I hope you get to Varrock okay!
translation: 哦，天哪。好吧，希望你能平安到达维洛克城！

english: Uh...so you can't help me?
translation: 呃……所以你帮不了我？

english: Sorry. I'm a bit busy right now.
translation: 抱歉。我现在有点忙。

english: Don't you want another quest?
translation: 你不想再接个任务吗？

english: No thanks. I'm too busy right now.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我现在太忙了。

english: Well, fine!
translation: 好吧，行！

english: Good!!
So go then!
translation: 那就走吧！

english: I'm going!
translation: 我走了！

english: Go then!
translation: 走啊！

english: I'm gone!
translation: 我走了！

english: Ah! You're back! Excellent!
translation: 啊！你回来了！太好了！

english: I can't remember what I am supposed to do!
translation: 我忘了该做什么！

english: Head north-west from here into the forest north-west of Varrock. Find the Outlaw Camp and kill the outlaws there.
translation: 从这里往西北走，进入维洛克城西北的森林。找到亡命徒营地，杀了那里的亡命徒。

english: Collect the pages of my document for me and put them into the folder I gave you. When the folder contains 5 pages, bring it to me!
translation: 帮我收集文件的页面，放进我给你的文件夹里。当文件夹里有5页时，就带回来给我！

english: I lost the folder you gave me. Do you have another one?
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的文件夹。你还有另一个吗？

english: Sure. Here you go. I'll add it to your account.
translation: 当然。给你。我会记在你的账上。

english: My account? Am I in debt?
translation: 我的账？我欠债了？

english: No, it's just the way you're standing!
translation: 不，只是你站的方式！

english: Yes, that's the folder I gave you. I need you to fill it with pages for me.
translation: 是的，那就是我给你的文件夹。我需要你帮我把它装满页面。

english: Yes! That's one of my papers! Gather all 5 of them and put them into that folder I gave to you.
translation: 是的！那是我的一份文件！收集全部5份，放进我给你的那个文件夹里。

english: Ah! It looks like you have found some of the pages I need. You still need more, though.
translation: 啊！看来你找到了一些我需要的页面。不过你还需要更多。

english: Hey, Rat! I got your pages back!
translation: 嘿，老鼠！我把你的书页找回来了！

english: Excellent! I knew you could help! Let me take those from you, there.
translation: 太好了！我就知道你能帮忙！让我拿过来吧。

english: Now, I liked the way you handled yourself on that last little 'mission' I gave you there, so I'm going to let you in on a little secret!
translation: 现在，我很欣赏你在我上次给你的那个小‘任务’中的表现，所以我打算告诉你一个小秘密！

english: Wait! Wait! Let me guess! You're actually a rich prince in disguise who wants to help poor people like me!?
translation: 等等！等等！让我猜猜！你其实是个伪装成穷人的富王子，想帮助像我这样的穷人！？

english: Uhhh...no. No, that's not it. You know, on second thought, I think I'll keep my secret for now. Look, instead, you can do another job for me.
translation: 呃……不。不，不是这样。你知道吗，我改主意了，我想我还是暂时保密吧。听着，你可以再帮我做件事。
