english: All work and no play makes [player name] a dull adventurer!
translation: 只工作不玩耍，[player name]变成无聊的冒险者！

english: Yes, well, I'm sure that may be the case. However, what I want you to do is take this letter to someone for me. It's in a different language so, trust me, you won't be able to read it.
translation: 是的，嗯，我想可能是这样。不过，我要你帮我把这封信送给一个人。信是用另一种语言写的，所以相信我，你看不懂。

english: Take it to a wizard named Surok Magis who resides in the Varrock Place Library. I'll see about some sort of reward for your work when I get myself sorted out here.
translation: 把它送给一位名叫苏洛克.马吉斯的魔法师，他住在维洛克城宫殿图书馆。等我在这里把事情处理好，我会考虑给你一些奖励。

english: Letter. Wizard. Varrock. Library. Got it!
translation: 信。魔法师。维洛克城。图书馆。明白了！

english: Yes, good luck then.
translation: 是的，那就祝你好运了。

english: Rat, I think I lost that letter you gave me!
translation: 老鼠，我好像把你给我的那封信弄丢了！

english: That's probably because you've replaced it with something else, by the looks of it! Talk to me when you have some space in your inventory!
translation: 那可能是因为你把它换成了别的东西，看起来是这样！等你背包里有空间了再来找我！

english: Goodness me! Not much of a messenger, are you? Here's another one; try not to lose it this time! I've charged the parchment to your account.
translation: 天哪！你不太像个信使，对吧？这是另一封；这次别再弄丢了！我把羊皮纸记在你的账上了。

english: Will you take a cheque?
translation: 你能收支票吗？

english: No thanks. I prefer tartan.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我更喜欢格子图案。

english: Hah! Come for my Aphro-Dizzy-Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh? Not surprised with a face like that, to be honest!
translation: 哈！来见识我的‘迷情牦牛’法术吧！想让某人疯狂地爱上你，嗯？说实话，就凭那张脸，我一点也不惊讶！

english: I didn't come here to be insulted!
translation: 我来这里不是来被侮辱的！

english: Really? Well, with ears like that, you do surprise me!
translation: 真的吗？嗯，就凭那对耳朵，你确实让我很惊讶！

english: No, look. I have a letter for you.
translation: 不，听着。我有一封信要给你。

english: Really? Well then, let me see it!
translation: 真的吗？那好，让我看看！

english: Oh. I had it here a moment ago. Where is it?
translation: 哦。我刚才还拿在手里的。去哪儿了？

english: Hah! You've lost it already? You can't get good help these days!
translation: 哈！你已经弄丢了？现在的帮手真不靠谱！

english: I'm very sorry! Let me go get another one!
translation: 非常抱歉！让我再去拿一封！

english: As you must! Now be off with you! I'm busy studying here!
translation: 你必须去！现在快走吧！我正忙着研究呢！

english: Of all the luck!
translation: 真倒霉！

english: Why did you destroy the letter?
translation: 你为什么毁掉那封信？

english: None of your business! It's a secret!
translation: 不关你的事！这是个秘密！

english: Yes, there seems to be a lot of them going around at the moment.
translation: 是啊，最近好像有很多秘密。

english: Of course. Hmmm. However, I could let you in on another secret, if you like?
translation: 当然。嗯。不过，如果你愿意，我可以再告诉你另一个秘密？

english: Go on, then!
translation: 那说吧！

english: My secret is this. I have been spending time here in the palace library trying to discover some ancient spells and magics.
translation: 我的秘密是这样的。我一直在宫殿图书馆里花时间，试图发现一些古老的咒语和魔法。

english: In my research, I have uncovered a most astounding spell that will allow me to transform simple clay into solid gold bars!
translation: 在我的研究中，我发现了一个最惊人的咒语，可以让我把简单的粘土变成纯金条！

english: I will only need a couple of items. The first is very simple: an ordinary bowl to use as a casting vessel.
translation: 我只需要几样东西。第一样很简单：一个普通的碗，用作施法容器。

english: You should be able to find one of these at any local store here in Varrock. I would go myself but I am...uh...busy with my research.
translation: 你应该能在维洛克城的任何一家商店里找到一个。我本来可以自己去，但我……呃……忙着做研究。

english: The other item is much harder. I need a metal wand infused with chaos magic.
translation: 另一样东西就难多了。我需要一根注入了混沌魔法的金属法杖。

english: How would I get something like that?
translation: 我怎样才能得到那样的东西？

english: Take this metal wand. You will also need 15 chaos runes. When you get to the Chaos Altar, use the wand on the altar itself. This should infuse the runes into the wand.
translation: 拿着这根金属法杖。你还需要15个混沌符文。当你到达混沌祭坛时，把法杖用在祭坛上。这应该能把符文注入法杖中。

english: How on earth do you know about Runecrafting? I thought only a few people knew of it.
translation: 你到底是怎么知道符文制作的？我以为只有少数人知道。

english: Hah! Don't presume to think that those wizards in their fancy tower are the only people to have heard of Runecrafting! Now pay attention!
translation: 哈！别以为只有那些在高塔里的魔法师才听说过符文制作！现在给我听好了！

english: You will need to have the 15 chaos runes in your inventory. Make sure you also have either a chaos talisman or chaos tiara to complete the infusion.
translation: 你的背包里必须有15个混沌符文。确保你也有一个混沌护符或混沌头冠来完成注入。

english: Where can I get a talisman or a tiara?
translation: 我在哪里可以弄到护符或头冠？

english: I'm afraid I don't know. You will need to search for one.
translation: 恐怕我不知道。你需要自己找一个。

english: Bring the infused wand and a bowl back to me and I will make us both rich!
translation: 把充能法杖和一个碗带回来给我，我们就能发财了！

english: One more thing. I have uncovered information here in the library which may be of use to you. It tells of a safe route to the Chaos Altar that avoids the Wilderness.
translation: 还有一件事。我在图书馆里发现了一些可能对你有用的信息。它记载了一条通往混沌祭坛的安全路线，可以避开荒野。

english: It is an old tome...a history book of sorts. It's somewhere here in the library. I forget where I left it, but it should be easy enough for you to find.
translation: 那是一本古老的典籍……有点像历史书。就在图书馆的某个地方。我忘了放在哪里了，但你应该很容易找到。

english: I have also given you a copy of a diary I...uh...acquired. It may also help you to find that which you seek.
translation: 我还给了你一份我……呃……‘弄到’的日记副本。它可能也能帮你找到你要找的东西。

english: Is it a BIG secret?
translation: 这是个很大的秘密吗？

english: It's a very big secret!
translation: 这是一个天大的秘密！

english: Bigger than a house?
translation: 比房子还大？

english: Er, yes! It's...
translation: 呃，是的！它……

english: Bigger than a volcano??
translation: 比火山还大？？

english: Yes. Look, it's big, alright? Now listen and I'll tell you.
translation: 是的。听着，它很大，行了吧？现在听我说，我会告诉你的。

english: Now I am ready to use the spell to create all the gold I...uh...the city wants. I would gladly share this gold with you; I simply need a few more things!
translation: 现在我准备好施展咒语，为……呃……城市制造所有需要的黄金了。我很乐意与你分享这些黄金；我只需要再找几样东西！

english: No thanks. I have other things to do for now!
translation: 不了，谢谢。我还有别的事要做！

english: Very well, then. I hope these other matters of 'great' importance outweigh the need to make a LOT of gold. A WHOLE lot of gold. Gold. Yes, gold.
translation: 好吧，那么。我希望这些‘重要’的事情，比赚一大堆黄金更重要。一大堆黄金。黄金。没错，黄金。

english: Uh, why are you repeating yourself like that?
translation: 呃，你为什么这样重复？

english: Dramatic effect.
translation: 戏剧效果。

english: Ah! You're back. Have you found the things I need yet?
translation: 啊！你回来了。你找到我需要的东西了吗？

english: Remind me what I am doing again?
translation: 提醒我一下，我现在要做什么？

english: I lost the wand!
translation: 我把法杖弄丢了！

english: Somehow, I knew that would happen so I have made a few spares for just such an occasion!
translation: 不知怎的，我就知道会这样，所以我提前做了几根备用的，以防万一！

english: Here you g...hang on! There's one still in your inventory! I just saw it! You don't need two and they're not worth anything...yet! Now get going already; there's not much time!
translation: 给你……等等！你的背包里还有一根！我刚刚看到了！你不需要两根，而且它们现在还不值钱……快走吧；没时间了！

english: You would lie to an arch-wizard? There is one in your bank! I can sense it! Go and retrieve that one first!
translation: 你竟敢对大法师撒谎？你银行里就有一个！我能感觉到！先去把那个拿来！

english: You have no space for another one! Lose some of that useless junk in your inventory first!
translation: 你没空间放另一根了！先把你背包里那些没用的垃圾扔一些！

english: Here you are. Try not to lose this one!
translation: 给你。这次别再弄丢了！

english: How much gold will I get?
translation: 我能得到多少黄金？

english: Hmmmm. That all depends on how quickly you get me that infused wand! Work fast and well for me, [player name], and I will make you rich, famous and powerful!
translation: 嗯。那要看你多快能给我弄到充能法杖了！为我卖力干活，[player name]，我会让你变得富有、出名而且强大！

english: Really? Powerful, eh? How powerful?
translation: 真的吗？强大，嗯？多强大？

english: On how soon you stop yapping and get me that wand! Now get moving!
translation: 取决于你什么时候停止碎嘴，把法杖给我拿来！现在快走！

english: Can I ask about the diary?
translation: 我能问问关于那本日记的事吗？

english: Who is this Sin'keth?
translation: 这个辛凯斯是谁？

english: Sin'keth Magis? From what I have read, it would appear he was a great leader of the Dagon'hai Mages.
translation: 辛凯斯.马吉斯？根据我读到的内容，他似乎是达贡海法师的一位伟大领袖。

english: The Dagon-what?
translation: 达贡什么？

english: Hmph! If you read the diary or perused that tome I mentioned, you would know who they are.
translation: 哼！如果你读了那本日记，或者翻阅过我提到的那本典籍，你就会知道他们是谁了。

english: Hey, wait! Isn't your last name Magis too? Are you related to him?
translation: 嘿，等等！你的姓不也是马吉斯吗？你是他的亲戚？

english: No. Not at all. Purely coincidence! Now, haven't you got work to do already?
translation: 不。根本不是。纯属巧合！现在，你难道没有工作要做吗？

english: How I came to have the diary is of no concern to you!
translation: 我是怎么得到这本日记的，你无需知道！

english: Oooo, tetchy!
translation: 哦，急了！

english: I suggest that you concentrate on getting the things I need and stop asking pointless questions!
translation: 我建议你专心去拿我需要的东西，别再问这些没意义的问题了！

english: Where is the safe route?
translation: 安全路线在哪里？

english: I could tell you, of course; I know more or less exactly where it is. However, that would take all the fun out of this, wouldn't it?
translation: 我当然可以告诉你；我大致知道它在哪儿。不过那样就不好玩了，对吧？

english: No, really! It's okay! You can tell me where it is!
translation: 不，真的！没关系！你可以告诉我它在哪儿！

english: No, I think you should see if you can find it for yourself. I have given you the diary and, along with the tome around here, you should be able to find that alternate route easily enough on your own!
translation: 不，我觉得你应该自己找找看。我已经给了你日记，再加上附近那本典籍，你应该能很容易自己找到那条替代路线！

english: Can I have another one?
translation: 能再给我一本吗？

english: You want another copy of the diary?
translation: 你想要另一本日记？

english: Yes, I seem to have misplaced the last one.
translation: 是的，我好像把上一本弄丢了。

english: Hang on! I can see the last copy I gave you in your inventory there! You don't need another one!
translation: 等等！我看到你背包里还有我上次给你的那本！你不需要另一本！

english: Fine, but this diary is important you know! It has secrets that you should not share around with just anybody!
translation: 好吧，但这本日记很重要，你知道吗！里面有些秘密你不该到处跟人说！

english: Never mind, I forgot the question.
translation: 算了，我忘了想问什么。

english: Fair enough. Go then. I expect you have a lot of work to do!
translation: 有道理。走吧。我想你还有很多事要做！

english: Where is that tome you mentioned, again?
translation: 你提到的那本典籍在哪儿来着？

english: Like I said, it's lying around here in the library somewhere. It should be easy enough to find.
translation: 我说过，就在这图书馆的某个地方。应该不难找。

english: Yes, I just gave that to you. Don't break it already!
translation: 是的，我刚把它给了你。别弄坏了！

english: Ah, [player name]! Good to see you! I heard you got my letter to Surok. Well done!
translation: 啊，[player name]！很高兴见到你！我听说你收到了我写给苏洛克的信。干得好！

english: That's right! I did your leg work. Now, how about a reward?
translation: 没错！我替你跑了腿。现在，给点奖励怎么样？

english: Yes, of course! I'd be happy to give you a reward, but I have a lot on my mind with...you know...trader...stuff!
translation: 是的，当然！我很乐意给你奖励，但我脑子里事情太多，你知道的……商人……那些事！

english: You're going to need a bronze pickaxe to get through there!
translation: 你需要一把青铜镐才能通过那里！

english: A bronze one? Why bronze? They're pretty cheap and tacky.
translation: 青铜的？为什么是青铜？那东西又便宜又寒酸。

english: Well, I don't claim to have a lot of knowledge about the ways of magic, but there's a strange protection spell on there.
translation: 呃，我不敢说自己很懂魔法，但那里有一种奇怪的防护咒语。

english: A protection spell?
translation: 防护咒语？

english: Yes. Apparently the makers of this tunnel protected it against all forms of pickaxes except bronze.
translation: 是的。显然这条隧道的建造者让它能抵御所有类型的镐，除了青铜镐。

english: Oh. Why bronze?
translation: 哦。为什么是青铜？

english: I don't think they thought anyone would actually try and use a bronze pickaxe as it's such a poor instrument!
translation: 我觉得他们没想到会有人真的用青铜镐，因为它太差了！

english: I see. Well, thanks for the help.
translation: 明白了。好吧，谢谢你的帮助。

english: Any time! Good luck!
translation: 随时效劳！祝你好运！

english: Thanks, but I already have one.
translation: 谢谢，但我已经有一把了。

english: Oh. Alright then! My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You'll need your bronze pickaxe to get in there.
translation: 哦。那好吧！我的雇主苏洛克.马吉斯传话给我，说你可能要用这条隧道。你需要你的青铜镐才能进去。

english: Yes, it is. Or, at least, it would be. I came to excavate the tunnel but, unfortunately, there so far.
translation: 是的，没错。或者说，本来应该是的。我是来挖掘这条隧道的，但不幸的是，目前只挖了这么多。

english: Be careful! You're going to bring the statue down on both of our heads if you go swinging wildly away like that.
translation: 小心点！你这样乱挥镐，会把雕像砸到我们头上的！

english: I would suggest you improve your Mining skills a bit before you attempt this.
translation: 我建议你在尝试之前，先把你的采矿技能练好一点。

english: Okay, I'd better go and train some more then!
translation: 好吧，那我最好再去多练练！

english: You opened the tunnel; well done!
translation: 你打开了隧道；做得好！

english: Oh. Alright then!
translation: 哦。那好吧！

english: Oh, hello there. I'm just taking a rest at the moment. Could you speak to me another time?
translation: 哦，你好。我现在正在休息。你能改天再跟我说话吗？

english: My employer, Surok Magis, sent word to me that you may come to use the tunnel. You'll need your bronze pickaxe to get in there.
translation: 我的雇主苏洛克.马吉斯传话给我，说你可能要来用隧道。你需要你的青铜镐才能进去。

english: I'm investigating the relative coexistence of convergent entries from two para-dimensional subspaces into a quantum metaphysical universe and the exponential decay of said linear pathways in the event of
translation: 我正在研究两个平行维度子空间汇聚入口在量子形而上学宇宙中的相对共存，以及这些线性路径在发生时空皮层波动时的指数衰减。

english: fluctuations in the space-time cortex.
translation: 时空皮层的波动。

english: Hello there! You must be here for the tunnel. I have a bronze pickaxe here for you, if you want it. You'll need some space for your inventory, though.
translation: 你好！你一定是来用隧道的。我这儿有一把青铜镐，如果你想要的话。不过你的背包得留点空位。

english: What on earth is that?
translation: 那到底是什么东西？

english: I can't tell you. It's a secret!
translation: 我不能告诉你。这是个秘密！

english: I see! It looks pretty magical; I'd be careful with that if I were you!
translation: 我明白了！看起来挺魔法的；要是我，我会小心对待它的！

english: I made the wand that you asked me for, but I seem to have lost it!
translation: 我做了你要的法杖，但好像弄丢了！

english: You lost it? Those wands are extremely powerful and dangerous in the wrong hands! You better hope someone doesn't find it!
translation: 你弄丢了？那些法杖非常强大，落到坏人手里很危险！你最好祈祷没人找到它！

english: Hmph! In the meantime, here's another metal wand. Go and make another infused wand for me...and be more careful this time! My patience is growing thin!
translation: 哼！与此同时，这里还有一根金属法杖。去再给我做一根充能法杖……这次小心点！我的耐心快耗尽了！

english: You say you made the infused wand for me? Then why do you still have that metal wand I gave you? Go and do what I ask before I lose my temper and turn you into a worm or something!
translation: 你说你为我做好了充能法杖？那你为什么还拿着我给你的那根金属法杖？在我发火把你变成蠕虫之类的东西之前，赶紧去做我要你做的事！

english: I have the things you wanted!
translation: 我有你想要的东西了！

english: No, it looks like you still need to find me a bowl first. An ordinary bowl. You can get one from one of the stores around here.
translation: 不，看起来你还需要先给我找一个碗。一个普通的碗。你可以在附近的商店里买一个。

english: Excellent! Well done! I knew that you would not let me down.
translation: 太好了！干得好！我就知道你不会让我失望的。

english: So...about this gold that you're going to give me?
translation: 那么……关于你要给我的那些黄金？

english: All in good time. I must prepare the spell first, and that will take a little time. While I am doing that, please take this letter to Rat, the trader outside the city who sent you here.
translation: 别急。我得先准备法术，这需要一点时间。在我准备的时候，请把这封信带给老鼠，就是城外那个把你派来的商人。

english: Okay, but I'll be back for my gold.
translation: 好吧，但我还会回来拿我的黄金的。

english: Yes, yes, yes. Now off you go!
translation: 是是是。现在快去吧！

english: I seem to have lost that letter you gave me!
translation: 我好像把你给我的那封信弄丢了！

english: Goodness me! You do lose a lot of things! It's a wonder you can make it out of bed in the mornings! Well, here's another one!
translation: 天哪！你丢的东西可真多！真不明白你早上是怎么起得了床的！好吧，再给你一封！

english: It's not surprising with all that junk in your inventory! Get some room, first, then speak to me again!
translation: 你背包里塞满了垃圾，丢东西也不奇怪！先腾出点空间，再来找我说话！

english: That letter was treasonous so I destroyed it!
translation: 那封信是叛国之物，所以我把它销毁了！

english: Really? You destroyed it?
translation: 真的吗？你把它销毁了？

english: You want another one, don't you?
translation: 你还想要一封，对吧？

english: Ah...uh...yes...yes, I do.
translation: 啊……呃……是的……是的，我想要。

english: Fine. Here you are. And stop all this complaining; it's getting me down!
translation: 好吧。给你。别再抱怨了；这让我很沮丧！

english: That is not your concern! I am Surok Magis and I am more powerful than you can possibly imagine!
translation: 这不关你的事！我是苏洛克.马吉斯，我的强大超乎你的想象！

english: So what's in it for me?
translation: 那我有什么好处？

english: You get to live. For now.
translation: 你能活命。至少暂时是。

english: Not that I'm complaining about the living part, but I was expecting something of more...er...value?
translation: 我不是抱怨能活下来，但我原本期待的是……呃……更有价值的东西？

english: Ah, yes. The gold. Don't you worry, I am still working on that. Just deliver my letter for me, first. Now be off!
translation: 啊，对。黄金。别担心，我还在想办法。先帮我把信送到。快去吧！

english: Fine. I will deliver the letter, but I will be back soon.
translation: 好吧。我会把信送到，但我很快会回来。

english: I am sure you will.
translation: 我相信你会的。

english: Do I still get the gold?
translation: 我还能拿到黄金吗？

english: If that is your only concern, then yes, you do. But I must warn you, my patience with you is wearing thin. So go now and do my bidding!
translation: 如果你只关心这个，那么是的，你会得到。但我必须警告你，我对你的耐心快耗尽了。所以现在快去执行我的命令！

english: Your majesty, I think that you should see this letter.
translation: 陛下，我觉得您应该看看这封信。

english: Letter? Let me see. Where's Postie Pete? He usually deals with the mail around here.
translation: 信？让我看看。邮差皮特呢？平时都是他处理这里邮件的。

english: This letter was delivered to me by hand, your majesty. I think you may be in some danger.
translation: 陛下，这封信是有人亲手交给我的。我觉得您可能身处危险之中。

english: Hmmm. I see. I appreciate your concern. However, I assure you, I am quite safe here. My guards are on full alert at all times.
translation: 嗯。我明白了。感谢你的关心。不过，我向你保证，我在这里非常安全。我的卫兵随时都处于高度戒备状态。

english: I don't think you understand...
translation: 我想你并不明白……

english: I understand perfectly. Now, for all I know, that letter could be a fake ruse. We get a lot of that sort of thing and it causes a lot of hassle.
translation: 我完全明白。现在，就我所知，那封信可能是假的诡计。我们经常遇到这种事，非常麻烦。

english: I'm trying to save your life!
translation: 我是想救你的命！

english: And you are shouting at your king! People who yell at their monarchs often find their heads become...loose!
translation: 而你在对自己的国王大吼大叫！对君主大喊大叫的人，脑袋往往会变得……松垮！

english: I'm just saying that the letter is real.
translation: 我只是说那封信是真的。

english: Then why do you have it?
translation: 那你为什么拿着它？

english: Because I'm supposed to deliv...oh.
translation: 因为我应该送……哦。

english: It seems to me that if that letter were genuine, I would be forced to arrest its bearer for treason. You understand.
translation: 在我看来，如果那封信是真的，我就不得不以叛国罪逮捕送信人。你懂的。

english: I...er...I reckon it's a fake! ...I guess...
translation: 我……呃……我觉得它是假的！……大概吧……

english: Just as I thought! Now off you go!
translation: 和我想的一样！现在你可以走了！

english: Ah, [player name]! You've returned!
translation: 啊，[player name]！你回来了！

english: Yes! I have a letter for you.
translation: 是的！我给你带来了一封信。

english: This letter is treasonous! This does indeed confirm my worst fears. It is time I let you into my secret and hopefully this will answer any questions you may have.
translation: 这封信是叛国的！这确实证实了我最坏的担忧。是时候让你知道我的秘密了，希望这能回答你所有的问题。

english: Okay. Go on.
translation: 好的，请说。

english: I am not really a trader. I am the Commander of the Varrock Palace Secret Guard. VPSG for short.
translation: 我并非真正的商人。我是维洛克城皇宫秘密守卫的指挥官，简称VPSG。

english: Okay, I had a feeling you weren't a real trader due to the fact that you had nothing to sell! So why the secrecy?
translation: 好吧，我早就觉得你不是真正的商人，因为你根本没东西卖！那为什么要保密呢？

english: I'm just getting to that. A short while ago, we received word that Surok had discovered a powerful mind-control spell and intended to use it on King Roald himself!
translation: 我正要说这个。不久前，我们收到消息说苏罗克发现了一种强大的精神控制法术，并打算用它对付罗尔德国王本人！

english: He could control the whole kingdom that way!
translation: 这样他就能控制整个王国了！

english: I think I can believe that. Surok's not the nicest person in Misthalin!
translation: 我倒觉得可信。苏罗克可不是米斯塔林最友善的人！

english: Yes, but until now, the spell has been useless to him as he is currently under guard at the palace and not allowed to leave. He could not get the tools for the spell because if he left the palace he would be arrested!
translation: 是的，但在此之前，这个法术对他毫无用处，因为他目前被守卫在宫殿里，不允许离开。他无法拿到施法工具，因为一旦离开宫殿就会被逮捕！

english: Uh oh! I think I may have helped him by mistake, here. He promised me a big reward if I collected some items for him...but he said it was for a spell to make gold!
translation: 哦不！我可能无意中帮了他。他承诺给我丰厚的报酬，让我收集一些东西……但他说是用来变出黄金的法术！

english: Yes, we heard that somehow Surok had obtained the things he needed but we were not sure how. I thought it might have been you.
translation: 是的，我们听说苏罗克不知怎么搞到了所需的东西，但不确定是怎么弄到的。我猜可能是你。

english: However, I assumed you did not know of his plans; that is why you weren't arrested!
translation: 不过，我猜你并不知道他的计划，所以才没有逮捕你！

english: Thank you! How can I help fix this mistake?
translation: 谢谢你！我该怎么弥补这个错误？

english: Okay, here's what I need you to do. One of my contacts has devised a spell that he is sure will be able to counteract the effects of the mind-control spell. I need you to visit him.
translation: 好的，我需要你这样做。我的一个联系人设计了一种法术，他确信能抵消精神控制法术的效果。我需要你去拜访他。

english: Okay, who is it?
translation: 好的，是谁？

english: His name is Zaff. He runs a staff shop in Varrock. Go and speak to him and he will tell you what you should do. I will send word to him to let him know that you are coming.
translation: 他叫扎夫。在维洛克城经营一家法杖店。去找他谈谈，他会告诉你怎么做。我会先给他传话，让他知道你要来。

english: Yes, sir! I'm on my way!
translation: 是的，长官！我这就去！

english: Yes, and you have some explaining to do!
translation: 是的，你可得解释清楚！

english: Why? Whatever do you mean?
translation: 为什么？你什么意思？

english: This letter from Surok to you implies that you're involved in a treasonous plot! I should tell the guards about you!
translation: 这封苏罗克给你的信暗示你参与了一个叛国阴谋！我应该告诉守卫关于你的事！

english: I'm sure I don't know what you mean. Let me see the letter, please.
translation: 我肯定不明白你在说什么。请把信给我看看。

english: What, you're still here?
translation: 什么，你还在这里？

english: Yes. I still haven't found someone to help me yet, but I hear you've been very busy yourself!
translation: 是的。我还没找到人帮我，但我听说你自己倒是挺忙的！

english: You have? Who told you that?
translation: 你听说了？谁告诉你的？

english: Oh, I have my sources. Was there anything else?
translation: 哦，我有自己的消息来源。还有别的事吗？

english: What am I doing now?
translation: 我现在要做什么？

english: You need to go and see Zaff. He can be found at 'ZaffsStaffs', the staff shop in Varrock. He will tell you what to do next.
translation: 你需要去见扎夫。他可以在维洛克城的‘扎夫法杖店’找到。他会告诉你下一步该怎么做。

english: Do you think we can stop Surok?
translation: 你觉得我们能阻止苏罗克吗？

english: Surok is a powerful mage and ruthless too. Who knows what will happen. I am sure that we will prevail, though. Don't worry, [player name]! You'll be fine!
translation: 苏罗克是个强大的法师，而且心狠手辣。谁知道会发生什么。但我相信我们终将获胜。别担心，[player name]！你会没事的！

english: Do you have anything to trade yet?
translation: 你有东西要交易了吗？

english: No, I'm afraid I have nothing in stock, largely due to the fact that I'm not really a trader, as I just mentioned.
translation: 不，恐怕我没什么存货，主要因为我不是真正的商人，我刚说过。

english: Ah yes, I remember!
translation: 啊对，我想起来了！

english: You know, your cart IS kind of small!
translation: 你知道吗，你的推车还真有点小！

english: What are you implying?
translation: 你什么意思？

english: Oh, nothing! It's very...er...cute!
translation: 哦，没什么！它很……呃……可爱！

english: Why exactly are you still here?
translation: 你到底为什么还在这里？

english: Okay, I better go!
translation: 好了，我还是走吧！

english: Okay, good luck!
translation: 好，祝你好运！

english: I've been told of your foul plans, Surok! You lied to me about the gold, so I've come to stop you!
translation: 苏罗克，我已经听说了你的邪恶计划！你关于黄金的事骗了我，所以我来阻止你！

english: Oh really? And what makes you think you have even the slightest chance of doing that?
translation: 哦，是吗？你凭什么觉得自己有一丁点机会做到？

english: I'll fight you if I have to!
translation: 必要的话，我会和你战斗！

english: Enough! You have been of use to me before but now you are wasting my time! Be gone!
translation: 够了！你以前对我有用，但现在你在浪费我的时间！滚开！

english: Rat Burgiss sent me!
translation: 是拉特.伯吉斯派我来的！

english: Ah, yes; You must be [player name]! Rat sent word that you would be coming. Everything is prepared. I have created a spell that will remove the mind control from the king.
translation: 啊，是的；你一定是[player name]！老鼠传话说你会来。一切都准备好了。我创造了一个可以解除国王精神控制的法术。

english: Okay, so what's the plan?
translation: 好的，那计划是什么？

english: Listen carefully. For the spell to succeed, the king must be made very weak. If his mind is controlled, you will need to fight him until he is all but dead.
translation: 仔细听着。要让法术成功，国王必须变得非常虚弱。如果他的心神被控制，你需要与他战斗，直到他几乎死去。

english: Then and ONLY then, use your ring to summon me. I will teleport to you and cast the spell that will cure the king.
translation: 只有那时，而且必须是那时，用你的戒指召唤我。我会传送过来，施展治愈国王的法术。

english: Why must I summon you? Can't you come with me?
translation: 为什么必须我召唤你？你不能跟我一起去吗？

english: I cannot. I must look after my shop here and I have lots to do. Rest assured, I will come when you summon me.
translation: 我不能。我必须在这里照看我的店，还有很多事要做。放心，你召唤我时我就会来。

english: Okay, so what do I do now?
translation: 好的，那我现在该做什么？

english: First, free up 2 inventory spaces so I can give you a couple of things.
translation: 首先，腾出2个物品栏空格，我好给你一些东西。

english: Take this beacon ring and some instructions.
translation: 拿着这个信标戒指和一些说明。

english: Once you have read the instructions, it will be time for you to arrest Surok.
translation: 等你读完说明，就该去逮捕苏罗克了。

english: Won't he be disinclined to acquiesce to that request?
translation: 他会不会不愿意服从那个要求？

english: Won't he what?
translation: 他不愿意什么？

english: Won't he refuse?
translation: 他会不会拒绝？

english: I very much expect so. It may turn nasty, so be on your guard. I hope we can stop him before he can cast his spell! Make sure you have that ring I gave you.
translation: 我非常希望如此。事情可能会变得棘手，所以要小心。我希望我们能在他的法术完成之前阻止他！确保你带着我给你的那枚戒指。

english: Okay, thanks, Zaff!
translation: 好的，谢谢，扎夫！

english: Rat has told me that you are to be made an honorary member of the VPSG so that you can arrest Surok. If you have any questions about this, ask Rat.
translation: 老鼠告诉我，你将作为VPSG的荣誉成员，这样你就可以逮捕苏洛克。如果你对此有任何疑问，去问老鼠。

english: One last thing: you must remember that as part of the VPSG, we must remain secretive at all times. For this reason, I cannot discuss matters such as this unless absolutely necessary!
translation: 最后一件事：你必须记住，作为VPSG的一员，我们必须时刻保密。因此，除非绝对必要，我不能讨论这类事情！

english: Of course! Thanks again!
translation: 当然！再次感谢！

english: I need to ask you something else.
translation: 我还有其他事要问你。

english: Go ahead!
translation: 说吧！

english: What am I doing again?
translation: 我再做什么来着？

english: Make sure you have read the instructions I gave you about the ring. Then, when you are ready, go to Surok and arrest him!
translation: 确保你已经读了我给你的关于戒指的说明。然后，准备好后，去找苏罗克，逮捕他！

english: You have one already. It's there in your inventory!
translation: 你已经有一个了。就在你的物品栏里！

english: Yes, I have another one, but you don't have any space for it. Speak to me when your inventory is less full!
translation: 是的，我还有一个，但你没有空间放了。等你的物品栏空一些再来找我！

english: Well, I do happen to have another one here that you can have. Please try and be a bit more careful with this one!
translation: 嗯，我这里正好还有一个可以给你。请尽量小心保管这个！

english: Can I have the instructions again?
translation: 我能再要一份说明吗？

english: What are you doing, [player name]? I'm right here! Why are you trying to summon me again?
translation: [player name]，你在干什么？我就在这里！你为什么又要召唤我？

english: Sorry, I was just testing the ring.
translation: 抱歉，我只是在测试戒指。

english: Well, stop playing around; I'm a busy man!
translation: 别玩了，我很忙的！

english: Okay, Surok, your time is ov...hey! What gives? You don't need me yet! Why did you use the ring?
translation: 好了，苏罗克，你的时间到了……嘿！搞什么！你还没需要我呢！你为什么用戒指？

english: Look, stop messing around! My shop doesn't look after itself, you know! Hmm. Perhaps I could invent a spell that would do that...
translation: 听着，别闹了！我的店可不会自己看店，你知道吗！嗯……也许我可以发明一个法术来做到这点……

english: Is that supposed to amuse me?
translation: 这应该让我觉得好笑吗？

english: Ooh! Shiny! I would take it, but I'd probably have to sell it. I have a wife and 17 children to feed!
translation: 哦！闪闪发光！我很想拿，但可能得卖掉。我还有老婆和17个孩子要养呢！

english: Besides, you probably need it more than me right now!
translation: 再说，你现在可能比我更需要它！

english: I have been to see Zaff and he has told me to go and arrest Surok.
translation: 我去见了扎夫，他让我去逮捕苏罗克。

english: Excellent! In that case, we are all set and ready to foil Surok's plans!
translation: 太好了！这样的话，我们已经准备好挫败苏罗克的计划了！

english: Now it is all down to you, [player name]. As you have proven yourself in the tasks I have set you, I am making you an honorary member of the VPSG!
translation: 现在一切都靠你了，[player name]。既然你在我的任务中证明了自己，我将任命你为VPSG的荣誉成员！

english: Oooh! Do we have adventurer's insurance?
translation: 哦！我们有冒险者保险吗？

english: Well...no. But we do have a nice lady called Emma who makes the tea on Mondays.
translation: 嗯……没有。但我们有一位叫艾玛的好心女士，她在每周一泡茶。

english: Oh, well that sounds just as good!
translation: 哦，那也不错！

english: Right then. You have an important task set out for you. Good luck, [player name]!
translation: 好了。你有重要的任务要完成。祝你好运，[player name]！

english: What are my orders again?
translation: 我的命令是什么来着？

english: You will need to go and speak to Surok now. Arrest him under the authority of the Varrock Palace Secret Guard.
translation: 你现在需要去找苏洛克谈话。以维洛克城皇宫秘密守卫的权威逮捕他。

english: Right then.
translation: 好的。

english: It may be tough and Surok will most likely not be arrested without a fight, so be on your guard!
translation: 可能会很艰难，苏洛克很可能不会乖乖就擒，所以要保持警惕！

english: Can you tell me of the Dagon'hai?
translation: 你能告诉我达贡海的事情吗？

english: How do you know of them?
translation: 你是怎么知道他们的？

english: Surok gave me a diary that spoke of them. Do you know anything about them?
translation: 苏洛克给了我一本日记，里面提到了他们。你知道些什么吗？

english: I see. The Dagon'hai were a powerful order of Zamorakian mages who resided here in this very city.
translation: 原来如此。达贡亥是一个强大的扎莫拉克法师组织，他们曾居住在这座城市里。

english: However, the priests of Saradomin warred ferociously with them and tried to destroy them. The Dagon'hai, though, were very clever and extremely cunning.
translation: 然而，萨拉多明的祭司们与他们激烈交战，试图消灭他们。但达贡亥非常狡猾，极其诡计多端。

english: They hid themselves away within the city and, rumour has it, they even had a way of getting to the Wilderness and back without ever being seen, although I have no idea how that might have been.
translation: 他们躲藏在城市里，而且有传言说，他们甚至有一种方法能在不被发现的情况下往返荒野，尽管我不知道那是怎么做到的。

english: So where are they now?
translation: 那他们现在在哪？

english: Nobody knows. They disappeared from the city a hundred years ago and very few people even remember who they were.
translation: 没人知道。一百年前他们就从这个城市消失了，甚至很少有人记得他们是谁。

english: So how do you know about them?
translation: 那你是怎么知道他们的？

english: My grandfather's brother, my great uncle, was a priest of Saradomin and he would tell me stories of the wars with the Dagon'hai as a child.
translation: 我祖父的兄弟，我的叔祖父，曾是一位萨拉多明祭司，他小时候会给我讲与达贡亥作战的故事。

english: I've lost that ring I had!
translation: 我弄丢了我那个戒指！

english: Then you will have to go and speak to Zaff at Zaff's Staffs to get another one!
translation: 那你得去扎夫的法杖店找扎夫再要一个！

english: At ease, soldier!
translation: 稍息，士兵！

english: You shouldn't mock your commanding officer, private! Don't forget, I can still have you arrested for conspiracy with Surok!
translation: 你不该嘲笑你的指挥官，列兵！别忘了，我仍然可以以与苏洛克合谋的罪名逮捕你！

english: What benefits do I get in the VPSG?
translation: 我在VPSG能得到什么好处？

english: Unfortunately, as an honorary member of the VPSG, you only get to act under our authority. You aren't entitled to the full Secret Guard package.
translation: 不幸的是，作为VPSG的名誉成员，你只能以我们的名义行事。你无权享受完整的秘密守卫待遇。

english: So I don't get the secret spy-pack then?
translation: 所以我拿不到秘密间谍包了？

english: I'm afraid not. No.
translation: 恐怕不行。不。

english: Okay, I need to go!
translation: 好了，我得走了！

english: Yes, you have an important job! Good luck, [player name]!
translation: 是的，你有重要任务！祝你好运，[player name]！

english: Surok!! Your plans have been uncovered! You are hereby under arrest on the authority of the Varrock Palace Secret Guard!
translation: 苏洛克！！你的计划已经暴露了！我以维洛克城皇宫秘密守卫的名义逮捕你！

english: So! You're with the Secret Guard, eh? I should have known! I knew you had ugly ears from the start...and your nose is too short!
translation: 哼！原来你跟秘密守卫是一伙的，是吧？我早就该猜到！我从一开始就觉得你的耳朵很丑……还有你的鼻子太短了！

english: Give yourself up, Surok!
translation: 投降吧，苏洛克！

english: Never! I am Surok Magis, descendant of the High Elder Sin'keth Magis, rightful heir of the Dagon'hai Order! I will have my revenge on those who destroyed my people!
translation: 绝不！我是苏洛克.马吉斯，高阶长老辛凯斯.马吉斯的后裔，达贡亥教团的合法继承人！我要向那些毁灭我族人的人复仇！

english: The place is surrounded. There is nowhere to run!
translation: 这个地方已经被包围了。你无处可逃！

english: Do you really wish to die so readily? Are you prepared to face your death?
translation: 你真的这么想死吗？你准备好面对死亡了吗？

english: Bring it on!
translation: 放马过来吧！

english: I am a Dagon'hai! I run from nothing. My spell has been completed and it is time for you to meet your end, [player name]! The king is now under my control!
translation: 我是达贡亥人！我从不逃跑。我的法术已经完成，是时候让你完蛋了，[player name]！国王现在在我掌控之下！

english: Annach Narh Hin Dei!
translation: 安纳克 纳尔 辛 戴！

english: What's going on...?
translation: 怎么回事……？

english: I... must... kill... [player name]!
translation: 我……必须……杀死……[player name]！

english: Uh oh! King Roald looks evil!
translation: 哎呀！罗尔德国王看起来好邪恶！

english: Fine! You win this time!
translation: 好吧！这次你赢了！

english: Get out of my sight then!
translation: 那就滚出我的视线！

english: The king's still too strong! We had better get out of here!
translation: 国王还是太强了！我们最好离开这里！

english: Wait! Let me keep fighting!
translation: 等等！让我继续打！

english: It's too late! I cast the spell as soon as you summoned me, but it was too early! We need to withdraw and plan our attack again!
translation: 太晚了！你一召唤我我就施了咒，但还是太早了！我们需要撤退，重新计划我们的攻击！

english: Sin danna nim borha!
translation: 辛 丹纳 宁 博尔哈！

english: The king's mind has been restored to him and he has been teleported away to safety. Now, to deal with Surok!
translation: 国王的心智已经恢复，他被传送到了安全的地方。现在，来对付苏洛克！

english: No! All is lost! I must escape!
translation: 不！全完了！我必须逃！

english: You will not escape justice this time, Surok!
translation: 这次你逃不掉正义的制裁了，苏洛克！

english: Mirra din namus!
translation: 米拉 丁 纳穆斯！

english: Stop!!
translation: 停下！！

english: Your teleport spell has been corrupted, Surok! I have placed a magic block on this room. You will remain here, under guard, in the library from now on.
translation: 你的传送法术已经被破坏了，苏洛克！我已经在这个房间施放了魔法封锁。从现在起，你将留在图书馆，在守卫的看管下。

english: No! My plans have been ruined! I was so close to success!
translation: 不！我的计划全毁了！我明明离成功那么近了！

english: Thank you for your help, [player name]. I will put the room back in order and then I must leave. Surok is defeated and will be no more trouble for us. We will guard him more closely from now on!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，[player name]。我会把房间恢复原状，然后我必须离开了。苏洛克被打败了，不会再给我们添麻烦了。从现在起，我们会更严密地看守他！

english: Why did you teleport us? We were winning!
translation: 你为什么要传送我们？我们明明要赢了！

english: The king was not weak enough and Surok's power over him was still too strong! You must weaken the king further before summoning me. Otherwise, we will fail.
translation: 国王还不够虚弱，苏洛克对他的控制力仍然太强！你必须在召唤我之前进一步削弱国王。否则，我们会失败的。

english: I am afraid we must try again. We will defeat Surok this time. I am sure of it!
translation: 恐怕我们得再试一次。这次我们会打败苏洛克的。我确信！

english: You have foiled my plans, [player name]... I obviously underestimated you.
translation: 你破坏了我的计划，[player name]……我显然低估了你。

english: Yes. Let this be a lesson to you.
translation: 没错。希望这对你是个教训。

english: We did it! We beat Surok!
translation: 我们做到了！我们打败了苏洛克！

english: Yes. You have done well, [player name]. You are to be commended for your actions!
translation: 是的。你做得很好，[player name]。你的行为值得表扬！

english: It was all in the call of duty!
translation: 这都是职责所在！

english: What will happen with Surok now?
translation: 现在苏洛克会怎么样？

english: Well, when I disrupted Surok's spell, he will have been sealed in the library, but we will still need to keep an eye on him, just in case.
translation: 嗯，当我扰乱苏洛克的法术时，他应该会被封在图书馆里，但我们还是得盯着他，以防万一。

english: When you are ready, report back to Rat and he will reward you.
translation: 等你准备好了，就回去向老鼠汇报，他会奖励你。

english: Okay, I will.
translation: 好的，我会的。

english: Sadly, however, after this I will not be able to discuss these matters with you again. They are secret and we must be vigilant. The VPSG will prevail!
translation: 不过可惜的是，在这之后，我将不能再和你讨论这些事了。这都是秘密，我们必须保持警惕。VPSG必胜！

english: No, I'm afraid I can't help you.
translation: 不，恐怕我帮不了你。

english: You've still got the last one I gave you on your finger!
translation: 我上次给你的那个还在你手指上戴着呢！

english: You're wearing it. There. On your finger!
translation: 你正戴着它呢。那儿，就在你手指上！

english: Remember, I am a member of the VPSG and we see everything! My sources tell me there is one in your bank. Go back and retrieve it from there!
translation: 记住，我是VPSG成员，我们什么都能看见！我的线人告诉我，你的银行里有一个。回去把它取出来！

english: Of course. I understand. Goodbye!
translation: 当然。我明白。再见！

english: Well, [player name], how did it go?
translation: 那么，[player name]，情况如何？

english: You should have been there! There was this...and Surok was like...and I was...and then the King...and, and...uh...ahem! The mission was accomplished and the king has been saved.
translation: 你真该在场！当时这样……苏洛克那样……我这样……然后国王……然后……呃……咳咳！任务完成了，国王得救了。

english: I take it that it went alright, then? That's great news!
translation: 那我猜一切顺利？太好了！

english: Zaff has already briefed me on the events. We will arrange for Surok to be fed and watched. I think he will not be a problem any more.
translation: 扎夫已经跟我汇报了情况。我们会安排给苏洛克送饭并派人看守。我想他不会再是麻烦了。

english: You know, one thing bothers me. He's now stuck in the library, but wasn't that the reason we were in this mess in the first place?
translation: 你知道，有件事让我很困扰。他现在被困在图书馆里，但这不就是我们最初陷入困境的原因吗？

english: Yes, you are right. But rest assured, we will be watching him much more closely from now on.
translation: 是的，你说得对。但请放心，从现在起我们会更严密地监视他。

english: You've done very well and have been a credit to the VPSG; perhaps one day there may be a place for you here!
translation: 你做得非常好，为VPSG增了光；也许有一天这里会有你一席之地！

english: In the meantime, let me reward you for what you've done, give you a little training. I will be sure to call on you if we ever need help in the future.
translation: 与此同时，让我奖励你的所作所为，给你一点训练。如果将来我们需要帮助，我一定会找你的。

english: Hi, Rat!
translation: 嗨，老鼠！

english: Ah! [player name]! You did a fine service for us. You might make a good member of the VPSG one day, with a little training and a bit more muscle!
translation: 啊！[player name]！你为我们立了大功。经过一点训练，再壮实点，你以后说不定能成为VPSG的好成员！

english: So, do you have any more jobs for me to do?
translation: 那你还有什么任务给我做吗？

english: At the moment, no. Things seem pretty quiet. However, I have heard a rumour about something strange going on in...hmm, no, I think we can handle this one for now.
translation: 目前没有。事情看起来挺平静的。不过，我听到一个传言，说有个地方在发生一些奇怪的事……嗯，不，我觉得这次我们能自己处理。

english: But, who knows? We may need your assistance again soon. Thank you, [player name].
translation: 不过，谁知道呢？我们可能很快又需要你的帮助。谢谢你，[player name]。

english: A letter for me? Let me see.
translation: 给我的信？让我看看。

english: Take it to a wizard named Surok Magis who resides in the Varrock Palace Library. I'll see about some sort of reward for your work when I get myself sorted out here.
translation: 把它拿给一个叫苏洛克.马吉斯的魔法师，他住在维洛克城宫殿图书馆。等我在这里把事情处理完，我会给你一些报酬的。

english: No problem! Say, have you been to see the wizard's tower in the south yet? It's an amazing sight! You should go and see it!
translation: 没问题！对了，你去过南边那座魔法师塔吗？那景色太棒了！你应该去看看！

english: No...I mean yes... Look, that's besides the point.
translation: 不……我是说对……听着，那不是重点。

english: Take that letter I gave you to Surok Magis, the wizard found in the Varrock Palace Library.
translation: 把我给你的那封信拿给苏洛克.马吉斯，那个在维洛克城宫殿图书馆的魔法师。

english: I see. Well, try not to drown yourself with all that brain usage!
translation: 我明白了。好吧，尽量别让那么多脑力活动淹死你自己！

english: Yes, good luck, then.
translation: 好吧，祝你好运。

english: You need to go and see Zaff. He can be found at 'Zaffs Staffs', the staff shop in Varrock. He will tell you what to do next.
translation: 你得去找扎夫。他在维洛克城的“扎夫的法杖”法杖店里。他会告诉你下一步该怎么做。

english: What I want you to do is take this letter to someone for me. It's in a different language so, trust me, you won't be able to read it.
translation: 我要你做的是帮我把这封信带给一个人。信是用另一种语言写的，所以相信我，你看不懂。

english: Yes, but until now the spell has been useless to him as he is currently under guard at the palace and not allowed to leave.
translation: 是的，但在此之前，这个法术对他毫无用处，因为他目前被守卫在宫殿里，不允许离开。

english: Okay, well listen this time. A short while ago we received word that Surok had discovered a powerful mind-control spell and intended to use it on King Roald himself.
translation: 好吧，这次听好了。不久前我们得到消息，苏洛克发现了一个强大的心灵控制法术，并打算用它对付罗尔德国王本人。

english: You still don't have any free space in your inventory! How do you get up in the morning with a brain like that? Talk to me when you have some space!
translation: 你的背包里还是没有空位！就凭那个大脑，你是怎么起床的？等你有空位了再来跟我说话！

english: Uhhh...no. No, that's not it. And nobody likes beggars! You know, on second thought, I think I'll keep my secret for now. Look, instead, you can do another job for me.
translation: 呃……不。不，不是这样。而且没人喜欢乞丐！你知道吗，我改主意了，暂时还是保守秘密吧。听着，不如你帮我做另一件事。

english: Yes, well, I'm sure that may be the case. But what I want you to do is take this letter to someone for me. It's in a different language so, trust me, you won't be able to read it.
translation: 好吧，我相信可能是这样。但我要你做的是帮我把这封信带给一个人。信是用另一种语言写的，所以相信我，你看不懂。

english: He could not get the tools for the spell because if he left the palace he would be arrested!
translation: 他拿不到法术所需的工具，因为一旦离开宫殿就会被逮捕！

english: However, I assumed you did not know of his plans, so you weren't arrested!
translation: 不过，我假定你不知道他的计划，所以你没有被捕！

english: Yes, that would be because it's a rickshaw cart.
translation: 是的，那是因为它是辆人力推车。

english: You don't say...!
translation: 真的假的……！

english: I happen to know you have the folder I gave you in your bank.
translation: 我碰巧知道你把我给你的文件夹放在银行里了。

english: Didn't I explain this already?
translation: 我不是已经解释过了吗？

english: You're going to poke someone's eye out, waving that around like that!
translation: 你这样挥舞会戳到别人的眼睛的！

english: Any time, Rat!
translation: 随时效劳，老鼠！

english: Good, you're here. I take it you received Idria's message?
translation: 很好，你来了。看来你收到伊德里亚的消息了？

english: Message?
translation: 消息？

english: It was not delivered to you? This is concerning... Still, the point is you're here. Now, are you willing to help us?
translation: 没送到你手上？这有点令人担忧……不过，关键是你来了。现在，你愿意帮我们吗？

english: I did, but I have a few questions...
translation: 我收到了，但我有几个问题……

english: They will have to wait. There is only one question of importance at the moment: Are you willing to help us?
translation: 那些得等等。现在只有一个重要问题：你愿意帮我们吗？

english: I think so...
translation: 我想是吧……

english: Good. Meet Thaerisk upstairs. There is much to discuss and Lucien's spies are everywhere.
translation: 很好。到楼上去见赛里斯克。有很多事要谈，而且卢西安的间谍无处不在。

english: Hang on... Did you say Lucien?
translation: 等等……你刚才是说卢西安？

english: Upstairs. Now!
translation: 楼上。现在！

english: I think I'll pass. This is all a bit weird for me.
translation: 我想我还是算了。这一切对我来说有点太奇怪了。

english: What are you waiting for? Thaerisk is waiting for you upstairs.
translation: 你还在等什么？赛里斯克在楼上等你。

english: Ah, you made it. Given recent events, that in itself is something for us to be thankful about.
translation: 啊，你来了。考虑到最近发生的事，这本身就值得我们庆幸了。

english: Unfortunately so. We've already lost several of our brethren in recent days. Lucien's agents are only growing bolder.
translation: 很不幸，是的。最近几天我们已经失去了几位同胞。卢西安的爪牙越来越嚣张了。

english: Sorry, but I'm going to need some explanation. What's going on, and what does it have to do with Lucien?
translation: 抱歉，但我需要一些解释。到底发生了什么，这跟卢西安有什么关系？

english: You mean you do not know? Idria's message should have explained the situation.
translation: 你是说你不知道？伊德里亚的消息应该已经说明了情况。

english: But I never received any message.
translation: 但我从没收到任何消息。

english: I see. In that case, I will explain what I can, but I will need to be brief.
translation: 我明白了。既然如此，我会尽量解释，但得长话短说。

english: Sorry, but I'm going to need a bit more of an explanation on what's going on. The message I received didn't have too many details.
translation: 抱歉，但我需要更详细地了解情况。我收到的消息没有太多细节。

english: Yes, of course. I will explain what I can, but I will need to be brief.
translation: 当然可以。我会尽量解释，但得长话短说。

english: My name is Thaerisk Cemphier and I lead a group of Guthixians called Crux Eqal. Our duty is a straightforward one: To safeguard this world from the chaos of imbalance.
translation: 我叫赛里斯克.森菲尔，领导一个名为克鲁克斯.埃卡尔的古斯信徒组织。我们的职责很简单：保护这个世界免受失衡带来的混乱。

english: Safeguard? Doesn't that risk conflicting with the peaceful nature of being a druid?
translation: 保护？这难道不会与德鲁伊的和平本性相冲突吗？

english: Yes, it sadly does. However, our work is a necessity. Without those of us willing to do what must be done to protect this world, peace will never be more than a fantasy.
translation: 是的，很遗憾确实如此。但我们的工作是必要的。如果没有我们这些愿意为保护这个世界而做该做的事的人，和平永远只是幻想。

english: Now, while I do enjoy debating concepts such as these, we are getting sidetracked. Let's get back to the matter at hand.
translation: 好了，虽然我很喜欢讨论这些概念，但我们跑题了。回到正事上来吧。

english: Lucien?
translation: 卢西安？

english: Precisely. We have been keeping an eye on the Mahjarrat for some time. We consider many of them to be grave threats to the safety of our world.
translation: 正是。我们监视玛哈加特已经有一段时间了。我们认为他们中的许多人对我们世界的安全构成了严重威胁。

english: However, truth be told, until recently, we didn't consider Lucien to be among that number. All that changed when you came along.
translation: 不过，说实话，直到最近，我们并不认为卢西安是其中之一。这一切在你出现后就变了。

english: When you helped Lucien obtain the Staff of Armadyl, you set him on a path to unimaginable power. After all, Zamorak himself was once a Mahjarrat, until he used the Staff of Armadyl to attain godhood...
translation: 当你帮助卢西安获得阿玛杜尔杖时，你让他走上了一条通往难以想象的力量的道路。毕竟，萨莫拉克本人曾经也是一名玛哈加特，直到他用阿玛杜尔杖获得了神性……

english: However, truth be told, until recently, we didn't consider Lucien to be among that number. All that changed when, despite your best attempts to stop him, he managed to obtain the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 不过，说实话，直到最近，我们并不认为卢西安是其中之一。这一切都变了，尽管你尽力阻止他，他还是设法得到了阿玛杜尔杖。

english: He has the Staff?
translation: 他拿到了法杖？

english: I'm afraid so, and with it, he is now on a path leading towards unimaginable power. After all, Zamorak himself was once a Mahjarrat, until he used the Staff of Armadyl to attain godhood...
translation: 恐怕是的，有了它，他现在正走在通往难以想象的力量的道路上。毕竟，萨莫拉克本人曾经也是一名玛哈加特，直到他用阿玛杜尔杖获得了神性……

english: Hang on a moment. I hear someone approaching from downstairs. Let us wait for them to pass.
translation: 等一下。我听到有人从楼下上来了。我们等他们过去再说。

english: Assassins!
translation: 刺客！

english: Thaerisk, are you okay?
translation: 赛里斯克，你没事吧？

english: Yes, I think so, but that was far too close. We have been dealing with the threat of Lucien's assassins for some time now, but that's the first time they've attacked us here in Taverley.
translation: 嗯，我想没事，但太险了。我们应对卢西安刺客的威胁已经有一段时间了，但这是他们第一次在塔韦利村袭击我们。

english: Lucien must consider you to be quite the threat to him.
translation: 卢西安一定认为你对他是个不小的威胁。

english: Perhaps he also sees you as a threat as well. You may have worked with him before, but I suspect that means little to someone like him.
translation: 也许他也把你视为威胁。你以前可能和他合作过，但我觉得对像他这样的人来说，这没什么意义。

english: You think the assassins were targeting me?
translation: 你觉得那些刺客的目标是我？

english: Who could say for sure, but it may not be a coincidence that his assassins attacked so soon after your arrival.
translation: 谁说得准呢，但他的刺客在你到达后这么快就发动袭击，可能不是巧合。

english: Perhaps he also sees you as a threat as well. It may not be a coincidence that his assassins attacked so soon after your arrival.
translation: 也许他也把你视为威胁。他的刺客在你到达后这么快就发动袭击，可能不是巧合。

english: Regardless, this is another reminder that time is not on our side. We must find out what Lucien is planning and stop him before it's too late.
translation: 无论如何，这再次提醒我们时间不站在我们这边。我们必须查明卢西安的计划，并在为时已晚之前阻止他。

english: I realise that's easier said than done, but I believe we have what it takes to do so.
translation: 我知道说起来容易做起来难，但我相信我们有能力做到。

english: What resources do you have?
translation: 你们有什么资源？

english: We're still on the back foot compared to Lucien, but that is changing fast. My order has already formed an alliance with the Guardians of Armadyl and we have reached out to the Temple Knights as well.
translation: 与卢西安相比，我们仍然处于劣势，但情况正在迅速改变。我的组织已经与阿玛杜尔守护者结盟，我们也联系了圣殿骑士。

english: That's quite the collective.
translation: 这阵容相当强大。

english: Indeed. Never would I have expected to see the followers of three different gods unite in this way, but our differences mean little compared to the threat Lucien poses.
translation: 确实。我从没想过会看到三位不同神的追随者以这种方式联合起来，但与卢西安构成的威胁相比，我们的分歧微不足道。

english: And you'd like me to join this alliance as well? Even though I helped Lucien before?
translation: 你也想让我加入这个联盟？即使我以前帮过卢西安？

english: Yes. I am aware of many of your past feats. You have regularly fought against the evils of this world. I believe there is more to you than what happened with Lucien.
translation: 是的。我知道你过去的许多壮举。你经常与这个世界的邪恶作斗争。我相信你身上有比与卢西安那件事更多的东西。

english: And you'd like me to join this alliance as well?
translation: 你也想让我加入这个联盟？

english: Yes. You have opposed Lucien before, and you have shown that you have the skills needed to make a difference in this fight.
translation: 是的。你以前反对过卢西安，而且你展示了在这场战斗中发挥作用所需的技能。

english: I see. So what would you have me do?
translation: 我明白了。那你希望我做什么？

english: Our spies have been trying to track Lucien for some time, but he is proving difficult to locate. However, he has been expanding his resources at a rapid rate. We might be able to take advantage of this.
translation: 我们的间谍一直在试图追踪卢西安，但他很难定位。不过，他一直在迅速扩张他的资源。我们也许可以利用这一点。

english: He's been forming alliances with all manner of groups and individuals. Such a large collective is likely to have plenty of weak links for us to exploit.
translation: 他与各种团体和个人结盟。如此庞大的集合体很可能有很多我们可以利用的薄弱环节。

english: With that in mind, we'd like you to investigate a treasure hunter by the name of Movario. We believe he has been working with Lucien for some time.
translation: 考虑到这一点，我们希望你去调查一个名叫莫瓦里奥的宝藏猎人。我们相信他一直在与卢西安合作。

english: Movario? What can you tell me about him?
translation: 莫瓦里奥？你能告诉我关于他的什么信息？

english: He's magically trained, has adventured, and has spent a lot of time in various archives.
translation: 他受过魔法训练，有过冒险经历，并且花了很多时间在各种档案室里。

english: So he's a bit of a history buff?
translation: 所以他有点历史迷？

english: Indeed. We suspect that his combined magical and historical knowledge is highly valuable to Lucien. In fact, we believe that it was Movario who first tracked down the Staff of Armadyl for him.
translation: 没错。我们怀疑他结合魔法和历史的知识对卢西安非常有价值。事实上，我们相信正是莫瓦里奥首先为他追踪到了阿玛杜尔杖。

english: Any ideas where I should start?
translation: 有什么建议我从哪里开始吗？

english: According to our spies, Movario has hired a member of the Khazard Army called Darve to act as his bodyguard. As such, I'd recommend you begin at the Fight Arena.
translation: 根据我们的间谍，莫瓦里奥雇佣了一个名叫达尔夫的卡扎德军队成员作为他的保镖。因此，我建议你从战斗竞技场开始。

english: Is there anything else you can tell me about Movario?
translation: 你还能告诉我关于莫瓦里奥的其他信息吗？

english: He first became a person of interest after you stole the Staff of Armadyl. He was regularly sighted in the area around the Temple of Ikov in the days beforehand.
translation: 他第一次成为关注对象是在你偷走阿玛杜尔杖之后。在那之前的几天里，他经常出现在伊科夫神殿附近。

english: He first became a person of interest after the Staff of Armadyl was stolen. He was regularly sighted in the area around the Temple of Ikov in the days beforehand.
translation: 他第一次成为关注对象是在阿玛杜尔杖被盗之后。在那之前的几天里，他经常出现在伊科夫神殿附近。

english: That doesn't seem like a lot to go on. How can you be sure he's involved?
translation: 这似乎没有太多依据。你怎么能确定他参与了？

english: Truth be told, we still don't have absolute confirmation that he is. However, few people have the skills needed to locate something like the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 说实话，我们仍然没有绝对确认他参与了。但很少有人具备定位像阿玛杜尔杖这样的东西所需的技能。

english: I see. Anything else of note?
translation: 我明白了。还有其他值得注意的吗？

english: He seems to have been researching something new of late. He's been sighted in many libraries all across the world.
translation: 他最近似乎在研究什么新东西。有人看到他在世界各地的许多图书馆里。

english: What's he researching?
translation: 他在研究什么？

english: We're not sure. His focus seems to be on the God Wars and the gods themselves. Saradomin and Guthix in particular.
translation: 我们不确定。他的重点似乎是神战和神祇本身。特别是萨拉多明和古斯。

english: Given what happened with the Staff, our fear is that Lucien has him looking for more sources of godly power.
translation: 考虑到法杖事件，我们担心卢西安让他寻找更多神力的来源。

english: That's... concerning. How did you find all of this out?
translation: 这……令人担忧。你是怎么发现这一切的？

english: Most of this information actually came from a single spy of ours. She obtained it by talking to Reldo of all people.
translation: 这些信息大部分实际上来自我们的一名间谍。她是通过与雷尔多交谈获得的。

english: Reldo? A local librarian was the source of information on a master artefact hunter working with Lucien?
translation: 雷尔多？一个当地的图书管理员是有关与卢西安合作的大师级文物猎人的信息来源？

english: Yes, he's quite an interesting individual. Most of course know him as an accomplished scholar, but I've found that there's a lot more to him than first meets the eye...
translation: 是的，他是个相当有趣的人。大多数人当然知道他是一位有成就的学者，但我发现他远不止表面上看起来那么简单……

english: Do we have any more information on what Lucien is up to?
translation: 我们还有关于卢西安在做什么的更多信息吗？

english: At this point, I'm afraid not. From what we can tell, he's mostly operated alone until very recently. However, since acquiring the Staff of Armadyl, he's been forming quite the alliance of individuals.
translation: 目前恐怕没有。据我们所知，直到最近他大多单独行动。但自从获得阿玛杜尔杖后，他一直在组建一个相当庞大的个人联盟。

english: It is clear he's planning something. Something big. However, any attempts by our spies to locate him have resulted in violent ends at the hands of his new allies.
translation: 很明显他在策划什么。一件大事。但我们间谍试图定位他的所有尝试都以被他的新盟友暴力终结而告终。

english: Who are these new allies?
translation: 这些新盟友是谁？

english: Right now they mostly seem to consist of various mercenaries and the like. However, given the resources he now has access to, we believe he's also allied with some larger organisations.
translation: 目前他们似乎主要由各种雇佣兵之类的人组成。但考虑到他现在能获得的资源，我们相信他也与一些更大的组织结盟了。

english: On top of that, there's also evidence to suggest he's been building an undead army somewhere in the Wilderness. There has been an increase in sightings of zombies and skeletons in the area.
translation: 除此之外，还有证据表明他正在荒野某处建立一支亡灵军队。该地区僵尸和骷髅的目击事件有所增加。

english: There's no shortage of necromancers, especially in the Wilderness. How can you be sure it's Lucien?
translation: 死灵法师并不少见，尤其是在荒野。你怎么能确定是卢西安？

english: Nothing is confirmed and this point, but these undead seem to be specifically targeting our spies in the area.
translation: 目前还没有任何确认，但这些亡灵似乎专门针对我们在该地区的间谍。

english: I see. Sounds like we need to learn more as soon as we can.
translation: 我明白了。看来我们需要尽快了解更多信息。

english: That is why I'm hoping that Movario will lead us to some answers.
translation: 这就是为什么我希望莫瓦里奥能带我们找到一些答案。

english: Could you tell me more about Crux Eqal?
translation: 你能多告诉我一些关于克鲁克斯.埃卡尔的事吗？

english: We are a group who believe that too many of our fellow Guthixians have allowed themselves to become spellbound by the beauty of nature. The wider world is constantly at threat, but they no longer wish to see it.
translation: 我们是一群认为太多古斯信徒让自己被自然之美迷住了的人。更广阔的世界不断受到威胁，但他们却不再愿意看到这一点。

english: Our organisation is still fairly new, and many of our members are on the younger side. However, we have the backing of many senior druids such as Sanfew and Kaqemeex.
translation: 我们的组织还相当新，许多成员都比较年轻。不过，我们得到了许多资深德鲁伊的支持，比如桑福和卡基米克斯。

english: I hope you don't mind me saying that druids are not known to be the best fighters. How are you ensuring that you're prepared to take on these threats?
translation: 希望你别介意我这么说，但德鲁伊并不以最优秀的战士而闻名。你们如何确保自己准备好应对这些威胁？

english: You are not wrong, my friend. I have no doubt that every member of our order would willing fight to the last drop of blood if the situation required it, but it is not where our strength lies.
translation: 你说得没错，朋友。我毫不怀疑我们组织的每个成员都愿意在必要时战斗到最后一滴血，但这不是我们的力量所在。

english: However, I do not see that as a bad thing. The world has no shortage of warriors and heroes, and our kingdoms have armies capable of standing against many a danger. Instead, we focus on what they often lack.
translation: 不过，我不认为这是坏事。这个世界从不缺少战士和英雄，我们的王国也有能够抵御许多危险的军队。相反，我们专注于他们经常缺乏的东西。

english: One example is our spy network. While still not quite as extensive as that of the Temple Knights, we have many who are experts in moving around unseen. After all, no one suspects a druid.
translation: 一个例子是我们的间谍网络。虽然还不及圣殿骑士那么广泛，但我们有很多擅长暗中行动的专家。毕竟，没人会怀疑一个德鲁伊。

english: Then of course you have our Herblore skills, which are second to none. We are constantly making new advancements that let us supply our allies with brews and potions for all manner of purposes.
translation: 当然，还有我们的草药学技能，那是首屈一指的。我们不断取得新的进展，为我们的盟友提供各种用途的酿造品和药水。

english: We're already putting many of these potions to the test in our fight against Lucien.
translation: 我们已经在与卢西安的战斗中测试了许多这些药水。

english: Be careful out there.
translation: 在外面小心点。

english: Hello again, Thaerisk.
translation: 又见面了，赛里斯克。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. What news do you have?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。有什么消息？

english: Nothing at the moment.
translation: 目前还没有。

english: Remember, we need you to investigate a treasure hunter by the name of Movario. Given that he hired a bodyguard from the Khazard Army, I'd recommend starting at the Fight Arena.
translation: 记住，我们需要你去调查一个名叫莫瓦里奥的宝藏猎人。考虑到他雇佣了卡扎德军队的保镖，我建议你从战斗竞技场开始。

english: You don't happen to know anyone called Darve, do you?
translation: 你碰巧认识一个叫达尔夫的人吗？

english: Can't say I do. Maybe try in the bar?
translation: 说不上认识。也许去酒吧问问？

english: Do you know anyone called Darve?
translation: 你认识一个叫达尔夫的人吗？

english: I might do. Why do you want to know?
translation: 或许会。你为什么想知道？

english: I'm trying to find him.
translation: 我在找他。

english: Good for you, but that's not really got anything to do with me.
translation: 那不错，但这跟我没什么关系。

english: Well what about someone called Movario?
translation: 那一个叫莫瓦里奥的人呢？

english: Movario? The mage?
translation: 莫瓦里奥？那个法师？

english: So you know him?
translation: 所以你认识他？

english: I'm aware of him. Couldn't tell you anything about him though, even if I wanted to.
translation: 我听说过他。不过就算我想，也不能告诉你任何关于他的事。

english: Well do you know someone who can?
translation: 那你知道谁能告诉我吗？

english: He sometimes uses the launderer just to the north of here. Maybe you should try talking to him. Now, would you like a drink?
translation: 他有时会去北边的洗衣店。也许你可以去跟他谈谈。现在，你要喝点什么吗？

english: Those damn broavs! Now I'll need to start over again!
translation: 那些该死的布罗夫！现在我得重新开始了！

english: Oh, sorry, I didn't see you come in.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我没看到你进来。

english: Is something wrong?
translation: 有什么问题吗？

english: Just the usual sort of nonsense you get around here. One of the guards bought some broavs for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by my laundry and making a mess of it!
translation: 只是这里常见的那种麻烦事。有个守卫买了一些布罗夫用来追踪，但它们总被我的洗衣物吸引，搞得一团糟！

english: Right... Anyway, you don't happen to know someone called Darve do you? Or maybe someone called Movario?
translation: 好吧... 对了，你碰巧认识一个叫达尔夫的人吗？或者一个叫莫瓦里奥的？

english: Movario? Oh yes I... Well, actually, I shouldn't really divulge client details. Times are tough enough as it is without me losing customers through gossiping!
translation: 莫瓦里奥？哦，是的，我……呃，其实我不应该透露客户信息。现在日子够难过了，我可不想因为说闲话而失去顾客！

english: Would 500 coins change your mind?
translation: 500金币能让你改变主意吗？

english: Oh... well I suppose so.
translation: 哦……好吧，我想可以。

english: Okay, I'll be back shortly with the money.
translation: 好，我很快带钱回来。

english: Now, what can you tell me about Movario?
translation: 现在，你能告诉我关于莫瓦里奥的什么事？

english: Well he's a fairly regular customer of mine. In fact, I have some of his clothes here right now.
translation: 他算是我的老顾客了。事实上，我这里现在就有他的一些衣服。

english: So does he live somewhere nearby?
translation: 所以他住在附近吗？

english: I assume so, but I don't know where.
translation: 我想是的，但我不知道具体在哪。

english: Hmm... I need some way of tracking him down...
translation: 嗯……我需要想办法追踪到他……

english: Hang on... What was it you were saying earlier about those broavs?
translation: 等等……你之前说那些布罗夫怎么了？

english: Broavs? Well one of the guards bought some for tracking, but they keep getting distracted by the laundry.
translation: 布罗夫？有个守卫买了一些用来追踪，但它们总被洗衣物吸引。

english: You don't think I'd be able to use one to track Movario, do you?
translation: 你不觉得我可以用一只来追踪莫瓦里奥吗？

english: I guess so, but they track using smell, so you'd need something that smells like him.
translation: 我想可以，但它们靠嗅觉追踪，所以你需要有他气味的东西。

english: Like his dirty laundry, perhaps?
translation: 比如他的脏衣服？

english: Oh, I see... I really shouldn't be giving out clothes belonging to customers.
translation: 哦，我明白了……我真的不能把顾客的衣服给别人。

english: Surely you have something he won't miss.
translation: 你肯定有他不在意的东西吧。

english: Well... I was thinking that one of his shirts wouldn't last the cleaning process. I suppose you can have it, but Movario can't find out!
translation: 嗯……我正想着他有一件衬衫可能洗不干净了。我想你可以拿去，但莫瓦里奥不能知道！

english: Thanks. So how would I go about getting myself one of those broavs?
translation: 谢谢。那我怎么才能弄到一只布罗夫呢？

english: I think they came from the Feldip Hills. Apparently there's some hunting expert down there who knows how to catch them.
translation: 我想它们来自费迪普丘陵。那里有个狩猎专家知道怎么抓它们。

english: Perfect! Thanks for all the help.
translation: 完美！谢谢你的帮助。

english: You can trust me.
translation: 你可以相信我。

english: Oh... yes, I suppose I can.
translation: 哦……是的，我想我可以。

english: Great! So what can you tell me about Movario?
translation: 太好了！那你能告诉我关于莫瓦里奥的什么事？

english: Hello again. Could you remind me where I can get one of those broavs?
translation: 又见面了。你能再告诉我哪里能弄到布罗夫吗？

english: Perfect! Thanks for the help.
translation: 完美！谢谢帮助。

english: Do you think you could help me with broavs?
translation: 你觉得你能帮我处理布罗夫的事吗？

english: Ah, yes. You want one for some tracking I'm guessing? They're very useful for that sort of thing, but not easy to capture, especially not alive. Then, of course, there's the training.
translation: 啊，是的。我猜你想要一只来追踪？它们干这个很在行，但不容易捕捉，尤其是活捉。当然，还有训练的问题。

english: Training? How do I train them?
translation: 训练？我怎么训练它们？

english: I only know of one person who can do that. She's a very experienced hunter and could possibly do it for you, but I don't think she could train you to do it.
translation: 我只知道一个人能做到。她是个非常有经验的猎人，也许可以帮你训练，但我觉得她不能教会你怎么训练。

english: Me of course!
translation: 当然是我！

english: Oh, okay. So I just bring a broav to you and you can train it?
translation: 哦，好的。所以我只要带一只布罗夫给你，你就能训练它？

english: Pretty much, but first you'll need to catch one. You'll need to set up a pitfall trap, but instead of luring the broav over it, you'll just want to bait the trap with a fungus from Mort Myre.
translation: 差不多，但首先你得抓一只。你需要设置一个陷坑陷阱，但不用把布罗夫引过去，只需用摩特.迈尔的蘑菇做诱饵。

english: Mort Myre? That's quite the trip.
translation: 摩特.迈尔？那可真是一段路程。

english: Well luckily for you, I have one here I can spare you. You'll need to make some room for it first though.
translation: 幸好你运气好，我这里有一个可以给你。不过你得先腾出点空间。

english: Well luckily for you, I have one here I can spare you. Take it and make yourself a trap over at the old trapping spot to the west. You'll have a broav caught in no time.
translation: 幸好你运气好，我这里有一个可以给你。拿着它，到西边的老捕猎点做个陷阱。你马上就能抓到布罗夫。

english: Have you managed to catch one?
translation: 你抓到一只了吗？

english: There's an old trapping spot to the west that should work perfectly. Remember, instead of luring the broav over your trap, you'll just want to bait it with a fungus from Mort Myre.
translation: 西边有个老捕猎点应该很合适。记住，不用把布罗夫引到陷阱上，只需用摩特.迈尔的蘑菇做诱饵。

english: Okay boy, go get 'em!
translation: 好了伙计，去抓它们！

english: It's alright boy, take your time.
translation: 没关系伙计，慢慢来。

english: Slow and steady wins the race...
translation: 稳扎稳打才能赢……

english: Okay, this isn't going to work. I think I need to take this broav to a hunting expert to get it woken up.
translation: 好吧，这样不行。我想我得把这只布罗夫带给狩猎专家，让它清醒过来。

english: Do you think you could train this broav for me?
translation: 你能帮我训练这只布罗夫吗？

english: Not a problem. I'll get it woken up and then we can get started...
translation: 没问题。我让它清醒过来，然后我们就可以开始了……

english: There we go. All done!
translation: 好了。搞定了！

english: Hey! Intruder alert!
translation: 嘿！有入侵者！

english: Hello there, friend. I hope things are going well for you. If you're in need of any help with... anything, perhaps you might want to talk to Thaerisk upstairs...
translation: 你好，朋友。希望你一切顺利。如果你需要任何帮助……任何事情，也许你可以上楼跟赛里斯克谈谈……

english: I've found a hideout near the Fight Arena that I think belongs to Movario. I've already found a few interesting things inside, but I'm going to keep searching and see what else I can uncover.
translation: 我在战斗竞技场附近找到了一个据点，我觉得属于莫瓦里奥。我已经在里面找到了一些有趣的东西，但我会继续搜索，看看还能发现什么。

english: Excellent work. I look forward to hearing the results.
translation: 干得好。我期待听到结果。

english: I've found a hideout near the Fight Arena that seems to belong to Movario. I found these interesting research notes inside that I think might be of use.
translation: 我在战斗竞技场附近找到了一个据点，似乎属于莫瓦里奥。我在里面找到了这些有趣的研究笔记，我觉得可能有用。

english: Excellent work, [player name]. These notes are very useful, albeit rather concerning as well. I'll let you keep hold of them. You'll probably want to read them yourself, if you haven't already.
translation: 干得好，[player name]。这些笔记非常有用，虽然也相当令人担忧。你先留着吧。如果你还没看过，大概自己想看看。

english: Thanks. So what's our next move?
translation: 谢谢。那我们下一步怎么做？

english: While you were gone, our negotiations with the Temple Knights continued. Given their nature, they weren't entirely convinced on joining our alliance initially, but it seems we managed to convince them.
translation: 你不在的时候，我们与圣殿骑士的谈判继续了。鉴于他们的性质，他们最初并不完全相信加入我们的联盟，但看来我们成功说服了他们。

english: As Taverley no longer seems to be safe, we've decided it best that we establish a base of operations for this new alliance at the White Knights' Castle in Falador.
translation: 由于塔韦利村似乎不再安全，我们决定最好在法拉多城的白骑士城堡为这个新联盟建立行动基地。

english: Sounds sensible. So are we heading over there now?
translation: 听起来很合理。那我们现在过去？

english: I will be departing shortly, but I'd like you to head for the Temple of Ikov instead. We've lost contact with Idria and the Guardians of Armadyl.
translation: 我很快就会出发，但我想让你去伊科夫神殿。我们与伊德莉亚和阿玛杜尔守护者失去了联系。

english: Hopefully it's no cause for concern, but given what happened here, I fear Lucien may be targeting them.
translation: 希望不必担心，但鉴于这里发生的事，我担心卢西安可能把他们当成了目标。

english: Alright, I'll get over there right away.
translation: 好的，我马上过去。

english: Head for the hidden entrance to the temple at McGrubor's Wood. Once you find Idria, send her to me at the White Knights' Castle and then join us there yourself. Good luck.
translation: 前往麦克格鲁伯森林的神庙隐藏入口。一旦找到伊德莉亚，让她到白骑士城堡来找我，然后你自己也过来。祝你好运。

english: Hello there, [player name]. I'll be departing for Falador shortly. You should head over to McGrubor's Wood as soon as you can. We need to make sure Idria and the Guardians of Armadyl are safe.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我很快就要出发去法拉多城了。你应该尽快赶到麦克格鲁伯森林去。我们需要确保伊德莉亚和阿玛杜尔的守护者们安全。

english: Alright, I'll go there right away.
translation: 好的，我马上就去那里。

english: Kill the Armadyl-worshipping scum!
translation: 杀死那些崇拜阿玛杜尔的渣滓！

english: It's a good job you showed up when you did. Those mercenaries nearly had us done for!
translation: 你来得正是时候。那些雇佣兵差点就把我们干掉了！

english: Sent by Lucien, no doubt. Thaerisk suspected something like this would happen.
translation: 毫无疑问是卢西安派来的。赛里斯克早就怀疑会发生这种事。

english: So I take it you're [player name]? I'm Idria. I've heard a lot about you. Much of it good... though it remains to be seen if that's enough to rectify your actions in stealing the Staff of Armadyl from us.
translation: 那么我想你就是[player name]了？我是伊德莉亚。我听说过很多关于你的事。大部分是好的……不过，这能否弥补你从我们这里偷走阿玛杜尔杖的行为，还有待观察。

english: Well that's why I'm here. I intend to fix that mistake no matter what. I hope that means something.
translation: 这就是我来的原因。我决心无论如何都要弥补那个错误。希望这能有点意义。

english: It very much does. It's a rare trait to be able to admit a mistake and work to fix it, though truth be told, it seems likely that Lucien would have obtained the Staff no matter what.
translation: 确实有意义。能承认错误并努力弥补是难得的品质，不过说实话，无论怎样卢西安似乎都有可能得到法杖。

english: But anyway, that's the past. We must focus on the future, and on ensuring said future is free of Lucien.
translation: 但无论如何，那都是过去的事了。我们必须专注于未来，确保那个未来没有卢西安。

english: So I take it you're [player name]? I've heard a lot about you. It's a pleasure to finally meet you. I'm Idria.
translation: 所以你就是[player name]？我听说过很多关于你的事。很高兴终于见到你。我是伊德莉亚。

english: Pleased to meet you, Idria.
translation: 很高兴见到你，伊德莉亚。

english: If Thaerisk sent you, I'm guessing you're more up to speed on the current state of things than I am. What can you tell me?
translation: 如果赛里斯克派你来，我想你比我更了解当前情况。你能告诉我什么？

english: The Temple Knights have agreed to join the alliance. They're establishing a headquarters in the White Knights' Castle for us to use. Thaerisk asked us to meet him there.
translation: 圣殿骑士已经同意加入联盟。他们正在白骑士城堡建立一个总部供我们使用。赛里斯克叫我们去那里与他会合。

english: Good. The more allies we have, the better. Now, given that Lucien is quite keen to see us dead, we shouldn't waste any more time here. I'll head to the White Knights' Castle as quick as possible.
translation: 好。盟友越多越好。现在，既然卢西安很想置我们于死地，我们不应该在这里浪费时间了。我会尽快前往白骑士城堡。

english: Hello there. I'd love to stop and chat, but I'm afraid I have some important work to get done.
translation: 你好。我很想停下来聊聊，但恐怕我有重要的工作要做。

english: Ah, there you are, [player name]. Idria told us what happened at McGrubor's Wood. I'm glad to see you made it here safely. Now, allow me to introduce Akrisae Kolluym of the Temple Knights.
translation: 啊，你来了，[player name]。伊德莉亚告诉了我们麦克格鲁伯森林发生的事。很高兴看到你安全到达这里。现在，请允许我介绍圣殿骑士的阿克里赛.科鲁姆。

english: Glad to have you with us, [player name]. I've heard a lot about you from Sir Tiffy. It's Saradomin's will that you're doing!
translation: 很高兴你能加入我们，[player name]。我从提菲爵士那里听说过很多关于你的事。你正在遵循萨拉多明的意志！

english: Perhaps it would be best if we kept theology out of this for now. While I'm sure all of us here would love to debate our differing viewpoints, we need to keep our focus on Lucien.
translation: 也许我们暂时最好不谈神学。虽然我相信在座各位都很乐意讨论各自的不同观点，但我们必须专注于卢西安。

english: A very fair point. My apologies.
translation: 说得很有道理。我道歉。

english: Anyway, now that we're all here, I think it's time we discussed the contents of the notes that [player name] found. To put it bluntly, these notes confirm all of our worst fears.
translation: 总之，既然我们都到齐了，我想是时候讨论[player name]找到的笔记内容了。直白地说，这些笔记证实了我们最坏的担忧。

english: It seems that Lucien is indeed attempting to follow in Zamorak's footsteps and attain godhood. The Staff of Armadyl was merely the first step in his plan, for he now seeks an even greater prize.
translation: 看来卢西安确实在试图追随萨莫拉克的脚步，获得神性。阿玛杜尔杖只是他计划的第一步，因为他现在寻求一个更大的目标。

english: What could be more powerful than the Staff?
translation: 还有什么比法杖更强大的？

english: There is an artefact that history has long forgotten. One with a power unlike anything else ever seen in Gielinor. A power that even the gods themselves struggle to comprehend.
translation: 有一个历史早已遗忘的遗物。其力量不同于吉里诺尔见过的任何东西。一种连神都难以理解的力量。

english: This power you speak of... You refer to the power found in the Temple of the Eye?
translation: 你所说的这个力量……你指的是眼之神殿里的力量？

english: Yes. The Eye of Saradomin is one name for this artefact, though it has had many others. For example, we in Crux Eqal know it as the Fist of Guthix. However, its real name is...
translation: 是的。萨拉多明之眼是这个遗物的一个名字，虽然它还有很多其他名字。例如，我们在克鲁克斯.埃卡尔称它为古斯之拳。然而，它的真实名字是……

english: You speak like you have first-hand experience, [player name]. Surely you have not encountered this artefact?
translation: 你说得好像你有亲身经历，[player name]。你肯定没有遇到过这个遗物吧？

english: Not exactly, but I was there when the Temple of the Eye was first uncovered. I had some sort of vision of the Stone. I've somehow known its name ever since.
translation: 不完全是，但眼之神殿刚被发现时我在场。我看到了那块石头的某种幻象。从那以后我就莫名知道它的名字。

english: A vision? Curious...
translation: 幻象？有趣……

english: And this Stone... You really think it can grant Lucien godhood?
translation: 那么这块石头……你真的觉得它能赐予卢西安神格？

english: Movario seems to think so, and he looks to have been right about everything else involving the Stone so far.
translation: 莫瓦里奥似乎是这么想的，而且到目前为止，他关于这块石头的一切判断看起来都是对的。

english: We must find Lucien and stop him by any means necessary.
translation: 我们必须找到卢西安，不惜一切代价阻止他。

english: I agree, but unfortunately our spies have had little luck in finding him so far.
translation: 我同意，但遗憾的是，我们的间谍至今还没能成功找到他的踪迹。

english: I suspect he's somewhere in the Wilderness. Our informants believe he has been raising an undead army there at a concerning speed. It will likely rival the zombie armies of Zemouregal before long.
translation: 我怀疑他躲在荒野的某个地方。我们的线人认为他正在那里以惊人的速度招募亡灵军队。用不了多久，这支部队恐怕就能与泽莫雷加尔的僵尸大军抗衡了。

english: The Wilderness is a big place. Too big. We'll need a more accurate location before we can do anything.
translation: 荒野很大，太大了。我们需要更精确的位置才能采取行动。

english: I wonder if I might have a solution to that...
translation: 我想我或许有办法解决这个问题……

english: According to Movario's notes, Lucien sent a pair of spies to keep an eye on him. If we can capture one of them, they might be able to lead us to him.
translation: 根据莫瓦里奥的笔记，卢西安派了两名间谍来监视他。如果我们能抓住其中一个，他们或许能带我们找到卢西安。

english: Ah, yes. We should have everything we need here to conduct an interrogation.
translation: 啊，没错。我们这里应该应有尽有，可以进行审讯了。

english: It might require quite the interrogation to make one of Lucien's dogs talk.
translation: 要让卢西安的狗腿子开口，恐怕得下点狠功夫审讯才行。

english: That depends on how loyal they are. Most of Lucien's followers seem to be mere mercenaries so far, but he does have some true believers as well.
translation: 那得看他们有多忠诚。到目前为止，卢西安的大多数追随者似乎只是雇佣兵，但他也有一些真正的信徒。

english: That said, we've recently managed to perfect a far more potent form of the traditional truth serum. I believe it should allow us to bypass any form of interrogating.
translation: 话虽如此，我们最近成功改良了一种比传统吐真剂更有效的版本。我相信它能让我们省去任何形式的审讯。

english: That's all well and good, but how are we going to capture one of these spies?
translation: 这倒是挺好，可我们怎么抓住其中一个间谍呢？

english: I reckon that is something I can help with. Silif, do you have the teleorb?
translation: 我想这事我能帮上忙。西利夫，你带着传送宝珠吗？

english: I have it right here, sir.
translation: 就在我这儿，长官。

english: [player name], given your experience in the field, I believe you'll be best placed for this task. Take this orb and plant it on one of Lucien's spies.
translation: [player name]，鉴于你丰富的实地经验，我觉得你是这项任务的最佳人选。拿着这颗宝珠，把它安在卢西安的一个间谍身上。

english: What is that thing? A commorb?
translation: 这是什么东西？通讯球吗？

english: Not quite. It's a teleorb containing a sophisticated teleport spell that's directly linked to this cell here. Once planted on the spy, we can use it to bring them right to us.
translation: 不完全是。这是一个传送宝珠，内含一个复杂的传送法术，直接与这间牢房相连。一旦安在间谍身上，我们就可以用它把人直接传送到我们面前。

english: Oh that is clever!
translation: 哦，这招真妙！

english: Alright, where can I find these spies?
translation: 好吧，我在哪儿能找到这些间谍？

english: Provided Movario's notes are accurate, they should be somewhere in Draynor Village.
translation: 如果莫瓦里奥的笔记没错的话，他们应该在德雷诺村的某个地方。

english: Right, I'll get to it.
translation: 好，我这就去。

english: If you want, I can teleport you to Draynor Village.
translation: 如果你愿意的话，我可以把你传送到德雷诺村。

english: Hello there, [player name]. If you need a hand with anything, you should talk to Akrisae.
translation: 你好啊，[player name]。如果你需要帮忙，可以去找阿克里赛。

english: Tell me a bit more about yourself, Thaerisk.
translation: 跟我多聊聊你自己吧，赛里斯克。

english: Not much to tell, really. I grew up in Taverley and spent most of my life around druids. It seemed only natural for me to join them, and ten years ago that's exactly what I did.
translation: 其实没什么好说的。我在塔韦利村长大，一生大部分时间都和德鲁伊们在一起。加入他们对我来说似乎很自然，十年前我就是这么做的。

english: After that, I travelled around most of Gielinor and saw tragedy and heartache, triumph and beauty.
translation: 之后，我游历了吉莱诺大部分地区，见证了悲剧与心痛，也见证了胜利与美丽。

english: I came back with a feeling that many of my fellow druids were a bit too absorbed in local matters and not spending enough time looking at the larger picture.
translation: 回来后，我感到我许多德鲁伊同伴过于关注本地事务，没有花足够的时间去看清大局。

english: And that's what led to Crux Eqal?
translation: 这就是成立“核心平等”的缘由吗？

english: Yes. It turns out I wasn't quite alone in my feelings. I found a few likeminded druids and Crux Eqal was formed.
translation: 是的。事实证明，有这种感受的不止我一人。我找到了一些志同道合的德鲁伊，于是“核心平等”就诞生了。

english: What do you know about the Stone of Jas?
translation: 你对贾斯之石了解多少？

english: Far more than most I suspect, but truth be told, that's still very little.
translation: 恐怕比大多数人都要多，但说实话，还是知之甚少。

english: To us druids, it is known as the Fist of Guthix. It is a divine creation that allows one to unlock powers beyond what even the gods possess.
translation: 在我们德鲁伊看来，它被称为“古斯之拳”。这是一件神圣造物，能让人解锁甚至超越诸神本身的力量。

english: It was misused by many during the God Wars, so when Guthix awoke, he hid it away so that none would ever be able to steal its power for themselves.
translation: 神战期间，许多人滥用它，所以古斯苏醒后，就把它藏了起来，让任何人都无法窃取它的力量。

english: And you don't know where it was hidden?
translation: 你不知道它藏在哪儿吗？

english: No. That is a secret that only Guthix himself now knows. I hope it stays that way.
translation: 不知道。这个秘密现在只有古斯本人知道。我希望永远如此。

english: What do you think of Akrisae?
translation: 你觉得阿克里赛怎么样？

english: He is very capable, but he reminds me of some of the druids back home. The ones that ultimately led us to form Crux Eqal.
translation: 他很有能力，但他让我想起家乡的一些德鲁伊——那些最终促使我们成立“核心平等”的人。

english: He puts a lot of faith in his god. I don't necessarily fault that. As a loyal servant of Guthix, it would be very hypocritical of me to do so.
translation: 他对自己信奉的神投入了极大的信任。我不一定指责这一点。作为古斯忠诚的仆从，我如果那样做就太虚伪了。

english: But Saradomin is long gone from this world, along with all the other gods. As their followers, we must be prepared to act without their guidance.
translation: 但萨拉多明早已随其他众神离开了这个世界。作为信徒，我们必须准备好在没有神指引的情况下行动。

english: What do you think of Idria?
translation: 你觉得伊德莉亚怎么样？

english: It is hard to form an opinion on her. She is very secretive. However, I sense a great sadness in her. Many of her order have already fallen victim to Lucien. I suspect she feels personally responsible.
translation: 很难对她形成看法。她非常神秘。不过，我感觉到她身上有一种深深的悲伤。她教团中许多成员已经死于卢西安之手。我怀疑她觉得自己负有个人责任。

english: Well if all goes well, they'll be avenged soon.
translation: 嗯，如果一切顺利的话，他们很快就能报仇了。

english: I wonder if that in itself is something she feels conflicted over. Armadyl is a god of justice, not revenge. And yet, to lose those close to you...
translation: 我怀疑这本身是否让她感到矛盾。阿玛杜尔是正义之神，而非复仇之神。然而，失去亲近的人……

english: Hello, Idria.
translation: 你好，伊德莉亚。

english: Hello, [player name]. How are things going with that spy?
translation: 你好，[player name]。那个间谍的事怎么样了？

english: Well if you need anything, just talk to Akrisae.
translation: 如果你需要什么，就去找阿克里赛。

english: I've managed to plant the orb!
translation: 我已经成功安下宝珠了！

english: Excellent work! You should let Akrisae know.
translation: 干得漂亮！你该去告诉阿克里赛。

english: Do you mind if I ask you a bit about yourself?
translation: 你不介意我问你一些关于你的事吧？

english: To be honest, I'd prefer if you didn't. In our line of work, it is sometimes better not to give too much information away, especially when dealing with a threat like Lucien.
translation: 说实话，我宁愿你别问。干我们这一行，有时最好别透露太多信息，尤其是在对付卢西安这样的威胁时。

english: But do you not think it would be beneficial for us to know a bit more about each other?
translation: 但你不觉得我们互相多了解一点会有好处吗？

english: If you're worried about my ability to work with you and the others, I promise you have nothing to worry about. Now, let us discuss something else.
