translation: 如果你担心我与你和其他人合作的能力，我保证你无须担心。现在，我们聊点别的吧。

english: I must admit, we had always wondered if the Staff of Armadyl was truly one of a kind, or if there might in fact be other artefacts out there of a similar power.
translation: 我必须承认，我们一直想知道阿玛杜尔杖是否真是独一无二的，或者是否还有其他类似力量的遗物存在。

english: However, until now, it was all just speculation. We'd never heard of this Stone before, so to be honest, I couldn't really tell you a thing about it.
translation: 然而，在此之前，这都只是猜测。我们从未听说过这块石头，所以老实说，我其实根本没法告诉你关于它的任何事。

english: To think that it was out there for all this time... It worries me. It makes me question what else we don't know.
translation: 想想它竟然一直存在于某个地方……这让我很担心。让我怀疑我们还有什么东西不知道。

english: He's a Saradominist through and through.
translation: 他是个彻头彻尾的萨拉多明信徒。

english: Not necessarily. I'd say Saradominist and Armadylean beliefs are more aligned than those of most gods.
translation: 不一定。我觉得萨拉多明与阿玛杜尔的信仰比大多数神明的信仰更合拍。

english: Still, I find Saradominists can be somewhat stubborn and unwilling to compromise. That could be a problem. If this alliance is to work, we'll need to set aside our egos.
translation: 不过，我发现萨拉多明的信徒有时相当固执，不愿妥协。这可能是个问题。如果这个联盟要成功，我们就得放下自我。

english: What do you think of Thaerisk?
translation: 你觉得赛里斯克怎么样？

english: I find that too many Guthixians are idealists. They prefer to imagine a perfect world rather than accept the one we currently live in.
translation: 我发现太多古斯信徒都是理想主义者。他们宁愿幻想一个完美的世界，也不愿接受我们现处的世界。

english: I know all too well the danger of that mindset. Our order was once the same, and we lost the Staff of Armadyl as a result.
translation: 我太清楚这种思维方式的危险了。我们的教团曾经也是如此，结果我们失去了阿玛杜尔杖。

english: Thaerisk on the other hand... He seems to understand that only through action can we ensure the safety of this world. We need more people like him.
translation: 但赛里斯克……他似乎明白只有通过行动才能确保这个世界安全。我们需要更多像他这样的人。

english: Hello there, Akrisae.
translation: 你好啊，阿克里赛。

english: Saradomin be with you, my friend. Would you like me to teleport you to Draynor Village?
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，我的朋友。需要我把你传送到德雷诺村吗？

english: Saradomin be with you, my friend. You should head over to Draynor Village and see if you can get that orb planted.
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，我的朋友。你应该去德雷诺村，看看能不能把那个宝珠安好。

english: Could you tell me a bit more about yourself?
translation: 你能多跟我聊聊你自己吗？

english: Well I shouldn't say too much. Protocol and all that sort of thing. The more you give away, the more your enemies can use against you.
translation: 这个嘛，我不该说太多。规程什么的。你泄露得越多，敌人就越能拿来对付你。

english: It would be useful to know a few details though, considering we're now working together.
translation: 不过，既然我们现在合作了，知道一些细节还是有用的。

english: Very true. Well, as you already know, I am a member of the Temple Knights, although I'm not actually a knight myself.
translation: 确实。好吧，正如你所知，我是圣殿骑士的一员，不过我自己其实并不是真正的骑士。

english: Normally to have reached my level of seniority, you'd have been knighted long ago. However, I was a priest originally, and technically still am.
translation: 通常，要达到我这样的资历，你早就被授予骑士爵位了。不过，我原本是祭司，严格来说现在还是。

english: A priest cannot also hold a knighthood, and so I am the one Temple Knight in a leadership role who doesn't have one.
translation: 祭司不能同时拥有骑士身份，所以我是圣殿骑士中唯一处于领导地位却没有骑士头衔的人。

english: That's an interesting rule.
translation: 这个规定挺有意思的。

english: Isn't it just. Our order is known for having a few oddities like that, as I'm sure you yourself are aware. I hear your own recruitment involved a loophole or two.
translation: 可不是嘛。我们的教团以有一些这样的怪癖而闻名，我相信你自己也知道。我听说你当初的招募过程就钻了一两个空子。

english: The Eye is what we know it as. After the recent rediscovery of the Temple of the Eye, we put a great deal of effort into learning more about it. However, we didn't actually end up finding much.
translation: 我们称之为“眼”。最近重新发现眼之神殿后，我们投入了大量精力去了解它。不过，实际上我们最终并没发现太多。

english: All we really know is that Saradomin used it to great effect in the God Wars. With it, he was able to protect this world from the evil of Zamorak.
translation: 我们真正知道的只有萨拉多明曾在神战中巧妙地使用过它。借助它，他保护了这个世界免受萨莫拉克的邪恶侵害。

english: But it seems Saradomin wasn't the only one to use it.
translation: 但似乎并非只有萨拉多明用过它。

english: Yes, that is quite a concerning development, but this is the first time I've heard these other names that it has been given. I wonder if there might be a misunderstanding somewhere.
translation: 是的，那是个相当令人担忧的进展，但这是我第一次听到它还有别的名字。我怀疑是不是哪里弄错了。

english: So do you not believe what Movario discovered?
translation: 所以你不相信莫瓦里奥的发现？

english: I just think it's important to keep an open mind. With how little is known about the Eye... or Stone if you prefer, we need to be very careful of any misinformation, intentional or otherwise.
translation: 我只是认为保持开放心态很重要。鉴于我们对“眼”——或者你更愿意叫石头——知之甚少，我们必须非常小心任何错误信息，不论是有意还是无意。

english: It is good to be working with her. Saradomin and Armadyl are natural allies. Just as the two of them once opposed Zamorak together, we will now oppose Lucien in the same way.
translation: 能跟她共事是件好事。萨拉多明和阿玛杜尔是天生的盟友。就像他们曾经共同对抗萨莫拉克一样，我们现在也要以同样的方式对抗卢西安。

english: It's quite something having the followers of multiple different gods all working together like this.
translation: 看到不同神明的信徒这样一起合作，真是了不起。

english: I suppose it's the one thing we can actually give Lucien credit for. He has united us in a way that few others could manage.
translation: 我想这算是卢西安唯一值得我们称赞的地方了。他以一种几乎无人能做到的方式把我们团结了起来。

english: It is refreshing to see a druid that is willing to stand up and take action. However, I do worry he may not have the stomach for this type of work.
translation: 看到一个愿意站出来采取行动的德鲁伊，真是令人耳目一新。不过，我确实担心他可能没有从事这类工作的胆量。

english: As a Temple Knight yourself, I have no doubt you understand that we sometimes need to make difficult choices for the good of this world.
translation: 你自己也是圣殿骑士，想必明白我们有时必须为了这个世界做出艰难的选择。

english: Saradomin be with you, friend.
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，朋友。

english: Ah, hello, [player name]. It's a pleasure to be working with you. Your exploits are, of course, legendary.
translation: 啊，你好，[player name]。很高兴能与你合作。你的功绩自然是传奇般的。

english: Oh, nothing much. I'd just heard Draynor was a nice place to visit.
translation: 哦，没什么。我只是听说德雷诺是个值得一游的好地方。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. Any luck with that orb?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。那个宝珠有进展吗？

english: Yes, the orb is planted!
translation: 是的，宝珠已经安置好了！

english: Saradomin seems to be smiling on our operation so far!
translation: 看来萨拉多明到目前为止都在眷顾我们的行动！

english: I'm sure that Guthix had just as much of a role in this as anyone else did.
translation: 我确信古斯在这件事上的作用不亚于任何人。

english: I thought we agreed to keep theology out of this? Besides, I'd say this work was exclusively [player name]'s doing.
translation: 我以为我们同意过不谈神学？再说了，我觉得这完全是[player name]的功劳。

english: Yes, of course, of course. Now, I believe it's time we invite one of Lucien's friends over for a little chat!
translation: 是的，当然，当然。现在，我想是时候邀请卢西安的一位朋友来聊聊天了！

english: Success!
translation: 成功了！

english: Over to you, Thaerisk.
translation: 交给你了，赛里斯克。

english: Now, before we begin the interrogation... could I interest you in a refreshing beverage?
translation: 现在，在我们开始审问之前……能请你喝杯提神饮料吗？

english: Beverage?
translation: 饮料？

english: Yes, of course! We may have this man imprisoned, but we should still show some decorum!
translation: 当然！我们虽然囚禁了这个人，但还是要保持一些礼节！

english: *whispers* Play along...
translation: *低声* 配合一下……

english: I have one of my druids preparing you some fine juice as we speak.
translation: 我让我的一个德鲁伊正在为你准备一些上好的果汁。

english: I have the drink you requested, sire.
translation: 大人，您要的饮料准备好了。

english: Excellent! Now, if you could give it to our friend here...
translation: 太好了！现在，请把它交给我们的这位朋友……

english: A drink, sir?
translation: 先生，要喝一杯吗？

english: And this is... juice?
translation: 这是……果汁？

english: Did you really think I'd fall for that?
translation: 你真以为我会中计？

english: The potion!
translation: 药水！

english: Someone get a healer over here, quickly!
translation: 快叫个治疗师过来！

english: Well, that spy ruined what truth serum we had...
translation: 唉，那个间谍毁了我们仅剩的吐真剂……

english: So we don't have any more? This is a disaster! It should have been clear that old druid was going to be attacked! Why send him in there?
translation: 所以我们没有了？这简直是灾难！早就该知道那个老德鲁伊会被攻击！为什么要派他进去？

english: Now look...
translation: 听我说……

english: We cannot afford to make these mistakes. The spy should have been restrained.
translation: 我们不能再犯这种错误了。那个间谍本应该被控制住。

english: Alright, you've all made your points, but we're not going to achieve anything like this. Thaerisk, can we make more of this potion?
translation: 好了，你们说的都有道理，但这样吵下去解决不了问题。赛里斯克，我们能再做一份这种药水吗？

english: We're not just using any old truth serum here, so the process is quite complex. Still, it should be doable.
translation: 我们用的可不是普通的吐真剂，所以制作过程相当复杂。不过，应该还是可行的。

english: First, we'll need some enriched snapdragon. Betty in Port Sarim should be able to help with that. You'll just need to take her a regular snapdragon seed.
translation: 首先，我们需要一些超级金鱼草。沙林港的贝蒂应该能帮忙。你只需要给她带一颗普通的金鱼草种子。

english: Snapdragon seeds aren't the cheapest.
translation: 金鱼草种子可不便宜。

english: Well I do have one that I suppose I could part with. Let me know if you want it. I can also teleport you to Port Sarim if you wish.
translation: 嗯，我倒是有一颗，可以给你。需要的话就跟我说。如果你愿意，我也可以把你传送到沙林港。

english: Could I have that seed?
translation: 能把那颗种子给我吗？

english: Now, would you like me to teleport you to Port Sarim?
translation: 现在，需要我传送你去沙林港吗？

english: Could you teleport me to Port Sarim?
translation: 你能传送我去沙林港吗？

english: Hello again, [player name]. You'll need to take a snapdragon seed to Betty in Port Sarim. I have one here if needed. I can also teleport you to Port Sarim if you wish.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你需要带一颗金鱼草种子去沙林港找贝蒂。如果需要的话，我这里有一颗。如果你愿意，我也可以传送你去沙林港。

english: Hello again, [player name]. You'll need to take a snapdragon seed to Betty in Port Sarim. I can teleport you there if you wish.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你需要带一颗金鱼草种子去沙林港找贝蒂。如果你愿意，我可以传送你去那里。

english: Hello, [player name]. How are things going?
translation: 你好，[player name]。事情进展如何？

english: I'm working on getting us a replacement truth serum.
translation: 我正在想办法弄一份新的吐真剂。

english: Well if you need anything, just talk to Thaerisk.
translation: 如果你需要什么，就跟赛里斯克说。

english: I hope we can get a replacement truth serum quickly. This delay is not what we need right now.
translation: 希望我们能尽快弄到新的吐真剂。现在这种延误可不是我们想要的。

english: Don't worry, Thaerisk and I are working on it.
translation: 别担心，赛里斯克和我正在处理。

english: If you think I'm going to talk, you're kidding yourself!
translation: 如果你以为我会开口，那你就是在自欺欺人！

english: Could you help me make some enriched snapdragon?
translation: 你能帮我制作一些超级金鱼草吗？

english: Enriched snapdragon, eh? There's only one person who'd be wanting one of those. So you're working with Thaerisk now?
translation: 超级金鱼草，嗯？只有一个人会想要这个。这么说你现在在帮赛里斯克做事？

english: Actually, on second thoughts, probably best I don't ask.
translation: 算了，还是别问了。

english: I can help you make the enriched snapdragon seed, but you'll then need to grow it yourself. If that's okay with you, you'll need to bring me a regular snapdragon seed.
translation: 我可以帮你制作超级金鱼草种子，但之后你得自己种植。如果你同意的话，你需要给我带一颗普通的金鱼草种子。

english: Right, you now need to enrich the seed using light from the doorway filtered through a rose-tinted lens.
translation: 好了，现在你需要用透过玫瑰色透镜过滤的门口光线来强化这颗种子。

english: But I don't have a rose-tinted lens.
translation: 但我没有玫瑰色透镜。

english: Well I can sell you the colouring needed, but you'll have to provide your own lantern lens.
translation: 嗯，我可以卖给你需要的染料，但你需要自己提供灯笼透镜。

english: In that case, I'll be back soon.
translation: 这样的话，我很快回来。

english: About that enriched snapdragon...
translation: 关于那个超级金鱼草……

english: I've placed your snapdragon seed on the counter. You now need to enrich the seed using light from the doorway filtered through a rose-tinted lens.
translation: 我已经把你的金鱼草种子放在柜台上了。你现在需要用透过玫瑰色透镜过滤的门口光线来强化这颗种子。

english: Well if you have your own lantern lens, then I can sell you the pink dye needed to colour it.
translation: 如果你有自己的灯笼透镜，我可以卖给你需要的粉红色染料来给它上色。

english: How much is it?
translation: 多少钱？

english: It's 20 coins per bottle.
translation: 每瓶20金币。

english: The seed is all ready for you. Just pick it up from the counter. After that, you'll need a specially prepared patch to grow it.
translation: 种子已经为你准备好了。从柜台上拿起来就行。之后，你需要一个特别准备的苗圃来种植它。

english: I see. I'll have to ask Thaerisk about that. Thanks for the help, Betty.
translation: 我明白了。我得去问问赛里斯克。谢谢你的帮助，贝蒂。

english: What do I do with it now?
translation: 我现在该拿它怎么办？

english: Now you need to grow it, but you'll need a specially prepared patch to do so.
translation: 现在你需要种植它，但需要一个特别准备的苗圃。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Any luck with that snapdragon seed?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。那颗金鱼草种子有进展吗？

english: I have it right here. What now?
translation: 我拿到了。现在怎么办？

english: We've prepared a patch to grow it in. It's on top of the western tower of the castle. Head up there and get the seed planted. After that, I think Idria has a task for you.
translation: 我们准备了一个苗圃来种植它。就在城堡西塔的顶部。上去把种子种下。之后，我想伊德莉亚有任务要交给你。

english: It's growing as we speak.
translation: 它正在生长中。

english: Excellent! While we wait for it to grow, I think Idria has a task for you.
translation: 太好了！在等它生长的同时，我想伊德莉亚有任务要交给你。

english: Ah, there you are, [player name]. I have a new task for you.
translation: 啊，你来了，[player name]。我有一个新任务给你。

english: Provided all goes well with this replacement truth serum, we should soon know Lucien's location. However, given he now has the Staff of Armadyl, taking him on is not going to be easy.
translation: 如果这份新的吐真剂一切顺利，我们应该很快就能知道卢西安的下落。不过，既然他现在有了阿玛杜尔杖，对付他可不容易。

english: Thanks to our alliance, we can now bring a sizable force to bear. However, for Lucien himself, we require individuals with more specialised skills.
translation: 多亏了我们的联盟，我们现在可以集结一支相当规模的军队。但对于卢西安本人，我们需要有更专业技能的人。

english: With that in mind, we're looking to recruit a group of heroes to form a small task force. They will be the ones to deal with Lucien.
translation: 考虑到这一点，我们打算招募一群英雄组成一个小型特遣队。他们将负责对付卢西安。

english: I take it you have some people in mind?
translation: 我想你心里已经有人选了吧？

english: We do. Your task is to seek out and recruit three legendary Slayer Masters: Turael, Mazchna and Duradel. Alongside them, we'd also like you to recruit a great warrior called Cyrisus.
translation: 是的。你的任务是找到并招募三位传奇杀戮大师：图拉尔、马斯纳和杜拉德尔。除此之外，我们还希望你招募一位名叫西里苏斯的伟大战士。

english: Ah, Cyrisus! I'm glad to hear he's considered a great warrior now. Back when I first met him he needed a bit of help with that sort of thing.
translation: 啊，西里苏斯！很高兴听到他现在被视为一位伟大的战士了。我当初第一次见到他时，他在那方面还需要一些帮助。

english: Oh, so you're already acquainted? That should make things easier as we've actually found it quite hard to locate him. He always seems to be on the move.
translation: 哦，你们已经认识了？那应该会容易些，因为我们实际上很难找到他。他似乎总是在移动。

english: I have heard that the elusive Moon Clan have methods for contacting people across great distances. Perhaps that might allow you to easily reach out to Cyrisus and the others.
translation: 我听说神秘的月亮族有远距离联系人的方法。也许这能让你轻松联系到西里苏斯和其他人。

english: I need to talk to you about Lucien.
translation: 我需要和你谈谈卢西安的事。

english: Lucien, eh? Can't say that's a name I'm familiar with.
translation: 卢西安，嗯？说实话，我没听说过这个名字。

english: He's a Mahjarrat who's growing in power and is trying to become a god! We're forming an alliance against him at the White Knight's Castle. We'd like you to join us.
translation: 他是一个玛哈加特，正在不断壮大力量，试图成为神！我们正在白骑士城堡组建一个联盟来对抗他。我们希望你能加入我们。

english: Truth be told, friend, this is basically my retirement. Still, I must admit, years of teaching amateurs how to kill goblins has had me itching to get back to the life of adventure...
translation: 说实话，朋友，我基本上已经退休了。不过，我必须承认，多年来教新手如何杀地精让我一直渴望重返冒险生活……

english: Eh, you know what... I'm in! One last job, and quite the job it is!
translation: 呃，你知道吗……我加入！最后一票，而且是个大活儿！

english: That's great, Turael. I'll see you in Falador.
translation: 太好了，图拉尔。法拉多城见。

english: I will be joining you at the White Knights' Castle very soon. I just have a few things I need to do first.
translation: 我很快就会去白骑士城堡与你们会合。我还有些事情要先处理。

english: How are you doing, Turael?
translation: 你还好吗，图拉尔？

english: I can honestly say that I'm very excited. It's been so long since I last did anything like this, and Lucien... Well, let's just say that this will be a fitting final adventure for me.
translation: 老实说，我非常兴奋。我已经很久没有做过这样的事了，而卢西安……这么说吧，这将是我最后一次冒险的完美收尾。

english: Well, being a Slayer Master was already a form of retirement, but I reckon it might finally be time for me to leave that behind as well.
translation: 嗯，当杀戮大师本身也算是一种退休，但我想现在也许是时候连这个也放下了。

english: No more needing to swap tasks for anyone! Can you imagine? The hours I've had to spend keeping records up to date! It will be nice not having to worry about that anymore.
translation: 再也不用为任何人更换任务了！你能想象吗？我花了多少时间来更新记录！不用再担心这个真是太好了。

english: Who do you think will take over from you?
translation: 你觉得谁会接替你的位置？

english: Well my sister, Aya, is currently filling in for me while I'm here. Maybe she'll be open to doing that longer term. If not, my daughter, Spria, has already become a capable Slayer Master herself.
translation: 嗯，我妹妹阿雅现在在我这里期间暂时接替我的工作。也许她会愿意长期做下去。如果不行，我的女儿斯普里亚也已经成了一名能干的杀戮大师。

english: And what happens if you end up getting bored of this new retirement?
translation: 如果你对这次新的退休生活感到厌倦了怎么办？

english: Well I was thinking I might take up viticulture. Someone needs to give Bernald some competition.
translation: 嗯，我在想也许可以从事葡萄栽培。总得有人给伯纳德一点竞争。

english: Well if it takes off, I'll be sure to come and try some samples.
translation: 如果成功了，我一定来尝尝样品。

english: The Mahjarrat.
translation: 那个玛哈加特。

english: Oh, him? I'm surprised that coward is still around to be honest. He was never worthy of being a Mahjarrat.
translation: 哦，他？说实话，我很惊讶那个懦夫还活着。他从来就不配当玛哈加特。

english: I'd be careful of underestimating him. He's managed to claim the Staff of Armadyl and is quickly growing in power.
translation: 小心别低估他。他已经拿到了阿玛杜尔杖，力量正在迅速增长。

english: Hmm... This is concerning. What can I do to help?
translation: 嗯……这令人担忧。我能帮上什么忙？

english: We've formed an alliance at the White Knights' Castle that we'd like you to join.
translation: 我们在白骑士城堡组建了一个联盟，希望你能加入。

english: I would be glad to. The chance to face a Mahjarrat again is something I have desired for many centuries. I look forward to the carnage.
translation: 我很乐意。再次面对玛哈加特的机会，我已经渴望了许多世纪。我期待着这场杀戮。

english: Control your enthusiasm, friend. I will join you in Falador as soon as I am able.
translation: 控制一下你的热情，朋友。我会尽快去法拉多城与你会合。

english: 'Ello! Think you're ready to face Lucien then?
translation: 你好！觉得准备好面对卢西安了吗？

english: I guess so, though I have a question for you: Why do all Slayer Masters say 'ello so much?
translation: 我想是的，不过我有个问题想问你：为什么所有杀戮大师都那么爱说'你好'？

english: Ah, it's somewhat of a tradition in our order. Perhaps there was once some reason, but it's long been lost to time.
translation: 啊，这在我们教团里算是一种传统。也许曾经有过什么原因，但早已被时间遗忘了。

english: You don't know the reason? That seems a bit odd to me.
translation: 你不知道原因？这对我来说有点奇怪。

english: Well who knows what would happen if we stopped? It would probably be fine, but can you really be sure?
translation: 谁知道如果我们停下来会发生什么？可能没事，但你真的能确定吗？

english: Is this regarding the Staff of Armadyl?
translation: 这是关于阿玛杜尔杖的事吗？

english: Yes... but how did you know about that?
translation: 是的……但你是怎么知道的？

english: I would love to tell you, but I'm afraid I am sworn to secrecy.
translation: 我很想告诉你，但恐怕我发过誓要保密。

english: I see... Well I'm hoping you'll be willing to join our alliance against him at the White Knights' Castle.
translation: 我明白了……好吧，我希望你愿意加入我们在白骑士城堡的联盟来对抗他。

english: Willing? Yes. However, I must first ensure that me leaving Shilo Village will not be a problem...
translation: 愿意？是的。不过，我必须先确保我离开希洛村不会有什么问题……

english: It seems my years of waiting are over. I have been granted leave to join your cause. Let Lucien tremble, for he will hear my laughter as his corrupt soul burns in the Abyss.
translation: 看来我多年的等待结束了。我获准加入你们的事业。让卢西安颤抖吧，因为他会听到我的笑声，看着他腐败的灵魂在深渊中燃烧。

english: Okay... Thanks, Duradel.
translation: 好吧……谢谢，杜拉德尔。

english: I am ready to join you. I just need to make arrangements for while I am gone, but then I will depart for Falador.
translation: 我准备好加入你们了。我只需要安排一下我不在时的事宜，然后就会出发前往法拉多城。

english: 'Ello! It's good to finally be out of that hut. After all these years, it's started to feel like a prison.
translation: 你好！终于能离开那间小屋了，真好。这么多年下来，它开始感觉像监狱了。

english: You mean you weren't permitted to leave? Who was stopping you? Who could stop you, for that matter?
translation: 你是说你不被允许离开？谁在阻止你？话说回来，谁能阻止你呢？

english: Let's just say that you don't become the greatest Slayer Master without treading on some very important toes.
translation: 这么说吧，要成为最伟大的杀戮大师，难免会得罪一些非常重要的人物。

english: Now, this is getting interesting. Do tell?
translation: 现在这变得有趣了。快说说？

english: I'm afraid it is a secret that will go to my grave, friend.
translation: 恐怕这是个会带进坟墓的秘密，朋友。

english: Hey Cyrisus, I need to talk to you about Lucien.
translation: 嘿，西里苏斯，我需要和你谈谈卢西安的事。

english: Ah, [player name]. Good to hear from you. Who's this Lucien you speak of?
translation: 啊，[player name]。很高兴听到你的消息。你说的这个卢西安是谁？

english: He's a Mahjarrat who's quickly growing in power. We need to stop him. Would you be willing to join a small party tasked with doing so?
translation: 他是一个力量迅速增长的玛哈加特。我们需要阻止他。你愿意加入一个负责此任务的小队吗？

english: What other challenges are there for an adventurer? If there's help I can offer, then offer it I shall!
translation: 对一个冒险者来说，还有什么其他挑战呢？如果我能提供帮助，那我一定会提供！

english: Great! We're gathering at the White Knights' Castle in Falador.
translation: 太好了！我们正在法拉多城的白骑士城堡集合。

english: Then I shall join you there.
translation: 那我就在那里加入你们。

english: Right, that's all the heroes recruited. I should probably check in with Idria.
translation: 好了，所有英雄都招募到了。我该去和伊德莉亚汇报一下了。

english: Well, this is all quite exciting. It's an illustrious group that you've invited me to join.
translation: 嗯，这真是太令人兴奋了。你邀请我加入的是一个杰出的团体。

english: We're happy to have you along. You've become quite the warrior.
translation: 我们很高兴有你加入。你已经成了一名相当出色的战士。

english: I suppose I've not done badly. Still, without you, I'd be nothing more than a coward. Thank you, friend. I won't let you down.
translation: 我想我做得还不错。不过，没有你的话，我不过是个懦夫。谢谢你，朋友。我不会让你失望的。

english: Hey, Idria. I've recruited those heroes. They're all quite keen to take on Lucien.
translation: 嘿，伊德莉亚。我已经招募了那些英雄。他们都很有兴趣对付卢西安。

english: They are not the kind of people to let evil thrive. That is why we picked them.
translation: 他们不是那种会让邪恶猖獗的人。这就是我们选择他们的原因。

english: You should check in with Thaerisk. Getting that truth serum sorted is our next priority.
translation: 你应该去和赛里斯克谈谈。准备好吐真剂是我们的下一个优先事项。

english: Hello again, [player name]. I imagine that snapdragon seed will have grown by now. You should head on up and check on it.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。我想那颗金鱼草种子现在应该已经长成了。你应该上去看看。

english: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How are things going with that truth serum?
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，[player name]。吐真剂的事情进展如何？

english: I reckon the enriched snapdragon might have grown by now.
translation: 我估计超级金鱼草现在可能已经长成了。

english: Hmm... Might be worth you going and checking on it.
translation: 嗯……也许值得你去检查一下。

english: I'm nearly there with that replacement truth serum.
translation: 那份替代的吐真剂我快准备好了。

english: Well if you need any help with it, just talk to Thaerisk.
translation: 如果你需要任何帮助，就和赛里斯克谈谈。

english: Hello again, [player name]. I imagine that snapdragon seed will have grown by now.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。我想那颗金鱼草种子现在应该已经长成了。

english: Yes, I have the herb right here.
translation: 是的，我这里有草药。

english: Excellent! I have a regular truth serum for you. Just add the herb to it and it should be ready to go. Given what happened before, it might be best if you administer it yourself this time.
translation: 太好了！我有一份普通的吐真剂给你。只要把草药加进去，就可以用了。鉴于之前发生的事，这次最好由你亲自使用。

english: Hello again, [player name]. How are things going with that truth serum?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。吐真剂的事情进展如何？

english: I still need to make some.
translation: 我还需要制作一些。

english: Well you should just need to add the enriched snapdragon to a regular truth serum. Given what happened before, it might be best if you administer it yourself this time.
translation: 你只需要把超级金鱼草加到一份普通的吐真剂里。鉴于之前发生的事，这次最好由你亲自使用。

english: We're nearly there now. I just need to prepare the serum.
translation: 我们快完成了。我只需要准备血清。

english: I have some right here.
translation: 我这里有一些。

english: Excellent! Given what happened before, it might be best if you administer it yourself this time. Just head into the cell when you're ready.
translation: 太好了！鉴于之前发生的事，这次最好由你亲自使用。准备好了就进牢房吧。

english: I have the replacement right here.
translation: 我这里就有替代品。

english: Praise Saradomin! May I suggest you be the one to give it to the spy this time so we avoid any more... accidents.
translation: 赞美萨拉多明！我建议这次由你把它给那个间谍，这样我们就能避免更多的……意外。

english: I have some replacement truth serum.
translation: 我有一些替代的吐真剂。

english: Perfect! Let's get it administered and see what this spy knows.
translation: 完美！我们把它用上，看看这个间谍知道些什么。

english: Right then. We've tried this the easy way, so now we're doing it the hard way! Drink this serum or I'll run you through like the dog you are!
translation: 好吧。我们已经试过温和的方式了，现在要来硬的了！喝下这瓶血清，否则我就把你像条狗一样刺穿！

english: Oh, well, I guess I can cooperate... Down in one, right?
translation: 哦，好吧，我想我可以合作……一口闷，对吧？

english: Okay, it's time for you to talk. Where is Lucien?
translation: 好了，该你开口了。卢西安在哪里？

english: I don't know! I've never even met him!
translation: 我不知道！我甚至没见过他！

english: Then who gives you your orders?
translation: 那谁给你下命令？

english: They call him the Dark Squall. He's super secretive! I don't know his real name!
translation: 他们叫他黑风暴。他非常神秘！我不知道他的真名！

english: I'm going to need more than that!
translation: 我需要的不止这些！

english: Wait! I can tell you what he looks like!
translation: 等等！我可以告诉你他长什么样！

english: Alright, let me grab some things to sketch him with and I'll be back.
translation: 好吧，让我拿些东西来给他画草图，我很快就回来。

english: He wears a hooded burgundy robe with purple trim and a strange diamond-shaped symbol on the front. Over the top he wears a tan jacket.
translation: 他穿着一件带兜帽的酒红色长袍，配有紫色装饰，正面有一个奇怪的菱形符号。外面套着一件棕褐色夹克。

english: And his face?
translation: 他的脸呢？

english: He hides it with a red mask!
translation: 他用一个红色面具遮住了脸！

english: That's all I know, I promise!
translation: 我就知道这些，我保证！

english: Please... I can tell you what the Dark Squall looks like!
translation: 求你了……我可以告诉你黑风暴长什么样！

english: Right, tell me what this Dark Squall looks like.
translation: 好，告诉我这个黑风暴长什么样。

english: Remind me what this Dark Squall looks like.
translation: 再告诉我一下这个黑风暴长什么样。

english: Any luck with the spy, [player name]?
translation: 那个间谍有进展吗，[player name]？

english: He's willing to give me details on a person of interest.
translation: 他愿意给我一个感兴趣的人的具体信息。

english: Well if you need anything, I'm sure Akrisae can help.
translation: 如果你需要什么，我相信阿克里赛能帮忙。

english: I've given the truth serum to the spy, but I need to make a sketch of a person of interest.
translation: 我已经把吐真剂给了间谍，但我需要画一张目标人物的草图。

english: Well if needed, I'm sure Akrisae will be able to help you with that.
translation: 如果需要的话，我相信阿克里赛能帮你。

english: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How are things going with that spy?
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，[player name]。那个间谍的事情进展如何？

english: He's prepared to give me details on a person of interest.
translation: 他准备给我一个感兴趣的人的具体信息。

english: You'll be wanting to make a sketch no doubt? Charcoal and papyrus are standard equipment in our line of work. There should be some nearby if you need them.
translation: 你肯定想画一张草图吧？木炭和莎草纸是我们这一行的标准装备。如果你需要的话，附近应该就有。

english: Right, I've questioned the spy and he gave me a description of someone called the Dark Squall.
translation: 好了，我已经审问了间谍，他给了我一个叫黑风暴的人的描述。

english: Dark Squall?
translation: 黑风暴？

english: Apparently the spy works for him rather than Lucien directly.
translation: 显然这个间谍是为他工作，而不是直接为卢西安工作。

english: I suppose it makes sense that Lucien would work through a proxy. Still, this doesn't give us a lot to go on.
translation: 我想卢西安通过代理人行事是有道理的。不过，这并没有给我们太多线索。

english: Yes, I made a sketch of what he described.
translation: 是的，我根据他的描述画了一张草图。

english: Yes, I reckon we can work with this. I'll arrange for some wanted posters to be put up.
translation: 是的，我觉得我们可以利用这个。我会安排张贴一些通缉令。

english: And I'll pass copies on to our spy network. Hopefully we'll have something before long.
translation: 我会把副本传给我们的间谍网络。希望不久我们就能有收获。

english: We have three more heroes that we'd like you to recruit to our cause.
translation: 我们还有三位英雄希望你能招募到我们的事业中来。

english: Who are we after this time?
translation: 这次我们要找谁？

english: Ghommal, Sloane and Harrallak. All three are members of the Warriors' Guild. Given their nature, we have no doubt they'll agree to join us once you explain the situation.
translation: 戈马尔、斯隆和哈拉拉克。三人都是战士公会的成员。鉴于他们的性格，我们毫不怀疑一旦你说明情况，他们会同意加入我们。

english: Yes, and I made a sketch... though I seem to have misplaced it.
translation: 是的，我画了一张草图……但我好像把它放错地方了。

english: You'll need to make another then. We're going to need that sketch if we're to find this Dark Squall.
translation: 那你得再画一张。我们要找到这个黑风暴，就需要那张草图。

english: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. I hear Idria has you recruiting more heroes to our cause. You should speak to her if you need help with anything.
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，[player name]。我听说伊德莉亚让你招募更多英雄加入我们的事业。如果你需要任何帮助，应该和她谈谈。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Have you managed to recruit those heroes yet?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你成功招募到那些英雄了吗？

english: Remember, you're aiming to convince Ghommal, Sloane and Harrallak to join us. All three are members of the Warriors' Guild.
translation: 记住，你的目标是说服戈马尔、斯隆和哈拉拉克加入我们。三人都是战士公会的成员。

english: Hello there, [player name]. I believe Idria has more heroes for you to recruit. You should speak to her about the details.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我相信伊德莉亚还有更多英雄要你去招募。你应该和她谈谈细节。

english: Lucien? Who's that?
translation: 卢西安？那是谁？

english: He's a powerful Mahjarrat who's trying to achieve godhood!
translation: 他是一个强大的玛哈加特，正试图达到神性！

english: Ah, yes, I remember this name now. Harrallak has spoken of him before.
translation: 啊，是的，我现在记起这个名字了。哈拉拉克以前提到过他。

english: I'm working with an alliance of people who are trying to stop him. We were hoping you would join us.
translation: 我正在和一个试图阻止他的联盟合作。我们希望你能加入我们。

english: A chance to put down evil is a chance I will never refuse! You have my support.
translation: 一个铲除邪恶的机会，我永远不会拒绝！我支持你。

english: Great! We've established a base of operations at the White Knights' Castle. Join us there when you're ready.
translation: 太好了！我们已经在白骑士城堡建立了行动基地。准备好了就来加入我们。

english: I will need to make arrangements with Laidee so we have someone to take care of the Guild. Once that is done, I will join you.
translation: 我需要和莱迪安排一下，这样有人照看公会。完成后，我就会加入你们。

english: Okay, great, thanks!
translation: 好的，太好了，谢谢！

english: I have already agreed to join your cause. I just need to make arrangements so we have someone to take care of the Guild while I'm gone.
translation: 我已经同意加入你们的事业。我只需要安排一下，这样我不在时有人照看公会。

english: When are we going to have this fight? I tire of waiting.
translation: 我们什么时候开打？我等得不耐烦了。

english: We're not ready quite yet, but I'm sure it won't be long.
translation: 我们还没完全准备好，但我相信不会太久了。

english: Good. This Mahjarrat will soon know pain!
translation: 好。这个玛哈加特很快就会知道痛苦的滋味！

english: Welcome to my humble Guild, [player name].
translation: 欢迎来到我简陋的战工会，[player name]。

english: Lucien? You speak of the Mahjarrat?
translation: 卢西安？你说的可是那位玛哈加特？

english: Oh yes. Many years ago, I was one of a group of heroes recruited by the Temple Knights to help stop his attack on Varrock.
translation: 哦，没错。许多年前，我是神殿骑士招募的一批英雄之一，协助阻止他对维洛克城的攻击。

english: Not that they really needed us. He was no Zemouregal, and his attack didn't really amount to much.
translation: 倒不是说他们真的需要我们。他根本不是泽莫雷加尔，他的攻击也没造成什么大影响。

english: Well I'm afraid he's grown a lot more powerful since then. He's managed to claim the Staff of Armadyl and is looking to ascend to godhood!
translation: 恐怕他自那以后变得强大得多。他已经夺得了阿玛杜尔杖，正企图晋升为神！

english: I see... That is disturbing news, my friend. I take it you seek my help in fighting against him once more?
translation: 我明白了……这消息令人不安，朋友。我猜你是想再次寻求我的帮助来对抗他？

english: Yes. We've formed an alliance that's trying to stop him and would like you to join us.
translation: 是的。我们组建了一个联盟试图阻止他，希望你能加入我们。

english: My friend, it would be an honour. My sword is yours.
translation: 朋友，这是我的荣幸。我的剑为你所用。

english: Thank you, Harrallak. When you're ready, head over to the White Knights' Castle.
translation: 谢谢你，哈拉拉克。准备好了就去白骑士城堡吧。

english: I will join you there as soon as I'm able.
translation: 我尽快赶到那里与你会合。

english: Don't worry, friend. I will be joining you at the White Knights' Castle shortly.
translation: 别担心，朋友。我很快就会到白骑士城堡与你汇合。

english: Ah, it's good to get going on a real adventure again. The Guild takes up so much of my time these days.
translation: 啊，又能踏上真正的冒险，真好。这些天战工会占了我太多时间。

english: You're not apprehensive about the dangers ahead?
translation: 你对前方的危险不感到担忧吗？

english: Absolutely, but I positively relish them as well. There's nothing like a bit of danger to get the blood pumping.
translation: 当然担忧，但也正是我所热爱的。没什么比一点点危险更能让热血沸腾了。

english: Lucien? I've heard the name, but never in a good way.
translation: 卢西安？我听说过这个名字，但从来没跟好事沾边。

english: Then you know the danger he poses. He's stolen the Staff of Armadyl and is trying to ascend to godhood!
translation: 那你该知道他带来的威胁。他偷走了阿玛杜尔杖，正企图晋升为神！

english: The Staff of Armadyl? I have heard tales of this artefact, but I assumed it to be a mere myth.
translation: 阿玛杜尔杖？我听过这件神器的传说，但一直以为只是个神话而已。

english: Then it sounds like this evil must be brought to justice. What can I do?
translation: 既然如此，这股邪恶力量必须被绳之以法。我能做些什么？

english: Well we've formed an alliance at the White Knights' Castle that we'd like you to join. I warn you though, it could be dangerous.
translation: 我们在白骑士城堡组建了一个联盟，希望你能加入。不过我警告你，可能会很危险。

english: Like my father before me, and his father before him, I live by an ancient code, my friend. It is what led me to the Warriors' Guild and it drives me every day.
translation: 就像我的父辈和祖辈一样，我遵循着一套古老的准则，朋友。正是这准则引领我来到战士工会，并每天激励着我。

english: I will not sit idly by and see evil flourish. Danger is nothing to a warrior who is true to his heart.
translation: 我不会袖手旁观，任由邪恶猖獗。对于一个忠于内心的战士而言，危险根本不算什么。

english: So is that a yes?
translation: 那么这是同意了？

english: If by lending my axe to this quest, it offers a better chance of success, then I will see it through. I will stand with you.
translation: 如果我的斧头能助你们一臂之力，提高成功的机会，那我就会坚持到底。我会与你们并肩作战。

english: Glad to have you with us!
translation: 很高兴你能加入我们！

english: Right, that's everyone recruited. I should probably head back to Falador.
translation: 好了，人已经都招募齐了。我该回法拉多城了。

english: You have my axe, friend. I just need to finish up some things here, but then I will join you.
translation: 我的斧头是你的了，朋友。我只需要处理好这边的一些事情，然后就来与你会合。

english: Well, I'm ready and waiting to get going. Do you know how long it will be?
translation: 我已经准备好，就等着出发了。你知道还要多久吗？

english: I'm not sure, but I don't expect it will be long.
translation: 我不确定，但应该不会太久。

english: Then I shall use this time to train. After all, there's no such thing as being overprepared.
translation: 那我就利用这段时间训练吧。毕竟，准备过头这种事是不存在的。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Good work recruiting those heroes. I reckon our task force is now complete.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。招募那些英雄做得不错。我想我们的特遣队现在已经齐整了。

english: Great! What happens now?
translation: 太好了！接下来呢？

english: You should speak to Akrisae. There has been a development that he can fill you in on.
translation: 你应该去找阿克里赛谈谈。出了点新情况，他可以告诉你详情。

english: Hello there, [player name]. Akrisae was hoping to speak with you.
translation: 你好，[player name]。阿克里赛一直想跟你谈谈。

english: Ah, there you are, [player name]. There has been a potential development in our hunt for the Dark Squall, but I am concerned about...
translation: 啊，你来了，[player name]。我们在追查黑风暴的行动中有了一个潜在进展，但我有些担心……

english: Hang on... did you hear that?
translation: 等等……你听到了吗？

english: It sounds like... footsteps? But really small ones...
translation: 听起来像是……脚步声？但非常小的那种……

english: Er... come in?
translation: 呃……请进？

english: Hazelmere?!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔？！

english: Ah, I see you're already here, human. Good.
translation: 啊，看来你已经在了，人类。很好。

english: I don't understand... What are you doing here?
translation: 我不明白……你在这里做什么？

english: Were you not paying attention when we last spoke? We find ourselves on the edge of a very dark future, one where the Mahjarrat deceiver is successful.
translation: 上次我们谈话时你没注意听吗？我们正处在一个极其黑暗的未来边缘，那个玛哈加特骗子就要得逞了。

english: He is a threat to all life. If he is not stopped, he will warp the Anima Mundi beyond recognition. As a guardian of the Anima Mundi, I must be here to ensure that doesn't happen.
translation: 他对所有生命都是威胁。如果不阻止他，他会把世界之魂扭曲得面目全非。作为世界之魂的守护者，我必须在这里确保那不会发生。

english: *whispers* Do you have any idea what they're doing?
translation: *低声说* 你知道他们在干什么吗？

english: *whispers* I haven't the slightest clue...
translation: *低声说* 我完全摸不着头脑……

english: Are you sure about this? Lucien is extremely dangerous!
translation: 你确定要这么做吗？卢西安极其危险！

english: The Anima Mundi gave me a choice, and I have made it. If this is to be my last winter, then I go knowing the world will live on to see the next.
translation: 世界之魂给了我选择，我已经做出了决定。如果这将是我最后一个冬天，那我离去时也深知这个世界将继续存续，迎来下一个冬天。

english: Hazelmere, I...
translation: 黑兹尔米尔，我……

english: Er... Sorry to interrupt, [player name], but would you mind explaining who this is?
translation: 呃……抱歉打断一下，[player name]，你能解释一下这位是谁吗？

english: Ah... yes, sorry. This is Hazelmere, one of the gnomes who created the Grand Tree in the Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 啊……对，抱歉。这位是黑兹尔米尔，是创造了地精要塞中大树家园的其中一个地精。

english: Ah, so you're Hazelmere! I've heard much about you!
translation: 啊，原来你就是黑兹尔米尔！久仰大名！

english: Blah blah blah Guthix blah blah!
translation: 咕噜咕噜咕噜 古斯 咕噜咕噜！

english: Er... Sorry, I didn't quite catch that.
translation: 呃……抱歉，我没太听清。

english: *sigh* Ipmesi human.
translation: *叹气* 愚昧的人类。

english: Ah, so that's what that looks like from the outside.
translation: 啊，原来从外面看是这个样子。

english: Would you care to explain what's going on?
translation: 你能解释一下怎么回事吗？

english: Hazelmere can mind meld with other people, allowing him to speak telepathically with them.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔能与他人进行心灵融合，从而与他们进行心灵感应交流。

english: Does he not speak the common tongue?
translation: 他不会说通用语吗？

english: It's not that he can't... He just chooses not to.
translation: 倒不是他不会……他只是选择不说。

english: Right... I believe I need to make some introductions. If you'll excuse us...
translation: 好吧……我想我需要做些介绍。失陪一下……

english: Blah blah!
translation: 咕噜咕噜！

english: Well that was... interesting.
translation: 好吧，这可真是……有趣。

english: Yeah... that's Hazelmere for you. Anyway, you said there had been a development.
translation: 是啊……黑兹尔米尔就是这样。总之，你刚才说有了新进展。

english: That's right. We had a reported sighting of someone matching the description of the Dark Squall near the Black Knights' Fortress.
translation: 没错。我们接到报告，在黑骑士要塞附近有人目击到一名符合黑风暴特征的人。

english: The Black Knights' Fortress? Could the Kinshra really have allied with Lucien?
translation: 黑骑士要塞？金什拉真的可能与卢西安结盟了吗？

english: Lord Daquarius is a devout Zamorakian. I doubt he would betray his god.
translation: 达夸里乌斯领主是个虔诚的扎莫拉克信徒。我不认为他会背叛他的神。

english: Not knowingly perhaps, but who's to say he knows Lucien's true ambition.
translation: 也许不是故意的，但谁能说他了解卢西安的真正野心呢。

english: A fair point. Regardless, I sent Silif to investigate, but we lost contact with him shortly after he entered the fortress.
translation: 说得有道理。不管怎样，我派了西利夫去调查，但他进入要塞后不久我们就失去了联系。

english: I'll go to the fortress. If the Dark Squall is there, I'll find him.
translation: 我去要塞。如果黑风暴在那里，我会找到他的。

english: Good luck, [player name]. Don't forget to take some sort of disguise with you. I can't see you getting into the fortress otherwise. Oh, and keep an eye out for Silif as well. He may be in need of support.
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。别忘了带上某种伪装。否则我看你进不去要塞。哦，还有留意一下西利夫。他可能需要支援。

english: If you want, I can speed things up a bit by teleporting you to Ice Mountain.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以用传送术送你到冰山，稍微加快点速度。

english: Very well. You know where I am if you change your mind.
translation: 那好。如果你改变主意，你知道我在哪里。

english: Hello there, [player name]. Any luck finding Silif or the Dark Squall?
translation: 你好，[player name]。找到西利夫或黑风暴了吗？

english: We lost contact with Silif shortly after he entered the Black Knights' Fortress, so I'd suggest you start there.
translation: 西利夫进入黑骑士要塞后不久我们就失去了联系，所以我建议你从那里开始。

english: I'm still trying to find Silif and the Dark Squall.
translation: 我还在努力寻找西利夫和黑风暴。

english: Well if you need any specific details, I'm sure Akrisae can help.
translation: 如果你需要任何具体细节，我相信阿克里赛能帮上忙。

english: Hello there, [player name]. How goes the hunt for the Dark Squall?
translation: 你好，[player name]。追查黑风暴进展如何？

english: Well if you need any help, just speak to Akrisae.
translation: 如果你需要任何帮助，只管跟阿克里赛说。

english: Attempting to perform a mind meld on this many people would be a needless waste of energy, so I find myself forced to use your rudimentary language.
translation: 试图对这么多人进行心灵融合将会是毫无必要的能量浪费，所以我只好被迫使用你们那粗陋的语言。

english: Oh come on, it's not that bad!
translation: 哦，别这样，也没那么差劲嘛！

english: Hmph! How much longer are we going to be waiting anyway?
translation: 哼！我们到底还要等多久？

english: Do you have better things to be doing?
translation: 你有更重要的事要做吗？

english: Then don't be so impatient. Maybe try socialising or something?
translation: 那就别这么不耐烦。也许试着社交一下什么的？

english: Bah! No one here will have anything of interest to say. I'm better off conversing with myself.
translation: 呸！这里没人会说任何有趣的话。我还不如自己跟自己聊。

english: Silif, is that you?
translation: 西利夫，是你吗？

english: What? I won't talk... You can't make me!
translation: 什么？我不说……你逼不了我！

english: Silif, it's me, [player name].
translation: 西利夫，是我，[player name]。

english: [player name]? Saradomin be praised!
translation: [player name]？萨拉多明保佑！

english: I'm going to get you out of here, Silif. Any suggestions?
translation: 我要把你弄出去，西利夫。有什么建议吗？

english: Sorry, but I've no idea. They roughed me up quite a bit... I'm struggling to think straight.
translation: 抱歉，我也不知道。他们把我揍得够呛……我脑子有点乱。

english: Don't worry, I'll work something out.
translation: 别担心，我会想办法的。

english: [player name]? Is that you?
translation: [player name]？是你吗？

english: It is. I'm still working on getting you out of there.
translation: 是我。我还在想办法把你救出来。

english: I wish I could help, but they roughed me up quite a bit... I'm struggling to think straight.
translation: 我希望能帮忙，但他们把我揍得不轻……我脑子有点乱。

english: I'm back, Silif. I've managed to get the cell unlocked. We should be able to get you out of here now.
translation: 我回来了，西利夫。我已经把牢门打开了。现在应该能把你弄出去了。

english: I'm very weak... I can barely move...
translation: 我太虚弱了……几乎动不了……

english: Hmm... Some food and a restoration potion should sort you out. I have both on me right now.
translation: 嗯……吃点东西和来一瓶恢复药水应该能让你好转。我现在身上恰好都有。

english: I'm back again, Silif. How are you doing?
translation: 我又回来了，西利夫。你怎么样了？

english: Not much better... I can still barely move...
translation: 没好多少……还是几乎动不了……

english: Well I have some food and a restoration potion for you. They should sort you out.
translation: 我这里有食物和一瓶恢复药水给你。应该能让你好转。

english: Well I have some food, but I'm still working on finding you a restoration potion.
translation: 我这里有些食物，不过还在想办法给你弄一瓶恢复药水。

english: Well I have a restoration potion, but I'm still working on finding you some food.
translation: 嗯，我有一瓶恢复药水，但还在帮你找食物。

english: Thank you, [player name]. However, this is quite embarrassing... but I don't think I have the strength to take them myself.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。不过，这实在有点尴尬……但我觉得我自己没有力气拿走它们。

english: So you need me to feed you?
translation: 所以你需要我喂你？

english: I'm afraid so...
translation: 恐怕是这样……

english: Okay, hang tight.
translation: 好的，坚持住。

english: Thank you, friend. I really needed that.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。我真的很需要这个。

english: Okay, Silif, do you think you can move now?
translation: 好了，西利夫，你觉得现在能移动了吗？

english: I think so. Thanks, [player name].
translation: 我想可以了。谢谢，[player name]。

english: Right, then let's get you out of here.
translation: 好，那我们带你离开这里。

english: Not yet. My mission isn't complete.
translation: 还不行。我的任务还没完成。

english: A few moments ago you could barely even move. You're in no fit state to be worrying about your mission.
translation: 刚才你连动都动不了。你现在这个状态不适合操心任务。

english: Then how about a compromise? My job was to find the Dark Squall and gather any intelligence available.
translation: 那折中一下如何？我的任务是找到黑风暴并收集任何可用的情报。

english: If you can get me into the inner section of this place, I can memorise any intelligence and then get back to Falador, leaving the Dark Squall for you to handle.
translation: 如果你能带我进入这个地方的内部区域，我可以记下所有情报，然后返回法拉多城，把黑风暴留给你处理。

english: Thank you, [player name]. I see you managed to find yourself a disguise to use. For this to work, I'll need one as well.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。我看到你给自己弄了套伪装。要成功，我也需要一套。

english: I have some armour here that should do the job.
translation: 我这里有些盔甲，应该能派上用场。

english: Excellent! Now, excuse me for a moment...
translation: 太好了！现在，请稍等片刻……

english: Right, shall we get to it?
translation: 好了，我们开始吧？

english: Very well. I'm right behind you.
translation: 很好。我跟在你后面。

english: Just give me a moment.
translation: 等我一下。

english: Very well, but don't take too long.
translation: 好吧，但别太久。

english: In that case, I'll look around and see what I can find.
translation: 那样的话，我四处看看能找到什么。

english: Thank you, friend. I'm feeling a bit better already.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。我已经感觉好多了。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Any luck finding that disguise?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。找到伪装了吗？

english: I'll wait here until you find something suitable.
translation: 我会在这里等你找到合适的东西。

english: We need to get into the inner section of this place. I'll follow your lead.
translation: 我们需要进入这个地方的内部区域。我会跟着你走。

english: This is where we want to be! Let's see if we can find some sort of intelligence. Maybe some maps or similar.
translation: 这就是我们要去的地方！看看能不能找到什么情报。也许是一些地图之类的。

english: Ah, this looks perfect. I'll stay here and study these maps while you deal with the Dark Squall.
translation: 啊，这个看起来完美。我留在这里研究这些地图，你去对付黑风暴。

english: I'm guessing you had something in mind for him?
translation: 我猜你对他有什么计划？

english: Indeed. Remember how you apprehended that spy earlier? I think the same sort of thing should work perfectly here.
translation: 没错。还记得你之前怎么抓住那个间谍的吗？我觉得同样的方法在这里应该很管用。

english: I managed to keep a teleorb hidden when I was captured. If you can plant it on the Dark Squall, we can teleport him to Falador!
translation: 我被抓的时候藏了一个传送宝珠。如果你能把它放在黑风暴身上，我们就可以把他传送到法拉多城！

english: Have you managed to plant that teleorb on the Dark Squall yet?
translation: 你把传送宝珠放在黑风暴身上了吗？

english: He must be somewhere nearby. Get it planted on him and then get yourself back to Falador.
translation: 他一定就在附近。把宝珠放在他身上，然后你自己回法拉多城。

english: Intruder! Attack!
translation: 入侵者！攻击！

english: That area is out of bounds, soldier! You know you can't go up there!
translation: 那个区域禁止进入，士兵！你知道你不能上去！

english: Good day, master... Wait, I didn't see you come back down!
translation: 日安，主人……等等，我没看见你下来！

english: Of course you didn't, you meathead! I simply teleported away!
translation: 你当然没看见，你这蠢货！我只是传送走了！

english: Of course, master! My apologies!
translation: 当然，主人！请原谅！

english: Of course you didn't, you meathead! I simply teleported away! Now drop and give me five!
translation: 你当然没看见，你这蠢货！我只是传送走了！现在趴下，给我做五个俯卧撑！

english: Yes master!
translation: 是，主人！

english: Who in the world are you?
translation: 你到底是谁？

english: Ah... Well... I was sent here by Lucien to be your new... apprentice?
translation: 啊……嗯……我是卢西安派来给你当新……学徒的？

english: That voice... I know who you are! You're [player name].
translation: 那个声音……我知道你是谁！你是[player name]。

english: Er... No I'm not...
translation: 呃……我不是……

english: Ha! You have no idea who you're meddling with, do you?
translation: 哈！你根本不知道你在跟谁作对，对吧？

english: Surok?!
translation: 苏洛克？！

english: You've been quite the problem for some time. I'll be glad to finally have rid of you...
translation: 你一直以来都是个大麻烦。我很高兴终于能除掉你了……

english: Powered staves are no match for my magic!
translation: 充能法杖不是我的魔法的对手！

english: I am unstoppable!
translation: 我是不可阻挡的！

english: My mind is pure arcanery!
translation: 我的思想是纯粹的秘法！

english: My magic transcends everything you know!
translation: 我的魔法超越你所知的一切！

english: You face the greatest wizard ever to live!
translation: 你面对的是有史以来最伟大的魔法师！

english: Witness true sorcery!
translation: 见证真正的巫术！

english: Fighting you is beneath me!
translation: 和你战斗有失我的身份！

english: My strength is yours, master!
translation: 我的力量属于你，主人！

english: Ha! None can break free from my strength!
translation: 哈！没人能挣脱我的力量！

english: My nimbleness is yours, master!
translation: 我的敏捷属于你，主人！

english: Too slow!
translation: 太慢了！

english: How are you doing there, Surok?
translation: 你那边怎么样了，苏洛克？

english: Here, you can look after this for me...
translation: 来，这个你帮我保管……

english: I should probably get back to Falador before he recovers.
translation: 我最好在他恢复之前赶回法拉多城。

english: It's probably best I don't go back up there again.
translation: 我最好别再上去了。

english: Hello, Silif.
translation: 你好，西利夫。

english: Hello there, friend. Thanks for your help back at the Black Knight Catacombs. I'd probably still be locked in that cell if it wasn't for you.
translation: 你好，朋友。谢谢你在黑骑士地牢里的帮助。要不是你，我可能还关在那间牢房里。

english: No problem, Silif. I'm sure you'd do the same for me.
translation: 不客气，西利夫。我相信你也会为我做同样的事。

english: Welcome back, [player name]. We've already heard about your heroics in those catacombs from Silif. Good work! Thanks to your help, he was able to gather some very useful information for us.
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]。我们已经从西利夫那里听说了你在那些地牢里的英勇事迹。干得好！多亏你的帮助，他为我们收集到了一些非常有用的情报。

english: Well that's not all. I was also able to discover the true identity of the Dark Squall: Surok Magis.
translation: 这还不是全部。我还发现了黑风暴的真实身份：苏洛克.马吉斯。

english: So it's not just the Kinshra. Lucien has managed to ally with the Dagon'hai as well.
translation: 所以不只是金什拉。卢西安还和达贡海结盟了。

english: It's starting to seem like Lucien's allied with more Zamorakian organisations than he hasn't!
translation: 看来卢西安几乎和所有扎莫拉克组织都结盟了！

english: Well when it comes to Surok, we might be able to deal with that problem fairly easily. I managed to plant a teleorb on him.
translation: 至于苏洛克，我们也许能轻松解决这个问题。我在他身上放了一个传送宝珠。

english: Excellent! That could be quite helpful when it comes to enacting our plan.
translation: 太好了！这对我们实施计划会很有帮助。

english: Plan?
translation: 计划？

english: This is the big one. We believe we are now in a place where we can move against Lucien.
translation: 这是个大计划。我们认为现在时机已到，可以对卢西安采取行动了。

english: The task force is already in position, and thanks to the information Silif was able to obtain, we believe we now know where to find Lucien.
translation: 特遣队已经就位，多亏西利夫获得的情报，我们相信现在知道在哪里能找到卢西安了。

english: Some of the plans I found detailed a remote location on the western edge of the Wilderness. I reckon that's Lucien's base of operations.
translation: 我找到的一些计划详细描述了一个位于荒野西缘的偏远地点。我猜那就是卢西安的行动基地。

english: How do we find out for sure?
translation: 我们怎么确定？

english: Well that's where you come in. We need you to scout out this location and confirm Lucien's presence. Once you have done so, the task force will move in and deal with him.
translation: 这就是你的任务了。我们需要你去侦察这个地点，确认卢西安在那里。一旦确认，特遣队就会行动，对付他。

english: So how do I get there?
translation: 那我怎么去那里？

english: It seems the enemy has their own form of teleorb, similar to the ones we use ourselves. I found details suggesting that the Dark Squall, or Surok I should say, was in possession of one.
translation: 看来敌人有自己的传送宝珠，和我们用的类似。我找到的细节表明，黑风暴——或者说苏洛克——拥有一个。

english: Surok is likely one of the few people who can directly reach Lucien. That orb is presumably how he does it.
translation: 苏洛克很可能是少数能直接联系到卢西安的人之一。那个宝珠大概就是他用来联系的方式。

english: I have an orb here that I found while exploring those catacombs. I'm guessing this is the one he uses.
translation: 我在这里有一个宝珠，是在探索那些地牢时找到的。我猜这就是他用的那个。

english: Perfect! That's one less thing to worry about. There will be a location within Surok's headquarters where the orb must be used from. Find it and use the orb to reach Lucien.
translation: 完美！这样少了一件要担心的事。在苏洛克的总部里，应该有一个必须使用宝珠的位置。找到它，用宝珠到达卢西安那里。

english: Where can I find this orb?
translation: 我在哪里能找到这个宝珠？

english: It's likely somewhere in Surok's headquarters. The same place you and Silif found that intelligence.
translation: 很可能在苏洛克总部的某个地方。就是你和西利夫找到情报的那个地方。

english: And once I have the orb? Then what?
translation: 拿到宝珠之后呢？然后怎么办？

english: There will be a location within Surok's headquarters where the orb must be used from. Find it and use the orb to reach Lucien.
translation: 在苏洛克的总部里，应该有一个必须使用宝珠的位置。找到它，用宝珠到达卢西安那里。

english: I'd recommend you keep that disguise on. It should let you get nice and close to Lucien without being spotted.
translation: 我建议你继续穿着那套伪装。这样你就能靠近卢西安而不被发现。

english: I'd recommend disguising yourself again before you do so. That should let you get nice and close to Lucien without being spotted.
translation: 我建议你在那之前再次伪装自己。这样你就能靠近卢西安而不被发现。

english: Yes, I have Surok's Dark Squall robes with me right now. I can use them.
translation: 是的，我现在带着苏洛克的黑风暴长袍。我可以穿上它们。

english: Right, I think that covers everything. When you're ready to go, just step inside the cell. We're going to use that teleorb you planted to swap your location with Surok's.
translation: 好了，我想该说的都说了。你准备好出发时，就走进牢房。我们会用你放在苏洛克身上的传送宝珠，把你的位置和他交换。

english: Ah, good thinking.
translation: 啊，好主意。

english: Let's finish this.
translation: 让我们了结这一切。

english: Hello there, [player name]. When you're ready to go, just step inside the cell. We're going to use that teleorb you planted to swap your location with Surok's.
translation: 你好，[player name]。你准备好出发时，就走进牢房。我们会用你放在苏洛克身上的传送宝珠，把你的位置和他交换。

english: Are you ready, [player name]? I'll teleport you as soon as you enter the cell.
translation: 准备好了吗，[player name]？你一进入牢房，我就传送你。

english: Then let's do this.
translation: 那就开始吧。

english: Actually, I need more time to prepare.
translation: 其实，我还需要更多时间准备。

english: Very well. Just enter the cell when you're ready.
translation: 好吧。准备好了就走进牢房。

english: Hello there, [player name]. How goes the hunt for Lucien?
translation: 你好，[player name]。追捕卢西安进行得怎么样了？

english: Don't worry, the heroes will be keeping an eye on things from a distance. They'll move in as soon as they have a positive sighting.
translation: 别担心，英雄们会从远处监视情况。一旦确认目标，他们就会行动。

english: I'm still working on finding Lucien.
translation: 我还在努力寻找卢西安。

english: Well good luck. I have no doubt you'll be successful.
translation: 祝你好运。我毫不怀疑你会成功的。

english: Lucien!
translation: 卢西安！

english: What's he doing now?
translation: 他现在在做什么？

english: You... Did you really think that disguise would fool me? You are not Surok... and you are not welcome!
translation: 你……你真以为那伪装能骗过我？你不是苏罗克……而且这里不欢迎你！

english: The human will be toast if we don't move now. Ready for teleport!
translation: 我们再不行动，那个人类就完了。准备传送！

english: Sloane! Duradel! No!
translation: 斯隆！杜拉德尔！不！

english: This decision was already made and was for the best. Goodbye, my friends.
translation: 这个决定已经做出，而且是最好的选择。再见了，我的朋友们。

english: Get out of there! He's too powerful!
translation: 快离开那里！他太强大了！

english: Hazelmere!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔！

english: What wonderful devastation! Now, I have things to attend to.
translation: 多么美妙的毁灭啊！现在，我还有事要处理。

english: We must find out where Lucien went! Turael and Duradel must be avenged!
translation: 我们必须查明卢西安去了哪里！图拉尔和杜拉德尔必须得以报仇！

english: Getting back to Falador would be wiser. Did you see the way he slaughtered us? That our weapons are useless? How many more would die? Some must survive to report this nightmare!
translation: 撤回法拉多城更明智。你没看到他屠杀我们的方式吗？我们的武器毫无用处？还要死多少人？必须有人活下来报告这场梦魇！

english: Such knowledge lost with their deaths... You are right. We have suffered enough for one day. We must retreat.
translation: 随着他们的逝去，多少知识也失落了……你说得对。我们今天已经遭受了足够多的损失。我们必须撤退。

english: [player name], get back to Falador! We're teleporting out now!
translation: [player name]，快回法拉多城！我们正在传送出去！

english: Hazelmere... Cyrisus... What have I done? Lucien will pay for this!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔……西里苏斯……我都做了什么？卢西安会为此付出代价的！

english: [player name]! Thank goodness you're back. When Mazchna reported in, we feared the worst!
translation: [player name]！谢天谢地你回来了。当马斯纳报告时，我们都担心最坏的情况发生了！

english: They're gone... All of them... He killed them, like they were nothing!
translation: 他们都不在了……全都死了……他杀了他们，就像碾死蚂蚁一样！

english: We thought we knew how powerful Lucien had become. We thought we'd prepared appropriately...
translation: 我们以为我们了解卢西安变得有多强大。我们以为我们做了充分的准备……

english: I fear no amount of preparation would have been enough. We were never going to have a hope against that level of power...
translation: 恐怕无论做多少准备都不够。面对那种级别的力量，我们从来就没有胜算……

english: He can't be allowed to get away with this!
translation: 绝不能让他就这样逃脱！

english: But what can we do? It seems we already lack the ability to stand against Lucien, and he doesn't even have the Stone yet! With it...
translation: 但我们又能做什么？看来我们连对抗卢西安的能力都没有，而他甚至还没拿到石头！一旦拿到……

english: He could bring an end to this world without even trying!
translation: 他甚至不费吹灰之力就能毁灭这个世界！

english: My friends, we cannot afford to lose hope now. The situation is dire, but one of our contacts recently reported in with information that may help us turn things around.
translation: 朋友们，我们现在不能失去希望。情况虽然危急，但我们的一名线人最近报告了一条可能帮助我们扭转局面的情报。

english: Information? What information?
translation: 情报？什么情报？

english: Movario has been sighted entering the caves below Lumbridge Swamp.
translation: 有人看见莫瓦里奥进入了仑桥镇沼泽下方的洞穴。

english: Lumbridge Swamp? There's nothing of value there, is there?
translation: 仑桥镇沼泽？那里没什么有价值的东西，对吧？

english: Nothing that we know of, but Movario has shown interest in the area before. He wouldn't be going back there now without good reason.
translation: 据我们所知没有，但莫瓦里奥以前就对那片区域表现出过兴趣。他现在回去肯定有充分的理由。

english: Surely it can't be...?
translation: 总不会是……吧？

english: You don't think the Stone is down there, do you?
translation: 你不会认为石头就在下面吧？

english: If there's any chance that it is, then we must make sure he doesn't find it.
translation: 如果有任何可能，我们必须确保他找不到它。

english: Hmm... I may have an idea. I could use my Dark Squall disguise to approach Movario.
translation: 嗯……我可能有个主意。我可以利用我的黑风暴伪装去接近莫瓦里奥。

english: I can find out what he knows, and if the Stone is down there, I can hopefully reach it before he does.
translation: 我可以探查出他知道什么，如果石头真的在下面，我有希望比他先拿到。

english: It's a risky plan, but I suspect it's the only one we've got.
translation: 这个计划很冒险，但恐怕这是我们唯一的选择了。

english: Akrisae, do we have any information on where exactly in these caves Movario is?
translation: 阿克里赛，我们有没有关于莫瓦里奥具体在这些洞穴里哪个位置的情报？

english: He was last seen entering a large cavern filled with some mysterious floating lights.
translation: 他最后一次被看到是进入了一个充满神秘浮光的大洞穴里。

english: I can work with that. I'll head over there right away.
translation: 这情报够用了。我马上过去。

english: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. How goes your mission?
translation: 沙若明与你同在，[player name]。你的任务进展如何？

english: I haven't found Movario yet.
translation: 我还没有找到莫瓦里奥。

english: According to our contact, he was seen entering a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights somewhere within the Lumbridge Swamp Caves.
translation: 根据我们的线人，有人看见他进入了仑桥镇沼泽洞穴内一个充满神秘浮光的大型洞穴。

english: Don't forget to disguise yourself as the Dark Squall before you approach him. We need to convince him you're someone he can trust.
translation: 别忘了在接近他之前伪装成黑风暴。我们需要让他相信你是他可以信任的人。

english: About the heroes...
translation: 关于那些英雄们……

english: They will always be remembered, my friend. I've already made arrangements to have statues built in their honour. Everyone will know of their bravery, and their sacrifice.
translation: 他们会永远被铭记，我的朋友。我已经安排为他们建造雕像以表敬意。每个人都会知道他们的勇敢和牺牲。

english: Statues? I think they'd have liked that. Thank you, Akrisae.
translation: 雕像？我想他们会喜欢的。谢谢你，阿克里赛。

english: Good to see you, [player name]. How are things going?
translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]。事情进展如何？

english: Akrisae said he'd been seen in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. There was mention of a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights.
translation: 阿克里赛说他曾在仑桥镇沼泽洞穴被看到。还提到一个充满神秘浮光的大型洞穴。

english: Just remember, you'll need to disguise yourself as the Dark Squall. That should convince Movario that you're working with him.
translation: 记住，你需要伪装成黑风暴。这应该能让莫瓦里奥相信你和他是一伙的。

english: Lucien will not be allowed to get away with his actions, my friend. We will stop him.
translation: 卢西安不会逍遥法外的，我的朋友。我们会阻止他。

english: So you believe in revenge?
translation: 所以你相信复仇？

english: Revenge? No. However, I do believe in justice. I know some druids would even challenge that, but a world without justice is a world without balance.
translation: 复仇？不。但我确实相信正义。我知道有些德鲁伊甚至质疑这一点，但没有正义的世界就是一个没有平衡的世界。

english: Lucien, and those like him, must be held accountable for their actions. It falls to people like us to ensure that happens. It's the only way the world will stay safe.
translation: 卢西安和他那样的人必须为他们的行为负责。确保这一点实现正是我们这类人的责任。这是世界保持安全的唯一方式。

english: I just hope we can stop him soon.
translation: 我只是希望我们能尽快阻止他。

english: We will, my friend. With people like you fighting for our cause, Lucien has no hope.
translation: 我们会做到的，我的朋友。有像你这样的人为我们的目标而战，卢西安毫无胜算。

english: Hello there, [player name]. Any luck with Movario?
translation: 你好，[player name]。有莫瓦里奥的消息了吗？

english: According to Akrisae, he was last seen somewhere in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves, in a large cavern filled with mysterious floating lights.
translation: 据阿克里赛说，最后一次有人看见他是在仑桥镇沼泽洞穴的某个地方，一个充满神秘浮光的大型洞穴里。

english: If you disguise yourself as the Dark Squall, you'll hopefully be able to convince him you're working with him.
translation: 如果你伪装成黑风暴，希望能说服他你是和他一伙的。

english: They will never be forgotten, [player name].
translation: 他们永远不会被忘记，[player name]。

english: It just feels like they died for nothing.
translation: 只是感觉他们死得毫无价值。

english: I know how you feel, but the sacrifices we make... it's never for nothing. They were willing to stand against a great evil so that the world might be safe.
translation: 我懂你的感受，但我们所做的牺牲……从来都不是无意义的。他们愿意挺身对抗一个巨大的邪恶，只为让世界安全。

english: That's how I know that Lucien will never win. We fight for something that he will never understand, and we do so no matter the chance of success.
translation: 正因为如此，我知道卢西安永远不会赢。我们为他永远不会理解的东西而战，而且不管成功几率有多小，我们都会坚持。

english: Because of that, our sacrifices will always have far more meaning than anything he stands for.
translation: 正因如此，我们的牺牲永远比他所代表的一切有意义得多。

english: Thank you, Idria. That means a lot.
translation: 谢谢你，伊德莉亚。这对我意义重大。

english: Movario?
translation: 莫瓦里奥？

english: Lucien has sent me to check on your progress.
translation: 卢西安派我来检查你的进展。

english: Movario! That's...
translation: 莫瓦里奥！那是……

english: Yes, Darve, I can see who it is. Let it be known, Surok, that I am not one of your minions. I will not bow down to your attempts to intimidate me.
translation: 是的，达尔夫，我看得出是谁。苏罗克，你给我听好了，我不是你的手下。我不会屈服于你恐吓我的企图。

english: As for my progress, you can tell Lucien that the investigations would be greatly expedited if I weren't subject to all these interruptions!
translation: 至于我的进展，你可以告诉卢西安，如果没有这些没完没了的打扰，调查早就快多了！

english: Then allow me to expedite things myself. Time is now of the essence and Lucien's patience is wearing thin.
translation: 那就让我亲自来加快进度吧。现在时间紧迫，卢西安的耐心快要耗尽了。

english: You would take over? Preposterous!
translation: 你想接手？荒谬！

english: While Lucien has asked me to oversee your investigations, I am not unreasonable. Believe it or not, I've actually read much of your detailed research myself.
translation: 虽然卢西安让我来监督你的调查，但我并非不讲道理。信不信由你，我自己其实读过你很多详细的研究资料。

english: You are clearly an expert in this area, and I am open to letting you continue to take the lead, provided we are able to quickly conclude our work here.
translation: 你显然是这个领域的专家，我乐意让你继续主导，前提是我们要能迅速完成这里的工作。

english: Looks like we don't have much choice, boss.
translation: 看来我们没多少选择了，老大。

english: Now, please share what you know with me.
translation: 现在，请把你所知道的分享给我。

english: Hmph. Very well. Given you have read my research, and given Lucien himself sent you, I trust you know what it is I seek.
translation: 哼。好吧。既然你读过我的研究，而且卢西安亲自派你来，我相信你知道我在找什么。

english: Even with all that I know, I can still scarcely even imagine it! A power beyond even the gods themselves!
translation: 即使我知道这么多，我仍然难以想象！一种甚至超越诸神本身的力量！

english: I am all too aware, but all this means little given you have still not found it.
translation: 我太清楚了，但这一切都毫无意义，因为你还没找到它。

english: Oh, but I believe I have found it. More than that, I believe we are stood right above it.
translation: 哦，但我相信我已经找到了。不仅如此，我相信我们就站在它的正上方。

english: Right above it? Surely you don't mean the chasm?
translation: 正上方？你肯定不是指那个深渊吧？

english: That's precisely what I mean. Perhaps now you see the issue that I face. Reaching the bottom will require a significant amount of effort.
translation: 正是此意。也许现在你明白我面临的问题了。到达底部需要相当大的努力。

english: I attempted to recruit some goblins to find a way down, but they proved... inadequate. I fear a gantry will need building, which will not be a quick process.
translation: 我曾试图招募一些哥布林来寻找下去的路，但他们证明……不称职。恐怕需要建造一个龙门架，那可不是一个快速的过程。

english: And what about the light creatures? Are they of no use?
translation: 那些光之生物呢？它们没用吗？

english: I don't think so... though I suppose they are rather unique. Perhaps I shall study their movements at some point.
translation: 我不这么认为……不过我想它们确实很独特。也许我以后会研究它们的运动方式。

english: I think Surok has an idea for using them, boss!
translation: 我觉得苏罗克有个利用它们的主意，老大！

english: Allow me to explain. This isn't my first time in these caves. On a previous visit, I found that a special type of lantern with a distinct blue light could attract the creatures.
translation: 请允许我解释一下。我不是第一次来这些洞穴了。在之前的一次探访中，我发现一种带有独特蓝光的特殊灯笼可以吸引那些生物。

english: Once attracted, they'd surround you and carry you to the far side.
translation: 一旦被吸引，它们会包围你并带你到另一边。

english: You wouldn't get me in one of those things! Not on your life!
translation: 你休想让我坐那玩意儿！绝对不行！

english: Shut up, Darve! The adults are talking!
translation: 闭嘴，达尔夫！大人们在谈话！

english: Did you ever manage to get them to go downwards? To the bottom?
translation: 你有没有成功让它们向下飞？飞到最底部？

english: No. I assume the lantern isn't bright enough for that.
translation: 没有。我猜是灯笼不够亮，不足以做到那样。

english: Hmm, intriguing! I know of a light spell which might work. If you were to use your lantern to call a creature, I could try and use my spell to send it down to the bottom of the chasm!
translation: 嗯，有趣！我知道一个光系法术可能管用。如果你用你的灯笼召唤一只生物，我可以试着用我的法术把它送到深渊底部！

english: However, that does then pose a problem.
translation: 不过，那样就产生了一个问题。

english: Well it would mean you'd be going down first! After all this work, do you really think I'm just going to let you get your hands all over my finds?
translation: 那意味着你会先下去！做了这么多工作，你以为我会让你染指我的发现吗？

english: Your finds? Is that how Lucien would describe them? What do you think he will do if I inform him of your lack of cooperation?
translation: 你的发现？卢西安会这么描述它们吗？如果我告诉他你不配合，你觉得他会怎么做？

english: Okay, fine! Given I have no choice, when you're ready to go down, just attract a light creature. Once you're in position, I'll use my light spell.
translation: 好吧，行！既然我别无选择，你准备好下去的时候就吸引一只光之生物。一旦你到位，我就用我的光系法术。

english: Nothing, I guess.
translation: 我猜没什么。

english: Then be gone, before I set Darve on you!
translation: 那就滚开，趁我还没让达尔夫对付你！

english: Ah, so you've returned. Ready to take your trip to the bottom yet?
translation: 啊，你回来了。准备好去底部了吗？

english: Can we hurry things up? I've got better things to do than hang around these filthy caves!
translation: 我们能快点吗？我有更好的事要做，而不是在这肮脏的洞穴里闲逛！

english: Shut up, Darve!
translation: 闭嘴，达尔夫！

english: Remind me what I need to do.
translation: 提醒我该做什么。

english: Just attract one of the light creatures using one of those lanterns you were talking about. When you're in position, I'll use my light spell to send you down to the bottom of the chasm.
translation: 用你提到的那种灯笼吸引一只光之生物就好。等你就位后，我会用我的光系法术把你送到深渊底部。

english: I hope that Surok character doesn't come back. There's something not right about him... He makes General Khazard seem normal!
translation: 我希望那个苏罗克别再回来了。他有点不对劲……跟他一比，连卡扎德将军都显得正常了！

english: If you don't like him, be glad you've never met Lucien.
translation: 你要是不喜欢他，那就庆幸自己没见过卢西安吧。

english: Watch out, surface-dweller! Don't get too close to the edge!
translation: 小心点，地面居民！别靠边太近！

english: Movario's paying us to help him with his expedition. He thin-
translation: 莫瓦里奥花钱雇我们帮他探险。他觉得——

english: Goblin! What did I tell you about what we're doing here?
translation: 地精！我跟你说过咱们在这儿干什么了吧？

english: That it's a secret... which means we shouldn't tell strangers about it.
translation: 是秘密……所以我们不该告诉陌生人。

english: Movario's paying us to help him with his expedition. He thinks there's something important down this chasm.
translation: 莫瓦里奥花钱雇我们帮他探险。他觉得这深渊下面有什么重要的东西。

english: Well Ulgon's climbing down to see if he can find the bottom. He didn't reach it last time, so Movario made us get a longer rope.
translation: 乌尔贡正往下爬，看看能不能找到底。上次他没到底，所以莫瓦里奥让我们弄了根更长的绳子。

english: I see. Well good luck.
translation: 明白了。那祝你好运。

english: I'm here to speak to Movario.
translation: 我是来找莫瓦里奥谈话的。

english: Why you talking to me then? He's right there.
translation: 那你跟我说话干嘛？他就在那边。

english: Don't think I can help the likes of you! Talk to Movario.
translation: 别以为我能帮你这种人！去跟莫瓦里奥说。

english: You play with fire, [player name].
translation: 你这是在玩火，[player name]。

english: You mean Movario? Don't worry, I'm trying to stop him.
translation: 你是说莫瓦里奥？别担心，我正试图阻止他。

english: Are you sure your intentions are pure? Look into your heart. The power Movario and his master seek, a part of you wants this power for yourself.
translation: 你确定你的意图是纯粹的吗？看看你的内心。莫瓦里奥和他主人追求的力量，你内心深处也想要这份力量据为己有。

english: I promise, my only intention is to stop Movario and Lucien. I won't let them find what they're looking for.
translation: 我发誓，我唯一的意图就是阻止莫瓦里奥和卢西安。我不会让他们找到他们要找的东西。

english: About Movario...
translation: 关于莫瓦里奥……

english: You must stop him and his master. This is a quest that matters above all others.
translation: 你必须阻止他和他的主人。这是一条比其他所有任务都重要的任务。

english: I won't let them find what they're looking for. I promise.
translation: 我不会让他们找到他们要找的东西。我保证。

english: Interesting... Some of the the light creatures followed me! I doubt I'll need that light spell to navigate down here again.
translation: 有意思……有些光之生物跟着我！我怀疑以后在这儿探路都不需要那道光系法术了。

english: You've returned! What news of the bottom? What's down there?
translation: 你回来了！底下有什么消息？下面是什么？

english: Oh, it's very dark down there. I can hardly see anything! It's going to take more work for me to get anywhere.
translation: 哦，下面非常暗。我几乎什么都看不见！我得再费点功夫才能有所进展。

english: Well then let me help! Tell me, how do we summon the light creatures? I made one of those blue lanterns, but they still don't seem to come!
translation: 那让我来帮你！告诉我，怎么召唤那些光之生物？我做了一个那种蓝色灯笼，但它们还是不来！

english: I'm not sure. It worked fine for me.
translation: 我不确定。我用的时候好好的。

english: It's that big snake over there! I keep telling you, every time you start enticing one, it does something to them! Why don't you listen to me?
translation: 是那边那条巨蛇！我一直跟你说，每次你开始引诱它们的时候，它就会对它们做些什么！你为什么就是不听我的？

english: It seems highly unlikely that a snake has that capability. That thing is nothing more than a bloated earth worm! Now silence, Darve!
translation: 一条蛇拥有那种能力似乎极不可能。那东西不过是一条肿胀的蚯蚓！现在闭嘴，达尔夫！

english: As for you, what can you tell me about the chasm?
translation: 至于你，关于这深渊你能告诉我什么？

english: Nothing much. Like I say, it's very dark. Now, I'm sorry, but I've answered your questions. You should let me get back to work.
translation: 没什么。就像我说的，非常暗。好了，抱歉，我已经回答了你的问题。该让我回去工作了。

english: The impertinence! I'll ask these same questions until I get the answers I need! Now tell me, what's down there?
translation: 无礼！我会一直问这些问题，直到得到我想要的答案！现在告诉我，下面有什么？

english: He thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself, but I haven't found anything of note yet.
translation: 他以为石头藏在洞穴深处的一个深渊里。我自己设法下去了，但还没发现什么值得注意的东西。

english: Well then you'd better get back there. If Movario is close to finding the Stone, then we need to find it first.
translation: 那你最好回去。要是莫瓦里奥快找到石头了，那我们就得先找到它。

english: He thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself and I've found some sort of Guthixian temple.
translation: 他以为石头藏在洞穴深处的一个深渊里。我自己设法下去了，还发现了一座像是古斯神庙的建筑。

english: I've found the Stone! It's in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves.
translation: 我找到石头了！它就在洞穴深处的一个深渊里。

english: Well then you need to get back there now and make sure the Stone is safe! I have a party that's nearly ready to support you. We will join you as soon as we can.
translation: 那你现在就得回去，确保石头安全！我有一队人快准备好支援你了。我们会尽快与你汇合。

english: Movario thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself, but I haven't found anything of note yet.
translation: 莫瓦里奥觉得石头藏在洞穴深处的一个深渊里。我自己设法下去了，但还没发现什么值得注意的东西。

english: Well keep it up, [player name]. I have no doubt you'll lead us to success.
translation: 那就继续努力，[player name]。我毫不怀疑你会带领我们走向成功。

english: Movario thinks the Stone is hidden in a chasm deep below the rest of the caves. I've managed to get down there myself and I've found some sort of Guthixian temple.
translation: 莫瓦里奥觉得石头藏在洞穴深处的一个深渊里。我自己设法下去了，还发现了一座像是古斯神庙的建筑。

english: A Guthixian temple? Curious... You'd better get back there as soon as you can.
translation: 古斯神庙？有意思……你最好尽快回去。

english: You must speak to Idria at once! She has been preparing a party to support you.
translation: 你必须立刻去找伊德莉亚谈谈！她一直在准备一支队伍支援你。

english: You'd better get back there as soon as possible, [player name]. We can't let Movario find the Stone.
translation: 你最好尽快回去，[player name]。我们不能让莫瓦里奥找到石头。

english: A Guthixian temple? This is concerning, [player name]. You'd better get back there as soon as possible.
translation: 古斯神庙？这让人担心，[player name]。你最好尽快回去。

english: Well then you must get back there as soon as you can! We can't let Lucien get the Stone.
translation: 那你必须尽快回去！我们不能让卢西安得到石头。

english: In the name of Guthix, what rights do you have here?
translation: 以古斯之名，你有什么资格在这里？

english: I don't know who you are... or what you are for that matter, but we don't have much time! The Stone is in danger!
translation: 我不知道你是谁……也不知道你是什么东西，但我们没多少时间了！石头有危险！

english: The Stone is always in danger. That is why I stand before you, [player name].
translation: 石头一直处于危险之中。这就是为什么我站在你面前，[player name]。

english: You know my name?
translation: 你知道我的名字？

english: I know everything about you, [player name]. I have seen your past, your present and your future.
translation: 我知晓你的一切，[player name]。我见过你的过去、现在和未来。

english: Then you must have seen Lucien and his power! We have to get the Stone to safety!
translation: 那你一定见过卢西安和他的力量！我们必须把石头转移到安全的地方！

english: Your duty is noble, [player name], but so is mine: To protect the Stone until a time when, near to death, you are relieved of all duties with the gratitude and blessings of Guthix.
translation: 你的职责是高尚的，[player name]，但我的也一样：保护石头，直到你濒临死亡之时，带着古斯的感激与祝福卸下所有职责。

english: So you won't help me?
translation: 所以你不会帮我？

english: I am not here to help. I wish you all the best, [player name], but I am charged with a singular purpose, and I will now do my duty...
translation: 我不是来帮忙的。祝你好运，[player name]，但我肩负着唯一的使命，我现在要去履行职责了……

english: I still don't understand, [player name].
translation: 我还是不明白，[player name]。

english: It was V who first found it, deep below the ice of Lunar Isle. A single touch granted him the power of the gods. The power of limitless creation...
translation: 是V最先找到它的，就在月亮岛的冰层深处。仅仅一次触碰就赋予了他神的力量。那无限创造的力量……

english: Over the centuries, it changed hands many times. For each person who'd use it for good, another would use it to destroy...
translation: 几个世纪以来，它多次易手。有人用它行善，就有人用它毁灭……

english: And the kin?
translation: 那族群呢？

english: They were bound to it long ago. To use the Stone causes them unimaginable pain, and grants them immense power.
translation: 他们很久以前就与它绑定了。使用石头会给他们带来难以想象的痛苦，同时也赋予他们巨大的力量。

english: So the only way to win...
translation: 所以获胜的唯一途径……

english: Is the Stone.
translation: 就是石头。

english: What in the...?
translation: 这是……？

english: The Stone! After all this time... I've finally found it!
translation: 石头！过了这么久……我终于找到了！

english: And look who's here as well! The so-called Lord Surok!
translation: 看看谁也在！所谓的苏罗克大人！

english: Yes, quite a clever ploy, [player name], but you should have known I'd work it out. Now, step aside.
translation: 是啊，真是聪明的把戏，[player name]，但你该知道我会识破的。现在，让开。

english: And let you take the Stone? I don't think so.
translation: 然后让你拿走石头？想都别想。

english: We stand before the most important, the most significant, the most powerful artefact to ever be discovered in Gielinor, and it's all thanks to me!
translation: 我们正站在吉莱诺有史以来最重要、最有意义、最强大的神器面前，而这一切都归功于我！

english: With the patience of a thousand men, I have spent my life following the smallest of clues and the slightest of hints to discover only the most minute inkling of its existence!
translation: 我怀着千人之耐心，穷尽一生追寻最细微的线索和最渺茫的暗示，才得以窥见其存在的蛛丝马迹！

english: So yes, you will step aside, because after all I've done to get here, I have no intention of letting you stop me now!
translation: 所以没错，你必须让开，因为我已经付出了这么多才走到这一步，我绝不打算让你现在阻止我！

english: If Lucien gets the Stone, the world burns. I don't plan on letting that happen.
translation: 如果卢西安得到石头，整个世界就会毁灭。我不打算让这种事发生。

english: And what makes you think Lucien will ever lay his hands on it? He may have contributed to my research funds, certainly, but in terms of actual possession, I now hold the cards.
translation: 你怎么就觉得卢西安能染指它呢？他确实资助过我的研究经费，但说到实际拥有，现在牌在我手里。

english: You'd be a fool to cross him. He'd wipe you from existence before you could even say a word.
translation: 跟他作对，你就是个傻瓜。你连一句话都来不及说，他就会把你从这个世界上抹去。

english: Before, yes, but now... Now the power of the Stone is in the palm of my hand. Lucien has no hope of standing against that.
translation: 以前，是的，但现在……现在贾斯之石的力量就在我掌中。卢西安毫无希望与之抗衡。

english: Except you don't have the Stone yet. You'll have to get through me first.
translation: 可你还没拿到石头呢。你得先过我这关。

english: No problems! I'll easily deal with you, mate!
translation: 没问题！我轻松就能搞定你，老兄！

english: Darve, I wouldn't be too enthusiastic about tangling with our friend here. His strength is... unusual. Surely you didn't...
translation: 达尔夫，我对你和这位朋友纠缠可没那么乐观。他的力量……非同寻常。你该不会……

english: Hang on... I detect a build up of energy...
translation: 等等……我察觉到能量在积聚……

english: Movario.
translation: 莫瓦里奥。

english: Lord Lucien! We did not expect...
translation: 卢西安大人！我们没料到……

english: It seems you have found the Stone. Why was I not informed?
translation: 看来你找到了石头。为什么没有通知我？

english: The discovery was made mere moments ago, my lord. Now I need time to conduct research and ensure it's safe to...
translation: 发现是片刻之前的事，我的主人。现在我需要进行研究，确保它安全……

english: Silence! Do you not feel that, Movario? It calls to me... my birthright!
translation: 闭嘴！你难道没感觉到吗，莫瓦里奥？它在召唤我……我的天赐之权！

english: Icthlarin... Zaros... Zamorak... All of them false! Finally the Mahjarrat shall take their rightful place as the sole inheritors of Gielinor, and I will be their god!
translation: 伊克哈林……扎罗斯……扎莫拉克……全都是假的！最终，玛哈加特将占据他们应有的位置，成为盖里诺的唯一继承者，而我将成为他们的神！

english: Any who stand in my way shall be swept away like the civilisations of old. For those that are lucky, their children shall become slaves!
translation: 任何挡我路的人都会被像古老文明一样扫除。那些幸运的人，他们的孩子将成为奴隶！

english: I wouldn't be so sure about that!
translation: 那可不一定！

english: Ah, [player name], I see you have decided to interfere once again. Commendable, but meaningless. You cannot stop what is to come. Death is all that awaits you if you try.
translation: 啊，[player name]，我看出你决定再次干预了。可嘉，但毫无意义。你无法阻止即将来临之事。你若尝试，等待你的唯有死亡。

english: You'll never have the satisfaction of killing me, Lucien. No matter what it takes, I'll make it my mission to stop you.
translation: 你永远别想享受杀死我的快感，卢西安。无论付出什么代价，我都会把阻止你作为我的使命。
