english: Such arrogance. Do you not realise who you address? I am Lord Lucien of the Mahjarrat, Master of the Thousand Curses. Look upon my works and despair!
translation: 如此狂妄。你难道不知道你在跟谁说话吗？我是玛哈加特的卢西安大人，千咒之主。看看我的杰作，然后绝望吧！

english: You can bestow as many titles upon yourself as you like, but before long, no one will even remember your name. You're just another monster, craving a power you'll never have.
translation: 你尽管给自己加封头衔，但用不了多久，没人会记得你的名字。你不过是又一个渴望永远得不到的力量的怪物。

english: Are you truly so misguided that you cannot see the truth before you? I hold both the Staff of Armadyl and the Stone of Jas!
translation: 你真的如此执迷不悟，连眼前的真相都看不见吗？我同时持有阿玛杜尔杖和贾斯之石！

english: Not since Zamorak himself has anyone possessed this much power! Nothing will stop me following in his footsteps!
translation: 自萨莫拉克本人以来，从未有人拥有过如此强大的力量！没有什么能阻止我追随他的脚步！

english: You think Zamorak will just stand by and let that happen?
translation: 你觉得萨莫拉克会袖手旁观，任由你这样做？

english: He doesn't have a choice. He no longer has any power here. His days are already done.
translation: 他别无选择。他在这里已经没有力量了。他的时代已经结束了。

english: Now, this conversation bores me. My ascension approaches, and I only have room for the strongest as my worshippers. Those too weak to slay even these lowly beasts will certainly not be wanted!
translation: 好了，这场谈话让我厌烦。我的飞升即将到来，我只为最强者留出位置作为我的信徒。那些弱到连这些低等野兽都杀不死的家伙，当然不会被需要！

english: Time for us to leave, Darve!
translation: 我们该走了，达尔夫！

english: We're with you, [player name]!
translation: 我们支持你，[player name]！

english: [player name], you must return to the temple below Lumbridge! Idria and her Guardians of Armadyl have already departed to support you!
translation: [player name]，你必须回到仑桥镇下方的神庙！伊德莉亚和她的阿玛杜尔守护者已经出发支援你了！

english: That was astounding, [player name]! Good work!
translation: 太惊人了，[player name]！干得好！

english: Blessed Armadyl, that was incredible! The Stone must have augmented your strengths. I've never seen anything like it!
translation: 神圣的阿玛杜尔，简直不可思议！一定是石头增强了你的力量。我从没见过这种事！

english: Now, we'd better get back to Falador. Do you want me to teleport you there?
translation: 好了，我们最好回到法拉多城。要我传送你过去吗？

english: No thanks. I'll make my own way back.
translation: 不用了，谢谢。我自己回去。

english: Very well. I'll see you back there.
translation: 很好。我会在那里等你回来。

english: You're back! Is everything okay?
translation: 你回来了！一切还好吗？

english: Not exactly. I'm sorry... I failed. Lucien has the Stone.
translation: 不太顺利。抱歉……我失败了。卢西安拿到了石头。

english: Then our worst fears have come to pass. The horrors that he could unleash with it...
translation: 那么我们最坏的担忧成真了。他能用它释放出多么可怕的恐怖啊……

english: That's something he'll never have a chance to do. Yes, this is a dark day, but I don't intend to give up, and I'm sure none of you do either.
translation: 他永远不会有这个机会。是的，这是黑暗的一天，但我不打算放弃，我相信你们也都不打算放弃。

english: But what do we do?
translation: 但我们该怎么做？

english: [player name], you've helped forge an alliance between the Temple Knights, Crux Eqal and the Guardians of Armadyl. Three very different groups, all fighting for the common good.
translation: [player name]，你帮助促成了圣殿骑士、克鲁克斯.埃卡尔和阿玛杜尔守护者之间的联盟。三个截然不同的团体，都在为共同的利益而战。

english: We must build on that. We will strengthen our forces, and find new allies to join our cause. When Lucien dares to rear his head again, we'll be ready.
translation: 我们必须在此基础上继续努力。我们会加强我们的力量，并寻找新的盟友加入我们的事业。当卢西安胆敢再次露面时，我们会做好准备。

english: Well said. When times are darkest, it is all the more important that we continue to look for the light. The Temple Knights stand ready.
translation: 说得好。在最黑暗的时刻，我们更要继续寻找光明。圣殿骑士团随时准备着。

english: As do we in Crux Eqal.
translation: 我们克鲁克斯.埃卡尔也是如此。

english: Rest, my friend. You have well and truly earned it. We will take things from here.
translation: 休息吧，我的朋友。你完全值得好好休息。这里由我们来处理。

english: Don't worry, [player name]. When the time is right, you'll be the first to know. I promise you, we will find Lucien. Together, we will stop him.
translation: 别担心，[player name]。时机成熟时，你会第一个知道。我向你保证，我们会找到卢西安。一起阻止他。

english: And the world will be safe once more.
translation: 世界将再次安全。

english: Hey, Idria. How are things here?
translation: 嘿，伊德莉亚。这里情况如何？

english: We're still trying to work out what Lucien's next move is, but so far everything has been quiet.
translation: 我们仍在试图弄清卢西安的下一步行动，但至今一切平静。

english: What do you think he's doing?
translation: 你觉得他在做什么？

english: It's hard to say. He has the Stone of Jas and the Staff of Armadyl now. That should give him everything he needs to follow in Zamorak's footsteps, but for whatever reason, he's chosen not to act yet.
translation: 很难说。他现在拥有贾斯之石和阿玛杜尔杖。这应该给了他追随萨莫拉克脚步所需的一切，但不知为何，他选择暂时不行动。

english: Not really at this point, but we'll be sure to let you know the moment he dares try anything. In the meantime, you might want to return to that temple beneath Lumbridge.
translation: 目前还没有，但他一旦胆敢行动，我们一定会通知你。与此同时，你或许可以回到仑桥镇地下的那个神殿。

english: It seems the magics Lucien used down there were far more than just a single summoning spell. The area has been permanently desecrated by those horrifying demons.
translation: 看来卢西安在那里使用的魔法远不止一个召唤法术。该区域已被那些可怕的恶魔永久玷污。

english: If you were looking for some way of keeping Lucien and his forces in check, killing a few of those demons wouldn't be a bad idea.
translation: 如果你想找办法牵制卢西安和他的势力，杀掉一些那些恶魔不失为一个好主意。

english: I might just do that. Thanks, Idria.
translation: 我可能会那么做。谢谢，伊德莉亚。

english: Saradomin be with you, [player name]. We have a lot to be grateful to you for.
translation: 萨拉多明与你同在，[player name]。我们有太多要感谢你的了。

english: Thanks, but I'm not sure I feel the same way. I wasn't able to stop Lucien.
translation: 谢谢，但我不确定我配得上。我没能阻止卢西安。

english: But you came very close and you lived to tell the tale. Lucien may have gained the upper hand, but he's not safe by any means.
translation: 但你差一点就成功了，并且活着讲述了这个故事。卢西安可能占了上风，但他绝不算安全。

english: He has people like you opposing him, not to mention an alliance between the Temple Knights, Crux Eqal and the Guardians of Armadyl!
translation: 他有像你这样的人反对他，更不用说圣殿骑士团、克鲁克斯.埃卡尔和阿玛杜尔守护者之间的联盟了！

english: You make a good point. Let's just hope it will be enough.
translation: 你说得对。只希望这足够了。

english: It will be, my friend.
translation: 会的，我的朋友。

english: Hello there, friend. I heard what happened with Lucien and the Stone. Don't worry, he'll pay for his crimes sooner or later.
translation: 你好，朋友。我听说卢西安和石头的事了。别担心，他迟早会为他的罪行付出代价。

english: I hope you're right, Silif.
translation: 希望你是对的，西利夫。

english: Have faith, friend. Evil never prospers for long.
translation: 要有信心，朋友。邪恶永远不会长久兴盛。

english: I lost those robes I was using as a disguise.
translation: 我弄丢了那些用来伪装的长袍。

english: Not to worry. I have them here for you.
translation: 别担心。我这里有给你准备的。

english: Until next time, friend.
translation: 下次再会，朋友。

english: How are you enjoying your cell, Surok?
translation: 苏罗克，你在这里牢房待得舒服吗？

english: You let me out of here! This isn't over...
translation: 你放我出去！这事没完……

english: It's nice to see a little justice around here!
translation: 很高兴看到这里还有一点正义！

english: Well... there's a story to that. You see, I should have an axe but-
translation: 嗯……这里面有故事。你看，我应该有一把斧头，但是——

english: Yes, and a good friend. Still, he would want us to be happy that he is now with his warrior brethren. Can I help you with anything else?
translation: 是的，而且是一位好朋友。不过，他会希望我们为他现在与他的战士兄弟们在一起而感到高兴。还有其他事需要帮忙吗？

english: About Lucien...
translation: 关于卢西安……

english: He will be made to pay, my friend, and I assure you, when the day of his reckoning comes, I will be there.
translation: 他会付出代价的，我的朋友，我向你保证，当他清算之日到来时，我会在那里。

english: So will I, Mazchna.
translation: 我也会去的，马斯纳。

english: Then we will fight, side by side, my friend. We will fight in honour of Turael and Duradel, and we will see them avenged!
translation: 那我们就会并肩作战，我的朋友。我们将为图拉尔和杜拉德尔而战，我们要看到他们复仇！

english: Have you got my ball back yet?
translation: 你拿回我的球了吗？

english: Well, it's in the shed in that garden.
translation: 嗯，在花园的那个棚子里。

english: Strange... I can't see any kind of lock or handle to open this door...
translation: 奇怪……我看不到任何锁或把手来打开这扇门……

english: Klarata... Sepptento... Valkan!
translation: 克拉拉塔... 塞普滕托... 瓦尔坎！

english: I'd better not go in there yet... I think I can hear someone inside!
translation: 我最好先别进去……我好像听到里面有人！

english: Hi, I have got your ball back. It was MUCH harder than I thought it would be.
translation: 嗨，我拿回了你的球。比我想象的难多了。

english: Thanks lady!
translation: 谢谢女士！

english: What could you want with an old woman like me?
translation: 你找我这样一个老太婆有什么事？

english: I am in search of a quest.
translation: 我在寻找一个任务。

english: Hmmm... Maybe I can think of something for you.
translation: 嗯...也许我能帮你想点什么。

english: Would you like to become more proficient in the dark arts?
translation: 你想在黑暗艺术上变得更精通吗？

english: Yes, help me become one with my darker side.
translation: 是的，帮我与我的黑暗面合为一体。

english: Okay, I'm going to make a potion to help bring out your darker self.
translation: 好的，我要制作一种药水来帮你引出你的黑暗面。

english: You will need certain ingredients.
translation: 你需要一些材料。

english: What do I need?
translation: 我需要什么？

english: You need an eye of newt, a rat's tail, an onion... Oh and a piece of burnt meat.
translation: 你需要一个蝾螈眼、一条鼠尾、一个洋葱...哦，还有一块烧焦的肉。

english: Great, I'll go and get them.
translation: 太好了，我去找它们。

english: No, I have my principles and honour.
translation: 不，我有我的原则和荣誉。

english: Suit yourself, but you're missing out.
translation: 随你便，但你会错过的。

english: I've heard that you are a witch.
translation: 我听说你是个女巫。

english: Yes it does seem to be getting fairly common knowledge.
translation: 是的，这似乎已经成了相当普遍的知识。

english: I fear I may be getting a visit from the witch hunters of Falador before long.
translation: 我担心不久后法拉多城的女巫猎人可能会来找我。

english: I've been looking for those ingredients.
translation: 我一直在找那些材料。

english: So what have you found so far?
translation: 那你到目前为止找到了什么？

english: I'm afraid I don't have any of them yet.
translation: 恐怕我一样都还没找到。

english: Well I can't make the potion without them! Remember... You need an eye of newt, a rat's tail, an onion, and a piece of burnt meat. Off you go dear!
translation: 没有它们我可做不了药水！记住...你需要一个蝾螈眼、一条鼠尾、一个洋葱和一块烧焦的肉。去吧，亲爱的！

english: I have the rat's tail (ewww), I don't have any burnt meat, I don't have an onion, and I don't have an eye of newt.
translation: 我有鼠尾（呃），我没有烧焦的肉，我没有洋葱，我也没有蝾螈眼。

english: I don't have a rat's tail, I have the burnt meat, I don't have an onion, and I don't have an eye of newt.
translation: 我没有鼠尾，我有烧焦的肉，我没有洋葱，我也没有蝾螈眼。

translation: 我没有鼠尾，我没有烧焦的肉，我有洋葱，我也没有蝾螈眼。

english: I don't have a rat's tail, I don't have any burnt meat, I don't have an onion, and I have the eye of newt, yum!
translation: 我没有鼠尾，我没有烧焦的肉，我没有洋葱，我有蝾螈眼，好吃！

translation: 我没有鼠尾，我有烧焦的肉，我有洋葱，我有蝾螈眼，好吃！

english: Great, but I'll need the other ingredients as well.
translation: 很好，但我还需要其他材料。

english: In fact I have everything!
translation: 事实上我全都有了！

english: Excellent, can I have them then?
translation: 太好了，那你能给我吗？

english: Well, is it ready?
translation: 嗯，准备好了吗？

english: Ok, now drink from the cauldron.
translation: 好了，现在从大锅里喝吧。

english: Well are you going to drink the potion or not?
translation: 你到底要不要喝药水？

english: Yes, improve your magic...
translation: 是的，提升你的魔法……

english: Do you have no sense of drama?
translation: 你就不能有点戏剧感吗？

english: I fear I may get a visit from the witch hunters of Falador before long.
translation: 我担心不久之后，法拉多城的女巫猎人就会找上门来。

english: Many aren't to start off with.
translation: 很多人一开始并不感兴趣。

english: But I think you'll be drawn back to this place.
translation: 但我觉得你最终会被吸引回这个地方的。

english: So have you found the things for the potion?
translation: 那么，你找到做药水的东西了吗？

english: Ok I'm going to make a potion to help bring out your darker self.
translation: 好了，我要制作一种药水，来帮助你释放你内心阴暗的一面。

english: You need an eye of newt, a rat's tail, and onion... Oh and a piece of burnt meat.
translation: 你需要一个蝾螈眼、一条鼠尾、一个洋葱……哦，还有一块烧焦的肉。

english: Yes, I will.
translation: 是的，我会的。

english: I'm here on a bit of a hunt. The hunt for treasure. Back in my home of Great Kourend, I came across a scroll. I believe it will lead me to something of great value.
translation: 我来这儿是为了进行一点狩猎。寻宝狩猎。在我的家乡大库兰德王国，我偶然发现了一张卷轴。我相信它会指引我找到非常有价值的东西。

english: Sounds good, what should I do?
translation: 听起来不错，我该怎么做？

english: First you should go and make some room in your inventory. Once you've done that, you can have a look at this scroll.
translation: 首先，你应该去清理一下背包腾出空间。完成后，你可以看看这张卷轴。

english: Take this scroll. It should lead you to the treasure I seek. Once you've found it, meet me at my ship. It's docked at the northernmost pier in Port Sarim.
translation: 拿着这张卷轴。它会指引你找到我寻找的宝藏。找到后，到我的船上见我。船停靠在沙林港最北边的码头。

english: Awesome. Anything else I should know?
translation: 太棒了。还有什么我需要知道的吗？

english: You'll probably want a spade, I find they're pretty much always needed when it comes to hunting treasure. Check the general store if you don't have one. If you need any extra help, just let me know.
translation: 你可能会需要一把铲子，我发现寻宝时几乎总是需要它。如果你没有，去杂货店看看。如果你需要任何额外的帮助，就告诉我。

english: Okay, thanks Veos.
translation: 好的，谢谢维奥斯。

english: Hmmm. Well now that you mention it, I could do with some help. The name's Veos. I'm a treasure hunter from the wonderous Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 嗯。好吧，既然你提到了，我确实需要一些帮助。我叫维奥斯。我是一名来自神奇的大库兰德王国的寻宝者。

english: Hello Veos. What brings you to Lumbridge?
translation: 你好，维奥斯。什么风把你吹到仑桥镇来了？

english: I'm here on a bit of a treasure hunt. Back in Kourend I came across a scroll. I believe it will lead me to something of great value.
translation: 我来这儿是为了进行一点寻宝游戏。在库兰德时，我偶然发现了一张卷轴。我相信它会指引我找到非常有价值的东西。

english: You'll probably want a spade, I find they're pretty much always needed when it comes to hunting treasure. Check the general store if you don't have one.
translation: 你可能会需要一把铲子，我发现寻宝时几乎总是需要它。如果你没有，去杂货店看看。

english: I'll be sticking around here a little longer before heading back to my ship. If you need extra guidance with anything, just let me know and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 我会在这里再待一会儿，然后回我的船。如果你需要任何额外指导，就告诉我，我会看看能帮上什么忙。

english: Ready to help with this treasure hunt?
translation: 准备好帮忙进行这次寻宝游戏了吗？

english: I came across this [scroll/orb]. Did you lose it by any chance?
translation: 我偶然发现了这个[scroll/orb]。你碰巧丢了它吗？

english: I did, thanks Veos.
translation: 是的，谢谢维奥斯。

english: Not to worry. Just try to be careful with it.
translation: 别担心。小心保管就好。

english: How's the treasure hunt going?
translation: 寻宝游戏进行得怎么样了？

english: This is the scroll I gave you. I don't know how to solve it I'm afraid. Maybe look for someone named Bob?
translation: 这是我给你的卷轴。恐怕我不知道怎么解开它。也许找个叫鲍勃的人？

english: Well keep at it. Once you've found the treasure, meet me at my ship. It's docked at the northernmost pier in Port Sarim.
translation: 继续努力吧。找到宝藏后，到我的船上见我。船停靠在沙林港最北边的码头。

english: Well keep at it. Once you've found the treasure, bring it to me.
translation: 继续努力吧。找到宝藏后，把它带给我。

english: Looks like a map to me. I'd assume the X marks where you need to go.
translation: 在我看来这像一张地图。我猜X标记了你要去的地方。

english: I could do with some extra help.
translation: 我需要一些额外帮助。

english: Interesting, these are quite rare. They work using temperature. The closer you are, the hotter the orb.
translation: 有趣，这些很稀有。它们利用温度工作。你离得越近，宝珠就越热。

english: Ah a cipher, I've seen these before. Try shifting the letters to the left or right. That normally works.
translation: 啊，密码，我以前见过。试着把字母向左或向右移动。通常这样就能解开。

english: Hmmmm... Must have been the wind.
translation: 嗯...一定是风。

english: Anyway, this must be the treasure that Veos is after. I should take it to him. If I remember right, he's docked at the northernmost pier in Port Sarim.
translation: 不管怎样，这一定是维奥斯在找的宝藏。我应该把它带给他。如果我没记错，他的船停靠在沙林港最北边的码头。

english: I don't think Veos would want me to open his treasure. I should take it to him. If I remember right, it's docked at the northernmost pier in Port Sarim.
translation: 我觉得维奥斯不会想让我打开他的宝藏。我应该把它带给他。如果我没记错，船停靠在沙林港最北边的码头。

english: I found the treasure!
translation: 我找到宝藏了！

english: Excellent. I'll take it off your hands now.
translation: 太好了。现在把它交给我吧。

english: Brilliant. This is just what I was looking for. Thank you so much for your help.
translation: 太棒了。这正是我要找的。非常感谢你的帮助。

english: No problem. So what is this treasure anyway?
translation: 不客气。话说这宝藏到底是什么？

english: Oh err... nothing important. Just something that might be of use to me back in Great Kourend.
translation: 哦呃...没什么重要的。只是些可能对我回大库兰德王国时有用的东西。

english: Anyway, as promised, a reward for you.
translation: 总之，按照承诺，这是给你的奖励。

english: Anyway, I'd best be getting back to Great Kourend. I'm sure I'll be back here before long though, there's always more treasure to be found.
translation: 总之，我最好回大库兰德王国了。不过我相信不久后我会再回来的，总有更多的宝藏等着被发现。

english: If you ever fancy visiting the kingdom, come find me here. I'm more than happy to take you there. Consider it an extra thank you for your help.
translation: 如果你想去那个王国看看，就来这里找我。我很乐意带你去。就当是对你帮助的额外感谢吧。

english: Sounds great, thanks Veos.
translation: 听起来不错，谢谢维奥斯。

english: Hello there, what's going on here?
translation: 你好，这儿发生什么事了？

english: Hey yous creature...wha's you's doing here? Yous be cleverer to be running so da sickies from da zogres don't dead ya.
translation: 嘿，你生物……你在这儿干啥？你最好聪明点，赶紧跑，免得那些佐格怪的病痛弄死你。

english: I'm just looking around thanks.
translation: 我只是到处看看，谢谢。

english: Yous creature won'ts see muchly in dis place...just da zogries coming wiv da sickies.
translation: 你生物在这儿看不到什么……只有那些佐格怪带着病痛过来。

english: What do you mean sickies?
translation: 你说的病痛是什么意思？

english: Da zogries comin wiv da sickies...yous get bashed by da zogries and get da sickies...den you gonna be like da zogries.
translation: 那些佐格怪带着病痛过来……你被佐格怪打了就会得病痛……然后你就会变得像佐格怪一样。

english: Sorry, I just don't understand...
translation: 抱歉，我真的听不懂……

english: Da sickies is when yous creature goes like orange till green and then goes 'Urggghhhh!'~ Grish imitates falling down with only the white of his eyes visible. ~
translation: 病痛就是你生物从橙子色变成绿色，然后‘呃啊啊啊啊！’——格里什模仿倒下，只露出眼白。——

english: What are Zogres?
translation: 佐格怪是什么？

english: Da Zogres are da bigun nasties wiv da sickies, deys old pals of Grish but deys jig in Jiggig when dey's full home is deep in da dirt, dey's is not da same dead'uns like was before.
translation: 佐格怪是那些带着病痛的大坏蛋，他们是格里什的老朋友，但他们住在吉吉格，老家在泥土深处，他们不像以前那样是死人了。

english: Sorry, yous creatures, but yous is too green behind da ears for dis job Grish finks.
translation: 对唔住，你们这些生物，但你们太嫩了，干不了这活儿，格里什觉得。

english: Yes you are!
translation: 你才太嫩！

english: Yes you are and that's final!
translation: 你确实太嫩，没得商量！

english: Yes creatures...yous does good fings for Grish and learn why Zogries at Jiggig and den get da Zogries back in da ground.
translation: 对，生物……你帮格里什做好事，搞清楚为什么佐格怪在吉吉格，然后让佐格怪回到地里。

english: Oh, so you want me to find out why the Zogres have appeared and then find a way of burying them?
translation: 哦，所以你想让我找出佐格怪出现的原因，然后想办法把它们埋回去？

english: Is what Grish says! But dis is da biggy danger fing yous creatures...yous be geddin' sickies most surely...yous needs be ready..wiv da foodies un da glug-glugs.
translation: 格里什就是这个意思！但这事儿对你们这些生物来说非常危险……你肯定会得病痛……你得准备好……带点吃的喝的。

english: Right, so you think there's a good chance that I can get ill from this, so I need to get some food and something to drink?
translation: 好吧，所以你觉得我很有可能因此生病，所以我需要带些食物和饮料？

english: Yea creatures, yous just say what Grish says...not know own wordies creature?
translation: 对，生物，你照格里什说的做就行……难道你生物不会自己说话吗？

english: Hmm, sorry, it sounds a bit too dangerous.
translation: 嗯，抱歉，听起来太危险了。

english: Yous creature is not a stoopid one...stays out of dere, like clever Grish. Yous can paint circles on chest and be da Shaman too!
translation: 你生物不傻……别去那儿，像聪明的格里什一样。你还可以在胸口画圈，当个萨满！

english: Hmm, is it too late to reconsider?
translation: 嗯，现在反悔还来得及吗？

english: Ok, I'll check things out then and report back.
translation: 好，那我去查查情况，再回来报告。

english: Is yous creatures really, really sure yous wanna do dis creatures..we's got no glug-glugs for da sickies? We's knows nuffin for da going of da sickies?
translation: 你生物真的、真的确定要这么做吗？我们可没有治病的酒水？我们也不知道怎么消除病痛？

english: Yes, I'm really sure!
translation: 是的，我真的很确定！

english: Dats da good fing yous creature...yous does Grish a good fing. But yous know dat yous get sickies and mebe get dead!
translation: 你生物做得很好……你帮了格里什一个大忙。但你知道你会得病痛，说不定还会死！

english: If that's your idea of a pep talk, I have to say that it leaves a lot to be desired.
translation: 如果这就是你所谓的打气话，那我得说，这差得远了。

english: Yous creatures is alus says funny stuff...speaks proper like Grish!
translation: 你们这些生物老说些怪话……要像格里什一样好好说话！

english: Der's yous go creatures...da best me's do for yous...and be back wivout da sickies.
translation: 给你，生物……这是我最好的东西了……你回来时别得病痛。

english: Hey yous creature's come back den?
translation: 嘿，你生物回来了？

english: Yes, I want to help you out and find out about the zogres.
translation: 是的，我想帮你，搞清楚佐格怪的事。

english: Yous creatures does da good fings for Grish and learn why Zogries at Jiggig and den get da Zogries back in da ground.
translation: 你生物帮格里什做好事，搞清楚为什么佐格怪在吉吉格，然后让佐格怪回到地里。

english: Yous creature dun da fing yet? Da zogries going in da dirt full home?
translation: 你介个生物干完那事儿了没？那些食人魔都回土里去了吗？

english: Nope, I haven't figured out why the zogres are here yet.
translation: 还没，我还没搞清楚佐格怪为什么会出现在这儿。

english: Yous needs ta stay away from dis place...yous get da sickies and mebe yous goes to dead if yous da unlucky fing.
translation: 你得离这地方远点……你会得病痛，运气不好可能就会死。

english: But Grish has asked me to look into this place and find out why all the undead ogres are here.
translation: 但格里什让我调查这个地方，找出为什么所有不死食人魔都在这儿。

english: Ok, dat is da big, big scary, danger fing! You's sure you's wants to go in?
translation: 好吧，这可是非常大、非常可怕的危险事！你真确定要进去吗？

english: Ok, I opens da stoppa's for yous creature.
translation: 好吧，我为你这个生物打开塞子。

english: Ok der' yous goes!
translation: 好了，给你打开了！

english: Raaarrrggghhh
translation: 嗷啊啊啊啊！

english: Urrrgggg.
translation: 呃啊啊。

english: Aarrrgghhh!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊！

english: Raarrrggggg! Yes!
translation: 嗷啊啊啊啊！太好了！

english: I found this tankard in the tomb, have you got any suggestions?
translation: 我在墓里找到了这个酒杯，你有什么建议吗？

english: Das a good drinker for da drinkies dat un is...is a small-un for Grish so yous creature keeps it yes. Yous creature keeps da fimble drinkers for da smaller drinkies.
translation: 那是个好喝东西的杯子……对格里什来说小了点，所以你生物留着吧。你生物留着这小杯子，喝小口的东西。

english: This torn page was on a lectern in the tomb, do you know why?
translation: 我在墓里的讲台上发现了这张被撕碎的书页，你知道为什么吗？

english: Dat's der wizzy stuff, not Ogery stuffsies like what Grish got. Das not even big enough for empty da big blower on! No use for Grish dat creatures...you's keeps it.
translation: 那是魔法师的东西，不是格里什这种食人魔的东西。连拿来放空那个大吹子都不够大！对格里什没用，生物……你留着吧。

english: Hey Grish, I found this in the tomb, do you know what it is?
translation: 嘿，格里什，我在墓里找到了这个，你知道是什么吗？

english: Whas you's shuvvin wizzy stuff in Grish face...is a pretty one but dat's more stuff for da wizzy's dan Grish.
translation: 你干嘛把魔法师的东西塞到格里什脸上……这东西挺漂亮，但那是给魔法师用的，不是给格里什的。

english: Hello there, I found this tankard in an ogre tomb cavern. It has the emblem of this Inn on it and I wondered if you knew anything about it?
translation: 你好，我在一个食人魔墓穴洞穴里发现了这个酒杯。上面有这个酒馆的徽章，我想知道你是否了解它？

english: Oh yes, this is Brentle's mug...I'm surprised he left it just lying around down some cave. He's quite protective of it.
translation: 哦，是的，这是布伦特尔的杯子……我还挺惊讶他会随便把它丢在某个洞穴里。他对这杯子挺宝贝的。

english: Brentle you say? So you knew him then?
translation: 你说布伦特尔？所以你认识他？

english: Yeah, this belongs to 'Brentle Vahn', he's quite a common customer, though I've not seen him in a while.
translation: 是的，这属于'布伦特尔.瓦恩'，他是一位相当常见的顾客，不过我有一阵子没见到他了。

english: He was talking to some shifty looking wizard the other day. I don't know his name, but I'd recognise him if I saw him.
translation: 他前几天在跟一个看起来很可疑的魔法师说话。我不知道那个魔法师的名字，但要是再见到他，我能认出来。

english: Hmm, I'm sorry to tell you this, but Brentle Vahn is dead - I believe he was murdered.
translation: 嗯，很抱歉告诉你，布伦特尔.范恩死了——我相信他是被谋杀的。

english: Noooo! I'm shocked...
translation: 不！我很震惊……

english: ...but not surprised. He was a good customer...but I knew he would sell his sword arm and do many a dark deed if paid enough.
translation: ……但并不惊讶。他是个好顾客……但我知道，只要给够钱，他会出卖他的剑臂，干下许多黑暗的勾当。

english: If you need help bringing the culprit to justice, you let me know.
translation: 如果你需要帮忙把凶手绳之以法，就告诉我。

english: Hello again. Can you tell me what you know about this tankard again please?
translation: 又见面了。你能再跟我说说你对这个酒杯知道什么吗？

english: Oh yes, Brentle's tankard. Yeah, you've shown me this already. It belonged to Brentle Vahn, he was quite a common customer, though I've not seen him in a while.
translation: 哦，是的，布伦特尔的酒杯。是啊，你已经给我看过了。它属于布伦特尔.瓦恩，他是一位相当常见的顾客，不过我有一阵子没见到他了。

english: Do you have any clue what this might be?
translation: 你知道这可能是什么吗？

english: Oooh, don't show me that sort of stuff, it's probably all magical and wizardy, probably turn me into a frog as soon as I look at it...
translation: 哦，别给我看那种东西，可能全是魔法和巫师的东西，说不定一看就会把我变成青蛙……

english: Hello there, I found this black prism, I wondered if you knew anything about it.
translation: 你好，我找到了这个黑色棱镜，我想知道你是否了解什么。

english: Hmmm, it's not really familiar to me, sorry I don't know what it's for, looks magical to me...maybe someone else in Yanille can help you?
translation: 嗯，我确实不太熟悉，抱歉我不知道这是干什么的，看起来挺魔法的……也许亚尼勒城有其他人能帮你？

english: Hey, what's this then, can you explain it?!
translation: 嘿，那这是什么，你能解释一下吗？！

english: Err..it looks sort of familiar, did you steal it from me? Come to think of it, you have the appearance of a common thief!
translation: 呃……看起来有点眼熟，你是从我这儿偷的吗？想想看，你看起来就像个普通盗贼！

english: I found it in a place called Jiggig where some undead ogres happen to be wandering around.
translation: 我在一个叫吉吉格的地方找到的，那儿有些不死食人魔在游荡。

english: Oh, nothing to do with me then, never seen it in my life before!
translation: 哦，那跟我没关系，我这辈子从没见过！

english: Have you ever seen anything like this before?
translation: 你以前见过这种东西吗？

english: It's probably a piece of rubbish someone threw away...what does it say, I can't read it?
translation: 这大概是某人扔掉的垃圾……上面写了什么，我看不懂？

english: You should be able to read it, it's been torn from a book on necromancy and you're meant to be a specialist in the subject.
translation: 你应该能看懂，这是从一本死灵术书上撕下来的，而且你应该是这方面的专家。

english: Oh, no..., not really a specialist, just a hobby of mine really. Hardly know anything about it, but it does seem interesting...
translation: 哦，不……算不上专家，其实只是我的爱好。我几乎一无所知，但确实看起来很有趣……

english: What about this then? Guess where I found this?
translation: 那这个呢？猜猜我在哪找到的？

english: You probably found it at the local brewhouse! It doesn't take a genius to figure that one out.
translation: 你大概是在本地的啤酒厂找到的！这不用天才也能猜到。

english: Aha! But I found this in an old ogre tomb! I suspect it's a clue which will lead me to the suspect.
translation: 啊哈！但我是在一个古老的食人魔墓里找到的！我怀疑这是个线索，能帮我找到嫌疑人。

english: Hmmm, well that eliminates all the local people who don't actually drink at the 'Dragon Inn'. When do you think you'll start questioning the remaining population of Yanille?
translation: 嗯，那就排除了所有不在‘龙客栈’喝酒的本地人。你打算什么时候开始盘问剩下的亚尼勒城居民？

english: Hey! What do you think you're doing?
translation: 嘿！你以为你在干什么？

english: Erk! I'd better not start rifling through peoples things without permission.
translation: 呃！我还是别没得到允许就翻别人的东西了。

english: There's some undead ogre activity over at 'Jiggig', and the ogres have asked me to look into it. I think I've found a clue and I wonder if you could take a look at it for me?
translation: 在‘吉吉格’那边有些不死食人魔的活动，食人魔让我去调查一下。我想我找到了一个线索，你能帮我看一下吗？

english: Hmmm, well this is an uncommon spell component. On its own it's useless, but with certain necromantic spells it can be very powerful. Did you find anything else there?
translation: 嗯，这是一个不常见的法术组件。单独使用没用，但配合某些死灵法术可以变得非常强大。你在那儿还找到别的了吗？

english: Well, I found this...
translation: 嗯，我找到了这个……

english: Hmmm, no, that's not really associated with this to be honest. Did you find anything else there?
translation: 嗯，不，实话实说，那跟这个没什么关系。你在那儿还找到别的了吗？

english: I don't know what to say then, there isn't enough to go on with the clues you've shown me so far. I'd suggest going back to search a bit more, but you may just be wasting your time?
translation: 那我也不知道该说什么了，仅凭你到目前为止给我看的线索，信息还不够。我建议你回去再搜一搜，但你可能只是在浪费时间？

english: Hmm, but this prism does seem to have some magical protection. Once you've finished with this item, bring it back to me would you? I may have a reward for you!
translation: 嗯，但这个棱镜似乎有些魔法保护。你用完之后，能把它带回来给我吗？我可能给你一个奖励！

english: Sure...I mean, I'll try if I remember.
translation: 当然……我是说，如果我还记得的话我会试试。

english: There's some undead ogre activity over at Jiggig, I've found a clue that you may be able to help with.
translation: 在吉吉格那边有些不死食人魔的活动，我找到了一个线索，你可能能帮上忙。

english: Hmm, this is a half torn spell page, it requires another spell component to be effective. Did you find anything else there?
translation: 嗯，这是一张半撕开的咒语书页，需要另一个法术组件才能生效。你在那儿还找到别的了吗？

english: There's some undead ogre activity over at Jiggig, I've found some clues, I wondered if you'd have a look at them.
translation: 在吉吉格那边有些不死食人魔的活动，我找到了一些线索，你能看看吗？

english: Hmmm, now this is interesting! Where did you get these from?
translation: 嗯，这下有意思了！你从哪弄来的？

english: I got them from a nearby Ogre tomb, it's recently been infested with zombie ogres and I'm trying to work out what happened there.
translation: 我从附近的一个食人魔墓里找到的，最近那儿充满了僵尸食人魔，我正在调查发生了什么。

english: This is very troubling [player name], very troubling indeed. While it's permitted for learned members of our order to research the 'dark arts', it's absolutely forbidden to make use of such magic.
translation: 这非常令人担忧，[player name]，确实非常令人担忧。虽然我们学会的学者被允许研究‘黑暗艺术’，但绝对禁止实际使用这种魔法。

english: Do you have any leads on people that I might talk to regarding this?
translation: 你有没有什么线索，关于我可以跟谁谈谈这件事？

english: Well a wizard by the name of 'Sithik Ints' was doing some research in this area. He may know something about it. He's lodged at that guest house to the North, though he's ill and isn't able to leave his room.
translation: 嗯，有个叫‘西希克.因茨’的魔法师在这一带做研究。他可能知道点什么。他住在北边的那家旅馆里，不过他生病了，没法离开房间。

english: Why not go and talk to him, poke around a bit and see if anything comes up. Let me know how you get on. However, I doubt that 'Sithik' had anything to do with it.
translation: 你何不去跟他谈谈，稍微探探口风，看看有没有什么发现。告诉我你的进展。不过，我怀疑‘西希克’跟这事没关系。

english: Hmm, that black prism seems to have some magical protection. Once you've finished with this item, bring it back to me would you. I may have a reward for you.
translation: 嗯，那个黑色棱镜似乎有些魔法保护。你用完之后，把它带回来给我好吗？我可能给你一个奖励。

english: I found this black prism at Jiggig where the undead ogre activity was happening?
translation: 我在吉吉格那个不死食人魔活动的地方找到了这个黑色棱镜？

english: Yes, you've already showed me that, bring it to me when you've resolved the problems at Jiggig and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 是的，你已经给我看过了，等你解决了吉吉格的问题就带给我，我看看能做什么。

english: I think I've found a clue from the Jiggig area where the undead ogre activity is happening.
translation: 我想我在吉吉格地区找到了一个线索，那儿有不死食人魔的活动。

english: I don't know what to say then really, there isn't enough to go on here as it is. I'd suggest going back to search a bit more, but you may just be wasting your time.
translation: 那我真的不知道该说什么了，目前的信息确实不够。我建议你回去再搜一搜，但你可能只是在浪费时间。

english: Hey...who gave you permission to come in here!
translation: 嘿……谁允许你进来的！

english: Zavistic Rarve said that I could come and talk to you and ask you a few questions.
translation: 扎维斯蒂克.拉尔夫说我可以来跟你谈谈，问你几个问题。

english: Oh, Zavistic...why...why would he send you to me?
translation: 哦，扎维斯蒂克……为什么……他为什么要派你来找我？

english: Do you know anything about the undead ogres at Jiggig?
translation: 你知不知道吉吉格的那些亡灵食人魔？

english: Er...undead ogres...no, sorry, no idea what you're talking about there.
translation: 呃……亡灵食人魔……不，抱歉，我不知道你在说什么。

english: Hmm, is that right...
translation: 哼，是那样吗……

english: Well, yes, yes it is. If I knew something, I'd tell you.
translation: 嗯，没错，没错。如果我知道什么，我会告诉你的。

english: Anyway, dead ogres you say? How strange? That must be a strange sight?
translation: 话说回来，你说死掉的食人魔？多么奇怪？那一定是个奇怪的景象吧？

english: Very well, if you don't know anything about it, you won't mind if I look around then?
translation: 很好，如果你对此一无所知，那你不介意我四处看看吧？

english: I'm a scholarly student of the magical arts. When I was younger I used to be an adventurer, probably just like yourself. But I lost interest in the constant fighting, looting and gaining abilities.
translation: 我是一位钻研魔法艺术的学者学生。年轻时我曾是个冒险者，大概和你一样。但我对不断的战斗、掠夺和提升能力失去了兴趣。

english: Instead I decided to focus my attention and time to study the purer form of the lost arts.
translation: 于是我决定将注意力和时间投入到研究失传技艺的更纯粹形式上。

english: The lost arts? What are they?
translation: 失传技艺？那是什么？

english: Ignorant people call them the 'dark arts'. I'm talking about Necromancy, the power to bring the dead back to life - the power of the gods! Surely the most awesome power known to man.
translation: 无知的人称之为'黑暗技艺'。我说的是死灵法术，让死者复活的力量——神的力量！无疑是人类所知最可怕的力量。

english: Hmm, well I guess I must be an ignorant person then, because bringing the dead back to life sounds very unnatural.
translation: 哼，那我大概就是个无知的人吧，因为让死者复活听起来非常不自然。

english: Do you mind if I look around?
translation: 你介不介意我四处看看？

english: Well, err....well, actually yes I do mind...it's my place and I don't want strangers going through my things.
translation: 嗯，呃……嗯，其实我介意……这是我的地方，我不想让陌生人翻我的东西。

english: Well, I'm going to have a look around anyway, if you're not involved in this whole thing, you won't have anything to hide.
translation: 嗯，反正我还是要到处看看，如果你没参与整件事，你也没什么好藏的。

english: Why, if I was a few years younger I'd give you a good hiding!
translation: 哼，如果我年轻几岁，我会好好揍你一顿！

english: I'm sure!
translation: 我信！

english: I've already told you that I do! But you'll probably just ignore me again!
translation: 我已经告诉过你我在意了！但你大概又会无视我！

english: Quite right!
translation: 说得对！

english: Hmmm, Sithik must really hate monsters then, I wonder if he hates ogres in particular?
translation: 嗯，那西锡克一定很恨怪物，我在想他是不是特别恨食人魔？

english: What's this then?
translation: 那这是什么？

english: What do you mean? It's a book by the respected HAM leader Johanhus Ulsbrecht, that man speaks for a lot of people who are unhappy with the current state of affairs.
translation: 你什么意思？这是受人尊敬的HAM领袖约翰胡斯.乌尔斯布雷希特写的一本书，那个人代表了很多对现状不满的人。

english: Can you honestly tell me that you've not had to fight for your life against the odd monster or two?
translation: 你能老实告诉我你从来没有为了保命而和怪物战斗过吗？

english: Hmm, that may be true, but I don't universally hate all monsters, whereas I have a sneaking suspicion that you do...and ogres in particular!
translation: 嗯，那也许没错，但我并非憎恨所有怪物，而我隐隐怀疑你恨……而且特别恨食人魔！

english: Hmm, that's an interesting theory, care to back it up with any facts?
translation: 哼，有个有趣的理论，能拿出什么事实来支持吗？

english: Aha! A necromantic book! What's this doing here then?
translation: 啊哈！一本死灵法术书！那这是什么意思？

english: Oh..I'm not quite sure actually...where did you find that then?
translation: 哦……我其实不太确定……你在哪儿找到的？

english: I found it in this cupboard! What do you have to say for yourself?
translation: 我在这个橱柜里找到的！你还有什么好说的？

english: Oh yes, that's right...I remember now. It's for my research, there's nothing really dangerous about it, unless it falls into the wrong hands. I'm sure it's pretty safe with me.
translation: 哦对，没错……我现在想起来了。这是我研究用的，其实没什么危险，除非落入坏人手里。我相信放在我这里很安全。

english: Hmmm, likely story!
translation: 哼，说得像真的一样！

english: Oh, so explain this then?
translation: 哦，那这个你怎么解释？

english: It's my hobby...I'm interested in portraiture, but all art in general. It's fun, you should try it.
translation: 这是我的爱好……我对肖像画感兴趣，不过广义上所有艺术都喜欢。很有趣，你应该试试。

english: How do I do it...
translation: 我要怎么做……

english: Well...you could start by reading the book!
translation: 嗯……你可以从读这本书开始！

english: Oh lovely! You're making my portrait! Let me see it afterwards!
translation: 哦太好了！你在画我的肖像！画完给我看看！

english: Here you go, what do you think?
translation: 给你，你觉得怎么样？

english: Hmmm, well it's an interesting interpretation, but not really classic realist representation is it? It's not my favourite, but I like the 'truth' of the work...well done.
translation: 嗯，这是一个有趣的诠释，但算不上经典写实表现手法，对吧？这不是我最喜欢的，但我喜欢作品中的'真实'……画得好。

english: Hmmm, well it's not the most flattering of portraits, but I like the 'honesty' of the work...well done.
translation: 嗯，这不是最讨喜的肖像，但我喜欢作品中的'诚实'……画得好。

english: Look, I made a portrait of Sithik.
translation: 看，我画了西锡克的肖像。

english: Who the demonikin is that? Is it meant to be a portrait of Sithik, it doesn't look anything like him!
translation: 那是什么鬼东西？这是西锡克的肖像？一点也不像他！

english: Hmm, great...but I already know what he looks like!
translation: 哼，很好……但我已经知道他长什么样了！

english: Who's that? I mean, I guess it's a picture of a person isn't it? Sorry...you've got me? And before you ask, you're not putting it up on my wall!
translation: 那是谁？我是说，我猜这是一张人的画吧？抱歉……难倒我了？而且别想把它挂在我墙上！

english: It's a portrait of Sithik Ints...don't you recognise him?
translation: 这是西锡克.因茨的肖像……你不认识他吗？

english: I'm sorry, I really am, but I just don't see it...can you make a better picture?
translation: 我很抱歉，真的，但我就是看不出来……你能画一张更好的吗？

english: Yeah, that's the guy who was talking to Brentle Vahn the other day! Look at those eyes, never a more shifty looking pair will you ever see!
translation: 对，就是那天和布伦特尔.范说话的那家伙！看那双眼睛，你再也找不到更贼溜溜的一双了！

english: Hmm, you've just identified the man who I think sent Brentle Vahn to his death.
translation: 哼，你刚指认了我认为是派人害死布伦特尔.范的那个人。

english: I'm trying to bring him to justice with the Wizards' Guild grand secretary. Do you think you could sign this portrait to say that he was talking to Brentle Vahn.
translation: 我正在试图和巫师公会的秘书长一起将他绳之以法。你能在这幅肖像上签字，证明他和布伦特尔.范说过话吗？

english: I can and I will!
translation: 我能，而且我会的！

english: Many thanks for your help, it's really very good of you.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助，你真是太好了。

english: Not at all, just doing my part.
translation: 不客气，只是尽我的一份力。

english: Hey, what do you think of this? I'm going to show it to Zavistic and you're going to be in trouble!
translation: 嘿，你觉得这个怎么样？我要把它拿给扎维斯蒂克看，你麻烦大了！

english: Hmmm, well, I've got quite a common looking face, I'm often mistaken for other wizards, you know, when I'm wearing my wizard's hat, robes and staff. There's a lot of us around here you know.
translation: 嗯，我的脸长得很普通，经常被误认成其他巫师，你知道，当我戴着巫师帽、穿着袍子、拿着法杖的时候。这里有很多巫师你知道的。

english: I don't think so! This is a signed picture of you, someone recognised you, you're in deep trouble!
translation: 我不信！这是有签名的你的画像，有人认出你了，你麻烦大了！

english: Ok, I'll pay you to keep this secret - how much do you want for the picture?
translation: 好吧，我给你钱让你保密——这张画你要多少钱？

english: You can't buy me Sithik!
translation: 你收买不了我，西锡克！

english: Ok, let's say two million...two million to keep quiet and give me the picture.
translation: 好吧，就两百万……两百万，你闭嘴然后把画给我。

english: Oh...erm...well, that is a lot of money actually...er....
translation: 哦……呃……嗯，那确实是很多钱……呃……

english: Yes, and you deserve it, you're very clever! Now, take the money...
translation: 对，你应得的，你很聪明！现在，拿钱吧……

english: No, I won't take the money, I'm going to bring you to justice!
translation: 不，我不会拿钱的，我要将你绳之以法！

english: Oh well, suit yourself! I wasn't going to give you the money anyway! No one will believe some crazy adventurer and an Inn keep.
translation: 哦好吧，随你便！反正我也没打算给你钱！没人会相信一个疯冒险者和一个酒馆老板的。

english: Ok, I'll shut up for two million!
translation: 好吧，两百万我就闭嘴！

english: Ha! Ha! You believed me! I'm not going to give you all my money! No one will believe a crazy adventurer and a local Inn keep!
translation: 哈哈！你居然信了！我才不会把所有钱都给你呢！没人会相信一个疯冒险者和一个本地酒馆老板的！

english: You're a mean and cruel man Sithik, a mean and cruel man!
translation: 你是个刻薄残忍的人，西锡克，刻薄残忍的人！

english: What did you say I should do?
translation: 你说我应该做什么来着？

english: You should go and have a chat with Sithik Ints, he's in that house just to the north. He's a lodger and has a room upstairs. Just tell him that I sent you to see him. He should be fine once you've mentioned my name.
translation: 你应该去和西锡克.因茨谈谈，他就在北边那栋房子里。他是个房客，楼上有个房间。就告诉他是我派你去找他的。一旦你提起我的名字，他就会没事的。

english: Where is Sithik?
translation: 西锡克在哪？

english: He's in that house just to the north, less than a few seconds walk away. He's a lodger and has a room upstairs...he's not very well though.
translation: 他在北边那栋房子里，走几步就到。他是个房客，楼上有个房间……不过他身体不太好。

english: I have an item that I'd like you to look at.
translation: 我有件东西想请你看看。

english: I have some items that I'd like you to look at.
translation: 我有几件东西想请你看看。

english: I have this necromancy book as evidence that Sithik is involved with the undead ogres at Jiggig.
translation: 我有这本死灵法术书作为证据，证明西锡克和吉吉格的亡灵食人魔有关。

english: Yeah, you've shown me this before...if this is all the evidence you have?
translation: 是啊，你之前给我看过这个了……如果你只有这些证据的话？

english: Please just look at it again...
translation: 请再看看吧……

english: Ok, let me look then.
translation: 好吧，那让我看看。

english: Ok, so he's researching necromancy...it doesn't mean anything in itself.
translation: 好吧，他是在研究死灵法术……这本身并不能说明什么。

english: Yes, but if you look, you can see that there is a half torn page which matches the page I found at Jiggig.
translation: 是的，但如果你仔细看，你会发现有一张被撕碎的书页，和我之前在吉吉格找到的那页是吻合的。

english: Hmm, yes, but someone could have stolen that from him and then gone and cast it without his permission or to try and deliberately implicate him.
translation: 嗯，是的，但可能有人从他那里偷了这页，然后未经他允许就施法，或者故意陷害他。

english: Look, this book proves that Sithik hates all monsters and most likely Ogres with a passion.
translation: 你看，这本书证明西锡克憎恨所有怪物，而且很可能特别痛恨食人魔。

english: So what, hating monsters isn't a crime in itself...although I suppose that it does give a motive if Sithik was involved. On its own, it's not enough evidence though.
translation: 那又怎样，憎恨怪物本身不是犯罪……虽然我猜如果西锡克涉案，这确实提供了动机。但单凭这个，证据还不够。

english: This is the tankard I found on the remains of Brentle Vahn!
translation: 这是我在布伦特尔.范的遗骸上找到的酒杯！

english: That doesn't mean anything in itself, you could have gotten that from anywhere. Even from the Dragon Inn tavern! There isn't anything to link Brentle Vahn with Sithik Ints.
translation: 这本身不能说明什么，你可能从任何地方搞到的。甚至从龙吟酒馆！没有任何东西能把布伦特尔.范和西锡克.因茨联系起来。

english: This is a portrait of Sithik, signed by the landlord of the Dragon Inn saying that he saw Sithik and Brentle Vahn together.
translation: 这是一幅西锡克的肖像，由龙吟酒馆的老板签名，证明他看到西锡克和布伦特尔.范在一起。

english: Hmmm, well that is interesting.
translation: 嗯，那倒是有意思。

english: However, there isn't enough evidence for me to take the issue further at this point. If you find any further evidence bring it to me.
translation: 不过，目前证据不足以让我进一步处理此事。如果你找到更多证据，拿来给我。

english: And I'm starting to think that Sithik may be involved. Here, take this potion and give some to Sithik. It'll bring on a change which should solicit some answers - tell him the effects won't revert until he's told the truth.
translation: 而且我开始觉得西锡克可能涉案了。拿着这瓶药水，给西锡克用一些。它会引发一种变化，应该能撬出一些答案——告诉他效果不会消退，直到他说出真相。

english: Have you used that potion yet?
translation: 你用了那瓶药水了吗？

english: Well, actually, I've lost it, could I have another one please?
translation: 嗯，其实我弄丢了，能再给我一瓶吗？

english: Sure, but don't lose it this time.
translation: 当然，这次别再弄丢了。

english: No, not yet, what was I supposed to do again?
translation: 不，还没，我该做什么来着？

english: Try to use the potion on Sithik somehow, he should undergo an interesting transformation, though you'll probably want to leave the house in case there are any side effects. Then go back and question Sithik and tell
translation: 试着想办法把药水用在西锡克.因茨身上，他应该会经历一个有趣的转变，不过你最好离开房子，以防有什么副作用。然后回去质问西锡克.因茨并告诉他。

english: him the effects won't wear off until he tells the truth. In fact, that's not exactly true, but I'm sure it'll be an extra incentive to get him to be honest.
translation: 他效果不会消退直到他说出真相。其实这并不完全正确，但我相信这会成为他坦白的一个额外动力。

english: Hey there's no need to be rude!
translation: 嘿，没必要这么粗鲁！

english: What do you expect when you just go snooping around a person's place against their express permission.
translation: 当你未经别人明确允许就在人家地盘上乱翻时，你还能期望什么？

english: Why do you spend most of your time in bed?
translation: 你为什么大部分时间都待在床上？

english: I'm actually quite old and not so very well and I'd like to get over this illness I have, then I'll return to my very serious and important studies.
translation: 其实我年纪很大了，身体也不太好，我想先治好我的病，然后回到我非常重要且严肃的研究中去。

english: Here, try some of this potion, it'll make you feel better!
translation: 来，试试这瓶药水，会让你感觉好点的！

english: Err, yuck....no way am I taking any potions or medication off you...I don't trust you!
translation: 呃，恶心……我才不会从你这里拿任何药水或药物呢……我不信任你！

english: Arghhhh..what's happened to me...you beast!
translation: 啊啊啊啊……我怎么了……你这野兽！

english: It's your own fault, you shouldn't have lied about your involvement with the undead Ogres at Jiggig. The potion will wear off once you've told the truth!
translation: 这是你自己的错，你不该谎称自己和吉吉格的亡灵食人魔无关。一旦你说出真相，药水就会失效！

english: Ok, ok, I admit it, I got Brentle Vahn to cast the spell to put an end to those awful Ogres...they're just disgusting creatures...
translation: 好吧好吧，我承认，是我让布伦特尔.范施法来消灭那些可恶的食人魔……它们就是令人作呕的生物……

english: Ok, that's a start...now I want some answers.
translation: 好吧，这是个开始……现在我要一些答案。

english: How do I remove the effects of the spell from the area? The ogres want to get their ceremonial dance area back and can't do that with undead walking all over it.
translation: 我要怎么移除这个区域的法术效果？食人魔想拿回他们的仪式舞蹈区，但到处都是亡灵走来走去，根本没法用。

english: Unfortunately you can't. The spell is permanent, it will last forever, the only option you have is to move the ceremonial area.
translation: 很不幸，你做不到。这个法术是永久性的，会永远持续下去，你唯一的选择就是搬走仪式区。

english: You're an evil man and I'm going to make you pay for this...you can stay like that forever as far as I'm concerned.
translation: 你真是个邪恶的人，我会让你付出代价的……在我看来，你就永远保持这样吧。

english: No...no, let me try to make amends...please I can help you. Just don't leave me like this.
translation: 不……不，让我试着弥补吧……求你了，我能帮你。别把我丢在这里不管。

english: Haven't I told you this already? You can't remove the spell, it's permanent, it will last forever, the only option you have is to move the ceremonial area.
translation: 我不是已经告诉过你了吗？你无法移除这个法术，它是永久性的，会永远持续下去，你唯一的选择就是搬走仪式区。

english: Ok, similar spells have been cast before and the only way to deal with the resulting creatures is to cordon off the area and not go in there again.
translation: 好吧，以前也有人施放过类似的法术，对付那些生物的唯一办法就是封锁该区域，别再进去了。

english: The undead creatures usually manifest some sort of disease so it's best to attack them from a distance with a ranged weapon.
translation: 亡灵生物通常会携带某种疾病，所以最好用远程武器从远处攻击它们。

english: From my research it looks like a flat ended arrow was designed called a 'Brutal arrow'. This does large amounts of crushing damage to the creature. You can make them by using larger arrows.
translation: 根据我的研究，有一种平头箭被设计出来，叫做'残酷箭'。这种箭能对生物造成大量碾压伤害。你可以用更大的箭来制作它们。

english: I think some Ogre hunters make them. But instead of adding an arrow tip, you hammer a large nail into the end of the shaft.
translation: 我想是一些食人魔猎手制作的。但他们不是装上箭头，而是在箭杆末端钉上一根大钉子。

english: Just tell me again or else I'll never turn you back into a human!
translation: 再跟我说一遍，否则我永远不会把你变回人类！

english: Just tell me again or I'll turn you back into an ogre.
translation: 再跟我说一遍，否则我就把你变回食人魔。

english: But...you can't just leave me here like this!
translation: 但是……你不能就这样把我丢在这里！

english: Arghhhh..what do you want now...you've turned me into a beast!
translation: 啊……你现在还想怎样……你把我变成了野兽！

english: I've got some questions for you...and you'd better answer them well or else!
translation: 我有几个问题要问你……你最好好好回答，否则后果自负！

english: Ok, ok, I'll tell you anything, just turn me back into a human again!
translation: 好好好，我什么都告诉你，快把我变回人类吧！

english: Don't you worry about Sithik, he's not likely to be moving from his bed for a long time. When he eventually does get better, he's going to be sent before a disciplinary tribunal, then we'll sort out what's what.
translation: 别担心西提克，他短时间内是下不了床了。等他最终好起来，会被送到纪律法庭受审，到时候我们就能把事情理清楚了。

english: Thanks for your help with all of this.
translation: 谢谢你在这件事上帮的忙。

english: Ooohh, no thanks required. It's I who should be thanking you my friend...your investigative mind has shown how vigilant we really should be for this type of evil use of the magical arts.
translation: 噢，不用谢。应该是我感谢你才对，我的朋友……你敏锐的调查头脑向我们展示了，对于这种邪恶使用魔法技艺的行为，我们确实应该保持警惕。

english: Yous creature dun da fing yet? Da zogries going in da ground?
translation: 你，生物，事情办好了没？那些佐格怪都埋进地里了吗？

english: I found who's responsible for the Zogres being here.
translation: 我找到了让佐格怪出现在这里的罪魁祸首。

english: Where is da creature? Me's wants to squeeze him till he's a deadun...
translation: 那个生物在哪？俺要把他捏死，捏成个死鬼……

english: The person responsible is a wizard named 'Sithik Ints' and he's going to be in serious trouble. He told me that the spell which raised the zogres from the ground will last forever.
translation: 罪魁祸首是一个叫'西提克.因茨'的魔法师，他麻烦大了。他告诉我，那个把佐格怪从地里召唤出来的法术会永远持续下去。

english: I'm sorry to say, but you'll have to move the site of your ceremonial dancing somewhere else.
translation: 很遗憾，你们得把仪式舞蹈的地点搬到别处去了。

english: Dat is da bad fing creature...we's needs new Jiggig for da fallin' down jig.
translation: 这可糟了，生物……俺们得找个新吉吉格来跳'倒栽葱舞'。

english: Yes, that's right, you'll need to create a new ceremonial dance area.
translation: 是的，没错，你们需要创建一个新的仪式舞蹈区。

english: Urghhh...not good fing creature, yous gotta get da ogrish old fings for da making new jiggig special. You's creature needs da key for getting in da low bury place.
translation: 呃……不好办啊，生物，你得弄到食人魔的古老物件，才能用特殊方式做出新吉吉格。你，生物，需要一把钥匙才能进那个低埋之地。

english: Oh, so you want me to go back in there and look for something for you?
translation: 哦，所以你想让我再进去一趟，帮你找点东西？

english: Yeah creature, yous gotta get da ogrish old fings for da making new jiggig and proper in da special way.
translation: 是啊，生物，你得弄到食人魔的古老物件，才能用特殊方式做出个像样的新吉吉格。

english: Sithik told me how to make Brutal arrows which means I can kill these zogres from a distance!
translation: 西提克告诉我怎么做残酷箭，这样我就能从远处杀死这些佐格怪了！

english: Uhggh, whas you's sayin' creature? Yous speakies too stupid for Grish...
translation: 呃，你，生物，说啥呢？你说的话太蠢了，格里什听不懂……

english: I know how to make large arrows...you know, 'big stabbers', to kill the zogres...they're bigger and apparently do a lot of damage, only thing is, the normal ogre bow I need to fire it is quite slow.
translation: 我知道怎么做大箭了……就是那种'大扎子'，用来杀佐格怪……它们更大，显然伤害也高，只不过，我用来射箭的普通食人魔弓相当慢。

english: Why you's not say so creature...me's shows you how to make da bigger stabber chucker...~ Grish gets a couple of items out of his back pack.~
translation: 你咋不早说呢，生物……俺来教你怎么做更大的扎子发射器……~格里什从背包里拿出几样东西。~

english: De're creature...now yous is makin' da bigga stabber chucker...
translation: 给你，生物……现在你会做更大的扎子发射器了……

english: Thanks! I think....
translation: 谢谢！我想是吧……

english: I also found out that the disease can be cured.
translation: 我还发现这种病是可以治好的。

english: Dat's da good fing creature, yous do good fing to give un to Uglug...he gives bright pretties for da sickies glug glug..
translation: 那是好事啊，生物，你做好事把药给乌格鲁格……他会给你亮闪闪的好东西，换那个治病的咕噜咕噜药水……

english: Yous creature got da old fings yet?
translation: 你，生物，拿到古老物件了吗？

english: I've lost the key you gave me!
translation: 我弄丢了你给我的钥匙！

english: Yous stupid creatures....luckily Grish has 'nother one..
translation: 你们这些蠢生物……幸好格里什还有一把……

english: Yous creatures doesn't loosing this ones.
translation: 你们这些生物可别再弄丢这把了。

english: Yous gets 'em quick tho, cos we'ze wonna do da new Jiggig place...
translation: 不过你得快点拿到，因为俺们想快点弄好新吉吉格的地方……

english: There must be an easier way to kill these zogres!
translation: 肯定有更简单的方法来杀这些佐格怪！

english: There must be a way to cure this disease!
translation: 肯定有办法治好这种病！

english: Did yous creature makes da sickies glug glug and putin some wiv Uglug for bright pretties? He's goodun for makin' da glug glugs...yous maken da glug-glug, den sellin' one for Uglug, he's makin' more of da sickies glug
translation: 你，生物，做了治病的咕噜咕噜药水，还拿了一些给乌格鲁格换亮闪闪的好东西了吗？他可是做咕噜咕噜药水的好手……你做好咕噜咕噜药水，然后卖给乌格鲁格一瓶，他会做出更多治病的咕噜药水……

english: glug and sellin' for bright pretties to yous creature...
translation: 然后咕噜咕噜地卖给你，生物，换亮闪闪的好东西……

english: Hey, you's creature got da old fings?
translation: 嘿，你，生物，拿到古老物件了吗？

english: No sorry, I don't have them yet.
translation: 不，抱歉，我还没拿到。

english: Yous creatures get dem for me soon doh, yes?
translation: 你，生物，快点给俺拿来，行不？

english: Yeah, I have them here!
translation: 有，我带来了！

english: Dat is da goodly fing yous creature, now's we's can make da new Jiggig place away from zogries! Yous been da big helpy fing yous creature, Grish wishin' yous good stuff for da next fings for creature.
translation: 那真是太好了，你，生物，现在俺们可以在远离佐格怪的地方建新吉吉格了！你帮了大忙了，你，生物，格里什祝你接下来一切顺利。

english: ~ Grish seems very pleased about the return of the artefacts. ~
translation: ~ 格里什似乎对找回这些神器感到非常高兴。 ~

english: Thanks, that's very nice of you!
translation: 谢谢，你真是太好了！

english: Are you, now? Free up some space so you can carry something, and we'll see how barbarian you really are.
translation: 哦，是吗？腾出些空间好让你能拿点东西，然后我们就能看看你到底有多野蛮了。

english: Not too bad. I've got my barcrawl card stored somewhere for safe-keeping.
translation: 还不错。我把酒吧巡游卡收在某个安全的地方了。

english: You need to take it with you when you're going on a barcrawl.
translation: 你去酒吧巡游的时候得随身带着它。

english: Oh no not another of you guys. These barbarian barcrawls cause too much damage to my bar.
translation: 哦不，又来一个。这些野蛮人的酒吧巡游对我的酒吧破坏太大了。

english: You're going to have to pay 50 gold for the Uncle Humphrey's Gutrot.
translation: 你得付50金币买一杯汉弗莱大叔的穿肠酒。

english: I don't have 50 coins.
translation: 我没有50金币。

english: Blearrgh!
translation: 呕啊！

english: Ah, you've come to the best stop on your list! I'll give you my famous Fire Toad Blast! It'll cost you 10 coins.
translation: 啊，你可是来到了清单上最棒的一站！我会给你我著名的火蟾爆破酒！只要10金币。

english: I don't have 10 coins right now.
translation: 我现在没有10金币。

english: Oh, another silly human come to have his mind melted? You should take that barcrawl card to Blurberry - he always likes to serve the Fire Toad Blast himself!
translation: 哦，又一个傻乎乎的人类来让脑子被烧坏？你应该把那张酒吧巡游卡拿给布鲁贝利——他总是喜欢亲自调制火蟾蜍爆破！

english: Oh, another silly human come to have her mind melted? You should take that barcrawl card to Blurberry - he always likes to serve the Fire Toad Blast himself!
translation: 哦，又一个傻乎乎的人类来让脑子被烧坏？你应该把那张酒吧巡游卡拿给布鲁贝利——他总是喜欢亲自调制火蟾蜍爆破！

english: And what will it be for you, fine sir?
translation: 那么，这位先生想要点什么？

english: And what will it be for you, fine madam?
translation: 那么，这位女士想要点什么？

english: But I doubt it, Kelda stout is very rare these days. Fortunately.
translation: 但我怀疑，凯尔达黑啤酒如今非常罕见。幸运的是。

english: Ah, sir has taste! A jug of wine will cost you 10 gold coins.
translation: 啊，先生有品味！一瓶葡萄酒要10金币。

english: I hope sir will enjoy it!
translation: 希望先生会喜欢！

english: If you want to sell any cocktails you've made yourself I suggest you talk to Blurberry, he's the one who owns the bar.
translation: 如果你想出售自己调制的任何鸡尾酒，我建议你和布鲁贝利谈谈，他才是这家酒吧的老板。

english: Ah, madam has taste! A jug of wine will cost you 10 gold coins.
translation: 啊，女士有品味！一瓶葡萄酒要10金币。

english: I hope madam will enjoy it!
translation: 希望女士会喜欢！

english: Haha time to be breaking out the old Supergrog. That'll be 15 coins please.
translation: 哈哈，是时候拿出老牌超级烈酒了。请付15金币。

english: Sorry I don't have 15 coins.
translation: 抱歉，我没有15金币。

english: I suppose you'll be wanting some Fire Brandy. That'll cost you 12 coins.
translation: 我想你想要来点火白兰地。要12金币。

english: Sorry I don't have 12 coins.
translation: 抱歉，我没有12金币。

english: Oh you're a barbarian then. Now which of these barrels contained the Liverbane Ale? That'll be 18 coins please.
translation: 哦，那你就是野蛮人了。现在这些桶里哪一桶装的是肝毒麦酒？请付18金币。

english: Sorry, I don't have 18 coins.
translation: 抱歉，我没有18金币。

english: Ah, there seems to be a fair few doing that one these days. My supply of Olde Suspiciouse is starting to run low, it'll cost you 10 coins.
translation: 啊，最近做这任务的人还挺多。我的老牌疑云酒快不够了，要10金币。

english: Thanksh very mush...
translation: 灰常感谢...

english: Are you sure?  You look a bit skinny for that.
translation: 你确定？你看上去有点瘦，不太像能喝的样子。

english: Yep that seems fine, you can come in now. I never learned to read, but you look like you've drunk plenty. Also, one more thing...
translation: 嗯，看起来没问题了，你可以进来了。我从没学过认字，但你看上去喝了不少。还有一件事...

english: What happened to the statue?
translation: 雕像怎么了？

english: There was an awful storm, worst we've ever seen. The combination of cold and wind as well as its great age just... well... you only have to look around to find pieces.
translation: 曾经有一场可怕的暴风雨，是我们见过的最严重的。寒冷和风的组合，以及它年代久远……好吧……你只需要环顾四周就能找到碎片。

english: Looks like you're planning on rebuilding it?
translation: 看起来你打算重建它？

english: I was, but I can't do it alone. Architects from all five cities have been working on individual projects to improve the roads around the kingdom,
translation: 我是这么想的，但我一个人做不了。来自五个城市的建筑师一直在各自的项目上工作，以改善王国周边的道路，

english: but now we're done and I hoped that they might come to help with the statue.
translation: 但现在我们完成了，我希望他们能来帮忙修复雕像。

english: Would you? The others... they refuse to talk to me.
translation: 你愿意吗？其他人……他们拒绝和我说话。

english: Sure. I assume that each city in Kourend will have an architect?
translation: 当然。我猜库兰德王国的每个城市都会有一位建筑师？

english: Yes indeed. If you could call together the architects from all five cities to co-operate on this statue - that will be something that has never happened before...
translation: 确实如此。如果你能召集五个城市的建筑师一起合作建造这座雕像——这将是一件前所未有的事……

english: Sadly you are not favoured by the citizens of Hosidius. When you are, come back to me and I'll help.
translation: 遗憾的是，你并不受霍西迪乌斯城居民的青睐。等你得到青睐后，回来找我，我会帮忙的。

english: But you're organising this thing.
translation: 但你在组织这件事啊。

english: That's all very well, but I would lose face with my people if I were to actively assist someone who was not favoured.
translation: 说得不错，但如果我主动帮助一个不受青睐的人，我会在族人面前丢脸。

english: How are we doing on the statue?
translation: 雕像进展如何？

english: Until we have architects skilled in all areas of the statue, we cannot proceed.
translation: 在我们拥有精通雕像各部分技艺的建筑师之前，我们无法继续。

english: I guess I have to go find some more architects then!
translation: 那我想我得去找更多建筑师了！

english: You'll find them all at home, in their respective cities.
translation: 你会在他们各自的城市的家里找到他们。

english: Sadly you are not favoured by the citizens of Hosidius. When you are, come back to me and I'll help too.
translation: 遗憾的是，你并不受霍西迪乌斯城居民的青睐。等你得到青睐后，回来找我，我也会帮忙的。

english: You are not favoured by the people of Arceuus. Now, if you don't mind, I have things to think about.
translation: 你并不受阿西乌斯城人民的青睐。现在，如果你不介意的话，我有事要思考。

english: Why yes I am. How can I help you?
translation: 是的，我是。我能帮你什么？

english: I wondered if you might be able to lend a hand with rebuilding a statue.
translation: 我想知道你是否能帮忙重建一座雕像。

english: Possibly. What might this statue be?
translation: 也许可以。这座雕像是怎么样的？

english: King Rada I!
translation: 拉达一世国王！

english: Of course I will help you. You are referring of course to the statue that was destroyed in the storm. How large were you thinking?
translation: 我当然会帮你。你指的是在暴风雨中被毁的那座雕像。你打算造多大？

english: Very big.
translation: 非常大。

english: Hmm if it's really big, then my skills are limited to feet, legs and robes on big statues.
translation: 嗯，如果它真的很大，那么我的技能仅限于大型雕像的脚、腿和袍子部分。

english: That's ok, I can find someone else to work on the other bits. See you at the site!
translation: 没关系，我可以找别人做其他部分。现场见！

english: I am preparing. I will be there shortly.
translation: 我正在准备。我马上就到。

english: Hi, I'm looking for an architect?
translation: 你好，我在找一位建筑师？

english: I am indeed, fastest builder in Kourend and a dab hand at sculpture. How can I help?
translation: 我确实是，库兰德王国最快的建筑工人，也是雕塑高手。我能帮你什么？

english: I wondered if you would be interested in helping to build a statue.
translation: 我想知道你是否对帮助建造一座雕像感兴趣。

english: Maybe. What of?
translation: 也许吧。什么雕像？

english: An enormous statue of King Rada I in the centre of Kourend.
translation: 一座拉达一世国王的巨型雕像，位于库兰德王国中心。

english: Oh really? Who was he then?
translation: 哦真的吗？那他是什么人？

english: He was your founding ruler! Surely you know your history?
translation: 他是你们的开国统治者！你肯定知道你的历史吧？

english: Of course I do, just pulling your leg. Sounds like a great idea, though I am only good at doing arms and hands on big statues - is that of use?
translation: 我当然知道，只是逗你的。听起来是个好主意，不过我只擅长大型雕像的手臂和手部——能派上用场吗？

english: Yes it is, I can find someone else to work on the other bits. See you at the site!
translation: 能，我可以找别人做其他部分。现场见！

english: Yes, yes, I'm on my way, just collecting my things! I'll be there shortly.
translation: 是的是的，我正出发，正在收拾东西！我马上就到。

english: I'm looking for an architect?
translation: 我在找一位建筑师？

english: What? Who're you? What do you want?
translation: 什么？你是谁？你想要什么？

english: Can't be doin' with that. Yer not favoured in my city. Go away.
translation: 不行。你在我的城市不受青睐。走开。

english: Ay? What's that you say?
translation: 哎？你说什么？

english: ARE YOU AN ARCHITECT?
translation: 你是建筑师吗？

english: No need to shout. I'm a well respected architect you know.
translation: 没必要大喊大叫。我可是备受尊敬的建筑师，你知道吗。

english: Maybe. What's it of?
translation: 也许吧。是什么雕像？

english: King Rada I.
translation: 拉达一世国王。

english: What? A larder that's burst? That's absurd!
translation: 什么？一个爆裂的食品储藏柜？太荒谬了！

english: KING RADA I!
translation: 拉达一世国王！

english: All right, all right, no need to shout, I'm not deaf.
translation: 好了好了，没必要喊，我又不是聋子。

english: King Rada you say? My grandad met him.
translation: 你说拉达国王？我祖父见过他。

english: Um, really? That was an awful long time ago.
translation: 呃，真的吗？那是很久很久以前了。

english: Hmm... Might have been my great grandad...
translation: 嗯……可能是我曾祖父……

english: The statue... do you want to help?
translation: 那座雕像……你愿意帮忙吗？

english: What's that? Oh, yes, of course. But if it's big, I'm really only good at the main body bit, most like a house you see.
translation: 什么？哦，是的，当然。但如果它很大，我真的只擅长主体部分，你知道，就像房子一样。

english: It's huge, and in the centre of Kourend.
translation: 它很巨大，位于库兰德王国中心。

english: Well then I'm your dwarf.
translation: 那好，我就是你要找的矮人。

english: Ok, I need to find someone else to work on the other bits. See you at the site!
translation: 好的，我需要找别人做其他部分。现场见！

english: Yes, yes, I'm on my way, give my old bones a chance! I'll be there shortly.
translation: 是的是的，我正出发，给我这把老骨头一点时间！我马上就到。

english: So sorry but the people of Shayzien do not favour you currently. Please leave.
translation: 很抱歉，谢兹恩城的人民目前不青睐你。请离开。

english: Yes [sir/ma'am].
translation: 是的[sir/ma'am]。

english: Ah good, I wondered if you would be interested in helping to build a statue.
translation: 啊好，我想知道你是否对帮助建造一座雕像感兴趣。

english: Of course [sir/ma'am]. What kind of statue?
translation: 当然[sir/ma'am]。什么样的雕像？

english: Well! How extraordinary! I'm definitely in, but only really good at doing armour and weapons on big statues - is that of use?
translation: 哇！太特别了！我肯定加入，但我只擅长大型雕像的盔甲和武器部分——能派上用场吗？

english: It is indeed, I can find someone else to work on the other bits. See you at the site!
translation: 确实可以，我可以找别人做其他部分。现场见！

english: We're all here, let's get started on this statue!
translation: 我们都到齐了，开始动手建造这座雕像吧！

english: Thank you all for agreeing to help me in this endeavour.
translation: 感谢大家同意帮助我完成这项事业。

english: You earned the favour of my people and I think it's right that we honour the founding of our city in this way, that is why I am here.
translation: 你赢得了我的人民的青睐，我认为以这种方式纪念我们城市的建立是正确的，这就是我来的原因。

english: I agree wholeheartedly.
translation: 我完全同意。

english: Same here.
translation: 我也是。

english: Let us commence our work.
translation: 让我们开始工作吧。

english: Yep, let's begin.
translation: 是的，开始吧。

english: Indeed we shall.
translation: 我们确实该开始了。

english: Yes, let's bash some rock.
translation: 是的，我们来敲些石头。

english: Ready!
translation: 准备好了！

english: Thanks for helping us all get together to finally build this statue! I've got something for you...
translation: 感谢你帮助我们聚在一起，最终建成这座雕像！我有东西要给你……

english: Oh yes! I love rewards, what have you got for me?
translation: 哦是的！我喜欢奖励，你给我准备了什么？

english: I've had this lamp for a while, but it'll serve you more good than it does for me.
translation: 我有这盏灯有一阵子了，但它对你比对我更有用。

english: Truly awesome!
translation: 真是太棒了！

english: I seem to have lost that antique lamp you gave me, have you got another one?
translation: 我好像把你给我的那盏古董灯弄丢了，你还有另一盏吗？

english: Ahhh yes, one of my specialities. I'd be glad to help now that you are favoured.
translation: 啊，是的，我的专长之一。既然你已获得青睐，我很乐意帮忙。

english: You will need to talk to the other architects and persuade them to help with the statue.
translation: 你需要和其他建筑师谈谈，说服他们帮忙建造雕像。

english: I've got an antique lamp for you, but you're going to need a space in your inventory for it.
translation: 我有一盏古董灯给你，但你的背包需要腾出空间来放它。

english: Magnificent!
translation: 宏伟壮观！

english: Truly a testament to a great King. Thank you for the opportunity to contribute.
translation: 这真是对一位伟大国王的证明。感谢你给我机会贡献一份力量。

english: Thriving thank you. Since working on that statue, everyone wants a miniature and my business is on a firm footing!
translation: 生意兴隆，谢谢。自从参与那座雕像的工作后，每个人都想要一个缩小版，我的业务基础稳固了！

english: Oh hello there.
translation: 哦，你好啊。

english: I'm afraid not, far too busy.
translation: 恐怕不行，太忙了。

english: We can't start till we have someone to build all the parts.
translation: 我们得先有人把所有零件造好才能开始。

english: How moving it looks!
translation: 它看起来多么动人啊！

english: Move it? Not now it's built!
translation: 搬动它？现在建好了可不行！

english: I meant... oh it doesn't matter...
translation: 我是说……哦算了……

english: Aye, lovely statue isn't it.
translation: 是啊，很可爱的雕像，不是吗。

english: Can't start till we have someone to build all the parts.
translation: 在有人能建造所有零件之前，我们无法开始。

english: No, no, I don't want to buy any today thank you.
translation: 不，不了，我今天不想买任何东西，谢谢。

english: Utterly amazing! So much better than I imagined.
translation: 太惊人了！比我想象的好太多了。

english: Isn't it just? I'm so proud at what we have pulled together to create.
translation: 谁说不是呢？我为我们齐心协力创造出的成果感到非常自豪。

english: Yes Sir.
translation: 是，先生。

english: Of course Sir. What kind of statue?
translation: 当然，先生。要哪种雕像？

english: Of course Ma'am. What kind of statue?
translation: 当然，女士。要哪种雕像？

english: Yes Ma'am.
translation: 是，女士。

english: Of course sir. What kind of statue?
translation: 当然，先生。要哪种雕像？

english: Yes ma'am.
translation: 是，女士。

english: Of course ma'am. What kind of statue?
translation: 当然，女士。要哪种雕像？

english: We can't stawt tiww we have someone to buiwd aww dapawts.
translation: 在有人建造所有部件之前，我们无法开始。

english: Good day! You seem a hearty warrior. Maybe even some barbarian blood in that body of yours?
translation: 你好！你看起来是个健壮的战士。说不定你体内还流着一些野蛮人的血呢？

english: Who can tell? My forefathers weren't averse to travelling, so it is possible. They tended to cause too much trouble in your so-called civilised lands, however, so most returned to their ancestral homes.
translation: 谁知道呢？我的祖先并不排斥四处游历，所以这有可能。不过他们总在你们所谓的文明之地惹太多麻烦，所以大多数人都回到了祖居地。

english: In any case, given you seem the type, I think you are ready to learn our more secret tribal feats for yourself.
translation: 无论如何，既然你看起来是那种人，我觉得你已经准备好学习我们部落更隐秘的技艺了。

english: Oh, that sounds interesting. What sort of skills would these be?
translation: 哦，听起来很有趣。是什么样的技能呢？

english: To begin with, I can supply knowledge in the ways of firemaking, our special rod fishing tricks, a selection of spear skills and our agricultural techniques.
translation: 首先，我可以传授生火的方法、我们特殊的鱼竿钓鱼技巧、一些矛术以及我们的农业技术。

english: There are more advanced stages though, going by your description?
translation: 不过听你的描述，还有更高级的阶段？

english: Your perception is creditable. I can eventually teach of more advanced firemaking techniques, and the rod fishing skills are but a preliminary to our special potions and brews.
translation: 你的洞察力值得称赞。我最终可以教你更高级的生火技巧，而鱼竿钓鱼技能只是我们特殊药水和酿造术的入门。

english: These secrets must, however, wait until you have mastered the basics.
translation: 但这些秘密必须等你掌握了基础之后才能传授。

english: Who are you and why do you live all the way out here?
translation: 你是谁？为什么住在这种偏远的地方？

english: Me? I am Otto, known as the Godblessed. I follow the ways of our barbarian ancestors, communing with the spirits of the dead and teaching their ways to worthy disciples.
translation: 我？我是奥托，人称神佑者。我遵循野蛮人祖先的道路，与亡者的灵魂交流，并将他们的方式传授给值得教导的弟子。

english: Perhaps you could be one of them. You look a likely sort to learn of these ways. As I say, you might even have a bit of barbarian blood hidden away in you.
translation: 也许你可以成为其中之一。你看起来像是能学会这些方式的人。就像我说的，你体内甚至可能隐藏着一点野蛮人的血统。

english: I really don't think I'm related to any barbarian.
translation: 我真的不认为我和任何野蛮人有血缘关系。

english: Your scepticism will be your loss.
translation: 你的怀疑只会让你自己吃亏。

english: Sorry, I'm too busy to talk about genealogy today.
translation: 抱歉，我今天太忙了，没空讨论家谱。

english: Well then, we will talk when you learn to be less impetuous.
translation: 好吧，等你学会不那么急躁的时候我们再谈。

english: Please teach me of your cunning with harpoons.
translation: 请教我如何使用鱼叉的技巧。

english: To learn more of such as tool, you must first focus your studies on those fish that the tool is used to catch.
translation: 要学习这种工具的更多用法，你必须先专注于研究这种工具所用来捕捉的鱼类。

english: You must catch fish which are usually harpooned, without a harpoon. You will be using your skill and strength.
translation: 你必须不用鱼叉，去捕捉通常用鱼叉捕的鱼。你将运用你的技巧和力量。

english: How do you expect me to do that?
translation: 你指望我怎么做？

english: Use your arm as bait. Wriggle your fingers as if they are a tasty snack and hungry tuna and swordfish will throng to be caught by you.
translation: 用你的手臂当诱饵。扭动你的手指，就像它们是美味的小吃，饥饿的金枪鱼和剑鱼就会蜂拥而来，让你抓住。

english: That sounds rather insanely dangerous. I'm glad you didn't mention shark too.
translation: 听起来相当疯狂危险。还好你没提到鲨鱼。

english: Oh, my mind slipped for a moment, this method does indeed work with shark - though in this case the action must be more of a frenzied thrashing of the arm than a wriggle.
translation: 哦，我刚才走神了，这个方法确实对鲨鱼也有效——不过在这种情况下，手臂的动作更像是疯狂的猛甩，而不是扭动。

english: ... and I thought fishing was a safe way to pass the time.
translation: ……我还以为钓鱼是消磨时间的安全方式。

english: I seek more knowledge.
translation: 我想学更多知识。

english: I have no more questions at this time.
translation: 我现在没有其他问题了。

english: In that case, farewell.
translation: 既然如此，再会。

english: What can I learn about the use of a fishing rod?
translation: 关于鱼竿的使用，我能学到什么？

english: While you civilised folk use small, weak fishing rods, we barbarians are skilled with heavier tackle. We fish in the lake nearby.
translation: 你们文明人用又小又弱的鱼竿，而我们野蛮人则擅长使用更重的钓具。我们在附近的湖里钓鱼。

english: So can you teach me of your methods?
translation: 那你能教教你的方法吗？

english: Certainly. Take the rod from under my bed and fish in the lake. When you have caught a few fish, I am sure you will be ready to talk more with me.
translation: 当然。从我床底下拿鱼竿，去湖里钓鱼。等你钓到几条鱼，我相信你就准备好和我进一步交谈了。

english: You will know when you are ready, since inspiration will fill your mind.
translation: 当你准备好的时候，你会知道的，因为灵感会充满你的脑海。

english: So I can obtain new foods from these fishing spots?
translation: 那么我就能从这些钓鱼点获得新的食物了？

english: We do not use these fish quite as you might expect. When you return we can speak more of this matter.
translation: 我们使用这些鱼的方式可能和你想象的不太一样。等你回来，我们可以进一步讨论这件事。

english: I'm ready for your firemaking wisdom. Please instruct me.
translation: 我已经准备好接受你的生火智慧了。请指教。

english: The first point in your progression is that of lighting fires without a tinderbox.
translation: 你进阶的第一步是不用火绒盒生火。

english: That sounds pretty useful. Tell me more.
translation: 听起来挺有用的。详细说说。

english: For this process you will require a strung bow. You use the bow to quickly rotate pieces of wood against one another. As you rub the wood, it becomes hot, eventually springing into flame.
translation: 这个过程你需要一把已上弦的弓。你用弓来快速旋转木片，让它们相互摩擦。当木头摩擦时，会变热，最终迸发出火焰。

english: No more secret details?
translation: 没有更多秘密细节了？

english: The spirits will aid you. The power they supply will guide your hands. Go and benefit from their guidance upon oak logs.
translation: 灵魂会帮助你。它们提供的力量会引导你的双手。去橡木原木上接受它们的指引吧。

english: How can I use my strength in the ways of agriculture?
translation: 我如何运用我的力量在农业方面？

english: Ah, so you wish to get your hands dirty? I can teach you how to plant seeds without the use of a seed dibber.
translation: 啊，所以你想亲自动手？我可以教你如何在不使用种植锥的情况下播种。

english: I can handle a little bit of muck. How does this work?
translation: 一点脏东西我能应付。这怎么操作？

english: The difficulty in this method is providing enough force to deeply root the seed in the ground, yet with enough care so that the the seed itself is not damaged.
translation: 这种方法的难点在于，既要提供足够的力量将种子深深埋入土中，又要足够小心，以免种子本身受损。

english: Practice this. You might fail at first, especially if like many a barbarian, you are not used to holding back. Indeed, it may be wise to avoid using seeds you are not willing to lose.
translation: 练习这个。一开始你可能会失败，尤其是如果你像许多野蛮人一样不习惯克制。实际上，明智的做法是避免使用你不愿意损失的种子。

english: Remember to be calm, and good luck.
translation: 记住要保持冷静，祝你好运。

english: I see you need encouragement in learning the ways of fishing without a harpoon.
translation: 我看你在学习不用鱼叉钓鱼方面还需要鼓励。

english: It's not the most safe-sounding task I have ever been given.
translation: 这可不是我接到过的最安全的任务。

english: Neither is it the most deadly. Go now and return when you have drawn a fish from the sea, with sheer strength and knowledge of our scaled prey.
translation: 也不是最致命的。去吧，等你仅凭纯粹的力量和对我们鳞片猎物的了解，从海里钓上一条鱼后再回来。

english: Alas, I do not sense that you have been successful in your fishing yet. The look in your eyes is not that of the osprey.
translation: 唉，我感觉你钓鱼还没成功。你眼中的神情不像鱼鹰。

english: Osprey?
translation: 鱼鹰？

english: Legendary birds, which the ignorant call eagles. They prey upon fish. Do as they do to gain inspiration.
translation: 传说中的鸟类，无知者称之为鹰。它们捕食鱼类。效仿它们的行为来获取灵感。

english: By now you know my response.
translation: 现在你知道我的回答了。

english: Go and light some oak logs using a strung bow?
translation: 去用上弦的弓点燃一些橡木原木？

english: I see you have yet to be successful in planting a seed with your fists.
translation: 我看你还没成功用拳头播种。

english: It's definitely one of the more delicate tasks you have provided me.
translation: 这绝对是你交给我的更精细的任务之一。

english: I've fished with my hands!
translation: 我已经徒手钓过鱼了！

english: I sense you have more understanding of harpoons through your studies.
translation: 我感觉你通过研究对鱼叉有了更多理解。

english: Well it was interesting, can I move on to more sane hobbies now?
translation: 嗯，挺有意思的，我现在能转向更正常的爱好吗？

english: Nothing is sane when one is born knowing only certain death. The spirits approve of you however, so death is on your side.
translation: 当一个人生来只知道必死无疑时，没有什么事是正常的。不过灵魂们认可你，所以死亡站在你这边。

english: I mean that when you eventually die and find peace, at least the spirits you encounter will be your friends. Alas for you adventurous sort, the natural ways of passing are close to impossible.
translation: 我的意思是，当你最终死去并找到安宁时，至少你遇到的灵魂会是你的朋友。可惜对于你们这些冒险者来说，自然死亡的方式几乎是不可能的。

english: I've fished with a barbarian rod!
translation: 我已经用野蛮人鱼竿钓过鱼了！

english: Your mind is as clear as the waters you have fished. This is good.
translation: 你的思绪和你钓过的水一样清澈。这很好。

english: So what do I do with these fish? They are all bloated and so nasty looking that even a starving vulture wouldn't eat one.
translation: 那我拿这些鱼怎么办？它们都鼓胀着，看起来恶心极了，连饿极了的秃鹫都不会吃一条。

english: Patience young one. These are fish which are fat with eggs rather than fat of flesh. It is these eggs that are the thing to make use of.
translation: 耐心点，年轻人。这些鱼是鱼卵肥厚，而不是肉质肥厚。要利用的是这些鱼卵。

english: I've set fire to logs with a bow!
translation: 我已经用弓点燃了原木！

english: Fine news indeed!
translation: 真是好消息！

english: I have completed firemaking with a bow. What follows this?
translation: 我已经完成了用弓生火。接下来是什么？

english: The next stage is quite complex, so listen well. In order to send our ancestors into the spirit world, their mortal remains must be burned with due ceremony.
translation: 下一阶段相当复杂，所以仔细听。为了将我们的祖先送入灵魂世界，他们的凡间遗骸必须通过适当的仪式焚烧。

english: This can only be done close to the water on the shore of the lake, just to our north-east. You will recognise the correct places by the ashes to be seen there.
translation: 这只能在靠近湖岸的水边进行，就在我们东北方。你会通过那里可见的灰烬认出正确的地点。

english: You will need to construct a small ship by using an axe upon logs in this area, then add the bones of a long dead barbarian hero.
translation: 你需要在这个区域用斧头在原木上建造一艘小船，然后加上一位早已死去的野蛮人英雄的遗骨。

english: Where do I obtain these bones?
translation: 我去哪里弄到这些遗骨？

english: From the caverns beneath this lake. Many of our ancestors travelled to these caverns in order to hunt for glory, but found only death. Their bones must still lie inside, their spirits trapped in torment.
translation: 从湖底下的洞穴里。我们许多祖先前往那些洞穴猎取荣耀，却只找到了死亡。他们的遗骨一定还在里面，灵魂被困在痛苦中。

english: So I make sure I am in the right place, then throw these bones on a ceremonial ship before I set light to it?
translation: 所以我确保自己在正确的地方，然后把遗骨扔到仪式船上，再点燃它？

english: Correct. The spirit will ascend to glory while the pyre will send the earthly remains to the depths. You will also obtain a closer link to the spirit world.
translation: 正确。灵魂将升入荣耀，而火葬船将把凡间遗骸送入深渊。你也会与灵魂世界建立更紧密的联系。

english: During this heightened contact, any bones you bury will have increased importance to the gods. The number of bones that may be buried before the link fades will depend on the wood used.
translation: 在这种增强的接触期间，你埋葬的任何骨头对诸神来说都会更加重要。在联系消退之前可以埋葬的骨头数量取决于所使用的木材。

english: Is there anything else I should know?
translation: 还有什么我应该知道的吗？

english: I have little knowledge of the caverns - they are blocked from the sight of the spirits with whom I commune. I can only suspect that whatever slew the barbarian heroes is indeed mighty.
translation: 我对那些洞穴知之甚少——它们被我所沟通的灵魂的视线所阻挡。我只能猜测，杀死那些野蛮人英雄的东西确实很强大。

english: I also suspect that the bones you seek might well be very uncommon, since heroes are not found in vast numbers.
translation: 我还怀疑你要找的遗骨可能非常稀有，因为英雄并不常见。

english: How do I enter the caverns?
translation: 我怎么进入洞穴？

english: Dive into the whirlpool in the lake to the east. The spirits will use their abilities to ensure you arrive in the correct location. Be warned, their influence fades, so you must find your own way out.
translation: 跳进东边湖里的漩涡。灵魂会利用它们的能力确保你到达正确的位置。但要注意，它们的影响力会消退，所以你必须自己找路出来。

english: I've created a pyre ship!
translation: 我已经造了一艘火葬船！

english: Hail to you, saviour of my ancestors. The spirits herald your presence with a spectral fanfare.
translation: 向你致敬，我祖先的救星。灵魂们以幽灵般的号角声宣告你的到来。

english: It's good to be appreciated.
translation: 被赏识的感觉真好。

english: On this great day you have my eternal thanks. May you find riches while rescuing my spiritual ancestors in the caverns for many moons to come.
translation: 在这个伟大的日子里，我向你致以永恒的感谢。愿你在未来的许多个月里，在洞穴中拯救我的灵魂祖先时找到财富。

english: And with that, your training is done. You have gone from apprentice, to master. Seek to inspire all with your daring deeds and legendary feats.
translation: 至此，你的训练完成了。你已从学徒成长为大师。用你勇敢的事迹和传奇的功绩去激励所有人吧。

english: Tell me more about the use of spears.
translation: 再给我讲讲矛的用法。

english: The next step is to manufacture a spear, suitable for combat. To do so, you must speak with our distant cousins on Karamja, in the village of Tai Bwo Wannai.
translation: 下一步是制造一把适合战斗的矛。为此，你必须与我们在卡拉姆詹岛上泰博瓦纳村的远房表亲交谈。

english: Couldn't you just take a bribe or something? I am sure you could do with some cash.
translation: 你就不能收点贿赂什么的吗？我相信你需要些钱。

english: I am afraid this is a vital step. The spirits foresee that your understanding of spears will increase through your journey there. You may not progress in the use of spears until you have completed this mission.
translation: 恐怕这是至关重要的一步。灵魂预见到你对矛的理解会通过这次旅程而加深。在完成这个任务之前，你无法在矛的使用上取得进展。

english: Many warriors complain that spears are difficult to find, we barbarians thus forge our own.
translation: 许多战士抱怨长矛很难找到，我们野蛮人因此自己锻造。

english: Can I just use some metal on an anvil, or is there something else involved?
translation: 我能不能直接用金属在铁砧上打，还是需要别的什么？

english: If you use our special barbarian anvil here, you will find it ideal. Other anvils are not sturdy enough or shaped appropriately for the forging work involved. Make any of our spears and return.
translation: 如果你用我们这里特殊的野蛮人铁砧，你会发现它很理想。其他铁砧不够坚固，或者形状不适合所需的锻造工作。制造出我们任何一把矛再回来。

english: Note well that you will require wood for the spear shafts; the quality of wood must be similar to that of the metal involved.
translation: 注意，你需要木材做矛杆；木材的质量必须与所用金属的质量相当。

english: What of the one handed spears of which you spoke?
translation: 你提到的单手矛呢？

english: The next step is to manufacture a one-handed version of a spear, suitable for combat. Such a spear is known to us as a hasta.
translation: 下一步是制造一把适合战斗的单手版矛。这种矛我们称之为短矛。

english: Can't I just pick one up and use it in one hand?
translation: 我就不能直接捡起来单手用吗？
