english: As you might suspect, our ways require greater understanding than is gained by simply looking at a weapon. It is also the case that the process involves a differently
translation: 正如你可能猜到的，我们的方式需要比仅仅看一把武器更深入的理解。而且这个过程涉及一种不同平衡的矛。

english: balanced spear. Before you may use such a weapon in anger, you must make an example. Only then will you fully understand the poise and techniques involved.
translation: 在你愤怒地使用这种武器之前，你必须先制作一个样品。只有这样你才能完全理解其中涉及的姿态和技巧。

english: So I must manufacture one? I see. This makes sense.
translation: 所以我必须制造一把？我明白了。这说得通。

english: Indeed. You may use our special anvil for this spear type too. The ways of black and dragon spears are beyond our knowledge, however; these spears may not be created.
translation: 确实。你也可以用我们特殊的铁砧来制造这种矛。不过黑矛和龙矛的制作方法超出了我们的知识范围；这些矛无法制造。

english: You do not exude the presence of one who has poured his soul into manufacturing spears.
translation: 你身上没有那种将灵魂倾注于制造长矛之人的气场。

english: The spirits told you?
translation: 是灵魂告诉你的？

english: Indeed they did. There are no secrets from those who live eternally.
translation: 确实如此。对于永生者而言，没有秘密可言。

english: Take some wood and metal and make a spear upon the nearby anvil, then you may return to me. As an example, you may use bronze bars with normal logs or iron bars with oak logs. If you perform this task I will
translation: 拿些木材和金属，在附近的铁砧上制作一把长矛，然后回来找我。举个例子，你可以用青铜条配普通原木，或者铁条配橡木原木。如果你完成这个任务，

english: be freed from the spirits complaining of your lack of dedication.
translation: 我就能摆脱那些抱怨你缺乏奉献精神的灵魂了。

english: The manufacture of spears is now yours as a speciality. Use your skill well. In addition I am ready to reveal one-handed spear crafts.
translation: 长矛制造现在已成为你的专长。善用你的技艺。此外，我已准备好传授单手矛的制作方法。

english: This sounds interesting indeed.
translation: 这听起来确实很有趣。

english: I see you have constructed your hasta, and are approaching readiness.
translation: 我看到你已经制作了你的短矛，并且正在接近准备就绪。

english: If I may ask, readiness for what?
translation: 如果我可以问，准备什么？

english: To live life to it's fullest of course - that you may be a peaceful spirit when your time ends.
translation: 当然是尽情享受生活——这样当你生命终结时，才能成为一个平和的灵魂。

english: What was that secret knowledge of herblore we talked of?
translation: 我们之前提到的那个草药学的秘密知识是什么？

english: The secret is linked to the fish in the lake nearby. If you use your knife upon them, several new fishy items will be produced. Fish parts can be used as bait, but the roe and caviar is more useful for us.
translation: 秘密与附近湖里的鱼有关。如果你用小刀处理它们，就会产生几种新的鱼类物品。鱼的部分可以用作鱼饵，但鱼卵和鱼子酱对我们更有用。

english: Do I cook them?
translation: 我要把它们煮熟吗？

english: Certainly not. Mixing these items with two dose potions is what should be done. This results in a nutritious slop, perfect for healing as well as imparting the effect of the potion.
translation: 当然不是。应该将这些物品与两剂药水混合。这样会得到一种营养丰富的糊状物，既能治疗，又能赋予药水的效果。

english: Roe can only be used for some of the more easily combined mixes, while caviar may be used for any of the mixes of which I am aware.
translation: 鱼卵只能用于一些较容易混合的配方，而鱼子酱可以用于我所知道的任何混合配方。

english: What if I only have four dose potions?
translation: 如果我只有四剂药水怎么办？

english: You are able to decant a four dose potion into an empty vial, thus giving two potions of two doses. This will aid you in the process.
translation: 你可以将四剂药水倒入一个空瓶中，从而得到两瓶两剂的药水。这会对你的过程有所帮助。

english: I guess you just want me to go away and make one of these potions?
translation: 我猜你只是想让我走开，然后制作一瓶这样的药水？

english: Have I become so predictable? But yes, I do indeed require a potion. It is of the highest importance that you bring me a lesser attack potion combined with fish roe.
translation: 我已经变得如此可预测了吗？但没错，我确实需要一瓶药水。你带给我一瓶混合了鱼卵的次级攻击药水，这是最重要的。

english: Do you have my potion?
translation: 你有我的药水吗？

english: What was it you needed again?
translation: 你刚才需要什么来着？

english: Bring me a lesser attack potion combined with fish roe. There is more importance in this than you will ever know.
translation: 带给我一瓶混合了鱼卵的次级攻击药水。这件事的重要性远超你的想象。

english: I've made a barbarian potion!
translation: 我制作了一瓶野蛮人药水！

english: I will take that off your hands now. I will say no more than that I am eternally grateful.
translation: 我现在就收下它。我只想说，我永远感激不尽。

english: I feel I am missing some vital information about your need for this potion, though I often have this suspicion.
translation: 我觉得我缺少一些关于你为什么需要这瓶药水的重要信息，不过我经常有这种怀疑。

english: I will not reveal all of my private matters to you. Some secrets are best kept rather than revealed.
translation: 我不会向你透露我所有的私事。有些秘密最好保守，而不是揭露。

english: I've planted seeds with my fists!
translation: 我用拳头种下了种子！

english: Yes, I sensed you had found success. Well done.
translation: 是的，我感觉到你成功了。做得好。

english: It definitely tested my patience.
translation: 这确实考验了我的耐心。

english: Patience comes alongside a strong spirit.
translation: 耐心伴随着坚强的灵魂而来。

english: I hope you're not saying I'm weak?
translation: 我希望你不是在说我软弱？

english: No child, but we all have potential to improve our strength.
translation: 不，孩子，但我们都有提升力量的潜力。

english: Are there any other fist related farming activities I can learn?
translation: 还有其他与拳头相关的农业活动可以学习吗？

english: This technique fully embraces your strength as a barbarian. Nuance is not required here. It's about the fine art of smashing pots.
translation: 这种技巧充分体现了你作为野蛮人的力量。这里不需要细腻。这是关于砸罐子的精湛技艺。

english: Smashing pots? That doesn't sound overly difficult.
translation: 砸罐子？听起来不太难。

english: The secret is how to smash them in a way that doesn't leave debris on the ground, for that would not be of benefit to the environment.
translation: 秘诀在于如何砸碎它们，而不会在地上留下碎片，因为那样对环境不利。

english: That makes sense. I wouldn't want to be littering shards of pot everywhere. What's the trick?
translation: 有道理。我可不想到处乱扔罐子碎片。有什么诀窍？

english: Planting a tree is strenuous work. You need to channel this energy into pure anger. Release all that anger on the pot that contained it, shattering it into dust!
translation: 种树是件辛苦活。你需要将这股能量转化为纯粹的愤怒。将所有愤怒发泄在装树的罐子上，把它砸成粉末！

english: I'm good at getting angry. I'll give it a try.
translation: 我很擅长生气。我会试试的。

english: May the spirits guide you into success.
translation: 愿灵魂指引你走向成功。

english: You have not yet attempted to plant a tree. Why not?
translation: 你还没有尝试种树。为什么不呢？

english: I've been busy doing other stuff.
translation: 我一直在忙别的事情。

english: You know your task. Come back when you have completed it.
translation: 你知道你的任务。完成后再回来。

english: I've smashed a pot whilst farming!
translation: 我在耕种时打碎了一个罐子！

english: I can see in your spirit that you have been successful in your latest endeavour.
translation: 我从你的灵魂中看到，你最近的努力取得了成功。

english: I planted a tree and got really angry. The pot was gone before I even realised.
translation: 我种了一棵树，然后变得非常生气。我还没反应过来，罐子就没了。

english: It will become more natural with practice.
translation: 随着练习，它会变得更加自然。

english: About the soul bearer again... I've dug it up, but it's damaged.
translation: 关于灵魂载体的事……我已经把它挖出来了，但它损坏了。

english: This should be of no surprise to you, adventurer, if you paid attention to my book. Indeed, I even spoke of this matter when I first told you where the artefact was buried.
translation: 冒险者，如果你仔细读过我的书，这应该不会让你感到惊讶。事实上，当我第一次告诉你神器埋在哪里时，我就已经提到了这件事。

english: Although the Elders of Arceuus never had the knowledge to repair it, I told you of one who may be able to help.
translation: 虽然阿西乌斯城的长老们从未掌握修复它的知识，但我告诉过你，有一个人可能能帮忙。

english: I spoke of the Key Master, he who watches over the cave of the three-headed Guardian of the River. He has been there for countless years, and will have absorbed power from the River in that time.
translation: 我说过钥匙守护者，他看守着三头河流守护者的洞穴。他在那里已经无数年了，期间一定从河流中吸收了力量。

english: We buried it in the crypt of the Arceuus church. As I revealed this secret to you earlier, you will not be affected by the spells that prevent unwary explorers from stumbling across it.
translation: 我们把它埋在了阿西乌斯教堂的墓穴里。既然我之前向你透露了这个秘密，你就不会受到那些阻止粗心探险者偶然发现它的法术的影响。

english: Go and dig in the crypt of the Arceuus church again, traveller. I am sure you will find it again if you need it.
translation: 再去阿西乌斯教堂的墓穴里挖一挖吧，旅行者。如果你需要它，我相信你会再次找到它的。

english: Oh yes, I see.
translation: 哦，是的，我明白了。

english: The voices! The voices in my head!
translation: 那些声音！我脑海里的声音！

english: Only those who have been assigned to slay Cerberus, or her lesser brethren, may face her in battle.
translation: 只有那些被指派去杀戮刻耳柏洛斯，或它那些低阶同类的人，才能在战斗中与它对抗。

english: The voices speak to me! They say you should go and dig in the crypt for another one.
translation: 那些声音在跟我说话！他们说你应该去墓穴里再挖一个出来。

english: Ah yes, yes, it has been done.
translation: 啊，是的，是的，已经办好了。

english: You must contact a Slayer master to confirm the details of your assignment before you may proceed.
translation: 在继续之前，你必须联系一个杀戮大师来确认你任务的细节。

english: You must contact a Slayer master to confirm the details of your assignment before you may proceed. Only they can-
translation: 在继续之前，你必须联系一个杀戮大师来确认你任务的细节。只有他们才能——

english: Wooo? Woooo woo woooooo wooooo woooowooo wooo woooooo woo!
translation: 呜？呜呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜呜呜 呜！

english: Woooo! Woowooooowoo, wooo WOOOOOOOOOOO woowoo woowoowoo woo!
translation: 呜！呜呜呜呜呜，呜 呜呜呜呜呜呜呜呜 呜呜呜 呜呜呜 呜！

english: Please... Leave me to my fate. I have been here so long that I scarce remember aught else...
translation: 请……让我自生自灭吧。我困在这里太久了，几乎不记得其他任何事……

english: Uh.... huh.
translation: 呃……嗯。

english: That's got to be a pretty rubbish way to spend your life. Er, death.
translation: 这种过活方式也太糟糕了。呃，死法。

english: Kharrim the messenger... Last I'd heard of him, he'd headed off to Carrallagarto seek his fortune. Ya might want to check around there somewhere.
translation: 信使卡里姆……我最后一次听说他，是他去了卡拉尔加寻找财富。你或许可以到那边附近找找。

english: So... You must be the infamous Viggora.
translation: 所以……你肯定就是臭名昭著的维戈拉了。

english: Hold thy tongue varlet! Speak fast, how come you to find me here, and how doth you understand mine speech?
translation: 闭嘴，无赖！快说，你怎么找到我的，又怎么听懂我的话？

english: You want me to hold my tongue and tell you how I found you?
translation: 你想让我闭嘴，然后告诉你我是怎么找到你的？

english: Cease thy chatter and respond to my demand!
translation: 少废话，回答我的问题！

english: Cease my chatter AND respond to your demand?
translation: 少废话，同时回答你的问题？

english: I warn thee knave, this curse upon me hath not improved my temper, these centuries past...
translation: 我警告你，无赖，这诅咒可没改善我的脾气，这几个世纪以来……

english: Well, it's actually about that curse that I have come to speak to you.
translation: 嗯，我正是为了那个诅咒来找你谈谈的。

english: Oh, be that so? Then forgive my swift anger, and speak to me of how you plan to break this curse.
translation: 哦，是这样吗？那就原谅我刚才的愤怒吧，跟我说说你打算如何打破这个诅咒。

english: Erm... I didn't actually mention anything about breaking the curse...
translation: 呃……我其实没提过要打破诅咒的事……

english: Then what lets you dare speak to me?
translation: 那你凭什么敢来跟我说话？

english: Well, I heard of your name from a mage called Dhalak, and I'm trying to find out what exactly caused the curse to befall him, and you as well apparently.
translation: 嗯，我是从一个叫达拉克的魔法师那里听说你的名字的，我想弄清楚到底是什么原因导致诅咒降临到他身上，显然也降临到了你身上。

english: Ha! So the weak-willed mage was cursed along with me?
translation: 哈！所以那个意志薄弱的法师也跟我一起被诅咒了？

english: Well now, that is an interesting turn of events... Then am I to assume that Valdez, Rennard, Kharrim and Lennissa were also cursed along with me?
translation: 嗯，这下事情变得有趣了……那么我是否可以假设瓦尔德兹、雷纳德、卡里姆和蕾妮莎也跟我一起被诅咒了？

english: ...How did you know that?
translation: ……你怎么知道的？

english: Ha ha ha! Oh, the curse cut deeper than I had previously thought!
translation: 哈哈哈！哦，这诅咒比我之前想的还要深！

english: Stranger, this news has brought me a ray of sunshine in an otherwise dreary millennium! Please, ask any question you wish!
translation: 陌生人，这个消息给原本黯淡无光的千年带来了一缕阳光！请随意提问！

english: Erm... Thanks, I think. So what exactly happened on that day you were all cursed?
translation: 呃……谢谢，大概吧。那么你们被诅咒的那天到底发生了什么？

english: I know that Valdez discovered the Staff of Armadyl, was robbed by Rennard, who then sent Kharrim to tell Zamorak of it.
translation: 我知道瓦尔德兹发现了阿玛杜尔杖，被雷纳德抢走，然后雷纳德派卡里姆去告诉萨莫拉克。

english: Meanwhile Lennissa heard of the sale, and informed Dhalak who placed an enchantment upon it so that its power would be hidden.
translation: 与此同时，蕾妮莎听说了这笔交易，通知了达拉克，达拉克在法杖上施了咒，隐藏了它的力量。

english: I still don't know what happened with the staff to cause this curse, or what you had to do with it though...
translation: 但我还是不知道那根法杖到底做了什么导致了这场诅咒，也不知道你与此事有何关联……

english: Well stranger, rest yourself awhile, and I will recount a tale of the events of that day, for I was one of the few actually there when it happened...
translation: 好吧，陌生人，先休息一下，我给你讲讲那天发生的事，因为我是当时为数不多在场的人之一……

english: When what happened?
translation: 什么事发生时？

english: When my Lord Zamorak first got his taste of godhood!
translation: 我主萨莫拉克第一次尝到神性滋味的时候！

english: Wow. Sounds like quite the dinner party anecdote.
translation: 哇，听起来是个不错的餐桌轶事。

english: You can take the snide venom out of your voice whelp, you came to me; 'twas not the other way round.
translation: 小子，你那阴阳怪气的语调收一收，是你来找我的，可不是反过来。

english: Okay, okay. Please continue.
translation: 好吧好吧，请继续。

english: Well now, let us see... As you may have heard tell, my affiliation lay with General Zamorak, a mighty warrior of the Mahjarrat tribe, and my skill on the battlefield had quickly brought
translation: 嗯，那么让我想想……你可能听说过，我效忠于扎莫拉克将军，一位玛哈加特族的强大战士，而我在战场上的技艺很快就引起了它的注意。

english: me to his attention.
translation: 他对我的嗜血十分满意，以至于在战场上当场提拔我加入他的荣誉守卫，我得说，这可是难得的荣誉，因为我是唯一被选中担任此职的人类。

english: So pleased was he with my bloodlust that he promoted me on the battlefield once to serve in his honour guard, and let me tell you, this was a rare honour indeed, for I was the only human chosen to take such a position.
translation: 他对我的嗜血如此满意，以至于在战场上提拔我加入他的荣誉守卫，让我告诉你，这确实是罕见的荣誉，因为我是唯一被选中担任此职位的人类。

english: Oh yes, the dragon riders, Mahjarrat, demons and vampyre warriors made up the bulk of the force, but I wager I was their equal in all ways of combat.
translation: 哦，是的，龙骑士、玛哈加特、恶魔和吸血鬼战士构成了部队的主力，但我敢打赌，在所有战斗方式上我都与他们不相上下。

english: Ha, when I think of someone like Lucien struggling to lift a blade, in some ways I was even their better!
translation: 哈，当我想到像卢西安这样的人连把刀片都举不起来时，从某些方面来说，我甚至比他们更强！

english: Please continue.
translation: 请继续。

english: Well anyway... Myself and the rest of Zamoraks honour guard were formulating stratagems in our battle-tent, when that sneaky messenger Kharrim came in offering to sell us
translation: 好吧，总之……我和扎莫拉克荣誉守卫的其他成员正在我们的作战帐篷里制定策略，这时那个鬼鬼祟祟的信使卡里姆进来，提出要卖给我们

english: the god-staff of Armadyl!
translation: 阿玛杜尔的神之法杖！

english: Naturally, we suspected that this was some trick by our Lord to test our loyalty...
translation: 当然，我们怀疑这是主上考验我们忠诚的某种把戏……

english: Yes, who was your lord? Everyone has been very evasive about that...
translation: 是啊，你的主上是谁？大家对这一点都很含糊……

english: Quiet fool, all things in their course; You are disrupting my train of thought!
translation: 闭嘴，傻瓜，凡事自有其时；你打断我的思路了！

english: Well anyway, we thought it was too good to be true, yet when we visited this scummy tavern we were amazed to discover there was no trick, no test of loyalty, no hidden trap:
translation: 好吧，总之，我们觉得这好得令人难以置信，然而当我们去了那个肮脏的小酒馆时，却惊讶地发现没有诡计，没有忠诚考验，没有隐藏陷阱：

english: Somehow this fool had actually managed to obtain the god-staff of Armadyl!
translation: 不知怎么的，这个傻瓜居然真的弄到了阿玛杜尔的神之法杖！

english: Its power was incredible, you could almost feel the energies crackling around it in the air!
translation: 有了这样的武器，我们一直谋划的对抗主上的叛乱终于可以付诸行动，但我们知道必须迅速行动，趁他还没听说我们有了能击败他的武器之前，而且行动必须果断，

english: Well, with such a weapon, the plans we had been developing for a rebellion against our lord could finally be put into action, but we knew that we would have to act swiftly, before he heard that we had a weapon
translation: 因为即便在我们中间，也仍有忠于主上的人——比如那个可怜的傻瓜阿扎纳德拉。

english: capable of defeating him, and we would have to act decisively, for even amongst our group there were still those loyal to the lord - such as that pathetic fool Azzanadra.
translation: 能够击败他，我们必须果断行动，因为即使在我们中间，也仍有忠于主上的人——比如那个可悲的傻瓜阿扎纳德拉。

english: So JUST WHO WAS this lord you speak of?
translation: 所以你说的这位主上到底是谁？

english: And I tell thee again, I will say when it is appropriate, now do not disrupt my tale!
translation: 我再说一次，到合适的时候我自然会说，现在别打断我的故事！

english: Okay, carry on then...
translation: 好吧，那你继续……

english: So anyway, Lord Zamorak and his most trusted compatriots, namely myself, Hazeel, Drakan, Thammaron and Zemouregal made plans to overthrow our lord using the god-weapon, and by pledging
translation: 所以，总之，扎莫拉克主上和他最信任的同伙，即我本人、哈兹尔、德拉肯、萨马隆和泽莫雷加尔，计划使用这件神之武器推翻我们的主上，并通过宣誓

english: allegiance to Zamorak as our master, were each to be given a large piece of land as our own in return.
translation: 我们决定立刻行动，免得有人临阵退缩，或者其他势力干预我们的计划，于是匆忙赶往主上居住的城堡。

english: We decided to move immediately, before anyone got cold feet, or any other parties could interfere in our work, and made haste towards the castle where our Lord lived.
translation: 我们决定立即行动，免得有人临阵退缩，或有其他势力干预，于是匆忙赶往主上居住的城堡。

translation: 和往常一样，我们的主上守卫森严，但这正是扎莫拉克带来他最信任战士的原因。

english: As usual, our lord was guarded well, but this was why Zamorak had brought his most trusted fighters with him.
translation: 我们用佯攻和攻击分散“空之主”的注意力，并纠缠住他的护卫，与此同时扎莫拉克大人绕到他身后，拔出法杖，刺进了他的后背！

english: While we distracted the Empty Lord with our feints and attacks, and kept his bodyguards busy, Lord Zamorak outflanked him, unsheathed the staff and plunged it into his back!
translation: 当我们用佯攻和攻击分散空无之主的注意力，并拖住他的保镖时，扎莫拉克主上包抄了他，拔出法杖，刺入了他的后背！

english: Ah, it was a glorious sight... At that moment I was reminded for whom I fought, and why General Zamorak had earned his nickname 'the scourge' upon the battlefield...
translation: 啊，那景象真是壮观……那一刻我想起了自己为谁而战，也明白了扎莫拉克将军为何在战场上赢得'祸害'这个绰号……

english: And the next thing you know you were cursed?
translation: 然后你就被诅咒了？

english: No, it was not quite that simple... The Empty Lord turned away from our battle, eyes burning with hatred, and towards Zamorak instead. Seeing this, we all fought with extra vigour, so that
translation: 好让扎莫拉克将军不必独自面对我们的主上，但我们被数百名战士和恶魔团团包围，无法冲过去帮助他！

english: General Zamorak would not face our lord alone, but we were outnumbered by many hundreds of warriors and demons, and could not reach him to assist him!
translation: 扎莫拉克将军本不必独自面对主上，但敌方战士和恶魔比我们多出数百，我们无法赶到他身边支援！

english: So what then?
translation: 那后来呢？

english: Why, it was the Empty Lord versus Zamorak, in single combat! And the sight of the battle will be with me forever more...
translation: “空之主”是一位强大的神祇，比当时苏醒的其他神祇都要强大，甚至可能和古蒂克斯一样强大，而扎莫拉克不过是个凡人：一个玛哈加特战士，拥有

english: The Empty Lord was a powerful god, stronger than any of the others awake at that time, possibly even as strong as Guthix is, and Zamorak was but a mortal: A Mahjarrat warrior all the same, with all of the
translation: 空无之主是一位强大的神，比当时苏醒的任何其他神祇都要强大，甚至可能和古斯一样强大，而扎莫拉克不过是个凡人：一个玛哈加特战士，尽管如此，拥有所有

english: strength and power that that entails, but mortal nonetheless, but to see him fight, you would not think of him as a 'mere' anything...

english: He was war itself! Flurry after flurry of blows he rained upon the Empty Lord, and the very castle walls shook and quivered with their power, but the Empty Lord would not fall!
translation: 即使神之武器还插在他背上，他依然继续战斗，每一击都让我们的胜利变得越来越不确定……

english: Even with the weapon of a god embedded in his back, he fought on, and with each blow our victory seemed less and less certain...
translation: 然后，奇迹发生了。或者运气，又或者天理昭彰。

english: Well, then a miracle happened. Or luck. Or natural justice.
translation: 随你怎么叫，就在“空之主”的双手紧紧掐住扎莫拉克的脖子时，扎莫拉克大人一边踢打、尖叫、愤怒地挣扎到最后一刻，一边猛地扑向

english: You can call it what you want, but as the Empty Lords hands wrapped tightly around Zamorak's throat, Lord Zamorak, kicking and screaming defiantly and radiant in his anger until the very last, plunged towards the
translation: 随你怎么说，但当空之主的双手紧紧掐住扎莫拉克的喉咙时，扎莫拉克大人挣扎嘶吼、怒火中烧直到最后一刻，猛然刺下

english: Empty Lord, who seemed to lose his footing slightly, and fell in such a way so that the staff plunged deeper into his body, but also impaled Lord Zamorak with it at the same time...
translation: 空无之主，他似乎脚步略微不稳，以这样一种方式倒下，使得法杖更深地刺入他的身体，但同时也刺穿了扎莫拉克主上……

english: And then...
translation: 然后什么都没有。突然闪过一道亮光，然后猛然一暗，寒意袭人，然后就结束了。

english: And then nothing. There was a sudden flash of bright light, and then a sudden blink of cold darkness, and it was over.
translation: 扎莫拉克站在“空之主”上方，后者正慢慢……从存在中消散……当他消散时，似乎……几乎像是扎莫拉克变得更加真实，

english: Zamorak stood over the Empty Lord who was slowly... fading from existence... And as he faded, it seemed as though... It almost seemed as though Zamorak became more real,
translation: 比以前更加实在……

english: more solid than he had been before...
translation: 当“空之主”从这个世界上完全消散时，我听到他的声音，几乎像风中的低语，诅咒所有帮助扎莫拉克取得胜利的人，正如你现在告诉我的，这似乎涵盖了所有

english: And as the Empty Lord faded from this world completely, I heard his voice, almost a whisper upon the wind, cursing all who had helped Zamorak in his victory, which as you now tell me seems to have been all who
translation: 当空之主彻底从这个世界消逝时，我听到他的声音，几乎像风中的低语，诅咒所有帮助扎莫拉克取胜的人，而照你现在的说法，这诅咒似乎已经

english: were responsible for the staff ending up in Zamorak's hands at the castle.
translation: 对法杖最终落入城堡中扎莫拉克之手负有责任。

english: As I heard it, I saw that I too was fading, just as the Empty Lord had, and I called to my brethren for their assistance, but they could no longer hear my words, nor see my form.
translation: 就在这时，其他神祇出现了，将扎莫拉克从这个世界彻底放逐，因为他竟敢杀害他们的同类之一，尽管结果证明他们并未如愿，当他归来时

english: It was then that the other gods appeared and banished Zamorak from the world completely for daring to kill one of their kind, although as it turned out it didn't quite work out that way for them, when he returned
translation: 他比以前更强大，成了神祇本身。

english: stronger than ever, a god himself.
translation: 但神战就是另一个故事了……

english: But the god wars were another story entirely...
translation: 但神战完全是另一回事了……

english: But... I don't understand... If it was Zamorak who used the weapon, then why was it only you who were cursed?
translation: 可是……我不明白……如果使用武器的是扎莫拉克，为什么被诅咒的只有你？

english: And the other people who were cursed, why them? Why not the other Mahjarrat for example?
translation: 而其他被诅咒的人，为什么是他们？为什么不是其他玛哈加特，比如说？

english: And just who was this 'Empty Lord' you keep speaking of?
translation: 你一直说的这位'空之主'到底是谁？

english: Well, in my life I was nothing but a warrior. I had no hidden knowledge, I didn't especially care about the gods or their magics, and I certainly didn't respect them.
translation: 嗯，我生前不过是个战士。我没有隐藏的知识，我不特别关心神祇或他们的魔法，我当然也不尊重他们。

english: Now in my... I suppose this is my death. I am but a shade on the wind, unnoticed by all who pass me, until today anyway, and the only answer I can give you is that the others who were with me, the

translation: 那些玛哈加特和吸血鬼，他们是魔法生物。

english: It runs through their very veins, and ebbs through their bones.
translation: 它流淌在他们的血脉中，浸透他们的骨髓。

english: Who knows why the curse fell as it did? Perhaps as a mere human I was more susceptible to it, when they were not. Perhaps they too are cursed, but their life spans are so
translation: 谁知道诅咒为何会如此降临？也许作为一个凡人，我比他们更容易受到诅咒的影响。也许他们也受到了诅咒，但他们的寿命如此……

english: long that it will be millennia before they feel it upon them. Perhaps because it did not affect them, it extended backwards through time, to the moment the staff was
translation: 漫长，以至于要过数千年他们才会感受到。也许因为它没有影响到他们，它便沿着时间回溯，直到法杖被

english: taken from its rightful place, and all who had known of its theft were cursed too. Perhaps there are others also cursed, who played no part in this tale, and were merely unlucky enough to be
translation: 在错误的时间出现在了错误的地方……

english: in the wrong place at the wrong time...
translation: ……在错误的时间出现在了错误的地方……

english: I don't know. Things do not always happen for a reason, just as tales do not always end with all of the loose ends neatly tied up and all answers supplied.
translation: 我不知道。事情并非总有原因，就像故事并不总是把所有线索都收拾妥当、给出所有答案。

english: I have simply told you the events I was witness to, for I can do no more.
translation: 你让我无比欣慰，因为你让我知道这个折磨我的诅咒并非让我独自困在这个世界之间的虚空里。

english: You have cheered me no end to let me know that this curse that has afflicted me has not left me alone here, in this void between worlds.
translation: 你让我无比欣慰，让我知道折磨我的这个诅咒并没有让我独自留在这里，留在这个世界之间的虚空中。

english: Perhaps I will hunt down these others who have also been cursed as I was, but I feel I must reward you for your efforts; Here, take my cloak, it is drenched in the blood of a
translation: 一千名敌人的鲜血，也许能在战斗中带给你好运。

english: thousand foes, and may bring you luck in battle.
translation: 那我该怎么破解这个诅咒？

english: So how can I break this curse?
translation: 那我该怎么解除这个诅咒术？

english: Who knows? If it was the death curse of the Empty Lord, there may be no way to break it.
translation: 谁知道呢？如果这是空无之主的死亡诅咒，那可能就无法打破了。

english: If it was not his death curse, and he is still alive but not on this world, then the only way to break it may be to bring him back here;
translation: 如果这不是他的死亡诅咒，而他还活着但不在这个世界上，那么打破它的唯一方法可能就是把他带回到这里；

english: But I would rather stay cursed than suffer under his rule again...
translation: 但我宁愿继续被诅咒，也不愿再次在他的统治下受苦……

english: But WHO was this 'Empty Lord'? WHAT was his NAME?
translation: 但这位'空无之主'到底是谁？他叫什么名字？

english: You do not know? You have not guessed yet?
translation: 你不知道？你还没猜到吗？

english: He was Zaros.
translation: 他是扎罗斯。

english: Hello - it's lovely to see a Mahogany Homes contractor on their rounds! Now, can I help you with something? Or might you be able to do me a little favour?
translation: 你好——很高兴看到桃花心木家居的承包商在跑业务！那么，有什么我能帮你的吗？或者你能帮我一个小忙？

english: What does this Mahogany Homes company do?
translation: 这家桃花心木家居公司是做什么的？

english: Oh, we redecorate people's houses, fixing things and building new furniture. Mending cabinets, building new chairs and tables - things like that.
translation: 哦，我们帮人重新装修房子，修理东西和打造新家具。修柜子、做新椅子和桌子——诸如此类。

english: When a client hires us to redecorate their house, we send a builder round to do the job, and we ensure the builder's paid for their work.
translation: 当客户雇我们装修房子时，我们会派一个建筑工人去干活，并确保工人得到报酬。

english: We can't hire you for that kind of work now, but perhaps you could do me a little favour instead, if you're willing. I can pay!
translation: 我们现在不能雇你做那种工作，但如果你愿意的话，也许你可以帮我一个小忙。我会付钱的！

english: What kind of favour do you want me to do?
translation: 你想让我帮什么忙？

english: Well, you see, it's about my dad. His house is really decrepit. I need someone to rip out the broken furniture and build him some better stuff. I'll pay you if you do it.
translation: 嗯，是这样的，是关于我父亲的。他的房子真的很破旧。我需要有人拆掉那些破损的家具，给他做些更好的。如果你做的话，我会付钱给你。

english: Aren't you in a construction company yourself though?
translation: 可你自己不就是建筑公司的吗？

english: See, my dad just - um - found the house. No-one was using it, so he just settled in. It's all perfectly harmless, and he's a sick old man anyway, so...
translation: 是这样的，我父亲只是——嗯——找到了那栋房子。没人住，所以他就搬进去了。完全无害，而且他反正也是个病弱的老人，所以……

english: Basically, he's not really meant to be there. And we'd prefer that the landlord not find out, so we're keeping this job off the record. I'll pay you myself.
translation: 基本上，他本来不该住在那里的。我们不想让房东发现，所以这次工作要私下进行。我会亲自付钱给你。

english: Why has he got such a bad house?
translation: 为什么他的房子这么差？

english: Some kind of economic downturn wiped out his pension plans. It happens more often than you'd think. But I'd rather not talk about it. Can you help him, though?
translation: 某种经济衰退把他的养老金计划搞没了。这种事比你想象的更常见。但我不想多谈。你能帮他吗？

english: Tell me more about the job.
translation: 再跟我说说这份工作。

english: Nothing too hard. You'll have to rip out the broken furniture, then build replacements. Dad will talk you through it - he's a retired carpenter himself. He loves talking about construction.
translation: 没什么太难的。你得拆掉破损的家具，然后做新的替换。父亲会指导你的——他自己也是个退休的木匠。他喜欢谈论建筑。

english: Tell me where he lives, and I'll do the job.
translation: 告诉我他住在哪里，我去做。

english: Fabulous! Dad lives in the south-east of Varrock, west of Aubury's Rune Shop. His name's Yarlo. Old Man Yarlo, they call him.
translation: 太好了！父亲住在维洛克城的东南部，奥布里符文店的西边。他叫亚洛。大家都叫他老人亚洛。

english: How are you getting on with helping my dad?
translation: 帮我父亲的事进展如何？

english: Where did you say he lived?
translation: 你刚才说他住在哪里？

english: Dad lives in the south-east of Varrock, west of Aubury's Rune Shop. His name's Yarlo. Old Man Yarlo, they call him. He's sure to be at home, so keep looking around.
translation: 父亲住在维洛克城的东南部，奥布里符文店的西边。他叫亚洛。大家都叫他老人亚洛。他肯定在家，所以继续找找吧。

english: What brings you here, young man?
translation: 年轻人，什么风把你吹来了？

english: Ah, young man, how's the redecoration coming on?
translation: 啊，年轻人，装修得怎么样了？

english: - A broken table in the kitchen - A broken table in the bedroom - The old campbed - The rotten carpet
translation: - 厨房里的一张破损的桌子 - 卧室里的一张破损的桌子 - 旧行军床 - 腐烂的地毯

english: Jolly good, young man. Now, we'll need to have a talk about what you'll build for me to replace it.
translation: 太好了，年轻人。现在，我们得谈谈你要给我做什么来替换它们。

english: I think that's everything - two stools, two tables, a chair, a bed and a carpet. Off you trot, young man. I'll be here if you have any questions.
translation: 我想就这些了——两张凳子、两张桌子、一把椅子、一张床和一块地毯。去吧，年轻人。如果你有问题，我就在这里。

english: Do you need some help with the building work, young man?
translation: 年轻人，建筑工作需要帮忙吗？

english: I need some waxwood planks for Old Man Yarlo.
translation: 我需要一些蜡木板材给老人亚洛。

english: That old geezer? Oh, alright. I won't charge for this, since it's for him.
translation: 那个老家伙？哦，好吧。既然是给他用的，我就不收费了。

english: I don't know any Old Man Yarlo, and I'd rather not work with that horrible material.
translation: 我不认识什么老人亚洛，而且我也不想碰那种糟糕的材料。

english: But he said he knew the chap at the sawmill, and you'd make waxwood planks for him.
translation: 但他说他认识锯木厂的那位伙计，你会为他做蜡木板材。

english: Perhaps he was thinking of some other sawmill operator.
translation: 也许他想到的是别的锯木厂操作员。

english: That's everything! Thank you so much, young man. Trot off back to my boy Marlo, now. He'll have something for you.
translation: 都完成了！非常感谢你，年轻人。现在快回去找我儿子马洛吧。他会给你报酬的。

english: Hello again, young man. Has my boy Marlo rewarded you yet?
translation: 又见面了，年轻人。我儿子马洛给你报酬了吗？

english: I've finished building the new furniture for your dad.
translation: 我已经为你父亲做好了新家具。

english: That's wonderful news! Dad's going to be so much happier. I'm very grateful! Now, I promised to pay you for your work...
translation: 真是好消息！父亲会开心多了。我非常感激！现在，我答应过要付你工钱……

english: Yeah, what have you got for me?
translation: 是啊，你给我准备了什么？

english: Now, I can't spare very much money, but I've got some supplies in this crate that might help with your own Construction work.
translation: 我拿不出太多钱，但这个板条箱里有一些补给品，可能对你自己的建筑工作有帮助。

english: I've included some handy spell tablets that'll take you to your house, to cut down on the walking a bit, as well as one for visiting my boss in Falador. Now, let me tell you some tricks of the trade too...
translation: 里面有一些方便的法术石板，可以把你传送到你的房子，省点走路的时间，还有一块是去法拉多城找我老板的。现在，让我也告诉你一些行业诀窍……

english: Can I do some other kind of building work for you?
translation: 我还能为你做其他建筑工作吗？

english: I'm so sorry, but you're not qualified to do contracts for Mahogany Homes yet. Just keep helping my dad, for now, and perhaps I can sort that out for you.
translation: 很抱歉，你还没有资格承接桃花心木家居的合同。暂时继续帮我父亲吧，也许之后我能帮你安排。

english: I haven't forgotten that I promised to pay you for your help. Is this a good time for that?
translation: 我没忘记答应过要付你报酬。现在是时候了吗？

english: Now, I can't spare very much money, but I've persuaded the Estate Agent to let me give you a house of your own. You'll be able to decorate it, like you did for my dad's house.
translation: 我拿不出太多钱，但我已经说服了地产经纪人，让我送你一栋自己的房子。你可以像装修我父亲的房子那样装修它。

english: Normally a new house costs 1,000 coins, so that's a bit of a saving. Also, I've got a crate of supplies to help you decorate it.
translation: 通常一栋新房子要1000金币，所以这算是省了一点。另外，我还有一板条箱补给品来帮你装饰它。

english: I've included some handy spell tablets that'll take you to your house, to cut down on the walking a bit, as well as one for visiting my boss in Falador. Let me tell you some tricks of the trade too...
translation: 里面有一些方便的法术石板，可以把你传送到你的房子，省点走路的时间，还有一块是去法拉多城找我老板的。让我也告诉你一些行业诀窍……

english: If you want to talk, this isn't the place for it. Meet me in Varrock's Chaos Temple, by the rune shop. Unless you're here to buy something?
translation: 想谈事情的话，这里不是地方。到维洛克城的混沌神殿来找我，就在符文商店旁边。除非你是来买东西的？

english: I already told you to meet me in Varrock's Chaos Temple, by the rune shop. Unless you're here to buy something?
translation: 我已经告诉过你了，到维洛克城的混沌神殿来找我，就在符文商店旁边。除非你是来买东西的？

english: Ah, you again. The Wilderness is hardly the appropriate place for a conversation now, is it? What was it you wanted?
translation: 啊，又是你。荒野可不是适合谈话的地方，对吧？你想干什么？

english: Err... I didn't really want anything.
translation: 呃……我其实没什么特别的事。

english: So why did you approach me?
translation: 那你为什么来找我？

english: I was just wondering why you sell runes in the Wilderness?
translation: 我只是好奇你为什么在荒野卖符文？

english: Well I can't go doing it in the middle of Varrock, can I? In case you hadn't noticed, I'm a servant of Zamorak. The Saradominists have made sure that people like me are not welcome in these parts.
translation: 我总不能跑到维洛克城中心去卖吧？你没注意到吗，我可是萨莫拉克的仆从。那些萨拉多明信徒早就让像我这样的人在这一带不受欢迎了。

english: Well we craft them of course.
translation: 我们当然是制作出来的。

english: My associates and I. Despite the best attempts of the Saradominists, there's still more of us around than they'd like.
translation: 我和我的同伙。尽管萨拉多明信徒费尽心机，但我们的人数还是比他们希望的多。

english: I can't imagine they like you crafting runes much. Do they not try and stop you?
translation: 我想他们不会喜欢你们制作符文吧。他们难道不阻止你们吗？

english: Ha! I'm sure they'd love to, but we have methods of runecrafting that they can only dream of!
translation: 哈！他们肯定想，但我们有他们做梦都想不到的符文制作方法！

english: Why would I? You are not a member of our institute. How do I know you won't just go and share all of our secrets with those Saradominist fools in the Order of Wizards.
translation: 我凭什么告诉你？你又不是我们教团的人。我怎么知道你不会转头就把我们的秘密全告诉巫师教团里那些萨拉多明傻瓜？

english: Maybe I could make it worth your while?
translation: 也许我能让你觉得值得呢？

english: How? What do you have to offer?
translation: 怎么个值得法？你能拿出什么来？

english: Well what is it you want?
translation: 那你想要什么？

english: Until recently, our runecrafting secrets allowed us to produce runes at a far superior rate compared to the inept Order of Wizards, but something has changed.
translation: 直到最近，我们的符文制作秘诀让我们能以远超无能的巫师教团的速度生产符文，但情况有变。

english: From what we can gather, they've somehow rediscovered how to access the lost Rune Essence Mine.
translation: 据我们了解，他们不知怎么重新找到了通往失落的符文精华矿场的路。

english: Ah, well I know all about that. I was actually the one to help them do it!
translation: 啊，这个我可清楚得很。其实是我帮他们做到的！

english: You did what? You helped the Order of Wizards?
translation: 你做了什么？你帮了巫师教团？

english: Yes, but I can still help you as well.
translation: 是的，但我同样可以帮你。

english: So you're a mercenary with no allegiance? Not the type I like working with, but if you have knowledge of the Rune Essence Mine, I seemingly have little choice.
translation: 所以你是没有立场的雇佣兵？我不喜欢和这种人合作，但既然你知道符文精华矿场的事，我似乎也没得选。

english: Alright, if you help us access the Rune Essence Mine, we will share our runecrafting secrets with you in return.
translation: 好吧，如果你帮我们进入符文精华矿场，我们就用符文制作秘诀作为回报。

english: I did it so that I could then steal their secrets.
translation: 我这么做是为了能偷走他们的秘密。

english: You did? Perhaps I underestimated you.
translation: 是吗？也许我低估你了。

english: Deal.
translation: 成交。

english: Good. Now, all I need from you is the spell that will teleport me to the Rune Essence Mine.
translation: 好。现在，我只需要你提供能把我传送到符文精华矿场的法术。

english: Err... I don't actually know the spell.
translation: 呃……我其实不会那个法术。

english: What? Then how do you get there.
translation: 什么？那你怎么去那里？

english: Oh, well the people who do know the spell just teleport me there directly.
translation: 哦，会那个法术的人直接把我传送过去。

english: Hmm... I see. That makes this slightly more complex, but no matter. You can still help us.
translation: 嗯……我明白了。这让事情复杂了一点，但没关系。你仍然可以帮我们。

english: I'll give you a scrying orb with a standard cypher spell cast upon it. The orb will absorb mystical energies that it is exposed to.
translation: 我会给你一个占卜球，上面施了一个标准的密码术法术。这个宝珠会吸收它所接触到的神秘能量。

english: If you teleport to the Rune Essence Mine from three different locations, the orb will absorb the energies of the spell and allow us to reverse-engineer the magic behind it.
translation: 如果你从三个不同的地点传送到符文精华矿场，这个宝珠就会吸收法术的能量，让我们能够逆向解析其背后的魔法。

english: Do you know of three different people who can teleport you there?
translation: 你知道三个能把你传送到那里的人吗？

english: Well if not, I'm sure one of those fools in the Order of Wizards can tell you. Now, here's the orb.
translation: 如果不知道，我相信巫师教团里那些傻瓜会告诉你的。好了，宝珠给你。

english: No deal.
translation: 不成交。

english: Fine. I will find another way.
translation: 好吧。我会另想办法。

english: I need to think about it.
translation: 我需要考虑一下。

english: I will be here once you have decided.
translation: 你决定好了我就在这里等你。

english: Sorry, I just remembered that I have to take my pet rat for a walk.
translation: 抱歉，我刚想起来我得带我的宠物老鼠去散步。

english: Yup! Got to go!
translation: 没错！我得走了！

english: But I'm a loyal servant of Zamorak as well!
translation: 但我也是萨莫拉克的忠实仆从啊！

english: Even if you speak the truth, it takes more than just being a follower of Zamorak to gain the secrets of the institute. You would need to offer something in return.
translation: 就算你说的是真的，光做萨莫拉克的信徒可不足以获得教团的秘密。你得拿出点东西来交换。

english: You did what? You helped the Order of Wizards? I thought you claimed to be a servant of Zamorak?
translation: 你做了什么？你帮了巫师教团？你不是自称是萨莫拉克的仆从吗？

english: Okay, fine. I don't really serve Zamorak.
translation: 好吧，好吧。我其实并不侍奉萨莫拉克。

english: Then give me one good reason why I shouldn't have you teleported into the depths of a volcano!
translation: 那你给我一个理由，为什么我不该把你传送到火山深处去！

english: Because I can still help you.
translation: 因为我仍然可以帮你。

english: You would help both sides for your own gain? I suppose as a Zamorakian, I can respect that, even if I don't like it.
translation: 你为了自己的利益帮助双方？作为萨莫拉克的信徒，我想我可以尊重这一点，尽管我不喜欢。

english: Alright, I'll leave. Just don't go teleporting me anywhere.
translation: 好吧，我这就走。只要别把我传送到什么地方去就行。

english: Be glad that I am merciful! Now go!
translation: 庆幸我心慈手软吧！快走！

english: You're right. I'm a faithful follower of Saradomin.
translation: 你说得对。我是萨拉多明的忠实信徒。

english: Then you have no place here! Leave, before I make you!
translation: 那你没资格待在这里！滚，别逼我动手！

english: Then you should be gone, for I am very busy.
translation: 那你该走了，我很忙。

english: You again. Have you considered my offer? If you help us access the Rune Essence Mine, we will share our runecrafting secrets with you in return.
translation: 又是你。考虑过我的提议了吗？如果你帮我们进入符文精华矿场，我们就用符文制作秘诀作为回报。

english: You again. Have you managed to use that scrying orb to obtain the information I need?
translation: 又是你。你用那个占卜球拿到我需要的信息了吗？

english: Fool! Take this, and don't lose it this time!
translation: 蠢货！拿着这个，这次别再弄丢了！

english: You must carry it with you and teleport to the Rune Essence Mine from three different locations. Return to me once you have done so.
translation: 你必须随身带着它，从三个不同的地点传送到符文精华矿场。完成后回来找我。

english: Yes, but it's in my bank.
translation: 是的，但它在我的银行里。

english: Well it is of no use there. Bring it to me.
translation: 放在那里可没用。拿来给我。

english: Right, let's take a look at this orb...
translation: 好了，让我看看这个宝珠……

english: Yes, this will do nicely. Once again, the Zamorak Magical Institute has overcome the Order of Wizards!
translation: 是的，这个正好。萨莫拉克魔法教团又一次战胜了巫师教团！

english: You have done well. Now, time for us to uphold our end of the bargin.
translation: 你做得很好。现在，该我们履行承诺了。

english: The reason we are able to craft so many runes is because we do not visit the runic altars in the traditional way. Instead, we have found a way to teleport to them directly.
translation: 我们能制作这么多符文的原因，是我们不用传统方式前往符文祭坛。相反，我们找到了一种直接传送到那里的方法。

english: Via another plane known as the Abyss. It is a complex place that cannot be easily explained, but I will share our research notes with you so you may better understand it.
translation: 通过一个叫做深渊的异位面。那是个复杂的地方，很难简单解释，但我会把我们的研究笔记分享给你，这样你就能更好地理解了。

english: So can I use the Abyss?
translation: 那我可以用深渊吗？

english: Yes. Visit me in the Wilderness whenever you wish to be teleported there. Just be careful, for it is a dangerous place. Still, I'm sure you'll agree that the risk is worth the reward.
translation: 可以。随时到荒野来找我，我就能把你传送过去。小心点，那是个危险的地方。不过，我相信你会同意，风险是值得的。

english: How is it dangerous?
translation: 怎么个危险法？

english: There are creatures there that will hunt and attack any visitors on sight. The magic we use for teleporting there can also be a bit... unstable.
translation: 那里有生物会猎杀并攻击任何闯入者。我们用来传送到那里的魔法也可能有点……不稳定。

english: Just don't expect to be using any prayers in there.
translation: 别指望能在里面使用祈祷。

english: Anyway, you may also have this pouch as well. I'm sure you will find it useful. Now, we're done here.
translation: 总之，这个袋子也给你。我相信你会觉得它有用。好了，我们的事办完了。

english: Meet me in Varrock's Chaos Temple. Here is not the place to talk.
translation: 到维洛克城的混沌神殿见我。这里不是说话的地方。

english: I already told you! Meet me in the Varrock Chaos Temple!
translation: 我已经告诉过你了！到瓦洛克城的混沌神殿见我！

english: Ah, you again. What was it you wanted? The Wilderness is hardly the appropriate place for a conversation now, is it?
translation: 啊，又是你。你想干什么？荒野可不是个适合谈话的地方，对吧？

english: I do not conduct business in this pathetic city. Speak to me in the wilderness if you desire to purchase runes from me.
translation: 我不在这座可怜的城市里做生意。如果你想从我这里买符文，就到荒野里来跟我说。

english: Oh, please!
translation: 哦，拜托啦！

english: Pretty please with sugar and cherries on top?
translation: 拜托拜托，上面再加点糖和樱桃好不好？

english: Pleeeeeeeeeease!
Stranger, I warn you I have a low tolerance for idiocy.
translation: 陌生人，我警告你，我对愚蠢行为的容忍度很低。

english: Now are you going to stand here all day annoying me, or was there something that you actually wanted?
translation: 你是打算整天站在这儿烦我，还是真有什么想要的东西？

english: Actually, that standing here annoying you thing sounds pretty good.
translation: 其实，就站在这儿烦你听起来挺不错的。

english: PLEEEEEEEEEAAAASE? pleasepleasepleaseplease pleasepleasepleaseplease pleasepleasepleaseplease
translation: 求——求——你——啦——？求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你求求你

english: Be QUIET or be DEAD!
translation: 给我闭嘴，否则就去死！

english: Wow, what a grouch...
translation: 哇，真是个爱发牢骚的家伙……

english: Where do you get your runes from? No offence, but people around here don't exactly like 'your type'.
translation: 你的符文是从哪儿弄来的？无意冒犯，但这里的人可不太喜欢‘你这种人’。

english: My 'type'? Explain.
translation: 我‘这种人’？解释一下。

english: You know... Scary bearded men in dark clothing with unhealthy obsessions with destruction and stuff.
translation: 你知道的……就是那些穿着深色衣服、留着吓人胡子、对毁灭之类的东西有着不健康痴迷的家伙。

english: Hmmm. Well, you may be right, the foolish Saradominists that own this pathetic city don't appreciate loyal Zamorakians, it is true.
translation: 嗯。好吧，你也许说得对，那些拥有这座可怜城市的愚蠢萨拉多明信徒确实不欣赏忠诚的萨莫拉克信徒，这是事实。

english: So you can't be getting your runes anywhere around here...
translation: 所以你不可能在这附近弄到你的符文……

english: That is correct stranger. The mysteries of manufacturing Runes is a closely guarded secret of the Zamorakian brotherhood.
translation: 没错，陌生人。制造符文的奥秘是萨莫拉克兄弟会严密保守的秘密。

english: Oh, you mean the whole teleporting to the Rune Essence mine, mining some essence, then using the talismans to locate the Rune Temples, then binding runes there?
translation: 哦，你是说整个传送到符文精华矿场，挖一些精华，然后用符石护身符定位符文神庙，再在那里束缚符石的过程？

english: I know all about it...
translation: 这些我都知道……

english: WHAT? I... but... you...
translation: 什么？我……但是……你……

english: Tell me, this is important: You know of the ancient temples? You have been to a place where this 'rune essence' material is freely available?
translation: 告诉我，这很重要：你知道那些古老的神殿？你去过一个可以自由获取这种‘符文精华’材料的地方？

english: How did you get to such a place?
translation: 你是怎么到那种地方的？

english: Well, I helped deliver some research notes to Sedridor at the Wizards Tower, and he teleported me to a huge mine he said was hidden off to the North somewhere where I could mine essence.
translation: 嗯，我帮人送了一些研究笔记给巫师塔的塞德里多，他把我传送到了一个巨大的矿场，他说那矿场藏在北边的某个地方，我可以在那里挖精华。

english: And there is an abundant supply of this 'essence' there you say?
translation: 你说那里有充足的这种‘精华’供应？

english: Yes, but I thought you said that you knew how to make runes? All this stuff is fairly basic knowledge I thought.
translation: 是的，但我以为你说你知道怎么制作符文？我以为这些都是相当基础的知识。

english: No. No, not at all.
translation: 不。不，完全不是。

english: We occasionally manage to plunder small samples of this 'essence' and we have recently discovered these temples you speak of, but I have never heard of these talismans before, and I was certainly not aware that this 'essence'
translation: 我们偶尔能掠夺到少量这种‘精华’样本，并且最近发现了你提到的那些神庙，但我以前从未听说过这些符石护身符，当然也不知道这种‘精华’……

english: substance is a heavily stockpiled resource at the Wizards Tower.
translation: 物质是巫师塔大量储备的资源。

english: This changes everything.
translation: 这改变了一切。

english: For many years there has been a struggle for power on this world. You may dispute the morality of each side as you wish, but the stalemate that exists between my Lord Zamorak
translation: 多年来，这个世界一直存在着权力斗争。你可以随意争论每一方的道德问题，但我的主人萨莫拉克

english: and that pathetic meddling fool Saradomin has meant that our struggles have become more secretive. We exist in a 'cold war' if you will, each side fearful of letting the other gain too much power, and each side
translation: 和那个可怜又好管闲事的傻瓜萨拉多明之间的僵局，意味着我们的斗争变得更加隐秘。可以说，我们处于一场‘冷战’之中，双方都害怕让对方获得太多力量，

english: equally fearful of entering into open warfare for fear of bringing our struggles to the attention of... other beings.
translation: 同样也害怕陷入公开的战争，担心我们的斗争会引起……其他存在的注意。

english: You mean Guthix?
translation: 你是指古斯？

english: Indeed. Amongst others. But you now tell me that the Saradominist Wizards have the capability to mass produce runes, I can only
translation: 确实。还有其他存在。但你现在告诉我，萨拉多明派的巫师有能力大规模生产符文，我只能

english: conclude that they have been doing so secretly for some time now.
translation: 断定他们已经秘密进行了一段时间。

english: I implore you adventurer, you may or may not agree with my aims, but you cannot allow such a one-sided shift in the balance of power to occur.
translation: 我恳求你，冒险者，你可能同意也可能不同意我的目标，但你不能允许这种权力平衡的单方面转变发生。

english: Will you help me and my fellow Zamorakians to access this 'essence' mine? In return I will share with you the research we have gathered.
translation: 你愿意帮助我和我的萨莫拉克同胞进入这个‘精华’矿场吗？作为回报，我将与你分享我们收集的研究成果。

english: Okay, I'll help you. What can I do?
translation: 好吧，我帮你。我能做什么？

english: All I need from you is the spell that will teleport me to this essence mine. That should be sufficient for the armies of Zamorak to once more begin stockpiling magic for war.
translation: 我只需要你提供能把我传送到这个精华矿场的法术。这应该足以让萨莫拉克的军队重新开始为战争储备魔法。

english: Oh. Erm.... I don't actually know that spell.
translation: 哦。呃……我其实不知道那个法术。

english: What? Then how do you access this location?
translation: 什么？那你是怎么进入这个地方的？

english: Oh, well, people who do know the spell teleport me there directly. Apparently they wouldn't teach it to me to try and keep the location secret.
translation: 哦，嗯，知道那个法术的人会直接把我传送到那里。显然他们不肯教给我，想以此保守地点的秘密。

english: Hmmm. Yes, yes I see. Very well then, you may still assist us in finding this mysterious essence mine.
translation: 嗯。是的，是的，我明白了。很好，那你仍然可以协助我们找到这个神秘的精华矿场。

english: I'll give you a scrying orb. I have cast a standard cypher spell upon it, so that it will absorb mystical energies that it is exposed to.
translation: 我会给你一个占卜球。我在上面施了一个标准的密码术法术，这样它就会吸收它所接触到的神秘能量。

english: Bring it with you and teleport to the rune essence location, and it will absorb the mechanics of the spell and allow us to reverse-engineer the magic behind it.
translation: 带着它，传送到符文精华地点，它会吸收法术的机制，让我们能够逆向解析其背后的魔法。

english: The important part is that you must teleport to the essence location from three entirely separate locations.
translation: 重要的是，你必须从三个完全不同的地点传送到精华地点。

english: More than three may be helpful to us, but we need a minimum of three in order to triangulate the position of this essence mine.
translation: 超过三次可能对我们更有帮助，但我们需要至少三次才能三角定位这个精华矿场的位置。

english: Here's the scrying orb. If you encounter any difficulties speak to me again.
translation: 这是占卜球。如果遇到任何困难，再来找我谈。

english: No, I don't want anything to do with you and trying to bribe me into helping isn't going to work on me.
translation: 不，我不想和你有任何瓜葛，想贿赂我帮忙是行不通的。

english: As you wish, stranger. I will achieve my goals elsewhere.
translation: 随你便，陌生人。我会在别处实现我的目标。

english: How dare you wear such disrespectful attire in this holy place? Remove them immediately if you wish to speak to me.
translation: 你怎敢穿着如此不敬的服装踏足这神圣之地？如果你想和我说话，就立刻把它们脱掉。

english: Well? Have you managed to use my scrying orb to obtain the information yet?
translation: 嗯？你用我的占卜球获取到信息了吗？

english: Uh... No.... I kind of lost that orb thingy that you gave me...
translation: 呃……不……我好像把你给我的那个宝珠弄丢了……

english: What? Incompetent fool. Take this. And do not make me regret allying myself with you.
translation: 什么？无能的蠢货。拿着这个。别让我后悔与你结盟。

english: I can offer a replacement, but not if you have no room to accept it, fool.
translation: 我可以给你一个替代品，但如果你没有空间接受它，那就不行，蠢货。

english: No... Actually, I had something I wanted to ask you...
translation: 不……其实，我有点事想问你……

english: I assumed the task to be self-explanatory. What is it you wish to know?
translation: 我以为这个任务不言自明。你想知道什么？

english: Please excuse me, I have a very bad short term memory. What exactly am I supposed to be doing again?
translation: 请原谅，我记性很差。我到底应该做什么来着？

english: I am slightly concerned about your capability for this mission, if you cannot even recall such a simple task...
translation: 如果你连这么简单的任务都记不住，我对你完成这次任务的能力有点担心……

english: All I wish for you to do is to teleport to this 'rune essence' location from three different locations while carrying the scrying orb I gave you. It will collect the data as you teleport, and if you then
translation: 我只希望你做的是，带着我给你的占卜球，从三个不同的地点传送到这个‘符文精华’地点。它会在你传送时收集数据，然后你

english: bring it to me I will be able to use it to further my own investigations.
translation: 把它带给我，我就能用它来推进我自己的调查。

english: So you want me to teleport to the rune essence mine while carrying the scrying ball?
translation: 所以你想让我带着占卜球传送到符文精华矿场？

english: And I need to teleport into the essence mine from three different locations?
translation: 而且我需要从三个不同的地点传送到精华矿场？

english: That is also correct.
translation: 这也正确。

english: Okay... I think I understand that...
translation: 好吧……我想我明白了……

english: That is good to know. Is there something else you need clarifying?
translation: 知道就好。还有其他需要澄清的吗？

english: I just want to know one thing: What's in this for me?
translation: 我只想知道一件事：我有什么好处？

english: Well now, I can certainly understand that attitude. Let me assure you of this; from what you tell me, you have discovered a way of gaining these 'essence stones' quickly and efficiently, yet it sounds as though your
translation: 嗯，我当然能理解这种态度。让我向你保证：根据你告诉我的，你发现了一种快速高效获取这些‘精华石’的方法，但听起来你

english: method of reaching the temples which are used to bind these essences is random and counter-productive.
translation: 到达用于束缚这些精华的神庙的方法是随机且适得其反的。

english: I, on the other hand, have information on quickly accessing these temples, yet my methods of procuring this 'essence' are time consuming and useless as a means of mass production.
translation: 另一方面，我有快速进入这些神殿的信息，但我获取这种‘精华’的方法既耗时，又无法用于大规模生产。

english: I think you can see for yourself how this may benefit both of us; You allow me the knowledge of finding plentiful essence, and I will in return show you the secret of these
translation: 我想你自己也能看出这对我们双方都有好处；你让我知道如何找到丰富的精华，作为回报，我会告诉你这些

english: temples.
translation: 神殿的秘密。

english: Yeah, okay, fair enough.
translation: 好吧，行，挺公平的。

english: If I help you with this... I'd just like to keep my conscience clear and know that you're not going to use whatever information I give to you in the pursuit of evil and badness and stuff.
translation: 如果我帮你这个忙……我只想让我的良心过得去，想知道你不会用我给你的任何信息去追求邪恶和坏事之类的东西。

english: Very well, if it makes you feel any better; I promise you that any knowledge you provide me with, absolutely will not be used in the service of anything more evil than what I was already planning on doing
translation: 很好，如果这能让你好受点的话；我向你保证，你提供给我的任何知识，绝对不会被用于比我原本计划要做的

english: anyway.
translation: 更邪恶的事情上。

english: I hope that sets your conscience at rest.
translation: 我希望这能让你的良心安定下来。

english: You know... In a weird way it actually does...
translation: 你知道吗……奇怪的是，它确实让我安心了……

english: Excellent. Was there anything else?
translation: 很好。还有别的事吗？

english: This crystal ball thingy is kind of nifty. Can I have another one?
translation: 这个水晶球玩意儿还挺别致的。能再给我一个吗？

english: It is not a 'crystal ball thingy'. It is a precision made magical instrument called a scrying orb. Do you have some particular need for another one?
translation: 那不是‘水晶球玩意儿’。那是一个精密制造的魔法仪器，叫做占卜球。你有什么特别的需要再要一个吗？

english: Not really, I just like to fill up my bank with cool looking stuff.
translation: 也不是，我就是喜欢用看起来很酷的东西填满我的银行。

english: Then no, no you may not have another one. One will be sufficient for the task at hand.
translation: 那不行，不，你不能再有另一个了。一个就足够完成手头的任务了。

english: Erm... But I lost the one you gave me... Can I have another one then?
translation: 呃……但我把你给我的那个弄丢了……那我能再要一个吗？

english: No you haven't. I can see that you have it there in your backpack. Now quit your foolishness and get on with the task in hand!
translation: 你没有弄丢。我能看到它就在你的背包里。现在别犯傻了，赶紧去完成手头的任务！

english: No you haven't. You have it in your bank. Now get on with it!
translation: 你没有弄丢。它在你银行里。现在赶紧去办！

english: No, I think I have everything clear in my head now.
translation: 不，我想我现在脑子里都清楚了。

english: That is good to hear, stranger. Bring me my orb back when you have successfully made those teleports.
translation: 很高兴听到你这么说，陌生人。成功完成那些传送后，把我的宝珠带回来。

english: And don't call me 'boss'.
translation: 还有，别叫我‘老大’。

english: Yes I have! I've got it right here!
translation: 是的，我完成了！就在这儿！

english: Excellent. Give it here, and I shall examine the findings. Speak to me in a small while.
translation: 太好了。把它给我，我来检查一下结果。过一会儿再来找我谈。

english: So... that's my end of the deal upheld. What do I get in return?
translation: 那么……我这边已经履行了约定。我能得到什么回报？

english: Indeed, a deal is always a deal.
translation: 确实，约定就是约定。

english: I offer you three things as reward for your efforts on behalf of my Lord Zamorak;
translation: 作为你代表我的主人萨莫拉克所付出努力的回报，我给你三样东西；

english: The first is knowledge. I offer you my collected research on the abyss. I also offer you 1000 points of experience in Runecrafting for your trouble.
translation: 第一是知识。我把我收集的关于深渊的研究笔记给你。另外，我还给你1000点符文制作经验作为辛苦费。

english: Your second gift is convenience. Here, you may take this pouch I discovered amidst my research. You will find it to have certain... interesting properties.
translation: 你的第二份礼物是便利。给你，你可以拿着这个我在研究中发现的口袋。你会发现它有一些……有趣的特性。

english: Your final gift is that of movement. I will from now on offer you a teleport to the abyss whenever you should require it.
translation: 你的最后一份礼物是移动能力。从现在开始，只要你需要，我可以随时为你提供传送到深渊的服务。

english: Huh? Abyss? What are you talking about? You told me that you would help me with Runecrafting!
translation: 嗯？深渊？你在说什么？你告诉过我会帮我进行符文制作！

english: And so I have done. Read my research notes, they may enlighten you somewhat.
translation: 我已经做到了。读读我的研究笔记，它们或许能让你有所启发。

english: Uh... I really don't see how this talk about an 'abyss' relates to Runecrafting in the slightest...
translation: 呃……我真的看不出这些关于“深渊”的讨论和符文制作有什么关系……

english: My primary research responsibility was not towards the manufacture of runes, this is true.
translation: 我的主要研究职责确实不是符文制造，这没错。

english: Rather, I was investigating an error that occurred to one of our initiates in a routine teleportation experiment.
translation: 更确切地说，我是在调查一次常规传送实验中一名新入会者出现的错误。

english: My discovery was this 'abyssal' space, and as a side effect, as documented in the research notes I have given you, I discovered the existence of these 'temples' used to create runes.
translation: 我的发现就是这个“深渊”空间，而作为副作用，正如我给你的研究笔记中所记载的，我发现了这些用于制作符文的“神殿”的存在。

english: Fortunate for both of us, I would say. As I say, read my research notes, it should all become clear.
translation: 对我们俩来说都很幸运，我得说。就像我说的，读读我的研究笔记，一切都会清楚的。

english: My colleague inside the abyss may be of help to you as well.
translation: 我在深渊里的同事可能也能帮到你。

english: So... This 'abyss' place... Is it dangerous?
translation: 那么……这个“深渊”地方……危险吗？

english: Well, the creatures there ARE particularly offensive...
translation: 嗯，那里的生物确实特别有攻击性……

english: You mean they smell?
translation: 你是说它们很臭？

english: No, I mean they hunt and attack any visitors to their dimension on sight. This is not the danger however.
translation: 不，我是说它们会猎杀并攻击任何闯入它们维度的访客。不过，这还不是最危险的地方。

english: It's not?
translation: 不是吗？

english: No. Unfortunately the magic we have had to use to retain a portal to the abyss open and effective is derived from Lord Zamorak himself.
translation: 不是。不幸的是，我们用来维持通往深渊的传送门开放和有效的魔法，源自萨莫拉克领主本人。

english: And that's a bad thing somehow...?
translation: 这难道不是好事吗……？

english: Well, he has his occasional quirks. In this case it means that when you enter this dimension you will be 'skulled' and your prayer will be drained.
translation: 嗯，他偶尔有些怪癖。在这种情况下，这意味着当你进入这个维度时，你会被“标记头颅”，并且你的祈祷会被抽干。

english: This makes it somewhat more dangerous than other places you may be used to.
translation: 这让它比你习惯的其他地方更危险一些。

english: Well, I reckon I'm prepared to go there now. Beam me there, or whatever it is that you do!
translation: 好吧，我觉得我已经准备好去那里了。把我传送过去吧，或者随便你怎么做！

english: No, not from here. The use of my Lord Zamoraks magic in this land will draw too much attention to myself.
translation: 不，不能从这里。在这片土地上使用我主萨莫拉克的魔法会引来太多注意。

english: Meet me in the wilderness where you spoke to me before, and right click to find the 'teleport' option.
translation: 到我们之前谈话的荒野来找我，然后右键点击找到“传送”选项。

english: I trust you do not wish to have too lengthy a conversation in such a dangerous place.
translation: 我相信你不想在那么危险的地方聊太久。

english: You're right, I don't!
translation: 你说得对，我不想！

english: I should be able to improve my stock of runes thanks to your assistance locating the essence site too, so feel free to stop by if you require any specific runes.
translation: 多亏你帮忙找到了精华矿场，我应该能改善我的符文库存了。所以如果你需要任何特定的符文，随时可以过来看看。

english: This is no place to talk! Meet me at the Varrock Chaos Temple!
translation: 这里不是说话的地方！到维洛克城的混沌神殿见我！

english: I cannot let you enter without full warning. Speak to me again in Varrock.
translation: 不给你充分警告，我不能让你进去。到维洛克城再跟我说话。

english: You are working for the Temple Knights, correct?
translation: 你在为圣殿骑士工作，对吧？

english: ...Yes. He took a large degree of my research into various things as well, but my research is inside my mind and easily replaceable, the money I possessed was essential
translation: ……是的。他还拿走了我大量关于各种事物的研究，但我的研究都在脑子里，很容易替代，而我拥有的钱对我的实验至关重要，

english: for my experimentation, and as I have no real skills to speak of, is not so easily replacable...
translation: 而且我没有什么真正的技能可言，所以钱没那么容易替代……

english: Twenty parts of rune essence is my price for my information. You may take it or leave it...
translation: 二十份符文精华是我情报的价格。你可以接受，也可以拒绝……

english: ...Okay. I appreciate your enthusiasm for Lord Zamorak stranger, but what exactly was it that you wanted?
translation: ……好吧。陌生人，我欣赏你对扎莫拉克大人的热情，但你到底想要什么？

english: I don't speak to Saradominist filth.
translation: 我不跟萨拉多明的渣滓说话。

english: Pathetic Guthixian... Don't bother me.
translation: 可怜的古斯信徒……别烦我。

english: Ha Ha Ha! I think not stranger!
translation: 哈哈哈！我想不会的，陌生人！

english: I will not haggle with you on my price. 20 Rune essences, and not a single essence less.
translation: 我不会跟你讨价还价。20份符文精华，一份都不能少。

english: ...I see. Well, in the future, do not waste my time, or you will feel the wrath of Zamorak upon you.
translation: ……我明白了。好吧，以后别再浪费我的时间，否则你会感受到扎莫拉克的怒火降临在你身上。

english: You do not have the free space for your reward. Go to the bank and free-up some space, I shall remain here until your return.
translation: 你没有空位领取奖励。去银行腾出些空间，我会在这里等你回来。

english: Come and speak to me again when you have some free space in your inventory.
translation: 等你背包有空位了再来跟我说话。

english: Then bring it here, fool!
translation: 那就把它带到这里来，蠢货！

english: I... I don't know w-what you want Solus, but whatever it is, please, just t-take it and leave, please...
translation: 我……我不知道你、你想要什么，索卢斯，但不管是什么，请拿走吧，然后离开，求你了……

english: I c-cannot let you have my research, it is being done in order to assist my lord Zamorak...
translation: 我、我不能让你拿走我的研究，这是为了协助我的主人扎莫拉克而做的……

english: I meant no disrespect Solus, please do not kill me...
translation: 我没有不敬的意思，索卢斯，请别杀我……

english: I have no riches, I am but a magical researcher...
translation: 我没有财富，我只是个魔法研究员……

english: My b-brains?
translation: 我的脑、脑子？

english: My... r-research?
translation: 我的……研、研究？

english: Oh no, no, no...
translation: 哦不，不，不……

english: Please don't kill me...
translation: 请别杀我……

english: P-please...
translation: 求、求你了……

english: Who dares...
translation: 谁敢……

english: Ah, you again. What was it you wanted? The wilderness is hardly the appropriate place for a conversation now, is it?
translation: 啊，又是你。你想要什么？荒野可不是适合谈话的地方，对吧？

english: Here, take this scrying orb. I have cast a standard cypher spell upon it, so that it will absorb mystical energies that it is exposed to.
translation: 来，拿着这个占卜球。我在上面施了一个标准的密码术法术，这样它就会吸收它所接触到的神秘能量。

english: My 'type' Explain.
translation: 我的“类型”？解释一下。

english: and that pathetic meddling fool Saradomin has meant that our struggle have become more secretive. We exist in a 'cold war' if you will, each side fearful of letting the other gain too much power, and each side
translation: 而那个可悲的多管闲事的傻瓜萨拉多明意味着我们的斗争变得更加隐秘。我们处于一种“冷战”状态，如果你愿意这么说的话，双方都害怕让对方获得太多力量，而且双方

english: We occasionally manage to plunder small samples of this 'essence' and we have recently discovered these temples you speak of, but I have never ever heard of these talismans before, and I was certainly not aware that this 'essence'
translation: 我们偶尔能掠夺到少量这种‘精华’样本，并且最近发现了你提到的那些神庙，但我以前从未听说过这些符石护身符，当然也不知道这种‘精华’……

english: That is correct stranger. My mysteries of manufacturing Runes is a closely guarded secret of the Zamorakian brotherhood.
translation: 没错，陌生人。我制造符文的奥秘是扎莫拉克兄弟会严密保守的秘密。

english: How did you get to such place?
translation: 你是怎么到那种地方的？

english: And there is an ubundant supply of this 'essence' there you say?
translation: 你说那里有充足的这种“精华”供应？

english: Have you spoke to Avan, Caleb and Johnathon yet?
translation: 你跟阿凡、迦勒和乔纳森谈过了吗？

english: Nope, not yet!
translation: 还没呢！

english: Hello there Avan, I've had a bit of spare time lately, and I was wondering whether you had anything I could help you out with, like a quest or something?
translation: 你好啊，阿凡。我最近有点空闲时间，想知道你有没有什么需要我帮忙的，比如一个任务之类的？

english: Honestly [player name], everything is fantastic! What you did for me and my family is amazing. My lady was very impressed with the perfect jewellery you obtained for me!
translation: 老实说，[player name]，一切都棒极了！你为我家人所做的一切都太棒了。我妻子对你帮我弄到的完美首饰印象深刻！

english: You know, I really have a LOT of spare time right now. Anything, I will help out with anything.
translation: 你知道，我现在真的有很多空闲时间。任何事情，我都愿意帮忙。

english: I couldn't bring myself to trouble you any further [player name]. Thank you for everything, but I am content.
translation: 我实在不忍心再麻烦你了，[player name]。谢谢你做的一切，但我已经很满足了。

english: I do one quest for you all and it solves all of your problems? Amazing... I'll go and tell your father how happy you all are!
translation: 我为你们做了一个任务，就解决了你们所有的问题？太神奇了……我去告诉你父亲你们有多开心！

english: Are you absolutely sure there is nothing I can help you out with?
translation: 你确定真的没有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Look, I really just want to get on with my life, your insistence on wanting another quest is getting annoying!
translation: 听着，我真的只想继续过我的生活，你一直坚持要另一个任务，这开始让人烦了！

english: I killed demons, I cured your poison and restored your family's honour! What can I help you with next Johnathon?
translation: 我杀了恶魔，治好了你的毒，还恢复了你们家族的荣誉！乔纳森，接下来我能帮你什么？

english: Actually, come to think of it...
translation: 其实，我想起来了……

english: I've been having this issue. You see the lady I seek is trapped up the top of a very large tower of a very large castle, and has been for all of her life so far.
translation: 我一直有个问题。你看，我追求的那位女士被困在一座巨大城堡的塔顶，她这辈子都待在那里。

english: There is but one problem, a fierce dragon circles the castle, breathing fire at anyone who dares go near.
translation: 但有一个问题，一条凶猛的龙在城堡周围盘旋，向任何胆敢靠近的人喷火。

english: This is sounding like a great opportunity to be heroic, shall I go get her for you?
translation: 听起来是个当英雄的好机会，要我去把她救出来吗？

english: Ha ha! You would believe anything. That was just a children's story!
translation: 哈哈！你还真信了。那只是个童话故事！

english: Very funny Johnathon, I can't help but laugh...
translation: 真有趣，乔纳森，我忍不住笑了……

english: So do you actually have any problems I can help you with?
translation: 那么，你实际上有什么问题需要我帮忙吗？

english: Everything is fantastic [player name]! You adventurers really do seem to love quests, but I do not have one for you today.
translation: 一切都很好，[player name]！你们冒险者似乎真的很喜欢任务，但我今天没有任务给你。

english: Are you sure there's nothing I can do, perhaps even teach you about Death Rune magicks, where your skills do not live up to mine.
translation: 你确定没有我能做的事吗？也许可以教你关于死亡符石魔法的知识，这方面你的技能可不如我。

english: I find that very insulting [player name]. You do not need to remind me of your superior skills. Leave me be.
translation: 我觉得这很冒犯，[player name]。你不需要提醒我你技能更高超。别来烦我了。

english: I have been and spoken to Avan, Caleb and Johnathon and none of them need anything from me!
translation: 我去找过阿凡、迦勒和乔纳森了，他们都不需要我帮忙！

english: That is excellent news [player name]. It's good to hear they are doing well.
translation: 那真是好消息，[player name]。很高兴听到他们都过得不错。

english: Yeah... you're welcome.
translation: 是啊……不客气。

english: Come to think of it, there is something you can help me out with!
translation: 说起来，还真有件事你可以帮忙！

english: Yes! I accept your quest!
translation: 好！我接受你的任务！

english: Slow down. I haven't told you what it is yet!
translation: 慢着。我还没告诉你是什么事呢！

english: I need 500,000 coins. Can you help me out with that?
translation: 我需要50万金币。你能帮我这个忙吗？

english: You just want coins?! Aren't you wealthy! Why do you need coins from me?
translation: 你只是想要金币？！你不是很有钱吗！为什么需要我的金币？

english: Okay, I suppose there will be no time better than this to tell you the truth.
translation: 好吧，我想现在正是告诉你真相的最佳时机。

english: Our family just pretends to be rich [player name]. We gave ourselves a fancy surname, pretended the gauntlets are a family heirloom and asked adventurers to solve our family issues.
translation: 我们家族只是假装富有，[player name]。我们给自己取了个花哨的姓氏，假装手套是传家宝，然后请冒险者来解决我们的家庭问题。

english: Wait, so all of this was for nothing? You just lied to me!
translation: 等等，所以这一切都是白费功夫？你只是在骗我！

english: No no, your work was indeed very helpful, the crest is important to us, it helps to portray that we are indeed wealthy, despite the fact we are not.
translation: 不不，你的工作确实很有帮助，徽章对我们很重要，它有助于塑造我们确实富有的形象，尽管我们实际上并不富有。

english: I don't have enough coins on me.
translation: 我身上没带够金币。

english: Thank you very much. In appreciation, I will inform Avan, Caleb and Johnathon that you did yet another great deed for the family, and that you would find more pairs of those gauntlets useful.
translation: 非常感谢。为表感激，我会告知阿凡、迦勒和乔纳森，你又为家族立下了一大功，并且你会发现更多双那种手套会很有用。

english: Well this didn't feel very heroic...
translation: 嗯，这感觉一点都不英雄……

english: You don't need 500,000 coins from me! I don't believe you! You can keep your rewards.
translation: 你不需要我的50万金币！我不信！你留着你的奖励吧。

english: I will be here if you change your mind.
translation: 如果你改变主意了，我就在这里。

english: I mean, if you were wealthy, would you live in a tiny house in the darkest corner of Varrock? Not a chance. This is your chance to do us a final favour, may I have 500,000 coins from you?
translation: 我的意思是，如果你有钱，你会住在维洛克最阴暗角落里的小房子里吗？不可能。这是你帮我们最后一个忙的机会，能给我50万金币吗？

english: I will not forget what you did for my family [player name]. Those 500,000 coins have allowed us to put food on the table.
translation: 我不会忘记你为我家人所做的一切，[player name]。那50万金币让我们得以糊口。

english: Anyway, I was wondering if I could get more of those gauntlets?
translation: 总之，我想知道能不能再弄几副那种手套？

english: You may, but you'll have to ask my sons for them, unless you just want a pair of the Steel gauntlets.
translation: 可以，但你得问我儿子们要，除非你只想要一副钢手套。

english: Yes, I do want a pair of steel gauntlets please.
translation: 是的，我确实想要一副钢手套。

english: No thanks Dimintheis.
translation: 不了，谢谢，迪明塞斯。

english: I thought these gauntlets were a family heirloom, how come you have several of them?
translation: 我以为这些手套是传家宝，你怎么有好几副？

english: I'm sorry for lying to you [player name], it was just all part of the ploy to make our family seem wealthy.
translation: 很抱歉骗了你，[player name]，这只是为了让我们的家族看起来富有而设的计谋的一部分。

english: You have my eternal gratitude adventurer, for all you have done in saving my family's honour. Perhaps some day my sons will overcome their differences.
translation: 冒险者，我永远感激你为挽回我家荣誉所做的一切。也许有一天，我的儿子们能化解他们的分歧。

english: Your chaos gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 你的混沌手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: Your steel gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 你的钢手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: Your goldsmithing gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 你的金匠手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: Your cooking gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 你的烹饪手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: The only thing I have heard of my son Caleb is that he is trying to earn his fortune as a great chef somewhere in the lands beyond White Wolf Mountain.
translation: 关于我儿子迦勒，我只听说他正在白狼山之外的某片土地上努力成为一名伟大的厨师。

english: Your chaos gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Clear some space and you can have them back.
translation: 你的混沌手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。清出一些空间，你就可以拿回去。

english: Your steel gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Clear some space and you can have them back.
translation: 你的钢手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。清出一些空间，你就可以拿回去。

english: Your goldsmithing gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Clear some space and you can have them back.
translation: 你的金匠手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。清出一些空间，你就可以拿回去。

english: Your cooking gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Clear some space and you can have them back.
translation: 你的烹饪手套最近通过魔法力量回到了我这里。清出一些空间，你就可以拿回去。

english: Sorry, you don't seem to have any room for them.
translation: 抱歉，你似乎没有空间放它们。

english: Your gauntlets have already been forged by me.
translation: 你的手套已经被我锻造过了。

english: Bring them to me, and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 把它们带给我，我看看我能做什么。

english: I'll want 25,000 coins to change your gauntlets.
translation: 我需要25,000金币来改变你的手套。

english: Your gauntlets have already been forged by me. Speak to my father if you need another pair.
translation: 你的手套已经被我锻造过了。如果你需要另一副，找我父亲谈谈。

english: Unfortunately, you do not seem to have space for this gift.
translation: 不幸的是，你似乎没有空间接收这份礼物。

english: I hope you succeed for my Fathers' sake.
translation: 为了我父亲，我希望你成功。

english: He said he was on some kind of search for treasure, or gold, or something out in the desert. You might want to ask around there for him.
translation: 他说他是在沙漠里进行某种寻宝，或者找金子，或者别的什么。你可以去那边打听一下他的消息。

english: Remember, I want the following cooked fish: Swordfish, Bass, Tuna, Salmon and Shrimp.
translation: 记住，我要以下熟鱼：剑鱼、鲈鱼、金枪鱼、鲑鱼和虾。

english: Last I heard he was on some stupid treasure hunt out in the desert somewhere. Your best bet is asking round there.
translation: 我上次听说他在沙漠某处搞一个愚蠢的寻宝游戏。你最好去那边问问。

english: I would, but I am very busy. I am trying to increase my reknown as one of the worlds' leading chefs by preparing a special and unique fish salad.
translation: 我很想去，但我很忙。我正在尝试通过准备一道特别而独特的鱼沙拉来提升我作为世界顶级厨师之一的声誉。

english: Well, we haven't really kept in touch... what with the dispute over the crest and all... I did hear from my brother Avan a while ago though..
translation: 嗯，我们其实没怎么联系……因为纹章的纠纷什么的……不过我确实不久前从我兄弟阿凡那里听说了一些消息……

english: Your gauntlets have already been treated with my potions. Speak to my father if you need another pair.
translation: 你的手套已经用我的药水处理过了。如果你需要另一副，跟我父亲说。

english: The... poison... it is all... too much... My head... will not... stop spinning...
translation: 那...毒药...实在...太难受了...我的头...一直...转个不停...

english: And right he is at that. Although my skill with Death Rune magicks was not great enough to defeat Chronozon, I am adequately skilled at Chaos Rune magicks.
translation: 他说得没错。虽然我的死亡符石魔法不足以击败克罗诺宗，但我的混沌符石魔法还算熟练。

english: Your gauntlets are already imbued with my powers.
translation: 你的护手已经被我灌注了力量。

english: Your gauntlets are already imbued with my powers. Speak to my father if you need another pair.
translation: 你的护手已经被我灌注了力量。如果你需要另一副，去跟我父亲说吧。

english: I'm feeling alright now, thanks.
translation: 我现在感觉好多了，谢谢。

english: The icon! He needs it now! You must dig, dig, dig. Slay the brothers six! It's okay, it won't hurt them... much. The icon will be in the chest!
translation: 那个圣像！他现在就需要它！你必须挖，挖，挖。杀了那六兄弟！没关系，不会太伤到他们的……圣像就在箱子里！

english: Why did you destroy the icon? I though you needed it!
translation: 你为什么毁掉了圣像？我以为你需要它！

english: This is for you. Take it! Take it!
translation: 这是给你的。拿着！拿着！

english: I see you have found more of these pages. I would be happy to take them off of you in return for 1,000 coins each.
translation: 看来你又找到了更多的书页。我很乐意以每张1000枚金币的价格从你这里收走它们。

english: I have not seen this before, however I am not interested in it as it is missing a few pages.
translation: 我以前没见过这个，不过它缺了几页，我没兴趣。

english: You do not have enough space to receive the coins.
translation: 你的空间不够，无法接收金币。

english: The library already has one of those.
translation: 图书馆已经有这个了。

english: Hey! You made it.
translation: 嘿！你来了。

english: I came as soon as I could. What are we dealing with?
translation: 我尽快赶来了。我们面对的是什么？

english: Up here? Not a lot. The Devourer must be deeper inside.
translation: 上面这里？没什么。吞噬者肯定在更深处。

english: Well then I guess that's where we're going as well.
translation: 那看来我们也要去那里了。

english: We shouldn't leave this entry unguarded. The Devourer still has plenty of servants out in the desert who we won't want coming in after us.
translation: 我们不该让这个入口无人看守。吞噬者在沙漠里还有很多仆人，我们可不想让他们跟进来。

english: Hmm... fair point. Alright, you keep an eye on things up here while I go after Amascut.
translation: 嗯…有道理。好吧，你在这里盯着，我去追阿玛斯库特。

english: I had a feeling you might say that, so I made some preparations.
translation: 我就知道你会这么说，所以我做了些准备。

english: Preparations?
translation: 准备？

english: Indeed. The Devourer has made plenty of enemies, and there are others willing to help us. Before you head deeper into the tomb, you might want to consider grouping up with some of them.
translation: 没错。吞噬者树敌众多，也有其他人愿意帮助我们。在你深入墓穴之前，不妨考虑和他们中的一些人组队。

english: I might just do that. Anything else I should know?
translation: 我会考虑的。还有其他我该知道的吗？

english: It seems Osmumten had various magical protections built into his tomb. It looks like the Devourer disabled them, which should make things easier for you.
translation: 看起来奥斯穆滕在他的墓穴里设置了各种魔法防护。不过吞噬者似乎已经把它们关掉了，这应该会让你轻松些。

english: Alright, I'd better not waste any more time. Amascut may well have already found the two weapons. If so, she'll already be draining the lesser gods of their power.
translation: 好吧，我不能再浪费时间了。阿玛斯库特很可能已经找到了那两件武器。如果是这样，她已经开始吸取次等神祇的力量了。

english: Meaning the longer we wait, the stronger she gets. If we don't stop her attaining true godhood, who knows what will happen.
translation: 也就是说我们等得越久，她就越强。如果不阻止她成为真神，谁知道会发生什么。

english: We'll stop her.
translation: 我们会阻止她的。

english: Oh, I almost forgot, I found this journal that might be worth a read.
translation: 哦，我差点忘了，我找到了这本日志，或许值得一读。

english: Just let me know if you want it.
translation: 如果你想要就跟我说。

english: Thanks. I'd better get ready.
translation: 谢谢。我最好准备一下。

english: The Devourer has all four of the lesser gods somewhere in this tomb. We have to assume she's already found the two weapons she seeks as well.
translation: 吞噬者把四个次等神祇都关在了这座墓穴的某处。我们也得假设她已经找到了她想要的那两件武器。

english: Which means she'll already be draining the lesser gods of their power.
translation: 也就是说她已经在吸取次等神祇的力量了。

english: Exactly. You need to head deeper into the tomb, free the lesser gods and stop the Devourer before it's too late.
translation: 正是如此。你需要深入墓穴，解放次等神祇，并在为时已晚之前阻止吞噬者。

english: This won't be an easy fight, so make sure you're well prepared. Thankfully, the Devourer is not short of enemies. If needs be, you can use the obelisk here and find some allies to join you.
translation: 这场战斗不会轻松，所以请确保你准备充分。幸好，吞噬者不缺敌人。如果需要，你可以使用这里的方尖碑，找一些盟友加入你。

english: Do you have that journal from earlier?
translation: 你之前那本日志还在吗？

english: I do, but you'll need to make some room for it.
translation: 还在，但你需要腾出点空间来装它。

english: I do. Here you go.
translation: 有的。给你。

english: Don't you already have it?
translation: 你不是已经拿到了吗？

english: Ah, so I do. Never mind.
translation: 啊，确实。算了。

english: You did it! I wasn't sure I'd make it out of that one, but I'm glad you proved me wrong. Come, let's get out of here.
translation: 你做到了！我还以为我逃不出来了，但你证明了我是错的，我很高兴。来，我们离开这里。

english: Amascut's hold on me is finally at an end. Human, let us return to the Nexus.
translation: 阿玛斯库特对我的控制终于结束了。人类，让我们返回枢纽。

english: Even with everything we're going through, I have to admit, that was an impressive fight to behold! I wish I could have joined you, friend. Now, let us return to the Nexus.
translation: 就算经历了这一切，我也得承认，那场战斗真是壮观！我多希望能和你并肩作战啊，朋友。现在，让我们返回枢纽。

english: The... the noise! Her voice in my head for so long, and now... silence! It's so loud! Please, we must leave!
translation: 那…那噪音！她的声音在我脑海里响了那么久，现在…寂静！太响了！求求你，我们必须离开！

english: Hi there. How are you doing?
translation: 你好。你还好吗？

english: Oh, you know, just getting over years of being controlled by a deranged family member. All part of the fun in a family like ours, I guess.
translation: 哦，你知道的，刚从被一个疯疯癫癫的家人控制多年的状态中恢复过来。像我们这样的家庭，这也算乐趣的一部分吧。

english: You seem quite jolly about it all.
translation: 你看起来倒是挺开心的。

english: Well as I always say, 'the real winner is the one smiling.' What Amascut has done is horrific, but it's not too late to stop her. I won't let her get me down, not while there's still hope.
translation: 嗯，我常说的：‘真正的赢家是那个笑着的人。’阿玛斯库特做的事很可怕，但阻止她还来得及。我不会让她打倒我，只要还有希望就不会。

english: Anyway, I'm annoyingly a bit too weak to help you much down here. However, I reckon if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to the lower level for you.
translation: 总之，我有点太弱了，帮不上你太多忙，真烦人。不过，我估计如果你能释放其他几个，我们就能为你打开通往下一层的路。

english: Anyway, we've been able to open the way for you! I wish we could help you down there, but we're still too weak. Don't worry though, I know you can do it!
translation: 总之，我们已经为你打开了路！真希望能帮你在下面战斗，但我们还是太弱了。不过别担心，我知道你一定能行！

english: I'm annoyingly a bit too weak to help you much down here. However, I reckon if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to the lower level for you.
translation: 我有点太弱了，帮不上你太多忙，真烦人。不过，我估计如果你能释放其他几个，我们就能为你打开通往下一层的路。

english: We've been able to open the way for you! I wish we could help you down there, but we're still too weak. Don't worry though, I know you can do it!
translation: 我们已经为你打开了路！真希望能帮你在下面战斗，但我们还是太弱了。不过别担心，我知道你一定能行！

english: Not feeling talkative?
translation: 不想说话？

english: I'm sure you will find a conversation with me more appealing than one with Scabaras. Still, I leave most of the talking to Apmeken.
translation: 我相信你会发现和我聊天比和斯卡巴拉斯聊天更有趣。不过，大多数时候话都是阿普梅肯说的。

english: Now, I can't support you in your fight, but if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to Amascut.
translation: 现在，我无法在战斗中支援你，但如果你能释放其他人，我们就能打开通往阿玛斯库特的路。

english: Now, we've opened the way to Amascut, but we can do no more. From here, it's up to you.
translation: 现在，我们已经打开了通往阿玛斯库特的路，但除此之外我们无能为力。接下来就看你的了。

english: Human, I can't support you in your fight, but if you can free the others, we'll be able to open the way to Amascut.
translation: 人类，我无法在战斗中支援你，但如果你能释放其他人，我们就能打开通往阿玛斯库特的路。

english: Human, we've opened the way to Amascut, but we can do no more. From here, it's up to you.
translation: 人类，我们已经打开了通往阿玛斯库特的路，但除此之外我们无能为力。接下来就看你的了。

english: Amascut! She's always been a monster, but she's doing things now I never believed her to be capable of! Had I not let my guard down, she'd surely be regretting her choices by now.
translation: 阿玛斯库特！她一直是个怪物，但她现在做的事，我从未相信她有能力做到！要不是我放松了警惕，她现在肯定在后悔自己的选择了。
