english: I guess we're lucky you came along when you did, my friend. I think you might have just given us a fighting chance!
translation: 我的朋友，我们很幸运你正好来了。我想你给了我们一个搏斗的机会！

english: I'm glad to have helped, but it's not over yet.
translation: 我很高兴能帮上忙，但还没结束。

english: Indeed. Were I not still weak, I would gladly deal with her myself, but I fear you will have to face Amascut without me.
translation: 确实。如果我不那么虚弱，我很乐意亲自对付她，但恐怕你得独自面对阿玛斯库特了。

english: You'll find her on the level below. If you can free the others, we should be able to open the way for you.
translation: 你会在下一层找到她。如果你能释放其他人，我们应该能为你打开路。

english: You'll find her on the level below. We have managed to open the way for you. Go now, and show her the error of her ways!
translation: 你会在下一层找到她。我们已经成功为你打开了路。现在去吧，让她明白她的错误！

english: My friend, Amascut has heavily weakened me, but I know you can do what is needed. If you can free the others, we should be able to open the way to the level below.
translation: 我的朋友，阿玛斯库特严重削弱了我，但我知道你能做到该做的事。如果你能释放其他人，我们应该能打开通往下一层的路。

english: We have opened the way for you, my friend. Any other day, I would have joined you in the fight against Amascut, but this one is up to you. Go now, and show her the error of her ways!
translation: 我们已经为你打开了路，我的朋友。换作平常，我会和你一起对抗阿玛斯库特，但这次靠你了。现在去吧，让她明白她的错误！

english: The silence... it's so loud! Free the others! Free them and we can help. Now please... go!
translation: 寂静…太响了！释放其他人！释放他们，我们就能帮忙了。现在请…走吧！

english: We... opened the way. Now... go. Stop her! Please!
translation: 我们…打开了路。现在…走吧。阻止她！求你了！

english: You! I should have known this would be your doing!
translation: 是你！我早就该知道这是你搞的鬼！

english: It's over, Amascut! Your plan has failed.
translation: 结束了，阿玛斯库特！你的计划失败了。

english: My plan has only just begun! Even with this setback, those pathetic fragments of my father have still given me ample power. My strength is absolute!
translation: 我的计划才刚刚开始！就算有这次挫折，我父亲那些可悲的碎片仍然给了我充足的力量。我的力量是绝对的！

english: Maybe, but it doesn't matter. I've stopped every one of your schemes so far, and I'll stop the next one as well.
translation: 也许吧，但这不重要。到目前为止我阻止了你每一个阴谋，下一个我也会阻止。

english: Really? You think you're leaving this place alive? I can promise you that won't be the case! My father's weapons have given me his power, and now they'll finally rid me of you!
translation: 真的吗？你以为你能活着离开这里？我向你保证绝不可能！我父亲的武器给了我他的力量，现在它们终于能让我摆脱你了！

english: My friend, we would like to have a word with you before you head back inside.
translation: 我的朋友，在你回去之前，我们想和你谈谈。

english: So this is a new one. There's a bunch of lesser gods standing just over there. You should probably go and talk to them.
translation: 这是个新情况。那边站着一群次等神祇。你最好去和他们谈谈。

english: Here [he is/she is/they are]!
translation: 他/她/他们来了！

english: My friend, you managed what few have ever achieved. You overcame Amascut herself! I wish I could have been there to see it!
translation: 我的朋友，你做到了几乎没人做到的事。你战胜了阿玛斯库特本人！我真希望当时能在场亲眼目睹！

english: Well I couldn't have done it alone. Speaking of which, where's Scabaras?
translation: 嗯，我一个人可做不到。说起来，斯卡巴拉斯呢？

english: Scabaras walks his own path. Do not consider his absence an insult. This is his way.
translation: 斯卡巴拉斯走他自己的路。不要把他的缺席当作侮辱。这就是他的风格。

english: Not to mention that he was under Amascut's control far longer than the rest of us. It will take him time to come to terms with his role in her plots.
translation: 更何况他被阿玛斯库特控制的时间比我们都长得多。他需要时间接受自己在她的阴谋中所扮演的角色。

english: Don't worry, he'll be okay. He always is.
translation: 别担心，他会没事的。他一直都这样。

english: Before we go any further... We didn't have much time for conversation back in the tomb. I'm sure you have some questions for us.
translation: 在我们继续之前…之前在墓穴里没太多时间交谈。我相信你肯定有些问题想问我们。

english: If you do, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果有的话，现在是提问的时候了。

english: I have a question for Apmeken.
translation: 我有个问题想问阿普梅肯。

english: What's your role in the Menaphite Pantheon?
translation: 你在梅奈法特神系中扮演什么角色？

english: I'm Tumeken's avatar of companionship! Tumeken himself was always considered a bit cold, which is a tad ironic when you think about it.
translation: 我是图梅肯的陪伴化身！图梅肯本人一直被认为有点冷漠，想想还挺讽刺的。

english: A cold sun god?
translation: 冷漠的太阳神？

english: Exactly! Bit odd, right? Still, although he wasn't exactly known for his social side, he still understood the importance of such things. That's why he made me!
translation: 没错！有点奇怪吧？不过，虽然他不以社交著称，但他仍然理解这些事情的重要性。这就是他创造我的原因！

english: My job is to make sure everyone remembers the importance of friendship. After all, we all need a friend or two, or ten, or maybe hundreds! Have as many as you want! I won't judge.
translation: 我的工作是确保每个人都记得友谊的重要性。毕竟，我们都需要一两个朋友，或者十个，甚至几百个！你想要多少就有多少！我不会评判的。

english: Why aren't there more monkeys or apes in the desert?
translation: 为什么沙漠里没有更多猴子或猿？

english: Ah, you can thank Amascut for that. The desert used to be home to thousands of apes and monkeys, but she targeted them to try and get to me.
translation: 啊，这要怪阿玛斯库特。沙漠曾经是成千上万猿猴的家园，但她为了对付我而盯上了它们。

english: Don't be! Now that I'm back, I know we can turn things around!
translation: 别担心！既然我回来了，我知道我们一定能扭转局面！

english: We'll be here when you're ready.
translation: 等你准备好了我们就在这儿。

english: I have a question for Crondis.
translation: 我有个问题想问克伦迪斯。

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of resourcefulness.
translation: 我是图梅肯的智谋化身。

english: Meaning my job is to guide the people of the desert not to live lives of excess.
translation: 也就是说我的工作是引导沙漠人民不要过奢侈的生活。

english: Guessing you're not a fan of Menaphos then?
translation: 那你肯定不喜欢梅奈法斯咯？

english: Much of the desert has forgotten the importance of modesty in my absence, but the situation in Menaphos is definitely the most concerning. Let us hope it can soon be rectified.
translation: 在我缺席期间，沙漠的许多地方都忘记了谦逊的重要性，但梅奈法斯的局势无疑是最令人担忧的。希望它很快能得到纠正。

english: Why are crocodiles so rude?
translation: 为什么鳄鱼这么粗鲁？

english: Rude? How so.
translation: 粗鲁？怎么个粗鲁法。

english: Well they always try to eat me when I go near them.
translation: 嗯，我靠近它们时它们总想吃掉我。

english: The life of a crocodile is not an easy one. They must seek food wherever it is available.
translation: 鳄鱼的生活并不容易。它们必须在任何能找到食物的地方觅食。

english: Besides, I sense you do not speak the whole truth. Did you not befriend a crocodile yourself in times past?
translation: 而且，我感觉到你没有说出全部实情。你过去不是自己就和一条鳄鱼交过朋友吗？

english: You mean Roger! I guess he was quite friendly.
translation: 你是说罗杰！我想他确实挺友好的。

english: Then perhaps crocodiles are not as rude as you think.
translation: 那也许鳄鱼并不像你想的那么粗鲁。

english: We will be here.
translation: 我们会在这里等你。

english: I have a question for Het.
translation: 我有个问题想问赫特。

english: I am Tumeken's avatar of health, both physical and mental.
translation: 我是图梅肯的健康化身，包括身体和心灵上的健康。

english: You talk about strength and fighting a lot. Surely fighting isn't good for someone's health.
translation: 你经常谈论力量和战斗。战斗肯定对健康不好吧。

english: Well when it comes to health, is strength not the ultimate goal? The strongest individual is one who is healthy in both body and mind, and what better way to celebrate that strength than in combat!
translation: 说到健康，力量难道不是最终目标吗？最强壮的个体是身心都健康的人，还有什么比战斗更能庆祝那股力量的呢！

english: I guess, but what about those who aren't strong?
translation: 我想是吧，但那些不强大的人呢？

english: Well health is not something to be hoarded, is it? Most weaknesses can be overcome, and it is the duty of the strong to help those less fortunate.
translation: 健康不是用来囤积的东西，对吧？大多数弱点都可以克服，而强者有责任帮助那些不那么幸运的人。

english: So they can become strong and healthy themselves?
translation: 这样他们自己也能变得强壮和健康？

english: An interesting question. Why do you ask?
translation: 有趣的问题。你为什么这么问？

english: Considering you have a human appearance, I wondered if that might resonate more with people.
translation: 考虑到你有人类的外表，我想知道这是否更能引起人们的共鸣。

english: Not as much as you might think. Believe it or not, in some ways, I'm actually considered a bit boring! Why follow the human when you have a baboon god?
translation: 可能没你想的那么多。信不信由你，在某些方面，我甚至被认为有点无聊！当你有一个狒狒神的时候，为什么要追随一个人类呢？

english: Especially when the baboon god is so fun to be around!
translation: 尤其是当这个狒狒神很有趣的时候！

english: Of course, people just following one of us was never really the intention anyway. We're a pantheon, and we all have a part to play.
translation: 当然，让人们只追随我们中的一个从来就不是本意。我们是一个万神殿，我们都有各自的角色要扮演。

english: Now that Amascut is running with her tail between her legs, perhaps we can remind people of that.
translation: 既然阿玛斯库特夹着尾巴逃跑了，也许我们可以提醒人们这一点。

english: We'll wait for you to return.
translation: 我们会等你回来。

english: I have a question for all of you.
translation: 我有个问题想问你们所有人。

english: What will happen with Amascut?
translation: 阿玛斯库特会怎么样？

english: I'd say that's up to her. If she doesn't change her ways, her fate won't be pretty.
translation: 我想这取决于她。如果她不改变她的方式，她的命运不会好。

english: But it's never too late for redemption. There might still be hope for her.
translation: 但寻求救赎永远不晚。她或许还有希望。

english: Whatever path she takes, we will be ready.
translation: 无论她选择哪条路，我们都会做好准备。

english: Do you really think she'd change her ways at this point?
translation: 你真的认为她到了这个地步还会改变吗？

english: It seems unlikely, but there is one who might be able to change that.
translation: 看起来不太可能，但有一个人或许能改变这一点。

english: Icthlarin! If anyone can help Amascut find her way again, it's him!
translation: 伊克哈林！如果有人能帮助阿玛斯库特找回正途，那一定是他！

english: He doesn't seem to have been doing much to help so far.
translation: 他到目前为止似乎没怎么帮忙。

english: Icthlarin is limited in what he can do. His duties to the dead require constant attention.
translation: 伊克哈林能做的有限。他对死者的职责需要持续的关注。

english: Not to mention the pact!
translation: 更不用说那个契约了！

english: Pact?
translation: 契约？

english: That is not for us to discuss.
translation: 那不是我们能讨论的。

english: Oh yes, sorry. Maybe we should talk about something else.
translation: 哦，是的，抱歉。也许我们该聊点别的。

english: Are you actually gods?
translation: 你们真的是神吗？

english: If you asked a citizen of these lands, I'm sure they'd probably say yes.
translation: 如果你问这片土地上的一个市民，我敢肯定他们很可能会说是。

english: Indeed, but they would not be truly correct.
translation: 确实，但他们并不完全正确。

english: Tumeken made us using his own divine essence! Each of us is a piece of him!
translation: 图梅肯用他自己的神圣精华创造了我们！我们每个人都是他的一部分！

english: But that does not make us gods. While great, our power is insignificant compared to a true god. That is why they are gone, and we remain.
translation: 但这并不能使我们成为神。虽然强大，但我们的力量与真正的神相比微不足道。这就是为什么他们离开了，而我们留了下来。

english: So what are you really?
translation: 那么你们到底是什么？

english: You might hear some refer to us as the Avatars of Tumeken. We'd consider that a more fitting title.
translation: 你可能会听到有人称我们为图梅肯的化身。我们认为那是一个更合适的称号。

english: What about Icthlarin and Amascut?
translation: 那伊克哈林和阿玛斯库特呢？

english: Tumeken made them too. Difference is, they also have some of Elidinis' divine essence, making them a lot more powerful!
translation: 图梅肯也创造了他们。不同的是，他们也拥有一些艾莉迪尼斯的神圣精华，这使得他们强大得多！

english: But again, they are not true gods.
translation: 但同样，他们也不是真正的神。

english: Amascut was hoping to change that today, but you showed her where to stick that plan!
translation: 阿玛斯库特今天本想改变这一点，但你让她明白了那个计划行不通！

english: We are the Avatars of Tumeken, and the Kharidian Desert has been without guidance for too long. It is time we fixed that.
translation: 我们是图梅肯的化身，而卡里迪安沙漠已经太久没有指引了。是时候由我们来纠正这一点了。

english: We're going to get started right away!
translation: 我们马上就开始行动！

english: But don't worry, we don't intend to miss the fight against Amascut. I hope you'll stand alongside us when that day comes.
translation: 但别担心，我们没打算错过与阿玛斯库特的战斗。我希望那天到来时，你能与我们并肩作战。

english: For now though, this is goodbye. We will meet again, human.
translation: 不过现在，是时候说再见了。我们会再见的，人类。

english: It was great to meet you. Thank you for helping us!
translation: 很高兴见到你。谢谢你帮助我们！

english: If you have questions, now is the time to ask them.
translation: 如果你有问题，现在是提问的时候了。

english: Hey! We should discuss some things before you head back in.
translation: 嘿！在你回去之前，我们应该讨论一些事情。

english: You're back! I have a little something for you, but you don't seem to have room for it. Come back when you do.
translation: 你回来了！我有点东西要给你，但你似乎没地方放。等你有空位了再来吧。

english: Indeed. Take care of yourself out there.
translation: 确实。在外面多保重。

english: Who? How did you get here? Never mind. I'll deal with you myself!
translation: 谁？你是怎么进来的？算了。我亲自来解决你！

english: Ha! I can't be slain that easily, fool!
translation: 哈！我可没那么容易被杀死，蠢货！

english: Hang on... I think I might have met this Fabia.
translation: 等等……我好像见过这个法比娅。

english: South of here, by some magic trees.
translation: 往南边走，在一些魔法树旁边。

english: The magic trees? Of course! How could I have been so stupid! Thank you, iknami. I'll head over right away!
translation: 魔法树？当然了！我怎么会这么笨！谢谢你，iknami。我马上过去！

english: You're not allowed in there. Come downstairs if you want to enter my arena.
translation: 你不能进去。如果你想进我的竞技场，就下楼来。

english: I am the great Kolodion, master of battle magic, and this is my battle arena. Top wizards travel from all over Gielinor to fight here.
translation: 我是伟大的科洛迪恩，战斗魔法大师，这里就是我的战斗竞技场。顶尖的魔法师从吉莱诺各地赶来在此对决。

english: Can I fight here?
translation: 我可以在这里战斗吗？

english: My arena is open to any high level wizard, but this is no game. Many wizards fall in this arena, never to rise again. The strongest mages have been destroyed.
translation: 我的竞技场对任何高级魔法师开放，但这可不是游戏。许多魔法师在这里倒下，再也站不起来。最强大的法师也在这里被摧毁过。

english: If you're sure you want in?
translation: 你确定你想加入吗？

english: Yes indeedy.
translation: 当然确定。

english: Good, good. You have a healthy sense of competition.
translation: 很好，很好。你有着健康的竞争心。

english: Remember, traveller - in my arena, hand-to-hand combat is useless. Your strength will diminish as you enter the arena, but the spells you can learn are amongst the most powerful in all of Gielinor.
translation: 记住，旅者——在我的竞技场里，近战格斗毫无用处。进入竞技场后你的力量会减弱，但你能学到的法术是整个吉莱诺最强大的之一。

english: Before I can accept you in, we must duel.
translation: 在我接受你之前，我们必须先决斗。

english: Okay, let's fight.
translation: 好吧，我们来打吧。

english: I must first check that you are up to scratch.
translation: 我必须先确认你的实力是否达标。

english: You don't need to worry about that.
translation: 你不需要担心这个。

english: Not just any magician can enter - only the most powerful and most feared. Before you can use the power of this arena, you must prove yourself against me.
translation: 不是随便哪个魔法师都能进来——只有最强大、最令人畏惧的才行。在你使用这座竞技场的力量之前，你必须先在我面前证明自己。

english: What's the point of that?
translation: 这样做的意义是什么？

english: We learn how to use our magic to its fullest and how to channel the forces of the cosmos into our world...
translation: 我们学习如何将我们的魔法发挥到极致，以及如何将宇宙的力量引入我们的世界...

english: But mainly, I just like blasting people into dust.
translation: 但主要来说，我只是喜欢把人轰成灰。

english: That's barbaric!
translation: 这也太野蛮了！

english: Nope, it's magic. But I know what you mean. So do you want to join us?
translation: 不，这是魔法。但我知道你的意思。所以，你想加入我们吗？

english: You must prove yourself... now!
translation: 你必须证明自己...就是现在！

english: This is only the beginning; you can't beat me!
translation: 这只是个开始；你打不倒我的！

english: Foolish mortal; I am unstoppable.
translation: 愚蠢的凡人；我是不可阻挡的。

english: Now you feel it... The dark energy.
translation: 你现在感受到了...那股黑暗能量。

english: Aaaaaaaarrgghhhh! The power!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊！这力量！

english: Well done, young adventurer; you truly are a worthy battle mage.
translation: 干得好，年轻的冒险者；你确实配得上战斗法师的称号。

english: Step into the magic pool. It will take you to a chamber. There, you must decide which god you will represent in the arena.
translation: 踏入魔法池。它会把你带到一间密室。在那里，你必须决定在竞技场中代表哪一位神。

english: Thanks, Kolodion.
translation: 谢谢你，科洛迪恩。

english: That's what I'm here for.
translation: 这就是我的职责所在。

english: Hello, young mage. You're a tough one.
translation: 你好，年轻的魔法师。你还真是难缠。

english: I have detected three life forces within the Wilderness, each of them giving out a strange magical power, one unlike any I have ever felt before.
translation: 我在荒野中检测到三股生命力量，每一股都散发出一种我从未感受过的奇异魔法能量。

english: If we could harness the power of these beings, I could imbue your god cape with that power, greatly increasing its potential.
translation: 如果我们能驾驭这些生物的力量，我就能将那股力量注入你的神斗篷，大大提升它的潜力。

english: Great, I've been waiting for an improvement!
translation: 太好了，我一直在等升级！

english: I will need you to kill these three beings and bring me their remains. Even in death, their power should be great enough for me to harness it for our own uses.
translation: 我需要你杀死这三只生物，并把它们的遗骸带给我。即使死后，它们的力量也足够强大，让我能为我们所用。

english: Where am I supposed to find these beings?
translation: 我该去哪里找这些生物？

english: Here, take this enchanted symbol of the gods. It will guide you to the creatures.
translation: 拿着，这是众神的魔法符印。它会指引你找到那些生物。

english: Bring me the remains of all three magical beings. Do this and I will imbue their combined power into a single god cape of your choice.
translation: 把三只魔法生物的遗骸带给我。完成后，我会将它们的合力注入你选择的一件神斗篷中。

english: You'll need to free up an inventory space before we continue.
translation: 你得先腾出一个背包空间，我们才能继续。

english: I see... If you ever change your mind, you know where to find me.
translation: 我明白了……如果你改变主意，你知道在哪里能找到我。

english: Where can I find these beings?
translation: 我在哪里能找到这些生物？

english: They can all be found in the Wilderness. The enchanted symbol can track their unique magical energies, leading you to their exact locations.
translation: 它们都在荒野中。魔法符印能追踪它们独特的魔法能量，带你找到确切位置。

english: Be warned though, the symbol will take a blood sacrifice every time it's used.
translation: 不过要小心，每次使用符印都需要血祭。

english: Any advice on fighting the beings?
translation: 对付这些生物有什么建议吗？

english: They can't be harmed by normal magic, melee or ranged attacks, you will need to use the god combat spell corresponding to the creature you are fighting.
translation: 普通魔法、近战或远程攻击伤不了它们，你需要使用与你战斗的生物对应的神系战斗法术。

english: Tell me more about these beings.
translation: 再跟我说说这些生物吧。

english: One is a justiciar. According to legend, the justiciars were the elite of Saradomin's forces. Some worked alone, operating as assassins behind enemy lines. Others led entire armies in Saradomin's name.
translation: 其中一个是审判官。传说审判官是萨拉多明军队的精锐。有些单独行动，在敌后充当刺客。另一些则以萨拉多明之名统领整支军队。

english: I couldn't tell you why this one wanders the Wilderness, but I suspect he has good reason.
translation: 我说不清为什么这个会在荒野游荡，但我猜他有充分的理由。

english: The second is a Demon of Zamorak. From what I can tell, he is completely mad. He roams the Wilderness, killing all who he comes across without mercy. Even his own kind do not escape his fury.
translation: 第二个是扎莫拉克的恶魔。据我所知，他完全疯了。他在荒野中游荡，毫无仁慈地杀死所有遇到的人。就连他自己的同类也逃不过他的怒火。

english: He's known to battle the justiciar quite regularly, perhaps they are old enemies.
translation: 据说他经常与审判官交战，也许他们是宿敌。

english: The final being is a Guthixian Ent. Like most followers of Guthix, he will avoid combat if possible. Make no mistake though, he is deadly when threatened.
translation: 最后一个是古斯树人。和大多数古斯信徒一样，他会尽量避免战斗。但别搞错了，受到威胁时他极其致命。

english: He seems to take great interest in the other two creatures. Maybe he is trying to keep a balance between them.
translation: 他似乎对另外两个生物很感兴趣。也许他试图在它们之间维持平衡。

english: All three of them give off a unique magical energy, one unlike any I have ever felt before. The fact that the three of them are so different, yet possess powers so similar, is very odd indeed.
translation: 这三者都散发出一种我从未感受过的独特魔法能量。它们如此不同，却拥有如此相似的力量，这确实非常奇怪。

english: I'd be very interested in learning more about the source of their power.
translation: 我很想进一步了解它们力量的来源。

english: Farewell, [player name].
translation: 再会了，[player name]。

english: I've got the remains of the Saradominist justiciar.
translation: 我拿到了萨拉多明审判官的遗骸。

english: Excellent work, [player name], but we aren't finished yet.
translation: 干得好，[player name]，但我们还没完。

english: I've got the remains of the Guthixian Ent.
translation: 我拿到了古斯树人的遗骸。

english: I've got the remains of the Zamorakian Demon.
translation: 我拿到了扎莫拉克恶魔的遗骸。

english: Excellent work, [player name], now you just need to hand me the god cape you wish to have imbued with great power.
translation: 干得好，[player name]，现在你只需把你希望注入强大力量的神斗篷交给我。

english: If you would like me to imbue any more capes, just bring me the remains of the respective creature.
translation: 如果你想让我注入更多斗篷，只需把对应生物的遗骸带来给我。

english: You'll have to bring me the Guthix creature's remains to imbue this cape.
translation: 你得把古斯生物的遗骸带来给我，才能注入这件斗篷。

english: You'll have to bring me the Saradomin creature's remains to imbue this cape.
translation: 你得把萨拉多明生物的遗骸带来给我，才能注入这件斗篷。

english: You'll have to bring me the Zamorak creature's remains to imbue this cape.
translation: 你得把扎莫拉克生物的遗骸带来给我，才能注入这件斗篷。

english: You may currently have a Saradomin cape, a Guthix cape and a Zamorak cape imbued, just hand over the cape when you're ready.
translation: 你现在可能已经注入了一件萨拉多明斗篷、一件古斯斗篷和一件扎莫拉克斗篷，准备好了就把斗篷交给我。

english: If you would like to imbue another cape, bring me the remains of the respective creature.
translation: 如果你想附魔另一件斗篷，就把相应生物的遗骸带给我。

english: You may currently have a Zamorak cape imbued, just hand over the cape when you're ready.
translation: 你目前可能有一件扎莫拉克斗篷被灌注了，准备好的时候把斗篷交给我就可以了。

english: You may currently have a Saradomin cape imbued, just hand over the cape when you're ready.
translation: 你现在已经附魔了一件萨拉多明斗篷，准备好了就把斗篷交过来吧。

english: You may currently have a Guthix cape imbued, just hand over the cape when you're ready.
translation: 你目前可能有一件古斯斗篷被灌注了，准备好的时候把斗篷交给我就可以了。

english: You have indeed shown potential, [player name]...
translation: [player name]...你确实展现了潜力...

english: You return, young conjurer. You obviously have a taste for the dark side of magic.
translation: 你回来了，年轻的召唤师。你显然对魔法的黑暗面很有兴趣。

english: You may currently have a Saradomin cape and a Zamorak cape imbued, just hand over the cape when you're ready.
translation: 你现在已经附魔了一件萨拉多明斗篷和一件扎莫拉克斗篷，准备好了就把斗篷交过来吧。

english: You may currently have a Guthix cape and a Zamorak cape imbued, just hand over the cape when you're ready.
translation: 你目前可能有一件古斯斗篷和一件扎莫拉克斗篷被灌注了，准备好的时候把斗篷交给我就可以了。

english: You may currently have a Saradomin cape and a Guthix cape imbued, just hand over the cape when you're ready.
translation: 你现在已经附魔了一件萨拉多明斗篷和一件古斯斗篷，准备好了就把斗篷交过来吧。

english: All three of them give off a unique magical energy, one unlike any I have ever felt before. The fact that the three of them are so different, yet posess powers so similar, is very odd indeed.
translation: 它们三者都散发着一种我前所未见的独特魔法能量。三种完全不同的力量，却拥有如此相似的能力，这实在非常奇怪。

english: Bring me the remains of any of the three gods along with the respective god cape and I'll craft it for you.
translation: 把三位神中任意一位的遗骸连同对应的神之斗篷带来，我就帮你制作。

english: Nothing else is required. You can find them in the areas surrounding the Lava Dragon Isle.
translation: 不需要其他东西。你可以在熔岩龙岛周围的区域找到它们。

english: If you would like me to imbue any more capes, just bring me the remains of the respective creatures.
translation: 如果你想让我附魔更多斗篷，只需把相应生物的遗骸带给我。

english: If we could harness the power of these beings. I could imbue your god cape with that power, greatly increasing its potential.
translation: 如果我们能驾驭这些生物的力量，我就能将那股力量灌注到你的神之斗篷中，大幅提升它的潜能。

english: Bring me the remains of one magical being. Do this and I will imbue it's power into the equivalent god cape.
translation: 把一只魔法生物的遗骸带来。这样我就能将它的力量注入对应的神之斗篷中。

english: You're all set! Good luck out there, [player name].
translation: 全部搞定！[player name]，祝你好运。

english: Very nice, [player name]! I shall infuse it as promised.
translation: 非常好，[player name]！我会依照约定将其注入。

english: The guardian chamber has something for you inside  the sparkling pool. You should collect that first.
translation: 守护者密室里，闪耀的水池中有东西给你。你应该先去取那个。

english: You are already hunting one of the beings, do you need another enchanted symbol?
translation: 你已经在狩猎其中一个生物了，你还需要另一个魔法符印吗？

english: For you, always. As a matter of fact I have just acquired a fleet of magic carpets, which operate throughout the Kharidian desert.
translation: 为你，永远。事实上我刚刚获得了一支魔法飞毯车队，在卡里迪安沙漠各地运营。

english: Wow, that sounds great, how about your stall?
translation: 哇，听起来不错，你的摊位怎么样了？

english: Trade is good, but I would like to expand and diversify, but it's proving a little more difficult than I initially thought.
translation: 生意不错，但我想扩大经营并多元化，但事实证明这比我最初想的要困难一些。

english: I think the other merchants in this town are conspiring against me.
translation: 我觉得这个镇上的其他商人在密谋对付我。

english: Oh come on! You're just being paranoid now.
translation: 哦，得了吧！你现在只是疑神疑鬼。

english: Well maybe I can't get any new suppliers then because I'm Pollnivnian.
translation: 嗯，也许我找不到新的供应商是因为我是波尼尼镇人。

english: You're what?
translation: 你是什么？

english: From Pollnivneach.
translation: 来自波尼尼镇。

english: Maybe I could help you then?
translation: 也许我可以帮你？

english: Perhaps you could.
translation: 也许你可以。

english: My friend in Sophanem... Ahh never mind him, maybe we might have a look at him another time.
translation: 我在索法尼恩城的朋友……啊，别管他了，也许我们改天再去找他。

english: Is there anyone else you want me to talk to on your behalf?
translation: 还有其他人需要我代表你去谈吗？

english: There's a blackjack seller in Pollnivneach, a cautious type of guy, not the usual entrepreneurial sort that I would normally deal with, but...
translation: 波尼尼镇有个短棍商人，是个谨慎的人，不是我通常打交道的那种企业家类型，但是……

english: I think that he has a product with real potential...
translation: 我认为他的产品有真正的潜力……

english: What? .... Blackjacks?
translation: 什么？……短棍？

english: Yes, but at the moment the product isn't polished enough, if you could convince him to create a larger variety of weapon I would gladly stock his products.
translation: 是的，但目前产品还不够精良，如果你能说服他制作更多种类的武器，我很乐意进货他的产品。

english: What's in this for me?
translation: 这对我有什么好处？

english: I thought you wanted to help.
translation: 我以为你想帮忙。

english: Of course, but everyone seems to be benefiting here but me.
translation: 当然，但这里似乎除了我之外每个人都在受益。

english: Well the trader gets their product sold, you get your cut, but what do I get?
translation: 商人卖出了产品，你拿到你的分成，但我能得到什么？

english: You get access to more products. Is that not reward enough?
translation: 你能获得更多产品。这还不够作为奖励吗？

english: Hmmm... Perhaps not.
translation: 嗯……也许不够。

english: I'll tell you what then, how about I let you have discounted flights on my magic carpet rides?
translation: 那我告诉你吧，让你在我的魔法飞毯之旅上享受折扣怎么样？

english: Wow that would be great.
translation: 哇，那太好了。

english: Fair enough so, we have a win, win, win situation on our hands then.
translation: 好吧，那么我们手上就有一个三赢的局面了。

english: Didn't we also agree that you would get discounted travel on my magic carpet network?
translation: 我们不是也说好你能在我的魔法飞毯网络上享受折扣旅行吗？

english: Oh ya, I forgot.
translation: 哦，对，我忘了。

english: So what's your problem then?
translation: 那你还有什么问题？

english: I don't have one I guess.
translation: 我猜我没有。

english: Good, that's what I like to hear. Now where were we?
translation: 很好，我就爱听这个。我们刚才说到哪儿了？

english: Well you had better get going, you've a fair bit of travelling ahead of you. Unless you want to make a small purchase from me first?
translation: 你最好出发吧，前面还有不少路程。除非你想先从我这里买点小东西？

english: Ok I'll get on to it.
translation: 好的，我这就去办。

english: I have an old friend - a cloth merchant Siamun, who lives in Sophanem - Do you know the place?
translation: 我有一个老朋友——布料商人西亚蒙，他住在索法尼恩城——你知道那个地方吗？

english: Umm..... Images of cats and priests come to mind. Ah yes! There we go, it's the city of the dead South of Pollnivneach isn't it?
translation: 嗯……脑海里浮现出猫和祭司的画面。啊，对了！那是波尼尼镇南边的亡者之城，对吧？

english: That's the one, well if you could convince him to supply me with some of his merchandise, I would be more than willing to sell them to the masses ...... for a small percentage of course.
translation: 就是那个人。如果你能说服他向我提供一些他的周边商品，我非常乐意把它们卖给大众……当然是要抽一小部分成。

english: I think I need just one more product type, something magical ... now what could I stock that's magical, has large demand and a pretty good profit margin...
translation: 我想我还需要一种产品类型，一些魔法物品……现在我能进货什么魔法物品，既有大量需求又有相当不错的利润率呢……

english: How about runes?
translation: 符文怎么样？

english: Yes, that would be perfect, but who could I get that would supply? There really seems to be a gap in the market in the desert but I don't know anyone in that line of business.
translation: 是的，那太完美了，但我能找到谁供货呢？沙漠里似乎真的存在市场空白，但我不认识做那一行的人。

english: Hang on, I know somebody called Aubury, decent fella. I helped him out a while back. Perhaps I could approach him about the idea.
translation: 等等，我认识一个叫奥伯里的人，是个不错的小伙。我之前帮过他。也许我可以找他说说这个想法。

english: Oh yes, the rune seller from Varrock. That would be perfect. He's far enough away that he wouldn't end up competing with himself.
translation: 哦，对，维洛克城的符文商人。那太完美了。他离得够远，不会和自己竞争。

english: Well the rune market is a limited one, if I were to sell his runes from a location nearby his shop, then I would take part of his market share so he would in fact not benefit from me selling runes.
translation: 符文市场是有限的，如果我在他店铺附近的地方卖他的符文，那我就会分走他的一部分市场份额，所以实际上他并不会因为我的销售而受益。

english: Ah ha I think I know where this is going. So because you're located far enough away from him you will take up someone else's share in the market and Aubury will make more money as a result.
translation: 啊哈，我想我明白你的意思了。因为你离他足够远，你会抢占别人的市场份额，而奥伯里因此能赚更多钱。

english: Very well anticipated.
translation: 好预判。

english: Ok I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好，我看看我能做什么。

english: ~Sigh.
translation: ~叹气。

english: Well, I always fancied that I could be a great draper, but the way things are looking that's not about to happen any time soon.
translation: 唉，我一直觉得自己能成为一个了不起的布料商，但照目前的情况看来，这件事近期内是没指望了。

english: Is there anything I could do to help?
translation: 有什么我能帮上忙的吗？

english: I have a friend - well, actually more of an acquaintance - who lives in Sophanem, some way to the south of here, and who may be able to help. But, from what I've heard, no one can enter or leave the city.
translation: 我有个朋友——好吧，其实更像是认识的人——住在南边的索法尼恩城，他那边也许能帮上忙。但据我所知，现在没人能进出那座城。

english: Maybe I could give it a look.
translation: 也许我可以去看看。

english: Is there any chance of getting you to look up a merchant to supply me?
translation: 有没有办法让你找个商人来供货给我？

english: Who did you want me to talk to again?
translation: 你刚才是要我找谁来着？

english: Go see Siamun in Sophanem about some clothes.
translation: 去索法尼恩城找西亚蒙拿些衣服。

english: Right, so I'll go see Siamun of Sophanem.
translation: 好，那我就去索法尼恩城找西亚蒙。

english: Could you talk to your friend Aubury in Varrock about supplying me with runes?
translation: 你能跟你在维洛克城的朋友奥伯里谈谈，让他给我提供符文吗？

english: Hmm, that could work out quite well. Varrock is always quite busy, so I might try to get a couple of other things done while I'm there.
translation: 嗯，这倒挺不错。维洛克城总是很繁忙，我可能会趁在那里的时候顺便做几件别的事。

english: Don't tarry there too long, I'm quite anxious to get a rune store open before anyone else in this area.
translation: 别在那里待太久，我很想在这个区域其他人之前，赶快开一间符文店。

english: In Pollnivneach go and talk to the blackjack seller. Convince him to supply me with his produce.
translation: 去波尼尼镇找短棍商人谈谈。说服他给我提供他的产品。

english: Any ideas how I should go about that?
translation: 你有没有什么好点子该怎么做？

english: You're a bright chap. I'm sure you'll work something out.
translation: 你是个聪明人，我相信你能想出办法来的。

english: Ya, I'll get to it soon.
translation: 是啊，我很快就会去处理。

english: Actually, I'm here with a business proposal from Ali Morrisane.
translation: 其实，我是带着阿里.莫里桑的一项商业提案来的。

english: Ali who?
translation: 阿里谁？

english: Ali Morrisane, a salesman of great repute based in Al Kharid.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑，一位常驻阿尔卡里德城的大名鼎鼎的推销员。

english: What is this proposal then?
translation: 那这个提案是什么？

english: He wants to set up a rune-selling franchise in the markets of Al Kharid and he wants you to supply him with the stock.
translation: 他想在阿尔卡里德城的市场里开一个符文销售特许经营店，希望你能给他供货。

english: Why doesn't he get his own runes and sell them?
translation: 他为什么不自己去弄符文来卖？

english: His talents don't lie in that area. What he's good at is selling things, and lots of them.
translation: 他的才能不在那里。他擅长的是卖东西，而且卖得很多。

english: Hmm, interesting... So let's get this straight, he wants me to supply him with runes, which he will sell, and send me the profits?
translation: 嗯，有意思……那我确认一下，他要我供应他符文，他负责卖，然后把利润给我？

english: Nearly. He will charge a small commission on the runes.
translation: 差不多。他会在符文上抽取一点小额佣金。

english: Do you think that it will work? Will people actually buy these runes off him?
translation: 你认为这行得通吗？真的会有人跟他买这些符文？

english: I wouldn't be surprised. Supply and demand are his rune essence and ore.
translation: 我一点也不意外。供给和需求就是他的符文精华和矿石。

english: Now this is very important, is he trustworthy?
translation: 这点非常重要，他值得信任吗？

english: Yes, I believe so. Trust is a key part of commerce and something, which I doubt he would neglect.
translation: 是的，我相信他。信任是商业的关键，我想他不会忽视这一点。

english: Fair enough, I'll trust your judgement.
translation: 说得有理，我相信你的判断。

english: So you'll supply him with runes then?
translation: 所以你愿意供应他符文了？

english: Well if he's half as good a salesman as you suggest I should have no problem in funding my research and maybe even redecorating this place.
translation: 嗯，如果他真有你说的那么会卖东西，那我应该就能有足够资金来资助我的研究，甚至还能重新装修这个地方。

english: Oh, sorry [player name], I didn't recognise you for a second, you're back again so soon. Have you spoken to Ali Morrisane yet about the runes?
translation: 噢，抱歉[player name]，我一下子没认出你，你又这么快就回来了。你跟阿里.莫里桑谈过符文的事了吗？

english: Umm... not yet, I'll try to get around to doing that soon.
translation: 嗯……还没，我会尽快找时间去办这件事。

english: Great! Now, do want to buy some runes?
translation: 太好了！那么，你想买些符文吗？

english: Good job on getting the rune shipments sorted. I'm just receiving the first of them. Though there seems to be a funny sort of locking mechanism on them, which I haven't completely figured out.
translation: 干得好，符文货运的事情搞定了。我刚收到第一批货。不过上面好像有一种奇怪的锁定机制，我还没完全搞懂。

english: No problem. I might have a look at it later.
translation: 没问题。我晚点也许可以来看看。

english: Hmmm... This lock looks like it may be impossible to priseopen.
translation: 嗯...这把锁看起来可能撬不开。

english: Hello. Could I interest you in a Blackjack?
translation: 你好。想不想来一把短棍？

english: Can I interest you in a proposal?
translation: 有兴趣听听一个提案吗？

english: What are we talking about here? Nothing dodgy I hope. I don't like anything dodgy, I had enough of that sort of thing when the bandits and those rogue Menaphites were running things here, so I packed up my things and left.
translation: 我们在这里谈论什么？我希望不是什么可疑的事。我不喜欢任何可疑的事，当强盗和那些盗贼梅纳菲特人在这里管事的时候，我已经受够了那种事，所以我收拾东西离开了。

english: No no nothing of the sort, a friend of mine Ali Morrisane, have you ever heard of him?
translation: 不不不，完全不是那种事。我的一个朋友阿里.莫里桑，你听说过他吗？

english: Have I what? He's my idol, he's the greatest salesman in all of Gielinor. Word has it that he even sold...
translation: 我听过吗？他是我的偶像，他是整个吉列诺最伟大的商人。消息都说他甚至卖过……

english: ...yeah yeah, sand to the Bedabin. Hmpf!! I have heard that story more times that I care for.. Anyway he has a proposal for you...
translation: ……是啊是啊，把沙子卖给贝达宾人。哼！！这个故事我听太多遍了，听到都烦了……总之他有一个提案给你……

english: I'm all ears. Does he want to take me on as an apprentice?
translation: 我洗耳恭听。他是不是想收我做学徒？

english: No no nothing of the sort.
translation: 不不不，完全不是这回事。

english: He sees quite a bit of potential in your product.
translation: 他非常看好你的产品潜力。

english: The urchins of the town do too, they're always trying to steal my products.
translation: 镇上的那些小混混也看好，他们总是试着偷我的产品。

english: Yes, but Ali says if he were to stock your products he would need a larger variation of product.
translation: 没错，但阿里说如果他要在店里卖你的产品，他需要更多样化的商品。

english: I don't know. I'm quite happy with the product that I'm making at the moment.
translation: 我不知道。我对现在做的产品很满意。

english: Hmm.. Ali did voice some concerns about you. He said you were an over cautious individual and ...
translation: 嗯……阿里确实说过对你有些顾虑。他说你是个过于谨慎的人，而且……

english: He did?
translation: 他真这么说？

english: Look will you create a larger variety of blackjacks or not?
translation: 听着，你到底要不要制作更多种类的短棍？

english: What do I have to do to convince you that you should make a larger variety?
translation: 我要怎么做才能说服你，让你觉得应该做更多样化的产品？

english: Well I suppose if you could demonstrate to me that they weren't up to the job.
translation: 嗯，我想如果你能向我证明它们不够好用的话。

english: Hmm... I'll have to think of a cunning plan.
translation: 嗯……我得想个巧妙的计划。

english: What was what? Oh I must have been thinking out loud again, sorry.
translation: 什么怎么了？哦，我一定又不小心把心里话说出来了，抱歉。

english: Psst... Player Come here.
translation: 喂……玩家，你过来一下。

english: I bet you couldn't knock me out with your blackjack.
translation: 我赌你用你的短棍打不倒我。

english: I reckon I could.
translation: 我觉得我可以。

english: I'll tell you what, if you can't knock me out with one blow, you should make better blackjacks.
translation: 我跟你说，如果你一击打不倒我，你就该去做更好的短棍。

english: Nah, I don't like the sounds of that. It leaves a lot up to chance.
translation: 不，我不喜欢这个提议。这太靠运气了。

english: Ok, ok, how about two blows to the head?
translation: 好吧好吧，那打头两下怎么样？

english: Are you sure? I could possibly kill you?
translation: 你确定吗？我可能会打死你？

english: Umm... on second thoughts I might give it a skip. I just had my hair done, I wouldn't want to mess it up.
translation: 嗯……我改变主意了，还是算了。我刚弄好头发，不想把它弄乱。

english: Phew! Sighs with relief. At last the voice of reason speaks.
translation: 呼！松了一口气。终于有理智的声音说话了。

english: Now if you don't mind I'll be getting back to work. Thank you.
translation: 好了，如果你不介意的话，我要回去工作了。谢谢你。

english: I'm sure. No pain no gain. Grrr!
translation: 我很确定。不劳无获。吼！

english: You adventurers are crazy.
translation: 你们这些冒险者真是疯了。

english: Ow! Ha! You didn't knock me down.
translation: 哎哟！哈！你没打倒我。

english: Pah, you didn't even draw blood.
translation: 哼，你连血都没打出来。

english: Yeeeoouch that hurt! I'm still standing thoughYou can't knock me down.
translation: 呀啊啊好痛！但我还站着，你打不倒我。

english: You really are truly mad.
translation: 你真的是疯了。

english: Are you going to hit me again? I really want to get this over with.
translation: 你还要再打一次吗？我真想赶快结束这件事。

english: Either your head is thicker than it looks or else I need to rework my blackjack.
translation: 要嘛是你的头比看起来还硬，要嘛就是我得重新设计我的短棍。

english: Umm... definitely the blackjack. You just about fight off another bout of dizziness and nausea.
translation: 嗯……肯定是短棍的问题。你刚刚才勉强压下又一阵头晕和恶心。

english: I suppose I'll just have to modify the blackjack so that it has a better attack.
translation: 我想我只好改装一下那把短棍，让它有更好的攻击力了。

english: Great, so I take it you will be supplying Ali Morrisane with the new variety of blackjack then?
translation: 太好了，所以我假设你会供应阿里.莫里桑新品种的短棍了？

english: Yes, yes. I'll start shipping it by carpet as soon as the first batch is ready.
translation: 对对对。等第一批货准备好，我就会用地毯运输开始发货。

english: Word has it that you're trying to get the blackjack man to change his kit.
translation: 听说你在设法让那个短棍商人更换他的装备。

english: Hey there I heard that you were trying to get the blackjack man to change his gear.
translation: 嘿，我听说你想让那个短棍商人换他的装备。

english: Do you forget who you're talking to? I'm the fastest and sneakiest urchin in this town.
translation: 你忘了你在跟谁说话吗？我可是这镇上最快最鬼祟的小混混。

english: Ok, so what's it to you then?
translation: 好，那你觉得怎么样？

english: Well it suits my purpose nearly as much as yours if the blackjack seller produces a wider variety of wares.
translation: 嗯，如果那个短棍商人能生产更多样化的商品，这对我的好处几乎不亚于你。

english: Well chances are, he'll produce some even higher quality items for me to steal
translation: 很有可能，他会做出更高品质的东西让我去偷。

english: Aha so if you can rob the blackjack seller and get away with it, it should prove to him that his blackjack isn't up to the job?
translation: 啊哈，所以如果你能抢劫那个短棍商人并且成功脱身，应该就能向他证明他的短棍不够好用了？

english: There's hope for you yet.
translation: 你还有点希望。

english: Seeing as we've worked successfully together in the past I will only charge you 100 gold.
translation: 鉴于我们过去合作愉快，我只收你一百金币。

english: Seeing as you owe me from the last bit of work we did together this is going to cost you 300 gold.
translation: 鉴于你上次那件工作还欠我人情，这次要收你三百金币。

english: Pity, maybe we can do it again sometime.
translation: 真可惜，也许我们以后还有机会再合作。

english: Woah! That's far too much.
translation: 哇！那太多了。

english: Fair enough, here you go.
translation: 好吧，给你。

english: Now walk up to the merchant, engage him in conversation and leave the rest up to me.
translation: 现在，走到那商人面前，跟他搭话，剩下的就交给我了。

english: Hi, I'm back.
translation: 嗨，我回来了。

english: What is it now?
translation: 现在又是什么事？

english: Yoink!
translation: 嘿咻！

english: Hey come back you thief!
translation: 嘿，回来，你这个盗贼！

english: That pesky little urchin has done it again! I can't believe it he's managed to rob me again.
translation: 那个讨厌的小鬼头又得手了！真不敢相信，他又一次抢了我。

english: Well maybe you should modify the blackjack to have better defensive qualities.
translation: 也许你应该改造一下短棍，让它有更好的防御性能。

english: I might as well. Next time I'll get him.
translation: 我也这么想。下次我一定能抓到他。

english: So I take it you will be supplying Ali Morrisane with the new variety of blackjack then?
translation: 那么，你会向阿里.莫里桑提供新品种的短棍了？

english: Have you checked with Ali Morrisane whether my blackjacks are selling or not?
translation: 你有没有跟阿里.莫里桑确认过我的短棍卖得怎么样？

english: Not yet, I have a few thing to do first.
translation: 还没有，我还有一些事情要先处理。

english: Well I would be very grateful if you could have a talk with him sooner rather than later, I am still a little nervous about the new variation of my blackjack.
translation: 嗯，如果你能尽快跟他谈谈，我会非常感激。我对短棍的新变体还是有点紧张。

english: I've only got one model in stock at the moment. It's a willow black jack which I'd be willing to let go for 600 gold coins.
translation: 我目前只有一种型号的存货。是一把柳木黑杰克，我愿意以600金币的价格出售。

english: What are we talking about here? Nothing dodgy I hope. I don't like anything dodgy, I had enough of that sort of thing when the bandits and those rogue Menaphites were running things here, so I packed up my things
translation: 我们在说什么？我希望不是什么见不得人的事。我不喜欢任何见不得人的事，当强盗和那些盗贼梅纳菲特人在这里管事的时候，我受够了那种事，所以我收拾了我的东西

english: Have I what? He's my idol, he's the greatest salesman in all of Gielinor. Word has it that he even sold....
translation: 我有没有什么？他是我的偶像，他是整个吉莱诺最伟大的推销员。有传言说他甚至卖掉了....

english: and left.
translation: 然后离开了。

english: I'm not too sure, I'm quite happy to stick with what I've got unless, I had a good reason to change.
translation: 我不太确定，我很乐意坚持用我现有的，除非我有充分的理由去改变。

english: Ah, it's you again [player name]. Tell me how are the blackjack sales going?
translation: 啊，又是你啊 [player name]。告诉我黑杰克卖得怎么样？

english: Oh sorry [player name]. I mistook you for another customer.
translation: 哦，对不起 [player name]。我把你误认为是另一位顾客了。

english: Phew!Sighs with relief. At last the voice of reason speaks.
translation: 呼！松了一口气。终于有人讲道理了。

english: Hah! Did you see the face on the blackjack seller! Ha boyo! I had to move quick to get out of the way of his blackjack.
translation: 哈！你看到那个短棍商人的脸了吗！哈，小子！我不得不迅速移动以躲开他的短棍。

english: You did well. I thought he hit you when swung his blackjack at you.
translation: 你做得很好。我还以为他朝你挥棍的时候打中你了。

english: Ya he nearly did. Boyo, does my head still hurt.
translation: 是啊，差点就打中了。伙计，我的头现在还疼呢。

english: You mean he hit you?
translation: 你是说他打中你了？

english: Barely, the trick is in moving with the blow.
translation: 勉强没打中，诀窍是顺着打击的方向移动。

english: I might bear that in mind for next time.
translation: 下次我会记住的。

english: Fantastic job on the blackjacks. I started getting the first batches of them a short time ago, and they've being flying off the shelves, although the demand seems to be dropping off a little.
translation: 短棍做得太棒了。我不久前才开始收到第一批，它们很快就卖光了，尽管需求似乎略有下降。

english: Not too badly, I hope.
translation: 希望不会太糟。

english: No, no, they're still selling fine, but if you could perhaps convince the blackjack man to send a different variety the next time you see him, I would be more than happy.
translation: 不不，它们卖得还不错，但如果你下次见到那个短棍商人的时候，能说服他送一些不同品种的货，我会非常高兴。

english: I should like to have a look at them, at some stage.
translation: 我希望能找个时间看看它们。

english: Well than what do you need?
translation: 那么你需要什么？

english: Either get me 3 pots of dye, or 3 animal pelts of the same variety and whatever you do, don't bring me banknotes!
translation: 要么给我3罐染料，要么给我3张相同种类的动物皮，无论如何，不要给我带票据！

english: I'll tell you what, get me 3 pots of dye and I'll change the type of garments I'm sending to Ali and, remember, I won't accept banknotes.
translation: 我跟你说，给我拿3罐染料，我就改变我寄给阿里的服装类型，记住，我不收票据。

english: Three pots of dye, no banknotes. Can you remember that?
translation: 三罐染料，不要票据。你能记住吗？

english: I tell you what, get me 3 animal pelts of the same variety and I'll change the shipments around and, remember, I won't accept banknotes.
translation: 我告诉你，给我带3张同一种类的动物毛皮，我就调整发货，记住，我不收票据。

english: Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep. Simpler still get me 3 pots of dye and, remember, I won't accept banknotes.
translation: 只需给我3张牛皮，3张狼皮或蛇皮，或者3只羊的羊毛。更简单的是给我3罐染料，记住，我不收票据。

english: Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep and, remember, I won't accept banknotes.
translation: 只需给我带3张牛皮、3张狼皮或蛇皮，或者3只羊的羊毛，记住，我不收票据。

english: Well I would be very much obliged it you could have a talk with him sooner rather than later, I'm not all that sure of the trustworthiness of those carpet men.
translation: 嗯，如果你能尽快跟他谈谈，我会非常感激，我对那些地毯商人不太放心。

english: Thank you adventurer. I will get my goods up to that merchant thief Ali Morrisane as quickly as possible.
translation: 谢谢你，冒险者。我会尽快把货物送到那个商人盗贼阿里.莫里桑那里。

english: Three pots of dye, no certs. Can you remember that?
translation: 三罐染料，不要证书。你能记住吗？

english: Just get me 3 cowhides, 3 wolf or snake skins or the shearings of 3 sheep and whatever you do, don't bring me any certs.
translation: 给我拿 3 张牛皮、3 张狼皮或蛇皮，或者 3 只羊的羊毛，无论如何，别给我带任何凭证来。

english: Keh! Get away from me. The only potion or solutions I'll have anything to with are dyes.
translation: 咳！离我远点。我唯一会碰的药水或溶液就是染料。

english: Siamun's clothes seem to have really struck a chord with the locals in Al Kharid. Menaphite culture seems to be taking off here, rumour has it that one of Prince Ali's servants bought him one of Siamun's robes.
translation: 西亚蒙的衣服似乎真的引起了阿尔卡里德城当地人的共鸣。梅奈法特文化似乎在这里兴起，有传言说阿里王子的一名仆人给他买了一件西亚蒙的长袍。

english: Wow, that sounds positive.
translation: 哇，听起来很积极。

english: Quite, if I don't say so myself. But in order to keep things fresh, the next time you're in Sophanem, could you ask that cranky old so-and-so Siamun to produce a new line of clothing?
translation: 确实，就算不是我自己说的。但为了保持新鲜感，下次你去索法尼恩的时候，能不能让那个脾气暴躁的老家伙西亚蒙生产新的服装系列？

english: Sure, why not. The Sultan himself might even buy some of the new range.
translation: 当然，为什么不呢。苏丹本人甚至可能会买一些新系列。

english: That would be the day.
translation: 那真是太阳打西边出来了。

english: [Player name], I would like to commend you on all the selfless help you have given me.
translation: [Player name]，我想称赞你给予我的所有无私帮助。

english: It was nothing, really.
translation: 没什么，真的。

english: I think you underestimate your efforts. Anyway, as a token of my gratitude I have told all my magic carpet attendants to allow you to travel on the carpets at a discounted rate.
translation: 我认为你低估了你的努力。无论如何，作为感激的表示，我已经告诉我所有的魔法飞毯服务员允许你以折扣价乘坐飞毯。

english: Really, Ali, there is no need.
translation: 真的，阿里，没必要。

english: I insist.
translation: 我坚持。

english: Well, I could dump this bucket of water over him. That would sober him up a little...
translation: 嗯，我可以把这桶水倒在他身上。那会让他清醒一点...

english: Hey, Skippy!
translation: 嘿，斯基皮！

english: Ahhhhhhhhhhgh! That's cold! Are you trying to kill me?
translation: 啊——！好冷！你是想杀了我吗？

english: Nope, just sober you up. Memory coming back yet?
translation: 不，只是想让你清醒一下。记忆恢复了吗？

english: No. But I could do with a bowl of tea to warm myself up a bit. Go grab me one and we'll talk.
translation: 没有。但我可以喝碗茶暖暖身子。去给我弄一碗来，我们再谈。

english: Any particular type of tea?
translation: 有什么特别想喝的茶吗？

english: Nettle for preference. Just make sure it's hot.
translation: 最好是荨麻茶。记得要热的。

english: And don't throw it at me!
translation: 还有，别泼我身上！

english: What's your problem? You're all clean now.
translation: 你有什么毛病？你现在干净了。

english: Gaah! Don't drench me again!
translation: 嘎！别再把我弄湿了！

english: Hey! I only did that once! Try not to be such a big baby!
translation: 嘿！我只做过那一次！别像个大宝宝一样！

english: So what are you here for then?
translation: 那你来这儿干嘛？

english: No real reason. I just thought I would check up on you is all.
translation: 没什么特别的原因。我只是想来看看你怎么样了。

english: Well, I'm still wet, still cold and still waiting on that nettle tea.
translation: 好吧，我现在还是湿的，还是冷的，还在等那碗荨麻茶。

english: I've come to give you your tea.
translation: 我来给你送茶了。

english: Excellent! I was thinking I was going to freeze out here!
translation: 太好了！我还以为我要冻死在这儿了！

english: Ohhhhh...
Not so loud...I think I have a hangover...
translation: 别那么大声……我好像宿醉了……

english: Great...Well, I doubt you can remember anything through a hangover. What a waste of nettle tea...
translation: 太好了……好吧，我看你宿醉着也记不起什么。真是浪费了荨麻茶……

english: Hey! A little sympathy here?
translation: 嘿！就不能有点同情心吗？

english: Owwowwoww... must remember not to shout...
translation: 嗷嗷嗷……得记住不能喊……

english: Look, I do know a hangover cure. If you can get me a bucket of the stuff I think I'll be ok.
translation: 听着，我确实知道一种解宿醉的方子。你要是能给我弄一桶那玩意儿来，我想我就没事了。

english: Wait... is this cure a bucket of chocolate milk and snape grass?
translation: 等等……这解药是一桶巧克力牛奶和斯内普草吗？

english: Yes! That's the stuff!
translation: 没错！就是这玩意儿！

english: Ahhh. Yes, I've made some of that stuff before. I should be able to get you some, no problem.
translation: 啊。是的，我以前做过一些那东西。我应该能给你弄到，没问题。

english: So what is it you need?
translation: 那你需要什么？

english: A bucket of milk with chocolate ground into it, with a handful of snape grass thrown in on top.
translation: 一桶牛奶，里面磨进巧克力，再在上面加一把斯内普草。

english: What? Run that past me again?
translation: 什么？再说一遍？

english: Take a bucket of milk, a bar of chocolate and some snape grass.
translation: 拿一桶牛奶、一块巧克力和一些斯内普草。

english: Grind the chocolate with a mortar and pestle.
translation: 用研钵和杵把巧克力磨碎。

english: Add the chocolate powder to the milk, then add the snape grass.
translation: 把巧克力粉加到牛奶里，然后加入斯内普草。

english: Then bring it here and I will drink it.
translation: 然后带到这里来，我喝掉它。

english: The end, and we all live happily ever after. Got it?
translation: 结束，我们都过上了幸福快乐的生活。明白了吗？

english: Egad! Don't you know not to shout around a guy with a hangover?
translation: 天哪！你不知道在宿醉的人旁边不能大喊大叫吗？

english: Ahhhhhg...No more shouting for me...
translation: 啊啊啊……我再也不喊了……

english: What is it anyway?
translation: 到底是什么事？

english: I just came back to ask you something.
translation: 我只是回来问你点事。

english: How do I make that hangover cure again?
translation: 那个宿醉解药是怎么做的来着？

english: Give me strength...Here's what you do. Pay attention!
translation: 给我力量吧……听好了。注意听！

english: You take a bucket of milk, a bar of chocolate and some snape grass.
translation: 你拿一桶牛奶、一块巧克力和一些斯内普草。

english: Grind the chocolate with a pestle and mortar.
translation: 用研钵和杵把巧克力磨碎。

english: Are you likely to remember that or should I go get some crayons and draw you a picture?
translation: 你能记住吗？还是我去拿些蜡笔给你画张图？

english: Hey! I remember it now, ok! See you in a bit.
translation: 嘿！我现在记住了，行了吧！一会儿见。

english: Why do they call you Skippy?
translation: 他们为什么叫你斯基皮？

english: I think it may have something to do with my near- constant raving about mudskippers.
translation: 我想这可能跟我几乎总在胡言乱语地谈论弹涂鱼有关。

english: That or it's something to do with that time with the dress and the field full of daisies...
translation: 要么就是跟那次穿着裙子在满是雏菊的田野里的事有关……

english: Well Skippy, you will no doubt be glad to hear that I got you your hangover cure!
translation: 好吧，斯基皮，你听到我给你弄来了宿醉解药，肯定会很高兴吧！

english: Gimme!
translation: 给我！

english: Ahhhhhhhhhhhhhhh...
Much better...
translation: 好多了……

english: Feeling better?
translation: 感觉好点了吗？

english: Considerably.
translation: 好多了。

english: Then tell me where the mudskippers are!
translation: 那就告诉我弹涂鱼在哪里！

english: I wish you wouldn't go looking for them. Those vicious killers will tear you apart.
translation: 我真希望你别去找它们。那些凶残的杀手会把你撕碎的。

english: It's all becoming clear to me now...
translation: 我现在全想起来了……

english: I was fishing using a Fishing Explosive...
translation: 我当时正在用钓鱼炸药钓鱼……

english: A Fishing Explosive?
translation: 钓鱼炸药？

english: Well, Slayer Masters sell these highly volatile potions for killing underwater creatures.
translation: 嗯，杀戮大师会出售这些用于杀死水下生物的高挥发性药水。

english: If you don't feel like lobbing a net about all day you can use them to fish with...
translation: 如果你不想整天扔网，你可以用它们来钓鱼……

english: But this time I was startled by what I thought was a giant mudskipper.
translation: 但这次我被一个我以为是大弹涂鱼的东西吓了一跳。

english: What it was, infact, was a...
translation: 实际上，那是一个……

english: Dramatic Pause...
translation: 戏剧性的停顿……

english: A Mogre!
translation: 一个莫格雷食人魔！

english: What exactly is a Mogre?
translation: 莫格雷食人魔到底是什么？

english: A Mogre is a type of Ogre that spends most of its time underwater.
translation: 莫格雷食人魔是一种大部分时间都待在水下的食人魔。

english: They hunt giant mudskippers by wearing their skins and swimming close until they can attack them.
translation: 它们通过披上弹涂鱼的皮，游近后发动攻击来猎杀大弹涂鱼。

english: When I used the Fishing Explosive I scared off all the fish, and so the Mogre got out of the water to express its extreme displeasure.
translation: 当我使用钓鱼炸药时，我吓跑了所有的鱼，所以那个莫格雷食人魔就爬出水来，表达它极度的不满。

english: With an iron mace.
translation: 用一把铁制钉锤。

english: I take it the head injury is responsible for the staggering and yelling?
translation: 我猜你走路摇摇晃晃、大喊大叫是因为头部受伤？

english: My addiction to almost-lethal alcohol did that.
translation: 我对几乎致命的酒精上瘾才是原因。

english: But if you are set on finding these Mogres just head south from here until you find Mudskipper Point.
translation: 但如果你执意要找到这些莫格雷食人魔，就从这里往南走，直到你找到弹涂鱼角。

english: When you arrive on the mainland you will be a Deadman. If you die when skulled or if you are killed by another Deadman you will lose the most valuable items from your bank.
translation: 当你到达大陆时，你将是一名亡灵。如果你在头骨状态下死亡，或者被其他亡灵杀死，你将失去银行中最有价值的物品。

english: You will also lose some of your experience. The amount varies depending on a few factors.
translation: 你还会失去一些经验值。具体数量取决于几个因素。

english: Do you have any experience with Deadman Mode?
translation: 你对死寂模式有经验吗？

english: Hello [player name], welcome to DeadScape!
translation: 你好，[player name]，欢迎来到死寂之地！

english: Hello [player name], welcome to Velos!
translation: 你好，[player name]，欢迎来到维洛斯！

english: I'll give you a quick reminder of the mechanics which make Deadman Mode, you can find a full guide on our website!
translation: 我来快速提醒你一下死寂模式的机制，你可以在我们的网站上找到完整的指南！

english: PvP is enabled across the whole map, except for major towns and areas.
translation: 除了主要城镇和区域外，整个地图都启用了玩家对战。

english: A death in Deadman mode is no joke. If you die to a player you will lose the 10 most valuable stacks of items from your bank to a bank raid
translation: 在死寂模式中死亡可不是闹着玩的。如果你被玩家杀死，你将失去银行中最有价值的 10 组物品，它们会被银行劫掠。

english: You can protect up to 10 items by placing them in your safe deposit box. Items in your safe deposit box will not be lost to a player who kills you, unlike those found in your bank ....
translation: 你可以将最多 10 件物品放入安全寄存箱来保护它们。存放在安全寄存箱中的物品不会因被玩家杀死而丢失，而银行里的东西则不然……

english: Deadman Mode is very competitive, so it is important to be prepared! Since there are no PvP combat level restrictions, it is highly advantageous to start training early to have a competitive combat level.
translation: 死寂模式非常具有竞技性，所以做好准备很重要！由于没有玩家对战等级限制，尽早开始训练以获得有竞争力的战斗等级非常有利。

english: Deadman mode is a PK oriented game mode however Player Killers will always need supplies! This makes skilling one of the best ways to obtain wealth in the game!
translation: 死寂模式是一个以玩家击杀为主的游戏模式，但玩家杀手们总是需要补给品！这使得技能训练成为游戏中获得财富的最佳途径之一！

english: That's it from me, however, you can find a full guide on our website if you didn't quite understand something.
translation: 我就说这么多了，不过如果你有不明白的地方，可以在我们的网站上找到完整的指南。

english: If you die with a skull inside a guarded zone, you will lose 10% of your experience in protected skills in addition to the existing item and XP loss.
translation: 如果你在守卫区域内带着头骨死亡，除了现有的物品和经验损失外，你还会失去受保护技能经验的 10%。

english: When a player attacks any other player that does not have a skull emblem, that player will receive a skull and a countdown timer which varies.
translation: 当一名玩家攻击任何没有头骨标志的其他玩家时，该玩家将获得一个头骨和一个时间不等的倒计时器。

english: When a player attacks any other player that does not have a skull emblem, that player will receive a skull and a countdown timer starting at 15 minutes
translation: 当一名玩家攻击任何没有头骨标志的其他玩家时，该玩家将获得一个头骨和一个从 15 分钟开始的倒计时器。

english: The mudskipper-eating monsters are to be found at Mudskipper point?
translation: 那些吃弹涂鱼的怪物在弹涂鱼角？

english: Shock!
translation: 震惊！

english: Thanks. I'll be careful.
translation: 谢谢。我会小心的。

english: Hello? Perhaps you can understand me? If you can hear me that is?
translation: 喂？你能听懂我的话吗？要是你能听见就好了？

english: Oh, hello there! Yes, I can understand you!
translation: 哦，你好！没错，我能听懂你的话！

english: You can? You can! How wonderful! It has been a long while since anyone came by that could understand what I wanted to say to them. You wouldn't happen to have a moment to help me out would you?
translation: 你能听懂？你真的能！太好了！已经很久没人能明白我想说什么了。你能不能稍微花点时间帮我个忙？

english: I could certainly try to help... what did you say your name was again?
translation: 我当然可以试试……你刚才说你叫什么名字来着？

english: Bernina! I don't think I did mention it. I haven't had to do an introduction for a while now!
translation: 我叫贝尔尼娜！我想我没提过。我已经很久没做过自我介绍了！

english: It's lovely to meet you, Bernina. I'm [player name]. How can I help you?
translation: 很高兴认识你，贝尔尼娜。我是[player name]。我能帮你什么？

english: It's very unfortunate really. I died.
translation: 说起来真的很不幸。我死了。

english: Ah, that explains the incorporeality. What happened?
translation: 啊，这就解释了你为什么是这副虚无缥缈的样子。发生什么事了？

english: I was a crew member on board a ship sailing out of Fortis. We got caught in a storm and sailed too close to the rocks around Shipwreck Cove. I'm sure you can guess the results...
translation: 我以前是一艘从福蒂斯出发的船上的船员。我们遇上了风暴，结果航行得太靠近沉船湾附近的礁石了。我想你也能猜到后果……

english: The thing is though, after I died, I was not guided to Mictl. I remained, but in this form. I saw the remains of our ship, and I saw some of those salvagers from the east claiming whatever they wanted.
translation: 问题是，我死后，并没有被引导到米克特尔。我留了下来，但以这种形态。我看到了我们船的遗骸，还看到一些来自东方的打捞者在索取他们想要的任何东西。

english: One of them took a diamond necklace from my body. It was very precious to me. It should not remain in the hands of a thief.
translation: 其中有个人从我身上拿走了一条钻石项链。那东西对我来说非常珍贵。它不应该落在一个盗贼手里。

english: I make no promises, but I'll try to recover it.
translation: 我不能保证什么，但我会试着把它找回来。

english: Thank you, [player name]. I heard the one that took it being called Jasper by one of his fellow salvagers. He is the one you will need to find.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。我听到拿走项链的那个家伙被另一个打捞者叫做贾斯珀。他就是你需要找的人。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Have you got any leads on my necklace yet?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。有我的项链的线索了吗？

english: That salvager, Jasper, hopefully still has it. I'm sure you'll find him with the rest of his people. They live to the east of here.
translation: 那个打捞者，贾斯珀，应该还拿着它。我肯定你能在他的同伴那里找到他。他们就住在这东边。

english: I'm an adventurer, and I'm looking for someone. Is your name Jasper?
translation: 我是个冒险者，我在找一个人。你叫贾斯珀吗？

english: It is... How did you know that?
translation: 是我……你怎么知道的？

english: I'm looking for a lost item and I think you might be able to help me.
translation: 我在找一件丢失的东西，我觉得你可能帮得上忙。

english: I'm... familiar with lost items.
translation: 我对……丢失的东西……挺熟的。

english: Have you come across a diamond necklace? One belonging to an unfortunate passenger involved in a nearby shipwreck?
translation: 你有没有见过一条钻石项链？属于附近一起沉船事故中一位不幸乘客的那条？

english: You wouldn't happen to be talking about... that necklace?
translation: 你说的……该不会是……那条项链吧？

english: That necklace?
translation: 那条项链？

english: A necklace crossed my path a while back, and everything suddenly started to go wrong for me. It was as if I was haunted by some spiteful spirit.
translation: 前段时间有条项链落到了我手里，然后我的一切就开始不顺了。就好像被某个恶毒的灵魂缠上了一样。

english: I did what I do best and I flogged it to some chap that came wandering through. He seemed very keen to buy it. Luck's been much better since!
translation: 我干了我最擅长的事，把它卖给了一个路过的家伙。他看起来很想买下它。从那以后运气就好多了！

english: This person you sold it to... Any idea where I can find him?
translation: 你卖给的那个人……你知道我在哪能找到他吗？

english: He looked like some sort of mountain climber. He said he was setting out on some sort of journey that was very important to him.
translation: 他看起来像个登山者。他说他正要出发去完成一趟对他来说非常重要的旅程。

english: I see... Thanks.
translation: 我明白了……谢谢。

english: Still looking for that necklace? I don't have it any more. I don't want anything to do with it!
translation: 还在找那条项链？我已经没有它了。我可不想再跟它有任何瓜葛！

english: The person you sold it to... Any idea where I can find him?
translation: 你卖给的那个人……你知道我在哪能找到他吗？

english: I have. I found the salvager that took it, but it was then sold on to a mountain climber.
translation: 我找到了。我找到了拿走项链的那个打捞者，但项链已经被转卖给了一个登山者。

english: Oh no. I'd hoped he wouldn't sell it on so quickly. Maybe there's still hope though. Any mountain climber around here will surely be heading up the Proudspire...
translation: 哦不。我还希望他不会这么快就把它卖掉呢。不过也许还有希望。这附近的登山者肯定都是朝着傲峰去的……

english: I actually did the climb myself once. I promised my son we'd go up there again together, but we never found the time...
translation: 其实我自己以前也爬过那座山。我答应过我儿子要再一起上去一次，但我们一直没找到时间……

english: Don't worry, I'm sure I can find this climber. I'll head up the Proudspire right away.
translation: 别担心，我肯定能找到这个登山者。我马上就上傲峰去找。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Did you find that mountain climber?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。你找到那个登山者了吗？

english: They will surely be heading up the Proudspire... I promised my son we'd go up there together one day, but we never found the time...
translation: 他肯定是在往傲峰上爬……我答应过我儿子要一起上去一次，但我们一直没时间……

english: Don't worry, I'm sure I can find this climber.
translation: 别担心，我肯定能找到这个登山者。

english: Hey, iknami. Sorry to be a bother, but could you lend us a hand?
translation: 嘿，朋友。抱歉打扰一下，能帮个忙吗？

english: Sure, what's up?
translation: 当然，怎么了？

english: I'm just having a rotten day. My logs won't light and it's gone cold up here. Could you get a fire going for me?
translation: 我今天真是倒霉透了。我的原木点不着火，这上面冷死了。你能帮我生个火吗？

english: Kuani! Thank you!
translation: 库阿尼！谢谢你！

english: Hey, iknami. Any luck with that fire?
translation: 嘿，朋友。火生得怎么样了？

english: I'll have one lit shortly.
translation: 马上就能点着了。

english: Kuani! This is much nicer now we've got a fire going. The name's Bernard.
translation: 库阿尼！生了火就好多了。我叫伯纳德。

english: [player name]. How's your climb going?
translation: [player name]。你攀登得怎么样？

english: Worst one I've had. Mum taught me to be well prepared, but I've never had so many issues. I've even worn my sturdier work gear to deal with the creatures out here.
translation: 这是我最糟糕的一次。妈妈教我要做好准备，但我从未遇到过这么多问题。我甚至还穿上了更坚固的工作齿轮来对付这里的生物。

english: Is mountaineering in the family?
translation: 你们家是登山世家吗？

english: Absolutely! In fact, this one's in honour of mum. She always wanted to take us up the Proudspire. I even managed to snag this necklace that reminded me of her just before setting off.
translation: 当然了！事实上，这次登山就是为了纪念妈妈。她一直想带我们爬上傲峰。出发前我甚至还弄到了一条让我想起她的项链。

english: You got a necklace from the salvagers? Is it a diamond necklace?
translation: 你从打捞者那里拿了一条项链？是钻石项链吗？

english: That's right... How did you know?
translation: 没错……你怎么知道的？

english: I've been looking for one like it. Bernard, was it?
translation: 我一直在找一条像这样的项链。你叫伯纳德，对吗？

english: Yes! Bernard, son of Bernina!
translation: 是的！伯纳德，贝尔尼娜的儿子！

english: Of course! Forgive me, Bernard, but there's someone I need to go and have a word with...
translation: 原来如此！请见谅，伯纳德，我得去找个人说几句话……

english: Hello again. Hope things are going well with you. Did you speak to that person you needed to talk to?
translation: 又见面了。希望你一切顺利。你跟你需要谈话的那个人谈过了吗？

english: No. I'd better go and see them now...
translation: 还没。我最好现在就去找他们……

english: I found the climber and your necklace!
translation: 我找到那个登山者和你的项链了！

english: You did? Were you able to get it back?
translation: 你找到了？你能把它拿回来吗？

english: No, but I don't think I need to. Would you be okay with heading up the mountain yourself? There's someone up there you need to see.
translation: 不能，但我觉得没必要。你愿意亲自上山一趟吗？上面有个人你需要见见。

english: Alright then. I'll meet you up there.
translation: 好吧。那我在上面等你。

english: Ah, hello again, [player name]. I don't want to cause alarm, but there's a ghost here with us!
translation: 啊，又见面了，[player name]。我不想引起恐慌，但我们这儿有个幽灵！

english: He can't understand me. Please, [player name], tell him who I am.
translation: 他听不懂我的话。求你了，[player name]，告诉他我是谁。

english: No need to panic, Bernard. This isn't just some random ghost. This is your mother.
translation: 别慌，伯纳德。这不是什么随便的幽灵。这是你母亲。

english: Mother... By Ralos...
translation: 母亲……以拉洛斯之名……

english: Tell him I'm proud of him, and... tell him I'm sorry I never came home.
translation: 告诉他我为他骄傲，还有……告诉他我很抱歉没能回家。

english: You can't understand her, but she wants you to know she's proud of you, and that she's sorry she didn't come home.
translation: 你听不懂她的话，但她想让你知道她为你感到骄傲，而且她为没能回家感到抱歉。

english: Oh... Mum...
translation: 哦……妈妈……

english: I think I know now... I know why I stayed behind. It was for this. Thank you, [player name]. I think it's time for me to go now. Tell Bernard I will always be with him...
translation: 我想我现在明白了……我明白我为什么留下来了。就是为了这一刻。谢谢你，[player name]。我想我该走了。告诉伯纳德，我会永远和他在一起……

english: Yes, he is gone from this place. You did a great thing removing him.
translation: 是的，他已经离开了这个地方。你把他赶走真是做了件大好事。

english: There are those who walk in the Shadow Realm whom should not.
translation: 有些人不该走在阴影领域里。

english: You were well rewarded for your effort. But you should leave this place, for it is not wise to tarry.
translation: 你的努力获得了丰厚的回报。但你应该离开这里，因为逗留是不明智的。

english: Whoooo wooo whooooooooo.
translation: 呜呜——呜——呜呜呜——

english: Woooo!
translation: 呜呜——！

english: You do not have enough space for it. Speak to me again when you do.
translation: 你没有足够的空间放它。等有了再来找我。

english: She has to go now, but she will always be with you, Bernard.
translation: 她现在得走了，但伯纳德，她会永远和你在一起的。

english: Goodbye mum... I hope I keep making you proud. This necklace... It's not just like yours is it? It is yours. I'm going to finish this climb, for both of us.
translation: 再见妈妈……我希望我能一直让你感到骄傲。这条项链……它不仅仅像你的那条，对吧？它就是你那条。我要完成这次攀登，为了我们俩。

english: I'll bury the necklace at the top. That way, even once I'm done, a part of us will always be on top of the world.
translation: 我会把项链埋在山顶。那样的话，即使我完成了，我们的一部分也将永远留在世界之巅。

english: Thank you, [player name]. Without you, I'd never have got to say goodbye. Now, I guess I'd better get going. I've got a mountain to climb.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。没有你，我永远没法说再见。现在，我想我得出发了。我还有座山要爬。

english: Best of luck, Bernard.
translation: 祝你好运，伯纳德。

english: I can't let you go in there.
translation: 我不能让你进去。

english: Hello? Who are you? What is this place?
translation: 你好？你是谁？这是什么地方？

english: I'm... Ashuelot... Ashuelot Reis. But I don't understand... How are you here?
translation: 我是……阿舒洛特……阿舒洛特.雷斯。但我不明白……你怎么会在这里？

english: Oh... Well I'm [player name], and I'm here because I was told there was a great treasure to be found.
translation: 哦……我是[player name]，我来这里是因为听说这里藏着巨大的宝藏。

english: Treasure? I fear you have been misled. There is no treasure here, only our great mistake.
translation: 宝藏？恐怕你被人误导了。这里没有宝藏，只有我们犯下的巨大错误。

english: Mistake?
translation: 错误？

english: This place is a prison. Here, a being of incomprehensible power was sealed away. Things would have stayed that way, if not for our foolishness.
translation: 这个地方是个监狱。这里封印着一个拥有难以理解力量的存在。如果不是因为我们愚蠢，事情本该一直那样下去。

english: We thought we were doing good, but we were led astray. We opened the prison, and unleashed the horror within.
translation: 我们以为自己是在做好事，但被引入了歧途。我们打开了监狱，释放了里面的恐怖。

english: But the door was locked until I came along.
translation: 但门在我来之前是锁着的。

english: Yes... After our great mistake, four opposing armies united to contain the evil again. They managed to reseal the prison, but they were unable to repair the original enchantments.
translation: 是的……在我们犯下大错之后，四支敌对的军队联合起来，再次遏制了那邪恶。他们设法重新封印了监狱，但无法修复我们破坏的原始结界。

english: This place has remained vulnerable ever since.
translation: 从此以后，这个地方一直很脆弱。

english: And now I've opened it again.
translation: 而现在我又把它打开了。

english: If what you've told me is true, you were fooled just as we were. But I suppose that means little now. With the prison now open again, there isn't much to prevent the evil escaping once more.
translation: 如果你跟我说的是真的，那你就像我们一样被骗了。不过，我想现在这也没什么意义了。监狱再次打开，没有什么能阻止那邪恶再次逃出了。

english: There must be something I can do to stop it.
translation: 一定有什么我能做的事来阻止它。

english: There is only one thing you can do. You can fight.
translation: 你只能做一件事。战斗。

english: Then that is what I will do.
translation: 那我就这么做。

english: Though, now that I think about it, I'm still not overly clear what this evil is.
translation: 不过，现在想想，我还是不太清楚这邪恶到底是什么。

english: She is a being of darkness. A servant of the Ruinous Powers. She is the Angel of Death. She is Nex.
translation: 她是一个黑暗的存在。毁灭之力的仆从。她是死亡天使。她是奈克斯。

english: I'll stop her.
translation: 我会阻止她。

english: I hope so. Nex can be found in the inner section of the prison. Join me there. But be warned, Nex was not imprisoned alone. You'll need to fight through her followers to reach her.
translation: 希望如此。奈克斯在监狱的内部区域。我们在那里会合。但要小心，奈克斯并不是单独被囚禁的。你得先打败她的追随者才能见到她。

english: You made it?
translation: 你到了？

english: You didn't think I would?
translation: 你以为我到不了？

english: Nex's followers are capable of bringing down even the strongest of warriors. I did fear you might not make it past them.
translation: 奈克斯的追随者有本事击倒最强大的战士。我确实担心你可能过不了他们那关。

english: Still, they are nothing compared to the Angel of Death herself.
translation: 不过，他们跟死亡天使本尊比起来还算不了什么。

english: So how do I deal with her?
translation: 那我该怎么对付她？

english: You will never be able to truly defeat her. The best you can do is to try and keep her contained. When you are ready to face her, just go through the barrier.
translation: 你永远无法真正击败她。你最多只能尽力把她困住。当你准备好面对她时，穿过屏障就行了。

english: If it helps, while my magic is limited here, I should still be able to transfer items in and out of the prison for you. Let me know if you'd like me to do this before you enter.
translation: 如果有帮助的话，虽然我的魔法在这里受到限制，但我应该还是能帮你把物品送进送出监狱。进去之前，如果你需要我这么做，就告诉我一声。

english: The rest is as I already told you. Nex posed such a danger, that the four armies temorarily joined forces to drive her back into the prison. They resealed it, but were unable to fix the enchantments we destroyed.
translation: 剩下的就像我之前告诉你的。奈克斯带来的威胁如此之大，以至于四支军队暂时联合起来，把她赶回了监狱。他们重新封印了它，但无法修复我们摧毁的结界。

english: Wooooo whooo wooo. Whoot!
You tell 'em.
translation: 你说得对。

english: You can see into the Shadow Realm and yet you are not of it. Oh well, you will be of no use.
translation: 你能看见阴影领域，但你并非其中一员。也罢，你派不上用场。

english: Huh? What do you mean I am not of it?
translation: 嗯？你说我不是其中一员是什么意思？

english: Your form is still solid. To be of the Shadow Realm you must be less opaque.
translation: 你的形体仍然是实体的。要成为阴影领域的一部分，你必须变得不那么实在。

english: Hello, General.
translation: 你好，将军。

english: What? You are not dead and yet you walk and talk in the Shadow Realm. Explain yourself.
translation: 什么？你没死，却能在阴影领域里行走说话。解释一下。

english: I'm a being of great power and experience. I can see and speak to ghosts. For my assistance they clothed me in their garb. Can I offer you assistance, General?
translation: 我是一个拥有强大力量和经验的生灵。我能看见并和幽灵交谈。作为回报，它们用它们的装束给我穿上。将军，我能为您效劳吗？

english: This intrigues me. How do you know me? You look familiar but I can't place it.
translation: 这让我很感兴趣。你怎么认识我？你看起来很眼熟，但我记不起来了。

english: Uh, well, you don't really have eyes, so how can you tell?
translation: 呃，好吧，你其实没有眼睛，那你怎么看得出来？

english: There are ways to see that you humans cannot grasp.
translation: 有你们人类无法理解的观察方式。

english: It doesn't matter anyway. You are not of the blood and I cannot trust you.
translation: 反正这也不重要。你不是血族成员，我不能信任你。

english: I'm a very trustworthy person.
translation: 我是个非常值得信赖的人。

english: That is not something I can take your word on.
translation: 这不是你空口白话就能让我相信的。

english: So who'sword would you take?
translation: 那你愿意相信谁的话？

english: Hmm... There is one person's word I would believe. If you visited the Sin Seer, and she judged you trustworthy, then I would have use for you.
translation: 嗯……有一个人说的话我会相信。如果你去拜访罪孽先知，而她判定你值得信赖，那我就会有用得着你的地方。

english: Where would I find her?
translation: 我在哪里能找到她？

english: Well, considering I told you she was a seer, of sorts, I would imagine you would find her in Seers' Village. It is to the south of here, not far.
translation: 嗯，既然我告诉过你她是个先知，那我想你会在先知村找到她。就在南边，不远。

english: Go and see her, return with her report and I will see if I have use for you. You will be well rewarded.
translation: 去找她，带着她的报告回来，我再看看有没有用得着你的地方。你会得到丰厚的报酬。

english: Okay! That sounds reasonable. Sin Seer, huh? How do you know someone like her?
translation: 好！听起来很合理。罪孽先知，是吧？你怎么会认识她这样的人？

english: It's a long story, and I do not have the time to tell it.
translation: 说来话长，我没时间讲。

english: I just have one of those faces.
translation: 我就是长了张大众脸。

english: True, I never can tell you humans apart. You're all ugly creatures, anyway.
translation: 确实，我从来分不清你们人类。反正你们都是些丑陋的生物。

english: Err, what was I supposed to do again?
translation: 呃，我该做什么来着？

english: You goldfish! Go find the Sin Seer - she will determine if you are trustworthy. She lives in Seers' Village to the south of here.
translation: 你这金鱼脑子！去找罪孽先知——她会判断你是否值得信赖。她住在南边的先知村。

english: Sorry, you don't have enough money.
translation: 抱歉，你的钱不够。

english: I'm going to have to give you a note to verify that I have read your sins, but it appears you don't have enough space to carry it. Clear some space, then I'll read your sins.
translation: 我得给你一张笔记，证明我读过了你的罪过，但你似乎没空间带了。腾出些空间，然后我再读你的罪过。

english: You have done many great deeds...but many terrible deeds. Sometimes you do them by accident, but they are still sins. No, I would not trust you to walk my dog.
translation: 你做过许多伟大的事……但也做过许多可怕的坏事。有时候你是不小心做的，但那仍然是罪过。不，我可不敢让你遛我的狗。

english: Whatcha lookin' at, chicken legs? Don't you have a General you should speak to?
translation: 看什么看，鸡腿？难道你不该去找将军汇报吗？

english: I have been to the Sin Seer. She has made her verdict.
translation: 我去见过罪孽先知了。她已经做出了裁决。

english: Err, and I seem to have misplaced the note she gave me.
translation: 呃，我好像把她给我的纸条弄丢了。

english: Well, you'd best go get another one! Be off with you!
translation: 那你最好再去拿一张！快去吧！

english: She said to give you this note to prove I went to see her.
translation: 她说让我把这张纸条给你，证明我去见过她了。

english: The note says you have committed many sins and atrocities in your life. I'm impressed; I will use you.
translation: 纸条上说你一生犯下无数罪孽和暴行。印象深刻；我会用你的。

english: It has been a long time since I have left my home in the south. I have lost track of what is going on in the world, but now it is imperative that I know.
translation: 我离开南方的家已经很久了。我已经不了解世界上正在发生什么，但现在我必须知道。

english: So, I sent out four scouts to gather information for me. I brought them to walk like me in the Shadow Realm, so they would be safe from my enemies.
translation: 所以，我派出了四名侦察兵为我收集情报。我让他们像我一样在阴影领域中行走，这样他们就能免受敌人的伤害。

english: I sent them on four missions. One was to go to the land of the gnomes and explore their holdings. One was to go to a jungle to the south. One was to explore where the White Knights rule. And one to the place that
translation: 我派他们执行四项任务。一个去地精的领地，探查他们的据点。一个去南方的丛林。一个去探查白骑士统治的地方。还有一个去我

english: I once called home - a place of great heat.
translation: 我曾经把一个地方称为家——一个非常炎热的地方。

english: I am going to entrust you with a very important message, which you must deliver to each one of them.
translation: 我要托付给你一个非常重要的口信，你必须传达给他们每一个人。

english: Tell them: The planets are nearing alignment; we will meet in the place of half light and ice soon. Beware of the others, for though they are weak and few, they are cunning.
translation: 告诉他们：行星即将对齐；我们很快会在半光与冰之地会合。提防其他人，虽然他们弱小且稀少，但他们很狡猾。

english: You can trust me to do it, sir!
translation: 先生，交给我您放心！

english: Do you make progress in finding my scouts?
translation: 找到我的侦察兵有进展吗？

english: I haven't found any. Where were they headed?
translation: 我一个都没找到。他们往哪去了？

english: I've found [one/two/three], but they're kind of hard to find. Where were they headed again?
translation: 我找到了[one/two/three]，但他们不太好找。他们又往哪去了来着？

english: One was to go to a jungle to the south.
translation: 一个去了南方的丛林。

english: One was to go to the land of the gnomes and explore their holdings.
translation: 一个去了地精的领地，探查他们的据点。

english: One was to explore where the White Knights rule.
translation: 一个去探查白骑士统治的地方。

english: One was to go to a place of great heat.
translation: 其中一个要去一个非常炎热的地方。

english: If I knew more of their locations I would go myself. Now go and finish the job.
translation: 如果我知道他们更多的位置，我就自己去了。现在去完成任务吧。

english: I am on a mission. I cannot spare time to speak to you.
translation: 我有任务在身。没时间跟你说话。

english: Spy! I shall kill you!
translation: 间谍！我要杀了你！

english: You can see into the Shadow Realm, but you are not of it. I cannot trust you.
translation: 你能看见阴影领域，但你并非其中一员。我不能信任你。

english: I am not of it? What Shadow Realm? Hello? He's not listening.
translation: 我不是其中一员？什么阴影领域？喂？他没在听。

english: Begone, you filthy human. I spare no words for you.
translation: 滚开，肮脏的人类。我懒得跟你废话。

english: All you had to say was: 'Please, come back some other time.'
translation: 你只需要说一句：‘请改天再来。’

english: A mere mortal can see into the Shadow Realm? The General will want to know of this.
translation: 一个凡人都能看见阴影领域？将军会想知道这件事的。

english: General who? Hello? How rude, he's not listening.
translation: 哪位将军？喂？真没礼貌，他根本没在听。

english: Hello there! General Khazard sent me.
translation: 你好！卡扎德将军派我来的。

english: You must be a great mage to be able to see me, human.
translation: 你一定是位伟大的法师，才能看见我，人类。

english: So, are you a ghost?
translation: 那么，你是幽灵吗？

english: Nothing so morbid. I am a scout for Khazard, and I move more easily through the land unseen. There are enemies everywhere.
translation: 没那么阴森。我是卡扎德的侦察兵，我在陆地上行动更隐蔽。到处都是敌人。

english: If you're not a ghost, why do I need an Amulet of Ghostspeak to talk to you?
translation: 如果你不是幽灵，为什么我需要幽灵语护身符才能和你说话？

english: Those who walk fully in the Shadow Realm become warped by it and speak as ghosts do. That is why I cannot speak to you unless you wear the amulet.
translation: 那些完全行走在阴影领域中的人会被其扭曲，说话像幽灵一样。这就是为什么除非你戴上护身符，否则我无法和你说话。

english: Oh. Well, here's your message.
translation: 哦。好吧，这是给你的口信。

english: Khazard says: 'The planets are nearing alignment; we will meet in the place of half light and ice soon. Beware of the others, for though they are weak and few, they are cunning.'
translation: 卡扎德说：‘行星即将对齐；我们很快会在半光与冰之地会合。提防其他人，虽然他们弱小且稀少，但他们很狡猾。’

english: Thank you, messenger.
translation: 谢谢你，信使。

english: So, how's your mission going?
translation: 那么，你的任务进展如何？

english: There is nothing pleasant about this land. The animals are vile, the temperature is unbearable and the plant life is often more dangerous than the animals.
translation: 这片土地没什么好印象。动物可憎，温度难耐，植物往往比动物更危险。

english: There were some strange occurrences in Tai Bwo Wannai. The people fled their village because their gods were angry with them, or the like, but now they have returned. I must investigate why.
translation: 泰博瓦纳村发生了一些奇怪的事情。村民们因为诸神发怒之类的原因逃离了村庄，但现在他们回来了。我必须调查原因。

english: Shilo Village was overrun with the undead, but someone of great ability has brought the situation under control.
translation: 希洛村被亡灵占领了，但某个能力出众的人已经控制了局面。

english: Well, there's always something interesting going on here.
translation: 嗯，这里总是有些有趣的事情发生。

english: Any idea where the other scouts are?
translation: 知道其他侦察兵在哪吗？

english: I am a scout, not a spy. I do not keep track of them.
translation: 我是侦察兵，不是间谍。我不追踪他们。

english: I was told to go south, so here I am. I know one was to investigate the gnomes. I believe one headed towards Asgarnia. Another was told to go to a place of great heat, but that they would have to sneak through a pass.
translation: 我被告知要去南方，所以我在这里。我知道其中一个是去调查地精。我相信一个去了阿斯加尼亚。另一个被告知要去一个非常炎热的地方，但他们必须偷偷穿过一个山口。

english: What news, skinbag?
translation: 有什么消息吗，皮囊？

english: Hey, no need to be rude.
translation: 嘿，没必要这么粗鲁。

english: Your smell disgusts me, so make it quick.
translation: 你的气味让我恶心，所以快点说。

english: I'll be glad when all this is over. The General will be strong again and we will push back this tide of filth that is humanity.
translation: 等这一切结束我会很高兴。将军会再次强大，我们将击退人类这股污秽的浪潮。

english: Oi! I am one of the filth, I mean, humans! Besides, we were here first.
translation: 喂！我就是那污秽之一，我是说，人类！再说了，是我们先到这里的。
