translation: 恭喜，你把自己耍了。等你觉得自己有本事完成任务了再回来找我。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the Southern house in the residential district over on the west side of town.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在小镇西边住宅区南边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the Northern house in the residential district over on the west side of town.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在小镇西边住宅区北边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the Western house in the residential district over on the west side of town.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在小镇西边住宅区西边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the South-Western house in the residential district over on the west side of town.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在小镇西边住宅区西南边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the South-Eastern house in the residential district over on the west side of town.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在小镇西边住宅区东南边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the North-Western house in the residential district over on the west side of town.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在小镇西边住宅区西北边的房子里找到。

english: We'll see. If you can get the job done, I'll make sure you get a fair share of the booty.
translation: 等着瞧。如果你能完成任务，我会确保你分到应得的那份战利品。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the southern house in the residential district over on the west side of the city.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在城市西边住宅区南边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the northern house in the residential district over on the west side of the city.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在城市西边住宅区北边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the south eastern house in the residential district over on the west side of the city.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在城市西边住宅区东南边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the north western house in the residential district over on the west side of the city.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在城市西边住宅区西北边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the western house in the residential district over on the west side of the city.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在城市西边住宅区西边的房子里找到。

english: You need to recover an artefact for me. It can be found in the south western house in the residential district over on the west side of the city.
translation: 你需要帮我找回一件文物。它可以在城市西边住宅区西南边的房子里找到。

english: Sea piracy just ain't what it used to be, so my crew and I have had to make do on land. We specialise in 'acquiring' valuable antiquities from around town and shipping them to our friends overseas.
translation: 海上抢劫已经不像当年那样了，所以我和我的船员们只好在陆地上谋生。我们专门从镇上各地“获取”珍贵的古董，然后运送给我们的海外朋友。

english: Sorry, you'll need to improve your thieving skills before you can get involved with me or my crew.
translation: 抱歉，你需要提高偷窃技能才能参与我和我的船员的活动。

english: Sorry, you'll need to improve your Thieving skills before you can get involved with me or my crew.
translation: 抱歉，你需要提高偷窃技能才能参与我和我的船员的活动。

english: Ye've already got 10 rewards waiting for ye! Go collect them at the reward pool before headin' back out.
translation: 你已经有10份奖励等着你了！先去奖励池领取，然后再出发。

english: Ye've already got 11 rewards waiting for ye! Go collect them at the reward pool before headin' back out.
translation: 你已经有11份奖励等着你了！先去奖励池领取，然后再出发。

english: Ye've already got 12 rewards waiting for ye! Go collect them at the reward pool before headin' back out.
translation: 你已经有12份奖励等着你了！先去奖励池领取，然后再出发。

english: Ye've already got 13 rewards waiting for ye! Go collect them at the reward pool before headin' back out.
translation: 你已经有13份奖励等着你了！先去奖励池领取，然后再出发。

english: Ye've already got 14 rewards waiting for ye! Go collect them at the reward pool before headin' back out.
translation: 你已经有14份奖励等着你了！先去奖励池领取，然后再出发。

english: Ye've already got 8000 rewards waiting for ye! Go collect them at the reward pool before headin' back out.
translation: 你已经有8000份奖励等着你了！先去奖励池领取，然后再出发。

english: Excellent!.
translation: 太棒了！

english: Ye've already got 15 rewards waiting for ye! Go collect them at the reward pool before headin' back out.
translation: 你已经有15份奖励等着你了！先去奖励池领取，然后再出发。

english: We have manipulated the landscape to our advantage in the fight against the lizardmen.
translation: 在与蜥蜴人的战斗中，我们改造了地形，使其对我们有利。

english: If it wasn't for us, the lizardmen would have invaded all of Great Kourend by now. It was a genius strategic decision by the honourable Lord Shayzien.
translation: 如果不是我们，蜥蜴人现在已经入侵了整个大库兰德。这是尊贵的谢兹恩勋爵的天才战略决策。

english: You may. You can access the canyon to the west of here.
translation: 你可以。你可以进入西边的峡谷。

english: I have to ask you to get back from here sir.
translation: 先生，我得请您离开这里。

english: I have to ask you to get back from here lady.
translation: 女士，我得请您离开这里。

english: No! We would never trust a stranger in the importance of a battle! A lot is at stake [player name]
translation: 不！我们绝不会在这么重要的战役中信任一个陌生人！赌注很高，[player name]。

english: Not until you have completed at least 100 challenges.
translation: 除非你完成至少100个挑战，否则不行。

english: Do not allow your curiousity to get the better of you.
translation: 不要让你的好奇心战胜你。

english: Certainly. From what my men have seen in the field, the monsters in the Chambers seem to grow larger in power depending on the number of people active and how strong they are.
translation: 当然。根据我手下在战场上的观察，密室里的怪物会因活跃人数及其强度而变得更强。

english: I've had a spell prepared that could make the foes inside the Chambers ignore your combat level and treat you as strong as possible, if that's something that would interest you.
translation: 我准备了一个法术，可以让密室内的敌人忽略你的战斗等级，视你为最强的状态——如果你感兴趣的话。

english: Very well. When you're the leader of your next raid, the enemies in the Chambers will be as strong as possible.
translation: 很好。当你下次作为突袭队长时，密室里的敌人将处于最强状态。

english: Perhaps later. Talk to me again once you've left your party.
translation: 也许晚点吧。等你离开队伍后再来找我。

english: Very well, come and talk to me again if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，再来找我。

english: The spell I had for you is currently making the enemies inside the Chambers ignore your combat level. Do you want me to revert it?
translation: 我之前为你准备的法术目前正让密室内的敌人忽略你的战斗等级。你想让我撤销它吗？

english: You could, but you don't have space for it.
translation: 你可以这么做，但你没有空间放它。

english: Very well. When you're the leader of your next raid, the enemies in the Chambers should be comparable in power to you.
translation: 很好。当你下次作为突袭队长时，密室里的敌人将调整到与你相当的实力。

english: Very well. When you're the leader of your next raid, the enemies in the Chambers will continue be as strong as possible.
translation: 很好。当你下次作为突袭队长时，密室里的敌人将继续保持最强状态。

english: Bewawe da Chambews of Xewic, adventuwew.
translation: 小心塞里克密室，冒险者。

english: Mayhaps later. Talk to me again once you've left your party.
translation: 也许晚点吧。等你离开队伍后再来找我。

english: Do you want to go on a trip to Karamja?
translation: 你想去卡拉姆詹岛旅行一趟吗？

english: The trip to Karamja will cost you 30 coins.
translation: 去卡拉姆詹岛的旅程需要花费30枚金币。

english: The trip will cost you 30 coins.
translation: 这次旅程需要花费你30枚金币。

english: No I need to stay alive, I have a wife and family to support.
translation: 不，我得活着，我还有个妻子和家人要养。

english: Mmmm ... nothing at all you say ...
translation: 嗯……你倒是说什么都没有……

english: Yes, why not - jump aboard then.
translation: 好啊，为什么不去——那就上船吧。

english: Wait a minute... Aren't those Karamja gloves? Thought I'd seen you helping around the island. You can go on half price - 15 coins.
translation: 等等……那不是卡拉姆詹手套吗？我好像看到你在岛上帮忙。你可以享受半价——15枚金币。

english: The trip will cost you 300 coins.
translation: 这次旅程需要花费300枚金币。

english: Excuse me, can you help me with this question?
translation: 打扰一下，你能帮我解答这个问题吗？

english: Great! I wrote it down for you.
translation: 太好了！我帮你写下来了。

english: Are you sure? That sounds a little off to me.
translation: 你确定吗？我觉得有点不太对劲。

english: Hey puss! Any news?
translation: 嘿，猫咪！有什么消息吗？

english: Purr
translation: 咕噜

english: Purr..purr...
translation: 咕噜…咕噜…

english: Normally I wouldn't consider you experienced enough to be taught by me, however during these strange times I will overlook your lack of experience in combat.
translation: 通常我不会认为你有足够的经验让我教导，但在这奇怪的时代，我会忽略你在战斗方面的经验不足。

english: We'll start you off hunting cows, you'll need to kill [X] of them.
translation: 我们先从猎杀奶牛开始，你需要杀死 [X] 头。

english: Your cape attests that you are experienced enough to be taught by me. I will overlook your lack of experience in combat.
translation: 你的披风证明你有足够的经验让我教导。我会忽略你在战斗方面的经验不足。

english: Hello there [player name], what can I help you with?
translation: 你好啊，[player name]，有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: I'll open the store for you.
translation: 我来为你打开商店。

english: Ah... Tzhaar... as you are undertaking this task alone, for an extra reward you could choose to slay TzTok- Jad instead of the TzHaar.
translation: 啊……特扎尔……既然你独自接受这个任务，作为额外奖励，你可以选择击杀特兹托克.贾德来替代特扎尔。

english: Like other giants, Fire Giants often wield large weapons, learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
translation: 和其他巨人一样，火焰巨人通常挥舞大型武器，学会识别武器的类型并相应应对。

english: Trolls regenerate damage quickly but are still vulnerable to poisons, they usually use crushing weapons.
translation: 巨魔恢复伤势很快，但仍然容易中毒，他们通常使用钝击武器。

english: Kalphite are large insects which live in great hives under the desert sands.
translation: 卡尔夫特虫是大型昆虫，生活在沙漠地下的巨大蜂巢中。

english: Lesser Demons are magic creatures so they are weak to magical attacks. Though they're relatively weak they are still dangerous.
translation: 小恶魔是魔法生物，因此对魔法攻击抵抗力较弱。虽然相对较弱，但它们仍然危险。

english: A wise choice.
translation: 明智的选择。

english: You'll find me in Zanaris. I'll be here when you need a new task.
translation: 你会在扎纳里斯城找到我。当需要新任务时，我就在这里。

english: Pyrefiends are beings of fire and molten rock, they're quick and agile so you'll want to be careful when getting close to them.
translation: 烈焰魔是由火焰和熔岩构成的生物，它们动作敏捷迅速，接近时需要小心。

english: Bronze Dragons are the weakest of the metallic dragons, their bronze scales are far thicker than normal bronze armour.
translation: 青铜龙是金属龙中最弱的，它们的青铜鳞片远比普通青铜盔甲厚。

english: Cave Slimes are the lesser cousins of Jellies, though don't be fooled they can still be dangerous as they're often poisonous.
translation: 洞穴史莱姆是果冻怪的远亲，但别被它们骗了，它们经常带毒，仍然很危险。

english: Infernal Mages are dangerous spell users, beware of their magic spells and go properly prepared.
translation: 地狱法师是危险的施法者，小心他们的魔法咒语，做好充分准备。

english: Blue Dragons aren't as strong as other dragons but they're still very powerful, watch out for their fiery breath.
translation: 蓝龙虽然不如其他龙强大，但仍然非常厉害，小心它们的火焰吐息。

english: Basilisks, like Cockatrice, have a gaze which will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a Mirror Shield to protect you.
translation: 石化蜥蜴和鸡蛇怪一样，它们的凝视会使猎物麻痹并造成伤害。你需要一面镜盾来保护自己。

english: Greater Demons are magic creatures so they are weak to magical attacks. Though not the strongest demon they are still dangerous.
translation: 大恶魔是魔法生物，所以对魔法攻击抵抗力较弱。虽然不是最强的恶魔，但仍然危险。

english: Hellhounds are a cross between Dogs and Demons, they are dangerous with a fierce bite.
translation: 地狱犬是狗和恶魔的杂交，它们咬合力凶猛，非常危险。

english: Cave Crawlers are small and fast, often hiding in ambush. Avoid their barbed tongue or you'll get poisoned.
translation: 洞穴爬虫体型小而速度快，经常潜伏突袭。避开它们带刺的舌头，否则你会中毒。

english: Cockatrice, like Basilisks, have a gaze which will paralyse and harm their prey. You'll need a Mirror Shield to protect you.
translation: 鸡蛇怪和石化蜥蜴一样，它们的凝视会使猎物麻痹并造成伤害。你需要一面镜盾来保护自己。

english: Jellies are nasty cube-like gelatinous creatures which absorb everything they come across into themselves.
translation: 果冻怪是一种恶心的立方体状凝胶生物，它们会将遇到的一切吸收进体内。

english: Lizards are large reptiles with tough skin. Those found in the desert will need you to douse them with freezing water to finish them off after a tough battle. You'll need boots of stone to protect your feet for those at Mount
translation: 蜥蜴是皮肤坚韧的大型爬行动物。沙漠中的蜥蜴需要你在苦战后用冰水浇它们才能彻底杀死。对于卡鲁尔姆山的蜥蜴，你需要石靴来保护双脚。

english: Karuulm.
translation: 卡鲁尔姆。

english: Rockslugs are strange stoney slugs. You'll need to fight them to near death before finishing them off with Salt
translation: 岩石蛞蝓是奇怪的石头状蛞蝓。你需要把它们打到濒死，然后用盐来结果它们。

english: My name's Chaeldar, I'm the Slayer Master best able to train you.
translation: 我叫查尔达，我是最能训练你的杀戮者大师。

english: Bloodveld are strange demonic creatures, they use their long rasping tongue to feed on just about anything they can find.
translation: 血魔是奇怪的恶魔生物，它们用长长的刺舌吸食能找到的任何东西。

english: Iron Dragons are some of the weaker metallic dragons, their iron scales are far thicker than normal iron armour.
translation: 铁龙是较弱的金属龙之一，它们的铁鳞片比普通铁盔甲厚得多。

english: Banshees use a piercing scream to shock their enemies, you'll need some Earmuffs to protect yourself from them.
translation: 女妖用刺耳的尖叫震慑敌人，你需要耳罩来保护自己。

english: Black Demons are magic creatures so they are weak to magical attacks. They're a very strong demon and very dangerous.
translation: 黑恶魔是魔法生物，所以对魔法攻击抵抗力较弱。它们是非常强大的恶魔，非常危险。

english: Harpie Bug Swarms are pesky critters that are hard to hit. You need a lit bug lantern to distract them with its hypnotic light.
translation: 哈比虫群是烦人的小东西，很难打中。你需要一个已点燃的虫灯，用它的催眠光线来分散它们的注意力。

english: Turoth are large vicious creatures with thick hides. You'll need a Leaf-Tipped Spear, Sword or Battle-axe, Broad Arrows, or a Magic Dart to harm them.
translation: 图罗斯是大型残暴的生物，皮很厚。你需要叶尖长矛、剑或战斧、宽箭或魔法飞镖才能伤害它们。

english: Wall Beasts are really much larger creatures but you'll only see their arms. You'll want something sharp on your head to stop them grabbing you.
translation: 墙兽实际上是更大的生物，但你只能看到它们的双臂。你头上需要戴点锋利的东西来防止它们抓住你。

english: Sorry, but you're not strong enough to be taught by me. Your best trainer would be Vannaka under Edgeville.
translation: 抱歉，你还不够强，不能接受我的训练。最适合你的训练师是边陲镇下方的范纳卡。

english: Dagannoth are large sea dwelling creatures which are very aggressive. You'll often find them in caves near sea water.
translation: 深潜者是生活在海中的大型生物，非常具有攻击性。你经常能在靠近海水的洞穴里找到它们。

english: Molanisks are subterranean creatures. You can find them in caves deep below the ground. I heard that the goblins have recently had trouble with some, but they use a bell of some sort to deal with them.
translation: 莫拉尼斯克是地下生物。你可以在深深的地下洞穴中找到它们。我听说地精们最近被它们搞得有点麻烦，但他们用一种钟来对付它们。

english: You need something new to hunt.
translation: 你需要猎杀一些新目标。

english: Mutated Zygomites are hard to destroy.  They regenerate quickly so you will need to finish them with fungicide.
translation: 菇人很难消灭。它们恢复得很快，所以你需要用杀真菌剂来结束它们。

english: Steel Dragons are dangerous metallic dragons, their steel scales are far thicker than normal steel armour.
translation: 钢龙是危险的金属龙，它们的钢鳞片比普通钢盔甲厚得多。

english: Aberrant Spectres are fetid, vile ghosts. The very smell of them will paralyse and harm you. A nosepeg will help ignore their stink.
translation: 变异幽灵是污秽、邪恶的鬼魂。它们的气味就会让你麻痹并受到伤害。鼻塞可以帮助你无视它们的恶臭。

english: Elves are quick, agile, and vicious fighters which often favour bows and polearms.
translation: 精灵是快速、敏捷且凶残的战士，通常擅长使用弓和长柄武器。

english: Spiritual creatures can be found in the icy caverns near Trollheim, supporting the cause of their chosen god. The warriors, mages and rangers have different Slayer requirements.
translation: 幽魂怪物出没在巨魔之家附近的冰洞穴中，支持他们所选神祇的阵营。战士、法师和弓箭手有不同的杀戮者等级要求。

english: Sorry, but you're not strong enough to be taught by me. Come back to me when you have more experience in combat.
translation: 抱歉，你还不够强，不能接受我的训练。等你有更多战斗经验后再回来找我。

english: Jungle Horrors can be found all over Mos Le'Harmless. They are strong and aggressive, so watch out!
translation: 丛林恐怪遍布莫斯勒哈姆斯岛。它们强大且具有攻击性，小心！

english: Shadow Warriors are dark and mysterious, they hide in the shadows so be wary of ambushes.
translation: 暗影战士黑暗而神秘，他们隐藏在阴影中，要警惕埋伏。

english: Wyrms are only found in the depths of the Karuulm Slayer Dungeon, you'll want some Boots of Stone to protect yourself from the heat.
translation: 蛇龙只存在于卡鲁尔姆杀戮者地牢的深处，你需要一些石靴来保护自己免受热量伤害。

english: Fever Spiders are giant spiders that carry the deadly Spider Fever. If you don't want to catch it I suggest you wear Slayer Gloves to fight them.
translation: 热病蜘蛛是携带致命蜘蛛热的大型蜘蛛。如果你不想被感染，我建议你戴上杀戮者手套来对抗它们。

english: Spiders are often poisonous, and many varieties are camouflaged too.
translation: 蜘蛛通常有毒，而且许多品种还会伪装。

english: Tzhaar reside in their cave under the Karamja volcano. Beware as they can call to their fellows for aid.
translation: 特扎尔居住在卡拉姆詹岛火山下的洞穴中。小心它们会呼叫同伴帮忙。

english: Mogres are a type of aquatic Ogre that is often mistaken for a giant mudskipper. You have to force them out of the water with a fishing explosive.
translation: 莫格雷食人魔是一种水生食人魔，经常被误认为是巨大的弹涂鱼。你必须用钓鱼炸药把它们逼出水面。

english: Brine rats can be found in caves that are near the sea. They are hairless, bad-tempered and generally unfriendly.
translation: 盐水鼠可以在靠近海边的洞穴里找到。它们没有毛发，脾气暴躁，通常不友好。

english: Hill Giants often wield large weapons, learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
translation: 丘陵巨人通常挥舞大型武器，学会识别武器的类型并相应应对。

english: Chaos Druids are druids who've turned to evil. Some of them have spells that can harm you, or even teleport you back to them if you flee.
translation: 混沌德鲁伊是堕入邪恶的德鲁伊。他们中的一些人有能伤害你的法术，甚至在你逃跑时把你传送回他们身边。

english: Ogres are brutal creatures, favouring large blunt maces and clubs, they often attack without warning.
translation: 食人魔是野蛮的生物，喜欢大型钝头钉锤和棍棒，经常在毫无征兆的情况下攻击。

english: Fossil Island Wyverns are extremely dangerous in different ways. To stand a good chance of surviving you'll need some elemental shielding from their icy breath.
translation: 化石岛的飞龙以不同方式极端危险。要想有生存机会，你需要一些元素防护来抵御它们的冰冷吐息。

english: Cave Horrors can be found under Mos Le'Harmless. You will need a Witchwood Icon to fight them effectively.
translation: 洞穴恐怪可以在莫斯勒哈姆斯岛地下找到。你需要一个巫木护符才能有效对抗它们。

english: Ankou are undead skeletal ghosts. They'll fight you up close but make sure to take advantage out of their limited defence.
translation: 昂骷是不死的骷髅幽灵。它们会跟你近战，但一定要利用它们有限的防御。

english: Like other giants, Moss Giants often wield large weapons, learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
translation: 和其他巨人一样，苔藓巨人通常挥舞大型武器，学会识别武器的类型并相应应对。

english: Kurask are large brutal creatures with very thick hides. You'll need a Leaf-Tipped Spear, Sword or Battle-axe, Broad Arrows, or a Magic Dart to harm it..
translation: 库拉斯克是大型残暴的生物，皮非常厚。你需要叶尖长矛、剑或战斧、宽箭或魔法飞镖才能伤害它。

english: Zombies are undead so magic is your best bet against them, there is even a spell specially for fighting the undead.
translation: 僵尸是不死生物，所以对付它们魔法是最好的选择，甚至有一种专门对付不死生物的法术。

english: Shades are undead so magic is your best bet against them, you can find Shades at Mort'ton.
translation: 阴魂是不死生物，所以对付它们魔法是最好的选择，你可以在莫顿镇找到阴魂。

english: Vampyres are extremely powerful beings. They feed on the blood of the living so watch out you don't get bitten.
translation: 吸血鬼是极其强大的生物。它们以活物的血液为食，小心别被咬到。

english: Dust Devils use clouds of dust, sand, ash, and whatever else they can inhale to blind and disorientate their victims.
translation: 尘魔使用灰尘、沙子、灰烬以及它们能吸入的其他东西来致盲并迷惑受害者。

english: Minotaurs are large manlike creatures but you'll want to be careful of their horns.
translation: 牛头怪是大型类人生物，但你要小心它们的角。

english: Cave Bugs are like Cave Crawlers, except smaller and easier to squish, though they still have a fondness for plants.
translation: 洞穴巴格斯和洞穴爬虫很像，只是更小更容易碾碎，不过它们仍然喜欢植物。

english: You must complete the entire fight cave, including TzTok-Jad. Beware, only those skilled in combat should attempt this and death will cancel your task.
translation: 你必须完成整个战斗洞穴，包括特兹托克.贾德。注意，只有擅长战斗的人才能尝试，死亡会取消你的任务。

english: Skeletal Wyverns are extremely dangerous and they are hard to hit with arrows as they slip right through. To stand a good chance of surviving you'll need some elemental shielding from its icy breath.
translation: 骷髅飞龙极其危险，而且箭很难射中它们，因为箭会直接滑过。要想有生存机会，你需要一些元素防护来抵御它们的冰冷吐息。

english: Ice Warriors are a kind of ice elemental, shatter them with blunt weapons or melt them with fire.
translation: 冰战士是一种冰元素，用钝器打碎它们或用火融化它们。

english: Crocodiles are large reptiles which live near water. You'll want to have a stabbing weapon handy for puncturing their thick scaly hides.
translation: 鳄鱼是生活在近水的大型爬行动物。你需要准备一把刺击武器来刺穿它们厚厚的鳞皮。

english: Goblins are mostly just annoying, but they can be vicious. Watch out for the spears they sometimes carry.
translation: 哥布林大多只是烦人，但它们可能很凶残。小心它们有时携带的长矛。

english: Dogs are much like Wolves, they are pack creatures which will hunt in groups.
translation: 狗和狼很像，它们是群居生物，会成群结队地狩猎。

english: Cows are bigger than you, so they'll often hit fairly hard but are usually fairly slow to react.
translation: 奶牛比你大，所以它们通常打人挺疼，但通常反应比较慢。

english: Crawling Hands are undead severed hands, fast and dexterous they claw their victims.
translation: 爬行之手是不死的断手，快速而灵活，用爪子抓挠受害者。

english: Like other giants, Ice Giants often wield large weapons, learn to recognise what kind of weapon it is and act accordingly.
translation: 和其他巨人一样，冰巨人通常挥舞大型武器，学会识别武器的类型并相应应对。

english: You'll have to come see me in person I am afraid! How else would you take anything from my store?
translation: 恐怕你得亲自来见我！否则你怎么从我的商店里拿东西呢？

english: Wolves are pack animals, so you'll always find them in groups. Watch out for their bite, it can be nasty.
translation: 狼是群居动物，所以你总是会发现它们成群的。小心它们的咬伤，可能很严重。

english: Sorry, but you're not strong enough to be taught by me. Your best trainer would be Mazchna in Morytania.
translation: 抱歉，你还不够强，不能接受我的训练。最适合你的训练师是莫利塔尼亚的马斯纳。

english: Gargoyles are winged creatures of stone. You'll need to fight them to near death before breaking them apart with a Rock Hammer
translation: 石像鬼是由石头构成的有翼生物。你需要把它们打到濒死，然后用岩石锤打碎它们。

english: Bats are rarely found on the ground, so you'll have to fight them while they're airborne, which won't be easy with melee.
translation: 蝙蝠很少在地上出现，所以你必须在它们飞行时战斗，用近战可不容易。

english: Werewolves are feral creatures, they are strong and tough with sharp claws and teeth.
translation: 狼人是凶残的生物，它们强壮而坚韧，有锋利的爪子和牙齿。

english: Icefiends are beings of ice and freezing rock, they're quick and agile so you'll want to be careful when getting close to them.
translation: 冰怪是由冰和冻结岩石构成的生物，它们动作敏捷迅速，接近时需要小心。

english: Earth Warriors are a kind of earth elemental, grind them to dust with blunt weapons.
translation: 土元素战士是一种土元素，用钝器把它们磨成粉末。

english: Bears are tough creatures and fierce fighters, watch out for their powerful claws.
translation: 熊是坚韧的生物和凶猛的战士，小心它们有力的爪子。

english: Ghosts are undead so magic is your best bet against them, there is even a spell specially for fighting the undead.
translation: 幽灵是不死生物，所以对付它们魔法是最好的选择，甚至有一种专门对付不死生物的法术。

english: Green Dragons are the weakest dragons but still very powerful, watch out for their fiery breath.
translation: 绿龙是最弱的龙，但仍然非常强大，小心它们的火焰吐息。

english: Black Dragons are the strongest dragons and very fierce, watch out for their fiery breath. Those with higher slayer knowledge and who seek a much tougher, but substantially more rewarding foe, may wish to fight
translation: 黑龙是最强的龙，非常凶残，小心它们的火焰吐息。杀戮者知识更高、寻求更强大但奖励更丰厚的对手的玩家，可能会愿意与库兰德王国地下墓穴中这些生物的残暴变种战斗。

english: Killerwatts store huge amounts of energy in their bodies, which is released if they are touched. You'll need to wear heavily insulated boots to counter this shocking effect.
translation: 杀手瓦特在其体内储存大量能量，一旦触碰就会释放。你需要穿重型绝缘靴来对抗这种电击效果。

english: Brutal versions of these creatures in the Kourend Catacombs.
translation: 库兰德王国地下墓穴中有这些生物的残暴变种。

english: Abyssal Demons are nasty creatures to fight. They aren't really part of this realm, and are able to move very quickly to trap their prey.
translation: 深渊恶魔是非常难打的生物。它们并非真正属于这个领域，并且能够快速移动来困住猎物。

english: Hobgoblins are sneaky underhanded creatures, they often wield spears and some times carry javelins too.
translation: 大哥布林是狡猾卑鄙的生物，它们通常使用长矛，有时也携带标枪。

english: Otherworldly Beings are ethereal beings making them weak to magical attack.
translation: 异界生物是缥缈的存在，因此对魔法攻击抵抗力较弱。

english: Nechryael are demons of decay which summon small winged beings to help them fight their victims.
translation: 死灵魔是腐朽的恶魔，会召唤小型有翼生物来协助它们攻击受害者。

english: Ah... Tzhaar... as you are undertaking this task alone, for an extra reward you could choose to slay TzTok- Jad or TzKal-Zuk instead of the TzHaar.
translation: 啊……特扎尔……既然你独自接受这个任务，作为额外奖励，你可以选择击杀特兹托克.贾德或特兹卡尔.祖克来替代特扎尔。

english: Ghouls aren't undead but they are stronger and tougher than they look. However they're also very cowardly and will run if they're losing a fight.
translation: 食尸鬼不是不死生物，但它们比看起来更强壮坚韧。然而它们也非常胆小，如果打不过就会逃跑。

english: Birds aren't the most intelligent of creatures, but watch out for their sharp stabbing beaks.
translation: 鸟类不是最聪明的生物，但小心它们锋利的喙。

english: Mithril dragons are more vulnerable to magic and to stab-based melee attacks than to anything else.
translation: 秘银龙对魔法和刺击类近战攻击比其他攻击更脆弱。

english: Dwarves are a small but tough race of miners, often using pickaxes to pierce their opponents armour.
translation: 矮人是一个矮小但坚韧的矿工种族，经常用鹤嘴锄刺穿对手的盔甲。

english: Cave Kraken are found in subterranean lakes north of Eagles' Peak. They're very hard to damage with ranged or melee attacks, so try Magic.
translation: 洞穴克拉肯海怪出现在鹰峰以北的地下湖中。用远程或近战很难造成伤害，试试魔法吧。

english: Skeletons are undead so magic is your best bet against them, there is even a spell specially for fighting the undead.
translation: 骷髅是不死生物，所以对付它们魔法是最好的选择，甚至有一种专门对付不死生物的法术。

english: Revenants can be found in the Wilderness, residing in the deepest cavern of the Forinthry dungeon. They use all three styles of combat, but a charged Revenant bracelet will protect you from their attacks.
translation: 亡灵出没在荒野，栖息在福林斯瑞地牢最深的洞穴中。它们使用所有三种战斗方式，但充能的亡灵手镯会保护你免受它们的攻击。

english: Scorpions are almost always poisonous, their hard carapace makes them resistant to crushing and stabbing attacks.
translation: 蝎子几乎总是有毒，它们坚硬的外壳使它们对钝击和刺击攻击有抗性。

english: Monkeys are tricky creatures, they are agile and fairly fast. Learn to anticipate their movements.
translation: 猴子是狡猾的生物，敏捷且相当快速。学会预判它们的动作。

english: Sourhogs have highly acidic saliva and are known to spit when provoked. You should ensure that you wear a pair of Reinforced Goggles to protect yourself.
translation: 酸猪的唾液酸性极强，受到挑衅时会喷出唾液。你应该确保佩戴一副加固的护目镜来保护自己。

english: Oh, I see you are a very skilled slayer! That is most impressive. I might be able to do you a favour if you want...
translation: 哦，看来你是个非常熟练的杀戮者！真是令人印象深刻。如果你愿意的话，我或许能帮你一个忙……

english: Catablepon are mythical, cow like, magical creatures. Beware their weakening glare.
translation: 凯塔勒蓬是神话般的、像奶牛一样的魔法生物。当心它们令人虚弱的凝视。

english: Lizardmen have a poisonous bite. Their shamans have many peculiar tricks - make sure they don't jump on your head.
translation: 蜥蜴人有毒咬。它们的萨满有许多古怪的把戏——确保它们不会跳到你头上。

english: Rats are your everyday pest, but they can get fairly big. Watch out for their sharp piercing teeth.
translation: 老鼠是日常害虫，但它们可能长得相当大。小心它们尖锐的穿刺牙齿。

english: Fleshcrawlers are scavengers and will eat you - and anyone else, given the chance.
translation: 血肉爬虫是食腐动物，一有机会就会吃掉你——以及其他任何人。

english: Lava dragons live in a volcanic area of the Wilderness. Their bones are well worth burying for the Prayer XP.
translation: 熔岩龙生活在荒野的火山区域。它们的骨头非常值得埋葬以获取祈祷经验值。

english: Waterfiends are creatures of water, which live under the Baxtorian Lake. Their watery form is well defended against slashing and piercing weapons, so use something blunt.
translation: 水魔是水中的生物，生活在巴克斯托里安湖下。它们的水形态对劈砍和穿刺武器有良好防御，所以使用钝器。

english: Bandits band together for protection against enemies such as yourself.
translation: 强盗们联合起来抵御像你这样的敌人。

english: Aviansies are bird-like creatures found in the icy dungeons of the north. Melee weapons can't reach them, so use Magic or Ranged attacks.
translation: 鸟人是类似鸟的生物，出现在北方的冰冷地牢中。近战武器够不到它们，所以使用魔法或远程攻击。

english: Smoke Devils emit a lot of noxious gases & are slow and lumbering. You'll need a facemask in order to get anywhere near them.
translation: 烟魔会排放大量有毒气体，并且行动缓慢笨重。你需要一个面罩才能靠近它们。

english: Terror dogs are the personal pets of Tarn Razorlor. Wherever you find him, you will find them. They are bad-tempered and generally unfriendly.
translation: 恐怖犬是塔恩.拉佐洛的私人宠物。无论你在哪里找到他，都会找到它们。它们脾气暴躁，通常不友好。

english: Ents are walking tree-people. Bring a hatchet to chop their wood once you've slain them.
translation: 树人是行走的树人。带一把斧头，杀死它们后砍下它们的木材。

english: Dark Beasts are large, dog-like predators. Their massively muscled bodies protect them from crushing weapons.
translation: 暗黑兽是大型的、类似狗的捕食者。它们肌肉发达的身体保护它们免受粉碎武器的伤害。

english: Oh yes, you're currently assigned to kill Callisto. How many would you like to slay?
translation: 哦对，你目前的任务是击杀卡利斯托。你想杀多少只？

english: Sorry, but you're not strong enough to be taught by me. Your best trainer would be Turael in Burthorpe.
translation: 抱歉，你还没有强大到足以让我来指导。你最好的训练师是伯索普的图拉尔。

english: Oh yes, you're currently assigned to kill Venenatis. How many would you like to slay?
translation: 哦对，你目前的任务是击杀维内纳蒂斯。你想杀多少只？

english: Oh yes, you're currently assigned to kill K'ril Tsutsaroth. How many would you like to slay?
translation: 哦对，你目前的任务是击杀克里尔.楚萨罗斯。你想杀多少只？

english: Oh yes, you're currently assigned to kill Kree'arra. How many would you like to slay?
translation: 哦对，你目前的任务是击杀克里阿拉。你想杀多少只？

english: You must complete the entire Inferno, including TzKal- Zuk. Beware, only those skilled in combat should attempt this and death will cancel your task.
translation: 你必须完成整个地狱，包括TzKal-Zuk。注意，只有精通战斗的人才应尝试，死亡将取消你的任务。

english: Oh yes, you're currently assigned to kill General Graardor. How many would you like to slay?
translation: 哦对，你目前的任务是击杀格拉多尔将军。你想杀多少只？

english: Sea Snakes are long and slithery with a venomous bite. The larger ones are more poisonous, so keep an eye on your health.
translation: 海蛇身体细长滑溜，带有毒咬。较大的海蛇毒性更强，所以要注意你的生命值。

english: Oh, on second thoughts, it doesn't look like you have anything in here that I don't already know.
translation: 哦，再想想，看来你这里面没什么我不知道的东西。

english: Who cares? It's the entire reason we are in this wretched cage! We need to learn the secret to flight, and the best way is to get these gullible humans to reveal it to us unwittingly. Blast them and their thumbs.
translation: 谁在乎？这就是我们困在这破烂笼子里的全部原因！我们需要学会飞行的秘密，最好的办法就是让这些轻信的人类在无意中透露给我们。该死的家伙和他们的大拇指。

english: The phrase is 'Do not trust the walrus.'
translation: 那句话是‘不要相信海象。’

english: This caused you to fly...ingenious.
translation: 这让你飞起来了……真有创意。

english: What bar? We have a bar? I need a drink!
translation: 什么酒吧？我们有酒吧？我需要喝一杯！

english: Sorry, no time. Remember comrade, strength through unity!
translation: 抱歉，没时间。记住，同志，团结就是力量！

english: Good luck with that. Only time I saw those guards leave was to try and arrest those bards.
translation: 祝你好运。我唯一一次看到那些守卫离开，是去逮捕那些吟游诗人。

english: This is just the entrance hall, nothing is going on. All the research goes on deeper in the 'berg.
translation: 这只是入口大厅，什么事都没有。所有研究都在冰山的深处进行。

english: Haa haa haa...oh you have me in stitches.
translation: 哈哈哈……哦，你笑死我了。

english: Don't lose sight of our goal, comrade. Through fight and flight we shall conquer!
translation: 不要忘记我们的目标，同志。通过战斗和飞行，我们必将征服！

english: I cannot speak to you, comrade... It is not safe.
translation: 我不能和你说话，同志……这不安全。

english: What, ain't you ever seen a black and white before?
translation: 怎么，你以前没见过黑白相间的吗？

english: You need check in with the operatives in Lumbridge before you head to the outpost. They might have some news for you to take as well.
translation: 你在前往前哨站之前，需要先去仑桥镇与那里的特工接头。他们可能也有一些消息要你带去。

english: No, thank you. I've just had lunch.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我刚吃过午饭。

english: Do not be so careless again, comrade. What if our reports fell into the wrong hands?
translation: 别再这么粗心了，同志。要是我们的报告落入坏人手里怎么办？

english: You have the report in your bank. How did you get a bank account comrade?
translation: 报告在你的银行里。你是怎么搞到银行账户的，同志？

english: You haven't got enough space to carry it.
translation: 你没有足够的空间携带它。

english: Every two-bit soldier knows that salute. We won't give you the time of day without the secret phrase. Now GO AWAY.
translation: 每个二流士兵都知道那种敬礼。不说出暗号，我们可不会搭理你。现在滚开吧。

english: They are lazy, good for nothing, codfish addicts. GO AWAY.
translation: 他们又懒又没用，还是鳕鱼成瘾者。滚开。

english: Excellent! The humans an aficionado! Make yourself comfortable and I'll begin...
translation: 太好了！这个人类是个行家！请随意坐好，我这就开始……

english: Have you dealt with the Farmer?
translation: 你处理掉那个农夫了吗？

english: Well, don't just stand there!
translation: 喂，别光站着！

english: Twinkle, twinkle little egg Wouldn't you like to grow some legs? And run around, on grass so green arguing with the milk and cream.
translation: 一闪一闪小蛋蛋，你不想长几条腿吗？在绿草上跑来跑去，和牛奶和奶油争吵。

english: You again?
translation: 又是你？

english: You still have the original one. Go away.
translation: 你还有原来那份呢。走开。

english: The humans found some symbols  And doesn't know what they mean So now it's cross-examining me And spoiling my routine!
translation: 人类发现了些符号，却不知含义如何。于是跑来盘问我，打乱我的日常节奏！

english: You klutz! Don't lose it this time.
translation: 你这个笨蛋！这次可别再弄丢了。

english: You have the report in your bank. Wow, you managed to get a bank account? Must have had a good human disguise.
translation: 报告在你银行里。哇，你居然能开银行账户？那肯定是用了不错的人类伪装。

english: You don't have enough space.
translation: 你没空间了。

english: Oi, cheers. 'Ers 'ur stuff, now git outta 'ere.
translation: 喂，谢了。这是你的货，现在滚出去。

english: The feds are everywhere!
translation: 条子到处都是！

english: Didja bring de stuff?
translation: 你带东西来了吗？

english: Whers me swamp tur?
translation: 我的沼泽龟呢？

english: Go away, 'ur attractin' attention.
translation: 走开，你在引人注意。

english: Oi, clear ou' 'ur pack.
translation: 喂，清空你的包。

english: Oi, git away. I'm doin' bizness 'ere.
translation: 喂，走开。我在这儿做生意。

english: Did you bring the instruments?
translation: 你带乐器来了吗？

english: Man, our vibes say that we're ready to sing for you.
translation: 老兄，我们的气场告诉我们，我们准备好为你演唱了。

english: Cool man, you got yourself a fine instrument.
translation: 酷啊老兄，你弄到了一件好乐器。

english: What do we need that for, man?
translation: 我们要那个干嘛，老兄？

english: What do we need that for, dude?
translation: 我们要那个干嘛，哥们？

english: That's what I have been saying from the start! But an entire army? This is just an outpost, so it can't be an entire army.
translation: 我从一开始就这么说了！但一整支军队？这里只是个前哨站，所以不可能是整支军队。

english: On the way I'll tell you how I got this great rucksack. I had this paper hat lying around...
translation: 路上我会告诉你我是怎么弄到这个大背包的。我有一顶纸帽子放在旁边...

english: Did I ever tell you about this one time...
translation: 我有没有跟你讲过有一次...

english: On the way I'll tell you how I learned to teleport. Well, this one time I got stuck in a wall...
translation: 在路上我会告诉你我是如何学会传送的。嗯，有一次我被卡在墙里...

english: The trip can be rather tedious so I will regale you with stories of my duties at the Zoo. Every morning I had to scoop...
translation: 这趟旅程可能会很无聊，所以我会跟你讲讲我在动物园的职责故事。每天早上我都要铲...

english: Well...it's permanent leave, and I am doing research! When I used to work at the Zoo, I noticed the penguins doing odd things, like taking notes or timing things. I asked to have my work detail transferred to
translation: 嗯...这是永久休假，而且我在做研究！我以前在动物园工作时，注意到企鹅在做奇怪的事，比如记笔记或计时。我申请把我的工作调去

english: their cage and I was fired!
translation: 它们的笼子，然后我就被开除了！

english: I was chatting with a local farmer, and there is a rumour about a 'thing' that lives around here. Maybe it's the penguins, and these simple people don't recognise them.
translation: 我跟一个当地农夫聊过，有个谣言说这里住着一个'东西'。也许是企鹅，而这些单纯的人认不出它们。

english: But you don't think penguins are dangerous, anyway. So there's no danger is there? Or are you coming around to my thinking that they are dangerous?
translation: 但反正你不觉得企鹅危险。所以没有危险，对吧？还是你开始同意我的想法，觉得它们危险了？

english: You need to have the suit with you if we are going to use it.
translation: 如果我们想用它，你得把企鹅装带在身上。

english: As a penguin?
translation: 扮成企鹅？

english: So, you'll be a human, pretending to be a penguin, pretending to be a human.
translation: 所以，你会是一个人类，假装成企鹅，再假装成人类。

english: I'd like an Oak table built.
translation: 我想造一张橡木桌。

english: Our work is at the iceberg now. I will meet you there.
translation: 我们现在的工作地点在冰山。我会在那里等你。

english: I can't talk about that right now.
translation: 我现在不能谈那个。

english: Oh, I don't have time for your lies. Go away.
translation: 哦，我没时间听你撒谎。走开。

english: But, there is no King of Lumbridge.
translation: 但是，仑桥镇没有国王啊。

english: Do you have all the items we need?
translation: 你带齐我们需要的所有物品了吗？

english: Let's go to the iceberg. We have much to do.
translation: 我们去冰山吧。还有很多事要做。

english: Now you know how it feels to be told you're crazy. Go tell the penguins about him.
translation: 现在你知道被人说疯子的感觉了吧。去跟企鹅说说他的事。

english: Well done. Now let's go to the iceberg and try it out.
translation: 做得好。现在我们去冰山试试看。

english: What did you drag me back here for? We need to discuss our observations before we move forward.
translation: 你把我拉回这里干嘛？在继续前进之前，我们需要讨论一下观察结果。

english: I'm too tired to teleport again. You'll have to use the boat in Rellekka.
translation: 我太累了，不能再传送了。你得用雷勒卡城的船。

english: You can't bring your cat with you. Penguins hate cats, with a passion. They'll smell it a mile off. Put it in your bag first.
translation: 你不能带你的猫。企鹅非常讨厌猫。它们一英里外就能闻到猫味。先把它放进你的袋子里。

english: We should go to the iceberg. There is much work to be done.
translation: 我们应该去冰山。还有很多工作要做。

english: The book will explain how to make the suit. But, since you seem to lazy to read it, I'll summarise.
translation: 这本书会解释怎么做企鹅装。不过，既然你懒得读，我就总结一下。

english: I can't see why not. Just be careful with it. Come back to me when you have finished and I'll complete any repairs it might need.
translation: 我看不出有什么不行。小心点用。用完后回来找我，我会修好它需要的任何地方。

english: Hmm...well...what about what those penguins on the iceberg did? It looked like they did three movements as a greeting or something.
translation: 嗯...好吧...那冰山上那些企鹅做的动作呢？看起来它们做了三个动作，像是在打招呼之类的。

english: Well, you've finished the bird hide, we might as well use it! Hurry back!
translation: 好吧，你完成了鸟类掩体，我们不如就用它！快回来！

english: My hands were shaking too badly. Besides, I told YOU to write it down! Well, just guess if you can't remember.
translation: 我的手抖得太厉害了。而且，我告诉过你让你写下来！好吧，如果你记不住，就猜猜看。

english: What did you do, lose your spade? You need to finish the bird hide. Use the boat to get back to the iceberg, post haste!
translation: 你做了什么，丢了铲子？你需要完成鸟巢。使用船尽快回到冰山！

english: I could ask you the same question. Go finish the bird hide!
translation: 我也想问你同样的问题。去完成鸟类掩体！

english: You can't bring your cat with you. Penguins hate cats, with a passion. They'll smell it a mile off. Put it in your bag and then we'll leave.
translation: 你不能带你的猫。企鹅非常讨厌猫。它们一英里外就能闻到猫味。先把它放进你的袋子里，然后我们就出发。

english: Quiet little chatter monkey. I'm observing penguins, I have no time for monkeys.
translation: 安静点，小话痨猴子。我在观察企鹅，没时间理猴子。

english: Time to put your information to the test. Just get in the boat and we'll be off.
translation: 是时候检验你的情报了。上船吧，我们出发。

english: Unfortunately you haven't unlocked access to the Fremennik Province so I cannot teleport you there.
translation: 不幸的是，你还没解锁弗瑞曼尼可省的通行权，所以我无法传送你过去。

english: If you use leather and a mahogany plank, you could make a set of bongos.
translation: 如果你用皮革和一块红木木板，你可以做一套邦戈鼓。

english: Who's Noodle?
translation: 努德尔是谁？

english: Well, you made the suit. Now meet me at the boat, but make sure you take the suit with you!
translation: 好吧，你做好了企鹅装。现在到船那里找我，但记得带上企鹅装！

english: Why are you talking about pasta? We're on a mission here!
translation: 你为什么在说意大利面？我们这是在执行任务！

english: I've never been there, but as my boat is clearly not here, perhaps this isn't a good place to discuss it anyway.
translation: 我从没去过那里，但既然我的船显然不在这里，也许这里也不是讨论这事的好地方。

english: I got lonely. Go back to the iceberg; we need to discuss our observations before we move forward.
translation: 我太孤单了。回冰山去；在继续前进之前，我们需要讨论一下观察结果。

english: Well, get going then!
translation: 好吧，那就快去吧！

english: Yes! Take my boat and go a very long way from me! And take your arm with you!
translation: 对！坐我的船离我远远的！把你的胳膊也带走！

english: I have my reasons. Now that you've finally finished the bird hide, we need to observe the penguins. Go back to the iceberg.
translation: 我有我的理由。既然你终于完成了鸟类掩体，我们需要观察企鹅。回冰山去。

english: Of course. Just have a look around here for a shifty pasta penguin.
translation: 当然。就在这附近找找看有没有可疑的意大利面企鹅。

english: Better give that instrument to the bard penguins.
translation: 最好把那件乐器交给吟游诗人企鹅。

english: Um... I think I must have misheard you, but the only thing I'll let my boat do is travel from here to Rellekka, with me in it. I'm not risking getting marooned here.
translation: 嗯...我想我一定是听错了，但我的船唯一能做的就是载着我和我从这里到雷勒卡城。我可不想冒险被困在这里。

english: I'd like an Oak drawer built.
translation: 我想造一个橡木抽屉柜。

english: Sorry, I'm not letting my boat go on detours, not from this place. I'm not risking getting marooned here.
translation: 抱歉，我不会让我的船绕路，尤其是从这地方。我可不想冒险被困在这里。

english: Hmm, I haven't heard of any monsters. You better be careful, now.
translation: 嗯，我没听说过什么怪物。你现在最好小心点。

english: You have everything. Now just take them to the boat and we'll go to the iceberg.
translation: 你带齐了所有东西。现在把它们拿到船上，我们去冰山。

english: We don't need to be here right now. You should return to the mainland.
translation: 我们现在不需要待在这里。你应该回大陆去。

english: To keep you from getting into trouble.
translation: 为了不让你惹上麻烦。

english: I'd like my drawers fixed.
translation: 我想修好我的抽屉柜。

english: Good, now go speak to the penguin.
translation: 好，现在去跟企鹅说话。

english: I'd like my grandfather clock fixed.
translation: 我想修好我的落地大钟。

english: I'd like my table fixed.
translation: 我想修好我的桌子。

english: I don't know. They won't talk to me. That's why you're running around in a penguin suit.
translation: 我不知道。它们不跟我说话。所以才是你穿着企鹅装到处跑。

english: I'd like an Mahogany table built.
translation: 我想造一张红木桌。

english: You don't have any space for it.
translation: 你没有空间放它。

english: I'd like an Mahogany drawers built.
translation: 我想造一个红木抽屉柜。

english: You seem to be lacking a few of the items.
translation: 你似乎还缺几样物品。

english: You have everything. Now you just need to build the hide.
translation: 你带齐了所有东西。现在你只需要建造掩体。

english: You need to have the suit with you before I can shrink you.
translation: 在我缩小你之前，你得把企鹅装带在身上。

english: Good luck. Don't let the penguins get the better of you! Just remember, they can't even fly.
translation: 祝你好运。别让企鹅占了上风！记住，它们连飞都不会。

english: Dumb human?
translation: 愚蠢的人类？

english: I definitely don't need that.
translation: 我绝对不需要那个。

english: I'd like an Teak drawers built.
translation: 我想造一个柚木抽屉柜。

english: I'd like an Oak drawers built.
translation: 我想造一个橡木抽屉柜。

english: What's the point in going back if you don't have the penguin suit?
translation: 如果你没有企鹅装，回去有什么意义？

english: I can't speak to you here; there are too many spies.
translation: 我不能在这里跟你说话；间谍太多了。

english: If you use leather and a mahogany plank you could make a set of bongos.
translation: 如果你用皮革和一块红木木板，你可以做一套邦戈鼓。

english: I'd like an Wood table built.
translation: 我想造一张木桌。

english: I'd like an Teak table built.
translation: 我想造一张柚木桌。

english: Then what are you standing around here for? Go listen to them.
translation: 那你还在等什么？去听它们说话。

english: You're currently on wave 2. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第二波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: You're currently on wave 3. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第三波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: You're currently on wave 10. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第十波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: You're currently on wave 4. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第四波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: Don't you want it anymore? I'll buy it back off you for 300 points in each of the four roles.
translation: 你不要它了吗？我会用四个角色各300点回购它。

english: You're currently on wave 5. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第五波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: You're currently on wave 6. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第六波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: You're currently on wave 7. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第七波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: You're currently on wave 8. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第八波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: You're currently on wave 9. So you want to start on wave one again?
translation: 你目前在第九波。你想从第一波重新开始吗？

english: I'm not taking that off you!
translation: 我可不会从你那拿走那东西！

english: Don't you want it anymore? I'll buy it back off you for 220 points in each of the four roles.
translation: 你不要它了吗？我会用四个角色各220点回购它。

english: Don't you want it anymore? I'll buy it back off you for 80 points in each of the four roles.
translation: 你不要它了吗？我会用四个角色各80点回购它。

english: Don't you want it anymore? I'll buy it back off you for 120 points in each of the four roles.
translation: 你不要它了吗？我会用四个角色各120点回购它。

english: You have: 209 Attacker Honour Points, 196 Defender Honour Points, 39 [player name] Honour Points and 82 Healer Honour Points.
translation: 你有：209 攻击者荣誉点数，196 防御者荣誉点数，39 [player name] 荣誉点数，以及 82 治疗者荣誉点数。

english: To create crystal tools you also need the dragon equivalent and 180 crystal shards.
translation: 要制作水晶工具，你还需要龙族对应工具和180个水晶碎片。

english: To create crystal tools, you also need the dragon equivalent and 180 crystal shards.
translation: 要制作水晶工具，你还需要龙族对应工具和180个水晶碎片。

english: To corrupt the Blade of Saeldor, you need 1000 crystal shards, plus another 500 shards for me to do it.
translation: 要腐化赛尔多尔之刃，你需要1000个水晶碎片，外加我操作的500个碎片。

english: To create crystal armour you need 50 crystal shards per seed used, plus another 60 shards for me to do it.
translation: 要制作水晶盔甲，每个种子需要50个水晶碎片，外加我操作的60个碎片。

english: To corrupt the Blade of Saeldor you need some crystal shards plus 500 for me to do it.
translation: 要腐化赛尔多尔之刃，你需要一些水晶碎片，外加我操作的500个碎片。

english: To corrupt the Bow of Faerdhinen, you need 2000 crystal shards, plus another 1000 shards for me to do it.
translation: 要腐化法尔迪宁之弓，你需要2000个水晶碎片，外加我操作的1000个碎片。

english: To create crystal armour, you need 50 crystal shards per seed used, plus another 60 shards for me to do it.
translation: 要制作水晶盔甲，每个种子需要50个水晶碎片，外加我操作的60个碎片。

english: To create a celestial signet, you need a celestial ring, elven signet, 100 crystal shards and 1000 stardust, plus another 50 shards for me to do it.
translation: 要制作天界印章，你需要一个天界戒指、一个精灵印章、100个水晶碎片和1000个星尘，外加我操作的50个碎片。

english: To create crystal tools you also need the dragon equivalent and 180 crystal shards, and to create crystal armour you need 50 crystal shards per seed used, plus another 60 shards for me to do it.
translation: 要制作水晶工具，你还需要龙族对应工具和180个水晶碎片；要制作水晶盔甲，每个种子需要50个水晶碎片，外加我操作的60个碎片。

english: To create crystal tools, you also need the dragon equivalent and 180 crystal shards, and to create crystal armour you need 50 crystal shards per seed used, plus another 60 shards for me to do it.
translation: 要制作水晶工具，你还需要龙族对应工具和180个水晶碎片；要制作水晶盔甲，每个种子需要50个水晶碎片，外加我操作的60个碎片。

english: You do not have enough materials to make any items currently.
translation: 你目前没有足够的材料来制作任何物品。

english: Now you have gained some experience in cooking, you can look forward to creating many more dishes.
translation: 现在你有了一些烹饪经验，可以期待做出更多菜肴了。

english: If you feel up to the task, you could try your hand at making pizza. A pizza is comprised of flour with water. Put some tomato on there, sprinkle on some cheese then cook it. You might consider adding a topping too.
translation: 如果你觉得可以胜任，可以尝试做披萨。披萨由面粉和水制成。放上一些番茄，撒上一些乳酪，然后烤熟。你也可以考虑加些配料。

english: But if you are looking for something with a bit of a kick, I suggest curry.
translation: 但如果你想找点带劲的，我推荐咖喱。

english: Potatoes are another great food, you can put all sorts of toppings on them if you so desire. Such as eggs and tomato.
translation: 土豆是另一种很棒的食物，如果你愿意，可以在上面放各种配料，比如鸡蛋和番茄。

english: The river north of here has an abundance of fish you could fish for, if you have the required fishing level to catch them. Alternatively, you could make stews.
translation: 北边的河里有很多鱼可以钓，只要你的钓鱼等级够高。或者，你也可以做炖菜。

english: Those foods may heal you for more in return though. Stews are a good option.
translation: 不过那些食物能给你回复更多生命值。炖菜是个不错的选择。

english: As you increase your cooking skill you will gain access to making more complicated dishes. The dishes may require more than two different ingredients to make, they could even require a new way of cooking them.
translation: 随着烹饪技能的提高，你将能制作更复杂的菜肴。这些菜肴可能需要两种以上不同的原料，甚至可能需要新的烹饪方式。

english: To make a stew you will need a bowl of water, a potato and some cooked meat. You can find all these things in Lumbridge. Then use them on the bowl of water and cook it!
translation: 要做炖菜，你需要一碗水、一个土豆和一些熟肉。这些东西在仑桥镇都能找到。然后把它们用到一碗水上，再煮熟就行了！

english: Now you will need to pick your topping if you want one. Get yourself a bowel and create the perfect topping. Then put the topping onto the potato.
translation: 现在，如果你想要配料，就得自己选一个。拿个碗，做出完美的配料，然后把配料放到土豆上。

english: You could visit the gnome stronghold and talk to Blurberry or Aluft Gianne snr. to learn about gnome cooking. They make all sorts of treats and drinks.
translation: 你可以去地精要塞，跟布鲁贝利或老阿鲁夫特.吉安聊聊，学习地精烹饪。他们会做各种美食和饮品。

english: You could talk to Rantz about Chompy Bird hunting, Chompy bird is very tasty. You can find Rantz East of Ogre city just north of the swamp pool.
translation: 你可以跟兰茨聊聊关于猎食人鸟的事，食人鸟非常美味。兰茨在食人魔城东边，沼泽池北边。

english: If you're looking for quests, head over to the Black Guard HQ in Keldagrim and find Commander Veldaban to find out more about that drunken dwarf.
translation: 如果你想找任务，就去凯尔达格林城的黑卫队总部，找维尔达班指挥官，了解更多关于那个醉酒的矮人的事。

english: Don't forget you can always go Chompy Bird hunting too! Talk to Rantz East of Ogre city just north of the swamp pool.
translation: 别忘了你随时都可以去猎食人鸟！跟食人魔城东边、沼泽池北边的兰茨聊聊。

english: Ah, yer misunderstand me lad, I wasn't generalising about the whole dwarf species, I had just stolen a bundle of jewels from a very specific group of dwarves who happened to have an odious stench about them!
translation: 啊，你误会我了小子，我不是在概括整个矮人种族，我只是从一群恰好有恶臭的特定矮人那里偷了一包首饰！

english: Ah, yer misunderstand me lass, I wasn't generalising about the whole dwarf species, I had just stolen a bundle of jewels from a very specific group of dwarves who happened to have an odious stench about them!
translation: 啊，你误会我了姑娘，我不是在概括整个矮人种族，我只是从一群恰好有恶臭的特定矮人那里偷了一包首饰！

english: You are a very strange young man...
translation: 你是个非常奇怪的年轻人……

english: I suggest you search the larger temples to his honour.
translation: 我建议你去搜索供奉他的大型神庙。

english: You are a very strange young woman...
translation: 你是个非常奇怪的年轻女人……

english: ...You are a very strange young man.
translation: ……你是个非常奇怪的年轻人。

english: Yes, of course... But you will need free space in your inventory first...
translation: 是的，当然……但你需要先腾出背包空间……

english: Mistress, I have returned with what thou asked me toretrieve. As I see thy inventory is full, I shall wait withthese 18 items until thou art ready.
translation: 女主人，我已带回您吩咐我取的东西。但我见您的背包已满，我将带着这18件物品等候，直到您准备好。

english: I wrote that letter to my late husband when he was exploring there.
translation: 那封信是我写给我已故丈夫的，当时他正在那里探险。

english: That was a great city as well, but the museum could only fund one excavation and this one was closer to home.
translation: 那座城市也很棒，但博物馆只能资助一次发掘，而这次离家更近。

english: Soon this world will cower once more at the name of Hazeel, and my fury will blaze across mine enemies just as my loyal followers gain their rewards.
translation: 很快，这个世界将再次在哈兹尔的名字面前颤抖，我的怒火将在敌人身上燃烧，正如我忠诚的追随者将获得他们的奖赏。

english: I knew they could not trap me here for long!
translation: 我知道他们不能把我困在这里太久！

english: You do not know of the battle?
translation: 你不知道那场战斗？

english: Warrior, for your efforts in freeing me, I offer you the gift of knowledge.
translation: 战士，为了你释放我的努力，我赐予你知识的礼物。

english: Well done, soldier, tell me, how goes the battle?
translation: 做得好，士兵，告诉我，战斗进行得如何？

english: They will replace the knowledge you previously had, but you may switch between them by praying at the altar in this room at any time.
translation: 它们将取代你之前拥有的知识，但你可以随时通过在这个房间的祭坛祈祷来切换它们。

english: More time must have passed than I had thought...
translation: 一定比我预想的过去了更多时间……

english: Now, I must leave you, for there must be some trace of my masters power left somewhere. Feel free to use the portal I shall create to return here easily in the future!
translation: 现在，我必须离开你，因为我主人的力量一定在某处留有踪迹。随意使用我将创造的传送门，以便将来轻松返回！

english: My lord... What has become of you? I cannot hear your voice in my mind anymore!
translation: 我的主人……你怎么了？我再也听不到你在我心中的声音了！

english: If the shining cities no longer stand, then it means that we must have failed my lord...
translation: 如果光辉之城已不复存在，那就意味着我们一定辜负了我的主人……

english: My thanks to you brave warrior for your help in freeing me from this accursed tomb, but it seems I have much to do to make amends.
translation: 感谢你，勇敢的战士，帮我从这被诅咒的坟墓中解脱，但我似乎还有很多事要做来弥补。

english: How long have I been trapped here? Master... Have you truly been dispatched from this world?
translation: 我被困在这里多久了？主人……你真的已经离开这个世界了吗？

english: I trust that we shall meet again adventurer, I offer you the blessings of myself and my master in all of your endeavours!
translation: 我相信我们会再见的，冒险者，我代表我和我的主人在你所有的努力中给予你祝福！

english: I bestow upon you the ancient magicks, taught me by my Lord before his disappearance, may you use them well in battle for our people!
translation: 我赐予你古老的魔法，这是我在主人消失前他教给我的，愿你在为我们人民的战斗中善加利用！

english: Ah, the Imcando Hammer. A very useful tool for Smithing and Construction. I could repair it for 1,250 barronite shards if you like?
translation: 啊，伊姆坎多锤。对于锻造和建筑来说非常有用的工具。我可以帮你修复它，需要1,250个巴隆石碎片，你要吗？

english: That looks like part of a weapon. Hmm, I might be able to make something out of it. You'll need to have all the right pieces... and 1,500 barronite shards.
translation: 那看起来像武器的一部分。嗯，我或许能用它做成点什么。你需要集齐所有正确的部件……还有1,500个巴隆石碎片。

english: Hmm, for a minute, I suppose 1,000 barronite shards should do the trick.
translation: 嗯，等一下，我想1,000个巴隆石碎片应该就够了。

english: Ah, that's a golem core. They're used to power the golems. You're lucky it survived with the damage you must have dealt to the thing.
translation: 啊，那是一个魔像核心。它们用来给魔像提供能量。你能在给那东西造成如此大损伤后让它幸存下来，真是幸运。

english: I'm afraid not. I'm not an expert in magic. But from what I remember, the cores were created using the power of the relevant runic altars.
translation: 恐怕不行。我不是魔法专家。但据我所知，这些核心是利用相关符文祭坛的力量制造的。

english: Best of luck [player name].
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]。

english: Apparently the dwarves of the golem workshop once used old cores to craft runes. Maybe you could do the same.
translation: 显然，魔像工作室的矮人曾用旧核心来制作符文。或许你也可以这么做。

english: Yama! I sold my soul you see, well, I guess that Ox- headed guy down there forcibly removed it.
translation: 阎魔！你看，我卖掉了我的灵魂，嗯，我猜是下面那个牛头家伙强行把它拿走了。

english: My mastew wishes u not to kiww his minions without anagenda. You may onwy sway within da Chasm that whichu have been assigned by a Swayew Mastew.
translation: 我的主人希望你如果没有任务就不要杀死他的爪牙。你只能在杀戮大师指定的深渊范围内进行杀戮。

english: What can I do for you, sir?
translation: 我能为您做点什么，先生？

english: What can I do for you, m'lady?
translation: 我能为您做点什么，女士？

english: Do you want me to remove your PvP protection?
translation: 你想让我移除你的 PvP 保护吗？

english: I can see you're the same as me; you've been to a lot of dangerous places too!
translation: 我看得出你和我一样；你也去过很多危险的地方！

english: I can remove your PvP protection, if you had any.
translation: 如果你有的话，我可以移除你的 PvP 保护。

english: Wayuckk! No, I would never debase myself to eat such filth.
translation: 哇呀！不，我绝不会自甘堕落到去吃那种脏东西。

english: I am a cat of high breeding! My family tree dates back to days before any sultan or king of Gielinor.
translation: 我是一只血统高贵的猫！我的家族谱系可以追溯到吉列诺任何一位苏丹或国王之前。

english: I am my own cat. I'm not owned by anyone, although I do permit the high priest of Icthlarin to feed me.
translation: 我是我自己的猫。我不属于任何人，不过我允许伊克哈林的大祭司喂我。

english: The Sphinx has no friends. She is too wrapped up in preserving her immortality for friends.
translation: 斯芬克斯没有朋友。她只顾着维护自己的永生，没空交朋友。

english: Well, because her immortality is based on the fact that she keeps us cats safe, so her whole existence is dedicated to protecting us.
translation: 嗯，因为她的永生是建立在她保护我们猫族安全的基础上，所以她整个存在就是为了保护我们。

english: True, life shouldn't be hoarded but lived...but don't tell her that; otherwise I'd have to be on the lookout for a new guardian.
translation: 没错，生命不该被囤积，而应该被活出来……但别告诉她；否则我就得另找新的守护者了。

english: The old high priest was a vindictive and cranky old man. If he ever didn't get his way, he would make everyone suffer until someone crumbled and gave in to his will. I must say that I respected that in him.
translation: 前任大祭司是个睚眦必报、脾气暴躁的老人。一旦无法如愿，他就会让所有人受苦，直到有人屈服于他的意志。我得说，我对此还挺敬佩的。

english: That's probably because most of the townsfolk fled as soon as the plague broke out. They had no confidence in him to fix things. Though, I must say, he treats me much better than the old high priest.
translation: 这大概是因为瘟疫爆发后大多数镇民都逃走了。他们对他解决问题没什么信心。不过，我得说，他对我可比前任大祭司好多了。

english: The new high priest is a bit of a wet towel. He is very unsure of himself and has little respect from the people of the town.
translation: 新任大祭司有点像个软蛋。他非常不自信，也得不到镇上居民的尊重。

english: A large black cat, purrr?
translation: 一只大黑猫，喵呜？

english: I sssshouldn't talk to strangers.
translation: 我不该和陌生人说话。

english: Purrr... Nice to meet you, [player name]. My name is Neite.
translation: 喵呜……很高兴见到你，[player name]。我叫奈特。

english: Well, life here in the desert can be a lonely existence, even with all my busy work...and he is the most eligible bachelor around. When I hear about him, it makes my whiskers tingle... But, to be honest, he worries me.
translation: 嗯，沙漠里的生活很孤独，就算我整天忙忙碌碌……而他是附近最合适的单身汉。每次听到他的消息，我的胡须都会发颤……但说实话，他让我担心。

english: I don't know if you could ever get to know that cat. He is a bit of an enigma...always wandering but yet no one knows what he's looking for. He's quite a handsome beast, though!
translation: 我不知道你能不能了解那只猫。他有点像个谜……总是在游荡，却没人知道他在找什么。不过，他可是个英俊的家伙！

english: Well, I pride myself on my knowledge of the family lines of cats. Obviously, Bob features quite heavily in most cats' family trees, but he himself has none!
translation: 嗯，我以自己对猫族谱系的知识为傲。显然，鲍勃在大多数猫的家谱中都很重要，但他自己却没有家谱！

english: Well, like I say, they are just stories. Probably some tale a gnomish mother invented to keep her little tykes from running off into the forest alone!
translation: 嗯，就像我说的，那只是故事。大概是某个地精母亲编出来，不让小崽子们独自跑进森林的传说！

english: It would be my pleasure. I don't like riddles at the best of times! Now, if you'll excuse me, I have some washing to do.
translation: 这是我的荣幸。我最讨厌谜语了！现在，请原谅，我还有衣服要洗。

english: Somehow they manipulated the dragons' eggs and made them their own! Then the ssstories just end, as if they disappeared into the sssmoke.
translation: 不知怎么的，他们操纵了龙蛋，把它们变成了自己的！然后故事就结束了，好像他们消失在了烟雾中。

english: The kin? Well, it's mostly just stories. Some say they were the first - the true ancient race of this world. They were sssupposed to have harnessed the power of dragons, making the wild creatures do their bidding.
translation: 龙族？嗯，大多只是传说。有人说他们是第一批——这个世界真正的远古种族。据说他们驾驭了龙的力量，让这些野性生物听命于他们。

english: I mean, nobody is sure where he came from. Not even the Sssphinx knows. It's just one of those mysteries. There are even ancient drawings and ssstories that talk of a warrior known as 'Robert' and his ssstruggles
translation: 我的意思是，没人知道他来自哪里。连斯芬克斯都不知道。这只是个谜。甚至还有古老的图画和故事，提到一个叫'罗伯特'的战士和他的斗争

english: against the dragon-kin. He fought with a ferocious black panther who could swallow houses in one gulp!
translation: 对抗龙族。他和一只凶猛的黑豹并肩作战，那黑豹能一口吞下房子！

english: Hiss!!
Oh, stop being so condescending, you silly human, or I'll rip your face off.
translation: 哦，别这么居高临下，你这蠢人类，不然我撕烂你的脸。

english: Hssss. Life can come from destruction too. Take a volcano; it will destroy all life that surrounds it, but it will also fertilise and enrich the surrounding earth. From that earth, more life will spring forth than there
translation: 嘶嘶嘶。生命也能从毁灭中诞生。就拿火山来说；它会摧毁周围的一切生命，但也会肥沃周围的土地。从那片土地中，会涌现出比原来更多的生命。

english: was in the first place.
translation: 比原来更多。

english: No, that's not her true form. She has only taken to adopting a form similar to this recently, although she's had many other forms since we rose up against her.
translation: 不，那不是她的真实形态。她只是最近才开始采用类似这样的形态，尽管自从我们反抗她以来，她有过许多其他形态。

english: They thought they could undermine the mighty Elidinis so she buried them. They have never been seen around here since.
translation: 他们以为能削弱强大的艾莉迪尼斯，所以她把他们埋了。从那以后，他们再也没在这附近出现过。

english: Don't mock me. I do that to seek vengeance.
translation: 别嘲笑我。我这么做是为了寻求复仇。

english: I disagree. It's in my nature to prey on smaller pathetic life forms in the same way as it is in the volcanoes nature to explode.
translation: 我不同意。捕食更弱小的生命形式是我的天性，就像火山爆发是它的天性一样。

english: Hah! Those insane earth burrowers! They got their come-uppance!
translation: 哈！那些疯狂的地底钻洞者！他们活该！

english: Hiss, nothing.
translation: 嘶，没什么。

english: Hmm... Maybe... Why not. Do you know what The Wanderer's true form is?
translation: 嗯……也许……为什么不呢。你知道'流浪者'的真身是什么吗？

english: Hisss!!! What? Hiss!!!
translation: 嘶嘶嘶！！！什么？嘶嘶嘶！！！

english: Who? Someone glamorous, I'd bet, or perhaps regal.
translation: 谁？我猜是个迷人的人，或者是个高贵的人。

english: Her acolytes and her priestesses.
translation: 她的侍从和女祭司。

english: The Devourer was so in love with death and destruction that she even started destroying her own worshipers. We tolerated this until she even started to destroy her own temples and clergy.
translation: 吞噬者如此热爱死亡和毁灭，以至于她开始摧毁自己的信徒。我们一直容忍，直到她甚至开始摧毁自己的神庙和神职人员。

english: We cursed her so that her name would be forgotten, that any corporeal body she adopted would soon cast her out and never again would she gather willing worshipers.
translation: 我们诅咒了她，让她的名字被遗忘，让她任何占据的肉体都会很快抛弃她，让她再也无法聚集自愿的信徒。

english: No, I used to be human. In fact, I was one of her chief priestesses...but that was before we rose up.
translation: 不，我曾经是人类。事实上，我曾是她的一位大祭司……但那是在我们反抗之前。

english: No; I wasn't always a cat.
translation: 不；我不一直是猫。

english: I'm sure your cat did most of the hard work.
translation: 我敢肯定你的猫干了大部分苦活。

english: Hmm... She is not remembered; only her foul deeds are. As for adopting a form, I believe the next time you come across her, she will have been forced to find a new host.
translation: 嗯……她本人不被记住；只有她的恶行被记住。至于形态，我相信下次你遇到她时，她会被迫寻找新的宿主。

english: We could have, but at that point, our thirst for destruction was well sated.
translation: 我们本可以，但那时，我们对毁灭的渴望已经充分满足了。

english: Well, the quality of the help that she has been forced to take has been quite poor recently; you failed in the simple task of retrieving a jar for her.
translation: 嗯，她被迫雇用的帮手最近质量很差；你连帮她拿个罐子这种简单任务都失败了。

english: Well, because the few remaining of us still possess some degree of the powers she gave us.
translation: 嗯，因为我们剩下的少数人还拥有她赋予我们的一些力量。

english: I refuse to answer that; the less that people know about this, the safer I am.
translation: 我拒绝回答；知道这件事的人越少，我就越安全。

english: It is not in Icthlarin's best interest to let us die, so we will never die of natural causes.
translation: 让咱们死不符合伊克哈林的最佳利益，所以我们永远不会自然死亡。

english: Spite sustains me.
translation: 怨恨支撑着我。

english: Don't we all!
translation: 我们不都是吗！

english: Recently I have noticed that The Devourer has focused her attentions more on cats. I think she might believe that if all her original followers die, the curse will lift.
translation: 最近我注意到'吞噬者'将她的注意力更多地集中在猫身上。我想她可能认为如果她所有的原始追随者都死了，诅咒术就会解除。

english: Pah! Stupid human. I don't know why I bother to talk to you.
translation: 呸！愚蠢的人类。我不知道为什么还要费心跟你说话。

english: Under herself.
translation: 在她自己下面。

english: I don't know. I'm not stupid enough to try.
translation: 我不知道。我没蠢到去尝试。

english: To dig under.
translation: 挖到下面去。

english: Out gallivanting, hunting noobs in the Wilderness. You know what he's like.
translation: 出去游荡，在荒野里猎杀菜鸟。你知道他是什么样的人。

english: Yes, well, since the townspeople have returned, they've a lot more confidence in him and I think he may have gained some more self-belief.
translation: 是的，嗯，自从镇民们回来后，他们对他更有信心了，我想他也获得了一些自信。

english: The new high priest used to be a bit of a wet towel. He was very unsure of himself and had little respect from the people of the town.
translation: 新任大祭司以前有点像个软蛋。他非常不自信，也得不到镇上居民的尊重。

english: Hiss! Suit yourself, human.
translation: 嘶！随你便，人类。

english: What you choose to believe in is the illusion of choice?
translation: 你选择相信的东西，就是选择的幻觉？

english: When you get to my age, very little seems new any more.
translation: 到了我这个年纪，很少有东西看起来是新的了。

english: You should never ask a lady her age!
translation: 你永远不该问一位女士的年龄！

english: I suppose you've never heard the phrase, 'that's the nature of the beast'? Or maybe you were to busy pretending to decide to breathe.
translation: 我想你从没听过'这就是野兽的本性'这句话吧？或者你忙着假装决定呼吸去了。

english: Your cat tells me you're in a spot of bother; something to do with grave-robbing, tisk tisk. So unbecoming of a guardian of cats.
translation: 你的猫告诉我你遇到了点麻烦；跟盗墓有关，啧啧。这可不是一位猫咪守护者该有的行为。

english: Well, I have to say I enjoy a laugh at someone's expense now and again...so let's have a bit of fun.
translation: 嗯，我得说，偶尔拿别人寻开心也挺有意思的……那我们就来玩点好玩的吧。

english: I'll help you if you can answer a simple puzzle of mine, but...
translation: 如果你能答对我的一个小谜题，我就帮你，不过……

english: ...but if you answer incorrectly, I get to keep your cat.
translation: ……但如果你答错了，你的猫就归我了。

english: Now what was it with which you needed help? Oh yes, I remember; your cat mentioned something about grave- robbing.
translation: 你刚才需要帮助的是什么事来着？哦，对了，我想起来了；你的猫提到了盗墓的事。

english: Too true, you didn't rob just anybody's tomb, you robbed the grave of the late high priest of Icthlarin.
translation: 没错，你盗的不是普通人的墓，而是已故的伊克哈林大祭司的坟墓。

english: Have you had any strange turns, flashbacks or out-of- body experiences recently?
translation: 你最近有没有经历过什么奇怪的转变、闪回或灵魂出窍？

english: Ah hah. It sounds like someone hypnotised you and forced you to carry out their bidding. I won't get any more involved with your petty human bickerings; I have my own kingdom to look after. However, I will give you
translation: 啊哈。听起来像是有人催眠了你，强迫你执行他们的命令。我不想再掺和你们人类那些鸡毛蒜皮的争吵了；我自己的王国还等着我去打理呢。不过，我可以给你

english: Here, I have a token that he will know is from me. Take that to him and I'm sure he will talk to you.
translation: 拿着，我有一枚代币，他看到就知道是我给的。把这个带给他，我相信他会跟你谈谈的。

english: Really? So explain why the shade of the high priest is ranting about you to the west of here...or how about explaining why you have a burial jar in your possession?
translation: 真的吗？那解释一下为什么大祭司的阴魂在这西边对你喋喋不休……或者解释一下为什么你身上会有一个葬瓮？

english: The trials of humans concern me not, but I do make exceptions for guardians of my kind.
translation: 人类的纷争与我无关，但对我同类的守护者，我可以破例。

english: Simple: I can smell the rotting organs from here.
translation: 简单：我在这里就能闻到腐烂的内脏味。

english: one bit of advice: seek out the new high priest to the south-west of this town. He will help you.
translation: 给你一个建议：去这座城镇西南边找新任大祭司。他会帮你的。

english: I'm afraid I will be of little help here. All I can do is hypnotise Bob, I can't enter his mind and choose which memory to view.
translation: 恐怕我在这里帮不上什么忙。我最多只能催眠鲍勃，但无法进入他的大脑选择查看哪段记忆。

english: Ahh yes. That amulet of yours is very useful but it has limitations. I can use my power to grant you the ability to talk to cats even when you're not wearing it.
translation: 啊，是的。你的那条护身符很有用，但有限制。我可以利用我的力量赐予你即使不佩戴它也能与猫交谈的能力。

english: Hello human, Bob was just telling me about your dungeon.
translation: 你好，人类，鲍勃刚才正在跟我讲你的地牢呢。

english: Very few humans are ever given this power, but you've proved yourself to be a friend to feline kind.
translation: 很少有人类能获得这种力量，但你已经证明了自己是猫族的朋友。

english: I hope that you will come to the understanding that not all the world's problems can be solved by an individual. You've done your bit; it's now up to the Menaphites and the priests of Icthlarin to solve this standoff.
translation: 我希望你能明白，并非世界上所有问题都能靠一个人解决。你已经尽了自己的力；现在该由梅纳菲特人和伊克哈林的祭司们来解决这场对峙了。

english: I have to confess that, despite myself, I am impressed by your actions. I may have some work for you at a later date.
translation: 我不得不承认，尽管我不情愿，但你的行为让我印象深刻。以后我可能有些工作要交给你。

english: You have the feel of a cat person about you. Do you look after one?
translation: 你身上有种爱猫之人的气质。你养猫吗？

english: How go things, great guardian of cats?
translation: 事情进展如何，伟大的猫之守护者？

english: I have helped you enough, or at least as much as I'm willing to.
translation: 我已经帮了你够多了，至少是我愿意帮的那么多。

english: Human, you interest me not.
translation: 人类，你引不起我的兴趣。

english: I'm sure you have, but you know nothing of my kind.
translation: 我确信你知道很多，但你对我的同类一无所知。

english: I thought that this would be pretty obvious.
translation: 我以为这很明显。

english: Come back to me when you befriend one of mine.
translation: 等你和我的同类交上朋友再来找我吧。

english: Flattery, my adventurer, will get you everywhere. But to answer your question, Sophanem has been struck down with plagues.
translation: 奉承话，我的冒险者，能让你无往不利。但回答你的问题，索法尼恩城遭受了瘟疫的打击。

english: How disappointing; well, nothing ventured, nothing gained. Goodbye, then.
translation: 真令人失望；好吧，不入虎穴，焉得虎子。那么，再见了。

english: Cats play a significant role in the religion of this area, particularly when it comes to guarding the dead from The Devourer.
translation: 猫在这个地区的宗教中扮演着重要角色，尤其是在守护死者免受吞噬者侵害方面。

english: Quite a number; there's a plague of frogs to the west of town and, in the east, you can find locusts.
translation: 数量不少；城镇西边有蛙灾，东边则有蝗虫。

english: When the plague first broke out, many of the resident tradespeople fled before the priests of Icthlarin decided to quarantine the city to prevent the plague being passed on to others living nearby.
translation: 瘟疫刚爆发时，许多当地商贩在伊克哈林的祭司决定隔离城市以防止瘟疫传播给附近居民之前就逃走了。

english: Some irritated god or other...or, perhaps, some peevish human; their grievances interest me little.
translation: 某个恼怒的神祇或其他……或者，也许是某个脾气暴躁的人类；他们的不满我没什么兴趣。

english: How very foolish.The Sphinx shakes her head in bemusement.
translation: 真是愚蠢至极。斯芬克斯困惑地摇了摇头。

english: The Menaphite pantheon is made up of four main deities.
translation: 梅纳菲特神系由四位主要神祇组成。

english: Your companion tells me that you are in a spot of bother.
translation: 你的同伴告诉我你遇到了点麻烦。

english: Have you taken a bang to the head recently?
translation: 你最近是不是撞到头了？

english: The livestock are diseased, the cows have only been producing sour milk since the outbreak and the remaining residents have been struck down by some rash of spots.
translation: 牲畜都染病了，奶牛自疫情爆发以来只产酸奶，剩下的居民也被某种斑点皮疹击倒了。

english: Interesting, very interesting. I'd like to help but I'm not going to get involved. Well, not just yet, anyway.
translation: 有趣，非常有趣。我很想帮忙，但我不打算介入。嗯，至少现在不会。

english: The main god which the Menaphites worship is called Tumeken. His wife, Elidinis, is the goddess of fertility and growth.
translation: 梅纳菲特人主要崇拜的主神叫图梅肯。他的妻子艾利迪尼斯是丰饶与生长女神。

english: The ghost that accosts passers by is just another part of it.
translation: 那个骚扰路人的幽灵只是其中一部分。

english: What do you mean by goings on?
translation: 你说的“那些事”是指什么？

english: I will tell you one thing, though: some important objects and locations can trigger memories, no matter how repressed they are.
translation: 不过我可以告诉你一件事：一些重要的物品或地点可以触发记忆，无论它们被压抑得多深。

english: I suppose I could spare a moment or two. Who do you want to know about?
translation: 我想我可以抽出一点时间。你想了解谁？

english: She was not always called such. She is thought of by her deeds, now, rather than her name.
translation: 她并非一直被称为那个名字。现在人们是根据她的行为来认识她，而不是她的名字。

english: Fire destroys, but is that evil?
translation: 火焰会毁灭，但那就是邪恶吗？

english: Okay, we could have an overlong theological debate now, but to get to my point, recently - well, in the last age or so - The Devourer has taken to destroying humans.
translation: 好吧，我们现在可以展开一场冗长的神学辩论，但简单来说，最近——嗯，大概上一个纪元左右——吞噬者开始毁灭人类。

english: Tumeken and Elidinis had two children: Icthlarin and The Devourer.
translation: 图梅肯和艾利迪尼斯有两个孩子：伊克哈林和吞噬者。

english: Nothing of the sort. As I've said before, I have no interest in humans. I look after my kind and, for that, Icthlarin looks after me.
translation: 完全没有这回事。我之前说过，我对人类没有兴趣。我照顾我的同类，为此，伊克哈林照顾我。

english: No, it's not really that simple. Neither are either good or bad. Icthlarin is the god of the dead, and takes care of the passing of souls from one plane to another.
translation: 不，事情没那么简单。他们既非善也非恶。伊克哈林是死神，负责将灵魂从一个位面渡到另一个位面。

english: Not just killing them, totally destroying them; body and soul. This has brought her into conflict with Icthlarin.
translation: 不仅仅是杀死他们，而是彻底毁灭他们；包括身体和灵魂。这使她与伊克哈林产生了冲突。

english: Well anticipated. The Devourer is terrified of cats for reasons I will not explain, but her followers - although few in number - are not. I ensure the survival of cats and, for this service, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
translation: 猜得不错。吞噬者害怕猫，原因我不解释，但她的追随者——虽然数量不多——却不怕。我确保猫的生存，作为回报，伊克哈林赐予我永生。

english: The Devourer is the goddess of destruction; she craves only to destroy things.
translation: 吞噬者是毁灭女神；她只渴望毁灭一切。

english: He once even was worshipped by the Mahjarrat but they turned away from him in the Third Age to follow Zamorak.
translation: 他曾经甚至被玛哈加特崇拜，但他们在第三纪元背离了他，转而追随萨莫拉克。

english: A pity; they can be of great help in some adventures. I would like to talk to your cat. Would you bring it to me?
translation: 真可惜；他们在某些冒险中能帮上大忙。我想和你的猫谈谈。你能把它带到我这里来吗？

english: What? That's no place for a cat!
translation: 什么？那可不是猫待的地方！

english: Sorry, I'm getting a bit ahead of myself. A pantheon is the collective name for the gods or deities of a group of people.
translation: 抱歉，我有点说快了。神系是指一群人崇拜的神祇的总称。

english: That's very observant of you. The river Elid is named in her honour as it brings growth and life to the area during times of flood.
translation: 你观察得很仔细。艾利德河就是以她的名字命名的，因为它在洪水时期给这片区域带来生长与生命。

english: Patience. You humans are so impatient; no wonder your life only spans a number of decades.
translation: 耐心点。你们人类太急躁了；难怪你们的生命只有几十年。

english: What do you mean by 'goings on'?
translation: 你说的“那些事”是指什么？

english: I will tell you one thing though: some important objects and locations can trigger memories, no matter how repressed they are.
translation: 不过我可以告诉你一件事：一些重要的物品或地点可以触发记忆，无论它们被压抑得多深。

english: Your cat tells me that you have yet to speak to the high priest. I wonder why I tried to help at all!
translation: 你的猫告诉我你还没跟大祭司谈过。我真纳闷我当初为什么要帮你！

english: I will say no more for now; there are players involved in this with powers far beyond mine.
translation: 我现在不再多说了；这件事涉及的角色拥有远超我的力量。

english: Try the large building to the south-west of Sophanem.
translation: 试试索法尼恩城西南边的那栋大建筑。

english: I believe that you've found one already. You would do well to find it again.
translation: 我相信你已经找到了一个。你最好再找到它。

english: Really? So explain why the shade of the high priest is ranting about you to the west of here...or how about explaining why you had a burial jar in your possession?
translation: 真的吗？那解释一下为什么大祭司的阴魂在这西边对你喋喋不休……或者解释一下为什么你身上会有一个葬瓮？

english: Simple: I can still smell the rotting organs off you.
translation: 简单：我还能闻到你身上腐烂的内脏味。

english: I think your master has proven that it is too foolish to look after you. Come with me.
translation: 我想你的主人已经证明了自己太愚蠢，不配照顾你。跟我来吧。

english: Really? I'm generally quite good at knowing these sorts of things.
translation: 真的吗？我通常很擅长判断这类事情。

english: She's the very incarnation of destruction. I would think you remember her from your previous activities.
translation: 她就是毁灭的化身。我想你应该从之前的活动中记得她。

english: Not just killing them; totally destroying them, body and soul. This has brought her into conflict with Icthlarin.
translation: 不仅仅是杀死他们；而是彻底毁灭他们，身体和灵魂。这使她与伊克哈林产生了冲突。

english: Indeed, The Devourer is terrified of cats for reasons I will not explain. Her followers - although few in number - are not, so I have to watch for them in my role as protector of cats.
translation: 确实，吞噬者害怕猫，原因我不解释。她的追随者——虽然数量不多——却不怕，所以我作为猫的保护者必须提防他们。

english: Hello again human. What was it you needed of me?
translation: 又见面了，人类。你需要我做什么？

english: Tumeken is the chief god of the area. You could say that you see him wherever you look but never notice him.
translation: 图梅肯是这个地区的主神。可以说，你无论看向哪里都能看到他，却从未注意到他。

english: Well, if you can imagine the force of the desert, it's not exactly a subtle instrument. Why use a sledgehammer to crack a nut...especially when you can be persuaded to help?
translation: 嗯，如果你能想象沙漠的力量，它可不是什么精妙的工具。何必用大锤砸核桃呢……尤其是当你能被说服来帮忙的时候？

english: It's lucky that he prefers to spend his time with Elidinis rather than smiting you.
translation: 幸运的是，他更喜欢和艾利迪尼斯待在一起，而不是惩罚你。

english: You begin to understand. The desert is indeed harsh but it protects us from outsiders. Outsiders generally mean us no good, so he protects Menaphos through this harshness.
translation: 你开始明白了。沙漠确实严酷，但它保护我们免受外来者的侵害。外来者通常对我们不怀好意，所以他通过这种严酷来保护梅纳菲斯。

english: I am unconcerned with the plight of mankind and their petty wars and beliefs.
translation: 我不关心人类的困境以及他们那些琐碎的战争和信仰。

english: Some might also phrase it that she is named after the river, or that she is the river. It's a common area of theological debate.
translation: 也有人可能会说她是因河得名，或者说她就是那条河。这是神学辩论中常见的领域。

english: You humans have a saying, 'you have to be cruel to be kind'. It seems to fit Tumeken.
translation: 你们人类有句俗话，“要仁慈就得残忍”。这似乎很适合图梅肯。

english: No, it's not really that simple. Neither are either good or bad. Icthlarin is the god of the dead and takes care of the passing of souls from one plane to another.
translation: 不，事情没那么简单。他们既非善也非恶。伊克哈林是死神，负责将灵魂从一个位面渡到另一个位面。

english: I ensure the survival of cats and, for this service, Icthlarin grants me eternal life.
translation: 我确保猫的生存，作为回报，伊克哈林赐予我永生。

english: Ahhh, you humans.
translation: 啊，你们人类啊。

english: Apmeken has the head of a monkey and is the incarnation of mental pleasures.
translation: 阿普梅肯长着猴子的头，是精神愉悦的化身。

english: Het is the lesser deity concerned with mental and physical health. Sophanem is the city of the dead so Het isn't really worshipped much here.
translation: 赫特是掌管精神与身体健康的下级神祇。索法尼恩城是死者之城，所以赫特在这里并不怎么受崇拜。

english: Or maybe it was Zaros to whom they turned; it was a long time ago and not that important. Suffice to say, Icthlarin cares for the dead rather than creating them.
translation: 或者也许他们转向的是扎罗斯；那是很久以前的事了，也没那么重要。总之，伊克哈林照顾死者，而不是创造他们。

english: Conversation, jokes, songs; that sort of thing. Good for a chat but prone to exaggeration, by all reports.
translation: 交谈、笑话、歌曲；诸如此类。适合聊天，但据所有报告说，容易夸大其词。

english: Yes, there is a shrine dedicated to Het in the Temple of the Lesser Gods in the north-east of this city. Jex there should know more about Het.
translation: 是的，在这座城市东北部的下级神祇神庙里有一座供奉赫特的神龛。那里的杰克斯应该更了解赫特。

english: That's for me to know and you to contemplate. I'm sure Jex at the Temple of the Lesser Gods can give more impartial information than I can, though.
translation: 这该我知道，你该去思考。不过，我相信下级神祇神庙的杰克斯能提供比我更客观的信息。

english: The Book of Light and Day says that Tumeken once fell into a deep sleep and dreamt for four days and four nights. The first night he slept and dreamt a good dream. He dreamt of a journey long and arduous.
translation: 《光明与白昼之书》记载，图梅肯曾陷入沉睡，连续做了四天四夜的梦。第一夜他入睡，做了一个好梦。他梦见了一段漫长而艰辛的旅程。

english: Yes, there is a shrine dedicated to Scabaras in the Temple of the Lesser Gods in the north-east of this city. Jex there might know more about the minor deities.
translation: 是的，在这座城市东北部的下级神祇神庙里有一座供奉斯卡巴拉斯的神龛。那里的杰克斯可能更了解这些下级神祇。

translation: 是的，斯卡巴拉斯的追随者曾经是伟大的地下建筑师。根据传说，他们曾计划在艾利德河下修建一条通道。毫无疑问，艾利迪尼斯惩罚了他们，因为再也没有

english: There is a place sacred to Crondis in the Temple of the Lesser Gods in the north-east of this city. Jex there should know more about this deity.
translation: 在这座城市东北部的下级神祇神庙里有一处供奉克伦迪斯的圣地。那里的杰克斯应该更了解这位神祇。

translation: 从他的潜意识中，阿普梅肯诞生为现实，是他梦境的具体化身。图梅肯又继续做了两天两夜的美梦。每做完一个梦，一个新的

english: Crondis is the lesser deity of physical pleasures. She has the head of a crocodile, which I don't see as being particularly physically pleasant.
translation: 克伦迪斯是掌管肉体愉悦的下级神祇。她长着鳄鱼的头，我觉得这算不上特别愉悦。

translation: 你的猫告诉我你对大祭司很无礼，还在谈话中途离开了。

english: Well, I suppose I do, but you have no room to carry the amulet; come back when you are less burdened.
translation: 嗯，我想我确实有，但你没有空间携带护身符；等你负担轻点再来吧。

english: Destroying the barrier of course. Head through the barrier and defeat the guardian, that should do the trick.
translation: 当然是摧毁屏障。穿过屏障，击败守护者，应该就能搞定。

english: You tell me, it's your mind we're in right now.
translation: 你告诉我，我们现在在你的脑海里。

english: Good job this is a shared dream then, it doesn't have to be you that defeats him.
translation: 幸好这是个共享梦境，不一定非得是你打败他。

english: Pass through the barrier and defeat the guardian, that should restore Bob's lost memories.
translation: 穿过屏障，击败守护者，这应该能恢复鲍勃失去的记忆。
