That's me. Not many people interested in visiting me these days. What brings you here?
translation: 是我。最近没多少人来看我。你为什么来这里？

english: I see. I'm afraid I can't help you. The key is gone.
translation: 我明白了。恐怕我帮不了你。钥匙不见了。

english: Yes gone. When my father passed the key down to me he told me that I must keep it safe no matter what. When the vampyres came to Port Phasmatys I buried it out in the swamps to stop them getting it.
translation: 是的，不见了。我父亲把钥匙传给我时，告诉我必须不惜一切代价保管好它。当吸血鬼来到法斯提斯港时，我把它埋在沼泽里，防止他们拿到。

english: You don't. The key is gone and it's safer that way. I never liked looking after that lump of metal anyway.
translation: 你不需要知道。钥匙不见了，这样更安全。反正我也不喜欢保管那块金属。

english: Yes, a strange red metal.
translation: 是的，一种奇怪的红色金属。

english: I'd like an Oak bed built.
translation: 我想定制一张橡木床。

translation: 我想定制一张橡木小桌子。

english: You again. You're not still after that key are you?
translation: 又是你。你不会还在找那把钥匙吧？

english: I can't find my husband, we got separated as we disembarked the ship.
translation: 我找不到我丈夫了，我们下船时走散了。

english: Oh that's Rosie, our resident sheepdog! She sure does like the fire.
translation: 哦，那是罗西，我们这里的牧羊犬！她确实喜欢火。

english: I'd like my small table fixed.
translation: 我想修理我的小桌子。

english: I'd like my bed fixed.

english: I'd like my shelves fixed.

english: I'd like an Mahogany bed built.

english: I'd like an Wood shelves built.
translation: 我想定制一套木材架子。

english: I'd like an Oak shelves built.
translation: 我想定制一套橡木架子。

english: What I need is simple: a couple of undead chickens. You should be able to pick some up at the farm near Port Phasmatys.
translation: 我要的东西很简单：几只亡灵鸡。你应该能在法斯提斯港附近的农场抓到一些。

english: Well, in that case, I think it may have something to do with Slayer abilities. After all, I did see Turael poking around the trees while I was moving in.
translation: 嗯，那样的话，我觉得可能和杀戮技能有关。毕竟我搬进来的时候，确实看到图拉尔在树丛里转悠。

english: I'll use one for my bed, then see what I can make from the other in the way of a reward. I have some ideas involving infinite feathers.
translation: 我会用一只来做我的床，然后看看能用另一只做点什么当奖励。我有几个关于无限羽毛的想法。

english: Of course, you won't be able to pick your nose any more, so I suppose you'll want to try the second option.
translation: 当然，以后你就不能再挖鼻孔了，所以我猜你会想试试第二个选项。

english: As he's not known for his random touristic activities, you should try chatting with this Turael. He's the Slayer Master near Burthorpe.
translation: 他平时不像是会到处旅游的人，你应该去和那个图拉尔聊聊。他是伯索普附近的杀戮大师。

english: The orb will pull you in the direction of the key. Be careful with it though, it's a little unstable.
translation: 这颗宝珠会把你拉向钥匙的方向。不过小心点，它有点不稳定。

english: Here you go. You can use this to track down that key of yours.
translation: 给你。你可以用这个来追踪你要找的钥匙。

english: Should be doable. Will need to be quite different to your device though, much greater distance and a different type of metal. You said it was red right?
translation: 应该能做到。不过需要和你的装置有很大不同，距离要远得多，而且要用不同的金属。你说过它是红色的，对吧？

english: Must be Orikalkum, Dragon as you adventuring lot call it. Quite rare, should make things easier. Now let me think about this, if we just... hmmm... yes... perfect!
translation: 那一定是奥里哈库姆，你们这些冒险者称之为龙金属。很稀有，应该能让事情更简单。现在让我想想，如果我们……嗯……对……完美！

english: Nothing to get worried about, it might just sting a bit when you use it.
translation: 没什么好担心的，你用它的时候可能只会有一点刺痛。

english: Hmmm. Might be possible. The chicken is the weakness at the moment. If you find something with a bit more kick I might be able to upgrade it further.
translation: 嗯……也许可以。目前鸡是弱点。如果你能找到更有劲的东西，我或许能进一步升级它。

english: Yes. Something a bit stronger, a bit more undead.
translation: 是的。要更强一点，更亡灵一点的东西。

english: Great, hand it over then.
translation: 太好了，那就交过来吧。

english: death in that brave ranger way.
translation: 以那种勇敢射手的方式死去。

english: Go and talk to the Witch next door. She'd talk the hind legs off a donkey but she can select the iron with which it is suitable for the chicken to interact.
translation: 去和隔壁的女巫谈谈。她能跟驴子说上三天三夜，但她能选出适合让鸡互动的那种铁。

english: Your short-term memory loss worries me. Combine the pattern with hard leather and some polished buttons, then hand the resulting container to me.
translation: 你的短期记忆让我担心。把图案和硬皮革以及一些已抛光的纽扣结合起来，然后把做好的容器交给我。

english: Hello again. Are you after an upgrade to your device, or a new device, or some information, or would you like to see my goods for sale?
translation: 又见面了。你是想升级你的装置，还是想要一个新装置，还是想要一些信息，或者想看看我卖的东西？

english: I can see now why Fenkenstrain prefers to work with dead folk. It can't be more frustrating than working with you.
translation: 我现在明白为什么芬肯斯特雷恩更喜欢和死人打交道了。和死人打交道总不会比跟你合作更让人恼火。

english: I'd like to talk before you hand it over.
translation: 我想在交给你之前先谈谈。

english: I'm not a nice girl, I'm a respectable scientist researching the interactions between ghosts and the forces of pure science.
translation: 我不是什么好女孩，我是一位研究幽灵与纯粹科学力量之间相互作用的可敬科学家。

english: I took over the position of assistant to the Professor upstairs, although, to be honest, his methods are somewhat eccentric. Did you hear about that Ernest scandal?
translation: 我接手了楼上教授的助理职位，不过说实话，他的方法有点古怪。你听说过那个欧内斯特丑闻吗？

english: I know you have the notes; I gave them to you, in case you forgot! Furthermore, if I had hints, I'd have translated those notes myself.
translation: 我知道你有笔记；是我给你的，以防你忘了！而且，如果我有提示，我早就自己翻译那些笔记了。

english: The magnetic attraction required for operation would cause feedback, so the device does not allow such incompatible item equippage.
translation: 运作所需的磁力吸引会产生反馈，所以装置不允许装备这种不兼容的物品。

english: I believe you'll have to talk to the priest who was in peril before you can enter Morytania.
translation: 我相信你得先和那位曾身处危难的祭司谈谈，才能进入莫利塔尼亚。

english: I'm sorry, you need to have more skill in Ranged before I can use your help.
translation: 抱歉，你的远程技能还不够高，我才能借助你的帮助。

english: I'm sorry, you need to have more skill in Slayer before I can use your help.
translation: 抱歉，你的杀戮技能还不够高，我才能借助你的帮助。

english: I'm sorry, you need to have completed the Priest in Peril quest for me to be able to use your help.
translation: 抱歉，你需要先完成“危难中的祭司”任务，我才能借助你的帮助。

english: What is this? Whatever it is, I have no use for it.
translation: 这是什么？不管是什么，我都用不上。

english: Why do you think I want these?
translation: 你为什么觉得我想要这些？

english: How is the quest going? I could really do with a good night's sleep, you know.
translation: 任务怎么样了？我真的需要好好睡一觉，你知道吗。

english: Thirdly, there is an even more upgraded version available when your Ranged level is 70 or greater, but I need the head of a powerful beast to create it for you.
translation: 第三，当你的远程等级达到70或以上时，还可以获得一个更高级的升级版本，但我需要一只强大野兽的头颅来为你制作它。

english: I'm sorry, you need to have more skill in Crafting before I can use your help.
translation: 抱歉，你的制作技能还不够高，我才能借助你的帮助。

english: A typical adventurer. Your honesty is refreshing but the cause of science can't be delayed by your inane chatting about lobsters in Catherby. Hop to it!
translation: 典型的冒险者。你的坦诚令人耳目一新，但科学事业不能因为你无聊地谈论凯瑟比镇的龙虾而耽搁。快行动起来！

english: I'm sorry, you need to have completed the Restless Ghost quest for me to be able to use your help.
translation: 抱歉，你需要先完成“不安的幽灵”任务，我才能借助你的帮助。

english: You lost it didn't you?
translation: 你把它弄丢了，是吧？

english: Well luckily for you I made a spare. Please try to look after this one.
translation: 还好我多做了一个备用的。请好好保管这个。

english: On second thought, the way you wave it about makes me fear for my life. Stow it in your bag and talk to me again.
translation: 转念一想，你拿着它乱挥的样子让我担心自己的小命。把它收进包里再跟我说话吧。

english: I'm sorry, you need to have more skill in Woodcutting before I can use your help.
translation: 抱歉，你的伐木技能还不够高，我还不能借助你的帮助。

english: I gave you those and have plenty of copies; I need them to be translated.
translation: 那些笔记是我给你的，而且我还有很多副本；我需要它们被翻译出来。

english: An entirely logical answer; you'll make a scientist yet.
translation: 完全符合逻辑的回答；你迟早能成为一位科学家。

english: What makes you think I want more twigs?
translation: 是什么让你觉得我想要更多的小树枝？

english: Thirdly, there is an upgraded version available when your Ranged level is 50 or greater, so visit me when you have had more practice.
translation: 第三，当你的远程等级达到50或以上时，可以获得升级版本，所以等你练习得更多了再来找我吧。

english: A pity; you'd look quite cute with rabbit ears. Perhaps I should have bribed him.
translation: 真可惜；你戴上兔子耳朵一定很可爱。也许我该贿赂他才对。

english: No, you'd only drop them. Clear some space first, then we can talk.
translation: 不，你会把它们弄掉的。先清出点空间，我们再谈。

english: Oh. So what are you doing here?
translation: 哦。那你来这里做什么？

english: You are an odd one. I'll be here if you remember what you wanted.
translation: 你真是个怪人。如果你想起你想要什么了，我就在这儿。

english: I'd hazard a guess at no.
translation: 我猜大概没有吧。

english: Firstly, it is not undead; it is very, very dead. Secondly, it smells atrocious and, thirdly, it has been plucked. Get me a feathery one that can still move.
translation: 第一，它不是亡灵；它是非常非常死的。第二，它臭得要命，第三，它被拔过毛了。给我找一只还有羽毛、还能动的。

english: We are trying to generate feathers here. Is this a magic feather that has little feather children?
translation: 我们正在设法生成羽毛。这是一根有羽毛小崽子的魔法羽毛吗？

english: You're pretty careless, aren't you. I assume you're the type who leaves a trail of arrows and knives behind them when they train?
translation: 你真是相当粗心大意，对吧。我猜你是那种训练时会在身后留下一串箭和飞刀的类型？

english: They seem about as common around here as intelligent adventurers. Get me an undead chicken.
translation: 它们在这附近好像跟聪明的冒险者一样稀有。给我弄只亡灵鸡来。

english: Well luckily for you I made a spare. If you make some room in your inventory I can give it to you.
translation: 还好我多做了一个备用的。如果你在背包里腾出点空间，我就能把它给你。

english: Let me guess, you've managed to mislay the notes after you translated them?
translation: 让我猜猜，你翻译完笔记后又把它们弄丢了？

english: Luckily, I assumed you were terminally careless, so I can supply these copies.
translation: 幸好，我早就猜到你是个无可救药的粗心鬼，所以我可以提供这些副本。

english: What would I want these for now; I already have two?
translation: 我现在要这些干嘛？我已经有两只了。

english: What in Gielinor are you wearing?
translation: 你穿的是什么玩意儿？

english: You're not impressing anyone walking around like that. Why don't you go...cross a road or something.
translation: 你穿成这样到处走可吸引不了任何人。你为什么不去……过个马路什么的。

english: These chickens think that everything even slightly curved is a worm in rigor mortis, so they swallow it. I might even be able to write an article on the phenomenon.
translation: 这些鸡认为任何稍微弯曲的东西都是一条处于尸僵状态的蠕虫，所以它们会吞下去。我甚至可能就这一现象写篇文章。

english: I'm afraid it isn't the sort of thing that a chicken would use, even one highly trained by an eminent scientist.
translation: 恐怕这不是一只鸡会用的东西，即使是由一位杰出科学家训练过也没用。

english: If you hadn't mislaid the originals, you'd not be asking me these questions. You have no one to blame but yourself.
translation: 要不是你把原件弄丢了，你也不会来问我这些问题。要怪只能怪你自己。

english: Hardly. I've seen the rants of rangers whose arrows have been picked up by passing scroungers. Now that is what I'd call melodramatic.
translation: 不至于。我见过那些射手因为箭被路过的捡破烂的人捡走而大发雷霆。那才叫夸张呢。

english: You'll need more space for the notes. If they went into your pack now, it might cause a rift in the time-space continuum.
translation: 你需要更多空间来放笔记。如果现在把它们放进你的背包，可能会引起时空连续体的裂隙。

english: Welcome to the Grand Library Historical Arhive.
translation: 欢迎来到大图书馆历史档案馆。

english: This is the Historical Archive of Great Kourend. Here you'll find historical documents and texts from all eras of Great Kourend's history, dating all the way back to the first decade.
translation: 这是大库兰德历史档案馆。在这里你可以找到库兰德王国历史上各个时期的文献和文件，最早可追溯到第一个十年纪。

english: We store the most important texts here for further study and additional protection.
translation: 我们把最重要的文本存放在这里，以便进一步研究和提供额外保护。

english: That is an ancient relic recovered from the Chambers of Xeric. It's a powerful artefact, and we're still studying its powers.
translation: 那是从泽里克圣所回收的一件古代遗物。它是一件强大的神器，我们仍在研究它的力量。

english: My name is Istoria. I'm the chief historian and curator of the histrical archive.
translation: 我的名字是伊斯托里亚。我是历史档案馆的首席历史学家和馆长。

english: Ah, Xeric, our most infamous ruler... We do have extensive records regarding Xeric; you can examine some of the texts here or speak to Ektheme, our Xerician expert.
translation: 啊，泽里克，我们最臭名昭著的统治者……我们确实有关于泽里克的详尽记录；你可以在这里查阅一些文本，或者和我们的泽里克专家埃克特梅谈谈。

english: Wintertodt, or the Winter beast as it was known at the time, terrorised northern Kourend for five decades. Logios is currently studying the Wintertodt Invasion, and we have various texts from that era.
translation: 冬将军，或者当时被称为的冬之野兽，肆虐了库兰德王国北部长达五个十年。洛吉奥斯目前正在研究冬将军入侵事件，我们也有那个时代的各种文本。

english: Our first records of the Mountain date back to the mid-thirty-sixth decade where a Shayzien patrol discovered the mountain during a survey of the western lands. King Shayzien VII was keen on
translation: 我们关于这座山的最早记录可以追溯到第三十六个十年的中期，当时一支谢兹恩城的巡逻队在勘察西部土地时发现了这座山。国王谢兹恩七世热衷于

english: conquering more land for Kourend and demanded his people explore suitable territories.
translation: 为库兰德王国征服更多土地，并要求他的人民探索合适的领土。

english: Gnosi is our expert on Mount Quidamortem but I'm afraid she's currently on an expedition to the Temple near the summit of the mountain. However we do have some texts available detailing the great expedition.
translation: 格诺西是我们研究奎达莫坦山的专家，但恐怕她目前正在远征前往山顶附近的神庙。不过，我们确实有一些详细描述那次大远征的文本可供查阅。

english: The mountain became known as Mount Quidamortem some decades later, after it was realised venturing towards the summit resulted in certain death.
translation: 那座山在几十年后被称为奎达莫坦山，因为人们意识到前往山顶必定会导致死亡。

english: It would seem that way. However, if you do want to learn more about King Shayzien VII, it might be worth talking to Pagida. He's recently been investigating the kings' additions to the Tower of Magic.
translation: 看起来是这样。不过，如果你真想了解更多关于国王谢兹恩七世的事，或许值得跟帕吉达谈谈。他最近一直在调查历代国王对魔法塔的增建。

english: Hello, my name is Imerominia and I'm the library Horologist.
translation: 你好，我叫伊梅罗米尼亚，是图书馆的钟表学家。

english: Jonathan is the Hosidius historian. He lives west of the Hosidius General Store. Amelia is the Shayzien historian. She lives south west of the Shayzien Bank.
translation: 乔纳森是霍西迪乌斯城的历史学家。他住在霍西迪乌斯城杂货店的西边。阿米莉亚是谢兹恩城的历史学家。她住在谢兹恩城银行的西南边。

english: Horology is the study and measurement of time, specifically I study how time and dates have been historically recorded.
translation: 钟表学是研究和测量时间的学问，我专门研究历史上时间和日期是如何被记录的。

english: I'm afraid I lose track of which day it is... but we are in the one hundred and forty-first decade.
translation: 恐怕我自己也搞不清今天是哪一天了……不过我们现在是在第一百四十一个十年。

english: The Royal Accord of Twill was signed by the rulers of each of the houses one hundred and thirty-nine decades ago, following the great famine.
translation: 特威尔皇家协议是在大饥荒之后，由各大家族的统治者在一百三十九个十年之前签署的。

english: That is correct; you seem to have understood our time and date format well.
translation: 没错；看来你已经很好地理解了我们的时间和日期格式。

english: You may find a book in the main Grand Library with further information. Is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 你可以在大图书馆里找到一本有更多详细信息的书。还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Our Kingdom has advanced somewhat over the many decades since the Accord. Though some parts of the Accord remain intact, the Kourend Council now rules Great Kourend.
translation: 自协议签订以来的几十年里，我们的王国已经有所发展。尽管协议的部分内容仍然完好，但库兰德议会现在统治着大库兰德王国。

english: During the twentieth decade, King Shayzien VI married the daughter of Lord Hosidius. Three decades later their son was crowned king.
translation: 在第二十个十年期间，国王谢兹恩六世迎娶了霍西迪乌斯领主的女儿。三十年后，他们的儿子加冕为王。

english: Indeed it was; in the thirteenth decade, King Shayzien III seized control of Kourend using the military under his command.
translation: 确实如此；在第十三个十年，国王谢兹恩三世利用他指挥的军队夺取了库兰德王国的控制权。

english: The full set of laws within the Accord haven't been followed since. However, some of them were reinstated in the fourty-seventh decade, by King Byrne I.
translation: 自那以后，协议中的全部法律就没有再被完全遵守过。不过，其中一些法律在第四十七个十年由伯恩一世国王重新恢复了。

english: King Hosidius IV followed by his son, King Hosidius V ruled Kourend until the early days of the thirty-second decade.
translation: 国王霍西迪乌斯四世及其子国王霍西迪乌斯五世统治库兰德王国，直至第三十二个十年的初期。

english: Xeric ruled Kourend for more than ten, dark decades using an army of lizardmen. This time period was known as the Age of Strife.
translation: 泽里克利用一支蜥蜴人军队统治了库兰德王国超过十个黑暗的十年。这段时期被称为纷争时代。

english: During the 20th decade, King Shayzien VI married the daughter of Lord Hosidius. Three decades later their son was crowned king.
translation: 在第二十个十年期间，国王谢兹恩六世迎娶了霍西迪乌斯领主的女儿。三十年后，他们的儿子加冕为王。

english: Xeric was eventually killed during the fourty-seventh decade and succeeded by King Byrne I.
translation: 泽里克最终在第四十七个十年被杀，由伯恩一世国王继位。

english: King Hosidius IV followed by his son, King Hosidius V ruled Kourend until the early days of the 32nd decade.
translation: 国王霍西迪乌斯四世及其子国王霍西迪乌斯五世统治库兰德王国，直至第三十二个十年的初期。

english: Ah, I do not have much more information, but you should speak to Ektheme - he's our Xerician expert.
translation: 啊，我没有更多信息了，但你应该去和埃克特梅谈谈——他是我们研究泽里克的专家。

english: Very little is known about those ancient times, but we refer to such times as decades 'Before Accord', or 'BA' for short.
translation: 关于那些远古时代，我们所知甚少，但我们把那样的时代称为'协议前'的十年，或者简称为'BA'。

english: A hero? Well she wouldn't have had much to do with Hosidius. The early Hosidius settlers were all pacificts, they'd have stayed away from people like her.
translation: 一位英雄？嗯，她跟霍西迪乌斯城应该没什么关系。早期的霍西迪乌斯城定居者都是和平主义者，他们会远离像她这样的人。

english: No but that's not surprising. Much of our history was lost during Xeric's reign. There is somewhere you might find answers though.
translation: 没有，但这并不奇怪。我们的大部分历史都在塞里克统治期间遗失了。不过，有个地方你或许能找到答案。

english: They're zombies, not ghosts. You'll find the entrance to the crypts in the Graveyard of Heroes, west of here. Be careful.
translation: 它们是僵尸，不是幽灵。你会在英雄墓地找到地穴的入口，就在西边。小心点。

english: The most likely place to find answers is the Shayzien Crypts. You'll find the entrance in the Graveyard of Heroes, west of here. Be careful, it's filled with zombies.
translation: 最有可能找到答案的地方是谢兹恩城地穴。你会在英雄墓地找到入口，就在西边。小心点，里面到处都是僵尸。

english: Our new weapon, one that will bring a swift end to humanity. I'd love to be able to show you, but I'm afraid I have more pressing matters.
translation: 我们的新武器，将迅速终结人类。我很想展示给你看，但恐怕我有更紧急的事要处理。

english: You'd like that wouldn't you. Alas, I'm afraid that I won't be the one that dies today.
translation: 你倒是想。可惜啊，恐怕今天死的不会是我。

english: Yes we will. For now it begins.
translation: 是的，我们会。现在，开始了。

english: There's a strange symbol on the map in two places. One marks this building, the other marks an island. I bet that's Lithkren.
translation: 地图上有两个地方画着奇怪的符号。一个标记了这栋建筑，另一个标记了一座岛。我敢打赌那就是利斯克伦。

english: We'll need a boat. Find a dwarf called Jardric, he should be somewhere on the island. He's an old friend who owes me a favour. He should be able to get a boat for us.
translation: 我们需要一艘船。找个叫贾德里克的矮人，他应该在这岛上的某个地方。他是我的老朋友，还欠我一个人情。他应该能帮我们弄到船。

english: Have a look at this grid on the floor. I think it might actually be a map. If you look at that tile in the middle it looks like part of this island.
translation: 看看地板上这个格子。我觉得它可能是一张地图。你看中间那块瓷砖，看起来像是这座岛的一部分。

english: We can't. I already tried but the doors are sealed. There's a circular indentation in the middle, maybe it's a keyhole.
translation: 我们打不开。我已经试过了，但门都封死了。中间有个圆形凹痕，也许是个钥匙孔。

english: By my calculations, there's 24 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 根据我的计算，还有24块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well I'm definitely not convinced but let's say you're telling the truth. How can a cat help us?
translation: 嗯，我肯定不信，但就假设你说的是真的吧。一只猫能帮我们什么？

english: It looks like it is, good job.
translation: 看起来是的，干得好。

english: Elvarg is very unusual as she is one of the few dragons to live alone, most of her kind live in large groups.
translation: 艾尔瓦格很不寻常，她是少数独居的龙之一，她的同类大多成群生活。

english: This is where Elvarg made her home, there must be something here to point us in the right direction. Have a look around and see what you can find.
translation: 这就是艾尔瓦格的家，这里一定有什么东西能给我们指明方向。四处看看，找找你能发现什么。

english: Good luck. Once you have all of the pieces bring them here and we'll see about putting this map together.
translation: 祝你好运。等你集齐所有碎片，就把它们带到这里来，我们看看怎么拼好这张地图。

english: So while I was waiting for you I had a look through these books again. One of them mentions an island called Lithkren not far from here. There's lots of islands around here though and it doesn't say which one it is.
translation: 我等你的时候又翻了翻这些书。其中一本提到附近有个叫利斯克伦的岛。不过这一带岛屿很多，没说具体是哪个。

english: There are ancient tales that tell of the origin of the dragons. They say they were created by a powerful race of creatures known as dragonkin.
translation: 有古老的传说讲述了龙的起源。据说它们是由一个强大的种族——龙人——创造出来的。

english: Yes you likely will have. We know for a fact that the dragonkin existed, they terrorised the world for many years during the early Fourth Age.
translation: 是的，你很可能听说过。我们确知龙人存在过，他们在第四纪早期肆虐世界多年。

english: We're to head to Elvarg's Lair beneath Crandor. There we will begin a research project on Elvarg and her attack on the island.
translation: 我们要前往克兰多尔下方的艾尔瓦格巢穴。在那里我们将展开一项关于艾尔瓦格及其对该岛攻击的研究项目。

english: I guess we'll never know though. Robert the Strong is gone, we've reached a dead end.
translation: 不过我想我们永远也不会知道了。强者罗伯特已经不在了，我们走进了死胡同。

english: Hello there dragonkin.
translation: 你好啊，龙人。

english: There's an old settlement on the island, similar architecture to this place. It contains lots of books, many written in a strange language. One of the books mentioned a place called Lithkren.
translation: 岛上有个古老的定居点，建筑风格和这里类似。里面有很多书，很多是用一种奇怪的语言写的。其中一本书提到了一个叫利斯克伦的地方。

english: However, although there are many stories, their connection to dragons has never been proven.
translation: 不过，虽然传说很多，但它们与龙的联系从未被证实。

english: Meet me in Elvarg's Lair beneath Crandor when you are ready to begin.
translation: 准备好之后，到克兰多尔下方的艾尔瓦格巢穴来找我。

english: I'm Dallas Jones and I came here for answers.
translation: 我是达拉斯.琼斯，我来这里是为了寻找答案。

english: We'll need a boat to get to Lithkren. Jardric should be able to help us. See if you can find him, he should be somewhere on the island.
translation: 我们需要一艘船去利斯克伦。贾德里克应该能帮上忙。看看你能不能找到他，他应该在这岛上的某个地方。

english: Bob's taught me so much since I got this amulet. It's very useful. How are things going with you?
translation: 自从我得到这个护身符，鲍勃教会了我很多东西。非常有用。你那边怎么样了？

english: For the next thirty years, Elvarg remained on the island until she was finally defeated, by you.
translation: 在接下来的三十年里，艾尔瓦格一直留在岛上，直到最终被你击败。

english: Well keep looking. We have 1 piece left to find. I suspect it will either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩1块碎片没找到。我猜它要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well no point waiting around, let's get these doors open.
translation: 嗯，干等着也没用，咱们把这些门打开吧。

english: You finished the map! Good work.
translation: 你拼好地图了！干得好。

english: Not yet. We have 1 piece left to find. I suspect it will either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 还没呢。我们还剩1块碎片没找到。我猜它要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: It looks like we've found everything here, we should move on to Fossil Island. I'll meet you at the old settlement on the north side of the island.
translation: 看来我们在这里找到所有东西了，应该继续前往化石岛。我会在岛北边的古老定居点和你碰头。

english: Well keep looking. We have 24 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩24块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Check the pile behind the ladder, you should find it there.
translation: 检查一下梯子后面的那堆东西，你应该能在那里找到它。

english: I'll be leaving for Crandor shortly, I'll meet you in Elvarg's Lair.
translation: 我马上就去克兰多尔，我们在艾尔瓦格巢穴碰头。

english: Not much to tell really. My name is Dallas Jones and I'm a researcher for the Varrock Museum. Many of the researchers have an area of expertise, mine is dragons.
translation: 其实也没什么好说的。我叫达拉斯.琼斯，是维洛克城博物馆的研究员。很多研究员都有自己的专长领域，我的专长是龙。

english: My father used to live on Crandor, before it was destroyed. He was one of the many who were killed by Elvarg.
translation: 我父亲以前住在克兰多尔，在它被毁之前。他是被艾尔瓦格杀死的众多人之一。

english: Hello again. I see you found Jardric.
translation: 又见面了。看来你找到贾德里克了。

english: I can see that. We could well be on to something here. You go through the tunnel and see if it's safe, I'll be right behind you.
translation: 我看到了。我们可能真的发现了什么。你先进隧道看看是否安全，我马上跟上。

english: I have it right here. Now we just need the boat. Jardric should know exactly what's needed.
translation: 我这儿就有。现在只需要船了。贾德里克应该知道具体需要什么。

english: Have a look around and see if you can find anything unusual. There must be something her to tell us more about Elvarg.
translation: 四处看看，找找有没有什么不寻常的东西。这里一定有什么能告诉我们更多关于艾尔瓦格的信息。

english: Well don't take too long. We've had to wait years for these answers. I don't want to wait much longer.
translation: 嗯，别拖太久。我们等这些答案已经等了好几年了。我不想再等更久了。

english: What is that creature? Kill it!
translation: 那是什么生物？杀了它！

english: Well talk to Jardric if you need some help, he'll know what to do.
translation: 嗯，如果需要帮助就去找贾德里克，他知道该怎么做。

english: Well keep looking. We have 19 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩19块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Good work. I'm afraid you'll need to be the one to do the mining, my back isn't what it once was.
translation: 干得好。恐怕得由你来负责采矿了，我的腰背不如从前了。

english: Well keep looking. We have 5 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩5块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 3 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩3块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 16 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩16块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: So while you were gone I managed to get myself one of those amulets. Bob here has been telling me some facinating things about the dragonkin.
translation: 你不在的时候，我设法给自己弄了一个那种护身符。鲍勃一直在告诉我一些关于龙人的迷人事情。

english: Well keep looking. We have 2 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩2块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 7 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩7块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 4 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩4块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 12 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩12块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Hello again. This cat popped up while you were gone.
translation: 又见面了。你不在的时候，这只猫突然冒出来了。

english: Hmmm. Maybe I'll seek out one of these amulets. In the meantime, you should keep working on this door.
translation: 嗯。也许我该去找一个这种护身符。与此同时，你应该继续研究这扇门。

english: So this cat is actually Robert the Strong? This is most fascinating.
translation: 所以这只猫其实就是强者罗伯特？这真是太迷人了。

english: Hello. How are things going?
translation: 你好。事情进展得怎么样了？

english: Shame I can't understand what it's saying though.
translation: 可惜我听不懂它在说什么。

english: Well they're no good in there. Go get them and bring them here.
translation: 嗯，它们放在那里没用。去把它们拿来，带到这里。

english: Keep it up. We need to get through these doors.
translation: 继续加油。我们得穿过这些门。

english: Well keep looking. We have 9 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩9块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 8 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩8块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 6 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩6块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 10 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩10块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 15 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩15块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 11 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩11块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 22 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩22块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 21 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩21块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Well keep looking. We have 17 pieces left to find. I suspect they'll either be in this building or very close by.
translation: 继续找吧。我们还剩17块碎片没找到。我猜它们要么在这栋建筑里，要么就在附近。

english: Please only talk to the king if it's important. He has a heavy burden to bear with the running of his kingdom.
translation: 除非有要事，否则请只与国王交谈。他肩负着治理王国的重任，压力很大。

english: The king of Misthalin, like any great leader, always requires the best advice and the best advisors.
translation: 米斯林国王，和任何伟大的领袖一样，总是需要最好的建议和最优秀的顾问。

english: He very often summons occasional advisors to help him in certain situations, but it was felt by the Church of Saradomin that a full time advisor on religious matters was needed.
translation: 他经常会在某些情况下召见临时顾问来协助他，但萨拉多明教会认为，需要一位全职的宗教事务顾问。

english: Apologies! Allow me to introduce myself. My name is Aeonisig Raispher, special advisor to King Roald on spiritual matters.
translation: 抱歉！请允许我自我介绍。我叫埃奥尼西格.莱斯弗，是罗尔德国王在精神事务上的特别顾问。

english: It means that some decisions the king has to make might have unforeseen repercussions on the nation's spiritual sensibilities.
translation: 这意味着国王必须做出的某些决定，可能会对国家民众的精神感受产生无法预见的后果。

english: My duty is to ensure that Saradominist ideals are not stomped underfoot.
translation: 我的职责是确保萨拉多明的理想不被践踏。

english: I took my religious and combat training in several parts of the known world. I've also fought despicable beasts in the Wilderness in Saradomin's name.
translation: 我在已知世界的多个地方接受过宗教和战斗训练。我还曾以萨拉多明之名在荒野中与可憎的野兽战斗。

english: Needless to say I have great experience in the ways of the world and am an invaluable aid to his lordship's decision-making process.
translation: 不用说，我对世间之道经验丰富，是协助陛下决策过程中不可或缺的助力。

english: Being knocked out by agents unknown does not constitute evidence. In fact it's something that the most inexperienced of local folk could accomplish!
translation: 被不明身份的人打晕并不能算作证据。事实上，就连最没经验的本地人都能做到这一点！

english: As are many, my young friend.  Is the King meant to leave Misthalin unguarded on the whim of some errant adventurer?
translation: 很多人都这样，我年轻的朋友。难道国王要因为某个任性的冒险者一时兴起，就让米斯林无人防守吗？

english: Hold your disrespectful tongue! How dare you address the King in that way? We should throw you in the stocks!
translation: 管好你那张不敬的嘴！你怎敢那样对国王说话？我们应该把你关进枷锁示众！

english: Is it nothing then to have an audience with the King? Your lack of respect astonishes me. How you have survived so long with such disgraceful manners is nothing short of a miracle!
translation: 难道觐见国王是件微不足道的事吗？你的无礼让我震惊。以你这样失礼的举止竟然能活到现在，简直是个奇迹！

english: The Guthixian edicts govern spiritual balance, sire - perhaps these need closer study. In addition, we need to consider a reduction in the Guthixian influence we are forced to endure in our religious affairs.
translation: 陛下，古斯的教令掌管着精神平衡——也许我们需要更仔细地研究这些教令。此外，我们还需要考虑减少我们在宗教事务中被迫忍受的古斯影响。

english: As you say, sire, it will take some time. We now pay the price for our lack of foresight in letting Guthixian edicts restrict the might of Saradomin's will.
translation: 正如您所说，陛下，这需要一些时间。我们现在正在为当初缺乏远见，任由古斯教令限制萨拉多明意志的力量而付出代价。

english: I am afraid with the Guthixian edicts regarding religious balance, there is little else we can do. Of course, there are measures we can start to take which might have an influence on that...
translation: 恐怕由于古斯关于宗教平衡的教令，我们能做的很有限。当然，我们可以开始采取一些措施，或许能对此产生影响……

english: I shall present you with some steel fighting claws. In addition I shall show you the knowledge of creating the fighting claws for yourself.
translation: 我将赠予你一些钢制战斗爪。此外，我还会传授你自行制作战斗爪的知识。

english: You are now an honorary member of the Imperial Guard!
translation: 你现在是帝国守卫的名誉成员了！

english: With all due respect, how can we be sure that this is the work of a dragonkin? I trust [player name] as much as anyone but what if there was a mistake?
translation: 恕我直言，我们怎么能确定这是龙人干的？我和大家一样信任[player name]，但万一搞错了呢？

english: Then hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: 那就快去吧，朋友！你还在这儿干什么？

english: He's right, this is the only option.
translation: 他说得对，这是唯一的选择。

english: Hurry, friend! What are you still doing here?
translation: 快点，朋友！你还在这儿干什么？

english: Hurry, friend! Find a way to free Godric!
translation: 快点，朋友！想办法救出戈德里克！

english: Before this meeting I thought I'd have a good old rummage around in our archives. I'm afraid the old bean is right. War is inevitable.
translation: 在这次会议之前，我好好翻了一遍我们的档案。恐怕那老家伙说得对。战争不可避免。

english: That I can. You should know though, Ungael is a dangerous place. It is guarded by a deadly force, one that spits fire at its enemies.
translation: 这个我能。不过你应该知道，昂盖尔是个危险的地方。它由一股致命的势力守卫，会对敌人喷火。

english: I have some of your things, you should take them before we head to the fleet.
translation: 我这里有你的一些东西，在我们去舰队之前你应该拿走。

english: Watch yourself outerlander.
translation: 自己小心点，外地人。

english: Of course, I'll be delighted to take extra Vorkath Heads from you in exchange for drop table rolls. Simply use the head on me and I'll reward you.
translation: 当然，我很乐意从你那里收取额外的沃卡斯头颅，以换取掉落表掷骰次数。只需将头颅用在我身上，我就会奖励你。

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you [player name] Drapare. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕我没有任何你的东西，[player name] 德拉帕尔。如果我确实有你的一些物品，但你在领取前死了，那么它们现在丢失了。

english: I do have some of your items here. Try not to lose them next time.
translation: 我这里确实有你的一些物品。下次别再弄丢了。

english: [player name] Riltor Drapare, are you ready to go to Ungael?
translation: [player name] 里尔托.德拉帕尔，你准备好去昂盖尔了吗？

english: Good day to you [player name] Drapare. Do you want to go to Ungael?
translation: 你好，[player name] 德拉帕尔。你想去昂盖尔吗？

english: Hahaha! Well fought outerlander! Now come down from there, you have passed my trial with flying colours!
translation: 哈哈哈！打得好，外地人！现在下来吧，你出色地通过了我的考验！

english: I did not say you had to, outerlander! All I asked was that you fought to the death! And you did! The death was your own!
translation: 我没说你必须做到，外地人！我只要求你战斗至死！你做到了！死的是你自己！

english: I was not interested in how strong you are! I was interested in how BRAVE you are! You fought a superior enemy to your very last breath - THAT is bravery.
translation: 我不在乎你有多强！我在乎的是你有多勇敢！你与强敌战斗到最后一息——那才是勇敢。

english: To our amazement he was perfectly healthy, even though he must have been in those deadly icey waters for many weeks.
translation: 令我们惊讶的是，他非常健康，尽管他肯定在那致命的冰冷海水中待了好几个星期。

english: The daylight makes him feel weak, so we have built him his own battleground beneath this building, where he can train his fiercesome skills without being disturbed.
translation: 白天让他感到虚弱，所以我们在这栋建筑底下为他建造了自己的战场，他可以在那里不受干扰地训练他凶猛的技能。

english: Outerlander... do not test my patience. I do not take kindly to people wandering in here and acting as though they own the place.
translation: 外地人……不要考验我的耐心。我不喜欢有人在这里闲逛，表现得好像他们拥有这个地方一样。

english: You will need to persuade one of the revellers in the Long Hall to give up their token, and their place, in deference to my own worthiness somehow.
translation: 你需要说服长厅里的一位狂欢者放弃他们的代币和位置，以某种方式尊崇我自身的价值。

english: They went on ahead, you should catch up. I'll cover the rear.
translation: 他们先走了，你应该跟上去。我来殿后。

english: We shall see...
translation: 我们走着瞧……

english: Galvek!
translation: 加尔维克！

english: Enough of this! You've had your fun!
translation: 够了！你已经玩够了吧！

english: Your precious hero is gone! Your friends have abandoned you!
translation: 你珍贵的英雄已经走了！你的朋友们抛弃了你！

english: But that fun is at an end!
translation: 但乐趣到此为止！

english: You will now face the full might of my power!
translation: 你现在将面对我全部的力量！

english: Yes, come on Dragon Slayer. Let's see what you've got.
translation: 是的，来吧，屠龙者。让我们看看你有什么本事。

english: Ah, I see you brought your friend with you. I'm surprised to see you here after all this time. Curious.
translation: 啊，我看到你带了你的朋友来。过了这么久还在这里见到你，我很惊讶。真奇怪。

english: You gave her a name? I never bothered, she was nothing.
translation: 你给她起了名字？我从没费心过，她什么都不是。

english: Hello Robert. You've had quite the makeover.
translation: 你好，罗伯特。你真是大变样了。

english: AWAKEN!
translation: 苏醒吧！

english: Release us!
translation: 释放我们！

english: Is that so? Tell me, Dallas Jones, what answers do you seek?
translation: 是吗？告诉我，达拉斯.琼斯，你想找什么答案？

english: Yes, an annoying setback. When you attacked, I had this place sealed, to keep our work safe. My people were to return after the attack and release me again.
translation: 是的，一个烦人的挫折。当你攻击时，我把这个地方封了起来，以保护我们的工作。我的人本应在攻击后回来再次释放我。

english: We moved on. We tried various other methods, all ending in disappointment. In the end we came here, our largest facility yet. Here we began work on what would become our masterpiece.
translation: 我们继续前进。我们尝试了各种其他方法，都以失望告终。最后我们来到这里，迄今为止最大的设施。我们在这里开始工作，最终成就了我们的杰作。

english: Why? You attacked us, tried to destroy us. You took away our homes, our people. Were we expected to stand by and watch?
translation: 为什么？你们攻击我们，试图毁灭我们。你们夺走了我们的家园和人民。难道我们要袖手旁观吗？

english: That I am, former boatman and now a researcher for Keldagrim. What can I do for you?
translation: 没错，我就是，以前是船夫，现在是凯尔达格林城的研究员。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Let's see. I'd say 8 Oak Planks, 10 Swamp Paste and 12 Nails of any kind should do it. Obviously you'll need a Hammer and a Saw as well.
translation: 让我想想。我觉得8块橡木板、10份沼泽膏和12颗任意种类的钉子应该就够了。当然，你还需要一把锤子和一把锯子。

english: Of course, Dallas works with the museum and he could easily put in a request for one. He's not a fan of waiting around though.
translation: 当然，达拉斯在博物馆工作，他可以很容易地提出申请。不过，他可不是个喜欢等待的人。

english: Mind you, you'll want to be quite good at building things unless you fancy a trip to the bottom of the ocean.
translation: 提醒你一下，除非你想体验一次海底之旅，否则你最好很擅长建造东西。

english: King Roald commands one of the largest armies in the world, he's probably a good starting point.
translation: 罗尔德国王指挥着世界上最大的军队之一，他可能是个不错的起点。

english: And I'll get in touch with Keldagrim, maybe they can help us.
translation: 我会联系凯尔达格林城，也许他们能帮上忙。

english: I'm Jardric, former boatman and now a researcher for Keldagrim. I'm here with the Varrock Museum to explore this island and discover its secrets.
translation: 我是贾德里克，以前是船夫，现在是凯尔达格林城的研究员。我和维洛克城博物馆一起来这里探索这座岛屿，发现它的秘密。

english: Aye that it is. I do miss it sometimes but I get so many opportunities now that I never used to. Just look at us. We may well be the first to step foot on this island in centuries.
translation: 是啊，确实如此。我有时会怀念过去，但现在我得到了很多以前从未有过的机会。看看我们。我们很可能是几个世纪以来第一批踏上这座岛屿的人。

english: If that isn't exciting I don't know what is.
translation: 如果这都不算激动人心，那我就不知道什么才算了。

english: You'll need a Saw, a Hammer, 8 Oak Planks, 10 Swamp Paste and 12 Nails of any kind. The best place to build the boat will be on the west side of the island, near the mushroom forest.
translation: 你需要一把锯子、一把锤子、8块橡木板、10份沼泽膏和12颗任意种类的钉子。建造船的最佳地点是在岛的西侧，靠近蘑菇森林的地方。

english: You'll need a Saw, a Hammer, 8 Oak Planks, 10 Swamp Paste and 12 Nails of any kind.
translation: 你需要一把锯子、一把锤子、8块橡木板、10份沼泽膏和12颗任意种类的钉子。

english: Head to Varrock and talk to King Roald. He can hopefully help us with this dragon threat.
translation: 去维洛克城找罗尔德国王谈谈。希望他能帮助我们解决这个龙的威胁。

english: Following your successful recreation of V's Shield, the council have agreed to end your exile. I hearby declare you a Fremennik again!
translation: 既然你成功重制了 V 的盾，议会同意结束你的流放。我在此宣布，你再次成为弗瑞曼尼克的族人！

english: I think I know of this island, Ungael, we call it. It is a dark place, guarded by a deadly beast. Some of our finest warriors tried to take the beast down but to no success.
translation: 我想我知道这个岛，我们叫它安格尔。那是个黑暗的地方，由一头致命的野兽守护。我们一些最优秀的战士曾试图击败那头野兽，但都没有成功。

english: Well let it not be said that the Fremennik turned away from a good fight. You have our support. Maybe we'll show your outerlander friends a thing or two.
translation: 哼，可别说弗瑞曼尼克人会临阵退缩。你有我们的支持。也许我们还能让你的外地朋友们见识见识。

english: Let me guess, you intend to take these beasts on.
translation: 让我猜猜，你打算去对付这些野兽。

english: Let me guess, you used your magic to work that one out.
translation: 让我猜猜，你是用你的魔法推断出来的吧。

english: The dragons are amassing at Ungael. We should take the fight to them and destroy the danger before it leaves that island.
translation: 龙群正在安格尔岛集结。我们应该主动出击，在威胁离开那座岛之前将其消灭。

english: We have not seen one of their people in a great many years, certainly not recently.
translation: 我们已经很多年没见过他们的人了，最近肯定没有。

english: Go and speak to the twelve members of the council of elders who live in this village. I am sure at least a few will be prepared to vote for you.
translation: 去和住在这个村子里的十二位长老议会成员谈谈。我相信至少会有几个人愿意投票支持你。

english: Exile, you must leave our province. Our people will no longer see you as their sister.
translation: 流放者，你必须离开我们的领地。我们的族人不再视你为姊妹。

english: Certainly not, outerlander. Now let us be silent on this subject.
translation: 当然不行，外地人。现在我们就别再提这件事了。

english: A new name?!? That is a strange request. What's wrong with ?
translation: 新名字？！？真是个奇怪的请求。 有什么不好？

english: I do think your Lunar Isle endeavours would be more prosperous were you to have one!
translation: 我确实认为，如果你有一个，你在月亮岛的事业会更顺利！

english: Come back to me once you have room for V's Shield.
translation: 等你准备好要拿 V 的盾时再来找我。

english: Of course we know, but we do not like to talk about it.
translation: 我们当然知道，但我们不喜欢谈论这件事。

english: You must understand, our parting was bitter and we prefer just not to talk about them. If their chieftain wants to talk to us, he must send one of his own people.
translation: 你必须明白，我们的分离并不愉快，我们宁可不要谈论他们。如果他们的酋长想和我们谈话，他必须派他自己的人来。

english: No, we're still waiting for him, but I'm sure he'll be here in due time.
translation: 不，我们还在等他，但我相信他很快就会到了。

english: No, we haven't seen him yet. Did you give him that safe passage guarantee yet?
translation: 不，我们还没见到他。你给他安全通行保证书了吗？

english: Ah, outerlander... if you wish to become a Fremennik you should try and pay more attention to what people tell you...
translation: 啊，外地人……如果你想成为弗瑞曼尼克人，就该多注意别人告诉你的话……

english: Now, please, let us speak of this no further.
translation: 现在，拜托，我们别再谈这个了。

english: Perhaps you should go back to their chieftain to tell him about the meeting.
translation: 也许你应该回去找他们的酋长，告诉他会议的事。

english: Only the one you are currently doing...?
translation: 就只有你正在做的这个……？

english: Sigli the hunter is the only one who knows of such hunting grounds. Go and request his knowledge.
translation: 只有猎人西格利知道那样的狩猎场在哪。去请教他吧。

english: Best you come back when you do then!
translation: 那你最好准备好了再回来！

english: Whatever happened to him must have rattled his soul so hard that his memory ran away from him, and he has not yet found it's hiding place.
translation: 发生在他身上的事一定重创了他的灵魂，让他的记忆逃走了，而他至今还没找到记忆的藏身之处。

english: when we saw a figure in the icey waters. As we were at least a 3 week sail from any port, and saw no other ships nearby, he must have been there some time.
translation: 当时我们在冰冷的海水中看到一个人影。因为我们距离任何港口都至少有三周的航程，附近也没看到其他船只，他一定在那里待了一段时间。

english: He still had no recollection of how he had come to be in the icey ocean, or of who he was, or where he had come from, but this did not matter to us or him.
translation: 他仍然不记得自己是怎么掉进冰冷海洋的，也不记得自己是谁，从哪里来，但这对我们和他来说都不重要。

english: Well I don't see how that's important right now but here you go.
translation: 好吧，我不明白这现在有什么重要的，但给你吧。

english: Ah you don't get out of it that easily.  When you've got the time come back and see me.

english: What do you mean?!

translation: 但如果你想追查到底，你应该去和卡拉姆詹岛造船厂的工头谈谈。

english: Karamja Shipyard, east of Shilo village. Be careful! If he discovers you're not working for Glough there'll be trouble! The sea men use the password Ka-Lu-Min.

english: Just west of the toad swamp.

english: Go to the King and tell him! Finally you have proof. Surely King Narnode will belive you now and set me free!
translation: 去找国王告诉他！你终于有证据了。纳诺德国王现在肯定会相信你，然后放了我！

english: Well then, if you've found him what's taking him so long.

english: Don't be daft, giant eagles don't really exist. It's just an old story, everyone knows that.

english: Okay then, as long as you bring him back you can believe what you like.

english: Well we certainly didn't ask him to do anything like that. Then again he never was very reliable at staying on task.

Unfortunately, he taught his apprentice everything he knew, then his apprentice killed him in his sleep. It's ironic he could save others from death, but not himself.! You found us! translation: 一旦你拿到想种的种子，就穿过那扇门进入我的农场，然后开始种植。

english: It was all nonesense, the king died naturally! He was old. He'd been on the throne for at least 40 years.
translation: 那都是胡说八道，国王是自然死亡的！他年纪大了。他已经在位至少40年了。

english: Indeed. He married late and his wife... Unfortunately she didn't survive bringing Rose into this world.
translation: 确实。他结婚很晚，他的妻子……不幸的是，她没能活着把玫瑰带到这个世界。

english: No... After the incident she was sent away. Most have forgotten about her now.
translation: 不……在那次事件之后，她被送走了。现在大多数人已经忘记她了。

english: Yes, I was friends with the last king. It was very sad when he died. The accusations some people aimed at poor little Rose were ridiculous.
translation: 是的，我和上一任国王是朋友。他去世时非常令人悲伤。有些人针对可怜的小玫瑰的指控真是荒谬。

english: Yes, I was friends with the last King. It was very sad when he died. The accusations some people aimed at poor little Rose were ridiculous.

english: Take care travelling through the swamps, I have heard they can be quite dangerous.
translation: 穿越沼泽时要小心，我听说那里可能相当危险。

english: Oh my, what are you doing here?
translation: 哦天哪，你在这里做什么？

english: Argh! What on Gielinor is going on?
translation: 啊！吉莱诺尔到底发生了什么？

english: ...and with your strength, I know we will be able to get through this ordeal...
translation: ……有了你的力量，我知道我们一定能度过这个难关……

english: For only those who are the most faithful...
translation: 因为只有那些最虔诚的人……

english: Ah, [player name]. I had faith that Saradomin would send you to help me.
translation: 啊，[player name]。我就相信萨拉多明会派你来帮助我。

english: Now now little monkey, it's time to return to where you came from.
translation: 好了好了，小猴子，是时候回到你来的地方去了。

english: That's because he wasn't bothering me at all!
translation: 那是因为他根本没打扰到我！

english: Ah, but who told the Duke that I was in need of your assistance?
translation: 啊，但是谁告诉公爵我需要你的帮助呢？

english: May Saradomin guide you on the rest of your travels, [player name].
translation: 愿萨拉多明在你接下来的旅途中指引你，[player name]。

english: And how did the Lumbridge Guide learn of this?
translation: 那仑桥镇向导是怎么知道这件事的？

english: Oh, I wasn't praying for myself. I was praying for him!
translation: 哦，我不是在为自己祈祷。我是在为他祈祷！

english: Saradomin works in wonderous ways, [player name]. If you spent more time devoting yourself to him, I'm sure you would understand.
translation: 萨拉多明以奇妙的方式行事，[player name]。如果你花更多时间献身于他，我相信你会明白的。

english: Things were a bit hectic at first, but once I started preaching about the glory of Saradomin, a wave of calm and understanding came over this poor fellow.
translation: 一开始有点混乱，但一旦我开始宣讲萨拉多明的荣耀，一股平静和理解就降临到这个可怜的家伙身上。

english: It's a shame, isn't it? The castle is even older than this church, and so it's terrible that it would be damaged, even if it's only the cellar.
translation: 真可惜，不是吗？城堡比这座教堂还要古老，所以它被损坏是很糟糕的，即使只是地下室。

english: Saradomin was on the brink of victory, but he could not defeat Zamorak without destroying the world.
translation: 萨拉多明曾处于胜利的边缘，但他无法在不毁灭世界的情况下击败萨莫拉克。

english: Again, I had always interpreted it as symbolic, but that is how the legend goes.
translation: 再说一次，我一直把它解释为象征性的，但传说就是这样。

english: That's right. The gods live in our hearts and listen to our prayers, but they no longer walk among us.
translation: 没错。神祇活在我们心中，倾听我们的祈祷，但他们不再行走在我们中间。

english: So Saradomin in his mercy allowed Zamorak to flee to another world, and all the gods agreed never again to intervene directly in the world.
translation: 所以萨拉多明出于仁慈，允许萨莫拉克逃往另一个世界，所有神祇都同意不再直接干预这个世界。

english: Welcome back, Zanik! I hope you have been thinking about our conversation.
translation: 欢迎回来，扎尼克！我希望你一直在思考我们的谈话。

english: Don't worry, I'm sure you'll find it again.
translation: 别担心，我相信你会再找到它的。

english: Welcome to the church of holy Saradomin, my friend! What can I do for you today?
translation: 欢迎来到神圣萨拉多明教堂，我的朋友！今天我能为你做些什么？

english: I believe he is currently living as a hermit in Lumbridge swamp. He has a little shack in the south-west of the swamps.
translation: 我相信他现在作为隐士住在仑桥镇沼泽。他在沼泽的西南部有一个小棚屋。

english: Well, how could I refuse?
translation: 嗯，我怎么能拒绝呢？

english: Well, I hope you like herbs.
translation: 嗯，我希望你喜欢草药。

english: It is, isn't it? It was built over two centuries ago.
translation: 是的，不是吗？它是在两个多世纪前建造的。

english: Surely you have heard of our god, Saradomin?
translation: 你肯定听说过我们的神，萨拉多明吧？

english: This is the god with more followers than any other ...at least in this part of the world.
translation: 这位神的追随者比任何其他神都多……至少在世界这一带是这样。

english: He who forged the world as we know it, along with his brothers Guthix and Zamorak?
translation: 他和他的兄弟古斯及萨莫拉克一起，锻造了我们所知的这个世界？

english: He who created the forces of goodness and purity in this world? I cannot believe your ignorance!
translation: 他创造了这个世界的善良与纯洁之力？我真不敢相信你的无知！

english: You'll have to go right into the western depths of the swamp, near the coastline. That is where his house is.
translation: 你必须直接进入沼泽的西部深处，靠近海岸线。那里就是他的房子所在。

english: There is only one Saradomin.
translation: 萨拉多明只有一个。

english: here, hve som munny.
translation: 给，拿些钱。

english: Good work. Get the potion to Juliet when you have it, she's expecting you. I'll talk to Romeo and make sure he knows what to do.
translation: 干得好。拿到药水后去找朱丽叶，她在等你。我会和罗密欧谈谈，确保他知道该怎么做。

english: Then Romeo can collect her from the crypt! Go to the Apothercary, tell him I sent you and that you'll need a 'Cadava' potion.
translation: 然后罗密欧就可以从墓穴里接她出来！去找药剂师，告诉他是我派你来的，你需要一瓶'卡达瓦'药水。

translation: "……让萨拉多明为你照亮道路……" 呃！

translation: 拿漂亮石头东西，谢谢带信。

translation: 我听到一些孩子说他们前几天看到了。他们当时在参观维洛克城东南部的采矿场。

translation: 我要一篮子苹果来换那个。

translation: 那么，猫，你觉得这个名字怎么样？

english: Well seagulls rarely make good central characters. They're a bit too ...  uhm.... flighty.
translation: 海鸥很少能当好主角啦。它们有点……嗯……太飘忽不定了。

translation: 那张'丑脸'又在吹牛了吗？

translation: 你得把你的猫带来给我，我好给它起个名字。不过我只给机灵猫和懒猫起名字。

translation: 你要是死在城堡战争或决斗竞技场那种地方，我可帮不了你，那里有自己的魔法保你平安。
