translation: 可以理解，你得是个勇敢的男人才能带着那么多金币来这儿。

english: Understandable, you'd have to be a brave woman to be carrying that much gold out here.
translation: 可以理解，你得是个勇敢的女人才能带着那么多金币来这儿。

english: The Wilderness takes a toll on a man's soul. Are you sure you can handle it?
translation: 荒野会侵蚀男人的灵魂。你确定你能承受？

english: The Wilderness takes a toll on a woman's soul. Are you sure you can handle it?
translation: 荒野会侵蚀女人的灵魂。你确定你能承受？

english: I can only give you one of these, so here you go.
translation: 我只能给你一个，拿着吧。

english: By Zamorak! Keep that thing away from me!
translation: 以萨莫拉克之名！离我远点！

english: I don't think it'll need any more fuel.
translation: 我觉得它不需要更多燃料了。

english: Hey lady! Always nice to see a fresh face!
translation: 嘿，女士！看到新面孔总是让人高兴！

english: Sorry guy, this is my spot.
translation: 抱歉，老兄，这是我的地盘。

english: That's right, lady! Ain't nobody better at fishing round here than me! That's for sure!
translation: 没错，女士！这附近没人比我更会钓鱼了！肯定没有！

english: Sorry lady, this is my spot.
translation: 抱歉，女士，这是我的地盘。

english: Sorry lady! This is my lucky spot!
translation: 抱歉，女士！这是我的幸运宝地！

english: Sorry guy. Big Dave don't like to lose!
translation: 抱歉，老兄。大戴夫不喜欢输！

english: Sorry lady. Big Dave don't like to lose!
translation: 抱歉，女士。大戴夫不喜欢输！

english: Who's Grampa Jack he says! He won this competition four years in a row! He lives in the house just outside the gate.
translation: 他说杰克爷爷是谁！他可是连续四年赢得了这个比赛！他就住在门外的那栋房子里。

english: Quit bugging me then, dude! I got me some fish to catch!
translation: 那就别烦我了，老兄！我还要钓鱼呢！

english: Who's Grampa Jack she says! He won this competition four years in a row! He lives in the house just outside the gate.
translation: 她说杰克爷爷是谁！他可是连续四年赢得了这个比赛！他就住在门外的那栋房子里。

english: Hey dude! This is my spot!
translation: 嘿，老兄！这是我的地盘！

english: No way man. I got a good feeling about this spot!
translation: 没门，伙计。我对这地方感觉很好！

english: Quit bugging me then, doll! I got me some fish to catch!
translation: 那就别烦我了，美女！我还要钓鱼呢！

english: Hello young man!  Come to visit old Grandpa Jack? I can tell ye stories for sure. I used to be the best fisherman these parts have seen!
translation: 你好啊小伙子！是来看望老杰克爷爷的吗？我当然可以给你讲故事。我曾经是这一带最棒的渔夫！

english: Hello young lady!  Come to visit old Grandpa Jack? I can tell ye stories for sure. I used to be the best fisherman these parts have seen!
translation: 你好啊小姑娘！是来看望老杰克爷爷的吗？我当然可以给你讲故事。我曾经是这一带最棒的渔夫！

english: Of course you can young lady. Let's see now...I think 5 gold is a fair price for a rod which has won the Fishing contest before eh?
translation: 当然可以，小姑娘。让我想想……我觉得5金币买一根曾经赢过钓鱼大赛的鱼竿很公平，对吧？

english: Ahh well, I'm sure you'll find something to put him off. After all, there must be a kitchen around here with some garlic in it, perhaps in Seers Village or Ardougne. If he's pretending to be a vampyre then he can pretend
translation: 啊，好吧，我相信你总能找到办法让他知难而退。毕竟，这附近肯定有个厨房里放着大蒜，也许在占卜师村或者阿多尼城。如果他假装是吸血鬼，那他也可以假装

english: to be scared of garlic!
translation: 害怕大蒜！

english: Try to get a spot round there. The best sort of bait for them is red vine worms.
translation: 试着在那边找个位置。钓它们最好的鱼饵是红色藤蔓蠕虫。

english: But young lady, you have your own. I'll not sell you mine when you already have one!
translation: 但是小姑娘，你自己有鱼竿啊。既然你已经有一根了，我就不卖给你了！

english: I think you will find that is my spot.
translation: 我想你会发现那是我的位置。

english: I like this place. I like to savour the aroma coming from these pipes.
translation: 我喜欢这个地方。我喜欢品味这些管道里飘出的香气。

english: We have a new winner!
translation: 我们有了新的获胜者！

english: The heroic-looking person who was fishing by the pipes has caught the biggest carp I've seen since Grandpa Jack used to compete!
translation: 那位在管道旁钓鱼、看起来英姿飒爽的人，钓到了自杰克爷爷参赛以来我见过最大的鲤鱼！

english: Okay folks, time's up! Let's see who caught the biggest fish!
translation: 好了各位，时间到了！让我们看看谁钓到了最大的鱼！

english: And the winner is... local favourite - Big Dave!
translation: 而获胜者是……本地宠儿——大戴夫！

english: No pay, no play.
translation: 没付钱就别玩。

english: This is the home of the Mountain Dwarves. How would you like it if I wanted to take a short cut through your home?
translation: 这里是山地矮人的家。如果我想抄近路穿过你的家，你会怎么想？

english: I don't make friends easily. People need to earn my trust first.
translation: 我不轻易交朋友。人们必须先赢得我的信任。

english: You've done us proud. Thank you lad. I think we can now trust you enough to let you in...
translation: 你让我们骄傲。谢谢你，小伙子。我想我们现在足够信任你，可以让你进去了……

english: You've done us proud. Thank you lass. I think we can now trust you enough to let you in...
translation: 你让我们骄傲。谢谢你，姑娘。我想我们现在足够信任你，可以让你进去了……

english: Hoi there! Halt!
translation: 嘿！站住！

english: You can't come in here!
translation: 你不能进来这里！

english: Seems to me like you're not much of anything.
translation: 在我看来你什么都不是。

english: Aye, it shouldn't take you long. When it's up to 10, come back and talk to me.
translation: 是的，不会花你很长时间。当它达到10时，回来跟我说话。

english: Ach! I don't want that!
translation: 啊！我不要那个！

english: You'd better go get it then hadn't you?
translation: 那你最好去拿吧，不是吗？

english: That is a very small shark indeed, outerlander. Small, but worthy.
translation: 那是一条非常小的鲨鱼，外地人。虽然小，但值得赞赏。

english: But I've already enchanted the sigil for you.
translation: 但我已经为你附魔了印记。

english: It is a right you earned. It is not my judgement to remove it.
translation: 这是你应得的权利。我没有资格剥夺它。

english: I sense something on your mind, however. How may I help?
translation: 不过我感觉你心里有事。我能帮什么忙？

english: Great job lad! Keep up the good work, deliveries will be coming in all day.
translation: 干得好小子！继续保持，送货今天会一直来。

english: Great job lass! Keep up the good work, deliveries will be coming in all day.
translation: 干得好丫头！继续保持，送货今天会一直来。

english: Get that fish into the cooler before it's ruined!
translation: 把鱼放进冷却器，不然就坏了！

english: Not quite. You see, the fish doesn't stay fresh for long once it's been removed from the delivery barrels. You'll have to get it back here and into the cooler before its quality deteriorates.
translation: 不太对。你看，鱼从送货桶里拿出来之后新鲜不了多久。你得赶紧把它带回来放进冷却器，否则品质就下降了。

english: There's 3 unloading areas; the North, East and West docks. You should get a move on, there are new deliveries coming in all day.
translation: 有三个卸货区：北码头、东码头和西码头。你得赶紧了，今天全天都有新货送来。

english: You seem like a trustworthy lad, perhaps you could help collect the fresh catches from the docks.
translation: 你看起来是个可靠的小伙子，也许你能帮我去码头收新鲜渔获。

english: You seem like a trustworthy lass, perhaps you could help collect the fresh catches from the docks.
translation: 你看起来是个可靠的姑娘，也许你能帮我去码头收新鲜渔获。

english: There's always work to be done on the docks. You're going to have to prove yourself worthy around here before you get any work from me, though.
translation: 码头上总有活干。不过你得先在这儿证明自己的价值，我才会给你活干。

english: I trade the finest fish in Piscarilius. In this town you get 2 choices, fishing or thuggery. I've kept afloat without resorting to the latter, not something which can be said by many of the folk around here.
translation: 我卖的是皮斯卡里琉斯城最好的鱼。在这个镇上，你只有两个选择：钓鱼或者当暴徒。我不用走后面那条路也能撑下来，这附近可没多少人能做到。

english: There's 3 unloading areas; the north, east and west docks. You should get a move on, there are new deliveries coming in all day.
translation: 有三个卸货区：北码头、东码头和西码头。你得赶紧了，今天全天都有新货送来。

english: Get your hands out of there!
translation: 把你的手从那里拿开！

english: You seem like a trustworthy lad, but I'm afraid you'll have to improve your fishing skills before you can help on the docks.
translation: 你看起来是个可靠的小伙子，但恐怕你得先提高钓鱼技能才能在码头上帮忙。

english: You seem like a trustworthy lass, but I'm afraid you'll have to improve your fishing skills before you can help on the docks.
translation: 你看起来是个可靠的姑娘，但恐怕你得先提高钓鱼技能才能在码头上帮忙。

english: by Nascarr
translation: 作者：Nascarr

english: I can insure you up to level 50 Hitpoints. That service costs only 100,000 coins.
translation: 我可以在你达到 50 级生命值之前为你投保。这项服务只需花费 100,000 金币。

english: I might be able to help. Fluffs followed me to our secret play area and I haven't seen her since.
translation: 我或许能帮忙。弗拉夫斯跟着我去了我们的秘密游乐区，从那以后我就没再见过她。

english: We play at an abandoned lumber mill to the north east. Just beyond the Jolly Boar Inn. I saw Fluffs running around in there.
translation: 我们在东北边一个废弃的木材磨坊玩。就在快乐野猪旅店过去一点。我看到弗拉夫斯在里面跑来跑去。

english: You shouldn't, but I won't help otherwise. I never liked that cat anyway, so what do you say?
translation: 你不应该这样，但你不答应我就不帮忙。反正我也不喜欢那只猫，你觉得怎么样？

english: W..wh..what?! Y..you wouldn't! A young lad like me!
translation: 什……什么？！你……你不会的！像我这样的小伙子！

english: If you want to hurt my brother you'll first have to get by me!
translation: 如果你想伤害我弟弟，先得过我这一关！

english: We don't talk to strange old people.
translation: 我们不和奇怪的老人说话。

english: No we don't!
translation: 对，我们不！

english: I can beat anyone up.
translation: 我能打败任何人。

english: I don't talk to strange old people.
translation: 我不和奇怪的老人说话。

english: Thanks miss!
translation: 谢谢小姐！

english: Hello, my dear. How's things?
translation: 你好，亲爱的。最近怎么样？

english: Well, my dear. Is there anything else I can do for you?
translation: 嗯，亲爱的。还有什么事要我帮忙吗？

english: Well there are these two ladies who know a lot about rat catching.
translation: 嗯，有两位女士对抓老鼠很在行。

english: They generally are to be found in the sewers underneath Varrock, a horrid place, I should know.
translation: 她们通常出现在维洛克城下面的下水道里，那地方恶心得很，我可知道。

english: I've had to drag Shilop and Wilough out of there more times than I care for, the little rascals.
translation: 我不得不把希洛普和威洛从那里面拖出来，次数多得我都不愿去想，那两个小捣蛋鬼。

english: I don't know which is harder raising kids or cats.
translation: 我不知道养孩子和养猫哪个更难。

english: Good good, See you again.
translation: 好好好，回头见。

english: Did you ever get to talk to those people I told you about?
translation: 你跟那些我提到的人谈过了吗？

english: You're still raising that last cat and it needs your attention. Only when the cat doesn't need your attention any longer could I possibly let you have another kitten.
translation: 你还在养上一只猫，它还需要你的照顾。只有等那只猫不再需要你照顾了，我才可能再给你一只小猫。

english: Oh, deary me. You've been letting it eat demonic beings, haven't you? Don't worry, just give it a drink of milk and it'll be right as rain.
translation: 哦，天哪。你让它吃了恶魔生物，是吧？别担心，给它喝点牛奶就会没事的。

english: I'm sorry, I'm too poor to pay you anything, the best I could offer is a warm meal.
translation: 对不起，我太穷了，付不起你任何东西，最多只能给你一顿热饭。

english: Hello little kitty, are you lost?
translation: 你好，小猫咪，你迷路了吗？

english: Come here little fella, I've got a tasty sardine for you.
translation: 过来，小家伙，我有一条美味的沙丁鱼给你。

english: Hello again, adventurer. I'm a bit busy now - come back another time, please.
translation: 又见面了，冒险者。我现在有点忙——请改天再来吧。

english: Who's a good fluff ball.
translation: 谁是乖乖毛球呀。

english: Well, okay then, I'll have to find someone else.
translation: 好吧，那我得找别人了。

english: Free up a little space so I can give you a present.
translation: 腾出点地方，我好给你个礼物。

english: LOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOL
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈哈

english: Hello, chap! Gilbert's the name. How may I help?
translation: 你好，伙计！我叫吉尔伯特。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: Hey Gilbert, I'm [player name]! I couldn't help but notice that rainbow near you. Where did it come from?
translation: 嘿，吉尔伯特，我是[player name]！我忍不住注意到你身边的彩虹。它是从哪来的？

english: 'Tis strange, isn't it [player name]? They appear almost anywhere in the world, I couldn't say where it came from... That being said, rainbows certainly are beautiful and aren't afraid to show their colours to the world! They fill me with such pride.
translation: 很奇怪，对吧[player name]？它们几乎出现在世界上的任何地方，我也说不清是从哪来的……话虽如此，彩虹确实很美，而且毫不畏惧地向世界展示它们的色彩！它们让我充满了自豪感。

english: 'Tis upsetting though. I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need... All of my clothing is plain.
translation: 不过这也挺让人沮丧的。我一直想像彩虹一样展示自己的色彩，但似乎找不到我需要的材料……我所有的衣服都是素色的。

english: You know, I've never thought about it like that!
translation: 你知道吗，我从来没这么想过！

english: Maybe I could help in some way?
translation: 也许我能帮上什么忙？

english: I'm not sure how much you know about rainbows, but they have a lot of colours to show! They also have a lot of colours to share.
translation: 我不确定你对彩虹了解多少，但它们有很多颜色要展示！而且它们也有很多颜色可以分享。

english: Sadly, some of those colours are in short supply so I'd feel bad asking you to take those.
translation: 可惜的是，有些颜色供应短缺，所以我不太好意思让你去取那些。

english: There's six colours that are in higher supply though: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and purple.
translation: 不过有六种颜色的供应量更大：红色、橙色、黄色、绿色、蓝色和紫色。

english: I can sense where rainbows are with extra strands of each of these colours...
translation: 我能感知到哪些彩虹有这些颜色的额外色带……

english: Could you find them for me, and take some of their spare colour?
translation: 你能帮我找到它们，并取一些它们多余的颜色吗？

english: Sounds fun!
translation: 听起来很有趣！

english: Now then, [player name] - Have you got any questions for me?
translation: 那么，[player name]——你有什么问题要问我吗？

english: What am I doing, again?
translation: 我到底要做什么来着？

english: Well, I've always wanted to show my colours like a rainbow, but I can't seem to get the ingredients I need myself.
translation: 嗯，我一直想像彩虹一样展示自己的色彩，但我自己似乎找不到需要的材料。

english: I'm able to sense the location of these rainbows in my mind, but it's always a little hazy. Feel free to ask me to sense a rainbow with extra strands of red, orange, yellow, green, blue or purple!
translation: 我能在脑海中感知到这些彩虹的位置，但总是有点模糊。随时可以请我感知一条带有额外红色、橙色、黄色、绿色、蓝色或紫色色带的彩虹！

english: Why am I only gathering six colours?
translation: 为什么我只收集六种颜色？

english: Well we don't want to take all of the colour from the rainbows! Some have extra strands of certain colours, and those are the ones I'll direct you towards...
translation: 嗯，我们可不想把彩虹的所有颜色都拿走！有些彩虹有某些颜色的额外色带，那些才是我要指引你去的……

english: But rainbows have so many colours! Surely there's some with other colours spare?
translation: 但彩虹有那么多颜色！肯定有些彩虹有其他颜色多余吧？

english: Some colours are in such short supply for every rainbow. Besides, it's the thought that counts! Even displaying a small selection of colours to others makes them feel comfortable showing theirs!
translation: 有些颜色对每条彩虹来说都供应不足。再说了，心意最重要！即使只向他人展示一小部分颜色，也能让他们感到自在地展示自己的色彩！

english: I never thought of it like that... Thanks Gilbert!
translation: 我从没这么想过……谢谢你，吉尔伯特！

english: Anytime, [player name]! Now, is there anything else I can help you with?
translation: 随时欢迎，[player name]！那么，还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra red strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到带有额外红色色带的彩虹吗？

english: I can see it...
translation: 我能看到……

english: South of my magical location, I see life! New adventurers and baldness rife.
translation: 在我魔法位置的南方，我看到了生命！新冒险者和随处可见的光头。

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra orange strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到一条带有额外橙色色带的彩虹吗？

english: Beside me now, a person of healing. Those who test their luck, find this place appealing.
translation: 在我身边，一个治疗者。那些碰运气的人，觉得这地方很吸引人。

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra yellow strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到带有额外黄色色带的彩虹吗？

english: On my face; shining sunlight. South of a dwarf whom redberries delight.
translation: 在我脸上；阳光闪耀。在一个喜爱红莓的矮人南方。

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra green strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到带有额外绿色色带的彩虹吗？

english: Lush nature and trees are to the east. The Green strand... no orange! No, blue! No, red! Green! Argh! There's so much bickering in this area it's hard to pinpoint its location... Sorry, [player name]!
translation: 东边有茂盛的自然风光和树木。绿色色带……不，橙色！不，蓝色！不，红色！绿色！啊！这个区域争吵太多了，很难确定它的位置……抱歉，[player name]！

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra blue strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到带有额外蓝色色带的彩虹吗？

english: In this area, there's a silent and artistic harmony... Ironically, north west, wizards kill newcomers effortlessly.
translation: 在这个区域，有一种安静而艺术的和谐……讽刺的是，西北方，巫师们毫不费力地杀死新来者。

english: Can you tell me where I can find a rainbow with extra purple strands?
translation: 你能告诉我在哪里可以找到带有额外紫色色带的彩虹吗？

english: The knights in this area, are full of Saradomin's spirit. On the top of this fortress, when I yell - all hear it!
translation: 这个区域的骑士，充满了萨拉多明的灵魂。在这座堡垒的顶端，当我大喊时——所有人都能听到！

english: I'm not someone who needs to show my colours...
translation: 我不是那种需要展示自己色彩的人……

english: Oh, that is most upsetting.
translation: 哦，那真是太令人沮丧了。

english: Sometimes just showing your own colours makes other people comfortable showing theirs, you know?
translation: 有时候，仅仅展示你自己的色彩就能让别人也自在地展示他们的，你知道吗？

english: [Player name], that's all of them! All six rainbow strands!
translation: [Player name]，全齐了！所有六种彩虹色带！

english: I can't thank you enough!
translation: 我感激不尽！

english: No problem at all, Gilbert! Always happy to help. What exactly are you going to make with all those strands, anyway?
translation: 完全没问题，吉尔伯特！总是乐意帮忙。话说回来，你打算用这些色带做什么呢？

english: You know, [player name]. All this time I've been wanting to show my colours like a rainbow and you've made me realise something...
translation: 你知道吗，[player name]。一直以来我都想像彩虹一样展示自己的色彩，而你让我意识到了一件事……

english: What you've made me realise, [player name], is that people like yourself who are willing to support those who wish to show their own colours proudly...
translation: 你让我意识到，[player name]，像你这样愿意支持那些希望自豪地展示自己色彩的人……

english: You're the reason I feel confident showing my colours! I want you to have this - you deserve it.
translation: 你才是我有自信展示自己色彩的原因！我想让你收下这个——你应得的。

english: Thank you so much for the scarf, Gilbert. It's wonderful!
translation: 非常感谢你的围巾，吉尔伯特。太棒了！

english: It's no problem at all, [player name]. I added a little heart on the item to show my personal thanks. Thank you for your help! Wear it with pride, and let everyone know to show their own colours proudly!
translation: 完全不用谢，[player name]。我在物品上加了一颗小心心，以表达我个人的谢意。谢谢你的帮助！自豪地戴上它，让每个人都知道要自豪地展示自己的色彩！

english: I will! Take care.
translation: 我会的！保重。

english: How much do want for each one?
translation: 每个你打算卖多少钱？

english: Ooh, I've never had that before. How exciting!
translation: 哦，我以前从没吃过这个。真让人兴奋！

english: Oh, I think I've heard people talking about that.
translation: 哦，我想我听过别人谈论这个。

english: That smells nice; what is it?
translation: 闻起来不错；这是什么？

english: So what's that then?
translation: 那又是什么？

english: Mmm, that smells good... What is it?
translation: 嗯，闻起来不错……这是什么？

english: Eww, what's that?
translation: 呃，那是什么？

english: Yuck, that looks horrid. What is it?
translation: 呸，看起来真恶心。这是什么？

english: Hmm, okay. I'll buy one.
translation: 嗯，好吧。我买一个。

english: Didn't I just buy some food from you? I need to shop for something else!
translation: 我不是刚在你这里买了些食物吗？我需要买点别的东西！

english: That's fair. I'll take one.
translation: 那很合理。我要一个。

english: That's a bit much for me.
translation: 对我来说有点贵了。

english: Oh, of course. I've had that occasionally.
translation: 哦，当然。我偶尔吃过那个。

english: That sounds like a good deal to me. I'll take two!
translation: 听起来很划算。我要两个！

english: Don't be absurd - it's clearly not worth that!
translation: 别开玩笑了——它显然不值这个价！

english: That sounds like a great deal to me. I'll take four!
translation: 听起来太划算了。我要四个！

english: That sounds like a good deal to me. I'll take three!
translation: 听起来很划算。我要三个！

english: Well, I'll take what you have then.
translation: 好吧，那我就全要了。

english: Oh, we have that all the time.
translation: 哦，我们经常吃那个。

english: That sounds like a great deal to me. I'll take five!
translation: 听起来太划算了。我要五个！

english: Hmm...if you're selling them that cheaply there must be something wrong with them. I think I'll pass.
translation: 嗯……如果你卖得这么便宜，那肯定有问题。我想我还是算了。

english: Surface-dweller, you shall have the honour of tasting my fabulous steamed pond loach!
translation: 地表居民，你将有幸品尝我美味的清蒸池塘泥鳅！

english: Since I'm trying some of your food, why don't you try some of my cave eel sushi?
translation: 既然我尝了你的食物，不如你也尝尝我的洞穴鳗鱼寿司？

english: Here, have some of my sauteed mushrooms as well!
translation: 来，也尝尝我的炒蘑菇！

english: Oooh! Is that what I think it is?
translation: 哦哦！是我想的那个东西吗？

english: This is what everyone has been talking about!
translation: 这就是大家都在谈论的东西！

english: I tell you what, I'll also give you some of these cave crawler fillets that I made!
translation: 我跟你说，我再给你一些我做的洞穴爬虫鱼片！

english: Hey, why don't you try these grubs a la mode? I made them myself!
translation: 嘿，不如尝尝这些风味烤蛆？我自己做的！

english: That again?
translation: 又是那个？

english: Why don't you try some Dorgeshuun cuisine, surface- dweller? Here's one of my famous roast frogs!
translation: 地表居民，不如尝尝多格舒恩的美食？这是我著名的烤青蛙之一！

english: Goodness! We don't deal in sums of money that big in the marketplace.
translation: 天哪！我们在市场上不做这么大笔的买卖。

english: Mmm, this is good stuff! I'm going to tell all my friends about this!
translation: 嗯，这真是好东西！我要告诉所有朋友这个！

english: You need 200 coins to travel to Shilo Village.
translation: 你需要200金币才能前往希洛村。

english: You need 200 coins to travel to Shilo Village
translation: 你需要200金币才能前往希洛村

english: It's really quite simple to make. Just walk down to that tree on the bank and chop it down.
translation: 制作起来其实非常简单。只需走到岸边那棵树旁，把它砍倒就行了。

english: Oi, you don't have enough money on you! Let's have another game.
translation: 喂，你身上钱不够！我们再玩一局。

english: I didn't expect you to talk to me!
translation: 我没料到你会跟我说话！

english: True! Nice to meet you!
translation: 真的！很高兴认识你！

english: What is it like living in a tiny bottle?
translation: 住在一个小瓶子里是什么感觉？

english: Can I talk to you occasionally?
translation: 我可以偶尔和你聊聊吗？

english: Who were you when you used to be alive?
translation: 你活着的时候是谁？

english: That's unfortunate. I've never heard of that happening before.
translation: 真不幸。我以前从未听说过这种事。

english: Who is your favourite god?
translation: 你最喜欢哪个神？

english: Any words of wisdom for me?
translation: 有什么智慧之言要告诉我吗？

english: Can you do any impressions?
translation: 你会模仿什么吗？

english: Surprise me!
translation: 给我个惊喜吧！

english: How many times have we spoken to each other now?
translation: 我们现在聊过几次了？

english: Wow! How are you keeping count?
translation: 哇！你怎么记得住的？

english: I suppose. Here's to many more great conversations!
translation: 我想也是。为更多精彩的对话干杯！

english: Why do you slap me each time I wake you up?
translation: 为什么每次我吵醒你你都要扇我？

english: What is your favourite number?
translation: 你最喜欢哪个数字？

english: Interesting, I've always liked eight myself.
translation: 有意思，我自己一直喜欢八。

english: You're a lovely colour of green today!
translation: 你今天这绿色真可爱！

english: Nothing. I just wanted to see if you were still here.
translation: 没什么。我就是想看看你是不是还在。

english: The adventurer returns. We await the return of our Lord from his business in the north here, so that we may wreak vengeance on his enemies.
translation: 冒险者回来了。我们在此等候吾主从北方办完事归来，好对他的敌人施以复仇术。

english: I bow before you in honour for your efforts in bringing Lord Hazeel back to this realm to lead us into glory once more!
translation: 我向您鞠躬，感谢您将哈兹尔大人带回这片领域，再次带领我们走向荣耀！

english: It's the meddler! The one who blew Jones' cover! I don't know why you came to this place but it is here that you will die.
translation: 是那个多管闲事的家伙！就是那个揭穿琼斯的人！我不知道你为什么会来这里，但你将命丧于此。

english: I'm [x] months old.(Month count differs based on kitten's current growth.)
translation: 我[x]个月大了。（月份数根据小猫当前成长阶段而变化。）

english: Me me! Find me some fish heads to crunch! Yum yum.
translation: 我我！给我找些鱼头来嚼！好吃好吃。

english: Indeed! Bob should be back by now, let's go find him.
translation: 没错！鲍勃现在应该回来了，我们去找他吧。

english: Go on. Ask him.
translation: 去吧。问他。

english: Lets go steal some things from stalls. I do enjoy watching shopkeepers panic!
translation: 我们去偷摊位上的东西吧。我特别喜欢看店主惊慌失措的样子！

english: I'm 10 months old.
translation: 我十个月大了。

english: I'm 9 months old.
translation: 我九个月大了。

english: I'm 8 months old.
translation: 我八个月大了。

english: I'm 7 months old.
translation: 我七个月大了。

english: I'm 5 months old.
translation: 我五个月大了。

english: I'm 6 months old.
translation: 我六个月大了。

english: What about the Dragonkin? A vicious race of bird like creatures?
translation: 那龙人呢？一个凶残的像鸟一样的种族？

english: Let's go out into the desert to talk about this, if you don't mind. I want the right atmosphere for the story.
translation: 我们到沙漠里去谈这个吧，如果你不介意的话。我想要一个适合这个故事的氛围。

english: I'm 4 months old.
translation: 我四个月大了。

english: Speaking of turning faces, shouldn't we get back to those ugly sisters?
translation: 说到变脸，我们是不是该回去找那些丑姐姐了？

english: I'm 3 months old.
translation: 我三个月大了。

english: Yeah 'suppose so, this covert rat killing just comes so naturally.
translation: 是啊，我想是吧，这种秘密杀老鼠的事对我来说简直小菜一碟。

english: I have many darksides.
translation: 我有很多阴暗面。

english: I'm 2 months old.
translation: 我两个月大了。

english: I suppose that is understandable, you did miss out on a little bit of the adventure.
translation: 我想这可以理解，你确实错过了一点点冒险。

english: Do you remember being hypnotised then?
translation: 那你记得被催眠的事吗？

english: Yes! When you were hypnotised you told us of when you defeated a Dragonkin!
translation: 是的！你被催眠的时候告诉了我们你打败龙人的事！

english: The Sphinx hypnotised Bob. Bob told us about when he was Robert the Strong fighting Dragonkin.
translation: 斯芬克斯催眠了鲍勃。鲍勃告诉我们他当年作为强者罗伯特对抗龙人的故事。

english: Hey [player name], hey talk to me.
translation: 嘿 [player name]，嘿，跟我说话。

english: Sorry, I got a little carried away.
translation: 抱歉，我有点得意忘形了。

english: Well then why don't you let me help out. Tell me when you're going to start the fire and I'll race over and get the rats, while you're smoking them out.
translation: 那不如让我来帮忙。告诉我你什么时候点火，我会冲过去抓老鼠，而你负责用烟把它们熏出来。

english: Look I can't let you keep doing this, you're doing it all wrong.
translation: 听我说，我不能让你继续这样下去，你全都搞错了。

english: Hu-ha!
translation: 呼哈！

english: Me? Whiney? Well, if that isn't the demon calling the imp red! I'll hunt you down when I'm bigger and you'll be sorry!
translation: 我？爱发牢骚？哈，这真是恶魔骂小恶魔红！等我长大了我会追到你，你会后悔的！

english: It's too late for you no-fur. I hope you get your sword stuck and a dragon falls on your head. Now shoo!
translation: 对你来说太晚了，无毛。我希望你的剑卡住，然后一条龙掉在你头上。现在，走开！

english: Every time you try smoke those rats out they run out of the hole, the only problem is the smoke clears fast enough for them to run back in before you can get over to them.
translation: 每次你试图用烟把那些老鼠熏出来，它们都会跑出洞，唯一的问题是烟散得太快，在你赶过去之前它们又跑回去了。

english: You got them? I think I may have had something to do with it.
translation: 你抓到它们了？我想我可能也出了点力。

english: Well of course you'd hardly expect that human to do a ratcatcher's job.
translation: 当然，你几乎不能指望那个人类能做好捕鼠的工作。

english: Can we go and tear up some furniture! I love that!
translation: 我们能去撕些家具吗！我喜欢那个！

english: The Apothecary said you need a vial of water to give to Unferth.
translation: 药剂师说你需要一瓶水给昂弗斯。

english: I think we should get away from those sisters. They are wierder than Dogs.
translation: 我觉得我们应该离那些姐妹远点。她们比狗还怪。

english: Lets go find Bob and lock him in a box.
translation: 我们去找鲍勃，把他锁在箱子里吧。

english: I don't think so.....
translation: 我不这么认为......

english: See you later Bob.
translation: 回头见，鲍勃。

english: No, but what's that got to do with.... no, nooooo! It cannot be!!
translation: 不，但这跟......不，不！不可能！！

english: OK dad, maybe later. You're scaring me!
translation: 好吧老爸，也许以后再说。你吓到我了！

english: Pretty good! [player name] could use your help with something.
translation: 不错！[player name]有点事需要你帮忙。

english: I can remember them, I'll make a list.
translation: 我能记住它们，我会列个清单。

english: Theres only one source of warmth in the house, I suggest you use it.
translation: 房子里只有一个温暖源，我建议你用它。

english: Meow, meow!
translation: 喵，喵！

english: Miaaow.
translation: 喵呜。

english: We better put Unferth out of his misery and tell him that Bob is safe.
translation: 我们还是让昂弗斯解脱吧，告诉他鲍勃没事了。

english: Hiss. Go away before I scratch those curious eyes out.
translation: 嘶。滚开，不然我挖出你那好奇的眼睛。

english: Let's stay here. I fancy a scrap.
translation: 我们留在这里吧。我想打一架。

english: Hmm... it seems you don't have enough space for the chores.
translation: 嗯......看来你没有足够的空间来做这些杂务。

english: Thank Zaros for that. Finally some freedom from your ugly face!
translation: 感谢扎罗斯。终于能摆脱你那丑脸了！

english: Lets get out of here! Sewers make my fur smell. Somewhere less, erm, organised.
translation: 我们快离开这里吧！下水道让我的毛皮都臭了。去个不那么……整洁的地方。

english: Meoow!
translation: 喵！

english: I did, just via you. Shall I do it again?
translation: 我做了，只是通过你做的。要我再来一次吗？

english: Oh yes, but many of us left due to the harsh conditions. Sand is the worst thing to lick yourself clean from.
translation: 哦，是的，但我们很多人因为恶劣的条件离开了。沙子是舔干净自己身上最糟糕的东西。

english: I'd love to crunch up some rats. Mmmmm rats.
translation: 我很想嚼碎一些老鼠。嗯嗯，老鼠。

english: Oiling? I have no idea, but I get the feeling it's not going to be funny.
translation: 上油？我不知道，但我感觉这不会是什么好笑的事。

english: Wow. That's so funny I almost laughed. Humpf. I guess I'll have to eat something else then.
translation: 哇。真好笑，我差点就笑了。哼。我想我得吃点别的了。

english: Good answer no-fur.
translation: 回答得好，无毛。

english: Only in your nightmares no-fur.
translation: 只会在你的噩梦里，无毛。

english: And so do I. But you didn't stop to ask before naming me did you?
translation: 我也是。但你给我起名字之前，没停下来问过我，对吧？

english: You bore me. I had packed my things weeks ago anyway, I was just hanging about to see how many little presents I could leave for you in your bank.
translation: 你让我无聊死了。我几周前就收拾好行李了，只是闲逛着看看能在你的银行里留下多少小礼物。

english: You'll what? Come on now, lets be honest. You couldn't fight your way out of a cow field. I'm off!!
translation: 你会怎样？得了吧，老实说。你连奶牛场都打不出去。我走了！！

english: Your cat shakes it head frantically and starts to scratchyour leg.
translation: 你的猫疯狂地摇头，开始抓你的腿。

english: If you mean by rodent catching, getting myself killed by attacking that there rat,.... no.
translation: 如果你是指抓老鼠，结果被那只老鼠弄死，……不。

english: Happy as a demon in a Lava pit.
translation: 开心得像熔岩坑里的恶魔。

english: We're in the port's ratpits so let's go fighting.
translation: 我们在港口的老鼠坑里，所以去打架吧。

english: Whoa-oa-oa! I feel good, I knew that I would now.. I feel nice!!
translation: 哇-哦-哦！我感觉很好，我就知道我会的……我感觉棒极了！！

english: Lets go hunting in Lumbridge.
translation: 我们去仑桥镇打猎吧。

english: Ha! If I wanted to bite your head off, I would have done while you distracted with that other no-fur.
translation: 哈！如果我想咬掉你的头，在你被那个其他无毛分心的时候我就已经做了。

english: More carnage! More rats! I seek RAGE!
translation: 更多杀戮！更多老鼠！我寻求愤怒！

english: Lets go hunt some butterflies. They're so stupid and ugly.
translation: 我们去抓些蝴蝶吧。它们又蠢又丑。

english: Argh!!
Lets go find Bob! I've got a bone to pick with him anyway.
translation: 我们去找鲍勃吧！反正我跟他有笔账要算。

english: Look!! My thumbs have gone wierd!
translation: 看！！我的拇指变得奇怪了！

english: Hiss! What would you care?
translation: 嘶！关你什么事？

english: Go away!!~From the look in its eyes you decide to leave alone fornow.
translation: 走开！！~从它的眼神可以看出，你决定暂时不去惹它。

english: Lets go to the duel arena and watch some fights!
translation: 我们去决斗竞技场看几场比赛吧！

english: Well, most of still is, you young whippersnapper!
translation: 嗯，大部分还是这样，你这小毛头！

english: Look there he is now!
translation: 看，他现在就在那儿！

english: Back to the pits. I want to tell the catchers what a evil master you've been.
translation: 回到坑里去。我要告诉那些捕手你是个多么邪恶的主人。

english: I would... you're great! I wouldn't have it any other way! Evilness is just so, you know, EEEVVIIILLL.
translation: 我会的……你很棒！我不想要别的方式！邪恶就是那么，你知道的，超级邪恶。

english: Lets go dig up King Rollie's garden. He was very pleased the last time he saw me in there.
translation: 我们去把国王罗利的花园挖了吧。上次他看到我在那里时非常高兴。

english: Somewhere brutal and nasty. I could do with a snooze you see.
translation: 某个残酷又肮脏的地方。你看，我正好可以打个盹。

english: Your the meanest old adventurer I have ever met. I'll be back on my feet some day, back in tip top form. And when I do, you'll be for it!
translation: 你是我见过的最刻薄的老冒险者。总有一天我会恢复过来，重回巅峰状态。到时候，你就有麻烦了！

english: You should be asking what isn't wrong with Bob. Very, very shifty if you ask me.
translation: 你应该问鲍勃有什么问题。依我看，他非常非常可疑。

english: Let's get out of here, this is Bob country.
translation: 我们离开这里吧，这是鲍勃的地盘。

english: Lets go maim and slaughter.
translation: 我们去残杀和屠杀吧。

english: Rats mainly. And a few goblins now and again.
translation: 主要是老鼠。偶尔还有一些地精。

english: Let's go play with those balls of wool you gave the farmer.
translation: 我们去玩你给农夫的那些毛线球吧。

english: Didn't you know that us cats are omnipotent?
translation: 你难道不知道我们猫是无所不能的吗？

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 4 pieces of copper ore. And I need them within 14 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要4块铜矿石。而且我需要在14分钟内拿到。

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 3 pieces of copper ore. And I need them within 13 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要3块铜矿石。而且我需要在13分钟内拿到。

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 4 pieces of clay. And I need them within 14 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要4块粘土。而且我需要在14分钟内拿到。

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 4 pieces of gold ore. And I need them within 14 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要4块金矿石。而且我需要在14分钟内拿到。

english: Are my 4 pieces of clay arriving anytime soon?
translation: 我的4块粘土快到了吗？

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 4 pieces of coal. And I need them within 14 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要4块煤。而且我需要在14分钟内拿到。

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 5 pieces of copper ore. And I need them within 15 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要5块铜矿石。而且我需要在15分钟内拿到。

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 3 bars of gold. And I need them within 18 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要3块金锭。而且我需要在18分钟内拿到。

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is 3 pieces of tin ore. And I need them within 13 minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要3块锡矿石。而且我需要在13分钟内拿到。

english: Good day, [player name].
translation: 日安，[player name]。

english: Don't interrupt adventurer.
translation: 别打扰冒险者。

english: Thank you so much, adventurer. We have defeated The Devourer; the plagues should abate now.
translation: 非常感谢你，冒险者。我们已经击败了吞噬者；瘟疫应该会平息了。

english: What? So I am. Somehow, I don't think this is over. The Devourer will not concede defeat so easily, after all.
translation: 什么？还真是。不知怎的，我觉得这事还没完。吞噬者毕竟不会轻易认输。

english: I will have no dealings with those who plunder the houses of the dead.
translation: 我不会与那些掠夺死者房屋的人打交道。

english: The only explanation I can think of is that some other adventurer has repeated your mistakes and has stolen a burial jar whilst we were here.
translation: 我能想到的唯一解释是，有别的冒险者重蹈了你的覆辙，趁我们在这里的时候偷走了一个葬瓮。

english: Nothing, nothing. You've done all you can.
translation: 没什么，没什么。你已经尽力了。

english: We must find the adventurer who has carried out this theft and get him to return the jar. Then, we will have to perform the ceremony again.
translation: 我们必须找到那个偷走瓮的冒险者，让他归还。然后我们还得重新举行仪式。

english: Well, until one of the sides give up, that is. Anyway, I have a gift for you back in town. But first, I have a few things to sort out here.
translation: 嗯，直到某一方放弃为止吧。总之，我在镇里为你准备了一份礼物。不过，我得先在这里处理一些事情。

english: Ah, there you are, [player name]. I've been waiting for you.
translation: 啊，你来了，[player name]。我一直在等你。

english: Oh no! What am I going to do? What am I going to do? Ummm, yes, I have it. Um...
translation: 哦不！我该怎么办？我该怎么办？嗯，对了，我想起来了。呃……

english: Um. What what?
translation: 呃。什……什么？

english: Well, um...you could try to avoid the traps?
translation: 嗯，呃……你可以试着避开陷阱？

english: Oh yes, how could I forget! The key to getting into the pyramid is to have a cat.
translation: 哦对，我怎么会忘记！进入金字塔的关键是有一只猫。

english: Hmmm... So, what do you want then.
translation: 嗯……那么，你想要什么？

english: Didn't the Sphinx tell you that cats act as guardians against The Devourer?
translation: 斯芬克斯没告诉过你猫是抵御吞噬者的守护者吗？

english: You're right, of course. Anyway, where did I put that trinket I promised you?
translation: 你说得对。总之，我答应给你的那个小玩意儿放哪儿了？

english: What, a burial jar?
translation: 什么，一个葬瓮？

english: Sorry, I'm still well...you know?
translation: 抱歉，我还是有点……你懂的？

english: You know...new.
translation: 你知道……新手。

english: It's my first week on the job and already I've had an outbreak of plagues, half the population has fled the town and, to top it off, some adventurer has desecrated the tomb of the old high priest.
translation: 这才是我上任的第一周，就爆发了瘟疫，一半居民逃离了城镇，更糟的是，还有冒险者亵渎了前任大祭司的陵墓。

english: Um...yes. That would be a good idea...wouldn't it?
translation: 嗯……对。那会是个好主意……对吧？

english: So, it stands to reason that only they should be able to open the pyramid door. Ask your cat for help when you intend to enter.
translation: 所以，按理说只有它们才能打开金字塔的门。想进去的时候，找你的猫帮忙。

english: You might be surprised to know that we wouldn't have been able to complete the ceremony without that in our presence, nor would you have been able to defeat The Wanderer's minion so easily.
translation: 你可能会惊讶地发现，没有它在场，我们根本无法完成仪式，你也不可能那么容易击败漫游者的爪牙。

english: Ummm, ah, well...um...
translation: 嗯，啊，呃……嗯……

english: By Icthlarin, they do and I will lead them.
translation: 以伊克哈林之名，他们确实如此，我会领导他们。

english: Because all the ceremonies haven't been completed yet and Klenter, the old high priest, grows weary of the mortal realm.
translation: 因为所有仪式还没完成，前任大祭司克伦特在凡界待得有些厌倦了。

english: Umm...I guess I forgot.
translation: 嗯……我想我忘了。

english: Actually, very little is left to be done. Most of the prayers have already been said but the embalmer still has a bit of work to do.
translation: 其实，剩下要做的事不多了。大部分祷告已经念完，但防腐师还有些活要干。

english: I need you to tell the carpenter to create a new holy symbol for the ceremony. Also, you should talk to the embalmer. I know that he's having problems getting supplies into town with the quarantine.
translation: 我需要你去告诉木匠，为仪式制作一个新的神圣护符。另外，你应该跟防腐师谈谈。我知道因为隔离，他的补给品运不进镇里。

english: Thank you, [player name]. You'll be handsomely rewarded for your services to Icthlarin.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。你对伊克哈林的效劳将得到丰厚回报。

english: I must thank you again; your victory over The Devourer's beast was magnificent.
translation: 我必须再次感谢你；你战胜吞噬者的野兽真是了不起。

english: Ah, yes, I have it here. I'm sure you'll get a huge amount of enjoyment out of it.
translation: 啊，对，我找到了。我相信你会从中获得极大的乐趣。

english: It's only a pity that we haven't won an outright victory over her. Well, I'll just have to get used to these spots and the sour milk the cows are producing, not to mention those darned frogs outside.
translation: 只可惜我们没能彻底战胜她。唉，我得习惯这些斑点，以及奶牛产的酸牛奶，更别提外面那些该死的青蛙了。

english: I have my own preparations to make, but could you help out the town's carpenter and embalmer?
translation: 我自己也要做准备了，但你能帮帮镇上的木匠和防腐师吗？

english: I don't know how you managed to get word to our citizens, but I am very grateful.
translation: 我不知道你是怎么把消息传给我们的市民的，但我非常感激。

english: If you rub this lamp, it will increase your combat stats. Be aware that it only has two wishes, rather than the traditional three.
translation: 如果你擦亮这盏灯，它会提升你的战斗属性。注意，它只有两个愿望，而不是传统的三个。

english: Someone just stole our relic, this is a disaster! Adventurer, you must find the fool who put that teleport beacon on the altar.
translation: 有人偷了我们的遗物，这简直是灾难！冒险者，你必须找到那个把传送信标放在祭坛上的傻瓜。

english: Well at least you're honest about it, but where did you get it from?
translation: 至少你够诚实，但你从哪里弄来的？

english: Those orbs are volatile, they use some very old magic, no worshipper of Saradomin would dare touch one. You must return to this monk and find out more, but be wary.
translation: 那些球体很不稳定，它们使用非常古老的魔法，没有萨拉多明的信徒敢碰一个。你必须回去找那个僧侣了解更多情况，但要小心。

english: This is not good, that relic was part of an ancient artefact which was said to have awesome power. You must report to Sir Tiffy in Falador, he must be informed.
translation: 这可不妙，那件遗物是一个古老神器的一部分，据说拥有强大的力量。你必须向法拉多城的蒂菲爵士报告，他必须知道此事。

english: Have you found our relic yet?
translation: 你找到我们的遗物了吗？

english: It never ends; as soon as I think we have it won, The Devourer catches us off our guard again.
translation: 这没完没了；每当我以为我们赢了的时候，'吞噬者'就会再次打我们一个措手不及。

english: Likewise, [player name], in your adventures.
translation: 也祝你好运，[player name]，在你的冒险中。

english: In that case, be sure to talk to Jex. He looks after the building and can tell you all about the place.
translation: 这样的话，一定要跟杰克斯谈谈。他负责照看这栋建筑，能告诉你所有相关的事情。

english: Yes, there is a shrine dedicated to Scabaras in the Temple of the Lesser Gods in the north-east of the city.
translation: 是的，在城东北的次等神明神殿里，有一座供奉斯卡巴拉斯的神龛。

english: Yes, the followers of Scabaras used to be great architects of the subterranean. According to legend, they once planned to build a passage under the river Elid. No doubt Elidinis smote them, because none of
translation: 是的，斯卡巴拉斯的信徒曾是地下世界的大建筑师。据传说，他们曾计划在埃利德河下修建一条通道。毫无疑问，埃利迪尼斯惩罚了他们，因为再也没有

english: The Sect of Scabaras: a cult dedicated to the lesser deity, Scabaras.
translation: 斯卡巴拉斯教派：一个崇拜次级神明斯卡巴拉斯的邪教。

english: Well, the followers of The Devourer shunned the light, but all her temples have been destroyed. Though there was also the Sect of Scabaras.
translation: 嗯，吞噬者的信徒躲避光明，但她所有的神殿都已被摧毁。不过，还有斯卡巴拉斯教派。

english: He is the husband of Elidinis, father of both Icthlarin and The Devourer, and the head of the pantheon of gods.
translation: 他是埃利迪尼斯的丈夫，伊克哈林和吞噬者的父亲，也是众神之首。

english: No. All Tumeken's children and their followers revel in the light these days.
translation: 没有。现在图梅肯的所有子女及其信徒都陶醉于光明之中。

english: None that I know of; if there was, it would probably be guarded.
translation: 据我所知没有；如果有，恐怕也会受到严密守卫。

english: I don't know. I think I'll leave that up to you.
translation: 我不知道。我想这个还是由你来决定吧。

english: That would solve part of our problems, but a large number of our townsfolk are in Menaphos. We must get word to them that it's safe to return.
translation: 那只能解决我们部分问题，但很多镇民都在麦纳法斯。我们必须通知他们可以安全返回了。

english: The Menaphites are led by a more secular ruler than I would like. Respect for the old ways is diminishing.
translation: 麦纳法斯人受制于一位比我期望的更世俗的统治者。对旧有方式的尊敬正在消退。

english: You have proved that the plagues aren't contagious, so we must try to lift the quarantine that Menaphos has imposed on us.
translation: 你已经证明瘟疫不具有传染性，所以我们必须设法解除麦纳法斯对我们施加的隔离。

english: I don't have a clue. I've already tried to meet with them and we were rebuffed in a most unpleasant fashion.
translation: 我一点头绪都没有。我已经试图与他们会面，却被极不愉快地拒绝了。

english: Greetings, Coenus.
translation: 你好，科努斯。

english: I have a feeling this could prove a somewhat hazardous quest for you and I'm not even sure where you would start. However, if you are happy dealing with our woes, we would, of course, be grateful.
translation: 我感觉这对你来说可能是个相当危险的任务，我甚至不确定该从哪里开始。不过，如果你愿意帮我们解决这些麻烦，我们当然会心存感激。

english: I led a delegation across the bridge but we were allowed no further.
translation: 我带领一个代表团过了桥，但他们不准我们再往前走了。

english: I'm glad you want to help, but how exactly to continue, I don't know.
translation: 我很高兴你想帮忙，但具体该如何继续，我也不知道。

english: the followers were ever seen again.
translation: 信徒们就再也没出现过。

english: From the loins of his subconscious Apmeken was born into reality, a physical manifestation of his dream. Tumeken continued to have pleasant dreams for a further two days and two nights. After each, a new
translation: 从他的潜意识深处，阿普梅肯诞生于现实，是他梦境的一个物理具现。图梅肯又继续做了两天两夜的美梦。每场梦之后，一个新的

english: You will let us pass. We are not contagious.
translation: 你会让我们过去的。我们不具有传染性。

english: Have you helped the embalmer and the carpenter to get all they need yet?
translation: 你帮防腐师和木匠搞到他们需要的东西了吗？

english: Perhaps you should go and check back with him. I'm probably going to leave for the ceremonial room soon, to get things underway.
translation: 也许你该回去跟他确认一下。我可能很快就要离开去仪式厅，好让事情进行下去。

english: Protect us from The Devourer's minion.
translation: 从吞噬者的爪牙手中保护我们。

english: Can you please hurry up? The people are begining to...erm...
translation: 你能快点吗？人们开始……呃……

english: Um...well, no, just my authority. Don't forget that to enter the pyramid, you need a cat.
translation: 嗯……好吧，不，只是我的权威。别忘了，要进入金字塔，你需要一只猫。

english: Do hurry up; I'm being driven demented with these infernal spots.
translation: 快点吧；我被这些该死的斑点逼得快疯了。

english: Please hurry, it can't be allowed into the wrong hands.
translation: 请快点，不能让它落入坏人手中。

english: Oh no! What a shame. Have you tried looking for it?
translation: 哦不！太可惜了。你试着找过它吗？

english: I'm sorry, I have no more left. Perhaps you could ask the Sphinx; she could well have a spare one and, from what I've gathered, she seems to have taken a liking to you.
translation: 抱歉，我这边没有了。也许你可以问问斯芬克斯；她很可能有多余的，而且据我了解，她似乎挺喜欢你的。

english: If you return with some space in your pack, I'll supply you with some sort of reward.
translation: 如果你背包有了空位再回来，我会给你一些奖励。

english: Hurry and report to Sir Tiffy.
translation: 快去向蒂菲爵士报告。

english: I doubt Coenus would let his mother over the bridge without threating to fill her full of arrows.
translation: 我怀疑科努斯不会让他母亲过桥，除非她威胁要射满她一身箭。

english: Don't. Coenus and his men may be cold-blooded thugs, but they are our brethren and, besides, they are just following orders.
translation: 别这样。科努斯和他的手下也许是冷血暴徒，但他们是我们的同胞，况且他们只是在执行命令。

english: I doubt it; they keep the bridge brightly lit at all times.
translation: 我不这么认为；他们让桥始终保持灯火通明。

english: They guard the bridge all day and night; we've looked into this route.
translation: 他们日夜守卫那座桥；我们已经考虑过这条路了。

english: There are probably gaps in the walls, but if the current doesn't kill you, the crocodiles will.
translation: 墙上可能有些缺口，但如果水流没杀死你，鳄鱼也会。

english: Get thee gone from my presence.
translation: 离开我的视线。

english: Ask away; any hope is better than none.
translation: 问吧；任何希望都比没有强。

english: Have you spoken with Jex yet?
translation: 你跟杰克斯谈过了吗？

english: I'm afraid you have benefitted all you can from these lamps.
translation: 恐怕这些灯你已经没法再获益了。

english: He should be outside the Temple of the Lesser Gods in the north-east corner of the city. He knows a large amount about the building.
translation: 他应该在城东北角的次等神明神殿外面。他对那栋建筑了解很多。

english: Don't worry; you'll be handsomely rewarded.
translation: 别担心；你会得到丰厚报酬的。

english: It's none of those things and it's of no monetary value whatsoever.
translation: 它既不是那些东西，也毫无金钱价值。

english: To quote someone else, 'all that glitters is not gold'.
translation: 引用别人的话：‘闪光的并不都是金子’。

english: I have?
translation: 我有吗？

english: Oh, just listen. What I'm offering you is something a bit different but quite useful, nonetheless. So, will you help or not?
translation: 哦，听着就行了。我要给你的是个有点不同但挺有用的东西。所以，你到底帮不帮忙？

english: I have nearly completed my preparations too. I will probably see you inside the ceremonial room in the pyramid.
translation: 我的准备也差不多完成了。我大概会在金字塔里的仪式厅见到你。

english: Ummm... So you have.
translation: 嗯……确实如此。

english: You already have a lantern; greed isn't good, you know.
translation: 你已经有一个灯笼了；贪心可不好，你知道。

english: Now that you mention it, there is that dastardly character, Simon Templeton, who is encouraging adventurers to thieve from one of the old, great pyramids to the north-east of the city walls.
translation: 既然你提到了，确实有个叫西蒙.坦普尔顿的可恶家伙，他正在怂恿冒险者从城墙东北方向一座古老的大金字塔里偷东西。

english: Of course. We Menaphites are believers in many gods.
translation: 当然。我们麦纳法斯人信仰众多神明。

english: I haven't heard anything more since my people returned. Ask them, if you're curious about Menaphos.
translation: 自从我的人回来后，我就没再听到更多消息了。如果你对麦纳法斯感到好奇，去问问他们吧。

english: Any luck with getting news to our people in Menaphos?
translation: 给我们在麦纳法斯的人传消息有什么进展吗？

english: No need for thanks. Sadly, this view isn't taken by all Menaphite sects.
translation: 不用谢。遗憾的是，并非所有麦纳法斯教派都持这种看法。

english: I, in my position as head priest of Icthlarin, still give praise to Tumeken and Elidinis each day at this very altar.
translation: 我作为伊克哈林的大祭司，仍然每天在这个祭坛上赞美图梅肯和埃利迪尼斯。

english: As I feared, our tribulations will continue unabated and we are without hope.
translation: 正如我所担心的，我们的苦难将继续有增无减，我们毫无希望。

english: I know not adventurer, it was just a myth I was told as a young boy. Perhaps somewhere icey?
translation: 我不知道，冒险者，这只是我小时候听说的一个传说。也许在某个寒冷的地方？

english: I would reward you but, by the looks of you, I doubt you could carry any more baggage.
translation: 我本想奖励你，但看你这副模样，我怀疑你再也拿不动更多东西了。

english: There is a room to the north of the pyramid containing a number of jars. That is its rightful place.
translation: 金字塔北边有个房间，里面放着一些罐子。那里才是它该待的地方。

english: Would you return it to its rightful place if I gave it to you?
translation: 如果我把它交给你，你愿意把它放回原处吗？

english: I gave him an almighty shoeing and ran him out of the town.
translation: 我狠狠教训了他一顿，把他赶出了镇子。

english: What am I thinking? Of course not, no. It's just the man annoys me so much.
translation: 我在想什么呢？当然不是，不是。只是那家伙太让我恼火了。

english: Oh dear, oh dear. What do you intend to do with it?
translation: 哎呀呀，哎呀呀。你打算拿它做什么？

english: What kind of jar? A burial jar?
translation: 什么样的罐子？一个葬罐？

english: You don't mean...this jar?The priest shows you the Canopic jar which you hadpreviously been holding.
translation: 你该不会是说……这个罐子吧？祭司向你展示了你之前拿着的那个卡诺皮克罐。

english: By the time I found out about what he was up to, it was already too late to recover most of the artefacts.
translation: 等我发现他在搞什么鬼的时候，已经来不及追回大部分文物了。

english: He pilfered so many things from our city when he came here claiming to work for the Museum of Varrock.
translation: 他当初来我们这里，声称是为维洛克城博物馆工作，结果偷走了我们城里那么多东西。

english: He had sold them on to private collectors.
translation: 他把它们都卖给了私人收藏家。

english: The town is getting back to normal, thanks to you.
translation: 多亏了你，小镇正在恢复正常。

english: We're doing a bit. Having Nardah and Pollnivneach nearby helps and we're also getting a lot of trade from adventurers these days.
translation: 我们还算有点起色。附近有那尔达城和波尼尼镇帮忙，而且最近从冒险者那里也接到了不少生意。

english: The bank under the Temple of the Lesser Gods has reopened and a number of our merchants have reopened their stalls.
translation: 次级神庙地下的银行已经重新开放，我们不少商人也重新开张了。

english: Still I look forward to when the city opens its gates to us again.
translation: 不过，我仍然期待着这座城市能再次向我们敞开大门。

english: Of course not. Forget I mentioned him.
translation: 当然不。忘了我提过他吧。

english: Stop wasting my time; can't you see I'm trying to put a stop to this plague?
translation: 别浪费我的时间了；你没看到我正在努力阻止这场瘟疫吗？

english: So much for Gielinor's greatest adventurer.
translation: 吉列诺最伟大的冒险者也不过如此。

english: May these seeds spring up fruitfully for you!
translation: 愿这些种子为你结出丰硕的果实！

english: Perhaps you'd like some runes for your trouble?
translation: 也许你想要一些符文来感谢你的帮忙？

english: This plague of spots is a divine burden placed on us, which no amount of alchemy or potion-mixing will ease.
translation: 这场斑点瘟疫是加诸于我们身上的神圣负担，任何炼金术或药水调配都无法缓解。

english: Certainly, though try to be more careful with this one.
translation: 当然可以，不过这次要小心一点。

english: You have no space, so I'm afraid I can't help you.
translation: 你没有空间了，所以恐怕我帮不了你。

english: Outta my way!
translation: 别挡路！

english: Master says move this rock, move that rock. I said no, much more fun to smash 'em. Master didn't like that. Kicked me into lava. I obey for now.
translation: 主人说搬这块石头，搬那块石头。我说不，砸碎它们有趣多了。主人不喜欢那样。把我踢进熔岩里。我现在先听话。

english: For now?
translation: 先听话？

english: One day I get big revenge. Masters lair will be mine!
translation: 总有一天我会报大仇。主人的巢穴会是我的！

english: Methinks redecorate. More cages, more skulls.
translation: 我想要重新装修。更多笼子，更多头骨。

english: More skulls?
translation: 更多头骨？

english: Of course! You not like yours? Make donation?
translation: 当然！你不喜欢你的吗？捐一个？

english: Erm... Not right now.
translation: 呃……现在不要。

english: Urgh... So... Heavy... But toiling makes me big and strong like master, yes?
translation: 呃……好……重……但苦干能让我变得像主人一样又大又强壮，对吧？

english: Please... N...No more kicking...
translation: 求你了……别……别再踢了……

english: Where did I need to take this?
translation: 我需要把这个拿到哪里去？

english: Can't wait to start smashing again...
translation: 等不及要开始再砸东西了……

english: Feel the burn!
translation: 感受燃烧吧！

english: I smell human...
translation: 我闻到人类的味道……

english: If I deliver this in time, master won't give me the hoof!
translation: 如果我按时送到这个，主人就不会踢我了！

english: Hurry hurry!
translation: 快快快！

english: So much to do. So little time.
translation: 事真多。时间真少。

english: Me not deserve this treatment.
translation: 我不该受这种待遇。

english: So tired...
translation: 好累……

english: Must work hard. Mustn't get clobbered.
translation: 得努力工作。不能挨揍。

english: Maybe master wants this one!
translation: 也许主人想要这个！

english: Soon me get revenge...
translation: 我很快就会报仇……

english: Mind... Over... Matter!
translation: 意志……战胜……物质！

english: Me remember everything, me not forget faces.
translation: 我记得一切，我不会忘记脸。

english: Did I pick up the right relic?
translation: 我拿对遗物了吗？

english: Time to lift stuff!
translation: 该举东西了！

english: Hey, you're hitting my half of the relic!
translation: 嘿，你打到我这边的遗物了！

english: So what?
translation: 那又怎样？

english: So that'smyhalf! That's what!
translation: 所以这是我的那一半！就是这样！

english: If it's your half, why am I hitting it?
translation: 如果是你的，为什么我在打？

english: Grrrrr! I hate working with you.
translation: 唔！我讨厌和你一起工作。

english: Maybe you go take a break, then I can smash the whole thing!
translation: 也许你去休息一下，这样我就能砸烂整个东西了！

english: Maybe I hit you instead!
translation: 也许我改打你！

english: You don't have the guts!
translation: 你没那个胆子！

english: I'll show you!
translation: 我证明给你看！

english: What you two need is some conflict resolution!
translation: 你们两个需要的是解决冲突！

english: Mind your own business!
translation: 少管闲事！

english: Yeah! Keep your eyes off our relic!
translation: 对！别盯着我们的遗物看！

english: I have an idea...
translation: 我有个主意……

english: Let's hit them instead!
translation: 我们打他们吧！

english: Good plan!
translation: 好主意！

english: Nevermind...
translation: 算了……

english: This looks so much better already!
translation: 这个看起来已经好多了！

english: Keep going! Hit harder!
translation: 继续！打重点！

english: We can flickedy flam these stones better than anyone else! A-boom-boom-boom!
translation: 我们处理这些石头比谁都厉害！嘣-嘣-嘣！

english: Do you feel the rhythm? Start dancing, human!
translation: 你感觉到节奏了吗？开始跳舞吧，人类！

english: Look at me going!
translation: 看我多厉害！

english: Wow, terrible!
translation: 哇，真差劲！

english: Worst moves me ever see!
translation: 我从没见过这么烂的舞步！

english: Absolutely no way am I dancing for you!
translation: 我绝对不会为你跳舞！

english: Grrr.
translation: 唔。

english: We make you dance one day, somehow...
translation: 总有一天我们会让你跳舞的，不管用什么办法……

english: Me know humans don't like pointy sticks!
translation: 我知道人类不喜欢尖棍子！

english: Ooh yes, we prod them good!
translation: 哦对，我们要好好戳他们！

english: Hi there little fella, what's on that scroll?
translation: 嘿，小家伙，那卷轴上写着什么？

english: Dezyogton? What's that mean? Me too stupid to read.
translation: 德佐格顿？那是什么意思？我太笨了读不懂。

english: Can I take a look at that scroll?
translation: 我能看看那个卷轴吗？

english: I suppose so! Heh.
translation: 我想可以吧！嘿。

english: Terrible handwriting, I can see why you're struggling.
translation: 字写得真烂，难怪你看不懂。

english: Struggling? Me's a foolish little imp! Of course me struggle!
translation: 看不懂？我是个愚蠢的小恶魔！当然看不懂啦！

english: It says destruction.
translation: 上面写的是毁灭。

english: Ohhhhhh!
translation: 噢噢噢噢！

english: It says destruction of the mortal mind.
translation: 上面写的是毁灭凡人的心智。

english: It does? What else does it say? Keep reading.
translation: 是吗？还写了什么？念下去。

english: Erm... In full, it says that reading this scroll will cause destruction of the mortal mind.
translation: 呃……完整的写着，阅读此卷轴将导致凡人心智毁灭。

english: Oh really? That's not good! You probably shouldn't have read it! Teehee!
translation: 哦真的吗？那可不太好！你大概不该读它！嘻嘻！

english: It also says that I stink?
translation: 上面还说我很臭？

english: You sure do! Hahaha!
translation: 你确实很臭！哈哈哈！

english: Sitting by the fire, reading my favourite scroll, this is the life!
translation: 坐在火边，读着我最喜欢的卷轴，这才是生活！

english: What is your favourite scroll?
translation: 你最喜欢的卷轴是什么？

english: It's called 'an introduction to flaying'. I like the pictures.
translation: 叫做《剥皮入门》。我喜欢里面的插图。

english: Oh deary me.
translation: 哦，我的天哪。

english: This is pointless. I should be stealing things.
translation: 这真没意思。我该去偷东西。

english: I'll throw this into lava soon...
translation: 我很快就会把这个扔进熔岩里……

english: B? No, that's a D...
translation: B？不，那是D……

english: Argh. I can't make sense of these symbols!
translation: 啊。我搞不懂这些符号！

english: Do I really need to be able to read?
translation: 我真的需要会识字吗？

english: Hop! Hop! Take that you stupid rock!
translation: 跳！跳！接招吧，你这蠢石头！

english: Why are you doing that?
translation: 你干嘛呢？

english: Me wrecky relic! Me wrecky relic! Hahaha!
translation: 我在砸遗物！我在砸遗物！哈哈哈！

english: Bouncy bouncy!
translation: 蹦蹦跳跳！

english: Having fun down there?
translation: 下面玩得开心吗？

english: Oh, such a good time!
translation: 哦，太开心了！

english: Higher!
translation: 再高些！

english: Oh no, is the relic starting to break? Oops!
translation: 哦不，遗物要开始裂了吗？哎呀！

english: I can jump higher than you all!
translation: 我比你们所有人都跳得高！

english: Hop hop hop!
translation: 跳跳跳！

english: Break 'em all!
translation: 全砸碎！

english: Watch me!
translation: 看着我！

english: Nope, that book's a bit too magical for my likes. If you don't want to carry it, maybe give it to someone else.
translation: 不，那本书对我来说有点太魔法了。如果你不想拿着它，也许可以给别人。

english: Oooh no, I wouldn't want to cross a Fremennik. You'll have to solve this one yourself.
translation: 哦不不，我可不想得罪弗瑞曼尼人。你得自己解决这个问题了。

english: Eww, keep that thing away from me; I don't wanna get infected.
translation: 呃，把那东西拿远点；我可不想被感染。

english: Get out of it! You ain't comming in here to get our blood or our food!
translation: 滚出去！你休想进来抢我们的血或食物！

english: Blimey, did you see that? He put some food in the chest for us! He's probably not after anything!
translation: 哎呀，你看到了吗？他往箱子里放了食物！他大概不是来搞鬼的！

english: Blimey, did you see that? She put some food in the chest for us! She's probably not after anything!
translation: 哎呀，你看到了吗？她往箱子里放了食物！她大概不是来搞鬼的！

english: Your probably one of them stinking vampyres in disguise! You ain't coming in!
translation: 你八成是那些臭吸血鬼假扮的！不准进来！

english: Hey! Stay away from our stuff!
translation: 嘿！离我们的东西远点！

english: Hey, we're all wondering what you put in that chest...
translation: 嘿，我们都想知道你往那箱子里放了什么……

english: It's really good of you to put something in that chest for us!
translation: 你给我们往箱子里放东西，真是太好了！

english: Oh, my name's Florin. I just help out around here, you know, looking for food and so on.
translation: 哦，我叫弗洛林。我就在这儿帮帮忙，找找食物什么的。

english: Not that it makes much difference but my name's Florin. Like all the other survivors here, I just try to make do and get through each day at a time.
translation: 虽然说了也没多大区别，但我的名字是弗洛林。和其他幸存者一样，我只是尽力应付，一天天活下去。

english: My name's Florin. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Just try to survive really, there's nothing much else we can do.
translation: 我叫弗洛林。什么都干一点。真的只是为了活下去，我们也没什么别的能做的。

english: Blimey, did you see that? He put some food in the casket for us! He's probably not after anything!
translation: 哎呀，你看到了吗？他往宝箱里放了食物！他大概不是来搞鬼的！

english: Blimey, did you see that? She put some food in the casket for us! She's probably not after anything!
translation: 哎呀，你看到了吗？她往宝箱里放了食物！她大概不是来搞鬼的！

english: I'd go and have a chat with him again if I were you.
translation: 我要是你，就再去跟他聊聊。

english: Oh, that's nice, but weren't you helping out Aurel?
translation: 哦，那挺好的，不过你不是在帮奥雷尔的忙吗？

english: I thought you were helping Aurel with something? Perhaps fixing up his store?
translation: 我以为你在帮奥雷尔忙什么事？也许是在修他的店？

english: Well, it would look a lot nicer if someone managed to fix up the general store I think.
translation: 嗯，要是有人能把杂货店修好，那看起来会好很多。

english: Hi there. You've done a good job on that general store.
translation: 嗨，你把那家杂货店修得不错。

english: I'd go and have a chat with him if I were you.
translation: 我要是你，就去跟他聊聊。

english: I thought you were helping out Aurel the store owner? You should go and talk to him.
translation: 我以为你在帮那个店主奥雷尔？你应该去跟他谈谈。

english: Imagine how nice it would be to have a warm fire for a change? I just hope they start to stock some tinderboxes!
translation: 想象一下能换个暖和的火堆该有多好？我只希望他们开始进一些打火匣！

english: It's looking a lot better now that the general store is fixed up. That said, it really needs some stock I think.
translation: 杂货店修好之后，看起来好多了。不过话说回来，我觉得它真的需要进点货。

english: It's getting to be quite nice now with the general store. There's still more work to do though.
translation: 有了杂货店之后，这里变得相当不错了。不过还有很多工作要做。

english: I take no orders from food sacks like you, Guile. Attend to this yourself. In any case, he wasn't much of a punch bag anyway.
translation: 我不会听从像你这样装食物的麻袋的命令，Guile。你自己去处理吧。反正他也不是什么像样的沙袋。

english: Though if you wish to do this, I'm afraid you'll need to aquire the weapons yourself. My efforts to procure them have been rather unsuccesful.
translation: 不过如果你想这么做，恐怕你得自己去弄武器。我设法获取它们的努力相当不成功。

english: I take no orders from food sacks like you, Guile. Attend to this yourself. In any case, she wasn't much of a punch bag anyway.
translation: 我不会听从像你这样装食物的麻袋的命令，Guile。你自己去处理吧。反正她也不是什么像样的沙袋。

english: I hear there's a boatman in Mort'ton who knows where to find them. You'll find the town south of here, through Mort Myre. It's a nasty place, but where isn't in Morytania?
translation: 我听说莫顿镇有个船夫知道在哪里能找到它们。你往南穿过莫尔迈尔就能找到那个镇。那是个糟糕的地方，但莫利塔尼亚哪里不糟糕呢？

english: No one knows for sure how many of them there are. The group hiding in Mory Myre supposedly has six members. There's whispers of more of them in other parts of Morytania though.
translation: 没人确切知道他们有多少人。躲在莫尔迈尔的那个团体据说有六个人。不过有传言说莫利塔尼亚其他地区还有更多。

english: How dare you trespass in my castle! You'll pay for this.
translation: 你竟敢闯入我的城堡！你会为此付出代价。

english: Ha! So we meet again, crath biber111. Prepare to die!
translation: 哈！我们又见面了，crath biber111。准备受死吧！

english: Didn't you hear me? I said they're draining my blood, that's what they're doing!
translation: 你没听见吗？我说他们在抽我的血，这就是他们在做的事！

english: Do I need to explain it all again? Stand in line ready to pay your blood tithe!
translation: 要我再说一遍吗？排好队准备缴纳血税！

english: Hello there [player name]. How are things going?
translation: 你好，[player name]。事情进展得怎么样？

english: There should be some spare disguises in the chest in the corner.
translation: 角落的箱子里应该有一些备用的伪装服。

english: The humans here live like cattle with the vampyres taking regular blood tithes to keep themselves fed. All in all, it's a dire place. Though we hope to change that.
translation: 这里的人类像牲畜一样生活，吸血鬼定期收取血税来维持自己的生计。总而言之，这是一个可怕的地方。不过我们希望改变这一切。

english: You need to bring me a full vyrewatch disguise. I can't work without every piece of it.
translation: 你需要给我带来一套完整的吸血鬼哨兵伪装服。缺少任何一件我都无法工作。

english: Maybe. I guess we'll find out soon enough. Myreque prevail.
translation: 也许吧。我想我们很快就会知道了。迈雷克必胜。

english: Once you've made some room in your inventory, I can give you the finished disguise.
translation: 等你在背包里腾出一些空间，我就可以把做好的伪装服给你。

english: Hello there. You probably should be over with Safalaan, Veliaf and Vanescula.
translation: 你好。你大概应该去萨法拉恩、维利亚夫和瓦内斯库拉那边。

english: [player name]. I think Safalaan, Veliaf and the vampyre want to talk to you.
translation: [player name]。我想萨法拉恩、维利亚夫和那个吸血鬼想和你谈谈。

english: Well met, [player name]. I see you have your weapon.
translation: 幸会，[player name]。我看到你带着武器了。

english: Of course, ask away.
translation: 当然，尽管问吧。

english: Damn them vampyres. We need to find a way to turn things in our favour.
translation: 该死的吸血鬼。我们得想办法扭转局势。

english: And formerly, sister to Ranis Drakan, before [player name] here came along.
translation: 而且，在[player name]出现之前，她曾是拉尼斯.德雷坎的妹妹。

english: Hmm. Well [player name] has to go with you. I want her there in case Vanescula here tries anything.
translation: 嗯。好吧，[player name]得跟你一起去。我要她在场，以防瓦内斯库拉耍什么花招。

english: Assuming the vampyres haven't put an end to them, there should be another group of Myreque operating in the region. We will need their support in the fight against the vampyres.
translation: 假设吸血鬼还没把他们赶尽杀绝，这个地区应该还有另一支迈雷克在活动。我们需要他们的支持来对抗吸血鬼。

english: Not at the moment, I'm afraid. We need someone with a little more experience. Come back when you've trained up a bit.
translation: 恐怕现在不行。我们需要更有经验的人。等你多训练一下再回来吧。

english: Good work. You should put it to use as soon as you can.
translation: 干得好。你应该尽快把它用上。

english: Good job. We'll still need to make sure another can't continue Kroy's work, however.
translation: 干得好。不过我们还得确保没有其他人能继续克罗伊的工作。

english: Good idea. That should put a permanent stop to this.
translation: 好主意。这应该能一劳永逸地解决这个问题。

english: Vanstrom is a menace. It's a good idea to keep an eye on him. Keep up the good work.
translation: 范斯特罗姆是个祸害。盯着他是个好主意。继续好好干。

english: Well you let us know if you need us.
translation: 如果你需要我们，就告诉我们。

english: Hmm, well it certainly looks very authentic. But there doesn't seem to be any enchantment on it, either mortal or devine. Perhaps there is a step of the process you have not completed yet?
translation: 嗯，看起来确实很逼真。但上面似乎没有任何凡人或是神圣的附魔。也许你还有某个步骤没完成？

english: Well met friend. Ready to help with that investigation?
translation: 幸会，朋友。准备好帮忙调查了吗？

english: That's not good. Anything we can do to help?
translation: 那可不好。有什么我们能帮忙的吗？

english: Well we're here if you need us.
translation: 我们就在这儿，需要的话就找我们。

english: Retreat? That's not like Safalaan. Things must be bad. Let me know if you need our help.
translation: 撤退？这可不像萨法兰的作风。情况一定很糟。如果需要帮忙就告诉我。

english: Tell me Drezel, where is Ivan?
translation: 告诉我，德雷泽尔，伊万在哪里？

english: Amazing! At times I wasn't even sure this would ever be possible. Good work, [player name].
translation: 太棒了！有时候我甚至不确定这能不能成。干得好，[player name]。

english: Not right now. Don't worry, you'll be the first to know if we need anything.
translation: 现在不行。别担心，如果需要什么，你是第一个知道的。

english: Hmm. Maybe he's hiding something. I'd have a good look around if I were you.
translation: 嗯。也许他隐瞒了什么。如果我是你，我会好好搜查一番。

english: Hang on. You don't seem to have your Ivandis Flail with you. You'll need it for this fight.

translation: 又见面了，冒险者。是什么风把你吹来了？

english: Wonderful! I just hope Romeo can remember to get me from the crypt.
translation: 太棒了！我只希望罗密欧能记得从墓穴里接我出来。

english: Romeo, Romeo, wherefore art thou Romeo? Bold adventurer, have you seen Romeo on your travels? Skinny guy, a bit wishy washy, head full of poetry.
translation: 罗密欧，罗密欧，为什么你是罗密欧？勇敢的冒险者，你在旅途中见过罗密欧吗？一个瘦弱的家伙，有点优柔寡断，满脑子都是诗歌。

english: Yes, that sounds like Romeo. I'd be very grateful if you could deliver a message to him?
translation: 是的，听起来像罗密欧。如果你能帮我带个口信给他，我会非常感激的？

english: Oh, that would be so wonderful of you!  I'd be most grateful if you could please deliver a message to him?
translation: 哦，那真是太好了！如果你能帮我带个口信给他，我将不胜感激？

english: He has his good points, he's not obsessed with fighting, magic and ranging at least.
translation: 他有他的优点，至少他不沉迷于战斗、魔法和远程攻击。

english: He's a very different sort of man. Even if he is a bit confused and soppy, he's my confused and soppy lover, and I wait patiently until we're together.
translation: 他是个非常与众不同的男人。即使他有点糊涂和多愁善感，他也是我那个糊涂又多愁善感的爱人，我会耐心等待，直到我们在一起。

english: Oh, well that's a shame, I was hoping that you might deliver a message to him for me.
translation: 哦，那真可惜，我本来希望你能帮我带个口信给他。

english: Before I swig this potion down, let me stand on the balcony so that I might see the sun one last time before I am commited to the crypt.
translation: 在我喝下这瓶药水之前，让我站在阳台上，这样我就能在被关进墓穴之前最后一次看到太阳。

english: Oh, he's so lovely...in his own soppy and confused way. You should spot him easily! He's usually fending off the advances of the Varrockian market women. Are you sure I couldn't persuade you to deliver my itsy bitsty

english: widdle message to my Romeo?
