english: Oh dear, that will be the ruin of our love. Well, I will just stay here and worry. You unromantic soul.
translation: 哦，天哪，那会毁了我们爱情的。好吧，我就待在这里担心吧。你这个不懂浪漫的家伙。

english: Quickly! Go and tell Romeo the plan!
translation: 快！去告诉罗密欧这个计划！

english: I don't care to drink that stuff again my friend...
translation: 我不想再喝那东西了，我的朋友……

english: Many thanks! Oh, i'm so very grateful. You may be our only hope.
translation: 非常感谢！哦，我太感激了。你可能是我们唯一的希望了。

english: I'd be most grateful if you could please deliver a message to him?
translation: 如果你能帮我带个口信给他，我将不胜感激？

english: Then, I will not keep you from them. Goodbye.
translation: 那么，我就不耽误你了。再见。

english: I'll pay you 360 points for one of those.
translation: 我愿意用 360 积分换你其中一个。

english: I don't want that.
translation: 我不想要那个。

english: Sorry, I don't accept returns on that item.
translation: 抱歉，那件物品我不接受退货。

english: I'll pay you 128 points for one of those.
translation: 我愿意用 128 积分换你其中一个。

english: I'm afraid I'm not offering you anything for that. Throw it away or cast an Alchemy spell on it if you don't want it.
translation: 恐怕我不会为那个给你任何东西。如果你不想要，就扔掉或者对它施个炼金术吧。

english: I'll pay you 400 points for one of those.
translation: 我愿意用 400 积分换你其中一个。

english: Hey, I'm Justine. I've got some wewawds hewe fowfightews who've done weww in Lisa's Last Man Standinggame. Wanna see?
translation: 嘿，我是贾斯汀。我这里有给那些在莉莎的最后一战里表现出色的拳手们准备的武器。想看看吗？

english: Well hello there, what can I do for you?
translation: 嗯你好，我能为你做什么？

english: My name is Kaiquir, I look after this canoe station.
translation: 我叫凯奎尔，我负责这个独木舟站点。

english: I see, that explains why you are out here.
translation: 我明白了，这就解释了为什么你在这里。

english: Indeed, can't have people ruining the canoe station so close to our home. Want to know more about canoes?
translation: 确实，不能让人们破坏离我们家这么近的独木舟站点。想了解更多关于独木舟的信息吗？

english: Unfortunately, you do not look like you have the skills to make a canoe at the moment. You will need to become a bit more skilled with the axe.
translation: 不幸的是，你目前看起来没有制作独木舟的技能。你需要在使用斧头方面变得更熟练一些。

english: Once you are a more seasoned woodsman, you will be able to make a canoe to travel the river.
translation: 一旦你成为一个更有经验的伐木工，你就能制作独木舟在河上旅行。

english: Certainly, use your axe to chop this tree down here. Then cut it into a canoe, it's really simple.
translation: 当然，用你的斧头砍倒这棵树。然后把它砍成独木舟，真的很简单。

english: Unfortunately, you will not be able to turn it into one of the more reliable canoes just yet.
translation: 你还不能把它做成更可靠的独木舟

english: By looking at you and your demeanor with an axe, you don't have the necessary skills for that. You'll only be able to go to the next stop.
translation: 从你和你的斧头使用方式来看，你还没有必要的技能。你只能到达下一站。

english: By the looks of it, you can make a reasonable canoe with your skills. You should be able to make a dugout.
translation: 凭你的技能，你应该能制作一个不错的独木舟，比如一个独木舟。

english: Most likely about two stops before it sinks.
translation: 很可能在沉没前能走两站。

english: Interesting, you look like the type of person who could make a decent canoe.
translation: 有趣，你看起来像是能制作出像样独木舟的人。

english: Quite far, but not the whole way down the river.
translation: 相当远，但并不是整条河全程。

english: Oh my, you are a seasoned woodsman are you not? You should have no problem crafting the finest canoes that will get you anywhere along the river!
translation: 哦天哪，你是个经验丰富的伐木工，不是吗？你应该能轻松制作出最精美的独木舟，带你到河上的任何地方！

english: Be master of your mind rather than mastered by your mind.
translation: 做你思想的主人，而不是被你的思想所支配。

english: Of course! Here you go, you've earned 1 token!
translation: 当然可以！给你，你获得了 1 个代币！

english: And it's said that they even intend to steal from the ruler of Al-Kharid himself!
translation: 据说他们还打算偷到阿尔哈立德统治者本人头上去呢！

english: Ooh, and you almost had me persuaded!
translation: 噢，你差点就说服我了！

english: Oooh, you shouldn't tease a poor girl so! But I'll take you downstream if you like!
translation: 噢噢，你可不该这样挑逗一个可怜的姑娘！不过如果你愿意的话，我可以带你去下游！

english: Are you wantin' a ride back up to the Colony? I won't ask ye for payment since you're helping Herman.
translation: 你想搭船回殖民地吗？既然你在帮赫尔曼，我就不收你钱了。

english: I'd finished my work for the day early and headed to bed. I didn't see anyone.
translation: 我提前完成了当天的工作，然后上床睡觉了。我没有看到任何人。

english: Pretty certain. I was really tired and tried to avoid getting assigned another job to do by one of the Sinclairs.
translation: 相当确定。我当时很累，尽量避开被某个辛克莱尔再派个活儿。

english: I seem to remember her looking at it a few days before the murder.
translation: 我好像记得她在谋杀案发生前几天看过它。

english: Yup, I don't pay heed to salesmen, they're a dodgy lot.
translation: 是啊，我不理会推销员，他们是一群狡猾的家伙。

english: Second, the thread. This thread was found at the scene of the crime. It matches Anna Sinclair's clothes.
translation: 第二，这根线。这根线是在犯罪现场发现的。它与安娜.辛克莱尔的衣服相符。

english: And last, but certainly not least, the poison that actually killed Lord Sinclair. It was found at the scene of the crime and had been bought by the defendant. Members of the jury, this woman is guilty.
translation: 最后但同样重要的是，真正毒死辛克莱尔勋爵的毒药。它在犯罪现场被发现，并且是由被告购买的。陪审团的各位，这个女人有罪。

english: First, the dagger. The dagger was found, stabbed into Lord Sinclair's body. It has the fingerprints of Anna Sinclair all over it.
translation: 首先是匕首。这把匕首被发现插在辛克莱尔勋爵身上，上面沾满了安娜.辛克莱尔的指纹。

english: Perhaps you should have signed up as prosecutor instead of defence, Mr [player name]. The idea is to disprove what the prosecution presents, not confirm it.
translation: 也许你当初应该报名做检察官而不是辩护律师，[player name]先生。我们的目的是反驳控方的指控，而不是确认它们。

english: Perhaps you should have signed up as prosecutor instead of defence, Miss [player name]. The idea is to disprove what the prosecution presents, not confirm it.
translation: 也许你当初应该报名做检察官而不是辩护律师，[player name]女士。我们的目的是反驳控方的指控，而不是确认它们。

english: You will then need to drop some bat's bones on the magic symbol while holding a lit black candle.
translation: 然后你需要拿着已点燃的黑色蜡烛，在魔法符号上丢下一些蝙蝠骨头。

english: We didn't order any Pizza. Get lost!
translation: 我们没有订任何披萨。滚开！

english: No. Get out of here before I run you through.
translation: 不。在我把你捅穿之前，赶紧滚出去。

english: The Grail? Ha! Frankly, little man, you're not in that league.
translation: 圣杯？哈！坦白说，小家伙，你还没那个级别。

english: The Grail? Ha! Frankly, little lady, you're not in that league.
translation: 圣杯？哈！坦白说，小姑娘，你还没那个级别。

english: They take all their deliveries by boat.
translation: 他们所有的货物都是用船运送的。

english: There are two ways in that I know of, the large heavy front doors, and the sea entrance, only penetrable by boat.
translation: 据我所知，有两个入口：沉重的前大门，以及只能乘船进入的海上入口。

english: Hanging? I'm not hanging. But I am very angry at being captured by those Black 'Knights', as they call themselves.
translation: 吊死？我可不是被吊死的。但我非常生气被那些自称‘黑骑士’的家伙抓住。

english: I am afraid I have no time to chat.
translation: 恐怕我没有时间聊天。

english: Funnily enough...
translation: 有趣的是……

english: It is good to see you again, brave sir, but under such sad circumstances. To first have our great King turned to stone and to then have our most prized treasure, the Holy Grail, stolen from us, is indeed the worst of days.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，勇敢的骑士，但却是如此悲伤的境况。先是伟大的国王变成了石头，然后我们最珍贵的宝藏——圣杯——又被偷走了，这真是最糟糕的日子。

english: It is good to see you again, brave lady, but under such sad circumstances. To first have our great King turned to stone and to then have our most prized treasure, the Holy Grail, stolen from us, is indeed the worst of days.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你，勇敢的女士，但却是如此悲伤的境况。先是伟大的国王变成了石头，然后我们最珍贵的宝藏——圣杯——又被偷走了，这真是最糟糕的日子。

english: Perhaps the mighty Excalibur would be strong enough...
translation: 也许强大的王者之剑足够坚固……

english: The Lady of the Lake is looking atfer it I believe... but I know not where she resides currently.
translation: 我相信湖中女士在保管着它……但我不知道她现在住在哪里。

english: Thank you. Food is always helpful during battle.
translation: 谢谢你。战斗中食物总是有用的。

english: Good day to you sir!
translation: 先生，日安！

english: Good day to you madam!
translation: 夫人，日安！

english: Isn't it terrible what happened to King Arthur? He was turned to stone before my eyes! I have failed him, I am not worthy of being his knight. To allow such lowlifes to take Camelot right from under our noses...
translation: 亚瑟王遭遇的事难道不可怕吗？他就在我眼前变成了石头！我辜负了他，我不配做他的骑士。竟然让这些卑鄙小人从我们眼皮底下夺走了卡美洛……

english: It's unforgivable.
translation: 这是不可原谅的。

english: Good day sir!
translation: 先生，日安！

english: Good day madam!
translation: 夫人，日安！

english: Good morrow sirrah!
translation: 早安，小子！

english: Good morrow madam!
translation: 早安，夫人！

english: 'Tis a magick most powerful and foul.
translation: 这是一种极其强大而邪恶的魔法。

english: I'm sorry, my lord, this is the guards' entrance. Only guards may enter.
translation: 抱歉，大人，这里是守卫入口。只有守卫才能进入。

english: Sorry, regulations are regulations. Only guards enter through here.
translation: 抱歉，规定就是规定。只有守卫才能从这里进入。

english: I'm sorry, my lady, this is the guards' entrance. Only guards may enter.
translation: 抱歉，夫人，这里是守卫入口。只有守卫才能进入。

english: They don't tell us. We just guard the Fortress... Wait a minute, if you are a Black Knight, shouldn't you know?
translation: 他们没告诉我们。我们只是守卫要塞……等一下，如果你是黑骑士，难道你不该知道吗？

english: I wouldn't...oh I'm sorry, sir, please go on through.
translation: 我不会……哦，抱歉，先生，请继续通过。

english: Well, you can see me wearing it. It's an iron chainbody and a bronze medium helm.
translation: 嗯，你看我穿着呢。是一件铁制链甲和一个青铜中型头盔。

english: I wouldn't...oh I'm sorry, lady, please go on through.
translation: 我不会……哦，抱歉，女士，请继续通过。

english: Be careful walking the corridors. The Black Knights are all on edge after that package got delivered.
translation: 在走廊里要小心。自从那个包裹送达后，黑骑士们都紧张兮兮的。

english: We weren't told, but it must be important if it's gotten them all excited like this.
translation: 我们没被告知，但能让它们都这么兴奋，一定很重要。

english: My lord, I hear the covert operation went well. Only one of those foolish Seers' Village guards suspects any foul play.
translation: 大人，我听说秘密行动很顺利。只有那些愚蠢的先知村守卫中的一个怀疑有猫腻。

english: Pffft, nah. He couldn't possibly be clever enough to work out our part in the plan.
translation: 切，不可能。他不可能聪明到能识破我们在计划中的角色。

english: My lady, I hear the covert operation went well. Only one of those foolish Seers' Village guards suspects any foul play.
translation: 夫人，我听说秘密行动很顺利。只有那些愚蠢的先知村守卫中的一个怀疑有猫腻。

english: We can't speak here. Speak to me another time.
translation: 我们不方便在这儿说话。换个时间再谈。

english: Pffft, nah. She couldn't possibly be clever enough to work out our part in the plan.
translation: 切，不可能。她不可能聪明到能识破我们在计划中的角色。

english: Welcome to my court. I am King Arthur.
translation: 欢迎来到我的宫廷。我是亚瑟王。

english: Well, in that case I think you need to go on a quest to prove yourself worthy.
translation: 嗯，既然如此，我认为你需要去执行一项任务来证明你的价值。

english: We discovered, some magic golden feathers that are said to point the way to the boots...
translation: 我们发现了一些魔法金羽，据说它们能指向那双靴子的所在……

english: My knights all appreciate a good quest.
translation: 我的骑士们都欣赏一项好任务。

english: Back in England, he got himself trapped in some sort of magical Crystal. We've moved him from the cave we found him in and now he's upstairs in his tower.
translation: 在英格兰的时候，他把自己困在某种魔法水晶里了。我们把他从发现的洞穴里搬了出来，现在他在楼上的塔里。

english: Unfortunately, our current quest is to rescue Merlin.
translation: 不幸的是，我们当前的任务是拯救梅林。

english: Well, the Grail IS very elusive, it may take some perserverance.
translation: 嗯，圣杯确实很难找到，可能需要一些毅力。

english: ...but you don't seem to have enough room to take the reward.
translation: ……但你好像没有足够的空间来领取奖励。

english: If you're having any troubles talk to the other knights around the room.
translation: 如果你遇到任何困难，和房间里其他骑士谈谈。

english: A touch? Yes, I'll do that.
translation: 碰一下？好的，我会做的。

english: Please help me. I was transformed into a frog by a well-meaning but sadly frog-obsessed old wizard.
translation: 请帮帮我。我被一个本意善良但不幸痴迷青蛙的老魔法师变成了青蛙。

english: Only a kiss can turn me back. Will you help me?
translation: 只有亲吻才能把我变回来。你愿意帮我吗？

english: Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog princess!
translation: 别跟我说话！去跟青蛙公主说吧！

english: Hurrah for the frog princess!
translation: 青蛙公主万岁！

english: Don't talk to me! Speak to the frog prince!
translation: 别跟我说话！去跟青蛙王子说吧！

english: Hurrah for the frog prince!
translation: 青蛙王子万岁！

english: Well, we'll see how you like being a frog!
translation: 哼，我们倒要看看你喜不喜欢当青蛙！

english: Hmph. Have you come to apologize for ignoring me?
translation: 哼。你是来为忽视我而道歉的吗？

english: All right. But in future be more polite.
translation: 好吧。但以后要更有礼貌些。

english: The frogs do not need your help any more.
translation: 青蛙们不再需要你的帮助了。

english: The fwogs do not need uw hewp wight now.
translation: 青瓦们现债不需要你滴帮助。

english: Don't wook at me, me'm just a fwog. Ribbit! Ribbit!
translation: 别看窝，窝只是一只青瓦。呱！呱！

english: Don't wook at me, I'm just a fwog. Ribbit! Ribbit!
translation: 别看窝，窝只是一只青瓦。呱！呱！

english: Pwease hewp me. me was twansfowmed into a fwog by aweww-meaning but sadwy fwog-obsessed owd wizawd.
translation: 请帮帮窝。窝被一个本意善良但不幸痴迷青瓦的老魔发湿变了青瓦。

english: Onwy a kiss can tuwn me back. Wiww u hewp me?
translation: 只哟亲吻才能把窝变回来。你愿一帮窝吗？

english: Your cape attests that you are experienced enough to serve the balance. I will disregard your lack of experience in combat.
translation: 你的披风证明你经验丰富，足以服务平衡。我将忽略你在战斗方面的经验不足。

english: Well you should be very experienced in the art of fishing, own the proper attire, and be recognised by your peers as a great fisherwoman.
translation: 嗯，你必须非常精通钓鱼艺术，拥有合适的装备，并且被同伴公认为一位伟大的女渔夫。

english: Sorry, but I just don't think you are renowned enough as a fisherman.
translation: 抱歉，但我只是觉得你作为渔夫的声望还不够高。

english: Sorry, but I just don't think you are renowned enough as a fisherwoman.
translation: 抱歉，但我只是觉得你作为女渔夫的声望还不够高。

english: I can't very well trade you no sharks now can I!? Come back and see me when you want to trade proper!
translation: 我可不能随便跟你换鲨鱼，不是吗！？等你真想正经交易的时候再来找我吧！

english: Ripper! You certainly seem to be the real deal, so sure, go ahead and take the boat over there.
translation: 高手！你看起来确实有两下子，行，去那边上船吧。

english: I can give you a shark for every 40 minnows that you give me. How many shark would you like?
translation: 每给我 40 条米诺鱼，我就能给你一条鲨鱼。你想要多少条鲨鱼？

english: Catch some minnows!
translation: 去抓些米诺鱼吧！

english: Oh, well I wanted to catch some minnows so I could use em' as bait, but the little blighters are just too quick! I managed to get 'em all rounded up over on my fishing platform, but I still can't catch 'em!
translation: 哦，我本想抓些米诺鱼当鱼饵，但这些小东西太快了！我好不容易把它们都赶到我的钓鱼平台上，但还是抓不住它们！

english: That'll do nicely, madam. Leave it with me - I'll make sure that tree grows up good and strong.
translation: 这样就很好，夫人。交给我吧——我会确保这棵树茁壮成长的。

english: I want 5 monkey nuts, a monkey bar and a ground-up Suqah tooth.
translation: 我想要5个猴坚果、一根猴条和一个磨碎的苏卡牙齿。

english: You can get a Suqah tooth from a Suqah's mouth, of course. Then you grind it up with a pestle and mortar. As for the monkey bar and nuts, try looking somewhere where there are lots of monkeys!
translation: 你当然可以从苏卡的嘴里获得苏卡牙齿。然后用研钵和杵把它磨碎。至于猴条和坚果，试着去有很多猴子的地方找找！

english: Alright, but it's not going to be cheap! I want 5 monkey nuts, a monkey bar and a ground-up Suqah tooth.
translation: 好吧，但这可不便宜！我想要5个猴坚果、一根猴条和一个磨碎的苏卡牙齿。

english: It is good to see you again! The Dorgeshuun Council would like to ask a favour of you, if you are interested.
translation: 很高兴再次见到你！如果你有兴趣，多尔戈什恩议会想请你帮个忙。

english: Help! Help! An outsider!
translation: 救命！救命！有外人！

english: We won't permit surface-dwellers to mine here until there is peace between our peoples.
translation: 在我们两个种族和平共处之前，我们不允许地表居民在这里采矿。

english: You'd better light a lamp first, or you won't be able to follow me!
translation: 你最好先点上一盏灯，否则你没法跟上我！

english: Most of the Dorgeshuun would be happy if such a war- like artefact was kept outside the city, and I am sure you will keep it in safe hands.
translation: 大多数多吉舒恩人会很乐意看到这种好战的物品留在城外，我相信你能确保它安全存放。

english: You might also want to visit the caves to the south of the city. There are many monsters to fight there, and Zanik tells me she has also found ways to cross over their heads!
translation: 你也可以去城南部的地下洞穴看看。那里有很多怪物可以打，扎尼克告诉我她还找到了从它们头顶越过的方法！

english: That's a pity. We have not had a major archaeological project for generations, so the archaeologists are working very slowly for fear of making mistakes.
translation: 真可惜。我们已经好几代没有进行过大型考古项目了，所以考古学家们工作非常缓慢，生怕出错。

english: He wearing green armour! General Bentnoze tell us wear red!
translation: 他穿着绿色盔甲！弯鼻将军叫我们穿红色！

english: But General Wartface say we must wear green!
translation: 但是疣脸将军说我们必须穿绿色！

english: He wearing red armour! General Wartface tell us wear green!
translation: 他穿着红色盔甲！疣脸将军叫我们穿绿色！

english: But General Bentnoze say we must wear red!
translation: 但是弯鼻将军说我们必须穿红色！

english: Cos General Bentnoze says so, and he bigger than me.
translation: 因为弯鼻将军说的，而且他比我大。

english: Goblin century mark year of big battle on plain of mud. That when Big High War God give us commandments.
translation: 哥布林世纪标志着泥原大战的那一年。那时大战神给了我们戒律。

english: What you call me?
translation: 你叫我什么？

english: Not you, him!
translation: 不是你，是他！

english: You not tell human secrets!
translation: 你不能告诉人类秘密！

english: I forgot now, but General Wartface says it is. So it must be.
translation: 我现在忘了，但疣脸将军说是就是。所以一定是。

english: Um... my brown armour in the wash.
translation: 呃...我的棕色盔甲在洗。

english: Big High War God take goblin people and make them strong! Without him we small and weak and stupid. But thanks to Big High War God we most powerful race in Gielinor!
translation: 大战神带领哥布林人民，让他们变得强大！没有他，我们又小又弱又蠢。但多亏了大战神，我们是吉莱诺最强大的种族！

english: That goblin secret! No human ever find plain of mud!
translation: 那是哥布林的秘密！人类永远找不到泥原！

english: Not you, her!
translation: 不是你，是她！

english: That General Wartface. He live in big hut.
translation: 那是疣脸将军。他住在大棚屋里。

english: No General Wartface is leader!
translation: 不，疣脸将军才是领袖！

english: He say Wartface is leader but real leader is Bentnoze!
translation: 他说疣脸是领袖，但真正的领袖是弯鼻！

english: That General Bentnoze. He live in big hut.
translation: 那是弯鼻将军。他住在大棚屋里。

english: He say Bentnoze is leader but real leader is Wartface!
translation: 他说弯鼻是领袖，但真正的领袖是疣脸！

english: No General Bentnoze is leader!
translation: 不，弯鼻将军才是领袖！

english: Bentnoze right, so me wear red.
translation: 弯鼻说得对，所以我穿红色。

english: Not listening. Me not argue with Bentnoze. He too big.
translation: 没在听。我不跟弯鼻争。他太大了。

english: I don't want that!
translation: 我不要那个！

english: You've been fighting! None of your type in here thanks.
translation: 你刚才在打架！这里不欢迎你这种人，谢谢。

english: It worked! Now we've just got to deal with Sigmund!
translation: 成功了！现在我们只需要对付西格蒙德！

english: Come find me in the city if you ever want to chat, [player name]. I'm going to go and think about what Juna said about my destiny. I don't know what it will involve, but I have a feeling we will adventure together
translation: 如果你想聊天，就到城里来找我吧，[player name]。我要去想想朱娜关于我命运的那番话。我不知道那会涉及什么，但我有种感觉，我们会一起冒险。

english: again!
translation: 再次！

english: Sure thing! Come on, [player name], let's go talk to the scribe!
translation: 当然！来吧，[player name]，我们去找那个书记官谈谈！

english: [player name] helped us to finish the dig! Look what he dug up!
translation: [player name]帮我们完成了挖掘！看看他挖出了什么！

english: Where are we going now?
translation: 我们现在要去哪里？

english: We've got to do something, [player name]! They're going to- -
translation: 我们得做点什么，[player name]！他们就要——

english: What are we waiting for? We ought to go down that trapdoor and find out where the HAM people are making their plans!
translation: 我们还在等什么？我们应该下到那个活板门里，找出HAM成员在哪里制定他们的计划！

english: Yes, how did they end? My ancestors missed that bit!
translation: 是啊，它们是怎么结束的？我的祖先们错过了那部分！

english: I will tell the Dorgeshuun about this! The gods are gone and the surface is safe for us!
translation: 我要把这件事告诉多吉需戛纳！神祇们已经离去，地表对我们来说是安全的了！

english: So that's why there are no gods here on the surface?
translation: 所以这就是为什么地表上没有神祇的原因？

english: Quick, [player name], let's smash that drilling machine before Sigmund returns! Then we can return to Dorgesh-Kaan for a hero's welcome!
translation: 快，[player name]，我们在西格蒙德回来之前砸烂那台钻孔机！然后我们就可以回到多吉需戛纳，享受英雄般的欢迎了！

english: Let's get this over with, [player name]. Let's just find whoever is in charge.
translation: 我们快点把这事了结吧，[player name]。我们直接去找管事的人。

english: No thank you, I have all I need!
translation: 不了，谢谢，我什么都不缺！

english: You should pick up your pet thingy first. It would only get in the way.
translation: 你应该先把你的宠物那玩意儿捡起来。它只会碍事。

english: All right. But I don't really understand it myself.
translation: 好吧。但连我自己也不太明白。

english: Perhaps we should talk to whoever is in charge of the HAM group.
translation: 也许我们应该和HAM组织的负责人谈谈。

english: A bit.
translation: 有一点。

english: Are there any goblins living up on the surface? I'd like to see them, to see how they're different from the Dorgeshuun.
translation: 地表上住着地精吗？我想见见他们，看看他们和我们的多吉需戛纳人有什么不同。

english: I still haven't seen the sky clearly. Take me outside, [player name]!
translation: 我还没看清天空呢。带我出去吧，[player name]！

english: It's got to be somewhere. Down there is worth a try!
translation: 肯定在某个地方。下面值得一试！

english: I've got to tell you what I heard in the meeting!
translation: 我得告诉你我在会议上听到的事情！

english: Come find me in the city if you ever want to chat, [player name]. I'm going to go and think about what Juna said about my destiny. I don't know what it will involve, but I have a feeling we will adventure
translation: 如果你想聊天，就到城里来找我吧，[player name]。我要去想想朱娜关于我命运的那番话。我不知道那会涉及什么，但我有种感觉，我们会一起冒险

english: together again!
translation: 再次一起！

english: I'll wait for you back in Lumbridge castle cellar.
translation: 我会在仑桥镇城堡的地窖里等你。

english: Where did you go? We need to smash this machine and then get back to Dorgesh-Kaan!
translation: 你去哪儿了？我们得砸烂这台机器，然后回到多吉需戛纳！

english: We're not going to find much out from these people. We need to get deeper into the cave.
translation: 我们从这些人身上问不出什么来。我们需要深入洞穴。

english: Surely you don't need all that stuff, [player name]! Drop some of it off at the bank and let's go!
translation: 你肯定不需要那么多东西吧，[player name]！把一些存到银行里，我们走吧！

english: But I didn't find out any more. They couldn't decide whether I really was the chosen commander or not, and they just got into a big argument about it.
translation: 但我没再打听到更多了。他们无法决定我到底是不是那个被选中的指挥官，然后就为此大吵了一架。

english: It's amazing! It's like being in a cave that's so big you can't see the sides or the top, and it's all blue and shining with light!
translation: 太神奇了！就像在一个大得看不到边际和顶端的洞穴里，而且到处都是蓝色，闪耀着光芒！

english: I was thinking about that ancient mace we found. I have a feeling that there's more to it than just its special ability?
translation: 我在想我们找到的那把古代钉锤。我总觉得它不仅仅只有那个特殊能力？

english: So much empty space above me and all around me... it's awe-inspiring! Exhilarating!
translation: 我头顶和周围有这么多空旷的空间……真是令人敬畏！令人振奋！

english: Where did that ability come from? What's powering it? And is it related to my destiny?
translation: 那个能力是从哪里来的？是什么在给它提供能量？它和我的命运有关吗？

english: I'm sorry, [player name]. I'd like to show you around the city, but the council has decided not to let any surface- dwellers in yet.
translation: 对不起，[player name]。我很想带你参观城市，但议会决定暂时不让任何地表居民进入。

english: And I mean actual disguises, not disguises in note form!
translation: 我说的是真正的伪装，不是票据形式的伪装！

english: We should go deeper into the HAM cave and see what's going on.
translation: 我们应该深入HAM的洞穴，看看里面到底在搞什么鬼。

english: I've got to tell you what I heard in the meeting! Let's go back to Lumbridge town so we can talk about it.
translation: 我得告诉你我在会议上听到的事情！我们回仑桥镇去吧，这样我们就能好好谈谈了。

english: We don't have time to chat now! We've got to foil the HAM plot at once!
translation: 我们现在没时间闲聊！我们必须立刻挫败HAM的阴谋！

english: Don't worry, [player name] and I will sort this out!
translation: 别担心，[player name]和我会解决这件事的！

english: Stop playing with your pet and help me, [player name]!
translation: 别玩你的宠物了，快来帮我，[player name]！

english: Come find me in the city if you ever want to chat, [player name]. I'm going to go and think about what Juna said about my destiny. I don't know what it will involve, but I have a feeling we will
translation: 如果你想聊天，就到城里来找我吧，[player name]。我要去想想朱娜关于我命运的那番话。我不知道那会涉及什么，但我有种感觉，我们会

english: adventure together again!
translation: 再次一起冒险！

english: Not today! [player name] is taking me on a tour of the surface! It's so exciting!
translation: 今天不行！[player name]要带我去地表游览！太令人兴奋了！

english: Shhh! We have to listen!
translation: 嘘！我们得听！

english: Oh, yes. My research along those lines has been coming along very well. I think I could make a Moving-Over- Distance Sphere to anywhere you like, given a little work.
translation: 哦，是的。我在这方面的研究进展得非常顺利。我想只要稍加努力，我就能做出一个能把你送到任何地方的远距移动球。

english: I can make you a moving-over-distance sphere for two law runes and a piece of molten glass.
translation: 我可以给你做一个远距移动球，需要两个律法符文和一块熔融玻璃。

english: I can make you one if you like. Where do you want a sphere to?

english: Yes, but you'll have to free up an inventory space if I'm going to give you a Moving-Over-Distance Sphere, [player name].
translation: 是的，但如果我要给你一个远距移动球，[player name]，你得先腾出一个背包空间。

translation: 你没有足够的空间放这个。

english: Yes, but you'll have to free up an inventory space if I'm going to give you a Moving-Over-Distance Sphere, [player name]
translation: 是的，但如果我要给你一个远距移动球，[player name]，你得先腾出一个背包空间。

english: Alright, now where was I...
translation: 好吧，我刚才说到哪了……

english: Excewwent! Now, just a minute...
translation: 太棒了！现在，稍等一下……

english: Excewwent! mecan make u 1000 moving-ovew-distancesphewes with dam! How many do u want?
translation: 太棒了！我可以用它们给你做1000个远距移动球！你想要多少个？

english: Whewe do u want a sphewe to?
translation: 你想要一个通往哪里的球？

english: Yes General Wartface sir?
translation: 是的，疣脸将军大人？

english: Grubfoot like Christmas. Grubfoot think it different from human Christmas. Goblins call it Gobmas.
translation: 格拉布福特喜欢圣诞节。格拉布福特觉得它和人类的圣诞节不一样。地精们叫它地精诞节。

english: Me not like this orange armour. Make me look like that thing.
translation: 我不喜欢这橙色盔甲。让我看起来像那个东西。

english: That fruit thing. The one that orange. What it called?
translation: 那个水果一样的东西。那个橙色的。它叫什么来着？

english: That right. This armour make me look same colour as orange-fruit.
translation: 没错。这件盔甲让我看起来和橙子水果一个颜色。

english: Goblin gifts from the treasures in village?
translation: 哥布林礼物是从村里的宝藏来的？

english: Now sacred boulder closer to goblins. It good so not more goblins fall down when go up to boulder to look.
translation: 现在神圣巨石更靠近哥布林了。这样很好，这样哥布林爬上巨石看的时候就不会再摔下来了。

english: Is it tasty? Is it scrumptious?
translation: 好吃吗？美味吗？

english: No, red glowy things!
translation: 不，是红色发光的东西！

english: Human scared of me not you! Then you think me bigger general!
translation: 人类怕的是我，不是你！这样你就会觉得我更像大将军！

english: Human can also get snowy wood house from estate agents.
translation: 人类也可以从地产经纪人那里得到雪木房子。

english: And they not all red!
translation: 而且它们不全都是红色的！

english: It not all green so General Wartface not happy. It OK with me. We get more red glowy things later.
translation: 不全是绿色，所以疣脸将军不高兴。我倒无所谓。我们以后会拿到更多红色发光的东西。

english: Me accept gifts from human next time too.
translation: 我下次也会接受人类的礼物。

english: Goblin Christmas superior to human Christmas. Also belly too full to invade now.
translation: 哥布林的圣诞节比人类的圣诞节高级。而且肚子太饱了，现在没法入侵。

english: For me too! I the best.
translation: 我也是！我最棒。

english: Very crunchable. Me have more?
translation: 非常脆。我还有吗？

english: We decide to celebrate goblin new century by changing colour of our armour, brown get boring after a bit.  We want change.
translation: 我们决定庆祝哥布林新世纪，把盔甲的颜色换掉，棕色穿久了会腻。我们想换换。

english: Me like meat!
translation: 我喜欢肉！

english: Also human can has small boulder and spare decorations from us.
translation: 人类也可以从我们这里拿一块小岩石和一些多余的装饰品。

english: Teach goblins? War easy. Learning hard.
translation: 教哥布林？打仗容易，学习难。

english: General Bentnoze not think this work.
translation: 弯鼻将军觉得这行不通。

english: Mudknuckles in there.
translation: 泥拳在里面。

english: Stinky sockings! Human so funny.
translation: 臭袜子！人类真搞笑。

english: In cave below village are glowy flying lights.
translation: 村子下面的洞穴里有发光的飞行光点。

english: Noooo! Red armour! Big High War God said so.
translation: 不！红色盔甲！大战神说的。

english: Bye-bye.
translation: 再见。

english: We take it so goblins happy. It great honour for Big High War God!
translation: 我们收下了，哥布林很高兴。这是大战神的无上荣耀！

english: They stinky and green.
translation: 它们又臭又绿。

english: Silly human!
translation: 傻人类！

english: That obvious. General Wartface has big belly.
translation: 那很明显。疣脸将军有个大肚子。

english: Yes, then goblins invade.
translation: 对，然后哥布林就入侵。

english: All goblins know is humans has it and humans say it good. So we take it. Goblins deserve good.
translation: 哥布林只知道人类有那东西，而且人类说它好。所以我们就抢。哥布林配得上好东西。

english: No! We invade when we agree that colour for armour is red!
translation: 不！等我们一致同意盔甲颜色是红色时，我们就入侵！

english: General Bentnoze too. And taking gifts from others. That good too.
translation: 弯鼻将军也是。还有收别人的礼物。那也不错。

english: Pretty is puny. Goblins need power!
translation: 漂亮就是弱小。哥布林需要力量！

english: Red!
translation: 红色！

english: Christmas good.
translation: 圣诞节好。

english: Above village goblins have sacred boulder. Goblins go there sometimes to look at boulder.
translation: 村庄上方哥布林有一块神圣巨石。哥布林有时会去那里看巨石。

english: General Bentnoze wants good gift! Better than General Wartface gift.
translation: 弯鼻将军要好的礼物！要比疣脸将军的礼物好。

english: Yes, only get. And take. It the goblin way.
translation: 对，只拿。还有抢。这是哥布林之道。

english: No! Scrubfoot bring red lights!
translation: 不！斯克鲁布福特会带来红色光点！

english: Human! Go get red lights before Scrubfoot! They in cave below village.
translation: 人类！在斯克鲁布福特之前去拿红色光点！它们在村子下面的洞穴里。

english: And human teach goblins about sockings! Humans have weird traditions.
translation: 还有人类教哥布林关于袜子的习俗！人类的传统真奇怪。

english: Yes, the fighting! And the uh... the pillaging?
translation: 对，打仗！还有呃...抢劫？

english: Sacred boulder is on ledge above village.
translation: 神圣巨石在村庄上方的壁架上。

english: Christmas good. It hard to pick one favourite thing.
translation: 圣诞节好。很难挑出最喜欢的一样东西。

english: Human get the red ones! In cave below village.
translation: 人类去拿红色的！在村子下面的洞穴里。

english: Maybe goblins invade after all.
translation: 也许哥布林终究还是会入侵。

english: Also human can has small boulder from us.
translation: 人类也可以从我们这里拿一块小岩石。

english: No! General Bentnoze did.
translation: 不！是弯鼻将军做的。

english: Yes, all goblins happy. But green glowy lights annoying.
translation: 对，所有哥布林都高兴。但是绿色发光光点很烦人。

english: Aha that'd be Wormbrain.
translation: 啊哈，那肯定是虫脑。

english: Wormbrain he steals too much. He got caught. Now he lives in Port Sarim town jail.
translation: 虫脑他偷得太多了。他被抓了。现在他住在沙林港镇上的监狱里。

english: We can has Christmas every day?
translation: 我们可以天天过圣诞节吗？

english: Me better.
translation: 我更好。

english: General Bentnoze too.
translation: 弯鼻将军也是。

english: Exactly. But we have spare boulder and decorations. Human can throw it away for goblins.
translation: 正是。但我们有多余的巨石和装饰品。人类可以帮哥布林把它们扔掉。

english: No, me!
translation: 不，是我！

english: Maybe same way you got orange armour?
translation: 也许和你得到橙色盔甲的方法一样？

english: There bound to be some around somewhere.
translation: 肯定有些地方能找到。

english: Why we have to do what human say? She not boss of us!
translation: 为什么我们要听人类的？她又不是我们的老大！

english: You take ancient goblin mace. Maybe it be useful. Talk to me when you have free space in inventory.
translation: 你拿这把古代哥布林钉锤吧。也许有用。等你背包有空位时再跟我说话。

english: Not red! red make you look fat.
translation: 不是红色！红色会让你看起来很胖。

english: No it has to be red.
translation: 不，必须是红色。

english: Me dunno what that look like. Have to see armour before we decide.
translation: 我不知道那长什么样。得先看到盔甲才能决定。

english: Yes bring us orange armour.
translation: 是的，给我们带橙色盔甲来。

english: That not much use - human go fetch it!
translation: 那没什么用——人类去把它拿来！

english: Yes as long as you pick red.
translation: 对，只要你选红色就行。

english: That would mean me wrong... but at least General Wartface not right!
translation: 那意味着我错了...但至少疣脸将军也不对！

english: I tell all goblins in village to wear red armour now!
translation: 我现在就告诉村里所有哥布林穿红色盔甲！

english: A picture of goblin armour?
translation: 一张哥布林盔甲的图片？

english: Problem is they want different change to us.
translation: 问题是他们想改的和我们不一样。

english: We decide to celebrate goblin new century by changing colour of our armour, brown get boring after a bit. We want change.
translation: 我们决定庆祝哥布林新世纪，把盔甲的颜色换掉，棕色穿久了会腻。我们想换换。

english: ...And then you dye it orange!
translation: ……然后你把它染成橙色！

english: Shut up General Wartface!
translation: 闭嘴，疣脸将军！

english: Maybe you can get more dye from here?
translation: 也许你能从这里弄到更多染料？

english: Stupid General Wartface, you not know how to spell!
translation: 蠢疣脸将军，你连拼写都不会！

english: But his color too ugly. Nearly make you look like an ugly goblin!
translation: 但他的颜色太丑了。几乎让你看起来像个丑哥布林！

english: ...And then you dye it blue!
translation: ……然后你把它染成蓝色！

english: ...And then you dye it brown!
translation: ……然后你把它染成棕色！

english: It in crates somewhere. Can't remember whcih crates now.
translation: 在某个板条箱里。现在不记得是哪个板条箱了。

english: The name's Lara, this here is my canoe station.
translation: 我叫拉拉，这里是我的独木舟站点。

english: Your canoe station?
translation: 你的独木舟站点？

english: I am employed here to keep it running. It's mine enough! Want to know more about canoes?
translation: 我受雇在这里维持运营。这足够算是我的了！想了解更多关于独木舟的事吗？

english: You look like you have not used your axe much at all, I doubt you will be able to make any canoes.
translation: 你看起来没怎么用过你的斧头，我怀疑你根本做不了任何独木舟。

english: Once you learn how to use your axe a bit more, you will be able to make a canoe to travel the river.
translation: 等你学会更好地使用斧头后，就能制作独木舟在河上旅行了。

english: I sure can, take your axe and chop this tree down here. You will then need to cut it into a canoe, easy stuff.
translation: 我当然可以，拿起你的斧头把这棵树砍倒。然后你需要把它削成独木舟，很简单的事。

english: Well, you will not be able to turn this tree into one of the more reliable canoes just yet.
translation: 嗯，你现在还不能把这棵树做成更可靠的独木舟。

english: By looking at you and the way you hold your axe, you don't have the right skills for that. It will only take you to the next stop.
translation: 看你的样子和握斧的方式，你还没有相应的技能。它只能带你去下一站。

english: I see the way you hold that axe of yours, you will be able to craft a reasonable canoe. You'll be able to make a dugout with those skills.
translation: 我看你握斧的方式，你应该能造出不错的独木舟。凭这些技能，你能做出一艘独木舟。

english: Two stops, I would say.
translation: 两站，我觉得。

english: Interesting form with your axe, you look like the type of person who could make a decent canoe.
translation: 握斧的姿势很有趣，你看起来像是能造出像样独木舟的人。

english: Very far, but not the whole way, best keep swinging that axe of yours.
translation: 很远，但到不了全程，最好继续挥动你的斧头。

english: You and your axe seem one in the same. You will be able to craft the best canoes that will get you anywhere along the river!
translation: 你和你的斧头仿佛融为一体。你将能造出最好的独木舟，带你沿河去任何地方！

english: I believe I mentioned you're only allowed to use Magic in this duel.
translation: 我想我说过这场决斗只允许使用魔法。

english: I believe I mentioned you're not allowed to take any Weapons or Armour into this duel.
translation: 我想我说过不允许携带任何武器或盔甲进入这场决斗。

english: I believe I mentioned you're only allowed to use Melee in this duel.
translation: 我想我说过这场决斗只允许使用近战。

english: I believe I mentioned you're not allowed to use Melee in this duel.
translation: 我想我说过这场决斗不允许使用近战。

english: I believe I mentioned you're not allowed to use Prayer in this duel.
translation: 我想我说过这场决斗不允许使用祈祷。

english: I believe I mentioned you're not allowed to take any items except those you're wearing into this duel.
translation: 我想我说过除了身上穿的，不允许携带任何物品进入这场决斗。

english: I believe I mentioned you're not allowed to use Magic in this duel.
translation: 我想我说过这场决斗不允许使用魔法。

english: I believe I mentioned you're not allowed to use Ranged in this duel.
translation: 我想我说过这场决斗不允许使用远程。

english: I believe I mentioned you're not allowed to take any Weapons or Armour into this duel, and that includes the materials to make them.
translation: 我想我说过不允许携带任何武器或盔甲进入这场决斗，包括制作这些东西的材料。

english: Ok I'm very old and fat! Are you happy now? Do you feel good, having a laugh at my expense?
translation: 好吧，我又老又胖！你满意了吗？拿我寻开心，你觉得很好吗？

english: I rather not say.
translation: 我宁愿不说。

english: Well maybe if you stroked me the odd time, or played with me.
translation: 嗯，也许你偶尔摸摸我，或者跟我玩玩。

english: A little older than I was before and not as old as I will be in another bit.
translation: 比之前老了一点，但又不像过一会儿那么老。

english: You're having a laugh! I couldn't even catch a cold if I tried.
translation: 你在开玩笑吧！我连感冒都抓不住。

english: Hisss. No the reason I can't catch any is because you neglect me, leaving me in the bank or in your bags for extended periods does not help.
translation: 嘶。不，我抓不到任何东西的原因是你忽视了我，把我长时间留在银行或你的包里可没半点帮助。

english: Well your idea of time and mine are too different for either of us to understand the other.
translation: 嗯，你对时间的看法和我的太不一样，我们谁都无法理解对方。

english: I don't know. Have you tried looking yet?
translation: 我不知道。你找过了吗？

english: Well for one I don't count the time I spend in your bank - which is horribly boring nor in your bag.
translation: 首先，我不算待在银行里的时间——那无聊得要死，也不包括在包里的时间。

english: If you paid me a little more attention I wouldn't, but I must admit I have been tempted to that for quite a while.
translation: 如果你对我再多关注一点，我就不至于这样。但我必须承认，我想那样做已经很久了。

english: I'm just getting started. Now there is also a difference in cat years and human years. To approximate time in cat years you take a value in years subtract 1 multiply it by 4 and then add 16.
translation: 我刚要开始说呢。猫年和人类年也是有区别的。要估算猫年的时间，你可以把年数减去 1，乘以 4，然后加上 16。

english: Uh.. I don't know. I must be so old now that I've forgotten what age I am.
translation: 呃……我不知道。我一定老得不记得自己几岁了。

english: I said approximate not calculate. Anyway it only works once the cat is 1 year old. Anyway the last complication is the discrepancy of rune years and earth years, which to date nobody has worked out.
translation: 我说的是估算，不是精确计算。不管怎样，这方法只适用于一岁以上的猫。最后还有个麻烦就是符文年与地球年的差异，至今没人能弄清楚。

english: Back to the pits. I want to tell the catchers what a rotten master you've been.
translation: 回斗坑去。我要告诉那些捕鼠人你是个多差劲的主人。

english: Not really. I'd rather she didn't see me in my bloated state. Maybe once I get fit again we could go and visit her.
translation: 不太想。我可不想让她看到我这副臃肿的样子。也许等我再恢复身材了，我们可以去看她。

english: Lets go down to the sewers, seeing as we're in Varrock.
translation: 我们去下水道吧，反正我们在维洛克城。

english: No there.
translation: 不去那边。

english: Stop, stop, stop! Right we're going to play a little game now.
translation: 停，停，停！好了，我们现在要玩个小游戏。

english: It's a quarter past tuesday.
translation: 现在是星期二过一刻。

english: Oh! My fault, well then to answer your question, I'd like to go to the Varrock sewers.
translation: 哦！是我不好，那么回答你的问题，我想去维洛克城下水道。

english: Hiss's'sss's.~Your cat tries to hold in a snigger, but fails miserably.
translation: 嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶。~你的猫试图忍住偷笑，但失败了。

english: You gently stroke your cat, then pick it up and finally leave it for an extended snooze in your backpack.
translation: 你轻轻地抚摸你的猫，然后把它抱起来，最后把它放进背包里让它好好打个盹。

english: AGHHHHH!!!!
That thing you're wearing is so like last year.
translation: 你穿的那东西真是太过时了。

english: Meeoow! I think someone is a bit touchy todaySSS.
translation: 喵嗷！我觉得某人今天有点暴躁嘶嘶嘶。

english: To be perfectly honest, I'd rather just lay about and groom myself. Looking at the state of your get up I reckon you would do well to follow suit.
translation: 说实话，我宁愿就躺着打理自己。看看你这一身打扮，我觉得你最好也学学我。

english: I'd never have guessed. Well in that case I would be really annoyed if you took me hunting rats.
translation: 我还真没猜到。好吧，要是那样的话，你带我去抓老鼠我会非常恼火。

english: Well one place I don't want to go is the ratpits.
translation: 嗯，有个地方我绝对不想去，那就是鼠坑。

english: The great and terrible demon Yama has bound this League to his will.
translation: 伟大而可怕的恶魔阎魔已将这个联赛束缚于他的意志之下。

english: Once again, regions contain monstrous Echo Bosses that can be defeated to earn unique and powerful rewards.
translation: 再次强调，每个区域都包含强大的回声Boss，击败它们可以获得独特而强大的奖励。

english: Yama, in his wisdom, has granted you the ability to augment your powers through Demonic Pacts. You may earn Demonic Pact points by completing Demonic Pact tasks.
translation: 阎魔以其智慧，赐予你通过恶魔契约增强力量的能力。你可以通过完成恶魔契约任务来获得恶魔契约点数。

english: Unlike before, you'll initially be restricted to the single Region of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you'll be able to unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: 与以往不同，你最初将仅限于瓦拉莫尔这一个区域。但随着你的进展，你将能够解锁自己选择的新区域。

english: Additionally, Misthalin will not be available at all this League, and once you reach the first task threshold Karamja will be unlocked for free.
translation: 此外，本次联赛米斯萨林将完全不可用，一旦你达到第一个任务门槛，卡拉姆詹岛将免费解锁。

english: Can you tell me about Demonic Pacts?
translation: 你能告诉我关于恶魔契约的事吗？

english: Demonic Pacts are new powers granted by Yama that modify and improve your combat abilities for the entire League.
translation: 恶魔契约是阎魔赐予的新力量，可在整个联赛中修改并提升你的战斗能力。

english: Why would Yama want to give me more power?
translation: 为什么阎魔要给我更多力量？

english: It wouldn't be very entertaining to see you go up against Echo Bosses with your mortal prowess now would it?
translation: 看着你以凡人之力对抗回声Boss，那可不怎么有趣，对吧？

english: At least, not for very long. Death comes easily to your kind.
translation: 至少，不会持续太久。死亡对你这类生物来说轻而易举。

english: You can earn Demonic Pact points by completing specific combat tasks.
translation: 你可以通过完成特定的战斗任务来获得恶魔契约点数。

english: These points can be spent to unlock abilities and progress through the pacts in a manner that suits your preference for combat.
translation: 这些点数可用于解锁能力，并以适合你战斗偏好的方式推进契约进度。

english: There are many choices available, but you will not be able to select them all. Plan ahead and choose wisely.
translation: 有很多选择，但你无法全部选中。提前规划，明智选择。

english: Now, would you like to take a look at the Demonic Pacts available to you?
translation: 现在，你想看看可用的恶魔契约吗？

english: Once you have achieved a certain amount of League Points you can unlock a new Relic. These artefacts have been reshaped by Yama and his cohort to grant new powers.
translation: 一旦你获得一定数量的联赛点数，就可以解锁一个新的遗物。这些神器已被阎魔及其同伙重塑，以赋予新的力量。

english: Currently, you are restricted to the Kingdom of Varlamore. However, as you progress, you can unlock more areas.
translation: 目前，你被限制在瓦拉莫尔王国。但随着你的进展，你可以解锁更多区域。

english: Once you have proven yourself dedicated to the League, Yama will also grant you free access to Karamja.
translation: 一旦你证明了自己对联赛的投入，阎魔还会免费授予你进入卡拉姆詹岛的权限。

english: There are eleven different areas in total. However, you can only unlock a maximum of five, including the two you are gifted. Choose wisely.
translation: 总共有十一个不同的区域。但最多只能解锁五个，包括你获赠的两个。明智选择。

english: The first two area unlocks are given to everyone. You can unlock the other three by completing the tasks you have been set.
translation: 前两个区域解锁是每个人都有的。你可以通过完成分配的任务来解锁另外三个。

english: What an interesting scroll you seem to have stumbled across.
translation: 你似乎偶然发现了一张有趣的卷轴。

english: We'd be willing to let you take one of Gielinor's most powerful weapons from Yama's vault in exchange for it.
translation: 我们愿意让你用这张卷轴从阎魔的金库中换取一件吉莱诺最强大的武器。

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts.
translation: 是的！当前的联赛是联赛六：恶魔契约。

english: This League features powerful boss variants in each region, and Demonic Pacts that let you choose new combat effects and improvements.
translation: 本次联赛在每个区域都有强大的Boss变体，以及让你选择新战斗效果和提升的恶魔契约。

english: One Relic allows you to harvest the souls of the slain, and another gives you the power to fell trees with your bare hands!
translation: 一个遗物让你能收割被杀者的灵魂，另一个则赋予你徒手砍树的力量！

english: Of course, there are many other Relics to choose from.
translation: 当然，还有许多其他遗物可供选择。

english: You are not eligible for any League Trophies, I'm afraid. But you can change that by participating in a League!
translation: 恐怕你还没有资格获得任何联盟奖杯。但参加联盟比赛就能改变这一点！

english: I do. Sadly you're not eligible for what I have to offer though. I'll be happy to help once you are.
translation: 我当然有。可惜的是，你目前不符合我提供的东西的资格。等你符合条件后，我很乐意帮忙。

english: Sadly you're not eligible for any League Trophies right now. I'll be happy to help once you are though.
translation: 很遗憾，你现在还没有资格获得任何联盟奖杯。不过等你符合条件后，我很乐意帮忙。

english: I can give you 1 more League item once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以再给你1件联盟物品。

english: Not only that, but within each League, you can unlock powerful artefacts known as Relics. These Relics completely change the way you progress through the League!
translation: 不仅如此，在每个联盟中，你还可以解锁名为“遗物”的强大神器。这些遗物会彻底改变你在联盟中的进展方式！

english: I can give you 2 more League items once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以再给你2件联盟物品。

english: Yes! The current League is Leagues II - Trailblazer.
translation: 是的！当前的联盟是联盟II——开拓者。

english: Within this League, you're initially locked to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, as you progress through the League, you'll unlock new areas of your choosing.
translation: 在这个联盟中，你一开始被锁定在米斯沙林王国。但随着你在联盟中不断推进，你可以自行解锁新的区域。

english: Anyway, would you like to take a look at the Relics for this League?
translation: 话说回来，你想看看这个联盟的遗物吗？

english: Hello there. Do you have any questions about Old School Leagues?
translation: 你好。你对旧学院联盟有什么疑问吗？

english: I can give you 1 League item once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以给你1件联盟物品。

translation: 那个联盟仍在进行中，所以我还不知道最终的分数线。你得等联盟结束后再来。

english: Not only that, but you must participate as an Iron Woman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 不仅如此，你还必须作为铁人模式参与。这意味着你孤身奋战，不能与其他参与者交易。

english: Now, for the entire League, you must participate as an Iron Woman. This means you stand alone and cannot trade with other participants.
translation: 现在，在整个联盟期间，你必须作为铁人模式参与。这意味着你孤身奋战，不能与其他参与者交易。

translation: 你想查看你的宠物收藏吗？

english: You earned 0 League Points in Leagues I - Twisted. Sadly, that means you are not eligible for any Twisted Trophies.
translation: 你在联盟I——扭曲中获得了0联盟点数。很遗憾，这意味着你没有资格获得任何扭曲奖杯。

translation: 你想现在领取你的联盟奖杯吗？

english: I can give you 11 more League items once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以再给你11件联盟物品。

english: You don't have any League Points I'm afraid. Take part in a League if you want to earn some.
translation: 恐怕你没有任何联盟点数。如果你想获得一些，就参加联盟吧。

english: I can give you 9 League items once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以给你9件联盟物品。

english: I can give you 13 more League items once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以再给你13件联盟物品。

translation: 话说回来，看起来你现在有一个区域可供选择！你想看看吗？

english: I can give you 12 more League items once you free up some space in your inventory.
translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以再给你12件联盟物品。

english: I can give you 11 League items once you free up some space in your inventory.
