translation: 等你腾出一些背包空间后，我可以给你14件联盟物品。

english: Take this axe and chop down one of these trees. Next you will need to use your tinderbox on the logs you get to make the fire. Then you can use your shrimp on the fire to cook it.
translation: 拿着这把斧头砍倒一棵树。然后你需要用火绒盒点燃得到的原木生火。接着你可以把虾放在火上烤熟。

english: Now you have the journal open, I'll tell you a bit about it. At the moment all of the quests are shown in red, which means you have not started them yet.
translation: 现在你打开了任务日志，我来给你讲讲。目前所有任务都显示为红色，这意味着你还没有开始它们。

english: Ah. Welcome, adventurer. I'm here to tell you all about quests. Let's start by opening your quest journal.
translation: 啊。欢迎你，冒险者。我来这里是为了告诉你关于任务的一切。我们先打开你的任务日志吧。

english: When you start a quest it will change colour to yellow. Once you've finished it, it will change to green. This is so you can easily see what's complete, what's started, and what's left to begin.
translation: 当你开始一个任务时，它会变成黄色。一旦你完成了，它会变成绿色。这样你就能轻松看出哪些完成了、哪些开始了、哪些还没开始。

english: If the quest is in progress, it will remind you what to do next.
translation: 如果任务正在进行中，它会提醒你下一步该做什么。

english: If you open your quest journal you will see that all of the quests are shown in red at the moment. This means you have not started them yet.
translation: 如果你打开任务日志，你会看到目前所有任务都显示为红色。这意味着你还没有开始它们。

english: Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. The rocks around here contain tin and copper. Why don't you get started by mining some? If you're unsure which is which, you can prospect them to find out.
translation: 采矿很简单，你只需要一把镐子。这里的岩石含有锡和铜。你为什么不先采一些呢？如果你不确定哪个是哪个，你可以通过勘察来了解。

english: The rocks around here contain tin and copper. You should try mining some. If you're unsure which is which, you can prospect them to find out.
translation: 这附近的岩石中含有锡和铜。你该试试挖一些。如果你不确定哪块是哪块，可以用勘测来查明。

english: It's really very simple. Usually when you go mining you can see if there is ore in a rock or not by its colour.
translation: 这真的很简单。通常当你采矿时，你可以通过岩石的颜色看出它是否含有矿石。

english: If you come across a rock you've not seen before and want to know what it is, or if you can't tell if a rock contains ore just by sight,
translation: 如果你遇到一块你以前没见过的岩石，想知道它是什么，或者无法仅凭视觉判断它是否含有矿石，

english: then simply right-click on the rock and select prospect to check closely. Anything else you wanted to know?
translation: 那么只需右键点击岩石并选择勘察来仔细检查。还有其他想知道的吗？

english: Ok then, [player name]. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you about mining and smithing.
translation: 好吧，[player name]。我叫德兹克，是个矿工。让我教你关于采矿和锻造的知识。

english: The rocks around here contain tin and copper.
translation: 这里的岩石含有锡和铜。

english: These are tin rocks.
translation: 这些是锡矿石。

english: Mining is very simple, all you need is a pickaxe. For smithing, you just need a hammer.
translation: 采矿很简单，你只需要一把镐子。至于锻造，你只需要一把锤子。

english: These are copper rocks.
translation: 这些是铜矿石。

english: Once you have some copper ore and tin ore, you can smelt them into a bronze bar at a furnace.
translation: 一旦你有了铜矿石和锡矿石，你就可以在熔炉里将它们熔炼成青铜锭。

english: You should try mining one of each. If you're unsure which is which, you can prospect them to find out.
translation: 你应该试着各挖一块。如果你不确定哪块是哪块，可以用勘测来查明。

english: Finally, take the bronze bar and a hammer to an anvil and smith it into a dagger.
translation: 最后，拿着青铜锭和锤子到铁砧那里，把它打造成一把匕首。

english: Ok then, buy capes from inferno.rs. My name is Dezzick and I'm a miner by trade. Let's teach you how to mine.
translation: 好吧，从 inferno.rs 购买斗篷。我叫德兹克，是个矿工。让我教你如何采矿。

english: Make sure you pick up the loot those rats drop. If the loot has disappeared, just kill another rat.
translation: 确保捡起那些老鼠掉落的战利品。如果战利品消失了，就再杀一只老鼠。

english: Time for some actual combat! Head into the pen and kill one of those rats and don't forget to pick up the loot those rats drop.
translation: 是时候进行真正的战斗了！进入围栏杀死其中一只老鼠，别忘了捡起那些老鼠掉落的战利品。

english: A world is what you play the game on. Each world can hold up to 2000 players and they are split into two main types, free worlds and members' worlds. You can swap worlds with the world switcher in the logout menu.
translation: 世界是你进行游戏的地方。每个世界最多可容纳2000名玩家，分为两种主要类型：免费世界和会员世界。你可以通过登出菜单中的世界切换器来切换世界。

english: Only this. Your account is very valuable and it's important you look after it. You have many tools at your disposal to help out with this such as bank pins and authenticators.
translation: 仅此而已。你的账号非常宝贵，照顾好它很重要。你有很多工具可以帮助你做到这一点，例如银行密码和验证器。

english: Next up, you have your inbox and name changer. The inbox is where you'll receive important information related to your account and the game. Be sure to keep an eye on it.
translation: 接下来，你有收件箱和改名功能。收件箱是你接收与账号和游戏相关重要信息的地方。请务必留意。

english: You'll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the useful links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
translation: 你可以在客户支持网页上找到更多关于账号安全的信息。你可以使用账号管理菜单中的有用链接部分前往那里。

english: You are currently on a free world but you do have membership. To enjoy all of your membership benefits, make sure you switch over to a members' world. You can find the world switcher in the logout menu.
translation: 你当前处于免费世界，但你是会员。要享受所有会员福利，请确保切换到会员世界。你可以在登出菜单中找到世界切换器。

english: Hello, I'm Brother Brace. I'm here to tell you all about Prayer, among other things.
translation: 你好，我是布雷斯修士。我来告诉你关于祈祷的一切，以及其他事情。

english: Now that we've covered your prayers themselves, you might want to know how to train your prayer.
translation: 既然我们已经介绍了你的祈祷本身，你可能想知道如何训练你的祈祷。

english: You should try activating one of your prayers now, and then recharge your Prayer Points at the altar here, once they've been drained.
translation: 你现在应该尝试激活一个祈祷，然后在祭坛这里补充你的祈祷点数，一旦它们耗尽。

english: Why don't you try burying the bones you got earlier while training with Vannaka?
translation: 你为什么不试试埋葬之前和范纳卡训练时得到的骨头呢？

english: You should activate one of your prayers, and then recharge your Prayer Points at the altar here.
translation: 你应该激活一个祈祷，然后在祭坛这里补充你的祈祷点数。

english: Why don't you try burying the bones you have?
translation: 你为什么不试试埋葬你拥有的骨头呢？

english: You should recharge your Prayer Points at the altar here.
translation: 你应该在祭坛这里补充你的祈祷点数。

english: Were you planning to become an Iron Man, by the way?
translation: 顺便问一下，你打算成为铁人吗？

english: If you're interested in that, you should go and ask the Iron Man tutor before you leave this island. He's standing outside my house.
translation: 如果你感兴趣，应该在离开这个岛之前去问问铁人导师。他就站在我家外面。

english: Were you planning to become an Iron Woman, by the way?
translation: 顺便问一下，你打算成为铁女吗？

english: You may now use the Home teleport spell to leave the island. This should be the first spell in your spellbook.
translation: 你现在可以使用回家传送法术离开这个岛。这应该是你法术书中的第一个法术。

english: There are three types of spells: Utility, combat and teleport spells. Combat spells are used to deal damage. Utility spells can be used to affect your targets stats, enchant items or even re-animation. Teleport spells are
translation: 有三种类型的法术：实用法术、战斗法术和传送法术。战斗法术用于造成伤害。实用法术可用于影响目标属性、附魔物品甚至复活。传送法术是

english: used to move you around the world. The higher your magic stat, the more spells You can choose to cast.
translation: 用于在世界中移动。你的魔法属性越高，你能选择施放的法术就越多。

english: The Iron Man tutor tells me that you need to set a Bank PIN to protect your Iron Man status. You'll have to set one before leaving.
translation: 铁人导师告诉我你需要设置一个银行销钉来保护你的铁人状态。你必须在离开前设置一个。

english: Beware adventurer lest thou lose thy head in search of source. Thou hast been tested for bravery and hast not been found wanting.
translation: 当心，冒险者，以免你在寻找源头时丢了脑袋。你已经接受了勇气的考验，并未被发现有不足之处。

english: Perilous dangers await for thee, Tojalon, Senay and Devere make three, None hold malice but will test your might, pray you do not lose these fights.
translation: 危险的挑战在等待着你，托贾隆、塞奈和德维尔是三人组，他们并无恶意但会考验你的力量，祈祷你不要输掉这些战斗。

english: If, however, you win this day, Take heart that see the source you may, Through Dragon's eye will you gain new heart, To see the source and then depart.
translation: 然而，如果你今天获胜，鼓起勇气，你或许就能看到源头，通过龙之眼你将获得新的勇气，看到源头然后离开。

english: To take challenge with me is useless for I am impervious to your attacks. Take your fight to someone else and maybe then get back on track.
translation: 向我挑战是徒劳的，因为我对你的攻击免疫。去找别人战斗吧，也许这样你就能重回正轨。

english: You would release me from my torment and the source would be available to you. However, you must realise that this will be no easy task.
translation: 你若能将我从折磨中释放，那源头便会为你所用。但你必须明白，这绝非易事。

english: I was brutally murdered by a vicious man called Viyeldi. I sense his presence near by, but I know that he is no longer living.
translation: 我被一个名叫维耶尔迪的恶毒之人残忍杀害。我感觉到他就在附近，但我知道他已不在人世。

english: I am Echned Zekin... and I seek peace from my eternal torture...
translation: 我是埃克内德.泽金……我寻求从永恒的折磨中解脱……

english: You will benefit from this decision, the source will be opened to you. Bring the dagger back to me when you have completed this task.
translation: 你会从这个决定中受益，源头将为你敞开。完成任务后，把匕首带回来给我。

english: My spirit burns with the need for revenge, I shall not rest while I sense his spirit still. If you seek the pure water, you must ensure he meets his end.
translation: 我的灵魂燃烧着复仇的渴望，只要我还能感觉到他的灵魂，我就不会安息。如果你寻求纯净之水，就必须确保他迎来终结。

english: I will furnish you with a weapon which will help you to achieve your aims... Here, take this...
translation: 我会为你提供一件武器，助你达成目标……拿着，收下这个……

english: If not, you will never see the source and your journey back must ye start. What is your answer? Will ye put an end to Viyeldi for me?
translation: 否则，你永远见不到源头，你的旅程必须重新开始。你的回答是什么？你愿意为我终结维耶尔迪吗？

english: I was robbed of my life by a cruel man called Viyeldi and I hunger for revenge upon him. It is long since I have walked this world looking for him to haunt him and raise terror in his life.
translation: 我被一个名叫维耶尔迪的残忍之人夺去了生命，我渴望向他复仇。我在这世上游荡已久，寻找他，纠缠他，给他的生活带来恐惧。

english: But tragedy of tragedies, his spirit is neither living or dead. He serves the needs of the source. He died trying to collect the water from this stream, and now I hang in torment for eternity.
translation: 但悲剧中的悲剧，他的灵魂既非生亦非死。他服务于源头的需要。他在试图从这条溪流取水时死去，如今我永远悬于折磨之中。

english: Something seems different about you... Your sense of purpose seems not bent to my will... Give me the dagger that you used to slay Viyeldi or taste my wrath!
translation: 你看起来有些不同……你的目标感似乎并未屈从于我的意志……把你用来杀死维耶尔迪的匕首给我，否则就尝尝我的怒火！

english: Aahhhhhhhhh! As I take the spirit of one departed, I will now reveal myself and spell out your doom.
translation: 啊——！当我取走一个逝者的灵魂时，我将现身并宣告你的末日。

english: So, you desire the water that flows here?
translation: 那么，你渴望这里流淌的水？

english: The water babbles so loudly and I am already so tortured. I cannot abide the sound so I have stoppered the streams. Care you not for my torment and pain?
translation: 水声潺潺，我已备受折磨。我无法忍受这声音，所以堵住了溪流。你难道不关心我的痛苦和折磨吗？

english: Avenge upon me the death of Viyeldi, the cruel. And I will give you access to source...
translation: 为我向残忍的维耶尔迪复仇，我就让你接近源头……

english: Return swiftly with the weapon as soon as your task is complete.
translation: 任务完成后，速速带着武器返回。

english: It is too late for second thoughts... Do as you have agreed and return to me in all haste... His presence tortures me so...
translation: 现在反悔已经太迟了……照你答应的去做，尽快回到我身边……他的存在折磨着我……

english: Yes, you may get some water, but first you must help me. Revenge is the only thing that keeps my spirit in this place.
translation: 是的，你可以取一些水，但必须先帮我。复仇是唯一让我的灵魂留在此处的东西。

english: Help me take vengeance on Viyeldi and I will gladly remove the rocks and allow you access to the water. What say you?
translation: 帮我向维耶尔迪复仇，我就很乐意移除这些石头，让你能接触到水。你觉得怎么样？

english: You worthless Vacu, how dare you seek to trick me. Go and slay Viyeldi as you promised or I will layer upon you all the pain and torment I have endured all these long years!
translation: 你这个无用的废物，竟敢试图欺骗我。去杀了维耶尔迪，就像你承诺的那样，否则我会把所有这些年来承受的痛苦和折磨都加诸于你！

english: Should I take from this that you do not wish to help me gain vengeance on Viyeldi?
translation: 我是否可以理解为，你不想帮我向维耶尔迪复仇？

english: Such noble thoughts, but Viyeldi is not alive. He is merely a vessel by which the power of the source protects itself.
translation: 多么高尚的想法，但维耶尔迪并非活人。他不过是源头力量用以保护自身的容器。

english: If that is your decision, so be it, but expect not to gain the water from this stream.
translation: 如果那是你的决定，那就这样吧，但别指望能从这条溪流中取水。

english: Bring it to me with all haste. Or torment and pain will I bring to you...
translation: 尽快把它带来。否则，我会给你带来折磨和痛苦……

english: The decision is yours but you will have no other way to get the source. The pure water you seek will forever be out of your reach.
translation: 决定权在你，但你别无他法获得源头。你所寻求的纯净之水将永远遥不可及。

english: I am long since dead and buried, lost in the passages of time. Long since have my kin departed and I been forgotten... It is unlikely that you know me... I am a poor tortured soul looking for rest and eternal peace...
translation: 我早已死去并被埋葬，迷失在时间的通道中。我的亲人早已离去，我也已被遗忘……你不太可能认识我……我是一个可怜的、寻求安息与永恒平静的被折磨的灵魂……

english: Go now and slay him, as you agreed. If you are forfeit on this I will take you as a replacement for Viyeldi!
translation: 现在就去杀了他，就像你答应的那样。如果你食言，我会拿你来代替维耶尔迪！

english: Very well, if that is your decision... However, you will not get access to the water...
translation: 很好，如果那是你的决定……不过，你将无法取水……

english: The rock must remain, it stoppers the waters that babble. The noise troubles my soul and I seek some rest... rest from this terrible torture...
translation: 石头必须留着，它堵住了潺潺的流水。那声音困扰着我的灵魂，我寻求一些安宁……从这可怕的折磨中解脱……

english: Use the dagger I have provided for you to complete this task and then bring it to me when Viyeldi is dead.
translation: 用我给你的匕首完成这个任务，等维耶尔迪死后，把它带回来给我。

english: You have proved yourself of the honour.
translation: 你已经证明了自己配得上这份荣誉。

english: How goes your quest to release Ungadulu Bwana?
translation: 你解救昂加杜鲁的任务进行得如何了，先生？

english: You are more than welcome bwana...
translation: 非常欢迎你，先生……

english: Very well Bwana...
translation: 好的，先生……

english: Greetings Bwana. Ah I see you have the golden bowl! Would you like me to show you how to bless it?
translation: 你好，先生。啊，我看到你拿到金碗了！要我教你如何祝福它吗？

english: A vessel made of sun metal, but it can be of any shape. However, it must be blessed.
translation: 一个用太阳金属制成的容器，形状不限。不过，它必须经过祝福。

english: Well there is a pool of water that is very sacred to us. But I am unsure why he would need that to douse flames. Perhaps the poor Shaman has lost his mind in the darkness of the caves?
translation: 嗯，有一处对我们来说非常神圣的水池。但我不确定他为什么需要那个来扑灭火焰。也许可怜的萨满在黑暗的洞穴里迷失了心智？

english: I am not sure but I have heard that deeper in the catacombs where you found Ungadulu, deep underground there is a terrible place guarded by the  spirits of the undead.
translation: 我不太确定，但我听说在你找到昂加杜鲁的地下墓穴更深处，有一个被亡灵守卫的可怕地方。

english: Greetings Bwana... Why do you make such strange sounds and disturb the peace of the jungle?
translation: 你好，先生……你为什么要发出这么奇怪的声音，打扰丛林的宁静？

english: Well, it had the desired effect... I am Gujuo, proud member of the Kharazi tribe. What did you want to talk about Bwana?
translation: 嗯，效果达到了……我是古朱奥，卡拉兹部落的骄傲成员。你想谈什么，先生？

english: Here, have this as an example... I pray that it will help you.
translation: 来，拿着这个作为例子……我祈祷它能帮到你。

english: Very good Bwana... this is indeed a very pleasant gesture. However, my people are very distributed throughout the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 很好，先生……这确实是非常友好的表示。不过，我的族人分散在卡拉兹丛林的各处。

english: All of my people normally congregate around a totem pole. But ours has been polluted by an evil spirit. It has been transformed, and now our people are afraid to approach it.
translation: 我的族人通常会聚集在图腾柱周围。但我们的图腾柱被恶灵污染了。它已经变了样，现在我的族人都害怕靠近它。

english: Greetings Bwana, we saw your fight with the Demon from some distance away. My people are so pleased with your heroic efforts. Your strength and ability as a warrior are Legendary.
translation: 你好，先生，我们在远处看到了你与恶魔的战斗。我的族人对你的英勇行为非常满意。你的力量和战士能力堪称传奇。

english: Please accept this as a token of our appreciation.
translation: 请收下这个，当作我们的一点心意。

english: We could try to make a new totem pole. However, we need to make it from the trunk of the sacred Yommi tree.
translation: 我们可以尝试制作一个新的图腾柱。不过，我们需要用神圣的约米树的树干来制作。

english: I have visited Ungadulu in the caves, he is hard at work studying. He looks well! Have you grown the Yommi tree yet?
translation: 我去洞穴里探望过昂加杜鲁，他正在努力研究。他看起来不错！你种下约米树了吗？

english: This is indeed a bad omen Bwana, that pool is sacred to us. I have seen it and it is full of filth, it is not natural. I suspect that some evil is at work here.
translation: 这确实是个不祥之兆，先生，那个水池对我们来说是神圣的。我见过它，里面满是污秽，这不正常。我怀疑有什么邪恶的东西在作祟。

english: First we need to plant a sacred Yommi tree. It is a magical tree of great power, however, our Shaman 'Ungadulu' is the only person with the seeds for this tree.
translation: 首先，我们需要种下一棵神圣的约米树。那是一棵拥有强大力量的魔法树，不过，只有我们的萨满‘昂加杜鲁’才有这种树的种子。

english: And I fear that it is impossible to get some seeds. He is being held against his will in some caves in the north western part of the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 而且我担心很难弄到种子。他被强行关在卡拉兹丛林西北部的一些洞穴里。

english: You make me very happy Bwana! In the north western part of the Kharazi Jungle area, near some great cliffs, you will find three rocks that form a roughly triangular shape.
translation: 你让我很高兴，先生！在卡拉兹丛林地区的西北部，靠近一些大悬崖的地方，你会发现三块大致呈三角形的岩石。

english: Hello Bwana, I'm very pleased to see you again. Things seem much happier now in the Kharazi Jungle. I suspect that it is down to your good doings!
translation: 你好，先生，很高兴再次见到你。现在卡拉兹丛林看起来快乐多了。我猜这都是你的功劳！

english: This sounds very strange Bwana... but maybe I can help. There is a pool of water that is sacred to us. It is located in the middle of the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 这听起来很奇怪，先生……但也许我能帮上忙。有一处对我们来说很神圣的水池。它位于卡拉兹丛林的中央。

english: Please, now consider yourself a friend of my people. And visit us anytime.
translation: 请把你自己当作我们族人的朋友吧。随时欢迎你来拜访。

english: We tried to drive the evil spirit out of the totem pole, but it does not seem to work.
translation: 我们试图把恶灵赶出图腾柱，但似乎不起作用。

english: Well, if you are sure you want to go, I will assist as much as I can. You will need the bravery of the jungle lion, if you are to go into that forbidden place. I can give you the recipe for a potion to help with that.
translation: 好吧，如果你确定要去，我会尽我所能帮助你。如果你要进入那个禁地，你需要丛林狮子的勇气。我可以给你一份药水食谱来帮忙。

english: Since they died trying to find the source of the stream, they are cursed to guard it for all eternity. The first to seek the source was said to be a high level sorcerer.
translation: 由于他们为了寻找溪流的源头而死，他们被诅咒永远守卫它。据说第一个寻找源头的人是一位高级魔法师。

english: They are flanked by the palm which also forms the divine geometry. The stones are the entrance, search them well. That's where you'll find Ungadulu. If you can free him he will entrust you with some sacred
translation: 它们两侧是棕榈树，也构成了神圣的几何图形。那些石头就是入口，仔细搜索它们。你会在那里找到昂加杜鲁。如果你能救出他，他会托付给你一些神圣的

english: When you have made the vessel, bring it to me. I will help but you need to ensure that you are devout and have faith. Your ability in prayer will be thoroughly tested.
translation: 当你做好容器后，就带给我。我会帮忙，但你需要确保自己虔诚且有信仰。你的祈祷能力将受到彻底的考验。

english: The pool of sacred water is very precious to us, it is located in the middle of the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 圣水池塘对我们非常珍贵，它位于卡拉兹丛林的中心。

english: He created a powerful spell in the caves. Now, all those who venture near are overcome by a supernatural fear. With all my heart Bwana, I would never go near such a place.
translation: 他在洞穴里创造了一个强大的法术。现在，所有靠近的人都会被一种超自然的恐惧所压倒。我真心实意地说，先生，我绝不会靠近那种地方。

english: The water contains special properties but it can only be contained in a blessed vessel made from metal of the sun. The water is difficult to get to, but I am sure you will manage to claim some.
translation: 这种水含有特殊的属性，但只能装在用太阳金属制成的祝福容器里。水很难获取，但我相信你能设法弄到一些。

english: Great Bwana, you are truly a brave warrior. Now you can try to grow the Yommi tree in earnest and make the totem pole.
translation: 伟大的先生，你真是个勇敢的战士。现在你可以认真尝试种植约米树并制作图腾柱了。

english: I'll take those germinated Yommi tree seeds to Ungadulu, I'm sure he'll appreciate them.
translation: 我会把这些发芽的约米树种子带给昂加杜鲁，我相信他会喜欢的。

english: You will need to find two herbs, Snake weed and Ardrigal. Add them both to a vial of water, and you will walk with the bravery of the Kharazi lion.
translation: 你需要找到两种草药，蛇草和阿德里加草。把它们都加入一瓶水中，你就会拥有卡拉兹狮子的勇气。

english: Would you like to try again?
translation: 你想再试一次吗？

english: The water contains special properties which can only be retained if the water is contained in a blessed vessel made from metal of the sun.
translation: 这种水含有特殊的属性，但只有装在用太阳金属制成的祝福容器里才能保持这些属性。

english: Yommi tree seeds.
translation: 约米树种子。

english: Perhaps the location has been hidden or buried under rubble? These stories were told to me as a child by the village elders. They were probably meant to frighten us away from the caves.
translation: 也许那个位置被隐藏起来或被瓦砾掩埋了？这些故事是我小时候村里的长辈讲给我听的。它们大概是为了吓唬我们，不让我们靠近那些洞穴。

english: I must go and hunt now Bwana..
translation: 我现在得去打猎了，先生……

english: I must visit my people now...
translation: 我现在得去拜访我的族人了……

english: The mosquitos bite me bwana! I must go for a swim...
translation: 蚊子咬我，先生！我得去游个泳……

english: I am tired Bwana, I must go and rest...
translation: 我累了，先生，我得去休息了……

english: I have to collect herbs now Bwana...
translation: 我现在得去采集草药了，先生……

english: I have work to do Bwana, I may see you again...
translation: 我有事要做，先生，我们也许还会再见……

english: I would urge you to take it, Bwana, I have heard that the caves are protected by a supernatural fear that renders even the bravest man to a trembling wreck.
translation: 我劝你带上它，先生，我听说那些洞穴被一种超自然恐惧保护着，即使最勇敢的人也会被吓得浑身发抖。

english: It is a bright and precious metal that is much sought after, though uncommonly found. It is the same glorious colour as the sun and it never loses its wondrous lustre. A blessed vessel made of this metal
translation: 这是一种明亮珍贵的金属，非常抢手，但并不常见。它的颜色和太阳一样灿烂，而且永远不会失去其奇妙的光泽。用这种金属制成的祝福容器

english: It could all just be a myth! Perhaps there is another way to get to the source of the stream? But I am not sure where it is.
translation: 这可能只是个传说！也许有别的办法可以到达溪流的源头？但我不确定它在哪。

english: It is found in some rocks and must be extracted. It has a magical ability over some people, it possesses them. They fall within its power and seek to gain more and more of this precious metal for themselves.
translation: 它存在于一些岩石中，必须被提炼出来。它对某些人有魔力，会控制他们。他们被它的力量所俘获，并试图为自己获取越来越多的这种珍贵金属。

english: You will need all your wits about you when dealing with the terrors that exist down there.
translation: 当你应对那里的恐怖事物时，你需要保持头脑清醒。

english: protects the purity of the water.
translation: 保护着水的纯净。

english: Bwana, I am very sorry, but you are too inexperienced to bless this bowl.
translation: 先生，非常抱歉，你的经验还不足以祝福这个碗。

english: Be wary Bwana. There are many unknown spirits that reside in these dark areas. You may be tricked by an unknown force...
translation: 小心点，先生。这些黑暗区域里住着许多未知的灵魂。你可能会被未知的力量欺骗……

english: A blessed vessel made of this metal protects the purity of the water.
translation: 用这种金属制成的祝福容器可以保护水的纯净。

english: You will need to grow the Yommi tree to full height. And then, before it rots, you must chop it down. Once you have felled the tree, you need to trim the branches.
translation: 你需要让约米树长到全高。然后，在它腐烂之前，你必须把它砍倒。砍倒树后，你需要修剪树枝。

english: And finally, you need to craft the totem pole out of the trunk. You'll need a very sharp, very tough axe to do all this. But once you have completed the totem pole,
translation: 最后，你需要用树干制作图腾柱。你需要一把非常锋利、非常结实的斧头来完成这一切。但一旦你完成了图腾柱，

english: I am at a loss as well Bwana. At this time Ungadulu is the only one who might know of a solution for this puzzle and at this time, he is part of that same puzzle.
translation: 我也没办法，先生。目前，昂加杜鲁是唯一可能知道这个谜题解法的人，而他现在本身也是这个谜题的一部分。

english: You will need to use it to replace a totem pole that already exists, as they're all placed on sacred areas to my people.
translation: 你需要用它来替换一个已经存在的图腾柱，因为它们都放置在我族人的神圣区域。

english: You are indeed very brave Bwana, we have noticed a difference in the Kharazi Jungle, the trees seem to sing again. And we have you to thank for it.
translation: 你确实非常勇敢，先生，我们注意到卡拉兹丛林有了变化，树木似乎再次歌唱。这都要感谢你。

english: I have visited Ungadulu in the caves, he is hard at work studying. He looks well! How is your quest going Bwana?
translation: 我去洞穴里探望过昂加杜鲁，他正在努力研究。他看起来不错！你的任务进行得如何了，先生？

english: Similar to the picture I have already given you.
translation: 和我已经给你的那张图类似。

english: How goes your quest to release Ungadulu?
translation: 你解救昂加杜鲁的任务进行得如何了？

english: Congratulations on releasing Ungadulu! My people are very pleased... How goes the growing of the Yommi tree?
translation: 恭喜你救出了昂加杜鲁！我的族人非常高兴……约米树种得怎么样了？

english: You are indeed brave Bwana, a truly fearsome warrior to take on such an enemy! Well Done!
translation: 你确实很勇敢，先生，真是个可怕的战士，敢于对抗这样的敌人！干得好！

english: Well done Bwana. With the blessings of the gods we will soon have our Totem Pole. Bwana, you now need to plant the seed in the fertile earth.
translation: 干得好，先生。在众神的祝福下，我们很快就能拥有我们的图腾柱了。先生，你现在需要把种子种在肥沃的土地里。

english: You should be able to find many places where the ground is fertile in the Kharazi Jungle. Planting the Yommi tree seeds in fertile soil gives it a good chance to grow.
translation: 你应该能在卡拉兹丛林里找到很多土地肥沃的地方。把约米树种子种在肥沃的土壤里，它就有机会好好生长。

english: That's fine Bwana, not to worry. I hope your quest is going well in any case.
translation: 没关系，先生，别担心。无论如何，我希望你的任务进展顺利。

english: Ardrigal is often found growing near to large groups of palms. Such a collection exists in the north. If you head east out of Tai Bwo Wannai village you should come across them.
translation: 阿德里加草通常生长在大片棕榈树附近。北方就有这样一片棕榈林。如果你从泰博瓦纳村向东走，应该就能找到它们。

english: You need to place the seeds into pure water, and they will begin to sprout tiny shoots. You can then plant them in fertile soil.
translation: 你需要把种子放在纯净的水里，它们就会开始长出嫩芽。然后你就可以把它们种在肥沃的土壤里了。

english: Snake weed is usually found by swampy marshy areas. It is not very common and it may be quite difficult to find.
translation: 蛇草通常生长在沼泽湿地附近。它不太常见，可能很难找到。

english: My people are trying to grow the Yommi tree as well. But so far we have not met with any success. If you find a rotten tree or what looks like a rotten totem pole,
translation: 我的族人也在尝试种植约米树。但到目前为止，我们还没有成功。如果你发现一棵腐烂的树，或者看起来像腐烂的图腾柱的东西，

english: The herb grows in the shade of the palm so check carefully.
translation: 这种草药生长在棕榈树的阴凉处，所以要仔细检查。

english: I am sorry Bwana, my people are scattered throughout the Kharazi Jungle. Without the totem pole to allay their fears, I believe it is impossible to collect them together as a group.
translation: 对不起，先生，我的族人分散在卡拉兹丛林各处。没有图腾柱来消除他们的恐惧，我相信不可能把他们聚集在一起。

english: There is some marsh to the south of Tai Bwo Wannai village. The herb grows near  jungle vines, so check all around very carefully.
translation: 泰博瓦纳村南边有一片沼泽。这种草药生长在丛林藤蔓附近，所以要在周围非常仔细地检查。

english: You'll need to remove it yourself to get to the fertile soil. It will take a very sharp, robust axe to do it.
translation: 你需要自己把它移开才能接触到肥沃的土壤。这需要一把非常锋利、结实的斧头。

english: Yes, it is a magical tree and can only survive on the water from the sacred pool. This is indeed a tragedy.
translation: 是的，那是一棵魔法树，只能靠神圣水池的水存活。这确实是个悲剧。

english: I understand Bwana, it would be a waste of a perfectly good life. We will try to defeat the evil spirits in other ways. But I am not sure how we will do that.
translation: 我明白，先生，白白浪费一条好命不值得。我们会尝试用其他方法打败恶灵。但我不确定该怎么做。

english: Well Bwana, it's a very interesting piece of work, not bad at all. Now we need to replace an existing corrupted totem pole with your newly constructed one. You should find those totems within the Kharazi Jungle.
translation: 嗯，先生，这是一件非常有趣的作品，相当不错。现在我们需要用你新制作的图腾柱替换一个现有的被腐化的图腾柱。你应该能在卡拉兹丛林里找到那些图腾。

english: Strange spirits that our forefathers summoned for visions. They haunt the underworld and caves that exist in this area. Take not anything as it might first appear.
translation: 我们的祖先召唤来获取幻象的奇怪灵魂。它们出没于这个区域的地底世界和洞穴。不要相信你最初看到的一切。

english: Well, if you are sure you want to go, I will assist as much as I can. You will need the  bravery of the jungle lion, if you are to go into that forbidden place.
translation: 好吧，如果你确定要去，我会尽力帮忙。如果你要进入那个禁地，你需要有丛林狮子的勇气。

english: Good day Bwana. The jungle is especially beautiful today isn't it? My village people pass on their thanks to you.
translation: 你好，先生。今天的丛林格外美丽，不是吗？我村里的人向你表示感谢。

english: I am unlearned in such matters. But I am told of sacred patterns that are scored on the ground to bind the spirit and confine it... But that is all I know.
translation: 我对这类事情不甚了解。但我听说过一种神圣的图案，刻在地面上用来束缚灵魂并将其禁锢……但我就知道这些。

english: Well, maybe you can get his attention somehow? Did you examine the nature of the magical flames? From where did they come do you think?
translation: 嗯，也许你能想办法引起他的注意？你检查过那些魔法火焰的性质了吗？你觉得它们是从哪里来的？

english: I can give you the recipe for a potion to help with that. You will need to find two herbs, Snake weed and Ardrigal. Add them both to a vial of water, and you will walk with the bravery of the lion.
translation: 我可以给你一份药水食谱来帮忙。你需要找到两种草药，蛇草和阿德里加草。将它们都加入一瓶水中，你就会拥有狮子的勇气。

english: That's great Bwana. Now you just need to germinate the seeds and then plant them in some fertile soil. I'm sure that Ungadulu has explained all this to you already.
translation: 太好了，先生。现在你只需要让种子发芽，然后把它们种在肥沃的土壤里。我相信昂加杜鲁已经向你解释过这一切了。

english: Sorry, but I don't need that Bwana.
translation: 抱歉，我不需要那个，先生。

english: Aha Bwana, well done, you have made the golden bowl. Would you like me to show you how to bless it.
translation: 啊哈，先生，干得好，你做出了金碗。要我教你如何祝福它吗？

english: I would urge you to take it, Bwana, I have heard that the caves are protected by supernatural fear that renders even the bravest man to a trembling wreck.
translation: 我劝你带上它，Bwana，我听说那些洞穴被超自然恐惧保护着，即使最勇敢的人也会变成颤抖的残骸。

english: It seems that Ungadulu has started to lose his senses. In our native and ancient history, the 'Vacu' were the servants of the evil spirits from the underworld.
translation: 看来昂加杜鲁开始失去理智了。在我们本土的古老历史中，‘瓦库’是来自地底世界的恶灵的仆人。

english: I am not sure. But I have heard that deeper in the catacombs where you found Ungadulu, deep underground, there is a terrible place guarded by the spirits of the undead.
translation: 我不太确定。但我听说在你找到昂加杜鲁的地下墓穴更深处，有一个被亡灵守卫的可怕地方。

english: Perhaps you should investigate the caves further? Have you been able to speak to Ungadulu yet? He may have some information to give you that  could help?
translation: 也许你应该进一步调查那些洞穴？你和昂加杜鲁谈过了吗？他也许能给你一些可能有帮助的信息？

english: The 'Vacu' were priests who summoned the spirits of our ancestors. But the priests were enslaved by the evil spirits of the underworld. It is but a myth, perhaps a story told to scare badly behaved children.
translation: ‘瓦库’是召唤我们祖先灵魂的祭司。但那些祭司被地底世界的恶灵奴役了。这不过是个传说，也许是个用来吓唬不听话孩子的故事。

english: Since they died trying to find the source of the stream, they are cursed to guard it for all eternity. The first to seek the source was said to be a high level sorcerer. He created a powerful spell in the caves.
translation: 由于他们为了寻找溪流的源头而死，他们被诅咒永远守卫它。据说第一个寻找源头的人是一位高级魔法师。他在洞穴中创造了一个强大的法术。

english: Well, it requires pure sacred water for it to grow. It is a very special tree...
translation: 嗯，它需要纯净的圣水才能生长。这是一棵非常特别的树……

english: Now, all those who venture near are overcome by a supernatural fear. With all my heart Bwana, I would never go near such a place.
translation: 现在，所有靠近的人都会被一种超自然的恐惧所压倒。我真心实意地说，先生，我绝不会靠近那种地方。

english: It could all just be a myth! You should perhaps talk to Ungadulu, he may know something? Perhaps there is another way to get to the source of the stream? But I am not sure where it is...
translation: 这可能只是个传说！你应该和昂加杜鲁谈谈，他也许知道些什么？也许有别的办法可以到达溪流的源头？但我不确定它在哪……

english: Sorry Bwana, but I shouldn't be talking to you.
translation: 抱歉，先生，我不应该和你说话。

english: Hmm, that sounds strange. But it looks like the Shaman has lost his mind. I am sorry Bwana, but it looks like I've sent you on a fools errand. My apologies Bwana.
translation: 嗯，听起来很奇怪。但看起来萨满已经疯了。对不起，先生，看来我让你白跑了一趟。我向你道歉，先生。

english: Search the caves and try to talk to Ungadulu, there may be some clues to be had by searching all the items in the cave...
translation: 搜索洞穴，试着和昂加杜鲁谈谈，搜索洞穴里所有的物品可能会找到一些线索……

english: Very good Bwana... however, it begs the question... What are you doing in the Kharazi Jungle?
translation: 很好，先生……不过，这引出了一个问题……你在卡拉兹丛林做什么？

english: I am sorry Bwana, but I have no experience of these things. I am sure that I would get in your way...
translation: 对不起，先生，我对这些事情没有经验。我肯定会碍你的事……

english: Just that everything is fine in the jungle with us. And that we are grateful to you for your help.
translation: 只是想告诉你，我们在丛林里一切都好。而且我们很感激你的帮助。

english: Well, there is a pool of water that is sacred to us. It contains pure water, but I am not sure why he needs this. Perhaps you should go back and talk to him again and get more information.
translation: 嗯，有一池对我们来说很神圣的水。里面是纯净的水，但我不确定他为什么需要这个。也许你应该回去再跟他谈谈，获取更多信息。

english: Good day Bwana. The Kharazi Jungle is especially beautiful today isn't it? My village people pass on their thanks to you.
translation: 日安，先生。今天的卡拉兹丛林格外美丽，不是吗？我的村民们向你转达他们的谢意。

english: My people are all happy living in the jungle. They are still afraid of strangers and will not approach but they are around, none the less.
translation: 我的人民在丛林里都过得很开心。他们仍然害怕陌生人，不会靠近，但他们就在附近，无论如何。

english: Ardrigal is often found growing near to large groups of palms. Such a collection exists in the north.
translation: 阿德里加草通常生长在大片棕榈树附近。北方就有这样一片。

english: Your story has been woven into the fabric of our society. And we all sing your many praises Bwana.
translation: 你的故事已经融入了我们社会的结构之中。我们都歌颂你的许多功绩，先生。

english: Yes Bwana. I can take you to the edge of the Kharazi Jungle. Would you like me to take you?
translation: 是的，先生。我可以带你去卡拉兹丛林的边缘。你想让我带你去吗？

english: Well, they were still there the last time I checked... Go as far to the west in the Kharazi Jungle as you can, until you reach the sea, then walk eastwards with the barrier rocks to the north.
translation: 嗯，我上次检查时它们还在那里……尽可能往卡拉兹丛林西边走，直到你到达海边，然后沿着屏障岩石向北向东走。

english: If you head east out of Tai Bwo Wannai village you should come across them. The herb grows in the shade of the palm so check carefully.
translation: 如果你从泰博瓦纳村往东走，应该会遇到它们。这种草药生长在棕榈树的阴凉处，所以要仔细检查。

english: Snake weed is usually found in swampy marshy areas. It is not very common and it may be quite difficult to find. There is some marsh to the south of Tai Bwo Wannai village. Near to where the river becomes the
translation: 蛇草通常生长在沼泽地区。它不太常见，可能很难找到。泰博瓦纳村南边有一些沼泽。就在河流入海处附近。

english: I'll take those Yommi tree seeds to Ungadulu, I'm sure he'll appreciate them.
translation: 我会把这些约米树种子带给昂加杜鲁，我相信他会很感激的。

english: Walk past the covered pass and you'll find some rocks on slightly elevated ground. You'll find the caves there.
translation: 走过有顶的通道，你会在地势稍高的地方找到一些岩石。你会在那里找到洞穴。

english: sea.
translation: 大海。

english: The herb grows near jungle vines, so check all around very carefully.
translation: 这种草药生长在丛林藤蔓附近，所以要非常仔细地检查周围。

english: Hello Bwana, I see that you already have a blessed golden bowl. Have you fallen under the spell of the metal of the sun? Alas, I cannot allow you to bless the vessel if you're possessed by greed.
translation: 你好，先生，我看到你已经有一个被祝福的金碗了。你是否被太阳金属的咒语所迷惑？唉，如果你被贪婪所支配，我不能让你祝福这个容器。

english: That's great Bwana, good luck with your quest and take care!
translation: 太好了，先生，祝你的任务好运，保重！

english: I am sorry Bwana, my people have scattered throughout the Kharazi Jungle. Without the totem pole to allay their fears, I believe it is impossible to collect them together as a group.
translation: 我很抱歉，先生，我的人民已经分散在卡拉兹丛林各处。没有图腾柱来消除他们的恐惧，我相信不可能把他们聚集在一起。

english: Yes Bwana, perhaps we will become friends sometime in the future... But not today... Ungadulu has problably lost his mind anyway...  It is most likely a lost cause...
translation: 是的，先生，也许我们将来会成为朋友……但不是今天……昂加杜鲁可能已经失去理智了……这很可能是个徒劳的尝试……

english: Good day Bwana, it's always good to see you.
translation: 日安，先生，见到你总是很高兴。

english: Well, that wasn't very nice of you. It took us a long time to make that Totem pole. Luckily, I made another one at the same time.
translation: 嗯，你那样做可不太好。我们花了很长时间才做好那根图腾柱。幸运的是，我同时做了另一根。

english: Well, I have heard that name before, perhaps from the eldars.
translation: 嗯，我以前听说过这个名字，也许是从长老们那里。

english: Ah, yes, I think that is the name of the wizard who first went in search of the source. Be wary of him Bwana, he may try to trick you.
translation: 啊，是的，我想那就是第一个去寻找源头的魔法师的名字。当心他，老兄，他可能会试图欺骗你。

english: Hmmm, well I don't see them. Why not go and see Ungadulu and see if you can get some more.
translation: 嗯，我没看到它们。为什么不去找昂加杜鲁，看看能不能再弄一些呢？

english: I am sorry to say that I don't Bwana. You will need to explore that area, but use your wits, and you may be lucky.
translation: 很抱歉，我不知道，先生。你需要探索那个区域，但要用点智慧，也许你会走运的。

english: A temple? There's an old dungeon in the south east corner of the jungle. Could this be what you seek Bwana?
translation: 一座神庙？丛林东南角有一个古老的地牢。这是你要找的吗，先生？

english: I must warn you Bwana, that place is dangous. Many of our people have entered and never returned.
translation: 我必须警告你，先生，那个地方很危险。我们很多人进去后就再也没有回来。

english: We would be very grateful and would be pleased to develop friendly relations with you. Do this thing for us all, my people would be very happy.
translation: 我们会非常感激，并很高兴与你发展友好关系。为我们所有人做这件事，我的人民会非常高兴。

english: Greetings bwana... Many thanks for defeating the demon... and releasing me from this dreadful possession... Pray tell me, what can I do to repay this great favour?
translation: 你好，先生……非常感谢你击败了恶魔……让我摆脱这可怕的附身……请告诉我，我能做些什么来报答这份恩情？

english: Oh, yes, Bwana... you will be doing a great favour to our people by doing this. However, you must know that it is a difficult task, the Yommi tree is difficult to grow.
translation: 哦，是的，先生……你这样做对我们族人来说是一个巨大的恩惠。但你必须知道，这是一项艰巨的任务，约米树很难种植。

english: Here you are, accept these with my gratitude. You'll need to soak them in sacred water before planting them. I notice that you must already be familiar with sacred water to have passed into the flaming octagram.
translation: 给你，带着我的感激收下这些。种植前你需要将它们浸泡在圣水中。我注意到你肯定已经熟悉圣水了，才能穿过火焰八角星。

english: Please come no closer... the flames will incinerate you.
translation: 请不要再靠近了……火焰会将你烧成灰烬。

english: Please, leave now...
translation: 请离开吧……

english: You must have a natural ability with such things to have a chance...
translation: 你必须在这类事情上拥有天赋才能有机会……

english: Please don't try to extinguish...
translation: 请不要试图扑灭……

english: ...from the above lands... hurry and release me...
translation: ……来自上面的土地……快释放我……

english: Curse you foul intruder... 'Ere near to death ye come now that ye has meddled in my dealings..
translation: 诅咒你，卑鄙的入侵者……你胆敢干涉我的勾当，这下离死不远了……

english: Hurry, Vacu, the heat kills me... ha ha ha
translation: 快点，瓦库，热量快把我烤死了……哈哈哈

english: Yes, douse the flames with water, pure water... foo...
translation: 是的，用水浇灭火焰，纯净的水……傻瓜……

english: Leave here, please, go... now...
translation: 离开这里，拜托，走吧……现在……

english: My sincerest pleasure Bwana...
translation: 这是我的荣幸，先生……

english: Please, leave now... don't listen to me... I beg you, leave now,  don't touch the flames...
translation: 请离开吧……别听我的……我求你，离开吧，不要碰那些火焰……

english: I will remain here in the protection of the flaming Octagram and continue my research into the spirit world. I am somewhat of an authority with my recent experience!
translation: 我会留在这里，在火焰八角星的保护下，继续研究灵魂世界。以我最近的经历，我算得上是个权威了！

english: Use this spell on the Spirit. It will force the spirit to show its true self. And it will also be vulnerable to normal attacks.
translation: 对这个灵魂使用这个法术。它会迫使灵魂显露出真身。同时它也会对普通攻击变得脆弱。

english: This dagger has been made for one purpose only...  Praise the gods that you brought it to me.
translation: 这把匕首只有一个用途……感谢神灵你把它带给了我。

english: How did you get this Bwana?
translation: 你是怎么得到这个的，先生？

english: I am Ungadulu, trapped here many years now... Leave these caves and save yourself...
translation: 我是昂加杜鲁，被困在这里很多年了……离开这些洞穴，救救你自己吧……

english: But do remember me from time to time and come to visit an old man. You never know, I may be able to  help you in the future, and repay you the favour  of releasing me from that terrible Demon...
translation: 但请记得时不时来看看我这个老人。你永远不知道，也许将来我能帮到你，报答你把我从那个可怕的恶魔手中解救出来的恩情……

english: I can make you a spell with this item which will force the spirit to reveal its true self. Once activated, you will be able to attack it like any normal creature.
translation: 我可以利用这件物品为你制作一个法术，它会让灵魂显露出真身。激活后，你就可以像攻击任何普通生物一样攻击它了。

english: Wait... get pure water from the pool... above lands...
translation: 等等……从水池里取纯净水……上面的土地……

english: A good question Bwana, but it is essentially quite simple. First you will need to soak the seeds in some pure water. This will help to germinate the seed and begin the growing process.
translation: 好问题，先生，但原理其实很简单。首先你需要把种子浸泡在纯净水中。这有助于种子发芽，开始生长过程。

english: Please run for your life...
translation: 请快逃命吧……

english: Run, run away... Run like the leopard Bwana!
translation: 快跑，快逃……像豹子一样跑吧，先生！

english: The Yommi tree is sacred and is also slightly magical. You need to seek out a patch of fertile earth. Such places are located around the jungle and should give the Yommi tree a good chance of survival.
translation: 约米树是神圣的，也带有一点魔法。你需要找到一块肥沃的土壤。这样的地方分布在丛林周围，应该能给约米树一个很好的生长机会。

english: Please Bwana, don't listen to me... run, save yourself...
translation: 拜托，先生，别听我的……快跑，保全自己……

english: The tree should show some remarkable growth quite early but will slow down, you may be able to speed the process up by watering the tree with more pure water, although it can be difficult to find it.
translation: 这棵树应该在早期生长显著，但之后会变慢。你可以用更多的纯净水浇灌它来加速生长，尽管很难找到纯净水。

english: Take more care of these this time around.
translation: 这次要更小心地保管它们。

english: Blessings on you Bwana. Did you manage to get the sacred water?
translation: 愿神祝福你，先生。你弄到圣水了吗？

english: Hello Bwana, how goes your quest to find the water?
translation: 你好，先生，你寻找圣水的进展如何？

english: I hope that teaches you a lesson!
translation: 希望这能给你一个教训！

english: Hmmm, the pure water is sacred to us. It is from a sacred spring which is fed from deep underground.
translation: 嗯，纯净之水对我们来说是神圣的。它来自一个神圣的泉水，由地下深处供给。

english: Legend has it that the spring is protected by spirits of long dead adventurers who went in search of the source of the spring. It is likely a myth and the source of the spring is buried deep underground with no paths
translation: 传说泉水由早已死去的冒险者灵魂守护，他们曾去寻找泉水的源头。这很可能是个神话，泉水的源头深埋地下，没有任何路径可通

english: to it.
translation: 通往那里。

english: Ha, ha ha Vacu... Come for me again and you'll taste more of my power!
translation: 哈哈，瓦库……再来找我，你会尝到我更多力量！

english: You already have some Yommi tree seeds, use those first... and let me know how you get along.
translation: 你已经有一些约米树种子了，先用那些……然后告诉我进展如何。

english: Blessings on you Bwana. Did you use the spell and kill the spirit? Do you have the sacred water yet?
translation: 愿神祝福你，先生。你用那个法术杀死灵魂了吗？弄到圣水了吗？

english: Hello Bwana, how goes your quest with the Yommi tree?
translation: 你好，先生，你的约米树任务进展如何？

english: That sounds very strange Bwana, I'm glad to see you didn't commit such a foul act. I can make a spell that would help you to defeat the spirit. But I need an item that belongs to the spirit to make it work.
translation: 听起来很奇怪，先生，很高兴看到你没有犯下如此卑劣的行径。我可以制作一个法术来帮你击败灵魂。但我需要一件属于那个灵魂的物品来制作它。

english: If you have something like that, please show it to me and I'll give you the spell. Beware of everything in these caves, I was tricked very easily and was enslaved, as you well know. Learn from my example.
translation: 如果你有这样的东西，请给我看看，我就给你法术。小心这些洞穴里的一切，我很容易就被骗了，被奴役了，你也知道。以我为鉴。

english: You did well to come to me Bwana. As I said before, I am an expert in spirits of the underworld. In most circumstances you should just ignore them. However, beware as many spirits will try to trick you.
translation: 你来找我是对的，先生。正如我之前说的，我是冥界灵魂的专家。大多数情况下你应该忽略它们。但小心，很多灵魂会试图欺骗你。

english: That is truly great Bwana... Well done! You have the spirit of the jungle lion.
translation: 真是太棒了，先生……干得好！你拥有丛林之狮的灵魂。

english: Great Bwana, now go plant them in the fertile soil. You should soon have a great Yommi tree worthy of a most marvelous totem pole.
translation: 太好了，先生，现在去把它们种在肥沃的土壤里。你应该很快就能拥有一棵伟大的约米树，足以制作最出色的图腾柱。

english: Above ground and spaced out throughout the whole jungle area are specially cultivated fertile soil areas. Seek one out and plant the Yommi tree in that. Be prepared to water it though...
translation: 在地面上，整个丛林区域散布着一些专门培育的肥沃土壤区域。找一个这样的地方，把约米树种在那里。不过要做好浇水的准备……

english: Well, you should be able to plant the Yommi tree. And then water it with the sacred water. You should then be able to start making the Totem pole.
translation: 嗯，你应该能种下约米树了。然后用圣水浇灌它。之后你就可以开始制作图腾柱了。

english: I know something about them, especially magical daggers. If you have a specific one, show it to me and I'll help as much as I can.
translation: 我对它们有所了解，尤其是魔法匕首。如果你有一把特定的，给我看看，我会尽力帮忙。

english: That's truly a miracle Bwana, very few come out of Viyeldi's caves alive. And you managed to defeat Nezikchened a second time? You are truly a legend bwana. Do you have the sacred water as well?
translation: 这真是个奇迹，先生，很少有人能从维耶尔迪的洞穴活着出来。你居然第二次击败了内齐克切内德？你真是个传奇，先生。你弄到圣水了吗？

english: Ha, ha ha! There's no need to use that on me anymore... I'm cured now, remember...
translation: 哈哈哈！现在没必要再对我用那个了……我已经好了，记得吗……

english: So long as you have banished the spirit and managed to get some of the sacred water. Let us pray that we have seen the last of that evil!
translation: 只要你驱逐了灵魂并弄到了一些圣水。让我们祈祷那邪恶之物不再出现！

english: Well, good luck with your quest Bwana. You may find it worthwhile exploring these catacombs. There is said to be an entrance to the Viyeldi caves, which is where the sacred source of the magic pool exists.
translation: 嗯，祝你好运，先生。探索这些地下墓穴也许会有收获。据说有一个入口通往维耶尔迪洞穴，那里就是魔法水池的神圣源头所在。

english: It is said that the caves where the stream is located, are littered with strange remains of a past civilisation. The dwarves are said to have excavated the area in search of the source of the sacred water.
translation: 据说溪流所在的洞穴里散落着一个过去文明的奇怪遗迹。据说矮人曾挖掘过该区域，寻找圣水的源头。

english: Beware though as it is said that the area is cursed. Anyone who is killed seeking the sacred water, will forever be sworn to protect its secret.
translation: 但要小心，据说那个区域被诅咒了。任何在寻找圣水时被杀的人，将永远发誓守护它的秘密。

english: Something bad must have happened because soon the area was cursed. Anyone who entered the area looking for the source of the water, and who died, would be forever cursed to protect the water......Forever...
translation: 一定发生了什么可怕的事，因为很快那个区域就被诅咒了。任何进入该区域寻找水源并死去的人，将永远被诅咒守护水源……永远……

english: Oh dear Bwana. Poor Viyeldi's spirit is trapped inside this weapon. No doubt the evil spirit that told you to kill Viyeldi is planning to use it for some vile purpose.
translation: 哦天哪，先生。可怜的维耶尔迪的灵魂被困在这件武器里。毫无疑问，那个让你杀死维耶尔迪的恶灵正打算用它来做某种邪恶勾当。

english: I see you have no totem pole, or Yommi tree seeds, is everything ok?
translation: 我注意到你没有图腾柱，也没有约米树种子，一切都还好吗？

english: I will try to release Viyeldi's spirit from the dagger. But it is far from certain that I will succeed.
translation: 我会尝试将维耶尔迪的灵魂从匕首中释放出来。但成功与否还远不能确定。

english: Oh dear Bwana, I sense something terrible has happened. This dagger is a portent of some evil action. Please, reveal to me anything that you have done so that I might understand this better.
translation: 哦天哪，先生，我感觉到发生了什么可怕的事。这把匕首是某种邪恶行为的预兆。请告诉我你所做的一切，以便我更好地理解这件事。

english: Poor Viyeldi, he was the guardian of the dead heroes that protected the source. Their tormented spirits will now be at the beck and call of the one who gave you the dagger.
translation: 可怜的维耶尔迪，他是守护水源的已故英雄的守护者。他们受苦的灵魂现在将听命于给你匕首的那个人。

english: Take this spell and pray that you can defeat this evil spirit before it's too late. The spell will force the spirit to reveal its true self. And it will also be vulnerable to normal attacks.
translation: 拿上这个法术，祈祷你能在来不及之前击败这个恶灵。这个法术会迫使灵魂显露出真身。同时它也会对普通攻击变得脆弱。

english: Why on earth did you do that?---The Shaman screams at you---
translation: 你到底为什么这么做？——萨满对你尖叫道——

english: Bwana, you have been tricked by a spirit! And you have done the worst thing imaginable. Viyeldi was the sorcerer who controlled the Heroes who protect the source.
translation: 先生，你被一个灵魂欺骗了！而且你做了最糟糕的事。维耶尔迪是控制着守护水源的英雄们的巫师。

english: Here, you take this spell...
translation: 给你，拿上这个法术……

english: Blessings on you Bwana. Have you managed to deal with the spirit? Do you have the water?
translation: 愿神祝福你，先生。你处理掉那个灵魂了吗？你弄到圣水了吗？

english: The spirits of these heroes are now free to be controlled by other, more powerful evil forces. Most likely the spirit that tricked you.
translation: 这些英雄的灵魂现在可以被其他更强大的邪恶力量控制了。很可能是那个欺骗你的灵魂。

english: This is great news Bwana, you've done really well. Perhaps we can start to rally our people together now. And live once again without fear in the jungle.
translation: 这是个好消息，先生，你做得很好。也许我们现在可以开始召集我们的人民了。再次在丛林中无忧无虑地生活。

english: Well, Bwana, you can simply replace the corrupted totem pole with the good one you have created. This will make my people very happy.
translation: 嗯，先生，你只需用你制作的好图腾柱替换掉被腐蚀的那个。这会让我的族人非常高兴。

english: Many thanks Bwana, my people are truly grateful. Have you seen Gujuo? I am sure that he may have something for you as a token of our appreciation.
translation: 非常感谢，老兄，我的人民真的很感激。你见过古朱奥吗？我相信他可能会给你点东西，作为我们的一点心意。

english: If you have killed him for the third time, then you have banished him from our world completely. This is indeed a legendary accomplishment Bwana, you should feel proud.
translation: 如果你第三次杀了他，那么你就彻底把他从我们的世界中驱逐了。这确实是传奇般的成就，先生，你应该感到自豪。

english: You have done well, Bwana, to have succeeded where so many others have failed. You are a true Legend Bwana.
translation: 你做得很好，先生，在众多失败者中成功了。你是一个真正的传奇，先生。

english: I am not sure at this time Bwana. Give me a few moments to think.
translation: 我现在不确定，先生。给我一点时间想想。

english: Hmmm, that sounds odd. I'm sure that Gujuo will tell you the same as me though. Searching for the source of the water pool will be difficult. However, with some help, it might be possible.
translation: 嗯，听起来有点奇怪。但我相信古朱奥会告诉你跟我一样的事情。寻找水池的源头会很困难。不过，有一些帮助的话，也许有可能。

english: Vile serpent, you'll pay for that!
translation: 邪恶的毒蛇，你会为此付出代价的！

english: ...What, what happened?, Why am I all wet?
translation: ……什么，发生了什么？我怎么浑身湿透了？

english: There is said to be a stream of the sacred water that exists underground. I'm sure that Gujuo will tell you quite a lot about it.
translation: 据说有一条圣水溪流存在于地下。我相信古朱奥会告诉你很多关于它的事情。

english: And even fewer have been returned alive if they did solve it. You can try to explore these caverns, it may help. You may just be able to find the Viyeldi caves. That is where the source of the sacred water resides.
translation: 即使有人解开了谜题，活着回来的人也很少。你可以试着探索这些洞穴，也许有帮助。你也许能找到维耶尔迪洞穴。那里就是圣水的源头所在。

english: I have not explored outside of this room, but I have heard that there is a huge metallic door of strange construction within these catacombs which challenges any person with a riddle. Very few have solved the riddle.
translation: 我没有探索过这个房间以外的区域，但我听说这些地下墓穴中有一扇巨大的金属门，结构奇特，会用一个谜题考验任何人。很少有人能解开那个谜题。

english: Take this spell and pray that you can defeat this evil spirit before it's too late. I'll take that dagger from you now!
translation: 拿上这个法术，祈祷你能在来不及之前击败这个恶灵。我现在就从你那里拿走那把匕首！

english: You have released me from the Demons grasp but for a short while. You need to find the book of binding, he has hidden it in the catacombs...
translation: 你暂时把我从恶魔的掌控中解救了出来。你需要找到束缚之书，他把它藏在了墓穴里……

english: Many trials before you reach the crystal pools, which lies beyond a puzzling door.
translation: 在到达水晶池之前要经过许多考验，水晶池在一扇令人费解的门后面。

english: I could make a spell that would help you to defeat the spirit. But I need you to bring me a possession that it once owned. If you have something like that, please show it to me. And I'll give you the spell.
translation: 我可以制作一个法术来帮你击败灵魂。但我需要你带来一件它曾经拥有的物品。如果你有这样的东西，请给我看看。我就给你法术。

english: Well, that is strange. I sense a growing evil power since you visited the caves.
translation: 嗯，这很奇怪。自从你去了洞穴之后，我感觉到一股邪恶力量在增长。

english: Use the Holy Force spell that I gave you earlier to defeat this spirit. Good luck. I'll take that dagger for safe keeping...
translation: 用我之前给你的圣力法术来击败这个灵魂。祝你好运。我会保管那把匕首以确保安全……

english: Blessings on you Bwana. Do you have the sacred water yet?
translation: 愿神祝福你，先生。你弄到圣水了吗？

english: You can use that Holy Force spell to try and defeat the spirit. Come back and let me know if I can help in any other way.
translation: 你可以用那个圣力法术尝试击败灵魂。回来告诉我，我是否还能以其他方式帮忙。

english: This sword is a symbol of your exploration of the Wilderness. Speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 10 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.
translation: 这把剑是你探索荒野的象征。每天到魔法竞技场找伦代尔说话，可以领取10枚免费符文，而且你可以从荒野拉杆传送至边陲镇或阿多尼城。

translation: 我已经为你升级了你的荒野之剑。曼德里思会给你进入资源区20%的折扣，你会更快砍倒树人，还能在荒野深处的某个地下城中使用一个捷径。你还可以

english: now own 4 ecumenical keys and receive 20 runes a day from Lundail.
translation: 现在拥有4把教会钥匙，并且每天从伦代尔那里获得20枚符文。

english: noted and Lundail will give you 50 free runes per day and the rate at which you catch Dark Crabs has been increased.
translation: 票据形式，伦代尔每天会给你50枚免费符文，并且捕捉黑暗螃蟹的速度提升了。

english: If you complete all of the easy tasks in the Wilderness, you can speak to Lundail at the Mage Arena every day to receive 10 free runes and you can teleport to either Edgeville or Ardougne from the Wilderness lever.

english: Ah, you would like to be able to bury them on the spot! Would you like to receive non noted bones?
translation: 啊，你想当场就能埋掉它们！你想要接收非票据形式的骨头吗？

translation: 你可以拥有5把教会钥匙，使用通往熔岩龙岛的捷径，而且伦代尔每天会给你30枚免费符文。你还可以以银行票据形式从荒野中的生成点隔空抓取扎莫拉克葡萄酒，

english: keys at once and receive 20 runes a day from Lundail.
translation: 同时拥有钥匙，并且每天从伦代尔那里获得20枚符文。

english: Very well, come speak with me if you change your mind.
translation: 很好，如果你改变主意，随时来找我。

english: Very well, I have done that for you. Come speak with me again if you change your mind.
translation: 很好，我已经帮你办好了。如果你改变主意，再来找我。

english: Ah, you would like to be able to carry lots of them! Bones in paper form is very convenient for that, do you want to receive noted lava dragon bones?
translation: 啊，你想能携带很多骨头！纸形式的骨头非常方便携带，你想接收票据形式的熔岩龙骨头吗？

english: I see ya got 10 tentacles there. Do ya want me to hold onto 'em for ya? For every 10 ya gives me, I'll enhance a trident for ya.
translation: 我看到你有10根触手。想让我帮你保管吗？每给我10根，我就帮你强化一次三叉戟。

english: If ya brings me a trident, I can enhance it for ya. It'll store 20,000 charges, not just 2,500. Ya brought me 10 tentacles; I'll use up 10 of 'em to do the job.
translation: 如果你给我一把三叉戟，我可以帮你强化它。它能储存20,000次充能，而不是只有2,500次。你带来了10根触手；我会用掉其中的10根来做这件事。

english: In this area, I expect players to only attack their Slayer Assignment.
translation: 在这个区域，我希望玩家只攻击他们的杀戮任务目标。

english: Hey, don't stick that too near the waterfiends - they don't like it!
translation: 嘿，别把那东西靠水魔太近——它们可不喜欢！

translation: 再给我8根触手，然后把你的三叉戟给我，我就开始帮你干活。

translation: 像突刺和斩击这样的侵略性攻击会提升你的力量技能；你命中的次数会减少，但一旦命中，造成的伤害通常会更高。

english: Lastly, the Defensive Block style of combat will help you take less damage, and expand your knowledge of Defence.
translation: 最后，防御性的格挡战斗方式能帮助你减少受到的伤害，并增加你对防御的知识。

english: from it!
translation: 从中获益！

english: If you're just starting out you can use the training dummies in Varrock to get a little Attack experience. Personally I prefer splatting monsters; much more satisfying, especially when you get to make a profit
translation: 如果你刚开始玩，可以用维洛克城的训练假人获得一些攻击经验。就我个人而言，我更喜欢痛扁怪物；那样爽多了，特别是还能赚到钱的时候。

english: Great, to set your Attack skill to level 1, it will cost 2,500,000 coins. Are you sure you want to continue?
translation: 好的，把你的攻击技能降到1级需要花费2,500,000金币。你确定要继续吗？

english: Sorry, you'll need to remove all of your equipment in order for me to lower your levels.
translation: 抱歉，你需要脱掉所有装备，我才能降低你的等级。

english: Well let me see now...There are stabbing type weapons such as daggers, then you have swords which are slashing, maces that have great crushing abilities, battle axes which are powerful and spears which can be good
translation: 嗯，让我想想……有匕首这样的刺击类武器，然后是剑（挥砍类），钉锤（有很强的碾压能力），战斧（威力强大），还有矛（也不错）

english: It depends a lot on how you want to fight. Experiment and find out what is best for you. Never be scared to try out a new weapon; you never know, you might like it! Why, I tried all of them for a while and settled on
translation: 这在很大程度上取决于你想怎么战斗。多尝试一下，找到最适合你的。永远不要害怕尝试新武器；说不定你会喜欢上它呢！你看，我把所有武器都试了一段时间，最后才决定用这把

english: for Defence and many forms of Attack.
translation: 用于防御和多种形式的攻击。

english: The Cape of Defence will act as ring of life, saving you from combat if your hitpoints become low. Is there something else I can help you with, perhaps?
translation: 防御斗篷会像生命戒指一样，在你生命值过低时救你一命。还有其他我能帮你的吗？

english: this rather good sword!
translation: 这把相当不错的剑！

english: Ta-da, there you go [player name]! I've successfully completed your request. Take care now!
translation: 噔噔，搞定了，[player name]！我已经成功完成了你的请求。保重！

english: Great, to set your Defence skill to level 1, it will cost 2,500,000 coins. Are you sure you want to continue?
translation: 好的，把你的防御技能降到1级需要花费2,500,000金币。你确定要继续吗？

english: Great, to set your Strength skill to level 1, it will cost 2,500,000 coins. Are you sure you want to continue?
translation: 好的，把你的力量技能降到1级需要花费2,500,000金币。你确定要继续吗？

english: You already have a training sword.
translation: 你已经有了一把训练剑。

english: You could try venturing into the Wilderness I suppose... but that's only for warriors who are strong and fearless like me!
translation: 我想你可以尝试进入荒野……但那只适合像我这样强壮无畏的战士！

english: Great, to set your Prayer skill to level 1, it will cost 2,500,000 coins. Are you sure you want to continue?
translation: 好的，把你的祈祷技能降到1级需要花费2,500,000金币。你确定要继续吗？

english: Great, to set your Ranged skill to level 1, it will cost 2,500,000 coins. Are you sure you want to continue?
translation: 好的，把你的远程技能降到1级需要花费2,500,000金币。你确定要继续吗？

english: In the Wilderness you may attack other players that are within the level range specified on your screen. The further north you go, the larger this level range and the more people can attack you.
translation: 在荒野中，你可以攻击屏幕上指定等级范围内的其他玩家。你越往北走，这个等级范围就越大，能攻击你的人也越多。

english: You may attack other players there but bear in mind though that if you attack anyone who has not attacked you first, you will be 'skulled'.
translation: 你可以在那里攻击其他玩家，但请记住，如果你攻击了没有先攻击你的人，你头上会出现'骷髅'标记。

english: Sorry, you don't have enough coins for me to cover the cost of lowering your stat.
translation: 抱歉，你的金币不够我支付降低属性的费用。

english: Remember if you kill someone with good equipment on, you can pick that equipment up!
translation: 记住，如果你杀了一个装备精良的人，你可以捡起那些装备！

english: A skull and crossbones appears over your head, this remains for 20 minutes. If you die during this time you will lose everything, not keeping your three most expensive items as usual.
translation: 一个头骨和交叉骨头的图案会出现在你头顶，持续20分钟。如果你在此期间死亡，你会失去所有物品，不像往常那样能保留三件最贵的物品。

english: You already have a training shield.
translation: 你已经有了一面训练盾。

english: You have a training shield in your bank.
translation: 你的银行里有一面训练盾。

english: That was funny; you should be a comedian, not a warrior!
translation: 真有趣；你应该去当喜剧演员，而不是当战士！

english: Ahem... You could have fun duelling another player in the Arena near Al Kharid or assisting your team to capture the flag in Castle Wars. This will both help your combat skills and be fun!
translation: 嗯哼……你可以在阿尔卡里德城附近的竞技场与其他玩家决斗，或者在城堡战争中协助你的队伍夺取旗帜来获得乐趣。这既能提升你的战斗技能，也很有趣！

english: Castle Wars is located west of Yanille and the Duel Arena is north-east of Al Kharid.
translation: 城堡战争位于亚尼勒城西边，而决斗竞技场在阿尔卡里德城东北边。

english: Great, to set your Magic skill to level 1, it will cost 2,500,000 coins. Are you sure you want to continue?
translation: 好的，把你的魔法技能降到1级需要花费2,500,000金币。你确定要继续吗？

english: You have a training sword in your bank.
translation: 你的银行里有一把训练剑。

english: Now check your combat side-panel.
translation: 现在检查你的战斗侧面板。

english: Aha! I see you already know how to wield your sword and shield. Well done!
translation: 啊哈！看来你已经知道如何装备剑和盾了。干得好！

english: I have tried to convince him to stay, but he will not listen. He believes our mother is controlling us, keeping us close against our will.
translation: 我试图说服他留下，但他不听。他相信我们的母亲在控制我们，违背我们的意愿把我们留在身边。

english: He does not see that she only acts out of fear, fear that she might lose us. He wants me to join him, but I won't leave her behind.
translation: 他不明白她只是出于恐惧，害怕失去我们。他想让我加入他，但我不会抛下她。

english: She is our mother, our creator. We owe everything to her.
translation: 她是我们的母亲，我们的创造者。我们欠她一切。

english: She cries out for him, desperate for him to return to her. I've been trying my best to comfort her, but it has been little help.
translation: 她为他哭泣，绝望地希望他回到她身边。我一直尽力安慰她，但收效甚微。

english: In her desperation for him to return, she has created new life in his image. They are pale imitations though, shadows of him and I.
translation: 在她渴望他回来的绝望中，她以他的形象创造了新的生命。但它们只是苍白的模仿，是他和我的影子。

english: Their creation has been sapping her energy, and I fear she will grow too weak. All may not be lost though, for I may be able to convince them to sacrifice their energy and return it to her.
translation: 他们的创造正在消耗她的能量，我担心她会变得过于虚弱。不过也许并非全无希望，因为我可以说服他们将能量还给她。

english: She has been dreaming more and more often recently. As she dreams, more beings are manifested. While her initial creations held some intellect, the latest ones have been purely instinctual.
translation: 她最近做梦越来越频繁。当她做梦时，更多的存在被显化出来。虽然她最初的创造物还有一些智力，但最新的那些完全是凭本能行事。

english: She is clearly running out of energy and running out of time. The beings that sacrificed themselves for her slowed things down, but it hasn't been enough.
translation: 她显然能量和时日无多了。那些为她牺牲的存在延缓了进程，但这还远远不够。

english: I am left with no choice, for I am powerless to help her. I have to leave her, before it is too late.
translation: 我别无选择，因为我无力帮助她。我必须在为时已晚之前离开她。

english: It was not easy to leave her, but I knew I had no choice. Since my departure, I travelled far and wide, finding nothing but empty worlds, long since abandoned.
translation: 离开她并不容易，但我知道我别无选择。离开后，我走遍天涯海角，只找到一些早已被遗弃、空无一物的世界。

english: I almost gave up, but just as I was ready to stop, I came upon a world full of life. The creatures here, they are a joy to behold, living in harmony with each other and their home.
translation: 我几乎要放弃了，但就在我准备停下时，我来到了一个充满生命的世界。这里的生物真是赏心悦目，它们彼此和谐共处，与家园也和睦相处。

english: I approached them, fearful of how they would react to me. It soon became clear that there was no need for fear though. They fell in love with me, and I fell in love with them.
translation: 我走近它们，担心它们会如何反应。但很快就发现其实没必要害怕。它们爱上了我，我也爱上了它们。

english: At long last, I feel like I am home. Never shall I leave their side.
translation: 终于，我感觉像回到了家。我永远不会离开它们。

english: Greetings, [player name]. It is good to see you. Have you done much training with the Round Table Knights? It would be wise to take advantage of the reward Arthur has given you.
translation: 你好，[player name]。很高兴见到你。你和圆桌骑士们一起训练得怎么样了？最好能利用一下亚瑟赐予你的奖励。

english: Only melee combat is permitted in this training ground.
translation: 这个训练场只允许近战战斗。

english: But, alas, you have no space for it.
translation: 但是，唉，你这里没空间了。

english: My magic powers tell me that you have discovered the Grail! Take it to Arthur immediately!
translation: 我的魔法力量告诉我，你已经发现了圣杯！立刻把它带给亚瑟！

english: Well done freeing Arthur, [player name]. Now go and speak to him so he may reward you justly.
translation: 干得好，[player name]，你解放了亚瑟。现在去和他谈谈，让他公正地奖励你。

english: My second-cousin is always telling me that knowledge is power, so here is a bit of knowledge for you...
translation: 我的远房表亲总是告诉我知识就是力量，所以这里有点知识给你……

english: My birth certificate. Now. how can I be of help?
translation: 我的出生证书。现在，我能帮什么忙？

english: Of course. However, you don't have any space for it. Make some space and I'll give you one of my spare keys.
translation: 当然可以。但是，你这里没空间了。腾出些空间，我给你一把备用钥匙。

english: Don't worry, I am sure you will soon enough.
translation: 别担心，我相信你很快就会有的。

english: On your travels, if you should happen to meet a griffin, always remember that griffins love to hear of evil deeds and death and destruction. It reminds them of home, I guess.
translation: 在你的旅途中，如果你有幸遇到一只狮鹫，永远记住狮鹫喜欢听邪恶的勾当、死亡和毁灭。我猜这会让它们想起家。

english: Yes. And stay away from my tower!
translation: 是的。离我的塔远点！

english: I see. How utterly repulsive! Let me continue.
translation: 我明白了。真是令人作呕！让我继续说。

english: You are welcome, [player name]. And thank you for finding my pendant for me.
translation: 不客气，[player name]。也谢谢你帮我找到了我的吊坠。

english: Indeed. Perhaps you should talk to your dwarf friend now?
translation: 确实如此。也许你现在该和你的矮人朋友谈谈了？

english: Oi! Where d'you think you're going? Come and speak to me before you go wonderingthrough there. You'll get yourself killed!
translation: 喂！你以为你要去哪儿？在那边乱逛之前先过来跟我谈谈。你会送命的！

english: I have a spare Dizana's quiver.
translation: 我有一个多余的迪扎纳的箭袋。

english: Want to offer it for some sunfire splinters? Just be aware you won't get the quiver back if you do.
translation: 想用它换一些阳火碎片吗？不过你要知道，换了就拿不回箭袋了。

english: It doesn't actually look like you have enough space to carry 4,000 sunfire splinters. Come back when you have room.
translation: 看起来你实际上没有足够的空间携带4000个阳火碎片。等你有空位了再来吧。

english: I'm afraid none of the other stations are open, human.
translation: 恐怕其他站点都没有开放，人类。

english: Minecart rides are 50 coins.
translation: 乘坐矿车需要50金币。

english: The Arceuus station is just next to their Library, in the north of the town.
translation: 阿西乌斯城车站就在他们的图书馆旁边，位于城镇北部。

english: The Shayzien station is north of their Infirmaries, north east of the camp.
translation: 谢兹恩城车站位于他们的野战医院北边，营地的东北方向。

english: Excuse me, human, but I do not believe you have business here.
translation: 抱歉，人类，我不认为你在这里有事情要做。

english: The Quidamortem station is outside the city, far to the south-west, beyond the lizardmen territory.
translation: 奎达莫特姆站在城外，远西南方向，蜥蜴人领地的另一边。

english: The Piscarilius station is south of the town, next to a small mine.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯城站在城镇南边，一个小矿场旁边。

english: The Hosidius station is north of the Woodcutting Guild, west of the saltpetre mines.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城车站位于伐木公会北边，硝石矿的西边。

english: One of my stations still requires a control scroll.
translation: 我还有一个站点需要控制卷轴。

english: That's very nice, human, but put it away now.
translation: 那很好，人类，但现在请把它收起来。

english: Yay! I'm free!
translation: 耶！我自由了！

english: Mmmm - you shouldn't have!
translation: 嗯——你不该这样的！

english: Mmmm - bananas!
translation: 嗯——香蕉！

english: Mmmm - my favourite!
translation: 嗯——我的最爱！

english: Mmmm - thank you!
translation: 嗯——谢谢你！

english: Anyway. Please step inside, Sir.
translation: 总之。请进，先生。

english: Anyway. Please step inside, Miss.
translation: 总之。请进，女士。

english: Hello there. I haven't seen you before?
translation: 你好。我以前没见过你？

english: We need double the men to get this order out on time!
translation: 我们需要双倍的人手才能按时完成这个订单！

english: I've had enough of this!
translation: 我受够了！

english: No. I can stand here all day.
translation: 不。我可以在这里站一整天。

english: Right answer. I have to watch for imposters.
translation: 答对了。我得提防冒牌货。

english: True but if the gnomes are really going to take over Gielinor they'll need at least that.
translation: 没错，但如果地精真的要占领吉莱诺，他们至少需要那么多。

english: Hmm...in that case we'd better go to my office.
translation: 嗯……这样的话，我们最好去我的办公室。

english: What's Glough's favourite dish?
translation: 格劳夫最喜欢的菜是什么？

english: It seems you can't carry anymore. Come back when you have some space.
translation: 看来你拿不下了。等有空位了再来吧。

english: Really? That's odd, considering she died last year.
translation: 真的？那可真奇怪，毕竟她去年就死了。

english: You almost had me fooled!
translation: 你差点骗到我了！

english: No, it's alright laddy, we quite like it in here.
translation: 不，没关系小伙子，我们挺喜欢这里的。

english: No, it's alright lass, we quite like it in here.
translation: 不，没关系姑娘，我们挺喜欢这里的。

english: Hey look, he's come round!
translation: 嘿看，他醒过来了！

english: I think he knows that Lumo...
translation: 我想他知道那个卢莫...

english: Hey look, she's come round!
translation: 嘿看，她醒过来了！

english: I think she knows that Lumo...
translation: 我想她知道那个卢莫...

english: It's great to be back home, [player name].
translation: 回到家的感觉真好，[player name]。

english: I think we should give him a prize.
translation: 我想我们应该给他一个奖励。

english: I don't know you - go away!
translation: 我不认识你——走开！

english: I'm good, uncle!
translation: 我很好，叔叔！

english: Grrr ... Get out of my way.
translation: 呃……别挡路。

english: Let me out! I knew this was a trick!
translation: 放我出去！我就知道这是个诡计！

english: Haha! You think this cage can stop me?
translation: 哈哈！你以为这个笼子能拦住我？

english: Almost got it!
translation: 差一点就打开了！

english: They're starting to bend!
translation: 它们开始弯曲了！

english: *munch* *munch* This is a very good banana though.
translation: *咀嚼* *咀嚼* 不过这根香蕉真好吃。

english: I didn't do anything at all! All I wanted was a monkey- sized battle axe and when I found one, that human started yelling and throwing things at me.
translation: 我什么都没做！我只是想要一把猴子大小的战斧，当我找到一把时，那个人就开始大喊大叫，向我扔东西。

translation: 我不到上面去。万一另一船上的一只猴子看到我怎么办？

english: Eeek!  Eeek!  Ook!
translation: 吱！吱！呜！

english: Are we there yet??
translation: 我们到了吗？？

english: Not again...I just got the dye out of my fur from last time...
translation: 又来……我上次才把染料从毛皮上洗掉……

english: Hello there! I've never met a talking human!
translation: 你好啊！我从没见过会说话的人类！

english: Go away! I don't know you!
translation: 走开！我不认识你！

english: Uruk aka oook! Eeek aka, ahh aka ook.
translation: 乌鲁克阿卡乌克！伊克阿卡，啊阿卡乌克。

english: Ook ook!
translation: 乌克乌克！

english: Hello, madam.
translation: 你好，女士。

english: I think he seems trustworthy, sir.
translation: 我觉得他看起来值得信赖，先生。

english: Good day, visitor. You should work on retrieving the captive for Awowogei. He is beginning to doubt you.
translation: 日安，来访者。你应该努力为阿沃盖找回那个俘虏。他开始对你产生疑虑了。

english: Good day, visitor. You should speak to Awowogei.
translation: 日安，来访者。你应该和阿沃盖谈谈。

english: I need not remind you that I outrank Garkor. As of this instant, your orders are to convey the human to the atoll and remain there until he needs to return.
translation: 我无需提醒你，我的级别高于加科尔。从现在起，你的任务是把这个人类送到环礁，并在那里待到需要返回为止。

english: When reinitialisation has been completed, you are to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name] and accompany her on the mission.
translation: 等重新初始化完成后，你要和[player name]一起飞到卡拉姆詹岛南部，并陪同她执行任务。

english: When reinitialisation has been completed, you are to fly to the south of Karamja with [player name] and accompany him on the mission.

english: Decommission the shipyard ... I see. Well, we have had some seriously strong southerly winds of late. They may have been blown off course during flight.
translation: 关闭船厂……我明白了。嗯，最近我们遭遇了非常强烈的南风。它们可能在飞行中被吹离了航线。

english: I shall see personally to the decommission. You should report to the King immediately.
translation: 我会亲自处理关闭事宜。你应该立刻向国王报告。

english: Ignore him. My colleague's official mission was to look after a human in the area, but don't worry: it is probably dead already.
translation: 别理他。我同事的官方任务是照看区域内一个人类，不过别担心：那家伙大概已经死了。

english: Ignore her. My colleague's official mission was to look after a human in the area, but don't worry: it is probably dead already.
