translation: 干得好。你是个出色的士兵。如果你需要回猿猴岛，告诉我一声。

english: ... because you're going to get one.
translation: ……因为你会得到一个。

english: They have been posted to the Ape Atoll. They will remain there, working as undercover operatives.
translation: 他们已被派往猿猴岛。他们会留在那里，作为秘密特工行动。

english: Do not lose that sigil. Zooknock will use it to locate you.
translation: 别弄丢那个印记。祖克诺克会用它来定位你。

english: In case the threat of the monkeys rises again, which it likely will, we shall need them there. We would probably also need you.
translation: 万一那群猴子卷土重来，可能性很大，我们会需要在那边留有人手。可能也需要你在。

english: You are to safeguard him on this potentially dangerous mission.
translation: 你要在这趟可能有危险的任务中保护他。

english: Quite. He is now on a secret mission for the King.
translation: 正是。他现在正在为国王执行秘密任务。

english: The Royal Guard is composed of particularly elite soldiers who have proven themselves in battle. They are duty bound to protect the Grand Tree, its King and his interests.
translation: 皇家卫队由经过战斗证明自己的精锐士兵组成。他们职责所在，必须保护大树家园、其国王以及国王的利益。

english: We have matters to discuss before you return to the island.
translation: 在你回岛之前，我们有些事要谈谈。

english: You are to safeguard her on this potentially dangerous mission.
translation: 你要在这趟可能有危险的任务中保护她。

english: Quite. She is now on a secret mission for the King.
translation: 正是。她现在正在为国王执行秘密任务。

english: Do I look like a bank?
translation: 我看起来像银行吗？

english: I'll need you to carry something for me. Come back when you have some space.
translation: 我需要你帮我带点东西。等你有空位了再来找我。

english: Has the note I translated helped you find out what's going on?
translation: 我翻译的那张笔记帮你搞清楚怎么回事了吗？

english: I heard whispering coming from a third level in his tree! I managed to climb the first branch... *sob* But I'm not agile enough to get up the second...
translation: 我听到他树屋第三层传来低语声！我好不容易爬上了第一根树枝……*抽泣* 但我的敏捷不够，爬不上第二根……

english: Oh no, not again... Please, try to stop him before he does something crazy.
translation: 哦不，又来了……拜托，在他做出什么疯狂举动之前阻止他。

english: Please be more careful, here's another copy.
translation: 请小心点，这里还有一份副本。

english: Please take it to Glough this time!
translation: 这次请把它交给格劳夫！

english: You can't carry anymore. Come back when you have some space.
translation: 你拿不下了。等腾出空间再来吧。

english: Oh. Please get it back and take it to Glough!
translation: 哦。请把它拿回来，然后交给格劳夫！

english: Well, they do...I was a monk. But I'm so sick of living on this island! I want to explore new frontiers!
translation: 嗯，确实如此……我以前是个僧侣。但我实在受够了住在这个岛上！我想去探索新的天地！

english: Would you be able to grow a willow tree? It's sort of necessary for the experiments.
translation: 你能种一棵柳树吗？这对实验来说必不可少。

english: Oh dear. Well, come back to me when you can.
translation: 哦，天哪。好吧，等你准备好了再来找我。

english: I don't need that right now.
translation: 我现在不需要那个。

english: Have you acquired three sheets of papyrus, one ball of wool, one full sack of potatoes, and one unlit candle?
translation: 你拿到三张莎草纸、一个毛线球、一满麻袋土豆和一根未点燃的蜡烛了吗？

english: Hmm, you don't seem experienced enough. Maybe you should help some other people first.
translation: 嗯，你看起来经验还不够。也许你应该先去帮帮其他人。

english: You need level 20 Firemaking to fly the balloon.
translation: 你需要生火等级20才能驾驶热气球。

english: We have travelled in a way no man has travelled before! The next step will be to go where no men have gone before.
translation: 我们以史无前例的方式旅行了！下一步就是去往无人涉足之地。

english: You were a wonderful assistant, [player name]. You will go down in history as one of the first Gielinor balloonists.
translation: 你是个出色的助理，[player name]。你将作为吉列诺最早的热气球飞行员之一载入史册。

english: You better extinguish that candle. You might burn something!
translation: 你最好把那根蜡烛熄灭了。小心烧着东西！

english: The balloon is already built! We don't need any of those now.
translation: 热气球已经造好了！我们现在不需要那些东西了。

english: You already gave this to me.
translation: 你已经把这个给我了。

english: You still seem to have your cap.
translation: 你的帽子好像还在。

english: Open the gates! A monkey wishes to pass!
translation: 打开大门！有只猴子要过去！

english: Yes, captain?
translation: 是的，船长？

english: Ook. Ook Ah Uh! Ook Ook! Ook Ook!
translation: 乌克。乌克阿乌！乌克乌克！乌克乌克！

english: You are a brave one, human!
translation: 你真是个勇敢的人类！

english: What you do here, human? Get out of my sight!
translation: 你在这儿干什么，人类？滚出我的视线！

english: Go away, Keef have no time for little human!
translation: 走开，基夫没空理小人类！

english: As you wish, sir.
translation: 如您所愿，先生。

english: I'm afraid there has been an incident at the platform, it is off limits until further notice.
translation: 恐怕平台那里发生了一起事故，在另行通知之前禁止进入。

english: Don't listen to him Awowogei!
translation: 别听他的，阿沃盖！

english: Don't listen to her Awowogei!
translation: 别听她的，阿沃盖！

english: The king has no time for you right now.
translation: 国王现在没空见你。

english: Wow. I swear we've seen him 5 times already.
translation: 哇。我发誓我们已经见过他五次了。

english: Wow. I swear we've seen her 5 times already.
translation: 哇。我发誓我们已经见过她五次了。

english: Oh my god - he's been through here 10 times now.
translation: 哦天哪——他已经从这里经过十次了。

english: ... and that's how I saved Narnode from the fire- breathing gnome-eating lizard-dragon-king of Jool.
translation: ...就这样，我从朱尔的喷火吃地精蜥蜴龙之王手中救出了纳诺德。

english: Look at that Bunkdo, he almost looks like he's praying.
translation: 看看那个邦克多，他看起来像是在祈祷。

english: Oh my god - she's been through here 10 times now.
translation: 哦天哪——她已经从这里经过十次了。

english: Look at that Bunkdo, she almost looks like she's praying.
translation: 看看那个邦克多，她看起来像是在祈祷。

english: Take that back!
translation: 收回那句话！

english: I am sure Sergeant Garkor is working on a way to get us out of here.
translation: 我相信加科尔中士正在想办法带我们离开这里。

english: Not all of us were captured. If you have not done so, you should make contact with those of us who escaped.
translation: 我们并非所有人都被抓住了。如果你还没做的话，应该联系一下那些逃脱的人。

english: Well done, human! That was a most impressive display of skill.
translation: 干得好，人类！这真是令人印象深刻的技巧展示。

english: You don't look very much like a Karamjan monkey to me. It definitely will not fool Awowogei.
translation: 你看起来一点也不像卡拉姆詹猴。这绝对骗不了阿沃盖。

english: You should be tracking down Le Smith, hopefully he has information we can use.
translation: 你应该去找勒.史密斯，希望他有我们能用的情报。

english: Come back when you look like a Karamjan monkey, and hurry!
translation: 等你看起来像只卡拉姆詹猴再回来，快点！

english: Well done - you look just like a Karamjan monkey.
translation: 干得好——你看起来就像一只卡拉姆詹猴。

english: So he has been working with Kruk behind Awowogei's back...
translation: 所以他一直在阿沃盖背后跟克鲁克勾结……

english: I've already found one - you.
translation: 我已经找到一个了——就是你。

english: You have to stop whatever it is Kruk and Glough were up to, [player name].
translation: 你必须阻止克鲁克和格劳夫在搞的任何勾当，[player name]。

english: Very well. Return here when it is done.
translation: 很好。事情办完就回到这里。

english: I said come back when you look like a Karamjan monkey. You still look like a human to me...
translation: 我说了等你看起来像只卡拉姆詹猴再回来。在我看来你还是个人类……

english: You said you dealt with the airships,Mod Lars!
translation: 你说过你处理了那些飞艇，拉尔斯模组！

english: How dare you accuse me! I'm the head tree guardian!
translation: 你竟敢指责我！我可是首席树守护者！

english: Shut up and die!
translation: 闭嘴去死吧！

english: You may have defeated my demon, human, but don't think this is over!
translation: 你也许打败了我的恶魔，人类，但别以为这事就这么完了！

english: Where are those darn keys?
translation: 那些该死的钥匙在哪儿？

english: Nicely done.
translation: 做得好。

english: Good work.
translation: 干得好。

english: Okay, give me a moment to create the greegree.
translation: 好的，给我一点时间来制作格里格里。

english: Here you go, human. Be careful, Kruk was very powerful, we can't be sure how taking his form will affect you
translation: 给你，人类。小心点，克鲁克非常强大，我们不确定变成他的样子会对你有何影响。

english: Welcome back, human. Have you been able to get hold of Kruk's remains?
translation: 欢迎回来，人类。你拿到克鲁克的遗骸了吗？

english: We still need the monkey amulet mould and something to do with monkey speech.
translation: 我们还需要猴子护符模具和与猴子语言相关的东西。

english: We still need the monkey amulet mould.
translation: 我们还需要猴子护符模具。

english: We still need the gold bar and the monkey amulet mould.
translation: 我们还需要金锭和猴子护符模具。

english: We still need something to do with monkey speech.
translation: 我们还需要与猴子语言有关的东西。

english: You have already given me some monkey remains. Would you like me to use these instead?
translation: 你已经给了我一些猴子遗骸。你希望我用这些代替吗？

english: You have already given me a monkey talisman.
translation: 你已经给了我一个猴子护符。

english: You should speak to the Sergeant.
translation: 你应该去找中士谈谈。

english: Be careful with that [player name]!
translation: 小心那个[player name]！

english: It allows you to relive past memories. Memories that may be painful.
translation: 它能让你重温过去的记忆。那些可能是痛苦的记忆。

english: We don't have time for idle chat, [player name], there is still a mission to complete, did you need something?
translation: 我们没有时间闲聊，[player name]，还有任务要完成，你需要什么吗？

english: It is a powerful training tool, allowing you to learn from past mistakes, but it can also bring sadness and exhaustion.
translation: 它是一个强大的训练工具，让你从过去的错误中学习，但它也可能带来悲伤和疲惫。

english: Then get back to the mission!
translation: 那就回去执行任务吧！

english: I have already empowered that talisman.
translation: 我已经强化了那个护符。

english: Welcome back, human. Have you been able to get hold of Kruk's remains and a monkey talisman?
translation: 欢迎回来，人类。你拿到克鲁克的遗骸和一个猴子护符了吗？

english: You have already given me a gold bar.
translation: 你已经给了我一枚金锭。

english: You don't have enough space in your inventory.
translation: 你的背包空间不够。

english: You have already given me some dentures.
translation: 你已经给了我一些假牙。

english: There you go, [player name].
translation: 给你，[player name]。

english: I see you have an ancient skull with you, shall I create an ancient monkey talisman?
translation: 我看到你带着一个古代头骨，要不要我制作一个古代猴子护符？

english: That is disappointing, [player name]. Fortunately, I made a few spares as a precaution.
translation: 这令人失望，[player name]。幸运的是，我多做了几个备用。

english: Garkor sent word of your mission. I will require Kruk's remains and a monkey talisman.
translation: 加科尔传来了你任务的消息。我需要克鲁克的遗骸和一个猴子护符。

english: You have already given me the amulet mould.
translation: 你已经给了我护符模具。

english: But of course. The vision is prised from your own memory, ergo, it will be exactly as terrible as you remember it to have been.
translation: 当然。这个幻象是从你自己的记忆里提取出来的，因此，它会和你记忆中的一样糟糕。

english: Return once you have gathered the necessary materials and I shall create the greegree.
translation: 等你收集到必要材料后回来，我就会制作格里格里。

english: Quite why you would want to relive such memories again and again is completely beyond me.
translation: 我完全无法理解你为什么想要一遍又一遍地重温这样的记忆。

english: I hope you're right [player name].
translation: 希望你是对的，[player name]。

english: Welcome back, human. I believe your duties are required elsewhere.
translation: 欢迎回来，人类。我相信你还有其他职责需要履行。

english: What do you expect me to do with that? There's no banks round here.
translation: 你指望我用那个做什么？这附近没有银行。

english: However, you don't appear to have enough space in your inventory for it.
translation: 不过，你的背包似乎没有足够的空间来存放它。

english: Sorry, [player name], the king has sealed off access to the cavern for the time being.
translation: 抱歉，[player name]，国王暂时封锁了通往洞穴的通道。

english: Yes, I'd imagine so. Our kind are much more nimble than yours. I still don't know why you insist on using only two of your four legs.
translation: 是的，我想也是。我们同类比你们灵活得多。我还是不明白你们为什么坚持只用四条腿中的两条。

english: Some of us have learned to speak with your kind, yes. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed during this incident.
translation: 我们中有些学会了和你们交流，是的。我很感激在这次事件中我的追随者没有受到伤害。

english: Once again you have proven a friend to our kind, human. I appreciate that none of my followers were harmed.
translation: 你再次证明了自己是我们同类的朋友，人类。我很感激我的追随者没有受到伤害。

english: Please, feel free to talk to my new head of the guard, Duke, about advanced combat training, should you wish to receive it.
translation: 请随意和我的新任守卫队长公爵谈谈高级战斗训练，如果你愿意接受的话。

english: If these are to be believed then this is terrible!
translation: 如果这些是真的，那太可怕了！

english: Never! Not Glough! He's a good gnome at heart!
translation: 不可能！不会是格劳夫！他骨子里是个好地精！

english: Thank Guthix for your arrival!
translation: 感谢古斯，你终于来了！

english: Hazelmere is one of the mages that created the Grand Tree! He is the only one that has survived from that time. Take this bark sample to him, he will be able to help!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔是创造大树家园的法师之一！他是那个时代唯一幸存的人。把这份树皮样本带给他，他能帮上忙！

english: Traveller, Can I speak to you in strictest confidence?
translation: 旅行者，我能跟你私下谈谈吗？

english: Not here, follow me.
translation: 这里不方便，跟我来。

english: But it's not proof, any one could have made these. Traveller, I understand your concern, I had guards search Glough's house but they found nothing suspicious, just these odd twigs.
translation: 但这不能证明什么，任何人都能做出这些东西。旅者，我理解你的担忧，我派守卫搜查了格劳夫的房子，但没发现任何可疑物品，只有这些奇怪的树枝。

english: I..I don't know what to say! How could I have been so blind?!
translation: 我……我不知道该说什么！我怎么会这么瞎？！

english: It's incredible, the tree's health is improving already! I don't know what to say, we owe you so much!
translation: 不可思议，大树的健康状况已经在好转了！我不知道该说什么，我们欠你太多了！

english: I'll drink to that!
translation: 为这个干杯！

english: It's a translation book, you'll need it to translate what Hazelmere says. Do this carefully! His words are our only hope! You'll find his dwellings high upon a towering hill, on an island east of Yanille.
translation: 这是一本翻译书，你需要用它来翻译黑兹尔米尔说的话。小心行事！他的话是我们唯一的希望！他的住处在一座高耸的小山上，位于亚尼勒城东边的一个岛上。

english: Very few know of the secret mine under the Grand Tree. If you push on the roots just to my north they will seperate and let you pass.
translation: 很少有人知道大树家园下面的秘密矿洞。如果你推动我北边那些树根，它们会分开让你通过。

english: That's magic trees for you!
translation: 这就是魔法树的厉害之处！

english: The first task is to find out what's killing the tree.
translation: 首要任务是找出是什么在杀死这棵树。

english: Guard! Call off the military training!
translation: 守卫！取消军事训练！

english: To think Glough had me fooled all along!
translation: 没想到格劳夫一直在骗我！

english: From now on I vow to make this stronghold a welcoming place for all! I'll grant you access to all our facilities.
translation: 从现在起，我发誓要让这座要塞成为欢迎所有人的地方！我会让你使用我们所有的设施。

english: All the best Traveller and thanks again!
translation: 一路顺风，旅行者，再次感谢你！

english: A reward will have to wait though, the tree is still dying! The guards are clearing Glough's rock supply now but there must be more Daconia hidden somewhere in the roots! Help us search, we have little time!
translation: 不过奖励得等等，树还在枯萎！守卫们正在清理格劳夫的岩石储备，但树根里肯定还藏着更多达科尼亚石！帮我们一起搜索吧，我们时间不多了！

english: First I must warn the tree guardians. Please, could you tell the chief tree guardian Glough. He lives in a tree house just in front of the Grand Tree.
translation: 首先我得警告大树守护者。麻烦你去告诉首席大树守护者格劳夫。他住在大树家园前面的一间树屋里。

english: The Grand Tree's still slowly dying, if it is human sabotage we must respond!
translation: 大树家园还在缓慢凋零，如果是人类破坏，我们必须反击！

english: That may well be useful. Thank you - I may well call for your help again.
translation: 那可能很有用。谢谢你——我可能还会请你帮忙。

english: The humans are not attacking!
translation: 人类没有在进攻！

english: You have my full apologies Traveller! And my gratitude!
translation: 我向你郑重道歉，旅行者！也向你表达我的感激！

english: On the other hand, if Glough's right about the humans we will need an army of gnomes to protect ourselves. So I've decided to allow Glough to raise a mighty gnome army.
translation: 另一方面，如果格劳夫关于人类的事是对的，我们需要一支地精军队来保护自己。所以我决定让格劳夫组建一支强大的地精军队。

english: Yes Glough really knows what he's doing. The human has been detained until we know who else is involved.
translation: 没错，格劳夫确实知道他在做什么。那个人类已经被拘留了，直到我们查出还有谁参与。

english: Oh, before you leave - I have something you might like.
translation: 哦，在你离开之前——我有个东西你可能会喜欢。

english: Maybe Glough was right, maybe humans are invading!
translation: 也许格劳夫是对的，也许人类正在入侵！

english: You don't have enough space to carry what I want to give you!
translation: 你的背包空间不够，装不下我想给你的东西！

english: Traveler, any word from Hazelmere?
translation: 旅行者，黑兹尔米尔有消息了吗？

english: Wait a minute, that doesn't sound like Hazelmere! Are you sure you translated correctly?
translation: 等一下，这听起来不像黑兹尔米尔说的话！你确定你翻译对了？

english: Hazelmere lives on an island just south of the Khazard Fight Arena. Give him the sample and translate his reply.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔住在卡扎德战斗竞技场南边的一个岛上。把样本给他，然后翻译他的回复。

english: I'm sorry Traveller but this is no good. The translation must be perfect or the infomation's no use. Please come back when you know exactly what Hazelmere said.
translation: 抱歉，旅行者，这不行。翻译必须完美，否则信息就没用。等你确切知道黑兹尔米尔说了什么之后再回来吧。

english: Hmm. Looks like you can't carry anymore. Put a couple of things down and come back to me.
translation: 嗯，看来你拿不了更多了。先放几样东西，再回来找我。

english: That's enough Traveller! I've no time for make believe. The tree's still dying, I must get to the truth of this!
translation: 够了，旅行者！我没时间听你瞎编。大树还在凋零，我必须查明真相！

english: OK. He lives just in front of the Grand Tree. Let me know when you've talked to him.
translation: 好的。他就住在大树家园前面。你跟他说过话之后告诉我。

english: What?! Do you realise the consequences if it falls into the wrong hands?
translation: 什么？！你知道这东西落到坏人手里会有什么后果吗？

english: Well, hello again Traveller! How are you?
translation: 嗯，又见面了，旅行者！你还好吗？

english: Better than ever, thanks to you!
translation: 比以往任何时候都好，多亏了你！

english: However, this mission is of paramount importance. I shall give you a spare in the meantime.
translation: 不过，这个任务至关重要。我先给你一个备用的。

english: I'd like to speak to you first.
translation: 我想先跟你谈谈。

english: [player name], what are you doing back here? You still have a mission to complete!
translation: [player name]，你怎么回来了？你还有任务没完成！

english: Here take these, I don't see how it will help though.
translation: 来，拿着这些，虽然我觉得没什么用。

english: What did you find at the shipyard?
translation: 你在造船厂发现了什么？

english: Do you believe Caranock's information about the southerly winds?
translation: 你相信卡拉诺克关于南风的说法吗？

english: Come back when you have some inventory space and I'll give you your reward.
translation: 等你的背包有空位了再来，我给你奖励。

english: Hmm. Looks like you can't carry anymore. Put something down and come back to me.
translation: 嗯，看来你拿不了更多了。先放些东西，再回来找我。

english: Did you find out anything about my 10th squad?
translation: 你查到我的第十小队有什么消息了吗？

english: Speak to me again when you have some inventory space, [player name]. I have a gift for you.
translation: 等你的背包有空位了再来找我，[player name]。我有个礼物给你。

english: Thanks again wanderer.
translation: 再次感谢你，流浪者。

english: Well that isn't much help now, please, bring the note here so I can see it for myself.
translation: 那现在帮不上什么忙，请把笔记带到这里，让我亲眼看看。

english: You don't appear to have enough space to take a replacement.
translation: 你的背包似乎没有足够的空间来拿替换品。

english: We', [player name]?
translation: 我们'，[player name]？

english: Perhaps Anita can give you another copy, [player name]. Return with the translation please, I must see that note!
translation: 也许安妮塔可以再给你一份副本，[player name]。请带着翻译回来，我必须看到那张笔记！

english: Like you were, taking those robes from my washing line??
translation: 就像你那样，从我的晾衣绳上拿走那些袍子？？

english: So yes, if you know a way I can be less helpful just tell me, I'll try it.
translation: 所以是的，如果你知道怎么让我少帮点忙，就告诉我，我会试试的。

english: If you know a way just tell me, I'll give it a try.
translation: 如果你知道办法就告诉我，我会试试的。

english: Theres something disturbingly familiar about the design of these trousers, they are made for an elf.
translation: 这条裤子的设计有种令人不安的熟悉感，它是为精灵做的。

english: There are still a few things I need before I can mend your trousers.
translation: 在修补你的裤子之前，我还需要几样东西。

english: You should not just give your things away dear, you may need them.
translation: 亲爱的，你不应该随便把你的东西送人，你以后可能会用到的。

english: I still need two pieces of silk.
translation: 我还需要两片丝绸。

english: I just need a piece of silk.
translation: 我只需要一片丝绸。

english: What good is a bit of paper to me?
translation: 一张纸对我来说有什么用？

english: I do not need any more silk, thanks.
translation: 我不需要更多丝绸了，谢谢。

english: I have all I need to mend your trousers, hand them over and I will get started right away.
translation: 我修补你裤子所需的东西都齐了，把它们交给我，我马上开始。

english: I don not need any more fur, thanks.
translation: 我不需要更多毛皮了，谢谢。

english: I have your trousers ready.
translation: 你的裤子我已经准备好了。

english: Us gnomes aren't wise so we don't get them. Face it, you'll never put me in enough pain that I'll tell you what you wanna know.
translation: 我们地精并不聪明，所以不懂那些。认命吧，你就算让我痛死，我也不会告诉你你想知道的事。

english: I'm not helping you fix that, as if it hasn't caused enough trouble as it is. Your friends have already tried every torture in the book!
translation: 我不会帮你修那东西的，它惹的麻烦还不够多吗？你的朋友们已经把书上所有的酷刑都试过了！

english: I'm still not telling anyone squat.
translation: 我还是什么都不会说的。

english: I used to play gnomeball as a kid. This is a walk in the park in comparison.
translation: 我小时候玩过地精球。跟这比起来根本不算什么。

english: Ho ho ho... no more... Teehee... please stop... Hoohoo... he he he...
translation: 吼吼吼……别挠了……嘻嘻……求求你停下……嚯嚯……嘿嘿嘿……

english: Well come on! Let me up so I can get started, I can't do anything from here.
translation: 那来吧！放我下来我好开始干活，我在这儿什么也做不了。

english: I hate you!
translation: 我恨你！

english: I've got nothing to say to you!
translation: 我没什么好跟你说的！

english: You beastly little blighter!
translation: 你这可恶的小混蛋！

english: Ha ha ha... no stop... Heehee... please no more... Teehee... Hoho...
translation: 哈哈哈……别挠了……嘻嘻……求求你别挠了……嘿嘿……嚯嚯……

english: It's not like I'm going to get anything out of helping you, is it? As I figure, that device is the only thing keeping me out of the slave pens, where I'd get fed a lot worse than nail and prune stew!
translation: 帮你又不会让我得到什么好处，对吧？照我看，那个装置是唯一能让我不进奴隶围栏的东西，进了那里吃得可比钉子炖菜差多了！

english: A.. ah... ACHOOO!!!
I told you you can't buy my cooperation...
translation: 我告诉过你，你是买不通我的合作的……

english: Let me up off of this rack and I'll get started, I can't do anything while I'm all tied up.
translation: 先把我从这架子上放下来，我才能开始干活，我被绑着什么都做不了。

english: ... but thanks for the snack.
translation: ……不过谢谢你的点心。

english: What you gonna do with that?
translation: 你拿那东西想干嘛？

english: Like I'd do anything that could benefit you.
translation: 好像我会做任何对你有好处的事似的。

english: No... I said being here is a walk in the park. Where do they get you guys? You must all be ogre rejects for being too thick.
translation: 不……我说了待在这里跟散步一样轻松。他们是从哪找来你们这些人的？你们一定是食人魔团队里因为太笨而被淘汰的吧。

english: Leave me be idiot.
translation: 别烦我，白痴。

english: I used to play gnomeball yes... what's that got to do with anything? Nothing that can convince me to help you that's for sure.
translation: 我小时候确实玩过地精球……那又怎么样？反正没法说服我帮你就是了。

english: Oooh... a big scary gnomeball. I mean, it might crush me and my entire family, because we're so small!
translation: 哦……好可怕的地精球啊。我是说，它可能会压死我和我全家，因为我们太小了！

english: Go away imbecile.
translation: 走开，蠢货。

english: Yes yes! That was it, I'd hate that, Please don't do that. By Guthix's beard you mourners are such idiots!
translation: 是的是的！就那样，我讨厌那样，求你别那样做。以古斯的胡子起誓，你们这些哀悼者真是蠢得要命！

english: They have big teeth and everything don't they? Sheesh. You mourners will have to try better than that. Now go away. I need some sleep after all these *yawn* scary threats.
translation: 它们有大牙齿什么的，对吧？切。你们哀悼者还得再努力点才行。现在走吧。经过这*哈欠*些可怕的威胁，我需要睡一觉了。

english: Leave me be moron.
translation: 别烦我，白痴。

english: There are no doctors in West Ardougne, just that nurse south east of the chapel. You don't need to worry though, we'll soon have it sorted.
translation: 西阿多尼城没有医生，只有礼拜堂东南边的一个护士。不过你不用担心，我们很快就会解决的。

english: Who are you? Go away!
translation: 你是谁？走开！

english: What do you think you're doing? You're meant to be getting information out of him, not making friends!
translation: 你以为你在干什么？你应该从他那里套取情报，不是交朋友！

english: Good good. Carry on.
translation: 很好很好。继续。

english: Good day. Are the townspeople causing you trouble?
translation: 日安。镇民们给你惹麻烦了吗？

english: Keep away civilian.
translation: 离远点，平民。

english: The plague of course...
translation: 当然是瘟疫……

english: This tower's here for your protection.
translation: 这座塔是为了保护你们。

english: I'm a mourner. It's my job to help heal the plague victims of West Ardougne and to make sure the disease is contained.
translation: 我是哀悼者。我的工作是帮助治疗西阿多尼城的瘟疫受害者，并确保疾病得到控制。

english: If you come down with any symptoms such as flu or nightmares let me know immediately.
translation: 如果你出现任何症状，比如流感或梦魇，请立即告诉我。

english: Have you experienced any plague symptoms?
translation: 你出现过任何瘟疫症状吗？

english: Not like these I assure you. Soon after a thick black liquid will seep from your nose and eyes.
translation: 我向你保证不像这些。不久后，一股浓稠的黑色液体会从你的鼻子和眼睛里渗出来。

english: First you'll come down with heavy flu, this is usually followed by horrifying nightmares.
translation: 首先你会患上重流感，随后通常会出现可怕的梦魇。

english: When it gets to that stage there's nothing we can do for you.
translation: 当发展到那个阶段时，我们就无能为力了。

english: We have no use for a doctor. Not that you were any use when we did need you.
translation: 我们不需要医生。尽管我们需要你的时候你也没什么用。

english: How did you get in here? This is a restricted area!
translation: 你怎么进来的？这是禁区！

english: It all started when King Tyras of West Ardougne came back from one of his visits to the lands west of here.
translation: 这一切都始于西阿多尼城的泰拉斯国王从一次对西部土地的访问归来。

english: All mourners wear this outfit. It's the only protection from the plague.
translation: 所有哀悼者都穿这套装束。这是唯一能抵御瘟疫的防护。

english: Hmmm, ok then. Be on your way.
translation: 嗯，好吧。你走吧。

english: Well if you take a turn for the worse let me know straight away.
translation: 嗯，如果你的情况恶化，立刻告诉我。

english: No... But you will have to be treated.
translation: 不……但你必须接受治疗。

english: We have to take measures to contain the disease. That's why you must let us know immediately if you take a turn for the worse.
translation: 我们必须采取措施控制疾病。所以如果你的情况恶化，必须立即通知我们。

english: The mourners were recruited by King Lathas of East Ardougne. It is our duty to protect his people.
translation: 哀悼者是由东阿多尼城的拉萨斯国王招募的。保护他的人民是我们的职责。

english: Their swords and armour have no effect on the plague.
translation: 他们的剑和盔甲对瘟疫无效。

english: You mourners are really not very good at this are you?
translation: 你们这些哀悼者还真是不太擅长这个，对吧？

english: Fine, since you gave me some crunchies, the parcels are actually toads.
translation: 好吧，既然你给了我一些脆饼，那些包裹其实是蟾蜍。

english: Yes, it's done. Here you go, take it. Now leave me to eat my crunchies in peace.
translation: 对，弄好了。给你，拿去吧。现在让我安安静静地吃我的脆饼。

english: How forgetful are you?
translation: 你这记性到底有多差？

english: Get some bellows and fill them with the dye you want. Then just head down to the Feldip Hills, find a toad and use the bellows to fill it up.
translation: 拿几个风箱，装满你想要的染料。然后去费迪普丘陵，找一只蟾蜍，用风箱把它填满就行了。

english: You know what I need. Some soft leather, some magic logs and some toad crunchies. I refuse to eat anymore nail and prune stew!
translation: 你知道我需要什么。一些软皮革、一些魔法原木和一些蟾蜍脆饼。我再也受不了钉子炖菜了！

english: Well when you have it all I'll fix that thing for you.
translation: 等你都凑齐了，我就帮你把那东西修好。

english: Yes, it's done. Make some room for it and I'll give it to you.
translation: 对，弄好了。腾点地方，我把它给你。

english: What good's one of them bits of paper to me?
translation: 那一张纸片对我来说有什么用？

english: Hey there, you wanna go in there to chop da special wood, it's gonna cost you's 100 trading sticks my friend.
translation: 嘿，你想进去砍那种特殊木材吗？得付100根交易棒，朋友。

english: You can purchase a standard machete from Jiminua's store. Gabooty has a selection of local items which you may like to purchase, including better machetes. Also, you may like to chat to Safta Doc, he may have a deal
translation: 你可以从吉米努阿的商店购买一把标准砍刀。加布提有一些当地物品你可能想买，包括更好的砍刀。另外，你也许想和萨夫塔.多克聊聊，他可能有个交易。

english: It grows much faster than any other herb I have seen, Bwana. But remember, although it is hardy enough to grow in the cold mountain lands, it may still become diseased.
translation: 它比我见过的任何草药长得都快，布瓦纳。但要记住，尽管它足够耐寒，能在寒冷的山地生长，但仍可能患病。

english: you'll find interesting.
translation: 你会发现很有趣的。

english: In which case Bwana, I'm afraid you cannot enter.
translation: 布瓦纳，这样的话，恐怕你不能进去。

english: What can I do for you, Bwana?
translation: 有什么我可以帮你的吗，布瓦纳？

english: favour and I will let you have what you need.
translation: 帮个忙，我就让你得到你需要的。

english: What do you need now?
translation: 你现在需要什么？

english: Oh no, Bwana! Those are far too valuable to give away, especially since we don't really owe you any favours at all. Maybe if you did some work around our village I could let you have one.
translation: 哦不，布瓦纳！那些东西太珍贵了，不能送人，更何况我们根本不欠你什么人情。也许你帮我们在村里干点活，我就让你拿一个。

english: What did you do with the ones I gave you before?
translation: 我之前给你的那些你拿去做什么了？

english: That was a lot of tubers! He has enough to last him a very long time. You will not need any more hardy gout tubers, and you certainly won't get any more from me!
translation: 那可是一大堆痛风草茎！他有足够用很久的了。你不再需要更多的耐寒的痛风草茎了，而且你肯定不能再从我这里得到更多了！

english: You were also telling me something strange about your arm, Bwana.
translation: 你还跟我说了件关于你胳膊的怪事，布瓦纳。

english: Oh, that is difficult, Bwana. Gout tubers only grow well in warm places with plenty of sun. If your friend wants to grow it in the mountains, he will need a special hardy gout tuber.
translation: 哦，那有点难，布瓦纳。痛风草茎只在温暖阳光充足的地方长得好。如果你朋友想在山里种，他需要一种特殊的耐寒的痛风草茎。

english: Very well, but please do not bring that creature to this village ever again!
translation: 好吧，但请别再带那个生物来这个村子了！

english: I think you have more than enough!
translation: 我觉得你已经有足够多的了！

english: Bwana, those things are valuable! Please use the ones in your bank first.
translation: 布瓦纳，那些东西很值钱！请先用你银行里的那些。

english: Then perhaps that is where you will find your friend.
translation: 那也许你会在那里找到你的朋友。

english: Bwana, you would only drop them on the ground if I tried to give you more tubers now!
translation: 布瓦纳，我现在要是再给你更多的痛风草茎，你只会把它们扔在地上！

english: Their history? Oh what a lurid tale that is! Why, I could go on for hours.
translation: 他们的历史？哦，那故事可精彩了！我可以讲上好几个小时。

english: Hmph, well, I suppose. What do you want to know?
translation: 哼，好吧，也算吧。你想知道什么？

english: Hmm, too bad you're not very experienced. I hear there is some more trouble going on up at the Sinclair Mansion.
translation: 嗯，可惜你没什么经验。我听说辛克莱尔庄园那边又出了些麻烦事。

english: Have you spoken to the guard by the mansion? He won't tell me much, he called me a gossip - the nerve - but he might be willing to speak to you.
translation: 你和庄园门口的守卫谈过吗？他没告诉我太多，还叫我长舌妇——真够大胆的——但他可能愿意跟你说。

english: Well, I don't know how much help this is, but I heard that their guard dog will bark loudly at anyone it doesn't recognise. Maybe you should find out if anyone heard anything suspicious?
translation: 嗯，我不知道这有多大帮助，但我听说他们的看门狗会对任何它不认识的人大声吠叫。也许你应该查查有没有人听到什么可疑动静？

english: Well, this might be of some help to you. My father was in the guards when he was younger,
translation: 嗯，这可能对你有帮助。我父亲年轻时当过守卫。

english: My father used to be in the guard. He always wrote himself notes on a piece of paper so he could keep track of information easily.
translation: 我父亲以前当过守卫。他总在纸上给自己写笔记，这样就能轻松跟踪信息。

english: I don't know how much help this is to you but my dad was in the guard once, and he told me that the marks on your hands are totally unique. He called them 'finger prints'.
translation: 不知道这能不能帮上忙，但我爸爸以前当过守卫，他告诉我手上的纹路是完全独特的。他管那叫“指纹”。

english: Maybe you should try that? Don't forget to thank me if I help you solve the case!
translation: 也许你应该试试？如果我帮你破了案，别忘了感谢我！

english: and he always said that there isn't a crime that can't be solved through careful examination of the crime scene and all surrounding areas.
translation: 他总说没有破不了的案子，只要仔细检查犯罪现场及周边区域就行了。

english: He said you can find them easily on any shiny metallic surface by using a fine powder to mark out where the marks are, and then using some sticky paper to lift the print from the object.
translation: 他说你可以在任何闪亮的金属表面上找到它们，用细粉末标出纹路，再用黏性纸把指纹从物体上取下来就行了。

english: I bet if you could find a way to get everyone's 'finger prints' you could solve the crime pretty easily!
translation: 我打赌如果你能找到办法获取每个人的“指纹”，就能轻松破案了！

english: I think Lord Sinclair kept it in the library. It was only decorative, so I never paid much attention to it.
translation: 我想辛克莱尔勋爵把它放在书房里了。那只是件装饰品，所以我从没太留意它。

english: That thread could be Anna's or David's. They were always wearing something of that colour.
translation: 那根线可能是安娜或大卫的。他们总是穿着那种颜色的衣服。

english: No, I can't.
translation: 不，我不能。

english: Well, yes, any of them with eyes.
translation: 嗯，是的，任何有眼睛的人都能。

english: Huh? I don't need that.
translation: 哈？我不需要那个。

english: You're assuming I was under it to begin with.
translation: 你假设我一开始就在它下面。

english: Yeah, but I don't really have anywhere else to go. I might head down to the pub, though, now that you mention it.
translation: 是啊，但我其实也没别的地方可去。不过，既然你提到了，我可能会去酒馆坐坐。

english: I have to sign some paper work before I can leave here. Besides, the last thing I want to do is go hang out with my family. I'm sure a clever boy like you can manage this on your own.
translation: 我得签完一些文件才能离开这里。再说，我最不想做的就是跟家人待在一起。我相信像你这样聪明的男孩能自己搞定。

english: You see, I told you that adventurer would turn up. She believed my every word.
translation: 你看，我就说那个冒险者会出现的。她对我说的每句话都深信不疑。

english: I have to sign some paper work before I can leave here. Besides, the last thing I want to do is go hang out with my family. I'm sure a clever girl like you can manage this on your own.
translation: 我得签完一些文件才能离开这里。再说，我最不想做的就是跟家人待在一起。我相信像你这样聪明的女孩能自己搞定。

english: Do you think 'she' would want to see her?
translation: 你觉得“她”想见她吗？

english: Why thank you. What are we going to do with her now?
translation: 哦谢谢。现在我们拿她怎么办？

english: It's some Green thread. It's not exactly uncommon is it? My trousers are made of the same material.
translation: 是些绿色线。这并不罕见吧？我的裤子也是用同样的材料做的。

english: Your presence is a blight on my day. Go away!
translation: 你的出现毁了我的一天。走开！

english: I refuse to listen to a prevaricator such as yourself!
translation: 我拒绝听你这种满口谎言的人说话！

english: Yes! Keep it up. Maybe you aren't as dumb as you look.
translation: 对！继续。也许你没看起来那么笨。

english: I don't waste my time speaking to plebeians such as yourself.
translation: 我可没时间跟你这种平民说话。

english: Don't waste time talking to me, defend me!
translation: 别浪费时间跟我说话，保护我！

english: You do realise that it's all your fault I'm in here!
translation: 你知不知道我落到这地步都是你的错！

english: Why won't you leave me alone!
translation: 你为什么就不能让我一个人待着！

english: You are certainly bungling this case up! Stick to things that prove me innocent!
translation: 你肯定把这个案子搞砸了！专心找能证明我清白的证据！

english: Didn't you do any research for this case? If it's going downhill, you should call a recess by leaving through the gate.
translation: 你难道没为这个案子做点调查吗？如果情况不妙，你应该从大门出去，宣布休庭。

english: And do some proper investigation!
translation: 然后好好调查一下！

english: You don't have enough room to carry it. Ask me when you have taken the time to free some space.
translation: 你空间不够，拿不了。等腾出地方再来找我。

english: It's some red thread... it kind of looks like the Same material as my trousers. But obviously it's not.
translation: 是一些红线……看起来跟我裤子的材质一样。但显然不是。

english: It's some thread. Sorry, do you have a point here? Or do you just enjoy wasting peoples time?
translation: 是一些线。抱歉，你想说什么？还是你只是喜欢浪费别人的时间？

english: Feisty one, isn't he? Easily duped as well. You didn't actually believe my sibling would help you, did you?
translation: 脾气不小，是吧？也很好骗。你不会真以为我兄弟姐妹会帮你吧？

english: Feisty one, isn't she? Easily duped as well. You didn't actually believe my sibling would help you, did you?
translation: 脾气不小，是吧？也很好骗。你不会真以为我兄弟姐妹会帮你吧？

english: Build us a stove mate, I'm absolutely starvin'!
translation: 给我们做个炉灶吧老兄，我快饿死了！

english: About these eggs... Odd colour, don't cha think?
translation: 说到这些蛋……颜色怪怪的，你不觉得吗？

english: For the love of Saradomin, please leave me be.
translation: 看在萨拉多明的份上，请别烦我。

english: Yeah, I guess they're nice.
translation: 是啊，我觉得还不错。

english: It's some Green thread, like my trousers are made of. Are you finished? I'm not sure which I dislike more about you, your face or your general bad odour
translation: 这是做我裤子那种绿色线。你问完了没？我不确定我更讨厌你哪一点，你的脸还是你身上那股怪味。

english: If you're looking for fossils yourself, there are new types of fossil to discover on an island others are calling 'fossil island'.
translation: 如果你自己也在找化石，在别人称为'化石岛'的岛上可以找到新的化石种类。

english: I hear you're helping with that voyage. I do wish you luck.
translation: 我听说你在帮忙那次航行。祝你好运。

english: Looks like Blue thread to me. If you can't work that out for yourself I don't hold much hope of you solving this crime.
translation: 我看像是蓝色线。如果你连这都看不出来，我对你能破案也不抱太大希望了。

english: I suppose it does. So what?
translation: 我猜是吧。那又怎样？

english: It kind of looks like the same material as my trousers are made of... same colour anyway. Think it's worth anything? Can I have it? Or just some money?
translation: 看起来有点像做我裤子的那种料子……至少颜色一样。你觉得值钱吗？能给我吗？或者给点钱也行？

english: Pretty certain. I usually tried to avoid being near any of the Sinclairs.
translation: 相当确定。我通常都尽量离辛克莱家的人远点。

english: No, I'm a very heavy sleeper. I didn't even hear the maid scream when she found the body. Louisa, the cook, had to come wake me.
translation: 没有，我睡得很沉。我甚至没听到女仆发现尸体时的尖叫声。是厨师路易莎来把我叫醒的。

english: They had a witch on their side and she threatened to turn me into a goat! I'm not moving from this spot.
translation: 他们那边有个女巫，她威胁要拿我变山羊！我是不会离开这个位置的。

english: No thank you, ma'am. I'd much rather stay here and not be killed.
translation: 不了谢谢，夫人。我更愿意待在这里，不被杀死。

english: No thank you, sir. I'd much rather stay here and not be killed.
translation: 不了谢谢，先生。我更愿意待在这里，不被杀死。

english: That thread could be from some of Anna's or David's clothes.
translation: 那根线可能是安娜或大卫的衣服上掉下来的。

english: Well, no, not precisely.
translation: 嗯，不，不完全确定。

english: Yes, they would if they paid attention
translation: 是的，如果他们留意的话就会。

english: There were various chores around the house that required poison. I believe everyone in the household bought some.
translation: 房子里有各种需要用到毒药的杂活。我相信家里每个人都买过一些。

english: I personally did not, I do not know about the others.
translation: 我个人没有，其他人的情况我不知道。

english: I only thought of it now.
translation: 我现在才想到。

english: I'm afraid I can't.
translation: 恐怕我不能。

english: Oh no, I think I'll stay. They were quite explicit that I'd be struck down my magical forces if I left the mansion.
translation: 哦不，我想我还是待着吧。他们说得非常清楚，如果我离开庄园，就会被魔法力量击倒。

english: I... I'm not supposed to speak to anyone outside the family.
translation: 我……我不应该和家族以外的人说话。

english: Louisa; I'm the cook.
translation: 路易莎；我是厨师。

english: Yes, they would have.
translation: 是的，他们本来会的。

english: No, I'm afraid I can't.
translation: 不，恐怕我不能。

english: I was with Hobbes the butler and Mary the maid in the kitchen. We were preparing dinner. I gave Lord Sinclair's meal to Mary and sent her on her way.
translation: 我当时和管家霍布斯、女仆玛丽在厨房里。我们正在准备晚餐。我把辛克莱勋爵的餐点交给玛丽，让她送过去。

english: Of course not. I was cooking, she was taking the meal to him. That's when she found the body.
translation: 当然没有。我当时在做饭，她把饭菜端给他。就在那时她发现了尸体。

english: No, I didn't keep track of it. Obviously some of it was used for murder.
translation: 不，我没有留意。显然有一部分被用来谋杀了。

english: Are you kidding? Without the Sinclairs here, this job is great.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？辛克莱一家不在了，这份工作简直太棒了。

english: And not have dinner ready on time? I think not!
translation: 然后晚餐不能准时准备好？我可不想这样！

english: Just because we're trapped here, doesn't mean I don't have work to do!
translation: 就算我们被困在这里，也不代表我没工作要做！

english: Yes, I suppose they would have.
translation: 是的，我想他们会的。

english: No, not for certain.
translation: 不，不确定。

english: That thread could be Anna's or David's. Almost all their clothes were of that colour. It made doing laundry a nightmare.
translation: 那根线可能是安娜或大卫的。他们几乎所有的衣服都是那种颜色。洗衣服简直是一场梦魇。

english: Wonderful! You should show the new head to Gordon.
translation: 太棒了！你应该把新头展示给戈登看看。

english: No, not really. I didn't buy any.
translation: 不，其实没有。我一个也没买。

english: No, I was upstairs cleaning when the salesman came by, so I didn't know until after he'd left that he'd come by.
translation: 不，销售员来的时候我正在楼上打扫，所以他走了之后我才知道他来过。

english: Err... Thanks, but no thanks!
translation: 呃……谢谢，但还是不用了！

english: Err... I have no use for that, I make the stuff!
translation: 呃……我用不上那个，我就是做神秘物质的！

english: But they'll find me! They threatened to do horrible things to all the servants just before they left. They swore if we left we'd be killed.
translation: 但他们会找到我的！他们在离开前威胁要对所有仆人做可怕的事情。他们发誓如果我们离开就会被杀。

english: No, no, no. I'm staying right here.
translation: 不，不，不。我就待在这里。

english: Are you here to save us? I'm so scared.
translation: 你是来救我们的吗？我好害怕。

english: Stanford; I'm the gardener.
translation: 斯坦福；我是园丁。

english: I s'pose so.
translation: 我想是吧。

english: 'Fraid not.
translation: 恐怕不是。

english: That could be Anna's or David's; green was their favourite colour.
translation: 那可能是安娜或大卫的；绿色是他们最喜欢的颜色。

english: Not all that much. I worked in the garden 'til late, and I was going inside for dinner when all the commotion started.
translation: 不太清楚。我在花园里工作到很晚，正要进屋吃晚饭时，骚动就开始了。

english: It was kept on display as some sort of replica of a great weapon. I'm not much good at history, so I can't remember any details.
translation: 它被陈列展示，像是某件伟大武器的复制品。我不太懂历史，所以记不清细节了。

english: Hmm, not that I can remember.
translation: 嗯，我不记得了。

english: I think the maid may have dusted it, but I don't really know; I work outside.
translation: 我想女仆可能给它掸过灰，但我不是很清楚；我在外面工作。

english: Paid? I'm just trying to earn some experience.
translation: 报酬？我只是想赚点经验。

english: Elabor-what now? All I know is they're gone and I can garden in peace.
translation: 详述什么？我只知道他们走了，我可以安心种花园了。

english: Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some guy like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.
translation: 呃，他肯定在那艘船上。我还记得他跟我说过像你这样的一个家伙，跟诅咒和船童搅在一起。

english: Well, 'e be on that ship for sure. And I remember 'im tellin' me about some gal like ye, getting all mixed up with curses and cabin boys.
translation: 呃，他肯定在那艘船上。我还记得他跟我说过像你这样的一个姑娘，跟诅咒和船童搅在一起。

english: Awww, ye've got nothing that mecan combine.
translation: 噢，你没有任何我能组合的东西。

english: Excuse me, I'm trying to solve some puzzle cubes here. They're very complicated, so I'm going to pour myself a hot bath and relax while I work.
translation: 不好意思，我正在解一些谜题方块。它们非常复杂，所以我打算泡个热水澡，一边放松一边思考。

english: No. I've given away lots of these cubes, and now I'm keeping the rest for myself.
translation: 不。我已经送出了很多这种方块，剩下的我要自己留着。

english: Oh, do leave me in peace! I'm retired, and I can't have a bath while you're standing there.
translation: 哦，别打扰我！我已经退休了，而且你站在这里我没法洗澡。

english: Sorry, I'm not looking for you.
translation: 抱歉，我不是在找你。

english: I do not believe you require my services.
translation: 我认为你不需要我的服务。

english: Sorry, I'm trying to speak to someone else.
translation: 抱歉，我在和别人说话。

english: I'm looking for [player name] Jr.
translation: 我在找 [player name] 二世。

english: I'm looking for Big [player name].
translation: 我在找大 [player name]。

english: I'm looking for Mini [player name].
translation: 我在找小 [player name]。

english: I'm looking for Also [player name].
translation: 我在找另一个 [player name]。

english: I'm looking for Iron [player name].
translation: 我在找铁 [player name]。

english: I'm looking for Main [player name].
translation: 我在找主 [player name]。

english: Hey, AaAoAAoAa, would you like to come and solve a maze for me?
translation: 嘿，AaAoAAoAa，你愿意来帮我解个迷宫吗？

english: I'm looking for Alt [player name].
translation: 我在找小号 [player name]。

english: Hey, EarlyCesteScempLowon, would you like to come and solve a maze for me?
translation: 嘿，EarlyCesteScempLowon，你愿意来帮我解个迷宫吗？

english: Be aware, this will be no easy challenge. I doubt you'll succeed alone. However, the guards will let you enter in a group of up to five. I suggest you take advantage of this.
translation: 注意，这可不是轻松的挑战。我怀疑你独自一人能否成功。不过，守卫允许你们最多五人一组进入。我建议你利用这一点。

english: You look like someone who can handle themselves. Are you intending to partake in the Theatre?
translation: 你看起来像是能应付的人。你打算参加血腥剧场吗？

english: You're strong enough to survive the Theatre but you need a reason to try. I have a little proposition for you.
translation: 你足够强大，能在血腥剧场中存活，但你需要一个尝试的理由。我有个小提议给你。

english: The Theatre is owned by Lady Verzik Vitur. I represent a party that has certain... interests in Verzik.
translation: 血腥剧场归维齐克.维图尔女士所有。我代表的一方对维齐克有某些……兴趣。

english: Lady Verzik's magic prevents most forms of teleportation. However, there is a special crystal whose power can overcome the restriction.
translation: 维齐克女士的魔法阻止了大多数传送法术。不过，有一种特殊水晶的力量可以克服这种限制。

english: My associates have... acquired some shards of the crystal. If you take one into the Theatre, you can use it to teleport out to safety in an emergency. I can sell you some if you wish.
translation: 我的同伙……弄到了一些水晶碎片。如果你带一块进血腥剧场，可以在紧急情况下用它传送出去到安全地点。如果你愿意，我可以卖一些给你。

english: Perhaps we should discuss some matters before we trade.
translation: 也许我们在交易之前应该讨论一些事情。

english: Even the outsiders don't survive though, no one does. You, however, might just have what it takes.
translation: 即使是外来者也活不下来，没人能活。不过你，可能正具备所需的条件。

english: Don't worry, you're not the first to sneak in. The guards here turn a blind eye to that sort of thing. Outsiders generally perform better in the Theatre so make for more interesting entertainment.
translation: 别担心，你不是第一个偷偷溜进去的人。这里的守卫对此睁一只眼闭一只眼。外来者通常在血腥剧场中表现更好，因此更能提供有趣的娱乐。

english: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would be quite the embarassment for Verzik, something that my associates would very much appreciate.
translation: 进入血腥剧场，打败里面的挑战。这样做会让维齐克大丢面子，我的同伙会非常感激。

english: Verzik will be back soon enough. Death will not come easy to a beast like that. However, you have still been of great use to my associates.
translation: 维齐克很快就会回来。死亡对那样的野兽来说可不容易。不过，你仍然对我的同伙很有用处。

english: I have already told you all that I personally have to tell. That said, I was left with a message for you in the event of your success. Allow me to share it.
translation: 我个人该告诉你的都已经告诉你了。不过，我这边有一条给你的信息，在你成功之时使用。让我来传达吧。

english: My kind have the ability to relive memories. That was a message from my master.
translation: 我们这类人有重历记忆的能力。这是我主人传来的信息。

english: Indeed. Perhaps one day he will wish to share more with you. For now, allow me to reward you.
translation: 确实。也许有一天他愿意与你分享更多。现在，让我给你奖励吧。

english: Verzik's magic prevents most forms of teleportation. However, there is a special crystal with the power to overcome this restriction.
translation: 维齐克的魔法阻止了大多数传送法术。不过，有一种特殊水晶的力量可以克服这种限制。

english: 'Adventurer, you have done a great service to me and my disciples. The beast you faced within the Theatre is not what it seems, and you have played an important role in keeping it in check.'
translation: “冒险者，你为我和我的门徒立了大功。你在血腥剧场中面对的野兽并非表面那样，你在抑制它方面发挥了重要作用。”

english: 'As a token of my gratitude, my disciple will ensure you are suitable rewarded. Know that you are now a friend of Sugadinti.'
translation: '作为我感激的象征，我的学徒会确保你得到应有的奖励。要知道，你现在是苏加丁蒂的朋友了。'

english: I can sell you some of these shards if you wish.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以卖一些这样的碎片给你。

english: Even the outsiders don't survive though. No one does. You however, might just have what it takes.
translation: 即使是外来者也活不下来。没人能活。不过你，可能正具备所需的条件。

english: I wouldn't advise going down there before you know the risks, adventurer.
translation: 我建议你在了解风险之前不要下去，冒险者。

english: Actually, I do. Lady Verzik's magic prevents most forms of teleportation. However, there is a special crystal whose power can overcome the restriction.
translation: 事实上，我知道。维齐克女士的魔法阻止了大多数传送法术。不过，有一种特殊水晶的力量可以克服这种限制。

english: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would cause great embarrasment to Verzik, and my associates would very much appreciate it.
translation: 进入血腥剧场，打败里面的挑战。这样做会让维齐克大丢面子，我的同伙会非常感激。

english: My associates have... acquired some shards of the crystal; do not ask me how. If you take one into the Theatre, you can use it to teleport out to safety in an emergency.
translation: 我的同伙……弄到了一些水晶碎片；别问我怎么弄到的。如果你带一块进血腥剧场，可以在紧急情况下用它传送出去到安全地点。

english: I suggest you don't waste my time.
translation: 我建议你不要浪费我的时间。

english: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would cause great embarrasment to Verzik and my associates would very much appreciate it.
translation: 进入血腥剧场，打败里面的挑战。这样做会让维齐克大丢面子，我的同伙会非常感激。

english: You have pleased my associates. In fact, I have something for you.
translation: 你取悦了我的同伙。事实上，我有东西给你。

english: That's right. Within the Theatre, there are numerous challenges for the citizens to try and overcome. If they succeed, they are granted freedom.
translation: 没错。在血腥剧场内，有众多挑战供市民尝试克服。如果他们成功，就能获得自由。

english: It doesn't. In reality, the Theatre is just another source of entertainment for Morytania's vampyre rulers.
translation: 实际上并没有。血腥剧场只是莫里塔尼亚吸血鬼统治者的另一个娱乐来源。

english: Technically, outsiders like yourself are not allowed in the Theatre, but you'll find that the guards here turn a blind eye to those that sneak in.
translation: 严格来说，像你这样的外来者是不允许进入血腥剧场的，但你会发现这里的守卫对那些偷偷溜进来的人睁一只眼闭一只眼。

english: You have pleased my associates. In fact, I have something for you. You may choose which you would desire.
translation: 你取悦了我的同伙。事实上，我有东西给你。你可以选择你想要的。

english: After all, outsiders are typically much stronger than the citizens here. This means they give a better performance in the Theatre, making for more interesting entertainment.
translation: 毕竟，外来者通常比这里的市民强得多。这意味着他们在血腥剧场中的表现更好，从而提供更有趣的娱乐。

english: Even the outsiders don't survive though. You however, might just have what it takes.
translation: 即使是外来者也活不下来。不过你，可能正具备所需的条件。

english: I see you are cautious adventurer. That is wise. If you free up some inventory space, I may have something which can help you.
translation: 我看你是个谨慎的冒险者。这很明智。如果你腾出一些背包空间，我可能有东西能帮到你。

english: Impressive. Don't stop there though, return to the Theatre and embarrass her again. Keep it up and you will be rewarded.
translation: 令人印象深刻。不过别停下来，回到血腥剧场，再次让她难堪。坚持下去，你会得到奖励。

english: You have returned. Now, where were we...
translation: 你回来了。我们刚才说到哪儿了……

english: Ah yes. Remember, you'll only have so much time within the Sepulchre. Before long, the magic within will seal both the coffins and the stairs leading to the next floor.
translation: 啊，是的。记住，你在墓穴里的时间有限。不久之后，里面的魔法就会将棺材和通往下一层的楼梯都封住。

english: Ah. Unfortunately you do not have space.
translation: 啊。可惜你没有空间了。

english: Unfortunately you do not have space for it.
translation: 可惜你没有空间放它。

english: You again. So, you're looking to partake in the Theatre of Blood?
translation: 又是你。那么，你是想参加血腥剧场？

english: I see you are cautious adventurer. That is wise. You can use any teleport spell to escape from the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 我看你是个谨慎的冒险者。这很明智。你可以使用任何传送法术逃离神圣墓穴。

english: Any wuck in da Theatwe?
translation: 剧..剧场里运气好吗？

english: You have pweased my associates. In fact, mehavesomething fow u. You may choose which u wouwddesiwe.
translation: 你取..取悦了我的同伙。事实上，窝有东西给你。你可以选择你想要的。

english: Reawwy?
translation: 真..真的吗？

english: Unfortunately the store is not currently available.
translation: 可惜这个店现在不开放。

english: Do you have any spare blueprints to recolour my exit portal in my player-owned house?
translation: 你有没有多余的蓝图能让我的玩家自宅出口传送门换个颜色？

english: Thank you, Nigel.
translation: 谢谢你，奈杰尔。

english: Can you teleport me somewhere?
translation: 你能传送我去什么地方吗？

english: Sure, but I can only do so once per day. Where would you like to go?
translation: 当然，但我一天只能做一次。你想去哪里？

english: I can only do that once per day, [player name]. You've used your daily teleport already.
translation: 我一天只能做一次，[player name]。你已经用掉今天的传送次数了。

english: Bring me a Toxic Staff of the Dead, Bow of Faerdhinen (c) or Crystal armour and I'll give it a trim.

translation: 黑骑士喜欢用黑色盔甲和武器，这让它们容易受到魔法攻击。

english: My name's Krystilia, I'm a Slayer Master who can train you, if you don't mind slaying in the Wilderness.
translation: 我叫克里斯蒂莉亚，是一位杀戮大师，如果你不介意在荒野里杀戮，我可以训练你。

english: You'll find me in Edgeville. I'll be here when you need a new task.
translation: 你会在边陲镇找到我。你需要新任务时我就在这儿。

english: So do you want to respawn in Edgeville in future?
translation: 那么，你以后想重生在边陲镇吗？

english: Oh yes, I remember those keys. I killed some merchant in the Wilderness, and he dropped lots of them. They open a chest in the ruins north-east of the Chaos Temple.
translation: 哦对，我记得那些钥匙。我在荒野里杀了个商人，他掉了一大堆钥匙。它们能打开混沌神庙东北方废墟里的一个箱子。

english: Yeah. The merchant had two chests, by the way. I was helping some pirates kill the merchant, and they took his other chest up to the north. It looked like there was better stuff in that chest.
translation: 是啊。顺便一提，那商人有两个箱子。我当时帮几个海盗杀那商人，他们把他的另一个箱子搬到了北边。那个箱子里看起来有更好的东西。

english: I could have looted it, obviously, but I thought it'd be more fun to let you adventurers risk your lives doing it. I'm nice that way.
translation: 我本来当然可以去搜刮的，但我想让你们冒险者去拼命拿更有意思。我就这么好心。

english: You've got it. Go loot' em if you like. Try not to die horribly!
translation: 拿到了。你想去刮就刮吧。可别死得太惨！

english: Venenatis lives in the Wilderness. Try to lure her into the multiway combat areas, otherwise she won't take much damage.
translation: 维内纳蒂斯生活在荒野里。试着把它引到多人战斗区域，否则它不会受到太多伤害。

english: Vet'ion is in the Wilderness. He dies only when he has been beaten twice. While his dogs guard him, he is immune to damage.
translation: 维提翁在荒野里。它被打倒两次才会死。当它的狗守卫它时，它免疫伤害。

english: Callisto roams the Wilderness. His roar can knock you off your feet, and he can hit through prayers.
translation: 卡利斯托在荒野里游荡。它的咆哮能把你击倒，而且它能穿透祈祷造成伤害。

english: The Chaos Fanatic has a magic attack that ricochets around, but you can try to dodge it. He can also unequip your items.
translation: 混沌狂热者有弹射的魔法攻击，但你可以尝试躲开。它还能卸下你的装备。

english: You can find Crazy Archaeologists in the Wilderness or on Fossil Island. They throw explosive books that ricochet around, but you can try to dodge them.
translation: 你可以在荒野或化石岛上找到疯狂考古学家。他们扔出爆炸书弹来弹去，但你可以尝试躲开。

english: The Chaos Elemental roams the deepest Wilderness. It can teleport you and make you unequip items randomly.
translation: 混沌元素在荒野最深处游荡。它能传送你，还能随机让你的装备脱落。

english: Scorpia's minions fill her cave, and will fight to protect their matriarch. Expect to be poisoned.
translation: 天蝎的洞穴里满是它的仆从，它们会誓死保护它们的女族长。小心被中毒。

english: Hah. Fine, you can keep respawning elsewhere, and I hope you enjoy it.
translation: 哈。好吧，你可以继续在别处重生，希望你享受。

english: Hello? Ah yes, the door is still locked. If you want to get in here, you'll need to find the key that I hid in some crates in the eastern room.
translation: 喂？啊，是的，门还锁着。如果你想进来，需要找到我藏在东边房间一些板条箱里的钥匙。

english: Sure t'ing, [player name]. I show you...
translation: 当然啦，[player name]。俺给你看……

english: My Arm not know what in book, so you read it, yuh? Perhaps it tell you how to grow t'ings up mountain.
translation: 我的手臂不知道书上写什么，你读一下，好吗？也许它会告诉你如何在山里种植东西。

english: Dat's easy! You know we trolls get named after der first thing wot we try to eat when we young?
translation: 那简单！你知道俺们巨魔小时候第一次试着吃啥，就会用那东西来取名不？

english: We meet at dat village, yah?
translation: 咱们在那个村子碰头，行不？

english: Nuffin' interesting happened.
translation: 没啥有意思的事。

english: You got anyfing for doin' that?
translation: 你有啥能用来干那事的吗？

english: What can My Arm do for you today, [player name]?
translation: 今天我的手臂能为你做什么，[player name]？

english: Hand it over quickly!
translation: 快把它交出来！

english: Is dat what Snowflake want? My Arm not really seeing why. He not much of a conversationalist.
translation: 雪花想要那个？我的手臂真不明白为什么。他可不是个健谈的人。

english: Anyfing else?
translation: 还有别的事吗？

english: My Arm is getting good at dis. I growin' plenty of goutweed for Burntmeat, an' he very happy.
translation: 我的手臂越来越擅长这个了。我种了很多痛风草给烧肉，他非常高兴。

english: Dat okay, [player name]. Come back anytime you like.
translation: 没事，[player name]。你想啥时候回来都行。

english: Okieday, you get permission to use dis human's boat, an' off we go to Weiss.
translation: 好嘞，你拿到用这个人族船只的许可了，那咱们就去韦斯吧。

english: I not wanna dig up da goutweed - it not dead!
translation: 俺可不想挖那痛风草——它还没死呢！

english: It a bit late for dat now.
translation: 现在说这个有点晚了。

english: Here, have dis one.
translation: 来，拿这个吧。

english: Dat could help. Off you go now.
translation: 那可能有用。你现在去吧。

english: That soundin' good. I got da hardy gout tuber thingies, so gimme somefing to poke 'em into da soil, an' My Arm get on with it.
translation: 听起来不错。我有那些耐寒的痛风草茎之类的东西，所以给我个东西把它们戳进土里，我的手臂就去干。

english: Look, [player name] is My Arm's good friend. He got some history what My Arm not like, but he helped My Arm real good.
translation: 听着，[player name]是我的手臂的好朋友。他有些我不喜欢的历史，但他真的帮了我的手臂大忙。

english: It not need curing when it not sick.
translation: 它又没病，不需要治疗。

english: Snowflake an' My Arm would love for you to get da herbies growin' in Weiss. Please!
translation: 雪花和我的手臂希望你让草药在维斯生长起来。拜托了！

english: Don't we gotta clear da weedies first?
translation: 咱们不得先把那些杂草清掉吗？

english: Dem rocks still blocking hole, an' My Arm not gonna be able to climb cliff. You found way to clear hole yet? My Arm want to get to Weiss!
translation: 那些石头还堵着洞，我的手臂没法爬悬崖。你找到清除洞口的方法了吗？我的手臂想去维斯！

english: My Arm sure you trying your best, [player name].
translation: 我的手臂相信你尽力了，[player name]。

english: If you gonna clear cave blockage, maybe you wanna take pickaxe thingy with you? Otherwise you get to other side of blockage an' feel very silly.
translation: 你要是打算清理洞穴堵塞物，也许该带上镐子啥的？不然你到了堵塞物另一边，会觉得自己很傻的。

english: That soundin' good. You gimme da hardy gout tuber thingies, an' gimme somefing to poke 'em into da soil, an' My Arm get on with it.
translation: 听起来不错。你给我那些耐寒的痛风草茎，再给我个东西把它们戳进土里，我的手臂就去干。

english: My Arm got apprentice! He learning the farming, like what you taught My Arm. He good kid, learning fast, an' we getting plenty goutweed.
translation: 我的手臂收了个学徒！他在学习农业，就像你教我的手臂那样。他是个好孩子，学得很快，我们收获了很多痛风草。

english: Dat were a shame. Lucky Murcaily gave us so many of dese hardy gout thingies, huh?
translation: 那可真可惜。幸好穆凯利给了俺们这么多耐寒的痛风草茎，对吧？

english: Grr! You go get some!
translation: 哼！你去弄一些来！

english: You stop wavin' stuff at me!
translation: 你别再冲俺挥舞东西了！

english: What Murcaily say, huh?
translation: 穆凯利说了啥，嗯？

english: Look, [player name] is My Arm's good friend. She got some history what My Arm not like, but she helped My Arm real good.
translation: 听着，[player name]是我的手臂的好朋友。她有些我不喜欢的历史，但她真的帮了我的手臂大忙。

english: Urgh! So you got da hardy goutweed?
translation: 呃！那你拿到耐寒的痛风草了吗？

english: What we gonna do, [player name]?
translation: 咱们要咋办，[player name]？

english: I fink you got one in your bank, yah?
translation: 俺觉得你银行里有一个，对吧？

english: Weak little humans always carrying so much rubbish. Trolls just carry weapon an' maybe shield.
translation: 弱小的人类总是带着这么多垃圾。巨魔只带武器，顶多再带个盾。

english: [player name]. I heard 'bout you. You bring Burntmeat dat tasty human for a stew one time.
translation: [player name]。俺听说过你。你曾经给烧肉带过一个美味的人来做炖菜。

english: I t'ink Burntmeat want to ask you another favour now. You go talk to him, yah?
translation: 俺觉得烧肉想再请你帮个忙。你去跟他说说，行不？

english: Dat's good. You go collect da gouty thingies.
translation: 那很好。你去收集那些痛风草茎吧。

english: Okieday, we go tell Mother that My Arm killed his mortal enemy. Then maybe Mother like My Arm, and let My Arm marry Snowflake.
translation: 好吧，我们去告诉母亲，我的手臂杀死了他的死敌。然后也许母亲会喜欢我的手臂，让我的手臂娶雪花。

english: Oh, My Arm not got that anymore. My Arm gave it to new apprentice.
translation: 哦，我的手臂已经没有那个了。我把它给了新学徒。

english: Oh, dat's good. You go work, den we get da special goutweed to take home.
translation: 哦，那很好。你去干活，然后咱们就能把特殊的痛风草带回家了。

english: Dat's right!
translation: 没错！

english: Apparently you gonna need a Farming level of 29 to teach me how to plant dis kinda herb.
translation: 显然你需要29级农业才能教俺种这种草药。

english: Why you want me to poke da goutweed plant, huh?
translation: 你为啥要俺去戳那痛风草，嗯？

english: Maybe you better go finish listening to Burntmeat, eh? Dat sound like good start for quest, otherwise you waste time in wrong places. My Arm done a quest, an' know dis stuff.
translation: 也许你最好先去听完烧肉的话，嗯？那看起来是个不错的任务开端，否则你在错误的地方浪费时间。我的手臂做过任务，懂这些。

english: When you say dat, it give My Arm odd feeling of apprehension. Dunno why.
translation: 你这么说，让我的手臂有种奇怪的预感。不知道为什么。

english: Yup. Hey, did dat Burntmeat ask you to show me how humans grow goutweed?
translation: 是啊。嘿，那个烧肉是不是让你教俺人类怎么种痛风草？

english: Okieday, [player name]. Perhaps I see you later.
translation: 好嘞，[player name]。也许俺们回头见。

english: Come on, [player name], we gotta go to Tai Bwo Wannai Village to see Murcaily. He help us grow goutweed here.
translation: 来吧，[player name]，咱们得去泰博瓦纳村见穆凯利。他会帮俺们在这儿种痛风草。

english: My Arm might have another copy, but you've not got room to hold one.
translation: 我的手臂可能还有另一本，但你的空间不够放一本。

english: Fat lotta good they doin' there!
translation: 它们在那儿可帮不上啥忙！

english: No t'anks. My Arm not need dat book back.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我的手臂不需要那本书了。

english: No t'anks, [player name]. Snowflake not gonna need more poo in a bucket from you.
translation: 不了，谢谢，[player name]。雪花不需要你再给她一桶便便了。

english: Dumb human said we can use boat! We go to Weiss now? My Arm can't wait!
translation: 那个愚蠢的人类说我们可以用船！我们现在去维斯吗？我的手臂等不及了！

english: It not lookin' like it need dat.
translation: 它看起来不需要那个。

english: Fat lotta good it do there. You go bring it here!
translation: 它在那儿可帮不上啥忙。你去把它带过来！

english: My Arm would get better help from a spotted kebbit! Go ask Murcaily for some more tuber thingies.

translation: 它在这儿的南西边，靠近一家剑店。

english: Not so good my friend...I miss Judi..., Junie..., Jooopie...
translation: 不太好，我的朋友……我想念朱蒂……朱妮……朱皮……

english: Sadly not my friend! And what's worse, her Father has threatend to kill me if he sees me. I mean, that seems a bit harsh!
translation: 可惜没有，我的朋友！更糟的是，她父亲威胁说见到我就杀了我。我说，这有点过分了吧！

english: [player name]...yes, yes...you make her sound very interesting!
translation: [player name]……对对……你让她听起来很有趣！

english: Juliet! I miss Juliet, terribly?
translation: 朱丽叶！我好想朱丽叶，非常想！

english: sure the human girls will like it as well.
translation: 肯定人类女孩也会喜欢的。

english: I think you're almost ready to do some work for Aluft Gianne Jnr. He is in charge of a new family venture: Gnome Food Delivery.  There are good tips to be made if you make and deliver gnome foods - though you may
translation: 我觉得你差不多可以开始为小阿鲁夫特.吉安工作了。他负责一项新的家族事业：地精食品配送。如果你制作并配送地精食品，可以赚到不少小费——不过你可能

english: I'm sure you'll make a great bartender.
translation: 我相信你会成为一个出色的酒保。

english: However, you'll need some basic gnome cooking training if you want to work for Lufty. Go and have a chat with his Dad, Aluft Gianne Snr. He'll tell you what you need to do.
translation: 不过，如果你想为卢夫提工作，你需要一些基本的地精烹饪训练。去和他爸爸老阿鲁夫特.吉安聊聊吧。他会告诉你需要做什么。

english: sure the human boys will like it as well.
translation: 肯定人类男孩也会喜欢的。

english: I don't know what you have there but it's no Pineapple Punch!
translation: 我不知道你手里拿的是什么，但那绝对不是菠萝潘趣酒！

english: I don't know what you have there but it's no SGG!
translation: 我不知道你手里拿的是什么，但那绝对不是SGG！

english: Looks tasty, but I'm not hungry
translation: 看起来很好吃，但我不饿。

english: No. What happened in the cellar?
translation: 不，地窖里发生了什么？

english: Yes. Part of the wall collapsed.
translation: 是的，一部分墙塌了。

english: Well that's a different question. No, I don't.
translation: 那是个不同的问题。不，我没有。

english: Good heavens! You'd better find out what happened!
translation: 天哪！你最好查清楚发生了什么！

english: I don't know. I just hope the rest of the castle isn't going to collapse!
translation: 我不知道。我只希望城堡的其他部分不会倒塌！

english: Good! I know we're safe in your hands.
translation: 很好！我们知道在你手里是安全的。

english: Have this flier...
translation: 拿着这张传单……

english: Do you require any assistance?
translation: 你需要帮助吗？

english: Good day, sir. What brings you to this end of town?
translation: 日安，先生。什么事让你来到城镇的这一头？

english: Go away. You Mourners helped the people from the outside shut us in like animals. I have nothing to say to you.
translation: 走开。你们这些哀悼者帮助外面的人把我们像动物一样关起来。我没什么好跟你说的。

english: You better watch your back, Mourner!
translation: 你最好小心点，哀悼者！

english: I've managed to find myself some work. Lots of repair work to do to get this city back up and running again.
translation: 我设法找到了些工作。为了让这座城市恢复运转，有很多修复工作要做。

english: Just think of me next time you're in a dark alley! Because I'll be waiting for you.
translation: 下次你在黑暗小巷里的时候想想我！因为我会在那里等你。

english: The mourners are gone but things are still awful here. The new king has a lot of work to do if he ever wants to see this place flourish.
translation: 哀悼者走了，但这里的情况还是很糟。新国王如果想让这里繁荣起来，还有很多工作要做。

english: Not great. The mourners might be gone but this city is still a long way from bring a nice place to live again.
translation: 不太好。哀悼者可能走了，但这座城市距离再次成为宜居之地还有很长的路要走。

english: Not too bad. Things are starting to look up now that the mourners have gone.
translation: 还不错。哀悼者走了，情况开始好转了。

english: Pretty good. We might finally be able to make a life here now.
translation: 挺好的。我们现在终于能在这里谋生了。

english: I'm good thanks. They're going to repair my roof soon, I can't remember the last time I had a roof.
translation: 我很好，谢谢。他们很快就要修我的屋顶了，我不记得上次有屋顶是什么时候了。

english: Good day, madam. What brings you to this end of town?
translation: 日安，女士。什么事让你来到城镇的这一头？

english: Ah, I suppose someone has to do it.
translation: 啊，我想总得有人做吧。

english: Good day to you. Nice weather we've been having.
translation: 日安。最近天气不错。

english: I'm a little worried I've heard there's lots of people going about, killing citizens at random.
translation: 我有点担心，我听说有很多人在到处随机杀害平民。

english: Greeting, traveller.
translation: 你好，旅行者。

english: I'm very well, thank you. Have you heard you can play board games in the Hosidius pub?
translation: 我很好，谢谢。你有没有听说可以在霍西迪乌斯城的酒馆里玩桌游？

english: People say it is really fun. I hope the Cloak and Stagger can get some in soon as well.
translation: 人们说那真的很有趣。我希望“斗篷与蹒跚”也能尽快引进一些。

english: Well, if everyone were in the army, then who'd handle the daily needs of the city?
translation: 嗯，如果每个人都去参军，那谁来处理城市的日常需求呢？

english: I have nothing to say to you Mourner, go away!
translation: 我没什么跟你说的，哀悼者，走开！

english: Sorry Sir, I'm in a hurry!
translation: 抱歉先生，我有急事！

english: Why you wretched Daughter-of-a-Big-Nosed-Warty- Smelly-Goblin! How dare you speak to a commanding officer like that?
translation: 你这个可恶的大鼻子疣子臭地精的女儿！你竟敢这样跟指挥官说话？

english: Let me get something clear. At the start of the First Age, the mighty Guthix placed deposits of rune stones all around Gielinor for people to use. But this gift simply wasn't enough for some people and they greedily
translation: 让我把话说清楚。在第一纪元之初，伟大的古斯将符文石矿藏遍布吉莱诺，供人们使用。但这个礼物对某些人来说远远不够，他们贪婪地

english: You can get vials from the Healer machine near the room's entrance - the machine with a green 'cross' symbol on it. These vials can be used with the nearby spring...
translation: 你可以从房间入口附近的治疗者机器那里拿到药水瓶——就是那个带有绿色'十字'标志的机器。这些药水瓶可以在附近的泉水处使用……

english: Talk Effigy, see what he say for himself.
translation: 跟雕像谈谈，看他怎么说。

english: I am satisfied with your reports. You just need to complete a physical and you will be free to roam at your leisure.
translation: 我对你的报告很满意。你只需要完成一次体能测试，就可以自由活动了。

english: It says here you jumped off a hill and flew? Without assistance?
translation: 这上面写你从一个小山上跳下来然后飞了？没借助外力？

english: Hey, get away from there!
translation: 嘿，离那儿远点！

english: What do you think, feather-brains? I am the guard for this door. I also arrest those bards, occasionally. They are a public nuisance.
translation: 你说呢，笨鸟？我是这扇门的守卫。偶尔也抓那些吟游诗人，他们太扰民了。

english: Move along. Move along.
translation: 往前走。往前走。

english: Move along, move along.
translation: 往前走，往前走。

english: You're all done here. Just go complete the Agility course and you'll be free to roam around.
translation: 你这边都搞定啦。去完成敏捷课程，你就可以自由活动了。

english: You do not have the Zoo mission report.
translation: 你没有动物园的任务报告。

english: You do not have your mission report.
translation: 你没有你的任务报告。

english: You do not have the Lumbridge mission report.
translation: 你没有仑桥镇的任务报告。

english: Where is your ID, agent? I need to inspect it.
translation: 你的身份证呢，特工？我需要检查。

english: Oh my...I was a little doubtful that you were telling the truth, but since you've lost something valuable, you must be a friend of my husbands.
translation: 哦天哪……我本来有点怀疑你是不是在说真话，但你丢了贵重的东西，那肯定是我丈夫的朋友了。

english: Well anyway, here, have this bread. I baked it this morning, so it's still nice and fresh.
translation: 反正，给你，拿着这块面包。我今天早上刚烤的，还新鲜着呢。

english: Come and see me again when you manage to keep a hold of it you poor, poor woman.
translation: 等你保管得住它的时候再来找我吧，可怜的女士。

english: Come and see me again when you manage to keep a hold of it you poor, poor man.
translation: 等你保管得住它的时候再来找我吧，可怜的先生。

english: I guard the monsters you see before you. I offer this area to you free of charge, but on one condition... you must be on a Slayer task in order to attack any of the creatures here.
translation: 我守护着你面前这些怪物。我免费向你开放这个区域，但有一个条件……你必须在杀戮任务中才能攻击这里的任何生物。

english: Then I will stop you when you attempt to strike a creature. This area is for players who want to do their task, uninterrupted.
translation: 如果你试图攻击生物，我会阻止你。这片区域是为那些想不受干扰完成任务的人准备的。

english: Hello, are you here for the monsters I guard?
translation: 你好，你是来对付我守护的怪物的吗？

english: I have some fresh shark for you - I netted them this morning.
translation: 我有些新鲜的鲨鱼给你——我今天早上用网捕到的。

english: Oh... That was a banquet compared to the stuff I've been living off.
translation: 哦……和我一直吃的东西相比，那简直是盛宴。

english: Look, I'm sorry, okay. Remember that I followed this map and ended up on the rocks.
translation: 听着，我很抱歉，行了吧。记住，我就是跟着这张地图，结果撞到了岩石上。

english: Look, I have a bit of a confession. I think that the map may well be cursed.
translation: 听着，我有点事要坦白。我觉得那张地图很可能被诅咒了。

english: It may be nothing, after all, but I think you should be very careful if you go looking for the treasure.
translation: 也许根本没什么，但我觉得如果你去找宝藏的话，应该非常小心。

english: I won't...go...anywhere until...I'm ready. I don't...care if I...freeze.
translation: 在我...准备好之前...我哪儿也...不去。我...不在乎...会不会冻僵。

english: Just get the...fire burning again. I have...some driftwood...you can use...when you can carry it.
translation: 把...火...重新生起来吧。我有...一些浮木...等你...能拿的时候...可以用。

english: Hmmm...even when I cut up that wood you won't have enough free space to carry both the carvings I'll be doing. Come back when you have some space in your pack.
translation: 嗯……就算我劈开那些木头，你也没有足够的空间来携带我要雕刻的东西。等你背包里有空间了再来吧。

english: I'll hand it over when you have the space to carry it, and not before!
translation: 等你有空间拿了，我才会交给你，在此之前免谈！

english: I wish i could see her again...
translation: 我希望能再见到她……

english: I'll bet he's grown since I left, those many, many, many...hours ago.
translation: 我打赌自从我离开后，他又长大了不少，就在那很多很多很多……小时之前。

english: You have a good point. I can't wait to get back.
translation: 你说得对。我等不及要回去了。

english: I suppose you've more than earned it. It was the last one my grandfather, Sven the Helmsman, ever made.
translation: 我想你已经完全赢得了它。这是我祖父，舵手斯文，制作的最后一个了。

english: You don't even have free space for a new one! Go away and don't bother me until you do.
translation: 你连放一个新雕刻品的空位都没有！走开，别烦我，等你有空位了再来。

english: Gah! Are you doing this deliberately now? Here, have another - and try not to lose this one!
translation: 啊！你是故意的吗？给你，再拿一个——这次可别再弄丢了！

english: Useless! Here: I carved a few more while you were gone - give her this one and be quick about it!
translation: 没用！给你：你不在的时候我又刻了几个——把这个给她，动作快点！

english: Well, here, have another load. And get it right this time. I can feel...my life slipping away...cough, cough. Splutter
translation: 好吧，给你，再拿一批。这次可要做对了。我能感觉到……我的生命正在流逝……咳，咳。噗。

english: So, you can lose my son's carving and still have time to fill your backpack with rubbish. I'll make a replacement - you can come and get it when you can carry it.
translation: 所以，你能弄丢我儿子的雕刻品，却还有时间把背包塞满垃圾。我会做一个替代品——等你能拿的时候再来拿吧。

english: Well...when you feel...like helping me...I'll give you some more. But you will need...to be able...to carry them.
translation: 嗯……等你……想帮我的时候……我会再给你一些。但你得……能……拿得动它们才行。

english: Well, I have some more for you, but if you can't carry it now you will have to come back when you can!
translation: 嗯，我这里还有一些给你，但如果你现在拿不了，那就等你能拿的时候再来吧！

english: When 100 years old you reach, look like a prune you will.
translation: 等你活到一百岁，你就会像颗梅干一样皱巴巴的。

english: I lived here when this was all just fields, you know.
translation: 你知道吗，我住在这里的时候，这里还全都是田野。

english: I already gave you a cup - what did you do with it?
translation: 我已经给过你一个杯子了——你把它怎么了？

english: You have already given me the robes of Necrovarus.
translation: 你已经给过我尼克罗瓦鲁斯的袍子了。

english: You have given me the Book of Haricanto.
translation: 你已经给过我哈里坎托之书了。

english: You have given me a translation manual.
translation: 你已经给过我一本翻译手册了。

english: Oh, thanks, but I'm not really thirsty at the moment.
translation: 哦，谢谢，但我现在不太渴。

english: No, I've found it - here you go.
translation: 不，我找到了——给你。

english: Oh, alright; come here, then.
translation: 哦，好吧，那就过来吧。

english: I didn't hear the magic word...
translation: 我没听到那个魔法词……

english: Sorry, didn't quite catch that...
translation: 抱歉，没听清……

english: Oh, no thanks; I'm not thirsty anymore.
translation: 哦，不用了，谢谢；我不渴了。

english: Here you are; luckily, I saved some of Alice's hair in case you were careless. Which you were.
translation: 给你；幸好我留了一些爱丽丝的头发，以防你粗心大意。而你确实粗心大意了。

english: You don't have a ghostspeak amulet for me to enchant.
translation: 你没有鬼语护符可以让我附魔。

english: Sorry me old ship mate, it looks like you haven't got enough space for a ticket. Come back when you've got rid of some of that junk.
translation: 抱歉，老船友，看来你没空位放船票了。清掉些垃圾再回来吧。

english: What the... get out of my shop!
translation: 搞什么鬼……给我滚出我的店！

english: Urgh... what are you doing? Get off me!
translation: 呃……你在干什么？从我身上下来！

english: What does it want? We don't normally serve its kind in this shop.
translation: 它想要什么？我们这家店一般不招待它这种客人。

english: Sure, I'll sign one of my flyers for the weird gnome person. I've got lots of the things - [player name] can have a flyer too.
translation: 当然，我会给那个奇怪的地精签一张我的传单。我有很多这玩意儿——[player name] 也可以拿一张。

english: Keep that thing out of my shop!
translation: 别把那东西带进我的店！

english: Argh! Get this stinking monkey off me!
translation: 啊！让这只臭猴子离我远点！

english: Ready when you are [player name].
translation: 随时可以出发，[player name]。

english: I've got a lot to take in and understand. I'm okay though.
translation: 我有很多东西要消化和理解。但我还好。

english: Yes and no. I now have my old memories again but there's so many of them. I can't quite piece them all together yet. I need time to properly work things out.
translation: 既是也不是。我现在又有了旧日的记忆，但太多了。我还没能完全拼凑起来。我需要时间好好理清楚。

english: After the battle, myself, Tristan and Camorra split the key into four pieces. We vowed to ensure that the Dragonkin would never recover them.
translation: 战斗结束后，我、特里斯坦和卡莫拉把钥匙分成了四片。我们发誓要确保龙人永远也找不到它们。

english: Be careful [player name]. The Dragonkin may be gone but the scars of their wars remain to this day. I don't know what that Vault contains, but I doubt it's anything good.
translation: 小心点，[player name]。龙人虽然不在了，但他们战争留下的伤痕至今仍在。我不知道那个金库里有什么，但我不认为会是什么好东西。

english: Huh! That's very kind of you, I suppose. I guess I've served the people of Lumbridge faithfully for many years.
translation: 哼！我想你真是太客气了。我为仑桥镇的居民忠实服务了许多年，大概就是这样吧。

english: We'll have to worry about that later, for now you'll need to take out these dragons.
translation: 我们以后再去担心那件事，现在你得先干掉这些龙。

english: Hello again [player name]. The Oneiromancer and I were discussing what our perfect Sunday would be.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。梦境法师和我刚才在讨论我们理想的星期天会是什么样。

english: Defeat the guardian? I'm no good at combat, I'm a cat.
translation: 打败守护者？我不擅长战斗，我是一只猫。

english: One thing that I do remember clearly is that battle though. I also remember what happened next.
translation: 不过那场战斗我确实记得很清楚。我还记得后来发生的事。

english: Tristan passed his piece on to his descendants. They lived in the city of Saranthium, where Varrock now stands. Perhaps the library has some record of them.
translation: 特里斯坦把他的那一片传给了子孙。他们住在萨兰锡姆城，就是现在的维洛克城所在的地方。也许图书馆里有他们的记录。

english: Camorra took one piece, Tristan took another and I took the final two.
translation: 卡莫拉拿了一片，特里斯坦拿了另一片，我拿了最后两片。

english: I am. I can't fight any more, but maybe I can be useful in some other way. Much of this is my fault and it's only right that I help put things right. Now let's get going.
translation: 是的。我不能再战斗了，但也许可以用别的方式帮上忙。这很大程度上是我的错，我来帮忙纠正也是应该的。现在我们出发吧。

english: It won't, but I have faith in you [player name]. Now you'd better head to the fleet, I'll see you in Rellekka.
translation: 不会的，但我信任你，[player name]。你最好现在就去舰队那里，我们在雷勒卡城见。

english: Galvek and Zorgoth are linked. When Jardric hurt Galvek, Zorgoth felt pain as well. Galvek is his weakness.
translation: 加尔维克和佐戈斯是相连的。当贾德里克伤害加尔维克时，佐戈斯也会感到疼痛。加尔维克就是他的弱点。

english: I do. When we were on Lithkren, Jardric fired a crossbow at Galvek.
translation: 我记得。在利斯克伦的时候，贾德里克用弩射了加尔维克一箭。

english: Okayyy. So who are you then?
translation: 好吧。那你到底是谁？

english: Dragonkin are not easy to kill. In fact, they are immune to most weapons. You can kill as many dragons as you want in this battle but it won't be over until Zorgoth is dead.
translation: 龙人不容易杀死。事实上，他们免疫大多数武器。这场战斗中你爱杀多少龙就杀多少，但只有佐戈斯死了才算结束。

english: Hello [player name]. We need to talk about Zorgoth.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我们需要谈谈佐戈斯。

english: Well I suppose I don't have anything better to do, not unless Unferth has forgotten where he lives again.
translation: 嗯，我想我也没什么更好的事可做，除非昂弗斯又忘了自己住在哪儿。

english: Hello [player name]. How's things?
translation: 你好，[player name]。怎么样？

english: Well that all sounds great to me [player name]. I'll meet you in Sophanem.
translation: 听起来都很好，[player name]。我们在索法尼恩城见。

english: I hid one of my pieces in the most unlikely of places, an abandoned Dragonkin fortress. You'll find the fortress on a snow covered island, north west of Rellekka.
translation: 我把其中一片藏在了一个最不可能的地方，一座废弃的龙人要塞。你要在那座被雪覆盖的岛上找到要塞，就在雷勒卡城西北方。

english: Hello [player name]. Shall we go back into the dream again?
translation: 你好，[player name]。我们要再进入那个梦境吗？

english: No. But we should find whoever is responsible and slay them! With an axe!
translation: 不。但我们应该找到罪魁祸首，然后用斧头砍了他们！

english: Okay, I'll join you there, on Lunar Isle. That's going to be a long walk on these paws.

english: There you go, 100 free pure essence. Return tomorrow for some more.
translation: 给你，100份免费的纯净精华。明天再来领更多吧。

english: Let me just get that spell scroll for you...
translation: 让我给你拿那个法术卷轴……

translation: 给你，150份免费的纯净精华。明天再来领更多吧。

translation: 给你，250份免费的纯净精华。明天再来领更多吧。

english: Return when you have space in your inventory for your daily allowance of free essence.
translation: 等你背包腾出空间，再来领取每日免费精华配额吧。

english: Well, I thought you were going to use that spell I gave you to free Petra from the rock face?
translation: 嗯，我还以为你会用我给你的那个法术把佩特拉从岩壁上救出来呢？

english: You don't have enough room for me to give you the scroll.
translation: 你的空间不够，我没法给你卷轴。

english: You must beMod Lars. My good friend Sedridor has told me about you. As both wizard and inventor, he has aided me in my great invention!
translation: 你一定是Mod Lars。我的好朋友塞德里多尔跟我提起过你。作为魔法师兼发明家，他协助我完成了这项伟大的发明！

english: Hewe u go.
translation: 给你。

english: I'm not making you angry, you're doing that all on your own! I just don't have a weather report to give you!
translation: 不是我让你生气，是你自己在生自己的气！我只是没有天气报告可以给你！

english: Fantastic, come and let me know when you've finished.
translation: 太好了，等你完成了就来告诉我一声。

english: Well, that's a bit of shame, I have to say...we all miss our Petra!
translation: 嗯，这有点可惜，我得说……我们都很想念我们的佩特拉！

english: I've no clue my friend, you mentioned something about Arhein, but your plans might have changed in the meantime.
translation: 我毫无头绪，朋友。你之前提到过阿海因，但你的计划可能已经变了。

english: Hmm, yes, I tried to get replacement parts made but they're just ones made from memory so they're not very good. However, I had to pay a pretty penny for them so I'm passing that cost on to you.
translation: 嗯，是的，我试着找人做了替换零件，但那些只是凭记忆做出来的，所以不太好用。不过，我花了不少钱才弄到它们，所以这笔费用得你来出。

english: Here you go then!
translation: 给你！

english: If you want these spare parts, it's going to cost you 335 gold pieces - perhaps this will ensure that you don't lose them again.
translation: 如果你想要这些替换零件，需要付我335金币——也许这能确保你不会再弄丢它们了。

english: If you want these spare parts, it's going to cost you 1000 gold pieces - perhaps this will ensure that you don't lose them again.
translation: 如果你想要这些替换零件，需要付我1000金币——也许这能确保你不会再弄丢它们了。

english: Well, you can't have them then...I'll find someone responsible to get these repaired.
translation: 好吧，那你不能拿它们了……我会找个负责任的人来修理这些东西。

english: If you want these spare parts, it's going to cost you 665 gold pieces - perhaps this will ensure that you don't lose them again.
translation: 如果你想要这些替换零件，需要付我665金币——也许这能确保你不会再弄丢它们了。
