english: Well, I knew you were going to say that! Here you go...have another one!
translation: 嗯，我就知道你会这么说！给你……再拿一个！

english: If you want these spare parts, it's going to cost you 330 gold pieces - perhaps this will ensure that you don't lose them again.
translation: 如果你想要这些替换零件，需要付我330金币——也许这能确保你不会再弄丢它们了。

english: Well, I've done a lot of research into Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawsers and it seems to have paid off, but answer me this one question. Why are you asking me about this rather than the Gnome?
translation: 嗯，我对三重冗余航空超级缆绳做了大量研究，看来没白费功夫。但回答我一个问题：你为什么不去问那个地精，反而来问我？

english: No, this really is a quick thing and shouldn't take you longer than a few minutes.
translation: 不，这事很快，不会花你几分钟。

english: Many thanks for bringing me the weather report, one of my associates has taken some T.R.A.S.H to your Gnome Glider Pilot friend on White Wolf mountain. Once again, many thanks for your help.
translation: 多谢你带来天气报告，我的一位同事已经拿了一些T.R.A.S.H.给你在白狼山上的地精滑翔机飞行员朋友了。再次感谢你的帮助。

english: Go to Seers Village and ask the new chap there, Phantuwti, for a weather report...then I'll give you the Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser.
translation: 去先知村找新来的伙计范图提，要一份天气报告……然后我就把三重冗余航空超级缆绳给你。

english: Hello! Would you like to trade? I've a variety of wares for sale!
translation: 你好！想交易吗？我这里有各种商品出售！

english: Various places up and down the coast. Mostly Karamja and Port Sarim.
translation: 沿海各地，主要是卡拉姆詹岛和沙林港。

english: Business is going reasonably well... I wouldn't say I was the richest of merchants every, but I'm doing fairly well all things considered.
translation: 生意还算不错……我不敢说自己是顶级富商，但总的来说还算顺利。

english: I'm funding a rather expensive trade run to Brimhaven soon and I want [player name] sure that the weather isn't going to change and cause my ships any trouble.
translation: 我很快要资助一趟去布尔哈文镇的昂贵贸易航行，我想让[player name]确保天气不会变化，给我的船带来麻烦。

english: Oh yes, thanks...I've already installed it. I should go like the wind now! Tell Sanfew, that yakking old druid, I'll be happy to take him to the ogre area now...and yourself of course if you should like to go.
translation: 哦，是的，谢谢……我已经装好了。我现在得赶紧走了！告诉桑福，那个喋喋不休的老德鲁伊，我很乐意带他去食人魔区域了……当然，如果你想去的话，也带上你。

english: T.R.A.S.H is a short way of saying, 'Triple Redundant Aero Super Hawser', it's a technical term that we gnomes like to use when specifying lightweight rope.
translation: T.R.A.S.H 是'三重冗余航空超级缆绳'的简称，这是我们地精在指定轻量级绳子时喜欢用的技术术语。

english: Why, there's hardly any in there! Have you been drinking it? Yuck, I won't drink from a cup someone has already drunk out of!
translation: 哎呀，里面几乎没剩多少了！你是不是喝了？呸，我才不喝别人喝过的杯子！

english: Err... yuck...this isn't fresh...did Sanfew say anything about making it fresh...yourself? I'm sure it must have slipped his mind!
translation: 呃……呸……这不新鲜……桑福有没有说要弄新鲜的……你自己？我肯定他一定是忘了！

english: Well hand 'em over then lad!
translation: 那就把它们交出来吧，小伙子！

english: Well hand 'em over then lass!
translation: 那就把它们交出来吧，姑娘！

english: They can be pretty dangerous. They'll defend for a long time, then attack suddenly and seemingly without warning, landing three viscious attacks at once. This can be pretty lethal. However, the nail beasts themselves
translation: 它们可能相当危险。它们会长时间防御，然后突然毫无预警地攻击，一次发动三次猛烈的攻击。这可能非常致命。不过，钉子兽本身

english: Well let me know when you do young 'un.
translation: 等你准备好了就告诉我，年轻人。

english: are curiously wounded from the Sanfew Serum itself...very bizzare, that a potion made from their claws should have such a pronounced effect on them.
translation: 奇怪的是，它们会被桑福血清本身所伤……用它们爪子制成的药水竟然对它们有如此显著的效果，真是奇怪。

english: I'm afraid you are not yet learned enough in the art of Herblore to be able to help me, adventurer...
translation: 恐怕你在草药学方面的学识还不够，无法帮助我，冒险者……

english: And what if it is? Tassie got into an arrangment that is mutually beneficial, as far as I understood it, she was happy with the deal.
translation: 就算是又怎样？塔西跟我达成了一个互利互惠的协议，据我所知，她对这笔交易很满意。

english: Where would I be if I just left all of my 'customers' alone? Some people just need a little extra 'encouragement' to make the best out of life...I'm just helping them along.
translation: 如果我把所有“客户”都放着不管，我还能有今天？有些人就是需要一点额外的“鼓励”才能把生活过得更好……我只是帮他们一把。

english: As I said I'm the apothecary not the vet.
translation: 我说了，我是药剂师，不是兽医。

english: I'm quite the expert, excuse me.
translation: 我可是专家，请见谅。

english: I think I can help you with that. Try me.
translation: 我想我能帮你。试试看。

english: Not Pox, what a personality. I remember... Hang on no, I have no time for dilly dallying.
translation: 不是波克斯，真有性格。我记得……等等，不，我没时间闲扯。

english: Quick, get this to Jack. If I know the man at all, he wouldn't have sent someone else to do this if his cat wasn't seriously ill.
translation: 快，把这个交给杰克。以我对他的了解，要不是他的猫病得很重，他不会派别人来干这事的。

english: Well cats are simple enough to treat. Just bring me a bucket of milk, some ground unicorn horn and a leaf of marrentill.
translation: 嗯，猫还算好治。给我拿一桶牛奶、一些独角兽的角粉和一片马伦提尔草来就行。

english: There you go! There's your herbal tincture!
translation: 给你！这就是你的草药酊剂！

english: I know just the thing that will sort Pox out.
translation: 我知道有什么东西能治好波克斯。

english: Ok then. Try this potion. Do you need anything else?
translation: 好吧。试试这瓶药水。还需要别的吗？

english: Go and see Tassie Slipcast in the Barbarian Village about making an airtight pot for me to store my breathing salts in, then you can take some for Horvik.
translation: 去野蛮人村庄找塔西.斯利普卡斯特，让他做个密封罐来装我的呼吸盐，然后你可以带一些给霍维克。

english: What are you giving me those for? I didn't ask you to get that.
translation: 你给我这些干什么？我没让你拿这个。

english: Only that spot cream. Hope you enjoy it. Do you need anything else?
translation: 只有那个祛痘膏。希望你喜欢。还需要别的吗？

english: If you have the ingredients, I am able to make potions for you.
translation: 如果你有材料，我可以帮你制作药水。

english: Since you are a member, I'll give you even more potions.
translation: 既然你是会员，我会给你更多药水。

english: No, I can... I can order plenty, but they'll lose their effectiveness. I need an airtight pot to keep them in.
translation: 不，我可以……我可以订很多，但那样会失效。我需要一个密封罐来保存它们。

english: You need to get some marrentill before we can proceed.
translation: 你得先弄些马伦提尔草，我们才能继续。

english: You mentioned something about Horvik, weren't you supposed to take those breathing salts and that herbal tincture to him?
translation: 你提到过霍维克，你不是应该把那些呼吸盐和草药酊剂带给他吗？

english: What are you hanging around here for? You've got the anti poison, so give it to Jack. Quick.
translation: 你还在这儿晃悠什么？你已经拿到解毒剂了，快给杰克送去。

english: You need to get some ground unicorn horn before we can proceed.
translation: 你得先弄些独角兽的角粉，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get a bucket of milk before we can proceed.
translation: 你得先弄一桶牛奶，我们才能继续。

english: Have you got the Cadava berries for the old man's potion?
translation: 你拿到给老人做药水的卡达瓦莓了吗？

english: Don't tell me you've lost the potion!
translation: 别告诉我你把药水弄丢了！

english: That's a relief. I can make more, but it'd feel like a waste of snake ears and dog horns. People don't understand how hard it is to get dog horns.
translation: 那就好。我可以再做一份，但总觉得浪费了蛇耳和狗角。人们不明白弄到狗角有多难。

english: What are you giving me those for? I've already given you a Cadava potion.
translation: 你给我这些干什么？我已经给过你卡达瓦药水了。

english: Hmm... it appears that you have no space for the hat.
translation: 嗯……看来你没空间放帽子了。

english: Well, it looked ok initially, but it doesn't seem to have been made correctly. Maybe you've been sold a duff one? Perhaps the person who made it hadn't been shown how to make it properly? If it were up to me, I'd
translation: 嗯，一开始看起来还行，但似乎没做对。也许你买到了次品？也许是做的人没学会正确的方法？要我说，我宁愿

english: just make one myself!
translation: 自己做一个！

english: Hmm, this is an interesting tome... Herbi Flax, yes, I'm familiar with his work... I wondered where he'd gotten to.
translation: 嗯，这是一本有趣的书……赫比.弗拉克斯，是的，我熟悉他的作品……我正想知道他去哪了。

english: Hmm, it looks like he's made some sort of serum to  counteract the effects of an existing disease. Hmm, it looks like he uses the academic name for  ashes, Fyrneght.
translation: 嗯，看起来他制作了一种药水来对抗某种现有疾病的效果。嗯，他用学术名称称呼灰烬：法尔奈特。

english: When you've finished with that diary, I'd be happy to take it off your hands and give you some  training in herblore in return.
translation: 等你用完那本日记，我很乐意收下，并给你一些草药学训练作为回报。

english: The writing is a little involved, but it looks  like the serum is just a simple combination of  tarromin and ashes, in a vial of water of course.
translation: 文字有点复杂，但看起来血清只是塔罗明草和灰烬的简单组合，当然还要放在水瓶里。

english: You need to get a bucket of milk, ground unicorn horn and some marrentill before I can create a cat anti- poison potion for you.
translation: 你得先弄一桶牛奶、独角兽的角粉和一些马伦提尔草，我才能给你做猫用解毒药水。

english: You will have to find them while I get the rest ready.
translation: 你去找这些东西，我准备剩下的。

english: Bring them here when you have them. But be careful. They are nasty.
translation: 找到后带到这里来。但要小心，它们很危险。

english: I have all that, but i need some Cadava berries.
translation: 我都有，但我还需要一些卡达瓦莓。

english: Hmmm, it'll cost you another airtight pot, plus 200 gold! I don't have time for people who don't look after stuff I give them.
translation: 嗯，那得再花一个密封罐，外加200金币！我可没时间应付那些不保管好我给的东西的人。

english: You need to get a bucket of milk and some ground unicorn horn before we can proceed.
translation: 你得先弄一桶牛奶和一些独角兽的角粉，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get some ground unicorn horn and marrentill before we can proceed.
translation: 你得先弄些独角兽的角粉和马伦提尔草，我们才能继续。

english: You need to get a bucket of milk and some marrentill before we can proceed.
translation: 你得先弄一桶牛奶和一些马伦提尔草，我们才能继续。

english: Well then, you can't have more breathing salts can you!
translation: 那好吧，你不能再拿更多呼吸盐了！

english: No problem if you have the ingredients with you.
translation: 如果你身上有材料，那没问题。

english: No problem. Free up some inventory space and I'll just rustle up another one for you.
translation: 没问题。腾出点背包空间，我再给你弄一份。

english: Come back quick when you do. The cat is in serious danger of dying. That poison it consumed was incredibly strong.
translation: 弄到了就快点回来。那只猫快死了，它吃下的毒药非常强。

english: Did you bring more Cadava berries?
translation: 你带更多卡达瓦莓来了吗？

english: The breathing salts will be a bit more of a problem though!
translation: 不过呼吸盐会麻烦一点！

english: It's going to cost you another airtight pot, plus 200 gold! I don't have time for people who don't look after stuff I give them.
translation: 那得再花一个密封罐，外加200金币！我可没时间应付那些不保管好我给的东西的人。

english: No problem with the tincture, I'll just rustle up another one for you.
translation: 酊剂没问题，我再给你弄一份。

english: Sorry, charity is not my strong point.
translation: 抱歉，慈善不是我的强项。

english: Hmmm, Seth eh! He's a good friend, but he still owes me three steel bars for a plough I fixed. I'm sorry but I need to have that paid off first before I can do any more work for him.
translation: 嗯，塞思是吧！他是好朋友，但他还欠我三块钢条，因为之前我帮他修了犁。抱歉，我得先把那笔账清了才能再为他干活。

english: Ok then! Great...tell me a little more about these chicken cages...Cough Cough Cough!
translation: 那好吧！太好了……再跟我说说这些鸡笼子的事……咳！咳！咳！

english: I also sell other armours if you are interested.
translation: 如果你有兴趣，我还卖其他盔甲。

english: Didn't you say you had to take those chicken cages to Seth Groats for some reason?
translation: 你不是说要把那些鸡笼子带去给塞斯.格罗茨吗？为了什么来着？

english: Well come back when you have 5, that should be enough for old Seth.
translation: 等你凑够了5个再来吧，应该够老塞思用了。

english: Well, Ok, I'm going to need five more to convert them, plus some money for my time, say 100 gold per cage?
translation: 那好吧，我还需要五个才能改造它们，再加上我的手工费，每个笼子100金币怎么样？

english: Sorry, but I can't talk to you about it right now... People may be listening, try another time and I'll be able to talk.
translation: 抱歉，我现在不能跟你谈这个……可能有人在听，换个时间我再跟你说。

english: Sorry, but you'll have to get some so that I can convert them.
translation: 抱歉，你得先弄一些给我，我才能改造它们。

english: Well, Ok, I'm going to need 2 more pigeon cages to convert them, plus some money for my time, say 100 gold per cage?
translation: 那好吧，我还需要两个鸽子笼子才能改造它们，再加上我的手工费，每个笼子100金币怎么样？

english: What are you talking about? Don't you come into my house shouting at me.
translation: 你在说什么啊？别跑到我家里来冲我嚷嚷。

english: Well then what is it boy?
translation: 那么到底是什么事，小子？

english: What are you doing on my land? You're not the one keeps leaving all my gates open and letting out all my sheep?
translation: 你在我的地盘上干什么？应该不是你老把我的大门开着，让我的羊都跑出去的吧？

english: Well then what is it girl?
translation: 那么到底是什么事，丫头？

english: What's this rubbish! This isn't wool, it's a note promising to give me wool!
translation: 这什么破烂！这不是羊毛，这是一张承诺给我羊毛的纸条！

english: I need 10 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要10个才能付你钱。

english: You're going to have to swap those in a bank or get me some more wool, I can't accept them.
translation: 你得去银行换一下，或者再给我弄些羊毛来，我不能收这些。

english: I need 4 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要4个才能付你钱。

english: I need 1 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要1个才能付你钱。

english: Well, I'll leave them on the table here if you want to grab them later...
translation: 好吧，那我把它们放在这张桌子上，你等会儿想要的话自己来拿……

english: I need 2 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要2个才能付你钱。

english: I need 5 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要5个才能付你钱。

english: Or you could go and buy some for yourself from the general store in Lumbridge.
translation: 或者你也可以自己去仑桥镇的杂货店买一些。

english: I need 3 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要3个才能付你钱。

english: I need 8 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要8个才能付你钱。

english: Have you been to see Seth Groats yet? He's over at the other farm on the way to Varrock!
translation: 你去见过塞斯.格罗茨了吗？他在去维洛克城路上的另一个农场那边！

english: Once you get some shears use them on the sheep out in my field.
translation: 等你拿到剪刀，就去我田里给羊剪毛。

english: I need 6 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要6个才能付你钱。

english: I need 9 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要9个才能付你钱。

english: I need 7 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要7个才能付你钱。

english: And what did he say?
translation: 那他怎么说？

english: Well, that's great...good old Seth!
translation: 嗯，那太好了……好样的塞思！

english: I need 11 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要11个才能付你钱。

english: I need 12 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要12个才能付你钱。

english: I need 15 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要15个才能付你钱。

english: I need 19 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要19个才能付你钱。

english: I need 13 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要13个才能付你钱。

english: I need 14 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要14个才能付你钱。

english: You need to collect 1 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集1个毛线球。

english: I need 16 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要16个才能付你钱。

english: I need 17 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要17个才能付你钱。

english: Well what do you expect if you ask a farmer for a quest? Now are you going to help me or not?
translation: 你找农夫要任务，还能指望什么？你到底帮不帮我？

english: You need to collect 10 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集10个毛线球。

english: I need 18 more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要18个才能付你钱。

english: What are you doing on my land? You're not the one who keeps leaving all my gates open and letting out all my sheep are you?
translation: 你在我地里干什么？老把我大门打开放跑羊的人不是你吧？

english: You're after a quest, you say? Actually I could do with a bit of help.
translation: 你说你想要个任务？其实我正好需要点帮助。

english: My sheep are getting mighty woolly. I'd be much obliged if you could shear them. And while you're at it spin the wool for me too.
translation: 我的羊变得毛茸茸的。如果你能帮它们剪羊毛，我会非常感激。另外，顺便也帮我纺成毛线。

english: Yes, that's it. Bring me 20 balls of wool. And I'm sure I could sort out somesort of payment. Of course, there's a small matter of The Thing.
translation: 是的，就是这样。给我带20个毛线球来。我相信我能安排某种报酬。当然，还有'那东西'的小问题。

english: You need to collect 2 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集2个毛线球。

english: How are you doing getting those balls of wool?
translation: 你收集那些毛线球进展如何？

english: I'm sure it's nothing to worry about. Just because my last shearer was seen bolting out of the field screaming for his life doesn't mean anything.
translation: 我肯定没什么好担心的。只不过我上一个剪毛工是尖叫着逃出田里的，但这不代表什么。

english: I'm not paying you by the hour!
translation: 我可不会按小时付你钱！

english: Well you can stop grinning and get to work then.
translation: 那你别傻笑了，赶紧干活吧。

english: You need to collect 4 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集4个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 19 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集19个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 3 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集3个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 5 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集5个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 6 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集6个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 8 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集8个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 7 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集7个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 15 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集15个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 12 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集12个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 9 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集9个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 14 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集14个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 11 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集11个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 17 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集17个毛线球。

english: To get to the Lumbridge Castle just follow the road east.
translation: 要去仑桥镇城堡，沿着东边的路走就行了。

english: You need to collect 18 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集18个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 16 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集16个毛线球。

english: You need to collect 13 more balls of wool.
translation: 你还需要收集13个毛线球。

english: Someone say it's a black hearted shapeshifter, hungering for the souls of hard working decent folk like me. Others say it's just a sheep.
translation: 有人说那是个黑心变形怪，专吸像我这样勤劳正派人的灵魂。也有人说那只是一只羊。

english: Just use a set of shears on a sheep to shear it.
translation: 用剪刀对着羊用就行了。

english: Well what do you expect if you ask a farmer for a quest?
translation: 你找农夫要任务，还能指望什么？

english: I need 10 before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要10个才能付你钱。

english: Well at least you haven't been eaten.
translation: 嗯，至少你没被吃掉。

english: I need 4 before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要4个才能付你钱。

english: Well go find a spinning wheel then. You can find one on the first floor of the Lumbridge Castle, just walk east on the road outside my house and you'll find Lumbridge.
translation: 那就去找一个纺车吧。你可以在仑桥镇城堡的一楼找到一个，只要从我房子外面的路往东走，你就会找到仑桥镇。

english: I know, you wouldn't think it would you! Could you ask her if she'll act as a character witness for my friend?
translation: 我知道，你不会想到吧！你能问她是否愿意为我朋友做品行证人吗？

english: Ok thanks. My friend passes on his gratitude for asking Aggie to be a character witness.
translation: 好的谢谢。我朋友转达他对你请阿吉做品行证人的感谢。

english: Hello friend. You're a long way from civilisation!
translation: 你好，朋友。你离文明世界可真够远的！

english: Well, I've not managed it yet but I heard that someone managed to find a way in. But they only just managed to escape the jungle with their lives.
translation: 嗯，我还没成功，但我听说有人找到了进去的方法。不过他们也只是勉强活着逃出了丛林。

english: *Gasp*-- The jungle forester looks speechless. --
translation: *倒吸一口气*——丛林护林员看起来哑口无言。——

english: Many thanks friend.
translation: 多谢了，朋友。

english: Here, I won't be needing this any longer, and it may help you. Whenever I've used it before, it attracted the attention of jungle natives.
translation: 给你，我用不着这个了，它可能对你有用。我以前每次用它，都会引来丛林土著的注意。

english: This is very impressive! I'm amazed, it's just great! Do you mind if I make a copy of it, and I'll give you an item in return.
translation: 这太厉害了！我太惊讶了，真是太棒了！你介意我抄一份吗？我会给你一件东西作为交换。

english: --The forester looks very interested-- Oh, well, that sounds quite good actually... Sorry if I sounded rude before, it just didn't seem like a good idea to me.
translation: ——护林员看起来很感兴趣——哦，嗯，听起来确实不错……抱歉刚才可能有点失礼，我只是觉得这主意不太好。

english: I guess I just wouldn't want to do it myself. But a map of that area would certainly be a big task. And it would certainly be very useful...-- The forester looks very thoughtful --
translation: 我想我只是不想自己去做。但绘制那个区域的地图肯定是个大工程。而且肯定非常有用……——护林员看起来若有所思——

english: Hey, if you manage to complete it, be sure to let me take a look! Well, best of luck with it, I'm sure you're going to need it.
translation: 嘿，如果你完成了，一定要让我看看！好了，祝你好运，我相信你肯定用得着。

english: Well, I've heard some funny sounds and I think I've seen a native... but I'm not sure. They generally don't like to be seen I guess.
translation: 嗯，我听到过一些奇怪的声音，好像还见过一个土著……但我不确定。我想他们一般不喜欢被人看到。

english: But I found an item that you might be interested in. You swing it above your head and it makes a strange sound, it seems to attract their attention.
translation: 但我发现了一件你可能感兴趣的东西。你把它在头顶上挥舞，它会发出奇怪的声音，似乎能吸引他们的注意。

english: Well, I wish I could give it to you. However, I have grown fond of it. And it may help me in case I get lost in the jungle.
translation: 嗯，我希望能把它给你。不过，我已经喜欢上它了。而且它也许能帮我在丛林里迷路时脱困。

english: Well, if you have something interesting, let me have a look at it and I'll offer you something in return. OK, I have to go now, but it's been nice talking with you.
translation: 嗯，如果你有什么有趣的东西，让我看看，我会给你点东西作为回报。好了，我得走了，但和你聊天很愉快。

english: Yes, he said he was from some place... near the Sorcerer's Tower. Mentioned something about a legend? It meant nothing to me though.
translation: 是的，他说他来自某个地方……靠近巫师塔。提到了什么传说？不过对我来说毫无意义。

english: I'm a forester, and I specialise in exotic woods. I've not managed to penetrate the Kharazi Jungle very far but I have found some interesting tree specimens.
translation: 我是个护林员，专攻异国木材。我没能深入卡拉兹丛林多远，但我找到了一些有趣的树木标本。

english: Not really, but I would say be careful, it's a dangerous place. And good luck.
translation: 没什么特别的，但我得说小心点，那是个危险的地方。祝你好运。

english: If you do happen to get into the Kharazi Jungle, do come and let me know. I'd love to be able to safely navigate my own way in and out.
translation: 如果你真的进了卡拉兹丛林，一定要来告诉我。我很想能安全地自己进出。

english: Sorry, I don't do that kind of thing anymore. You should go and talk to Pirate Jackie in Brimhaven instead.
translation: 抱歉，我不再做那种事了。你应该去找布尔哈文镇的海盗杰基谈谈。

english: Of course. I am hungry.
translation: 当然。我饿了。

english: Wow! It looks like you're already loaded down with stuff! Tell you what, if you want to dump some of that stuff, I'll give you the axe, okay?
translation: 哇！看起来你已经带了不少东西了！这样吧，如果你想扔掉一些东西，我就把斧头给你，怎么样？

english: You might like to use that when you get into the Kharazi jungle, it might attract more natives...
translation: 你进卡拉兹丛林时可能会用到它，它能引来更多土著……

english: No, of course not... Sorry, I have to be on my way...
translation: 不，当然不是……抱歉，我得走了……

english: Well, I can offer you this?
translation: 嗯，我能给你这个？

english: If you swing this above your head, it makes a strange sound. I noticed that it attracts the attention of the natives. Is it a deal? Can I make a copy of your map?
translation: 如果你把这个在头顶上挥舞，它会发出奇怪的声音。我注意到它能吸引土著的注意。成交吗？我能抄一份你的地图吗？

english: I'm a jungle forester. Names mean little in this part of the world.
translation: 我是个丛林护林员。名字在这个地方没什么意义。

english: It's a great map, thanks for letting me take a copy! It has helped me out a number of times now.
translation: 这地图太棒了，谢谢你让我抄了一份！它已经帮了我好几次了。

english: Very well friend, I understand, I must be on my way as well.-- The Jungle Forester seems a bit annoyed...and wanders off. --
translation: 好吧，朋友，我理解，我也得走了。——丛林护林员似乎有点恼火……然后走开了。——

english: Ugh, that's not cooked properly. Take it away!
translation: 呃，这没煮熟。拿走吧！

english: Don't judge a book by its cover -  judge it on its' grammar and, punctuation.

english: The blessings of the gods prepare to receive...

english: Hi there, what can I help you with?
translation: 你好，有什么能帮你的？

english: I'm Pete and this is my canoe station.
translation: 我叫皮特，这是我的独木舟站点。

english: Does the zoo not own this station?
translation: 动物园不是拥有这个站点吗？

english: They think they do just because I work at it, but I built this station on my lonesome. But enough about zoo politics, want to know more about canoes?
translation: 他们以为他们拥有它，就因为我在这里工作，但这站点是我一个人建的。不过动物园的政治说够了，想了解更多关于独木舟的事吗？

english: I don't think so, you seem to not have used an axe at all, so making a canoe is not possible for you I'm afraid.
translation: 恐怕不行，你好像根本没使用过斧头，所以做独木舟对你来说是不可能的。

english: Once you learn to swing your axe better, you will be able to make a canoe to travel the river.
translation: 等你学会更好地挥舞斧头，你就能做独木舟在河上旅行了。

english: I definitely can do, swing your axe at this tree. Then shape it into a canoe, easy enough.
translation: 我当然可以，对着这棵树挥动斧头，然后把它修成独木舟，很简单。

english: You look like you have not swung your axe much, I don't think you will be able to shape a very good canoe yet.
translation: 你看起来没怎么挥过斧头，我觉得你现在还做不出一艘像样的独木舟。

english: Oh... How come?
translation: 哦……为什么？

english: As I said, you don't seem to have swung your axe much, so your canoe will not last long.
translation: 我说过了，你好像没怎么挥过斧头，所以你的独木舟撑不了多久。

english: Let me take a look at you. Hmm... you're getting there, you should be able to make a reasonable canoe with your skills, a dugout.
translation: 让我看看你。嗯……你进步了，凭你的技能应该能做一艘过得去的独木舟，一艘独木舟。

english: Two stops, before the thing gives way.
translation: 到两站，然后那东西就不行了。

english: I see... you seem to know how to swing an axe, you could make a decent canoe.
translation: 我明白了……你看起来会用斧头，你能做一艘不错的独木舟。

english: A great distance, but not the whole way along the river.
translation: 很远，但不能走完整条河。

english: Colour me impressed, looks like you and the axe are one in the same. You will have no problem crafting the best canoes and have no problem travelling down the river.
translation: 我真是刮目相看，看来你和斧头合二为一了。你制作最好的独木舟没问题，沿河旅行也没问题。

english: No problem. I'll also get in touch with Pete at the Volcanic Mine and let him know you're trustworthy.
translation: 没问题。我也会联系火山矿场的皮特，告诉他你是可信的。

english: Well, you've started building some of the stuff in the camp! If you finish it off I'll happily reward you with your efforts.
translation: 嗯，你已经开始在营地里建造一些东西了！如果你把它完成，我会很高兴地奖励你的努力。

english: Fine, regular fossils won't drop for you anymore. Come back to me if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，普通化石不会再为你掉落了。如果你改变主意，就回来找我。

english: Well, I'm sure everyone would appreciate you helping to build the camp! There's a total of six things that still need building. If you help, I'm sure I can give you a small reward.
translation: 嗯，我相信大家都会感激你帮忙建造营地！总共有六样东西还需要建造。如果你帮忙，我肯定能给你一点奖励。

english: I see you've been exploring the mountains to the east. That's very helpful - all our exploration will expand our knowledge of that inaccessible area. Here, I've got a reward for you...
translation: 我看到你一直在探索东边的山脉。这非常有帮助——我们所有的探索都会扩展我们对那片难以进入区域的认识。来，这是给你的奖励……

english: I see you've been exploring the swamps in the south. That's very helpful - all our exploration will expand our knowledge of that terrifying area. Here, I've got a reward for you...
translation: 我看到你一直在探索南边的沼泽。这非常有帮助——我们所有的探索都会扩展我们对那片可怕区域的认识。来，这是给你的奖励……

english: I see you've been exploring the north of the island. That's very helpful - all our exploration will expand our knowledge of this amazing island. Here, I've got a reward for you...
translation: 我看到你一直在探索岛屿的北部。这非常有帮助——我们所有的探索都会扩展我们对这座神奇岛屿的认识。来，这是给你的奖励……

english: I think I'll just stay here and pan though!
translation: 我想我还是待在这里淘金吧！

english: I think that's everything off the list, but there are always more fossils out there to find! Any you find can be cleaned and identified at the benches you built in the camp.
translation: 我想清单上的东西都齐了，但外面总有更多的化石可以找到！你找到的任何化石都可以在营地你建造的工作台上清理和鉴定。

english: I've got a reward for you, but you need space for five items in your backpack. Go and deposit some stuff in that handy bank chest you built, then come and see me again.
translation: 我为你准备了奖励，但你的背包里需要有五个物品的空位。去把你建的那个方便的银行箱里存点东西，然后再来找我。

english: You've done so much exploring already, but there are always more fossils out there to find! Any you find can be cleaned and identified at the benches you built in the camp.
translation: 你已经探索了很多地方，但外面总有更多的化石可以找到！你找到的任何化石都可以在营地你建造的工作台上清理和鉴定。

english: I see you've been exploring the swamps in the south. I'd reward you, but you'll need space for five items in your backpack first. Clear some space, then come and see me again.
translation: 我看到你一直在探索南边的沼泽。我本想奖励你，但你的背包里需要先有五个物品的空位。清理出一些空间，然后再来找我。

english: I see you've been exploring the mountains to the east. I'd reward you, but you'll need space for five items in your backpack first. Clear some space, then come and see me again.
translation: 我看到你一直在探索东边的山脉。我本想奖励你，但你的背包里需要先有五个物品的空位。清理出一些空间，然后再来找我。

english: I see you've been exploring the north of the island. I'd reward you, but you'll need space for five items in your backpack first. Clear some space, then come and see me again.
translation: 我看到你一直在探索岛屿的北部。我本想奖励你，但你的背包里需要先有五个物品的空位。清理出一些空间，然后再来找我。

english: Wow you are doing a great job here on the island, have these!
translation: 哇，你在岛上干得真棒，这些给你！

english: Sorry [player name], you're goin' to need to wait up a min or two. It's not safe for you to enter right now!
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，你得等一两分钟。现在进去不安全！

english: I'd say you'll need at least level 50 Mining and 150 Kudos to be capable. You'll also need to help out around the Museum Camp to prove you're trustworthy.
translation: 依我看，你至少需要 50 级采矿和 150 点声望才能胜任。你还得在博物馆营地帮忙，证明你值得信赖。

english: Well luckily for you, or rather, unlucky for you, I'll let you go inside, you've helped out the expedition more than enough and you've definitely got the mining skills.
translation: 算你走运，或者说，算你倒霉，我让你进去。你对探险队的帮助已经够多了，而且你的采矿技术也绝对过关。

english: Will have to charge you though, the upkeep of this place ain't cheap and cheerful. I'll need 30 Numulites.
translation: 不过得收你点费用，维护这地方可不便宜。我需要 30 个努米矿。

english: Nice one [player name]. In future I'll give you twice as much water when you go into the mine!
translation: 干得好 [player name]。以后你进矿洞，我会给你双倍的水！

english: Sorry [player name], you're going to need a space for this special heat-proof water container before you can head in.
translation: 抱歉[player name]，你需要一个空间来放置这个特殊的耐热储水箱，然后才能进去。

english: Look out for the Lava beasts, they'll throw projectiles at anyone they see. You'll have stalacmites falling on you, fire jumping out the lava towards you. Seriously, you're insane.
translation: 小心熔岩兽，它们会朝任何看到的东西投掷石块。还会有石笋掉下来砸你，火焰从熔岩里朝你喷出来。说真的，你真是疯了。

english: Sorry [player name], there's no point in you trying to take that water in, it'll just evaporate, put it in the bank first.
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，你带那种水进去也没用，会直接蒸发掉。先存到银行里吧。

english: Have you been up to no good? That wasn't the mine I expected you to come from!
translation: 你是不是没干好事？你出来的那个矿洞可跟我想的不一样！

english: Hello there young man.
translation: 你好啊，小伙子。

english: You are required to build the entire musuem camp before I will allow you to go in the mine.
translation: 你必须先建好整个博物馆营地，我才会允许你进入矿洞。

english: You are required to rebuild the entire museum camp before you can enter the mine.
translation: 你必须先重建整个博物馆营地，才能进入矿洞。

english: You are required to pay me 30 numulites to enter that mine.
translation: 你得付我 30 个努米矿才能进那个矿洞。

english: Hello there young lady.
translation: 你好啊，小姑娘。

english: The payment to enter the mine is 30 numulites.
translation: 进入矿洞的费用是 30 个努米矿。

english: I'll need 50 coins per item.
translation: 每件物品我需要 50 个金币。

english: Sorry, I wasn't expecting anyone to want to convert that sort of item, so I haven't any banknotes for it.
translation: 抱歉，我没想到会有人想把那种东西换成票据，所以我这里没有对应的票据。

english: That's a banknote already. What are you trying to achieve? Banknoteception?
translation: 那已经是票据了。你想干嘛？票据套娃？

english: I'm pretty sure there's no such thing as a banknote for that item.
translation: 我很确定那种东西没有对应的票据。

english: I exchange items for bank notes. Hand over the items you wish to note and I will exchange them for you. This process is free.
translation: 我用物品兑换银行票据。把你想换成票据的物品交给我，我会为你兑换。这个过程是免费的。

english: Arrr, take this lamp I found washed ashore too.
translation: 啊，把这盏我捡到的冲上岸的灯也拿去吧。

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer further explorin' on the island. Cap'n Izzy's arranged it so ye gets a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena, an' ye can use the stepping stone in
translation: 这副卡拉姆詹手套上的附魔，是你进一步探索这座岛的象征。伊兹船长已经安排好了，让你在我们的敏捷竞技场里获得一点额外好处，而且你还能使用希洛村的踏脚石。

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer exhaustive explorin'. They'll take ye to a mine under Shilo Village now, an' all the merchants will give ye discounts. Ye can have this lamp too.
translation: 这副卡拉姆詹手套上的附魔，是你全面探索的象征。现在它们能带你去希洛村地下的一个矿洞，而且所有商人都会给你折扣。这盏灯也拿去吧。

english: Shilo Village. Ye can have this lamp too.
translation: 希洛村。这盏灯也拿去吧。

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be the ultimate symbol of yer exhaustive explorin'. Ye'll now get double TokKul from the Fight Cave an' Inferno. Ye'll have a chance for double tickets in our Agility
translation: 这副卡拉姆詹手套上的附魔，是你全面探索的终极象征。你现在能从战斗洞穴和地狱获得双倍托库尔。在我们的敏捷竞技场里，你还有机会获得双倍票券。

english: banknotes too, if ye likes.
translation: 如果你喜欢，也可以换成票据。

english: Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use some more short-cuts around the island, an' even enter some places fer free. I can make the metal dragons under Brimhaven give ye bars as
translation: 这里的竞技场。你每天可以在战斗洞穴复活一次，还能在岛上使用更多捷径，甚至可以免费进入一些地方。我还可以让布尔哈文镇地下的金属龙把金属锭作为钞票给你。

english: Arrr, I upgrade the Karamja gloves so ye gets a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena with 'em on. Ye can use the stepping stone in Shilo Village, an ye still gets the easy rewards too.
translation: 啊，我升级了卡拉姆詹手套，这样你戴着它们在我们的敏捷竞技场里就能获得一点额外好处。你可以在希洛村使用踏脚石，而且你仍然能获得简单的奖励。

english: Ye'll have to unlock the medium an' easy rewards before I can reward ye for that.
translation: 你得先解锁中级和简单的奖励，我才能给你那个奖励。

english: Arrr, I upgrade the Karamja gloves so they can take ye to a special mine under Shilo Village. Ye still gets the easy and medium rewards too.
translation: 啊，我升级了卡拉姆詹手套，这样它们就能带你去希洛村地下的一个特殊矿洞。你仍然能获得简单和中级的奖励。

english: Arrr, ye can get double TokKul from the Fight Cave an' Inferno, an' have a chance for double tickets in our Agility Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use a lot of short-cuts around the
translation: 啊，你可以从战斗洞穴和地狱获得双倍托库尔，还有机会在我们的敏捷竞技场里获得双倍票券。你每天可以在战斗洞穴复活一次，还能在岛上使用很多捷径。

english: Ye'll have a chance for double tickets in our Agility Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use some more short-cuts around the island, an' even enter some places fer free.
translation: 你还有机会在我们的敏捷竞技场里获得双倍票券。你每天可以在战斗洞穴复活一次，还能在岛上使用更多捷径，甚至可以免费进入一些地方。

english: island, an' even enter some places fer free. I can make the metal dragons under Brimhaven give ye bars as banknotes too, if ye likes. Ye still gets the easy, medium an' hard rewards too.
translation: 岛上，甚至可以免费进入一些地方。如果你喜欢，我还可以让布尔哈文镇地下的金属龙把金属锭作为票据给你。你仍然能获得简单、中级和困难的奖励。

english: Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use a lot of short-cuts around the island, an' even enter some places fer free.
translation: 你每天可以在战斗洞穴复活一次，还能在岛上使用很多捷径，甚至可以免费进入一些地方。

english: Arrr, ye'll 'ave make more space in yer pack.
translation: 啊，你得在背包里腾出更多空间。

english: Ye'll have to unlock the hard, medium an' easy rewards before I can reward ye for that.
translation: 你得先解锁困难、中级和简单的奖励，我才能给你那个奖励。

english: Ye'll have to unlock the easy rewards before I can reward ye for that.
translation: 你得先解锁简单的奖励，我才能给你那个奖励。

english: Aye, I can recolour that if ye've got the tickets to pay for it...
translation: 啊，如果你有足够的票券来支付，我可以给那个重新上色……

english: Nay, I can't recolour that. The pirates who sail the western seas say there's a man there who might know more. Osten, he's called.
translation: 不，我不能给那个重新上色。航行在西边海域的海盗说，那里有个人可能知道更多。他叫奥斯滕。

english: I'm afraid I'm all sold out of poison at the moment. People know a bargain when they see it!
translation: 恐怕我现在的毒药都卖光了。人们看到便宜货可不会放过！

english: I can't tell you anything about it if it's in your bank!
translation: 如果东西在你的银行里，我什么也告诉不了你！

english: Greetings adventurer, what can I do for you?
translation: 你好，冒险者，我能为你做什么？

english: The name's Porkai, I look after the village canoe station.
translation: 我叫波凯，照看村子的独木舟站点。

english: Interesting, why does the village have a canoe station?
translation: 有意思，村子为什么会有独木舟站点？

english: So that adventurers, such as yourself, can travel the river. Want to know more about canoes?
translation: 为了让你这样的冒险者能在河上旅行。想了解更多关于独木舟的事吗？

english: Well you do not look like you have the right skills to make a canoe at the moment. Try using your axe a bit more first.
translation: 你看起来目前没有足够的技能做独木舟。先用用你的斧头吧。

english: Certainly, swing your axe at this tree here. Then cut it into a canoe, easy stuff.
translation: 当然，对着这棵树挥动斧头，然后把它砍成独木舟，小意思。

english: Unfortunately, you will not be able to carve it into a more reliable canoe right now.
translation: 不幸的是，你现在还不能把它雕刻成一艘更可靠的独木舟。

english: By looking at you and your posture holding your axe, you don't have the right skills for that. You will only be able to go to the next stop.
translation: 看你拿斧头的姿势，你没有那个技能。你只能到下一站。

english: By the looks of it, you can make a reasonable canoe with your skills. You'll be able to make a dugout!
translation: 看样子，凭你的技能你能做一艘过得去的独木舟。你能做一艘独木舟！

english: Two stops sounds about right before it sinks.
translation: 差不多两站就会沉。

english: I see, you seem like the type of adventurer who could make a very nice canoe.
translation: 我明白了，你看起来像是能做出很好独木舟的那种冒险者。

english: A decent distance, but not the whole river.
translation: 一段不错的距离，但不是整条河。

english: Wow, you seem knowledgeable about the woods, are you a gnome yourself? All joking aside, you will be able to craft the best canoes to go anywhere down the river!
translation: 哇，你好像对木材很了解，你自己是个地精吗？玩笑归玩笑，你将能制作最好的独木舟，去河上任何地方！

english: Have you brought the weapon for me?
translation: 你给我带武器来了吗？

english: Good day to you adventurer, could you spare the time to help me?
translation: 你好，冒险者，能抽出时间帮我个忙吗？

english: Our warriors are facing new and dangerous threats, we need a specially designed weapon to be victorious. If you could help by building one of these weapons you will help to ensure victory is ours.
translation: 我们的战士正面临新的危险威胁，我们需要一种特别设计的武器才能获胜。如果你能帮忙打造其中一件武器，就能帮助我们确保胜利。

english: Yes yes, now pay attention. I need you to take a two handed sword, mithril should do, to Doric's place and grind it down to a slender blade. Once it's flexible enough you should be able to string it with a normal
translation: 是的是的，现在注意听。我需要你拿一把双手剑，秘银的就行，去多里克那里把它磨成细长刀刃。等它足够柔韧后，你应该能用普通的弓弦把它绷上。

english: What are you talking about? I just need you to make a delivery to Entrana for me. There's a special ceremony, which unfortunately I can't attend, and I wanted to give them a gift to mark the occasion.
translation: 你在说什么？我只是需要你帮我把东西送到恩特纳岛。有一个特别的仪式，可惜我无法参加，我想送他们一份礼物以纪念这个场合。

english: Not so fast, it's supposed to be a surprise so you'll need to sneak it onto the island. I hear there's some kind of 'other realm' or some such which you've got access to...
translation: 别急，这应该是个惊喜，所以你得偷偷带上岛。我听说你有某种“异界”之类的地方可以进入……

english: Ah excellent, this won't be forgotten. You've been a great help, though I wonder if you could do me one final favour.
translation: 啊，太好了，这不会被忘记的。你帮了大忙，不过我想知道你能否帮我最后一个忙。

english: Yes that's the one. Now take this orb and put it in one of the large pouches from there, don't want it getting damaged.
translation: 对，就是那个。现在拿着这个宝珠，把它放进那里的一个大口袋里，别让它损坏了。

english: bow string. Bring it back here when you're done.
translation: 弓弦。完成后把它带回来。

english: It's a foreign design, maybe later one of our warriors will show you how it's used.
translation: 这是异国设计，也许以后我们的一个战士会教你如何使用。

english: You need to hurry or you'll miss the ceremony.
translation: 你得快点，否则你会错过仪式的。

english: Your name will be forever listed amongst the virtuous!
translation: 你的名字将永远列在美德之人中！

english: It's a foreign design, maybe later one of our warriors will show you how it's used. Speaking of which, may I have it please?
translation: 这是异国设计，也许以后我们的一个战士会教你如何使用。说到这个，能把它给我吗？

english: Owww...Would y-you like to receive a...blessing?
translation: 嗷……你、你想要接受一个……祝福吗？

english: Ah well, our lord is always gracious to those who help him, I'm sure you'd be fittingly rewarded.
translation: 啊，好吧，我们的主人对帮助他的人总是很仁慈，我相信你会得到合适的奖励。

english: Well hurry along then.
translation: 那就快走吧。

english: You what? Ah well, good thing I have a spare, be more careful this time.
translation: 你说什么？啊，好吧，还好我有个备用的，这次小心点。

english: Thanks for the weapon, it won't be forgotten. You've been a great help, though I wonder if you could do me one final favour.
translation: 谢谢你的武器，这不会被忘记的。你帮了大忙，不过我想知道你能否帮我最后一个忙。

english: Ah well, come and see me if you change your mind.
translation: 啊，好吧，如果你改变主意，就来找我。

english: Your loss, our lord can be very generous indeed. Come back and see me if you change your mind.
translation: 你的损失，我们的主人确实非常慷慨。如果你改变主意，就回来找我。

english: You what? Ah well, good thing I have a spare, though you'll have to make some space for it first.
translation: 你说什么？啊，好吧，还好我有个备用的，不过你得先腾出点地方。

english: I must warn you, it could be dangerous. Mort Myre is filled with ghasts!
translation: 我必须警告你，这可能很危险。莫特迈尔到处都是食尸鬼！

english: Misthalin would have quickly fallen to the vampyres, were it not for the the bravery of the Seven Priestly Warriors.
translation: 若不是那七位祭司勇士的英勇，米斯塔林早就落入吸血鬼之手了。

english: Hello, [player name]. Did you find anything out nearby?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你在附近发现什么了吗？

english: How do you mean, [player name]?
translation: 你这是什么意思，[player name]？

english: Likewise, [player name].
translation: 彼此彼此，[player name]。

english: Yes, now the Salve is restored you may, but speak to me first, as I have advice for you before you pass through.
translation: 是的，现在萨尔维河已经恢复，你可以通过了，但先跟我谈谈，在你过去之前，我有一些建议给你。

english: Servants of Saradomin are not concerned with triffling matters such as proof. We have our faith, and our faith guides us.
translation: 萨拉多明的仆从不关心诸如证据之类的琐事。我们有我们的信仰，而我们的信仰指引着我们。

english: Almost certainly adventurer, but not from inside here. You must first open my cell door!
translation: 几乎可以肯定，冒险者，但不是从这里面。你必须先打开我的牢房门！

english: Don't take that tone with me, young man! Saradomin's powers are not to be underestimated.
translation: 别用那种语气跟我说话，年轻人！萨拉多明的力量不容小觑。

english: Many thanks to you brother!
translation: 非常感谢你，兄弟！

english: That's fine, I'm sure someone else will be along shortly who can. Now, if you will excuse me, I do have some things to be getting on with.
translation: 没关系，我相信很快就会有其他人能帮上忙。现在，请恕我失陪，我还有些事情要处理。

english: Don't take that tone with me, young lady! Saradomin's powers are not to be underestimated.
translation: 别用那种语气跟我说话，年轻女士！萨拉多明的力量不容小觑。

english: Many thanks to you sister!
translation: 非常感谢你，姐妹！

english: Perhaps the nature of the spell should give some guidance here. It is a bloom spell isn't it?
translation: 也许这个法术的性质能给你一些指引。这是一个绽放法术，对吧？

english: Perhaps you should harvest natures bounty? In any case, you'll need another bloom scroll, go and see Filliman, he may have another.
translation: 也许你应该去收获大自然的馈赠？无论如何，你还需要另一张绽放卷轴，去找菲利曼吧，他可能还有。

english: Well, what does he need now? Has he asked for any other things? What does it take to become a Nature Spirit?
translation: 嗯，他现在需要什么？他有没有要求其他东西？要成为自然之灵需要什么条件？

english: Filliman's home is somewhere in the southern end of Mort Myre. I don't know the exact location I'm afraid.
translation: 菲利曼的家在莫特迈尔南端的某个地方。恐怕我不知道确切位置。

english: You mean... he's dead?
translation: 你的意思是……他死了？

english: Hmmm, that's very interesting, I seem to remember Father Aereck in Lumbridge and his predecessor Father Urhney having a similar issue. Though this is probably not related to your problem.
translation: 嗯，这很有趣，我记得仑桥镇的艾瑞克神父和他的前任乌尔尼神父也遇到过类似的问题。不过这可能和你的问题无关。

english: Okay, here's another one for you.
translation: 好吧，这里再给你一张。

english: I will pray that it wasn't the spirit of my friend Filliman, but some lost soul who needs some help. Please do let me know how you get on with it.
translation: 我会祈祷那不是我的朋友菲利曼的灵魂，而是一个需要帮助的迷失的灵魂。请务必告诉我你处理得怎么样了。

english: He was always losing things in his camp, take a good look around.
translation: 他总是在营地里丢东西，好好找找。

english: Hello again [player name]. I hear you're working with the Myreque now. You're just the kind of person they need.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。我听说你现在在和迈雷克合作。你正是他们需要的那种人。

english: Ivan told me about this business with Vanescula. You'd all better be careful out there.
translation: 伊万告诉我关于瓦内斯库拉这件事。你们在外面最好都小心点。

english: Well, it sounds like he needs some help, have you tried offering to help him?
translation: 嗯，听起来他需要帮助，你试过主动提出帮助他吗？

english: Okay. Here's another one for you.
translation: 好吧。这里再给你一张。

english: Oh dear, such grave news. Filliman and I used to have such lovely chats...
translation: 哦，天哪，这么沉重的消息。菲利曼和我以前经常愉快地聊天……

english: Hmm, it sounds like he's trapped here until he can accept that he's dead. He still see's the world as if he were in it. If he could somehow see that he is no longer here, that might just do the trick.
translation: 嗯，听起来他困在这里，直到他能接受自己已经死了。他仍然像活着时一样看待这个世界。如果能让他以某种方式看到自己已经不在了，那可能就行了。

english: Hmm, I've no clue really my friend, the life of a priest does not mirror your adventurous life style. I'll certainly reflect on the matter, but I'm sure you'll come up with the answer before too long.
translation: 嗯，我的朋友，我真的毫无头绪，祭司的生活不像你那样充满冒险。我当然会思考这个问题，但我相信你很快就会想出答案的。

english: Well, let me know when you do. It's a limited offer, though, so don't do too much adventuring before you come back or they won't be on offer any longer.
translation: 好吧，等你准备好了就告诉我。不过，这是个限时优惠，所以别在外面冒险太久才回来，否则它们就不再提供了。

english: That's great! How many did Filliman ask you kill?
translation: 太好了！菲利曼让你杀多少只？

english: Hmm, did Filliman ask you to do something special with it? Perhaps it has a special purpose? I'd keep it safe until you need it though, do you have somewhere safe to keep it?
translation: 嗯，菲利曼有没有让你用它做点什么特别的事？也许它有特殊用途？不过，在需要之前，还是把它安全地收好吧，你有安全的地方放它吗？

english: Sorry, my friend, I cannot help you at the moment.
translation: 抱歉，我的朋友，我现在帮不了你。

english: So, tell me, what brings you both to Paterdomus?
translation: 那么，告诉我，是什么风把你们俩吹到帕特多莫斯来的？

english: Well, did Filliman give you any special instructions on how to combat them?
translation: 嗯，菲利曼有没有给你任何关于如何对付它们的特别指示？

english: Hello, [player name], are you back to collect those runes?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你是回来拿那些符文的吗？

english: Well, perhaps it has something to do with the silver sickle, do you think that in blessing it, it did something special to it?
translation: 嗯，也许这和银镰刀有关，你觉得在祝福它的时候，是不是对它做了什么特别的事？

english: Well, perhaps Filliman needs it? Why not show it to him.
translation: 嗯，也许菲利曼需要它？为什么不拿给他看看。

english: It certainly is. Now remember, you need to go and speak to King Roald. These runes will help to get you there more quickly.
translation: 确实如此。现在记住，你需要去和罗尔德国王谈谈。这些符文会帮助你更快地到达那里。

english: So, you've got one more to kill then!
translation: 那么，你还有一个要杀！

english: Well, that's great! You'd best take it to him then with all haste!
translation: 嗯，太好了！你最好尽快把它带给他！

english: So, you've got two more to kill then!
translation: 那么，你还有两个要杀！

english: Well, return when you have some space. And remember, we need to get this information to King Roald regarding your recent attack by these creatures. Time is of the essence.
translation: 好吧，等你有空间了再回来。记住，我们需要把这些关于你最近被这些生物袭击的信息传递给罗尔德国王。时间至关重要。

english: So, you've killed them all then! Go and tell him, I'll bet he'll be pleased.
translation: 那么，你已经把它们全杀了！去告诉他吧，我打赌他会很高兴的。

english: How does it adventurer? Any luck in finding the key to the cell or a way of stopping the vampire yet?
translation: 怎么样了，冒险者？找到牢房钥匙或者阻止吸血鬼的方法了吗？

english: Yes I know, but you have no space for a key at the moment.
translation: 是的，我知道，但你目前没有空间放钥匙。

english: Well don't give up adventurer! That key MUST be around here somewhere! I know none of those Zamorakians ever got very far from this building!
translation: 别放弃，冒险者！那把钥匙一定就在这附近的某个地方！我知道那些萨莫拉克教徒从来没离开过这栋建筑多远！

english: Just check around the building, will you, and make sure there's nothing funny going on. Ivan mentioned that he had heard some strange noises recently.
translation: 检查一下建筑周围，好吗，确保没有什么奇怪的事情发生。伊万提到他最近听到一些奇怪的声音。

english: Good! I'm glad you're keeping your sense of humour; it will help you to maintain mental clarity while dealing with the tasks you've been given.
translation: 很好！我很高兴你还能保持幽默感；这有助于你在处理交给你的任务时保持头脑清晰。

english: I must make immediate preparations and meet with other members of my order. You must hurry directly to King Roald and impart this information to him. Here, take these runes; they should help you to return to
translation: 我必须立即做准备，并会见我教团的其他成员。你必须赶紧直接去找罗尔德国王，把这条信息告诉他。拿着这些符文；它们应该能帮你更快地回到

english: Hello, [player name], did you find anything out nearby?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你在附近发现什么了吗？

english: Well excellent work adventurer! Unfortunately, as you know, I cannot risk waking that vampire in the coffin.
translation: 干得好，冒险者！不幸的是，如你所知，我不能冒险吵醒棺材里的那个吸血鬼。

translation: 哎呀，你好啊，姑娘。朋友们都叫我内德。我曾经是个海上的汉子，但现在不行了。我能给你做或卖些绳子吗？

english: Hello again, lass. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 又见面了，姑娘。有什么我能帮忙的吗？想买些绳子吗？

english: I don't need to be laughed at just 'cos I am getting a bit old.
translation: 我不需要因为年纪大了点就被嘲笑。

english: Ah yes, it's a tough world these days. There's a few brave enough to attack from 10 metres away.

english: You do that then.
translation: 那你就去做吧。

english: Aggie's got a keen eye for colours, and the Wise Old Man is great motivation!

english: Har! Thanks, lad, but I can't be taking all the credit.
translation: 哈！谢谢，小伙子，但我不能独占功劳。

english: Me door? I see no harm in it, go ahead.
translation: 我的门？我看没什么坏处，去吧。

english: Har! Thanks, lass, but I can't be taking all the credit.
translation: 哈！谢谢，姑娘，但我不能独占功劳。

english: Thanks for painting me door, but I think it's missing something.
translation: 谢谢你帮我漆了门，但我总觉得少了点什么。

english: No, I don't think that's it... leave me be, lad, I'll figure it out.
translation: 不，我觉得不是那样……别管我，小伙子，我自己会想明白的。

english: No, I don't think that's it... leave me be, lass, I'll figure it out.
translation: 不，我觉得不是那样……别管我，姑娘，我自己会想明白的。

english: Well... That's an interesting though. Yes, I think I could do something. Give me 3 balls of wool and I might be able to do it.

english: Here you go, how's that for a quick effort? Not nad I think!

english: There you go, finest rope in Zaros.

english: Could you go and check out that abandoned building and see if there's anything odd going on. Just check to see if there's any sign of young Jimmy.
translation: 你能去那栋废弃建筑看看有没有什么奇怪的事吗？就看有没有小吉米的踪迹。

english: Paint? Hmmm... If you have some ingredients I might be able to come up with something. I'll also want payment, mind.
translation: 油漆？嗯...如果你有些材料，我或许能弄出点东西来。不过我也要报酬，注意。

english: This... is an IOU?
translation: 这...是张借条？

english: Hmm... your friend wouldn't happen to be that Easter bunny out in front of Ned's house, would it?
translation: 嗯...你的朋友该不会是奈德家门前那只复活节兔子吧？

english: Because he is so unbelievably adorable! And this note is so cute! I love it!
translation: 因为他实在太可爱了！这张纸条也超可爱！我喜欢！

english: You know, it's funny...
translation: 你知道，这挺有趣的...

english: A while back someone gave me an order to make a bunch of cyan dye, but they never came to collect it.
translation: 不久前有人让我做一堆青色染料，但他们从没来取。

english: I bet it's gotten thick enough to use as paint, meanwhile I can use those flowers to get a fresh batch going!
translation: 我打赌它已经浓稠到能当油漆用了，同时我可以用那些花来做一批新的！

english: And this is coming from a witch who just sits around a cauldron all day!
translation: 这话还是从一个整天围着一口大锅坐着的女巫嘴里说出来的！

english: I tell you what; I don't have any 'paint', per se, but I think I might have something.
translation: 我告诉你吧；我本身没有'油漆'，但我想我可能有别的东西。

english: The people of Draynor aren't usually a festive bunch, but this year everyone seems down right miserable.
translation: 德雷诺的居民通常不是爱过节的人，但今年每个人都显得相当沮丧。

english: It's been sat in the cupboard for a while and has dried up and thickened a fair amount.
translation: 它放在橱柜里有一阵子了，已经干涸并变稠了不少。

english: But hopefully you and your cute bunny friend are able to bring some seasonal cheer to us, Guthix knows we need it...

english: Well dearie, you need a base for the paste.  That's a mix of ash, flour and water. Then you need redberries to colour it as you want. Bring me those four items and I will make you some.

english: Well, I sent him to Lumbridge to get some supplies and he hasn't come back! He left about two days ago and I've seen neither hide nor hair of him in all that time.
translation: 我派他去仑桥镇拿些补给品，但他一直没回来！他大约两天前离开的，从那以后我完全没了他的音讯。

english: It's probably nothing...but it would aid my mind a lot to know that he was safe. I can't leave here until he returns. What if he's had an accident and needs some emergency magical attention?
translation: 可能没什么大事...但知道他很安全会让我放心很多。在他回来之前我不能离开这里。万一他出了意外需要紧急魔法救助呢？

english: Don't mention it, as long as your cute little bunny friend is happy I'm happy.
translation: 不客气，只要你那只可爱的小兔子朋友开心，我就开心。

english: You should probably go see if he needs anything else, I think he's still outside Ned's house.
translation: 你或许该去看看他是否还需要别的，我想他还在奈德的房子外面。

english: I'm not entirely sure. I used to go and nab the stuff from the public gardens in Falador. It hasn't been growing there recently though.
translation: 我不太确定。我以前常去法拉多城的公共花园偷那种东西。但最近那里不长了。

english: Happy Easter to you, [player name]! Do you like the decorations?
translation: 复活节快乐，[player name]！你喜欢这些装饰吗？

english: Well, Ned's an old hand when it comes to crafting, and with two extra pairs of hands it just flew right by.
translation: 嗯，内德在制作方面是个老手，再加上两双额外的帮手，事情很快就做完了。

english: Well, between you and me, I'm not much of a witch. I'm much more into potions and herblore.
translation: 好吧，就你我知道，我算不上个女巫。我更喜欢药水和草药学。

english: And I think he'd agree with me if I said the Wise Old Man is a bit past his prime!
translation: 我觉得如果我说老智者有点过了他的巅峰期，他也会同意的！

english: Oh, I don't know, you mumbled something about 'witnesses', I just can't think straight worrying so much about poor little Jimmy.
translation: 哦，我不知道，你嘟囔了关于'证人'的事情，我担心可怜的小吉米，没法好好思考。

english: Oh, that adventure was with you, was it?
translation: 哦，那次冒险是和你一起的，是吗？

english: Well, I'm sure he'll agree with me when I say the Wise Old Man of old could have easily saved the colony single handedly.
translation: 嗯，我相信他会同意我的说法：当年的老智者本可以单枪匹马轻松拯救那个殖民地。

english: Be careful not to lose it this time.

english: Hm... There's definitely some good colours there, but I don't have anything that'd make it thick enough as well.
translation: 嗯...这些颜色确实不错，但我也没有能让它足够浓稠的东西。

english: Why it's one of my most popular potions. The women here, they like to have smooth looking skin. And I must admit, some of the men buy it as well.
translation: 哎呀，这可是我最受欢迎的药水之一。这里的女人都喜欢皮肤光滑。而且我得承认，有些男人也买。

english: I mostly make what I find pretty. I sometimes make dye for the women's clothes to brighten the place up. I can make red, yellow and blue dyes. If you'd like some, just bring me the appropriate ingredients.
translation: 我通常做我觉得漂亮的东西。有时我给女人们的衣服做染料，让这个地方亮堂起来。我能做红色、黄色和蓝色染料。如果你想要一些，带合适的材料给我就行。

english: Sorry my dear, but I can't talk to you about it right now... People may be listening, try another time and I'll be able to talk.
translation: 对不起亲爱的，但我现在不能跟你谈这个...可能有人在听，换个时间我就能谈了。

english: Then I suggest you leave until you do.
translation: 那我建议你离开，直到你有东西为止。

english: Well, I can tell you I have a valuable prisoner here in my cells.
translation: 嗯，我可以告诉你，我的牢房里关着一个重要的囚犯。

english: I can expect a high reward to be paid very soon for this guy. I can't tell you who he is, but he is a lot colder now.
translation: 我很快就能为这家伙拿到一大笔赎金。我不能告诉你他是谁，但他现在冷多了。

english: Yes. I did most of the work. We had to grab the Pr...
translation: 是的。大部分工作都是我做的。我们不得不抓住那个王……

english: There, run along now I am very busy.
translation: 好了，快走吧，我现在很忙。

english: Can't say, all very secret. You should get out of here. I am not suposed to talk while I guard.
translation: 不能说，都是机密。你应该离开这里。我守卫的时候不该说话。

english: You do have everything for the disguise.
translation: 你确实有伪装所需的一切了。

english: You should carry on, get in and rescue the prince. Keli is sharp, she won't stay tied up long.
translation: 你应该继续前进，进去救出王子。凯莉很精明，她不会长时间被绑住的。

english: Great! The guard is now harmless. Now you just need to use the rope on Keli to remove her. Then you can go in and give everything to the prince.
translation: 太好了！那个守卫现在没威胁了。现在你只需要用绳子绑住凯莉，把她弄走。然后你就可以进去把所有东西交给王子。

english: Foolish man! A new key will cost 15 coins.
translation: 愚蠢的男人！新钥匙要花15金币。

english: Foolish woman! A new key will cost 15 coins.
translation: 愚蠢的女人！新钥匙要花15金币。

english: Get some soft clay and get her to sho you the key somehow. Then take the print, with bronze, to my father.
translation: 弄些软粘土，想办法让她给你看钥匙。然后用青铜取印，带去给我父亲。

english: Good, you have all the basic equipment. Next to deal with the guard on the door. he is talkative, try to find a weakness in him.
translation: 很好，你有了所有基本装备。下一步对付门口的守卫。他很健谈，试着找出他的弱点。

english: You have the rope I see, to tie up Keli. That will be the most dangerous part of the plan.
translation: 我看到你有绳子了，用来绑凯莉。这将是计划中最危险的部分。

english: most of the guards will be easy. The disguise will get past them. The only guards who will be a problem will be the one at the door.
translation: 大多数守卫都很容易对付。伪装就能骗过他们。唯一会出问题的是门口那个守卫。

english: Thank you, Al-Kharid will forever owe you for your help. I think that if there is every anything that needs to be done, you will be someone they can rely on.
translation: 谢谢你，阿尔卡哈德将永远感激你的帮助。我想如果有什么需要做的事，你会是他们可以信赖的人。

english: ...and whatever you do, don't risk giving yourself away when you tell the Sophanites to return.
translation: ……还有，无论你做什么，在告诉索法尼恩人返回时，千万别暴露自己。

english: [player name], what are you doing here!
translation: [player name]，你在这里做什么！

english: I had everything under control here! Besides, I thought we agreed that you would wait upstairs for me?
translation: 这里的一切我都掌控着！而且，我们不是说好了你在楼上等我吗？

english: I didn't go anywhere. I decided to blend into the shadows...just one of the many tricks I've picked up over the years.
translation: 我哪儿也没去。我决定融入阴影……这只是我多年来学到的众多把戏之一。

english: Nah, but I do recommend you pick up Kaleef's dagger. I can assure you, it packs some punch.
translation: 不，但我建议你拿上卡里夫的匕首。我向你保证，它威力不小。

english: It's good to see he went out fighting.
translation: 很高兴看到他战斗到了最后一刻。

english: Indeed, I'm glad he took on board some of my teaching.
translation: 确实，我很高兴他采纳了我的一些教导。

english: My help is needed all over the place.
translation: 到处都需要我的帮助。

english: You must be mistaken. She's in Menaphos and that city is locked tight to everyone, thanks in no small part to me.
translation: 你一定搞错了。她在美纳弗斯城，而那座城市被我封锁得严严实实，这很大程度上归功于我。

english: Nothing out of the ordinary. I've had my people instigate a bit of civil unrest. Officially our cities may be at peace, but I have some old scores to settle first.
translation: 没什么特别的。我让我的人挑起了一些内乱。表面上我们的城市可能处于和平，但我有些旧账要先算。

english: Ah, Maisa, a great talent but far too highly strung. I should have known. I'll send down one of my people to sort her out shortly.
translation: 啊，麦莎，一个很有天赋但太神经质的人。我早该想到的。我很快就会派我的人下去处理她的事。

english: I can't do that; that would be tantamount to sticking one's head in a crocodile's mouth.
translation: 我不能那么做；那无异于把头伸进鳄鱼嘴里。

english: Our two kingdoms were at war with one another for centuries. They tried to expand their kingdom northwards many times over the years, but we held them off.
translation: 我们的两个王国互相交战了几个世纪。多年来，他们多次试图向北扩张领土，但我们抵挡住了他们。

english: The desert is a great equalizer. It's very difficult to move large armies about in it, particularly if you don't have ready access to water.
translation: 沙漠是一个伟大的均衡器。在那里调动大军非常困难，尤其是如果你没有现成的水源。

english: Technically, yes, but that doesn't mean that bad blood will instantly run good. As Spy Master of Al Kharid, I've been responsible for many a dark deed.
translation: 严格来说，是的，但这并不意味着坏血会立刻变好。作为阿尔卡里德城的间谍大师，我负责过许多黑暗的勾当。

english: I owe you nothing for that; Hassan the Chancellor paid you for your services.
translation: 我对此不欠你什么；首相哈桑已经为你的服务付过钱了。

english: Yes, yes, but what are you doing?
translation: 是，是，但你在做什么？

english: So, you've agreed with Maisa to get these people to return to Sophanem? What makes you think that I'll aid you with helping the old enemy?
translation: 那么，你和麦莎已经达成一致，要让这些人返回索法尼恩城？你怎么会认为我会帮助你帮助旧敌？

english: It's nothing. Your nerves are probably just shot. Losing Kaleef was tough on us all.
translation: 没什么。你大概只是神经紧张。失去卡里夫对我们所有人来说都很难受。

english: I think you may be on to something. Leverage... I like that.
translation: 我觉得你可能说到点子上了。筹码……我喜欢这个说法。

english: Get out of here quick before the cave collapses!
translation: 在洞穴坍塌前快离开这里！

english: Don't worry about me. I've been in Sophanem more times than I'd care for and, besides, I'm not called a Spy Master for nothing.
translation: 别担心我。我去索法尼恩城的次数多得我不想再提了，再说了，我被称为间谍大师可不是白叫的。

english: Wait for me here; there's no point in both of us risking our necks getting seen together.
translation: 在这里等我；我们俩没必要都冒险被人看到在一起。

english: I couldn't find a way in; I'm getting too old for scaling city walls.
translation: 我找不到进去的路；我太老了，爬不动城墙了。

english: Well then, [player name], my business is done here so I'll be off.
translation: 那么，[player name]，我的事办完了，我要走了。

english: I have one or two things to sort here before I depart. I'll meet you close to Sophanem shortly.
translation: 我出发前还有一两件事要处理。我很快就会在索法尼恩城附近与你见面。

english: What makes you suggest that I'm more urgently needed in Sophanem?
translation: 是什么让你认为索法尼恩城更需要我？

english: I would be lynched on sight if I were to be found.
translation: 如果被发现，我会被当场处以私刑。

english: What exactly are you up to, anyway?
translation: 话说回来，你到底在搞什么鬼？

english: The Menaphites would find it difficult not to try to punish me or extract certain delicate information out of me if I managed to fall into their arms.
translation: 如果我不小心落入美纳弗人手中，他们很难忍住不惩罚我或从我这里榨取某些敏感信息。

english: Actually, there is one thing you could do for me.
translation: 实际上，有件事你可以为我做。

english: You could get me some sq'irk juice.
translation: 你可以给我弄点斯奇克果汁。

english: So, I'd need a very very good reason to go there.
translation: 所以，我需要一个非常非常好的理由才能去那里。

english: Hello, I am Osman. With what can I assist you?
translation: 你好，我是奥斯曼。有什么可以帮你的？

english: The prince is not here. He is...away. If you can be trusted, speak to the chancellor, Hassan.
translation: 王子不在这里。他……外出了。如果你值得信任，就去和首相哈桑谈谈。

english: I am in the employ of the Emir. That is all you need to know.
translation: 我为埃米尔效力。你只需要知道这些。

english: My wounds are healing slowly but I think I'll make a full recovery.
translation: 我的伤口愈合得很慢，但我想我会完全康复的。

english: Maisa is fine. Where she is or what she's doing, I couldn't possibly tell you.
translation: 麦莎很好。她在哪里或在做什么，我绝对不能告诉你。

english: One piece of espionage gossip I can tell you is that I won't be returning to Sophanem or Menaphos any time soon.
translation: 我能告诉你的一则间谍八卦是，我不会很快返回索法尼恩城或美纳福斯。

english: Is there anything else with which I can help you?
translation: 还有其他我能帮你的吗？

english: That bothers me not. The secrets of Al-Kharid protect themselves.
translation: 我不在乎。阿尔卡里德的秘密会保护自己。

english: Would this be what you're looking for?
translation: 这是你要找的东西吗？

english: I'll let it go for hmmmm...what's a blade like this worth? Lets say 20000 gold coins.
translation: 让我想想……这样的刀片值多少钱？就算两万金币吧。

english: Uh, thanks, but is there any chance you could squeeze the fruit into the glass for me?
translation: 呃，谢谢，但你能不能帮我把水果挤到杯子里？

english: How are you getting on with what we need?
translation: 我们需要的东西你准备得怎么样了？

english: So you'd better come up with a much better reason to get me to go to Sophanem.
translation: 所以你最好想出一个更好的理由让我去索法尼恩城。

english: Good, you have the print of the key. Get a bar of bronze, too, and I can get the key made.
translation: 很好，你有钥匙的印模了。再拿一根青铜条，我就能把钥匙做出来。

english: We discovered a stash of them in some of our investigations. As far as we have been able to determine, it was created by worshippers of Elidinis in order to smite the followers of Scabaras.
translation: 我们在一些调查中发现了一批这样的东西。据我们目前所知，这是由埃利迪尼斯的信徒制造的，用来惩戒斯卡巴拉斯的追随者。

english: They are specially enchanted against both scarab creatures and kalphites...which is odd, since we thought the two races to be entirely different. Any more details you'll have to discover yourself by using it in the field.
translation: 它们被特别附魔，对圣甲虫生物和卡尔菲特都有效……这很奇怪，因为我们原以为这两个种族完全不同。更多细节你得自己在实战中使用它来发现。

english: When you have everything, go to Leela. Then you can start the breakout.
translation: 当你准备好一切后，去找莉拉。然后你就可以开始越狱行动了。

english: That there might be, but, if there is, it belongs to the dead. Bad things happen to those who steal from them.
translation: 也许有，但如果有，那也是属于死者的。偷他们东西的人会遭遇不幸。

english: Do you know Simon Templeton?
translation: 你认识西蒙.坦普尔顿吗？

english: I'm sure to be recognised; we'd then have to fight our way through the town. Any hopes that we had for the truce between our cultures would then be as dead as the guards.
translation: 我肯定会被认出来；那样我们就得一路打穿城镇。我们对我们文化之间休战的任何希望都会和那些守卫一样死掉。

english: Well, that particular grave robber is stuck out in the desert with no real hope of escape because of his greed.
translation: 嗯，那个特别的盗墓者因为贪婪被困在沙漠里，没有真正的逃脱希望。

english: Hmm... I like the sounds of that...but no, it's still too risky. I can't jeopardise the truce by being caught here.
translation: 嗯……我喜欢这个主意……但是不行，风险还是太大了。我不能因为在这里被抓而危及休战。

english: I hear from Leela that you are well on the way with the rescue. I am always kept informed, you know.
translation: 我从莉拉那里听说你的救援行动进展顺利。你知道的，我总是消息灵通。

english: I only carry knives or other such devices on me when I'm on the job.
translation: 我只有在执行任务时才会随身携带刀具或其他此类装置。

english: I have a few tricks up my sleeves yet.
translation: 我还有些锦囊妙计。

english: I see you failed to pick up Kaleef's dagger after you slew that vile scarab. Luckily for you, Maisa was able to pass it on to me before I made my escape.
translation: 我看到你在杀死那只可恶的圣甲虫后，忘了捡起卡里夫的匕首。幸运的是，麦莎在我逃脱前把它交给了我。

english: The dagger I just gave you is specially enchanted against both scarab creatures and kalphites...which is odd, since we thought the two races to be entirely different. Any more details you'll have to discover yourself by
translation: 我刚给你的匕首被特别附魔，对圣甲虫生物和卡尔菲特都有效……这很奇怪，因为我们原以为这两个种族完全不同。更多细节你得自己在实战中使用它来发现。

english: using it in the field.
translation: 在实战中使用它来发现。

english: Well, whatever or which, you'll need a better reason for me to leave here.
translation: 好吧，不管是什么或哪个，你需要一个更好的理由让我离开这里。

english: We are aware of this. The elite guard will protect them from any harm.
translation: 我们知道这一点。精英守卫会保护他们免受任何伤害。

english: I've no idea what is going on there. It's all on a need- to-know basis so I'm not going to be asking you for information either.
translation: 我不知道那里发生了什么。一切都是按需知悉的原则，所以我也不会向你打听信息。
