translation: 训练短弓和训练箭只能一起使用。记得捡回你的箭，重复使用，需要更多时再回来领取。

english: more likely to hit, rapid means you shoot more often but might not hit so often and long range means just that, it increases your range. I prefer rapid personally, experiment and try it out!
translation: 精准模式更容易命中，快速模式意味着你射得更快但可能不那么容易命中，而远程模式顾名思义，就是增加你的射程。我个人更喜欢快速模式，试试看吧！

english: Visit the ranging guild over near Hemenster, there you can practice your archery and earn tickets for it at the same time.
translation: 去海门斯特附近的射手公会看看吧，在那里你可以练习射箭，同时还能赚取奖券。

english: Ahh the art of making your own bow and arrows. It's quite simple really. You'll need an axe to cut some logs from trees and a knife. Knives can be found in and around the Lumbridge castle and in the Varrock
translation: 啊，自制弓箭的艺术。其实相当简单。你需要一把斧头来砍树获取原木，以及一把小刀。小刀可以在仑桥镇城堡附近和维洛克城

english: General store upstairs.
translation: 的杂货店楼上找到。

english: For arrows you will need to smith some arrow heads and kill some chickens for feathers. Add the feathers and heads to the shafts to make arrows you can use.
translation: 对于箭矢，你需要锻造一些箭头，然后杀鸡获取羽毛。将羽毛和箭头装到箭杆上就能做出可用的箭了。

english: to make a working bow!
translation: 才能做出一把能用的弓！

english: You'll need to find a flax field. There's one south of Seers' Village. Gather flax, then spin it on a spinning wheel, there's one in Seers' Village too. This makes bow strings which you can then use on the unstrung bows
translation: 你需要找到一片亚麻田。先知村南边就有一片。采集亚麻，然后在纺车上纺线，先知村也有纺车。这样能做出弓弦，然后将弓弦用在未上弦的弓上

english: Darts are the way to go! If you haven't already, talk to Irene south of the Shantay pass.
translation: 飞镖才是王道！如果你还没去过，去沙泰隘口南边找艾琳聊聊。

english: You can throw darts much quicker than you can shoot arrows. Sure they don't do quite the damage of arrows, but you have more chances to hit with darts for that very reason.
translation: 投掷飞镖的速度比射箭快得多。虽然伤害不如箭矢，但正因如此你有了更多命中机会。

english: Wow! You were incredible!
translation: 哇！你太厉害了！

english: The way you defeated the Culinaromancer, you made it seem so easy!
translation: 你打败烹饪大师的方式，看起来真轻松！

english: Hello friend, how is the adventuring going?
translation: 你好朋友，冒险进行得怎么样了？

english: One Eye Of Newt A freshly made 'Dirty Blast' A rotten tomato
translation: 一个蝾螈眼、一杯现调的'脏爆'、一个烂番茄

english: Does he want a cake? Cakes are my most famous product.
translation: 他想要蛋糕吗？蛋糕是我最出名的作品。

english: Great! You're back!
translation: 太好了！你回来了！

english: Seriously, you were great! I can't believe I nearly caused all of those people to be killed!
translation: 说真的，你太棒了！真不敢相信我差点害死那么多人！

english: I keep running out of supplies! There should be a Grand Exchange outlet in every town - that'd be a proper 'quality of life' improvement. How does anyone train like this?
translation: 我的补给品老是见底！每个城镇都应该有个大交易所分店——那才是真正的'生活质量'提升。这样叫人怎么练技能？

english: Did you bring the ingredients I asked for?
translation: 你带了我要求的材料吗？

english: Also, shops should have instant restocking of items, and there ought to be an option to stop food ever burning - that'd make Cooking less frustrating. And a frustrating world is a badly designed one.
translation: 还有，商店应该能即时补货，而且应该有个选项让食物永远不会烧焦——这样烹饪就不会那么烦人了。一个让人沮丧的世界就是设计糟糕的世界。

english: Really, people who just want to cook well immediately ought to be able to choose that, while people who want to train the skill slowly should be able to do that instead. Then everyone would be happy.
translation: 真的，想立刻做好菜的人应该能选择那样，而想慢慢练技能的人也能选择慢慢来。这样大家就都开心了。

english: Alright, I can work from memory now. I've tried this recipe so many times, you know. One day I'll get it right - so far, all the cakes just burn, so I have to send another adventurer to fetch more ingredients.
translation: 好吧，我现在可以凭记忆做了。这个食谱我试过太多次了，你知道的。总有一天我会做对——但到目前为止，所有蛋糕都烧焦了，所以我只好再派另一个冒险者去取更多材料。

english: Remember, I need an eye of newt, a glass of greenman's ale, a rotten tomato, and a 'Dirty Blast'!
translation: 记住，我需要一个蝾螈眼、一杯绿人麦酒、一个烂番茄，还有一杯'脏爆'！

english: Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realise it was Easter already!
translation: 哦，好可爱的兔子！我都没意识到复活节已经到了！

english: Hmm... Well, I do have a large collection of eggs, but most of them are regular old chicken eggs for making cakes.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我确实收集了一大堆蛋，但大部分都是做蛋糕用的普通鸡蛋。

english: Seriously, don't mention it.
translation: 说真的，别客气。

english: Well, that's me convinced! Let me dig them out for you!
translation: 好吧，你说服我了！让我把它们翻出来给你！

english: Sorry, sir, I can't work any more until you pay me my 3,000 coins.
translation: 抱歉，先生，除非你付我3000金币，否则我不能再工作了。

english: I don't know if this occasion is special enough, though.
translation: 不过我不确定这个场合够不够特别。

english: Though come to think of it, I might have something...
translation: 不过想想，我可能有点东西……

english: There's a sheep pen not too far north of here. You could get some fresh wool if you wanted.
translation: 从这里往北不远有个羊圈。如果你想要的话，可以去弄点新鲜羊毛。

english: I have a... 'special' collection of eggs that I keep in the... well... back of my cupboards for very... 'special' occasions.
translation: 我有一批……'特别'的蛋收藏，放在……嗯……橱柜后面，留着非常……'特别'的场合用。

english: Yes, go to the sheep pen and out of my kitchen...
translation: 对，去羊圈吧，离开我的厨房……

english: Oh, you're still here.
translation: 哦，你还在这儿啊。

english: I suppose you want me to bring back one of those.
translation: 我猜你是想让我带一个回来吧。

english: Didn't you say you were off to the sheep pen north of here?
translation: 你不是说你要去北边的羊圈吗？

english: Actually, while you're still here, there's something else you can do.
translation: 其实，既然你还在这儿，还有件事你可以做。

english: It's the Duke's birthday soon, and I'm running low on ingredients.
translation: 公爵的生日快到了，我的材料快用完了。

english: Sorry, madam, I can't work any more until you pay me my 3,000 coins.
translation: 抱歉，女士，除非你付我3000金币，否则我不能再工作了。

english: Ahem... forget I said anything.
translation: 咳咳……当我没说。

english: You really got my bacon out of the fire there!
translation: 你可真是救了我一命！

english: If you insist on using a talented cook as a mere courier! What do you need?
translation: 如果你坚持要把一个有才华的厨师当跑腿的用！你需要什么？

english: I refuse to carry more than 16 items!
translation: 我拒绝携带超过16样物品！

english: One of Gielinor's finest chefs reduced to a builder's mate. All right, I'll be back soon.
translation: 吉莱诺最优秀的厨师之一沦落成建筑工的小弟。好吧，我很快就回来。

english: I... well yes, but how else am I supposed to train cooking?
translation: 我……嗯，是的，但不然我该怎么练烹饪？

english: And have the entire castle smelling like Port Sarim? No thank you!
translation: 然后让整座城堡闻起来像沙林港？不了谢谢！

english: Oh, has he changed his mind about wanting a cake?
translation: 哦，他改变主意不要蛋糕了吗？

english: Ooh dear, yes I do! It's the Duke of Lumbridge's birthday today, and I need to bake him a cake!
translation: 哦天哪，是的！今天是伦布里奇公爵的生日，我得给他烤个蛋糕！

english: Hello again adventurer! How's the adventuring going?
translation: 又见面了冒险者！冒险进行得怎么样了？

english: I need you to bring me some eggs, some flour, some milk and a chocolate bar...
translation: 我需要你帮我带些鸡蛋、面粉、牛奶和一根巧克力棒……

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take the last item because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连最后一样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Nah, not really, I'm just messing with you! Thanks for all your help, I know I can count on you again in the future!
translation: 不，没有啦，我逗你玩的！谢谢你的所有帮助，我知道以后还能再指望你！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 2 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这两样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: And why haven't you gone and looked at the feast I have prepared yet?
translation: 还有，你为什么还没去看我准备的盛宴？

english: I'm sure the gnome still has it.
translation: 我确定那个地精还留着它。

english: Hah! You just don't appreciate a culinary artist!
translation: 哈！你就是不懂得欣赏烹饪艺术家！

english: Okay, do you want me to take those to the sawmill, or the bank?
translation: 好吧，你要我送到锯木厂还是银行？

english: Trust me, it will be a sight the likes of which you will never see again!
translation: 相信我，那会是你再也见不到的奇景！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 8 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这8样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: That's why I always need adventurers to bring me more ingredients, yes. It'd be so much easier if they'd just add a Grand Exchange outlet in here, for my 'quality of life'.
translation: 这就是为什么我总需要冒险者给我带更多材料，是的。要是他们能在这里开个大交易所分店，为了我的'生活质量'，那就容易多了。

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 4 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这4样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Err... Try looking in your pocket?
translation: 呃……看看你口袋里？

english: You're welcome. It wasn't helping me anymore.
translation: 不客气。它对我已经没用了。

english: Don't worry - there are plenty more where they came from. I'll get it right one day.
translation: 别担心——还有很多呢。总有一天我会做对的。

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 3 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这3样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: You seem to have some on you now, so I'll assume that you are joking.
translation: 你现在身上好像有一些，所以我猜你是在开玩笑。

english: You could try locating the source of that crabby smell from your inventory..
translation: 你可以试着从你的背包里找出那股螃蟹味的来源……

english: Well, the way I remember it you walked out of here, came back a little later to ask how fishcakes are made, and then went and freed Pirate Pete with one.
translation: 嗯，我记得你走出这里，过了一会儿回来问鱼饼怎么做，然后就用一块鱼饼去救了海盗皮特。

english: You jumped into the magic portal right behind him and fought him to the death!
translation: 你跳进他身后的魔法传送门，和他战斗到死！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 7 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这7样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Only if you give it to me, you fool!
translation: 除非你把它给我，你这个傻瓜！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 5 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这5样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 6 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这6样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Admittedly that is the simple version, but the excitement of the final showdown overshadowed that particular adventure.
translation: 诚然那是简略版，但最终对决的刺激盖过了那次冒险的细节。

english: Also, it's a little-known fact that if you poison a chicken via combat, without it dying immediately, or changing its combat target, it might start laying more eggs.
translation: 还有，很少有人知道，如果你在战斗中给一只鸡下毒，而它没有立即死亡，也没有改变攻击目标，它可能会开始下更多蛋。

english: I suppose you want me to take that to the bank?
translation: 我猜你是想让我把这个送到银行？

english: You fool! You don't have any in your bank!
translation: 你这个傻瓜！你的银行里一个都没有！

english: One of Gielinor's finest chefs reduced to a courier. All right, I'll be back soon.
translation: 吉莱诺最优秀的厨师之一沦落成跑腿的。好吧，我很快就回来。

english: Alright, madam. I can start work immediately.
translation: 好的，女士。我可以马上开始工作。

english: Well, he wanted some funny looking eggs, and they were the funniest I had.
translation: 嗯，他想要一些奇怪的蛋，而这是我手里最奇怪的了。

english: Of course I can! Give me some logs and I'll fetch the planks for you.
translation: 我当然可以！给我一些原木，我就去帮你取木板。

english: I, sir, am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: 我，先生，是吉莱诺最优秀的厨师！我还能很快地往返银行或锯木厂。

english: What gnome child?
translation: 什么地精小孩？

english: Honestly! I go to all this trouble to fetch something and you don't even want it!
translation: 说真的！我费这么大劲去取东西，结果你还不想要！

english: Have you tried looking in your backpack?
translation: 你试过看看你的背包吗？

english: Just be thankful he didn't ask for some fancy milk instead!
translation: 庆幸他没要什么高级牛奶吧！

english: You mean you didn't check it out yet?
translation: 你是说你还没去看过？

english: Excellent! Those fishcakes are exactly the same as the ones you used to protect Pirate Pete from the Culinaromancer's spell before!
translation: 太好了！这些鱼饼和你之前用来保护海盗皮特免受烹饪大师法术影响的一模一样！

english: I can't give you the money you will need to purchase ingredients if you don't have any room for it!
translation: 如果你没有空间，我就不能给你买材料需要的钱！

english: I really think you should, it seems to be some kind of magical cooking chest, I found a bunch of food in it earlier, along with a bunch of weird looking kitchen equipment and some snazzy gloves!
translation: 我真的觉得你应该去看看，那似乎是个魔法烹饪箱，我之前在里面找到了一堆食物，还有一些奇怪的厨房装备和时髦的手套！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 9 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这9样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Great! When you've cooked those up, they'll be exactly the same as the ones you used to save Pirate Pete before!
translation: 太好了！等你把这些做好，它们就会和你之前用来救海盗皮特的一模一样！

english: Come back and see me when you have some free space!
translation: 等你腾出空间再来找我！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 10 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这10样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Of course, sir! After you've tasted my cooking you'll never want to eat anywhere else!
translation: 当然，先生！品尝了我的烹饪后，你就不想去别处吃了！

english: Well, get those fancy ideas out of your head. Out here you've got nothing but your armour and muscle to protect you from the endless dark and the screaming hordes coming to kill you!
translation: 好了，把那些花哨的想法从脑子里清掉。在这里，你只有盔甲和肌肉来保护你，免受无尽的黑暗和前来杀你的尖叫大军的侵袭！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 16 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这16样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: I, madam, am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: 我，女士，是吉莱诺最优秀的厨师！我还能很快地往返银行或锯木厂。

english: He said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: 他说'你能讲个笑话吗？'上当了吧！哈哈哈！

english: A cup of tea? Is THAT all?
translation: 一杯茶？就这？

english: Of course, madam! After you've tasted my cooking you'll never want to eat anywhere else!
translation: 当然，女士！品尝了我的烹饪后，你就不想去别处吃了！

english: I absolutely refuse to carry more than 16 items!
translation: 我绝对拒绝携带超过16样物品！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 12 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这12样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Oh dear. Well I'm sure if you try again you will get it right this time. You did it ok before, right?
translation: 哦天哪。好吧，我相信如果你再试一次，这次一定能做对。你之前不是做得好好的吗？

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 11 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这11样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Your tea. Do you want me to put milk in it for you as well?
translation: 你的茶。要我也帮你加牛奶吗？

english: Yes. He said he wants my recipe book, right?
translation: 是的。他说他想要我的食谱书，对吧？

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 15 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我大老远跑去银行为你取东西，结果你连这15样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: I'm sure I'll have more success with your ingredients. I have a lucky feeling about it, this time.
translation: 我相信用你的材料我会更成功。这次我有种幸运的感觉。

english: Because you can't be bothered to? A fine friend you are!
translation: 因为你懒得去？你可真是个好伙伴！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 13 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我特地跑到银行给你取东西，结果你连这13样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Would you like a drink?
translation: 要来杯饮料吗？

english: She said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: 她说‘你能讲个笑话吗？’上当了吧！哈哈哈！

english: I go all the way to the bank for you and then you can't even take these 14 items because your hands are full!
translation: 我特地跑到银行给你取东西，结果你连这14样都拿不了，因为手满了！

english: Thanks, but you've already given me an egg.
translation: 谢了，但你已经给过我鸡蛋了。

english: I don't want bank-notes pal, I need the ingredients to cook with!
translation: 伙计，我不要银行票据，我需要食材来烹饪！

english: I think he said he was going to the sheep pen north of here.
translation: 我想他说他要去北边的羊圈。

english: Thanks, but you've already given me some flour.
translation: 谢了，但你已经给过我一些面粉了。

english: And I suppose you'll want me to clean up after your drunken friends as well?
translation: 我猜你还想让我帮你那些喝醉的朋友清理吧？

english: Oh dear, oh dear, oh dear, I'm in a terrible mess! It's the Duke's birthday today, and I should be making him a lovely big birthday cake.
translation: 哎呀呀呀，我真是糟透了！今天是公爵的生日，我本该给他做一个又大又漂亮的生日蛋糕。

english: Your kitchen isn't equipped even for making tea! How can you expect me to work in a place like this?
translation: 你的厨房连泡茶都不够格！你怎么指望我在这种地方干活？

english: Thanks, but I don't need any flour any more.
translation: 谢了，但我不再需要面粉了。

english: Thanks for the ingredients you have got so far please get the rest quickly. I'm running out of time! The Duke will throw me into the streets!
translation: 谢谢你拿到的食材，请快点把剩下的找来。我没时间了！公爵会把我赶到大街上去的！

english: Thanks, but you've already given me some milk.
translation: 谢了，但你已经给过我一些牛奶了。

english: How should I know? You should check in Draynor, maybe you'll find him there.
translation: 我怎么知道？你应该去德雷诺找找，说不定能在那里找到他。

english: Thanks, but I don't need any milk any more.
translation: 谢了，但我不再需要牛奶了。

english: How can I be expected to work without a properly equipped kitchen?
translation: 没有配备齐全的厨房，我怎么工作？

english: Thanks, but I don't need an egg any more.
translation: 谢了，但我不再需要鸡蛋了。

english: You don't own a dining table for me to serve the food on! Honestly, how can I work in a house like this?
translation: 你连一张让我上菜的餐桌都没有！说真的，我怎么能在这种房子里工作？

english: And what will I do if I can't get back in here when I'm done? Your bank is full!
translation: 要是我干完活回不来怎么办？你的银行满了！

english: You ask me to serve drinks but you don't have any in your kitchen! Honestly, I've never worked for such an idiot!
translation: 你让我上饮料，可你厨房里一瓶都没有！说真的，我从没给这么蠢的人干过活！

english: Sorry, sir, I can't work any more until you pay me my 3,000 coins. The moneybag hasn't got enough.
translation: 抱歉，先生，你付我3000金币之前我没法继续工作。钱袋里钱不够。

english: This house not good enough for you? All right, follow me.
translation: 这房子不够好是吧？行，跟我来。

english: Sorry, madam, I can't work any more until you pay me my 3,000 coins. The moneybag hasn't got enough.
translation: 抱歉，女士，你付我3000金币之前我没法继续工作。钱袋里钱不够。

english: It's nearly pay day, sir. My fee is 3,000 coins.
translation: 快到发薪日了，先生。我的费用是3000金币。

english: That item can't be stored in a bank, you fool!
translation: 那东西不能存银行，你这个蠢货！

english: I refuse to handle those unhygenic bones!
translation: 我拒绝处理那些不卫生的骨头！

english: Dinner is served!
translation: 晚餐准备好了！

english: There is a Mill fairly close, Go North and then West. Mill Lane Mill is just off the road to Draynor. I usually get my flour from there.
translation: 附近有一个磨坊，往北走再往西。磨坊巷磨坊就在通往德雷诺的路边。我通常从那里拿面粉。

english: Talk to Millie, she'll help, she's a lovely girl and a fine Miller..
translation: 去找米莉，她会帮忙的，她是个可爱的女孩，也是个好磨坊主。

english: You idiot! Your bank is so full of useless junk that nothing else will fit!
translation: 你这个白痴！你的银行里塞满了没用的垃圾，什么都放不下了！

english: Talk to Gillie Groats, she looks after the Dairy cows ' she'll tell you everything you need to know about milking cows!
translation: 去找吉利.格罗茨，她照看奶牛，她会告诉你所有关于挤奶的事！

english: It's nearly pay day, madam. My fee is 3,000 coins.
translation: 快到发薪日了，女士。我的费用是3000金币。

english: Fine! I don't know why I bother.
translation: 好吧！我真不知道我干嘛要费劲。

english: This recipe is one of the oldest legends in our world, and I would greatly appreciate the book from which it comes.
translation: 这份食谱是我们世界最古老的传说之一，我非常感激能拥有记载它的那本书。

english: You've got so much random junk in your bank that that won't fit!
translation: 你银行里乱七八糟的垃圾太多了，放不下了！

english: If you don't want any then you should stop wasting my time!
translation: 如果你不想要，就别浪费我时间！

english: It's all standard cook's issue uniform...
translation: 这都是标准的厨师制服……

english: I'm a servant ready to work. I'll offer my services to you for an initial hiring cost of 150,000 coins. What do you say?
translation: 我是个仆从，随时可以工作。初次雇用费用为15万金币，我愿意为你服务。你觉得怎么样？

english: If you don't want me to take any then you should stop wasting my time!
translation: 如果你不让我拿，就别浪费我时间！

english: Your bank is too full to take those certificates.
translation: 你的银行太满，放不下那些凭证了。

english: It's nearly pay day, madam. My fee is 3,000 coins, and the moneybag hasn't got that much.
translation: 快到发薪日了，女士。我的费用是3000金币，但钱袋里没那么多。

english: Thank you, Moha the great goat fucker! If you can convince the Duke I'm telling the truth then we can get to the bottom of this mystery.
translation: 谢谢你，伟大的山羊干者莫哈！如果你能让公爵相信我说的真话，我们就能查清这个谜团。

english: I can carry 16 items at once and I take 17 seconds to return from a bank trip. Every 8 services I perform for you, I'll require 15,000 coins.
translation: 我一次能拿16样东西，去银行往返需要17秒。每为你服务8次，我需要15000金币。

english: Ha Ha Ha Ha
translation: 哈哈哈哈

english: Yeah, I think you need to prepare the ingredients first.
translation: 是啊，我觉得你得先准备好材料。

english: You've spoiled that one though, you'd better go and get some more ingredients.
translation: 不过那个被你搞砸了，你最好再去弄点材料来。

english: gghmnmmn !!!
translation: 嗯嗯嗯嗯！！！

english: Iwazaru mimes a slicing motion and a grinding motion.
translation: 言猴比划了一个切割动作和一个研磨动作。

english: Hello ambassador, what can I do for you?
translation: 你好，大使，有什么能帮你的？

english: Hello again, Can I do anything for you?
translation: 又见面了，有什么能为你效劳的吗？

english: Well, enjoy the Island.
translation: 嗯，好好享受这座岛吧。

english: Thanks. Now I have regal business to get on with, enjoy your stay here.
translation: 谢谢。现在我有王室事务要处理，祝你在这里玩得愉快。

english: You need to prepare the ingredients and stuff the animal.
translation: 你需要准备材料，然后把动物填满。

english: I don't know - they don't let blind monkeys into the kitchen.  Anyway, you're the cook. I'm sure you can work it out.
translation: 我不知道——他们不让瞎猴子进厨房。反正你是厨师，我相信你能搞定的。

english: I'm Mizaru - This is Iwazaru
translation: 我是观猴，这是言猴。

english: Tasty Banana. Thanks mate!
translation: 美味的香蕉。谢啦，伙计！

english: He says hello, and this is Kikazaru
translation: 他向你问好，这是闻猴。

english: Nuts! I love nuts. Yummy
translation: 坚果！我爱坚果。好吃。

english: Apparently there are some on the small island to the east of here.  Never been there myself - they be foreign lands.
translation: 据说东边的小岛上就有一些。我自己从没去过——那些是异国他乡。

english: Ooh, Mmmmm tasty. Thanks.
translation: 哦，嗯，好吃。谢谢。

english: Of course. You'll need to provide the coal tar though. Do you need reminding how it works?
translation: 当然。不过你得提供煤焦油。需要提醒你它怎么用吗？

english: It's quite simple really. You have to get the still heat up very high. However, if it gets too hot it will burn out and you will have to start over.
translation: 其实很简单。你必须把蒸馏器的温度升得很高。但是，如果温度太高，它就会烧坏，你就得重新开始。

english: Make sure there's no lamp oil in there first, mind.
translation: 首先确保里头没有灯油，注意。

english: It's very nice that you've come all the way down here, but I really don't have time to talk at the moment. Maybe if you come back later I'll be able to help.
translation: 你大老远过来很好，但我现在真没时间聊。也许你晚点再来我能帮你。

english: Well, I may be able to help you, but I think this will require more knowledge of herbs and flowers than you currently possess.
translation: 嗯，我也许能帮你，但我认为这需要你对草药和花卉有比现在更多的了解。

english: Well then. Hmmm. My lamp oil still may be able to do what you want. Give it a go, and see if it works.
translation: 那么好吧。嗯。我的灯油蒸馏器也许能做到你想要的。试试看，看有没有用。

english: You will have to mix the flowers with the oil first; you won't be able to put flowers in the still.
translation: 你得先把花和油混合；你不能直接把花放进蒸馏器。

english: Oh, and make sure there's no lamp oil in there first, mind.
translation: 哦，还有先确保里头没有灯油，注意。

english: Glad to help, anytime.
translation: 乐意效劳，随时。

english: You cannot pass! These are the king's quarters. No one enters without invitation.
translation: 你不能过去！这里是国王的寝宫。未经邀请，任何人不得入内。

english: Sorry, can't stop to talk, you should go to General Hining.
translation: 抱歉，没空聊天，你应该去找希宁将军。

english: If the king wants to see you he will ask for you.
translation: 如果国王想见你，他会召见你的。

english: Absolutely none! Now let me get on with my job.
translation: 完全没有！现在让我继续工作吧。

english: You cannot enter! This is now General Hining's pavilion. Since the king's death he has held us together.
translation: 你不能进去！现在是希宁将军的营帐。国王去世后，是他团结了我们。

english: I remember you! You're the one who's working with them wicked elves. I will make you pay for that mistake.
translation: 我记得你！你就是那个跟那些邪恶精灵勾结的家伙。我会让你为此付出代价。

english: Good day. Sorry I can't stop to talk. General Hining is keeping a tight watch.
translation: 日安。抱歉，没空聊天。希宁将军盯得很紧。

english: I wish I could. Just to see my wife, but if we don't stop the evil here, it will be too late!
translation: 我希望我能回去。哪怕只是见见我妻子。但如果我们不在这里阻止邪恶，那就太晚了！

english: These are dark times, I must prepare for the coming darkness.
translation: 黑暗时代来临，我必须为即将到来的黑暗做好准备。

english: Soon Zamorak's fury will be released upon us.
translation: 很快萨莫拉克的怒火就会降临到我们头上。

english: Good day, I'm busy guarding King Tyras. I have no time for idle chat.
translation: 日安，我正在忙着守卫泰拉斯国王。没时间闲聊。

english: Sorry, I shouldn't give out sensitive information to civilians. You should go to General Hining. He's in command since the death of the king.
translation: 抱歉，我不应该向平民透露敏感信息。你应该去找希宁将军。国王去世后由他指挥。

english: I've got no need for that.
translation: 我不需要那个。

english: You got me a rabbit! Great! Only problem is I don't have any way to cook it.
translation: 你给了我一只兔子！太好了！唯一的问题是我没法烹饪它。

english: Human! You must be one of Tyras's men. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: 人类！你一定是泰拉斯的手下。我没时间理会匪徒或逃犯。

english: Thanks... But I have no need of that.
translation: 谢谢……但我不需要那个。

english: Ahh... brigand [player name]...
translation: 啊……匪徒[player name]……

english: I have no need for that.
translation: 我不需要那个。

english: Leave me be. I have no time for brigands or outlaws.
translation: 别烦我。我没时间理会匪徒或逃犯。

english: Me me, scratch me behind the ears.
translation: 我我，挠我耳朵后面。

english: I was going anyway, hiss. You're probably the worst adventurer ever, I bet you'll probably be killed by a chicken before too long, hisss!!!
translation: 反正我本来就要走了，嘶。你大概是有史以来最差劲的冒险者了，我打赌你很快就会被一只鸡杀死，嘶嘶嘶！！！

english: Hiss...
Meow what does the human want?
translation: 喵，这人类想要什么？

english: Nothing much, bit of this, bit of that. You know how it is.
translation: 没什么，一点这个一点那个。你知道的。

english: Do you have something you'd like to trade, young man?
translation: 小兄弟，你有什么想交易的东西吗？

english: Do you have something you'd like to trade, young woman?
translation: 小姑娘，你有什么想交易的东西吗？

english: I'm not taking that off you.
translation: 这东西我可不要。

english: Just a little place where we Spirit Anglers can store things, young man. I used to be the chief mate on one of our ships, but now I just watch over the stores from the land.
translation: 只是一个小地方，年轻人，我们海灵垂钓者可以存放东西。我曾经是我们一艘船上的大副，但现在我只是在陆地上看守仓库。

english: Just a little place where we Spirit Anglers can store things, young woman. I used to be the chief mate on one of our ships, but now I just watch over the stores from the land.
translation: 只是一个小地方，年轻女士，我们海灵垂钓者可以存放东西。我曾经是我们一艘船上的大副，但现在我只是在陆地上看守仓库。

english: You should take the pages out of the book before trying to exchange it for more pages!
translation: 你应该先把书中的书页取出来，再尝试用它换取更多书页！

english: Go and talk to Gita Prymes if you don't want your spirit angler kit anymore.
translation: 如果你不想要你的海灵垂钓者工具包了，就去找吉塔.普莱姆斯谈谈吧。

english: Hello? Who's there? I can't see anything.
translation: 喂？谁在那儿？我什么也看不见。

english: Oh, wow, I never thought of that.
translation: 哦，哇，我从没想到过这个。

english: Wait, before you go, I apologise for the mess. I haven't cleaned my room in a while.
translation: 等等，在你走之前，我为这乱糟糟的样子道歉。我有一阵子没打扫房间了。

english: Hey, [player name]. Have you found my head yet?
translation: 嘿，[player name]。你找到我的头了吗？

english: I'm starting to regret this...
translation: 我开始后悔了……

english: I was doing some research on farming. Pumpkins are actually very easy to cast spells on, much like cabbages.
translation: 我一直在做农业方面的研究。南瓜其实很容易施法，就像卷心菜一样。

english: There's also a section about magically cooking the vegetables, which is really good for me because I don't know how to cook.
translation: 还有一节是关于用魔法烹饪蔬菜的，这对我很实用，因为我根本不会做饭。

english: Oh, umm... right. So I was casting this spell on a pumpkin, and I must have gotten part of it wrong.
translation: 哦，嗯……好吧。我当时正对着一个南瓜施咒，肯定哪一步搞错了。

english: Well. I must find a way to re-attach my head. I don't suppose you could help me?
translation: 好吧。我得想办法把我的头重新接上。你不会帮我吧？

english: That's awesome! I think the first thing we need to do is recover my head. I thought it would be best to leave it in my room to keep it safe.
translation: 太棒了！我想我们首先要做的就是找回我的头。我当时觉得放在房间里最安全。

english: I left it in my room at the Wizards' Tower, just south of here, across the bridge.
translation: 我把它留在法师塔的房间里了，就在这边南边，过了那座桥。

english: I can see! How do I look?
translation: 我能看见了！我看上去怎么样？

english: Thank you so much, [player name]. What would I do without you?
translation: 太感谢你了，[player name]。没有你我可怎么办？

english: Yeah I still have some bruises from that. Anyway, here. Take this as a thank you.
translation: 是啊，我身上还留着一些瘀伤。不过，拿着这个作为感谢吧。

english: Not if I see you first!
translation: 要是我先看到你，就不会了！

english: My head! Did it work?
translation: 我的头！成功了吗？

english: Really? That's amazing news!
translation: 真的吗？这消息太棒了！

english: Eve? Who's that?
translation: 夏娃？那是谁？

english: Alright, [player name]. Let's cast this spell.
translation: 好了，[player name]。我们来施这个咒吧。

english: You really gotta stop that. Anyway, how do we get rid of this pumpkin?
translation: 你真得改改这毛病了。总之，我们怎么处理掉这个南瓜？

english: Thank you so much for returning my head! Now all we need to do is find a way to re-attach it to my body. I'm sick of this pumpkin!
translation: 太感谢你帮我找回头了！现在我们只需要想办法把它重新安到我的身体上。我受够这个南瓜了！

english: Well... I didn't want to ask the other wizards about it, because frankly it's embarrassing! That's why I came out here alone.
translation: 呃……我不想问其他法师，因为说实话太丢人了！所以我才一个人跑到这里来。

english: It's worth a shot. Perhaps one of the higher-ups know something about it. Could you ask them for me?
translation: 值得一试。也许某个高层人物知道点什么。你能替我问问他们吗？

english: Great! I will try to make my way back to the Wizards' Tower. Once you've found a way to revert the spell, see me in my room.
translation: 太好了！我会试着赶回法师塔。一旦你找到解除咒语的方法，到我的房间来找我。

english: I was reading this very interesting book about it called 'Kwuarm and peas'. You should totally read it.
translation: 我读过一本很有趣的书，叫《科瓦姆与豌豆》。你真该读读。

english: It's not as easy as you might think. I can't just take this pumpkin off, because it has swapped places with my head.
translation: 没你想的那么容易。我不能直接把南瓜摘下来，因为它和我的头互换了位置。

english: However, moving around without a head proved more difficult than I thought. Could you fetch it for me please?
translation: 不过，没了头四处走动比我想象的难多了。你能帮我去把它拿来吗？

english: Before I knew it, my head had swapped places with the pumpkin!
translation: 我还没反应过来，我的头就和南瓜互换了！

english: I never want to see a pumpkin again!
translation: 我再也不想看到南瓜了！

english: The nature of pumpkins is fascinating. And the thought of magically farming them without having to dirty your hands - amazing!
translation: 南瓜的本质令人着迷。想到可以不用弄脏手就能神奇地种植它们，真是太棒了！

english: Hey, [player name]! What's up?
translation: 嘿，[player name]！怎么了？

english: Have you spoken to any of the wizards yet?
translation: 你和那些法师谈过了吗？

english: Nope, I already gave you the pumpkin that used to be on my head, as well as my enchanted helm.
translation: 没有，我已经把原来在我头上的南瓜给了你，还有我附了魔的头盔。

english: If you can't find them, perhaps you should seek out Diango in Draynor Village. He collects these things.
translation: 如果你找不到它们，也许你应该去德雷诺村找迪亚戈。他收集这些玩意儿。

english: Good luck. Whomever it was he talked about, I hope they can help.
translation: 祝你好运。不管他提到的是谁，希望他们能帮上忙。

english: I went out to find a way to revert this pumpkin head. I left my actual head at the tower though.
translation: 我出去找办法来变回这个南瓜头。不过我把我真正的头留在塔里了。

english: I left it in my room at the Wizards' Tower, just south of here, across the bridge. My room is through the orange portal on the middle floor.
translation: 我把它留在了法师塔的房间里，就在南边，过了桥。我的房间在中间楼层的橙色传送门里。

english: Laters, [player name].
translation: 回头见，[player name]。

english: I figured it would be safer there, but now I regret it. I can't see anything without my head, and I keep bumping into trees!
translation: 我本以为那里更安全，但现在我真后悔。没头我什么都看不见，老是撞到树上！

english: My name is Rick and originally I come from Ardougne. I am a student who studies magical farming at the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 我叫里克，老家在阿多尼城。我是法师塔的一名学生，研究的是魔法农业。

english: Sigh.
translation: 唉。

english: I'd prefer it if you didn't. Besides, I haven't completely lost my head. I know roughly where it is. I'm only nearly headless.
translation: 我宁愿你不要。再说了，我还没完全丢掉我的脑袋。我大概知道它在哪儿。我只是差不多算没头而已。

english: By leaving your head at home when you go out.
translation: 出门的时候把头留在家里。

english: One of the higher-ups would know. I don't know which one exactly.
translation: 某个高层人物应该知道。具体是哪一个我不清楚。

english: Honestly? Not so good. I'm glad you found my head, but, well... I'm scared I'll have to stay this way forever!
translation: 说实话？不太好。我很高兴你找到了我的头，但是，嗯……我害怕我会永远变成这样！

english: A witch?
translation: 一个女巫？

english: Thank you, that means a lot.
translation: 谢谢你，这对我来说很重要。

english: I never trusted witches, but... I trust you. Good luck out there, [player name].
translation: 我从来不信女巫，但是……我相信你。祝你好运，[player name]。

english: Excellent! I've not felt this good in ages!
translation: 太棒了！我好久没这么开心了！

english: Have you heard the song that's playing? I just want to listen to it on repeat for 10 hours!
translation: 你听到现在放的这首歌了吗？我真想单曲循环10个小时！

english: Ah yes, my box! I think that's where I stored my head. I've bumped into too many trees today to remember how to unlock it.
translation: 啊，是的，我的箱子！我想我把我的头存在那里了。我今天撞了太多树，都忘了怎么打开它了。

english: I think it had something to do with a bartender. Or maybe I just need a beer right now.
translation: 我觉得跟一个酒保有关。或者我现在只是需要一杯啤酒。

english: The wizards would be in the Wizards' Tower. Just exit using my portal over there.
translation: 法师们应该在法师塔里。用那边的传送门出去就行了。

english: Perhaps you can find a way to unlock it?
translation: 也许你能找到打开它的办法？

translation: 你需要获得75%人口的支持才能成为摄政王。

english: There you go, Sir. Are there any other matters in which I may be of assistance?
translation: 好了，先生。还有其他事情需要我帮忙吗？

english: Negotiating peace with Etceteria, Sir.
translation: 与埃西特利亚岛进行和谈，先生。

english: I'm afraid you will need another free space in your bank to hold all the items your subjects have collected.
translation: 恐怕你需要在银行腾出一个空位，才能存放你的臣民收集的所有物品。

english: There you go, Madam. Are there any other matters in which I may be of assistance?
translation: 好了，女士。还有其他事情需要我帮忙吗？

english: Negotiating peace with Etceteria, Madam.
translation: 与埃西特利亚岛进行和谈，女士。

english: What would you like to know, Sir?
translation: 你想了解什么，先生？

english: ...Is that you, your Royal Highness?
translation: ...是您吗，殿下？

translation: 真有趣，殿下。需要我帮什么忙？

english: Gaining the support of the population, Sir.
translation: 争取民众的支持，先生。

english: What would you like to know, Madam?
translation: 你想了解什么，女士？

english: Gaining the support of the population, Madam.
translation: 争取民众的支持，女士。

english: Dealing with all the little troubles that come up from time to time, your Royal Highness.
translation: 处理时不时冒出来的小麻烦，殿下。

english: Who is this?

translation: 很好。这是你的臣民收集的物品清单。

english: You could hardly go wrong with a gift of flowers, and of course talking to him is important. He is also very receptive of praise for his musical performance.
translation: 送花准没错，当然和他交谈也很重要。他还很喜欢别人称赞他的音乐演奏。

english: I have watched the suitors come and go, trying to win her heart, and I can tell you this is no easy task.
translation: 我目睹了无数追求者来来去去，试图赢得她的芳心，这绝非易事。

english: She had many suitors, but you were the first to capture her attention.
translation: 她有过很多追求者，但你是第一个引起她注意的。

english: You could hardly go wrong with a gift of flowers, and of course talking to her is important. I also hear she favours a man who knows how to dance.
translation: 送花准没错，当然和她交谈也很重要。我还听说她偏爱会跳舞的男人。

english: Talking to the citizens of Miscellania and Etceteria, your Royal Highness.
translation: 与米斯凯尼亚和埃西特利亚岛的居民交谈，殿下。

english: Talking to the Prince and Princess, your Royal Highness. I believe they have something to ask you.
translation: 与王子和公主交谈，殿下。我想他们有事要问你。

english: When the time comes to actually ask for her hand in marriage, do not forget the engagement ring.
translation: 等到真要向她求婚时，别忘了带上订婚戒指。

english: She has grown very fond of you; you would do well to show you are fond of her too.
translation: 她已经很喜欢你了；你最好也表现出你对她的喜爱。

english: ...though your current appearance may well surprise her.
translation: ……不过你现在的样子可能会让她大吃一惊。

english: She has many suitors, but has yet to be impressed by any of them.
translation: 她有很多追求者，但至今没有谁能打动她。

english: ...I believe the King asked you to talk to me, your Royal Highness.
translation: ……我想是国王让您来和我谈谈的，殿下。

english: ...though your current appearance may well surprise him.
translation: ……不过你现在的样子可能会让他大吃一惊。

english: Talking to the sailor on the jetty, your Royal Highness.
translation: 与码头上的水手交谈，殿下。

english: Wooing the fair Prince Brand, Madam.
translation: 追求英俊的布兰德王子，女士。

english: You should talk to the King.
translation: 你应该和国王谈谈。

english: You seem to have impressed her at least somewhat.
translation: 你似乎至少给她留下了一些印象。

english: When the time comes to actually ask for his hand in marriage, do not forget the engagement ring.
translation: 等到真要向他求婚时，别忘了带上订婚戒指。

english: She is quite the archer, and collects bows, if you take my meaning...
translation: 她是个了不起的弓箭手，还收集弓——你懂的……

english: Wooing the fair Princess Astrid, Sir.
translation: 追求美丽的阿斯特丽德公主，先生。

english: Investigating the dungeons, your Royal Highness.
translation: 调查地牢，殿下。

english: He has grown very fond of you; you would do well to show you are fond of him too.
translation: 他已经很喜欢你了；你最好也表现出你对他的喜爱。

english: Very well, your Royal Highness. If you have any further problems, please talk to me in person.
translation: 好的，殿下。如果还有其他问题，请亲自来找我。

english: Talking to the King and Queen, your Royal Highness.
translation: 与国王和王后交谈，殿下。

english: I am somewhat uncertain about this plan the Prince has come up with, I must admit.
translation: 我得承认，我对王子提出的这个计划有些不确定。

english: You seem to have impressed him at least somewhat.
translation: 你似乎至少给他留下了一些印象。

english: I'm afraid not, your Royal Highness. I have never visited the dungeons.
translation: 恐怕没有，殿下。我从未去过地牢。

english: He has quite the sweet tooth, and is very fond of cake, if you take my meaning...
translation: 他非常爱吃甜食，特别喜欢蛋糕，你明白我的意思吧...

english: Showing the dungeon guard that you have permission to enter, your Royal Highness.
translation: 向地牢守卫出示你的进入许可，殿下。

english: I believe there was a letter Queen Sigrid wanted you to deliver to King Vargas, your Royal Highness.
translation: 我想西格里德女王有封信要您转交给瓦加斯国王，殿下。

english: Asking the King for access to the dungeons, your Royal Highness.
translation: 向国王请求进入地牢的许可，殿下。

english: Very amusing, your Royal Highness. I can see you talking.
translation: 真有趣，殿下。我能看见你在说话。

english: Returning the stolen Etceterian items, your Royal Highness.
translation: 归还被偷走的埃西特利亚物品，殿下。

english: Can I help you with anything, your Royal Highness?
translation: 殿下，有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: Would you like to try some fine Miscellanian ale, your Royal Highness?
translation: 陛下，您想尝尝上好的米斯凯尼亚麦酒吗？

english: I don't care what they said, I'm not going back in there!
translation: 不管他们说什么，我都不回那里去了！

english: You can't get into the caves without it...
translation: 没有它你进不了洞穴……

english: Let me know when you have the space to take it.
translation: 等你有空间拿的时候告诉我。

english: Greetings Adventurer, have you managed to find Bob yet?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你找到鲍勃了吗？

english: So you're the adventurer we heard about, then. The one who married the princess.
translation: 这么说，你就是我们听说的那个冒险者。那个娶了公主的人。

english: So you're the adventurer we heard about, then. The one who married the prince.
translation: 这么说，你就是我们听说的那个冒险者。那个嫁给了王子的人。

english: It's insulting! The title alone, ''You're Stupid, We're the Best'', should be enough to give you an idea!
translation: 这太侮辱人了！光看这个标题，'你们是蠢货，我们是最棒的'，就应该能让你明白了吧！

english: Apparently some of their young 'uns are impressively useless.
translation: 显然，他们的一些小崽子们废物得令人印象深刻。

english: I am sure she won't be able to resist your heroic charms. You can ask Ghrim for advice; that's what he's here for, after all.
translation: 我敢肯定她无法抗拒你的英雄魅力。你可以向格瑞姆请教；毕竟，这就是他在这里的用处。

english: By Miscellanious tradition, one may not become ruler of the kingdom if one is not part of the royal family.
translation: 根据米斯凯尼亚的传统，如果不是王室成员，就不能成为王国的统治者。

english: Now, has my daughter agreed to marry you?
translation: 那么，我女儿同意嫁给你了吗？

english: You will have to convince my daughter, Princess Astrid, to marry you.
translation: 你必须说服我的女儿，阿斯特丽德公主，让她嫁给你。

english: I am sure he won't be able to resist your heroic charms. You can ask Ghrim for advice; that's what he's here for, after all.
translation: 我敢肯定他无法抗拒你的英雄魅力。你可以向格瑞姆请教；毕竟，这就是他在这里的用处。

english: Now, has my son agreed to marry you?
translation: 那么，我儿子同意嫁给你了吗？

english: You will have to convince my son, Prince Brand, to marry you.
translation: 你必须说服我的儿子，布兰德王子，让他嫁给你。

english: Well, keep at it then!
translation: 好吧，那就继续努力吧！

english: Come back when you do, and I'll give it to you then.
translation: 等你办到了再回来，到时候我就给你。

english: Then you should talk to the citizens of Etceteria and find out exactly what is going on.
translation: 那你应该去和埃西特利亚岛的市民谈谈，弄清楚到底发生了什么。

english: I see. Yes, of course, the sailor would know if anyone had arrived on the island from outside.
translation: 我明白了。是的，当然，水手会知道是否有外人来到岛上。

english: And what did they say?
translation: 他们怎么说？

english: Talk to my citizens, then. Finding out what's happened to their goods is most important.
translation: 那就去和我的市民谈谈吧。查明他们的货物出了什么事是最重要的。

english: I suggest you hurry up. We can't afford to lose those resources: we're only a small kingdom, after all.
translation: 我建议你快点。我们可承受不起失去这些资源的代价：毕竟我们只是个小王国。

english: There hasn't been a Miscellanean army for several hundred years.
translation: 米斯凯尼亚已经几百年没有军队了。

english: Into Etceteria?
translation: 进入埃西特利亚岛？

english: Does that mean that the caves below Miscellania are also connected to Etceteria?
translation: 这是否意味着米斯凯尼亚下方的洞穴也与埃西特利亚岛相连？

english: I hear you still have to run some errands for Sigrid. When you are finished with those, I will make sure you get your reward.
translation: 我听说你还有西格丽德交代的差事要办。等你办完了，我会确保你拿到奖励。

english: Well, start investigating the dungeons, then.
translation: 好吧，那就开始调查地牢吧。

english: I suggest you talk to her about it.
translation: 我建议你和她谈谈这件事。

english: I hear that Sigrid also has a reward she would like you give you.
translation: 我听说西格丽德也有一份奖励要给你。

english: *ahem* Never mind.
translation: *咳咳* 没什么。

english: A true hero should let nothing stop him. Drunken dwarves, monsters with huge teeth, insane yeti queens...
translation: 一个真正的英雄应该无所畏惧。喝醉的矮人、长着巨大牙齿的怪物、疯狂的雪人女王……

english: Go into those caves, then, and find and slay this monster!
translation: 那就进入那些洞穴，找到并杀死这个怪物！

english: Just reminiscing about my adventuring days.
translation: 只是在回忆我当年的冒险时光。

english: Well, if they weren't really Etceterians...
translation: 嗯，如果他们不是真正的埃西特利亚人……

english: Neither of our countries have had an army for years, so I was shocked to hear Sigrid had managed to raise one.
translation: 我们两国都已经多年没有军队了，所以听到西格丽德成功组建了一支军队，我很震惊。

english: ...then that would make a lot of sense.
translation: ……那就说得通了。

english: Splendid, splendid. Resourceful as well as heroic.
translation: 太好了，太好了。既英勇又足智多谋。

english: Still, don't let your guard down. That monster is in there somewhere, and you should go and fight it!
translation: 不过，不要放松警惕。那个怪物就在里面的某个地方，你应该去和它战斗！

english: It seems you are an even better choice for Regent than I thought.
translation: 看来你比我预想的更适合当摄政王。

english: Have you spoken to the one who saw the monster?
translation: 你和那个目击怪物的人谈过了吗？

english: And why not? You're an adventurer, it's part of your job to talk to everyone!
translation: 为什么不呢？你是个冒险者，和每个人交谈是你的工作！

english: Don't mention it, Sir.
translation: 别客气，先生。

english: Good day, Madam.
translation: 日安，女士。

english: Don't mention it, darling.
translation: 别客气，亲爱的。

english: And why do you think that might be, Madam?
translation: 那您觉得是为什么呢，女士？

english: Well, if my father had had something to occupy him, he wouldn't have got bored and decided to argue with Queen Sigrid again.
translation: 唉，要是我父亲有点事做，他就不会无聊到又去跟西格里德女王吵架了。

english: Welcome back, my darling!
translation: 欢迎回来，亲爱的！

english: My heart is an open book to you, my darling, and all the pages say yes... ''Yes''!
translation: 我的心对你完全敞开，亲爱的，每一页都写着'愿意'……'愿意'！

english: You flatter me, my darling.
translation: 你过奖了，亲爱的。

english: Your hair is like a waterfall Or perhaps a bramble bush Your eyes are like an ocean on which I want to sail the ship of our love!
translation: 你的秀发如瀑布，又似荆棘丛；你的眼眸如海洋，我愿乘着我们爱的船航行其上！

english: ...you have to marry somebody in the royal family, namely myself?
translation: ……你必须嫁给王室成员，也就是我？

english: This may be the case. I am willing to give you a chance; if you impress me enough, I will consider accepting to marry you.
translation: 也许吧。我愿意给你一个机会；如果你能让我足够印象深刻，我会考虑接受你的求婚。

english: Of course, she couldn't understand as well as you do, my darling.
translation: 当然，她不可能像你一样理解我，亲爱的。

english: I'm glad you liked it, my darling.
translation: 很高兴你喜欢，亲爱的。

english: Mmm, a very good answer, Madam.
translation: 嗯，回答得很好，女士。

english: Not yet, my darling; let us just say my heart is a maze of inescapable tunnels, and you are the light at the end of one of them.
translation: 还没呢，亲爱的；只能说我的心是一座无法逃脱的迷宫，而你是其中一条通道尽头的光。

english: You have perhaps more poetry in your soul than I first thought, Madam...
translation: 你灵魂中的诗意或许比我想象的更多，女士……

translation: 谢谢你，亲爱的。

translation: 我听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛恢复了和平。干得好，亲爱的。

translation: 怎么了，女士？

translation: 从某些方面来说，这算是一种进步。

translation: 我听说你再次让我们王国和埃西特利亚岛恢复了和平。干得好，先生。

translation: 抱歉，但是……你是谁？

english: But... weren't you a woman the last time we met?
translation: 但是……上次见面你不是女人吗？

english: Though you do look different - very different, if I may be plain - I do believe you are the person I agreed to marry.
translation: 虽然你看起来确实不一样了——直说的话，非常不一样——但我相信你就是我同意要娶的那个人。

english: Don't say that, sister!
translation: 别这么说，姐姐！

english: That aside... what did you want to talk about?
translation: 除此之外……你想谈什么？

english: I can only hope that you find a way to return to how you were before.
translation: 我只能希望你能找到变回原来样子的方法。

english: It's terrible, my darling! My father's been arguing with the Queen of Etceteria, and has managed to start a war again.
translation: 太糟糕了，亲爱的！我父亲一直在和埃西特利亚女王争吵，结果又挑起了一场战争。

english: Perhaps it's an odd idea, my darling, but since we don't have an army, we can hardly declare war...
translation: 也许这想法有点奇怪，亲爱的，但既然我们没有军队，我们几乎没法宣战……

english: I'm sure you'll manage to do it, darling.
translation: 我相信你能做到的，亲爱的。

english: I don't believe we've met...
translation: 我想我们没见过面……

english: No thank you, Sir.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，先生。

translation: 别客气，女士。

translation: 什么事这么好笑，女士？

translation: '当事情不太顺利时，我们唱这首可爱的歌，[player name] 我们都会感觉好很多，不会花太长时间。'

english: Welcome back, my dear!
translation: 欢迎回来，亲爱的！

english: ...you have to marry somebody in the royal family, namely me?
translation: ……你必须嫁给王室成员，也就是我？

translation: 我希望你明白，我有很多追求者。

translation: 你或许比我最初以为的更有趣，先生……

translation: 令人印象深刻。我喜欢会跳舞的男人。

translation: 你还好吗，亲爱的？说服我父亲了吗？

english: Your dancing never ceases to impress me, Sir.
translation: 你的舞姿总是让我印象深刻，先生。

english: If you want to applaud someone, Sir, I suggest you find my brother.
translation: 如果你想为某人鼓掌，先生，我建议你去找我兄弟。

english: If you want to cheer someone on, Sir, I suggest you find my brother.

translation: 如果你想为某人加油，女士，我建议你去找我兄弟。

english: ''You're stupid, we're the best, Etceteria beats the rest! and Queen Sigrid is very pretty, King Vargas is a fool, hey, nonny-nonny!''
translation: “你蠢，我们最棒，埃西特利亚岛胜过其他！西格里德女王非常漂亮，瓦加斯国王是个傻瓜，嘿，诺尼-诺尼！”

english: Finally, a ruler of Miscellania who's willing to do something for her neighbours.
translation: 终于，有个米斯凯尼亚的统治者愿意为她的邻居们做点事了。

english: Well, what exactly happened?
translation: 嗯，到底发生了什么？

english: Ah ha!
translation: 啊哈！

english: And what do they say happened?
translation: 他们说是怎么发生的？

english: Talk to my citizens, then. Finding out what's happened to their items is most important.
translation: 那就去和我的子民谈谈。弄清楚他们的物品发生了什么最重要。

english: Vargas, not only do you write inflammatory letters, but you even send soldiers around to steal from my people?
translation: 瓦加斯，你不仅写煽动性的信件，甚至还派士兵来偷我子民的东西？

english: Then you should talk to the citizens of Miscellania and find out exactly what is going on.
translation: 那你应该去和米斯凯尼亚的子民谈谈，弄清楚到底发生了什么。

english: Letters are one thing, but raising an army... how has he managed it?
translation: 信件是一回事，但组建军队……他是怎么做到的？

english: Come back when you have the space, please. This letter is important.
translation: 请等你有空间了再回来。这封信很重要。

english: I want you to go directly to Vargas and ask him what he thinks he's doing.
translation: 我要你直接去找瓦加斯，问问他到底想干什么。

english: But there hasn't been an Etceterian army for several centuries.
translation: 但埃西特利亚岛已经好几个世纪没有军队了。

english: Well then, here you are.
translation: 嗯，给你。

english: Oh dear, you don't seem to have enough space to take this reward.
translation: 哦，天哪，你似乎没有足够的空间来领取这份奖励。

english: I don't suppose you have space for the reward I offered, do you?
translation: 我想你应该没有空间来拿我提供的奖励吧？

english: Please come back and talk to me again when you do have space to carry them.
translation: 等你有空间携带它们时，请回来再和我谈谈。

english: It would be a pity not to reward you appropriately.
translation: 不给你适当的奖励会很可惜。

english: I'd have thought it was obvious.
translation: 我以为这很明显。

english: How dare he call me a bloodthirsty tyrant! Who was the one who declared Etceteria part of Miscellania, anyway?
translation: 他竟敢叫我嗜血的暴君！到底是谁宣布埃西特利亚岛是米斯凯尼亚的一部分的？

english: And how can he call me a megalomaniac? He tried to conquer this country first!
translation: 他怎么能叫我自大狂？是他先试图征服这个国家的！

english: If he'd like a war, I'll be happy to oblige!
translation: 如果他想要战争，我很乐意奉陪！

english: I'll keep it for you until you have room to carry it.
translation: 我会替你保管，直到你有空间携带它。

english: Of course, all those insults I made about his parentage can't have helped the matter...
translation: 当然，我对他父母说的那些侮辱性的话肯定也无助于解决问题……

english: That's kind of him.
translation: 他还挺客气。

english: That's a great relief.
translation: 这真是如释重负。

english: What did he say in reply?
translation: 他回复了什么？

english: I suggest you hurry up. We're only a small kingdom, after all, so the culprits can't have gone far.
translation: 我建议你快点。毕竟我们只是个小王国，所以罪犯们跑不了多远。

english: What do you mean, 'a little problem'?
translation: 你说“一个小问题”是什么意思？

english: Get into that cavern and defeat the sea snake!
translation: 进入那个洞穴，击败海蛇！

english: Well, you're a hero, aren't you?
translation: 嗯，你是个英雄，不是吗？

english: But what about the items that went missing? Did you find out where they are?
translation: 但那些丢失的物品呢？你找到它们在哪里了吗？

english: It looks like you don't have enough room for it. Come back when you can carry it.
translation: 看来你没有足够的空间来放它。等你能携带它时再来吧。

english: What's the trouble, old bellybutton fluff?
translation: 怎么了，老肚脐绒毛？

english: I see. Well, you might be in luck. I have recently made another one to replace it. I guess you could have it for 60,000 gold. For the materials, you understand.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，你可能走运了。我最近又做了一个来替换它。我想你可以用 60,000 金币买下它。这是材料费，你懂的。

english: There you are! I hope this one serves you well enough, old cabbage.
translation: 给你！希望这一个能让你满意，老卷心菜。

english: Hmm. It looks like you don't quite have enough on you, old porridge. Come back and see me again when you have a bit more gold on you.
translation: 嗯。看来你身上的金币不够，老麦片粥。等你多带些金币再来找我吧。

english: Oh, right. What was that then, old parrot?
translation: 哦，对。那是什么来着，老鹦鹉？

english: Ah yes! That's my old helmet, old speckled hen! I hope it's serving you well.
translation: 啊对！那是我的旧头盔，老花斑母鸡！希望它对你很有用。

english: No problem! Come back and see me if you change your mind, old garters.
translation: 没问题！要是你改变主意了再回来找我，老吊袜带。

english: I see! How very interesting, old flotsam. I expect that will indeed come in handy to you at some point.
translation: 我明白了！真有意思，老漂流物。我猜那东西以后肯定能派上用场。

english: Hmm. It looks like you're going to need some more space in your inventory first, old jumper. Come back and see me again when you've made some room.
translation: 嗯。看来你得先腾出一些背包空间，老毛衣。等你有空位了再来找我吧。

english: Yes, I thought as much. I managed to find an odd looking trader with it and had to take it off him. Nevertheless, here it is. Try not to lose it this time.
translation: 嗯，我猜到了。我找到了一个拿着它的古怪商人，好不容易才从他手里拿回来。不过，总算在这儿了。这次可别再弄丢了。

english: Of course you can, old skeleton! However I notice you will need to make some space in your inventory for it first. Speak to me when you've done so.
translation: 当然可以，老骷髅！不过我注意到你首先得腾出一些背包空间来装它。腾好之后跟我说话吧。

english: I'm sorry to hear that. Perhaps it was something you ate?
translation: 真是遗憾。可能是你吃了什么不干净的东西？

english: Aha! Sweet freedom! It's good to be alive, old sweet shop! Thank you for freeing me, Did you ever hear the Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the wise? I thought not. It's not a story the Jedi would tell you. It's a Sith legend. Darth Plagueis was a Dark Lord of the Sith, so powerful and so wise he could use the Force to influence the midichlorians to create life... He had such a knowledge of the dark side that he could even keep the ones he cared about from dying. The dark side of the Force is a pathway to many abilities some consider to be unnatural. He became so powerful... the only thing he was afraid of was losing his power, which eventually, of course, he did. Unfortunately, he taught his apprentice everything he knew, then his apprentice killed him in his sleep. It's ironic he could save others from death, but not himself..
translation: 啊哈！甜蜜的自由！活着真好，老糖果店！谢谢你救了我。你听过智者达斯.普雷格斯的悲剧故事吗？我想没有。这是绝地武士不会讲的故事。这是一个西斯传说。达斯.普雷格斯是一位西斯黑暗尊主，强大而睿智，甚至能用原力影响迷地原虫创造生命……他对黑暗面了如指掌，甚至能让他关心的人免于死亡。原力的黑暗面是通往许多被认为有违天理之能的途径。他变得如此强大……唯一害怕的就是失去力量，当然，他最终还是失去了。不幸的是，他把毕生所学都教给了他的学徒，而他的学徒在他睡着时杀了他。他能救别人于死亡，却救不了自己，真是讽刺……
