english: Look for something that can identify the place. Leave no stone unturned.
translation: 找一些能识别那个地方的东西。不要放过任何一块石头。

english: Look for something relating to Zadimus at the temple. He was the Priest who built the temple.
translation: 在神庙里找找与扎迪姆斯有关的东西。他就是建造那座神庙的祭司。

english: Oh yes, let me see it then.
translation: 哦对了，让我看看。

english: Yes, things do look very bad indeed.
translation: 是啊，事情确实非常糟糕。

english: You are looking for Ardrigal. It is related to the palm  and grows in its brothers shady profusion.
translation: 你要找的是阿德里加草。它与棕榈树有关，生长在它同类茂密的树荫下。

english: Hmm, that doesn't surprise me.  The only information I have refers to its name. Ah Za Rhoon, its name means  'Magnificence Floating on Water'.
translation: 嗯，这并不意外。我仅有的信息是关于它的名字的。阿扎鲁恩，它的意思是‘水上荣光’。

english: I still think we need to take this clue quite literally. Perhaps you found something at Bervirius' Tomb that could help to protect you from Rashiliyia's attacks?
translation: 我仍然认为我们需要从字面意思理解这个线索。也许你在贝维里乌斯之墓找到了什么东西，可以保护你免受拉希利娅的攻击？

english: All I know is that Zadimus was a high priest of Zamorak. Rashiliyia loved him, but he did not return her affections.
translation: 我只知道扎迪姆斯是萨莫拉克的大祭司。拉希利娅爱他，但他没有回应她的感情。

english: When she became a more powerful sorceress she attacked Ah Za Rhoon, reducing it to rubble. What Zadimus' fate was, I do not know.
translation: 当她成为更强大的女巫后，她袭击了阿扎鲁恩，将其夷为瓦砾。扎迪姆斯的命运如何，我不知道。

english: Many thanks Bwana, but I don't need that herb at the moment. Can you please get me the herb I asked for?
translation: 非常感谢，巴瓦纳，但我目前不需要那种草药。你能把我要求的草药给我吗？

english: If you find anything relating to him at the temple of Ah Za Rhoon, please let me see it.
translation: 如果你在阿扎鲁恩神庙找到任何与他有关的东西，请让我看看。

english: That's not fresh Rogue's Purse, did you pick it yourself? Go get me some fresh Rogue's Purse and remember to pick it yourself.
translation: 那不是新鲜的盗贼草，你是自己采的吗？去给我弄些新鲜的盗贼草，记住要自己采。

english: as I may have a proposition for you.  Now I need to attend to the plight of my people. Please excuse me...
translation: 因为我可能有件事想和你商量。现在我必须去处理我族人的困境了。请见谅……

english: Hmmm, I'm not sure you will get much use out of this. Why not see if you can sell it in Shilo Village.
translation: 嗯，我不确定这东西对你有多大用处。不如看看能不能在希洛村卖掉它。

english: There is a legend about Rashiliyia, look for it in the temple.
translation: 有一个关于拉希利娅的传说，在神庙里找找看。

english: Usually a strong creature of some sort will be guarding her remains. And of course, she is a very powerful spell caster herself. Not to be tackled lightly.
translation: 通常会有某种强大的生物守护着她的遗骸。当然，她本人也是个非常强大的施法者。不可轻敌。

english: Look for details of Rashiliyia's kin, these may be well hidden.
translation: 寻找拉希利娅亲属的详细信息，这些可能隐藏得很好。

english: Perhaps there is something relating to Bervirius at the temple of Ah Za Rhoon. Check the Temple carefully if you haven't already to see if it exists.
translation: 也许在阿扎鲁恩神庙里有与贝维里乌斯有关的东西。如果你还没查过，仔细检查一下神庙，看看是否真的存在。

english: Well, just show me the items and I'll help as much as I can.
translation: 好吧，把东西给我看看，我会尽力帮忙。

english: Hello, Bwana, do you have the Snake Weed?
translation: 你好，巴瓦纳，你有蛇草吗？

english: Hello, Bwana, do you have the Ardrigal?
translation: 你好，巴瓦纳，你有阿德里加草吗？

english: Hello, Bwana, do you have the Sito Foil?
translation: 你好，巴瓦纳，你有西托箔草吗？

english: Hello, Bwana, do you have the Volencia Moss?
translation: 你好，巴瓦纳，你有瓦伦西亚苔吗？

english: Please, don't try to deceive me.
translation: 拜托，别想骗我。

english: I need to make a special brew! A potion that helps to commune with the gods. For this potion, I need special herbs, that are only found deep in the jungle.
translation: 我需要制作一种特殊的药水！一种有助于与神灵沟通的药水。这种药水需要特殊的草药，只有在丛林深处才能找到。

english: Great, you have the Snake Weed! Many thanks. Ok, the next herb is called Ardrigal. It is related to the palm and crows to the east in its brother's shady profusion.
translation: 太好了，你有蛇草！非常感谢。好了，下一种草药叫做阿德里加草。它与棕榈树有关，生长在东部它同类茂密的树荫下。

english: Well, I would certainly investigate it..
translation: 嗯，我肯定会调查一下的……

english: Hello, Bwana, do you have the Rogue's Purse?
translation: 你好，巴瓦纳，你有盗贼草吗？

english: in the northern part of this island. A secret entrance to the caverns is set int the northern cliffs of this land. Take care Bwana as it may be dangerous.
translation: 在这个岛屿的北部。一个通往洞穴的秘密入口在这片土地的北部悬崖上。小心点，巴瓦纳，那里可能很危险。

english: This is the most difficult to find as it is inhabits  the darkness of the underground. It is called Rogues Purse, and is only to be found in caverns
translation: 这是最难找到的，因为它生长在地下的黑暗之中。它叫盗贼草，只存在于洞穴里。

english: Ah Volencia Moss, beautiful. One final herb and the potion will be complete.
translation: 啊，瓦伦西亚苔，真美。最后一种草药，药水就可以完成了。

english: A fissure is a long, narrow crack, usually in rock. Just the kind of thing that adventurers love to find  and explore.
translation: 裂缝是一条又长又窄的缝隙，通常在岩石中。正是冒险家们喜欢发现和探索的那种东西。

english: It most likely is, but that isn't normally a barrier to most adventurers! And it may very well lead to something very interesting.
translation: 很有可能，但这通常难不倒大多数冒险者！而且它很可能通向某个非常有趣的地方。

english: Perhaps you should explore it? If it's the temple of Ah Za Rhoon, it may be our only chance against Rashiliyia. I implore you to  investigate Bwana.
translation: 也许你应该去探索一下？如果那是阿扎鲁恩神庙，那可能是我们对抗拉希利娅的唯一机会。我恳求你去调查，巴瓦纳。

english: It may be an idea to try it and then scout out the area. If it relates to Rashiliyia, it might help us  to defeat her.
translation: 也许可以试试看，然后侦察一下那个区域。如果它与拉希利娅有关，可能有助于我们打败她。

english: it means 'small clearing in the jungle' but it is now the name of our village.
translation: 它的意思是‘丛林中的小空地’，但现在成了我们村庄的名字。

english: Well, investigate it further, you may find something interesting!
translation: 嗯，继续调查下去，你可能会发现有趣的东西！

english: Well, that is good news, as I have a proposition for you.
translation: 嗯，这是好消息，因为我有个提议要和你商量。

english: You are looking for Ardrigal. It is related to the palm and grows in its brothers shady profusion.
translation: 你要找的是阿德里加草。它与棕榈树有关，生长在它同类茂密的树荫下。

english: My greatest respect Bwana, I have communed with my gods and the future
translation: 我最高的敬意，巴瓦纳，我已经与我的神灵沟通，未来……

english: Maybe there are more items to be found at Ah Za Rhoon?
translation: 也许阿扎鲁恩还有更多东西可以找到？

english: Ah, a fine helm for any hunter. Did you want me to make another for you?
translation: 啊，一顶适合猎人的好头盔。你想要我再给你做一顶吗？

english: A fine piece of armour for any hunter! Did you want me to make you another?
translation: 一件适合猎人的好盔甲！你想要我再给你做一件吗？

english: If I knew I would not have asked you to go and get me one, now would I?
translation: 如果我知道的话，就不会让你去给我弄一个来了，对吧？

english: And where is your proof of the hunt, outerlander? Without proof of the hunt it as though it never happened.
translation: 你的狩猎证明在哪里，外乡人？没有狩猎证明，就等于什么都没发生过。

english: Then bring it to me. I require the proof of the hunt.
translation: 那就把它带来。我需要狩猎证明。

english: Did you even ASK Askeladden?
translation: 你有没有问过阿斯卡拉登？

english: My apologies but I will need 2 pieces of dark dagger- mouth hide, 1 stretched hide and 7,500 coins to make you some leg armour...
translation: 抱歉，但我需要2块黑暗匕首嘴兽皮、1块拉伸的兽皮和7500金币才能为你制作一些腿甲...

english: Did you even ASK the Seer?
translation: 你有没有问过先知？

english: An amateurish mistake, outerlander. Any hunt without the proof of it is naught but empty boasting. Take this and try once more.
translation: 外乡人，真是业余的错误。任何没有证明的狩猎都不过是空洞的吹嘘。拿着这个，再试一次。

english: Did you even ASK the barkeep?
translation: 你有没有问过酒保？

english: Well, I did have something you may have been interested in, but I've been given orders not to-
translation: 嗯，我确实有件你可能感兴趣的东西，但我接到命令不能——

english: I haven't the faintest idea. Good luck!
translation: 我一点头绪都没有。祝你好运！

english: Very well then; In the name of King Valence, and for the honour of Saradomin, I now pronounce you a fully deputised White Knight.
translation: 很好；以瓦伦斯国王之名，并为了萨拉多明的荣耀，我现在宣布你为正式的白骑士代理。

english: ... Well anyway, for the fine work you achieved at that incident in the Black Knights Fortress, I would be honoured to accept you as my Squire.
translation: ……总之，鉴于你在黑骑士堡垒事件中的出色表现，我很荣幸能接纳你为我的侍从。

english: What is worse, it seems he is in possession of dangerous new magics that we are powerless against!
translation: 更糟的是，他似乎掌握了一种我们无力对抗的危险新魔法！

english: That is entirely correct [player name], but I have no idea where you may have heard that, for it is a secret guarded only to members of our order!
translation: 你说得完全正确，[player name]，但我不知道你从哪听说的，这可是只有我们骑士团成员才知道的秘密！

english: Well, a fine adventurer such as yourself would be a perfect candidate as a deputy in my eyes, but fortunately this can only be done in a time of crisis, and all is currently well.
translation: 嗯，像你这样优秀的冒险者，在我看来是代理骑士的绝佳人选，但幸运的是，这只能在危机时刻进行，而目前一切安好。

english: Well, I DO have a task, but it is very dangerous, and it's critical to us that no mistakes are made. I couldn't possibly let an unexperienced adventurer like yourself undertake it.
translation: 嗯，我确实有个任务，但非常危险，而且对我们来说至关重要，不容有失。我绝不能让你这样没有经验的冒险者去承担。

english: Nothing I can think of at the moment...
translation: 目前我没想到什么……

english: That is 'Sir Amik' or 'My Liege' - not 'Boss'.
translation: 要叫我'阿米克爵士'或'我的领主'——不是'老大'。

english: I can not tell you much... They are called the Temple Knights, and are an organisation that was founded by Saradomin personally many centuries ago.
translation: 我不能告诉你太多……他们被称为圣殿骑士，是一个许多世纪前由萨拉多明亲自创立的组织。

english: There are many rumours and fables about their works and actions, but official records of their presence are non-existent.
translation: 关于他们的工作和行动有许多传闻和传说，但没有任何官方记录证明他们的存在。

english: Let me put it this way; Should you decide to take them up on their generous offer to join, you will find yourself in an advantageous position that many in this world would envy, and that
translation: 这么说吧：如果你决定接受他们慷慨的入会邀请，你会发现自己的地位将令世上许多人羡慕，而且

english: It is a secret organisation of extraordinary power and resourcefulness...
translation: 那是一个拥有非凡力量和资源的秘密组织……

english: few are called to occupy.
translation: 很少有人能被召唤去占据。

english: Don't forget to read that dossier of information I gave you.
translation: 别忘了读我给你的那份档案。

english: Sorry adventurer, my orders are very clear. Sir Vey could make things very difficult for me if I were to disobey his orders.
translation: 抱歉，冒险者，我的命令非常明确。如果我违抗维伊爵士的命令，他会让我很难办。

english: As for imprisonment... Solus is a highly dangerous man not just because of his mastery of the magical arts, but for his uncanny resourcefulness.
translation: 至于监禁……索卢斯是个极其危险的人物，不仅因为他精通魔法，还因为他那不可思议的足智多谋。

english: I am sure he will let you know should your services be required again.
translation: 我相信如果需要你的服务，他会通知你的。

english: Nothing tangible, no, but you will be deputised to act as a White Knight, and you will feel a warm glow inside of having done the right thing.
translation: 没有实质性的奖励，没有，但你会被授权以白骑士的身份行事，并且内心会因做了正确的事而感到温暖。

english: So what say you [player name]? Spend five long years of your life doing pointless busywork without pay for me, on the off chance that at some point in the future I may put your name forward
translation: 那么，[player name]，你意下如何？为我白白浪费五年的生命做无意义的杂务，只为了将来某天我可能把你的名字提上去

english: Look, I am very sorry [player name], but if you have no proof of your encounter, I can hardly promote you to be a full White Knight, now can I?
translation: 听着，我很抱歉，[player name]，但如果你没有遭遇战的证据，我很难提拔你为正式的白骑士，对吧？

english: as a novice White Knight?
translation: 作为一名新手白骑士？

english: It is a tragedy to hear you speak so, but we must trust in our valour and the wisdom of Saradomin to protect us from this evil man if we cannot enlist help against him.
translation: 听你这么说真是悲剧，但我们必须相信我们的勇气和萨拉多明的智慧，如果无法寻求帮助对抗这个恶人，那就靠它们来保护我们。

english: [player name]... Solus Dellagar is still loose... Please, for the safety of my lands you must find him immediately...
translation: [player name]……索卢斯.德拉加还在逍遥法外……求你了，为了我领地的安全，你必须立刻找到他……

english: Subtley isn't exactly our strong point.
translation: 低调行事可不是我们的强项。

english: Well, the Black Knights have started making strange threats to us; demanding large amounts of money and land, and threating to invade Falador if we don't pay them.
translation: 嗯，黑骑士开始对我们发出奇怪的威胁；要求大量金钱和土地，并威胁说如果我们不付钱，就入侵法拉多城。

english: The information is classified. I am forbidden to share it with outsiders.
translation: 这些信息是保密的。我禁止与外人分享。

english: Well keep at it! Falador's future is at stake!
translation: 那就继续努力吧！法拉多城的未来危在旦夕！

english: Careful Brundt, I am not the enemy here.
translation: 小心点，布伦特，我可不是你的敌人。

english: Gypsy Aris? Is she still alive? I remember her from when I was pretty young. Well what do you need to talk to me about?
translation: 吉普赛人阿里斯？她还活着？我小时候就记得她。好吧，你想跟我谈什么？

english: Yes, news of your carelessness is almost as widespread as knowledge of your victory. Fortunately for you, the sword has come back into my possession.
translation: 是啊，你粗心大意的消息几乎和你胜利的消息一样广为人知。算你走运，这把剑又回到了我手里。

english: I'm not going to just give it away, it's far too important to be treated so disrespectfully. Especially now your fight with Agrith-Naar has increased its powers, turning it into Darklight!
translation: 我不会就这么把它交出去，它太重要了，不能被如此轻慢地对待。尤其是你和阿格里斯-纳尔的战斗增强了它的力量，把它变成了黑暗之光！

english: If you wish to make use of the sword again, it will cost you 1000 coins. Maybe that will encourage you to look after it.
translation: 如果你想再次使用这把剑，需要付给我1000金币。也许这能让你学会好好保管它。

english: Oh, is that the same gypsy? I would have thought she would have died by now. She was pretty old when I was a lad.
translation: 哦，是同一个吉普赛人吗？我还以为她早就死了呢。我小时候她就很老了。

english: I'm not going to give it away that easily again, it's far too important to be treated so disrespectfully.
translation: 我不会再那么轻易地把它交出去了，它太重要了，不能被如此轻慢地对待。

english: If you wish to make use of Silverlight again, it will cost you 500 coins. Maybe that will encourage you to look after it.
translation: 如果你想再次使用银光剑，需要付给我500金币。也许这能让你学会好好保管它。

english: If you wish to make use of Silverlight again, it will cost you 500 gold pieces. Maybe that will encourage you to look after it.
translation: 如果你想再次使用银光剑，需要付给我500金币。也许这能让你学会好好保管它。

english: I'll be here when you actually have that much money to pay me.
translation: 等你真有了那么多钱再来找我吧。

english: You don't look up to much. I suppose Silverlight may be good enough to carry you though though.
translation: 你看上去不怎么样。不过我想银光剑应该足够带你过关了。

english: He is one of the wizards who lives in the tower on the little island just south coast. I believe his quartes are on the first floor of the tower.
translation: 他是住在南海岸小岛塔里的法师之一。我相信他的房间在塔的二楼。

english: Oh , is that the same gypsy? I would have thought she would have died by now. She was pretty old when I was a lad.
translation: 哦，是同一个吉普赛人吗？我还以为她早就死了呢。我小时候她就很老了。

english: HEY! Just WHAT do you THINK you are DOING??? STAY OUT of MY cupboard!
translation: 嘿！你觉得自己在干什么？？？离我的橱柜远点！

english: Did you want to buy the platelegs as well?
translation: 你还想买护腿吗？

english: Did you want to buy the chainmail as well?
translation: 你还想买锁子甲吗？

english: There you go. Sturdy armour. You need another piece?
translation: 给你。结实的盔甲。还需要别的部件吗？

english: It'll cost 5,000 coins. That ok?
translation: 需要5000金币。可以吗？

english: It'll cost 10,000 coins. That ok?
translation: 需要10000金币。可以吗？

english: There you go. Fine helm. You want another?
translation: 给你。好头盔。还要别的吗？

english: It'll cost 7,500 coins. That ok?
translation: 需要7500金币。可以吗？

english: Come back when you got it.
translation: 凑够了再来吧。

english: Sorry. Need 1 piece of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 rock-shell chunk and 5,000 coins to make you helmet.
translation: 抱歉。需要1张黑暗匕首之口皮、1块岩壳块和5000金币才能给你做头盔。

english: Apologies. Need 3 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 rock-shell shard and 10,000 coins to make you strong armour.
translation: 抱歉。需要3张黑暗匕首之口皮、1块岩壳碎片和10000金币才能给你做结实的盔甲。

english: Apologies. Need 2 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 rock-shell splinter and 7,500 coins to make you leg armour.
translation: 抱歉。需要2块黑暗匕首嘴兽皮、1块岩壳裂片和7500金币才能为你制作腿甲。

english: Speak to Chieftain Brundt. He'll explain all.
translation: 去找酋长布伦特谈谈。他会解释一切的。

english: Sorry outerlander. Can't help you. Forbidden by decree.
translation: 抱歉，外地人。帮不了你。法令禁止。

english: Can't help you with that outerlander. Good luck with your trials anyway.
translation: 这个帮不了你，外地人。总之祝你的试炼好运。

english: I'm afraid you need Level 25 Agility to be able to use this course.
translation: 恐怕你需要25级敏捷才能使用这个课程。

english: I've lost my perfected whistle. Do you have any spares?
translation: 我把我的完美哨子弄丢了。你有多余的吗？

english: Someone found one just the other day and gave it to me in case someone came to claim it. Could it be yours?
translation: 前几天有人捡到一个，交给了我，以防有人来认领。可能是你的吗？

english: It's possible? Can I see it?
translation: 有可能吗？我能看看吗？

english: That notch in the tail, that scratch on the underside... Yes, it's mine! I can't believe it!
translation: 尾巴上的那个缺口，底部的那个划痕……没错，是我的！真不敢相信！

english: Here you go! I'm afraid it has no charges left, though.
translation: 给你！不过恐怕它已经没有充能了。

english: Can I get a whistle with unlimited charges?
translation: 我能得到一个无限充能的哨子吗？

english: I see you already have a Perfected quetzal whistle, I can upgrade it for you at a cost.
translation: 我看到你已经有一个完美绿咬鹃哨了，我可以帮你升级，但要收费。

english: How much is this going to set me back.
translation: 这要花我多少钱？

english: I don't want your coins. Instead, I would like 10,000 charges worth of food for the birds here. You can give that to me piece by piece as well if need be.
translation: 我不要你的金币。相反，我想要价值10000份鸟食的饲料。你也可以一点一点地给我。

english: That sounds good to me, I have some food for the birds right here.
translation: 听起来不错，我这里正好有一些鸟食。

english: Thanks for the feed, you still need to give me another [number] charges worth of food for the birds.
translation: 谢谢你的饲料，你还需要再给我价值[number]份的鸟食。

english: Thanks for all the food, I'll be glad to give you a whistle with infinite charges. The first one is free of course, any more will cost you though.
translation: 谢谢所有的鸟食，我很乐意给你一个无限充能的哨子。第一个当然是免费的，但再要的话就要收费了。

english: I have some more food for the birds.
translation: 我还有一些鸟食。

english: Can I get another Perfected quetzal whistle with unlimited charges?
translation: 我能再要一个无限充能的完美绿咬鹃哨吗？

english: I can produce another whistle for you, for a moderate cost.
translation: 我可以再为你做一个哨子，收费适中。

english: What sort of moderate cost?
translation: 什么样的适中收费？

english: 50,000 coins. These whistles are my art and not that easy to make. Plus a small fee for the charges.
translation: 50,000金币。这些哨子是我的艺术品，没那么容易做。再加上一点充能费。

english: Ah, I can't afford one right now. I'll pop back later.
translation: 啊，我现在买不起。我晚点再来。

english: Here you go, one Perfected quetzal whistle with unlimited charges.
translation: 给你，一个无限充能的完美绿咬鹃哨。

english: I like meat!
translation: 我喜欢吃肉！

english: C'mon, we're hungry!
translation: 快点，我们饿了！

english: Make more pie!
translation: 多做点派！

english: More pineapple pizza!
translation: 多点菠萝披萨！

english: Bring us stew!
translation: 给我们炖菜！

english: Oi - you're meant to fight the lizardmen, not us!
translation: 喂——你应该去打蜥蜴人，不是我们！

english: I see one adventurer in the canyon to the west.
translation: 我看到西边的峡谷里有一个冒险者。

english: I see 2 adventurers in the canyon to the west.
translation: 我看到西边的峡谷里有两个冒险者。

english: The Shayzien army doesn't want strangers wandering around the battlefield. You'd only get in the way.
translation: 谢兹恩城军队不想让陌生人在战场上闲逛。你只会碍事。

english: The lizardmen are the bane of Kourend. I'm not much for history, but the Shayzien forces have been fighting them off for as long as anyone can remember.
translation: 蜥蜴人是库兰德王国的祸害。我不太了解历史，但谢兹恩城军队从远古时代起就一直与他们作战。

english: I see one adventurer in the canyon to the east.
translation: 我看到东边的峡谷里有一个冒险者。

english: You don't want to go down there, mate! The lizardman shamans are lethal, and our soldiers want only the most trustworthy troops on the battlefield.
translation: 你不想去那里吧，哥们！蜥蜴人萨满非常致命，我们的士兵只希望最值得信赖的人上战场。

english: I hope we get to leave this place soon.
translation: 我希望我们很快就能离开这个地方。

english: I don't understand why the Captain is always happy.
translation: 我不明白为什么船长总是那么开心。

english: You'd better keep your distance, stranger. Those lizardmen are fierce.
translation: 你最好保持距离，陌生人。那些蜥蜴人很凶猛。

english: I see 3 adventurers in the canyon to the west.
translation: 我看到西边的峡谷里有三个冒险者。

english: I see 2 adventurers in the canyon to the east.
translation: 我看到东边的峡谷里有两个冒险者。

english: The Shayzien Army doesn't want strangers wandering around the battlefield. You'd only get in the way.
translation: 谢兹恩城军队不想让陌生人在战场上闲逛。你只会碍事。

english: The Captain led us here to wipe out the lizardmen. He knows we haven't got the forces to finish them off, but he's too proud to retreat without finishing the mission.
translation: 船长带领我们到这里消灭蜥蜴人。他知道我们兵力不足，无法彻底消灭他们，但他太骄傲了，不愿意在没有完成任务的情况下撤退。

english: Hey, we don't know you, and we don't trust you. Get off our battlefield and go away.
translation: 嘿，我们不认识你，也不信任你。离开我们的战场，滚远点。

english: We haven't seen you kill any lizardmen yet.
translation: 我们还没看到你杀死任何蜥蜴人。

english: Sona si Latine loqueris.
translation: 如果你说拉丁语，那就好了。

english: Carpe Diem!
translation: 把握今天！

english: Vacca foeda.
translation: 肮脏的母牛。

english: Da mihi sis bubulae frustrum assae, solana tuberosa in modo Gallico fricta, ac quassum lactatum coagulatum crassum.
translation: 请给我一块烤牛肉、法式炸土豆和一份厚的凝乳。

english: Corripe Cervisiam!
translation: 拿啤酒来！

english: Latine loqui coactus sum.
translation: 我被迫说拉丁语。

english: Di! Ecce hora! Uxor mea me necabit!
translation: 天啊！时间到了！我老婆会杀了我的！

english: Raptus regaliter.
translation: 像国王一样被绑架。

english: Mihi ignosce. Cum homine de cane debeo congredi.
translation: 请原谅我。我必须和那个狗男人打架。

english: Die dulci fruere.
translation: 享受美好的日子。

english: Fac ut gaudeam.
translation: 让我开心。

english: Vescere bracis meis.
translation: 吃我的裤子。

english: Braccae tuae aperiuntur.
translation: 你的裤子是敞开的。

english: Quantum materiae materietur marmota monax si marmota monax materiam possit materiari?
translation: 如果一只土拨鼠能砍木头，那么它到底能砍多少木头？

english: Te audire non possum. Musa sapientum fixa est in aure.
translation: 我听不见你说话。智慧之音已固定在我耳中。

english: Errare humanum est.
translation: 人非圣贤，孰能无过。

english: Noli me vocare, ego te vocabo.
translation: 别叫我，我会叫你的。

english: Furnulum pani nolo.
translation: 我不想吃面包。

english: Utinam barbari spatium proprium tuum invadant!
translation: 但愿野蛮人入侵你的私人空间！

english: Meliora Cogito.
translation: 我追求更好的事物。

english: Ne auderis delere orbem rigidum meum!
translation: 别想摧毁我的硬球！

english: Cogito Ergo Sum.
translation: 我思故我在。

english: Fac ut vivas.
translation: 好好活着。

english: Nemo dat quod non habet.
translation: 没有人能给出他没有的东西。

english: I see 3 adventurers in the canyon to the east.
translation: 我看到东边的峡谷里有三个冒险者。

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed one lizardman since they began tracking your kills.
translation: 谢兹恩的记录显示，自从他们开始追踪你的击杀数以来，你已经杀死了一只蜥蜴人。

english: I see 4 adventurers in the canyon to the west.
translation: 我看到西边的峡谷里有四个冒险者。

english: Don't even think about attacking me! Get out of our battlefield.
translation: 想都别想攻击我！滚出我们的战场。

english: I see 5 adventurers in the canyon to the west.
translation: 我看到西边的峡谷里有五个冒险者。

english: Please get off the battlefield now before you get in the way.
translation: 请现在离开战场，免得碍事。

english: I see 4 adventurers in the canyon to the east.
translation: 我看到东边的峡谷里有四个冒险者。

english: The Shayzien records say you've killed one lizardman since they began tracking your kills. One was a lizardman shaman.
translation: 谢兹恩的记录显示，自从他们开始追踪你的击杀数以来，你已经杀死了一只蜥蜴人。其中一只是蜥蜴人萨满。

english: You've not completed any laps of our advanced agility course yet.
translation: 你还没有完成我们高级敏捷课程的任何一圈。

english: There should be a spare one in the cupboard for you.
translation: 橱柜里应该有一个备用的给你。

english: Elena! The authorities came and took her away!
translation: 埃琳娜！当局来把她带走了！

english: You'd be willing to help? Thank you. Speak to Edmond, he was there when they took her.
translation: 你愿意帮忙？谢谢你。去和埃德蒙谈谈，他们带走她时他就在场。

english: You need to bring me some silk and some purple dye. I need them to be able to make the tabard. Come back when you have both.
translation: 你需要给我带一些丝绸和一些紫色染料。我需要它们来做罩袍。等你两样都齐了再来找我。

english: It's not common round here, though I hear it's easy to find by the coast south west of Falador.
translation: 这一带不常见，不过我听说在法拉多城西南海岸很容易找到。

english: Well I don't have any chocolate, but this may help.
translation: 嗯，我没有巧克力，但这个可能有用。

english: Not a problem. I still have enough materials to make another. You'll need to make some room in your inventory for me to give you it though.
translation: 没问题。我还有足够的材料再做一件。不过你需要在背包里腾出一些空间，我才能给你。

english: Tim?
translation: 蒂姆？

english: Hmm... Very well. As you were... Tim...
translation: 嗯...好吧。继续吧...蒂姆...

english: You don't look much like a Tim.
translation: 你看起来不太像蒂姆。

english: What are you doing here... Tim?
translation: 你在这里做什么...蒂姆？

english: Sue?
translation: 苏？

english: Hmm... Very well. As you were... Sue...
translation: 嗯...好吧。继续吧...苏...

english: You don't look much like a Sue.
translation: 你看起来不太像苏。

english: What are you doing here... Sue?
translation: 你在这里做什么...苏？

english: Good to see you Tim.
translation: 很高兴见到你，蒂姆。

english: Hmm... Is your head working okay today Tim?
translation: 嗯...你今天脑子还好使吗，蒂姆？

english: Good to see you Sue.
translation: 很高兴见到你，苏。

english: Hmm... Is your head working okay today Sue?
translation: 嗯...你今天脑子还好使吗，苏？

english: Good stuff, now for the digging. Beneath us are the Ardougne sewers. I've done some research, and I reckon you can use them to access to West Ardougne.
translation: 好东西，现在该挖了。我们脚下是阿多尼城的下水道。我做过一些研究，我觉得你可以利用它们进入西阿多尼城。

english: I don't know... All I know is that she's gone...
translation: 我不知道……我只知道她不见了……

english: But you've already got one! It's in your bank.
translation: 但你已经有了一件！就在你的银行里。

english: Thanks you friend.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。

english: Hello friend. Have you been to the prison yet?
translation: 你好，朋友。你去过监狱了吗？

english: Thank goodness. Let me know if you need my help.
translation: 谢天谢地。如果需要我帮忙，就告诉我。

english: Not good at all. Elena's been taken and now you're telling me the plague is all a lie.
translation: 糟透了。埃琳娜被抓走了，现在你又告诉我瘟疫全是谎言。

english: Then you'll need to make it again. You'll need a steel platebody, some steel platelegs and a steel full helm.
translation: 那你得重新做一个。你需要一件钢制胸甲、一条钢制腿甲和一个钢制头盔。

english: The plume on the helm will need dying red and you'll need a tabard for the platebody. If needed, my wife can help you with the tabard.
translation: 头盔上的羽饰需要染成红色，胸甲上需要一件罩袍。如果需要，我妻子可以帮你做罩袍。

english: Things are always better when Elena comes to visit!
translation: 埃琳娜来拜访的时候，一切都会好很多！

english: I know you Mourners are up to no good, go away!
translation: 我知道你们这些哀悼者没安好心，走开！

english: How dare you come in here? Get out of my house!
translation: 你怎么敢进来？滚出我的房子！

english: Go away Mourner!
translation: 滚开，哀悼者！

english: It'll be a good day when you Mourners leave, not until then.
translation: 等你们这些哀悼者离开的那天，日子才会好过。在那之前，免谈。

english: Haven't you people done enough to my family? Leave me to grieve over my son on my own.
translation: 你们这些人对我家人做的还不够吗？让我独自哀悼我的儿子。

english: That's not going to bring him back, is it?
translation: 那也不会让他回来，对吧？

english: Good work driving those mourners out. Now you should speak to Elena and Councillor Halgrive, they'll let you know what happens next.
translation: 干得好，赶走了那些哀悼者。现在你应该和埃琳娜及哈尔格里夫议员谈谈，他们会告诉你接下来怎么做。

english: Thanks, but I don't accept gifts.
translation: 谢了，但我不收礼物。

english: Afraid not, maybe some of the others do though.
translation: 恐怕没有，不过也许其他人有。

english: Yeah, I'm out of ideas as well. Someone else might have something though.
translation: 是啊，我也没主意了。不过也许别人有办法。

english: Good job at the castle. You'd better speak to Elena and Councillor Halgrive, they'll know what to do now.
translation: 城堡里干得不错。你最好去找埃琳娜和哈尔格里夫议员谈谈，他们知道接下来该怎么做。

english: Well he may be king but he clearly doesn't have a clue about health. This could be disastrous for the city!
translation: 好吧，他也许是国王，但他显然对健康一窍不通。这对城市来说可能是灾难性的！

english: You Mourners... are meant to be helping us, but you're doing more harm here than good. You won't even let me send a letter out to my family.
translation: 你们这些哀悼者……应该来帮助我们，但你们在这里弊大于利。你们甚至不让我给家人写信。

english: That's what you all say!
translation: 你们都是这么说的！

english: Very well. I'm going to be starting training soon. I'm hoping to become a medic on the frontline!
translation: 很好。我很快就要开始训练了。我希望成为前线的医护兵！

english: Hello there. Welcome to Shayzien. Home of justice and safety for the entirety of Great Kourend.
translation: 你好。欢迎来到谢兹恩城，这里是整个大库兰德王国的正义与安全之地。

english: Surprisingly peaceful. Because of the war with the lizardmen, many people are out fighting. The city is pretty quiet as a result.
translation: 出人意料地平静。因为与蜥蜴人的战争，很多人都在外作战。所以城市里相当安静。

english: You'll all pay for what you've done to us, Mourner scum.
translation: 你们这些哀悼者渣滓，会为对我们所做的一切付出代价的。

english: Yes, can I help? Anything for a plague doctor.
translation: 是的，需要帮忙吗？为瘟疫医生效劳。

english: Well if you're ever in need just ask. Good day.
translation: 好吧，如果需要帮忙尽管开口。再见。

english: Do you wish to donate your fertiliser?
translation: 你愿意捐赠你的堆肥吗？

english: Mr Bravek, there's a man here who really needs to speak to you.
translation: 布拉维克先生，这里有位男士急需和您谈谈。

english: Mr Bravek, there's a lady here who really needs to speak to you.
translation: 布拉维克先生，这里有位女士急需和您谈谈。

english: My cloaks and vexilla are for members of clans.
translation: 我的斗篷和旗帜只出售给部族成员。

english: Ah, clans. Where do I begin?  Clans are groups of people gathered together for numerous reasons. Usually they have shared interests, like activities they enjoy together.
translation: 啊，部族。从何说起呢？部族是出于众多原因聚集在一起的人群。通常他们有共同的兴趣，比如一起喜欢的活动。

english: If you form a clan, and become its owner, you may have to wait a few days before leaving your clan, or handing the ownership to someone else.
translation: 如果你组建了一个部族并成为其所有者，你可能需要等待几天才能离开你的部族，或将所有权转交给他人。

english: Certainly! In order to form a clan, you must have four friends join you. There wouldn't be much of a clan with just you in it, would there? Now, let me note all this down. Your name, please?
translation: 当然！要组建部族，你需要有四位朋友加入。只有你一个人的部族可就不像什么部族了，对吧？现在，让我记下这些。请问你的名字？

english: How unique. Now, gather some friends to help form your clan. Meanwhile you can find a suitable name for the group.
translation: 多么独特。现在，召集一些朋友来帮你组建部族。同时你可以为这个团体想一个合适的名字。

english: You'll be able to leave your clan immediately if the clan's less than a week old. But once the clan's longer- established, resigning will take a few days - just to avoid accidents, you know!
translation: 如果部族成立不到一周，你可以立即离开。但一旦部族存在时间更长，辞职就需要几天时间——你知道的，只是为了避免意外！

english: Once you have accepted your four friends and confirmed that everything looks good, your clan will be created.
translation: 一旦你接受了四位朋友并确认一切无误，你的部族就创建成功了。

english: I'm afraid the stores cannot hold any more fertiliser at the moment. Thank you for your support.
translation: 恐怕仓库目前无法再存放更多堆肥了。感谢你的支持。

english: I can't offer you anything if you don't have space to take it.
translation: 如果你没有空间存放，我无法给你任何东西。

english: Alright. Maybe you could help a friend form a clan instead, so that they become its owner instead of you. I'll be here if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧。或许你可以帮朋友组建部族，这样他们就成为所有者而不是你。如果你改变主意，我随时在这里。

english: In order to form a clan, one should be experienced enough to lead. Come back when you have spent more time in this world.
translation: 要组建部族，需要有足够的领导经验。等你在这个世界多花些时间后再回来吧。

english: Yes, you can! Just because you choose to limit yourself doesn't mean that you can't still socialise with others.
translation: 是的，你可以！仅仅因为你选择限制自己，并不意味着你不能与他人社交。

english: Well it seems you are already in the process of forming a clan. Come back another time.
translation: 嗯，看来你已经在组建部族的过程中了。下次再来吧。

english: You formed a clan too recently. Come back tomorrow.
translation: 你最近刚组建了一个部族。明天再来吧。

english: I can't seem to check your clan's settings at the moment, so I might end up giving you the wrong items. Maybe you should ask me again later.
translation: 我目前似乎无法检查你的部族设置，所以可能会给你错误的东西。或许你稍后再来问我。

english: You'll be able to leave your clan immediately if the clan's less than a week old. But once the clan's longer-established, resigning will take a few days - just to avoid accidents, you know!
translation: 如果部族成立不到一周，你可以立即离开。但一旦部族存在时间更长，辞职就需要几天时间——你知道的，只是为了避免意外！

english: It seems you are already a member of a clan. I suggest you leave that one before forming a new one.
translation: 看来你已经是某个部族的成员了。我建议你先离开那个部族，再组建新的。

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have one bucket here, and one more in the bank. We require 944 buckets.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的居民需要硫磺堆肥用于农场。我看到你这里有一桶，银行里还有一桶。我们需要944桶。

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have one bucket here, and one more in the bank. We require 762 buckets.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的居民需要硫磺堆肥用于农场。我看到你这里有一桶，银行里还有一桶。我们需要762桶。

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have one bucket here, and one more in the bank. We require 946 buckets.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的居民需要硫磺堆肥用于农场。我看到你这里有一桶，银行里还有一桶。我们需要946桶。

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have one bucket here, and one more in the bank. We require 696 buckets.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的居民需要硫磺堆肥用于农场。我看到你这里有一桶，银行里还有一桶。我们需要696桶。

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have one bucket here, and one more in the bank. We require 2 buckets.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的居民需要硫磺堆肥用于农场。我看到你这里有一桶，银行里还有一桶。我们需要2桶。

english: The people of Hosidius require sulphurous fertiliser for the farms. I see you have one bucket here, and one more in the bank. We require 662 buckets.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的居民需要硫磺堆肥用于农场。我看到你这里有一桶，银行里还有一桶。我们需要662桶。

english: Silk? You're not carrying any silk.
translation: 丝绸？你身上没带丝绸啊。

english: No, you're carrying a bit of paper that says it can be exchanged for silk at a bank or general store. I'm not buying that. Fetch me some real silk, then we'll trade.
translation: 不，你带的是一张纸，上面写着可以在银行或杂货店兑换丝绸。我可不要那个。去弄些真正的丝绸来，我们再交易。

english: Good day Sir. Would you like some nice freshly baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?
translation: 日安，先生。您想要一些新鲜出炉的面包吗？或者来一块美味的蛋糕？

english: Good day Madame. Would you like some nice freshly baked bread? Or perhaps a nice piece of cake?
translation: 日安，女士。您想要一些新鲜出炉的面包吗？或者来一块美味的蛋糕？

english: Well I suggest you go back to where you found it.
translation: 我建议你从哪找到的就放回哪去。

english: Liar. You stored it somewhere, didn't you!
translation: 骗子。你把它藏到别处了，对吧！

english: Wait, look how much you're carrying! You can't carry this too.
translation: 等等，看看你身上带了多少东西！这个你拿不下了。

english: I wonder what is inside.
translation: 我好奇里面是什么。

english: I was waiting for you to say that, because I just found it!
translation: 我正等你这么说呢，因为我刚找到它！

english: I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it! Take it and don't lose it.
translation: 我正等你这么说呢，因为我刚找到它！拿去吧，别弄丢了。

english: I can sell you a starting house in Brimhaven for 1000 coins.
translation: 我可以卖给你一栋布尔哈文镇的起家房，只要1000金币。

english: Thank you. Go through the Brimhaven house portal and you will find your house ready for you to start building in it.
translation: 谢谢你。穿过布尔哈文镇的房屋传送门，你就会看到你的房子已经准备好让你开始建造了。

english: Absolutely, let me borrow your blueprints and I'll make it happen! You will get them back if you redecorate your house to a different theme.
translation: 当然，把你的蓝图借给我，我来搞定！如果你以后要重新装修成不同主题，蓝图会还给你。

english: I can sell you a starting house in Rimmington for 1,000 coins. As you increase your Construction skill you will be able to have your house moved to other areas and redecorated in other styles.
translation: 我可以卖给你一栋里明顿村的起家房，只要1000金币。随着你的建筑技能提升，你就能把房子搬到其他区域，并重新装修成其他风格。

english: I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to use that style. You need to have level 50.
translation: 恐怕你的建筑等级不够高，无法使用那种风格。你需要达到50级。

english: You cannot move your house there as you haven't unlockedAsgarnia.
translation: 你无法把房子搬到那里，因为你还没解锁阿斯加尼亚。

english: I've got a book here that will help you to make a house, but I see your hands are full. Talk to me again when you have space to take it.
translation: 我这里有本书可以帮你盖房子，但看来你手上没空。等你有空间拿的时候再来找我吧。

english: You cannot move your house there as you haven't unlockedFremennik Province.
translation: 你无法把房子搬到那里，因为你还没解锁弗雷门尼克省。

english: You cannot move your house there as you haven't unlockedKharidian Desert.
translation: 你无法把房子搬到那里，因为你还没解锁卡里迪安沙漠。

english: I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to use that style. You need to have level 10.
translation: 恐怕你的建筑等级不够高，无法使用那种风格。你需要达到10级。

english: I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to use that style. You need to have level 40.
translation: 恐怕你的建筑等级不够高，无法使用那种风格。你需要达到40级。

english: I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to use that style. You need to have level 30.
translation: 恐怕你的建筑等级不够高，无法使用那种风格。你需要达到30级。

english: I'm afraid you don't have a high enough Construction level to use that style. You need to have level 20.
translation: 恐怕你的建筑等级不够高，无法使用那种风格。你需要达到20级。

english: Never heard of it.
translation: 从没听说过。

english: It looks like you are currently advertising your house on the noticeboard. If you wish to move your house, your advert will need to be removed.
translation: 看来你目前正在公告板上为你的房子打广告。如果你想搬家，需要先把广告撤下来。

english: You cannot move your house there as you haven't unlockedKandarin.
translation: 你无法把房子搬到那里，因为你还没解锁坎达林。

english: Hello. Welcome to the Zaros Housing Agency! What can I do for you?
translation: 你好。欢迎来到萨洛斯房屋中介！有什么能帮你的？

english: You seem to have some people in your house at the moment. You should tell them to leave before you redecorate.
translation: 你房子里好像还有人在。你应该先让他们离开，然后再重新装修。

english: I can sell you a starting house in Edgeville for 10,000 coins. As you increase your construction skill you will be able to build better rooms and redecorate in other styles.
translation: 我可以卖给你一栋边陲镇的起家房，只要10000金币。随着你的建筑技能提升，你就能建造更好的房间，并重新装修成其他风格。

english: Thank you! Go through the Edgeville house portal and you will find your new house ready to be built in.
translation: 谢谢你！穿过边陲镇的房屋传送门，你就会看到你的新房子已经准备好让你建造了。

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 5000 coins.
translation: 哼。等你有了5000金币再来吧。

english: As you no longer want your house theme to be Twisted, I'd like to give you your Twisted blueprints back. However you don't appear to have space for them. Come back when you do.
translation: 既然你不再想要扭曲主题的房子了，我想把你的扭曲蓝图还给你。不过你似乎没有空间来拿。等你有空间了再来吧。

english: Would you like to purchase a starter house?
translation: 你想买一栋起家房吗？

english: I can sell you a starting house in Rimmington for50,000coins. As you increase your construction skill you will be able to have your house moved to other areas and redecorated.

english: On Zaros, your house is linked to all portals around the world. You can enter your house from any of the 9 portals and your exit location will always be in Edgeville.
translation: 在萨洛斯，你的房子与世界各地所有的传送门相连。你可以从9个传送门中的任何一个进入你的房子，而你的出口位置将始终在边陲镇。

english: Congratulations, adventurer! You now have your very own house! Simply step through the portal south of me, or teleport to your house to visit it.
translation: 恭喜你，冒险者！你现在拥有自己的房子了！只要穿过我南边的传送门，或者传送到你的房子去看看。

english: Come see me again if you'd like to move your house somewhere else, or have it redecorated.
translation: 如果你想搬家或重新装修，再来找我。

english: You don't have this theme unlocked yet. Bring me some hosidius blueprints from Amy's reward shop first.
translation: 你还没解锁这个主题。先去艾米的奖励商店给我带些霍西迪乌斯蓝图来。

english: You don't have enough money to buy a house, come back when you can afford one.
translation: 你的钱不够买房子，等你能买得起的时候再来吧。

english: You need a Construction level of 10 to buy this style.
translation: 你需要建筑等级10才能购买这种风格。

english: I'm sorry but it's impossible to move your house to Yanille with all those guards around. Please pick somewhere else.
translation: 很抱歉，周围有那么多守卫，不可能把你的房子搬到亚尼勒城。请选别的地方吧。

english: Quite. The wizards didn't want to get bogged down in the business side of things so they  hired me to sell the houses.

english: There are various other people across Zaros who can help you furnish your house. You should start buying planks from the sawmill operator in Varrock.
translation: 萨洛斯各地还有其他人可以帮你布置房子。你应该先去维洛克城找锯木厂操作员买些木板。

english: Hmph. Come back when you have 50000 coins.

english: I see you have recently achieved 99 construction. Would you like to buy a cape for 99,0000 gp?

translation: 哦，你身上好像没带够钱。等带够了再来吧！

english: As you may know, skillcapes are only available to masters in a skill. I have spent my entire life building houses and now I spend my time selling them! As a sign of my abilites I wear this Skillcape of Construction. If you ever have
translation: 你可能知道，技能披风只有技能大师才能获得。我一生都在建造房屋，现在则是在卖房子！为了证明我的能力，我穿着这件建筑技能披风。如果你有朝一日

english: enough skill to build a demonic throne, come and talk to me and I'll sell you a skillcape like mine.
translation: 有足够的技能建造恶魔王座，就来找我，我会卖给你一件像我这样的技能披风。

english: Very well, I shall make the necessary arrangements to redecorate your house with the Deathly Mansion style...
translation: 很好，我会做必要的安排，用死亡庄园风格重新装修你的房子……

english: You need a Construction level of 30 to buy this style.

english: Youw house has been moved to Rimmington.

english: Okay, if you change your mind you know where to findme.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，你知道在哪里能找到我。

translation: 哼。等你有了250000金币再来吧。

english: My insurance fee is 500,000 coins. Once you've paid that, the pet's insured forever, and you can reclaim it here unlimited times for a reclamation fee of 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 我的保险费用是 50 万金币。付清之后，宠物就永久受保，之后每次可以在这里花 100 万金币的取回费无限次领回。

english: Great! The insurance fee is 500,000 coins. Just hand me the pet so that I can register it.
translation: 太好了！保险费用是 50 万金币。把宠物交给我，我来登记。

english: I'm afraid you don't seem to have insured any pets at all.
translation: 恐怕你似乎没有投保任何宠物。

english: It's simple. You show me your pet, and pay an insurance fee of 500,000 coins. From that moment, I'll watch out for that pet.
translation: 很简单。你把宠物给我看，支付 50 万金币的保险费用。从那一刻起，我就会照看那只宠物。

english: Every time you lose it or dismiss it in future, I'll catch the pet and keep it safely here. You can collect it each time for a reclamation fee of 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 以后每次你弄丢或放走它，我都会抓住它并安全地保管在这里。每次你可以支付 100 万金币的取回费来领回。

english: The insurance fee is a one-off charge; once you've insured a pet, it stays insured no matter how many times you lose it and reclaim it. You just have to pay the reclamation fee each time.
translation: 保险费用是一次性收费；一旦你为宠物投保，无论你弄丢并领回多少次，它都一直受保。你只需要每次支付取回费。

english: I'm afraid you don't seem to have insured any pets, so I can't help you.
translation: 恐怕你似乎没有投保任何宠物，所以我帮不了你。

english: You've already taken out insurance for that pet.
translation: 你已经为那只宠物投保过了。

english: Let's take a look at my records...
translation: 让我看看我的记录……

english: Well it's all very simple. Whenever you get a pet, it will be automatically insured for free. If you lose the pet, you can simply come here and reclaim it.
translation: 嗯，这很简单。每当你获得一只宠物，它都会自动免费投保。如果你弄丢了宠物，直接来这里领回就行。

english: Here's my record of your insurance policies...
translation: 这是我记录的你的保险单……

english: Are you sure? That doesn't sound right to me.
translation: 你确定吗？我觉得这听起来不太对劲。

english: No, sorry, I don't do cats. I'm not a cat person.
translation: 不，抱歉，我不处理猫。我不是个喜欢猫的人。

english: If you keep waving money at me, I might take it! Hand me your pet if you want to buy insurance.
translation: 如果你一直在我面前晃钱，我可能会收下！如果你想买保险，就把你的宠物交给我。

english: Ah [player name], just the person I'm looking for, this little one ran away and found their way back to me. Here, you can have your pet back.
translation: 啊 [player name]，我正要找你呢，这个小家伙跑掉了，然后又自己找回到我这里。来，你可以领回你的宠物了。

english: Hello adventurer! I run the Zaros pet insurance bureau. What is it that you need?
translation: 你好，冒险者！我经营着萨洛斯的宠物保险局。你需要什么？

english: No problem, simply hand the pet over to me and I'll see what I can do.
translation: 没问题，把宠物交给我，我看看能做什么。

english: I'll watch after your pet from now on. If you lose it come and see me.
translation: 从现在起我会照看你的宠物。如果你弄丢了它，就来找我。

english: You simply pay a hefty fee up-front to insure a pet. Every time you lose that pet in battle, I'll recover it for you and charge another fee for you to reclaim it.
translation: 你只需预先支付一笔高额费用来为宠物投保。每次你在战斗中弄丢那只宠物，我都会为你找回它，并再收取一笔费用让你领回。

english: Ah [player name], just the person I'm looking for, this little one ran away and found their way back to me. Please can you make some space and take your pet back.
translation: 啊 [player name]，我正要找你呢，这个小家伙跑掉了，然后又自己找回到我这里。请腾出点空间，把你的宠物领回去吧。

english: Once a pet is insured, it's insured forever. You'll only have to pay the reclaim fee each time you lose the pet.
translation: 一旦宠物投保，就永久受保。你只需要每次弄丢宠物时支付取回费。

english: I won't watch after this pet. This pet is never lost on death!
translation: 我不会照看这只宠物。这只宠物死亡时不会丢失！

english: I'm afraid I can't insure that kind of pet.
translation: 恐怕我无法为那种宠物投保。

english: You already have have that particular pet insured by my services.
translation: 你已经通过我的服务为那只特定的宠物投保了。

english: You need to have 2,500,000 coins to permanently insure a pet with me.
translation: 你需要有 250 万金币才能在我这里永久投保一只宠物。

english: Ah :^], just the person I'm looking for, this little one ran away and found their way back to me. Here, you can have your pet back.
translation: 啊 :^]，我正要找你呢，这个小家伙跑掉了，然后又自己找回到我这里。来，你可以领回你的宠物了。

english: Yes mistress! Kill them all.
translation: 是的，女主人！把他们全杀了。

english: Good day, adventurer. I must thank you for protecting our high priest. Word has it that it was quite the battle.
translation: 日安，冒险者。我必须感谢你保护了我们的大祭司。听说那是一场相当激烈的战斗。

english: Sorry, Sophanem is under quarantine. No one may leave or enter.
translation: 抱歉，索法尼恩城正在隔离中。任何人不得离开或进入。

english: Nobody may enter or leave Sophanem for any reason, so says the new high priest of Icthlarin.
translation: 任何人不得以任何理由进出索法尼恩城，这是伊克哈林的新任大祭司的命令。

english: Don't let us keep you. I'm sure you've got plenty of other important questing to get on with.
translation: 别让我们耽误你。我相信你还有很多重要的任务要去做。

english: Thank you, unbeliever; your heroic efforts have saved the day. I shudder to think of the fallout if we were to have lost another high priest so soon after the last.
translation: 谢谢你，异教徒；你的英勇努力挽救了局面。一想到如果我们在上一任大祭司之后这么快又失去一位，后果不堪设想，我就不寒而栗。

english: Why would I do that? I'm under orders not to let anyone in or out of the city.
translation: 我为什么要那么做？我接到命令，不让任何人进出城市。

english: Okay, one second.
translation: 好的，稍等一下。

english: Bother me not; I am in preparation for the burial ceremony. I'm sure even you can curb your trivial demands until after that.
translation: 别来烦我；我正在准备葬礼仪式。我相信即使是你也能把那些琐碎的要求推迟到那之后。

english: Well hello again. I hear you managed to dispose of those sheep. Good work.
translation: 嗯，又见面了。我听说你处理掉了那些羊。干得好。

english: And what can the Keldagrim bank do for you today?
translation: 那么，凯尔达格林银行今天能为你做些什么？

english: We have an agreement with them, yes, although it took some time to work out.
translation: 我们和他们有协议，是的，虽然花了一些时间才谈妥。

english: It could be better. The businesses here still have not recovered from their relocation. Personal banking like yours makes up the majority of our trade.
translation: 情况本可以更好。这里的商铺还没有从搬迁中恢复过来。像你这样的个人银行业务占我们交易的大部分。

english: We're the only bank on these two islands, so business is pretty good.
translation: 我们是这两座岛上唯一的银行，所以生意还不错。

english: This is an elven bank. The magic in this place allows you to access your account here in the western lands.
translation: 这是一家精灵银行。这里的魔法允许你在西部大陆访问你的账户。

english: Stop it, don't be so obvious. In the mysterious tongue, remember:O ocaaaa acac acaaaa acabac cacac acaaaa acabca aaaacac ocach acaj cachba aaj cach.
translation: 停下，别这么明显。用神秘的语言，记住：O ocaaaa acac acaaaa acabac cacac acaaaa acabca aaaacac ocach acaj cachba aaj cach。

english: Good day, would you like to access your bank account?
translation: 日安，您想要访问您的银行账户吗？

english: It goes well. The Consortium has brought an era of prosperity to the dwarves that we haven't seen for a long time.
translation: 一切顺利。财团为矮人带来了我们很久未见的繁荣时代。

english: Newcomers aren't allowed to use anything in the bank, including the poll booth. Come back once you've earned our trust.
translation: 新人不允许使用银行内的任何东西，包括投票亭。等你赢得我们的信任后再回来。

english: We don't deal with your kind, you stand alone.
translation: 我们不与你们这类人打交道，你独自站着吧。

english: Sorry, I'm not allowed to talk to you.
translation: 抱歉，我不被允许和你说话。

english: Option 3
translation: 选项 3

english: Oh gweat, anodaw customew.What do u want?
translation: 哦太嚎了，又一个顾客。你想药什么？

english: Option 2
translation: 选项 2

english: Option 1
translation: 选项 1

english: What do u want meat bag?
translation: 你个肉袋子想要啥？

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Zaros. We have branches in many towns.
translation: 这是扎罗斯银行的一个分行。我们在许多城镇都有分行。

english: Good day, how may me hewp u?
translation: 日安，我能帮您点什么？

english: Oh great, another customer. AQue quieres?
translation: 哦太好了，又一个顾客。你想要什么？

english: This is the injected dialog before everything continues.  What happens when you make it ridiculously long?  It automatically wraps over multiple lines!
translation: 这是在一切继续之前注入的对话。如果你让它长得离谱会怎样？它会自动换行到多行！

english: This is a three-line message.
translation: 这是一个三行消息。

english: Hand me a banknote, and I'ww twy to convewt it to anitem.
translation: 递给我一张票据，我会试试把它转换成物品。

english: This is a branch of the Bank of Gielinor. We have  branches in many towns.
translation: 这是吉莱诺银行的一个分行。我们在许多城镇都有分行。

english: I'd reccomend you wear a gas mask before entering West Ardougne. You don't want to risk catching the plague.
translation: 我建议你在进入西阿多尼城之前戴上防毒面具。你不想冒感染瘟疫的风险吧。

english: Hmm, don't think so.
translation: 嗯，我不这么认为。

english: Hello there, I expect you want filling in on what's happening here. Elena is the best person for that.
translation: 你好，我猜你想了解这里的情况。埃琳娜是最了解此事的人。

english: Are you ready to begin the beard 1075?
translation: 你准备好开始胡子1075任务了吗？

english: Welcome back the beard 1075, and good work out there. Thanks to you we now have a force that can stand up to Lathas and his armies.
translation: 欢迎回来，胡子1075，你在那边干得好。多亏了你，我们现在有了一支能够对抗拉萨斯及其军队的力量。

english: We've had various reports come in about a sudden increase in dragon activity. I assume this is what you're referring to.
translation: 我们收到了各种关于龙族活动突然增加的报告。我猜这就是你指的事情。

english: Don't worry, I'm preparing for my departure to Varrock.
translation: 别担心，我正在准备出发前往维洛克城。

english: Had I been born into the Cadarn clan, I'd be considered a hero right now. But I wasn't, so instead, I am the villain.
translation: 如果我出生在卡达恩氏族，我现在就会被视为英雄。但可惜我没有，所以我反而成了恶人。

english: 'The song of creation increased their lifespans, but at a  terrible price. It bound them to me. To stray too far from their sides, caused pain, and even death.'
translation: “创世之歌延长了他们的寿命，但代价惨重。它把他们和我绑在了一起。离他们身边太远，就会带来痛苦，甚至死亡。”

english: If you wish, I can teleport you somewhere.
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以把你传送到某个地方。

english: You are already here, I need not teleport you.
translation: 你已经在这里了，我不需要传送你。

english: Well prepare to die Tim!
translation: 那就准备受死吧，蒂姆！

english: Well prepare to die Sue!
translation: 那就准备受死吧，苏！

english: You're a hero, and all of us here know it. Again, thank you.
translation: 你是个英雄，我们这里所有人都知道。再次感谢你。

english: Why should we? All you humans do is take and destroy with no care for others. We don't need your help. You've done enough damage.
translation: 凭什么？你们人类只会索取和破坏，从不关心他人。我们不需要你的帮助。你们造成的破坏已经够多了。

english: Maybe, but it's not a risk worth taking. It was the acts of humans that led to my grandmother's death. You will bring similar ruin to us.
translation: 也许吧，但这不是值得冒的风险。正是人类的行为导致了我祖母的死亡。你们会给我们带来同样的毁灭。

english: I don't know the consecration process myself. You should speak with Eluned. She is wise in the ways of the ritual.
translation: 我自己也不知道祝圣的流程。你应该去找埃卢内德谈谈。她对仪式的各种方式很了解。

english: We elves use equipment formed out of crystal itself, far superior to your human weapons. However, the crystal does degrade with use and will eventually revert to seed.
translation: 我们精灵使用由水晶本身形成的装备，远比你们人类的武器优越。不过，水晶在使用中会逐渐磨损，最终会变回种子。

english: All elven crystal starts as a seed. It can then be sung into various shapes through the power of the voice. Eventually, it reverts back to seed, ready for the next song.
translation: 所有精灵水晶都始于一颗种子。然后可以通过声音的力量将其吟唱成各种形状。最终，它会变回种子，为下一次吟唱做好准备。

english: Alright. If you ever need a replacement, I can sell you another. Remember, the better the condition of crystal equipment, the more potential it has.
translation: 好吧。如果你需要替换品，我可以再卖给你一个。记住，水晶装备的状况越好，它的潜力就越大。

english: Keep an eye out for an elf named Ilfeen as you wander the forest. She can chant crystal seeds into new items for you.
translation: 在森林里闲逛时，留意一个叫伊尔芬的精灵。她可以把水晶种子吟唱成新的物品给你。

english: Both the shield and the bow I am carrying have been used, so are not at their full potential. They should still be quite useful though.
translation: 我携带的盾和弓都用过了，所以没有达到它们的全部潜力。不过它们应该还是相当有用的。

english: Ahh... good to see you back. Are you after more crystal equipment?
translation: 啊……很高兴看到你回来。你是想要更多水晶装备吗？

english: Very well human, we will take you to Arianwyn. But first, there is something you must do. If my grandmother has been moved, then her new tomb must be consecrated. Do this, and you will earn my trust.
translation: 很好，人类，我们会带你去见阿里安温。但首先，你必须做一件事。如果我祖母被移动了，那她的新墓必须被祝圣。做到这一点，你就会赢得我的信任。

english: That costs 750,000 coins.
The tomb of my grandmother must be consecrated. I don't know the process myself though. You should speak with Eluned. She is wise in the ways of the ritual.
translation: 我祖母的墓必须被祝圣。不过我自己不知道这个过程。你应该去找埃卢内德谈谈。她对仪式的各种方式很了解。

english: That costs 900,000 coins.
They're 750,000 coins each for new ones.
translation: 新的每件 750,000 金币。

english: Let go of your pride, Ysgawyn. [player name] has proven her worth to us.
translation: 放下你的骄傲吧，伊斯卡温。[player name]已经向我们证明了她的价值。

english: They're 900,000 coins each for new ones.
translation: 新的每件 900,000 金币。

english: Look after yourself.
translation: 保重。

english: This is good to hear. It puts me at ease to know she is in my grandfather's home. I will rest even easier once it has been consecrated.
translation: 这真是好消息。知道她在祖父的家里，我就放心了。一旦它被祝圣，我就更安心了。

english: Leave me be, I have no time for humans.
translation: 别烦我，我没时间搭理人类。

english: Sorry, you don't have enough space to hold any.
translation: 抱歉，你没有足够的空间来装下任何东西。

english: Not a problem. Just let us know when you're ready.
translation: 没问题。准备好了就告诉我们。

english: He is, he's the only family I have left. The rest of them died in his war.
translation: 是的，他是我唯一剩下的家人了。其他人都死在了他的战争中。

english: Lord Iorwerth is upon us, you'd better speak with my grandfather.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主来了，你最好去和我祖父谈谈。

english: I'm not surprised, your kind wouldn't care about them. Now begone.
translation: 我不惊讶，你们这类人根本不在乎它们。现在滚吧。

english: What would you like?
translation: 你想要什么？

english: You've run out of space.
translation: 你的空间用完了。

english: Good to see you [player name]. You should speak to Baxtorian when you're ready to begin.
translation: 很高兴见到你，[player name]。你准备好开始后，应该去找巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: Not a problem. Just let us know when you are.
translation: 没问题。准备好了就告诉我们。

english: Leave me be, I have no time for easterners. Between your lot and them gnomes, all you do is take and destroy. No thought for others.
translation: 别烦我，我没时间搭理东方人。你们这帮家伙和那些地精一样，只会索取和破坏。从不考虑别人。

english: Save your excuses young one! It was one of your species that disturbed my grandmother's remains. Will she never get the peace she deserves?
translation: 省省你的借口吧，小家伙！正是你们中的一个打扰了我祖母的遗骸。她就不能得到应得的安宁吗？

english: You've been in grandfather's home? That's where we originally wanted to leave Glarial's ashes to rest, but we could not understand how to enter.
translation: 你去过祖父的家？我们原本想把格拉里亚尔的骨灰安放在那里，但我们不知道怎么进去。

english: Yes gnomes! One of those little pests took the key to my grandmother's tomb. He must've given it to the human that desecrated the tomb.
translation: 是的，地精！就是那些小害虫中的一个拿走了我祖母墓穴的钥匙。它一定把钥匙给了那个亵渎墓穴的人类。

english: Yes! Someone took her ashes from her tomb. If it wasn't for them gnomes she'd have been left in peace. But now I can sense her restlessness.
translation: 是的！有人从她的墓穴里拿走了她的骨灰。要不是那些地精，她本可以安息的。但现在我能感觉到她的不安。

english: Yes... How did you know that?
translation: 是的……你怎么知道的？

english: I don't know the consecration process. You should speak with Eluned... she is wise in the ways of the ritual.
translation: 我不知道祝圣的过程。你应该去找埃卢内德谈谈……她对仪式的各种方式很了解。

english: Are you offering to help?!? Maybe not all humans are as bad as I thought.
translation: 你是要帮忙吗？！也许不是所有人类都像我想的那么坏。

english: This is gravely concerning... Her resting place must be consecrated.
translation: 这非常令人担忧……她的安息之地必须被祝圣。

english: Her restlessness has finally left me.
translation: 她的不安终于离我而去了。

english: You have returned! Thank you for all you have done. Now both me and my grandmother can rest in peace.
translation: 你回来了！感谢你所做的一切。现在我和我的祖母都可以安息了。

english: Welcome back to the land of the elves, friend!
translation: 欢迎回到精灵之地，朋友！

english: Hello there, it's a lovely day for a walk in the woods. So what can I help you with?
translation: 你好啊，今天天气不错，适合在林子里散步。那么，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Maybe this human isn't as bad as you think Islwyn.
translation: 也许这个人类不像你想的那么坏，伊斯尔温。

english: I can only make shields and bows. I've been trying halberds but haven't managed to get it right yet.
translation: 我只能制作盾和弓。我也试过制作戟，但还没成功。

english: Hey there. Islwyn told me that he'd given you some crystal equipment.
translation: 嘿，你好。伊斯尔温告诉我他已经给了你一些水晶装备。

english: As this is the first item I've made for you it will be 900,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
translation: 因为这是我第一次为你制作物品，所以价格是九十万金币。随着我越来越了解你的共鸣，费用应该会降低。

english: Hey, you're the human that helped my friend Islwyn, aren't you? He told me that he'd given you some crystal equipment.
translation: 嘿，你就是那个帮助我朋友伊斯尔温的人类，对吧？他告诉我他给了你一些水晶装备。

english: As this is the first item I've made for you it will be 750,000 coins. The cost should get cheaper as I get to know your resonance.
translation: 因为这是我第一次为你制作物品，所以价格是七十五万金币。随着我越来越了解你的共鸣，费用应该会降低。

english: I can't recharge seeds for you if you haven't got any seeds.
translation: 如果你没有种子，我没办法帮你充能。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 600000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要六十万金币。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 720000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要七十二万金币。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 450000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要四十五万金币。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 540000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要五十四万金币。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 300000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要三十万金币。

english: Sorry, you don't have enough coins.
translation: 抱歉，你的金币不够。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 360000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要三十六万金币。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 150000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要十五万金币。

english: Sorry, I don't have time to talk.
translation: 抱歉，我没时间聊天。

english: I'm afraid not, I don't keep track of where the others are. I know they're nearby though.
translation: 恐怕不行，我没有追踪其他人的位置。不过我知道他们就在附近。

english: As I've chanted for you before, it's a little easier - only 180000 coins this time.
translation: 因为我之前已经为你吟唱过，所以这次会容易一些——只要十八万金币。

english: Of course! This was the saw I gave to Oaknock. How is the young gnome? I rather liked him. He was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.
translation: 当然！这是我给橡敲的那把锯子。那个年轻的地精怎么样了？我还挺喜欢他的。他虽然嗓门有点大，但灵魂很好，而且对精灵魔法非常感兴趣。

english: [player name], Lord Iorwerth is here. You'd better go and speak to Baxtorian.
translation: [player name]，伊尔沃斯领主来了。你最好去和巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: Welcome to my crystal seed services. If you have a crystal weapon seed, I'll charge it into a shield, halberd, or bow... for a fee of course.
translation: 欢迎来到我的水晶种子服务处。如果你有水晶武器种子，我会把它充能成盾、戟或弓……当然，需要收费。

english: That costs 150,000 coins.
translation: 那需要十五万金币。

english: That costs 180,000 coins.
translation: 那需要十八万金币。

english: I would, it doesn't look like you have anything I can enchant though.
translation: 我愿意，但看起来你没有什么东西可以让我附魔的。

english: Of course! This was the seed I gave to Oaknock. How is the young gnome? I rather liked him. He was rather loud, but he had a good soul, and was very interested in elven magic.
translation: 当然！这是我给橡敲的种子。那个年轻的地精怎么样了？我还挺喜欢他的。他虽然嗓门有点大，但灵魂很好，而且对精灵魔法非常感兴趣。

english: This is the seed I gave him, it grows into a saw if I remember correctly.
translation: 这是我给他的种子，如果我没记错的话，它会长成一把锯子。

english: Very well, what would you like me to turn the seed into?
translation: 很好，你想让我把种子变成什么？

english: Do you want me to chant the seed?
translation: 你想让我吟唱这颗种子吗？

english: You don't seem to have any weapon seeds with you. I'll tell you what -- come back with one and I'll turn it into whatever item you wish.
translation: 你身上似乎没有武器种子。我告诉你——等你拿来一颗，我就把它变成你想要的任何物品。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a halberd for the price of 150,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一把戟，价格为十五万金币。

english: Sure. I can only make shields and bows. I've been trying halberds but haven't managed to get it right yet.
translation: 当然。我只能制作盾和弓。我也试过制作戟，但还没成功。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a shield for the price of 150,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一面盾，价格为十五万金币。

english: Hey there. You should let Baxtorian know once you're ready to get started.
translation: 嘿，你好。你准备好开始之后，应该让巴克斯托里安知道。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a halberd for the price of 600,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一把戟，价格为六十万金币。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a halberd for the price of 750,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一把戟，价格为七十五万金币。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a halberd for the price of 450,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一把戟，价格为四十五万金币。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a shield for the price of 750,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一面盾，价格为七十五万金币。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a halberd for the price of 300,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一把戟，价格为三十万金币。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a shield for the price of 300,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一面盾，价格为三十万金币。

english: I'll enchant the seed into a bow for the price of 180,000 coins.
translation: 我会把种子附魔成一把弓，价格为十八万金币。

english: You need 750,000 coins to chant a Crystal shield full.
translation: 你需要七十五万金币才能吟唱一个水晶盾 (满)。

english: They're here. You'd better go speak with Baxtorian.
translation: 他们来了。你最好去和巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: 'Ere... How'd you get in 'ere?
translation: 喂……你是怎么进来的？

english: Wait... You must be [player name]!
translation: 等等……你一定是[player name]！

english: Klank told me about you, told me how you got rid of that Iban fellow. As it's you, I'll make you an offer, I'll trade you a Death Talisman. You'll need it if you want to access this altar.
translation: 克兰克跟我提过你，说你解决了那个叫伊班的家伙。既然是你，我就给你个机会，我用一个死亡护符跟你换。想用这个祭坛，你就需要它。

english: Well if you wanna 'nother, just come back and I'll tell you what I need.
translation: 嗯，如果你还想要一个，就回来找我，我会告诉你我需要什么。

english: I just need a few things, here I'll make you a list.
translation: 我只需要几样东西，我给你列个清单。

english: Looks like the enemy is here. You'd better go talk to your elf friend.
translation: 看来敌人已经到了。你最好去找你的精灵朋友谈谈。

english: I need to give you a list of things to collect, but it doesn't look like you've got room.
translation: 我得给你一张要收集物品的清单，但你身上好像没地方放了。

english: Well when you do, just come back and I'll tell you what I need.
translation: 等你准备好了，就回来找我，我会告诉你我需要什么。

english: I see you've got the item, can I have it please?
translation: 我看到你拿到那个物品了，能把它给我吗？

english: I see you've got the Spade, can I have it please?
translation: 我看到你拿到铲子了，能把它给我吗？

english: I see you've got the Chisel, can I have it please?

english: I see you've got the White berries, can I have it please?
translation: 我看到你拿到白莓了，能把它给我吗？

english: For years the rebels have fought against the tyranny of Lord Iorwerth. I suspect the end of that fight draws near, another completed verse in the song of the elves. I wonder how it will conclude...
translation: 多年来，叛军一直在反抗伊尔沃斯领主的暴政。我怀疑这场战斗即将结束，精灵之歌中又完成了一节。不知道它会如何收场...

english: The time has come, I hope you are ready. You'd better go and see Baxtorian.
translation: 时机已到，我希望你准备好了。你最好去找巴克斯托里安。

english: I would advise you speak with Arianwyn, rather than me.
translation: 我建议你去找阿里安温谈谈，而不是我。

english: I would advise you speak with Baxtorian, rather than me.
translation: 我建议你去找巴克斯托里安谈谈，而不是我。

english: Most of the elves here give me a wide berth. They seem to find me intimidating. How ironic that an old woman is more of a threat to them than the entire Iorwerth clan.
translation: 这里的大多数精灵都对我敬而远之。他们似乎觉得我很吓人。多么讽刺啊，一个老太婆比整个伊尔沃斯氏族更让他们感到威胁。

english: Yes, but not the time to tell them. They have plenty of books in the Grand Library, if you want stories. There's a portal in the Tower of Voices that will take you there.
translation: 是的，但不是告诉他们的时候。如果你想听故事，大图书馆里有很多书。声音之塔里有一个传送门可以带你去那里。

english: The rebels had better get a move on and defeat Lord Iorwerth. Old ladies like me have a tendency to drop dead, and I'll be very annoyed if that happens before I see Prifddinas again.
translation: 叛军最好快点行动，打败伊尔沃斯领主。像我这样的老太太很容易突然去世，如果在我再次见到普里夫迪纳斯城之前就死了，我会非常恼火的。

english: Lord Iorwerth has decided to grace us with his presence. Why don't you send him back to where he came? Let Baxtorian know when you're ready.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主决定赏光驾临。你为什么不把他送回他来的地方？准备好了就告诉巴克斯托里安。

english: Don't bother this old lady, go speak to Arianwyn instead.
translation: 别打扰这位老太太，去找阿里安温谈谈吧。

english: Don't bother this old lady, go speak to Baxtorian instead.
translation: 别打扰这位老太太，去找巴克斯托里安谈谈吧。

english: You should go and speak with Baxtorian. Battle is upon us.
translation: 你应该去找巴克斯托里安谈谈。战斗即将来临。

english: I suggest you talk to Baxtorian. He is taking the lead here.
translation: 我建议你去找巴克斯托里安。他在这里负责指挥。

english: At long last we are back in our city, our home. Here, in the light of Seren, we can properly continue our path to enlightenment.
translation: 我们终于回到了我们的城市，我们的家。在这里，在塞伦的光芒下，我们可以继续我们的启蒙之路。

english: They come, speak to Baxtorian at once.
translation: 他们来了，马上去找巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: I am here to guide, not to lead. Speak with Baxtorian instead.
translation: 我是来引导的，不是来领导的。去找巴克斯托里安吧。

english: They're here, you'd better go see Baxtorian.
translation: 他们来了，你最好去找巴克斯托里安。

english: I hope we stop Lord Iorwerth. It would be a bit embarrassing to be known as the shortest serving clan elder.
translation: 我希望我们能阻止伊尔沃斯领主。要是成为任期最短的氏族长老，那可就有点尴尬了。

english: Not much is fun when Lord Iorwerth is involved.
translation: 有伊尔沃斯领主掺和的事，就没多少乐趣了。

english: The Iorwerth forces are here. You'd better go and speak to Baxtorian.
translation: 伊尔沃斯的部队来了。你最好去找巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: Yes, is there anything I can help with? I'm in charge of what's left of this army and I'm rather busy.
translation: 是的，有什么我能帮忙的吗？我负责管理这支军队剩余的人，现在忙得很。

english: The king will see no one. He can trust no one!
translation: 国王谁也不见。他谁都不能信任！

english: In the coming battle he will stand between us and the end. Then you will see him.
translation: 在即将到来的战斗中，他会站在我们和末日之间。到那时你就会见到他了。

english: This is not a good place to be, go and prepare for the coming darkness.
translation: 这里不是久留之地，去准备迎接即将到来的黑暗吧。

english: There is no great hero left to fight back the forces that face us now... Go, leave, prepare for the darkness. While you still have time!
translation: 已经没有伟大的英雄能反抗我们面前的力量了……去吧，离开这里，为黑暗做好准备。趁你还有时间！

english: The time to prepare is over, for darkness is upon us. Speak to Baxtorian at once.
translation: 准备的时间已经结束了，黑暗已降临在我们头上。立刻去和巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: That's not much use. Go and fetch it.
translation: 那没什么用。去把它拿来。

english: You're back already? How is the epidemic going?
translation: 你这么快就回来了？疫情怎么样了？

english: A long time ago, Seren herself ordered the construction of a great temple deep beneath the earth. This temple guards a great power, one that is key to our plans.
translation: 很久以前，塞伦亲自下令在地底深处建造了一座宏伟的神殿。这座神殿守护着一股强大的力量，这是我们计划的关键。

english: It shouldn't be long now. We have started to see signs that we are near.
translation: 应该快了。我们已经开始看到接近目标的迹象。

english: That's right. One of our dig teams has gone missing while searching for the temple. I need you to find out what happened to them.
translation: 没错。我们有一支挖掘队在寻找神殿时失踪了。我需要你去查明他们发生了什么事。

english: You say that now but the beasts in the mines are deadly, you'll have to be very careful in there.
translation: 你现在这么说，但矿井里的野兽很致命，你在里面必须非常小心。

english: It is good to see your enthusiasm. I was going to get one of the others to do this job, but as you are here...
translation: 看到你这么有热情很好。我本来打算派其他人去做这件事，但既然你在这里……

english: We have never tried this before, but some joker put something in our food not too long ago that gave us all symptoms akin to those of a plague.
translation: 我们以前从没试过这样，但不久前有个捣蛋鬼在我们的食物里下了东西，让我们所有人都出现了类似瘟疫的症状。

english: Did they not tell you? Hmm... I'd better fill you in.
translation: 他们没告诉你吗？嗯……我最好给你说明一下。

english: Now, to keep our presence in the city secret, Lord Iorwerth arranged an alliance with King Lathas, the ruler in the east.
translation: 为了隐藏我们在城里的行踪，伊尔沃斯领主与东边的统治者拉萨斯国王结成了联盟。

english: Well we have had a few near misses. Recently we had some girl from East Ardougne poking around asking too many questions, so we locked her up while we decided what to do with her.
translation: 我们有过几次差点暴露。最近有个来自东阿多尼城的女孩到处打探，问太多问题，所以我们把她关了起来，同时决定怎么处置她。

english: Well you don't think they end up those ridiculous colours naturally do you?
translation: 你不会真以为它们天生就是那些可笑的颜色吧？

english: Not quite, for starters the sheep need to be dyed red, yellow, green and blue. But most important is that you are not seen doing this by anyone.
translation: 不完全对，首先要把羊染成红色、黄色、绿色和蓝色。但最重要的是，你做这些事时不能被任何人看到。

english: We have a gnomic device that fires fat dye parcels that rupture on impact.
translation: 我们有一个地精装置，可以发射装满染料的包裹，撞击时会破裂。

english: This seems to be all in order. Welcome to the Death Guard. Now, for your first assignment...
translation: 看来一切就绪。欢迎加入死亡守卫。现在，你的第一个任务……

english: We believe the temple lies beneath this city. That is why we are here.
translation: 我们相信神殿就在这座城市地下。这就是我们来这里的原因。

english: Anyway, now that you know about the temple, I have a new task for you to perform, deep within the mines.
translation: 总之，既然你已经知道神殿的事，我有个新任务要交给你，在矿井深处执行。

english: It has been quite a while since anyone got ill from the plague, so I would like you to see to it that people do!
translation: 已经很久没人因瘟疫而生病了，所以我希望你去让这事发生！

english: If you can find out what it was that we were poisoned with, you could reproduce the effects. If done right the poison should not be fatal and could help restock our dwindling supply of cheap labour.
translation: 如果你能查出我们之前中的是什么毒，就可以重现那种效果。如果做得好，这种毒应该不会致命，还能帮助我们补充日益减少的廉价劳动力。

english: As you may know, part of what we do here is keep the people believing in the plague...
translation: 你可能知道，我们在这里的部分工作就是让人们相信瘟疫的存在……

english: Unfortunately, progress has been slower than we'd have liked. The slaves accidently mined into some old caverns infested with beasts. They have caused us significant issues.
translation: 不幸的是，进展比我们预期的要慢。奴隶们不小心挖到了一些布满野兽的古老洞穴，给我们造成了很大的麻烦。

english: Alas, one of the guards has taken the key to the mines to be copied. Report in regularly and I will see that you get a copy as soon as he gets back.
translation: 唉，有个守卫把矿井钥匙拿去复制了。你定期来报到，等他回来我就给你一把。

english: Distribution should be easy enough. Because of the city walls no one can grow their own food. Instead, all the food here comes from one of our three supply points.
translation: 分发应该很容易。因为有城墙，没人能自己种食物。相反，这里所有的食物都来自我们的三个补给点之一。

english: Any news yet on our missing dig team?
translation: 失踪的挖掘队有消息了吗？

english: Well as you undoubtedly know, we were sent here by Lord Iorwerth to secure the city. The reason for this is so that we can access the caves below...
translation: 你肯定知道，我们是伊尔沃斯领主派来占领这座城市的。原因是为了能进入下面的洞穴……

english: Apparently the fool thinks we will help him dispose of the Knights of Camelot once our work here is done. I expect he'll be disappointed.
translation: 显然那个傻瓜以为我们完成这里的工作后会帮他除掉卡美洛的骑士。我猜他会失望的。

english: Annoyingly, she managed to escape with the help of some adventurer. Lucky for us, they were so stupid that we managed to use the adventurer to deal with King Tyras. It all worked out quite well in the end.
translation: 烦人的是，她在某个冒险者的帮助下逃走了。幸运的是，他们太蠢了，我们利用那个冒险者对付了泰拉斯国王。最后结果还不错。

english: We can then have the 'infected' citizens removed and sent into the mines.
translation: 然后我们就可以把‘受感染’的市民带走，送到矿井里去。

english: Also you will need to re-dye them the colours they already are or the farmer may notice the change.
translation: 另外，你得把它们重新染成原来的颜色，否则农夫可能会注意到变化。

english: Anyway, shame of it is that we have yet to find a way to stop the dye from washing out. So we need someone, that someone being you, to go and re-dye them.
translation: 可惜的是，我们还没找到防止染料褪色的方法。所以我们需要有人，也就是你，去重新给它们染色。

english: Unfortunately, we have run out of the parcels and the device is broken.
translation: 不幸的是，包裹用完了，装置也坏了。

english: This is not good news. Did you find anything else down there?
translation: 这不是好消息。你在下面还发现了什么吗？

english: I must ask you to return to the search. Do let me know if you see anything elven-made down there as well. Any clues to the location of the temple will be very helpful.
translation: 你必须继续搜索。如果下面看到任何精灵制造的东西，也请告诉我。任何关于神殿位置的线索都会很有帮助。

english: Second, it means we can abduct citizens to mine the caves below with ease. We just pretend they've fallen victim to the plague.
translation: 其次，这意味着我们可以轻松地绑架市民去开采下面的洞穴。我们只需假装他们成了瘟疫的受害者。

english: The old halfwit thinks just because his sheep are an abnormal colour, that they are all ill with plague. It's amazing what a bit of dye can do.
translation: 那个老糊涂以为他的羊颜色不正常，就都得了瘟疫。一点染料就能做到的事，真是神奇。

english: Good, keep at it.
translation: 很好，继续努力。

english: Anyway, the plague serves two purposes. First, it allows us to move around the city in secret thanks to our mourner disguises.
translation: 总之，瘟疫有两个目的。首先，它让我们能穿着哀悼者的伪装在城里秘密行动。

english: Things like that is why we must ensure the people keep believing in the plague though. One of the things we do to keep up the lie is to fool old Farmer Brumty into believing his sheep are infected.
translation: 正因为有这种事，我们才必须确保人们继续相信瘟疫。我们维持谎言的手段之一，就是愚弄老农夫布鲁姆蒂，让他相信他的羊被感染了。

english: Have a new one then, if you lose it help yourself to one from my desk.
translation: 那就给你一把新的，如果弄丢了，就从我书桌上自己拿。

english: Try freeing up some space in your inventory, then we can talk about keys.
translation: 先腾出一些背包空间，然后我们再谈钥匙的事。

english: Welcome to the Death Guard. Now, for your first assignment...
translation: 欢迎加入死亡守卫。现在，你的第一个任务……

english: GET OUT! Return to Prifddinas in shame!
translation: 滚出去！羞愧地滚回普里夫迪纳斯城！

english: Keep at it. Try to get that gnome next door to spill his secrets.
translation: 继续努力。想办法让隔壁那个地精吐露他的秘密。

english: Free up some inventory space and get another one from my desk.
translation: 腾出一些背包空间，然后从我书桌上再拿一把。

english: If the Death Guard see fit to re-issue you with a letter of recommendation, then maybe we will find a use for you.
translation: 如果死亡守卫认为可以重新给你发一封推荐信，那我们也许会给你找个差事。

english: We need you to make it seem like people are ill with the plague. It will help keep the lie alive and also give us an excuse to abduct some more slaves for the mines.
translation: 我们需要你制造出人们感染瘟疫的假象。这有助于维持谎言，也给我们一个借口，为矿井绑架更多奴隶。

english: Find out what it was that we were recently poisoned with and create a poison that reproduces the effects. Use this poison to contaminate two of the three food supply points in the city.
translation: 查出我们最近中的是什么毒，然后制造一种能重现那种效果的毒药。用这种毒污染城中三个食物补给点中的两个。

english: Get away from my desk!
translation: 离我的书桌远点！

english: Keep at it. That gnome next door might be of some help.
translation: 继续努力。隔壁那个地精也许能帮上忙。

english: Get away from that chest.
translation: 离那个箱子远点。

english: Good work in the epidemic, give it a few days and the slave pens will be full again.
translation: 疫情干得不错，再过几天，奴隶围栏就会再次满员了。

english: What are you doing here human?
translation: 你在这里做什么，人类？

english: Good work, just one more to go then.
translation: 干得好，那就只剩一个了。

english: That I do. It is elvish tradition to plant a specially enchanted crystal seed at the graves of our ancestors. The seed will create guardians to protect the area.
translation: 没错。精灵族的传统是在祖先的墓穴中种下一颗经过特殊附魔的水晶种子。这颗种子会创造出守护者来保护这片区域。

english: Now, let me see... Hmm... Ah, there we go.
translation: 现在，让我看看……嗯……啊，找到了。

english: Unfortunately, the crystal seed must be tuned to the person it's protecting, a new seed won't do. But you should be able to recover the seed from her old tomb.
translation: 可惜的是，水晶种子必须与它所保护的人调谐，新的种子不行。但你应该能从她旧的墓穴中取回那颗种子。

english: Here you go... If you ever need to get back to Lletya, you can use this.
translation: 给你……如果你需要回到莱蒂亚村，可以用这个。

english: Now, I had better get going or Islwyn will get worried.
translation: 好了，我得走了，不然伊斯尔温会担心的。

english: Use it sparingly as it only has a few uses. If you need, I can re-enchant it, but I am not as talented as the singer who originally made this one.
translation: 省着点用，它只能用几次。如果需要，我可以重新附魔，但我的技艺不如最初制作它的那位歌者。

english: I'm not very familiar with the lands to the east so I couldn't tell you where her old tomb is I'm afraid.
translation: 我对东边的土地不太熟悉，所以恐怕无法告诉你她旧的墓穴在哪里。

english: I'm afraid you don't have enough money.
translation: 恐怕你的钱不够。

english: It's good to have you helping us. Do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystal?
translation: 很高兴有你帮忙。需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: Hey, how's it going? Have you managed to reconsecrate Glarial's resting place?
translation: 嘿，怎么样了？你成功重新祝圣格拉里亚尔的安息地了吗？

english: Very well. Arianwyn will be in Lletya, I can take you there.
translation: 很好。阿里安温会在莱蒂亚村，我可以带你去那里。

english: I understand you agreed to help us! This is good news indeed.
translation: 我知道你同意帮我们了！这真是个好消息。

english: I ask 150 coins to cover my costs.
translation: 我需要150金币来支付成本。

english: I ask 750 coins to cover my costs.

english: The Duke invited me here to help show the citizens that not all outsiders are evil.
translation: 公爵邀请我来这里，帮助向市民们展示并非所有外来者都是邪恶的。

english: I ask 150 coins for each crystal to cover my costs.
translation: 每颗水晶我需要150金币来支付成本。

english: You should be able to find it in her old resting place, I think you said it was south east of Baxtorian Falls. You'll need to defeat one of the old tomb's guardians to obtain it.
translation: 你应该能在她旧的安息地找到它，我记得你说过是在巴克斯托里安瀑布的东南方。你需要击败旧墓穴的一个守护者才能拿到它。

english: It's good to have you helping us. Do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystals?
translation: 很高兴有你帮忙。需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: Hey [player name], do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystals?
translation: 嘿 [player name]，需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: I understand you agreed to help us! This is wonderful news. Do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystal?
translation: 我知道你同意帮我们了！这真是个好消息。需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: I ask 600 coins to cover my costs.
translation: 我需要600金币来支付成本。

english: Perhaps another time, [player name].
translation: 也许下次吧，[player name]。

english: Bring it to me as soon as you find it, then I can re- enchant it.
translation: 找到后就立刻带给我，这样我就能重新附魔它。

english: I'm afraid not. I wouldn't want to make a scene by singing crystal in the middle of a party.
translation: 恐怕不行。我可不想在派对中间唱水晶之歌，引起骚动。

english: I'm not entirely sure how much of a help I can be, but if my presence helps reduce conflict, I'm more than happy to help.
translation: 我不太确定自己能帮上多大忙，但如果我的出现有助于减少冲突，我非常乐意帮忙。

english: What am I? I'm an elf! We don't often leave our homeland and outsiders rarely visit.
translation: 我是什么？我是精灵！我们不常离开家乡，外来者也很少来访。

english: I ask 450 coins to cover my costs.
translation: 我需要450金币来支付成本。

english: I understand you did not speak with Arianwyn while in the village, you really should.
translation: 我知道你在村子里没有和阿里安温说话，你真的应该去谈谈。

english: I'm sure you will if you ever visit our homeland.
translation: 我相信如果你去我们的家乡，你会见到的。

english: Silent? Perhaps it is to you humans, but there are others here who may hear it. If you want your teleport crystals enchanted, you'll have to meet me back in Prifddinas.
translation: 安静？也许对你们人类来说是如此，但这里有其他人可能听得见。如果你想附魔传送水晶，就得回普里夫迪纳斯城找我。

english: I'm not entirely sure how much of a help I can be, but if my presence helps reduce conflict, then I'm more than happy to help.
translation: 我不太确定自己能帮上多大忙，但如果我的出现有助于减少冲突，那么我非常乐意帮忙。

english: I ask 300 coins to cover my costs.
translation: 我需要300金币来支付成本。

english: I understand you agreed to help us! This is wonderful news. Do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystals?
