english: Silent? Perhaps it is to you humans, but there are others here who may hear it. If you want your teleport crystals enchanted, you'll have to meet me back in Tirannwn.
translation: 安静？也许对你们人类来说是如此，但这里有其他人可能听得见。如果你想附魔传送水晶，就得回提兰温找我。

english: I ask 750 coins for the first, and 600 for the second.
translation: 第一颗需要750金币，第二颗需要600金币。

english: I had better get going, bye.
translation: 我得走了，再见。

english: I'm afraid that's all you can afford.
translation: 恐怕你只能付得起这些。

english: Any time Arianwyn, how can I help this time?
translation: 随时恭候，阿里安温。这次需要我帮什么？

english: Thanks, but I have no need for that.
translation: 谢谢，但我不需要那个。

english: Fair enough, just let us know when you are.
translation: 好吧，准备好了就告诉我们。

english: I ask 750 coins for the first, 600 for the second, 450 for the third and 300 for the fourth. Beyond that the cost will be 150 coins each.
translation: 第一颗需要750金币，第二颗600，第三颗450，第四颗300。之后每颗150金币。

english: I ask 300 coins for the first. Beyond that the cost will be 150 coins each.
translation: 第一颗需要300金币。之后每颗150金币。

english: Lord Iorwerth's forces have arrived, you'd better see Baxtorian.
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主的人马已经到了，你最好去见巴克斯托里安。

english: I ask 600 coins for the first, 450 for the second and 300 for the third. Beyond that the cost will be 150 coins each.
translation: 第一颗需要600金币，第二颗450，第三颗300。之后每颗150金币。

english: I ask 450 coins for the first and 300 for the second.
translation: 第一颗需要450金币，第二颗300金币。

english: I ask 600 coins for the first, and 450 for the second.
translation: 第一颗需要600金币，第二颗450金币。

english: I ask 450 coins for the first and 300 for the second. Beyond that the cost will be 150 coins each.
translation: 第一颗需要450金币，第二颗300金币。之后每颗150金币。

english: Do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystal? It is important that you return there quickly.
translation: 需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？尽快回到那里很重要。

english: I ask 750 coins for the first, 600 for the second and 450 for the third.
translation: 第一颗需要750金币，第二颗600，第三颗450。

english: I ask 750 coins for the first, 600 for the second, 450 for the third and 300 for the fourth.
translation: 第一颗需要750金币，第二颗600，第三颗450，第四颗300。

english: Yes it is ready now, here.
translation: 是的，已经准备好了，给你。

english: Do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystals? It is important that you return there quickly.
translation: 需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？尽快回到那里很重要。

english: I ask 600 coins for the first, 450 for the second and 300 for the third.
translation: 第一颗需要600金币，第二颗450，第三颗300。

english: Hand the blackened crystal here then and I will take a look at it. I should be able to make a new one.
translation: 把黑化水晶递过来，我来看看。我应该能做一个新的。

english: Anyway, do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystal?
translation: 总之，需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: Hey there [player name]. Baxtorian's leading this meeting so you should let him know when you're ready to start.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。巴克斯托里安在主持这次会议，你准备好开始时就告诉他。

english: Well bring it to me as soon as you can, then I can re- enchant it.
translation: 那就尽快带给我，这样我就能重新附魔它。

english: Oops, what am I doing here?
translation: 哎呀，我在这里做什么？

english: Hey [player name], do you need me to re- enchant your teleport crystal?
translation: 嘿 [player name]，需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: Hey [player name], do you need me to re- enchant your teleport crystals?
translation: 嘿 [player name]，需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: Plant this seed in Glarial's new tomb, close to her remains and she will rest in peace.
translation: 把这颗种子种在格拉里亚尔的新墓穴里，靠近她的遗骸，她就能安息了。

english: That I do... It is elvish tradition to plant a specially enchanted crystal seed at the graves of our ancestors. The seed will create guardians to protect the area.
translation: 没错……精灵族的传统是在祖先的墓穴中种下一颗经过特殊附魔的水晶种子。这颗种子会创造出守护者来保护这片区域。

english: Unfortunately the crystal seed must be tuned to the person it's protecting... a new seed won't do. But you should be able to recover the seed from her old tomb.
translation: 可惜的是，水晶种子必须与它所保护的人调谐……新的种子不行。但你应该能从她旧的墓穴中取回那颗种子。

english: The tomb's guardian will be protecting the seed, you'll need to defeat him to get it. Once you have it, return here and I will re-enchant it.
translation: 墓穴的守护者会保护那颗种子，你需要击败他才能拿到。拿到后回到这里，我会重新附魔它。

english: I already know the resonance of that crystal, I have no need for another, thanks.
translation: 我已经知道那颗水晶的共鸣了，不需要另一颗，谢谢。

english: Very well. I'll sell you a brand new teleportation crystal for 750 gold. What do you say?
translation: 好吧。我卖你一颗全新的传送水晶，750金币。你觉得怎么样？

english: Well done... You should go see Islwyn, but I'd guess he already knows.
translation: 做得好……你应该去见伊斯尔温，不过我猜他已经知道了。

english: Hey... how's it going? Have you managed to reconsecrate Glarial's resting place?
translation: 嘿……怎么样了？你成功重新祝圣格拉里亚尔的安息地了吗？

english: You still have the charged seed with you, I can feel it. Hurry adventurer, go plant the seed and free my grandmother's spirit.
translation: 你身上还带着充能后的种子，我能感觉到。快去吧冒险者，去种下种子，解放我祖母的灵魂。

english: You leave them alone!
translation: 你离它们远点！

english: [player name] here has an old crystal sample, we need you to make a replacement for it.
translation: [player name] 这里有一块旧的水晶样本，我们需要你做一个替代品。

english: Anyway, do you need me to re-enchant your teleport crystals?
translation: 总之，需要我重新附魔你的传送水晶吗？

english: I'm sure you will want to get back to your king and tell him. He will undoubtedly want some proof. He should trust me enough in this matter, Give him this letter, it verifies that the job is done.
translation: 我相信你会想回去告诉你的国王。他无疑会想要一些证据。在这件事上他应该足够信任我。把这封信给他，它证明任务完成了。

english: He should be at Tyras's old camp. It's south east of here, just north of that poisoned lake. Once you've found the camp, come and let me know.
translation: 他应该在泰拉斯的旧营地。就在这里的东南方，那个毒湖的北边。找到营地后，来告诉我一声。

english: Well you should. Once you have, let me know if you have any questions.
translation: 嗯，你应该。找到后，如果有任何问题就告诉我。

english: Ahh [player name]. Good day, sorry I cannot stop to talk. So much to do, so little time.
translation: 啊，[player name]。你好，抱歉我不能停下来聊天。事情太多，时间太少。

english: Ahh [player name], good day. Sorry, can't stop to talk. So much to do, so little time.
translation: 啊，[player name]，你好。抱歉，不能停下来聊天。事情太多，时间太少。

english: Just show him the pendant I gave you.
translation: 把我给你的吊坠给他看就行了。

english: Keep at it. Let me know if you have any questions.
translation: 继续努力。如果有任何问题就告诉我。

english: It is lucky I had a scribe make a few copies is it not?
translation: 幸好我让抄写员做了几份副本，不是吗？

english: What are you doing here?! You will ruin everything... Get back to Ardougne now!
translation: 你在这里做什么？！你会毁了一切...马上回阿多尼城去！

english: Ask my tracker, he may be able to help there.
translation: 问问我的追踪者，他也许能帮上忙。

english: Thank you friend. Don't forget your disguise.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友。别忘了你的伪装。

english: I don't have an exact plan for you I'm afraid. You know the city better than any of us so are best placed to make a plan yourself.
translation: 恐怕我没法给你一个确切的计划。你比我们任何人都更了解这座城市，所以最好由你自己来制定计划。

english: [player name], what is the latest news?
translation: [player name]，有什么最新消息？

english: This isn't good, it will only be a matter of time before they discover the temple.
translation: 这可不妙，他们发现神殿只是时间问题。

english: It should be quite simple. Once you have powered up the newly formed crystal, you will need to return to the blackened crystal and place the new shard with the others. This should restore the safeguards.
translation: 应该很简单。一旦你为新形成的水晶充能，你需要返回黑化水晶处，将新的碎片与其他碎片放在一起。这样就能恢复防护措施。

english: That is not surprising, he is not particularly fond of humans. But if you've earnt his trust, it proves to me that I was right to take a chance on you.
translation: 这并不奇怪，他并不特别喜欢人类。但如果你赢得了他的信任，这向我证明了我冒险信任你是正确的。

english: This isn't the end by any means. The Iorwerth forces are still at large and we are not strong enough to stop them. However, with the temple secure, the main threat has been dealt with.
translation: 这绝不是说结束。伊尔沃斯的部队仍然逍遥法外，而我们的实力不足以阻止他们。不过，既然神殿安全了，主要威胁已经消除。

english: However, as I said before, there have been sightings of mourners crossing the Arandar mountain pass. I'm sure you can take advantage of that.
translation: 不过，正如我之前所说，有目击到哀悼者穿过阿兰达山隘。我相信你可以利用这一点。

english: Many years ago, all elves lived in harmony within the crystal city of Prifddinas alongside our goddess, Seren.
translation: 许多年前，所有精灵都与我们的女神塞伦和谐地生活在普里夫迪纳斯城的水晶之城中。

english: That's good to hear, I can see why you managed to earn Islwyn's trust.
translation: 听到这个很好，我明白你为什么能赢得伊斯卢温的信任了。

english: First, I need you to return to the temple and find the crystal that is powering the safeguards. As they are no longer working, I expect the crystal will be black in colour.
translation: 首先，我需要你回到神殿，找到为防护措施提供能量的水晶。既然它们已经失效，我预计那块水晶会是黑色的。

english: I can't offer much of a reward I'm afraid. However, I did have Eluned make this for you. It should allow you to bypass the defences on the temple.
translation: 恐怕我给不了太多报酬。不过，我让埃卢内德为你制作了这个。它应该能让你绕过神殿的防御。

english: When the God Wars ended, Seren was lost to us. For the first time, we were alone. To lead us through those difficult times, Baxtorian Cadarn was named the first king of the elves.
translation: 当神战结束时，塞伦离我们而去。我们第一次孤身无援。为了带领我们度过那段艰难时期，巴克斯托里安.卡达恩被命名为精灵的第一位国王。

english: Even still, I can't see Lord Iorwerth discovering this tunnel any time soon. For now, he should have no way to summon the Dark Lord.
translation: 即便如此，我不认为伊尔沃斯领主短期内会发现这条隧道。目前他应该没有办法召唤黑暗之主。

english: Anyway, with Baxtorian gone and Prifddinas lost, our land erupted into a Civil War. We've been fighting ever since.
translation: 总之，巴克斯托里安离去，普里夫迪纳斯城失落，我们的土地爆发了内战。从那以后我们一直在战斗。

english: During that time, Lord Iorwerth turned away from Seren and pledged himself to Zamorak, the Dark Lord.
translation: 在那期间，伊尔沃斯领主背离了塞伦，向黑暗之主扎莫拉克效忠。

english: Baxtorian tried to take it back from him, but Prifddinas was built to survive the God Wars. There was no way to retake it.
translation: 巴克斯托里安试图从他手中夺回，但普里夫迪纳斯城是为抵御神战而建的。根本无法重新夺回。

english: In a last attempt to keep the city safe, Baxtorian and the clan elders sung the song of inversion which reverted the entire city into a crystal seed.
translation: 为了保护城市安全的最后一次尝试中，巴克斯托里安和氏族长老们唱起了逆转之歌，将整座城市变回了一颗水晶种子。

english: A larger kingdom meant our forces were further spread. Lord Iorwerth took advantage of that. He claimed Prifddinas as his own.
translation: 更大的王国意味着我们的力量更加分散。伊尔沃斯领主利用了这一点。他宣称普里夫迪纳斯城归他所有。

english: Under Baxtorian, our kingdom expanded into the east. We prospered for a time, but little did we know that an enemy walked among us.
translation: 在巴克斯托里安的领导下，我们的王国向东扩张。我们一度繁荣昌盛，但我们却不知道敌人就在我们中间。

english: Return to the Mourner Headquarters and gain access to their mine. Once there, see what you can discover about the Temple of Light.
translation: 返回哀悼者总部，进入他们的矿井。到了那里，看看你能发现关于光之神殿的什么信息。

english: This is good news indeed [player name]. That should stop anyone from entering for another thousand years.
translation: 这确实是个好消息，[player name]。这应该能阻止任何人再进入一千年。

english: This isn't the end by any means. Lord Iorwerth is still at large and our forces are not large enough to stop him. However, with the temple secure, the main threat has been dealt with.
translation: 这绝不是说结束。伊尔沃斯领主仍然逍遥法外，而且我们的兵力不足以阻止他。不过，既然神殿安全了，主要威胁已经消除。

english: Take it to the end of the temple and power it up by placing it on the altar. Once that's done, return to the blackened crystal and place the new shard with the others. This should restore the safeguards.
translation: 把它带到神殿尽头，放在祭坛上充能。完成后，返回黑化水晶处，将新的碎片与其他碎片放在一起。这样就能恢复防护措施。

english: I do suspect we are still safe though. I imagine Lord Iorwerth and his forces won't be hurrying into the Underground Pass any time soon.
translation: 不过我确实怀疑我们仍然安全。我想伊尔沃斯领主和他的部队不会很快匆忙进入地下通道。

english: First of all, we need to know how close the Iorwerth elves are to finding it. Do you think you're ready for this?
translation: 首先，我们需要知道伊尔沃斯的精灵们离找到它还有多远。你觉得你准备好了吗？

english: Anyway, you have done well [player name]. With the safeguards restored, Lord Iorwerth has no way to summon the Dark Lord.
translation: 总之，你干得很好，[player name]。防护措施已经恢复，伊尔沃斯领主无法召唤黑暗之主了。

english: Very well. We need you to return to the Mourner Headquarters and gain access to their mine. Once there, see what you can discover about the temple.
translation: 很好。我们需要你返回哀悼者总部，进入他们的矿井。到了那里，看看你能发现关于神殿的什么信息。

english: We should gather the others and decide our next steps. Could you fetch Ysgawyn for me. He's probably on the upper platforms. You should bring your friend Elena as well. I'm not sure where she is I'm afraid, Ysgawyn
translation: 我们应该召集其他人，决定下一步行动。你能帮我把伊斯卡温叫来吗？他可能在上层平台上。你也应该带上你的朋友埃琳娜。恐怕我不确定她在哪里，伊斯卡温

english: might know though.
translation: 可能知道。

english: Hmm... Well you can try asking our local seamstress, Oronwen, about them.
translation: 嗯……你可以试试问问我们当地的裁缝奥罗文关于它们的事。

english: [player name], do you have that sample yet?
translation: [player name]，你有那个样本了吗？

english: Just a second, I will summon Eluned again.
translation: 稍等一下，我再召唤埃卢内德。

english: Good job finding Lord Amlodd. You still need to find Lady Trahaearn though. Speak to Baxtorian, he can tell you about the clue Lady Trahaearn left behind.
translation: 找到阿姆洛德领主做得很好。不过你还需要找到特拉赫恩女士。和巴克斯托里安谈谈，他可以告诉你关于特拉赫恩女士留下的线索。

english: Well I have another, here.
translation: 嗯，我还有一个，给你。

english: Thank you for responding to my summons again Eluned.
translation: 谢谢你再次响应我的召唤，埃卢内德。

english: Ah [player name], there you are. It's good to see you well.
translation: 啊，[player name]，你来了。很高兴看到你安好。

english: It seems that [player name] here misplaced that crystal. Could you make him another copy?
translation: 看来这里的[player name]把那个水晶放错地方了。你能为他再做一份吗？

english: Hmm... Well you can try asking our local seamstress, Oronwen, about the trousers.
translation: 嗯……你可以试试问问我们当地的裁缝奥罗文关于那条裤子的事。

english: Ah, a disguise. Good thinking. Use it to enter the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne. Once your in, see if you can find out what they are doing in the city.
translation: 啊，伪装。好主意。用它进入西阿多尼城的哀悼者总部。一旦进去，看看你能不能查明他们在这座城市里做什么。

english: As for the top, you'll need to find a way to get it cleaned. Maybe you can find someone who does a lot of laundry. Someone who wears lots of white might be a good bet.
translation: 至于上衣，你需要想办法把它洗干净。也许你能找到一个经常洗衣服的人。穿很多白色衣服的人可能是个不错的选择。

english: You should fetch your friend Elena. I'm not sure where she is I'm afraid, Ysgawyn might know though.
translation: 你应该去叫你的朋友埃琳娜。恐怕我不确定她在哪里，不过伊斯卡温可能知道。

english: Ah, a disguise. Good thinking. Put it on and head to the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne. Once your in, see if you can find out what they are doing in the city.
translation: 啊，伪装。好主意。穿上它，前往西阿多尼城的哀悼者总部。一旦进去，看看你能不能查明他们在这座城市里做什么。

english: Don't take too long. Remember, you need to search the temple for a blackened crystal. Once you find it, bring a sample of it back here.
translation: 别花太长时间。记住，你需要搜索神殿寻找一块黑化水晶。一旦找到，带一份样本回来。

english: It seems that [player name] here misplaced that crystal. Could you make her another copy?
translation: 看来这里的[player name]把那个水晶放错地方了。你能为她再做一份吗？

english: Great, bring it here and we'll get started.
translation: 太好了，把它带到这里，我们就可以开始了。

english: Very good, let me know when you discover something.
translation: 很好，发现什么就告诉我。

english: Good job finding Lady Trahaearn. You still need to find Lord Amlodd though. Speak to Baxtorian, he can tell you about the clue Lord Amlodd left behind.
translation: 找到特拉赫恩女士做得很好。不过你还需要找到阿姆洛德领主。和巴克斯托里安谈谈，他可以告诉你关于阿姆洛德领主留下的线索。

english: them for us.
translation: 为我们处理它们。

english: Indeed we do. Baxtorian's knowledge allowed [player name] to reunite us with Lord Amlodd and Lady Trahaearn. It was the Amlodd clan that created those defences, Lord Amlodd can overcome
translation: 确实如此。巴克斯托里安的知识让[player name]使我们与阿姆洛德领主和特拉赫恩女士重聚。正是阿姆洛德氏族创造了那些防御设施，阿姆洛德领主能够克服

english: You should give that crystal sample to Eluned.
translation: 你应该把那块水晶样本交给埃卢内德。

english: You don't have any inventory space for another.
translation: 你的背包没有空间再放一个了。

english: Hmm... You'll need to find a way to get it cleaned. Maybe you can find someone who does a lot of laundry. Someone who wears lots of white might be a good bet.
translation: 嗯……你需要想办法把它洗干净。也许你能找到一个经常洗衣服的人。穿很多白色衣服的人可能是个不错的选择。

english: Once Eluned has made the replacement crystal, come and talk to me. I will explain what you must do with it.
translation: 一旦埃卢内德制好了替换水晶，过来和我谈谈。我会解释你必须用它做什么。

english: Are you the human by the [player name] name?
translation: 你是那个叫[player name]的人类吗？

english: You'd never have got this far without [player name], maybe you should start trusting them.
translation: 没有[player name]，你永远走不到这一步，也许你应该开始信任他们。

english: Lord Iorwerth's forces approach. Are you ready?
translation: 伊尔沃斯领主的军队逼近了。你准备好了吗？

english: Yes, General Hining has given us the full support of the Tyras forces. Sadly though, the new King of Ardougne does not wish to assist us.
translation: 是的，希宁将军已给予我们泰拉斯军队的全力支持。但遗憾的是，阿多尼城的新国王不愿协助我们。

english: The Amlodd clan is a clan of mystics. Some sort of magic may be key to finding Lord Amlodd. That crystal seed I gave you might also be of use, Lord Amlodd gave it to me before we went our seperate ways.
translation: 阿姆洛德部族是一个神秘主义者部族。某种魔法可能是找到阿姆洛德领主的关键。我给你的那颗水晶种子或许也有用，那是阿姆洛德领主在我们分道扬镳前给我的。

english: The Meilyr clan is a clan of scientists and explorers. You'll probably need to do some exploring yourself to find Lady Meilyr. Hopefully that scroll I gave you will be of use.
translation: 梅利尔部族是一个由科学家和探索者组成的部族。你可能需要亲自探索一番才能找到梅利尔女士。希望我给你的那卷卷轴能派上用场。

english: You should try and find Lady Hefin. She could be of big help to us in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 你应该试着找到赫芬女士。她能在对抗伊尔沃斯领主的战斗中帮上大忙。

english: Before we begin, one of the scouts has some of your items. You'll find them on the platforms above.
translation: 在我们开始之前，一名侦察兵拿了一些你的物品。你会在上方的平台上找到它们。

english: It wasn't all good though. Seren was remarkable, but under the surface, she hid a great pain. For a long time, I wondered what it was. Thanks to you, we now finally know.
translation: 不过也并非全是好事。塞伦很出色，但在表面之下，她隐藏着巨大的痛苦。很长一段时间，我都不知道那是什么。多亏了你，我们现在终于知道了。

english: It makes sense I suppose. We all have our demons, even the gods. Seren was a beacon of light in this grim world, but the brightest light casts the darkest shadow, and none shone brighter than her.
translation: 我想这很合理。我们都有自己的心魔，即使是神也不例外。塞伦是这个阴暗世界中的一束光明信标，但最亮的光会投下最暗的影，而没有任何光比她的更亮。

english: I... I think I failed them. I had the chance to stop this, to stop everything that has happened. But I cared more about my Glarial than I did for them, and they all bled because of it.
translation: 我……我想我辜负了他们。我本有机会阻止这一切，阻止所发生的所有事。但我更在乎我的格莱瑞尔，而不是他们，而他们都因此流血牺牲。

english: We can end this war, but we can never right the wrongs of the past. This world will bear the scars of my actions forever.
translation: 我们可以结束这场战争，但永远无法纠正过去的错误。这个世界将永远承载着我行为的伤疤。

english: To be honest, until recently I knew little of him. When I left Prifddinas to expand our kingdom into the east, he was but a child, with the Iorwerth clan ruled by his mother.
translation: 说实话，直到最近我对他了解甚少。当我离开普里夫迪纳斯城向东扩张我们的王国时，他还只是个孩子，伊尔沃斯部族由他的母亲统治。

english: You should try and find Lord Crwys. He could be of big help to us in the fight against Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 你应该试着找到克鲁伊斯领主。他能在对抗伊尔沃斯领主的战斗中帮上大忙。

english: I was a fool. Deep down I think I knew I would never see her again. But I couldn't accept that, and my people suffered because I couldn't let go.
translation: 我是个傻瓜。内心深处我想我知道再也见不到她了。但我无法接受，而我的子民因为我不肯放手而受苦。

english: Have you found Ysgawyn yet?
translation: 你找到伊斯卡温了吗？

english: Please hurry. We need to find out what he's up to.
translation: 请快一点。我们需要弄清楚他想干什么。

english: My distillator, I can't test any plague samples without it. They're holding it in the Mourner Headquarters in West Ardougne.
translation: 我的蒸馏器，没有它我就没法检测任何瘟疫样本。他们把它扣在西阿多尼城的哀悼者总部里。

english: Perfect. Well get yourself some naphtha and some mashed rotten apples and mix them together. Once you've done that, strain out any solids.
translation: 完美。那你去找些石脑油和捣碎的烂苹果，把它们混在一起。弄好之后，把固体滤掉。

english: Right then, the first thing to do is mash up a lot of rotten apples, then you will need to dissolve the toxin into a liquid that has a very low evaporation point, some form of solvent.
translation: 好，首先要把大量烂苹果捣碎，然后你需要把毒素溶解到一种蒸发点很低的液体里，也就是某种溶剂。

english: Hmm... That sounds like they were ill from some sort of toxin. I imagine it was a mould of some sort that had the effect, not the rotten apple itself. What do you need it for?
translation: 嗯...听起来他们像是中了某种毒素。我想是某种霉菌起了作用，而不是烂苹果本身。你要它做什么？

english: You'd better be right about this, and I'd better make sure you get this toxin right so no one dies!
translation: 你最好是对的，而且我最好确保你弄对这份毒素，这样才不会有人死！

english: Ick... Alright then, let's get started.
translation: 呃……好吧，那我们开始吧。

english: Well I'm not going anywhere.
translation: 我哪儿也不去。

english: His loyalty? What's going on?
translation: 他的忠诚？怎么回事？

english: I don't know as much about those kinds of chemicals but I believe naphtha will be perfect for this.
translation: 我对这类化学品了解不多，但我相信石脑油会很适合。

english: Okay, I've managed to isolate a small sample of the toxin. It's a byproduct of the mould that grows on these apples, it's not fatal so a counteractant shouldn't be necessary.
translation: 好了，我成功分离出了一小份毒素样本。它是生长在这些苹果上的霉菌的副产品，不致命，所以应该不需要解毒剂。

english: Bring me a sample of rotten apple to examine. I'll also see if I can make a counteractant for the toxin.
translation: 给我带一份烂苹果样本让我检查。我也会看看能不能做出这种毒素的解毒剂。

english: Finally, heat the mixture to evaporate off the solvent. Be careful of naked flames as the solvent will be highly flammable.
translation: 最后，加热混合物以蒸发掉溶剂。注意明火，因为溶剂高度易燃。

english: How big is the store that you're going to affect?
translation: 你要影响的仓库有多大？

english: Right, the first thing to do is mash up a lot of rotten apples. You'll probably be able to do that at the orchard just north of the city. I hear no one has tended it since the blight infected the trees there.
translation: 好，首先要把大量烂苹果捣碎。你大概可以在城北的果园里做这件事。我听说自从枯萎病感染了那里的树之后，就没人照料了。

english: Huh? Oh hello. I just can't get used to a friend being dressed as a mourner.
translation: 嗯？哦，你好。我就是不习惯朋友穿着哀悼者的衣服。

english: Yeah, it scares me what might have happened if he didn't.
translation: 是啊，想到要是他没这么做会发生什么，我就害怕。

english: Hey [player name]. It's good to see you safe, things got pretty intense back there.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。看到你平安真好，刚才那里情况挺紧张的。

english: Next, you'll want to get yourself some naphtha and mix it with the rotten apples. You mentioned the chemist in Rimmington helped you with naphtha before. You might want to speak to him again.
translation: 接下来，你要弄些石脑油，和烂苹果混在一起。你之前提过里明顿村的化学家帮过你弄石脑油。你可能得再去找他谈谈。

english: Once that's done, use the sieve I gave you to strain out any solids. Finally, heat the mixture to evaporate off the solvent. Be careful of naked flames as the solvent will be highly flammable.
translation: 完成后，用我给你的筛子滤掉所有固体。最后，加热混合物以蒸发掉溶剂。注意明火，因为溶剂高度易燃。

english: Hello friend. Any luck finding my distillator?
translation: 你好，朋友。找到我的蒸馏器了吗？

english: Speak to Jerico, he might be able to help you cross the wall. He lives in a house south east of here, north of the chapel.
translation: 去找杰里科谈谈，他也许能帮你翻过那堵墙。他住在这里东南方的一栋房子里，在礼拜堂北边。

english: You're right, it just makes me feel uncomfortable, all of this. It's good to know I'm not alone in that though.
translation: 你说得对，只是这一切让我觉得很不舒服。不过知道不是只有我这么想，感觉好多了。

english: I'll keep an eye on the patch while it grows. You should check in with Arianwyn and Baxtorian in the meantime.
translation: 我会在它生长期间留意这块地。你 meantime 应该去找阿里安温和巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: Yes, I saw. Quickly, meet with Jerico's friends and cross the wall before the pigeons fly off.
translation: 是的，我看到了。快，在鸽子飞走之前，去和杰里科的朋友们会合，翻过那堵墙。

english: Is this connected to your work with the king?
translation: 这和你为国王做的工作有关吗？

english: Fair enough, you be careful out there.
translation: 有道理，你在外面小心点。

english: Hmm... That's not my area I'm afraid. I'd recommend speaking to the chemist in Rimmington instead.
translation: 嗯……恐怕这不是我的领域。我建议你去和里明顿村的化学家谈谈。

english: Anyway, did you need something?
translation: 总之，你需要什么吗？

english: Hey [player name]. I think Baxtorian wants to talk to you.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。我觉得巴克斯托里安想和你谈谈。

english: Come back soon [player name].
translation: 早点回来 [player name]。

english: You should get out of here, it's probably best you're not around when I escape. You should head back to my father.
translation: 你应该离开这里，我逃跑的时候你最好不在场。你应该回去找我父亲。

english: So have you found out what those mourners are up to yet?
translation: 那么，你查出那些哀悼者在搞什么鬼了吗？

english: Hey. The elder cadantine herb grew perfectly. Let's get it harvested.
translation: 嘿。高阶卡丹丁草长得非常好。我们去收割吧。

english: Was he able to help?
translation: 他能帮上忙吗？

english: It doesn't look like you need any more.
translation: 看起来你不需要更多了。

english: Hey. Lord Iorwerth's forces are approaching, you'd better go see Baxtorian.
translation: 嘿。伊尔沃斯领主的人马正在逼近，你最好去找巴克斯托里安。

english: Hey [player name], good to see you. I think Baxtorian wants to talk to you.
translation: 嘿 [player name]，见到你真好。我觉得巴克斯托里安想和你谈谈。

english: Hmm, could be tricky.
translation: 嗯，可能有点棘手。

english: Anyway, I won't keep you, I'm sure you've got things to do. See you later.
translation: 总之，我就不耽误你了，你肯定有事要忙。回头见。

english: Hey [player name]. Thanks for the talk earlier, it meant a lot. Anyway, I won't keep you, I'm sure you've got things to do. See you later.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。谢谢刚才的谈话，对我意义重大。总之，我就不耽误你了，你肯定有事要忙。回头见。

english: Hey [player name]. I won't keep you, I'm sure you've got things to do. See you later.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。我就不耽误你了，你肯定有事要忙。回头见。

english: Anyway, I'm sure you've got things to do. I won't keep you.
translation: 总之，你肯定有事要忙。我就不耽误你了。

english: You shouldn't creep up on people in all that gear... Where was I... Oh yes...
translation: 你不该穿着那身装备悄悄接近别人...我说到哪了...哦，对了...

english: Hey [player name]. Thanks for the talk earlier, it meant a lot.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。谢谢刚才的谈话，对我意义重大。

english: Hey [player name]. Good luck in the library. We'll talk more when you get back.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。祝你在图书馆里好运。等你回来我们再详谈。

english: Well be careful, that toxin is nasty stuff!
translation: 小心点，那毒素可不是闹着玩的！

english: Like I said, you should speak to the chemist in Rimmington. This isn't my area.
translation: 就像我说的，你应该去找里明顿村的化学家谈谈。这不是我的领域。

english: Hey. Do you have that seed yet?
translation: 嘿。你拿到那颗种子了吗？

english: Hey [player name]. You should probably go talk to Lord Amlodd.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。你大概该去和阿姆洛德领主谈谈。

english: [player name]! How's it going?
translation: [player name]！最近怎么样？

english: Hmm... That's not my area I'm afraid. I'd reccomend speaking to the chemist in Rimmington instead.
translation: 嗯……恐怕这不是我的领域。我建议你去和里明顿村的化学家谈谈。

english: Hey [player name], good to see you. I won't keep you, I'm sure you've got things to do. See you later.
translation: 嘿 [player name]，见到你真好。我就不耽误你了，你肯定有事要忙。回头见。

english: Hey [player name]. You should talk to Baxtorian when you're ready to begin.
translation: 嘿 [player name]。你准备好开始的时候，应该去找巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: That's good to know. Anyway, on that note, I should let you get off. I'm sure Baxtorian will need your help deciding the next move. We'll talk later.
translation: 知道这点很好。总之，说到这个，我该让你走了。我相信巴克斯托里安需要你帮忙决定下一步行动。我们回头再聊。

english: Not too bad, all things considered. I worry about what happens now though.
translation: 总的来说，还不算太糟。但我担心接下来会发生什么。

english: The Void Knight was killed, another of our Order has fallen and that Island is lost.
translation: 虚空骑士被杀了，我们骑士团又倒下了一位，那座岛屿也沦陷了。

english: Of course, my lady. But I must tell you the rules first. Would you like to hear them now?
translation: 当然，女士。但我必须先告诉你规则。你想现在听吗？

english: Good day, my lady. Is there anything I can do for you?
translation: 日安，女士。有什么我可以为你效劳的吗？

english: Greetings, my lord. Have you returned to finish your training?
translation: 你好，大人。你是回来完成训练的吗？

english: Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my lady. Fight in the training ground and earn your reward to find out!
translation: 啊，耐心是骑士的美德，女士。在训练场战斗并赢得奖励就知道了！

english: Very good. Remember: no magic, no ranged, no prayer. You will begin fighting with the last knight you were fighting when you left. If you die, you will keep your items and be returned safely here.
translation: 很好。记住：禁止魔法、禁止远程、禁止祈祷。你将从上次离开时最后战斗的那位骑士开始。如果你死了，你会保留物品并安全返回这里。

english: Congratulations on succeeding in the Knight Waves, my lady.
translation: 恭喜成功通过骑士浪潮，女士。

english: I'm afraid not, my lady. Once you have won, you cannot re-enter.
translation: 恐怕不行，女士。一旦你获胜，就不能再进入了。

english: Let us begin...
translation: 让我们开始吧……

english: I'm not a hundred percent sure the Imcando tribe exists anymore.
translation: 我不太确定伊姆坎多部落是否还存在。

english: Greetings, my lady. Have you returned to finish your training?
translation: 你好，女士。你是回来完成训练的吗？

english: I'm sorry, my lady, but you cannot enter this area.
translation: 抱歉，女士，但你不能进入这个区域。

english: Cats are not allowed in the Knight Waves. You'll need to put it away if you wish to enter.
translation: 骑士浪潮不允许带猫。如果你想进入，必须把猫收起来。

english: Can I help you, sir?
translation: 需要帮忙吗，先生？

english: Can I help you, madam?
translation: 需要帮忙吗，女士？

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard, sir. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission, even with a knight such as yourself.
translation: 在监视那些帝国守卫，先生。我们不能信任他们，你知道的。但我不该谈论他的任务，即使是对像您这样的骑士。

english: I'm having a break, sir. Though I admit I'm feeling a bit discouraged - I've served for years, and worked really hard, but I don't seem any closer to becoming a knight.
translation: 我正在休息，先生。虽然我承认有点沮丧——我服务多年，工作努力，但似乎离成为骑士还遥遥无期。

english: Thank you! Can I have it?
translation: 谢谢！我能要吗？

english: Congratulations! You managed to destroy all the portals! We've awarded you 4 Void Knight Commendation points. Please also accept these coins as a reward.
translation: 恭喜！你成功摧毁了所有传送门！我们奖励你4点虚空骑士嘉奖积分。另外请收下这些金币作为奖励。

english: Well could you go and get it for me then please? Quickly?
translation: 那你能去帮我拿来吗？快点？

english: Very well, perhaps another time.
translation: 好吧，也许下次吧。

english: Keeping an eye on those Imperial Guard, madam. We can't trust 'em, you know. But I shouldn't talk about his mission, even with a knight such as yourself.
translation: 在监视那些帝国守卫，女士。我们不能信任他们，你知道的。但我不该谈论他的任务，即使是对像您这样的骑士。

english: I'm having a break, madam. Though I admit I'm feeling a bit discouraged - I've served for years, and worked really hard, but I don't seem any closer to becoming a knight.

english: Well done, the Void Knight managed to complete the ritual and the portals were all closed. We've awarded you 3 Void Knight Commendation points. Please also accept these coins as a reward.

english: I simply cannot match the Shaikahan's agility!
translation: 我根本跟不上沙伊卡汉狮的敏捷！

english: ... and it does seem extremely sick!
translation: ……而且它看起来确实病得很重！

english: I have no need for that now.
translation: 我现在不需要那个。

english: I have no interest in your weapons right now. Only slaying the Shaikahan.
translation: 我现在对你的武器没兴趣。我只想杀掉沙伊卡汉狮。

english: I have no interest in your potions right now. Only slaying the Shaikahan.
translation: 我现在对你的药水没兴趣。我只想杀掉沙伊卡汉狮。

english: ... but it does seem extremely sick!
translation: ……但它看起来确实病得很重！

english: Bwana, I feel more than agile enough to slay the Shaikahan.
translation: 主人，我觉得我足够敏捷，可以杀掉沙伊卡汉狮了。

english: Oh Bwana, I am sorry but you do not have enough space for my gift.
translation: 哦主人，很抱歉，但你的空间不够放我的礼物。

english: Thank you Bwana, but I have all the seaweed I need.
translation: 谢谢主人，但我已经有足够的海藻了。

english: That is but an illusion. I still feel his evil in the wind. I must kill the Shaikahan myself.
translation: 那不过是幻觉。我仍然能感受到风中的邪恶。我必须亲自杀掉沙伊卡汉狮。

english: It's monkey skin.
translation: 那是猴皮。

english: You'll want to give that to my brother, Tinsay. He likes that sort of thing.
translation: 你想把它给我弟弟廷赛。他喜欢那类东西。

english: The Shaikahan will die only by the spear, as in the legends of my ancestors!
translation: 沙伊卡汉狮只会死于长矛之下，就像我祖先传说中的那样！

english: No thanks, Bwana.
translation: 不了谢谢，主人。

english: ... and  it seems [player name] healing too quickly!
translation: ……而且[player name]似乎恢复得太快了！

english: ... but  it does seem quite sick! Perhaps another poison would be more effective?
translation: ……但它看起来确实病得不轻！也许另一种毒药会更有效？

english: I'm canoeing on the river! It's enormous fun!  Would you like to know how?
translation: 我在河上划独木舟！非常好玩！你想知道怎么划吗？

english: My no good son here seems to have taken a holiday instead of caring for his father like any good son would. Can you do something for me instead?
translation: 我那个不孝的儿子，放着该照顾父亲的正事不做，跑去度假了。你能帮我做点事吗？

english: Why you useless little human! I should thrown you in the Kelda! With a lump of granite attached to your feet!
translation: 你这个没用的渺小人类！我真该把你扔进凯尔达河里！再在你脚上绑块大花岗岩！
