translation: 站点继续营业。

english: I don't live here all the time, you know! I was back home in Al Kharid last night.
translation: 我又不是一直住在这里！昨晚我回阿尔卡里德城的家了。

english: I'm totally clueless, although it may have something to do with Sophanem, word has it that there has been some strange goings on there, something to do with Icthlarin's priests.
translation: 我完全不了解，不过可能跟索法尼恩城有关，听说那里发生了一些怪事，跟伊克塔林的神庙祭司有关。

english: It would be a shame to make you walk for lack of 25 gold coins. Very well, 75GP it is.
translation: 让你因为缺25金币而走路，那太可惜了。好吧，就75金币。

english: And a while ago a big group of dark wizards arrived here. I haven't seen them leave though - they must have set up shop in that abandoned temple.
translation: 不久前，一大群黑暗魔法师来到这里。不过我还没见他们离开——他们肯定在那座废弃的庙宇里安了窝。

english: Yes, I remember that. Eight carpets in a line, with a wizard on each. They were dressed all in black too, not the best clothes for the desert!
translation: 是啊，我记得。八张飞毯排成一列，每张上面坐着一个魔法师。他们也都穿着黑色衣服，在沙漠里可不是最好的衣服！

english: There was something odd about their leader. He gave me the creeps.
translation: 他们的首领有点古怪。他让我觉得毛骨悚然。

english: I couldn't tell you. He hasn't been around here for a while.
translation: 我说不上来。他有一阵子没来过这儿了。

english: Come back anytime
translation: 随时欢迎再来。

english: Oh, I've heard of the curse. Some of the locals have spoken about it too me. I don't know why it would have happened though.
translation: 哦，我听说过那个诅咒术。有些当地人跟我提过。但我不知道为什么会发生这种事。

english: I'd tell you more, but my throat is drying up and my lips are dry. This desert climate is an inhospitable one. Get me another beer so that I can continue.
translation: 我本想多说点，但我的喉咙发干，嘴唇也干裂了。这沙漠气候真不适合居住。再给我弄杯啤酒，我才能继续说下去。

english: I happen to know that you are looking for somebody.
translation: 我碰巧知道你在找什么人。

english: I don't know exactly, he disappeared last week, either those Bandits or Menaphites have something to do with it. Perhaps their feuding has something to do with it, perhaps if you were to solve that problem...
translation: 具体我也不清楚，他上周失踪了。要么是那些强盗，要么是梅纳菲特人参与了。也许是他们的争斗有关，如果你能解决那个问题……

english: But my lips are dry, how can I possibly continue?
translation: 但我嘴唇太干了，怎么继续下去呢？

english: Now is that his nephew from his side or his wife's? They have a huge family you see. I remember.......
translation: 那是他这边的侄子，还是他老婆那边的？他们家可大了，你知道吗。我记得……

english: It's yourself again, isn't it?
translation: 又是你，对吧？

english: That's kind of getting a little deep for me, existential reasoning or justification was never my strong suit. So what can I do for you?
translation: 这对我来说有点太深奥了，存在主义的推理或论证从来不是我的强项。那么我能为你做些什么呢？

english: Well you're not here sightseeing, that's for certain. Anyway it's not really important how I know what I know. What is important is that I know all about the person you're looking for.
translation: 你肯定不是来观光的。总之，我怎么知道的并不重要。重要的是，我对你找的那个人了如指掌。

english: I've known him since he was a wee lad. A right little mischievous beggar....
translation: 我从小就认识他。真是个调皮的小乞丐……

english: Well now, if you had just asked me about that in the first place I would have told you directly.
translation: 哎呀，如果你一开始就问那个问题，我早就直接告诉你了。

english: Anyway is there any chance of another beer?
translation: 总之，还有机会再来杯啤酒吗？

english: Ahh, a kind stranger. Get this old man a drink so that he may wet his throat and tell you of strange happenings in this town.
translation: 啊，好心的陌生人。给这老头弄杯喝的，让他润润喉咙，然后告诉你镇上发生的怪事。

english: What were we talking about again? Yes yes, when I was a boy..... no that's not it.
translation: 我们刚才说到哪儿了？对对，我小时候……不对，不是这个。

english: Get this old man another drink so that he may wet his lips and continue.
translation: 再给这老头弄杯喝的，让他润润嘴唇继续说下去。

english: I've got a lovely bunch of coconuts, doobidy do.
translation: 我有一串可爱的椰子，嘟比嘟嘟。

english: What you looking at.
translation: 看什么呢。

english: You know, I have this friend, and he.... I can't remember. What was I saying?
translation: 你知道吗，我有这么一个朋友，他……我记不起来了。我刚才说什么来着？

english: Thank you my friend - now if you don't mind I'm having a conversation with my imaginary friend Bob here.
translation: 谢谢你，我的朋友——现在如果你不介意的话，我正在和我想象中的朋友鲍勃聊天呢。

english: Good day to you too adventurer.
translation: 你也午安，冒险者。

english: Ah yes that snake will do just fine, a nice agonising death, for Ali of course. I'd never kill a fellow vindictive, nasty soul such as Snuggles the snake here!
translation: 啊，没错，那条蛇正合适，一个痛苦的死法，当然是给阿里的。我绝不会杀害一个同样记仇、恶毒的灵魂，比如这条叫'抱抱'的蛇！

english: Ah yes, now that I have the toxin I need something to hide its trace, fresh camel dung should do the job.
translation: 啊，是的，既然我有了毒素，我需要一些东西来隐藏它的痕迹，新鲜的骆驼粪便应该可以。

english: And don't forget it has to be fresh. Now are you going to give me the snake or not.
translation: 别忘了，必须是新鲜的。你到底给不给我那条蛇？

english: Ahh, I see. But that is rarely a simple matter. Extinguishing the flame of life is simple, but people rarely wish to face the consequences, and I doubt you are any different.
translation: 啊，我明白了。但这通常不是件简单的事。熄灭生命之火很简单，但很少有人愿意面对后果，我怀疑你也不例外。

english: Now remember. This poison isn't designed to be used on a weapon. In fact it's not a contact poison at all. You'll have to do more than just smear it on a blade!
translation: 现在记住。这种毒药不是设计用在武器上的。事实上它根本不是接触性毒药。你不能只是把它涂在刀片上！

english: Well how else would you abbreviate Alice then? And no, you can't call me Al!
translation: 那你还能怎么缩写爱丽丝？不行，你不能叫我'艾尔'！

english: Well now this is getting interesting. I'd recommend a poisoning. Who do you wish dead? I need to know so that I may tailor a poison to their specific needs!
translation: 嗯，现在这变得有意思了。我建议下毒。你想让谁死？我需要知道，这样我才能针对他们的特殊需求调配毒药！

english: Please? Never have I heard a more inappropriate use of that foul word. Traitorous Ali you say... I believe he should be easily gotten rid of.
translation: 拜托？我从没听过比这更不恰当使用那个脏词的了。你说叛徒阿里……我相信他应该很容易被除掉。

english: None, I will extract much pleasure from his passing, just bring me the ingredients I require.
translation: 分文不取，我会从他的死亡中获取很多乐趣，只要给我带来我需要的材料就行。

english: Ah impatience! Traitorous Ali's time is indeed nigh. Firstly bring me some snake venom, which will act as the main toxin.
translation: 啊，不耐烦！叛徒阿里的死期确实近了。首先给我带些蛇毒，作为主要毒素。

english: Sheesh! You'd never make a chemist, never mind an alchemist. Just bring me a snake, with teeth in its head and don't even think of giving me that snake charmer's pet worm, it's about as dangerous as a rubber knife.
translation: 切！你永远成不了化学家，更别提炼金术士了。给我带条蛇，头上有牙的那种，别想给我弄条耍蛇人的宠物蠕虫，那东西跟橡胶刀一样危险。

english: I have the poison already mixed, I just needed the ingredients to prepare another batch, you wouldn't believe the demand, its been murder.
translation: 我已经调好毒药了，只是需要材料再准备一批，你不会相信需求量有多大，简直要命。

english: Now what do you want from me then? A hex? A spot potion? Power, beauty, eternal youth or something else drab like that?
translation: 那么你想从我这里得到什么？一个诅咒？一瓶祛斑药水？力量、美貌、永葆青春，还是其他诸如此类乏味的东西？

english: You're not as useless as I thought.
translation: 你没我想的那么没用。

english: Well don't bother me again until such time that you do have one.
translation: 好吧，在你弄到一条之前别再烦我。

english: I warned you about needlessly bothering me. That's it I'm hexing you into a frog!
translation: 我警告过你别没事来烦我。够了，我要把你诅咒成青蛙！

english: Don't taunt me because I will, once I find time to get around to it!
translation: 别激我，因为我真的会这么做——等我找到时间去做！

english: Now what do you want from the Old hag of Pollnivneach? To hex someone? Power, beauty, eternal youth or something else drab like that?
translation: 那么，你想从波尼尼镇的老巫婆这里要什么？诅咒某人？力量、美貌、永生，还是其他类似的乏味东西？

english: Well if that's the case, no! I have better things to be doing than continiously brewing poison for people who have no use for it.
translation: 如果是这样，免谈！我有更好的事要做，没空一直给用不上毒药的人调配毒药。

english: Well don't come back until you have it.
translation: 好吧，等你弄到了再回来。

english: What? How do you just lose a batch of the most potent poison in all Gielinor? It's even more deadly than the jungle karambwan.
translation: 什么？你怎么能弄丢一批整个吉莉诺尔最厉害的毒药？它比丛林的卡拉姆万还要致命。

english: Well ok, I'll give you another batch this time.
translation: 好吧，这次我再给你一批。

english: That's right, I have been keeping track of your progress. It was impressive.
translation: 没错，我一直在关注你的进展。令人印象深刻。

english: The bandits? A mere nuisance, insignificant in my overall plans.
translation: 那些强盗？不过是些小麻烦，在我的整体计划中微不足道。

english: World domination, first Pollnivneach, then Al Kharid then the whole of Gielinor!
translation: 统治世界，先拿下波尼尼镇，然后是阿尔卡里德城，最后是整个吉列诺！

english: You do understand who 'We' are?
translation: 你知道‘我们’指的是谁吗？

english: Silence! We are the chosen, exiled from Menaphos for trying to overthrow the Pharaoh. Loyal servants of Amascut the Devourer, God of Destruction.
translation: 闭嘴！我们是天选之人，因试图推翻法老而被逐出梅纳佛斯。我们是毁灭之神阿玛斯库特吞噬者的忠实仆人。

english: We are regrouping again to launch another offensive against the thrall of Tumeken, using Pollnivneach as a spawning ground for revolution!
translation: 我们正在重新集结，准备对图梅肯的奴仆发动新一轮进攻，以波尼尼镇作为革命的滋生地！

english: Talk to Ali the Operator. I'm busy.
translation: 去找操作员阿里谈。我忙着呢。

english: Tell me what your problem is and I'll know then if I can.
translation: 告诉我你有什么问题，我就知道能不能帮忙。

english: It wasn't me, I honestly swear.
translation: 不是我，我真的发誓。

english: Well there is Traitorous Ali.
translation: 嗯，有个叛徒阿里。

english: Possibly the most untrustworthy backstabbing fiend to ever walk Tumeken's fair desert. He'd sell his mother to slavers if he hadn't already betrayed her and had her locked up for the last job he pulled.
translation: 可能是图梅肯美丽沙漠上最不可信任的背信弃义的恶魔。他要是没把母亲出卖给奴隶贩子，也会在上一票活儿里背叛她并把她关起来。

english: Well what can I say, he doesn't have that name for being loyal!
translation: 唉，我能说什么呢，他那个名字可不是白叫的！

english: Go away! I'm busy.
translation: 走开！我忙着呢。

english: Well I suppose so.
translation: 嗯，我想是吧。

english: Those bandits would never agree to that. They're such bad thieves they couldn't afford to buy even the mangiest excuse of a camel, never mind the desert traversing four legged beauty that we would demand.
translation: 那些强盗绝不会同意。他们偷得那么差，连最寒碜的骆驼都买不起，更别说我们要的那等沙漠穿越的四足美兽了。

english: I think our leader once mentioned that they robbed one of our camels. A heinous crime around here, worthy of a stoning.
translation: 我记得我们的领袖提起过，他们抢了我们一头骆驼。在这里是滔天罪行，该被石刑处死。

english: I cannot remember, as it's been going on for so long.
translation: 我记不清了，因为这已经持续太久了。

english: Admittedly, we are far better than them at that sort of thing, but they did start the cycle.
translation: 诚然，我们在那种事上远比他们擅长，但最初是他们挑起的。

english: They are always stealing, starting fights and causing disruption to the life of the people in this town.
translation: 他们总是偷东西、打架，扰乱这个镇子居民的生活。

english: One other thing, Ali wants to have a word with you.
translation: 还有一件事，阿里想和你谈谈。

english: Traitor foul spawn of Icthlarin. A curse on you. I should never have trusted you.
translation: 叛徒，伊克哈林的肮脏幼体。诅咒你。我真不该信任你。

english: If you need anything ask Ali the Operator. He's the brains behind the whole operation.
translation: 如果你需要什么，去找操作员阿里。他是整个行动的大脑。

english: Exactly, what do you want?
translation: 正是，你想要什么？

english: Well when you do, come back to me.
translation: 等你准备好了，再来找我。

english: Ya, I see them. Give me a sec.
translation: 嗯，我看到他们了。给我一秒。

english: Listen you're crazy, I can't see anyone to distract.
translation: 听着，你疯了，我找不到任何人可以分散注意力。

english: Did you see the way I distracted that guy? Man I'm one smooth operator!
translation: 你看到我分散那家伙注意力的方式了吗？天啊，我真是个厉害的操作员！

english: Not much really to say about it. Pollnivneach is a small town located between Al Kharid and Menaphos and has a particularly bad crime problem. Besides that nothing much happens here.
translation: 其实没什么好说的。波尼尼镇是位于阿尔卡里德城和梅纳福斯之间的小镇，犯罪问题特别严重。除此之外，这里也没什么大事发生。

english: He was ok, although he used to kick us when he caught any of us stealing from his stall.
translation: 他还行吧，不过每次抓到我们从他的摊位偷东西时，都会踢我们。

english: He disappeared around a week ago, he was involved in some dodgy business with both the gangs. I think he scammed them. Whether he got away with it or they got him I don't know, but I reckon if you gained either
translation: 他大概一周前失踪了，他当时和两个帮派都有些见不得人的交易。我觉得他骗了他们。我不知道他是脱身了还是被他们抓住了，但我想如果你获得了其中

english: There's not much really to say about them, they're just a group of local thugs led by the largest amongst them. They don't harbour the ambitions of the Menaphites.
translation: 其实他们没什么好说的，就是一群本地暴徒，由他们中间最强壮的人领导。他们没有梅纳福斯人那样的野心。

english: The mayor is a spineless coward. The current state of the town is all his fault. He didn't stand up to the Menaphites when they first came to town. When he finally realised his mistake he hired a group of thugs to
translation: 镇长是个懦夫。小镇现在的状况都是他的错。梅纳福斯人刚来镇上的时候，他不敢反抗。等他终于意识到自己的错误时，他雇了一群暴徒来

english: of the gangs trust they may let you in on some more info.
translation: 帮派的信任，他们可能会告诉你更多信息。

english: They're a bad bunch, always starting fights down in the the Asp and Snake. Word on the street is that they're led by some deranged priest. Though nobody gets to see him as he deals through Ali 'the Operator'. They are
translation: 他们是一群坏蛋，老是在阿斯普和蛇酒馆打架。街头传言说他们是由一个疯狂的祭司领导的。不过没人见过他，因为他都是通过阿里.‘操作员’打交道。他们

english: try get rid of them. When they discovered him to be weak they turned against him too. Thus causing an even larger mess.
translation: 试图赶走他们。当发现他软弱时，他们也反目了。结果把事情搞得更糟。

english: planning something but they're such a close knit group that little ever slips out.
translation: 在密谋什么，但他们团伙很紧密，很少有消息泄露出来。

english: Thanks ma'am, I didn't think you would hold up your side of the deal. There's not much honour amongst thieves, you know.
translation: 谢谢夫人，我没想到你会履行交易。你知道，盗贼之间没多少信用可言。

english: Psst... [player name] Come here.
translation: 嘘……[player name] 过来。

english: There doesn't seem to be anyone around to rob at the moment. Perhaps we can try again later.
translation: 现在似乎附近没有人可以偷。也许我们可以晚点再试。

english: They're a bad bunch, always starting fights down in the Asp and Snake. Word on the street is that they're led by some deranged priest. Though nobody gets to see him as he deals through Ali 'the Operator'. They are
translation: 他们是一群坏蛋，老是在阿斯普和蛇酒馆打架。街头传言说他们是由一个疯狂的祭司领导的。不过没人见过他，因为他都是通过阿里.‘操作员’打交道。他们

english: planning something, but they're such a close knit group that little ever slips out.
translation: 在密谋什么，但他们团伙很紧密，很少有消息泄露出来。

english: Here I go what? You haven't got any money!
translation: 我干什么去？你一个子儿都没有！

english: I've heard that before. If you don't give me the money, you will be sorry.
translation: 这话我听过。如果你不给我钱，你会后悔的。

english: That's not enough! But it'll have to do - you're broke! Still, at least you came back to pay.
translation: 这点不够！但也只能这样了——你破产了！不过至少你回来付钱了。

english: You hardly think that a couple of pick-pocketings would do, did you?
translation: 你该不会以为随便偷几个钱包就行了吧？

english: Good, now the next thing you have to do is a spot of burglary.
translation: 好，接下来你要做的是小小的入室行窃。

english: Well I think that a disguise would be a good start. After that I would definitely stake out the place to make sure the mayor is not in.
translation: 嗯，我觉得伪装是个好的开始。之后肯定得先踩点，确保市长不在家。

english: Impressive, I didn't expect you to succeed so soon with cracking that safe. Did you have help?
translation: 了不起，没想到你这么快就撬开了保险箱。有帮手吗？

english: Now your final task is one of the upmost importance. It has come to my attention that there is a traitor in our midst.
translation: 现在你最后的任务至关重要。我获悉我们中间有个叛徒。

english: That mayor is a fool. Now give me the jewels.
translation: 那个市长是个傻瓜。现在把首饰给我。

english: Yes and I want you to root them out.
translation: 是的，我要你把它们根除。

english: Because I feel like I can trust you. You don't have all the baggage that comes with being a villain your entire life.
translation: 因为我觉得可以信任你。你没有那种一辈子当坏人的包袱。

english: No!! I would never have suspected that 'Traitorous Ali' would betray us. Actually... what am I saying! Of course it would have been him. He betrayed his family for a sandpit and an umbrella!
translation: 不！！我怎么也没想到那个“叛徒阿里”会背叛我们。其实……我说什么呢！当然会是他。他为了一片沙坑和一把伞就背叛了家人！

english: Stop, I don't want to know. It hurts too much already. Find him and then kill him, but do it quietly, I don't want a fuss.
translation: 住口，我不想听。已经够痛了。找到他，然后杀了他，但要悄悄的，我不想闹出动静。

english: It means that I want you to go out into the town and pickpocket 3 villagers and then report back to me.
translation: 意思就是我要你到镇上去扒窃三个村民，然后回来向我报告。

english: You have proven yourself to be worthy of the bosses presence.
translation: 你已经证明自己值得去见Boss了。

english: I'm sure he sold us out for much more.
translation: 我敢肯定他卖了我们换来了更多东西。

english: The only place worth pilfering is the mayor's villa.
translation: 唯一值得偷的地方就是市长的别墅。

english: You'll need a key to the front door too.
translation: 你还需要前门的钥匙。

english: I want you to retrieve the mayor's wife's jewels.
translation: 我要你把市长夫人的首饰拿来。

english: As you might have gathered we have the reputation for being less than scrupulous, something with good foundation.
translation: 你可能也看出来了，我们的名声不太好，而且确实有根有据。

english: He wants to see you now to discuss the future direction of the gang.
translation: 他现在想见你，讨论帮派未来的方向。

english: You seem to be a lady of action. We could do with more people like you to sort those despicable bandits out.
translation: 你看起来是个行动派女士。我们正需要更多像你这样的人来收拾那些卑鄙的强盗。

english: What did the master say?
translation: 老大说什么了？

english: Make sure you interview our other members they may know more than they let on.
translation: 务必盘问一下我们其他成员，他们可能知道更多而不肯说。

english: Why did you have to go and ruin everything? We had a beautiful future ahead of us, the town would have been ours.
translation: 你为什么非要毁掉一切？我们本来有美好的未来，整个小镇都将是我们的。

english: Sheep, ready for the slau... hang on I shouldn't be saying..., listen I don't want to talk about them.
translation: 羊，准备好被宰……等等，我不该说……听着，我不想谈论它们。

english: Perhaps we will have some more work for you in future, if you stay in town.
translation: 如果你继续待在镇上，以后我们可能还有更多活给你干。

english: Don't take all day, the days getting on and there's still plenty of foul deeds to be done.
translation: 别拖太久，日子一天天过去，还有很多坏事要干呢。

english: Thank you for making those cowardly bandits give us a camel. They should give us far more if they want our mercy, but this is a start.
translation: 谢谢你让那些懦弱的强盗给了我们一匹骆驼。他们要是想要我们的仁慈，就该给更多，不过这是个开始。

english: I see. I knew the power hunger would get to you eventually.
translation: 我明白了。我就知道对权力的渴望终究会找上你。

english: No it just wouldn't be the same, I think I'll just wallow in self pity for a while.
translation: 不，那感觉不一样了，我还是自怨自艾一阵吧。

english: Tell me when you are ready. This should not be undertaken lightly.
translation: 准备好了就告诉我。这事可不能轻率行事。

english: Then search the house more thoroughly, everything you should need will be there.
translation: 那就更彻底地搜索房子，你需要的一切都会在那里。

english: Here take this, it might help.
translation: 拿着这个，或许有用。

english: So, you've lost your keys then. It's lucky I keep a spare pair.
translation: 这么说，你的钥匙丢了。幸好我留了一把备用的。

english: How the worm has turned. You who was robbing, looting and poisoning not too long ago are now taking the moral high ground! Or are you trying to keep the whole town for yourself?
translation: 蠕虫翻身了。不久前还在抢劫、掠夺和投毒的你，现在却占据道德高地！还是你想把整个城镇据为己有？

english: Adventurer... I have underestimated you. Perhaps we can come to an agreement. How about if I work for you? Think of the riches you would make.
translation: 冒险者……我看低你了。或许我们可以达成协议。我为你效力如何？想想你能赚到的财富。

english: The people's champion, you are so naive. They won't even thank you for this you know.
translation: 人民的英雄，你太天真了。他们甚至不会为此感谢你的。

english: I will not be run out of my own town without a fight. If you defeat my best warrior I will leave town.
translation: 我不会不战就被赶出我自己的镇子。如果你打败我最强的战士，我就离开。

english: You dog! You killed our champion and for that you will die.
translation: 你这狗东西！你杀了我们的勇士，为此你必须死。

english: So you're the one who freed Azzanadra from his prison? Thank you, kind sir!
translation: 原来是你把阿扎纳德拉从监狱里放出来的？谢谢你，好心的先生！

english: So you're the one who freed Azzanadra from his prison? Thank you, kind lady!
translation: 原来是你把阿扎纳德拉从监狱里放出来的？谢谢你，好心的女士！

english: What do you want lass?
translation: 你想干什么，姑娘？

english: You are not welcome here you Menaphite dog!
translation: 这里不欢迎你，你这美奈菲特的狗！

english: Zamorakian scum!
translation: 扎莫拉克的渣滓！

english: Welcome! Our leader would be pleased to congratulate you on your disposal of the Menaphites who plagued this town.
translation: 欢迎！我们的首领很高兴祝贺你铲除了祸害小镇的美奈菲特人。

english: Saradominist filth!
translation: 萨拉多明的污秽！

english: Do I look like I care who you are or where you came from?
translation: 你觉得我在乎你是谁或者从哪来吗？

english: I'm sure there are many secrets buried beneath the sands here. The thing about this being a desert, is that they're likely to stay that way.
translation: 我敢肯定沙子底下埋藏着许多秘密。不过这里是沙漠，它们很可能永远埋在那里。

english: The gods forsake us, and drove us to this place. Anything of worth has been long gone.
translation: 诸神抛弃了我们，把我们赶到这个地方。任何有价值的东西早已不在了。

english: You dog... you'll not kill our champion. I'll get you first.
translation: 你这狗东西……你杀不了我们的勇士。我会先杀了你。

english: I have no interest in the world that betrayed my people. Search where you will, you will find nothing.
translation: 我对那个背叛我族人的世界毫无兴趣。随你怎么搜索，你什么都找不到。

english: You are a crazy woman. The only thing you will find out here in the desert is your death.
translation: 你是个疯女人。你在沙漠里唯一能找到的就是死亡。

english: Me? No, um no, I was um just complimenting your ..... um..... don't kill me please?
translation: 我？不，呃不，我只是在恭维你的……嗯……请别杀我好吗？

english: You dog! You attacked our champion and for that I hope you die a slow and painful death.
translation: 你这狗东西！你攻击了我们的冠军，为此我希望你死得又慢又痛苦。

english: Good day adventurer, have you come with the Menaphite peace offering?
translation: 你好，冒险者，你是否带来了梅纳菲特的和解祭品？

english: Good job, you just made everything worse for us poor villagers!
translation: 干得好，你让我们这些可怜的村民处境更糟了！

english: Oh it's you again!
translation: 哦，又是你！

english: Gratitude? For what? You come into our town and rob, mug, burgle and kill and then expect respect and our gratitude? Look if it's praise and thanks you're looking for, talk to the mayor.
translation: 感激？感激什么？你闯进我们的镇子，抢劫、偷窃、杀人，然后还指望我们尊重和感激你？听着，如果你想要赞美和感谢，去找镇长吧。

english: It's not that simple, things never are. A vacuum is created - power is available to the person best situated to take it.
translation: 事情没那么简单，从来都没那么简单。权力真空出现了——最有机会上位的人就会抓住权力。

english: Now that the balance is lost, the Bandits reign unopposed! They no longer have to deal with the Menaphites and inflict nothing but more misery on us. You must finish the job that you have started.
translation: 现在平衡被打破了，强盗们肆无忌惮！他们不再需要应付梅纳菲特人，只会给我们带来更多的痛苦。你必须完成你已经开始的工作。

english: Who do you think is in the best position to take power, our good mayor or the leader of the bandits?
translation: 你觉得谁最有机会上台？是我们那位好镇长，还是强盗头子？

english: Just run the bandits out of town. Incidentally, I spotted their leader to the north-west a few minutes ago.
translation: 把强盗赶出镇子就行了。顺便说一句，我几分钟前在西北边看到了他们的头目。

english: Uneducated fool! It will die, it will die!
translation: 没受过教育的蠢货！它会死的，它会死的！

english: Here here here.
translation: 这里这里这里。

english: Well there's always those wild Ugthanki, snakes, and wolves to kill on the outskirts of town.
translation: 镇子边上总有那些野生的乌格坦基骆驼、蛇和狼可以杀。

english: You know, even a stopped clock tells the right time twice a day.
translation: 你知道吗，即使是一座停摆的钟，一天也会准两次。

english: I think we need a new mayor. The one we've got isn't very good.
translation: 我觉得我们需要一个新镇长。现在这个不怎么样。

english: My thanks, your methods and motives may be questionable but nonetheless thank you for delivering this town from those wicked individuals. I think now that our problems are at a manageable size, mistakes made
translation: 多谢你，你的手段和动机可能值得商榷，但还是要感谢你把这些恶人赶出小镇。现在问题总算控制住了，过去的错误不会重演。

english: in the past will not be repeated.
translation: 过去的错误不会重演。

english: The least that I can do for you is answer your questions about the whereabouts of Ali Morrisane's nephew. He was asked to leave the town as much for concerns for his health and, as sad as it is to admit, the
translation: 我至少可以回答你关于阿里.莫里桑侄子下落的问题。他被要求离开小镇，很大程度上是出于对他健康的担忧，而且，虽然不愿承认，但也是为了他的健康。

english: for his health. He angered a number of people by coercing them into buying things they really didn't want. He acted completely within the letter of the law...
translation: 为了他的健康。他强迫别人买他们根本不需要的东西，因此惹恼了不少人。他完全在法律条文允许的范围内行事……

english: anger of our towns people.
translation: 而是镇上居民的怒火。

english: life no longer hold any water he plans to open some kind of superstore with forty of his disreputable friends. A 'treasure trove' he claims. I will believe it when I see it though.
translation: 生活不再有意义，他计划和他的四十个声名狼藉的朋友开一家某种超级商店。他声称是个'宝库'。不过，我亲眼见到才会相信。

english: I hope that helps you in your quest. Will you give my apologies to Ali Morrisane for treating his family so.
translation: 希望这对你的任务有帮助。请代我向阿里.莫里桑致歉，这样对待他的家人。

english: He is a good lad but is too good a salesman
translation: 他是个好小伙子，但过于擅长销售。

english: He will probably remain hidden for some time.
translation: 他大概还会躲藏一段时间。

english: ...but that could only protect him so long. Once he angered the Menaphites and the Bandits I could no longer protect him, and he had to go. I can assure you that he is safe and well and now that the threats to his
translation: ……但那也只能保护他一时。一旦他惹怒了美奈菲特人和强盗，我就再也保护不了他，他必须离开。我可以向你保证他平安无事，既然对他的生命威胁已经……

english: I really can't chat for very long, I'm very busy, the recent escalation in crime has me run off my feet. Muggings and burglaries happening in broad daylight in the town, it's just not on.
translation: 我真的不能聊太久，我很忙，最近犯罪率激增，让我忙得不可开交。光天化日之下镇上发生抢劫和入室盗窃，这绝对不行。

english: Welcome adventurer to the town of Pollnivneach, the gateway to Menaphos and Al-Kharid. My name is Ali and I'm the mayor of this town. I hope you enjoy your stay here.
translation: 欢迎冒险者来到波尼尼镇，这里是通往美奈菲特和阿尔-卡里德的门户。我叫阿里，是这里的镇长。希望你在这里过得愉快。

english: Perhaps you should talk to him, I'm sure he's keen to hear word of his nephew.
translation: 也许你应该和他谈谈，我相信他很想听到他侄子的消息。

english: I don't know what we did, to have you imposed on our little town but I for one am sorry.
translation: 我不知道我们做了什么，要让你强加在我们这个小镇上，但我个人感到抱歉。

english: All are welcome here, such is the way of things in border regions. Now more than ever I suppose.
translation: 这里欢迎所有人，边境地区向来如此。我想现在更是如此。

english: There's trouble in town, and a lot of villagers have left as a result.
translation: 镇上有麻烦，很多村民因此离开了。

english: Do you understand the concept of consequence? Do anything and other things will happen as a result. Well the consequences of your little piece of butchery are that the town is now even worse off. The bandits no
translation: 你懂什么叫后果吗？做任何事都会导致其他事情发生。你那一场小屠杀的后果就是小镇现在更糟了。强盗们不用……

english: Why do I wish that you hadn't said that. Your heavyhanded tactics scare me.
translation: 我多希望你没说那句话。你那些强硬手段让我害怕。

english: longer have to waste time and energy fighting with the Menaphites and can direct all their attention to making us miserable. So for your efforts I thank you, but I wish no-one had asked for your help.
translation: 再也不用浪费时间和精力与美奈菲特人争斗，可以将全部注意力用来折磨我们了。所以尽管我感谢你的努力，但我真希望没人找过你帮忙。

english: I doubt that's easy in Pollnivneach.
translation: 在波尼尼镇恐怕没那么容易。

english: I'm more than a little busy at the moment, I'm sure there are plenty of people in town who could help you.
translation: 我现在有点忙，我相信镇上有很多人能帮你。

english: Well not to be immodest, but it was all my idea. Well I have things to do, good luck adventurer.
translation: 好吧，不是自夸，但这全是我的主意。嗯，我还有事，祝你好运，冒险者。

english: I really can't chat for very long, Muggings and burglaries happening in broad daylight in the town, it's just not on. Just a short while ago even my own house was robbed. This can not continue.
translation: 我真的不能聊太久，光天化日之下镇上发生抢劫和入室盗窃，这绝对不行。就在不久前，连我自己的房子都被抢了。不能再这样下去了。

english: One cannot put a price on life, they are precious beyond the worth of the crass value of gold coins!
translation: 生命是无价的，它们比金币那种粗俗的价值更珍贵！

english: Here are the receipts for the camels so that you can pick them up as soon as I get them in.
translation: 这是骆驼的收据，这样你就能在我一到货时就来取。

english: But you are in luck - I have another two beautiful camels arriving in soon from the best stable in all of Al Kharid.
translation: 但你运气好——马上又有两头漂亮的骆驼从整个阿尔卡里德城最好的马厩运过来。

english: Yes - a great idea - selling camels at discounted prices so that the common man can experience the joys of owning a camel too. They're not just a source of kebab meat you know!
translation: 没错——好主意——以折扣价卖骆驼，让普通人也体验一下拥有骆驼的乐趣。你要知道它们不只是烤肉肉的来源！

english: Well you've found your man.
translation: 好吧，你找对人了。

english: Well no, but one of them owns a camel hire franchise.
translation: 嗯，不，但其中一个人有骆驼租赁的加盟权。

english: Not much really, I just want to thank you for what you have done for this village, I can now get on with business.
translation: 其实没什么，我只是想感谢你为这个村子做的一切，我现在可以继续做生意了。

english: Well I've been debating whether I should diversify. I might move into camel rental although I do have all these cages lying around which I could put to some use.
translation: 好吧，我一直在考虑要不要多样化经营。我可能会进军骆驼租赁，不过我手边也有这些笼子可以派上用场。

english: You are too generous, I would have sold for half of that!
translation: 你太慷慨了，我本来一半价就卖了！

english: I would never sell one to the likes of you, they are beautiful majestic creatures not sandwich fillers! Get out of my shop.
translation: 我绝不会卖给你这种人，它们是美丽高贵的生物，不是三明治馅料！滚出我的店。

english: Ah wondrous creatures, ships of the desert, far more useful than any horse or donkey. A man's best friend.
translation: 啊，奇妙的生物，沙漠之舟，比任何马或驴都有用。是男人最好的朋友。

english: It's a beautiful day today but word has it that it will rain tomorrow.
translation: 今天天气真好，但有传闻说明天会下雨。

english: No don't worry I'm only joking!
translation: 不，别担心，我只是开玩笑！

english: Well Sandy, the female camel is a placid beast, and is 20 years of age and comes from a prestigious family whose mother was the part of the Sultan's baggage train.
translation: 嗯，桑迪，这头母骆驼性情温顺，二十岁大，出身名门，它的母亲曾是苏丹辎重队的一员。

english: I would consider giving them to you if you were able to look after them. But it is abundantly clear that you've got your hands full at the moment.
translation: 如果你能照顾好它们，我会考虑把它们给你。但现在很明显你手头很忙。

english: Well Pollnivneach is a funny little place. It's a small town and you'd think it would be a quiet place.
translation: 好吧，波尼尼镇是个有趣的小地方。它是个小镇，你会以为它会很安静。

english: Lumps, on the other hand is a 15 year old male, a bit surly and prone to bouts of stubbornness. However he more than makes up for this failing with his immense strength and stamina.
translation: 而拉普斯则是一头十五岁的公骆驼，有点暴躁，容易犯倔。不过它用巨大的力量和耐力弥补了这个缺点。

english: Both of them are of the 'Camelus Horribleus' family, a breed peculiar only to this area of Gielinor. It is....
translation: 它们都属于'恐怖骆驼属'家族，一种只存在于吉莉诺尔这片地区的独特品种。那是……

english: But those Menaphites and bandits are making this place quite unbearable.
translation: 但那些梅纳菲特人和强盗让这地方变得相当难以忍受。

english: Business is booming, Pollnivneach has never seen this number of visitors.
translation: 生意兴隆，波尼尼镇从没见过这么多访客。

english: Pah! That might buy you a mangy flea infested sheep if you're lucky. Don't insult me.
translation: 呸！那点钱运气好也就能买只长满跳蚤的癞皮羊。别侮辱我。

english: Didn't I warn you that a camel is not like a puppy or a kitten, fun for a few days and then a tasty snack? They're more than that, they're for life!
translation: 我没警告过你吗？骆驼不像小狗小猫，玩几天就变成美味零食？它们比那重要得多，它们是终身的！

english: You're teasing me now! You rogue! Everyone has a laugh at my expense, I'm just more enlightened than you!
translation: 你在耍我！你这盗贼！大家都拿我寻开心，我只是比你更开明罢了！

english: Yes perhaps you could.
translation: 是的，也许你可以。

english: That may be so, but you are also the brave adventurer and you should know!
translation: 也许是这样，但你也是勇敢的冒险者，你应该知道！

english: Well one group is as bad as the other, stealing from each other and the locals, fighting, and just the last day one of the bandits came looking for protection money
translation: 好吧，一群人和另一群人一样坏，互相偷窃、偷当地人、打架，就在昨天还有个强盗来收保护费。

english: If you haven't noticed this is a remote town, half way between Menaphos and Al Kharid, a place where neither exert any power.
translation: 如果你没注意到，这是个偏远小镇，位于梅纳菲托斯和阿尔卡里德城之间，两者都管不到这里。

english: That's a little unfair my friend. We can't all be brave adventurers. If we were, where would you go to get camels at discounted prices?
translation: 这有点不公平，我的朋友。我们不可能都是勇敢的冒险者。如果都是的话，你上哪儿去买打折的骆驼呢？

english: To tell the truth we live in hope that an objective outsider could broker a deal to halt the hostilities between them.
translation: 说实话，我们寄希望于有个客观的外人能够斡旋，停止他们之间的敌对行动。

english: You might think about that. Anyway isn't it the job of the brave adventurer to deliver the weak and innocent from evil and harm?
translation: 你可以考虑一下。再说了，勇敢的冒险者不就是应该把弱者和无辜者从邪恶和伤害中拯救出来吗？

english: The state of adventurers today. They need everything spelt out for them.
translation: 现在的冒险者啊。什么都得跟他们说得清清楚楚。

english: Well, ok I will help. Try and see if you can get the groups to agree to a truce by perhaps each offering a token gift as an act of reconciliation.
translation: 好吧，我会帮忙。试试看你能不能通过让双方各自提供一个象征性的礼物作为和解的姿态，来让团体同意休战。

english: Not Sandy and Lumps! You beast! Get out of my shop now!
translation: 不是桑迪和拉普斯！你这野兽！马上滚出我的店！

english: If that fails to work, I would consider trying to influence the groups from within.
translation: 如果那样不行，我会考虑尝试从内部影响那些群体。

english: Glad to know you're not of that ilk.
translation: 很高兴知道你不是那种人。

english: Pah! You just do not know how to treat them. If you abuse them and treat them badly of course they're going to spit and bite.
translation: 呸！你就是不知道怎么对待它们。如果你虐待它们、对它们不好，它们当然会吐口水咬人。

english: Well one can only do and sell so much. If I had more staff I'd be able to sell more, rather than wasting my time on menial things I could get on with selling sand to the Bedabin and useless tourist trinkets to everyone.
translation: 一个人只能做和卖这么多。如果我有更多员工，我就能卖更多，而不是把时间浪费在琐事上，我就可以继续向贝达宾人卖沙子，向所有人卖无用的游客小饰品。

english: Yes I know, I know - the life of a shop keeper isn't slaying dragons and wooing damsels but it has its charms.
translation: 是的，我知道，我知道——店主的生活不是屠杀龙和追求少女，但它自有其魅力。

english: Ah, many thanks, my friend. My nephew's name is 'Ali' and he lives to the south in a town called 'Pollnivneach'.
translation: 啊，多谢了，我的朋友。我侄子叫'阿里'，住在南边一个叫'波尼尼镇'的小镇。

english: Although you can help me in another way, a nephew of mine lives not too far from here in a little town called Pollnivneach. If you could fetch him here I'll give you the first month of his salary!
translation: 不过你可以用另一种方式帮我，我侄子就住在这附近一个叫波尼尼镇的小镇里。你要是能把他带过来，我就把他第一个月的薪水给你！

english: Yes, but by people with too much money and not enough sense. All willingly parted with their money and received what they purchased.
translation: 没错，但那是钱多没脑子的人。他们都心甘情愿地掏钱，拿到了他们买的东西。

english: Well then tell me what has become of him. Nothing bad I hope.
translation: 那你告诉我他怎么样了。希望不是什么坏事。

english: Hello again my friend. I see you have not found my troublesome nephew. Have you any news of his whereabouts?
translation: 又见面了，我的朋友。看来你还没找到我那麻烦的侄子。有他的消息吗？

english: Now have a look at my wares.
translation: 现在来看看我的货吧。

english: Well I still am in need of an assistant....
translation: 好吧，我还是需要个助理……

english: Any word on my good nephew?
translation: 有我那好侄子的消息吗？

english: That's not really the news I was looking forward to. Since you've been gone trade has gotten even busier. Will you have a look at my wares?
translation: 这可不是我想听到的消息。你走了之后生意更忙了。你要看看我的货吗？

english: Good job on getting the rune stone shipments sorted. I'm just receiving the first of them. Though there seems to be a funny sort of locking mechanism on them, which I haven't completely figured out.
translation: 干得好，把符文石货运整理好了。我刚刚收到第一批。不过上面似乎有一种奇怪的锁定机制，我还没完全弄明白。

english: My friend in Sophanem.... Ahh never mind him, maybe we might have a look at him another time.
translation: 我在索法尼恩城的朋友……啊，别管他了，也许改天再找他。

english: As always it's a pleasure doing business with you.
translation: 和你做生意总是很愉快。

english: Don't worry, I'll tell you what I won't put the runes up for sale just yet. I'll let you have first dibs on them.
translation: 别担心，我告诉你，我还不会把这些符文拿出来卖。我会让你先挑。

english: [player name], I would like to commend you on all the selfless help you have given me.
translation: [player name]，我想感谢你给我提供的所有无私帮助。

english: There's really no one at the moment who you can deal with for me. Maybe another time.
translation: 目前真的没有人需要你去打交道。也许下次吧。

english: I do recall hearing about a rune salesman in Varrock.
translation: 我确实记得听说过维洛克城有个符文商人。

english: You know, I really could do with some magic stock.
translation: 你知道吗，我真的需要一些魔法弩托。

english: Hmmm.. I am reluctant to have business dealings with someone I know little about.
translation: 嗯……我不太愿意和一个我不太了解的人做生意。

english: I suppose you could. But mind you I would need for you to have a significant degree of trust in them before I would go into business with him.
translation: 我想你可以。但请注意，在我和他做生意之前，你需要对他有相当大的信任。

english: No I'm afraid not.
translation: 不，恐怕不行。

english: Well I can't think of anyone off hand. I think there's a rune seller in Varrock but... nah, I haven't had a huge amount of dealings with the merchant. How about you?
translation: 好吧，我一时想不出谁来。我记得维洛克城有个符文商人，不过……呃，我和那个商人打交道不多。你呢？

english: Oh! Err .. unfortunately it seems to have expired yesterday!
translation: 哦！呃……不幸的是，它似乎昨天就过期了！

english: I don't know what you mean!
translation: 我不知道你在说什么！

english: Not a problem at all, come back at any time.
translation: 完全没问题，随时可以回来。

english: It strikes me that you are quite reluctant to receive your reward, come back when you've some room in you inventory.
translation: 我觉得你好像不太愿意接受奖励，等你背包有空位了再来吧。

english: There's your reward as agreed.
translation: 按照约定，这是你的奖励。

english: Yes I know, I know - the life of a shop keeper isn't slaying dragon and wooing damsels but it has its charms
translation: 是的，我知道，我知道——店主的生活不是屠杀龙和追求少女，但它自有其魅力。

english: Grundt! Eat up! You're a growing young dwarf.
translation: 格伦特！快吃！你是个正在长身体的小矮人。

english: Grundt! Don't insult the charming young lady.
translation: 格伦特！别冒犯这位迷人的年轻女士。

english: I apologise for my colleague, he is rude and thoughtless. Maybe we could go for a drink after our business dealings. I'd love to taste more of your home cooking, personally.
translation: 我为我的同事道歉，他粗鲁又没礼貌。也许我们谈完生意后可以去喝一杯。我个人很想品尝更多你家里的手艺。

english: Is this the best food they have here?
translation: 这就是他们这里最好的食物？

english: Welcome, Talvald. Do you have any questions?
translation: 欢迎，塔尔瓦尔德。有什么问题吗？

english: Spare us a few coppers mister
translation: 先生，赏我们几个铜板吧

english: Spare us a few coppers miss
translation: 小姐，赏我们几个铜板吧

english: How did it go on Neitiznot? You should report to our King.
translation: 奈提兹诺镇那边怎么样？你应该向我们的国王报告。

english: Our mines are just outside the western gatehouse. Walk northwards round the city walls and you'll find the stairwell down.
translation: 我们的矿场就在西门楼外面。沿着城墙向北走，你会找到下去的楼梯井。

english: Go talk to Flosi Dalksson, the fishmonger. He shares a building with Keep on the eastern side of town.
translation: 去找鱼贩弗洛西.达尔克森谈谈。他和基普合住一栋楼，在镇子东边。

english: Good luck over in Neitiznot.
translation: 祝你在奈提兹诺镇好运。

english: I hope you found out what is going on in Neitiznot.
translation: 希望你查清了奈提兹诺镇发生了什么事。

english: I hear that you've been over to Neitiznot?
translation: 我听说你去过奈提兹诺镇？

english: I hear everyone gets poked with sticks before breakfast over there. Is that true?
translation: 我听说那里每个人早饭前都要被棍子戳。是真的吗？

english: I hear they marry yaks over there as well. Is that true?
translation: 我还听说他们在那里和牦牛结婚。是真的吗？

english: I hear they eat babies over there. Is that true?
translation: 我听说他们在那里吃婴儿。是真的吗？

english: That can't be true.
translation: 那不可能是真的。

english: Anyway...
translation: 总之...

english: More taxes; how depressing.
translation: 又是税；真让人沮丧。

english: Why should I pay a Window Tax when I don't want any windows. I'd be more than happy staring at the blank walls. How much money are we supposed to pay?
translation: 我根本不要窗户，干嘛要交窗户税？我宁愿盯着空墙看。我们该付多少钱？

english: What? Can't you count? I'm not paying my tax to someone who can't count!
translation: 什么？你连数都不会数？我不会把税交给一个数数都不行的人！

english: If you are new around here, you should speak with our ruler, King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
translation: 如果你是新来的，应该去跟我们的统治者国王古基.索沃特四世谈谈。

english: Our mines are just outside the western gatehouse. Walk northwards round the walls and you'll find the stairwell down.
translation: 我们的矿山就在西门楼外。沿着城墙向北走，你会找到下去的楼梯井。

english: Good luck over on Neitiznot.
translation: 在奈提兹诺镇祝你好运。

english: Go talk to Flosi Dalksson the fishmonger. He shares a building with Keep on the eastern side of town.
translation: 去找鱼贩弗洛西.达尔克森谈谈。他和凯普共享镇东边的一栋建筑。

english: I hope you found out what is going on in Neitiznot?
translation: 希望你已经弄明白奈提兹诺镇发生了什么？

english: Go talk to Flosi Dalksson the fishmonger. He shares a building with Keep on the eastern side of town?
translation: 去找鱼贩弗洛西.达尔克森谈谈。他和基普合用一个房子，在镇东边？

english: You should speak with our ruler, King Gjuki Sorvott IV.
translation: 你应该跟我们的统治者，国王古基.索沃特四世谈谈。

english: Shhhh! Yes, I mean the head operative back at home- base. He has given me permission to follow up any leads based on your intelligence.
translation: 嘘！对，我指的是大本营的负责人。他允许我根据你的情报跟进任何线索。

english: *ahem* Misinformation my boy. Misinformation and misdirection.
translation: *咳咳* 错误情报，孩子。错误情报和误导。

english: Oh. I'd take your jester's costume off first, if I were you.
translation: 哦。如果我是你，我会先把你的小丑服装脱掉。

english: *ahem* Misinformation my girl. Misinformation and misdirection.
translation: *咳咳* 错误情报，姑娘。错误情报和误导。

english: Well done! I have informed the King of your good work. I have been authorised to give you this...
translation: 干得好！我已经向国王通报了你的出色工作。我被授权把这个给你……

english: You don't have space for the reward.
translation: 你的背包空间不够，放不下奖励。

english: You don't have space for the reward. Come back when you do.
translation: 你的背包空间不够，放不下奖励。有空位了再回来。

english: What costume?
translation: 什么服装？

english: I am NOT wearing a costume. Anyone who tells you otherwise is lying.
translation: 我没有穿什么服装。谁跟你说别的，那都是撒谎。

english: I could tell you but I'd have to kill you.
translation: 我可以告诉你，但我得杀了你。

english: I'm not wearing any costume.
translation: 我没穿任何服装。

english: Can't talk now. I'm on duty.
translation: 现在没空说话。我在执勤。

english: Thank you sir. We have food, Strength potions and Prayer potions to see us through this battle.
translation: 谢谢你，先生。我们有食物、力量药水和祈祷药水来撑过这场战斗。

english: Yes sir! I have some supplies with me if you need them, but I only have a small amount left. We took a heavy toll getting here.
translation: 是的，先生！我身上带了些补给品，如果你需要的话，但我只剩下一点点了。我们到这里付出了惨重的代价。

english: He will be here soon. The Burgher trusts Him. That's good enough for me.
translation: 他很快就到。市民官信任他。这对我来说就足够了。

english: She will be here soon. The Burgher trusts Her. That's good enough for me.
translation: 她很快就到。市民官信任她。这对我来说就足够了。

english: Here, take this tuna quickly, sir!
translation: 来，快拿着这条金枪鱼，先生！

english: Purrr.
translation: 咕噜噜。

english: Meouw!
translation: 喵！

english: Meeow?
translation: 喵？

english: Miouw...meow.
translation: 喵呜……喵。

english: Meeeiouw! Mewwww!
MEEEEOOOUW!!!!
MEEEIOOOOUW! MIOOOOOEW! YOOWLLL!
Purrrrrrrrrr
translation: 咕噜噜噜噜噜

english: Well, outlander, one requires a fish immediately.
translation: 嗯，外地人，本喵需要一条鱼，立刻。

english: An outlander, how unusual. Welcome.
translation: 一个外地人，真是少见。欢迎。

english: One is satisfied with the freshness of the tuna. The humans have acted satisfactorily in this matter.
translation: 本喵对金枪鱼的新鲜度感到满意。人类在这件事上表现令人满意。

english: You have a human Fremennik name, how unusual.
translation: 你有一个人类弗瑞曼尼名字，真是少见。

english: Behave yourself human! One shall behave as one likes.
translation: 规矩点，人类！本喵想怎么着就怎么着。

english: Will you stop interrupting one? For the last time one requires tuna immediately.
translation: 你能不能别打断本喵？最后说一次，本喵要金枪鱼，立刻。

english: For goodness' sake! One might acquire the mistaken impression that the human rules this place. I command you to feed me.
translation: 看在老天分上！本喵会误以为人类统治这个地方。我命令你喂我。

english: And about time too, insolent human-pet.
translation: 总算来了，无礼的人类宠物。

english: Hmmm, one will lower oneself to eat the fish, despite the human's insult.
translation: 嗯，本喵将屈尊吃这条鱼，尽管人类如此侮辱。

english: Miouw!
translation: 喵！

english: Purrrrz!
translation: 咕噜噜！

english: Then get a move on human!!
translation: 那就快点，人类！！

english: Mieeeow!
translation: 喵——嗷！

english: One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for him to stay.
translation: 本喵祝愿带金枪鱼的外地人安好。本喵希望他留下。

english: One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for her to stay.
translation: 本喵祝愿带金枪鱼的外地人安好。本喵希望她留下。

english: I guess I won't be getting paid for finding you then.
translation: 那我找到你不会得到报酬了。

english: You jest! He doesn't look that impressive to me.
translation: 你在开玩笑！我看他没那么了不起。

english: require bravery. We on Neitiznot are warriors, but we are not just warriors.
translation: 需要勇气。我们奈提兹诺镇的人是战士，但我们不仅仅是战士。

english: You mean the priceless heirloom that I gave to you as a sign of my trust and gratitude?
translation: 你指的是我作为信任和感激的象征而送给你的那件无价传家宝？

english: It's a good job I have alert and loyal men who notice when something like this is left lying around and picks it up.
translation: 幸好我有警觉又忠诚的手下，他们注意到这种东西被随意丢在地上并捡了起来。

english: You jest! She doesn't look that impressive to me.
translation: 你在开玩笑！我看她没那么了不起。

english: Please be more careful with it in future.
translation: 以后请小心一点。

english: I'm afraid I'm going to have to charge you a 50,000GP handling cost.
translation: 恐怕我得向你收取五万金币的处理费。

english: Guards! Please escort this outlander to the docks. He is not welcome in my court.
translation: 卫兵！请把这个外乡人护送到码头。他在我的朝廷里不受欢迎。

english: The aroma, outlander! It's very distinctive. So do you wish to get your hide cured?
translation: 是气味，外乡人！非常独特。那么你想处理你的兽皮吗？

english: Well yes, of course it is. We supply rope to all of the rope traders in Gielinor. Its an excellent business.
translation: 嗯，当然是的。我们向吉列诺所有的绳索商人供应绳索。这是一门好生意。

english: I'm not interested in that right now.
translation: 我现在对这个不感兴趣。

english: You'd better get on with it then!
translation: 那你最好赶紧去办！

english: You'd better get on with it then.
translation: 那你最好赶紧去办。

english: You can't build bridges with notes! Get me the real thing.
translation: 光靠笔记可建不了桥！给我真家伙。

english: My scouts have reported that your militia have gathered inside a chamber in the troll caves.
translation: 我的斥候报告说，你的民兵已经聚集在巨魔洞穴的一个密室里。

english: You may access this through the north-eastern cave entrances.
translation: 你可以通过东北方向的洞穴入口进入。

english: Once you have joined forces with them you should be able to fight your way over to the Troll King's chamber. I believe you will be able to fight your way across a bridge after killing ten or more trolls.
translation: 一旦你与他们汇合，就应该能杀出一条路，到达巨魔王的密室。我相信你在杀死十只或更多巨魔后，就能从桥上杀过去。

english: Ah, jester. I am no longer in need of jest.
translation: 啊，小丑。我不再需要逗乐了。

english: Please be more careful with it in the future.
translation: 以后请小心一点。

english: If my Champion wishes to talk with me, she should dress as one.
translation: 如果我的冠军想和我说话，她应该穿得像冠军。

english: If my Champion wishes to talk with me, he should dress as one.
translation: 如果我的冠军想和我说话，他应该穿得像冠军。

english: Though I can hardly give you anything if you don't have any space in your pack.
translation: 不过如果你的背包没有空位，我很难给你什么东西。

english: whatever means you are familiar with.
translation: 任何你熟悉的方式。

english: the ones that simply require bravery. We on Neitiznot are warriors, but we are not just warriors.
translation: 那些只需要勇气的任务。我们奈提兹诺镇的人是战士，但我们不仅仅是战士。

english: I thank you on behalf of all my kinsmen [player name].
translation: 我代表所有族人感谢你，[player name]。

english: Bah! Bards are all the same, they never shut up! If I need to be entertained I'll hire a mime; maybe I'll get some rest then. Now if you'll listen, I'll explain what I want you to do.
translation: 呸！吟游诗人都一个样，从来不肯闭嘴！要是我需要娱乐，我会雇个哑剧演员；说不定那样我就能休息一下了。现在听好了，我来解释我要你做什么。

english: Oh, there is one more thing. In order to gain an audience with the Burgher you will need my Spymaster's, err, costume.
translation: 哦，还有一件事。要想获得与市民的会面，你需要我的间谍大师的，呃，服装。

english: Ah, yes, so the Burgher of Neitiznot Island is an enemy of free-thinking Jatizso citizens. My informants tell me an increased number of trade ships have been seen docking at their ports. They must be preparing for
translation: 啊，是的，奈提兹诺镇的市民是崇尚自由思想的贾蒂佐市民的敌人。我的线人告诉我，已经看到有更多贸易船停靠在他们港口。他们一定是在准备

english: something. Chancellor, fill in the details.
translation: 什么。首相，你来补充细节。

english: Now, where was I?
translation: 我刚才说到哪儿了？

english: This man has gathered the remaining ores needed by Keldagrim's merchants.
translation: 这个人已经收集了凯达格林商人所需的剩余矿石。

english: Please reward this man for his efforts.
translation: 请奖励这个人的努力。

english: This woman has gathered the remaining ores needed by Keldagrim's merchants.
translation: 这个女人已经收集了凯达格林商人所需的剩余矿石。

english: Please hurry back with seven coal, Keldagrim's traders are drinking my cellars dry.
translation: 请快点带回七块煤，凯达格林商人们快把我的酒窖喝干了。

english: Please reward this woman for her efforts.
translation: 请奖励这个女人的努力。

english: Please hurry back with six mithril ore, Keldagrim's traders are drinking my cellars dry.
translation: 请快点带回六块秘银矿石，凯达格林商人们快把我的酒窖喝干了。

english: Good lad.
translation: 好小子。

english: Good, good. Please reward this man for his efforts.
translation: 好，好。请奖励这个人的努力。

english: Good lass.
translation: 好姑娘。

english: Good, good. Please reward this woman for her efforts.
translation: 好，好。请奖励这个女人的努力。

english: Please hurry back with eight tin ore, Keldagrim's traders are drinking my cellars dry.
translation: 请快点带回八块锡矿石，凯达格林商人们快把我的酒窖喝干了。

english: That's not raw tuna. It's cooked! Hrafn will never eat that. Go get some raw tuna.
translation: 那不是生金枪鱼。那是熟的！赫拉夫恩绝不会吃那个。去弄些生金枪鱼来。

english: That's not raw tuna. That's a piece of paper with a tuna drawn on it. Get Hrafn some real fish.
translation: 那不是生金枪鱼。那只是一张画了金枪鱼的纸。给赫拉夫恩弄些真正的鱼来。

english: They'll never get enough ore in time, the bunch of lazy no-good layabouts.
translation: 他们永远无法及时弄到足够的矿石，那帮懒惰的废物。

english: We need six pieces of mithril ore for Keldagrim's merchants.
translation: 凯尔达格林的商人需要六块秘银矿石。

english: We need seven pieces of coal for Keldagrim's merchants.
translation: 凯尔达格林的商人需要七块煤。

english: Of course your majesty.
translation: 当然，陛下。

english: Excellent. This man has gathered the six pieces of mithril ore needed by Keldagrim's merchants, sire.
translation: 太好了。陛下，这位男子已经收集了凯尔达格林商人所需的六块秘银矿石。

english: Excellent. This man has gathered the seven pieces of coal needed by Keldagrim's merchants, sire.
translation: 太好了。陛下，这位男子已经收集了凯尔达格林商人所需的七块煤。

english: Of course. Please bring seven pieces of coal.
translation: 当然。请带来七块煤。

english: Hrafn looks contented now. You should be able to continue your conversation with the King now ...
translation: 赫拉夫恩现在看起来满意了。你现在应该可以继续和国王的谈话了……

english: I hear you killed the Troll King. Thanks you for that, however I'm afraid I can't really talk to you any more, the King would be unhappy!
translation: 我听说你杀了巨魔王。谢谢你所做的一切，不过恐怕我不能再跟你多说了，国王会不高兴的！

english: Excellent. This woman has gathered the six pieces of mithril ore needed by Keldagrim's merchants, sire.
translation: 太好了。陛下，这位女子已经收集了凯尔达格林商人所需的六块秘银矿石。

english: Of course. Please bring six pieces of mithril ore.
translation: 当然。请带来六块秘银矿石。

english: We need eight pieces of tin ore for Keldagrim's merchants.

english: Ee, ye've had yer sand fer today.
translation: 哎呀，你今天已经有沙子了。

english: I'll ge' on wit' movin' it. Thankee fer makin' sure Sandy go' it in t'neck fer 'is double dealin's!
translation: 我会继续搬的。谢谢你让桑迪为他的两面三刀付出代价！

english: Ah, keep yer 'air on, I'll leg i' to tha bank wit' some sand fer ya.
translation: 啊，别急，我马上跑一趟银行给你带些沙子。

english: I's would be givin' yer tha 'and, but yer can no' be carryin' it. Come back when ye can.
translation: 我倒想帮你一把，但你拿不了。等你能拿了再回来。

english: Aye, when I takes yer bucket o' sand to yer bank each day, I'll not bother ye wi' any messages 'bout it. Ye'll just find yer sand in there.
translation: 是啊，我每天把你的那桶沙子送到银行，就不会再拿消息烦你了。你只管在银行里找到你的沙子。

english: Thank t'gods! I tho' I searched up another when I been pickin' this'un up outside... Take tha' blasted thing to yon Guard Captain quick sharp.
translation: 谢天谢地！我还以为我捡起来的时候又挖到了一个……快把这该死的玩意儿拿去给那边的守卫长。

english: Suits me, [player name]! I be a wee bi' busy, an' I'll happily stop takin' sand to yer bank for ye. Come an' see me if ye changes yer mind.
translation: 随你便，[player name]！我有点忙，而且我很乐意不再往你银行里送沙子。如果改主意了，就来找我。

english: Huh? Wha' tha doin' in marn ed?
translation: 哼？你在我脑袋里干什么？

english: Be away wit' ya!
translation: 走开！

english: I only talk to people that 'ave 'elped me ou'! Go 'way!
translation: 我只跟帮过我的人说话！走开！

english: Eeee, ye've go' no free space in yon bank, [player name]. Make some room 'tween the fishes 'n boots fore ye come back ta me.
translation: 哎呀，你的银行里没空位了，[player name]。在回来找我之前，先在鱼和靴子之间腾点地方。

english: I's be seein' ya drop it on tha' way out, 'ere 'tis.
translation: 我看到你出门时把它掉了，给你。

english: Ello there [player name]!
translation: 你好啊，[player name]！

english: Your empire will crack and gnomes will become but a joke.
translation: 你的帝国将会崩溃，而侏儒只会沦为笑话。

english: Well you know that pebble I gave to you? I found it again. Would you like it back?
translation: 嗯，你记得我之前给你的那颗鹅卵石吗？我又找到了。你想要回去吗？

english: Oh... That reminds me... Seeing as you like elven things, I found this.
translation: 哦……这倒提醒我了……既然你喜欢精灵的东西，我找到了这个。

english: These hob-gobs aren't very smart are they? Anyhow, it's funny you should show up...
translation: 这些霍布哥布林不太聪明，对吧？总之，你来得正好……

english: If you wanna go in there with them hob-gobs that's your business.
translation: 如果你想跟那些霍布哥布林一起进去，那是你的事。

english: Better now I'm on the right side of them bars. I hope that pebble helped you out.
translation: 现在好多了，我在栏杆这边。希望那颗鹅卵石帮到了你。

english: Better now I'm on the right side of them bars. Anyhow, it's funny you should show up...
translation: 现在好多了，我在栏杆这边。总之，你来得正好……

english: Anyway I have lots to do. Them hob-gobs left my stuff out here in a right mess.
translation: 总之我有很多事要做。那些霍布哥布林把我的东西扔得到处都是，乱糟糟的。

english: Alright then, but it's here if you ever need it.
translation: 好吧，但如果你需要，它就在这儿。

english: These hob-gobs aren't very smart are they? I hope that pebble helped you out.
translation: 这些霍布哥布林不太聪明，对吧？希望那颗鹅卵石帮到了你。

english: That's me. I've been stuck in here for weeks, those goblins are trying to steal my family's heirlooms. My grandad gave me all sorts of old junk.
translation: 那就是我。我被困在这里几个星期了，那些哥布林想偷我家的传家宝。我爷爷给了我各种各样的旧垃圾。

english: Thanks a lot for the key traveller. I think I'll wait in here until those goblins get bored and leave.
translation: 非常感谢你的钥匙，旅行者。我想我会在这里等着，直到那些哥布林感到无聊离开。

english: Time is of the essence! You should spend less time chatting more time delivering if you want to get it done on time.
translation: 时间紧迫！如果你想按时完成，就应该少聊天多送货。

english: What? That's hardly professional - if you accept a job you should do it...
translation: 什么？这太不专业了——既然接了活就该好好干……

english: Oh alright...
translation: 好吧……

english: You seem to be missing your delivery box, do you want another one?
translation: 你好像弄丢了你的送货箱，要不要再要一个？

english: Here you go don't lose this one.
translation: 给你，这次可别弄丢了。

english: I cannot offer you a hard job at this time. But I can offer you an easy job.
translation: 我现在没法给你一个困难任务，但可以给你一个简单任务。

english: Are you sure you want to turn this order down, you'll have to wait 5 minutes before I can give you another easy order. I may have a hard one available for you though...
translation: 你确定要拒绝这个订单吗？你得等5分钟我才能给你另一个简单订单。不过也许我可以给你一个困难订单……

translation: 这是战斗洞穴，特扎尔.希尔为了练习而建造的，但很多贾利特也来这里战斗。只要进入洞穴，确保你准备好了就行。

english: Come back when you have a cape of fire, JalYt.
translation: 等你有了火焰斗篷再回来吧，贾利特。

english: You defeated TzTok-Jad, I am most impressed! Please accept this gift. Give cape back to me if you not want it.
translation: 你击败了特兹托克.贾德，我印象深刻！请收下这份礼物。如果你不想要，就把斗篷还给我。

english: You'we on uw own now JawYt, pwepawe to fight fowuw wife!
translation: 你现在只能靠自己了，贾利特，准备为你的生命而战吧！

english: You not wucky. Maybe next time, JawYt.
translation: 你运气不好。也许下次吧，贾利特。

english: You even defeated TzTok-Jad, meam most impwessed!Pwease accept dis gift.Give cape back to me if u not want it.
translation: 你甚至击败了特兹托克.贾德，我印象深刻！请收下这份礼物。如果你不想要，就把斗篷还给我。

english: Are you not JalYt-Ket?
translation: 你不是贾利特.凯特吗？

english: You even defeated TzTok-Jad, me am most impwessed!Pwease accept dis gift.Give cape back to me if u not want it.
translation: 你甚至击败了特兹托克.贾德，我印象深刻！请收下这份礼物。如果你不想要，就把斗篷还给我。

english: Are you not JalYt-Hur-Kal-hHZAelu0B0iV?
translation: 你不是贾利特.赫尔.卡尔-hHZAelu0B0iV吗？

english: Then you JalYt-Xil-Kal!
translation: 那你就是贾利特.希尔.卡尔！

english: Are you not JalYt-Xil-Kal-[player name]?
translation: 你不是贾利特.希尔.卡尔-[player name]吗？

english: You want help JalYt-Ket-Moohbeespakerpen?
translation: 需要帮忙吗，贾利特.凯特.穆比斯帕克彭？

english: You want help JalYt-Mej-PennyMynattait?
translation: 需要帮忙吗，贾利特.梅杰.彭尼迈纳泰特？

english: These spots are the best thing since log rollers!
translation: 这些斑点比原木滚轮还棒！

english: Well you see, since the outbreak of the plagues, the city has been under quarantine and has been unable to import anything.
translation: 你看，自从瘟疫爆发以来，城市就一直被隔离，无法进口任何东西。

english: So, no quarried rock has been able to get in. So, we have had no work to do. I hope the plague lasts forever.
translation: 所以，没有采石运进来，我们就没活可干。我希望瘟疫永远持续下去。

english: I would take a dermatological irritation over back- breaking, mind-numbing labour any day. Although, there are other downsides.
translation: 我宁愿得皮肤病，也不愿每天干那些累死人的苦役。不过，也有其他坏处。

english: Word has it that you very nearly spoiled our fun!
translation: 听说你差点坏了我们的好事！

english: Well, the cows have the plague too, so all they produce is sour milk...and plagued beef has me considering the unthinkable.
translation: 唉，奶牛也得了瘟疫，所以它们产的奶都是酸的……至于受感染的牛肉，我正考虑一些不敢想的事。

english: No, something far worse!
translation: 不，是更糟糕的事！

english: Vegetarianism!A visible shiver runs down the back of the slave.
translation: 素食主义！奴隶的背脊明显打了个寒颤。

english: So that we could get back to work again? What makes you believe that he even deserves such a burial?
translation: 好让我们能重新干活？你凭什么觉得他配得上这样的葬礼？

english: What, even those that gain through the blood, sweat, tears and misery of others?
translation: 什么，连那些靠别人的血汗、眼泪和苦难获利的人也包括在内？

english: You know - when your epidermis...
translation: 你知道——就是你的表皮……

english: Your hide? Your skin? Your bark?
translation: 你的皮？你的皮肤？你的树皮？

english: And, word has it, you're out to do the same again.
translation: 而且，听说你又要重蹈覆辙。

english: Because once they're back, we'll have to start working again.
translation: 因为他们一旦回来，我们就得重新干活了。

english: I know your type, trying to ruin the small man's fun. Well, I won't have it.
translation: 我懂你这种人，就想破坏小人物的乐子。我可不答应。

english: An impostor... Die scum!
translation: 假冒的……去死吧，渣滓！

english: Ha ha! I warned you that it's strong stuff. A good meal may sober you up a bit. I could part with some food for a few coins.
translation: 哈哈！我警告过你这东西劲很大。吃顿好饭或许能让你清醒一点。我可以拿点食物换几个金币。

english: Nothing like a *hic* bit of home brew before getting to work. Speaking of which *hic*, shouldn't you be talking to that Baxtorian elf?
translation: 没什么比得上*呃*开工前来点自酿的。说到这个*呃*，你不该去跟那个巴克斯托里安精灵谈谈吗？

english: Well good luck. Remember to use those gauntlets to protect yourself from the soulless, their bite is vicious.
translation: 祝你好运。记住用那些护手保护自己免受无魂者的伤害，它们咬人可狠了。

english: I have something else that might help you. I crafted these to protect myself from the teeth of the soulless, their bite is vicious.
translation: 我还有其他东西可能对你有帮助。我制作了这些来保护自己免受无魂者牙齿的伤害，它们咬人可狠了。

english: Anyway, have some food to aid your journey.
translation: 总之，拿些食物来帮助你上路吧。

english: You'd better go speak to Baxtorian, friend. The battle is about to begin.
translation: 你最好去和巴克斯托里安谈谈，朋友。战斗就要开始了。

english: There's nothing light down here. Anyway, have some food to aid your journey.
translation: 这里没什么轻便的东西。总之，拿些食物来帮助你上路吧。

english: Very well adventurer. Head on in when you're ready. You'll soon come to a bridge, I will catch up with you there.
translation: 很好，冒险者。准备好了就进去吧。你很快会遇到一座桥，我会在那里追上你。

english: Hello there. I have some food here if you need some.
translation: 你好。我这里有些食物，如果你需要的话。

english: Hello adventurer. Have you found the way across yet?
translation: 你好，冒险者。你找到过桥的方法了吗？

english: I'm afraid not. It's possible that whoever was here before left something of use behind though. I had a look through their things and found some cloth along with the charred remains of some arrows.
translation: 恐怕不行。不过，之前在这里的人可能留下了一些有用的东西。我翻看了一下他们的东西，找到了一些布料和一些烧焦的箭矢遗骸。

english: Their stuff is by the fire if you want to have a look.
translation: 他们的东西在火堆旁，如果你想看看的话。

english: Hello, how's things?
translation: 你好，最近怎么样？

english: She lives on the platforms above, we dare not go there. Here, take some food to aid your journey.
translation: 她住在上面的平台上，我们不敢去那里。拿着，带些食物助你上路。

english: The enemy has arrived. You'd better go talk to Baxtorian.
translation: 敌人来了。你最好去跟巴克斯托里安谈谈。

english: Well it's a good job I found it.
translation: 幸好我找到了它。

english: Traveller, good to see you!
translation: 旅行者，很高兴见到你！

english: We're looking into how we can safely block the tunnel for your elf friends. We don't want to bring the cavern down on everyone.
translation: 我们正在研究如何安全地堵住隧道，帮你的精灵朋友们。我们不想把洞穴弄塌压到所有人。

english: I see. Well fear not, I will ensure our forces are ready to fight back against this threat.
translation: 我明白了。不过别担心，我会确保我们的军队准备好反击这个威胁。

english: I do indeed. However, I worry you might not be ready to carry it out. Are you sure you're up for it?
translation: 我确实有计划。不过，我担心你还没准备好执行它。你确定你应付得来？

english: I appreciate your enthusiasm adventurer. However, I fear you are not yet ready for the challenges ahead. Return to me when you are and we will discuss our next steps.
translation: 我感谢你的热情，冒险者。不过，恐怕你还没准备好面对前方的挑战。等你准备好了再来找我，我们讨论下一步。

english: Very well. Now, I recently managed to make contact with the elves that inhabit the western lands.
translation: 很好。最近我设法联系上了居住在西部土地上的精灵。

english: I appreciate your enthusiasm adventurer but are you sure you're ready for this?
translation: 我感谢你的热情，冒险者，但你确定你准备好了？

english: My training ground is open to you if needed. Return to me when you are ready and we will discuss our next steps.
translation: 如果需要的话，我的训练场对你开放。等你准备好了再来找我，我们讨论下一步。

english: Very well. Return to me when you are and we will begin.
translation: 很好。等你准备好了就回来找我，我们开始。

english: Ah... [player name], how goes your exploration? Any luck finding my brother?
translation: 啊……[player name]，你的探索进展如何？找到我兄弟了吗？

english: What are you doing here then? I'm counting on you [player name].
translation: 那你在这里干什么？我可是指望你呢，[player name]。

english: Greetings. I'm just preparing for my departure to Varrock.
translation: 你好。我正在准备前往维洛克城。

english: I do indeed. However, I fear you are not yet ready to carry it out. Return to me when you are and we will begin.
translation: 我确实有计划。不过，恐怕你还没准备好执行它。等你准备好了再来找我，我们开始。

english: Sorry, I'm a bit busy at the moment. Could you come back later?
translation: 抱歉，我现在有点忙。你能晚点再来吗？

english: There's been an uprising in West Ardougne, we need to gather the soldiers and put a stop to this now!
translation: 西阿多尼城发生了起义，我们需要集结士兵，现在就要制止他们！

english: Liar! You've put it in your bank!
translation: 骗子！你把它放进银行了！

english: Well I would give you another letter if you had space to carry it.
translation: 如果你有空间携带的话，我会再给你一封信。

english: You're not one of the slaves assigned to this mine! Get back to the pens!
translation: 你不是分派到这座矿场的奴隶！回围栏去！
sub_category: Dialogue for Vampyre Juvinate (Daeyalt essence mine)

english: Do not disturb me. I must keep an eye on these slaves.
translation: 别打扰我。我得盯着这些奴隶。

english: You deaf? We're getting some delicious blood tithes from these sacks of food.
translation: 你聋了吗？我们正从这些食物麻袋里收取美味的血税。

english: You do not need to collect taxes from me. Begone with you!
translation: 你不需要向我收税。滚开！

english: This is the best food on the island. Everyone else here eats fish. Quite often raw because the cook can't be bothered to cook any more.
translation: 这是岛上最好的食物。其他人都吃鱼。而且经常是生的，因为厨师懒得再煮了。

english: I don't think so, sleazeball.
translation: 我不这么认为，人渣。

english: You'll find me under Edgeville. I'll be here when you need a new task.
translation: 你会在边陲镇下面找到我。当你需要新任务时，我就在这里。

english: My name's Vannaka, I'm the Slayer Master best able to train you.
translation: 我叫范纳卡，我是最能训练你的杀戮大师。

english: Certainly! I hope you don't get seasick, it's a long voyage.
translation: 当然！希望你不会晕船，航程挺长的。

english: Oh err... Nothing important. Just something that might be of use to me back in Great Kourend.
translation: 呃……没什么重要的。只是些回库兰德王国后可能用得上的东西。

english: Well here we are friend. Welcome to the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 好了，我们到了，朋友。欢迎来到库兰德王国。

english: I am here on a bit of a hunt. The hunt for treasure. Back in my home of Great Kourend, I came across a scroll. I believe it will lead me to something of great value.
translation: 我来这里是为了进行一次狩猎。寻宝的狩猎。在我的家乡大库兰德，我发现了一张卷轴。我相信它会指引我找到价值非凡的东西。

english: As a matter of fact, [player name], I do.
translation: [player name]，说实话，我确实有。

english: Alas, I've hit a bit of a blocker. The scroll has led me here but as I don't really know the area, I'm not sure what to do next. Maybe you could help with this.
translation: 唉，我遇到了点阻碍。卷轴把我带到了这里，但我对这片区域不太熟，不知道下一步该怎么做。也许你能帮上忙。

english: I'm here on a bit of a treasure hunt. Back in Kourend, I came across a scroll. I believe it will lead me to something of great value.
translation: 我来这里是为了进行一场寻宝游戏。在库兰德王国，我偶然发现了一个卷轴。我相信它会指引我找到非常有价值的东西。

english: Now Kourend is a big place and it can be quite intimidating at first. If you need any help just let me know.
translation: 库兰德王国是个很大的地方，一开始可能会让人望而生畏。如果你需要任何帮助，就告诉我。

english: Of course not. But you'll need to prove that to them. If you want to unlock everything Kourend has to offer, you'll have to earn the favour of her people.
translation: 当然不是。但你需要向他们证明这一点。如果你想解锁库兰德王国提供的一切，你必须赢得她子民的好感。

english: However, since our last King died 20 years ago, the kingdom has instead been ruled by an elected council.
translation: 然而，自从我们上一任国王在20年前去世后，王国就改由选举产生的议会统治了。

english: Well I find that the best way to get someone to like you is to help them out in some way. If you assist the people of Kourend, they'll soon come to like you.
translation: 嗯，我发现让别人喜欢你的最好方法就是以某种方式帮助他们。如果你帮助库兰德王国的人民，他们很快就会喜欢上你。

english: Anyway, I'd best be getting back to Great Kourend. You're welcome to come along. In fact, as a thank you for your help, I'm willing to take you to and from Great Kourend any time you like.
translation: 总之，我最好还是回库兰德王国了。欢迎你跟我一起去。事实上，为了感谢你的帮助，我愿意随时带你去库兰德王国并把你送回来。

english: Now this may seem like a strange place to you, but to the people of Kourend you are the strange one. Don't expect them to trust you right away.
translation: 对你来说，这可能看起来是个奇怪的地方，但对库兰德王国的人民来说，你才是那个奇怪的人。别指望他们会立刻信任你。

english: However, since our last king died 20 years ago, the kingdom has instead been ruled by an elected council.
translation: 然而，自从我们上一任国王在20年前去世后，王国就改由选举产生的议会统治了。

english: They'll also tell all of their friends about you, and you'll quickly make a name for yourself as someone who can be trusted.
translation: 他们还会把你的事情告诉所有的朋友，你很快就会因为值得信赖而名声在外。

english: Anyway, if you're looking for a good way to get to know the kingdom a bit better, I do have a job you might be interested in.
translation: 对了，如果你想找个好办法更好地了解这个王国，我倒有份差事你可能会感兴趣。

english: Yes, I heard it too... They mentioned that your task was complete.
translation: 是的，我也听说了……他们提到你的任务已经完成了。

english: Here's that reward I promised you.
translation: 这是我答应给你的报酬。

english: Wonderful! In that case, let's be getting off. I hope you don't get seasick by the way, it's a long voyage.
translation: 太好了！那我们就出发吧。顺便说一句，希望你不会晕船，航程挺长的。

english: I came across this scroll. Did you lose it by any chance?
translation: 我偶然发现了这卷卷轴。是你丢的吗？

english: This is the port of Piscarilius. Home to Kourend's finest fisherman but beware of the thieves!
translation: 这里是皮斯卡里琉斯城港口。库兰德最棒的渔夫的家园，但要小心小偷！

english: Further west is Lovakengj, where you'll find our best miners and smithers working to arm the Shayzien soldiers to the south east.
translation: 再往西是洛瓦肯吉城，那里有我们最优秀的矿工和铁匠，他们正在为东南方的谢兹恩城士兵打造装备。

english: Not right now, I'm afraid. Do keep checking in though. I often have jobs that need doing.
translation: 恐怕现在没有。不过记得常来看看，我经常有需要帮忙的活儿。

english: That scroll I given to you is special. When written on with a particular type of quill, my client will see what you're writing without anything being seen on the scroll itself.
translation: 我给你的那卷卷轴很特别。用一种特殊的羽毛笔在上面写字时，我的委托人能看到你写的内容，但卷轴本身却看不出任何痕迹。

english: This is the scroll I gave you. I don't know how to solve it I'm afraid. Maybe look for someone called Bob?
translation: 这就是我给你的卷轴。恐怕我也不知道该怎么解。也许可以找个叫鲍勃的人问问？

english: Worry not, [player name], I have many of those scrolls. Luckily, due to the way it works, you haven't lost any information on it!
translation: 别担心，[player name]，那种卷轴我有很多。幸好因为它的工作原理，你没有丢失任何信息！

english: Actually, [player name], I'll need you to return with room in your backpack before I can give you this quest.
translation: 事实上，[player name]，你得先把背包腾出空间再来找我，我才能给你这个任务。

english: You already have your scroll, [player name], I can literally see it peeking out of your backpack...
translation: 你已经拿到你的卷轴了，[player name]，我都看见它从你背包里露出来了……

english: Ah a cipher, I've seen these before. Try shifting the letters one to the left or right. That normally works.
translation: 啊，是密码。我以前见过。试着把字母往左或往右移动一位，通常这样就能解开了。

english: I came across this orb. Did you lose it by any chance?
translation: 我偶然发现了这个宝珠。是你丢的吗？

english: I do have some things for you. You'll need more space to hold them though.
translation: 我确实有些东西要给你，但你需要更多空间来装。

english: My client requires... another simple task. They assure me that it will be the last. Take the orb I handed to you, and activate it beside the Dark Altar, north of Arceuus.
translation: 我的委托人需要……另一项简单的任务。他们向我保证这是最后一次了。拿着我给你的宝珠，到阿西乌斯城北边的黑暗祭坛旁激活它。

english: Not to worry. Just make some room in your inventory and I'll give it back to you.
translation: 别担心。把你的背包腾出点空间，我就还给你。

english: Well could you go and get it then?
translation: 那你能去把它拿来吗？

english: Interesting, these are quite rare. They work using temperature. The closer you are to the treasure, the hotter the orb.
translation: 有意思，这东西相当稀有。它们利用温度工作。你离宝藏越近，宝珠就越热。

english: Interesting... These are quite rare. They work using temperature. The closer you are to the treasure, the hotter the orb.
translation: 有意思……这东西相当稀有。它们利用温度工作。你离宝藏越近，宝珠就越热。

english: Ah a cipher. I've seen these before. Try shifting the letters one to the left or right. That normally works.
translation: 啊，是密码。我以前见过。试着把字母往左或往右移动一位，通常这样就能解开了。

english: [player name]... I can't thank you enough. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future, I can repay you.
translation: [player name]……我真是感激不尽。我没有什么报酬，但对我来说这意义重大。也许将来我能够报答你。

english: Well unfortunately it seems that you're not quite ready to visit Great Kourend yet. Come back when you are and I'll happily take you there.
translation: 可惜看来你还没准备好去库兰德王国。等你准备好了再来找我，我很乐意带你去。

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, [player name]. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make me
translation: 真的吗？你愿意为我这么做？太感谢你了，[player name]。我感激不尽！自从那件事发生后，我的心里一直充满悔恨……我想如果能找回科珀的一小部分，就能让我

english: complete again.
translation: 重新完整起来。

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, [player name]. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make
translation: 真的吗？你愿意为我这么做？太感谢你了，[player name]。我感激不尽！自从那件事发生后，我的心里一直充满悔恨……我想如果能找回科珀的一小部分，就能让我

english: me complete again.
translation: 重新完整起来。

english: Looks like a map to me. I'd assume the X marks where you need to dig.
translation: 对我来说像是一张地图。我猜那个X标记就是你需要挖掘的地方。

english: [player name]... I can't thank you enough for what you've done for me. I don't have a reward, but know that to me, this means so much. Perhaps in the future I can repay you.
translation: [player name]……你为我做的一切我真是感激不尽。我没有什么报酬，但对我来说这意义重大。也许将来我能够报答你。

english: Ah that. I bought it at an auction a while back. Apparently, it belonged to the daughter of King Kharedst IV, the final monarch of Great Kourend.
translation: 啊，那个啊。我是在一次拍卖会上买到的。据说它属于卡雷斯德四世国王的女儿——他是库兰德王国的最后一位君主。

english: I'd imagine the fox which killed Copper will likely still have the collar in their possesion. They were nearby a Fremennik town.
translation: 我想那只杀死科珀的狐狸应该还带着那个项圈。它们当时在弗雷门尼克镇附近。

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, [player name]. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make me complete
translation: 真的吗？你愿意为我这么做？太感谢你了，[player name]。我感激不尽！自从那件事发生后，我的心里一直充满悔恨……我想如果能找回科珀的一小部分，就能让我重新

english: again.
translation: 完整起来。

english: It's nice to share these kind of things sometimes, [player name].
translation: 有时候分享这些东西感觉真好，[player name]。

english: Actually, [player name], I need to give you something. Return to me when you have room in your backpack.
translation: 事实上，[player name]，我需要给你点东西。等你背包腾出空间了再来找我。

english: Whewe wouwd u wike to go?
translation: 泥想区哪来？

english: It's fine, [player name]. You didn't know.
translation: 没关系，[player name]。你之前不知道。
