translation: 真的吗？你愿意为我这么做？太感谢你了，[player name]。我感激不尽！自从那件事发生后，我的心里一直充满悔恨……我想如果能找回科珀的一小部分，就能重新

english: make me complete again.
translation: 让我重新完整起来。

english: Truly? You'd do that for me? Thank you so much, Fe Colombian. I can't thank you enough! My heart's been filled with regret ever since it happened... and I think having a small part of Copper back, would make me
translation: 真的吗？你愿意为我这么做？太感谢你了，Fe Colombian。我感激不尽！自从那件事发生后，我的心里一直充满悔恨……我想如果能找回科珀的一小部分，就能让我

english: Hello again, Did you ever hear the Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the wise? I thought not. It's not a story the Jedi would tell you. It's a Sith legend. Darth Plagueis was a Dark Lord of the Sith, so powerful and so wise he could use the Force to influence the midichlorians to create life... He had such a knowledge of the dark side that he could even keep the ones he cared about from dying. The dark side of the Force is a pathway to many abilities some consider to be unnatural. He became so powerful... the only thing he was afraid of was losing his power, which eventually, of course, he did. Unfortunately, he taught his apprentice everything he knew, then his apprentice killed him in his sleep. It's ironic he could save others from death, but not himself.! What can I do for you?
translation: 嗨，又见面了。你有没有听说过达斯.普雷格斯的悲剧？我想你没有。那不是绝地会告诉你的故事。这是一个西斯传说。达斯.普雷格斯是一位西斯黑暗尊主，他强大而睿智，能运用原力影响迷地原虫来创造生命……他对黑暗面了如指掌，甚至能让他所关心的人免于死亡。黑暗面原力是通往许多被认为不自然的能力的途径。他变得如此强大……他唯一害怕的就是失去力量，当然他最终还是失去了。不幸的是，他把自己所知的一切都教给了他的学徒，然后他的学徒在睡梦中杀了他。讽刺的是，他能拯救别人免于死亡，却救不了自己。有什么事需要我帮忙吗？

english: It is the wizards' helping hand - let 'em up.
translation: 这是法师们的援手——放他们上去。

english: Mmm! But not just now, t'anks.
translation: 嗯！但不是现在，谢谢。

english: Ugh - that's not the sort I want.
translation: 呃——这不是我想要的那种。

english: You probably stored it somewhere, silly t'ing.
translation: 你大概把它存放在什么地方了，傻东西。

english: Small t'ing, how could you be so careless? Here, take this one.
translation: 小东西，你怎么能这么粗心？来，拿着这个。

english: Small t'ing, how could you be so careless? Come for another when you have the space to hold it.
translation: 小东西，你怎么能这么粗心？等你腾出地方再来拿另一个。

english: I got somet'ing to give you, so you can help me, but you got to have some free space to carry it. Come see me when you do.
translation: 我有东西要给你，这样你就能帮我了，但你必须腾出一些空位来装。准备好了就来找我。

english: Stoopid! I have another, but you can't even take it!
translation: 蠢货！我还有另一个，但你连装都装不下！

english: Grrr, why do I bother? I got another part but you can't even hold it yet!
translation: 哼，我干嘛费这个劲？我还有另一部分，但你现在还拿不了！

english: I take that off you.
translation: 我从你那里拿走这个。

english: You know who I is?
translation: 你知道我是谁吗？

english: I hit you!
translation: 我打你！

english: I am Gorad, and you are tiny. Go now and I won't chase you!
translation: 我是戈拉德，而你是个小不点。现在走吧，我不会追你的！

english: That'll annoy Gorad lots! Now free up some more space so I can give you something.
translation: 那会让戈拉德很生气！现在腾出点空间，我好给你点东西。

english: I suppose you want another? I suppose if you had some free space I could give you my copy...
translation: 我猜你还想要一个？我想如果你有空位，我可以把我那份给你……

english: Stupid morsel. I have another. Come take it when you have free space to carry it.
translation: 愚蠢的小东西。我还有一份。等你空出手来拿的时候就来拿吧。

english: Hey, you can't go climbing all over the city! Use the path!
translation: 嘿，你不能在城里到处乱爬！走大路！

english: Hur, hur, hur. Well done imp, but you haven't got anywhere for me to put the reward, have you?
translation: 呵，呵，呵。干得好，小恶魔，但你好像没地方让我放奖励，对吧？

english: Come back again when you have and I might reward you.
translation: 等你有地方了再来，我可能会奖励你。

english: What's the point? Go away, and dont bother me again until you have space for a replacement!
translation: 有什么意义？走开，在你腾出地方放替换品之前别来烦我！

english: Gor cur...
translation: 戈尔 库尔……

english: Ar, ar cur!
translation: 阿，阿 库尔！

english: Ar cur!
translation: 阿 库尔！

english: Gor nod!
translation: 戈尔 诺德！

english: Bidith ig!
translation: 比迪斯 伊格！

english: Thank you, kind sir.
translation: 谢谢你，好心的先生。

english: Thank you, kind madam.
translation: 谢谢你，好心的女士。

english: Ah, master. You did well to understand our language.
translation: 啊，主人。你能听懂我们的语言，真是厉害。

english: I cannot help you, but the others can.
translation: 我帮不了你，但其他人可以。

english: Let me tells you the most common skavid words:
translation: 我来告诉你最常见的斯卡维德语词汇：

english: Ar, nod, gor, ig and cur.
translation: 阿、诺德、戈尔、伊格和库尔。

english: Those will gets you started.
translation: 这些够你入门了。

english: Hehe! So you speak a little skavid, eh?
translation: 嘿嘿！你懂一点斯卡维德语，嗯？

english: I'm impressed. Here, take this prize. The others are with the shamans in the enclave - you'll never get them back.
translation: 佩服。拿着，这份奖励。其他的在飞地里的萨满那里——你永远拿不回来了。

english: They hid one in the sacred rock - nothing can touch it now.
translation: 他们把一块藏在神圣岩石里——现在谁也碰不到了。

english: I haves no more for you.
translation: 我没有更多东西给你了。

english: I'll be on my way, then.
translation: 那我就走了。

english: You make space to carry it, eh?
translation: 你腾出空间来装它，嗯？

english: Stop bothering me, minion!
translation: 别烦我，小喽啰！

english: Ugh, what's this? I hate them!
translation: 呃，这是什么？我讨厌这东西！

english: Grrr. Trying to pay me off, are you?
translation: 哼。想收买我，是吗？

english: What's this? Something to wipe your nose with? How dare you!
translation: 这是什么？给你擦鼻子的东西？你好大的胆子！

english: What am I supposed to do with this junk?
translation: 你让我拿这垃圾干什么？

english: I've seen these before. A servant's nails, ugh!
translation: 我以前见过这些。仆人的指甲，呃！

english: May you have success in your task.
translation: 愿你任务顺利。

english: Yes, those will do nicely.
translation: 没错，这些正好。

english: Well done, well done! You are clever; hold onto it until you have all four.
translation: 干得好，干得好！你很聪明；先留着它，等集齐四个再说。

english: Keep searching for the others. If you've dropped any, then you will need to go back to where you got it from.
translation: 继续找其他的。如果你掉落了任何一个，就得回到你拿到它的地方去。

english: Perhaps you just forgot where you stored it.
translation: 也许你只是忘了放在哪里。

english: You will also need some jangerberries. Those go into the mix before the final ingredient.
translation: 你还需要一些姜格莓。在放最后一种材料之前，要把它们加进去。

english: Magnificent! At last you've brought all the crystals. Now the shield generator can be activated and, once again, Yanille will be safe from the threat of the ogres.
translation: 太棒了！你终于把所有的水晶都带来了。现在可以激活盾发电机了，亚尼勒城将再次免受食人魔的威胁。

english: You need a guam leaf.
translation: 你需要一片瓜姆叶。

english: You will need to add that first.
translation: 你得先把那个加进去。

english: Throw the lever to activate the system.
translation: 拉动拉杆来激活系统。

english: Bring me all four of the crystals before you try putting them on the pillars.
translation: 在你试图把水晶放到柱子上之前，先把四个都带给我。

english: You'll have to get that magic potion back from wherever you've stored it, I think.
translation: 我想你得从你存放的地方把那瓶魔法药水拿回来。

english: No, no. The potion is not complete yet.
translation: 不，不。药水还没完成。

english: Yes, I'll take that off you.
translation: 好，我收下那个。

english: Oh dear, what am I to do? The safety of this whole area is in jeopardy!
translation: 哎呀，我该怎么办？整个地区的安全都岌岌可危！

english: Yes, that is the potion I enchanted for you.
translation: 没错，那就是我为你附魔的药水。

english: Ummm, is that so? I can't help you there, I never was much good at puzzles.
translation: 嗯，是吗？这我可帮不了你，我向来不擅长解谜。

english: It is the ogre statue I finished for you.
translation: 这是我为你完成的食人魔雕像。

english: Yes indeed, this city is very ancient. It's not clear whether the ogres actually constructed it, or whether they took it over from another race.
translation: 没错，这座城市非常古老。不清楚是食人魔建造的，还是他们从另一个种族手中夺来的。

english: Indeed, these ogres have harnessed the black arts. They wield great power.
translation: 确实，这些食人魔掌握了黑魔法。他们拥有强大的力量。

english: Indeed they are, but you must confront them to break the power of the ogres. They MUST be beaten!
translation: 他们确实很厉害，但你必须去对抗他们，瓦解食人魔的力量。他们必须被打败！

english: Never mind, clear some space and I'll give you another one.
translation: 没关系，腾出点空间，我再给你一个。

english: What I can tell you is that the whole city is controlled by a group of ogre shamans.
translation: 我能告诉你的是，整座城市都被一群食人魔萨满控制着。

english: That's the spirit! May your search prove fruitful.
translation: 这才对嘛！愿你的搜索硕果累累。

english: Well, well - a map! Indeed, this shows the paths into the skavid caves, so you can go in there.
translation: 哎呀呀，一张地图！没错，这显示了通往斯卡维德洞穴的路径，这样你就能进去了。

english: Alright, but I'd prefer it if you didn't keep asking me for this.
translation: 好吧，但我希望你别一直问我要这个。

english: This is grave news. Make another and then talk to me, and I will see if I can enchant it.
translation: 这是坏消息。再做一个，然后跟我说话，我会看看能不能给它附魔。

english: Scared? To get this far and to falter now... Perchance, you are not ready for the final challenge?
translation: 害怕了吗？走到这一步却退缩……莫非你还没准备好迎接最后的挑战？

english: Leave that alone!
translation: 别碰那个！

english: I can't let you use this now, it's just too dangerous. I'd better take it from you before you injure yourself.
translation: 我现在不能让你用这个，太危险了。最好还是在你伤到自己之前把它收走。

english: It looks like you've brought me all the pieces of the relic. Free up some space and I'll try fixing it for you.
translation: 看来你把遗物的所有部件都带来了。腾出点空间，我试着帮你修好它。

english: What? Lost the relic? How careless! Free up some space and I'll give you a copy.
translation: 什么？遗物丢了？太粗心了！腾出点空间，我给你一份复制品。

english: I'm sorry, but I can't do that right now
translation: 抱歉，我现在不能那么做。

english: When we heard of a magical presence in these Western lands, the Wizards' Tower had no choice but to send out a research party.
translation: 当我们听说西方大陆有魔法存在时，法师塔别无选择，只能派出一支研究队。

english: I'm afraid I can't make you any more now. You need 3 pieces of bark, 3 pieces of fine cloth and 32,000 coins for splitbark legs.
translation: 恐怕我现在不能再给你做了。你需要3块树皮、3块精布和32000金币来制作裂皮腿。

english: I'm afraid I can't make you any more now. You need 4 pieces of bark, 4 pieces of fine cloth and 37,000 coins for a splitbark body.
translation: 恐怕我现在不能再给你做了。你需要4块树皮、4块精布和37000金币来制作一件裂皮甲。

english: When we heard of a magical presence in these western lands, the Wizards' Tower had no choice but to send out a research party.
translation: 当我们听说西方大陆有魔法存在时，法师塔别无选择，只能派出一支研究队。

english: I'm afraid I can't make you any more now. You need 2 pieces of bark, 2 pieces of fine cloth and 6,000 coins for a splitbark helm.
translation: 恐怕我现在不能再给你做了。你需要2块树皮、2块精布和6000金币来制作一个裂皮头盔。

english: Okay! Good luck!
translation: 好的！祝你好运！

english: I need bark from a hollow tree, and some fine cloth. Unfortunately both these items can be found in Morytania, especially the cloth which is found in the tombs of shades.
translation: 我需要空心树的树皮和一些精布。不幸的是，这两样东西都可以在莫利塔尼亚找到，尤其是布料，可以在阴魂的坟墓里找到。

english: 1 need 1 piece of each for either gloves or boots, 2 pieces of each for a hat, 3 pieces of each for leggings, and 4 pieces of each for a top.
translation: 制作手套或靴子每样各需要1份，制作帽子各需要2份，制作护腿各需要3份，制作上衣各需要4份。

english: I'll charge you 1,000 coins for either gloves or boots, 6,000 coins for a hat 32,000 coins for leggings, and 37,000 for a top.
translation: 手套或靴子我会收你1000金币，帽子6000金币，护腿32000金币，上衣37000金币。

english: Split-bark armour is special armour for mages, it's much more resistant to physical attacks than normal robes. It's actually very easy for me to make, but I've been having trouble getting hold of the pieces.
translation: 裂皮盔甲是专为法师设计的特殊盔甲，它比普通长袍更能抵抗物理攻击。实际上对我来说制作起来非常容易，但我一直很难搞到材料。

english: Certainly, what would like to me to make?
translation: 当然，你想让我制作什么？

english: Hand it to me, and I'll get to work.
translation: 把它交给我，我来动手。

english: You should probably free up some inventory space first.
translation: 你最好先腾出一些背包空间。

english: Certainly; how far have you got?
translation: 当然；你进展到哪了？

english: Most of these small caves are actually just the ends of various tunnels running through the ice. If you follow the cliff for a little way, you should be able to find more. Try searching around some of those and see if
translation: 这些小型洞穴大多其实是冰层中各种隧道的末端。沿着悬崖走一小段，你应该能找到更多。试着搜索其中一些，看看是否……

english: you can pick up the trail.
translation: 你能重新找到踪迹。

english: I'd suggest looking for places the creature may have squeezed through and, hence, left some sort of mark. Try examining one of those tunnel entrances in the ice near the end of your trail. That might give you some
translation: 我建议寻找生物可能挤过去的地方，从而留下某种痕迹。试着检查你踪迹末端附近冰层中的一个隧道入口。那可能会给你一些……

english: ideas.
translation: 启发。

english: Well, I'm sure you will do some day, although don't be too disappointed if you don't manage to catch one without some more practice in Hunter first. Kyatts are incredibly fearsome, and the sabre-toothed kyatts around
translation: 嗯，我相信总有一天你能做到，不过如果没能在猎人技能上多练练就捉到，也别太失望。凯亚特兽非常可怕，尤其这里周围的剑齿凯亚特兽……

english: here especially so.
translation: 尤其如此。

english: I'd suggest looking for places the creature may have squeezed through and, hence, left some sort of mark. Try examining one of those old hollow logs near the end of your trail. That might give you some ideas.
translation: 我建议寻找生物可能挤过去的地方，从而留下某种痕迹。试着检查你踪迹末端附近的一根空心老原木。那可能会给你一些启发。

english: It sounds like the creature might be hiding somewhere very near, then. Polar kebbits will quite often hide in the snow to evade predators. Try looking for some disturbed snow near the end of the trail.
translation: 听起来那只生物可能就藏在很近的地方。极地凯比特兽经常躲在雪里躲避捕食者。试着在踪迹末端附近寻找被搅乱的雪地。

english: You do? That's excellent work. Lets hear it then.
translation: 你知道吗？干得漂亮。那说来听听。

english: Oh, you want to work in another area of the mine eh?--The guard seems pleased with his rhetorical question.--Well, I can understand that! A change is as good as arest they say.
translation: 哦，你想去矿场的其他地方工作，嗯？——守卫似乎对自己的反问很满意。——嗯，我能理解！俗话说，换换环境等于休息。

english: We don't have many murders here in Gielinor and I'm afraid we wouldn't have been able to solve it by ourselves. We will hold him here under house arrest until such time as we bring him to trial.
translation: 吉莱诺这里谋杀案不多，恐怕我们自己也破不了案。我们会把他软禁在这里，直到开庭审判。

english: Now now. Come along quietly. There'll be no revenge where YOU'RE going  - Port Sarim Jail.
translation: 好了好了。乖乖跟我走。你要去的地方——沙林港监狱，可报不了仇。

english: I said stay there, outerlander! You're not welcome in our camp.
translation: 我说了站着别动，外地人！我们的营地不欢迎你。

english: Sorry, sir, nobody's allowed down there by order of the King.
translation: 抱歉，先生，奉国王之命，任何人不得进入那里。

english: Sorry, mister 'Regent', nobody can go into the dungeons without the King's say-so.
translation: 抱歉，“摄政王”先生，没有国王的许可，任何人不得进入地牢。

english: Well, if I were him, I would learn as much as I can about the Sinclair family history.
translation: 嗯，如果我是他，我会尽可能多地了解辛克莱尔庄园家族的历史。

english: How did you get down here?!
translation: 你是怎么到这儿来的？！

english: Hey! Get away from that door!
translation: 嘿！离那扇门远点！

english: Halt! The city is on lockdown until the rebel elves are dealt with.
translation: 站住！城市已封锁，直到叛乱精灵被解决为止。

english: We don't have many murders here in Gielinor, and I'm afraid we wouldn't have been able to solve it by ourselves. We will hold her here under house arrest until such time as we bring her to trial.
translation: 吉莱诺这里谋杀案不多，恐怕我们自己也破不了案。我们会把她软禁在这里，直到开庭审判。

english: Sorry, madam, nobody's allowed down there by order of the King.
translation: 抱歉，女士，奉国王之命，任何人不得进入那里。

english: Hey you, move away from there!
translation: 嘿，你，从那儿走开！

english: Hey! What are you doing here? Get out!
translation: 嘿！你在这儿干什么？滚出去！

english: Hmm... it all seems to be in order.
translation: 嗯……看起来一切正常。

english: Ordinary members aren't allowed down here! You should get back upstairs.
translation: 普通会员不允许到这里来！你应该回到楼上去。

english: Ah! Of course. And we know where they've gone because of the note about the camel.
translation: 啊！当然。我们之所以知道他们去了哪里，是因为那张关于骆驼的笔记。

english: Sorry, miss 'Regent', nobody can go into the dungeons without the King's say-so.
translation: 抱歉，“摄政王”小姐，没有国王的许可，任何人不得进入地牢。

english: Hey, what are you doing? You can't go in there.
translation: 嘿，你在干什么？你不能进去。

english: Well, if I were her, I would learn as much as I can about the Sinclair family history.
translation: 嗯，如果我是她，我会尽可能多地了解辛克莱尔庄园家族的历史。

english: What do you want - leave us be!
translation: 你想干什么——别来烦我们！

english: That's true, but we don't know that the Sinclairs have actually gone to Camelot. For all we know the knights were there just for social reasons.
translation: 说得没错，但我们不知道辛克莱尔庄园的人是不是真的去了卡梅洛特。说不定那些骑士只是去社交的。

english: Oh right! With this evidence and the armour you brought me, we know they had intentions to do harm to King Arthur.
translation: 哦对啊！有了这些证据和你带来的盔甲，我们知道他们意图伤害亚瑟王。

english: Welcome back, Sir.
translation: 欢迎回来，先生。

english: Sorry - workman's entrance only. Go around to the front of the Museum to get in.
translation: 抱歉，只有工人入口。绕到博物馆前面进去。

english: Nothing right now, we have it all under control.
translation: 目前没什么事，一切都在掌控之中。

english: Welcome back, Madam.
translation: 欢迎回来，女士。

english: Hello. I haven't seen you around here before. If you've come to admire The Carnillean family home I must warn you not to cause any trouble.
translation: 你好。我以前没在这一带见过你。如果你是来参观卡尼利恩家族住宅的，我必须警告你不要惹麻烦。

english: Glad to hear it. Let's keep it that way, hmmm?
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。那就继续保持，嗯？

english: Due to recent criminal activities against such a prominent member of Ardougnian politics I have been sent here on special guard duty to ensure the Carnilleans' security.
translation: 由于最近针对阿多尼政坛如此显要人物的犯罪活动，我被派到这里执行特别守卫任务，以确保卡尼利恩家族的安全。

english: Anyone caught interfering with the person or possessions of any Carnilleans will be taken to Jail so quickly their feet won't touch the floor!
translation: 任何被抓住干涉卡尼利安人的人身或财产的人，会被迅速送进监狱，连脚都来不及着地！

english: That pineapple was just delicious, many thanks. I don't suppose you could get me another?-- The guard looksat you pleadingly.
translation: 那个菠萝真是太好吃了，非常感谢。你能不能再给我弄一个？——守卫用恳求的眼神看着你。

english: There is nothing for you here, outerlander.
translation: 这里没你的事，外地人。

english: Run along then. If I catch you again you're in trouble!
translation: 那就快走吧。要是我再抓到你，你就有麻烦了！

english: Sorry, but only guards are allowed up there.
translation: 抱歉，只有守卫才能上去。

english: Why the demoninikin are you waving THAT at me?
translation: 你他妈干嘛朝我挥那个？

english: Oh, these store rooms house all the worldly belongings the members gave up when they joined the group. Some of them are quite valuable.
translation: 哦，这些储藏室存放着成员加入组织时放弃的所有世俗财物。其中一些还挺值钱的。

english: Oh, its you again.
translation: 哦，又是你。

english: Don't worry, they're quite safe here! We keep the keys to the chests on us. We put this wealth to good use in our fight against the monsters.
translation: 别担心，它们在这里很安全！箱子的钥匙我们随身带着。我们把这些财富用于对抗怪物的战斗。

english: Well well well... if it isn't our very own local hero. Good to see you managed to clear your name I always had faith in you!
translation: 哎呀呀……这不是我们本地的英雄吗。很高兴看到你成功洗清了罪名，我一直都相信你！

english: What's that you have there?
translation: 你手里拿的是什么？

english: You again? Didn't I make it clear you're not welcome around here? Clear off before you make me get rough with you!
translation: 又是你？我没说清楚这里不欢迎你吗？赶紧走开，别逼我跟你动粗！

english: I'm guarding troublesome prisoners. They think they can get away with attacking the guards. Well, we taught them a thing or two.
translation: 我在看守麻烦的囚犯。他们以为袭击了守卫就能逃掉。哼，我们给他们点颜色瞧瞧。

english: Oh, of course you did.
translation: 哦，你当然知道。

english: Sorry, not interested in your pineapple! You must have me confused with someone else!
translation: 抱歉，对你的菠萝没兴趣！你肯定认错人了！

english: If you're really the Regent, ask the King to write you another.
translation: 如果你真是摄政王，那就让国王再给你写一份。

english: Yes, I know, you gave it to me already. It was a change of address form.
translation: 是，我知道，你已经给过我了。那是一张地址登记表。

english: Good! Now put those sleuthing skills to work.
translation: 好！那就发挥你的侦查技能吧。

english: That's the thread you found at the crime scene.
translation: 那就是你在犯罪现场找到的线。

english: I should think so too, now get back to work.
translation: 我也这么觉得，现在回去工作吧。

english: Yes, I know, you gave it to me already. It was a note about meeting at Camelot.
translation: 是，我知道，你已经给过我了。那是一张关于在卡梅洛特会面的笔记。

english: I heard from the other guards you won your trial. You let a murderer get away.
translation: 我从其他守卫那里听说你赢了官司。你让一个杀人犯逃掉了。

english: Why are you showing me this?
translation: 你给我看这个干嘛？

english: Well, make some space and then come back to get it.
translation: 好吧，腾出点空间，然后回来拿。

english: Yes, I know, you gave it to me already. It was a piece of armour from the Black Knights.
translation: 是，我知道，你已经给过我了。那是黑骑士的一件盔甲。

english: Take that you mad child of a dog!
translation: 接招吧，你这个疯狗崽子！

english: Welcome to the magic emporium.
translation: 欢迎光临魔法商店。

english: I heard from Zavistic what a good job you did. If you want some more pink dye, I have made up a batch and you can have some for 20 gold.
translation: 我听扎维斯提克说你干得很棒。如果你还想要些粉红色染料，我新做了一批，20金币就能卖你一些。

english: Well, if you see anyone who is into magic, please send them my way.
translation: 嗯，如果你遇到对魔法感兴趣的人，请介绍他们到我这儿来。

english: I'm afraid you don't have space in your pack for anything more, come back when you do.
translation: 恐怕你的背包里没有空间再装东西了，等有空位再来吧。

english: Oh don't worry about that deary, I have plenty of bottles and you can start the whole thing again.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，别担心那个，我还有很多瓶子，你可以从头再来一遍。

english: Here, have another bottle.
translation: 来，再给你一个瓶子。

english: Oh don't worry about that deary, I have plenty and you can start the whole thing again.
translation: 哦，亲爱的，别担心那个，我还有很多，你可以从头再来一遍。

english: I'd let you have another but you don't seem to have a spare hand to carry it, come back when you have room.
translation: 我本想再给你一个，但你似乎腾不出手来拿，等你有空位再来吧。

english: You're actually very strong, are you sure you don't want Mazchna in Morytania to assign you a task?
translation: 你其实很强，你确定不想让莫利塔尼亚的马斯纳给你指派任务吗？

english: Slaying in the Wilderness is hard - I could give you a new assignment, if you'd like.

english: If you do get a new one, you will reset your standard task streak of [player name]. Is that okay? It won't affect your Wilderness task streak of 23.
translation: 如果你确实拿到了一个新的，你将重置你的[player name]的标准任务连续次数。可以吗？这不会影响你的23次荒野任务连续次数。

english: Pass it to me and I'll put it on the brazier. Okay?
translation: 把它递给我，我把它放在火盆上。行吗？

english: Erm, no thanks.
translation: 呃，不用了。

english: Your choice of headgear is spot on, don't lose that!
translation: 你的帽子选得真准，别弄丢了！

english: I've put the clothes back in the chest.
translation: 我已经把衣服放回箱子里了。

english: The weapon is perfectly suited to me.
translation: 这把武器非常适合我。

english: The item you gave me for my legs is perfect, I'd change something else.
translation: 你给我的腿甲非常完美，但我还想换点别的。

english: Not what I want, but it was pretty close.
translation: 虽然不是我最想要的，但也差得不远。

english: To the footwear I say: good choice!
translation: 至于鞋子，我要说：选得好！

english: The body armour couldn't be better, keep that!
translation: 这件身体盔甲再好不过了，留着它！

english: I suppose so, but you can't take your follower with you. It wouldn't be fair.
translation: 我猜也是，但你不能带着你的随从。那样不公平。

english: I've put the clothes back in the chest, sorry.
translation: 我把衣服放回箱子里了，抱歉。

english: That armour just doesn't suit me.
translation: 那件盔甲不适合我。

english: Good start. Go back to the bank and see what you can get from Jack.
translation: 有个好的开始。回银行看看能从杰克那里拿到什么。

english: For me? Sorry, I don't really need anything right now.
translation: 给我的？抱歉，我现在什么都不需要。

english: Haven't you got more... important things to do?
translation: 你就没有更重要的事要做了吗？

english: How about you just try to help me?
translation: 不如试着帮帮我？

english: I've put the clothes back in the chest. I'm not impressed.
translation: 我把衣服放回箱子里了。我并不满意。

english: Please, take them back, it's not quite what I'm after.
translation: 请拿回去吧，这不太符合我的要求。

english: Thank youMod Lars. I would surely be dead without you.
translation: 谢谢你，Mod Lars。没有你我肯定死定了。

english: You're not really selling this you know.
translation: 你这推销可不怎么样。

english: Well yes, but why should I do it?
translation: 嗯，是没错，但我凭什么要做呢？

english: No. You could try Tegid by the lake though. He does all the laundry.
translation: 不，你可以试试找湖边的特吉德。所有洗衣服的活都是他干的。

english: Heehee... he say he warrior... I not heard that one for... at leas' 5 minutes!
translation: 嘻嘻...他说他是战士...我至少...五分钟没听过这个了！

english: Heehee... she say she warrior... I not heard that one for... at leas' 5 minutes!
translation: 嘻嘻...她说她是战士...我至少...五分钟没听过这个了！

english: Very well. Oh and when you see that lazy toadBrimstail, tell him next time he needs information tocome himself.
translation: 很好。哦，还有，你要是看到那只懒蛤蟆布林斯泰尔，告诉他下次要情报就自己来。

english: I never studied it, but I believe it used elven magic -So it must have used crystals of some sort. Crystaldiscs, yes that sounds familiar.  Actually come to thinkof it I think I may have one lying around.  Here take
translation: 我从未研究过它，但我相信它使用了精灵魔法——所以它一定用了某种水晶。水晶盘，对，听起来耳熟。实际上，我想起来我可能有一个闲置的。给你。

english: Nobody knows for certain, somewhere rocky I suppose.The rumour is that after founding his new home,Glouphrie used his magicks to shroud the city in mist.Arposandra may not exist at all, however I suspect that
translation: 没人确切知道，我想是在某个多岩石的地方。传闻说，格洛弗里在建立他的新家之后，用他的魔法将城市笼罩在雾中。阿波桑德拉可能根本不存在，不过我怀疑...

english: Old magicks beyond your skill human. You can stopflapping your big human lips as well.  Just think.
translation: 古老魔法远超你的能力，人类。你那张大嘴也可以停歇了。只管去想。

english: Both armies moved to claim the lands, and were ofcourse destined to meet in battle...
translation: 两军都出动争夺土地，自然注定要在战场上相遇……

english: And so it came to pass the Goblin and Gnome armiesmet at the Battle of Atarisundri.
translation: 于是，哥布林和地精的军队在阿塔里桑德里之战中相遇了。

english: I'm reading your mind foolish human. How do youthink?  Now CLEAR YOUR MIND...
translation: 我正在读你的心思，愚蠢的人类。你以为呢？现在清空你的思绪……

english: Both sides faced each other on the Battlefield. A bloodybattle was in prospect, our gnomes were brave, but wewere no match for the mass of brute goblin stupidity...
translation: 双方在战场上对峙。一场血战在即，我们的地精很勇敢，但面对那群蛮横的哥布林蠢货，我们不是对手……

english: Just shut up and listen! I have a story to tell you thatwill answer most of your questions.
translation: 闭嘴好好听着！我要给你讲个故事，能解答你大部分疑问。

english: ... but Glouphrie and King Healthorg had devised aplan...
translation: ……但格洛弗里和海尔索格国王设计了一个计划……

english: And so, Glouphrie created an army of illusory Gianttortoises, knowing that goblins would be scared ofanything bigger than they were.
translation: 于是，格洛弗里创造了一支幻象巨龟大军，他知道哥布林会被任何比他们大的东西吓到。

english: I rushed straight back to the Grand Tree, only to findthat no-one had noticed anything, and that Argento wasstill standing and seemed alive.  But I knew somethingwas wrong. He refused to talk to me and his aura was
translation: 我直接冲回大树家园，却发现没人注意到任何异常，阿根托还站着，似乎还活着。但我知道不对劲。他拒绝与我交谈，他的气场……

english: And I knew that one of the Old Ones had died, and Ihad lost a friend.
translation: 我知道一位古老者已经逝去，我失去了一个朋友。

english: Then I felt a sudden pain, as if the Anima Mundi wascrying out with the loss of a favoured child....
translation: 然后我突然感到一阵剧痛，仿佛世界灵魂因失去一个宠爱的孩子而哀嚎……

english: I felt a shadow pass over me, and a tingling in the air,even though the weather was fine and dry.
translation: 我感到一片阴影掠过，空气中一阵刺痛，尽管天气晴朗干燥。

english: Stop wittering on [player name]. You're giving me aheadache.  This mind speech is hard enough withouthaving to listen to your incoherent babbling. Thinkabout nothing. Clear your mind.
translation: 别唠叨了，[player name]。你让我头疼。这心灵交流已经够难了，还得听你语无伦次的胡言乱语。什么都别想。清空你的思绪。

english: ... If you don't lead an invincible army - pretend youdo...
translation: ……如果你没有一支无敌军队——那就假装有……

english: Let us travel back in time, to the time you humans callthe Fourth Age. King Healthorg had become King.The elves mysteriously decided to travel west, leavingmost of Kandarin open for conquest. The humans
translation: 让我们回到过去，回到你们人类称为第四纪元的时代。海尔索格国王成为了国王。精灵们神秘地决定向西迁徙，使得坎达林王国的大部分地区敞开了征服之门。人类

english: no longer present.  Someone had hidden his death.  Italked to Oaknock and he was incensed.  Heimmediately blamed Glouphrie, and although Oaknockcould be rather irrational when it came to Glouphrie -
translation: 不再在场。有人隐藏了他的死亡。我跟奥克诺克谈了，他非常愤怒。他立刻指责格洛弗里，尽管奥克诺克在涉及格洛弗里时相当不理性——

english: And so Glouphrie left and travelled with somecompanions to a place they called Arposandra. We haveheard nothing but rumours about them since...
translation: 于是格洛弗里离开，与一些同伴前往他们称之为阿波桑德拉的地方。此后我们只听到关于他们的传闻……

english: weren't here yet, only King Healthorg and the gnomesto the north, and a collection of Goblin tribes to thesouth.
translation: 那时还不在这里，只有北方的海尔索格国王和地精，以及南方的一群哥布林部落。

english: There was once a very special Spirit Tree in theStronghold. Silver as a birch, old and wise - Iconsidered him a friend. I called him Argento, his truename was unpronouncable.
translation: 要塞里曾经有一棵非常特别的灵魂树。银白如桦树，古老而智慧——我视他为朋友。我叫他阿根托，他的真名无法发音。

english: they never saw eye to eye - I knew he was right thistime.  Glouphrie had used his magicks to hide the truthfrom all of us.
translation: 他们从未意见一致——但我知道这次他是对的。格洛弗里用他的魔法向我们所有人隐瞒了真相。

english: Oaknock had made a machine - an anti-illusion machine,with some help from the elves.  He prepared it, andsummoned the advisors to Argento..
translation: 奥克诺克制造了一台机器——一台反幻觉机器，在精灵的帮助下。他准备好后，召集了顾问们去见阿根托……

english: He was the first Spirit Tree I had befriended, and theone I knew the best. I would sometimes travel, visitingand finding other Spirit trees, and during one such trip,I was filled with a great sense of foreboding...
translation: 他是我结交的第一棵灵魂树，也是我最了解的一棵。我有时会旅行，拜访和寻找其他灵魂树。在一次这样的旅途中，我充满了巨大的不祥预感……

english: Sadly, the golden times were not destined to last forlong...
translation: 可惜，黄金时代注定无法长久持续……

english: Well, I never expected to be impressed by a human,but you have done a good deed for the gnomes - evenif most gnomes won't recognise it.  You humans arenot as stupid as I first thought...
translation: 嗯，我从没想过会被一个人打动，但你为地精们做了一件好事——尽管大多数地精不会承认。你们人类并不像我最初认为的那么愚蠢...

translation: 别唠叨了，[player name]。你让我头疼。这心灵交流已经够难了，还得听你语无伦次的胡言乱语。什么都别想。清空你的思绪。

english: What do you want now? Go and talk to Brimstail, that'swhy you came to see me in the first place...
translation: 你现在想要什么？去找布林斯泰尔谈吧，你一开始来找我就是因为这个……

english: Concentrate! I can't maintain a connection if you letyour mind wander.  Watch and Listen!
translation: 集中注意力！如果你任由思绪飘散，我无法维持连接。看和听！

english: Oh that's right young human, anyway...
translation: 哦，对了，年轻的人类，总之……

english: ... ethereal link ... failed ... puny human mind ...insufficiently disciplined ... mental rigour required ...trained ... magical skills ...
translation: ……灵体连接……失败……渺小的人类心智……缺乏训练……需要严谨心性……受过训练的……魔法技能……

english: You still haven't fixed the machine yet have you?
translation: 你还没修好那台机器，是吧？

english: Stop wittering on [player name]. You're giving mea headache.  This mind speech is hard enough withouthaving to listen to your incoherent babbling. Thinkabout nothing. Clear your mind.

english: Hmph. Come back when you have some space in yourpack.
translation: 哼。等你背包有空位再来。

english: Well, I do remember seeing Oaknock using the saw.He said it allowed him to build devices more complicatedthat even he was capable of constructing. The device hebuilt must have been very complicated indeed.
translation: 嗯，我确实记得见过奥克诺克用那把锯子。他说这让他能建造甚至他自己都造不出的更复杂的装置。他造的装置一定非常复杂。

english: Stop wittering on [player name]. You're givingme a headache.  This mind speech is hard enoughwithout having to listen to your incoherent babbling.Think about nothing. Clear your mind.
translation: 别唠叨了，[player name]。你让我头疼。这心灵交流已经够难了，还得听你语无伦次的胡言乱语。什么都别想。清空你的思绪。

english: Either talk to an elf or find some other way to sing tothe crystal. If this came from Oaknock, he must havefound a way...
translation: 要么跟精灵谈谈，要么找别的办法对水晶唱歌。如果这是奥克诺克留下的，那他一定找到了方法……

english: The seed is a piece of elven magic, all elven magiccomes from the manipulation of seeds of crystal. Theelves give it divine properties. Elves sing to theircrystals and they form into the desired shape.
translation: 种子是精灵魔法的一部分，所有精灵魔法都源于对水晶种子的操控。精灵赋予它神圣属性。精灵对水晶唱歌，水晶就会形成想要的形状。

english: Hmm, well done - the machine seems to be working.Though I don't know what you're doing here.  It lookslike you have work to do in the Stronghold.  Thosecreatures - need to be destroyed. If this is what
translation: 嗯，做得好——机器似乎能用了。不过我不知道你来这里做什么。看起来你在要塞里有事要办。那些生物——需要被消灭。如果这就是……

english: Glouphrie is up to these days, then I have to admit -I'm a bit worried.
translation: 格洛弗里最近在搞的勾当，那我得承认——我有点担心。

english: Oh no! The surface-dwellers are coming to kill us all!
translation: 哦不！地面上的人要来杀光我们了！

translation: 你是怎么进到洞穴里来的？

translation: 这么说现在有个入口了。我们的与世隔绝结束了……

english: Hello Zanik! Are you out hunting giant frogs?
translation: 你好，扎尼克！你是出来猎杀巨型青蛙的吗？

english: You must collect some of the tears using Zanik's tear- bowl. Although I would not normally deem you worthy to collect the tears, I will let you into the cave for this special purpose.
translation: 你必须用扎尼克的泪碗收集一些泪水。虽然我通常不会认为你有资格收集泪水，但我会让你进入洞穴，为了这个特殊目的。

translation: 你必须用扎尼克的泪碗收集一些泪水。这次不会算入你下次自行收集泪水的次数。

translation: 距离你上次来访还没多久。明天再来吧。

translation: 你的故事娱乐了我。但我不会允许任何冒险者每周接触泪水超过一次。七天后回来吧。

translation: 从来没有一个故事比朱丽叶和她的罗密欧更令人悲伤了。

translation: 海盗们总是这么愚蠢，把掠夺物埋在地下，好让别人再挖出来。

translation: 我怕你没有什么新故事可以告诉我了。如果你到时有更多冒险经历，七天后再来吧。

translation: 你应该利用那段时间去冒险！在你有更多故事可讲之前，不得再进入洞穴。

english: The Dorgeshuun goblins have been good neighbours during my vigil here. They are a timid race, but not cowardly, and I am glad they have the peace they desire.
translation: 多吉舒恩的哥布林在我守夜期间一直是好邻居。他们是个胆小的种族，但并不懦弱，我很高兴他们得到了渴望的和平。

english: You should pick up your pet. This is no time to have an animal at your feet to trip you up.

translation: 看来你没什么故事可讲！完成一两个任务，然后回来告诉我所有细节。

translation: 自从这些被创造以来，已经过去了无数个纪元。无数凡人出生、生活、然后按照平衡的要求死去。他们一定知道多少故事啊！

english: It's over Dragonkin. The island is ours. You have lost.
translation: 结束了，龙人。这座岛是我们的。你输了。

english: No. Now it ends.

english: No. That dragonkin mentioned a weapon, one that could destroy us all. Better something like that remains hidden.

english: Here is my pendant. Now, I cannot stay here much longer. Meet me in my house, across the river south- east from Edgeville. It is next to the so-called Grand Exchange.

english: Well if you see any be sure to point them in my direction.
translation: 好吧，如果你看到任何（龙人），一定要指给我看。

english: I told you not to meet me here again!
translation: 我告诉过你不要再来这里见我！

english: Hah! I knew it! I expect you want my Aphro-Dizzy- Yak spell! Want someone to fall madly in love with you, eh?
translation: 哈！我就知道！你是想要我的‘迷情牦牛’法术吧！想让某个人疯狂地爱上你，嗯？

english: My slave will destroy you, [player name]!
translation: 我的奴隶会干掉你的，[player name]！

english: Never you mind! It's a secret!
translation: 不关你的事！这是个秘密！

english: Of course. Hmmm. However, I could let you in on a secret, if you like?
translation: 当然。嗯……不过，我可以告诉你一个秘密，你想听吗？

english: You will need the 15 chaos runes in your inventory. Make sure you also have either a chaos talisman or chaos tiara to complete the infusion.
translation: 你的背包里需要准备好15个混沌符文。同时，你还需要一个混沌护符或混沌头冠来完成充能。

english: Bring the infused wand and a bowl to me and I will make us both rich!
translation: 把充能法杖和一个碗带给我，我们就能一起发财了！

english: Look, I am very busy so please come back another time! And, no, your gold isn't ready yet! These spells take time.
translation: 听着，我很忙，请改天再来！还有，你的金子还没准备好！这些法术需要时间。

english: I told you, you can deliver that letter for me to the trader, Rat. He's the man who sent you here in the first place, remember?
translation: 我告诉过你，你可以替我把那封信送给商人老鼠。就是他让你来这儿的，还记得吗？

english: Other than that, I am very busy so please come back another time! And, no, your gold isn't ready yet!
translation: 除此之外，我很忙，请改天再来！还有，你的金子还没准备好！
