english: Was there something else you wanted to ask good old Tiffy, milady?
translation: 你还有其他事想问老蒂菲吗，女士？

english: Sorry dear boy but we are still in the process of organising.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的孩子，我们还在组织筹备中。

english: We usually lose some equipment when he does so, but its a small price to pay to be hale and hearty again, what?
translation: 他这么做时我们通常会损失一些装备，但为了恢复健康强健，这点代价不算什么，是吧？

english: What ho, old gal. Well, hand it over and let's have a look, shall we?
translation: 啊哈，老姑娘。好吧，把它交出来，让我们看看，好吗？

english: Well, I may have a mission for you, but you need to have a higher Runecrafting skill to even attempt it.
translation: 嗯，我可能有个任务给你，但你需要更高的符文制作技能才能尝试。

english: Yes, yes. All in good time. I'll have to consult my commanding officer first. Thank you lad, you're dismissed.
translation: 好的，好的。时机合适时会处理的。我得先咨询我的指挥官。谢谢你，小子，你可以走了。

english: Oh dear. Well, thank you very much, young lad. You've been a great help. I shall pass it on to my superiors.
translation: 哦，天哪。好吧，非常感谢你，小伙子。你帮了大忙。我会把它转交给我的上级。

english: Apparently not. It appears that a millennia-old battle is still being fought beneath the ruins of the temple, and the prize for winning the battle is the Godsword! Hmm... Well, thank you very much, young lass. You've been a
translation: 显然不是。看来一场持续千年的战斗仍在寺庙废墟下进行，而赢得这场战斗的奖品就是神剑！嗯……好吧，非常感谢你，小姑娘。你帮了

english: Yes, yes. All in good time. I'll have to consult my commanding officer first. Thank you, lass, you're dismissed.
translation: 好的，好的。时机合适时会处理的。我得先咨询我的指挥官。谢谢你，姑娘，你可以走了。

english: Well, I may have a mission for you, but you need to have completed the Sea Slug quest first.
translation: 嗯，我可能有个任务给你，但你需要先完成海蛞蝓任务。

english: Sorry dear gal but we are still in the process of organising.
translation: 抱歉，亲爱的姑娘，我们还在组织筹备中。

english: Heavens, girl! I am not a pawn shop, to be holding bits and pieces for you while you go off and do something else!
translation: 天哪，姑娘！我可不是当铺，不能在你去做别的事时帮你保管零碎东西！

english: Yes, yes. All in good time. I'll have to consult my commanding officer first. Thank you lass, you're dismissed.
translation: 好的，好的。时机合适时会处理的。我得先咨询我的指挥官。谢谢你，姑娘，你可以走了。

english: Liase with Savant about the best way to track Solus, what? And... good luck.
translation: 去和学者联络一下，找出追踪索勒斯的最佳方法，对吧？还有……祝你好运。

english: Oh dear. Well, thank you very much, young lass. You've been a great help. I shall pass it on to my superiors.
translation: 哦，天哪。好吧，非常感谢你，小姑娘。你帮了大忙。我会把它转交给我的上级。

english: Well, I may have a mission for you, but you need to have a higher Thieving skill to even attempt it.
translation: 嗯，我可能有个任务给你，但你需要更高的偷窃技能才能尝试。

english: Well, I may have a mission for you, but you need to have a higher Slayer skill to even attempt it.
translation: 嗯，我可能有个任务给你，但你需要更高的杀戮技能才能尝试。

english: Well, sorry to hear you say that old gal, but I can't hold it against you.
translation: 嗯，听你这么说很遗憾，老姑娘，但我不会怪你的。

english: Well, sorry to hear you say that old boy, but I can't hold it against you.
translation: 嗯，听你这么说很遗憾，老伙计，但我不会怪你的。

english: Well, I may have a mission for you, but you need to have a higher Crafting skill to even attempt it.
translation: 嗯，我可能有个任务给你，但你需要更高的制作技能才能尝试。

english: We've got your back Os Paxar Services. Now you show that dragon what for!
translation: 我们支持你，奥克斯.帕克萨服务。现在就让那条龙见识见识你的厉害！

english: No thanks, old girl, I'm not taking that off you. Get a normal one from a Slayer Master.
translation: 不了谢谢，老姑娘，我不会从你那里收下这个的。去找杀戮大师拿一个普通的吧。

english: You can earn more points by completing tasks assigned by me or one of the other Slayer masters throughout Gielinor.
translation: 你可以通过完成我或吉列诺其他杀戮大师指派的任务来赚取更多积分。

english: When you start to become adept at slaying, you'll begin to receive tasks that can be especially lucrative. So get training!
translation: 当你开始精通杀戮之道时，就会接到一些特别有利可图的任务。所以，去练练吧！

english: My father, Turael in Burthorpe, has the authority to assign you something else. You might want to speak with him if you seek a different task.
translation: 我父亲，伯索普公国的图拉尔，有权为你指派其他任务。如果你想换个任务，可以去找他谈谈。

english: Up until now, so long as they were left alone, they'd keep to themselves. Rumours are, they live in deep underground caverns, scavenging what they can find.
translation: 到目前为止，只要不去招惹它们，它们就会安分守己。有传言说，它们住在深深的地下洞穴里，靠捡拾能找到的东西为生。

english: No, you still have the last pair I gave you!
translation: 不，我上次给你的那副你还在用呢！

english: You can, but it doesn't look like you have any free inventory space at the moment.
translation: 可以是可以，但你背包里好像没空位了。

english: My dear man, I couldn't possibly duel you, I might hurt you and then what would happen to my reputation! Besides, I have this wonderful guild to run. Why don't you take a look at the various activities we
translation: 亲爱的先生，我可不能跟你决斗，万一伤到你，我的名声可就毁了！再说了，我还要打理这个精彩的公会呢。你不妨看看我们提供的各种活动……

english: Well you see my dear boy, the games there really do sap your energy quite a bit. You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.
translation: 你看，亲爱的孩子，那里的游戏确实很耗费精力。你可以在银行后面的楼梯上去找到它。

english: My dear lady, I couldn't possibly duel you, I might hurt you and then what would happen to my reputation! Besides, I have this wonderful guild to run. Why don't you take a look at the various activities we
translation: 亲爱的女士，我可不能跟你决斗，万一伤到你，我的名声可就毁了！再说了，我还要打理这个精彩的公会呢。你不妨看看我们提供的各种活动……

english: Oh no my dear man, I did not mean you at all! The training area has mechanical dummies which pop up out of holes in the floor. The noble dwarf Gamfred invented the mechanism and Ajjat can explain more about what
translation: 哦不，亲爱的先生，我说的完全不是您！训练区有机械假人从地板上的洞里冒出来。高贵的矮人甘弗雷德发明了这个机关，阿加特可以解释更多关于……

english: Farewell brave warrior, I do hope you enjoy my guild.
translation: 再见，勇敢的战士，希望你喜欢我的公会。

english: Well you see my dear lady, the games there really do sap your energy quite a bit. You can find it just up the stairs behind the bank.
translation: 你看，亲爱的女士，那里的游戏确实很耗费精力。你可以在银行后面的楼梯上去找到它。

english: Farewell fair lady, I do hope you enjoy my guild.
translation: 再见，美丽的女士，希望你喜欢我的公会。

english: Oh no my dear lady, I did not mean you at all! The training area has mechanical dummies which pop up out of holes in the floor. The noble dwarf Gamfred invented the mechanism and Ajjat can explain more about what
translation: 哦不，亲爱的女士，我说的完全不是您！训练区有机械假人从地板上的洞里冒出来。高贵的矮人甘弗雷德发明了这个机关，阿加特可以解释更多关于……

english: You'll find me in Canifis. I'll be here when you need a new task.
translation: 你会在坎尼非斯村找到我。当你需要新任务的时候我就在这里。

english: My name's Mazchna, I'm the Slayer Master best able to train you.
translation: 我叫马斯纳，我是最能训练你的杀戮大师。

english: You are going to need to do few things, You'll need a waking sleep potion, a Lunar staff, and ceremonial travelling clothes. Start with the potion, I suggest you go have a word with Baba Yaga in her chicken house,
translation: 你需要做几件事：你需要一份清醒睡眠药水、一根月之杖和一套仪式旅行衣服。从药水开始，我建议你去鸡舍找芭芭雅嘎谈谈。

english: Well we've never actually done a shared dream between a human and a cat before, it shouldn't be any different though. You'll just need another Potion of Shared Dreaming.
translation: 嗯，我们其实从未做过人类和猫之间的共享梦境，不过应该没什么不同。你只需要另一份共享梦境药水。

english: You know it's really not that hard, you just need a bit of magic on your side. Anyway, Bob and I go way back.
translation: 你知道这其实没那么难，你只需要一点魔法帮助。总之，鲍勃和我是老相识了。

english: You're forgetting I can read you mind. I simply looked to see what you knew you were carrying, and analysed the average amount a person can carry and extrapolated...
translation: 你忘了我能读心。我只是看了看你知道自己携带了什么，然后分析了普通人能携带的平均量，并进行了推断……

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 30000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！30000金币！

english: I'll give you a vial. You'll need to fill it with water followed by one ground astral rune and some goutweed.
translation: 我给你一个药瓶。你需要先装满水，然后加入一个磨碎的星界符石和一些痛风草。

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 10000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！10000金币！

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 15000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！15000金币！

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 120000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！120000金币！

english: Deary me. Come back later then and I shall pass one to you.
translation: 哎呀。那晚点再来吧，我会给你一个。

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 2000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！2000金币！

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 80000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！80000金币！

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 12000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！12000金币！

english: Lunar Isle - why don't you go have a look around town.
translation: 月亮岛——你为什么不去镇上四处看看呢。

english: But it's going to cost you! It will be 4000 coins!
translation: 但这是要收费的！4000金币！

english: Why would you want to know that? you've already given me the Lunar ring to look after.
translation: 你为什么想知道那个？你已经把月之戒交给我保管了。

english: I would gladly say yes...
translation: 我很乐意说可以……

english: If you didn't already have some in the costume room of your house!
translation: 如果你家里服装室里没有一些的话！

english: And did you find what you were looking for?
translation: 你找到你要找的东西了吗？

english: Be cautious in this quest, that vault could contain all manners of evil. Never forget that violent delights have violent ends.
translation: 在这个任务中要小心，那个金库可能藏有各种邪恶。永远不要忘记，暴虐的欢乐必有暴虐的结局。

english: You'ww find a monstew cawwed da Suqah that is indigenousto dis iswand. You'ww need one of daiw hides to makeuw twousews, which u can tan onwy in dis town
translation: 你会找到一种叫苏卡的怪物，它是这座岛上的土著。你需要一张它们的皮来做你的裤子，你只能在这个镇子上鞣制。

english: Hunting! Meow! Yes hunting iss good.
translation: 打猎！喵！是的，打猎很好。

english: I feel as old as the last rat I killed and seeing as it was so tender and juicy, it must have been fairly young.
translation: 我感觉自己和我杀的最后一只老鼠一样老，而且那只老鼠又嫩又多汁，肯定还挺年轻的。

english: I don't know. Master knows me thinks.
translation: 我不知道。主人应该知道吧。

english: Don't patronise me with your ratsies. And if you were such a good master why don't you play with me or rub my tummy?
translation: 别拿你的老鼠来敷衍我。如果你真是个这么好的主人，为什么不陪我玩，或者揉揉我的肚子？

english: Don't be so sure.
translation: 别这么肯定。

english: Aahh, that was fun!
translation: 啊哈，真有趣！

english: They weren't very tough!
translation: 他们不太厉害嘛！

english: A green gnome? Now there's a blast from the past - even I wasn't around back in your day! Why are you here, you little marvel?
translation: 一个绿色地精？这可真是老古董了——连我都没活到你那个年代！你来这儿干嘛，你这小宝贝？

english: My lovely blue hat is seen as an historic artefact? That is most gratifying! I had not expected that my... little shopping trip... would become such a renowned event in your culture.
translation: 我那可爱的蓝色帽子被视为历史文物？这真是太令人欣慰了！我可没想到我那次……小小的购物之旅……会在你们的文化中成为如此著名的事件。

english: Oh, alright. I've got plenty of spares from that time I filled in for Santa at Christmas.
translation: 哦，好吧。我那次圣诞节替圣诞老人代班时，还留了不少备用的。

english: Have a good Easter, [player name]! And you too, strange rabbit!
translation: 复活节快乐，[player name]！还有你也是，奇怪的兔子！

english: Between the three of us, we managed to have the entire village decorated in no time!
translation: 我们三个齐心协力，很快就装饰好了整个村子！

english: Then Aggie arrived and wanted to get involved...
translation: 然后阿吉来了，也想掺和进来……

english: Ned agreed, and we had a laugh painting and decorating.
translation: 内德同意了，我们一边油漆一边装饰，笑得很开心。

english: I thought it looked rather good, and asked if he'd help decorate my front door.
translation: 我觉得那颜色挺好看的，就问他能不能帮我装饰一下前门。

english: He thought the colour would be a good base for some Easter decorations.
translation: 他觉得这颜色很适合作为复活节装饰的底色。

english: It started about... ooohh... ten minutes ago when Ned realised someone had painted his door.
translation: 事情大概是从……呃……十分钟前开始的，当时内德发现有人油漆了他的门。

english: It started about... ooohh... 10 minutes ago when Ned realised someone had painted his door.
translation: 事情大概是从……呃……10分钟前开始的，当时内德发现有人油漆了他的门。

english: Perhaps I can answer that question.
translation: 也许我能回答那个问题。

english: I think we might have started a new tradition I'm calling Eastdoor!
translation: 我想我们可能开创了一个新传统，我称之为“复活门”！

english: Get it? It's a play on the words 'Easter' and 'door'!
translation: 懂了吗？这是“复活节”和“门”的双关语！

english: ...Well, I thought it was a good pun, anyway.
translation: ……好吧，反正我觉得这是个不错的双关。

english: The Ring of Charos has now been opened to you, [player name]. You may use its power to charm the weak- minded, but it will only work whilst you are wearing it.
translation: 查罗斯之戒现已为你开启，[player name]。你可以用它来迷惑意志薄弱的人，但只有在你佩戴它时才会生效。

english: Indeed you believe rightly, [player name], and if you know that then you'll also know that they cost 99000 coins.
translation: 你确实没想错，[player name]，既然你知道这个，那你也该知道它们要价99000金币。

english: Maybe I was still using it as my emotional support hat at the time, and I couldn't bear to part with it. Or maybe I just see its value differently these days.
translation: 也许那时候我还把它当作情感寄托的帽子，舍不得放手。又或者，如今我对它的价值有了不同的看法。

english: Well, it all seems to have gone smoothly enough so far!
translation: 嗯，到目前为止一切似乎都还挺顺利的！

english: Oh, I saw it on the floor when I was out for my morning stroll.
translation: 哦，我早上出去散步时在地板上看到的。

english: I remember an extremely unpleasant reindeer called Dolph with a glowing nose, yes. The others called him Rude Dolph. Ah, the happy memories!
translation: 我记得有一头叫多尔夫的、鼻子发光的驯鹿，非常讨厌。其他驯鹿都叫他粗鲁的多尔夫。啊，美好的回忆！

english: Yes, that's right. Would you like to ask me about something else?
translation: 是的，没错。你还想问点别的吗？

english: I'm guessing you haven't got all the runes I needed, have you?
translation: 我猜你还没凑齐我需要的所有符文，对吧？

english: Your little green friend still has it.
translation: 你的绿色小朋友还拿着它呢。

english: Well, I suppose so. [player name], do you feel ready to fight?
translation: 嗯，我想是吧。[player name]，你准备好战斗了吗？

english: Well, now you have, come back and see me again when you want one.
translation: 好吧，现在你知道了，想要的时候再回来找我。

english: Could he not come here himself?
translation: 他就不能自己来这儿吗？

english: Yes, it does. I might go back to Entrana for a while though, or maybe to the monastery. The food's not all that bad in the monastery, and the company is pleasant. Is there anything else you'd like to ask?
translation: 是的，确实如此。不过我也许会回恩特纳岛待一阵子，或者去修道院。修道院的伙食还不错，同伴们也很友善。你还有什么想问的吗？

english: Hm... that would make sense, wouldn't it.
translation: 嗯……这倒说得通，是吧。

english: Well, how long does it take you to cook a batch of fish?
translation: 嗯，你煮一批鱼要多久？

english: The trolls are coming back!
translation: 巨魔们要回来了！

english: But no, when you have the prowess of such fine craftsmen as Ned and Aggie, you can work remarkably quickly.
translation: 但话说回来，有内德和阿吉这样技艺精湛的工匠在，我们干起活来自然快得惊人。

english: Now we've killed all those trolls we should be able to get into the Colony.
translation: 现在我们杀光了那些巨魔，应该能进入聚居地了。

english: My dear boy, how do you think we did it?
translation: 我亲爱的孩子，你觉得我们是怎么做到的？

english: Off you go, find Herman and tell him I'm here.
translation: 去吧，找到赫尔曼，告诉他我在这儿。

english: I must say, we didn't seem to fare very well against those trolls.
translation: 我得说，我们对付那些巨魔似乎不太顺利。

english: If Mother's fire is blocking teleport magicks, are we trapped here? And what else can these fires do?
translation: 如果母亲的火焰阻断了传送魔法，我们是不是被困在这里了？这些火焰还能做什么？

english: I hear my old friend Fr Lawrence in Varrock is drinking a bit too much. I'd like to get a letter to him about it.
translation: 我听说我在维洛克城的老朋友劳伦斯修士最近喝得太多了。我想写封信劝劝他。

english: No, no, I'm not planning anything like that again.
translation: 不，不，我可没打算再干那种事了。

english: Good. Finish building my coffin, then hand me the potion.
translation: 很好。先把我的棺材做好，然后把药水递给我。

english: Alright, whenever you're ready. I've stocked up on runes again.
translation: 好吧，你随时准备好了就行。我又囤了一批符文。

english: I think you'll find that your little green friend still has it.
translation: 我想你会发现你的绿色小朋友还拿着它。

english: You said there's a troll called My Arm who wants to pretend he's killed me, in revenge for driving trolls away from Keldagrim, and this will impress his girlfriend's father.
translation: 你说有个叫'我的手臂'的巨魔，他想假装杀了我，作为把巨魔赶出凯尔达格林城的报复，这样就能给他女朋友的父亲留下好印象。

english: (You sense the Wise Old Man's disapproval.)
translation: （你感觉到睿智老者的不赞同。）

english: My dear girl, how do you think we did it?
translation: 我亲爱的姑娘，你觉得我们是怎么做到的？

english: Robbed a bank? What in the world could make you think I robbed a bank?
translation: 抢银行？到底是什么让你觉得我抢了银行？

english: The bank showed you their security recording?
translation: 银行给你看了他们的安保录像？

english: I certainly hope so!
translation: 我当然希望如此！

english: Oh well, at least you'll never be able to tell the bank about me. They'll never listen.
translation: 哦好吧，至少你永远没法跟银行告发我。他们不会听的。

english: Spoken to a sphinx, you say? My dear young man, you can't possibly be serious!
translation: 你说你跟斯芬克斯说过话？我亲爱的年轻人，你肯定是在开玩笑吧！

english: If you get some seaweed and a bucket of sand, you'll be able to mix them at a furnace to make molten glass. Most of what you need can be found on Entrana.
translation: 如果你弄到一些海藻和一桶沙，就可以在熔炉里把它们混合起来制成熔融玻璃。你需要的大部分东西都能在恩特纳岛找到。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make daggers.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作匕首。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make axes.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作斧头。

english: Those salt formations are really quite remarkable. But I'm ready to fight once Snowflake gives the word.
translation: 那些盐的形态真是相当奇特。不过我已经准备好战斗了，只等雪花一声令下。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make short swords.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作短剑。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make warhammers.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作战锤。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make wire.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作电线。

english: You seem to have stored the letter in your bank.
translation: 你好像把信存到银行里了。

english: Use a small fishing net to get anchovies from the sea south of here. Then cook them on a fire or range.
translation: 用一张小渔网从南边的海里捞些凤尾鱼。然后在火堆或炉灶上烹饪。

english: Try hammering an iron bar on an anvil to make maces.
translation: 试着把铁锭放在铁砧上锤打，做成钉头锤。

english: You shouldn't have much trouble mining it.
translation: 你开采它应该没什么困难。

english: Ask the head wizard in the tower south of here to teleport you to the Rune Essence mine. Then you can mine me some pieces.
translation: 去问问南边塔里的首席魔法师，让他把你传送到符文精华矿场。然后你就可以给我挖一些碎片了。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make maces.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作钉头锤。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make throwing knives.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作飞刀。

english: Try hammering an iron bar on an anvil to make warhammers.
translation: 试着把铁锭放在铁砧上锤打，做成战锤。

english: Use a small fishing net to get shrimp from the sea south of here. Then cook them on a fire or range.
translation: 用一张小渔网从南边的海里捞些虾。然后在火堆或炉灶上烹饪。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make helmets.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作头盔。

english: Try hammering an iron bar on an anvil to make throwing knives.
translation: 试着把铁锭放在铁砧上锤打，做成飞刀。

english: The fabled Lost City of Zanaris has an entrance somewhere near here. Perhaps some day you'll go there.
translation: 传说中的失落之城扎纳里斯城的入口就在这附近某处。也许有一天你会去那里。

english: If you get some iron ore, you can use the furnace in Lumbridge to smelt it into bars.
translation: 如果你弄到一些铁矿石，可以用仑桥镇的熔炉把它们冶炼成铁锭。

english: Try smelting some copper and tin ore to make bronze. Then hammer the bronze on an anvil to make arrowheads.
translation: 试着熔炼一些铜矿石和锡矿石来制作青铜。然后在铁砧上锤打青铜来制作箭头。

english: Try hammering an iron bar on an anvil to make arrowheads.
translation: 试着把铁锭放在铁砧上锤打，做成箭头。

english: I suppose you could use that for defence.
translation: 我想你可以用它来防御。

english: The Evil Chicken? Why in the world would you want to find the Evil Chicken?
translation: 邪恶鸡？你为什么要找邪恶鸡？

english: Oh! Well, I heard of some witches who met in a fairy land to worship the Evil Chicken with offerings of its favourite food, heedless of the danger from the fearsome beasts that allegedly guard the Chicken's lair.
translation: 哦！嗯，我听说有些女巫在仙境聚会，用邪恶鸡最喜欢的食物作为祭品来崇拜它，全然不顾那些据称守护着邪恶鸡巢穴的可怕野兽所带来的危险。

english: On completing the trials to use the Mage Arena, you can wield the cloak and staff of Saradomin. You will then be able to cast the Saradomin Strike spell, which summons his power against your foe.
translation: 完成魔法竞技场的试炼后，你就能装备萨拉多明的斗篷和法杖。然后你就能施展萨拉多明之击法术，召唤他的力量来对抗你的敌人。

english: Just run along now, be a good girl, and don't worry yourself about me or my finances!
translation: 快走吧，做个好姑娘，别操心我或者我的财务状况了！

english: Why, yes, I did. Why this sudden interest?
translation: 哦，是的，我确实做过。怎么突然对这个感兴趣了？

english: The dwarves were very appreciative of my help. But why are you interested in that old adventure?
translation: 矮人们非常感激我的帮助。但你为什么对那次老冒险感兴趣？

english: Hmmph! Very well.
translation: 哼！好吧。

english: Adventurer, what folly leads you to think any of these - things - exist?
translation: 冒险者，是什么愚蠢的想法让你觉得这些——东西——存在？

english: I'm sorry, I can't sell you one of those now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在不能卖给你那个。

english: I'm sorry, I can't give you one of those now.
translation: 抱歉，我现在不能给你那个。

english: Well, you make sure you don't get hypnotised again, and I'm sure you'll not meet any more jackal-headed men claiming to be gods!
translation: 嗯，你确保自己别再被催眠了，我相信你就不会再遇到任何自称是神的胡狼头人了！

english: I'm not drinking this until you've finished building a coffin for me. I don't intend to collapse on the floor like a drunkard.
translation: 在你给我造好棺材之前，我是不会喝这个的。我可不想像个醉汉一样瘫倒在地上。

english: To this day, no-one has fully understood how rune stones could be created. Perhaps one day the secret will be uncovered.
translation: 直到今天，还没有人完全理解符文石是如何被创造出来的。也许有一天这个秘密会被揭开。

english: You haven't quite earned the right to wear one. You should go and talk to my friend the Odd Old Man. You'll find him on the way to Canifis.
translation: 你还没完全有资格佩戴它。你应该去找我的朋友，那个怪异的老人谈谈。你会在去坎尼非斯村的路上找到他。

english: Indeed you believe rightly, [player name], however you haven't quite earned the right to wear one. You should go and talk to my friend the Odd old man. You'll find him on the way to Canafis.
translation: 你确实没想错，[player name]，不过你还没完全有资格佩戴它。你应该去找我的朋友，那个怪异的老人谈谈。你会在去坎尼非斯村的路上找到他。

english: I'm not making the potion myself, you know! Go to Varrock and ask the Apothecary to do it.
translation: 我可不会自己制作药水！去维洛克城找药剂师来做。

english: Runes are very useful things, but I'll take that off your hands for you.
translation: 符文是非常有用的东西，不过我可以帮你处理掉它。

english: Yes, unfortunately Quest Point Capes have a tendency to do that. Luckily I keep a supply of them handy for people who lose theirs. Next time make sure you have some free inventory or bank slots available.
translation: 是的，不幸的是，任务点数披风确实有这种倾向。幸好我常备一些，给那些弄丢的人。下次记得确保你的背包或银行有足够的空间。

english: Yes, where did he go?
translation: 是啊，他去哪儿了？

english: Thanks, but I don't have anything I need.
translation: 谢谢，但我没什么需要的。

english: Well that's the cost, and it's not changing.
translation: 嗯，就是这个价，不会变的。

english: That's a huge dose - it looks more suitable for a young adult, not an old chap like me. Go to Varrock and ask the Apothecary for something more suitable.
translation: 这剂量太大了——看起来更适合年轻人，而不是像我这样的老头子。去维洛克城找药剂师，让他给点更合适的。

english: Have a good Easter, BoostedMMO.com! And you too, strange rabbit!
translation: 复活节快乐，BoostedMMO.com！还有你也是，奇怪的兔子！

english: From the Realm of Memories, we observed your bank heist, in which you obtained the blue party hat. I need such historic artefacts to reopen the portal. May I have the hat, please?
translation: 我们从记忆之境观察到了你的银行劫案，你从中获得了蓝色派对帽。我需要这样的历史文物来重新打开传送门。能把那顶帽子给我吗？

english: That's a banknote! I can't use that!
translation: 那是张银行票据！我用不了那个！

english: Ooh, a rune? Yes, it's quite valuable.
translation: 哦，一个符文？是的，相当值钱。

english: Hello again, Did you ever hear the Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the wise? I thought not. It's not a story the Jedi would tell you. It's a Sith legend. Darth Plagueis was a Dark Lord of the Sith, so powerful and so wise he could use the Force to influence the midichlorians to create life... He had such a knowledge of the dark side that he could even keep the ones he cared about from dying. The dark side of the Force is a pathway to many abilities some consider to be unnatural. He became so powerful... the only thing he was afraid of was losing his power, which eventually, of course, he did. Unfortunately, he taught his apprentice everything he knew, then his apprentice killed him in his sleep. It's ironic he could save others from death, but not himself.! I must thank you for persuading me to come - I feel quite invigorated in the sea breeze!
translation: 又见面了。你有没有听过智者达斯.普雷格斯的悲剧？我想你没有。这不是绝地会讲给你的故事。这是一个西斯传说。达斯.普雷格斯是一位西斯黑暗尊主，他强大而睿智，能运用原力影响迷地原虫来创造生命……他对黑暗面如此了解，甚至能让他关心的人免于死亡。黑暗面是通往许多被某些人视为有违自然的能力的途径。他变得如此强大……他唯一害怕的就是失去力量，当然，他最终还是失去了。不幸的是，他把自己知道的一切都教给了他的学徒，然后他的学徒在他睡觉时杀了他。他能拯救别人免于死亡，却救不了自己，这真是讽刺。我必须感谢你说服我来这里——海风吹拂让我感觉精神焕发！

english: I... can't... move... Did you ever hear the Tragedy of Darth Plagueis the wise? I thought not. It's not a story the Jedi would tell you. It's a Sith legend. Darth Plagueis was a Dark Lord of the Sith, so powerful and so wise he could use the Force to influence the midichlorians to create life... He had such a knowledge of the dark side that he could even keep the ones he cared about from dying. The dark side of the Force is a pathway to many abilities some consider to be unnatural. He became so powerful... the only thing he was afraid of was losing his power, which eventually, of course, he did. Unfortunately, he taught his apprentice everything he knew, then his apprentice killed him in his sleep. It's ironic he could save others from death, but not himself., you must fight this for me...
translation: 我……动……不了……你有没有听过智者达斯.普雷格斯的悲剧？我想你没有。这不是绝地会讲给你的故事。这是一个西斯传说。达斯.普雷格斯是一位西斯黑暗尊主，他强大而睿智，能运用原力影响迷地原虫来创造生命……他对黑暗面如此了解，甚至能让他关心的人免于死亡。黑暗面是通往许多被某些人视为有违自然的能力的途径。他变得如此强大……他唯一害怕的就是失去力量，当然，他最终还是失去了。不幸的是，他把自己知道的一切都教给了他的学徒，然后他的学徒在他睡觉时杀了他。他能拯救别人免于死亡，却救不了自己，这真是讽刺。你必须替我打败这个……

english: Yes, unfortunately Quest Point Hoods have a tendency to do that. Luckily I keep a supply of them handy for people who lose theirs. Next time make sure you have some free inventory or bank slots available.
translation: 是的，不幸的是，任务点数兜帽确实有这种倾向。幸运的是，我手头常备一些，给那些弄丢的人。下次记得确保你的背包或银行里有空位。

english: I see you also have an immaculate mole skin with you, I will give you extra birds nests for those.
translation: 我看到你还有一张完美的鼹鼠皮，我会为此额外给你一些鸟巢。

english: In my quest for perfection I looked into 'Malignius- Mortifer's-Super-Ultra-Flora-Growth-Potion'. It worked well on my plants, no doubt about it! But it had the same effect on a nearby mole. Ya can imagine the
translation: 在我追求完美的过程中，我研究了‘马利纽斯-莫提弗的超强植物生长药水’。它对我的植物效果很好，这点毫无疑问！但它对附近的一只鼹鼠也产生了同样的效果。你可以想象……

english: Ye might need a bit more inventory space first, just to be on the safe side.
translation: 为了保险起见，你可能需要先腾出一点背包空间。

english: Thanks for being generous here's an extra woad leave.
translation: 谢谢你这么慷慨，这里多给你一片菘蓝叶。

english: If I'm not mistaken, you've got some mole bits there! I'll trade 'em for bird nest if ye likes.
translation: 如果我没看错，你那里有些鼹鼠零件！如果你愿意，我可以拿鸟巢跟你换。

english: Mmmm... ok, that sounds fair.
translation: 嗯……好吧，听起来挺公平的。

english: Well, if you've got nothing better to do...I mean, you looked bored.
translation: 嗯，如果你没什么更好的事可做……我是说，你看上去挺无聊的。

english: I buy antiques and other interesting items. If you have any interesting items that you might want to sell me, please let me see them and I'll offer you a fair price. Would you like me to have a look at your items and
translation: 我收购古董和其他有趣的物品。如果你有什么有趣的物品想卖给我，请让我看看，我会给你一个公平的价格。你想让我看看你的物品然后

english: give you a quote?
translation: 给你报个价吗？

english: Give you? I don't think you heard me...I asked for a favour! It means that I'll 'owe you one' when you need something doing. That's what a favour is!
translation: 给你？我想你没听清楚……我是在请你帮个忙！意思是，当你需要帮忙的时候，我就‘欠你一个人情’。这就是帮忙的意思！

english: Coooiii! Sorry your most amazingness, didn't realise you were too above it all to do someone a favour!
translation: 哎哟！抱歉，您这位了不起的大人物，没意识到您高高在上，不屑于帮别人一个忙！

english: Sorry, Sir, I have nothing that you need.
translation: 抱歉，先生，我这里没有您需要的东西。

english: It's gonna cost you 500 coins to get it back again!
translation: 要拿回来得花你500金币！

english: Yes, Sir. I have a very fetching bead necklace; apparently it aids adventurers in a plethora of ways. I also have a beautiful key crafted from bone.
translation: 是的，先生。我有一条非常漂亮的珠子项链；据说它能在很多方面帮助冒险者。我还有一把用骨头精心制作的钥匙。

english: Sorry, Madam, I have nothing that you need.
translation: 抱歉，女士，我这里没有您需要的东西。

english: I'll give you 5000 coins for your Black Prism...
translation: 我出5000金币买你的黑色棱镜……

english: Yes, Madam. I have a very fetching bead necklace; apparently it aids adventurers in a plethora of ways. I also have a beautiful key crafted from bone.
translation: 是的，女士。我有一条非常漂亮的珠子项链；据说它能在很多方面帮助冒险者。我还有一把用骨头精心制作的钥匙。

english: It happens I do, Sir. I have a beautiful key crafted from a shard of bone.
translation: 我正好有，先生。我有一把用骨头碎片精心制作的漂亮钥匙。

english: Sorry, but I have to pay bills around here.
translation: 抱歉，但我这里也要付账单的。

english: It happens I do, Sir. I have a very fetching bead necklace; apparently it aids adventurers in a plethora of different ways.
translation: 我正好有，先生。我有一条非常漂亮的珠子项链；据说它能在很多不同的方面帮助冒险者。

english: It happens I do, Madam. I have a beautiful key crafted from a shard of bone.
translation: 我正好有，女士。我有一把用骨头碎片精心制作的漂亮钥匙。

english: It happens I do, Madam. I have a very fetching bead necklace; apparently it aids adventurers in a plethora of different ways.
translation: 我正好有，女士。我有一条非常漂亮的珠子项链；据说它能在很多不同的方面帮助冒险者。

english: Oh....ok, I guess I could offer you these lamps...but you don't have enough space for them.
translation: 哦……好吧，我想我可以给你这些灯……但你的空间不够放它们。

english: That's your loss, friend.
translation: 那是你的损失，朋友。

english: Very good, Sir, but it looks as if Sir is a little low on funds.
translation: 很好，先生，但看起来先生手头有点紧。

english: Oh look, you've still got that key ring. You should keep hold of it.
translation: 哦，看，你还留着那个钥匙环。你应该留着它。

english: Here you go, don't lose them again.
translation: 给你，别再弄丢了。

english: Sorry my young friend, but they're just normal mahogany logs. What I need is special red Mahogany for this antique piece. The person I know who can get that is the jungle forester to the south of here.
translation: 抱歉，我的小朋友，但那只是普通的红木原木。我需要的是特殊的红色红木来做这件古董。我知道谁能弄到那种木材，就是南边的那位丛林护林员。

english: Very good, Madam, but it looks as if Madam is a little low on funds.
translation: 很好，女士，但看起来女士手头有点紧。

english: Very good, Sir, but it looks as if Sir needs a little more inventory space.
translation: 很好，先生，但看起来先生需要多一点背包空间。

english: Here you go, don't lose it again.
translation: 给你，别再弄丢了。

english: Very good, Madam, but it looks as if Madam needs a little more inventory space.
translation: 很好，女士，但看起来女士需要多一点背包空间。

english: Thanks my friend, but you've already sold me one of these, I don't need another one.
translation: 谢谢，我的朋友，但你已经卖给我一个了，我不需要另一个。

english: Let's not ignore the obvious, Arianwyn. Our supposed ally, [player name], helped lead the uprising. Her actions may well have endangered us all.
translation: 阿里安温，别忽视显而易见的事。我们所谓的盟友[player name]帮助领导了起义。她的行为很可能危及了我们所有人。

english: I thought I asked you to leave me alone.
translation: 我以为我让你别来烦我。

english: Nice to see how forgetful you are. I think she's by the pond to the south west. Now if that's everything, please go away.
translation: 你真是健忘。我想她在西南边的池塘旁。如果没别的事，请走吧。

english: Very observant of you human.
translation: 人类，你观察得真仔细。

english: Well you can't. He's out on a mission. If it is something urgent, I can help in his place.
translation: 你见不到他。他出任务了。如果事情紧急，我可以替他帮忙。

english: Once again, you can't. Now if you have nothing to say, I suggest you be on your way. I have a lot to do.
translation: 再说一次，不行。如果你没话说，我建议你上路吧。我有很多事要忙。

english: You should take more care with your belongings. I have one here.
translation: 你应该多注意自己的物品。我这里有一个。

english: No. Go away and talk to Baxtorian instead.
translation: 不。去找巴克斯托里安谈吧。

english: I didn't find anything that I could clean. Unfortunately I'm not very good at cleaning jungle herbs.
translation: 我找不到任何可以清洗的东西。可惜我不太擅长清洗丛林草药。

english: Hi, I clean herbs for a fee of 200 coins per herb. I can clean all the herbs in your inventory at once, or you can show me a herb for me to clean it individually.
translation: 嗨，我清洗草药，每棵收费200金币。我可以一次性清洗你背包里的所有草药，或者你也可以给我看一棵草药，让我单独清洗。

english: I can also decant your potion vials to into different doses. That service is free so long as you have any empties needed or a few coins if not. So, what would you like today?
translation: 我还可以帮你分装药水瓶到不同剂量。只要你有需要的空瓶，这项服务免费；如果没有，则需支付少量金币。那么，今天需要什么？

english: You need to bring along a base for me to make unfinished potions with.
translation: 你需要带个基底来，我才能制作半成品药水。

english: You don't have anything for me to combine.
translation: 你没有东西需要我合成。

english: Sorry, as you are not a veteran explorer of the desert lands, and you do not look like a master herbalist, I will not offer this service to you.
translation: 抱歉，由于你不是沙漠地区的资深探险家，而且看起来也不像草药学大师，我不会向你提供这项服务。

english: I don't offer this service for free or at a discount. You'll need at least 200 coins.
translation: 我不提供免费或打折服务。你至少需要200金币。

english: I can't help you with that.
translation: 这我帮不了你。

english: I'll want 200 coins to clean each herb.
translation: 清洗每棵草药我要200金币。

english: I've cleaned your herb.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的草药。

english: I didn't find anything that I could clean. If you had been a veteran explorer of the desert lands, I could have cleaned your noted herbs.
translation: 我没有找到可以清洗的东西。如果你曾是沙漠地区的资深探险家，我就能清洗你的票据形式的草药。

english: There you go, I've decanted all of your potions.
translation: 好了，我已经把所有药水分装好了。

english: I've cleaned your herbs.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的草药。

english: This is true, but many of my customers wish to sell the herbs which they can't clean to other adventurers. They might hope for a better price for this.
translation: 确实如此，但我的许多顾客希望把那些他们无法清洗的草药卖给其他冒险者。他们可能希望能卖个好价钱。

english: Sorry, as you are not a veteran explorer of the desert lands, I will not clean your noted herbs.
translation: 抱歉，由于你不是沙漠地区的资深探险家，我不会清洗你的票据形式的草药。

english: There, all done. If you had been a veteran explorer of the desert lands, I could have cleaned your noted herbs.
translation: 好了，全部完成。如果你曾是沙漠地区的资深探险家，我就能清洗你的票据形式的草药。

english: All spick and span!
translation: 干干净净！

english: Why hello there! What can I do for you?
translation: 嘿，你好！我能为你做什么？

english: There you are! I have made all possible unfinished potions.
translation: 你来了！我已经制作了所有可能的半成品药水。

english: You don't have enough money for me to clean any more herbs.
translation: 你的钱不够我继续清洗草药了。

english: There, all done. Unfortunately I'm not very good at cleaning jungle herbs.
translation: 好了，全部完成。可惜我不太擅长清洗丛林草药。

english: Hmm... you don't seem skilled enough in the art of herblore for me to do this for you. Come back when you have 99 herblore.
translation: 嗯...你的草药学技艺似乎还不够熟练，我不能为你做这件事。等你草药学达到99级再来吧。

english: Oh, sorry, I can't clean jungle herbs.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我不会清洗丛林草药。

english: I'm going to need more vial of water.
translation: 我还需要更多水瓶。

english: I've cleaned your guam leaf.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的瓜姆叶。

english: I've cleaned your torstol.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的托斯托尔草。

english: You don't have enough coins! I require 1,900gp per potion.
translation: 你的金币不够！每瓶药水我需要1,900gp。

english: I've cleaned some of your herbs.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的一部分草药。

english: I've cleaned your tarromin.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的塔罗明草。

english: I've cleaned your lantadyme.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的兰塔丁草。

english: You don't have enough coins! I require 1,800gp per potion.
translation: 你的金币不够！每瓶药水我需要1,800gp。

english: I've cleaned your dwarf weed.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的矮人草。

english: I've cleaned your avantoe.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的阿凡托草。

english: I've cleaned your harralander.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的哈拉兰德草。

english: I've cleaned your cadantine.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的卡丹丁草。

english: You don't have enough coins! I require 1,940gp per potion.
translation: 你的金币不够！每瓶药水我需要1,940gp。

english: I've cleaned your irit leaf.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的伊瑞特叶。

english: You don't have enough money for me to clean any more herbs or enough space to hold the ones I can clean.
translation: 你的钱不够我继续清洗草药，或者空间不足容纳我能清洗的草药。

english: I've cleaned your kwuarm.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的库阿姆草。

english: I've cleaned your snapdragon.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的金鱼草。

english: I didn't find anything that I could clean. Unfortunately I'm not very good at cleaning jungle herbs. If you had been a veteran explorer of the desert lands, I could have cleaned your noted herbs.
translation: 我没有找到可以清洗的东西。可惜我不太擅长清洗丛林草药。如果你曾是沙漠地区的资深探险家，我就能清洗你的票据形式的草药。

english: You need to bring 200 coins for me to clean herbs.
translation: 你需要带200金币来，我才能清洗草药。

english: Hmm... Seems like you don't have enough space left. Come back later so that I may finish.
translation: 嗯...看来你的空间不够了。等会儿再来，好让我完成。

english: I've cleaned your marrentill.
translation: 我已经清洗了你的马伦提尔草。

english: You don't have enough coins! I require 2,000gp per potion.
translation: 你的金币不够！每瓶药水我需要2,000gp。

english: Ok, dat is da big, big scary, danger fing!  You's sure you's wants to go in?
translation: 好吧，那是个大大的、吓人的、危险的东西！你确定你要进去？

english: It's the small creature; you may pass.
translation: 是小生物；你可以通过。

english: I know you, creature; you may pass.
translation: 我认识你，生物；你可以通过。

english: Why have you returned with no proof of companionship? Back to whence you came!
translation: 你为什么没有同伴证明就回来了？回到你来的地方去！

english: Yous best not touch dem till yous chat wiv Grish - use look at dem again more when yous do stuff for Grish.
translation: 你最好别碰它们，直到你和格里什聊过——当你为格里什做事时，可以再多看看它们。

english: That is of no use to me, creature!
translation: 那对我没用，生物！

english: That is not what I want, creature! Bring me a bar of pure gold and I will let you pass.
translation: 那不是我要的，生物！给我带一块纯金条来，我就让你通过。

english: It's that creature again. This time we will let it go.
translation: 又是那个生物。这次我们放它走。

english: No thank you, creature. You are already my friend.
translation: 不用了，谢谢你，生物。你已经是我的朋友了。

english: No thank you, creature. You have already proven your companionship.
translation: 不用了，谢谢你，生物。你已经证明了你的同伴关系。

english: What's this thing? It looks a bit like our Dalgroth... but it's broken. Go away!
translation: 这是什么东西？看起来有点像我们的达尔格罗斯……但它是坏的。走开！

english: No thank you, creature, the rock cake you brought me was plenty.
translation: 不用了，谢谢你，生物，你带给我的石糕已经够了。

english: You! Little thing! You aren't nimble enough to make it across that hole!
translation: 你！小东西！你不够灵活，过不了那个洞！

english: Come back when you gots the moves to make it!
translation: 等你有了本事再来！

english: Why you bringin' me this disgusting dwarfish stuff?
translation: 你为什么给我带这些恶心的矮人玩意？

english: This is stolen gold! You are a thief! Get away, thief!
translation: 这是偷来的金子！你是个盗贼！走开，盗贼！

english: Welcome Brother...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow brother.
translation: 欢迎加入，兄弟……来到我们的组织……我们的战斗是为了各种形态的人类……并清除存在于我们世界的怪物。我们与同胞兄弟没有争执。

english: Welcome Sister...to our organisation...ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms...and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world. We have no quarrel with a fellow sister.
translation: 欢迎加入，姐妹……来到我们的组织……我们的战斗是为了各种形态的人类……并清除存在于我们世界的怪物。我们与同胞姐妹没有争执。

english: You should know, brother...we don't let ordinary members in on all our plans...but rest assured those foul creatures will be dealt with very soon!
translation: 你应该知道，兄弟……我们不会让普通成员知道所有计划……但请放心，那些污秽的生物很快就会被处理掉！

english: You should know, sister...we don't let ordinary members in on all our plans...but rest assured those foul creatures will be dealt with very soon!
translation: 你应该知道，姐妹……我们不会让普通成员知道所有计划……但请放心，那些污秽的生物很快就会被处理掉！

english: We've got to get them before they get us!
translation: 我们得在他们干掉我们之前先下手为强！

english: No! That kind of information is for...only senior members of the group. Why should I tell it to an...outsider?
translation: 不！那种信息只对……组织的资深成员开放。我为什么要告诉一个……外人？

english: Welcome back Brother [player name], how are your negotiations going with Brother Fred?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]兄弟，你和弗雷德兄弟的谈判进行得怎么样了？

english: Welcome back Sister [player name], how are your negotiations going with Brother Fred?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]姐妹，你和弗雷德兄弟的谈判进行得怎么样了？

english: Look around pal. Does it looks like there's any treasure near here?
translation: 四处看看啊，哥们。这附近像是有宝藏的样子吗？

english: Look around lady. Does it looks like there's any treasure near here?
translation: 四处看看啊，女士。这附近像是有宝藏的样子吗？

english: Yeah, I recognise that Geezer, he was talking to one of my customers the other day.
translation: 是啊，我认得那家伙，他前几天还在跟我的一个客人说话。

english: You ain't got room to carry it, and I'm glad 'cos I didn't want to serve you anyway.
translation: 你没地方放，我也高兴，反正我本来就不想招待你。

english: So you're the fella that freed Azzanadra, huh? Fair play to ya. What will you have?
translation: 所以你就是那个解放了阿扎纳德拉的家伙，对吧？干得漂亮。你想喝点什么？

english: The treasure hunter? I think I heard him say that he was heading back to his ship in Draynor Village.
translation: 宝藏猎人？我好像听他说他要回他在德雷诺村的船那里。

english: A bad attack of sand? I think you're on the wrong track, miss so-called archaeologist.
translation: 沙子严重攻击？我说你搞错方向了吧，所谓考古学家小姐。

english: So you're the lass that freed Azzanadra, huh? Fair play to ya. What will you have?
translation: 所以你就是那个解放了阿扎纳德拉的姑娘，对吧？干得漂亮。你想喝点什么？

english: The treasure hunter? I think I heard him say that he was heading back to his ship in Port Sarim.
translation: 宝藏猎人？我好像听他说他要回他在沙林港的船那里。

english: Ooh I don't know if I should be giving away information, makes the computer game too easy.
translation: 噢，我不知道该不该透露信息，这样会让电脑游戏变得太简单。

english: This world around us... is a computer game.... called Zaros.
translation: 我们周围这个世界……是一个电脑游戏……叫做扎罗斯。

english: It's a sort of magic box thing, wich can do all sorts of stuff.
translation: 那是一种魔法盒之类的东西，可以做各种事情。

english: Well,err....well, actually yes I do mind...it's my place and I don't want strangers going through my things.
translation: 呃，嗯……实际上我确实介意……这是我的地方，我不想让陌生人翻我的东西。

english: Alas poor Clarence, I knew him well.
translation: 唉，可怜的克拉伦斯，我很了解他。

english: There's a severe penalty for using the 'dark arts'. If you find any evidence to the contrary, please bring it to me.
translation: 使用“黑暗艺术”会受到严厉惩罚。如果你找到任何相反的证据，请带给我。

english: Thank you [player name], we shall bury him today. I have sent word for the guards to arrest Sandy, so no one will ever see him again!
translation: 谢谢你[player name]，我们今天会埋葬他。我已传话让卫兵逮捕桑迪，这样没人会再见到他了！

english: Ok, that's good, that should work. Pop back in a little while to see Sithik and start questioning him.
translation: 好的，不错，这样应该可行。等会儿再回来找西希克，开始审问他。

english: Unfortunately you haven't unlocked access to Asgarnia so I cannot teleport you there.
translation: 可惜你尚未解锁阿斯加尼亚的访问权限，所以我无法将你传送过去。

english: Hmmm, well this is an uncommon spell component.  On it's own it's useless, but with certain necromantic spells it can be very powerful. Did you find anything else there?
translation: 嗯，这是一种不常见的法术成分。单独使用毫无用处，但结合某些死灵法术可以变得非常强大。你在那里还发现了别的东西吗？

english: Ah yes, I remember saying something about a reward didn't I? Well, I can offer you 2000 coins for it as it stands, but I know that Yanni Salika in Shilo Village would offer you more than twice as much.
translation: 啊对，我记得我说过有奖励对吧？好吧，就目前而言，我可以给你2000金币，但我知道希洛村的雅尼.萨利卡会出价两倍以上。

english: What would you like to do?
translation: 你想怎么做？

english: Very well my friend.
translation: 很好，我的朋友。

english: Sure, go ahead, ask away.
translation: 当然，问吧。

english: Unfortunately I've already helped you with one teleport, get some exercise - your legs won't fall off!
translation: 可惜我已经帮过你一次传送了，活动活动筋骨——你的腿不会断的！

english: Hmmm, well this is an uncommon spell component.  On it's own it's useless, but with certain necromantic spells it can be very powerful.
translation: 嗯，这是一种不常见的法术成分。单独使用毫无用处，但结合某些死灵法术可以变得非常强大。

english: Hmm, it seems to have some magical protection. Once you've finished with this item, bring it back to me would you. I may have a reward for you.
translation: 嗯，它似乎有某种魔法保护。等你处理完这件物品，带回来给我好吗？我可能会有奖励给你。

english: Fair enough my friend, you deserve it!
translation: 说得对，我的朋友，你应得的！

english: Well, either the Dragon Inn is now delivering to the Ogres at Jiggig or a patron of the Dragon Inn visited the ogre area. That seems quite logical to me.
translation: 嗯，要么是龙之酒馆现在在向吉吉格的食人魔送货，要么是龙之酒馆的顾客去过食人魔区域。这在我看来相当合理。

english: Fair enough my friend, you deserve it, but you may find that the village is in need of some assistance before you can actually get your reward.
translation: 说得对，我的朋友，你应得的，但你可能会发现，在你能实际拿到奖励之前，村子需要一些帮助。

english: You must be pulling my leg, I told you that I'd only teleport you once!
translation: 你一定是在开玩笑，我告诉过你我只会传送你一次！

english: Don't lose your head over it.
translation: 别为此乱了分寸。

english: I'm happy to help as much as I can but you have to remember that I'm quite busy. If you find any more clues about what happened at Jiggig, I'll consider them with an open mind - that's as much as I can offer.
translation: 我很乐意尽力帮忙，但你要记住我很忙。如果你找到更多关于吉吉格事件线索，我会以开放的心态考虑——这是我所能做的。

english: No matter, here, have another I've already activated it for you!
translation: 没关系，给你，我已经为你激活了另一个！

english: What do you expect me to do with a piece of paper?
translation: 你指望我拿一张纸做什么？

english: Hey yous creature...yous still here?
translation: 嘿，你这生物……你还在这儿？

english: If yous finds somefin for da sickies, yous brings to me...and I's gives you bright pretties, den me make more for alls pepels.
translation: 如果你找到给病号用的东西，就拿来给我……我就给你亮闪闪的好东西，然后我就能给所有人做更多了。

english: Mee's not taking da risky wiv dis un, yous make me's da right glug glug when yous found out to make it.
translation: 我可不想拿这个冒险，你得先搞清楚怎么做，给我做出正确的咕噜咕噜药水才行。

english: Where you's get dis from creatures...it's not sniffing big fresh? Did's yous creatures makes dis?
translation: 你从哪儿弄来的这东西……闻起来不新鲜吗？是你们这些生物做的吗？

english: ~ Grish seems very pleased about the return of theartefacts. ~
translation: ~ 格里什对手工艺品的回归显得非常满意。~

english: Da sickies is when yous creature goes like orange till green and then goes 'Urggghhhh!'~ Grish imitates falling down with only the white of hiseyes visible. ~
translation: 生病期就是你的生物从橙色变成绿色，然后'呃啊啊啊！'~格里什模仿着倒下，只露出眼白。~

english: Dem zogries commin from da under dirt and us is lost for da Jiggie jig place.
translation: 那些佐格怪从泥土底下来，俺们找不到吉格吉格地儿了。

english: Yous creature jus makin da bigga stabber chucker like Grish shows you...
translation: 你们生物就照着格里什教的做更大号戳戳扔扔器……

english: But it's da  big laffsies when it's facey goes to whiteness....ha ha ha!
translation: 不过等它脸儿变白就好好笑……哈哈哈！

english: Dis is da big prob for creature? Did da stoopid man say nuffin on da zogres? If I's see's da evil wizzy, I's make him tell us all da stuff...he's prolly knows stuff about da zogries, how to dead 'em and not get da
translation: 这对生物是大问题吗？那个蠢蛋男人没说佐格怪的事儿？俺要是见到那个坏蛋巫师，就逼他把所有东西都说出来……他大概知道佐格怪的事，知道怎么干掉它们还不沾

english: sickies.
translation: 病薄症。

english: Yea creatures, you's just say what Grish says...not know own wordies creature?
translation: 对啊生物，你们就照格里什说的说……不知道自个儿的词儿吗生物？

english: Yous creature got da sickies? Yous go to evil wizzy wot made dem zogries and squeezen him tell he's tellin' all stuff...
translation: 你们生物得了病薄症？你们去找造出佐格怪的坏蛋巫师，使劲捏他说出所有东西……

english: Is what Grish said.
translation: 格里什说的就是这个。

english: Yous creatures doesn't loosing this ones else yous gets da bash from Grish!
translation: 你们这些生物别弄丢这个，否则格里什会揍你们！

english: Hey...yous creature too stoopid to use dat...go chatsie wiv Rantz! He learn you good how to cook da chompy!
translation: 嘿……你们生物太笨了不会用那个……去找兰茨聊聊！他教你们怎么煮好鸟！

english: Hello young one.
translation: 你好，小家伙。

english: Cross my palm with silver and the future will be revealed to you.
translation: 用银币划过我的掌心，未来便会向你展现。

english: He shouldn't be too hard to find. He lives in the royal palace in this city. Tell him Gypsy Aris sent you.
translation: 他应该不难找——他就住在这座城市的皇宫里。告诉他是吉普赛人阿里斯派你来的。

english: Alright, I think I've got it now, it goes....
translation: 好了，我想我明白了，是这样的……

english: You have been on this world a relatively short time. At least compared to me.
translation: 你在这个世界上的时间相对很短——至少跟我相比是这样。

english: Oh, sorry, I forgot. With gold, I mean. They haven't used silver coins since before you were born! So, do you want your fortune told?
translation: 哦，抱歉，我忘了——我是说黄金。自从你出生之前，他们就再也没用过白银金币了！那么，你想算命吗？

english: So, do you want your fortune told or not?
translation: 那么，你到底想不想算命？

english: Cross my palm with silver then.
translation: 那就用银币划过我的掌心吧。

english: Older than you imagine.
translation: 比你想象中要老得多。

english: Carlem... Gabindo... Aber... Camerinthum... Purchai.
translation: 卡勒姆……加宾多……阿贝尔……卡梅林图姆……珀尔凯。

english: Purchai... Aber... Carlem... Camerinthum... Gabindo.
translation: 珀尔凯……阿贝尔……卡勒姆……卡梅林图姆……加宾多。

english: Aber... Carlem... Gabindo... Purchai... Camerinthum.
translation: 阿贝尔……卡勒姆……加宾多……珀尔凯……卡梅林图姆。

english: Camerinthum... Aber... Purchai... Carlem... Gabindo.
translation: 卡梅林图姆……阿贝尔……珀尔凯……卡勒姆……加宾多。

english: Aber... Camerinthum... Carlem... Gabindo... Purchai.
translation: 阿贝尔……卡梅林图姆……卡勒姆……加宾多……珀尔凯。

english: *sigh* Yeah...
translation: *叹气* 是啊...

english: Humans only care about rabbits for Easter decorations, right? Well, what if we give these people something else to celebrate with?
translation: 人类只关心用兔子做复活节装饰，对吧？那么，如果我们给这些人别的东西来庆祝呢？

english: Eastdoors!
translation: 东门！

english: Well... no, not really.
translation: 嗯...不，其实不是。

english: Thanks for everything, human!
translation: 谢谢你做的一切，人类！

english: Eggcellent! This is going to be the best Easter ever! Now, where to start...
translation: 太棒了！这将是最棒的复活节！现在，从哪里开始呢...

english: Couldn't hurt to ask, I guess. If I give you some flowers to use as ingredients, can you ask her to make some paint?
translation: 问问也无妨，我想。如果我给你一些花用作原料，你能请她做些颜料吗？

english: Well, yes, but I don't think I can actually wear it.
translation: 嗯，是的，但我觉得我实际上不能穿它。

english: Merry Easter, human!
translation: 复活节快乐，人类！

english: Any time! Oh, that reminds me - you can have the hat that nice lady gave to me as well!
translation: 随时！哦，这提醒了我——你也可以留着那位好心的女士给我的帽子！

english: Yep! Though admittedly, not how I thought it would.
translation: 是的！不过得承认，和我想的不太一样。

english: Exactly! He didn't call me an Easter bunny or a cute rabbit or anything like that!
translation: 没错！他没有叫我复活节兔子或可爱兔兔之类的话！

english: No, not that!
translation: 不，不是那样！

english: Human, did you hear that...?
translation: 人类，你听到了吗...？

english: It's an IOU. We rabbits don't usually carry cash on us, I'm afraid.
translation: 这是一张借条。恐怕我们兔子通常不带现金。

english: Yep! She's just down that alley there, in the house behind the wheelbarrow in front of it. Best of luck!
translation: 是的！她就在那条小巷里，那房子前面有辆手推车，她就在那房子后面。祝你好运！

english: Easter just seems to be about rabbits, so whenever a rabbit shows up all anyone can think of is 'Ooh look at the Easter Rabbit!'.
translation: 复活节似乎只关乎兔子，所以每当一只兔子出现，所有人想到的都是‘哦，看，复活节兔子！’。

english: I want to go out and explore Gielinor, but nobody takes me seriously enough to let me travel.
translation: 我想出去探索Gielinor，但没人把我当回事，让我去旅行。

english: Hmm... all these brown doors aren't particularly Eastery... We should probably start by painting them.
translation: 嗯……所有这些棕色的门都不太有复活节气氛……我们可能应该先给它们上漆。

english: The goblins even got to keep their stupid sled track from Christmas!
translation: 那些哥布林甚至还能保留他们圣诞节留下的愚蠢雪橇轨道！

english: Meanwhile, all the other holidays have a bunch of cool stuff associated with them so nobody bats an eyelid when a zombie shambles through town.
translation: 与此同时，所有其他节日都有一大堆很酷的东西与之相关，所以当一个僵尸蹒跚地穿过城镇时，没人会眨一下眼。

english: ... Wait a second...
Doors... Easter... Doors... East... Doors... Eastdo-
I wonder who could have decorated an entire village so quickly...?
translation: 我想知道谁能在这么短时间装饰了整个村庄...？

english: I dunno. I just feel like as long as I live, I'm gonna be an advertisement for Easter and nothing more.
translation: 我不知道。我只是觉得只要我活着，我就会是复活节的广告，仅此而已。

english: Then you can have your Easter and I can go be a rabbit!
translation: 这样你就可以过你的复活节，而我可以去当一只兔子！

english: What do you say, human? Do you want to help?
translation: 你觉得呢，人类？你想帮忙吗？

english: Human! I've got it! Eastdoor!
translation: 人类！我想到了！东门！

english: I have no idea. I just came back and this door's been fully decorated without us!
translation: 我不知道。我刚回来，这扇门就已经完全装饰好了，没靠我们！

english: But hey, anything that takes the spotlight off of us rabbits can't hurt! Plus, it could be fun!
translation: 但嘿，任何能把聚光灯从我们兔子身上移开的事情都不会有坏处！而且，还可能很有趣！

english: I... Human, I didn't do this..
translation: 我...人类，这不是我做的..

english: Ok! Hold on to your ammo!
translation: 好的！抓紧你的弹药！

english: Well if you like it, it's bound to go down well! Let's head back to Draynor and get this put up!
translation: 嗯，如果你喜欢它，它一定会大受欢迎！我们回Draynor去，把这个挂起来！

english: I think I have all of my supplies on me... brushes... pallette... safety goggles...
translation: 我想我身上带了所有补给品...刷子...调色盘...护目镜...

english: ... And I think we're done!
translation: ...我想我们完成了！

english: Exactly! Now, hold this nail for me...
translation: 没错！现在，帮我拿着这根钉子...

english: Oh! Human, this is perfect!
translation: 哦！人类，这太完美了！

english: ... Ok, I think I'm gonna be alright. I got the planks out, at the very least.
translation: ...好吧，我想我会没事的。至少我把木板拿出来了。

english: Do you think the owner will mind?
translation: 你觉得主人会在意吗？

english: I'm fine, just... let me catch my breath...
translation: 我没事，只是...让我喘口气...

english: Oh, gosh darn, I'm fresh out of paint!
translation: 哦，天哪，我刚用完颜料！

english: Great! Let me get my brushes and...
translation: 太好了！让我拿我的刷子...

english: But no, right at the end!
translation: 但不是，偏偏在最后！

english: Maybe if I had more colours...
translation: 如果我有更多颜色就好了...

english: Though I suppose we did do that as well, didn't we...
translation: 不过我想我们也确实做了那件事，不是吗...

english: Blast! Looks like there's only one thing for it, then.
translation: 糟糕！看来只有一条路可走了。

english: We'll just have to decorate it ourselves! But first, we need something to decorate it with.
translation: 我们只能自己装饰它了！但首先，我们需要一些装饰用的东西。

english: I'll tell you what - seeing as we don't need it any more, how would you like to keep this door?
translation: 我跟你说——既然我们不再需要它了，你想留着这扇门吗？

english: He was so focused on Eastdoor he didn't make the connection!
translation: 他太专注于东门了，没联想到！

english: Sounds great! I can either teleport us there now, or I can meet you there if you'd prefer.
translation: 听起来不错！我可以现在传送我们过去，或者如果你愿意，我可以在那里和你碰面。

english: No thank you, Human. You've done enough already. You sit back and relax. I'll be back in a moment!
translation: 不用了，谢谢你，人类。你已经做得够多了。你坐下休息吧。我马上就回来！

english: Should be easy enough.
translation: 应该足够简单。

english: Ok! Hold on to your hat!
translation: 好的！抓紧你的帽子！

english: Ooh! These are perfect! Thanks a lot!
translation: 哦！这些太完美了！非常感谢！

english: Hmm... I think some nice fluffy wool could look quite nice...
translation: 嗯...我觉得一些松软的羊毛看起来会很好...

english: I didn't know... that cats could be... so violent!
translation: 我不知道...猫能...这么暴力！

english: Human, what is that?
translation: 人类，那是什么？

english: Cute?! I'll give you cute! I'll...
translation: 可爱？！我要给你好看！我要...

english: I know what a sheep is, human!
translation: 我知道羊是什么，人类！

english: That's clearly just two penguins in a sheep costume!
translation: 那显然是两只企鹅穿着羊的服装！

english: Well, anyway, we need to get some wool. I think three pieces would be enough.
translation: 嗯，不管怎样，我们需要弄些羊毛。我觉得三块就够了。

english: Oh, thank you so much human!
translation: 哦，太谢谢你了人类！

english: It's a bit of a trek. I'm going to teleport again. Would you like me to take you along?
translation: 有点远。我要再次传送了。你想让我带你一起去吗？

english: I think if we had some planks, I have all the nails and fixings to make the thing...
translation: 我想如果我们有一些木板，我有所有做这东西需要的钉子和配件...

english: Hmm... I think we have all the decorations we need, but I had an idea.
translation: 嗯...我觉得我们已经有所需的所有装饰品了，但我有个主意。

english: That's all the wool we need! Thanks a lot, human! You're a big help.
translation: 这就是我们需要的所有羊毛！多谢了，人类！你帮了大忙。

english: You know how to shear sheep, right human? You just walk up to them and give them a good snip!
translation: 你知道怎么剪羊毛吧，人类？你只要走到它们跟前，好好剪一刀！

english: Now we just need a door to paint...
translation: 现在我们只需要一扇门来画...

english: If you think I'm small, you should see the rabbits in Tirannwn. They're so small most people don't even look at them.
translation: 如果你觉得我小，你应该看看Tirannwn的兔子。它们小到大多数人甚至不会注意到它们。

english: This is perfect! Thanks a lot, miss!
translation: 这太完美了！非常感谢，小姐！

english: Ah well, I'll figure it out later.
translation: 啊好吧，我以后再想办法。

english: Ribbons would be perfect, human! Do you know where we could get some?
translation: 丝带会很棒，人类！你知道我们能在哪里弄到一些吗？

english: Well, that's better than nothing! We'll go to Thessalia's!
translation: 嗯，总比没有好！我们去Thessalia那里！

english: Wait a second... what's that?!
translation: 等一下...那是什么？！

english: Ok! Hold on to your boots!
translation: 好的！抓紧你的靴子！

english: Yep, but these are rabbit scissors!
translation: 是的，但这是兔子剪刀！

english: You humans like Easter eggs, don't you? Do you know where we could get some good eggs?
translation: 你们人类喜欢复活节彩蛋，对吧？你知道我们能在哪里弄到一些好蛋吗？

english: I bet I can just sneak right in and grab a few planks without anyone noticing!
translation: 我打赌我可以悄悄溜进去，拿几块木板，没人会发现！

english: Oh wait, look! There's a break in the fence there!
translation: 哦等等，看！那边栅栏有个缺口！

english: That sounds perfect! I'll meet you there, human!
translation: 听起来完美！我在那里和你碰面，人类！

english: Anyway, we've got all the wool, so we should probably move on. What else do we need?
translation: 不管怎样，我们已经有了所有羊毛，所以我们应该继续前进。还需要别的吗？

english: *grumble grumble grumble*
translation: *咕哝咕哝咕哝*

english: ... What?
... At any rate, it looks like we need a better plan...
translation: ...不管怎样，看来我们需要一个更好的计划...

english: Hey! I'll have you know Easter is a very special occasion!
translation: 嘿！我要你知道复活节是一个非常特殊的场合！

english: But what is that thing doing in the middle of all of them?
translation: 但那个东西在它们中间干什么？

english: Sounds like a plan, human! The lumberyard is to the north-east of here, I'll see you out in front of it!
translation: 听起来是个计划，人类！木材厂在这儿的东北方向，我在它前面见你！

english: I tried to get it myself but these shears aren't really designed with rabbits in mind.
translation: 我自己试过拿，但这些剪刀不是专门为兔子设计的。

english: So I was thinking - why not make a new door, decorate it, and simply swap the doors out!
translation: 所以我在想——为什么不做一个新门，装饰它，然后直接把门换掉呢！

english: Wait, aren't there scary dark mages at the front of Varrock? I should probably teleport in... Would you like me to take you along, human?
translation: 等等，维洛克城前面不是有可怕的黑暗法师吗？我最好传送进去...你想让我带你一起去吗，人类？

english: It's going to be really annoying trying to put all these decorations on a door while it's still in a frame.
translation: 试图把这些装饰品都挂在一扇还装在门框上的门上，真是烦人。

english: Yeah! Look how colourful it is! It's great!
translation: 是啊！看它多色彩缤纷！太棒了！

english: ... hmph. Can't seem to get it on.
translation: ...哼。好像穿不上。

english: Yay! Just let me get this...
translation: 耶！让我把这个...

english: I love it! Can I have it?
translation: 我喜欢它！能给我吗？

english: Excellent! I'm glad I brought my scissors along!
translation: 太好了！我很高兴我带了剪刀来！

english: Just be careful - I'm fairly sure there's a ram in here and he might not appreciate it so much.
translation: 小心点——我很确定这里有只公羊，他可能不太欣赏这样。

english: Wait... gosh darn it, I forgot to grab my piggy bank!
translation: 等等……该死的，我忘了拿我的存钱罐！

english: ... over the ears and...
translation: ...从耳朵上方穿过...

english: Human, would you mind buyi-
translation: 人类，你介意买—

english: Yep! Just passing the time, you know!
translation: 没错！就是打发时间而已，你知道的！

english: We're not in a hurry. The sheep are in a pen, so it's not like they can go anywhere.
translation: 我们不着急。羊都在围栏里，反正也跑不掉。

english: Really? Who shears them for him?
translation: 真的吗？谁帮他剪羊毛？

english: That would include you, I guess?
translation: 那也包括你，对吧？

english: You know them?
translation: 你认识他们？

english: Why would penguins need to spy on sheep?
translation: 企鹅为什么要监视羊？

english: Penguins are trying to take over Gielinor?
translation: 企鹅想统治基利诺尔？

english: ... Human, are you feeling alright?
translation: ...人类，你没事吧？

english: Thanks again for the hat!
translation: 再次感谢你的帽子！

english: Merry Easter, human! Did you want anything?
translation: 复活节快乐，人类！想要点什么吗？

english: Wait... where's the sawmill operator?
translation: 等等...锯木厂操作员去哪了？

english: How could you not like it? It's so colorful!
translation: 你怎么会不喜欢？它多鲜艳啊！

english: So how do you get your planks then?
translation: 那你怎么弄到木板？

english: Do you think the farmer knows about it?
translation: 你觉得农夫知道这事吗？

english: The Grand Exchange! I don't have that kind of money!
translation: 大交易所！我可没那么多钱！

english: Thanks, human! But we still need 2 more wool!
translation: 谢了，人类！但我们还需要2块羊毛！

english: My name is Gregg!
translation: 我叫格雷格！

english: No, with 3 gs.
translation: 不，是三个g。

english: Hmmm... I haven't put too much thought into it, actually.
translation: 嗯...其实我没怎么想过。

english: Now you're just being silly, human.
translation: 你现在是在犯傻，人类。

english: I see you brought your own shears! Wonderful!
translation: 我见你自带剪刀了！太好了！

english: I don't actually know your name, either. I've just been calling you human this whole time.
translation: 其实我也不知道你叫什么名字。我一直都叫你人类。

english: Oh, you don't know the half of it, human...
translation: 哦，你只知其一不知其二，人类...

english: Hmm... I don't know, human. We don't usually start making plans for Easter until at least halfway through the year.
translation: 嗯...我不确定，人类。我们通常至少要到年中才会开始计划复活节的事。

english: [player name]? I'm not a fan, honestly.
translation: [player name]？说实话，我不太喜欢。

english: No, we need a better plan.
translation: 不，我们需要更好的计划。

english: So long, human!
translation: 再见，人类！

english: I was meant to be helping the people of Draynor with Easter, but seeing as they helped themselves, I have some time on my hands!
translation: 我本来要帮德雷诺的人们筹备复活节，但他们自己动手了，所以我现在有空闲！

english: But if I am around, I hope I get to talk to you again!
translation: 不过如果我还在的话，希望还能再跟你聊！

english: You've forgotten already? Silly human!
translation: 你又忘了？傻人类！

english: I'm going to keep calling you human, human!
translation: 我还是要叫你人类，人类！

english: I might just use it to relax a little bit. It's not often rabbits get time off.
translation: 我可能就用它来放松一下。兔子难得有假。

english: Well, they're not in there now!
translation: 呃，它们现在不在里面了！

english: Are you kidding me? There's no bell to ring! No, we need a better plan.
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？根本没有钟可以敲！不，我们需要一个更好的计划。

english: Thanks, human! But we still need 1 more wool!
translation: 谢了，人类！但我们还需要1块羊毛！

english: You were about to take the ingredients from me to that nice dye-making witch in the house down that alley behind the wheelbarrow!
translation: 你正要把我给的配料拿去给那条巷子里手推车后面房子里的制染料女巫！

english: Human, I don't think that wool is fresh.
translation: 人类，我觉得那羊毛不新鲜。

english: ... Oh. Well, I'll be here if you change your mind, I guess.
translation: ...哦。好吧，如果你改变主意，我会在这里等你。

english: We were going to use it to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: 我们打算用它们来装饰一些门，以体现复活节的精神，这样人们就不会那么把它和兔子联系在一起了！

english: Of course it matters! Everybody knows fresh wool is softer and shinier!
translation: 当然重要！大家都知道新鲜的羊毛更柔软更有光泽！

english: Silly human! You have the ingredients on you already!
translation: 傻人类！你已经带着配料了！

english: Well, now you do! So now you can go and get some fresh wool!
translation: 好吧，你现在有了！所以你可以去弄些新鲜羊毛了！

english: Hmm... maybe, but let's get one first and see how we get on.
translation: 嗯...也许吧，但我们先弄一个试试看。

english: You need to take them to the witch who makes dyes you mentioned. Aggie, I think her name was.
translation: 你需要把它们拿给你提到的那位制染料的女巫。她好像叫阿吉。

english: This is your first day in Gielinor, right human? If that's the case, you should come back to me tomorrow for some rewards!
translation: 这是你第一天到盖里诺吧，人类？如果是的话，明天再回来找我领奖赏吧！

english: Hello human!
translation: 你好，人类！

english: Yep! But I'm taking a bit of a break, and it would appear you are too, human!
translation: 对！但我正在休息一会儿，看来你也在休息，人类！

english: *sigh* I'm sure it is, human. I tried to go on it myself but the goblins kept mobbing me about Easter eggs.
translation: *叹气* 我确信是的，人类。我自己也想试试，但那些哥布林老是缠着我问复活节彩蛋。

english: Wow, human, that hat looks great on you!
translation: 哇，人类，这顶帽子在你身上真好看！

english: I... Human, I honestly don't think I could stomach going.
translation: 我...人类，我真的觉得我去不了。

english: I told them they'd have to wait until Easter like everybody else, but they wouldn't have any of it!
translation: 我告诉它们得像其他人一样等到复活节，但它们根本不听！

english: It's not that, it's... I just don't want to be ridiculed for being an Easter bunny.
translation: 不是那个问题，是...我只是不想因为自己是复活节兔子而被嘲笑。

english: That sounds awfully dangerous, human!
translation: 听起来太危险了，人类！

english: Well, I'm not risking my hide running around the Wilderness! We need a better plan.
translation: 我可不想冒险在荒野里跑！我们需要更好的计划。

english: Well, I think it looks amazing! Really suits you. Anyway, did you want anything?
translation: 嗯，我觉得它看起来棒极了！真的很适合你。总之，你想要点什么吗？

english: So long, human! I'll be here if you need anything!
translation: 再见，人类！如果你需要什么，我就在这里！

english: Hmm... Human, I don't think you have enough room in your pockets for more things.
translation: 嗯...人类，我觉得你口袋里没空间再装东西了。

english: Have you changed your mind about teleporting to Lumbridge with me?
translation: 你改变主意要和我传送到仑桥镇了吗？

english: I've put up with being the 'cute widdle wabbit' my whole life. I don't think I can take much more of it.
translation: 我一辈子都在忍受被称为'可爱的小兔兔'。我觉得我快受不了了。

english: Ok! I'm gonna hang around here for a little bit, so come talk to me if your change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: 好！我会在这里待一会儿，要是改变主意就来找我。不然，我们在那里见！

english: Your hint is; you have some shears, and we're stood inside of a sheep pen.
translation: 提示是：你有一把剪刀，而且我们站在羊圈里。

english: There's a Bank just south down the road. You can go there to drop off a few items if you want to make space.
translation: 沿着这条路往南走有个银行。你可以去那里存几样东西腾地方。

english: Have you changed your mind, human?
translation: 你改变主意了吗，人类？

english: I think we were going to the sheep pen north of Lumbridge to get some wool.
translation: 我记得我们打算去仑桥镇北边的羊圈弄些羊毛。

english: Hey human! Are you ready to go to Draynor?
translation: 嘿，人类！准备好去德拉诺了吗？

english: Are you ready to go to Varrock, human?
translation: 准备好去维洛克城了吗，人类？

english: Pretty good, human. How are you?
translation: 还不错，人类。你呢？

english: Try not to lose these ones. If people find my IOUs, I'm gonna have quite the bill to pay!
translation: 别再把它们弄丢了。要是别人发现我的借条，我可要付一大笔账单了！

english: Ok human! Let me know if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: 好吧，人类！改变主意就告诉我。不然，我们在那里见！

english: Yep! Bring me the wool after you're done! We need 3 more pieces!
translation: 对！弄完羊毛后带给我！我们还需要3块！

english: This isn't the best conversation ever, I have to say.
translation: 不得不说，这不是最好的对话。

english: I think we were going to the lumberyard to the north- east of Varrock to get some planks.
translation: 我记得我们打算去维洛克城东北边的木材场弄些木板。

english: I think that's wise, human.
translation: 我觉得那样很明智，人类。

english: Ok, human! I'll wait here for a little bit just in case you change your mind, or you can meet me there!
translation: 好吧，人类！我会在这里等一会儿，以防你改变主意，或者你也可以在那里等我！

english: Silly human, you're meant to give that to the nice witch down the road, not me!
translation: 傻人类，你应该把这个给路上的女巫，不是给我！

english: Oh, you'll also want to make yourself some inventory space to keep the wool in. I think there's a Bank at the top of Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 哦，你还要腾出一些背包空间来装羊毛。我记得仑桥镇城堡顶楼有个银行。

english: I think we were going to the Lumbridge Kitchens to talk to a cook about some eggs.
translation: 我记得我们打算去仑桥镇厨房跟一个厨师谈谈拿些鸡蛋。

english: Nah, dye is fine if you're working with fabric, but if you want to paint wood you need something a lot thicker.
translation: 不，如果你处理的是织物，染料还行，但如果你想给木头上漆，你需要更浓稠的东西。

english: Yep! Bring me the wool after you're done! We need 1 more piece!
translation: 对！弄完羊毛后带给我！我们还需要1块！

english: I think she's just down that street there, in the house with the wheelbarrow in front of it.
translation: 她应该就在那条街上，门口有手推车的那栋房子里。

english: Speak to you soon, human!
translation: 待会儿见，人类！

english: Yep! Bring me the wool after you're done! We need 2 more pieces!
translation: 对！弄完羊毛后带给我！我们还需要2块！

english: We were about to go to Lumbridge to speak to a Cook there who has a lot of eggs!
translation: 我们正要前往仑桥镇，去找那里一个有很多鸡蛋的厨师！

english: Wait a minute, I don't know about this... there could be some nasty man waiting in Lumbridge for you human, I'd hop worlds if you want a teleport.
translation: 等一下，我有点担心...可能有坏家伙在仑桥镇等你，人类。如果你想传送，我建议换个世界。

english: We were going to use them to decorate some doors in the spirit of Easter so people associate it less with rabbits!
translation: 我们打算用它们来装饰一些门，以体现复活节的精神，这样人们就不会那么把它和兔子联系在一起了！

english: You were about to take some ingredients off me to give to the nice dye-making witch in exchange for some paint!
translation: 你正要把我给的配料拿去给那位好的制染料女巫，以换取一些颜料！

english: I think we were going to the clothes shop in the middle of Varrock to get some ribbons.
translation: 我想我们是要去维洛克城中间的服装店买些缎带。

english: Well, you're a human. How can you teleport?
translation: 嗯，你是人类。你怎么传送？

english: And rabbits can't use magic?
translation: 兔子就不能用魔法吗？

english: Of course we can! How else do you think we make Easter happen each year?
translation: 当然可以！不然你以为我们每年怎么实现复活节的？

english: Hmm... human, that is a nice egg in this trying time, but unfortunately I meant a decorative egg.
translation: 嗯...人类，在这个艰难时刻，这是个好蛋，但可惜我指的是装饰蛋。

english: From what I've heard, they're trying to summon a demon to attack Varrock!
translation: 据我所知，他们想召唤一个恶魔来攻击维洛克城！

english: Human, if I had coins to give you, I wouldn't have given you an IOU in the first place!
translation: 人类，如果我有金币给你，我一开始就不会给你借条了！

english: Most of what I know is second hand knowledge, but none of it is good!
translation: 我知道的大部分都是二手消息，但没有一个好消息！

english: Last year one of my mates walked by too close and they nearly had him for rabbit stew!
translation: 去年我的一个伙伴走得太近了，他们差点把他做成兔肉炖菜！

english: I'll be fine, I didn't get scratched too badly. Plus at least I have a cool story to tell my friends.
translation: 我没事，伤得不重。而且至少我有个酷故事可以跟朋友们吹嘘。

english: I'm just sad I didn't get to pet the cute cat...
translation: 我只是遗憾没能摸摸那只可爱的猫...

english: It's a good thing I grabbed a bunch of these before I headed out!
translation: 还好我出发前抓了一大把这玩意儿！

english: You know, something colourful or fancy or made of chocolate. Do you have one of those?
translation: 你知道的，什么花花绿绿、稀奇古怪或者巧克力做的东西。你有那样的吗？

english: Hey, everyone knows cats love being petted!
translation: 嘿，谁都知道猫喜欢被人摸！

english: That one just seemed mad about something else... I wonder what.
translation: 那只猫好像是因为别的什么在发火……不知道是什么。

english: Aww, if I didn't feel mad at it for trying to scratch out my eyes, I'd want to go help it...
translation: 啊，要不是因为它差点抓瞎我的眼睛而让我生气，我还真想去帮帮它……

english: Wow! Human, that's incredible!
translation: 哇！人类，太厉害了！

english: Wait, they actually summoned a demon?! And you killed it?!
translation: 等等，他们真的召唤了一只恶魔？！然后你把它杀了？！

english: I bet everyone knows you as one of the greatest heroes of all time!
translation: 我敢打赌所有人都知道你是有史以来最伟大的英雄之一！

english: ...Why would you show me that, human?
translation: ……你为什么要给我看那个，人类？

english: I'd like to give you a reward, but you don't have the space. Could you free up one space in your inventory?
translation: 我想给你奖励，但你没空间了。你能腾出一个物品栏空格吗？

english: If you change your mind about wanting a teleport I'll be here. Otherwise, I'll see you in Varrock, human!
translation: 如果你改变主意想要传送，我还会在这里。不然的话，维洛克城见，人类！

english: So long, human! I'll be here a little while longer if you want a teleport. Otherwise I'll see you in Lumbridge!
translation: 再见，人类！如果还需要传送，我会在这儿多待一会儿。不然的话，仑桥镇见！

english: Well, we have the door completed, so now all that's left to do is to put it up in Draynor.
translation: 好吧，咱们的门做好了，接下来就剩把它装到锥岩村去了。

english: Hah, silly human! No, I thought this through.
translation: 哈，傻人类！不，我考虑周全了。

english: There's... six or seven, I think. Why?
translation: 大概……六七个吧，我想。怎么了？

english: The plan is, we swap out that first door we painted for this one. Then we decorate that first door, swap it out for another one, decorate, swap, repeat!
translation: 计划是，我们把刷好的第一扇门换成这扇。然后装饰第一扇门，再换成另一扇，装饰，换掉，重复！

english: That way I only need to lug one door all the way down to Draynor.
translation: 这样我只需要一路拖一扇门到锥岩村就够了。

english: I got enough decorations for all of Draynor going around.
translation: 我准备了好多装饰，足够把整个锥岩村打扮一遍。

english: Yeah, when you do Easter decorations for a few years you get pretty good at logistics.
translation: 是啊，搞几年复活节装饰，后勤这块就熟门熟路了。

english: Wait a minute, I don't know about this... there could be some nasty man waiting in Varrock for you human, I'd hop worlds if you want a teleport.
translation: 等等，这我可说不准……维洛克城可能有坏蛋等着你呢人类，你要传送的话我建议换个世界。

english: See you in Draynor, human! Talk to me again if you want a teleport there!
translation: 锥岩村见，人类！想传送到那儿再跟我说一声！

english: We were about to go to Thlessia's... Thasselio's... Thlessaloa's...
translation: 我们正准备去塞西利娅……塔塞利欧……塞萨洛亚……的店……

english: You'd think so, but apparently he hasn't done a thing about anything going on outside his walls for years!
translation: 你会这么想，但显然他好几年来对他围墙外的事一点都没管过！

english: Yes! Thessalia's shop in Varrock! We were going to get some nice ribbons for decorations!
translation: 对！维洛克城的塞萨莉亚裁缝店！我们打算去买些好看的丝带做装饰！

english: Why wouldn't it be?
translation: 不然还能是为什么？

english: Conventiently ignore the problem by teleporting around it!
translation: 那就方便地无视问题，传送绕过去呗！

english: Maybe Aggie knows where it is? You should ask her.
translation: 也许阿吉知道它在哪儿？你应该问问她。

english: ... Thanks for putting that thought into my head, human.
translation: ……谢谢你让我想到这个，人类。

english: Wait a minute, I don't know about this... there could be some nasty man waiting in Draynor for you human, I'd hop worlds if you want a teleport.
translation: 等等，这我可说不准……锥岩村可能有坏蛋等着你呢人类，你要传送的话我建议换个世界。

english: Wait, you're in danger! I'll stay with you here until you're safe, human.
translation: 等等，你有危险！我会陪着你直到你安全为止，人类。

english: ... Huh, I never thought of it like that.
translation: ……哈，我从来没这么想过。

english: Thanks a lot, human! I'm still not gonna like it, but I can at least put up with being a cute Easter bunny for the rest of the year!
translation: 多谢啦，人类！虽然我还是不喜欢，但至少今年剩下的时间我能忍忍，当个可爱的复活节兔子！

english: I'd give you these shears but you appear to be a little overloaded.
translation: 我本来想给你这把剪刀，但你看起来有点拿不下了。

english: If you don't mind running back to Lumbridge Castle, there should be a Bank on the top floor for you to put your stuff away!
translation: 如果你不介意跑回仑桥镇城堡，顶层应该有一个银行，你可以把你的东西存起来！

english: Your hint is; you had some shears, and we're stood inside of a sheep pen.
translation: 给你个提示：你刚才拿着剪刀，而我们现在站在羊圈里。

english: I do, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 我有是有的，不过你得先把口袋腾出些空位。

english: Thanks, human, but I don't think we need any more wool.
translation: 谢了人类，不过我们不需要更多羊毛了。

english: Are you alright, human? You appear to be in intense physical pain.
translation: 你没事吧，人类？你看上去好像疼得很厉害。

english: Human, I appreciate you getting into the spirit, but I don't think Easter needs fancy dress parties. Can you take off the costume please?
translation: 人类，我很欣赏你融入节日气氛，但我不认为复活节需要化装舞会。你能把戏服脱掉吗？

english: I can only think of one person silly enough to wear that bad of a penguin costume, human!
translation: 我只能想到一个傻到会穿那么烂的企鹅装的人，人类！

english: I can give you some more flowers, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 我可以再给你些花，不过你得先腾出更多口袋空间。

english: Use a clue scroll of easy, medium, hard, or elite difficulty on me and I can auto-complete it for you.
translation: 把简单、中等、困难或精英难度的线索卷轴交给我，我可以帮你自动完成。

english: I'm sorry, but I only complete Hard clue scrolls and above for Extreme Donators.
translation: 抱歉，我只为极限捐赠者完成困难线索卷轴及以上难度的。

english: You need 1 easy, 1 medium, 1 hard, and 1 elite clue scroll for a master scroll.
translation: 你需要1个简单、1个中等、1个困难和1个精英线索卷轴才能合成一个大师卷轴。

english: I'm sorry, but I only complete Elite clue scrolls and above for Legendary Donators.
translation: 抱歉，我只为传奇捐赠者完成精英线索卷轴及以上难度的。

english: That's not a clue scroll!
translation: 那不是线索卷轴！

english: I'm sorry, but Master clue scrolls are a bit too difficult for me to complete.
translation: 抱歉，大师级线索卷轴对我来说太难完成了。
