translation: 这不是个好主意，因为你清楚自己生日会收到多少礼物。所以你能想象有多少人知道这个日期。永远不要用个人信息来设置找回问题或银行销钉！

english: Never changing your recovery questions will lead to an insecure account due to keyloggers or friends knowing enough about you to guess them. Don't use personal details for your recoveries.
translation: 从不更改找回问题会导致账号不安全，因为键盘记录器或足够了解你的朋友可能猜到它们。不要用个人信息来设置找回问题。

english: Wrong! Zaros values players opinons, but we use polls and forums to see what you think. The recoveries are not there to gain personal information about anybody but to protect your account. Never use personal details
translation: 错误！Zaros 重视玩家的意见，但我们通过投票和论坛来了解你的想法。找回问题不是为了获取任何人的个人信息，而是为了保护你的账号。永远不要用个人信息。

english: Wrong! This does nothing to help the security of your account. You should reset your questions through the'Lost password' link on our website.
translation: 错误！这对你账号的安全毫无帮助。你应该通过我们网站上的“忘记密码”链接来重置你的问题。

english: Ok! Don't tell them the details. But reporting the incident to Zaros would help. Use the Report Abuse button. Never use personal details for recoveries or bank PINs!
translation: 好的！不要告诉他们细节。但向 Zaros 报告此事会有帮助。使用“举报滥用”按钮。永远不要用个人信息来设置找回问题或银行销钉！

english: This is one solution, however someone will fall for this scam sooner or later. Tell us about it through the Zaros website. Remember that  moderators are hand picked by Zaros.
translation: 这是一种解决办法，但迟早会有人上当。通过 Zaros 网站告诉我们。请记住，版主是由 Zaros 亲自挑选的。

english: Normally recovery questions will take 14 days to become active, so there's no point in changing them everyday! Don't use personal details for your recoveries.
translation: 通常找回问题需要14天才能生效，所以每天更改它们毫无意义！不要用个人信息来设置找回问题。

english: Wrong! Zaros never uses email to contact you, this is a scam and a fake, do not reply to it and delete it straight away. Zaros will only contact you through your Game Inbox avaibale on our website.
translation: 错误！Zaros 从不通过电子邮件联系你，这是骗局和伪造的，不要回复并立即删除。Zaros 只会通过我们网站上的游戏收件箱联系你。

english: Wrong! You account may only be used by you.
translation: 错误！你的账号只能由你使用。

english: Wrong! Typing random letters into your recoveries won't help you or the Zaros staff - you'll never remember them anyway! Never use personal details for recoveries or bank PINs!
translation: 错误！在恢复问题中随意输入字母对您或Zaros工作人员都没有帮助——反正您自己也记不住！切勿在恢复问题或银行PIN码中使用个人详细信息！

english: This is a bad idea because it is very difficult to remember and you won't be able to recover your account! Remember: Don't use personal details for your recoveries.
translation: 这是个坏主意，因为很难记住，你将无法找回账号！记住：不要用个人信息来设置找回问题。

english: Wrong! Some programs steal your password without you even knowing, this only requires running the program once, even if you don't use it.
translation: 错误！有些程序会在你不知情的情况下窃取你的密码，只需运行一次程序即可，即使你不使用它。

english: Wrong! The program may steal your password and is against the rules to use.
translation: 错误！该程序可能会窃取你的密码，并且使用它违反规定。

english: This is a bad idea as anyone who knows you could guess them. Remember: Don't use personal details for your recoveries.
translation: 这是个坏主意，因为任何认识你的人都可能猜到。记住：不要用个人信息来设置找回问题。

english: Wrong! Zaros never ask for your account information especially to become a player moderator. Press the 'Report Abuse' button and fill in the offending player's name and the correct cattegory.
translation: 错误！Zaros 绝不会要求你提供账号信息，尤其是为了成为玩家版主。按下“举报滥用”按钮，填写违规玩家的姓名和正确的类别。

english: This is a bad idea as if someone happens to find out your bank PIN on Zaros, they then have acces to your bank account.
translation: 这是个坏主意，因为如果有人碰巧知道了你在 Zaros 上的银行销钉，他们就能访问你的银行账户。

english: Wrong! Always use a unique password purely for your Zaros account.
translation: 错误！始终为你的 Zaros 账号使用独一无二的密码。

english: Wrong! Zaros would never use such an insecure method to pick you. We will contact you through your Game Inbox available on our website.
translation: 错误！Zaros 绝不会使用如此不安全的办法来挑选你。我们会通过网站上的游戏收件箱联系你。

english: Greetings Adventurer. This place is kept safe by the espAritus dentro de las puertas. A medida que pasas, serAs hizo preguntas sobre seguridad. OjalA aprendas mucho de nosotros.
translation: 你好，冒险者。这个地方由门内的精灵守护着。当你经过时，会被问到关于安全的问题。希望你从我们这里学到很多。

english: Wrong! This will almost certainly lead to your accout being hijacked. No website can make you a moderator as they are hand picked by Zaros.
translation: 错误！这几乎肯定会导致你的账号被盗。没有哪个网站能让你成为版主，因为版主是由 Zaros 亲自挑选的。

english: Wrong! This could mean your account may be accessed by someone else. Remove the keylogger then change your password and recoveries. Never use personal details for recoveries or bank PINs!
translation: 错误！这可能意味着你的账号会被别人访问。先移除键盘记录器，然后更改你的密码和找回问题。永远不要用个人信息来设置找回问题或银行销钉！

english: To pass you must answer me this: Can I leave my cuenta conectada mientras estoy fuera de la habitaciA3n?
translation: 要过去，你得回答我这个问题：我可以在离开房间时让我的账号保持登录状态吗？

english: I don't know. I am a gypsy, not a cook.
translation: 我不知道。我是个吉普赛人，又不是厨师。

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have 6 council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我已经用传送术把他们送到安全的地方了！你只需要再保护 6 位议会成员了！

english: Ah, well, that's where it breaks down a bit you see.  The only 'thing' alive which might help you get the Jubbly Chompy is the most confusing beast that Gielinor has ever known.
translation: 啊，嗯，问题就出在这里。唯一能帮你弄到朱布利啃皮兽的活物，是吉列诺大陆有史以来最令人困惑的野兽。

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have 5 council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我已经用传送术把他们送到安全的地方了！你只需要再保护 5 位议会成员了！

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have 7 council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我已经用传送术把他们送到安全的地方了！你只需要再保护 7 位议会成员了！

english: I'm afraid it is.  You see...you need to go and speak to an Ogre called Rantz over in the Feldip hills.
translation: 恐怕是的。你看……你需要去费迪普丘陵找一个叫兰茨的食人魔谈谈。

english: [player name], you must help me defeat this evil!
translation: [player name]，你必须帮我击败这个邪恶！

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have 4 council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我已经用传送术把他们送到安全的地方了！你只需要再保护 4 位议会成员了！

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have 3 council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我已经用传送术把他们送到安全的地方了！你只需要再保护 3 位议会成员了！

english: Hmmm... Wait a moment, my gypsy-sense is tingling...
translation: 嗯……等一下，我的吉普赛直觉在跳动……

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have 2 council members left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我已经用传送术把他们送到安全的地方了！你只需要再保护 2 位议会成员了！

english: [player name], I must warn you, inside that dimension you will have no assistance from the gods, and your prayers will not work at all!
translation: [player name]，我必须警告你，在那个维度里，你将得不到众神的帮助，你的祈祷也完全不会起作用！

english: Good work adventurer, I've teleported them away to safety! You only have one council member left to protect!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！我已经用传送术把他们送到安全的地方了！你只需要再保护 1 位议会成员了！

english: Good work [player name]! I think that will be the last we'll see of him! You'd better come back now.
translation: 干得好，[player name]！我想这是我们最后一次见到他了！你最好现在回来。

english: Take care, I suspect the culinaromancer will not give up so easily!
translation: 小心点，我怀疑烹饪大师不会这么轻易放弃！

english: I am a gypsy, not a cook, and again I would suggest you speak to the cook next door who will be much more helpful on such culinary matters.
translation: 我是个吉普赛人，不是厨师，我再次建议你去和隔壁的厨师谈谈，他在烹饪方面会更有帮助。

english: I am the Gypsy. My friends call me Aris.
translation: 我是吉普赛人。朋友们都叫我阿里斯。

english: You can call me the Gypsy.
translation: 你可以叫我吉普赛人。

english: That is correct. I live in a tent in Varrock.
translation: 没错。我住在维洛克的一个帐篷里。

english: No, not really. Was there something else you wanted to interrogate me about?
translation: 不，不太记得。你还有别的事想盘问我吗？

english: I should do, you came to see me about defeating the demon Delrith.
translation: 我应该记得，你来找我是为了击败恶魔德尔里斯的事。

english: I hear there's a rather chilly reception on top of a rather icy mountain.
translation: 我听说在一座非常寒冷的山顶上，会有一个相当冷淡的接待。

english: What are you telling me for? If you need assistance talk to Traiborn.
translation: 你告诉我干嘛？如果你需要帮助，去找特莱伯恩。

english: Just make that cake!
translation: 只管去做那个蛋糕！

english: That's not very nice. You should have more compassion.
translation: 这可不太好。你应该更有同情心。

english: [player name]! Please help, it's urgent!
translation: [player name]！请帮帮忙，情况紧急！

english: Go into the dining room, I will teleport you to the time of the feast. I saw him escape through the portal as I was casting my spell. Follow him through it and defeat him once and for all. Good luck [player name]!
translation: 进入餐厅，我会把你传送到宴会的时间点。我施法时看到他通过传送门逃走了。跟着他穿过去，一劳永逸地击败他。祝你好运，[player name]！

english: The Culinaromancer! He's back!
translation: 烹饪大师！他回来了！

english: The Culinaromancer, he was the Lumbridge chef a hundred years ago. That was until he threatened the secret council with death.
translation: 烹饪大师，他是一百年前仑桥镇的厨师。直到他用死亡威胁秘密议会。

english: Luckily, he was thwarted by Duke's assistant who managed to trap him in another dimension. I have no idea how he has managed to escape.
translation: 幸运的是，他被公爵的助理挫败了，助理设法将他困在了另一个维度。我不知道他是怎么逃出来的。

english: There was a feast yesterday, with all council members attending. He appeared out of nowhere, seeking vengeance. He was about to attack the council members, so I cast a spell freezing everyone in time.
translation: 昨天有一场宴会，所有议会成员都参加了。他不知从哪儿冒出来，前来寻仇。他正要攻击议会成员，所以我施了一个法术，把所有人都冻结在了时间里。

english: He escaped back into his dimension. He knows that the spell won't last forever. Please, you must follow him and kill him once and for all. Before the spell wears off.
translation: 他逃回了他的维度。他知道这个法术不会永远持续下去。求你了，你必须跟着他，一劳永逸地杀了他。在法术失效之前。

english: Good work [player name]! I think that will be the last we'll see of him. You'd better come back now.
translation: 干得好，[player name]！我想这是我们最后一次见到他了。你最好现在回来。

english: I saw him escape through the portal as I was casting my spell. Follow him through it and defeat him once and for all. Good luck [player name]!
translation: 我施法时看到他通过传送门逃走了。跟着他穿过去，一劳永逸地击败他。祝你好运，[player name]！

english: Thank you for saving the council [player name]! It appears the Culinaromancer's old chest is still down in the cellar. Feel free to take a look! It might have something of value.
translation: 谢谢你拯救了议会，[player name]！看来烹饪大师的旧箱子还在下面的地窖里。尽管去看看！里面可能有些值钱的东西。

english: Which items were amongst those you were shown?
translation: 你看到的东西里有哪些是这些物品？

english: Which of the following items were NOT shown to you?
translation: 以下哪个物品你没有看到？

english: How many weapons were you shown?
translation: 你看到了多少种武器？

english: How many types of rune were there?
translation: 有多少种类的符文？

english: Which item began with the letter 'm'?
translation: 哪个物品以字母 'm' 开头？

english: Hello there. I don't know anything about that. I'm far too concerned about thingummywuts.
translation: 你好。我啥也不知道。我太关心那些小玩意儿了。

english: If anyone were to know anything about that, it would probably be Mizgog. You can find him on the top floor. I think I see one! Right there!
translation: 如果有人知道那件事的任何情况，那很可能就是米兹戈格。你可以在顶楼找到他。我想我看到一个了！就在那里！

english: Hmmm yes thingummywuts.
translation: 嗯嗯，没错，小玩意儿。

english: A gold ring is to 5, as a holy symbol is to...
translation: 金戒指与 5 的关系，如同神圣护符与……？

english: What is the defence level requirement to wear a Mystic Hat?
translation: 佩戴神秘帽需要多少防御等级？

english: What doesn't lie between Morytania and Asgarnia?
translation: 莫利塔尼亚和阿斯加尼亚之间不包含哪个？

english: The River Salve runs from...?
translation: 萨尔维河从……流经？

english: The combat level of Goblins near Lumbridge is:
translation: 仑桥镇附近哥布林的战斗等级是：

english: What ingredients are used in a cake?
translation: 蛋糕需要哪些材料？

english: What is the nearest guild to the Fishing Platform (as the seagull flies)?
translation: 距离钓鱼平台最近（海鸥直线飞行距离）的公会是哪个？

english: I can hear howling in one direction and buzzing in the other - where am I?
translation: 我听到一边有嚎叫声，另一边有嗡嗡声——这是哪里？

english: How much gp does it take to bribe a guard at the toll gate to Al Kharid prior to earning their trust?
translation: 在获得阿尔卡里德城收费站守卫的信任之前，贿赂他需要多少金币？

english: If I'm going to need glass, first I will need:
translation: 如果我要用玻璃，首先我需要：

english: A glass vial is to 33, as a glass orb is to...
translation: 玻璃瓶与 33 的关系，如同玻璃宝珠与……？

english: I'm in a bar west of Pollnivneach. Where am I?
translation: 我在波尼尼镇西边的一家酒吧里。这是哪里？

english: Which tower is closest to the Crafting Guild?
translation: 哪一座塔离制作公会最近？

english: Take the number of Fire Runes required to cast Fire Strike, and multiply by the number of Air Runes used to cast Wind Strike before adding the number of Earth Runes used to cast Earth Wave. What do you get?
translation: 用施放火焰弹所需的火焰符文数量，乘以施放风弹术所用的空气符文数量，再加上施放土浪术所用的土符文数量，结果是多少？

english: That's correct
translation: 正确。

english: OK. You must answer 3 general questions about our lands correctly without getting one wrong. You have as many chances as you need.
translation: 好的。你需要在不错一道题的情况下正确回答三个关于我们大陆的常识问题。你有多少次机会都行。

english: OK. You will be presented with some people that you may have come across on your travels - it's up to you to recall their names. Guess three correctly without error and you will succeed in enchanting the egg.
translation: 好的。你会看到一些你旅途中可能遇到过的人——你需要回忆他们的名字。连续猜对三个，就能成功给蛋附魔。

english: Wassat? No, I need actual bones, not a bank whatsit.
translation: 啥？不，我要的是真骨头，不是银行那个玩意儿。

english: I still need 20 more.
translation: 我还需要 20 个。

english: I still need 24 more.
translation: 我还需要 24 个。

english: That's not the kind of bones I want.
translation: 那不是我要的骨头。

english: I still need 21 more.
translation: 我还需要 21 个。

english: I still need 23 more.
translation: 我还需要 23 个。

english: I still need 22 more.
translation: 我还需要 22 个。

english: Well done, that's correct.
translation: 做得好，答对了。

english: I sealed it using one of my magic rituals. So it would makes sense that another ritual would open it again.
translation: 我用我的一个魔法仪式把它封住了。所以合理的推测是另一个仪式能再次打开它。

english: Okey dokey, watch out for evil cows.
translation: 好嘞，小心邪恶奶牛。

english: Well, you don't have enough space for me to give you the flour.
translation: 呃，你的空间不够，我没法给你面粉。

english: For enchanting this item you will be shown a selection of itemitemhen you stop viewing this selection you'll have to answer three questions correctly in a row and then the flour will be enchanted with guidance.
translation: 为了给这件物品附魔，你会看到一系列物品。等你不再查看这些物品后，你需要连续正确回答三个问题，然后面粉会在引导下被附魔。

english: Well, you don't have enough space for me to give you the egg.
translation: 呃，你的空间不够，我没法给你蛋。

english: I shall need you as my guide and protector, to lead me to these places.
translation: 我需要你作为我的向导和保护者，带我去这些地方。

english: Take me to the cabbage field south of Falador, so we can get a cabbage there together.
translation: 带我去法拉多城以南的卷心菜田，这样我们就可以一起在那里摘一颗卷心菜。

english: I shall now perform a ritual to open the portal...
translation: 我现在要举行一个仪式来打开传送门……

english: I am so grateful to you for your help, [player name]. Let me reward you with some items by which you may remember me...
translation: 我非常感谢你的帮助，[player name]。让我用一些物品来奖励你，这样你就能记住我……

english: How wonderful - I have everything I need to reopen the portal. I shall proceed with the spell when you are ready.
translation: 太棒了——我有了重新打开传送门所需的一切。等你准备好了，我就开始施法。

english: The portal to the Realm of Memories is open! Please, step inside, where I shall be happy to reward you for all your wonderful help.
translation: 通往记忆领域的传送门已经打开！请走进去，我会很高兴地奖励你所有的出色帮助。

english: My heart overflows with gratitude for your help, [player name].
translation: 我的心中充满了对你的感激之情，[player name]。

english: You are very kind to help me on this journey, [player name].
translation: 你真好，愿意在这段旅程中帮助我，[player name]。

english: Do you need to ask me something, [player name]?
translation: 你有什么要问我的吗，[player name]？

english: I seek a feather from Ernest the Chicken. I am aware that Ernest is no longer a chicken, thanks to you, though we should still find what we need on the top floor of Draynor Manor.
translation: 我在寻找一根来自小鸡欧内斯特的羽毛。我知道，多亏了你，欧内斯特不再是一只鸡了，不过我们仍然应该在德雷诺庄园的顶楼找到我们需要的东西。

english: I am very much enjoying our time together, [player name].
translation: 我很享受我们在一起的时光，[player name]。

english: We have everything I need to reopen the portal to the Realm of Memories. Let us return to the top of the Wizards' Tower, where the portal is.
translation: 我们有了重新打开通往记忆领域传送门所需的一切。让我们回到法师塔的顶层，传送门就在那里。

english: In the sheep field north of Lumbridge, there is a mysterious Thing. It looks like a sheep, but it is not a sheep. Bring some shears so we can get some of its wool.
translation: 在仑桥镇以北的羊田里，有一个神秘的东西。它看起来像羊，但又不是羊。带些剪刀，这样我们就能弄到一些它的羊毛。

english: You do me great honour, Bob!
translation: 你给了我莫大的荣幸，鲍勃！

english: Thank you. To return to the Realm of Memories, I need artefacts of great historical importance. But I must visit those historic sites myself, to experience their significance as I collect the artefacts.
translation: 谢谢你。要回到记忆领域，我需要具有重大历史意义的文物。但我必须亲自访问那些历史遗址，在收集文物的同时体验它们的重要性。

english: We must visit Bob, who can be found in the Lumbridge axe shop. He is an incredibly important figure in Gielinor, and I seek his autograph.
translation: 我们必须去拜访鲍勃，他可以在仑桥镇的斧头店里找到。他是吉列诺尔一个极其重要的人物，我想要他的签名。

english: Also in Lumbridge, we must visit the Cook in the castle kitchen. I would like to collect his recipe book.
translation: 同样在仑桥镇，我们必须去城堡厨房拜访厨师。我想收集他的食谱书。

english: Thank you so much, Hans.
translation: 非常感谢你，汉斯。

english: We must visit Draynor Village and obtain the party hat of the Wise Old Man. Please take me to him.
translation: 我们必须去德雷诺村，拿到老智者的派对帽。请带我去见他。

english: It is a great honour for me to meet the mighty Bob. In my realm, you are hailed as one of Gielinor's most famous heroes.
translation: 能见到强大的鲍勃是我的莫大荣幸。在我的领域里，你被誉为吉列诺尔最著名的英雄之一。

english: We must visit Lumbridge, and obtain the navigational chart of a man named Hans. It is a unique chart that has steered his life for many years now.
translation: 我们必须去仑桥镇，拿到一个名叫汉斯的人的航海图。这是一张独特的航海图，多年来一直指引着他的人生。

english: It is an honour to meet you, Dionysius. As [player name] says, I do need your help.
translation: 很高兴见到你，狄俄尼索斯。正如[player name]所说，我确实需要你的帮助。

english: Thank you so much, old man!
translation: 非常感谢你，老人家！

english: Oh, but you are too modest! Your defeat of the Dragonkin in ancient times was a truly historic achievement, and I am a great admirer of yours. May I have your autograph, please?
translation: 哦，你太谦虚了！你在远古时代击败龙人的成就确实是历史性的壮举，我是你的崇拜者。能请你给我签个名吗？

english: I am sure we will find some in the laboratory if we try.
translation: 我相信如果我们去实验室找找，一定能找到一些。

english: Yes, Hans. I have long admired your faithful patrol around this castle, and your friendly greetings for new arrivals in the land.
translation: 是的，汉斯。我一直很钦佩你忠实地绕着这座城堡巡逻，以及你对这片土地上新来者的友好问候。

english: From the earliest days of this world, Fred the Farmer was warning potential sheep shearers of a mysterious Thing that haunted his fields.
translation: 从这个世界最早的日子起，农夫弗雷德就一直在警告潜在的剪羊毛者，有一个神秘的东西出没在他的田地里。

english: I see some things have changed since my era! But no, I do not need a cake. What I need is your recipe book, the one you have been following for all the cakes you have made throughout the years.
translation: 我看到自从我的时代以来有些事情已经改变了！但是不，我不需要蛋糕。我需要的是你的食谱书，就是你多年来制作所有蛋糕时一直遵循的那本。

english: It is an artefact of great historical importance. Even before my own time, you were here in Lumbridge sending adventurers out to bring you cake ingredients.
translation: 这是一件具有重大历史意义的文物。甚至在我自己的时代之前，你就已经在仑桥镇派遣冒险者去为你带来蛋糕原料。

english: As an artefact of historical importance, I can use its inherent powers to reopen the portal to the Realm of Memories, where I reside.
translation: 作为一件具有历史意义的文物，我可以利用它内在的力量重新打开通往我居住的记忆领域的传送门。

english: Now I need your navigational chart to help me get home to the Realm of Memories.
translation: 现在我需要你的航海图来帮助我回到记忆领域。

english: Very much so. Furthermore, I know that the hats were very precious in that era, but they are different nowadays. May I please have it?
translation: 非常正确。此外，我知道在那个时代帽子非常珍贵，但现在它们已经不同了。能把它给我吗？

english: I came through a portal from the Realm of Memories, where I reside with other creatures who have vanished from these lands. Now I need your help to return there.
translation: 我是通过一个传送门从记忆领域过来的，我和其他已经从这片土地上消失的生物一起住在那里。现在我需要你的帮助才能回到那里。

english: At first, there was no Thing - perhaps he just said it to make his sheep-shearing quest sound exciting!
translation: 起初，并没有那个东西——也许他只是为了让他的剪羊毛任务听起来更刺激才这么说的！

english: To return to the Realm of Memories, I need artefacts of great historical importance. But I must visit those historic sites myself, to experience their significance as I collect the artefacts.
translation: 要回到记忆领域，我需要具有重大历史意义的文物。但我必须亲自访问那些历史遗址，在收集文物的同时体验它们的重要性。

english: I shall wait with that friendly wizard in his tower. Meet me there when you are ready to continue.
translation: 我会和那位友好的魔法师在他的塔里等着。你准备好继续的时候，到那里找我。

english: Then, in later times, an actual Thing appeared, and it was even given a purpose. As it has been talked about for so long, I consider it to have historic significance.
translation: 然后，在后来的时代，一个真正的“东西”出现了，它甚至被赋予了目的。既然它被谈论了这么久，我认为它具有历史意义。

english: You are especially famous for asking adventurers to get cake ingredients for you.
translation: 你尤其以要求冒险者为你取蛋糕原料而闻名。

english: You were leading me to the top floor of Draynor Manor to collect a feather from Ernest the Chicken. Although he is no longer a chicken, thanks to you, we should still find what we need there.
translation: 你正带我去德雷诺庄园的顶楼，去收集一根来自小鸡欧内斯特的羽毛。虽然多亏了你，他不再是一只鸡了，但我们仍然应该在那里找到我们需要的东西。

english: Since the earliest days of the world, the humble cabbage has been favoured above all other vegetables. All must know that cabbage is good for you!
translation: 从这个世界最早的日子起，不起眼的卷心菜就比其他所有蔬菜更受青睐。所有人都必须知道卷心菜对你有好处！

english: Long ago, there was a break-in at the Draynor Village bank. A man smashed through the wall and stole a lot of money.
translation: 很久以前，德雷诺村的银行发生了一起闯入事件。一个人破墙而入，偷了很多钱。

english: I am just a simple gnome. Perhaps to you I look unusual, but in my day all gnomes were green, like the trees where we live.
translation: 我只是一个简单的地精。也许在你看来我与众不同，但在我的时代，所有地精都是绿色的，就像我们居住的树木一样。

english: The field south of Falador is renowned as a wondrous source of brassican goodness. Let us go there and pluck one from its earthy cradle.
translation: 法拉多城以南的田地被誉为芸苔属美味的奇妙源泉。让我们去那里，从它泥土的摇篮中摘一颗吧。

english: You were leading me to the sheep field north of Lumbridge, to shear some wool from the mysterious Thing that looks like a sheep, but that is not a sheep.
translation: 你正带我去仑桥镇以北的羊田，去剪那个看起来像羊但又不是羊的神秘东西的羊毛。

english: The world has changed since he first acquired that hat. I think I will get what I need.
translation: 自从他第一次得到那顶帽子以来，世界已经变了。我想我会得到我需要的东西。

english: Some forces in this world move in mysterious ways. Gravity, the Anima Mundi and the price of granite mauls are just three everyday examples.
translation: 这个世界上有些力量以神秘的方式运作。重力、阿尼玛.蒙迪和花岗岩巨锤的价格只是三个日常例子。

english: It is the haunted mansion where you saved Ernest before. As you will recall, we may enter freely through the front doors, though we must leave through the back door which is in the easternmost room.
translation: 那是你之前拯救欧内斯特的鬼屋。你记得，我们可以自由地从正门进入，但必须从最东边房间的后门离开。

english: For many new arrivals in Gielinor, their first adventure is helping the Cook to bake a cake. Indeed, it is one of the oldest adventures of all time!
translation: 对于许多吉列诺尔的新来者来说，他们的第一次冒险就是帮助厨师烤蛋糕。确实，这是有史以来最古老的冒险之一！

english: I came here at the invitation of this friendly wizard, and soon he will help me depart again.
translation: 我是应这位友好的魔法师的邀请来到这里的，很快他就会帮我离开。

english: This recipe for cakes is famed among the many generations who have passed through Lumbridge, and I greatly desire the recipe book.
translation: 这份蛋糕食谱在历经仑桥镇的几代人中都很有名，我非常想要这本食谱书。

english: In my realm, we can observe all deeds, hear all secrets, learn all truths, understand all things. We also know your name, [player name].
translation: 在我的领域里，我们可以观察所有行为，听到所有秘密，了解所有真相，理解一切事物。我们也知道你的名字，[player name]。

english: In the course of the raid, a victim dropped her blue party hat, and the man took it. It is no secret that this was the Wise Old Man, though the bank remains discreet about it.
translation: 在袭击过程中，一名受害者掉落了她的蓝色派对帽，那个男人拿走了它。众所周知，这个人就是老智者，尽管银行对此事保持缄默。

english: Hans may move more predictably, but his navigational chart will reveal the guiding principles that steer him, so that we can better understand this iconic facet of our world.
translation: 汉斯的行动可能更可预测，但他的航海图将揭示指引他的指导原则，这样我们就能更好地理解我们世界中这个标志性的一面。

english: You were leading me to the cabbage field south of Falador so that we can get a cabbage there.
translation: 你正带我去法拉多城以南的卷心菜田，这样我们就可以在那里摘一颗卷心菜。

english: As a memorial of that event, there can be no finer artefact than a blue party hat from the Wise Old Man.
translation: 作为那次事件的纪念，没有比老智者的蓝色派对帽更好的文物了。

english: The bank's security footage of the event can be watched, if you ever wish, by bribing the guard who now patrols the area.
translation: 如果你愿意，可以通过贿赂现在在该区域巡逻的守卫来观看该事件的银行安全录像。

english: Your offer is kind, but for now I must direct you to the wizard, since he was the one who brought me here.
translation: 你的提议很友善，但现在我必须让你去找那位魔法师，因为是他把我带到这里来的。

english: Hans patrols the courtyard of Lumbridge Castle, as he has done for many years. Many people remember him as one of the first friendly faces they encountered in these lands.
translation: 汉斯在仑桥镇城堡的庭院里巡逻，多年来一直如此。许多人记得他是他们在这片土地上遇到的第一批友善面孔之一。

english: No, I wish to witness the moment when the individual cabbage's connection to the Anima Mundi is irreversibly severed, as you pluck it from the nurturing soil in the field south of Falador.
translation: 不，我希望亲眼目睹那颗卷心菜与阿尼玛.蒙迪的联系被不可逆转地切断的那一刻，当你在法拉多城以南的田地里将它从滋养的土壤中拔出时。

english: Over time, many people have come into the world and left it again. One such is Thrander, who used to perform armour conversion services in Varrock. Another is Chuck, the wood certificate trader.
translation: 随着时间的推移，许多人来到这个世界又离开了。其中之一是特兰德，他曾在维洛克城提供盔甲转换服务。另一个是查克，木材证书商人。

english: When their services were no longer required, they moved on, but they were not all forgotten. Some linger still in the Realm of Memories.
translation: 当他们的服务不再需要时，他们就离开了，但他们并没有全部被遗忘。有些人仍然留在记忆领域。

english: I would have dearly loved that. However we are limited to this hall, where the more aggressive creatures can play in safety.
translation: 我本来非常希望那样。不过我们只能局限在这个大厅里，这样更具攻击性的生物就可以安全地玩耍。

english: His long-term contribution to our society renders him historically significant, and an artefact from Hans would be a precious gift.
translation: 他对我们社会的长期贡献使他具有历史意义，来自汉斯的文物将是一份珍贵的礼物。

english: First you must get some shears. Then you can continue leading me to the sheep field north of Lumbridge, to shear some wool from the mysterious Thing that looks like a sheep, but that is not a sheep.
translation: 首先你必须弄到一些剪刀。然后你可以继续带我去仑桥镇以北的羊田，去剪那个看起来像羊但又不是羊的神秘东西的羊毛。

english: Furthermore, the dimensional shifts would not allow it - a two-dimensional entity would be incomprehensible to your three-dimensional mind.
translation: 此外，维度转换不允许这样做——一个二维实体对你三维的头脑来说是无法理解的。

english: From the Realm, we watch how the world changes. We see the happy moments, the sad times, the lucky events, the dry streaks. It is a wonderful existence.
translation: 从领域里，我们观察世界如何变化。我们看到快乐的时刻、悲伤的时光、幸运的事件、倒霉的连败。这是一种美妙的存在。

english: No, some things must be left to the memory, even here in the Realm of Memories.
translation: 不，有些事情必须留给记忆，即使是在记忆领域里。

english: From the Realm of Memories, we saw that Bob was disguised as a cat so effectively that even he forgot who he had been.
translation: 从记忆领域，我们看到鲍勃伪装成一只猫，效果如此之好，以至于连他自己都忘记了自己曾经是谁。

english: I do not require any more feathers, thank you.
translation: 我不需要更多的羽毛了，谢谢。

english: Is it a mere coincidence that this man bears the same name? Or might his name reveal an underlying truth - that Bob is Bob?
translation: 这个人与之同名，仅仅是巧合吗？或者，他的名字是否揭示了一个潜在的真相——鲍勃就是鲍勃？

english: I am just a simple gnome. Perhaps to you I look unusual, but in my day all gnomes were green, like the trees where we live. In the Realm of Memories, the old days are remembered thus.
translation: 我只是一个简单的地精。也许在你看来我与众不同，但在我的时代，所有地精都是绿色的，就像我们居住的树木一样。在记忆领域，旧日时光就是这样被铭记的。

english: Go to the sheep field north of Lumbridge. Seek the Thing that looks like a sheep, but that is not a sheep. Use the shears on it.
translation: 去仑桥镇以北的羊田。寻找那个看起来像羊但又不是羊的东西。用剪刀剪它。

english: You have not had extensive dealings with the mysterious Bob, I see, so you cannot possibly comprehend his enigmatic nature. I am confident that this man's autograph is what I need.
translation: 我看你和神秘的鲍勃没有过广泛的交往，所以你不可能理解他神秘的本质。我相信这个人的签名就是我需要的。

english: Even to this day, the Short Green Guy cocktail is so named because of this. In fact, Blurberry still instructs his apprentices not to bring him a gnome when he asks for a Short Green Guy.
translation: 直到今天，小绿人鸡尾酒之所以得名，就是因为这个。事实上，布鲁贝利仍然指示他的学徒们，当他点小绿人时，不要给他带一个地精来。

english: In the kitchen, in Lumbridge Castle.
translation: 在仑桥镇城堡的厨房里。

english: Get some shears, maybe in a local shop. Then go to the sheep field north of Lumbridge. Seek the Thing that looks like a sheep, but that is not a sheep. Use the shears on it.
translation: 弄些剪刀，也许在当地的商店里。然后去仑桥镇以北的羊田。寻找那个看起来像羊但又不是羊的东西。用剪刀剪它。

english: You were leading me to Draynor Village, so we could obtain the party hat of the Wise Old Man.
translation: 你正带我去德雷诺村，这样我们就能拿到老智者的派对帽。

english: With that attitude you may miss so many wonders in this world! But I desire Bob's autograph even if you do not believe in him.
translation: 抱着这种态度，你可能会错过这个世界上的许多奇迹！但即使你不相信鲍勃，我也想要他的签名。

english: I seek a feather from Ernest the Chicken. I do not believe you have met him yet, but you can find him on the top floor of Draynor Manor.
translation: 我在寻找一根来自小鸡欧内斯特的羽毛。我不认为你见过他，但你可以在德雷诺庄园的顶楼找到他。

english: Even when a story has ended on a sad note, there can always be a sequel. I shall continue believing that Bob is Bob, even if you think their names are just a coincidence.
translation: 即使一个故事以悲伤的结局告终，也总会有续集。我会继续相信鲍勃就是鲍勃，即使你认为他们的名字只是巧合。

english: He surely did, though he may not understand the significance of whatever items he used. Sadly he seems reluctant to speak to me himself, so I cannot enlighten his mind with my wisdom.
translation: 他肯定做了，尽管他可能不明白他使用的任何物品的意义。可悲的是，他似乎不愿意亲自和我说话，所以我无法用我的智慧启迪他的思想。

english: The artefacts would have been significant to the imps, in their own way. As their summoner, Grayzag's connection to the imps would convey the significance to him, whether or not he realised this.
translation: 这些文物对小恶魔来说，以它们自己的方式具有意义。作为它们的召唤者，格雷扎格与小恶魔的联系会将这种意义传达给他，无论他是否意识到这一点。

english: You were leading me to Lumbridge, so we could obtain the navigational chart of Hans. It is a unique chart that has steered his life for many years now.
translation: 你正带我去仑桥镇，这样我们就能拿到汉斯的航海图。这是一张独特的航海图，多年来一直指引着他的人生。

english: Like me, they dwelt in the world as it used to be, in various different eras. Many such people have faded away into the mists of time, but a lucky few are remembered.
translation: 和我一样，他们生活在过去的世界里，在不同的时代。许多这样的人已经消失在时间的迷雾中，但少数幸运儿被铭记。

english: Grayzag acquires all kinds of items from his imps, without necessarily understanding what they are. After so many years, it is of no surprise that he has stumbled across something useful at last!
translation: 格雷扎格从他的小恶魔那里获得了各种各样的物品，不一定明白它们是什么。这么多年过去了，他终于偶然发现了有用的东西，这并不奇怪！

english: They would be glad to meet you, I am sure.
translation: 我相信他们会很高兴见到你。

english: I do not require any more cabbages, thank you.
translation: 我不需要更多的卷心菜了，谢谢。

english: You were leading me to the Lumbridge axe shop, so I could request the autograph of the great Bob.
translation: 你正带我去仑桥镇的斧头店，这样我就可以请求伟大的鲍勃的签名。

english: I shall need you as my guide and protector, to lead me to these places. But you appear to have a follower already - perhaps you can relieve yourself of this encumbrance.
translation: 我需要你作为我的向导和保护者，带我去这些地方。但你似乎已经有一个跟随者了——也许你可以摆脱这个累赘。

english: I believe not, though I doubt he would ever acknowledge this! We shall have to acquire artefacts ourselves to reopen his portal. Best of all, I shall enjoy our walk together!
translation: 我不这么认为，尽管我怀疑他永远不会承认这一点！我们必须自己获取文物来重新打开他的传送门。最重要的是，我会享受我们一起散步的时光！

english: Meet me at the portal in the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 在法师塔的传送门处见我。

english: Indeed. Even to this day, the Short Green Guy cocktail is so named because of this. In fact, Blurberry still instructs his apprentices not to bring him a gnome when he asks for a Short Green Guy.
translation: 确实。直到今天，小绿人鸡尾酒之所以得名，就是因为这个。事实上，布鲁贝利仍然指示他的学徒们，当他点小绿人时，不要给他带一个地精来。

english: There are monsters there too - demons and dragons as they looked in older days. Though they are not what Grayzag hoped to summon into the world, so he has no interest in the Realm.
translation: 那里也有怪物——恶魔和龙，就像它们过去的样子。不过它们不是格雷扎格希望召唤到世界上的东西，所以他对这个领域没有兴趣。

english: Ernest was a rather unfortunate human. Now he is a rather unfortunate chicken. I need not dwell on the details, but I greatly desire one of his feathers.
translation: 欧内斯特曾经是一个相当不幸的人类。现在他是一只相当不幸的鸡。我不需要详述细节，但我非常想要他的一根羽毛。

english: One piece of wool will suffice from this sheep-themed costume for penguins. Why would anyone need a second? That might become ridiculous.
translation: 从这个企鹅的绵羊主题服装上取一块羊毛就够了。为什么有人需要第二块？那可能会变得荒谬。

english: You were leading me back to the Wizards' Tower so that I can reopen the portal to the Realm of Memories, on the top floor of the tower.
translation: 你正带我回到法师塔，这样我就可以在塔的顶楼重新打开通往记忆领域的传送门。

english: Yes, thank you indeed!
translation: 是的，非常感谢！

english: You were leading me to the kitchen of Lumbridge Castle, where I seek the recipe book of the Cook.
translation: 你正带我去仑桥镇城堡的厨房，我要在那里找厨师的食谱书。

english: It will be very helpful.
translation: 这会非常有帮助。

english: It is kind of you to offer me your items, [player name], but that is not the way I need to acquire the artefacts to reopen the portal.
translation: 你真好，愿意把你的物品给我，[player name]，但这不是我获取文物来重新打开传送门所需要的方式。

english: Draynor Manor is a haunted mansion, north of Draynor Village. We may enter freely through the front doors, though we must leave through the back door which is in the easternmost room.
translation: 德雷诺庄园是一座鬼屋，位于德雷诺村北边。我们可以从前门自由进入，但必须从最东边房间的后门离开。

english: This does not feel like the route I had expected. I would prefer not to go much further.
translation: 这感觉不像是我预想的路。我不想再走太远了。

english: That is your cabbage, not my cabbage. My cabbage would have been plucked, in my presence, in the big cabbage field south of Falador.
translation: 那是你的卷心菜，不是我的卷心菜。我的卷心菜应该是在法拉多城南边的大卷心菜田里，在我面前被摘下来的。

english: You were leading me to the top floor of Draynor Manor to collect a feather from Ernest the Chicken. I do not believe you have met him yet, but you can find him there.
translation: 你正带我去德雷诺庄园的顶楼，去收集一根来自小鸡欧内斯特的羽毛。我不认为你见过他，但你可以在那里找到他。

english: Cabbage is good for you.
translation: 卷心菜对你有好处。

english: Yes, thank you very much!
translation: 是的，非常感谢！

english: Try not to provoke the ghosts or trees.
translation: 尽量不要招惹那些幽灵或树。

english: It is so precious to me!
translation: 它对我来说太珍贵了！

english: Would you tell a mountain it is too tall? Would you tell the sea it is too wet? The world does not seek our approval or belief; accept that things are as they are.
translation: 你会对一座山说它太高了吗？你会对大海说它太湿了吗？这个世界并不寻求我们的认可或相信；接受事物本来的样子。

english: I shall wait.
translation: 我会等的。

english: Consider a world in which particles and waves were aspects of a single nebulous reality, and in which the passage of time could be dilated by gravitational effects. Is that not far-fetched?
translation: 想象一个世界，其中粒子和波是一种模糊现实的方面，时间的流逝可以被引力效应所延缓。这难道不是很牵强吗？

english: But no, the world need not conform to our expectations. A leaf blowing in the wind must go where the wind takes it, and a human living in this world must accept magic. Things are as they are.
translation: 但是不，世界不必符合我们的预期。一片风中飘动的叶子必须随风而去，一个生活在这个世界的人类必须接受魔法。事物就是它们本来的样子。

english: This is not where I wanted to obtain a cabbage. I asked for one from the cabbage field south of Falador. The big field, perpetually laden with brassican goodness.
translation: 这不是我想得到卷心菜的地方。我要的是法拉多城南边卷心菜田里的一个。那片大田，永远长满了芸苔属的好东西。

english: While cabbage is good for you, one will suffice for me at this time.
translation: 虽然卷心菜对你有好处，但一个就够我现在的了。

english: I am so grateful to you for your help, [player name]. If you could free up an inventory space, I wish to reward you with some items by which you may remember me.
translation: 我非常感谢你的帮助，[player name]。如果你能腾出一个背包空间，我想用一些物品奖励你，让你能记住我。

english: You were leading me to Draynor Village, to speak to the old woman who spies on the house of the Wise Old Man. I would have preferred to meet him, to ask for his party hat, but he is away from home.
translation: 你正要带我去德雷诺村，跟那个监视老智者房子的老妇人说话。我更想见他，问他要他的派对帽，但他不在家。

english: I had hoped to meet the Wise Old Man of Draynor Village. However I know he is away from home at the moment.
translation: 我本来希望见到德雷诺村的老智者。不过我知道他现在不在家。

english: I seek a feather from Ernest the Chicken. He is still on the top floor of Draynor Manor, as you have yet to find the Professor's missing items.
translation: 我在寻找一根来自小鸡欧内斯特的羽毛。他还在德雷诺庄园的顶楼，因为你还没有找到教授丢失的物品。

english: I trust you will complete that quest one day, so that Ernest can be reunited with Veronica. However, for now, I do indeed require you to help me pluck a feather from him.
translation: 我相信你总有一天会完成那个任务，这样欧内斯特就能和维罗妮卡团聚了。不过，现在我的确需要你帮我从他身上拔一根羽毛。

english: I expect the old woman will help us.
translation: 我期待那位老妇人会帮助我们。

english: What I need is his party hat. Perhaps you can take me to the old woman who spies on his house. She may be able to help us instead.
translation: 我需要的是他的派对帽。也许你可以带我去见那个监视他房子的老妇人。她或许能帮我们。

english: Hello Miss Schism. Yes, as the Wise Old Man is away from home, I think you might be able to help me instead.
translation: 你好，希斯姆小姐。是的，既然老智者不在家，我想你也许能帮我。

english: From the Realm of Memories, we observed the old man's bank heist, in which he obtained a blue party hat. I need such historic artefacts to reopen the portal. Can you help me get it?
translation: 从记忆领域，我们观察到了老者的银行劫案，他得到了一个蓝色派对帽。我需要这样的历史文物来重新打开传送门。你能帮我拿到它吗？

english: I shall need you as my guide and protector, to lead me to these places. But you appear to have a follower already, and if I follow you now, it will be lost.
translation: 我需要你作为我的向导和保护者，带我去这些地方。但你似乎已经有了一个跟随者，如果我现在跟你走，它就会消失。

english: I came through a portal from the Realm of Memories, where I reside with other creatures who have vanished from these lands. I think you can help me to return there.
translation: 我从记忆领域穿过一道传送门而来，我和其他从这片土地上消失的生物住在那里。我想你可以帮我回到那里。

english: It is the haunted mansion where you met Professor Oddenstein. As you will recall, we may enter freely through the front doors, though we must leave through the back door which is in the easternmost room.
translation: 就是你遇见奥登斯坦教授的那座鬼屋。你大概记得，我们可以从前门自由进入，但必须从最东边房间的后门离开。

english: It is kind of you to offer me your items, [player name], but I already have the artefacts I require to reopen the portal.
translation: 你真好，想把你的物品给我，[player name]，但我已经有重新打开传送门所需的文物了。

english: You were leading me to the top floor of Draynor Manor, so we can collect a feather from Ernest the Chicken.
translation: 你正带我去德雷诺庄园的顶楼，这样我们就可以收集一根来自小鸡欧内斯特的羽毛。

english: Let's not confuse matters, [player name]. I have the autograph of the mighty Bob, and I am satisfied with that.
translation: 我们别把事情搞混了，[player name]。我有强大的鲍勃的签名，对此我很满意。

english: Are you really sure? Some followers are highly valuable and hard to replace. Are you really willing to lose it by letting me follow you now?
translation: 你确定吗？有些跟随者非常珍贵且难以替代。你真的愿意为了让我现在跟随你而失去它吗？

english: It should suffice. It is still the Wise Old Man's blue party hat, after all.
translation: 应该就够了。毕竟这还是老智者的蓝色派对帽。

english: The creatures of this realm are neither truly canonical nor cannonable.
translation: 这个领域的生物既不是真正正典的，也不是可以炮击的。

english: In that case you should free up some inventory space so you can carry it.
translation: 那样的话，你应该腾出一些背包空间来携带它。

english: I observed that incident from the Realm of Memories, yes. Do not let her make you feel bad about your role in that event, [player name].
translation: 我从记忆领域观察到了那件事，是的。别让她因为你在那件事中的角色而让你感到内疚，[player name]。

english: Sorry, you may only use the targets for the competition, not for practicing.
translation: 抱歉，你只能使用比赛用的靶子，不能用来练习。

english: I suggest you use the 10 bronze arrows I gave you.
translation: 我建议你用我给你的10支青铜箭。

english: You need a bow to take part in the competition.
translation: 你需要一把弓才能参加比赛。

english: Ok, but it'll cost you 100 coins.
translation: 好吧，但你要付100金币。

translation: 你真的总能找到最不寻常的东西。我知道这是什么——一种强力化学物质，叫硝酸铵。你为什么要这个，我永远搞不懂...

english: right track for a find of great archaeological importance!
translation: 正朝着重大考古发现的方向前进！

english: Its inhabitants were humans  supporters of the god Saradomin. It's not recorded what happened to the community here.
translation: 它的居民是人类——萨拉多明神的信徒。没有记载这里后来发生了什么。

english: I don't think that has any archaeological significance
translation: 我觉得这没什么考古价值。

english: Ah yes, I recognise you! You're the lass who found that strange artefact about Zaros for the museum, aren't you? What can I do for you now?
translation: 啊，是的，我认出你了！你就是那个为博物馆找到扎罗斯奇怪古物的姑娘，对吧？现在我能为你做什么？

english: Good  that's three; I can exchange them for normal gold now. You can get this refined and make a profit!
translation: 好，三个了；现在我可以把它们换成普通金币。你可以把这精炼一下，赚一笔！

english: Whyever not? You're the strangest delivery girl I've ever met!
translation: 为什么不行？你是我见过最奇怪的送货女孩！

english: Let me see... This is a belt buckle. Not so unusual - I should imagine it came from a guard.
translation: 让我看看……这是个皮带扣。不算太稀奇——我猜是来自一个守卫的。

english: No doubt this arrow was shot by a strong warrior  it's split in half! It is not a valuable object though.
translation: 毫无疑问这支箭是由一位强壮的战士射出的——它裂成了两半！不过不是什么值钱的东西。

english: Well, I wrote you up a rough translation, but you'll need to free up some inventory space for it.
translation: 嗯，我给你写了一份粗略的翻译，但你需要腾出一些背包空间来拿它。

english: Ah, yes  a fine bone example... no noticeable fractures... and in good condition. These are common cow bones, however; they have no archaeological value.
translation: 啊，是的——一个很好的骨骼样本……没有明显裂缝……保存良好。不过这些是普通的奶牛骨头，没有考古价值。

english: You don't even have room for another in your pack!
translation: 你背包里连一个都放不下了！

english: Hello there, AaAoAAoAa!
translation: 你好啊，AaAoAAoAa！

english: Well, I can give you another, but you'll need to free up some inventory space for it.
translation: 嗯，我可以再给你一个，但你需要腾出一些背包空间来拿它。

english: So, if ye add 5 buckets of water to the hoppers, then ye get access to one bottle.  If you add 3 bowls of coloured water you get access to one bottle, and if you add one of anything else you get access to one bottle.
translation: 所以，如果您往料斗里加5桶水，就可以得到一个瓶子。如果您加3碗有色水，就可以得到一个瓶子，如果您加任何其他一件东西，也可以得到一个瓶子。

english: Well, for each bottle that your team produces, I'll give you one piece of eight.
translation: 嗯，您的团队每生产一个瓶子，我就给您一枚八片币。

english: Inside this walled area there are a few Scrapey trees.  They are the big, ill looking ones, you can't miss them.
translation: 在这个围起来的区域里有几棵刮刮树。它们是那些看起来病恹恹的大树，你不会错过的。

english: Arrr! Looks like my crew is quite large enough.
translation: 啊！看来我的船员已经够多了。

english: Come back when there is some space for you.
translation: 等有空位了再来吧。

english: No, get away!
translation: 不，走开！

english: Get off me! No, no... don't pull my hair!
translation: 放开我！不，不……别拉我的头发！

english: Help! Someone please help! This monkey is attacking me!
translation: 救命！有人吗？快来帮帮我！这只猴子在攻击我！

english: Thanks for getting that monkey. You're my saviour!
translation: 谢谢你赶走了那只猴子。你是我的救命恩人！

english: Someone? Anyone!
translation: 有人吗？谁也好！

english: Aaah! It's pulling my hair!
translation: 啊！它在扯我头发！

english: Although I'm not sure how I can possibly repay you?

english: Oh my, aren't you a rare breed of adventurer?
translation: 哦，天哪，你难道是个稀有的冒险者吗？

english: You wouldn't believe how many people just ran on by, ignoring my plight. They're always just looking out for themselves and won't do anything unless they'll get something out of it.
translation: 你简直不敢相信有多少人无视我的困境，直接跑过去。他们总是只顾自己，除非能从中得到好处，否则什么也不肯做。

translation: 嗯，仑桥镇公爵发现了一块奇怪的石头，似乎没人能理解。也许你能帮他？你大概能在仑桥城堡楼上找到他。

english: Hi there, I'm Ektheme, an expert on the Xerician era.
translation: 你好，我是埃克特梅，泽里克时期的专家。

english: We do have records of course. However, while Xeric was indeed ruler of the kingdom from the thirty-seventh to the forty-seventh decades, some believe that he actually ruled for longer.
translation: 我们当然有记录。不过，虽然泽里克确实在第37到第47个十年间统治着王国，但有些人认为他实际统治时间更长。

english: It is often speculated that Xeric and his predecesor, King Shayzien VII, were in fact the same person.
translation: 人们经常猜测泽里克和他的前任，谢兹恩七世国王，实际上是同一个人。

english: It's possible. I am no expert on necromancy but we know the Dark Altar has the power to resurrect beasts. We also know that it can extend life, it's how the people of Arceuus are immortal.
translation: 有可能。我不是死灵法术专家，但我知道黑暗祭坛有能力复活野兽。我们也知道它可以延长寿命，阿西乌斯城的人就是这样不朽的。

english: Xeric drew much of his power from the Dark Altar but he asserted his authority as ruler through his personal army of creatures, the lizardmen.
translation: 泽里克从黑暗祭坛汲取了大量力量，但他通过自己的生物军队——蜥蜴人来确立他作为统治者的权威。

english: During the fourty-seventh decade, after ten decades of oppression, the people revolted against Xeric and his army of lizardmen.
translation: 在第四十七个十年，经过十年的压迫，人民起义反抗泽里克和他的蜥蜴人军队。

english: The king was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the thirty-seventh decade. We have many accounts of this yet his body was never recovered.
translation: 国王在第三十七个十年的大会战中阵亡。我们有很多关于此事的记载，但他的尸体从未被找到。

english: Just days after his death, we have the first recorded mention of Xeric, an incredibly powerful mage who resembled the king.
translation: 就在他死后几天，我们第一次记录到了泽里克，一个与国王长得极为相似、极其强大的法师。

english: Xeric was undoubtedly powerful but he couldn't rule the people singlehandedly, nor could he rely on human informants. He needed an army he could control.
translation: 泽里克无疑很强大，但他无法独自统治人民，也不能依赖人类线人。他需要一支他能控制的军队。

english: 'Twas the three-hundred and twelvth day of decade forty-seven. Byrne, a farmer by trade, is said to have witnessed a lizardman guard murder a child whilst working his farm.
translation: 那是第四十七个十年的第312天。据说有个名叫伯恩的农夫，在耕作时目睹一名蜥蜴人守卫谋杀了一个孩子。

english: It is written that Xeric killed the other rulers and claimed the Kingdom of Great Kourend as his own.
translation: 据记载，泽里克杀死了其他统治者，将大库兰德王国据为己有。

english: Sadly no, while we have many witness accounts they all differ so we can not verify it at all.
translation: 可惜没有，虽然我们有很多目击者的说法，但它们各不相同，所以我们根本没办法验证。

english: Whatever Byrne said, the people responded; together the citizens of Kourend revolted, grabbing whatever they could use as a weapon. They fought the lizardmen.
translation: 无论伯恩说了什么，人民都响应了；库兰德王国的市民们团结起来，拿起任何能当作武器的东西进行了起义。他们与蜥蜴人战斗。

english: During the battle the temple surrounding the Dark Altar was destroyed, weakening Xeric's power. We believe he fled to Quidamortem.
translation: 战斗中，环绕黑暗祭坛的神庙被摧毁，削弱了泽里克的力量。我们相信他逃到了奎达莫特姆。

english: Outraged at what he had just seen, Byrne gathered his pitchfork and sprinted towards the guard.
translation: 伯恩看到这一幕，怒不可遏，抄起干草叉就冲向那个守卫。

english: The lizardmen, while strong and powerful were simply outnumbered. In a matter of days they had been driven back into the lands beyond the kingdom.
translation: 蜥蜴人虽然强壮有力，但终究寡不敌众。几天之内，他们就被赶回了王国以外的土地。

english: Blinded by fury, Byrne attacked the guard, slaughtering the lizardman in plain sight of all within the town.
translation: 伯恩被愤怒冲昏了头脑，攻击了那个守卫，在镇里所有人的眼前杀死了那个蜥蜴人。

english: Some say Xeric was actually killed during the revolt but we have no record of his remains being discovered.
translation: 有些人说泽里克实际上在起义中被杀了，但我们没有发现他遗骸的记录。

english: They remain loyal to Xeric. Even to this day they continue to attack the kingdom as you have seen.
translation: 他们仍然忠于泽里克。即使到今天，他们还在继续攻击王国，就像你看到的那样。

english: Without examining their minds we will never know for sure. However we assume Xeric genetically altered them, to enforce that their duty is to serve him.
translation: 不检查他们的思想，我们永远不会确定。不过我们假设泽里克对他们进行了基因改造，以确保他们的职责就是效忠于他。

english: A good question, [player name]. One that I'm afraid I do not know the answer to.
translation: 好问题，[player name]。但恐怕我也不知道答案。

english: Fortunately the Shayzien army keeps them under control.
translation: 幸运的是，谢兹恩军队控制着他们。

english: Originally, we believed that Xeric created the lizardmen. However, recent discovieres suggest they were actually created during the time of King Shayzien VII.
translation: 最初，我们相信是泽里克创造了蜥蜴人。然而，最近的发现表明，他们实际上是在谢兹恩七世国王时期被创造出来的。

english: Xeric was incredibly powerful, but we can reasonably assume that he soon perished. Without the power of the Dark Altar, Xeric would have become mortal.
translation: 泽里克非常强大，但我们可以合理推测他很快就消亡了。没有黑暗祭坛的力量，泽里克会变成凡人。

english: The king was killed at the Battle of the Concourse during the 37th decade. We have many accounts of this, yet his body was never recovered.
translation: 国王在第37个十年的大会战中阵亡。我们有很多关于此事的记载，但他的尸体从未被找到。

english: Fortunately, the Shayzien army keeps them under control.
translation: 幸运的是，谢兹恩军队控制着他们。

english: Originally we believed that Xeric created the lizardmen. However, recent discovieres suggest they were actually created during the time of King Shayzien VII.
translation: 最初我们相信是泽里克创造了蜥蜴人。然而，最近的发现表明，他们实际上是在谢兹恩七世国王时期被创造出来的。

translation: 泽里克非常强大，但如果没有黑暗祭坛，他很快就会变成凡人并消亡。

english: After that, I saw he'd got lots of holiday items hidden in his house, so of course I took some. So I've got blue party hats from the old man, and you can have one.
translation: 之后我发现他屋里藏了好多节日物品，我当然拿了一些。所以我从他那里拿到了蓝色派对帽，你可以拿一顶。

english: Oooh, yes, I can help you, my dear. I've been in that house, and I know all his dirty little secrets. I found his store of holiday items, long ago.
translation: 哦，是的，我能帮你，亲爱的。我进过那房子，知道他所有肮脏的小秘密。我很久以前就发现了他的节日物品储藏室。

english: He didn't deserve them, you know. So of course I took them. He's got plenty more, so don't go feeling sorry for that old man. And they're evidence of his crimes, anyway.
translation: 他不配拥有它们，你知道的。所以我当然拿了。他还有更多呢，别为那老头感到难过。再说，那些也是他罪行的证据。

english: Oooh, a gnome? Where is it?
translation: 哦，一个地精？在哪？

english: Thanks, you should be able to get some tears from the next chest!
translation: 谢谢，你应该能从下一个箱子里得到一些眼泪了！

english: You're not going through there with that thing on your head.
translation: 你头上戴着那玩意别想从这里过去。

english: You're not going through there with that bowl with you.
translation: 你带着那个碗别想从这里过去。

english: Yes, some fish can be a good source of air too.
translation: 是啊，有些鱼也可以作为不错的空气来源。

english: I can teach you some useful Agility and Thieving techniques in exchange for those.
translation: 我可以教你一些有用的敏捷和偷窃技巧来交换那些东西。

english: Yup, that's right. Don't get me started about those horrible bowl things that you humans keep trying to bring down here.
translation: 对，没错。别让我提起你们人类老是试图带下来的那些讨厌的碗状东西。

english: Anyway, do you want the warning back? When you try to go diving, but you don't have your stupid bowl and backpack on, you'd be reminded to get them first.
translation: 不管怎样，你想要回那个警告吗？当你试着潜水，但没有戴上你那愚蠢的碗和背包时，你会被提醒先去拿它们。

english: I see what you're trying to do with that - thinking of making a fishbowl are you? You're not going through there.
translation: 我明白你想用那个干什么——想做个鱼缸，是吧？你过不去的。

english: Get that thing away from me!
translation: 把那东西拿开！

english: Quite right. I think I like you better now.
translation: 没错。我想我现在更喜欢你了。

english: Alright, have it your way. Next time you try diving without your bowl or backpack, you'll get a reminder to fetch them first. Sounds stupid to me, but who am I to judge?
translation: 好吧，随你便。下次你试图潜水却没有碗或背包时，你会收到提醒先去拿它们。我觉得这很蠢，但谁让我来评判呢？

english: I can see that bowl in your tackle box, you know!
translation: 我看到你渔具盒里那个碗了，你知道的！

english: You cannot enter from that side.
translation: 你不能从那边进去。

english: You shall not enter with any fishbowls in your inventory.
translation: 如果你背包里有任何鱼缸，你不得入内。

english: You shall not enter with that thing on your head.
translation: 你头上戴着那玩意不得入内。

english: I've upgraded your Explorer's ring for you. It can restore half of your run energy and teleport you to the Draynor cabbage patch three times per day, there's also a new shortcut available under the Draynor village
translation: 我已经升级了你的探险者戒指。它每天可以恢复一半的跑步能量，并传送你到德雷诺村的卷心菜地三次，德雷诺村墙下还有一个新的捷径

english: wall.
translation: 墙。

english: I've upgraded your Explorer's ring for you. It now has unlimited cabbage teleports and four charges to restore half your run energy. Collecting Tears of Guthix will now provide increased experience and a shortcut from
translation: 我已经为你升级了你的探险者戒指。现在它拥有无限的卷心菜传送和四次恢复一半跑步能量的充能。收集古斯之泪现在将提供更多经验值和一条捷径从

english: Lumbridge swamp to the Desert is now available.
translation: 仑桥镇沼泽到沙漠的捷径现已可用。

english: level alchemy thirty times per day. The Culinaromancer's chest is now 20% cheaper too.
translation: 每天三十次高等级炼金术。厨艺师的宝箱现在也便宜了 20%。

english: In addition to the easy rewards, your ring can restore half of your run energy and teleport you to the Draynor cabbage patch three times per day, there's also a new shortcut available under the Draynor village wall.
translation: 除了简单的奖励外，你的戒指每天可以恢复一半的跑步能量，并传送你到德雷诺村的卷心菜地三次，德雷诺村墙下还有一个新的捷径可用。

english: Culinaromancer's chest is 20% cheaper and you can use Fairy rings without needing a dramen or lunar staff.
translation: 厨艺师的宝箱便宜 20%，而且你可以使用仙子环，无需德拉门杖或月之杖。

english: In addition to the easy and medium benefits, the ring will have unlimited cabbage teleports and four charges to restore half your run energy. Collecting Tears of Guthix will provide increased experience and a shortcut
translation: 除了简单和中等的增益外，戒指将拥有无限的卷心菜传送和四次恢复一半跑步能量的充能。收集古斯之泪将提供更多经验值和一条捷径

english: from Lumbridge swamp to the Desert becomes available.
translation: 仑桥镇沼泽到沙漠的捷径变得可用。

english: Well, that depends on what you have in mind.
translation: 嗯，那得看你想干什么。

english: Well then, what do you want it for?
translation: 那好吧，你要它做什么？

english: You're not going to put it in drunken Ali's drink now, are you? That's what happened the last time I gave someone the sauce.
translation: 你不会把它放进醉鬼阿里的饮料里吧？上次我给某人酱料时就发生过这种事。

english: Seeing as I'm in the kebab construction industry. I mainly help people who have want of a kebab.
translation: 鉴于我从事烤肉行业。我主要帮助那些想吃烤肉的人。

english: That will be three gold coins please.
translation: 请付三枚金币。

english: Or are my services even required?
translation: 还是说根本不需要我的服务？

english: A super kebab it is so. Be careful, they really are as hot as they're made out to be.
translation: 超级烤肉，就是这样。小心点，它们真的跟传说中一样辣。

english: Didn't I just give you a bottle of this already?
translation: 我不是刚给了你一瓶这个吗？

english: I'm trying to run a business here, not a charity.
translation: 我是在做生意，不是开慈善。

english: If I told you that I would have to kill you. Kebab sales is a cut-throat industry. The extra-hot kebab gives me the competitive edge on the rest and if I were to divulge my secrets to every passing adventurer, well it
translation: 如果我告诉了你，我就得杀了你。烤肉销售可是一个竞争激烈的行业。特辣烤肉让我在同行中拥有竞争优势，如果我把我的秘方告诉每个路过的冒险者，那……

english: I don't think I will give you it, for the simple fact that you already have one sticking out of your bag. I have to run a business here.
translation: 我想我不会给你，原因很简单：你的包里已经插着一个了。我得做生意。

english: would soon disappear.
translation: 很快就会消失的。

english: I'm no ghost! I'm a spirit, I'm injecting my thoughtsinto your head
translation: 我不是幽灵！我是灵魂，我在把想法注入你的脑袋。

english: Hmm... I don't have much to offer, but if you happenupon a skull sceptre, I could make it stronger.
translation: 嗯……我没什么能给的，但如果你碰巧找到一根头骨权杖，我可以让它更强。

english: Currently the sceptre is fragile: it breaks once allcharges have been used. Show me the treasure and Icould imbue it so it can be recharged with any sceptrepiece.
translation: 目前这权杖很脆弱：所有充能用完就会碎裂。把宝藏给我看，我就能给它注入力量，以后它可以用任何权杖碎片来充能。

english: Oh no, they had no idea I was hurt, I guess theyassumed I'd found the treasure and made a new lifefor myself.
translation: 哦不，他们不知道我受伤了，我猜他们以为我找到了宝藏，重新开始生活了。

english: It was all death and pillaging, I prefer the finer thingsin life, like exploration and discovery!
translation: 那里全是死亡和掠夺，我更喜欢生活中更美好的东西，比如探索和发现！

english: Yes, my sister told me not to go, she said it wasdangerous and that I'm no fighter. Unfortunately... shewas correct.
translation: 是的，我姐姐叫我别去，她说那里很危险，而且我不是战士。不幸的是……她说对了。

english: I died... Of course, I tried escaping, long before I'dmade it to the treasure, but I was shot with arrows justas I approached the exit.
translation: 我死了……当然，我试过逃跑，在还没拿到宝藏之前很久就试过，但就在我接近出口时被箭射中了。

english: Of course I can... But first, you must show mewhatever treasure lies within that cradle and make surethat your account is safe.
translation: 我当然可以……但首先，你必须让我看看那个摇篮里的宝藏，并且确保你的账户是安全的。

english: Oh marvellous! If only I had corporeal form I'd be ableto wear them, but alas...
translation: 哦，太棒了！要是我有实体的话就能穿上它们了，但可惜……

english: It seems you have the authenticator set up, that'sperfect! Now just show me the treasure.
translation: 看来你设置了验证器，完美！现在给我看看宝藏吧。

english: Of course, of course! In fact if you have more thanone I'll imbue all of them!
translation: 当然，当然！事实上如果你有不止一根，我会全部注入力量！

english: Most of them give 3, although the left skull gives 5.Each completed tier of the Varrock achievement diarywill get you one extra charge per piece and allow yoursceptre to hold 4 more charges.
translation: 大多数碎片提供3点充能，不过左边的头骨提供5点。每完成一级维洛克城成就日记，每个碎片就能多提供1点充能，并且让你的权杖多容纳4点充能。

english: Finally, be warned that if you disable yourauthenticator, the imbue on the sceptre will be removed.
translation: 最后，警告你：如果你禁用验证器，权杖上的灌注效果将会被移除。

english: There you go, now that I've imbued all of yoursceptres, once they run out of charges they will nolonger break and they can be charged with any piece ofthe sceptre you find.
translation: 好了，现在我已经灌注了你所有的权杖，它们用尽充能后就不会碎裂了，并且可以用你找到的任何权杖碎片来充能。

english: You can use a chisel to break a sceptre piece intofragments, then use those to charge the sceptre instead.More flexible if you ask me.
translation: 你可以用凿子把权杖碎片敲成碎块，然后用那些碎块给权杖充能。要我说，这样更灵活。

english: As I said, I am Solztun, the greatest barbarian explorer!I came to explore this place, but unfortunately I diedlong before I made it to the treasure.
translation: 正如我所说，我是索尔兹顿，最伟大的野蛮人探险家！我来探索这个地方，但不幸的是，我还没到达宝藏就死了。

english: Each piece will increase the charges of the sceptre by 3.If you disable your authenticator, the imbue on thesceptre will be removed.
translation: 每个碎片会为权杖增加3点充能。如果你禁用验证器，权杖上的灌注效果将会被移除。

english: There you go, now that I've imbued it, once it runsout of charges it will no longer break and it can becharged with any piece of the sceptre you find.
translation: 好了，我已经灌注了它，它用尽充能后就不会碎裂了，并且可以用你找到的任何权杖碎片来充能。

english: To make sure your account is secured, please turn onthe authenticator. Simply visit the support link on theoldschool.runescape.com website.
translation: 为确保你的账户安全，请开启验证器。只需访问oldschool.runescape.com网站上的支持链接即可。

english: It seems your account isn't as secure as it could be,I'm afraid I can't imbue your sceptre.
translation: 看来你的账户不够安全，恐怕我不能为你灌注权杖。

english: Mother needs your help, traveller. Do not delay.
translation: 旅行者，母亲需要你的帮助。不要耽搁。

english: I would advise against doing that, traveller. I have some of your things. You should retrive them first.
translation: 旅行者，我建议你不要那么做。我这里有你的一些东西。你应该先取回它们。

english: If you are willing, we would appreciate your help in keeping her safe. You can use the pool here to enter Mother's mind and take on the Nightmare within.
translation: 如果你愿意，我们会感激你帮忙保护她。你可以使用这里的池子进入母亲的心灵，对抗其中的梦魇。

english: That would be a step in the right direction.
translation: 那将是正确方向上的一步。

english: You did, which is a step in the right direction. There is more for you to do though.
translation: 你做到了，这是正确方向上的一步。不过你还有更多事情要做。

english: I do not, traveller. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 我没有，旅行者。如果我真的有你的物品，但你在取回之前死了，它们现在就已经丢失了。

english: I would advise against doing that, traveller. The siren has some of your things. You should retrive them first.
translation: 旅行者，我建议你不要那么做。塞壬有你的一些东西。你应该先取回它们。

english: Ahoy there! Pay up first!
translation: 嘿，那边的人！先付钱！

english: Avast there, ye've already paid!
translation: 站住，你已经付过钱了！

english: Oi matey! No followers allowed in the arena!
translation: 喂，伙计！竞技场里不准带跟班！

english: Thanks me hearty!
translation: 谢了，好兄弟！

english: Ye've already paid, so down ye goes...
translation: 你已经付过钱了，所以下去吧……

english: I don't know, I doubt that your types up to the task...
translation: 我不知道，我怀疑你这种人能不能胜任这项任务……

english: Come back when your hands are free.
translation: 等你手空出来时再来吧。

english: I've told the cormorant to auto-cut the fish for you into chunks.
translation: 我已经吩咐鸬鹚自动为你把鱼切成块。

english: The bird will no longer auto-cut fish up for you.
translation: 这只鸟不会再自动为你切鱼了。

english: Now that is a biggun! How you managed to wrangle one like that I'll never know.
translation: 那可是条大家伙！你是怎么弄到这么一条的，我永远也猜不透。

english: They aren't the easiest creatures to tame, you know. It takes more than you might think to keep them under control!
translation: 它们可不是最容易驯服的生物，你知道。要控制它们比你想象的要难得多！

english: Lucky for you it flew back over here... Do you want another go?
translation: 算你走运，它飞回这儿来了……你想再试一次吗？

english: Don't be silly, you already have her on your arm!
translation: 别傻了，她已经在你胳膊上了！

english: Well, I'm not sure. First of all there's something odd about the doors on the place.
translation: 嗯，我不太确定。首先，那地方的门有些古怪。

english: I don't think he likes people. However he does allow you to enter some of the rooms in the tomb. They are dangerous though.
translation: 我觉得他不喜欢人类。不过他允许你进入墓穴的一些房间，不过很危险。

english: Well, if you go into that pyramid then you'll be laughing a lot then. It's full of poisonous snakes and scarabs, and rather nasty Mummies as well. You could die in there.
translation: 嗯，如果你进了那座金字塔，那你可就笑不出来了。里面全是毒蛇、圣甲虫，还有相当凶恶的木乃伊。你可能会死在里面。

english: There are also lots of poisonous snakes in the urns. They'll bite you if they can. You might be able to charm them if you know how. I'd bring some antipoison anyway if I were you.
translation: 瓮里也有很多毒蛇。它们会咬你。如果你知道方法也许能驯服它们。不过要是我，我会带些解毒剂。

english: There are lots of artefacts, you should be able to sell them on the black market, I mean, to a legitimate trader, for some money.
translation: 里面有很多文物，你可以在黑市上卖掉，我是说，卖给一个合法的商人，换点钱。

english: There's four of them - but three of them lead to an empty tomb.
translation: 有四扇门，但其中三扇通往空的墓穴。

english: Well, he's as 'legitimate' as you can get, if you can get out of this city and get to him.
translation: 嗯，他是你能找到的最“合法”的人了，只要你能离开这座城市找到他。

english: I have heard a rumour that there is a valuable magic sceptre in there as well.
translation: 我听说里面还有一把值钱的魔法权杖。

english: Not a lot. It is apparently made of gold and covered in jewels, and used to be owned by one of Tumeken's sons.
translation: 不太多。它显然是用黄金做的，上面镶满了首饰，曾经属于图梅肯的一个儿子。

english: Tumeken, the sun god and head of the gods. His sons were the rulers, chosen by him to rule in his name.
translation: 图梅肯，太阳神，众神之首。他的儿子们是统治者，由他挑选以他的名义统治。

english: Hmmm. Well it is supposed to have some magical powers.
translation: 嗯。据说它有一些魔法力量。

english: If I make it through the door there's a Mummy waiting.
translation: 如果我穿过那扇门，里面有个木乃伊等着。

english: Hey! If you find it I deserve a share of the profits! You wouldn't have known it existed without my help.
translation: 嘿！如果你找到了，我该分一份！没有我的帮助你不会知道它的存在。

english: But which door the right one is seems to change, it's all quite confusing.
translation: 但哪扇门是正确的似乎会变，真让人困惑。

english: The other one is guarded by something - I keep getting knocked out.
translation: 另一扇门有东西守卫，我老是被打晕。

english: I managed to get into one room, but the next room was harder. My lockpicking skills weren't good enough, maybe I should have brought a lockpick.
translation: 我设法进了一个房间，但下一个房间更难。我的开锁技巧不够好，也许我应该带个开锁器。

english: It was a present, my employer thought it would suit me. I'm not sure it does, though it does keep the sun off very well.
translation: 这是礼物，我的雇主觉得它适合我。我不确定是否如此，不过它确实很防晒。

english: Simon Templeton, though I haven't seen him since the town gates were closed off.
translation: 西蒙.坦普尔顿，不过自从镇上的大门关闭后我就没见过他了。

english: He's an archaeologist, I worked as an assistant for him. Though I work for myself now.
translation: 他是个考古学家，我以前是他的助理。不过我现在自己干了。

english: I've been investigating that pyramid over there.
translation: 我一直在调查那边那座金字塔。

english: Simon suggested that there might be riches to be found in that pyramid over there.
translation: 西蒙建议说那边那座金字塔里可能有财宝。

english: I see you've found some artefacts, where's my cut?
translation: 我看到你找到了一些文物，我的那份呢？

english: Wow. It looks very valuable. You come to give me my share?
translation: 哇。看起来非常值钱。你是来给我分成的吗？

english: Hey, that's not fair. I told you about it!
translation: 嘿，这不公平。是我告诉你的！

english: Why, yesss it isss... Many yearsss ago now, 30? 40? I've lost count.
translation: 嗯，是的是的...很多年前了，30年？40年？我记不清了。

english: Alasss, I took an arrow to the eye and missed the battle, I woke up here, worried for my life.
translation: 唉，我眼睛中了一箭，错过了战斗，醒来就在这里，担心自己性命不保。

english: I wasss a Captain of the Shayzien Watch, Captain Reynard Koil, ssstationed up on Shayziens' wall.
translation: 我曾经是谢兹恩城守卫的船长，雷纳德.科伊尔船长，驻守在谢兹恩城的城墙上。

english: Oh yesss, once my ssstrength returned, I went and ssspoke to the Shayzien Watch.
translation: 哦是的，等我恢复了体力，我去和谢兹恩城守卫谈过。

english: We were told to attack the Lizardmen, for they were apparently attacking usss. I led the charge.
translation: 我们接到命令攻击蜥蜴人，因为他们显然在攻击我们。我带头冲锋。

english: They thought I wasss a Lizardman and fired arrowsss at me, ssso I returned here.
translation: 他们以为我是蜥蜴人，朝我射箭，所以我就回到了这里。

english: Or at leassst, that isss what the Lizardmen tell me...
translation: 或者至少，蜥蜴人是这么告诉我的...

english: I found these in thisss shrine, I guesss they belonged to sssome long dead priest.
translation: 我在这座神龛里找到的，我想它们属于某个早已死去的祭司。

english: This grossss ssswamp is my home, you sssure do ask a lot of questionsss, adventurer.
translation: 这个肮脏的沼泽就是我的家，你问题还真多啊，冒险者。

english: They are my sssaviours. I owe them my life.
translation: 他们是我的救星。我欠他们一条命。

english: I wasss a Captain of the Shayzien Army, Captain Reynard Koil. I was ssstationed up on Shayziens' wall.
translation: 我曾经是谢兹恩城军队的船长，雷纳德.科伊尔船长。我驻守在谢兹恩城的城墙上。

english: Lassst I heard, her mind had cracked, her father died and...
translation: 我最后一次听说，她精神崩溃了，她父亲去世了，然后...

translation: 抱歉，但我想跟[player name] UwU说话，但她好像在无视我。

translation: 啊。你看，很多垂钓者都穿那种难看的绿色东西。那确实能帮他们钓鱼，但他们穿起来太丑了。所以吉塔.普莱姆斯发明了更好看的东西。

english: Zulrah is the all-powerful snake god of the southern wastes. He rises from the swamp to show his divine majesty and to accept our homeage.
translation: 祖尔拉是南部荒原全能的蛇神。他从沼泽中升起，展示他神圣的威严，并接受我们的敬意。

english: Willing volunteers are never hard to find for their sacrifice buys peace for the tribe and I grant their families extra rations of food.
translation: 自愿者从来不缺，因为他们的献祭为部落换来了和平，而我会给他们的家人额外配给食物。

english: Zulrah granted us the right to dwell in his lands, and to eat of their bounty. None shall ever drive us out for Zulrah protects us.
translation: 祖尔拉赐予我们居住在他领地的权利，并享用其中的丰饶。没有人能赶走我们，因为祖尔拉保护着我们。

english: Long ago, our forebears came to this place, not realizing that they were trespassing in Zulrah's domain. He arose from the swamp in wrath and many were slain.
translation: 很久以前，我们的祖先来到此地，却不知他们已闯入祖尔拉的领域。他愤怒地从沼泽中升起，许多人当即被杀。

english: Then my mother, oldest and wisest of the tribe, dared to intercede with the mighty Zulrah on behalf of her people, and this a sacred contract was declared.
translation: 然后我的母亲，部落中最年长最智慧的人，勇敢地代表她的人民向强大的祖尔拉求情，于是这份神圣的契约便宣告成立了。

english: By speaking to me. I'll arrange passage for you to meet Zulrah in person. You may now use the boat on the dock in order to offer yourself as a sacrifice to Zulrah.
translation: 跟我说话就行。我会为你安排去见祖尔拉本人的行程。你现在可以使用码头上的船，将你自己献祭给祖尔拉。

english: Yes. Now leave before I change my mind, outsider.
translation: 是的。在我改变主意之前离开吧，外来者。

english: Why should I tell you anything? Those are private matters of the late royal family! It wouldn't be proper to divulge such information to an adventurer like you.
translation: 我凭什么要告诉你任何事？那些是先王室的私事！向你这样的冒险者透露这些信息不太合适。

english: Yes, how did you come across this? I thought all the pages were seperated. I wasn't even sure they still existed to be honest.
translation: 是的，你是怎么找到这个的？我原以为所有书页都分散了。说实话，我甚至不确定它们是否还存在。

english: Well, if I were you, I'd keep shush on the whole matter.
translation: 嗯，如果我是你，我会对整件事保持沉默。

english: You must be new here. When the King died, everyone assumed the princess would take the throne when she came of age.
translation: 你一定是新来的。国王去世时，所有人都以为公主成年后会继承王位。

english: Yes, I do indeed. Off with you. I've had my fair share of nosy adventurers for one day.
translation: 是的，我当然有。走吧。我今天已经受够了多管闲事的冒险者。

english: You need a Shantay pass to get through this gate. I'll sell you one for a very reasonable price.
translation: 你需要一张沙泰隘口通行证才能通过这道门。我会以非常合理的价格卖给你一张。

english: Sorry, but you may not pass through the gate.
translation: 抱歉，你不能通过这道门。

english: Can I see your Desert Pass please?
translation: 请问我能看看你的沙漠通行证吗？

english: You need a Shantay pass to get thwough dis gate. SeeShantay, he wiww seww u one fow a vewy weasonabwepwice.
translation: 你需要一张沙泰隘口通行证才能通过这道门。去找沙泰（Shantay），他会以非常合理的价格卖给你一张。

english: Greetings Sir.
translation: 您好，先生。

english: You are welcome Sir.
translation: 不客气，先生。

english: Greetings Madam.
translation: 您好，女士。

english: Of course Sir. There are two different weights of shot...
translation: 当然，先生。有两种不同重量的铅球……

english: Yes Sir. Shot. The iron spheres that are propelled by the chemical energy stored in your body.
translation: 是的，先生。铅球。就是靠你体内储存的化学能量推动的铁球。

english: Your strength Sir. The stronger you are, the further you can throw the shot, but there are other factors of course, like your technique.
translation: 你的力量，先生。你越强壮，铅球就能扔得越远，当然还有其他因素，比如你的技巧。

english: The style of the shot Sir.
translation: 铅球的风格，先生。

english: Sir, the style in which you throw the shot, not the style of the iron.
translation: 先生，是你扔铅球的风格，不是铁的风格。

english: Crudely put Sir, but yes. Some are more difficult than others. Experiment and see which you prefer.
translation: 说得粗鲁些，先生，不过是的。有些风格比别的更难。试试看哪个更适合你。

english: Tips Sir?
translation: 要诀，先生？

english: Sir may find that a fine powder applied to the hands may give one an advantage when putting the shot.
translation: 先生可能会发现，手上涂点细粉能在推铅球时获得优势。

english: You are welcome Madam.

translation: 是的，女士。

english: Good luck Sir.
translation: 祝你好运，先生。

english: Good luck Madam.
translation: 祝你好运，女士。

english: Well, I am one. Why are you looking for council members, then? Trying to become a Fremennik, outerlander?
translation: 嗯，我就是其中一个。那你为什么要找议会成员？想成为弗莱梅尼克人吗，外地人？

english: Hmph. You outerlanders are so arrogant. I suppose you think you can butter me up into voting for you by doing some silly little trial or something?
translation: 哼。你们外地人真是傲慢。你以为你随便搞个愚蠢的小考验就能让我投票给你？

english: Well I have a trial for you then. I'll vote for you if you can bring me all of the following items;
translation: 那我给你一个考验。如果你能给我带来以下所有物品，我就投你一票：

english: Not so arrogant now, are you outerlander? Let me clarify: you will NEVER get my vote at the council. I hate all outerlanders, ESPECIALLY you.
translation: 现在不傲慢了吧，外地人？让我说清楚：你永远别想在议会得到我的投票。我恨所有外地人，尤其是你。

english: The Mage Gower's skull, a sleeping bag, Saradomin's wig, Zamorak's teddy bear, Guthix's climbing boots, cheese from the moon, a dodo egg and a left-handed chisel.
translation: 法师高尔的头骨、一个睡袋、萨拉多明的假发、萨莫拉斯的泰迪熊、古斯的登山靴、月亮的乳酪、一只渡渡鸟蛋和一把左手用的凿子。

english: Finally, a pupil using his brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: 终于有个学生用脑子思考而不是试图吃掉它们了。下一个问题。

english: Finally, a pupil using her brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: 终于有个学生用脑子思考而不是试图吃掉它们了。下一个问题。

english: I'm Mihail. I'm just trying to stay warm.
translation: 我是米哈伊尔。我只是想暖和一下。

english: I'm surprised you hadn't heard before.
translation: 我很惊讶你之前没听说过。

english: I didn't give them anything, of course.
translation: 我当然什么都没给他们。

english: A few days ago, Miscellanian soldiers came and demanded tribute.
translation: 几天前，米斯凯尼亚士兵来了，要求进贡。

english: They're hardly valuable, but we do need them at home. Could you get them back?
translation: 它们不怎么值钱，但我们家里确实需要。你能把它们拿回来吗？

english: But the next day, they'd taken our best set of plates right out of the kitchen!
translation: 但第二天，他们就从厨房里拿走了我们最好的一套盘子！

english: Have you found the plates those Miscellanian soldiers took from me?
translation: 你找到那些米斯凯尼亚士兵从我这里拿走的盘子了吗？

english: My brother in Rellekka told me about them. I thought he was joking about how bad they were.
translation: 我在雷勒卡城的兄弟告诉我的。我还以为他在开玩笑说他们有多糟糕。

english: The children who kept on failing the trials, year after year?
translation: 那些年复一年一直无法通过试炼的孩子们？

english: So, do you have my plates?
translation: 那么，你有我的盘子吗？

english: 75% of people approve of you.
translation: 75% 的人支持你。

english: No! Well I wouldn't be, would I? I've spent my whole life dedicated to my sect. I dreamed of one day entering this sanctuary and finally meeting Mother!
translation: 不！我当然不会高兴，对吧？我一生都奉献给我的教派。我梦想着有一天能进入这个圣殿，最终见到母亲！

english: We... never expected to see any of your kind from across the sea either, but yes, you would be correct. The Duke did ask for a representative from Kourend and I was selected to attend.
translation: 我们……也没想到会见到海对岸来的你们这种人，不过没错，你说得对。公爵确实要求库兰德王国派一名代表，我被选中来参加。

english: Now if you excuse me, this conversation is... tiring. Being away from the Dark Altar has taken a greater toll on me than I expected.
translation: 那么，恕我失陪，这场对话……令人疲惫。离开黑暗祭坛对我的影响比我预想的大得多。

english: Citizens of Arceuus would have been fine.
translation: 叫我阿西乌斯城的市民就好了。

english: Who are you.
translation: 你是谁。

english: You misunderstand. Your question should've been 'who are you?', not 'what are you?'. The latter is significantly more offensive.
translation: 你误会了。你的问题应该是'你是谁？'，而不是'你是什么？'。后者冒犯得多。

english: I see. Well I am Mofina, a citizen of Arceuus.
translation: 我明白了。我是莫菲娜，阿西乌斯城的市民。

english: You are learning. That question is significantly less offensive.
translation: 你在进步。那个问题就没那么冒犯了。

english: I believe Veos, one of your portmasters in Port Sarim, can help assist in such matters.
translation: 我相信维奥斯，你们沙林港的港口主管之一，能在这方面提供帮助。

english: Arceuus is one of five cities in the Kingdom of Great Kourend, found on the continent to the west.
translation: 阿西乌斯城是库兰德王国五大城市之一，位于西边的大陆上。

english: Greetings, Your Highness. Have some fresh fish!
translation: 您好，殿下。来点鲜鱼吧！

english: Greetings, Sir. Get your fresh fish here!
translation: 您好，先生。来这儿买鲜鱼！

english: Greetings, Madam. Get your fresh fish here!
translation: 您好，女士。来这儿买鲜鱼！

english: 88% of people approve of you.
translation: 88%的人认可您。

english: 45% of people approve of you.
translation: 45%的人认可您。

english: Welcome [player name]. My fish is fresher than any in Miscellania!
translation: 欢迎[player name]。我的鱼比米斯凯尼亚任何地方的都新鲜！

english: 20% of people approve of you.
translation: 20%的人认可您。

english: You'd best talk to Ignisia, she's in charge around here.
translation: 你最好跟伊格尼西亚谈谈，这里归她管。

english: Great! Ask me anything you like about the Bruma Tree, I'm an expert.
translation: 太好了！关于布鲁玛树你随便问，我可是专家。
