translation: 布鲁玛树是削弱冬将军的关键，丁因它能够对抗冬将军而在这里建造了监狱。有些传说说，泽里克是门变弱的原因，或者是他让

english: It's a known fact that he was interested in the Bruma Tree, for what purpose... there are only rumours.
translation: 众所周知他对布鲁玛树很感兴趣，至于目的……只有谣言流传。

english: the Wintertodt stronger?
translation: 冬将军变得更强了？

english: Regardless, the Bruma tree definitely contains powerful magic, I've been studying the sap for years and it has truly astounding properties.
translation: 不管怎样，布鲁玛树确实含有强大的魔法。我研究它的树液多年，它具有真正惊人的特性。

english: Some would say that ice preserves while fire destroys, but no amount of fire is destroying the Wintertodt, that's a cold that will freeze the air in your lungs.
translation: 有人会说冰保存而火毁灭，但再多的火焰也摧毁不了冬将军，那是一种能冻结你肺中空气的寒冷。

english: What you see in that pit is not the Wintertodt at full strength, it never will be while the Bruma tree still burns and the Doors of Dinh remain closed.
translation: 你在那个坑里看到的并非全盛时期的冬将军，只要布鲁玛之树仍在燃烧，丁之门依然紧闭，它就永远不会恢复全力。

english: Me? I'm a member of the Woodcutting guild, more of a researcher though... I'm currently tasked with growing a new Bruma tree.
translation: 我？我是伐木公会的成员，不过更像研究员……我目前的任务是培育一棵新的布鲁玛树。

english: It's just an idea really, for all I know, it could be magic way beyond me, beyond even the Pyromancers.
translation: 其实只是个想法，就我所知，这可能是远超我、甚至远超火法师的魔法。

english: Some legends say that Xeric is the cause for the doors weakening, or maybe he made the Wintertodt stronger?
translation: 有些传说说，泽里克是门变弱的原因，或者是他让冬将军变强了？

english: The prices to passing the tunnel are 200 numulite for a day or 20,000 numulite for permanent access.
translation: 通过隧道的价格是：一天200货币石，或者永久通行权20,000货币石。

english: Hello human, if you wish to use the drift net activity and catch fish shoals you can pay me numulite to enter the area.
translation: 你好，人类，如果你想使用流刺网活动并捕捉鱼群，你可以付我货币石进入该区域。

english: You don't have any shards for me to convert.
translation: 你没有可供我转换的碎片。

english: You don't have enough space in your bank for the essence. Come back when you do.
translation: 你的银行里没有足够的空间存放精华。有空间了再来吧。

english: Just kill someone already!
translation: 快杀个人啊！

english: Me busy - go away!
translation: 我忙着呢——走开！

english: Hah! What you want with me, little city man?
translation: 哈！你这城里的小个子，找我干嘛？

english: Hey! Ain't nothing for you down there. Clear off!
translation: 嘿！下面没你的事。滚开！

english: You not talk like barbarian man. You certainly not smell like barbarian man! But I think I give you test anyway.
translation: 你说话不像野蛮人。你闻起来当然也不像野蛮人！不过我想我还是会给你个考验。

english: Hah! Soft city woman, you want fight?
translation: 哈！软弱的城里女人，你想打架？

english: Ha ha ha! I not interested in talking to soft city man who not know what he want.
translation: 哈哈哈！我没兴趣跟一个不知道自己想要什么的软弱的城里男人说话。

english: Hah! What you want with me, little city woman?
translation: 哈！你这城里的小女人，找我干嘛？

english: You not talk like barbarian woman. You certainly not smell like barbarian woman! But I think I give you test anyway.
translation: 你说话不像野蛮人女人。你闻起来当然也不像野蛮人女人！不过我想我还是会给你个考验。

english: Ha ha ha! I not interested in talking to soft city woman who not know what she want.
translation: 哈哈哈！我没兴趣跟一个不知道自己想要什么的软弱的城里女人说话。

english: Good day, ma'am.
translation: 你好，女士。

english: You haven't any blasted ore to deposit.
translation: 你没有炸碎的矿石可以存放。

english: Deposit your ore in the sack, quickly, before it degrades.
translation: 把你的矿石放进麻袋里，快点，不然它会变质。

english: You'd better collect your ore from my colleague downstream before you ask us to wash any more for you.
translation: 你最好先去下游的同事那里取走你的矿石，再让我们帮你清洗更多的。

english: What do you want, human? I've got a lot of ore to clean.
translation: 你想干什么，人类？我有很多矿石要清洗。

english: Here you go. Come back with more inventory space and collect the rest.
translation: 给你。等你的背包有更多空间了再回来取剩下的。

english: You've got some dynamite, good. You need to use a chisel to excavate a cavity in the hard rock walls. Then you can put the dynamite in, and light the fuse.
translation: 你有一些炸药，很好。你需要用凿子在坚硬的岩石墙壁上挖一个空腔。然后把炸药放进去，点燃引信。

english: Just deposit it into my sack here, and I'll see that it gets cleaned safely. You can collect your ore from my colleague downstream.
translation: 把它放进我的麻袋里，我会确保它安全清洗干净。你可以去下游的同事那里取走你的矿石。

english: Hey, that doesn't go in there! It's for blasted ore only.
translation: 嘿，那东西不能放进去！这里只放炸碎的矿石。

english: You'd better collect your cleaned ore from my colleague before we can wash any more.
translation: 你最好先去同事那里取回你洗好的矿石，我们才能清洗更多。

english: You'll need more inventory space to collect your ore.
translation: 你需要更多背包空间才能取走你的矿石。

english: Looks like your ore had degraded already. Try depositing it quicker next time.
translation: 看起来你的矿石已经变质了。下次存快一点。

english: Go upstream and deposit your ore in my colleague's sack, quickly, before it degrades.
translation: 去上游把你的矿石放进我同事的麻袋里，快点，不然会变质。

english: You're not eligible to mine here at the moment, though.
translation: 不过你现在没有资格在这里采矿。

english: Put a string on that pot of dynamite to act as a fuse. Then you need to use a chisel to excavate a cavity in the hard rock walls, so you can put the dynamite in, then light the fuse.
translation: 在那罐炸药上放一根绳子作为引信。然后你需要用凿子在坚硬的岩石墙壁上挖出一个空腔，这样你就可以把炸药放进去，然后点燃引信。

english: I noticed you don't have a rune defender! These cyclops down here are quite brutal... I can't let you inside without one of equal or greater value.
translation: 我注意到你还没有符文格挡匕首！下面的那些独眼巨人可是相当凶残的……没有同等或更高价值的东西，我不能放你进去。

english: Oi - get on with the fight!
translation: 喂——赶紧打啊！

english: Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild.  Only accomplished chefs and cooks are allowed in here.  Feel free to use any of our facilities.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到厨师公会。只有有成就的厨师和烹饪者才能进入。请随意使用我们的任何设施。

english: If you ever achieve level 99 cooking you'll get to wear one too and doing so means you'll never burn any food!
translation: 如果你达到了 99 级烹饪，你也能穿上一件，这意味着你永远不会烧焦任何食物！

english: You can't come in here unless you're wearing a chef's  hat or something like that.
translation: 除非你戴着厨师帽或类似的东西，否则你不能进来。

english: Hello, welcome to the Cooking Guild. It's always great to have such an accomplished chef visit. Say would you be interested in a Skillcape of Cooking? They're only available to master chefs.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到厨师公会。有如此有成就的厨师来访真是太好了。你对烹饪技能披风感兴趣吗？只有大师级厨师才能获得。

english: Most certainly, just as soon as you give me 99000 gold coins.
translation: 当然可以，只要你给我 99000 金币。

english: Thank you! It's my most prized possesion, it's a Skillcape of Cooking; it shows that I've achieved level 99 Cooking and am one of the best chefs in the land!
translation: 谢谢！它是我最珍贵的财产，是一件烹饪技能披风；它表明我已经达到了 99 级烹饪，是这片土地上最好的厨师之一！

english: Certainly! Right when you give me 99000 coins.
translation: 当然！只要你给我九万九千金币。

english: Booooorrring! When are you going to fight someone?
translation: 好无~聊~啊！你什么时候才要跟人打一架？

english: It can talk! A real success.
translation: 它会说话！真是成功的杰作。

english: Long time indeed!
translation: 确实好久不见！

english: Oh no, look!
translation: 哦不，快看！

english: Yes, it's just an experiment in alchemy.
translation: 没错，这只是一个炼金实验。

english: Get out of the tower before it's too late!
translation: 趁还来得及，快离开塔！

english: Why, thanks. You'll find various pieces of machinery to fix in there. You can no doubt find the materials in there, too.
translation: 哎呀，谢谢。你会在里面找到各种待修的机械。材料想必里面也有。

english: Marvellous.
translation: 太妙了。

english: That too.
translation: 那个也是。

english: Simple. I like to turn things from one form into another. You've heard of the principle of equal trade?
translation: 很简单。我喜欢把东西从一种形态变成另一种。你听说过等价交换原则吗？

english: No, no, no. As in everything is made of substance. You simply have to know what ingredients you need and how to combine them, then you can make anything, though you can't make something from nothing.
translation: 不，不，不。是说万物皆由物质构成。你只需要知道需要什么原料以及如何组合，就能造出任何东西，不过你不能无中生有。

english: The head builder?
translation: 建筑工人头头？

english: Well, the builder's hard hat MIGHT be a clue.
translation: 嗯，建筑工人的安全帽可能是个线索。

english: Bothered.
translation: 烦死了。

english: Rather you than me. Can't say you look like you'll make it out alive.
translation: 你去总比我去好。不过我觉得你不太可能活着出来。

english: So, you want me to lie?
translation: 所以，你是要我撒谎？

english: I question why you are so pleased about this.
translation: 我怀疑你为什么对此这么高兴。

english: Go downstairs and speak to Commander Veldaban. Your business is with him.
translation: 下楼去找维尔达班指挥官谈话。你的事归他管。

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Black Bug?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建黑色巴格斯的雕像之外？

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Blue Opal?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建蓝色蛋白石的雕像之外？

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Purple Pewter?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建紫色锡器的雕像之外？

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Yellow Fortune?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建黄色财富的雕像之外？

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Green Gemstone?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建绿色宝石的雕像之外？

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Silver Cog?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建银色齿轮的雕像之外？

english: Apart from you helping to rebuild the statue for the Brown Engine?
translation: 除了你帮忙重建棕色引擎的雕像之外？

english: Well, you look like a pretty smart cobber.  Could you take a look at the display plaques and give 'em a runthrough?
translation: 嗯，你看起来挺聪明的。你能看看那些展示牌，给它们走一遍吗？

english: Pah! All of it is incredibly interesting, I slew the great Smolodin Kyatt that plagued the province for many years, I retrieved the crown of many heads from the snake pit and hunted the silver stag of the western
translation: 呸！每一件都极其有趣，我杀死了肆虐该省多年的大斯莫洛丁.基亚特，从蛇坑中取回多头王冠，还猎杀了西方的银雄鹿……

english: Funny you should mention boars, I'm currently hunting one, well... I was...
translation: 你提到野猪可真巧，我目前正在猎一头，嗯……曾经在猎……

english: provinces.
translation: 省。

english: I'm Freja the Kyattess of the Fremennik Province, who are you?
translation: 我是弗雷娅，弗雷姆尼克省的基亚特女猎手，你是谁？

english: My current quest took me to Acheron, a horribly bitter northern territory, in search for this famous Boar... as big as a hut, so the songs say. Anyway, my companions all met a rather grizzly end, I guess I'm looking for
translation: 我现在的任务把我带到了阿切隆，一个极其寒冷的北方领地，去寻找那著名的野猪……像小屋一样大，歌谣里是这么唱的。总之，我的同伴们都遭遇了相当可怕的结局，我想我在寻找……

english: Ha ha ha! You're very new here, you've certainly proved you are a worthy hero, but I'd rather someone with a few more years behind them.
translation: 哈哈哈！你在这里还很新，你确实证明了自己是位值得尊敬的英雄，但我更希望是位经验更丰富的人。

english: new ones.
translation: 新的。

english: Ah, so you've found my latest donation to the guild, what do you think? Spooky, isn't it?
translation: 啊，所以你找到了我最近捐给公会的东西，你觉得怎么样？挺吓人的，对吧？

english: I certainly tried... Perhaps there are some date inconsistencies and a few words I had to guess at. I had found a lot of trade scrolls with early Fremennik tribes on the isle too, which certainly made my job
translation: 我当然试过了……也许有些日期不一致，还有一些字词我只能猜测。我还在岛上找到了很多早期弗雷姆尼克部落的贸易卷轴，这确实让我的工作……

english: Oh Guthix, no! These texts are inscribed in rock paper in a tome even I struggle to lift, the writer left it there as a warning and I assume they didn't want it to be moved.
translation: 哦，古斯之神，不！这些文字写在岩石纸上，装订成一本连我都很难抬起的巨著，作者把它留在那里作为警告，我想他们不希望它被移动。

english: easier.
translation: 更容易了。

english: It certainly seems reasonable. It is said that an angry Fremennik chief launched an attack on Asgarnia, a war on magic is what the singers say.
translation: 这听起来确实合理。据说一位愤怒的弗雷姆尼克酋长向阿斯加尼亚发动了攻击，歌者们称之为魔法战争。

english: I offer unique toggle options to adventurers like yourself. Let me show you what I can do.
translation: 我为像你这样的冒险者提供独特的切换选项。让我展示一下我能做什么。

english: You've toggled the vial-smashing ability. When it's on, you'll automatically crush a vial when you're done drinking a potion.
translation: 你已切换了药水瓶粉碎能力。开启后，喝药水后会自动粉碎药水瓶。

english: I've set your Mythical Cape teleport location to: Bottom floor. You will arrive there now when using your cape.
translation: 我已将你的神话斗篷传送位置设置为：底层。你现在使用斗篷时会传送到那里。

english: I've set your Mythical Cape teleport location to: Middle floor. You will arrive there now when using your cape.
translation: 我已将你的神话斗篷传送位置设置为：中层。你现在使用斗篷时会传送到那里。

english: I've set your Mythical Cape teleport location to: Vorkath. You will arrive there now when using your cape.
translation: 我已将你的神话斗篷传送位置设置为：沃卡斯。现在使用斗篷时你会到达那里。

english: I've set your Mythical Cape teleport location to: Top floor. You will arrive there now when using your cape.
translation: 我已将你的神话斗篷传送位置设置为：顶层。你现在使用斗篷时会传送到那里。

english: Ahhh, mon ami! My name iz Jacques and I am ze Museum's finest art critic!
translation: 啊哈，我的朋友！我叫雅克，是博物馆最优秀的艺术评论家！

english: Zis iz true, mon ami. 'owever, in ze future, I will 'ave my own entire floor of ze Museum with paintings galore!
translation: 这是真的，我的朋友。不过，在未来，我将在博物馆拥有整整一层楼，挂满画作！

english: Ah, I see monsieur iz 'aving ze little bon mot, eh?
translation: 啊，我看先生是在开玩笑，嗯？

english: Ze bon mot, ze laugh, ze fun of poking at me, eh? I shall 'ave my gallery, you vill see eventually, mon ami. Zen I shall be ze, 'ow you say, laughing last!
translation: 开玩笑，嘲笑，拿我寻开心，嗯？我会有我的画廊的，你最终会看到的，我的朋友。到时候，我会笑到最后！

english: Je trone dans l'azur comme un sphinx incompris; J'unis un coeur de neige a la blancheur des cygnes; Je hais le mouvement qui deplace les lignes, Et jamais je ne pleure et jamais je ne ris.
translation: 我如不被理解的斯芬克斯，端坐碧空；我以天鹅之白，融一颗冰雪之心；我憎恨移动线条的动作，我从不哭泣，也从不欢笑。

english: Ah, I see madame iz 'aving ze little bon mot, eh?
translation: 啊，我看女士是在开玩笑，嗯？

english: Ahh yes, I forget, open ze ears and I shall tell monsieur.
translation: 啊，是的，我忘了，竖起耳朵听，我来告诉先生。

english: Ahh yes, I forget, open ze ears and I shall tell madame.
translation: 啊，是的，我忘了，竖起耳朵听，我来告诉女士。

english: Actually, you look healthy already!
translation: 其实，你已经看起来很健康了！

english: I've got some stuff you left at the shrine earlier. You should get it back from me before sacrificing yourself again.
translation: 我之前在神龛那里捡到你留下的一些东西。在你再次献祭自己之前，应该先从我这里拿回去。

english: You can use your magical powers to flee from Zulrah's grasp, though that would defeat the point of the sacrifice and you'll have to try again.
translation: 你可以用你的魔法力量逃离祖尔拉的掌控，不过那样就违背了献祭的意义，你还得再试一次。

english: There is no way I'm getting on that boat alone with you! Your skull leaves me feeling rather uncomfortable. Begone!
translation: 我绝不可能和你单独上那条船！你的头骨让我很不舒服。滚开！

english: You weft da shwine. Did Zuwwah weject uw sacwifice?
translation: 你把猪搞丢了。祖尔拉是不是拒绝了你的献祭？

english: Stop! Who ever crosses this bridge must answer me these questions three.
translation: 停下！凡过此桥者，须答我三个问题。

english: What... is your favorite colour?
translation: 你……最喜欢的颜色是什么？

english: You don't say, is that it ?
translation: 不会吧，就这些？

english: Tell you what, I'll give you 200 Death Runes for the cat.
translation: 这样吧，我给你200个死亡符文换这只猫。

english: The dwarves bring them from the mine for us. Tell you what, I'll give you 200 Death Runes for the cat.
translation: 矮人从矿里给我们带来的。这样吧，我给你200个死亡符文换这只猫。

english: Tell you what, I'll give you 100 Death Runes for the cat.
translation: 这样吧，我给你100个死亡符文换这只猫。

english: If you Mourners really wanna help, why don't you do something about these mice?!
translation: 如果你们哀悼者真想帮忙，为什么不处理一下这些老鼠呢？！

english: The dwarves bring them from the mine for us. Tell you what, I'll give you 100 Death Runes for the cat.
translation: 矮人从矿里给我们带来的。这样吧，我给你100个死亡符文换这只猫。

english: That kitten isn't big enough, come back when it's bigger.
translation: 那只小猫还不够大，等它长大了再来。

english: Really, lets have a look.
translation: 真的吗？让我看看。

english: Hah! that little thing won't catch any mice. I need a fully grown cat.
translation: 哈！那个小东西抓不到老鼠的。我需要一只成年猫。

english: Stop, human!
translation: 站住，人类！

english: Hey, human, you no go through there!
translation: 嘿，人类，你不能再往前走了！

english: Bad weather in mountains just now.
translation: 山上现在天气不好。

english: Mostly we like Snowflake just fine. But this not something to chat to human about.
translation: 大部分时候我们挺喜欢雪花的。但这种事不适合跟人类聊。

english: Thanks. Hopefully I'll be back patrolling the city again soon.
translation: 谢谢。希望我很快就能恢复在城市巡逻。

english: We'll never keep on top of the crime in this city at this rate. Maybe you could help deal with some gangsters while you're in Kourend.
translation: 照这样下去，我们永远无法遏制这座城市的犯罪。也许你在库兰德王国时可以帮忙对付一些帮派分子。

english: Gimme a medpack. I need my strength back.
translation: 给我一个医疗包。我需要恢复力量。

english: Gangsters. I was on patrol in Port Piscarilius, but those scumbags lured me into an alley and hit me with a stick.
translation: 帮派分子。我当时在皮斯卡里琉斯港巡逻，那些混蛋把我诱进小巷，用棍子打了我。

english: That won't help.
translation: 那没用。

english: There should be some around here somewhere.
translation: 附近应该有一些。

english: That's not mine.
translation: 那不是我的。

english: It was nonsense, but I recall the words 'Inyetat' and 'Coshmar', whatever those mean.
translation: 那都是胡言乱语，但我记得‘Inyetat’和‘Coshmar’这两个词，不知道是什么意思。

english: Well this is a dungeon for the more wealthy discerning adventurer, be gone with your riff raff.
translation: 嗯，这是给更有钱、更有眼光的冒险者的地牢，带着你的乌合之众滚开。

english: Hummph.
translation: 哼。

english: And how can I help you?
translation: 我能帮你什么吗？

english: Greetings to you.
translation: 向你问好。

english: Another beautiful day in Keldagrim, I should say!
translation: 要我说，又是凯尔达格林城美好的一天！

english: Well, I heard some human knocked over the statue of King Alvis recently. You know anything about that?
translation: 嗯，我听说最近有个人类撞倒了阿尔维斯国王的雕像。你知道什么内情吗？

english: Weren't you on a quest yourself right now? Something to do with... knocking over a statue?
translation: 你不是自己正在做任务吗？跟……撞倒雕像有关？

english: No, not really. I don't have any missing relatives, lost family heirlooms, deceased parents whose spirits need to be put to rest or even a broken statue.
translation: 不，真没有。我没有失踪的亲戚、丢失的传家宝、需要安息的已故父母，甚至连破损的雕像都没有。

english: I heard you helped to build a statue in honour of the Black Bug! Well done!
translation: 我听说你帮忙建了一座雕像来纪念黑虫！干得好！

english: I heard you helped to build a statue in honour of the Green Gemstone! Well done!
translation: 我听说你帮忙建造了一座雕像来纪念绿色宝石！干得好！

english: I heard you helped to build a statue in honour of the Purple Pewter! Well done!
translation: 我听说你帮忙建造了一座雕像来纪念紫色锡蜡！干得好！

english: I heard you helped to build a statue in honour of the Blue Opal! Well done!
translation: 我听说你帮忙建造了一座雕像来纪念蓝色蛋白石！干得好！

english: I heard you helped to build a statue in honour of the Yellow Fortune! Well done!
translation: 我听说你帮忙建造了一座雕像来纪念黄色财富！干得好！

english: I heard you helped to build a statue in honour of the Silver Cog! Well done!
translation: 我听说你帮忙建了一座雕像来纪念银齿轮！干得好！

english: It's simple. A group of competitors are taken to the island, only one comes out alive.
translation: 很简单。一批参赛者被带到岛上，只有一个人能活着出来。

english: You have some choice for the items you're given on arrival. Use my supply chest to configure your loadout.
translation: 抵达时给你分配的物品有一些选择。用我的补给箱来配置你的套装。

english: The fight for survival will boost your physical and mental abilities, ensuring you make a worthy contender as the Last Man Standing. Praying to the gods will not cost you your precious energies on the island.
translation: 生存之战会提升你的体能和精神能力，确保你成为配得上最后幸存者称号的竞争者。向神明祈祷在岛上不会消耗你宝贵的气力。

english: You can't take any of your belongings to the island; you must use only what you are given there on arrival, and anything else you find there.
translation: 你不能带任何自己的物品到岛上；你只能使用抵达时给你的东西，以及你在那里找到的其他任何东西。

english: Lethal fog will fill the island after a set amount of time, forcing contenders to a designated safe zone.
translation: 在设定时间后，致命的雾会充满整个岛屿，迫使参赛者前往指定的安全区域。

english: Regarding what you are given on arrival, you have a few options to pick from. Use my supply chest to configure your loadout.
translation: 关于你抵达时得到的东西，你有几个选项可以选择。用我的补给箱来配置你的套装。

english: Very well - please store your pet safely. There's a deposit box just outside my office.
translation: 很好——请把你的宠物安全存放好。我办公室外面有个寄存箱。

english: Wewcome, awe u wooking to take pawt in a game ofLast Man Standing?
translation: 欢迎，泥是来参加最后幸存者游戏的嘛？

english: Regawding what u awe given on awwivaw, u have afew options to pick fwom. Use my suppwy chest toconfiguwe uw woadout.
translation: 关于你到达时得到的东西，泥有几个选项可以选。用我的补给箱来配置你的套装。

english: Indeed. We have set up two awenas on anodaw pwane.When a game stawts, we pick one at wandom. Onceevewyone awwives in da awena, da fight fow suwvivawbegins.
translation: 是的。我们在另一个平面设立了两个竞技场。游戏开始时，我们随机选择一个。当大家都到达竞技场后，生存之战就开始了。

english: Hmm... I don't sense them nearby though. Tell me, adventurer, on which floor did you see the owls?
translation: 嗯……但我没感觉到它们在附近。告诉我，冒险者，你在哪层地板看到猫头鹰的？

english: Are ye blind lad? Tis over there in the next room with me assistant working it!
translation: 你是瞎了吗小子？就在隔壁房间，我的助理在操作它呢！

english: Are ye blind lass? Tis over there in the next room with me assistant working it!
translation: 你是瞎了吗姑娘？就在隔壁房间，我的助理在操作它呢！

english: Today I can exchange 30 flax banknotes for bowstrings, if you bring me enough flax banknotes.
translation: 今天我可以兑换30张亚麻票据换弓弦，如果你给我足够多的亚麻票据的话。

translation: 你好。你想用亚麻票据换弓弦吗？我今天可以给你换30张，明天你可以再来换更多。

english: I can ferry ye up t' Al Kharid, if ye want t' be off? I can ferry ye up t' Al Kharid, if ye want t' be off? I can ferry ye up t' Al Kharid, if ye want t' be off?
translation: 我可以渡你上阿尔卡里德城，如果你想走的话？我可以渡你上阿尔卡里德城，如果你想走的话？我可以渡你上阿尔卡里德城，如果你想走的话？

english: I can ferry ye up t' Al Kharid, if ye want t' be off ?
translation: 我可以渡你上阿尔卡里德城，如果你想走的话？

english: I can see you have not visited. Would you like to? I can send you straight there. But only once.
translation: 我看你还没去过。想去吗？我可以直接送你过去。但只有一次。

english: That fellow over by that stall says he's setting up a magic carpet business. He said his name was Ali Morrisane.
translation: 那个摊位旁边的家伙说他正在搞一个魔法飞毯生意。他说他叫阿里.莫里桑。

english: Like I said, we'll not be happy if it starts up.
translation: 就像我说的，如果它开张了，我们不会高兴的。

english: Of course, it's likely to flop and not get off the ground, if you see what I mean.
translation: 当然，它很可能会失败，飞不起来，你懂我的意思吧。

english: This is one of the lairs of those foul lizardmen. We've managed to corner these ones so they can't escape.
translation: 这是那些可恶的蜥蜴人的巢穴之一。我们设法困住了这些，让它们逃不掉。

english: Oy! You can't do that! I only want the most trustworthy soldiers fighting these Lizardmen.
translation: 喂！你不能那样做！我只想要最值得信赖的士兵来对抗这些蜥蜴人。

english: Cleive. Captain Cleive. Captain in the Shayzien Army and renowned slayer.
translation: 克莱夫。克莱夫船长。谢兹恩城军队的船长，也是著名的杀戮者。

english: Oy! You can't do that! I only want the most trustworthy soldiers fighting these lizardmen.
translation: 喂！你不能那样做！我只想要最值得信赖的士兵来对抗这些蜥蜴人。

english: I don't have time to talk right now! My boss is paying me to hand out these flyers.
translation: 我现在没时间聊天！老板付钱让我发这些传单。

english: Apart from a busy and wonderous market place in Al Kharid to the south, there is the Duel Arena to the south-east where you can challenge other players to a fight.
translation: 除了南边阿尔卡里德城繁忙而奇妙的集市外，东南方还有个决斗竞技场，你可以在那里挑战其他玩家进行战斗。

english: I still have hundreds of these flyers to hand out, I wonder if Ali would notice if I quietly dumped them somewhere?
translation: 我还有几百张传单要发，不知道如果我悄悄把这些传单扔到某个地方，阿里会不会注意到？

english: Are you trying to be funny or has age turned your brain to mush? You already have a flyer!
translation: 你是想搞笑还是年纪大了脑子糊涂了？你已经有一张传单了！

english: Looks like your hands are full. Come back when you have space for my flyer.
translation: 看来你手里满了。等你腾出地方拿我的传单时再来吧。

english: Sorry, I can't chat while I'm on duty; have to keep alert.
translation: 抱歉，值班时不能聊天；必须保持警惕。

english: We're guarding this place to make sure that nothing comes up from that trap door and that nobody unnecesserarily goes down there.
translation: 我们守卫这里是为了确保没有东西从那扇活板门里出来，也没有人无故下去。

english: I'll sell you an unlit torch for 200gp.
translation: 我卖给你一支未点燃的火把，200金币。

english: I have one I could sell you for 50gp.
translation: 我有一支可以卖给你，50金币。

english: Oh, the plague of spots. Well, I wasn't here when the outbreak took place.
translation: 哦，斑疹瘟疫。嗯，疫情爆发时我不在这里。

english: We were out of town trying to catch an antiques thief called Simon Templeton.
translation: 我们当时出城去抓一个叫西蒙.坦普尔顿的古董贼。

english: Sophanem is my home town so it would take a lot more than the threat of a few spots to keep me away.
translation: 索法尼恩城是我的家乡，所以区区几个斑疹的威胁不足以让我离开。

english: This is the remains of the Sophanem Bank.
translation: 这是索法尼恩银行的遗骸。

english: Some time back, these scarab creatures started coming up from the basement. We fought them off, but they kept coming and coming and eventually destroyed the place. We've now fought them back again and
translation: 一段时间前，这些圣甲虫生物开始从地下室涌出来。我们击退了它们，但它们不断涌来，最终摧毁了这里。现在我们又把它们击退了，并且

english: barricaded the trap door.
translation: 用路障堵住了活板门。

english: Move along, move along; nothing to see here.
translation: 走开，走开；这里没什么可看的。

english: No problem; come back if you change your mind.
translation: 没问题；改变主意的话就回来。

english: Greetings to you. If only I had time to talk... I've heard you have many daring tales to tell.
translation: 向你问好。要是我有时间聊天就好了……我听说你有很多惊险的故事可讲。

english: Oh, to be off duty with a nice, cold drink.
translation: 哦，要是能下班喝杯冰凉的饮料就好了。

english: This is the recently renovated Sophanem Bank.
translation: 这是最近翻新过的索法尼恩城银行。

english: Once all the townsfolk returned, we decided to patch the place up and return it to normal.
translation: 一旦所有镇民都回来了，我们就决定把这里修补好，恢复原状。

english: I suppose it is a worry, but ever since the townsfolk have returned the scarab attacks have become more sporadic and a lot less organised.
translation: 我想这确实令人担忧，但自从镇民回来后，圣甲虫的攻击变得更加零星，也没有那么有组织了。

english: That must be reducing the scarab numbers.
translation: 那一定在减少圣甲虫的数量。

english: I'll be here when you get back.
translation: 你回来的时候我会在这里。

english: 'Ello there lad! What can I be getting you?
translation: 嘿，小伙子！我能给你点什么？

english: 'Ello there lassy! What can I be getting you?
translation: 嘿，小姑娘！我能给你点什么？

english: Welcome to the Duel Arena!
translation: 欢迎来到决斗竞技场！

english: When you go to the arena you'll go up an access ramp to the walkways that overlook the duel arenas. From the walkways you can watch the duels and challenge other players.
translation: 进入竞技场时，你会沿着一条通道斜坡走到俯瞰决斗场的走道上。从走道上你可以观看决斗并向其他玩家发起挑战。

english: You'll know you're in the right place as you'll have a Duel-with option when you right-click a player.
translation: 你会在正确的位置，因为右键点击其他玩家时会出现'与...决斗'选项。

english: The Duel Arena has six duel arenas where you can fight other players in a controlled environment. We have our own dedicated hospital where we guarantee to put you back together, even if you lose.
translation: 决斗竞技场有六个决斗场，你可以在受控环境中与其他玩家对战。我们有专属医院，保证即使你输了也能把你恢复原状。

english: See you in the arenas!
translation: 竞技场上见！

english: Inbetween the arenas are walkways where you can watch the fights and challenge other players.
translation: 竞技场之间是走道，你可以在那里观看战斗并向其他玩家发起挑战。

english: The archaeologists that are excavating the area east of Varrock have been working on this site as well. From these cliffs they uncovered this huge building. The experts think it may date back to the second age!
translation: 在维洛克城以东区域进行发掘的考古学家们也对这块遗址进行了工作。从这些悬崖上，他们发现了这座巨大的建筑。专家认为它可能追溯到第二纪元！

english: You and your opponent can offer coins or platinum as a stake. If you win, you receive what your opponent staked minus some tax, but if you lose, your opponent will get whatever items you staked.
translation: 你和你的对手可以押上金币或铂金币作为赌注。如果你赢了，你会得到对手押注的金额减去一些税费；如果你输了，你的对手将得到你押注的一切物品。

english: You can choose to use rules to spice things up a bit. For instance if you both agree to use the 'No Magic' rule then neither player can use magic to attack the other player. The fight will be restricted to ranging and
translation: 你可以选择使用规则来增加一些趣味。例如，如果你们双方都同意使用'禁止魔法'规则，那么双方都不能使用魔法攻击对方。战斗将仅限于远程攻击和……

english: Now that the archaeologists have moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, have bought the land and converted it to a set of duel arenas. The best fighters from around the world come here to fight!
translation: 既然考古学家们已经搬走了，由我带领的一群战士买下了这块地，把它改造成了一组决斗竞技场。来自世界各地的顶尖战士都来这里战斗！

english: The rules are fairly self-evident with lots of different combinations for you to try out!
translation: 规则不言自明，有多种不同的组合供你尝试！

english: melee only.
translation: 仅限近战。

english: Welcome to the Duel Arena! What can I do for you?
translation: 欢迎来到决斗竞技场！有什么能帮你的？

english: When you go to the arena you'll go up an access ramp to the walkways that overlook the arenas. From the walkways you can watch the duels and challenge other players.
translation: 进入竞技场时，你会沿着一条通道斜坡走到俯瞰竞技场的走道上。从走道上你可以观看决斗并向其他玩家发起挑战。

english: The Duel Arena has six arenas where you can fight other players in a controlled environment. We have our own dedicated hospital where we guarantee to put you back together, even if you lose.
translation: 决斗竞技场有六个竞技场，你可以在受控环境中与其他玩家对战。我们有专属医院，保证即使你输了也能把你恢复原状。

english: Win. And if you ever stop having fun, stop dueling.
translation: 赢。如果哪天你觉得不好玩了，就别再决斗了。

english: In between the arenas are walkways where you can watch the fights and challenge other players.
translation: 竞技场之间是走道，你可以在那里观看战斗并向其他玩家发起挑战。

english: Now that the archaeologists have moved out, a group of warriors, headed by myself, have bought the land and converted it to a set of arenas for duels. The best fighters from around the world come here to fight!
translation: 既然考古学家们已经搬走了，由我带领的一群战士买下了这块地，把它改造成了一组用于决斗的竞技场。来自世界各地的顶尖战士都来这里战斗！

english: Hope you like the new do!
translation: 希望你喜欢新发型！

english: Mmm... very distinguished!
translation: 嗯... 非常有气质！

english: It really suits you!
translation: 真的很适合你！

english: Good afternoon sir. In need of a haircut are we? Or perhaps a shave? The service costs 1000 coins.
translation: 下午好先生。需要理发吗？或者刮个胡子？服务费 1000 金币。

english: Good afternoon madam. In need of a haircut are we? The service costs 2000 coins.
translation: 下午好女士。需要理发吗？服务费 2000 金币。

english: Please select the hairstyle and colour you would like from this brochure.
translation: 请从这本册子里选择你喜欢的发型和颜色。

english: Well, come back when you do. I'm not running a charity here!
translation: 好吧，等你想好了再来。我这里可不是做慈善的！

english: Good afternoon sir. In need of a haircut are we? Or perhaps a shave? The service costs 1,000 coins.
translation: 下午好先生。需要理发吗？或者刮个胡子？服务费 1,000 金币。

english: Good afternoon madam. In need of a haircut are we? The service costs 2,000 coins.
translation: 下午好女士。需要理发吗？服务费 2,000 金币。

english: A haircut will cost 1,000 coins.
translation: 理发需要 1,000 金币。

english: A haircut will cost 2,000 coins.
translation: 理发需要 2,000 金币。

english: Hope u wike da new do!
translation: 希望泥喜欢新发型！

english: Mmm... vewy distinguished!
translation: 嗯... 灰常有气质！

english: It weawwy suits u!
translation: 真的很适合泥！

english: I don't like it when people cross there. It scares the fish. Please don't.
translation: 我不喜欢人们从那里经过。会吓到鱼。请别这样。

english: I'm sorry, Your Royal Highness, but it scares the fish when people cross there. Please don't.
translation: 抱歉，殿下，但人们从那里经过会吓到鱼。请别这样。

english: I'm painting my toenails... what's it look like I'm doing? Silly outsider...
translation: 我在涂脚趾甲……你看我像是在干什么？愚蠢的外乡人……

english: You hadn't heard, your Royal Highness? Etceterian soldiers came and demanded tithes from us.
translation: 你没听说吗，殿下？埃特塞里亚士兵来了，向我们征收什一税。

english: Hey! This is the King's fishing spot. You'll need his approval to make use of it.
translation: 嘿！这是国王的钓鱼点。你需要他的许可才能使用。

english: You managed to carry all those barrels?
translation: 你居然搬走了所有这些桶？

english: I've heard about them from visitors.
translation: 我从访客那里听说过它们。

english: So, do you have my barrels?
translation: 那么，你有我的桶吗？

english: The ones who kept on failing the trials for years?
translation: 那些多年来一直未能通过试炼的人？

english: The only bones long enough are those of the fearsome giant frog!
translation: 唯一够长的骨头是那些可怕的巨蛙的骨头！

english: Um, sorry, but we're not allowed to let surface-dwellers mine here.
translation: 嗯，抱歉，我们不允许地面居民在这里采矿。

english: You know, if you start getting comfortable down there, things can be a little unstable at times...
translation: 你知道吗，如果你开始在那下面待得舒服了，有时候情况可能会有点不稳定……

english: Hey! Don't think you can be using our training grounds as some kind of safe haven.
translation: 嘿！别以为你能把我们的训练场当成什么安全避难所。

english: Thewe's something in that dawe chest waiting fow u.Don't weave it fow too wong.
translation: 那个胆大的箱子里有东西在等着你。别让它等太久哦。

english: Shame, I don't think I have anything for you. Train up your Thieving skill to at least 50 and I might be able to help you out.
translation: 可惜，我没什么能给你的。把你的偷窃技能练到至少50级，我或许能帮你。

english: You don't really need my help do you? You're not even in the maze yet!
translation: 你其实不需要我帮忙吧？你连迷宫都还没进去呢！

english: Great, well you've already got a jewel so away you go!
translation: 太好了，你已经有一颗首饰了，那就走吧！

english: Of couse you won't do it again, you can only kill me once.
translation: 你当然不会再做了，你只能杀我一次。

english: Good day, sir. Are you interested in the history of this area?
translation: 你好，先生。你对这片区域的历史感兴趣吗？

english: Good day, madam. Are you interested in the history of this area?
translation: 你好，女士。你对这片区域的历史感兴趣吗？

english: He is here, actually he was here! He's just nipped out to go to the toilet a few minutes ago. His drink is over there on the table by those barrels.
translation: 他在这里，实际上他刚才还在！几分钟前他刚溜出去上厕所了。他的饮料就在那边靠近那些桶的桌子上。

english: The only problem is that no one has ever actually seen a toilet in Gielinor so he may take a little while.
translation: 唯一的问题是，在吉莱诺从来没人真正见过厕所，所以他可能要花点时间。

english: Well, I'm called Ali and from here. Do you want me?
translation: 嗯，我叫阿里，就来自这里。你找我吗？

english: Actually all my uncles are called Ali!
translation: 实际上我所有的叔叔都叫阿里！

english: That's a difficult question to answer. Everyone in the town have uncles called Ali.
translation: 这个问题很难回答。镇上的每个人都有一个叫阿里的叔叔。

english: I admit it appears so, seeing as everybody and every other establishment in this town has the name 'Ali' in it.
translation: 我承认看起来是这样，毕竟镇上的每个人和每家店的名字里都带着‘阿里’。

english: If you don't like the name I could rename it 'Ali's' but then it may be confused with the Camel shop and Kebab house.
translation: 如果你不喜欢这个名字，我可以改叫‘阿里店’，但那样可能会和骆驼店、烤肉店混淆。

english: Nothing much really, the same as you would expect of any border town on the edge of the desert.
translation: 其实没什么，跟沙漠边缘任何边境小镇一样。

english: Nothing much to say really about them. They're all paying customers so I won't rock the boat if you don't mind.
translation: 关于他们，真的没什么好说的。他们都是付钱的顾客，所以如果你不介意的话，我不想惹麻烦。

english: What! Drink being poisoned in my bar! My reputation could be destroyed if someone died here. Thank you adventurer.
translation: 什么！在我的酒吧里下毒！要是有人死在这里，我的名声就毁了。谢谢你，冒险者。

english: Here have a beer - it's on the house.
translation: 来杯啤酒——本店请客。

english: Well since you gave the two gangs a good kicking, things have improved hugely. Both gangs seem to be spending all their gold here drowning their sorrows.
translation: 自从你狠狠地教训了那两个帮派之后，情况大为好转。两个帮派似乎都把所有的金币花在这里借酒消愁了。

english: Get out of here, you cheeky rascal. A cut in my profits? As if!
translation: 滚开，你这厚脸皮的家伙。分我利润？想得美！

english: Hello, sir! If you need help with your tasks then you are welcome to talk to the Burgher or his advisors.
translation: 你好，先生！如果你需要任务帮助，欢迎和市民长官或他的顾问交谈。

english: Hello, ma'am! If you need help with your tasks then you are welcome to talk to the Burgher or his advisors.
translation: 你好，女士！如果你需要任务帮助，欢迎和市民长官或他的顾问交谈。

english: Hello, sir! Just talk to the Burgher or his advisors if you need any help.
translation: 你好，先生！如果需要帮助，只需和市民长官或他的顾问交谈。

english: Hello, ma'am! Just talk to the Burgher or his advisors if you need any help.
translation: 你好，女士！如果需要帮助，只需和市民长官或他的顾问交谈。

english: Ah... It is expected for an outsider like yourself to notice the mountain and wonder how we exist in its shadow.
translation: 啊……像你这样的外来者注意到那座山并好奇我们如何存在于它的阴影之下，也是意料之中的。

english: I don't know why people like it so much... it tastes a like a ball of chewed up grass.
translation: 我不知道为什么人们这么喜欢它……吃起来像一团嚼过的草。

english: Very well, sir, as you wish.
translation: 好的，先生，如您所愿。

english: Very well, madam, as you wish.
translation: 好的，女士，如您所愿。

english: I wouldn't mind him setting up shop, but he's brought others in.
translation: 我倒不介意他开店，但他还带了其他人来。

english: Two of them came here and said they were going to put me out of business if I didn't listen to them!
translation: 他们中有两个人跑来这里说，如果我不听他们的，就要让我做不下去！

english: The other shopkeepers and I won't give in to their threats. Osman's also told us that he'll make sure we're protected.
translation: 其他店主和我都不会屈服于他们的威胁。奥斯曼也向我们保证会保护我们。

english: I'll keep tanning leather for people like you to make into clothes and armour.
translation: 我会继续为像你这样的人鞣制皮革，让你们做成衣服和盔甲。

english: Hah, as if they think they could threaten me with a hammer and a pair of scissors.
translation: 哈，好像他们以为拿把锤子和一把剪刀就能威胁我似的。

english: Alternatively you could try hard leather. It's not so easy to craft, but I only charge 3gp per cowhide to prepare it, and it makes much studier armour.
translation: 或者你也可以试试硬皮革。它没那么容易加工，但我每张牛皮只收3金币来处理，而且能做出更坚固的盔甲。

english: I see you've brought me some hides. Would you like me to tan them for you?
translation: 我看你带了些兽皮来。要我帮你鞣制吗？

english: You ain't got no locks, come back when you do.
translation: 你一个锁都没有，有了再来吧。

english: Can't... you can't carry now, come back when you can carry it.
translation: 不能……你现在拿不动，等你能拿的时候再来吧。

english: If you remove lock from current coffin, I fit coffin with new lock.
translation: 如果你把当前棺材上的锁取下来，我就给棺材装上新锁。

english: Well if you put a string on that holy symbol I can bless it for you or I could tell you about skillcapes.
translation: 嗯，如果你在那个神圣护符上系根绳子，我可以帮你祝福它，或者我可以跟你聊聊技能披风的事。

english: Well I can bless that star of Saradomin you have!
translation: 我可以祝福你手上的萨拉多明之星！

english: Well if you put a string on that holy symbol I can bless it for you.
translation: 嗯，如果你在那个神圣护符上系根绳子，我可以帮你祝福它。

english: You wouldn't mind?
translation: 你不介意吗？

english: I'd love to count everything you've collected on your adventures, although you might want to take a seat this could take a while.
translation: 我很乐意清点你在冒险中收集的所有物品，不过你可能想坐下，这可能要花点时间。

english: Colour me impressed, you've collected more items than me, I look forward to seeing your collection grow even more!
translation: 真是让我刮目相看，你收集的物品比我还多，我期待看到你的收藏继续壮大！

english: From what I can see you have collected 1 item in your collection!
translation: 据我看，你的收藏中已经收集了1件物品！

english: back home as an act of gratitude.  Budding farmers will also find their link with plants to be just a little bit better than before.
translation: 作为感激之情带回家。初出茅庐的农夫们还会发现他们与植物的联系比以前更紧密一些。

english: Well, you don't appear to have enough space in your inventory to carry one, so there's not much point me selling it to you! Make some space and come back.
translation: 嗯，你的背包好像没空间装了，所以卖给你也没用！腾出地方再来吧。

english: Maybe you could deposite some of your items in the bank here?
translation: 也许你可以把一些物品存到这里的银行？

english: Ultimate Iron Men may not save inventory space with item sets.
translation: 终极铁人男玩家不能通过物品套装节省背包空间。

english: Wewcome to da Gwand Exchange.Wouwd u wike to twade now, ow exchange item sets?
translation: 欢迎来到大交易所。你想现在交易，还是交换物品套装？

english: Ultimate Iron Women may not save inventory space with item sets.
translation: 终极铁人女玩家不能通过物品套装节省背包空间。

english: Saradomin rest his soul. I hear people try to get rich by fighting in the Wilderness north of here or the Duel Arena in the south, but that's no way for honest folks to earn a living! So get yourself a good trade, and keep
translation: 萨拉多明安息他的灵魂。我听说有人通过在北边的荒野或南边的决斗竞技场战斗来发财，但那可不是老实人该谋生的方式！所以找个好行当吧，保持

english: No thanks, dearie, I don't want that just now.
translation: 不了谢谢，亲爱的，我现在不想要那个。

english: Want to cross the river? It's just 2 gold pieces!
translation: 想过河吗？只要2个金币！

english: Hello, want to cross the river?
translation: 你好，想过河吗？

english: Are you kidding?
translation: 你在开玩笑吗？

english: Want me to take you across? It's just 2 gold pieces!
translation: 要我带你过去吗？只要2个金币！

english: Of course I am! But it's just 2 gold coins, do you want to go?
translation: 当然是开玩笑！不过只要2个金币，你想过河吗？

english: I... guess.
translation: 我……猜是吧。

english: Oh, we wouldn't want that to happen. Come along, you can go for free this time.
translation: 哦，我们可不想那样。来吧，这次免费让你过。

english: Here, let me just relieve you of that one coin you have there and I'll take you across.
translation: 来，让我帮你减轻那一个硬币的负担，我就送你过河。

english: There, I have repaired your pouches. Now leave me alone. I'm concentrating.
translation: 好了，我已经修好了你的袋子。现在别烦我了，我在集中精神。

english: You don't seem to have any pouches in need of repair. Leave me alone.
translation: 你似乎没有需要修理的袋子。别烦我。

english: What? Oh... Very well. What did you want?
translation: 什么？哦……好吧。你想干嘛？

english: Do you mean what am I doing here in Abyssal space, or are you asking me what I consider my ultimate role to be in this voyage that we call life?
translation: 你是指我在深渊空间里做什么，还是问我在这场我们称之为生命的旅程中，我认为自己的最终角色是什么？

english: Well, if my concentration is broken while keeping this gate open, then, if we are lucky, everyone within a one mile radius will either have their heads explode, or will be consumed internally by the creatures of the Abyss.
translation: 嗯，如果我在维持这个传送门打开时被打断注意力，那么，如果我们幸运的话，方圆一英里内的每个人要么脑袋爆炸，要么被深渊的生物从内部吞噬。

english: By remaining here and holding this portal open, I am providing a permanent link between normal space and this strange dimension that we call Abyssal space.
translation: 通过留在这里并保持这个传送门打开，我在正常空间和我们称之为深渊空间的这个奇怪维度之间提供了一个永久的连接。

english: As long as this spell remains in effect, we have the capability to teleport into abyssal space at will.
translation: 只要这个法术仍然有效，我们就能够随意传送到深渊空间。

english: I am attempting to subdue the elemental mechanisms of the universe to my will.
translation: 我正试图让宇宙的元素机制服从我的意志。

english: Inane chatter from random idiots is not helping me achieve this!
translation: 来自随机白痴的无聊闲聊可帮不了我实现这个目标！

english: What can I do for you, friend?
translation: 朋友，有什么能帮你的？

english: No thanks. My colleagues and I have to be careful about the people with whom we do business.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我和我的同事们必须小心选择合作对象。

english: Bring as much as you like - the Shayzien armies always want more.
translation: 你想带多少就带多少——谢兹恩城的军队总是想要更多。

english: You're a decent miner and smith, so yes. The Shayzien armies always need supplies of armour, and the artisans of Lovakengj are responsible for supplying it. I'll explain what I need...
translation: 你是个不错的矿工和铁匠，所以是的。谢兹恩城的军队总是需要盔甲补给，而洛瓦肯吉城的工匠负责提供这些。我会解释我需要什么……

english: You don't have any suitable equipment for me. I need you to mine lovakite ore, smelt it into bars, then smith tier 5 Shayzien kit from the bars.
translation: 你没有适合我的装备。我需要你开采洛瓦凯特矿石，将其冶炼成金属锭，然后用这些金属锭锻造5级谢兹恩城装备。

english: No thanks. Try asking my colleagues - we all coordinate equipment of different tiers, and you may be able to help one of them instead.
translation: 不了，谢谢。去问问我的同事们吧——我们都协调不同等级的装备，也许你能帮上他们其中一位。

english: I coordinate the supply of equipment for the Shayzien armies. The Shayzien forces protect our Kingdom from all types of threat, so it's a very important business.
translation: 我负责协调谢兹恩城军队的装备供应。谢兹恩城的军队保护我们的王国免受各种威胁，所以这是一项非常重要的事务。

english: My job is to coordinate tier 5 equipment. That's the best stuff, for their chief officers and elite fighters.
translation: 我的工作是协调五级装备。这是最好的东西，供他们的高级军官和精英战士使用。

english: The people round here are great at mining and smithing, but not so good at fighting, so we depend on the Shayzien armies for protection from anything invading the city.
translation: 这里的人很擅长采矿和锻造，但不擅长战斗，所以我们依靠谢兹恩城的军队来保护我们免受任何入侵城市的威胁。

english: All the equipment you've brought is the wrong tier. I deal with tier 5 equipment. Try asking my colleague instead.
translation: 你带来的所有装备等级都不对。我负责五级装备。去问问我的同事吧。

english: The Shayzien armies always want supplies of armour, and the artisans of Lovakengj are responsible for supplying it. I'll explain what to do, but you'll need level 65 Mining and level 45 Smithing to make anything.
translation: 谢兹恩城的军队总是需要盔甲补给，而洛瓦肯吉城的工匠负责提供这些。我会解释该怎么做，但你需要65级采矿和45级锻造才能制作任何东西。

english: Bring as much as you like - the Shayzien Army always wants more.
translation: 尽管带来，越多越好——谢兹恩城的军队总是需要更多。

english: You're a decent miner and smith, so yes. The Shayzien Army always needs armour, and the artisans of Lovakengj are responsible for supplying it. I'll explain what I need...
translation: 你是个不错的矿工和铁匠，所以是的。谢兹恩城的军队总是需要盔甲，而洛瓦肯吉城的工匠负责供应这些。我会解释我需要什么……

english: I coordinate the supply of equipment for the Shayzien Army. They protect our kingdom from all types of threat, so it's a very important business.
translation: 我负责协调谢兹恩城军队的装备供应。他们保护我们的王国免受各种威胁，所以这是一项非常重要的事务。

english: The people round here are great at mining and smithing, but not so good at fighting, so we depend on the Shayzien Army for protection from anything invading the city.
translation: 这里的人很擅长采矿和锻造，但不擅长战斗，所以我们依靠谢兹恩城的军队来保护我们免受任何入侵城市的威胁。

english: The Shayzien Army always wants armour, and the artisans of Lovakengj are responsible for supplying it. I'll explain what to do, but you'll need level 65 Mining and level 45 Smithing to make anything.
translation: 谢兹恩城的军队总是需要盔甲，而洛瓦肯吉城的工匠负责供应这些。我会解释该怎么做，但你需要65级采矿和45级锻造才能制作任何东西。

english: All the equipment you've brought is the wrong tier. I deal with tier 3 equipment. Try asking my colleague instead.
translation: 你带来的所有装备等级都不对。我负责三级装备。去问问我的同事吧。

english: You don't have any suitable equipment for me. I need you to mine lovakite ore, smelt it into bars, then smith tier 3 Shayzien kit from the bars.
translation: 你没有适合我的装备。我需要你开采洛瓦凯特矿石，将其冶炼成金属锭，然后用这些金属锭锻造3级谢兹恩城装备。

english: My job is to coordinate tier 3 equipment, for warriors who can't handle the fancy equipment we make for their elite fighters.
translation: 我的工作是协调三级装备，给那些用不了我们为精英战士制作的精良装备的战士。

english: You don't have any suitable equipment for me. I need you to mine lovakite ore, smelt it into bars, then smith tier 2 Shayzien kit from the bars.
translation: 你没有适合我的装备。我需要你开采洛瓦凯特矿石，将其冶炼成金属锭，然后用这些金属锭锻造2级谢兹恩城装备。

english: All the equipment you've brought is the wrong tier. I deal with tier 2 equipment. Try asking my colleague instead.
translation: 你带来的所有装备等级都不对。我负责二级装备。去问问我的同事吧。

english: My job is to coordinate tier 2 equipment. That's what they wear when they've passed basic training but aren't ready for real combat.
translation: 我的工作是协调二级装备。这是他们通过基础训练但还没准备好真正战斗时穿的。

english: He does. He don't seem to care about that sorta stuff no more though. Since I've known 'im, he's only been obsessin' over gettin' as many people to play his game as possible.
translation: 他确实有。不过他似乎不再在乎那种事情了。从我认识他以来，他只沉迷于让尽可能多的人玩他的游戏。

english: It's 'ard to say. Me master never told me what it is or why he built it.
translation: 很难说。我的主人从未告诉过我那是什么，或者他为什么建造它。

english: Dung? How dare you?!
translation: 粪便？你怎么敢？！

english: We breed them. The originals were found by gnome explorers back in King Healthorg the Great's rule.  On their discovery King Healthorg authorised a small party to go there and transport a breeding pair back here. He
translation: 我们繁殖它们。最初是在海尔索格大帝统治时期由地精探险家发现的。发现后，海尔索格国王授权一支小队去那里，把一对种兽运回这里。他

english: Hurumph. Don't ask me. I didn't put it there. I keep trying to get my tortoises to stomp on it, but it keeps running away.
translation: 哼。别问我。不是我放那儿的。我一直想让我的乌龟去踩它，但它总是跑掉。

english: Will these creatures make useful foot soldiers in the gnome Army? I think not.
translation: 这些生物能成为地精军队中有用的步兵吗？我不这么认为。

english: How would I know! I've got tortoises to train - you have wasted enough of my time with trivialities, Goodbye.
translation: 我怎么知道！我还要训练乌龟——你已经用琐事浪费了我够多时间了，再见。

english: It seems you have no space for a beer. We wouldn't want it to fall on the floor, now would we? Come back when you have space.
translation: 看来你没有空间放啤酒了。我们可不想让它掉在地上，对吧？等你有空间了再来吧。

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear chap. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 我真是太失礼了，亲爱的老兄。我叫奥多瓦卡尔，为那家卓越的企业——吉莱诺银行工作。

english: Absolutely correct, dear sir. I must warn you, however, that due to the significantly increased overheads of an enterprise such as this, there is a small bank charge of 100gp every time you want to access your account.
translation: 完全正确，亲爱的先生。不过我必须警告你，由于这样一家企业的管理费用大幅增加，你每次访问账户都要收取100gp的小额银行费用。

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear lady. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 我真是太失礼了，亲爱的女士。我叫奥多瓦卡尔，为那家卓越的企业——吉莱诺银行工作。

translation: 完全正确，亲爱的女士。不过，我必须警告你，由于像这样的企业运营成本大幅增加，每次你想访问时都会收取100金币的小额银行费用。

english: your account.
translation: 你的账户都要收取100gp的小额银行费用。

english: It's not that I don't trust you to pay afterwards, old chap, but as the old adage goes, 'money comes before friends'.
translation: 不是我不信任你会事后付款，老兄，但俗话说得好，‘金钱比朋友更重要’。

english: It's not that I don't trust you to pay afterwards, old girl, but as the old adage goes, 'money comes before friends'.
translation: 不是我不信任你会事后付款，姑娘，但俗话说得好，‘金钱比朋友更重要’。

english: Hello, only the top fishers are allowed in here. You need a fishing level of 68 to enter.
translation: 你好，只有顶级的钓者才能进入这里。你需要68级的钓鱼技能才能进入。

english: I'm happy to, my friend. This beautiful cape was presented to me in recognition of my skills and experience as a fisherman and I was asked to be the head of this guild at the same time. As the best
translation: 我很乐意，我的朋友。这件漂亮的披风是为了表彰我作为渔夫的技巧和经验而赠送的，同时我被要求担任这个公会的会长。作为公会里最好的

english: fisherman in the guild it is my duty to control who has access to the guild and to say who can buy similar skillcapes.
translation: 渔夫，我有责任控制谁能进入公会，以及谁能购买类似的技能披风。

english: Hello, only the top fishers are allowed to use our premier fishing facilities and you seem to meet the criteria. Enjoy!
translation: 你好，只有顶级的钓者才能使用我们一流的钓鱼设施，而你似乎符合条件。尽情享受吧！

english: Certainly! Right when you pay me 99000 coins.
translation: 当然可以！只要付给我99000金币就行。

english: Human! Get back to da swave pens befowe mecaww daguawds!
translation: 人类！在偶叫守卫之前，滚回奴隶围栏去！

english: Welcome to the vinery, young man. Can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到葡萄园，年轻人。需要帮忙吗？

english: Welcome to the vinery, young lady. Can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到葡萄园，年轻女士。需要帮忙吗？

english: I'm afraid you aren't allowed, dear.
translation: 恐怕不允许你这么做，亲爱的。

english: Now, can I help you with anything else?
translation: 那么，还有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: When I can.
translation: 有空的时候。

english: Most aren't any good so I throw rotten fruit at them!
translation: 大部分都不怎么样，所以我就朝他们扔烂水果！

english: This is the Duel Arena...duh!
translation: 这是决斗竞技场……当然！

english: Here's the stuff you won in that duel earlier.
translation: 这是你刚才决斗赢得的那些东西。

english: Hey, you've got some winnings you need to collect from me! Free up some inventory space and I'll hand them over.
translation: 嘿，你有些赢利需要从我这里领取！腾出一些背包空间，我就把它们交给你。

english: Very good, very good. Its good to taste real gnomish flavours.
translation: 非常好，非常好。能尝到真正的地精风味真是太好了。

english: Oh, that sounds important. You'd better talk to the librarian about that.
translation: 哦，听起来很重要。你最好去跟图书管理员谈谈。

english: What's this large pouch?
translation: 这个大型精华袋是什么？

english: Well, I will assume that 'anything' includes weapons and armour. So, come back when you've got rid of them.
translation: 好吧，我就当'任何东西'包括武器和盔甲。所以，等你处理掉它们再回来吧。

english: You need to speak to Auguste back on Entrana to receive your reward. You can use the balloon to go back there if you have one normal log.
translation: 你需要回恩特纳岛找奥古斯特领取奖励。如果你有一根普通原木，可以用热气球回去。

english: What's this large orb?
translation: 这个大型宝珠是什么？

english: You don't have any suitable equipment for me. I need you to mine lovakite ore, smelt it into bars, then smith tier 4 Shayzien kit from the bars.
translation: 你没有适合我的装备。我需要你开采洛瓦凯特矿石，将其冶炼成金属锭，然后用这些金属锭锻造4级谢兹恩城装备。

english: All the equipment you've brought is the wrong tier. I deal with tier 4 equipment. Try asking my colleague instead.
translation: 你带来的所有装备等级都不对。我负责四级装备。去问问我的同事吧。

english: My job is to coordinate tier 4 equipment. It's pretty good stuff, used by their upper ranks.
translation: 我的工作是协调四级装备。这是相当不错的东西，供他们的高级军官使用。

english: Well, it's quite simple really my mother was a drysalter and I learnt the trade from her.
translation: 嗯，其实很简单，我母亲是个干货商，我从她那里学到了这门手艺。

english: This is TzHaar terminal chamber. TzHaar rest here to draw warmth from volcano.
translation: 这里是特扎尔的终端密室。特扎尔在此休息，从火山中汲取热量。

english: As TzHaar grow, we lose heat and begin to solidify. Heat from volcano allows us to prolong the process.
translation: 特扎尔成长时，我们会失去热量并开始凝固。火山的热量让我们得以延长这个过程。

english: TzHaar will eventually harden and cease to be molten. We turn to rock, known as Haar-Tok.
translation: 特扎尔最终会硬化，不再保持熔融状态。我们会变成岩石，被称为哈尔.托克。

english: In essence. Haar-Tok cannot move or communicate, but the former TzHaar remains conscious.
translation: 本质上来说。哈尔.托克无法移动或交流，但前特扎尔仍然保持意识。

english: Looks like there are some interesting things there now if you'd like to have a dip!
translation: 看起来那里现在有些有趣的东西，如果你想泡一泡的话！

english: Hello there, big guy!
translation: 你好啊，大个子！

english: Hello there, big lady!
translation: 你好啊，大女士！

english: Oh no, she won't. In fact, she is the one who sent me here to become a sacrifice to Zulrah!
translation: 哦不，她不会的。事实上，正是她派我来这里成为祖尔拉的祭品！

english: I shall bring honor to my Gnomish family by being eaten by the snake lord. In return, my family will be rewarded with extra food rations.
translation: 我将通过被蛇王吃掉来为我的地精家族带来荣耀。作为回报，我的家族将获得额外的食物配给品作为奖励。

english: WHAT HAVE YOU DONE?! I was supposed to be the one to sacrifice myself! I will have to return to my family in shame.
translation: 你都做了什么？！我才是应该献祭自己的人！我将不得不羞愧地回到家人身边。

english: Go forward!
translation: 向前走！

english: Now left!
translation: 现在向左！

english: Look at that, a fantastic steed!
translation: 看看那，多棒的坐骑！

english: Haha! Now we're talkin'.
translation: 哈哈！这才像话。

english: I said left, not right! Turn around!
translation: 我说左，不是右！转过来！

english: You can do it this time. Go left! Left!
translation: 这次你能行。向左！左！

english: No! No! No! Left! LEFT! Not right! Turn around again!
translation: 不！不！不！左！左！不是右！再转过来！

english: You can do it this time. Go right! Right!
translation: 这次你能行。向右！右！

english: Of course I can. Now stand back, foul human, lest me and my beast slay you!
translation: 我当然能。现在退后，可恶的人类，免得我和我的野兽杀了你！

english: Very good. Now let's try this again. Go right!
translation: 很好。现在再试一次。向右！

english: I give up! This beast is useless!
translation: 我放弃了！这野兽没用！

english: I was trying to take control of this beast so that we had an advantage in combat against you humans!
translation: 我本想控制这野兽以便在与你们人类的战斗中获得优势！

english: A banana? Is this some sort of trick? I doubt you have a banana with you human.
translation: 一根香蕉？这是什么把戏？我怀疑你身上真有香蕉吗，人类。

english: If I can't tame this beast then I guess I'll have to deal with you myself!
translation: 如果我不能驯服这野兽，那看来我得亲自对付你了！

english: I'm sorry sir, but no weapons or armour may be worn on Entrana. This rule even forbids items dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 抱歉先生，但恩特纳岛上不允许穿戴任何武器或盔甲。这条规则甚至禁止奉献给萨拉多明的物品。

english: I'm sorry madam, but no weapons or armour may be worn on Entrana. This rule even forbids items dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 抱歉女士，但恩特纳岛上不允许穿戴任何武器或盔甲。这条规则甚至禁止奉献给萨拉多明的物品。

english: Sorry, human, Percy doesn't want people going through there unless he trusts them personally.
translation: 抱歉，人类，帕西不想让人从那经过，除非他本人信任他们。

english: You should look inside my arena. There's an abundance of valuable resources inside.
translation: 你应该看看我的竞技场里面。里面有很多宝贵的资源。

english: One day, adventurer, I will boast ownership of a much larger, more dangerous arena than this. Take advantage of this offer while it lasts.
translation: 总有一天，冒险者，我会夸耀拥有一个比这个更大、更危险的竞技场。趁这个机会还在，好好利用吧。

english: Guards! Remove this human!
translation: 卫兵！把这个人类赶出去！

english: Guards! Guards! A human!
translation: 卫兵！卫兵！有个人类！

english: Guards! A human!
translation: 卫兵！有个人类！

english: And that lad is why they call me two feet Charley, because they found me jammed two feet down a shark's throat.
translation: 这就是为什么他们叫我两英尺查理，小伙子，因为他们发现我被卡在鲨鱼喉咙里两英尺深的地方。

english: All right, lad, since yer so insistent, I'll tell ye.
translation: 好吧，小伙子，既然你这么坚持，我就告诉你。

english: All right, lass, since yer so insistent, I'll tell ye.
translation: 好吧，小姑娘，既然你这么坚持，我就告诉你。

english: And that lass is why they call me two feet Charley, because they found me jammed two feet down a shark's throat.
translation: 这就是为什么他们叫我两英尺查理，小姑娘，因为他们发现我被卡在鲨鱼喉咙里两英尺深的地方。

english: My apologies, but I can't take you with me while you're affected by that spell. It should wear off in 4 minutes, 58 seconds.
translation: 抱歉，你受到那个法术影响时我不能带你走。它应该会在4分58秒后消失。

english: My apologies, but I can't take you with me while you're affected by that spell. It should wear off in 4 minutes, 57 seconds.
translation: 抱歉，你受到那个法术影响时我不能带你走。它应该会在4分57秒后消失。

english: My apologies, but I can't take you with me while you're affected by that spell. It should wear off in 4 minutes, 45 seconds.
translation: 抱歉，你受到那个法术影响时我不能带你走。它应该会在4分45秒后消失。

english: My apologies, but I can't take you with me while you're affected by that spell. It should wear off in 2 minutes, 27 seconds.
translation: 抱歉，你受到那个法术影响时我不能带你走。它应该会在2分27秒后消失。

english: Hey! I'm not flying out this deep into the Wilderness. They don't pay me danger money, you know.  I'm out of here.
translation: 嘿！我可不会飞到荒野这么深的地方。他们又不给我危险津贴，你知道吗。我要走了。

english: Ah, hello there, laddie! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: 啊，你好啊，小伙子！我刚挖出一个我的旧宝箱。

english: Ah, hello there, lassie! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: 啊，你好啊，小姑娘！我刚挖出一个我的旧宝箱。

english: Arrr, you're not the feller I be needin'.
translation: 啊，你不是我要找的那个家伙。

english: Arrr, you're not the lassie I be needin'.
translation: 啊，你不是我要找的那个姑娘。

english: Awww, u'we not da wassie me be needin'.
translation: 啊呜，你不是我要找的那个家伙。

english: Awww, u'we not da wassie mebe needin'.
translation: 啊呜，你不是我要找的那个姑娘。

english: Ah, hewwo dawe, wassie!I've just dug up an owd tweasuwe chest of mine.
translation: 啊，你好啊，小家伙！我刚挖出一个我的旧宝箱。

english: You don't have any suitable equipment for me. I need you to mine lovakite ore, smelt it into bars, then smith tier 1 Shayzien kit from the bars.
translation: 你没有适合我的装备。我需要你开采洛瓦凯特矿石，将其冶炼成金属锭，然后用这些金属锭锻造1级谢兹恩城装备。

english: My job is to coordinate tier 1 equipment. That's the basic training kit, so it's nothing fancy.
translation: 我的工作是协调一级装备。那是基础训练装备，所以没什么特别的。

english: All the equipment you've brought is the wrong tier. I deal with tier 1 equipment. Try asking my colleague instead.
translation: 你带来的所有装备等级都不对。我负责一级装备。去问问我的同事吧。

english: Hello there. Want to travel to Slepe? I charge 50,000 coins for the journey.
translation: 你好。想去斯莱普镇吗？我收五万金币的旅费。

english: Anyway, I'm able to rent a room here, and to buy food. I'm not being a burden on anyone, and there are no vampyres coming for my blood.
translation: 总之，我在这里能租到房间，也能买食物。我没有拖累任何人，也没有吸血鬼来吸我的血。

english: I'm afraid something's blocking my magic, actually.
translation: 实际上，恐怕有什么东西在阻碍我的魔法。

english: No. Only citizens of Meiyerditch can enter and you're not one of them.
translation: 不行。只有迈尔迪奇的市民才能进入，而你不是其中之一。

english: You shouldn't be. However, Verzik Vitur has us turn a blind eye to outsiders sneaking in. She likes to watch them die in the Theatre.
translation: 你不应该意外。不过，维齐克.维图尔让我们对外来者潜入睁一只眼闭一只眼。她喜欢看他们在剧院里死去。

english: You already have a flyer. I've only so many left.
translation: 你已经有一张传单了。我剩下的不多了。

english: It doesn't look like you have any room in your inventory.
translation: 你的背包看起来没有空间了。

english: I want a pet sea slug for my birthday. They are so cute!
translation: 我生日想要一只海蛞蝓宠物。它们太可爱了！

english: The monkeys are so funny-looking!
translation: 这些猴子看起来真好笑！

english: We're going to see the dragons! They're my favourite!
translation: 我们要去看龙！它们是我的最爱！

english: My dad says he got bitten by a giant snail once.
translation: 我爸爸说他曾经被一只巨型蜗牛咬过。

english: Do you know where the moles are?
translation: 你知道鼹鼠在哪里吗？

english: The Kalphite Queen is soo scary!
translation: 卡尔夫特虫后好可怕啊！

english: I bet a wyvern would beat a dragon in a fight!
translation: 我打赌飞龙在战斗中能打败龙！

english: Oh, hello adventurer. Can I help you with anything?
translation: 哦，你好，冒险者。有什么能帮你的吗？

english: The ore found within these caverns can be rather volatile, especially when heated. We've found that when imbued, this ore can damage her armor.
translation: 这些洞穴里发现的矿石相当不稳定，尤其是在受热时。我们发现，当这种矿石被注入能量后，可以破坏她的护甲。

english: You'll want to head on in and mine the ore from the rocks around the prison. Once you have some, you can heat is using the furnace and then imbue it using the altar.
translation: 你需要进去，从监狱周围的岩石中开采矿石。一旦你有了矿石，你可以用熔炉加热它，然后在祭坛上注入能量。

english: Zalcano is formed completely from stone. Because of this, normaly weapons won't work on her.
translation: 扎尔卡诺完全由石头构成。因此，普通武器对她无效。

english: Are you sure you want to recolour that piece of graceful clothing? It will cost 15 marks of grace.
translation: 你确定要重新染色那件优雅服装吗？这将花费15个优雅印记。

english: Oh, no, you can't have my outfit unless you have maximum favour with all the cities of Kourend.
translation: 哦，不行，除非你获得了库兰德王国所有城市的最高声望，否则我不能给你我的服装。

english: I only recolour pieces of graceful clothing.
translation: 我只为优雅服装重新染色。

english: I'm afraid you need 100% favour with a city before you may wear its colours. You don't have enough favour with any of them.
translation: 恐怕你需要某个城市100%的声望才能穿它的颜色。你目前没有任何城市达到足够声望。

english: The item of clothing already has those colours.
translation: 这件服装已经是那些颜色了。

english: Never mind. You can still use them like a normal crossbow or dagger. Are you interested?
translation: 没关系。你仍然可以像普通弩或匕首一样使用它们。有兴趣吗？

english: Oh yes, young girl? Yes, what do you want?
translation: 哦，是啊，小姑娘？嗯，你想要什么？

english: She says she's looking for her quest!
translation: 她说她在找她的任务！

english: Now she says she wants a task!
translation: 现在她又说想要个差事！

english: Let me see, she appears to be a human of some sort.
translation: 让我看看，她看起来像是某种人类。

english: I didn't let her in, she let herself in!
translation: 我没让她进来，她自己闯进来的！

english: I wouldn't think on it too long, I'd just died, my emotions were unbearable.
translation: 我不会想太久，我刚死的时候，情绪难以承受。→ 我不会想太久，我刚死的时候，情绪实在难以承受。

english: This is the servery, where the soldiers from the Shayzien barracks come for meals. It is our duty to keep the Shayzien troops well fed.
translation: 这是食堂，谢兹恩城军营的士兵们来这里吃饭。让谢兹恩城的部队吃饱是我们的职责。

english: They're a pretty boring bunch, never willing to try anything new or interesting. But hey, they keep the city safe, so I'll feed 'em what they want.
translation: 他们可真是一群无聊的家伙，从不愿尝试新鲜有趣的东西。不过嘛，他们保护城市的安全，所以我就给他们想吃的。

english: Nope, u'we not da one da teachew wanted me tofind!
translation: 不，你不是老师要我找的那个人！

english: Hey, Moha the great goat fucker, the teacher wants you to come to school for a test.
translation: 嘿，伟大的山羊操手莫哈，老师让你来学校参加考试。

english: Hey, [player name], da teachew wants u to come to schoowfow a test.
translation: 嘿，[player name]，老师要你回学校考试。

english: Simple. We send each lander out every few minutes, however we need at least 5 volunteers or it's a suicide mission. The lander can only hold a maximum of 25 people though, so we do send them out early if they get
translation: 很简单。我们每隔几分钟就派一艘登陆艇出去，但至少需要5名志愿者，否则就是自杀任务。不过登陆艇最多只能容纳25人，所以如果凑满了我们也会提前派出去。

english: You'we awweady hewe.
translation: 你已经在这儿了。

english: When Wintertodt first attacked, it was feared that all Kourend may be lost. Fortunately the Order of the Sacred Flame and Dinh the Master Smith were able to stop it.
translation: 冬将军第一次袭击时，人们担心整个库兰德王国都会沦陷。幸运的是，圣焰骑士团和大师铁匠丁恩阻止了它。

english: More than one hundred and thirty-seven decades ago, seemingly from nowhere, the Wintertodt began terrorising the lands north of Kourend, freezing everything within its path.
translation: 一百三十七多年前，冬将军仿佛凭空出现，开始在库兰德王国以北的地区肆虐，冻结了途径的一切。

english: attack.
translation: 攻击。

english: The Wintertodt remained within its prison until very recently when it began to threaten Kourend once more. Fortunately the Order of the Sacred Flame is able to contain the Wintertodt and prevent another
translation: 冬将军一直被困在监狱里，直到最近它又开始威胁库兰德王国了。幸运的是，圣焰骑士团能够压制冬将军，防止另一次

english: Dinh was a great smith and engineer. He uncovered the power of the Bruma tree. Using bark from the Bruma tree and various metal compounds, Dinh forged the doors of the prison that hold Wintertodt.
translation: 丁恩是一位伟大的铁匠和工程师。他发现了布鲁玛树的力量。他用布鲁玛树的树皮和多种金属化合物锻造了囚禁冬将军的监狱大门。

english: In addition, the Order of the Sacred flame utilised the Bruma tree in firemaking, heating the environment to subdue Wintertodt.
translation: 此外，圣焰骑士团在生火中利用了布鲁玛树，加热环境以压制冬将军。

english: Be vigilant friend.
translation: 保持警惕，朋友。

english: Ignisia will explain. Just be careful of what she tells you.
translation: 伊格尼西亚会解释的。小心她告诉你的事情。

english: I've heard stories about them and the things they have done over the years. Be careful of them, they can't be trusted.
translation: 我听说过关于他们的故事，以及他们多年来做的事。小心他们，他们不可信。

english: The Dark Altar. It felt the Altar's power and wanted to consume it for itself. It wouldn't be the first time...
translation: 黑暗祭坛。它感受到了祭坛的力量，想要吞噬它。这也不是第一次了……

english: Lady Piscarilius has sent me here to keep an eye on the situation. She doesn't trust the other houses and believes something sinister is going on here.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯女士派我来这里监视情况。她不信任其他家族，并相信这里正在发生一些邪恶的事情。

english: You've put one of my children in your bank?
translation: 你把我的一个孩子放进了你的银行？

english: Mmm?
translation: 嗯？
