english: I'm out of here on a mission, do you think I chose to hang around these lowlifes?
translation: 我出任务去了，你以为我喜欢和这些下等人混在一起吗？

english: Hee hee! What shaww we tawk about, human?
translation: 嘿嘿！我们聊聊什么呀，人类？

english: No no no! I won't get back to training, leave me alone!
translation: 不不不！我不想回去训练，别管我！

english: Oh, you're not the drill sergeant, please don't tell them I'm hiding over here.
translation: 哦，你不是训练教官，请别告诉他们我躲在这里。

english: When I was growing up, all I ever wanted to be was a fisherman. I wanted to go and live in Port Piscarilius and sail the vast ocean to the east.
translation: 我从小就想当个渔夫。我想去皮斯卡里琉斯港生活，航行在东方无尽的海洋上。

english: My parents though... they hate the people of Piscarilius and wanted me to do so as well. They said I must be a soldier and bring honour to Shayzien.
translation: 可我的父母……他们恨皮斯卡里琉斯城的人，也想让我恨。他们说，我必须当一名士兵，为谢兹恩城带来荣耀。

english: I just can't handle it though, the training is too intense, my heart is just not in it. That's why I'm out here, I'm not going back until the drill sergeant finishes his session.
translation: 但我实在受不了，训练太苦了，我压根儿不感兴趣。这就是我躲这儿的原因，等训练教官结束训练我才回去。

english: Please please! I'll do anything, please don't tell the sergeant! I'll be the laughing stock of the whole kingdom.
translation: 求求你！我什么都愿意做，请别告诉中士！我会成为整个王国的笑柄的。

english: I don't have that much. I'll give you all I can for you to keep quiet, how is 1 gold coin?
translation: 我没那么多钱。我把我能给的都给你，让你保守秘密，1枚金币怎么样？

english: Ahah! With this mount I will be unstoppable in combat and shall take over this land belonging to the humans!
translation: 啊哈！有了这坐骑，我在战斗中势不可挡，必将占领这片属于人类的土地！

english: Oh? You're approaching me?
translation: 哦？你是在向我靠近吗？

english: What's this? A challenger?
translation: 这是什么？挑战者？

english: Haha! You don't stand a chance!
translation: 哈哈！你没机会的！

english: Is that the best you can do?
translation: 你就这点能耐吗？

english: I've never seen a creature like this before!
translation: 我从未见过这样的生物！

english: Now, get ready to face my might!
translation: 现在，准备好迎接我的力量吧！

english: Wow, this one has a sword on its head!
translation: 哇，这个头上长了把剑！

english: Wait, what? You can't do that! Come back here!
translation: 等等，什么？你不能那样！给我回来！

english: Another one! I shall fight you instead!
translation: 又一个！那我就跟你打！

english: Is that so? Prove your loyalty to me!
translation: 是吗？证明你对我的忠诚！

english: Only if it is the best banana in the world!
translation: 除非那是世界上最棒的香蕉！

english: Oh, it looks like you don't have a spare inventory slot for it.
translation: 哦，看来你没有多余的背包栏位放它了。

english: Do you though? The subtleties between different types of birds is quite incredible, you see-
translation: 你真的懂吗？不同种类鸟类之间的细微差别真是太不可思议了，你看——

english: Ah yes, well, of course! I've travelled around this island and found the best spots for bird watching, I placed a ring of stones at these locations.
translation: 啊，是的，当然！我环游了这座岛，找到了最好的观鸟点，我在这些地方放了一个石环。

english: It's my fathers fault really, constantly talking about falconry...
translation: 其实是我父亲的错，他老是在谈论猎鹰术……

english: I sense bad news. It's okay, he's been gone so long, I believe I've moved on.
translation: 我感觉有坏消息。没关系，他离开那么久了，我想我已经走出来了。

english: Good bye, [player name].
translation: 再见，[player name]。

english: Hello there. You look lost - are you okay?
translation: 你好啊。你看起来很迷茫——你还好吗？

english: I've disabled your lap counter messages, if you want to turn it back on, so you can see your total laps after you finish one, speak to me again.
translation: 我已禁用你的圈数计数器消息，如果你想重新打开它，以便在完成一圈后看到总圈数，再跟我说话。

english: I've turned on your lap counter, you'll get a message when you complete a lap on a course. To help you keep track.
translation: 我已打开你的圈数计数器，当你在跑道上完成一圈时，你会收到一条消息。以帮助你记录。

english: If you want to recolor your graceful pieces, just simply use the piece you wish to be recolored on me, and we can begin.
translation: 如果你想给你的优雅套装部件染色，只需把你想要染色的部件用在我身上，我们就可以开始了。

english: Come back when you have some Marks of Grace.
translation: 等你有了优雅印记再来吧。

english: I can grant you 50 base agility XP per each Mark of Grace you have. You'll get a total of 50 base XP for your one mark.
translation: 我可以根据你拥有的每个优雅印记，给你 50 点基础敏捷经验值。你的一个印记总共能获得 50 点基础经验值。

english: Nope, u wwong pewson.
translation: 不，你找错人了。

english: Why, he can cross the Kharidian Desert in three bounds, and he's so strong that he could haul the brick for the Duel Arena in only a day!
translation: 哎呀，他三步就能跨越卡里迪安沙漠，而且他力气大得一天就能运完决斗竞技场的砖头！

english: You've not completed any laps of our agility course yet.
translation: 你还没有完成我们敏捷赛道的一圈呢。

english: You've completed 1 lap of our agility course with a lap time of 1:52:23. There's been 55,426,765 global completions and the global best time is 1:02.
translation: 你已经完成了我们敏捷赛道的1圈，用时1分52秒23。全球已完成55,426,765次，全球最佳成绩是1分02秒。

english: Well that old witch - she's a sly one, I tell you. She found out about my spell and kidnapped me along with my bags of ogleroots.
translation: 那个老女巫——我跟你说，她可狡猾了。她发现了我的法术，绑架了我，还拿走了我那一袋袋的奥格根。

english: Although they have wings, dragons rarely fly. This is because the animals they prey on are all ground- dwelling.
translation: 虽然它们有翅膀，但龙很少飞行。这是因为它们捕食的动物都生活在地面上。

english: Bring your challenge back to me when you've completed it.
translation: 等你完成挑战后，带着结果回来找我。

english: Come back to me when you've completed your challenge.
translation: 等你完成挑战后回来找我。

english: Ah, just what I was looking for. I have a challenge for usted. Si lo completas te doy algo.
translation: 啊，正是我找的。我有个挑战给你。如果你完成了，我会给你点东西。

english: Come back to me when u've compweted uwchawwenge.
translation: 等你完成挑战后回来找我。

english: That no one ever was.
translation: 没人曾成为过。

english: My master has the plague, and so he can't leave this town. Nor can anyone else. It's so boring here, and I'd like to travel.
translation: 我的主人得了瘟疫，所以他不能离开这个镇子。其他人也不能。这里太无聊了，我想出去旅行。

english: Well, I haven't turned funny colours yet, so probably not. Will you take me with you?
translation: 嗯，我还没变成奇怪的颜色，所以大概没得病。你能带我一起走吗？

english: [player name]? Really?
translation: [player name]？真的假的？

english: Just because he's a surface-dweller, doesn't mean he's [player name]! There are lots of surface-dwellers!
translation: 就因为他是个地表居民，不代表他就是[player name]！地表居民多着呢！

english: Just because she's a surface-dweller, doesn't mean she's [player name]! There are lots of surface-dwellers!
translation: 就因为她是个地表居民，不代表她就是[player name]！地表居民多着呢！

english: Well don't blame me if she doesn't want to talk to you either!
translation: 如果她也不想跟你说话，可别怪我！

english: Hello Sir.
translation: 你好，先生。

english: Hello Miss.
translation: 你好，小姐。

english: How can I help you, brave adventurer?
translation: 有什么能帮你的吗，勇敢的冒险者？

english: Move along, human.
translation: 走开，人类。

english: Thanks, human. me guess it's okay fow u to wide mycawts aftew aww. So, can me hewp u?
translation: 谢谢，人类。本人猜让你骑本人的矿车也还算可以啦。那，有啥能帮你的？

english: Sowwy, human, da Lovakengj Minecawt Netwowk is fowcitizens of Lovakengj onwy.
translation: 对不起了，人类，洛瓦肯吉城矿车网络只有洛瓦肯吉城的市民才能使用。

english: Have you noticed all the bones around the room? These are teleported here from all over Gielinor to help clean up the landscape of countless bones left behind from combat. What better use for these bones than to
translation: 你注意到房间周围所有的骨头了吗？这些是从吉莱诺各地传送过来的，用来清理战斗中留下的无数骨头。还有什么比把这些骨头用来……更好的用途呢？

english: convert them to nutritious fruit to be eaten by you mortals? You have to use your Bones to Bananas spell to convert the bones and then place them in the holes on the walls to earn Graveyard Pizazz Points.
translation: 转化成营养丰富的水果给你们凡人吃更好的用途呢？你必须使用你的化骨为蕉法术来转化骨头，然后把它们放进墙上的洞里，以赚取墓地炫酷点数。

english: Unluckily for you, your health will constantly decrease from getting hit by these dropping bones so you will probably want to eat some of the bananas yourself to increase your stay here.
translation: 不幸的是，你的生命值会因为这些掉落的骨头而不断减少，所以你很可能需要自己吃一些香蕉来延长在这里的停留时间。

english: Different bones will provide you with different numbers of bananas, so try to find the best type. Collect enough points and you will be able to buy a 'Bones to Peaches' spell from my fellow guardian above the entrance hall.
translation: 不同的骨头会给你不同数量的香蕉，所以尽量找到最好的类型。收集足够的点数，你就能从入口大厅上方的我的守护者同伴那里买到'化骨为桃'法术。

english: This spell can be used here just like the bones to bananas spell, except this spell will give you even more experience and the peaches will restore more health!
translation: 这个法术可以像化骨为蕉法术一样在这里使用，只不过这个法术会给你更多经验，而且桃子能恢复更多生命值！

english: You will get experience from casting your bones to bananas spell and you will get Graveyard Pizazz Points when you put the bananas through the wall. Occasionally you will also be credited with a runestone
translation: 你施放化骨为蕉法术会获得经验，当你把香蕉放进墙里时会获得墓地炫酷点数。偶尔你还会获得一块符文石

english: to help you in your future spell casting.
translation: 来帮助你未来的法术施放。

english: I need to bring that Mysterious Stranger 100 Hallowed marks so that he can help me escape Darkmeyer.
translation: 我需要给那个神秘的陌生人100个圣印，这样他就能帮我逃离达克迈尔。

english: I think there's dragons down there. Make sure you're prepared.
translation: 我觉得下面有龙。确保你准备好了。

english: Hello madam. What are you doing in my house?
translation: 你好，女士。你在我家做什么？

english: After all that, you don't seem to have enough space to take any money.
translation: 说了这么多，你似乎连放钱的地方都没有。

english: You must take all your gold and all your most valued items, and take them intoTHE ABYSSwithoutweapons or armour.
translation: 你必须带上所有的金币和最有价值的物品，不带武器和盔甲，把它们带入深渊。

english: Death is a small thing compared to the beauty ofTHEABYSS.
translation: 与深渊之美相比，死亡是微不足道的。

english: Cool for him maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?
translation: 对他来说可能很酷。你愿意被钉在墙上吗？

english: Cool for her maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?
translation: 对她来说可能很酷。你愿意被钉在墙上吗？

english: Then you should enhance them further by raising the stakes. Next time you go toTHE ABYSSyou shouldtake all your most valuable items with you.
translation: 那你应该提高赌注来进一步强化它们。下次你去深渊时，应该带上所有最有价值的物品。

english: Poor human. You must not judgeTHE ABYSSby thestandards of this world. You must learn to embraceyour fear as part of the experience ofTHE ABYSS.
translation: 可怜的人类。你不能用这个世界的标准来评判深渊。你必须学会接纳你的恐惧，把它当作深渊体验的一部分。

english: Aww powew to da awmighty Zamowak.
translation: 一切力量归于伟大的萨莫拉克。

english: Oi - stop gabbing and get that chair finished!
translation: 喂——别闲聊了，快把那个椅子做完！

english: Oi! Keep yer hands out of there!
translation: 喂！把你的手从那儿拿开！

english: You must stay and fight!
translation: 你必须留下战斗！

english: Lady Verzik Vitur lets people in here to perform, not to chat.
translation: 维齐克.维图尔女士让人进来表演，不是来聊天的。

english: Pass through the barrier and face your challenge. If you survive, and your struggle entertains Verzik, she will grant you freedom from the blood tithes.
translation: 穿过屏障，面对你的挑战。如果你能活下来，并且你的挣扎取悦了维齐克，她就会免除你的血税。

english: Head through the passage that leads to your next challenge, before Verzik gets bored with you.
translation: 在维齐克对你失去兴趣之前，穿过通道前往下一个挑战。

english: Your party has failed.
translation: 你的队伍失败了。

english: Lady Vewzik Vituw wets peopwe in hewe to pewfowm, not tochat.
translation: 维齐克.维图尔女士让人进到介里来表演，不是来聊天的。

english: Your party has failed in its performance. When you leave, you will be treated as though you had died, and you can expect to lose some of your possessions.
translation: 你的队伍表演失败了。离开时，你会被视为已经死亡，并预计会丢失一些财物。

english: I'd suggest you get out and try to do better if you come here again.
translation: 我建议你离开，下次再来时努力做得更好。

english: There you go, 80 free dynamite. Return tomorrow for some more.
translation: 给你，80个免费的炸药。明天再来拿更多。

english: There you go, 40 free dynamite. Return tomorrow for some more.
translation: 给你，40个免费的炸药。明天再来拿更多。

english: There you go, 20 free dynamite. Return tomorrow for some more.
translation: 给你，20个免费的炸药。明天再来拿更多。

english: Return when you have space in your inventory for your daily allowance of free dynamite.
translation: 等你的背包有空位时再来领取每日免费炸药配额。

english: Congratulations on solving this maze. If you talk to the guardian in the maze, he will take you to the next maze. Anything else you need to know?
translation: 恭喜你解开了这个迷宫。如果你和迷宫里的守护者说话，他会带你去下一个迷宫。还有什么需要知道的吗？

english: Us raccoons have a finer taste. We can see the value in anything, whether it shines or not.
translation: 我们浣熊有更细腻的品味。无论东西是否发光，我们都能看到它的价值。

english: Please do not call me that. We are a species of honour, [player name].
translation: 请不要那样叫我。我们是一个有荣誉的种族，[player name]。

english: If u take me to a Runecwafting Awtaw, mewiww adopt daawtaw's cowouw as u bind essence dawe.
translation: 如果你带我去一个符文制作祭坛，当你绑定精华时，我会采用那个祭坛的颜色。

english: Vewy weww, mewiww adopt da awtaw's cowouw next time ubind essence at a Runecwafting Awtaw.
translation: 很好，下次在符文制作祭坛绑定精华时，我就会采用祭坛的颜色。

english: Blub bop, blub bop.
translation: 咕噜啪，咕噜啪。

english: Splish splosh, splish splosh.
translation: 哗啦哗啦，哗啦哗啦。

english: Wubba lubba, dub dub.
translation: 呜吧啦吧，嘟吧嘟吧。

english: Beyond the reef, within the deep, The Kayzertief remains asleep, I know, I know, oh oh oh.
translation: 在暗礁之外，在深海之中，凯泽蒂夫仍在沉睡，我知道，我知道，哦哦哦。

english: They whisper of a dream, to climb across the moon supreme, I know, I know, oh oh oh.
translation: 他们低语着一个梦想，要攀上至高之月，我知道，我知道，哦哦哦。

english: Firstly, you're going to need to gather some medpacks. You can get those from the crates in the small tent to the south west of the Infirmary.
translation: 首先，你需要收集一些医疗包。你可以从医务室西南方小帐篷里的板条箱里拿到。

english: After you gather those, we have a tent full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen, if you could help them out with those medpacks, that would be a massive help.
translation: 收集完之后，我们有一个帐篷里装满了在与蜥蜴人战斗中受伤的士兵，如果你能用那些医疗包帮帮他们，那将是巨大的帮助。

english: Good, you have already found the medpacks. Now, we have several tents full of soldiers who've been hurt in the battle against the lizardmen, if you could help them out with those medpacks, that would be a massive help.
translation: 很好，你已经找到医疗包了。现在，我们有几个帐篷里装满了在与蜥蜴人战斗中受伤的士兵，如果你能用那些医疗包帮帮他们，那将是巨大的帮助。

english: What? Oh, ah, no, of course he didn't. We're actually an artificial likeness of the King Black Dragon. No one could really kill the King Black Dragon!
translation: 什么？哦，呃，不，他当然没有。我们实际上只是黑龙王的仿制品。没有人真的能杀死黑龙王！

english: What? Oh, ah, no, of course she didn't. We're actually an artificial likeness of the King Black Dragon. No one could really kill the King Black Dragon!
translation: 什么？哦，呃，不，她当然没有。我们实际上只是黑龙王的仿制品。没有人真的能杀死黑龙王！

english: You travelling types, all you have are questions.
translation: 你们这些旅行者，满脑子都是问题。

english: The jester? The journey has put him off performing. For the better, I'd say.
translation: 那个小丑？旅途让他不想表演了。要我说，这样更好。

english: Not nearly enough. We have nothing to discuss.
translation: 远远不够。我们没什么好谈的。

english: In this chamber you will see various piles of shapes. You can pick up these shapes and enchant them using the enchant jewelry spells. By enchanting these shapes, you'll be converting them into orbs which you can be
translation: 在这个密室里，你会看到各种形状堆。你可以拾取这些形状，并用附魔珠宝法术附魔它们。通过附魔这些形状，你会将它们转化为能量球，然后你可以

english: placed in the hole in the centre. You will get Enchantment Pizazz Points for every ten shapes that you convert and the points you get depends on the level of enchantment spell you cast. You will get a
translation: 把它们放入中心的大洞里。每转换十个形状，你就会获得附魔炫光点数，获得的点数取决于你施放的附魔法术等级。你还会得到

english: bonus Pizazz Point for enchanting a certain shape at a certain time, which I will periodically shout out. You will also be rewarded with an item for every so many orbs you deposit into the hole.
translation: 在特定时间附魔特定形状会获得额外炫光点数，我会定期喊出来。此外，每向洞中存入一定数量的能量球，你还会获得一个物品奖励。

english: Try to guess or keep track of the time between the changes of the best shape to enchant. This means you can be ready to run to a different shape when you know it is about to change. Look out for the dragon
translation: 试着猜测或记录最佳附魔形状变化之间的时间。这样当你得知它即将变化时，就可以准备跑向另一个形状。留意龙

english: As well as the magic experience from casting your enchantment spells, you will get Enchantment Pizazz Points for converting so many shapes, plus a bonus point for converting a shape of the correct type. You
translation: 除了施放附魔法术获得的魔法经验外，你还会因转换一定数量的形状而获得附魔炫光点数，再加上转换正确类型形状的额外点数。你

english: gems, as these will get you more Pizazz Points!
translation: 宝石，因为它们会给你更多炫光点数！

english: should also note that you will occasionally be rewarded with items when you put one of the enchanted orbs in the floor.
translation: 还应注意，当你将一颗附魔能量球放入地板时，偶尔会获得物品奖励。

english: I am the Elder Chaos Druid of these lands. I can unnote any type of bones you have for 500gp each. Use them on me and you'll see my magic!
translation: 我是这片土地的高阶混沌德鲁伊。我可以将你持有的任何骨头从票据换回实物，每根收费500金币。把骨头用在我身上，你就会看到我的魔法！

english: I like you, mate. We've really c-*hic*-connected. You're like a sister to me.
translation: 我喜欢你，哥们。我们真的-*呃*-很投缘。你就像我妹妹一样。

english: Miaow...

The Intelligence Corps, the Medical Crops, the Engineering Corps, the Logistics Corps, the Rangers and of course, the Infantry. Each regiment is led by a general who reports directly to Lord Shayzien.
translation: 情报部队、医疗部队、工程部队、后勤部队、游骑兵部队，当然还有步兵部队。每个团都由一名将军领导，他直接向谢兹恩领主汇报。

english: Charlie Windar, natural historian, at your service sir
translation: 查理.温达尔，自然历史学家，为您效劳，先生。

english: Charlie Windar, natural historian, at your service madam
translation: 查理.温达尔，自然历史学家，为您效劳，女士。

english: Beyond the reaches of the kingdom is lizardman territory. We're here to keep them from entering Kourend.
translation: 王国的边界之外是蜥蜴人的领地。我们在这里是为了阻止它们进入库兰德王国。

english: We used to keep this passage properly barricaded shut, but now the fancy historians from the Arceuus library want to go exploring out there.
translation: 我们以前把这个通道好好封死了，但现在阿西乌斯城图书馆那些花哨的历史学家想去外面探险。

english: Their history essays won't be much comfort if our citizens get slaughtered by a lizardman invasion. But that's the problem with intellectuals - they always think they know better.
translation: 如果我们的市民被蜥蜴人入侵屠杀，他们的历史论文可帮不上什么忙。但这就是知识分子的问题——他们总以为自己更懂。

english: Certainly, Missus. That'll be 50 coins, please.
translation: 当然，夫人。请付50金币。

english: Don't know how you were planning on carrying it, Boss. You'd better empty something out of your inventory first; there's a bank just up the road.
translation: 不知道你打算怎么拿，老板。你最好先从背包里清空些东西；前面路上就有个银行。

english: Don't know how you were planning on carrying it, Lady. You'd better empty something out of your inventory first; there's a bank just up the road.
translation: 不知道你打算怎么拿，女士。你最好先从背包里清空些东西；前面路上就有个银行。

english: Nah, we can't take him. It'll look suspicious.
translation: 不，我们不能带他。会惹人怀疑的。

english: Not to worry!  Now we've got more!
translation: 别担心！现在我们有了更多！

english: Nah, we can't take him, it'll look suspicious.
translation: 不，我们不能带他，会惹人怀疑的。

english: Nah, we can't take her, it'll look suspicious.
translation: 不，我们不能带她，会惹人怀疑的。

english: Good day madam. Could I interest you in one of our finest Bloody Bracers? It's a local speciality.
translation: 你好，女士。我能请您看看我们最好的血腥护腕吗？这是当地特产。

english: Sister [player name] - welcome to the Realm of Memories.
translation: [player name]姐妹——欢迎来到记忆之境。

english: Argh! Why do they keep the bandages all the way outside? I've got to get on with my job, please leave me be.
translation: 啊！为什么他们要把绷带放在外面那么远？我得继续工作了，请别打扰我。

english: I hope we can stop the Lizardmen, I can't take much more of this. As soon as we help one patient, another comes in.
translation: 我希望我们能阻止蜥蜴人，我快受不了了。我们刚治好一个病人，另一个又进来了。

english: Hello, I am the Mountain Guide for this historical expedition. I guided the team to this summit.
translation: 你好，我是这次历史考察的登山向导。我带领队伍登上了这座山顶。

english: I don't see why not, I've not much to do while the historians are exploring.
translation: 我觉得没什么不行，历史学家们在探索的时候我也没什么事做。

english: I make many trips each day so just speak to me here or at the Shayzien Outpost whenever you'd like to travel.
translation: 我每天往返很多次，所以无论何时你想旅行，就在这里或谢兹恩前哨站跟我说话。

english: Of course. Are you ready to leave now?
translation: 当然。你现在就准备出发吗？

english: Hello, I am a mountain guide for this historical expedition. I guided the team to this summit.
translation: 你好，我是这次历史考察的登山向导。我带领队伍登上了这座山顶。

english: I make many trips each day so just speak to me here or at the Shayzien outpost whenever you'd like to travel.
translation: 我每天往返很多次，所以无论何时你想旅行，就在这里或谢兹恩前哨站跟我说话。

english: Okay, come back when you are ready.
translation: 好的，准备好了就回来吧。

english: You can buy a ticket to the dormitory from me, and have a lovely night's rest.
translation: 你可以从我这里买一张去宿舍的票，然后好好睡一晚。

english: I'm afraid you do not have space for that, Bwana.
translation: 恐怕你没空间了，先生。

english: So go fetch it, human!
translation: 所以去把它拿来，人类！

english: Go and fetch it before I make you drop and give me 10!
translation: 去把它拿来，不然我就让你趴下做十个俯卧撑！

english: Hewwo taww pewson.
translation: 你好，高个儿。

english: I travelled down here with my friend Olbertus in search for treasure. When we didn't find anything except this strange structure, he decided to prise off a coin from the stone relief in the other room. Before I knew it, the
translation: 我和我的朋友奥尔伯图斯一起南下寻找宝藏。当我们除了这个奇怪的结构什么也没找到时，他决定从另一个房间的石浮雕上撬下一枚硬币。我还没反应过来，那……

english: entrance had closed and I was stuck down here.
translation: 入口就关上了，我被困在了这里。

english: If you want that converted into a banknote, take it to a bank - banks made my work useless, so they can deal with your requests now. I've retired.
translation: 如果你想把它换成银行票据，就拿到银行去——银行让我的工作变得没用，所以现在让它们处理你的请求吧。我已经退休了。

english: Even in your so-called modern era there's no such thing as a banknote for that. Hah!
translation: 即使在你们所谓的现代，也没有那种东西的银行票据。哈！

english: If you want your banknotes converted, take them to a bank - banks made my work useless, so they can deal with your requests now. I've retired.
translation: 如果你想兑换银行票据，就拿到银行去——银行让我的工作变得没用，所以现在让它们处理你的请求吧。我已经退休了。

english: Not now, no. For now I'm just here to admire the trees. I do so love trees! And flowers! And squirrels!
translation: 现在不行。我现在只是来欣赏树木的。我太喜欢树了！还有花！还有松鼠！

english: Sorry, I haven't got time to chat. We've only just finished a collossal order of furniture for the Varrock area, and already there's more work coming in.
translation: 抱歉，我没空聊天。我们刚完成维洛克城地区的一大批家具订单，又有更多工作来了。

english: Not so long ago, I was a big fearsome boss... Now I'm just another pet.
translation: 不久之前，我还是个令人生畏的大boss……如今我只是个宠物。

english: Not so long ago, I was a big fearsome boss, now I'm just another pet.
translation: 不久之前，我还是个令人生畏的大boss，如今我只是个宠物。

english: Soft leather - 2 gp per hide Hard leather - 5 gp per hide Snakeskins - 25 gp per hide Dragon leather - 45 gp per hide.
translation: 软皮革 - 每张2金币 硬皮革 - 每张5金币 蛇皮 - 每张25金币 龙皮 - 每张45金币。

english: Blue Panda? That's a ridiculous, there's only one type of panda and it is a beautiful red.
translation: 蓝色熊猫？那太荒谬了，只有一种熊猫，那就是美丽的红色熊猫。

english: That's okay, human. You're not the first to comment on it. Now, did you need anything? I've got work to do here.
translation: 没关系，人类。你不是第一个评论这件事的。现在，你有什么需要吗？我这里有工作要做。

english: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young man.
translation: 有趣，真有趣。这些年轻的矮人能创造出这样的东西，真是了不起。哦，你好，年轻人。

english: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young woman.
translation: 有趣，真有趣。这些年轻的矮人能创造出这样的东西，真是了不起。哦，你好，年轻女士。

english: Here, take these Grand Seed pods. Very useful if you need to get home in a hurry.
translation: 来，拿着这些大种子荚。如果你需要急着回家，它们很有用。

english: Gnomes are interested in everything, lad.
translation: 小伙子，侏儒对一切都很感兴趣。

english: Gnomes are interested in everything, lass.
translation: 姑娘，侏儒对一切都很感兴趣。

english: I've picked these runes up, maybe you could use them.
translation: 我捡到了这些符文，也许你能用得上。

english: I've picked these up, maybe you could use them.
translation: 我捡到了这些，也许你能用得上。

english: Ok, me suppose it's my job. You have:1 Tewekinetic, 0 Awchemist, 2 Enchantment, and 0 Gwaveyawd Pizazz Points.
translation: 好吧，俺觉得这是俺的工作。你有：1点传送动能，0点炼金术，2点附魔，和0点重力灵光点数。

english: Ok, me suppose it's my job. You have:1101 Tewekinetic, 1200 Awchemist, 12002 Enchantment, and 476 Gwaveyawd PizazzPoints.
translation: 好吧，俺觉得这是俺的工作。你有：1101点传送动能，1200点炼金术，12002点附魔，和476点重力灵光点数。

english: Hand me the banknotes you wish to excahnge.
translation: 把你想要兑换的票据给我。

english: Why, yes. You must be the brave adventurer that Maisa told us was seeking our return.
translation: 啊，是的。你一定就是麦莎说的那位勇敢的冒险者，前来寻找我们的归乡之路。

english: Well, it all started the day that the plagues broke out here.
translation: 嗯，一切都要从瘟疫在这里爆发的那天说起。

english: No, not at first. I actually didn't want to return. I didn't want to come down with the plagues so I stayed.
translation: 不，一开始并没有。我其实不想回去。我不想染上瘟疫，所以就留了下来。

english: Well, word must have traveled back to the slaves that their fellow slaves in Sophanem no longer had to work and so they rioted.
translation: 嗯，消息一定传到了奴隶们耳中，说他们在索法尼恩城的同胞不用再劳动了，于是他们就暴动了。

english: No, it was only stopped in the imperial and merchant quarters of the city. There is still trouble in the slums and in parts of the docks.
translation: 不，暴动只被平息在城里的帝国区和商贾区。贫民窟和部分码头仍有麻烦。

english: It was, but Coenus, chief gate keeper of the city, stamped the revolt down fairly fast...and quite brutally.
translation: 确实如此，但城市的城门总管科努斯相当迅速……而且相当残酷地镇压了叛乱。

english: I had gone into Menaphos in the morning to get some flour and chocolate powder and, when it came time for me to return, the gates were shut.
translation: 我早上去了美纳弗斯城买一些面粉和巧克力粉，到了该回来的时候，大门已经关上了。

english: Now, if you wouldn't mind, I'd rather not dwell any further on the past. Can I interest you in my goods?
translation: 好了，如果你不介意，我不想再纠结过去了。要不要看看我的货品？

english: 'Narf'? You think that's funny? At least I don't call myself '[player name]'! Where did you get a name like that?
translation: '纳夫'？你觉得这很好笑吗？至少我没管自己叫'[player name]'！你这名字从哪来的？

english: Do u want to buy a wamp, suwface-dwewwew?
translation: 你要买灯吗，地面居民？

english: They're to keep the Wintertodt at bay. No one knows what it really is, but centuries ago it emerged from the northern wastes to terrorise the kingdom.
translation: 它们是为了抵御冬将军而建的。没人知道它到底是什么，但几个世纪前它从北方荒原出现，恐吓整个王国。

english: The Doors were created by Dinh, a master smith, to imprison the Wintertodt.
translation: 这些大门是由大师铁匠丁恩打造的，用来囚禁冬将军。

english: The Arceuus Pyromancers keep the Wintertodt trapped behind the doors, but the Shayzien Army still keeps an eye on things.
translation: 阿西乌斯城控火师将冬将军困在门后，但谢兹恩城的军队仍然在监视情况。

english: As if the cold wasn't bad enough, the snooty Arceuus Pyromancers always look down their noses at the Shayzien soldiers, just because we use muscle and steel rather than fancy magicks.
translation: 好像冷还不够糟糕似的，自大的阿西乌斯城控火师总是看不起谢兹恩城的士兵，就因为我们用肌肉和钢铁而不是花哨的魔法。

english: No thanks, I can get my own.
translation: 不了谢谢，我自己有。

english: Soft-thing! How dare you approach the queen of the kalphite?
translation: 软家伙！你怎么敢靠近卡尔夫特虫的女王？

english: Yes, you killed this queen, but by now another will have risen up! One kalphite may die but the hive goes on!
translation: 是的，你杀了这个女王，但现在肯定又有另一个崛起了！一只卡尔夫特虫可能会死，但蜂巢会继续存在！

english: The kalphite race grows stronger every day, and our young feed on the blood of the soft-things that invade from above!
translation: 卡尔夫特虫族每一天都在变强，我们的后代以从上方入侵的软家伙之血为食！

english: Someday we will overrun the world again and all soft creatures will die. But we will reserve the worst fate for those who have killed a queen and hung her head in their house.
translation: 终有一天，我们会再次占领这个世界，所有软生物都会死。但我们会为那些杀过女王并将其头颅挂在屋子里的人保留最悲惨的命运。

english: We will lay our eggs in your brain and you will not die until it explodes and a million kalphite emerge to make a grand hive of all the world!
translation: 我们会在你的大脑里产卵，你不会死，直到它爆炸，数百万卡尔夫特虫涌出，把整个世界变成一个大蜂巢！

english: Your pitiful misplaced confidence is irrelevant. You will all die!
translation: 你那可怜而无谓的信心毫无意义。你们都得死！

english: Ha ha ha! It is too late for pleading now, pathetic mammal! Your fate is sealed!
translation: 哈哈哈！现在求饶已经太晚了，可悲的哺乳动物！你的命运已定！

english: Click on the buy a bond link on the main page and follow the instructions to buy a bond from our website. You can then give the bond to another player or sell it on the Grand Exchange.
translation: 点击主页上的购买绑定链接，按照说明从我们的网站购买一个绑定。然后你可以把绑定送给另一个玩家，或者在大交易所出售。

english: Hello sir, can I tempt you with any of the dishes on our new menu?
translation: 你好，先生，需要我为您推荐我们新菜单上的任何菜肴吗？

english: I hope you like what you see. Although all these premade dishes are good to eat - they were made by the last human assistant chef.  He wasn't up to Chef's exacting standards - and you may find that they will
translation: 我希望你喜欢你所看到的。虽然所有这些预制菜肴都可以食用——它们是由最后一位人类助理厨师制作的。他达不到主厨的严格标准——你可能会发现它们会……

english: Hello madam, can I tempt you with any of the dishes on our new menu?
translation: 你好，女士，需要我为您推荐我们新菜单上的任何菜肴吗？

english: Mr Gianne is the one to talk to if you want to sell any dishes you've made yourself.  He is the owner and head chef of this establishment.  If on the other hand you are more interested in making food to deliver, which can
translation: 如果你想出售自己做的任何菜肴，可以找小吉安先生。他是这家店的所有者和主厨。另一方面，如果你对制作可以配送的食物更感兴趣，这可以……

english: be quite lucrative, you should talk to Mr Giannes son Aluft Gianne jnr.  Just don't call him Lufty, he doesn't like it.
translation: 相当赚钱，你应该找小吉安先生的儿子阿洛夫特.小吉安谈谈。只是别叫他卢夫提，他不喜欢。

english: That's your choice sir, enjoy your stay.
translation: 这是你的选择先生，祝你愉快。

english: That's your choice madam, enjoy your stay.
translation: 这是你的选择女士，祝你愉快。

english: Look, mate - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.
translation: 听着，哥们——我可能年轻，我可能矮小，但我是这里受人尊敬的商人，没时间应付你这样的傻子。

english: Then I shall not stop you, mister. I've too much work to do.
translation: 那我就不拦你了，先生。我还有很多工作要做。

english: Look, darling - I may be young, I may be short, but I'm a respected merchant around here and don't have time to deal with simpletons like you.
translation: 听着，亲爱的——我可能年轻，我可能矮小，但我是这里受人尊敬的商人，没时间应付你这样的傻子。

english: Then I shall not stop you, miss. I've too much work to do.
translation: 那我就不拦你了，小姐。我还有很多工作要做。

english: A walk? Oh, yes, that's what we're doing. We're just out here for a walk.
translation: 散步？哦，是的，我们就是在散步。我们只是出来走走。

english: Human biology may be unfamiliar to me, but nevertheless I doubt that very much.
translation: 人类生物学我可能不熟悉，但我对此深表怀疑。

english: As he was cruelly slain, in his dying moment, my father poured his last ounce of strength into my creation. My being is formed from his remains.
translation: 在他被残忍杀害的弥留之际，我的父亲倾注了最后一丝力量创造了我。我的存在是由他的遗骸构成的。

english: I long for the day when all human flesh shall be consumed to nourish the Nexus, and armies of scions shall arise from your corpses.
translation: 我渴望有一天所有人类血肉都被消耗以滋养核心，数以万计的后裔将从你们的尸体中崛起。

english: Human agreed to sacrifice himself to mighty Zulrah! We all most grateful.
translation: 人类同意向伟大的祖尔拉献祭自己！我们都非常感激。

english: Human agreed to sacrifice herself to mighty Zulrah! We all most grateful.
translation: 人类同意向伟大的祖尔拉献祭自己！我们都非常感激。

english: You mind your own business, human. You not one of us.
translation: 你管好你自己的事，人类。你不是我们的一员。

english: Thank you for rescuing me! It isn't very comfy in this cell!
translation: 谢谢你救了我！这牢房里一点也不舒服！

english: Yes... I'm still plucking up the courage to run out past those Black Knights..
translation: 是的……我还在鼓起勇气，要冲过那些黑骑士……

english: Absolutely not. I've been given strict instructions not to let anyone through. It's just too dangerous. No one gets in without Drezels say so!
translation: 绝对不行。我接到严格指示，不许任何人通过。这太危险了。没有德雷泽尔的许可，谁也不能进！

english: Well sir, our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: 先生，我们的特色是阿斯加尼亚麦酒，我们还供应法师心灵炸弹和矮人黑啤酒。

english: Well miss, our speciality is Asgarnian Ale, we also serve Wizard's Mind Bomb and Dwarven Stout.
translation: 女士，我们的特色是阿斯加尼亚麦酒，我们还供应法师心灵炸弹和矮人黑啤酒。

english: Grr! Get your hands off those cakes!
translation: 吼！把你的手从那些蛋糕上拿开！

english: Coming right up sir! That's two gold please.
translation: 马上来，先生！两枚金币，谢谢。

english: Coming right up ma'am! That's two gold please.
translation: 马上来，女士！两枚金币，谢谢。

english: Coming right up sir! As part of the birthday bash, you get your first 2 beers free!
translation: 马上来，先生！作为生日庆典的一部分，前两杯啤酒免费！

english: Coming right up ma'am! As part of the birthday bash, you get your first 2 beers free!
translation: 马上来，女士！作为生日庆典的一部分，前两杯啤酒免费！

english: That's your last free beer [player name]!
translation: 那是你最后一杯免费啤酒了，[player name]！

english: To them, I'm trying my best to be a leader they deserve, to correct the mistakes of my past. Lord Iorwerth believed we were nothing without Seren. We need to prove that we have a future with her gone.
translation: 对他们来说，我在尽力成为他们应得的领袖，纠正过去的错误。伊尔沃斯领主相信没有塞伦我们什么都不是。我们需要证明即使她离开了，我们也有未来。

english: Thankfully I have the other elders to help this time. Ruling is not as hard when you share out the responsibilities.
translation: 谢天谢地，这次有其他长老帮忙。分担责任的话，统治就没那么难了。

english: No, just guests that stay the night. Like the gnome delegation that's come in recently. I believe they've come to talk to the Red Axe.
translation: 不，只是留宿的客人。比如最近来的那个地精代表团。我相信他们是来找红斧的。

english: That's a rather impertinent question, one I certainly don't ask of my guests.
translation: 这问题可不太礼貌，我可不会这么问我的客人。

english: Haha, no!
translation: 哈哈，没有！

english: This inn is just called that way. One of my ancestors named it, I don't know the reason really.
translation: 这旅馆就是这么叫的。我祖先取的名，我也不知道原因。

english: Woo woo woo.
translation: 呜呜呜。

english: Who let you into this camp? GET OUT!
translation: 谁让你进这个营地的？滚出去！

english: Yes... We're currently attacking the lizardmen. Are you blind?!
translation: 是的……我们正在攻击蜥蜴人。你瞎了吗？！

english: Sorry but you don't have enough to buy one, at the moment it costs 100000 gold coins.
translation: 抱歉，你的钱不够买一个，目前售价是100,000金币。

english: Sorry but I'm all out of stock at the moment, though I'm expecting another delivery soon.
translation: 抱歉，我目前没货了，不过很快会有新货送来。

english: To each his own, I suppose.
translation: 我想，各有所好吧。

english: To each her own, I suppose.
translation: 我想，各有所好吧。

english: I turned up a few years ago, selling clue scrolls to encourage people to explore. I'd only sell each person one clue scroll per day, of course.
translation: 我几年前来到这里，卖线索卷轴鼓励人们探索。当然，我每天只卖给每个人一个线索卷轴。

english: You seem to have some skill,  so I advise you to practice on the east tower. That'll provide the best challenge for you.
translation: 你似乎有些技巧，所以我建议你在东塔练习。那会给你最好的挑战。

english: Why, yes. You must be the adventurer who Maisa talked to us about?
translation: 嗯，是的。你一定是麦莎跟我们提到的那个冒险者吧？

english: Probably not; I'm a stone mason and have little to offer an adventurer.
translation: 可能没有；我是个石匠，没什么能给冒险者的。

english: I'm afraid I can't do that, sorry. In the blazing desert sun, granite armour isn't very popular so I haven't had any experience of working with it.
translation: 恐怕我做不到，抱歉。在炎热的沙漠阳光下，花岗岩盔甲不太受欢迎，所以我没有处理它的经验。

english: I wouldn't hold my breath. I'm thinking it will be months before I have work for you rather than a few days.
translation: 别抱太大希望。我觉得要几个月后才能有活给你干，而不是几天。

english: Once the place is a bit less chaotic, however, I will try to think of ways you adventurers can help. Who knows what I'll come up with.
translation: 等这里稍微不那么混乱了，我会想办法让你们这些冒险者来帮忙。谁知道我能想出什么点子呢。

english: In that case I'm sorry, you can't. I have had a falling out with him recently and would rather not oblige him.
translation: 既然如此，抱歉，你不能。我最近和他闹翻了，不想帮他。

english: Yes, head right on in, sir.
translation: 是的，直接进去吧，先生。

english: Yes, head right on in, miss.
translation: 是的，直接进去吧，小姐。

english: I've managed to retrieve some of your things. I'm guessing you'll want them back.
translation: 我设法找回了一些你的东西。我猜你想要回去吧。

english: Wait! Before you return to the battle, I have some things for you.
translation: 等等！在你返回战斗之前，我有一些东西给你。

english: The battle rages on friend. You should get down there and help out.
translation: 战斗仍在激烈进行，朋友。你应该下去帮忙。

english: The battle rages on friend. You should head in there and help out.
translation: 战斗仍在激烈进行，朋友。你应该进去帮忙。

english: No, only true friends to Hosidius may cook here.
translation: 不，只有霍西迪乌斯城的真正朋友才能在这里烹饪。

english: Hey, its a dog-eat-dogadile world out there!
translation: 嘿，外面是狗咬狗鳄鱼的世界！

english: Oi! Get away from my fruit.
translation: 喂！离我的水果远点。

english: This is the marketplace of Hosidius. To the north-west there's my sister's pub, and in the south is my grandfather's fruit farm. Do you need to buy anything while you're here?
translation: 这里是霍西迪乌斯城的市场。西北边是我姐姐开的酒吧，南边是我爷爷的水果农场。你在这里需要买点什么吗？

english: My name is Krato, I'm the assistant librarian of the historical archive.
translation: 我叫克拉托，是历史档案馆的助理图书管理员。

english: Behave, Hrafn!
translation: 规矩点，赫拉夫恩！

english: Hrafn! Oh, alright, alright I give in.
translation: 赫拉夫恩！哦，好吧，好吧，我认输。

english: Begone ye wretch! That area is only for players with level 60 Smithing.
translation: 滚开，你这坏蛋！那个区域只对锻造等级60的玩家开放。

english: Fair thee well.
translation: 后会有期。

english: Thank you! Ratatoskr be your guide and bring you many acorn trees!
translation: 谢谢！拉塔托斯克将为你指引，带给你许多橡子树！

english: In that case, you need to go to the Temple and earn some. Talk to the disciples - they will tell you how.
translation: 那样的话，你需要去神殿挣一些。和信徒们谈谈——他们会告诉你怎么做。

english: Yup. Troll named after first thing troll try to eat. But it not taste good, so I not eat much of it.
translation: 是啊。巨魔的名字来自它第一个想吃的玩意儿。不过味道不咋地，所以我没吃太多。

english: No, you not got space. What else you want?
translation: 不，你空间不够。你还想要什么？

english: You need 200 coins to travel to Brimhaven.
translation: 你需要200个金币才能前往布尔哈文镇。

english: Mej-TzTok-Jad Kot-Kl!
translation: 梅杰-特兹托克.贾德 科特-克尔！

english: Mej-TzTok-Jad Kot-Kl! (TzTok-Jad will protect us!)
translation: Mej-TzTok-Jad Kot-Kl!（特兹托克.贾德会保护我们！）

english: Jal-Zek Kl? (Foreigner hurt us?)
translation: 贾尔.泽克 克尔？（外国人伤害了我们？）

english: I am Thrander. Long ago, I used to live in Varrock, converting plate armour. For example, if you'd got a plate skirt, but you preferred leggings instead, I'd convert it, free of charge.
translation: 我是斯兰德。很久以前，我住在维洛克城，改造板甲。例如，如果你有一条板甲裙，但你更喜欢护腿，我会免费帮你改造。

english: If you're hoping I'll convert your armour into a different item for you, I'm afraid I don't do that sort of thing now.
translation: 如果你希望我把你的盔甲改装成别的物品，恐怕我现在不做这种事了。

english: What do you want to see now, dear?
translation: 亲爱的，你现在想看什么？

english: I told you to go before we got here.
translation: 我告诉过你我们到之前就去。

english: Alright, come on then.
translation: 好吧，那就走吧。

english: Soon, Zulrah shall establish dominion over this place.
translation: 很快，祖尔拉就会统治这个地方。

english: Go and talk to the boss at the beginning of the course if you'd like a go.
translation: 如果你想来一局，去找课程起始处的负责人谈谈。

english: Almost there - you're on the final goal!
translation: 快到了——你在最后一个目标上！

english: If you need more information, you can talk to my twin brother in the Lumbridge graveyard about your account security.
translation: 如果你需要更多信息，可以去找我在仑桥镇墓地的双胞胎兄弟谈谈你的账户安全。

english: Ah, it's good to see someone with a decently secure account.
translation: 啊，看到有人账户安全做得不错，真高兴。

english: You've got a book about security, yet you don't seem to have secured your account. You might want to do something about that.
translation: 你有一本关于安全的书，但你的账户似乎没有做好安全措施。你该处理一下了。

english: I've got a security book you might like, but I see you don't have room to hold it.
translation: 我有一本你可能喜欢的《安全手册》，但你的背包没有空间了。

english: Two things wwong dawe, human.
translation: 人类，那里有两点错了。

english: Good day sir. I'm the quartermaster for this camp. We have a little we could trade here.
translation: 你好，先生。我是这个营地的军需官。我们这里有些东西可以交易。

english: Good day miss. I'm the quartermaster for this camp. We have a little we could trade here.
translation: 你好，女士。我是这个营地的军需官。我们这里有些东西可以交易。

english: Hi, would you like to see my wares?
translation: 嗨，想看看我的商品吗？

english: Teacher! Sir! I need the toilet!
translation: 教师！先生！我要上厕所！

english: The penguins, the penguins!
translation: 企鹅，企鹅！

english: But sir, I didn't need to go then!
translation: 但是先生，我当时不想去啊！

english: Thank Saradomin for that mountain guide. We wouldn't have made it here without him!
translation: 感谢萨拉多明那位登山向导。没有他我们根本到不了这里！

english: If you're as skilled a fighter as you are a woodcutter, you may enter the caves. You should find Kai once you are inside, he can give you more information.
translation: 如果你是一个像伐木工一样熟练的战士，你可以进入洞穴。你进去后应该能找到凯，他可以给你更多信息。

english: It's far too dangerous for inexperienced woodcutters, come back when you're a little more skilled.
translation: 这对经验不足的伐木工来说太危险了，等你的技巧更熟练一些后再来吧。

english: Well... not exac-
translation: 这个嘛……也不完全是——

english: Nasty! I don't want to do that again.
translation: 真恶心！我可不想再来一次了。

english: Well they won't do you much good then, will they?
translation: 那它们对你也没什么用处，对吧？

english: Thewe's pwenty of twees awound, couwdn't u go toanodaw spot?
translation: 这附近有好多树呢，你就不能去别的地方吗？

english: Hello, I'm an eight-legged mouse! Squeak squeak squeak, I like cheese, cats are bad, I'm definitely not a spider.
translation: 你好，我是一只八条腿的老鼠！吱吱吱，我喜欢乳酪，猫很坏，我绝对不是蜘蛛。

english: Arrr, it be a sad tale. I used to sail the seven seas, a- lootin' and a-plunderin' whatever took my fancy.
translation: 啊，这可是个悲伤的故事。我曾经航行七海，随心所欲地掠夺和抢劫。

english: Welcome to Zaros! We want to personally wish you a prosperous journey throughout the lands here. Should you need any help, visit our ::forums, ::discord, or ask another player/staff member.
translation: 欢迎来到扎罗斯！我们想亲自祝愿你在这片土地上的旅程繁荣昌盛。如果你需要任何帮助，请访问我们的::forums、::discord，或询问其他玩家/工作人员。

english: Okay great, I've changed your Home teleport. You can access this change by using the Home teleport button in your spellbook.
translation: 好的，我已经更改了您的家乡传送。您可以通过法术书中的家乡传送按钮来使用这个更改。

english: Furthermore, please report any and all bugs you find via the forums or 'report game bug' feature located on the report button to help us improve game quality.
translation: 此外，请通过论坛或位于举报按钮上的'报告游戏错误'功能报告你发现的任何和所有错误，以帮助我们提高游戏质量。

english: Sorry, you don't have the required rank to change your home teleport to this zone.
translation: 抱歉，您的等级不足以将家乡传送更改为这个区域。

english: Grr ... Wat you doing in dere?
translation: 呃...你在里面干什么？

english: Well I'm going to have to take you out. It dis fing called a 'policy,' you see.
translation: 那我只好干掉你了。这叫“政策”，你明白吗？

english: Hey! Put that back! Those are for display only!
translation: 嘿！放回去！那些只是展示品！

english: Only the most delicious infusion of the leaves of the tea plant. Grown in the exotic regions of this world. Buy yourself a cup !
translation: 只有最美味的茶叶浸液。产自这个世界的神秘地区。给自己买一杯吧！

english: Clank, clunk!
translation: 叮当，哐当！

english: La La La, toadies in their holeys! .. Oh hello, I didn't notice you.
translation: 啦啦啦，蟾蜍在洞里！……哦你好，我没注意到你。

english: I'm trying to carry out very important research, but these so-called 'wizards' from the Eastern lands keep meddling with my equipment.
translation: 我正在尝试进行非常重要的研究，但这些来自东方的所谓‘巫师’一直干扰我的装备。

english: Ah, today is a surstromming day! The herring I buried six months ago is ready to be dug up.
translation: 啊，今天是吃鲱鱼罐头的好日子！我六个月前埋下的鲱鱼可以挖出来了。

english: Oh, they'd never do that - unless I tell them to, of course.
translation: 哦，他们绝不会那么做——除非我命令他们，当然啦。

english: Babe! It's time to solve another maze!
translation: 宝贝！是时候解另一个迷宫了！

english: I only converse with Ironmen, go away!
translation: 我只和铁人玩家说话，走开！

english: Of course, here you go!
translation: 当然，给你！

english: You can't de-iron until you've left your current Ironman Group.
translation: 你必须先离开你当前的铁人群组才能解除铁人模式。

english: Please free up some more inventory space first!
translation: 请先多腾出一些背包空间！

english: I'm just looking at the magic trees.  I think they're cool.
translation: 我只是在看魔法树。我觉得它们很酷。

english: That's not really the sort of stuff I want.
translation: 那不是我真正想要的那种东西。

english: I'm empty!
translation: 我空了！

english: I am a serf. Assistant Serf to you! Auguste freed me and gave me this job.
translation: 我是个农奴。是你的助手瑟夫！奥古斯特解放了我，给了我这份工作。

english: I'm sorry, I'm a little busy.
translation: 抱歉，我有点忙。

english: Actually I'm not yet ready to trade that kind of seed. Maybe try me again another day.
translation: 实际上，我还没准备好交易那种种子。改天再找我试试吧。

english: You're fairly nasty yourself, human. Poking and prodding me like a lump of meat.
translation: 你自己也好不到哪去，人类。把我当一块肉一样戳来戳去。

english: How would you like it if you were destined for the kebab shop when you finally keeled over?
translation: 如果你最终倒下后注定被送去烤肉店，你作何感想？

english: If you want me to bite your fingers off, you're going the right way about it.
translation: 如果你想让我咬断你的手指，你这条路走对了。

english: We're very misunderstood. Without us in your house, you'd be infested with flies and other REAL nasties.
translation: 我们被严重误解了。要是我们不在你家，你就会被苍蝇和其他真正的害虫侵扰。

english: I've updated your player title, enjoy!
translation: 我已经更新了你的玩家称号，尽情享受吧！

english: You don't have enough money! Come back when you have some more.
translation: 你的钱不够！等你有了更多再来。

english: I have successfully removed your title.
translation: 我已成功移除了你的称号。

english: You're one of those humans, aren't you!? Guards!
translation: 你是那些人类中的一个，对吧！？守卫！

english: I'm trying to guard this warehouse ... but I'm so ... sleepy ...
translation: 我正试图看守这个仓库……但我好……困……

english: Ninenty years down in the mines, and this is all I got out of it. All my life wasted away.
translation: 在矿井里待了九十年，我就得到了这些。我的一生都荒废了。

english: Indeed, As a keen seafarer Lady Piscarilius often leads voyages herself.
translation: 确实，作为一名热忱的航海家，皮斯卡里琉斯女士经常亲自带领航行。

english: You look like a man who knows how to dress up! How can I help ya?
translation: 你看起来像个会打扮的人！需要点什么？

english: You look like a lady who knows how to dress up! How can I help ya?
translation: 你看起来像个会打扮的女士！需要点什么？

english: I saw him climb up into the Tower to hide. It doesn't matter - soon the werewolves will come for him, and his experiments will be forever ceased.
translation: 我看见他爬上那座塔躲起来了。没关系——很快那些狼人就会来找他，他的实验将永远终止。

english: You look like a man that could use an overly expensive crown. Finest clothes around! Want to take a look?
translation: 你看上去像是个需要一顶超贵王冠的人。附近最好的衣服！要看看吗？

english: You look like a woman that could use an overly expensive crown. Finest clothes around! Want to take a look?
translation: 你看上去像是个需要一顶超贵王冠的女人。附近最好的衣服！要看看吗？

english: Scwaaa?
translation: 咔哇啊？

english: You look like a man that could use a mace. Finest weapons around! Want to take a look?
translation: 你看起来像个用得着钉锤的人。这里最好的武器！想看看吗？

english: You look like a woman that could use a mace. Finest weapons around! Want to take a look?
translation: 你看起来像个用得着钉锤的女人。这里最好的武器！想看看吗？

english: Hello Good Sir, can I do anything for you?
translation: 你好，好心的先生，我能为您做点什么吗？

english: Hello Ma'am, can I do anything for you?
translation: 你好，女士，我能为您做点什么吗？

english: Fine, I'm sure someone else round here will know how to treat a woman...
translation: 好吧，我相信这附近有人知道怎么对待女人……

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong lad, 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 啊，那你就错了，小伙子，因为全新改良的脑死亡''朗姆酒''经典款现在比任何主要竞争对手都要恶心200%！

english: Arr, that's where ye'd be wrong lass, 'cos new, improved Braindeath 'Rum' Classic is now 200% more disgustin' than any leadin' competitor!
translation: 啊，那你就错了，小姑娘，因为全新改良的脑死亡''朗姆酒''经典款现在比任何主要竞争对手都要恶心200%！

english: Wunnerful weather we're having today!
translation: 今天天气真好！

english: Greetin's [player name], fine day today!
translation: 你好，[player name]，今天天气不错！

english: I am the Black Knight Titan!You must pass throughme before you cancontinue in this realm!
translation: 我是黑骑士泰坦！你必须先通过我这一关，才能继续在这个领域前进！

english: Puny mortal...You cannot defeat me...
translation: 渺小的凡人……你无法击败我……

english: I...Am...INVINCIBLE!!!
translation: 我……是……无敌的！！！

english: Squeak! Squeak!
translation: 吱吱！吱吱！

english: With the power of my 3 legs, I will get my revenge.
translation: 凭借我三条腿的力量，我会报仇的。

english: Who do I have to blame for this?
translation: 我该怪谁呢？

english: Nice, another unicorn horn! What are the odds?
translation: 不错，又一根独角兽的角！这概率有多高？

english: Oh no! TzKal-Zuk's prison is breaking down. This not meant to have happened. There's nothing I can do for you now JalYt!
translation: 哦不！特卡尔.祖克的监狱正在崩溃。这本来不该发生的。我现在帮不了你了，JalYt！

english: Would you like to buy some Crafting equipment?
translation: 你想买一些制作装备吗？

english: Are you absolutely sure? There's no going back!
translation: 你确定吗？可没有回头路了！

english: They'll never win that Dragon Chainbody.
translation: 他们永远赢不了那件龙金链甲。

english: Hello, I'm a happy smiling food delivery gnome. If you are interested in delivering food, and earning a free delivery yourself then go and talk to Aluft Gianne jnr. in the Tree Gnome Stronghold.
translation: 你好，我是一个快乐的送餐地精。如果你对送餐感兴趣，并且想为自己赚取一趟免费配送，那就去树地精要塞找小吉安.阿尔夫特谈谈吧。

english: Puny human! You wouldn't understand!
translation: 弱小的人类！你不懂！

english: Greetings stranger. If you wish to browse my wares, you will need to be more favoured by Port Piscarilius.
translation: 你好，陌生人。如果你想看我的货品，你需要获得皮斯卡里琉斯港更多的好感。

english: Take yourself a good look.
translation: 你自己好好看看吧。

english: You will not as long as I draw breath.
translation: 只要我还有一口气，你就别想。

english: Adventurer, protect us so we may finish the ceremony.
translation: 冒险者，请保护我们，让我们完成仪式。

english: You can only own one of these, I'm afraid. I'll recharge it for you if you bring the one you own to me.
translation: 恐怕你只能拥有其中一个。如果你把你拥有的那个带给我，我会帮你充能。

english: Your jar generator is already full. Why not buy something else?
translation: 你的制罐器已经满了。为什么不买点别的呢？

english: Sorry, I don't have time to speak right now. See the dockmaster if you need anything.
translation: 抱歉，我现在没时间说话。有什么需要就找码头主管吧。

english: Great! I'll get some bees moved in right away. Here, have something for your trouble...
translation: 太好了！我马上弄些蜜蜂进来。给你，这是谢礼……

english: That's not right! Look out! Beeeeeeees!
translation: 不对！小心！蜜蜜蜜蜂！

english: I will crush you with the power of all five heads!
translation: 我会用五个头的力量碾碎你！

english: What? HOW?
translation: 什么？怎么可能？

english: Hey, you're not allowed through there!
translation: 嘿，你不能从这里过去！

english: Sorry but I'm a bit busy at the moment. Here's your money back. Maybe we can do this again.
translation: 抱歉，我现在有点忙。钱还给你，也许我们下次再交易。

english: Well I'm in charge.
translation: 嗯，我负责。

english: ARG! You could have had my head off! Be more careful.
translation: 啊！你差点把我的头打掉！小心点。

english: You are not welcome to mine here, human.
translation: 这里不欢迎你采矿，人类。

english: Are you in need of provisions?
translation: 你需要补给吗？

english: No I am.
translation: 不，我才是。

english: Okay! Okay! Please don't hurt me!
translation: 好了！好了！求求你别伤害我！

english: Welcome to the gambling area. Here, you'll be able to partake in various forms of gambling.
translation: 欢迎来到赌博区。在这里，你可以参与各种形式的赌博。

english: Can't you Mourners just leave us all alone?
translation: 你们这些哀悼者就不能让我们清静一下吗？

english: This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Within it you'll find the PvP Arena options.
translation: 这是分组标签的图标。在里面你可以找到PvP竞技场选项。

english: There, you can click Find to seek the official group for ranked Tournaments. Alternatively, you could look for another player's group, for an unranked Tournament.
translation: 在那里，你可以点击“寻找”来搜索排位赛的官方队伍。或者，你也可以寻找其他玩家的队伍参加非排位赛。

english: Once you've found a suitable group for you, click Sign up to sign up to it, and you'll be considered for an invitation to a Tournament, whenever one begins.
translation: 找到合适的队伍后，点击“报名”加入，这样当比赛开始时，你就有机会被邀请参赛。

english: This is the icon for the Grouping tab. Once you've formed a recruitment group, you'll be able to control it there, via the PvP Arena options.
translation: 这是分组标签的图标。一旦你组建了招募队伍，就可以通过PvP竞技场选项在那里进行管理。

english: When you're ready to start, click Start to summon your awaiting fighters. You'll need to be on a PvP Arena world to start your Tournament.
translation: 准备好后，点击“开始”召唤等待的战士。你需要在PvP竞技场世界才能开始比赛。

english: Abbot Langley carefully breaks each shield, leaving the sigils perfectly intact.
translation: 兰利修道院长小心地打破每面盾牌，徽记完好无损。

english: Abbot Langley quickly takes the soft clay, leather boots and bowl of hot water in exchange for a mysterious helmet.
translation: 兰利修道院长迅速用软粘土、皮靴和一碗热水换了一个神秘头盔。

english: Abbot Langley has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 兰利修道院长又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: The player unmasks the killer, revealing Abigale as the culprit.
translation: 玩家揭开了杀手的真面目，发现阿比盖尔是凶手。

english: Another killer comes out of the closest near the door.
translation: 另一个杀手从门附近的衣柜里走了出来。

english: The killer unmasks himself, revealing Hewey as the culprit.
translation: 杀手摘下面具，发现休伊是凶手。

english: Abigale stabs Hewey.
translation: 阿比盖尔刺伤了休伊。

english: Hewey dies.
translation: 休伊死了。

english: The player stabs Abigale.
translation: 玩家刺伤了阿比盖尔。

english: In the background, Mandy gets up.
translation: 背景中，曼迪站了起来。

english: Mandy walks toward the Bandos godsword on the table.
translation: 曼迪走向桌上的班多斯神剑。

english: Mandy picks up the Bandos godsword and enters the closet.
translation: 曼迪拿起班多斯神剑，走进了衣柜。

english: Mandy comes out of the closet behind Mandy.
translation: 曼迪从曼迪身后的衣柜里走了出来。

english: Mandy uses the sword's special attack on Abigale.
translation: 曼迪用剑的战技攻击阿比盖尔。

english: Abigale dies.
translation: 阿比盖尔死了。

english: I'm not getting involved.
translation: 我不掺和。

english: You’ll find more information on account security on the Customer Support webpage. You can use the useful links section of the Account Management menu to get there.
translation: 你可以在客户支持网页上找到更多关于账户安全的信息。通过账户管理菜单中的有用链接部分可以到达那里。

english: No Thanks
translation: 不了，谢谢

english: Ello, and what are you after then?
translation: 嘿，你想要什么？

english: Ello, can I help you?
translation: 嘿，需要帮忙吗？

english: Cause it didn't have the guts to fart!
translation: 因为它没胆子放屁！

english: Aggie waves her hands about, and you seem to be five coins poorer.
translation: 阿吉挥了挥手，你似乎少了5个金币。

english: Aggie waves her hands about, and you seem to be 20 coins poorer.
translation: 阿吉挥了挥手，你似乎少了20个金币。

english: Aggie waves her hands about, and you seem to have a pot of flour less.
translation: 阿吉挥了挥手，你似乎少了一罐面粉。

english: Al Shabim gives you a key.
translation: 阿尔.沙比姆给了你一把钥匙。

english: Al Shabim gives you another key.
translation: 阿尔.沙比姆又给了你一把钥匙。

english: You show Al Shabim the prototype dart.
translation: 你向阿尔.沙比姆展示了原型飞镖。

english: You hand over the technical plans for the weapon.
translation: 你交出了武器的技术图纸。

english: Al Shabim's advisors show you some advanced techniques for making the new weapon.
translation: 阿尔.沙比姆的顾问向你展示了一些制造新武器的高级技巧。

english: You receive six bronze throwing darts from Al Shabim.
translation: 你从阿尔.沙比姆那里收到了六枚青铜投掷飞镖。

english: *** Dart Construction *** Congratulations! You can now construct darts.
translation: *** 飞镖制造 *** 恭喜！你现在可以制造飞镖了。

english: You receive a tasty looking pineapple from Al Shabim.
translation: 你从阿尔.沙比姆那里收到了一个看起来很美味的菠萝。

english: Shall I compare thee to a desert's day' is my finest yet, but I've also composed others.
translation: “我能否将你比作沙漠的一天”是我最好的作品，但我也创作了其他诗篇。

english: Alan hands over your purchase.
translation: 艾伦递给你购买的东西。

english: Wow that sounds great, how about your stall?
translation: 哇，听起来不错，你的摊位怎么样？

english: I think the other merchants are conspiring against me.
translation: 我觉得其他商人在密谋对付我。

english: Fair enough, so we have a win, win, win situation on our hands then.
translation: 有道理，那我们就是三赢的局面了。

english: I think I need just one more product type, something, magical ... now what could I stock that's magical, has large demand and a pretty good profit margin...
translation: 我想我还需要一种产品，一种有魔力的……我该进什么有魔力、需求大、利润又高的货呢……

english: Ah ha, I think I know where this is going. So because you're located far enough away from him you will take up someone else's share in the market and Aubury will make more money as a result.
translation: 啊哈，我大概知道你的意思了。因为你离他足够远，所以你会占据别人的市场份额，而奥伯里因此能赚更多钱。

english: So what's in this for me?
translation: 那我有什么好处？

english: No I'm really too busy.
translation: 不，我实在太忙了。

english: Ok
translation: 好的

english: No thanks I'm ok. Thanks for your time.
translation: 不用了，我没事。谢谢你的时间。

english: Oh dear, well do any of them have a stall in the Bazaar in Al Kharid?
translation: 哦，天哪，那他们有人在阿尔卡里德城的集市有摊位吗？

english: No thanks I'm ok.
translation: 不用了，我没事。

english: Camels, beautiful? I worry about you.
translation: 骆驼，漂亮？我真替你担心。

english: Ok, ok, that's enough! So they're camels then!
translation: 好了好了，够了！所以它们就是骆驼！

english: Ali the discount camel seller gives you a receipt for the camels in return for 500 gold coins.
translation: 打折骆驼贩子阿里给了你一张骆驼收据，换取了500金币。

english: Would 1000 gold coins for the pair of them do?
translation: 两匹骆驼1000金币行吗？

english: About those camels, I've lost the receipt can I have another?
translation: 关于那些骆驼，我把收据弄丢了，能再给我一张吗？

english: I decided to get rid of the camels.
translation: 我决定处理掉那些骆驼。

english: No, they didn't so I sold them as Kebab meat!
translation: 不，它们没派上用场，所以我把它们当烤肉卖了！

english: I'm not really a camel person so I gave them to a better owner.
translation: 我不太喜欢骆驼，所以把它们送给了一个更好的主人。

english: I decided to try use them to end the hostilities between the two gangs.
translation: 我决定用它们来结束两个帮派之间的敌对。

english: Well good luck to you in whatever venture you do decide to go ahead with.
translation: 好吧，无论你决定做什么，祝你好运。

english: About those camels, I've lost the receipt. Can I have another?
translation: 关于那些骆驼，我把收据弄丢了。能再给我一张吗？

english: Wow! look at this place, it's so colourful.
translation: 哇！看看这地方，真多彩。

english: Aluft Gianne gives you a voucher for 100 balls of Gianne Dough.
translation: 阿鲁夫特.吉安给了你一张100个吉安面团的代金券。

english: Amascut activates the obelisk and teleports away.
translation: 阿玛斯库特激活了方尖碑并传送走了。

english: You have been given a new clue!
translation: 你得到了一个新线索！

english: Player: Yeah I've noticed that they seem to keep breaking hatstands all the time too, I'm not sure how easy it is to break a hatstand...
translation: 玩家：是啊，我也注意到它们好像老是弄坏帽架，我不确定弄坏一个帽架有多容易……

english: You pay Andras 1,000,000 coins for for permanent access to his boat.
translation: 你付给安德拉斯1,000,000金币，获得了他船的永久使用权。

english: You show the chainmace to Andros Mai.
translation: 你向安德罗斯.迈展示了链枷。

english: You show the claws to Andros Mai.
translation: 你向安德罗斯.迈展示了爪子。

english: You show the Claws of callisto to Andros Mai.
translation: 你向安德罗斯.迈展示了卡利斯托的爪。

english: Andros Mai combines the items and gives you the Ursine chainmace (u).
translation: 安德罗斯.迈将物品组合，给了你熊爪链枷 (未充能)。

english: You show the fangs to Andros Mai.
translation: 你向安德罗斯.迈展示了尖牙。

english: You show the skull to Andros Mai.
translation: 你向安德罗斯.迈展示了头骨。

english: You show the weapon piece to Andros Mai.
translation: 你向安德罗斯.迈展示了武器部件。

english: Ha Ha Ha. Well if it isn't [player name], why do you dare enter my domain....
translation: 哈哈哈。哎呀，这不是[玩家名]吗，你竟敢闯入我的领地……

english: Long time no see Anti-Santa, how's prison life been treating you?
translation: 好久不见，反圣诞老人，监狱生活过得怎么样？

english: It has been glorious, you may have thought me to be rotting inside these walls, but I've been coming up with plot to end Christmas once and for all!
translation: 好极了，你可能以为我在这高墙里腐烂，但我一直在策划如何彻底终结圣诞节！

english: You may ofstopped me all those years ago, but you didn't stop my mind.
translation: 多年前你或许阻止了我，但你没阻止我的头脑。

english: Soon I'll escape these walls and there'll be naught to stop me.
translation: 很快我就能逃出这里，没人能阻止我。

english: This pathetic holiday will come to an end and I'll laugh as it burns.
translation: 这个可悲的节日将迎来终结，我会看着它燃烧大笑。

english: That red buffoon will not be able to stop me, nor you, nor that dumb cat!
translation: 那个红衣服的小丑阻止不了我，你也一样，还有那只蠢猫！

english: Anti-Santa, Santa told me all about you.
translation: 反圣诞老人，圣诞老人跟我提过你。

english: Don't mention his name to me, he's everything I hate about this repulsive holiday, I have always dreamed about tearing down this revolting time of year.
translation: 别在我面前提他，他代表了我讨厌这个恶心节日的一切，我一直梦想着摧毁这个一年中最令人作呕的时刻。

english: Years ago I almost succeeded, but I was thwarted by that red buffoon and some dumb cat!
translation: 多年前我差点成功，但被那个红衣服小丑和一只蠢猫破坏了！

english: But in the years I've been locked away, I've been plotting and scheming. When I escape from this cell....
translation: 但被关起来的这些年，我一直在策划阴谋。等我逃出这牢房……

english: Yes, Christmas will never be the same, children will be crying instead of laughing!
translation: 没错，圣诞节将不复从前，孩子们会哭而不是笑！

english: The streets will be cold and lifeless.
translation: 街道将寒冷而毫无生气。

english: I will stop Christmas once and for all!
translation: 我要一劳永逸地阻止圣诞节！

english: And soon it will be the year of the Anti-Christmas!
translation: 很快就是反圣诞节之年了！

english: *Snores*
translation: *打鼾声*

english: OI!
translation: 喂！

english: *Wakes up* Oh sorry! You were going on for a bit, I thought it'd never end.
translation: *醒来* 哦抱歉！你说了好一阵子，我还以为没完没了呢。

english: You've been moved to the top of my kill list [player name].
translation: 你已经升到我的必杀名单第一位了，[玩家名]。

english: Let's cut to the chase, I need your help Anti-Santa.
translation: 开门见山吧，我需要你的帮助，反圣诞老人。

english: Oh, so you've come begging to me for help, what makes you think I would help you?
translation: 哦，所以你是来求我帮忙的？凭什么觉得我会帮你？

english: What other choice do you have? It looks incredibly boring in this cell.
translation: 你还有别的选择吗？这牢房里看起来无聊透顶。

english: Well, that's true, but I'd rather that than help you.
translation: 嗯，这倒是，但我宁愿无聊也不帮你。

english: You're so over dramatic. Santa said he'd consider freeing you only if you help us.
translation: 你也太夸张了。圣诞老人说，只要你帮我们，他会考虑放你出来。

english: Oh did he... ...now might be my chance to escape this cell... you know what. I will help you.
translation: 哦，他这么说……现在可能是我逃出牢房的机会……好吧，我帮你。

english: Finally, he needs you to deal with Jack Frost at a bakery in Varrock.
translation: 终于，他需要你去维洛克城的一家面包店对付冰霜杰克。

english: Is that it? Why can't he do it himself?
translation: 就这？他自己为什么不去？

english: He's testing a new parenting technique.
translation: 他在试验一种新的育儿技巧。

english: Really? How are we meant to get into this bakery?
translation: 真的？我们怎么进那家面包店？

english: He gave me this teleport tablet, it will take us right inside of the bakery.
translation: 他给了我这个传送石，能直接把我们送进面包店。

english: After all these years, he's still making adventurers do his dirty work. He's just as bad as me.
translation: 这么多年了，他还是让冒险者干他的脏活。他跟我一样坏。

english: Trust me, I'm getting tired of it as well, we need to go before it's too late.
translation: 相信我，我也受够了，我们得赶紧去，不然就来不及了。

english: Ha Ha Ha If it isn't Jack Frost. You look smaller than last time I saw you.
translation: 哈哈哈，这不是冰霜杰克吗？你看起来比我上次见你时更小了。

english: A-A-Anti Santa!? What are you doing here?
translation: 反……反圣诞老人！？你在这里干什么？

english: Your father sent me. Apparently, you've been rather naughty this year.
translation: 你父亲派我来的。看来你今年相当淘气啊。

english: I'm here to sort you out.
translation: 我来收拾你。

english: What? My dad sent you? No way, he put me in charge of Christmas.
translation: 什么？我爸派你来的？不可能，他让我负责圣诞节。

english: He did and apparently you're doing such an awful job of it, you've ruined it for everyone...
translation: 他是这么说的，但显然你干得一塌糊涂，把所有人的圣诞节都毁了……

english: When you think about it, are you sure you're not my son?
translation: 想想看，你确定你不是我儿子？

english: You're not my father, you're just an ugly bag of bones.
translation: 你不是我父亲，你只是一袋丑陋的骨头。

english: I won't let you stop me. Take this!
translation: 我不会让你阻止我的。接招！

english: Ha Ha Ha. Is that all you've got, Jack?
translation: 哈哈哈。你就这点本事吗，杰克？

english: Oh come on! How did that not hurt you?
translation: 哦拜托！那怎么没伤到你？

english: You're weak just like your father.
translation: 你跟你父亲一样弱。

english: I'm gonna slap you back to Lumbridge!
translation: 我要把你扇回仑桥镇！

english: You're going to need a lot worse to defeat me.
translation: 你得拿出更厉害的本事才能打败我。

english: Good thing I'm not done yet.
translation: 幸好我还没完呢。→ 幸好我还没结束。

english: I learned this from an old friend of mine.
translation: 这招是我从一个老朋友那学的。

english: You cannot stop me Jack.
translation: 你阻止不了我，杰克。

english: I'm getting out of here. This isn't worth it!
translation: 我要离开这里。这不值得！

english: That didn't go as planned.
translation: 事情没按计划发展。

english: Ha Ha Ha. He won't get away that easily!
translation: 哈哈哈。他没那么容易逃掉！

english: I'll be back to deal with you soon [player name]....
translation: 我很快会回来找你算账的，[玩家名]……

english: Here he is!
translation: 他来了！

english: The avatars depart.
translation: 化身离去。→ 化身们离开了。

english: Do you have more followers than the others?
translation: 你的追随者比其他人多吗？

english: You hand over the berries, which the Apothecary shakes up in a vial of strange liquid.
translation: 你把浆果交给药剂师，他把浆果在一瓶奇怪液体里摇晃。

english: The Apothecary gives you a Cadava potion.
translation: 药剂师给了你一瓶卡达瓦药水。

english: Screen shakes back and forth then blacks out
translation: 屏幕前后摇晃，然后变黑。

english: You show the Serum book to the Apothecary.
translation: 你把血清之书拿给药剂师看。

english: Yes, I'll drink it all down.
translation: 好，我全喝下去。

english: No, I'm having second thoughts now.
translation: 不，我现在改变主意了。

translation: 费利克斯用你的深渊红色染料换了一些深渊绿色染料。

translation: 费利克斯用你的深渊绿色染料换了一些深渊蓝色染料。

translation: 费利克斯用你的深渊蓝色染料换了一些深渊红色染料。

translation: 费利克斯用你的深渊蓝色染料换了一些深渊绿色染料。

english: Felix gives you the tarnished locket.
translation: 费利克斯给了你暗淡的吊坠盒。

english: Felix gives you the lost bag.
translation: 费利克斯给了你丢失的包裹。

translation: 你把深渊绿色染料交给费利克斯。

translation: 你把深渊蓝色染料交给费利克斯。

translation: 你以50颗深渊珍珠的价格卖掉了深渊蓝色染料。

translation: 你把深渊红色染料交给费利克斯。

english: You sell your abyssal red dye for 50 abyssal pearls.
translation: 你以50颗深渊珍珠的价格卖掉了深渊红色染料。

english: You present the Abyssal lantern to Felix.
translation: 你把深渊灯笼交给费利克斯。

english: You sell your abyssal lantern for 100 abyssal pearls.
translation: 你以100颗深渊珍珠的价格卖掉了深渊灯笼。

english: You show the abyssal red dye to Felix.
translation: 你把深渊红色染料拿给费利克斯看。

english: You show the abyssal green dye to Felix.
translation: 你把深渊绿色染料拿给费利克斯看。

translation: 你把深渊蓝色染料拿给费利克斯看。

english: So I hear theres a leprechaun around here who can show me the way to Zanaris?
translation: 我听说附近有个小妖精能带我去扎纳里斯城？

translation: 从塞德里多那里？但...他不可能吧？请把它给我。他派一个陌生人来，这一定非常重要。

english: You hand Aubury the research package.
translation: 你把研究包裹交给了奥伯里。

english: Aubury goes through the package of research notes.
translation: 奥伯里翻看着研究笔记的包裹。

english: Aubury hands you some research notes.
translation: 奥伯里递给你一些研究笔记。

english: Anything useful in that package I gave you?
translation: 我给你的那个包裹里有什么有用的东西吗？

english: Well, let's have a look...
translation: 嗯，让我看看...

english: Ya... about that, there's some crazy locking mechanism attached to each casket of runes, which he cannot figure out.
translation: 呃...关于那个，每个符石宝箱上都有个奇怪的锁，他搞不定。

english: Oh, yes, the rune locks, they're a bit of a doozy, I've completely forgotten how they work, but I'm sure they shouldn't prove too much of a struggle to an intelligent adventurererlike you, [player name]. Eh?
translation: 哦，对，符石锁，有点棘手，我完全忘了怎么弄，但我相信对你这样聪明的冒险者来说应该不难，[玩家名字]。嗯？

english: I wouldn't hold my breath.
translation: 我可不敢抱太大希望。

english: You got the Fishing Contest Pass!
translation: 你获得了钓鱼大赛通行证！

english: Looks like Victor isn't home right now. Go quickly!
translation: 看起来维克托现在不在家。快走！

english: Avan hands you a pair of Goldsmith gauntlets.
translation: 阿凡递给你一副金匠手套。

english: Could I have another pair of Goldsmith gauntlets?
translation: 我能再要一副金匠手套吗？

english: You show the banana to King Awowogei.
translation: 你向阿沃盖国王展示了香蕉。

english: You give the banana to King Awowogei.
translation: 你把香蕉给了阿沃盖国王。

english: I didn't realise monkeys could talk!
translation: 我没想到猴子会说话！

english: It was definitely more work than I thought it would be.
translation: 这确实比我想象的要费劲得多。

english: I suppose I've never thought about it like that before.
translation: 我想我以前从没这么想过。

english: It's for the good of the village. I met a genie down the crevice. He told me he would give me the statuette in exchange for your soul.
translation: 这是为了村子好。我在裂缝里遇到了一个精灵。他告诉我，只要我把你的灵魂给他，他就给我小雕像。

english: The Jormungand kills Bakuna in one hit
translation: 耶梦加得一击杀死了巴库纳

english: So you're the one who freed Azzanadra from his prison? Thank you, kind [sir/lady]!
translation: 所以是你把阿扎纳德拉从监狱里救出来的？谢谢你，善良的[先生/女士]！

english: You pay 5,000 trading sticks. Banisoch adds a climbing rope to the hole for you.
translation: 你支付了5,000根交易棒。巴尼索克为你往洞里放了一根攀爬绳。

english: You equip the camulet and turn towards the bank camel.
translation: 你装备了骆驼护符，转向银行骆驼。

english: The bank camel gives you a strange key.
translation: 银行骆驼给了你一把奇怪的钥匙。

english: The bank camel takes the grain, but quickly spits it out in disgust!
translation: 银行骆驼接过谷物，但很快厌恶地吐了出来！

english: The bank camel happily takes the grain before looking at you as if contemplating something.
translation: 银行骆驼高兴地接过谷物，然后看着你，好像在思考什么。

english: You show the banana to the bank camel.
translation: 你向银行骆驼展示了香蕉。

english: You show the fang to the bank camel.
translation: 你向银行骆驼展示了毒牙。

english: You show the ashes to the bank camel.
translation: 你向银行骆驼展示了灰烬。

english: You show the dung to the bank camel.
translation: 你向银行骆驼展示了粪便。

english: You search the sack and find a needle.
translation: 你搜索麻袋，找到了一根针。

english: You successfully take some grain while the bank camel isn't looking.
translation: 你趁银行骆驼不注意，成功拿了一些谷物。

english: Baraek sells you a fur.
translation: 巴拉克卖给你一张毛皮。

english: You hand Baraek your fur to look at.
translation: 你把你的毛皮递给巴拉克看。

english: Baraek has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 巴拉克给了你一张挑战卷轴！

english: Baraek has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 巴拉克又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Ha ha ha! Little Player wants to buy me a drink, how sweet.
translation: 哈哈哈！小玩家想给我买酒喝，真贴心。

english: Ha ha ha! Little Player cannot yell like barbarian. Also, I strong barbarian woman; I get my own drink. Run away now, little Player.
translation: 哈哈哈！小玩家不能像野蛮人那样喊叫。而且，我是强壮的野蛮人女人；我自己买酒喝。快跑吧，小玩家。

english: Ello friend. I see you're drinking like a barbarian - do you want to stop smashing your vials when you finish them?
translation: 你好朋友。我看你喝酒像野蛮人一样——你想喝完酒后不再摔碎小瓶吗？

english: Ello friend. Do you want me to show you how to smash your vials when you finish drinking them?
translation: 你好朋友。你想让我教你喝完酒后怎么摔碎小瓶吗？

english: Aye, that I can [Fremennik Name]! Yonder lies the lair of the daggermouth kings, the three beasts of legend!
translation: 没错，我能做到，[费明尼克名字]！那边就是匕首嘴之王的老巢，传说中的三头野兽！

english: Ah, you did not come prepared [Fremennik Name]?
translation: 啊，你没有准备好吗，[费明尼克名字]？

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [Fremennik Name], I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall! (Fremennik item gets replaced by a cooked shark.)
translation: 啊，这可以当我的备用武器！谢谢你，[费明尼克名字]，我相信总有一天我们会在雷勒卡城的长厅里一起唱起光荣战斗的歌！（费明尼克物品被替换成一块熟鲨鱼。）

english: As you wish, [Fremennik Name] My weapons have lasted me this long, I will keep my trust in them yet.
translation: 如你所愿，[费明尼克名字]。我的武器已经陪我这么久，我还是相信它们。

english: No [Fremennik Name], I will trade you my finely cooked shark for a trusty Fremennik blade, a sturdy Fremennik helm, or a mighty Fremennik shield...
translation: 不，[费明尼克名字]，我愿意用我精心烹制的熟鲨鱼换一把可靠的费明尼克刀、一顶坚固的费明尼克头盔或一面强大的费明尼克盾...

english: Listen, [Fremennik Name]. I'm sorry about the way I acted while you were exiled. Bardur gets hostile around outerlanders.
translation: 听着，[费明尼克名字]。我很抱歉你被流放时我的态度。巴杜尔对外来者很敌视。

english: (player loses 150k, gains a fremennik shield)
translation: （玩家失去15万金币，获得一面费明尼克盾）

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the bones you're carrying and for any you have in your bank.
translation: 我出[NUMBER]金币买你身上和银行里的骨头。

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shells you're carrying.
translation: 我出[NUMBER]金币买你身上的蜗牛壳。

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the snail shells you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
translation: 我出[NUMBER]金币买你身上的蜗牛壳，同时我会尽量给你一些制作方面的建议。

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shells you're carrying.

english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shell you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
