english: I'll give you [NUMBER] gp for the tortoise shells you're carrying, and I'll try to give you some advice on Crafting while I'm at it.
translation: 我出[NUMBER]金币买你身上的陆龟壳，同时我会尽量给你一些制作方面的建议。

english: And what will it be for you, fine [sir/madam]?
translation: 您要点什么，尊敬的[先生/女士]？

english: Ah, [sir/madam] has taste! A jug of wine will cost you 10 gold coins.
translation: 啊，[先生/女士]真有品味！一壶葡萄酒要10金币。

english: I hope [sir/madam] will enjoy it!
translation: 希望[先生/女士]会喜欢！

english: The archaeologist takes the necklace and turns it over in his hands, studying it closely.
translation: 考古学家接过项链，在手中翻转，仔细端详。

english: The archaeologist shows you the techniques for this particular spell, which requires five fire runes arranged around one cosmic rune - and level 49 Magic - then casting the spell on a crafted ruby necklace of your
translation: 考古学家向你展示了这个特定法术的技巧，需要五个火符石围绕一个宇宙符石排列——以及49级魔法——然后对你制作的

english: own. You can make enchanted ruby necklaces.
translation: 红宝石项链施法。你可以制作附魔红宝石项链了。

english: The archaeologist gives you [5x] coins... must have been worth a lot in his day!
translation: 考古学家给了你[5x]枚金币...在他那个年代一定值不少钱！

english: Hullo there friend, what can I do you for?
translation: 嘿，朋友，有什么能帮你的？

english: Do you sell beer?
translation: 你卖啤酒吗？

english: Aye, we do.
translation: 是啊，我们卖。

english: Could I get one?
translation: 能给我来一杯吗？

english: Nope, sorry [laddie/lassie].
translation: 不行，抱歉[小伙子/姑娘]。

english: The egg's order, I only have cabbage beer and I'm not allowed to sell it anymore.
translation: 都是那该死的命令，我只有卷心菜啤酒，而且现在不让卖了。

english: Can't you see by my lack of customers?
translation: 你没看到我这儿都没客人吗？

english: I just thought no one wanted to come in.
translation: 我还以为只是没人愿意进来呢。

english: Get out me pub!
translation: 滚出我的酒吧！

english: This is a nice pub you've got here.
translation: 你这酒吧真不错。

english: Aye, it is.
translation: 是啊，确实不错。

english: How long has it been around?
translation: 开了多久了？

english: Oh not too long, use to be a house, but I demolished it with me bare paws and rebuilt it as a pub.
translation: 哦，没多久，以前是栋房子，我赤手空拳把它拆了，改造成了酒吧。

english: You demolished the house? Was anyone living there?
translation: 你把房子拆了？当时有人住吗？

english: Nope, been empty for quite a while.
translation: 没有，空了好一阵子了。

english: Oh... what an interesting story.
translation: 哦……真是个有趣的故事。

english: No thank you, I'm just browsing.
translation: 不了谢谢，我只是随便看看。

english: What do you mean browsing? This is a pub, not a carrot market.
translation: 随便看看？这是酒吧，不是胡萝卜市场。

english: Sorry, I just wanted to have a look.
translation: 抱歉，我只是想看看。

english: I've a half mind to bar you from me pub right now if you don't leave.
translation: 你再不走，我就要把你赶出我的酒吧了。

english: Nice pub you've got here.
translation: 你这酒吧真不错。

english: Just browsing, thanks.
translation: 随便看看，谢谢。

english: (the player receives Bandit's Brew.)
translation: （玩家获得了强盗酒。）

english: A bad attack of sand? I think you're on the wrong track here, stranger.
translation: 沙子攻击？我觉得你搞错了，陌生人。

english: Ask about Desert Treasure I
translation: 询问关于沙漠宝藏 I

english: Buy a drink
translation: 买杯饮料

english: I heard about treasure...
translation: 我听说有宝藏……

english: I heard about four diamonds...
translation: 我听说有四颗钻石……

english: I heard about a fortress...
translation: 我听说有一座要塞……

english: I've heard of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: 我听说过阿扎纳德拉的钻石。

english: You've been given another clue!
translation: 你得到了另一个线索！

english: You buy a pint of cheap beer.
translation: 你买了一品脱廉价啤酒。

english: The Burning Man is a monument to a great triumph in Lovakengj history. We're talking thosands of years ago, before Kourend was even a kingdom! Sadly, that does mean some details have been lost to time.
translation: 燃烧之人是一座纪念碑，纪念洛瓦肯吉城历史上的一次伟大胜利。那是几千年前的事了，库兰德王国都还没建立！可惜的是，有些细节已经随时间流逝了。

english: You blow the whistle...
translation: 你吹响了哨子……

english: You feed the egg to your pet...
translation: 你把蛋喂给了你的宠物……

english: Eating logs is like enjoying wine. They all have a nuance of flavour. That last one for example was earthy, with hints of nuts and redberries, along with a scent of rose.!
translation: 吃原木就像品酒一样。每根都有细微的风味差别。比如刚才那根，有泥土气息，带着坚果和红莓的香味，还有一丝玫瑰的芬芳！

english: Please kind [sir/lady]... my family and I are starving...
translation: 好心的[先生/女士]……我和家人都快饿死了……

english: Well if you get some, you know where to come.
translation: 如果你弄到了，你知道该去哪儿。

english: The beggar has turned into the Lady of the Lake!
translation: 乞丐变成了湖中女士！

english: No I don't have any bread with me.
translation: 不，我身上没有面包。

english: The beggar isn't interested in talking.
translation: 乞丐没兴趣说话。

english: No, I still have none.
translation: 不，我还是没有。

english: Can you deliver sand to my bank, please?
translation: 你能把沙子送到我的银行吗？

english: Sorry I'm not into magic.
translation: 抱歉，我对魔法不感兴趣。

english: You hand over 20 gold pieces in return for the dye
translation: 你支付了20金币换取了染料。

english: Betty places a vial on her counter.
translation: 贝蒂把一个药瓶放在柜台上。

english: You hand the sand and watch Betty sprinkle it in the serum, it fizzes.
translation: 你把沙子递给贝蒂，看着她把沙子撒进药剂里，药剂嘶嘶作响。

english: You've found a new special clue! However, a magical force prevents you from putting this item in your inventory!
translation: 你发现了一个新的特殊线索！然而，一股魔法力量阻止你将这件物品放入背包！

english: No thanks Betty
translation: 不了，谢谢贝蒂。

english: Talk to Betty about the Hand in the Sand.
translation: 和贝蒂谈谈沙中之手。

english: Talk to Betty about her shop.
translation: 和贝蒂谈谈她的商店。

english: Why don't you do the cluue scrolls yourself?
translation: 你为什么不自己去做线索卷轴？

english: I suppose ye'll be wantin' a lift while yer here, right [lad/lass]?
translation: 我想你在这儿的时候想搭个便车吧，[小伙子/姑娘]？

english: No, I should be gettin' back anyway. Come on [lad/lass], let's be off.
translation: 不，我也该回去了。来吧[小伙子/姑娘]，我们走吧。

english: Nothin' I won't put on hold. Come on [lad/lass], let's be off.
translation: 没什么事不能放下的。来吧[小伙子/姑娘]，我们走吧。

english: I am the Black Knight Titan! You must pass through me before you can continue in this realm!
translation: 我是黑骑士泰坦！你必须先过我这一关，才能继续前进！

english: Puny mortal... You cannot defeat me...
translation: 渺小的凡人……你打不败我的……

english: Maybe you need something more to beat the titan?
translation: 也许你需要点别的东西才能打败泰坦？

english: For Camelot!
translation: 为了卡美洛！

english: Well done! You have defeated the Black Knight Titan!
translation: 干得好！你打败了黑骑士泰坦！

english: Ho there! Who are you?
translation: 嘿！你是谁？

english: Does Keldagrim have a lot of sculptors then?
translation: 那么凯尔达格林城有很多雕刻家吗？

english: Sure, sure, of course.
translation: 当然，当然，没问题。

english: Yeah, maybe you should visit the mountain people topside of this mountain some time... all they have is a big lump of stone!
translation: 是啊，也许你该去山顶上拜访一下那些山民……他们只有一块大石头！

english: But I'd rather not go up there, they don't like dwarves much.
translation: 但我不太想去那儿，他们不太喜欢矮人。

english: You need some wool and a rock in order to keep this highly inflated toad from flying around everywhere.
translation: 你需要一些羊毛和一块石头，才能让这只胀得鼓鼓的蛤蟆不乱飞。

english: I certainly can, I am wearing this amulet I got in Sophanem!
translation: 我当然能，我戴着这个在索法尼恩城得到的护身符！

english: Ah so you've met one of the local felines, wise and confusing , those Sphinges.
translation: 啊，所以你遇到了本地的一只猫科动物，那些斯芬克斯既聪明又令人费解。

english: Wow!!! You know the plural of Sphinx!!! What else do you know?
translation: 哇！！！你居然知道斯芬克斯的复数形式！你还知道什么？

english: All sorts of stuff! I pick up no end of comments on my travels, want to hear one?
translation: 各种东西！我在旅途中收集了不少趣闻，想听一个吗？

english: I certainly do. Share your wisdom, Bob!
translation: 当然想。分享你的智慧吧，鲍勃！

english: Bolkoy has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 博尔科伊给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: You pay Bonzo 5 coins.
translation: 你付给邦佐5金币。

english: Ok, we've got all the fishermen. It's time to roll!
translation: 好了，所有渔夫都到齐了。该行动了！

english: No thanks; I'll just watch the fun.
translation: 不了谢谢，我看看热闹就好。

english: Okay folks, time's up! Let's see who caught the biggest fish.
translation: 好了各位，时间到！看看谁钓到了最大的鱼。

english: You hand over your catch.
translation: 你交出了你的收获。

english: Human arm might taste good, maybe, so if Wolfbone sent your arm as a snack, we happy to take it an' eat it.
translation: 人类手臂可能味道不错，也许吧，所以如果狼骨把你的手臂当零食送来，我们很乐意收下吃掉。

english: Urgh - human arm attached to human body with human mouth what keep talking an' talking. Shut up and' go away.
translation: 呃——人类手臂连着人类身体，还有一张喋喋不休的人类嘴巴。闭嘴滚开。

english: Anyway, Boulder not here to talk ontological distinction between mind an' matter, especially with dumb human who not know what [his/her] arm is. So push off.
translation: 总之，巨石不是来跟你讨论心灵与物质的本体论区别的，尤其是跟一个连自己手臂是什么都不知道的愚蠢人类。所以滚吧。

english: You are given some mintcake as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一些薄荷蛋糕作为小费。

english: You are given some seed pods as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一些种子荚作为小费。

english: You are given some goutweed as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一些痛风草作为小费。

english: You are given nothing as a tip.
translation: 你没有得到任何小费。

english: Ello.
translation: 你好。

english: Ello!
translation: 你好！

english: Brimstail shows you a small crystal seed.
translation: 布林斯泰尔给你看了一颗小水晶种子。

english: I need to mine some rune essence.
translation: 我需要挖一些符文精华。

english: I worship Ralos, a common practice where I am form. However, I found out that our order may have originated from this temple. If you find anything of interest, please let me know.
translation: 我信奉拉洛斯，这是我家乡的常见习俗。但我发现我们的教团可能起源于这座神庙。如果你发现任何有趣的东西，请告诉我。

english: Brother Jered holds the bottle up so you can see it.
translation: 杰瑞德修士举起瓶子让你看。

english: Brother Jered hands you the haunted bottle. You can just make out an angry ghost inside.
translation: 杰瑞德修士把闹鬼的瓶子递给你。你隐约能看到里面有一个愤怒的幽灵。

english: Brother Kojo has given you a watch.
translation: 科乔修士给了你一块表。

english: Brother Kojo has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 科乔修士给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Brother Kojo has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 科乔修士又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: [Brother Omad has given you another clue scroll!/You've obtained a casket!]
translation: [奥马德修士又给了你一个线索卷轴！/你获得了一个宝箱！]

english: Brother Tranquility has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 宁静修士给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Brother Tranquility has given you a another clue scroll!
translation: 宁静修士又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: (shows previous options)
translation: （显示之前的选项）

english: I don't have any votes yet.
translation: 我还没有任何投票。

english: I only have [X] votes so far.
translation: 我目前只有[X]票。

english: I’m still looking into it at the moment.
translation: 我还在调查这件事。

english: No rush, [Fremennik name]. I’m sure it’s nothing to worry about. Just talk to Freygerd and Reeso at the sandpit when you’re ready.
translation: 不急，[费明尼克名字]。我相信没什么好担心的。准备好了就去沙坑找弗雷格德和里索谈谈吧。

english: [Fremennik name], I’m glad you’ve returned! This letter you have found is very worrying and requires our utmost attention.
translation: [费明尼克名字]，很高兴你回来了！你发现的这封信非常令人担忧，需要我们高度重视。

english: I don’t understand. What does this letter mean? Who is the Jormungand? And since when could basilisks read and write?
translation: 我不明白。这封信是什么意思？耶梦加得是谁？还有，石化蜥蜴什么时候会读写文字了？

english: While they may not show it, basilisks are much smarter than they seem. Many years ago, a great basilisk army enslaved our people and took our home. The Joumungand, sometimes known as The Serpent King, was the leader of this army. Along with his three generals, Typhor, Vritra and Bakuna, he brought a terror to these lands unlike any other. If it hadn’t been for the bravery of a great hero, we might never have been freed.
translation: 虽然它们不表现出来，但石化蜥蜴比看起来要聪明得多。许多年前，一支庞大的石化蜥蜴军队奴役了我们的人民，占领了我们的家园。耶梦加得，有时被称为蛇王，是这支军队的领袖。他和他的三位将军——泰福尔、弗利特拉和巴库纳——给这片土地带来了前所未有的恐怖。如果不是一位伟大英雄的勇敢，我们可能永远不会获得自由。

english: Well that depends who you ask. The bards wrote a great song about V’s victory. They called it the Ballad of the Basilisk, and it claims V killed the Jormungand.
translation: 那得看问谁了。吟游诗人们写了一首关于V的胜利的伟大歌曲，他们称之为《石化蜥蜴歌谣》，歌里说V杀死了耶梦加得。

english: Well... bards are known to bend the truth a bit, especially if it makes a song sound better. In reality V sealed the Serpent King in a magical prison on the island, where he remains to this day.
translation: 嗯……吟游诗人以稍微歪曲事实而闻名，尤其是为了让歌曲更好听。实际上，V将蛇王封印在岛上的一个魔法监狱里，他至今仍在那里。

english: A magical prison? I thought the Fremennik people didn’t approve of magic?
translation: 魔法监狱？我以为费明尼克人不赞成魔法？

english: V was different. Stories tell of how he unlocked the potential of magic with a single touch of a stone. In that moment, he became more than just a man.
translation: V与众不同。传说他仅凭触摸一块石头就解锁了魔法的潜力。在那一刻，他不再只是一个凡人。

english: It’s not a distinction the Fremennik particularly care for. To us, he has always been a hero to be respected, not a god to be worshipped. They say he felt the same way.
translation: 费明尼克人并不特别在意这种区分。对我们来说，他始终是一位值得尊敬的英雄，而不是一个需要崇拜的神。据说他自己也这么认为。

english: We will stay strong, [Fremennik name]. We’ll... We’ll be doomed! Our army isn’t large enough to hold back the forces of the Serpent King.
translation: 我们会保持坚强，[费明尼克名字]。我们会……我们会完蛋的！我们的军队不够强大，无法抵挡蛇王的军队。

english: [Fremennik name], you’re strong. But you’re no army.
translation: [费明尼克名字]，你很强大。但你一个人不是一支军队。

english: You’re forgetting Brundt. We have the element of surprise! They don’t know we’re aware of their attack. We could have days to prepare before they make their move. We could...
translation: 你忘了布伦特。我们还有出其不意的优势！他们不知道我们已经察觉了他们的进攻。我们可能有几天的时间准备，然后他们才会行动。我们可以……

english: A cutscene starts
translation: 过场动画开始

english: Chieftain Brundt! I’m here on behalf of the Fremennik Council! We’ve heard some disturbing news about a basilisk in town.
translation: 布伦特酋长！我代表费明尼克议会前来！我们听说镇上有石化蜥蜴的坏消息。

english: Well I won’t deny there’s been a little issue but [Fremennik name] and I will soon have things back under control.
translation: 好吧，我不否认出了一些小问题，但[费明尼克名字]和我很快就会控制住局面。

english: [Fremennik name]? When will you see that this outerlander is the cause of all our problems!
translation: [费明尼克名字]？你什么时候才能明白这个外来者是我们所有问题的根源！

english: [Fremennik name] is no outerlander! He passed our trials and is a Fremennik, just like you and I.
translation: [费明尼克名字]不是外来者！他通过了我们的试炼，是费明尼克人，就像你和我一样。

english: You can disguise it all you want, but he is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let him in, we’ve had nothing but trouble! And to top it all off, now we have basilisks wandering our town. The council have had enough!
translation: 你可以随便掩饰，但他是个外来者，永远都是！自从我们让他加入以来，麻烦就没断过！更糟的是，现在还有石化蜥蜴在我们的镇上乱逛。议会受够了！

english: Do not use the name! The decision of the council is final. As Chieftain, you are honour bound to enact it.
translation: 不要提那个名字！议会的决定是最终的。作为酋长，你有义务执行它。

english: I see... Exile, you must leave our province. Our people will no longer see you as their [brother/sister].
translation: 我明白了……流放者，你必须离开我们的省份。我们的人民将不再视你为他们的[兄弟/姐妹]。

english: Chieftain Brundt gestures his head towards the south east.
translation: 布伦特酋长朝东南方向点了点头。

english: Indeed. I’m sorry [Fremennik name]. The reality is that many on the council did not take kindly to you becoming one of us. They’ve been looking for a good excuse to exile you ever since you arrived.
translation: 确实如此。对不起，[费明尼克名字]。事实是，议会中的许多人对你成为我们的一员并不友善。自从你到来后，他们一直在找借口流放你。

english: But they’re the one that voted for me in the first place!
translation: 但当初是他们投票让我加入的！

english: Well… not quite. Seven of the twelve council members gave you their vote, but you never had the support of the other five. They’re the ones who’ve been pushing for your exile.
translation: 嗯……不完全是这样。十二位议会成员中有七位投了赞成票，但你从未得到另外五位的支持。正是他们在推动你的流放。

english: I see. And they’ve used this basilisk problem to convince some of the others.
translation: 我明白了。他们利用石化蜥蜴的问题说服了其他人。

english: I don’t understand though, they’re only basilisks. Surely we have the strength to defeat them.
translation: 但我不明白，它们只是石化蜥蜴。我们肯定有力量击败它们。

english: Many years ago, before the time of V, it was a foretold that this world will end in a great battle. They called this battle Ragnarok, or more commonly, the End of Things.
translation: 许多年前，在V的时代之前，曾有预言说这个世界将在一次大战中终结。他们称这场战争为诸神黄昏，或者更常见的说法是——终结之日。

english: Well that doesn’t sound good. Where do the basilisks fit in?
translation: 听起来不妙。那石化蜥蜴又扮演什么角色？

english: Then we’d better make sure the Jormungand stays in that prison!
translation: 那我们最好确保耶梦加得一直待在那个监狱里！

english: Well, [Fremennik name], that’s why I asked you to meet me out here. If you are to help us put a stop to this threat, you’ll need to regain the trust of the council. And I think I know just how you can do that.
translation: 嗯，[费明尼克名字]，这就是我让你在这里见我的原因。如果你想帮助我们阻止这个威胁，你需要重新赢得议会的信任。我想我知道该怎么做。

english: I think the best possible way to those your worth to them is by being the person that restores V’s Shield.
translation: 我认为最能证明你价值的方式，就是成为修复V之盾的人。

english: V’s Shield?
translation: V之盾？

english: The shield used by V when he seated the Serpent King. It is legendary amongst our people. If we are to have any chance of stopping this threat, we will need to remake it. There’s a few things I know about the shield though other things are lost from stories past. I believe some members of the Moon Clan might know the detail I don’t, so your diplomatic relations should come in handy. Keep in mind, now that you’ve been exiled, most people in the province will be unlikely to talk to you.
translation: V在封印蛇王时使用的盾牌。它在我们的人民中是传奇之物。如果我们有机会阻止这个威胁，就必须重铸它。我对这面盾牌了解一些，但其他细节已经失传。我相信月亮部落的一些成员可能知道我不知道的细节，所以你的外交关系应该派上用场。记住，既然你已经被流放，省内大多数人可能不会和你说话。

english: Stories tell of how V’s Shield was made using for components. First, the base of the shield. This was a traditional Fremennik Shield, like the ones our warriors use. Next, the Lunar Glass. This was apparently created by a great Moon Clan mystic and was used to reflect the Serpent King’s gaze. Then you have the Polishing Rock. This was needed to shine the Lunar Glass. This rock was heated softly in a boiling spring. Finally, V’s Sigil. This sigil was crafted by the Moon Clan, using a unique metal known only to them.
translation: 传说V之盾由四个部件制成。首先是盾牌基底，那是一面传统的费明尼克盾，就像我们战士使用的那种。其次是月玻璃，由一位伟大的月亮部落神秘学家创造，用于反射蛇王的目光。然后是抛光石，用来打磨月玻璃，这块石头在沸腾的泉水中温和加热。最后是V的徽记，由月亮部落用一种他们独有的特殊金属打造而成。

english: Buneir gives you 100,000 coins.
translation: 布奈尔给了你100,000金币。

english: I take it you're the new butler...?
translation: 我猜你就是新来的管家……？

english: Yes, you could say that...
translation: 是的，可以这么说……

english: Yes certainly, though it will cost you 25,000 coins
translation: 当然可以，不过要花费25,000金币。

english: Caleb takes the guantlets from you, pours some herbs and seasonings on them, bakes them on his range for a short time, then hands them back to you
translation: 迦勒从你手中接过手套，倒上一些草药和调料，在炉灶上烤了一会儿，然后还给了你。

english: Caleb hands you a pair of Cooking gauntlets.
translation: 迦勒递给你一双烹饪手套。

english: Could I have another pair of Cooking gauntlets?
translation: 能再给我一双烹饪手套吗？

english: You show Callio the bone shards.
translation: 你向卡利奥展示了骨碎片。

english: You show Callio the calcified deposit.
translation: 你向卡利奥展示了钙化沉积物。

english: You show Callio the moth.
translation: 你向卡利奥展示了飞蛾。

english: The parrot has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 鹦鹉给了你一张挑战卷轴！

english: The parrot has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 鹦鹉给了你另一张线索卷轴！

english: Ah, hello there, laddie/lassie! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: 啊，你好啊，小伙子/姑娘！我刚挖出了一个我的旧宝箱。

english: Arrr, you're not the [lad/lassie] I be needin'.
translation: 啊，你不是我要找的[小伙子/姑娘]。

english: Well, obviously the actual pirating is a big part of our agenda, but we like to think of ourselves as non-regulated merchants.
translation: 嗯，显然真正的海盗行为是我们议程的重要部分，但我们更喜欢把自己看作是非正规的商人。

english: What is good plunder if you have nothing to spend it on, hmmmm?
translation: 如果没地方花钱，抢来的好东西有什么用呢，嗯？

english: Which as it turned out was very lucky for us.
translation: 结果证明这对我们来说非常幸运。

english: Anything ese you wanted to know before we set sail?
translation: 在我们起航前，你还有什么想知道的吗？

english: Ah, a connoisseur! Yes, she's name the Lady Zay, and may I say, is one of the finest ships to ever sail the seas!
translation: 啊，行家啊！是的，她叫扎伊女士，我敢说，她是航行在海上最棒的船之一！

english: Actually, the last I had heard quite a few of them had survived, and had set up a little hideaway in the remains of the shipwreck.
translation: 实际上，我上次听说，他们中有不少人活了下来，在沉船的残骸里建了个小藏身处。

english: If you're particularly worried about the, perhaps you might like to go and pay them a visit someday, and make sure to bring a lot of easily transferable wealth with you.
translation: 如果你特别担心他们，也许哪天你可以去拜访他们一下，记得带上大量容易携带的财富。

english: As long as you keep your Seal Of Passage with you at all times while you are on the island you should be okay, even if you are a Femennik.
translation: 只要你在岛上时一直带着通行印章，就应该没事，即使你是费明尼克人。

english: The ship sails in a circle around Pirates' Cove a second time
translation: 船第二次绕着海盗湾转了一圈。

english: Can you tell me something about the Moon Clan?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于月亮部落的事吗？

english: What were you doing at Lunar Isle?
translation: 你在月亮岛上做什么？

english: Can you tell me something about your ship?
translation: 你能告诉我一些关于你的船的事吗？

english: Can we sail to Lunar Isle now?
translation: 我们现在能航行去月亮岛吗？

english: Absolutely nothing at all.
translation: 完全没事。

english: The pilot has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 飞行员给了你一个谜盒！

english: The pilot has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 飞行员给了你另一张线索卷轴！

english: Fancy some 'rum', [lad/lass]? It's still fresh. Well, fresh-ish...
translation: 想来点'朗姆酒'吗，[小伙子/姑娘]？还是新鲜的。嗯，还算新鲜……

english: Boring'? You'll get nowhere with that kind of attitude! Drop and give me ten!
translation: 无聊？这种态度可不行！趴下，做十个俯卧撑！

english: You are given a gnome pilot's scarf as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一条地精飞行员围巾作为小费。

english: You are given a pair of pilot's goggles as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一副飞行员护目镜作为小费。

english: Really? Then what about that fight in Turtle Basin?
translation: 真的吗？那海龟盆地的那场战斗是怎么回事？

english: We'll see about that. (Khaled tells the player to obtain an artefact from a certain location.)
translation: 我们走着瞧。（哈立德告诉玩家从某个地点获取一件神器。）

english: (Captain Khaled takes the stolen item and hands the player some coins.)
translation: （哈立德船长拿走了偷来的物品，给了玩家一些金币。）

english: There's a demon who wants to invade this city.
translation: 有一个恶魔想要入侵这座城市。

english: Otherwise the demon will destroy the city
translation: 否则恶魔会摧毁这座城市。

english: Sir Prysin said you would give me the key
translation: 普里辛爵士说你会把钥匙给我。

english: I'd rather go to Crandor Isle.
translation: 我宁愿去克兰多岛。

english: Brave [player], have you any news about my son and his father?
translation: 勇敢的[玩家]，有我儿子和他父亲的消息吗？

english: Don't worry about it, a good deed is its own reward. And that 2000 gold didn't hurt either.
translation: 别担心，善行本身就是回报。而且那2000金币也不赖。

english: Ello, who's that?
translation: 喂，那是谁？

english: The guardian hands you an ornate magic staff.
translation: 守护者递给你一根华丽的魔法杖。

english: The chancellor hands you some water.
translation: 大臣递给你一些水。

english: You need to complete the hard tier of the Desert achievement diary and get an Agility level of 70 to use this shortcut.
translation: 你需要完成沙漠成就日记的困难等级，并且拥有70级敏捷才能使用这个捷径。

english: Please [sir/madam], can you help me.
translation: 请帮帮我，[先生/女士]。

english: You already have a sieve that will do the job in your bank.
translation: 你的银行里已经有一个能用的筛子了。

english: The guard gives you another map.
translation: 守卫给了你另一张地图。

english: Yep, fine thanks.
translation: 是的，挺好的，谢谢。

english: You show the certificate to the Fairy Coordinator.
translation: 你向仙子协调员展示了证书。

english: Sorry, I no longer want to be involved.
translation: 抱歉，我不想再参与了。

english: Greetings, Zilyana.
translation: 你好，齐莉安娜。

english: Commander, if you don't mind.
translation: 请叫我指挥官。

english: I don't, Zilyana.
translation: 我不介意，齐莉安娜。

english: Bah, find me some more cake. oh and FIND THE GODSWORD!
translation: 哼，再给我找些蛋糕来。哦，还有找到神剑！

english: I'll err... get some more cake alright?
translation: 我会……呃……再弄些蛋糕来，好吗？

english: [He/She] said 'Can you tell me any good jokes?' Got ya! Hahahaha!
translation: [他/她]说'你能讲个笑话吗？'上当了吧！哈哈哈！

english: The whole hat, apron, stripey trousers ensemble - it works. It make you lookslike a real cook.
translation: 整套帽子、围裙、条纹裤子搭配起来很协调，让你看起来像个真正的厨师。

english: Hello Cook. The Easter Bunny has run out of fuel for his egg making machine and has sent me to ask you for a favour.
translation: 你好，厨师。复活节兔子的制蛋机没燃料了，它派我来请你帮个忙。

english: I am listening.
translation: 我在听。

english: Do you by chance have any Hosidius milk? The Easter Bunny needs some to make the fuel.
translation: 你碰巧有霍西迪乌斯城的牛奶吗？复活节兔子需要一些来制作燃料。

english: I may have some lying around the kitchen, I would gladly give you some milk for the Easter Bunny.
translation: 我厨房里可能有一些，我很乐意给你一些牛奶给复活节兔子。

english: But first you must answer a riddle. If you get it right, I will give you some Hosidius milk.
translation: 但首先你得回答一个谜语。答对了，我就给你霍西迪乌斯城的牛奶。

english: I would be glad to answer a riddle for you.
translation: 我很乐意为你解答谜语。

english: Are you ready to answer my riddle?
translation: 准备好回答我的谜语了吗？

english: Yes I am ready, crack out your riddle.
translation: 是的，我准备好了，出题吧。

english: I leave my home only once a year, but do not give any Christmas cheer. Who am I?
translation: 我一年只离开家一次，但从不带来圣诞的欢乐。我是谁？

english: I am sorry but that is not quite right.
translation: 抱歉，答案不对。

english: Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: 准备好再试的时候跟我说话。

english: Congratulations, that's the right answer.
translation: 恭喜，答对了。

english: Here is the Hosidius milk I promised.
translation: 这是答应给你的霍西迪乌斯城牛奶。

english: You receive a bottle of Hosidius milk
translation: 你获得了一瓶霍西迪乌斯城牛奶

english: Filling me with eggs is bad... but I'll make a case for it.
translation: 用蛋填满我可不好……但我会为此辩护。

english: When dark and bitter, drink me warm in the winter.
translation: 当又黑又苦时，冬天趁热喝我。

english: I am round, yet not a perfect sphere. I can be cracked and not have anything inside. What am I?
translation: 我是圆的，但不是完美的球体。我可以被敲开，里面却空无一物。我是什么？

english: Not just yet, maybe later.
translation: 现在不行，也许以后吧。

english: You should probably go and give the milk to the Easter Bunny, hop to it. Don't want to keep the Easter Bunny waiting.
translation: 你最好赶紧把牛奶给复活节兔子送去，快去吧。别让复活节兔子等太久。

english: I seem to have lost the milk, do you by any chance have any more?
translation: 我好像把牛奶弄丢了，你还有多的吗？

english: Of course I do, try not to spill it this time.
translation: 当然有，这次别洒了。

english: Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already!
translation: 哦，多可爱的兔子！我都没意识到复活节已经到了！

english: *AHEM*
translation: *咳咳*

english: Cook, we're looking for some fancy eggs that we can use as decorations. You wouldn't happen to have anything, would you?
translation: 厨师，我们想找些漂亮的蛋来做装饰。你碰巧有吗？

english: The Cook digs around the back of his cupboards and produces several colourful eggs, giving them to Gregg.
translation: 厨师在柜子后面翻找，拿出几个彩蛋，递给了格雷格。

english: Well, we have some eggs now. What's next?
translation: 好吧，我们现在有蛋了。接下来呢？

english: As important as the Duke of Lumbridge is, I'm sure he won't mind waiting a little longer for the sake of Easter.
translation: 虽然仑桥镇公爵很重要，但我相信为了复活节，他不会介意多等一会儿。

english: Wait... didn't the Duke just have his birthday?
translation: 等等……公爵不是刚过完生日吗？

english: Cook, as fun as it is bringing you ingredients, don't you just burn all your cakes anyway?
translation: 厨师，虽然给你送食材很有趣，但你不是总把蛋糕烤焦吗？

english: You could try something simple like fish, perhaps?
translation: 你可以试试简单的，比如鱼？

english: The eggs you gave Gregg were just rotten ones, weren't they.
translation: 你给格雷格的蛋都是坏掉的，对吧？

english: *sigh* Do you know where he went at least?
translation: *叹气* 你至少知道他去了哪里吗？

english: I'm always happy to help a cook in distress.
translation: 我总是乐意帮助有困难的厨师。

english: I can't right now, Maybe later.
translation: 我现在没空，也许以后吧。

english: Can you make me a cake?
translation: 你能给我做个蛋糕吗？

english: Talk about Easter.
translation: 聊聊复活节。

english: Count Check.
translation: 检查伯爵。

english: Easter Bunny.
translation: 复活节兔子。

english: Father Aereck.
translation: 艾瑞克神父。

english: Bob.
translation: 鲍勃。

english: Santa.
translation: 圣诞老人。

english: River Lum.
translation: 卢姆河。

english: Sack.
translation: 麻袋。

english: Spider web.
translation: 蜘蛛网。

english: Basket.
translation: 篮子。

english: Bucket.
translation: 桶。

english: Lemon juice.
translation: 柠檬汁。

english: Beer.
translation: 啤酒。

english: Sewer water.
translation: 下水道水。

english: Butter.
translation: 黄油。

english: Chocolate.
translation: 巧克力。

english: Easter Egg.
translation: 复活节彩蛋。

english: The Grand Exchange.
translation: 大交易所。

english: Cake.
translation: 蛋糕。

english: Potato.
translation: 土豆。

english: Choc-ice.
translation: 巧克力冰棍。

english: Ask about the Easter event.
translation: 询问复活节活动。

english: I, [sir/madam], am the finest cook in all Gielinor! I can also make good time going to the bank or the sawmill.
translation: 我，[先生/女士]，是吉列诺最棒的厨师！我还能快速往返银行或锯木厂。

english: Alright [sir/madam]. I can start work immediately.
translation: 好的[先生/女士]。我可以马上开始工作。

english: When you have a full inventory of meat or fish, find a range. Look for this icon on your minimap.
translation: 当你背包里装满肉或鱼时，找个炉灶。在小地图上寻找这个图标。

english: When you have a full inventory of cooked food, drop the useless burnt food and find a bank. Look for this symbol on your minimap after climbing the stairs of the Lumbridge Castle to the top. There are numerous banks around the world, all marked with that symbol.
translation: 当你背包里装满熟食时，扔掉没用的烧焦食物，找个银行。爬上仑桥镇城堡的楼梯到顶层后，在小地图上寻找这个符号。世界各地有很多银行，都标有那个符号。

english: Look for this symbol on your minimap after climbing the stairs of the Lumbridge Castle to the top. There are numerous banks around the world, all marked with that symbol.
translation: 爬上仑桥镇城堡的楼梯到顶层后，在小地图上寻找这个符号。世界各地有很多银行，都标有那个符号。

english: Fish and meat of most varieties can be cooked very simply on either a fire or range, experiment which one works for you.
translation: 大多数种类的鱼和肉都可以在火堆或炉灶上简单烹饪，试试哪种适合你。

english: You can brew your own beers using the fermenting vats in either Keldagrim or Port Phasmatys.
translation: 你可以使用凯尔达格林城或法斯提斯港的发酵桶来酿造自己的啤酒。

english: Baked potatoes are a more advanced food and are healthy too!
translation: 烤土豆是更高级的食物，而且也很健康！

english: Use a pot of flour with a bucket of water. You will then need to make some pastry dough.
translation: 用一罐面粉和一桶水混合。然后你需要制作糕点面团。

english: Use the pastry dough with a pie dish to get a pie shell, then add your choice of filling such as apples or red berries.
translation: 将糕点面团和派烤盘一起使用得到派皮，然后加入你选择的馅料，比如苹果或红莓。

english: Now you will need to get yourself a tomato and some cheese. Use the tomato on the pizza base and then use the cheese. Cook the uncooked pizza base and there you have yourself a plain pizza.
translation: 现在你需要弄到一个番茄和一些乳酪。把番茄用在披萨饼底上，然后再用乳酪。烤制未烤熟的披萨饼底，你就得到了一个原味披萨。

english: Baked potatoes are excellent foods and they are healthy too!
translation: 烤土豆是极好的食物，而且也很健康！

english: How may I help you, [sir/madam]?
translation: 有什么能帮您的吗，[先生/女士]？

english: When you kill a target, if you've been in long enough, you'll get a crate. If you've been in there longer, you'll get a higer value crate.
translation: 当你击杀目标时，如果你在里面待得够久，你会得到一个板条箱。如果你待得更久，你会得到更高价值的板条箱。

english: well regardless, your handling of the situation with Sophia Hughes seems to have had quite an impact on them.
translation: 不过话说回来，你处理索菲娅.休斯那件事的方式，似乎对他们产生了不小的影响。

english: Ah, I see. You want me to convinve them.
translation: 啊，我明白了。你想让我说服他们。

english: The councillor gives you some poisoned sheep feed.
translation: 议员给了你一些有毒的羊饲料。

english: You show the certificate to the cow.
translation: 你把证书给牛看。

english: I'm in so much trouble, can you help?
translation: 我惹上大麻烦了，你能帮帮我吗？

english: What with?
translation: 什么事？

english: I was bad and opened my present early and now the cows tails are falling off!
translation: 我太淘气了，提前打开了礼物，结果现在牛的尾巴都掉下来了！

english: I'm not quite sure how those two things are linked... but ok.
translation: 我不太明白这两件事有什么联系……不过好吧。

english: Jack Frost saw me, and cursed me. Why else do you think my hair is green?? Oh please help! Find tails and put them back on the cows.
translation: 冰霜杰克看见了我，就诅咒了我。不然你以为我的头发为什么是绿的？？求你了，帮帮忙！找到尾巴，把它们装回牛身上。

english: Where do I find the tails?
translation: 我去哪里找尾巴？

english: They sometimes drop off if you kill them.
translation: 如果你杀了它们，有时候会掉下来。

english: Um... ok! This is possibly the weirdest thing I've ever been asked to do... But why not?
translation: 嗯……好吧！这可能是我被要求做过的最奇怪的事……但为什么不呢？

english: You show one of the relics to the curator.
translation: 你把其中一件遗物展示给馆长看。

english: You've been given a large heap of coins.
translation: 你得到了一大堆金币。

english: To each [his/her] own, I suppose.
translation: 各有所好吧，我想。

english: You wear the blindfold Daero hands you.
translation: 你戴上了达埃罗递给你的眼罩。

english: Greetings human. I am Darcor quo Narga, a guardian for the Kahlith. Are you here to serve the balance?
translation: 你好，人类。我是达尔科.夸.纳尔加，卡利斯的守护者。你是来维护平衡的吗？

english: Ello [guv/miss].
translation: 你好啊，[先生/小姐]。

english: Well you see, [guv/miss], I've got these unshakable religious convictions.
translation: 你看，[先生/小姐]，我有坚定不移的宗教信仰。

english: Well, that's because you're not a [man/woman] of the cloth are you?
translation: 嗯，那是因为你不是神职人员，对吧？

english: I didn't nick anything, [guv/miss]. I've got twenty people who'll swear blind I was...
translation: 我没偷任何东西，[先生/小姐]。有二十个人可以发誓证明我当时……

english: Trust me, [guv/miss], lots of people need help after coming into contact with the spirits we produce here.
translation: 相信我，[先生/小姐]，很多人接触了我们这里生产的烈酒后都需要帮助。

english: I might have had a bit of an overestimation problem [guv/miss]. I'm sure it won't happen again.
translation: 我可能有点高估了自己，[先生/小姐]。我保证不会再犯了。

english: No problem, [guv/miss]. Good luck with your little problem.
translation: 没问题，[先生/小姐]。祝你那个小问题好运。

english: Well, no. I don't know what you mean, but I'm sure I'll find out!
translation: 嗯，不。我不知道你什么意思，但我肯定会弄明白的！

english: Ello again [guv/miss]. How's things?
translation: 又见面了，[先生/小姐]。最近怎么样？

english: Nothin' [guv/miss], you just have a nice day.
translation: 没什么，[先生/小姐]，祝你愉快。

english: Ello again [guv/miss]. I take it you're here about the wrench?
translation: 又见面了，[先生/小姐]。我猜你是为了扳手来的？

english: Well [guv/miss], maybe that's what I want you to think.
translation: 嗯，[先生/小姐]，也许这正是我想让你以为的。

english: Let me escort you to [Edgeville/Camelot/Falador/Ferox Enclave/Kourend Castle/Lumbridge/Prifddinas], [player name].
translation: 让我护送你到[边陲镇/卡美洛/法拉多城/费罗飞地/库兰德城堡/仑桥镇/普里夫迪纳斯城]，[player name]。

english: A gravestone appears on the ground near where you died. You can go there and retrieve your items by clicking on it.
translation: 你死亡地点附近出现了一个墓碑。你可以去那里点击它取回你的物品。

english: Your gravestone would be marked with an arrow to help to spot it. A grave icon appears on the world map too, if your grave is in a mapped area.
translation: 你的墓碑上会有一个箭头标记，方便你找到它。如果你的墓地在已探索区域，世界地图上也会出现一个墓碑图标。

english: Gravestones charge a small fee to return especially valuable items, but most things are returned free of charge. Conveniently, a gravestone can take its fee straight from your bank.
translation: 墓碑会收取少量费用来归还特别贵重的物品，但大多数物品是免费归还的。方便的是，墓碑可以直接从你的银行扣除费用。

english: A gravestone does not last forever. After about 15 minutes, a gravestone will collapse. Anything in it will be sent here, to me.
translation: 墓碑不会永远存在。大约15分钟后，墓碑会坍塌。里面的所有东西都会被送到我这里。

english: Death's Coffer won't accept items worth less than 10,000 coins per item - Death doesn't want cheap junk! But more valuable items can be sacrificed to pay down future reclamation fees.
translation: 死神的保险箱不接受每件价值低于10,000金币的物品——死神可不要廉价垃圾！但更有价值的物品可以献祭，用来支付未来的回收费用。

english: A gravestone lasts for at least 15 minutes before it collapses. However, that timer pauses if you become inactive, in case you have lost your connection to the world.
translation: 墓碑至少会持续15分钟才会坍塌。不过，如果你变得不活跃，计时器会暂停，以防你与世界的连接中断。

english: A timer on your head-up display shows the remaining time before your gravestone will collapse.
translation: 你抬头显示器上的计时器会显示墓碑坍塌前的剩余时间。

english: The Items Kept on Death menu tells you roughly what your items will do when you next die, including estimating gravestone fees.
translation: “死亡时保留的物品”菜单会大致告诉你下次死亡时物品的情况，包括估算的墓碑费用。

english: I regret, [Master/Mistress], that I must insist on payment up front.
translation: 我很抱歉，[主人/女主人]，我必须坚持先付款。

english: I shall devote my every art to thy service, my [Master/Mistress].
translation: 我将倾尽所有技艺为您服务，我的[主人/女主人]。

english: Do you know of such path?
translation: 你知道这样的路吗？

english: Ah yes, and the guard hast lost the combination to your equipment room in the castle on the hill?
translation: 啊，是的，而且守卫弄丢了你在山上城堡里装备室的密码？

english: I've found a secret way up Death Plateau so I just need to find the combination and unlock the door.
translation: 我找到了一条上死亡高原的秘密通道，所以我只需要找到密码，打开门就行了。

english: Is there anything you'd like to know?
translation: 你有什么想知道的吗？

english: Yes, there is another way up Death Plateau!
translation: 是的，还有另一条路上死亡高原！

english: Denulth has given you a certificate.
translation: 德努斯给了你一张证书。

english: I'm working on it, I just need to give the certificate to Dunstan.
translation: 我正在处理，只需要把证书交给邓斯坦。

english: Yes! There is a path that runs from Sherpa's hut around the back of Death Plateau. The trolls haven't found it yet. The Sherpa made a map I can give you.
translation: 是的！有一条路从夏尔巴人的小屋后面绕过死亡高原。巨魔们还没发现它。夏尔巴人画了一张地图，我可以给你。

english: You give Denulth the map of the secret way.
translation: 你把秘密通道的地图给了德努斯。

english: You give Denulth the combination to the equipment room.
translation: 你把装备室的密码给了德努斯。

english: You are now an honourary member of the Imperial Guard!
translation: 你现在是帝国卫队的荣誉成员了！

english: I've got some climbing boots.
translation: 我有一些登山靴。

english: I've found my way into the stronghold!
translation: 我找到了进入要塞的路！

english: My name is Player.
translation: 我的名字是玩家。

english: Pleased to meet you, Player!
translation: 很高兴见到你，玩家！

english: Hello again, Player!
translation: 又见面了，玩家！

english: What kind of question is that to ask? With [his/her] great might of course!
translation: 问这种问题是什么意思？当然是靠[他/她]强大的力量！

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would [he/she]?
translation: 当然是真的！玩家不会无缘无故这么说，对吧？

english: You show the bow to Derse Venator.
translation: 你把弓展示给德尔斯.维纳托看。

english: You show the Fangs of venenatis to Derse Venator.
translation: 你把维内纳蒂斯之牙展示给德尔斯.维纳托看。

english: Derse Venator combines the items and gives you the Webweaver bow (u).
translation: 德尔斯.维纳托将物品组合起来，给了你织网弓 (未充能)。

english: You show the claws to Derse Venator.
translation: 你把爪子展示给德尔斯.维纳托看。

english: You show the skull to Derse Venator.
translation: 你把头骨展示给德尔斯.维纳托看。

english: You show the weapon piece to Derse Venator.
translation: 你把武器部件展示给德尔斯.维纳托看。

english: Dimintheis hands you a pair of Steel gauntlets.
translation: 迪明塞斯递给你一双钢手套。

english: Could I get another pair of gauntlets?
translation: 我能再要一副手套吗？

english: No thanks!
translation: 不用了，谢谢！

english: The disciple of Iban attacks the player.
translation: 伊班的门徒攻击了玩家。

english: Som Molica Aniul Demonte.
translation: 索姆.莫利卡.阿尼乌尔.德蒙特。

english: You show the squire some of your Void kit.
translation: 你向侍从展示了一些你的虚空装备。

english: Void mage helm: The squire offers you [0-160] Commendation points.
translation: 虚空法师头盔：侍从出价 [0-160] 点嘉奖点数。

english: Void melee helm: The squire offers you [0-160] Commendation points.
translation: 虚空近战头盔：侍从出价 [0-160] 点嘉奖点数。

english: Void ranger helm: The squire offers you [0-160] Commendation points.
translation: 虚空射手头盔：侍从出价 [0-160] 点嘉奖点数。

english: Void knight mace: The squire offers you [0-200] Commendation points.
translation: 虚空骑士钉锤：侍从出价 [0-200] 点嘉奖点数。

english: Elite void top: The squire offers you [0-360] Commendation points.
translation: 高级虚空上衣：侍从出价 [0-360] 点嘉奖点数。

english: Void knight top: The squire offers you [0-200] Commendation points.

english: Hello there, welcome to Lumbridge.
translation: 你好，欢迎来到仑桥镇。

english: What's with all the snow?
translation: 怎么这么多雪？

english: A particularly harsh winter for Lumbridge this year. Still, we make the best of it. I hope all our new visitors aren't getting too cold.
translation: 今年仑桥镇的冬天特别冷。不过，我们尽量过得开心。希望新来的访客们别冻着了。

english: I'm not new!
translation: 我不是新来的！

english: Oh yes, I know that.
translation: 哦，我知道。

english: Who cares about them?
translation: 谁在乎他们？

english: Well... I do.
translation: 嗯……我在乎。

english: I'm ok, though I am new around town.
translation: 我没事，不过我刚来镇上。

english: Then doubly welcome you are to Lumbridge.
translation: 那就加倍欢迎你来到仑桥镇。

english: Actually yes, I am rather cold.
translation: 其实是的，我挺冷的。

english: Well... I may be able to help there.
translation: 嗯……我或许能帮上忙。

english: Who are you calling new?
translation: 你说谁是新来的？

english: I haven't seen you around much before, that's all.
translation: 只是以前没怎么见过你而已。

english: I wonder if you might help me with a little project of mine?
translation: 我想知道你能不能帮我一个小忙？

english: Yes, I can help.
translation: 好的，我能帮忙。

english: Great! Thank you!
translation: 太好了！谢谢你！

english: So, I have seen how much extra work the Lumbridge citizens are putting in recently, what with so many new adventurers in town. I'd like to give them something back.
translation: 我注意到仑桥镇的居民最近因为镇上来了这么多新冒险者，额外做了很多工作。我想回报他们一些东西。

english: And here comes the but...
translation: 然后就要说“但是”了……

english: How did you know? But... I have to stay here in my room as I have so much paperwork to do.
translation: 你怎么知道的？但是……我得待在房间里，因为有很多文书工作要做。

english: So I'm delivering the presents? I get to be Santa?
translation: 所以我来送礼物？我当圣诞老人？

english: Um. Not quite, but nearly!
translation: 嗯。差不多，但还差一点！

english: What do you mean... not quite?
translation: 什么叫“还差一点”？

english: Well, I don't want them to see you deliver it.
translation: 嗯，我不想让他们看到是你送的。

english: What? Why? How?
translation: 什么？为什么？怎么送？

english: Well it kind of looks lazy on my part doesn't it. I'd like you to disguise yourself... as a tree.
translation: 因为这样显得我很懒。我希望你伪装成……一棵树。

english: A TREE?
translation: 一棵树？

english: Yes, a festive tree, as if I'd planted the tree near them and it's holding a present for them... isn't that a wonderful idea?
translation: 对，一棵节日树，就像我在他们附近种了一棵树，树上挂着礼物……这主意不错吧？

english: If by wonderful you mean awful... I suppose you want me to cut bits off trees and stick them to myself and decorate it with something shiny?
translation: 如果你说的“不错”是指糟糕的话……我猜你是想让我砍些树枝粘在身上，再用什么闪亮的东西装饰一下？

english: I'm leaving now.
translation: 我现在就走。

english: Oh very good... leaving... well done.
translation: 哦，很好……走吧，干得好。

english: The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should use some of their branches to decorate them.
translation: 外面的雪树看起来非常有节日气氛，你应该用它们的树枝来装饰。

english: What about a decoration on top, I don't want to be involved with creepy dolls again.
translation: 那顶上的装饰呢？我可不想再碰那些吓人的娃娃了。

english: Oh no, no, no. I think you'll be able to find something star like to put on your head, maybe from the church?
translation: 哦，不不不。我觉得你能找到星星一样的东西戴在头上，也许从教堂里？

english: Where do I get the tree branches from?
translation: 我从哪里弄树枝？

english: The snowy trees out there look so treemendously festive, you should just use some of their branches, but leave the big one alone. Just take something sharp to them. A knife or some shears should do the job.
translation: 外面的雪树看起来非常有节日气氛，你就用它们的树枝吧，但别动那棵大的。拿点锋利的东西去弄，刀或剪刀就行。

english: I don't think I can take anymore puns.
translation: 我觉得我再也受不了双关语了。

english: Stick with it, it'll soon be over.
translation: 坚持住，很快就结束了。

english: Where do I get the decoration?
translation: 我从哪里弄装饰？

english: Well, not out of my crown! Get it? Crown?
translation: 嗯，别打我的王冠主意！懂吗？王冠？

english: Must not react to pun...
translation: 不能对双关语有反应……

english: OH ok, have it your way. I noticed a barrel of old waste material near the furnace. You should be able to find some there. Oh, and don't forget you can probably borrow a star from the church.
translation: 好吧，随你便。我注意到熔炉附近有一桶废料。你应该能在那里找到一些。哦，别忘了你大概可以从教堂借一颗星星。

english: How do I put it all together?
translation: 我怎么把它们组合起来？

english: Well, thread is too light and rope is too heavy for this job... You could try some wool?
translation: 嗯，线太轻，绳子太重……你可以试试羊毛？

english: Why do I need it again?
translation: 我再问一次，我为什么需要这个？

english: To deliver my presents of course!
translation: 当然是送我的礼物！

english: Oh yeah... you're too busy to do it yourself and don't want them to know that I did it. Pretty poor excuse.
translation: 哦对……你太忙了不能亲自送，又不想让他们知道是我送的。借口真烂。

english: Hey, I have a town to run, it's not all it's cracked up to be you know.
translation: 嘿，我要管理一个镇子，这可不是什么轻松活儿。

english: That was an egg pun, wrong holiday.
translation: 那是个蛋的双关语，节日不对。

english: How very pithy of you. It wasn't meant to be a pun!
translation: 你真会说话。那本来就不是双关语！

english: No thanks, bye.
translation: 不了，谢谢，再见。

english: I see you've got your disguise sorted out, you really should wear it for it to be effective though.
translation: 我看到你准备好伪装了，不过你得穿上才有效。

english: Is that tree talking to me? I must be ill.
translation: 那棵树在跟我说话？我一定是病了。

english: And there was me thinking that yew wouldn't have made something that convincing.
translation: 我还以为紫杉树做不出这么逼真的东西呢。

english: So what do I have to do?
translation: 那我需要做什么？

english: Here, I've written it all down for you.
translation: 给你，我都写下来了。

english: Duke Horacio hands you a neatly written list.
translation: 霍拉西奥公爵递给你一张写得整整齐齐的清单。

english: How goes the job of Santa?
translation: 圣诞老人的工作怎么样了？

english: I've made some progress. But I have some questions.
translation: 有点进展了，但我有些问题。

english: Ah Hans, loyal to a fault. He walks the castle grounds all day, everyday. He really could do with a sit down, don't you think? Take my chair, just over there.
translation: 啊，汉斯，忠诚得过分。他整天在城堡里走来走去。他真该坐下来歇歇，你不觉得吗？把我的椅子拿去吧，就在那边。

english: Count Check... he's a bit of an odd one isn't he? He's obsesedwith counting. He loves counting, especially shiny things. The other day I was chatting to him and he was completely unable to take his eyes off the golden rings on my fingers. Perhaps he'd like some of those. However, they're not normal gold rings, like you would make. These I get specially from the apprentice near the furnace.
translation: 检查伯爵……他有点古怪，对吧？他痴迷于数数。他喜欢数东西，尤其是闪亮的东西。前几天我跟他聊天，他完全无法把目光从我手指上的金戒指上移开。也许他会喜欢一些那样的戒指。不过，它们不是普通的金戒指，不是你能做的那种。我是从熔炉附近的学徒那里特别弄来的。

english: The lovely Gillie. Such pure white milk she brings us daily. But she is so run off her feet. She often suggests that we should find a magic spell to duplicate her! What a notion. I'm surprised we don't hear the same complaints from Bob.
translation: 可爱的吉莉。她每天给我们送来那么纯白的牛奶。但她忙得脚不沾地。她经常建议我们找个魔法咒语复制一个她！真是异想天开。我很惊讶没听到鲍勃也有同样的抱怨。

english: Fred? Such a wholesome farmer. He does his job with the chickens and cows well. However, it wasn't his first choice of profession. He wanted to grow fruit trees you know. The one planted in the castle grounds sure did catch his eye.
translation: 弗雷德？多么淳朴的农夫。他养鸡养牛的工作做得很好。不过，那并不是他的首选职业。你知道吗，他想种果树。城堡里种的那棵果树确实吸引了他的目光。

english: He's so gloomy, everything is doom doom doom. He needs some light entertainment. I heard he used to be a friend of Party Pete, in Falador, maybe ask him.
translation: 他太阴郁了，什么事都是厄运厄运厄运。他需要一些轻松的娱乐。我听说他以前是法拉多城派对皮特的朋友，也许问问他。

english: Talk about Lumbridge holiday event.
translation: 谈谈仑桥镇的节日活动。

english: Present for Hans.
translation: 给汉斯的礼物。

english: Present for Count Check.
translation: 给检查伯爵的礼物。

english: Present for Gillie.
translation: 给吉莉的礼物。

english: Present for Farmer Fred.
translation: 给农夫弗雷德的礼物。

english: Present for Doom Sayer.
translation: 给末日预言者的礼物。

english: You give Dunstan the certificate.
translation: 你把证书给了邓斯坦。

english: You give Dunstan an iron bar and the climbing boots.
translation: 你把一个铁锭和登山靴给了邓斯坦。

english: Dunstan has given you the spiked boots.
translation: 邓斯坦给了你钉鞋。

english: Dunstan has given you a challenge scroll!

english: Dunstan has given you another clue scroll!

english: Eblis gives you a little signet. Its shape matches the icon you saw on the altar in the pyramid.
translation: 埃布利斯给了你一个小印章。它的形状和你之前在金字塔祭坛上看到的图标一致。

english: You show the icon to Eblis.
translation: 你把图标给埃布利斯看。

english: You've been given an Ancient sceptre.
translation: 你得到了一根古代权杖。

english: Please accept my apologies! I thought you were but some opportunistic thief, looking to steal what heritage we have left! Now I see that you are in fact a brave adventurer,
translation: 请接受我的道歉！我还以为你只是个投机取巧的盗贼，想偷走我们仅存的遗产！现在我明白了，你其实是个勇敢的冒险者。

english: Yes, I will go get those for you.
translation: 好的，我去帮你拿那些东西。

english: Why is this village so hostile?
translation: 为什么这个村子这么有敌意？

english: No, I want to hear this story.
translation: 不，我想听这个故事。

english: I don't care about your story.
translation: 我不在乎你的故事。

english: Do you know anything about treasure near here?
translation: 你知道这附近有什么宝藏吗？

english: Do you know anything about a fortress near here?
translation: 你知道这附近有什么要塞吗？

english: Tell me of The four diamonds of Azzanadra
translation: 告诉我关于阿扎纳德拉四颗钻石的事。

english: No, please repeat those ingredients.
translation: 不，请重复那些材料。

english: Player: I still need to pour one more bucket of water on the soil.
translation: 玩家：我还需要往土壤上再倒一桶水。

english: The player and Edmond pull on the rope, opening the grill on the pipe.
translation: 玩家和埃德蒙一起拉绳子，打开了管道上的格栅。

english: Twas the 312th day of decade 47. Byrne, a farmer by trade, is said to have witnessed a lizardman guard murder a child whilst working his farm.
translation: 那是第47个十年的第312天。据说一个名叫伯恩的农夫在农场干活时，目睹了一个蜥蜴人守卫杀害了一个孩子。

english: I've completed all of the easy tasks in my Western achievement diary!
translation: 我已经完成了西部成就日记中的所有简单任务！

english: This banner is a symbol of your exploration of the Western Provinces. You now have a 25% change of 2 Chompy birds appearing when hunting and Rantz will provide you with 25 free ogre arrows every day.
translation: 这面旗帜象征着你探索了西部省份。现在你狩猎时有25%的几率出现2只Chompy鸟，并且兰茨每天会免费提供25支食人魔箭。

english: Well that's the thing... I don't really know any more. It turns out the king was lying to me.
translation: 问题就在这……我也不知道更多了。原来国王一直在骗我。

english: No, I'm [player name]! Lord Iorwerth said you might be able to help me.
translation: 不，我是[玩家名]！伊尔沃斯领主说你可能能帮我。

english: You show the tracker the crystal pendant.
translation: 你把水晶吊坠给追踪者看。

english: That is Lord Iorwerth's pendant. He must have a lot of faith in you. Now, what is it I can help you with?
translation: 那是伊尔沃斯领主的吊坠。他一定很信任你。那么，我能帮你什么？

english: As it goes I'm not actually tracking them at the moment. I'm currently trying to trace our renegade brethen instead. This here is the best lead we've found so far.
translation: 其实我现在不是在追踪他们。我目前正在追踪我们那些叛逃的同胞。这是我们目前找到的最好线索。

english: Getting there.
translation: 快到了。

english: In this chamber you will see various piles of shapes. You can pick up these shapes and enchant them using the enchant jewelry spells. By enchanting these shapes, you'll be converting them into orbs which you can be placed in the hole in the centre. You will get Enchantment Pizazz Points for every ten shapes that you convert and the points you get depends on the level of enchantment spell you cast. You will get a bonus Pizazz Point for enchanting a certain shape at a certain time, which I will periodically shout out. You will also be rewarded with an item for every so many orbs you deposit into the hole.
translation: 在这个密室里，你会看到各种形状的堆叠。你可以捡起这些形状，用附魔珠宝法术附魔它们。通过附魔这些形状，你会将它们转化为能量球，然后可以放入中央的洞中。每转化十个形状，你就会获得附魔皮萨兹点数，点数多少取决于你施放的附魔法术等级。如果你在特定时间附魔特定形状，我会定期喊出，你将获得额外皮萨兹点数。此外，每向洞中存入一定数量的能量球，你还会获得一件物品作为奖励。

english: Where is the guard that was on last night staying?
translation: 昨晚值班的守卫住在哪里？

english: Hmm. Harold has got in trouble a few over his drinking and gambling. Perhaps he'd open up after a drink?
translation: 嗯。哈罗德因为喝酒和赌博惹过几次麻烦。也许喝一杯后他会敞开心扉？

english: You said Harold had a weakness?
translation: 你说哈罗德有个弱点？

english: Eohric has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 奥里克给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Eohric has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 奥里克又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Uhld? I've seen that inscribed on that big old statue down below, what's that about?
translation: 乌尔德？我在下面那个大雕像上见过这个铭文，那是怎么回事？

english: Did the... Err, Gunnites, return?
translation: 那些……呃，冈尼特人，回来了吗？

english: The beggar throws a cabbage at you with disdain.
translation: 乞丐轻蔑地朝你扔了一个卷心菜。

english: Thank you [sir/m'lady]. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: 谢谢你，[先生/女士]。变成一只鸡真是烦死了。我该怎么感谢你呢？

english: I am not a slave, I am a free man!
translation: 我不是奴隶，我是自由人！

english: You catch a... what is this?? Is this a fish?? And... it's cooked already??
translation: 你抓到一条……这是什么？？这是鱼吗？？而且……已经煮熟了？？

english: You heard me! There's the cold fire, by the trees, now get uncooking
translation: 你没听错！树旁边有冷火，快别煮了。

english: Evil Dave escorts you into the demonic throne room.
translation: 邪恶戴夫护送你进入恶魔王座室。

english: I mean, the whole room was frozen in time at the moment the culinomancer cast his spell, right?
translation: 我的意思是，整个房间在烹饪法师施法的那一刻被冻结了，对吧？

english: Because otherwise you won't be saved from the culinomancer's spell.
translation: 否则你就无法从烹饪法师的法术中得救。

english: By using 'evil' as a term of praise...
translation: 通过使用'邪恶'作为赞美之词……

english: I am sure you won't get any problems. Speak to the Curator of Varrock's Museum.
translation: 我相信你不会遇到任何问题。去和维洛克博物馆的馆长谈谈。

english: Yes I certainly am.
translation: 是的，我当然是。

english: The study of planets and the history of worlds.
translation: 研究行星和世界的历史。

english: The examiner has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 考官给了你一个谜盒！

english: The examiner gives you another clue scroll!
translation: 考官又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Alright I'll try and get it.
translation: 好吧，我会试着拿到它。

english: Yes, I certainly am.
translation: 是的，我当然是。

english: The study of planets, and the history of worlds.
translation: 研究行星和世界的历史。

english: I was just... Processing. I suppose I could allow you another chance to obtain a piece of equipment, but it won't be guaranteeed.
translation: 我刚才只是在……处理。我想我可以再给你一次获得装备的机会，但不保证一定能得到。

english: Eyatalli hands you a new [item given].
translation: 埃亚塔利递给你一件新的[给予的物品]。

english: I see-a by your face dat you have-a not-a heard of-a me. Irrespettoso, eet iz no eemportance. You weesh-a to know sometheeng else or no?
translation: 我从你的脸上看出你没听说过我。不敬，但这不重要。你还想知道别的吗？

english: Where's the Fairy Queen?
translation: 仙子女王在哪里？

english: How-a much do ya know about-a fairy folk, my beeg friend?
translation: 你对仙子一族了解多少，我的大朋友？

english: Well, let-a me enlighten yous. Zanaris iz-a nexus of-a da worlds. Da Queen Bee, she iz-a da guardian of-a all da folk dat live-a in Zanaris.
translation: 好吧，让我来告诉你。扎纳里斯城是各个世界的枢纽。女王蜂，她是所有生活在扎纳里斯城居民的守护者。

english: I don't have the Fairy Queen's secateurs with me.
translation: 我没带仙子女王的修枝剪。

english: I obtained this pair of Enchanted secateurs, I think they must contain the Queen's missing magic.
translation: 我得到了这把附魔修枝剪，我想它一定包含了女王丢失的魔法。

english: You show the certificate to the Godfather.
translation: 你向教父出示了证书。

english: The Fairy Godfather has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 仙子教父给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: The Fairy Godfather has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 仙子教父又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Where is the Fairy Queen?
translation: 仙子女王在哪里？

english: Ello, sugar. I'm afraid I can't gossip right now, I've got a cake in the oven.
translation: 嗨，亲爱的。恐怕我现在不能闲聊，我烤箱里还有蛋糕呢。

english: You show the certificate to the Fairy chef.
translation: 你向仙子厨师出示了证书。

english: E went MOO MOO MOO all night.
translation: 他整晚都在哞哞叫。

english: Course, the weather were better back then.
translation: 当然，那时候天气更好。

english: Them dwarves won't pay decent price anymore.
translation: 那些矮人再也不肯出好价钱了。

english: Hello, young [sir/lady]. Did you want to work on my farm?
translation: 你好，年轻的[先生/女士]。你想在我的农场工作吗？

english: Hey, young [sir/lady], do you know what you're doing in there?
translation: 嘿，年轻的[先生/女士]，你知道你在里面干什么吗？

english: Alright, young [sir/lady], I won't. Talk to me if you ever want a reminder.
translation: 好吧，年轻的[先生/女士]，我不会的。如果你想提醒，就跟我说话。

english: Watch yourself, don't trample on any of me cabbages or I'll thump ya.
translation: 小心点，别踩到我的卷心菜，否则我会揍你。

english: Oi, what are you doing with my cabbage! Give it back!
translation: 喂，你拿我的卷心菜干什么！还回来！

english: I better not see you with my cabbages again!
translation: 最好别再让我看到你拿我的卷心菜！

english: Father Aereck has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 艾瑞克神父给了你一个挑战卷轴！

english: Father Aereck has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 艾瑞克神父又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Welcome to the church of the egg.
translation: 欢迎来到蛋之教堂。

english: What do you mean egg?
translation: 你说蛋是什么意思？

english: Surely you've heard of the almighty egg?
translation: 你肯定听说过全能的蛋吧？

english: The one who guides us through such troubled times.
translation: 那位在如此动荡的时代指引我们的存在。

english: The Duke is his voice and he is the commander, he will lead us to eternal happiness.
translation: 公爵是他的声音，他是指挥官，他将带领我们走向永恒的幸福。

english: Oh, THAT egg..
translation: 哦，那个蛋啊……

english: There... is only one egg...
translation: 只有……一个蛋……

english: Aargh! Avaunt foul creature from another dimension! Avaunt! Begone in the name of the Egg!
translation: 啊！滚开，来自异次元的邪恶生物！滚开！以蛋之名退散！

english: That's lucky, I need someone to do a quest for me, but the Duke told me not to mingle with you.
translation: 真巧，我需要有人帮我做个任务，但公爵告诉我不要和你来往。

english: Maybe I should come back after I've finished with the Duke.
translation: 也许我应该等和公爵谈完后再回来。

english: Ok, let me help then.
translation: 好吧，那我来帮忙。

english: Thank you, the problem is, uh...well...there's a goat haunting my graveyard.
translation: 谢谢，问题是，呃……嗯……有只山羊在我的墓地里作祟。

english: Goat? Don't you mean ghost?
translation: 山羊？你不是说幽灵吗？

english: Well yes and no, it's a ghost goat.
translation: 嗯，既是也不是，是一只幽灵山羊。

english: Sounds like you have a restless goat problem!
translation: 听起来你遇到了不安分的山羊问题！

english: Now is not the time for jokes, are you going to help me or not?
translation: 现在不是开玩笑的时候，你到底帮不帮我？

english: Yeah might as well, I'll go take a look.
translation: 好吧，我去看看。

english: Thank you friend, be safe out there.
translation: 谢谢你，朋友，外面小心。

english: Oh well. If you do have some spare time on your paws, come back and talk to me.
translation: 哦，好吧。如果你有空闲时间，回来找我谈谈。

english: I need you to rid me of the ghost goat that is haunting my graveyard.
translation: 我需要你帮我除掉在我墓地里作祟的幽灵山羊。

english: Got it, I'll get back to it.
translation: 明白了，我这就去办。

english: Church of the egg?
translation: 蛋之教堂？

english: Oh, THAT egg...
translation: 哦，那个蛋啊……

english: Sorry, I don't have time right now
translation: 抱歉，我现在没时间。

english: Ask about the ghost.
translation: 问问关于幽灵的事。

english: Try and keep it happy too,wily cats can be a little nasty when they're cranky.
translation: 也要尽量让它开心，狡猾的猫在烦躁时可能会有点讨厌。

english: You give Femi 1000 coins.
translation: 你给了费米1000金币。

english: Femi sneaks the Player inside the Grand Tree
translation: 费米偷偷把玩家带进了大树家园。

english: Ok then, here you go.
translation: 好吧，给你。

english: Ferain gives you 100,000 coins.
translation: 费兰给了你10万金币。

english: Course not. Don't even 'ave t' fix a price!
translation: 当然不。连价钱都不用谈！

english: Jump! 'Cmon boy, Jump!
translation: 跳啊！来吧小子，跳！

english: Jump! 'Cmon girl, Jump!
translation: 跳啊！来吧姑娘，跳！

english: I don't suppose you have any idea where I could find a flower from across the sea, do you?
translation: 我想你也不知道我在哪里能找到一朵来自海外的花，对吧？

english: Look for this icon on the minimap to find fishing spots, they will move as the fish swim around so you can't be lazy.
translation: 在小地图上寻找这个图标来找到钓鱼点，它们会随着鱼群游动而移动，所以你不能偷懒。

english: Ahoy, small net fishin' you can do just south of Draynor Village and in these very spots here. Aye.
translation: 啊，用小网捕鱼可以在德雷诺村南边和这里进行。是的。

english: Shrimp and anchovies can be caught with your small fishin' net.
translation: 用你的小渔网可以捕到虾和凤尾鱼。

english: Aye, you can net yourself some big fish in Catherby, which is a good place to fish for most things, Gar!
translation: 啊，你可以在凯瑟比镇用网捕到大鱼，那里是钓大多数鱼的好地方，嘎！

english: Mackrel and Cod will form the backbone of your catch when big net fishin'.. except for the added extras...
translation: 用大网捕鱼时，鲭鱼和鳕鱼会是你的主要收获……除了额外的惊喜……

english: Aye, rod fishin' can be practiced here at these spots, as well as south of Draynor Village and in the Lumbridge river, depending upon your experience. You can get bait at any fishin' shop, there be one in Port Sarim.
translation: 啊，竿钓可以在这些地方进行，也可以在德雷诺村南边和仑桥镇的河里，取决于你的经验。你可以在任何渔具店买到鱼饵，沙林港就有一家。

english: With a rod you can catch pike, sardines and herring. Good eating on them.
translation: 用鱼竿你可以钓到狗鱼、沙丁鱼和鲱鱼。味道不错。

english: The art of fly fishin' can be done in rivers, so the Lumbridge river here would suffice.
translation: 飞蝇钓法可以在河流中进行，所以仑桥镇的河就足够了。

english: Aye, you can catch yourself a delicious trout or salmon.
translation: 啊，你可以钓到美味的鳟鱼或鲑鱼。

english: Arrr, Lobster pots can be used from the pier on the island of Karamja.
translation: 啊，龙虾笼可以在卡拉姆詹岛的码头上使用。

english: In Lobster pots you can catch lobsters. They're tasty after thems cooked.
translation: 用龙虾笼可以捕到龙虾。煮熟后味道鲜美。

english: Arrr, you can also use your harpoon from the pier on the island of Karamja.
translation: 啊，你也可以在卡拉姆詹岛的码头上使用鱼叉。

english: With it you can catch Tuna and Swordfish.
translation: 用它你可以捕到金枪鱼和剑鱼。

english: ... and shark.
translation: ……还有鲨鱼。

english: The flax keeper exchanges your flax for bowstrings.
translation: 亚麻管理员会用你的亚麻交换弓弦。

english: Not today
translation: 今天不了

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 1000 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: 但对你，我要你献上1000条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼。

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 800 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: 但对你，我要你献上800条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼。

english: But for you, I would have you offer me 600 raw shark, raw manta ray, raw sea turtle and raw bass.
translation: 但对你，我要你献上600条生鲨鱼、生魔鬼鱼、生海龟和生鲈鱼。

english: I have an egg for you
translation: 我有个蛋给你

english: This icon denotes a Spinning Wheel on the world map.
translation: 这个图标在世界地图上表示纺车。

english: I need [1..19] more before I can pay you.
translation: 我还需要[1..19]个才能付钱给你。

english: None of that sounds at all boring, I look forward to finding your book.
translation: 那些听起来一点都不无聊，我期待找到你的书。

english: What?! I've literally killed many dragons that threatened to kill everyone, I think I'm ready for a boar hunt.
translation: 什么？！我明明杀过很多威胁要杀死所有人的龙，我觉得我已经准备好去猎野猪了。

english: Forestry? Don't you look after pheasants as well?
translation: 林业？你不是也照看野鸡吗？

english: In a way, though I find them a little freaky!
translation: 在某种程度上，不过我觉得它们有点古怪！

english: You see, the forests have woken up and we need those trained in the way of the forester now more than ever!
translation: 你看，森林已经苏醒了，我们现在比以往任何时候都更需要受过护林员训练的人！

english: You know, tending to the woodland with your fellow foresters so it may flourish!
translation: 你知道，和你的护林员同伴一起照料林地，让它茁壮成长！

english: And, of course, drinking plenty of tea to fuel yourself!
translation: 当然，还要喝大量的茶来补充体力！

english: Sounds interesting, how can I get started?
translation: 听起来很有趣，我该怎么开始？

english: I'd recommend spending some more time in the forests before embarking on your forestry journey.
translation: 我建议你在开始林业之旅之前，先在森林里多待些时间。

english: Come back when you can fell a mighty oak!
translation: 等你能砍倒一棵高大的橡树时再来吧！

english: I'll bear that in mind. Thanks for the information.
translation: 我会记住的。谢谢你的信息。

english: You seem like you know your way around the forests.
translation: 你看起来对森林很熟悉。

english: To get started with forestry, I can sell you a Forestry kit for a reasonable price.
translation: 要开始林业，我可以以合理的价格卖给你一个林业套件。

english: Need to make sure our foresters are committed, you know?
translation: 得确保我们的护林员是认真的，你懂吧？

english: Then all you need to do is chop some trees while you have the kit on you and the woodland will do the rest!
translation: 然后你只需要带着套件砍些树，剩下的林地会自己搞定！

english: Oh, and if you find any anima-infused bark while tending to the forests, I'll gladly trade with you.
translation: 哦，如果你在照料森林时发现任何注入灵能的树皮，我很乐意和你交易。

english: I'll have a look at your shop, thanks.
translation: 我会看看你的商店，谢谢。

english: Good luck on your adventure!
translation: 祝你的冒险好运！

english: Oh there once was a dwarf named Tonalo! He started a fight with a buffalo!'
translation: 哦，从前有个矮人叫托纳洛！他和一头水牛打了起来！

english: He kicked and he punched, it was quite the show! But he tripped on a rock and stubbed his toe!'
translation: 他又踢又打，真是场好戏！但他被石头绊倒，撞伤了脚趾！

english: Fycie has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 菲西又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Welcome to the vinery, young [man/lady]. Can I help you?
translation: 欢迎来到葡萄园，年轻的[先生/女士]。需要帮忙吗？

english: A Saradominist priest who was staying here told them too.
translation: 一位住在这里的萨拉多明祭司也告诉他们了。

english: You don't seem to notice much. Do you even live here?
