translation: 既然你身上有材料，为什么不自己去问她呢？

english: Witches aren't that scary. I'm sure Aggie is lovely once you get to know her.
translation: 女巫没那么可怕。我相信阿吉熟悉了之后会很可爱的。

english: Poor guy.
translation: 可怜的家伙。

english: So, uh... what am I meant to be doing again?
translation: 那么，呃……我到底要做什么来着？

english: This seems... awfully convoluted.
translation: 这看起来……也太复杂了吧。

english: So long, human! I'll be here if you need anything.
translation: 再见，人类！需要什么就来找我。

english: I can give you more flowers, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 我可以再给你一些花，但你得先腾出点口袋空间。

english: I can give you another IOU, but you'd need to make more space in your pockets first.
translation: 我可以再给你一张借条，但你得先腾出点口袋空间。

english: Gregg quickly scratches up a new IOU for 5 coins.
translation: 格雷格飞快地写了一张新的5金币借条。

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers.
translation: 格雷格又递给你一束淡色花。

english: Gregg hands you another bunch of pastel-coloured flowers and an IOU for 5 coins.
translation: 格雷格又递给你一束淡色花和一张5金币的借条。

english: You need to take them to the witch who makes dyes you mentioned. Aggie, I think her name.
translation: 你得把它们拿去给你说的那个做染料的女巫。她叫阿吉，我记得。

english: I just thought you might like more than one load of paint.
translation: 我只是觉得你可能需要不止一份颜料。

english: Hmmm... maybe, but let's get one first and see how we get on.
translation: 嗯……也许吧，但先弄一份看看情况再说。

english: Could I have some coins instead?
translation: 能给我一些金币吗？

english: Which witch, sorry?
translation: 哪个女巫，抱歉？

english: Gregg, I have something we can use as paint!
translation: 格雷格，我有东西可以当颜料！

english: Wait... gah, I could have sworn I had it on me!
translation: 等等……啊，我明明记得带在身上的！

english: You give Gregg the thickened dye.
translation: 你把浓缩染料给了格雷格。

english: There's one right there. Maybe we can use it?
translation: 那里就有一扇门。也许我们可以用它？

english: I've worked with Ned in the past; he's a nice guy. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: 我以前和内德合作过，他人不错。我相信他不会介意的。

english: Aggie mentioned people in Draynor could use some cheer. I'm sure he won't mind.
translation: 阿吉提到德雷诺的人需要点欢乐。我相信他不会介意的。

english: Let me get my brushes and...
translation: 让我拿上刷子……

english: The camera fades to black. Sounds of painting are heard. The camera fades back in, and Ned's house door is painted cyan.
translation: 画面渐黑。传来涂漆的声音。画面重新亮起，内德家的门被漆成了青色。

english: The Cook can now be asked about the Easter event.
translation: 现在可以问厨师关于复活节活动的事了。

english: I don't mean to be a critic, but I had imagined it looking more... inspired.
translation: 我不是想批评，但我本来以为它会看起来更有……创意。

english: Well, Aggie only mentioned the one colour of dye so we're stuck there.
translation: 嗯，阿吉只提到了一种颜色的染料，所以我们只能这样了。

english: Hmm... I don't, but I think I might know someone who does.
translation: 嗯……我没有，但我想我可能认识有鸡蛋的人。

english: There's a Cook in Lumbridge that everyone gives eggs to. He's bound to have some fancy eggs for us.
translation: 仑桥镇有个厨师，大家都把鸡蛋给他。他肯定有一些漂亮的鸡蛋给我们。

english: Gregg can now be found at the kitchen, and the Cook talks sense again.
translation: 格雷格现在可以在厨房找到，厨师也恢复正常了。

english: But I'm not wearing a...
translation: 但我没穿……

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3214, 0).
translation: 玩家被看到在仑桥城堡后面（坐标约3201, 3214, 0）施放了一个不可打断的自我传送（不是兔子的传送他人）。

english: ... hat!
translation: ……帽子！

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) behind the Lumbridge castle (location in proximity of 3201, 3215, 0).
translation: 玩家被看到在仑桥城堡后面（坐标约3201, 3215, 0）施放了一个不可打断的自我传送（不是兔子的传送他人）。

english: Ok! I'm gonna hang around here for a little bit, so come talk to me if you change your mind. Otherwise, I'll see you there!
translation: 好！我在这儿待一会儿，如果你改变主意就来找我。不然我们那儿见！

english: Wait, you're a rabbit. How can you even teleport?
translation: 等等，你是只兔子。你怎么会传送？

english: I just use magic.
translation: 我只是用魔法而已。

english: I didn't know rabbits could use magic!
translation: 我不知道兔子还会用魔法！

english: You make a good point...
translation: 你说得对……

english: Wait, aren't I supposed to be meeting you somewhere else?
translation: 等等，我不是应该在别的地方见你吗？

english: Can you remind me where I'm meant to be meeting you?
translation: 你能提醒我该在哪儿见你吗？

english: Gregg can now be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: 格雷格现在可以在仑桥镇北边的羊圈里找到。

english: Gregg can no longer be found at the kitchen.
translation: 格雷格不再出现在厨房。

english: That's a sheep.
translation: 那是只羊。

english: Hmm... I'm not entirely sure why that's there.
translation: 嗯……我也不太确定它为什么在那儿。

english: I'd hope so, maybe I'll ask him about it later.
translation: 希望如此，也许我之后会问问他。

english: Oh, that's The Thing.
translation: 哦，那是“那东西”。

english: We've tried explaining this to Fred the Farmer, but he thinks it's some kind of chicken-eating shapeshifting demon.
translation: 我们跟农夫弗雷德解释过，但他觉得那是某种吃鸡的变形恶魔。

english: The man won't shear his own sheep!
translation: 那家伙连自己的羊都不剪毛！

english: Whichever advernturerswalk by that he can talk into doing it.
translation: 哪个路过的冒险者被他忽悠着去干。

english: ... Yes.
translation: ……是的。

english: Those agents are still there...?
translation: 那些特工还在那儿？

english: They're KGP agents sent from the Iceberg to collect information on Farmer Fred and his sheep.
translation: 他们是冰山派来的KGP特工，来收集农夫弗雷德和他的羊的情报。

english: They thought the sheep were also secret agents placed to stop them taking over Gielinor.
translation: 他们以为这些羊也是阻止他们占领吉列诺的秘密特工。

english: Yeah, they have war machines built up and everything.
translation: 是啊，他们连战争机器都造好了。

english: Never felt better, actually.
translation: 其实感觉好多了。

english: I could shear the sheep for you if you'd like?
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以帮你给羊剪毛。

english: I've gotten this far without those good-for-nothing bankers, thank you very much!
translation: 没有那些没用的银行家，我也走到了这一步，多谢了！

english: Gregg hands you a pair of shears.
translation: 格雷格递给你一把剪刀。

english: I see you brought your own shears. Wonderful!
translation: 我看到你自带剪刀了。太好了！

english: I'm very aware of the state of my inventory, thank you.
translation: 我很清楚我的背包状况，谢谢。

english: Could I have some shears, please?
translation: 能给我一把剪刀吗？

english: Gregg hands you another pair of shears.
translation: 格雷格又递给你一把剪刀。

english: Not too bad, actually.
translation: 其实还不错。

english: I'm gonna go back to sheep shearing.
translation: 我要回去剪羊毛了。

english: Your hint is; you had some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: 提示：你有一把剪刀，而且我们站在羊圈里。

english: So... I should be shearing some sheep?
translation: 所以……我应该去剪羊毛？

english: Yep! Bring me the wool after you're done! We need [3/2/1] more piece[s]!
translation: 对！剪完后把羊毛给我！我们还需要[3/2/1]块！

english: Your hint is; you have some shears, and we're stood inside a sheep pen.
translation: 提示：你有一把剪刀，而且我们站在羊圈里。

english: I didn't know that!
translation: 我不知道！

english: You hand Gregg [1/2/3] piece[s] of wool.
translation: 你把[1/2/3]块羊毛递给格雷格。

english: Thanks, human! But we still need [2/1] more wool!
translation: 谢谢，人类！但我们还需要[2/1]块羊毛！

english: And you're a small rabbit.
translation: 而你是一只小兔子。

english: Where...?
translation: 哪里……？

english: Hmm... some ribbons might look nice.
translation: 嗯……一些丝带可能看起来不错。

english: Uh... not really. The only place I can think of that does any kind of fabrics is Thessalia's Fine Clothes in Varrock.
translation: 呃……不太清楚。我能想到的唯一卖布料的地方是维洛克城的特萨莉亚精品服装店。

english: But I'm not wearing any...
translation: 但我没穿任何……

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) between the Varrock general store and Thessalia's Fine Clothes store (location in proximity of 3212, 3416, 0).
translation: 玩家被看到在维洛克城杂货店和特萨莉亚精品服装店之间（坐标约3212, 3416, 0）施放了一个不可打断的自我传送（不是兔子的传送他人）。

english: ... boots!
translation: ……靴子！

english: Gregg can no longer be found in the sheep pen north of Lumbridge.
translation: 格雷格不再出现在仑桥镇北边的羊圈里。

english: What do you know about the dark wizards?
translation: 你对黑暗巫师了解多少？

english: A demon? Outside of Varrock? Surely the King should do something about that?
translation: 一个恶魔？在维洛克城外？国王难道不该管管吗？

english: So what are we going to do about it?
translation: 那我们该怎么办？

english: Conventientlyignore the problem by teleporting around it!
translation: 方便地忽略问题，用传送绕过去！

english: That does sound like a good plan, to be fair.
translation: 说实话，这听起来确实是个好计划。

english: They're still there? I thought they would have cleared off after I killed their demon...
translation: 它们还在？我以为我杀了它们的恶魔后它们就会离开……

english: Yeah, I managed to banish him again with some help from the gypsy in town.
translation: 是啊，我在镇上那个吉普赛人的帮助下又把它赶走了。

english: Eh, most shopkeepers don't seem to care that you managed to save the world.
translation: 呃，大多数店主似乎并不在乎你拯救了世界。

english: Thessalia's Fine Clothes?
translation: 塞萨利亚精品服装店？

english: Isn't she just going to make some Easter reference that you'll get upset about?
translation: 她是不是又要提复活节，然后让你不高兴？

english: Hey, cheer up! At least you're making other people feel happy.
translation: 嘿，振作点！至少你让别人开心了。

english: You're an Easter bunny, so obviously you remind people of Easter, which is a great time for a lot of people.
translation: 你是复活节兔子，所以显然你会让人想起复活节，对很多人来说那是个美好的时光。

english: Even if you don't like it, you being around makes people think of festive times and is a surefire way to get smiles on faces.
translation: 即使你不喜欢，你的存在也会让人想到节日，而且肯定能让人脸上露出笑容。

english: Oh, uh... I'm sure it's nothing.
translation: 哦，呃……我肯定没什么。

english: Anyway, we were hoping you could help us with something.
translation: 总之，我们希望你能帮我们个忙。

english: We were hoping you might have some ribbons that we could use as decorations.
translation: 我们希望你可能有一些丝带可以用来做装饰。

english: Didn't you just have trouble using shears?
translation: 你刚才不是用剪刀都有困难吗？

english: Thessalia starts gathering up several offcuts of fabric.
translation: 塞萨利亚开始收集几块布料边角料。

english: Gregg's attention is grabbed by an extremely silly hat.
translation: 格雷格的注意力被一顶极其滑稽的帽子吸引住了。

english: I love it! Can I have it!
translation: 我喜欢！能给我吗？

english: Well, it was designed for humans, not rabbits.
translation: 嗯，这是为人设计的，不是为兔子。

english: Gregg puts the hat away.
translation: 格雷格把帽子收了起来。

english: Thessalia hands Gregg a box full of offcuts and spare fabric.
translation: 塞萨利亚递给格雷格一个装满边角料和多余布料的盒子。

english: That doesn't sound too ridiculous, actually. What do we need?
translation: 实际上听起来没那么离谱。我们需要什么？

english: If you want planks, your best bestis heading to the lumberyard and talking to the sawmill operator.
translation: 如果你想要木板，最好去木材场找锯木厂操作员谈谈。

english: No thanks. We'll be on our way to the lumberyard in a bit.
translation: 不了，谢谢。我们一会儿就去木材场。

english: I think that's part of the problem.
translation: 我觉得这是问题的一部分。

english: I think we were going to the lumberyard to the north-east of Varrock to get some planks.
translation: 我想我们是要去维洛克城东北边的木材场弄些木板。

english: Hey, I got you this...
translation: 嘿，我给你弄了这个……

english: The sudden thought of XP waste prevents you from handing over the plank to Gregg.
translation: 突然想到浪费经验值，你没能把木板递给格雷格。

english: Well, here we are. Now all we need to do is get some planks.
translation: 好了，我们到了。现在只需要弄些木板。

english: Come to think of it, I've never actually seen anyone working in there...
translation: 说起来，我其实从没见过有人在里面工作……

english: I dunno, probably off the Grand Exchange.
translation: 不知道，大概是从大交易所买的。

english: I was just going to run screaming into the Wilderness and hope for the best.
translation: 我本来打算尖叫着跑进荒野，然后听天由命。

english: Eh, it beats hanging around the Grand Exchange all day.
translation: 呃，总比整天在大交易所闲逛好。

english: Huh... I could've sworn there was someone in there at some point.
translation: 嗯……我发誓以前那里有人的。

english: There might be a bell, have a look.
translation: 可能有个铃铛，找找看。

english: Do you know how expensive planks are? If I'm buying planks, they're exclusively for repairing the furniture I plan on breaking!
translation: 你知道木板有多贵吗？如果我要买木板，那绝对是用来修我打算砸坏的家具！

english: Well if you find a better way of constructiontraining, let me know.
translation: 如果你找到更好的训练建造技能的方法，告诉我一声。

english: Are you sure you don't want me to go?
translation: 你确定不要我去吗？

english: Woah, are you alright?
translation: 哇，你没事吧？

english: I didn't even know there were cats in there to begin with!
translation: 我根本不知道那里有猫！

english: I guess the lumberyard is a popular spot for cats...
translation: 看来木材场是猫喜欢去的地方……

english: So we can make the door now?
translation: 那我们现在能做门了吗？

english: Time passes...
translation: 时间流逝……

english: The camera fades to black. Sounds of nails being hit with a hammer are heard.
translation: 画面渐黑。传来钉子被锤子敲击的声音。

english: The camera fades back to view.
translation: 画面重新亮起。

english: Gregg shows off the completed door.
translation: 格雷格展示做好的门。

english: That looks... surprisinggood, actually.
translation: 看起来……意外地不错。

english: Draynor becomes decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: 德雷诺村的地上装饰着复活节彩蛋、节日彩柱和七扇彩色的门。

english: But that doesn't make any...
translation: 但这说不通……

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3105, 3262, 0).
translation: 玩家在德雷诺村内德房子东北方向（坐标约3105, 3262, 0）施展了一个不可打断的自传送（不是兔子传送他人）。

english: ... sense!
Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. Thessalia can now instruct the player to look for Gregg at where the event started.
translation: 格雷格不再出现在木材场。塞萨利亚可以指示玩家去活动开始的地方找格雷格。

english: The player is seen casting an uninterruptable self-teleport (not tele-other by the rabbit) north-east of Ned's house at Draynor (location in proximity of 3104, 3263, 0).
translation: 玩家在德雷诺村内德房子东北方向（坐标约3104, 3263, 0）施展了一个不可打断的自传送（不是兔子传送他人）。

english: Are you alright after that cat attacked you?
translation: 被那只猫攻击后你还好吗？

english: Not so nice being called cute, is it...?
translation: 被说可爱不好受吧……？

english: Hmm... Based on past experienced with cats in the lumberyard, I bet it's hungry, thristy or looking for its kitten.
translation: 嗯……根据以前在木材场遇到猫的经验，我猜它要么饿了，要么渴了，要么在找它的小猫。

english: How many doors are there in Draynor?
translation: 德雷诺村有多少扇门？

english: We're not going to need to go through this six or seven times, are we?
translation: 我们不会要重复六七次吧？

english: That's... actually pretty smart.
translation: 这……其实挺聪明的。

english: Draynor Village is decorated with Easter eggs on the ground, festive poles, and seven colourful doors.
translation: 德雷诺村的地上装饰着复活节彩蛋、节日彩柱和七扇彩色的门。

english: Oh, I see you put the door in already.
translation: 哦，我看到你已经把门装好了。

english: Gregg can no longer be found at the lumberyard. (Thessalia's beliefs about Gregg's presence in the lumberyard are not changed.)
translation: 格雷格不再出现在木材场。（塞萨利亚对格雷格在木材场的看法没有改变。）

english: Wait, someone else decorated this door?
translation: 等等，这扇门是别人装饰的？

english: The camera fades to black and a cutscene begins.
translation: 画面渐黑，一段过场动画开始。

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking from his house to in front of the bank in the background.
translation: 老智者从他的房子走向背景中的银行前。

english: Look around - it looks like the whole has been decorated too!
translation: 看看周围——好像整个村子都被装饰了！

english: The Wise Old Man starts walking towards the crossroad.
translation: 老智者开始走向十字路口。

english: Perhaps I can answer to that question.
translation: 也许我能回答那个问题。

english: Wise Old Man leaves, walks back towards his house. The camera fades to black, and the cutscene ends.
translation: 老智者离开，走回他的房子。画面渐黑，过场动画结束。

english: The player can now ask Wise Old Man more about the Easter event, while he's at home in his house.
translation: 玩家现在可以在老智者在家时向他询问更多关于复活节活动的事。

english: I feel like he kind of glossed over the part where three people decorated an entire village in 10 minutes...
translation: 我觉得他有点轻描淡写了三个人十分钟装饰整个村子这件事……

english: The part where we trekked all across Misthalin for nothing?
translation: 我们白跑一趟米斯萨林的那部分？

english: He called you a... strange rabbit?
translation: 他叫你……奇怪的兔子？

english: So your plan... worked?
translation: 所以你的计划……成功了？

english: Well, I'm glad I could try and help at least.
translation: 嗯，至少我很高兴能试着帮忙。

english: I'm... not entirely sure what I'm going to do with it, but thanks.
translation: 我……不太确定要拿它做什么，但谢谢。

english: Didn't you want it?
translation: 你不是想要吗？

english: Gregg gives you the decorated door and his garish hat.
translation: 格雷格给了你装饰好的门和他那顶俗气的帽子。

english: Time off? But I only see you around Easter!
translation: 休假？但我只在复活节见到你！

english: You know, it just occuredto me I never actually asked what your name is.
translation: 你知道吗，我突然意识到我从来没问过你叫什么名字。

english: Greg?
translation: 格雷格？

english: Greggg?
translation: 格雷格格？

english: I'm [name].
translation: 我叫[name]。

english: [name]? I'm not a fan, honestly.
translation: [name]？说实话，我不太喜欢。

english: Will you be around next year?
translation: 你明年还会在吗？

english: Really? I thought it looked a bit silly.
translation: 真的？我觉得它有点傻。

english: Why don't you go?
translation: 你为什么不去？

english: Do you have more ingredients?
translation: 你还有更多材料吗？

english: Yes, take me to Lumbridge.
translation: 是的，带我去仑桥镇。

english: How can you even teleport?
translation: 你怎么能传送？

english: I need a new pair of shears.
translation: 我需要一把新剪刀。

english: Yes, teleport me to Varrock.
translation: 是的，传送我去维洛克城。

english: Yes, take me to Draynor.
translation: 是的，带我去德雷诺村。

translation: 姐妹们抱起你的猫，使劲闻了闻，然后轻轻放回地上。

english: He's back!

translation: 想得美，菜鸟。

translation: 他说是激动人心的新岗位。

translation: 我好无聊

english: 10 green bottles sit..*Whistles*
translation: 十个绿瓶子坐着……*吹口哨*

english: I miss Billy and Bob *sighs*
translation: 我想比利和鲍勃了 *叹气*

english: Dum dum dum de dum Hey!

translation: 你把啤酒递给守卫长，他喝了一大口。

translation: 你把……手……递给守卫长，他笨拙地接住，掉进了啤酒里，捞出来又还给你。

english: The Guard Captain fished the hand out of his beer and hands it to you.
translation: 守卫长从啤酒里捞出手，递给你。

english: This sceptre seems to have run out of charges.
translation: 这根权杖似乎已经耗尽了充能。

english: If I gave you back some of the artefacts I've taken from the tomb, would you recharge the sceptre for me.
translation: 如果我把从墓穴里拿走的一些神器还给你，你能帮我给权杖充能吗？

english: You have found the Pharaoh's Sceptre.
translation: 你找到了法老权杖。

english: You find a golden sceptre but don't have space to carry it. Clear some space in your pack and pick the sceptre up, if you want it...
translation: 你发现了一根金色权杖，但没有空间携带。清空背包空间后捡起权杖，如果你想要的话……

english: I want to charge or remove charges from my sceptre.
translation: 我想给我的权杖充能或移除充能。

english: Apatura gives you a note.
translation: 阿帕图拉给了你一张笔记。

english: Apatura gives you a key.
translation: 阿帕图拉给了你一把钥匙。

english: Guildmaster Jane has given you a seed pack.
translation: 公会会长.简给了你一组种子。

translation: 你用灵魂树种子换了一组种子。

translation: 你用灵魂树幼苗换了一组种子。

english: Gunnjorn has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 冈乔恩又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Hello [Brother/Sister], you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: 你好，[兄弟/姐妹]，现在你穿对了衣服，融入得好多了。之前你简直像个异类！不过还是要保持警惕；我听说我们中间有贼！

english: This is [Fremennik name] your majesty.
translation: 陛下，这位是[弗瑞曼尼名字]。

english: Not now, Hrafn. Now where was I?
translation: 现在不是时候，赫拉芬。我刚才说到哪了？

english: Ah, yes. Your unique position among Fremennik-
translation: 啊，对了。你在弗瑞曼尼人中的独特地位——

english: Look, could you fetch my cat some fish? Then we can finish our conversation in peace.
translation: 听着，你能给我的猫弄点鱼吗？这样我们就能安静地谈完了。

english: Thank you. Hrafn will only eat raw tuna.
translation: 谢谢。赫拉芬只吃生金枪鱼。

english: Yes, fussy though Hrafn is, he doesn't care where the tuna comes from. If you don't already have any, you can catch some down by the docks, or you can buy some from my fishmonger, Flosi Dalksson.
translation: 是的，虽然赫拉芬很挑剔，但他不在乎金枪鱼从哪来。如果你没有，可以去码头钓一些，或者从我的鱼贩弗洛西.达尔克森那里买。

english: Hello again, [Fremennik name]. Do you have a piece of raw tuna for Hrafn?
translation: 又见面了，[弗瑞曼尼名字]。你有生金枪鱼给赫拉芬吗？

english: You feed Hrafn the tuna.
translation: 你喂赫拉芬吃了金枪鱼。

english: Thanks [Fremennik name], you are the first person to stand up to the King's bullying in many a year. Maybe he learnt something today?
translation: 谢谢[弗瑞曼尼名字]，你是多年来第一个敢反抗国王欺凌的人。也许他今天学到了点什么？

english: Purrrrz! (One wishes the tuna-bearing outlander well. One would prefer for him to stay.)
translation: 咕噜噜！（愿带金枪鱼的外来者安好。希望他能留下。）

english: Hopefully Hrafn won't disturb your discussion with the King now.
translation: 希望赫拉芬现在不会打扰你和国王的谈话了。

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath
translation: 说漂亮可太谦虚了，[先生/女士]。美丽、惊艳甚至改变人生才更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以埋葬在瀑布下的精灵国王命名。

english: What happened to the elven king?
translation: 那位精灵国王怎么了？

english: I don't like nature, it gives me a rash!
translation: 我不喜欢大自然，它会让我起疹子！

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind [sir/lady]. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 说漂亮可太谦虚了，[先生/女士]。美丽、惊艳甚至改变人生才更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以埋葬在瀑布下的精灵国王命名。

english: I don't suppose you know anything about some kind of diamond nearby here, do you?
translation: 你知不知道这附近有什么钻石之类的东西？

english: I am afraid not [Sir/Madam]. But isn't our waterfall very pretty?
translation: 恐怕不知道，[先生/女士]。但我们的瀑布不是很美吗？

english: Um... yeah, I guess.
translation: 嗯……是啊，大概吧。

english: I don't suppose you've ever heard of someone named Damis, have you?
translation: 你有没有听说过一个叫达米斯的人？

english: Tell me, I have reason to believe there is some kind of invisible hideout nearby... As a tourist guide, you might have heard someone mention it before...?
translation: 告诉我，我有理由相信附近有个隐形藏身处……作为导游，你可能听人提起过？

english: Anything out of the ordinary then?
translation: 那有什么不寻常的事吗？

english: Hmmm... Well, we did have a report of a young couplespicnic being interrupted when a skeleton mysteriously appeared out of thin air...
translation: 嗯……我们接到报告说，一对年轻情侣的野餐被一个凭空出现的骷髅打断了……

english: And where was this?
translation: 那是在哪里？

english: Thank you very much, you have been most helpful.
translation: 非常感谢，你帮了大忙。

english: Yes, actually I did. Thanks for the help!
translation: 是的，我确实知道了。谢谢你的帮助！

english: Ask about Desert Treasure Quest
translation: 询问关于沙漠宝藏任务

english: Hagus shows you some tainted essence.
translation: 哈古斯给你看了一些受污染的精粹。

english: Hagus shows you one of the extracts.
translation: 哈古斯给你看了一份提取物。

english: You show Hagus a wrath rune. His eyes light up.
translation: 你给哈古斯看愤怒符石。他眼睛一亮。

english: You hand Hagus a wrath rune.
translation: 你把愤怒符石递给哈古斯。

english: You show Hagus a blood rune.
translation: 你给哈古斯看血符石。

english: Good afternoon sir. In need of a haircut are we? Or perhaps a shave? Currently we're offering this service for free!
translation: 下午好，先生。需要理发吗？或者刮胡子？目前我们免费提供这项服务！

english: Good afternoon madam. In need of a haircut are we? Currently we're offering this service for free!
translation: 下午好，女士。需要理发吗？目前我们免费提供这项服务！

english: Hans! Hans! You've been walking around this courtyard since we were two dimensional, have you seen the Gnome Child's hat? He has lost it.
translation: 汉斯！汉斯！你从我们还是二维的时候就在这个院子里转悠了，你见过地精小孩的帽子吗？他弄丢了。

english: Ummm... a little green hat? Yes, a seagull picked it up and flew off.
translation: 嗯……一顶绿色小帽子？是的，一只海鸥叼起来飞走了。

english: Really? A seagull picked up a hat? Can they do that?
translation: 真的？海鸥叼走了帽子？它们能做到吗？

english: So it seems! I'm afraid I didn't happen to see which way it went.
translation: 看来是的！可惜我没看到它往哪飞了。

english: I should probably go somewhere that Hans might actually see me.
translation: 我该去个汉斯可能看到我的地方。

english: You place the chair on the ground and wait for Hans to notice you...
translation: 你把椅子放在地上，等着汉斯注意到你……

english: Oh my aching feet! A chair! Just what I've been needing! I'm going to go sit by the fountain, so pretty this time of year.
translation: 哦，我的脚好痛！一把椅子！正是我需要的！我要去喷泉边坐坐，每年这个时候那里真美。

english: Hans takes the chair and teleports away with it.
translation: 汉斯拿起椅子，带着它传送走了。

english: I think he hasn't sat down for a while!
translation: 我想他很久没坐下过了！

english: Hey Hans, you look like you're enjoying the party!
translation: 嘿，汉斯，你看起来玩得很开心！

english: Of course *hic* I love a good *hic* party.
translation: 当然 *嗝* 我喜欢好 *嗝* 派对。

english: I have a *hic* great party trick *hic*
translation: 我有个 *嗝* 超棒的派对把戏 *嗝*

english: Does it include guessing my age?
translation: 包括猜我的年龄吗？

english: Exactly *burp* that!
translation: 就是 *嗝* 那个！

english: You've probably spent *hic* [amount] days, [amount] hours, [amount] minutes in the world since you arrived [amount] days ago.
translation: 你大概已经在这个世界度过了 *嗝* [amount]天，[amount]小时，[amount]分钟，从你[amount]天前到来开始。

english: Gnomechild's missing hat.

english: I said I didn't want to talk about it!
translation: 我说了我不想谈这个！

english: You have to offer some money.
translation: 你得给点钱。

english: Harold has given you your winnings!
translation: 哈罗德给了你赢得的奖金！

english: You give Harold his winnings.
translation: 你把哈罗德赢的钱给他。

english: I really fancy one of those Blurberry Specials! I never get over to the Gnome Stronghold so I haven't had one for ages!
translation: 我真想喝一杯蓝莓特调鸡尾酒！我从来没去过地精要塞，所以好久没喝到了！

english: You give Harold a Blurberry Special.
translation: 你给了哈罗德一杯蓝莓特调鸡尾酒。

english: Ello matey!

english: *hic!*
Harold is so drunk he can hardly see, let alone count!

english: Um... not enough money.

english: Harold has given you an IOU scribbled on some paper.

english: Hatna gives you 100,000 coins.

english: So you wnat to know what your crystal saw does?

english: You give the bark sample to Hazelmere.
translation: 你把树皮样本交给了黑兹尔米尔。

english: (The bark sample is removed from the player's inventory)
translation: （树皮样本从玩家的背包中消失）

english: The mage carefully studies the sample.
translation: 法师仔细研究了样本。

english: You make a writing motion. The mage scribbles something down on a scroll.
translation: 你做了一个写字的手势。法师在卷轴上潦草地写了些什么。

english: Hazelmere has given you the scroll.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔把卷轴给了你。

english: You still can't understand Hazelmere. The mage wrote it down for you on a scroll.
translation: 你还是听不懂黑兹尔米尔的话。法师把它写在卷轴上给了你。

english: The chef has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 厨师又给了你一个线索卷轴！

translation: 赫克尔.芬奇又给了你一个线索卷轴！

translation: 嘿，小猫！我在跟你说话！

english: Go away!!

english: ~From the look in its eyes you decide to leave alone for now.

english: Let's go to the Emir's Arena, near Al Kharid, and watch some fights!
translation: 我们去阿尔卡里德城附近的埃米尔竞技场看几场比赛吧！

english: We'll see what we can do.
translation: 我们看看能做什么。

english: How old are you now? (Repeat)
translation: 你现在多大了？（重复）

english: You have reached the Lunar Communication Helpline. I'm sorry we can't answer your telekinetic question right now. Our opening times are carefully organised to coincide with you being busy. If you are having an emergency, you have our most profound apologies. Have a nice day. Good bye.
translation: 您已接通月之通讯热线。很抱歉，我们现在无法回答您的念力问题。我们的开放时间精心安排，正好与您忙碌的时间重合。如果您遇到紧急情况，我们深表歉意。祝您愉快。再见。

english: My pleasure, Lady Henryeta.
translation: 我的荣幸，亨利埃塔女士。

english: That's the spirit! Now, what I need is [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]. And I need them within [13—15] minutes as well.
translation: 这才像话！现在，我需要[3—5]块[粘土/铜矿石/锡矿石/铁矿石/银矿石/煤/金矿石/秘银矿石]。而且我需要在[13—15]分钟内拿到。

translation: 算不上什么大任务，但我会做的。只要[3—5]块[粘土/铜矿石/锡矿石/铁矿石/银矿石/煤/金矿石/秘银矿石]，[13—15]分钟内。

english: Are my [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore] arriving anytime soon?
translation: 我的[3—5]块[粘土/铜矿石/锡矿石/铁矿石/银矿石/煤/金矿石/秘银矿石]快到了吗？

english: Good news, I got you [3—5] pieces of [clay/copper ore/tine ore/iron ore/silver ore/coal/gold ore/mithril ore]!
translation: 好消息，我给你弄到了[3—5]块[粘土/铜矿石/锡矿石/铁矿石/银矿石/煤/金矿石/秘银矿石]！

english: Are my [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril] arriving anytime soon?

english: Good news, I got you [3—5] bars of [bronze/iron/silver/steel/gold/mithril]!

translation: 大祭司交给你一个水之冠，作为交换你支付了10,000金币。

english: You show the ashes to the High Priest.

translation: 阿尔多用斯库里乌斯的脊柱给了你一盏古董灯。

english: England...
translation: 英格兰...

translation: 你把猫用解毒药剂交给了杰克。

english: Hordal gives you 100,000 coins.

english: How are you doing, Hudon?

english: ggmmhhmm

english: That's all for the moment.
translation: 暂时就这些了。

english: Oh just monkeying around.
translation: 哦，只是在胡闹而已。

english: hmhmhhhh mmgghh
translation: 嗯嗯嗯嗯 嗯嗯嗯

english: Mizaru slaps Iwazaru. Iwazaru slaps Mizaru back. They start to fight.
translation: 观猴打了言猴。言猴还手打了观猴。它们开始打起来了。

english: Mizaru slumps to the floor and rolls about in pain.
translation: 观猴瘫倒在地，痛苦地打滚。

english: Ha! Serves you right! Anyway, The priest only had enough ingredients for one curse, so when he tried to keep us all from telling anyone the recipe, each of us only got part of the curse. That's why I can't hear anything now.
translation: 哈！活该！总之，祭司的材料只够施一个诅咒术，所以他试图让我们都别说出食谱时，我们每人只中了部分诅咒。这就是为什么我现在什么都听不见。

english: The king has a real soft spot for Roasted Giant Snake stuffed with sliced banana and monkey nut paste.
translation: 国王特别喜欢烤巨蛇，里面塞着切片香蕉和猴坚果糊。

english: Yup, you need to find some bananas, and some monkey nuts and stuff a Giant snake with them. It's as simple as that. Stop hassling me Iwazaru.
translation: 没错，你得找些香蕉和猴坚果，塞进一条巨蛇里。就这么简单。别烦我了，言猴。

english: Iwazaru says you have the wrong type of banana.
translation: 言猴说你的香蕉不对。

english: Blue bananas? There's no such thing. Hey, wait a second where did you say you come from?
translation: 蓝色香蕉？哪有这种东西。嘿，等等，你说你从哪来的？

english: (Iwazaru shakes his head vigourously)
translation: （言猴使劲摇头）

english: They need the minerals and dampness found in hill caves, but also cannot grow without sunlight.
translation: 它们需要山间洞穴里的矿物质和湿气，但也不能没有阳光。

english: I never realised monkey sign language was so... concise. Anywhere, where do I find this plant then?
translation: 我从不知道猴式手语这么……简洁。那我在哪能找到这种植物？

english: Do you know anything about Awowogei's favourite dish?
translation: 你知道阿沃沃吉最喜欢的菜吗？

english: What's... wrong with you?
translation: 你……怎么了？

english: Do you know anything about the King's favourite dish?

english: The killer approaches Sid behind his back.
translation: 杀手从西德背后靠近。

translation: 杀手刺中了西德。

english: Sid stumbles forward, drowning in the water barrel.
translation: 西德向前踉跄，淹死在水桶里。

english: Sid collapses to the ground in a crumpled mess. As he falls down you spot something shiny fall out of his shirt pocket and into the barrel of water.
translation: 西德瘫倒在地，缩成一团。他倒下时，你看到有闪亮的东西从他衬衫口袋里掉出，落入水桶中。

english: The killer walks away.
translation: 杀手走开了。

english: The killer appears from a closet, stabbing Tayten, who is reading a book.
translation: 杀手从壁橱里出现，刺中了正在看书的泰滕。

english: The killer slips a note under the door, and escapes using the closet.
translation: 杀手在门下塞了一张纸条，然后从壁橱逃走了。

english: The killer stabs Lacey.
translation: 杀手刺中了蕾西。

english: Lacey dies.
translation: 蕾西死了。

english: The killer slips a note through the fence, and walks away.
translation: 杀手从栅栏缝隙塞进一张纸条，然后走开了。

english: The walls and door seem too thick for Mandy to be able to hear you.
translation: 墙壁和门似乎太厚了，曼迪听不到你。

english: Mandy goes outside to investigate the noises.
translation: 曼迪出去查看动静。

english: Mandy looks around.
translation: 曼迪环顾四周。

english: Mandy goes back into the kitchen.
translation: 曼迪回到厨房。

english: The killer comes out of the closet near the exit and stabs Mandy.
translation: 杀手从出口附近的壁橱里出来，刺中了曼迪。

english: Mandy dies.
translation: 曼迪死了。

translation: 伦布里奇女士号是一艘古老的克兰多尔渔船——据我所知，是最后一艘了。那种船总是非常灵活，但不太坚固。

english: You give Koanee the damp egg.
translation: 你把潮湿的鸡蛋给了科尼。

translation: 科夫蒂克给了你一些布，上面涂了一层油状物质。

english: The path of the righteous man is beset on all sides by the iniquitiesof the selfish and the tyranny of evil men.
translation: 正义之路被自私者的不义和恶人的暴虐所包围。

english: Don't be, friend. Anyway, do you know the definition of insanity?
translation: 别这样，朋友。话说，你知道疯狂的定义吗？

english: We were losing you to Iban's influence.
translation: 你差点就被伊班控制了。

english: You've done well! Thanks for saving me.
translation: 干得好！谢谢你救了我。

english: Your mind is filled with strange images. A unicorn. A boulder. Some paladins. They seem real... but were they?
translation: 你的脑海里充满了奇怪的画面。一只独角兽。一块巨石。几个圣骑士。它们看起来很真实……但真的是吗？

english: I see. We must now inform the king. Follow me, I'll lead you out.
translation: 我明白了。我们现在必须通知国王。跟我来，我带你出去。

english: Koftik leads you back through the winding caverns to the entrance. But it feels like part of you has been left behind...
translation: 科夫蒂克带你穿过蜿蜒的洞穴回到入口。但你感觉有一部分自己留在了那里……

english: This is no time to linger. The king must know that Iban is dead. This is a truly historical event for Ardougne.
translation: 现在不是逗留的时候。国王必须知道伊班死了。这对阿多尼来说是一个真正具有历史意义的事件。

translation: 玩家被传送到法师竞技场与科洛迪恩战斗。

english: Kragen hands over your purchase.
translation: 克拉根递上你购买的东西。

english: I have no idea what to do about any of it. I'm an adventurer, not a weather controller!
translation: 我完全不知道该怎么办。我是个冒险者，又不是天气控制器！

english: [Charm] You seem to be a little irritable, my friend.
translation: [魅力] 你看起来有点烦躁，我的朋友。

translation: [魅力] 我不喜欢看到同胞这么难过。

translation: [魅力] 那么，我的朋友，你哪里不舒服？

translation: [魅力] 嗯，有什么我能帮你的吗？

translation: [魅力] 啊啊啊啊啊！我讨厌卷心菜！！！！把种子给我！！！！！

english: It's definietlya sight to behold.

translation: 要开始“被遗弃的高塔”任务，你必须满足以下条件：库兰德王国的客户、20% 洛瓦肯吉城好感度。

english: As a matter of fact I do!
translation: 事实上，我知道！

english: So tell me, Lalli. Have you ever tried a human delicacy known as stone soup?
translation: 那么告诉我，拉利。你尝过一种叫做石头汤的人类美食吗？

english: Well, that is where you are wrong. I will now put this rock, into your cauldron over there, and make soup from it.
translation: 嗯，那你就错了。我现在就把这块石头放进你的大锅里，用它来做汤。

english: Ah, that is simply seasoning. Stone soup is delicious by itself, but the taste is really brought out if you use onion, potato and cabbage too.
translation: 啊，那只是调味料。石头汤本身就很美味，但如果你再加入洋葱、土豆和卷心菜，味道会更棒。

english: Other human?
translation: 其他人类？

translation: 不，说真的，你真的很聪明。

translation: 看看我手里的这只死鸡。（仅当玩家背包里有鸡时显示）

translation: “我的手臂”走近码头。

translation: “我的手臂”：我的手臂来了！

translation: 我现在不能说话。我有太多事要做。时机成熟时我会联系你。**

english: Um... I think I must have misheard you, but the only thing I'll let my boat do is travel here to Rellekka, with me in it. I'm not risking getting marooned here.

translation: 拉克斯把莱昂.德库尔的披风递给你。

english: Lassin gives you 100,000 coins.
translation: 拉辛给了你 100,000 金币。

english: Twas a good hawl t' start, plenty of manta ray and snappers. But we would be movin' on the next day to our deep sea fishin' spot.
translation: 一开始收获不错，抓了不少魔鬼鱼和鲷鱼。但我们第二天就要转移到深海捕鱼点。

english: Twas nothin' but smooth sailin' to our deep sea spot near Karamja, but on the way I noticed more debris in the water than usual.
translation: 一路顺风顺水到了卡拉姆詹岛附近的深海点，但路上我发现水里的碎片比平时多。

english: Sorry' won't bring those Mahjarrat back.
translation: 说“对不起”也换不回那些玛哈加特了。

english: Really, really rea....

translation: 啊！！你也来了。

translation: 你检查了猫语护符，查看中央宝石是否有瑕疵。

english: Strange, it looks ok to me.
translation: 奇怪，我看它没问题。

english: Hiss's'sss's.
translation: 嘶嘶嘶嘶嘶。

english: ~Your cat tries to hold in a snigger, but fails miserably.
translation: ~你的猫试图忍住偷笑，但失败了。

english: I refuse to take fashion advice from a cat, a fat lazy one to boot!
translation: 我拒绝接受一只猫的时尚建议，还是一只又胖又懒的猫！

english: Umm.. I don't really understand.
translation: 嗯……我真的不明白。

english: Ummm... so if... a cat is newly born it's already 12 cat years old?
translation: 嗯……所以如果……一只猫刚出生，它就已经 12 猫岁了？

english: Umm... anyway back to the question, how old are you in cat years then?
translation: 嗯……回到问题，那你按猫岁算多大？

english: Aghh!! This is ridiculous, I'm not talking to you again until you start acting sensible.
translation: 啊！！这太荒谬了，在你开始表现得理智之前，我不会再和你说话了。

english: Oh come on tell me.
translation: 哦，告诉我吧。

translation: 哦，猫咪，对不起。我不是那个意思。我怎么补偿你？

english: Look cat, I promise I'll try to be a better to you from now on.
translation: 听着，猫咪，我保证从现在开始我会对你好一些。

english: Hmm.. I think we may have to work on your self esteem first, with an attitude like yours it's no wonder you can't catch rats.
translation: 嗯……我想我们得先提高你的自尊心，就你这态度，难怪你抓不到老鼠。

english: Ummmm..... sorry?
translation: 嗯……对不起？

english: That dragon armour you're wearing is so like last year.
translation: 你穿的那身龙盔甲，太去年款了。

translation: 除了简单和中等难度奖励外，你可以在沼泽中采集双倍摩特梅尔真菌，从焚烧阴魂中获得更多经验，在莫斯勒哈姆雷斯解锁一条捷径，从巴罗斯墓穴获得更多符文，

translation: 欢迎您，[先生/女士]！希望您在传奇公会过得愉快。

translation: 你交出了5枚金币。

english: You hand over 10 gold coins.
translation: 你交出了10枚金币。

english: You hand over 15 gold coins.
translation: 你交出了15枚金币。

english: You hand over 20 gold coins.
translation: 你交出了20枚金币。

english: -- The guard takes the five gold coins. --
translation: -- 守卫拿走了五枚金币。 --

english: The bank exchanges your coins for platinum tokens.
translation: 银行把你的金币兑换成了白金代币。

english: The bank exchanges your platinum tokens for coins.
translation: 银行把你的白金代币兑换成了金币。

english: I suppose you could try speaking to Sir Galahad?
translation: 我想你可以试着和加拉哈德爵士谈谈？

english: Where is King Arthur now? he's not in the jail cell with us.
translation: 亚瑟王现在在哪里？他不和我们一起在牢房里。

english: Morgan le Faye has been itching to get revenge upon Arthur and myself for some time. When she heard of the murder of old Sinclair, she learned that she was not the only one with a vendetta against Camelot.
translation: 摩根.勒菲一直想找机会报复亚瑟和我。当她听说老辛克莱尔被杀后，她得知自己并非唯一与卡美洛有仇的人。

english: The Sinclairs have wanted to get their slimy hands on Camelot since their father's death. With Morgan's cunning and their riches, they make a formidable team. They brought the services of the Black Knights from
translation: 辛克莱尔家族自父亲死后就一直想染指卡美洛。凭借摩根的狡猾和他们的财富，他们组成了一个强大的团队。他们从……雇来了黑骑士的服务。

english: Morgan always keeps things of power near her. So the grail will be somewhere in Keep Le Faye. However, it will most likely be disguised and booby-trapped. Morgan has a thing about transmogrifying.
translation: 摩根总是把强大的东西放在身边。所以圣杯一定在勒菲城堡的某处。不过，它很可能被伪装并设有陷阱。摩根对变形术很在行。

english: Tell me where King Arthur is.
translation: 告诉我亚瑟王在哪里。

english: Tell me about Morgan Le Faye and the Sinclairs.
translation: 告诉我关于摩根.勒菲和辛克莱尔家族的事。

english: Reclaim Camelot
translation: 夺回卡美洛

english: Retreive the Holy Grail
translation: 取回圣杯

english: Save King Arthur
translation: 拯救亚瑟王

english: You've been given a message.
translation: 你收到了一条消息。

english: The messenger says nothing as he hands you another letter. However, the fear in his eyes is clear to see.
translation: 信使一言不发地递给你另一封信。但他眼中的恐惧清晰可见。

english: I imagine its quite the challenge then?
translation: 我想这一定很有挑战性吧？

english: Eventually, the kingdom gave me the role of Colosseum Master. I still make sure to fit some fighting in, but now I have the honor of managing the fights themselves.
translation: 最终，王国任命我为斗技场大师。我仍然确保自己参与一些战斗，但现在我有幸管理战斗本身。

english: You exchange Dizana's Quiver for 4,000 Sunfire Splinters.
translation: 你用迪扎纳的箭袋换取了4000枚阳火碎片。

english: Tell me about prospecting again.
translation: 再跟我说说勘探的事。

english: Look for this icon on your minimap to find mining rocks.
translation: 在小地图上寻找这个图标来找到采矿岩石。

english: Look for this symbol on your minimap after climbing the stairs of the Lumbridge Castle to the top.
translation: 爬上仑桥镇城堡的楼梯到顶层后，在小地图上寻找这个符号。

english: Clay can be mined in many places. Try south west of Varrock or the crafting guild. See the crafting tutor upstairs in Lumbridge Castle for more information on what you can make with clay.
translation: 粘土可以在很多地方开采。试试维洛克城西南或制作公会。到仑桥镇城堡楼上的制作导师那里了解更多关于粘土制作的信息。

english: Rune Essence can only be mined at secret places... I don't know where these are but you can speak to the Duke of Lumbridge to find out more.
translation: 符文精华只能在秘密地点开采……我不知道这些地方在哪里，但你可以和仑桥镇公爵谈谈了解更多。

english: Rocks which yield copper ore can be found around here, and other places such as Al Kharid, Rimmington or Varrock mines. They're quite common.
translation: 产出铜矿石的岩石可以在这里附近找到，也可以在阿尔卡里德城、里明顿村或维洛克城矿场等其他地方找到。它们相当常见。

english: Tin ore is much the same as copper. It can be found around this area as well as Varrock, Al Kharid and the Barbarian Village.
translation: 锡矿石和铜矿石差不多。可以在这一带以及维洛克城、阿尔卡里德城和野蛮人村庄找到。

english: Iron can be mined around Rimmington, Al Kharid and Varrock. It's tricky to smelt though - see the boy at the furnace in Lumbridge for tips.
translation: 铁可以在里明顿村、阿尔卡里德城和维洛克城附近开采。不过冶炼起来有点棘手——去仑桥镇熔炉旁找那个男孩请教技巧。

english: Look for this icon on your minimap to find the furnace.
translation: 在小地图上寻找这个图标来找到熔炉。

english: You'll need to be a fairly good miner before you can start mining coal. You can find it in the Dwarf mine, Al Kharid and quite a few other places.
translation: 你需要成为一名相当不错的矿工才能开始开采煤。你可以在矮人矿场、阿尔卡里德城和其他不少地方找到它。

english: Silver can be mined to help you with your crafting. You can find it in the Crafting guild, Al Kharid and many other mines.
translation: 开采银矿可以帮助你进行制作。你可以在制作公会、阿尔卡里德城和许多其他矿场找到它。

english: Gold requires quite a lot of experience in mining before you can successfully extract it from the rocks. It can be found in Al Kharid, the Crafting guild, Rimmington and other places.
translation: 金矿需要相当多的采矿经验才能成功从岩石中提取。可以在阿尔卡里德城、制作公会、里明顿村和其他地方找到。

english: Mithril and Adamantite rocks are fairly rare and require great skill to mine. You can find them in Al Kharid, the Dwarven mines, Lumbridge Swamps and other places.
translation: 秘银矿石和精金矿石相当稀有，需要高超的技能才能开采。你可以在阿尔卡里德城、矮人矿场、仑桥镇沼泽和其他地方找到它们。

english: Runite is the most prized of ores and is very rare. I'll leave you to find where to mine it.
translation: 符文矿石是最珍贵的矿石，非常稀有。你自己去找开采地点吧。

english: The Bronze Pick is your basic tool of the trade. You can buy one from Bob's Axe shop very cheaply, that's north of here in Lumbridge, I also heard that exploring the castle walls may yield a surprise or two.
translation: 青铜镐是你的基本工具。你可以从鲍勃的斧头店非常便宜地买到一把，就在仑桥镇北边，我还听说探索城堡墙壁可能会有意外收获。

english: The Iron and Steel Picks are faster than the bronze pickaxe, but you will need to progress with your mining a little before you can use them. You can buy them from Nurmof in the Dwarven mines.
translation: 铁镐和钢镐比青铜镐更快，但你需要先提升一些采矿等级才能使用。你可以从矮人矿场的努莫夫那里购买。

english: Mithril, Adamantite, and Rune Picks may be used as you progress with your skill of mining. They can be obtained from Nurmof in the Dwarven mines.
translation: 随着采矿技能的提升，你可以使用秘银镐、精金镐和符文镐。它们可以从矮人矿场的努莫夫那里获得。

english: Miriam gives you 100,000 coins.
translation: 米里亚姆给了你100,000枚金币。

english: Miriam gives you some control scrolls.
translation: 米里亚姆给了你一些控制卷轴。

english: Erm, what are you?
translation: 呃，你是什么？

english: I'm [player name]. Nice to meet you.
translation: 我是[玩家名字]。很高兴认识你。

english: Oh... erm.... I didn't mean to offend.
translation: 哦……呃……我不是有意冒犯的。

english: Nice to meet you Mofina. Erm...
translation: 很高兴认识你，莫菲娜。呃……

english: Where exactly are you from, Mofina? I haven't heard of Arceuus and I haven't seen anyone else who is dressed like you around here.
translation: 莫菲娜，你究竟是从哪里来的？我没听说过阿西乌斯城，也没见过这里有人穿得像你一样。

english: Okay, and how can I get to Kourend?
translation: 好吧，那我怎么去库兰德王国？

english: I never expected to see one of your kind outside of Kourend. I guess the Duke invited you to the party for the same reason he invited the others?
translation: 我没想到会在库兰德王国之外见到你这样的人。我猜公爵邀请你来参加派对，和邀请其他人的理由一样？

english: Sorry, that came across a little ruder than I intended. I just wasn't entirely sure what term to use for citizens of Arceuus.
translation: 抱歉，我这话说得有点粗鲁了。我只是不太确定该怎么称呼阿西乌斯城的居民。

english: I hope you still enjoy the party!
translation: 希望你还是能享受派对！

english: Mogrim gives you 100,000 coins.
translation: 莫格林给了你10万金币。

english: You show the scroll to the dwarf.
translation: 你把卷轴展示给矮人看。

english: Molly's given you [1-5] noted uncut [sapphires/emeralds/rubies/diamonds].
translation: 莫莉给了你[1-5]个未加工的[蓝宝石/绿宝石/红宝石/钻石]（票据形式）。

english: I'm sorry [sir/madam], but no weapons or armour may be worn on Entrana. This rule even forbids items dedicated to Saradomin.
translation: 抱歉，[先生/女士]，恩特纳岛上禁止携带任何武器或盔甲。这条规则甚至包括献给萨拉多明的物品。

english: Good Point.
translation: 说得好。

english: You wait until the mourner's back is turned and sneak into the building.
translation: 你等到哀悼者转过身去，然后偷偷溜进了大楼。

english: Very noble of you.
translation: 你真是高尚。

english: Nothing, just being polite.
translation: 没什么，只是礼貌一下。

english: Yes, I'm fine thanks.
translation: 是的，我很好，谢谢。

english: I used to have nightmares when I was younger.
translation: 我小时候经常做噩梦。

english: No, I feel fine.
translation: 不，我感觉很好。

english: Can you cure it then?
translation: 那你能治好它吗？

english: Treated?
translation: 治疗？

english: No, but can you tell me where the plague came from?
translation: 不，但你能告诉我瘟疫是从哪里来的吗？

english: Maybe…
translation: 也许吧……

english: Finally, a pupil using [his/her] brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: 终于，有个学生用[他/她]的脑子而不是试图吃掉它们。下一个问题。

english: There, you can click Find to seek the official group for ranked Duels or Tournaments.
translation: 在那里，你可以点击“查找”来寻找排名决斗或锦标赛的官方群组。

english: Once you've found it, click Sign up to sign up to one, and you'll be considered for an invitation to a Duel or Tournament, whenever one begins.
translation: 找到后，点击“报名”加入一个，当决斗或锦标赛开始时，你就会被考虑邀请。

english: Murphy has given you a sextant.
translation: 墨菲给了你一个六分仪。

english: The bandit hands you a Ring of Shadows.
translation: 强盗递给你一枚阴影之戒。

english: Sorry, I'm trying to speak to someone else, but he/she/they seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 抱歉，我想和别人说话，但[他/她/他们]似乎不理我。

english: So you just need me to embarrass her? Doesn't sound too bad.
translation: 所以你只需要我让她难堪？听起来不太糟。

english: Enter the Theatre and beat the challenges within. Doing so would cause great embarrassment to Verzik and my associates would very much appreciate it.
translation: 进入剧院并击败里面的挑战。这样做会让维兹克非常难堪，我的同伙们会很感激的。

english: I've managed to defeat her! I survived every single one of Verzik's challenges!
translation: 我成功击败了她！我挺过了维兹克的每一个挑战！

english: At the end, she even chose to face me herself. I couldn't fully defeat her though, she just transformed into a bat and flew away.
translation: 最后，她甚至选择亲自面对我。但我没能完全击败她，她变成一只蝙蝠飞走了。

english: Go and buy teleport crystals.
translation: 去买传送水晶。

english: Enter the Theatre without any teleport crystals.
translation: 不带任何传送水晶进入剧院。

english: The mysterious stranger pulls a coin out of his pocket and shows it to you.
translation: 神秘的陌生人从口袋里掏出一枚硬币给你看。

english: Course, there's only a few people who know it, so unless you can get someone to show you you won't be able to do it.
translation: 当然，只有少数人知道，所以除非有人带你，否则你做不到。

english: Narf'? You think that's funny? At least I don't call myself [player name]! Where did you get a name like that?
translation: 纳夫？你觉得好笑？至少我没叫自己[玩家名字]！你从哪弄来这么个名字？

english: I've lost my notes... Dufft, have you seen my notes?
translation: 我弄丢了笔记……达夫特，你看到我的笔记了吗？

english: You hand the map parts to Ned.
translation: 你把地图碎片交给内德。

english: Clouds surround the ship.
translation: 乌云笼罩着船。

english: CRASH!
translation: 轰隆！

english: You are knocked unconscious and later awake on an ash-strewn beach.
translation: 你被击昏，后来在满是灰烬的海滩上醒来。

english: You're a sailor? Could you take me to Crandor?
translation: 你是水手？能带我去克兰多尔岛吗？

english: No thanks, Ned. I don't need any.
translation: 不了，谢谢，内德。我不需要。

english: Nigel rewards you with the Deadman's chest armour.
translation: 奈杰尔奖励你亡命者箱盔甲。

english: Nigel rewards you with the Deadman's leg armour.
translation: 奈杰尔奖励你亡命者腿甲。

english: Nigel rewards you with the Deadman's cape.
translation: 奈杰尔奖励你亡命者斗篷。

english: That's right, I'm on a quest for King Lathas. I need to find a way through these caverns.
translation: 没错，我在为拉萨斯国王执行任务。我需要找到穿过这些洞穴的路。

english: Good luck with that! If we knew how, we'd have slain him already.
translation: 祝你好运！如果我们知道方法，早就杀了他了。

english: Thanks. Take care.
translation: 谢谢。保重。

english: You're brave to come down to this place. Not many survive down here.
translation: 你敢来这地方真是勇敢。没多少人能在这里活下来。

english: You show the doll to Niloof.
translation: 你把玩偶展示给尼鲁夫看。

english: Niloof gives you a book.
translation: 尼鲁夫给了你一本书。

english: Niloof tries to give you a book but you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 尼鲁夫想给你一本书，但你的空间不够。

english: Nurmof hands you the repaired dragon pickaxe.
translation: 努莫夫把修好的龙金镐递给你。

english: The assistant gives you some wine.
translation: 助理给了你一些酒。

english: The professor has given you a navigation chart.
translation: 教授给了你一张航海图。

english: Congratulations! You have completed the Bard's Trial!
translation: 恭喜！你完成了吟游诗人的试炼！

english: As you finished playing you felt Fossegrimen's power leave you...
translation: 当你演奏完毕，你感到福塞格里门的力量离开了你……

english: You show the Basilisk Jaw to Olaf.
translation: 你把石化蜥蜴颚骨展示给奥拉夫看。

english: Remind me about crafting a lyre
translation: 提醒我关于制作竖琴的事

english: Remind me about Fossegrimen
translation: 提醒我关于福塞格里门的事

english: Remind me about playing on stage
translation: 提醒我关于在舞台上演奏的事

english: I don't need a reminder
translation: 我不需要提醒

english: Old Man Ral hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: 老人拉尔递给你一个谜盒！

english: Hello again, young [man/lady]. You really did wonders for my little home. I feel so much happier living here now.
translation: 又见面了，年轻的[先生/女士]。你真是把我的小窝收拾得焕然一新。我现在住在这里开心多了。

english: Well If I find out anything useful, I'll come let you know, alright?
translation: 好吧，如果我发现了什么有用的东西，我会来告诉你的，好吗？

english: So, I made this sphere. It's a glass ball coated with powdered law runes, prepared in a special way.
translation: 所以，我做了这个球体。它是一个玻璃球，涂有粉末状的律法符文，用特殊方法制备的。

english: Oldak makes you a moving-over-distance sphere.
translation: 奥达克为你制作了一个远距离移动球。

english: I have %NUMBER% law runes and %NUMBER% pieces of molten glass here!
translation: 我这里有%NUMBER%个律法符文和%NUMBER%块熔融玻璃！

english: Excellent! I can make you %NUMBER% moving-over-distance spheres with them! How many do you want?
translation: 太好了！我可以给你做%NUMBER%个远距离移动球！你想要几个？

english: Oldak makes you %NUMBER% moving-over-distance spheres.
translation: 奥达克为你制作了%NUMBER%个远距离移动球。

english: Firstly, you need volcanic sulphur. It comes from Toothy's mine, west of here.
translation: 首先，你需要火山硫磺。它来自图西的矿场，就在西边。

english: Secondly, you need juniper charcoal. Smoggy's got some charcoal furnaces on the beach in the Hosidius area, near the juniper woods.
translation: 其次，你需要杜松木炭。斯莫吉在霍西迪乌斯城地区的海滩上有一些木炭炉，靠近杜松树林。

english: Thirdly, you need saltpetre. There are some natural deposits in the Hosidius woodlands, near the juniper trees.
translation: 第三，你需要硝石。霍西迪乌斯城林地有一些天然矿床，靠近杜松树。

english: Mix the volcanic sulphur, the juniper charcoal and the saltpetre in a pot to make dynamite. Finally add a string as a fuse.
translation: 把火山硫磺、杜松木炭和硝石混合在一个罐子里制成炸药。最后加一根绳子作为引信。

english: You show Oriana the keys.
translation: 你把钥匙展示给奥莉安娜看。

english: You hand in [number] valuable items for [number] coins.
translation: 你上交了[数量]件贵重物品，获得了[数量]金币。

english: You need some valuables from nearby houses to trade in.
translation: 你需要从附近的房子里找些贵重物品来交易。

english: I hear wild rumours about a prince.
translation: 我听到一些关于王子的疯狂谣言。

english: I am just being nosy.
translation: 我只是爱管闲事。

english: Hi, Osman! How are you doing?
translation: 嗨，奥斯曼！你还好吗？

english: How is Maisa? Is she back in Al Kharid?
translation: 麦莎怎么样了？她回阿尔卡里德城了吗？

english: I've heard that some of the shopkeepers have been threatened!
translation: 我听说有些店主受到了威胁！

english: Do you know anything about Keris, the dagger I recovered in the course of my last mission?
translation: 你知道关于克里西斯弯刀的事吗？就是我在上次任务中找回的那把匕首。

english: So what is so good about them?
translation: 那它们有什么好的？

english: Ello there [lad/lassy]! What can I be getting you?
translation: 嘿，[小伙子/姑娘]！我能给你点什么？

english: Otto has created a dragon hasta.
translation: 奥托制作了一把龙金刺矛。

english: Otto has converted your spear into a hasta.
translation: 奥托把你的长矛改成了刺矛。

english: Otto has converted your hasta into a spear.
translation: 奥托把你的刺矛改成了长矛。

english: Otto has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 奥托给了你一张挑战卷轴！

english: Otto has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 奥托又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Otto Godblessed has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 奥托.神佑给了你一张挑战卷轴！

english: Otto Godblessed has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 奥托.神佑又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: No nothing of the sort. I was just trying to make conversation, that's all.
translation: 不，没那回事。我只是想找点话说而已。

english: What!! How do you know about that?
translation: 什么！！你怎么知道的？

english: Gosh you're a bit dull and boring.
translation: 天哪，你有点迟钝无聊。

english: Subjugation? That seems like a bit of an over- exaggeration.
translation: 征服？这有点夸大其词了吧。

english: All right, I'll give ye a quest. I'll let you wear my rune platemail if ye...
translation: 好吧，我给你个任务。如果你……我就让你穿我的符文板甲。

english: Go to the Guildmaster in the Champions' Guild. He'll help ye out if yer so keen on doing a quest. I'm not going to be handholding any adventurers.
translation: 去冠军公会找公会会长吧。既然你这么想做任务，他会帮你的。我可没空手把手带冒险者。

english: Oziach skillfully forges the shield and visage into a new shield.
translation: 奥扎克熟练地将盾和龙首融合成一面新盾。

english: Oziach has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 奥扎克给了你一个谜盒！

english: Oziach has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 奥扎克又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: A dragon, that sounds like fun.
translation: 一条龙？听起来挺有意思的。

english: Hello Oziach.
translation: 你好，奥扎克。

english: Sorry [player name], I'm talking to the estate agent right now.
translation: 抱歉，[玩家名]，我现在正和地产经纪人说话呢。

english: Oziach is alone! Seems like the perfect time to scare him.
translation: 奥扎克一个人！正是吓唬他的好时机。

english: I just need to climb this tree and blow on the bottle, that should do it.
translation: 我只要爬上这棵树，对着瓶子吹气，应该就行了。

english: I see you there, what are you doing?!
translation: 我看见你了，你在干什么？！

english: Oziach caught me. I should try to be a bit faster next time.
translation: 奥扎克发现了我。下次我得再快一点。

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about trying this again.
translation: 我应该找杰瑞德修士谈谈，再试一次。

english: OOOoOOOooOOooOOOOoOOOO
The player shakes the evergreen tree slightly.
translation: 玩家轻轻摇了摇常青树。

english: What was that? A ghost?!
translation: 那是什么？幽灵？！

english: Hello?? Is that a ghost?
translation: 喂？？是幽灵吗？

english: ONE ghost? Haha, ONE ghost can't spook me!
translation: 一个幽灵？哈哈，一个幽灵可吓不到我！

english: The player returns to Brother Jered.
translation: 玩家回到杰瑞德修士身边。

english: Seems like I wasn't very scary. Oziach said ONE ghost isn't enough!
translation: 看来我吓人不够狠。奥扎克说一个幽灵不够！

english: I need to find another ghost, to scare Oziach from the trees on the other side of the path. That would work!
translation: 我得再找一个幽灵，从路另一边的树上吓唬奥扎克。这样应该行！

english: I should talk to Brother Jered about this. Maybe he can help.
translation: 我应该和杰瑞德修士谈谈。也许他能帮忙。

english: The estate agent should be back soon.
translation: 地产经纪人应该快回来了。

english: What a wonderful day!
translation: 多美好的一天啊！

english: It's quite the step up from my little humble house!
translation: 比起我那简陋的小屋，这真是大升级！

english: I am slightly worried about the ghost...
translation: 我有点担心那个幽灵……

english: I'm buying the monastery, so I'm just having a look around.
translation: 我要买下这座修道院，所以先四处看看。

english: Did you find anything interesting?
translation: 你发现什么有趣的东西了吗？

english: Yes! But there is ONE ghost around. It's a little bit scary but ONE ghost isn't enough to scare me properly.
translation: 是的！但只有一个幽灵。有点吓人，但一个幽灵还不足以真正吓到我。

english: Would TWO ghosts be enough to scare you?
translation: 两个幽灵够吓到你吗？

english: I don't know, maybe, depends how scary they are.
translation: 不知道，也许吧，看它们有多吓人。

english: I'm just interested in ghosts, they're fascinating!
translation: 我只是对幽灵感兴趣，它们太迷人了！

english: I'm very well thank you. Very excited as I'm about to finish buying the monastery!
translation: 我很好，谢谢。很兴奋，因为我马上就要买下修道院了！

english: Did the ghosts not scare you off?
translation: 幽灵没把你吓跑吗？

english: No, there was only ONE, so it wasn't that scary.
translation: 没有，只有一个，所以没那么吓人。

english: Only ONE ghost? I thought there were loads!
translation: 只有一个幽灵？我以为有很多呢！

english: I've only found ONE. If there are more, then I might have to rethink my purchase.
translation: 我只找到一个。如果还有更多，我可能得重新考虑购买计划了。

english: Why is that interesting?
translation: 这有什么有趣的？

english: I just thought there were lots of ghosts, but maybe there is only ONE!
translation: 我只是以为有很多幽灵，但也许只有一个！

english: Hi, [player name].
translation: 嗨，[玩家名]。

english: I'm just admiring the monastery, I'm going to purchase it!
translation: 我只是在欣赏修道院，我打算买下它！

english: Are you going to live there?
translation: 你要住在那儿吗？

english: Yes! I'm going to turn it into a cool house, maybe add a swimming pool.
translation: 是的！我要把它改造成一栋酷房子，也许再加个游泳池。

english: I see. What are the monks going to do?
translation: 这样啊。那僧侣们怎么办？

english: I don't know, find somewhere else to live!
translation: 我不知道，让他们另找地方住！

english: Was that you hiding by the tree earlier?
translation: 刚才躲在树后面的是你吗？

english: Nope, wasn't me! Must have been someone else.
translation: 不，不是我！肯定是别人。

english: They looked a lot like you.
translation: 他们看起来很像你。

english: I have quite a familiar face!
translation: 我长了一张大众脸！

english: I saw you by that tree earlier, what were you doing?
translation: 我刚才看见你在那棵树旁边，你在干什么？

english: I don't think that was me!
translation: 我觉得那不是我！

english: Why were you sneaking around the trees earlier?
translation: 你刚才为什么在树丛里鬼鬼祟祟的？

english: That wasn't me, I've only just got here!
translation: 那不是我，我才刚到这儿！

english: I'll keep an eye out for them though, they sound suspicious!
translation: 不过我会留意的，他们听起来很可疑！

english: Oziach spotted us! We'll have to try again. Talk to me when you're ready to try again.
translation: 奥扎克发现我们了！我们得再试一次。准备好再试的时候跟我说。

english: Don't be too long though, the saucepan is quite heavy on my head! I'll be here.
translation: 不过别太久，平底锅顶在我头上挺重的！我会在这儿等着。

english: The player climbs the first tree.
translation: 玩家爬上了第一棵树。

english: BANG CLANG BANG
translation: 砰！哐当！砰！

english: Ghosts?! More than ONE?! Stay away from me!
translation: 幽灵？！不止一个？！离我远点！

english: Cutscene ends.
translation: 过场动画结束。

english: Oziach seemed pretty scared after that! Time to go to the next tree along the path.
translation: 奥扎克看起来吓坏了！该去路边下一棵树了。

english: The player climbs the second tree.
translation: 玩家爬上了第二棵树。

english: BONG DING CLONG
translation: 咚！叮！哐！

english: ooOO ooooOOO OOOooo OOOOooo oooOoO oooOOOoo
Ah! How many ghosts are there??
translation: 啊！到底有多少幽灵？？

english: It's working! Scaring Oziach one more time should do it!
translation: 起作用了！再吓奥扎克一次应该就行了！

english: The player climbs the third tree.
translation: 玩家爬上了第三棵树。

english: Help! Somebody help! The ghosts are chasing me!
translation: 救命！来人啊！幽灵在追我！

english: We've failed. Oziach still wants to buy the monastery.
translation: 我们失败了。奥扎克还是想买修道院。

english: I thought TWO ghosts would be enough!
translation: 我以为两个幽灵就够了！

english: Maybe we need more ghosts? A THIRD ghost?
translation: 也许我们需要更多幽灵？第三个幽灵？

english: I guess so. Let's go and place another advert in the Herald.
translation: 我想是的。我们再去《信使报》上登个广告吧。

english: A portal opens in front of Oziach, and Death appears before him.
translation: 奥扎克面前打开了一道传送门，死神出现在他面前。

english: ...what is that??
translation: ……那是什么？？

english: It is I, Death!
translation: 是我，死神！

english: The scariest. The immortal. The terrifying. Me!
translation: 最可怕的。不朽的。令人胆寒的。就是我！

english: Where are [player name] and Iffie? I must prove my scariness.
translation: [玩家名]和伊菲在哪儿？我必须证明我的可怕之处。

english: They will regret not picking me!
translation: 他们会后悔没选我的！

english: Death?!
translation: 死神？！

english: TOO SCARY!
translation: 太吓人了！

english: i'm off. You can keep the monastary!
translation: 我走了。修道院你留着吧！

english: I'm off. You can keep the monastery!
translation: 我走了。修道院你留着吧！

english: What? I don't want the monastery...?
translation: 什么？我不想要修道院……？

english: Oziach walks away from Death.
translation: 奥扎克从死神身边走开。

english: Mummmmmmmyyyy!
What a strange mortal being...
translation: 真是个奇怪的凡人……

english: Patty hands you the broken cake tin.
translation: 帕蒂把破损的蛋糕模具递给你。

english: The cook hands you a promissory note.
translation: 厨师递给你一张期票。

english: I'm terribly sorry, but I don't have time to talk right now, the Duke might need me.
translation: 非常抱歉，我现在没时间说话，公爵可能需要我。

english: Hey, do you know what's going on with the Duke?
translation: 嘿，你知道公爵怎么了吗？

english: It's that cursed egg.
translation: 都是那个该死的蛋。

english: He does have a strange relation with it... He does know it's an inanimate object, right?
translation: 他和它的关系确实很奇怪……他知道那是个死物吧？

english: The Duke is a little, different, he's never been very good at making decisions.
translation: 公爵有点……特别，他从来就不太擅长做决定。

english: But ever since this egg came along, he has let it make all the decisions for him.
translation: 但自从这个蛋出现后，他就让蛋替他做所有决定。

english: What does it do? He just seemed to ask it questions and shake it.
translation: 它有什么用？我看他只是问它问题然后摇一摇。

english: I don't know how it works, but I know it's wrong.
translation: 我不知道它怎么运作，但我知道这不对劲。

english: I managed to sneak in and ask it a question one night, I asked: 'Magic Egg, are we puppets to a being we cannot comprehend?', it responded with almost certainly.
translation: 有天晚上我溜进去问了个问题，我问：‘魔法蛋，我们是不是某个无法理解存在的傀儡？’它回答‘几乎可以肯定’。

english: That's a very strange thing to ask a talking egg.
translation: 问一个会说话的蛋这种问题可真奇怪。

english: I had a couple forest carrots that night and was feeling a bit off.
translation: 那天晚上我吃了些森林胡萝卜，感觉有点不对劲。

english: ... Uh... alright then.
We need to do something, the magician on the other side of the por....
translation: 我们得做点什么，传送门另一边的魔法师……

english: I mean, who knows where that portal leads to, rabbits might be hopping to their death!
translation: 我是说，谁知道那传送门通向哪里，兔子们可能正跳向死亡！

english: I agree, I've hatched a plan that could save rabbits from certain doom.
translation: 我同意，我想到一个计划，可以拯救兔子免于厄运。

english: I'm all ears.
translation: 我洗耳恭听。

english: We're going to make an egg similar to his one, but it only replies negatively.
translation: 我们要做一个和他那个相似的蛋，但只会给出否定回答。

english: How am I going to make that? I've only got two very small paws and no thumbs.
translation: 我怎么做得到？我只有两只小爪子，没有拇指。

english: You'll need three things: a conch shell, if you whisper into it, it will echo back whatever you say, you should be able to find one on the beach.
translation: 你需要三样东西：一个海螺壳，如果你对着它低语，它会回响你说的话，你应该能在海滩上找到一个。

english: Next you'll need an egg to put it in. To make it look like the real one in his room.
translation: 其次，你需要一个蛋来装它，让它看起来像他房间里的真蛋。

english: Finally, you'll need to paint it gold. Luckily, we've done some redecorating on the top floor of the castle, you should find some paint there.
translation: 最后，你需要把它涂成金色。幸运的是，我们在城堡顶楼重新装修过，你应该能在那里找到一些油漆。

english: Good luck, if you have any more questions let me know.
translation: 祝你好运，如果还有问题就告诉我。

english: How are you getting along with making the replacement egg?
translation: 替代蛋做得怎么样了？

english: I can't remember what I needed.
translation: 我不记得需要什么了。

english: Good luck, if you have anymore questions let me know.
translation: 祝你好运，如果还有问题就告诉我。

english: That's great, you're almost there, you just need to paint it now.
translation: 太好了，你差不多完成了，现在只需要涂漆。

english: Where am I supposed to find some paint?
translation: 我该去哪里找油漆？

english: There should be some left over paint on the roof of the castle, we were repainting some of it.
translation: 城堡屋顶应该还剩一些油漆，我们之前重新粉刷过一部分。

english: Hello Paws, I managed to make a replacement egg.
translation: 你好，爪子，我成功做了一个替代蛋。

english: Perfect and it only gives negative answers?
translation: 完美，而且它只给出否定回答？

english: Yep, I tested it myself.
translation: 是的，我自己测试过。

english: Great, all that's left to do is the switch, you need to convince him that this egg is the real one.
translation: 太好了，剩下的就是调包，你需要让他相信这个蛋才是真的。

english: How do you suppose I do that?
translation: 你觉得我该怎么做？

english: You could get him to ask the real one if it is real and hope it says no.
translation: 你可以让他问真蛋它是不是真的，希望它说不是。

english: And if it says it is the real egg.
translation: 如果它说它是真蛋呢？

english: -Shrugs-
translation: -耸肩-

english: Fine, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看能做什么。

english: Somehow your plan worked.
translation: 你的计划居然成功了。

english: Of course it would, the egg told me.
translation: 当然会成功，蛋告诉我的。

english: I don't really fancy going through that annoying puzzle room again now that I have the Seer's vote.
translation: 既然我已经有了先知的支持，我可不想再走一遍那个烦人的谜题房间。

english: (non-quest dialogue)
translation: （非任务对话）

english: I'm sorry, you are our [brother/sister] no more. I cannot help you. Leave, before I must call the guards.
translation: 抱歉，你不再是我的[兄弟/姐妹]了。我无法帮助你。离开吧，在我叫守卫之前。

english: Begone exile, you're no [brother/sister] to me.
translation: 滚开，流放者，你不再是我的[兄弟/姐妹]。

english: Here is your prediction: The place called [Ardougne/Burthorpe/Canifis/Falador/Karamja/Varrock/The Wilderness/Yanille] will be worth your time to visit.
translation: 这是你的预言：一个叫[阿多尼城/伯索普公国/坎尼非斯村/法拉多城/卡拉姆詹岛/维洛克城/荒野/亚尼勒城]的地方值得你一去。

english: Ask about depositing your equipment
translation: 询问存放装备的事

english: You trade 20,000 coins and two sunlight antelope fur for a mixed hide top.
translation: 你用20,000金币和两张日光羚羊皮换了一件混装皮甲。

english: You trade 20,000 coins and three fox fur for some mixed hide legs.
translation: 你用20,000金币和三张狐狸皮换了一条混装皮裤。

english: You trade 17,500 coins and one sunlight antelope fur for some mixed hide boots.
translation: 你用17,500金币和一张日光羚羊皮换了一双混装皮靴。

english: You trade 20,000 coins and one jaguar fur for a mixed hide cape.
translation: 你用20,000金币和一张美洲豹皮换了一件混装皮革斗篷。

english: Tell me about the room with the fountain.
translation: 告诉我关于喷泉房间的事。

english: You are given some raw oomlie bird meat as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一些生奥利鸟肉作为小费。

english: Perdu tells you about a merchant in Ferox Enclave who sells special scrolls called Trouver Parchments.
translation: 佩杜告诉你费罗飞地有个商人出售一种叫‘寻宝卷轴’的特殊卷轴。

english: A cutscene shows the player being caught
translation: 过场动画显示玩家被抓住

english: Haa haa! I am glad we installed that ant-magic security. What have we here?
translation: 哈哈！幸好我们安装了反魔法安全系统。看看这是谁？

english: You are caught.
translation: 你被抓住了。

english: End of cutscene
translation: 过场动画结束

english: Well sounds like I am capable then!.
translation: 听起来我确实有能力！

english: You need at least 50 Mining and 150 Kudos to enter the Volcanic Mine. You'll also need to fully build the Museum Camp and have Peter verify that you've done so.
translation: 你需要至少50级采矿和150点声望才能进入火山矿场。你还需要完全建好博物馆营地，并让彼得确认你已经完成。

english: You hand over 30 Numulites to Pete.
translation: 你交给皮特30个货币石。

english: You hand over 3,000 Numulites to Pete.
translation: 你交给皮特3,000个货币石。

english: You need 150 x Numulite to recieve your items.
translation: 你需要150个货币石才能领取你的物品。

english: [player name] has started up a mine! Join [him/her] down there now!
translation: [玩家名]已经启动了一个矿场！快来加入[他/她]吧！

english: Nice one, [player name]! I'll give you twice as much water when you're starting a run.
translation: 干得好，[玩家名]！你开始运行时我会给你双倍的水。

english: You show the sceptre to Phabelle Bile.
translation: 你向法贝尔.拜尔展示了权杖。

english: You show the skull to Phabelle Bile.
translation: 你向法贝尔.拜尔展示了头骨。

english: Phabelle Bile combines the items and gives you the Accursed sceptre (au).
translation: 法贝尔.拜尔将物品组合，给了你诅咒权杖 (自动施法+未充能)。

english: You show the claws to Phabelle Bile.
translation: 你向法贝尔.拜尔展示了爪子。

english: You show the fangs to Phabelle Bile.
translation: 你向法贝尔.拜尔展示了尖牙。

english: You show the weapon piece to Phabelle Bile.
translation: 你向法贝尔.拜尔展示了武器碎片。

english: Phantuwti quickly takes the oak logs and the vial in exchange for a mysterious kiteshield.
translation: 潘图提迅速拿走了橡木原木和小瓶，换给你一面神秘的筝形盾。

english: Jones is a bad man, Philipe.
translation: 琼斯是个坏人，菲利普。

english: You're a bad [man/lady]! I don't like you!
translation: 你是个坏[男人/女人]！我不喜欢你！

english: I'll try and console myself about that disappointment somehow.
translation: 我会想办法安慰自己这个失望的。

english: And I'm sure Romeo is just the sort of jester to make her laugh out loud...hysterically you might say. He always brings a tear to my eyes...tears of happiness at his foolish antics!
translation: 而且我敢说罗密欧就是那种能让她哈哈大笑的小丑……可以说是歇斯底里。他总能让我流泪……为他那些愚蠢的把戏流下幸福的眼泪！

english: Oh, thanks...I like to do my cupid bit.
translation: 哦，谢谢……我喜欢当红娘。

english: Oh, hello again! How was I...do you think I was convincing?
translation: 哦，又见面了！我刚才表现得怎么样……你觉得我够有说服力吗？

english: Good, good...you lucky thing, I can't wait to see the look on his face!
translation: 好，好……你真是走运，我等不及想看他脸上的表情了！

english: Hey Phillipa, we need to do something about Juliet.
translation: 嘿，菲利帕，我们得想想朱丽叶的事。

english: Hi [player name], good to see you again, how are you?
translation: 嗨，[玩家名]，很高兴再见到你，你还好吗？

english: Hi... I'm good thanks.
translation: 嗨……我很好，谢谢。

english: Oh that's great! Romeo and I are also doing great thanks for asking, we've been having the best time since you introduced me to him.
translation: 哦，太好了！罗密欧和我也很好，谢谢关心，自从你介绍我们认识后，我们一直过得很开心。

english: I'm not here to find out how you and Romeo are getting on, I'm here to help Juliet.
translation: 我不是来打听你和罗密欧过得怎么样的，我是来帮朱丽叶的。

english: Typical, what is she upset about this time?
translation: 老样子，她这次又为什么事不开心？

english: Her father put her in charge of the birthday party this year, but she's not feeling up to it, recent events have got her feeling quite down.
translation: 她父亲让她负责今年的生日派对，但她觉得自己应付不来，最近发生的事让她很沮丧。

english: Why don't you try cheering her up?
translation: 你为什么不试着让她开心起来？

english: I offered to get her one of Gertrude's cats, but she told me there's little chance of that happening.
translation: 我提议给她弄一只格特鲁德的猫，但她告诉我那几乎不可能。

english: Hmm, why don't you try dressing up as one, you could be her emotional support human.
translation: 嗯，你为什么不打扮成猫呢？你可以当她的情感支持人类。

english: That sounds like a terrible idea...
translation: 这听起来是个糟糕的主意……

english: Surely there's something less... weird... I can do instead?
translation: 肯定有什么不那么……奇怪……的事我能做吧？

english: Got any better ideas?
translation: 你有什么更好的主意吗？
……没有。

english: Thought not, so since she loves cats, why don't you dress up as one and dance for her.
translation: 我就知道，所以既然她喜欢猫，你为什么不打扮成猫给她跳个舞呢？

english: I'm not going to dress up as a cat...
translation: 我才不要打扮成猫……

english: Fine, but what about just the ears?
translation: 好吧，那光戴个猫耳朵呢？

english: ... I suppose I can do that.
translation: ……我想这个我可以接受。

english: Where am I supposed to find some? I'm not about to take some off a cat.
translation: 我去哪儿弄猫耳朵？我可不想从猫身上割下来。

english: I'm sure Iffie in town could put something together for you, she stays in the clothing store by Varrock Square.
translation: 我肯定城里的伊菲能帮你做一对，她就在维洛克广场旁的服装店里。

english: Fine, I'll go have a word.
translation: 好吧，我去跟她谈谈。

english: How are you getting on with your cat costume?
translation: 你的猫装准备得怎么样了？

english: Still working on it, who did you say could help me with it?
translation: 还在弄呢，你说谁能帮我做来着？

english: Iffie should be able to help, she runs the clothing store by Varrock Square.
translation: 伊菲应该能帮忙，她在维洛克广场旁开了家服装店。

english: Alright Phillipa, I've got the cat ears, now what do you want me to do?
translation: 好了菲利普，我拿到猫耳朵了，现在你想让我做什么？

english: Aww, they're so adorable!
translation: 哇，它们太可爱了！

english: Okay, you need to go talk to Juliet and try cheer her up, do a dance for her or something, do you have any good moves?
translation: 好了，你得去跟朱丽叶谈谈，试着让她开心起来，给她跳个舞什么的，你有什么好舞步吗？

english: I know a couple, okay let me try.
translation: 我会几个，好吧，让我试试。

english: Thanks for cheering up Juliet, you've saved the party.
translation: 谢谢你让朱丽叶开心起来，你拯救了派对。

english: It's okay, I'm used to it at this point.
translation: 没关系，我已经习惯了。

english: The phoenix dodges the water.
translation: 凤凰躲开了水。

english: Well, I think you'll have a hard time explaining your slurred speech, odd behaviour, bitter, nostril dissolving stench and rolling, bloodshot eyes if your not drunk.
translation: 嗯，我觉得如果你没喝醉，很难解释你含糊不清的说话、古怪的行为、苦涩刺鼻的口气和布满血丝的眼睛。

english: The enchantment on these 'ere Karamja gloves be a symbol of yer further explorin' on the island. Cap'n Izzy's arranged it so ye get a little extra benefit in our Agility Arena, an' ye can use the stepping stone in
translation: 这副卡拉姆詹手套上的附魔象征着你在这座岛上进一步的探索。伊兹船长安排好了，让你在我们的敏捷竞技场里获得一点额外好处，而且你还能使用岛上的踏脚石。

english: Ye'll have a chance for double tickets in our Agility Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use some more shortcuts around the island, an' even enter some places fer free.
translation: 你在我们的敏捷竞技场里有机会获得双倍票券。你每天可以在战斗洞穴里复活一次，还能使用岛上更多的捷径，甚至免费进入一些地方。

english: Arrr, ye can get double TokKul from the Fight Cave an' Inferno, an' have a chance for double tickets in our Agility Arena 'ere. Ye can resurrect in the Fight Cave once per day, an' use a lot of shortcuts around the
translation: 啊，你可以从战斗洞穴和地狱获得双倍托库尔，还有机会在我们的敏捷竞技场里获得双倍票券。你每天可以在战斗洞穴里复活一次，还能使用岛上很多捷径。

english: That I did, indeed! Peter Potter's Patented Multipurpose poison! A miracle of modern apothecarys! My exclusive concoction has been test on...

english: The salesman takes a deep breath.
translation: 推销员深吸了一口气。

english: He seems to have finished for the time being.
translation: 他暂时说完了。

english: Y-you would??? Um, okay! I knew I still had the old salesman skills going on!

english: Maybe I can take your name and add it to my mailing list for potential purchasers of Peter Potter’s patented multipurpose poison?
translation: 也许我可以记下你的名字，把你加到我的邮寄名单里，作为彼得.波特专利多用途毒药的潜在买家？

english: Till next time. Farewell.
translation: 下次再见。告辞。

english: Tis all quiet on the eastern front.
translation: 东线一片寂静。

english: The cat seems too sick to respond.
translation: 猫似乎病得太重，无法回应。

english: The archaeologist shows you an unusual icon.
translation: 考古学家向你展示了一个不寻常的图标。

english: The archaeologist gives you some rope.
translation: 考古学家给了你一些绳子。

english: What do you know about the necropolis to the south?
translation: 你对南边的墓地了解多少？

english: Not too much. It's been abandoned for a long time. In fact, you couldn't even access most of it until fairly recently.
translation: 不太多。它已经废弃很久了。事实上，直到最近你都无法进入它的大部分区域。

english: Interesting... Do you know if many people have been there since it was uncovered?
translation: 有意思……你知道自从它被发掘以来，有多少人去过那里吗？

english: Anyway, I had to pay 75,000 coins to buy this one, so if you want it, that's how much I'll have to charge you.
translation: 总之，我花了75,000金币才买到这个，所以如果你想要，也得付这么多钱。

english: If you then somehow lose your pet, you can reclaim it here for one reclaim token. Reclaim tokens cost 1,000,000 coins each.
translation: 如果你之后不小心弄丢了宠物，你可以用一个回收代币在这里找回它。每个回收代币价值1,000,000金币。

english: If you lose a pet somehow, you can come here and reclaim them for one reclaim token. Reclaims tokens cost 1,000,000 coins each.

english: No no, just people like shopkeepers and such, they're quite willing to teach you things in exchange for the jobs as well. But here, tell you what, I'll give you some seeds if you can deliver this letter to a friend in Falador.
translation: 不不，只是像店主那样的人，他们很愿意教你东西来换取帮忙。不过这样吧，如果你能把这封信送到法拉多城的一个朋友那里，我就给你一些种子。

english: Oh, there's one in Keldagrim-East, upstairs in the Laughing Miner. They brew their own beer, they do.
translation: 哦，凯尔达格林城东区有一家，在欢笑矿工酒馆楼上。他们自己酿啤酒，真的。

translation: 啊，还得等上好几个月呢。到时候再来问我吧，我会给你留些额外的肉和蜜酒，伙计。

english: Well, I don't know what to tell you really... This village is called Canifis and lies on the border between Morytania and Misthalin... so we're kind of on the front line if those Saradominists to the west ever decide to attack us... South East of here is the castle of Lord Drakan, our master.
translation: 呃，我真不知道该怎么说……这个村子叫坎尼非斯村，坐落在莫利塔尼亚和米斯林的交界处……所以如果西边那些萨拉多明信徒决定攻击我们，我们基本上就在前线……东南边是德拉肯领主的城堡，我们的主人。

english: Ahh... you must be new to these parts if you haven't heard of Lord Draken! He's the lord of this land, and we all pledge allegiance to him.
translation: 啊……你一定是新来的，居然没听说过德拉肯领主！他是这片土地的主人，我们都向他效忠。

english: You mean you kill someone you know in order to meet the tithe?
translation: 你是说，为了凑够血税，你们会杀掉认识的人？

english: That's right, but only if we haven't managed to get enough spare blood from our hunts. It's kind of severe if you look at it that way, but frankly, I think the price is fair for his protection and his tolerance of
translation: 没错，但只有在我们打猎没弄到足够多的血时才会这样。这么说可能有点过分，但老实说，我觉得用这个代价换取他的保护和容忍是公平的。

english: Ah, yeah... good old Rufus... He's kind of getting on in years and doesn't like to come out of his wolf form so often, but let me tell you this: that guy is a hunter through and through. You seen how much food he
translation: 啊，是啊……老好人鲁弗斯……他年纪大了，不太喜欢经常变回狼形，但我告诉你：那家伙是个彻头彻尾的猎人。你看到他一天能抓多少食物了吗？

english: catches a day? That takes real dedication! Some of the young pups think just because a wolf has a bit of grey in his fur then he's past it, but I've seen him put those pups to shame in a hunt! He's a real inspiration to us all!
translation: 那需要真正的奉献精神！有些小崽子觉得，只要狼的毛皮有点灰白，就不中用了，但我见过他在狩猎中让那些小崽子自愧不如！他真是我们所有人的榜样！

english: Luckily they seem to have calmed down somewhat recently, and tend to stay away on their side of the river... but the wrong they have done my people will never be forgotten, and will never be forgiven. What is worse is
translation: 幸运的是，他们最近似乎平静了一些，通常都待在河对岸……但他们对我族人犯下的错永远不会被遗忘，也永远不会被原谅。更糟的是……

english: : ...Um, okay, thanks, bye.

english: A story??? Heh, well the only one I can think of right now is my dear old mammy told me as a pup...

translation: 把他带到房子！勇敢的小狼怀疑是人类的陷阱，就穿上老人的衣服，跳上床，假装成人类好逃离这个可怕的陷阱！可这时，这个人类……

english: You hand over 100 gold and Rohak bakes you a rock cake.
translation: 你交出100金币，罗哈克给你烤了一块石糕。

translation: 好的，我会告诉她的。

english: ...marriage and will...

translation: 我们唯一的希望是劳伦斯神父，我们长期的知己，也许能帮上忙。’

english: Oh , ok...come on! I think I saw the entrance when I visited there last...
translation: 哦，好吧……来吧！我记得上次去的时候看到入口了……

english: Oh , be quiet...
translation: 哦，闭嘴……

translation: 也许我可以帮你找到她？

translation: 虽然你找到了顾客，但你似乎没带对的食物！你需要一份[地精食物/饮料]！

translation: 你把一份[地精食物/饮料]交给罗梅蒂。

translation: 你还有[数字]积分，可换取免费送货代币。你可以获得[数字]份地精食物送货上门。

english: Lemme think... oh yesh. Get me... [a random item].

translation: 我真不知道该去哪儿找那个。

translation: 我曾经拥有那份荣誉……你为何找我？

translation: 啊，我明白了……是的，我知道如何制作这样的物品……不过已经很多年没做过了……

translation: 我很乐意为你制作这个壶，但你必须给我带一根银条……唉，我不能再自己收集材料了，只能留在这里……

english: Yesss, of courssse...There you are, put it to good usssse...
