english: Ahoy there sailor and welcome to Storm Tempor!
translation: 嘿，水手，欢迎来到风暴泰姆波！

english: What do you mean? We've got the fresh sea breeze, the spray of the ocean water, a supply of the finest rum this side of the Unquiet ocean and one of the fiercest storms in Gielinor to contend with.
translation: 你什么意思？我们有清新的海风、飞溅的海水、不宁海这边最好的朗姆酒，还有吉列诺最猛烈的风暴要对付。

english: Ye'd be right to fear the storm, it's bested many a sailor around these parts. That's what makes it so exciting though!
translation: 你害怕风暴是对的，它打败过这一带不少水手。不过这也正是它刺激的地方！

english: Us Barracudas live for the rush and we trust that our skills will save us a trip to the locker.
translation: 我们梭鱼帮就为这种刺激而活，我们相信自己的技能能让我们免于葬身海底。

english: I'm always up for a challenge, but what's the point? Why not take the safer route around the storm?
translation: 我向来喜欢挑战，但有什么意义呢？为什么不走更安全的路线绕过风暴？

english: Well you see, there's value in sailors with skills like us. Most common folk would think like you and avoid the storm, but that takes time and as them merchants say, 'time is money'.
translation: 你看，像我们这样有技能的水手是有价值的。大多数普通人会像你一样想，避开风暴，但那要花时间，就像那些商人说的，‘时间就是金钱’。

english: That's where we come in! Those merchant folk sail up to the south-end of the storm, drop off their shipments to one of our boats down there and we make sure it gets to the Pandemonium!
translation: 这就是我们的用武之地！那些商人航行到风暴南端，把货物卸到我们的一艘船上，我们负责把货物送到潘德莫尼姆岛！

english: Makes sense to me, what's in it for you guys?
translation: 有道理，那你们能得到什么？

english: Why, the thrill of the sport! Sailing isn't just about going places, it's about mastery of the boat, the pull of the sails, the feeling of the tiller in your hand and the taste of rum in your mouth! *hic
translation: 当然是运动的刺激！航行不只是去某个地方，而是掌控船只、拉帆、手握舵柄的感觉，还有嘴里朗姆酒的味道！*嗝

english: Sailing as a sport is what us Barracudas do, we have trials setup all across the sea where you can test your mettle against the clock.
translation: 航行作为一项运动，就是我们梭鱼帮做的事，我们在海上各处设有试炼，你可以挑战时间，测试自己的本事。

english: I'm in charge of this here trial, the Tempor Tantrum.
translation: 我负责这里的试炼，叫‘海灵狂怒’。

english: The objective is simple: Sail south, collect a rum shipment from our boat south of Tempoross and deliver it back to this boat here.
translation: 目标很简单：向南航行，从海灵南边的船上取一批朗姆酒，然后送回这里。

english: While you're out there, keep an eye out for any lost supplies aswell as they also determine your rank.
translation: 在外面的时候，也要留意任何丢失的补给品，因为它们也决定你的等级。

english: If you can deliver all the rum shipments and collect all the lost supplies in the time given, ye'll be awarded a barracuda rank!
translation: 如果你能在规定时间内送达所有朗姆酒并收集所有丢失的补给品，就能获得梭鱼等级！

english: Each trial has three ranks, Swordfish, Shark or Marlin and each rank is harder than the last.
translation: 每个试炼有三个等级：剑鱼、鲨鱼或马林鱼，每个等级都比前一个更难。

english: For this trial you'll be asked to fetch additional rum shipments and collect even more lost supplies as the rank increases.
translation: 在这个试炼中，随着等级提高，你需要取回更多的朗姆酒，收集更多的丢失补给品。

english: You can't attempt the next rank until you beat the one before it. You can also try unranked if you'd rather warm up your hands beforehand.
translation: 你必须先通过当前等级，才能尝试下一个等级。如果你想先热身，也可以尝试无等级模式。

english: Sure do sailor!
translation: 当然有，水手！

english: First up! You're going to need a boat with at least an oak mast built in order to withstand the storm. Boats as good as a goner without that.
translation: 第一！你需要一艘至少装有橡木桅杆的船，才能抵御风暴。没有这个，船就完蛋了。

english: Second! Your boat will also need to have at least an oak hull to withstand the rapids, but those that do will experience a burst of speed from travelling through them.
translation: 第二！你的船还需要至少橡木船体才能抵挡急流，但拥有橡木船体的船在穿过急流时会获得速度爆发。

english: The more rapids you go through without letting your speed drop off the faster you'll go!
translation: 你穿过的急流越多，速度不减，就会越快！

english: Third! Avoid all lightning clouds and try to move as fast as you can, even with a strong mast they'll still slow you down.
translation: 第三！避开所有闪电云，尽量快速移动，即使有坚固的桅杆，它们也会减慢你的速度。

english: Fourth! Keep your sails trimmed to gain even more speed. This aint no shipwreck salvaging, go fast or go home.
translation: 第四！调整好帆，以获得更快的速度。这不是打捞沉船，要么快，要么回家。

english: Finally watch out for those rocks, hitting them will kill all of your boats momentum immediately.
translation: 最后，小心那些岩石，撞上它们会立刻让你的船失去所有动力。

english: Anything worth stealing'?
translation: 有什么值得偷的吗？

translation: 你好！

translation: 蛋白石刃砍刀——萨夫塔.多克需要以下材料制作这把砍刀：3颗蛋白石（切割或未切割）、1株痛风草和300根交易棒。

english: San Tojalon: You have proved yourself of the honour.
translation: 桑.托贾隆：你已经证明了自己的荣誉。

english: A chunk of crystal forms mid-air and falls to the floor. You place the crystal chunk into your inventory.
translation: 一块水晶在空中形成，掉落到地上。你把水晶块放入背包。

english: You give Saniboch 875 coins.
translation: 你给了萨尼博奇875金币。

english: You give Saniboch 1,000,000 coins for permanent access to the dungeon.
translation: 你给了萨尼博奇1,000,000金币，获得地牢的永久通行权。

english: Saniboch has given you a puzzle box!
translation: 萨尼博奇给了你一个谜盒！

english: Saniboch has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 萨尼博奇给了你另一个线索卷轴！

english: Hello Santa, long time no see!
translation: 你好圣诞老人，好久不见！

english: Ho Ho Hello [player name], it certainly has been a long time.
translation: 呵呵呵，你好[玩家名字]，确实好久不见了。

english: Quick question, why are you hanging out with a bunch of angry children?
translation: 问个问题，你怎么跟一群生气的孩子混在一起？

english: Christmas is ruined! My son, Jack Frost, has messed it all up!
translation: 圣诞节毁了！我儿子冰霜杰克把一切都搞砸了！

english: I put him in charge of this year's Christmas to learn some much needed responsibility.
translation: 我让他负责今年的圣诞节，好让他学点责任感。

english: All he does is sit at home, eating my mince pies, drinking my eggnog and throwing snowballs at my elves.
translation: 他整天就待在家里，吃我的肉馅饼，喝我的蛋奶酒，还朝我的精灵扔雪球。

english: So why has that caused a problem with the Gingerbread Gnomes?
translation: 那这跟姜饼地精有什么关系？

english: A major part of my job is overseeing Gingerbread Gnome production here in Varrock. I like to... ensure production is top quality... and do some taste testing from time to time.
translation: 我工作的一大部分就是监督维洛克城的姜饼地精生产。我喜欢……确保产品质量一流……时不时还做点试吃。

english: As soon as he stepped in, production came to a stand still. I need my Gingerbread Gnomes, it's part of my balanced diet.
translation: 他一插手，生产就停滞了。我需要我的姜饼地精，那是我均衡饮食的一部分。

english: So why don't you go help him out instead of standing around Varrock?
translation: 那你为什么不去帮他，反而在维洛克城闲逛？

english: I'm trying a new parenting technique, he needs to learn from his mistakes.
translation: 我在尝试一种新的育儿方法，他得从错误中学习。

english: But in the mean time, could you go and have a word with him? The bakery is south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: 但与此同时，你能去跟他谈谈吗？面包店在维洛克城药剂师南边。

english: Great, now this is my problem, thanks Santa.
translation: 太好了，现在这成了我的问题，谢谢圣诞老人。

english: Have you managed to solve the problem at the Bakery yet?
translation: 你解决面包店的问题了吗？

english: In case you forgot, the bakery is just south of the Apothecary here in Varrock.
translation: 如果你忘了，面包店就在维洛克城药剂师南边。

english: Hurry it along would you, I'm getting quite hungry.
translation: 快点吧，我快饿坏了。

english: Hello again Santa.
translation: 又见面了，圣诞老人。

english: Ho Ho Hello [player name], have you managed to sort out my son?
translation: 呵呵呵，你好[玩家名字]，你搞定我儿子了吗？

english: Not yet, I found the bakery and it appears Jack has thrown a tantrum....
translation: 还没，我找到了面包店，但杰克好像发了顿脾气……

english: Oh dear, what has he done?
translation: 哦天哪，他做了什么？

english: Well he's locked the bakers up and brought in an Icelord.
translation: 他把面包师们锁起来了，还带了个冰霜领主进来。

english: One of the bakers managed to escape and is outside.
translation: 有个面包师逃了出来，现在在外面。

english: Where did I go wrong... Jack used to be such a happy young boy.
translation: 我到底哪里做错了……杰克以前是个那么快乐的小男孩。

english: Looks like I'm going to need to step in if we're going to save Christmas.
translation: 看来我得亲自出马才能拯救圣诞节了。

english: Great! So you're going to go and talk to him?
translation: 太好了！那你要去跟他谈谈吗？

english: Ho Ho Ho, of course not [player name], I've got a better idea.
translation: 呵呵呵，当然不[玩家名字]，我有更好的主意。

english: Fantastic... and that is?
translation: 真棒……什么主意？

english: You're going to bring Anti-Santa to sort him out, Jack is terrified of him.
translation: 你去把反圣诞老人带来收拾他，杰克怕死他了。

english: Anti-Santa?! No way am I freeing him after all that work a few years ago.
translation: 反圣诞老人？！我才不会放他出来，几年前费了那么大劲才把他关起来。

english: Don't you think I know that! We have no choice I'm afraid.
translation: 你以为我不知道吗！但恐怕我们别无选择。

english: I'm sure we can come up with something better than freeing him.
translation: 我肯定我们能想出比放他出来更好的办法。

english: Well if you have a better idea, spit it out.
translation: 那你要是有更好的主意，就快说啊。

english: Thought so, now I'm going to need you to free him from his prison in ScapeRune.
translation: 我就知道。现在我需要你把他从ScapeRune的监狱里放出来。

english: How am I going to do that? Evil Bob took him away....
translation: 我怎么放？邪恶鲍勃把他带走了……

english: Yes, but we don't need Evil Bob's help this time, I can teleport you into his cell.
translation: 没错，但这次我们不需要邪恶鲍勃帮忙，我可以把你传送到他的牢房里。

english: You'll still need to convince him to help us though.
translation: 不过你还是得说服他帮我们。

english: Anti-Santa? Never heard of him, sound'slike an edgy version of you.
translation: 反圣诞老人？从没听说过，听起来像是你的黑暗版。

english: He certainly has his... unique aspects to his personality.
translation: 他确实有……独特的个性。

english: But he'll be very useful for scaring Jack. There aren't many things Jack's afraid of, but that giant skeleton is one of them.
translation: 但他吓唬杰克会很有用。杰克怕的东西不多，但那个巨型骷髅就是其中之一。

english: Where can I find Anti-Santa? I've never come across him in my travels.
translation: 我在哪儿能找到反圣诞老人？我旅行中从没遇见过他。

english: A few years ago, Evil Bob locked him away in ScapeRune.
translation: 几年前，邪恶鲍勃把他关在了ScapeRune。

english: Great, I'm sure if we wait long enough, Evil Bob will appear out of nowhere....
translation: 太好了，我敢肯定只要我们等得够久，邪恶鲍勃就会凭空出现……

english: We don't have time for that, he trusted me to look after him. Evil Bob was tired of dealing with his dirty laundry.
translation: 我们没时间等了，他信任我让我照看他。邪恶鲍勃厌倦了处理他的烂摊子。

english: I'll teleport you right into his cell, you're going to need to convince him to help us.
translation: 我会把你直接传送到他的牢房，你需要说服他帮我们。

english: Surely he'll still be angry about last time?
translation: 他肯定还在为上次的事生气吧？

english: Most likely, but if you tell him that I'm considering setting him free, he'll change his tune.
translation: 很可能，但如果你告诉他我在考虑放他自由，他会改变态度的。

english: Take this as well. After you've convinced him to help, you can use this to teleport both of you to the bakery.
translation: 这个也拿着。说服他帮忙后，你可以用这个把你们俩传送到面包店。

english: You've got too much on you, come back when you've got some free space.
translation: 你身上东西太多了，清出点空间再来吧。

english: Santa gives you a teleport tablet to teleport you to the bakery.
translation: 圣诞老人给了你一块传送石，可以把你传送到面包店。

english: Ah [player name], you've returned, have you managed to sort out the bakery?
translation: 啊[玩家名字]，你回来了，面包店搞定了吗？

english: Hello again Santa, yes I've managed to sort out the bakery and stop your son.
translation: 又见面了圣诞老人，是的，我搞定了面包店，也阻止了你儿子。

english: Ho Ho Ho, that's perfect and what of the Anti-Santa?
translation: 呵呵呵，太好了，那反圣诞老人呢？

english: Uhm... well... there was a slight problem when we returned from ScapeRune.
translation: 嗯……这个……我们从ScapeRune回来时出了点小问题。

english: He sort of beat up Jack then escaped when Jack fled.
translation: 他好像揍了杰克一顿，然后杰克逃跑时他也跑了。

english: Uh... that wasn't supposeto happen. Do you know where they went?
translation: 呃……这不应该发生啊。你知道他们去哪儿了吗？

english: I'm afraid not, Jack teleported out and Anti-Santa followed him.
translation: 恐怕不知道，杰克传送走了，反圣诞老人追着他去了。

english: That's going to come back and bite me in the future... Oh well, problem for another year I suppose, did you manage to make any Gingerbread Gnomes for me?
translation: 这以后肯定会给我惹麻烦……算了，明年再说吧。你帮我做了姜饼地精吗？

english: I'm afraid I didn't, although I do have this giant one I used to protect myself from the Icelord, the bakers are going to use the Icelord from now on to ice their gnomes.
translation: 恐怕没有，不过我有个巨大的姜饼地精，是我用来保护自己免受冰霜领主伤害的。面包师们打算以后用冰霜领主来给他们的地精上糖霜。

english: Oh, that wouldn't be edible at all, Icelord saliva isn't safe to eat, you better keep that one and maybe go tell the bakers later as well.
translation: 哦，那根本不能吃，冰霜领主的唾液不安全。你最好留着那个，然后晚点去告诉面包师们。

english: Ho Ho Ho, well thank you for all your help this year [player name], I'm sure I'll see you again soon.
translation: 呵呵呵，谢谢你今年帮了这么多忙[玩家名字]，我相信我们很快会再见的。

english: Yeah... looking forward to it....
translation: 是啊……很期待……

english: Ho Ho Ho, I'm still waiting for the delivery to come in!
translation: 呵呵呵，我还在等送货呢！

english: Well hello there [player name].
translation: 你好啊[玩家名字]。

english: What can I do for you on this fine winter day?
translation: 在这个美好的冬日，我能为你做些什么？

english: I was hoping to enter into your festive games!
translation: 我想参加你的节日游戏！

english: Ah, splendid! Another contender.
translation: 啊，太好了！又一位参赛者。

english: Now I must warn you, the games will put you to the test. They may even break you.
translation: 但我得警告你，这些游戏会考验你，甚至可能击垮你。

english: Failing the games will put you on the Naughty List until the end of time.
translation: 游戏失败会让你永远待在淘气名单上。

english: Do you accept these conditions?
translation: 你接受这些条件吗？

english: Uh... I guess so.
translation: 呃……我想是吧。

english: Santa tells you your game time.
translation: 圣诞老人告知你的游戏时间。

english: Thanks! Can I also ask a favour?
translation: 谢谢！我能再问个事吗？

english: It depends, have you been nice this year?
translation: 那得看情况，你今年乖吗？

english: Very well, I trust you. What do you desire?
translation: 好吧，我相信你。你想要什么？

english: A Gilded Scimitar.
translation: 一把镀金弯刀。

english: A Twisted Bow.
translation: 一把扭曲弓。

english: Wait no... Sorry ignore that. Instinct kicked in.
translation: 等等不……抱歉，当我没说。本能反应。

english: Could I get another entry time? My friend has been caught up re-homing lost kittens and would love a chance to enter the games.
translation: 我能再要一个参赛时间吗？我朋友一直在忙着给走失的小猫找新家，他很想有机会参加游戏。

english: What a delightful friend you have there. Of course.
translation: 你朋友真不错。当然可以。

english: Santa tells you Guss' game time.
translation: 圣诞老人告诉你格斯的游戏时间。

english: My time and my friend's time are different?
translation: 我的时间和朋友的时间不一样？

english: That's the rules I'm afraid, we can't have any funny business going on.
translation: 恐怕规矩就是这样，我们不能搞什么猫腻。

english: Oh uh... Fair enough.
translation: 哦呃……好吧。

english: Your game time is coming up, better get ready!
translation: 你的游戏时间快到了，最好准备一下！

english: I'll be back in a jiffy. I just need to chat to my... friend.
translation: 我马上回来。我只需要跟我的……朋友聊两句。

english: Before you go in, you'll need to solve a Christmas riddle...
translation: 在你进去之前，你得先解一个圣诞谜语……

english: Oh gosh.
translation: 哦天哪。

english: It's nothing sorry. Speaking to myself.
translation: 没什么，抱歉。我在自言自语。

english: So, on to the riddle...
translation: 那么，谜语来了……

english: What do you get when you meet a vampyre in the winter?
translation: 冬天遇到吸血鬼会得到什么？

english: Killed.
translation: 被杀。

english: A nice seafood dinner for two.
translation: 一顿双人海鲜晚餐。

english: Frostbite.
translation: 冻伤。

english: Ho Ho oh no, that's not quite right... How about this one? I'm feeling kind today.
translation: 呵呵呵，不对……那这个呢？我今天心情好。

english: I am a plant seen every Christmas which people hang up above, they stand beneath me and kiss someone they love.
translation: 我是一种植物，每年圣诞节人们把我挂起来，站在我下面亲吻所爱之人。

english: Mistletoe.
translation: 槲寄生。

english: Wreath.
translation: 花环。

english: Stocking.
translation: 长袜。

english: Gosh you really want to enter these games after failing two easy riddles?
translation: 天哪，连错两个这么简单的谜语，你还真想参加这些游戏？

english: They're gonna eat you alive in there, but best of luck!
translation: 他们会在里面把你生吞活剥的，不过祝你好运！

english: Ho ho happy days! Well done that's the right answer.
translation: 呵呵，好日子！干得好，答对了。

english: You may now enter into the Festive Games!
translation: 你现在可以进入节日游戏了！

english: I'll bring you out a beer when Guss wins!
translation: 等格斯赢了，我给你拿杯啤酒出来！

english: Guss??
translation: 格斯？？

english: I mean when I win, ha ha. Slip of the tongue.
translation: 我是说等我赢了，哈哈。说漏嘴了。

english: Would you like to enter the games?
translation: 你想参加游戏吗？

english: I'll enter soon, there's just something I need to do.
translation: 我一会儿再参加，有件事要先做。

english: I'll be here all Christmas.
translation: 我整个圣诞节都会在这儿。

english: Amazing job in the games [player name], you and Guss really made a great show.
translation: 游戏里表现太棒了，[玩家名]，你和格斯真是上演了一场好戏。

english: You... saw?
translation: 你……看到了？

english: I see all.
translation: 我无所不见。

english: You really think I didn't see yours and Guss's little plan?
translation: 你真以为我没看到你和格斯的小计划？

english: I don't think I've ever seen such dedication to The Nutcracker from anyone. Guss earned it.
translation: 我从没见过有人对《胡桃夹子》这么投入。格斯应得的。

english: Guss thinks they're on the naughty list! I can't wait to tell them.
translation: 格斯以为自己上了淘气名单！我等不及要告诉他们了。

english: I'm afraid that'll have to be our little secret [player name].
translation: 恐怕这得是我们之间的小秘密了，[玩家名]。

english: Oh crumbs.
translation: 哦，糟了。

english: Have a happy holidays [player name]!
translation: 节日快乐，[玩家名]！

english: Are you Sarah Corvo?
translation: 你是莎拉.科沃吗？

english: Yes gone. When my father passed the key down to me he told me that I must keep it safe no matter what. When the vampyres came to Port Phasmatys I buried it out in the swamps to stop them from getting it.
translation: 是的，不见了。我父亲把钥匙传给我时，告诉我无论如何都要保管好它。当吸血鬼来到法斯提斯港时，我把它埋在沼泽里，以防他们拿到。

english: Metal?
translation: 金属？

english: Hmm. I think I might know just the scientist to help me out with this. Time for me to visit Draynor Manor.
translation: 嗯。我想我知道哪位科学家能帮我解决这个问题。是时候去拜访德拉诺庄园了。

english: Oh nothing. I'd best be off, thank you for your time.
translation: 哦，没什么。我该走了，多谢你抽空。

english: Nope, just stopping by to say hello.
translation: 不，只是顺路打个招呼。

english: Ello matey! D'ya wanna buy some exciting new toys?
translation: 嘿，伙计！想买些刺激的新玩具吗？

english: The seer produces a small mirror
translation: 先知拿出一面小镜子。

english: The seer gazes into the mirror
translation: 先知凝视着镜子。

english: The seer smoothes his hair with his hand
translation: 先知用手抚平头发。

english: Well, I've checked my looking glass. There seems to be a kharid scorpion in a little village to the east, surrounded by lots of uncivilised-looking warriors. Some kind of merchant there seems to have picked it up.
translation: 嗯，我查过我的镜子了。东边一个小村庄里似乎有只卡里德蝎子，周围全是些粗野的战士。那里有个商人好像捡到了它。

english: I've retrieved the second scorpion.
translation: 我已经取回了第二只蝎子。

english: Selim hands you a Keris dagger in exchange for 20,000 coins.
translation: 塞利姆递给你一把克里西斯弯刀，换取两万金币。

english: Selim hands you a Keris partisan in exchange for 60,000 coins.
translation: 塞利姆递给你一把克里西斯阔头枪，换取六万金币。

english: Go on this mat and do some star jumps!
translation: 到这块垫子上做开合跳！

english: Go to this mat and do some push ups!
translation: 到这块垫子上做俯卧撑！

english: Go to this mat and jog on the spot!
translation: 到这块垫子上原地慢跑！

english: Go to this mat and do some sit ups!
translation: 到这块垫子上做仰卧起坐！

english: Go to this mat and do some star jumps!
translation: 到这块垫子上做开合跳！

english: How does it fit in a shed then?
translation: 那它怎么塞进棚屋的？

english: I've been in that shed, I didn't see a city.
translation: 我去过那个棚屋，没看到城市。

english: You show the certificate to the sheep.
translation: 你把证书给羊看。

english: You decided it's best not to hurt the boy.
translation: 你决定最好别伤害那男孩。

english: You give the lad 100 coins.
translation: 你给了小伙子100金币。

english: Well never mind, it's Fluffs' loss.
translation: 算了，那是毛毛的损失。

english: (End of dialogue)
translation: （对话结束）

english: Your inventory is too full to accept another Talisman.
translation: 你的背包太满，无法再拿护符。

english: I defeated the draugen, but I have lost the talisman to prove I did.
translation: 我击败了德拉根，但弄丢了证明的护符。

english: What's a Draugen?
translation: 什么是德拉根？

english: Greetings again brother [Fremennik name]! What can I do for you this day?
translation: 再次问候，兄弟[弗瑞曼尼名字]！今天我能为你做些什么？

english: You buy some silk for 2 gp.
translation: 你花2金币买了些丝绸。

english: You buy some silk for 3 gp.
translation: 你花3金币买了些丝绸。

english: I'll see what I can find once I take it off my key ring.
translation: 等我从钥匙环上取下来，看看能找到什么。

english: That's kind of hard because I lost the key.
translation: 这有点难，因为我弄丢了钥匙。

english: I found a chest, but I lost it and any contents it had.
translation: 我找到了一个箱子，但弄丢了它和里面的东西。

english: I was waiting for you to say that because I just found it!
translation: 我正等你这么说，因为我刚找到它！

english: I found a chest
translation: 我找到了一个箱子

english: Erin reads the journal.
translation: 艾琳读了日记。

english: Ask about the outpost.
translation: 询问前哨站。

english: You hand over the artefact(s) and Simon hands you [10000 per Pyramid top] coins.
translation: 你交出文物，西蒙递给你[每个金字塔顶10000]金币。

english: Can't you go to another spot?
translation: 你不能换个地方吗？

english: Arghh! WHAT is that GHASTLY smell??? I think I will mover over here instead...
translation: 啊！那是什么恶心的味道？？？我想我还是挪到这边来吧……

english: Sir Kay has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 凯爵士给了你一张挑战卷轴！

english: Sir Kay has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 凯爵士又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: King Percival has given you a challenge scroll!
translation: 珀西瓦尔国王给了你一张挑战卷轴！

english: Sir Prysin has given you another clue scroll!

english: A cutscene plays in which Ranis Drakan and Vanstrom Klause arrive at Ver Sinhaza and enter the Theatre of Blood.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，拉尼斯.德雷坎和范斯特罗姆.克劳斯抵达维尔辛哈萨，进入血腥剧场。

english: A cutscene plays in which a large looming shadow is spotted to the east.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，东方出现了一个巨大的逼近的阴影。

english: A cutscene plays in which the abomination attacks the Myreque Hideout.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，憎恶怪袭击了迈雷克藏身处。

english: A cutscene plays in which the player uses the chimes and Incomitatus is healed to perfect health.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，玩家使用风铃，英科米塔图斯被治愈，恢复完美健康。

english: A cutscene plays in which two Terrorbird Guards are guarding a door.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，两只骇鸟守卫正守着一扇门。

english: A cutscene plays of a Khazard Ogre exiting a cell toward Justin Servil.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，一名卡扎德食人魔从牢房里走出来，走向贾斯汀.塞尔维尔。

english: A cutscene plays, showing Ranis' corpse. Vanescula Drakan and Vanstrom Klause approach the body.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，显示拉尼斯的尸体。范尼斯库拉.德雷坎和范斯特罗姆.克劳斯走向尸体。

english: A cutscene plays, showing a workshop too big for regular-sized people to use.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，显示一个对普通人来说太大的工作室。

english: A cutscene plays, showing the statue from The Giant Dwarf. "Rise of the Red Axe, Part II, Forgettable Tale of a Drunken Dwarf" appears on the screen, and the camera pans to the drunken dwarf's house. The player ends up in front of the house after the cutscene.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，显示《巨大的矮人》中的雕像。屏幕上出现“红斧崛起，第二部，醉酒的矮人之难忘故事”字样，镜头转向醉酒矮人的房子。过场动画结束后，玩家出现在房子前。

english: A cutscene plays, where the monks, Iffie, and the player partying it up at the Blue Moon Inn. Getting Down to Business music track plays.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，僧侣们、伊菲和玩家在蓝月旅馆狂欢。背景音乐播放着《开始干活》的曲目。

english: A cutscene plays. The Great Guardian prepares to close the rift.
translation: 一段过场动画播放。伟大守护者准备关闭裂隙。

english: A cutscene plays. The three apprentices and Traiborn appear.
translation: 一段过场动画播放。三名学徒和特雷伯恩出现。

english: A cutscene showing Wally defeating Delrith plays.
translation: 一段过场动画播放，显示沃利击败德尔里斯。

english: A cutscene shows a near-invisible gnome sneak by Brimstail and the player as they discuss.
translation: 一段过场动画显示，一个近乎隐形的侏儒在布林斯泰尔和玩家交谈时悄悄溜过他们身边。

english: A cutscene shows him killing an ogre shaman
translation: 一段过场动画显示他杀死了一名食人魔萨满。

english: A cutscene shows the Ancestral Glyph breaking, freeing TzKal-Zuk from his prison.
translation: 一段过场动画显示先祖符文破碎，将特兹卡尔.祖克从囚禁中释放出来。

english: A cutscene starts right after freeing the last council member.
translation: 在释放最后一名议会成员后，一段过场动画开始。

english: A cutscene starts with King Roald and the player stepping into the Garden.
translation: 一段过场动画开始，罗尔德国王和玩家步入花园。

english: A cutscene starts with two Falador guards...
translation: 一段过场动画开始，两名法拉多城守卫……

english: A cutscene starts. All the frogs and capybara gather by the water.
translation: 一段过场动画开始。所有的青蛙和水豚都聚集在水边。

english: A cutscene starts. Spooky music track plays.
translation: 一段过场动画开始。播放阴森的音乐曲目。

english: A cutsene starts.
translation: 一段过场动画开始。

english: A danger?
translation: 一个危险？

english: A dark liquid has been smeared onto the doll.
translation: 一种黑色液体被涂抹在玩偶上。

english: A dark power emanates from the relic. You sense that this power can be directed.
translation: 一股黑暗的力量从遗物中散发出来。你感觉到这股力量可以被引导。

english: A defeated dragon is a good dragon.
translation: 被打败的龙就是好龙。

english: A dog is just what I need! Emma and Suzie's new business has been keeping me on my toes and I need someone to practice new styles on... I'm in!
translation: 我正需要一只狗！艾玛和苏西的新生意让我忙得不可开交，我需要有人来练习新发型……我加入！

english: A dog? I dunno... I'm fine on my own, but I'll think about it.
translation: 一只狗？我不知道……我一个人挺好的，但我会考虑一下。

english: A dragon? Look out!
translation: 一条龙？小心！

english: A dull knife that was presumably once used for food preparation. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
translation: 一把钝刀，大概曾经用来准备食物。你觉得这么古老的物品应该放在博物馆里。

english: A fabulous roll of fabric awarded to those who have achieved the marlin rank at the Jubbly Jive Barracuda Trial. This would make a fine flag to showcase on a boat.
translation: 一卷华丽的织物，奖励给在朱布利摇摆梭鱼试炼中达到马林鱼等级的玩家。这可以做成一面漂亮的旗帜，挂在船上展示。

english: A faint smell of poison and a few dead spiders is all that remains of the spiders nest.
translation: 蜘蛛巢只剩下淡淡的毒药味和几只死蜘蛛。

english: A ferret goes into the box trap.
translation: 一只雪貂钻进了箱式陷阱。

english: A few freshly cooked anchovies would be perfect for the salad I'm preparing. I still need [number].
translation: 几份刚煮好的凤尾鱼正好适合我正在准备的沙拉。我还需要[number]。

english: A few freshly cooked anchovies would be perfect for the salad I'm preparing. Please bring me [number].
translation: 几份刚煮好的凤尾鱼正好适合我正在准备的沙拉。请给我带[number]份来。

english: A few hours should be fine. Here are the eggs.
translation: 几个小时应该没问题。这是鸡蛋。

english: A few hours...? But I have other things to do!
translation: 几个小时……？但我还有别的事要做！

english: A few lumps of iron ore would be nice. I still need [number].
translation: 几块铁矿石会很不错。我还需要[number]。

english: A final flashback shows King Healthorg, Oaknock, Glouphrie and Hazelmere in front of an apparently intact Argento.
translation: 最后的闪回画面显示，海尔索格国王、奥克诺克、格洛弗里和黑兹尔米尔站在一个看似完好无损的阿根托面前。

english: A flag appears on the booth to let you know when you're invited to vote in a poll.
translation: 投票亭上会出现一面旗帜，通知你被邀请参与投票。

english: A flashback begins, visually showing the battle between gnomes and goblins.
translation: 一段闪回开始，画面展示了地精与哥布林之间的战斗。

english: A flashback to a few days ago...
translation: 闪回到几天前……

english: A flashback to a few nights ago...
translation: 闪回到几个夜晚前……

english: A follower of mine will offer assistance instantly, for they are pure of heart and know the glory of performing good deeds in my name.
translation: 我的追随者会立即提供帮助，因为他们心地纯洁，知道以我的名义行善的荣耀。

english: A fountain with large numbers of insects around the base.
translation: 一座喷泉，底座周围聚集着大量昆虫。

english: A ghost cat? Oh no! How are we supposed to understand one of those?
translation: 一只幽灵猫？哦不！我们怎么可能听得懂那种东西说话？

english: A ghost cat? Would you believe it, I can actually understand one of those!
translation: 一只幽灵猫？你信不信，我居然能听懂那种东西说话！

english: A giant Kebbit jumps out of the cave.
translation: 一只巨大的凯比特兔从洞穴里跳了出来。

english: A gift? I don't think a present is going to make me win...
translation: 一份礼物？我不觉得一份礼物能让我赢……

english: A glow of happiness appears on the child's face as they open the present.
translation: 孩子打开礼物时，脸上露出了幸福的光芒。

english: A glow of happiness appears on the gnome child's face as they open the present.
translation: 地精孩子打开礼物时，脸上露出了幸福的光芒。

english: A gnome needs your help, and he sent me here.
translation: 一个地精需要你的帮助，他派我到这里来。

english: A gnome wants something from the Wise Old Man, and he said we should talk to you since the old man's gone away.
translation: 一个地精想从老智者那里拿点东西，他说既然那个老人走了，我们应该跟你谈谈。

english: A good serf should know better than to leave the refrigerator open for so long.
translation: 一个好农奴应该知道不能把冰箱门开这么久。

english: A good word?
translation: 一句好话？

english: A green tear.
translation: 一滴绿色眼泪。

english: A grisly sight meets your eyes. A human corpse hangs from the noose. His hands have been tied behind his back.
translation: 眼前是一幅可怕的景象。一具人类的尸体吊在绞索上。他的双手被绑在背后。

english: A guard approaches you and pretends to start hitting you.
translation: 一名守卫走近你，假装开始打你。

english: A guard comes over and takes the barrel off you.
translation: 一名守卫走过来，拿走了你身上的桶。

english: A guard in a high position.
translation: 一个身居高位的守卫。

english: A guard spots you in a restricted area and kicks you out.
translation: 一名守卫在禁区发现了你，把你赶了出去。

english: A guard with a big bag walks out of Varrock Castle.
translation: 一名背着大袋子的守卫走出维洛克城堡。

english: A happy ending for all... apart from Wilough. Fancy buying an iron platebody?
translation: 对所有人来说都是个幸福的结局……除了威洛。想买件铁制胸甲吗？

english: A high quality salvaging hook, damaged by something fierce. You reckon it might be useful for shipbuilding.
translation: 一个高质量的打捞钩，被某种猛烈的东西损坏了。你觉得它可能对造船有用。

english: A horse
translation: 一匹马

english: A hot cramped crate I imagine!
translation: 我想象是一个又热又挤的板条箱！

english: A huge roar comes from the well as the temple starts to collapse.
translation: 随着神庙开始崩塌，井中传来一声巨大的咆哮。

english: A human party has such focus on food and drink. This is apt. Consider how we come to celebrate the passing of six years...
translation: 人类的派对如此专注于食物和饮料。这很恰当。想想我们是如何庆祝六年时光的流逝……

english: A humiliating defeat for [other player name].
translation: [other player name]遭受了耻辱性的失败。

english: A hunk of crystal forms mid-air and falls to the floor. You place the crystal hunk into your inventory.
translation: 一块大水晶块在半空中形成，掉落到地上。你将这块大水晶块放入背包。

english: A jewel which can be attached to a Keris Partisan granting increased accuracy and damage within Tombs of Amascut.
translation: 一颗可以镶嵌在克里西斯阔头枪上的宝石，可在阿玛斯库特之墓中提供更高的命中率和伤害。

english: A jewel which can be attached to a Keris Partisan granting it a passive ability to restore health at the cost of prayer when defeating creatures within Tombs of Amascut and to have increased accuracy against them
translation: 一颗可以镶嵌在克里西斯阔头枪上的宝石，使其获得被动能力，在阿玛斯库特之墓中击败生物时，能以消耗祈祷值为代价恢复生命值，并对它们拥有更高的命中率。

english: A jewel which can be attached to a Keris Partisan granting it a special attack which when used increases damage taken by creatures within Tombs of Amascut.
translation: 一颗可以镶嵌在克里西斯阔头枪上的宝石，使其获得一项战技，使用时能增加阿玛斯库特之墓中生物受到的伤害。

english: A jewel which can be attached to a Keris Partisan granting it increased accuracy against Kalphites and Scarabs.
translation: 一颗可以镶嵌在克里西斯阔头枪上的宝石，使其对圣甲虫和圣甲虫类生物拥有更高的命中率。

english: A large Bandosian force is marching on Paddewwa. Reinforcements will be needed there.
translation: 一支庞大的班多斯军队正在向帕德瓦进军。那里需要增援。

english: A learning opportunity then. Chromium is one of our most significant discoveries. With it we have elevated the empire. It behoves us all to know how it is made.
translation: 那是个学习的机会。铬是我们最重要的发现之一。凭借它，我们提升了帝国的地位。我们所有人都应该知道它是如何制造的。

english: A light! I see the other side!
translation: 有光！我看到另一边了！

english: A lightning conductor mould falls down out of the chimney.
translation: 一个避雷针模具从烟囱里掉了下来。

english: A little too fiery... It burns your insides!
translation: 有点太辣了……烧得你五脏六腑都疼！

english: A little while?
translation: 一小会儿？

english: A little.
translation: 一点点。

english: A long-broken compass. It doesn't point anywhere now. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
translation: 一个早已损坏的指南针。现在它哪里也指不了了。你觉得这么古老的物品应该放在博物馆里。

english: A long-broken sextant that would have been used to navigate the seas. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
translation: 一个早已损坏的六分仪，曾经用于海上导航。你觉得这么古老的物品应该放在博物馆里。

english: A low hum resonates from the Amulet of Nature - it seeks audience with you.
translation: 自然护符发出低沉的嗡鸣声——它想与你交流。

english: A lump of crystal forms mid-air and falls to the floor. You place the crystal lump into your inventory.
translation: 一块水晶团块在半空中形成，掉落到地上。你将这块水晶团块放入背包。

english: A magic circle appears in the floor...
translation: 地板上出现了一个魔法圈……

english: A magic land of snow, wardrobes, and lions
translation: 一个充满雪、衣柜和狮子的魔法之地

english: A magical dye. It looks like it could fit a fortified version of Elidinis' Ward.
translation: 一种魔法染料。看起来可以用于伊莉迪尼斯护符的强化版本。

english: A magical force calls you to Zanaris.
translation: 一股魔法力量召唤你前往扎纳里斯城。

english: A magical force prevents you from gripping the monkeybars.
translation: 一股魔力阻止你抓住猴子杠。

english: A magical piece of bone, turned strong and hard over the course of time. It looks like it could fit Osmumten's Fang.
translation: 一块神奇的骨头，随着时间的推移变得坚硬无比。看起来可以用于奥斯穆滕之牙。

english: A man from the Legends' Guild saw what happened and helped me up, he spoke of some kind of temple and offered to help me retrieve the artifact.
translation: 一位来自传说公会的人看到了发生的事情，并扶我起来。他提到某种神庙，并主动提出帮我取回神器。

english: A man near some trees.
translation: 一个靠近一些树的男人。

english: A max hit. Nice.
translation: 最大伤害。不错。

english: A minor haunting! How about that for a trick?
translation: 一个小闹鬼！这个把戏怎么样？

english: A mission? What kind of mission?
translation: 一个任务？什么样的任务？

english: A monument dedicated to the fallen.
translation: 一座献给阵亡者的纪念碑。

english: A mouldy doll that was presumably once the property of a child. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
translation: 一个发霉的玩偶，大概曾经是某个孩子的财产。你觉得这么古老的物品应该放在博物馆里。

english: A mouldy wooden block that might have once been part of a toy. You get the feeling that an item this old belongs in a museum.
translation: 一块发霉的木块，可能曾经是玩具的一部分。你觉得这么古老的物品应该放在博物馆里。

english: A mouse runs out of the hole.
translation: 一只老鼠从洞里跑了出来。

english: A murder.
translation: 一桩谋杀案。

english: A mysterious bandaged hand punches you away from the door. Ouch!
translation: 一只缠着绷带的神秘手把你从门口打飞了。哎哟！

english: A mystical force blasts the orb back out.
translation: 一股神秘力量将宝珠弹了回去。

english: A narwhal horn of the highest quality. You think you could probably fashion this into a knife.
translation: 一根最高品质的独角鲸角。你觉得大概可以把它做成一把刀。

english: A nearby guard spots you!
translation: 附近的一名守卫发现了你！

english: A needle is required to remove this crafting kit.
translation: 需要一根针才能移除这个制作工具包。

english: A needle is required to work with this crafting kit.
translation: 需要一根针才能使用这个制作工具包。

english: A new recruit? Excellent! Please talk to the squire in the courtyard for the required paperwork!
translation: 一个新兵？太好了！请到庭院里找侍从办理所需文件！

english: A nudge that's brought a bit more colour to Gielinor.
translation: 一次推动，为吉列诺带来了更多色彩。

english: A pair of civilians.
translation: 一对平民。

english: A pair of magical gauntlets that when worn grant your next magic attack of the same type a doubled chance of hitting if the previous attack missed.
translation: 一双魔法手套，穿戴后，如果你的上一次魔法攻击落空，下一次同类型的魔法攻击将有双倍几率命中。

english: A palm leaf falls to the ground.
translation: 一片棕榈叶落到了地上。

english: A panel opens from the bookcase. The letter 'L' appears to be scratched into it.
translation: 书架上打开了一块镶板。上面似乎刻着字母'L'。

english: A particular bunny told me you're a dab hand at making things bigger.
translation: 一只特别的兔子告诉我，你很擅长把东西变大。

english: A party like this cannot be rushed!
translation: 这样的派对不能操之过急！

english: A passage hidden behind a bookcase. Leads directly from the backstage area to the wine cellar. Likely how the killer got to Livius.
translation: 一条隐藏在书架后面的通道。直接从后舞台区域通往酒窖。很可能是杀手接近利维乌斯的路径。

english: A pear sapling for Farmer Fred.
translation: 一棵给农夫弗雷德的梨树苗。

english: A piece of Rogue equipment.
translation: 一件盗贼装备。

english: A piece of paper slides out between the crates wooden slats. You take it.
translation: 一张纸从板条箱的木条之间滑了出来。你把它拿走了。

english: A pillory guard appears behind the Wise Old Man and attempts to arrest him
translation: 一名枷锁守卫出现在老智者身后，试图逮捕他。

english: A place to sleep when darkness falls.
translation: 一个在夜幕降临时睡觉的地方。

english: A plague.
translation: 一场瘟疫。

english: A pole vault
translation: 撑杆跳

english: A pot of soup is bubbling away on the range.
translation: 炉灶上有一锅汤在咕嘟咕嘟地煮着。

english: A potion? Oh yes, I make lots of those. Here's one I made for my mother - you can have it, since she didn't drink it all...
translation: 药水？哦对，我做了很多。这瓶是我给母亲做的——既然她没喝完，就给你吧……

english: A powerful magic seizes you and throws you from Keep La Faye.
translation: 一股强大的魔法抓住了你，把你从拉斐堡扔了出去。

english: A powerful staff that can cast two bolt, blast or wave spells at once. Prioritises casting spells that match your foe's elemental weakness and gives a 10% accuracy and damage bonus for Standard Spellbook spells.
translation: 一根强大的法杖，可以同时施放两种箭、爆或波系法术。优先施放符合敌人元素弱点的法术，并为标准法术书中的法术提供10%的准确度和伤害加成。

english: A pretty babbling spring. The water bubbles with a strange effervescence.
translation: 一处美丽的潺潺泉水。水面上冒着奇怪的泡沫。

english: A pretty trinket for Gillie the milk maid.
translation: 一件给送奶女工吉莉的漂亮小饰品。

english: A priest!?
translation: 一个祭司！？

english: A pumpkin dye, perhaps?
translation: 也许是南瓜染料？

english: A question? I do know many things. But as with all things, information doesn't come free.
translation: 一个问题？我确实知道很多事情。但和所有事物一样，信息不是免费的。

english: A rather loud clank reverberates from the safe. It sounds as if you've gotten the combination wrong. You wonder how many more attempts you have before the safe permanently locks itself.
translation: 保险箱里传来一声相当响亮的哐当声。听起来像是你输错了组合。你 wondering 在保险箱永久锁死之前你还有多少次尝试机会。

english: A realtor who'd been assessing the house earlier
translation: 一个早些时候评估过这栋房子的房地产经纪人

english: A rehoming event? That sounds like a party to me, and I absolutely love a party! Let's make this happen for you. Where were you thinking of hosting your event?

english: Adopt a dog? You must know me well my friend! I have been thinking about it for some time now... Of course I will attend the event!
translation: 领养一只狗？你一定很了解我，我的朋友！我已经考虑这件事很久了……我当然会参加活动！

english: Adventure? I thought you were just heading to Varrock Museum?
translation: 冒险？我以为你只是要去维洛克城博物馆？

english: Adventurer, are you quite alright?
translation: 冒险者，你还好吗？

english: Advisor Ghrim of Miscellania has been helping Neitiznot.
translation: 米斯凯尼亚的顾问格里姆一直在帮助奈提兹诺镇。

english: Aeonisig teleports you back to Paterdomus.
translation: 埃奥尼西格把你传送回帕特多莫斯。

english: After I entered the lighthouse, and repaired the lighting mechanism, I discovered a strange wall that blocked the entrance to an underground cavern, where Jossik was.
translation: 我进入灯塔并修理了照明装置后，发现了一堵奇怪的墙壁，堵住了通往地下洞穴的入口，乔西克就在那里。

english: After I killed some strange sea monsters, I managed to get Jossik out of the cavern and back to the lighthouse.
translation: 我杀死了一些奇怪的海怪后，成功把乔西克从洞穴里救出来，带回了灯塔。

english: After all, you are more than welcome to dress how you like, when you like.
translation: 毕竟，你随时都可以随心所欲地打扮。

english: After an hour threading a needle, and then 20 minutes of sewing, Iffie hands over something that vaguely represents a snow imp.
translation: 花了一个小时穿针引线，然后又缝了二十分钟，伊菲递过来一个勉强像雪地小恶魔的东西。

english: After applying the cleaning solution to the vat, the tanning stains magically vanish!
translation: 将清洁液涂在大桶上后，鞣革污渍神奇地消失了！

english: After carefully examining the rocks, you manage to pick up the mysterious trail again. The tracks aren't entirely unfamiliar, but they do seem somewhat larger than any you have seen before.
translation: 仔细检查岩石后，你再次找到了神秘的踪迹。这些足迹并非完全陌生，但似乎比你以前见过的都要大一些。

english: After drinking the milk, you fail an unseen skill check.
translation: 喝下牛奶后，你未能通过一个隐藏的技能检定。

english: After finishing the chore
translation: 完成杂务后

english: After gaining access to the House, we started preparing for Forebearer Janus to return. To do so, I created a Makeshift Blackjack and gave Captain Vibia a Sack. Once he arrived, Captain Vibia used the Sack to restrain him and I knocked him out with the Blackjack. Captain Vibia then departed to fetch Queen Zyanyi.
translation: 进入房子后，我们开始准备迎接先驱者雅努斯归来。为此，我做了一把临时短棍，并给了维比娅船长一个麻袋。他一到，维比娅船长就用麻袋制住了他，我用短棍把他打晕。然后维比娅船长就出发去接赞扬伊女王了。

english: After hearing a noise from the tree, the Count hurries up taking the rest of the rings from your hand.
translation: 听到树上有动静，伯爵急忙从你手中拿走了剩下的戒指。

english: After inspecting the marker, you get the feeling that you could get back here somehow.
translation: 检查标记后，你感觉有办法能回到这里。

english: After inspecting the marker, you get the feeling that you could get back here with your sailors' amulet.
translation: 检查标记后，你感觉可以用水手护符回到这里。

english: After level 42
translation: 42级之后

english: After perusing the empty bookcase for a while, you decide to check behind it. There's a crevice in the wall! You might just be able to force your way through if you were in any way athletic.
translation: 在空书架前看了一会儿后，你决定检查一下书架后面。墙上有一条裂缝！如果你身手够矫健，也许能挤过去。

english: After some deliberation, you withdraw your hand from the questionable stash.
translation: 考虑了一下，你把手从那可疑的藏匿处缩了回来。

english: After some time you find a scrumpled up piece of paper. It looks like rubbish.
translation: 过了一会儿，你找到了一张皱巴巴的纸。看起来像垃圾。

english: After some time, he comes back and gives you an animate rock spell.
translation: 过了一会儿，他回来了，给了你一个岩石活化法术。

english: After some time, you find a small cave opening... and walk through.
translation: 过了一会儿，你发现了一个小小的洞穴开口……然后走了进去。

english: After talking to Oriana
translation: 与奥莉安娜交谈后

english: After the goblin invasion of Lumbridge, our scout managed to track the goblins back to their lair. Now we've set up a portal to transport our army in there.
translation: 哥布林入侵仑桥镇后，我们的斥候追踪到了它们的巢穴。现在我们设置了一个传送门，可以把我们的军队送进去。

english: After we climb down from our trees I'll walk to my next one and wait for you to climb yours.
translation: 我们从树上爬下来后，我会走到下一棵树那里，等你爬上你的树。

english: After weeding the garden
translation: 给花园除完草后

english: After your drink, you hear an excited meow nearby.
translation: 喝完饮料后，你听到附近传来一声兴奋的猫叫。

english: Against all common sense, the Medallion of the Deep has somehow found its way into this crate. You quickly grab it before you lose it again.
translation: 完全不合常理的是，深海奖章不知怎么跑到了这个板条箱里。你赶紧在它再次消失之前把它抓了起来。

english: Aggie can help there.
translation: 阿吉能帮忙。

english: Aggie hands you another bottle of thickened dye.
translation: 阿吉递给你另一瓶浓稠的染料。

english: Aggie hands you the Skin Paste.
translation: 阿吉把皮肤糊状物递给你。

english: Aggie suggested we paint all the roads different colours, but Doric said that would clash too much with the green grass.
translation: 阿吉建议我们把所有的路漆成不同的颜色，但多里克说那样会和绿色的草太不搭。

english: Aggie takes the dust and mixes up some gold paint and hands it to you.
translation: 阿吉接过粉尘，调了一些金色油漆递给你。

english: Aggie takes the dust and mixes up some silver paint and hands it to you.
translation: 阿吉接过粉尘，调了一些银色油漆递给你。

english: Aggressiveness was highly increased, and there were numerous perceptual faults, hallucinations and the like.
translation: 攻击性大幅增加，并出现了许多感知错误、幻觉等情况。

english: Ah! This is always a sore point for mortals. The answer is both yes and no.

translation: 啊！你也许能帮上忙！

translation: 啊！[player name]，我正需要你。

translation: 啊，我想你是在找这个。

english: Ah, I forgot that's why we started doing this in the first place.
translation: 啊，我忘了我们一开始为什么要做这件事。

english: Ah, I see. Well, you will be disappointed to hear that thus far, everything is going smoothly.
translation: 啊，我明白了。不过，你听了可能会失望——到目前为止，一切都很顺利。

english: Ah, [player name]! Such glorious battle makes you feel glad of life, does it not?
translation: 啊，[player name]！如此辉煌的战斗让你感到生命的喜悦，不是吗？

english: Ah, [player name]! How goes the League?
translation: 啊，[player name]！联赛进行得怎么样了？

english: Ah, [player name], thank you so much for coming to help me. It's terrible, simply terrible. I can't understand it at all.
translation: 啊，[player name]，非常感谢你来帮我。太可怕了，简直太可怕了。我完全搞不懂。

english: Ah, [player name]. Thank you for coming. I require your assistance.
translation: 啊，[player name]。感谢你的到来。我需要你的帮助。

english: Ah, already sorted one out?
translation: 啊，已经解决了一个？

english: Ah, an egg box. The solution is usually near where you found it. Try searching the Archery shop for clues.
translation: 啊，一个蛋盒。线索通常就在你找到它的地方附近。去弓箭店找找看。

english: Ah, but you are not to know. You are very young after all.
translation: 啊，不过你不知道也正常。毕竟你还太年轻。

english: Ah, darn. Party Pete's deviled eggs are rather delicious, I was hoping he would have made a batch.
translation: 啊，该死。派对皮特的魔鬼蛋还挺好吃的，我还指望他做了一批呢。

english: Ah, finally someone else who sees through the cheerful facade! But what exactly do you want to do, mortal?
translation: 啊，终于有人能看穿那副欢快的假象了！不过，凡人，你到底想做什么？

english: Ah, good chap, you're back. Give me the cow blood, so I can decorate this chamber.
translation: 啊，好家伙，你回来了。把牛血给我，我好装饰这间密室。

english: Ah, hello there! Any luck wit' the fish?
translation: 啊，你好！鱼钓得怎么样？

english: Ah, hello! I have some rewards for you but I'm afraid they're currently in the Falador Party room. Come talk to me there!
translation: 啊，你好！我有一些奖励要给你，不过恐怕它们现在在法拉多城的派对室里。去那里找我谈吧！

english: Ah, here are my notes!
translation: 啊，我的笔记在这里！

english: Ah, if it isn't the spookiest Trick-or-Treater!
translation: 啊，这不是最吓人的不给糖就捣蛋鬼吗！

english: Ah, it seems I can't give you your rewards right now. You'll have to come back with more free inventory spaces.
translation: 啊，看来我现在没法给你奖励。你得清出更多背包空间再来。

english: Ah, it seems there's something in the cargo hold of that boat. If the port wizard recovers the boat, any fish, salvage, crates or bounty parts will be lost.
translation: 啊，那艘船的货舱里好像有东西。如果港口魔法师把船捞回来，里面的鱼、打捞物、板条箱或悬赏部件都会丢失。

english: Ah, it'll be fine. It's not like I can burn your eyebrows off with this one.
translation: 啊，没事的。我又不会用这个把你的眉毛烧掉。

english: Ah, my loyal subject, yes, this is excellent.
translation: 啊，我忠诚的子民，没错，这太棒了。

english: Ah, ok. Back upstairs it is then.
translation: 啊，好吧。那就回楼上去吧。

english: Ah, our 4th birthday! Well I'm in a bit of a muddle, the kingdom relies on me, help me with this first.
translation: 啊，我们的四周年庆！不过我有点手忙脚乱，王国还指望着我呢，先帮我处理这个。

english: Ah, smart thinking. He was always a clever one.
translation: 啊，好主意。他一向很聪明。

translation: 啊，你终于来了，主银 [player name]。我好高兴你召唤了我。请拿好这盏灯，许个愿吧。

english: Ah, so you found a solution to your problem?
translation: 啊，所以你找到解决问题的办法了？

english: Ah, so you'd like me to build them a snowman?
translation: 啊，所以你想让我给他们堆个雪人？

english: Ah, some help. Every year around this time of year, we druids perform a ritual to protect nature from evil corrupting spirits.
translation: 啊，有人帮忙了。每年这个时候，我们德鲁伊都会举行一个仪式，保护自然免受邪恶腐化之灵的侵害。

english: Ah, the Dragon Slayer takes on a new challenge!
translation: 啊，屠龙者要迎接新的挑战了！

english: Ah, the Evolution of Cabbage. The great cruciferous march of life!
translation: 啊，卷心菜的进化。伟大的十字花科生命之旅！

english: Ah, the archetypal adventurer, always seeking quest rewards - no wonder Mizgog roped you into finding beads for him! Don't worry, we'll get there soon.
translation: 啊，典型的冒险者，总是追求任务奖励——难怪米兹戈会拉你去找珠子！别担心，我们很快就到了。

english: Ah, the archetypal adventurer, always seeking quest rewards! Don't worry, we'll get there soon.
translation: 啊，典型的冒险者，总是追求任务奖励！别担心，我们很快就到了。

english: Ah, the spookiest of seasons is upon us. My favourite!
translation: 啊，最吓人的季节来了。我的最爱！

english: Ah, this party looks wonderful! Would there be some nibbles available?
translation: 啊，这个派对看起来棒极了！有没有什么小吃？

english: Ah, this sounds like something I can do! I actually used to have a similar job on another island far to the east of here!
translation: 啊，这听起来是我能做的事！其实我以前在更东边的另一个岛上干过类似的活！

english: Ah, this will serve me well as a backup! My thanks to you [player name], I trust we will one day sing songs together of glorious battles in the Rellekka longhall!
translation: 啊，这可以当我的备用武器！多谢你了，[player name]。我相信总有一天我们会在雷勒卡城的长厅里一起高歌那些辉煌的战斗！

english: Ah, those skeletons look wonderful on the walls. The smell is good for the ambience too. The children are going to remember this for the rest of their lives!
translation: 啊，那些骷髅挂在墙上真好看。那股味道也增添了气氛。孩子们这辈子都会记住这个的！

english: Ah, we have a visitor!
translation: 啊，我们有客人来了！

english: Ah, well as you've heard, I do! I actually have too many coolers in here, it's getting a bit too cool for my liking. You can have one if you'd like.
translation: 啊，正如你听说的，我确实有！我这里冷却器太多了，对我来说有点太凉了。如果你想要，可以拿一个。

english: Ah, well if you're that way inclined, give me 100 coins and we have a deal.
translation: 啊，如果你真有这个意思，给我100金币，我们就成交。

english: Ah, well... now you ask, my mind is a bit blank. Let me think for a second.
translation: 啊，这个……你一问，我脑子有点空白。让我想想。

english: Ah, yer more than welcome te try. Though, ye'll be needin' some fishing supplies. I can give you some, if ye'd like.
translation: 啊，你尽管试试。不过，你需要一些钓鱼用品。如果你想要，我可以给你一些。

english: Ah, yes, Buoy and Gurl can be a bit like that. Both very set on what they want.
translation: 啊，没错，浮标和格尔有时候就是这样。两个人都很固执己见。

english: Ah, yes, that was it!
translation: 啊，对，就是这样！

english: Ah, yes, that was it. Well, I haven't had any experience myself with this.
translation: 啊，对，就是这样。不过，我自己对此没有任何经验。

english: Ah, yes. That's what I said too...?
translation: 啊，没错。我也是这么说的……？

english: Ah, you again. How can I help you?
translation: 啊，又是你。我能帮你什么？

english: Ah, you again. Perhaps I can interest you in my wares this time?
translation: 啊，又是你。也许这次我能让你对我的货物感兴趣？

english: Ah, you again. We need your help again, unfortunately. Could you get another riddle from Thordur for us?
translation: 啊，又是你。不幸的是，我们还需要你的帮助。你能再帮我们从索杜尔那里拿一个谜语吗？

english: Ah, you don't have any space to take it! I'll hold on to it for you.
translation: 啊，你没地方放了！我先帮你保管着。

english: Ah, you found me! I have a challenge for you.
translation: 啊，你找到我了！我有个挑战给你。

english: Ah, you speak of Nigel. Nigel is no friend of Evil Chicken; he is an imbecile and cheats at cards.
translation: 啊，你说的是奈杰尔。奈杰尔可不是邪恶鸡的朋友；他是个白痴，打牌还作弊。

english: Ah, you're taking part in the leprechaun's fishing contest then, are you? Yes, I have something that should help with that.
translation: 啊，那么你是要参加那个妖精的钓鱼大赛了，是吗？没错，我有个东西应该能帮上忙。

english: Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa! Perfect! Now Party Pete will never suspect me!
translation: 啊哈哈哈哈哈哈！完美！这下派对皮特永远不会怀疑我了！

english: Ah... too late. She's busy dancing already.
translation: 啊……太晚了。她已经在忙着跳舞了。

english: Aha! Found you at last.
translation: 啊哈！终于找到你了。

english: Aha! You find some trousers!
translation: 啊哈！你找到了一条裤子！

english: Aha, glad you asked! It has been my recent lifelong dream to make a name for myself with the White Knights of Falador. It was part of the reason I chose my name, you know?
translation: 啊哈，很高兴你问起！我最近的毕生梦想就是在法拉多城的白骑士团中扬名立万。这也是我选择这个名字的部分原因，你知道吗？

english: Aha, this time I got you.
translation: 啊哈，这次我可逮到你了。

english: Ahem... With great age comes great wisdom, but my memory isn't as good as it was. Can you remember the passphrase?
translation: 咳咳……年纪大了智慧也多了，但我的记性不如从前了。你还记得口令吗？

english: Ahem... secondly, find the toy room in the warrens below, you'll find yourself Milkee, my brother.
translation: 咳咳……其次，去下面迷宫里的玩具房，你会在那里找到我的兄弟米尔奇。

english: Ahh perfect.
translation: 啊，完美。

english: Ahh, you're a good egg... Happy Easter [player name]!
translation: 啊，你真是个好人……复活节快乐，[player name]！

english: Ahh, you've done a grand job on that sword. It's exactly what I need to help with that part of my painting.
translation: 啊，你这把剑做得太棒了。这正是我画作那部分所需要的。

english: Ahhh, a hard-nosed dealer who talks straight, that's what I like. For yer 'ard effort, I'll be willin' ta compensate ye. How's ye fancy a festive hat with a fancy nose décor, what I got on a recent raid to the north?
translation: 啊啊，一个说话直来直去的精明商人，我就喜欢这样。为了你的辛苦付出，我愿意补偿你。你觉得这顶带华丽鼻子装饰的节日帽子怎么样？是我最近去北方突袭时弄到的。

english: Ahhh, tea is so refreshing!
translation: 啊，茶真是提神醒脑！

english: Ahhh...... an interesting question. But who are you to say such a thing does not indeed already exist...? The puny of mind who attempt to scam their wealth instead of earning it in the glory of battle should be wary, for I know many council members walk the land anonymously, so that they might take vengeance without fear of reprisal or recognition...
translation: 啊……一个有趣的问题。但你凭什么说这种东西还不存在呢……？那些试图靠诈骗发财而不是在光荣战斗中赢取财富的愚昧之徒应该小心了，因为我知道许多议会成员都在匿名行走世间，这样他们就能在不惧报复或暴露身份的情况下复仇……

english: Ahhhhhhhh-*cough* I mean, almost got me!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊——*咳* 我是说，差点就抓到我了！

english: Ahoy, [player name], how are you doin'?
translation: 嘿，[player name]，你还好吗？

english: Ahoy, [player name]. Well done on finding me treasure chest.
translation: 嘿，[player name]。干得好，找到了我的宝箱。

english: Ahoy, [player name]. Well done on finding me treasure chest. Enjoy the rest o' the event!
translation: 嘿，[player name]。干得好，找到了我的宝箱。好好享受剩下的活动吧！

english: Aim for the beacons!
translation: 瞄准烽火台！

english: Air Runes from each Essence.
translation: 每个精华都能产出空气符文。

english: Ajjat at the Warriors' Guild? He has something special that is only available to true masters of the Attack skill!
translation: 战士公会的阿加特？他那里有只有真正的攻击技能大师才能获得的特殊物品！

english: Ak-Haranu gives you a translation manual in return for the signed oak longbow.
translation: 阿克.哈兰努给了你一本翻译手册，作为那把签名的橡木长弓的交换。

english: Ak-Haranu gives you another translation manual.
translation: 阿克.哈兰努又给了你一本翻译手册。

english: Akrisae and he told me there had been a possible sighting of the Dark Squall at the Black Knights' Fortress. He sent Silif to investigate, but lost contact with him. I should head to the Black Knights' Fortress myself to find both Silif and the Dark Squall.
translation: 阿克里赛告诉我，黑骑士要塞可能出现了黑风暴的踪迹。他派西利夫去调查，但后来失去了联系。我应该亲自前往黑骑士要塞，找到西利夫和黑风暴。

english: Akrisae and he told me there had been a possible sighting of the Dark Squall at the Black Knights' Fortress. He sent Silif to investigate, but lost contact with him. I travelled to the Black Knights' Fortress myself to investigate and found a Hidden Trapdoor. I should see where it leads.
translation: 阿克里赛告诉我，黑骑士要塞可能出现了黑风暴的踪迹。他派西利夫去调查，但后来失去了联系。我亲自前往黑骑士要塞调查，发现了一个隐藏的活板门。我应该看看它通向哪里。

english: Akrisae and he told me there had been a possible sighting of the Dark Squall at the Black Knights' Fortress. He sent Silif to investigate, but lost contact with him. I travelled to the Black Knights' Fortress myself to investigate and found a Strange Tile that might be of relevance.
translation: 阿克里赛告诉我，黑骑士要塞可能出现了黑风暴的踪迹。他派西利夫去调查，但后来失去了联系。我亲自前往黑骑士要塞调查，发现了一块可能有关的奇怪的瓷砖。

english: Akrisae and he told me there had been a possible sighting of the Dark Squall at the Black Knights' Fortress. He sent Silif to investigate, but lost contact with him. I travelled to the Black Knights' Fortress myself to investigate and found some Catacombs beneath the Fortress. I should explore them and see what I can find.
translation: 阿克里赛告诉我，黑骑士要塞可能出现了黑风暴的踪迹。他派西利夫去调查，但后来失去了联系。我亲自前往黑骑士要塞调查，在要塞下方发现了一些地下墓穴。我应该探索一下，看看能找到什么。

english: Akrisae and he told me there had been a possible sighting of the Dark Squall at the Black Knights' Fortress. He sent Silif to investigate, but lost contact with him. I travelled to the Black Knights' Fortress myself to investigate. I found Silif imprisoned in some Catacombs beneath the Fortress. I should find a way to free him.
translation: 阿克里赛告诉我，黑骑士要塞可能出现了黑风暴的踪迹。他派西利夫去调查，但后来失去了联系。我亲自前往黑骑士要塞调查。我在要塞下方的地下墓穴里发现西利夫被囚禁了。我应该想办法救他出来。

english: Akrisae gives you the teleorb.
translation: 阿克里赛给了你传送宝珠。

english: Akrisae, Movario was spotted entering a cavern full of Floating Lights in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. If I can find the Stone of Jas before he does, I might still be able to stop Lucien from getting it. I should disguise myself as the Dark Squall and meet with Movario to find out what he knows.
translation: 阿克里赛说，有人看到莫瓦里奥进入了仑桥镇沼泽洞穴中一个充满浮光的洞穴。如果我能在他之前找到贾斯之石，或许还能阻止卢西安得到它。我应该伪装成黑风暴，去见莫瓦里奥，套出他知道的情报。

english: Akthanakos set out from Senntisten on an unauthorised mission. Status unknown.
translation: 阿克塔纳科斯从森提斯坦出发执行一项未经授权的任务。状态未知。

english: Al Kharid mining pit cliffside scramble Agility shortcut.
translation: 阿尔卡里德城矿坑悬崖攀爬敏捷捷径。

english: Alas I seem to have dropped all my coal!
translation: 唉，我好像把所有的煤都弄丢了！

english: Alas friend, another day of hopelessness for me.
translation: 唉，朋友，对我来说又是绝望的一天。

english: Alba at Ortus Farm about a missing Meat Delivery.
translation: 关于一份丢失的肉类送货，去找奥图斯农场的阿尔芭。

english: Alba at Ortus Farm about a missing Meat Delivery. She told me the Delivery had been delayed due to an issue with some Wolves. However I was able to deal with this issue. I should see if she can send the Delivery to Emelio now.
translation: 关于一份丢失的肉类送货，去找奥图斯农场的阿尔芭。她告诉我送货因为一些狼的问题而延误了。不过我已经解决了这个问题。我应该看看她现在能否把货送给埃梅利奥。

english: Alba at Ortus Farm about a missing Meat Delivery. She told me the Delivery had been delayed due to an issue with some Wolves. She asked me to head to the Den west of the Farm and kill the Largest Wolf.
translation: 关于一份丢失的肉类送货，去找奥图斯农场的阿尔芭。她告诉我送货因为一些狼的问题而延误了。她让我去农场西边的兽穴，杀死最大的那只狼。

english: Alfonse winks at you.
translation: 阿尔方斯朝你眨了眨眼。

english: Ali Morrisane agreed to it and I've already got his pay. If he's fine with random adventurers potentially stealing the report, so be it.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑同意了，我已经拿到了他的报酬。如果他不在乎报告可能被路过的冒险者偷走，那我也无所谓。

english: Ali Morrisane gives you 500 coins.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑给了你500金币。

english: Ali Morrisane hands you a bottle of magical cleaning potion.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑递给你一瓶魔法清洁药水。

english: Ali Morrisane hands you some weird looking fishing bait.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑递给你一些看起来怪怪的鱼饵。

english: Ali Morrisane has sent me to find a contact for him, in return he will give me some information.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑派我去帮他找一个联系人，作为回报，他会给我一些情报。

english: Ali Morrisane turns away and starts checking over his market stall.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑转过身去，开始检查他的市场摊位。

english: Ali Morrisane. He runs a market stall at the north edge of Al Kharid.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑。他在阿尔卡里德城北边经营一个市场摊位。

english: Ali Morrisane. You can find him at his market stall on the north side of Al Kharid.
translation: 阿里.莫里桑。你可以在阿尔卡里德城北边的市场摊位找到他。

english: Ali The Operator hands you a Blackjack made out of oak.
translation: 操作员阿里递给你一把橡木做的短棍。

english: Ali hands you a bottle of special hot sauce.
translation: 阿里递给你一瓶特制辣酱。

english: Ali the Operator hands you a set of keys.
translation: 操作员阿里递给你一串钥匙。

english: Ali the Operator motions as if to give you a Blackjack but you decline, as you have no room in your inventory.
translation: 操作员阿里做出要给你一把短棍的动作，但你拒绝了，因为你的背包没有空间了。

english: Ali the barman gives you a beer.
translation: 酒保阿里给了你一杯啤酒。

english: Ali the discount camel seller gives you a receipt for the camels in return for 1,000 gold coins.
translation: 骆驼折扣商阿里给你一张骆驼收据，换取1000金币。

english: Align the power grid?
translation: 调整电网？

translation: 活着

english: Alive (See Notes)
translation: 活着（见备注）

translation: 全部搞定！船现在已经停靠在雷勒卡城了。不过，恐怕因为船翻了，港口魔法师无法从你的货舱里找回任何鱼、打捞物、板条箱或悬赏部件。
