translation: 全部搞定！船现在已经停靠在潘德莫尼姆岛了，不过有个坏消息，伙计。因为船翻了，港口魔法师无法从你的货舱里找回任何鱼、打捞物、板条箱或悬赏部件。

english: All done! The boat is now docked here at the Pandemonium, but there's bad news, mate. Because the boat was lost at sea, the port wizard won't have been able to recover any fish, salvage, crates or bounty parts
translation: 全部搞定！船现在已经停靠在潘德莫尼姆岛了，不过有个坏消息，伙计。因为船在海上失踪了，港口魔法师无法从你的货舱里找回任何鱼、打捞物、板条箱或悬赏部件。

english: All done! The boat is now docked here at the Pandemonium.
translation: 全部搞定！船现在已经停靠在潘德莫尼姆岛了。

english: All done! They'll get a priority treatment as soon as they come in, as long as we're opened.
translation: 全部搞定！只要我们还开着，他们一进来就会得到优先处理。

english: All done, mate. Your boat has been broken up into scrap.
translation: 全部搞定，伙计。你的船已经拆成废料了。

english: All for you. Every time you deliver it, you'll unlock a new colour of wrapping paper for it.
translation: 全都是给你的。每次你送出它，都会解锁一种新的包装纸颜色。

english: All four images are contained within separate spheres, much like the orb attached to the gate...
translation: 所有四幅图像都包含在独立的球体中，就像附着在门上的宝珠一样……

english: All good news then!
translation: 那都是好消息了！

english: All hail Zamorak!
translation: 扎莫拉克万岁！

english: All hail! I have thou hat of power oh magnificent one!
translation: 万岁！我拿到了您的力量之帽，伟大的存在！

english: All in a day's work! Helping (and a number of nice items) is its own reward.
translation: 日常工作而已！帮助别人（以及一些不错的物品）本身就是奖励。

english: All interested artisans should really consider taking up the hobby of portraiture. To do so, one uses a piece of papyrus on the intended subject to initiate a likeness drawing activity.
translation: 所有感兴趣的工匠都应该认真考虑从事肖像画这门手艺。要这么做，只需将一张莎草纸用在目标对象身上，即可开始肖像绘制活动。

english: All is well...
translation: 一切安好……

english: All of Gielinor deserve to celebrate Easter. I figured Varrock is a particularly busy place.
translation: 整个吉列诺都值得庆祝复活节。我觉得维洛克城是个特别热闹的地方。

english: All of a sudden, a final sense of deja-vu sweeps over you...
translation: 突然间，一股最终的既视感涌上你心头……

english: All of a sudden, the frosty critters unleash a flurry of attacks on Anti-Santa.
translation: 突然间，那些冰冷的生物对反圣诞老人发动了一连串攻击。

english: All of the above!
translation: 以上全部！

english: All over Falador City, and the Falador Castle, there are crumbling parts. A so-called "secret entrance for nonmembers into the members world" 'exists' in the west wall of the city where there is hope-raising option to "climb over crumbling wall" and results in saying "you cannot climb this wall from this side." The north entrance has a giant scaffold. Is this the doing of the Black Knights? Where on or off the world did these destruction signs come from?
translation: 法拉多城和法拉多城堡到处都有摇摇欲坠的墙壁。城市西墙有一个所谓的“非会员进入会员世界的秘密入口”，那里有一个让人充满希望的选项“爬过摇摇欲坠的墙壁”，结果却显示“你无法从这一侧爬上这堵墙。”北入口有一个巨大的脚手架。这是黑骑士的杰作吗？这些破坏的迹象到底是从哪里来的？

english: All previous Halloween rewards have been unlocked. You can claim any you don't have from the children or Diango.
translation: 所有之前的万圣节奖励都已解锁。你可以从孩子们或迪亚戈那里领取任何你没有的奖励。

english: All right, I'll see what I can do.
translation: 好吧，我看看我能做些什么。

english: All right. I'll head back to the Grand Tree to defend the king.
translation: 好吧。我这就回大树家园保卫国王。

english: All right. If you ever need a replacement I can sell you another. Remember, the better the condition of crystal equipment, the more potential it has.
translation: 好吧。如果你需要替换品，我可以再卖你一个。记住，水晶装备的状况越好，它的潜力就越大。

english: All that have passed the appropriate Earth Sciences exams.
translation: 所有通过相关地球科学考试的人。

english: All that's in the chest is a message...
translation: 箱子里只有一张字条……

english: All the spare pumpkins ended in this bin. How about you grab one of your choice and give it the most terrifying face you can think of? There's a table you can use to carve your pumpkin right there.
translation: 所有多余的南瓜最后都进了这个桶里。不如你挑一个，给它刻上你能想到的最恐怖的脸？那边有张桌子可以用来雕刻你的南瓜。

english: All the times you stubbed your toe flash before your eyes.
translation: 你所有踢到脚趾头的经历都在眼前闪过。

english: All this time I could've been eating chocolate instead of hiding it away.
translation: 原来我一直都可以吃巧克力，而不是把它藏起来。

english: All those who oppose us will perish...
translation: 所有反对我们的人都将灭亡……

english: All tortugans must make their own spear as part of their Trial by Water, but those spears are quite personal and many prefer not to risk damaging them.
translation: 所有龟人必须制作自己的矛作为水之试炼的一部分，但这些矛非常个人化，许多人宁愿不冒险损坏它们。

english: All you need to do is stand still for me... and be green.
translation: 你只需要为我站好……并且是绿色的。

english: Allow Zaff to create Bryophyta's staff for you?
translation: 允许扎夫为你制作布赖奥菲塔的法杖？

english: Allow auto-activation after a set period of inactivity?
translation: 允许在一段设定的不活动时间后自动激活？

english: Allow escape crystals to act as a ring of life when worn?
translation: 允许逃生水晶在佩戴时充当生命戒指？

english: Allow other players to activate your escape crystals?
translation: 允许其他玩家激活你的逃生水晶？

english: Ally
translation: 盟友

english: Almost there! Now these goblins want me to steal something for them. I have to go see if the general store has something interesting to steal.
translation: 快好了！现在这些哥布林想让我帮他们偷点东西。我得去看看杂货店里有没有什么有趣的东西可以偷。

english: Almost, but you can't go Trick-or-Treating without a spooky costume! At least three Halloween items should do the trick!
translation: 差不多了，但你不穿一套恐怖服装可没法玩‘不给糖就捣蛋’！至少三件万圣节物品应该就够了！

english: Alomone continues to recite the scroll. It is a language you have never heard and do not understand at all.
translation: 阿洛蒙继续诵读卷轴。这是一种你从未听过的语言，完全听不懂。

english: Alrena crushes the berries into a smooth paste. She then smears the paste over a strange mask.
translation: 阿尔蕾娜把浆果碾成光滑的糊状物。然后她把糊状物涂抹在一个奇怪的面具上。

english: Alrena gives you a Knight of Ardougne tabard.
translation: 阿尔蕾娜给了你一件阿多尼骑士短袍。

english: Alrena has given you a gas mask.
translation: 阿尔蕾娜给了你一个防毒面具。

english: Alright alright, don't lose your head! I'll get the rest of the priests to do it.
translation: 好了好了，别昏了头！我会让其他祭司去做的。

english: Alright but I'm watching you closely, any funny business and I'll turn you into an omelette.
translation: 好吧，但我会紧盯着你，要是敢耍花样，我就把你变成煎蛋卷。

english: Alright cheater, got an Easter egg for me?
translation: 好吧，作弊者，有复活节彩蛋给我吗？

english: Alright then, what's the question...
translation: 那好吧，问题是什么……

english: Alright you look like you need the help.
translation: 好吧，你看起来需要帮助。

english: Alright, I'll do it. Though, Camarst won't let me do magic in here after the last time...
translation: 好吧，我来做。不过，自从上次之后，卡马斯特就不让我在这里用魔法了……

english: Alright, I'll get to it then, thanks for the advice.
translation: 好吧，那我就去办，谢谢你的建议。

english: Alright, I'll go and speak with him.
translation: 好吧，我去和他谈谈。

english: Alright, I'll have a chat with him then.
translation: 好吧，那我去和他聊聊。

english: Alright, I'll help you.
translation: 好吧，我来帮你。

english: Alright, I'll lend him a hand.
translation: 好吧，我去帮他一把。

english: Alright, I'll look at it, then visit Urhney.
translation: 好吧，我去看看，然后拜访乌尔尼。

english: Alright, alright, do you at least have any idea on who I can talk to about a growth spell?
translation: 好了好了，你至少知道我可以找谁谈谈关于生长魔法的事吗？

english: Alright, calm down! Each to their own, I guess!
translation: 好了，冷静点！各有所好，我想！

english: Alright, calm down.
translation: 好了，冷静点。

english: Alright, got those eggs you wanted?
translation: 好吧，拿到你要的那些蛋了吗？

english: Alright, here goes.
translation: 好吧，开始了。

english: Alright, here, have some food. Now give me the map.
translation: 好吧，给你，吃点东西。现在把地图给我。

english: Alright, how can I help you?
translation: 好吧，我能帮你什么？

english: Alright, just don't put it off for too long!
translation: 好吧，别拖太久！

english: Alright, let's go back.
translation: 好吧，我们回去吧。

english: Alright, mate, let's call in the port wizard.
translation: 好吧，伙计，我们把港口魔法师叫来吧。

english: Alright, now you've sorted out the potion, we're going to need an egg to test on.
translation: 好了，现在你搞定了药水，我们需要一个鸡蛋来测试。

english: Alright, then, hmm... I'm out of ideas!
translation: 好吧，那么，嗯……我没主意了！

english: Alright, this is what I have so far.
translation: 好了，这是我目前找到的。

english: Alright, we can turn back.
translation: 好了，我们可以掉头了。

english: Alright, which flavours do you want?
translation: 好吧，你想要哪些口味？

english: Alright. Could you... look away for a moment? The coolers won't fit through the small hole, and I want to keep my identity a secret, even from you.
translation: 好吧。你能不能……暂时别看过来？冷却器塞不进那个小洞，而且我想对自己的身份保密，连你也不能知道。

english: Alright. I'll be back once I've explored this fort.
translation: 好的。等我探索完这座堡垒就回来。

english: Alright. In that case, here is a replacement report. Look after it better this time. Deliver it to Ali Morrisane!
translation: 好吧。既然如此，这里有一份替换的报告。这次保管好一点。把它交给阿里.莫里桑！

english: Alright. So what can I do for you?
translation: 好吧。那么，我能为你做点什么？

english: Alry equips the player with the Cormorant's glove.
translation: 阿尔里为玩家装备上鸬鹚手套。

english: Also someone should have delivered the shipment to him earlier today.
translation: 另外，今天早些时候应该有人把货物送给他了。

english: Also, as an armourer with his own smithy, I imagine you'll have something to represent Smithing too.
translation: 另外，作为一个拥有自己铁匠铺的盔甲匠，我想你也会有代表锻造的东西吧。

english: Also, don't forget to mention Special spices and bring me some carrots would ya please!
translation: 还有，别忘了提一下特制香料，再给我带点胡萝卜，拜托了！

english: Also, if you ever forgot what you need, there will be a worker nearby who can remind you.
translation: 另外，如果你忘了需要什么，附近会有工人提醒你。

english: Also, you say balance is between good and evil. If you think about it though, balance is actually good, and unbalance is bad. In that case, you are good, which would totally make all your philosophies meaningless? What do you have to say about this?
translation: 还有，你说平衡存在于善恶之间。但仔细想想，平衡其实是好的，不平衡是坏的。这样的话，你就是好的，那岂不是让你所有的哲学都变得毫无意义了？对此你有什么要说的？

english: Although I am not in a position to do that right now.
translation: 虽然我现在不方便这么做。

english: Although often used as fishing bait, the objects actually dropped by zombies are maggots. To ask who started that, I would have to answer that it was the flies that feast upon carrion and bear their eggs there.
translation: 虽然常被用作鱼饵，但僵尸实际上掉落的是蛆虫。要问是谁搞混了这个，我得说，是那些以腐肉为食并在那里产卵的苍蝇。

english: Although the High Priest's secret powers protect him from harm, some artefacts have been discovered that could bypass his protection. The lieutenants are gathering the artefacts to destroy them.
translation: 虽然大祭司的秘密力量保护他不受伤害，但已经发现了一些可以绕过他保护的神器。副官们正在收集这些神器以摧毁它们。

english: Although the dagger does not look particularly strong, it instils you with a sense of dread.
translation: 虽然这把匕首看起来并不特别结实，但它让你感到一阵恐惧。

english: Although you can't hear anything, your crystals have been chanted.
translation: 虽然你什么也听不见，但你的水晶已经被吟唱过了。

english: Although you have performed a mission on behalf of the White Knights, you were never actually working for them.
translation: 虽然你代表白骑士执行了一项任务，但你实际上从未为他们工作过。

english: Although you still might be able to help, would you be interested in completing some deliveries for me while I head to Varrock?
translation: 虽然你也许还能帮上忙，但在我前往维洛克城期间，你有兴趣替我完成一些送货任务吗？

english: Although you've now discovered the fate of the Old Ones, you feel that there could be more to find. Perhaps you should continue exploring and see if you can fully translate the stone tablets.
translation: 虽然你已经发现了古人的命运，但你感觉还有更多东西可寻。也许你应该继续探索，看看能否完全翻译那些石板。

english: Although, I'm getting very annoyed with Graardor over there who just keeps eating everything he can find.
translation: 不过，那边的格拉多尔让我很恼火，他一直在吃他能找到的任何东西。

english: Although... one second.
translation: 不过……等一下。

english: Always good to see you brother [player name].
translation: 见到你总是很高兴，[player name]兄弟。

english: Always good to see you sister [player name].
translation: 见到你总是很高兴，[player name]姐妹。

english: Always handle with care; strike the rock cleanly on its cleaving point.
translation: 务必小心处理；对准岩石的劈裂点干净利落地敲击。

english: Always happy to help.
translation: 随时乐意帮忙。

english: Always watched. To the garden. Thank you. Much appreciated!
translation: 一直看着呢。去花园吧。谢谢。非常感谢！

english: Always! But I'm not looking for any assistance from passing adventurers, if that's what you were thinking. Maybe another time.
translation: 当然！但我不需要路过的冒险者帮忙，如果你是在想这个的话。也许下次吧。

english: Am I a creature of magic or a creature of logic?
translation: 我是魔法生物还是逻辑生物？

english: Am I... going to die here?
translation: 我……会死在这里吗？

english: Am i annoying you?
translation: 我烦到你了吗？

english: Amascut and her family have so far taken no part in the war.
translation: 阿玛斯库特和她的家人至今未参与战争。

english: Amazing news!
translation: 好消息！

english: Amazing! Archibald, my beloved. Didn't I tell you not to go running off like that?
translation: 太棒了！阿奇博尔德，我亲爱的。我不是告诉过你别那样乱跑吗？

english: Amazing! Great job. Now we just need to follow the secret recipe to create the magical cleaning potion, and then use it to clean the armour.
translation: 太棒了！干得好。现在我们只需要按照秘密食谱制作魔法清洁药水，然后用它来清洁盔甲。

english: Amazing, keep it up!
translation: 太棒了，继续加油！

english: Amazing, let me taste it!
translation: 太棒了，让我尝尝！

english: Amazing, let's do this. Merry Christmas [sir/madam]!
translation: 太棒了，我们开始吧。[sir/madam]圣诞快乐！

english: Amazing, that's a great start. May I have them?
translation: 太棒了，这是个很好的开始。能给我吗？

english: Among other things, the table is covered in books and notes. One note looks to have been written fairly recently. You decide to give it a read...
translation: 除此之外，桌子上堆满了书籍和笔记。有一张笔记看起来是最近才写的。你决定读一读……

english: Amongst the papers on Herman's desk is a book. You 'borrow' it.
translation: 在赫尔曼的桌子上的文件中，有一本书。你把它'借'走了。

english: Amongst the scattered books one in particular grabs your attention; there seems to be something poking out from between the pages.
translation: 在散落的书籍中，有一本特别吸引了你的注意；书页之间似乎有什么东西露了出来。

english: Amongst the scattered books you find a small metal feather.
translation: 在散落的书籍中，你找到了一根小小的金属羽毛。

english: Amoxliatl banishes you from Tapoyauik.
translation: 阿莫克斯利亚特尔将你逐出了塔波亚维克。

english: Amoxliatl off until she teleported me out of the Ruins. I should head for the Sunrise Palace in Civitas illa Fortis to let them know what happened.
translation: 阿莫克斯利亚特尔一直攻击，直到她把我传送出废墟。我应该前往福蒂斯城的日出宫，告诉他们发生了什么。

english: Amoxliatl teleports the player away.
translation: 阿莫克斯利亚特尔将玩家传送走了。

english: Amoxliatl, a large ice nagua, appears.
translation: 阿莫克斯利亚特尔，一只巨大的冰纳瓜，出现了。

english: Amphora.
translation: 双耳瓶。

english: Amur Leopard.
translation: 阿穆尔豹。

english: Amur leopards
translation: 阿穆尔豹

english: An Entranan Firebird feather, a Master Thieves' armband, and a cooked Lava Eel.
translation: 一根恩特拉纳火鸟羽毛、一个大师盗贼臂章和一条烤熔岩鳗。

english: An LFG ad? What's that?
translation: 一个寻找组队广告？那是什么？

english: An abyssal rift opens.
translation: 一道深渊裂隙打开了。

english: An amphora of wine, found half-full. Someone had been drinking from it.
translation: 一壶酒，发现时已半满。有人喝过。

english: An anagram, huh? I bet it's a location in Varrock. Probably an inn - that's where I would go.
translation: 一个变位词，嗯？我打赌是维洛克城里的某个地点。很可能是一家旅馆——那是我会去的地方。

english: An answer for everything. Typical human.
translation: 什么都有答案。典型的人类。

english: An answer.
translation: 一个答案。

english: An associate of mine has information for me. I need you to collect their report and bring it to me.
translation: 我的一个同伙有情报要给我。我需要你去收集他们的报告并带给我。

english: An egg mould is missing? Why would I know about that?
translation: 鸡蛋模具不见了？我怎么会知道那个？

english: An egg shaped treat? Marvellous!
translation: 蛋形点心？太棒了！

english: An elegant roll of fabric awarded to those who have achieved the marlin rank at the Gwenith Glide Barracuda trial. This would make a fine flag to showcase on a boat.
translation: 一卷优雅的织物，奖励给在格温尼斯滑翔梭鱼试炼中达到马林鱼等级的人。这可以做成一面漂亮的旗帜展示在船上。

english: An elemental claw.
translation: 一只元素之爪。

english: An elemental fire block is recessed into a hole above a fire symbol. There's a second empty recess above a water symbol.
translation: 一个元素火方块嵌在火符号上方的凹洞里。水符号上方还有第二个空的凹洞。

english: An elemental helm.
translation: 一顶元素头盔。

english: An elf? Well what are you doing in Lumbridge?
translation: 一个精灵？那你来仑桥镇做什么？

english: An enchanted Slayer staff requires level 75 Magic and level 55 Slayer to equip, and is untradeable. Reverting it will not give your spell parchment back.
translation: 附魔杀戮法杖需要75级魔法和55级杀戮才能装备，且不可交易。还原它不会归还你的法术羊皮纸。

english: An evening in a decorated church basement listening to Eric telling stories? That sounds like Eric's idea of a party alright.
translation: 在装饰过的教堂地下室里听埃里克讲故事度过一晚？听起来确实是埃里克心目中的派对。

english: An evil presence in the cave prevents your prayers from being heard.
translation: 洞穴中的邪恶存在阻挡了你的祈祷。

english: An excellent choice.
translation: 绝佳的选择。

english: An honourable mention! Thank you, my friend! You've made this old farmer's haunted dreams come true. I've never won anything in a Spook-a-thon contest before!
translation: 荣誉提名！谢谢你，我的朋友！你让这个老农夫的噩梦成真了。我以前从未在惊吓马拉松比赛中赢过任何东西！

english: An imp! Painted green? Well... I suppose it will have to do!
translation: 一个小恶魔！涂成绿色？嗯……我想也只能这样了！

english: An important part of Christmas - some would actually say it's the most important part - is gifts.
translation: 圣诞节的一个重要部分——有些人甚至会说这是最重要的部分——就是礼物。

english: An interface opens, giving players choices on which clan seal to teleport to.
translation: 一个界面打开，让玩家选择要传送到哪个公会印章。

english: An interface will be open during the period of this event when ever you're in the event area. Do you want to toggle this off?
translation: 在此活动期间，只要你身处活动区域，就会有一个界面保持打开。你想关闭它吗？

english: An intricate roll of fabric awarded to those who have achieved the marlin rank at the Tempor Tantrum Barracuda Trial. This would make a fine flag to showcase on a boat.
translation: 一卷精美的织物，奖励给在海灵狂怒梭鱼试炼中达到马林鱼等级的人。这可以做成一面漂亮的旗帜展示在船上。

english: An ogre approaches the telescope's view.
translation: 一个食人魔进入了望远镜的视野。

english: An ogre artefact appears in front of you. You quickly put it into your backpack.
translation: 一个食人魔神器出现在你面前。你迅速把它放进了背包。

english: An old book is forced into your hands.
translation: 一本旧书被塞到了你手里。

english: An old, rusty range. Exactly the type of thing that you would expect to find in the cabin in the woods.
translation: 一个老旧生锈的炉灶。正是你期望在森林小屋里找到的那种东西。

english: An omega egg!
translation: 一个欧米伽蛋！

english: An undead goblin high priest rises from the grave...
translation: 一名不死哥布林大祭司从坟墓中升起……

english: An undead lord of the Claws clan, who seeks to undermine the Christmas season. He has little to do in the rest of the year, so he tries to ruin other holidays too.
translation: 利爪氏族的不死领主，企图破坏圣诞季。他在一年中的其他时间无所事事，所以也试图毁掉其他节日。

english: An' that's not all Shanty's got for ye. Wrap yer hands around this pile o' festive booty...
translation: 而且香堤给你的还不止这些。来，把这堆节日战利品收好吧……

english: Ana gives you a wrought iron key...
translation: 安娜给了你一把熟铁钥匙……

english: Ancient Temple and found the Stone of Jas. However, upon finding it, I was attacked by some sort of Elemental Creature which I was forced to defeat. I then touched the Stone and was granted a Strange Vision. However, Movario arrived at the same time, shortly followed by Lucien. I need to make sure that he doesn't claim the Stone.
translation: 远古神庙并找到了贾斯之石。然而，在找到它时，我遭到了某种元素生物的攻击，被迫将其击败。然后我触摸了石头，获得了一个奇异幻象。但莫瓦里奥同时到达，卢西安紧随其后。我必须确保他无法得到石头。

english: Ancient Temple and found the Stone of Jas. However, upon finding it, I was attacked by some sort of Elemental Creature which I was forced to defeat. I then touched the Stone and was granted a Strange Vision. However, Movario arrived at the same time, shortly followed by Lucien. Lucien teleported away with the Stone and summoned some Demons. I'll need to defeat them.
translation: 远古神庙并找到了贾斯之石。然而，在找到它时，我遭到了某种元素生物的攻击，被迫将其击败。然后我触摸了石头，获得了一个奇异幻象。但莫瓦里奥同时到达，卢西安紧随其后。卢西安带着石头传送走了，并召唤了一些恶魔。我需要击败它们。

english: Ancient Temple and found the Stone of Jas. However, upon finding it, I was attacked by some sort of Elemental Creature which I was forced to defeat. I then touched the Stone and was granted a Strange Vision. However, Movario arrived at the same time. I need to make sure that neither he nor Lucien is able to claim the Stone.
translation: 远古神庙并找到了贾斯之石。然而，在找到它时，我遭到了某种元素生物的攻击，被迫将其击败。然后我触摸了石头，获得了一个奇异幻象。但莫瓦里奥同时到达。我必须确保他和卢西安都无法得到石头。

english: Ancient Temple and found the Stone of Jas. However, upon finding it, I was attacked by some sort of Elemental Creature which I was forced to defeat. It should now be safe for me to inspect the Stone.
translation: 远古神庙并找到了贾斯之石。然而，在找到它时，我遭到了某种元素生物的攻击，被迫将其击败。现在我应该可以安全地检查石头了。

english: Ancient Temple and found the Stone of Jas. However, upon finding it, I was attacked by some sort of Elemental Creature. I'll need to defeat it.
translation: 远古神庙并找到了贾斯之石。然而，在找到它时，我遭到了某种元素生物的攻击。我需要击败它。

english: Ancient Wyvern shield (with 66 Smithing)!
translation: 古代飞龙盾（需要66级锻造）！

english: Ancient witch Eve, camp west of Lumbridge Swamp... Got it! Thank you, Wizard Mizgog.
translation: 古代女巫夏娃，营地就在仑桥镇沼泽西边……明白了！谢谢你，魔法师米兹戈格。

english: And I suppose your servant was killed by some huge man-eating spider!
translation: 我猜你的仆从是被某只巨大的食人蜘蛛杀死的吧！

english: And I think Ali Morrisane is the best person to ask about something to clean the vat with.
translation: 而且我觉得阿里.莫里桑是询问用什么来清洁大桶的最佳人选。

english: And I'm going to guess that you're asking me to do just that?
translation: 我猜你是想让我去做这件事吧？

english: And I'm saying that off my own back and am in no way being forced into saying so....Really!
translation: 而且这是我自愿说的，绝不是被迫这么说的……真的！

english: And I'm still alive. I rock!
translation: 我还活着。我真牛！

english: And bite upon my bait.
translation: 然后咬住我的饵。

english: And did you get hurt?
translation: 那你受伤了吗？

english: And did you have to freeze my eyebrows off?!
translation: 而且你非得把我的眉毛都冻掉吗？！

english: And disrespect fine dwarven cuisine? I would never!
translation: 不尊重精美的矮人料理？我绝不会！

english: And drop to your feet into a narrow underground corridor.
translation: 然后掉进一条狭窄的地下走廊。

english: And ever since I saw you
translation: 自从我见到你之后

english: And he gave you some of Sir Vyvin's wine, which you brought here to me, I remember.
translation: 然后他给了你一些维文爵士的酒，你带到了我这里，我记得。

english: And he's definitely breathing, although very weakly.
translation: 而且他确实还在呼吸，尽管非常微弱。

english: And he's gone!
translation: 他走了！

english: And here's a pamphlet about the joining process. For unproven recruits, you'll be a knight's squire like me for five years before becoming an initiate.
translation: 这里有一本关于加入流程的小册子。对于未经考验的新兵，你会像我一样先当五年的骑士侍从，然后才能成为见习骑士。

english: And how is he now that he has defeated Jonas once again?
translation: 他再次击败乔纳斯之后，现在怎么样了？

english: And how's that been going for you? Any visits from strange creatures in the night?
translation: 那件事进展如何？晚上有没有奇怪的生物来访？

english: And if I help you win, then I sort of win too anyway. It's a win win!
translation: 如果我帮你赢了，那我也算是赢了。这是双赢！

english: And in return, you'll tell me what you know?
translation: 作为回报，你会告诉我你知道的事情？

english: And it wasn't stealing as such; it was all for the children, you know?
translation: 而且那也不算是偷窃；都是为了孩子们，你懂吧？

english: And it's not just any birthday, it's the 9th birthday o' Gielinor!
translation: 而且这可不是普通的生日，这是吉莱诺的九岁生日！

english: And lastly, we had a request from Trollweiss to allow them to sample some of our cuisine. A troll by the name of My Arm can be found outside the Duel Arena.
translation: 最后，巨魔花那边还提出请求，想尝尝我们的料理。一个叫"我的手臂"的巨魔就在决斗竞技场外面。

english: And now I'll have to take it back myself.
translation: 现在我得自己把它拿回去了。

english: And now someone is after you for stealing the wood?
translation: 所以现在有人因为你偷了木头在追你？

english: And now to reveal the truth of my foe...
translation: 现在就来揭穿我敌人的真面目……

english: And now we've got strict orders to make sure all the eggs get back to the Easter Bunny.
translation: 现在我们接到严格命令，要确保所有彩蛋都送回复活节兔子那里。

english: And of course, as part of the winning team, you should be rewarded!
translation: 当然，作为获胜队伍的一员，你应该得到奖励！

english: And offers you a completed cake tin!
translation: 然后递给你一个做好的蛋糕模具！

english: And sometimes really generous grown-ups come by and give lots of treats!
translation: 有时候，特别慷慨的大人会过来送好多糖果！

english: And that explains the tinderbox.
translation: 这就解释了火绒盒的用途。

english: And that is probably everything of use in the junk pile.
translation: 垃圾堆里大概也就这些有用的东西了。

english: And that one man was Jarvis?
translation: 那个人就是贾维斯？

english: And that poor adventurer, they died!
translation: 那个可怜的冒险者，他们死了！

english: And that worked?
translation: 那招管用了？

english: And that's not all; we've got a huge, evil tree growing out of the floor now!
translation: 这还没完；现在地板上还长出了一棵巨大的邪恶树！

english: And the Lumbridge cake?
translation: 那仑桥镇的蛋糕呢？

english: And the egg mould wasn't there after?
translation: 之后鸡蛋模具就不在那里了？

english: And the gems were on the swords?
translation: 宝石是在剑上？

english: And the ghosts!
translation: 还有那些幽灵！

english: And the researchers?
translation: 那研究人员呢？

english: And then I hit on it. I ordered a batch of chocolate rabbits from Diango. But these weren't ordinary chocolate rabbits, these were enchanted so they would deliver themselves.
translation: 然后我灵机一动。我从迪亚戈那里订了一批巧克力兔子。但这些可不是普通的巧克力兔子，它们被施了魔法，可以自己送货上门。

english: And then I will go and help the goblins and become an adventurer!
translation: 然后我就去帮助那些哥布林，成为一名冒险者！

english: And then disaster struck! I counted my eggs backwards, forwards, upside-down and up, but alas... One is missing.
translation: 然后灾难就降临了！我把彩蛋正着数、倒着数、翻过来数、竖着数，但唉……还是少了一个。

english: And then we can have warm cabbage soup.
translation: 然后我们就能喝上热乎乎的卷心菜汤了。

english: And there is some strong washing line that could tie everything together...
translation: 那里有根结实的晾衣绳，可以把所有东西捆在一起……

english: And they think I killed them! I just want to get out of here and cook some shrimp.
translation: 他们以为是我杀了他们！我只想离开这里，煮点虾吃。

english: And very level-headed outlook on life.
translation: 还有非常冷静的人生观。

english: And wait...
translation: 等等……

english: And wake up exactly where you were, wondering what happened.
translation: 然后在你原来的地方醒来，纳闷发生了什么事。

english: And wake up exactly where you were.
translation: 然后在你原来的地方醒来。

english: And wake up somewhere strange, with an extremely dry mouth.
translation: 然后在一个陌生的地方醒来，口干舌燥。

english: And wake up somewhere strange.
translation: 然后在一个陌生的地方醒来。

english: And wake up somewhere strangely familiar.
translation: 然后在一个莫名熟悉的地方醒来。

english: And we add the holly because it's spiky, to scare the stain away.
translation: 我们加上冬青是因为它带刺，可以吓跑污渍。

english: And we're both here at this lovely festival!
translation: 我们俩都来到了这个美好的节日！

english: And what about your belongings?
translation: 那你的东西怎么办？

english: And what are you?
translation: 那你是什么？

english: And what does my outfit say?
translation: 我的装扮说明了什么？

english: And what is it you want to grow exactly?
translation: 你到底想种什么？

english: And what is that shining?
translation: 那闪闪发光的是什么？

english: And what's in it for me?
translation: 我有什么好处？

english: And whatever you do, don't forget to check upstairs and downstairs while you are there. Once a ghost has been busted it will be gone for good, so you'll need to keep looking around for them.
translation: 无论你做什么，去那里的时候别忘了检查楼上楼下。一旦幽灵被赶走，就再也不会回来了，所以你得不停地四处寻找它们。

english: And why didn't you tell me your daughter's been missing for years?
translation: 那你为什么不告诉我你女儿失踪好几年了？

english: And yet I come back for more...
translation: 但我还是回来找罪受……

english: And you could probably put one of the wheels from this roller over the top and spin it to do the mixing...
translation: 你可以把这个滚轮上的一个轮子放在上面，然后转动它来搅拌……

english: And you know what a knight needs? A cape!
translation: 你知道骑士需要什么吗？一件披风！

english: And you look pretty scary!
translation: 你看起来挺吓人的！

english: And you need me because...
translation: 你需要我是因为……

english: And you teach them to write, too?
translation: 你还教他们写字？

english: And you wanted me to help him with the portal?
translation: 你想让我帮他处理传送门的事？

english: And you'd best put on at least three pieces of Halloween-themed clothing and hold the spooky pumpkin lantern. We need to show we've got the Halloween spirit before his final judgement!
translation: 你最好至少穿上三件万圣节主题的服装，并拿着幽灵南瓜灯笼。在他做出最终裁决之前，我们得展示出万圣节精神！

english: And you're a tiny *caw* human.
translation: 而你是个小小的*呱*人类。

english: And you're not making any pernicious plans?
translation: 你没有在策划什么恶毒的计划吧？

english: And, as you guessed, I keep a pickaxe in the hope that one day we will be able to mine our own essence.
translation: 而且，正如你猜到的，我随身带着一把镐子，希望有一天我们能自己开采符文精华。

english: Angler outfit.
translation: 钓鱼者套装。

english: Angry! It makes me angry!
translation: 生气！这让我很生气！

english: Animal Skull and thinks he may have dropped it around the digsite. I need to find it and return it to him, maybe someone has picked it up?
translation: 动物头骨，他觉得可能掉在考古挖掘场附近了。我得找到它并还给他，也许有人捡到了？

english: Animal Wrangler.
translation: 动物驯服者。

english: Animation to use for death.
translation: 死亡动画。

english: Anita gives you a key.
translation: 安妮塔给了你一把钥匙。

english: Anita hands you a translation of the notes.
translation: 安妮塔递给你一份笔记的翻译。

english: Anita takes a moment to translate the notes.
translation: 安妮塔花了一点时间翻译笔记。

english: Annakarl fell early in the war to forces of Saradomin. Attempts to reclaim the fortress have so far been unsuccessful.
translation: 安娜卡尔在战争初期就落入了萨拉多明势力之手。夺回这座堡垒的尝试至今未果。

english: Annihilate that [man/woman]!
translation: 消灭那个[man/woman]！

english: Annihilation Home Teleport. This can be toggled by right-clicking on the Home Teleport in your spellbook.
translation: 湮灭之家传送。你可以在法术书中右键点击“回家传送”来切换此功能。

english: Annihilation home teleport.
translation: 湮灭之家传送。

english: Annihilation is a temporary event. All progress made will be transferred to Permanent Deadman Mode upon its conclusion.
translation: 歼灭战是暂时性活动。所有进度将在活动结束后转移至永久死亡模式。

english: Annihilation ornament theme for your weapons and armour.
translation: 你的武器和盔甲的湮灭装饰主题。

english: Annihilation weapon ornaments.
translation: 歼灭战武器装饰。

english: Annihilation worlds until their conclusion on the 21st of February, at which point your progress will be converted for use in Permanent Deadman.
translation: 歼灭战世界将持续至2月21日结束，届时你的进度将转换至永久死亡模式中使用。

english: Annihilation, you will need to forfeit ALL progress associated with it in Permanent Deadman.
translation: 歼灭战中，你将需要放弃在永久死亡模式中与之相关的所有进度。

english: Annihilation. Would you like to read the scroll?
translation: 湮灭。你想读一下卷轴吗？

english: Anniversary!
translation: 周年纪念！

english: Another cutscene begins with Grubfoot still wearing the orange armour.
translation: 另一段过场动画开始，格拉布福特仍穿着橙色盔甲。

english: Another flashback about Argento, the silver-coloured spirit tree, begins.
translation: 另一段关于银色灵魂树阿根托的回忆开始了。

english: Another recruit looking to enlist in D.U.N.G?
translation: 又一个想加入地下城联盟的新兵？

english: Another wish
translation: 又一个愿望

english: Answer
translation: 答案

english: Answer 4 is redacted.
translation: 答案4已被编辑。

english: Answer me three questions to prove you goblin. You ready?
translation: 回答我三个问题，证明你是哥布林。准备好了吗？

english: Anti-Santa is very perceptive. If he becomes suspicious about your presence, he may realize I am trying to evict him and take offence, then there's no getting rid of him.
translation: 反圣诞老人非常敏锐。如果他对你的出现起疑，他可能会意识到我想赶他走，然后生气，那样就再也甩不掉他了。

english: Anti-Santa seems to be enjoying himself. You should probably not mess with him.
translation: 反圣诞老人似乎玩得很开心。你最好别去惹他。

english: Anti-Santa shows you a strange box.
translation: 反圣诞老人给你看了一个奇怪的箱子。

english: Anti-Santa takes the vial and absorbs a sorrowful essence from the liquid within.
translation: 反圣诞老人接过小瓶，吸收了里面液体中的悲伤精华。

english: Anti-Santa wanted my house to be colder, so he extinguished the boiler. Now there are icicles on the ceiling! Go to the basement and re-light the boiler, so that my guests will be comfortable.
translation: 反圣诞老人想让我的房子更冷，所以他熄灭了锅炉。现在天花板上都结冰柱了！去地下室重新点燃锅炉，这样我的客人们才能舒服些。

english: Anti-Santa will be keen to escape the humid atmosphere you have created, but the lazy slob needs an incentive to go outside.
translation: 反圣诞老人会很想逃离你制造的潮湿环境，但这个懒鬼需要点动力才会出门。

english: Anti-Santa's coal box fills itself with useless lumps of coal.
translation: 反圣诞老人的煤箱里装满了没用的煤块。

english: Anti-Santa? A few months ago, I helped the Easter Bunny defeat a chocolate demon that claimed it had been summoned by Anti-Santa to ruin Easter. He really hates the holidays.
translation: 反圣诞老人？几个月前，我帮复活节兔子打败了一个巧克力恶魔，那恶魔声称是反圣诞老人召唤它来破坏复活节的。他真的很讨厌节日。

english: Anti-Santa? I met him last Christmas. He hired me to collect useless coal dust from him to distribute as junk gifts. He really hates the holidays.
translation: 反圣诞老人？去年圣诞节我见过他。他雇我收集他那里没用的煤灰，当作垃圾礼物分发。他真的很讨厌节日。

english: Anti-firebreath potion.
translation: 抗龙火药水。

english: Any chance you have another Giant Bronze Dagger?
translation: 你还有没有另一把巨型青铜匕首？

english: Any damage to the preform will lower its quality, tracked via the quality bar. If there's no quality left in the preform it becomes unworkable, and must be throw away.
translation: 对未完成的部件造成的任何损伤都会降低其品质，品质条会显示进度。如果未完成的部件品质归零，就无法再加工，必须扔掉。

english: Any luck finding that mould yet?
translation: 找到那个模具了吗？

english: Any luck finding the goblin that stole my hat yet?
translation: 找到偷我帽子的哥布林了吗？

english: Any luck with Bob?
translation: 鲍勃那边有进展吗？

english: Any more quickity questions?
translation: 还有更多快问快答吗？

english: Any other day I'd ask if you've been on the Karamjan rum, but today has been an odd day for hats.
translation: 换作平时我会问你是不是喝了卡拉姆詹朗姆酒，但今天对帽子来说真是奇怪的一天。

english: Any plans for Valentine's Day, cook?
translation: 情人节有什么计划吗，厨师？

english: Any spares from previous birthdays are on the tables over there. Once you've checked them out, let me know which ones you want to withdraw!
translation: 以前生日剩下的都在那边的桌子上。你看过之后，告诉我你想拿走哪些！

english: Any thoughts on the first unfinished line?
translation: 对第一行未完成的诗句有什么想法吗？

english: Any update on the candle?
translation: 蜡烛有消息了吗？

english: Any way i can become your race?
translation: 有没有办法让我变成你的种族？

english: Anyhow, I don't think I can impose on your time anymore. I've had lots of fun thanks to you and I will have lots of stories to tell when I have dinner with dad after Christmas!
translation: 总之，我不能再占用你的时间了。多亏了你，我玩得很开心，圣诞节后和爸爸吃饭时，我会有好多故事可以讲！

english: Anything else you need for Halloween, partner?
translation: 万圣节还需要别的吗，伙伴？

english: Anything left on the ground will be lost.
translation: 留在地上的任何东西都会消失。

english: Anything of note, or was he as happy for you as I am?
translation: 有什么值得注意的吗？还是他和我一样为你高兴？

english: Anyway, Anti-santa, behold! Time for [player name] to come crashing and crushing!
translation: 总之，反圣诞老人，看好了！是时候让[player name]来大闹一场了！

english: Anyway, I know a good place we can do it. Follow me!
translation: 总之，我知道有个好地方可以动手。跟我来！

english: Anyway, I need a beard. I've done some research and all the best Sirs have one. I had a poster of Sir Tiffy Cashien in my room growing up and he's my inspiration.
translation: 总之，我需要胡子。我研究过了，所有最棒的爵士都有胡子。我小时候房间里贴着一张蒂菲.卡申爵士的海报，他就是我的灵感来源。

english: Anyway, I think that you're a bit off the mark. The book is all about easter!
translation: 总之，我觉得你有点搞错了。这本书讲的全是复活节！

english: Anyway, are you okay to talk about Jonas now?
translation: 总之，你现在可以谈谈乔纳斯了吗？

english: Anyway, could you possibly help me distribute the eggs? I've got a reward in mind for you.
translation: 总之，你能帮我分发这些蛋吗？我已经想好要给你什么奖励了。

english: Anyway, did you want to buy anything?
translation: 总之，你想买点什么吗？

english: Anyway, early readings are looking good. He placed the device right next to the Altar, just as requested. That said, I likely won't have long to acquire and store the energy needed. The device will no doubt interfere with the ascended humans of Arceuus. They will soon realise something is amiss.
translation: 总之，初步读数看起来不错。他按要求把装置放在了祭坛旁边。不过，我可能没有太多时间来获取和储存所需的能量。这个装置无疑会干扰阿西乌斯城的飞升者。他们很快就会察觉到不对劲。

english: Anyway, here are your seeds. You can have them, gratis. I don't charge for a good cause!
translation: 总之，这是你的种子。免费送你了。为了好事我不收费！

english: Anyway, shall we begin?
translation: 总之，我们可以开始了吗？

english: Anyway, so, one of my fellow tradesmen deep in the desert, sells chocolate to the locals there in the form of a choc-ice.
translation: 总之，我有个在沙漠深处的同行，他把巧克力做成巧克力冰棍卖给当地人。

english: Anyway, thank you for taking the time to listen to my silly story. Have some well-deserved treats. They're not all mints, I promise.
translation: 总之，谢谢你花时间听我讲这个傻故事。这些是你应得的点心。我保证不全是薄荷糖。

english: Anyway, this blaster might be just what we need. If we load it with different ammunition, it should work on chocolate instead of ghosts.
translation: 总之，这个爆破器可能正是我们需要的。如果我们装上不同的弹药，它应该能对付巧克力而不是幽灵。

english: Anyway, you were asking about Pixies. We're happy, cheerful and hardworking. We're also extremely cheap to employ. Should you wish to hire us please contact the Fairy Godfather with a bag of gold and all paperwork
translation: 总之，你刚才问到了小精灵。我们快乐、开朗又勤劳。而且雇佣我们非常便宜。如果你想雇用我们，请带着一袋金币和所有文件联系仙子教父。

english: Anyways, as I was saying before, I was sent here by Death. We need your help?
translation: 总之，就像我之前说的，我是死神派来的。我们需要你的帮助？

english: Anyways, guess I'll go grow an egg.
translation: 总之，我想我还是去种个蛋吧。

english: Anyways, yes, he can borrow my cauldron if he thinks it'll make his Halloween treat better. It can't hurt.
translation: 总之，是的，如果他认为这能让他的万圣节点心更好吃，他可以借用我的大锅。反正也没坏处。

english: Anyways, yes, you can have the key. I swear, the secluded life of a hermit is more exciting than a day with Eric, so try not to go mad with boredom.
translation: 总之，是的，你可以拿走钥匙。我发誓，隐士的隐居生活都比和埃里克待一天有趣，所以尽量别无聊到发疯。

english: Apart from the way he disappears so slowly. I understand why he normally hides for that part.
translation: 除了他消失得那么慢的方式。我明白他为什么通常在那部分躲起来了。

english: Ape Atoll? What are those banana-brained nitwits doing over here? Well...well... I guess I may just be able to help you after all, [sir/madam].
translation: 猿猴岛？那些香蕉脑子的蠢货跑到这儿来干什么？好吧……好吧……我想我或许还是能帮上你的忙，[sir/madam]。

translation: 阿里斯说我命中注定要杀死那个恶魔。

english: Aris suggested they paint the wheat different shades of the rainbow, but the cook in Lumbridge said that would ruin the flavour of his baking.
translation: 阿里斯建议他们把小麦染成彩虹的各种颜色，但仑桥镇的厨师说那样会破坏他烘焙的风味。

english: Arise, Sir Kit Breaker, for I knight you Sir Protector of the Glade.
translation: 起来，基特.布雷克爵士，我封你为林地守护骑士。

english: Armadyl area in the God Wars Dungeon.
translation: 神战地牢中的阿玛杜尔区域。

english: Armadyl commands his forces from the Empyrean Citadel.
translation: 阿玛杜尔从苍穹堡垒指挥他的军队。

english: Armageddon Home Teleport. This can be toggled by right-clicking on the Home Teleport in your spellbook.
translation: 末日降临之家传送。你可以在法术书中右键点击回家传送来切换。

english: Armageddon cape ornaments.
translation: 末日披风装饰。

english: Armageddon home teleport animation. However you have already unlocked this animation.
translation: 末日降临之家传送动画。不过你已经解锁了这个动画。

english: Armageddon home teleport.
translation: 末日降临之家传送。

english: Armageddon ornament theme for your capes.
translation: 你的披风的末日降临装饰主题。

english: Armageddon ornament theme for your weapons.
translation: 你的武器的末日降临装饰主题。

english: Armageddon. Would you like to read the scroll?
translation: 末日降临。你想读一下卷轴吗？

english: Around this kitchen you'll find an assortment of flavours. I've not bothered learning their names, just the colours.
translation: 在这厨房周围，你会找到各种风味。我懒得记它们的名字，只记颜色。

english: Arr, that's the spirit! Choose yerself a boat, and away ye' goes.
translation: 啊，这才像话！给自己挑艘船，出发吧。

english: Arr, they call me Captain Emmemji. I've sailed the ocean blue since I was a slip o' a lad, commanding every kind of vessel under the sun.
translation: 啊，他们都叫我埃姆杰米船长。我从小就在蔚蓝的大海上航行，指挥过世上各种船只。

english: Arr, welcome to my sailing flotilla. Are ye wantin' to go for a sail?
translation: 啊，欢迎来到我的船队。想出海航行吗？

english: Arrav's Heart, I'll first need to find a way of keeping it preserved. Following Elias' suggestion, I entered the Mastaba in the Uzer Oasis and found some information on how to do this. I'll need to obtain a Canopic Jar and fill it with three Dwellberries and a Ring of Life.
translation: 阿拉夫之心，我首先得找到保存它的方法。按照伊莱亚斯的建议，我进入了乌泽绿洲的马斯塔巴墓，找到了一些关于如何做到这一点的信息。我需要得到一个卡诺皮克罐，并在里面装满三颗德维尔莓和一枚生命戒指。

english: Arrav's Heart, I'll first need to find a way of keeping it preserved. Following Elias' suggestion, I entered the Mastaba in the Uzer Oasis. I should search the Mastaba for the information we need.
translation: 阿拉夫之心，我首先得找到保存它的方法。按照伊莱亚斯的建议，我进入了乌泽绿洲的马斯塔巴墓。我应该搜索马斯塔巴墓，寻找我们需要的信息。

english: Arrghhh! My eyes!
translation: 啊！！！我的眼睛！

english: Artic Pine pyre ships.
translation: 北极松火葬船。

english: Artima has repaired the sails for you.
translation: 阿蒂玛已经为你修好了船帆。

english: As Alomone finishes reading from the scroll you hear a shrill scream emanate from Hazeel's coffin.
translation: 当阿洛蒙读完卷轴时，你听到从哈泽尔的棺材里传来一声刺耳的尖叫。

english: As Damien dies, you use his blood to scent your disguise.
translation: 达米安死的时候，你用他的血来给你的伪装增添气味。

english: As I said, I had assistance. And on that note, adventurer, I do need to thank you.
translation: 正如我所说，我得到了帮助。说到这个，冒险者，我确实需要感谢你。

english: As I understand it, you have been asleep for many millenia, and the gods Saradomin and Zamorak have usurped the world you once presided over. Saradominists have told me tales of how there are only three gods: Saradomin, You, and Zamorak. In my travels however I have learned that there are many more RuneScape gods than just the three. There has been talk of Zaros, and Armadyl, both of which supposedly share the opposite relationship as Saradomin and Zamorak do. Do you feel that this could mean trouble for you if more of these gods came to power, and left you as the only powerless god? Apparently, Zaros is more evil than Zamorak, or so many have said, but as he is a lesser known god, there is little harm I can see... Yet.
translation: 据我所知，你已经沉睡了数千年，而萨拉多明和扎莫拉克神已经篡夺了你曾经统治的世界。萨拉多明信徒告诉我，世上只有三位神：萨拉多明、你，以及扎莫拉克。然而在我的旅途中，我了解到符文世界的神远不止这三位。有传闻提到扎罗斯和阿玛杜尔，据说他们之间的关系与萨拉多明和扎莫拉克相反。你觉得如果这些神掌权，而让你成为唯一无力的神，这对你来说会不会是个麻烦？显然，扎罗斯比扎莫拉克更邪恶，至少很多人这么说，但由于他是个较不为人知的神，我目前还看不出有什么危害……

english: As Santa's delegate, I have granted you an Anti-Santa costume. Wear it and scare the pixies. With the Santa suit you got me, I will then persuade them that I have saved them.
translation: 作为圣诞老人的代表，我授予你一套反圣诞老人服装。穿上它去吓唬那些小精灵。有了你给我的圣诞老人套装，我就能说服他们是我救了他们。

english: As a cook, you must have prepared a lot of nourishing meals. I need a memento of the Cooking process, and one for the Hitpoints restored by the food.
translation: 作为一名厨师，你一定准备过很多营养餐。我需要一个烹饪过程的纪念品，以及一个由食物恢复的生命值的纪念品。

english: As a famously experienced builder, perhaps you could help me, please. I need a memento of Construction, something to invoke the memories of training the skill. Perhaps a saw.
translation: 作为一位著名的经验丰富的建筑工人，也许你能帮帮我。我需要一个建筑的纪念品，能唤起训练这项技能的记忆。也许是一把锯子。

english: As a holy man, you will surely be an expert on training the Prayer skill. Can you offer me a memento of your training, please?
translation: 作为一名圣洁之人，你肯定是训练祈祷技能的专家。你能给我一个你训练的纪念品吗？

english: As a human grows, they are taught to put childish thoughts aside. Yet the childish thoughts of a Gnome Child can far outstrip the shallow reckonings of humankind. Consider...
translation: 随着人类的成长，他们被教导要摒弃幼稚的想法。然而，一个地精小孩的幼稚想法，却远胜于人类肤浅的认知。想想看……

english: As a matter of fact [player name], I do have a quest for you. Are you interested?
translation: 事实上，[player name]，我确实有个任务要交给你。你有兴趣吗？

english: As a reward he now lets me use his high quality range which lets me burn things less whenever I wish to cook there.
translation: 作为奖励，他现在让我使用他的高品质炉灶，这样我以后在那里烹饪时，烧焦东西的几率就降低了。

english: As a reward, not only may you keep your disguise, but also, this giant candy cane, and a few other things.
translation: 作为奖励，你不仅可以保留你的伪装，还可以得到这根巨大的拐杖糖，以及一些其他东西。

english: As a way to challenge ourselves, when we were a bit younger, we would knit the most horrifying Halloween costumes, then wear them and scare passers-by out of their wits!
translation: 为了挑战自己，我们年轻一点的时候，会编织最恐怖的万圣节服装，然后穿上它们，把路人吓得魂飞魄散！

english: As an added bonus, you get to bring a plus one with you to the pub!
translation: 作为额外奖励，你可以带一个人一起去酒吧！

english: As before, a piece of paper slides out between the crates wooden slats. You take it.
translation: 和之前一样，一张纸从板条箱的木条之间滑了出来。你拿起了它。

english: As for the remaining seeds, maybe you could visit another trader. I know there was one by a bank, but I can't remember where that bank was.
translation: 至于剩下的种子，也许你可以去找另一个商人。我知道银行旁边有一个，但我记不清那家银行在哪了。

english: As if to threaten me, their King, with petty tricks if I do not hand over treats!
translation: 好像要用这些小把戏来威胁我，他们的国王，如果我不交出糖果！

english: As it happens the principle is much the same as the backpack we made.
translation: 碰巧的是，原理和我们做的背包差不多。

english: As last task to proive you really are one of us, you need to go in Lumbridge and steal from human. Collect precious item for us.
translation: 作为最后一项任务来证明你真的是我们中的一员，你需要去仑桥镇偷人类的东西。为我们收集珍贵的物品。

english: As long as it keeps the crows away, most things should do!
translation: 只要能赶走乌鸦，大多数东西应该都行！

english: As long as you're sure! I usually dig some snow from the snow piles that form around the city, and then roll that snow into snowballs.
translation: 只要你确定就好！我通常从城里堆积的雪堆里挖些雪，然后把雪滚成雪球。

english: As much as I love your costume, I'd like to see some other people's as well!
translation: 虽然我很喜欢你的服装，但我也想看看其他人的！

english: As much as I love your costume, why not show it to some other people as well?
translation: 虽然我很喜欢你的服装，但为什么不也给别人看看呢？

english: As nice as that looks, I think I'll give it a miss for now.
translation: 虽然看起来不错，但我想我还是先不看了。

english: As nice as this queue is, I am missing out on my daily steps.
translation: 虽然排队挺好的，但我每天的步数都落下了。

english: As promised, I have your Quality Violet Tulip seed. Just come back once you have room for it.
translation: 如约，我有你的优质紫郁金香种子。等你有空位了再来拿吧。

english: As promised, here's your Quality Violet Tulip seed.
translation: 如约，这是你的优质紫郁金香种子。

english: As promised, your reward; my new invention!
translation: 如约，你的奖励：我的新发明！

english: As soon as I've figured out how to make it change the colour of the pumpkin...
translation: 等我想出怎么用它来改变南瓜的颜色……

english: As soon as you get on the cart, it starts to move. Before too long you are past the gates. You jump off the cart taking Ana with you.
translation: 你一上推车，它就开始移动。没过多久，你就穿过了大门。你带着安娜跳下了推车。

english: As the cultist dies, Attala arrives in the chamber...
translation: 邪教徒死去时，阿塔拉来到了密室……

english: As the fish lured by the fly.
translation: 就像鱼被苍蝇引诱一样。

english: As the furnace cools down, you dig through the coal and find a fully formed chromium ingot.
translation: 熔炉冷却下来时，你在煤堆里翻找，发现了一块完全成型的铬锭。

english: As the medallion and tablet are held together, a surge of power connects the two. After a brief moment, the tablet crumbles, and the medallion feels somehow different.
translation: 当徽章和石板握在一起时，一股能量涌流将两者连接起来。片刻之后，石板碎裂，徽章感觉有些不同了。

english: As the old woman drinks the cup of milky tea, enlightenment glows from within her eyes.
translation: 老妇人喝下那杯奶茶时，她的眼中闪烁着顿悟的光芒。

english: As the warlord falls to the ground, a ghostly vapour floats upwards from his battle-worn armour. Out of sight you hear a shrill scream in the still air. You spot the orbs of protection among his remains.
translation: 军阀倒地时，一股幽灵般的蒸汽从他饱经战火的盔甲上升起。在视线之外，你听到寂静的空气中传来一声刺耳的尖叫。你在他的遗骸中发现了防护宝珠。

english: As the wheel of time slowly turns onwards, you may find such a thing occurs, but it will not be soon and it will not be often...
translation: 随著时间之轮缓缓转动，你可能会发现这样的事情发生，但不会很快，也不会很频繁……

english: As we revere in the number six, let us recall that there are six elements to a tragedy. My favourite of these is Thought; I am pleased to stand on this dance floor indulging in it.
translation: 当我们尊崇数字六时，让我们回想一下，悲剧有六个要素。其中我最喜欢的是思想；我很高兴能站在这舞池中沉浸其中。

english: As you approach the altar you hear a strange voice.
translation: 当你走近祭坛时，你听到一个奇怪的声音。

english: As you approach the gate the guard dog starts barking loudly at you. There is no way an intruder could have committed the murder. It must have been someone the dog knew to get past it quietly.
translation: 当你走近大门时，看门狗开始对你大声吠叫。入侵者不可能犯下谋杀案。一定是狗认识的人才能悄无声息地通过。

english: As you can see, ahead of you is a course of a rather vicious design. I use it to keep my servants on their toes. Test it please.
translation: 如你所见，你面前是一条设计相当险恶的跑道。我用它来让我的仆人们保持警觉。请测试一下。

english: As you cast the enchantment on the rod, it seems to vibrate and glow.
translation: 当你对钓竿施放附魔时，它似乎开始振动并发光。

english: As you clear away the last of the rubble, you notice a dusty looking wall plaque which you hadn't spotted before.
translation: 当你清理掉最后一块瓦砾时，你注意到一块布满灰尘的墙壁牌匾，你之前没发现它。

english: As you climb the stairs you hear a click...
translation: 当你爬上楼梯时，你听到一声咔哒……

english: As you close the scroll it starts to disintegrate in your hands.
translation: 当你合上卷轴时，它开始在你手中分解。

english: As you commune with the holy star, you feel the light of Saradomin preparing to fill your mind and enlighten your vision. If you submit, it will help you see through the darkness of Zamorak's evil.
translation: 当你与圣星交流时，你感到萨拉多明的光芒准备充满你的心灵，启迪你的视野。如果你顺从，它将帮助你看穿萨莫拉克邪恶的黑暗。

english: As you cook the herring on the stove, the colouring on it peels off separately as a red sticky goop...
translation: 当你在炉灶上烹饪鲱鱼时，上面的颜色像红色粘稠物一样单独剥落……

english: As you crawl out into the sunlight, the strange fungus you are carrying crumbles to dust.
translation: 当你爬出洞口，重见阳光时，你携带的奇怪蘑菇碎成了粉末。

english: As you cross the stepping stones, Persten rows out to join you.
translation: 当你跨过踏脚石时，佩尔斯滕划船过来与你汇合。

english: As you dance the clue you lost magically appears at your feet. You have no space to pick it up though, and it fades away into the ground again.
translation: 当你跳舞时，你丢失的线索神奇地出现在你脚下。但你却没有空间捡起它，它又消失在地面中。

english: As you dance, the lost clue magically appears at your feet. You pick it up.
translation: 当你跳舞时，丢失的线索神奇地出现在你脚下。你捡起了它。

english: As you dance, the second clue magically appears at your feet. You pick it up.
translation: 当你跳舞时，第二条线索神奇地出现在你脚下。你捡起了它。

english: As you deposit noted buckets of compost into your bottomless compost bucket, you mysteriously receive noted empty buckets back.
translation: 当你将票据形式的堆肥桶存入你的无底堆肥桶时，你神秘地收到了票据形式的空桶。

english: As you drop the crystal, it hits a rock and explodes. You are lascerated by shards of glass.
translation: 当你丢下水晶时，它撞到一块岩石并爆炸了。你被玻璃碎片割伤。

english: As you drop the item, it bounces into a stream, never to be seen again.
translation: 当你丢下物品时，它弹进了一条溪流，再也找不到了。

english: As you drop the item, it falls down a narrow crevice, never to be seen again.
translation: 当你丢下物品时，它掉进了一条狭窄的裂缝，再也找不到了。

english: As you drop the item, it gets carried away by the wind, never to be seen again.
translation: 当你丢下物品时，它被风吹走了，再也找不到了。

english: As you fail to guess the combination one more time, you hear the lock reset.
translation: 当你再次猜错组合时，你听到锁重置的声音。

english: As you finish reading the book, you notice the last page has a very peculiar picture drawn on it.
translation: 你读完这本书时，注意到最后一页画着一幅非常奇特的图画。

english: As you finish reading, you spot a note on the floor. However, you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 你读完时，发现地上有一张纸条。但你的背包空间不够，拿不了。

english: As you finish reading, you spot a note stuck to the back of the tablet.
translation: 你读完时，发现石板背面贴着一张纸条。

english: As you flick through the log, you notice you are owed some training from Chartin' Charles McAtless on the Pandemonium.
translation: 你翻阅日志时，注意到查廷.查尔斯.麦卡特利斯还欠你一些在潘德莫尼姆岛上的训练。

english: As you focus the light on the vial and betty pours the potion in, the lens heats up and shatters. After a few seconds betty hand you the vial of Truth Serum.
translation: 当你把光线聚焦在小瓶上，贝蒂把药水倒进去时，镜片过热碎裂。几秒钟后，贝蒂把装有吐真剂的小瓶递给你。

english: As you go to make the jump, another sense of deja-vu sweeps over you...
translation: 你正要跳过去，又一股似曾相识的感觉涌上心头……

english: As you go to move, a dwarf appears...
translation: 当你准备移动时，一个矮人出现了……

english: As you insert the metallic feather into the final indentation you hear a low grinding as if stone blocks were moving against one another.
translation: 你把金属羽毛插入最后一个凹槽时，听到一阵低沉的摩擦声，仿佛石块在相互移动。

english: As you inspect the bottle, a voice echoes out of it...
translation: 你检查瓶子时，一个声音从里面回荡出来……

english: As you inspect the inscription on the tomb, you notice that the plaque it is on is loose. You remove the plaque, revealing a second inscription.
translation: 你检查墓碑上的铭文时，发现那块牌匾松动了。你取下牌匾，露出了第二段铭文。

english: As you inspect the key you almost cut yourself on its sharp edges. Whoever created it clearly didn't intend for it to be used easily.
translation: 你检查钥匙时，差点被它锋利的边缘割伤。制造它的人显然没打算让它被轻易使用。

english: As you inspect the key, a tingling sensation shoots up your arm. You feel charged and ready to explore for the lock it opens.
translation: 你检查钥匙时，一股刺痛感窜上手臂。你感到充满能量，准备去寻找它对应的锁。

english: As you inspect the key, an acrid aroma fills the air. Hopefully it won't take too long to find what it opens.
translation: 你检查钥匙时，空气中弥漫着一股刺鼻的气味。希望找到它打开的东西不会花太久。

english: As you inspect the monument, a crab suddenly scuttles up to you and presses a mysterious piece of a medallion into your hands! Before it departs, it moves its pincers in an unusual way, almost as if it's dancing!
translation: 你检查纪念碑时，一只蟹突然爬到你面前，把一块神秘的勋章碎片塞进你手里！它离开前，以一种不寻常的方式挥动钳子，简直像是在跳舞！

english: As you jot down the final information on Arceuus, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于阿西乌斯城的最后信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you jot down the final information on Hosidius, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于霍西迪乌斯城的最后信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you jot down the final information on Lovakengj, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于洛瓦肯吉城的最后信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you jot down the final information on Port Piscarilius, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于皮斯卡里琉斯港的最后信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you jot down the final information on Shayzien, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于谢兹恩城的最后信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you jot down the final information on the Arceuus house, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于阿西乌斯家族的最终信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you jot down the final information on the Hosidius house, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于霍西迪乌斯家族的最终信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you jot down the final information on the Lovakengj house, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'

english: As you jot down the final information on the Piscarilius house, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'

english: As you jot down the final information on the Shayzien house, you hear a mysterious whisper in your ear. 'Return to Veos...'
translation: 你记下关于谢兹恩家族的最终信息时，耳边传来神秘的低语：‘回到维奥斯身边……’

english: As you make the killing strike, the machinery within the room falls silent.
translation: 你发出致命一击时，房间里的机械安静了下来。

english: As you may be aware, travelling on foot over sand is not ideal; sand is coarse, rough, and it gets everywhere.
translation: 你可能也知道，在沙地上步行并不理想；沙子又粗又糙，还会到处乱钻。

english: As you move the lever you hear a low grinding elsewhere in the caves.
translation: 当你移动拉杆时，你听到洞穴别处传来低沉的研磨声。

english: As you open the book something falls out from between the pages. It appears to be a small metal feather.
translation: 你打开书时，有东西从书页间掉了出来。看起来是一根小小的金属羽毛。

english: As you pull the book a hidden latch springs into place, and the bookcase swings open, revealing a secret compartment.
translation: 你拉动书本时，一个隐藏的插销弹开，书架随之打开，露出一个秘密隔间。

english: As you pull the lever, the ticking stops and you hear a loud click.
translation: 你拉动拉杆时，滴答声停止了，你听到一声响亮的咔嗒声。

english: As you pull the lever, you hear a loud click from the door.
translation: 你拉动拉杆时，听到门那边传来一声响亮的咔嗒声。

english: As you pull the lever, you hear a strange click coming from the north east.
translation: 你拉动拉杆时，听到东北方向传来一声奇怪的咔嗒声。

english: As you pull the lever, you hear a strange ticking sound.
translation: 你拉动拉杆时，听到一阵奇怪的滴答声。

english: As you put your foot on the bottom of the ladder, you hear it creak loudly... It nearly breaks! This ladder can't support your weight!
translation: 你把脚踩在梯子底部时，听到它嘎吱作响……差点断了！这梯子撑不住你的重量！

english: As you reach for Archibald, he tumbles away. You pick up the note he left behind.
translation: 你伸手去抓阿奇博尔德时，他跌跌撞撞地逃开了。你捡起他留下的纸条。

english: As you reach for the lever, you notice the word 'reset' engraved into the handle in large angular letters.
translation: 你伸手去拉拉杆时，注意到手柄上刻着‘重置’两个大字，棱角分明。

english: As you reach to open the door a great terror overcomes you!
translation: 你伸手去开门时，一股巨大的恐惧笼罩了你！

english: As you seemed to have fun with the beacons earlier, I'm going to add beacons at random and you can keep collecting them if you like.
translation: 既然你之前玩烽火玩得挺开心，那我就随机加一些烽火，你要是喜欢就继续收集吧。

english: As you slide the final piece into place you begin to hear a low rumbling sound...
translation: 你把最后一块拼图滑入到位时，开始听到一阵低沉的隆隆声……

english: As you talk to Gordon, part of the clay falls off.
translation: 你和戈登说话时，一部分粘土掉了下来。

english: As you touch the door, your hand tingles and room seems to grow dim. You can hear Surok muttering a spell behind you...
translation: 当你触碰门时，你的手一阵刺痛，房间似乎变得昏暗。你可以听到苏罗克在你身后低声念咒……

english: As you touch the key, you take an imprint of it using your soft clay.
translation: 你触碰钥匙时，用软粘土印下了它的形状。

english: As you touch the pyramid door, a sense of deja-vu sweeps over you...
translation: 你触碰金字塔门时，一股似曾相识的感觉涌上心头……

english: As you turn away, you feel a pang of guilt. Shouldn't you help this poor fellow?
translation: 你转身离开时，感到一阵内疚。难道不该帮帮这个可怜的家伙吗？

english: As you wind the old clock a letter falls out. Judging by the thick covering of dust it must have been here for some time.
translation: 你给旧钟上发条时，一封信掉了出来。从厚厚的灰尘来看，它在这里已经有一段时间了。

english: As you wish, [player name]. What kind of armour were you thinking of exactly?
translation: 如你所愿，[player name]。你具体想要什么样的盔甲？

english: As you're quite new to Gielinor, you need to play for [x] more hours to be able to claim the tradeable rewards for this event.
translation: 由于你刚来吉莱诺不久，还需要再玩[x]小时才能领取本次活动的可交易奖励。

english: As you're quite new to Gielinor, you're not yet able to claim tradeable rewards. You need to play for 24 more hours to be able to claim them.
translation: 由于你刚来吉莱诺不久，目前还无法领取可交易奖励。你需要再玩24小时才能领取。

translation: 由于你之前已完成血腥剧场，你可以选择跳过这一部分。

translation: 你赤手触碰大门时，感到一阵电击。

english: Assassins dealt with, Thaerisk asked me to investigate a treasure hunter called Movario who he believed had worked with Lucien. He suggested I start my search at the Fight Arena as Movario hired a bodyguard from there called Darve.
translation: 处理完刺客后，赛里斯克让我去调查一个叫莫瓦里奥的宝藏猎人，他相信此人曾与卢西安合作过。他建议我从战斗竞技场开始调查，因为莫瓦里奥从那里雇了一个叫达尔夫的保镖。

english: Assemble part A, which is the main part of Baba Yaga's house.
translation: 组装A部分，这是芭芭雅嘎房屋的主体。

english: Assemble the feet by constructing both Es and attaching an F to each side (these are the toes on the house's chicken legs).

english: Assemble the steps, part C. These attach just below the door to Baba Yaga's house.
translation: 组装台阶，C部分。这些连接在芭芭雅嘎房屋门的正下方。

translation: 每份纯符文精华可获得的星界符文

english: Asyff is a tailor with a shop near the south-east of the city. He does a lot of Crafting with materials from the Hunter skill, so I expect he can help us.
translation: 阿西夫是个裁缝，店铺在城市的东南部附近。他经常用猎人技能获得的材料进行制作，所以我想他能帮上忙。

english: At Patzi's request, I entered the Wine Cellar to find some Principum Red. I found some, but ended up spilling it due to a Loud Crashing Sound coming from elsewhere in the Cellar. I investigated and found a Man lying on the floor. Before I could do anything else, I was arrested by two guards.
translation: 应帕齐的要求，我进入酒窖寻找一些普林西普姆红葡萄酒。我找到了一些，但被酒窖别处传来的巨大撞击声吓得洒了。我去查看，发现一个男人躺在地上。还没来得及做任何事，就被两个守卫逮捕了。

english: At first taste Evil Chicken tastes like chicken. Wait two weeks, fleshy non-beaked mortal, then let Evil Chicken know how your insides feel.
translation: 初次品尝时，邪恶鸡吃起来像鸡肉。等两周，无喙的肉体凡人，再告诉邪恶鸡你的内脏感觉如何。

english: At great cost to your personal magical energies, you have crafted the wyvern visage and elemental shield into an ancient wyvern shield.
translation: 你耗费了大量个人魔法能量，将飞龙面罩和元素盾制作成了古代飞龙盾。

english: At least we'll never see the likes of him again!
translation: 至少我们再也见不到他这种人了！

english: At least you know for next time.
translation: 至少下次你就知道了。

english: At least you're looking where you're going, the last brute trampled right over me. Now I think about it, he was much bigger than you, spookier too!
translation: 至少你还看着路走，上一个莽汉直接从我身上踩了过去。现在想想，他比你大多了，也更吓人！

english: At least, excited compared to how he normally is. Excitement isn't Eric's thing.
translation: 至少，跟他平时比起来算是兴奋了。兴奋可不是埃里克的风格。

english: At long last! With the words contained within this scroll, our lord shall finally return to us!
translation: 终于！有了这卷轴上的话语，我们的主人终于要回到我们身边了！

english: At the bottom of the cart you find a missing page of Rolad's book!
translation: 在推车底部，你找到了罗拉德书里缺失的一页！

english: At the bottom of the cart you find a missing page of Rolad's book! Unfortunately, you can't carry it and are forced to drop it on the ground.
translation: 在推车底部，你找到了罗拉德书里缺失的一页！可惜你拿不了，只好把它丢在地上。

english: At the moment he's a big floating metal skull, but I've also seen him as a small multicoloured butterfly and as a large rock type thingy. He's a weird one...
translation: 目前他是一个漂浮的大金属头骨，但我也见过他变成小型的彩色蝴蝶和一个大岩石之类的东西。他是个怪咖……

english: Attach a rope to the top of the hole?
translation: 在洞口顶部系上绳子？

english: Attach the feet to the smaller end of the legs, then attach the broader end to the two spotted squares underneath the house.
translation: 将脚部连接到腿的较细端，然后将较宽端连接到房屋下方两个有斑点的方形上。

english: Attach the jaw to the helmet?
translation: 把下颚装到头盔上？

english: Attach the roof to the house. Admire your handiwork.
translation: 将屋顶连接到房屋上。欣赏你的杰作。

english: Attacker, Defender, Collector or Healer. I will explain these roles shortly.
translation: 攻击者、防御者、收藏家或治疗者。我马上会解释这些角色。

english: Attala about what happened with the Old One Keystone and she told me that Teumo was able to escape from Cam Torum. As a result, the Twilight Emissaries now have all that they need to access the Crypt of Tonali. I should head to Tal Teklan in the Tlati Rainforest and report this to Queen Zyanyi.
translation: 我问了阿塔拉关于古老者基石的事，她告诉我特乌莫成功逃出了卡姆托鲁姆。结果，暮光使者现在拥有了进入托纳利墓穴所需的一切。我应该前往特拉提雨林的塔尔泰克兰，向齐扬伊女王报告此事。

english: Attala and Servius depart for Teumo's home.
translation: 阿塔拉和塞维乌斯出发前往特乌莫的家。

translation: 阿塔拉和塞维乌斯出发了。

translation: 吸引萨满的注意。

translation: 阿特扎给了你一些修剪毛皮。

translation: 奥伯里将玩家传送至符文精华矿

translation: 先知梅茨利走上舞台。

translation: 奥雷尔把加德兰克的战锤给了你。

translation: 艾娃给了你一个定位宝珠。

translation: 艾娃把做好的定位宝珠给了你。

english: Ava quickly scribbles some complicated looking schematics onto some paper for you, and then thrusts them into your hands.
translation: 艾娃飞快地在纸上给你画了一些看起来很复杂的示意图，然后塞到你手里。

english: Ava takes the quiver and fiddles around with it for a bit...
translation: 艾娃拿起箭袋，摆弄了一会儿……

translation: 阿凡递给你一些金匠手套。

english: Aven the flower trader sadly didn't have any of the others left in stock, so we'll have to go to the second trader you mentioned earlier for the rest.
translation: 卖花的商人阿文很遗憾地没有其他品种的存货了，所以我们得去找你之前提到的第二个商人买剩下的。

english: Aven turns away and starts looking for more flower seeds.
translation: 阿文转过身去，开始寻找更多的花种。

english: Avernic
translation: 阿维尼克

english: Away with you.
translation: 滚开。

translation: 阿沃盖已经告诉我战舰的事了。

translation: 唉，但我跑腿跑得正开心呢。

translation: 哇，好可爱！我真不想吵醒它。

english: Aww, that's why I like talking to you. You're always so nice.
translation: 唉，这就是我喜欢跟你说话的原因。你总是这么友善。

translation: 艾-亚斯特。伊-斯特。你这是在崇拜一个以蛋为基础的节日！

english: Aye! If you accept the challenge that is.
translation: 没错！如果你接受挑战的话。

english: Aye, [lad/lass], volcano is what I be meanin'. The south foot o' the same. They's be 'avin' a cavern there, but arm yerself wi' the chilly snowball ammo afore ye goes venturin' inside.
translation: 是啊，[lad/lass]，我说的就是火山。就在那南边山脚下。他们在那儿有个洞穴，但进去探险之前，得先备好冰冷的雪球弹药。

english: Aye, can't let it pile up, or we'd be all be goin' mad.
translation: 是啊，可不能让它堆起来，不然我们都会疯掉的。

translation: 没错，就是那儿。就在那边的绿洲里。

english: Aye, maybe. Go 'n see Chancellor Hassan in the palace. 'Tis the huge building in the south of Al Kharid. Ye can't miss it.
translation: 嗯，也许吧。去宫殿找哈桑大臣吧。就是阿尔卡里德城南部那栋巨大的建筑，你不会错过的。

english: Aye, that does make less sense in a desert. Well, just good luck then!
translation: 是啊，在沙漠里这么说确实不太对劲。好吧，那就祝你好运了！

english: Aye, that it is [player name]! Skulgrimen fashioned it for me from the carcass of one of the monsters on Waterbirth Island after our last hunt!
translation: 没错，正是如此，[player name]！那是斯库尔格里门在上次狩猎后，用水诞岛上的一只怪物的尸体为我打造的！

english: Aye, that it is brother [player name]. Should you desire one of your own, you should go to Skulgrimen's shop and see what they have available!
translation: 没错，正是如此，[player name]兄弟。如果你也想要一件，你应该去斯库尔格里门的店里看看他们有什么货！

english: Aye, that it is sister [player name]. Should you desire one of your own, you should go to Skulgrimen's shop and see what they have available!
translation: 没错，正是如此，[player name]姐妹。如果你也想要一件，你应该去斯库尔格里门的店里看看他们有什么货！

english: Aye, that's right.
translation: 没错，就是这样。

english: Aye, that's what I said, aye. And to give it ye, you'll need to be on a members' server. If yer interested just start filling these 'ere cages with gublinch and, when they's filled, come see me for yer rewards.
translation: 是啊，我就是这么说的，没错。要把它给你，你得在会员服务器上才行。如果你有兴趣，就开始把这些笼子装满戈布林奇吧，装满了就来找我领奖励。

english: Aye, that's what I said, aye. And to give it ye, you'll need to be on a members' server. If yer interested, just start filling these 'ere cages and, when ten are filled, come to me for yer rewards.
translation: 是啊，我就是这么说的，没错。要把它给你，你得在会员服务器上才行。如果你有兴趣，就开始把这些笼子装满吧，装满十个就来找我领奖励。

english: Aye, that's what ol' Shanty says. Let it fill yer heart wi' festive cheer.
translation: 是啊，老尚蒂就是这么说的。让它用节日的欢乐填满你的心吧。

english: Aye, those lads are always causing trouble around here.

translation: 但还有一个人知道乔纳斯的事。他叫贾维斯.汤普森。我一直保留着他的记忆，就怕这一天会到来。他当初就是杀死乔纳斯的人，也是可能帮上忙的人。

translation: 但我们从没见过你。

translation: 多姆！你确定要继续往下走吗？

translation: 别跟我提'上次'！杰里米的眉毛还没长回来呢！

english: Don't ask me I just work here...
translation: 别问我，我只是在这儿打工的……

english: Don't bank your equipment
translation: 不要存你的装备

english: Don't be a fool, I have no use for that.
translation: 别傻了，那东西对我没用。

english: Don't be afraid!
translation: 别害怕！

english: Don't be greedy now, there needs to be enough treats for everyone!
translation: 别贪心，得留够给每个人的份！

english: Don't be silly! You'd get burnt!
translation: 别傻了！你会被烫伤的！

english: Don't be silly. I'd never hurt my dear niece and nephew. Children love a spooky thrill at Halloween, and this will be the best one ever!
translation: 别傻了。我绝不会伤害我亲爱的侄女和侄子。孩子们就喜欢万圣节那种毛骨悚然的刺激，这将会是最棒的一次！

english: Don't blame yourself, it's not your fault.
translation: 别自责了，这不是你的错。

english: Don't concern yourself. I had instructed the gargoyles to take it from you.
translation: 不必担心。是我命令石像鬼从你那儿把它拿走的。

english: Don't drink it all at once!
translation: 别一口气全喝了！

english: Don't eat it until you're in front of the tunnel entrance, or the magic will wear off too quickly.
translation: 等到了隧道入口再吃，否则魔法效果会消失得太快。

english: Don't even think of asking me for free food today, [player name]. I'm taking a break.
translation: 想都别想今天来找我要免费食物，[player name]。我在休息。

english: Don't ever pick a fight with a cactus, they have prickly tempers.
translation: 永远别跟仙人掌打架，它们的脾气可扎人了。

english: Don't follow me now - I'll deal with my follower first.
translation: 现在别跟着我——我得先处理我的跟班。

english: Don't forget about the grown-ups tricking people too!
translation: 别忘了还有大人也在捉弄人呢！

english: Don't forget that when you have completed this event you will be deposited where you left, so only deposit items that you can do without when you get back.
translation: 别忘了，完成这个活动后，你会被送回离开时的位置，所以只存放那些你回来后不需要的物品。

english: Don't forget the plan. You dress up as Anti-Santa, terrify the pixies and I will 'save' them. That should get them working.
translation: 别忘了计划。你扮成反圣诞老人，吓唬那些小精灵，然后我来'拯救'它们。这样它们就该干活了。

english: Don't forget you also freed me...
translation: 别忘了你也释放了我……

english: Don't forget, my workshop is in the basement of the abandoned house in the north of the village. If you find yourself in a sewer then you're in the wrong place.
translation: 别忘了，我的工作室在村子北边那栋废弃房子的地下室里。要是你发现自己在下水道里，那就是走错地方了。

english: Don't get trapped in a bottle.
translation: 别被困在瓶子里了。

english: Don't give up? You had your chance to help me, 25 years it's taken you!
translation: 别放弃？你本来有机会帮我的，可你花了整整二十五年！

english: Don't go in.
translation: 别进去。

english: Don't hog them all to yourself. Share them with your valentine, adventurer!
translation: 别一个人独吞。和你的情人分享吧，冒险者！

english: Don't insert your cat.
translation: 别把你的猫塞进去。

english: Don't knock them until you've tried them; it's always funny when someone tries to get in a sneak hit with a warhammer, only to have it bounce off my horns and back in their face, leaving them only a stunned expression and a number of missing teeth.
translation: 别在试过之前就否定它们；当有人想用战锤偷袭我，结果锤子从我的角上弹回去砸到他们自己脸上，只留下一脸震惊和几颗掉落的牙齿，这总是很有趣。

english: Don't leave me here!
translation: 别把我丢在这儿！

english: Don't let prisoner escape.
translation: 别让囚犯逃跑。

english: Don't lose this one!
translation: 别再弄丢这个了！

english: Don't make me laugh!
translation: 别逗我笑了！

english: Don't make me laugh. You are puny, barely a morsel.
translation: 别让我笑了。你太渺小了，连塞牙缝都不够。

english: Don't make me make more accidents happen. You're lucky I have extras. Don't lose this one.
translation: 别逼我再制造更多意外。算你走运，我还有备用的。别再弄丢这个了。

english: Don't many other towns not follow Elidinis though?
translation: 不过，不是很多其他城镇都不信奉伊莉迪尼斯吗？

english: Don't mention it. Anyway, I was wondering if you had any more of those seeds?
translation: 别客气。话说回来，我想知道你还有没有那种种子？

english: Don't mention it. I'm always happy to help.
translation: 别客气。我随时乐意帮忙。

english: Don't mention it. I'm happy to help.
translation: 别客气。我很乐意帮忙。

english: Don't mind me, I'll be happy to help.
translation: 别管我，我很乐意帮忙。

english: Don't most humans get heavier at Christmas?
translation: 大多数人类不是在圣诞节都会变重吗？

english: Don't play the cutscene.
translation: 不要播放过场动画。

english: Don't proceed.
translation: 不要继续。

english: Don't stop - keep on training!
translation: 别停下——继续训练！

english: Don't take a vial.
translation: 不要拿小瓶。

english: Don't take too long, or get too close to Oziach, as he might catch us, and we'll have to start again.
translation: 别拖太久，也别离奥扎克太近，不然他可能会抓住我们，我们就得从头再来了。

english: Don't take too long, we need to get some eggs delivered!
translation: 别花太长时间，我们还得去送些蛋呢！

english: Don't talk to me, there are eggs to deal with!
translation: 别跟我说话，还有蛋要处理呢！

english: Don't tell anyone, but I've got a crush on one of the guards!
translation: 别告诉别人，但我迷上了一个守卫！

english: Don't tell him.
translation: 别告诉他。

english: Don't underestimate how meaningful a kind act from a random stranger can be.
translation: 别小看一个陌生人的善意之举能有多大的意义。

english: Don't use the dye.
translation: 不要使用染料。

english: Don't view the display
translation: 不要查看展示

english: Don't waste numulites!
translation: 别浪费努米利特！

english: Don't worry - I just need to pick up a couple of mementos. You see, I need something that represents Defence, and an armourer is perfectly placed to help there.
translation: 别担心——我只是需要拿几件纪念品。你看，我需要一件能代表防御的东西，而盔甲匠正好能帮上忙。

english: Don't worry for now, you'll know if you need it.
translation: 现在别担心，需要的时候你自然会知道。

english: Don't worry too much. Fortunately for you, I'm in a good mood.
translation: 别太担心。算你走运，我今天心情不错。

english: Don't worry! I've done this before... Once or twice.
translation: 别担心！我以前做过这个……一两次吧。

english: Don't worry, I always make spares. When at sea, things get lost all the time!
translation: 别担心，我总会做备用的。在海上，东西总是会弄丢！

english: Don't worry, I found it just now. Here it is.
translation: 别担心，我刚才找到了。给你。

english: Don't worry, I found them earlier. They must have blown into the castle courtyard on the wind!
translation: 别担心，我之前找到了。它们一定是被风吹到城堡院子里了！

translation: 别担心，我这儿有呢！它自己回到我身边了。

translation: 别担心，我捡起来了。给你。

translation: 别担心，我这儿拿着呢。给你。尽量别再掉了。这是盔甲，但也不是坚不可摧的！

english: Don't worry, I've got it right here. Here you go. Try not to drop it again. Its just been cleaned and it'll be covered in dirt!
translation: 别担心，我这儿拿着呢。给你。尽量别再掉了。刚洗干净，又会沾满泥土的！

translation: 别担心，我这儿拿着呢。给你。尽量别再掉了。刚洗干净，又会沾满泥土的！

translation: 别担心，我这儿拿着呢。我在地上找到的。给你。尽量别再掉了。这是个玻璃瓶，下次可能会摔碎！

translation: 别担心，绝对安全。它们实际上不会碰到。我只是要把它泼在这外室的墙上。为了营造气氛，你懂的！

english: Don't worry, the Easter Bunny is sure to work you to the bone to compensate.
translation: 别担心，复活节兔子肯定会让你累死累活来补偿的。

english: Don't worry, we will find a way.

translation: 够了！我不需要你的帮助！

english: Enough? You can never have enough woad leaves! You can sell them, make dyes from them, even just keep them, so many things!
translation: 够了？菘蓝叶子永远不嫌多！你可以卖掉它们，用它们做染料，甚至只是留着，用处多着呢！

translation: 超级金鱼草，并用它制作了一些新的吐真剂。我现在应该给间谍服用这种吐真剂。

english: Enriched Snapdragon and used it to make some new Truth Serum. I then administered the Truth Serum to the Spy and he provided details on an individual known as the Dark Squall. I made a Sketch of this Dark Squall based on the information provided. I should let the others know.
translation: 超级金鱼草，并用它制作了一些新的吐真剂。然后我给间谍服用了吐真剂，他提供了关于一个被称为黑风暴的人的详细信息。我根据提供的信息画了一张黑风暴的草图。我应该通知其他人。

english: Enriched Snapdragon from the Specially Prepared Patch on the roof of the White Knights' Castle. I should now be able to use it to make some new Super Truth Serum from a regular Truth Serum.
translation: 来自白骑士城堡屋顶特制苗床的超级金鱼草。我现在应该能用它从普通的吐真剂中制作一些新的超级吐真剂。

english: Enriched Snapdragon from the Specially Prepared Patch on the roof of the White Knights' Castle. I should now be able to use it to make some new Truth Serum. I should speak to Thaerisk about how to do this.
translation: 来自白骑士城堡屋顶特制苗床的超级金鱼草。我现在应该能用它制作一些新的吐真剂。我应该和赛里斯克谈谈如何做到这一点。

translation: 用来让末日预言者高兴起来的娱乐活动。

english: Entry 12 reads: I hear him now. This is progress. Temple complete. To the mountain? Of course Master. We'll come to you. Scaly and strong.
translation: 第12条记录写道：我现在能听到他了。这是进步。神殿完工。去山上？当然，主人。我们会来找你。鳞甲覆身，强壮无比。
