translation: 第8条记录写道：本周山上笼罩着一层奇怪的雾。三个人去调查但再也没有回来。他们的工资将被扣留直到他们返回。接下来的几天里，情况发生了剧变，

english: Entry 9 reads: Our Master walked among us this week, a true blessing. His latest experiment has borne fruit and he's been passing around an odd green tonic. He claims it'll make the workers stronger and healthier...
translation: 第9条记录写道：我们的主人本周在我们中间行走，真是天赐之福。他最新的实验有了成果，他正在分发一种奇怪的绿色补药。他声称这会让工人们更强壮、更健康……

english: Er yes, of course. Courier, that's me. I'm from the umm... Castle Courier Service.
translation: 呃，是的，当然。信使，就是我。我来自嗯……城堡信使服务。

english: Er, I think I'll manage. Please continue; your story's 'enthralling'.
translation: 呃，我想我能应付。请继续；你的故事真是'引人入胜'。

english: Er, not sure I'm afraid.
translation: 呃，恐怕我不太确定。

english: Er, what do you mean?
translation: 呃，你是什么意思？

english: Er... On second thoughts... I think I'll stay up here.
translation: 呃……再想想……我还是待在上面好了。

english: Er... how about a spooky pumpkin lantern? That would tie everything together perfectly.
translation: 呃……来个幽灵南瓜灯笼怎么样？那就能完美搭配一切了。

english: Eric hands you a bundle of Halloween-themed rewards.
translation: 埃里克递给你一捆万圣节主题的奖励。

english: Eric produces a creepy-looking old book and places it on the lectern. He hides his notebook inside it.
translation: 埃里克拿出一本看起来很吓人的旧书，放在讲台上。他把自己的笔记本藏在里面。

english: Eric sent me to fetch a crypt key from you.
translation: 埃里克派我来找你拿墓穴钥匙。

english: Eric summoned a... demon head? And made dead people walk around?
translation: 埃里克召唤了一个……恶魔头？还让死人到处走动？

english: Eric's asked me to collect your children for his Halloween treat.
translation: 埃里克让我来收你的孩子，作为他的万圣节款待。

english: Eric's just down that trapdoor there...
translation: 埃里克就在那个活板门下面……

english: Eric? I've met that man. What would he do with a witch's cauldron? He's got all the magical aptitude of a level 3 skiller, but with less charisma!
translation: 埃里克？我见过那个人。他要女巫的大锅做什么？他有的那点魔法天赋，顶多就是个3级技能号，魅力还更差！

english: Eric? What does that fool want with my crypt key? It opens the Rimmington church crypt, but there's nothing in there that Eric would want.
translation: 埃里克？那个傻瓜要我的墓穴钥匙做什么？那是开里明顿村教堂墓穴的，但里面可没有埃里克想要的东西。

english: Erm, Father Aereck?
translation: 呃，艾瑞克神父？

english: Erm, I've lost the mattress...
translation: 呃，我把床垫弄丢了……

english: Erm, I... don't really know what I expected.
translation: 呃，我……真不知道自己在期待什么。

english: Erm, monkey? Wake up! There's a tasty banana here for you!
translation: 呃，猴子？醒醒！这里有根好吃的香蕉给你！

english: Erm... Excuse me... Could I ask...
translation: 呃……打扰一下……我能问一下……

english: Erm... Open sesame?
translation: 呃……芝麻开门？

english: Erm... about that.
translation: 呃……关于那个……

english: Erm....hi?
translation: 呃……嗨？

english: Ernest was a rather unfortunate man. Now he is a rather unfortunate chicken. I need not dwell on the details, but I greatly desire one of his feathers.
translation: 欧内斯特是个相当不幸的人。现在他成了一只相当不幸的鸡。我不需要细说细节，但我非常想要他的一根羽毛。

english: Err, I guess not.
translation: 呃，我想不是。

english: Err, how? You're inside a crate.
translation: 呃，怎么？你可是在板条箱里面。

english: Err, not right now. I've actually come to ask you a question.
translation: 呃，现在不是。我其实是来问你一个问题的。

english: Err, yeah. How do you catch them?
translation: 呃，是啊。你是怎么抓到它们的？

english: Err.. no, I have... rabbit things to do.
translation: 呃……不，我还有……兔子的事要忙。

english: Err.. yeah, Death showing up out of nowhere, again, is totally fun.
translation: 呃……是啊，死神又突然冒出来，真是太有趣了。

english: Err... I don't think so.
translation: 呃……我不这么认为。

english: Err... I thought it'd be fun to be the bad guy for once.
translation: 呃……我以为当一次坏人会很有趣。

english: Err... maybe another time.
translation: 呃……也许下次吧。

english: Errare humanum est. (Making mistakes is human.)
translation: 人非圣贤，孰能无过。

english: Error
translation: 错误

english: Errr, Jarvis?
translation: 呃，贾维斯？

english: Errr... No.
translation: 呃……不。

english: Essyllt hands you a strange object and a tarnished key.
translation: 埃西尔特递给你一个奇怪物体和一把暗淡的钥匙。

english: Essyllt hands you a strange object.
translation: 埃西尔特递给你一个奇怪物体。

english: Essyllt hands you a tarnished key.
translation: 埃西尔特递给你一把暗淡的钥匙。

english: Essylt hands you a newly cut key.
translation: 埃西尔特递给你一把新切好的钥匙。

english: Eugh! I don't feel too good...
translation: 呃！我感觉不太舒服……

english: Eve gave me an incantation, but I seem to have lost it.
translation: 夏娃给了我一个咒语，但我好像弄丢了。

english: Eve, wait!
translation: 夏娃，等等！

english: Eve... thank you so much.
translation: 夏娃……太感谢你了。

english: Eve? Who is that?
translation: 夏娃？那是谁？

english: Even for an experienced armourer it is not an easy task, but eventually it is ready. You have restored the dragon square shield to its former glory.
translation: 即使对经验丰富的盔甲匠来说，这也不是件容易的事，但最终还是完成了。你将龙形方盾恢复到了昔日的荣光。

english: Even for an expert armourer it is not an easy task, but eventually it is ready. You have crafted the draconic visage and anti-dragonbreath shield into a dragonfire shield.
translation: 即使对专家级盔甲匠来说，这也不是件容易的事，但最终还是完成了。你将龙形面具和防龙息盾制作成了龙火盾。

english: Even for an expert armourer it is not an easy task, but eventually it is ready. You have crafted the skeletal visage and anti-dragonbreath shield into a dragonfire ward.
translation: 即使对专家级盔甲匠来说，这也不是件容易的事，但最终还是完成了。你将骷髅面罩和防龙息盾制作成了龙火护符。

english: Even if I didn't win, this has been a fun trip out for me. Hopefully I'll see you back in Hemenster one day!
translation: 就算我没赢，这趟出来也挺开心的。希望有一天能在赫门斯特再见到你！

english: Even if I didn't win, this has been a fun trip out for me. You should come try and win the fishing contest in Hemenster; there's some REAL big fish out there!
translation: 就算我没赢，这趟出来也挺开心的。你应该来赫门斯特试试赢得钓鱼大赛；那里可是有真正的大鱼！

english: Even if it was accidentally.
translation: 即使是不小心的。

english: Even magic?
translation: 连魔法也是？

english: Even to save the children?
translation: 即使是为了救孩子们？

english: Event goers can go on a treasure hunt to find me chest!
translation: 参加活动的人可以参加寻宝游戏来找我的宝箱！

english: Eventually it gets set off, a small explosion happens and the magic dissipates
translation: 最终它被引爆了，发生了一次小爆炸，魔法消散了。

english: Eventually the Jubbly is nicely cooked.
translation: 最终，贾布利被完美地煮熟了。

english: Eventually we understood that someone had been putting Halloween costumes on the hungry stray dogs! We now keep the bowls where we can see them!
translation: 最后我们才明白，原来是有人给那些饥饿的流浪狗穿上了万圣节服装！现在我们把碗放在我们能看见的地方了！

english: Ever since the time we agreed that I would get compensated.
translation: 自从我们同意我会得到补偿那时起。

english: Every synapse in your brain screams at you that should not have put what you just did in your mouth.
translation: 你大脑里的每一个神经突触都在尖叫，告诉你刚才不应该把那个东西放进嘴里。

english: Every tree needs something to top it off!
translation: 每棵树都需要点东西来点缀树顶！

english: Every year she sings to all who will listen that all she wants for Christmas is me. Everywhere I go, I hear her. It's awful. I've tried to explain to her that I'm not into her, to no avail.
translation: 每年她都会对所有愿意听的人唱，她圣诞节只想要我。我走到哪儿都能听到她的声音。太可怕了。我试着跟她解释我对她没兴趣，但没用。

english: Every year? And you ask for them? Then surely you knew what you were getting?
translation: 每年？而且你还要它们？那你肯定知道自己会得到什么吧？

english: Everybody likes ice cream, everybody likes chocolate chips. May as well mix the two!
translation: 人人都喜欢冰淇淋，人人都喜欢巧克力片。不如把两者混在一起！

english: Everyone and his dog wants a fancy dress costume! My poor fingers are being worn to the bone with all this work. Unfortunately you'll need to find someone else to do it.
translation: 每个人和他家的狗都想要化装舞会服装！我可怜的手指都快被这活儿磨断了。不幸的是，你得找别人来做了。

english: Everyone copy me!|colour=yellow|shadow=yes
translation: 大家都学我！|colour=yellow|shadow=yes

english: Everyone get down!
translation: 大家都趴下！

english: Everyone is wearing Santa hats so all my hard work can't be seen!
translation: 每个人都戴着圣诞老人帽子，所以我所有的辛苦都看不见了！

english: Everyone knows that Santa has little helpers.
translation: 大家都知道圣诞老人有小帮手。

english: Everyone plays it at school, haven't you heard of it? After counting to 3, you pick one. Egg beats secateurs, secateurs beat silk, silk beats egg. Simple.
translation: 学校里大家都玩这个，你没听说过吗？数到3之后，你选一个。蛋克修枝剪，修枝剪克丝绸，丝绸克蛋。简单。

english: Everyone seems to be having a great time so I'd say it's been quite successful!
translation: 大家似乎都玩得很开心，所以我觉得相当成功！

english: Everything has a reason, even if you don't know what it is.
translation: 凡事皆有原因，即使你不知道是什么。

english: Everything normal here?
translation: 这里一切正常吗？

english: Everything okay?
translation: 一切都好吗？

english: Evidently.
translation: 显然。

english: Evil Bob appears.
translation: 邪恶鲍勃出现了。

english: Evil Chicken has tired of your taste. Evil Chicken wishes to eat other warriors.
translation: 邪恶鸡已经厌倦了你的味道。邪恶鸡想吃其他战士了。

english: Evil Dave has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 邪恶戴夫又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Evil was the only course left, puny featherless being. You kill Evil Chicken's brethren and expect Evil Chicken to come round for tea and pie?
translation: 邪恶是唯一剩下的道路，渺小的无毛生物。你杀了邪恶鸡的同胞，还指望邪恶鸡过来喝茶吃派？

english: Ewww, it smells!
translation: 呃，好臭！

english: Exactly! I know a great deal of wizards who can do a great deal of things to people and animals, but I don't know that many who can do things to inanimate objects!
translation: 没错！我认识很多巫师，他们能对人或者动物做很多事，但我不认识几个能对无生命物体做手脚的！

english: Exactly! I'm sure you're also very excited to learn about this year's fiasco?
translation: 没错！我相信你也很想知道今年的闹剧是怎么回事？

english: Exactly! We just need to get some camel milk and make some ice cream, then put it inside the eggs...
translation: 没错！我们只需要弄些骆驼奶，做些冰淇淋，然后放进蛋里……

english: Exactly! We've had many ideas on how to do this, but none of them are suitable.
translation: 没错！我们想了很多办法来做这个，但都不合适。

english: Exactly! You'll be fine. Are you ready?
translation: 没错！你会没事的。准备好了吗？

english: Exactly. So, are you going to make the magical cleaning potion?
translation: 没错。那么，你打算制作魔法清洁药水吗？

english: Excellent! 2 more left to kill.
translation: 太好了！还剩2个要杀。

english: Excellent! Can I see it?
translation: 太好了！我能看看吗？

english: Excellent! Hand it over and give me a minute.
translation: 太好了！把它给我，稍等一下。

english: Excellent! Let's get you all set up, I've got a spare pickaxe or two around here somewhere.
translation: 太好了！我来帮你准备好，我这儿附近应该有一两把备用的镐子。

english: Excellent! Now you need some flammable oil. There's a gungy pool near the mining rocks with an oily scum on the surface.
translation: 太好了！现在你需要一些可燃油。在采矿岩石附近有个黏糊糊的水坑，表面浮着一层油污。

english: Excellent! Step through the portal and prepare for battle!
translation: 太好了！穿过传送门，准备战斗！

english: Excellent! Well, the first flower trader is apparently 'At the place where you turn essence into the power of the body', whatever that means.
translation: 太好了！嗯，第一个花商据说在‘你把精华变成身体力量的地方’，管它什么意思。

english: Excellent! What do you want for them?
translation: 太好了！你想要什么来换它们？

english: Excellent! Would you mind putting it together? My paws are a bit too big for this...
translation: 太好了！你介意把它组装起来吗？我的爪子有点太大了，做不了这个……

english: Excellent, I'll take that and be on my way delivering. Go check on the pixies, make sure they're still working.
translation: 太好了，我拿着这个就去送货了。去看看那些小精灵，确保它们还在工作。

english: Excellent, all the skills are represented now. I can feel the power building up already!
translation: 太好了，现在所有技能都齐了。我已经能感觉到力量在积聚了！

english: Excellent, excellent! Thank you so much.
translation: 太好了，太好了！非常感谢你。

english: Excellent, glad to help.
translation: 太好了，很高兴能帮忙。

english: Excellent, go show that boy some humility.
translation: 太好了，去让那小子知道什么叫谦虚。

english: Excellent, let's see what's inside.
translation: 太好了，看看里面有什么。

english: Excellent, you've restored the battleaxe to its former glory! You'd better bring it to Blasidar the sculptor now.
translation: 太好了，你把战斧恢复到了昔日的荣光！你现在最好把它带给雕塑家布拉西达。

english: Excellent. As I said, keep an eye on that Wise Old Man. The last thing we want is for Christmas to be ruined!
translation: 太好了。就像我说的，盯紧那个老智者。我们最不希望的就是圣诞节被搞砸！

english: Excellent. As you can see, I've prepared a fire pit on which we can put it. Let's have a look now...
translation: 太好了。如你所见，我准备了一个火坑，我们可以把它放上去。现在让我们看看……

english: Excellent. His name is Thordur.
translation: 太好了。他叫索杜尔。

english: Excellent. Sorry. Thank you. Pardon me.
translation: 太好了。抱歉。谢谢。请原谅。

english: Excellent. That will do very nicely.
translation: 太好了。那非常合适。

english: Excellent. Use the items on the desk to write a promissory note, promising that Santa will pay Diango for the toys, and sign it with Santa's seal.
translation: 太好了。用书桌上的物品写一张期票，承诺圣诞老人会付钱给迪亚戈买玩具，然后用圣诞老人的印章签名。

english: Excellent. You're now assigned to kill Barrows brothers [number] times. Your reward point tally is [number],[number].
translation: 很好。你现在被指派去击杀巴罗斯墓穴兄弟 [number] 次。你的奖励积分总计为 [number],[number]。

english: Excellent. You're now assigned to kill Callisto [number] times. Your reward point tally is [number],[number].
translation: 很好。你现在被指派去击杀卡利斯托 [number] 次。你的奖励积分总计为 [number],[number]。

english: Excellent. You're now assigned to kill Cerberus [number] times. Your reward point tally is [number].

translation: 最后，法拉多城附近农场的莎拉一直在制作一些万圣节装饰品。如果你运气好，也许能让她分给你一些东西。

english: Finally, in return for charting information, I can offer some training that will help you improve your sailing abilities. Just let me know any time you completely chart an ocean.
translation: 最后，作为对绘制海图信息的回报，我可以提供一些训练来帮助你提高航海能力。只要你完整绘制了一片海洋的海图，随时告诉我。

english: Finally, my army of sorrow brought to life!
translation: 终于，我的悲伤大军活过来了！

english: Find a sealed crate near the Pandemonium and sample the contents.
translation: 在潘德莫尼姆岛附近找到一个密封箱，并品尝里面的东西。

english: Find someone else for your bizarre experiment!
translation: 找别人去做你那奇怪的实验吧！

english: Find that mould in the end?
translation: 最后找到那个模具了吗？

english: Find the toy room in the warrens below, you'll find yourself Milkee, my brother. He's likely to ask you questions.
translation: 去下面的兔子洞里找玩具房，你会见到我弟弟米尔奇。他大概会问你一些问题。

english: Find to seek the official group for ranked Duels or Tournaments.
translation: 寻找排位决斗或锦标赛的官方队伍。

english: Find to seek the official group for ranked Duels.
translation: 寻找排位决斗的官方队伍。

english: Find to seek the official group for ranked Tournaments. Alternatively, you could look for another player's group, for an unranked Tournament.
translation: 寻找排位锦标赛的官方队伍。或者，你也可以找其他玩家的队伍参加非排位赛。

english: Finding where Zemouregal is keeping Arrav's heart. Hopefully I'll have something by the time you're done.
translation: 正在找泽莫雷加尔藏阿拉夫心脏的地方。希望等你忙完时我能有点进展。

english: Fine! I have a card but I'm not that old!
translation: 好吧！我是有卡，但我还没那么老！

english: Fine, I'll go and talk to her.
translation: 好吧，我去跟她谈谈。

english: Fine, I'll go and talk to her... Where can I find Carol?
translation: 好吧，我去跟她谈谈……我在哪里能找到卡罗尔？

english: Fine, and what was that about mine carts?
translation: 好吧，那矿车又是怎么回事？

english: Fine, but don't let the destruction of Falador sit on your conscience.
translation: 好吧，但别让法拉多城的毁灭成为你良心的负担。

english: Fine, how about... Yummy for My Tummy Eggs Sort of Like a Choc-Ice But Bigger and Better?
translation: 好吧，那……我的肚子爱吃的蛋，有点像巧克力冰棍但更大更好？

english: Fine, one last idea, how about... Easter Eggs?
translation: 好吧，最后一个主意，叫……复活节彩蛋怎么样？

english: Fine, since I made a deal with the Easter Bunny for at least ten eggs all to myself for helping fix this farce.
translation: 好吧，反正我跟复活节兔子说好了，帮它收拾这个烂摊子，至少能拿到十个蛋归我自己。

english: Fine, stupid human, as long as you not join stupid Falador.
translation: 好吧，愚蠢的人类，只要你不加入那愚蠢的法拉多城就行。

english: Fine. No need to be rude about it.
translation: 好吧。没必要这么粗鲁。

english: Fine. You heard right... I've got an amulet of duplication!
translation: 好吧。你没听错……我有一条复制护身符！

english: Fine... I might as well make use of you while you're here... we need some new flavours, can you do that?
translation: 好吧……既然你来了，不如就利用你一下……我们需要一些新口味，你能搞定吗？

english: Fingers crossed it works!
translation: 希望这能行！

english: Finish this [player name]...
translation: 了结这一切吧，[player name]……

english: Fire Runes from an Essence.
translation: 每个精华能做出火焰符文。

english: Fire Runes from each Essence.
translation: 每个精华能做出火焰符文。

english: Fire and brimstone! May Zamorak light my path with the blood of my enemies.
translation: 烈火与硫磺！愿扎莫拉克用我敌人的鲜血照亮我的道路。

english: First I must immerse myself in the atmosphere of the Chambers, and in the spirit of the story, and warm up my voice.
translation: 首先，我得沉浸在议会厅的氛围里，融入故事的精神，再开开嗓。

english: First I spoke to the cook, who told me the golbins were trick or treating.
translation: 我先跟厨师聊了聊，他告诉我那些哥布林在玩不给糖就捣蛋。

english: First correct answer
translation: 第一个正确答案

english: First things first then, let's get some camel milk.
translation: 那就先办正事吧，我们去弄点骆驼奶。

english: First time is always a little awkward, just don't dwell on it too much. Here, takes these.
translation: 第一次总是有点尴尬，别太放在心上。来，拿着这些。

english: First up, we have Thurgo and his Imcando Dwarf Cake! Or... Is it more of a pie?
translation: 首先登场的是瑟戈和他的伊姆坎多矮人蛋糕！或者……这更像是个派？

english: First you'll need some chocolate, luckily for you, the walls in the northern section of the cave are full of the stuff.
translation: 首先你需要一些巧克力，算你走运，洞穴北边的墙上全是这玩意儿。

english: First, answer three questions. You ready?
translation: 首先，回答三个问题。准备好了吗？

english: First, you'll need a map of the pumpkin field showing you where every colour goes.
translation: 首先，你需要一张南瓜地的地图，上面标明了每种颜色该放哪里。

english: Firstly we use white wine, not red. We all know that white wine is good at removing red wine stains, so it will work on other red stains too!
translation: 首先我们用白葡萄酒，不是红的。大家都知道白葡萄酒擅长去除红酒渍，所以对其他红色污渍也有效！

english: Firstly, was anything inedible baked into it?
translation: 首先，里面有没有烤进什么不能吃的东西？

english: Firstly, you might want to give all that old stuff a polish. Your dad may not have used it in a while and I'm sure it'll be dusty.
translation: 首先，你最好把那些旧东西都擦亮。你爸可能很久没用过了，肯定积了不少灰。

english: Fish Stalls!
translation: 鱼摊！

english: Five hundred years have passed since the rule of King Alvis,
translation: 阿尔维斯国王统治至今已过五百年，

english: Five years!?
translation: 五年！？

english: Fix the boat?
translation: 修船？

english: Fix the booth?
translation: 修摊位？

english: Fix the chimney?
translation: 修烟囱？

english: Fix the chute?
translation: 修滑道？

english: Fix the roof?
translation: 修屋顶？

english: Fix the wall?
translation: 修墙？

english: Fizz...
translation: 嘶嘶……

english: Fletching, Crafting, Smithing.
translation: 制箭、制作、锻造。

english: Floating crates of drink can be found at sea and pried open with a crowbar. Once open, you can sample what you find inside. However, take care, for expired alcohol can be dangerous...
translation: 海上能找到漂浮的饮料板条箱，用撬棍就能撬开。打开后，你可以尝尝里面的东西。不过要小心，过期的酒可能很危险……

english: Floopa heads over to Elder Raley's home.
translation: 弗卢帕朝长老雷利家走去。

english: Flosi Dalksson puts 1000gp into the tax bag.
translation: 弗洛西.达尔克森往税袋里放了1000金币。

english: Flour in inventory
translation: 背包中的面粉

english: Flowers! I'm a flower trader. I've been selling so many that I'm almost out of stock, so I'm looking around for some more.
translation: 花！我是个花商。卖得太好都快断货了，所以我正在四处找些新货源。

english: Fluffs looks proud.
translation: 毛毛看起来很得意。

english: Focus! What's been happening here?
translation: 说重点！这里发生了什么事？

english: Foe (See Notes)
translation: 敌人（见注释）

english: Follow Tamayu on the next hunt?
translation: 跟随塔马尤进行下一次狩猎？

english: Follow me - I understand I'll lose my existing follower.
translation: 跟着我——我知道我会失去现有的跟从者。

english: Follow me and let's go!
translation: 跟我来，我们走！

english: Follow the directions another time.
translation: 改天再按指示走。

english: Follow the directions to the house.
translation: 按照指示前往那栋房子。

english: Follow the guide?
translation: 跟着向导走？

english: Follow the path?
translation: 沿着小路走？

english: Follow the road north west from Falador. If you come to the goblin village, you've gone too far in which case you should turn south.
translation: 从法拉多城沿西北方向的路走。如果你到了哥布林村庄，那就是走过头了，这时你应该往南折返。

english: Follow the scary cat?
translation: 跟着那只吓人的猫？

english: Follow the technical plans?
translation: 按照技术图纸来？

english: Followers are not allowed in the Knight Waves. You'll need to put it away if you wish to enter.
translation: 骑士试炼中不允许携带跟从者。如果你想进入，必须把它收起来。

english: Following Elias' suggestion, I entered the Mastaba in the Uzer Oasis and found some information on how to preserve Arrav's Heart.
translation: 按照伊莱亚斯的建议，我进入了乌泽绿洲的石墓，找到了一些关于如何保存阿拉夫心脏的信息。

english: Following the instructions from the schematic you make an elemental claw.
translation: 按照示意图上的说明，你制作了一个元素之爪。

english: Following the instructions in the book, you make an elemental mind helm.
translation: 按照书中的说明，你制作了一个元素心灵头盔。

english: Following the plans is tricky, but you persevere.
translation: 按照图纸操作很棘手，但你坚持了下来。

english: Foolish human, you dare speak to me?
translation: 愚蠢的人类，你竟敢跟我说话？

english: For a birthday, maybe? After all, we're never short of events to celebrate!
translation: 也许是生日？毕竟我们从来不缺值得庆祝的事！

english: For completely charting the Ardent Ocean, Gerardus hands you... a bedsheet?
translation: 作为完全绘制炽热之海海图的奖励，杰拉杜斯递给你……一张床单？

english: For completely charting the Northern Ocean, Gerardus hands you... a book about lighthouses?
translation: 作为完全绘制北海海图的奖励，杰拉杜斯递给你……一本灯塔之书？

english: For completely charting the Shrouded Ocean, Gerardus hands you... a weird black orb?
translation: 作为完全绘制迷雾海海图的奖励，杰拉杜斯递给你……一个奇怪的黑宝珠？

english: For completely charting the Unquiet Ocean, Gerardus hands you... a burned key?
translation: 作为完全绘制不宁海海图的奖励，杰拉杜斯递给你……一把烧焦的钥匙？

english: For everyone, you say?
translation: 你说给所有人？

english: For free?
translation: 免费？

english: For helping us complete the ritual many times, please also accept this helm as a symbol of the season.
translation: 感谢你多次帮助我们完成仪式，请收下这顶头盔作为这个季节的象征。

english: For me?
translation: 给我的？

english: For me? Is this my secret Santa present?
translation: 给我的？这是我的神秘圣诞老人礼物吗？

english: For now, just enjoy the tricks and treats!
translation: 现在嘛，就好好享受捣蛋和糖果吧！

english: For some reason, you take a severed leg.
translation: 不知为何，你拿起了一条断腿。

english: For treats you say? I have a weird feeling about this whole thing...
translation: 你说要糖果？我对整件事有种奇怪的感觉……

english: For treats? I am so confused about this whole thing.
translation: 要糖果？我对整件事感到非常困惑。

english: For treats? Where did they go next?
translation: 要糖果？他们接下来去了哪里？

english: For two whole eggs? I shall right away!
translation: 为了整整两个蛋？我马上去！

english: For what now?
translation: 现在又要干嘛？

english: For you to be Santa, I had to illuminate a reindeer's nose.
translation: 为了让你当圣诞老人，我得先点亮一只驯鹿的鼻子。

english: For you to notice me,
translation: 为了让你注意到我，

english: For your own continued good health, I implore you to drop this subject. Speak that name no more, and trouble not your mind with such thoughts.
translation: 为了你持续的健康，我恳求你放弃这个话题。不要再提那个名字，也不要让这些想法困扰你的心智。

english: Force open the window.
translation: 强行打开窗户。

english: Forebearer Janus casts a spell at the member, gravely injuring them.
translation: 先驱者雅努斯向那名成员施放法术，使其重伤。

english: Forebearer Janus casts a spell at the member, killing them.
translation: 先驱者雅努斯向那名成员施放法术，将其杀死。

english: Forget I said anything, goodbye.
translation: 当我什么都没说过，再见。

english: Forget it then.
translation: 那算了。

english: Forget it, see you at the festival!
translation: 算了，节日上见！

english: Forgive me, it's just...
translation: 原谅我，只是……

english: Fortified Elidinis' Ward.
translation: 强化伊莉迪尼斯护符。

english: Fossil Island (with 80 Hunter).
translation: 化石岛（需要80级猎人）。

english: Foul? Perhaps some prefer their meat crispy.
translation: 难闻？也许有些人就喜欢肉烤得焦脆。

english: Found dis in a wardrobe,'ll
translation: 在衣柜里找到这个，

english: Found dis in a wardrobe,'ll i' do?
translation: 在衣柜里找到这个，我该拿它怎么办？

english: Found it in the castle. Fit my head perfectly!
translation: 在城堡里找到的。戴在我头上正合适！

english: Found it! Here you go.
translation: 找到了！给你。

english: Four leaved clover.
translation: 四叶三叶草。

english: Four legs, eats grass! I think? I had to de-ice a path to get it back out. Come on, can we please stay on topic?
translation: 四条腿，吃草！大概吧？我还得给一条路除冰才能把它弄出来。拜托，我们能别跑题吗？

english: Fox by a Chasm near the Locus Oasis, but he'd been attacked. He asked me to make a Poultice for him using leaves from two nearby Plants along with an Embertailed Jerboa Tail.
translation: 在轨迹绿洲附近的深渊旁有只狐狸，但它被袭击了。它让我用附近两种植物的叶子和一条焰尾跳鼠尾给它做敷剂。

english: Fox explained to me that he was attacked whilst on route to trade with Atza in Outer Fortis. He asked me to go to her on his behalf while he recovers from his injuries. He gave me the Fur Sample that he took from Kiko's Bed to give to her.
translation: 狐狸解释说，它在去福蒂斯外围跟阿特扎做交易的路上被袭击了。它让我在它养伤期间替它去找她。它把从奇科床上拿来的毛皮样本给了我，让我转交给她。

english: Fox explained to me that he was attacked whilst on route to trade with Atza in Outer Fortis. He asked me to go to her on his behalf while he recovers from his injuries. If I give her the Fur Sample that Fox took from Kiko's Bed, she should be able to supply the Fur needed. I can find her home near the south western gate of Civitas illa Fortis.
translation: 福克斯解释说，他在前往福蒂斯外围与阿特扎交易的路上遭到了袭击。他请我在他养伤期间代他去见她。如果我把福克斯从奇科床上拿走的毛皮样本交给她，她应该就能提供所需的毛皮。她的家在福蒂斯城西南门附近。

english: Fox gives you a fur sample.
translation: 福克斯给了你一份毛皮样本。

english: Fox gives you a report.
translation: 福克斯给了你一份报告。

english: Fox with the Trimmed Fur and he gave me a Report. At his request, I delivered it to Guild Scribe Verity at the Hunter Guild. Now I just need to use the Trimmed Fur along with an Embertailed Jerboa Tail to fix Kiko's Bed.
translation: 福克斯那里有修剪毛皮，他还给了我一份报告。应他的要求，我把报告送到了猎人公会的公会文书维里蒂那里。现在我只需要用修剪毛皮和一条焰尾跳鼠尾来修理奇科的床。

english: Fox with the Trimmed Fur. At his request, I went back to the Hunter Guild and used it to fix Kiko's Bed. With the job done, I should speak to Guildmaster Apatura.
translation: 福克斯那里有修剪毛皮。应他的要求，我回到猎人公会，用它修好了奇科的床。事情办完了，我应该去跟公会会长阿帕图拉谈谈。

english: Fox with the Trimmed Fur. He asked me to head back to the Hunter Guild and use the Fur along with an Embertailed Jerboa Tail to fix Kiko's Bed. He also asked me to deliver a Report from him to Guild Scribe Verity.
translation: 福克斯那里有修剪毛皮。他让我回猎人公会，用毛皮和一条焰尾跳鼠尾来修理奇科的床。他还让我把他的一份报告交给公会文书维里蒂。

english: Fox writes up another report and hands it to you.
translation: 福克斯又写了一份报告，递给了你。

english: Fr Aereck Aereck gives you an uncut emerald.
translation: 阿雷克神父给了你一颗未切割的绿宝石。

english: Fr Aereck Aereck gives you an uncut red topaz.
translation: 阿雷克神父给了你一颗未切割的红托帕石。

english: Fr Aereck blesses you. You gain some Prayer xp.
translation: 阿雷克神父祝福了你。你获得了一些祈祷经验值。

english: Fr Aereck gives you some seeds.
translation: 阿雷克神父给了你一些种子。

english: Frank examines the thread from the crime scene.
translation: 弗兰克检查了犯罪现场的线。

english: Frank hands you a chest key.
translation: 弗兰克递给你一把宝箱钥匙。

english: Frank happily takes the rum... and hands you a key.
translation: 弗兰克高兴地接过朗姆酒……然后递给你一把钥匙。

english: Fred gives you a set of sharp shears.
translation: 弗雷德给了你一把锋利的剪刀。

english: Fred seems happy enough with his present already!
translation: 弗雷德似乎已经对他的礼物很满意了！

english: Fred takes the sapling from your feet, somehow blissfully unaware of your presence.
translation: 弗雷德从你脚边拿走了树苗，不知怎的，他幸福地没注意到你的存在。

english: Fred? Such a wholesome farmer. He does his job with the chickens and cows well. However, it wasn't his first choice of profession. He wanted to grow fruit trees you know. The one planted in the castle grounds sure did
translation: 弗雷德？真是个淳朴的农夫。他把养鸡养牛的活儿干得很好。不过，这并非他首选的职业。你知道吗，他本来想种果树。城堡里种的那棵确实……

english: Free food? Count me in!
translation: 免费食物？算我一个！

english: Free of charge of course!
translation: 当然是免费的！

english: Freeze, hm? Well, I do have a spell for that. Though, runes aren't cheap. What are you offering for payment?
translation: 冰冻，嗯？好吧，我确实有这么一个法术。不过，符文可不便宜。你打算付多少钱？

english: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon spiked blades jump Agility shortcut.
translation: 费明尼克杀戮者地牢的尖刺刀片跳跃敏捷捷径。

english: Fremennik round shields.
translation: 弗瑞曼尼克的圆盾。

english: Freneskae is a realm of near constant warfare, that hath developed techniques and weaponry far beyond the inkling of most mortals. It hath influenced this land, for many warriors that were used by mine brethren in the wars of the gods came directly from that plane, and when defeated here oft did drop pieces of their strange and powerful equipment as they fell. Such powerful equipment inevitably became prized amongst warriors for both its power and sturdiness, although most warriors desirous of such equipment cared little for its origin.
translation: 弗瑞内斯卡是一个近乎持续战乱的领域，它发展出的技术和武器远超大多数凡人的想象。它影响了这片土地，因为我的同胞在诸神战争中所使用的许多战士都直接来自那个位面，当他们在此地被击败时，常常会掉落他们那奇特而强大的装备碎片。如此强大的装备自然因其力量和坚固性而受到战士们的珍视，尽管大多数渴望这种装备的战士并不关心它的来历。

english: Fresh
translation: 新鲜

english: Freshly nibbled. Very interesting.
translation: 刚被啃过。非常有趣。

english: Friends are a weakness, all you can rely on is yourself. I share my combat experience with nobody! Followers are better than friends anyway, and minions are the best of all!
translation: 朋友是弱点，你能依靠的只有自己。我不会与任何人分享我的战斗经验！追随者总比朋友好，而仆从才是最好的！

english: Frightfully fun, you could say!
translation: 可以说是超级好玩！

english: Frogs agreed to begin peace talks with Marcellus. I let him know about this, but he told me he would only be willing to negotiate with their leader. I should see if they have one.
translation: 青蛙们同意与马塞勒斯开始和平谈判。我告诉了他这件事，但他告诉我他只愿意和他们的领袖谈判。我应该去看看他们有没有领袖。

translation: 对他们手下留情！做这种事不容易，尤其是他们做朋友已经这么久了。

english: Go find the real Santa and tell him!
translation: 去找真正的圣诞老人，告诉他！

english: Go forth! Play your part.
translation: 去吧！尽你的一份力。

english: Go get another guest in! Get back to the queue!
translation: 去叫下一位客人进来！回到队伍里去！

english: Go get him my frosty minions! Freeze his plans of festivity for good!
translation: 去抓住他，我的冰霜仆从们！把他的节日计划彻底冻结！

english: Go get that nasty rat, don't back down!
translation: 去抓住那只可恶的老鼠，别退缩！

english: Go go go!
translation: 冲啊冲啊冲啊！

english: Go greet whoever is at the front of the queue.
translation: 去迎接队伍最前面的人。

english: Go in anyway.
translation: 还是进去吧。

english: Go into the warren and catch ten chocolate kebbits. As you catch them, put them into the chute north of where you came into the warren. The chute leads to a pen, which I'll explain in a bit.
translation: 进入兔穴，捕捉十只巧克力凯比特兔。抓到后，把它们放进你进入兔穴处北边的滑道里。滑道通向一个围栏，我待会儿再解释。

english: Go north.
translation: 往北走。

english: Go now young sprout, and embrace your destiny!
translation: 去吧，年轻的嫩芽，拥抱你的命运！

english: Go on now, before he travels too far!
translation: 快去吧，趁他还没走远！

english: Go on then! I could do with a good haircut.
translation: 那就来吧！我正需要理个好发型。

english: Go on then, I'll follow you. Lead on.
translation: 那走吧，我跟着你。带路吧。

english: Go on then, you'll never beat me!
translation: 那就来吧，你永远赢不了我！

english: Go sort IT out.
translation: 去把这件事搞定。

english: Go south.
translation: 往南走。

english: Go take a seat and I'll prepare you a meal you'll never forget!
translation: 去坐下吧，我给你准备一顿让你终生难忘的大餐！

english: Go through the door next to the kebbit chute and use the eggs to go bowling for kebbits!
translation: 穿过凯比特兔滑道旁边的门，用这些蛋来玩凯比特兔保龄球！

english: Go to Rimmington, and ask Hetty to lend us her space cauldron. When you have it, fill it with water and cabbages, so it looks like a bubbling green witch's brew!
translation: 去里明顿村，请赫蒂把她的太空大锅借给我们。拿到之后，在里面装满水和卷心菜，让它看起来像一锅冒着绿色泡泡的女巫魔药！

english: Go to Thordur's blacker Blackhole.
translation: 去索杜尔更黑的黑洞。

english: Go to Thordur's other Blackhole.
translation: 去索杜尔的另一个黑洞。

english: Go to the bird's room, at the north of my warren. In a crate, you'll find a weapon that we can adapt to work on the creatures.
translation: 去鸟的房间，在我兔穴的北边。在一个板条箱里，你会找到一件武器，我们可以改造它来对付那些生物。

english: Go to the easter workshop?
translation: 去复活节工作室？

english: Go west.
translation: 往西走。

english: Goading Potions.
translation: 激怒药水。

english: Goblin Generals in Goblin Village.
translation: 哥布林村庄里的哥布林将军。

english: Goblin Invasion?
translation: 哥布林入侵？

english: Goblin Village you say? I better head up there. 5 -->
translation: 你说哥布林村庄？我最好去那里看看。5 -->

english: Goblin always ready.
translation: 哥布林随时准备着。

english: Goblin leaders should be good at planning in order to win battles.
translation: 哥布林领袖应该善于策划，才能赢得战斗。

english: Goblin, Bear, Big Frog, Ram, Unicorn, Monkey, Giant Rat, and Giant Bat.
translation: 哥布林、熊、大青蛙、公羊、独角兽、猴子、巨鼠和巨型蝙蝠。

english: Goblins and intelligence; two words I'd never of put in the same sentence.
translation: 哥布林和情报；我从来不会把这两个词放在同一个句子里。

english: Goblins in costumes you say? They were here earlier today asking for treats.
translation: 你说穿着戏服的哥布林？他们今天早些时候来过这里要糖果。

english: Goblins in costumes? Ghost costumes? They went around the castle earlier today, asking for treats!
translation: 穿着戏服的哥布林？幽灵戏服？他们今天早些时候在城堡周围转悠，要糖果呢！

english: Goblins in costumes? I saw them passing by the church earlier today, asking Father Aereck for treats.
translation: 穿着戏服的哥布林？我今天早些时候看到他们经过教堂，向艾瑞克神父要糖果。

english: Goblins in costumes? They were here earlier today asking for treats. They weren't even willing to pay for them!
translation: 穿着戏服的哥布林？他们今天早些时候来过这里要糖果。他们甚至不愿意付钱！

english: Goblins, east of Lumbridge.
translation: 哥布林，在仑桥镇东边。

english: Goblins. Lots of goblins. I saw the entrance to a deeper cave, where their High Priest must have his temple, but I'm not going in there without an army!
translation: 哥布林。好多哥布林。我看到了一个更深洞穴的入口，他们的大祭司肯定在那里有座神庙，但没有一支军队，我是不会进去的！

english: God
translation: 神

english: Goes to ground with full inventory
translation: 背包满时钻入地下

english: Going to inform Santa of the Wise Old Man's treachery with Jack Frost in Corsair Cove.
translation: 要去告诉圣诞老人，关于睿智老人与冰霜杰克在海盗湾的背叛行为。

english: Going upstairs would not be wise as there is no easy escape route.
translation: 上楼并不明智，因为没有方便的逃生路线。

english: Gold paint.
translation: 金色油漆。

english: Golden rings for Count Check to count.
translation: 给检查伯爵数的金戒指。

english: Golovanova fruit in Hosidius.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城的戈洛瓦诺瓦果实。

english: Golovanova seed (level 34)
translation: 戈洛瓦诺瓦种子（等级 34）

english: Gone? What!? We were always free, we just wanted better working conditions! You idiot... how are we going to make the presents now!?
translation: 走了？什么！？我们一直是自由的，我们只是想要更好的工作条件！你这个白痴……我们现在怎么做礼物啊！？

english: Good - I am pleased to finally meet a mortal with some courage.
translation: 很好——我很高兴终于遇到一个有勇气的凡人。

english: Good choice! Here you go.
translation: 好选择！给你。

english: Good day! I'm Marika. Have you come to take a look at my pumpkins?
translation: 你好！我是马丽卡。你是来看我的南瓜的吗？

english: Good day, [player name]. Are you able to help us with the ritual again today?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你今天还能再帮我们进行仪式吗？

english: Good day, druid.
translation: 你好，德鲁伊。

english: Good day. I wonder, might you be available to do me a favour? I have something wonderful planned, but I'm going to need help getting things into place.
translation: 你好。我想知道，你能帮我一个忙吗？我计划了一些美妙的事情，但我需要帮助来安排妥当。

english: Good footwear and strong calf muscles.
translation: 好的鞋子和强健的小腿肌肉。

english: Good for eats but not very interesting.
translation: 适合吃，但没什么意思。

english: Good for now, thank you. Now I need to get back to my friend, though!
translation: 暂时这样就够了，谢谢你。不过我现在得回到我的朋友那里去了！

english: Good for you, bye.
translation: 那很好啊，再见。

english: Good good. I suggest you take a boat there. I will wait for you at the jetty of the island. Come find me when you have a way of trapping Jonas.
translation: 好好好。我建议你坐船过去。我会在岛上的码头等你。等你找到困住乔纳斯的方法就来找我。

english: Good good. They're hiding on the south-west coast, near the bank.
translation: 好好好。他们躲在西南海岸附近，靠近银行。

english: Good gravy, that's some repulsively stinky stuff! I'm not going to go near that.
translation: 老天爷啊，这玩意儿臭得让人反胃！我可不想靠近它。

english: Good guess, but it's a bit [low/high]! Count them again and come back with your answer.
translation: 猜得不错，但有点[low/high]了！再数一遍，然后回来告诉我答案。

english: Good guess, but it's a bit low! Count them again and come back with your answer.
translation: 猜得不错，但有点低了！再数一遍，然后回来告诉我答案。

english: Good guess. Reminds me of a song... but the name passes me by. Anyway, your guess is a bit high, try again.
translation: 猜得不错。让我想起一首歌……但名字我一时想不起来。总之，你猜得有点高了，再试试。

english: Good idea but you must hurry [player name], we don't know how long Ulina has left!
translation: 好主意，但你必须快点，[player name]，我们不知道尤莉娜还能撑多久！

english: Good idea! But how do we get in to the kitchen? The chef is always there.
translation: 好主意！但我们怎么进厨房？厨师一直在那儿。

english: Good idea! We'll give you one of these seeds in return of course.
translation: 好主意！作为回报，我们会给你其中一颗种子。

english: Good idea, where should I start looking?
translation: 好主意，我该从哪里开始找？

english: Good idea. I'll look for it there.
translation: 好主意。我去那儿找找看。

english: Good job, kid. That's your shift done!
translation: 干得好，小子。你的班次结束了！

english: Good job. I think we go on break now, you guard prisoner for us.
translation: 干得好。我想我们该休息了，你来替我们看守囚犯。

english: Good job. I'm not sure my heart can take much more.
translation: 干得好。我真不确定我的心脏还能承受更多了。

english: Good luck Guss! you'll need it. I'll see you in there.
translation: 祝你好运，格斯！你会需要的。我们里面见。

english: Good luck on becoming an adventuer!
translation: 祝你成为一名冒险者！

english: Good luck on your journey to find who you really are. Meeting people will expand your horizons and help you progress. I know meeting you changed my life.
translation: 祝你找到真正的自己。结识他人会开阔你的眼界，帮助你成长。我知道遇见你改变了我的人生。

english: Good luck to whoever is eating that!
translation: 祝那个吃这东西的人好运！

english: Good luck to you too dearie, this is so exciting!
translation: 也祝你好运，亲爱的，这真是太令人兴奋了！

english: Good luck wit' that, there are lots o' adventurers already on the hunt!
translation: 祝你好运，已经有很多冒险者在追捕了！

english: Good luck with the eggs!
translation: 祝你鸡蛋顺利！

english: Good luck with the next one!
translation: 下一个也祝你好运！

english: Good luck, I hope you can complete the test this time!
translation: 祝你好运，我希望你这次能通过测试！

english: Good luck, I hope you can solve them!
translation: 祝你好运，我希望你能解开它们！

english: Good luck, I hope you complete the test this time.
translation: 祝你好运，我希望你这次能完成测试。

english: Good luck, I wish you a fair wind in yer sails!
translation: 祝你好运，愿你一帆风顺！

english: Good luck, [player name], we can't let Anti-Santa destroy Christmas!
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]，我们不能让反圣诞老人毁了圣诞节！

english: Good luck, have fun!
translation: 祝你好运，玩得开心！

english: Good luck, let me have a look when you've made it!
translation: 祝你好运，做好了让我看看！

english: Good luck, try not to lose it again!
translation: 祝你好运，别再弄丢了！

english: Good luck, try not to lose it again. It'll only slow you down!
translation: 祝你好运，别再弄丢了。那只会拖慢你的速度！

english: Good luck, try not to lose them again!
translation: 祝你好运，别再弄丢它们了！

english: Good luck. My Arm need judge other contestants now.
translation: 祝你好运。"我的手臂"现在要去评判其他参赛者了。

english: Good luck. You should stay down here in the pass where it's hottest too, to make sure it's a fair test!
translation: 祝你好运。你也应该待在这个最热的隘口下面，确保测试公平！

english: Good news I hope? Did the experiment work?
translation: 希望是好消息？实验成功了吗？

english: Good news! Diango says he can help! He's happy to hire your entire team.
translation: 好消息！迪亚戈说他能帮忙！他很乐意雇佣你的整个团队。

english: Good news! I've made the ice cream churn!
translation: 好消息！我做好了冰淇淋搅拌器！

english: Good news! Jimmy has been released!
translation: 好消息！吉米被释放了！

english: Good planning! There are two areas of scuffed snow on the ground by Buoy and Gurl, they'd make good spots for the two snowmen.
translation: 计划不错！浮标和格儿附近的地上有两处被踩乱的雪，正好适合放那两个雪人。

english: Good point. I'll go get those ingredients now.
translation: 说得对。我现在就去拿那些材料。

english: Good stuff. I have found a nice underwater cavern we can use to trap him in where I am sure he will never be found.
translation: 好东西。我找到了一个不错的水下洞穴，可以用来困住他，我确定他永远都不会被发现。

english: Good thing that lava was shallow!
translation: 还好那熔岩很浅！

english: Good to hear. if you need something sharper, perhaps I can interest you in some of my regular wares?
translation: 很高兴听到。如果你需要更锋利的东西，也许我可以让你看看我的一些常规商品？

english: Good to see you [player name]. Do you wish to return to Rellekka?
translation: 见到你真好，[player name]。你想回雷勒卡城吗？

english: Good to see you [player name]. Wanting to go to the Island of Stone?
translation: 见到你真好，[player name]。想去石之岛吗？

english: Good work! Did you run into any trouble at Ferox this time?
translation: 干得好！这次在费罗那儿遇到什么麻烦了吗？

english: Good! Keep it up. Once it's all cleaned then we can return the armor to Sir Vyvin and I won't lose my job!
translation: 好！继续加油。等全部清理干净，我们就能把盔甲还给维文爵士，我也就不会丢饭碗了！

english: Good, I'd hate that sort of thing.
translation: 好，我讨厌那种事。

english: Good, be quick, the information is time sensitive!
translation: 好，快点，这信息有时效性！

english: Good, because it definitely isn't.
translation: 好，因为它肯定不是。

english: Good, because this ritual will need to be repeated tomorrow.
translation: 好，因为这个仪式明天还得重复。

english: Good, don't ask me to make another pair.
translation: 好，别让我再做另一双了。

english: Good, don't take too long, it's important business information!
translation: 好，别花太长时间，这是重要的商业信息！

english: Good, everything has turned sunny side up!
translation: 好，一切都圆满解决了！

english: Good, go to the general store and steal item.
translation: 好，去杂货店偷东西。

english: Good, good, I will pass it to Jack soon. Here is your reward.
translation: 好好好，我很快就会把它交给杰克。这是你的奖励。

english: Good, right answer. Next question.
translation: 好，回答正确。下一题。

english: Good. Do you have everything I asked for?
translation: 好。我要的东西你都带齐了吗？

english: Good. Easter is saved.
translation: 好。复活节得救了。

english: Good. Now go to stupid small town of Falador and find there stupid spies. They threaten our mission of takin' over.
translation: 好。现在去那个愚蠢的小镇法拉多城，找到那些愚蠢的间谍。他们威胁到了我们的占领计划。

english: Good. Now go to stupid small town of Falador with this big machine thing and paint their guards!
translation: 好。现在带着这个大机器去那个愚蠢的小镇法拉多城，给他们的守卫涂上油漆！

english: Good. Now then, Easter Bunny, how do we resolve this?
translation: 好。那么，复活节兔子，我们该怎么解决这个问题？

english: Good. The general is north of Falador. Take this cannon and bring him down!
translation: 好。将军就在法拉多城北边。带上这门大炮，把他干掉！

english: Good. Then you are making progress?
translation: 好。那你正在取得进展？

english: Good. Your mission, should you one day have a choice of accepting it, is to locate and capture any Goblins you suspect of being spies.
translation: 好。你的任务，如果有一天你选择接受它，就是找到并抓捕任何你怀疑是间谍的哥布林。

english: Good. Your mission, should you one day have a choice of accepting it, is to locate and shoot paint at any Goblins you find.
translation: 好。你的任务，如果有一天你选择接受它，就是找到任何你发现的哥布林，并向他们喷射油漆。

english: Good... news?
translation: 好……消息？

english: Goodbye!|colour=yellow|shadow=yes
translation: 再见！|colour=yellow|shadow=yes

english: Goodness, no... I'm hardly the sort of chap who'd... oh, I don't know... force you to explore a haunted house, or make you fight serial killers!
translation: 天哪，不……我可不是那种会……哦，我不知道……强迫你去探索鬼屋，或者让你去对付连环杀手的人！

english: Gor blimey wot's next?
translation: 老天爷，接下来会是什么？

english: Gor.
translation: 戈。

english: Gosh I don't think I can do this.
translation: 天哪，我觉得我做不到。

english: Gosh, really? How handy.
translation: 天哪，真的吗？真方便。

english: Gosh, this amazing cook is offering to bake me a birthday cake! I could never afford that sort of thing on my squire allowance.
translation: 天哪，这位了不起的厨师主动提出要给我烤一个生日蛋糕！我靠我那点侍从津贴可永远买不起这种东西。

english: Gosh, you must love fetching things! But no, I bought one from a traveling antiques merchant in Lumbridge. It will look incredible on the lectern, and I can hide my notebook inside it.
translation: 天哪，你一定很喜欢跑腿！不过不是，我从仑桥镇一个流动古董商人那里买了一个。放在讲台上会非常好看，我还可以把我的笔记本藏在里面。

english: Got a bit heavy for the staging arena? What an unfortunate sequence of events.
translation: 对舞台竞技场来说有点太重了？多么不幸的一系列事件啊。

english: Got any eggsh mate?
translation: 有鸡蛋吗，伙计？

english: Got any spare change, mate? That stingy bloke [player name] wouldn't give me anything.
translation: 老兄，有零钱吗？那个小气鬼 [player name] 一毛钱都不肯给我。

english: Got any spare change, mate? That stingy hussy [player name] wouldn't give me anything.
translation: 老兄，有零钱吗？那个小气婆娘 [player name] 一毛钱都不肯给我。

english: Got it! I need to remove your mask!
translation: 明白了！我得摘下你的面具！

english: Got it! I'll head over there now, good luck!
translation: 明白了！我现在就过去，祝你好运！

english: Got that, a night on the town it is!
translation: 明白了，就是在城里过夜！

english: Got that, a toffee apple it is!
translation: 明白了，就是太妃糖苹果！

english: Got that, dinner it is!
translation: 明白了，就是晚餐！

english: Got yer bowl of fruit, init.
translation: 拿着你的水果碗，是吧。

english: Got you! You're not getting away this time!
translation: 抓到你了！这次你跑不掉了！

english: Got your instructions? Let's go find those targets. Let me know if you need any help.
translation: 拿到指示了？我们去找那些目标吧。需要帮忙就告诉我。

english: Graaaah! How dare you slay my creatures? But I shall not fail my master.
translation: 啊啊啊！你竟敢杀死我的生物？但我不能辜负我的主人。

english: Graardor and his forces are marching on Paddewwa.
translation: 格拉多和他的军队正在向帕德瓦进军。

english: Graardor eats a nearby ankou.
translation: 格拉多吃掉了附近的一个安库。

english: Graphical solution of mathematical problems
translation: 数学问题的图形解法

english: Grave-digging.
translation: 挖坟。

english: Grayzag rewards Gary, and departs.
translation: 格雷扎格奖励了加里，然后离开了。

english: Grayzag says I'm supposed to help you get some stuff for reopening the portal that brought you here.
translation: 格雷扎格说我应该帮你弄些东西，来重新打开把你送到这里的传送门。

english: Grayzag teleports imps in from their own realm, and as they have not yet adjusted to the unique climate we have here on RuneScape, their skin colouring is slightly darker than the 'homegrown' imps raised here.
translation: 格雷扎格从它们自己的领域传送来了小鬼，由于它们尚未适应我们符文之地独特的气候，它们的肤色比这里土生土长的小鬼要深一些。

english: Great googelies! You've made some marionettes!
translation: 天哪！你做了几个提线木偶！

english: Great idea, [player name]! Why don't you go with them back to their church and find out!
translation: 好主意，[player name]！你为什么不跟他们回教堂去看看呢！

english: Great name eh? I can tell you like it! Good taste!
translation: 好名字，对吧？我看得出来你喜欢！品味不错！

english: Great plan, so what's the magic spell you had in mind?
translation: 好计划，那你心里想的是什么魔法咒语？

english: Great stuff. I'll get right to it.
translation: 好东西。我马上开始。

english: Great stuff. Shall we get going?
translation: 好东西。我们出发吧？

english: Great work, I know you'd have it in you! Give me a moment to purify these tears and then we can continue.
translation: 干得好，我就知道你有这个本事！给我一点时间净化这些眼泪，然后我们就可以继续了。

english: Great work, now we just have to... wait... what's that?
translation: 干得好，现在我们只需要……等等……那是什么？

english: Great! Are you ready to get underway?
translation: 太好了！你准备好出发了吗？

english: Great! Better than ever, thanks to you. You gave an old lady a chance. I will be forever grateful for that.
translation: 太好了！多亏了你，比以往任何时候都好。你给了我这个老太太一个机会。我将永远感激不尽。

english: Great! He'll probably be done by now though, so you might want to pick it up!
translation: 太好了！不过他现在可能已经做好了，所以你最好去拿！

english: Great! Here you go.
translation: 太好了！给你。

english: Great! How much do you want for it?
translation: 太好了！你想卖多少钱？

english: Great! I do have one question though, you're not really a...
translation: 太好了！不过我有个问题，你该不会是个……

english: Great! I will be off then.
translation: 太好了！那我先走了。

english: Great! Is there any ingredients I can use?
translation: 太好了！有什么我可以用的材料吗？

english: Great! Just go grab all the ingredients from the basement and I'll cook it right up!
translation: 太好了！去地下室把所有材料拿来，我马上就能做好！

english: Great! Now come back to talk to me!
translation: 太好了！现在回来跟我说话吧！

english: Great! Now, there are some rocks in the middle of my warren containing an explosive mineral. Mine some, and load the blaster.
translation: 太好了！现在，我的洞穴中间有些岩石含有爆炸性矿物。去挖一些，然后装填爆破器。

english: Great! There is a staging area to the south, place the egg on the platform and pour on the growth potion.
translation: 太好了！南边有个准备区，把蛋放在平台上，然后倒上生长药水。

english: Great! We'll know if the mould is still in good condition if you can make 5 Easter eggs?
translation: 太好了！如果你能做出5个复活节彩蛋，我们就知道模具是否还能用。

english: Great! You have the Desert Clothes! Okay, here's the clothes, I won't need them anymore.
translation: 太好了！你有沙漠衣服！好了，这是衣服，我不再需要它们了。

english: Great, I hope the directions weren't too easy for you?
translation: 很好，希望这些指示对你来说不会太简单？

english: Great, I'll be right back.
translation: 好的，我马上回来。

english: Great, and don't mind the goblin, they're one of the chefs.
translation: 好的，别在意那个哥布林，他是厨师之一。

english: Great, now the bark isn't slippery anymore!
translation: 太好了，现在树皮不滑了！

english: Great, thanks kid, do you know how I can get it off her cardigan?
translation: 太好了，谢谢你孩子，你知道我怎么才能把它从她的开襟衫上弄掉吗？

english: Great, that identifies it as... something supernatural. In a world with ghosts, demons, necromancers, reanimators, homunculi and Anti-Santa, you'll have to narrow it down better.
translation: 很好，这把它鉴定为……某种超自然的东西。在一个有幽灵、恶魔、死灵法师、复生者、人造人和反圣诞老人的世界里，你得再缩小范围才行。

english: Great, that's the last of them! Come and talk to me!
translation: 太好了，这是最后一个了！过来跟我谈谈！

english: Great, that's the last one I need! May I have them?
translation: 太好了，这正是我需要的最后一个！能给我吗？

english: Great, the wilderness... I'd better be careful!
translation: 很好，荒野……我最好小心点！

english: Great, then would you like to visit Santa?
translation: 很好，那你想去拜访圣诞老人吗？

english: Great, you've collected all the chocolate kebbit chunks I'll need.
translation: 太好了，你已经收集了我需要的所有巧克力凯比特兔肉块。

english: Great. Here you go, nice and warm.
translation: 很好。给你，又暖又好。

english: Great. I've broken him. Now what? Maybe I could snap him out of it by shocking him somehow.
translation: 很好。我把他弄垮了。现在怎么办？也许我可以用某种方式电击他，让他清醒过来。

english: Green dragonhide shields.
translation: 绿龙皮盾牌。

english: Green is nice, but what about red, orange, yellow, indigo, and violet. We need some more of those!
translation: 绿色不错，但红色、橙色、黄色、靛蓝和紫色呢？我们还需要更多这些颜色！

english: Green is the colour of nature, yet green is not the natural colour of my lowly flesh. Your proposal is incoherent, unworthy of the glorious winged status you proffer me.
translation: 绿色是自然的颜色，但绿色并非我卑微肉身的天然颜色。你的提议毫无条理，配不上你赐予我的光荣有翼身份。

english: Green was the colour chosen by the armourer to honour me with.
translation: 绿色是盔甲匠选来向我致敬的颜色。

english: Greenman carvings.
translation: 绿人雕刻。

english: Grey-Haired Man was travelling to Varrock. I travelled there myself and confronted Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum about Xerna's Diadem. He claimed not to know anything, but I might want to do some investigating all the same.
translation: 灰发男子当时正前往维洛克城。我亲自去了那里，在维洛克博物馆就泽尔娜的头冠一事质问馆长海格.哈伦。他声称一无所知，但我或许还是该调查一下。

english: Grey-Haired Man was travelling to Varrock. I travelled there myself and confronted Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Museum about Xerna's Diadem. He claimed not to know anything, but I was able to steal a Storeroom Key from him which might help my investigation.
translation: 灰发男子当时正前往维洛克城。我亲自去了那里，在维洛克博物馆就泽尔娜的头冠一事质问馆长海格.哈伦。他声称一无所知，但我从他那里偷到了一把储藏室钥匙，可能对我的调查有帮助。

english: Grid Master has arrived! Time to get your game on!
translation: 网格大师来了！是时候开始你的游戏了！

english: Grim's party hasn't started yet. Besides, he's hardly going to invite a serf like you. He picks his friends carefully.
translation: 格里姆的派对还没开始。再说，他也不会邀请你这样的农奴。他挑选朋友很谨慎。

english: Grimesquit hands you a rat pole.
translation: 格里姆斯奎特递给你一根捕鼠杆。

english: Grimgnash cackles in what you can only imagine must be a griffin's laugh.
translation: 格里姆纳什发出咯咯的笑声，你只能想象那一定是狮鹫的笑声。

english: Grimsson equips his helmet.
translation: 格里姆森戴上了他的头盔。

english: Grind down the blade of your mithril two-handed sword?
translation: 磨掉你的秘银双手剑的剑刃？

english: Grip hands you a key.
translation: 格里普递给你一把钥匙。

english: Grish asks if you have the items yet.
translation: 格里什问你有没有拿到那些物品。

english: Grish shows you he has Achey tree logs and wolf bones, he starts to whittle away at them both with a knife.
translation: 格里什向你展示他有酸痛树原木和狼骨，然后开始用刀削它们。

english: Grish shows you his achievement, a rather powerful looking composite bow frame...
translation: 格里什向你展示他的成就，一个看起来相当强力的复合弓弓身……

english: Grish shows you his proud achievement...
translation: 格里什向你展示他引以为傲的成就……

translation: 地面

english: Group Teleport to the Ice Plateau!
translation: 群体传送至冰原！

english: Growing impatient and worrying about my business here I decided to leave and explore the caves on my way back.
translation: 越来越不耐烦，又担心这里的事情，我决定离开，并在回去的路上探索那些洞穴。

english: Grubfoot goes into the changing room with orange-painted goblin mail.
translation: 格拉布福特带着涂成橙色的哥布林链甲走进更衣室。

english: Grubfoot goes into the changing room, switching his orange armour to blue armour.
translation: 格拉布福特走进更衣室，把他的橙色盔甲换成了蓝色盔甲。

translation: 格伦什对玩家施法。

english: Guthix has a game... something like a chess board, upon which all destinies and actions can be played out, endlessly. When new Quests occur upon this land for people to resolve, they have already been played out a million times, for Guthixes secret purposes, before a single action has been taken. As best I understand it he uses intelligent apes (well, intelligent by ape standards) to see the outcomes of events before they occur in real life. I have no idea what the meaning of this bizarre mockery of life means, or for what purpose Guthix plays with it, but quite often I see new apes delivered to Guthixes abode, yet never do I see any leave...
translation: 古斯有一个游戏……有点像国际象棋棋盘，所有命运和行动都可以在上面无尽地演绎。当这片土地上出现新的任务供人们解决时，在任何人采取行动之前，这些任务早已为了古斯隐秘的目的被演绎了百万次。据我所知，他利用聪明的猿猴（嗯，以猿猴的标准来说很聪明）来预知事件在现实发生之前的结果。我不知道这种对生命的怪异嘲弄有何意义，也不知道古斯玩弄它的目的是什么，但我经常看到新的猿猴被送到古斯的住所，却从未见过任何一只离开……

english: Guthixes current form (I have no idea why he has chosen it personally) seems to suit him somewhat, but you should not take the value of a person (or indeed a god) by their appearance. Just as a man may be beautiful to look at yet have a soul as ugly as sin, so too may a monster have a heart of golden honour.
