english: Haven't you had enough of chocolate for now?
translation: 你现在还没吃够巧克力吗？

english: Haven't you punished me enough?
translation: 你惩罚我还不够吗？

english: Having a keg of horizon's lure on your boat will give a 2.5% boost to all Sailing experience gained.
translation: 在船上放一桶地平线的诱惑桶，将使所有航海经验获得2.5%的加成。

english: Having a keg of kraken ink stout on your boat will improve the chance of random encounters spawning at sea by 4%.
translation: 在船上放一桶克拉肯墨汁黑啤酒，将使海上随机遭遇事件的生成几率提高4%。

english: Having a keg of perildance bitter on your boat will increase the max hit of your cannons by one.
translation: 在船上放一桶佩里兰斯苦啤酒桶，将使你的大炮最大伤害增加1点。

english: Having a keg of trawler's trust on your boat will give a 5% chance to catch an extra fish whilst deep sea trawling.
translation: 在船上放一桶拖网渔夫的信赖桶，将在深海拖网捕鱼时有5%的几率多捕获一条鱼。

english: Having deciphered the Inscription, Jessamine revealed the Ruins to be called Neypotzli, with them being built to house some sort of Emissaries using the power of Earth and Streams. To locate the source of this power, Attala suggested I take some Talismans found by Jessamine to Nahta in Cam Torum's Magic Shop.
translation: 解读了铭文后，杰萨明透露这些废墟被称为内波茨利监狱，它们是为了利用大地与溪流的力量来安置某种使者而建造的。为了找到这股力量的源头，阿塔拉建议我带上杰萨明找到的一些护符，去卡姆托伦魔法商店找纳赫塔。

english: Having discovered all that you can in the ruins, you return to the crypt...
translation: 在废墟中探索完所有能发现的东西后，你回到了墓穴……

english: Hazeel and Khazard depart.
translation: 哈兹尔和卡扎德离开了。

english: Hazeel gives you some coins. They seem to be extremely ancient.
translation: 哈兹尔给了你一些金币。它们看起来非常古老。

english: Hazeel turns to look at your directly.
translation: 哈兹尔转过身来，直接看着你。

english: Hazelmere appears in front of the player.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔出现在玩家面前。

english: Hazelmere looks toward his hand at a special seed pod.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔看向他手中的一个特殊种子荚。

english: Hazelmere looks toward his hand at the seed pod, seeing it wilt.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔看向他手中的种子荚，看到它枯萎了。

english: Hazelmere uses the seed pod and a large aura surrounds the player and him.
translation: 黑兹尔米尔使用了种子荚，一道巨大的光环笼罩了玩家和他。

english: He 'had a chat' with you?
translation: 他跟你'聊了聊'？

english: He actually said it was rather boring. Nice and exotic, but boring.
translation: 他其实说那挺无聊的。虽然新奇又异域，但很无聊。

english: He also said that the rehoming event sounded like a party and that we should hold it in the Party room. He already reserved it for us!
translation: 他还说那个重新安置活动听起来像个派对，我们应该在派对厅举办。他已经帮我们预订好了！

english: He analyses your work...
translation: 他分析着你的工作……

english: He ate all the trapped souls from my refrigerator. If you collect the empty jars from the refrigerator, and go outside to the graveyard...
translation: 他把我冰箱里所有被困的灵魂都吃掉了。如果你从冰箱里收集那些空罐子，然后去外面的墓地……

english: He called it a Phantasmic Destabiliser Mark 500. I call it a Ghost Buster 500.
translation: 他称之为幻影稳定器500型。我管它叫捉鬼器500。

english: He calls himself Anti-Santa. Normally he focuses on destroying Christmas, but he gets very bored in the springtime, so he's branching out.
translation: 他自称反圣诞老人。通常他专注于破坏圣诞节，但春天他非常无聊，所以开始拓展业务了。

english: He claims it to be powerful enough to clean their armour to a perfect shade of white, when it's clearly just mulled wine mixed with holly!
translation: 他声称这东西威力强大，能把他们的盔甲洗成完美的白色，可那明明只是加了冬青的热红酒！

english: He could've been a bit more grateful.
translation: 他本可以更感激一点的。

english: He did mention that. I said I didn't want to know what he was doing with exploding swamp toads.
translation: 他确实提过。我说我不想了解他用爆炸沼泽蟾蜍在搞什么名堂。

english: He did seem rather on the fence about coming, although maybe he just doesn't have Asgarnia unlocked.
translation: 他看起来对来不来相当犹豫，不过也许只是他还没解锁阿斯加尼亚。

english: He did seem rather on the fence about coming.
translation: 他看起来对来不来相当犹豫。

english: He did, did he? Well, that's mighty convenient, isn't it?
translation: 他确实说了，是吗？哼，那可真是太方便了，不是吗？

english: He didn't sound too happy...
translation: 他听起来不太高兴……

english: He died, again? In the same spot? In the same way?
translation: 他又死了？在同一个地方？以同样的方式？

english: He doesn't seem very nice!
translation: 他看起来不太友善！

english: He failed in his tasks, and was left alive to be taken captive by my enemies. He deserves the punishment he has received.
translation: 他未能完成任务，被我的敌人活捉。他活该受到这样的惩罚。

english: He flashes a copy of a book at you titled 'McAtless's Multitude of Maps'.
translation: 他向你晃了晃一本名为《麦卡特莱斯的地图大全》的书。

english: He gave me a barcrawl card to track my progress.
translation: 他给了我一张酒吧巡游卡来记录我的进度。

english: He gave me an answer to one of the questions on the first exam.
translation: 他给了我第一次考试中一个问题的答案。

english: He gave me this note and said it would cover the cost.
translation: 他给了我这张纸条，说这能抵账。

english: He gives you the vial of ethenea.
translation: 他把那瓶乙醚给了你。

english: He gives you the vial of liquid honey.
translation: 他把那瓶液态蜂蜜给了你。

english: He gives you the vial of sulphuric broline.
translation: 他把那瓶硫酸溴林给了你。

english: He has no idea what's going to hit him!
translation: 他完全不知道即将面临什么！

english: He has some costumes that were designed for children but might be able to fit dogs with a bit of adjusting... And he knows a guy.
translation: 他有一些为儿童设计的服装，但稍加修改也许能适合狗穿……而且他认识一个人。

english: He has trade dealings with people all over the world.
translation: 他与世界各地的人都有贸易往来。

english: He hasn't told me the details yet.
translation: 他还没告诉我细节。

english: He is a curious one. Whenever he hears of interesting places, he tends to want to go there.
translation: 他是个好奇的人。每当他听说有趣的地方，就总想去看看。

english: He is a nice guy, that's true. Maybe I should come clean about it?
translation: 他是个好人，这没错。也许我应该坦白交代？

english: He is well. Defeating Jonas has really helped him return to normal. He even said he wants to go traveling now.
translation: 他很好。打败乔纳斯真的帮他恢复了正常。他甚至说现在想去旅行了。

english: He looks mad. What should you do?
translation: 他看起来很生气。你该怎么办？

english: He loves choc bombs.
translation: 他喜欢巧克力炸弹。

english: He loves you way more than he lets on. The other chest I gave you is actually from him, and the code to open it represents his feelings towards you.
translation: 他对你的爱远比他表现出来的多。我给你的另一个箱子其实是他送的，打开它的密码代表了他对你的感情。

english: He must be nearby. I'll go and fetch him.
translation: 他一定就在附近。我去找他。

english: He must have stored one of his best spells in this tablet, perhaps he has some sort of device which could utilise it?
translation: 他一定把他最好的一个法术储存在这块石板里了，也许他有什么装置能利用它？

english: He once dyed a set green in an accident with exploding swamp toads. That was quite something.
translation: 他有一次在爆炸沼泽蟾蜍的事故中把一套盔甲染成了绿色。那可真够瞧的。

english: He opened the parcel, and out fell a toy doll.
translation: 他打开包裹，掉出来一个玩具娃娃。

english: He opened the parcel, and out fell a toy doll. Derek didn't want a doll, so he threw it to the back of his toy cupboard and left it there.
translation: 他打开包裹，掉出来一个玩具娃娃。德里克不想要娃娃，就把它扔到玩具橱柜后面，丢在那里不管了。

english: He opened the parcel, and out fell...
translation: 他打开包裹，掉出来……

english: He said I should collect something from you and bring it to him, a report or something.
translation: 他说我应该从你那里拿点东西带给他，一份报告之类的。

english: He said he was organising a Halloween treat for some children, and he's got me decorating the local church crypt for it.
translation: 他说他正在为一些孩子组织万圣节款待活动，还让我为此装饰当地的教堂墓穴。

english: He said he would be able to.
translation: 他说他可以的。

english: He said we need to make an offering at the altar and gave me a riddle... A riddle is provided depending on the day, a full list can be found here.
translation: 他说我们需要在祭坛上献祭，并给了我一个谜语……谜语根据日期不同而变化，完整列表可在此处找到。

english: He scratches his head...
translation: 他挠了挠头……

english: He seems to be filling a vial with water.
translation: 他似乎在往一个小瓶里装水。

english: He seems to be mining some tin ore.
translation: 他似乎在开采一些锡矿石。

english: He seems to be mixing a potion.
translation: 他似乎在混合一种药水。

english: He seems to be moving too fast, try again when he has strumbled to a halt.
translation: 他看起来移动得太快了，等他跌跌撞撞停下来时再试一次。

english: He seems to be picking some berries.
translation: 他似乎在采摘一些浆果。

english: He seems to be picking some wheat.
translation: 他似乎在收割一些小麦。

english: He seems to be using a potion on the altar.
translation: 他似乎在祭坛上使用一种药水。

english: He seems to have a pulse.
translation: 他似乎还有脉搏。

english: He should be outside the palace. Go switfly, my friend.
translation: 他应该在宫殿外面。快去吧，我的朋友。

english: He shows you another called 'The Charlespendium of Sea Charts'.
translation: 他又给你看了另一本叫《查尔斯的海图大全》的书。

english: He shows you the bow frame and the string and after some time and a great deal of effort, he strings the composite ogre bow.
translation: 他向你展示了弓身和弓弦，经过一番时间和大量努力，他给复合食人魔弓上了弦。

english: He smells like the stray dog and always asks people for money.
translation: 他闻起来像那只流浪狗，还总是向人要钱。

english: He starts checking the steering on the cart.
translation: 他开始检查推车的转向装置。

english: He takes another bite of the meat.
translation: 他又咬了一口肉。

english: He takes out a strange looking object and hands it to you.
translation: 他拿出一个奇怪的东西，递给了你。

english: He takes the vial of ethenea from you.
translation: 他从你那里拿走了那瓶乙醚。

english: He takes the vial of liquid honey from you.
translation: 他从你那里拿走了那瓶液态蜂蜜。

english: He takes the vial of sulphuric broline from you.
translation: 他从你那里拿走了那瓶硫酸溴林。

english: He took the parcel up to his bedroom to open it, away from his parents. Up there, he shook the parcel, and heard a sound...
translation: 他把包裹拿到楼上的卧室去打开，避开他的父母。在楼上，他摇了摇包裹，听到一个声音……

english: He took the parcel up to his bedroom to open it, away from his parents. Up there, he shook the parcel, and heard the sound of childish giggling.
translation: 他把包裹拿到楼上的卧室去打开，避开他的父母。在楼上，他摇了摇包裹，听到了孩子般的咯咯笑声。

english: He tries to give you the vial of ethenea but you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 他想把那瓶乙醚给你，但你的空间不够了。

english: He tries to give you the vial of liquid honey but you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 他想把那瓶液态蜂蜜给你，但你的空间不够了。

english: He tries to give you the vial of sulphuric broline but you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 他想把那瓶硫酸溴林给你，但你的空间不够了。

english: He turned up in the summer, raving about chocolate demons and interfering adventurers, and in a moment of pity I let him into my house.
translation: 他夏天的时候出现了，滔滔不绝地讲着巧克力恶魔和多管闲事的冒险者，我一念之慈就让他进了我家。

english: He tuts to himself and starts checking the wheels.
translation: 他啧了一声，开始检查轮子。

english: He was a dude, I was a guy, can I make it any more obvious?
translation: 他是个帅哥，我是个靓仔，这还不够明显吗？

english: He was following me earlier. I'll go look for him.
translation: 他之前一直跟着我。我去找他。

english: He was going to follow me, but he must have got lost somewhere. I'll go and look for him.
translation: 他本来要跟着我的，但肯定在什么地方迷路了。我去找他。

english: He what!? Right, stay here, I'll sort this out.
translation: 他什么！？好，待在这儿，我来处理这事。

english: He wouldn't have joined me anyway. Christmas is not evil enough, apparently.
translation: 反正他也不会跟我一起。显然，圣诞节还不够邪恶。

english: He'll definitely have some knowledge about food! His shop is just south-east of here.
translation: 他肯定对食物很有研究！他的店就在这儿东南边。

english: He's a lost sheep, if so. I'll go back and look for him.
translation: 如果是这样的话，他就像一只迷路的羊。我回去找他。

english: He's a wizard who was supposed to be following me. I'll go back and fetch him.
translation: 他是个本该跟着我的魔法师。我回去找他。

english: He's busy preparing his troops. I should report back to Santa on what has occurred.
translation: 他正忙着准备他的部队。我应该回去向圣诞老人报告发生的事。

english: He's busy running another errand so I offered to help him with some deliveries.
translation: 他正忙着跑另一趟差事，所以我主动提出帮他送些货。

english: He's decorated the nearby church crypt, and he's going to read the children a story down there. A scary one.
translation: 他装饰了附近的教堂墓穴，打算在那里给孩子们读个故事。一个恐怖故事。

english: He's dropped a tooth. You grab it quickly.
translation: 他掉了一颗牙。你迅速捡了起来。

english: He's going off script.
translation: 他脱离剧本了。

english: He's made of chocolate. That means you can destroy him with the blaster. Quick - save Easter!
translation: 他是巧克力做的。这意味着你可以用爆破枪摧毁他。快——拯救复活节！

english: He's not coming back. I should head to the White Knights' castle courtyard.
translation: 他不回来了。我应该前往白骑士城堡的庭院。

english: He's not the only one...
translation: 他不是唯一一个……

english: He's operating out of our new location on Wester Island. The only way to get there is through the rabbit tunnel network.
translation: 他在我们位于西岛的新地点活动。去那里的唯一途径是通过兔子隧道网络。

english: He's planning a Halloween treat for his niece and nephew, and he thinks that crypt would be the perfect setting for it.
translation: 他正在为他的侄子和侄女计划万圣节款待活动，他认为那个墓穴是完美的地点。

english: He's standing deadly still and not responding to any attempt you make to distract or talk to him.
translation: 他一动不动地站着，对你任何试图分散他注意力或与他交谈的尝试都毫无反应。

english: He's up on the second floor on the east side of the castle.
translation: 他在城堡东侧的二楼。

english: He's upstairs on the east side of the castle, second floor.
translation: 他在城堡东侧的楼上，二楼。

english: He's... not with me. I'll go back and fetch him.
translation: 他……没跟我在一起。我回去找他。

english: He.. he.. stole it all!
translation: 他...他...全偷走了！

english: Head back down to the nest and youll see for yourself.
translation: 回到鸟巢那里，你自己看看就知道了。

english: Head to the trees on the other side of the path. I'll get ready over here.
translation: 去小路另一边的树那里。我在这边准备。

english: Hear ye! Hear ye! Come and check out the spookiest costume in town!
translation: 听好了！听好了！快来看看镇上最吓人的装扮！

english: Heard of you? You are famous in Gielinor!
translation: 听说过你？你在吉莱诺可是大名鼎鼎！

english: Hee hee, lardi da, lardi dee.
translation: 嘻嘻，啦嘀哒，啦嘀嘀。

english: Heh, heh - and when Santa asks, [player name] will testify that the money was already gone when he found the vault key.
translation: 嘿嘿——等圣诞老人问起来，[player name]会作证说，他找到金库钥匙的时候钱已经不见了。

english: Hehehe, no dearie, there's more than one way to shave a cat.
translation: 呵呵呵，亲爱的，剃猫可不只有一种方法。

english: Hello Carol.
translation: 你好，卡罗尔。

english: Hello Cecilia! How's the cleanup work going?
translation: 你好，塞西莉亚！清理工作进行得怎么样了？

english: Hello Charlie! How's life with your new dog?
translation: 你好，查理！和新狗一起生活得怎么样？

english: Hello Easter Bunny, how are you?
translation: 你好，复活节兔子，你还好吗？

english: Hello Easter Bunny. How're things?
translation: 你好，复活节兔子。最近怎么样？

english: Hello Gertrude! Any idea on which of these dogs you'd like to adopt?
translation: 你好，格特鲁德！你知道想领养哪只狗了吗？

english: Hello Gertrude! How's life with your new dog?
translation: 你好，格特鲁德！和新狗一起生活得怎么样？

english: Hello Gertrude, how are you doing?
translation: 你好，格特鲁德，你还好吗？

english: Hello Iffie! Are you here for the job?
translation: 你好，伊菲！你是来工作的吗？

english: Hello Kanel, do you know where the egg mould is?
translation: 你好，卡内尔，你知道鸡蛋模具在哪里吗？

english: Hello Larry, I was wondering if you could help me with something?
translation: 你好，拉里，我想知道你能不能帮我个忙？

english: Hello [player name]. You've come to the right place for yer greens!
translation: 你好啊 [player name]。想买蔬菜，你来对地方了！

english: Hello Ma'am, are you Iffie?
translation: 你好，女士，你是伊菲吗？

english: Hello Martin, I hear from the Easter Bunny that you are the man to talk about spices.
translation: 你好，马丁，我听复活节兔子说你是谈香料的人。

english: Hello Philop, do you know where the egg mould is?
translation: 你好，菲洛普，你知道鸡蛋模具在哪里吗？

english: Hello Sarah! Does any of these dogs catch your eye?
translation: 你好，莎拉！这些狗里有你喜欢的吗？

english: Hello Sarah! How's life with your new dog?
translation: 你好，莎拉！和新狗一起生活得怎么样？

english: Hello Shilop, do you know where the egg mould is?
translation: 你好，希洛普，你知道鸡蛋模具在哪里吗？

english: Hello Shilop, don't suppose you want to play me at egg, silk or secateurs?
translation: 你好，希洛普，你不会想跟我玩鸡蛋、丝绸还是修枝剪吧？

english: Hello Sir Vyvin!
translation: 你好，维文爵士！

english: Hello Wayne!
translation: 你好，韦恩！

english: Hello Wilough, do you know where the egg mould is?
translation: 你好，威洛，你知道鸡蛋模具在哪里吗？

english: Hello Wyson
translation: 你好，怀森

english: Hello [player name]! Are you ready for your rewards now?
translation: 你好，[player name]！准备好领取你的奖励了吗？

english: Hello [player name]! Are you ready to have a chat now?
translation: 你好，[player name]！准备好聊一聊了吗？

english: Hello [player name]! Thank you for saving the monastery, we will be forever thankful!
translation: 你好，[player name]！感谢你拯救了修道院，我们永远感激不尽！

english: Hello [player name], Merry Christmas! Did you like your present?
translation: 你好，[player name]，圣诞快乐！喜欢你的礼物吗？

english: Hello [player name], did you find the egg mould?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你找到鸡蛋模具了吗？

english: Hello [player name], have you cleaned the armour yet?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你清理好盔甲了吗？

english: Hello [player name], have you seen my egg mould anywhere?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你看到我的鸡蛋模具了吗？

english: Hello [player name], here is the report. Deliver it to Ali Morrisane without delay.
translation: 你好，[player name]，这是报告。立刻把它交给阿里.莫里桑。

english: Hello [player name], how goes the mission?
translation: 你好，[player name]，任务进行得怎么样了？

english: Hello [player name]. How is my armour coming along?
translation: 你好，[player name]。我的盔甲做得怎么样了？

english: Hello [player name]. I can't talk anymore.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我不能再多说了。

english: Hello [player name]. Lovely festival isn't it?
translation: 你好，[player name]。节日很愉快，不是吗？

english: Hello [player name]. Merry Christmas! Or, at least it would be merry...
translation: 你好，[player name]。圣诞快乐！或者，至少本该是快乐的……

english: Hello [player name]. Thank you for all your help. I have enough toys to do me. I might catch you again next year.
translation: 你好，[player name]。感谢你所有的帮助。我的玩具已经够多了。也许明年还能再见到你。

english: Hello [player name]. You've found me, well done.
translation: 你好，[player name]。你找到我了，干得好。

english: Hello [sir/madam]. Thank you for the gift!
translation: 你好，[sir/madam]。谢谢你的礼物！

english: Hello again Iffie!
translation: 又见面了，伊菲！

english: Hello again Iffie, I managed to find some cat hair.
translation: 又见面了，伊菲，我找到了一些猫毛。

english: Hello again Kanel.
translation: 又见面了，卡内尔。

english: Hello again [player name]. Come to see what's for sale?
translation: 又见面了 [player name]。来看看有什么在卖？

english: Hello again [player name]. I suppose you want a drink? Or are you going to try another scam with that terrible Askeladden again?
translation: 又见面了 [player name]。你是想喝一杯？还是又要跟那个讨厌的阿斯卡拉登搞什么新把戏？

english: Hello again Philop.
translation: 又见面了，菲洛普。

english: Hello again brother [player name]! I hope your travels have brought you wealth and joy! What compels you to visit me on this day?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]兄弟！希望你的旅途给你带来了财富和快乐！今天是什么风把你吹来了？

english: Hello again brother [player name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了，[player name]兄弟。今天需要我做什么？你随时可以信赖我的帮助！

english: Hello again sister [player name]! I hope your travels have brought you wealth and joy! What compels you to visit me on this day?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]姐妹！希望你的旅途给你带来了财富和快乐！今天是什么风把你吹来了？

english: Hello again sister [player name]. What need you of me this day? You can always rely on my assistance!
translation: 又见面了，[player name]姐妹。今天需要我做什么？你随时可以信赖我的帮助！

english: Hello again to you [player name]. How goes the hunt?
translation: 又见面了 [player name]。狩猎进行得如何？

english: Hello again to you [player name]. Us bards should stick together, what?
translation: 又见面了 [player name]。我们吟游诗人应该团结一致，对吧？

english: Hello again! Are you looking for advice or are you looking for treats?
translation: 又见面了！你是来找建议还是找点好吃的？

english: Hello again, Hotpheex.
translation: 又见面了，霍特菲克斯。

english: Hello again, Rick.
translation: 又见面了，里克。

english: Hello again, [player name]! Have you unlocked the scuffed chest yet?
translation: 又见面了，[player name]！你打开那个刮花的箱子了吗？

english: Hello again, could you remind me where to find the pumpkin lantern?
translation: 又见面了，你能再告诉我一次在哪里能找到南瓜灯笼吗？

english: Hello again, sister [player name]. If you're ready to jump aboard, we're all ready to set sail with the tide!
translation: 又见面了，[player name]姐妹。如果你准备好上船了，我们随时可以趁着潮汐起航！

english: Hello again. What should I do?
translation: 又见面了。我该做什么？

english: Hello and welcome to the Blue Moon Inn!
translation: 你好，欢迎来到蓝月旅馆！

english: Hello and welcome to the Blue Moon Inn. Can I get you something to drink?
translation: 你好，欢迎来到蓝月旅馆。要喝点什么吗？

english: Hello dearie! Are you ready to give me my reward?
translation: 你好，亲爱的！准备好给我奖励了吗？

english: Hello dearie! I'd love to go on another adventure. It's been so long!
translation: 你好，亲爱的！我真想再去冒险一次。已经好久没去了！

english: Hello dearie, are you here for another tale?
translation: 你好，亲爱的，你是来听另一个故事的吗？

english: Hello dearie, have you now? I'm surprised you even bothered.
translation: 你好，亲爱的，你现在有了？真没想到你还会费这个心。

english: Hello dearie, that looks like some interesting fabric you have there. Did you want something done with it?
translation: 你好，亲爱的，你手上那块织物看起来挺有意思的。你想拿它做点什么吗？

english: Hello human. Can I help?
translation: 你好，人类。需要帮忙吗？

english: Hello little guy, do you know where I can get some cat hair?
translation: 你好，小家伙，你知道我在哪里能弄到猫毛吗？

english: Hello ma'am!
translation: 你好，女士！

english: Hello mortal, have you found the source of this disturbance?
translation: 你好，凡人，你找到这场骚乱的源头了吗？

english: Hello mortal. I am glad you have come to see me.
translation: 你好，凡人。很高兴你来看我。

english: Hello tall one. I am waiting for Santa to bring me my presents.
translation: 你好，高个子。我在等圣诞老人给我送礼物。

english: Hello there Aggie, Martin wants to ask if you are able to dye this Fine silk red for him.
translation: 你好，阿吉，马丁想问你能否帮他把这块精美丝绸染成红色。

english: Hello there [player name]. Looking for fresh fish?
translation: 你好啊 [player name]。想找点鲜鱼？

english: Hello there [player name], I'm heading to the festival in a minute. I hope to see you there!
translation: 你好，[player name]，我马上要去参加节日了。希望在那里见到你！

english: Hello there [player name]. It's nice to see you, though things could certainly be better...
translation: 你好，[player name]。很高兴见到你，虽然情况肯定可以更好……

english: Hello there stranger.
translation: 你好，陌生人。

english: Hello there, Easter Bunny. Is everything alright?
translation: 你好，复活节兔子。一切都还好吗？

english: Hello there, that's a nice hat you've got.
translation: 你好，你戴的帽子真不错。

english: Hello there, what's this? It can only be something bad, perhaps it summons the end of the world.
translation: 你好，这是什么？肯定不是什么好东西，说不定会召唤世界末日。

english: Hello there. I just wanted to ask where I am to go next.
translation: 你好。我只是想问接下来该去哪里。

english: Hello there. You seem to be the adventury type, fancy helping me out?
translation: 你好。你看起来像是喜欢冒险的人，想帮我个忙吗？

english: Hello young sprout. How can I help you?
translation: 你好，小嫩芽。我能帮你什么？

english: Hello your majesty, I hope you're enjoying the party.
translation: 你好，陛下，希望您享受这场派对。

english: Hello! Do you happen to know anything about swapping heads with vegetables?
translation: 你好！你碰巧知道怎么把头和蔬菜互换吗？

english: Hello! How is the mining going?
translation: 你好！采矿进行得怎么样了？

english: Hello! How will we fix the picture?
translation: 你好！我们要怎么修复那幅画？

english: Hello! How's easter going?
translation: 你好！复活节过得怎么样？

english: Hello! I think that's all the eggs that the hopping one requested.
translation: 你好！我想这就是那只跳跳兔要的所有鸡蛋了。

english: Hello! I've been told we have enough eggs. Come to the workshop with me when you're ready and we'll look at the final count.
translation: 你好！我听说我们的鸡蛋够了。准备好了就跟我去工作室，我们看看最终数量。

english: Hello! It's handy that you can understand me.
translation: 你好！你能听懂我的话真是太好了。

english: Hello! Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好！圣诞快乐！

english: Hello! My name is Kit Breaker and I would like to enlist in the White Knights!
translation: 你好！我叫基特.布雷克，我想加入白骑士团！

english: Hello! My name is Kit. Kit Breaker.
translation: 你好！我叫基特。基特.布雷克。

english: Hello! The name's Kit. Kit Breaker, at your service!
translation: 你好！我叫基特。基特.布雷克，随时为您效劳！

english: Hello! Yes, I'm working on a magical ritual for which I need mementos of some skills. Firstly Magic and Runecraft. Also, perhaps you can cover Mining too?
translation: 你好！是的，我正在准备一个魔法仪式，需要一些技能的纪念品。首先是魔法和符石制作。另外，也许你也能搞定采矿？

english: Hello, Aggie. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，阿吉。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, Ali Morrisane sent me to collect a trade report.
translation: 你好，阿里.莫里桑派我来取一份贸易报告。

english: Hello, Capt' Arnav!
translation: 你好，阿纳夫船长！

english: Hello, Cecilia! We got your invitations!
translation: 你好，塞西莉亚！我们收到你的邀请函了！

english: Hello, Charlie. I have been sent by Cecilia to invite you to a rehoming event for some ownerless dogs. All the details are on the invitation.
translation: 你好，查理。塞西莉亚派我来邀请你参加一个无主狗的领养活动。所有细节都在邀请函上。

english: Hello, Charlie. I wanted to invite you to a rehoming event we're holding in the Falador Party room but it seems I've misplaced the invitation. I'll go rectify this.
translation: 你好，查理。我想邀请你参加我们在法拉多城派对厅举办的领养活动，但我好像把邀请函弄丢了。我这就去补办。

english: Hello, Doris. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，多丽丝。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, Easter Bunny!
translation: 你好，复活节兔子！

english: Hello, Fred. Is everything alright?
translation: 你好，弗雷德。一切都还好吗？

english: Hello, Gertrude. I have been sent by Cecilia to invite you to a rehoming event for some playful dogs. All the details are on the invitation.
translation: 你好，格特鲁德。塞西莉亚派我来邀请你参加一个为活泼的狗狗们举办的领养活动。所有细节都在邀请函上。

english: Hello, Gertrude. I wanted to invite you to a rehoming event we're holding in the Falador Party room but it seems I've misplaced the invitation. I'll go rectify this.
translation: 你好，格特鲁德。我本来想邀请你参加我们在法拉多城派对厅举办的领养活动，但好像把邀请函弄丢了。我这就去处理一下。

english: Hello, Hans. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，汉斯。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, Herquin. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，赫昆。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, I can't help but notice that you're made of gold?
translation: 你好，我忍不住注意到你是金子做的？

english: Hello, I have a pigment problem I was told you might be able to help with.
translation: 你好，我有个颜料方面的问题，听说你也许能帮忙。

english: Hello, I think I have a delivery for you...
translation: 你好，我想我有个东西要送给你……

english: Hello, I've not seen you around here before, who are you?
translation: 你好，我以前在这附近没见过你，你是谁？

english: Hello, Jobless Jim. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，无业的吉姆。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, Karim. I can't remember who you suggested I talk to.
translation: 你好，卡里姆。我记不清你建议我去找谁谈了。

english: Hello, Karim. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，卡里姆。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, Karim. The Easter Bunny told me to talk to you.
translation: 你好，卡里姆。复活节兔子让我来找你谈谈。

english: Hello, [player name]. I'm Caninelle Draynar and this is Pipistrelle Draynar.
translation: 你好，[player name]。我是卡尼内尔.德雷纳，这位是皮皮斯特雷尔.德雷纳。

english: Hello, My Arm
translation: 你好，"我的手臂"

english: Hello, Oziach. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，奥扎克。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, Rick.
translation: 你好，里克。

english: Hello, Rommik. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，罗米克。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, Santa says you have something to tell me.
translation: 你好，圣诞老人说你有话要告诉我。

english: Hello, Sarah. I have been sent by Cecilia to invite you to a rehoming event for some friendly pooches. All the details are on the invitation.
translation: 你好，莎拉。塞西莉亚派我来邀请你参加一个为友善的狗狗们举办的领养活动。所有细节都在邀请函上。

english: Hello, Sarah. I wanted to invite you to a rehoming event we're holding in the Falador Party room but it seems I've misplaced the invitation. I'll go rectify this.
translation: 你好，莎拉。我本来想邀请你参加我们在法拉多城派对厅举办的领养活动，但好像把邀请函弄丢了。我这就去处理一下。

english: Hello, Shantay. Could you remind me who I should talk to?
translation: 你好，沙泰。你能提醒我该去找谁吗？

english: Hello, Shantay. Karim sent me here. He said you might be able to help me with something.
translation: 你好，沙泰。卡里姆让我来这找你。他说你也许能帮我个忙。

english: Hello, Sir Amik. I have been sent by Cecilia to invite you to an adoption event for some adorable dogs. All the details are on the invitation.
translation: 你好，阿米克爵士。塞西莉亚派我来邀请你参加一个为可爱的狗狗们举办的领养活动。所有细节都在邀请函上。

english: Hello, Sir Amik. I wanted to invite you to a rehoming event we're holding in the Falador Party room but it seems I've misplaced the invitation. I'll go rectify this.
translation: 你好，阿米克爵士。我本来想邀请你参加我们在法拉多城派对厅举办的领养活动，但好像把邀请函弄丢了。我这就去处理一下。

english: Hello, Sir Prysin. Merry Christmas!
translation: 你好，普里辛爵士。圣诞快乐！

english: Hello, [player name]! Are you ready to go to my belongings?
translation: 你好，[player name]！准备好去拿我的东西了吗？

english: Hello, [player name]! Are you ready to go to see Gilbert?
translation: 你好，[player name]！准备好去见吉尔伯特了吗？

english: Hello, [player name]! Let's check if the cape is ready yet!
translation: 你好，[player name]！我们去看看披风做好了没！

english: Hello, [player name]! Let's talk to Gilbert!
translation: 你好，[player name]！我们去和吉尔伯特谈谈！

english: Hello, [player name]! Look! I can't believe it!
translation: 你好，[player name]！你看！我真不敢相信！

english: Hello, [player name], have you had time to read the Book of Ayaster yet?
translation: 你好，[player name]，你有时间读《阿亚斯特之书》了吗？

english: Hello, [player name]. Are you taking part in the cookout?
translation: 你好，[player name]。你要参加户外烹饪活动吗？

english: Hello, [player name]. I can't really talk right now sorry, I'm taking part in the cookout!
translation: 你好，[player name]。我现在真没空说话，抱歉，我正在参加户外烹饪活动呢！

english: Hello, [player name]. I'm about to start making them! Have you spoken to your contact in the crate yet?
translation: 你好，[player name]。我正要开始做呢！你和板条箱里的联系人谈过了吗？

english: Hello, [player name]! Are you ready to go to see Sir Amik?
translation: 你好，[player name]！准备好去见阿米克爵士了吗？

english: Hello, adventurer! Welcome to the party!
translation: 你好，冒险者！欢迎来到派对！

english: Hello, can you help me? Chocco has asked me to create some flavoured chocolate eggs.
translation: 你好，能帮我个忙吗？乔科让我做一些有味道的巧克力蛋。

english: Hello, have you spoken to Buoy and Gurl yet?
translation: 你好，你和浮标还有格尔谈过了吗？

english: Hello, how's the Gala?
translation: 你好，盛会怎么样？

english: Hello, human. Are you enjoying your time in Port Roberts.
translation: 你好，人类。你在罗伯特港玩得开心吗？

english: Hello, is this where the fishing contest is taking place?
translation: 你好，钓鱼大赛是在这里举行吗？

english: Hello, sir. I have been sent by Cecilia to invite you to a rehoming event for some beautiful dogs. All the details are on the invitation.
translation: 你好，先生。塞西莉亚派我来邀请你参加一个为漂亮的狗狗们举办的领养活动。所有细节都在邀请函上。

english: Hello, sir. I wanted to invite you to a rehoming event we're holding in the Falador Party room but it seems I've misplaced the invitation. I'll go rectify this.
translation: 你好，先生。我本来想邀请你参加我们在法拉多城派对厅举办的领养活动，但好像把邀请函弄丢了。我这就去处理一下。

english: Hello, this is going to sound strange but can I paint your door?
translation: 你好，这听起来可能有点奇怪，但我能给你的门刷漆吗？

english: Hello, up there!
translation: 你好，上面那位！

english: Hello, what are you doing with those eggs?
translation: 你好，你拿那些蛋做什么？

english: Hello, you look a bit worse for wear, are you okay?
translation: 你好，你看起来有点疲惫，还好吗？

english: Hello, you must be Chocco, your father asked me to assist you in creating new flavours, how can I help?
translation: 你好，你一定是乔科吧，你父亲让我来帮你创造新口味，我能做些什么？

english: Hello. Did you want something [player name]?
translation: 你好。你想要点什么吗，[player name]？

english: Hello. Err. Grim. It's me again.
translation: 你好。呃。格里姆。又是我。

english: Hello. I cooked this meal for the generals but I'm not sure if it's any good.
translation: 你好。我为将军们做了这顿饭，但我不确定好不好吃。

english: Hello. I need to make a great feast for Christmas, on behalf of the generals.
translation: 你好。我需要代表将军们为圣诞节准备一场盛宴。

english: Hello. I wonder, could you help me with a project I'm doing?
translation: 你好。我在想，你能帮我做个项目吗？

english: Hello. I would like to talk to the Sage if you don't mind?
translation: 你好。如果不介意的话，我想和智者谈谈？

english: Hello. Is everything okay? You look a little lost.
translation: 你好。一切都还好吗？你看起来有点迷茫。

english: Hello. No, sadly not.
translation: 你好。不，很遗憾没有。

english: Hello. No, sadly not. I did find this box though.
translation: 你好。不，很遗憾没有。不过我确实找到了这个盒子。

english: Hello. No, sadly not. I went to your room but couldn't find it.
translation: 你好。不，很遗憾没有。我去了你的房间，但没找到。

english: Hello? Can you hear me up there?
translation: 喂？你能听到我说话吗？

english: Hello? Can you hear me? I need help!
translation: 喂？你能听到我说话吗？我需要帮助！

english: Hello? Is this thing working?
translation: 喂？这东西能用吗？

english: Hello? This is [player name] here. What's going on?
translation: 喂？我是[player name]。发生什么事了？

english: Help me? You believe me in need of help? Do you think freedom is some precious thing to me? Vengeance perhaps?
translation: 帮我？你觉得我需要帮助？你认为自由对我来说是什么珍贵的东西吗？还是复仇？

english: Help the monks? (Start Halloween event)
translation: 帮助僧侣们？（开始万圣节活动）

english: Help you? That depends on what it is. Ask away.
translation: 帮你？那得看是什么事。说吧。

english: Hence the sticky situation!
translation: 所以才这么棘手！

english: Her name is?
translation: 她叫什么名字？

english: Here I rest the map to my beloved home. To whoever finds it, I beg of you, let it be. I was honour-bound not to destroy the map piece, but I have used all my magical skill to keep it from being recovered.
translation: 我将通往我心爱家园的地图安放于此。无论谁找到它，我恳求你，就此罢手。我因荣誉所缚不能毁掉这片地图碎片，但我已用尽所有魔法技艺，使其无法被寻回。

english: Here are some spooky things you can make a costume with.
translation: 这里有一些吓人的东西，你可以用来做一套服装。

english: Here are the other two.
translation: 这是另外两个。

english: Here boy!
translation: 过来，小家伙！

english: Here for some rope or to show me the results of your sweet plundering?
translation: 是来拿绳子，还是来给我看看你搜刮糖果的成果？

english: Here he comes, make sure to keep him busy! I'll sneak into the back and grab the stuff.
translation: 他来了，一定要拖住他！我溜到后面去拿东西。

english: Here is a magic egg. Take it into the rabbit warren. Near the light shining down from the surface is a small hole in the wall. Eat the egg in front of that and you'll be able to crawl through.
translation: 这是一个魔法蛋。把它带进兔子洞穴。在从地面照下来的光附近，墙上有个小洞。在那前面吃掉这个蛋，你就能爬过去了。

english: Here is my card, sir.
translation: 这是我的名片，先生。

english: Here is the armour.
translation: 盔甲在这里。

english: Here is the camel milk.
translation: 骆驼奶在这里。

english: Here is the festive cinnamon as promised.
translation: 这是答应给你的节日肉桂。

english: Here is the festive white wine you wanted. I hope you enjoy it!
translation: 这是你要的节日白葡萄酒。希望你喜欢！

english: Here is yer first clue.
translation: 这是你的第一条线索。

english: Here is your drink. Enjoy!
translation: 这是你的饮料。请享用！

english: Here is your meal. Enjoy!
translation: 这是你的餐点。请享用！

english: Here it is again! Listen very carefully.
translation: 又来了！非常仔细地听。

english: Here it is, well deserved! I've thrown in a few extras for you too as an extra thanks.
translation: 给你，这是你应得的！我还额外给你加了一些东西，聊表谢意。

english: Here take this box. Bring it back to me when you've filled it.
translation: 拿着这个盒子。装满后带回来给我。

english: Here we go again.
translation: 又来了。

english: Here we go. I'd probably wear gloves if I were you.
translation: 给你。我要是你的话，可能会戴上手套。

english: Here you go [player name]. Use it well.
translation: 给你，[player name]。好好利用它。

english: Here you go! Be careful with it.
translation: 给你！小心点。

english: Here you go, enjoy! It's a good advert if I say so myself.
translation: 给你，好好享用吧！不是我自夸，这广告做得不错。

english: Here you go, have an Easter egg!
translation: 给你，拿一个复活节彩蛋吧！

english: Here you go, look after them.
translation: 给你，好好照顾它们。

english: Here you go, one time bubble.
translation: 给你，一个时间泡泡。

english: Here you go, you better take this back to the Easter Bunny on the double.
translation: 给你，你最好马上把这个带回给复活节兔子。

english: Here you go. Eat it in front of the tunnel near where you enter the warren.
translation: 给你。在进入洞穴附近的隧道前吃掉它。

english: Here you go. Hopefully they are acceptable as a reward!
translation: 给你。希望这些作为奖励你能接受！

english: Here you go. I got this incantation from a witch named Eve.
translation: 给你。我从一个叫夏娃的女巫那里得到了这个咒语。

english: Here's 750,000 coins.
translation: 这里是75万金币。

english: Here's a load of roots for you, Diango!
translation: 迪亚戈，这是一大堆树根给你！

english: Here's a reward for all the help you've given me.
translation: 这是给你所有帮助的奖励。

english: Here's the gem.
translation: 宝石在这里。

english: Here's your paint.
translation: 这是你的油漆。

english: Here's your reward. I have the usual deal with Diango, so if you lose it, he'll give you another.
translation: 这是你的奖励。我和迪亚戈有老规矩，所以如果你弄丢了，他会再给你一个。

english: Here's your sword.
translation: 这是你的剑。

english: Here, boy! Want a snack?
translation: 过来，小子！想吃点零食吗？

english: Here, have this. It will get you out.
translation: 拿着这个，它能帮你出去。

english: Here, take these as a reward.
translation: 来，这些是给你的奖励。

english: Here, take this as my appreciation for your help!
translation: 拿着，这是我感谢你帮忙的一点心意！

english: Here, take this note which lists the locations of the reported sightings. It should prove useful.
translation: 拿着这张纸条，上面列出了目击报告的地点。应该会有用。

english: Here, these can be made into a perfectly servicable snow imp costume. They just need some snow.
translation: 这些可以做成一套很不错的雪人小恶魔服装。只需要加点雪就行了。

english: Here, you can borrow my tinderbox.
translation: 来，你可以借用我的火绒盒。

english: Herman talks about the Wise Old Man's adventures.
translation: 赫尔曼讲述着智者老人的冒险故事。

english: Heroes!
translation: 英雄们！

english: Herquin hands you a fresh festive gingerbread gnome. Yum.
translation: 赫昆递给你一个新鲜的节日姜饼地精。真好吃。

english: Herquin hands you the festive cinnamon.
translation: 赫昆把节日肉桂递给你。

english: Herquin polishes the gem for you.
translation: 赫昆为你打磨了宝石。

english: Het and the player return to the Nexus
translation: 赫特和玩家返回枢纽

english: Hetty gives you her spare cauldron.
translation: 赫蒂把她备用的坩埚给了你。

english: Hetty lent us a cauldron.
translation: 赫蒂借给了我们一个坩埚。

english: Hetty mutters to herself.
translation: 赫蒂喃喃自语。

english: Hey Diango! I've come to collect the toys.
translation: 嘿，迪亚戈！我来拿玩具了。

english: Hey Diango, I need the key to Santa's Grotto. Can you give it to me please?
translation: 嘿，迪亚戈，我需要圣诞老人洞穴的钥匙。能给我吗？

english: Hey Diango, can I ask you a question?
translation: 嘿，迪亚戈，我能问你个问题吗？

english: Hey Iffie!
translation: 嘿，伊菲！

english: Hey Iffie, what's the plan?
translation: 嘿，伊菲，计划是什么？

english: Hey Karim, I've accidently lost the special super hot kebab.
translation: 嘿，卡里姆，我不小心把特制超辣烤肉弄丢了。

english: Hey Larry, I've spoken to Buoy and Gurl! I'm going to make them both a snowman!
translation: 嘿，拉里，我跟布伊和格尔谈过了！我要给他们俩各做一个雪人！

english: Hey Mizgog! I found Eve.
translation: 嘿，米兹戈格！我找到夏娃了。

english: Hey Osman, I-
translation: 嘿，奥斯曼，我——

english: Hey Romeo, why aren't you at the birthday event?
translation: 嘿，罗密欧，你怎么没去参加生日活动？

english: Hey Santa, how's it going?
translation: 嘿，圣诞老人，最近怎么样？

english: Hey Wilough, fancy another game of egg, silk or secateurs?
translation: 嘿，威洛，想再玩一次鸡蛋、丝绸还是修枝剪的游戏吗？

english: Hey [player name]! Are you going to the festival? I'm heading there now with my gingerbread gnomes!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！你要去参加节日吗？我现在正带着我的姜饼地精往那边走呢！

english: Hey [player name]! Are you going to the festival? I'm heading there now. I'll be at the grotto!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！你要去参加节日吗？我现在正往那边走。我会在洞穴那里！

english: Hey [player name]! I hope you liked your present. Merry Christmas!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！希望你喜欢你的礼物。圣诞快乐！

english: Hey [player name]! I'm going to the festival now, hopefully I'll see you there!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！我现在要去参加节日了，希望能在那儿见到你！

english: Hey [player name]! Make sure to stop by my stall at the festival. I'll give you some mulled wine!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！记得在节日上光顾我的摊位。我会给你一些热红酒！

english: Hey [player name]! Make sure to stop by my stall at the festival. I'll have some gingerbread gnomes for you!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！记得在节日上光顾我的摊位。我会给你准备一些姜饼地精！

english: Hey [player name]! Thank you for finding those chocolate chips for me. The gingerbread gnomes are coming along nicely!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！谢谢你帮我找到那些巧克力片。姜饼地精做得越来越好了！

english: Hey [player name]! Thank you for helping me with the presents, I was really stuck with those riddles!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！谢谢你帮我处理礼物，那些谜语真的把我难住了！

english: Hey [player name]! Thank you for making those snowmen. Buoy and Gurl had a lovely time!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！谢谢你做了那些雪人。布伊和格尔玩得很开心！

english: Hey [player name]. Glad everything went okay at Baxtorian [player name].
translation: 嘿 [player name]。很高兴巴克斯托里安那边一切顺利，[player name]。

english: Hey again, Eve.
translation: 又见面了，夏娃。

english: Hey great, there's my Mum!
translation: 嘿，太好了，我妈妈在那儿！

english: Hey man, it's Christmas.
translation: 嘿，老兄，现在是圣诞节了。

english: Hey partner, looks like you've done some hard work since I last saw you. Hope you like your reward. You've earned it!
translation: 嘿，伙伴，看来从我上次见到你之后，你干了不少苦活。希望你喜欢你的奖励。这是你应得的！

english: Hey there, I don't suppose that's your friend over there?
translation: 嘿，那边那个该不会是你的朋友吧？

english: Hey there, did you get your T.R.A.S.H?
translation: 嘿，你拿到你的 T.R.A.S.H 了吗？

english: Hey there. I'm looking for someone who bought some Quality Violet Tulip seeds.
translation: 嘿，你好。我在找一个买了优质紫罗兰郁金香种子的人。

english: Hey thief! I's gonna teach ya!
translation: 嘿，小偷！我要教训你！

english: Hey what are you doing with those eggs?
translation: 嘿，你拿那些鸡蛋干什么？

english: Hey! A scorpion is in here!
translation: 嘿！这里面有只蝎子！

english: Hey! Could you go please go and find out who is that suspicious individual that is scoffing all the deviled eggs?
translation: 嘿！你能去查查那个狼吞虎咽吃魔鬼蛋的可疑家伙是谁吗？

english: Hey! Don't give up quite yet. I'm sure we can find a way.
translation: 嘿！别这么快就放弃。我相信我们总能找到办法的。

english: Hey! I got the costume ready!
translation: 嘿！我把服装准备好了！

english: Hey! I heard from several people you guys were out trick or treating earlier in Lumbridge, stop playing around and let him go!
translation: 嘿！我听好几个人说你们之前在仑桥镇玩不给糖就捣蛋，别闹了，快放了他！

english: Hey! It's [player name]! Let me buy you a drink!
translation: 嘿！是 [player name]！让我请你喝一杯！

english: Hey! So, how bad is it this year?
translation: 嘿！那么，今年有多糟糕？

english: Hey! Thanks for the help! You did an eggselent job.
translation: 嘿！谢谢你的帮助！你干得棒极了。

english: Hey! That wasn't the god you chose.
translation: 嘿！那不是你选择的神。

english: Hey, Easter Bunny!
translation: 嘿，复活节兔子！

english: Hey, Easter Bunny, I had the churn, and it was frozen, but I've lost it!
translation: 嘿，复活节兔子，我拿到了搅拌器，但它冻住了，可我又把它弄丢了！

english: Hey, Easter Bunny, I have the churn, and it's frozen!
translation: 嘿，复活节兔子，我拿到了搅拌器，而且它已经冻住了！

english: Hey, Easter Bunny, I've got an ice cooler ready for the eggs.
translation: 嘿，复活节兔子，我已经准备好了一个冰桶来装鸡蛋。

english: Hey, Easter Bunny, how are the Easter Eggs coming along?
translation: 嘿，复活节兔子，复活节彩蛋做得怎么样了？

english: Hey, Easter Bunny. I have news.
translation: 嘿，复活节兔子。我有消息。

english: Hey, Easter Bunny. I have some information!
translation: 嘿，复活节兔子。我有一些情报！

english: Hey, Gnome Child, you wanted to meet Bob, and here's Bob.
translation: 嘿，地精小孩，你想见鲍勃，这就是鲍勃。

english: Hey, Grim, this serf of yours is behaving awfully strangely! Teach [him/her] a lesson, will you?
translation: 嘿，格里姆，你的这个农奴行为非常古怪！教训教训[him/her]，好吗？

english: Hey, I can't let you take that sack out of here.
translation: 嘿，我不能让你把那袋东西带出去。

english: Hey, I don't suppose you'd like to come to the pride march with me? I wrote a poem for you too...
translation: 嘿，你愿意和我一起去参加骄傲游行吗？我还为你写了一首诗……

english: Hey, I have space for that bucket now.
translation: 嘿，我现在有地方放那个桶了。

english: Hey, I knew you seemed cool when I met you [player name]!
translation: 嘿，我当初见到你的时候就感觉你挺酷的，[player name]！

english: Hey, I need your help! A new player has been captured by some goblins over at the watermill!
translation: 嘿，我需要你的帮助！一个新玩家被水车那边的几个哥布林抓住了！

english: Hey, I wanted to ask about hats...
translation: 嘿，我想问问关于帽子的事……

english: Hey, I'm in the southern chamber now, if you're looking for me. This is where I'll want to set up the lectern.
translation: 嘿，我现在在南边的密室，如果你在找我的话。我打算在这里放讲台。

english: Hey, I'm ready for the milk now.
translation: 嘿，我已经准备好要牛奶了。

english: Hey, I'm ready for the notes now!
translation: 嘿，我现在准备好要笔记了！

english: Hey, I'm working on it, and I'm always looking for a few bad men (and women - especially women; I have a reputation to maintain) to help me achieve my goals.
translation: 嘿，我正在努力，而且我一直在寻找一些坏男人（和女人——尤其是女人；我得维护我的名声）来帮我实现目标。

english: Hey, I've made the ice cream!
translation: 嘿，我做好冰淇淋了！

english: Hey, I-
translation: 嘿，我——

english: Hey, [player name]! Go buy your own beer! That keg belongs to me!
translation: 嘿，[player name]！自己去买你的啤酒！那个酒桶是我的！

english: Hey, My Arm.
translation: 嘿，"我的手臂"。

english: Hey, Scrubfoot. How did you make it up here so fast?
translation: 嘿，斯克鲁布福特。你怎么这么快就到这儿了？

english: Hey, [player name]. Do you have some time to help me now?
translation: 嘿，[player name]。你现在有时间帮我吗？

english: Hey, [player name]. How is the experiment going?
translation: 嘿，[player name]。实验进行得怎么样了？

english: Hey, [player name]. I'm glad I changed my mind and helped you out. You won!
translation: 嘿，[player name]。我很高兴我改变了主意帮了你。你赢了！

english: Hey, [player name]. Well done on winning the contest. I'd have never thought of a banana pizza, let alone a burnt one!
translation: 嘿，[player name]。恭喜你赢得了比赛。我绝对想不到香蕉披萨，更别说是烤焦的了！

english: Hey, don't I know you from the Hemenster fishing contest?
translation: 嘿，我是不是在赫门斯特钓鱼大赛上见过你？

english: Hey, have you seen two goblins passing by here?
translation: 嘿，你看到两个哥布林经过这里吗？

english: Hey, hey, it's Christmas! Let's be nice. You both have three, that is more than enough. No need to argue.
translation: 嘿，嘿，现在是圣诞节！大家都和气点。你们俩都有三个了，这已经足够了。别吵了。

english: Hey, let me pass through this gate.
translation: 嘿，让我通过这扇门。

english: Hey, look over there! (Distract and sneak away).
translation: 嘿，看那边！（分散注意力然后溜走）。

english: Hey, me too!
translation: 嘿，我也是！

english: Hey, serf, what are you doing to the fire?
translation: 嘿，农奴，你在对火做什么？

english: Hey, serf, what are you doing with the refrigerator?
translation: 嘿，农奴，你在对冰箱做什么？

english: Hey, serf, what business have you in there?
translation: 嘿，农奴，你进去有什么事？

english: Hey, that's my stuff!
translation: 嘿，那是我的东西！

english: Hey, the game hasn't started yet.
translation: 嘿，比赛还没开始呢。

english: Hey, the snowmen are both finished. Buoy and Gurl are now happily decorating them!
translation: 嘿，两个雪人都做好了。布伊和格尔正在开心地装饰它们！

english: Hey, there are, I just don't take much interest in them as they seem to be immune to my 'charms'.
translation: 嘿，确实有，我只是对她们不太感兴趣，因为她们似乎对我的‘魅力’免疫。

english: Hey, these are my trees. Your ones are on the other side of the path.
translation: 嘿，这些是我的树。你的那些在小路另一边。

english: Hey, this is a bit of a long shot, but have you seen a seagull carrying a small green conical hat?
translation: 嘿，虽然希望不大，但你有没有看到一只海鸥叼着一顶小小的绿色锥形帽？

english: Hey, those eggs aren't just for you!
translation: 嘿，那些鸡蛋不只是给你的！

english: Hey, we're looking for a powerful magician, would you happen to know any?
translation: 嘿，我们在找一个强大的魔法师，你碰巧认识谁吗？

english: Hey, you can only use that if you're taking part in the cookout!
translation: 嘿，只有参加户外烹饪活动的人才能用那个！

english: Hey, you found me! Nice work.
translation: 嘿，你找到我了！干得好。

english: Hey, you need a Treat cauldron to deposit treats from! Come speak to me if you need one.
translation: 嘿，你需要一个糖果埚来存放糖果！如果你需要的话，来找我。

english: Hey, you've already taken part in the cookout! You don't need to use that anymore.
translation: 嘿，你已经参加过户外烹饪活动了！你不再需要那个了。

english: Hey, your cart has no donkey!
translation: 嘿，你的推车没有驴！

english: Hey, your friends wanted me to let you know they're done with their poetry.
translation: 嘿，你的朋友们让我告诉你，他们的诗写完了。

english: Hhuh?
translation: 哈？

english: Hi Ali.
translation: 嗨，阿里。

english: Hi Benny, I'd like to place an ad please! Specifically an LFG ad.
translation: 嗨，班尼，我想刊登一则广告！具体来说是找队友的广告。

english: Hi Benny, I'm ready to finish the advert now.
translation: 嗨，班尼，我准备好完成广告了。

english: Hi Capt' Arnav, I have your treasure chest!
translation: 嗨，阿纳夫船长，我找到你的宝箱了！

english: Hi Capt' Arnav... I have lost the clue you gave me.
translation: 嗨，阿纳夫船长……我弄丢了你给我的线索。

english: Hi Cecilia!
translation: 嗨，塞西莉亚！

english: Hi Cecilia. Merry Christmas. The festival looks great!
translation: 嗨，塞西莉亚。圣诞快乐。这个节日看起来真棒！

english: Hi Diango, Fred the Farmer sent me. He's been decorating for the Spook-a-thon contest and said you might have a spooky pumpkin lantern?
translation: 嗨，迪亚戈，是农夫弗雷德让我来的。他正在为惊吓马拉松比赛布置装饰，他说你可能有幽灵南瓜灯笼？

english: Hi Eluned, could you enchant some of my teleport crystals?
translation: 嗨，埃卢内德，你能帮我附魔一些传送水晶吗？

english: Hi Herquin! How are the festive gingerbread gnomes doing?
translation: 嗨，赫昆！节日姜饼地精们怎么样了？

english: Hi Iffie!
translation: 嗨，伊菲！

english: Hi Iffie, I'm really sorry, but I lost my cat ears.
translation: 嗨，伊菲，真的很抱歉，但我弄丢了我的猫耳。

english: Hi Karim, I'm here for the kebab.
translation: 嗨，卡里姆，我来拿烤肉。

english: Hi Karim, could I buy a special kebab?
translation: 嗨，卡里姆，我能买一份特制烤肉吗？

english: Hi Larry! I can smell the festive mulled wine from across the festival!
translation: 嗨，拉里！我隔着整个节日都能闻到节日热红酒的香味！

english: Hi Larry.
translation: 嗨，拉里。

english: Hi Wayne!
translation: 嗨，韦恩！

english: Hi Wyson!
translation: 嗨，怀森！

english: Hi [player name]! Are you enjoying the festival?
translation: 嗨，[player name]！你喜欢这个节日吗？

english: Hi [player name]! How are you doing? Enjoying the festival?
translation: 嗨，[player name]！你还好吗？享受节日吗？

english: Hi [player name]! Nice to see you here.
translation: 嗨，[player name]！很高兴在这里见到你。

english: Hi [player name], have you found my associate yet?
translation: 嗨，[player name]，你找到我的同伴了吗？

english: Hi [player name], how goes it?
translation: 嗨，[player name]，最近怎么样？

english: Hi [player name], will you help me now? The Christmas festival depends on it!
translation: 嗨，[player name]，你现在能帮我了吗？圣诞节活动就靠它了！

english: Hi [player name], you came to the festival!
translation: 嗨，[player name]，你来参加节日了！

english: Hi [player name]. I didn't think you'd find me!
translation: 嗨，[player name]。我没想到你能找到我！

english: Hi [player name]. I hope to see you at the Christmas festival!
translation: 嗨，[player name]。我希望能在这个圣诞节活动上见到你！

english: Hi [player name]. I hope to see you at the festival!
translation: 嗨，[player name]。我希望能在这个节日上见到你！

english: Hi [player name]. Merry Christmas! Thanks for visiting me at the grotto, I hope you liked your present!
translation: 嗨，[player name]。圣诞快乐！谢谢你到洞穴来看我，希望你喜欢你的礼物！

english: Hi [player name]... I'm so sad, my life is over!
translation: 嗨，[player name]……我好难过，我的人生完了！

english: Hi again [player name]! What can I do for you?
translation: 又见面了 [player name]！有什么能为你效劳的？

english: Hi again, Scrubfoot.
translation: 又见面了，斯克鲁布福特。

english: Hi again. Are you still enjoying Christmas?
translation: 又见面了。你还在享受圣诞节吗？

english: Hi again. Do you have anything for me for helping you out with Christmas?
translation: 又见面了。我帮你解决了圣诞节的事，你有什么要给我的吗？

english: Hi buddy! Or do ya want me to call ya [player name] now?
translation: 嗨，哥们！还是说你现在想让我叫你 [player name]？

english: Hi cook!
translation: 嗨，厨师！

english: Hi human, My Arm running cookout competition. If you want to take part, talk to Hassan in big palace.
translation: 嗨，人类，'我的手臂'在办烹饪比赛。如果你想参加，去大宫殿找哈桑。

english: Hi human. My Arm still like your cooking. I write it down for make again later.
translation: 嗨，人类。'我的手臂'还是喜欢你的烹饪。我把它记下来，以后再做。

english: Hi there Herquin!
translation: 嗨，赫昆！

english: Hi there Iffie!
translation: 嗨，伊菲！

english: Hi there [player name]. I am Falo the bard! Like my brother Olaf, who lives in Rellekka, I also write music.
translation: 你好啊 [player name]。我是吟游诗人法洛！和我住在雷勒卡城的兄弟奥拉夫一样，我也创作音乐。

english: Hi there [player name]! Have you come to visit Santa?
translation: 嗨，[player name]！你是来看圣诞老人的吗？

english: Hi there [player name], are you ready to talk some more?
translation: 嗨，[player name]，你准备好再聊聊了吗？

english: Hi there [player name], is there anything I can help you with?
translation: 嗨，[player name]，有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Hi there! What are you doing in there?
translation: 嗨！你在里面做什么？

english: Hi there! Yes I saw them heading towards Bob's Axes. They looked rather funny in those costumes!
translation: 嗨！是的，我看到他们朝鲍勃的斧头店去了。他们穿着那些戏服看起来真滑稽！

english: Hi there! Yes I saw them heading towards Bob's Axes. They looked rather funny in those sheets!
translation: 嗨！是的，我看到他们朝鲍勃的斧头店去了。他们裹着那些床单看起来真滑稽！

english: Hi there, Ali!
translation: 嗨，阿里！

english: Hi there, Capt' Arnav!
translation: 嗨，阿纳夫船长！

english: Hi there, I'm looking for some clues regarding two goblins dressed as ghosts!
translation: 嗨，我在找关于两个扮成幽灵的地精的线索！

english: Hi there, fellow goblins! it's me, your goblin friend!
translation: 嗨，各位地精同胞！是我，你们的地精朋友！

english: Hi! Are you enjoying the party?
translation: 嗨！你喜欢这个派对吗？

english: Hi! I just received some interesting news from people around Lumbridge.
translation: 嗨！我刚从仑桥镇附近的人那里听到一些有趣的消息。

english: Hi! I saw them heading towards the church and then towards the general store.
translation: 嗨！我看到他们朝教堂走去，然后又去了杂货店。

english: Hi! I'm Party Pete. Welcome to the Party Room and happy birthday!
translation: 嗨！我是派对皮特。欢迎来到派对室，生日快乐！

english: Hi! Thanks for your help earlier, I hope you enjoyed your meal.
translation: 嗨！谢谢你之前的帮忙，希望你喜欢你的餐点。

english: Hi! Yes, I saw them around the Lumbridge Castle kitchen.
translation: 嗨！是的，我在仑桥镇城堡厨房附近看到过他们。

english: Hi! You can call me Mo, I'm a travelling trader and I've just relocated to Lumbridge.
translation: 嗨！你可以叫我小莫，我是个旅行商人，刚搬到仑桥镇。

english: Hi, Capt' Arnav.
translation: 嗨，阿纳夫船长。

english: Hi, Easter Bunny.
translation: 嗨，复活节兔子。

english: Hi, Hans!
translation: 嗨，汉斯！

english: Hi, I don't think I've seen someone like you before. What are you?
translation: 嗨，我以前好像没见过你这样的人。你是什么？

english: Hi, I need to talk to you about chicken cages!
translation: 嗨，我需要跟你谈谈鸡笼的事！

english: Hi, I was wondering if you could make me a new kind of potion with some ingredients I'm carrying.
translation: 嗨，我在想你能不能帮我用我带的材料做一种新药水。

english: Hi, [player name], you should speak with Burgher Mawnis Burowgar in the main chambers. Do you have any questions?
translation: 嗨，[player name]，你应该去主厅跟市民莫尼斯.布罗加谈谈。你有什么问题吗？

english: Hi, [player name], you should speak with King Sorvott in the main chambers.
translation: 嗨，[player name]，你应该去主厅跟索沃特国王谈谈。

english: Hi, My Arm! I'd like to ask you a question if that is okay?
translation: 嗨，'我的手臂'！如果可以的话，我想问你一个问题？

english: Hi, Sarah! Fred sent me. He's entering the Spook-a- thon and needs some decorations.
translation: 嗨，莎拉！弗雷德派我来的。他要参加惊吓马拉松，需要一些装饰品。

english: Hi, Sir Vyvin!
translation: 嗨，维文爵士！

english: Hi, [player name]. How is it going? Found anything out yet?
translation: 嗨，[player name]。怎么样了？查出什么了吗？

english: Hi, [player name]. I see you've joined the cookout!
translation: 嗨，[player name]。我看到你加入烹饪比赛了！

english: Hi, [player name]. I'm a bit busy at the moment, I'm taking part in the cookout!
translation: 嗨，[player name]。我现在有点忙，我在参加烹饪比赛！

english: Hi, [player name]. Thanks again for all the help. Are the rewards I gave you okay?
translation: 嗨，[player name]。再次感谢你的所有帮助。我给你的奖励还满意吗？

english: Hi, [player name]. You found a way to make the banana more exciting, while keeping it exotic. I'm impressed!
translation: 嗨，[player name]。你找到了让香蕉更刺激的方法，同时又保持了它的异域风情。我印象深刻！

english: Hi, could you help me cheer up Juliet?
translation: 嗨，你能帮我让朱丽叶开心起来吗？

english: Hi, er, your falcon ran away.
translation: 嗨，呃，你的猎鹰跑了。

english: Hi, excuse me, I-
translation: 嗨，打扰一下，我——

english: Hi, expecting a delivery from Little Mo?
translation: 嗨，在等小莫送货吗？

english: Hi, have you seen two goblins in ghost costumes nearby?
translation: 嗨，你附近有没有看到两个穿着幽灵服装的地精？

english: Hi, sailor. How can I help you?
translation: 嗨，水手。有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: Hi. Have you delivered the armour to Sir Vyvin yet?
translation: 嗨。你把盔甲交给维文爵士了吗？

english: Hi. Thanks for giving the armour back to Sir Vyvin. You really saved the day!
translation: 嗨。谢谢你把盔甲还给维文爵士。你真的救了场！

english: Hi. Who are you?
translation: 嗨。你是谁？

english: Hic senex, ludavit unum...
translation: 这位老人，玩了一个……

english: Hickton has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 希克顿又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Hidden inside a vial you find a copy of Fairy Nuff's certificate, but you don't have space to take it.
translation: 你在一个小瓶里发现了一份仙子努夫的证书副本，但你没有空间拿它。

english: Hidden inside a vial you find a copy of Fairy Nuff's certificate.
translation: 你在一个小瓶里发现了一份仙子努夫的证书副本。

english: Hidden passage.
translation: 隐藏通道。

english: Hide and seek.
translation: 捉迷藏。

english: Hild gives you the enchanted amulet.
translation: 希尔德给了你附魔护身符。

english: His clothes
translation: 他的衣服

english: His father's shoes
translation: 他父亲的鞋子

english: His fault we lose! No style!
translation: 都怪他我们才输！没品位！

english: His fault we lose! No taste!
translation: 都怪他我们才输！没格调！

english: His head and chest inflates before popping into a variety of desserts that go flying everywhere.
translation: 他的头和胸部膨胀起来，然后爆裂成各种甜点，飞得到处都是。

english: His mother doing some tidying
translation: 他母亲在收拾东西

english: His toys
translation: 他的玩具

english: Hitpoints please!
translation: 请加生命值！

english: Hiya, I wrote this poem for you to ask you to come with me to the pride march.
translation: 嗨呀，我写了这首诗给你，想邀请你和我一起去参加骄傲游行。

english: Hm, now I think about it, I'm fairly sure I've seen you around before.
translation: 嗯，现在我想想，我很确定我以前见过你。

english: Hm... I see your point.
translation: 嗯……我明白你的意思了。

english: Hm... that depends, what do you need?
translation: 嗯……那要看情况，你需要什么？

english: Hm... this might be a problem. [player name], would you mind helping pair these people to their new friends for life?
translation: 嗯……这可能是个问题。[player name]，你介意帮忙把这些人和他们的新终身朋友配对吗？

english: Hm... well, I did throw out a vat like this one, that'll easily hold all the milk you could put in it.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我确实扔掉了一个像这样的大桶，它绝对能装下你放进去的所有牛奶。

english: Hm? Oh, I'm sure it's nothing. Anyway, here we go...
translation: 嗯？哦，我肯定没什么。总之，我们开始吧……

english: Hm? You no sound like goblin. Also, why are you tall like tree?
translation: 嗯？你听起来不像地精。还有，你为什么像树一样高？

english: Hmm I can't decide, they're all such fine choices. You are going to have to choose for me my friend! Just pick something that typically says 'royalty'. What sort of dog would a lord or even a monarch have?
translation: 嗯，我拿不定主意，每个选择都这么好。你得替我选一个，朋友！就挑那种一看就透着'皇家气派'的。领主甚至君主会养什么样的狗呢？

english: Hmm I saw some eggs trying to burrow into the ground, they could be hiding like that till we leave.
translation: 嗯，我看到有些蛋想往土里钻，它们可能就这样躲着，直到我们离开。

english: Hmm I see. Where would you like to meet your potential candidates?
translation: 嗯，我明白了。你想在哪儿见那些可能的候选人？

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Crunchy flavours could be created with some rock! You could find some piled up on the surface.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些岩石就能做出酥脆口味！你可以在表面找到一些堆起来的。

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Fish flavours could be created with some wester fish! You could find some in the larder.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些西部鱼就能做出鱼味！你可以在食品储藏柜里找到一些。

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Fluffy flavours could be created with some feathers! You could find some on the chicken that runs around to the south west of here.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些羽毛就能做出蓬松口味！你可以在西南边跑来跑去的那只鸡身上找到一些。

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Meaty flavours could be created with some beef fillet! You could find some in the larder.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些牛里脊就能做出肉味！你可以在食品储藏柜里找到一些。

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Rich flavours could be created with some gold! You could find some by speaking to Goldie to the south east of here.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些金子就能做出浓郁口味！你可以在东南边跟戈尔迪说话找到一些。

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Salty flavours could be created with some sea salt! You could find some on the storage shelves nearby.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些海盐就能做出咸味！你可以在附近的储物架上找到一些。

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Smoked flavours could be created with some ashes! You could find some in the oven furnace.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些灰烬就能做出烟熏味！你可以在烤箱熔炉里找到一些。

english: Hmm now, let me think... Oh yes! Spicy flavours could be created with some spices! You could find some on the storage shelves nearby.
translation: 嗯，让我想想……哦对了！用些香料就能做出辣味！你可以在附近的储物架上找到一些。

english: Hmm okay. Well, I have one goblin mail now. I can ask for another one next year, and one the year after.
translation: 嗯，好吧。我现在有一件哥布林链甲了。明年可以再要一件，后年再要一件。

english: Hmm that's not quite what I had in mind, could you try again? I'd like the lovely small one with the present box on its head!
translation: 嗯，这跟我想的不太一样，你能再试试吗？我想要那个可爱的小家伙，头上顶着礼物盒的那个！

english: Hmm, I already have one of those.
translation: 嗯，我已经有一个了。

english: Hmm, I don't know. Maybe it's time for one of your mum's snacks.
translation: 嗯，我不知道。也许是时候尝尝你妈妈做的小吃了。

english: Hmm, I think I'll pass.
translation: 嗯，我想还是算了。

english: Hmm, I will have a look around. Again, thank you very much!
translation: 嗯，我四处看看。再次非常感谢你！

english: Hmm, I'll probe no further.
translation: 嗯，我不再追问了。

english: Hmm, I'll see what he has to say.
translation: 嗯，我去听听他怎么说。

english: Hmm, I'm interested in a boat trip.
translation: 嗯，我对乘船旅行感兴趣。

english: Hmm, I'm not sure I follow.
translation: 嗯，我不太明白你的意思。

english: Hmm, don't you think it suggests that the eggs have been kidnapped?
translation: 嗯，你不觉得这暗示蛋被绑架了吗？

english: Hmm, have you tried washing it again? Maybe the pink will fade a bit.
translation: 嗯，你试过再洗一次吗？也许粉色会褪掉一点。

english: Hmm, if you must.
translation: 嗯，如果你非要这样。

english: Hmm, make some space and I'll give you the tools
translation: 嗯，腾点地方，我把工具给你。

english: Hmm, maybe I have all the old notes now.
translation: 嗯，也许我现在已经收集齐所有破旧的纸条了。

english: Hmm, right. That doesn't bode well.
translation: 嗯，好吧。这可不是好兆头。

english: Hmm, seems my ring of pursuit doesn't work here. Must be the magic of these mushrooms.
translation: 嗯，看来我的追求戒指在这里不起作用。一定是这些蘑菇的魔法。

english: Hmm, so I'll need you to give me 3 flavours in a specific order, if you mess it up...
translation: 嗯，所以你得按特定顺序给我三种口味，要是搞砸了……

english: Hmm, that doesn't really sound like me. Perhaps something else might fit?
translation: 嗯，这听起来不太像我。也许别的更合适？

english: Hmm, these should do! The vat needs a very good clean. I should talk to Ali and see if he has some cleaning supplies. Then I just need something sharp to chop the ice...
translation: 嗯，这些应该够了！大桶需要好好清洗一下。我得跟阿里谈谈，看他有没有清洁用品。然后我只需要一件锋利的东西来砍冰……

english: Hmm, what if you just pretended to enjoy the party? You'd really be doing me a favour.
translation: 嗯，要是你假装享受派对呢？那可真是在帮我大忙了。

english: Hmm, you don't have any room to hold the report. Come talk to me when you have some space for it. Be quick, this is important business information.
translation: 嗯，你没地方放这份报告了。等你有空位了再来找我。快点，这可是重要的商业信息。

english: Hmm, you should check yer notes if stuck!
translation: 嗯，卡住了就看看你的笔记！

english: Hmm. I find myself ruminating on this very question. What happened to me?
translation: 嗯。我发现自己正在思考这个问题。我到底怎么了？

english: Hmm. That doesn't taste like chocolate... What is it?
translation: 嗯。这尝起来不像巧克力……这是什么？

english: Hmm... Based on past experienced with cats in the lumberyard, I bet it's hungry, thirsty or looking for its kitten.
translation: 嗯……根据以前在木材场跟猫打交道的经验，我敢打赌它不是饿了、渴了，就是在找它的小猫。

english: Hmm... Doesn't look like there are any boats here, and I think I'd rather avoid a swim...
translation: 嗯……这里好像没有船，我想我还是别游泳了……

english: Hmm... I bet Thaerisk will want to see these notes.-->
translation: 嗯……我打赌赛里斯克会想看这些纸条。

english: Hmm... I feel like I'm missing a piece here...
translation: 嗯……我感觉好像少了点什么……

english: Hmm... I'm not sure I like being called small, but I do like not having to worry!
translation: 嗯……我不太喜欢被人说小，但我确实喜欢不用操心！

english: Hmm... Looks like whatever you did caused the cabinet over there to move...
translation: 嗯……看来你刚才做的事让那边的柜子移动了……

english: Hmm... Ok, I'm willing to give it a go. How does it work? I've been cutting my own hair at home this whole time, you see.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我愿意试试。这怎么用？你看，我一直都在家自己剪头发。

english: Hmm... Probably best I don't just start messing around with someone else's workbench.
translation: 嗯……最好别随便乱动别人的工作台。

english: Hmm... Probably best I don't just start messing around with this cargo. I don't know what any of it is for.
translation: 嗯……最好别随便乱动这批货物。我不知道这些东西是干什么用的。

english: Hmm... Probably best I don't just start messing around with this stuff. I don't know what any of it is for.
translation: 嗯……最好别随便乱动这些东西。我不知道它们是干什么用的。

english: Hmm... Roald's cake was already burned, and the Gnome Child's cookies are, well, cookies.
translation: 嗯……罗阿尔德的蛋糕已经烤焦了，而地精小孩的饼干嘛，就是饼干而已。

english: Hmm... Spooky indeed. Not spine-chilling, but... effort was made.
translation: 嗯……确实挺吓人的。算不上毛骨悚然，但……是用心了。

english: Hmm... There's a lot of adverts related to sailing here... If only I knew what they meant...
translation: 嗯……这里有很多跟航海有关的广告……要是我知道它们是什么意思就好了……

english: Hmm... This looks familiar.
translation: 嗯……这个看起来很眼熟。

english: Hmm... What are those?
translation: 嗯……那些是什么？

english: Hmm... and a pizza isn't exotic enough, and a banana isn't exciting enough.
translation: 嗯……披萨不够异域风情，香蕉也不够刺激。

english: Hmm... are the stars really small, or are they just a long way off?
translation: 嗯……星星是真的小，还是只是离得很远？

english: Hmm... it's still too barren and featureless. People say that about me, too, sometimes. So let's put a centrepiece in this outer chamber.
translation: 嗯……还是太荒凉单调了。有时候别人也这么说我。所以，我们在这个外密室放个中心装饰品吧。

english: Hmm... maybe I could help out? I'm pretty good at coming up with ideas!
translation: 嗯……也许我能帮上忙？我很擅长出主意！

english: Hmm... that pile of rubbish looks like it has a lot of random parts in it. I think it belongs to the tanner. Maybe you could talk to him.
translation: 嗯……那堆垃圾里好像有很多零碎部件。我想那是鞣皮师的东西。也许你可以跟他谈谈。

english: Hmm... the weather seemed to get even fiercer where he passed through.
translation: 嗯……他经过的地方，天气似乎变得更猛烈了。

english: Hmm... yep, 'tis a fish.
translation: 嗯……没错，是一条鱼。

english: Hmm... you could try placing an ad in the Varrock Herald. You can speak to Benny by the protesters in Varrock Square to do this.
translation: 嗯……你可以试试在《维洛克城先驱报》上登个广告。你可以跟维洛克城广场抗议者旁边的班尼说这事。

english: Hmm.... I do like chocolate...
translation: 嗯……我确实喜欢巧克力……

english: Hmm...let me think...where can we trap him where he won't be found?
translation: 嗯……让我想想……我们能把他困在哪儿才不会被发现？

english: Hmmm, I'm not sure. I want to ask a few more questions first.
translation: 嗯，我不确定。我想先再问几个问题。

english: Hmmm, nothing here.
translation: 嗯，这里什么都没有。

english: Hmmm, seems some of the words are missing from this book...
translation: 嗯，这本书里好像有些字不见了……

english: Hmmm. Just a little trouble. Nothing to worry yourself with.
translation: 嗯。只是点小麻烦。你不用操心。

english: Hmmm. Mortals and their goal-driven attitude. One thing that shall forever elude my understanding. As you wish, but trouble me no more.
translation: 嗯。凡人啊，总是目标至上。这一点我永远无法理解。随你便吧，但别再烦我了。

english: Hmmm... I think the crypt still looks too clean and sanitised. People used to say the same about me; that's why I grew this moustache.
translation: 嗯……我觉得这墓穴看起来还是太干净整洁了。以前别人也这么说我；所以我留了这胡子。

english: Hmmm... In order to outsmart these goblins, we need to think like goblins.
