translation: 我还需要弄到多少巧克力凯比兔？

english: How many people are waiting in each room?
translation: 每个房间里有多少人在等？

english: How many toys go in a box?
translation: 一个盒子里放几个玩具？

english: How much GP does Jagex pay you?
translation: Jagex 付给你多少钱？

english: How much horizon's lure would you like to buy?
translation: 你想买多少地平线的诱惑？

english: How much kindling do you want to place on the statue? (1-X)
translation: 你想在雕像上放多少引火物？（1-X）

english: How much perildance bitter would you like to buy?
translation: 你想买多少佩里兰斯苦啤酒？

english: How much trawler's trust would you like to buy?
translation: 你想买多少拖网渔夫的信赖？

english: How observant of you... what do you want?
translation: 你眼力真好……你想要什么？

english: How on earth did this dwarf get in here?
translation: 这个矮人到底是怎么进来的？

english: How rude. Now do me a favour and answer the following question so I can put an end to this rudeness.
translation: 真没礼貌。现在帮我个忙，回答下面这个问题，好让我结束这种无礼的行为。

english: How should I know that? I think you've mistaken me for someone else, thingummywut.
translation: 我怎么会知道？你认错人了，那个谁。

english: How unfortunate, make some space and I'll give you a new copy.
translation: 真不幸，腾点地方，我给你一份新的。

english: How unfortunate. Well, with these festivities, I do feel rather generous. Clear some space in your inventory, and I will give you some more bait.
translation: 真不幸。不过，趁着过节，我心情还不错。清空一下背包，我再给你些饵料。

english: How unfortunate. Well, with these festivities, I do feel rather generous. Have some more bait.
translation: 真不幸。不过，趁着过节，我心情还不错。再给你些饵料吧。

english: How was the first game? I heard you did great.
translation: 第一场比赛怎么样？我听说你表现得很棒。

english: How was your Christmas din-dins, Jim?
translation: 吉姆，你的圣诞大餐怎么样？

english: How will I recognise him then?
translation: 那我怎么认出他？

english: How will they help us with easter eggs?
translation: 它们怎么能帮我们做复活节彩蛋？

english: How will we pay for that?
translation: 我们怎么付钱？

english: How will you 'get yourself into character'?
translation: 你要怎么‘进入角色’？

english: How would YOU like to be rudely awoken when you're trying to sleep?
translation: 要是你睡觉的时候被人粗暴地吵醒，你乐意吗？

english: How would you like to kill him?
translation: 你想怎么杀他？

english: How's business?
translation: 生意怎么样？

english: How's it hopping?
translation: 蹦跶得怎么样？

english: How's my costume?
translation: 我的服装怎么样？

english: How's the cape coming along?
translation: 披风做得怎么样了？

english: How's things Diango? The workshop still free from ghosts?
translation: 迪亚戈，最近怎么样？工作室里还没有幽灵吧？

english: How's your adventure going?
translation: 你的冒险怎么样了？

english: How... He seems to have an answer for all possibilities?
translation: 怎么……他好像对所有可能都有答案？

english: How? Egg beats secateurs.
translation: 怎么会？鸡蛋赢了修枝剪。

english: How? It should be a draw.
translation: 怎么会？应该是平局才对。

english: How? Secateurs beat silk.
translation: 怎么会？修枝剪赢了丝绸。

english: How? Silk beats egg.
translation: 怎么会？丝绸赢了鸡蛋。

english: However we found the treats vanishing in an instant, as if a greedy passer-by would help themselves without leaving any for anyone else.
translation: 然而我们发现那些点心瞬间就不见了，就好像有个贪婪的路人自顾自地拿光，一点也没给别人留。

english: However, if you were to keep our guests engaged by participating in their activities, I would be more than happy to reward you with an advance prototype.
translation: 不过，如果你能参与他们的活动，让我们的客人尽兴，我很乐意奖励你一个先行版原型。

english: However, we seem to be missing something... and I don't know what to do.
translation: 不过，我们好像少了点什么……我不知道该怎么办。

english: Hring Hring puts 1000gp into the tax bag.
translation: 赫林.赫林往税袋里放了1000金币。

english: Hrm, seems reasonable. Ok, I'll do it.
translation: 嗯，听起来挺合理的。好吧，我干。

english: Hueycoatl Bodies.
translation: 休伊科特尔身体。

english: Hueycoatl Coifs.
translation: 休伊科特尔头巾。

english: Huh der is this many colours...
translation: 呃，原来有这么多颜色……

english: Huh, normally Santa is the start of these events. I wonder who I should speak to?
translation: 呃，通常这些活动都是从圣诞老人开始的。我该找谁说话呢？

english: Huh, what does that mean?
translation: 呃，那是什么意思？

english: Huh. I don't know, I never thought I'd get this far.
translation: 呃。我不知道，我从没想过能走到这一步。

english: Huh. Simple.
translation: 呃。简单。

english: Huh. So you want me to help him instead.
translation: 呃。所以你是想让我去帮他。

english: Huh... I suppose you're right.
translation: 呃……我想你说得对。

english: Huh? What happened there?
translation: 嗯？那里发生了什么？

english: Huh? When I last looked at the list, all the names were scored out. Why would they suddenly not be scored out?
translation: 嗯？我上次看名单的时候，所有名字都被划掉了。怎么突然又没被划掉了？

english: Huka.
translation: 胡卡。

english: Human Taxidermy for Nincompoops
translation: 傻瓜也能学会的人类标本制作术

english: Human go away, we guard prisoner. You want be captured too?
translation: 人类走开，我们看守囚犯。你也想被抓起来吗？

english: Human has food to show My Arm?
translation: 人类有食物要给‘我的手臂’看？

english: Human not bad cook after all. My Arm thinks this is best dish of cookout!
translation: 人类厨艺其实还不错。‘我的手臂’觉得这是野炊里最好吃的一道菜！

english: Human will do as human please.
translation: 人类想怎么做就怎么做吧。

english: Human! You're not going to believe this!
translation: 人类！你肯定不敢相信！

english: Human, we busy guarding prisoner. You know this.
translation: 人类，我们忙着看守囚犯呢。你知道的。

english: Human, what is that? 50--> 0-->
Humans make lots of different foods, so My Arm can learn about them all here, even though human food is bad.
translation: 人类会做很多种不同的食物，所以‘我的手臂’可以在这里都学到，虽然人类食物很难吃。

english: Hunting Expert in the Feldip Hills and she showed me how to catch and train a Broav. I should now be able to return to the Fight Arena and use my Broav to track Movario using his Dirty Shirt.
translation: 费迪普丘陵的狩猎专家，她教我怎么捕捉和训练布罗夫。我现在应该可以回到战斗竞技场，用我的布罗夫，通过他的脏衬衫来追踪莫瓦里奥了。

english: Hunting Expert in the Feldip Hills and she showed me how to catch and train a Broav. I should now be able to return to the Fight Arena and use my Broav to track Movario using his Dirty Shirt. If I lose my Broav, I'll need to catch and train another.
translation: 费迪普丘陵的狩猎专家，她教我怎么捕捉和训练布罗夫。我现在应该可以回到战斗竞技场，用我的布罗夫，通过他的脏衬衫来追踪莫瓦里奥了。如果我的布罗夫丢了，我得再抓一只来训练。

english: Hunting Expert in the Feldip Hills and she told me how to catch a Broav. To do so, I'll need to set up a Pitfall Trap just west of her and bait it with a Mort Myre Fungus.
translation: 费迪普丘陵的狩猎专家，她告诉我怎么捕捉布罗夫。要做到这一点，我需要在她的西边设置一个陷坑，并用莫特迈耶菇做诱饵。

english: Hunting expert gives you a Hunter kit.
translation: 狩猎专家给了你一个猎人工具包。

english: Hunting the mighty rabbits outside the castle?
translation: 在城堡外面猎那些大兔子？

english: Hurry up, human! Me wants gift now. 1 -->
translation: 快点，人类！我现在就要礼物。1 -->

english: Hydra Heart, the Hydra Eye, and Hydra Fang into the Brimstone Ring? This cannot be reversed.
translation: 把九头蛇心脏、九头蛇之眼和九头蛇毒牙放进硫磺戒指？这是不可逆的。

english: I 'ave a Santa costume meself, innit.
translation: 我自己也有一套圣诞老人服装，对吧。

english: I 'ave hidden me treasure chest for the birthday event!
translation: 我把我的宝箱藏起来，为了生日活动！

english: I 'ave hidden me treasure chest!
translation: 我把我的宝箱藏起来了！

english: I (insert full name here) do hereby swear fealty and indebtedness to the Fairy Godfather until such time as he releases me from my bond. Signed (insert full name and date here)
translation: 我（在此填写全名）特此宣誓效忠并欠仙子教父人情，直至他解除我的契约。签名（在此填写全名和日期）

english: I DID IT! I opened the portal! You can go on through - I'm going to call my dad and tell him!
translation: 我做到了！我打开了传送门！你可以过去了——我要给我爸打电话告诉他！

english: I KNOW it was Anna.
translation: 我知道是安娜干的。

english: I accept the challenge!
translation: 我接受挑战！

english: I accept the deal.
translation: 我接受这笔交易。

english: I accept the fact that I will lose any HiScores I have set.
translation: 我接受我会失去所有已创下的排行榜纪录这个事实。

english: I accidentally lost the potion earlier, and I'm not sure what to do.
translation: 我之前不小心弄丢了药水，现在不知道该怎么办。

english: I actually came to ask about them. The Easter Bunny says his egg mould went missing last night!
translation: 我其实是来问这件事的。复活节兔子说他的鸡蛋模具昨晚不见了！

english: I actually have a present for you and the boys.
translation: 我其实有份礼物要送给你和兄弟们。

english: I actually took them home, in the end! I didn't want to clutter this restful meadow with my things. Whilst I was there, I had a chat with my parents and they couldn't be more proud!
translation: 我最后还是把它们带回家了！我不想用我的东西把这片宁静的草地弄得乱七八糟。在那里的时候，我和父母聊了聊，他们再自豪不过了！

english: I admire your spirit, but you can't go Trick-or- Treating without a Treat cauldron!
translation: 我欣赏你的热情，但没有糖果埚是不能玩不给糖就捣蛋的！

english: I agree.
translation: 我同意。

english: I agreed to help the student in the orange shirt. He has lost his Special Cup and thinks he may have dropped it around the tents near the panning site. I need to find it and return it to him.
translation: 我答应帮助那个穿橙色衬衫的学生。他弄丢了他的特殊杯子，觉得可能掉在淘金点附近的帐篷周围了。我得找到它并还给他。

english: I agreed to help the student in the purple skirt. She has lost her Lucky Mascot and thinks she may have dropped it by one of the large urns at the edge of the digsite. I need to find it and return it to her.
translation: 我答应帮助那个穿紫色裙子的学生。她弄丢了她的幸运吉祥物，觉得可能掉在挖掘场边缘的一个大瓮旁边了。我得找到它并还给她。

english: I agreed to sail to the island in search of the attacker, and her friends that were left behind. Abigale says the boat she used to escape can be found on the South-Eastern shore of Lumbridge swamp.
translation: 我同意乘船去岛上寻找袭击者，以及她那些被留下的朋友。阿比盖尔说她逃跑时用的船可以在仑桥镇沼泽的东南岸找到。

english: I almost have. The festival is about to begin, but there are three presents left to deliver, and I can't figure out who they're meant to go to.
translation: 我差不多完成了。节日就要开始了，但还有三份礼物没送出去，我搞不清楚它们是要送给谁的。

english: I already feel like a ghost! Nobody pays attention to me anymore.
translation: 我已经觉得自己像个幽灵了！没人再注意我了。

english: I already got a feather for the gnome. He didn't say anything about wanting more of them.
translation: 我已经给地精拿了一根羽毛了。他没说还想要更多。

english: I already have Anna's Necklace.
translation: 我已经有安娜的项链了。

english: I already have Bob's cup.
translation: 我已经有鲍勃的杯子了。

english: I already have Carol's bottle.
translation: 我已经有卡罗尔的瓶子了。

english: I already have David's book.
translation: 我已经有大卫的书了。

english: I already have Elizabeth's Needle.
translation: 我已经有伊丽莎白的针了。

english: I already have Frank's pot.
translation: 我已经有弗兰克的罐子了。

english: I already have some food with me. I should bring it to the generals.
translation: 我身上已经有一些食物了。我应该把它带给将军们。

english: I already have the murder weapon.
translation: 我已经有凶器了。

english: I already have the poisoned pot.
translation: 我已经有毒罐子了。

english: I already painted the sword.
translation: 我已经给剑上过漆了。

english: I already put a Mouldy sawdust in the cauldron. One should do.
translation: 我已经往大锅里放了一块发霉锯末。一块应该就够了。

english: I already put a Rotten meat in the cauldron. One should do.
translation: 我已经往大锅里放了一块烂肉。一块应该就够了。

english: I also awarded you Anti-Santa's spare underpants, a copy of my undead gravedigger costume, and all the unlockable items from previous Halloween festivities.
translation: 我还奖励了你反圣诞老人的备用内裤、我的亡灵掘墓人服装副本，以及之前万圣节活动中所有可解锁的物品。

english: I also need to use the key I got from Gunnjorn to enter the lighthouse.
translation: 我还需要用从冈乔恩那里拿到的钥匙进入灯塔。

english: I also was interested whether the armour of the White Knights and Black Knights exists in the pc world. Black Knights' Armour isn't Black Armor, it looks more like a very shady dark iron. And if you click examine White Knights, it just says "Nice Armor!". Is there any way to obtain these armors pc?
translation: 我也想知道白骑士和黑骑士的盔甲在电脑版世界中是否存在。黑骑士的盔甲不是黑色盔甲，它看起来更像是一种非常暗沉的深色铁甲。而且如果你检查白骑士，它只会显示“好盔甲！”。有什么办法能在电脑版中获得这些盔甲吗？

english: I always let them take the bags of chocolate chips with them when they go and play, keeps them busy and away from the jewellery!
translation: 我总是让它们带着巧克力片袋子去玩，这样能让它们有事可做，远离首饰！

english: I always look forward to creating a different costume each year...
translation: 我总是期待每年设计一套不同的服装……

english: I am Anti-Santa. I seek to eradicate the spirit of self-deception that is embodied by that buffoon in the red suit.
translation: 我是反圣诞老人。我致力于根除那个穿红衣服的小丑所体现的自欺欺人的精神。

english: I am Death. Immortal. Terrifying. The End of Times.
translation: 我是死亡。不朽的。可怕的。末日的终结。

english: I am FEAR! I am the essence of fear itself.
translation: 我是恐惧！我是恐惧本身的精髓。

english: I am SO sure it was Carol.
translation: 我百分之百确定是卡罗尔。

english: I am a flower trader, but not the only one! Are you looking for any flowers in particular?
translation: 我是个花商，但不是唯一的一个！你在找特定的花吗？

english: I am actually deaf and can't hear anything.
translation: 我其实是个聋子，什么都听不见。

english: I am afraid I have not managed to collect anything new [just yet, sir/just yet, madam/just yet].
translation: 恐怕我还没能收集到任何新东西[just yet, sir/just yet, madam/just yet]。

english: I am afraid that your patch has succumbed to disease and died, my friend. I am truly sorry.
translation: 恐怕你的苗圃已经染病枯死了，我的朋友。我真的很抱歉。

english: I am afraid that your patch has succumbed to disease, my friend. You must attend to it immediately, before it dies.
translation: 恐怕你的苗圃染病了，我的朋友。你必须立刻照料它，否则它就要死了。

english: I am always interested in weaponry, and as much fun as a long, drawn out, and bloody battle might be, there is always a need for a decisive and sudden display of power. I'll have some of my Chaos Dwarfs look into experimenting with some stuff, and get back to you on that.
translation: 我一直对武器很感兴趣，虽然一场漫长、持久而血腥的战斗可能很有趣，但总需要一种果断而突然的力量展示。我会让我的一些混沌矮人研究一些东西，然后给你答复。

english: I am an h'officer of the law. I must remain at my post.
translation: 我是一名执法官。我必须坚守岗位。

english: I am an honourable being. The old lady is correct. We should state our cases. It is only fair, and I will win anyway.
translation: 我是个高尚的人。老太太说得对。我们应该陈述各自的情况。这样才公平，而且反正我也会赢。

english: I am chef!
translation: 我是厨师！

english: I am death itself. My domain is a year round Halloween theme. If you can answer some questions correctly, I'll grant you some of my prized decorations...
translation: 我就是死亡本身。我的领域是全年万圣节主题。如果你能正确回答一些问题，我会给你一些我珍爱的装饰品……

english: I am far from typical!
translation: 我绝非典型！

english: I am fine with losing access to Permanent Deadman worlds for now.
translation: 我暂时不介意失去进入永久死亡模式世界的权限。

english: I am from a place far in the Kharidian Desert. So far that you would not have heard of it, so there is no point in me telling you the name of this place.
translation: 我来自卡里迪安沙漠深处的一个地方。远到你都没听说过，所以告诉你名字也没意义。

english: I am glad that you are still wearing that jumper I made for you! It still fits you perfectly, even two years on.
translation: 我很高兴你还穿着我为你织的那件套头衫！即使过了两年，它还是那么合身。

english: I am glad to hear it. Well, here you go!
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。好了，给你！

english: I am glad we figured something out!
translation: 很高兴我们想出了办法！

english: I am going to head there right now and practise climbing some trees.
translation: 我现在就去那里练习爬树。

english: I am here because I was invited! Halloween is the season when I am venerated in spirit, but when the other mortal performed the ritual of my invocation, I became manifest.
translation: 我来这里是因为我被邀请了！万圣节是我在精神上受到尊崇的季节，但当那个凡人执行召唤我的仪式时，我就实体化了。

english: I am here to fetch the key to Santa's Grotto. You aren't going to stop me.
translation: 我来这里是为了拿圣诞老人洞穴的钥匙。你阻止不了我。

english: I am holding onto [number] buckets for ya.
translation: 我帮你保管着 [number] 个桶。

english: I am holding onto [number] buckets for ya. Why would ya want so many buckets?
translation: 我帮你保管着 [number] 个桶。你要这么多桶干嘛？

english: I am indeed carrying a cabbage.
translation: 我确实带着一颗卷心菜。

english: I am most curious, do tell.
translation: 我非常好奇，快说说看。

english: I am much more ferocious when I am hungry.
translation: 我饿的时候要凶猛得多。

english: I am my friend but this is just the start of the story.
translation: 我是我的朋友，但这只是故事的开头。

english: I am not an experienced actor, but I believe I can portray the right character to make a success of this project.
translation: 我不是个有经验的演员，但我相信我能演绎出合适的角色，让这个项目成功。

english: I am not sure if thee has seen it all, but was there any other creatures that inhabited this place before that are now extinct?
translation: 我不确定你是否都见过了，但这里是否还有其他曾经居住过、现已灭绝的生物？

english: I am one with nature, and as such mine appearance doth change with the thoughts of the viewer; just as if you asked a bird and a fish what this planet looks like, thou wouldst recieve very different answers, both true in their way, yet missing the insight of the other. So too is my presence upon this realm. Physical presence is an aspect of my being, yet it is only needed where physical presence is necessary; to say I hath not this presence is to underestimate mine influence.
translation: 我与自然融为一体，因此我的外貌会随着观察者的想法而改变；就像如果你问一只鸟和一条鱼这个星球是什么样子，你会得到非常不同的答案，两者在其方式上都是真实的，但却缺少了对方的见解。我在这片领域的存在也是如此。物理存在是我存在的一个方面，但它只在需要物理存在的地方才需要；说我没有这种存在就是低估了我的影响力。

english: I am ruined!
translation: 我完蛋了！

english: I am so glad you have returned to the Realm of Memories, all these years after our adventure together!
translation: 真高兴你回到了记忆之境，在我们一起冒险这么多年之后！

english: I am so happy, thank you!
translation: 我太开心了，谢谢你！

english: I am so very sorry, but could you just tell me what you want me to do?
translation: 非常抱歉，但你能告诉我你想要我做什么吗？

english: I am sorry [player name], but I need 3 pieces of dark dagger- mouth hide, 1 ribcage piece and 10,000 coins to make you this armour...
translation: 抱歉 [player name]，但我需要 3 块黑暗匕首嘴皮、1 块肋骨碎片和 10,000 金币才能为你制作这件盔甲……

english: I am starting to think I should've stayed...
translation: 我开始觉得我应该留下来……

english: I am still looking!
translation: 我还在找！

english: I am still too busy sorry.
translation: 我还是太忙了，抱歉。

english: I am thank you. Are you enjoying it?
translation: 我很好，谢谢。你喜欢吗？

english: I am too busy sorry, but good luck!
translation: 我太忙了，抱歉，但祝你好运！

english: I am very happy with the dog you chose! Great organisation! Although in all honesty, I kind of wish there had been nibbles.
translation: 我对你选的狗非常满意！组织得很好！不过说实话，我有点希望有小点心。

english: I am very sorry [player name], but I will require 2 pieces of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 fibula piece and 7,500 coins to make this type of leg armour.
translation: 非常抱歉 [player name]，但我需要 2 块黑暗匕首嘴皮、1 块腓骨碎片和 7,500 金币才能制作这种腿甲。

english: I am wiser than to trust you again, human.
translation: 我还没蠢到再相信你，人类。

english: I am! Do you have any advice for me? I'm not sure what to cook.
translation: 是的！你有什么建议给我吗？我不确定该做什么菜。

english: I am! Well, flower seeds. Do you sell seeds?
translation: 是的！嗯，花种子。你卖种子吗？

english: I am, is there anything you're after in particular?
translation: 是的，你有什么特别想要的东西吗？

english: I appear to have misplaced that list of monkey sightings...
translation: 我好像把那份猴子目击清单放错地方了……

english: I appreciate the attention, although I was just really hoping for some treats!
translation: 我很感激这份关注，虽然我其实只是希望能有些糖果！

english: I asked around town about the Missing People and found a Couple who seemed to be distressed at the mention of them
translation: 我在镇上打听失踪人口的事，发现一对夫妇在提到他们时似乎很痛苦。

english: I assure you everything will be fine, come and see!
translation: 我向你保证一切都会好的，过来看看！

english: I await your return.
translation: 我等你回来。

english: I believe he had some personal matters to attend to. Not to worry.
translation: 我相信他有些私事要处理。别担心。

english: I believe that is now everyone having a good time!
translation: 我相信现在每个人都很开心！

english: I believe the leprechauns, lead by one named Larry, are hosting a fishing competition over by the oasis, north of the Gem trader.
translation: 我相信由一位名叫拉里的小妖精带领的妖精们，正在宝石商人北边的绿洲附近举办一场钓鱼比赛。

english: I believe there's a boat in Port Sarim with a Captain Tock aboard that can take you there.
translation: 我相信沙林港有艘船，上面有位托克船长，可以带你去那里。

english: I believe they ordered...
translation: 我相信他们点了……

english: I believe you are a specialist in slaying certain monsters, are you not?
translation: 我相信你是猎杀特定怪物的专家，对吧？

english: I believe you often create outfits, yes, so I am hoping you can help me get a memento of the Crafting skill. Also one of the Hunter skill, from the materials you use.
translation: 我相信你经常制作服装，对吧，所以我希望你能帮我弄到一件制作技能的纪念品。还有猎人技能的，用你使用的材料做。

english: I believe you own an Anti-Santa costume. You should dress up as Anti-Santa and scare them. With the Santa suit you got me, I will then persuade them that I have saved them.
translation: 我相信你有一套反圣诞老人服装。你应该打扮成反圣诞老人去吓唬他们。用你给我的圣诞老人套装，我就能说服他们是我救了他们。

english: I believe you've visited the most generous of us!
translation: 我相信你已经拜访过我们中最慷慨的人了！

english: I bet he givesh the eggsh to thoshe priestsh back there... Look at their hats... Eggy weggy headwear... EGGHEADSH!!
translation: 我打赌他把鸡蛋给了后面那些祭司……看看他们的帽子……蛋蛋头饰……蛋头！！

english: I bet that rabbit is selling them on the sly.
translation: 我打赌那只兔子在偷偷卖它们。

english: I better be careful, anymore coal and I'll be eliminated.
translation: 我最好小心点，再多拿一块煤我就要被淘汰了。

english: I better see how Guss is doing before I make any small talk with the staff.
translation: 在和员工闲聊之前，我最好先去看看格斯怎么样了。

english: I brought you these fireflies. I mean uh... glowy things.
translation: 我给你带来了这些萤火虫。我是说……呃……发光的东西。

english: I can add that to my list of jumpers I ought to try knitting.
translation: 我可以把它加到我应该尝试编织的套头衫清单里。

english: I can assure you friend, your delivery of the trade report has helped me more than you could possibly know!
translation: 我可以向你保证，朋友，你送来的贸易报告对我的帮助超乎你的想象！

english: I can change that.
translation: 我可以改变这一点。

english: I can do that, I'll take it to him now.
translation: 我能做到，我现在就给他送去。

english: I can finally leave the castle and carry out my festive duties. I believe you may have earned a spot on the nice list despite everything you had to do...
translation: 我终于可以离开城堡去履行我的节日职责了。我相信尽管你不得不做了那些事，但你或许已经赢得了在好孩子名单上的一席之地……

english: I can give you a demonstration if you're interested? 1. This will remember the player has spoken to Nomad previously, but won't allow them to enter the minigame yet.-->
translation: 如果你有兴趣，我可以给你演示一下？1. 这将记录玩家之前与游牧民交谈过，但还不允许他们进入小游戏。-->

english: I can give you any past spooky things you don't already have.
translation: 我可以给你任何你还没有的过去恐怖物品。

english: I can grant you 50 base agility XP per each Mark of Grace you have. You'll get a total of [number] base XP for your [number] marks.
translation: 我可以根据你拥有的每个优雅印记给予你 50 点基础敏捷经验值。你的 [number] 个印记总共可以获得 [number] 点基础经验值。

english: I can grant you a one-off experience boost to one of the following skills; which would you like? And be quick!
translation: 我可以给你一次性的经验加成，用于以下技能之一；你想要哪个？快点！

english: I can guarantee you we are getting up to no evil exploits!
translation: 我可以向你保证，我们绝对没在搞什么邪恶的勾当！

english: I can hand them out to any passing adventurers to help spread the colour around some more!
translation: 我可以把它们分发给路过的冒险者，让色彩传播得更广！

english: I can hit something with this to make a loud noise.
translation: 我可以用这个敲东西发出很大的声音。

english: I can indeed. What would you like?
translation: 我当然可以。你想要什么？

english: I can make my own choices.
translation: 我可以自己做选择。

english: I can never have too many pairs of scissors!
translation: 剪刀再多也不嫌多！

english: I can offer you a one time teleport to the Party Room if you would like?
translation: 如果你愿意，我可以提供一次性的传送去派对房间？

english: I can only think of one thing. My good friend Larry's two children, Buoy and Gurl, often come and visit me during the week.
translation: 我只能想到一件事。我的好朋友拉里的两个孩子，浮标和格尔，经常在周中来看我。

english: I can prove this to you, come with me to the easter workshop!
translation: 我可以向你证明这一点，跟我去复活节工作室！

english: I can quite clearly see that you're not a box, you're talking to me!
translation: 我很清楚你不是个箱子，你在跟我说话！

english: I can see some balloons in this room, so it's more than that! Try again.
translation: 我能看到这个房间里有些气球，所以不止如此！再猜猜看。

english: I can see something.
translation: 我好像看到了什么。

english: I can see that but... why? What's the occasion?
translation: 我看得出来，但是……为什么？是什么场合？

english: I can see that you are wearing a costume.
translation: 我看得出你穿着戏服。

english: I can see them from the window! They look like they're having fun. Thank you ever so much for doing this.
translation: 我从窗户能看到他们！他们看起来玩得很开心。真是太感谢你帮忙了。

english: I can teleport you to Varrock town centre, but only once. Would you like to go there now?
translation: 我可以把你传送到维洛克城中心，但只能一次。你想现在去吗？

english: I can tell.
translation: 我看得出来。

english: I can try, but I'm not sure they'll tell me anything. They kept saying business secrets last time.
translation: 我可以试试，但我不确定他们会告诉我什么。上次他们一直说是商业机密。

english: I can understand why.
translation: 我能理解为什么。

english: I can't afford anything less sharp...
translation: 我可买不起更不锋利的东西了……

english: I can't believe I genuinely thought I'd just waltz in here and get into the White Knights right away.
translation: 我真不敢相信自己居然以为能大摇大摆走进来，直接加入白骑士团。

english: I can't believe I got tricked by a child, does he do this often?
translation: 我真不敢相信被一个小孩耍了，他经常这样吗？

english: I can't believe I lost! I explicitly told Pete I didn't want to lose!
translation: 我真不敢相信我输了！我明明跟皮特说过我不想输的！

english: I can't believe I'm doing this. Oh well, here goes nothing!
translation: 我真不敢相信我在做这种事。唉，管他呢，试试看吧！

english: I can't believe how big that bird is!
translation: 我真不敢相信那只鸟那么大！

english: I can't believe that the dragons' invitation reached them.
translation: 我真不敢相信龙族的邀请函居然送到了他们手上。

english: I can't believe you knew they would let you-
translation: 我真不敢相信你早就知道他们会让你——

english: I can't believe you were using me like this! Why you...
translation: 我真不敢相信你居然这样利用我！你这个……

english: I can't catch any of the bunnies.
translation: 我一只兔子都抓不到。

english: I can't dig up anything with him attacking me!
translation: 他攻击我的时候我什么都挖不出来！

english: I can't do much with these, try taking them to Bob.
translation: 这些我派不上什么用场，试试拿去给鲍勃吧。

english: I can't even see what kind of head fur I'm working with here. Maybe a different dog would be better.
translation: 我甚至看不清我在处理的是什么头毛。也许换只狗会更好。

english: I can't find any Easter eggs.
translation: 我一个复活节彩蛋都找不到。

english: I can't give it to him. It goes right through him.
translation: 我没办法给他。这东西直接穿过他了。

english: I can't help you out without seeing it first unfortunately.
translation: 不幸的是，不先亲眼看看，我帮不了你。

english: I can't imagine where you get these ideas! But my Halloween treat must be entirely child-friendly, so let's keep all the danger well off the metaphorical table.
translation: 我真想不出你这些点子都是从哪来的！但我的万圣节款待必须完全适合孩子，所以咱们把所有危险都远远地抛到脑后吧。

english: I can't keep dogs here, they'd be an allergy concern for the party room.
translation: 我不能在这里养狗，它们会让派对房间有过敏问题。

english: I can't really be bothered with all that.
translation: 我真的懒得管那些事。

english: I can't really talk right now [player name], I'm taking part in the cookout!
translation: 我现在真的没空说话，[player name]，我正在参加野餐会呢！

english: I can't risk being found, I have too many important business secrets.
translation: 我不能冒险被发现，我有太多重要的商业机密了。

english: I can't say I'm surprised. I was taking a risk making a pie.
translation: 说不上惊讶。我做馅饼本来就是冒险。

english: I can't show myself to the White Knights like this. If I want to make a good first impression, I need to look the part. I'm pretty sure they don't bestow the title of Sir willy nilly.
translation: 我不能这副样子去见白骑士。要想留下好的第一印象，我得打扮得体。我很确定他们不会随随便便就赐予爵士头衔。

english: I can't speak cow.
translation: 我不会说牛语。

english: I can't take that, it's not mine!
translation: 我不能拿那个，那不是我的！

english: I can't thank you enough for all of your help. I really will get my act together next year, I promise.
translation: 对你的帮助我感激不尽。我保证明年一定会振作起来。

english: I can't thank you enough, [player name]. You have really been the catalyst of this whole adventure. Don't be a stranger!
translation: 我太感谢你了，[player name]。你真是这整场冒险的催化剂。别成了陌生人！

english: I can't thank you for your help without a little something. Here are a couple of cool things that I think would fit you well.
translation: 不给你点东西，我都没法好好感谢你的帮助。这里有几样我觉得很适合你的酷东西。

english: I can't wait to see that.
translation: 我等不及要看了。

english: I can't work out what to do with these discs!
translation: 我想不出这些圆盘能用来做什么！

english: I cannot begin to imagine the horrors he must have seen on the island, or those that he had to commit himself in order to end the life of Jonas. Knowing that he had been able to do so, I felt that I had no choice
translation: 我无法想象他在岛上目睹了怎样的恐怖，或是为了结束乔纳斯性命而不得不亲手犯下的罪行。既然知道他能够做到，我觉得自己别无选择。

english: I cannot combine the pieces without having all 3.
translation: 没有集齐全部3块碎片，我无法将它们组合起来。

english: I cannot say I've heard of it before.
translation: 我不能说我以前听说过。

english: I cannot stop you from taking this map piece now, but think on this: if you can slay the Dragon of Crandor, you are a greater hero than my land ever produced. There is no shame in backing out now.
translation: 我现在无法阻止你拿走这块地图碎片，但请想想：如果你能杀死克兰多之龙，那你就是我这片土地从未有过的伟大英雄。现在退出也不丢人。

english: I cannot wait for my din-dins!
translation: 我等不及要吃晚饭了！

english: I certainly have items relating to Magic. Also Runecraft, thanks to [player name] helping rediscover the essence mine - for which I also have a handy pickaxe.
translation: 我当然有与魔法相关的物品。还有符石制作，多亏[player name]帮忙重新发现了精华矿——为此我还有一把好用的镐子。

english: I certainly have items relating to Magic. Runecraft is still quite a mystery, but I've bought a little essence off travelling merchants for my research.
translation: 我当然有与魔法相关的物品。符石制作仍然是个谜，但我从行商那里买了一点精华用于研究。

english: I challenge you to a special birthday bash...
translation: 我向你发起一场特别的生日派对决……

english: I changed my mind, I want to keep it.
translation: 我改变主意了，我想留着它。

english: I changed my mind, I'll stay here.
translation: 我改变主意了，我留在这里。

english: I choose treat! Have a happy Halloween!
translation: 我选款待！万圣节快乐！

english: I collected the tears like I had before...
translation: 我像以前一样收集了眼泪……

english: I come as an emissary from the people of Nardah
translation: 我是作为那尔达城人民的使者前来的。

english: I confess my curiosity has finally won through. Long have I heard tales of these Leagues, and the lengths mortals like you will go to for a shred of favour from a superior being.
translation: 我承认我的好奇心最终占了上风。我早就听说过这些联盟的传说，以及像你这样的凡人为了从高等存在那里获得一丝青睐会付出多大的努力。

english: I confronted Haig Halen and he admitted to taking Xerna's Diadem, but only to keep it safe because it was about to be stolen by someone else. However, he realised his mistake and agreed to have it returned. I returned to the Grand Museum of Civitas illa Fortis to let them know and I was rewarded for my help.
translation: 我当面质问海格.哈伦，他承认拿走了泽尔娜的头冠，但只是为了保护它，因为有人正要偷走它。不过，他意识到了自己的错误，并同意归还。我回到福蒂斯城的大博物馆告知他们，并因我的帮助得到了奖励。

english: I confronted and distracted all three of the Moons of Peril, allowing Eyatlalli to complete the ritual. With the Moons of Peril contained, Cam Torum is now safe. However Eyatlalli promised me further rewards if I assisted her in keeping them imprisoned.
translation: 我直面并牵制了全部三个灾厄之月，让埃亚特拉利得以完成仪式。灾厄之月被控制后，卡姆托伦现在安全了。不过埃亚特拉利承诺，如果我帮她继续囚禁它们，还会有更多奖励。

english: I confronted the killer, and discovered that it was in fact Abigale and Hewey working together.
translation: 我当面质问杀手，发现实际上是阿比盖尔和休伊在联手作案。

english: I continued my work on the Totem by carving depictions of the nearby Spirit Animals into it.
translation: 我继续在图腾上雕刻附近灵兽的形象。

english: I control not the actions of my followers in how they choose to honour me, and the weapon of which thou speak wouldst seem... against mine very nature in its overpowering strength.
translation: 我无法控制我的追随者选择如何尊崇我的行为，而你所说的那件武器……其压倒性的力量似乎……违背了我的本性。

english: I copied this from in game (Forgot to take a screenshot, however skill guide says it's 49 runecrafting for 2 sunfire runes, not level 66 which is when this appeared
translation: 我是从游戏里抄下来的（忘了截图，不过技能指南说制作2个日炎符文需要49级符石制作，而不是出现这个提示时的66级。

english: I could do with a break, so that's appreciated.
translation: 我正需要休息一下，所以很感激。

english: I could do with some freshly cooked shrimp for a salad I'm planning. I still need [number].
translation: 我计划做个沙拉，需要一些新鲜烹制的虾。我还需要 [number] 只。

english: I could do with some freshly cooked shrimp for a salad I'm planning. Please bring me [number].
translation: 我计划做个沙拉，需要一些新鲜烹制的虾。请给我带 [number] 只来。

english: I could do with some iron throwing knives to keep the goblins away from my house. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些铁制飞刀来赶走我家附近的哥布林。我还需要 [number] 把。

english: I could do with some medium-sized helmets. I'd like bronze ones. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些中型头盔。我想要青铜制的。我还需要 [number] 个。

english: I could eat five!
translation: 我能吃五个！

english: I could have just used one of my own buckets, they're easy to get hold of.
translation: 我本来可以用自己的桶，那些很容易弄到。

english: I could make the toys!
translation: 我可以做玩具！

english: I could really use some help from an old pal!
translation: 我真需要老朋友的帮助！

english: I could really use the help to find out how to deliver these eggs without them melting!
translation: 我真需要帮忙找出如何运送这些蛋而不让它们融化！

english: I could take it to the Museum for you!
translation: 我可以帮你把它送到博物馆！

english: I could. It will be expensive though.
translation: 我可以。不过会很贵。

english: I couldn't do that! it would've ruined Easter.
translation: 我不能那么做！那会毁了复活节的。

english: I couldn't find any the last time I checked!
translation: 我上次检查的时候一个都没找到！

english: I covered the rocks in the cave with an Explosive Compound.
translation: 我用爆炸化合物覆盖了洞穴里的岩石。

english: I crack open the Giant Easter Egg and find a surprise!
translation: 我敲开巨型复活节彩蛋，发现了一个惊喜！

english: I created a Poultice for Fox and gave it to him.
translation: 我为福克斯制作了一剂药膏并给了他。

english: I crushed it.
translation: 我把它压碎了。

english: I dare not cross you, of all people, for fear of ending up like Elvarg!
translation: 我尤其不敢得罪你，怕落得像艾尔瓦格一样的下场！

english: I dealt with the Creature that had escaped from the Ruins and I was granted access to Cam Torum in return. Within the city, I was invited by Jessamine to join her expedition into the Ruins.
translation: 我处理了从废墟逃出的生物，作为回报，我被允许进入卡姆托伦。在城内，杰萨明邀请我加入她的废墟探险队。

english: I definitely do not want to drink any of this!
translation: 我绝对不想喝这个！

english: I definitely knew. Yep.
translation: 我当然知道。没错。

english: I delivered the Package to Aubury in Varrock. He confirmed Sedridor's suspicions and asked me to take some Research Notes back to him. I did so, and Sedridor used them to discover the Teleportation Incantation to the lost Rune Essence Mine. As a thank you for my help, he granted me permission to use the Rune Essence Mine whenever I please.
translation: 我把包裹送到了维洛克城的奥伯里那里。他证实了塞德里多的怀疑，并让我带一些研究笔记回去给他。我照做了，塞德里多用它们发现了通往失落的符文精华矿的传送咒语。作为对我帮助的感谢，他允许我随时使用符文精华矿。

english: I delivered the Strange Talisman to Sedridor in the Wizards' Tower. He believed it might be key to discovering a Teleportation Incantation to the lost Rune Essence Mine. He asked me to help confirm this by delivering a Package to Aubury, an expert on Runecrafting.
translation: 我把奇怪的护身符送到了法师塔的塞德里多那里。他认为这可能是发现通往失落的符文精华矿的传送咒语的关键。他让我把一个包裹送给符石制作专家奥伯里，以帮助确认这一点。

english: I depart! Take your children back!
translation: 我走了！把你的孩子们带回去！

english: I did consider that, and went as far as using my own hair clippings to make one when I shortened my hairstyle, but it was very itchy and not all that convincing.
translation: 我确实考虑过，甚至在我剪短发型时用自己的头发碎做了一个，但非常痒，而且不太逼真。

english: I did find it! But then I lost it again.
translation: 我确实找到了！但后来又弄丢了。

english: I did find it! Here you go.
translation: 我确实找到了！给你。

english: I did have an IOU from the Cook... Where did I put it?
translation: 我确实有一张厨师的借条……我放哪儿了？

english: I did indeed, apparently it's the Spirit of Love.
translation: 确实如此，显然那是爱之灵。

english: I did it! That chicken really went to pieces!
translation: 我做到了！那只鸡真的碎成渣了！

english: I did it! The mixture is now mixed together!
translation: 我做到了！混合物现在混合在一起了！

english: I did see some beds in the factory, I could use one of the sheets!
translation: 我确实在工厂里看到一些床，我可以用其中一张床单！

english: I did send out an invitation to the dragon Elvarg...
translation: 我确实给龙艾尔瓦格发了邀请函……

english: I did thank you!
translation: 我确实谢过你了！

english: I did that last year and mixed up the sauces. Ended up pouring in some sauce I got from a Kebab seller in Pollnivneach. Safe to say, no love was shared that day.
translation: 我去年就这么做了，结果把酱料搞混了。最后倒进了一些我从波尼尼镇的烤肉摊主那里买来的酱汁。可以肯定地说，那天没有分享到任何爱意。

english: I did wonder which of them would turn up considering Elvarg's... condition.
translation: 考虑到艾尔瓦格的……状况，我确实好奇它们谁会来。

english: I did! Here you go, have a taste. 3; the Goblin kitchen's cauldron also reverts back to pre-event state. The Goblin stew is removed from the player's inventory. -->
translation: 我做了！给你，尝尝看。3；哥布林厨房的大锅也会恢复到活动前的状态。哥布林炖菜会从玩家背包中移除。-->

english: I did! I tried it out and it still produces quality Easter eggs.
translation: 我做了！我试过了，它仍然能产出优质的复活节彩蛋。

english: I did, thank you, it was a pretty cool present. Enjoy the rest of the festival. Merry Christmas!
translation: 我收到了，谢谢，那是个很酷的礼物。祝你节日愉快。圣诞快乐！

english: I did. I also talked to a witch.
translation: 我做了。我还跟一个女巫聊了聊。

english: I did. I pushed it into the village and it's now ready to be decorated.
translation: 我做了。我把它推进了村子，现在可以装饰了。

english: I did. The Easter Bunny asked me to make sure it still worked.
translation: 我做了。复活节兔子让我确保它还能用。

english: I did. What do you think it was?
translation: 我做了。你觉得那是什么？

english: I did. Wizard Mizgog told me of someone who may be able to help. I need to investigate more.
translation: 我做了。魔法师米兹戈格告诉我可能有个人能帮忙。我需要进一步调查。

english: I didn't get an Easter egg last year, life's not fair.
translation: 我去年没拿到复活节彩蛋，生活真不公平。

english: I didn't know witches celebrated Christmas?
translation: 我不知道女巫也庆祝圣诞节？

english: I didn't see them properly, Philop came to play with me as his brothers ran off and left him. Maybe they ran off to hide it.
translation: 我没看清楚，菲洛普的兄弟们跑掉丢下他，他就来找我玩了。也许他们跑掉是为了藏东西。

english: I didn't steal it!
translation: 我没偷！

english: I didn't think you were serious about inviting them?
translation: 我以为你邀请他们只是开玩笑？

english: I disagree.
translation: 我不同意。

english: I distiniguish not between the two; you will all get a chance to feed my pets in the Wilderness. And rest assured, feed they will.
translation: 我不区分这两者；你们都有机会在荒野中喂我的宠物。放心，它们一定会饱餐一顿的。

english: I distracted Kiko and then inspected his Bed to find some of the fur missing. Fox presumably took a sample to help him find the right replacement. Wolf suggested I look for him near the Pyre Foxes on the way to the Locus Oasis.
translation: 我引开基科，然后检查了他的床，发现少了一些毛皮。福克斯大概拿走了样本，以帮助他找到合适的替代品。沃尔夫建议我去通往洛克斯绿洲路上的火葬狐狸附近找他。

english: I djont fit in dis bawwel... Wet me out!!
translation: 我挤不进去这桶里……放我出去！！

english: I do believe you have done everything I require. Thank you very much indeed, [player name].
translation: 我确实相信你已经完成了所有我要求的事。真的非常感谢你，[player name]。

english: I do have some festive white wine here, however I'm wondering if you'd be able to do me a favour first? In return for the festive white wine!
translation: 我这儿确实有些节日白葡萄酒，不过我在想你能不能先帮我个忙？作为交换，这节日白葡萄酒就是你的了！

english: I do have some information that might help you. However as I said, it's not free.
translation: 我确实有些情报可能对你有帮助。不过我说过，这不是免费的。

english: I do have... this.
translation: 我确实有……这个。

english: I do hope they're serving trout!
translation: 我真希望他们有鳟鱼吃！

english: I do know of a way to fix it, but I don't have the time due to my grotto preparations and squire duties.
translation: 我确实知道怎么修，但我忙着准备洞穴和侍从的职责，没时间。

english: I do love a good party if I do say so myself! Need to think about the ongoing battle first...
translation: 不是我自夸，我确实喜欢一场好派对！不过得先想想眼前的战斗……

english: I do love seeing all the colour combinations people use!
translation: 我真的很喜欢看大家用的各种颜色搭配！

english: I do not believe you, mortal.
translation: 我不相信你，凡人。

english: I do not need any more cabbages, thank you.
translation: 我不需要更多卷心菜了，谢谢。

english: I do say this party looks to be a bit of a disappointment.
translation: 我得说这场派对看起来有点令人失望。

english: I do yes, right here!
translation: 是的，我确实有，就在这儿！

english: I do! How did you know?
translation: 我确实有！你怎么知道的？

english: I do, and don't I look fancy! Some smelly old human with a paper crown wanted my picture. He was a little weird, but he filled my cheek-pouches with acorns, so I didn't mind.
translation: 是的，而且我看起来不是很时髦吗！一个戴着纸皇冠的臭烘烘的老人类想要我的照片。他有点奇怪，但他把我的颊囊塞满了橡子，所以我不介意。

english: I do, very much so! Will you be going to the Falador Christmas Festival?
translation: 我确实很喜欢！你会去法拉多城的圣诞节庆典吗？

english: I do. It is an important service I provide to our people. My spears in particular are quite desirable.
translation: 是的。这是我为我们的人民提供的重要服务。尤其是我的长矛，非常抢手。

english: I don't actually care.
translation: 我其实不在乎。

english: I don't actually know how to make a toffee apple.
translation: 我其实不知道怎么做太妃苹果。

english: I don't at the moment. I'll come back when I have space.
translation: 我现在没有。等我有空位了再回来。

english: I don't believe so, no.
translation: 我不这么认为，没有。

english: I don't believe we have any reason to talk right now. In case you hadn't noticed, there's quite a few visiting dignitaries that I need to keep an eye on.
translation: 我觉得我们现在没什么好谈的。你可能没注意到，有不少来访的要人需要我盯着。

english: I don't care what you do as long as you do not interfere. Proceed.
translation: 只要你不干涉，我不在乎你做什么。继续吧。

english: I don't even care whose birthday it is, let's dance the night away.
translation: 我甚至不在乎是谁的生日，咱们跳舞跳到天亮吧。

english: I don't even want to know what a stew made with that water would taste like.
translation: 我甚至不想知道用那水做的炖菜是什么味道。

english: I don't feel like helping you right now.
translation: 我现在不想帮你。

english: I don't get it! Why are you stealing all the eggs and bringing them here?
translation: 我不明白！你为什么偷走所有的蛋，还把它们带到这里来？

english: I don't give that out to just anyone, you know. What on Gielinor could you need it for?
translation: 我可不会随便给人那个。你在吉里诺到底需要它做什么？

english: I don't have 5 tradeable paints on me right now.
translation: 我现在身上没有5瓶可交易的颜料。

english: I don't have a decent larder here, so I can't store food very well. Now I'm out of loaves of bread. I still need [number].
translation: 我这里没有像样的食品储藏柜，所以食物保存得不好。现在我的面包条都吃完了。我还需要 [number] 条。

english: I don't have any money on me, is that alright?
translation: 我身上没带钱，这样可以吗？

english: I don't have any money on me, now I'm stuck here forever!
translation: 我身上没带钱，现在我永远被困在这里了！

english: I don't have anything I can pay you with, though. I barely scrape a living together as a squire.
translation: 不过我没什么能付给你的。我当侍从勉强糊口。

english: I don't have anything to pay you with...
translation: 我没什么能付给你的……

english: I don't have the right key though. I don't know if lockpicking is a skill that's well regarded among the white knights, but it's morally questionable. I would rather not risk it in case it harms my chances.
translation: 但我没有正确的钥匙。我不知道开锁在白骑士中是否受推崇，但这在道德上有问题。我宁愿不冒险，免得影响我的机会。

english: I don't have time at the moment, sorry.
translation: 我现在没时间，抱歉。

english: I don't have time for this.
translation: 我没时间搞这个。

english: I don't have time to explain exactly where everyone is so I'm afraid you'll have to do a bit of searching to find them.
translation: 我没时间详细解释每个人在哪儿，所以恐怕你得自己找找他们。

english: I don't have time to search that.
translation: 我没时间搜那个。

english: I don't have time. I'm here to rescue Sir Servil and Sammy.
translation: 我没时间。我是来救瑟维尔爵士和萨米的。

english: I don't know any Ali Morrisane.
translation: 我不认识什么阿里.莫里桑。

english: I don't know any Gary. Go away.
translation: 我不认识什么加里。走开。

english: I don't know how much damage I could have done to it, it's not particularly fragile. I assumed he didn't want me to become a knight, back then.
translation: 我不知道我能对它造成多大损坏，它又不是特别脆弱。我当时以为他不想让我成为骑士。

english: I don't know if I can even afford to stay out here for too long.
translation: 我不知道我能不能在外面待太久。

english: I don't know if I would prefer a large spider far away or a small spider on my face!
translation: 我不知道我是宁愿远处有只大蜘蛛，还是脸上有只小蜘蛛！

english: I don't know what I expected... but this should work... thanks.
translation: 我不知道我期待什么……但这应该行……谢谢。

english: I don't know what exactly?
translation: 我不知道具体是什么？

english: I don't know what that is.
translation: 我不知道那是什么。

english: I don't know what they are but would you like them? Consider it a thank you for protecting my business.
translation: 我不知道它们是什么，但你要吗？就当是感谢你保护我的生意。

english: I don't know why I did that...
translation: 我不知道我为什么那么做……

english: I don't know why you want that. It's horrible, that's why we call it Brewer's Folly. Yes, you can have some. We don't charge for it; no-one would pay anyway.
translation: 我不知道你为什么想要那个。那玩意儿糟透了，所以我们叫它酿酒师的蠢行。行，你可以拿一些。我们不收钱；反正也没人会付。

english: I don't know, but it was... beautiful, don't you think?
translation: 我不知道，但它……很美，你不觉得吗？

english: I don't know, how about a bunch of mini-challenges to keep you on your toes?
translation: 我不知道，来一堆小挑战让你保持警觉怎么样？

english: I don't know, sounds like a long shot. Wait here, I'll go ask them a trick question to confirm.
translation: 我不知道，听起来希望不大。在这儿等着，我去问他们一个刁钻问题来确认。

english: I don't know. Something seem wrong. If you really are goblin, prove it.
translation: 我不知道。好像有点不对劲。如果你真是哥布林，证明给我看。

english: I don't know? A Santa hat? Sailing boat? An egg?
translation: 我不知道？一顶圣诞帽？一艘帆船？一个蛋？

english: I don't like Christmas. My dad's always too busy to spend time with me. It's the busiest time of the year for him.
translation: 我不喜欢圣诞节。我爸爸总是太忙，没时间陪我。这是一年中最忙的时候。

english: I don't like it either, but I don't have much choice. Do you think you could make some for me?
translation: 我也不喜欢，但我没什么选择。你觉得你能帮我做一些吗？

english: I don't like where this is going...
translation: 我不喜欢这走向……

english: I don't need to climb this anymore! I should talk to Iffie about claiming my rewards.
translation: 我不需要再爬这个了！我应该跟伊菲谈谈领取奖励的事。

english: I don't need to climb this anymore! I should talk to Iffie about her reward instead.
translation: 我不需要再爬这个了！我应该跟伊菲谈谈她的奖励。

english: I don't need to serve this table right now.
translation: 我现在不需要服务这张桌子。

english: I don't quite follow you, old bean!
translation: 我没太听懂你的意思，老兄！

english: I don't really care to be honest.
translation: 说实话，我真的不在乎。

english: I don't really want to dive around in this pile of trash. It smells awful.
translation: 我真的不想在这堆垃圾里翻来翻去。臭死了。

english: I don't recall anything you've one over the past year?
translation: 我不记得你过去一年做过什么？

english: I don't remember anymore. Pretty old.
translation: 我不记得了。太老了。

english: I don't see a way I can do that. I think I should find a different camel.
translation: 我看不出有什么办法能做到。我想我应该找另一只骆驼。

english: I don't see any more monkeys on her!
translation: 我没看到她身上还有更多猴子！

english: I don't see any more monkeys on him!
translation: 我没看到他身上还有更多猴子！

english: I don't see many around here either...
translation: 我在这儿附近也没看到多少……

english: I don't suppose you could remind me how to play this game?
translation: 你能不能提醒我一下怎么玩这个游戏？

english: I don't suppose you could remind me on how to play this game?
translation: 你能不能提醒我一下怎么玩这个游戏？

english: I don't suppose you could spare a few to help share Christmas cheer?
translation: 你能不能匀出一些来帮忙传播圣诞的欢乐？

english: I don't suppose you could spare them?
translation: 你能不能把它们让给我？

english: I don't think I actually want to drink that. I need it for the ice cream!
translation: 我觉得我其实不想喝那个。我需要它来做冰淇淋！

english: I don't think I can help right now.
translation: 我觉得我现在帮不上忙。

english: I don't think I can make tea with that.
translation: 我觉得我没法用那个泡茶。

english: I don't think I can teach you that - you don't look like bubble casting material to me.
translation: 我觉得我教不了你——你看上去不像能施展泡泡魔法的料。

english: I don't think I can.
translation: 我觉得我做不到。

english: I don't think I need another set, but we will see! Merry Christmas [player name].
translation: 我觉得我不需要另一套了，但走着瞧吧！圣诞快乐，[player name]。

english: I don't think I need any more of these.
translation: 我觉得我不需要更多这些了。

english: I don't think I understood any of that.
translation: 我觉得我一点都没听懂。

english: I don't think I want to go through there right now.
translation: 我觉得我现在不想穿过那里。

english: I don't think I'm quite ready yet.
translation: 我觉得我还没完全准备好。

english: I don't think I'm ready to use this yet.
translation: 我觉得我还没准备好使用这个。

english: I don't think he wants to talk to you.
translation: 我觉得他不想跟你说话。

english: I don't think it was the penguins.
translation: 我觉得不是企鹅干的。

english: I don't think so either! Maybe we should bring him one of these eggs, I'm sure he needs a pick-me-up after all this!
translation: 我也不这么认为！也许我们应该给他带一个这些蛋来，我肯定他在这一切之后需要提提神！

english: I don't think so for the moment. I'm in no need of a date for the pride march.
translation: 目前我不这么想。我不需要为骄傲游行找个伴。

english: I don't think so, I reckon that would take you somewhere between 72 and 74 years even with the new make-all interface. Ask the Wise Old Man, perhaps he has an idea.
translation: 我不这么认为，我估计即使有新的批量制作界面，那也要花你72到74年。去问问老智者吧，也许他有办法。

english: I don't think so, it might animate and attack me!
translation: 我不这么认为，它可能会活过来攻击我！

english: I don't think that cow will try coming back here again in a hurry.
translation: 我觉得那头牛不会急着再回到这里了。

english: I don't think that's wine...
translation: 我觉得那不是酒……

english: I don't think the duke would like it if you stole his chair.
translation: 我觉得如果你偷了公爵的椅子，他不会高兴的。

english: I don't think there are many plants that would appreciate that kind of water...
translation: 我觉得没多少植物会喜欢那种水……

english: I don't think there's anything else worth reading here.
translation: 我觉得这里没什么值得读的了。

english: I don't think this compliments my eyes very well...
translation: 我觉得这个不太配我的眼睛……

english: I don't think this is something I can help with at the moment.
translation: 我觉得这不是我现在能帮忙的事。

english: I don't think we have a venue yet. Cecilia said she would be looking into that.
translation: 我觉得我们还没有场地。塞西莉亚说她会在找。

english: I don't think you have [player name]. I suggest you try looking for it again.
translation: 我觉得你没有，[player name]。我建议你再找找看。

english: I don't think you understand. It's not that he wants a monkey - he wants to save the citizens of Lumbridge from a group of 6 monkeys from Ape Atoll!
translation: 我觉得你没明白。他不是想要一只猴子——他是想从猿猴岛的6只猴子手中拯救仑桥镇的居民！

english: I don't understand? I was mumbling jibberish?
translation: 我不明白？我刚才在胡言乱语？

english: I don't want strange people finding me just now.
translation: 我现在不想让陌生人找到我。

english: I don't want to do that here. I should wait until I've got into the Shantay Pass first.
translation: 我不想在这里做那个。我应该先等到进入沙泰隘口再说。

english: I don't want to do that right now.
translation: 我现在不想做那个。

english: I don't want to eat these. Herquin needs them for the gingerbread gnomes!
translation: 我不想吃这些。赫昆需要它们来做姜饼侏儒！

english: I don't want to know what you were doing with swamp toads, let alone exploding ones.
translation: 我不想听你跟沼泽蟾蜍干了什么，更别提会爆炸的那种了。

english: I don't want to talk about it ever again.
translation: 我再也不想提这件事了。

english: I don't want to talk about it too much. But around Halloween time, I was adventuring, and I came across Death.
translation: 我不想说太多。不过大概在万圣节前后，我在冒险时遇到了死神。

english: I don't want to wear that; I might turn pink too!
translation: 我不想穿那个；说不定我也会变成粉红色！

english: I don't want to wear that; it's just been cleaned!
translation: 我不想穿那个；它刚洗干净！

english: I dont think so... No. No I haven't.
translation: 我不这么认为……不。不，我没有。

english: I double-checked with Santa and it seems his helpers made a mistake, you were meant to be on the nice list all along!
translation: 我跟圣诞老人再三确认过，看来是他的助手搞错了，你本来就应该在好孩子名单上！

english: I doubt that. Out of curiosity, do you know where the egg mould is?
translation: 我表示怀疑。顺便问一下，你知道鸡蛋模具在哪吗？

english: I drank Uncle Humphrey's Gutrot at the Blue Moon Inn.
translation: 我在蓝月酒馆喝了汉弗莱叔叔的穿肠酒。

english: I drank the Ape Bite Liqueur at the Karamja Spirits Bar.
translation: 我在卡拉姆詹岛的精神酒吧喝了猿咬利口酒。

english: I drank the Black Skull Ale at the Rusty Anchor Inn.
translation: 我在拉斯蒂锚旅馆喝了黑颅麦酒。

english: I drank the Fire Brandy at the Dragon Inn.
translation: 我在龙之酒馆喝了火焰白兰地。

english: I drank the Hand of Death cocktail at the Rising Sun Inn.
translation: 我在旭日旅馆喝了死亡之手鸡尾酒。

english: I drank the Heart Stopper at the Flying Horse Inn.
translation: 我在飞马旅馆喝了碎心酒。

english: I drank the Liverbane Ale at the Forester's Arms.
translation: 我在护林人臂弯喝了肝毒麦酒。

english: I drank the Olde Suspiciouse at the Jolly Boar Inn.
translation: 我在欢乐野猪旅馆喝了陈年疑云酒。

english: I drank the Supergrog at the Dead Man's Chest.
translation: 我在死者的宝箱喝了超级烈酒。

english: I drank the a Fire Toad Blast at Blurberry's Bar.
translation: 我在布鲁贝里酒吧喝了一杯火焰蟾蜍炸弹。

english: I dropped four identical stones, into four identical buckets, each containing an identical amount of water.
translation: 我把四块一模一样的石头，丢进了四个一模一样的桶里，每个桶里装着等量的水。

english: I dug through the rubble...
translation: 我挖穿了瓦砾……

english: I entered Neypotzli and encountered Eyatlalli. She gave me a Keystone Fragment which I used to find the Old One Keystone that Ennius and Furia were looking for. However, I wasn't able to stop them before they could take it. Although they got away, they left behind a pair of Emissaries. However, I was able to defeat them.
translation: 我进入了内波茨利监狱并遇到了埃亚特拉利。她给了我一块基石碎片，我用它找到了恩尼乌斯和富里娅正在寻找的古老者基石。然而，我没能阻止他们拿走它。虽然他们逃走了，但留下了两名使者。不过，我击败了他们。

english: I entered some Tunnels from the peak of Trollweiss Mountain and found a way through them into the Fort. Inside I encountered Arrav. He was called away by Zemouregal, but before leaving, he directed me to some Plans hidden behind a Tapestry.
translation: 我从巨魔山脉的山顶进入了一些隧道，并找到了一条通往堡垒的路。在里面我遇到了阿拉夫。他被泽莫雷加尔叫走了，但离开前，他指引我找到了藏在挂毯后面的计划书。

english: I entered the Dungeon below the Twilight Temple and snuck into Metzli's Chamber. There, I overheard her revealing to Furia that she'd moved Itzla elsewhere.
translation: 我进入了暮光神殿下的地牢，并潜入了梅茨利的密室。在那里，我偷听到她向富里娅透露她把伊茨拉转移到了别处。

english: I entered the Ruins below Cam Torum with Jessamine. Zuma and Attala decided to join the expedition as well. Inside, we found a selection of Murals depicting apocalyptic scenes along with an Inscription. I established some Camps elsewhere in the Ruins while Jessamine worked on deciphering the Inscription.
translation: 我和杰萨明一起进入了卡姆托伦下方的废墟。祖玛和阿塔拉也决定加入探险。在里面，我们发现了一系列描绘末日场景的壁画和一段铭文。在杰萨明破译铭文的同时，我在废墟的其他地方建立了一些营地。

english: I err, I'll be back in a second My Arm.
translation: 呃，我马上回来，我的手臂。

english: I err... may have been hiding behind a tree when you came across Death. I saw the whole thing!
translation: 呃……你遇到死神的时候，我可能正躲在树后面。我全都看见了！

english: I errr, guess with the normal cleaning stuff!
translation: 呃，我猜是用普通的清洁用品！

english: I estimate there to be 1 million inhabitants in the world of Gielinor, creatures and people both.
translation: 我估计吉莱诺世界有一百万居民，包括生物和人类。

english: I even changed my name. I was sure nobody would recognize me.
translation: 我甚至改了名字。我确信没人能认出我。

english: I even see Sir Vyvin here, in his clean armour!
translation: 我甚至看到维文爵士也在这里，穿着他干净的盔甲！

english: I exist because I must exist; if I did not, then I would be created again, for the universe requires balance in all things. Many of the deities of this land also exist because their function is required to fulfill the roles they do.
translation: 我存在是因为我必须存在；如果我不存在，那么我会被再次创造，因为宇宙需要万物的平衡。这片土地上的许多神祇也存在，因为他们的功能是履行他们所扮演的角色所必需的。

english: I expect so. Just... don't eat the chocolate. Can you come to my office now, please?
translation: 我想是的。只是……别吃巧克力。你现在能来我办公室一趟吗？

english: I explored Metzli's Chamber and found a Message that might be of use. A Guard found me and took the Message from me, but I was able to defeat him and get it back. The Message revealed the location of a Cultist Safe House in Civitas illa Fortis.
translation: 我探索了梅茨利的密室，找到了一条可能有用的消息。一名守卫发现了我并抢走了消息，但我击败了他并夺了回来。消息揭示了福蒂斯城中一个邪教徒安全屋的位置。

english: I explored the Ancient Temple and found the Stone of Jas. However, upon finding it, I was attacked by some sort of Elemental Creature which I was forced to defeat. I then touched the Stone and was granted a Strange Vision. However, Movario arrived at the same time, shortly followed by Lucien.
translation: 我探索了远古神庙并找到了贾斯之石。然而，在找到它时，我遭到了一种元素生物的攻击，不得不击败它。然后我触摸了石头，获得了一个奇怪的幻象。但莫瓦里奥同时到达，卢西安也紧随其后。

english: I feel bad now though. He's not actually scary, it was just a bit of a shock! I wish there was a way to say sorry.
translation: 不过我现在觉得有点内疚。他其实没那么吓人，只是有点震惊！真希望能有个办法道个歉。

english: I feel horrible, I should have helped!
translation: 我感觉糟透了，我本该帮忙的！

english: I feel it best that you hold onto Jonas' mask. If somehow he does find a way to break free once again, the energy on the mask will surely become active. If this ever happens you must come and see me at once,
translation: 我觉得最好由你保管乔纳斯的面具。万一他真找到办法再次挣脱束缚，面具上的能量肯定会活跃起来。如果发生这种事，你必须立刻来见我。

english: I feel it!
translation: 我感觉到了！

english: I feel like I may be letting down Falador coming over here and partying...
translation: 我觉得跑到这儿来开派对有点辜负法拉多城……

english: I feel like there has to be a better solution to that, but good luck anyway!
translation: 我觉得肯定有更好的解决办法，不过还是祝你好运！

english: I feel like you're not telling me something...
translation: 我觉得你有事瞒着我……

english: I feel ridiculous in this outfit.
translation: 穿这身衣服我觉得自己很可笑。

english: I feel the soul of Jonas is in a fixed state, but I cannot quite sense what has happened. Explain.
translation: 我感觉乔纳斯的灵魂处于一种固定状态，但我无法完全感知发生了什么。解释一下。

english: I felt an incredible burst of energy from the spiritual realm. I arrived just in time to see you dying and was able to save you.
translation: 我感受到来自灵界的一股巨大能量爆发。我刚好赶到，看到你奄奄一息，及时救了你。

english: I figured I'd come and pay my birthday respects to the team that invented me. I wasn't around in the original 2007 game and if it wasn't for them, I may never of existed!
translation: 我想着过来给创造我的团队送上生日祝福。2007年的原版游戏里没有我，要不是他们，我可能根本不会存在！

english: I figured I'd let the ol' girl out for a bit. Those darn boosters kept hitting her whilst they were in the lobby area. Poor girl...
translation: 我想着让这老姑娘出来透透气。那些该死的加速器玩家在休息区老是撞到她。可怜的姑娘……

english: I figured everyone got tired of me shouting my name at them everytime they tried to do a lap and it's a party, 'course I'm going to attend!
translation: 我想大家都烦透了我每次他们跑圈时冲他们喊我的名字，而且这是个派对，我当然要来参加！

english: I finally got around to repairing that statue. You might want to take a look. ... Jogre bones!
translation: 我终于抽出时间修好了那座雕像。你或许该去看看。……乔格雷食人魔骨头！

english: I finished repairing that cake tin for you!
translation: 我帮你修好了那个蛋糕模具！

english: I follow the path of Saradomin.
translation: 我追随萨拉多明的道路。

english: I forgot that the mixing machine is out as well. So now we can't mix the ingredients together to make the fuel.
translation: 我忘了搅拌机也坏了。所以现在我们没法把原料混合在一起制作燃料了。

english: I forgot the pass phrase.
translation: 我忘了口令。

english: I forgot who I was meant to talk to...
translation: 我忘了该跟谁说话……

english: I fought Amoxliatl off until she teleported me out of the Ruins. I then travelled to the Sunrise Palace in Civitas illa Fortis where I encountered Servius. He prepared to pass the news on to the Queen and assured me I'd be involved in the plan to rescue Itzla.
translation: 我和阿莫克斯利亚特尔战斗，直到她把我传送出了废墟。然后我前往福蒂斯城的日出宫殿，在那里遇到了塞尔维乌斯。他准备把消息传给女王，并向我保证我会参与营救伊茨拉的计划。

english: I found Fox by a Chasm near the Locus Oasis, but he'd been attacked. He asked me to make a Poultice for him.
translation: 我在绿洲裂隙附近找到了福克斯，但他遭到了袭击。他让我给他做个药膏。

english: I found Jossik in an underground cavern, behind a strange wall where he had been attacked by some sea creatures.
translation: 我发现乔西克在一个地下洞穴里，躲在一堵奇怪的墙后面，他遭到了某些海洋生物的攻击。

english: I found Movario in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. By disguising myself as the Dark Squall, I managed to convince him that I was there to help him find the Stone of Jas.
translation: 我在仑桥镇沼泽洞穴里找到了莫瓦里奥。通过伪装成黑风暴，我成功让他相信我是来帮他找贾斯之石的。

english: I found Nickolaus within the cave system of the mountain. It seems that he had been abducted by giant eagles. Nickolaus suggested making an eagle disguise to try and infiltrate the eagles' nest. He recommended that I talk to the owner of the fancy dress shop in Varrock who may be able to help me. I should take some suitable materials with me; there are plenty of giant feathers around the nest that I could take.
translation: 我在山里的洞穴系统中找到了尼古拉斯。他似乎被巨型鹰绑架了。尼古拉斯建议制作一个鹰的伪装，试图潜入鹰巢。他建议我去找维洛克城戏服店的老板，也许他能帮我。我应该带些合适的材料去；巢穴周围有很多巨型羽毛可以拿。

english: I found a camp-site in the area where Nickolaus was expected to have been, but it looked like it had been abandoned in a hurry. Looking around the campsite I found a small metal feather inside a book about birds. Maybe if I can find out what this is for then I can find Nickolaus.
translation: 我在尼古拉斯预计会出现的地方找到了一个营地，但看起来是匆忙遗弃的。在营地周围查看时，我在一本关于鸟类的书里找到了一根小金属羽毛。也许我能弄清楚这是干什么用的，然后就能找到尼古拉斯了。

english: I found a clean vat this time, how convenient! I thought I would have to find another bottle of cleaning potion, but here we are!
translation: 这次我找到了一个干净的大桶，真方便！我还以为得再找一瓶清洁药水呢，结果这就有了！

english: I found a little memento of our adventure for you, as well as some more mundane Halloween-themed rewards. Let's see what you can carry...
translation: 我给你找了一个我们冒险的小纪念品，还有一些更普通的万圣节主题奖励。看看你能带多少……

english: I found a part of the cliff that looked out of place compared to the rest of the mountain. Upon closer inspection, this turned out to be a secret passage, unlocked by the metal feather I had found earlier. Maybe if I go into the mountain then I will find out what Nickolaus was up to.
translation: 我发现悬崖上有一部分看起来和山体其他地方格格不入。仔细一看，原来是一条秘密通道，用我之前找到的金属羽毛就能打开。也许我进到山里面就能知道尼古拉斯在搞什么鬼了。

english: I found a strange casket on the dead body of a sea monster, which Jossik said he could tell me about.
translation: 我在一只海怪的尸体上发现了一个奇怪的宝箱，乔西克说他知道这是怎么回事。

english: I found a suit in that wardrobe.
translation: 我在那个衣柜里找到了一套衣服。

english: I found it! Is it still okay to use?
translation: 我找到了！还能用吗？

english: I found it! They buried it next to the drain outside the pub.
translation: 我找到了！他们把它埋在酒馆外面的排水沟旁边。

english: I found out about the symbol...
translation: 我查明了那个符号的来历……

english: I found some Research Notes within the Hidden Base and took them to Thaerisk in Taverley.
translation: 我在隐藏基地里找到了一些研究笔记，并把它们带给了塔韦利村的赛里斯克。

english: I found the e- I mean, Archibald.
translation: 我找到了那个……呃，我是说阿奇博尔德。

english: I found the island where Abigale and her friends were attacked.
translation: 我找到了阿比盖尔和她的朋友们遇袭的那个岛。

english: I found this spectral masked stranger in 6 locations, performing different actions at each. It looks like he is doing something with potions.
translation: 我在6个地点发现了这个幽灵般的蒙面陌生人，每个地点他都在做不同的事。看起来他正在用药水做些什么。

english: I froze it.
translation: 我把它冻住了。

english: I froze your milk!
translation: 我把你的牛奶冻住了！

english: I gave Carol her old gift but she says that was the past and she is focussed on business now.
translation: 我把旧礼物给了卡罗尔，但她说那都是过去的事了，她现在专注于生意。

english: I gave General Wartface and General Bentnoze some of the original Brown Goblin Mail, and it turned out to be their favourite. They're clearly not the smartest, but that's goblins for you.
translation: 我给了疣脸将军和弯鼻将军一些原始的棕色哥布林链甲，结果发现这是他们的最爱。他们显然不是最聪明的，但哥布林就是这样。

english: I gave it to the generals and they loved it.
translation: 我把它给了将军们，他们很喜欢。

english: I gave no such order. Round up the centurions! We have a traitor among us.
translation: 我没下过这种命令。把百夫长们都集合起来！我们中间有叛徒。

english: I gave some Blue Goblin Mail to General Wartface and General Bentnoze, but they didn't like it. They asked me to bring them some of their original Brown Goblin Mail to try out instead.
translation: 我给了疣脸将军和弯鼻将军一些蓝色哥布林链甲，但他们不喜欢。他们让我带一些他们原来的棕色哥布林链甲来试试。

english: I gave some Orange Goblin Mail to General Wartface and General Bentnoze, but they didn't like it. They asked me to bring them some Blue Goblin Mail to try out instead.
translation: 我给了疣脸将军和弯鼻将军一些橙色哥布林链甲，但他们不喜欢。他们让我带一些蓝色哥布林链甲来试试。

english: I gave you a box. Use the box on a coal rock. It will absorb the coal and create the useless lumps that I seek. Then bring it back to me.
translation: 我给了你一个盒子。把盒子用在煤岩上。它会吸收煤炭，制造出我需要的无用煤块。然后把它带回来给我。

english: I gave you some enchanted cloth, if you recall. You should get it covered in snow so that it resembles a snow imp's pelt.
translation: 我给你了一些附魔布料，如果你还记得的话。你应该让它沾满雪，这样它看起来就像雪精的毛皮了。

english: I gave you two pumpkins and two mask sets containing the red, green and blue Halloween masks.
translation: 我给了你两个南瓜和两套面具，包括红色、绿色和蓝色的万圣节面具。

english: I got some of both.
translation: 我两种都弄到了一些。

english: I got the fancy dress shop owner to make me an eagle disguise so that I could trick the eagles and get into their nest. I gave a disguise to Nickolaus so that he could escape the nest. I still need to get him to capture a ferret for the zookeeper.
translation: 我让戏服店老板给我做了一套鹰的伪装，这样我就能骗过老鹰进入它们的巢穴。我给了尼古拉斯一套伪装，让他能逃出巢穴。我还需要让他去给动物园管理员抓一只雪貂。

english: I got the key!
translation: 我拿到钥匙了！

english: I got the presents!
translation: 我拿到礼物了！

english: I grew up with Eric - he's the most boring man in Gielinor. After a Halloween treat from Eric, the only screams you'll get from those children will be cries of boredom. What's his plan?
translation: 我和埃里克一起长大——他是吉莱诺最无聊的人。吃了埃里克的万圣节糖果，那些孩子只会无聊得尖叫。他到底想干嘛？

english: I guess I can help, just one last time.
translation: 我想我可以帮忙，就这最后一次。

english: I guess I'd better give Chocco the bad news... I hope he likes his eggs scrambled.
translation: 我想我最好去告诉乔科这个坏消息……希望他喜欢炒蛋。

english: I guess I'll head home then.
translation: 那我想我就回家吧。

english: I guess it is a little farfetched, especially coming from a human... Maybe you can turn yourself a ghost or something?
translation: 我想这确实有点离谱，尤其是从一个人类嘴里说出来……也许你可以把自己变成幽灵什么的？

english: I guess it's time for the walk of shame. I'll get back to my things and take this armour off. I'm not big enough to fill it.
translation: 我想是时候灰溜溜地走了。我去收拾东西，把这身盔甲脱了。我个头不够大，撑不起来。

english: I guess so, I want one wrapped in the stripy coloured paper, I always like those.
translation: 我想是的，我想要一个用条纹彩纸包的，我一直很喜欢那种。

english: I guess so. What is it?
translation: 我想是吧。是什么事？

english: I guess that'd be ok. Now, about those costumes. Is it something you'd be able to help with?
translation: 我想那也行。那么，关于那些服装。你能帮上忙吗？

english: I guess that's true. I hope you enjoy yourself!
translation: 我想确实如此。希望你玩得开心！

english: I guess you do deserve good, just like everyone else. Why don't I teach you about Christmas?
translation: 我想你也确实应该得到好东西，就像其他人一样。不如我来教你关于圣诞节的事？

english: I guess! So don't feel too bad. I'm doing well now, and I've even leveled up quite a bit since then!
translation: 我想是吧！所以别太难过了。我现在过得很好，而且从那以后我还升了不少级呢！

english: I guess... Chocolate, eggs and bunnies, Easter is what it is.
translation: 我猜……巧克力、彩蛋和兔子，复活节就是这样。

english: I guess... wait, what's that on the ground there?
translation: 我猜……等等，地上那是什么？

english: I guess... you're not going to kill me are you?
translation: 我猜……你不会杀了我吧？

english: I had a coupon for this, but I've misplaced it.
translation: 我本来有张优惠券的，但我弄丢了。

english: I had a look around the Museum and found evidence that the Diadem had been stolen by a Professional Thief. I asked around and someone mentioned they saw a Suspicious-Looking Person leaving the Museum before heading to the nearby Quetzal Landing Site.
translation: 我在博物馆里查看了一番，找到了王冠被一个职业盗贼偷走的证据。我四处打听，有人说看到一个形迹可疑的人离开博物馆，然后前往附近的绿咬鹃着陆点。

english: I had a look around the home of the Distressed Couple and found a Scratched Wall with a trail of Strange Puddles leading away. I followed these Puddles and found a Scrap of Fabric.
translation: 我在那对苦恼夫妇的家里看了看，发现一面有划痕的墙，还有一串奇怪的水洼通向远处。我顺着这些水洼找去，找到了一块织物碎片。

english: I had a plan. It was a great plan.
translation: 我有个计划。一个绝妙的计划。

english: I had a scout around while you were finishing the pie. I've found six suitable trees.
translation: 趁你吃完馅饼的时候，我四处侦察了一下。找到了六棵合适的树。

english: I had an inkling, but I wasnt sure. I'm glad it worked out.
translation: 我隐约有点感觉，但不太确定。很高兴事情顺利解决了。

english: I had everything prepared! The eggs, the baskets - I even straightened my ears before I got here.
translation: 我什么都准备好了！鸡蛋、篮子——来之前我甚至还把耳朵捋直了。

english: I had fun solving them! I have lost my festive holly though, could I have some more?
translation: 解谜很有趣！不过我的节日冬青丢了，能再给我一些吗？

english: I had fun solving them. Some of them were pretty difficult!
translation: 解谜很有趣。有些还挺难的！

english: I had plans for something, a little different for my girlfriend this year. You know, something less cliché.
translation: 我今年打算给女朋友准备点不一样的。你知道的，不那么老套的东西。

english: I had the report... but I've lost it somewhere.
translation: 报告我本来有的……但不知道丢哪儿了。

english: I had to, you went all weird and froze again.
translation: 我不得不这么做，你又变得怪怪的，还僵住了。

english: I harvested the Enriched Snapdragon and used it to make some new Truth Serum. I then administered the Truth Serum to the Spy and he provided details on an individual known as the Dark Squall.
translation: 我收获了超级金鱼草，用它制作了一些新的吐真剂。然后我给间谍服用了吐真剂，他提供了关于一个被称为黑风暴的人的情报。

english: I hath many plans for this world, for it is crucial in mine experiments. Some day thou may see what mine purpose is, but for now, I shall keep it secret to all for fear that knowledge of my intentions may change the observations which I must make in mine experiment.
translation: 我对这个世界有很多计划，因为它对我的实验至关重要。也许有一天你会看到我的目的是什么，但现在，我会对所有保密，因为我担心我的意图被知晓可能会改变我在实验中必须进行的观察。

english: I hath no race, I am unique in all of the worlds. I am simply Guthix.
translation: 我没有种族，在所有世界中我是独一无二的。我就是古斯。

english: I hath no symbol of mine own, for acceptance of my beliefs is not a choice of itself; it is rather a rejection of the choices forced upon thee by mine brethren. To follow in the balance is to dismiss the notion that thou must be aligned either one way or the other, or that thou must only take one path in thy life and stray no further. In the past certain of my followers have created their own symbols to honour me, for although it seems improper to possess such a symbol in mine own eyes, I dictate not to mine followers how best to proceed other than to guide them in the ways of balance. It is not entirely beyond the realms of possibility that some day my ancient symbol may be rediscovered, but I hold no desire that it should be so. I wouldst prefer mine followers to bring me honour in their actions, not in their apparel.
translation: 我没有自己的圣徽，因为接受我的信仰本身并非一种选择；它更像是对我的同胞强加给你的选择的拒绝。追随平衡就是摒弃你必须要么倒向这边要么倒向那边的观念，或者你一生只能走一条路而不能偏离。过去，我的一些追随者创造了他们自己的圣徽来尊崇我，因为尽管在我看来拥有这样的圣徽似乎不妥，但我不会指示我的追随者如何最好地行事，除了引导他们走上平衡之道。也许有一天我的古老圣徽会被重新发现，这并非完全不可能，但我并不希望如此。我更希望我的追随者通过他们的行动，而不是他们的服饰来给我带来荣耀。

english: I have V's Shield for you here [player name]. Bear it with honour.
translation: 我这里有 V 的盾要给你，[player name]。带着它，荣耀地使用它。

english: I have V's Shield for you here [player name]. Come back to me once you have room for it.
translation: 我这里有 V 的盾要给你，[player name]。等你腾出空间再来找我拿吧。

english: I have a bit of a problem, I've dropped some of the armour!
translation: 我有点麻烦，我把一些盔甲弄掉了！

english: I have a couple of questions.
translation: 我有几个问题。

english: I have a coupon for this!
translation: 我有这个的优惠券！

english: I have a delivery for you from Little Mo.
translation: 我替小莫给你送个东西。

english: I have a food order!
translation: 我有个食物订单！

english: I have a friend, a very wise old Dwarf, who might know what is wrong. Unfortunately, I can't leave the altar at such a critical time. May I ask you consult him on our behalf?
translation: 我有个朋友，一位非常睿智的老矮人，他可能知道问题出在哪里。不幸的是，在这个关键时刻我不能离开祭坛。能请你替我们去请教他吗？

english: I have a gift for you, it's from all of us. Make sure you open it once you leave the grotto!
translation: 我有个礼物给你，是我们大家的心意。记得离开洞穴后再打开！

english: I have a map here that I used to plant the original picture. If I gave it to you, would you harvest the incorrect pumpkins for me? You can throw them to me and I'll place them in this storage bin.
translation: 我这里有一张地图，我当初就是用它来种出原图的。如果我把它给你，你能帮我把种错的南瓜收掉吗？你可以把它们扔给我，我会放进这个储存箱里。

english: I have a new job for you.
translation: 我有份新工作给你。

english: I have a nice banana here. Would that prove it?
translation: 我这里有一根不错的香蕉。这能证明吗？

english: I have a plan! Last Halloween, that Diango fellow sold me a 'Phantasmic Destabliser Mark 500'. He said they were brilliant, and he only wanted 1,000,000 coins.
translation: 我有个计划！去年万圣节，那个叫迪亚戈的家伙卖给我一个‘幻象稳定器500型’。他说这东西棒极了，而且只要一百万金币。

english: I have a present for you!
translation: 我有个礼物给你！

english: I have a rather sandy problem that I'd like to palm off on you.
translation: 我有个挺麻烦的沙子问题，想甩给你处理。

english: I have a strong hunch that he wouldn't do anything at all, he's a nice guy.
translation: 我强烈预感他什么都不会做，他是个好人。

english: I have a time bubble which we can use to trap Jonas. We just need to hold him in place so I can use it on him.
translation: 我有一个时间泡泡，可以用来困住乔纳斯。我们只需要把他定住，我就能对他使用它。

english: I have a very bad feeling about what will happen when my sister finds out the whole truth.
translation: 我对我妹妹知道全部真相后会发生什么有种非常不好的预感。

english: I have actually heard about them, so the word gets around! It will have to be for another occasion, however.
translation: 我其实听说过它们，消息传得真快！不过，只能等下次机会了。

english: I have all the boxes of puppets I need now, thank you.
translation: 我现在有所有需要的木偶盒子了，谢谢你。

english: I have all the items now. Festive cinnamon, festive white wine, and festive holly!
translation: 我现在所有物品都齐了。节日肉桂、节日白葡萄酒，还有节日冬青！

english: I have already searched this place.
translation: 我已经搜过这个地方了。

english: I have also come across the Lost City of Zanaris, and all it has to offer. I have also been in the marketplace there, and there I had come across a fairy named Jakut, who was selling swords of a type of metal called Dragon. The fairy had also told me that these weapons were from a realm called "Frenaskae" or something similar to that effect, however the name or spelling eludes me at this point in time. The guardians of Armadyl who I have also helped in my travels have also told me about this place briefly, but I cannot remember if they said it was a place or person. Either way, it is all very mysterious to me. This realm or person must hold extreme power if they have these weapons made of this material called Dragon that is even more powerful than the Runite or Rune metal we know on RuneScape. Is anything known about this place or person, whatever it may be?
translation: 我还发现了失落之城扎纳里斯城及其所提供的一切。我也去过那里的市场，在那里我遇到了一个名叫贾库特的仙子，他在卖一种叫做龙金属的剑。那个仙子还告诉我这些武器来自一个叫做“弗瑞内斯卡”或类似名字的领域，但名字或拼写我现在想不起来了。我在旅途中帮助过的阿玛杜尔的守护者也简短地告诉过我这个地方，但我记不清他们说的是一个地方还是一个人。无论如何，这一切对我来说都非常神秘。如果这些由叫做龙的金属制成的武器比我们在符文之地所知的符文金属还要强大，那么这个领域或人一定拥有极端的力量。关于这个地方或人，无论它是什么，有什么已知的信息吗？

english: I have also lost the bucket of camel milk...
translation: 我还把那一桶骆驼奶也弄丢了……

english: I have an answer for your challenge!
translation: 我有你挑战的答案！

english: I have an answer!
translation: 我有答案了！

english: I have another question.
translation: 我还有个问题。

english: I have been sending a disturbance in the force.
translation: 我一直在发送原力中的扰动。

english: I have been working on my magic level, hoping to get to 80, so that i can cast flames of zamorak, but so far i have only been able to get to level 31, if it is not to much to ask, could you give me any tips on raising my magic?
translation: 我一直在提升我的魔法等级，希望能到80级，这样我就能施放扎莫拉克之火了，但到目前为止我只升到了31级。如果不太麻烦的话，你能给我一些提升魔法的建议吗？

english: I have better things to do than help you all day.
translation: 我还有比整天帮你更重要的事要做。

english: I have both a husband and daughter.
translation: 我既有丈夫也有女儿。

english: I have brought you someone who seems to be in need of your advice.
translation: 我给你带来了一个似乎需要你建议的人。

english: I have come a long way just to get here, it would be a shame to quit now!
translation: 我大老远来到这里，现在放弃太可惜了！

english: I have confronted the killer, and now they must be defeated.
translation: 我已经和杀手对质过了，现在必须击败他们。

english: I have feet! I am alive goblin!
translation: 我有脚！我是活生生的哥布林！

english: I have found no task truly impossible if you have capable allies. Even if they do spend their stay in a loungechair.
translation: 我发现只要有能干的盟友，就没有真正不可能的任务。即使他们大部分时间都躺在躺椅上。

english: I have found some chocolate chips. One bag!
translation: 我找到了一些巧克力片。一袋！

english: I have found some chocolate chips. Two bags!
translation: 我找到了一些巧克力片。两袋！

english: I have given the cook a bucket of milk.
translation: 我已经给了厨师一桶牛奶。

english: I have given the cook a pot of flour.
translation: 我已经给了厨师一罐面粉。

english: I have given the cook an egg.
translation: 我已经给了厨师一个鸡蛋。

english: I have great news! The Lumbridge cake won the Cake Off!
translation: 好消息！仑桥镇的蛋糕赢得了蛋糕大赛！

english: I have guests coming for my Halloween party, and I will be humiliated if they see the house in this state. I cannot evict him alone; there are influential figures who might see it as... obstreperous.
translation: 我有客人要来参加我的万圣节派对，如果他们看到房子这个样子，我会很丢脸。我不能一个人赶他走；有些有影响力的人可能会认为这……太吵闹了。

english: I have had my eyes on this woman for awhile... her mysterious concoctions just wift through my window. Irresistable!
translation: 我注意这个女人有一阵子了……她那些神秘的药剂总是飘进我的窗户。真是难以抗拒！

english: I have heard a little, but I think Katrine is tougher.
translation: 我听说过一点，但我认为卡特琳更厉害。

english: I have heard from all of the visiting dignitaries, and all of them have appreciated your involvement in their events.
translation: 我收到了所有来访贵宾的反馈，他们都很感谢你参与他们的活动。

english: I have heard rumours of some spectral occurrences around Varrock. More specifically, three within the city itself, and three more to the areas south of the city walls.
translation: 我听说维洛克城附近发生了一些幽灵事件。更具体地说，城内有三起，城墙以南的区域还有三起。

english: I have heard rumours that you kill people.
translation: 我听说谣言，说你杀人。

english: I have however, lost the bucket of camel milk...
translation: 不过，我把那一桶骆驼奶弄丢了……

english: I have indeed! Why don't you have a look?
translation: 我确实有！你为什么不看看呢？

english: I have indeed. This one is most agreeable.
translation: 我确实有。这个非常合意。

english: I have it here for you, Mo has been busy so I'm helping him out.
translation: 我替你拿来了，莫一直很忙，所以我来帮他。

english: I have it right here. Are you really going to eat it?
translation: 就在我这儿。你真的要吃它吗？

english: I have it with me.
translation: 我随身带着呢。

english: I have lost my festive white wine though, could I have some more?
translation: 不过我的节日白葡萄酒丢了，能再给我一些吗？

english: I have lost my hat, it is the source of everything that makes me what I am.
translation: 我弄丢了我的帽子，它是我之所以为我的力量源泉。

english: I have lost the treasure chest.
translation: 我把宝箱弄丢了。

english: I have manufactured a few items of clothing out of my flowers before. If you would kindly pick some of each flower for me, I could make you a cape.
translation: 我以前用我的花做过几件衣服。如果你好心帮我每种花都采一些，我可以给你做一件披风。

english: I have met with Gilbert, just west of Varrock, who is planning to remodel a glade as a meeting point for those who want to find their true self.
translation: 我见过吉尔伯特了，就在维洛克城西边，他正计划改造一片林间空地，作为那些想寻找真我的人的聚会点。

english: I have misplaced a present.
translation: 我放错了一个礼物。

english: I have no idea what that sounds like, but I trust you.
translation: 我不知道那听起来像什么，但我相信你。

english: I have no idea what this thing is, and no idea who to ask about it. Maybe I need to embark on a quest to find out...
translation: 我完全不知道这是什么东西，也不知道该问谁。也许我需要踏上一次冒险去查明真相……

english: I have no idea which god to side with. Zamorak? Saradomin? You? Or stick with being an atheist?
translation: 我不知道该支持哪个神。扎莫拉克？萨拉多明？你？还是坚持做个无神论者？

english: I have no idea. I'm new here, I just came from Tutorial Island.
translation: 我不知道。我是新来的，刚从教程岛过来。

english: I have no interest in the currency of men, I fulfill my role answering questions as it enables all to see my wisdom and serves to show good reason why they should choose to follow their lives in my name.
translation: 我对人类的货币毫无兴趣，我履行职责回答问题，因为这能让所有人看到我的智慧，并充分证明他们为何应该选择以我的名义度过一生。

english: I have no reason to do that.
translation: 我没有理由那么做。

english: I have no space at the moment. I'll come back in a minute when I've freed up some room.
translation: 我现在没地方了。等我腾出点空间，过一会儿再来。

english: I have no time to sleep, I am a busy deity! As such I have no pillows, but I do indeed enjoy bananas, fresh from Karamja.
translation: 我没时间睡觉，我可是个忙碌的神祇！所以我没有枕头，但我确实喜欢香蕉，刚从卡拉姆詹岛运来的那种。

english: I have not been plundering, I have been Trick-or- Treating properly!
translation: 我没有在抢劫，我是在正经地玩‘不给糖就捣蛋’！

english: I have other questions for you.
translation: 我还有其他问题要问你。

english: I have passed my first Earth Science exam.
translation: 我通过了第一次地球科学考试。

english: I have passed my second Earth Science exam.
translation: 我通过了第二次地球科学考试。

english: I have personally done a lot of soul-searching before realising that my purpose was here, in bringing colour to this world.
translation: 我亲自进行了很多深刻的自我反省，才意识到我的使命就在这里，为这个世界带来色彩。

english: I have proof one of the family lied about the poison.
translation: 我有证据证明家族中有人对毒药的事撒了谎。

english: I have re-tarred the lighthouse torch.
translation: 我已经重新给灯塔火把涂了焦油。

english: I have read the book cover to cover, and memorised everything! I've also lost it!
translation: 我把这本书从头到尾读了一遍，并且记住了所有内容！不过我也把它弄丢了！

english: I have read the book. I think that you're a bit off the mark, it's all about easter!
translation: 我读过这本书。我觉得你有点搞错了，这全是关于复活节的！

english: I have reinvented the meaning of a cake. Observe the exceptional textures of the crunchy.
translation: 我重新定义了蛋糕的意义。观察一下这脆饼非凡的质地。

english: I have relit the lighthouse torch.
translation: 我已经重新点燃了灯塔火把。

english: I have returned to you with the Ring of Charos.
translation: 我带着查罗斯之戒回来找你了。

english: I have returned with what you asked me to retrieve. As I see your inventory is full, I shall wait with these [number] items until you are ready.
translation: 我已带回你要求的东西。但见你的背包已满，我会带着这[number]件物品等你准备好。

english: I have seen adventurers sporting a wide range of interesting get-ups no matter the season.
translation: 我见过冒险者们无论什么季节都穿着各种有趣的装束。

english: I have seen that for each of the gods, or most of them, they have a symbol to depict themselves, or for adventurers to wear when worshiping the gods.
