Saradomin has a Holy Symbol adventurers can wear, and so does Zamorak, although Unholy. But I am puzzled, why do you not have a symbol? Surely your followers would want to wear your symbol with pride, would they not? It would also help your followers in times of need.
translation: 我注意到，每位神祇——或者说大部分神祇——都有代表自己的象征物，供冒险者在崇拜时佩戴。萨拉多明有冒险者可以佩戴的神圣护符，扎莫拉克也有，尽管是不洁的。但我很困惑，为什么你没有象征物？你的信徒们肯定想自豪地佩戴你的象征物，不是吗？这也能在危难时刻帮助你的信徒。

english: I have seen the adverts, and I am preeeeetty sure that is a scam. I don't want to be one of those people that fall for them.
translation: 我见过那些广告，而且我非非非非常确定那是个骗局。我可不想成为那些上当受骗的人之一。

english: I have seized the Sage just as I have claimed this League.
translation: 我已经抓住了智者，就像我占领了这个联盟一样。

english: I have shielded it. It will do you no harm.
translation: 我已经把它屏蔽了。它不会伤害你的。

english: I have some chocolate kebbit chunks to give you.
translation: 我有一些巧克力凯比特兔块要给你。

english: I have some enchanted chocolate kebbit chunks to give you.
translation: 我有一些附魔的巧克力凯比特兔块要给你。

english: I have some fletching experience... I'll be right back!
translation: 我有点制箭经验……我马上回来！

english: I have some food for you to cook!
translation: 我有一些食物要你烹饪！

english: I have some items that I need some help with.
translation: 我有一些物品需要帮忙处理。

english: I have some painted baubles for you.
translation: 我有一些彩绘小饰品给你。

english: I have space for it!
translation: 我有地方放它！

english: I have spoken to Abigale, she and her friends were attacked on an island just off the coast of Lumbridge swamp.
translation: 我和阿比盖尔谈过了，她和她的朋友们在仑桥镇沼泽海岸附近的一个岛上遭到了袭击。

english: I have sprites!
translation: 我有小精灵！

english: I have that festive holly right here, I made sure to pick the most festive bunch for you.
translation: 我这儿就有节日冬青，我特意为你挑了最喜庆的一束。

english: I have the cloth all snowy.
translation: 我把布料弄得全是雪。

english: I have the complete jester's costume.
translation: 我有一套完整的小丑服装。

english: I have the magic spell for it, but I need a flower seed of each colour to power the spell.
translation: 我有对应的魔法咒语，但我需要每种颜色的花种来为咒语充能。

english: I have the rabbit mould!
translation: 我有兔子模具！

english: I have the report right here!
translation: 报告就在我这儿！

english: I have the saucepan here though, will you return it to the chef for me?
translation: 不过平底锅在我这儿，你能帮我把它还给厨师吗？

english: I have the tincture and breathing salts.
translation: 我有药剂和呼吸盐了。

english: I have this big fish. Is it enough to win?
translation: 我有这条大鱼。够赢了吗？

english: I have this dirty vat.
translation: 我有这个脏兮兮的大桶。

english: I have this sauce...
translation: 我有这个酱料……

english: I have this special fabric, can you make me a snow imp costume?
translation: 我有这种特殊织物，你能帮我做一套雪人小恶魔服装吗？

english: I have to be going now.
translation: 我得走了。

english: I have to get out! I can't live my life down here! I have to find a way out!
translation: 我得出去！我不能一辈子待在这下面！我必须找到出路！

english: I have to stop this. I can't let you take Christmas.
translation: 我必须阻止这一切。我不能让你夺走圣诞节。

english: I have to stop this. I can't let you take Christmas. Even though you can't really take it because it's not a physical thing.
translation: 我必须阻止这一切。我不能让你夺走圣诞节。虽然你其实也夺不走，因为它又不是个实物。

english: I have two of the seeds now! Red and orange.
translation: 我现在有两颗种子了！红色和橙色。

english: I have, he has something we can use. I just need to make some space for it.
translation: 我有，他有我们能用的东西。我只需要腾出点空间来放它。

english: I have, yes!
translation: 我有，没错！

english: I have. They didn't trust me at first, so I showed them the special hot sauce.
translation: 我有。他们一开始不信任我，所以我就给他们看了特制辣酱。

english: I haven't actually made my way through everything here yet... However he did ask that you go and speak to him.
translation: 我其实还没把这里的东西都看完……不过他确实让你去找他谈谈。

english: I haven't built a snowman in ages, it should be fun!
translation: 我好久没堆过雪人了，应该会很好玩！

english: I haven't cooked the snake yet.
translation: 我还没煮那条蛇。

english: I haven't finished cooking yet.
translation: 我还没做完饭。

english: I haven't found any yet!
translation: 我一个都还没找到！

english: I haven't found them yet!
translation: 我还没找到它们！

english: I haven't got any of the items yet.
translation: 我一件物品都还没拿到。

english: I haven't grown any watermelons this year, but maybe we can solve two problems in one go and use one of the wrong pumpkins.
translation: 我今年没种西瓜，不过也许我们可以一举两得，用那些长错的南瓜之一。

english: I haven't had ANY Easter eggs this year. Can I have one of yours?
translation: 我今年一个复活节彩蛋都没拿到。能给我一个你的吗？

english: I haven't heard that name in a long time. I had hoped I would never hear it again. Tell me what happened. What fool unleashed him upon this world?
translation: 我很久没听到那个名字了。我本以为再也不会听到。告诉我发生了什么。是哪个蠢货把他放出来祸害这个世界的？

english: I haven't lost it yet m'gell. You get on with your work. I'll help [player name].
translation: 我还没弄丢呢，小姐。你继续忙你的吧。我来帮[player name]。

english: I haven't really had that issue myself so it's not something I've ever had to solve. Kebabs don't really melt.
translation: 我自己倒没遇到过这个问题，所以也不是我需要解决的事。烤肉串又不会融化。

english: I haven't seen you around here, where are you from?
translation: 我在这附近没见过你，你是从哪儿来的？

english: I haven't started it yet, and I've lost the cooler.
translation: 我还没开始，而且我把冷却器弄丢了。

english: I haven't started it yet.
translation: 我还没开始呢。

english: I haven't thought about this yet! Do you have any recommendations?
translation: 我还没想过这个呢！你有什么推荐吗？

english: I haven't tried that yet since I didn't want to give our plan away.
translation: 我还没试过，因为我不想暴露我们的计划。

english: I hear Duke Horacio in Lumbridge is welcoming all Trick-or-Treaters with a generous supply of treats!
translation: 我听说仑桥镇的霍拉西奥公爵正在慷慨地招待所有来玩‘不给糖就捣蛋’的人！

english: I hear Party Pete in Falador loves a bit of Trick-or- Treating and has plenty of treats to hand out!
translation: 我听说法拉多城的派对皮特很喜欢‘不给糖就捣蛋’，而且有很多糖果可以发！

english: I hear him now. This is progress. Temple complete. To the mountain? Of course Master. We'll come to you. Scaly and strong.
translation: 我现在听到他了。有进展了。神殿完工。去山上？当然，主人。我们会来找你。鳞甲坚韧。

english: I hear him play the same game every day with different people, and he always wins. Today, we will change that.
translation: 我听说他每天都和不同的人玩同一个游戏，而且他总是赢。今天，我们要改变这一点。

english: I hear people whisper of potions...
translation: 我听到有人在悄悄谈论药水……

english: I hear pet cats are getting popular these days. I'd like some raw rat in case I get one. I still need [number].
translation: 听说最近宠物猫很流行。我想弄些生老鼠肉，万一我弄到一只猫呢。我还需要[number]个。

english: I hear something, it sounds very faint.
translation: 我听到什么声音，听起来很微弱。

english: I hear the Lumbridge Guide is welcoming all Trick-or- Treaters with a generous supply of treats!
translation: 我听说仑桥镇向导正在慷慨地招待所有来玩‘不给糖就捣蛋’的人！

english: I hear the Town crier in Falador loves a bit of Trick- or-Treating and has plenty of treats to hand out!
translation: 我听说法拉多城的城镇传令官很喜欢‘不给糖就捣蛋’，而且有很多糖果可以发！

english: I hear the name Zaros many times in queries unto myself, yet as I hath previously stated, the name holds no significance for me. Whatever purpose he held upon this realm has long since decayed, and whatever events that transpired occurred during mine slumbers. As loathe as I am to say this, should thou have questions of this being, thou must listen to the words of either Saradomin or Zamorak, yet be aware that the truth of the matter will lie somewhere between both of their answers. As for thy concerns that the other deities of this realm might someday combine to exert their powers on this world, this will not happen and I refute thy claim that I am powerless...
translation: 我在向自己祈祷时多次听到扎罗斯这个名字，但正如我之前所说，这个名字对我毫无意义。无论他曾在这个领域扮演什么角色，都早已腐朽；无论发生过什么事，都发生在我沉睡期间。虽然我很不愿意这么说，但如果你对这个存在有疑问，你必须去听萨拉多明或扎莫拉克的话，但要知道，真相往往介于他们两人的回答之间。至于你担心这个领域的其他神祇有朝一日会联合起来对这个世界施加力量，这不会发生，而且我驳斥你关于我无能为力的说法……

english: I hear you, young one. Care to talk? I have a lot of time on my hands.
translation: 我听到你了，小家伙。想聊聊吗？我时间多得很。

english: I heard of the Diamonds of Azzanadra.
translation: 我听说过阿扎纳德拉钻石。

english: I heard of their location from a friend, who heard from his friend, who heard from her friend, who told him what they'd heard from their sister who heard from a passerby.
translation: 我从一个朋友那里听说了它们的位置，他是从他朋友那里听说的，他朋友又是从她朋友那里听说的，她朋友告诉了他从她姐姐那里听来的消息，而她姐姐是从一个路人那里听说的。

english: I heard some people can talk to ghosts.
translation: 我听说有些人能和幽灵说话。

english: I heard there was a powerful necromancer south of Falador who accidentally created a giant mole, perhaps he'll know something.
translation: 我听说法拉多城以南有个强大的死灵法师，不小心造出了一只巨型鼹鼠，也许他知道些什么。

english: I heard there'd be a fishing contest 'round here, so I came to win it.
translation: 我听说这儿附近有场钓鱼大赛，所以我来赢下它。

english: I heard you are trying to take Christmas.
translation: 我听说你想夺走圣诞节。

english: I heard you needed help making a choice? What kind of dog are you interested in?
translation: 我听说你需要帮忙做选择？你对哪种狗感兴趣？

english: I heard you played a hand in helping to make it happen.
translation: 我听说你帮忙促成了这件事。

english: I heard you're on the naughty list! This is the only present you'll be getting this year!
translation: 我听说你上了淘气名单！这是你今年唯一能得到的礼物了！

english: I helped mine through a Blockage in the Ruins. However, some Nagua ambushed us on the other side, separating myself and Itzla.
translation: 我帮我的那个通过了废墟里的堵塞物。然而，一些纳瓜人在另一边伏击了我们，把我和伊茨拉分开了。

english: I hereby grant this house an... honourable mention!
translation: 我在此授予这栋房子……荣誉奖！

english: I honestly don't know why people obssess about my wine so much. Do I go stealing beer from all of your bank accounts? Hmm... actually, that's not a bad idea... it would certainly cost me less when paying my lessers to produce the artwork for these letters pages...
translation: 说实话，我真不明白为什么人们这么痴迷我的酒。难道我会去偷你们银行账户里的啤酒吗？嗯……实际上，这主意不错……这样我付钱给那些小喽啰为这些信件版面制作艺术品时，就能省不少钱了……

english: I hope I don't see you again!
translation: 我希望再也别见到你！

english: I hope it helps, be seeing you!
translation: 希望能帮上忙，再见！

english: I hope it will. We just wanted to make some Easter eggs because we didn't get any last year.
translation: 希望如此。我们只是想做一些复活节彩蛋，因为去年一个都没拿到。

english: I hope it works!
translation: 希望有用！

english: I hope not!
translation: 希望不会！

english: I hope not. We're meant to be doing the scaring today, not being scared.
translation: 希望不会。我们今天应该是去吓人，而不是被吓到。

english: I hope so too. I've got a particularly good recipe for deviled eggs which always go down great at parties.
translation: 我也希望如此。我有一个特别好的魔鬼蛋食谱，在派对上总是很受欢迎。

english: I hope so! It's supposed to be spooky, silly!
translation: 希望如此！本来就该是阴森恐怖的，傻瓜！

english: I hope so. I don't know what he would do if he knew about the mistakes I've made, he'd probably fire me instantly!
translation: 希望如此。我不知道他要是知道我犯的错会怎么做，他大概会立刻炒了我！

english: I hope the people of Lumbridge don't get any ideas or we may be in need of your services once again!
translation: 希望仑桥镇的人别打什么歪主意，否则我们可能又需要你的服务了！

english: I hope they like them. Maybe I'll get one myself!
translation: 希望他们会喜欢。也许我自己也弄一个！

english: I hope they've got a big loot key.
translation: 希望他们有一把大战利品钥匙。

english: I hope to see you at the festival, maybe we can talk more about adventuring! Merry Christmas!
translation: 希望能在节日上见到你，也许我们可以多聊聊冒险的事！圣诞快乐！

english: I hope you do! Good luck!
translation: 希望你能做到！祝你好运！

english: I hope you enjoy the rest of the festival. Merry Christmas!
translation: 希望你享受节日的剩余时光。圣诞快乐！

english: I hope you find some more!
translation: 希望你能找到更多！

english: I hope you get something nice. Maybe another armour set!
translation: 希望你能拿到好东西。也许再来一套盔甲！

english: I hope you get something you like?
translation: 希望你能拿到你喜欢的东西？

english: I hope you have your wits about you adventurer. These riddles are never easy and us druids are no good at them.
translation: 冒险者，希望你保持头脑清醒。这些谜语从来都不简单，我们德鲁伊可不擅长这个。

english: I hope you like the costumes!
translation: 希望你喜欢这些服装！

english: I hope you like your presents... I mean, present. Oops.
translation: 希望你喜欢你的礼物们……我是说，礼物。哎呀。

english: I hope you lot figure it out soon.
translation: 希望你们这群人快点搞清楚。

english: I hope you'll definitely use it only for decoration. I've heard of adventurers doing all kinds of sick things with blood, like pouring it into weapons or potions. This isn't for that!
translation: 希望你一定只把它用于装饰。我听说过冒险者用血做各种恶心的事，比如倒进武器或药水里。这个可不是用来干那个的！

english: I hope you're enjoying the games, [player name].
translation: 希望你玩得开心，[player name]。

english: I hope you're satisfied! Good bye!
translation: 希望你满意！再见！

english: I hope you've managed to avoid those mine carts, they're very heavy!
translation: 希望你已经设法避开了那些矿车，它们可重了！

english: I humbly request to be given the remains.
translation: 我谦卑地请求获得那些遗骸。

english: I imagine those creatures are manifesting themselves through some sort of link to those children you upset.
translation: 我想那些生物是通过某种与你惹恼的那些孩子的联系而显现出来的。

english: I intend to burn them to heat the house.
translation: 我打算烧了它们来给房子供暖。

english: I investigated the Wine Cellar and questioned the Suspects, but was unable to find anything conclusive. As such, Stradius and Hutza agreed to let me pickpocket the Suspects. In doing so, I found some more potential clues.
translation: 我调查了酒窖并审问了嫌疑人，但没能找到任何确凿证据。因此，斯特拉迪乌斯和胡扎同意让我扒窃嫌疑人。通过这样做，我找到了一些更多潜在的线索。

english: I journeyed to Cam Torum with Queen Zyanyi and Servius. There, we met with Highlord Katlo. He claimed he wasn't aware of any Emissaries in Cam Torum, but his advisor, Attala, convinced him to let us investigate anyway. Queen Zyanyi departed for the Tlati Rainforest, leaving Servius and I to find the Emissaries with Attala's help.
translation: 我和齐扬伊女王以及塞尔维乌斯一起前往卡姆托鲁姆。在那里，我们会见了高阶领主卡特洛。他声称不知道卡姆托鲁姆有任何使者，但他的顾问阿塔拉说服他让我们进行调查。齐扬伊女王出发前往特拉提雨林，留下我和塞尔维乌斯在阿塔拉的帮助下寻找使者。

english: I just happen to have some right here.
translation: 我这儿正好有一些。

english: I just have a quick question, then I'll go!
translation: 我只有一个简单的问题，问完就走！

english: I just have one small favour to ask...
translation: 我只是想请你帮一个小忙……

english: I just love seeing all these costumes, so I'm giving out treats to Trick-or-Treaters!
translation: 我就是喜欢看这些服装，所以我在给玩‘不给糖就捣蛋’的人发糖果！

english: I just need a dragon.
translation: 我只需要一条龙。

english: I just need a little help writing it. I've worked out the beginning, and I've got lots of ideas, but I think it would benefit from your advice.
translation: 我只是需要一点帮助来写它。我已经想好了开头，也有很多想法，但我认为你的建议会对它有益。

english: I just need to move all of this, now. I think it's a task I'd better undertake on my own.
translation: 我现在只需要把这些都搬走。我想这个任务最好由我自己来完成。

english: I just need you to pet that goose over there!
translation: 我只需要你去摸摸那边那只鹅！

english: I just put in whatever I could find.
translation: 我只是把能找到的东西都放进去了。

english: I just sit there and knit, looking out of the window, yearning for the adventures of old.
translation: 我就坐在那儿织毛衣，望着窗外，怀念着过去的冒险。

english: I just spoke to Bob, he said they were looking for treats around the area.
translation: 我刚和鲍勃谈过，他说他们正在这附近找糖果。

english: I just spoke to Father Aereck, he said they were looking for treats around the area.
translation: 我刚和艾瑞克神父谈过，他说他们正在这附近找糖果。

english: I just spoke to a shopkeeper, he said they were looking for treats around the area.
translation: 我刚和一个店主谈过，他说他们正在这附近找糖果。

english: I just spoke to the cook, he said they were looking for treats around the area.
translation: 我刚和厨师谈过，他说他们正在这附近找糖果。

english: I just want to make normal compost now.
translation: 我现在只想做普通的堆肥。

english: I just wanted to say thanks again for the dye.
translation: 我只是想再次感谢你给的染料。

english: I just wasn't quick enough to save him! I'm so sorry!
translation: 我只是动作不够快，没能救到他！非常抱歉！

english: I just wasn't ready to commit to red trousers just for a costume. I'm more of a robes kind of man, like these Zamorak monk robes. I like the freedom. Just don't ask where I got them.
translation: 我只是还没准备好为了一个服装就穿红裤子。我更喜欢穿长袍，比如这些扎莫拉克僧侣袍。我喜欢那种自由感。别问我是从哪儿弄来的。

english: I just went to all the effort of getting this over here. I'm not sending it back.
translation: 我费了好大劲才把这个弄过来。我可不会把它送回去。

english: I keep making mistakes argh! Help me with this question then I'll agree to attend the party.
translation: 我老是犯错，啊！帮我回答这个问题，我就同意去参加派对。

english: I keep. Lucky Warmhandz!
translation: 我留着。幸运暖手！

english: I killed you, remember?
translation: 我杀了你，还记得吗？

english: I kind of feel bad about that. I didn't want to be mean, but I suppose there was no other choice.
translation: 我有点过意不去。我不想那么刻薄，但我想当时也别无选择了。

english: I knew I could count on you, [player name]. If you hand them over to me, [player name] can start the celebrations!
translation: 我就知道能指望你，[player name]。如果你把它们交给我，[player name]就可以开始庆祝了！

english: I knew you would return here.
translation: 我就知道你会回到这里。

english: I know I captured all six... I must've misplaced some of them on the way back.
translation: 我知道我抓了全部六个……肯定是在回来的路上把几个放错地方了。

english: I know I hardly know you and all, but... Would you mind having a go at it for me? Please?
translation: 我知道我跟你还不熟，但是……你愿意帮我试试吗？拜托？

english: I know and I'm sorry, could you please make me another pair.
translation: 我知道，对不起，能请你再给我做一双吗？

english: I know not the full histories of this region of Gielinor, for when first I came to this realm there were no other inhabitants, and yet it is clear that some civilisation didst once flourish in that accursed area from the ruins and wreckage that thou mayst discover there, but I will tell thee this: When first I rose from mine slumbers to discover the arrival on this world of the other deities, petty and spiteful in their ways and cruel and unusual in their demeanours, they were all engaged in fearful war in this part of the land. The earth itself was blackened and charred from the force of their pitched battle, and I couldst not stand to see this beautiful planet destroyed in their vainglorious attempts to outdo each other, and thus I bade them cease. I know not the exact details that turned this place into such as it now is, I simply know that had I not intervened the entire realm wouldst be in a similar state, if not even worse.
translation: 我并不完全了解吉列诺这片区域的历史，因为我初临此界时，这里尚无其他居民。然而，从你可能会在那片受诅咒之地发现的废墟和残骸来看，显然曾有某种文明在那里繁荣过。但我要告诉你的是：当我从沉睡中苏醒，发现其他神祇降临这个世界时——他们行事卑劣恶毒，举止残忍怪异——他们全都在这片土地上卷入了一场可怕的战争。大地本身因他们激战的威力而变得焦黑炭化，我无法忍受看到这颗美丽的星球在他们虚荣的争强好胜中被摧毁，于是我命令他们停战。我不知道这个地方变成如今这副模样的确切细节，我只知道，如果我没有干预，整个领域都会处于类似的状态，甚至更糟。

english: I know of a dwarf who is quite familiar with our ritual, Thurdor, but as I can not leave the ritual site could you speak to him on our behalf?
translation: 我认识一个叫瑟多的矮人，他对我们的仪式很熟悉，但我不能离开仪式现场，你能替我们去跟他说说吗？

english: I know some people use banks, even though I don't personally.
translation: 我知道有些人用银行，虽然我自己不用。

english: I know that I will be unable to get those stats and items back.
translation: 我知道那些属性和物品是拿不回来了。

english: I know that must have been a blow, but you can't let that get you down.
translation: 我知道那肯定是个打击，但你不能因此消沉下去。

english: I know that you can change into different things...can you turn into anything? I may have already asked that...
translation: 我知道你可以变成不同的东西……你能变成任何东西吗？我可能已经问过这个问题了……

english: I know that you've been wanting to walk in my footsteps for the longest time. You don't need to do this to make me proud. I already am.
translation: 我知道你一直想追随我的脚步。你不需要做这些来让我骄傲。我已经为你感到骄傲了。

english: I know there are two flower traders currently visiting the local area who may have the seeds we need.
translation: 我知道有两个花商正在本地附近，他们可能有我们需要的种子。

english: I know they lurk around here and am in no rush to find them!
translation: 我知道他们潜伏在这附近，但我可不想急着去找他们！

english: I know! I couldn't climb the trees very well with it in my hand.
translation: 我知道！手里拿着它，我爬树都不太利索了。

english: I know, I found it! here you go.
translation: 我知道，我找到了！给你。

english: I know, I know. It's just all this waiting... It's making me nervous.
translation: 我知道，我知道。只是这么等着……让我很紧张。

english: I know, but as luck would have it, I found it!
translation: 我知道，但运气好的是，我找到了！

english: I know, but even that can't help me. I have had such an accident, the likes of which has never been seen before!
translation: 我知道，但就算那样也帮不了我。我出了这么个意外，简直是前所未有！

english: I know, how about I give YOU a costume. Then you can also be EVIL and I won't stand out so much! Yes! Perfect!
translation: 我知道了，不如我给你一套服装吧。这样你也可以当坏蛋，我就不会那么显眼了！对！完美！

english: I know, it all came together. I'm so proud of everyone.
translation: 我知道，一切都凑齐了。我真为每个人感到骄傲。

english: I know, it's just, earlier...
translation: 我知道，只是，之前……

english: I know, right? I never thought I'd see the day where I got to wear my dad's old armour! Growing up he always told me to stay away from it.
translation: 对吧？我从没想过有一天能穿上我爸的旧盔甲！从小到大他一直叫我离它远点。

english: I know, smells lovely doesn't it. Would you like a bottle?
translation: 我知道，闻起来很香对吧。想要一瓶吗？

english: I know, sorry. If only there was something more to go on.
translation: 我知道，抱歉。要是能有更多线索就好了。

english: I learn ten years from watching cook, and have lucky hat.
translation: 我看了厨师十年，学到了本事，还有一顶幸运帽。

english: I learnt about anagrams recently. I'll give you 3 guesses.
translation: 我最近学了字谜。给你三次机会猜。

english: I left it in my room at the Wizards' Tower, just south of there, across the bridge.
translation: 我把它落在法师塔的房间里了，就在那南边，过了桥就是。

english: I like that it's wearing a helmet, yet I can't shake the feeling that it's not the right dog for me.
translation: 我喜欢它戴着头盔的样子，但我总有种感觉，它不是我想要的那只狗。

english: I like to be with someone I've gained a close bond with over the years, maybe someone I've worked with and know well.
translation: 我喜欢和多年来建立了深厚感情的人在一起，也许是我共事过、很了解的人。

english: I like to sell chain. Protects you and I from pain. As always, prices wane.
translation: 我喜欢卖锁链。保护你我不受伤害。一如既往，价格低廉。

english: I like to think of myself as fairly righteous and larger than life, Saradomin all the way.
translation: 我自认相当正直且超凡脱俗，永远追随萨拉多明。

english: I like yours too.
translation: 我也喜欢你的。

english: I looked around the Empty Chamber where Itzla and I found Metzli. I found information that revealed the Ruins were indeed meant to be an Archive for the Old Ones, but that work was never completed due to the presence of some sort of Creature deep beneath the Archive. I also found two statues with the names Ralos and Ranul on them.
translation: 我在伊兹拉和我发现梅兹利的空荡密室里四处查看。我找到的信息显示，废墟原本确实是用来做古神档案馆的，但由于档案馆深处存在某种生物，这项工作从未完成。我还发现了两尊雕像，上面刻着拉洛斯和拉努尔的名字。

english: I lost my clue
translation: 我把线索弄丢了

english: I lost some items, what do I need again?
translation: 我丢了一些东西，我需要什么来着？

english: I lost someone very dear to me this year, and I wanted to connect with them one last time.
translation: 今年我失去了一位非常珍视的人，我想和他们做最后的联系。

english: I lost the cooler you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的冷却器弄丢了。

english: I lost the incantation.
translation: 我把咒语弄丢了。

english: I lost the notes.
translation: 我把笔记弄丢了。

english: I lost the spooky picture.
translation: 我把诡异的图画弄丢了。

english: I lost the spooky pumpkin lantern.
translation: 我把幽灵南瓜灯笼弄丢了。

english: I love eggs, simple as!
translation: 我爱鸡蛋，就这么简单！

english: I love moo.
translation: 我爱哞哞。

english: I love my job, Santa's given us all June off on holiday.
translation: 我爱我的工作，圣诞老人给了我们整个六月假期。

english: I love someone who keeps an eye on me. I'm thinking of someone who uses their telescope from their window... Makes sure I'm not up to no good.
translation: 我喜欢有人盯着我。我在想那个从窗户用望远镜看的人……确保我没干坏事。

english: I love the sand!
translation: 我爱沙子！

english: I love what you've done with the place, by the way!
translation: 顺便说一句，我喜欢你把这地方布置的样子！

english: I love woad leaves!
translation: 我爱菘蓝叶！

english: I made a Carol a new present and she liked it but it still hasn't convinced her.
translation: 我给卡罗尔做了一件新礼物，她很喜欢，但还是没能说服她。

english: I made one of my finest pizzas. Lovely base, juiciest tomatoes, the cheesiest of cheeses.
translation: 我做了一个我最拿手的披萨。饼底很棒，番茄最多汁，奶酪也是最浓郁的。

english: I made some food but it's still in the kitchen. I'll go get it from the cauldron.
translation: 我做了些吃的，但还在厨房里。我去大锅里拿。

english: I managed to bypass the defences in Zemouregal's Base and reach Arrav's Heart. However, I was confronted by Zemouregal. He ordered Arrav to kill me, giving me no choice but to fight him off. After I defeated Arrav, Elias arrived and distracted Zemouregal, giving me time to grab the Heart. Elias took the Heart to begin researching it, promising to get in touch once he'd made some progress.
translation: 我成功绕过了泽莫雷加尔基地的防御，到达了阿拉夫之心。然而，我遇到了泽莫雷加尔。他命令阿拉夫杀了我，我别无选择，只能击退他。在我击败阿拉夫后，伊莱亚斯赶到并引开了泽莫雷加尔的注意，给了我夺取心脏的时间。伊莱亚斯带走了心脏开始研究，并承诺一旦取得进展就会联系我。

english: I managed to free Silif from his imprisonment in the Black Knight Catacombs and gave him a Disguise. While he gathered Intelligence, I set out to find the Dark Squall. However, upon finding him, I discovered him to actually be Surok Magis. He recognised me and attacked, but I was able to defeat him and plant a Teleorb on him.
translation: 我成功将西利夫从黑骑士墓穴的囚禁中解救出来，并给了他一套伪装。在他收集情报的同时，我出发去寻找黑风暴。然而，找到他时，我发现他实际上是苏洛克.马吉斯。他认出了我并发动攻击，但我击败了他，并在他身上放置了一个传送宝珠。

english: I managed to repair the lighthouse light with some molten glass, some swamp tar and a tinderbox.
translation: 我用一些熔融玻璃、一些沼泽焦油和一个火绒盒修好了灯塔的灯。

english: I managed to steal a Storeroom Key from Haig Halen. I used it to enter the Varrock Museum Storeroom where I found Xerna's Diadem.
translation: 我从海格.哈伦那里偷到了一把储藏室钥匙。我用它进入了维洛克博物馆的储藏室，在那里找到了泽尔娜的头冠。

english: I managed to work out that the Grey-Haired man was travelling to Varrock. I travelled there myself and confronted Curator Haig Halen in the Varrock Musem about Xerna's Diadem, but he claimed not to know anything.
translation: 我设法查明了灰发男子正在前往维洛克城。我亲自前往那里，在维洛克博物馆与馆长海格.哈伦对质泽尔娜的头冠一事，但他声称一无所知。

english: I may have accidentally lost the spooky wall lamp.
translation: 我可能不小心把幽灵壁灯弄丢了。

english: I may have an idea... Why don't you go and talk to Patty Seer in the castle. She could help you be a chef.
translation: 我可能有个主意……你不如去城堡里找先知帕蒂谈谈。她也许能帮你成为厨师。

english: I may have backstabbed Guss, but I crushed it.
translation: 我可能背叛了格斯，但我搞定了。

english: I may have lost the scarecrow.
translation: 我可能把稻草人弄丢了。

english: I may have mentioned the problem to my customers though.
translation: 不过我可能跟我的顾客提过这个问题。

english: I may have overestimated my idea-creating ability!
translation: 我可能高估了自己的创意能力！

english: I may not be scary, or immortal, or terrifying, but I am Iffie, and I'll make you proud!
translation: 我可能不可怕，不是不死之身，也不吓人，但我是伊菲，我会让你骄傲的！

english: I may only be a cooks assistant, but this food is terrible!
translation: 我可能只是个厨师助理，但这食物也太难吃了！

english: I may take the appearance of anything. To appear to be something is not the same thing as actually being something...
translation: 我可以呈现任何形态。但看起来像某样东西，和真正成为那样东西，是两码事……

english: I mean I accidently destroyed it, it's gone, don't worry!
translation: 我是说我不小心把它毁了，没了，别担心！

english: I mean there is ANOTHER malignant presence in my house.
translation: 我是说我房子里还有另一个邪恶的存在。

english: I mean you, [player name]!
translation: 我是说你，[player name]！

english: I mean, I'm a box, I can't know people.
translation: 我是说，我是个箱子，我不可能认识人。

english: I mean... he stands right outside your church! He probably saw the monkey come in and heard your cries for help!
translation: 我是说……他就站在你的教堂外面！他很可能看到猴子进来了，也听到了你的呼救声！

english: I meet a lot of people in my line of work and hear a lot of stories. Believe it or not, people tell stories of adventures, past and future, just by the way they dress.
translation: 在我的工作中，我遇到很多人，听到很多故事。信不信由你，人们仅凭穿着就能讲述过去和未来的冒险故事。

english: I met Ali Morrisane's contact. I'm getting them a kebab in return for a report for Ali.
translation: 我见到了阿里.莫里桑的联系人。我正在给他们弄一份烤肉，以换取给阿里的报告。

english: I met him last Christmas, too. He hired me to collect useless coal dust from him to distribute as junk gifts.
translation: 去年圣诞节我也见过他。他雇我收集他那里没用的煤尘，当作垃圾礼物分发出去。

english: I met someone earlier who was hiding in a shipping crate. They said that it was nice and cool inside.
translation: 我之前遇到一个人，躲在一个货运板条箱里。他们说里面又舒服又凉快。

english: I met with Captain Vibia at the Cultist Safe House in south western Civitas illa Fortis. While she kept watch, I found a Window for us to use to get into the House, distracted a Dog on the other side, and then unlocked a Door leading to the rest of the House
translation: 我在福蒂斯城西南部的邪教徒安全屋与维比娅船长会面。她放哨时，我找到了一扇我们可以用来进入房子的窗户，引开了另一边的狗，然后打开了一扇通往房子其他地方的门。

english: I might be able to. What does he need?
translation: 我或许可以。他需要什么？

english: I might know where it is. If you can solve this challenge, I will give you a hint, but if I win, what do I get?
translation: 我可能知道它在哪。如果你能解决这个挑战，我就给你一个提示，但如果我赢了，我能得到什么？

english: I might need some time to think about it.
translation: 我可能需要一些时间考虑一下。

english: I might want to give them a wash first, while I'm at it. While I do that, if you could deliver these to their recipients, that would be fabulous.
translation: 我可能想先把它们洗一洗，顺便的事。在我洗的时候，如果你能把这些送给收件人，那就太好了。

english: I mind my own business. That way I don't get cut.
translation: 我管好自己的事。这样就不会被砍了。

english: I must admit it has gotten boring watching this jail, I've started counting the trees... How many can you spot within the jail's fenced off area?
translation: 我得承认看守这个监狱变得很无聊，我开始数树了……你能在监狱围起来的区域里看到多少棵树？

english: I must be going now.
translation: 我现在得走了。

english: I must be off soon. Please come and visit me and my new charge when you have the chance!
translation: 我很快就要走了。有空请来看看我和我的新委托人！

english: I must confront the killer.
translation: 我必须去面对那个杀手。

english: I must defeat these sea monsters to save him!
translation: 我必须击败这些海怪才能救他！

english: I must investigate the manor and find a way to stop the killer.
translation: 我必须调查庄园，找到阻止杀手的方法。

english: I must now cast an extremely powerful spell. It is not often we are successful in investing shapeshifting powers within objects.
translation: 我现在必须施放一个极其强大的法术。我们很少能成功地将变形能力注入物体中。

english: I must see to my other tasks now. Goodbye.
translation: 我现在必须去处理其他事务了。再见。

english: I need a box to put completed marionettes into.
translation: 我需要一个盒子来放做好的提线木偶。

english: I need a box to put painted baubles into.
translation: 我需要一个盒子来放涂好颜色的小饰品。

english: I need a few bronze arrowheads to complete some arrows I was making. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些青铜箭头来完成我正在制作的箭。我还需要[number]个。

english: I need a few bronze daggers to keep the goblins at bay. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要几把青铜匕首来抵御地精。我还需要[number]把。

english: I need a few lumps of copper ore. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要几块铜矿石。我还需要[number]块。

english: I need a few lumps of tin ore. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要几块锡矿石。我还需要[number]块。

english: I need a find from the digsite to impress the Expert.
translation: 我需要从挖掘现场找到一个发现来打动专家。

english: I need a handful of feathers to stick in my beard. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一把羽毛插在我的胡子上。我还需要[number]根。

english: I need a memento of Farming, something that evokes the memory of all the training you'll have done.
translation: 我需要一个农业的纪念品，能唤起你所有训练记忆的东西。

english: I need a proper imposing lectern to read from. Go up to the church and fetch the lectern, and bring it to me, please.
translation: 我需要一个像样的、气派的讲台来宣读。请去教堂把讲台拿来给我。

english: I need an appropriate Santa costume. Perhaps you can find something for me.
translation: 我需要一套合适的圣诞老人服装。也许你能帮我找到。

english: I need an enchanted silver sickle
translation: 我需要一把附魔的银镰刀

english: I need another magic egg.
translation: 我还需要一个魔法蛋。

english: I need clearance to enter a plague house.
translation: 我需要许可才能进入疫病房屋。

english: I need help with Rashliyia.
translation: 我需要对付拉什莉娅的帮助。

english: I need help with fighting a Tanglefoot.
translation: 我需要对付缠足怪的帮助。

english: I need it to make some cat ears for someone.
translation: 我需要它来给某人做一对猫耳。

english: I need no title.
translation: 我不需要头衔。

english: I need one hand for the rolling pin and one hand for holding on to the tree.
translation: 我需要一只手拿擀面杖，另一只手抓住树。

english: I need one of your stakes, please. Although unconventional, I think it will work as a memento of the specialist combat techniques involved in Slayer!
translation: 我需要你的一根木桩。虽然不太寻常，但我觉得它可以作为杀戮专用战斗技巧的纪念品！

english: I need silence right now.
translation: 我现在需要安静。

english: I need some Brewer's Folly for a birthday party.
translation: 我需要一些酿酒师的愚行啤酒来办生日派对。

english: I need some bronze bars. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些青铜条。我还需要[number]个。

english: I need some bronze spears. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些青铜矛。我还需要[number]把。

english: I need some chain
translation: 我需要一些锁链

english: I need some iron arrowheads to put on the arrows I was making. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些铁箭头来装在我正在制作的箭上。我还需要[number]个。

english: I need some iron bars. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些铁条。我还需要[number]个。

english: I need some lengths of bronze wire to repair something. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要几段青铜丝来修理东西。我还需要[number]段。

english: I need some potatoes, if you'd be so kind. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些土豆，如果你方便的话。我还需要[number]个。

english: I need some potatoes, if you'd be so kind. Please bring me [#].
translation: 我需要一些土豆，麻烦你了。请给我带来[#]个。

english: I need something that I can use to mix ice cream with. Ellis said you would be able to help.
translation: 我需要一个可以用来搅拌冰淇淋的东西。埃利斯说你能帮忙。

english: I need something to cover my hands before I stake out the house. I might leave fingerprints.
translation: 在我监视那栋房子之前，我需要一些东西来遮住手。我可能会留下指纹。

english: I need something to disguise my head before I stake out the house. Somebody might spot me.
translation: 在我监视那栋房子之前，我需要一些东西来伪装头部。可能会有人认出我。

english: I need that phrase!
translation: 我需要那句话！

english: I need the guards' permission to do that.
translation: 我需要得到守卫的许可才能那么做。

english: I need to bring her an opal.
translation: 我需要给她带一颗蛋白石。

english: I need to dry it over a fire first.
translation: 我得先把它在火上烤干。

english: I need to find a way to move the rocks blocking the way in the shaft. Perhaps someone can help me.
translation: 我需要想办法搬开矿井里挡路的岩石。也许有人能帮我。

english: I need to find some goutweed.
translation: 我需要找一些痛风草。

english: I need to get back to my knitting now, [player name]. Thank you again for the adventure!
translation: 我现在得回去织毛衣了，[player name]。再次感谢你带来的冒险！

english: I need to get some [beverage] from the bar.
translation: 我需要去酒吧拿点[beverage]。

english: I need to go and do something else.
translation: 我得去做点别的事。

english: I need to ignite the Explosive Compound and blow up the rocks blocking the way.
translation: 我需要点燃爆炸混合物，炸开挡路的岩石。

english: I need to investigate the dig shafts.
translation: 我需要调查那些挖掘竖井。

english: I need to plant the beans, water them, let them grow into some big plant, climb the plant to get to a cloudy area, kill a giant, find a golden goblin and bring it back to you?
translation: 我需要种下豆子，浇水，让它们长成大型植物，爬上去到达云层区域，杀死一个巨人，找到金色哥布林，然后带回来给你？

english: I need to repair the bridge leading to Rellekka.
translation: 我需要修复通往雷勒卡城的桥。

english: I need to return the letter of recommendation from the Curator of Varrock Museum to the Examiner at the Exam Centre for inspection.
translation: 我需要把维洛克博物馆馆长写的推荐信交还给考试中心的考官进行审核。

english: I need to speak to the student in the green top about the exams.
translation: 我需要和穿绿色上衣的学生谈谈考试的事。

english: I need to speak to the student in the orange top about the exams.
translation: 我需要和穿橙色上衣的学生谈谈考试的事。

english: I need to speak to the student in the purple skirt about the exams.
translation: 我需要和穿紫色裙子的学生谈谈考试的事。

english: I need to stop the killer, I'll have to find a way into the manor.
translation: 我必须阻止那个杀手，得想办法进入庄园。

english: I need to study for my second exam. Perhaps the three students on the digsite can help me again?
translation: 我需要为第二次考试学习。也许挖掘场的那三个学生能再帮我一次？

english: I need to study for my third exam. Perhaps the students on the digsite can help?
translation: 我需要为第三次考试学习。也许挖掘场的学生们能帮忙？

english: I need to take the letter to a workman near a winch.
translation: 我需要把这封信带给绞盘附近的工人。

english: I need two spaces before I remove the eggs as I need to remove them at the same time. Otherwise the experiment won't work!
translation: 我需要两个空位才能同时取出这些蛋，否则实验会失败！

english: I need you to fill it with the tears of the innocent. The children of Varrock make perfect candidates!
translation: 我需要你用无辜者的眼泪装满它。维洛克城的孩子们是最佳人选！

english: I need you to go into the warren and catch ten chocolate kebbits. As you catch them, put them into the chute north of where you came into the warren. The chute leads to a pen, which I'll explain in a bit.
translation: 我需要你进入兔穴，捕捉十只巧克力兔。抓到后，把它们放进你进入兔穴处北边的滑槽里。滑槽通向一个围栏，我待会再解释。

english: I never want to see that suit again! So, that's why I'm giving it to you.
translation: 我再也不想看到那套衣服了！所以，我才把它送给你。

english: I noticed an Empty Display in the Grand Museum of Civitas Illa Fortis. The Display apparently contained Xerna's Diadem, but it was recently stolen. I spoke to the Museum Curator and he offered me a reward in return for recovering the Diadem.
translation: 我在福蒂斯城的大博物馆里注意到一个空展示柜。那个展示柜原本放着泽尔娜的头冠，但最近被偷了。我和博物馆馆长谈过，他愿意提供报酬，让我找回那头冠。

english: I obey.
translation: 遵命。

english: I once fell overboard, nearly drowned, got rescued by a mermaid, fell in love and married her. Trouble is, for a sailor, the sea is always yer true mistress, and the wife caught me cheatin' with her.
translation: 我有次掉下船，差点淹死，被一条美人鱼救了，然后相爱结婚。问题是，对水手来说，大海永远是你真正的情妇，我老婆抓到我出轨了。

english: I once got caught in a calm fer weeks, an' had to drink my own water. Want to try some? I've a bottle spare.
translation: 我有次被困在无风带好几个星期，不得不喝自己的水。想尝尝吗？我多带了一瓶。

english: I once had a crew of sailors who worshipped Brassica Prime, the great Cabbage god. Vegetables ward off the scurvy, ye see.
translation: 我有过一帮水手，他们崇拜伟大的卷心菜神——布拉西卡.普莱姆。你看，蔬菜能预防坏血病。

english: I once sailed right up the back of the Cape of Fire. That be a terrifyin' place, with lava drippin' down, an' only a stinky harbour to be found within.
translation: 我有次直接驶进了火之角的背面。那是个可怕的地方，熔岩往下滴，里面只有一个臭烘烘的港口。

english: I only get one try, so I need to make sure I do a good job. I should talk to the other contestants first and see what they did before I start cooking.
translation: 我只有一次机会，所以我得确保做好。在开始烹饪之前，我应该先和其他参赛者聊聊，看看他们做了什么。

english: I only managed to start speaking to one person before they realised it wasn't a costume. Now everybody is scared!
translation: 我只来得及跟一个人说话，他们就发现那不是服装了。现在大家都吓坏了！

english: I pass the items to JalYt-Hur-Jack. You get little toy in thanks.
translation: 我把物品交给贾尔伊特-胡尔-杰克，作为感谢你得到一个小玩具。

english: I placed it next to the path before having my dinner.
translation: 我在吃晚饭前把它放在了小路旁边。

english: I plan to distribute lumps of coal to the scum of this world. These lumps cannot be used for smelting; they exist solely to waste bank space. Ha ha ha!
translation: 我打算把煤块分发给这个世界的渣滓们。这些煤块不能用来冶炼；它们的存在只是为了浪费银行空间。哈哈哈！

english: I plan to slash and chop many things!
translation: 我打算砍砍砍，切切切很多东西！

english: I practice nothing except the concept and pursuit of balance.
translation: 我除了平衡的理念和追求之外，什么都不修习。

english: I prefer to worship the lesser known Deities.
translation: 我更喜欢崇拜那些不太知名的神祇。

english: I prepared a Canopic Jar by filling it with three Dwellberries and a Ring of Life.
translation: 我准备了一个卡诺皮克罐，里面装了三颗德维尔莓和一枚生命戒指。

english: I presented Sue's offer to Marcellus, but he asked to see proof that the Flies needed to be dealt with. Sue and Gary suggested I steal a prized possession from Marcellus and plant it on the Flies.
translation: 我向马塞勒斯提出了苏的建议，但他要求看到需要处理苍蝇的证据。苏和加里建议我从马塞勒斯那里偷一件贵重物品，然后栽赃给苍蝇。

english: I probably shouldn't take any more of these.
translation: 我可能不该再拿这些了。

english: I probably shouldn't take what isn't mine on Christmas.
translation: 圣诞节我大概不该拿不属于我的东西。

english: I probably shouldn't touch this for now.
translation: 我现在大概不该碰这个。

english: I probably shouldn't touch this.
translation: 我大概不该碰这个。

english: I progressed through the Ruins and met up with Itzla again. we managed to open a Door that was blocking us from progressing further. On the other side we encountered a Nagua called Amoxliatl. She impled that the Emissaries were looking for something in the Tlati Rainforest, but didn't share any more information. We were then interuppted by the arrival of Metzli, Furia and Ennius, who captured Itzla. Amoxliatl attacked, but the others fled, leaving me to deal with her alone.
translation: 我穿过废墟，再次与伊茨拉会合。我们设法打开了一扇挡路的门。另一边，我们遇到了一条名叫阿莫克斯利亚特尔的纳瓜蛇。她暗示使者们在特拉提雨林中寻找某样东西，但没有透露更多信息。随后梅茨利、富里亚和恩尼乌斯赶到，打断了我们，并抓住了伊茨拉。阿莫克斯利亚特尔发动攻击，但其他人逃走了，留下我一个人对付她。

english: I promise, this will be the best banana you've ever had.
translation: 我保证，这将是你吃过的最好的香蕉。

english: I really do feel like I should thank [player name] too. For [his/her] great assistance... and for [his/her] discretion.
translation: 我真的觉得也应该感谢[player name]。感谢[his/her]的大力协助……以及[his/her]的谨慎。

english: I really don't have time to get involved in this, goodbye.
translation: 我真的没时间掺和这事，再见。

english: I really don't thi-
translation: 我真的不认为——

english: I really don't want to bring them with me until I know for sure that I'm accepted. Hey, maybe I can ask one of the guards over there to keep an eye on them?
translation: 在确定我被接纳之前，我真的不想带他们一起去。嘿，也许我可以请那边的一个守卫帮忙照看他们？

english: I really like your costume too!
translation: 我也很喜欢你的服装！

english: I really need to sort out my taxes... I have quite the assets! I pay 24% on my income of 2,000,000 coins. How much do I owe?
translation: 我真的需要处理我的税务了……我的资产可不少！我收入200万金币，要交24%的税。我该交多少？

english: I really needed to read that. We've not had the best history. I wish he could have said this face to face.
translation: 我真的很需要读到这个。我们之间的过往并不愉快。我真希望他能当面说这些。

english: I really should use this to make a Monkey cage instead. I'm sure there'll be time to eat one after the monkeys have been dealt with.
translation: 我真的应该用这个来做猴子笼。我相信处理完猴子之后，会有时间吃一个的。

english: I received a gift from an old friend a while ago, but I have no space in my store to mount it.
translation: 不久前我收到一位老朋友送的礼物，但我的店里没有空间来展示它。

english: I reckon Hans could do with a sit down as he's always on his feet. I think I saw a comfy chair in the Duke's room.
translation: 我觉得汉斯需要坐下来休息一下，因为他总是站着。我记得在公爵的房间里看到过一把舒适的椅子。

english: I reckon I need some local bait, but there's not a fishing shop nearby.
translation: 我想我需要一些当地的鱼饵，但附近没有钓鱼店。

english: I remember agreeing to help him mine some coal last Christmas.
translation: 我记得去年圣诞节答应帮他挖一些煤。

english: I remember seeing a massive vault under the bank here in west Varrock.
translation: 我记得在维洛克城西边的银行下面见过一个巨大的金库。

english: I remember talking to a lad by the name of [player name] a while ago...
translation: 我记得不久前和一个叫[player name]的小伙子聊过……

english: I remember talking to a lass by the name of [player name] a while ago...
translation: 我记得不久前和一个叫[player name]的姑娘聊过……

english: I remember that name. I was asked to find a load of beads that Grayzag's imps stole.
translation: 我记得那个名字。有人让我去找格雷扎格的小鬼偷走的一堆珠子。

english: I remembered that they're somewhere in Varrock!
translation: 我想起来了，它们在维洛克城的某个地方！

english: I reopened the gnome's portal and went to the Realm.
translation: 我重新打开了侏儒的传送门，进入了那个领域。

english: I repaired the bridge leading to Rellekka and got a key from Gunnjorn so I could enter the lighthouse.
translation: 我修复了通往雷勒卡城的桥，并从冈乔恩那里拿到了一把钥匙，这样我就能进入灯塔了。

english: I require another one of your premium bananas.
translation: 我需要再来一根你的优质香蕉。

english: I require some more bamboo.
translation: 我还需要一些竹子。

english: I respect the sheep, for their purpose is essential, albeit secret. Some day the rest of you mortals might discover the true power of the sheep, innocent in appearance but essential in bearing, and realise why they shelter under my protection for the time being.
translation: 我尊重羊，因为它们的使命至关重要，尽管是秘密的。总有一天，你们这些凡人中的其他人可能会发现羊的真正力量——它们外表无辜，但承载着关键作用——并意识到它们为何暂时在我的庇护之下。

english: I returned to Fox with the Trimmed Fur. At his request, I went back to the Hunter Guild and used it to fix Kiko's Bed. With the job done, I returned to Guildmaster Apatura and reported my success to her.
translation: 我带着修剪毛皮回到了福克斯那里。应他的要求，我回到猎人公会，用它修好了奇科的床。工作完成后，我回到公会会长阿帕图拉那里，向她报告了成功。

english: I returned to Queen Zyanyi in Civitas illa Fortis and told her what I'd discovered. She directed me to meet with Captain Vibia at the Cultist Safe House. The two of us must then gain entry into the House and capture Forebearer Janus, the cultist living there.
translation: 我回到福蒂斯城，向齐扬伊女王报告了我的发现。她指示我去邪教徒安全屋与维比娅船长会合。然后我们俩必须进入那所房子，抓住住在那里的邪教徒——先驱者雅努斯。

english: I returned to Steve and he introduced me to Old Grog, a privateer hunting Will and Anne. Old Grog agreed to let me join him, but told me I'd need to get more experience out at sea first. Steve assured me that he'd keep me informed of any updates from Old Grog and encouraged me to head back out on my new Raft to begin working on my sailing skills.
translation: 我回到史蒂夫那里，他把我介绍给了老格罗格，一个正在追捕威尔和安妮的私掠者。老格罗格同意让我加入，但告诉我需要先在海上积累更多经验。史蒂夫向我保证，他会随时告知我老格罗格的最新消息，并鼓励我乘着我的新木筏出海，开始磨练我的航海技能。

english: I returned to the Cave in the Custodia Pass and found Antos. Before I could help him, I was attacked by three Strange Creatures, but I was able to fight them off. With them dealt with, I helped Antos get back to Auburnvale.
translation: 我回到库斯托迪亚隘口的洞穴，找到了安托斯。还没来得及帮他，我就遭到了三个奇怪生物的袭击，但我成功击退了它们。处理完它们后，我帮助安托斯回到了奥本维尔。

english: I returned to the Crypt of Tonali and met with Itzla and Queen Zyanyi. Itzla suggested that Furia be allowed to live so as not to make another martyr for the surviving Twilight Emissaries. The Queen agreed. She then thanked us for stopping Metzli before returning to Civitas illa Fortis. Itzla then thanked me himself and presented me with his sword, the Arkan Blade, before departing for Civitas illa Fortis himself.
translation: 我回到托纳利墓穴，与伊茨拉和齐扬伊女王会面。伊茨拉建议饶富里亚一命，以免为幸存的暮光使者制造又一个烈士。女王同意了。她感谢我们阻止了梅茨利，然后返回了福蒂斯城。随后伊茨拉亲自向我道谢，并将他的剑——阿坎之刃赠予我，之后他也动身前往福蒂斯城。

english: I returned to the Distressed Couple and asked them about the Scrap of Fabric. They told me that it was likely from the clothing of one of their Sons.
translation: 我回到那对焦虑的夫妇那里，向他们询问那块织物碎片。他们告诉我，那很可能是他们其中一个儿子的衣服上的。

english: I returned to the Fight Arena and was able to use my Broav to track Movario's scent to a Hidden Base below the Khazard Battlefield.
translation: 我回到战斗竞技场，用我的布罗夫追踪莫瓦里奥的气味，一直追到卡扎德战场下方的一个隐藏基地。

english: I returned to the Neypotzli Antechamber to find that Zuma had disturbed the seal keeping the Moons of Peril contained. To restore the seal, I gathered some items for Eyatlalli to use as part of a ritual.
translation: 我回到内波茨利监狱的前厅，发现祖玛扰乱了封印灾厄之月的封印。为了修复封印，我为埃亚特拉利收集了一些物品，用于仪式的一部分。

english: I returned to the White Knights' Castle and updated the others on what happened in the Black Knight Catacombs. Using information found by Silif, we were able to locate Lucien's Camp near the Wilderness.
translation: 我回到白骑士城堡，向其他人通报了黑骑士墓穴中发生的事。利用西利夫找到的信息，我们得以定位到荒野附近的卢锡安营地。

english: I returned to the zoo and presented Charlie with a replacement for his lost ferret.
translation: 我回到动物园，给了查理一只雪貂来替代他丢失的那只。

english: I ruined Christmas by putting a stop to their slave labour camp, apparently.
translation: 显然，我阻止了他们的奴隶劳改营，从而毁掉了圣诞节。

english: I run the secret Santa for the Falador Christmas Festival, but it has all gone wrong!
translation: 我负责法拉多城圣诞节的秘密圣诞老人活动，但全搞砸了！

english: I sadly don't have all of the seeds you're after, as my stocks are running quite low, but I do have seeds for a Legendary Red Rose and a Gorgeous Orange Lily.
translation: 很遗憾，我没有你要的所有种子，因为我的库存不多了，但我确实有传奇红玫瑰和华丽橙百合的种子。

english: I said I was sorry!
translation: 我说过对不起了！

english: I said it most definitely wouldn't! And that there is no need to anyway now that I am here to help.
translation: 我说过绝对不会！而且既然我来帮忙了，也就没必要了。

english: I said it must be hot in the desert being so hairy.
translation: 我说，在沙漠里长这么多毛一定很热。

english: I said less cliché!
translation: 我说少点老套！

english: I saw a sack with black powder close to the furnace room in Lumbridge. Maybe you could check what it contains?
translation: 我在仑桥镇的熔炉房附近看到一个装有黑色粉末的麻袋。也许你可以检查一下里面有什么？

english: I saw a thief roaming the south-east end of the city, just east of where we met. I'm sure he'll have a memento of Thieving - but we shouldn't ask where he got it!
translation: 我看到一个小偷在城市的东南角游荡，就在我们见面的地方东边。我肯定他有偷窃的纪念品——但我们不该问他从哪弄来的！

english: I saw a weird priest looking fellow disappear with a giant egg!
translation: 我看到一个看起来像祭司的怪人带着一个巨型蛋消失了！

english: I saw an interesting bed in Karamja called a 'hammock'. It seemed to be made out of string, and I'd like some balls of wool so I can make my own. I still need [number].
translation: 我在卡拉姆詹岛看到一种有趣的床，叫‘吊床’。它似乎是用绳子做的，我想要一些毛线球，这样我就能自己做一张了。我还需要[number]个。

english: I saw him too. Thank you for delivering the armour! It looks almost too clean doesn't it?
translation: 我也看到他了。谢谢你送来盔甲！它看起来干净得有点过分了，不是吗？

english: I saw it work! Well done!
translation: 我看到它起作用了！干得好！

english: I saw one dressed as a huge spider earlier!
translation: 我之前看到一个打扮成巨型蜘蛛的人！

english: I saw some spiders in the graveyard outside. Go and fetch one, and release it in here. That'll get us some cobwebs! I think spiders work quite fast, don't they?
translation: 我在外面的墓地里看到一些蜘蛛。去抓一只来，然后在这里放生。这样我们就能弄到一些蜘蛛网了！我觉得蜘蛛干活挺快的，对吧？

english: I saw the goblins heading to other houses in the area. Maybe you can find more clues someone else.
translation: 我看到那些哥布林往这个区域的其他房子去了。也许你能从别人那里找到更多线索。

english: I saw you carve a pumpkin earlier, I wonder what happened to it. I suppose you will have to make another! Those crows aren't going to scare themselves!
translation: 我之前看到你刻了一个南瓜，不知道它后来怎么样了。我想你得再做一个！那些乌鸦可不会自己吓自己！

english: I saw your face
translation: 我看到你的脸了

english: I searched the Backstage Area and found some new clues. With them, I came to the conclusion that Naiatli, Livius' understudy, was the one responsible for his death. I went on stage and confronted her. She admitted to being responsible, but claimed it to be an accident. She was then arrested, concluding the case.
translation: 我搜查了后台区域，找到了一些新线索。根据这些线索，我得出了结论：利维乌斯的替角奈亚特利应对他的死负责。我走上舞台与她当面对质。她承认了责任，但声称是意外。随后她被逮捕，案件就此了结。

english: I see I see, that is a problem indeed! Would you like me to go and grab you some more chocolate chips from the shop?
translation: 我明白了，我明白了，这确实是个问题！要不要我去商店再给你拿些巧克力片来？

english: I see a lot of food items go through the pass day to day, however I don't pay too much attention to that.
translation: 我每天都能看到很多食物经过这个关口，不过我没太留意那些。

english: I see from the list that you want a cabbage. By a remarkable coincidence, I am already carrying a cabbage.
translation: 我从清单上看到你想要一颗卷心菜。巧的是，我正好随身带着一颗。

english: I see myself taking on a more advisory role.
translation: 我觉得自己更适合担任顾问的角色。

english: I see the events from my perspective, but this does not guarantee truth or an accurate answer.
translation: 我从我的视角看待事件，但这并不能保证真相或准确的答案。

english: I see the problem.
translation: 我明白问题所在了。

english: I see there is an embarrassed-looking dwarf...
translation: 我看到一个表情尴尬的矮人……

english: I see you already have a tinderbox, try using that one to light the smoke.
translation: 我看到你已经有火绒盒了，试试用那个来点烟雾。

english: I see you brought your own shears. Wonderful! 51--> 52-->
translation: 我看到你自带剪刀了。太棒了！51--> 52-->

english: I see you brought your trusty....steed.
translation: 我看到你带来了你可靠的……坐骑。

english: I see you don't have a ticket for the ship, my colleague normally only sells them in Shilo village. But I could sell you one for a small additional charge. Shall we say [number] coins?
translation: 我看你没有船票，我的同事通常只在希洛村卖票。但我可以卖你一张，不过要加收一点费用。就收 [number] 金币如何？

english: I see you have been gathering antique emblems. My master is most pleased! I will offer you [number] points for all the antique emblems in your bank, if you wish.
translation: 我看到你一直在收集古董徽章。我的主人非常满意！如果你愿意，我会为你银行里所有的古董徽章提供[number]点积分。

english: I see you've finished helping mine the eggs, well done!
translation: 我看到你已经帮忙挖完蛋了，干得好！

english: I see! Normally you just turn up, but maybe I can get you an appointment?
translation: 我明白了！通常你直接来就行，但也许我能帮你约个时间？

english: I see, and the second trader?
translation: 我明白了，那第二个商人呢？

english: I see, another devious plan by the Easter bunny?
translation: 我明白了，又是复活节兔子的一个狡猾计划？

english: I see, so you want me to be your servant?
translation: 我明白了，所以你想让我当你的仆从？

english: I see, sounds like you've thought this through a lot. It sounds like a good plan!
translation: 我明白了，听起来你考虑得很周全。这是个好计划！

english: I see, very brave!
translation: 我明白了，非常勇敢！

english: I see. Before we get down to business, would you like a nice banana?
translation: 我明白了。在我们谈正事之前，你想来根美味的香蕉吗？

english: I see. Do you know who I can talk to about it?
translation: 我明白了。你知道我可以找谁谈谈这件事吗？

english: I see. I never realised how seriously you took this.
translation: 我明白了。我从来不知道你这么认真对待这件事。

english: I see. Let's do this quickly, I am quite busy.
translation: 我明白了。我们快点搞定吧，我很忙。

english: I see. Well everyone seems to be having a good time. I hope to see you again in the future.
translation: 我明白了。嗯，大家似乎都玩得很开心。希望以后还能再见到你。

english: I see... I'll ensure work begins at once.
translation: 我明白了……我会确保立即开工。

english: I see... You should've brought it to me, we could've been rich!
translation: 我明白了……你本该把它带给我的，我们本可以发财的！

english: I seek to shatter the illusion of hope this holiday embodies.
translation: 我要粉碎这个节日所代表的希望幻象。

english: I seem interested to you, do I?
translation: 你觉得我对你感兴趣，是吗？

english: I seem to be raising a cat, too, ever since some local lady persuaded me to buy one off her.
translation: 我好像也在养猫，自从当地一位女士说服我从她那里买了一只之后。

english: I seem to have lost that serving platter you gave me.
translation: 我好像把你给我的那个托盘弄丢了。

english: I seem to have lost the scroll you gave me; could I have another?
translation: 我好像把你给我的卷轴弄丢了；能再给我一个吗？

english: I seem to have lost track of that cake you baked.
translation: 我好像把你烤的那个蛋糕给忘了。

english: I seem to have taken all the plunder.
translation: 我好像把所有战利品都拿走了。

english: I sell news each day. 'Read all about it' I say. A low price to pay.
translation: 我每天卖新闻。'快来读读看'我说。价格低廉。

english: I sell tools that chop. Near where adventurers begin. Come visit my shop.
translation: 我卖砍伐工具。就在冒险者出发地附近。欢迎光临我的小店。

english: I sense you already have my wall lamp stored away somewhere. Come back to me if you lose it.
translation: 我感觉你已经把我的壁灯收在某个地方了。如果弄丢了就回来找我。

english: I serve only Zamorak.
translation: 我只侍奉扎莫拉克。

english: I shall let Hotpheex know. Thank you, Thordur.
translation: 我会通知霍特菲克斯。谢谢你，索杜尔。

english: I shall let Kaqemeex know. Thank you, Thordur.
translation: 我会通知卡基米克斯。谢谢你，索杜尔。

english: I shall prepare them for battle, and when the time is right, we shall storm the White Knights' Castle!
translation: 我会让他们做好战斗准备，时机一到，我们就冲进白骑士城堡！

english: I shall reward you with wealth such as you deserve.
translation: 我会赐予你应得的财富。

english: I shall see what options your brothers can offer me first.
translation: 我想先看看你的兄弟们能给我什么选择。

english: I shall! I really am appreciative of all their hard work.
translation: 我会的！我真的很感激他们所有的辛勤工作。

english: I shall, since you have assisted me.
translation: 我会的，既然你帮了我。

english: I should add some camel milk to this.
translation: 我应该往里面加些骆驼奶。

english: I should ask the Cook where to find them.
translation: 我应该问问厨师在哪里能找到它们。

english: I should bring My Arm the burnt banana pizza. I only get one shot at this.
translation: 我应该把烧焦的香蕉披萨带给"我的手臂"。我只有一次机会。

english: I should bring my notes with me incase I need them.
translation: 我应该随身带着我的笔记，以防需要用到。

english: I should deal with that ghost before trying to take the key again.
translation: 在再次尝试拿钥匙之前，我应该先处理掉那个幽灵。

english: I should fetch him, so he can tell you!
translation: 我应该去把他找来，这样他就能告诉你了！

english: I should free up some space so I can bring this stew-like food to the generals.
translation: 我应该腾出些空间，好把这炖菜般的食物带给将军们。

english: I should get some fireflies of each colour to keep the generals happy.
translation: 我应该每种颜色的萤火虫都抓一些，让将军们开心。

english: I should get the Cook to prepare these ingredients before I serve them.
translation: 我应该先让厨师准备这些食材，然后再端上去。

english: I should go and talk to the Easter Bunny about what I've learned!
translation: 我应该去跟复活节兔子谈谈我所了解到的情况！

english: I should go and think a bit more about it.
translation: 我应该再去好好想想。

english: I should go back to Juliet and see if I can cheer her up now.
translation: 我现在应该回到朱丽叶那里，看看能不能让她开心起来。

english: I should go get all the ingredients for their Christmas dinner.
translation: 我应该去收集他们圣诞晚餐所需的所有食材。

english: I should go seat another guest!
translation: 我应该去安排另一位客人入座！

english: I should have expected this! I will have to admit that my treat supply is limited and I have many more adventurers to reward.
translation: 我早该料到的！我得承认我的糖果储备有限，而且还有更多冒险者等着我去奖励。

english: I should have gone in front of you brushing the ice to make you go faster. Anyhow, you're back to being a stick.
translation: 我本该走在你前面，帮你把冰扫开，让你走得更快。不管怎样，你又变回一根棍子了。

english: I should have guessed that was what you were making... but sadly, no.
translation: 我早该猜到你在做那个……但可惜，不是。

english: I should have known from the anagram! I'd better get to it soon, otherwise it might be damaged.
translation: 我早该从字谜里看出来的！我最好快点去拿，不然它可能会损坏。

english: I should leave some supplies for other explorers.
translation: 我应该给其他探险者留些补给。

english: I should look for an interesting find in the secret room I found, and show it to the Expert at the Exam Centre.
translation: 我应该在我发现的密室里找找有趣的发现，然后拿给考试中心的专家看。

english: I should make 5 Easter eggs in total before speaking to Gertrude, otherwise they can't have an Easter egg each!
translation: 在和格特鲁德说话之前，我应该总共制作5个复活节彩蛋，否则他们每人分不到一个！

english: I should not disturb someone as tough as you, great lady.
translation: 我不该打扰像您这样强悍的人，伟大的女士。

english: I should not disturb someone as tough as you.
translation: 我不该打扰像你这样强悍的人。

english: I should probably get on with something else.
translation: 我或许该去做点别的事了。

english: I should probably give that Moon of Peril some time to cool off... I could check the rewards chest in the meantime.
translation: 我或许该给那个'危月'一点时间冷却……在此期间我可以检查一下奖励箱。

english: I should probably go hide me chest again so someone else can find it.
translation: 我或许该再去把我的箱子藏起来，好让别人能找到它。

english: I should probably go somewhere that Fred might actually see me.
translation: 我或许该去个弗雷德真能看到我的地方。

english: I should probably go somewhere that the Count might actually see me.
translation: 我或许该去个伯爵真能看到我的地方。

english: I should probably go somewhere that the Doomsayer might actually see me.
translation: 我或许该去个厄运预言者真能看到我的地方。

english: I should probably go talk to the captured player again.
translation: 我或许该再去和那个被俘的玩家谈谈。

english: I should probably have a chat with the Doom Sayer and find out what entertains him.
translation: 我或许该和厄运预言者聊聊，看看什么能让他开心。

english: I should probably leave the rest of these to anyone else who needs them.
translation: 我或许该把剩下的这些留给其他需要的人。

english: I should probably leave these alone.
translation: 我或许该别碰这些东西。

english: I should probably let Kit sort out his own belongings.
translation: 我或许该让基特自己整理他的东西。

english: I should probably report this to Arianwyn.
translation: 我或许该向阿里安温报告这件事。

english: I should probably talk to the Easter Bunny before I take anything.
translation: 我或许该在拿任何东西之前先和复活节兔子谈谈。

english: I should probably try and make this costume actually look like a tree...
translation: 我或许该试着把这套服装弄得真像棵树……

english: I should put on that armour.
translation: 我应该穿上那套盔甲。

english: I should really go get a new serving platter from the Cook before I try to serve a table.
translation: 在尝试上菜之前，我真该去厨师那里拿个新托盘。

english: I should return to Gilbert and show him what I've found.
translation: 我应该回到吉尔伯特那里，给他看看我的发现。

english: I should speak to Holly before I wander into an unknown dungeon.
translation: 在闯入未知地牢之前，我应该先和霍莉谈谈。

english: I should speak to Iffie about giving her the reward I promised! 67 -->
translation: 我应该和伊菲谈谈，把我承诺的奖励给她！

english: I should speak to the Examiner about taking Earth Science Exams.
translation: 我应该和考官谈谈参加地球科学考试的事。

english: I should take the letter the Examiner has given me to the Curator of Varrock Museum for his approval.
translation: 我应该把考官给我的信带给维洛克城博物馆的馆长，征求他的同意。

english: I should talk to Brother Jered before climbing this tree.
translation: 在爬这棵树之前，我应该先和杰瑞德修士谈谈。

english: I should talk to Iffie before climbing this tree.
translation: 在爬这棵树之前，我应该先和伊菲谈谈。

english: I should talk to her to see if she can help with my exams.
translation: 我应该和她谈谈，看看她能不能帮我准备考试。

english: I should talk to him to see if he can help with my exams.
translation: 我应该和他谈谈，看看他能不能帮我准备考试。

english: I should talk to the Examiner to take my first exam. If I have forgotten anything I can always ask the students again.
translation: 我应该和考官谈谈，参加我的第一场考试。如果我忘了什么，随时可以再问那些学生。

english: I should talk to the Examiner to take my second exam. If I have forgotten anything I can always ask the students again.
translation: 我应该和考官谈谈，参加我的第二场考试。如果我忘了什么，随时可以再问那些学生。

english: I should talk to the Examiner to take my third exam. If I have forgotten anything I can always ask the students again.
translation: 我应该和考官谈谈，参加我的第三场考试。如果我忘了什么，随时可以再问那些学生。

english: I should then take the disguises to Nickolaus in the cave.
translation: 然后我应该把伪装服带到洞穴里给尼古拉斯。

english: I should wait for Iffie to get to her next tree before I climb.
translation: 我应该等伊菲走到下一棵树再爬。

english: I should wait until I'm in a tree to do this!
translation: 我应该等爬到树上再做这个！

english: I should wait until I've gotten a food order before I start taking things.
translation: 我应该等接到点餐单之后再开始拿东西。

english: I shouldn't read other people's letters.
translation: 我不该偷看别人的信。

english: I slaved away in your little factory and for my trouble I get thrown into the sea...
translation: 我在你的小工厂里当牛做马，结果却被扔进了海里……

english: I somehow did not think Halloween was a holiday you'd enjoy.
translation: 我不知怎么的，觉得万圣节不是你喜欢的节日。

english: I speak of Anti-Santa. I let him come in for a chat, but that was months ago, and he's still here.
translation: 我说的是反圣诞老人。我让他进来聊聊天，但那已经是几个月前的事了，他现在还赖着不走。

english: I speak reason. Someone around here needs to!
translation: 我说的是道理。这里总得有人讲道理！

english: I split him.
translation: 我把他劈开了。

english: I spoke to Akrisae and he told me there had been a possible sighting of the Dark Squall at the Black Knights' Fortress. He sent Silif to investigate, but lost contact with him. I travelled to the Black Knights' Fortress myself to investigate. I found Silif imprisoned in some Catacombs beneath the Fortress.
translation: 我和阿克里赛谈过，他告诉我有人在黑骑士要塞可能看到了黑风暴。他派西利夫去调查，但后来就失去了联系。我亲自前往黑骑士要塞调查。我在要塞下方的地下墓穴里找到了被囚禁的西利夫。

english: I spoke to Alba at Ortus Farm and sorted out a missing Meat Delivery.
translation: 我在奥图斯农场跟阿尔芭谈过，处理了一笔失踪的肉类送货。

english: I spoke to Betty in her Magic Shop in Port Sarim. She told me that the Grey-Haired Man carrying a Case came in to buy some Runes, but left as she didn't sell the ones he was after. She said she made some Notes detailing which ones he wanted. She also mentioned that he was wearing a Monocle.
translation: 我在沙林港的魔法商店跟贝蒂谈过。她告诉我，那个提着箱子的灰发男子进来买符文，但因为店里没有他要的符文就离开了。她说她做了些笔记，详细记录了他想要哪些符文。她还提到他戴着一副单片眼镜。

english: I spoke to Charlie who deals with new deliveries at the Ardougne zoo. Apparently one of their associates named Nickolaus went in search of a ferret to replace one they lost, but he hasn't been heard from since. I should head to Eagles' Peak, a mountain to the West of the Gnome Stronghold, where he was last expected to have been. Maybe there I can find some clues as to his whereabouts.
translation: 我跟负责阿多尼城动物园新货的查理谈过。显然他们有个叫尼古拉斯的同事去找一只雪貂来替换丢失的那只，但之后就音讯全无。我应该前往鹰峰，那是地精要塞西边的一座山，他最后预计出现的地方。也许在那里我能找到一些关于他下落的线索。

english: I spoke to Constantinius, the host of the Party, and learnt a bit about him for Patzi. I also spoke to Cozyac, Pavo, and Xocotla and learnt about them as well.
translation: 我跟派对主人康斯坦提尼乌斯谈过，为帕齐了解了一些他的事。我也跟科齐亚克、帕沃和索科特拉谈过，同样了解了他们的情况。

english: I spoke to Duke Horacio in Lumbridge Castle. He told me that he'd found a Strange Talisman in the Castle which might be of use to the Order of the Wizards at the Wizards' Tower. He asked me to take it there and give it to a wizard called Sedridor.
translation: 我在仑桥镇城堡跟霍拉西奥公爵谈过。他告诉我他在城堡里发现了一个奇怪的护符，可能对法师塔的魔法师协会有用。他让我把护符带到那里，交给一个叫塞德里多的魔法师。

english: I spoke to Elias White in the Uzer Oasis. He asked for my help in freeing Arrav from Zemouregal by recovering his Heart.
translation: 我在乌泽绿洲跟伊莱亚斯.怀特谈过。他请求我帮忙找回阿拉夫的心脏，将他从泽莫雷加尔手中解救出来。

english: I spoke to Emelio in Outer Fortis. He asked me for some help in setting up Varlamore's first Kebab Shop. To do so, I chased up some Missing Deliveries for him.
translation: 我在福蒂斯外围跟埃梅利奥谈过。他请我帮忙在瓦拉莫尔开设第一家烤肉店。为此，我帮他追查了一些失踪的送货。

english: I spoke to General Wartface and General Bentnoze in Goblin Village. They were trying to pick a new colour of armour for the goblins in the village, but were unable to agree on a colour. I offered to help, so they asked me to bring them some Orange Goblin Mail to try out.
translation: 我在哥布林村庄跟疣脸将军和弯鼻将军谈过。他们正试图为村里的哥布林挑选一种新的盔甲颜色，但无法达成一致。我主动提出帮忙，所以他们让我带一些橙色哥布林链甲来试试。

english: I spoke to Guild Scribe Verity in The Burrow. She asked to look into the disappearance of Guild Hunter Fox. She suggested I talk to Guild Hunter Wolf to learn more.
translation: 我在洞穴里跟公会文书维里蒂谈过。她请求调查公会猎人狐狸失踪一事。她建议我跟公会猎人狼谈谈以了解更多。

english: I spoke to Guildmaster Apatura in the Hunter Guild. She told me that Guild Scribe Verity needed help with something and asked me to speak to her in The Burrow below the Guild.
translation: 我在猎人公会跟公会会长阿帕图拉谈过。她告诉我公会文书维里蒂需要帮忙处理一些事情，并让我到公会下方的洞穴里跟她谈谈。

english: I spoke to Ivy Sophista in Taverley. She directed me to Thaerisk, the leader of a group of Guthixians called Crux Eqal. Thaerisk asked me to help deal with the growing threat posed by Lucien. Before he could tell me more, we were attacked by Assassins. However, we were able to defeat them.
translation: 我在塔韦利村跟艾薇.索菲斯塔谈过。她指引我去找赛里斯克，一个叫克鲁克斯.埃卡尔的古斯教团领袖。赛里斯克请我帮忙应对卢西安日益增长的威胁。在他告诉我更多细节之前，我们遭到了刺客袭击。不过，我们成功击败了他们。

english: I spoke to Marcellus at the Locus Oasis. He made claims about a nearby group of Frogs having plans to overthrow humanity. I decided to look into this and discovered that the Frogs could talk. Despite Marcellus' claims, the Frogs had no plans to overthrow humanity.
translation: 我在洛克斯绿洲跟马塞勒斯谈过。他声称附近有一群青蛙计划推翻人类。我决定调查此事，发现这些青蛙竟然会说话。尽管马塞勒斯这么说，但青蛙并没有推翻人类的计划。

english: I spoke to Nahta in Cam Torum's Magic Shop and he enchanted the Talismans found by Jessamine. He then sent me to Cam Torum's Blacksmith who finished them off for me.
translation: 我在卡姆托鲁姆的魔法商店跟纳赫塔谈过，他给杰萨明找到的护符施了魔法。然后他让我去找卡姆托鲁姆的铁匠，铁匠帮我完成了最后的工序。

english: I spoke to Patzi on Aldarin. He asked me to help him sneak into a Party at Villa Lucens by posing as his Butler. To do so, I followed advice from Patzi's bag carrier, Adala, and obtained a Butler's Uniform from a Villa on the north side of the island.
translation: 我在阿尔达林岛跟帕齐谈过。他请我假扮他的管家，帮他潜入卢森斯别墅的一场派对。为此，我听从了帕齐的行李搬运工阿达拉的建议，从岛北边的一栋别墅弄到了一套管家制服。

english: I spoke to Prince Itzla Arkan in the Teomat atop Ralos' Rise. He told me he had a plan for dealing with the Twilight Emissaries. However, while explaining it to me, his mother, Queen Zyanyi Arkan, arrived and admonished him for failing to stop the attack on the Teomat. Itzla then directed me to rent the Basement Room in the Quetzacalli Gorge Pub.
translation: 我在拉洛斯之巅的特奥马特修道院跟伊茨拉.阿坎王子谈过。他告诉我他有一个对付暮光使者的计划。然而，在他向我解释时，他的母亲齐安伊.阿坎女王赶到，斥责他未能阻止对特奥马特修道院的袭击。伊茨拉随后让我去租下克察卡利峡谷酒吧的地下室房间。

english: I spoke to Ranulph near the Totem in north western Auburnvale. He told me he was researching the Ents of the Auburn Valley and their interactions with the Totems.
translation: 我在奥本谷西北部的图腾附近跟拉努尔夫谈过。他告诉我他正在研究奥本谷的树人以及它们与图腾的互动。

english: I spoke to Regulus Cento at the Quetzal Landing Site and he told me that a Suspicious-Looking Ma carrying a Case wanted to use one of the Quetzals. After being turned away, this Man apparently headed towards the Fortis Cathon.
translation: 我在绿咬鹃着陆点跟雷古卢斯.森托谈过，他告诉我一个形迹可疑、提着箱子的男子想使用一只绿咬鹃。被拒绝后，这名男子显然朝着福蒂斯卡松方向去了。

english: I spoke to Servius, Teokan of Ralos in the Sunrise Palace in Civitas illa Fortis. He took me to meet with Queen Zyanyi Arkan, who tasked me with helping to rescue her son, Prince Itzla Arkan, from the Twilight Emissaries. She told me to go to the Twilight Temple to gather information on the Emissaries' plans for Itzla.
translation: 我在福蒂斯城的日出宫跟拉洛斯的神官塞维乌斯谈过。他带我去见了齐安伊.阿坎女王，女王委托我帮忙从暮光使者手中救出她的儿子伊茨拉.阿坎王子。她让我前往暮光神殿收集关于使者们对伊茨拉计划的情报。

english: I spoke to Wolf and she explained to me that Fox was looking into making some repairs to Guild Hunter Kiko's Cat Bed.
translation: 我跟狼谈过，她向我解释说狐狸正在研究如何修理公会猎人基科的猫床。

english: I spoke to Zuma, a Priest of Ranul, and Attala, a Dwarven Official, at the entrance to Cam Torum. They were having a disagreement about some sort of Ruins found beneath the city. However, before I could learn more, we were informed that a Creature had escaped from these Ruins.
translation: 我在卡姆托鲁姆入口处跟拉努尔的祭司祖玛和矮人官员阿塔拉谈过。他们对于城市下方发现的一些废墟产生了分歧。然而，在我了解更多之前，我们被告知一个生物从这些废墟中逃了出来。

english: I spoke to members of the Trader Crew in the Fortis Cothon. They agreed to provide information in return for a favour. At their request, I took their Tattered Sails to the nearby Crafting Store to have them repaired. In return, they told me that a Grey-Haired Man carrying a Case recently booked passage to Port Sarim.
translation: 我在福蒂斯卡松跟商人船员的成员谈过。他们同意提供信息以换取一个忙。应他们的要求，我把他们的破烂的帆拿到附近的制作店修理。作为回报，他们告诉我一个提着箱子的灰发男子最近订了去沙林港的船票。

english: I spoke to the Boys and asked them what happened. They told me that they say Antos, another one of the Missing People, getting dragged deeper into the Cave in the Custodia Pass.
translation: 我跟男孩们谈过，问他们发生了什么事。他们告诉我他们看到安托斯，另一个失踪者，被拖进了库斯托迪亚隘口的洞穴深处。

english: I spoke to the Distressed Couple and they told me that their two Sons were among the Missing People.
translation: 我跟那对焦虑的夫妇谈过，他们告诉我他们的两个儿子也在失踪者之中。

english: I spoke to the Hunting Expert in the Feldip Hills and she showed me how to catch and train a Broav.
translation: 我跟费迪普丘陵的狩猎专家谈过，她教我如何捕捉和训练布罗夫。

english: I spoke to the Spice Merchant in the Bazaar and sorted out a missing Spice Delivery.
translation: 我跟集市的香料商人谈过，处理了一笔失踪的香料送货。

english: I spoke to the generals in the Goblin Village...
translation: 我跟哥布林村庄的将军们谈过……

english: I spoke to the members of the Trader Crew in Port Sarim. They told me that after disembarking, the Grey-Haired Man carrying a Case headed north while talking abour Runes.
translation: 我跟沙林港的商人船员成员谈过。他们告诉我，那个提着箱子的灰发男子下船后一边谈论着符文一边向北走去。

english: I spoke with Attala about what happened with the Old One Keystone and she told me that Teumo was able to escape from Cam Torum, resulting in the Twilight Emissaries having everything they needed to access the Crypt of Tonali.
translation: 我跟阿塔拉谈过关于古老者基石的事，她告诉我特乌莫成功逃离了卡姆托鲁姆，导致暮光使者拥有了进入托纳利墓穴所需的一切。

english: I spoke with Thaerisk, Akrisae and Idria about the contents of Movario's Research Notes. They revealed Lucien's desire to find and claim an artefact of unimaginable power called the Stone of Jas.
translation: 我跟赛里斯克、阿克里赛和伊德莉亚谈过莫瓦里奥研究笔记的内容。他们透露了卢西安想要找到并夺取一件名为贾斯之石的、拥有难以想象力量的 artifacts 的愿望。

english: I started the test... but I messed it up.
translation: 我开始了测试……但我搞砸了。

english: I started work on the Totem by rebuilding the main structure of it.
translation: 我开始重建图腾的主体结构。

english: I still need to clean out this vat! Ellis said that Ali Morrisane should have something for that.
translation: 我还需要清理这个大桶！埃利斯说阿里.莫里桑应该有办法。

english: I stole a Plushy from Marcellus and planted it on the Flies. However, upon doing so, I was attacked by Cuthbert, who it turns out survived the election. Thankfully, I was able to deal with him.
translation: 我从马塞勒斯那里偷了一个毛绒玩具，并把它栽赃给了苍蝇。然而，就在这样做的时候，我遭到了卡斯伯特的袭击，原来他在选举中幸存了下来。谢天谢地，我成功解决了他。

english: I suggest you embark on a quest, for as all adventurers know, a solid quest can often result in some small degree of wealth. Suggestions that spring to mind include the 'car-washing' quest, or the 'extra-chores' quest; speak to the keepers of the treasure, and see if there is some small quest you may undertake for them in return for a little financial reward.
translation: 我建议你开始一项任务，因为所有冒险者都知道，一个扎实的任务往往能带来一些小小的财富。我想到的建议包括“洗车”任务，或者“额外家务”任务；去和宝藏的守护者谈谈，看看有没有什么小任务你可以为他们做，以换取一点金钱奖励。

english: I summon the dead. Skeletons, Zombies and Ghosts. Land, Flame, Wind and Sea.
translation: 我召唤死者。骷髅、僵尸和幽灵。大地、火焰、风与海洋。

english: I suppose I could catch the other monkeys first.
translation: 我想我可以先抓住其他猴子。

english: I suppose I could lend a hand. Any ideas where to start?
translation: 我想我可以搭把手。有什么头绪从哪里开始吗？

english: I suppose I could lend an ear.
translation: 我想我可以倾听一下。

english: I suppose I could round up all of the monkeys for you, but I've never captured a monkey before. Perhaps it would be easier to just kill them?
translation: 我想我可以帮你把所有猴子都抓起来，但我以前从没抓过猴子。也许直接杀了它们更容易？

english: I suppose I could rustle up a few other things...
translation: 我想我可以再弄点别的东西……

english: I suppose I could, but you'll need to help me dear.
translation: 我想我可以，但亲爱的，你得帮我。

english: I suppose I do like to fish a bit on my day off, too. Alright, I don't really get it, but you can have the stuff.
translation: 我想我休假的时候也确实喜欢钓点鱼。好吧，我其实不太懂，但你可以拿走这些东西。

english: I suppose I should have made the clue harder.
translation: 我想我本应该把线索弄得更难一点。

english: I suppose I'd better go find one.
translation: 我想我最好去找一个。

english: I suppose I'll have to wait until then. But for now... Santa hats, gingerbread gnomes, and mulled wine!
translation: 我想我只能等到那时候了。但现在嘛……圣诞帽、姜饼侏儒和热红酒！

english: I suppose I'll head home then, thanks for the adventure.
translation: 我想那我就回家了，谢谢你的冒险。

english: I suppose it will have to.
translation: 我想也只能这样了。

english: I suppose she does sing she doesn't want a lot, then she goes on to ask for me, yet Dad always says I'm a lot. Maybe you're right and she's not after me at all!
translation: 我想她确实唱着她不想要太多，然后她又开始要我了，但爸爸总说我太麻烦。也许你说得对，她根本就不是冲我来的！

english: I suppose so, but I thought we were supposed to play tricks on them...
translation: 我想是吧，但我以为我们应该捉弄他们……

english: I suppose so. Okay, I'll be back in a few minutes.
translation: 我想是吧。好吧，我几分钟后就回来。

english: I suppose so. You had best go find out how to do that then.
translation: 我想是吧。那你最好去弄清楚该怎么做。

english: I suppose that is fair enough. In that case, I will take your advice to help me find someone else to visit!
translation: 我想这很公平。既然如此，我会接受你的建议，帮我找别人去拜访！

english: I suppose that is fair.
translation: 我想这很公平。

english: I suppose that's a start....
translation: 我想这算是个开始……

english: I suppose the mountain they mention here is Quidamortem as it lies south of Molch... Interesting.
translation: 我想他们这里提到的山是基达莫特姆，因为它位于莫尔奇聚落以南……有意思。

english: I suppose you are correct. We did a good job!
translation: 我想你说得对。我们干得不错！

english: I suppose you're just quitting then.
translation: 我想你这就是要放弃了。

english: I suppose you're referring to the incident with the mole... May I ask why you converse with small woodland critters about my feats?
translation: 我想你指的是那只鼹鼠的事……我能问问你为什么跟小林地生物谈论我的事迹吗？

english: I suppose. I'd have had to make multiple trips, and nobody wants that.
translation: 我想是吧。不然我就得跑好几趟了，没人想那样。

english: I suppose... Maybe I'm just not cut out for this.
translation: 我想……也许我根本不适合干这个。

english: I t'ink that is okay. You are bit late though, others already dun. Not many ingredients left.
translation: 我觉得没问题。不过你来晚了点，其他人已经做完了。剩下的材料不多了。

english: I take little interest in the pagan lands that do not recognise my glory, but judging from the deities they choose to worship it would surprise me little if they are embarked in some foolish war or other. I know traders are constantly trying to reopen the closed trade routes between the various continents, but I suspect they will meet with some resistance.
translation: 我对那些不承认我荣耀的异教之地没什么兴趣，但从他们选择崇拜的神祇来看，如果他们正卷入某场愚蠢的战争或其他事情，我一点也不惊讶。我知道商人们一直在试图重新开放各大洲之间关闭的贸易路线，但我怀疑他们会遇到一些阻力。

english: I take no concern nor solace in the use of herblore for personal gain, for it teaches those who use such elixirs the respect that must be held for nature, even though consciously they mayst claim otherwise. Herblore hath benefits to all, whether it be the strength imparted by the potion of Zamorak, or the increased blessings of Saradomin in prayer restore potions; this is all part of the balance, and serves the truth of mine own power.
translation: 我对利用草药学谋取私利既不关心也不感到慰藉，因为它教会了使用这些灵药的人必须对自然怀有的尊重，尽管他们可能口头上不承认。草药学对所有人都有益处，无论是扎莫拉克药水赋予的力量，还是萨拉多明在祈祷恢复药水中增加的祝福；这都是平衡的一部分，并服务于我自身力量的真理。

english: I talked to Gertrude. She said you boys didn't get an Easter egg last year.
translation: 我跟格特鲁德谈过。她说你们这些孩子去年没拿到复活节彩蛋。

english: I talked to Oziach...
translation: 我跟奥扎克谈过……

english: I tell you what. I'll go and ask, and if I don't come back, assume that he said yes and come and join me in the castle courtyard, ok?
translation: 我跟你说。我去问问，如果我没回来，就当他是同意了，然后到城堡庭院里来找我，好吗？

english: I think Elly normally hangs out near Ali Morrisane, and Alice hangs out just south of the gem trader.
translation: 我想埃莉通常待在阿里.莫里桑附近，爱丽丝待在宝石商人南边。

english: I think Gertrude would love some Easter eggs this year.
translation: 我想格特鲁德今年会喜欢一些复活节彩蛋。

english: I think I can help you with those!
translation: 我想我能帮你搞定那些！

english: I think I could do that... It is Christmas, after all!
translation: 我想我能做到……毕竟现在是圣诞节！

english: I think I forgot where I was going. I remember now. Back to Cecilia in Falador Park I go!
translation: 我想我忘了要去哪里。现在想起来了。我要回到法拉多公园的塞西莉亚那里去！

english: I think I have everything I need for the churn!
translation: 我想我有了搅拌桶所需的一切！

english: I think I have it handled for now.
translation: 我想目前我能应付。

english: I think I have, don't know for sure yet though, we'll have to do some tests.
translation: 我想我有了，但还不确定，我们得做些测试。

english: I think I hear a cat meowing.
translation: 我好像听到猫在叫。

english: I think I know the children he means. They'll be bored to tears. Next year maybe I should send them trick-or-treating, rather than leaving them for Eric to entertain.
translation: 我想我知道他指的是哪些孩子。他们会无聊到哭的。明年也许我该让他们去玩不给糖就捣蛋，而不是留给埃里克去哄。

english: I think I know where it is! It's buried near a drain, by the pub, south of Varrock.
translation: 我想我知道它在哪！它埋在维洛克城南部酒吧附近的一个排水沟旁。

english: I think I know where the hideout is, but I can't get inside.
translation: 我想我知道藏身处在哪里，但我进不去。

english: I think I need some more space before I open that. Looks like I need [number of spaces] more [space/spaces] before I can open it!
translation: 我想在打开那个之前我需要更多空间。看起来我还需要[number of spaces]个[space/spaces]才能打开它！

english: I think I should go and speak to Hans.
translation: 我想我应该去跟汉斯谈谈。

english: I think I will do just fine.
translation: 我想我会过得很好。

english: I think I'd better have a lie down.
translation: 我想我最好躺下休息一下。

english: I think I'd better learn the words of binding before summoning a mighty spirit...
translation: 我想在召唤强大的灵魂之前，我最好先学会束缚咒语……

english: I think I'll check my other options with your brothers.
translation: 我想我会跟你兄弟们看看其他选择。

english: I think I'll stand if that is ok.
translation: 我想我站着就好，如果没问题的话。

english: I think I'll stay here
translation: 我想我就待在这里

english: I think I'll stick to Trick-or-Treating for now.
translation: 我想我现在还是坚持玩不给糖就捣蛋吧。

english: I think I'm going crazy...
translation: 我想我快疯了……

english: I think I'm going mad.
translation: 我想我快疯了。

english: I think I'm going to need a prop of the sword to use as a reference, however, I'm not one to go off looking for such a thing.
translation: 我想我需要一把剑的道具作为参考，不过我不是那种会去找这种东西的人。

english: I think I'm good. Thanks, Diango!
translation: 我想我够了。谢谢，迪亚戈！

english: I think I've helped you enough, already.
translation: 我想我已经帮你够多了。

english: I think I've taught you everything I can about Christmas. How do you feel about it now? 12. -->
translation: 我想我已经把关于圣诞节的一切都教给你了。你现在感觉如何？12. -->

english: I think Oaknock's machine is now unlocked, what do I do now?
translation: 我想奥克诺克的机器现在已经解锁了，我现在该怎么办？

english: I think Party Pete's onto me too and is going to stop me enjoying the nibbles soon because I stand out like a hellcat. I need to blend in so he won't be suspicious.
translation: 我想派对皮特也盯上我了，很快就会阻止我享用小吃，因为我像只地狱猫一样显眼。我需要融入其中，这样他就不会起疑了。

english: I think he might have been sleeping.
translation: 我想他可能一直在睡觉。

english: I think he said he was going to the lumberyard north-east of here, you should probably go check up on him.
translation: 我想他说他要去这里东北边的木材场，你最好去看看他。

english: I think he's banking on success near the East bank here in Varrock.
translation: 我想他正指望着在维洛克城东边的银行附近成功。

english: I think it is, you know. I must have performed a ritual that summoned the THING. I was only looking in the book for a more spooky story, to replace the one we wrote.
translation: 我想确实如此，你知道的。我一定是在书里寻找一个更恐怖的故事来替换我们写的那一个时，进行了一个仪式，召唤出了那个东西。

english: I think it should have a camel's head.
translation: 我想它应该有个骆驼头。

english: I think it'll just mean an increase of shipwrecks, if you ask me! But it is good for my business.
translation: 要我说，这只会导致沉船事故增加！不过这对我的生意有好处。

english: I think it's good news for your friends.
translation: 我想这对你的朋友们来说是个好消息。

english: I think it's over... Can we get that orb back up?
translation: 我想结束了……我们能把那颗宝珠放回去吗？

english: I think my work here is done. I'll leave you both to it.
translation: 我想我的工作完成了，你们俩慢慢忙吧。

english: I think one bunch of the biggest flowers of each colour will be more than enough for now. Pass them my way once you get them, the fresher they are, the better.
translation: 我想每种颜色最大的一束花暂时就足够了。拿到后交给我，越新鲜越好。

english: I think so! I need to head off, I have someone I need to tell.
translation: 我想是的！我得走了，有个人我得去告诉他。
