english: I think so! It needs to be delivered to Party Pete in Falador. Would you mind taking it to him?
translation: 我想是的！需要送到法拉多城的派对皮特那里。你介意帮我送给他吗？

english: I think so, can you check to make sure they're okay?
translation: 我想是的，你能检查一下确保他们没事吗？

english: I think some gold and silver paint would do. Have a chat with Aggie in Draynor Village, she's good with colours.
translation: 我想金色和银色的颜料就行。去德雷诺村找阿吉聊聊，她对颜色很在行。

english: I think that makes me the winner dude.
translation: 老兄，我想这样我就是赢家了。

english: I think that might stain the wood... Best not to do that.
translation: 我想那可能会弄脏木头……最好别那么做。

english: I think that sums it up...
translation: 我想就是这样了……

english: I think that's everybody covered! I should probably go and see the Duke again.
translation: 我想所有人都照顾到了！我该再去见见公爵了。

english: I think that's everyone sorted, come see me over by Gilbert west of Gertrude's house to debrief.
translation: 我想所有人都安排好了，到格特鲁德房子西边的吉尔伯特那里找我汇报情况。

english: I think the answer to one's existence is a difficult one to answer for anyone. Without a goal or a drive, one can lose oneself.
translation: 我想存在的意义对任何人来说都很难回答。没有目标或动力，人就会迷失自我。

english: I think the cook in the Blue Moon Inn can help us. The inn is just north of where you & I met.
translation: 我想蓝月旅馆的厨师能帮我们。旅馆就在我们相遇的地方北边。

english: I think the fact that she misplaced her glasses the other day has something to do with it.
translation: 我想她前几天把眼镜放错地方跟这事有关。

english: I think the goblins went to another house here in Lumbridge, try looking somewhere else.
translation: 我想哥布林去了仑桥镇的另一间房子，试试去别处找找。

english: I think the key to opening the scuffed chest is in my mum's letter. I'll read it again.
translation: 我想打开那个磨损的箱子的钥匙在我妈妈的信里。我再读一遍。

english: I think the pumpkin's getting to his head.
translation: 我想那个南瓜让他冲昏了头。

english: I think there was one loitering around near the crates before. Could you go confront them?
translation: 我想之前有一个在板条箱附近闲逛。你能去质问他们吗？

english: I think they're Gertrude's children, she lives west of here.
translation: 我想他们是格特鲁德的孩子，她住在这里西边。

english: I think this may be a step further than really hot food.
translation: 我想这可能比真正的辣食更进一步了。

english: I think this might belong to you.
translation: 我想这个可能是你的。

english: I think this poor dog will need more attention than I can give it.
translation: 我想这只可怜的狗需要的照顾比我所能给的更多。

english: I think we have a memento for every skill! Let's return to the building where we met, and see how the ritual grid is looking! It's upstairs.
translation: 我想我们每个技能都有纪念品了！回到我们见面的那栋楼，看看仪式网格怎么样了！在楼上。

english: I think we should each take one side of the path, climb up a tree, and scare Oziach.
translation: 我想我们应该各走小路的一边，爬上树，吓唬奥扎克。

english: I think we should get the children back to Rimmington before anything else happens. You'd better come too - I owe you a reward.
translation: 我想我们得在出事前把孩子带回里明顿村。你最好也来——我欠你一份报酬。

english: I think we're back?
translation: 我想我们回来了？

english: I think we're done for now.
translation: 我想我们暂时做完了。

english: I think we're finished!
translation: 我想我们完成了！

english: I think we're getting a bit off course.
translation: 我想我们有点偏离正轨了。

english: I think you already have my scarecrow stored away somewhere. Come back to me if you lose it.
translation: 我想你已经把我的稻草人收在某个地方了。如果弄丢了就回来找我。

english: I think you can help me with mementos for Attack and Strength. I need traditional weapons that people have been able to use since time immemorial to train the skills.
translation: 我想你能帮我找攻击和力量的纪念品。我需要自古以来人们用来训练这些技能的传统武器。

english: I think you can help us cover three skills in one stop! First, I'll need a traditional shortbow as a memento of Ranged. But you also make some of your own wares, don't you?
translation: 我想你能帮我们一次搞定三个技能！首先，我需要一把传统短弓作为远程的纪念品。但你自己也会做一些商品，对吧？

english: I think you could potentially look elsewhere in life.
translation: 我想你或许可以在生活中另寻他路。

english: I think you did, deep down!
translation: 我想你内心深处是知道的！

english: I think you will be best off targeting the yellow ones next; [X] left.
translation: 我想你接下来最好瞄准黄色的；还剩[X]个。

english: I think you're completely mad!
translation: 我想你完全疯了！

english: I think you've brought everything I need! Now, as a reward, I've cooked you my signature dish, using the recipe for which I'm famous...
translation: 我想你带齐了我需要的一切！现在，作为奖励，我为你做了我的招牌菜，用的是我赖以成名的食谱……

english: I think you've solved the problem as much as possible. Thanks!
translation: 我想你已经尽可能解决了问题。谢谢！

english: I thought I heard something weird outside the castle. What happened?
translation: 我好像听到城堡外面有奇怪的声音。发生什么事了？

english: I thought I was finally free... But recently she somehow thawed out and started singing again. I can't go on like this.
translation: 我以为我终于自由了……但最近她不知怎么解冻了，又开始唱歌。我受不了这样下去了。

english: I thought about shaving it all off, but that would probably scare the locals even more.
translation: 我想过全剃掉，但那可能会更吓到当地人。

english: I thought for once everything would run as smooth as milk chocolate.
translation: 我以为这次一切都会像牛奶巧克力一样顺利。

english: I thought hairdressers only removed the hair, not added it.
translation: 我以为理发师只剪头发，不添头发。

english: I thought it was just some sort of marketing nonsense!
translation: 我以为那只是某种营销废话！

english: I thought it would be very fitting to the theme!
translation: 我觉得这很符合主题！

english: I thought maybe you could bring me the sword I need?
translation: 我想也许你能把我需要的剑带来？

english: I thought that if I painted a big enough picture of something they liked and it was visible at the time of the year when spirits are closest to us...
translation: 我想如果我画一幅足够大的他们喜欢的东西的画，并且在一年中灵魂离我们最近的时候能看到它……

english: I thought this was a chance to adventure again, just one more time.
translation: 我以为这是再次冒险的机会，就最后一次。

english: I thought we had to mix the cinnamon and holly into the wine?
translation: 我以为我们得把肉桂和冬青混进酒里？

english: I thought you had to give the mould to the Easter Bunny?
translation: 我以为你得把模具交给复活节兔子？

english: I thought you said you were good at coming up with ideas?
translation: 你不是说你很擅长想点子吗？

english: I thought you were going to ask for just one more small favour.
translation: 我以为你只会再求一件小事。

english: I tire of ogres; prepare to die!
translation: 我厌倦了食人魔；准备受死吧！

english: I told Marcellus about his Plushy and he agreed to the peace terms. Sue and Gary thanked me for my help, calling me a hero. I now hope to never go through anything like this ever again.
translation: 我告诉马塞勒斯他的毛绒玩具的事，他同意了和平条款。苏和加里感谢我的帮助，称我为英雄。我现在希望再也不要经历这种事了。

english: I told Servius and Attala what I'd discovered. Servius left to inform Queen Zyanyi while Attala set out to find and deal with Teumo.
translation: 我把发现告诉了塞尔维乌斯和阿塔拉。塞尔维乌斯离开去通知齐扬伊女王，而阿塔拉出发去寻找并处理特乌莫。

english: I told you it would be handy! Let me guess - they asked for a kebab?
translation: 我告诉过你这会派上用场！让我猜猜——他们要了烤肉？

english: I told you!
translation: 我告诉过你！

english: I took a look at a Notice Board in the Auburn Pub in Auburnvale and found it to be covered in Missing Person Posters.
translation: 我看了看奥本谷奥本酒吧的公告板，发现上面贴满了寻人启事。

english: I took the Fur Sample to Atza in Outer Fortis and she gave me the Trimmed Fur needed to fix Kiko's Bed.
translation: 我把毛皮样本带到福蒂斯外围的阿特扎那里，她给了我修理基科床所需的修剪毛皮。

english: I took the letter to the squire.
translation: 我把信交给了侍从。

english: I travelled to Lucien's Camp and confronted Lucien with the Heroes. However, he was too powerful for us. Duradel, Turael, Sloane, Cyrisus, Ghommal and Hazelmere were all killed. The rest of us were forced to flee.
translation: 我前往卢西安的营地，与英雄们一起对抗卢西安。然而，他太强大了。杜拉德尔、图拉尔、斯隆、西里苏斯、戈马尔和黑兹尔米尔全部被杀。我们其余人被迫逃离。

english: I travelled to the Crypt of Tonali in the Tlati Rainforest and met up with Queen Zyanyi and Captain Vibia. We tried our best to fight off the Twilight Emissaries attacking the Crypt, but thanks to Teumo, they were able to make it through to the inner section. However, we did at least manage to rescue Itzla after they did so.
translation: 我前往特拉提雨林的托纳利墓穴，与齐扬伊女王和维比娅船长会合。我们尽力击退攻击墓穴的暮光使者，但多亏了特乌莫，他们得以进入内部区域。不过，在他们得手后，我们至少成功救出了伊茨拉。

english: I travelled to the Fight Arena and found a Launderer who knew Movario. He gave me a Dirty Shirt belonging to him and directed me to the Hunting Expert in the Feldip Hills to ask about obtaining a Broav to track Movario with.
translation: 我前往战斗竞技场，找到一个认识莫瓦里奥的洗衣工。他给了我一件属于莫瓦里奥的脏衬衫，并指引我去费迪普丘陵找狩猎专家，询问如何获得一只布罗夫来追踪莫瓦里奥。

english: I travelled to the Quetzacalli Gorge Pub and rented a room there. I met with Itzla's Contact, but they turned out to be Itzla himself. He explained that his plan is for us to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries by posing as new recruits. To do so, I spoke to the Quetzacalli Gorge Shopkeeper, a member of the Emissaries, about joining. He agreed to send word to them.
translation: 我前往克察卡利峡谷酒吧，在那里租了一个房间。我见到了伊茨拉的联系人，结果发现他就是伊茨拉本人。他解释说，他的计划是让我们假扮新兵潜入暮光使者。为此，我跟克察卡利峡谷的店主（使者的一员）谈了加入的事。他同意向他们传话。

english: I travelled to the Quetzacalli Gorge Pub and rented a room there. I met with Itzla's Contact, but they turned out to be Itzla himself. He explained that his plan is for us to infiltrate the Twilight Emissaries by posing as new recruits. To do so, I spoke to the Quetzacalli Gorge Shopkeeper, a member of the Emissaries, about joining. He agreed to send word to them. I returned to Itzla and let him know that the Shopkeeper agreed to contact the Emissaries for us. Itzla then asked me to meet him at the Twilight Temple where the Emissaries are based.
translation: 我前往克察卡利峡谷酒吧，在那里租了一个房间。我见到了伊茨拉的联系人，结果发现他就是伊茨拉本人。他解释说，他的计划是让我们假扮新兵潜入暮光使者。为此，我跟克察卡利峡谷的店主（使者的一员）谈了加入的事。他同意向他们传话。我回到伊茨拉那里，告诉他店主同意为我们联系使者。然后伊茨拉让我到使者所在的暮光神庙与他会合。

english: I travelled to the Twilight Temple and witnessed Metzli giving a speech to her followers with Ennius and Furia at her side. During the speech, Itzla was brought out from a Dungeon directly below the Temple.
translation: 我前往暮光神庙，目睹了梅茨利在恩尼乌斯和富里亚的陪同下向追随者发表演讲。演讲期间，伊茨拉被从神庙正下方的地牢里带了出来。

english: I travelled to the Twilight Temple east of Quetzacalli Gorge and met with Itzla outside of the Tower of Ascension. While we waited to be called up to take our Recruitment Tests, I spoke to the other Recruits. One of them told me the Emissaries had a new leader called the Augur.
translation: 我前往克察卡利峡谷东边的暮光神庙，在飞升之塔外与伊茨拉会面。在等待被叫去参加招募测试时，我与其他新兵交谈。其中一人告诉我，使者们有了一位新领袖，叫做预言者。

english: I tried speaking to Carol but she just won't budge. Do you have any ideas?
translation: 我试着跟卡罗尔谈过，但她就是不肯让步。你有什么主意吗？

english: I tried to do a quest once that I needed goblin mail for, but I couldn't find any, so I gave up.
translation: 我曾经想做一个需要哥布林链甲的任务，但我找不到，所以就放弃了。

english: I tried to help your son but he kicked me off of Wester Island!
translation: 我试图帮助你儿子，但他把我赶出了韦斯特岛！

english: I tried, but the goblins hit me and stopped the teleport.
translation: 我试过了，但哥布林打了我，打断了传送。

english: I understand you are an expert on watercraft. Do you have a memento of Sailing, or anything like that? I know your canoes don't have sails, but we're miles from the sea!
translation: 我知道你是船只专家。你有航海的纪念品或类似的东西吗？我知道你的独木舟没有帆，但我们离海有好几英里呢！

english: I understand you do not wish to talk about Zaros, but who is he? If even Zamorak is afraid of him?
translation: 我明白你不想谈论扎罗斯，但他到底是谁？连扎莫拉克都怕他？

english: I understand. Let me know if you change your mind!
translation: 我明白了。如果你改变主意，告诉我一声！

english: I understood that to mean he doesn't want me freezing the whole continent.
translation: 我明白那意思是说，他不想让我把整个大陆都冻住。

english: I used the Talismans to find the source of power in Neypotzli. It turned out that this source of power was a creature known as a Nagua. She introduced herself as Eyatlalli and told me that Neypotzli was built to contain three dangerous Nagua called the Moons of Peril. However, before she could tell me more, we were interrupted by a sudden shaking.
translation: 我使用护符找到了内波茨利监狱的力量之源。结果发现这个力量之源是一种叫做纳瓜的生物。她自我介绍为埃亚特拉利，并告诉我内波茨利监狱是为了囚禁三个被称为灾厄之月的危险纳瓜而建造的。然而，在她告诉我更多之前，一阵突如其来的震动打断了我们。

english: I used to be an adventurer like you...
translation: 我以前也像你一样是个冒险者……

english: I usually deal in just about anything and everything!
translation: 我通常什么都买卖！

english: I usually get a nice kebab around now but I think these eggs are crackin'.
translation: 我通常这时候会吃个美味的烤肉，但我想这些蛋棒极了。

english: I visited the grotto earlier. I had a lovely time!
translation: 我之前去了那个洞穴。我玩得很开心！

english: I w-
I want a bubbling green witch's brew! A cauldron of foul-smelling green water will have to do. Now, off you go to Hetty in Rimmington.
translation: 我要一杯冒着绿泡的女巫的魔药！一锅臭烘烘的绿水就行。现在，你去找里明顿村的赫蒂吧。

english: I want a place people can visit in peace and calm, without fear of judgement. Right now, I am in talks with some leprechauns for a piece of land.
translation: 我想要一个人们可以平静安宁地参观、不用担心被评判的地方。目前，我正在和一些矮妖精洽谈一块土地。

english: I want my reward.
translation: 我要我的奖励。

english: I want to ask about the Magic Guild.
translation: 我想问问关于魔法公会的事。

english: I want to develop friendly relations with your people.
translation: 我想与你们的人民发展友好关系。

english: I want to earn Prince Brand's approval.
translation: 我想赢得布兰德王子的认可。

english: I want to earn Princess Astrid's approval.
translation: 我想赢得阿斯特丽德公主的认可。

english: I want to go to the cave.
translation: 我想去那个洞穴。

english: I want to know about tree baubles.
translation: 我想了解树上的小饰品。

english: I want to know about tree decorations?
translation: 我想了解树的装饰品？

english: I want to learn more - what should I study?
translation: 我想了解更多——我应该学什么？

english: I want to make some arrows, so I'll need some headless arrows that have the feathers attached. I still need [number].
translation: 我想做些箭，所以我需要一些已经装上羽毛的无头箭。我还需要[number]支。

english: I want to resign from the party.
translation: 我想退出队伍。

english: I want to return to the Wise Old Man's house.
translation: 我想回到睿智老人的房子。

english: I want to see people dancing, people moving, people drinking and have a fun time - can you help out with that?
translation: 我想看到人们跳舞、活动、喝酒，玩得开心——你能帮忙吗？

english: I want to stick to making rotten tomatoes.
translation: 我想继续做烂番茄。

english: I want to stick to making supercompost.
translation: 我想继续做超级堆肥。

english: I want to unlock more colours!
translation: 我想解锁更多颜色！

english: I want to use my tomato to make compost.
translation: 我想用我的番茄做堆肥。

english: I want you to make me a [Fruity/Fresh/Bitter/Earthy/Smoked/Crunchy/Spicy/Fishy/Meaty/Rich/Fluffy/Salted] easter egg.
translation: 我要你帮我做一个[Fruity/Fresh/Bitter/Earthy/Smoked/Crunchy/Spicy/Fishy/Meaty/Rich/Fluffy/Salted]的复活节彩蛋。

english: I wanted to win, I still do. But I can't let you throw it away when you're so close.
translation: 我想赢，现在仍然想。但我不能让你在如此接近的时候放弃。

english: I was afraid I'd trample mud on them from outside.
translation: 我担心从外面会把泥巴踩到它们上面。

english: I was born in your ancestors, back when they cowered from beasts in the highest trees and the deepest caves. As your species advanced, I lived on in new forms.
translation: 我诞生于你们的祖先之中，那时他们还躲藏在最高的树上和最深的洞穴里躲避野兽。随着你们物种的进步，我以新的形态继续存在。

english: I was born ready.
translation: 我生来就准备好了。

english: I was down there earlier, extinguishing the boiler to cool the house down, and I didn't see a shovel. You're not making any sense - be off with you.
translation: 我之前下去过，熄灭了锅炉让房子凉快下来，但我没看到铲子。你简直在胡说八道——快走吧。

english: I was expecting something a little better than this to be honest.
translation: 说实话，我原本期待的东西比这要好一点。

english: I was gathering ingredients for the eggs, and I came across a fully assembled ice cream churn just laying around! It's like someone made it and just threw it away!
translation: 我正在收集鸡蛋的原料，结果发现一个组装好的冰淇淋搅拌器就扔在那里！好像有人做好了就直接丢掉了！

english: I was going to scrub them clean.
translation: 我正打算把它们擦干净。

english: I was hopeful that things would work out.
translation: 我曾希望事情能顺利解决。

english: I was hoping you could back to the Ferox Enclave find another magician.
translation: 我希望你能回到费罗飞地再找个魔法师。

english: I was hoping you had some treats...
translation: 我还指望你带点好吃的来呢……

english: I was hoping you'd say that! I'm baking some gingerbread gnomes for the Falador Christmas Festival, which as you know, is very soon!
translation: 我就等你这句话！我正在为法拉多城的圣诞节庆典烤一些姜饼侏儒，你知道的，庆典很快就要到了！

english: I was just enjoying a drink!
translation: 我正享受一杯饮料呢！

english: I was just on my way to do that. Do you want me to relay any messages to him?
translation: 我正要去办那件事。需要我给他带什么话吗？

english: I was just telling them one of my stories when suddenly the biggest spider I had ever seen appeared in front of my eyes!
translation: 我正给他们讲我的一个故事，突然我见过最大的蜘蛛出现在我眼前！

english: I was on the naughty list, remember?
translation: 我在淘气名单上，记得吗？

english: I was playing with my friend because my brothers ran off.
translation: 我本来在和我的朋友玩，因为我哥哥们跑掉了。

english: I was reading the history of runes in the Varrock Library and it said that runes were for those who did not spend a long time practising the arts of Magick. The best mages in Runescape spend many hours, days and weeks practising the arts so why do they still need runestone?
translation: 我在维洛克城图书馆读符文历史时，上面说符文是为那些没有花大量时间练习魔法技艺的人准备的。Runescape 里最优秀的法师会花很多小时、很多天、很多星期来练习技艺，那他们为什么还需要符文石呢？

english: I was rewarded for my findings.
translation: 我的发现得到了奖励。

english: I was sent by Death.
translation: 我是死神派来的。

english: I was trying to craft a playground for everyone, with ramps and everything. That should be fun and entertaining, right?
translation: 我本想为大家建一个游乐场，有坡道什么的。那应该会很有趣很好玩，对吧？

english: I was visiting Lumbridge and a terrible thing has happened.
translation: 我正在拜访仑桥镇，结果发生了一件可怕的事情。

english: I was with the Knights for quite some time and they waffled on a lot but I heard them mention Lumbridge caves a few times.
translation: 我和骑士们待了相当长一段时间，他们废话连篇，但我听到他们提过几次仑桥镇洞穴。

english: I was wondering if you could help me make Lunar Glass?
translation: 我想知道你能不能帮我制作月玻璃？

english: I was wondering if you'd have any costumes we could borrow to dress up the dogs and increase their chances of adoption?
translation: 我想知道你们有没有什么服装可以借给我们，给狗狗们打扮一下，增加它们被领养的机会？

english: I wasn't allowed to leave the house because I didn't finish my homework.
translation: 我不被允许离开房子，因为我没完成作业。

english: I wasn't planning on it. I can't reach up there anyway.
translation: 我没打算那么做。反正我也够不到上面。

english: I wasn't sure how to repay you for your help, but I made a lot of these flower crowns while waiting here earlier.
translation: 我不知道该怎么报答你的帮助，但我之前在这里等的时候做了很多这种花冠。

english: I went through all this trouble to restore this axe, I'm not going to ruin it now by wielding it and accidentally smashing it to pieces. I'd better take it to the sculptor.
translation: 我费了这么大劲才修复这把斧头，我可不想现在挥舞它，不小心把它砸成碎片。我最好把它拿给雕刻师。

english: I will also grant you the right to have your own house decorated like mine, and the makeover mage will henceforth offer some more... spooky options.
translation: 我还会授予你将自己的房子装饰成我这样的权利，而且变身法师今后也会提供一些更……阴森的选择。

english: I will be there!
translation: 我会去的！

english: I will consider it.
translation: 我会考虑的。

english: I will do that now. I'll be back soon with the treasure chest.
translation: 我现在就去办。我很快就会带着宝箱回来。

english: I will express my gratitude in the usual way, with two sets of masks and two pumpkins. You may also have Anti-Santa's spare underpants; this pair appears to have shrunk, and may fit you.
translation: 我会用老办法表达我的感激之情，给你两套面具和两个南瓜。你也可以拿走反圣诞老人的备用内裤；这条看起来缩水了，可能适合你。

english: I will get on it right away.
translation: 我马上去办。

english: I will go and find out, back soon.
translation: 我去查查，很快回来。

english: I will go find Wizard Traiborn and see what he says.
translation: 我去找魔法师特雷伯恩，听听他怎么说。

english: I will have to cause some form of distraction. Maybe light something on fire?
translation: 我得制造点混乱。也许放把火？

english: I will head there now. It feels odd to leave you behind for once!
translation: 我现在就去那里。难得把你抛在后面，感觉怪怪的！

english: I will help you with your ritual.
translation: 我会帮你完成你的仪式。

english: I will hide somewhere in the house.|colour=yellow|shadow=yes
translation: 我会躲在房子里的某个地方。|colour=yellow|shadow=yes

english: I will hold these [number] items until madam has space to take them.
translation: 我会保管这[number]件物品，直到女士有空来取。

english: I will hold these [number] items until sir has space to take them.
translation: 我会保管这[number]件物品，直到先生有空来取。

english: I will insert the ores. That device, there, allows the air that flows into the furnace to be regulated. Pull it gently.
translation: 我来放入矿石。那个装置，就在那里，可以调节流入熔炉的空气。轻轻拉一下。

english: I will let Chancellor Hassan know that ye won, I be sure he'll be impressed.
translation: 我会让哈桑大臣知道你赢了，我肯定他会印象深刻的。

english: I will meet with this man on one condition, [player name].
translation: 我可以见这个人，但有一个条件，[player name]。

english: I will not ask whether this is also your choice of clothes the rest of the year.
translation: 我不会问这是否也是你一年中其他时间的衣服选择。

english: I will not give away specifications, beaky. All you need to know is that it can hit a mushroom from two hundred acorns away. Try flying away from that one. Oh, you can't fly? Ah, bless.
translation: 我不会透露具体规格的，鸟嘴。你只需要知道，它能从两百颗橡子远的地方击中一朵蘑菇。有本事你飞着躲开那个试试。哦，你不会飞？啊，真可怜。

english: I will not let you down!
translation: 我不会让你失望的！

english: I will offer you [number] points for all the antique emblems in your bank, if you wish.
translation: 如果你愿意，我会为你银行里所有的古董徽章提供[number]点积分。

english: I will once I have some.
translation: 等我有了一些再说。

english: I will search for her!
translation: 我会去找她的！

english: I will slay dragons, hunt demons, save kingdoms! You will soon see me in the guild of Legends!
translation: 我要屠龙、猎魔、拯救王国！你很快就能在传奇公会里看到我了！

english: I will stick around!
translation: 我会留下来的！

english: I will take this side of the path, you take the other one.
translation: 我走这条路的一边，你走另一边。

english: I will tell you, Azacor, but not just yet. Finish showing me around Lumbridge and then I'll tell you.
translation: 我会告诉你的，阿扎科尔，但不是现在。先带我逛完仑桥镇，然后我再告诉你。

english: I will when you have enough space for it. You will need 7 spaces for all the gear; 5 coloured destabilisers, 1 white destabiliser and the Ghost Buster.
translation: 等你腾出足够空间我就给你。你需要7个格子来装所有装备：5个彩色去稳定器、1个白色去稳定器和幽灵克星。

english: I will! Bye!
translation: 我会的！再见！

english: I will, thanks! What is it?
translation: 我会的，谢谢！是什么？

english: I win!
translation: 我赢了！

english: I wish I knew of one!
translation: 我希望我知道一个！

english: I wish to gain insight into your wants, so that I may provide enticing relics to your kind.
translation: 我希望深入了解你们的愿望，以便我能为你们这类人提供诱人的遗物。

english: I witnessed the killer claim their first victim - Sid - around the West side of the manor.
translation: 我目睹了杀手在庄园西侧夺走了他们的第一个受害者——西德。

english: I witnessed the killer claim their fourth victim - Mandy - in the kitchen.
translation: 我目睹了杀手在厨房里夺走了他们的第四个受害者——曼迪。

english: I witnessed the killer claim their second victim - Tayten - in the library.
translation: 我目睹了杀手在图书馆里夺走了他们的第二个受害者——泰滕。

english: I witnessed the killer claim their third victim - Lacey - around the back of the manor.
translation: 我目睹了杀手在庄园后面夺走了他们的第三个受害者——蕾西。

english: I woke up in a daze, without the artifact, not entirely sure what had happened.
translation: 我迷迷糊糊地醒来，神器不见了，完全不知道发生了什么。

english: I won't ask how it did that.
translation: 我不会问它是怎么做到的。

english: I won't bother then. I'd like to keep my cargo.
translation: 那我就不麻烦了。我想保留我的货物。

english: I won't keep you any longer Elsie, but before I go, do you know of anyone that might have treats left?
translation: 我就不多留你了，艾尔西，但在我走之前，你知道有谁可能还有好吃的吗？

english: I won't pay.
translation: 我不会付钱的。

english: I won't, it all sounds too scary for me. Goblins, ahhh!
translation: 我不会去的，这一切对我来说都太吓人了。哥布林，啊！

english: I wonder how old this bread is. But oh well, in it goes. 7; the player still tells the Goblin Generals it hasn't been finished cooking yet, because varbit 11727 remains at value 1 until the next dialogue. -->
translation: 我不知道这面包放了多久了。但算了，扔进去吧。7；玩家仍然告诉哥布林将军们面包还没烤好，因为varbit 11727在下一个对话之前保持值为1。-->

english: I wonder if Ali Morissane
translation: 我想知道阿里.莫里萨尼

english: I wonder if I can get you to draw something dot-to- dot. There, I'll give you beacons to aim for! Start with this one.
translation: 我想知道能不能让你画个连线画。来，我给你一些目标点！从这一个开始。

english: I wonder if I could... somehow get something both exciting and exotic out of that information.
translation: 我想知道我能不能……从那条信息里弄到点既刺激又新奇的东西。

english: I wonder if there's a way I can roll it into the village.
translation: 我想知道有没有办法把它滚进村子里。

english: I wonder if, yes, that may work. Definitely.
translation: 我想知道，是的，也许能行。绝对能行。

english: I wonder what it is that the ghosts are trying to tell me. Something to do with gathering ingredients to make a potion? Maybe the apothecary could help?
translation: 我想知道那些幽灵想告诉我什么。是不是和收集原料制作药水有关？也许药剂师能帮忙？

english: I wonder what monster carved this cave out?
translation: 我想知道是什么怪物挖出了这个洞穴？

english: I wonder when the 3d version of runescape is ready? You are a :#mighty god and you should be able to make it quick!
translation: 我想知道 Runescape 的 3D 版本什么时候准备好？你是一位 :# 强大的神，你应该能很快搞定它！

english: I wondered what that was... I thought it was my tinnitus flaring up. Can you find out why?
translation: 我还在想那是什么声音……我还以为是我的耳鸣犯了。你能查查原因吗？

english: I wore the socks; they looked nice!
translation: 我穿了那双袜子；它们看起来不错！

english: I work a tough job, but I am paid well, I receive 1520 coins per hour, and work 24 hours per day. How many coins do I get per day?
translation: 我工作很辛苦，但报酬不错，每小时赚1520金币，每天工作24小时。我一天能赚多少金币？

english: I would be happy to, my child!
translation: 我很乐意，我的孩子！

english: I would be honoured. Can I hear the poem?
translation: 我很荣幸。我能听听那首诗吗？

english: I would consider myself the chosen egg if I am able to help the Easter Bunny out.
translation: 如果我能帮复活节兔子一把，我会认为自己就是那颗被选中的蛋。

english: I would have gone to them myself but I don't really know where to go and I don't want someone to come and use this meadow for their own idea!
translation: 我本来可以自己去找他们，但我真的不知道该去哪里，而且我也不想有人来把这片草地据为己用！

english: I would have jumped out of my skin if I could still jump.
translation: 如果我还跳得动的话，我早就吓得魂飞魄散了。

english: I would head straight for the cave and not tarry too long [player name], the cold winds on this island can cut right through you should you spend too long in them.
translation: 我会直奔洞穴，不会耽搁太久，[player name]，这座岛上的冷风要是待久了，能直接刺穿你的骨头。

english: I would leave that up to him... Actually, there he is now!
translation: 我会让他自己决定……实际上，他就在那儿！

english: I would like to think so. So, the egg mould?
translation: 我希望如此。那么，鸡蛋模具呢？

english: I would love to. Do I need to bring anything with me?
translation: 我很乐意。我需要带什么东西吗？

english: I would normally, but, not t'day!
translation: 平时我会的，但今天不行！

english: I would rather wrestle a black dragon bare-handed.
translation: 我宁愿赤手空拳和黑龙搏斗。

english: I would rather you didn't pick my lovely flowers without a good reason.
translation: 我希望你不要无缘无故摘我可爱的花。

english: I would recommend trying it. In all my years in Al Kharid, this bait is the only thing I know of capable of drawing fish from these waters.
translation: 我建议你试试。在阿尔卡里德城这么多年，我知道只有这种鱼饵才能从这些水域里钓到鱼。

english: I would reward you but you need [number] more free spaces in your pack.
translation: 我想奖励你，但你的背包还需要[number]个空位。

english: I would take more treats if you're offering!
translation: 如果你还有好吃的，我倒是想多拿点！

english: I would, but these kids are a menace.
translation: 我倒是想，但这些孩子太捣蛋了。

english: I wouldn't be so confident against the party king.
translation: 在派对国王面前，我可不敢这么自信。

english: I wouldn't be so sure. It seems you've already come a long way.
translation: 那可不一定。看来你已经走了很长的路了。

english: I wouldn't be, if it wasn't for you!
translation: 如果不是因为你，我才不会这样呢！

english: I wouldn't call having sprites shoved up your nose happytime.
translation: 我可不会把精灵塞进鼻子里叫做快乐时光。

english: I wouldn't eat that even if I got paid for it.
translation: 就算给我钱，我也不会吃那个。

english: I wouldn't hit him with it... you'll kill him!
translation: 我不会用那个打他的……你会打死他的！

english: I wouldn't pick that up for all the runes in Gielinor.
translation: 就算用吉列诺所有的符文来换，我也不会捡那个东西。

english: I yearn for the Sage to defy master Yama, I shall feast on their broken body!
translation: 我渴望智者违抗阎魔大人，我会吞噬他们破碎的身体！

english: I'd be a pretty poor substitute for Santa if I couldn't unlock holiday items!
translation: 如果我不能解锁节日物品，那我这个圣诞老人可就当得太差劲了！

english: I'd be here all day if I tried digging this up by hand...
translation: 如果用手挖这个，我得挖上一整天……

english: I'd better check it again for, eurgh, costumes.
translation: 我最好再检查一下，呃，看看有没有服装。

english: I'd better get a reward for this!
translation: 我最好为此得到奖励！

english: I'd better get to work right away.
translation: 我最好马上开始工作。

english: I'd better go and speak to Holly.
translation: 我最好去和霍莉谈谈。

english: I'd better go and tell Holly the good news.
translation: 我最好去告诉霍莉这个好消息。

english: I'd better go make some space.
translation: 我最好去腾点地方。

english: I'd better go, thank you Philop!
translation: 我该走了，谢谢你菲洛普！

english: I'd better look for them as well then?
translation: 那我也该去找他们了？

english: I'd better make room in my inventory first!
translation: 我得先腾出点背包空间！

english: I'd better not steal other people's fish!
translation: 我可不能偷别人的鱼！

english: I'd better see how Guss is getting on.
translation: 我去看看格斯怎么样了。

english: I'd better wield Silverlight first.
translation: 我最好先装备上银光剑。

english: I'd eat four before you even eat three, you're so slow.
translation: 我吃四个你才吃三个，你太慢了。

english: I'd give you these shears but you appear to be a little overloaded. 51-->
translation: 我想把这把剪刀给你，但你好像有点拿不下了。51-->

english: I'd guess that is probably something to do with a saucepan and rolling pin...
translation: 我猜那大概跟平底锅和擀面杖有关……

english: I'd have a look around the palace for this one.
translation: 这个的话，我去宫殿里找找看。

english: I'd have been happy with 70 percent!
translation: 百分之七十我就很满意了！

english: I'd hazard a guess that this mysterious master figure is the infamous Xeric - he seems to have very little care for the lives of others, even those who follow him religiously.
translation: 我斗胆猜一下，这位神秘的大师就是臭名昭著的泽里克——他似乎毫不在意他人的性命，即使是那些虔诚追随他的人。

english: I'd hope so.
translation: 希望如此。

english: I'd hoped he'd have forgotten that by now...
translation: 我还以为他早就忘了那件事……

english: I'd like a bit of grain. I still need [number].
translation: 我想要一点谷物。我还需要[number]份。

english: I'd like a few cowhides. I still need [number].
translation: 我想要几张牛皮。我还需要[number]张。

english: I'd like some bronze knives to throw at goblins. I still need [number].
translation: 我想要一些青铜飞刀来扔地精。我还需要[number]把。

english: I'd like some chunky iron warhammers. I still need [number].
translation: 我想要一些厚重的铁战锤。我还需要[number]把。

english: I'd like some maces made of bronze. I still need [number].
translation: 我想要一些青铜钉头锤。我还需要[number]把。

english: I'd like that!
translation: 我喜欢！

english: I'd like to buy some runes!
translation: 我想买些符文！

english: I'd like to cancel a port task.
translation: 我想取消一个港口任务。

english: I'd like to change Renu's appearance.
translation: 我想改变雷努的外貌。

english: I'd like to change my wristwear.
translation: 我想换一下我的腕饰。

english: I'd like to claim my port task rewards.
translation: 我想领取我的港口任务奖励。

english: I'd like to keep it simple. Simple yet effective.
translation: 我想保持简单。简单但有效。

english: I'd like to leave please.
translation: 我想离开了。

english: I'd like to offer them a night on the town please!
translation: 我想请他们去城里玩一晚！

english: I'd like to offer them a toffee apple please!
translation: 我想请他们吃个太妃糖苹果！

english: I'd like to offer them dinner please!
translation: 我想请他们吃晚餐！

english: I'd like to order one of your chef's famous pumpkin pies please!
translation: 我想点一份你们大厨的招牌南瓜派！

english: I'd like to study the rune essence that the wizards have been talking about recently, so I need a few pieces. I still need [number].
translation: 我想研究一下法师们最近在谈论的符文精华，所以我需要几块。我还需要[number]块。

english: I'd like to think you wouldn't be carrying bones around.
translation: 我觉得你不会随身带着骨头吧。

english: I'd like to try again.
translation: 我想再试一次。

english: I'd like you to do me a favour before I hand over the report though.
translation: 不过在我交出报告之前，我想请你帮我一个忙。

english: I'd love to help, but I'm a bit busy at the moment. I'll return when I can.
translation: 我很乐意帮忙，但我现在有点忙。我有空再来。

english: I'd love to help, but I'm somewhat busy right now.
translation: 我很乐意帮忙，但我现在有点忙。

english: I'd never considered that, [player name]. I'll have to think about that later.
translation: 我从没想过这一点，[player name]。我以后得好好想想。

english: I'd pick you over Death any day of the week!
translation: 我宁愿选你也不要死神！

english: I'd planned to learn the recipe earlier but got caught up in our adventure. I'm sorry!
translation: 我本来打算早点学那个食谱的，但被我们的冒险给耽搁了。抱歉！

english: I'd really love to want to help you with that, but uh, a priest was... Taken prisoner... In uh... Morytania...
translation: 我真的很想帮你那个忙，但是呃，有个祭司……被俘虏了……在呃……莫里塔尼亚……

english: I'd reckon we have a good shot at it!
translation: 我觉得我们很有机会！

english: I'd recommend you have at least during the games.
translation: 我建议你至少在比赛期间要有这个。

english: I'd tell ye, but then I'd have to kill ye.
translation: 我可以告诉你，但之后我就得杀了你。

english: I'd thought the Duke's guests might not come, so I wouldn't have to cater for them.
translation: 我还以为公爵的客人不会来，这样我就不用为他们准备食物了。

english: I'd wonder who this mysterious master figure is - they seem to have very little care for the lives of others, even those who follow them religiously.
translation: 我想知道这位神秘的大师是谁——他似乎毫不在意他人的性命，即使是那些虔诚追随他的人。

english: I'll be back here cooking up whatever needs cooking if you get a little lost or need some guidance.
translation: 如果你有点迷路或需要指导，我会回到这里烹饪任何需要烹饪的东西。

english: I'll be back in a bit.
translation: 我一会儿就回来。

english: I'll be back in a jiffy.
translation: 我马上回来。

english: I'll be fine without a tinderbox.
translation: 没有火绒盒我也没问题。

english: I'll be heading back there in a second, just grabbing some more presents. It has been super busy!
translation: 我马上回去那里，只是再拿些礼物。这里一直忙得不可开交！

english: I'll be more careful, I promise!
translation: 我会更小心的，我保证！

english: I'll be needing a few pieces of soft leather. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要几块软皮革。我还需要[number]块。

english: I'll be off too.
translation: 我也该走了。

english: I'll be right there.
translation: 我马上到。

english: I'll bet you ANYTHING it was Elizabeth.
translation: 我敢拿任何东西打赌，肯定是伊丽莎白。

english: I'll buy one.
translation: 我买一个。

english: I'll come back when I've got some more.
translation: 等我再有一些的时候再回来。

english: I'll come back with a tinderbox.
translation: 我带着火绒盒回来。

english: I'll do it dearie.
translation: 我来做吧，亲爱的。

english: I'll do just that.
translation: 我这就去办。

english: I'll do my best, good luck!
translation: 我会尽力的，祝你好运！

english: I'll do my best, see you soon!
translation: 我会尽力的，回头见！

english: I'll do that now.
translation: 我现在就去做。

english: I'll draw you a picture of a big magnet and you can stick it to your boat.
translation: 我给你画一张大磁铁的图，你可以把它贴在你的船上。

english: I'll eggscort you to the cave. Follow me.
translation: 我护送你到洞穴。跟我来。

english: I'll even throw in an extra shirt for good measure. Wear them with pride!
translation: 我还会额外多送你一件衬衫。自豪地穿上它们吧！

english: I'll fetch him, so he can explain.
translation: 我去把他叫来，让他解释。

english: I'll fill you in on the details once you've got the necessary supplies. You'll need a vial from the crate over there.
translation: 等你拿到必要的补给后，我再告诉你细节。你需要从那边那个板条箱里拿一个小瓶。

english: I'll fill your stockings with coal by carbonising your feet.
translation: 我会把你的脚碳化，往你的袜子里塞满煤。

english: I'll free up some more space then. I'll be back in a second.
translation: 那我再腾出点空间。我马上回来。

english: I'll free up some space then. I'll be back in a second.
translation: 那我腾出点空间。我马上回来。

english: I'll get a drink in a moment, I better check up on Guss.
translation: 我待会儿再去喝一杯，最好先去看看格斯。

english: I'll get back to you.
translation: 我回头再找你。

english: I'll get right on it, goodbye.
translation: 我马上去办，再见。

english: I'll get started right away then! What made you come here to run a cooking competition?
translation: 那我马上开始！是什么让你来这里举办烹饪比赛的？

english: I'll get working on these immediately. Can't have those adventurers waiting any longer.
translation: 我马上开始处理这些。不能让那些冒险者再等了。

english: I'll get your head for you. Where is it?
translation: 我来帮你拿脑袋。它在哪？

english: I'll give it a try, thank you for the help. Just out of curiosity, did you give them any treats for free?
translation: 我试试看，谢谢你的帮助。只是好奇问一下，你有没有免费给过他们什么零食？

english: I'll give it a try.
translation: 我试试看。

english: I'll give it a try. Thank you for the help Father.
translation: 我试试看。谢谢你的帮助，神父。

english: I'll give you some super cool rewards of course! Although I'm not sure what they'll be yet...
translation: 我当然会给你一些超酷的奖励！虽然我还不确定是什么……

english: I'll go and ask him, thank you.
translation: 我去问问他，谢谢你。

english: I'll go and ask him. Will you stay here?
translation: 我去问问他。你待在这里吗？

english: I'll go and have a look!
translation: 我去看看！

english: I'll go and mingle amongst all those ankou.
translation: 我去和那些昂骷打成一片。

english: I'll go and order some right away!
translation: 我马上去点一些！

english: I'll go and search for those items you asked for.
translation: 我去找你要的那些东西。

english: I'll go and search for those items you wanted.
translation: 我去找你要的那些物品。

english: I'll go and see if they'll tell me then. I'll be back soon.
translation: 我去看看他们会不会告诉我。我很快回来。

english: I'll go back and fetch him so he can tell you.
translation: 我回去把他带来，让他告诉你。

english: I'll go back and fetch him then.
translation: 那我回去把他带来。

english: I'll go do that now, goodbye.
translation: 我现在就去办，再见。

english: I'll go talk to whoever I think is the perfect match for you!
translation: 我去找我认为最适合你的人谈谈！

english: I'll have yours if you don't want it dear!
translation: 亲爱的，如果你不想要，那我要你的！

english: I'll help out, no problem.
translation: 我来帮忙，没问题。

english: I'll investigate the disturbance for you.
translation: 我去为你调查那起骚乱。

english: I'll just be going then.
translation: 那我就先走了。

english: I'll just be on my way then.
translation: 那我就先告辞了。

english: I'll keep an eye out, Sire.
translation: 我会留意的，陛下。

english: I'll keep hold of my tomato for now.
translation: 我的番茄先留着。

english: I'll keep my eyes peeled.
translation: 我会留意的。

english: I'll keep working on it.
translation: 我会继续努力的。

english: I'll leave before you get sta-
translation: 我趁你还没被冻住之前走——

english: I'll leave you alone for now.
translation: 我先不打扰你了。

english: I'll leave you too it.
translation: 我就不打扰你了。

english: I'll let Diango know you can have it too, because then you can reclaim any of it from Party Pete and distract him further!
translation: 我会告诉迪亚戈你也可以拥有它，这样你就可以从派对皮特那里重新领取任何一件，进一步分散他的注意力！

english: I'll look around and see what I can find.
translation: 我四处看看能找到什么。

english: I'll make it snow on you briefly too, so everyone can see how awesome you are. It'll only work if you stay around here though.
translation: 我也会让你身边短暂地下点雪，这样大家都能看到你有多棒。不过只有你待在这附近才有效。

english: I'll make sure these eggs get delivered in time now!
translation: 我现在就确保这些蛋能准时送到！

english: I'll make sure to pop into the inn later and apologise to the chef. Maybe I'll knit him something.
translation: 我晚点会去旅馆向厨师道歉，也许还会给他织点东西。

english: I'll make sure to visit Santa at the grotto, then. See you there!
translation: 那我一定会去洞穴拜访圣诞老人。到时候见！

english: I'll make sure to, can't beat some mulled wine!
translation: 我一定会的，热红酒最棒了！

english: I'll meet you at the festival after! You should come visit the grotto!
translation: 之后我们在庆典上见！你应该来洞穴看看！

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, BEBESITA- [number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，BEBESITA-[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, BERETTA- F[number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，BERETTA-F[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, DANIELA- RS[number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，DANIELA-RS[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, EL- DEMENTE-[number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，EL-DEMENTE-[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, G[number]- ASCENDING.
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，G[number]-ASCENDING。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, IRON AFCA[number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，IRON AFCA[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, MAGIKAMI- [number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，MAGIKAMI-[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, MISS- EARTH[number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，MISS-EARTH[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, S-UR[number] D- EATH.
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，S-UR[number] D-EATH。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, TWICE [number] EVER.
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，TWICE [number] EVER。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, X-VENTURA- X[number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，X-VENTURA-X[number]。

english: I'll meet you back at the Grand Tree, [number]-NARUTO- [number].
translation: 我们在大树家园碰头，[number]-NARUTO-[number]。

english: I'll need some clay that's been softened so I can craft it. I still need [number].
translation: 我需要一些软化过的粘土才能塑形。我还需要[number]块。

english: I'll only wear the bedsheet inside Port Phasmatys!
translation: 我只会在法斯提斯港里面穿床单！

english: I'll pay.
translation: 我来付钱。

english: I'll probably go on a long sea voyage and compose some more shanties! Shanty by name, shanty by nature!
translation: 我大概会去远航，再写几首船歌！人如其名，本性难移！

english: I'll probably stick around here and make some more of these flower crowns.
translation: 我大概会留在这里，再多做些花冠。

english: I'll put mistletoe where you won't like kissing under it.
translation: 我会把槲寄生放在你不想在下面接吻的地方。

english: I'll put two eggs into the cooler for you, a normal one and an ice cream filled one.
translation: 我会帮你放两个蛋到冷却器里，一个普通的，一个冰淇淋馅的。

english: I'll re-wrap your gifts in your kitten's pelt.
translation: 我会用你家小猫的皮把你的礼物重新包起来。

english: I'll recreate Evil Tree, starting with your Christmas tree.
translation: 我会重现邪恶之树，就从你的圣诞树开始。

english: I'll set rude words to your favourite Christmas songs.
translation: 我会把你最喜欢的圣诞歌填上粗俗的歌词。

english: I'll show you who's boss first and destroy this place afterwards.
translation: 我会先让你看看谁才是老大，然后再毁掉这个地方。

english: I'll stay then.
translation: 那我就留下吧。

english: I'll stick to trading from my cart from now on but as for where I end up next, who knows...
translation: 从现在起我会继续用我的推车做买卖，但接下来会去哪里，谁知道呢……

english: I'll take it! Thanks!
translation: 我收下了！谢谢！

english: I'll take that as a no... Happy Easter, [player name]!
translation: 那我就当你是拒绝了……复活节快乐，[player name]！

english: I'll take that book back too.
translation: 那本书我也要拿回去。

english: I'll take your word for that.
translation: 我就信你这句话。

english: I'll teach you about Christmas and help you celebrate it in your own way. In return you don't invade the humans. Deal?
translation: 我会教你认识圣诞节，并帮你用自己的方式庆祝。作为回报，你不准入侵人类。成交？

english: I'll tell Fry that they're here, and he can sort them out. No way I'm touching them in that state!
translation: 我会告诉弗莱他们来了，让他来处理。他们那副样子，我才不碰呢！

english: I'll try not to!
translation: 我会尽量不这样！

english: I'll try something different instead.
translation: 那我换个花样试试。

english: I'll turn your snowcones yellow.
translation: 我会把你的雪球变成黄色。

english: I'll unlock the next colour for you.
translation: 我会为你解锁下一种颜色。

english: I'll use the loudspeakers to give more instructions when you've found it.
translation: 等你找到之后，我会用扩音器给出更多指示。

english: I'll wait back at the house in southern Varrock. We can meet there when you're ready to continue.
translation: 我会在维洛克城南边的房子里等着。你准备好继续的时候，我们可以在那里碰面。

english: I'll watch you. When you climb your tree, I will climb mine. When you make your sounds, I will do mine.
translation: 我会看着你。你爬你的树，我就爬我的树。你发出你的声音，我就发出我的声音。

english: I'll... head right there.
translation: 我……这就过去。

english: I'm Auntie Santa. Give your auntie a kiss.
translation: 我是圣诞阿姨。来亲阿姨一下。

english: I'm Deviled Dave, finisher of deviled eggs, demolisher of balloons and the most EVIL party guest.
translation: 我是恶魔戴夫，魔鬼蛋终结者，气球破坏者，最邪恶的派对客人。

english: I'm Gary Grayzag, a wizard. At least, I'm going to be a wizard. My dad's one too - Wizard Grayzag, from the Wizards' Tower south of Draynor Village.
translation: 我是加里.格雷扎格，一个魔法师。至少，我将来会成为一个魔法师。我爸爸也是——魔法师格雷扎格，来自德雷诺村南边的法师塔。

english: I'm Gary Grayzag, the wizard. Well, apprentice wizard. My father is Wizard Grayzag. He asked you to deal with the green Gnome Child that came through a portal from the Realm of Memories.
translation: 我是加里.格雷扎格，那个魔法师。呃，魔法学徒。我父亲是魔法师格雷扎格。他请你来处理那个从记忆之境通过传送门过来的绿色地精小孩。

english: I'm Gary Grayzag, the wizard. Well, apprentice wizard. My father is Wizard Grayzag. He once accidentally created a portal to the Realm of Memories.
translation: 我是加里.格雷扎格，那个魔法师。呃，魔法学徒。我父亲是魔法师格雷扎格。他曾经意外地创造了一个通往记忆之境的传送门。

english: I'm Gary Grayzag. We haven't met, but my dad told me all about you. You might remember him - Wizard Grayzag, from the Wizards' Tower south of Draynor Village.
translation: 我是加里.格雷扎格。我们没见过面，但我爸爸跟我提过你。你可能还记得他——魔法师格雷扎格，来自德雷诺村南边的法师塔。

english: I'm Gary, the wizard. I've not actually been qualified for very long, so I'm living here near the rune shop so I can keep practicing the magical arts.
translation: 我是加里，那个魔法师。其实我拿到资格没多久，所以我住在符文店附近，这样就能继续练习魔法技艺了。

english: I'm a bit busy trying to work something out... huh! You could help me! Then I'll attend.
translation: 我正忙着想解决一个问题……哈！你可以帮我！那样我就去参加。

english: I'm a bit hungry. I'd like some cooked meat, not chicken or any sort of bird. And definitely not camel or rabbit either! I still need [number].
translation: 我有点饿了。我想要一些熟肉，不要鸡肉或任何鸟类。当然也不要骆驼肉或兔子肉！我还需要[number]块。

english: I'm a bit of a no-hoper aren't I?
translation: 我有点没出息，对吧？

english: I'm a bit stuck on what to make, do you have any ideas for me?
translation: 我有点不知道该做什么，你有什么建议吗？

english: I'm a little busy now, I'll come back later.
translation: 我现在有点忙，待会再来。

english: I'm a qualified wizard now, thanks to you. So I've settled here, near a handy rune shop, so I can keep practicing the magical arts while I raise this cat that some local lady persuaded me to buy.
translation: 多亏了你，我现在是个合格的魔法师了。所以我在这里定居下来，靠近一家方便的符文店，这样我就可以一边练习魔法技艺，一边养着这只某个当地女士说服我买的猫。

english: I'm a wizard. Take the cloth, coat it with snow and I'll arrange transport.
translation: 我是个魔法师。拿着这块布，把它裹上雪，我来安排运输。

english: I'm afraid I am very busy right now, [player name].
translation: 恐怕我现在很忙，[player name]。

english: I'm afraid I can't chat, got this line to keep an eye on.
translation: 恐怕我没空聊天，我得盯着这条线。

english: I'm afraid I can't teleport you to Falador again, so you'll have to deliver that cake by yourself.
translation: 恐怕我不能再把你传送到法拉多城了，所以你得自己送那个蛋糕。

english: I'm afraid I cannot assist you now. I have to compile my report about the goblin cave.
translation: 恐怕我现在不能帮你。我得整理关于地精洞穴的报告。

english: I'm afraid I don't have anything for you [player name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕我没什么能给你的，[player name]。如果我确实有你的物品，但你在领取之前就死了，那它们现在应该已经丢失了。

english: I'm afraid I misplaced the invitations...
translation: 恐怕我把请柬放错地方了……

english: I'm afraid I'm not much of an artist.
translation: 恐怕我不太擅长艺术。

english: I'm afraid I've over-indulged though. I lost track of time, and my friend Rick really needs me.
translation: 不过恐怕我有点放纵过头了。我忘了时间，我的朋友里克真的很需要我。

english: I'm afraid it's very specific, you won't find it anywhere, you'll have to make it yourself.
translation: 恐怕这东西很特别，你在别处找不到，得自己做。

english: I'm afraid not [player name]. If I did have any of your items, but you died before collecting them, they'll now be lost.
translation: 恐怕没有，[player name]。如果我确实有你的物品，但你在领取之前就死了，那它们现在应该已经丢失了。

english: I'm afraid of you.
translation: 我怕你。

english: I'm afraid that could be a little tricky on account of your... tangibility.
translation: 恐怕这有点棘手，因为你的……实体性。

english: I'm afraid this is the only present you'll be getting this year. Santa knows what you gnome children are like!
translation: 恐怕这是你今年唯一能得到的礼物了。圣诞老人知道你们地精小孩是什么德行！

english: I'm afraid you don't have any assigned tasks for me to cancel.
translation: 恐怕你没有任何指派的任务可以让我取消。

english: I'm afraid you don't seem to own any boats.
translation: 恐怕你似乎没有任何船。

english: I'm afraid you have made the wrong choice. Let's try this again...
translation: 恐怕你做了错误的选择。我们再来一次……

english: I'm afraid you to enter the games.
translation: 恐怕你不能参加比赛。

english: I'm afraid you will need [number] more free spaces in your bank to hold all the items your subjects have collected.
translation: 恐怕你的银行还需要[number]个空位才能存放你子民收集的所有物品。

english: I'm afraid you'll need some free inventory space to have any of these drinks.
translation: 恐怕你需要一些空的背包空间才能拿这些饮料。

english: I'm afraid you've had treats from me, but please, no tricks!
translation: 恐怕你已经从我这里拿到糖果了，但请别捣蛋！

english: I'm all out right now sorry!
translation: 我现在全用完了，抱歉！

english: I'm already getting a bad feeling about all this.
translation: 我已经对这一切有种不好的预感了。

english: I'm an aspiring White Knight, but that dream is on hold until I can perform a truly heroic feat. Except I'm not that heroic. I don't really know who I am.
translation: 我是个有抱负的白骑士，但那个梦想得等我完成一件真正的英雄事迹才能实现。只是我没那么英勇。我其实不知道自己是谁。

english: I'm an experienced player.
translation: 我是个有经验的玩家。

english: I'm as confused as you are...
translation: 我和你一样困惑……

english: I'm at home, painting and counting eggs, of course! And tending to my chickens.
translation: 我当然是在家画蛋、数蛋啦！还要照顾我的鸡。

english: I'm awake.
translation: 我醒着。

english: I'm awarding you [number] Slayer reward points. You can use points to purchase rewards and upgrades to enhance your effectiveness as a Slayer.
translation: 我要奖励你[number]点杀戮奖励积分。你可以用积分购买奖励和升级，以提升你作为杀戮者的效率。

english: I'm aware, no need to tell me about them.
translation: 我知道，不用跟我提他们。

english: I'm back with some space!
translation: 我回来了，腾出空间了！

english: I'm beginning to suspect that the potion was just a normal magic potion.
translation: 我开始怀疑那瓶药水只是一瓶普通的魔法药水。

english: I'm brand new! This is my first time here.
translation: 我是全新的！这是我第一次来这里。

english: I'm burning damp coal dust to make a horrible smoke.
translation: 我在烧湿煤粉，制造可怕的烟雾。

english: I'm certain it was Bob.
translation: 我确定是鲍勃。

english: I'm climbing in anyway. Don't warn me again.
translation: 反正我要爬进去。别再警告我了。

english: I'm collecting some more seeds! I'm running low on stocks.
translation: 我在收集更多种子！库存快用完了。

english: I'm collecting some seeds!
translation: 我在收集一些种子！

english: I'm collecting unpainted baubles and then I'm going to paint them. Do you want to help?
translation: 我在收集未上色的小饰品，然后打算给它们上色。你想帮忙吗？

english: I'm curious as to how you're going to fix it.
translation: 我很好奇你要怎么修好它。

english: I'm doing my best!
translation: 我正在尽力！

english: I'm doing okay, a bit stuck at the moment though.
translation: 我还行，不过现在有点卡住了。

english: I'm err.. here to collect his next shipment of premium bananas.
translation: 我呃……是来取他下一批高级香蕉的。

english: I'm excited, let's do this!
translation: 我很兴奋，开始吧！

english: I'm far too busy right now.
translation: 我现在太忙了。

english: I'm fine. I just... I just need to see it again.
translation: 我没事。我只是……只是想再看它一眼。

english: I'm getting to the problem!
translation: 我正要处理问题！

english: I'm glad I could give them some time to recover! It's a lovely grotto.
translation: 我很高兴能给他们一些时间恢复！这是个可爱的洞穴。

english: I'm glad they were able to help. You'd better get moving!
translation: 我很高兴他们能帮上忙。你最好赶紧行动！

english: I'm glad to hear that, do you know if they've baked anything before?
translation: 很高兴听到这个，你知道他们以前烤过东西吗？

english: I'm glad to hear that.
translation: 很高兴听到这个。

english: I'm glad to hear that. Now you had better keep that armour on.
translation: 很高兴听到这个。现在你最好把那件盔甲穿上。

english: I'm glad you asked, adventurer. I've been working on a new invention in my spare time, and I am planning to debut it towards the end of the ceremonies.
translation: 很高兴你问，冒险者。我业余时间一直在研究一项新发明，打算在仪式接近尾声时首次亮相。

english: I'm glad you came to speak to me. That child has been cheating at that game for far too long.
translation: 很高兴你来跟我说话。那个小孩在那游戏里作弊太久了。

english: I'm glad you like it! It took quite a bit of effort to work that churn.
translation: 很高兴你喜欢！操作那个搅拌器可费了不少劲。

english: I'm glad you like it, I can give you the recipe if you want?
translation: 很高兴你喜欢，如果你想要，我可以给你食谱？

english: I'm glad you like them though. Always good to get something that you actually want!
translation: 不过很高兴你喜欢它们。能拿到真正想要的东西总是好的！

english: I'm glad you've found my citizens' missing items, [player name]. Have you had a chance to give Vargas my letter?
translation: 很高兴你找到了我子民丢失的物品，[player name]。你有机会把我的信交给Vargas吗？

english: I'm going away now.
translation: 我现在要走了。

english: I'm going to be the fastest to find the treasure!
translation: 我会是最快找到宝藏的人！

english: I'm going to get back to work, good luck.
translation: 我要回去工作了，祝你好运。

english: I'm going to get looking around.
translation: 我打算四处看看。

english: I'm going to give you another chance.
translation: 我会再给你一次机会。

english: I'm going to head over now, see you there!
translation: 我现在就过去，到时候见！

english: I'm going to look inside it.
translation: 我要看看里面。

english: I'm going to make an omelette, so I'll need some eggs. I still need [number].
translation: 我要做煎蛋饼，所以需要一些鸡蛋。我还需要[number]个。

english: I'm going to speak to the Sage now since you're intent on being rude.
translation: 既然你执意要这么无礼，我现在就去找智者谈谈。

english: I'm going to stand here annoying you.
translation: 我就站在这烦你。

english: I'm going to tell the children a scary story. But it won't look very atmospheric if I'm just standing there, reading from my notebook. So I've got a better plan.
translation: 我打算给孩子们讲个恐怖故事。但如果我只是站在那，照着笔记本念，气氛就不够。所以我有个更好的主意。

english: I'm gonna give you my spare boots. I think they'll suit you. I'll give you a couple Easter eggs too.
translation: 我打算把我备用的靴子给你。我觉得会很适合你。再顺便给你几个复活节彩蛋。

english: I'm good for now thanks!
translation: 我现在不需要，谢谢！

english: I'm good thanks! Shouldn't you be out looking for adventurers to help you with your treasure chest?
translation: 我很好，谢谢！你不是应该出去找冒险者帮你处理那个宝箱吗？

english: I'm grateful for your help. I'm not entirely sure what I would've done without it.
translation: 我很感激你的帮助。没有它我真不知道该怎么办。

english: I'm grateful!
translation: 我很感激！

english: I'm happy to say that I think everything is resolved then!
translation: 我很高兴地说，我觉得一切都解决了！

english: I'm having a wonderful time exploring the Realm. I hope you are too.
translation: 我在王国里探索得很开心。希望你也是。

english: I'm heading over to the festival now. Will you come and visit? It's just south of the park, near the east bank.
translation: 我现在正要去节日现场。你会来拜访吗？就在公园南边，靠近东岸银行。

english: I'm helping her out with the deliveries! She was struggling with some of the riddles.
translation: 我在帮她送货！她有些谜语解不开。

english: I'm helping the Easter Bunny out, and he needs to deliver some chocolate eggs to some adventurers south in the desert, but the eggs just melt!
translation: 我在帮复活节兔子，他需要送一些巧克力蛋给沙漠南边的冒险者，但蛋总是融化！

english: I'm here about the sicks...err Zogres
translation: 我来是为了那些病……呃，佐格怪。

english: I'm here to collect the toys.
translation: 我来收玩具。

english: I'm here to fish.
translation: 我来钓鱼。

english: I'm in the trees, they won't see it coming.
translation: 我在树上，他们不会发现的。

english: I'm just a bunny, you're the wizard.
translation: 我只是只兔子，你才是魔法师。

english: I'm just curious! This place is inspiring.
translation: 我只是好奇！这地方真让人有灵感。

english: I'm just enjoying thinking about when we will finally get to see a real egg of Ayaster.
translation: 我只是在享受想象我们什么时候才能亲眼见到真正的阿亚斯特之蛋。

english: I'm just impressed you managed to get them all up so quickly.
translation: 我只是佩服你能这么快把它们都装好。

english: I'm just letting you know, just in case anyone says anything about strange noises or boxes filled with ghosts.
translation: 我只是提醒你一下，万一有人提到奇怪的声音或装满幽灵的箱子。

english: I'm just playing by your rules.
translation: 我只是按你的规矩来。

english: I'm just pulling your leg, I know I've got some training to do!
translation: 我只是逗你玩，我知道我还得练练！

english: I'm just relaxing and enjoying the nature. I need a break!
translation: 我只是在放松，享受大自然。我需要休息一下！

english: I'm just super keen to do something fun! Knitting gets quite boring, sometimes.
translation: 我只是超级想做点有趣的事！有时候织毛衣挺无聊的。

english: I'm just trying to admire this tree, but you tall folk keep getting in the way.
translation: 我只是想欣赏这棵树，但你们这些高个子老是挡路。

english: I'm led to believe you might already know Captain Arnav. He's leading a treasure hunt, and can be found just north-east of the bank.
translation: 我听说你可能已经认识阿纳夫船长了。他正在组织一场寻宝游戏，你可以在银行东北边找到他。

english: I'm lighting the boiler to warm up the house.
translation: 我在点锅炉，好让房子暖和起来。

english: I'm looking for RED[player name].
translation: 我在找RED[player name]。

english: I'm looking for a man named Avan Fitzharmon
translation: 我在找一个叫阿凡.菲茨哈蒙的人。

english: I'm looking for a way to keep something cool as it travels through the desert.
translation: 我在找一种方法，让东西在穿越沙漠时保持凉爽。

english: I'm looking for a way to keep something cool during transport. I thought you might have an idea.
translation: 我在找一种方法，让东西在运输过程中保持凉爽。我想你可能有主意。

english: I'm looking for a way to stop chocolate melting in the desert heat.
translation: 我在找一种方法，防止巧克力在沙漠高温下融化。

english: I'm looking for an accomplice for an adventure. They must not be afraid of climbing trees and must be a bit scary, so preferably a ghost.
translation: 我在找一个冒险的同伴。他不能怕爬树，还得有点吓人，所以最好是幽灵。

english: I'm looking for cabbages.
translation: 我在找卷心菜。

english: I'm looking for my marshmallow.
translation: 我在找我的棉花糖。

english: I'm looking for some festive white wine. I was told you'd be the person to speak to!
translation: 我在找一些节日白葡萄酒。有人告诉我应该找你谈谈！

english: I'm looking for something a bit discreet, essentially a bit of fun with someone who enjoys a drink.
translation: 我在找点低调的乐子，基本上就是想找个爱喝酒的人一起玩玩。

english: I'm looking for the toilet.
translation: 我在找厕所。

english: I'm making a cursed voyage.
translation: 我正在经历一场受诅咒的航行。

english: I'm more interested in how it became an accountant.
translation: 我更感兴趣的是它怎么变成会计的。

english: I'm more of an adventurer-type person, myself.
translation: 我自己更像是个冒险者类型的人。

english: I'm much more of a plant person than a people person!
translation: 比起和人打交道，我更擅长和植物打交道！

english: I'm no cleaner!
translation: 我才不是清洁工！

english: I'm not a huge fan of parties if I'm honest... but I tell you what, I'll go if you can answer this for me.
translation: 老实说，我不是很喜欢派对……但这样吧，如果你能回答我这个问题，我就去。

english: I'm not a rabbit!
translation: 我不是兔子！

english: I'm not actually planning on drinking it. It's for a magical potion to help the squire with some...!
translation: 我其实没打算喝它。这是用来做魔法药水，帮侍从解决一些……！

english: I'm not afraid of Death!
translation: 我不怕死神！

english: I'm not afraid of you.
translation: 我不怕你。

english: I'm not allowed back after... the incident.
translation: 那次……事件之后，他们就不让我回去了。

english: I'm not climbing that without a good reason. I might scrape my lovely hands on the rough ladder.
translation: 没有充分理由我是不会爬那个的。那粗糙的梯子会刮伤我可爱的手。

english: I'm not complete sure. You should see if anyone else here in Lumbridge knows.
translation: 我不太确定。你应该看看仑桥镇还有没有其他人知道。

english: I'm not completely sure. See if anyone else here in Lumbridge knows.
translation: 我不太确定。看看仑桥镇还有没有其他人知道。

english: I'm not entirely sure where that is.
translation: 我不太确定那在哪里。

english: I'm not falling for this.
translation: 我才不上这个当。

english: I'm not going near that - it's just far too stinky!
translation: 我才不靠近那个——太臭了！

english: I'm not here, I'm someplace far away.
translation: 我不在这里，我在很远的地方。

english: I'm not hungry.
translation: 我不饿。

english: I'm not interested in whatever this is.
translation: 我对这个没兴趣。

english: I'm not interested, sorry.
translation: 我没兴趣，抱歉。

english: I'm not quite sure that's correct, have another go!
translation: 我觉得那不太对，再试一次吧！

english: I'm not ready just yet.
translation: 我还没准备好。

english: I'm not ready to die for them, but a quiz? Sure, I'm ready.
translation: 我还没准备好为他们去死，但做个问答？行，我准备好了。

english: I'm not ready yet, give me a some time.
translation: 我还没准备好，给我点时间。

english: I'm not really a diplomat.
translation: 我其实不太擅长外交。

english: I'm not really a farmer.
translation: 我其实不是农夫。

english: I'm not really much of a traveller, sorry.
translation: 我其实不太爱旅行，抱歉。

english: I'm not really sure yet.
translation: 我还不确定。

english: I'm not really sure... I know she keeps going on about the beautiful red sunsets around here. Don't know if that helps though.
translation: 我不太确定……我只知道她一直念叨着这里美丽的红色日落。不知道这有没有帮助。

english: I'm not scared
translation: 我不怕

english: I'm not scared. Let's go!
translation: 我不怕。走吧！

english: I'm not sure I can actually eat all these, I'm already quite full on my first one.
translation: 我不确定我能不能吃完这些，吃第一个就已经很饱了。

english: I'm not sure I want to try that when I'm this injured.
translation: 我不确定在伤得这么重的时候尝试那个。

english: I'm not sure I'm really ahead right now...
translation: 我不确定我现在真的领先……

english: I'm not sure a competition works like that.
translation: 我不确定比赛是那样运作的。

english: I'm not sure how effective this banana would be if it were cut up.
translation: 我不确定这根香蕉切碎了还能有多大效果。

english: I'm not sure how or why they've grown legs, but it's probably something to do with uncontrolled concentrated easter energies!
translation: 我不确定它们是怎么长出腿的，但很可能和不受控制的浓缩复活节能量有关！

english: I'm not sure how, though...
translation: 不过，我不知道该怎么做……

english: I'm not sure that really matches my vibe, you know?
translation: 我不确定那真的符合我的风格，你懂吗？

english: I'm not sure we have anything to discuss on that, can I help with anything else?
translation: 我觉得我们没什么好谈的，还有别的事我能帮忙吗？

english: I'm not sure what to do with this... Maybe I could ask one of the heroes that confronted Lucien for some ideas.
translation: 我不知道该拿这个怎么办……也许我可以问问那些对抗过卢西安的英雄们，看看他们有没有什么主意。

english: I'm not sure you'll get one from her any more.
translation: 我不确定你还能从她那里拿到一个。

english: I'm not sure! It depends really on the molecular makeup of the chocolate and the temper...
translation: 我不确定！这实际上取决于巧克力的分子构成和调温……

english: I'm not sure, I'll go and ask Pete.
translation: 我不确定，我去问问皮特。

english: I'm not sure. One minute I'm at our Ghostly Gala, the next I'm in your physical realm!
translation: 我不确定。前一秒我还在我们的幽灵盛会，下一秒就到了你们的物质世界！

english: I'm not sure. Who is Gary?
translation: 我不确定。加里是谁？

english: I'm not sure... could you chase it down to find out?
translation: 我不确定……你能追上去看看吗？

english: I'm not that naive you know.
translation: 我可没那么天真，你知道的。

english: I'm not too familiar with him, but I'm happy to come along with you if you like.
translation: 我对他不太熟，但如果你愿意，我很乐意跟你一起去。

english: I'm okay for the moment, thank you.
translation: 我现在还好，谢谢你。

english: I'm okay, but my boys have been up to no good recently. They've been very secretive since last night.
translation: 我没事，但我的孩子们最近没干好事。从昨晚开始他们就神神秘秘的。

english: I'm on it boss!
translation: 我这就去办，老大！

english: I'm on it guv.
translation: 我这就去办，头儿。

english: I'm out of flour, so I could do with a few pots of that. I still need [number].
translation: 我的面粉用完了，所以需要几罐面粉。我还需要[number]罐。

english: I'm planning a Halloween treat for my niece and nephew, and the crypt of this church would be the perfect setting. I just need help preparing my show. It won't be hard work, I assure you.
translation: 我正在为我的侄女和侄子策划一个万圣节惊喜，这座教堂的墓穴会是完美的场地。我只需要有人帮我准备我的表演。不会很辛苦的，我保证。

english: I'm plucking the chicken to help a gnome open a portal.
translation: 我在拔鸡毛，帮一个地精打开传送门。

english: I'm pretty sure Franklin wanted IRON sheets.
translation: 我很确定富兰克林要的是铁板。

english: I'm pretty sure it was the Lumbridge Guide who created the list for the Duke.
translation: 我很确定是仑桥镇向导为公爵列的那张清单。

english: I'm probably smarter than you too!
translation: 我可能也比你聪明！

english: I'm ready for the judgement!
translation: 我准备好接受审判了！

english: I'm ready now!
translation: 我现在准备好了！

english: I'm ready to go back to shore.
translation: 我准备好回岸上了。

english: I'm ready too, let's go! To the Blue Moon Inn we go!
translation: 我也准备好了，走吧！我们去蓝月旅馆！

english: I'm ready! I feel like I can take on the world! Let's go to see the White Knights, now!
translation: 我准备好了！感觉能征服全世界！我们现在就去找白骑士吧！

english: I'm ready, let's go.
translation: 我准备好了，走吧。

english: I'm ready. Does that count?
translation: 我准备好了。这算数吗？

english: I'm really starting to look the part now! I just need some standard-issue weaponry and I'm good to go. Maybe it's time we unlocked the other chest.
translation: 我现在看起来真有模有样了！只需要一些制式武器就能出发了。也许该打开另一个箱子了。

english: I'm running short of food, so I'd like some cooked chickens. I still need [number].
translation: 我的食物快吃完了，所以想要一些熟鸡。我还需要[number]只。

english: I'm selling flowers and flower seeds. I'm a travelling flower trader!
translation: 我在卖花和花种。我是个流动花商！

english: I'm short of ammunition, so I could do with some bronze arrows. That way I can shoot at goblins through my window. I still need [number].
translation: 我弹药短缺，所以需要一些青铜箭。这样我就能从窗户射地精了。我还需要[number]支。

english: I'm smarter and better than Wilough at everything else though!
translation: 不过我在其他方面都比威洛更聪明、更厉害！

english: I'm so excited about getting into the Realm of Memories!
translation: 能进入记忆之境，我太兴奋了！

english: I'm so glad I found my hat, it's a shame you couldn't have been more help!
translation: 真高兴找到了我的帽子，可惜你没帮上什么忙！

english: I'm so happy for you! You look right at home.
translation: 真为你高兴！你看起来就像在自己家一样自在。

english: I'm so happy. I think the next step will be to return to my belongings and take them to Gilbert, since I will be spending my time there from now on...
translation: 我太开心了。我想下一步就是回去拿我的东西，然后带去给吉尔伯特，毕竟以后我都要待在那里了……

english: I'm so pleased. So, to the task at hand. What should I be doing in here.
translation: 我很满意。那么，回到手头的事吧。我在这里该做些什么？

english: I'm so sorry!
translation: 非常抱歉！

english: I'm so sorry. I really didn't mean it. I'd better get back to work now.
translation: 真的很抱歉。我真的不是故意的。我最好现在回去工作了。

english: I'm so tired...
translation: 我好累……

english: I'm sorry about earlier, it turns out you were on the nice list all along!
translation: 之前的事很抱歉，原来你一直都在好孩子名单上！

english: I'm sorry about that!
translation: 那件事我很抱歉！

english: I'm sorry dear the nice bunny is running out of eggs, maybe we can get one next year.
translation: 抱歉亲爱的，好兔子的蛋快发完了，也许我们明年能拿到一个。

english: I'm sorry for bothering you.
translation: 抱歉打扰你了。

english: I'm sorry to hear that. Maybe I could help try and find him?
translation: 听到这个我很遗憾。也许我可以帮忙找他？

english: I'm sorry to report that at this time you owe me...
translation: 很遗憾地报告，目前你欠我……

english: I'm sorry, I can't give you any milk.
translation: 抱歉，我不能给你牛奶。

english: I'm sorry, I got scared! You saw the kind of strange people that go around there!
translation: 抱歉，我被吓到了！你看到那里出没的那些怪人了吧！

english: I'm sorry, she's very grumpy today.
translation: 抱歉，她今天脾气很暴躁。

english: I'm sory to ask this but, can you do one last task for me?
translation: 不好意思问这个，但你能帮我做最后一件任务吗？

english: I'm still a bit busy right now.
translation: 我现在还有点忙。

english: I'm still a bit confused about how to fix Oaknock's machine.
translation: 我还是有点搞不懂怎么修奥克诺克的机器。

english: I'm still looking for the parts for the ice cream churn.
translation: 我还在找冰淇淋搅拌机的零件。

english: I'm still selling my flowers and seeds! Did you find your last seed?
translation: 我还在卖我的花和种子！你找到最后一颗种子了吗？

english: I'm still thinking about it, I haven't solved any yet.
translation: 我还在想，一个都还没解出来。

english: I'm struggling to complete this fish salad of mine,
translation: 我正发愁怎么完成我的鱼沙拉，

english: I'm struggling to find some cat hair.
translation: 我正发愁怎么找到一些猫毛。

english: I'm struggling to follow Bethans's instructions.
translation: 我正发愁怎么理解贝珊的指示。

english: I'm struggling to follow Gregory's instructions.
translation: 我正发愁怎么理解格雷戈里的指示。

english: I'm struggling to follow Quinton's instructions.
translation: 我正发愁怎么理解昆顿的指示。

english: I'm struggling to follow Tabbitha's instructions.
translation: 我正发愁怎么理解塔比莎的指示。

english: I'm sure I can get a sapphire...
translation: 我肯定能弄到一颗蓝宝石……

english: I'm sure I will. Merry Christmas!
translation: 我肯定会的。圣诞快乐！

english: I'm sure everyone will be showing off their new haircuts after the festival!
translation: 我相信节后大家都会炫耀自己的新发型！

english: I'm sure he believes in you but we all need help every now and again...
translation: 我相信他信任你，但我们偶尔都需要帮助……

english: I'm sure he will be as well, and if they need more help, I'm always happy to get involved.
translation: 我相信他也会的，如果他们需要更多帮助，我很乐意参与。

english: I'm sure he will, goodbye.
translation: 我相信他会的，再见。

english: I'm sure he'll love it. I better be off now, I wouldn't want to be late.
translation: 我相信他会喜欢的。我最好现在就走，我可不想迟到。

english: I'm sure it will be!
translation: 我相信会的！

english: I'm sure it won't be too bad though. I have my bonnet on underneath for cushioning.
translation: 不过我相信不会太糟。我里面戴了帽子当缓冲。

english: I'm sure it would, [player name]. Now, do you want to hear the song?
translation: 我相信会的，[player name]。那么，你想听这首歌吗？

english: I'm sure she would like that! And human food isn't all bad!
translation: 我相信她会喜欢的！而且人类食物也不是一无是处！

english: I'm sure the Dark Lord is pleased with your blind devotion and love of fire.
translation: 我相信黑暗领主对你的盲目忠诚和对火焰的热爱很满意。

english: I'm sure they will, it brings more colour to Misthalin, just like we wanted!
translation: 我相信他们会喜欢的，这给米斯萨林带来了更多色彩，正如我们所愿！

english: I'm sure they'll love it.
translation: 我相信他们会喜欢的。

english: I'm sure you are!
translation: 你肯定是！

english: I'm sure you can as well. Anyway, I'll let you get on with your work.
translation: 我相信你也能。总之，我就不打扰你工作了。

english: I'm sure you will. I'll keep my finger crossed for you.
translation: 我相信你会的。我为你祈祷。

english: I'm sure you'll find a place to stay.
translation: 我相信你会找到住处的。

english: I'm sure you'll find somewhere to stay.
translation: 我相信你会找到地方住的。

english: I'm sure you'll get one soon. Remember the person who bought the seeds went off to the Blue Moon Inn.
translation: 我相信你很快就能拿到一个。记得买种子的人去了蓝月旅馆。

english: I'm sure you'll survive! I'm going to go and visit the grotto, see you around.
translation: 我相信你死不了！我要去参观洞穴了，回头见。

english: I'm sure you'll work it out.
translation: 我相信你能解决的。

english: I'm surprised that Diango didn't mention that to me, I might have volunteered to help get the stolen decorations back.
translation: 我很惊讶迪亚戈没跟我提过，我本来可能会自愿帮忙找回被偷的装饰品。

english: I'm surprised you can even hold it up.
translation: 我很惊讶你居然能把它举起来。

english: I'm surprising everyone today!
translation: 我今天要让所有人都大吃一惊！

english: I'm suspecting a 'but' next.
translation: 我猜接下来有个'但是'。

english: I'm talking to Ali Morrisane at the moment. I think he might know something!
translation: 我现在正在和阿里.莫里桑谈话。我觉得他可能知道些什么！

english: I'm terribly sorry but I don't understand what you mean.
translation: 非常抱歉，但我不明白你的意思。

english: I'm too busy. (No)
translation: 我太忙了。（不）

english: I'm too laid back to really care, mate.
translation: 我太懒散了，真的不在乎，哥们。

english: I'm trapped in a bottle. I'm not going anywhere.
translation: 我被困在瓶子里了。我哪儿也去不了。

english: I'm trying to fix the temperature in here.
translation: 我正试着调节这里的温度。

english: I'm trying to help bring some more colour to Misthalin!
translation: 我正努力为米斯萨林增添更多色彩！

english: I'm trying to make an ice cream churn, do you know if there's anything in there that could be useful?
translation: 我正在做一个冰淇淋搅拌机，你知道里面有没有什么有用的东西吗？

english: I'm trying to recreate a portal that my dad accidentally opened, some time ago.
translation: 我正试着重现我父亲不久前意外打开的一个传送门。

english: I'm trying to sleep, what is it?
translation: 我正想睡觉，什么事？

english: I'm very glad Pete didn't ask us to bake a cake... Mixing wizards and baking is a recipe for disaster!
translation: 我很高兴皮特没让我们烤蛋糕……把巫师和烘焙混在一起简直是灾难食谱！

english: I'm very glad he wants to go to the march with me... I even think he liked my poem!
translation: 我很高兴他想和我一起去游行……我甚至觉得他喜欢我的诗！

english: I'm very proud of this cake... Even if it accidentally rolled back into the oven!
translation: 我为这个蛋糕感到非常自豪……尽管它不小心滚回了烤箱里！

english: I'm with the Fishing Guild Anti-Monopoly Department.
translation: 我是钓鱼公会反垄断部的。

english: I'm working on a super spooky one!
translation: 我正在做一个超级恐怖的！

english: I'm... Not quite sure who you are.
translation: 我……不太确定你是谁。

english: I've almost finished preparing for the festival too. I just have one last errand to run.
translation: 我也快准备好过节了。只剩最后一件事要办。

english: I've already given you one. Fill that one first.
translation: 我已经给过你一个了。先把那个装满。

english: I've already got a few ideas for potential adopters. Hmm... What if we set up a rehoming event? An adoption drive!
translation: 我已经有了一些潜在领养者的想法。嗯……我们办个重新安置活动怎么样？一个领养活动！

english: I've already got some beef.
translation: 我已经有一些牛肉了。

english: I've already got some broccoli.
translation: 我已经有一些西兰花了。

english: I've already got some cabbage.
translation: 我已经有一些卷心菜了。

english: I've already got some carrots.
translation: 我已经有一些胡萝卜了。

english: I've already got some cauliflower.
translation: 我已经有一些花椰菜了。

english: I've already got some chicken.
translation: 我已经有一些鸡了。

english: I've already got some jubbly.
translation: 我已经有一些朱比利肉了。

english: I've already got some mushroom wellington.
translation: 我已经有一些蘑菇威灵顿了。

english: I've already got some nut roast.
translation: 我已经有一些坚果烤了。

english: I've already got some potatoes.
translation: 我已经有一些土豆了。

english: I've already got some sprouts.
translation: 我已经有一些芽菜了。

english: I've already got some trout.
translation: 我已经有一些鳟鱼了。

english: I've already scared Oziach from this tree. I should find one further down the path.
translation: 我已经用这棵树吓跑过奥扎克了。我应该沿着路再找一棵。

english: I've already submitted my entry, and it didn't win! I submitted a banana.
translation: 我已经提交了我的参赛作品，但没赢！我提交了一根香蕉。

english: I've already tried that. No luck! It's as pink as ever.
translation: 我已经试过了。没运气！它还是那么粉。

english: I've been commissioned to paint a very special painting. No matter how hard I try, I just can't seem to get the perspective correct on this sword...
translation: 我受委托画一幅非常特别的画作。不管我怎么努力，就是画不对这把剑的透视……

english: I've been known to run errands for all types of creatures, it's what I do.
translation: 大家都知道我为各种生物跑腿，这就是我的工作。

english: I've been sent by Duke Horacio of Lumbridge to ask for your help in dealing with a matter of great urgency.
translation: 我是仑桥镇的霍拉西奥公爵派来请你帮忙处理一件非常紧急的事情。

english: I've been sent by the Legends' Guild.
translation: 我是传奇公会派来的。

english: I've been sent here by Ali Morrisane!
translation: 我是阿里.莫里桑派来这里的！

english: I've been sent to help purify the Varrock stone circle.
translation: 我被派来帮助净化维洛克城的石圈。

english: I've been showcasing some of my latest creations on Archibald, who, as I just discovered, loves rolling in hair clippings. Never was cleaning up shop this much of an uphill struggle! It's also a lot of laughs, of course.
translation: 我一直在阿奇博尔德身上展示我的最新作品，结果发现他超爱在头发屑里打滚。打扫店铺从来没这么费劲过！当然，也挺好笑的。

english: I've been so busy that my scissors are going blunt!
translation: 我忙到剪刀都钝了！

english: I've been tracking the compound interest, you see.
translation: 我一直在追踪复利，你懂的。

english: I've been watching all the contestants, and I think I know what to do to win.
translation: 我一直在观察所有参赛者，我想我知道该怎么赢了。

english: I've captured all of the monkeys!
translation: 我已经抓住了所有猴子！

english: I've cheered up all of the children!
translation: 我已经让所有孩子都开心起来了！

english: I've cleaned some of it, the potion is working. I still have to clean the rest though.
translation: 我已经清理了一部分，药水有效。不过剩下的还得继续清理。

english: I've collected four of the five seeds from the traders.
translation: 我已经从商人那里收集了五颗种子中的四颗。

english: I've completed all the activities!
translation: 我已经完成了所有活动！

english: I've currently stopped you from gaining XP. Would you like me to restore it?
translation: 我目前已经阻止你获得经验值。你想让我恢复它吗？

english: I've done it! The animated eggs have been eggs- terminated.
translation: 我做到了！那些活蛋已经被消灭了。

english: I've done some training. Can you use my items?
translation: 我训练过了。你能用我的物品吗？

english: I've figured that out too! The chef is extremely proud of his cooking and very defensive of it.
translation: 那个我也搞清楚了！厨师对自己的烹饪非常自豪，而且很护短。

english: I've finished in the garden as you saw. Where should I be going now?
translation: 如你所见，我已经完成了花园的部分。我现在该去哪儿？

english: I've forgotten how to use the serum.
translation: 我忘了怎么用血清了。

english: I've found Anti-Santa. He wants me to fill a vial with children's tears.
translation: 我找到了反圣诞老人。他要我用小瓶装孩子的眼泪。

english: I've found a use for cadava berries. I still need [number].
translation: 我找到了卡达瓦莓的用途。我还需要[number]个。

english: I've found all five seeds!
translation: 我找到了全部五颗种子！

english: I've found out how to cure the disease.
translation: 我找到了治愈这种疾病的方法。

english: I've found the second entrance to the mine.
translation: 我找到了矿场的第二个入口。

english: I've found your teddy... Doesn't this remind of what Christmas is about?
translation: 我找到了你的泰迪熊……这难道不让你想起圣诞节的意义吗？

english: I've given out [X] eggs!
translation: 我已经分发了[X]个蛋！

english: I've given the report to Ali Morrisane! Now I just need to get the information from him.
translation: 我已经把报告交给了阿里.莫里桑！现在只需要从他那里获取情报。

english: I've got a Santa costume.
translation: 我有一套圣诞老人服装。

english: I've got a few ideas for this!
translation: 我对这个有些想法！

english: I've got a list here, which you can check any time.
translation: 我这里有一份清单，你可以随时查看。

english: I've got a little issue. I've dropped some of the clean armour!
translation: 我有个小问题。我掉了一些干净的盔甲！

english: I've got all the decorations here.
translation: 我这里有所有的装饰品。

english: I've got better things to be doing to be honest.
translation: 老实说，我有更好的事情要做。

english: I've got graves to dig, and I left my shovel in there
translation: 我有坟墓要挖，而且我把铲子落在里面了。

english: I've got my hat back already.
translation: 我已经拿回我的帽子了。

english: I've got my sources.
translation: 我有我的消息来源。

english: I've got other things to do now. Can you leave?
translation: 我现在有别的事要做。你能离开吗？

english: I've got some chocolate eggs to test!
translation: 我有一些巧克力蛋要测试！

english: I've got some hints as to where the mould is, but not yet retrieved it.
translation: 我得到了一些关于模具在哪里的线索，但还没拿到手。

english: I've got some information on how to kill the zogres from a distance.
translation: 我得到了一些关于如何从远处杀死佐格人的信息。

english: I've got some silk here. Will you buy it?
translation: 我这里有些丝绸。你要买吗？

english: I've got some! A lovely camel named [Alice/Cam/Elly] gave me some.
translation: 我弄到了一些！一只可爱的骆驼，名叫[Alice/Cam/Elly]，给了我一些。

english: I've got the feathers and materials you requested.
translation: 我拿到了你要的羽毛和材料。

english: I've got the ingredients we need...
translation: 我拿到了我们需要的材料……

english: I've got the ingredients!
translation: 我拿到材料了！

english: I've got the report from Ali Morrisane's contact. I'm hoping Ali will give me some information in return for it.
translation: 我从阿里.莫里桑的联系人那里拿到了报告。我希望阿里能给我一些情报作为交换。

english: I've got the spooky pumpkin lantern from Diango.
translation: 我从迪亚戈那里拿到了幽灵南瓜灯笼。

english: I've got the vial, now what?
translation: 我拿到小瓶了，现在怎么办？

english: I've got to get back to the Stronghold.
translation: 我得回要塞了。

english: I've got to snap out of it! That thing nearly hypnotised me!
translation: 我得清醒过来！那东西差点催眠了我！

english: I've got you a dragon.
translation: 我给你弄了条龙。

english: I've grown sick of Christmas and all that it embodies.
translation: 我已经厌倦了圣诞节以及它所代表的一切。

english: I've had my eyes on someone... he is irresistable, but I don't know his name.
translation: 我一直在关注一个人……他让人无法抗拒，但我不知道他的名字。

english: I've heard a little, but I think Katrine is tougher.
translation: 我听说了一点，但我认为卡特琳更难对付。

english: I've heard he's done similar appearances before, so I'm sure he'd be up for it!
translation: 我听说他以前也做过类似的出场，所以我肯定他会愿意的！

english: I've heard of a few camels. Elly, Cam and Alice are all north-east of here. Maybe try them.
translation: 我听说过几只骆驼。艾莉、卡姆和爱丽丝都在这里的东北方向。也许可以去找它们。

english: I've hired some pixies to make some toys for me, but they're completely hopeless!
translation: 我雇了一些小精灵帮我做玩具，但它们完全靠不住！

english: I've killed [number] spying creatures so far, maybe there are more to find...
translation: 到目前为止，我已经杀死了 [number] 个间谍生物，也许还有更多要寻找……

english: I've killed all of the spies.
translation: 我已经杀了所有间谍。

english: I've lost Patty's cake tin.
translation: 我把帕蒂的蛋糕模具弄丢了。

english: I've lost both of the seeds you gave me!
translation: 我把你给我的两颗种子都弄丢了！

english: I've lost my Book of Ayaster.
translation: 我把我的《阿亚斯特之书》弄丢了。

english: I've lost my clue
translation: 我把我的线索弄丢了。

english: I've lost my notes!
translation: 我把我的笔记弄丢了！

english: I've lost one of the seeds you gave me!
translation: 我把你给我的其中一颗种子弄丢了！

english: I've lost that scroll you gave me, could I have a replacement copy?
translation: 我把你给我的那个卷轴弄丢了，能给我一份副本吗？

english: I've lost the Book of Ayaster that you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的《阿亚斯特之书》弄丢了。

english: I've lost the clue you gave me, I'm sorry.
translation: 我把你给我的线索弄丢了，对不起。

english: I've lost the iron oxide, can I have some more?
translation: 我把氧化铁弄丢了，能再给我一些吗？

english: I've lost the promissory note the cook gave me.
translation: 我把厨师给我的期票弄丢了。

english: I've lost the snake
translation: 我把蛇弄丢了。

english: I've lost the special hot sauce you gave me.
translation: 我把你给我的特制辣酱弄丢了。

english: I've lost the special hot sauce.
translation: 我把特制辣酱弄丢了。

english: I've lost the treasure chest.
translation: 我把宝箱弄丢了。

english: I've lost the whistle you gave me...
translation: 我把你给我的哨子弄丢了……

english: I've lost your cake tin.
translation: 我把你的蛋糕模具弄丢了。

english: I've made contact with the cave goblins...
translation: 我已经和洞穴哥布林取得了联系……

english: I've made it in to the mines.
translation: 我成功进入了矿场。

english: I've made some progress! I've spoken to Karim who told to talk to a man named Shantay.
translation: 我取得了一些进展！我和卡里姆谈过了，他让我去找一个叫沙泰的人。

english: I've made you an egg.
translation: 我给你做了个蛋。

english: I've managed to lose both the cake tin and the note you gave me.
