translation: 我不小心把你给我的蛋糕模具和纸条都弄丢了。

english: I've never heard that one before...
translation: 我从没听过这种说法……

english: I've no idea how many newcomers I've welcome to the world in the six years that we've been here, but I really am most pleased!
translation: 我不知道这六年来我迎接了多少新生命来到这个世界，但我真的非常高兴！

english: I've no idea what you mean! It seems perfectly edible.
translation: 我不知道你在说什么！这东西看起来完全可以吃。

english: I've no idea. The bird doesn't know either. I suspect magical sabotage. Maybe someone really hates Easter eggs.
translation: 我不知道。那只鸟也不知道。我怀疑是魔法破坏。也许有人真的很讨厌复活节彩蛋。

english: I've not got it yet.
translation: 我还没拿到呢。

english: I've only got little arms, I can't take anymore items.
translation: 我只有小胳膊，拿不了更多东西了。

english: I've only got most of my life in these containers.
translation: 我大半辈子都装在这些容器里了。

english: I've only seen slaves and guards go down there, I never see the slaves come back up. At least up here you have a nice view and a bit of sun.
translation: 我只看到奴隶和守卫下去，从没见过奴隶上来。至少在上面你还能看看风景，晒晒太阳。

english: I've picked out a nice cold bottle for you.
translation: 我给你挑了一瓶冰好的。

english: I've placed the churn, just need to add the milk!
translation: 我已经放好了搅拌器，就差加牛奶了！

english: I've probably got enough of these by now.
translation: 我现在大概有足够多了。

english: I've purified the tears into this sorrowful solution, all you have to do is pour it into the machine over there!
translation: 我已经把眼泪净化成了这种悲伤溶液，你只需要把它倒进那边的机器里就行了！

english: I've put your name down for an appointment at the Falador hairdresser. He's expecting you at your earliest convenience.
translation: 我已经帮你预约了法拉多城的理发师。他随时恭候你的光临。

english: I've reached out to one of my acquaintances, Probita, and she confirmed to me that none of these five adorable little tykes have an owner.
translation: 我联系了我的一个熟人，普罗比塔，她向我确认这五个可爱的小家伙都没有主人。

english: I've returned with good news.
translation: 我带来了好消息。

english: I've seen quite a few good costumes but I still liked yours a lot. So as for next year, who can tell? Not me!
translation: 我看到了不少好服装，但我还是很喜欢你的。至于明年会怎样？谁知道呢，反正不是我！

english: I've seen that Thing - it's two penguins in a suit!
translation: 我见过那个东西——那是两只企鹅穿着西装！

english: I've sent [number] essence to your bank.
translation: 我已经向你的银行发送了[number]份精华。

english: I've smelt doom for YEARS, I tell you, years.
translation: 我闻到厄运的味道好几年了，我告诉你，好几年了。

english: I've spoken to Ellis, and I know what parts I need to make the churn, now I just need to get them.
translation: 我和埃利斯谈过了，我知道做搅拌器需要哪些零件了，现在只需要去弄到手。

english: I've spoken to Karim, who sent me to Shantay, who told me to talk to a man named Ali Morrisane.
translation: 我和卡里姆谈过了，他让我去找沙泰，沙泰又让我去找一个叫阿里.莫里桑的人。

english: I've spoken to Thordur, what should I do now?
translation: 我和索杜尔谈过了，现在我该做什么？

english: I've spoken to the master crafter...
translation: 我和制作大师谈过了……

english: I've taken to calling them 'skis' after the skidding you have to do to turn. It sounds intimidating, but it's quite enjoyable if you find a rhythm.
translation: 我开始叫它们‘滑雪板’，因为转弯的时候得滑行。听起来挺吓人，但找到节奏后还挺好玩的。

english: I've tracked the goblin raiders back to their cave. Soon we can gather our armies to take our revenge!
translation: 我追踪哥布林掠夺者回到了他们的洞穴。很快我们就能集结军队复仇了！

english: I've tried just about everything and it just won't light.
translation: 我几乎试了所有方法，它就是点不着。

english: I've unlocked the heavy chest! It's your things, though, so I didn't check the contents.
translation: 我打开了那个沉重的箱子！不过那是你的东西，所以我没有查看里面的内容。

english: I've upgraded your Ardougne cloak for you. Wizard Cromperty will now give you 250 pure essence every day, you will catch 50% more fish from the Fishing Trawler and receive 25% more marks of grace on the
translation: 我已为你升级了阿多尼斗篷。法师克伦珀蒂现在每天会给你250份纯净精华，你从捕鱼拖网中捕获的鱼会增加50%，并且在……上获得25%更多的格蕾丝印记。

english: I've worked out where we can get suitable mementos around Varrock, and I've prepared a place upstairs in this building where we'll perform a ritual with them.
translation: 我想到了在维洛克城附近哪里可以找到合适的纪念品，并且我在这栋楼的楼上准备了一个地方，我们可以在那里用它们举行仪式。

english: I, however, must ensure I have passage at the end.
translation: 然而，我必须确保自己最后有路可走。

english: I, the bartender of the Dragon Inn, do swear that this is a true likeness of the wizzy who was talking to Brentle Vahn, my customer the other day.'
translation: 我，龙之酒馆的酒保，在此发誓，这确实是那天和我的顾客布伦特尔.瓦恩谈话的那个巫师的真实肖像。

english: I... I guess I did.
translation: 我……我想我确实做了。

english: I... I'm afraid.
translation: 我……我害怕。

english: I... Of course. We'll make preparations.
translation: 我……当然。我们会做好准备的。

english: I... Um, I shouldn't have said that. Best not mention it to anyone.
translation: 我……呃，我不该说那个。最好别跟任何人提起。

english: I... can milk you? I just need to use my big bucket on you?
translation: 我……可以挤你的奶？我只需要用我的大桶对着你用一下？

english: I... can't milk you?
translation: 我……不能挤你的奶？

english: I... don't want to put a spanner in the works, but I think you need three goblin mail for that quest.
translation: 我……不想捣乱，但我觉得那个任务需要三件哥布林链甲。

english: I... fine. Hello. You say that Ali sent you?
translation: 我……好吧。你好。你说你是阿里派来的？

english: I... just wanted to go on an adventure, and help some people.
translation: 我……只是想出去冒险，顺便帮帮别人。

english: I... need to see a man about a dog. Party on, my friend!
translation: 我……有点私事要处理。继续狂欢吧，我的朋友！

english: I... that's the same... sure. I'll do it right now.
translation: 我……那是一样的……好吧。我现在就做。

english: I... uh... I used to watch musicals and plays, funny ones. Party Pete used to host a little event quite regularly in the party room in Falador. But... that was before.
translation: 我……呃……我以前会看音乐剧和戏剧，搞笑的那种。派对皮特以前经常在法拉多城的派对厅定期举办小活动。但……那是以前的事了。

english: I... uhh...
IT'S DYING! IT'S ALL DYING! THE GAME IS DYING!!
translation: 它快死了！全都快死了！这游戏要完蛋了！！

english: Ice Mountain western scramble Agility shortcuts.
translation: 冰山西侧攀爬的敏捷捷径。

english: Ice is pretty deadly, which is convenient because I don't think we would have talked him into leaving.
translation: 冰相当致命，这倒挺方便，因为我觉得我们本来也没法说服他离开。

english: Icthlarin and his family have so far taken no part in the war.
translation: 伊克哈林和他的家人至今未参与这场战争。

english: Icyene

english: If there are three gods, then how does thy brother, Saradomin, has his own island, meaning Entrana, that is being inhabited by locals that only adore thy brethren, Saradomin? Don't you think that thou and thy other brethren, Zamorak, shall also have ye own island which shelters people that worship both thee and thy brother?
translation: 既然有三位神祇，为何你的兄弟萨拉多明能拥有自己的岛屿，也就是恩特纳岛，而岛上的居民只崇拜你的兄弟萨拉多明？难道你不觉得你和你的另一位兄弟扎莫拉克，也该有一座属于你们的岛屿，来庇护那些同时崇拜你和那位兄弟的人吗？

english: If there is gonna be new "special" strikes with weapons then will it be like r2h and scimitar will have different kind of attacks?
translation: 如果武器会有新的“特殊”攻击，那是不是像双手剑和弯刀会有不同类型的攻击方式？

english: If there's a party, I'm there!
translation: 有派对，我必到！

english: If they have their ways, they will disturb the seedlings again. I've started building a scarecrow, but it's still missing a head.
translation: 如果它们得逞，又会来捣乱那些幼苗。我已经开始搭一个稻草人了，但还缺个头。

english: If this is a skill, why isn't it in the skill interface?
translation: 如果这是一种技能，为什么不在技能界面里？

english: If thou art asking of the city beneath the waves, it hath been submerged for many centuries, and most commonfolk consider it naught but a myth. I tell thee true, however, that such a place doth indeed exist, and even as I write this there are those working to re-establish access between this place and the outside world that hath all but forgotten it over these past centuries.
translation: 若你问的是那海底之城，它已沉没数百年，大多数平民只当它是个传说。但我告诉你，这地方确实存在，就在我写下这段话时，还有人正在努力重建它和外界之间的联系——而外界在过去几个世纪里几乎已将它遗忘。

english: If thou consider the possessions of an enemy to be like a roulette wheel, then the 'rare' items so coveted by players are located on a second roulette wheel, that will only be spun shouldst thou roll a specific number on the first wheel. The ring of wealth affects not the number which thou may achieve upon the first wheel, but should thou gain the precise number to allow thee access to the second, the ring will make thy chances of gaining an object on that second roulette wheel all the greater. My analogy is flawed, for death is not like roulette, but I hope that thou see the truth within this.
translation: 若你把敌人的掉落物看作一个轮盘，那么玩家们梦寐以求的‘稀有’物品就在第二个轮盘上，只有当你第一个轮盘转到特定数字时，第二个轮盘才会转动。财富戒指影响的不是你在第一个轮盘上转到的数字，但若你恰好转到了能让你进入第二个轮盘的数字，这枚戒指就会让你在第二个轮盘上获得物品的几率大大增加。我这个比喻并不完美，因为死亡不像轮盘赌，但我希望你能从中领悟到真相。

english: If up is down and down is up, how would you go west?
translation: 如果上是下，下是上，那你怎么往西走？

english: If used on a bonecrusher or a dragonbone necklace without the other item present in the player's inventory
translation: 如果对碎骨器或龙骨项链使用，但玩家背包中没有另一件物品

english: If used on a hydra tail or a dragonbone necklace without the other item present in the player's inventory
translation: 如果对九头蛇尾或龙骨项链使用，但玩家背包中没有另一件物品

english: If we could get hold of any of these artefacts, and use them to slay the High Priest, that might end the invasions for good!
translation: 如果我们能拿到这些神器中的任何一个，并用它们杀死大祭司，也许就能彻底终结入侵！

english: If we don't make presents it will ruin Christmas! We just need a better boss.
translation: 如果我们不做礼物，圣诞节就毁了！我们只是需要一个更好的老板。

english: If we don't succeed, then it's the end of the monks' lives as we know it!
translation: 如果我们不成功，那这些僧侣的生命就到头了，就像我们所知的那样！

english: If we had Christmas every day it wouldn't feel so special anymore.
translation: 如果每天都过圣诞节，它就不会那么特别了。

english: If we haven't discovered all of our planet, don't you think there is a place not located on any terrain here in "Gielenor"? Perhaps, something unimaginably mysterious beneath the seas, which we see almost everywhere we go.
translation: 如果我们还没有探索完整个星球，你不觉得在‘吉莱诺’这片大陆上，可能有个地方不在地图上吗？也许，就在我们几乎随处可见的海洋之下，藏着某种难以想象的秘密。

english: If we order some food from the bar, and then complain about it, the chef is sure to come out to defend it!
translation: 如果我们从吧台点些食物，然后抱怨它，厨师肯定会出来辩护！

english: If we start near the monastery, we can scare Oziach down the path one set of trees at a time.
translation: 如果我们从修道院附近开始，我们可以把奥扎克吓得沿着小路跑，一次经过一排树。

english: If wrong name is chosen
translation: 如果选择了错误的名字

english: If you also give me some of the wood from which you make them, that would constitute a memento of Woodcutting too.
translation: 如果你再给我一些你用来制作它们的木材，那也算是一份伐木的纪念品。

english: If you can solve the riddles and deliver the presents, I'd be happy to give you the remaining festive holly!
translation: 如果你能解开谜语并送出礼物，我很乐意把剩下的节日冬青给你！

english: If you can solve them for us, we'll reward you.
translation: 如果你能为我们解开它们，我们会奖励你。

english: If you can turn into anything then you are the best "god" on runescape. I know this Because then you could turn into saradomin or zamorak.
translation: 如果你能变成任何东西，那你就是RuneScape里最厉害的‘神’。我知道这一点，因为那样你就能变成萨拉多明或扎莫拉克了。

english: If you choose to cease paying the council tithe for the members lands, then you will be returned to the free lands, and any items you have gained that are not allowed in the free lands will still be present upon you, but they will be labelled as members items and you will not be able to use them. Any skills you have gained in your travels through the members lands will remain as they were before your membership was cancelled, but you will not be able to use the members only skills at all in the free lands.
translation: 如果你选择停止向议会缴纳会员区域的什一税，你将被送回免费区域，你获得的任何在免费区域不允许使用的物品仍会保留在你身上，但会被标记为会员物品，你将无法使用它们。你在会员区域旅行中获得的任何技能等级，在你取消会员资格后仍会保留，但在免费区域你将完全无法使用会员专属技能。

english: If you come to ice mountain or the dwarven mine, you don't know the difference between east and west, in which case just give up.
translation: 如果你来到冰山或矮人矿场，却分不清东西南北，那还是放弃吧。

english: If you could fetch it for me, I would be very grateful.
translation: 如果你能帮我取来，我会非常感激。

english: If you could help my priests by giving each of them 3 eggs, that would be wonderful!
translation: 如果你能帮我的祭司们，给他们每人3个蛋，那就太好了！

english: If you could join in with our chant, we might see some progress.
translation: 如果你能加入我们的吟唱，我们或许能看到一些进展。

english: If you destroy the boat, the items in the cargo hold will be lost.
translation: 如果你摧毁船，货舱里的物品将会丢失。

english: If you don't save me one, it'll be bad news for you!
translation: 如果你不给我留一个，那对你来说可就是坏消息了！

english: If you dress up just like them, they might think you're one of them! That way you can distract them and I can escape!
translation: 如果你打扮得跟他们一模一样，他们可能会以为你是他们的一员！这样你就能分散他们的注意力，我就能逃走了！

english: If you ever feel a tickle on your face in the night, that just means one of us got lost while taking a stroll.
translation: 如果你晚上感觉脸上痒痒的，那只是我们中的一个人在散步时迷路了。

english: If you have a house of your own, you may now pay the Estate Agents to redecorate it in the style of my own mansion. Finally, you can access additional skin tones at the Makeover Mage.
translation: 如果你有自己的房子，现在可以付钱给房地产经纪人，让他们按照我豪宅的风格重新装修。最后，你还可以在变身法师那里获得额外的肤色。

english: If you have a house, you can use it for decoration or to repel crows, although we saw how well that worked last time.
translation: 如果你有房子，你可以用它来装饰或驱赶乌鸦，尽管我们上次已经见识过效果如何了。

english: If you have gained from those six years, it is as though you drew nourishment from your food and drink. But if not, it is as though your food dripped straight out of your bottom.
translation: 如果你从这六年中有所收获，那就如同你从食物和饮料中汲取了营养。但如果没有，那就如同你的食物直接从屁股流了出去。

english: If you have to. Try and make it interesting.
translation: 如果你必须的话。试着让它有趣点。

english: If you job is that bad can't you just quit?
translation: 如果你的工作那么糟糕，你就不能辞职吗？

english: If you keep the entire thing cold, the mixers prevent the milk from forming into a giant block of ice and you end up with a nice ice cream!
translation: 如果你让整个东西保持低温，搅拌器就能防止牛奶结成一大块冰，最后你就能得到美味的冰淇淋！

english: If you know Christmas so well, name one thing you do during that time?
translation: 如果你这么了解圣诞节，说说你那时候会做的一件事？

english: If you know Christmas so well...
translation: 如果你这么了解圣诞节……

english: If you leave by this door you will fail this trial. Press continue to go through the door anyway.
translation: 如果你从这扇门离开，你将无法通过这次试炼。按继续键仍要穿过这扇门。

english: If you leave now, the eggs will escape and you will have to start hunting them again.
translation: 如果你现在离开，蛋会逃走，你得重新开始追捕它们。

english: If you leave you'll have to start again!
translation: 如果你离开，就得重新开始！

english: If you look very carefully, you see what looks like a guild emblem.
translation: 如果你非常仔细地看，你会看到看起来像公会徽章的东西。

english: If you manage to do this three times for us, we'll give you a special reward.
translation: 如果你能为我们成功做到三次，我们会给你一份特殊奖励。

english: If you need to give this item to a player who's restricted from trading, you can give them the item by using it on them.
translation: 如果你需要把这个物品给一个受交易限制的玩家，你可以通过对其使用该物品来给予。

english: If you need to retrieve an unlockable item of this nature, I suggest you visit Diango in Draynor Village. He looks after such things.
translation: 如果你需要取回这种性质的解锁物品，我建议你去德雷诺村找迪亚戈。他负责保管这类东西。

english: If you opponent accepts the challenge you will be taken to one of the tables around where you will play your game of choice.
translation: 如果你的对手接受挑战，你将被带到附近的一张桌子旁，在那里进行你选择的游戏。

english: If you prefer, you can also have a go at challenge mode where I will add all the beacons at once and you have to collect them as fast as you can!
translation: 如果你愿意，也可以试试挑战模式，我会一次点亮所有信标，你要尽可能快地收集它们！

english: If you revert your Emberlight, you'll get your Tormented synapse back, but you'll lose any other materials used to make the weapon.
translation: 如果你还原你的余烬之光，你会拿回被折磨的突触，但会失去制造武器时使用的其他材料。

english: If you revert your Purging staff, you'll get your Tormented synapse back, but you'll lose any other materials used to make the weapon.
translation: 如果你还原你的净化法杖，你会拿回被折磨的突触，但会失去制造武器时使用的其他材料。

english: If you revert your Scorching bow, you'll get your Tormented synapse back, but you'll lose any other materials used to make the weapon.
translation: 如果你还原你的灼热之弓，你会拿回被折磨的突触，但会失去制造武器时使用的其他材料。

english: If you search around the room you'll find various items. Could you kindly put them back where they belong? My diary is on the table, read this for some clues. If you tell anyone what you read, you shall die.
translation: 你在房间里四处找找，会发现各种物品。能麻烦你把它们放回原处吗？我的日记在桌子上，读一读会有线索。如果你把看到的内容告诉任何人，你就死定了。

english: If you search my cart you'll find some packages for delivery. Each package is labelled but in order to protect my customers' privacy they're a little vague.
translation: 你搜搜我的推车，会发现一些要送的包裹。每个包裹都有标签，但为了保护客户的隐私，标签写得有点含糊。

english: If you tell me what you're doing here, I won't tell the generals.
translation: 如果你告诉我你在这里干什么，我就不告诉将军们。

english: If you try to pick this cabbage using brute force it will probably shatter. A more delicate approach may be required.
translation: 如果你试图用蛮力摘这颗卷心菜，它很可能会碎掉。可能需要更精细的方法。

english: If you try to pick this cabbage using brute force it will probably shatter. It needs thawing out.
translation: 如果你试图用蛮力摘这颗卷心菜，它很可能会碎掉。需要先解冻。

english: If you walk away, your cat will retreat from the fight to follow you. You may like to pass food through the curtain to support your cat.
translation: 如果你走开，你的猫会退出战斗跟着你。你可以透过窗帘递食物来支援你的猫。

english: If you want it, you'll need to prove you've got the Halloween spirit! That means wearing at least three pieces of Halloween-themed clothing!
translation: 如果你想要，你得证明你有万圣节精神！也就是说，至少要穿三件万圣节主题的服装！

english: If you want planks, your best best is heading to the lumberyard and talking to the sawmill operator. 79-->
translation: 如果你想要木板，最好去木材场找锯木厂操作员谈谈。79-->

english: If you want show me food den give me it. If you stuck, check notes u got.
translation: 如果你要给我食物就拿来。如果你卡住了，看看你拿到的笔记。

english: If you want that spooky pumpkin lantern, you'll need to prove you've got the Halloween spirit! That means wearing at least three pieces of Halloween-themed clothing!
translation: 如果你想要那个幽灵南瓜灯笼，你得证明你有万圣节精神！也就是说，至少要穿三件万圣节主题的服装！

english: If you want, you can keep on taking pumpkins from the bin and carve them. Better that than them going to waste, although bear in mind they won't keep long.
translation: 如果你愿意，你可以继续从桶里拿南瓜来雕刻。总比浪费了好，不过要记住它们放不久。

english: If you were in Falador castle, and wished to teleport to Varrock, then you could use this 'slow-teleport' technique to be in both places simultaneously, but invisible to anyone in either.
translation: 如果你在法拉多城堡，想传送到维洛克城，那么你可以用这种'慢速传送'技术同时出现在两个地方，但对两边的人来说你都隐形。

english: If you were on a members' world you would also receive these strange goblin decorations and unlock the Cosy cabin wallkit!
translation: 如果你在会员世界，你还会收到这些奇怪的哥布林装饰品，并解锁舒适小屋墙饰套装！

english: If you were to cheer up those same children, perhaps we could turn Anti-Santa's own army against him, he wouldn't stand a chance against all that Christmas cheer.
translation: 如果你能让那些孩子开心起来，也许我们就能让反圣诞老人自己的军队倒戈相向，他绝对抵挡不住那么多圣诞欢乐。

english: If you were to insert that, the rat might eat it, and you would gain nothing.
translation: 如果你把那东西放进去，老鼠可能会吃掉它，而你什么也得不到。

english: If you were to move them quickly enough, I'm sure they could churn through anything frozen.
translation: 如果你移动得够快，我相信它们能碾碎任何冻结的东西。

english: If you win, I'll buy an Easter egg for you.
translation: 如果你赢了，我就给你买个复活节彩蛋。

english: If you would just go look in the crypt, youll see what I'm trying to say.
translation: 你只要去墓穴里看看，就会明白我在说什么了。

english: If you'd like more Easter eggs, go up to my storeroom. It's still infested with the critters, but there are Easter eggs in there somewhere.
translation: 如果你想要更多复活节彩蛋，就去我的储藏室吧。那里虽然还是爬满了小虫子，但里面确实有些复活节彩蛋。

english: If you'll allow me to continue my friend...
translation: 如果你允许我继续说下去，我的朋友……

english: If you're a wizard, are you doing anything magical?
translation: 如果你是个魔法师，你在施展什么魔法吗？

english: If you're correct, I'll give you the treasure chest!
translation: 如果你答对了，我就把宝箱给你！

english: If you're going Trick-or-Treating, first you'll need a Treat cauldron to put your treats in...
translation: 如果你要去玩'不给糖就捣蛋'，首先你需要一个糖果埚来装你的糖果……

english: If you're here to offer us a hand during the festive rush, please talk to the cook in the kitchen!
translation: 如果你是来在节日高峰期帮我们一把的，请去厨房找厨师谈谈！

english: If your light source goes out down there you'll be in trouble! Are you sure you want to go in without a tinderbox?
translation: 如果你的光源在下面熄灭了，你就有麻烦了！你确定要在没有火绒盒的情况下进去吗？

english: Iffie angrily makes another pair of cat ears for you.
translation: 伊菲气呼呼地又给你做了一对猫耳。

english: Iffie gives you a look.
translation: 伊菲看了你一眼。

english: Iffie hands you a (rather ugly, but reversible) halloween jumper.
translation: 伊菲递给你一件（相当难看，但可双面穿的）万圣节毛衣。

english: Iffie hands you a pair of cat ears.
translation: 伊菲递给你一对猫耳。

english: Iffie hands you the saucepan. It looks like it would make a good hat.
translation: 伊菲把平底锅递给你。它看起来很适合当帽子。

english: Iffie said she would wait for me to climb the trees.
translation: 伊菲说她会等我爬树。

english: Iffie starts to work on the cat ears...
translation: 伊菲开始制作猫耳……

english: Iffie! ...I, I didn't know you felt that way!

translation: 圣诞老人选在圣诞节休息，不是很蠢吗？他为什么不能跟披头士一起去度暑假呢？

english: Isn't it just mulled wine?
translation: 这不就是热红酒吗？

english: Isn't it north of Falador? Just past Doric's hut?
translation: 那不是在法拉多城北边吗？就在多里克的小屋旁边？

english: Isn't that exactly what you wanted? You just mentioned your scissors were going blunt!
translation: 那不就是你想要的吗？你刚才还说你剪刀钝了！

translation: 小零食不就是给狗吃的吗？

english: Isn't the story the point of this Halloween treat?
translation: 这个万圣节款待的重点不就是故事吗？

translation: 难道没有厨房员工来做这些事吗？

english: Isn't this place built a bit out the way
translation: 这地方是不是建得有点偏僻了？

english: Isn't this whole thing a game?
translation: 这整件事不就是个游戏吗？

translation: 相信那些在荒野里闲逛的随机法师，是不是有点冒险？

english: It MUST have been Mary the maid.
translation: 一定是女仆玛丽干的。

english: It a shame My Arm can't do dat geomancy spell thing to check on crops. My Arm is meant to be protecting someone's herbs. Oh well, no matter.

english: It appears the creatures have moved locations, the symbol glows slightly as it locates their new positions.
translation: 看来那些生物转移了位置，符号在定位它们的新位置时微微发光。

english: It appears to be some sort of smelting mould. It's unnaturally cold to the touch, even in comparison to the rest of the cave.

english: It appears to be some sort of smelting mould. It's unnaturally cold to the touch, even in comparison to the rest of the cave. As you stand before it, you hear what sounds like a faint whisper, but it quickly fades.
translation: 这看起来像某种冶炼模具。摸起来异常冰冷，即使与洞穴的其他部分相比也是如此。当你站在它面前时，你听到像是微弱的低语声，但很快就消失了。

english: It be a fishin' contest, matey! What does it look like?
translation: 这是个钓鱼比赛，伙计！不然还能是什么？

english: It begins with some protesting monks in Varrock Square...
translation: 故事从维洛克城广场上一些抗议的僧侣开始……

english: It can ONLY be Donovan the handyman.
translation: 只能是勤杂工多诺万。

english: It can't just be about genetics, since my dad's beard is glorious. Do you have any ideas?
translation: 这不可能只是遗传的问题，因为我爸的胡子就很漂亮。你有什么想法吗？

english: It certainly is!
translation: 当然是的！

english: It certainly looks like you know the ins and outs of pumpkins.
translation: 看来你对南瓜的里里外外都很了解。

english: It could be poachers.
translation: 可能是偷猎者。

english: It could be something really sinister...
translation: 这可能是什么非常邪恶的东西……

english: It could well be. It is being looked into, but given the recent events at the Teomat, there are other matters that also require attention.
translation: 很有可能。正在调查中，但鉴于特奥马特修道院最近发生的事件，还有其他事情需要关注。

english: It destroyed their home. Perhaps they wish to destroy it in return.
translation: 它摧毁了他们的家园。也许他们想反过来摧毁它。

english: It did! It was a long shot but I'm so happy. They are happy and I know they're in a better place now.
translation: 确实如此！虽然希望渺茫，但我非常高兴。他们很开心，我知道他们现在在一个更好的地方了。

english: It did! The normal egg melted instantly and the ice cream filled egg didn't!
translation: 确实如此！普通的蛋瞬间就融化了，而装满冰淇淋的蛋没有！

english: It didn't work?! Well, I'll spook you next time!
translation: 没成功？！好吧，下次我再吓你！

english: It does indeed! Congratulations!
translation: 确实如此！恭喜！

english: It does, and of course not forgetting the grotto too. I'm going to visit Santa soon.
translation: 是的，当然也不能忘了洞穴。我很快就要去拜访圣诞老人了。

english: It does. I haven't known Rick for long but I can't let him down.
translation: 是的。我认识里克的时间不长，但我不能让他失望。

english: It doesn't look like my bowl is in the pile.
translation: 我的碗好像不在那堆东西里。

english: It doesn't look like you'll be able to get back through this pipe from the other side. Are you sure you want to enter?
translation: 看来你无法从另一边再通过这根管道回来了。你确定要进去吗？

english: It doesn't really matter
translation: 其实无所谓

english: It doesn't seem like a good idea to modify anything right now.
translation: 现在修改任何东西似乎都不是个好主意。

english: It doesn't seem worth getting the feather if Gnome Child isn't here too.
translation: 如果地精小孩不在这里，那拿羽毛似乎也不值得。

english: It doesn't take long for the potion to take effect, causing them to pass out.
translation: 药水很快就生效了，让他们昏了过去。

english: It dropped some kind of Chronicle for storing these teleport cards.
translation: 它掉了一种用来存放这些传送卡的编年史。

english: It feels a little clunky, want to try again?
translation: 感觉有点笨拙，想再试一次吗？

english: It grows on and on. I add colour, style and shape. Small talk is my song.
translation: 它不断生长。我添加色彩、风格和形状。闲聊就是我的歌。

english: It is I, Death, and I am here for the job.
translation: 是我，死神，我是来干活的。

english: It is a contractual matter, I'm sure that you understand.
translation: 这是合同上的事，我相信你明白。

english: It is bad! Very bad! We need to contain them!
translation: 情况很糟！非常糟！我们必须控制住它们！

english: It is calling your name. You've been waiting for a cat?
translation: 它在呼唤你的名字。你一直在等一只猫？

english: It is done. Consider this pain next time you uncork any bottle. Do not let me have to talk to you a third time.
translation: 完成了。下次你打开任何瓶子时，记住这份痛苦。别让我再跟你谈第三次。

english: It is done. Do not be so careless again, or I shall not be so forgiving.
translation: 完成了。别再这么粗心大意了，否则我不会再这么宽容了。

english: It is enough to say that I require guarantees for the near future.
translation: 我只想说，我需要近期的一些保证。

english: It is good to see you at this gathering, [player name]. I was very touched that the Duke invited me; maybe relations between our peoples will improve.
translation: 很高兴在这次聚会上见到你，[player name]。公爵邀请我，让我非常感动；也许我们两族之间的关系会有所改善。

english: It is indeed! What a coincidence!
translation: 确实如此！真巧！

english: It is indeed. So, here is a bucket for you to collect the camel milk in. Make sure you fill it up, we'll need a lot of ice cream.
translation: 确实如此。那么，给你一个桶去收集骆驼奶。一定要装满，我们需要很多冰淇淋。

english: It is low-maintenance. It springs back up after taking a helmet off. I saw my face in the mirror and felt so good! What do you think?
translation: 它很好打理。摘下头盔后它就会弹回来。我在镜子里看到自己的脸，感觉好极了！你觉得呢？

english: It is milady [player name] with whom I desire to speak, but she seems to be preoccupied.
translation: 我想和[player name]女士说话，但她似乎正忙着。

english: It is milord [player name] with whom I desire to speak, but he seems to be preoccupied.
translation: 我想和[player name]先生说话，但他似乎正忙着。

english: It is milord o[player name] with whom I desire to speak, but he seems to be preoccupied.
translation: 我想和[player name]先生说话，但他似乎正忙着。

english: It is nice to see everyone dressed up.
translation: 看到大家都盛装打扮，真不错。

english: It is no problem. I look forward to seeing you at the festival. I'll make sure to save you a gingerbread gnome!
translation: 没问题。我期待在节日上见到你。我会确保给你留一个姜饼地精！

english: It is not an eye at all, but some kind of disk made of wood. You take it from the head.
translation: 那根本不是眼睛，而是一种木制的圆盘。你把它从头上取了下来。

english: It is not an eye at all, but some kind of red coloured disk. You take it from the head.
translation: 那根本不是眼睛，而是一种红色的圆盘。你把它从头上取了下来。

english: It is not enough for me to read the words of our story; I must perform it. I must bring it to life, so that the children are completely immersed in the drama.
translation: 仅仅阅读我们故事的文字是不够的；我必须表演出来。我必须让它活起来，这样孩子们才能完全沉浸在戏剧中。

english: It is not too late Carol, you can still change things for the better.
translation: 还不算太晚，卡罗尔，你仍然可以让事情变得更好。

english: It is not your concern. Whilst in my domain you shall never be far from my gaze.
translation: 这不关你的事。在我的领域里，你永远逃不出我的视线。

english: It is ready! Would you like to try it on? If you could kneel for a second while I put this on you.
translation: 准备好了！你想试穿一下吗？你能不能跪一下，我帮你戴上。

english: It is recommended to have an Agility level of at least 60 before starting the Mourning's End Part II quest.
translation: 建议在开始'哀悼的终结 II'任务前，至少拥有60级敏捷。

english: It is so much more than that to me. It is my chance to shine, and to be admired. To be popular. To be the fun guy at the party. With your help I can be all that, and more.
translation: 对我来说远不止如此。这是我闪耀的机会，是被仰慕的机会。是受欢迎的机会。是成为派对上那个风趣的人的机会。有了你的帮助，我就能做到这一切，甚至更多。

english: It is too hot to take. You need something cold to pick it up with.
translation: 它太烫了，拿不了。你需要用冷的东西来捡起它。

english: It is well and truly locked tight.
translation: 它锁得严严实实的。

english: It is you that is deluded, mortal. Now, do you dare to ask me anything else?
translation: 被蒙蔽的是你，凡人。现在，你还敢问我别的吗？

english: It is you that is deluded, serf.
translation: 被蒙蔽的是你，贱民。

english: It is! Have you been to the grotto yet?
translation: 是的！你去过那个洞穴了吗？

english: It is, although there is one major problem.
translation: 是的，不过有一个大问题。

english: It is, isn't it? Still, I must admit, I'm keen to get out into the wider world. Coco and Torgan say it won't be long now until it's time for my Trial by Water.
translation: 是啊，不是吗？不过，我必须承认，我很想出去看看更广阔的世界。可可和托根说，离我接受'水之试炼'的时候不远了。

english: It is, isn't it? Who would have known that a small sunburst of colour could bring so much joy to Misthalin.
translation: 是啊，不是吗？谁能想到一小片绚丽的色彩能给米斯林带来这么多欢乐。

english: It just doesn't have the same... earthy flavour.
translation: 就是少了那种……泥土的香味。

english: It looks a bit battered, Iffie. I don't think he'd want it anymore.
translation: 它看起来有点破旧了，伊菲。我觉得他不会再想要了。

english: It looks as if something is buried here.
translation: 看起来这里埋着什么东西。

english: It looks as if something is buried here. You may need some tools to excavate further.
translation: 看起来这里埋着什么东西。你可能需要一些工具来进一步挖掘。

english: It looks as if this is where very difficult prisoners are sent as a punishment.
translation: 看来这里是用来惩罚非常难缠的囚犯的地方。

english: It looks as if this pool has dried up. A thick black sludge has replaced the sparkling pure water, and it smells like death. Maybe Gujuo knows what's happened.
translation: 看来这个水池已经干涸了。一层厚厚的黑色污泥取代了清澈纯净的水，闻起来像死亡的味道。也许古朱奥知道发生了什么。

english: It looks as though some poor unfortunate soul died here.
translation: 看起来某个可怜的灵魂死在了这里。

english: It looks dangerous, are you sure you wish to enter?
translation: 看起来很危险，你确定要进去吗？

english: It looks dark and narrow in there. It's probably best if you don't go in.
translation: 里面又黑又窄。你最好别进去。

english: It looks entirely burnt! Was there no time to make another one?
translation: 看起来完全烧焦了！难道没时间再做一个吗？

english: It looks exactly like the one in the Duke's room.
translation: 它看起来和公爵房间里的那个一模一样。

english: It looks like Grimgnash is almost asleep. You better think about the best way to finish this story!
translation: 看起来格里姆纳什快睡着了。你最好想想怎么最好地结束这个故事！

english: It looks like Neite would rather be alone right now.
translation: 看来奈特现在想一个人待着。

english: It looks like Pete has invited absolutely everyone he could think of!
translation: 看来皮特把他能想到的所有人都请来了！

english: It looks like a ghost?
translation: 看起来像个幽灵？

english: It looks like a pie?
translation: 看起来像个馅饼？

english: It looks like a smokey black gem of some sort...very creepy. Some magical force must have prevented it from being shattered when it hit the coffin.
translation: 看起来像某种冒烟的黑色宝石……非常瘆人。一定是某种魔法力量阻止了它撞到棺材时碎裂。

english: It looks like a spiders' nest of some kind...
translation: 它看起来像是某种蜘蛛巢……

english: It looks like a tree on a large rock with roots trailing down to the ground.
translation: 它看起来像一棵长在大岩石上的树，树根垂到地面。

english: It looks like a warning message to keep us away.
translation: 看起来像是一条警告信息，叫我们远离。

english: It looks like some rocks have fallen down and blocked the path! You will have to lead him round the long way!
translation: 看起来有些岩石掉下来堵住了路！你得带他绕远路！

english: It looks like that did the trick. Grimgnash is snoring loudly! You better grab the feather and get out before he wakes up again!
translation: 看来这招奏效了。格里姆纳什正在大声打鼾！你最好趁他再次醒来前抓起羽毛赶紧离开！

english: It looks like the Sinclair family crest but it is very dirty. You can barely make it out under all of the grime. It's certainly clear nobody's cleaned it recently.
translation: 看起来像是辛克莱尔家徽，但非常脏。在层层污垢下几乎辨认不出来。显然最近没人清理过它。

english: It looks like the hole in the front of this locked chest exactly the size of a numulite.
translation: 看起来这个锁着的箱子前面的孔正好是一枚货币石的大小。

english: It looks like there is a steep drop just after the fissure. It may be dangerous to try to climb down without any sort of support.
translation: 看起来裂缝后面就是陡峭的落差。没有任何支撑就爬下去可能会有危险。

english: It looks like there is enough in here for three bits of armour, which is exactly the amount we need.
translation: 看起来这里面的材料足够做三件盔甲，正好是我们需要的数量。

english: It looks like there might be a usable script in this bookcase, but you don't have enough space to take it.
translation: 看起来这个书架上可能有一本可用的手稿，但你没有足够的空间拿走它。

english: It looks like there's some sort of fabric caught on the plank, but it's too far away for you to reach.
translation: 看起来有某种织物卡在了木板上，但距离太远你够不着。

english: It looks like there's some sort of fabric caught on the plank. You might be able to reach it with your fishing rod...
translation: 看起来有某种织物卡在了木板上。也许你可以用鱼竿够到它……

english: It looks like you have items stored in your cargo hold. I must warn you that these will be lost if the boat is destroyed.
translation: 看起来你的货舱里存有物品。我必须警告你，如果船被摧毁，这些物品将会丢失。

english: It looks like you will need a Thieving level of 58 to climb over this wall without being seen.
translation: 看起来你需要58级偷窃才能在不被发现的情况下翻过这堵墙。

english: It looks like you've got things stored in your cargo hold, mate. Gotta warn you that these will be lost if the boat is destroyed.
translation: 伙计，看起来你的货舱里存了些东西。得提醒你，如果船被摧毁，这些都会丢失。

english: It looks like you've some ingredients that would be safe to mix together.
translation: 看起来你有一些可以安全混合在一起的原料。

english: It looks terrific! That all sounds great, but I'd have to check with Cecilia first.
translation: 看起来棒极了！听起来都很不错，但我得先跟塞西莉亚确认一下。

english: It looks too steep to go down by foot. Maybe I could find something to slide down with.
translation: 看起来太陡了，没法步行下去。也许我能找到什么东西滑下去。

english: It looks very sophisticated...
translation: 看起来非常精密……

english: It makes a heady brew. This must be what Gujuo was talking about. You certainly would need to be brave to drink this!

translation: 这是一个奇怪的机关，里面有一个土元素方块。

english: It's a strange mechanism with an elemental water block in it.
translation: 这是一个奇怪的机关，里面有一个水元素方块。

english: It's a surprise! You'll find out when you open it.
translation: 这是个惊喜！你打开就知道了。

english: It's a tight fit, but you manage to squeeze through the boards covering the window.
translation: 虽然很紧，但你设法挤过了封住窗户的木板。

english: It's a trap! Do you want to try and disarm it?
translation: 有陷阱！你想试着解除它吗？

english: It's a very nice picture. I'm sorry for your loss.
translation: 这张照片真好看。节哀顺变。

english: It's a very old beehive.
translation: 这是一个非常古老的蜂箱。

english: It's about as hard as staying within the lines when freezing a field.
translation: 这大概就跟在冰冻田地时保持在线条内一样难。

english: It's about time for the festival to open. I will be heading there shortly, I hope to see you there!
translation: 差不多到节日开幕的时间了。我马上就去那里，希望能在那里见到你！

english: It's actually really funny you should say that.
translation: 你这么说其实真的很有趣。

english: It's all in good fun! Perhaps you could find a way to turn their tricks against them?
translation: 都是为了好玩！也许你能找到办法，把他们的把戏反过来对付他们？

english: It's all part of the journey, isn't it? I wish I could get Strength levels carrying heavy items around.
translation: 这都是旅程的一部分，不是吗？我真希望背着沉重的东西到处走就能提升力量等级。

english: It's almost like it's fighting back...
translation: 感觉就像它在反击……

english: It's already a huge step forward. But for now, let's focus on you!
translation: 这已经是巨大的一步了。但现在，我们先专注于你吧！

english: It's alright, here you go.
translation: 没关系，给你。

english: It's alright, the special hot sauce you gave me had more than enough in it to make another one.
translation: 没关系，你给我的特制辣酱足够再做一瓶了。

english: It's always been my experience that pretty boys don't last long on the battlefield... spend more time worrying about the fight, and less about your looks if I were you.
translation: 根据我的经验，小白脸在战场上活不长……如果我是你，我会多花点心思在战斗上，少关心你的外表。

english: It's always nice to have a warm cup of tea, you know. Keeps the fingers nimble.
translation: 你知道，喝杯热茶总是好的。能让手指保持灵活。

english: It's an amulet worn by members of the Hazeel Cult.
translation: 这是哈兹尔邪教成员佩戴的护身符。

english: It's an ancient coffin with a strange rod fused to the top. The rod gives out a mixture of both mortal and divine energies and seems to be made out of a unique silver and mithril alloy.
translation: 这是一口古老的棺材，顶部融合了一根奇怪的棒子。这根棒子散发出凡间和神圣两种能量，似乎是由一种独特的银和秘银合金制成的。

english: It's an ancient furnace that hasn't been used in a long time. It looks like it might still work, but it needs refuelling with coal and lighting with a tinderbox.
translation: 这是一个很久没用过的古代熔炉。看起来还能用，但需要加煤并用火绒盒点燃。

english: It's an ancient icon filled with power. You might be able to use it to craft a powerful ring.
translation: 这是一个充满力量的古代圣物。你也许可以用它来制作一枚强大的戒指。

english: It's an ancient vestige filled with power. You might be able to combine it with something else.
translation: 这是一个充满力量的古代残片。你也许能把它和其他东西组合起来。

english: It's an icon from an old ring. With the help of a Fremennik, you might be able to combine it with something else.
translation: 这是一枚旧戒指上的图标。在弗瑞曼尼克的帮助下，你也许能把它和其他东西组合起来。

english: It's an interesting place.
translation: 是个有趣的地方。

english: It's an old chemical refinery. It still seems to be in working order.
translation: 这是一个旧的化学精炼厂。看起来还能用。

english: It's an old power grid. It's receiving power, but it is not aligned.
translation: 这是一个旧的电网。它正在接收电力，但未校准。

english: It's an old steam generator. There's some fuel already in it but it needs cranking up to start it. However, the crank is missing.
translation: 这是一个旧的蒸汽发生器。里面已经有一些燃料了，但需要摇动曲柄才能启动。不过，曲柄不见了。

english: It's another figure of spee- don't worry. Good luck, come back quick if you find some!
translation: 这又是一个修辞手——别担心。祝你好运，找到了就快点回来！

english: It's as if a spell has been cast on them to keep away unwanted visitors.
translation: 仿佛有咒语施加在它们身上，用来驱赶不速之客。

english: It's awfully cold this far north!
translation: 北方这里可真冷啊！

english: It's been a great little event, also I love the venue! I can't wait to bring the dog home, though!
translation: 这是个很棒的小活动，而且我喜欢这个场地！不过我已经等不及要把狗带回家了！

english: It's been a pleasure!
translation: 很高兴认识你！

english: It's beyond me!
translation: 这超出了我的能力范围！

english: It's cold
translation: 很冷

english: It's cold and warmer than last time
translation: 很冷，但比上次暖和

english: It's cold but colder than last time
translation: 很冷，而且比上次更冷

english: It's collecting treats and looking spooky while doing it!
translation: 就是在收集糖果的同时，还要把自己打扮得阴森恐怖！

english: It's coming to us!
translation: 它朝我们来了！

english: It's dead! You've saved Easter! Come back to my office - I've got a reward for you.
translation: 它死了！你拯救了复活节！回我的办公室来——我有奖励给你。

english: It's definitely a pie, but it is delicious!
translation: 这绝对是个派，但味道好极了！

english: It's done, all cleaned, no problems. I've got it here!
translation: 搞定了，全洗干净了，没问题。我拿来了！

english: It's done, he is trapped here. Time to head back to the surface.
translation: 搞定了，他被困在这里了。是时候回到地面了。

english: It's done... where's my reward.
translation: 搞定了……我的奖励呢？

english: It's exciting.
translation: 真令人兴奋。

english: It's exotic.
translation: 很有异域风情。

english: It's fine! It does bang into things, especially branches when climbing, but I just push through them.
translation: 没关系！它确实会撞到东西，尤其是爬树的时候会撞到树枝，但我直接硬闯过去就行了。

english: It's fine, I wasn't in a hurry anyway. Although I am curious to know why you are here in the first place? It's unusual to see you outside of Tirannwn.
translation: 没关系，反正我也不赶时间。不过我倒是很好奇，你一开始为什么会在这里？在提兰温之外的地方看到你，可真不寻常。

english: It's for the good of the Province!
translation: 这是为了行省的利益！

english: It's freezing
translation: 冷极了

english: It's freezing and warmer than last time
translation: 冷极了，但比上次暖和

english: It's freezing but colder than last time
translation: 冷极了，而且比上次更冷

english: It's full of jars for storing trapped souls, but all the souls have been eaten. You don't need any more jars.
translation: 里面装满了用来储存被困灵魂的罐子，但所有的灵魂都被吃掉了。你不再需要更多的罐子了。

english: It's full of jars for storing trapped souls, but all the souls have been eaten. You take some jars.
translation: 里面装满了用来储存被困灵魂的罐子，但所有的灵魂都被吃掉了。你拿了一些罐子。

english: It's funny you should say that...
translation: 你这么说真有意思……

english: It's going fine! It's right there on my to-do list.
translation: 进展顺利！它就在我的待办清单上。

english: It's going to be great!
translation: 一定会很棒的！

english: It's going well, thanks.
translation: 进展顺利，谢谢。

english: It's got the children trapped in the crypt. How do we get rid of it?
translation: 它把孩子们困在了墓穴里。我们怎么才能赶走它？

english: It's great, but I still need to do some activities.
translation: 很好，但我还需要做一些活动。

english: It's hard for an old codger like me to change. You know what they say about dogs and new tricks. But I love you. I know you can do anything you put your mind to.
translation: 像我这样的老家伙很难改变。你知道那句老话，老狗学不会新把戏。但我爱你。我知道你只要下定决心，就什么都能做到。

english: It's hard to explain in words... I suppose I could mime it?
translation: 很难用语言解释……我想我可以用哑剧来表演？

english: It's hardly the Rising Sun Inn, but I guess it will do.
translation: 虽然比不上朝阳客栈，但我想也凑合了。

english: It's honestly impressive. I've never seen decorations like these before. Where do you even find this stuff?
translation: 说实话，真让人印象深刻。我从没见过这样的装饰。你究竟是从哪儿找到这些东西的？

english: It's hot and warmer than last time
translation: 很热，而且比上次更热

english: It's hot but colder than last time
translation: 很热，但比上次凉快

english: It's in a crate in the bird's room, at the north end of my warren. I'll use the loudspeakers to give more instructions when you've found it.
translation: 在我洞穴北边那间鸟屋里，有个板条箱。等你找到了，我会用扩音器给你更多指示。

english: It's just a saying!
translation: 这只是个说法而已！

english: It's just as well otherwise we'd be in a lot of trouble for our little magical accidents.
translation: 幸好如此，不然我们那些小小的魔法意外可就要惹上大麻烦了。

english: It's just finding the right words... It's... hard.
translation: 只是找不到合适的词……这……很难。

english: It's like a very strong helmet! Keeps my head safe.
translation: 就像一顶非常坚固的头盔！能保护好我的脑袋。

english: It's me, [Player]!
translation: 是我，[Player]！

english: It's me, of whom many legends are sung.
translation: 是我，那个被无数传说歌颂的人。

english: It's meant to look like a stalagmite, but there's something unnatural about it. Looking carefully, you notice a strange carving on the rocky surface.
translation: 它看起来像一根石笋，但总感觉有些不对劲。仔细一看，你注意到岩石表面上刻着奇怪的图案。

english: It's much more tame when eaten, don't worry. Karim knows how to make them.
translation: 别担心，煮熟了吃就温顺多了。卡里姆知道怎么做。

english: It's my first time.
translation: 这是我第一次。

english: It's my wish-list, I've written down all the presents I would like from Santa!
translation: 这是我的愿望清单，我把所有想从圣诞老人那里得到的礼物都写下来了！

english: It's never nice when someone steals your kill. I can sympathize with that.
translation: 猎物被人抢走的感觉可不好受。我能理解。

english: It's nice of you to be helping my friends out so much.
translation: 你愿意这么帮助我的朋友们，真是太好了。

english: It's nice that summer's upon us at last.
translation: 夏天终于来了，真好。

english: It's no problem! I do have a slight problem myself though...
translation: 没问题！不过我自己倒是有个小麻烦……

english: It's no problem. Good luck with the last one!
translation: 没问题。祝你好运，搞定最后一个！

english: It's no problem. Now, would you like to browse my wares?
translation: 没问题。那么，你想看看我的货吗？

english: It's not a trick. If you don't believe me, I will show you. Let's start by getting you in the arena. Right this way! Unless you're scared?
translation: 这不是什么把戏。如果你不信，我可以证明给你看。先带你进竞技场吧。这边请！除非……你怕了？

english: It's not actually hot at all, it's nice and cool in here. Business secrets!
translation: 其实一点都不热，这里面又凉快又舒服。商业机密！

english: It's not entirely clear where it came from, but the worker hands you a cup of tea.
translation: 虽然不太清楚这茶是从哪儿来的，但工人还是递给了你一杯。

english: It's not for me...it's for a friend.
translation: 不是给我的……是给朋友的。

english: It's not from me, it's your secret Santa present! I don't know who it's from.
translation: 这不是我送的，是你的神秘圣诞老人礼物！我也不知道是谁送的。

english: It's not just a physical thing you can take away from someone.
translation: 这不仅仅是你能从别人身上夺走的某种有形之物。

english: It's not like I have much else to do.
translation: 反正我也没什么别的事可做。

english: It's not made of mud, it's not burned, and it is a good cake!
translation: 不是泥巴做的，也没烤焦，而且是一块好蛋糕！

english: It's not melted yet...
translation: 还没融化呢……

english: It's not often I get to leave Lumbridge, but when I do, I like to go a little wild.
translation: 我很少有机会离开仑桥镇，但只要一出来，我就想稍微放纵一下。

english: It's not quite ready yet. I need to find more ingredients.
translation: 还没完全准备好。我还需要找更多的材料。

english: It's not the kind of thing I normally drop into a casual conversation. We all have different paths to achieve our goals, and you might have been discouraged seeing mine.
translation: 这不是我平时会在闲聊里提起的事。我们每个人都有不同的路来实现目标，你看到我的路，可能会感到气馁。

english: It's not too bad, I promise. There's a wild goose over there. If you would kindly pet it for me?
translation: 我保证，没那么糟糕。那边有只野鹅。你能帮我摸摸它吗？

english: It's not very spooky. Try using at least 3 Halloween items.
translation: 这还不够吓人。试着至少用三件万圣节物品。

english: It's not your place to know everything [player name], best to leave the knowing to your elders.
translation: [player name]，有些事情不该你知道，最好还是让长辈们来操心吧。

english: It's ok, I was always going to pick you anyway. Death was very rude showing up like that.
translation: 没关系，反正我本来也打算选你。死神那样突然出现，真是太没礼貌了。

english: It's ok, I'll pretend I didn't hear that!
translation: 好吧，我就当没听见！

english: It's ok, because guess what I got from the grotto?
translation: 没关系，你猜我从洞穴里弄到了什么？

english: It's ok, we all have our sad stories.
translation: 没关系，我们都有自己的伤心往事。

english: It's okay, I'll go over myself. Enjoy the rest o' the event!
translation: 没关系，我自己过去。好好享受活动的其余部分吧！

english: It's okay, calm down. I was sent to find you. And what was that about a squirrel?
translation: 没事，冷静点。我是被派来找你的。还有，刚才说的松鼠是怎么回事？

english: It's okay. Elder Coco is showing me how to make a remembrance basket. We weave them specially and fill them with things that were important to the one who's gone.
translation: 没关系。长老可可正在教我怎么编织纪念篮子。我们会特别编织这些篮子，然后装满对逝者来说重要的东西。

english: It's on a table just over there, you should take it and give it a read.
translation: 就在那边的桌子上，你应该拿去读一读。

english: It's one of Duke Sucellus' many eyes. You might be able to combine it with something else.
translation: 这是苏塞勒斯公爵众多眼睛之一。你也许能把它和其他东西组合起来。

english: It's one of the hazards of ruling a country, [player name]. You'll get used to it.
translation: 这是统治国家的风险之一，[player name]。你会习惯的。

english: It's only time for the one and only...
translation: 现在是时候，只为那独一无二的……

english: It's our summer ritual. You'll have to ask Hotpheex.
translation: 这是我们夏天的仪式。你得去问霍特菲克斯。

english: It's overcast. I can't see anything
translation: 天阴了。我什么都看不见。

english: It's pretty busy, I should probably go talk to the Easter Bunny and get an egg first.
translation: 挺忙的，我可能应该先去跟复活节兔子谈谈，拿个蛋。

english: It's quiz time!
translation: 问答时间到！

english: It's right he-
translation: 它就在这——

english: It's sealed tightly shut.
translation: 它被紧紧地封住了。

english: It's so hot! My nose is on fire!
translation: 好烫！我的鼻子要着火了！

english: It's so terrible! A white knight can't have pink armour, they're not pink knights!
translation: 太糟糕了！白骑士怎么能穿粉红色的盔甲呢，他们又不是粉红骑士！

english: It's something we were planning on working on for Christmas, but apparently the kids didn't like them in the end.
translation: 这是我们原本打算为圣诞节准备的东西，但显然孩子们最后并不喜欢。

english: It's sort of like a big floating head, and it's making the dead walk around, and it told me that it is Fear.
translation: 它就像一个巨大的漂浮头颅，让死者四处走动，它告诉我，它就是恐惧。

english: It's sour yet satisfying!
translation: 酸酸的，但很满足！

english: It's spooky season! Halloween is here!
translation: 惊悚季节到了！万圣节来了！

english: It's strange, though. Doesn't seem like there's even anything in the pond...
translation: 不过，真奇怪。池塘里好像什么都没有……

english: It's terrible, the Easter Bunny's egg making machine and mixing machine have both ran out of fuel.
translation: 太糟糕了，复活节兔子的制蛋机和搅拌机都没燃料了。

english: It's the 9th birthday o' Gielinor. I be helpin' out with the birthday event!
translation: 今天是盖林诺的九岁生日。我正帮忙筹备生日活动呢！

english: It's the Dwarf entry to the Cake Off. It looks a lot more like a pie than anything. Perhaps it's an illusion cake.
translation: 这是矮人参加蛋糕大赛的作品。它看起来更像一个派。也许是个幻觉蛋糕。

english: It's the Gnome Child's entry to the Cake Off. It's not really a cake.
translation: 这是地精小孩参加蛋糕大赛的作品。这根本算不上蛋糕。

english: It's the Goblin entry to the Cake Off. It looks like it's made from chocolate. It probably isn't.
translation: 这是哥布林参加蛋糕大赛的作品。看起来像是巧克力做的。但很可能不是。

english: It's the biggest party in all of Gielinor [player name]! This one is our biggest yet, numero 4.
translation: [player name]，这是整个盖林诺最盛大的派对！这次是最大的一次，第四号！

english: It's the drains from the kitchen.
translation: 这是厨房的排水管。

english: It's the eggs, the chocolate eggs for Easter. They've been hatching. Now my warren's infested by demonic chocolate critters. They're terrifying!
translation: 是那些蛋，复活节的巧克力蛋。它们孵化了。现在我的洞穴里到处都是恶魔巧克力小怪物。太可怕了！

english: It's the evil chocolate chicken you see, it's destroyed everything.
translation: 你看，就是那只邪恶的巧克力鸡，它把一切都毁了。

english: It's the gublinch, ye see. The evil gublinch ain't too pleased, what with the recent snow. Right near their landlubbin' homes, it be. And these sweaty, smelly, warmth-loving critters, they's a tad sensitive to the cold.
translation: 你看，是那些哥布林林奇。邪恶的哥布林林奇对最近的雪很不高兴。雪就落在它们陆地上的家旁边。而这些汗津津、臭烘烘、喜欢温暖的家伙，对寒冷有点敏感。

english: It's the head of Vardorvis' axe. You might be able to combine it with something else.
translation: 这是瓦尔多维斯斧头的头部。你也许能把它和其他东西组合起来。

english: It's the jaw of a Basilisk Knight. It looks like it could be attached to a Helm of Neitiznot.
translation: 这是石化蜥蜴骑士的下颚。看起来可以装到奈提兹诺头盔上。

english: It's the jaw of a Basilisk Knight. Perhaps Olaf the Bard knows a good story about it.
translation: 这是石化蜥蜴骑士的下颚。也许吟游诗人奥拉夫知道一个关于它的好故事。

english: It's the lure of the Leviathan. You might be able to combine it with something else.
translation: 这是利维坦的诱饵。你也许能把它和其他东西组合起来。

english: It's the skull of the ghost that is haunting Lumbridge graveyard. Maybe I should return this back to the ghost's coffin.
translation: 这是游荡在仑桥镇墓地的那个幽灵的头骨。也许我应该把这个放回幽灵的棺材里。

english: It's the thought that counts.
translation: 心意最重要。

english: It's the time of giving anyway, and you're giving me the festive white wine in return, so it all balances out!
translation: 反正现在是送礼的季节，而你用节日白葡萄酒回报我，所以扯平了！

english: It's too big to fit in the vial.
translation: 它太大了，放不进小瓶里。

english: It's too dangerous for me out there while Anti-Santa is on the loose. The White Knights' are keeping me here until it's safe. At this rate, I'll miss Christmas altogether!
translation: 反圣诞老人还在逍遥法外，外面对我来说太危险了。白骑士们把我留在这里，直到安全为止。照这样下去，我整个圣诞节都要错过了！

english: It's too embarrassing, but let's just say I ruined a perfectly good table.
translation: 太尴尬了，总之就是我毁了一张好好的桌子。

english: It's too late - you're in big trouble now!

english: Junior Jim updates your log with details on his request. You can consult the log at any point for a reminder on what he needs you to do.
translation: 小吉姆在你的日志中更新了他请求的细节。你可以随时查阅日志，以提醒你需要为他做什么。

english: Juniper Trees.
translation: 杜松树。

english: Jus' tidyin' up.
translation: 只是收拾一下。

english: Just Easter Eggs?
translation: 只是复活节彩蛋？

english: Just South of town can my champion be found, tending cautiously to fertile ground.
translation: 就在镇南边能找到我的冠军，他正小心翼翼地照料着肥沃的土地。

english: Just a friend.
translation: 只是个朋友。

english: Just a plain stove. Nothing here.
translation: 只是个普通的炉灶。没什么特别的。

english: Just a second...
translation: 等一下……

english: Just a... banana? Nothing else?
translation: 只是……一根香蕉？没别的了？

english: Just an honourable mention? After all that work?
translation: 只是荣誉提名？做了那么多工作？

english: Just as I thought - this Master of theirs can't be trusted.
translation: 果然不出我所料——他们的这位主人不可信。

english: Just as food and drink passes through your bodies until it goes the way of all things, the six years have passed through your minds.
translation: 就像食物和饮料穿过你的身体，最终归于尘土一样，这六年也穿过了你的脑海。

english: Just ask around and see if someone has seen anything suspicious.
translation: 四处问问，看看有没有人看到什么可疑的东西。

english: Just because I lost the dance off, doesn't mean I cannot put this dagger to good use.
translation: 就算我输了舞斗，也不代表我不能好好利用这把匕首。

english: Just before you open the backpack, you notice a small leather patch with the moniker: 'B.Vahn', on it.
translation: 就在你打开背包之前，你注意到上面有一小块皮革补丁，上面写着名字：‘B.瓦恩’。

english: Just bring me 10 roots to show you've given it a go and I'll see what I can rustle up for you.
translation: 只要给我带10个树根，证明你试过了，我就看看能给你弄点什么来。

english: Just checking! What haven't you tried? Is there something I could find for you?
translation: 只是确认一下！你还没试过什么？有什么我能帮你找的吗？

english: Just enter the shed.
translation: 直接进棚屋。

english: Just hand us the scrolls you have and we'll update them for you.
translation: 把你有的卷轴交给我们，我们会帮你更新。

english: Just home teleport back to the castle?
translation: 直接传送回家到城堡？

english: Just hop into the hole right here and you'll find your way there.
translation: 直接跳进这个洞，你就能找到路去那里。

english: Just keep the costumes. You might need them for the contest!
translation: 服装就留着吧。比赛时你可能用得上！

english: Just like that? I don't need to complete a task for you?
translation: 就这样？我不需要为你完成任务吗？

english: Just mix the holly and cinnamon into the wine.
translation: 把冬青和肉桂混进酒里。

english: Just odd jobs, small favours, that kind of thing, at least until we have land to work on. They should be here before too long, if you wanted to check in with them before you go off adventuring again.
translation: 只是些零工、小忙之类的，至少在我们有地可种之前是这样。他们应该很快就到了，如果你想在再次出发冒险之前去看看他们的话。

english: Just one left now.
translation: 现在只剩一个了。

english: Just one per day, thanks.
translation: 每天一个，谢谢。

english: Just one quick taste...
translation: 就尝一小口……

english: Just order some more food from the bartender when you're ready. I'll be here.
translation: 准备好了就找酒保再点些吃的。我就在这儿。

english: Just order some pumpkin pie from the bartender over there.
translation: 找那边的酒保点些南瓜派就行。

english: Just outside the city, to the south-west, Dreven the bush patch gardener should be able to help us with a Farming memento.
translation: 就在城外西南边，灌木种植地的园丁德雷文应该能帮我们弄到一个农业纪念品。

english: Just relax, you have nowhere to be.
translation: 放松点，你哪儿也不用去。

english: Just remember, it's half full, not half empty!
translation: 记住，是半满，不是半空！

english: Just so you know, partner, I didn't steal anything.
translation: 跟你说清楚，搭档，我什么都没偷。

english: Just some pots, you see no sign of any paranormal activity.
translation: 只有一些罐子，你看不到任何超自然活动的迹象。

english: Just spread the word about my business! Tell all your friends how great it is.
translation: 帮我宣传一下我的生意吧！告诉你的朋友们这里有多棒。

english: Just squish it through the gaps in the wood. There is a small hole over here.
translation: 把它从木头的缝隙里挤过去。这边有个小洞。

english: Just talk to me when you're ready. I'll be here.
translation: 准备好了就跟我说话。我会一直在这儿。

english: Just the two?
translation: 就这两个？

english: Just use the hole I made to get to the surface - you can fit through that.
translation: 用我挖的洞爬到地面上去——你钻得过去的。

english: Just walk, Oziach isn't looking this way, but be quiet.
translation: 直接走，奥扎克没往这边看，但别出声。

english: Jute plants.
translation: 黄麻植物。

english: Kael shows you Ranis Drakan's medallion.
translation: 凯尔向你展示了拉尼斯.德拉坎的奖章。

english: Kaht B'alam gives you a key.
translation: 卡赫特.巴兰给了你一把钥匙。

english: Kalrag slumps to the floor...
translation: 卡尔拉格瘫倒在地……

english: Kandarin small boat.
translation: 坎达林王国小船。

english: Kanel and Philop are playing in the house, Wilough and Shilop are probably in Varrock Square.
translation: 卡内尔和菲洛普在屋里玩，威洛和希洛普大概在维洛克城广场。

english: Kanel overheard Wilough and Shilop talking about a colourful spade at dinner.
translation: 卡内尔吃晚饭时无意中听到威洛和希洛普在谈论一把彩色的铲子。

english: Kanel! I learnt how to write my name in alphabet number code today at school!
translation: 卡内尔！我今天在学校学会了用字母数字密码写自己的名字！

english: Kangai Mau has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 康盖.毛又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Kaqemeex gives you a Druidic wreath.
translation: 卡基米克斯给了你一个德鲁伊花环。

english: Kaqemeex gives you a Mask of Balance.
translation: 卡基米克斯给了你一个平衡面具。

english: Kaqemeex gives you a half full wine jug.
translation: 卡基米克斯给了你一个半满的葡萄酒。

english: Kaqemeex hands you another hood for your skillcape.
translation: 卡基米克斯递给你另一个技能斗篷兜帽。

english: Kaqemeex sent me. He and the druids are having trouble with their ritual. The altar isn't responding to their chants.
translation: 是卡基米克斯派我来的。他和德鲁伊们的仪式出了麻烦。祭坛对他们的吟唱没有反应。

english: Kaqemeex's business.
translation: 卡基米克斯的事。

english: Karambwan.
translation: 卡拉姆万。

english: Karamja Dungeon.
translation: 卡拉姆詹岛地牢。

english: Karamja Spirits Bar.
translation: 卡拉姆詹岛烈酒酒吧。

english: Kardia is busy talking to her cat.
translation: 卡迪亚正忙着跟她的猫说话。

english: Karim hands you the special super hot kebab.
translation: 卡里姆递给你特制超辣烤肉。

english: Karim is in his kebab shop just south-east of here.
translation: 卡里姆就在他东南边那家烤肉店里。

english: Karuulm dungeon pipe shortcut.
translation: 卡鲁尔姆地牢管道捷径。

english: Kasonde gives you an unfinished potion.
translation: 卡松德给了你一瓶未完成的药水。

english: Kasonde tries to give you an unfinished potion, but you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 卡松德想给你一瓶未完成的药水，但你的空间不够了。

english: Katrine gives you a master thief armband.
translation: 卡特琳给了你一个盗贼大师臂章。

english: Katrine groans.
translation: 卡特琳呻吟了一声。

english: Katrine spits.
translation: 卡特琳啐了一口。

english: Kauayotl departs for the temple.
translation: 考阿约特尔动身前往神庙。

english: Kauayotl sets up the dragon egg.
translation: 考阿约特尔安置好了龙蛋。

english: Kebabs, Emelio wants us to market them to the people of Varlamore. To help with this, Lelia at the Fortis Colosseum has arranged a slot for me to enter the Colosseum and advertise the Kebabs. I should speak to her when I'm ready to do so.
translation: 烤肉，埃梅利奥要我们把烤肉推销给瓦拉莫尔的居民。为了帮忙，福蒂斯竞技场的莱莉亚给我安排了一个进入竞技场宣传烤肉的机会。我准备好了就该去找她谈谈。

english: Kebabs, Emelio wants us to market them to the people of Varlamore. To help with this, he's asked me to take some to Lelia in the Fortis Colosseum.
translation: 烤肉，埃梅利奥要我们把烤肉推销给瓦拉莫尔的居民。为了帮忙，他让我带一些去福蒂斯竞技场给莱莉亚。

english: Keep at it and I'll start to believe him instead of you.
translation: 你再这样下去，我就要相信他而不是你了。

english: Keep at it! Follow the beacons on the ramps.
translation: 继续加油！跟着坡道上的信标走。

english: Keep it up, recruit!
translation: 保持下去，新兵！

english: Keep logs.
translation: 保留原木。

english: Keep out of my way, peasant! Can't you see the King and I are trying to have an intimate time?
translation: 别挡路，农民！没看见国王和我正要享受亲密时光吗？

english: Keep walking
translation: 继续走

english: Keep your chin up, things will come good.
translation: 打起精神来，一切都会好起来的。

english: Keepa Kettilon puts 1000gp into the tax bag.
translation: 基帕.凯蒂隆将1000金币放入税袋。

english: Keg (with 25 Construction).
translation: 酒桶（需要25级建筑）。

english: Keli shows you a small key on a strong looking chain.
translation: 凯莉给你看了一把挂在一根看起来很结实的链子上的小钥匙。

english: Kemo.
translation: 凯莫。

english: Kennith scrambles through the broken wall...
translation: 肯尼斯手脚并用地爬过破损的墙壁……

english: Ketla gives you the blackstone fragment.
translation: 凯特拉给了你黑石碎片。

english: Ketla shows you a fragment of strange black stone.
translation: 凯特拉给你看了一块奇怪的黑色石头碎片。

english: Key drops to ground with full inventory.
translation: 背包已满，钥匙掉到了地上。

english: Kharazi Jungle vine climb shortcut.
translation: 卡拉兹丛林藤蔓攀爬捷径。

english: Kharid-et (See Notes)
translation: 卡里德-埃特（见注释）

english: Kharid-et survived multiple enemy advances, but was eventually sealed and abandoned due to the high numbers of undead present there.
translation: 卡里德-埃特在多次敌军进攻中幸存，但最终因亡灵数量过多而被封印并废弃。

english: Kharidian Desert areas in this League.
translation: 本联赛中的卡里迪安沙漠区域。

english: Kharshai vanished from Senntisten early in the war during an investigation into his loyalties. Status unknown.
translation: 卡沙伊在战争初期因忠诚度调查而从森蒂斯滕失踪。下落不明。

english: Kharyrll was completely destroyed by Zamorakian forces.
translation: 卡里尔被萨莫拉克军队彻底摧毁。

english: Kick them?
translation: 踢它们？

english: Kids today, eh?
translation: 现在的孩子啊，是吧？

english: Kiko and then inspected his Bed to find some of the fur missing. Fox presumably took a sample to help him find the right replacement. I should speak to Wolf about this.
translation: 然后检查了基科的床，发现少了一些毛皮。狐狸大概拿走了样本，好帮他找到合适的替代品。我应该跟沃尔夫谈谈这件事。

english: Kiko and then inspected his Bed to find some of the fur missing. Fox presumably took a sample to help him find the right replacement. Wolf suggested I look for him near the Pyre Foxes on the way to the Locus Oasis, as he'll have likely stopped off there.
translation: 然后检查了基科的床，发现少了一些毛皮。狐狸大概拿走了样本，好帮他找到合适的替代品。沃尔夫建议我去往洛克斯绿洲路上的火狐附近找他，因为他很可能在那里停留过。

english: Kiko happily starts playing with the toy mouse.
translation: 基科开心地开始玩玩具老鼠。

english: Kill five Shades?
translation: 杀死五个阴魂？

english: Kill stuff
translation: 杀东西

english: Killing Tarn Razorlor has greatly improved your Slayer knowledge. You gain 5000 Slayer XP.
translation: 杀死塔恩.剃刀洛尔大大提升了你的杀戮知识。你获得了5000点杀戮经验值。

english: Killing dragons, saving the world, toy making ... all part of an adventurer's day.
translation: 屠龙、拯救世界、做玩具……都是冒险家的日常。

english: Kilron throws a rope ladder over the wall.
translation: 基尔隆把绳梯扔过墙头。

english: King Arthur gives you a feather.
translation: 亚瑟王给了你一根羽毛。

english: King Awowogei tucks into his roasted snake.
translation: 阿沃盖国王大口吃起了烤蛇。

english: King Bolrie is seen with his advisor, walking towards him.
translation: 看到博尔利国王和他的顾问一起向他走来。

english: King Narnode gives you a small crystal seed.
translation: 纳诺德国王给了你一颗小水晶种子。

english: King Narnode hands you a huge stack of gold coins and several diamonds!
translation: 纳诺德国王递给你一大叠金币和几颗钻石！

english: King Narnode hands you a replacement copy of the translation book.
translation: 纳诺德国王递给你一本替换用的翻译书。

english: King Narnode has sent me.
translation: 是纳诺德国王派我来的。

english: King Narnode reads the translated note.
translation: 纳诺德国王阅读了翻译后的笔记。

english: King Percival has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 珀西瓦尔国王又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: King Roald approaches the player and starts attacking.
translation: 罗尔德国王走近玩家并开始攻击。

english: King Roald leans his body forward as if something left his body.
translation: 罗尔德国王身体前倾，仿佛有什么东西离开了他的身体。

english: King Roald starts talking louder.
translation: 罗尔德国王开始提高音量说话。

english: King Roald winks at you.
translation: 罗尔德国王对你眨了眨眼。

english: King Sorvott hands you a document.
translation: 索沃特国王递给你一份文件。

english: King Sorvott hands you a sealed document.
translation: 索沃特国王递给你一份密封的文件。

english: Kiss me baby, one more time.
translation: 吻我吧宝贝，再来一次。

english: Kit is out there with theirs, but they will be back here shortly. With you, the cape has a chance to go around the world.
translation: 基特带着他们的出去了，但他们很快就会回来。有了你，这件斗篷就有机会环游世界了。

english: Kit's a great name too. I can't wait to hear the stories of Kit Breaker doing something heroic - just don't be too brave all of the time.
translation: 基特也是个好名字。我等不及要听基特.布雷克做英雄事迹的故事了——只是别总是那么勇敢。

english: Kit? That's a nice name!
translation: 基特？这名字真好听！

english: Klank tries to give you some gauntlets but you don't have enough room for them.
translation: 克兰克想给你一些护手，但你的空间不够了。

english: Knee-height, eyes as dark as the night, a large gaping mouth, four legs, skin peeling and covered in fleas!
translation: 齐膝高，眼睛像黑夜一样暗，一张大嘴张着，四条腿，皮肤剥落，满是跳蚤！

english: Knights need armour. I will have more chance to be taken seriously if I am wearing some. Before I decide to take drastic measures and buy my own, I want to check the 'little something' my mum sent me out with.
translation: 骑士需要盔甲。如果我穿上盔甲，被认真对待的机会就更大。在我决定采取激烈手段自己买一套之前，我想先看看我妈让我带出来的那点'小东西'。

english: Knowledge passed down can be misconstrued. How can anyone know the truth for sure? It's not like there are any of these Old Ones around for us to ask.
translation: 流传下来的知识可能会被曲解。谁能确定真相呢？又不像还有那些远古者可以让我们去问。

english: Koftik gives you a staff.
translation: 科夫蒂克给了你一根法杖。

english: Koftik gives you some cloth. It's coated in an oily substance.
translation: 科夫蒂克给了你一些布料。上面涂了一层油性物质。

english: Koftik tries to give you some cloth but you don't have room for it.
translation: 科夫蒂克想给你一些布料，但你的空间不够了。

english: Kolodion hands you an enchanted symbol.
translation: 科洛迪恩递给你一个魔法符印。

english: Kolodion takes the Demon's heart.
translation: 科洛迪恩拿走了恶魔之心。

english: Kolodion takes the Ent's remains.
translation: 科洛迪恩拿走了树精的遗骸。

english: Kolodion takes the Justiciar's remains.
translation: 科洛迪恩拿走了审判官的遗骸。

english: Kolodion takes your cape and imbues it with the power of the gods before handing it back.
translation: 科洛迪恩拿走你的斗篷，注入了神的力量，然后还给了你。

english: Koma
translation: 科马

english: Koschei. We named him 'The Deathless' because he is seemingly unkillable!
translation: 科斯切。我们叫他'不死者'，因为他似乎杀不死！

english: Kovac looks out to the tools around you.
translation: 科瓦克环视着你周围的工具。

english: Kovac ponders your question...
translation: 科瓦克思考着你的问题……

english: Kovac shrugs...
translation: 科瓦克耸了耸肩……

english: Kovac takes a long look at the grindstone...
translation: 科瓦克仔细端详着磨石……

english: Kovac takes a long look at the trip hammer...
translation: 科瓦克仔细端详着冲锤……

english: Kovac takes a look at what you've done...
translation: 科瓦克看了看你做的事……

english: Kovac will give you 1,600 Foundry Reputation for this.
translation: 科瓦克会为此给你1,600点铸造厂声望。

english: Kovac will give you 12 Foundry Reputation for this.
translation: 科瓦克会为此给你12点铸造厂声望。

english: Kragen stares at you in silence, in such a manner that says to you that it's probably best to end this conversation right now.
translation: 克拉根沉默地盯着你，那神情分明在告诉你，最好现在就结束这场对话。

english: Kree'Arra looks at you glaringly.
translation: 克里阿拉狠狠地瞪着你。

english: Kualt.
translation: 库尔特。

english: Kuli
translation: 库利

english: Kupus hands you a copy of the Cruciferous Codex.
translation: 库普斯递给你一本《十字花科植物图鉴》。

english: Kupus presents you with your very own Cabbage Picking skillcape!
translation: 库普斯送给你一件专属的卷心菜采摘技能披风！

english: Kupus sells you 12 cabbage runes.
translation: 库普斯卖给你12个卷心菜符文。

english: Kuradal hands you an old notebook.
translation: 库拉达尔递给你一本旧笔记本。

english: Kyatt.
translation: 凯亚特。

english: Lady Hefin departs for Lletya.
translation: 赫芬女士出发前往莱蒂亚村。

english: Lady Ithell departs for the Underground Pass.
translation: 伊瑟尔女士出发前往地下通道。

english: Lady Meilyr departs for Lletya.
translation: 梅利尔女士出发前往莱蒂亚村。

english: Lady Trahaearn departs for Lletya.
translation: 特拉哈恩女士出发前往莱蒂亚村。

english: Language!
translation: 注意言辞！

english: Lanthus takes your bracelet from you, granting you [number] charges for your next games of Castle Wars. You have [#] charges stored.
translation: 兰苏斯拿走了你的手镯，为你的下一场城堡战争游戏充能[number]次。你目前储存了[#]次充能。

english: Lanthus won't consider looking at Ava's devices until you've completed Animal Magnetism.
translation: 在你完成动物磁力任务之前，兰苏斯不会考虑查看艾娃的装置。

english: Larch Logs.
translation: 落叶松原木。

english: Large oven Oak bookcase Oak shaving stand

english: Lumbridge is one of the portals of this realm that are most easily accessed. When your deity of choice spares your life and intercepts your passing to a different plane, it's usually just easiest to attach you to one of the many teleport spells that carry passengers from Tutorial Island to Lumbridge castle, rather than starting again from scratch with a fresh spell of our own. Believe it or not, there's a fair bit of work involved being RuneScape's resident deity of destruction, and I don't have the time to invest in letting careless PKers carry on where they left off. Besides, the walk of shame from lumbridge back to varrock teaches them a lesson about being more cunning in future.
translation: 仑桥镇是这个领域最容易进入的传送门之一。当你选择的神祇饶你一命，阻止你前往另一个位面时，通常最简单的做法就是把你挂接到众多从教程岛传送乘客到仑桥城堡的传送法术之一，而不是从头开始施放我们自己的新法术。信不信由你，作为RuneScape常驻的毁灭之神，这活儿可不少，我可没时间让那些粗心的PK玩家从他们死掉的地方继续。再说了，从仑桥镇灰溜溜地走回维洛克城，也能给他们一个教训，让他们以后学聪明点。

translation: 俺觉得你想套取获胜秘诀！那可不行。

translation: 俺！俺可不怕什么幽灵。

translation: 俺？你确定吗？俺其实不是骑士，你知道吗？

translation: 俺？我是说，俺可以，但俺不太认识你。

english: Meanwhile, I will look forward to the day where you come home and I get to see the awesome person you've become.
translation: 与此同时，我期待着有一天你回家，让我看到你变成了多么了不起的人。

english: Meanwhile, in the Shaman's enclave...
translation: 与此同时，在萨满的领地……

translation: 在拉里的船那儿见我。

translation: 迈尔迪奇实验室（需要78级采矿）。

english: Meliora cogito. (I strive for the best.)
translation: Meliora cogito.（我追求卓越。）

english: Memento of training Prayer? I suppose it's mostly about burying bones, so... um... yes, you can take these bones I've got. That'll save me writing another funeral sermon.
translation: 训练祈祷的纪念品？我想主要是埋骨头吧，所以……嗯……是的，你可以拿走我这些骨头。这样我省得再写一篇葬礼布道词了。

english: Meow!No special dialogue with catspeak amulet equipped
translation: 喵！装备猫语护符时没有特殊对话

english: Mercenaries dealt with, I gave Idria an update on my recent discoveries. She then departed for the White Knights' Castle in Falador. I should meet up with her and Thaerisk there.
translation: 处理完佣兵后，我向伊德莉亚汇报了最近的发现。然后她出发前往法拉多城的白骑士城堡。我应该在那边与她和赛里斯克会合。

english: Merci, I shall pass it to Monsieur Jacques tout de suite. Here is ze cracker as promised.
translation: 谢谢，我马上把它交给雅克先生。这是答应给你的拉炮。

english: Mercifully, it looks like the form is finished.
translation: 谢天谢地，表格看起来填完了。

english: Mere mortals do not have the powers of magic running through their blood like I do, so have to store charges made elsewhere upon them, bound into runestones, to release the power at will. Frankly, you're lucky you even have magic, I can hardly think of any races less deserving of access to the kind of magical powers I possess than your own. There are a few exceptions, such as Iban or Invrigar, but on the whole mages waste their talents on foolish pursuits like making money or heating ores. There is also a slight degree of strain upon the minds of those who use the magical powers of the gods but that are not naturally adept at channeling that kind of power. You only have to look at the once promising Melzar to see this for yourself...
translation: 凡人的血液里可不像我这样流淌着魔法力量，所以他们必须把从别处充能的魔力储存起来，绑定在符文石上，才能随意释放。坦白说，你能拥有魔法就已经很幸运了，我实在想不出有哪个种族比你更不配拥有我这种魔法力量。当然也有少数例外，比如伊班或因夫里加，但总的来说，法师们把天赋浪费在赚钱或加热矿石这种愚蠢的追求上。那些使用神祇魔法力量却天生不擅长引导这种力量的人，精神上也会承受一定压力。你只要看看曾经前途无量的梅尔扎就知道了……

english: Merlin disappears.
translation: 梅林消失了。

english: Merlin says...
translation: 梅林说……

english: Merry Christmas Santa!
translation: 圣诞快乐，圣诞老人！

english: Merry Christmas to you both, I hope you have a fun time at the grotto later!
translation: 祝你们俩圣诞快乐，希望你们待会在洞穴玩得开心！

english: Merry Christmas to you too Cecilia!
translation: 也祝你圣诞快乐，塞西莉亚！

english: Merry Christmas to you too!
translation: 也祝你圣诞快乐！

english: Message 1
translation: 消息1

english: Metzli teleports the Emissaries away.
translation: 梅茨利将使者们传送走了。

english: Metzli was able to flee deeper into the Ruins. Itzla and I followed her and found her in an Emtpy Chamber. Having completely searched the Ruins, Metzli came to the conclusion they were empty and accepted defeat. However, beforee we could do anything with her, Furia arrived and killed her. Itzla then took Furia back to the surface, but I decided to stay behind and look around some more. I should see if I can find out why the Ruins are empty.
translation: 梅茨利逃到了废墟深处。伊茨拉和我跟着她，在一个空密室里找到了她。彻底搜查废墟后，梅茨利断定废墟是空的，于是认输了。然而，我们还没来得及对她做什么，富里亚就来了，杀了她。然后伊茨拉把富里亚带回地面，但我决定留下来再四处看看。我应该看看能不能找出废墟空无一人的原因。

english: Metzli's Chamber and found a Message that might be of use. A Guard found me and took the Message from me, but I was able to defeat him and get it back. The Message revealed the locatino of a Cultist Safe House is Civitas illa Fortis. I should return to Queen Zyanyi and let her know about this.
translation: 梅茨利的密室，发现了一条可能有用的消息。一名守卫发现了我，抢走了消息，但我击败了他，夺了回来。消息显示邪教徒安全屋的位置在福蒂斯城。我应该回到齐扬伊女王那里，告诉她这件事。

english: Mighty treasures!
translation: 强大的宝藏！

english: Mihi ignosce. Cum homine de cane debeo congredi. (Excuse me. I've got to meet up with a man about a dog.)
translation: Mihi ignosce. Cum homine de cane debeo congredi.（抱歉。我得去见个人，谈点事。）

english: Milk in inventory
translation: 背包里有牛奶

english: Mind Runes from each Essence.
translation: 每个精华产出意念符文。

english: Mine senses oft draw me to Taverley, for it hath a tranquil beauty in the way it absorbed nature as part of itself, rather than forcing the natural world out of it as other cities such as Falador hath done.
translation: 我的感官常常将我引向塔韦利村，因为它有一种宁静的美，将自然融入自身，而不是像法拉多城等其他城市那样将自然排斥在外。

english: Mining Tutor south of Lumbridge.
translation: 仑桥镇南边的采矿导师。

english: Missing Deliveries sorted, Emelio and I needed to perfect the recipe for the Kebabs. We did this with the help of a selection of 'Connoisseurs'. I should see what Emelio needs now.
translation: 处理完丢失的送货后，埃梅利奥和我需要完善烤肉的食谱。我们在一群‘鉴赏家’的帮助下做到了。我应该看看埃梅利奥现在需要什么。

english: Missing Deliveries sorted, Emelio now needs me to help perfect the recipe for the Kebabs. He's gathered a selection of 'Connoisseurs' to help with this. I'll need to get their opinions on the right ratio of Ingredients to create the perfect Kebab.
translation: 处理完丢失的送货后，埃梅利奥现在需要我帮忙完善烤肉的食谱。他召集了一群‘鉴赏家’来帮忙。我需要征求他们对正确配料比例的意见，以制作出完美的烤肉。

english: Missing People and found a Couple who seemed distressed at the mention of them. However, they refused to tell me anything. I should keep asking around and see what I can learn.
translation: 失踪的人，发现一对夫妇，一提到他们就显得很痛苦。然而，他们什么也不肯告诉我。我应该继续四处打听，看看能了解到什么。

english: Missing People and found a Couple who seemed distressed at the mention of them. I should see what I can learn from them.
translation: 失踪的人，发现一对夫妇，一提到他们就显得很痛苦。我应该看看能从他们那里了解到什么。

translation: 纯符文精华产出迷雾符文。

translation: 女主人，我已取回您吩咐的物品。见您行囊已满，我会带着这 [number] 件物品等候，直到您准备好。

translation: 秘银鸢盾。

translation: 秘银飞刀。

translation: 秘银双手剑。

translation: 你说混合冰淇淋？嗯……我确实有一些钢弯刀，没能磨到我通常的锋利标准。

english: Mixed hide body.
translation: 混合皮甲。

translation: 将1瓶血瓶与200个血符文的能量混合倒入这口井中，每组将增加100次充能。

english: Mizaru grabs the banana surprisingly quickly for a blind monkey.
translation: 观猴以惊人的速度抓住了香蕉，对于一只盲猴来说。

english: Mizaru is singing.
translation: 观猴在唱歌。

english: Mizaru snatches the nuts from your grasp in an eye blink.
translation: 观猴一眨眼就从你手中抢走了坚果。

english: Mizaru tries to snatch the nuts from your grip. You slap his wrists.
translation: 观猴试图从你手中抢走坚果。你打了它的手腕。

english: Mmm, turkey!
translation: 嗯，火鸡！

english: Mmmfmfmm! No? Just the tasty ones. Look, they're my favourite and I don't get to eat them very often.
translation: 嗯嗯嗯！不？只是那些好吃的。你看，它们是我的最爱，我不常吃到。

english: Mmmm, hmm, that went down well.
translation: 嗯嗯，嗯，这味道不错。

english: Mo gives you the item he found beneath Lumbridge.
translation: 莫把他埋在仑桥镇地下的东西给了你。

translation: 莫匆匆忙忙地朝维洛克城走去。

english: Mo shows you what he found deep within the Lumbridge Caves.
translation: 莫向你展示他在仑桥镇洞穴深处发现的东西。

translation: 莫尔奇聚落岛（需要35级猎人）。

translation: 莫尔奇聚落岛（需要43级钓鱼）。
