translation: 钱对商业巨魔来说就是一切。如果卡罗尔不改变会怎样？

english: Monkey Food Stalls!
translation: 猴子食品摊！

english: Monsieur Jacques? You do not know Monsieur Cracker Jacques? How strange, I thought you did.
translation: 雅克先生？你不知道拉炮雅克先生？真奇怪，我以为你知道。

english: Months! We'll never have them grown in time!
translation: 好几个月！我们根本来不及种好它们！

english: Moonlight moths (barehanded).
translation: 月光飞蛾（徒手）。

english: Moons of Peril, allowing Eyatlalli to complete the ritual. I should now return to her and the others.
translation: 灾厄之月，让埃亚特拉利完成了仪式。我现在应该回到她和其他人那里。

english: Mooooooo!
More Trick-or-Treaters, woohoo!
translation: 更多不给糖就捣蛋的人，呜呼！

english: More carrots, I must be on the right track.
translation: 更多胡萝卜，我肯定走对路了。

english: More of these creatures are bound to turn up!
translation: 肯定还会有更多这种生物出现！

english: More than that, do you understand what this League actually is? Where we are?
translation: 不止如此，你明白这个联盟到底是什么吗？我们又在什么地方？

english: Morgan Le Faye vanishes.
translation: 摩根.勒菲消失了。

english: Mori gives you a Dark Nullifier.
translation: 莫里给了你一个信号阻挡器。

english: Morning! Your place looks incredible! The cobwebs, the pumpkin... and is that a moving chair?
translation: 早上好！你这里看起来太棒了！蜘蛛网、南瓜……还有那是会动的椅子吗？

english: Mortal fool? I'm the one who's going to defeat you once and for all!
translation: 凡人的傻瓜？我才是那个要彻底打败你的人！

english: Mortals, only death awaits you here...
translation: 凡人，这里只有死亡在等着你们……

english: Mosol gives you a Wampum belt.
translation: 莫索尔给了你一条贝壳串珠腰带。

english: Mosol looks at you and shakes his head in bewilderment.
translation: 莫索尔看着你，困惑地摇了摇头。

english: Mosol lowers his head in deep concentration.
translation: 莫索尔低下头，陷入沉思。

english: Mosol seems to be looking around very cautiously. He jumps a little when you approach and talk to him.
translation: 莫索尔似乎非常警惕地环顾四周。当你走近和他说话时，他吓了一跳。

english: Mosol strains to remember something...
translation: 莫索尔努力回忆着什么……

english: Most comings and goings to the desert pass past him, so he's likely to have an idea!
translation: 大多数进出沙漠的人都经过他身边，所以他很可能知道点什么！

english: Mouldy sawdust? I already have some with me. Maybe I could cook it somewhere.
translation: 发霉锯末？我身上已经有一些了。也许我可以在某个地方煮一下。

english: Movario in the Lumbridge Swamp Caves. By disguising myself as the Dark Squall, I managed to convince him that I was there to help him find the Stone of Jas. Movario believes the Stone to be at the bottom of a Large Chasm, but he hasn't been able to find a way down. I suggested we use one of the nearby Light Creatures. When I'm ready, I should use a Sapphire Lantern to attract one.
translation: 莫瓦里奥在仑桥镇沼泽洞穴里。通过伪装成黑风暴，我成功说服他我是来帮他找贾斯之石的。莫瓦里奥相信石头在一个大深渊的底部，但他一直找不到下去的路。我建议我们用附近的一只光之生物。等我准备好了，我应该用蓝宝石灯笼来吸引一只。

english: Movario, I was able to reach the bottom of a Large Chasm by attracting a Light Creature with a Sapphire Lantern. I searched the area and managed to open a tunnel into an Ancient Temple. I should explore this Temple.
translation: 莫瓦里奥，我用蓝宝石灯笼吸引了一只光之生物，到达了一个大深渊的底部。我搜索了该区域，并设法打开了一条通往古庙的隧道。我应该探索这座庙宇。

english: Movario, I was able to reach the bottom of a Large Chasm by attracting a Light Creature with a Sapphire Lantern. I should explore the area and see what I can find.
translation: 莫瓦里奥，我用蓝宝石灯笼吸引了一只光之生物，到达了一个大深渊的底部。我应该探索这个区域，看看能找到什么。

english: Move all available items from your cargo hold to your bank?
translation: 将货舱中所有可用物品移至银行？

english: Move deeper into the mines?
translation: 深入矿井？

english: Mr Onion, henceforth known as Dom, cannot be held liable for accidental loss of limbs (yours or otherwise) and or psychological damage as a result of entering the Nightmare Zone. Please note there is a strict no-refunds policy, and all dream purchases are final.
translation: 洋葱先生，此后称为多姆，对因进入噩梦地带而导致的意外肢体损失（无论是否属于你）和/或心理伤害概不负责。请注意，严格执行不退款政策，所有梦境购买均为最终决定。

english: Much huffing and panting later...
translation: 气喘吁吁了好一阵子之后……

english: Much of the mural is beyond your understanding, but you recognise a Mahjarrat facing off against a Pharaoh Queen.
translation: 壁画的大部分内容超出了你的理解，但你认出了一位玛哈加特正与一位法老女王对峙。

english: Much of the mural is beyond your understanding, but you recognise a Pharaoh Queen placing a heart into a canopic jar.
translation: 壁画的大部分内容你无法理解，但你认出一位法老女王正将一颗心脏放入卡诺皮克罐中。

english: Much of the mural is beyond your understanding, but you recognise a Pharaoh Queen preparing a canopic jar. A diagram seems to show the jar being filled with three dwellberries and a ring of life.
translation: 壁画的大部分内容你无法理解，但你认出一位法老女王正在准备一个卡诺皮克罐。一张示意图似乎显示罐子里装了三颗德维尔莓和一枚生命戒指。

english: Much of this 'destruction' you speak of is merely the effects of time upon such an ancient and noble city as Falador. Often, large bustling cities need continuous repair work just to keep them from descending any further into decay, and as building methods improve, often labourers are called in to provide a degree of refurbishment.
translation: 你所说的这些‘破坏’，很大程度上不过是时间对法拉多城这样古老而高贵的城市造成的影响。通常，繁华的大城市需要持续的修缮工作才能防止其进一步衰败，而且随着建筑方法的改进，也常常会召集工匠来进行一定程度的翻新。

english: Mud Runes from Pure Rune Essence.
translation: 用纯净符文精华制作泥符文。

english: Mudskipper Point. WARNING! BEWARE OF THE MUDSKIPPERS!
translation: 弹涂鱼角。警告！小心弹涂鱼！

english: Mummy, Daddy these eggs are so good!
translation: 妈咪，爹地，这些蛋太好吃了！

english: Mummy, mummy! I'd love an egg mummy!
translation: 妈咪，妈咪！我想要一个蛋木乃伊！

english: Murcaily has given you a hardy gout tuber.
translation: 穆凯利给了你一个耐寒的痛风草茎。

english: Murcaily has given you lots more hardy gout tubers.
translation: 穆凯利给了你更多耐寒的痛风草茎。

english: Murng bats.
translation: 穆尔格蝙蝠。

english: Murphy has given you his old sextant.
translation: 墨菲把他的旧六分仪给了你。

english: Museum and found evidence that the Diadem had been stolen by a Professional Thief. I asked around and someone mentioned they saw a Suspicious-Looking Person leaving the Museum before heading to the nearby Quetzal Landing Site. I should investigate this.
translation: 博物馆并发现证据表明王冠被一名职业盗贼偷走了。我四处打听，有人提到他们看到一个形迹可疑的人离开博物馆，然后前往附近的绿咬鹃着陆点。我应该去调查一下。

english: Museum and found evidence that the Diadem had been stolen by a Professional Thief. I should ask around and see if anyone saw anything suspicious.
translation: 博物馆并发现证据表明王冠被一名职业盗贼偷走了。我应该四处问问，看有没有人看到什么可疑的事情。

english: Mushroom Wellington
translation: 蘑菇威灵顿

english: Must be kept in the inventory to function. 3x rewards from Wintertodt, 3x points from Tempoross and Guardians of the Rift. Clue scrolls dropped are stackable. Resources gathered from Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting and Farming are banked automatically.
translation: 必须放在背包中才能生效。来自冬将军的奖励三倍，来自海灵和裂隙守护者的点数三倍。掉落的线索卷轴可堆叠。从采矿、钓鱼、伐木和农业中收集的资源会自动存入银行。

english: Must be kept in the inventory to function. 5 marks of grace appear instead of 1. Any shortcut can be used regardless of agility level requirements, although item requirements are still needed. Automatically re-pickpocket NPCs until you're unable to.
translation: 必须放在背包中才能生效。每次出现5个恩惠印记而非1个。无论敏捷等级要求如何，任何捷径都可使用，但物品要求仍然需要。自动重复扒窃NPC直到无法继续。

english: Must be kept in the inventory to function. Clue scrolls are dropped 3x more often. Resources gathered from Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting and Farming are 3x. Gather 3x Chinchompas per successful capture. When Runecrafting, gain 5x as many runes as usual.
translation: 必须放在背包中才能生效。线索卷轴掉落频率提高三倍。从采矿、钓鱼、伐木和农业中收集的资源数量三倍。每次成功捕捉获得三倍数量的金丝雀。进行符文制作时，获得通常五倍数量的符文。

english: Must be kept in the inventory to function. Clue scrolls dropped are stackable. Resources gathered from Mining, Fishing, Woodcutting and Farming are banked automatically. Points from the following places are tripled: Barbarian Assault, Pest Control, Chompy Bird Hunting, Mage Training Arena, Motherlode Mine,
translation: 必须放在背包中才能生效。掉落的线索卷轴可堆叠。从采矿、钓鱼、伐木和农业获得的资源会自动存入银行。以下地点的点数三倍计算：野蛮人突袭、虫害治理、食人鸟狩猎、魔法师训练场、母矿脉矿洞，

english: Must be kept in the inventory to function. Max hits of thralls are multiplied by 5. 50% more accuracy in all styles against monsters. 25% damage reduced from monsters.
translation: 必须放在背包中才能生效。仆从的最大伤害乘以5。对所有风格的怪物命中率提高50%。来自怪物的伤害减少25%。

english: My Arm has eaten the goutweedy lump.
translation: “我的手臂”吃掉了痛风草块。

english: My Arm is a good farmer now, so want to see what can be made with stuff from farms.
translation: “我的手臂”现在是个好农夫了，所以想看看能用农场里的东西做出什么。

english: My Arm is thinking...
translation: “我的手臂”正在思考……

english: My Arm leads you through the Troll Stronghold...
translation: “我的手臂”带你穿过巨魔要塞……

english: My Arm not stupid. My Arm knows what is going on. Next thing you show me will be your entry!
translation: “我的手臂”不傻。“我的手臂”知道发生了什么。你接下来给我看的东西就是你的入场券！

english: My Arm tells you a secret about herbs.
translation: “我的手臂”告诉你一个关于草药的秘密。

english: My Arm will let Hassan know human won cookout.
translation: “我的手臂”会让哈桑知道人类赢了野餐会。

english: My Arm wouldn't have come if they said there'd be a dwarf at the party. Dwarf not my mate.
translation: 如果他们说派对上会有矮人，“我的手臂”就不会来了。矮人不是我的哥们。

english: My Christmas dinner!
translation: 我的圣诞晚餐！

english: My Family and Other Zombies
translation: 我的家人和其他僵尸

english: My Herblore knowledge isn't good enough to understand what they mean...
translation: 我的草药学知识不足以理解他们的意思……

english: My affairs are concentrated mostly on Rellekka, so my knowledge is not great, but I will happily share what I do know with you [player name].
translation: 我的事务主要集中在雷勒卡城，所以知识有限，但我很乐意与你分享我所知道的一切，[player name]。

english: My apologies [player name], but I will need you to bring me 1 piece of dark dagger-mouth hide, 1 skull piece and 5,000 coins before I can make this helm for you.
translation: 抱歉，[player name]，但在为你制作这顶头盔之前，我需要你带来1块黑暗匕首嘴皮、1块头骨碎片和5000金币。

english: My apologies brother [player name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉了，[player name]兄弟！我没时间在这里陪你闲聊！

english: My apologies sister [player name]! I have not time to tarry here with you!
translation: 抱歉了，[player name]姐妹！我没时间在这里陪你闲聊！

english: My appearance in this manifestation is merely a shape, and my reanimation of those skeletons is just a party trick, but my voice whispers in the minds of all living creatures.
translation: 我在此形态中的外表只是一个形状，我复活那些骷髅也只是个小把戏，但我的声音在所有生灵的脑海中低语。

english: My arrow's magic won't work here gah! He'll have to go without this year.
translation: 我的箭矢魔法在这里不起作用，啊！他今年只能将就了。

english: My assistant Milkee is in the cavern, he should be able to help you make eggs.
translation: 我的助理米尔基在洞穴里，他应该能帮你做蛋。

english: My beliefs are in accord with the teachings of Guthix.
translation: 我的信仰与古斯的教义一致。

english: My brother said you were going to give us each an Easter egg.
translation: 我哥哥说你会给我们每人一个复活节彩蛋。

english: My chocolatey powers make me the ideal agent to attack the Easter Bunny's chocolate eggs.
translation: 我的巧克力力量使我成为攻击复活节兔子巧克力蛋的理想特工。

english: My chosen, back from the fray. Welcome.
translation: 我的选民，从战斗中归来了。欢迎。

english: My cows outside my house need entertaining, maybe with an emote? If they approve, I'll give you a Halloween Scarecrow.
translation: 我家外面的牛需要娱乐，也许可以用一个表情动作？如果它们满意，我就给你一个万圣节稻草人。

english: My dad sells clothes in the Gnome Stronghold. The kit I'm selling isn't from Dad's stock, though. I got it from some dwarves. It's far more suitable for the beach.
translation: 我爸爸在地精要塞卖衣服。不过，我卖的这套装备不是爸爸的库存。我是从一些矮人那里弄来的。它更适合海滩。

english: My dad was trying to invent a time travel portal, so he could go into the past and meet mighty demons of the Third Age like Thammaron, and maybe control them.
translation: 我爸爸试图发明一个时间旅行传送门，这样他就可以回到过去，遇见像萨马隆这样的第三纪强大恶魔，也许还能控制它们。

english: My dad's never going to believe it when I make this happen!
translation: 当我实现这个的时候，我爸爸绝对不会相信！

english: My dad's old sword and shield! He definitely did not let me touch that before! Give me a second.
translation: 我爸爸的旧剑和盾牌！他以前绝对不让我碰那个！等我一下。

english: My dear [boy/girl], how do you think we did it?
translation: 我亲爱的[boy/girl]，你觉得我们是怎么做到的？

english: My dear son. I know it's been hard for me to express my feelings. We've not always seen eye to eye and I'm the first to admit I've not always been the most understanding.
translation: 我亲爱的儿子。我知道我一直很难表达我的感情。我们并不总是意见一致，我第一个承认我并不总是最善解人意的。

english: My dear squire, while very loyal and dedicated, is quite accident-prone!
translation: 我亲爱的侍从，虽然非常忠诚和敬业，但很容易出事故！

english: My door is always open should you ever need my help [player name].
translation: 我的大门永远为你敞开，[player name]，只要你需要帮助。

english: My egg is freshly hard boiled. The heat shrinks your low quality silk to powder.
translation: 我的蛋是刚煮熟的。热量会把你的劣质丝绸缩成粉末。

english: My egg is hard boiled and will smash your egg into pieces.
translation: 我的蛋是煮熟的，会把你的蛋砸得粉碎。

english: My eggs and I are going to spread the Easter cheer to the fine city of Varrock.
translation: 我和我的蛋们要把复活节的欢乐传播到美丽的维洛克城。

english: My favourite thing to grow is tomatoes, but sadly they didn't quite fit the bill for what I was trying to achieve.
translation: 我最喜欢种的是西红柿，但可惜它们不太符合我想要达到的目标。

english: My first assignment?
translation: 我的第一个任务？

english: My first is in fish, but not in the sea. My second in birds, but not in the sea. My third is in mountains, but not underground. My last is everything, but not at all.
translation: 我的第一个在鱼里，但不在海里。我的第二个在鸟里，但不在海里。我的第三个在山里，但不在地下。我的最后一个是一切，但又不是全部。

english: My first is in mage, but not in wizard. My second in goblin, and also in lizard. My third in night, but not in the day. My last is in fields, but not in the hay.
translation: 我的第一个在魔法师里，但不在巫师里。我的第二个在哥布林里，也在蜥蜴里。我的第三个在夜晚里，但不在白天里。我的最后一个在田野里，但不在干草里。

english: My first is in tar, but not in a swamp. My second in fire, but not in a camp. My third is in eagle, but never in air. My last is in hate, but also in care.
translation: 我的第一个在焦油里，但不在沼泽里。我的第二个在火里，但不在营地里。我的第三个在鹰里，但绝不在空气里。我的最后一个在仇恨里，但也在关心里。

english: My first is in the well, but not at sea. My second in 'I', but not in 'me'. My third is in flies, but insects not found. My last is in earth, but not in the ground.
translation: 我的第一个在水井里，但不在海里。我的第二个在‘我’里，但不在‘我’里。我的第三个在苍蝇里，但找不到昆虫。我的最后一个在泥土里，但不在土地里。

english: My first is in water, and also in tea. My second in fish, but not in the sea. My third in mountains, but not underground. My last is in strike, but not in pound.
translation: 我的第一个在水里，也在茶里。我的第二个在鱼里，但不在海里。我的第三个在山里，但不在地下。我的最后一个在打击里，但不在磅里。

english: My first is in wizard, but not in a mage. My second in jail, but not in a cage. My third is in anger, but not in a rage. My last in a drawing, but not on a page.
translation: 我的第一个在巫师里，但不在魔法师里。我的第二个在监狱里，但不在笼子里。我的第三个在生气里，但不在狂怒里。我的最后一个在图画里，但不在书页上。

english: My footwear is getting a bit worn out, so I need a few pairs of leather boots. I still need [number].
translation: 我的鞋子有点磨损了，所以需要几双皮靴。我还需要 [number] 双。

english: My friend! Look him up, he's quite famous.
translation: 我的朋友！查查他，他相当有名。

english: My friend, I have been on a most strange adventure!
translation: 我的朋友，我经历了一场最奇异的冒险！

english: My glassware got damaged when I moved here, so I need some new beer glasses. I still need [number].
translation: 我搬到这里时玻璃器皿损坏了，所以需要一些新的啤酒杯。我还需要 [number] 个。

english: My goodness... it's full of stars!
translation: 我的天哪……里面全是星星！

english: My grandfather used to work in a mine, one day *Sniff* *sniff* actually if you wouldn't mind excusing me.
translation: 我祖父以前在矿上工作，有一天*抽泣* *抽泣* 实际上，如果你不介意的话，请允许我离开。

english: My hair is one of my most distinguished features, and as there is no god of hairdressing, I will not permit a lowly mortal to touch my blessed locks. So no.
translation: 我的头发是我最显著的特征之一，既然没有理发之神，我绝不会允许一个卑微的凡人触碰我神圣的发丝。所以，不行。

english: My head is a little achy, but not too bad!
translation: 我的头有点疼，但还不算太糟！

english: My help? With what?
translation: 我的帮助？帮什么？

english: My house. You have found yourself here because I deem it necessary.
translation: 我的房子。你发现自己在这里，是因为我认为有必要。

english: My job's supposed to be simple - I get chocolate eggs from the bird and tell the rabbits to deliver them in the springtime. That's all I should have to do!
translation: 我的工作本来很简单——我从鸟那里拿到巧克力蛋，然后告诉兔子们在春天把它们送出去。这就是我该做的全部！

english: My last servant died in here. His skull still remains and you must bring it out to prevent my next servant getting the wrong impression.
translation: 我的上一个仆人死在这里了。他的头骨还在，你必须把它带出来，以免我的下一个仆人产生错误的印象。

english: My latest project, for example, is to try and create a refuge where people can rest, ponder life and find themselves.
translation: 例如，我最新的项目是尝试创建一个避难所，让人们可以休息、思考人生并找到自我。

english: My lord, what happened?
translation: 我的大人，发生什么事了？

english: My love for you seems cold,
translation: 我对你的爱似乎冰冷，

english: My love has thrown a birthday party this year, but I cannot go, for her father keeps us apart.
translation: 我的爱人今年举办了一个生日派对，但我不能去，因为她父亲把我们分开了。

english: My master summoned me to end this Easter foolishness. Humans seize any excuse to pretend a season is special, with frivolous gifts and unhealthy foodstuffs.
translation: 我的主人召唤我来终结这场复活节的愚蠢行为。人类抓住任何借口来假装某个季节很特别，用轻浮的礼物和不健康的食品。

english: My memory is foggy... What was I doing again?
translation: 我的记忆很模糊……我刚才在做什么来着？

english: My name is 11 1 14 5 12.
My name is Hotpheex, I am but a humble druid.
translation: 我的名字是霍特菲克斯，我只是一个谦卑的德鲁伊。

english: My name is [player name]. Perhaps you would see better if you took that pumpkin off?
translation: 我的名字是[player name]。也许你把那个南瓜拿下来会看得更清楚？

english: My name's Nieve, I'm the Slayer Master best able to train you.
translation: 我叫尼芙，是能最好地训练你的杀戮大师。

english: My office is at the eastern side of the warren. Please come and help me.
translation: 我的办公室在养殖场的东侧。请过来帮我。

english: My old friend Pete has very generously made an exception to his letter-only rule for my pumpkin seeds!
translation: 我的老朋友皮特非常慷慨地为我的南瓜种子破例，打破了他只收信件的规矩！

english: My painter has made a portrait for my Xmas card this year. I would let you see it, as I know I have more grace and beauty in a single tail-hair than any of you bloated black and white swimming chickens, but I'm only sending it out to my closest squirrel friends.
translation: 我的画师为我今年的圣诞贺卡画了一幅肖像。我本想让你看看，因为我知道我一根尾巴毛上的优雅和美丽就超过你们这些臃肿的黑白游泳鸡，但我只打算把它寄给我最亲近的松鼠朋友们。

english: My plan is flawless! Ah-ha-ha-ha-ha-haa!
translation: 我的计划完美无缺！啊-哈-哈-哈-哈-哈！

english: My plan might be too obvious if I equip my Giant Bronze Dagger...
translation: 如果我装备上我的巨型青铜匕首，我的计划可能就太明显了……

english: My plans for today require some sets of bones, the normal-sized sort you get from goblins. I still need [number].
translation: 我今天的计划需要几套骨头，就是哥布林身上那种普通大小的。我还需要 [number] 套。

english: My pumpkiiiiiiins!
translation: 我的南——瓜——！

english: My revenge will be great...
translation: 我的复仇将无比盛大……

english: My roof is leaking, so I need some swamp paste to fix it. I still need [number].
translation: 我的屋顶漏水了，所以需要一些沼泽膏来修补。我还需要 [number] 份。

english: My secateurs are magic and superior in every single way, I found them by a farm patch.
translation: 我的修枝剪是魔法物品，在各方面都更优越，我是在一个农场地块旁找到它们的。

english: My secateurs are magic, I found them by a farm patch.
translation: 我的修枝剪是魔法物品，我是在一个农场地块旁找到它们的。

english: My shortbow's string is getting a bit worn out, so could you fetch me some bow strings? I still need [number].
translation: 我的短弓弦有点磨损了，你能帮我弄些弓弦来吗？我还需要 [number] 根。

english: My silk is from the silk chasm far north from here. The best quality silk in Gielinor!
translation: 我的丝绸来自遥远的北方丝绸深渊，是吉列诺尔最好的丝绸！

english: My silk is from the silk chasm, so finely woven it cannot be cut by your blunt secateurs.
translation: 我的丝绸来自丝绸深渊，织得如此精细，你那钝的修枝剪根本剪不断。

english: My sister and I have always loved knitting. Between Christmas jumpers and other wolly scarves, we have a little family tradition.
translation: 我和我姐姐一直很喜欢编织。从圣诞毛衣到其他羊毛围巾，我们有一个小小的家庭传统。

english: My son's a smart kid who's becoming a great wizard, while you're a do-gooder who fetches & carries stuff for smarter people. I know which of you two earned my respect.
translation: 我儿子是个聪明的孩子，正在成为一名伟大的巫师，而你只是个为更聪明的人跑腿搬东西的老好人。我知道你们俩谁赢得了我的尊重。

english: My spears are of high quality, but lack the sentimental elements. They are seen as ideal by many tortugans. Would you like to buy one? Or perhaps you'd be more interested in something else I have for sale?
translation: 我的长矛质量上乘，但缺乏情感元素。许多托图加人认为它们是理想之选。你想买一把吗？或者你可能对我出售的其他东西更感兴趣？

english: My trusted Bloodied Axe has been at my side since first I learnt the glory of battle and the endless amusement offered by the slaughter of my foes. Plus it looks totally awesome embedded in someones head.
translation: 自从我第一次领悟战斗的荣耀和屠杀敌人带来的无尽乐趣以来，我信赖的血染之斧就一直伴我左右。而且，它嵌在别人脑袋上的样子简直酷毙了。

english: My undergarments are getting a bit worn out. I'll be needing some sheets of silk to patch them. I still need [number].
translation: 我的内衣有点旧了。我需要一些丝绸布料来缝补。我还需要 [number] 块。

english: My weapons collection isn't all it used to be. Some short swords made of bronze would be much appreciated. I still need [number].
translation: 我的武器收藏大不如前了。如果能有一些青铜短剑就太好了。我还需要 [number] 把。

english: My whole cannot die as long as it has food. What am I?
translation: 只要有食物，我的整体就不会死。我是什么？

english: My whole crushes mountains, drains rivers, and destroys civilisations.All that live fear my passing. What am I?
translation: 我的整体能碾碎山脉、抽干河流、摧毁文明。所有生灵都惧怕我的经过。我是什么？

english: My whole helps to make bread, let birds fly and boats sail. What am I?
translation: 我的整体有助于制作面包、让鸟儿飞翔和船只航行。我是什么？

english: My whole is the most powerful tool you will possess. What am I?
translation: 我的整体是你将拥有的最强大的工具。我是什么？

english: My whole wears rings the older I get. What am I?
translation: 我的整体越老，戴的环就越多。我是什么？

english: My whole when stolen from you, causes you death. What am I?
translation: 我的整体如果从你那里被偷走，会导致你死亡。我是什么？

english: My work here is done.
translation: 我在这里的工作完成了。

english: My workshop is in the basement of the abandoned house in the north of the village. If you find yourself in a sewer you're in the wrong place.
translation: 我的工作室在村子北部废弃房子的地下室里。如果你发现自己在下水道里，那你就走错地方了。

english: My, what a fabulous costume!
translation: 哎呀，多么棒的服装！

english: Mystic Vigour
translation: 神秘活力

english: Mystical forces guide you into a cavern below the whirlpool.
translation: 神秘的力量引导你进入漩涡下方的洞穴。

english: NESTED?!
translation: 嵌套？！

english: NO QUESTIONS ASKED OR ANSWERED!
translation: 不问也不答！

english: NO! It is definitely not about a favour!
translation: 不！这绝对不是关于一个忙！

english: NO! It's never just one small favour!
translation: 不！从来都不只是一个小忙！

english: NOT ALL GHOSTS ARE FRIENDLY! DID THE EVIL LOOKING MASK NOT GIVE IT AWAY!?
translation: 并非所有幽灵都是友好的！那个看起来很邪恶的面具难道没有暴露这一点吗！？

english: NOT GUILTY
translation: 无罪
