english: Now I'm not stupid and have had people try and steal from me before... but this guy was different and had some kind of special powers I simply couldn't fight.
translation: 我可不傻，以前也有人想偷我的东西……但这家伙不一样，他有些特殊能力，我根本打不过。

english: Now I'm older, I'm teachin' landlubbers like yerself how to command yer own vessels, so ye can have adventures like I did.
translation: 现在我老了，正在教像你这样的旱鸭子如何指挥自己的船只，这样你们就能像我一样去冒险了。

english: Now go find those misplaced pumpkins!
translation: 现在去找那些放错地方的南瓜吧！

english: Now he's finally gone, I would like you to do me one last small favour.
translation: 现在他终于走了，我想请你帮我最后一个忙。

english: Now he's not a chicken, how do we get feathers?
translation: 现在他不是鸡了，我们怎么弄到羽毛？

english: Now hop along and go get the cocoa.
translation: 现在快去吧，去拿可可豆。

english: Now if I just had something to tie it all together...
translation: 现在要是有个东西能把它们都绑在一起就好了……

english: Now is not the time to try and plant anything here.
translation: 现在不是在这里种东西的时候。

english: Now is not the time!
translation: 现在不是时候！

english: Now it's all Doom! Doom everywhere!
translation: 现在全是末日！到处都是末日！

english: Now now, not any old egg, it needs to be a special egg.
translation: 好了好了，不是随便什么蛋都行，得是个特别的蛋。

english: Now seems like a good time to run...
translation: 现在似乎是逃跑的好时机……

english: Now take this to Party Pete.
translation: 现在把这个拿去给派对皮特。

english: Now tell me mortal, what events have transpired which led to me saving your life? What caused this surge of energy?
translation: 现在告诉我，凡人，发生了什么事导致我救了你的命？是什么引起了这股能量涌动？

english: Now that I've done with that part of the painting, I have arranged a present for you. And, if you'd like it, you can take the sword as I don't need it anymore.
translation: 既然我已经完成了画作的那部分，我为你准备了一份礼物。而且，如果你想要的话，你可以拿走这把剑，因为我不再需要它了。

english: Now that is a good idea!
translation: 这倒是个好主意！

english: Now that is a spooktacular idea!
translation: 这真是个惊悚绝伦的好主意！

english: Now that the boiler is alive, the fire in the main room has automatically started burning. Anti-Santa will not like the heat, but it is insufficient to drive him out.
translation: 既然锅炉已经活了，主房间里的火就自动燃烧起来了。反圣诞老人不会喜欢这种热度，但这还不足以把他赶出去。

english: Now that the unruly eggs in the crypt have been taken away, we can send back the normal ones for the Easter Bunny.
translation: 既然墓穴里那些不守规矩的蛋已经被拿走了，我们就可以把正常的蛋送还给复活节兔子了。

english: Now that you have everything, off you go! Plant those seeds!
translation: 既然你什么都准备好了，那就出发吧！去种下那些种子！

english: Now that you mention it, I'm having a few problems with that.
translation: 既然你提到了，我确实在这方面遇到了一些问题。

english: Now that you mention it...
translation: 既然你提到了……

english: Now that you mention it... I'm not entirely sure.
translation: 既然你提到了……我也不太确定。

english: Now that's just nasty...
translation: 这可真够恶心的……

english: Now that's what I'm talking about! Gimme gimme.
translation: 这才像话嘛！给我给我。

english: Now the Kings in Keldagrim are but a distant memory...
translation: 如今凯尔达格林城的国王们已成遥远的回忆……

english: Now the crows have been dealt with, we're ready for the next task. Planting new seeds! Unfortunately I've ran out of them...
translation: 既然乌鸦已经处理掉了，我们就可以准备下一个任务了。种下新的种子！可惜我已经用完了……

english: Now then, I could use your help with sorting out a slight problem.
translation: 那么，我需要你帮忙解决一个小问题。

english: Now then, let's get you all kitted out.
translation: 那么，我们来把你全副武装起来吧。

english: Now they seem hungrier than ever!
translation: 现在它们看起来比以往任何时候都更饿了！

english: Now to REALLY find that chicken... afterall, how hard can it be to deal with a chicken?
translation: 现在要真正找到那只鸡了……毕竟，对付一只鸡能有多难？

english: Now to find it...
translation: 现在去找它……

english: Now to find that pesky chicken and chase it off.
translation: 现在去找那只讨厌的鸡，把它赶走。

english: Now to put the key back and no one will ever know...
translation: 现在把钥匙放回去，就没人会知道了……

english: Now we have the seeds, we can plant them. First you'll need the map again.
translation: 现在我们有了种子，可以种了。首先你还需要那张地图。

english: Now we just need the pumpkins to grow. This should take a few months.
translation: 现在我们只需要等南瓜长大。这应该需要几个月的时间。

english: Now we've cleared the field, we have something we can use to deal with the crow problem.
translation: 既然我们已经清理了田地，就有办法来解决乌鸦的问题了。

english: Now why would I want to be teleported somewhere by a weird priest?
translation: 我干嘛要让一个奇怪的祭司把我传送到某个地方？

english: Now would be a good time to summon Zaff!
translation: 现在是召唤扎夫的好时机！

english: Now would be a good time to visit Veldaban of the Black Guard, in the west of Keldagrim.
translation: 现在是去拜访凯尔达格林城西边黑卫队的维尔达班的好时机。

english: Now you just need to add the white berries to make the pink dye.
translation: 现在你只需要加入白莓来制作粉红色染料。

english: Now you only need to plant the right seeds in the right place! Match the numbers on the map and the packet if you struggle with colours.
translation: 现在你只需要把正确的种子种在正确的地方！如果你分不清颜色，就对照地图和种子包上的数字。

english: Now you're thinking like a party planner!
translation: 现在你思考起来像个派对接待员了！

english: Now you've really embraced the spooky spirit! Please, take these treats!
translation: 现在你真正领悟了惊悚精神！请收下这些糖果！

english: Now's not the time to be going back in there.
translation: 现在不是回去的时候。

english: Now, I am a busy Santa, and I must get back to work! Thank you again for helping us all. You showed some true Christmas spirit!
translation: 好了，我是个忙碌的圣诞老人，得回去工作了！再次感谢你帮助我们所有人。你展现了真正的圣诞精神！

english: Now, I must reward you for your time and trouble. I hope you've got some inventory space...
translation: 现在，我必须为你的时间和辛劳给予奖励。希望你的背包还有空位……

english: Now, come back to me when you have some free space and I'll give you your prize.
translation: 好了，等你有了空位再来找我，我会给你奖品。

english: Now, head in to the bar, greet whoever's at the front of the queue, and show them to an empty table.
translation: 现在，走进酒吧，问候队伍最前面的人，然后带他们到空桌子就座。

english: Now, how can I help you find love?
translation: 那么，我该怎么帮你找到爱情呢？

english: Now, how many more eggs do you think we'll be able to hand out next year with the help of those priests?
translation: 那么，你觉得有了那些祭司的帮助，我们明年能多送出多少蛋？

english: Now, just keep away from those evil trees, ok?
translation: 好了，离那些邪恶的树远点，好吗？

english: Now, the crypt is locked, but my old friend Urhney should have the key. He lives in Lumbridge Swamp, east of Port Sarim, in a little wooden house. He's a priest, so he calls himself Father Urhney.
translation: 现在，墓穴是锁着的，但我的老朋友乌尔尼应该有钥匙。他住在沙林港以东的仑桥镇沼泽，一间小木屋里。他是个祭司，所以自称乌尔尼神父。

english: Now, what do you have?
translation: 那么，你有什么？

english: Now, your prize! The spooky wall lamp, or wall lamp as I call it, is yours. Use it wisely, mortal.
translation: 好了，你的奖品！这个幽灵壁灯，或者我称之为壁灯，归你了。明智地使用它，凡人。

english: Now... I can explain, the thing is-
translation: 现在……我可以解释，事情是这样的——

english: Noxious Halberds.
translation: 剧毒长戟。

english: Nung holds up [number] of his fingers.
translation: 农竖起了[number]根手指。

english: Nut Roast
translation: 坚果烤

english: O...K.... so what exactly do you want me to do in here?
translation: 好……吧……那你到底想让我在这里做什么？

english: OK I will do all that.
translation: 好的，我会照做。

english: OK let's see. What if, to start with, you give yourselves a present? General Wartface will give one to himself, and General Bentnoze, you give one to yourself.
translation: 好的，让我想想。要不这样，一开始你们先给自己送个礼物？疣脸将军给自己一个，弯鼻将军，你也给自己一个。

english: OK. I'll bring you your own presents to give to yourself. This isn't weird at all.
translation: 好的。我会把你们自己的礼物带来给你们自己。这一点也不奇怪。

english: ONCE UPON A TIME... aaaAAAooooAHHHH ... there lived a BOY called DEREK...
translation: 很久很久以前……啊啊啊啊嗷嗷嗷……有一个叫德里克的男孩……

english: OW! A terrible shock jars through your skull, and you burn your mouth too.
translation: 嗷！一股可怕的冲击震得你头骨发麻，还烫到了嘴。

english: OW! A terrible shock jars through your skull.
translation: 嗷！一股可怕的冲击震得你头骨发麻。

english: Oak armchair Greenman's Ale barrel Rope bell-pull
translation: 橡木扶手椅 绿人麦酒桶 绳索拉铃

english: Oak cargo hold on your boat.
translation: 你船上的橡木货舱。

english: Oak dresser, Lesser magical balance, Teak bell-pull, Grassland pet habitat, Oak pet feeder, Oak pet house
translation: 橡木梳妆台、次级魔法天平、柚木拉铃、草原宠物栖息地、橡木宠物喂食器、橡木宠物屋

english: Oak mast with linen sails on your boat.
translation: 你船上的橡木桅杆配亚麻布帆。

english: Oarswoman Olga from Burgh de Rott (after completing In Aid of the Myreque).
translation: 来自伯格德罗特镇的女桨手奥尔加（完成援助迈雷克后）。

english: Oathplate armour.
translation: 誓约板甲。

english: Obor's lair
translation: 奥博尔的巢穴

english: Obviously, I am Malignius Mortifer.
translation: 显然，我就是马利尼乌斯.莫蒂弗。

english: Of all the creatures I have slain, demons are the most well suited to killing each other. Everything from their blood to their magic is designed to be corrosive to their own kind.
translation: 在我杀过的所有生物中，恶魔最擅长自相残杀。从它们的血液到魔法，一切都被设计成对同类具有腐蚀性。

english: Of course I was serious! I wanted them to bring a cake...
translation: 我当然没开玩笑！我是想让他们带个蛋糕来……

english: Of course I'm all here, where else would parts of me be? And I was just sat here thinking. You really are strange.
translation: 我当然全须全尾地在这儿，我身上哪部分还能在别处？我刚才就坐在这儿想事情。你真的很奇怪。

english: Of course I'm speaking to you - you employ me!
translation: 我当然是在跟你说话——你可是我的雇主！

english: Of course dearie! One crazy night out can't stop me knitting!
translation: 当然啦，亲爱的！一个疯狂的夜晚可阻止不了我织东西！

english: Of course it is. So, where am I retrieving it from?
translation: 当然是的。那么，我要从哪里把它拿回来？

english: Of course it's handy! What will it take to keep you quiet about it?
translation: 当然方便！要怎样才能让你对此保密？

english: Of course not! No-one has. An evil so intense must not exist in this world, not even in memory. I used my powers to remove all memory of Jonas from this world.
translation: 当然没有！没人记得。如此强烈的邪恶不应存在于这个世界，连记忆里也不行。我用我的力量抹去了这个世界对乔纳斯的所有记忆。

english: Of course not, I kept it a secret like you asked!
translation: 当然没有，我按你的要求保密了！

english: Of course not, no funny business.
translation: 当然没有，没搞什么鬼。

english: Of course not, use a net.
translation: 当然不是，用网。

english: Of course they aren't, we had so much fun with our poems we wanted to give you some riddles too.
translation: 它们当然不是，我们写诗玩得那么开心，还想再给你出些谜语呢。

english: Of course we do! The holiday was ours to begin with!
translation: 我们当然有！这个节日本来就是我们的！

english: Of course you can. Diango doesn't mind about the decorations. I wouldn't go hoarding them though they're mildly magical and once that wears out they're liable to disappear. Don't tell that to those pesky imps though.
translation: 当然可以。迪亚戈不介意这些装饰品。不过我不会囤积它们，因为它们带点魔法，一旦魔法耗尽就容易消失。不过别告诉那些讨厌的小恶魔。

english: Of course you do. Okay then, what do you need from me?
translation: 你当然有。好吧，那你需要我做什么？

english: Of course you will!
translation: 你当然会！

english: Of course! And with my sock experience, I feel like I'm well suited to the job.
translation: 当然！而且以我的袜子经验，我觉得自己很适合这份工作。

english: Of course! I mostly sell seeds as they tend to make it back home in one piece. Flowers themselves are quite delicate.
translation: 当然！我主要卖种子，因为它们通常能完好无损地到家。花朵本身相当娇嫩。

english: Of course! I will leave you two to your reunion.
translation: 当然！我就不打扰你们俩重聚了。

english: Of course! I'd like to see the stalls and join in with the festival fun!
translation: 当然！我想看看那些摊位，加入节日的欢乐！

english: Of course! I'm always happy to help out.
translation: 当然！我一直很乐意帮忙。

english: Of course! I've got a few more things to do and then I'll go.
translation: 当然！我还有几件事要做，做完就走。

english: Of course! It's massive, so we'll need as much help as we can get!
translation: 当然！它太大了，我们需要尽可能多的帮助！

english: Of course! Just come back once you have room for one.
translation: 当然！等你腾出地方再来吧。

english: Of course! Let me have that empty sack.
translation: 当然！把那个空袋子给我。

english: Of course! She would probably love to learn about goblin cuisine from you.
translation: 当然！她大概会很乐意跟你学学哥布林料理。

english: Of course! There's lots of maths to be done around here.
translation: 当然！这儿有很多数学题要算。

english: Of course! Those foolish Saradominists think they've won. We'll wait until they let their guard down, then rise up and retake our fortress!
translation: 当然！那些愚蠢的萨拉多明信徒以为他们赢了。我们会等他们放松警惕，然后奋起夺回我们的堡垒！

english: Of course! We have a lot of ads looking for something, but looking for a ghost is a first!
translation: 当然！我们有很多找东西的广告，但找幽灵还是头一回！

english: Of course! Who wouldn't be interested in that?
translation: 当然！谁会不感兴趣呢？

english: Of course! Wish me luck.
translation: 当然！祝我好运吧。

english: Of course, I always help random people I meet.
translation: 当然，我总是帮助遇到的陌生人。

english: Of course, I would be happy to help.
translation: 当然，我很乐意帮忙。

english: Of course, I'll help you out.
translation: 当然，我会帮你。

english: Of course, I'll let her know you're all done too.
translation: 当然，我也会告诉她你已经完成了。

english: Of course, [player name]! Your presence is more than welcome on this cull! You wish to leave now?
translation: 当然，[player name]！非常欢迎你参与这次清除行动！你想现在出发吗？

english: Of course, bunnies are all about... resurrection.
translation: 当然，兔子嘛……就是关于复活。

english: Of course, every year us druids get together to thank Guthix for creating our world.
translation: 当然，每年我们德鲁伊都会聚在一起感谢古斯创造了我们的世界。

english: Of course, it's just that your expertise would greatly benefit our research.
translation: 当然，只是你的专业知识会大大有益于我们的研究。

english: Of course, it's my duty.
translation: 当然，这是我的职责。

english: Of course, no traveler in modern day RuneScape can scour the world without coming across the area orth of the kingdoms of Misthalin and Asgarnia known quite bluntly as "The Wilderness". A wasteland of esolation and death, and ultimately the realm of Zamorak. Many adventurers fall prey here to other dventurers who are simply there to kill, known by many as "PKers". Harrowing tales have come from people who have spoken to who have made it out with barely their lives of Dragons, Demons, overgrown poisonous spiders, and adventurers touched by Zamorak himself, twisting their minds so that they may serve his chaotic ways. Little is known about this place in general, except that Zamorak is the ruler of this domain. Is there any lore of how the area we know as the Wilderness came to be? I have heard only tales, never any actual lore or written history. Many have spoken to me about speculation that this area was where the gods warred with one another and the result at the end was this place, or how it was once a peaceful, grand kingdom that fell prey to war itself, and the war caused this devastation. However all I have heard is hearsay, no truth to it. Has this history been lost?
translation: 当然，在当今的RuneScape中，任何旅行者游历世界时都难免会经过米斯林王国和阿斯加尼亚王国以北的地区，那里被直白地称为‘荒野’。一片荒凉与死亡的废土，归根结底是扎莫拉克的领域。许多冒险者在此沦为其他单纯为了杀戮而来的冒险者的猎物，这些人常被称为‘PKer’。那些侥幸逃生的人讲述了关于龙、恶魔、巨大的毒蜘蛛以及被扎莫拉克本人触及、心智扭曲以侍奉其混乱之道的冒险者的骇人故事。总的来说，人们对这个地方知之甚少，只知道扎莫拉克是这片领域的主宰。有没有关于我们称之为荒野的地区是如何形成的传说？我只听过一些故事，从未见过真正的传说或文字记载。很多人跟我推测，说这里是众神相互征战的战场，最终形成了这个地方；或者说这里曾是一个和平繁荣的伟大王国，因战争而沦陷，战争导致了这场毁灭。但我听到的都是道听途说，没有真相。这段历史是否已经失传了？

english: Of course, once you have coated it with snow, you'll need to get it tailored into a costume. Thessalia can probably help there.
translation: 当然，一旦你给它涂上雪，就需要把它裁剪成一套服装。塞萨利亚或许能帮上忙。

english: Of course, there is nothing more delicious than a special super hot kebab on a hot day in the desert while stuck in a cramped crate!
translation: 当然，没有什么比在沙漠里炎热的日子里，被困在狭小的板条箱中，吃一份特制超辣烤肉更美味的了！

english: Of course, though I have no knowledge of the process.
translation: 当然，不过我对这个过程一无所知。

english: Of course, we can trap him in an underwater cavern where no-one will go! I'm a genius!
translation: 当然，我们可以把他困在一个没人会去的海底洞穴里！我真是个天才！

english: Of course, what do you need me to do?
translation: 当然，你需要我做什么？

english: Of course, what is wrong? Don't you like my name ideas?
translation: 当然，怎么了？你不喜欢我起的名字吗？

english: Of course, when I was young, people threw parties in my honour all the time after I'd saved their cities from ravaging monsters.
translation: 当然，我年轻时，每次从肆虐的怪物手中拯救了他们的城市后，人们总会为我举办派对。

english: Of course, yet the games go on. Unpleasant circumstances and the volatile beasts that surround me are simply facts I must accept - for now.
translation: 当然，但游戏仍在继续。不愉快的处境和周围暴躁的野兽只是我必须接受的事实——暂时如此。

english: Of course, you know what every chef does need to do?
translation: 当然，你知道每个厨师都需要做什么吗？

english: Of course. (lie)
translation: 当然。（撒谎）

english: Of course. Easter only happens once a year. I have to make the most out of it.
translation: 当然。复活节一年只有一次。我得好好享受。

english: Of course. I name all my eggs. There's also Eggward, Eggon, Leggolas and Greggory, to name a few.
translation: 当然。我给我所有的蛋都起了名字。还有艾格沃德、艾格昂、莱戈拉斯和格雷戈里，等等。

english: Of course. Is my duty. Enjoy break, see you later.
translation: 当然。这是我的职责。好好休息，回头见。

english: Of course. Just show me the armour and I'll get it done.
translation: 当然。把盔甲给我看看，我就能搞定。

english: Of course. Keeping secrets is...err, are, my middle names.
translation: 当然。保守秘密是我……呃，是我的中间名。

english: Of course. Put two puppets of each colour in each box.
translation: 当然。每个盒子里放两个每种颜色的木偶。

english: Of course. What is it?
translation: 当然。是什么？

english: Of course... just give me a moment...
translation: 当然……给我一点时间……

english: Off you go! You just need to step in. Ice is slippery so you should keep going straight until you find an obstacle or some ground you can stop on.
translation: 去吧！你只需要走进去。冰很滑，所以你应该一直直走，直到找到障碍物或可以停下来的地面。

english: Offer them a night on the town.
translation: 请他们在城里玩一晚。

english: Offer them a toffee apple.
translation: 给他们一个太妃糖苹果。

english: Offer them dinner on you.
translation: 请他们吃顿晚饭。

english: Officially? I was bored so my dad tasked me to bring a tiny bit of cheer to Gielinor.
translation: 官方说法？我太无聊了，所以我父亲让我给吉莱诺带来一点欢乐。

english: Oh Archibald, oh Archibald. Wheresoever art thou, Archibald?
translation: 哦，阿奇博尔德，哦，阿奇博尔德。你到底在哪儿，阿奇博尔德？

english: Oh I can't remember! I'm sure it's delicious!
translation: 哦，我记不清了！但我肯定它很好吃！

english: Oh I didnt even make them, a higher power was responsible for that!
translation: 哦，我甚至都没做它们，那是更高力量的责任！

english: Oh I don't know about that, have you tried one yet?
translation: 哦，这我可不知道，你试过一个了吗？

english: Oh I get it, so the normal egg should melt, and the ice cream one shouldn't. That way we know it works?
translation: 哦，我明白了，所以普通的蛋应该会融化，而冰淇淋蛋不会。这样我们就知道它起作用了？

english: Oh I love that, let's write that in immediately.
translation: 哦，我喜欢这个，我们马上把它写进去。

english: Oh I see, well I hope you find some more!
translation: 哦，我明白了，好吧，我希望你能找到更多！

english: Oh I shall, I like parties!
translation: 哦，我会的，我喜欢派对！

english: Oh I wouldn't worry, it's all good spooky fun!
translation: 哦，我不担心，这都是有趣的恐怖乐子！

english: Oh I'm sure they're there, you simply radiate dark energy!
translation: 哦，我肯定它们在那儿，你简直散发着黑暗能量！

english: Oh absolutely! Ain't nothing as partytastic as these wonderful birthday balloons filled with auto floating gas!
translation: 哦，当然！没有什么比这些充满自动漂浮气体的奇妙生日气球更有派对气氛了！

english: Oh alright, fine. I'll go order then. I'll get a beer.
translation: 哦，好吧，行。那我去点单。我要一杯啤酒。

english: Oh and... borrowed a saucepan and rolling pin. I seem to have lost the rolling pin.
translation: 哦，还有……借了一个平底锅和擀面杖。我好像把擀面杖弄丢了。

english: Oh but it does! Though I fear that to you, it may never.
translation: 哦，但它确实有意义！不过恐怕对你来说，可能永远不会。

english: Oh course *hic* I love a good *hic* party.
translation: 当然*呃*我喜欢一个好*呃*派对。

english: Oh dear! Me and my big mouth! I didn't mean it. Really I didn't. I'm sorry
translation: 哦，天哪！都怪我这张大嘴！我不是故意的。真的不是。对不起。

english: Oh dear! Okay, so now you just wait and see what happens to the other one?
translation: 哦，天哪！好吧，那现在你就等着看另一个会怎么样？

english: Oh dear! That's okay though, it was a fun treasure hunt!
translation: 哦，天哪！不过没关系，这是个有趣的寻宝游戏！

english: Oh dear! There truly is no limit to his malignance! Unfortunately, I see no choice but for you to go through with it, we must learn more about his plans.
translation: 哦，天哪！他的恶意真是没有极限！不幸的是，我看你别无选择，只能继续下去，我们必须了解更多他的计划。

english: Oh dear! This is terrible.
translation: 哦，天哪！这太糟糕了。

english: Oh dear! Well luckily for you I have some spares. Here you go.
translation: 哦，天哪！不过算你走运，我有一些备用的。给你。

english: Oh dear! Well, it's ok then, it's the thought that counts.
translation: 哦，天哪！好吧，那没关系，心意最重要。

english: Oh dear, I bet these apples taste disgusting.
translation: 哦，天哪，我打赌这些苹果味道很难吃。

english: Oh dear, I forgot about the riddles! Poor Cecilia. I'm sure she appreciates you helping her out.
translation: 哦，天哪，我忘了那些谜语！可怜的塞西莉亚。我相信她很感激你帮她。

english: Oh dear, I hope this isn't too difficult for you. The priest, Father Urhney, lives in Lumbridge Swamp, east of Port Sarim, in a little wooden house. Please ask him for the crypt key.
translation: 哦，天哪，我希望这对你来说不会太难。祭司乌尔尼神父住在沙林港以东的仑桥镇沼泽，一间小木屋里。请向他索要墓穴钥匙。

english: Oh dear, I know your pain! I once put a pair of red underwear in the wash with my white socks. I ended up with pink socks!
translation: 哦，天哪，我懂你的痛苦！我曾经把一条红内裤和我的白袜子一起洗。结果我的袜子变成了粉色！

english: Oh dear, I really didn't do well there.
translation: 哦，天哪，我那儿确实做得不好。

english: Oh dear, where is this going [player name]?
translation: 哦，天哪，这是要往哪儿去啊，[player name]？

english: Oh dear, you don't have enough space to carry the seeds. Come back when you have two spaces free.
translation: 哦，天哪，你没有足够的空间携带种子。等你空出两个位置再来吧。

english: Oh dear, your boat has capsized! You barely make your way back to land.
translation: 哦天哪，你的船翻了！你勉强游回了岸边。

english: Oh dear, your boat has capsized! You barely make your way back to land. You'll now need to speak to a shipwright to recover your boat. To find a shipwright, just look for the relevant icon on your map. Any items
translation: 哦，天哪，你的船翻了！你勉强游回岸边。现在你需要和船匠谈谈来修复你的船。要找到船匠，只需在地图上寻找相关图标。任何物品

english: Oh dear. Well.. I have a cunning plan.
translation: 哦，天哪。好吧……我有个狡猾的计划。

english: Oh dear. You'll need [number] rubies for that, I'm afraid. I can take part payment now if you wish? However there are no refunds.
translation: 哦，天哪。恐怕你需要 [number] 颗红宝石。如果你愿意，我可以先收一部分？不过概不退款。

english: Oh dear. You'll need [number] rubies, a Digsite pendant, [number] cosmic runes and [number] fire runes with you I'm afraid.
translation: 哦，天哪。恐怕你需要随身携带 [number] 颗红宝石、一个考古挖掘场护符、[number] 个宇宙符文和 [number] 个火焰符文。

english: Oh dear... Well, seeing as you lot caused this issue, would you help us get more eggs in time?
translation: 哦，天哪……好吧，既然你们这帮人惹出了这个麻烦，你们能帮我们及时弄到更多蛋吗？

english: Oh dear...you are nearly dead.
translation: 哦天哪……你快要死了。

english: Oh did he? Good to know he doesn't think I can do it...
translation: 哦，他真这么说了？很好，知道他觉得我做不到……

english: Oh don't worry, this isn't anything to do with the cookout. It's just a total coincidence that it's a food related question.
translation: 哦，别担心，这和野餐会毫无关系。这只是一个关于食物的问题，纯属巧合。

english: Oh excellent, okay!
translation: 哦，太好了，好的！

english: Oh for bwuk sake.
translation: 哦，真是见鬼了。

english: Oh for...
translation: 哦，真是……

english: Oh good, that's the last one I was waiting on! Hand it over.
translation: 哦太好了，这就是我等的最后一个！快交出来吧。

english: Oh great, some bones!
translation: 哦太好了，是骨头！

english: Oh hello again [player name], do you have any news?
translation: 哦，[player name]，又见面了，有什么消息吗？

english: Oh hello, [player name]! I'm a bit stressed at the moment I must admit.
translation: 哦，你好，[player name]！我得承认，我现在有点压力。

english: Oh how I long for my own lily-pad.
translation: 哦，我多么渴望拥有自己的荷叶啊。

english: Oh it is! I am flattered!
translation: 哦，确实如此！我受宠若惊！

english: Oh it looks brand new! Now, is there a chance you may be able to help find my hat?
translation: 哦，看起来跟新的一样！那么，你有没有可能帮我找到我的帽子？

english: Oh it was nothing really. Really easy, no problem at all.
translation: 哦，其实没什么。真的很简单，一点问题都没有。

english: Oh it's not too complicated, they should all be made by now. All you would have to do is paint them and pack them.
translation: 哦，这并不复杂，现在应该都做好了。你只需要给它们上色然后打包就行。

english: Oh it's very exciting, the Cake Off, but you should try talking to Patty Seer in Lumbridge to get involved!
translation: 哦，蛋糕大赛非常刺激，但你应该试着去仑桥镇找先知帕蒂谈谈，才能参与进来！

english: Oh jolly wonderous day!
translation: 哦，多么欢乐奇妙的一天！

english: Oh lovely! Now there's a couple of things I need to know about this cake.
translation: 哦，太好了！关于这个蛋糕，我有几件事需要了解一下。

english: Oh my, aren't you just the cutest little thing! 75-->
translation: 哦天哪，你真是最可爱的小东西了！

english: Oh my, he's real! It's not a suit! That's... You're the Easter Bunny!
translation: 哦天哪，他是真的！不是玩偶装！那是……你就是复活节兔子！

english: Oh my, that is a lot! If you don't mind me asking, what are they all for?
translation: 哦天哪，真不少！如果你不介意我问一下，这些都是做什么用的？

english: Oh my, then it is as I feared... although... There may be something we can do.
translation: 哦天哪，那正如我所担心的……不过……也许我们还能做点什么。

english: Oh my, there is something simply frightful about you! Enjoy the treats...
translation: 哦天哪，你身上有种可怕的东西！好好享用这些糖果吧……

english: Oh no no no not at all.
translation: 哦不不不，完全不是。

english: Oh no problem! I get it! Take off that stupid rabbit suit!
translation: 哦，没问题！我懂了！快脱掉那件愚蠢的兔子装！

english: Oh no! A giant space-spider is eating the moon!
translation: 哦不！一只巨大的太空蜘蛛正在吃月亮！

english: Oh no! Do you need a new set of eggs to test with?
translation: 哦不！你需要一套新的蛋来测试吗？

english: Oh no! Fear not, [player name], here's another copy.
translation: 哦不！别怕，[player name]，这里还有一份副本。

english: Oh no! I'll be sure to keep an eye out for any of their members sneaking around.
translation: 哦不！我一定会留意他们有没有成员在附近鬼鬼祟祟的。

english: Oh no! I'm not quite level 13... he's going to come after me first!
translation: 哦不！我还没到13级……他会先来找我！

english: Oh no! That sounds horrible! Luckily we made lots of ice cream earlier and I found some more coolers. Here you go.
translation: 哦不！听起来真可怕！幸好我们之前做了很多冰淇淋，我又找到了一些冷却器。给你。

english: Oh no! Was there no-one around to help her?
translation: 哦不！当时周围没人能帮她吗？

english: Oh no! What did it look like?
translation: 哦不！它长什么样？

english: Oh no! What unfortunate series of event have befallen you?
translation: 哦不！你遭遇了什么不幸的连环事件？

english: Oh no! You must tell Carol, even she won't want this!
translation: 哦不！你必须告诉卡罗尔，连她都不会想要这个！

english: Oh no! You're correct, that was close, good spot! Just mix the cinnamon and holly into the wine.
translation: 哦不！你说得对，好险，好眼力！只要把肉桂和冬青混进酒里就行了。

english: Oh no, I'm sorry Wyson!
translation: 哦不，对不起，怀森！

english: Oh no, I've seen fake cobwebs before. They look like someone chopped up a silk curtain. No, I want something more realistic for my Halloween treat.
translation: 哦不，我以前见过假蜘蛛网。它们看起来就像有人把丝绸窗帘切碎了。不，我想要更逼真的东西来做我的万圣节糖果。

english: Oh no, am I going to have to fetch seeds from some faraway place?
translation: 哦不，我是不是得去某个遥远的地方取种子？

english: Oh no, he was pretty crazy.
translation: 哦不，他真是够疯的。

english: Oh no, it's Anti-Santa!
translation: 哦不，是反圣诞老人！

english: Oh no, not one of these spider things!
translation: 哦不，别又是这种蜘蛛玩意儿！

english: Oh no, not that time of year again.
translation: 哦不，又到一年中的这个时候了。

english: Oh no, that's horrible. Thanks for letting me know.
translation: 哦不，那太可怕了。谢谢你告诉我。

english: Oh no, that's not my style. Though I do appreciate their spooky spirit!
translation: 哦不，那不是我的风格。不过我很欣赏他们的恐怖精神！

english: Oh no, there'll be no need for that. Everything we need for the story is right here, between you and me.
translation: 哦不，没那个必要。故事需要的一切就在这里，只有你我知道。

english: Oh no, you can have them for free, sir! I couldn't sell these in their current state.
translation: 哦不，先生，你可以免费拿走它们！这些东西现在这个样子，我卖不出去。

english: Oh no. Don't do it.
translation: 哦不。别这么做。

english: Oh no. Give them to the Pixie overseer. Feel free to take some for yourself. I hear they have a huge tree in the centre of Varrock which needs decorating.
translation: 哦不。把它们交给小精灵监督者。你自己也可以拿一些。我听说他们在维洛克城中心有一棵大树需要装饰。

english: Oh no... We'll pay for that!
translation: 哦不……我们会为此付出代价的！

english: Oh okay, come back when you have two spaces free.
translation: 哦好吧，等你腾出两个空格再回来。

english: Oh okay, should I make you a different flavoured chocolate egg?
translation: 哦好吧，要不要我给你做一个不同口味的巧克力蛋？

english: Oh please let Santa bring you a brain this year. Of course sprites. Next you'll be asking how to catch them.
translation: 哦，拜托让圣诞老人今年给你带个脑子来。当然是精灵。接下来你就要问怎么抓它们了。

english: Oh please, you were never really a popular boss anyway. You had to be given extra drops just to incentivise people to find you. Even then, I doubt anyone would notice if you disappared.
translation: 哦拜托，反正你从来都不是什么受欢迎的Boss。还得给你加额外掉落，才能激励人们来找你。就算这样，我怀疑就算你消失了，也没人会注意到。

english: Oh right yes, when you left Juliet for dead and went off with her cousin.
translation: 哦对，没错，就是你丢下朱丽叶等死，然后跟她表妹跑了的时候。

english: Oh right, sure he does, goodbye.
translation: 哦对，他当然有，再见。

english: Oh sorry, I mean... I have found your hat in this box.
translation: 哦抱歉，我是说……我在这个盒子里找到了你的帽子。

english: Oh sorry... Also what's a horses?
translation: 哦抱歉……还有，马是什么？

english: Oh thank goodness you've come, [player name]. I've really made a mess of it this year.
translation: 哦谢天谢地你来了，[player name]。今年我真的把事情搞得一团糟。

english: Oh thank you! Go south to the crypt and you'll see, I'm not trying to trick you!
translation: 哦谢谢你！往南走到墓穴你就会看到，我没想骗你！

english: Oh that is clever! We can do that with the Easter eggs too.
translation: 哦，真聪明！我们也可以用复活节蛋这么做。

english: Oh that would be just the ticket! It'd have to be the right person though - I do have someone in mind...
translation: 哦，那正是我想要的！不过得是合适的人选——我确实有个人选……

english: Oh that's easy. We can use some of the old diving gear from the camp. It is pretty heavy stuff mind you so we will only be able to walk on the ocean floor, not swim.
translation: 哦，那简单。我们可以用营地里的一些旧潜水装备。不过那东西很重，所以我们只能在海底走，不能游泳。

english: Oh that's so sweet! Can you read it for me?
translation: 哦，真贴心！你能读给我听吗？

english: Oh that's unlucky! You hit the 100 coal limit and were eliminated.
translation: 哦，真倒霉！你达到了100块煤的上限，被淘汰了。

english: Oh that's unlucky! You were pummelled with snowballs.
translation: 哦，真倒霉！你被雪球砸扁了。

english: Oh the energies I will devour...
translation: 哦，我将吞噬的能量……

english: Oh these would all be such wonderful friends to my dear girl! But if I had to be picky, maybe something that could work as another farming dog - are any of these herders?
translation: 哦，这些都能成为我亲爱的姑娘的好朋友！但如果非要挑剔的话，也许能当另一只农业犬的——这些里面有牧羊犬吗？

english: Oh they're just moving about as they see fit. It shouldn't be a problem for an agile biped like you!
translation: 哦，它们只是随意移动。对你这样敏捷的两足动物来说应该不成问题！

english: Oh this is just my normal face, don't mind me!
translation: 哦，这只是我的正常脸，别在意我！

english: Oh this one's harmless. It seems to have a habit of following me everytime I enter my slayer dungeon to rescue yet another fool who thought they could finish that final slayer monster with no food and low HP.
translation: 哦，这个无害。它似乎有个习惯，每次我进入我的杀戮地牢去救又一个以为没食物、低血量就能干掉最终杀戮怪物的傻瓜时，它都会跟着我。

english: Oh very well indeed!
translation: 哦，确实非常好！

english: Oh wait, I don't have any Quality Violet Tulip seeds. Someone bought the last of them from me earlier.
translation: 哦等等，我没有优质紫色郁金香种子了。之前有人从我这里买走了最后一批。

english: Oh well every so often we get a little bit hyperactive and any static magic floating around starts gathering around us. This then sometimes builds up and becomes more and more unstable.
translation: 哦，好吧，我们时不时会有点过度活跃，周围漂浮的静态魔法就会开始聚集在我们身边。然后有时会积累起来，变得越来越不稳定。

english: Oh would you? That would be great!
translation: 哦，你愿意吗？那太好了！

english: Oh wow, he is just the man for me hehehehe.
translation: 哦哇，他正是我的真命天子，呵呵呵呵。

english: Oh wow, not too close! That smells extremely hot!
translation: 哦哇，别靠太近！那闻起来超级烫！

english: Oh wow, there's my dad's old steel plate armour in there. He is not going to be happy when he realises that has gone missing.
translation: 哦哇，那里有我爸爸的旧钢制板甲。他发现不见了肯定不会高兴。

english: Oh yeah! That was a good day.
translation: 哦耶！那是美好的一天。

english: Oh yeah, oops. This time I will make the juice. Promise!
translation: 哦对，哎呀。这次我会做果汁。保证！

english: Oh yeah, that reminds me.
translation: 哦对，那提醒了我。

english: Oh yeah, they were here before.
translation: 哦对，他们之前来过这里。

english: Oh yeah, we wouldn't want this to become ridiculous.
translation: 哦对，我们可不想让这变得荒谬。

english: Oh yeah, you'll need a Treat cauldron to put all your treats in...
translation: 哦对，你需要一个糖果埚来放你所有的糖果……

english: Oh yes indeed. The sound of a large metallic hammer hitting someones skull has a reassuring quality you just don't get with staves. If they open their mouth at the same time you get a cool hollowed echoey effect too. "Twonk!"
translation: 哦，确实如此。大铁锤砸在某人头骨上的声音有一种令人安心的特质，这是法杖无法比拟的。如果他们同时张开嘴，还会产生一种很酷的空洞回声效果。‘咚！’

english: Oh yes my Herblore supplies! Thanks!
translation: 哦对，我的草药学材料！谢谢！

english: Oh yes this is great. I'll be done in no time.
translation: 哦对，这太棒了。我马上就能搞定。

english: Oh yes! You've definitely captured the flavour I wanted but I don't think it's the right flavour for our customers.
translation: 哦对！你确实抓住了我想要的味，但我觉得这不是适合我们顾客的口味。

english: Oh yes, I forgot about that. Could you deliver the shipment to him for me?
translation: 哦对，我忘了那件事。你能帮我把这批货送给他吗？

english: Oh yes, I forgot about that. I've a second contract to fill. I'm meant to be making tree decorations, it pays less so I'm less bothered about it, but still if you want to help out painting the decorations I'll be happy to
translation: 哦对，我忘了那件事。我还有第二个合同要完成。我本来要做树饰，报酬少一些，所以我不太在意，但如果你愿意帮忙给装饰品上色，我还是很乐意的。

english: Oh yes, I'm sorry to disturb your... guarding. I just have a question for you, regarding this pathetic prisoner.
translation: 哦对，抱歉打扰你的……守卫工作。我只是有个问题想问你，关于这个可怜的囚犯。

english: Oh yes, and his imps stole all those beads from Wizard Mizgog.
translation: 哦对，他的小鬼们从魔法师米兹戈格那里偷走了所有珠子。

english: Oh yes, my mother was one. And my father. And their parents before them.
translation: 哦对，我母亲就是其中之一。我父亲也是。还有他们之前的父母。

english: Oh yes, so I am.
translation: 哦对，我确实是。

english: Oh yes, so you did. I hope you liked your basket.
translation: 哦对，你确实给了。希望你喜欢你的篮子。

english: Oh yes, someone to share a beer with would make all the difference to this party.
translation: 哦对，有人一起喝杯啤酒，这场派对就完全不同了。

english: Oh yes, that is astounding!
translation: 哦对，那太惊人了！

english: Oh yes. In fact, I sell to humans far more than I sell to tortugans. Most of our kind have no issues with catching their own fish, and can normally do so without all these tools you humans use.
translation: 哦对。事实上，我卖给人类的比卖给龟族的多得多。我们大多数同类自己捕鱼都没问题，而且通常不需要你们人类用的这些工具就能做到。

english: Oh yes. Usually in a cupboard or attic, or toilet, where we won't disturb anyone much. Also, we like to crawl into your beds while you're sleeping, just for the warmth.
translation: 哦对。通常在橱柜、阁楼或厕所里，这样我们不会太打扰别人。还有，我们喜欢在你们睡觉时爬进你们的床，只是为了取暖。

english: Oh you know how it is, these things take time.
translation: 哦，你知道的，这些事情需要时间。

english: Oh you poor thing. I feel like I should take you in, but I can't face having to deal with the fleas.
translation: 哦，你这可怜的小东西。我觉得应该收留你，但我实在不想处理跳蚤。

english: Oh you'll be wanting a time bubble for that. Fantastic little things.
translation: 哦，那你需要一个时间泡泡。神奇的小玩意儿。

english: Oh you're so silly, sweetykins!
translation: 哦，你真傻，小甜心！

english: Oh! I suppose I do do that. I just... I just want to get on with it, you know?
translation: 哦！我想我确实会那样做。我只是……我只是想继续下去，你知道吗？

english: Oh! I understand now. The Easter Bunny is making some fuel and he needs the Special Spice blend for the mixture.
translation: 哦！我现在明白了。复活节兔子正在制作某种燃料，他需要特制香料混合物来调配。

english: Oh! Is that all! No need to go in for that, I really don't care what happens to it now. How dare he treat us like this.
translation: 哦！就这？没必要进去了，我现在根本不在乎它怎样了。他竟敢这样对我们。

english: Oh! It is such an honour! Thank you, master.
translation: 哦！真是莫大的荣幸！谢谢您，主人。

english: Oh! Let me see if I can sort you out.
translation: 哦！让我看看能不能帮你解决。

english: Oh! This cake tin? I found it lying on the ground.
translation: 哦！这个蛋糕模具？是我在地上捡到的。

english: Oh! You can't hold this right now, I'll give it to Patty for safekeeping!
translation: 哦！你现在拿不了这个，我交给帕蒂保管吧！

english: Oh, Ahem... I'm not filling in for Santa anymore. He and I have had a chat, and agreed that I should step down from that job.
translation: 哦，咳咳……我不再代班圣诞老人了。我和他谈过了，都同意我应该辞去这份工作。

english: Oh, Burntmeat? I know them!
translation: 哦，烧肉？我认识他们！

english: Oh, I am sorry.
translation: 哦，我很抱歉。

english: Oh, I appreciate a good trick as much as anyone!
translation: 哦，我和大家一样喜欢好把戏！

english: Oh, I can see why. You are a big rabbit! I've been on lots of adventures so I'm not really scared of anything anymore.
translation: 哦，我明白了。你是一只大兔子！我经历过很多冒险，所以已经没什么好怕的了。

english: Oh, I can't stomach this. [player name], won't you help me find the missing egg?
translation: 哦，我受不了了。[player name]，你能帮我找到丢失的蛋吗？

english: Oh, I could go fetch it if you'd like?
translation: 哦，如果你愿意，我可以去拿？

english: Oh, I didn't bring Gary. At least he's probably not far away.
translation: 哦，我没带加里来。不过至少他应该离得不远。

english: Oh, I didn't even notice that!
translation: 哦，我都没注意到！

english: Oh, I do have something! Aven said there is another trader near a bank, maybe it's a bank in Varrock?
translation: 哦，我确实有点线索！艾文说银行附近还有另一个商人，也许是维洛克城的银行？

english: Oh, I don't think I could. I think I need a lie down and a think.
translation: 哦，我觉得我做不到。我想我需要躺下来好好想想。

english: Oh, I have no clue how to solve that. If they have a holiday then we don't have the toys for Christmas.
translation: 哦，我完全不知道该怎么解决。如果他们放假了，那圣诞节我们就没玩具了。

english: Oh, I love weird outfits, thank you so much!
translation: 哦，我喜欢古怪的服装，太感谢了！

english: Oh, I see what you're saying.
translation: 哦，我明白你的意思了。

english: Oh, I see you put the door in already. 134217728--> 125-->
Oh, I suppose I can spare you a bit of turkey.
translation: 哦，我想我可以分你一点火鸡肉。

english: Oh, I suppose so. I'll just need to remember.
translation: 哦，我想是吧。我得记住才行。

english: Oh, I suppose so...
translation: 哦，我想是吧……

english: Oh, I thought you meant...
translation: 哦，我还以为你是指……

english: Oh, I was hoping for that sort of thing.
translation: 哦，我正希望是那种事。

english: Oh, I was not expecting that plot twist!
translation: 哦，真没想到会有这种转折！

english: Oh, I'd better free up an inventory slot.
translation: 哦，我最好腾出一个背包格子。

english: Oh, I'll leave it alone.
translation: 哦，我就不管它了。

english: Oh, I'm just making sure they won't be a danger anymore.
translation: 哦，我只是确保它们不再构成威胁。

english: Oh, I'm not sure actually! I'll have to check with Pete.
translation: 哦，其实我也不确定！我得跟皮特确认一下。

english: Oh, I'm occasionally hearing reports of some of the developers transmogrifying into a form, similar to myself, and then parading around as me.
translation: 哦，我偶尔会听到报告说有些开发者变形变成类似我的样子，然后冒充我到处招摇。

english: Oh, I'm sorry that is incorrect...
translation: 哦，抱歉，那不对……

english: Oh, I'm sorry to bother you. Perhaps another time...
translation: 哦，抱歉打扰你了。也许下次吧……

english: Oh, I'm sorry. I hope you can come back another time.
translation: 哦，抱歉。希望你能改天再来。

english: Oh, I'm sure I had it just a second ago. I'll track it down!
translation: 哦，我确定刚才还在的。我会找到它的！

english: Oh, I'm sure you'll be fine!
translation: 哦，我相信你会没事的！

english: Oh, I've always wanted to be able to grow a tree! This is the best day of my life!
translation: 哦，我一直希望能种一棵树！这是我一生中最棒的一天！

english: Oh, [player name]! I just need to move all of this, now. I think it's a task I'd better undertake on my own.
translation: 哦，[player name]！我现在得把这些都搬走。我想这任务还是我自己来比较好。

english: Oh, [player name], it's everything I ever hoped for! The demons, the dragons, the orcs - all looking like they did in the old days! And my dad's even come too!
translation: 哦，[player name]，这正是我一直期盼的！恶魔、龙、兽人——全都和过去一样！连我爸爸也来了！

english: Oh, [player name], won't you help me? I need someone to gather all the chocolate kebbits up and grind them into chunks. Everything is set up to do it, I just need a kind, helpful person to do the job.
translation: 哦，[player name]，你能帮帮我吗？我需要有人把所有巧克力凯比兔收集起来，磨成碎块。一切都准备好了，就差一个好心又乐于助人的人来动手。

english: Oh, alright, I won't say anything to him.
translation: 哦，好吧，我不会跟他说什么的。

english: Oh, and I guess you can take this spooky picture. I had it up last year, but it gave my cows nightmares.
translation: 哦，我想你可以拿走这张诡异的图画。我去年挂过，但它让我的奶牛做噩梦了。

english: Oh, and if you can do something about that tree I'd be grateful.
translation: 哦，如果你能处理一下那棵树，我会很感激的。

english: Oh, and if you want to stop, just come talk to me, or destroy your bottle. You'll have to get a new one if you destroy it though!
translation: 哦，如果你想停下来，就来找我说话，或者毁掉你的瓶子。不过要是毁了，你得再弄一个新的！

english: Oh, and not forgetting your half wine!
translation: 哦，别忘了你的半瓶酒！

english: Oh, but I'd come to rescue you.
translation: 哦，但我是来救你的。

english: Oh, but it is! It is the Falador Christmas Festival soon, and I am playing the part of Santa for the grotto.
translation: 哦，但确实如此！法拉多城的圣诞节庆典快到了，我要在洞穴里扮演圣诞老人。

english: Oh, but you'll need some inventory space before you go.
translation: 哦，但你走之前得腾出一些背包空间。

english: Oh, come on...do something nice for Tassie.
translation: 哦，拜托……为塔西做点好事吧。

english: Oh, does it look that heavy on me?
translation: 哦，它在我身上看起来有那么重吗？

english: Oh, don't be so simple-minded!
translation: 哦，别这么头脑简单！

english: Oh, don't worry! I put a magical spell on all the presents. It teleports them to me if they get lost, just in case something like this happens! One second...
translation: 哦，别担心！我给所有礼物施了魔法。万一丢了，它们会自动传送到我身边，以防这种事发生！等一下……

english: Oh, don't you feel a sense of obl-egg-ation.
translation: 哦，难道你不觉得有种蛋-任感吗？

english: Oh, for a moment I thought you were a ghost as well!
translation: 哦，有那么一瞬间我还以为你也是个幽灵！

english: Oh, ha ha. It was just joke. of course I steal from human, no problem!
translation: 哦，哈哈。只是开个玩笑。我当然偷人类的东西，没问题！

english: Oh, have you lost yours?
translation: 哦，你的丢了吗？

english: Oh, he spoke to me earlier. I thought it was a guy in a costume, not a huge bunny. Scared me half to death when I realised!
translation: 哦，他之前跟我说话了。我还以为是个穿戏服的人，不是一只大兔子。发现真相时差点把我吓死！

english: Oh, he's a little wizard? Hello.
translation: 哦，他是个小魔法师？你好。

english: Oh, he's gone. Whoops. I'll go back and fetch him.
translation: 哦，他不见了。哎呀。我回去找他。

english: Oh, he's gone...
translation: 哦，他走了……

english: Oh, hello [player name]. Always good to see a friend.
translation: 哦，你好，[player name]。见到朋友总是很高兴。

english: Oh, hello there! Actually, no, everything's not alright. I've made a terrible mistake...
translation: 哦，你好！其实，不，一切都不好。我犯了个大错……

english: Oh, hey there.
translation: 哦，嘿，你好。

english: Oh, him. Yes, I met Anti-Santa last Christmas. So he summoned a chocolate demon to attack Easter?
translation: 哦，他啊。是的，去年圣诞节我见过反圣诞老人。所以他召唤了一个巧克力恶魔来攻击复活节？

english: Oh, if you're restocking it, we've run out of trapped souls - all the jars are empty. Be a good serf and fill 'em up.
translation: 哦，如果你要补货，我们被困住的灵魂用完了——所有罐子都是空的。做个好农奴，把它们装满吧。

english: Oh, ignore me then. I still need to visit the grotto myself.
translation: 哦，那就别管我了。我自己还得去一趟洞穴。

english: Oh, it seems it's missing far more...
translation: 哦，看来它缺的远不止这些……

english: Oh, it was just a spider crawling across the lens!
translation: 哦，只是一只蜘蛛爬过镜头而已！

english: Oh, keep looking! Remember that this trader is at the Varrock West Bank.
translation: 哦，继续找！记住这个商人在维洛克城西银行。

english: Oh, looks like you've got no space for it. I'll hold onto it until you do.
translation: 哦，看来你没地方放它。我先帮你保管着，等你有空间了再说。

english: Oh, maybe I didn't hear it, then.
translation: 哦，那可能是我没听到吧。

english: Oh, my bad. Have a happy holiday.
translation: 哦，我的错。祝你节日快乐。

english: Oh, never mind then, that can't be right.
translation: 哦，那算了，那肯定不对。

english: Oh, never mind, I'll go back and fetch him.
translation: 哦，算了，我回去找他。

english: Oh, never mind, you don't have space for it. Come back to me when you're ready.
translation: 哦，算了，你没地方放。准备好了再来找我。

english: Oh, never mind, you don't have space. Come back to me when you have a space.
translation: 哦，算了，你没空间。等你有空位了再来找我。

english: Oh, no, I'm not in search of love. In fact, I've been helping others with their search today.
translation: 哦，不，我不是在寻找爱情。事实上，我今天一直在帮别人寻找。

english: Oh, okay, please carry on.
translation: 哦，好的，请继续。

english: Oh, okay. Well as before, come back if you can free up some time. I'd still welcome some help!
translation: 哦，好吧。和之前一样，如果你能腾出时间就回来。我仍然欢迎帮忙！

english: Oh, opps, I seem to have misplaced some of the seeds.
translation: 哦，哎呀，我好像把一些种子放错地方了。

english: Oh, please do.
translation: 哦，请便。

english: Oh, really? What happened?
translation: 哦，真的吗？发生什么事了？

english: Oh, really? Why not, that would be great!
translation: 哦，真的吗？为什么不呢，那太好了！

english: Oh, right, I thought it was for Jack.
translation: 哦，对，我还以为是给杰克的。

english: Oh, right, how very nice of you to say so.
translation: 哦，对，你这么说真是太好了。

english: Oh, right. I'll hurry to the Wizards' Tower.
translation: 哦，好的。我赶紧去法师塔。

english: Oh, so I could go now?
translation: 哦，那我现在可以走了？

english: Oh, sorry I had my notes upside-down.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我把我的笔记拿反了。

english: Oh, sorry I'll go over there!
translation: 哦，抱歉，我过去那边！

english: Oh, sorry! I'll go and find another camel.
translation: 哦，抱歉！我去找另一只骆驼。

english: Oh, sorry, I thought I could lend you a hand?
translation: 哦，抱歉，我还以为我能帮你一把？

english: Oh, sorry, I thought you were doing something else.
translation: 哦，抱歉，我还以为你在做别的事。

english: Oh, take care to avoid the mine carts. They've become a bit... Independent.
translation: 哦，小心避开矿车。它们变得有点……独立了。

english: Oh, thank goodness!
translation: 哦，谢天谢地！

english: Oh, thank you! You can take eggs from the pile downstairs or dig up the eggs the rabbits bury on the surface. Hand out ten eggs then come back to me for your reward.
translation: 哦，谢谢！你可以从楼下的蛋堆里拿蛋，或者挖出兔子埋在地表的蛋。分发十个蛋，然后回来找我领奖励。

english: Oh, that does sound interesting!
translation: 哦，听起来确实有趣！

english: Oh, that does sound interesting! I wonder if they'll let me?
translation: 哦，听起来确实有趣！不知道他们会不会让我去？

english: Oh, that is okay. I have a spare.
translation: 哦，没关系。我有一个备用的。

english: Oh, that might be an issue.
translation: 哦，那可能是个问题。

english: Oh, that sounds bad.
translation: 哦，听起来不妙。

english: Oh, that's a shame. Come back if you can free up some time. I'd still welcome some help!
translation: 哦，真可惜。如果你能腾出时间就回来。我仍然欢迎帮忙！

english: Oh, that's awesome! Santa must have known you needed one!
translation: 哦，太棒了！圣诞老人一定知道你需要一个！

english: Oh, that's perfect! Just in time for the judging too.
translation: 哦，太完美了！正好赶上评审。

english: Oh, that's perfect! Let me write the place and time on those invitations, then. After that I'll need to head to the Party room to get it ready.
translation: 哦，太完美了！那让我在那些邀请函上写上地点和时间。之后我得去派对房间准备一下。

english: Oh, that's really cold!
translation: 哦，那可真冷！

english: Oh, that's us! Why do you ask?
translation: 哦，那就是我们！你问这个干嘛？

english: Oh, the banana isn't waking it up.
translation: 哦，香蕉没把它弄醒。

english: Oh, there is actually!
translation: 哦，还真有！

english: Oh, things like turning you into a rat or giving you scary old junk-
translation: 哦，比如把你变成老鼠，或者给你一些吓人的旧垃圾——

english: Oh, uh, I just find it interesting, that's all. I'm sure there will be a call for adventurers if any are needed!
translation: 哦，呃，我只是觉得有趣而已。如果需要冒险者的话，我相信一定会有人召集的！

english: Oh, uh, thank you!
translation: 哦，呃，谢谢你！

english: Oh, umm no?
translation: 哦，嗯……没有？

english: Oh, very nice. Yes, this will make me look just right as Santa. Well done.
translation: 哦，非常好。没错，这让我扮圣诞老人看起来刚刚好。干得好。

english: Oh, we spiders understand humans very well. We've been around you for years. Wherever you live, there's probably a whole colony of us there, even if you've not seen us.
translation: 哦，我们蜘蛛非常了解人类。我们在你们身边待了好多年了。无论你住在哪里，那里很可能都有我们的一大群同类，就算你没见过我们。

english: Oh, we've had plenty of discussions, mostly about resurrection, as you'd imagine.
translation: 哦，我们讨论过很多次，主要都是关于复活的事，你也能想象得到。

english: Oh, welcome to Gielinor! So many adventures await...
translation: 哦，欢迎来到吉莱诺！有那么多冒险在等着你……

english: Oh, well that is some good luck then that it's something you like so much!
translation: 哦，那还真是好运，正好是你这么喜欢的东西！

english: Oh, well, any more questions?
translation: 哦，好吧，还有什么问题吗？

english: Oh, well, keep looking! Remember that the first flower trader is 'At the place where you turn essence into the power of the body'.
translation: 哦，好吧，继续找！记住第一个花商在‘你把精华转化为身体力量的地方’。

english: Oh, well, would you like it? I have no need for it.
translation: 哦，好吧，你想要吗？我用不着它。

english: Oh, what a cute bunny! I didn't realize it was Easter already! 25 || 11 -> 25-->
translation: 哦，多可爱的兔子！我都没意识到复活节已经到了！25 || 11 -> 25-->

english: Oh, what a relief. Thank you, [player name].
translation: 哦，真是松了一口气。谢谢你，[player name]。

english: Oh, what is it?
translation: 哦，是什么？

english: Oh, what's the matter?
translation: 哦，怎么了？

english: Oh, what's the point? Who am I kidding? There's nothing heroic about what I'm doing.
translation: 哦，有什么意义呢？我在骗谁呢？我做的事一点也不英勇。

english: Oh, where's the beard?
translation: 哦，胡子呢？

english: Oh, where?
translation: 哦，哪里？

english: Oh, why's that?
translation: 哦，为什么？

english: Oh, wow! Look at that!
translation: 哦，哇！快看那个！

english: Oh, yeah, right, thanks boss!
translation: 哦，对，没错，谢谢老板！

english: Oh, yes, I've crafted outfits from all kinds of pelts from hunters. It's an odd ask, but I suppose I can spare a little stuff...
translation: 哦，是的，我用猎人们带来的各种毛皮做过衣服。这个要求有点奇怪，不过我想我能匀出一点材料……

english: Oh, yes. Sorry, I've just been sent over to collect some of Elder Degga's things. She passed away a few days ago.
translation: 哦，是的。抱歉，我刚被派来收集德加长老的一些遗物。她几天前去世了。

english: Oh, you appear to be missing a scroll. Here have this replacement.
translation: 哦，你好像少了一张卷轴。给你这张替代品。

english: Oh, you can keep it for your hard work - if you need another or more cards, I'm sure Diango can help you out.
translation: 哦，这个你留着作为辛苦工作的奖励吧——如果你还需要更多卡片，我相信迪亚戈能帮你。

english: Oh, you don't appear to have the space to take them. Make some room in your inventory and talk to me again.
translation: 哦，你好像没有空间拿它们。在背包里腾出点地方再来找我。

english: Oh, you don't have any room for the notes. Come back when you have a space!
translation: 哦，你没有空间放这些笔记了。等有空位了再来吧！

english: Oh, you don't have any space for a new cooler. Come back when you have space.
translation: 哦，你没有空间放新的冷却器了。等有空位了再来吧。

english: Oh, you don't have any space for it!
translation: 哦，你没有空间放它了！

english: Oh, you don't have enough space for it! Come back when you have some room.
translation: 哦，你没有足够的空间放它！等腾出点地方再来吧。

english: Oh, you don't have enough space to hold it right now. I'll keep it here for you when you're ready.
translation: 哦，你现在没有足够的空间拿它。我会替你保管在这里，等你准备好了再来。

english: Oh, you don't have enough space to hold it. Come back to me when you have a space free.
translation: 哦，你没有足够的空间拿它。等你有空位了再来找我。

english: Oh, you don't have enough space to hold one right now, I'll make it when you have room.
translation: 哦，你现在没有足够的空间拿一个，等你有空位了我再做。

english: Oh, you don't have enough space to hold them both right now. Come talk to me when you've got more space in your inventory.
translation: 哦，你现在没有足够的空间同时拿它们两个。等背包里空间多了再来找我。

english: Oh, you don't have enough space to hold them. Come back to me when you have two spaces free.
translation: 哦，你没有足够的空间拿它们。等你有两个空位了再来找我。

english: Oh, you don't have space for the camel milk. Get some space and talk to me again.
translation: 哦，你没有空间放骆驼奶了。腾出点地方再来找我。

english: Oh, you don't have space for the churn. Come back when you have space.
translation: 哦，你没有空间放搅拌器了。等有空位了再来吧。

english: Oh, you don't have space for the milk. Come back when you have space.
translation: 哦，你没有空间放牛奶了。等有空位了再来吧。

english: Oh, you have a voucher. I'll accept it while making you planks.
translation: 哦，你有一张凭证。我会收下它，同时给你做木板。

english: Oh, you have no space for the bucket. Come back when you have space.
translation: 哦，你没有空间放桶了。等有空位了再来吧。

english: Oh, you haven't heard? There is quite the dilemma going on in Misthalin right now.
translation: 哦，你没听说吗？米斯萨林现在正面临一个相当棘手的困境。

english: Oh, you should be aware as well; I threw the vat away because it got badly stained by the various chemicals used in tanning.
translation: 哦，你也应该知道；我把大桶扔了，因为它被鞣制过程中使用的各种化学物质严重污染了。

english: Oh, you should go to the Shantay Pass and test the eggs there. It's the perfect temperature.
translation: 哦，你应该去沙泰隘口测试那里的蛋。那里的温度刚刚好。

english: Oh, you should have said! What is it? Maybe I can help in exchange for some of that festive cinnamon!
translation: 哦，你早该说的！是什么事？也许我可以帮忙，换一些那种节日肉桂！

english: Oh, you still don't have any room for the notes. Come back when you have a space!
translation: 哦，你仍然没有空间放这些笔记。等有空位了再来吧！

english: Oh, you still don't have space for the camel milk. Get some space and talk to me again.
translation: 哦，你仍然没有空间放骆驼奶。腾出点地方再来找我。

english: Oh, you still have no space for the bucket. Come back when you have space.
translation: 哦，你仍然没有空间放桶。等有空位了再来吧。

english: Oh, you want to work in another area of the mine eh? Well, I can understand that! A change is as good as a rest they say.
translation: 哦，你想在矿场的另一个区域工作，嗯？好吧，我能理解！俗话说，换换环境等于休息。

english: Oh, you'll know him when you see him.
translation: 哦，你见到他就知道了。

english: Oh, you'll love this, everything is gone!
translation: 哦，你会喜欢的，全都没了！

english: Oh. But how have you been listening to me talking all this time?
translation: 哦。但你刚才怎么一直在听我说话？

english: Oh. Fair enough. May I ask why?
translation: 哦。有道理。我能问为什么吗？

english: Oh. I expected worse..
translation: 哦。我本以为会更糟……

english: Oh. It appears you are right.
translation: 哦。看来你是对的。

english: Oh. Okay... I think I can see them?
translation: 哦。好吧……我想我能看到它们？

english: Oh. Uhm. Me goblin, just like you. Also dead, because stupid human use stab-stick on me.
translation: 哦。嗯。俺是哥布林，跟你一样。也死了，因为愚蠢的人类用戳棍捅俺。

english: Oh. Very well then, let me know if you change your mind.
translation: 哦。那好吧，如果你改变主意了告诉我。

english: Oh. Well, what help do you want?
translation: 哦。好吧，你想要什么帮助？

english: Oh. Yes. That could be a problem.
translation: 哦。是的。那可能是个问题。

english: Oh... I have no idea. I'll go check it out.
translation: 哦……我不知道。我去看看。

english: Oh... I'm back where I started.
translation: 哦……我又回到了起点。

english: Oh... Oh no no... Please [player name]. Whatever you do, keep an eye on him.
translation: 哦……哦不不……拜托了[player name]。无论你做什么，都要盯紧他。

english: Oh... Right, sorry. Merry Christmas?
translation: 哦……对，抱歉。圣诞快乐？

english: Oh... Yes, of course. We're just trying to write these poems.
translation: 哦……是的，当然。我们只是在试着写这些诗。

english: Oh... drat. Maybe I should just use the Grand Exchange.
translation: 哦……该死。也许我该直接用大交易所。

english: Oh... ehrm... sure...?
Oh... is this supposed to make me happy? Go on then, get it over with.
translation: 哦……这应该让我高兴吗？那来吧，快点结束。

english: Oh... who are you?
translation: 哦……你是谁？

english: Oh... yes it would be awful if you all lost your...
translation: 哦……是的，如果你们都失去了你们的……那会很糟糕。

english: Oh? Do elaborate.
translation: 哦？请详细说说。

english: Oh? Do you think you could help us out?
translation: 哦？你觉得你能帮我们吗？

english: Oh? How come you're here instead then?
translation: 哦？那你为什么会在这里？

english: Oh? I'd be happy to help. What is the issue?
translation: 哦？我很乐意帮忙。是什么问题？

english: Oh? That's okay... I guess I didn't need help after all! Chocco has created four new flavours of Easter egg and they're wildly popular!
translation: 哦？那好吧……看来我根本不需要帮忙！乔可创造了四种新口味的复活节彩蛋，它们大受欢迎！

english: Ohhh. Yeh. I met you before. You got me beer! Very kind.
translation: 哦哦。是啊。我以前见过你。你给过我啤酒！太客气了。

english: Ohhhh right, you should have said! How about... Choc-ice Eggs?
translation: 哦哦哦对，你早该说的！不如……巧克力冰棍蛋？

english: Oi! Have you seen any eggs?!
translation: 喂！你看到蛋了吗？！

english: Oi! You stay away from there! If you want anything, you're going to have to come talk to me!
translation: 喂！你离那里远点！如果你想要什么东西，就得过来跟我谈！

english: Oi. Weren't you told to go to the garden first?
translation: 喂。不是叫你先去花园吗？

english: Oil Lantern Frames.
translation: 油灯笼框架。

english: Ok I lied.
translation: 好吧我撒谎了。

english: Ok I'll get to it.
translation: 好吧我这就去办。

english: Ok then! Good luck!
translation: 那好吧！祝你好运！

english: Ok what do I do?
translation: 好吧我该做什么？

english: Ok you's creature, here's da hatsies!
translation: 好吧你个小生物，帽子们给你！

english: Ok, I guess. What do I have to do?
translation: 好吧，我想是吧。我得做什么？

english: Ok, I know where I can get snow.
translation: 好吧，我知道哪里能弄到雪。

english: Ok, I will wait here for you, and then we will go together.
translation: 好吧，我在这里等你，然后我们一起去。

english: Ok, I'll go do that then.
translation: 好吧，那我就去做了。

english: Ok, I'll go find Diango.
translation: 好吧，我去找迪亚戈。

english: Ok, I'll go find him.
translation: 好吧，我去找他。

english: Ok, I'll let you think about it for a bit longer.
translation: 好吧，我再让你多考虑一会儿。

english: Ok, I'll speak to Ellis the tanner and see if I can find out more.
translation: 好，我去跟鞣皮师埃利斯谈谈，看看能不能问出更多线索。

english: Ok, I'm done with you.
translation: 好了，我没别的事了。

english: Ok, a little short one then. One day a very kind adventurer came and brought me a warm cup of tea.
translation: 好吧，那就讲个短的。有一天，一位非常善良的冒险者过来，给我端来了一杯热茶。

english: Ok, are you ready for the recipe?
translation: 好，你准备好听食谱了吗？

english: Ok, but I don't know where he is!
translation: 好，但我不知道他在哪！

english: Ok, everybody ready?
translation: 好，大家都准备好了吗？

english: Ok, get a torso from the torso box. You gots it?
translation: 好，从躯干箱里拿一个躯干出来。拿到了吗？

english: Ok, give me a minute.
translation: 好，给我一分钟。

english: Ok, if you win, you'll get 12 gold back. Anyway, I have to get going, I do have work to do.
translation: 好，如果你赢了，就能拿回12金币。总之我得走了，我还有工作要做。

english: Ok, just so I know what I'm getting into, I have to put together some toys in your workshop, pack them in a box, and deliver them, right? Where is the drop-off point?
translation: 好，我先确认一下我要做什么：在你的工作室里组装一些玩具，把它们装进箱子，然后送货上门，对吧？交货点在哪？

english: Ok, let's give this a try...
translation: 好，我们来试试看……

english: Ok, ok, keep your ears on. I just had to pluck up my courage.
translation: 好了好了，竖起耳朵听好。我只是需要鼓起勇气。

english: Ok, ok. I'll help.
translation: 好吧好吧，我帮忙就是了。

english: Ok, ok. I'll help. But you're doing most of the work.
translation: 好吧好吧，我帮忙就是了。但大部分活还是你来干。

english: Ok, so let me get this straight. First I mine some chocolate, then I navigate this maze, which might I add, seems a little unnecessary.
translation: 好，让我理一下。首先我要挖一些巧克力，然后穿过这个迷宫——顺便说一句，这迷宫看起来有点多余。

english: Ok, so what do you want me to do then?
translation: 好，那你到底想让我做什么？

english: Ok, thanks for the information!
translation: 好，谢谢你的情报！

english: Ok, that's weird!
translation: 好，这真奇怪！

english: Ok, touching him seems to be a bad idea.
translation: 好，碰他看来不是个好主意。

english: Ok, what paint do you need?
translation: 好，你需要什么颜料？

english: Ok. I don't supose you have any other rewards apart from a creepy mask?
translation: 好吧。除了一个吓人的面具，你应该没有其他奖励了吧？

english: Ok. I've got this noted down. Now what about a reward or payment for the job? What were you thinking?
translation: 好，我都记下来了。那这份工作的报酬或酬劳呢？你打算给多少？

english: Okay Diango, I'll just run to the bank!
translation: 好的迪亚戈，我马上去银行一趟！

english: Okay I will go and speak to the Oracle.
translation: 好的，我去找神谕者谈谈。

english: Okay I'll try that, thanks.
translation: 好的，我试试看，谢谢。

english: Okay fine, freshen me up!
translation: 好吧好吧，给我换个新造型！

english: Okay fine, freshen me up! I suppose I could do with a good haircut.
translation: 好吧好吧，给我换个新造型！我想我也该好好理个发了。

english: Okay ma'am.
translation: 好的，夫人。

english: Okay mortal, as you wish.
translation: 好吧，凡人，如你所愿。

english: Okay okay, let's all calm down. Do you believe me now?
translation: 好了好了，大家都冷静点。现在你相信我了吧？

english: Okay then, I'll let Pete know we may be at a loss with the candle.
translation: 好吧，那我跟皮特说一声，蜡烛的事我们可能没辙了。

english: Okay then, let me think... Yes! He's out near the mine to the South-West of Varrock.
translation: 好吧，让我想想……对了！他在维洛克城西南边的矿场附近。

english: Okay! I'll be going then!
translation: 好吧！那我走了！

english: Okay! I'll gladly help if it means I can go play.
translation: 好的！如果能让我去玩，我很乐意帮忙。

english: Okay's now you's needs to cook da chompy! Slurp! You's can cook it's over der!
translation: 好咯，现在你该去煮那只胖胖鸟了！吸溜！你可以在那边煮它！

english: Okay, 11 1 14 5 12, do you know where the egg mould is?
translation: 好，11 1 14 5 12，你知道鸡蛋模具在哪吗？

english: Okay, I believe you. There is only one person who has that!
translation: 好吧，我相信你。只有一个人会有那个东西！

english: Okay, I better go find some things.
translation: 好，我最好去找些东西。

english: Okay, I guess I don't have much of a choice.
translation: 好吧，我想我也没多少选择。

english: Okay, I guess. I'll go and fetch you a kebab.
translation: 好吧，我想也是。我去给你弄个烤肉来。

english: Okay, I have all your rocks here, let me out now.
translation: 好，你的石头都在我这里了，现在放我出去吧。

english: Okay, I made it up. It's my first day and I wanted to promote a united attitude.
translation: 好吧，我承认是我编的。今天是我第一天上班，我想提倡一下团结精神。

english: Okay, I try do my best.
translation: 好的，我会尽力而为。

english: Okay, I'll be right here waiting!
translation: 好的，我就在这儿等着！

english: Okay, I'll come back another time.
translation: 好的，我改天再来。

english: Okay, I'll go and do that now.
translation: 好的，我现在就去办。

english: Okay, I'll go and fetch them.
translation: 好的，我去把它们拿来。

english: Okay, I'll go fetch cow blood.
translation: 好的，我去弄牛血来。

english: Okay, I'll have another go.
translation: 好的，我再试一次。

english: Okay, I'll help you.
translation: 好的，我来帮你。

english: Okay, I'll keep an eye out for the blue ones next trip.
translation: 好的，下次我会留意那些蓝色的。

english: Okay, I'll report back once I know more.
translation: 好的，等我了解更多情况后再回来报告。

english: Okay, I'll visit Diango now.
translation: 好的，我现在就去找迪亚戈。

english: Okay, I'll wait here for you. Just talk to me when you're ready!
translation: 好的，我在这儿等你。准备好了就跟我说一声！

english: Okay, I'm done asking questions. What now?
translation: 好了，我问完了。接下来呢？

english: Okay, I'm going over there now.
translation: 好的，我现在就过去那边。

english: Okay, I've burnt the pizza. I think it has somehow improved it! Guess I should show it to My Arm.
translation: 好吧，我把披萨烤焦了。但我觉得反而更好吃了！看来应该拿给'我的手臂'看看。

english: Okay, Iffie?
translation: 好的，伊菲？

english: Okay, after that?
translation: 好，然后呢？

english: Okay, and how will we communicate?
translation: 好，那我们怎么联络？

english: Okay, as you wish. Well, the advert did say I was looking for a ghost.
translation: 好吧，如你所愿。不过广告上确实说我要找一个幽灵。

english: Okay, but be quick, we don't know who is watching.
translation: 好，但动作快点，我们不知道谁在看着。

english: Okay, but even if we shout for him, it's not like he would hear us down here.
translation: 好，但就算我们喊他，他在下面也听不见。

english: Okay, clearly they have no idea of what happened to them, I think you're right. They don't remember anything.
translation: 好吧，他们显然完全不知道发生了什么，你说得对。他们什么都不记得了。

english: Okay, don't be long.
translation: 好，别去太久。

english: Okay, don't be too long, the saucepan is quite heavy on my head!
translation: 好，别太久，平底锅顶在我头上好重！

english: Okay, feel free to come back to me when you're ready to head to Falador!
translation: 好，等你准备好去法拉多城的时候，随时可以回来找我！

english: Okay, feel free to head in when you're ready. Make sure to check out the rest of the festival afterwards. Merry Christmas!
translation: 好，准备好了就进去吧。别忘了之后逛逛节日的其他地方。圣诞快乐！

english: Okay, got those noted down.
translation: 好，都记下来了。

english: Okay, have a bite (Offer a blood tithe).
translation: 好，咬一口（献上血税）。

english: Okay, here are your rewards.
translation: 好，这是你的奖励。

english: Okay, here you go. Luckily we made enough ice cream earlier!
translation: 好，给你。幸好我们之前做了足够的冰淇淋！

english: Okay, here's a little something I got the professor to whip together to deal with this little problem.
translation: 好，这是我让教授赶制出来解决这个小问题的小玩意儿。

english: Okay, how about... Chocolate Eggs With Nice Cold Ice Cream Centre?
translation: 好，那……巧克力蛋配冰凉冰淇淋夹心怎么样？

english: Okay, how do I get over there?
translation: 好，我怎么过去那边？

english: Okay, last year we had a lot of pressure when it came to Christmas. Trying to fill the orders got a little hectic, if you get my drift.
translation: 好，去年圣诞节的时候我们压力很大。订单多得有点手忙脚乱，你懂我的意思吧。

english: Okay, let's carry on.
translation: 好，我们继续吧。

english: Okay, let's get on with it.
translation: 好，我们开始吧。

english: Okay, let's go there instead.
translation: 好，那我们去那边吧。

english: Okay, let's try this.
translation: 好，我们试试这个。

english: Okay, my crate is filled with ice coolers! A friend of mine is a Slayer master, and recommended them to me as a way to keep things cool.
translation: 好，我的箱子里装满了冰袋！我有个朋友是杀戮大师，他推荐我用这个来保持低温。

english: Okay, no problem. Bye!
translation: 好，没问题。再见！

english: Okay, off I go to Rimmington.
translation: 好，我这就去里明顿村。

english: Okay, okay! And what about banging it with the rolling pin? Isn't that loud?
translation: 好了好了！那用擀面杖敲它呢？那声音不大吗？

english: Okay, one moo for yes, two moo's for no. Got it?
translation: 好，哞一声表示是，哞两声表示否。明白了吗？

english: Okay, order up!
translation: 好，上菜！

english: Okay, panic over. You should go back to my associate and collect a new copy, I do actually want to read it.
translation: 好，虚惊一场。你应该回去找我同事拿一份新的，我确实想读一读。

english: Okay, remove the upgrade.
translation: 好，移除升级。

english: Okay, so I have it all set up. There is a bear trap here that we need to lure Jonas onto.
translation: 好，我都布置好了。这里有个捕熊陷阱，我们要把乔纳斯引上去。

english: Okay, so we want six colours. Red, orange, yellow, green, indigo and violet. I've already got some Green Carnation seeds here that I found earlier.
translation: 好，我们需要六种颜色：红、橙、黄、绿、靛、紫。我之前已经找到了一些绿色康乃馨种子。

english: Okay, so what is the plan? We need to scare someone?
translation: 好，那计划是什么？我们要吓唬人？

english: Okay, so what items do I need to gather?
translation: 好，那我需要收集哪些物品？

english: Okay, so, do you have any ideas for what to do?
translation: 好，那你有什么想法吗？

english: Okay, so, do you have any ideas?
translation: 好，你有什么主意吗？

english: Okay, sorry.
translation: 好，抱歉。

english: Okay, thanks for sharing, but I need to get her started on the birthday party or there won't be one this year.
translation: 好，谢谢分享，但我得让她开始准备生日派对了，不然今年就没得办了。

english: Okay, thanks. I'll be back with the captured monkeys soon.
translation: 好，谢谢。我很快就会带着抓到的猴子回来。

english: Okay, that all sounds exciting, but why is that a problem?
translation: 好，听起来都很刺激，但这有什么问题吗？

english: Okay, that sounds about right. Back to business I suppose!
translation: 好，听起来差不多。我想我们该回去工作了！

english: Okay, that sounds about right. Can I have the Ghost Buster?
translation: 好，听起来差不多。能把幽灵克星给我吗？

english: Okay, uncharge it.
translation: 好，解除充能。

english: Okay, well, I think I have enough to go on anyway! I shall go and look for these seeds.
translation: 好吧，我觉得我掌握的信息已经足够了！我这就去找这些种子。

english: Okay, well, I'm not going anywhere! Unless he feels generous enough to let me go!
translation: 好吧，我哪儿也不去！除非他大发慈悲放我走！

english: Okay, well, you know where to find me if you change your mind.
translation: 好吧，如果你改变主意了，你知道上哪儿找我。

english: Okay, yeah. I can work with that.
translation: 好的，没问题。这个我能搞定。

english: Okay, you better be off then! We need to get some eggs delivered.
translation: 好了，那你快去吧！我们还得送些蛋呢。

english: Okay, you get that done whilst I paint the sword.
translation: 好的，你去办那件事，我来给剑上色。

english: Okay. Make sure to come back soon, you don't want to miss out on the present!
translation: 好的。记得快点回来，你可不想错过礼物吧！

english: Okay. Moving on swiftly to...
translation: 好的。我们赶紧进入下一个话题……

english: Okay. Now you have your ticket, do you want to sail anywhere?
translation: 好了。现在你拿到票了，想坐船去哪儿吗？

english: Okay. Please come back if you do get some time, these eggs need delivering!
translation: 好的。如果你有空的话请一定回来，这些蛋需要送出去！

english: Okay... and?
translation: 好吧……然后呢？

english: Ol' Shanty's got another prize for ye that'll make yer landlubbin' heart beat full bore. Ye'll be needing a patch o' dirt for yer dry-docked ship for this.

translation: 老人亚洛是个退休的建筑工人。他能帮我们弄到一件关于建筑的纪念品。他就住在我们见面的地方往东北一点。

english: Old School players have donated [number] Old School bonds so far to the WWF.
translation: 截至目前，Old School 的玩家们已经向世界自然基金会捐赠了 [number] 张 Old School 债券。

translation: 想了想，你觉得多尔夫的鼻子现在应该够亮了。

translation: 在蓝月旅馆的屋顶上，有个人精通敏捷。我想我们可以通过旅馆西边阳台上的梯子爬上去。

translation: 这次，如果你希望以新身份代表白骑士，我们会配发标准制式盔甲。这将是你训练的开始。

translation: 进入下一局！祝你好运！

translation: 你又站在我面前了。

english: Once upon a time, there lived a boy called Derek.
translation: 从前，有个叫德里克的男孩。

translation: 游戏结束后，你会回到这里的挑战室，可以再次挑战！我们在世界各地的几家酒馆里也设有桌子！

english: Once you have your rewards, please come upstairs to join my party.
translation: 拿到奖励后，请上楼来参加我的派对。

translation: 一个（当前）。

translation: 答对一题，还剩两个问题。这是下一个问题。

translation: 一位顾客每小时喝 2.5 杯啤酒。每杯啤酒让他醉意增加 4 点，但每小时他会自然恢复 1 点。7 小时后他会有多醉？

translation: 最后试一次。

translation: 最后再努力一把。洞穴的墙壁现在指引着你走向光明。

translation: 再转一圈，确保一切就绪。

translation: 其中一个巧克力蛋把我变成了兔子。

translation: 杂货店的一个工人本该送一板条箱的篮子给我，但我还没收到。

translation: 圣诞节的重头戏之一就是圣诞树。通常我们会把一棵大树——比如松树——搬进屋里，然后好好装饰一番。

english: Queen Zyanyi arrived at the House and asked to be left alone with Forebearer Janus so that she could interrogate him. By the time we returned later, Janus was dead. According to him, they believe the Crypt to contain a path to Mokhaiotl. To achieve entry into the Crypt, the Emissaries are apparently seeking help from some Dwarves in Cam Torum. The Queen has decided that we must investigate this. I should speak to her when I'm ready to depart for Cam Torum. Alternatively, I can make my own way there.
translation: 齐扬伊女王抵达了那栋房子，并要求与先驱者雅努斯单独相处，以便审问他。等我们稍后返回时，雅努斯已经死了。不过，在他死前，他告诉了女王关于使者们计划利用伊茨拉进入特拉提雨林中的托纳利墓穴的事。据他说，他们相信墓穴中有一条通往莫卡约特尔的道路。为了进入墓穴，使者们显然正在寻求卡姆托鲁姆的一些矮人的帮助。女王决定我们必须调查此事。我准备好出发前往卡姆托鲁姆时，应该和她谈谈。或者，我也可以自己前往那里。

english: Servius and Attala in Teumo's home in eastern Cam Torum. I searched the house and found a Secret Tunnel. I explored the Tunnel and was able to spy on a meeting between Teumo, Ennius and Furia. During the meeting, Teumo agreed to help them gain access to the Crypt of Tonali, but first asked them to retrieve and Old One Keystone from within Neypotzli for him. I should let Servius and Attala know about this.
translation: 塞维乌斯和阿塔拉在卡姆托鲁姆东部特乌莫的家中。我搜查了房子，发现了一条秘密隧道。我探索了隧道，偷听到了特乌莫、恩尼乌斯和富里亚的一次会议。会议中，特乌莫同意帮助他们进入托纳利墓穴，但首先要求他们从内波茨利监狱内为他取回一块古老者基石。我应该告诉塞维乌斯和阿塔拉这件事。

translation: 塞维乌斯和我在卡姆托鲁姆市场与阿塔拉会面。她建议我们从调查特乌莫开始，他是少数几个能允许人类进入城市的矮人之一。特乌莫的家在卡姆托鲁姆东部，就在银行后面。我应该在那里与塞维乌斯和阿塔拉会合。

She told me to go to the Twilight Temple to gather information on the Emissaries' plans for Itzla.
