translation: 那你想看我转盘子吗？还是想要回节日物品？

english: So does this mean it's the winner?
translation: 所以这意味着它赢了？

english: So everything considered, it's the perfect solution!
translation: 所以综合考虑，这是完美的解决方案！

english: So far you've completed [number] laps, keep it up!
translation: 到目前为止你已经完成了 [number] 圈，继续加油！

english: So have you caught anything?
translation: 那你抓到什么了吗？

english: So how did you decorate the entirity of Draynor so fast?
translation: 那你是怎么这么快就把整个德拉诺装饰好的？

english: So how do I cook it again?
translation: 那我该怎么再煮一次？

english: So how do I help you write a story?
translation: 那我怎么帮你写故事？

english: So how do we get actual ice cream then?
translation: 那我们怎么才能弄到真正的冰淇淋？

english: So how do we get him to show himself?
translation: 那我们怎么让他现身？

english: So how do you know it doesn't work?
translation: 那你怎么知道它没用？

english: So how long do they actually take to grow?
translation: 那它们到底要长多久？

english: So how many eggs have you given out now?
translation: 那你现在发了多少彩蛋了？

english: So is it really a surprise that you got new scissors?
translation: 所以你拿到新剪刀有什么好惊讶的？

english: So it did! Does that mean you can deliver chocolate all throughout the desert now?
translation: 还真管用！那是不是意味着你现在可以穿越沙漠送巧克力了？

english: So it is! Please don't tell him that I know. If he knew I had multiple armour sets, he might not put so much effort into cleaning them in the future!
translation: 还真是！请别告诉他我知道。要是他知道我有好几套盔甲，以后可能就不会那么卖力地擦洗它们了！

english: So it is.
translation: 确实如此。

english: So it may not be an entirely accurate recount of the original explanation.
translation: 所以这可能不完全是对原解释的准确复述。

english: So it would seem, perhaps you've learned a valuable lesson [player name].
translation: 看来是这样，也许你学到了宝贵的一课，[player name]。

english: So it's not fine?
translation: 所以这不行？

english: So many great people have came to the party!
translation: 这么多了不起的人都来参加派对了！

english: So much colour!
translation: 真是五彩缤纷！

english: So much wasted chocolate.
translation: 浪费了这么多巧克力。

english: So no midnight cruise along the isle of Crandor? No romantic meals at Gianne's cuisine?
translation: 所以没有午夜巡游克兰多尔岛的节目？没有在吉安娜餐厅的浪漫晚餐？

english: So now I offer you the same bargain that the 'mighty' Sage has struck time and time again. However, I present you with the chance of true power.
translation: 所以现在，我向你提供与那位'强大的'智者一次又一次达成的相同交易。不过，我给你的可是获得真正力量的机会。

english: So now I sit myself
translation: 所以我坐在这里

english: So now I'd like to recreate a portal like what my dad saw, so that I can enter the Realm of Memories for myself, and prove I should be a fully qualified wizard rather than an apprentice!
translation: 所以现在我想重现我父亲见过的传送门，这样我就能亲自进入记忆之境，证明我够格当一名正式魔法师，而不是学徒！

english: So now all the children are getting their eggs... aren't they?
translation: 所以现在所有孩子都拿到彩蛋了……对吧？

english: So now you need me to save the children from the THING you summoned?
translation: 所以现在你需要我去救那些被你召唤出来的东西抓走的孩子？

english: So putting the saucepan on my head was the only option.
translation: 所以把平底锅扣在头上是唯一的选择。

english: So tell me, does this mean that living with the memories of Jonas did not harm Jarvis's mind?
translation: 那么告诉我，这是否意味着与乔纳斯的记忆共存并没有损害贾维斯的心智？

english: So tempted to just eat it...
translation: 好想直接吃掉它……

english: So that's why my face feels so cold...
translation: 难怪我的脸这么冷……

english: So that's why you want to get hold of an Ape Atoll monkey? To discover the source of these scimitars?
translation: 所以这就是你想弄到一只猿猴岛猴子的原因？为了找到这些弯刀的来源？

english: So the Easter Bunny thought that since you are a cracking dancer, you could mix the fuel by dancing.
translation: 所以复活节兔子觉得既然你舞跳得棒极了，你可以通过跳舞来混合燃料。

english: So the artifact is gone... are you okay?
translation: 所以神器不见了……你还好吗？

english: So the ingredients I brought you myself were wasted?
translation: 所以我亲自带来的那些材料都浪费了？

english: So these were the eggs of Ayaster all this time?
translation: 所以这些一直都是阿亚斯特的蛋？

english: So they've childernapped the childerkins from hereabouts, forcin' 'em to stoke the fires in the gublinch caves!
translation: 所以他们把附近的小孩都拐走了，逼他们在咕布林奇洞穴里烧火！

english: So this Anti-Santa person summoned a chocolate demon to attack Easter?
translation: 所以这个反圣诞老人召唤了一个巧克力恶魔来攻击复活节？

english: So this is their sacred boulder. It kind of looks like a potato.
translation: 所以这就是他们的圣石。看起来有点像土豆。

english: So this is your church?
translation: 所以这就是你们的教堂？

english: So this isn't your stall?
translation: 所以这不是你的摊位？

english: So tired... must find somewhere better to sleep than those lice ridden blankets.
translation: 好累……得找个比那些满是虱子的毯子更好的地方睡觉。

english: So too will your bank be intact, as you left it, you will just have access to a larger vault of deposit to accomodate the extra items and garments that you will no doubt find and acquire upon your travels.
translation: 同样，你的银行也会保持原样，就像你离开时那样，你只是会拥有一个更大的存储金库，用来容纳你在旅途中无疑会发现和获得的额外物品与服装。

english: So true. What has the world come to?
translation: 说得太对了。这世道变成什么样了？

english: So we are going to re-run the final. I think the dwarf over there is making strange gestures at you.
translation: 所以我们要重赛决赛。我觉得那边那个矮人正在对你做奇怪的手势。

english: So we've got another chance.
translation: 所以我们又有了机会。

english: So what are the rules?
translation: 那规则是什么？

english: So what are they?
translation: 那它们是什么？

english: So what are you doing up here?
translation: 那你在这儿上面干什么？

english: So what are you selling then?
translation: 那你到底在卖什么？

english: So what did you all do with Uncle Eric?
translation: 那你们对埃里克叔叔做了什么？

english: So what do you actually do here?
translation: 那你在这里到底是做什么的？

english: So what do you need me to do first?
translation: 那你需要我先做什么？

english: So what do you need me to do? It's Halloween, so do you need something... scary? Or dangerous?
translation: 那你需要我做什么？现在是万圣节，所以你需要……恐怖的东西？还是危险的东西？

english: So what do you suggest we do? We can't just do nothing!
translation: 那你建议我们怎么做？我们不能就这么干等着！

english: So what do you want to know?
translation: 那你想知道什么？

english: So what do you want? We're in a big rush 'cause Diango is getting crotchety with us.
translation: 那你想要什么？我们赶时间，因为迪亚戈对我们发脾气了。

english: So what exactly are you going to do with the Sage?
translation: 那么你究竟打算怎么对付那个智者？

english: So what is the thing I am missing?
translation: 那我缺的是什么？

english: So what is this 'abyss' stuff?
translation: 那这个‘深渊’是什么东西？

english: So what is your homework assignment?
translation: 那你的家庭作业是什么？

english: So what should I do with them then?
translation: 那我该怎么处理它们？

english: So what's happened?
translation: 那发生什么事了？

english: So what's in this box?
translation: 那这个盒子里是什么？

english: So what's next?
translation: 那接下来呢？

english: So what's your story? How did you end up here?
translation: 那你的故事呢？你是怎么到这里的？

english: So when it's my turn to be sent on your errand, will the ingredients just be wasted?
translation: 那等轮到我被你派去跑腿的时候，那些材料是不是也会被浪费掉？

english: So where do I find this Hazelmere chap then?
translation: 那我该去哪儿找这个叫黑兹尔米尔的家伙？

english: So where is the blaster, and what ammunition are we going to use on it?
translation: 那发射器在哪儿，我们又要用什么弹药？

english: So where is this boss of yours then?
translation: 那你的老板在哪儿？

english: So who do you think stands a chance in the Spook-a-thon Decoration Contest?
translation: 那你觉得谁有可能在惊吓装饰大赛中获胜？

english: So why are you just sat here?
translation: 那你为什么只是坐在这里？

english: So why did you need me to fetch cake ingredients before?
translation: 那你之前为什么让我去拿蛋糕材料？

english: So why doesn't the Easter Bunny add more fuel?
translation: 那复活节兔子为什么不加更多燃料？

english: So why was there no-one with her?
translation: 那为什么没有人和她在一起？

english: So will ye go for a sail now?
translation: 那现在要出海航行吗？

english: So would ye like to go for a sail now?
translation: 那现在想出海航行吗？

english: So you didn't see anyone put it here?
translation: 所以你没看到有人把它放在这里？

english: So you just go up to them in a costume of at least three spooky pieces and shout 'TRICK OR TREAT!!'
translation: 所以你只要穿上至少三件恐怖服装，走到他们面前大喊'不给糖就捣蛋！！'就行了。

english: So you see... many ideas, but not many suitable ones!
translation: 所以你看……点子很多，但合适的没几个！

english: So you think the wizards may know a way to revert this?
translation: 所以你觉得那些魔法师可能有办法逆转这个？

english: So you want Anti-Santa to go?
translation: 所以你想让反圣诞老人离开？

english: So you want me to make some fake cobwebs?
translation: 所以你想让我做些假蜘蛛网？

english: So you want me to save Christmas, like last year?
translation: 所以你想让我像去年一样拯救圣诞节？

english: So you want me to save Christmas?
translation: 所以你想让我拯救圣诞节？

english: So you want us to dress in ghost costumes and believe we suddenly died to some player passing by?
translation: 所以你想让我们穿上幽灵服装，然后假装突然被路过的玩家吓死？

english: So you were in the process of offering me a reward just before that happened...
translation: 所以在那之前你正要给我奖励……

english: So you'd like me to go and kill all of the monkeys and save the people of Lumbridge? I can do that.
translation: 所以你想让我去杀掉所有猴子，拯救仑桥镇的居民？没问题，包在我身上。

english: So you'll help me?
translation: 所以你会帮我？

english: So you're not playing tricks like these other people?
translation: 所以你不会像其他人那样耍花招？

english: So you're stealing my job then? Whilst I'm stuck in a prison of my own creation?
translation: 所以你是来抢我饭碗的？就因为我被困在自己造的牢笼里？

english: So you're the one that took my hat, are you?
translation: 所以是你拿走了我的帽子，对吧？

english: So you've not got very far at all, then?
translation: 所以你根本没什么进展？

english: So, I got my workers started on the presents now, as that means everything will be nice and ready for the big day, and there'll be plenty of time left in case anything goes wrong.
translation: 所以，我已经让工人们开始准备礼物了，这样一切都能在重要日子前准备妥当，就算出什么差错也还有充裕的时间。

english: So, I guess I will go and find some camel milk then. Any idea where to get it from?
translation: 那么，我想我得去找些骆驼奶了。你知道上哪儿弄吗？

english: So, I have good news!
translation: 所以，我有好消息！

english: So, I need to make something exciting and exotic.
translation: 所以，我需要做些刺激又新奇的东西。

english: So, [player name]. Was there anything more you wished to hear?
translation: 那么，[player name]。你还有什么想听的吗？

english: So, Mr Monkeys ...
translation: 那么，猴子先生们……

english: So, Sir Amik, which of these dogs take your fancy?
translation: 那么，阿米克爵士，这些狗里你看上哪只了？

english: So, a deal is a deal. What was your question again?
translation: 那么，一言为定。你刚才的问题是什么来着？

english: So, about my reward...
translation: 那么，关于我的奖励……

english: So, about that egg.
translation: 那么，关于那颗蛋。

english: So, about those rewards...
translation: 那么，关于那些奖励……

english: So, are ye willing to try it out?
translation: 那么，你愿意试试吗？

english: So, did we win the Cake Off?
translation: 那么，我们赢了蛋糕大赛吗？

english: So, did you spot the spookiest stray dogs?
translation: 那么，你找到最吓人的流浪狗了吗？

english: So, have you rooted out the Forces of Darkness?
translation: 那么，你铲除黑暗势力了吗？

english: So, how about you and Aggie?
translation: 那么，你和阿吉怎么样了？

english: So, how about you and King Roald?
translation: 那么，你和罗尔德国王怎么样了？

english: So, how about you and Sir Vyvin?
translation: 那么，你和维文爵士怎么样了？

english: So, how about you and the Wise Old Man?
translation: 那么，你和老智者怎么样了？

english: So, how does the competition work?
translation: 那么，比赛是怎么进行的？

english: So, how we do?
translation: 那么，我们表现如何？

english: So, it wasn't all just magic?
translation: 所以，不全是靠魔法？

english: So, now ye knows about the adventurous life of a sailor, will ye be going fer a sail yerself now?
translation: 那么，现在你了解了水手的冒险生活，你自己要出海航行吗？

english: So, one of my fellow tradesmen deep in the desert, sells chocolate to the locals there in the form of a choc-ice.
translation: 我有个在沙漠深处的商人同行，他把巧克力做成巧克力冰棍卖给当地人。

english: So, time for some of that magic!
translation: 那么，是时候施展点魔法了！

english: So, who are we scaring?
translation: 那么，我们要吓唬谁？

english: So, why have you got a chicken suit lying around? Doesn't seem like a very bunny thing to have.
translation: 那么，你为什么会有一套鸡装？这看起来不太像兔子该有的东西。

english: So, why wouldn't she just replace it?
translation: 那么，她为什么不直接换一个？

english: So, would you like to buy some herblore supplies?
translation: 那么，你想买些草药学用品吗？

english: So, yes, I was saying that Wizard Grayzag is my dad.
translation: 所以，是的，我刚才说魔法师格雷扎格是我爸。

english: So, you have the potion ingredients?
translation: 那么，你拿到药水材料了？

english: So, you want an accomplice for an adventure...
translation: 那么，你想找个冒险同伙……

english: So, your trader friend... how do they make choc-ices?
translation: 那么，你的商人朋友……他们是怎么做巧克力冰棍的？

english: So. A bit of a mixed bag there.
translation: 那么，真是好坏参半啊。

english: So... I need to get some camel milk.
translation: 那么……我得弄些骆驼奶。

english: So... I'm to make the chocolate egg and then I need to provide the spell? What are you doing?!
translation: 那么……我要做巧克力蛋，然后还得提供咒语？你在干什么？！

english: So... about that party?
translation: 那么……关于那个派对？

english: So... any chance of a reward for my service?
translation: 那么……有没有可能给我点服务奖励？

english: So... now I just wait. Hopefully the ice cream one doesn't melt!
translation: 那么……现在我只能等了。希望冰淇淋那个别融化！

english: So... the... er... flowers?
translation: 那么……呃……花呢？

english: So... when you're not smelling doom... what do you do for entertainment?
translation: 那么……你不闻末日气息的时候……都怎么娱乐？

english: So? I don't care.
translation: 那又怎样？我不在乎。

english: Sob story? I've seen more in my short life than you will ever...
translation: 悲惨故事？我短暂一生中见过的比你一辈子都多……

english: Sobered you up a bit did it?
translation: 让你清醒了点，是吧？

english: Softly
translation: 轻声

english: Sol Heredit doesn't take kindly to your eager prayer.|colour=red
translation: 索尔.赫雷迪特对你急切的祈祷感到不悦。|colour=red

english: Sol Heredit jumps down from his seat...|color=red
translation: 索尔.赫雷迪特从他的座位上跳了下来...|color=red

english: Solus approaches Lord Daquarius, who is guarded by two Black Knights.
translation: 索鲁斯走向由两名黑骑士守卫的达夸里乌斯领主。

english: Solus casts Ice Barrage, killing the two Black Knights next to Lord Daquarius, and leaving him barely alive.
translation: 索鲁斯施展冰之弹幕，杀死了达夸里乌斯领主身旁的两名黑骑士，并让他奄奄一息。

english: Solus teleports away.
translation: 索鲁斯传送走了。

english: Solus teleports to the Chaos altar in the middle of Varrock.
translation: 索鲁斯传送至维洛克城中央的混沌祭坛。

english: Solve the riddle
translation: 解开谜题

english: Solve the riddles on those scrolls to come and watch us deliver our poems!
translation: 解开那些卷轴上的谜题，然后来看我们朗诵诗歌！

english: Some adventurer had an accident with an alchemy spell... I don't want to talk about it.
translation: 有个冒险者用炼金术出了意外……我不想提这事。

english: Some blue thread. Not enough to be worth taking.
translation: 一些蓝色线。数量太少，不值得拿。

english: Some chunks of molten glass would be the ideal patch for my cracked window. I still need [number].
translation: 几块熔融玻璃正好可以修补我破裂的窗户。我还需要 [number] 块。

english: Some green thread. Not enough to be worth taking.
translation: 一些绿色线。数量太少，不值得拿。

english: Some guards close in around you.
translation: 几名守卫向你围拢过来。

english: Some iron maces would be useful. I still need [number].
translation: 一些铁钉头锤会很有用。我还需要 [number] 把。

english: Some may say you are, the spice man.
translation: 也许有人会说，你就是那个香料人。

english: Some new scissors!
translation: 一把新剪刀！

english: Some of the adventurers I normally deliver to are deep in the desert doing adventurery things.
translation: 我平时送货的一些冒险者正在沙漠深处做冒险的事。

english: Some of the ancient Gnome phrases found on the note are missing from the translation book. I should tell the King.
translation: 便条上的一些古老地精语短语在翻译书里找不到。我应该告诉国王。

english: Some of the bars need to be completed - you need to get the sizes correct, though.
translation: 有些铁条需要完成——不过你得把尺寸弄对。

english: Some of the grown-ups are giving out treats to Trick- or-Treaters. Even the guards are doing it!
translation: 有些大人会给来'不给糖就捣蛋'的人发糖果。连守卫都在这么做！

english: Some of the volunteers needed... neutralising.
translation: 有些志愿者需要……处理掉。

english: Some of them are!
translation: 有些确实是！

english: Some oil has oozed up to the surface from the rotting vegetation in the pool's depths. You suck some of it into the blaster.
translation: 池底腐烂的植物渗出了一些油到水面上。你吸了一些到喷射器里。

english: Some ore is ready to be collected from the sack.
translation: 有些矿石已准备好可以从麻袋中收取。

english: Some ore is ready to be collected from the sack. It's getting full.
translation: 有些矿石已准备好可以从麻袋中收取。麻袋快满了。

english: Some reason I feel compelled to ask a ratio question! We keep stocks of 15 cannonballs per 2 cannons, and we have 14 cannons. How many cannonballs should we have in stock?
translation: 不知为何，我忍不住想问个比例问题！我们每2门大炮配15发炮弹，现在有14门大炮。我们应该库存多少发炮弹？

english: Some red thread. Not enough to be worth taking.
translation: 一些红色线。数量太少，不值得拿。

english: Some rubbish falls out of the rubble as you pick it up. It's too big to fit in the bucket.
translation: 你捡起瓦砾时，一些垃圾掉了出来。它太大了，放不进桶里。

english: Some silverware has gone missing from the castle cellar...
translation: 城堡地窖里丢了一些银器……

english: Some specialist tools have been left on the ground. Presumably they were used for no good.
translation: 地上留下了一些专业工具。估计是用来干坏事的。

english: Some things never change.
translation: 有些事永远不会变。

english: Some thread seems to have been caught on a loose nail on the window.
translation: 窗户上松动的钉子似乎勾住了一些线。

english: Some time later.....
translation: 过了一段时间……

english: Some time passes, during which you contemplate some complex theological problems...

english: Some would say they're actually hotter than the desert if you consider some of the sauces I use!

english: Somebody else completely bought out the stock of the last seed we need! But I'm going to give them a visit and see if they have any spare.
translation: 有人把我们需要的最后一种种子全买光了！不过我要去拜访他们，看看有没有多余的。

english: Someone has forced the chest open, breaking it in the process. If anything was in the chest, it's now gone.

translation: 一个吓人的家伙，比如死神本人！

translation: 有人告诉我只有三位神。

english: Something coarse.
translation: 粗糙的东西。

english: Something cool happens.
translation: 发生了很酷的事。

translation: 有什么东西紧紧抓住了你的肩膀。你痛苦地颤抖着。

english: Something has happened to the eggs we stored in the crypt.
translation: 我们存放在墓穴里的蛋出事了。

english: Something in the wall goes 'clink'.
translation: 墙里传来'叮当'一声。

english: Something in the water bites you.
translation: 水里的什么东西咬了你一口。

english: Something moving in the cupboard
translation: 橱柜里有东西在动

english: Something screams into life right in front of you.
translation: 有个东西在你面前尖叫着活了过来。

english: Something seems wrong, you should clean it out and start from the beginning.
translation: 好像有点不对劲，你应该清理干净，从头开始。

english: Something smelly.
translation: 有股臭味。

english: Something spooky.
translation: 有股阴森的气息。

english: Something squishy.
translation: 软绵绵的东西。

translation: 你身后有动静！

english: Something sweet.
translation: 有股甜味。

english: Something taps you on the shoulder. You feel the presence of Death.
translation: 有东西拍了拍你的肩膀。你感受到了死神的存在。

english: Something tedious, I'll bet. There isn't even anything 'spooky' in the crypt - no ghosts, just the bodies of some long-dead aristocrats, resting in Saradomin's peace. They were boring too.
translation: 我敢打赌，肯定很无聊。墓穴里根本没什么'阴森'的东西——没有幽灵，只有一些早已死去的贵族尸体，安息在萨拉多明的宁静中。他们也很无聊。

english: Something terrible has spawned in that crypt!
translation: 那座墓穴里诞生了什么可怕的东西！

english: Something to hold the milk, something to mix it with, something to move the mixers, and something to hold it all together.
translation: 需要装牛奶的东西、搅拌牛奶的东西、移动搅拌器的东西，以及把所有东西固定在一起的东西。

english: Something very strange happens to the Sandpit, it looks like it has filled itself up!
translation: 沙坑发生了非常奇怪的事，看起来它自己填满了！

english: Something with a bit more... Pomp, potentially.
translation: 也许需要更……气派一点的东西。

english: Something's happened to the machine! It's broken!
translation: 机器出事了！它坏了！

english: Something's wrong with the sacred water!
translation: 圣水出问题了！

english: Sometimes Evil Chicken pecks at the flesh of warriors for Evil Chicken likes the taste. Warriors taste of chicken.

english: Sometimes I can kind of tolerate Guthix when he's in a bad mood and killing stuff. He's less annoying than that old fool Saradomin that's for sure. I still wouldn't say he's exactly my 'favorite' though.
translation: 有时候当古斯心情不好在杀东西时，我还能勉强容忍他。他肯定比那个老傻瓜萨拉多明没那么烦人。不过我还是不会说他就是我的'最爱'。

translation: 有时候会有蝙蝠从里面飞出来。

english: Sometimes it's hard to know what to say, right?

english: Somewhere hot. I know we're already in the desert, but do you know any good spots?

english: Steve Beanie, the bartender of The Pandemonium. I learned from him that Will and Anne recently stole a Map from The Pandemonium and it was that Map that led them to the Medallion. Steve suggested I discuss the Map with its previous owner, Ribs, a regular at The Pandemonium.
translation: 史蒂夫.比尼，潘德莫尼姆的酒保。我从他那里得知，威尔和安妮最近从潘德莫尼姆偷了一张地图，正是那张地图指引他们找到了勋章。史蒂夫建议我和地图的前主人，潘德莫尼姆的常客里布斯，谈谈这张地图。

english: Steve about hunting down Will and Anne. He told me I'd need a Boat of my own and directed me to Junior Jim on the docks of The Pandemonium.
translation: 史蒂夫关于追捕威尔和安妮的事。他告诉我需要一艘自己的船，并指引我去找潘德莫尼姆码头的小吉姆。

english: Steve gives you a cup.
translation: 史蒂夫给了你一个杯子。

english: Steve hands you a crowbar.
translation: 史蒂夫递给你一根撬棍。

english: Steve tries to give you a cup, but you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 史蒂夫想给你一个杯子，但你的空间不够，拿不了。

english: Steve's suggestion, I spoke with Ribs, the previous owner of the Map and a regular at The Pandemonium. He believed the Medallion taken by Will and Anne to be cursed, and suggested I might want to try and hunt them down. I should discuss this with Steve.
translation: 按照史蒂夫的建议，我和地图的前主人、潘德莫尼姆的常客里布斯谈了谈。他认为威尔和安妮拿走的勋章被诅咒了，并建议我或许应该试着去追捕他们。我应该和史蒂夫讨论一下这件事。

english: Sticks and stones... Are you implying I would have cracked his rib either way?
translation: 棍棒和石头……你是在暗示我无论如何都会打断他的肋骨吗？

english: Still looking egg shaped...
translation: 看起来还是像蛋形……

english: Still looking into it.
translation: 还在调查中。

english: Still pretty normal.
translation: 还是相当正常。

english: Still solid...
translation: 还是实心的……

english: Still waiting on a few more players to join in. I'd go chat to that dwarf over there. They are looking a bit nervous.
translation: 还在等几个玩家加入。我会去和那边那个矮人聊聊。他们看起来有点紧张。

english: Still, Captain Dalbur's decent company. Talks a lot about how adventurers sometimes deliver food out here. Need t' see how I can get in on that.
translation: 不过，达尔布尔船长人还不错。他经常说起冒险者有时会往这里送食物。我得看看怎么才能掺和进去。

english: Still, I suppose him breaking free was inevitable, so I am glad it was you who did so after all
translation: 不过，我想他挣脱束缚是不可避免的，所以我很高兴最终是你这么做了。

english: Still, an entire village in 10 minutes?
translation: 不过，十分钟内屠掉整个村子？

english: Still, that's a little active for a lump of wood.
translation: 不过，对一块木头来说，这也太活跃了点。

english: Still, that's an incredible invention! How did you manage to get the time to put it together?
translation: 不过，真是个不可思议的发明！你是怎么抽出时间把它组装起来的？

english: Still, the mind is a fragile thing. I fear that the years of reliving those memories will not have been kind to Jarvis. Is it right to condemn an innocent man, a hero, to a lifetime of torture, even if it is for the greater
translation: 不过，心灵是脆弱的东西。我担心多年重温那些记忆对贾维斯来说并不好受。将一个无辜的人，一个英雄，判处终身折磨，即使是为了更伟大的利益，这样做对吗？

english: Stop bother us. Go talk to prisoner instead, he keep on asking for you. Is annoying.
translation: 别来烦我们了。去找那个囚犯谈吧，他一直问起你。真烦人。

english: Stop calling me that daddy!
translation: 别那么叫我，爸爸！

english: Stop disturbing me, human. Me busy, talk soon.
translation: 别打扰我，人类。我忙着呢，回头再聊。

english: Stop escape crystals from acting as a ring of life when worn?
translation: 阻止逃脱水晶在佩戴时充当生命戒指？

english: Stop following me if you don't want to be here!
translation: 不想待在这儿就别跟着我！

english: Stop it, both of you! There's no need to go to war.
translation: 住手，你们两个！没必要开战。

english: Stop other players activating your teleport crystals?
translation: 阻止其他玩家激活你的传送水晶？

english: Stop teasing her dear!
translation: 别逗她了，亲爱的！

english: Stop throwing water over me you hooligan!
translation: 别往我身上泼水了，你这个流氓！

english: Stop wasting time, human. Get to work shooting them stupid guards!
translation: 别浪费时间了，人类。快去射那些蠢守卫！

english: Stop! That one's in the right place!
translation: 停下！那个位置是对的！

english: Storeroom Key from Haig Halen. I used it to enter the Varrock Museum Storeroom where I found Xerna's Diadem. I should confront Haig Halen about this.
translation: 从海格.哈伦那里得到的储藏室钥匙。我用它进入了维洛克城博物馆的储藏室，在那里找到了泽尔娜的头冠。我应该就此事质问海格.哈伦。

english: Stradius and Hutza gathered the Suspects upstairs for me. I reviewed my findings and decided to accuse Adala of being the Killer. She admitted to being a Thief, having come to the Party to steal from the Villa. However, she denied killing Livius and attacked me, but I was able to defeat her. She was then arrested. I should speak to Stradius and Hutza about what to do now.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯和胡扎为我将嫌疑人聚集在楼上。我回顾了调查结果，决定指控阿达拉是杀手。她承认自己是个盗贼，来派对是为了从别墅偷东西。然而，她否认杀害了利维乌斯并攻击了我，但我击败了她。随后她被逮捕。我应该和斯特拉迪乌斯及胡扎谈谈接下来该怎么做。

english: Stradius and Hutza gathered the Suspects upstairs for me. I should review my findings and then accuse the person who I believe to be the Killer.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯和胡扎为我将嫌疑人聚集在楼上。我应该回顾调查结果，然后指控我认为是杀手的人。

english: Stradius and Hutza, the Guards who arrested me, revealed that the Man I found had been murdered. They also revealed him to be Livius, an actor who was meant to be performing in a play at the Villa as part of the Party. I managed to convince them I was innocent and they agreed to let me help find the real Killer.
translation: 逮捕我的守卫斯特拉迪乌斯和胡扎透露，我发现的那个人被谋杀了。他们还透露他是利维乌斯，一名本应在别墅的派对上表演戏剧的演员。我设法说服他们我是无辜的，他们同意让我帮忙找出真正的杀手。

english: Stradius and Hutza, the Guards who arrested me, revealed that the Man I found had been murdered. They also revealed him to be Livius, an actor who was meant to be performing in a play at the Villa as part of the Party. I managed to convince them I was innocent and they agreed to let me help find the real Killer. To do so, I should investigate the Wine Cellar and question the Suspects. Once I'm satisfied that I've found everything of note, I should let Stradius and Hutza know.
translation: 逮捕我的守卫斯特拉迪乌斯和胡扎透露，我发现的那个人被谋杀了。他们还透露他是利维乌斯，一名本应在别墅的派对上表演戏剧的演员。我设法说服他们我是无辜的，他们同意让我帮忙找出真正的杀手。为此，我应该调查酒窖并审问嫌疑人。一旦我确信找到了所有值得注意的东西，就应该通知斯特拉迪乌斯和胡扎。

english: Stradius presents the drinking flask.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯出示了饮水瓶。

english: Stradius presents the shipping contract.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯出示了运输合同。

english: Stradius presents the threatening note.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯出示了威胁信。

english: Stradius presents the wine labels.
translation: 斯特拉迪乌斯出示了葡萄酒标签。

english: Straight to the point I see. Fine, please take these with my thanks! Have a happy Halloween!
translation: 我明白了，直截了当。好吧，请收下这些，谢谢！万圣节快乐！

english: Straightened your ears? How would you even-
translation: 把你的耳朵弄直？你怎么能——

english: Strange Puddles I followed seemed to be heading towards the Custodia Pass west of Auburnvale, I decided to continue my search there. I soon found a Cave in the Pass. I should see what's inside.
translation: 我追踪的奇怪水坑似乎正朝着奥本谷西边的库斯托迪亚通道而去，我决定在那里继续搜索。我很快在通道里发现了一个洞穴。我应该看看里面有什么。

english: Strange Talisman to Sedridor in the basement of the Wizards' Tower. He believes it might be key to discovering a Teleportation Incantation to the lost Rune Essence Mine. He asked me to help confirm this by delivering a Package to Aubury, an expert on Runecrafting. I can find him in his Rune Shop in south east Varrock.
translation: 将奇怪的护身符交给法师塔地下室的塞德里多。他认为这可能是发现通往失落的符文精华矿的传送咒语的关键。他让我把一个包裹送给符文制作专家奥伯里，以帮助确认这一点。我可以在维洛克城东南部他的符文商店找到他。

english: Strange as it may seem, I want a lot of beer! I still need [number].
translation: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但我想要很多啤酒！我还需要[number]个。

english: Strange as this may seem, I need some unfired pie dishes. I still need [number].
translation: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但我需要一些未烤制的馅饼盘。我还需要[number]个。

english: Strange casket As you see, I am... a casket. Some of us are not mere vessels of wealth.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 如你所见，我是……一个宝箱。我们中的一些不仅仅是财富的容器。

english: Strange casket Do you... seek a challenge? If you do, the Mimic will test your mettle.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 你……在寻求挑战吗？如果是的话，拟态怪会考验你的勇气。

english: Strange casket Do you... tire of the challenge?
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 你……厌倦挑战了吗？

english: Strange casket If so, the Mimic will reveal itself, and summon you to its arena, to fight.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 如果是这样，拟态怪会现身，并将你召唤到它的竞技场进行战斗。

english: Strange casket If you are victorious, the Mimic will reward you with... things.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 如果你获胜，拟态怪会用……东西奖励你。

english: Strange casket Return to me when you are prepared.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 等你准备好了就回到我这里。

english: Strange casket So, would you like the chance to face the Mimic? The rewards are... special.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 那么，你想要面对拟态怪的机会吗？奖励是……特别的。

english: Strange casket Some of us speak. Some can walk. And some, like the Mimic... can fight.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 我们中的一些会说话。一些能走路。还有一些，比如拟态怪……能战斗。

english: Strange casket The Mimic has... found you! Will you fight now?
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 拟态怪已经……找到你了！你现在要战斗吗？

english: Strange casket The Mimic is... a casket. When you find treasure, perhaps you will realise your casket is the Mimic.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 拟态怪是……一个宝箱。当你找到宝藏时，也许你会意识到你的宝箱就是拟态怪。

english: Strange casket The Mimic is... disappointed.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 拟态怪……很失望。

english: Strange casket The Mimic is... pleased.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 拟态怪……很满意。

english: Strange casket Very well. You shall not be challenged by the Mimic again. Return to me if you change your mind.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 好吧。你不会再受到拟态怪的挑战了。如果你改变主意，就回到我这里。

english: Strange casket You may find me here if you change your mind. The Mimic will wait.
translation: 奇怪的宝箱 如果你改变主意，可以在这里找到我。拟态怪会等着。

english: Straven hands you a Master Thief armband.
translation: 斯特拉文递给你一个盗贼大师臂章。

english: Straven hands you a key.
translation: 斯特拉文递给你一把钥匙。

english: Straw hats are fashion. Twenty is double fifteen. Woads are my passion.

translation: 再次感谢你的所有帮助。

english: Thank you so much for helping me open the Realm of Memories, [player name]!
translation: 非常感谢你帮我打开记忆之境，[player name]！

english: Thank you so much for helping me!
translation: 非常感谢你帮我！

english: Thank you so much for helping me! I couldn't have done it without you.
translation: 非常感谢你帮我！没有你我不可能做到。

english: Thank you so much for helping us.
translation: 非常感谢你帮我们。

english: Thank you so much for offering to help me. The Duke told his guests to order whatever they wanted, and they had some odd requests for food and drink. I've written them down in a list...
translation: 非常感谢你愿意帮我。公爵让他的客人随便点他们想要的东西，他们对食物和饮料有些奇怪的要求。我已经把它们列在一张单子上了……

english: Thank you so much for what you did!
translation: 非常感谢你所做的一切！

english: Thank you so much for your help! Now those critters and the demon have gone, my rabbits can get back to work.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助！现在那些小动物和恶魔都走了，我的兔子们可以回去工作了。

english: Thank you so much! I better be off now though, goodbye.
translation: 非常感谢！不过我得走了，再见。

english: Thank you so much! Okay, here is the report. Deliver it to Ali Morrisane without delay.
translation: 非常感谢！好了，这是报告。立刻把它交给阿里.莫里桑。

english: Thank you so much! Please be quick!
translation: 非常感谢！请快点！

english: Thank you so much! To open the portal to the Realm of Memories, I believe we need mementos that will invoke powerful memories of the world.
translation: 非常感谢！要打开通往记忆之境的传送门，我相信我们需要能唤起世界强烈记忆的纪念品。

english: Thank you so much. This world needs a few more people like you.
translation: 非常感谢。这个世界需要更多像你这样的人。

english: Thank you very much [player name]! When the party kicks in I'll be sure to get you a beer. Pete out!
translation: 非常感谢，[player name]！派对开始后我一定给你弄杯啤酒。皮特闪人！

english: Thank you very much my new friend, here take this Dried cocoa and give the Easter Bunny my thanks.
translation: 非常感谢，我的新朋友，拿着这份干可可豆，替我向复活节兔子道谢。

english: Thank you! Archibald left a note before he left. It may help you find him. It's on a table just over there.
translation: 谢谢！阿奇博尔德走之前留了张字条。也许能帮你找到他。就在那边的桌子上。

english: Thank you! I spent a lot of time on it.
translation: 谢谢！我花了很多时间在这上面。

english: Thank you! I'll stay here by the coast where it's a bit cooler. See you soon, good luck!
translation: 谢谢！我就待在这海边，这里凉快些。回头见，祝你好运！

english: Thank you! I'm here on behalf of Cecilia. Some dogs have recently moved into Falador park and we'd like to run a rehoming event to help them find a better home.
translation: 谢谢！我代表塞西莉亚来的。最近有些狗跑进了法拉多公园，我们想办个领养活动，帮它们找个更好的家。

english: Thank you! If you're ready to get scaring, we can start now!
translation: 谢谢！如果你准备好去吓人了，我们现在就可以开始！

english: Thank you! Now it IS a Merry Christmas!
translation: 谢谢！现在这才叫圣诞快乐！

english: Thank you! Now let's get this advert sorted.
translation: 谢谢！现在我们来搞定这个广告吧。

english: Thank you! Now what shall we do?
translation: 谢谢！现在我们该做什么？

english: Thank you! Okay, now, time for the spell. It should be quite the spectacle, are you ready to watch?
translation: 谢谢！好了，现在，是时候施展法术了。应该会相当壮观，你准备好看了吗？

english: Thank you! Okay, so, there is a magical cleaning potion, it gets the stains out of anything!
translation: 谢谢！好了，有一种魔法清洁药水，它能洗掉任何污渍！

english: Thank you! Search around the bushes south of here. I hope you find some, otherwise we're going to be in real trouble.
translation: 谢谢！在这南边的灌木丛里找找。希望你能找到一些，不然我们就有大麻烦了。

english: Thank you! Until I get my goblin mail, feel free to come visit any time. I sell a lot of chainmail myself.
translation: 谢谢！在我拿到我的哥布林链甲之前，随时欢迎你来拜访。我自己也卖很多锁子甲。

english: Thank you! While I'm here, can you think of anyone else I should spook?
translation: 谢谢！既然我在这儿，你能想到还有谁我应该去吓唬一下吗？

english: Thank you! You might just save my haunted house dreams, and help me win the contest.
translation: 谢谢！你也许能拯救我的鬼屋梦想，帮我赢得比赛。

english: Thank you! You'll find Carol in the factory to the North West, just descend the steps to go inside.
translation: 谢谢！你会在西北边的工厂里找到卡罗尔，走下台阶就能进去。

english: Thank you! be your guide and bring you many acorn trees!
translation: 谢谢！做你的向导，给你带来许多橡子树！

english: Thank you, Aggie!
translation: 谢谢你，阿吉！

english: Thank you, Benny!
translation: 谢谢你，班尼！

english: Thank you, Death. That's a sentence I never thought I'd say.
translation: 谢谢你，死神。我从没想过我会说出这句话。

english: Thank you, Diango. I'll make sure it gets put to good use.
translation: 谢谢你，迪亚戈。我会确保它物尽其用。

english: Thank you, I shall. Merry Christmas!
translation: 谢谢，我会的。圣诞快乐！

english: Thank you, I think. I don't have any sails!
translation: 谢谢……吧。我根本没有帆！

english: Thank you, I think?
translation: 谢谢……吧？

english: Thank you, I'll get the armour cleaned right now.
translation: 谢谢，我马上去把盔甲清理干净。

english: Thank you, I'll go and ask him.
translation: 谢谢，我去问问他。

english: Thank you, I'll go and get them now!
translation: 谢谢，我现在就去拿！

english: Thank you, I'm just excited! Make sure you open it! Enjoy the rest of the festival. Merry Christmas!
translation: 谢谢，我只是太兴奋了！记得打开它！好好享受剩下的节日。圣诞快乐！

english: Thank you, Rick. I'll see you around.
translation: 谢谢你，里克。回头见。

english: Thank you, Sarah!
translation: 谢谢你，莎拉！

english: Thank you, Sedridor.
translation: 谢谢你，塞德里多。

english: Thank you, Your Majesty.
translation: 谢谢您，陛下。

english: Thank you, Your Royal Highness, Jack will be very happy. I present you with your cracker.
translation: 谢谢您，殿下，杰克会非常高兴的。我为您呈上您的拉炮。

english: Thank you, [player name]! The ritual is complete and balance is restored for today.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]！仪式完成了，今天的平衡已经恢复。

english: Thank you, [player name]! With your help we might just save easter after all!
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]！有你的帮助，我们说不定真能拯救复活节！

english: Thank you, but we've got enough of them already.
translation: 谢谢，但我们已经有够多的了。

english: Thank you, but your own items will be of no use to me.
translation: 谢谢，但你自己的物品对我没用。

english: Thank you, it's spotless! Almost too clean. How did he clean it?
translation: 谢谢，一尘不染！干净得有点过头了。他是怎么清理的？

english: Thank you, mortal. For some reason, I normally get very little affirmation in this job. Now, did you want to ask me something else?
translation: 谢谢你，凡人。不知为何，我这份工作通常得不到多少肯定。现在，你还有什么想问的吗？

english: Thank you, serf. For some reason I normally get very little affirmation in my work.
translation: 谢谢你，农奴。不知为何，我的工作通常得不到多少肯定。

english: Thank you, that is a great start. One more bag should do it!
translation: 谢谢，这是个很好的开始。再来一袋就够了！

english: Thank you, that should keep Hans happy!
translation: 谢谢，这应该能让汉斯高兴了！

english: Thank you, the Lumbridge Guide will be very happy with that.
translation: 谢谢，仑桥镇向导会非常满意的。

english: Thank you, we couldn't have done all this without you! The food, the drinks, the decorations, the grotto, it's all turned out great because of you.
translation: 谢谢，没有你我们不可能完成这一切！食物、饮料、装饰、洞穴，都因为你而变得很棒。

english: Thank you. Do you have a moment? An extra set of hands would be of great help.
translation: 谢谢。你有空吗？多一双手帮忙会很有用。

english: Thank you. Good luck with the thingummywuts.
translation: 谢谢。祝你在那些小玩意儿上好运。

english: Thank you. Here is a [jacket/gloves/pantaloons/boots/mask] like mine. Each day you bring me a box of coal lumps, I will reward you further.
translation: 谢谢。这是和我一样的[jacket/gloves/pantaloons/boots/mask]。只要你每天给我带一箱煤块来，我就会进一步奖励你。

english: Thank you. I also noted down the different size snowballs that the children want, so I can check my notes if I forget.
translation: 谢谢。我还记下了孩子们想要的不同大小的雪球，这样如果我忘了可以查查我的笔记。

english: Thank you. I will make sure she's given a proper burial now.
translation: 谢谢。我现在会确保她得到妥善安葬。

english: Thank you. I'll deliver it now.
translation: 谢谢。我现在就去送。

english: Thank you. I'm sure you can do it. I believe in you!
translation: 谢谢。我相信你能做到。我对你有信心！

english: Thank you. If you find where it is, let me know before you move the egg mould about, it's very fragile!
translation: 谢谢。如果你找到了它在哪，移动鸡蛋模具之前先告诉我，它非常易碎！

english: Thank you. It really felt like I was made out of stone, out there.
translation: 谢谢。在外面的时候，我真感觉自己像是石头做的。

english: Thank you. Merry Christmas!
translation: 谢谢。圣诞快乐！

english: Thank you. You have [number] to go before you have enough for a medallion.
translation: 谢谢你。你还差[number]个才能凑够一枚勋章。

english: Thankfully they weren't too bad, I'm here aren't I?
translation: 谢天谢地，它们不算太糟，我不是还在这儿吗？

english: Thankfully, I've gotten everything I need from here already.
translation: 谢天谢地，我已经从这里拿到了我需要的一切。

english: Thanks Iffie, I'll see what I can find.
translation: 谢谢伊菲，我看看能找到什么。

english: Thanks Mo, so what's next for you?
translation: 谢谢莫，那你接下来打算做什么？

english: Thanks [player name], I'm so excited for an all-I-can- drink beer-fest.
translation: 谢谢[player name]，我对这个啤酒畅饮节超级兴奋。

english: Thanks a bunch Martin, you've been a good egg.
translation: 多谢了马丁，你真是个好人。

english: Thanks a bunch mate, you did a cracking job getting all the ingredients for me.
translation: 多谢了哥们，你帮我弄到所有材料，干得漂亮。

english: Thanks again Iffie, sorry for taking up your precious time.
translation: 再次感谢伊菲，抱歉占用了你宝贵的时间。

english: Thanks again for helping to save the Easter festivities!
translation: 再次感谢你帮忙拯救了复活节庆典！

english: Thanks again for helping to save the Easter festivities! Have a word with Diango if you need to collect your holiday items.
translation: 再次感谢你帮忙拯救了复活节庆典！如果你需要领取你的节日物品，去跟迪亚戈说一声。

english: Thanks again for saving me from the goblins!
translation: 再次感谢你从哥布林手中救了我！

english: Thanks again for your help.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助。

english: Thanks again for your help. I had better give you your just deserts.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助。我最好给你应得的报酬。

english: Thanks again for your help. Until we meet again.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助。后会有期。

english: Thanks again, [player name]. Happy Easter!
translation: 再次感谢，[player name]。复活节快乐！

english: Thanks again, the meadow looks lovely! Happy Pride!
translation: 再次感谢，草地看起来美极了！骄傲月快乐！

english: Thanks again. They'll be so excited. They're both outside playing in the snow, you should speak to them to see what sort of snowman they'd like.
translation: 再次感谢。他们会非常兴奋的。他们俩都在外面玩雪，你应该去跟他们聊聊，看看他们想要什么样的雪人。

english: Thanks for all of your help with the poems.
translation: 谢谢你帮我处理那些诗。

english: Thanks for all your help [player name]. We're really looking forward to working with Diango!
translation: 谢谢你所有的帮助，[player name]。我们真的很期待与迪亚戈合作！

english: Thanks for all your help! You were eggceptional!
translation: 谢谢你的所有帮助！你真是蛋彩绝伦！

english: Thanks for all your help. I think I'll stop outsourcing my work and, next year, just deliver everything myself...unless I get a better idea!
translation: 谢谢你的所有帮助。我想我以后不再外包工作了，明年我自己来送所有东西……除非我想出更好的主意！

english: Thanks for all your help. There's still more to be done but as a token of our gratitude, have this...
translation: 谢谢你的所有帮助。虽然还有更多事要做，但作为我们感激的一点心意，请收下这个……

english: Thanks for being here for me, I'm so glad she liked it.
translation: 谢谢你陪着我，我很高兴她喜欢。

english: Thanks for helping me adventurer! You're such a good egg.
translation: 谢谢你帮我，冒险者！你真是个好人。

english: Thanks for helping me with my homework. Thinking back, I overheard Wilough and Shilop talking about a colourful spade at dinner.
translation: 谢谢你帮我做作业。回想起来，我无意中听到威洛和希洛普在晚餐时谈论一把彩色的铲子。

english: Thanks for helping me with this, [player name]!
translation: 谢谢你帮我这个忙，[player name]！

english: Thanks for helping out.
translation: 多谢帮忙。

english: Thanks for helping to save Easter, [player name]!
translation: 谢谢你帮忙拯救复活节，[player name]！

english: Thanks for helping us break player records!
translation: 感谢你帮助我们打破玩家记录！

english: Thanks for helping us with the easter decorations.
translation: 谢谢你帮我们布置复活节装饰。

english: Thanks for that, I'm feeling a lot better now.
translation: 谢了，我现在感觉好多了。

english: Thanks for the Easter egg.
translation: 谢谢你的复活节彩蛋。

english: Thanks for the autographed flyer.
translation: 谢谢你的签名传单。

english: Thanks for the book.
translation: 谢谢你的书。

english: Thanks for the extra eggs, a few of mine dissappeared!
translation: 谢谢你多给的蛋，我自己的有几个不见了！

english: Thanks for the help, I'll finish off this load.
translation: 多谢帮忙，我来把这批货弄完。

english: Thanks for the offer but I'm not letting this artifact out of my sight.
translation: 谢谢你的提议，但我不会让这件神器离开我的视线。

english: Thanks for waiting, we've all sorted out our instructions for you.
translation: 谢谢你的等待，我们都为你整理好了指示。

english: Thanks for you help.
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。

english: Thanks for your help [player name]. Happy Easter!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助，[player name]。复活节快乐！

english: Thanks for your help. Hopefully I'll make it out of here in one piece!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助。希望我能毫发无伤地离开这里！

english: Thanks once again for your assistance, adventurer. Truly, you are a friend to Al Kharid.
translation: 再次感谢你的协助，冒险者。你真是阿尔卡里德城的朋友。

english: Thanks once again for your assistance, adventurer. You may not be a friend of Al Kharid, but know that your assistance will not be forgotten.
translation: 再次感谢你的协助，冒险者。你或许不是阿尔卡里德城的朋友，但要知道你的帮助不会被遗忘。

english: Thanks so much for your help, [player name]. I can relax and enjoy my holiday now.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助，[player name]。我现在可以放松下来享受假期了。

english: Thanks so much for your help. I was worried we would ruin Christmas entirely! Here, take these gifts as a present from us to you.
translation: 非常感谢你的帮助。我本来担心我们会把圣诞节彻底搞砸！来，把这些礼物收下，这是我们送给你的。

english: Thanks so much!
translation: 非常感谢！

english: Thanks so much, that sounds about right! I guess I'll meet you at the party soon!
translation: 非常感谢，听起来差不多！我想我们很快就能在派对上见面了！

english: Thanks so much, that sounds about right! I'll grace the party with my royal presence soon!
translation: 非常感谢，听起来差不多！我很快就会以王室身份驾临派对！

english: Thanks very much Pete, let's enjoy the party.
translation: 非常感谢，皮特，让我们享受派对吧。

english: Thanks you for my Easter Egg [player name], although I'm never playing you again at egg, silk or secateurs.
translation: 谢谢你的复活节彩蛋，[player name]，不过我以后再也不会跟你玩蛋、丝绸或修枝剪了。

english: Thanks! The Duke of Lumbridge tells me that you may be able to organise some appropriate entertainment for the Doomsayer in Lumbridge?
translation: 谢谢！仑桥镇公爵告诉我，你也许能为仑桥镇的厄运预言者安排一些合适的娱乐活动？

english: Thanks! We made them ourselves!
translation: 谢谢！我们自己做的！

english: Thanks, Ali! I couldn't have done it without your help!
translation: 谢谢，阿里！没有你的帮助我做不到！

english: Thanks, Dave!
translation: 谢谢，戴夫！

english: Thanks, Diango; back to work for me!
translation: 谢谢，迪亚戈；我该回去工作了！

english: Thanks, I will go and see if they have any spare.
translation: 谢谢，我去看看他们有没有多余的。

english: Thanks, I will start there.
translation: 谢谢，我从那里开始。

english: Thanks, I'll be right back!
translation: 谢谢，我马上回来！

english: Thanks, I'll bear that in mind.
translation: 谢谢，我会记住的。

english: Thanks, I'll get making the ice cream!
translation: 谢谢，我这就去做冰淇淋！

english: Thanks, I'll get to it then.
translation: 谢谢，那我这就去办。

english: Thanks, I'll try my best to keep a hold on them.
translation: 谢谢，我会尽力看好它们的。

english: Thanks, Scrubfoot!
translation: 谢谢，斯克鲁布福特！

english: Thanks, dad! So, now I've proven myself, can I ditch the 'apprentice' title, please? This feat surely qualifies me for higher status, right? Pleeeeease?
translation: 谢谢，老爸！那么，既然我已经证明了自己，能不能去掉我那个'学徒'的头衔？这次壮举总该让我升个级了吧？求求你啦？

english: Thanks, mate, Jack'll be over the moon. Here's your cracker.
translation: 谢了，兄弟，杰克会高兴坏的。这是你的拉炮。

english: Thanks, that makes me feel a little better.
translation: 谢谢，这让我感觉好一点了。

english: Thanks, that was fun.
translation: 谢谢，挺有趣的。

english: Thanks, want to wait and see what is inside?
translation: 谢谢，想等等看里面是什么吗？

english: Thanks, you two. I appreciate it. 14 -->
translation: 谢谢你们俩。我很感激。14 -->

english: Thanks, you'll be out in no time!
translation: 谢谢，你很快就能出去了！

english: Thanks. Give me one second, I'll whip something up.
translation: 谢谢。给我一秒钟，我马上弄点东西出来。

english: Thanks. I hope the generals will like it too.
translation: 谢谢。希望将军们也会喜欢。

english: Thanks. I told you I am goblin.
translation: 谢谢。我告诉过你我是哥布林。

english: Thanks. I'll return to you once I've trapped them all.
translation: 谢谢。等我把它们都抓到了就回来找你。

english: Thanks. I'll total this all up now...
translation: 谢谢。我现在就来算总数……

english: Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. For every [number], ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 谢了。我现在已经帮你存了[number]根触手。每存够[number]根，你就可以给我一把三叉戟，我会帮你强化它。

english: Thanks. I've got [number] tentacles stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me [number], ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 谢了。我现在已经帮你存了[number]根触手。等你带够[number]根，就可以给我一把三叉戟，我会帮你强化它。

english: Thanks. I've got one tentacle stored for ya now. Once ye've brought me [number], ya can hand me a trident, an' I'll enhance it.
translation: 谢了。我现在已经帮你存了一根触手。等你带够[number]根，就可以给我一把三叉戟，我会帮你强化它。

english: Thanks. It's actually my children, Buoy and Gurl, that need help. They want to build a snowman, but I've just been too busy to help them. I feel so bad!
translation: 谢谢。其实需要帮助的是我的孩子，浮标和格尔。他们想堆雪人，但我一直太忙没空帮他们。我觉得很内疚！

english: Thanks. So I'll have one normal egg and one new ice cream filled egg?
translation: 谢谢。那么我会有普通蛋和一个新的冰淇淋蛋？
