english: That was your last guess! Seeing as you're so bad at this I'll give you one more guess.
translation: 那是你最后一次猜测了！看你这么不擅长这个，我再给你一次机会猜。

english: That was your second guess!
translation: 那是你的第二次猜测！

english: That wasn't such a good idea.
translation: 那主意可不怎么样。

english: That wasn't the correct combination of tumblers. Try again.
translation: 那不是正确的锁芯组合。再试一次。

english: That water doesn't look great... Best not to do that.
translation: 那水看起来不太干净……最好别那么做。

english: That way you still get a present, but we can practice giving one away. Sound good?
translation: 这样你仍然能得到礼物，但我们也可以练习送出一份。听起来不错吧？

english: That we do! Well, now we have the frozen ice cream churn, the only thing left to do is try it.
translation: 确实如此！好了，现在我们有了冷冻的冰淇淋搅拌桶，唯一剩下的事就是试试它了。

english: That we know of.
translation: 据我们所知是这样。

english: That which is widely known is not necessarily true, just as truth is not always :idely known. The dwarves are a highly noble and intelligent race. They know of the benefits that magic doth bring to the metallurgical arts, and use such spells accordingly.
translation: 广为人知的事情未必是真实的，正如真理并不总是广为人知。矮人是一个极其高贵和聪明的种族。他们知道魔法给冶金工艺带来的好处，并相应地使用这些法术。

english: That will be the Oracle I'm guessing.
translation: 我猜那会是神谕者。

english: That won't help fix the bridge.
translation: 那对修桥没有帮助。

english: That won't work here! Sir Vyvin needs his armour, and it needs to be white. If I can't get rid of the pink, I will be fired from my job, and have nowhere to go!
translation: 在这里行不通！维文爵士需要他的盔甲，而且必须是白色的。如果我不能去掉这粉色，我会被炒鱿鱼，无家可归！

english: That worked out rather well, didn't it?
translation: 结果还不错，对吧？

english: That would be a terrible waste. Perhaps there's something better you can use.
translation: 那会是种可怕的浪费。也许有更好的东西你可以用。

english: That would be correct. I'm sorting out refreshments for the festival.
translation: 没错。我正在为节日准备点心。

english: That would be great! We're based on a mountain to the far west of here but you can teleport there with us.
translation: 那太好了！我们的基地在西方远处的一座山上，但你可以和我们一起传送过去。

english: That would be lovely!
translation: 那太好了！

english: That would be lovely, I'm listening.
translation: 那太好了，我洗耳恭听。

english: That would be lovely, it'd quench my thirst and help me relax!
translation: 那太好了，既能解渴又能帮我放松！

english: That would be splendid! I don't find any old company acceptable though.
translation: 那太棒了！不过我可不会随便什么人都接受。

english: That would be super helpful, if you wouldn't mind?
translation: 那会非常有帮助，如果你不介意的话？

english: That would be useful, thanks.
translation: 那会很有用，谢谢。

english: That would certainly be helpful, but it won't be an easy task; Anti-Santa isn't going to just reveal his plans to anybody, you'll have to earn his trust first. First, however, you'll have to find him!
translation: 那当然会有帮助，但这可不是件容易的事；反圣诞老人不会随便向任何人透露他的计划，你得先赢得他的信任。不过首先，你得先找到他！

english: That would cost [number] coins, you know!
translation: 那要花[number]金币，你知道吗！

english: That would do just the job. I do love a good cold beer.
translation: 那正好。我最喜欢来一杯冰凉的啤酒了。

english: That would make sense. Thanks boss!
translation: 有道理。谢谢老板！

english: That would scare any old sailor, and I've seen my fair share of things!
translation: 那足以吓到任何老水手了，而我也见过不少世面！

english: That you are very interested in gathering sweet treats!
translation: 你对收集糖果非常感兴趣！

english: That'd be convenient! But no, I need to obtain the items with you myself. Otherwise the memories associated with them aren't transferred to me.
translation: 那倒是很方便！但不行，我需要和你一起亲自获取这些物品。否则，与之相关的记忆就无法转移给我。

english: That's a big ask when you put it like that.
translation: 你这么说，要求可真不小。

english: That's a bit bold considering you needed help to finish the poem, no?
translation: 考虑到你连首诗都写不完还需要帮忙，这话说得有点太狂了吧？

english: That's a bit creepy, I wonder if those new comers were those workers that went missing? The plot thickens.
translation: 有点诡异，我在想那些新来的人是不是就是失踪的工人？事情越来越复杂了。

english: That's a bit less full of doom, job done I'd say.
translation: 这下没那么绝望了，我觉得任务完成了。

english: That's a bit like doing a favour, isn't it? But alright, I can sort you out some basic stuff.
translation: 这有点像在帮人忙，不是吗？不过好吧，我可以给你一些基本的东西。

english: That's a bit of an overkill, normal cheese would work perfectly fine.
translation: 那有点小题大做了，普通的乳酪就完全没问题。

english: That's a good idea!
translation: 好主意！

english: That's a long time to wait to find out there was a better way.
translation: 等了那么久才发现有更好的办法，真是够久的。

english: That's a lot of chests!
translation: 好多箱子啊！

english: That's a lucky guess. Please don't tell anybody, and don't venture there yourself, it's too dangerous!
translation: 猜得真准。请别告诉任何人，也别自己去那里，太危险了！

english: That's a nice idea. I'll see you around!
translation: 好主意。回头见！

english: That's a shame, I'll have to chase them down myself.
translation: 真可惜，我得亲自去追他们了。

english: That's a shame, hopefully someone will come along and help sort it out for you.
translation: 真可惜，希望有人会来帮你解决这个问题。

english: That's a shame, keep hope though. I've heard dragons aren't the best communicators. Lots of fire involved.
translation: 真可惜，不过别灰心。我听说龙不太擅长沟通，动不动就喷火。

english: That's all five Shades!
translation: 五个阴魂都齐了！

english: That's all of them. I don't have space in my inventory for the gifts though. I should come back with more space. 2. -->
translation: 全都拿到了。但我背包里没空间放礼物了。我应该等有更多空间再来。2. -->

english: That's all three Ghasts!
translation: 三个恶灵都齐了！

english: That's all well and good, but why am I even here then?
translation: 这都很好，但我到底为什么在这里？

english: That's awesome! I went to the grotto earlier too, it was great!
translation: 太棒了！我之前也去过那个洞穴，那里很棒！

english: That's better, but it doesn't sound very exciting. There is no air of mystery!
translation: 这样好多了，但听起来还是不够刺激。一点神秘感都没有！

english: That's certainly one way of putting it.
translation: 这倒是一种说法。

english: That's certainly unlucky, [player name]. Though we did find out that some of the contestants were cheating.
translation: 那确实很不走运，[player name]。不过我们发现有些参赛者在作弊。

english: That's clever. Well, good luck. I hope you find the information you're looking for!
translation: 真聪明。好吧，祝你好运。希望你能找到你要的信息！

english: That's cool! Maybe I'll stop buy and get some later.
translation: 真酷！也许我改天会顺路去买一些。

english: That's cool. I think I'll go and visit soon. I hope I get more goblin mail!
translation: 真酷。我想我很快会去拜访一下。希望能拿到更多哥布林链甲！

english: That's done! I'll let you check the contents out!
translation: 搞定了！我让你看看里面的东西！

english: That's easy, you just add your ingredients to the chocolate, grab an egg mould and use your chocolate mixture on the egg oven.
translation: 很简单，你只要把配料加到巧克力里，拿一个鸡蛋模具，然后把你的巧克力混合物放进鸡蛋烤箱就行了。

english: That's eggcelent!
translation: 太棒了！

english: That's everyone on the list... Time to go enjoy the party!
translation: 名单上的人都齐了……是时候去享受派对了！

english: That's fair, my friend. However I'm so convinced she'll love it that I'll book you in already. You can come and let me know if she decides she doesn't want to host it there.
translation: 说得对，我的朋友。不过我非常确信她会喜欢，所以我已经帮你预约好了。如果她决定不想在那里举办，你可以来告诉我。

english: That's fair. You are only at the start of your ice- skating journey, and you still did better than the cow.
translation: 这很公平。你才刚开始你的滑冰之旅，而且你滑得比那头牛好多了。

english: That's fairly odd, but I'll go with it.
translation: 这有点奇怪，但我接受。

english: That's far too small to fit the orb in!
translation: 那太小了，装不下宝珠！

english: That's fascinating.
translation: 真迷人。

english: That's four Shades!
translation: 四个阴魂了！

english: That's good news! What next?
translation: 好消息！接下来呢？

english: That's good, I suppose...
translation: 我想……那还不错。

english: That's great! I was going to offer to help but I've been very busy doing all the Christmas haircuts.
translation: 太好了！我本来想帮忙的，但我一直忙着做所有的圣诞发型。

english: That's great! I'll go and tell Holly the good news!
translation: 太好了！我去告诉霍莉这个好消息！

english: That's great! I'm going to go to the grotto soon. I hope I get something good.
translation: 太好了！我很快要去那个洞穴。希望能拿到好东西。

english: That's great! Thanks to you, Easter can go ahead, albeit a little late this year.
translation: 太好了！多亏了你，复活节能如期举行了，虽然今年稍微晚了一点。

english: That's great, are you sure they will pay?
translation: 太好了，你确定他们会付钱吗？

english: That's great, thank you! I'll go and check it out right now!
translation: 太好了，谢谢你！我现在就去看看！

english: That's great, we've got 8 boxes now.
translation: 太好了，我们现在有8个箱子了。

english: That's great. It's a good start!
translation: 太好了。这是个好的开始！

english: That's impossible! No one can do that!
translation: 不可能！没人能做到！

english: That's ironic, when combined with iron ore that is.
translation: 真是讽刺，当和铁矿石结合时。

english: That's it? Varrock is huge, I'll be looking for ages!
translation: 就这些？维洛克城这么大，我得找上好久！

english: That's jolly decent of you, young man.
translation: 你真是太好了，年轻人。

english: That's jolly decent of you, young man. I'm planning a Halloween treat for my niece and nephew, you see, and the crypt of this church would be the perfect setting.
translation: 你真是太好了，年轻人。我正打算为我的侄子和侄女准备一个万圣节惊喜，你看，这座教堂的墓穴会是完美的地点。

english: That's just as well, there were a lot of unhappy people starting to gather in Varrock.
translation: 那正好，维洛克城里开始聚集了很多不满的人。

english: That's kind of you, but that's the wrong kind of blue. Have a chat to Herquin in Falador, he's good with gems.
translation: 你真好，但那是错的蓝色。去法拉多城找赫昆谈谈，他对宝石很在行。

english: That's more like it! Heroes should be rewarded for their service; I've always said so. Every quest ought to have a decent reward.
translation: 这才像话！英雄应该因他们的服务而得到奖励；我一直都这么说。每个任务都应该有像样的奖励。

english: That's my dad, yes! I'm sorry about his... manners.
translation: 那是我爸爸，没错！我为他的……态度感到抱歉。

english: That's my dad, yes! I'm sorry about his... manners. Anyway, I wanted to talk about that green Gnome Child. He'd come into this world from the Realm of Memories.
translation: 那是我爸爸，没错！我为他的……态度感到抱歉。总之，我想谈谈那个绿色的地精小孩。他是从记忆之境来到这个世界的。

english: That's nice of you! She's been very busy this year.
translation: 你真好！她今年一直很忙。

english: That's nice. Have you got it?
translation: 不错。你拿到了吗？

english: That's no better.
translation: 那也没好到哪去。

english: That's not a very spooky costume! Try combining at least three Halloween items, that'll be sure to spook!
translation: 那可不是什么吓人的服装！试着至少组合三件万圣节物品，那肯定会吓到人！

english: That's not even a word!
translation: 那甚至不是一个词！

english: That's not even an anagram of andri!
translation: 那甚至不是 andri 的变位词！

english: That's not good to hear.
translation: 这可不是什么好消息。

english: That's not important. What's important is...
translation: 那不重要。重要的是……

english: That's not my name!
translation: 那不是我的名字！

english: That's not quite right... I need you to be approaching the beacon from the east.
translation: 不太对……我需要你从东边接近信标。

english: That's not quite right... I need you to be approaching the beacon from the west.
translation: 不太对……我需要你从西边接近信标。

english: That's not quite what I-
translation: 那不是我想要的——

english: That's not really what I need.
translation: 那不是我需要的。

english: That's not right, you did not pass the test. Start over.
translation: 不对，你没有通过测试。重新开始。

english: That's not scary. I used to love doing that when I was young. Jiggle bells, jiggle bells...
translation: 这有什么好怕的。我小时候可爱玩这个了。叮当铃，叮当铃……

english: That's not specifically. It's the fact they're in the desert. Deserts are hot!
translation: 不完全是。重点是它们待在沙漠里。沙漠很热啊！

english: That's not the chest you need to try and open!
translation: 那不是你要开的箱子！

english: That's not the point of my Halloween treat!
translation: 我的万圣节糖果可不是这个意思！

english: That's not the right kind of stew.
translation: 那不是我要的那种炖菜。

english: That's not too far either, I'll head there now.
translation: 那也不算太远，我现在就过去。

english: That's not uw assigned Swayew tawget. men my cave,me expect peopwe to focus on daiw Swayew twaining.
translation: 那布是尼分配的目biao。在我的洞穴里，我希望大家专注与每日的目biao训练。

english: That's not very Christmassy?
translation: 这不太有圣诞气氛吧？

english: That's not very polite if you ask me. I was ready to be up in arms about today's youth, but I thought it would be prudent to witness the thief first.
translation: 要我说，这太没礼貌了。我本来准备好好教训一下现在的年轻人，但我觉得还是先亲眼看看那个盗贼比较稳妥。

english: That's not what I heard...
translation: 我听到的可不是这样……

english: That's not what I mean! The sword needs to look like a sword.
translation: 我不是那个意思！剑得看起来像把剑才行。

english: That's not what I'm looking for. I'm after [main].
translation: 这不是我要找的。我要找的是[main]。

english: That's not what I'm suggesting at all. I suggest we trap him somewhere. Permanently. Somewhere where no-one will ever find him.
translation: 我根本不是那个意思。我的建议是把他困在某个地方。永远地。一个没人能找到他的地方。

english: That's not what it says on Santa's list, this is the only present you'll be getting this year!
translation: 圣诞老人的名单上可不是这么写的，这是你今年唯一能得到的礼物了！

english: That's not your business, mortal.
translation: 这不关你的事，凡人。

english: That's of no concern to you.
translation: 这与你无关。

english: That's ok, I can always try one next year!
translation: 没关系，我明年再试一个也行！

english: That's ok, I understand.
translation: 没关系，我理解。

english: That's ok, but don't take too long, the festival is soon. Try searching the bushes south of here, that's where Buoy and Gurl spend most of their time.
translation: 没关系，但别拖太久，节日快到了。试试搜索南边的灌木丛，浮标和古尔大部分时间都待在那里。

english: That's ok, where would I get them?
translation: 好吧，那我去哪里弄到它们？

english: That's ok. Make sure to come back if you change your mind!
translation: 没关系。要是改变主意了，记得回来找我！

english: That's okay, I'm just looking for treats.
translation: 没关系，我只是在找糖果。

english: That's okay, it'll be nice to go together later.
translation: 没关系，晚点一起去也挺好的。

english: That's okay, means there is more for me!
translation: 没关系，这样我就能多分一点了！

english: That's one Ghast, 2 more to kill.
translation: 一个恶灵，还要再杀2个。

english: That's one Shade!
translation: 一个阴魂！

english: That's outrageously expensive.
translation: 这也贵得太离谱了。

english: That's perfect! This is sure to work!
translation: 太完美了！这肯定能行！

english: That's quite a long time to wait. What if somebody else completes the quest?
translation: 那要等很久啊。要是别人先完成了任务怎么办？

english: That's quite a situation, good luck with it.
translation: 这情况可真够呛，祝你好运。

english: That's quite alright, we're here for a good time!
translation: 完全没问题，我们就是来找乐子的！

english: That's reassuring, I suppose. Merry Christmas, you lot!
translation: 我想这还算让人放心。各位，圣诞快乐！

english: That's right! You really proved yourself goblin. You are clearly smart like rest of us.
translation: 没错！你确实证明了自己，地精。你显然和我们其他人一样聪明。

english: That's right. Sir Vyvin would never give away his wine, but I think his squire might help us. I'll give you a letter to take to the squire, in Falador Castle.
translation: 没错。维文爵士绝不会把他的酒送人，但我想他的侍从可能会帮我们。我给你一封信，你带去法拉多城堡交给那个侍从。

english: That's right. The normal egg is your control in the test. It's the point of comparison!
translation: 没错。普通的蛋是测试中的对照组。是用来比较的基准！

english: That's rough, buddy. Well, thanks for the help!
translation: 真够惨的，哥们。不过，谢谢你的帮助！

english: That's so cool! Who do I deliver it to next?
translation: 太酷了！我接下来要送给谁？

english: That's strange, I wonder where this leads? Perhaps I can clear it from the other side.
translation: 真奇怪，不知道这通向哪里？也许我可以从另一边清理掉它。

english: That's strange... After the Glough incident I thought that King Awowogei would be more accepting of humans.
translation: 真奇怪……经过格劳夫那件事后，我以为阿沃盖国王会对人类更包容一些。

english: That's terrible! How did they end up reverting the spell?
translation: 太糟糕了！他们最后是怎么逆转那个法术的？

english: That's that.
translation: 就这样吧。

english: That's the Easter Bunny!
translation: 那是复活节兔子！

english: That's the best news I've heard all year! I was so worried, thank you for helping me.
translation: 这是我今年听到最好的消息了！我一直很担心，谢谢你帮我。

english: That's the last of the monkeys caught. I should go and return them all to the Duke of Lumbridge.
translation: 这是最后一只抓到的猴子了。我应该去把它们全部还给仑桥镇公爵。

english: That's the lot! Well done! Let me craft that cape.
translation: 全齐了！干得好！让我来制作那件披风。

english: That's the one! I think this dog will be perfect for me.
translation: 就是这只！我觉得这只狗非常适合我。

english: That's the problem, there is no more fuel left.
translation: 问题就在这，已经没有燃料了。

english: That's the problem, we don't know. These goblins are dressed up as ghosts, they think they're dead and... It's all very confusing.
translation: 问题就在这，我们也不知道。这些地精打扮成幽灵的样子，他们以为自己死了，然后……这整件事非常令人困惑。

english: That's the spirit! We'll need a few more days to gather a proper army, but you're welcome to thin down the goblins hordes first if you can. Follow me...
translation: 这才像话！我们还需要几天时间来集结一支像样的军队，但如果你有本事，欢迎你先去削减一下地精大军的数量。跟我来……

english: That's the spirit! You know the drill, head down the rabbit hole and speak to my son, he's got a plan that likely requires him to do very little, and you... Well, you'll do it all!
translation: 这才像话！你懂的，老规矩，跳下兔洞去找我儿子谈谈，他有个计划，很可能他自己什么都不用做，而你……嗯，你全包了！

english: That's the spirit. You'll need to look the part, of course.
translation: 这才像话。当然，你得打扮得像个样子。

english: That's the thing, he didn't like it! He said it was exciting, but wasn't exotic enough.
translation: 问题就在这，他不喜欢！他说这很刺激，但不够异域风情。

english: That's the weapon all prepared. Now you can use it to wipe out those horrible critters.
translation: 武器已经准备好了。现在你可以用它来消灭那些讨厌的小东西了。

english: That's the wrong colour! You need a number [x] seed.
translation: 颜色不对！你需要一个编号[x]的种子。

english: That's the wrong colour! You need a seed from the [colour] pumpkin packet.
translation: 颜色不对！你需要一个来自[colour]南瓜包里的种子。

english: That's three Shades!
translation: 三个阴魂了！

english: That's too big to safely carry the orb in!
translation: 那太大了，没法安全地携带宝珠！

english: That's too far, go yourself.
translation: 那太远了，你自己去吧。

english: That's too small to fit the orb in!
translation: 那太小了，装不下宝珠！

english: That's true, but it looks like you didn't make it onto his nice list this year, this is the only present you'll be receiving!
translation: 没错，但看来你今年没上他的好孩子名单，这是你唯一能收到的礼物了！

english: That's true, it took ages to wash the melted chocolate off my hands. Maybe I'll wait until next year to try them.
translation: 没错，我花了老半天才把手上的融化巧克力洗干净。也许我还是等到明年再试吧。

english: That's two Ghasts, 1 more to kill.
translation: 两个恶灵，还要再杀1个。

english: That's two Shades!
translation: 两个阴魂了！

english: That's unfortunate. I think I heard a cat meow.
translation: 真不幸。我好像听到有猫在叫。

english: That's up to you; depends on what you find interesting.
translation: 这取决于你；看你觉得什么有趣。

english: That's very generous, I'll make you some colourful Easter eggs while you go drop those off.
translation: 你真是太慷慨了，你去送那些东西的时候，我会给你做些彩色的复活节蛋。

english: That's very kind of you [player name], I'm sure Chocco would appreciate all the help he can get.
translation: 你真是太好了[player name]，我相信乔科会感激他能得到的所有帮助。

english: That's very kind of you, but I don't want to impose. Thanks for your help, [player name]. Despite my failure you've been a big help. I will see myself out, now.
translation: 你真是太好了，但我不想给你添麻烦。谢谢你的帮助，[player name]。尽管我失败了，但你帮了大忙。我现在就自己离开了。

english: That's very kind, but... Could it not have been a cake?
translation: 你真好，但是……就不能是蛋糕吗？

english: That's what I was told.
translation: 别人是这么告诉我的。

english: That's what they want you to think.
translation: 他们就是想让你这么想。

english: That's why I'm here! Let's get egg making!
translation: 所以我来了！我们开始做蛋吧！

english: That's wonderful! Could you also check on Annie for us? She's been a bit quiet whilst we've been doing this?
translation: 太好了！你能也帮我们看看安妮吗？我们做这些事的时候她一直有点安静？

english: That's wonderful, I hope my boys had nothing to do with it being lost.
translation: 太好了，我希望我的孩子们跟它丢失的事无关。

english: That's your biggest concern?
translation: 那是你最担心的事？

english: That's... it? That's the entire secret recipe?
translation: 就……这样？这就是整个秘密食谱？

english: That's... oddly convenient. Thanks, I guess!
translation: 这……还真是方便得有点奇怪。谢了，我想！

english: That's... unfortunate. Still, the show must go on.
translation: 这……真不幸。不过，演出还是得继续。

english: That, or I should have a reason to get my own armour rather than these hand-me-downs.
translation: 要么这样，要么我就该找个理由给自己弄套盔甲，而不是穿这些别人用过的旧货。

english: That, you will see, was a pitfall trap. You need to walk around them.
translation: 你看，那是个陷坑陷阱。你得绕着它们走。

english: That... Sounds sensible.
translation: 这……听起来很合理。

english: That... actually makes sense. But you don't need to take away Christmas from the humans to celebrate it as well!
translation: 这……其实说得通。但你们没必要为了庆祝圣诞节就从人类那里夺走它！

english: That... sounds like a good idea! That may be what we're after. The Easter eggs are hollow inside, so this could work.
translation: 这……听起来是个好主意！这可能就是我们想要的。复活节蛋里面是空的，所以这应该可行。

english: Thats okay, I made some copies but you'll need to make some space to be able to take them.
translation: 没关系，我复制了一些，但你需要腾出点空间才能拿走它们。

english: Thats okay, I made some copies so here you go.
translation: 没关系，我复制了一些，给你。

english: Thatsh your problem! You've alwaysh been a lazy shwine...
translation: 这素你的问题！你一直素一头懒猪……

english: The 'Teleport to Target' spell requires level 85 Magic, and can be cast only within the Wilderness, while you have a Target. This scroll will be destroyed when it has been read.
translation: “传送至目标”法术需要85级魔法，并且只能在荒野中，且你拥有一个目标时施放。此卷轴被阅读后将会销毁。

english: The 'glowy flying things'... they're fireflies!
translation: 那些‘会飞的发光东西’……是萤火虫！

english: The 549th annual Wizard Dance Off. That thingummywut won't know what hit him when I bust out those moves!
translation: 第549届年度魔法师舞林大会。等我亮出那些舞步，那个什么玩意儿肯定会被打得措手不及！

english: The Amulet of blood fury is untradeable.
translation: 鲜血愤怒护符不可交易。

english: The Ancient Vault
translation: 远古金库

english: The Apothecary busily fills the airtight pot and then quickly seals the lid.
translation: 药剂师忙碌地装满密封罐，然后迅速盖上盖子密封好。

english: The Apothecary gets out a jar of breathing salts.
translation: 药剂师拿出一罐呼吸盐。

english: The Apothecary gives you a pot of breathing salts.
translation: 药剂师给了你一罐呼吸盐。

english: The Apothecary prepares the potion.
translation: 药剂师正在准备药水。

english: The Apothecary shows you the herbal tincture.
translation: 药剂师给你看了草药酊剂。

english: The Apothecary would be well placed to get us a memento for Herblore. His shop's in the south-west of the city.
translation: 药剂师很适合帮我们弄到草药学的纪念品。他的店在城市的西南边。

english: The Arcane grimoire refreshes your memory of the Ancient spellbook.
translation: 奥术魔法书唤醒了你对远古法术书的记忆。

english: The Arcane grimoire refreshes your memory of the Arceuus spellbook.
translation: 奥术魔法书唤醒了你对阿西乌斯城法术书的记忆。

english: The Arcane grimoire refreshes your memory of the Lunar spellbook.
translation: 奥术魔法书唤醒了你对月之法术书的记忆。

english: The Arcane grimoire refreshes your memory of the standard spellbook.
translation: 奥术魔法书唤醒了你对标准法术书的记忆。

english: The Arceuus house.
translation: 阿西乌斯城。

english: The Avatar of Creation smiles upon you.
translation: 创造化身对你露出了微笑。

english: The Avatar of Creation smites you.
translation: 创造化身重击了你。

english: The Avatar of Destruction smiles upon you.
translation: 毁灭化身对你露出了微笑。

english: The Avatar of Destruction smites you.
translation: 毁灭化身重击了你。

english: The Bank of RuneScape promises to pay the bearer, on demand, one Rune Pouch, provided the bearer is eligible to receive one. Use this Note on a bank booth to exchange it.
translation: RuneScape银行承诺，只要持票人符合资格，见票即付一个符石袋。将此票据用于银行柜台即可兑换。

english: The Barrelchest has dropped its anchor! If you could get it fixed, then it would make a formidable weapon...
translation: 桶箱怪掉落了它的锚！如果你能把它修好，那将是一件强大的武器……

english: The Battleaxe
translation: 战斧

english: The Birthday Event 2023
translation: 2023年生日活动

english: The Black Guard sent Lawgof this cannon to help defend the mines against the goblins.
translation: 黑卫队把这门大炮送给了劳戈夫，用来帮助保卫矿井，抵御地精。

english: The Blood Moon
translation: 血月

english: The Blue Moon
translation: 蓝月

english: The Book is now coated with a thin layer of flour.
translation: 这本书现在覆盖着一层薄薄的面粉。

english: The Bravery Potion bubbles with a strange effervescence, but it smells very strange, like oily burnt oranges. Are you sure you want to drink it?
translation: 勇气药水冒着奇怪的气泡，但闻起来很奇怪，像油腻的烧焦橘子味。你确定要喝它吗？

english: The Burgher gives you a hard stare.
translation: 市民对你投以严厉的目光。

english: The Burgher hands you his crown.
translation: 市民把他的王冠递给你。

english: The Cannon Engineer gives you another mould.
translation: 大炮工程师又给了你一个模具。

english: The Cannon Engineer gives you some more notes.
translation: 大炮工程师又给了你一些笔记。

english: The Cannon Engineer gives you some notes and a mould.
translation: 大炮工程师给了你一些笔记和一个模具。

english: The Captain drinks the 'rum' as quickly as possible.
translation: 船长以最快的速度喝下那杯'朗姆酒'。

english: The Captain hands you a cape.
translation: 船长递给你一件披风。

english: The Captain ponders a moment and then looks at your critically.
translation: 船长沉思片刻，然后挑剔地打量着你。

english: The Captain starts rambling on about his days as a salty sea dog. He looks quite distracted...
translation: 船长开始喋喋不休地讲述他当年当老水手的日子。他看起来心不在焉……

english: The Captain takes the Slugling and stamps on it until it stops squirming, then hands it back.
translation: 船长抓起小蛞蝓，用力踩踏直到它不再扭动，然后把它还给你。

english: The Cathedral.
translation: 大教堂。

english: The Chieftain hands you the letter back.
translation: 酋长把信还给你。

english: The Christmas toy production will continue on schedule!
translation: 圣诞玩具的生产将如期进行！

english: The Clue Compass doesn't respond to that clue step.
translation: 线索指南针对这个线索步骤没有反应。

english: The Combat Achievements for the Doom of Mokhaiotl are here!
translation: 莫凯奥特之灾的战斗成就来了！

english: The Cook gives you a shopping list. You glance over it quickly.
translation: 厨师递给你一张购物清单。你快速扫了一眼。

english: The Cook hands you a letter addressed to Sir Vyvin's squire, care of Falador Castle.
translation: 厨师递给你一封写给维文爵士侍从的信，由法拉多城堡转交。

english: The Cook hands you a serving platter.
translation: 厨师递给你一个上菜盘。

english: The Cook loads up your serving platter with the food.
translation: 厨师把你的上菜盘装满了食物。

english: The Cook presents you with a special cake. It looks inedible.
translation: 厨师为你端上一个特别的蛋糕。它看起来不能吃。

english: The Corgi in the Christmas tree costume.
translation: 穿着圣诞树服装的柯基犬。

english: The Count seems happy enough with his presents already!
translation: 伯爵似乎已经对他的礼物很满意了！

english: The Count takes the golden rings from your fingers one at a time as he counts them out, too distracted to notice the human hand.
translation: 伯爵一边数着金戒指，一边一个接一个地从你手指上取下，太过专注以至于没注意到那只人类的手。

english: The Crypt of Tonali, in the Tlati Rainforest. The cult believe the crypt houses the secret path to Mokhaiotl.
translation: 托纳利墓穴，位于特拉提雨林中。该教派相信墓穴中隐藏着通往莫凯奥特尔的秘密通道。

english: The Culinaromancer teleports away, leaving a portal behind him.
translation: 烹饪大师传送走了，留下了一个传送门。

english: The Cupboard
translation: 橱柜

english: The Dark Mage casts a spell on the amulet.
translation: 黑暗法师对护身符施了一个法术。

english: The Dark Mage hands you an incantation.
translation: 黑暗法师递给你一段咒语。

english: The Dark Mage pauses for a moment, as if lost in thought. He then hastily pulls out a scroll and scribbles something on it.
translation: 黑暗法师停顿了一下，仿佛陷入了沉思。然后他匆忙抽出一张卷轴，在上面潦草地写了些什么。

english: The Dark Mage suddenly starts talking to someone else.
translation: 黑暗法师突然开始和别人说话。

english: The Dark Mage turns back to you.
translation: 黑暗法师转过身来面对你。

english: The Dark mage has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 黑暗法师又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: The Demon Slayer Quest
translation: 恶魔杀手任务

english: The Desert is a VERY Dangerous place. Do not enter if you areafraid of dying. Beware of high temperatures, sand storms, robbers,and slavers. No responsibility is taken by Shantay if anything badshould happen to you in any circumstances whatsoever.
translation: 沙漠是个非常危险的地方。如果你怕死就别进去。小心高温、沙暴、强盗和奴隶贩子。如果任何情况下你遭遇不测，沙泰概不负责。

english: The Doom Sayer seems happy enough with his present already!
translation: 厄运预言者似乎已经对他的礼物很满意了！

english: The Doomsayer blows the whistle...
translation: 厄运预言者吹响了哨子……

english: The Dragon Inn bartender signs the portrait.
translation: 龙之酒馆的酒保在肖像上签了名。

english: The Duke asked me to return to him after speaking to Zeke before trying to capture any monkeys.
translation: 公爵让我在尝试捕捉猴子之前，先和齐克谈谈再回去找他。

english: The Duke hands you some coins.
translation: 公爵递给你一些金币。

english: The Duke hands you the talisman.
translation: 公爵把护符递给你。

english: The Duke loads you up with presents.
translation: 公爵给你装满了礼物。

english: The Duke seemed to imply that there was a sapling growing somewhere on the castle grounds.
translation: 公爵似乎暗示城堡场地的某处长着一棵树苗。

english: The Duke shows you a talisman.
translation: 公爵给你看一个护符。

english: The Duke writes a document and signs it.
translation: 公爵写了一份文件并签了名。

english: The Dwarf Captain gives you a tool kit.
translation: 矮人船长给了你一个工具包。

english: The Dwarf Captain gives you another railing.
translation: 矮人船长又给了你一根栏杆。

english: The Dwarf Captain gives you another toolkit.
translation: 矮人船长又给了你一个工具包。

english: The Dwarf Captain gives you six railings.
translation: 矮人船长给了你六根栏杆。

english: The Dwarf writes on a scrap of paper and hands it to you.
translation: 矮人在一张纸屑上写了些东西，然后递给你。

english: The Earthbound Cavern
translation: 大地洞穴

english: The Easter Bunny adds some chocolate chips to the milk filled frozen churn.
translation: 复活节兔子往装满牛奶的冷冻搅拌桶里加了些巧克力片。

english: The Easter Bunny asked me to search for it, I think the egg mould will work if I can return it.
translation: 复活节兔子让我去找它，我想如果能把它拿回来，鸡蛋模具就能用了。

english: The Easter Bunny awards you a pair of bunny feet boots.
translation: 复活节兔子奖励你一双兔脚靴。

english: The Easter Bunny gives you a chicken head.
translation: 复活节兔子给了你一个鸡头。

english: The Easter Bunny gives you some chicken feet.
translation: 复活节兔子给了你一些鸡脚。

english: The Easter Bunny gives you some chicken legs.
translation: 复活节兔子给了你一些鸡腿。

english: The Easter Bunny gives you some chicken wings. You can now do the improved Flap Emote, if you have unlocked it from the Stronghold of Security.
translation: 复活节兔子给了你一些鸡翅。如果你已经从安全要塞解锁了拍翅动作，现在可以做出更好的版本了。

english: The Easter Bunny gives you the Unmixed Mixture.
translation: 复活节兔子给了你未混合的混合物。

english: The Easter Bunny hands you a rather large bucket.
translation: 复活节兔子递给你一个相当大的桶。

english: The Easter Bunny hands you a replacement big bucket.
translation: 复活节兔子递给你一个替换用的大桶。

english: The Easter Bunny hands you another basket.
translation: 复活节兔子又递给你一个篮子。

english: The Easter Bunny hands you some chocolate eggs and an egg shaped helm.
translation: 复活节兔子递给你一些巧克力蛋和一个蛋形头盔。

english: The Easter Bunny hands you the bucket of camel milk.
translation: 复活节兔子把装满骆驼奶的桶递给你。

english: The Easter Bunny hands you the frozen churn.
translation: 复活节兔子把冷冻搅拌桶递给你。

english: The Easter Bunny hands you the ice cooler.
translation: 复活节兔子把冰桶递给你。

english: The Easter Bunny inspects the egg mould.
translation: 复活节兔子检查了鸡蛋模具。

english: The Easter Bunny mixes all the ingredients together to make what appears to be an unmixed liquid.
translation: 复活节兔子把所有原料混合在一起，制成了一种看起来是未混合的液体。

english: The Easter Bunny needs your help.
translation: 复活节兔子需要你的帮助。

english: The Easter Bunny places both of the Easter eggs into your cooler.
translation: 复活节兔子把两个复活节蛋都放进你的冷却器里。

english: The Easter Bunny places two new test eggs into your cooler.
translation: 复活节兔子把两个新的测试蛋放进你的冷却器里。

english: The Easter Bunny pulls a giant Easter egg from his burrow and hands it to you.
translation: 复活节兔子从他的洞穴里拿出一个巨型复活节彩蛋递给你。

english: The Easter Bunny said the Eastfloor spade had a special connection to the mould, perhaps I should use that.
translation: 复活节兔子说东地之铲和模具之间有特殊的联系，也许我应该用它。

english: The Easter Bunny shows you the churn you made. You say nothing.
translation: 复活节兔子给你看你做的搅拌桶。你一言不发。

english: The Easter Bunny walks over to the churn.
translation: 复活节兔子走向搅拌桶。

english: The Easter Bunny will know how to extract the mould.
translation: 复活节兔子知道如何取出模具。

english: The Easter bunnies are delivering eggs, but I can't find them.
translation: 复活节兔子们正在运送蛋，但我找不到它们。

english: The Easter bunny gives you a new cooler containing two test Easter eggs.
translation: 复活节兔子给了你一个新的冷却器，里面装着两个测试用的复活节蛋。

english: The Easter bunny gives you a rubber chicken.
translation: 复活节兔子给了你一只橡胶鸡。

english: The Eclipse Moon
translation: 月蚀

english: The Elite Void Knight hands you over some paint.
translation: 精英虚空骑士递给你一些油漆。

english: The Elite Void Knight swaps the void orb for a bucket of paint.
translation: 精英虚空骑士用虚空宝珠换了一桶油漆。

english: The Emir knows the benefits of showcasing the city of Al Kharid to a global audience at an event such as this, and has entrusted me to ensure everything runs flawlessly.
translation: 埃米尔深知在这样一场盛会中向全球观众展示阿尔卡里德城的好处，并委托我确保一切顺利进行。

english: The Empty Lord is gone! He will not answer your prayers!
translation: 空虚之主已经消失！他不会回应你的祈祷！

english: The Envoy to Varlamore, by Deryk Paulson. You already have a copy.
translation: 《瓦拉莫尔特使》，德里克.保尔森著。你已经有一本了。

english: The Envoy to Varlamore, by Deryk Paulson. You don't have room to take a copy.
translation: 《瓦拉莫尔特使》，德里克.保尔森著。你没有空间再拿一本了。

english: The Envoy to Varlamore, by Deryk Paulson. You take a copy.
translation: 《瓦拉莫尔特使》，德里克.保尔森著。你拿了一本。

english: The Evil Chicken
translation: 邪恶鸡

english: The Eye of Ayak has been charged with demon tears. It currently has [#] charges.
translation: 阿亚克的眼已用恶魔之泪充能。目前有 [#] 次充能。

english: The Eye of Ayak has been charged with runes. It currently has [#] charges.
translation: 阿亚克的眼已用符文充能。目前有 [#] 次充能。

english: The Eye of Ayak has no charges! You need to charge it with either death runes and chaos runes or with demon tears.|colour=red
translation: 阿亚克的眼没有充能了！你需要用死亡符文和混沌符文，或者恶魔之泪来给它充能。|colour=red

english: The Eye of Ayak is charged with demon tears, and thus can only be charged with more demon tears. You must fully uncharge it to use runes.
translation: 阿亚克的眼充能了恶魔之泪，因此只能用更多的恶魔之泪充能。你必须完全耗尽能量才能使用符文。

english: The Eye of Ayak is charged with runes, and thus can only be charged with more runes. You must fully uncharge it to use demon tears.
translation: 阿亚克的眼充能了符文，因此只能用更多的符文充能。你必须完全耗尽能量才能使用恶魔之泪。

english: The Fairy Queen gives you an XP lamp.
translation: 仙子女王给了你一个经验之灯。

english: The Farmer is harmless.
translation: 农夫是无害的。

english: The Feldip Hills are under Bandosian control, but are of limited strategic value.
translation: 费迪普丘陵处于班多斯教的控制之下，但战略价值有限。

english: The Frogs agreed to begin peace talks with Marcellus. I let him know about this, but he told me he would only be willing to negotiate with their leader.
translation: 青蛙们同意与马塞勒斯开始和平谈判。我告诉了他这件事，但他告诉我他只愿意与他们的领袖谈判。

english: The Frogs held an election to select their leader, but due to the sabotage, Cuthbert died, making Sue the winner by default. She then gave me an offer to present to Marcellus' that would see the Frogs deal with the nearby Flies for him.
translation: 青蛙们举行了一次选举来选出他们的领袖，但由于破坏行为，卡斯伯特死了，苏默认获胜。然后她给了我一个提议，让我转交给马塞勒斯，提议内容是青蛙们会为他处理附近的苍蝇。

english: The Frostenhorn has been missing since the loss of the Pontifex Maximus. It was removed from Senntisten by unknown individuals. Status unknown.
translation: 自大祭司长失踪以来，弗罗斯滕霍恩号也下落不明。它被不明身份的人从森提斯滕移走。状态未知。

english: The Frostenhorn isn't here.
translation: 弗罗斯滕霍恩号不在这里。

english: The General hands you a severed leg.
translation: 将军递给你一条断腿。

english: The Ghostly Gala is splendid and, of course, spooky! We do it every year around this time, you know?
translation: 幽灵盛会既华丽又当然很恐怖！我们每年这个时候都会举办，你知道吗？

english: The Goblin people are a notoriously stupid race. Try as I might, I have had no success in organising and mobilising them as a cohesive fighting unit. Perhaps they would be better off as kebabs after all?
translation: 地精一族是出了名的愚蠢种族。无论我怎么努力，都无法将他们组织并动员成一支有凝聚力的战斗部队。也许他们还是做成烤肉串比较好？

english: The Goblins have been attacking Falador for over a week now and we need your help.
translation: 哥布林攻击法拉多城已经超过一个星期了，我们需要你的帮助。

english: The Pandemonium, I'll need to see if there's a boat heading there from Port Sarim.
translation: 潘德莫尼姆岛，我得看看有没有从沙林港出发去那里的船。

english: The Parents of the Boys told me I'd need to give them time to recover before asking them about what happened. In the meantime, I helped them out by reinforcing their Scratched Wall. At their request, I also spoke to Captain Ariadna about what happened.
translation: 男孩们的父母告诉我，得给他们时间恢复，才能问他们发生了什么。与此同时，我帮他们加固了那面有划痕的墙。应他们的要求，我也跟阿里阿德涅船长说了这件事。

english: The Phalanx only looks compatible with Osmumten's Fang.
translation: 方阵看起来只与奥斯穆滕之牙兼容。

english: The Pixie Foreman says they're striking cause Santa is on holiday and they can't have one.
translation: 精灵工头说他们在罢工，因为圣诞老人放假了，他们却没法放假。

translation: 女王和维比亚出发前往福蒂斯，带上了富里亚。

translation: 盗贼女王任务已开始。

english: The Rewards Guardian doesn't respond. They presumably don't recognise the diary.
translation: 奖励守护者没有回应。他们大概不认得这本日记。

english: The Sage has well and truly earned their place in my domain. Such squandered potential...
translation: 智者确实在我的领域中赢得了自己的位置。真是浪费了潜力……

english: The Sage takes your voucher and hands you a Scythe of vitur (uncharged).

translation: 谢兹恩城的记录显示，自从开始统计你的击杀数以来，你已经杀了[number]只蜥蜴人。其中一只是蜥蜴人萨满。

english: The Sinclair Family Crest is hung up here.
translation: 辛克莱尔家徽挂在这里。

english: The Sinclair family crest. It's shiny and freshly polished and has a slight smell of poison.
translation: 辛克莱尔家徽。它闪闪发亮，像是刚抛光过，还带着一丝毒药的气味。

translation: 西部兔子吞掉了蛋，你递过去的时候差点连你的手也吞了。

translation: 堡垒陷落时，低语者正驻守在拉萨尔。此后音讯全无。推定已死亡。

translation: 白骑士的间谍已将搜索范围缩小到维洛克城内某处，你应该去那里找找看。

translation: 老智者对奥利维亚施放了传送他人法术，将她送走，然后转向银行

translation: 老智者对Elfinlocks施放了一个法术，杀死了她，她掉落了蓝色派对帽

translation: 老智者对枷锁守卫施放了一个法术

translation: 老智者对派对帽施放了远程抓取，戴上它，然后向剩下的银行职员逼近

translation: 幻影消失在你埋葬尸体的地面下。你看到面前的地面震动，一块骨片破土而出。你拿起骨片，把它放进你的

english: The armour worn by the White Knights is of a special custom made equipment, that is not freely available, for it marks membership of my glorious order of the White Knights. Only those chosen specifically to become a member of the order are permitted to wear such armour, and at this moment no players may join this order as anything other than a freelance operative, and as such may not wear the armour. I suspect the accursed Kinshra have a similar system in place, though my knowledge of such evil workings is limited.
translation: 白骑士所穿的盔甲是特制的专属装备，并非随意可得，因为它标志着我光荣的白骑士团成员身份。只有被特别选中成为骑士团成员的人才能穿这种盔甲，而目前玩家只能以自由行动特工的身份加入这个骑士团，因此不能穿这种盔甲。我怀疑那些该死的金什拉也有类似的制度，不过我对这种邪恶运作方式的了解有限。

english: The assassin collects his sword and departs.
translation: 刺客收起他的剑离开了。

translation: 刺客给了你一个开锁器。

translation: 刺客留下了你制造巨大噪音所需的一切。

english: The aura of Fillimans camp protects you from the swamp.
translation: 菲利曼营地的光环保护你免受沼泽的侵害。

translation: 斧头从亡灵木头上弹开了。你应该向艾娃报告此事。

translation: 斧头损坏了，需要在磨刀石上修理。

translation: 斧头状态不佳，但应该可以修复。不过，不幸的是，你觉得自己没有所需的技能。要修理这把斧头，你需要70级锻造。

english: The axe isn't in a great state, but it should be possible to repair it. You reckon you have the skills needed to do so yourself. You'll just need a hammer and an anvil.
translation: 斧头状态不佳，但应该可以修复。你认为自己具备所需的技能。你只需要一把锤子和一个铁砧。

english: The backpack seems to be empty.
translation: 背包似乎是空的。

translation: 气球坠毁了。

english: The balm makes you feel odd...
translation: 这药膏让你感觉怪怪的……

translation: 酒保给了你一杯啤酒，换取了两枚金币。

translation: 桶现在是空的。

translation: 桶里散发着标准吉里诺尔酒馆的气味。

english: The barrels have been disturbed recently. Someone came this way.
translation: 这些桶最近被动过。有人来过这里。

english: The bartender gives you a glass of Liverbane Ale.
translation: 酒保给了你一杯灭肝麦酒。

english: The bartender hands you a small glass and sets light to the contents.
translation: 酒保递给你一个小杯子，并点燃了里面的东西。

translation: 酒保在你的卡片上潦草地签了名。

translation: 酒保给你端来一杯奇怪的浓稠黑色液体。

translation: 酒保在你的卡片上签了名。

translation: 豆茎太粗了，你砍不断。也许有办法让它变细？

english: The beehive buzzes with activity. These bees definitely don't seem poisoned at all.
translation: 蜂箱里嗡嗡作响，一片繁忙。这些蜜蜂看起来完全没有中毒。

translation: 封住窗户的最佳材料是枯木——那邪恶的光芒应该能阻止他干扰它。

translation: 最好的路线是穿过法拉多城。从北门出发，沿西北方向的道路前进。如果你到了哥布林村庄，那就走过头了，所以掉头向南。

translation: 想知道你是否信任某人，最好的方法就是信任他们。

translation: 短棍商人试图用短棍击晕玩家。

translation: 短棍商人朝那个顽童挥了一棍，但只是擦过了他的头。

english: The blacksmith gives you a damaged axe.
translation: 铁匠给了你一把损坏的斧头。

translation: 铁匠想给你一把损坏的斧头，但你的背包空间不够。

translation: 刀片状态不佳，但应该可以修复。不过，不幸的是，你觉得自己没有所需的技能。要修理这把剑，你需要70级锻造。

translation: 船夫从你那里拿走了三块木板，用来修理他的船。

translation: 尸体是塞里尔.卡尼利安爵士的。他脸朝下躺在地上，死因似乎是背部的一处刺伤。伤口看起来是由一把异常薄的刀片造成的。

translation: 利维乌斯的尸体。他穿着戏服，死因不明。

translation: 这本书是用一种你不懂的语言写的。萨法拉恩知道该怎么处理它。

translation: 书中提到一件埋藏在库兰德王国的人工制品，但作者没有说明埋藏的具体位置。也许你能说服她改变主意。

english: The bookshelf contains lots of antiquarian books, and a curious feline statue.

translation: 老板让我告诉你去找马丁谈谈。

translation: 这个瓶子现在覆盖着一层薄薄的面粉。

translation: 巨石滚下山坡，冲进了村庄。一个哥布林勉强躲开了滚过的巨石。

translation: 装饰品箱子满了。你应该把这个交给精灵首领。

translation: 箱子竟然是空的。费了这么大劲才到这里！

translation: 那个男孩看起来非常难过。

translation: 那些男孩一定把模具藏在流浪汉查理附近了。

translation: 布罗夫仍然一动不动。

translation: 布罗夫保持静止。

english: The brush is too long to attach any more canes.
translation: 刷子太长了，不能再连接更多藤条了。

translation: 桶降了下去，但没有到达底部。

translation: 桶里已经装满了沙子。

english: The burn adds extra crisp that trolls love!
translation: 烧焦的部分增添了额外的酥脆，巨魔们很喜欢！

english: The bush has been disturbed recently. Someone came this way.

translation: 灌木丛变得沉寂，蜜蜂们离开了。你帮助森林变得更加多样和美丽！|colour=green

translation: 卷心菜从天花板上的洞掉下来，落入药水中，将其毁掉了。

translation: 卷心菜太扎手了，没有手部保护无法采摘。

translation: 卷心菜异常难拔。再用力点？

english: The cabbages are evolving…

translation: 卷心菜正在世界上占据它们应有的位置，你可以帮助它们。

translation: 蛋糕抗拒所有吃掉它的尝试。

english: The camera closes in as Hazelmere casts a mind spell on the player's head.
translation: 镜头拉近，黑兹尔米尔对玩家的头部施放了一个心灵法术。

english: The camera pans around to face his sleeping congregation.
translation: 镜头平移，转向他沉睡的会众。

english: The camera pans to show the terror dog cages being unlocked.

translation: 镜头转向逼近的阴影，屏幕渐黑。

english: The camera pans to the street urchin.

english: The camp dweller shakes his head.

english: The cannon blows up!

english: The cannon has been fired, but not cleaned with a Ramrod.
translation: 大炮已经发射过，但没有用搠杖清理。

english: The cannon has been loaded with ammunition.
translation: 大炮已经装填了弹药。

english: The cannon has had powder added.
translation: 大炮已经添加了火药。

english: The cape (complete!)
translation: 披风（完成！）

english: The captain marches away in disgust leaving his guards to tackle you
translation: 船长厌恶地走开了，留下他的卫兵来对付你。

translation: 船长似乎被你刚才说的话分散了注意力。船长望向窗外看是否有火灾。

english: The captain smiles broadly and with a sickening voice says...
translation: 船长咧嘴大笑，用令人作呕的声音说道……

english: The cart driver completely ignores you.
translation: 推车车夫完全无视了你。

english: The cart driver goes back to his work, laughing to himself.
translation: 推车车夫回到他的工作中，自顾自地笑着。

english: The cart driver laughs at your pun...
translation: 推车车夫被你的双关语逗笑了……

english: The cart driver looks around at you and tries to weigh you up.
translation: 推车车夫打量着你，似乎在掂量你的分量。

english: The cart driver points at a nearby guard.
translation: 推车车夫指向附近的一名守卫。

english: The cart driver quickly starts preparing the cart.
translation: 推车车夫迅速开始准备推车。

english: The cart driver seems much happier now.
translation: 推车车夫现在看起来开心多了。

english: The cart driver seems to be busy inspecting the cart for defects.
translation: 推车车夫似乎正忙着检查推车有没有缺陷。

english: The cart driver seems to be festidiously cleaning his cart. It doesn't look as if he wants to be disturbed.
translation: 推车车夫似乎正在一丝不苟地清洁他的推车。看起来他不想被打扰。

english: The cart driver seems visibly shaken...
translation: 推车车夫明显在发抖……

english: The cart driver smiles a bit and then turns to you.
translation: 推车车夫微微一笑，然后转向你。

english: The cart driver turns around quickly to face you.
translation: 推车车夫迅速转过身来面对你。

english: The cart is now full.
translation: 推车现在装满了。

english: The castle walls.
translation: 城堡的城墙。

english: The cat continues to purr contently. or
translation: 猫继续满足地咕噜咕噜叫。

english: The cat runs off and hides.
translation: 猫跑开躲了起来。

english: The cave kraken stares blankly at you.
translation: 洞穴克拉肯海怪茫然地盯着你。

english: The cave smells funny. I'd rather not go in there without a good reason.
translation: 洞穴里气味古怪。没有充分理由的话，我宁愿不进去。

english: The cavern is empty of gublinch now; there's no need to go down there.
translation: 洞穴里已经没有哥布林奇了；没必要下去了。

english: The cavern is silent. Caverns do not know the answers to such questions.
translation: 洞穴一片寂静。洞穴不知道这些问题的答案。

english: The cavern is silent. Caverns do not react to anger.
translation: 洞穴一片寂静。洞穴不会对愤怒做出反应。

english: The cavern is silent. Caverns do not speak.
translation: 洞穴一片寂静。洞穴不会说话。

english: The cavern is silent. Caverns do not sympathise with humans.
translation: 洞穴一片寂静。洞穴不会同情人类。

english: The cell door is securely locked.
translation: 牢房门锁得严严实实。

english: The chalice only contains some old ashes.
translation: 圣杯里只有一些旧灰烬。

english: The charred key breaks off in the lock, but the chest opens! Inside is a large cache of paint. You take some.
translation: 焦黑的钥匙断在了锁里，但箱子打开了！里面是一大堆颜料。你拿了一些。

english: The chatbox chathead interface is closed. The player can now try again to climb the third tree.
translation: 聊天框头像界面已关闭。玩家现在可以再次尝试爬上第三棵树。

english: The chemist gives you some touch paper.
translation: 化学家给了你一些引火纸。

english: The chest contains some body runes. A label on the chest reads 'Olkat'.
translation: 箱子里有一些身体符文。箱子上贴着标签写着'Olkat'。

english: The chest contains some bottles of what seems to be poison. A label on the chest reads 'Achi Toka'.
translation: 箱子里有几瓶看起来像是毒药的东西。箱子上贴着标签写着'Achi Toka'。

english: The chest contains some empty packages. It looks like they were used to hold food.
translation: 箱子里有一些空包装。看起来是用来装食物的。

english: The chest contains some hourglasses. A label on the chest reads 'Miki Toka'.
translation: 箱子里有一些沙漏。箱子上贴着标签写着'Miki Toka'。

english: The chest contains what look to be home teleport tablets. A label on the chest reads 'Antil'.
translation: 箱子里看起来是些回家传送石。箱子上贴着标签写着'Antil'。

english: The chest has a strange slot on the front, but you can't see any obvious way to open it.
translation: 箱子正面有一个奇怪的插槽，但你看不出任何明显的打开方法。

english: The chest is empty.
translation: 箱子是空的。

english: The chest is full of strange devices, but as you have one you leave them alone.
translation: 箱子里装满了奇怪的装置，但既然你已经有了一件，就不去动它们了。

english: The chest is full of strange devices. You take one.
translation: 箱子里装满了奇怪的装置。你拿了一个。

english: The chest is locked.
translation: 箱子锁着。

english: The chest is locked. It looks like it needs a key.
translation: 箱子锁着。看起来需要一把钥匙。

english: The chest is locked. You'll need a lockpick to pick the lock on it.
translation: 箱子锁着。你需要一把开锁器来撬开它。

english: The chest is securely locked.
translation: 箱子锁得很牢。

english: The chest is securely locked. It looks like it needs a key to open it.
translation: 箱子锁得严严实实。看起来需要一把钥匙才能打开。

english: The chest is securely locked. You can't see any obvious way to unlock it.
translation: 箱子锁得严严实实。你看不出任何明显的解锁方法。

english: The chest opens and inside you find a strange dark liquid.
translation: 箱子打开了，里面你发现了一种奇怪的黑色液体。

english: The chest opens but it contains nothing.
translation: 箱子打开了，但里面什么也没有。

english: The chest pops open and you snatch a very aged piece of parchment before it slams shut again.
translation: 箱子啪地弹开，你抢出一张非常陈旧的羊皮纸，然后它又砰地关上了。

english: The chick is... no more.
translation: 小鸡……没了。

english: The chicken leaves behind an odd book.
translation: 鸡留下了一本奇怪的书。

english: The chieftain quickly drinks the second keg and stumbles off.
translation: 酋长迅速喝下第二桶酒，然后跌跌撞撞地走了。

english: The chieftain takes both kegs and quickly drinks one.
translation: 酋长接过两桶酒，迅速喝了一桶。

english: The child bursts into tears when they open the present to find it contains a lump of coal.
translation: 孩子打开礼物发现里面是一块煤，顿时大哭起来。

english: The child hands you a Treat cauldron.
translation: 孩子递给你一个糖果埚。

english: The children of the sun! That's Itzla Arkan, heir to the throne of Varlamore! And there's Servius, the Teokan of Ralos!
translation: 太阳之子！那是伊茨拉.阿尔坎，瓦拉莫尔的王位继承人！还有塞尔维乌斯，拉洛斯的特奥坎！

english: The chocolate chips disperse nicely throughout the frozen camel milk mix.
translation: 巧克力片均匀地分散在冷冻的骆驼奶混合物中。

english: The chute down to the sea looks like it will break the boat if used.
translation: 通往大海的滑道看起来如果使用的话会把船撞坏。

english: The citizens are still as eager as ever, though, and I hear Varrock is the place to be for Trick-or-Treaters!
translation: 不过市民们依然热情不减，我听说维洛克城是玩'不给糖就捣蛋'的好地方！

english: The citizens are still eager as ever, though, and I hear Varrock is the place to be for Trick-or-Treaters!
translation: 不过市民们依然热情不减，我听说维洛克城是玩'不给糖就捣蛋'的好地方！

english: The city of Al Kharid wishes you an excellent stay, adventurer.
translation: 阿尔卡里德城祝您在此愉快，冒险者。

english: The clam is empty. For some reason, you consider placing something inside.
translation: 蛤蜊是空的。不知为何，你考虑放点东西进去。

english: The clam is shut and won't budge. You don't think you'll be seeing your item again.
translation: 蛤蜊紧闭着，纹丝不动。你觉得是拿不回你的东西了。

english: The clam seems to be offering you a pearl. You take it.
translation: 蛤蜊似乎要给你一颗珍珠。你收下了。

english: The clam spits the pearl back at you, refusing to take it.
translation: 蛤蜊把珍珠吐回给你，拒绝收下。

english: The coast is clear, nobody's home.
translation: 海岸很安全，没人在家。

english: The code was incorrect.
translation: 密码错误。

english: The coffer is empty.
translation: 保险箱是空的。

english: The coffer is empty. You need at least 1,000 coins to make a deposit.
translation: 保险箱是空的。你需要至少 1,000 金币才能存入。

english: The coffin creaks open...
translation: 棺材吱呀一声打开了……

english: The coffin is incredible heavy, and does not budge.
translation: 棺材重得不可思议，纹丝不动。

english: The cog fits perfectly.
translation: 齿轮完美契合。

english: The cog is red hot from the flames. You cannot pick it up.
translation: 齿轮被火焰烧得通红。你拿不起来。

english: The coin purse is already full of sand.
translation: 钱袋里已经装满了沙子。

english: The collector hands you the Adamant staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你精金藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Black staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你黑铁藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Bronze staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你青铜藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Dragon staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你龙金藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Gilded staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你镀金藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Iron staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你铁制藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Mithril staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你秘银藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Rune staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你符文藏品法杖。

english: The collector hands you the Steel staff of collection.
translation: 收藏家递给你钢制藏品法杖。

english: The combat instructor gives you a bronze sword and a wooden shield.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一把青铜剑和一面木盾。

english: The combat instructor gives you a shortbow and some bronze arrows.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一把短弓和一些青铜箭。

english: The combination seems correct!
translation: 组合似乎正确！

english: The compartment in the furnace looks like it should hold something. It looks like it needs one more piece.
translation: 熔炉里的隔间看起来应该放点东西。看起来还需要一块。

english: The compartment in the furnace looks like it should hold something. It looks like it needs two more pieces.
translation: 熔炉里的隔间看起来应该放点东西。看起来还需要两块。

english: The compartment in the furnace looks like it should hold something. It's divided into three seperate sections.
translation: 熔炉里的隔间看起来应该放点东西。它被分成了三个独立的部分。

english: The compost bin contains a different kind of compost to what you have in your
translation: 堆肥箱里的堆肥种类与你手中的不同。

english: The compost bin contains compostable items
translation: 堆肥箱里装有可堆肥的物品

english: The compost bin contains supercompostable items
translation: 堆肥箱里装有可制成高级堆肥的物品

english: The compost bin contains tomatoes
translation: 堆肥箱里装有番茄

english: The compost bin is closed.
translation: 堆肥箱是关闭的。

english: The compost bin is empty.
translation: 堆肥箱是空的。

english: The compost bin is now empty.
translation: 堆肥箱现在空了。

english: The compost bin must be emptied before you can put new items in it.
translation: 必须先清空堆肥箱，才能放入新物品。

english: The compost is teeming with maggots. Somebody should really do something about it. It's certainly clear nobody's used poison here.
translation: 堆肥里满是蛆虫。真该有人管管了。很明显没人在这里用过毒药。

english: The compost transforms into supercompost.
translation: 堆肥转化成了超级堆肥。

english: The container shakes violently, thrumming with magical energy. You reckon it might be useful for shipbuilding.
translation: 容器剧烈摇晃，充满了魔法能量的嗡鸣声。你觉得它可能对造船有用。

english: The contents have begun to rot.
translation: 里面的东西开始腐烂了。

english: The contents of your cargo hold are washed away as the ship sinks.
translation: 随着船沉没，你货舱里的货物都被冲走了。

english: The contract is between Livius and Xocotla. It's for the shipping of an undescribed object.
translation: 合同在利维乌斯和索科特拉之间。内容是关于运输一件未描述的物品。

english: The cook mentioned that you owe him a favour.
translation: 厨师提到你欠他一个人情。

english: The cook said that My Arm thought his plain pizza wasn't exotic enough. Maybe I can do something to make it more exotic?
translation: 厨师说'我的手臂'觉得他的原味披萨不够异域风情。也许我能做点什么让它更异域一些？

english: The cook suggested I give these to someone else instead of just hogging them all to myself.
translation: 厨师建议我把这些给别人，而不是自己独吞。

english: The corpse seems to regenerate again!
translation: 尸体似乎又再生了！

english: The cosmetically upgraded pickaxe is too beautiful to convert into an infernal pickaxe.
translation: 经过外观升级的镐子太漂亮了，无法转化为地狱镐。

english: The costumer gives you one of her special needles.
translation: 服装师给了你一根她的特制针。

english: The course hasn't been used for some time. Just want to make sure it still all works.
translation: 这条路线已经有一段时间没用过了。只是想确认一下它是否还能正常运作。

english: The cows seemed to enjoy that.
translation: 那些奶牛似乎很喜欢这样。

english: The cows seemed to enjoy that. You should return to Sarah.
translation: 那些奶牛似乎很喜欢这样。你应该回到莎拉那里去。

english: The crate contains a bottle of [drink name], but you don't take it as you've already sampled it before.
translation: 板条箱里有一瓶[drink name]，但你没有拿，因为你以前已经尝过了。

english: The crate contains a bottle of [drink name], but you doubt your ability to stomach it. You need a Sailing level of [number] to do so.
translation: 板条箱里有一瓶[drink name]，但你怀疑自己能不能喝得下去。你需要 [number] 级的航海技能才能喝。

english: The crate contains a bottle of fish bladder stout, but you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 板条箱里有一瓶鱼鳔黑啤酒，但你没有足够的空间拿。

english: The crate contains a bottle of fish bladder stout, but you don't take it as you already have one.
translation: 板条箱里有一瓶鱼鳔黑啤酒，但你没有拿，因为你已经有了一瓶。

english: The crate contains some blessed silver sickles. You leave them as you have no need for one.
translation: 板条箱里有一些祝福过的银镰刀。你没有拿，因为你不需要。

english: The crate contains some chains. You leave them as you have no need for any.
translation: 板条箱里有一些锁链。你没有拿，因为你不需要。

english: The crate contains that water-repellant waxwood Old Man Yarlo described. You take some.
translation: 板条箱里装着老人亚洛描述的那种防水蜡木。你拿了一些。

english: The crate is already full.
translation: 板条箱已经满了。

english: The crate is empty.
translation: 板条箱是空的。

english: The crate is empty. It's just about big enough to hide inside.
translation: 板条箱是空的。大小刚好够躲进去。

english: The crate is filled with uncharged cells, but you already have plenty.
translation: 板条箱里装满了未充能的能量单元，但你已经有足够多了。

english: The crate is filled with uncharged cells. You take some.
translation: 板条箱里装满了未充能的能量单元。你拿了一些。

english: The crate is full of bananas.
translation: 板条箱里装满了香蕉。

english: The crate is full of hammers, but you leave them as you already have one.
translation: 板条箱里装满了锤子，但你已经有了一把，所以没拿。

english: The crate is full of saws, but you leave them as you already have one.
translation: 板条箱里装满了锯子，但你已经有了一把，所以没拿。

english: The crawl space on the other side of the cavity seems quite restrictive. You'll need both of your hands free.
translation: 空腔另一侧的爬行空间似乎非常狭窄。你需要腾出双手。

english: The creature becomes instantly sober, horror all too evident in his undead eyes.
translation: 那只生物瞬间清醒过来，不死之眼中充满了恐惧。

english: The creature stumbles over towards the mirror, focuses upon his reflection and...
translation: 那只生物跌跌撞撞地走向镜子，凝视着自己的倒影，然后……

english: The creatures stop and turn towards Anti-Santa.
translation: 那些生物停了下来，转向反圣诞老人。

english: The creatures surge towards the castle with evil intent...
translation: 那些生物带着邪恶的意图涌向城堡……

english: The crows are all on the scarecrow?
translation: 乌鸦全都停在稻草人上了？

english: The crystal blazes brilliantly.
translation: 水晶发出耀眼的光芒。

english: The crystal crackles periodically at a rhythmic rate, reminscent of a slow heartbeat. It can be used to make a crystal extractor on a boat.
translation: 水晶有节奏地噼啪作响，就像缓慢的心跳声。它可以用来在船上制作水晶提取器。

english: The crystal glows brightly.
translation: 水晶发出明亮的光芒。

english: The crystal glows faintly.
translation: 水晶发出微弱的光芒。

english: The crystal is very bright.
translation: 水晶非常明亮。

english: The cup is now coated with a thin layer of flour.
translation: 杯子上现在覆盖了一层薄薄的面粉。

english: The cupboard is bare.
translation: 橱柜是空的。

english: The cupboard is full of bird feed.
translation: 橱柜里装满了鸟饲料。

english: The curator gives you two half-certificates.
translation: 馆长给了你两张半证书。

english: The curator hands you a medallion.
translation: 馆长递给你一枚勋章。

english: The curator peers at the shield.
translation: 馆长仔细端详着盾牌。

english: The curator writes out two half-certificates.
translation: 馆长写了两张半证书。

english: The current is flowing against the raft. It won't move.
translation: 水流正逆着木筏的方向流动。它动不了。

english: The cutscene changes to show him fighting Dad but he gets knocked back, smashing the camera and ending the cutscene
translation: 过场动画切换到他与老爹战斗的场景，但他被击退，撞坏了镜头，过场动画结束。

english: The cutscene changes to show him fighting the Kalphite Queen
translation: 过场动画切换到他与卡尔夫特虫后战斗的场景。

english: The cutscene changes to show him killing the Shaikahan
translation: 过场动画切换到他杀死沙伊卡汉狮的场景。

english: The cutscene changes to show him killing the drunken dwarf
translation: 过场动画切换到他杀死醉酒的矮人的场景。

english: The cutscene ends and Prince Itzla Arkan returns to The Teomat.
translation: 过场动画结束，伊茨拉.阿坎王子返回特奥马特修道院。

english: The cutscene from the quest plays.
translation: 任务中的过场动画开始播放。

english: The cylinder is full of explosive gas, a small explosion could ignite it.
translation: 圆柱体里充满了爆炸性气体，一点小爆炸就能点燃它。

english: The damp coal dust is stored in my shed. If you pour some onto the fire in the main room, it will make the area smokey and humid. Anti-Santa will not like that.
translation: 潮湿的煤尘存放在我的棚屋里。如果你把一些倒进主房间的火里，会让那里烟雾弥漫、潮湿不堪。反圣诞老人不会喜欢那样的。

english: The dark red powder.
translation: 深红色的粉末。

english: The dark squirrel faces north.
translation: 黑暗松鼠面朝北方。

english: The darkness of the cavern envelops everything...
translation: 洞穴的黑暗吞没了一切……

english: The dead aren't going to mind. They're dead! But they can still help me now, if you'll just hang them on the wall like puppets.
translation: 死人才不会介意呢。他们已经死了！但他们现在还能帮我，只要你把他们像木偶一样挂在墙上。

english: The death throes of the rats seem to have shaken the door loose its hinges. You pick it up and go through.
translation: 老鼠的垂死挣扎似乎把门从铰链上震松了。你捡起门，走了过去。

english: The decorations are now complete, and my Halloween treat is completely ready! But now I must prepare myself, and get into character.
translation: 装饰现在已经完成了，我的万圣节款待也完全准备好了！但现在我必须做好准备，进入角色。

english: The delicious fragrance of those trapped souls stewing in the cauldron should tempt Anti-Santa to go outside. Go and invite him to take a walk in the garden.
translation: 大锅里炖煮的那些被困灵魂散发出的美味香气，应该能引诱反圣诞老人到外面去。去邀请他到花园里散散步吧。

english: The difference between a fairy and a fly is that fairies complain when you eat them.
translation: 仙子和苍蝇的区别在于，你吃仙子的时候她们会抱怨。

english: The discs shown in the window clunk out of the machine into your hands.
translation: 窗户里显示的圆盘从机器里咔嗒一声掉到你手里。

english: The discs you have put in clunk out.
translation: 你放进去的圆盘咔嗒一声掉了出来。

english: The discs you put into the slot, clunk out into your hand.
translation: 你放进槽里的圆盘咔嗒一声掉到你手里。

english: The dish needs to be exciting and exotic, which your banana pizza is. But it's missing something.
translation: 这道菜需要既刺激又异域风情，你的香蕉披萨符合要求。但还少了点什么。

english: The display case contains an old ornate hammer made of some strange metal. You take it.
translation: 展示柜里有一把用某种奇怪金属制成的古老华丽锤子。你拿走了它。

english: The display case is sealed. It contains an old ornate hammer made of some strange metal. There's a strange panel beneath the display case with some symbols on it.
translation: 展示柜是密封的。里面有一把用某种奇怪金属制成的古老华丽锤子。展示柜下面有一块奇怪的镶板，上面有一些符号。

english: The dog takes Alan's bones. Something doesn't feel quite right about this, but the dog seems happy enough. He quickly calms down and gives your hand a little lick.
translation: 狗叼走了艾伦的骨头。这感觉有点不对劲，但狗似乎很开心。它很快平静下来，轻轻舔了舔你的手。

english: The dog takes the bones and then licks your hand in return.
translation: 狗叼走了骨头，然后舔了舔你的手作为回报。

english: The doll coming to life
translation: 玩偶活了过来

english: The dolmen is intricately decorated with the symbol of two crossed palm trees. It might be the family crest? You can see that there are some items on the dolmen.
translation: 巨石阵上精细地装饰着两棵交叉棕榈树的符号。这可能是家徽？你可以看到巨石阵上放着一些物品。

english: The door doesn't seem to have a keyhole this side... You could probably use the window.
translation: 这扇门这边似乎没有钥匙孔……你也许可以用窗户。

english: The door is already unlocked.
translation: 门已经解锁了。

english: The door is damaged and can't be opened.
translation: 门损坏了，打不开。

english: The door is locked tight. You'll need some way to unlock it.
translation: 门锁得很紧。你需要想办法打开它。

english: The door is ornately carved with depictions of skeletal warriors. All the skeletons are complete. It looks as if you walk through this door.
translation: 门上华丽地雕刻着骷髅战士的图案。所有骷髅都是完整的。看起来你可以穿过这扇门。

english: The door is ornately carved with depictions of skeletal warriors. You notice that some of the skeletal warriors depictions are not complete.Instead, there are recesses where some of the bones should be. There are three recesses.
translation: 门上华丽地雕刻着骷髅战士的图案。你注意到有些骷髅战士的图案并不完整。相反，在应该是骨头的地方有一些凹处。有三个凹处。

english: The door is ornately carved with depictions of skeletal warriors. You notice that some of the skeletal warriors depictions are not complete.Instead, there are recesses where some of the bones should be. There are two recesses.
translation: 门上华丽地雕刻着骷髅战士的图案。你注意到有些骷髅战士的图案并不完整。相反，在应该是骨头的地方有一些凹处。有两个凹处。

english: The door is ornately carved with depictions of skeletal warriors. You notice that some of the skeletal warriors depictions are not complete.Instead, there are recesses where some of the bones should be. There is one recess.
translation: 门上华丽地雕刻着骷髅战士的图案。你注意到有些骷髅战士的图案并不完整。相反，在应该是骨头的地方有一些凹处。有一个凹处。

english: The door is securely locked.
translation: 门锁得很牢。

english: The door refuses to open.
translation: 门打不开。

english: The door refuses to open. Only followers of Zamorak may enter.
translation: 门打不开。只有扎莫拉克的追随者才能进入。

english: The door seems frozen in place.
translation: 门似乎被冻住了。

english: The door seems to be frozen shut. There must be some way to open it.
translation: 门似乎被冻住了。一定有办法打开它。

english: The door seems to be locked from the inside. I'll need to find another way to get in.
translation: 门似乎从里面锁上了。我需要另找办法进去。

english: The door seems to be locked in place. There is an engraving of an eagle on the door. Three of the feathers illustrated in the engraving seem to be cut deeper than the others. It looks like they may once have contained some sort of decoration.
translation: 门似乎被锁住了。门上刻有一只鹰的图案。图案中的三根羽毛似乎比其他羽毛刻得更深。看起来它们可能曾经镶嵌过某种装饰。

english: The door seems to be stuck.
translation: 门好像卡住了。

english: The door seems to change slightly. Two depictions of skeletal warriors turn their heads towards you. They are alive! The Skeletons wrench themselves free of the door. Stepping out of the door, with grinning teeth they push the huge doors open.
translation: 门似乎微微发生了变化。两个骷髅战士的图案转过头来看着你。他们是活的！骷髅们挣脱了门。他们咧着嘴笑着，从门里走出来，推开了巨大的门。

english: The door won't open!
translation: 门打不开！

english: The door won't open. You notice a black cross on the door.
translation: 门打不开。你注意到门上有一个黑色的十字。

english: The doors are securely locked. You can't see any obvious way to open them.
translation: 门锁得很牢。你看不到任何明显的开门方法。

english: The doors close behind you with the sound of crunching bone. Before you stretches a winding tunnel blocked by an ancient gate.
translation: 门在你身后关上，发出骨头碎裂的声音。在你面前延伸着一条蜿蜒的隧道，被一扇古代大门挡住了。

english: The drain is totally blocked. It really stinks. No, it REALLY smells bad. It's certainly clear nobody's cleaned it recently.
translation: 排水沟完全堵住了。臭气熏天。不，真的是臭不可闻。很明显最近没人清理过。

english: The drain seems to have been recently cleaned. You can still smell the faint aroma of poison.
translation: 排水沟似乎最近被清理过。你还能闻到淡淡的毒药气味。

english: The drink coats your tastebuds in what feels like tar...
translation: 这饮料让你的味蕾裹上了一层像焦油一样的东西……

english: The drink doesn't taste, it just burns in new and interesting ways.
translation: 这饮料没有味道，只是以新奇有趣的方式灼烧着。

english: The drink fills you with energy and fire...
translation: 这饮料让你充满能量和火焰……

english: The drink has a deep taste of slightly burnt onions.
translation: 这饮料有一股微微烧焦的洋葱味。

english: The drink invigorates you!
translation: 这饮料让你精神焕发！

english: The drink is delicious, but fiery!
translation: 这饮料美味但火辣！

english: The drink is delightfuly moreish, so you glug it down...
translation: 这饮料美味得让人欲罢不能，所以你一饮而尽……

english: The drink is extremely... wet.
translation: 这饮料非常……湿。

english: The drink is so refreshing, it hits you like a wave.
translation: 这饮料如此清爽，像波浪一样冲击着你。

english: The drink is somehow slimy.
translation: 这饮料不知怎么有点黏糊糊的。

english: The drink is unexpectedly strong...
translation: 这饮料出乎意料地烈……

english: The drink is very sippable... unfortunately. You down the lot.
translation: 这饮料非常顺口……可惜了。你一口气全喝完了。

english: The drink makes your ears ring. Your brain resonates in pain.
translation: 这饮料让你的耳朵嗡嗡作响。你的大脑痛苦地共鸣着。

english: The drink makes your head spin.
translation: 这饮料让你头晕目眩。

english: The drink refreshes you, although it doesn't taste like you were actually supposed to drink it.
translation: 这饮料让你精神一振，尽管喝起来感觉它本来不是给人喝的。

english: The drink reinvigorates you slightly...
translation: 这饮料让你稍微恢复了一点精神……

english: The drink tastes fantastic...
translation: 这饮料味道好极了……

english: The drink tastes like it's missing something. Pure disappointment.
translation: 这饮料喝起来好像少了点什么。纯粹的失望。

english: The drink tastes of blue raspberry.
translation: 这饮料有蓝树莓味。

english: The drink tastes... ugly?
translation: 这饮料尝起来……很丑？

english: The drink, if you can call it that, seems to call something from the sea...
translation: 这饮料，如果能这么叫的话，似乎在召唤海里的什么东西……

english: The driver completely ignores you.
translation: 车夫完全无视了你。

english: The druid gives you some enriched snapdragon.
translation: 德鲁伊给了你一些超级金鱼草。

english: The druid pouch makes the ghast visible.
translation: 德鲁伊的袋让恶灵显形了。

english: The druid produces a small sheet of papyrus with some writing on it.
translation: 德鲁伊拿出一小张莎草纸，上面写着一些字。

english: The druid seems to be in a state of trance.
translation: 德鲁伊似乎处于恍惚状态。

english: The druids need my help agin. What is today's riddle?
translation: 德鲁伊们又需要我的帮助了。今天的谜语是什么？

english: The druids that follow you use a craft called Herblore to do many strange and very beneficial things. Many warriors and adventurers have found potions to be a source of strength in both combat and everyday tasks. However, as far as I know, Saradominists (And possibly Zamorakians too) shun these druids for their craft as well as you. Yet I see many adventurers who are either Zamorakian or Saradominist USING this craft... The number of users is increasing almost daily. Some even speak in whispers to me about how Zamorakians highly experienced in the craft of Herblore can create a potion to honor Zamorak himself! Apparently the ingredients are Torstol as the herb, and Jangerberries as the secondary ingredient. I myself have experimented with this craft, yet I am not quite sure which god I follow as of now in this time of uncertainty. I was taught this craft by one of your followers, Kaqemeex. How do you feel about these followers of these opposite gods using the craft that your followers, the druidic people, use? Do you feel that perhaps one day their followers may use this craft against you?
translation: 跟随你的德鲁伊们使用一种叫做草药学的技艺来做许多奇异且非常有益的事情。许多战士和冒险家发现药水在战斗和日常任务中都是力量的源泉。然而，据我所知，萨拉多教徒（可能还有扎莫拉克教徒）都因为这门技艺而排斥这些德鲁伊，也排斥你。但我看到许多冒险家，无论是扎莫拉克教徒还是萨拉多教徒，都在使用这门技艺……使用者的人数几乎每天都在增加。有些人甚至私下告诉我，在草药学方面经验丰富的扎莫拉克教徒可以制作出一种药水来向扎莫拉克本人致敬！显然，原料是托斯托尔草作为草药，姜格莓作为辅助原料。我本人也试验过这门技艺，但在这个充满不确定性的时代，我还不确定自己现在追随的是哪位神。我是由你的一个追随者卡基米克斯教导这门技艺的。你对这些对立神的追随者使用你的追随者——德鲁伊人民——所使用的技艺，有何看法？你是否觉得也许有一天，他们的追随者会用这门技艺来对付你？

english: The duck recognises your boat and climbs aboard. He shares the secrets of the currents he travelled on with you.
translation: 鸭子认出了你的船，爬了上来。它与你分享了它航行过的水流的秘密。

english: The duck recognises your ship and climbs aboard. It shares the secrets of the currents it travelled on with you.
translation: 鸭子认出了你的船，爬了上来。它与你分享了它航行过的水流的秘密。

english: The dwarf child runs off into the caverns.
translation: 矮人小孩跑进了洞穴深处。

english: The dwarf ferries you across the river.
translation: 矮人渡你过河。

english: The dwarf nurses the very last drops of the pint as if he'd really like more.
translation: 矮人细细品味着杯中的最后几滴酒，好像还想再来一杯。

english: The dwarf tries to give you some food but you don't have enough room for it.
translation: 矮人想给你一些食物，但你拿不下了。

english: The dwarves have allied with Saradomin. Their strength is too great. Lassar will fall.
translation: 矮人已经与萨拉多明结盟。他们的力量太强大了。拉萨尔城将陷落。

english: The dwarves of Acheron uncovered it. They lost their home as a result.
translation: 阿切隆的矮人发现了它。结果他们失去了家园。

english: The dye only looks compatible with the fortified version of Elidinis' Ward.
translation: 这种染料似乎只适用于强化版的伊莉迪尼斯护符。

english: The dying breath of the icefiend cools your hot rock cake.
translation: 冰怪的最后一口气冷却了你滚烫的石糕。

english: The egg is finished.
translation: 蛋完成了。

english: The egg is well and truly broken. You cannot see any way to put him back together again.
translation: 蛋彻底碎了。你看不出有什么办法能把它重新拼好。

english: The egg returns to its dormant state.
translation: 蛋回到了休眠状态。

english: The eggs are a family tradition. Hatching them, caring for them, watching them develop. This is the job of an Easter Bunny.
translation: 这些蛋是家族传统。孵化它们，照顾它们，看着它们成长。这是复活节兔子的工作。

english: The enemy marches on Lassar.
translation: 敌人向拉萨尔城进军。

english: The engraving is already complete. There is nowhere left to put this feather.
translation: 雕刻已经完成了。已经没有地方放这根羽毛了。

english: The entrance is completely blocked. However, the blockage looks to have happened fairly recently. Perhaps it occurred during the excavation.
translation: 入口完全被堵住了。不过，堵塞看起来是最近才发生的。也许是在挖掘过程中发生的。

english: The entrance is completely blocked. The citizens are slowly mining a way through, but it will take some time.
translation: 入口完全被堵住了。市民们正在慢慢地挖出一条路，但这需要一些时间。

english: The entrance is completely blocked. There doesn't seem to be any way through.
translation: 入口完全被堵住了。似乎没有任何办法通过。

english: The entry is securely sealed. You can't see any obvious way to get it open.
translation: 入口被牢牢封住了。你看不到任何明显的打开方法。

english: The ever-boastful Guthix has strange desires indeed, and I must confess, his philosophies are something of a mystery to myself. He often claims to be working towards some 'greater good', yet he allowed (and even encourages!) great evils to be permitted in his name! I suggest you ignore whatever he tells you and listen only to my wisdom instead.
translation: 那个总是自吹自擂的古斯确实有着奇怪的欲望，而且我必须承认，他的哲学对我来说有些神秘。他经常声称自己在为某种‘更伟大的善’而努力，但他却允许（甚至鼓励！）以他的名义犯下巨大的邪恶！我建议你忽略他告诉你的一切，只听从我的智慧。

english: The experience people have gained, every single day, since the world was created, training their skills - imagine how intense that collective memory will be! So my ritual uses mementos of the 24 skills.
translation: 自从世界被创造以来，人们每天通过训练技能所获得的经验——想象一下那集体记忆会有多么强烈！所以我的仪式使用了24种技能的纪念品。

english: The expert was impressed with the Zaros Tablet that I found, and I also discovered an ancient altar!
translation: 专家对我找到的扎罗斯石板印象深刻，我还发现了一座古代祭坛！

english: The fairy rings.
translation: 仙子环。

english: The falconer brings a bird over to land on your glove.
translation: 训鹰人带了一只鸟，让它落在你的手套上。

english: The false wall looks to have been slightly damaged.
translation: 假墙看起来有些损坏。

english: The fan is sucking, but it really needs to blow instead.
translation: 风扇正在吸气，但它实际上需要吹气。

english: The fan starts to blow.
translation: 风扇开始吹气了。

english: The farm south of Falador should have plenty of cow blood from their slaughtering work.
translation: 法拉多城以南的农场应该有很多屠宰工作剩下的牛血。

english: The farmer is definitely an enemy.
translation: 那个农夫绝对是敌人。

english: The fearsome Vannaka is one of the strongest warriors to ever grace this world, and as such he has the power to wield what would normally be considered to be a two handed sword single-handedly. This is a strength that most mortals do not posess, and it adds to his fearsome reputation as a great swordsman. It is somewhat of a pity that his glory days are behind him, and his self-imposed exile to tutorial island is in place, for I would deeply desire to see him overcome his shame for his past actions, and take up his place at the vanguard of my holy warriors once again. Perhaps the best we may see of him is his current role as Slayer Master and Combat Instructor, although I suspect his thirst for adventure may bring him back for one last battle, so that he may end his days in glory...
translation: 令人畏惧的范纳卡是曾降临这个世界的最强大的战士之一，因此他有能力单手挥舞通常被认为是双手剑的武器。这是大多数凡人都不具备的力量，这也为他作为伟大剑士的可怕名声增添了光彩。有点可惜的是，他的辉煌岁月已经过去，他自我放逐到了教程岛，因为我非常希望看到他克服对自己过去行为的羞耻，重新在我的神圣战士先锋队中占据一席之地。也许我们能看到他最好的状态就是他目前作为杀戮大师和战斗导师的角色，尽管我怀疑他对冒险的渴望可能会让他回来进行最后一场战斗，以便他能光荣地结束自己的生命……

english: The feather doesn't seem to work here...
translation: 羽毛在这里似乎不起作用……

english: The feather points at the sacks.
translation: 羽毛指向麻袋。

english: The feather points to somewhere nearby.
translation: 羽毛指向附近的某个地方。

english: The feather points to the east.
translation: 羽毛指向东方。

english: The feather points to the north.
translation: 羽毛指向北方。

english: The feather points to the northeast.
translation: 羽毛指向东北方。

english: The feather points to the northwest.
translation: 羽毛指向西北方。

english: The feather points to the south.
translation: 羽毛指向南方。

english: The feather points to the southeast.
translation: 羽毛指向东南方。

english: The feather points to the southwest.
translation: 羽毛指向西南方。

english: The feather points to the west.
translation: 羽毛指向西方。

english: The festival is getting closer, and Sir Vyvin's armour is still pink. We can't take too long!
translation: 节日越来越近了，但维文爵士的盔甲还是粉色的。我们不能拖太久！

english: The fight against Glough.
translation: 与格劳夫的战斗。

english: The fight with Nex is already in progress. You'll have to wait until the next fight begins.
translation: 与奈克斯的战斗已经开始。你必须等到下一场战斗开始。

english: The figure turns and soars away, quickly disappearing into the distance.
translation: 那个身影转身飞走了，迅速消失在远方。

english: The finger prints are an exact match to Anna's.
translation: 指纹与安娜的完全匹配。

english: The finger prints are an exact match to Bob's.
translation: 指纹与鲍勃的完全匹配。

english: The finger prints are an exact match to Carol's.
translation: 指纹与卡罗尔的完全匹配。

english: The finger prints are an exact match to David's.
translation: 指纹与大卫的完全匹配。

english: The finger prints are an exact match to Elizabeth's.
translation: 指纹与伊丽莎白的完全匹配。

english: The finger prints are an exact match to Frank's.
translation: 指纹与弗兰克的完全匹配。

english: The fire cannot be lit from here. It appears to be powered from the boiler downstairs.
translation: 无法从这里点火。它似乎是由楼下的锅炉提供动力的。

english: The fire has been recently extinguished, you find a half burned note in the ashes.
translation: 火最近被扑灭了，你在灰烬中发现了一张烧了一半的纸条。

english: The firebox of the press is now filled with wood.
translation: 压机的火箱现在装满了木头。

english: The fireplace contains a hidden lever, but you've already pulled it.
translation: 壁炉里藏着一根隐藏的拉杆，但你已经拉过了。

english: The first entry misses the beginning: ...continues as expected. A single builder was crushed this week due to a collapsing winch, other than that, not much of note.
translation: 第一条记录的开头缺失：……按预期继续进行。本周有一名建筑工人因绞盘倒塌被压死，除此之外，没什么值得注意的。

english: The first thing you should do is talk to Rosie and get a box for putting completed puppets into.
translation: 你应该做的第一件事是跟罗西谈谈，拿一个盒子来装做好的木偶。

english: The five of you enter the portal.
translation: 你们五个人进入了传送门。

english: The five of you exit the portal at a strange, watery place.
translation: 你们五个人从传送门出来，来到一个奇怪的水域。

english: The flames form a solid wall, rising straight up out of the ground. There's something odd about it...
translation: 火焰形成了一堵坚实的墙，从地面直冲而起。这有点奇怪……

english: The flames of Lloigh-enn are an often rumoured, almost mythical, barrier between various dimensions, that require a spell recited most precisely, that is different for each individual who wishes to pass through.
translation: 洛伊恩之焰是一个常被传闻、近乎神话般的屏障，存在于不同维度之间，需要极其精确地念诵咒语，而且每个想要通过的人咒语都不同。

english: The flashback ends.
translation: 闪回结束。

english: The flask is full!
translation: 烧瓶满了！

english: The flask is now empty!
translation: 烧瓶现在是空的！

english: The flavour is delightfully sweet. You are enjoying it until...
translation: 味道甜美宜人。你正享受其中，直到……

translation: 苍蝇
