english: There are a lot of dead mosquitos around the base of the fountain. A faint smell of poison is in the air, but the water seems clean.
translation: 喷泉底座周围有很多死蚊子。空气中隐约有股毒药味，但水看起来是干净的。

english: There are a lot of these yellow rugs around here... but they need cleaning. Can you please tell me how many are found around the castle?
translation: 这里有很多这种黄色地毯……但它们需要清洁。你能告诉我城堡周围有多少块吗？

english: There are big trolls outside, focus your attention on that instead of trying to deposit items!
translation: 外面有巨魔，把注意力放在那上面，别想着存东西了！

english: There are braziers around the place that you could light to corral some of them.
translation: 这附近有一些火盆，你可以点燃它们来围住其中一些。

english: There are crows around here, and they have been pecking at some of the seeds and moving them around. I've never seen anything like it! But the outcome is that the image doesn't look right.
translation: 这附近有乌鸦，它们一直在啄一些种子，还把种子移来移去。我从没见过这种事！但结果就是图案看起来不对了。

english: There are five types of ghosts down there, and if you get rid of three of each then we should be able to make a bit of a start on the toys again.
translation: 下面有五种幽灵，如果你每种都消灭三个，我们应该就能重新开始处理玩具了。

english: There are foresters nearby who have some basic knowledge of the jungle. It would be wise to speak to them before venturing in.
translation: 附近有一些护林员，他们对丛林有基本的了解。在冒险进入之前，跟他们谈谈是明智之举。

english: There are four bridges to repair.
translation: 有四座桥需要修理。

english: There are four emblems slotted into the plaque, but you don't have enough room to take them.
translation: 牌匾上插着四个徽章，但你没有足够的空间拿走它们。

english: There are four emblems slotted into the plaque. You take them.
translation: 牌匾上插着四个徽章。你拿走了它们。

english: There are loads of cooking utensils in the kitchen here, if we could grab a few of those, I could bang them together to make a noise.
translation: 这里的厨房里有很多烹饪用具，如果我们能拿几样，我可以把它们敲在一起制造噪音。

english: There are lots of camels around Al Kharid, try some of those.
translation: 阿尔卡里德城附近有很多骆驼，试试那些吧。

english: There are no gang meetings listed at the moment.
translation: 目前没有列出任何帮派会议。

english: There are no lights on downstairs in the basement, the pixies must have moved on. I hope I see them again.
translation: 地下室的楼下没有灯光，小精灵们肯定已经离开了。希望我能再见到它们。

english: There are no more recesses to fill, you filled them all.
translation: 没有更多的凹处需要填充了，你已经全部填满了。

english: There are no right words for something like this! It's always going to be awkward, so embrace that awkwardness!
translation: 这种事情根本没什么合适的说法！反正都会很尴尬，不如坦然接受这种尴尬！

english: There are not only three gods upon this world. I know not why, but this is a lie spread by one of mine brothers for his own secret purpose. As for Entrana, it is my understanding that this island was the place where Saradomin didst first step forth upon this world, and as such hath been honoured by his followers more than other such locations. If thou hath truly looked upon this place however, thou will know that although it carries the veneer of Saradominism, at it's heart and under it's skin it hath still the touch of Zamorak below its' earth. There doth not exist a place in the mortal realm wholly aligned with one deity or the other, for this would disrupt the balance and I shall not allow that to occur.
translation: 这个世界上并非只有三位神祇。我不知道为什么，但这是我的一位兄弟为了自己不可告人的目的而散布的谎言。至于恩特纳岛，据我所知，这座岛屿是萨拉多明第一次踏足这个世界的地方，因此他的追随者给予它的尊崇超过了其他地方。然而，如果你真的仔细看过这个地方，你就会知道，尽管它披着萨拉多明教的外衣，但在它的核心和表皮之下，其土地深处仍然留有扎莫拉克的痕迹。凡间不存在完全归属于某一位神祇的地方，因为这会破坏平衡，而我不会允许这种情况发生。

english: There are other Non player ch... I mean players in here, that are going to be with you trying to offload their coal.
translation: 这里还有其他非玩家角……我是说其他玩家，他们会和你一起试着卖掉他们的煤。

english: There are some boxes of unpainted decorations on the far side of the walkway, take some and bring them back to the painting benches and paint them different colours.
translation: 人行道远端有一些装着未上色装饰品的盒子，拿一些回来到绘画台，把它们涂成不同的颜色。

english: There are some carrot costumes in this wardrobe! They smell a bit musty, but they look like they will do just fine for a performance.
translation: 这个衣柜里有一些胡萝卜服装！闻起来有点发霉，但看起来用来表演应该没问题。

english: There are some old wooden poles you could use to attach the wheel...
translation: 有一些旧木杆，你可以用来安装轮子……

english: There are some technical diagrams scrawled all over the pages...
translation: 书页上潦草地画着一些技术示意图……

english: There are still dogs to be matched to their owners! Ask the prospective adopters for what kind of dog they're after.
translation: 还有狗需要和主人配对！问问那些潜在的领养者他们想要什么样的狗。

english: There are still plenty of green ones to take care of; [X] by my count at any rate.
translation: 还有很多绿色的需要处理；至少我数了有 [X] 个。

english: There are three books here that look important... What would you like to do?
translation: 这里有三本看起来很重要的书……你想怎么做？

english: There are three bridges to repair.
translation: 有三座桥需要修理。

english: There are three clues in total, all within Al Kharid.
translation: 总共有三条线索，全部在阿尔卡里德城内。

english: There are three emblems slotted into the plaque, but you don't have enough room to take them.
translation: 牌匾上插着三个徽章，但你没有足够的空间拿走它们。

english: There are three emblems slotted into the plaque. You take them.
translation: 牌匾上插着三个徽章。你拿走了它们。

english: There are three on each side of the path leading to the monastery.
translation: 通往修道院的小路两边各有三个。

english: There are three vials on this shelf.
translation: 这个架子上有三个小瓶。

english: There are too many rocks in the way. You can't find a way in.
translation: 路上有太多岩石挡着。你找不到进去的路。

english: There are two Easter eggs inside the cooler...
translation: 冷却器里面有两个复活节彩蛋……

english: There are two emblems slotted into the plaque, but you don't have enough room to take them.
translation: 牌匾上插着两个徽章，但你没有足够的空间拿走它们。

english: There are two emblems slotted into the plaque. You take them.
translation: 牌匾上插着两个徽章。你拿走了它们。

english: There are two schematics here...
translation: 这里有两张示意图……

english: There are two vials on this shelf.
translation: 这个架子上有两个小瓶。

english: There doesn't seem to be a lot going on down there.
translation: 下面似乎没什么动静。

english: There doesn't seem to be any way of attaching this feather to the engraving. The indentations look like they probably contained some sort of decoration rather than real feathers, although there is no sign of their whereabouts now.
translation: 似乎没办法把这根羽毛固定在雕刻上。那些凹痕看起来可能原本嵌着某种装饰品，而不是真正的羽毛，不过现在也找不到它们的踪迹了。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything here for you. Maybe you could work with the Spirit Anglers...
translation: 这里似乎没有你能用的东西。也许你可以和海灵垂钓者合作……

english: There doesn't seem to be anything in the rift for you.
translation: 裂隙里似乎没有你能用的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Adala's pocket.
translation: 阿达拉的口袋里似乎没什么值得注意的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Constantinius' pocket.
translation: 康斯坦提乌斯的口袋里似乎没什么值得注意的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Cozyac's pocket.
translation: 科兹亚克的口袋里似乎没什么值得注意的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Patzi's pocket.
translation: 帕齐的口袋里似乎没什么值得注意的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Pavo's pocket.
translation: 帕沃的口袋里似乎没什么值得注意的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything of note in Xocotla's pocket.
translation: 索科特拉的口袋里似乎没什么值得注意的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything of value in their pocket.
translation: 他们的口袋里似乎没什么有价值的东西。

english: There doesn't seem to be anything to observe past the trees.
translation: 树林那边似乎没什么可观察的。

english: There don't appear to be any people nearby who need saving. Perhaps I should get closer?
translation: 附近似乎没有需要拯救的人。也许我应该靠近点？

english: There has been a development.
translation: 有新的进展了。

english: There is 1 birthday balloon in this building!
translation: 这栋建筑里有 1 个生日气球！

english: There is 1 pint of Kelda Stout in the barrel.
translation: 桶里有1品脱凯尔达黑啤酒。

english: There is a clear patch in the layer of dust covering the top of the pedestal. It looks like something lay here recently, but you can't find any further clues as to where it may have gone.
translation: 基座顶部的灰尘层中有一块干净的区域。看起来最近有什么东西放在这里，但你找不到任何关于它可能去了哪里的进一步线索。

english: There is a clear patch in the layer of dust covering the top of the pedestal. It looks like something lay here recently, but you don't have a high enough Hunter level to determine where it may have gone.
translation: 基座顶部的灰尘层中有一块干净的区域。看起来最近有什么东西放在这里，但你的猎人等级不够高，无法判断它可能去了哪里。

english: There is a clear patch in the layer of dust covering the top of the pedestal. It looks like something lay here recently. Around the base of the pedestal you spy what appear to be faint footprints leading away from the area.
translation: 基座顶部的灰尘层中有一块干净的区域。看起来最近有什么东西放在这里。在基座底部周围，你发现了一些模糊的脚印，似乎正离开这个区域。

english: There is a clicking sound as the compartment in the fireplace unlocks.
translation: 壁炉里的暗格解锁，发出咔哒一声。

english: There is a clicking sound as the compartment on the piano unlocks.
translation: 钢琴上的暗格解锁，发出咔哒一声。

english: There is a clue in the drink, for some reason.
translation: 饮料里有一条线索，也不知道为什么。

english: There is a combination lock on this door. Above the lock you can see that there is a metal plaque with a riddle on it.
translation: 这扇门上有一个组合锁。锁的上方你可以看到一块金属牌匾，上面刻着谜语。

english: There is a faint smell of poison behind the smell of the compost.
translation: 在堆肥的气味后面，隐约能闻到一股毒药味。

english: There is a glowing orb in the pouch.
translation: 袋子里有一个发光宝珠。

english: There is a grill blocking your way.
translation: 有一个烤架挡住了你的路。

english: There is a huge cascading waterfall in front of you, the roar of the water is quite loud. To the east you can see what looks like a trecherous pathway, it might lead outside.
translation: 你面前有一个巨大的瀑布倾泻而下，水声震耳欲聋。东边有一条看起来险峻的小路，可能通向外面。

english: There is a label on this crate. It says;
translation: 这个板条箱上有个标签。上面写着：

english: There is a malignant presence in my house.
translation: 我的房子里有一股邪恶的存在。

english: There is a party on your boat, and everyone worth inviting is invited.
translation: 你的船上正在举办派对，所有值得邀请的人都收到了邀请。

english: There is a period missing on this level up message
translation: 这条升级消息缺少一个句号

english: There is a small creaking sound and the ping of a latch opening. Soon followed by a small thump and the sound of something closing.
translation: 传来一声轻微的吱嘎声和门闩打开的叮当声。紧接着是一声轻响和什么东西关闭的声音。

english: There is a spiders' nest here. You estimate there must be at least a few hundred spiders ready to hatch. It's certainly clear nobody's used poison here.
translation: 这里有一个蜘蛛巢。你估计至少有几百只蜘蛛即将孵化。很明显这里没人用过毒药。

english: There is a stone slab here obstructing the door. There is a small hole in the slab that looks like it might be for a handle.
translation: 这里有一块石板挡住了门。石板上有一个小孔，看起来可能是用来装把手的。

english: There is a tangle of rusty old farming equipment in here.
translation: 这里有一堆生锈的旧农业设备缠在一起。

english: There is a trader deep in the desert who sells chocolate in the form of a choc-ice.
translation: 沙漠深处有一个商人，他卖巧克力冰棍形式的巧克力。

english: There is a vial on this shelf.
translation: 这个架子上有一个小瓶。

english: There is already a monkey in that cage!
translation: 那个笼子里已经有只猴子了！

english: There is already sweetcorn in the hopper.
translation: 料斗里已经有甜玉米了。

english: There is also some rum stashed in here too.
translation: 这里还藏了一些朗姆酒。

english: There is an ancient symbol on the gate. It looks like a human figure with something around its neck. It looks pretty scary.
translation: 门上有一个古老的圣徽。看起来像是一个人形，脖子上挂着什么东西。样子挺吓人的。

english: There is an ice cooler on the floor by the crate. You pick it up.
translation: 板条箱旁边的地上有一个冰桶。你把它捡了起来。

english: There is an old generator crank in the crate. You take it.
translation: 板条箱里有一个旧的发电机曲柄。你拿走了它。

english: There is little value in tall tales.
translation: 夸夸其谈的故事没什么价值。

english: There is no cargo available for you to collect here.
translation: 这里没有你可以领取的货物。

english: There is no cargo of that type available for you to collect here.
translation: 这里没有那种类型的货物供你领取。

english: There is no clear weapon that was used to kill Livius.
translation: 没有发现用来杀死利维乌斯的明确凶器。

english: There is no need for haste, just send a runner.
translation: 不必着急，派个跑腿的去就行了。

english: There is no penalty for resigning now.
translation: 现在退出不会受到惩罚。

english: There is no powder in this cannon, you will need to start again.
translation: 这门大炮里没有火药，你得重新开始。

english: There is no suitable material to be affected in this area.
translation: 这个区域没有适合影响的材料。

english: There is no tea in this flask.
translation: 这个瓶子里没有茶。

english: There is nobody here, go away.
translation: 这里没人，走开。

english: There is nothing different about the crystal. You're most likely not close enough for it to be active.
translation: 这颗水晶没什么不同。很可能你离得不够近，它还没激活。

english: There is nothing growing in your patch.
translation: 你的种植地里什么也没长。

english: There is nothing in the crate.
translation: 板条箱里什么都没有。

english: There is nothing in the fountain.
translation: 喷泉里什么都没有。

english: There is nothing interesting in these boxes.
translation: 这些箱子里没什么有趣的东西。

english: There is nothing more inside this box.
translation: 这个盒子里没有别的东西了。

english: There is nothing new about this dolmen.
translation: 这个巨石阵没什么新发现。

english: There is nothing of interest in there.
translation: 里面没什么值得注意的。

english: There is one last thing, these new eggs need a name!
translation: 还有最后一件事，这些新蛋需要取个名字！

english: There is one person I can think of who may know something on this topic.
translation: 我能想到有一个人可能知道这方面的事情。

english: There is one serving of tea in this flask.
translation: 这个瓶子里还有一份茶。

english: There is space on the cart for you get on, would you like to try?
translation: 推车上还有空位让你上去，要试试吗？

english: There is, first take a torso from a puppet parts box, add a head to it, then arms and legs. Make sure the puppet is all the same colour.
translation: 是这样的，先从玩偶零件盒里拿一个躯干，加上头，然后是胳膊和腿。要确保玩偶全身颜色一致。

english: There is, in fact, no toilet in there. However I wish you success in your quest.
translation: 事实上，里面并没有厕所。不过，我祝你任务顺利。

english: There isn't a boat here for you to board.
translation: 这里没有你可以上的船。

english: There isn't enough wood left in this table to make anything!
translation: 这张桌子上剩下的木头不够做任何东西了！

english: There looks to be a passage behind the painting.
translation: 画作后面似乎有一条通道。

english: There looks to be a passage behind the wall.
translation: 墙壁后面似乎有一条通道。

english: There looks to be a small amount of burnt kindling around the statue.
translation: 雕像周围似乎有一些烧过的引火物。

english: There may be just enough space to squeeze yourself into the cart. Would you like to try?
translation: 空间可能刚好够你挤进推车里。要试试吗？

english: There might be stuff in here I can use, but I'm not really sure. I should talk to Ellis the tanner, he should be in the building.
translation: 这里面可能有我能用的东西，但我不太确定。我应该去跟鞣皮师埃利斯谈谈，他应该在那栋楼里。

english: There seems to be a riddle on it...
translation: 上面似乎有一道谜题……

english: There seems to be a soul struggling to break free, although I cannot sense which soul that might be. Could you have a look into this for me?
translation: 似乎有一个灵魂在挣扎着想要挣脱，但我感觉不到是哪个灵魂。你能帮我查查这件事吗？

english: There seems to be some sort of recepticle on the door. Perhaps it needs a key?
translation: 门上似乎有个某种容器。也许需要一把钥匙？

english: There seems to be someone else up in the tree, you'll have to wait.
translation: 树上好像还有别人，你得等一等。

english: There seems to be something slightly familiar about this presence.
translation: 这个存在似乎有点眼熟。

english: There seems to be something useful here but I don't have the space for it.
translation: 这里似乎有些有用的东西，但我没有空间拿了。

english: There should be enough space for Ana (in the barrel) to go on here.
translation: 这里应该有足够的空间让安娜（在桶里）上去。

english: There should have been. Counsellors were suppose to do patrols in pairs.
translation: 本该有的。顾问们应该两人一组巡逻。

english: There was one was following me earlier. I'd better find him.
translation: 之前有一个在跟踪我。我最好找到他。

english: There we go again. Well, time to wait and see what happens.
translation: 又来了。好吧，是时候等着看会发生什么了。

english: There we go, that's better. Now you can make the ice cream!
translation: 好了，这样好多了。现在你可以做冰淇淋了！

english: There were no terms specified beforehand! Hahaha.
translation: 事先可没说明条件！哈哈哈。

english: There ye go. Come back t' me if ye need anythin' else.
translation: 给你。要是还需要别的，就回来找我。

english: There ye go. Solve the clues to find me treasure chest and return it to me.
translation: 给你。解开线索找到我的宝箱，然后还给我。

english: There you are! I've been looking for you everywhere! The adoption party is about to start in the Party room. Let's go!
translation: 你在这儿啊！我到处找你！领养派对马上就要在派对厅开始了。我们走吧！

english: There you are! I've been looking for you everywhere! We still need your help to clean up the Party room after the adoption party! Meet me there!
translation: 你在这儿啊！我到处找你！领养派对结束后，我们还需要你帮忙打扫派对厅！在那儿碰头！

english: There you are! I've been looking for you everywhere! We still need your help to match dogs to their new owners! Meet me at the Party room!
translation: 你在这儿啊！我到处找你！我们还需要你帮忙把狗和它们的新主人配对！在派对厅碰头！

english: There you go! Think of this as a little something for all the hard work.
translation: 给你！把这当作是辛苦工作的一点小意思。

english: There you go! Try not to lose it!
translation: 给你！可别弄丢了！

english: There you go, all topped up.
translation: 给你，加满了。

english: There you go, as good as new. There's just something great about Lumbridge tin.
translation: 给你，跟新的一样。仑桥镇的锡就是好。

english: There you go, let me know if you have any questions.
translation: 给你，有问题就问我。

english: There you go, partner! Thanks for your help.
translation: 给你，搭档！谢谢你的帮忙。

english: There you go. And remember, if you lose any of this costume then just come see me about it, y'hear?
translation: 给你。记住，要是弄丢了这套服装的任何部分，就来找我，听到了吗？

english: There you go. Enjoy it, but be careful!
translation: 给你。好好享用，但要小心！

english: There you go. Good hunting!
translation: 给你。狩猎愉快！

english: There you go. Now it's back to workity work!
translation: 给你。现在回去干活干活！

english: There you go. Now what else do you want?
translation: 给你。还想要什么？

english: There you go. That's all sorted for you.
translation: 给你。都帮你搞定了。

english: There you go. We found these by the Great Cauldron and they look just like it, even as it fills up!
translation: 给你。我们在大锅旁边找到这些，它们看起来跟大锅一模一样，即使装满东西时也一样！

english: There's a big tree in the centre of Varrock which could do with some decorating.
translation: 维洛克城中心有棵大树，可以装饰一下。

english: There's a crate full of them by the egg oven.
translation: 蛋烤箱旁边有个板条箱，里面装满了它们。

english: There's a glowing fungus I placed in here earlier.
translation: 我之前在这里放了一个荧光菇。

english: There's a kitchen within the warrens, Goldie will help you flavour the egg, something to do with honey. Oh and don't forget to grab an egg mold and make the egg!
translation: 兔子洞里有个厨房，戈尔迪会帮你给蛋调味，跟蜂蜜有关。哦，别忘了拿个蛋模子来做蛋！

english: There's a large hole in the chimney of the furnace which is probably why it doesn't work.
translation: 熔炉的烟囱上有个大洞，这大概就是它不工作的原因。

english: There's a large ornate key hidden inside the painting. You take it.
translation: 画作里面藏着一把大型装饰钥匙。你拿走了它。

english: There's a lot of spare decorations and costumes that Party Pete can't make use of, and he thought you might like them.
translation: 派对皮特有很多用不上的多余装饰品和服装，他觉得你可能会喜欢。

english: There's a nice and complete skeleton in here!
translation: 这里面有一具完好无损的骷髅！

english: There's a passage behind the wall.
translation: 墙壁后面有一条通道。

english: There's a problem though... look around here. Not many people are enjoying themselves.
translation: 不过有个问题……看看周围。没几个人玩得开心。

english: There's a reward in here for you, but don't have space to hold it.
translation: 这里面有给你的奖励，但你没有空间拿了。

english: There's a sharp drop on either side of the path. Are you sure you want to risk climbing over these rocks?
translation: 小路两边都是陡峭的悬崖。你确定要冒险爬过这些岩石吗？

english: There's a skeleton without a skull in here.
translation: 这里面有一具没有头骨的骷髅。

english: There's a small recess in the pillar, hidden behind a panel. However, there's nothing of interest in it.
translation: 柱子上有一个小凹处，藏在一块镶板后面。不过，里面没什么值得注意的。

english: There's a small recess in the pillar, hidden behind a panel. You find a strange shard in it.
translation: 柱子上有一个小凹处，藏在一块镶板后面。你在里面发现了一块奇怪的碎片。

english: There's a small recess in the pillar, hidden behind a panel. You find a strange shard in it. However, you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 柱子上有一个小凹处，藏在一块镶板后面。你在里面发现了一块奇怪的碎片。但是，你没有足够的空间拿走它。

english: There's a small recess in the pillar, hidden behind a panel. You find an old cipher and a strange shard in it.
translation: 柱子上有一个小凹处，藏在一块镶板后面。你在里面发现了一个旧密码和一块奇怪的碎片。

english: There's a small recess in the pillar, hidden behind a panel. You find an old cipher and a strange shard in it. However, you don't have enough room to take them.
translation: 柱子上有一个小凹处，藏在一块镶板后面。你在里面发现了一个旧密码和一块奇怪的碎片。但是，你没有足够的空间拿走它们。

english: There's a small recess in the pillar, hidden behind a panel. You find an old cipher in it.
translation: 柱子上有一个小凹处，藏在一块镶板后面。你在里面发现了一个旧密码。

english: There's a small recess in the pillar, hidden behind a panel. You find an old cipher in it. However, you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 柱子上有一个小凹处，藏在一块镶板后面。你在里面发现了一个旧密码。但是，你没有足够的空间拿走它。

english: There's a square block recessed into the wall, next to an etching of an air symbol. You can't see any obvious way to remove the block.
translation: 墙上嵌着一个方形石块，旁边是一幅空气符号的蚀刻画。你看不出有什么明显的方法可以移除这个石块。

english: There's a square block recessed into the wall, next to an etching of an earth symbol. You can't see any obvious way to remove the block.
translation: 墙上嵌着一个方形石块，旁边是一幅大地符号的蚀刻画。你看不出有什么明显的方法可以移除这个石块。

english: There's a square block recessed into the wall, next to an etching of an fire symbol. You can't see any obvious way to remove the block.
translation: 墙上嵌着一个方形石块，旁边是一幅火焰符号的蚀刻画。你看不出有什么明显的方法可以移除这个石块。

english: There's a square block recessed into the wall, next to an etching of an water symbol. You can't see any obvious way to remove the block.
translation: 墙上嵌着一个方形石块，旁边是一幅流水符号的蚀刻画。你看不出有什么明显的方法可以移除这个石块。

english: There's a sweet little monkey hiding in the warm crate. You gently pick it up.
translation: 温暖的板条箱里藏着一只可爱的小猴子。你轻轻地把它抱了起来。

english: There's a trapdoor hidden under the bed.
translation: 床底下藏着一个活板门。

english: There's a vyre noble disguise in the chest but you leave it as you already have one.
translation: 箱子里有一套维尔吸血鬼贵族伪装，但你已经有了一套，所以没拿。

english: There's already a sheep like this in the pen. You don't need to fetch another one now.
translation: 围栏里已经有这样一只羊了。你现在不需要再弄一只来。

english: There's already some rum in here...
translation: 这里面已经有朗姆酒了……

english: There's already something in the nest.
translation: 巢里已经有东西了。

english: There's also a letter? Oh! It's a letter for me.
translation: 还有一封信？哦！是给我的信。

english: There's always Melzar's patch to the west of here, although if you ask me, the Draynor Manor cabbages north-east of here are the best-tasting ones.
translation: 这里西边总是有梅尔扎的菜地，不过要我说，这里东北边德雷诺庄园的卷心菜味道最好。

english: There's always something going on in this town... What happened this time?
translation: 这个镇子总是有事发生……这次又怎么了？

english: There's an emblem slotted into the plaque, but you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 牌匾上嵌着一个徽章，但你没有足够的空间拿走它。

english: There's an emblem slotted into the plaque. You take it.
translation: 牌匾上嵌着一个徽章。你拿走了它。

english: There's are lots of strange folk hanging around this year though... those egg priests just ain't right!
translation: 不过今年有很多奇怪的家伙在附近晃悠……那些蛋祭司就是不对劲！

english: There's certainly an enticing reward for those most worthy.
translation: 对于最值得的人，当然会有一份诱人的奖励。

english: There's just a few minor details I need to smooth over.
translation: 只有几个小细节需要我处理一下。

english: There's just one problem.
translation: 只有一个问题。

english: There's no compost to take at the moment.
translation: 目前没有堆肥可以取用。

english: There's no head among the dusty books.
translation: 那些布满灰尘的书里没有头。

english: There's no place like gnome child's house.
translation: 没有什么地方比得上地精小孩的家了。

english: There's no point in wasting more money.
translation: 再浪费钱也没意义了。

english: There's no time to dance, I need to help Rick.
translation: 没时间跳舞了，我得去帮里克。

english: There's no way I'm putting this ghastly concoction in my mouth.
translation: 我绝不会把这可怕的玩意儿放进嘴里。

english: There's not really much going on here. I was hoping this would be a fun evening.
translation: 这里其实没什么事。我本来指望今晚能有点乐子的。

english: There's nothing in here for you now.
translation: 现在这里没有你要的东西。

english: There's nothing interesting about these remains.
translation: 这些遗骸没什么有趣的。

english: There's nothing left in the flask.
translation: 瓶子里什么也没剩下。

english: There's only one king around these parts. He lives in Varrock Palace.
translation: 这一带只有一个国王。他住在维洛克城宫殿里。

english: There's some coolant jugs in the cupboard.
translation: 橱柜里有些冷却液罐子。

english: There's some flypaper in there. Should I take it?
translation: 里面有粘蝇纸。我该拿走吗？

english: There's something about hanging out near a river that's so peaceful.
translation: 在河边待着有种说不出的宁静。

english: There's something mesmerising about this fire...
translation: 这火焰有种迷人的魔力……

english: There's something shiny hidden at the bottom. You take Anna's Silver Necklace.
translation: 底部藏着个闪闪发光的东西。你拿走了安娜的银项链。

english: There's something shiny hidden at the bottom. You take Bob's silver cup.
translation: 底部藏着个闪闪发光的东西。你拿走了鲍勃的银杯。

english: There's something shiny hidden at the bottom. You take Carol's silver bottle.
translation: 底部藏着个闪闪发光的东西。你拿走了卡罗尔的银瓶。

english: There's something shiny hidden at the bottom. You take David's silver book.
translation: 底部藏着个闪闪发光的东西。你拿走了大卫的银书。

english: There's something shiny hidden at the bottom. You take Elizabeth's silver needle.
translation: 底部藏着个闪闪发光的东西。你拿走了伊丽莎白的银针。

english: There's something shiny hidden at the bottom. You take Frank's silver pot.
translation: 底部藏着个闪闪发光的东西。你拿走了弗兰克的银罐。

english: There's still plenty of flour left.
translation: 面粉还剩很多。

english: There, I've added some extra details to help you out. You should update it as you go, to keep track of things!
translation: 好了，我加了些额外细节来帮你。你应该边走边更新，好记录进度！

english: There, I've done what I can, but you're a bit short of empty vessels or cash. Empty vials cost coins each and cups cost coins each.
translation: 好了，我能做的都做了，但你手头的空容器或现金有点不够。空小瓶每个需要金币，杯子每个需要金币。

english: There, it's an Easter basket. People used them for handing out Easter eggs, a long time ago. I've given you some other goodies too.
translation: 好了，这是个复活节篮子。很久以前人们用它来分发复活节彩蛋。我还给了你一些其他好东西。

english: There, that should do what you need.
translation: 好了，这应该能满足你的需要了。

english: There, that wasn't so hard!
translation: 看吧，也没那么难！

english: These appear to be complex plans for Zemouregal's Base in Silvarea. Maybe Elias can help you interpret them.
translation: 这些似乎是泽莫雷加尔在希尔瓦雷亚基地的复杂计划。也许伊莱亚斯能帮你解读它们。

english: These are enchanted chocolate chunks. If I use it to make chocolate rabbits, then my plan to have them deliver themselves will still work!
translation: 这些是附魔的巧克力块。如果我用来做巧克力兔子，那么让它们自己送货上门的计划就还能行得通！

english: These are supposed to be needles.You swap your needle for the Golden needle.
translation: 这些应该是针。你用你的针换来了金色针。

english: These are the presents. Each present has a riddle on the nametag, figure out who the present is for and deliver it to them.
translation: 这些就是礼物。每份礼物的标签上都有一个谜语，猜出礼物是给谁的，然后送给他们。

english: These books are full of scrawled notes. You open one at a random page...
translation: 这些书里写满了潦草的笔记。你随手翻开一页……

english: These bracelets, I can't seem to get them off. If I could get them off, I'd be able to climb my way out of here.
translation: 这些手镯，我好像摘不下来。如果能摘下来，我就能爬出这里了。

english: These creatures, they're made from the tears I collected?
translation: 这些生物，是用我收集的眼泪做的？

english: These don't really need watering - the soil seems to be extremely fertile.
translation: 这些其实不需要浇水——土壤似乎非常肥沃。

english: These feelings I have
translation: 我心中的这些感受

english: These floorboards look a little weak near to the wall.
translation: 这些地板靠近墙壁的地方看起来有点脆弱。

english: These gates are locked, you don't seem to be able to open them.
translation: 这些大门锁着，你似乎打不开它们。

english: These goblins have taken me hostage! Please ask them to let me out!
translation: 这些哥布林把我当人质了！请让他们放我出去！

english: These goblins told me that you killed them. What are they talking about?
translation: 这些哥布林告诉我你杀了他们。他们在说什么？

english: These magic stones will guide you to me!|colour=yellow|shadow=yes
translation: 这些魔法石头会指引你找到我！|colour=yellow|shadow=yes

english: These monkeys are too busy arguing with each other to notice you.
translation: 这些猴子忙着互相争吵，没注意到你。

english: These potatoes seem to have been largely untouched.
translation: 这些土豆似乎基本没被动过。

english: These rocks appear to have shifted recently. Further inspection reveals faint tracks among the debris, although they aren't tracks you recognise.
translation: 这些岩石最近似乎移动过。进一步检查发现碎片中有模糊的痕迹，不过不是你认识的痕迹。

english: These rocks contain nothing interesting. They are just in the way.
translation: 这些石头里没什么有趣的，它们只是挡路而已。

english: These rocks look like they have been stacked uniformly.
translation: 这些岩石看起来堆叠得很整齐。

english: These seeds have been germinated in pure sacred water and are ready to be planted in fertile soil.
translation: 这些种子已在纯净圣水中发芽，可以种在肥沃的土壤里了。

english: These seeds look magical. They need to be germinated in pure sacred water.
translation: 这些种子看起来很神奇。它们需要在纯净圣水中发芽。

english: These seeds need to be planted in the other plantpot.
translation: 这些种子需要种在另一个花盆里。

english: These special hops need to be brewed in the Keldagrim brewery. Oh well...
translation: 这些特殊的霍普斯需要在凯尔达格林城的酿酒厂酿造。唉……

english: These things don't come cheap... But if it'll keep you quiet, I'll let you have it in exchange for a good word.
translation: 这些东西可不便宜……但如果能让你闭嘴，我就让你用一句好话换走它。

english: These tricksters must have summoned you!
translation: 这些骗子一定召唤了你！

english: Thessalia hands Gregg a box full of offcuts and spare fabric. 78-->
translation: 塞萨利亚递给格雷格一个装满边角料和备用织物的盒子。78-->

english: Thessalia starts gathering up several offcuts of fabric. 76-->
translation: 塞萨利亚开始收集几块织物边角料。76-->

english: They always play just south of here, there is a nice grassy area with some bushes and trees to climb.
translation: 他们总是在南边玩，那里有片不错的草地，还有些灌木和树可以爬。

english: They are a bit tricky, but very fun. Bet you had fun making them.
translation: 它们有点棘手，但很有趣。我打赌你做它们的时候很开心。

english: They are easter eggs. The Easter Bunny hands them out every year.
translation: 它们是复活节彩蛋。复活节兔子每年都会分发它们。

english: They are imps, the most foolish and weak race in this land. Sometimes they choose to disguise themselves as stronger enemies, but do not seem to appreciate their own sense of scale.
translation: 它们是恶魔，这片土地上最愚蠢最弱小的种族。有时它们会伪装成更强的敌人，但似乎对自己的体型没什么概念。

english: They are in a secluded bay, near Miscellania.
translation: 它们在米斯凯尼亚附近一个隐蔽的海湾里。

english: They are in a secluded bay, near Rellekka.
translation: 它们在雷勒卡城附近一个隐蔽的海湾里。

english: They are ready now.
translation: 它们现在准备好了。

english: They both dont use spell check so it could realy be one person miss spelling,how old are you? any 4th grader could spell wouldnt like wouldnt not like you guthix u spelt it as wouldst.
translation: 他们俩都不用拼写检查，所以可能真的是同一个人拼错了。你多大了？随便一个四年级学生都能拼对 wouldn't，而不是像你那样拼成 wouldst，古斯在上。

english: They both make a very metallic sound when moved. I want to double-check whether there's equipment in there or not.
translation: 移动时它们都发出很金属的声音。我想再确认一下里面有没有装备。

english: They both type very similar kinda odd
translation: 他们俩打字风格非常相似，有点奇怪。

english: They can indeed! I'm getting them made right now and they'll be delivered shortly.
translation: 确实可以！我正在让人制作，很快就会送到。

english: They can't be seen near me. It's a business thing, very complicated. It would take too long to explain.
translation: 它们不能出现在我附近。这是生意上的事，非常复杂。解释起来太费时间了。

english: They can't have gone far, they'll probably be wearing the hat!
translation: 他们走不远的，很可能戴着那顶帽子！

english: They can't see you anyway why would you hide?
translation: 反正他们也看不见你，你为什么要躲？

english: They conceal their emotions behind a cheerful facade, eating and drinking to block out the fear and pain of everyday life.
translation: 他们把情绪藏在快乐的外表下，用吃喝来掩盖日常生活的恐惧和痛苦。

english: They do love their kebabs.
translation: 他们确实很喜欢烤肉串。

english: They don't actually need to be a ghost, just scary enough to pretend to be one.
translation: 他们其实不需要是幽灵，只要够吓人，能假装成幽灵就行了。

english: They don't call me the Wise Old Man for nothing, you know! How else do you think I manage to transport you to places no one else can get to? I can transport myself anywhere I want, too!
translation: 他们叫我老智者可不是白叫的，你知道吧！不然你以为我是怎么把你送到别人去不了的地方的？我自己也能想去哪儿就去哪儿！

english: They don't like fire, seems they can understand enough for a little self preservation!
translation: 它们不喜欢火，看来它们还有点自我保护意识！

english: They don't make you any better at farming as a result. It would be too good to be true, otherwise.
translation: 它们并不会因此让你农业技能变得更好。否则就太美好了，不像是真的。

english: They don't seem to be the same. I guess that clears Anna of the crime. You destroy the useless fingerprint.
translation: 它们似乎不一样。我想这洗清了安娜的嫌疑。你销毁了无用的指纹。

english: They don't seem to be the same. I guess that clears Bob of the crime. You destroy the useless fingerprint.
translation: 它们似乎不一样。我想这洗清了鲍勃的嫌疑。你销毁了无用的指纹。

english: They don't seem to be the same. I guess that clears Carol of the crime. You destroy the useless fingerprint.
translation: 它们似乎不一样。我想这洗清了卡罗尔的嫌疑。你销毁了无用的指纹。

english: They don't seem to be the same. I guess that clears David of the crime. You destroy the useless fingerprint.
translation: 它们似乎不一样。我想这洗清了大卫的嫌疑。你销毁了无用的指纹。

english: They don't seem to be the same. I guess that clears Elizabeth of the crime. You destroy the useless fingerprint.
translation: 它们似乎不一样。我想这洗清了伊丽莎白的嫌疑。你销毁了无用的指纹。

english: They don't seem to be the same. I guess that clears Frank of the crime. You destroy the useless fingerprint.
translation: 它们似乎不一样。我想这洗清了弗兰克的嫌疑。你销毁了无用的指纹。

english: They fled south, but some remained under its control. They brought it with them.
translation: 他们逃往南方，但有些仍受其控制。他们把它带在身边。

english: They haven't disappeared or anything!
translation: 它们没有消失或怎样！

english: They is okay. Bit squishy.
translation: 它们还行。有点软塌塌的。

english: They knocked each other out... completely? Both of them?
translation: 他们互相打晕了……完全晕了？两个都？

english: They look so good, but what is Cecilia wearing?
translation: 它们看起来真不错，但塞西莉亚穿的是什么？

english: They loved travelling, poetry and pottery among other things. They also liked cats very much, that's why I picked a picture of a cat.
translation: 他们喜欢旅行、诗歌和陶器等等。他们也非常喜欢猫，所以我选了一张猫的图片。

english: They may have, but in the end, their hints helped me retrieve it safely.
translation: 也许吧，但最终，他们的提示帮我安全地找回了它。

english: They mentioned costumes too, so I thought I'd crash the party by putting on my most EVIL costume, because I want to be in disguise, but still EVIL.
translation: 他们也提到了服装，所以我想我要穿上我最邪恶的服装去砸场子，因为我想伪装，但还是要保持邪恶。

english: They object to your opaque clothes.
translation: 他们反对你穿着不透明的衣服。

english: They really are everywhere....
translation: 它们真是无处不在……

english: They really liked my moves, I think.
translation: 我想他们真的很喜欢我的舞步。

english: They seem pretty innocent.
translation: 他们看起来挺无辜的。

english: They seem to be dying.
translation: 他们似乎快要死了。

english: They seem to have exhausted themselves now.
translation: 他们现在似乎已经筋疲力尽了。

english: They speak of a Happy New Year, yet the world spins on and on through the void, unchanged and unchanging, with nothing Happy or New to show for another year's striving.
translation: 他们说着新年快乐，然而世界在虚空中不停旋转，一成不变，又一年的奋斗也拿不出什么快乐或新鲜的东西。

english: They spend a few coins on trinkets for each other, pretending that their money can buy forgiveness for a year of uncaring selfishness or spite.
translation: 他们花几个金币给对方买小饰品，假装金钱能买来对一年冷漠自私或恶意的宽恕。

english: They succumbed. It had no further use for them.
translation: 他们屈服了。它不再需要他们了。

english: They sure were!
translation: 它们确实是！

english: They turned on one another, and Hewey was killed. I should find a way to take advantage of the situation.
translation: 他们互相反目，休伊被杀死了。我应该想办法利用这个局面。

english: They want me to help them deliver their poems to their interests, maybe you could join me in that?
translation: 他们想让我帮忙把他们的诗送到他们感兴趣的人那里，也许你可以和我一起？

english: They weigh as much as a dead dragon! I gained two Strength levels dragging them around. Why on Gielinor have we not yet come up with an easier way to carry things!
translation: 它们重得像条死龙！拖着它们走让我力量升了两级。在吉莱诺上我们怎么还没想出更轻松的搬运方法！

english: They were a bit dull when grey, but now they're all colourful... maybe you'd like one as a thankyou?
translation: 它们灰色的时候有点单调，但现在五颜六色的……也许你想要一个作为感谢？

english: They were bought by someone who went off to the Blue Moon Inn, so you should be able to find them there!
translation: 它们被一个去了蓝月旅馆的人买走了，所以你应该能在那里找到它们！

english: They were some dance moves I was trying to remember.
translation: 那是我试图记起的一些舞步。

english: They weren't just mindless husks... It's like... they were still in there.
translation: 它们不只是没有思想的空壳……就好像……它们还在里面。

english: They will be given some fine ale and meat.
translation: 他们会得到一些好麦酒和肉。

english: They will be given some party hats and balloons.
translation: 他们会得到一些派对帽和气球。

english: They will be ready tomorrow.
translation: 它们明天就能准备好。

english: They will never agree on one. Perhaps I should get them some of each colour.
translation: 他们永远不会达成一致。也许我应该给他们每种颜色都买一些。

english: They won't. It's a very difficult quest, and only I know the location!
translation: 他们不会的。这是个非常困难的任务，而且只有我知道地点！

english: They wouldn't be big enough for what we need.
translation: 它们不够大，满足不了我们的需要。

english: They wouldn't take these, apparently, and I can't even open them to empty them! They are locked and the key my mother gave me isn't the right one.
translation: 显然他们不肯收这些，我甚至打不开它们来清空！它们锁着，我母亲给我的钥匙不对。

english: They're a bit maze like in structure, but I'm sure you'll have no problem finding your way.
translation: 它们的结构有点像迷宫，但我相信你找到路没问题。

english: They're also the only buckets I have.
translation: 它们也是我仅有的桶。

english: They're cute little creatures, aren't they?
translation: 它们是可爱的小生物，对吧？

english: They're great thanks, and it was no problem. Hopefully those adventurers can get their Easter eggs now!
translation: 它们很好，谢谢，而且没问题。希望那些冒险者现在能拿到他们的复活节彩蛋了！

english: They're hiding on the south-west coast near the bank. They'll be hidden, but should be easy to find now you know they're there.
translation: 它们藏在银行附近的西南海岸。它们会藏起来，但既然你知道它们在那里，应该很容易找到。

english: They're insulated boxes filled with icey water. I just keep them open and they cool the crate down nicely.
translation: 它们是装满冰水的保温箱。我只要让它们开着，就能很好地冷却板条箱。

english: They're just a bit long really. It's quite hard to remember a fourteen word name. I was thinking more like one or two words.
translation: 只是有点长而已。要记住一个十四个字的名字太难了。我想的是一两个字的名字。

english: They're just chocolate eggs, not cursed omens.
translation: 它们只是巧克力蛋，又不是什么受诅咒的预兆。

english: They're not here for you to take.
translation: 它们不是给你拿的。

english: Thing is, it's hard to tell if it's working so far. They've been awkwardly standing there for quite a while now.
translation: 问题是，现在还很难说有没有效果。他们尴尬地站在那里已经好一阵子了。

english: Things like food and drinks.
translation: 像是食物和饮料之类的东西。

english: Thinking about it, I vaguely remember someone mentioning something to me about a certain Gilbert near Varrock that helped them.
translation: 仔细想想，我隐约记得有人跟我提过，维洛克城附近有个叫吉尔伯特的帮过他们。

english: Third correct answer
translation: 第三个正确答案

english: Third right, seventh left. Got it. I'll get going then!
translation: 右边第三个，左边第七个。记住了。那我出发了！

english: This 'wall' has some disks set into it showing a picture and some levers. I should try pulling the levers to see what happens.
translation: 这面'墙'上嵌着一些圆盘，上面有图案和一些拉杆。我应该拉拉杆看看会发生什么。

english: This Sage seems to be my hostage. You seem to be at my beck and call.
translation: 这位智者似乎是我的俘虏。而你似乎得听我使唤。

english: This Trailblazer tool is too extravagant to convert into an infernal pickaxe.
translation: 这把开拓者工具太奢华了，不能转换成地狱镐。

english: This Trick-or-Treating business.
translation: 这个不给糖就捣蛋的勾当。

english: This adventurer was unwittingly helping me test it.
translation: 这个冒险者无意中在帮我测试它。

english: This all sounds very far-fetched.
translation: 这一切听起来都很牵强。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of ammunition.You take what you find inside.
translation: 这看起来是一批弹药。你拿走了里面找到的东西。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of construction supplies. You take the ones not damaged by water.
translation: 这看起来是一批建筑用品。你拿走了没有被水损坏的那些。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of farming goods. You take what's left of the seeds inside.
translation: 这看起来是一批农业用品。你拿走了里面剩下的种子。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of metals. You find a piece that looks unweathered.
translation: 这看起来是一批金属。你找到了一块看起来没有风化的。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of potions. You take the one that is still corked.
translation: 这看起来是一批药水。你拿走了那瓶还塞着塞子的。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of runes. You take what's left of them.
translation: 这看起来是一批符文。你拿走了剩下的那些。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of treated animal hides. You find a piece in good condition.
translation: 这看起来是一批处理过的兽皮。你找到了一块状况良好的。

english: This appears to have been a shipment of weapons. You find just one left in the crate.
translation: 这看起来是一批武器。你发现板条箱里只剩下一件了。

english: This area of rock doesn't quite seem to match the rest of the cliff face. There appears to be a thin vertical slot in the middle of the rock, with what appears to be a carving of a feather above it.
translation: 这片岩石区域似乎与悬崖的其他部分不太匹配。岩石中间似乎有一条细长的垂直缝隙，上方刻着一根羽毛的图案。

english: This axe feels a little much for unfamiliar hands to wield it.
translation: 这把斧头对不熟悉的手来说有点难以挥舞。

english: This bank booth is in an awful condition. There's a lot of broken glass and most of the wooden structure of the booth has been destroyed.
translation: 这个银行柜台状况糟透了。到处都是碎玻璃，柜台的大部分木质结构都被破坏了。

english: This barrel has been recently ransacked.
translation: 这个桶最近被洗劫过。

english: This barrel is quite big, but you may be able to carry one. Would you like to take one?
translation: 这个桶相当大，但你也许能搬得动一个。你想拿一个吗？

english: This boat looks pretty broken and is in need of a serious overhaul.
translation: 这艘船看起来破旧不堪，需要彻底大修。

english: This boat looks pretty broken.
translation: 这艘船看起来破旧不堪。

english: This book has some very enlightening points to make, but you are at a loss to know how anyone without a head could possibly read it.
translation: 这本书提出了一些很有启发性的观点，但你想不通一个没有头的人怎么可能读得了它。

english: This book leaves you contemplating vegetarianism.
translation: 这本书让你开始思考素食主义。

english: This book seems far too complex for you. Maybe Safalaan will know what to do with it.
translation: 这本书对你来说似乎太复杂了。也许萨法拉恩知道该怎么处理它。

english: This book seems to have been read hundreds of times, and has scribbles and formulae on every page. One such scribble says 'None good enough - have had to lock them in the caverns...'
translation: 这本书似乎被读过几百遍了，每一页都有潦草的字迹和公式。其中一处潦草的字迹写着'没有一个够格的——只好把他们锁在洞穴里……'

english: This book uses very strange language and some incomprehensible symbols. It has a very dark feeling to it. As you're loooking through the book, you notice that one of the pages has been torn and half of it is missing.
translation: 这本书使用非常奇怪的语言和一些难以理解的符号。给人一种非常黑暗的感觉。当你翻阅这本书时，你注意到有一页被撕掉了，只剩下一半。

english: This bookcase is full of old scripts, scores, and performance pieces.
translation: 这个书架里装满了旧剧本、乐谱和表演作品。

english: This bush is fake, and there's a hole underneath it!
translation: 这丛灌木是假的，下面有个洞！

english: This cabbage is too firmly rooted. Only a sharp blade will be able to free it.
translation: 这颗卷心菜扎根太深了。只有锋利的刀片才能把它弄出来。

english: This cart is being unloaded into this section of the mine. Before being sent back to another section for another load.
translation: 这辆推车正在把货物卸到矿场的这个区域。然后会被送回另一个区域再装一车。

english: This cart is full of eggs!
translation: 这辆推车装满了蛋！

english: This chair is... moving? Perfect! Exactly the kind of spookiness Fred needs.
translation: 这把椅子……在动？完美！正是弗雷德需要的那种恐怖感。

english: This chest has [X] loads of plunder inside.
translation: 这个箱子里有[X]份掠夺品。

english: This chest has been recently plundered.
translation: 这个箱子最近被掠夺过。

english: This chest is full of plunder.
translation: 这个箱子里装满了掠夺品。

english: This chest is securely locked shut. There is some kind of balance attached to the lock, and a number four is painted just above it.
translation: 这个箱子锁得很牢固。锁上连着某种天平，正上方画着数字四。

english: This chute looks to be in pretty poor condition.
translation: 这个滑道看起来状况很差。

english: This chute looks to be in pretty poor condition. You don't think you'll get the boat down it in this state.
translation: 这个滑道看起来状况很差。你觉得以这种状态，没法把船从上面滑下去。

english: This combination is incorrect.
translation: 这个组合不正确。

english: This crate currently contains [amount] logs, [amount] oak logs, [amount] willow logs, [amount] yew logs and [amount] magic logs.
translation: 这个板条箱目前装有[amount]根原木、[amount]根橡木原木、[amount]根柳木原木、[amount]根紫杉原木和[amount]根魔法原木。

english: This crate has been recently looted.
translation: 这个板条箱最近被洗劫过。

english: This crate is full of ... magical monkey talking dentures!
translation: 这个板条箱里装满了……会说话的魔法猴子假牙！

english: This crate is full of ... monkey amulet moulds!
translation: 这个板条箱里装满了……猴子护身符模具！

english: This crate is full of ... spare controls!
translation: 这个板条箱里装满了……备用的控制器！

english: This crowbar can be used to pry open crates full of drinks while out at sea. You can then add them to your sea charts by sampling the drinks.
translation: 这把撬棍可以用来撬开海上装满饮料的板条箱。然后你可以通过品尝这些饮料，将它们添加到你的海图中。

english: This crystal seems to glow and has a mystical aura about it. It seems to be vaguely heart shaped.
translation: 这颗水晶似乎在发光，散发着神秘的气息。它看起来隐约是心形的。

english: This diving equipment works in place of the non- upgraded version. Higher level dives whilst charting the sea floor with mermaids will require this upgraded equipment.
translation: 这套潜水装备可以替代未升级的版本。与美人鱼一起绘制海底地图时，进行更高等级的潜水需要这套升级装备。

english: This doesn't look too bad, actually. I should show this to the Easter Bunny.
translation: 实际上，这看起来还不错。我应该把这个给复活节兔子看看。

english: This doesn't seem to be the right magnet to open this door...
translation: 这似乎不是打开这扇门的正确磁铁……

english: This doesn't seem to do what you want it to.
translation: 这似乎达不到你想要的效果。

english: This dog is perfect! A dog this size will command respect with my cows, and the coat should keep it warm in winter.
translation: 这只狗太完美了！这么大的狗能让我的牛群服服帖帖，而且它的皮毛应该能让它在冬天保暖。

english: This dog is perfect, thank you so much!
translation: 这只狗太完美了，非常感谢！

english: This dog looks like it will try to herd my knights. That's my job. Maybe another dog would work better.
translation: 这只狗看起来会试图驱赶我的骑士们。那是我的工作。也许换一只狗会更好。

english: This dog looks quite distinguished, but will need more grooming than I can commit to.
translation: 这只狗看起来很高贵，但需要的打理时间比我能够投入的要多。

english: This door appears to be securely locked.
translation: 这扇门似乎锁得很牢固。

english: This door does not seem to be openable.
translation: 这扇门似乎打不开。

english: This door is securely locked.
translation: 这扇门锁得很牢。

english: This drink has been sealed in a crate for an unknown amount of time. It could do anything to you, good or bad. Are you sure you want to drink it?
translation: 这瓶饮料被封在板条箱里不知道多久了。它可能对你产生任何影响，好的或坏的。你确定要喝吗？

english: This duck can be used to chart the currents of the sea. Place him in an area where you wish to chart currents, then collect the duck from wherever he ends up.
translation: 这只鸭子可以用来绘制海流图。把它放在你想绘制海流的区域，然后从它最终到达的地方把它捡回来。

english: This dungeon contains colourful transition effects that can be distressing to some players.
translation: 这个地牢包含色彩鲜艳的过渡效果，可能会让一些玩家感到不适。

english: This field looks so colourful! How did you do it?
translation: 这片田地看起来真五彩缤纷！你是怎么做到的？

english: This fireplace looks pretty old. It certainly hasn't been dusted recently. You see a loose tile and some scratch marks where a sharp instrument has been used.
translation: 这个壁炉看起来很旧了。最近肯定没有打扫过。你看到一块松动的瓷砖和一些被尖锐工具划过的痕迹。

english: This fireplace looks pretty old. It certainly hasn't been dusted recently. You see a loose tile with an empty compartment behind it.
translation: 这个壁炉看起来很旧了。最近肯定没有打扫过。你看到一块松动的瓷砖，后面有一个空隔间。

english: This gnome needs your help.
translation: 这个地精需要你的帮助。

english: This good, Carol likes this!
translation: 这个好，卡罗尔喜欢这个！

english: This guy doesn't seem in any state to have organised grand theft eggo.
translation: 这家伙看起来不像是有能力组织偷蛋大案的样子。

english: This guy seems a little down on his luck. Do you want to help him?
translation: 这家伙看起来有点倒霉。你想帮他吗？

english: This had better not be some kind of trick.
translation: 这最好别是什么把戏。

english: This happened to a cow earlier, and although I could mime it again, I'd really rather not.
translation: 之前有头牛也发生过这种事，虽然我可以再比划一次，但我真的不想。

english: This happens every year....
translation: 每年都这样……

english: This has been such a great day! I'm in the Realm of Memories, and I've even finished my apprenticeship. [player name], thank you so much!
translation: 今天真是美好的一天！我来到了记忆之境，甚至还完成了我的学徒期。[player name]，太感谢你了！

english: This head was found in Rick's box. Hopefully it's him.
translation: 这个头是在里克的盒子里找到的。希望是他的头。

english: This incantation will hopefully work.
translation: 希望这个咒语能起作用。

english: This is a blindweed patch. The soil has not been treated. The patch needs weeding.
translation: 这是一块盲草种植地。土壤未经处理。这块地需要除草。

english: This is a contest, isn't it? I'm not going to tell my secrets, if that's alright!
translation: 这是个比赛，对吧？如果没问题的话，我可不会说出我的秘密！

english: This is a furnace for smelting metal. You'll learn how to use it soon.
translation: 这是一个用来熔炼金属的熔炉。你很快就会学会如何使用它。

english: This is a hops patch. The soil has not been treated. The patch (Crop) is fully grown.
translation: 这是一个啤酒花种植地。土壤未经处理。种植地（作物）已完全成熟。

english: This is a piece of map that you found in Melzar's Maze. You will need to join it to the other two map pieces before you can see the route to Crandor.
translation: 这是你在梅尔扎迷宫里找到的一块地图碎片。你需要把它和另外两块地图碎片拼在一起，才能看到通往克兰多的路线。

english: This is a piece of map that you found in a secret chest in the Dwarven Mine. You will need to join it to the other two map pieces before you can see the route to Crandor.
translation: 这是你在矮人矿场的一个秘密箱子里找到的一块地图碎片。你需要把它和另外两块地图碎片拼在一起，才能看到通往克兰多的路线。

english: This is a piece of map that you got from Wormbrain, the goblin thief. You will need to join it to the other two map pieces before you can see the route to Crandor.
translation: 这是你从哥布林盗贼虫脑那里得到的一块地图碎片。你需要把它和另外两块地图碎片拼在一起，才能看到通往克兰多的路线。

english: This is a powerful scroll. Perdu, the dwarf, can use it to help lock certain items to their owners, so that the items aren't destroyed on death in deep Wilderness.
translation: 这是一张强大的卷轴。矮人佩杜可以用它来帮助将某些物品锁定给其主人，这样这些物品就不会在荒野深处死亡时被摧毁。

english: This is a statement, not a question...
translation: 这是个陈述句，不是问题……

english: This is a supercompostable item - are you sure?
translation: 这是一个可以制成超级堆肥的物品——你确定吗？

english: This is amazing news! So this means I can finally deliver Easter eggs into the desert. Those adventurers will be so happy!
translation: 这真是个好消息！这意味着我终于可以把复活节彩蛋送到沙漠里去了。那些冒险者一定会很高兴的！

english: This is an Imcando favourite, cooked to perfection.
translation: 这是伊姆坎多人的最爱，烹饪得恰到好处。

english: This is an anvil used for smithing. You'll learn how to use it soon.
translation: 这是一个用于锻造的铁砧。你很快就会学会如何使用它。

english: This is around the time my wares ripen and sell for their highest price.
translation: 差不多到了我的货物成熟并能卖出最高价的时候了。

english: This is going to sound crazy, but do you have any fishing bait that I could use to fish in a desert oasis?
translation: 这听起来可能很疯狂，但你有鱼饵吗？我想在沙漠绿洲里钓鱼。

english: This is good! I wonder what's in it? Actually... I'd rather not know.
translation: 这很好！我好奇里面是什么？其实……我还是不知道为好。

english: This is great news!
translation: 这真是个好消息！

english: This is hard work, but we must make up for our wrongs.
translation: 这工作很辛苦，但我们必须弥补我们的过错。

english: This is just a rock, why're you searching it? Just get on with what you're meant to be doing!
translation: 这只是一块石头，你搜它干嘛？赶紧去做你该做的事！

english: This is marvellous! It's exactly what I need. With some decorations, these rooms shall be...
translation: 太棒了！这正是我需要的。再装饰一下，这些房间将会……

english: This is my latest experimental arena. I... designed it to make people feel and accept the pain of life.
translation: 这是我最新的实验性竞技场。我……设计它是为了让人们感受并接受生活的痛苦。

english: This is not really the time to dance.
translation: 现在真的不是跳舞的时候。

english: This is not what I had in mind for this time of year.
translation: 这可不是我心目中这个时节该有的样子。

english: This is some party you've got going here!
translation: 你这里办的派对真不错！

english: This is someones name. Have a look around the Al Kharid inhabitants.
translation: 这是某个人的名字。在阿尔卡里德城的居民中找找看。

english: This is terrible! I was just trying to get into the Halloween mood, reading something scary from that antique book of Rituals and suddenly the crypt shook and a THING appeared!
translation: 太可怕了！我只是想找找万圣节的感觉，读那本古老的仪式书里一些吓人的内容，突然墓穴震动起来，然后一个东西出现了！

english: This is the Easter Bunny. I'm stuck in my office, and I'm having to use my emergency broadcast system to talk to you.
translation: 我是复活节兔子。我被困在办公室里了，不得不使用紧急广播系统跟你说话。

english: This is the costume, what do you think?
translation: 这就是那套服装，你觉得怎么样？

english: This is the famous Party Pete's wicked birthday bash, how can they not be enjoying themselves?
translation: 这可是派对名人皮特那场超棒的生日狂欢，他们怎么可能不尽兴呢？

english: This is the land of snow... there's tons of it out there.
translation: 这里是雪之国……外面到处都是雪。

english: This is the schematics board. It's used to upgrade core parts of your boat, such as the hull. However, you have no reason to use it right now. You should focus on building your cargo hold instead.
translation: 这是示意图板。用来升级船的核心部件，比如船体。不过你现在还没理由用它。你应该先专注于建造货舱。

english: This is the worst event I have ever seen. Where's the chaos? Where's the misery?
translation: 这是我见过最烂的活动。混乱在哪？苦难在哪？

english: This is the wrong sort of cabbage!
translation: 这种卷心菜不对！

english: This is too big; you need a spit roast for this big bird.
translation: 这太大了；对付这只大鸟，你需要一个旋转烤架。

english: This is true, I'm sycamore paperwork.
translation: 说得对，我就是个西克莫文书。

english: This is useless, all of these flavours are terrible! Thanks for nothing, get off our island!
translation: 真没用，这些口味都糟透了！白费功夫，滚出我们的岛！

english: This is very important, we have to make sure we test thoroughly!
translation: 这非常重要，我们必须彻底测试！

english: This is wonderful!
translation: 太棒了！

english: This isn't spooky, this is obscene.
translation: 这不吓人，这简直下流。

english: This isn't the right time to be adding Kelda hops.
translation: 现在不是添加凯尔达啤酒花的时候。

english: This keg is filled with horizon's lure. A keg of horizon's lure gives a 2.5% boost to all Sailing experience gained.
translation: 这桶里装的是地平线的诱惑。一桶地平线的诱惑能让所有航海经验获取量提升2.5%。

english: This keg is filled with kraken ink stout. A keg of kraken ink stout improves the chance of random encounters spawning at sea by 4%.
translation: 这桶里装的是克拉肯墨汁黑啤酒。一桶克拉肯墨汁黑啤酒能让海上随机遭遇事件的发生几率提升4%。

english: This keg is filled with perildance bitter. A keg of perildance bitter increases the max hit of your cannons by one.
translation: 这桶里装的是佩里兰斯苦啤酒。一桶佩里兰斯苦啤酒能让你的火炮最大伤害增加1点。

english: This keg is filled with trawler's trust. A keg of trawler's trust gives a 5% chance to catch an extra fish whilst deep sea trawling.
translation: 这桶里装的是拖网渔夫的信赖。一桶拖网渔夫的信赖能让你在深海拖网时有5%的几率多捕一条鱼。

english: This keg is filled with whirlpool surprise. A keg of whirlpool surprise gives your crew a minimum of 2 Deckhandiness and 2 Helmsmanship.
translation: 这桶里装的是漩涡惊喜。一桶漩涡惊喜能让你的船员至少拥有2点甲板熟练度和2点操舵技术。

english: This key doesn't open this door.
translation: 这把钥匙打不开这扇门。

english: This knife doesn't seem sturdy enough to have killed Lord Sinclair.
translation: 这把刀看起来不够结实，杀不了辛克莱尔勋爵。

english: This ladder looks like it's missing the top part. It looks too dangerous to climb down from here.
translation: 这梯子看起来少了上半部分。从这里爬下去太危险了。

english: This leads to the viewing gallery. You can leave the viewing area again by going down the ladder.
translation: 这里通向观景台。你可以顺着梯子下去离开观景区。

english: This leather looks pretty tough to work with... Maybe the dragonkin had a way.
translation: 这皮革看起来很难加工……也许龙人有什么办法。

english: This looks good! I should let the Easter Bunny know.
translation: 看起来不错！我应该告诉复活节兔子。

english: This looks like a full mining barrel. Slaves use this to load up the rocks and stones that they're mining. This barrel is full of coal.
translation: 这看起来是个装满矿石的桶。奴隶们用它来装载他们开采的岩石和石头。这个桶里装满了煤。

english: This looks like a lift of some sort. You see barrels of rocks being placed on the lift and they're hauled up to the surface.
translation: 这看起来像某种升降机。你看到装着岩石的桶被放在升降机上，然后被吊到地面。

english: This looks like a scroll about Rashiliyia. Would you like to read it?
translation: 这看起来是一份关于拉希利娅的卷轴。你想读读看吗？

english: This looks like a winch, it probably brings rocks up from underground.
translation: 这看起来像个绞盘，可能是用来把岩石从地下吊上来的。

english: This looks like an empty mining barrel. Slaves use this to load up the rocks and stones that they're mining.
translation: 这看起来是个空的采矿桶。奴隶们用它来装载他们开采的岩石和石头。

english: This looks like an interesting mining barrel.
translation: 这看起来是个有趣的采矿桶。

english: This looks like one of the pages to Kharedst's Memoirs. Maybe I should try adding it to the book.
translation: 这看起来像是卡雷德斯的回忆录中的一页。也许我该试着把它加到书里。

english: This looks like part of a scroll about someone called Bervirius. Would you like to read it?
translation: 这看起来像是一份关于某个叫贝维里乌斯的人的卷轴的一部分。你想读读看吗？

english: This looks like some disturbed sand. Footsteps seem to be heading off towards the South.
translation: 这看起来像是被翻动过的沙子。脚印似乎朝着南边去了。

english: This looks perfect! Exactly how it should look.
translation: 看起来完美！就该是这个样子。

english: This looks pretty steep. But if Scrubfoot went down here, so can I!
translation: 这看起来相当陡峭。但如果斯克鲁布福特能下去，我也能！

english: This looks quite important, are you sure you want to drop it?
translation: 这看起来相当重要，你确定要丢掉它吗？

english: This looks very colourful, but you remember what Father Lawrence told you about it, probably best not to drink it.
translation: 这看起来色彩缤纷，但你还记得劳伦斯神父告诉过你关于它的事，最好还是别喝。

english: This looks very promising, but it would look better if it were cooking! I've prepared a fire pit underneath the cauldron; please light it.
translation: 这看起来很有希望，但如果能煮起来就更好了！我已经在大锅下面准备好了火坑，请把它点燃。

english: This map is for use elsewhere.
translation: 这张地图是别处用的。

english: This map leads to the lair of the beast that destroyed my home, devoured my family, and burned to a cinder all that I love. But revenge would not benefit me now, and to disturb this beast is to risk bringing its wrath down upon another land.
translation: 这张地图通往那头野兽的巢穴，它摧毁了我的家园，吞噬了我的家人，把我所爱的一切都烧成了灰烬。但复仇现在对我没有好处，惊扰这头野兽只会冒险将它的怒火引向另一片土地。

english: This mean I am chef now?
translation: 这是不是意味着我现在是厨师了？

english: This means we're ready for the next task. Planting new seeds! Unfortunately I've ran out of them...
translation: 这意味着我们准备好进行下一步了。播种新种子！可惜我已经用完了……

english: This meat is disgusting but... the goblins seem to like this sort of thing. 2 -->
translation: 这肉真恶心，但……地精们似乎喜欢这种东西。 2 -->

english: This mercenary Captain looks very fierce. Are you sure you want to attack him?
translation: 这个雇佣兵队长看起来非常凶猛。你确定要攻击他吗？

english: This might go better if Gnome Child was here.
translation: 如果地精小孩在这儿，可能会顺利些。

english: This mine cart is being loaded up with new rocks and stone. It gets sent to a different section of the mine for unloading.
translation: 这辆矿车正在装载新的岩石和石头。它会被送到矿场的另一个区域去卸载。

english: This moment is just for you.
translation: 这一刻只为你。

english: This once, you will have to tell me where you wish to go, for I do not yet know where to take you back.
translation: 这一次，你得告诉我你想去哪里，因为我还不知道要把你送回哪里。

english: This one's for me, not you.
translation: 这是给我的，不是给你的。

english: This painting has been slashed. It looks like something was once hidden inside it. It's empty now though.
translation: 这幅画被划破了。看起来里面曾经藏着什么东西。不过现在里面是空的。

english: This painting is a little odd. It seems to depict the statue of a female vampyre holding a key.
translation: 这幅画有点奇怪。似乎描绘了一个拿着钥匙的女性吸血鬼雕像。

english: This part of the bar only has beer. You're trying to find [beverage].
translation: 吧台的这部分只有啤酒。你在找[beverage]。

english: This part of the bar only has chocolate milk. You're trying to find [beverage].
translation: 吧台的这部分只有巧克力牛奶。你在找[beverage]。

english: This part of the bar only has cider. You're trying to find [beverage].
translation: 吧台的这部分只有苹果酒。你在找[beverage]。

english: This part of the bar only has dwarvern stout. You're trying to find [beverage].
translation: 吧台的这部分只有矮人烈酒。你在找[beverage]。

english: This part of the bar only has eggnog. You're trying to find [beverage].
translation: 吧台的这部分只有蛋奶酒。你在找[beverage]。

english: This part of the bar only has milk. You're trying to find [beverage].
translation: 吧台的这部分只有牛奶。你在找[beverage]。

english: This part of the bar only has wine. You're trying to find [beverage].
translation: 吧台的这部分只有葡萄酒。你在找[beverage]。

english: This party isn't very regal... I don't think I am going to enjoy myself here.
translation: 这个派对不够气派……我觉得我在这儿不会玩得开心。

english: This party really isn't doing it for me [player name].
translation: 这个派对真的不适合我，[player name]。

english: This patch doesn't really need treating with compost - the soil seems to be extremely fertile.
translation: 这块地其实不需要用堆肥处理——土壤似乎非常肥沃。

english: This person sells four items.
translation: 这个人卖四样东西。

english: This place is very promising, but it needs more atmosphere. Do you know what I mean? Something to make the children remember my Halloween treat forever!
translation: 这个地方很有潜力，但还需要更多氛围。你懂我的意思吗？需要一些东西让孩子们永远记住我的万圣节款待！

english: This plant doesn't seem to be quite as healthy as the others. It has a few dead branches sprouting from it.
translation: 这株植物似乎没有其他几株那么健康。它长出了几根枯枝。

english: This plant pot has been filled with sand.
translation: 这个花盆已经装满了沙子。

english: This plantpot needs some compost in it first.
translation: 这个花盆里得先放些堆肥。

english: This quest is coming soon...
translation: 这个任务即将推出……

english: This quiz.
translation: 这个测验。

english: This railing is broken and needs to be replaced.
translation: 这段栏杆坏了，需要更换。

english: This railing is now fixed.
translation: 这个栏杆现在修好了。

english: This reminds me of how we first met, back in your kitchen in Lumbridge Castle, when you made me fetch the ingredients for a birthday cake.
translation: 这让我想起了我们第一次见面的时候，在仑桥镇城堡你的厨房里，你让我去取做生日蛋糕的原料。

english: This rod looks very similar to the rod you saw fused to the top of the coffin. However, this rod lacks the divine energies that the original gave off.
translation: 这根棒子看起来和你之前看到的嵌在棺材顶上的那根非常相似。不过，这根棒子缺少原物散发出的神圣能量。

english: This said, it's the season to be spooky and you do a fine job of it!
translation: 话虽如此，现在可是搞怪吓人的季节，你做得很好！

english: This script is all out of order, but it might have to do.
translation: 这剧本完全乱套了，但也许还能凑合着用。

english: This scroll contains the ability to override your High Alchemy spell animation. Would you like to read the scroll?
translation: 这张卷轴包含覆盖你的高等炼金术法术动画的能力。你想阅读这张卷轴吗？

english: This scroll is a collection of writings. Some of them are just scraps of papyrus with what looks like random scribblings. Which would you like to read?
translation: 这张卷轴是一本作品集。其中一些只是莎草纸碎片，上面有看似随意的涂鸦。你想读哪一篇？

english: This seed may only be planted close to Glarial's remains.
translation: 这颗种子只能种在格拉里亚尔的遗骸附近。

english: This seems like an odd place to perform this emote.
translation: 在这里做这个表情动作似乎有点奇怪。

english: This seems to be a small sac filled with venom.
translation: 这似乎是一个装满毒液的小囊。

english: This should be easy - there ought to be some skeletons in the coffins here. Be a good chap and get them hung up, please.
translation: 这应该很容易——这里的棺材里应该有些骷髅。行行好，请把它们挂起来。

english: This sounds like a terrible plan.
translation: 这听起来是个糟糕的计划。

english: This sounds very scientific! Any idea where I should go to test these?
translation: 听起来很科学！知道我应该去哪里测试这些吗？

english: This spider is actually not that bad!
translation: 这只蜘蛛其实没那么糟！

english: This stack of fragments is roughly equivalent to X pieces of essence.
translation: 这堆碎片大约相当于X份精华。

english: This stack of fragments is roughly equivalent to one piece of essence.
translation: 这堆碎片大约相当于一份精华。

english: This station can be used to record weather patterns. To find where to record the data, first use the wind measurements to see which direction the wind is moving, then use those measurements to work out where it isn't
translation: 这个站点可以用来记录天气模式。要找到记录数据的位置，首先用风向测量仪看风往哪个方向吹，然后用这些测量结果推算出风不在哪里。

english: This statue needs to go on the other plinth.
translation: 这个雕像需要放在另一个基座上。

english: This stone seems to have strange markings on it.
translation: 这块石头上似乎有奇怪的标记。

english: This stone seems to have strange markings on it. Maybe Trufitus can decipher them? THe stone is too heavy to carry but the letters stand proud on a plaque. Maybe you could seperate the plaque from the rock?
translation: 这块石头上似乎有奇怪的标记。也许特鲁菲图斯能解读它们？石头太重搬不动，但字母清晰地刻在一块牌匾上。也许你能把牌匾从石头上分离下来？

english: This strange-looking gate is covered in mysterious symbols. Weirdly, the handle is a glass orb.
translation: 这扇奇怪的门上覆盖着神秘的符号。奇怪的是，门把手是一个玻璃宝珠。

english: This table might be useful with some adjustment.
translation: 这张桌子调整一下也许有用。

english: This tendon is very springy and stretchy.
translation: 这根肌腱非常有弹性和延展性。

english: This thread looks like it could be used to augment a rune pouch.
translation: 这根线看起来可以用来强化一个符石袋。

english: This tonic can be used to remove rust from Meaty Aura Logist's weather station when helping her to chart weather patterns in the sea. It can also be used to remove rust from swords.
translation: 这种补剂可以用来去除米蒂.奥拉.洛吉斯特气象站的锈迹，帮助她绘制海上的天气模式。它也可以用来去除剑上的锈。

english: This totem pole is truly awe inspiring. It depicts powerful Karamjan animals. It is very well carved and brings a sense of power and spiritual fulfillment to anyone who looks at it.
translation: 这根图腾柱真是令人敬畏。它描绘了强大的卡拉玛贾动物。雕刻得非常精美，给任何看到它的人带来一种力量感和精神上的满足感。

english: This totem pole looks corrupted. You don't like to look at it for too long.
translation: 这根图腾柱看起来被腐化了。你不想盯着它看太久。

english: This treat has a hard exterior and a gooey centre, delicious!
translation: 这个点心外壳坚硬，内馅软糯，美味极了！

english: This tree is a bit too far down the path. I should look for one closer to Oziach.
translation: 这棵树离路有点太远了。我应该找一棵离奥扎克近一点的。

english: This very exciting! So many strange chefs!
translation: 太令人兴奋了！这么多奇怪的厨师！

english: This walkway looks dangerous. Are you sure you want to take this path?
translation: 这条人行道看起来很危险。你确定要走这条路吗？

english: This wardrobe is full of old costumes.
translation: 这个衣柜里装满了旧戏服。

english: This wardrobe stinks - and the door won't stay open!
translation: 这个衣柜臭死了——而且门还关不上！

english: This was a great event! I can't wait to go back to Varrock and introduce this dog to the family!
translation: 这是个很棒的活动！我等不及要回维洛克城把这只狗介绍给家人了！

english: This whistle requires a knife and one set of redwood logs.
translation: 这个哨子需要一把刀和一组红杉原木。

english: This whistle requires a knife and one set of willow logs.
translation: 这个哨子需要一把刀和一组柳木原木。

english: This whistle requires a knife and one set of yew logs.
translation: 这个哨子需要一把刀和一组紫杉原木。

english: This will consume the scroll.
translation: 这将消耗掉这张卷轴。

english: This will consume your armour seed as well as your crystal shards. Reverting the helmet will not give you any crystal shards back.
translation: 这将消耗掉你的盔甲种子和水晶碎片。还原头盔不会返还任何水晶碎片。

english: This will do nicely! I can bang the rolling pin and saucepan together.
translation: 这正好合用！我可以把擀面杖和平底锅敲在一起。

english: This will play a cutscene that is quite long that you can't exit out of.
translation: 这将播放一段相当长的过场动画，期间你无法退出。

english: This workbench is too complicated. You need instructions to follow.
translation: 这个工作台太复杂了。你需要照着说明书来操作。

english: This would be useful for cooking the meal for the generals. I could probably use some of the ingredients I found.
translation: 这可以用来给将军们做饭。我大概能用上我找到的一些食材。

english: This'll end well, I'm sure.
translation: 我敢肯定，这会有好结果的。

english: This? This is a cape of skill mastery, worn by those who have achieved true cabbage picking enlightenment.
translation: 这个？这是技能大师披风，只有那些真正领悟了摘卷心菜真谛的人才能穿。

english: Thish ish the life [player name].
translation: 这才叫生活啊，[player name]。

english: Thordur hands you a disk of returning.
translation: 索杜尔递给你一个回归圆盘。

english: Thordur likes to hide between the planes of acceptance. You will not find him using convential adventuring. Thankfully, I can teleport you directly too him.
translation: 索杜尔喜欢躲在接纳位面之间。用常规的冒险方式是找不到他的。幸好，我可以直接把你传送到他那里。

english: Thordur resides in a distant plane. To reach him you'll need to activate this from the mines beneath Falador.
translation: 索杜尔住在一个遥远的位面。要找到他，你得在法拉多城地下的矿场里激活这个。

english: Thordur told me that we need to make an offering to the altar. We need to decypher the item required from the riddle.
translation: 索杜尔告诉我，我们需要向祭坛献上祭品。我们必须从谜语中解读出所需的物品。

english: Thorkel Silkbeard hands you [amount] coins.
translation: 索克尔.丝须递给你[amount]枚金币。

english: Thorkel Silkbeard hands you an empty money bag, which bears the symbol of King Sorvott IV.
translation: 索克尔.丝须递给你一个空钱袋，上面有索沃特四世国王的徽记。

english: Thorkel Silkbeard takes [six/seven/eight] lumps of [tin/coal/mithril].
translation: 索克尔.丝须拿走了[six/seven/eight]块[tin/coal/mithril]。

english: Those Eggs have been really busy blighters down there, though.
translation: 不过，那些蛋在下面可真是些忙碌的小捣蛋鬼。

english: Those [X] black ones should keep you busy for a bit next trip.
translation: 那些[X]个黑色的家伙，下次够你忙活一阵子了。

english: Those are eggs left over from last year - I can't give them out!
translation: 那些是去年剩下的蛋——我可不能把它们发出去！

english: Those are voices; a spoken riddle. Solving the riddle will tell you what you need to offer to the altar in order for the ritual to work.
translation: 那些是声音，一个口述的谜语。解开谜语就会告诉你需要向祭坛献上什么，仪式才能生效。

english: Those colours sound familiar. Have you by any chance already got seeds for red, orange and green flowers?
translation: 这些颜色听起来很耳熟。你该不会已经有红色、橙色和绿色花的种子了吧？

english: Those hooligans really shouldn't be hanging around, won't somebody please think of the children.
translation: 那些小混混真不该在这闲逛，难道就没人替孩子们想想吗？

english: Those items you're carrying, Your Royal Highness, are they for Jack?
translation: 殿下，您身上带的那些东西，是给杰克的吗？

english: Those magical cleaning potions are good at what they do!
translation: 那些魔法清洁药水干起活来可真有一套！

english: Those presents have given the chicken the ability to teleport out of reach of anyone who attempts to capture it. Unless someone can startle the chicken into relinquishing all the presents, Easter's going to flop.
translation: 那些礼物让这只鸡拥有了传送能力，可以躲开任何试图抓住它的人。除非有人能吓唬这只鸡，让它放弃所有礼物，否则复活节就要搞砸了。

english: Those stairs don't look so safe...
translation: 那些楼梯看起来不太安全……

english: Those that subscribe to mine ideology do not deny the existence, power, nor the role of the other deities upon this land; they see that all are necessary to fulfill the required roles, and in their own way also serve the cause of balance. Mine power is based upon the movements of the planets, the balance of life and death and the wisdom of nature. I hath no need for followers, yet appreciate those who search for truth in mine actions.
translation: 信奉我理念的人，并不否认其他神祇在这片土地上的存在、力量或角色；他们认为所有神祇都是履行必要职责所必需的，并且都以自己的方式服务于平衡之道。我的力量基于行星的运行、生与死的平衡以及自然的智慧。我不需要追随者，但我欣赏那些在我的行动中寻求真理的人。

english: Those wall lamps are to die for.
translation: 那些壁灯真是美得让人想死。

english: Those were some amazing moves Pete, thankfully the mugger was stopped!
translation: 皮特，那些动作真是太棒了，幸好抢劫犯被制止了！

english: Those were some eggcelent moves there Party Pete! Thanks a bunch!
translation: 派对皮特，那些动作真是蛋彩绝伦！非常感谢！

english: Those who do not believe in Big High War God, whether they goblins or other races, must die.
translation: 那些不信奉至高战神的人，无论是地精还是其他种族，都必须死。

english: Those who serve under me must first prove they are worthy! Now, answer my question.
translation: 在我手下效力的人，必须先证明自己的价值！现在，回答我的问题。

english: Thou mayest have noticed that there hath been a minor explosion in the quantity of runes available throughout the world recently. I hath been informed that a lost skill hath been resurrected, but I know not the reason why this secret hath now been shared, nor the purpose for which those behind this discovery plot towards.
translation: 你可能已经注意到，最近世界上可用的符文数量发生了一次小小的爆炸。我得知一项失传的技能已被复兴，但我不知道这个秘密为何现在被分享，也不知道那些发现背后的人图谋什么目的。

english: Thou mayst consider a journey to the agility arena secreted upon Brimhaven, for thou willst be able to purchase Toad-flax there.
translation: 你不妨考虑前往布尔哈文镇隐藏的敏捷竞技场一游，因为在那里你可以买到蟾蜍亚麻。

english: Thou repeat thyself, but I do not.
translation: 你在重复自己，但我不会。

english: Thou should make thy choice according to thine own nature; in truth thou do not make the choice at all, for thine own morality hath already made it long ago. This is the way balance is preserved, and I will not try and influence thy choice one way or the other.
translation: 你应该根据自己的本性做出选择；事实上，你根本没有做出选择，因为你的道德观早已替你做出了选择。这就是平衡得以维持的方式，我不会试图以任何方式影响你的选择。

english: Though I feel a strange presence in these caves, it is with the heart of a lion that I fight my fears and mark the magical octagram of binding.
translation: 虽然我感觉到这些洞穴里有一种奇怪的存在，但我仍以狮子般的心战胜恐惧，并标记出束缚的魔法八角星。

english: Though I haven't yet heard back.
translation: 虽然我还没收到回音。

english: Though you think you have defeated Evil Chicken, Evil Chicken has been rummaging in your mind. Evil Chicken is analysing your brain patterns for man-thoughts that will aid him in his quest for domination.
translation: 虽然你以为自己打败了邪恶鸡，但邪恶鸡一直在你的脑海里翻找。邪恶鸡正在分析你的大脑模式，寻找能帮助它实现统治野心的人类思维。

english: Though, I do find myself missing them now. Maybe I should get a dog of my own?
translation: 不过，我现在确实有点想念它们了。也许我该自己养条狗？

english: Though, perhaps we should talk again when you have space to carry them...
translation: 不过，也许等你身上有地方装它们的时候，我们再谈吧……

english: Thread drops to ground with full inventory
translation: 背包已满，线掉到了地上。

english: Thread of Elidinis to augment your rune pouch. This process is reversible at any time and the thread will be returned.
translation: 伊莉迪尼斯之线可以强化你的符石袋。这个过程随时可以逆转，并且线会被归还。

english: Three each? How are you guys going to eat three each?
translation: 每人三个？你们每人怎么吃得下三个？

english: Three?! How do you know this? How do you know what quest I am on? Are you trying to beat me to the reward?!
translation: 三个？！你怎么知道的？你怎么知道我在做什么任务？你是想抢在我前面拿到奖励吗？！

english: Throne room and more.
translation: 王座室等等。

english: Through my connections, I managed to acquire a horn-less Unicorn!
translation: 通过我的关系，我设法弄到了一只没有角的独角兽！

english: Through some careful handywork, you manage to put together a Christmas tree costume.
translation: 经过一番细心的手工活，你成功拼凑出了一套圣诞树服装。

english: Through telepathic communication, the Queen is able to determine the number of each class of Penance (Fighter, Ranger, Healer or Runner) and communicate to her spawn the form they should take on to fill any gaps in numbers. If the spawn receives no communication from a Queen, it turns into a Queen itself, because
translation: 通过心灵感应交流，女王能够确定各类赎罪者（战士、射手、治疗者或跑者）的数量，并告知她的幼体应该变成什么形态来填补数量空缺。如果幼体没有收到女王的任何信息，它就会自己变成女王，因为

english: Through the power of alchemy.
translation: 通过炼金术的力量。

english: Throw snowballs!
translation: 扔雪球！

english: Throw the water!
translation: 泼水！

english: Thunk
translation: 咚

english: Thurgo eats the pie.
translation: 瑟戈吃掉了馅饼。

english: Thurgo gives you an Uncut emerald!
translation: 瑟戈给了你一颗未切割的绿宝石！

english: Thurgo gives you some banknotes that can be exchanged for herbs.
translation: 瑟戈给了你一些可以兑换草药的票据。

english: Thurgo gives you some coins.
translation: 瑟戈给了你一些金币。

english: Thurgo gives you some runes.
translation: 瑟戈给了你一些符石。

english: Thurgo pats his stomach.
translation: 瑟戈拍了拍他的肚子。

english: Thy question is flawed, for it depends entirely upon circumstance.
translation: 你的问题有缺陷，因为它完全取决于具体情况。

english: Tiadeche hands you his first catch!
translation: 蒂亚德切把他第一次的渔获递给了你！

english: Tiadeche trains you in fishing technique.
translation: 蒂亚德切训练你的钓鱼技巧。

english: Ticking - it's an ornamental clock
translation: 滴答声——这是一个装饰钟。

english: Tiger.
translation: 老虎。

english: Tigers
translation: 老虎

english: Time fo the games to begin! You can start by going through that portal.
translation: 游戏时间到了！你可以先穿过那个传送门开始。

english: Time for third question.
translation: 该问第三个问题了。

english: Time for your rewards!
translation: 该给你奖励了！

english: Time to find some things to make a scary noise with...
translation: 是时候找些东西来制造吓人的声音了……

english: Time to get my groove on.
translation: 是时候嗨起来了。

english: Time to head to the monastery again and find Iffie.
translation: 是时候再去修道院找伊菲了。

english: Time to look and see what ingredients I can find in the cupboard.
translation: 是时候看看橱柜里能找到什么食材了。

english: Time to sneak out back to [player name]. I hope the chef hasn't killed [him/her] yet!
translation: 是时候溜回去找[player name]了。希望厨师还没把[him/her]干掉！

english: Time to turn it up a notch.
translation: 是时候再加把劲了。

english: Timfraku hands you a big stack of gold coins.
translation: 蒂姆弗拉库递给你一大叠金币。

english: Timor metus formido pavor hic senex lusit unum lusit knickknackum apud me...
translation: 恐惧、畏惧、惊骇、恐慌，这个老家伙在我这里玩了一个小玩意儿……

english: Timor metus formido pavor... Well, I don't know what that means, but it sounds jolly scary. Let's see how the story goes...
translation: 恐惧、畏惧、惊骇、恐慌……好吧，我不知道那是什么意思，但听起来挺吓人的。我们看看故事怎么发展吧……

english: Tin tack's full guv.
translation: 锡钉满了，老大。

english: Tina giggles and signs your card.
translation: 蒂娜咯咯笑着，在你的卡片上签了名。

english: Tindel gives you [number] coins.
translation: 廷德尔给了你[number]枚金币。

english: Tindel gives you a black longsword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把黑铁长剑。

english: Tindel gives you a black sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把黑铁剑。

english: Tindel gives you a bronze long sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把青铜长剑。

english: Tindel gives you a bronze sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把青铜剑。

english: Tindel gives you a long sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把长剑。

english: Tindel gives you a mithril long sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把秘银长剑。

english: Tindel gives you a mithril sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把秘银剑。

english: Tindel gives you a new, old mattress!
translation: 廷德尔给了你一张新的旧床垫！

english: Tindel gives you a steel long sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把钢制长剑。

english: Tindel gives you a steel sword.
translation: 廷德尔给了你一把钢剑。

english: Tinnitus
translation: 耳鸣

english: Tinsay hands you a Karambwan vessel crafting manual.
translation: 廷赛递给你一本卡拉姆班鱼笼制作手册。

english: Tips on raising magic eh? Well, I have a couple...
translation: 提升魔法的技巧？嗯，我有几个建议……

english: Tithe Farm, Fossils, Mahogany homes, Volcanic Mine, Warriors Guild Tokens, Guardians of the Rift pearls, Giants Foundry, Rogues Den, Trouble Brewing, Tai Bwo Wannai Trio Cleanup, Mining Minerals, Shooting Star Dust, Molch Pearls, Agility Arena Tickets, Hallowed Sepulchre, Tempoross, Mixology, Forestry and Vale Totems.
translation: 什一税农场、化石、桃花心木房屋、火山矿场、战士公会代币、裂隙守护者珍珠、巨人铸造厂、盗贼巢穴、酿酒大战、泰博瓦纳三重奏清理、采矿矿物、流星尘埃、莫尔奇聚落珍珠、敏捷竞技场门票、神圣墓穴、海灵、调酒学、林业和山谷图腾。

english: To Lord Handelmort, Handelmort Mansion, Ardougne.
translation: 致阿多尼城汉德尔莫特庄园的汉德尔莫特勋爵

english: To [player name], with love – Your secret admirer.
translation: 致[player name]，爱你的——你的秘密仰慕者。

english: To all those with learning and supernatural powers, who with book and rune spend the long dark hours. If further challenges you would endure, give me a taste of your power so pure.
translation: 致所有拥有学识和超自然力量，以书和符石度过漫长黑暗时光的人。若你愿承受更多挑战，就让我品尝你那纯粹的力量。

english: To be fair, it was pretty awkward when you asked me out as well.
translation: 平心而论，你约我的时候也挺尴尬的。

english: To be frank, mate, I'd say you're already at the top of your game. Still, I guess I can probably chuck a few pointers your way. Let's have a butchers...
translation: 老实说，哥们，我觉得你已经登峰造极了。不过，我想我还是可以给你指点几招。让我瞧瞧……

english: To be honest I wasn't even sure how to take it off properly...
translation: 说实话，我甚至不确定该怎么正确地把它脱下来……

english: To be honest, I'm a bit busy - tell you what, help me with this and I'll go.
translation: 说实话，我有点忙——这样吧，你帮我搞定这个，我就走。

english: To be honest, matey, I didn't really want te host the fishin' contest. I just wanted te get a tan!
translation: 说实话，老兄，我其实不想主持钓鱼比赛。我只是想晒个日光浴！

english: To charge the ring of shadows, you will need soul runes, death runes, blood runes and law runes. Runes inside a pouch will not work.
translation: 要给阴影之戒充能，你需要灵魂符石、死亡符石、血符石和律法符石。放在符石袋里的符石无效。

english: To check sea depths, you'll need to find a mermaid in the ocean, don some diving gear and then answer her puzzle. She'll then guide you down to the bottom of the sea for you to document your findings.
translation: 要测量海洋深度，你需要在海里找到一条美人鱼，穿上潜水装备，然后回答她的谜题。之后她会引导你到海底，让你记录你的发现。

english: To chop the hespori, you'll need an axe that you have the Woodcutting level to use.
translation: 要砍伐赫斯波里，你需要一把你伐木等级能用的斧头。

english: To do so, I accept the fact that I will lose all my stats and items.
translation: 为此，我接受我将失去所有属性和物品的事实。

english: To each their own, I guess.
translation: 我想，各有所好吧。

english: To earn powerful rewards for Grid Master, and Grid Points for Main Game Cosmetics.
translation: 为网格大师模式赚取强力奖励，以及为主游戏外观赚取网格点数。

english: To find Lucien, Thaerisk suggested we capture one of his Spies from Draynor Village. As such, I planted a Teleorb given to me by Akrisae on one of them. He then used this Teleorb to teleport the Spy into a cell.
