translation: 为了找到卢西安，赛里斯克建议我们从德雷诺村抓一个他的间谍。于是，我把阿克里赛给我的一个传送宝珠放在其中一个间谍身上。然后他用这个传送宝珠把那个间谍传送到了一个牢房里。

english: To get points you simply have to put the gingerbread in your hopper.
translation: 要获得积分，你只需把姜饼放进你的料斗里。

english: To keep their skin stretched out nice and tight.
translation: 为了让他们的皮肤保持紧绷光滑。

english: To make some more Truth Serum, I prepared an Enriched Snapdragon Seed and planted it in a Specially Prepared Patch on the roof of the White Knights' Castle. While waiting for it to grow, I recruited Turael, Mazchna, Duradel and Cyrisus to our cause.
translation: 为了制作更多的吐真剂，我准备了一颗超级金鱼草种子，并把它种在白骑士城堡屋顶上一个特别准备好的苗圃里。在等待它生长的同时，我招募了图拉尔、马斯纳、杜拉德尔和西里苏斯加入我们的事业。

english: To make the legs, first assemble the two part Ds. Be aware that they should make a wide 'V' shape.

translation: 从巨魔山脉的山顶进入隧道，并找到了穿过隧道进入堡垒的路。在里面我遇到了阿拉夫。他被泽莫雷加尔叫走了，但离开前，他指引我找到了藏在挂毯后面的计划书。我应该把这些计划书带给乌泽绿洲的伊莱亚斯。

translation: 从巨魔山脉的山顶进入隧道，并找到了穿过隧道进入堡垒的路。在里面我遇到了阿拉夫。他被泽莫雷加尔叫走了，但离开前，他建议我去调查堡垒里的一幅挂毯。

translation: 图拉尔、马斯纳和杜拉德尔。除了他们，我们还想让你招募一位名叫西里苏斯的伟大战士。

translation: 暮光神殿，目睹了梅兹莉在恩纽斯和富里亚的陪同下向她的追随者发表演讲。演讲期间，伊茨拉被从神殿正下方的地牢里带了出来。我应该探索这个地牢，看看能发现什么。

english: Twilight Temple east of Quetzacalli Gorge and met with Itzla outside the Tower of Ascension. While we wait to be called up to take our Recruitment Tests, Itzla suggested I speak to the other Recruits.
translation: 奎察卡利峡谷东边的暮光神殿，并在飞升之塔外与伊茨拉会面。在等待被叫上去进行招募测试的同时，伊茨拉建议我和其他新兵谈谈。

english: Twilight Temple east of Quetzacalli Gorge and met with Itzla outside the Tower of Ascension. While we waited to be called up to take our Recruitment Tests, I spoke with the other Recruits. One of them told me the Emissaries had a new leader called the Augur. I should discuss this with Itzla.
translation: 奎察卡利峡谷东边的暮光神殿，并在飞升之塔外与伊茨拉会面。在等待被叫上去进行招募测试的同时，我和其他新兵聊了聊。其中一人告诉我，使者们有了一位新领袖，名叫预言者。我应该和伊茨拉讨论一下这件事。

english: Twilight's Promise and the Final Dawn.
translation: 暮光之约和最终黎明。

translation: 扭曲弓。你确定吗？此操作不可逆。

translation: 两袋应该绰绰有余了，谢谢你。

english: Two huge metal doors bar the way forward. There is an intense and unpleasant feeling from this place and as you peer through the cracks in the door you see why.
translation: 两扇巨大的金属门挡住了去路。这个地方散发出一种强烈且令人不快的感觉，当你透过门缝窥视时，便明白了原因。

english: Two of the bankers attempt to restrain the Wise Old Man as the third hides in a corner
translation: 两名银行职员试图制服老智者，而第三名则躲在角落里

english: Two parts of hydrogen to one part of oxygen. I hath used this recipe before, I know that it works.
translation: 两份氢和一份氧。我以前用过这个配方，我知道它有效。

english: Two. I've always liked two. It's small, simple, and doesn't play any tricks.
translation: 二。我一直喜欢二。它小巧、简单，而且不会耍什么花招。

english: Two? That's great. May I have them?
translation: 两个？太好了。能给我吗？

translation: 乌艾

translation: 呃！一只脏老鼠。

translation: 唉，就没一件事是简单的，对吧？

translation: 呃……这可能是任何一个守卫，大多数都没有军衔！

translation: 乌格卢格.纳尔给了你一张挑战卷轴！

translation: 乌格卢格.纳尔又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Uh hu.

translation: 嗯哼……是啊……效果不错。

translation: 哎呀，我也最好赶紧离开这里！

translation: 哎呀。他听起来很生气。

english: Uh, [player name]... One small question. What about payment? Show me the money.
translation: 呃，[player name]……一个小问题。报酬呢？让我看看钱。

english: Uh, he- hello? Death?! What are you doing here?
translation: 呃，他——喂？死神？！你在这儿干嘛？

english: Uh, yeah well I need you to see something. I've been conducting surveillance on the Wise Old Man.
translation: 呃，好吧，我需要你看点东西。我一直在监视老智者。

english: Uh, yeah, my friend gave it to me...
translation: 呃，是啊，我朋友给我的……

translation: 呃，是的，抱歉！我忘了那件事！

translation: 呃。那听起来更像是首关于你自己的诗……我想我得拒绝了。

translation: 呃……迪亚戈。你戴的帽子是不是把耳朵堵住了？你在这儿听不到吗？小精灵们在仓库那儿抗议呢。

english: Uh.. what happened to the rest of the crest?
translation: 呃……徽章的其他部分呢？

translation: 呃……我觉得你从一开始就没有眉毛。

translation: 呃呃呃。我觉得他用的是大红龙锤。

translation: 顺便一提，终极铁人玩家不像其他玩家那样使用墓碑，所以他们不被允许向死神的保险箱献祭物品来支付费用。

translation: 乌尔托、贝拉托、维纳托和玛古斯之戒。

translation: 嗯……我回去把他带来，让他告诉你。

translation: 嗯……既然你提到了，我确实是来寻求帮助的。

translation: 嗯……关于练习农业的记忆？我想我们通常都是从耙地开始的，所以我给你一把耙子。

translation: 嗯，那个麻袋。我们叫它偷蛋袋，因为蛋在里面打盹！

translation: 在被告知马塞勒斯的要求后，青蛙们决定举行选举来选出他们的领袖。然而，其中两只青蛙，苏和加里告诉我，另一只青蛙卡斯伯特打算在获胜后宣战。为了防止这种情况发生，我破坏了他的选举跳台睡莲叶。

translation: 维蒂达带你穿过贫民区。

english: Very clean indeed. You didn't tell my squire that I know about the armour did you?
translation: 确实很干净。你没告诉我的侍从我知道盔甲的事，对吧？

english: Very clever. How long do you think it will take?
translation: 真聪明。你觉得要花多久？

english: Very forgetful, why can't I remember? Hmm... you could help me! Then I'll attend that birthday bash.
translation: 真健忘，我怎么就想不起来呢？嗯……你可以帮我！这样我就能去参加那个生日派对了。

english: Very funny. Har, har.
translation: 真好笑。哈，哈。

english: Very good! Let's get started then.
translation: 很好！那我们开始吧。

english: Very good. I have achieved everything that I set out to achieve.
translation: 很好。我原本想达成的目标都已经实现了。

english: Very good. In that case, complete the tasks you have been presented with and we can arrange some appropriate enhancements.
translation: 很好。既然如此，完成交给你的任务，我们就可以安排一些适当的强化。

english: Very good. Now I need you to get it turned into a costume. Thessalia ought to be able to help. She runs the Varrock clothes shop.
translation: 很好。现在我需要你把它做成一套戏服。塞萨利亚应该能帮忙，她在维洛克经营一家服装店。

english: Very interesting. If you suspect potions may be involved then I believe the apothecary in Varrock might be your best point of contact.
translation: 真有趣。如果你怀疑涉及药水，我认为维洛克的药剂师可能是你最好的联络人。

english: Very nice, thank you. It's a remarkable island you have here.
translation: 太好了，谢谢你。你这座岛真是了不起。

english: Very sorry, I misunderstood.
translation: 非常抱歉，我误会了。

english: Very well thank you. I can't decide if I want some gingerbread gnomes or mulled wine!
translation: 很好，谢谢。我拿不定主意是想要一些姜饼侏儒还是热红酒！

english: Very well, I will be here when you are ready.
translation: 很好，我就在这里等你准备好。

english: Very well, from now on you will be known as [player name].
translation: 很好，从现在起，你将被称为[player name]。

english: Very well, release her and let's see what she can do.
translation: 很好，放开她，让我们看看她能做什么。

english: Very well, thank you! It's a lot easier to get things done when you don't have a pack of dogs trying to dig up the soil under your feet.
translation: 很好，谢谢你！没有一群狗在你脚下拼命挖土，做事轻松多了。

english: Very well. Do enjoy yourself, adventurer.
translation: 很好。好好享受吧，冒险者。

english: Very well. You will now gain XP again. Speak to me if you wish to disable it.
translation: 很好。你现在将再次获得经验值。如果你想禁用它，就跟我说话。

english: W-What do you mean?

english: WHAT!? How? No, this can't be happening!?
translation: 什么！？怎么可能？不，这不可能发生！？

english: WHY YOU LITTLE...
translation: 你这个小……

translation: 你这坨没用的鼻涕，为什么这样对我？

english: Waaaaaiiiiiiiit!
Wahisietel leads the garrison at Senntisten.
translation: 瓦希塞特尔领导森提斯滕的驻军。

english: Wait a few years?
translation: 等几年？

english: Wait a minute... Thanks? That's it?
translation: 等一下……谢谢？就这样？

english: Wait a minute... this jug is half empty!
translation: 等一下……这个罐子是半空的！

english: Wait a second, is that why these goblins think they are dead? Maybe they don't remember what happened?
translation: 等等，这就是这些哥布林以为自己死了的原因吗？也许他们不记得发生了什么？

english: Wait a second. Dave? Evil Dave?
translation: 等一下。戴夫？邪恶戴夫？

english: Wait a second. How do you know what I need help with?
translation: 等一下。你怎么知道我需要什么帮助？

english: Wait a second... Where did that Christmas tree come from?
translation: 等一下……那棵圣诞树是从哪来的？

english: Wait a second... is this your...
translation: 等一下……这是你的……

english: Wait another [number] minutes before coming back in. You clearly need a break from pumping.
translation: 再等 [number] 分钟再回来。你显然需要从泵送工作中休息一下。

english: Wait for me! Oh, he's already gone.
translation: 等等我！哦，他已经走了。

english: Wait thats not dirt, its chocolate.
translation: 等等，那不是泥土，是巧克力。

english: Wait wait wait! I haven't told you what the plan is!
translation: 等等等等！我还没告诉你计划是什么！

english: Wait wait wait. Are you absolutely sure she's after you specifically and she's not just singing that song because it's festive? Does she follow you at other times of the year?
translation: 等等等等。你确定她是在针对你，而不是因为过节才唱那首歌？她在一年中的其他时间也会跟着你吗？

english: Wait wait wait. Nobody said anything about hard labour...
translation: 等等等等。没人说过要干苦力……

english: Wait! Can you hear this?
translation: 等等！你听到了吗？

english: Wait! Don't go in there! Something terrible has happened! We need to talk, urgently!
translation: 等等！别进去！出大事了！我们得谈谈，很紧急！

english: Wait! Hold on... Thank you for all your hard work [player name].
translation: 等等！等一下……[player name]，感谢你所有的辛勤付出。

english: Wait! I created those flavour profiles!
translation: 等等！那些风味配方是我创造的！

english: Wait! I have something to add.
translation: 等等！我有些话要补充。

english: Wait! I know what happens now. You're going to run off and leave me behind to join you later.
translation: 等等！我知道接下来会发生什么。你会跑掉把我丢下，然后晚点再来找我。

english: Wait! Just because we can't have a dinner, doesn't mean we can't do something else!
translation: 等等！不能吃晚餐，不代表我们不能做点别的！

english: Wait! Just because we can't have a toffee apple, doesn't mean we can't do something else!
translation: 等等！不能吃太妃糖苹果，不代表我们不能做点别的！

english: Wait! That one doesn't need harvesting!
translation: 等等！那个还不需要收割！

english: Wait! There is one other thing.
translation: 等等！还有一件事。

english: Wait! They could be listening at this very moment!
translation: 等等！他们现在可能正在偷听！

english: Wait! What about Diango? He's always making presents and might be able to help you out?
translation: 等等！迪亚戈呢？他总是在做礼物，也许他能帮你？

english: Wait! What's this on the floor? Another letter? That's my dad's handwriting!
translation: 等等！地上这是什么？又一封信？那是我爸爸的笔迹！

english: Wait, I'm not here to cause trouble, I want to help.
translation: 等等，我不是来找麻烦的，我是来帮忙的。

english: Wait, did I just grab you lunch?
translation: 等等，我刚才是不是拿了你的午餐？

english: Wait, if this monkey wasn't bothering you then why were you praying for help?
translation: 等等，如果这只猴子没烦你，那你为什么在祈祷求助？

english: Wait, is that monkey asleep?
translation: 等等，那只猴子睡着了吗？

english: Wait, that's not what I meant...
translation: 等等，我不是那个意思……

english: Wait, those are my feet? I thought they are grass.
translation: 等等，那是我的脚？我还以为是草。

english: Wait, wait! Can I also get seeds and things delivered?
translation: 等等，等等！我也可以订购种子之类的东西送货上门吗？

english: Wait, what colour are you about to put in?
translation: 等等，你打算放什么颜色进去？

english: Wait, what is that?!
translation: 等等，那是什么？！

english: Wait, what? You never mentioned this.
translation: 等等，什么？你从没提过这个。

english: Wait, where did everybody go?!
translation: 等等，人都去哪了？！

english: Wait, why bother? I know how to cast ice spells! I can do this myself!
translation: 等等，何必那么麻烦？我知道怎么施放冰系法术！我自己来就行了！

english: Wait, you don't even have an Uncooking skill.
translation: 等等，你连个反烹饪技能都没有。

english: Wait. If you have the eggs already, why not deliver them?
translation: 等等，既然你已经有蛋了，为什么不直接送过去？

english: Wait... That's illegal.
translation: 等等……那是违法的。

english: Wait... hold on. I know I put them somewhere.
translation: 等等……等一下，我记得我放在某个地方了。

translation: 走开

translation: 慢慢走开

translation: 现在就要情报？我可没空整天等你。

english: Warning! The Amulet of fury will consume your Blood shard to make the Amulet of blood fury and you won't be able to get it back.
translation: 警告！愤怒护符会消耗你的血之碎片来制作鲜血愤怒护符，你将无法取回它。

english: Warning! The tentacle will gradually consume your whip and destroy it. You won't be able to get the whip out again. The combined item is not tradeable.
translation: 警告！触手会逐渐吞噬你的鞭子并摧毁它。你将无法再取出鞭子。组合后的物品不可交易。

english: Warning! You're about to enter an instanced area. Anything left on the ground when you leave will be lost. Would you like to continue?
translation: 警告！你即将进入一个独立区域。离开时留在地上的任何物品都会丢失。是否继续？

english: Warped sceptres!
translation: 扭曲权杖！

english: Warrens?
translation: 沃伦斯？

english: Warriors' Guild Access
translation: 战士公会准入

english: Was Bob able to repair the tin?
translation: 鲍勃修好那个锡罐了吗？

english: Was I talking to you? I'm here for Private Alt [player name].
translation: 我在跟你说话吗？我是来找二等兵阿尔特 [player name] 的。

english: Was I talking to you? I'm here for Private Big [player name].
translation: 我在跟你说话吗？我是来找二等兵大个 [player name] 的。

english: Was I talking to you? I'm here for Private Really [player name].
translation: 我在跟你说话吗？我是来找二等兵真 [player name] 的。

english: Was I talking to you? I'm here for Private [player name] 0.
translation: 我在跟你说话吗？我是来找二等兵 [player name] 0 的。

english: Was I talking to you? I'm here for Private [player name] V2.
translation: 我在跟你说话吗？我是来找二等兵 [player name] V2 的。

english: Was I talking to you? I'm here for Private [player name].
translation: 我在跟你说话吗？我是来找二等兵 [player name] 的。

english: Was I talking to you? I'm here for Private l[player name].
translation: 我在跟你说话吗？我是来找二等兵 l[player name] 的。

english: Was Santa happy with the toys?
translation: 圣诞老人对那些玩具满意吗？

english: Was it ghosts? I bet it was ghosts.
translation: 是幽灵吗？我打赌就是幽灵。

english: Was it? I thought it went really well!
translation: 是吗？我觉得进行得很顺利啊！

english: Was there anything else you wanted help with?
translation: 还有其他需要帮忙的吗？

english: Was there anything else you wanted me to do?
translation: 还有其他事要我做的吗？

english: Washing your clothes in really hot water can shrink them. There must be somewhere that Santa washes his clothes around here.
translation: 用很热的水洗衣服会让衣服缩水。这附近一定有圣诞老人洗衣服的地方。

english: Watch where the adamant and the rune meet. We are looking for a silvery sheen.
translation: 注意精金和符文交汇的地方。我们在找一种银色的光泽。

english: Watching not good like doing.
translation: 光看不如动手。

english: Watchmen.
translation: 守卫。

english: Water Runes from each Essence.
translation: 每个精华都能产出水系符文。

english: Water is delightfully refreshing.
translation: 水真是令人神清气爽。

english: Waterbirth Island cliffside scale.
translation: 水诞岛悬崖边的鳞片。

english: Waterway
translation: 水道

english: Watson Alright, feel free to carry on using mine.
translation: 沃森 好吧，你尽管继续用我的。

english: Watson Here you go.
translation: 沃森 给你。

english: Watson I'm not giving it away for free, 500 coins is just covering my expenses!
translation: 沃森 我可不会免费送给你，500金币只是收回我的成本！

english: Watson It lets you view any of your S.T.A.S.H units that you have built around Gielinor.
translation: 沃森 它可以让你查看你在吉列诺各地建造的任何S.T.A.S.H储藏柜。

english: Watson No, but I could write down the instructions to make one. Then all you'd need is a house with a study to build it in, and a bolt of cloth.
translation: 沃森 不，但我可以写下制作说明。然后你只需要一所有书房的房子来建造它，以及一卷布卷。

english: Watson Well it's just a board with some notes on it. I'm sure you could figure something out.
translation: 沃森 嗯，这只是一块上面有些笔记的板子。我相信你能想出办法的。

english: Watson You don't have enough space for it.
translation: 沃森 你没有足够的空间放它。

english: Watson hands you a master scroll box.
translation: 沃森递给你一个大师卷轴盒。

english: Waymottin hands you a replica of the squad sigil.
translation: 韦莫廷递给你一个小队徽章的复制品。

english: We add the cinnamon because nobody likes a mouth full of cinnamon, not even stains!
translation: 我们加肉桂是因为没人喜欢满嘴肉桂味，连污渍都不喜欢！

english: We all appreciate your help. you did a cracking job!
translation: 我们都很感激你的帮助。你干得太棒了！

english: We also have a holiday promotion going on right now, where our pie is free for senior citizens!
translation: 我们现在还有节日促销活动，老年人可以免费吃我们的派！

english: We are no longer in the light of our leader but we are not directionless. On his return to the mountain he has sent down some... well, we're not sure who - or what - they are as they have horribly
translation: 我们不再沐浴在领袖的光芒下，但我们并非没有方向。在他回到山上后，他派下了一些……嗯，我们不确定他们是谁——或者是什么——因为他们可怕地

english: We are performing our annual summer ritual to Guthix.
translation: 我们正在向古斯举行一年一度的夏日仪式。

english: We are the Easter carrots...
translation: 我们是复活节胡萝卜……

english: We are the doubters! We are the outcasts! Society shunned us for it, but only those who question everything will ever find the truth.
translation: 我们是怀疑者！我们是弃儿！社会因此回避我们，但只有质疑一切的人才能找到真相。

english: We are trying to win, don't aim for me!
translation: 我们正努力赢呢，别瞄准我！

english: We came to celebrate longevity yet, as time passes, the end may draw nearer, bringing the ruination of all. But let us cheer; today we are still alive, and together we can defy the perils of the future.
translation: 我们来庆祝长寿，然而随着时间流逝，终结可能越来越近，带来万物的毁灭。但让我们欢呼吧；今天我们仍然活着，团结起来就能抵御未来的危险。

english: We can give you any past spooky things you don't already have. If you've lost something, Diango in Draynor Village can also help out!
translation: 我们可以给你任何你还没有的过去万圣节物品。如果你丢了什么东西，德雷诺村的迪亚戈也能帮忙！

english: We can make presents but now we have no one to manage deliveries and shipping... you've ruined Christmas!
translation: 我们可以做礼物，但现在没人管理配送和运输……你毁了圣诞节！

english: We can pick up a couple of combat mementos in the sword shop, just west of where you & I met.
translation: 我们可以在剑店里拿几件战斗纪念品，就在我们相遇的地方西边。

english: We can't use that. That's my friends name!
translation: 我们不能用那个。那是我朋友的名字！

english: We cannon them stupid guards and cover them in sticky paint.
translation: 我们用大炮轰那些蠢守卫，把他们涂满粘漆。

english: We certainly did! Gielinor is once again safe from that monster!
translation: 我们当然做到了！吉列诺再次摆脱了那个怪物的威胁！

english: We did a good job there, come and meet me over by Gilbert, west of Gertrude's house, so we can debrief.
translation: 我们干得不错，来吉尔伯特那边找我，就在格特鲁德家西边，我们好汇报一下情况。

english: We did it Jarvis!
translation: 我们成功了，贾维斯！

english: We didn't contractually agree upon any rewards before you agreed to help, and I'm not even certain that you did help.
translation: 在你同意帮忙之前，我们并没有在合同上约定任何报酬，而且我甚至不确定你是否真的帮了忙。

english: We do have more copies if you need another.
translation: 如果你还需要一份，我们确实还有更多副本。

english: We do have some gingerbread gnomes though
translation: 不过我们确实有一些姜饼侏儒

english: We do this in order to keep Gielinor in balance, as Guthix requests.
translation: 我们这样做是为了保持吉列诺的平衡，正如古斯所要求的那样。

english: We don't have long before the pride march to get these done... the stress doesn't help.
translation: 在骄傲游行之前，我们没多少时间完成这些了……压力一点用都没有。

english: We don't know what the eggs of Ayaster are really like.
translation: 我们不知道阿亚斯特的蛋到底是什么样的。

english: We don't know yet. These goblins are dressed up as ghosts, they think they're dead and... It's all very confusing.
translation: 我们还不知道。这些地精打扮成幽灵，他们以为自己死了……这太令人困惑了。

english: We don't know, but we're hoping to find out!
translation: 我们不知道，但我们希望能查出来！

english: We flower-traders talk, you know!
translation: 我们花商之间会互通消息，你知道的！

english: We forget about that every year.
translation: 我们每年都会忘记那件事。

english: We go back a few centuries, after all, he and I are both skeletal figures in black, and our work leaves us with relatively small social circles.
translation: 我们认识几个世纪了，毕竟，他和我都是穿着黑衣的骷髅形象，我们的工作让我们的社交圈相对较小。

english: We go back a few centuries, so I was tolerant, but the situation is now unacceptable. He smells like a corpse, forever rambles on about his conspiracy theories, and now he's eaten all the trapped souls in my refrigerator.
translation: 我们认识几个世纪了，所以我一直很容忍，但现在的情况已经无法接受了。他闻起来像具尸体，永远在喋喋不休地讲他的阴谋论，现在他还吃光了我冰箱里所有被困的灵魂。

english: We goblins lost all trust in all you stupid humans! Get away from us!
translation: 我们地精对你们这些愚蠢的人类彻底失去了信任！离我们远点！

english: We got them the seeds so that they could plant them together, thinking maybe the shared activity would nudge them into taking the first step!
translation: 我们给他们买了种子，这样他们就能一起种花，想着也许共同的活动能促使他们迈出第一步！

english: We have an array of ingredients available all over the island, what flavour are you looking to create?
translation: 我们在岛上各处都有各种食材可用，你想创造什么口味？

english: We have bowls of treats we keep to treat Trick-or- Treaters. We left the bowls outside the shop so the Trick-or-Treaters wouldn't come in and frighten the customers.
translation: 我们准备了几碗糖果来招待不给糖就捣蛋的人。我们把碗放在店外，这样他们就不会进来吓到顾客了。

english: We have loose animals in there that may be dangerous to an inexperience hunter like yourself.
translation: 里面有一些散养的动物，可能对你这样经验不足的猎人来说很危险。

english: We have storage chests in the factory, you should start there.
translation: 工厂里有储物箱，你应该从那里开始。

english: We have to go back?!
translation: 我们得回去？！

english: We haven't been yet. We have to wait until later since dad wants to come with us.
translation: 我们还没去过。得等晚点，因为爸爸想和我们一起去。

english: We hid the egg mould near a drain. If you want to know more you'll need to ask my brothers.
translation: 我们把鸡蛋模具藏在一个排水沟附近。如果你想知道更多，得去问我兄弟们。

english: We in second week and phase of Goblin advances.
translation: 我们正处于地精攻势的第二周和第二阶段。

english: We insult the food!
translation: 我们侮辱食物！

english: We interrupt this harrowing scene with a soothing picture of a kitten. Please do not think about what happened to Ulina - she found peace.
translation: 我们打断这个悲惨的场景，插播一张舒缓的小猫图片。请不要去想乌莉娜遭遇了什么——她找到了安宁。

english: We interrupt this insult to bring you this soothing picture of a kitten. Normal service will be resumed shortly. Thank you for your patience.
translation: 我们打断这次侮辱，为您带来这张舒缓的小猫图片。正常服务将很快恢复。感谢您的耐心等待。

english: We lost it. Can we have another?
translation: 我们弄丢了。能再给一个吗？

english: We lost the autographed flyer.
translation: 我们弄丢了那张亲笔签名的传单。

english: We lost the chart.
translation: 我们弄丢了那张图表。

english: We lost the recipe book.
translation: 我们弄丢了那本食谱。

english: We love Uncle Eric!
translation: 我们爱埃里克叔叔！

english: We love you lots. Mum. P.S. The dog misses you too.
translation: 我们非常爱你。妈妈。附言：狗也很想你。

english: We make it, of course! We have the ingredients already, we only need a churn to make it in!
translation: 我们当然会做！我们已经有了食材，只需要一个搅拌器来做！

english: We managed to recover this paint gun from a dead Goblin, so we're using their weaponary against them.
translation: 我们从一个死掉的地精身上找到了这把油漆枪，所以我们在用他们的武器对付他们。

english: We need a few items, and then we combine them using a secret recipe. I have the recipe here, but sadly none of the items.
translation: 我们需要几样物品，然后用一个秘密配方把它们组合起来。我这里有配方，但遗憾的是没有那些物品。

english: We need blood stains on the walls! Can you go to the farm south of Falador? They slaughter their own livestock, and I'm sure the shopkeeper there will be able to supply some cow blood.
translation: 我们需要墙上有血迹！你能去法拉多城南边的农场吗？他们自己屠宰牲畜，我相信那里的店主能提供一些牛血。

english: We need more decorations in here. There ought to be cobwebs on the walls.
translation: 这里需要更多装饰。墙上应该有蜘蛛网。

english: We need seeds for a Beautiful Yellow Pansy, a Tenacious Indigo Iris, and a Quality Violet Tulip.
translation: 我们需要一株美丽黄色三色堇、一株坚韧靛蓝鸢尾和一株优质紫色郁金香的种子。

english: We need seeds for a Legendary Red Rose, a Gorgeous Orange Lily, a Beautiful Yellow Pansy, a Tenacious Indigo Iris, and a Quality Violet Tulip.
translation: 我们需要一株传奇红色玫瑰、一株华丽橙色百合、一株美丽黄色三色堇、一株坚韧靛蓝鸢尾和一株优质紫色郁金香的种子。

english: We need some help freezing this bucket of camel milk!
translation: 我们需要帮忙把这桶骆驼奶冻起来！

english: We need to get to the crash site.
translation: 我们得赶到坠机地点。

english: We need to harvest the incorrect pumpkins.
translation: 我们需要收获错误的南瓜。

english: We need to plant the correct seeds.
translation: 我们需要种下正确的种子。

english: We offer him me. Ever since our last encounter I am sure he wants some revenge.
translation: 我们把我献给他。自从上次相遇后，我确信他想报复。

english: We priests are glad that we could help make up for our errors. Apologies again, hopping one.
translation: 我们这些祭司很高兴能帮忙弥补我们的错误。再次道歉，跳跃者。

english: We refilled again and this time hid very carefully. For a while nothing happened. Charlie came by, but he only took a couple of sweets before strolling back.
translation: 我们再次装满，这次藏得非常小心。有一阵子什么都没发生。查理路过，但他只拿了几颗糖果就溜达回去了。

english: We refilled the bowls and waited, but we must have been too visible. Everyone was behaving perfectly. We went to sit back and the sweets vanished once again!
translation: 我们重新装满碗并等待，但我们一定太显眼了。每个人都表现得很好。我们刚坐回去，糖果又消失了！

english: We seek wisdom, but find platitudes. We seek the far north, but find latitudes. We seek leadership, but find attitudes.
translation: 我们追寻智慧，却只得到陈词滥调。我们追寻极北之地，却只找到纬度。我们追寻领导力，却只看到态度。

english: We shall not be taking the Easter Bunny's eggs away any more.
translation: 我们不会再拿走复活节兔子的蛋了。

english: We should have a wicked birthday bash more often - see you around!
translation: 我们真该多办几次这么棒的生日派对——后会有期！

english: We should relocate it.
translation: 我们应该把它搬走。

english: We should visit Aubury, in his rune shop in the south- east of the city.
translation: 我们应该去拜访奥伯里，他的符文店在城市的东南边。

english: We suspect there's a Goblin uprising on the horizon and the Goblins are sending spies to seek out weak spots in the city.
translation: 我们怀疑哥布林即将发动叛乱，他们正派遣间谍寻找城里的薄弱之处。

english: We thought some nice flowers might help things along a bit. They've both loved Quality Violet Tulips ever since they worked a stint on the same farm together.
translation: 我们觉得送些漂亮的花或许能帮上点忙。自从他们一起在同一个农场工作过之后，两人就一直很喜欢优质紫色郁金香。

english: We travelled to the jungle and a battlefield and encountered many dangers before meeting some knights of Falador.
translation: 我们穿越丛林和战场，历经重重危险，最后才遇到了一些法拉多城的骑士。

english: We tried a few styles, and it turns out the beard just wasn't me. But this new hairstyle? It's powerful yet manly.
translation: 我们试了几种造型，结果发现胡子真的不适合我。但这个新发型呢？既霸气又充满男子气概。

english: We want to interrogate them and find out what they're up to!
translation: 我们想审问他们，搞清楚他们在搞什么鬼！

english: We were looking forward to some lovely easter eggs, weren't we sweetykins?
translation: 我们本来很期待一些可爱的复活节彩蛋的，对吧，小甜心？

english: We won remember, it was a win win!
translation: 我们赢了，记住，这是双赢！

english: We won't actually be using a real sword, just a prop, so it doesn't need to be made from metal. Gather some normal logs and carve the sword using a knife.
translation: 我们实际上不会用真剑，只是个道具，所以不需要用金属做。收集一些普通原木，用小刀雕刻成剑就行了。

english: We work in a factory making Christmas presents, we used to love our work but this year our boss has turned into a corporate machine and is making us work crazy hours.
translation: 我们在工厂里制作圣诞礼物，以前我们很喜欢这份工作，但今年老板变成了一个冷酷的机器，逼我们没日没夜地加班。

english: We'll dat's da fing wiv da hatsies, dey's many hatsies for da many chompies dat you stick. But you's godda get at least this many for a hat.
translation: 俺说啊，帽子这事儿吧，你插多少只鸟就有多少种帽子。但要做一顶帽子，你至少得弄这么多只。

english: We'll have to try something else, perhaps a new gift could make her feel differently.
translation: 我们得试试别的办法，也许换个新礼物能让她改变想法。

english: We'll hold on to it for you!
translation: 我们会替你保管好的！

english: We'll miss you, but this is your chance to go and find yourself out in the world. You'll always be welcome home but I get the feeling it might be a while before you're back.
translation: 我们会想你的，但这是你出去闯荡、寻找自我的机会。家里永远欢迎你，但我有种感觉，你可能要过一阵子才会回来。

english: We'll need to harvest all the incorrect pumpkins and plant new ones. However I don't think we can fix anything without dealing with the crows first.
translation: 我们需要把所有不对的南瓜都收掉，然后种新的。不过，我觉得不先解决那些乌鸦，什么都修不好。

english: We'll start you off hunting TzHaar, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀特扎尔，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting TzTok-Jad, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀特兹托克.贾德，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting ankou, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀昂骷，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting bandits, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀强盗，你需要杀死 [number] 个。

english: We'll start you off hunting bats, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀蝙蝠，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting bears, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀熊，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting birds, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀鸟，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting black demons, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀黑恶魔，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting black dragons, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀黑龙，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting blue dragons, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀蓝龙，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting bronze dragons, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀青铜龙，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting catablepon, you'll need to kill [number] of them.
translation: 我们先让你去猎杀凯塔勒蓬，你需要杀死 [number] 只。

english: We'll start you off hunting chaos druids, you'll need to kill [number] of them.

english: We'll take the hat!
translation: 我们要这顶帽子！

english: We're getting there.
translation: 我们快到了。

english: We're going to need something to keep the eggs once they're made.
translation: 蛋做好之后，我们得有个东西来装它们。

english: We're going to scare Fear?
translation: 我们要去吓唬恐惧本身？

english: We're happy of course to help the hopping one again in the future!
translation: 我们当然很乐意以后再次帮助那位蹦蹦跳跳的朋友！

english: We're having some sort of infestation down here. The chocolate's gone mad! Please come down to my office and help me. There's a reward.
translation: 我们这里出了点虫害。巧克力都疯了！请到我办公室来帮帮我。有报酬的。

english: We're making them in factory! You'll have to find out what kind of gift would be suitable though!
translation: 我们在工厂里做呢！不过你得弄清楚什么样的礼物才合适！

english: We're nearly done now, blessings to you for your aid!
translation: 我们快完成了，感谢你的帮助，愿神保佑你！

english: We're not sure...
translation: 我们不太确定……

english: We're okay just very tired, our boss has been working us very hard this year.
translation: 我们还好，只是很累，老板今年把我们使唤得太狠了。

english: We're so sad that there are no eggs for us, aren't we sweetykins?
translation: 没有蛋给我们，我们好伤心啊，对吧，小甜心？

english: We're still working on directions for you, why not chat to Annie whilst you wait?
translation: 我们还在帮你查路线，不如趁等待的时候跟安妮聊聊天？

english: We're talking about an unprecedented event here! All experts on the totem were lost. We had to make assumptions!
translation: 我们说的可是史无前例的大事！所有研究图腾的专家都失散了。我们只能靠猜测！

english: We're terribly sorry for all the trouble we've caused.
translation: 对于造成的所有麻烦，我们深感抱歉。

english: We're watching you, you know.
translation: 我们可盯着你呢，你知道的。

english: We're working out some difficulties.
translation: 我们正在解决一些难题。

english: We've also just redecorated the place for the holidays.
translation: 我们刚为节日重新装饰了这里。

english: We've got five cakes to judge today, so let's get right into it!
translation: 今天有五块蛋糕要评判，我们直接开始吧！

english: We've got more work to do, let's get a move on!
translation: 我们还有更多工作要做，赶紧行动起来吧！

english: We've pushed the goblins back after weeks of pressure, now to finish them off!
translation: 经过数周的施压，我们已将哥布林击退，现在该彻底解决他们了！

english: We've received reports of a gang [in location]! They're meeting [in location].The full list of messages is documented on the tackle organised crime page.
translation: 我们收到报告，[in location]有一个帮派！他们正在[in location]集会。完整的信息列表记录在打击有组织犯罪页面上。

english: We, the inhabitants, have decided we'd like a bit more colour. It's very green!
translation: 我们这些居民决定，想要多一点色彩。这里太绿了！

english: Wear a fake one?
translation: 戴个假的？

english: Wear hat.
translation: 戴上帽子。

english: Wearing this cape will give you a PK skull.
translation: 穿上这件披风会让你获得PK头骨标记。

english: Wee-wee
translation: 嘘嘘

english: Weird! Those are sacred cabbages. Cabbages that have achieved true oneness with Brassica Prime.
translation: 奇怪！那些是神圣卷心菜。是与布拉西卡至尊达到真正合一的卷心菜。

english: Weirdly, nobody's managed to catch any fish yet...
translation: 奇怪的是，到现在还没人钓到过一条鱼……

english: Welcome back [player name]! Have you seen the furs I have today?
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]！你看到我今天带来的毛皮了吗？

english: Welcome back Mo, you've been gone a while. What happened at the museum?
translation: 欢迎回来，莫，你离开有一阵子了。博物馆那边发生了什么事？

english: Welcome back brother [player name]. It has been too long since last we spoke! The fish are really biting today!
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]兄弟。我们好久没说话了！今天的鱼真的很爱咬钩！

english: Welcome back brother [player name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]兄弟。在这里见到你总是很高兴！

english: Welcome back sister [player name]. It has been too long since last we spoke! The fish are really biting today!
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]姐妹。我们好久没说话了！今天的鱼真的很爱咬钩！

english: Welcome back sister [player name]. It is always a pleasure to see you here!
translation: 欢迎回来，[player name]姐妹。在这里见到你总是很高兴！

english: Welcome back to my domain.
translation: 欢迎回到我的领地。

english: Welcome back! Do you bring any news of your heroic deeds?
translation: 欢迎回来！你带来了什么英雄事迹的消息吗？

english: Welcome back! While I've got you, you remember the pumpkin field? Well, there's just one problem with it.
translation: 欢迎回来！趁你在这儿，你还记得那片南瓜地吗？嗯，它出了点问题。

english: Welcome back, Player. Floopa still needs time to rest and to think upon the meaning of that ship. May I suggest you come back later?
translation: 欢迎回来，玩家。弗卢帕还需要时间休息，思考那艘船的意义。我建议你过会儿再来？

english: Welcome back, what have you discovered?
translation: 欢迎回来，你发现了什么？

english: Welcome to Lumbridge! If you need some help, simply talk to the Lumbridge Guide. Look for the question mark icon on your minimap to find him.
translation: 欢迎来到仑桥镇！如果你需要帮助，只需和仑桥镇向导谈谈。在你的小地图上寻找问号图标就能找到他。

english: Welcome to my domain.
translation: 欢迎来到我的领地。

english: Welcome to the Sailing Alpha. To take full advantage of what's on offer, you might like to copy your main save on to this profile. To do so, just sign in to a regular world and use the convert option in the gameplay section of the settings menu.
translation: 欢迎来到航海Alpha测试。要充分利用这里提供的内容，你可能想把主存档复制到这个档案上。只需登录一个常规世界，然后在设置菜单的游戏部分使用转换选项即可。

english: Welcome to the quiz!
translation: 欢迎参加问答！

english: Welcome to the wilderness of Love.
translation: 欢迎来到爱的荒野。

english: Welcome to the world of trading my friend! Are you in or are you out?
translation: 欢迎来到交易的世界，我的朋友！你是入伙还是退出？

english: Welcome! Looking forward to this years festivities?
translation: 欢迎！期待今年的庆典吗？

english: Welcome, contestant. Not dead yet I see.
translation: 欢迎，参赛者。看来你还没死。

english: Well I can't take an imaginary coupon as payment.
translation: 我可不能收一张想象中的优惠券当报酬。

english: Well I did manage to catch something, but it's not exactly a prize-winning catch...
translation: 嗯，我确实钓到了一些东西，但算不上能获奖的渔获……

english: Well I did manage to defeat the demons and got these red spiky things...
translation: 嗯，我确实打败了恶魔，拿到了这些红色的尖刺东西……

english: Well I don't have a lot of space, so something small preferably. Though it needs to have lots of hair for me to practice new hairstyles on!
translation: 嗯，我地方不大，所以最好是小的。不过它得有很多头发，好让我练习新发型！

english: Well I don't think anybody was hurt at least... and the candle - it's lit.
translation: 嗯，至少我觉得没人受伤……而且那根蜡烛——它点着了。

english: Well I don't want to keep Santa waiting. I'll see you there. Merry Christmas!
translation: 我可不想让圣诞老人久等。我们那儿见。圣诞快乐！

english: Well I found a brooch underground...
translation: 嗯，我在地下找到了一枚胸针……

english: Well I guess you could say he is at peace...
translation: 嗯，我想你可以说他安息了……

english: Well I have been feeling a disturbance in the souls of the dead to be more specific.
translation: 嗯，更具体地说，我一直感觉到死者灵魂中的骚动。

english: Well I hope you enjoy yourself and....don't kill anyone?
translation: 嗯，我希望你玩得开心，而且……别杀人？

english: Well I just thought I'd say you're doing great work Santa.
translation: 嗯，我只是想说，圣诞老人，你干得很棒。

english: Well I never recalled promising you a reward.
translation: 嗯，我不记得答应过给你报酬。

english: Well I never...back in my day...
translation: 哎呀，我从来没见过……想当年……

english: Well I saw a ghost, so I decided to help them. It's kind of what I do.
translation: 嗯，我看到了一个幽灵，所以我决定帮帮他们。这算是我的老本行。

english: Well I suppose I can enjoy a party, but there's no one here.
translation: 嗯，我想我可以享受派对，但这里一个人都没有。

english: Well I suppose I could. What about you Eggus?
translation: 嗯，我想我可以。你呢，埃格斯？

english: Well I suppose that's only fair. Let's do it! Anything to right our wrongs!
translation: 嗯，我想这样才公平。我们干吧！只要能弥补我们的过错，什么都行！

english: Well I was originally sent to find you because of a ferret.
translation: 嗯，我最初被派来找你，是因为一只雪貂。

english: Well I wish you luck with whatever you are up to.
translation: 嗯，不管你在忙什么，祝你好运。

english: Well I won't pretend this isn't risky. But I have faith in [player name], here. [player name] first human to kill a vyre, and quite the vyre it was. Vanescula would be unwise to try anything.
translation: 好吧，我不会假装这没有风险。但我相信 [player name]。[player name] 是第一个杀死维尔吸血鬼的人类，而且那可不是个普通的维尔吸血鬼。瓦内斯库拉要是敢轻举妄动，那可就太不明智了。

english: Well I'm glad I did! The egg mould is back where it should be.
translation: 嗯，我很高兴我这么做了！鸡蛋模具回到了它该在的地方。

english: Well I'm not really sure what I expected. I hope I didn't contract any horrible diseases...
translation: 嗯，我也不太确定自己期待什么。希望我没染上什么可怕的疾病……

english: Well [player name], you're very smart, aren't you?
translation: 嗯，[player name]，你很聪明，对吧？

english: Well anyway, with that many spooks gone, and the tree de-rooted, the fairies should be able to take care of the rest of the job.
translation: 嗯，不管怎样，赶走了那么多幽灵，又拔掉了树根，剩下的工作妖精们应该能处理了。

english: Well apparently it's been stuck in a vial for some time, that might have something to do with it.
translation: 嗯，显然它被关在小瓶里有一阵子了，这可能跟这有关。

english: Well can you think of anything that might help me find him?
translation: 嗯，你能想到什么能帮我找到他的东西吗？

english: Well come and say hello, I don't bite!
translation: 过来打个招呼吧，我又不吃人！

english: Well dearie, appearances can be deceiving! Let me tell you a little story of my youth.
translation: 哎呀，亲爱的，外表是会骗人的！让我给你讲讲我年轻时的一个小故事。

english: Well done - you've got them all!
translation: 干得好——你全找到了！

english: Well done dear boy. Give it to me.
translation: 干得好，好孩子。把它给我。

english: Well done! You have finished mapping the Kharazi Jungle. Radimus Erkle will be pleased.
translation: 干得好！你已经完成了卡拉兹丛林的地图绘制。拉迪穆斯.厄克尔会很高兴的。

english: Well done! You've fixed the cannon! Better go and tell Captain Lawgof.
translation: 干得好！你修好了大炮！快去告诉劳戈夫船长。

english: Well done, they look great!
translation: 干得好，它们看起来棒极了！

english: Well done, you defeated the Earth Warrior Champion! Here's a reward for you.
translation: 干得好，你击败了土元素战士冠军勇士！这是给你的奖励。

english: Well done, you defeated the Ghoul Champion! Here's a reward for you.
translation: 干得好，你击败了食尸鬼冠军勇士！这是给你的奖励。

english: Well done, you defeated the Giant Champion! Here's a reward for you.
translation: 干得好，你击败了巨人冠军勇士！这是给你的奖励。

english: Well done, you defeated the Goblin Champion! Here's a reward for you.
translation: 干得好，你击败了哥布林冠军勇士！这是给你的奖励。

english: Well done, you defeated the Human Champion! Here's a reward for you.

english: Well done, you defeated the Imp Champion! Here's a reward for you.
translation: 干得好，你击败了小恶魔冠军勇士！这是给你的奖励。

english: Well done, you defeated the Imp Champion! This lamp will award you 1,600 XP in Slayer and Hitpoints.
translation: 干得好，你击败了小恶魔冠军勇士！这盏灯将奖励你1600点杀戮和生命值经验。

english: Well done, you defeated the Jogre Champion! Here's a reward for you.
translation: 干得好，你击败了乔格雷食人魔冠军勇士！这是给你的奖励。

english: Well done, you defeated the Lesser Demon Champion! Here's a reward for you.

english: Well done, you defeated the Zombie Champion! Here's a reward for you.

english: Well done, you defeated the Zombie Champion! This lamp will award you 2,400 XP in Slayer and Hitpoints.
translation: 干得好，你击败了僵尸冠军勇士！这盏灯将奖励你杀戮和生命值各 2,400 点经验。

english: Well done, you've completed a beehive. The bees can now be safely rehomed.
translation: 干得好，你完成了一个蜂箱。现在可以安全地把蜜蜂重新安置了。

english: Well done, you've made your first kill!Pass through the gate and talk to the combat instructor. He will give you your next task.
translation: 干得好，你完成了第一次击杀！穿过大门，去找战斗导师谈谈。他会给你下一个任务。

english: Well done. Next on the list is an appropriate costume for me, as I'm not going to pass for Santa in my current robes.
translation: 干得好。接下来要给我弄一套合适的服装，我穿这身袍子可冒充不了圣诞老人。

english: Well done. Your score is: [number]. For that score you will receive [number] Archery tickets.
translation: 做得好。你的分数是：[number]。根据这个分数，你将获得 [number] 张射箭券。

english: Well folks, that was an unexpected interruption to our show today. Unfortunately we're going to have to cut things short to clean up!
translation: 各位观众，今天的表演出了点意外插曲。很遗憾，我们得提前结束来收拾残局了！

english: Well go and do that then!
translation: 那就赶紧去办吧！

english: Well go and order some food! We don't have long before Oziach has finished buying the monastery!
translation: 那就去点些吃的吧！奥扎克快要把修道院买下来了，我们时间不多了！

english: Well honestly, neither option is appealing. I like my limbs where they are.
translation: 说实话，两个选项都不吸引人。我还想留着我的四肢。

english: Well human, where it?
translation: 喂，人类，它在哪？

english: Well i' 'as ter glow doesn't it?
translation: 呃，它总得发发光吧，不是吗？

english: Well if it isn't [player name]. I've heard of your exploits in the Lunar Isles!
translation: 哎呀，这不是[player name]吗。我听说过你在月岛上的事迹！

english: Well if it's a trick they're after, this should make you especially spooky!
translation: 如果他们想要的是恶作剧，那这个应该能让你显得特别吓人！

english: Well if you don't like trees, perhaps we could decorate something else. Is there something around here you think would make a good centrepiece?
translation: 如果你不喜欢树，也许我们可以装饰点别的。这附近有什么你觉得适合做中心装饰品的东西吗？

english: Well if you gave me a ferret I could take it back for you.
translation: 如果你给我一只雪貂，我可以帮你把它带回去。

english: Well if you like it, it's bound to go down well! Let's head back to Draynor and get this put up! 104--> 2-->
translation: 既然你喜欢，那肯定大受欢迎！我们回德雷诺把它挂起来吧！104--> 2-->

english: Well if you're good enough to save Easter, you will be good enough to beat me in Egg, Silk or Secateurs.
translation: 既然你能拯救复活节，那在蛋、丝绸或修枝剪上打败我也应该没问题。

english: Well it has to glow doesn't it?
translation: 它总得发发光吧，不是吗？

english: Well it is Christmas!
translation: 这可是圣诞节啊！

english: Well it is a very bad situation, we have to help them!
translation: 情况非常糟糕，我们必须帮助他们！

english: Well it is very difficult to remember, a whole single instruction...
translation: 要记住一整条指令可太难了……

english: Well it might have been me.
translation: 呃，可能是我干的。

english: Well it wasn't. Hold still whilst I extract your unfortunate victim.
translation: 可惜不是。别动，我来把你那个不幸的受害者弄出来。

english: Well it's all thanks to you, yes, I know what you did. But I'm better off for it, so I guess I can use some of the tricks I learned filling in for Santa to reward you.
translation: 这都多亏了你，是的，我知道你做了什么。不过我也因此受益，所以我想可以用一些代班圣诞老人时学到的把戏来奖励你。

english: Well it's quite a long story, are you sure you want to hear it now?
translation: 说来话长，你确定现在要听吗？

english: Well met [player name]. Do you want to return to Rellekka?
translation: 幸会，[player name]。你想回到雷勒卡城吗？

english: Well met, brother [player name]. It is always good to see your face in glorious Rellekka once more!
translation: 幸会，[player name]兄弟。再次在光荣的雷勒卡城看到你的脸总是很高兴！

english: Well met, sister [player name]. It is always good to see your face in glorious Rellekka once more!
translation: 幸会，[player name]姐妹。再次在光荣的雷勒卡城看到你的脸总是很高兴！

english: Well now that you mention it. I charge a mere twenty gold pieces for a dozen runes. Are you interested?
translation: 既然你提到了。我一打符文只收二十金币。有兴趣吗？

english: Well now, someone's clearly in the Halloween spirit! A deal's a deal! Here's your spooky pumpkin lantern.
translation: 哎呀，看来有人很有万圣节精神嘛！一言为定！这是你的幽灵南瓜灯笼。

english: Well of course, anything for my best customer! But I need to ask a favour of you in return.
translation: 当然可以，为了我最棒的顾客什么都行！不过作为回报，我需要你帮我一个忙。

english: Well of course. Sorry. I was just wondering, what is this place?
translation: 当然可以。抱歉。我只是好奇，这是什么地方？

english: Well she's been feeling down, she mentioned not being able to be with some guy called Romeo and her father has put her in charge of this years birthday party.
translation: 她一直心情不好，提到不能和一个叫罗密欧的家伙在一起，而且她父亲让她负责今年的生日派对。

english: Well show them to an empty table then.
translation: 那就带他们去空桌子吧。

english: Well sir, lord, erm, your highness...
translation: 呃，先生，大人，嗯，殿下……

english: Well some imps broke in here the other night and made off with a load of decorations, if they found out that they will disappear in a couple of weeks they might return and steal other things that might not.
translation: 前几天晚上有些小鬼闯进来偷走了一堆装饰品，如果它们发现这些东西几周后就会消失，可能会回来偷走其他不会消失的东西。

english: Well that certainly turned dark...
translation: 这话题可真是突然变得阴暗了……

english: Well that was disgusting! It had dirt, sticks and leaves in it! I do feel oddly invigorated though...
translation: 真恶心！里面有泥土、树枝和树叶！不过奇怪的是，我确实感觉精神焕发……

english: Well that's some of the eggs replaced, and the priests seem convinced of the error of their ways.
translation: 嗯，一些蛋已经放回去了，那些牧师似乎也相信他们做错了。

english: Well that's what I thought but as I left the museum I was approached by a hooded man who tried to take it from me!
translation: 我也是这么想的，但当我离开博物馆时，一个戴兜帽的男人靠近我，想把它抢走！

english: Well that's why he's called Party Pete. Now can I have the fuel please?
translation: 所以他才叫派对皮特。现在能把燃料给我了吗？

english: Well the boys never tell me anything, but it wouldn't surprise me if they have taken it.
translation: 那些小子从来不跟我说实话，不过就算真是他们拿的，我也不会惊讶。

english: Well the sun is not actually there, it's where it used to be!
translation: 太阳其实不在那里，它还在原来的位置！

english: Well then I guess that makes me your newest friend!
translation: 那么，我想我就是你最新的朋友了！

english: Well then, we'll have to get some more help. I've heard that powerful magicians gather inside the Ferox Enclave in the wilderness...
translation: 那么，我们得找更多帮手。我听说荒野里的费罗飞地聚集着强大的魔法师……

english: Well there was this spectral man who was wearing a scary mask. He seemed to be having some trouble with making this weird potion, so I decided to help him. I made the potion and used it on him, releasing him from
translation: 有个戴着可怕面具的幽灵男人，他似乎在制作一种奇怪的药水时遇到了麻烦，所以我决定帮他。我做好药水并用在他身上，把他从……中释放了出来。

english: Well they are still there for you to complete. You get nothing for completing them except the knowledge that you have done something cool.
translation: 它们还在那里等着你去完成。完成之后你什么也得不到，除了知道自己做了一件很酷的事。

english: Well this is all very strange, but it certainly fits the season!
translation: 这一切都很奇怪，但确实很应景！

english: Well three seem to be missing now!
translation: 嗯，现在好像少了三个！

english: Well we definitely need more colour around here. Thing is, those seeds are quite important to us.
translation: 我们这里确实需要更多色彩。问题是，那些种子对我们来说相当重要。

english: Well we have a slight problem...
translation: 呃，我们遇到了一点小麻烦……

english: Well we're nearly there, so let's get those eggs collected!
translation: 我们快到了，赶紧去收集那些蛋吧！

english: Well we've not tried it, of course. The risks...
translation: 当然，我们还没试过。风险太大了……

english: Well well well, if it isn't the champion of egg, silk or secateurs.
translation: 哎呀呀，这不是蛋、丝绸或修枝剪的冠军吗。

english: Well yes, actually I would like to ask about something else.
translation: 嗯，是的，其实我想问点别的事。

english: Well yes, you're doing a painting of it.
translation: 嗯，是的，你正在画它。

english: Well you can't come in anyway.
translation: 反正你也进不来。

english: Well you can't really do that. You see, when I say at peace, I kinda mean...dead.
translation: 这你可办不到。你看，我说安息，其实意思是……死了。

english: Well you were so good at helping us write them that surely you could also support us as we deliver them. Give us a moment to write some... Instructions.
translation: 你帮我们写这些写得这么好，那在我们送的时候肯定也能帮上忙。给我们点时间写一些……指示。

english: Well! Did I get the wrong end of the stick about that whistle... this is wonderous! This is... magical!
translation: 哇！看来我对那个哨子的理解完全错了……这太奇妙了！这简直是……魔法！

english: Well, 75 percent is more than a passing grade so we can't be too unhappy there.
translation: 嗯，百分之七十五已经超过及格线了，我们也不能太不满意。

english: Well, Hassan told me to meet him here. Guess I'll just wait...
translation: 嗯，哈桑让我在这里等他。看来我只能等着了……

english: Well, I assume you've got a job to do through all this... It did seem quite obvious.
translation: 嗯，我猜你在这整件事里是有任务在身的……这看起来很明显。

english: Well, I can assure you nobody else has come to me for advice yet. That fish will almost certainly be all you need to attain victory.
translation: 嗯，我可以向你保证，还没有其他人来找我讨教过。那条鱼几乎肯定就是你获胜所需的一切。

english: Well, I can think of a few ice spells I could use, but they're all a bit too dangerous for a bucket of milk.
translation: 嗯，我能想到几个可以用的冰系法术，但用来对付一桶牛奶都有点太危险了。

english: Well, I caught this fish. What do you reckon?
translation: 嗯，我抓到了这条鱼。你觉得怎么样？

english: Well, I definitely know what doesn't work...
translation: 嗯，我至少知道什么行不通……

english: Well, I do have an idea for a reward... hand out some eggs for me and I'll sort you out with something. Will you help?
translation: 嗯，我确实有个奖励的主意……帮我分发一些蛋，我就给你弄点好东西。你愿意帮忙吗？

english: Well, I don't know who would ever eat this, but it's certainly exciting and exotic!
translation: 嗯，我不知道谁会吃这个，但它确实令人兴奋又充满异国情调！

english: Well, I don't need a real dragon. Just something small, with 4 limbs and wings. Just so I can get the idea of a baby dragon. Hmm, perhaps we could put wings on you.
translation: 嗯，我不需要真龙。只要一个小东西，有四条腿和翅膀。这样我就能想象出幼龙的样子。嗯，也许我们可以给你装上翅膀。

english: Well, I don't really swab the deck with... Oh, never mind, please do go on!
translation: 嗯，我其实不用……来擦甲板。哦，算了，请继续说吧！

english: Well, I dunno... I s'pose nobody else has caught anythin' yet.
translation: 嗯，我不知道……我想还没人钓到任何东西吧。

english: Well, I forgot to mention that. It was indeed pink, but it's not anymore! And I did help him with it!
translation: 嗯，我忘了提那一点。它以前确实是粉色的，但现在不是了！而且我确实帮了他！

english: Well, I guess that depends on what is involved.
translation: 嗯，那得看具体要做什么了。

english: Well, I had better go back to the park. Thanks again, [player name]!
translation: 嗯，我最好回公园去了。再次感谢你，[player name]！

english: Well, I had that held safely away from the others! I'll give it a try now...
translation: 嗯，我把它安全地和其他东西分开放了！我现在就来试试……

english: Well, I heard there'd be a fishing contest 'round here, so I came to win it.
translation: 嗯，我听说这附近有钓鱼大赛，所以我来赢下它。

english: Well, I hope it's not too long before I see you again!
translation: 嗯，希望我们很快就能再见面！

english: Well, I hope you now know that not everyone is like that.
translation: 嗯，我希望你现在知道并非所有人都那样。

english: Well, I imagine you've gathered up quite a lot of stuff on your travels. Things you used for quests a long time ago that you don't need now. 1-->
translation: 嗯，我想你在旅途中收集了不少东西。那些很久以前做任务用过、现在不再需要的东西。1-->

english: Well, I just wanted to know where I could get some kind of jewellery around here.
translation: 嗯，我只是想知道这附近哪里能买到首饰。

english: Well, I managed to catch this tiny fish, but I'm not sure it'll win me the contest.
translation: 嗯，我好不容易抓到了这条小鱼，但我不确定它能让我赢得比赛。

english: Well, I might have done a thing or two to push Juliet into throwing it.
translation: 嗯，我可能做了点手脚，促使朱丽叶把它扔了。

english: Well, I might have run out of wood after I tried my hand at a little Construction, so I got my workers to take a little wood from Draynor Manor...
translation: 嗯，我试着搞了点建筑之后可能把木头用完了，所以就让我的工人从德雷诺庄园拿了一点木头……

english: Well, I might have something for you, but I need to see you've got the right enthusiasm!
translation: 嗯，我可能有点东西给你，但我得看看你有没有足够的热情！

english: Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words! I met some man earlier wot called himself [player name].
translation: 嗯，我见过更糟的。大多数经过这里的人类，他们的名字里全是数字和根本不是词的东西！我之前遇到个男的，他自称 [player name]。

english: Well, I seen worse. Most humans come through here, dey got names with like all numbers and things wot aren't even words! I met some woman earlier wot called herself [player name].
translation: 嗯，我见过更糟的。大多数经过这里的人类，他们的名字里全是数字和根本不是词的东西！我之前遇到个女的，她自称 [player name]。

english: Well, I suppose I can give you a few hints. First up, Death himself has plenty of creepy decorations. Next, the moving chair can be found in Draynor Manor, if you've got the spine to search it.
translation: 嗯，我想我可以给你一些提示。首先，死神本人有很多吓人的装饰品。其次，那把会动的椅子可以在德雷诺庄园找到，如果你有胆量去搜的话。

english: Well, I suppose I can let you keep that! It's always brought me luck!
translation: 嗯，我想我可以让你留着它！它一直给我带来好运！

english: Well, I suppose I never thought about that.
translation: 嗯，我想我从来没想过这个。

english: Well, I suppose that's possible. Scribe Eggulomunus the Lazy wasn't known for his eggsacting detail...
translation: 嗯，我想这有可能。懒惰的抄写员埃古洛穆努斯向来不以精确细致著称……

english: Well, I surely cannot deny you the cape now. There is of course a fee…
translation: 嗯，我现在当然不能拒绝给你披风。不过当然要收费……

english: Well, I understand you're a thief...
translation: 嗯，我知道你是个盗贼……

english: Well, I was meant to be delivering eggs, but I left it a bit late again this year...
translation: 嗯，我本来应该去送蛋的，但今年我又拖得有点晚了……

english: Well, I would hurry. Trade information tends to be rather time-sensitive.
translation: 嗯，我建议你快点。交易信息通常时效性很强。

english: Well, I would suggest going to collect it. That information could be very time-sensitive!
translation: 嗯，我建议你去取一下。那条信息可能时效性很强！

english: Well, I wouldn't put it that way...
translation: 嗯，我不会那么说……

english: Well, I'd best give you what you came for then.
translation: 嗯，那我最好把你想要的东西给你。

english: Well, I'd better get back to treating. Happy Halloween!
translation: 嗯，我最好回去继续发糖了。万圣节快乐！

english: Well, I'll leave you to your planning.
translation: 嗯，我就不打扰你计划了。

english: Well, I'm glad I could try and help at least. 127-->
translation: 嗯，至少我很高兴能试着帮上忙。127-->

english: Well, I'm glad this is almost over, see you around.
translation: 嗯，很高兴这事快结束了，回头见。

english: Well, I'm here now! Maybe I can go and get the seeds for you?
translation: 嗯，我现在来了！也许我可以去帮你拿种子？

english: Well, I'm not unseeing that any time soon.
translation: 嗯，我短时间内是忘不掉那画面了。

english: Well, I'm still in one piece. A good start.
translation: 嗯，我还完好无损。这是个好开始。

english: Well, I'm taking a huge gamble on this artifact being valuable. I'm willing to offer you a share of its final sale price.
translation: 嗯，我是在赌这件神器很值钱。我愿意分给你一部分最终售价。

english: Well, I've been known to be powerful from time to time. What can I do for you?
translation: 嗯，我偶尔也会展现一下实力。有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: Well, I've recently acquired an interesting artifact in a trade and would like to have it examined by a specialist at the Varrock Museum.
translation: 嗯，我最近在一次交易中得到了一件有趣的文物，想请维洛克城博物馆的专家鉴定一下。

english: Well, I... Err... Have come a long way to be here, Sir and... Err... Oh, who am I kidding. I've never defeated a criminal. I couldn't even tell my dad to his face that I was leaving home.
translation: 嗯，我……呃……大老远跑来这儿，先生……呃……唉，我装不下去了。我从来没打败过罪犯，甚至连离家出走都不敢当面跟我爸说。

english: Well, [player name], welcome to the essence mine.
translation: 嗯，[player name]，欢迎来到精华矿场。

english: Well, Santa left me a message that Diango has the key to his grotto, so firstly, please fetch the key, then we can see what kind of job awaits us.
translation: 嗯，圣诞老人给我留了消息，说迪亚戈有他洞穴的钥匙。所以，首先请你去拿钥匙，然后我们看看有什么任务等着我们。

english: Well, [player name], you've been a great help in making my wish a reality. Let me reward you. I hope you like pumpkins, because I have a lot of those going spare.
translation: 嗯，[player name]，你帮我实现了愿望，帮了大忙。让我好好奖励你。希望你喜欢南瓜，因为我有很多多余的可以给你。

english: Well, adventurer, this report has given me quite a bit to consider. I can certainly say you've more than earned this bait.
translation: 嗯，冒险者，这份报告让我思考了很多。我敢说你完全配得上这份诱饵。

english: Well, after I got the invite to this party, I thought for a bit, and I realised that I would like a dog, but if I was going to get a dog, I needed to make sure I could take care of it.
translation: 嗯，收到派对邀请后，我想了想，意识到我想要一只狗。但如果要养狗，我得先确保自己能照顾好它。

english: Well, after that cake it probably doesn't matter. As long as they keep baking from now on.
translation: 嗯，吃了那块蛋糕后，这大概也无所谓了。只要他们从现在开始继续烤就行。

english: Well, after this year, when I've amazed my niece and nephew with the best Halloween treat ever, no-one will call me boring again! But I need these chambers to be more atmospheric first.
translation: 嗯，等今年我用最棒的万圣节礼物让侄子和侄女大吃一惊之后，就再也没人敢说我无聊了！但我得先让这些房间更有气氛才行。

english: Well, all the drinks are behind the bar, not back here in the kitchen.
translation: 嗯，所有饮料都在吧台后面，不在后面的厨房里。

english: Well, are you sure?
translation: 嗯，你确定吗？

english: Well, around Christmas we tend to focus more on giving rather than receiving. We call it the gift of giving.
translation: 嗯，圣诞节期间，我们更注重给予而非接受。我们称之为‘给予的礼物’。

english: Well, as it happens I've been practicing making rings recently! Why?
translation: 嗯，巧了，我最近一直在练习做戒指！怎么了？

english: Well, as it turns out, I have yet to manage to grow a beard. Not for fault of trying, you know. I hear some people try their whole life and still can't.
translation: 嗯，结果我还是没能长出胡子。可不是没试过，你知道的。我听说有些人努力了一辈子也长不出来。

english: Well, as long as I can keep myself safe first!
translation: 嗯，前提是我得先保证自己的安全！

english: Well, at least that's that as sorted as it can be.
translation: 嗯，至少事情已经尽可能处理好了。

english: Well, aye, but it's the 9th year since we decided to start countin' here!
translation: 嗯，是啊，但这是我们决定开始在这里计数的第九年！

english: Well, can I get a job here?
translation: 嗯，我能在这儿找份工作吗？

english: Well, do you know the VAGUE AREA you lost it?
translation: 嗯，你知道你弄丢它的大致区域吗？

english: Well, do you want vengeance?
translation: 那么，你想要复仇术吗？

english: Well, either way, you seem perfect for me! I can't offer much, but I can promise we're gonna have the best adventures together!
translation: 嗯，不管怎样，你对我来说简直完美！我给不了太多，但我保证我们会一起经历最棒的冒险！

english: Well, everything was going to plan at the museum, the specialist examined the artifact and explained that it was actually part of an ancient and powerful, much larger stone.
translation: 嗯，博物馆那边一切按计划进行，专家检查了文物，解释说它实际上是一块古老而强大的巨型石头的一部分。

english: Well, feel free to stop by anytime that you wish [player name]. You are always welcome here!
translation: 嗯，随时欢迎你过来，[player name]。你在这里永远受欢迎！

english: Well, feel free to take your time. I need to gather some more ingredients for the final product.
translation: 嗯，慢慢来，别着急。我还需要收集一些最终产品的原料。

english: Well, first we have to... oh dear, that can't be right! Apparently we have to recharge the lead reindeer's nose?
translation: 嗯，首先我们得……哦天哪，这不对吧！看来我们得给领头驯鹿的鼻子充电？

english: Well, first you'll need to annoy it somehow. You'll need to have an axe with you when you do that, as you'll need it to attack the roots.
translation: 嗯，首先你得想办法激怒它。你得随身带把斧头，因为你需要用它来攻击树根。

english: Well, for Halloween last year, I was invited to a costume party.
translation: 嗯，去年万圣节，我被邀请去参加一个化装舞会。

english: Well, get a mooooooooooove on.
translation: 嗯，快点动起来吧。

english: Well, got to go... see you.
translation: 嗯，得走了……再见。

english: Well, have fun, and don't forget to take your medication!
translation: 嗯，玩得开心，别忘了吃药！

english: Well, have you offered to take a drink order yet?
translation: 嗯，你问过他们要喝什么了吗？

english: Well, haven't you already received your gift this year?
translation: 嗯，你今年不是已经收到礼物了吗？

english: Well, he also got angry and filled my house with coal.
translation: 嗯，他还生气了，往我家里塞满了煤。

english: Well, he clearly just doesn't like poetry.
translation: 嗯，他显然就是不喜欢诗歌。

english: Well, he seems happy with that!
translation: 嗯，他看起来对此很满意！

english: Well, he's taking a holiday.
translation: 嗯，他在休假。

english: Well, help me come up with a plan to get you out of here. They don't seem very open minded about this whole situation.
translation: 嗯，帮我想个办法让你离开这里。他们对这件事似乎不太开明。

english: Well, here we are! Lots of pumpkins to look at!
translation: 嗯，我们到了！好多南瓜可以看！

english: Well, here we are. Now all we need to do is get some planks. 0--> 100-->
translation: 嗯，我们到了。现在只需要弄些木板来。0--> 100-->

english: Well, how do you plan on doing that?
translation: 嗯，你打算怎么做？

english: Well, if there were, the dogs would have gotten to them already.
translation: 嗯，如果有的话，那些狗早就把它们抓到了。

english: Well, if we increase the flux via some bigonometry we should be able to create a dipolar ordnance grabber, or D.O.G., to fetch your balls.
translation: 嗯，如果我们通过一些三角学来增加通量，应该能制造出一个偶极子指令抓取器，简称D.O.G.，来取回你的球。

english: Well, if you cannot satisfy yourself in helping the event, perhaps you could satisfy yourself by partaking in it instead?
translation: 嗯，如果你无法通过帮助活动来满足自己，也许你可以通过参与其中来满足自己？

english: Well, if you change your mind, I'll be here.
translation: 嗯，如果你改变主意，我就在这儿。

english: Well, if you have an axe I'm sure when it swallows you, you'll be able to make short work of its roots.
translation: 嗯，如果你有斧头，我相信当它吞下你的时候，你很快就能解决它的树根。

english: Well, if you haven't already, you should speak to Kellan in the pub. He knows everything there is to know about deep sea trawling.
translation: 嗯，如果你还没去过，你应该去酒馆找凯兰谈谈。他对深海拖网捕捞无所不知。

english: Well, if you'd like, I know a few fire spells to warm you back up...
translation: 嗯，如果你愿意，我知道几个火焰法术可以帮你暖和起来……

english: Well, if you're sure! How do we do this then? What's the plan?
translation: 嗯，如果你确定的话！那我们该怎么做？有什么计划？

english: Well, if you've kept to the recipe eggzactly, it wouldn't be empty now, would it.
translation: 嗯，如果你严格按照食谱来做，它现在就不会是空的，对吧。

english: Well, in that case, I wish you good luck.
translation: 嗯，那样的话，祝你好运。

english: Well, it certainly will help... Now then, what did you want to know?
translation: 嗯，这肯定会有帮助……那么，你想知道什么？

english: Well, it is a competition, but I'd like to see someone win, and that isn't going to be me.
translation: 嗯，这是一场比赛，但我希望看到有人赢，而那个人不会是我。

english: Well, it is an amulet of duplication! It would be stupid not to have duplicates.
translation: 嗯，这可是复制护身符！不弄几个复制品才傻呢。

english: Well, it is nice to see you again. I hope you enjoy your time outside of Tirannwn.
translation: 嗯，很高兴再次见到你。希望你在提兰恩之外的地方过得愉快。

english: Well, it looks like we still have one left.
translation: 嗯，看来我们还剩一个。

english: Well, it seems like there are so many spooks attached to the wood, that the bits and pieces we made are floating about, totally packed with ghosts!
translation: 嗯，看来这木头上附着了好多幽灵，以至于我们做出来的那些零碎部件都飘起来了，里面塞满了幽灵！

english: Well, it seems that this wrench is just not holy enough to work. You should go and get it blessed.
translation: 嗯，看来这把扳手还不够神圣，无法工作。你应该去给它祝福一下。

english: Well, it's Easter, and I'm delivering Easter eggs as I always do. However I'm in a bit of a sticky situation.
translation: 嗯，今天是复活节，我像往常一样在送复活节彩蛋。不过我遇到了一点麻烦。

english: Well, it's a giant block of ice milk. I'm not sure what you expected.
translation: 嗯，这是一大块冰牛奶。我不知道你期望的是什么。

english: Well, it's a good thing the message was encoded. I can give you another copy. Do try to keep this one secure.
translation: 嗯，幸好信息是加密的。我可以再给你一份副本。请务必保管好这份。

english: Well, it's sort of like a big floating head, and it's making the dead walk around.
translation: 嗯，它有点像一个大浮头，让死者到处走动。

english: Well, luckily I have a few more. Don't misplace this one!
translation: 嗯，幸好我还有几个。别把这个弄丢了！

english: Well, most of the easter eggs have gone missing, and there isn't time to make more!
translation: 嗯，大部分复活节彩蛋都不见了，而且没时间再做新的了！

english: Well, my fingers are crossed! Especially if we need one to light the candle.
translation: 嗯，我祈祷好运！特别是如果我们需要用它来点蜡烛的话。

english: Well, naturally, if he sent you, you'll have no problems answering the security question then?
translation: 嗯，当然，既然是他派你来的，那你回答安全问题应该没问题吧？

english: Well, next year I can turn over a new leaf, spruce this room up and if I can think of something else funny to say I would...
translation: 嗯，明年我可以改过自新，把这房间装饰一新，如果我能想出什么有趣的话来说，我会说的……

english: Well, no, that's why we're out here and not in the Old Nite.
translation: 嗯，不，所以我们才在这儿，而不是在老奈特酒馆。

english: Well, not really a lot. We'll increase the number of guards posted at the entrances into town, but without knowing what we're looking for, we can't do much else.
translation: 嗯，其实没什么大不了的。我们会增加镇入口处的守卫数量，但不知道我们在找什么，我们也做不了别的。

english: Well, not that Ali will believe me, but that worked flawlessly.
translation: 嗯，虽然阿里不会相信我，但这招完美奏效了。

english: Well, now we have a bucket of camel milk, we just need to freeze it.
translation: 嗯，现在我们有一桶骆驼奶了，只需要把它冻起来。

english: Well, now we have the frozen camel milk, the only thing left to do is try it!
translation: 嗯，现在我们有了冷冻骆驼奶，唯一要做的就是尝尝它！

english: Well, now we have the machine, now we just need to cool it!
translation: 嗯，现在我们有了机器，只需要把它冷却下来！

english: Well, now you mention it... If we knew what Anti-Santa was up to, we could get a step ahead and put an end to his holiday ruining shenanigans once and for all.
translation: 嗯，既然你提到了……如果我们知道反圣诞老人在搞什么鬼，我们就能抢先一步，一劳永逸地终结他破坏节日的恶作剧。

english: Well, of course. Would you ignore someone that rubbed you?
translation: 嗯，当然会。你会无视一个蹭你的人吗？

english: Well, ok then.
translation: 嗯，那好吧。

english: Well, other than looking pretty snazzy, I hear there's some kind of fountain in the Heroes Guild that allows some kind of teleportation magic to be stored in the amulet. I can't really say much more than that, because I'm not a Hero and don't know anyone who is. Always found them very dull, self righteous Saradominist types to be honest; give me the high spirits of the Bandit camp any day!
translation: 嗯，除了看起来很时髦之外，我听说英雄公会里有个喷泉，可以把某种传送魔法储存在护身符里。我只能说这么多了，因为我不是英雄，也不认识任何英雄。老实说，我一直觉得他们都是些沉闷、自以为是的萨拉多明信徒；相比之下，我宁愿天天享受强盗营地的狂欢气氛！

english: Well, reminding Carol of the past and improving her present didn't work... we need to convince her the future will be better if she changes her ways.
translation: 嗯，让卡罗尔回忆过去和改善现状都没用……我们需要说服她，如果她改变方式，未来会更好。

english: Well, she does have an awful lot of cows to milk, I wonder if someone around town can help with this. Bob seems to have a lot of work cut out...
translation: 嗯，她确实有好多奶牛要挤奶，我想知道镇上有没有人能帮忙。鲍勃似乎有很多活要干……

english: Well, since you mention it, I'm looking for some festive holly.
translation: 嗯，既然你提到了，我正在找一些节日冬青。

english: Well, since you're so brave, would you be able to help me out by asking some of the locals about my melting chocolate issue?
translation: 嗯，既然你这么勇敢，你能帮我问问当地人关于我的巧克力融化问题吗？

english: Well, some gold would be nice.
translation: 嗯，有点金币就好了。

english: Well, thankfully it's a fairly simple recipe!
translation: 嗯，幸好食谱相当简单！

english: Well, that didn't work. I should talk to someone and see what I'm doing wrong.
translation: 嗯，那没用。我应该找个人问问，看看我哪里做错了。

english: Well, that looks bad... what do you want me to do?
translation: 嗯，看起来不妙……你想让我做什么？

english: Well, that seemed to fool them satisfactorily! Now that the silly pixies are back at work, you can go and pick up the presents.
translation: 嗯，看来成功骗过他们了！现在那些傻精灵回去工作了，你可以去拿礼物了。

english: Well, that was a lot of fun, I'll have to thank My Arm for the idea!
translation: 嗯，真是太有趣了，我得感谢‘我的手臂’出的主意！

english: Well, that was certainly more dramatic than I had hoped for.
translation: 嗯，这肯定比我预想的要戏剧化得多。

english: Well, that was close! I should get this churn to the Easter Bunny before my hands freeze off...
translation: 嗯，好险！我得趁手还没冻僵，把这个搅拌器送到复活节兔子那里……

english: Well, that wasn't too bad! And as a bonus, I think I have something for your help!
translation: 嗯，还不算太糟！而且作为奖励，我想我有点东西要给你，感谢你的帮助！

english: Well, that went horribly wrong. So this year, I thought to myself, Harvey, how are you going to deliver goodies to all the kids?
translation: 嗯，那真是糟透了。所以今年，我心想，哈维，你要怎么给所有孩子送礼物呢？

english: Well, that's Fred taken care of for Christmas.
translation: 嗯，弗雷德的圣诞节算是安排好了。

english: Well, that's a waste of time.
translation: 嗯，真是浪费时间。

english: Well, that's better than nothing! We'll go to Thessalia's! 56-->
translation: 嗯，总比没有好！我们去塞萨莉亚那里！56-->

english: Well, that's certainly one way to make it last forever.
translation: 嗯，这倒是个让它永远持续下去的好办法。

english: Well, that's everyone here matched to a dog...
translation: 嗯，这里的每个人都配上了一只狗……

english: Well, that's everyone. I guess I should head off the entrance on the west side of Ice Mountain.fact
translation: 嗯，人都到齐了。我想我应该去冰山西边的入口了。fact

english: Well, that's one way you could look at it. The other is that at my birth the doctor lost a finger and the midwife screamed in her every sleepless night until the end of her life...
translation: 嗯，你可以这么看。另一种看法是，我出生时医生断了一根手指，助产士在余生中每个不眠之夜都在尖叫……

english: Well, that's probably as close to a compliment I'm ever likely to get from you, so thanks!
translation: 嗯，这大概是我能从你那里得到的最接近夸奖的话了，所以谢谢！

english: Well, thats a relief.
translation: 嗯，真是松了一口气。

english: Well, the Duke has heard that you may have been looking into methods to safely trap monkeys.
translation: 嗯，公爵听说你一直在研究安全捕捉猴子的方法。

english: Well, the Easter Bunny needs to deliver some chocolate eggs to some adventurers deep in the desert.
translation: 嗯，复活节兔子需要给沙漠深处的一些冒险者送些巧克力蛋。

english: Well, the stuff mixes into a real nasty gunk and I'll never be able to get it off the walls.
translation: 嗯，这些东西混在一起变成了一团恶心的污垢，我永远也没法把它从墙上弄下来。

english: Well, the whole 'getting swallowed alive by a tree' thing isn't really selling this concept, but I think I know what I'm doing now.
translation: 嗯，被树活活吞掉这件事确实不太吸引人，但我想我现在知道该怎么做了。

english: Well, there is one issue.
translation: 嗯，有一个问题。

english: Well, there is part of the answer. We know it's hot enough to melt the normal one!
translation: 嗯，这就是答案的一部分。我们知道它热到足以熔化普通的那个！

english: Well, they were happy I was leaving the proverbial nest.
translation: 嗯，他们很高兴我离开那个所谓的安乐窝。

english: Well, this fish seems hilariously small. Still, if it's the only fish, there's a chance I can win the contest. I should show it to Larry.
translation: 嗯，这条鱼小得可笑。不过，如果只有这一条鱼，我还是有机会赢得比赛的。我应该把它拿给拉里看看。

english: Well, usually something goes wrong at these events and you need someone like me to help!
translation: 嗯，这种活动通常都会出点岔子，需要像我这样的人来帮忙！

english: Well, we certainly have a lot to think about.
translation: 嗯，我们确实有很多事情要考虑。

english: Well, we haven't really seen much of you over the past year.
translation: 嗯，过去这一年我们确实没怎么见到你。

english: Well, we moved back here from our main office on Wester Island, but due to budget cuts, we can't afford the transport costs.
translation: 嗯，我们从西斯特岛的总部搬回了这里，但因为预算削减，我们负担不起运输费用了。

english: Well, we need something for me to make scary noises with.
translation: 嗯，我们需要一些东西让我来制造恐怖的声音。

english: Well, we thought some new and unique flavours might do it, so my son Chocco has been investigating but he's not been able to find the right flavours.
translation: 嗯，我们觉得一些新奇独特的口味可能管用，所以我儿子乔科一直在研究，但他还没找到合适的口味。

english: Well, we've brought this sack along. It's specially designed to cancel out egg energy, or as we call it - eggnergy.
translation: 嗯，我们带来了这个麻袋。它是专门设计来抵消蛋能量的，或者我们称之为——蛋能。

english: Well, well, well. Here to bask in the warmth of my domain no doubt. Do not linger too long, you have much yet to do.
translation: 哎呀呀。无疑是来沐浴我领域温暖的吧。别逗留太久，你还有很多事要做。

english: Well, when you annoy it it'll shove you into it's mouth, and then you'll fall inside it.
translation: 嗯，你要是惹恼了它，它就会把你塞进嘴里，然后你就会掉进它肚子里。

english: Well, yeah, but it's all spooky fun!
translation: 嗯，是啊，但这都是惊悚的乐趣！

english: Well, yes, but what else?
translation: 嗯，是的，但还有别的吗？

english: Well, yes, we don't just grow crops here, whatever most of our visitors seem to think. We have cow blood.
translation: 嗯，是的，我们这里不只是种庄稼，不管大多数访客怎么想。我们有牛血。

english: Well, yes. Black cake would be burnt, which wouldn't be very nice.
translation: 嗯，是的。黑色的蛋糕会烤焦，那就不好吃了。

english: Well, you aren't mumbling jibberish any more. You seem much less...unstable.
translation: 嗯，你不再胡言乱语了。你看起来稳定多了……

english: Well, you can decorate with things you like. People typically use fairy lights and stockings, to name a few.
translation: 嗯，你可以用你喜欢的东西来装饰。人们通常会用到仙子灯和长袜，这只是举几个例子。

english: Well, you can get some camel milk. I'm going to stay here where it's cooler. I'm still a big fluffy bunny.
translation: 嗯，你可以去弄些骆驼奶来。我要待在这里，这里凉快些。我毕竟还是一只毛茸茸的大兔子。

english: Well, you certainly know how to party. I like that. I w[player name] help you, [player name].
translation: 嗯，你果然很懂怎么玩。我喜欢。我[player name]帮你，[player name]。

english: Well, you could simply give me the potion...
translation: 嗯，你直接把药水给我就行了……

english: Well, you don't need to be afraid of a little chocolate anymore.
translation: 嗯，你以后不用再怕一点巧克力了。

english: Well, you have something that lets you speak to ghosts, and I am a ghost.
translation: 嗯，你有能让你和幽灵说话的东西，而我就是个幽灵。

english: Well, you know that this time of year Santa travels the multiverse, judging children and adults alike for their behaviour and rewarding them accordingly?
translation: 嗯，你知道每年这个时候，圣诞老人都会穿越多元宇宙，评判孩子和大人的行为，并给予相应的奖励吗？

english: Well, you may have picked up some things from the rest of the order.
translation: 嗯，你可能从教团其他人那里学到了一些东西。

english: Well, you see, this is only the beginning. Now you are in the arena, may the trials begin!
translation: 嗯，你看，这还只是开始。现在你已进入竞技场，试炼开始吧！

english: Well, you take the Ghost Buster here, right...and you load it with a white destabiliser.
translation: 嗯，你拿着这个捉鬼器，对吧……然后装上白色去稳定器。

english: Well, you'll find a vat, wheel, washing line and wooden pole in the rubbish pile around the back. Zeke the scimitar merchant should be able to help you find some mixers.
translation: 嗯，你会在后面的垃圾堆里找到一个大桶、一个轮子、一根晾衣绳和一根木杆。卖弯刀的齐克应该能帮你找到一些搅拌器。

english: Well, you'll find out in time... Let's make a game out of this, ey?
translation: 嗯，你迟早会知道的……我们把这个当成一场游戏吧，嗯？

english: Well, you've completed the required quests. However, you also need to have 107 Quest points. Sorry to disappoint you, but you need [number] more quest points. They don't call it the Legends Guild for nothing you
translation: 嗯，你已经完成了所需的任务。不过，你还需要有107个任务点数。很抱歉让你失望了，但你还需要[number]个任务点数。传奇公会可不是白叫的。

english: Well. That's an experience I shall never forget!
translation: 嗯。那是我永远不会忘记的经历！

english: Well... As you wish.
translation: 嗯……如你所愿。

english: Well... Go on, then!
translation: 嗯……那就继续吧！

english: Well... I have this note, which will guarantee payment once Santa returns. Will that do?
translation: 嗯……我有一张欠条，等圣诞老人回来就能保证付款。这样可以吗？

english: Well... I suppose you've proved yourself.
translation: 嗯……我想你已经证明了自己。

english: Well... I was thinking I could get our poets drinking, at the very least.
translation: 嗯……我在想，至少能让我们的诗人喝上酒。
