translation: 凭什么由你来决定谁能保留他们的文物？

english: Why was everyone in the mines slaughtered?
translation: 为什么矿场里的人都惨遭杀害？

english: Why was your navigation chart spinning like that?
translation: 你的航海图为什么那样旋转？

english: Why were they punished again?
translation: 他们为什么又受罚了？

english: Why would I break into a house like this?
translation: 我为什么要闯进这样一栋房子？

english: Why would a goblin want to steal your hat?
translation: 哥布林为什么要偷你的帽子？

english: Why would there be cobwebs with no spiders here?
translation: 这里没有蜘蛛，怎么会有蜘蛛网？

english: Why would you want the Wise Old Man's hat?
translation: 你为什么要那个智慧老人的帽子？

english: Why would you want to destroy such good milk? Do you not wish to taste it?
translation: 你为什么要毁掉这么好的牛奶？难道你不想尝尝吗？

english: Why would you want to go back to jail?
translation: 你为什么要回监狱？

english: Why wouldn't it be you?
translation: 为什么不能是你？

english: Why wouldn't you be?
translation: 你怎么会不是呢？

english: Why yes I can! We go way back, used to be party buddies till he got a bad case of Doom. I've been writing to him and I've managed to get my hands on this summoning whistle that I think will do just the trick.
translation: 当然可以！我们交情很深，以前是派对老友，直到他得了严重的末日症。我一直给他写信，还搞到了这个召唤哨子，我觉得正好派上用场。

english: Why yes I have, here you go.
translation: 是的，我有，给你。

english: Why yes! These soft brown eggs are a powerful ill omen.
translation: 没错！这些软软的棕色鸡蛋可是个强大的凶兆。

english: Why yes, I do. But how would you know about the shipment?
translation: 没错，我确实知道。但你怎么会知道那批货的事？

english: Why yes, I found a green hat that would fit him perfectly.
translation: 是的，我找到了一顶绿色帽子，他戴起来肯定很合适。

english: Why you cheeky little.... Guards! Guards!
translation: 你这厚脸皮的小……卫兵！卫兵！

english: Why's this book all charred?
translation: 这本书怎么烧焦了？

english: Why, I do believe that you can...
translation: 哎呀，我确实相信你可以……

english: Why, are you looking for inspiration for next year?
translation: 怎么，你是在为明年找灵感吗？

english: Why, we're having a feast. I'm cooking while the kids have some fun with the gnomeball net.
translation: 我们在办盛宴呢。我在做饭，孩子们在玩地精球网。

english: Why, yes I am!
translation: 没错，我就是！

english: Why.. it's Old School RuneScape's first birthday! A year ago everything we see now was reanimated for this very community.
translation: 这……是Old School RuneScape的一周年生日！一年前，我们现在看到的一切都是为了这个社区而重生的。

english: Why? Did somebody tell you I do?!
translation: 怎么？有人告诉你我做了？！

english: Why? What does it do?
translation: 为什么？它有什么用？

english: Wilderness areas in this League.
translation: 本联赛中的荒野区域。

english: Wilderness from the God Wars
translation: 来自神战的荒野

english: Wilderness theme
translation: 荒野主题

english: Wilderness. There are no trees suitable to make a canoe there. You will have to walk back.
translation: 荒野。那里没有适合做独木舟的树。你得走回去。

english: Will Burntmeat reward me with burnt meat again?
translation: 烧肉会再奖励我烧焦的肉吗？

english: Will I be getting paid for this?
translation: 做这个有钱拿吗？

english: Will I get a pet today?
translation: 我今天能拿到宠物吗？

english: Will I keep all of my current items?
translation: 我会保留我当前所有的物品吗？

english: Will and Anne on the Port Sarim docks. They offered me a a job and asked me to join them on their Boat to discuss the details.
translation: 威尔和安妮在沙林港的码头。他们给了我一份工作，并让我上他们的船讨论细节。

english: Will and Anne on the Port Sarim docks. They offered me a a job and asked me to join them on their Boat to discuss the details. I should let them know when I'm ready to board the Boat.
translation: 威尔和安妮在沙林港的码头。他们给了我一份工作，并让我上他们的船讨论细节。我应该在他们准备好时告诉他们我要上船。

english: Will and Anne on the Port Sarim docks. They seemed uite keen on interviewing me for a job. I should talk to them again and see what this job is.
translation: 威尔和安妮在沙林港的码头。他们似乎很想面试我一份工作。我应该再跟他们谈谈，看看是什么工作。

english: Will and Anne on their Boat and sailed them to a spot east of the Karamja Shipyard to gather some salvage.
translation: 和威尔与安妮一起上了他们的船，航行到卡拉姆詹岛造船厂东边的一个地点收集打捞物。

english: Will and Anne on their Boat and sailed them to a spot east of the Karamja Shipyard to gather some salvage. I should man the Salvaging Hook when ready.
translation: 和威尔与安妮一起上了他们的船，航行到卡拉姆詹岛造船厂东边的一个地点收集打捞物。准备好后我应该操作打捞钩。

english: Will and Anne on their Boat and they asked me to sail them to a spot east of the Karamja Shipyard to gather some salvage.
translation: 和威尔与安妮一起上了他们的船，他们让我航行到卡拉姆詹岛造船厂东边的一个地点收集打捞物。

english: Will be managed.
translation: 会被管理好。

english: Will do, but I'll be seeing you soon!
translation: 没问题，但我很快就会来找你！

english: Will the hat work if it's not from the bank robbery?
translation: 如果帽子不是从银行抢劫来的，还能用吗？

english: Will these treats best him? Time will tell!
translation: 这些点心能打败他吗？时间会证明一切！

english: Will you hand me the seeds?
translation: 你能把种子递给我吗？

english: Will you help me get chocolate eggs? The bunnies won't let me have any. They just carry them past!
translation: 你能帮我拿巧克力蛋吗？兔子们不让我拿。它们就那样带着蛋跑过去！

english: Will you help me recreate a portal to the Realm of Memories? Please! I'd be so grateful! It'll prove I should be a fully qualified wizard rather than an apprentice.
translation: 你能帮我重建一个通往记忆领域的传送门吗？求你了！我会非常感激的！这能证明我应该成为一名合格的魔法师，而不是一个学徒。

english: Will you help me with making a time bubble or not?
translation: 你到底帮不帮我制作时间泡泡？

english: Will you help me? All you need to do is hand out some eggs to children.
translation: 你能帮我吗？你只需要给孩子们发一些蛋就行了。

english: Will you help the Easter Bunny again?
translation: 你还会再帮复活节兔子吗？

english: Will you help the Easter Bunny?
translation: 你愿意帮助复活节兔子吗？

english: Will you join us in locating and defending Falador?
translation: 你愿意加入我们，一起定位并保卫法拉多城吗？

english: Wilough said they hid the egg mould near a pub.
translation: 威洛说他们把鸡蛋模具藏在一家酒馆附近。

english: Wind catcher on your boat.
translation: 你船上的捕风器。

english: Wine Cellar and questioned the Suspects, but was unable to find anything conclusive. As such, Stradius and Hutza agreed to let me pickpocket the Suspects in the hopes of finding something incriminating.
translation: 搜查了酒窖并盘问了嫌疑人，但未能找到任何确凿证据。因此，斯特拉迪乌斯和胡扎同意让我扒窃嫌疑人，希望能找到一些不利证据。

english: Wine Stalls!
translation: 葡萄酒摊！

english: Wink wink!
translation: 眨眨眼！

english: Wise decision. It makes me squeamish just thinking about it!
translation: 明智的决定。光是想想就让我觉得恶心！

english: Wish I'd brought some water with me, it's quite hot.
translation: 真希望我带了点水来，这里好热。

english: Witch in Draynor Village who makes Dye that can be used to recolour Goblin Mail.
translation: 德雷诺村的女巫，她会制作可以用来给哥布林链甲重新染色的染料。

english: Witch in Draynor Village who makes Dye that can be used to recolour Goblin Mail. I should be able to find some Goblin Mail in crates around Goblin Village.
translation: 德雷诺村的女巫，她会制作可以用来给哥布林链甲重新染色的染料。我应该能在哥布林村庄周围的板条箱里找到一些哥布林链甲。

english: With Adala dealt with, Constantinius decided to go ahead with the Play. With the Killer potentially still at large, I decided to continue my investigation. Constantinius didn't want any disruptions, so I had to use the Cliffside Path south of the Villa to reach the Theatre.
translation: 处理完阿达拉后，康斯坦提尼乌斯决定继续上演戏剧。由于杀手可能仍然在逃，我决定继续调查。康斯坦提尼乌斯不想有任何干扰，所以我必须使用别墅南边的悬崖小路前往剧院。

english: With a crushing blow you finish [other player name].
translation: 你以一记粉碎性的打击结束了[other player name]。

english: With a few swings of your pick, you split off a part of the rock and sneakily put it in your pocket.
translation: 你用镐子敲了几下，从岩石上敲下一块，然后偷偷放进口袋里。

english: With a grinding of machinery, a trapdoor snaps open!
translation: 随着一阵机械的轰鸣声，一扇活板门啪地弹开了！

english: With all these tricks being played I think treats are in order!
translation: 玩了这么多恶作剧，我觉得该给点糖果了！

english: With help from Mandy, one of the apparent victims, I defeated the killers.
translation: 在其中一个受害者曼迪的帮助下，我击败了杀手们。

english: With more than one perfect shell
translation: 当拥有不止一个完美的贝壳时

english: With my Butler's Uniform obtained, I used the Staff Entrance to enter Villa Lucens. I met up with Patzi inside and he asked me to gather information on the Host and the Guests for him.
translation: 拿到我的管家制服后，我通过员工入口进入了卢森斯别墅。我在里面遇到了帕齐，他让我为他收集关于主人和客人们的情报。

english: With no chocolate eggs, there can be no celebration. And the eggs were easy to sabotage - it took very little of my magic to animate and possess them.
translation: 没有巧克力蛋，就没法庆祝。而且这些蛋很容易破坏——我只需用一点点魔法就能让它们活过来并附身它们。

english: With no snail shells or perfect snail shells in the inventory
translation: 当背包里没有蜗牛壳或完美的蜗牛壳时

english: With one perfect shell
translation: 当拥有一个完美的贝壳时

english: With only not-perfect shells
translation: 当只有不完美的贝壳时

english: With snail shells or perfect snail shells in the inventory
translation: 当背包里有蜗牛壳或完美的蜗牛壳时

english: With some difficulty you manage to push yourself through the small crack in the rock.
translation: 你费了些力气，设法把自己挤过了岩石上的小裂缝。

english: With some skill you manage to slide the blade along the lock edge and click into place the teeth of the primitive mechanism.
translation: 凭借一些技巧，你成功地将刀片沿着锁边滑动，并咔哒一声卡入了这个原始机构的齿槽中。

english: With the Assassins dealt with, Thaerisk asked me to investigate a treasure hunter called Movario who he believed had worked with Lucien. He suggested I start my search at the Fight Arena as Movario hired a bodyguard from there called Darve.
translation: 处理完刺客后，赛里斯克让我去调查一个名叫莫瓦里奥的宝藏猎人，他认为此人与卢西安合作过。他建议我从战斗竞技场开始调查，因为莫瓦里奥从那里雇了一个叫达尔夫的保镖。

english: With the Mercenaries dealt with, Idria and I journeyed to the White Knights' Castle in Falador. There we met up with Thaerisk, as well as Akrisae of the Temple Knights.
translation: 处理完雇佣兵后，伊德莉亚和我前往法拉多城的白骑士城堡。我们在那里与赛里斯克以及圣殿骑士团的阿克里赛会合。

english: With the Missing Deliveries sorted, Emelio and I needed to perfect the recipe for the Kebabs. We did this with the help of a selection of 'Connoisseurs'.
translation: 处理完丢失的货物后，埃梅利奥和我需要完善烤肉串的食谱。我们在一群'美食鉴赏家'的帮助下完成了这件事。

english: With the Spy captured, we attempted to interrogate him using some Truth Serum. However, the Spy was able to destroy it.
translation: 抓住间谍后，我们试图用一些吐真剂审问他。然而，间谍设法毁掉了它。

english: With the Tree Spirit defeated you can now chop the tree.
translation: 击败树精后，你现在可以砍这棵树了。

english: With the aid of 5 fire runes.
translation: 借助5个火焰符文的力量。

english: With the aid of the junior navigator, you sail back to the digsite.
translation: 在初级航海家的帮助下，你航行回到了挖掘场。

english: With the help of the magical dragonstones!
translation: 在魔法龙石的帮助下！

english: With the recipe perfected, Emelio asked me to speak to Lelia at the Fortis Colosseum about marketing the Kebabs to the people of Varlamore.
translation: 食谱完善后，埃梅利奥让我去福蒂斯竞技场找莱莉亚，商量如何向瓦拉莫尔的居民推销烤肉串。

english: With this and a bit of mithril, I reckon I could make something useful to use with my crossbow...
translation: 有了这个，再加点秘银，我觉得我能做出点有用的东西来配我的弩……

english: With your belief I don't think I can give up!
translation: 有你的信任，我觉得我不能放弃！

english: Withdraw money.
translation: 取钱。

english: Without hat, I not chef. Watch for ten years how to cook in castle, now my turn.
translation: 没帽子，我就不是厨师。在城堡里看了十年怎么做菜，现在轮到我了。

english: Without the egg mould, no Easter eggs can be made. That would be Easter ruined in Gielinor!
translation: 没有鸡蛋模具，就做不了复活节彩蛋。那吉列诺的复活节可就毁了！

english: Wizard Blizzards.
translation: 魔法师暴风雪。

english: Wizard Cromperty teleports the player to the rune essence mine.
translation: 法师克伦珀蒂将玩家传送到符文精华矿。

english: Wizard Distentor teleports the player to the rune essence mine
translation: 魔法师迪斯滕托将玩家传送到符文精华矿

english: Wizard Mizgog has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 魔法师米兹戈格又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Wizards Mizgog, Sedridor and Traiborn walk into a bar. The bartender serves them two wizard mind bombs and one asgarnian ale. The bar closes at 11, at which point everyone leaves. How many people left the bar?
translation: 魔法师米兹戈格、塞德里多和特雷伯恩走进一家酒吧。酒保给他们上了两杯魔法师心灵炸弹和一杯阿斯加尼亚麦酒。酒吧11点关门，那时所有人都离开了。有多少人离开了酒吧？

english: Woad leaves!!
translation: 菘蓝叶！！

english: Woad plants.
translation: 菘蓝植物。

english: Woah there, clearly you didn't have anything for breakfast today.
translation: 哇哦，看来你今天早餐什么都没吃。

english: Woah, I think you're about to make a terrible mistake!
translation: 哇，我觉得你正要犯一个可怕的错误！

english: Woah, not sure you would want to go lower than 0... I'm not very impressed.
translation: 哇，你确定要降到0以下吗……这可不怎么让我佩服。

english: Woah, what'd I do? Oh no, the skull's gone.
translation: 哇，我做了什么？哦不，头骨不见了。

english: Woah, you're a big bird!
translation: 哇，你真是只大鸟！

english: Woah. You made me jump. How does your voice carry so far?
translation: 哇。你吓了我一跳。你的声音怎么能传这么远？

english: Woe is me, Draul won't let me in...not after everything that happened with Juliet.
translation: 我真命苦，德劳尔不让我进去……自从朱丽叶那件事之后。

english: Wolf and she explained to me that Fox was looking into making some repairs to Guild Hunter Kiko's Cat Bed. I should have a look at the Bed and see what repairs he was trying to make.
translation: 沃尔夫向我解释说，福克斯正在研究修理猎人基科的猫床。我应该去看看那张床，看看他想修什么。

english: Wolf hands you a small toy mouse.
translation: 沃尔夫递给你一只小玩具老鼠。

english: Wolf, Bat, Rat, Baby Blue Dragon, Ogre, Jogre, Zogre, Mogre, Dagannoth, Snake, Zombie, Werewolf, Moss Giant, Fire Giant, Ice Giant, Terrorbird, Ghoul, Troll, Seagull, Undead Cow, Experiment, Rabbit, Basilisk, Massive Desert Lizard, Cave Goblin, Vulture and Jackal.
translation: 狼、蝙蝠、老鼠、蓝龙幼崽、食人魔、乔格雷食人魔、佐格雷食人魔、莫格雷食人魔、深潜者、蛇、僵尸、狼人、苔藓巨人、火焰巨人、冰巨人、骇鸟、食尸鬼、巨魔、海鸥、亡灵牛、实验体、兔子、石化蜥蜴、巨型沙漠蜥蜴、洞穴哥布林、秃鹫和胡狼。

english: Wolfbone describes how to reach Weiss by sea.
translation: 狼骨描述了如何从海路到达韦斯。

english: Wolfbone said we should go by sea.
translation: 狼骨说我们应该走海路。

english: Won't I need money to cross the border to Al-Kharid? Is there any chance you'd be able to provide that?
translation: 我过境去阿尔卡哈德不需要钱吗？你能提供这个吗？

english: Wonderful! Could you tell me about them?
translation: 太好了！你能跟我说说它们吗？

english: Wonderful! Here's the churn, off to the wilderness you go!
translation: 太好了！这是搅拌器，去荒野吧！

english: Wonderful! I'll just take that and set this holiday right!
translation: 太好了！我收下这个，让这个节日重回正轨！

english: Wonderful! In that case I think the ritual can begin...
translation: 太好了！那样的话，我觉得仪式可以开始了……

english: Wonderful! Was Warmhandz happy with the win?
translation: 太好了！沃姆汉兹对胜利满意吗？

english: Wonderful, off we go!
translation: 太好了，我们出发吧！

english: Wonderful. A few of our visiting dignitaries have set up activities to entertain our guests; I am sure they would greatly appreciate your participation.
translation: 太好了。我们几位来访的贵宾设置了一些活动来招待客人；我相信他们会非常感激你的参与。

english: Wonderful. Maybe I should go pay him a visit.
translation: 太好了。也许我该去拜访他一下。

english: Woohoo all part of the party my friend, thank a lot for getting 'em all here.
translation: 呜呼，都是派对的一部分，我的朋友，非常感谢你把他们都请来了。

english: WooooOOoOoo
translation: 呜呜呜呜呜

english: Wooooo wooo wooooo!
translation: 呜呜呜 呜呜 呜呜呜！

english: Woops, not that one!
translation: 哎呀，不是那个！

english: Working hard on what?
translation: 在忙什么？

english: Worse, I don't even know exactly what's in them!
translation: 更糟的是，我甚至不知道里面到底有什么！

english: Wotcha' yer just in time, caught me takin' a break.
translation: 嘿，你来得正好，抓到我正在休息呢。

english: Would an imp do?
translation: 小恶魔行吗？

english: Would be? What is wrong?
translation: 会怎样？出什么事了？

english: Would gnome child do?
translation: 地精小孩行吗？

english: Would the Wise Old Man do?
translation: 老智者行吗？

english: Would you all care to take a look at the dogs?
translation: 你们要不要来看看这些狗？

english: Would you be so kind as to let me have some?
translation: 你能好心给我一些吗？

english: Would you believe it? That dog I had my eyes on was a cat all along. I guess a larupia can't change its spots after all. I'm a cat lady through and through! I'm not sure I'll forgive Cecilia for the false advertising, however.
translation: 你信吗？我一直盯着的那条狗，结果从头到尾都是一只猫。看来拉鲁皮亚终究是改不了本性。我彻头彻尾就是个爱猫女士！不过，我不确定我会原谅塞西莉亚的虚假宣传。

english: Would you like a beer?
translation: 要来杯啤酒吗？

english: Would you like me to teleport you to the mines beneath Falador?
translation: 要我传送你去法拉多城地下的矿场吗？

english: Would you like one? I'll give you one for free for being such a help earlier. I couldn't have made them without you!
translation: 你想要一个吗？为了感谢你之前的帮忙，我免费送你一个。没有你我可做不出来！

english: Would you like to adjust earning combat experience or hitpoints experience?
translation: 你想调整获得战斗经验还是生命值经验？

english: Would you like to ask Prince Brand to marry you?
translation: 你想向布兰德王子求婚吗？

english: Would you like to ask Princess Astrid to marry you?
translation: 你想向阿斯特丽德公主求婚吗？

english: Would you like to visit Santa in his grotto? I hear he has a present for you!
translation: 你想去洞穴里拜访圣诞老人吗？我听说他有礼物给你！

english: Would you meet me outside the palace by the well? I have some preparations to make.
translation: 你能在宫殿外的井边和我碰面吗？我有些准备工作要做。

english: Would you mind looking over my things while I'm gone? I promise I won't be long! Hopefully!
translation: 我不在的时候，你能帮我照看一下我的东西吗？我保证不会太久！希望如此！

english: Would you prefer they just exclaim 'treat'?
translation: 你更希望他们直接喊‘款待’吗？

english: Would you really? Thank you ever so much! Is there anything I can do to repay you?
translation: 真的吗？太感谢你了！有什么我能报答你的吗？

english: Would you really? That would help me out so much!
translation: 真的吗？那真是帮了我大忙了！

english: Would you take the armour to Sir Vyvin for me, while I take care of this last thing?
translation: 你能帮我把盔甲带给维文爵士吗？我来处理这最后一件事。

english: Would... Would it be possible to avoid the squire period and move straight to initiate, Sir?
translation: 先生……有没有可能跳过侍从阶段，直接成为见习骑士？

english: Wouldn't that just be orange dye?
translation: 那不就是橙色染料吗？

english: Wouldn't that mess up all our clothes? And it'll wash away if it rains!
translation: 那不会弄脏我们所有的衣服吗？而且下雨的话会被冲掉的！

english: Wow - I bet this one's popular!
translation: 哇——我打赌这个很受欢迎！

english: Wow Romeo, you're a really classy guy, keep it up.
translation: 哇，罗密欧，你真是个有品位的家伙，继续保持。

english: Wow! A creepy costume to rival the Grim Reaper himself! You'll probably enjoy these treats more, though.
translation: 哇！一套能和死神本人媲美的恐怖服装！不过，你可能会更喜欢这些糖果。

english: Wow! A spooky wall lamp, a moving chair, a spooky picture and even a scarecrow! Thank you!
translation: 哇！一个幽灵壁灯、一把会动的椅子、一幅诡异的图画，甚至还有一个稻草人！谢谢你！

english: Wow! Did you manage to recover the artifact?
translation: 哇！你真的找回那个神器了？

english: Wow! Hassan, what are those?!
translation: 哇！哈桑，那些是什么东西？！

english: Wow! Now that costume sends shivers up my spine! You've earned these treats!
translation: 哇！那套服装让我脊背发凉！这些糖果是赏你的！

english: Wow! look at the massive size of this emerald!
translation: 哇！看看这颗绿宝石有多大！

english: Wow, amazing! You did that really neatly. Well done!
translation: 哇，太厉害了！你做得真利落。干得好！

english: Wow, it looks like you completed all of the achievements I could come up with!
translation: 哇，看来你完成了所有我能想到的成就！

english: Wow, look at the size of this emerald.
translation: 哇，看看这颗绿宝石的个头。

english: Wow, okay. Well I do have to admit that I feel better than I have done in years. Perhaps I will finally leave this place and travel the world.
translation: 哇，好吧。我得承认，我感觉比过去几年都要好。也许我最终会离开这里，去周游世界。

english: Wow, that looks incredible!
translation: 哇，看起来太棒了！

english: Wow, that was amazing! I'm starting to think icing this field was a really good idea!
translation: 哇，太精彩了！我开始觉得给这片地撒糖霜真是个绝妙的主意！

english: Wow, that's for me? Thank you so much!
translation: 哇，这是给我的吗？太感谢了！

english: Wow, they're all so cute! I can't decide which one to take!
translation: 哇，它们都太可爱了！我决定不了该带走哪一个！

english: Wow, this is actually fun!
translation: 哇，这还挺好玩的！

english: Wow, very spooky! Now go pretend you're a goblin, just like them. Then please let me out of here.
translation: 哇，真够吓人的！现在去假装你是个哥布林，就像他们一样。然后请放我出去。

english: Wow, you actually like it? That's weird... but good for you.
translation: 哇，你真的喜欢？真奇怪……不过你喜欢就好。

english: Wow, you did it! They're gone! I'm free!
translation: 哇，你做到了！他们走了！我自由了！

english: Wow, you have no chill. That's ok, I have chill for the both of us.
translation: 哇，你真是淡定。没关系，我替咱们俩淡定。

english: Wow. Thank you, [player name]! This party should be wonderful, you're great for making this happen for us!
translation: 哇。谢谢你，[player name]！这场派对一定会很精彩，多亏了你才能办成！

english: Wow. These goblins never cease to amaze me.
translation: 哇。这些哥布林总能让我大吃一惊。

english: Wow. Was it all just a dream?
translation: 哇……难道这只是一场梦？

english: Wow... maybe you do have some intelligence. Not just any net though. There's a special one around here somewhere.
translation: 哇……也许你确实有点脑子。不过不是随便什么网都行。这附近某个地方有一张特别的网。

english: Wow...these look...purrfect.
translation: 哇……这些看起来……太喵了。

english: Wriggle through the rubble?
translation: 从瓦砾中钻过去？

english: Written by [other player name].
translation: 由[other player name]撰写。

english: Wrong answer, are you really goblin?
translation: 答错了，你真的是哥布林吗？

english: Wrong size, wrong fur. If a customer sees those bald patches, they'll question my hairdressing skills!
translation: 尺寸不对，毛皮也不对。要是顾客看到那些秃斑，他们会质疑我的理发手艺的！

english: Wrong, but I am very good at seeking.
translation: 错了，但我很擅长寻找。

english: Wrong. A group of crows has taken this delightful name.
translation: 错了。一群乌鸦已经用了这个可爱的名字。

english: Wrong. Also for future reference, you can't run from me.
translation: 错了。另外提醒你一下，你逃不出我的手掌心。

english: Wrong. Coal is not received well as a present, but most mortals seem to avoid this fate.
translation: 错了。煤作为礼物不太受欢迎，但大多数凡人似乎都避开了这种命运。

english: Wrong. Not everyone gets frightened on this day.
translation: 错了。不是每个人都会在这一天被吓到。

english: Wrong. Not nearly enough death there.
translation: 错了。那里的死亡气息还不够浓。

english: Wrong. Only generations I have visited in the past would use a turnip. Turnips don't see the light of day anymore.
translation: 错了。只有我过去拜访过的几代人会用芜菁。芜菁现在可不见天日了。

english: Wrong. Still, a plague does bring good business, as do a group of locusts.
translation: 错了。不过，瘟疫确实能带来好生意，蝗虫群也一样。

english: Wrong. Too small and squishy, although excellent for throwing.
translation: 错了。太小太软了，虽然很适合扔着玩。

translation: 索科特拉，一个水手。她经营一家航运公司，声称从未与利维乌斯做过生意。然而，她身上有一份他们两人之间的合同。她为什么要撒谎？

english: Y'know, I've got a better idea! if you make a single chocolate egg, we could use magic to make it HUGE, and we can all knock off early.
translation: 你知道吗，我有个更好的主意！如果你做一个巧克力蛋，我们可以用魔法把它变得巨大，然后我们都能提前收工。

english: YES! Brilliant idea!
translation: 好！绝妙的主意！

translation: 是啊，有时候它会在最不合时宜的时候发作。

translation: 阎魔不情愿地接过披萨，然后把它烧成了灰烬。

english: Yay! I knew they could do it!
translation: 耶！我就知道他们能做到！

english: Yay, I can't wait! I haven't been on a night out in ages!
translation: 耶，我等不及了！我好久没出去过夜生活了！

english: Yay, I can't wait! I'm looking forward to a lovely dinner!
translation: 耶，我等不及了！我期待着一顿美味的晚餐！

english: Yay, I can't wait! I'm looking forward to that toffee apple, I've never had one before!
translation: 耶，我等不及了！我很期待那个太妃糖苹果，我以前从没吃过！

english: Ye do? Hand it over!
translation: 你有？把它交出来！

english: Ye'll find snowdrifts near the entrance to their cave. When ye's frozen a gublinch, bring it back 'ere an' place it in one o' these cages.
translation: 你会在他们洞穴入口附近找到雪堆。等你冻住了一个哥布林奇，就把它带回这里，放进其中一个笼子里。

english: Yeah I gots it the precious.
translation: 是啊，我得到了它，我的宝贝。

english: Yeah I'm sure, I don't need a haircut!
translation: 是的，我确定，我不需要理发！

english: Yeah mate. But here's issues.
translation: 是啊，哥们。但问题来了。

english: Yeah right okay there's no point taking this further.
translation: 好吧好吧，没必要再谈下去了。

english: Yeah they have weird hats, and necklaces with eggs on!
translation: 是啊，他们戴着奇怪的帽子，还有挂着蛋的项链！

english: Yeah we have some gingerbread gnomes. Herquin gave us three each!
translation: 是啊，我们有一些姜饼侏儒。赫昆给了我们每人三个！

english: Yeah! And I was so scared. I lost my rune scimmy that I'd worked so hard to get.
translation: 是啊！我吓坏了。我丢了我好不容易才弄到的符文弯刀。

english: Yeah! Let's do it!
translation: 好！我们干吧！

english: Yeah! They do need to be a bit scary, or at least be able to pretend to be a bit scary, like a ghost.
translation: 是啊！他们确实需要有点吓人，或者至少能装得有点吓人，比如像幽灵那样。

english: Yeah, I can't give this to people! I thought we could just freeze milk and get something close enough to ice cream.
translation: 是啊，我不能把这个给人吃！我以为我们可以冷冻牛奶，做出差不多像冰淇淋的东西。

english: Yeah, I fancy myself on the rebellious side.
translation: 是啊，我觉得自己挺叛逆的。

english: Yeah, I think so. Pack it aboard soon as you can. I'm on a tight schedule for deliveries!
translation: 是啊，我想是的。尽快把它装上船。我的送货时间很紧！

english: Yeah, I'll give it another go.
translation: 好，我再试一次。

english: Yeah, I'll join you.
translation: 好，我跟你一起。

english: Yeah, I'm supposed to be helping him myself.
translation: 是啊，我本来就应该去帮他的。

english: Yeah, I'm sure that's the reason... Then I need to speak to your brother in the toy room and then Goldie in the kitchen.
translation: 是啊，我确定这就是原因……那我需要去玩具房找你弟弟，然后去厨房找戈尔迪。

english: Yeah, I've done that for him myself.
translation: 是啊，我自己也为他做过。

english: Yeah, Scott. Scott Cheggs.
translation: 是啊，斯科特。斯科特.切格斯。

english: Yeah, about that. I'm going to need your help here. Being the adventurer you are, you're not new when it comes to travelling.
translation: 是啊，关于那个。我需要你在这里帮忙。作为你这样的冒险者，你对旅行应该不陌生。

english: Yeah, but Jeremy bought a lot of beer.
translation: 是啊，但杰里米买了很多啤酒。

english: Yeah, cool!
translation: 是啊，酷！

english: Yeah, do you think we could have some more time? We'll buy drinks afterwards.
translation: 是啊，你觉得我们能再多待一会儿吗？之后我们会买饮料的。

english: Yeah, guarding all day make me tired.
translation: 是啊，整天站岗让我很累。

english: Yeah, it wasn't too difficult thankfully.
translation: 是啊，幸好不太难。

english: Yeah, it's Halloween don't you know?!
translation: 是啊，今天是万圣节，你不知道吗？！

english: Yeah, it's pretty scrambled.
translation: 是啊，乱成一团了。

english: Yeah, it's really spooky!
translation: 是啊，真的很阴森！

english: Yeah, just the slight job of guarding the palace.
translation: 是啊，只是守卫宫殿这点小事。

english: Yeah, let's go and talk to the easter bunny.
translation: 好，我们去找复活节兔子谈谈。

english: Yeah, no eggs anywhere. The world's gone mad!
translation: 是啊，到处都没有蛋。这世界疯了！

english: Yeah, so what now?
translation: 是啊，那现在怎么办？

english: Yeah, sure, I'll get the skeletons hung up.
translation: 好，当然，我会把骷髅挂起来的。

english: Yeah, then I spoke to Bob, who told me the goblins fought about the sweets until they couldn't stand up anymore.
translation: 是啊，然后我跟鲍勃谈了，他告诉我那些哥布林为了糖果打架，直到站不起来为止。

english: Yeah, they sometimes make ghosts appear too. That's a very cool trick!
translation: 是啊，他们有时候还会让幽灵出现。那招非常酷！

english: Yeah, they were cool! Nice one.
translation: 是啊，他们太酷了！干得漂亮。

english: Yeah, well...we put aside our differences for the party since we're indebted to the development team for bringing us to life in the first place.
translation: 是啊，嗯……为了派对，我们搁置了分歧，因为我们感激开发团队最初赋予了我们生命。

english: Yeah, why not! It's a name everyone knows and loves. The ice cream inside will just be a cool surprise, an air of mystery.
translation: 是啊，为什么不呢！这是个家喻户晓、人见人爱的名字。里面的冰淇淋只是个很酷的惊喜，一种神秘感。

english: Yeah, yeah.
translation: 是啊，是啊。

english: Yeah, you did good, kid. I won't pretend I'm into this kind of thing, but you did a proper good job on the magic ritual.
translation: 是啊，你干得不错，小子。我不会假装我喜欢这种事，但你在魔法仪式上干得真漂亮。

english: Yeah... I like the... colour?
translation: 是啊……我喜欢这个……颜色？

english: Yee-haw! That'll let us get in there to take care of the toys and no mistake!
translation: 呀吼！这样我们就能进去处理那些玩具了，错不了！

english: Yeeeess... what does this have to do with me?
translation: 是——的……这跟我有什么关系？

english: Yeeeessss... The impostrous falseshells. What of them?
translation: 是的是的……那些冒牌假壳。它们怎么了？

english: Yep - but not as much as Thurgo does! That dwarf really loves pies!
translation: 是的——但不如瑟戈那么喜欢！那个矮人真的很爱馅饼！

english: Yep! I'm not sure he's made for pking.
translation: 没错！我不确定他适合玩PK。

english: Yep! I've been good all year around so I know Santa will be giving me something nice!
translation: 没错！我这一年都很乖，所以我知道圣诞老人会给我好东西！

english: Yep! We tried to settle on an idea for one but they couldn't agree. It seemed easier to just make two.
translation: 没错！我们试过想一个点子，但他们意见不合。干脆做两个似乎更简单。

english: Yep, I think that's enough roots. Here's a reward for you - a Jack O' Lantern helmet!
translation: 对，我觉得树根够多了。这是给你的奖励——一顶杰克南瓜灯笼头盔！

english: Yep, I'm still shaking. Are you ok?
translation: 对，我还在发抖。你还好吗？

english: Yep, and it was still working too!
translation: 对，而且它居然还能用！

english: Yep, everythings pretty normal here.
translation: 对，这里一切都很正常。

english: Yep, it's a deal.
translation: 好，成交。

english: Yep, just waiting for my friends over there to finish writing their poetry.
translation: 对，只是在等我那边的朋友写完诗。

english: Yep, sounds about right.
translation: 对，差不多就是这样。

english: Yep, that was a silly question.
translation: 对，那是个蠢问题。

english: Yep, you can use the Telekinetic Grab spell.
translation: 对，你可以用意念取物法术。

english: Yep. I just need to wait here a little while and see if the ice cream one melts. If it doesn't... then experiment success!
translation: 对。我只需要在这里等一会儿，看看冰淇淋那个会不会融化。如果没化……那实验就成功了！

english: Yep. Look, you can change its wrapping paper to blue now.
translation: 对。你看，现在可以把它的包装纸换成蓝色了。

english: Yes - I acknowledge I'll lose all milk within the bucket.
translation: 是的——我明白我会失去桶里所有的牛奶。

english: Yes - combine them
translation: 是的——把它们组合起来

english: Yes - remove it.

english: Yes, liquid-filled vials. Big deal.
translation: 是的，装满液体的小瓶。有什么了不起的。

english: Yes, long ago. But at a great cost. And even then, he is back. No, simply killing this monster cannot guarantee our safety.
translation: 是的，很久以前。但付出了巨大的代价。即便如此，他还是回来了。不，仅仅杀死这个怪物并不能保证我们的安全。

english: Yes, look at you! You're stood here fully armed and ready to go!
translation: 是的，看看你！你全副武装地站在这里，准备出发了！

english: Yes, my League.
translation: 是的，我的联赛。

english: Yes, my hat must be somewhere close by. I'd imagine if you ask someone who always hangs around here, they may have seen it.
translation: 是的，我的帽子一定就在附近。我想如果你问问经常在这附近晃悠的人，他们可能见过。

english: Yes, my lucky hat... it was stolen by a goblin. It can't have gotten very far by now!
translation: 是的，我的幸运帽……被一个哥布林偷走了。它现在肯定跑不远！

english: Yes, my success in joining the White Knights! I thanked him for his help and he sent a rather extensive reply.
translation: 是的，我成功加入了白骑士团！我感谢了他的帮助，他回了一封相当长的信。

english: Yes, need it to be chef.
translation: 是的，需要它成为厨师。

english: Yes, of course I dare speak to you. I've brought you some coal lumps.
translation: 是的，我当然敢跟你说话。我给你带了些煤块。

english: Yes, of course, those bandits should be taught a lesson.
translation: 是的，当然，那些强盗应该被教训一顿。

english: Yes, off you go. Hengel and I will have some dinner ready for them when they get back.
translation: 是的，去吧。亨格尔和我会在他们回来时准备好晚餐。

english: Yes, pay 25,000 x Coins.
translation: 是的，支付25,000 x 金币。

english: Yes, people have called me boring all my life. Thanks to your help, that will change tonight when the children see how entertaining my Halloween treats can be.
translation: 是的，人们一辈子都说我无聊。多亏了你的帮助，今晚当孩子们看到我的万圣节糖果有多有趣时，这种情况就会改变。

english: Yes, perhaps I could…
translation: 是的，也许我可以……

english: Yes, process them.
translation: 是的，处理它们。

english: Yes, pull the reset lever.
translation: 是的，拉动重置拉杆。

english: Yes, put it in the nest.
translation: 是的，把它放进巢里。

english: Yes, recharge my Amulet of blood fury.
translation: 是的，给我的鲜血愤怒护符充能。

english: Yes, recover it without cargo.
translation: 是的，不带货物回收它。

english: Yes, she said to talk to her four boys to try find the mould. Her boys are called Philop, Kanel, Shilop and Wilough.
translation: 是的，她说去找她的四个儿子试着找模具。她的儿子们叫菲洛普、卡内尔、希洛普和威洛。

english: Yes, should I find them a therapist now?
translation: 是的，我现在就该给他们找个心理医生吗？

english: Yes, so can you give me a knife and some feathers too? The knife would be a fine memento of Fletching, and feathers are popular for Fishing.
translation: 是的，那你能也给我一把刀和一些羽毛吗？刀可以当作制箭的纪念品，羽毛在钓鱼时很受欢迎。

english: Yes, something cool might happen.
translation: 是的，可能会发生很酷的事。

english: Yes, sorry dearie, I was just taking a moment to process things. You were talking for ages!
translation: 是的，抱歉亲爱的，我只是需要点时间消化一下。你刚才说了好久！

english: Yes, sorry, that was just a very long explanation.
translation: 是的，抱歉，刚才的解释实在太长了。

english: Yes, take a note.
translation: 是的，记下来。

english: Yes, take it.
translation: 是的，拿着吧。

english: Yes, take the dagger back.
translation: 是的，把匕首拿回去。

english: Yes, teleport me to Unferth's house.
translation: 是的，把我传送到安弗斯家。

english: Yes, thank you. I see you're in your armour. It's looking clean!
translation: 是的，谢谢你。我看到你穿着盔甲，看起来很干净！

english: Yes, thank you. It really meant so much!
translation: 是的，谢谢你。这真的意义重大！

english: Yes, thank you. It's a lovely atmosphere!
translation: 是的，谢谢你。这里气氛真好！

english: Yes, thanks.
translation: 是的，谢了。

english: Yes, that should do it... Hand that tin over here then.
translation: 是的，应该够了……把那块锡递过来吧。

english: Yes, that sounds like the right amount. Put them straight into the carts that the priests are using.
translation: 是的，听起来数量正好。直接放进牧师们用的推车里。

english: Yes, that's great!
translation: 是的，太棒了！

english: Yes, that's it!
translation: 是的，就是这样！

translation: 是的，这就是答案。报告在这里。

english: Yes, that's true. Thanks for your help, [player name]! Now all those dogs have a home for the holidays, and I can finally clean up the park!
translation: 是的，没错。谢谢你的帮助，[player name]！现在所有狗都有地方过节了，我终于可以清理公园了！

english: Yes, that's what happened.
translation: 是的，事情就是这样。

english: Yes, the Defences United against Nasty Goblins.
translation: 是的，联合防御对抗讨厌的哥布林。

english: Yes, the boys let me know where I should search for the mould, but I should talk to the Easter Bunny first.
translation: 是的，小伙子们告诉了我该去哪里找模具，但我得先和复活节兔子谈谈。

english: Yes, the last test attempt didn't go too well. Going to make sure I do it correctly this time.
translation: 是的，上次测试不太顺利。这次我要确保做对。

english: Yes, there was a conflict regarding the sweets. The argument turned into a fistfight, and I am pretty sure they knocked each other out completely at one point.
translation: 是的，糖果方面起了冲突。争吵变成了拳斗，我敢肯定他们一度把对方完全打晕了。

english: Yes, they are.
translation: 是的，他们是。

english: Yes, they were.
translation: 是的，他们曾经是。

english: Yes, they're called sapphires, you can get them mining.
translation: 是的，它们叫蓝宝石，你可以通过采矿获得。

english: Yes, this keeps happening to me whenever I cater birthday parties. I just don't have the supplies I need. Can you help?
translation: 是的，每次我承办生日派对都会遇到这种事。我就是没有需要的物资。你能帮忙吗？

english: Yes, throw it all away.
translation: 是的，全扔掉。

english: Yes, very 'cool' indeed. I see what you did there. Thank you!
translation: 是的，确实很‘酷’。我懂你的意思。谢谢！

english: Yes, very much so. I find it to be a fun place to take a break and just watch the world go by. There's always ships coming and going and always plenty of people to meet. There's also a lot you can learn here.
translation: 是的，非常喜欢。我觉得这是个休息的好地方，可以看看人来人往。总有船来来去去，总能遇到很多人。在这里也能学到很多东西。

english: Yes, we were going to get some nibbles, but the dogs would have eaten them...
translation: 是的，我们本来想吃点零食，但狗会把它们吃掉的……

english: Yes, well... I'd like to do that, but first I think I should probably give Party Pete a hand cleaning up here.
translation: 是的，嗯……我想这么做，但首先我觉得应该帮派对皮特清理一下这里。

english: Yes, well...it's a long story. I'll tell you if you do me another favour.
translation: 是的，嗯……说来话长。如果你再帮我一个忙，我就告诉你。

english: Yes, what have you got?
translation: 是的，你有什么？

english: Yes, what you want to know?
translation: 是的，你想知道什么？

english: Yes, you can have some milk. Just use that big bucket on me.
translation: 是的，你可以拿些牛奶。用那个大桶对着我用就行。

english: Yes, you can make magic potions to boost your skills.
translation: 是的，你可以制作魔法药水来提升技能。

english: Yes, you deal with me now, and no other. Perhaps I am interested in how you will fare, perhaps not.
translation: 是的，你现在要应付的是我，没有别人。也许我对你的表现感兴趣，也许不。

english: Yes, you were. But it seems like confronting your fears in Jonas and overcoming him has cured you.
translation: 是的，你确实害怕。但看来面对并战胜乔纳斯这个恐惧，已经治好了你。

english: Yes,I'll take the pickaxe.
translation: 是的，我拿这把镐子。

english: Yes. A deal is a deal.
translation: 是的，一言为定。

english: Yes. A downside to being a big fluffy bunny is I don't get on too well with hot weather. So much fur.
translation: 是的，作为一只毛茸茸的大兔子，缺点就是不太适应炎热的天气。毛太多了。

english: Yes. After defeat last year, we're rising up again to defeat smaller more stupid town this time.
translation: 是的。去年失败后，我们今年要卷土重来，打败一个更小更蠢的城镇。

english: Yes. Always save the best until last.
translation: 是的。最好的总是留到最后。

english: Yes. But I'm having problems.
translation: 是的。但我遇到麻烦了。

english: Yes. But first, who are you?
translation: 是的。但首先，你是谁？

english: Yes. Gilbert, just outside of Varrock. He has met a lot of people and is quite wise. We should go and meet him.
translation: 是的。吉尔伯特，就在维洛克城外。他见过很多人，很有智慧。我们应该去见见他。

english: Yes. Goblins hear humans have Christmas. Christmas good. Goblins take it from humans. 3 -->
translation: 是的。哥布林听说人类有圣诞节。圣诞节好。哥布林从人类那里抢过来。3 -->

english: Yes. Goblins strong. Goblins take what goblins wants.
translation: 是的。哥布林强壮。哥布林想要什么就拿什么。

english: Yes. Half-way down now.
translation: 是的。现在走到一半了。

english: Yes. Human wins cookout. My Arm thinks he might make this himself, once he learn how to grow the stuffs for it.
translation: 是的。人类赢了野炊比赛。"我的手臂"觉得他学会种材料后，可以自己做这个。

english: Yes. Human wins cookout. My Arm will let Hassan know.
translation: 是的。人类赢了野炊比赛。"我的手臂"会告诉哈桑。

english: Yes. I don't know what that is though, you'll have to figure that out.
translation: 是的。但我不知道那是什么，你得自己弄清楚。

english: Yes. I know that dropped items may be irretrievable.
translation: 是的。我知道掉落的物品可能无法找回。

english: Yes. I think she might be able to help, but I need to talk to her more.
translation: 是的。我觉得她可能帮得上忙，但我需要和她多谈谈。

english: Yes. I think the letter from my mom held the key to opening it. Let me know if you want me to read it to you again.
translation: 是的。我觉得我妈妈的信里藏着打开它的钥匙。如果你想，我可以再读一遍给你听。

english: Yes. I'd expect you'd want something sturdy, maybe made of metal. Zeke is probably the best person to talk to about that; he's the scimitar merchant in town.
translation: 是的。我想你会想要结实点的东西，也许是金属做的。齐克可能是最合适的人选；他是镇上的弯刀商人。

english: Yes. I'd like to try.
translation: 是的。我想试试。

english: Yes. It's all clean. The potion worked!
translation: 是的。全干净了。药水起作用了！

english: Yes. Melted chocolate does not get on well with my fur. I don't want to go through that again!
translation: 是的。融化的巧克力对我的毛可不好。我可不想再经历一次！

english: Yes. Oziach is trying to buy the Edgeville Monastery from the monks...
translation: 是的。奥扎克正试图从僧侣那里买下边陲镇的修道院……

english: Yes. Scrubfoot small so the humans no see Scrubfoot spying. 2 -->
translation: 是的。斯克鲁布福特个子小，所以人类看不到斯克鲁布福特在偷看。2 -->

english: Yes... I can imagine. Their discomfort will drive their work.
translation: 是的……我能想象。他们的不适会驱使他们工作。

english: Yes... There's no need to make a big deal out of it. I'm only human.
translation: 是的……没必要大惊小怪。我只是个普通人。

english: Yes... it was very subtle.
translation: 是的……非常微妙。

english: Yes? Are you ready?
translation: 是吗？你准备好了？

english: Yet I've hardly set out and I'm already falling at the first obstacle. I have no equipment to call my own. I just dragged some heavy chests for hours and I'm puffed-out.
translation: 可我还没出发，就在第一个障碍前摔倒了。我连自己的装备都没有。我拖了几个小时的沉重箱子，累得气喘吁吁。

english: Yew pyre ships.
translation: 紫杉火葬堆船只。

translation: 你试图撬开棺材上的锁。

english: You attempt to pick the lock...
translation: 你试图撬开锁……

english: You attempt to read the message on the gate...
translation: 你试图阅读大门上的信息……

english: You attempt to repalce the broken railing...
translation: 你试图更换破损的栏杆……

english: You attempt to replace the corrupted totem pole. A black cloud emanates from the rotten wood, and it slowly coalesces into the dread demon Nezikchened.
translation: 你试图替换被腐化的图腾柱。一股黑云从腐烂的木头中散发出来，并慢慢凝聚成可怕的恶魔内齐克切内德。

english: You attempt to string the bow, but burn yourself in the process. You'll need a Fletching level of 74 to craft a scorching bow.
translation: 你试图给弓上弦，但在这个过程中烧伤了自己。你需要 74 级制箭技能才能制作灼热之弓。

english: You attempt to unlock the chest...
translation: 你试图打开箱子的锁……

english: You attune the feather to the enchanted scroll, creating an enchanted quill.
translation: 你将羽毛与附魔卷轴调谐，制作出一支魔法羽毛笔。

english: You attune your hat to the power of the tiara.
translation: 你将你的帽子与头冠的力量调谐。

english: You awe to bwing bawance to [number] Abewwant Spectwes inda Stwonghowd Swayew Dungeon.
translation: 你需要在要塞杀戮者地牢中平衡[number]只畸变幽灵。

english: You awe to bwing bawance to [number] Kawphite in da task-onwy Kawphite Cave.
translation: 你需要在专属任务的卡尔夫特虫洞穴中平衡[number]只卡尔夫特虫。

english: You bail, but land safely on Entrana.
translation: 你跳伞了，但安全降落在恩特纳岛上。

english: You bash the parts together into a reasonable looking ice cream churn!
translation: 你将零件敲打在一起，做成一个像模像样的冰淇淋搅拌器！

english: You begin experimenting in forging the weapon...
translation: 你开始尝试锻造武器……

english: You begin shaping the mithril into a hopper.
translation: 你开始将秘银塑造成一个料斗。

english: You begin sketching the irritable Sithik.
translation: 你开始为暴躁的西西克画素描。

english: You begin to doubt whether you really want to open this chest...
translation: 你开始怀疑自己是否真的想打开这个箱子……

english: You begin to experience a vision, and walk towards a Mysterious Stone.
translation: 你开始经历一个幻象，并走向一块神秘石头。

english: You begin to lower yourself into the hole...
translation: 你开始把自己降到洞里……

english: You begin to operate the frozen churn...
translation: 你开始操作冰冻的搅拌器……

english: You being to search through the pile of junk...
translation: 你开始在那堆垃圾里翻找……

english: You bind the sand-filled purse to the end of the springy branch, creating a makeshift blackjack.
translation: 你将装满沙子的钱包绑在弹性树枝的末端，制作了一把临时短棍。

english: You bite hard into the hot rock cake to guzzle it down.
translation: 你狠狠地咬了一口滚烫的石糕，把它吞了下去。

english: You bless Dizana's quiver (uncharged), allowing it to not need charges.
translation: 你祝福了迪扎纳的箭袋 (未充能)，使其不再需要充能。

english: You blow out the flame and drink it.
translation: 你吹灭火焰，喝了下去。

english: You board the boat and wave to Mac.
translation: 你登上船，向麦克挥手。

english: You board the raft!
translation: 你登上了木筏！

english: You board the small raft and push off down stream...
translation: 你登上小木筏，顺流而下……

english: You board up the window.
translation: 你用木板封住了窗户。

english: You boil the water and make nettle tea.
translation: 你烧开水，泡了荨麻茶。

english: You both got good gifts, OK? Obviously someone really thoughtful put great effort into finding you good ones.
translation: 你们都收到了不错的礼物，对吧？显然有个很体贴的人费了很大心思为你们找到了好礼物。

english: You brace yourself against the doors...
translation: 你顶住大门……

english: You brace yourself for the wyverns on the other side...
translation: 你做好准备，迎接另一边的飞龙……

english: You bravely swig down the entire contents of the vial and then wait for some sort of internal explosion. After a few seconds, you realise that you actually feel alright.
translation: 你勇敢地一口喝干小瓶里的全部内容，然后等待着某种内部爆炸。几秒钟后，你意识到自己其实感觉还好。

english: You break up the [rune/pure essence] shards into dust.
translation: 你将[rune/pure essence]精华碎片打成了粉末。

english: You break up the [rune/pure] essence into shards.
translation: 你将[rune/pure]精华打成了碎片。

english: You bring the orb towards the etching and it disintegrates, causing an elemental air block to be released.
translation: 你将宝珠靠近蚀刻画，它随即崩解，释放出一个风元素方块。

english: You bring the orb towards the etching and it disintegrates, causing an elemental earth block to be released.
translation: 你将宝珠靠近蚀刻画，它随即崩解，释放出一个土元素方块。

english: You bring the orb towards the etching and it disintegrates, causing an elemental fire block to be released.
translation: 你将宝珠靠近蚀刻画，它随即崩解，释放出一个火元素方块。

english: You bring the orb towards the etching and it disintegrates, causing an elemental water block to be released.
translation: 你将宝珠靠近蚀刻画，它随即崩解，释放出一个水元素方块。

english: You bring the orb towards the etching, but nothing happens.
translation: 你将宝珠靠近蚀刻画，但什么也没发生。

english: You bring the totem pieces together with a click. It looks kind of like an arcane key and pulses with dark power in your hand.
translation: 你将图腾碎片咔嗒一声拼合在一起。它看起来有点像一把奥术钥匙，并在你手中脉动着黑暗的力量。

english: You bring the two claws together and combine them.
translation: 你将两只爪子合在一起，组合起来。

english: You brought a lot with you for a failed attempt.
translation: 你为一次失败的尝试带了不少东西。

english: You brought me all the way to this birthday bash, I cannot help but feel this is a waste of time.
translation: 你大老远把我带到这个生日派对上，我不禁觉得这是在浪费时间。

english: You brutally murder Conrad King. You monster.
translation: 你残忍地杀害了康拉德.金。你这个怪物。

english: You build a quetzal landing site.
translation: 你建造了一个绿咬鹃着陆点。

english: You built the cage!
translation: 你造好了笼子！

english: You built the machine! It still needs calibrating, though.
translation: 你造好了机器！不过它还需要校准。

english: You burn the stuffed snake.
translation: 你烧掉了填馅蛇。

english: You burn your hands on the hot rock cake and then drop it.
translation: 你的手被滚烫的石糕烫到，然后把它掉在了地上。

english: You burn your mouth and hands on the hot rock cake.
translation: 你的嘴和手都被滚烫的石糕烫伤了。

english: You bury the bones and feel a wave of gratitude from the spirit of [high priest].
translation: 你埋葬了骸骨，感受到来自[high priest]灵魂的一阵感激之情。

english: You buy a Black Skull Ale.
translation: 你买了一杯黑骷髅麦酒。

english: You buy a Fire Toad Blast.
translation: 你买了一杯火蟾蜍冲击。

english: You buy a Hand of Death cocktail.
translation: 你买了一杯死亡之手鸡尾酒。

english: You buy a Sailing Skillcape from Brass Hand Harry.
translation: 你从铜手哈里那里买了一件航行技能披风。

english: You buy a mayoral election kit from Harry for 50 coins.
translation: 你花了50金币从哈里那里买了一个市长选举工具包。

english: You buy a pint of Olde Suspiciouse.
translation: 你买了一品脱老可疑。

english: You buy a pint of blood.
translation: 你买了一品脱的血。

english: You buy some Uncle Humphrey's Gutrot.
translation: 你买了一些汉弗莱叔叔的穿肠酒。

english: You can access this interface any time by selecting the 'Inspect' option on the man.
translation: 你可以随时通过选择那个人身上的“检查”选项来访问这个界面。

english: You can clearly hear the voice coming from the water now.
translation: 你现在可以清楚地听到从水里传来的声音。

english: You can come back to this when you've learnt about the bank.
translation: 等你了解了银行之后，可以再回来处理这个。

english: You can eat it after. Right now we have more important things to do!
translation: 你可以之后再吃。现在我们有更重要的事情要做！

english: You can embark or disembark from your boat via docking points found around the world. To find a docking point, just look for the relevant icon on your map.
translation: 你可以通过世界各地的停靠点上船或下船。要找到停靠点，只需在地图上寻找相关图标即可。

english: You can enter a raid of the Tombs of Amascut in parties of up to eight people. To form a party or join an existing one, use the Grouping Obelisk.
translation: 你可以以最多八人的队伍进入阿玛斯库特之墓的副本。要组建队伍或加入现有队伍，请使用组队方尖碑。

english: You can feel the distinct energy of Ancient Magicks emanating from the door. You reach out and touch it, but nothing happens.
translation: 你能感觉到门上散发出远古魔法特有的能量。你伸手触摸，但什么也没发生。

english: You can feel the distinct energy of Ancient Magicks emanating from the door. You reach out and touch it. The symbol on the door starts to glow in response...
translation: 你能感觉到门上散发出远古魔法特有的能量。你伸手触摸。门上的符号开始发光回应……

english: You can find a pickaxe just south of here, if you need one!
translation: 如果你需要镐子，可以在这南边找到一把！

english: You can find various drinks at the bar.
translation: 你可以在酒吧找到各种饮品。

english: You can get another one from Diango in Draynor Village.
translation: 你可以从德雷诺村的迪亚戈那里再拿一个。

english: You can give out holiday items?
translation: 你能发放节日物品？

english: You can go to my workshop and collect the toys now.
translation: 你现在可以去我的工作室领取玩具了。

english: You can hand this in to an Estate Agent to unlock the Wilderness theme for your player-owned house.
translation: 你可以把这个交给地产经纪人，为你的玩家房屋解锁荒野主题。

english: You can have one for free for being such a help earlier with the snowmen.
translation: 你可以免费拿一个，作为之前帮雪人忙的答谢。

english: You can inflict [#] more points of damage before a ring will shatter.
translation: 你还能再造成 [#] 点伤害，然后戒指就会碎裂。

english: You can just about make out one of the titles of the books - 'A Nightmare of Elf Feet'.
translation: 你勉强能辨认出其中一本书的书名——《精灵脚的梦魇》。

english: You can just about make out one of the titles of the books - 'Bride of Fenkenstrain'.
translation: 你勉强能辨认出其中一本书的书名——《芬肯斯坦的新娘》。

english: You can just about make out one of the titles of the books - 'The Helda Witch Project'.
translation: 你勉强能辨认出其中一本书的书名——《海尔达女巫计划》。

english: You can just about make out the bartender signing your barcrawl card.
translation: 你勉强能看到酒保在你的酒吧巡游卡上签了名。

english: You can just about see dark, shadowy shapes flitting around in the still, dark air...
translation: 你勉强能看到黑暗、模糊的影子在静止而昏暗的空气中穿梭……

english: You can make enchanted ruby necklaces.
translation: 你可以制作附魔红宝石项链。

english: You can make out some faded words on the ancient parchment, but there's nothing more for you to learn.
translation: 你能辨认出古老羊皮纸上一些褪色的文字，但已经没有更多东西可学了。

english: You can make out some faded words on the ancient parchment, revealing the secrets of teleport negation. Would you like to absorb their power?
translation: 你能辨认出古老羊皮纸上一些褪色的文字，揭示了传送阻断的秘密。你想吸收它们的力量吗？

english: You can make out some faded words on the ancient parchment. It appears to be a demonic learning on spell efficiency. Would you like to absorb its knowledge?
translation: 你能辨认出古老羊皮纸上一些褪色的文字。这似乎是关于法术效率的恶魔学识。你想吸收它的知识吗？

english: You can make out some faded words on the ancient parchment. It appears to be an archaic invocation of the gods! Would you like to absorb its power?
translation: 你能辨认出古老羊皮纸上一些褪色的文字。这似乎是向诸神祈祷的古老咒文！你想吸收它的力量吗？

english: You can make out some faded words on the ancient parchment. It appears to be an archaic invocation of the gods. However there's nothing more for you to learn.
translation: 你能辨认出古老羊皮纸上一些褪色的文字。这似乎是向诸神祈祷的古老咒文。不过已经没有更多东西可学了。

english: You can make out some faded words on the ancient parchment. It's an archaic invocation of the gods. However there's nothing more for you to learn.
translation: 你能辨认出古老羊皮纸上一些褪色的文字。这是向诸神祈祷的古老咒文。不过已经没有更多东西可学了。

english: You can make out some faded words on the ancient parchment. It's archaic invocation of the gods. There is nothing more you can learn from this.
translation: 你能辨认出古老羊皮纸上一些褪色的文字。这是向诸神祈祷的古老咒文。你无法从中再学到任何东西。

english: You can now cast the Watchtower teleport spell... ...Provided you have the required runes and magic level.
translation: 你现在可以施展瞭望塔传送术了……前提是你拥有所需的符文和魔法等级。

english: You can now enter Shilo Village.
translation: 你现在可以进入希洛村了。

english: You can now jump over the eastern Rellekka fence, cross the Yanille Dungeon monkey bars and climb the north-eastern rock scramble on Great Conch's eastern plateau.
translation: 你现在可以跳过雷勒卡城东边的栅栏，穿过亚尼勒城地牢的攀爬架，并攀爬大康奇岛东部高原东北部的岩石堆。

english: You can now use Large Pouches to carry additional Essence.
translation: 你现在可以使用大型袋子来携带额外的精华。

english: You can now use the Bunny Hop emote.
translation: 你现在可以使用兔子跳表情。

english: You can now use the Motherlode Mine dark tunnel and the Western Aldarin cliff scramble Agility shortcuts.
translation: 你现在可以使用母矿矿脉的黑暗隧道和阿尔达林岛西部悬崖攀爬的敏捷捷径。

english: You can now use the Werewolf and Seers' Village courses, jump the pillars in the Wintertodt's prison, access the God Wars Dungeon via the Agility route, jump the estuary across Mos Le'Harmless, scramble through the Frozen Throne tunnel shortcut and the stepping stone within the Tombs of Amascut.
translation: 你现在可以使用狼人和先知村的课程，跳过冬之囚牢中的柱子，通过敏捷路线进入神战地牢，跳过莫斯勒哈姆斯岛上的河口，穿过冰冻王座隧道捷径以及阿玛斯库特之墓内的踏脚石。

english: You can now use the stepping stone by Miscellania docks and the Cape Conch rock scramble.
translation: 你现在可以使用米斯凯尼亚码头旁的踏脚石和康奇角岩石攀爬。

english: You can only add ingredients when you're cooking a chompy bird. Ensure you have the seasonings you want to use in your inventory when cooking the chompy bird and you will use them automatically when cooking.
translation: 你只能在烹饪食人鸟时添加配料。确保在烹饪食人鸟时，你想要的调味料在你的背包中，烹饪时会自动使用它们。

english: You can only apply supercompost potion to a bin containing normal compost.
translation: 你只能将超级堆肥药水施加到装有普通堆肥的桶上。

english: You can only apply volcanic ash to a bin containing super compost.
translation: 你只能将火山灰施加到装有超级堆肥的桶上。

english: You can only deposit multiples of 1,000 coins.
translation: 你只能存入1000金币的倍数。

english: You can only enter Thordur's Blackholes from the Dwarven Mines, beneath Falador.
translation: 你只能从法拉多城下方的矮人矿井进入索杜尔的黑洞。

english: You can only enter the Bounty Hunter minigame in a Bounty Hunter world.
translation: 你只能在赏金猎人的专属世界中进入该小游戏。

english: You can only plant those in the Varrock Palace garden.
translation: 你只能把这些种在维洛克城宫殿的花园里。

english: You can only remove this kit in building mode.
translation: 你只能在建造模式下移除这套工具。

english: You can only use plain tea with the flask.
translation: 你只能将清茶倒入烧瓶。

english: You can only use the flask with plain cups of tea.
translation: 你只能用烧瓶装清茶。

english: You can only withdraw multiples of 1,000 coins.
translation: 你只能取出1000金币的倍数。

english: You can perform the 'Scared' and 'Zombie Hand' emotes, as well as the new 'Hypermobile Drinker' emote.
translation: 你现在可以使用“害怕”和“僵尸手”表情，以及新的“灵活饮酒者”表情。

english: You can run past, but keep in mind that a dangerous area follows!
translation: 你可以跑过去，但请记住，后面是一个危险区域！

english: You can see Iffie giving you a thumbs up from across the path.
translation: 你看到伊菲在路对面朝你竖起大拇指。

english: You can see a small recepticle, not unlike the one on the opposite side of the door!
translation: 你看到一个小容器，和门对面的那个很像！

english: You can see a tattered flag blowing in the wind. The [skull emblem/top half/bottom half] is coloured [red/blue/yellow/orange/green/purple].
translation: 你看到一面破旧的旗帜在风中飘扬。[skull emblem/top half/bottom half]是[red/blue/yellow/orange/green/purple]的。

english: You can see a tattered flag blowing in the wind. The wind is blowing too hard to make out any details.
translation: 你看到一面破旧的旗帜在风中飘扬。风太大了，看不清任何细节。

english: You can see that there is something hidden behind some rocks. Do you want to have a look? It looks a bit dangerous as the ceiling doesn't look at all safe.
translation: 你看到一些岩石后面藏着什么东西。你想看看吗？看起来有点危险，因为天花板看起来一点也不安全。

english: You can see the barrel with Ana in it on the cart already.
translation: 你已经能看到装着安娜的桶在推车上了。

english: You can see the cat bed needs repairs, but you'll need the right materials along with a needle and an embertailed jerboa tail to fix it.
translation: 你看到猫床需要修理，但你需要合适的材料，以及一根针和一条焰尾跳鼠尾才能修好它。

english: You can see the gluey outline from where you peeled the address label off.
translation: 你能看到你撕下地址标签后留下的胶水痕迹。

english: You can someone to a game anywhere in the Games Zone (except on a PvP or Deadman world) by using the right click option.
translation: 你可以在游戏区的任何地方（除了PvP或死寂世界）通过右键选项邀请某人进行游戏。

english: You can suddenly smell colours and see sounds.
translation: 你突然能闻到颜色，听到声音了。

english: You can talk!
translation: 你会说话！

english: You can use my coffin-making workshop to make planks from the deadwood trees, and I have some coffin nails somewhere.
translation: 你可以用我的棺材制作工作室，用枯木树制作木板，我这儿还有些棺材钉子。

english: You can use this token to order gnome food to deliver. You can currently order [X] items.
translation: 你可以用这个代币订购地精食物送货上门。目前你可以订购 [X] 件物品。

english: You can view the Grid Master interface by selecting it's Orb
translation: 你可以通过选择它的宝珠来查看网格大师界面。

english: You can't afford it, you need 50 coins!
translation: 你买不起，需要 50 个金币！

english: You can't carry any more nettles.
translation: 你拿不了更多荨麻了。

english: You can't chop from his trees. Yours are at the other end of the island. Chop them down instead!
translation: 你不能砍他的树。你的树在岛的另一头。去砍那些树吧！

english: You can't craft any more clothes from these hides. You will have to speak with the Oneiromancer.
translation: 你无法用这些兽皮制作更多衣服了。你得去跟梦境法师谈谈。

english: You can't create another quill... by using the quill on the scroll.
translation: 你不能用羽毛笔在卷轴上再制作一支羽毛笔……

english: You can't do that while you're under attack!
translation: 你在被攻击时不能这么做！

english: You can't drop your follower while holding the heavy crate.
translation: 你抱着沉重的板条箱时，不能放下你的随从。

english: You can't feel your legs.
translation: 你感觉不到你的腿了。

english: You can't find another rake. Good job you already have one.
translation: 你找不到另一把耙子了。幸好你已经有一把了。

english: You can't find any watering cans without holes in them, so you decide to use your own.
translation: 你找不到没有洞的浇水壶，所以决定用自己的。

english: You can't get a clear shot from here.
translation: 你从这里无法进行清晰的射击。

english: You can't give him what you don't have.
translation: 你不能给他你没有的东西。

english: You can't give up at the first hurdle!
translation: 你不能在第一个障碍栏就放弃！

english: You can't graft the fang onto a charged trident.
translation: 你不能把毒牙装到已充能的三叉戟上。

english: You can't have my hat.
translation: 你不能拿走我的帽子。

english: You can't just attach a branch back to a plant again.
translation: 你不能把树枝重新接回植物上。

english: You can't just take Christmas. That's not how it works.
translation: 你不能就这么把圣诞节拿走。事情不是这样办的。

english: You can't loot the chest whilst Bryophyta is still attacking you!
translation: 布赖奥菲塔还在攻击你，你不能搜刮箱子！

english: You can't open the door, it's locked tight.
translation: 你打不开门，它锁得很紧。

english: You can't open this door.
translation: 你打不开这扇门。

english: You can't pass the barriers of Port Phasmatys while wearing the bedsheet.
translation: 你穿着床单时无法通过法斯提斯港的屏障。

english: You can't plant seeds if you don't have them.
translation: 如果你没有种子，就无法播种。

english: You can't possibly put that in there, it would spoil your sack.
translation: 你不可能把那东西放进去，它会弄坏你的麻袋的。

english: You can't push the monolith in that direction as there's something in the way.
translation: 你无法朝那个方向推动巨石，因为有什么东西挡住了路。

english: You can't put that in there.
translation: 你不能把那东西放进去。

english: You can't see any obvious way to unblock the entrance. Given the loud screeching coming from within, you're not sure you'd want to go inside anyway.
translation: 你看不到任何明显的方法可以疏通入口。考虑到里面传来的巨大尖叫声，你也不确定自己是否想进去。

english: You can't see anything of interest on the stand.
translation: 你在架子上看不到任何有趣的东西。

english: You can't shoot the bridge from this side.
translation: 你不能从这一侧射击那座桥。

english: You can't store that in the chugging barrel.
translation: 你不能把那东西存放在畅饮桶里。

english: You can't store this in the spice rack.
translation: 你不能把这个存放在香料架里。

english: You can't teleport now, you need to wake up first!
translation: 你现在不能传送，你得先醒来！

english: You can't think of any suitable translations for that word.
translation: 你想不出那个词有什么合适的翻译。

english: You can't use the sextant underground.
translation: 你不能在地下使用六分仪。

english: You can't... You can't do this to me!
translation: 你不能……你不能这样对我！

english: You can, but ye needs to get permission to join the event first...
translation: 你可以，但你需要先获得参加活动的许可……

english: You cannot add more discs after you have exchanged.
translation: 你在交换之后就不能再添加光盘了。

english: You cannot build anymore traps as you already have 6 built.
translation: 你不能再建造更多陷阱了，因为你已经建了 6 个。

english: You cannot cut down this tree yet. You must progress further in the tutorial.
translation: 你还不能砍倒这棵树。你必须在教程中继续前进。

english: You cannot fish here yet. You must progress further in the tutorial.
translation: 你还不能在这里钓鱼。你必须在教程中继续前进。

english: You cannot get the flame close enough to the fuse to use that to light it.
translation: 你无法将火焰靠得足够近，无法用那个来点燃引信。

english: You cannot imprison me forever...
translation: 你不可能永远囚禁我……

english: You cannot light the abyssal lantern as you already have one lit.
translation: 你无法点燃深渊灯笼，因为你已经点亮了一个。

english: You cannot make this on Tutorial Island.
translation: 你不能在教程岛上制作这个。

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both the and areas in this League.
translation: 你无法通过，因为你尚未在本联赛中解锁这两个区域的通行权限。

english: You cannot possibly fathom the potential futures I am conjuring for the contents of that cage should they fail me.
translation: 你无法想象，如果那个笼子里的东西让我失望，我会为它们构思出怎样可怕的未来。

english: You cannot stop me now Pete. Get out of my way.
translation: 你现在阻止不了我，皮特。给我让开。

english: You cannot teleport from Tutorial Island just yet!
translation: 你还不能从教程岛传送！

english: You cannot tie Keli up until you have all equipment and disabled the guard!
translation: 在你拥有所有装备并解除守卫的武装之前，你不能捆绑凯莉！

english: You cannot understand what he is saying.
translation: 你听不懂他在说什么。

english: You cannot withdraw coins from the coffers on Deadman worlds.
translation: 你不能在死亡模式世界中从金库中提取金币。

english: You carefully administer the potion to Silif.
translation: 你小心地将药水喂给西利夫。

english: You carefully attach the phalanx to the fang. Its bony structure expands, completely overtaking the weapon.
translation: 你小心地将指骨连接到毒牙上。它的骨骼结构扩张开来，完全覆盖了武器。

english: You carefully craft a pair of confliction gauntlets.
translation: 你精心制作了一对冲突手套。

english: You carefully drip the dye over the ward. It quickly spreads in veins through the ward, pulsing to reach every inch of it.
translation: 你小心地将染料滴在结界上。染料迅速沿着结界的脉络扩散，脉动着蔓延到它的每一寸。

english: You carefully feed the food to Silif.
translation: 你小心地将食物喂给西利夫。

english: You carefully fill the bucket with the foul-smelling swill.
translation: 你小心地用桶装满那气味难闻的泔水。

english: You carefully fix up Kiko's bed.
translation: 你小心地修好了奇科的床。

english: You carefully insert your lockpick into the lock.
translation: 你小心地将开锁器插入锁中。

english: You carefully inspect the large pile of treasure and find that it was sadly too good to be true. The treasure is all fake and is linked to a deadly trap beneath the floor.
translation: 你仔细检查了那堆巨大的宝藏，发现可惜这只是个美好的假象。所有宝藏都是假的，并且与地板下致命的陷阱相连。

english: You carefully manage to remove enough rocks to see a book shelf. You gingerly remove a delicate scroll from the shelf and place it in your inventory.
translation: 你小心翼翼地移开足够多的石块，看到了一个书架。你轻轻地从书架上取下一卷精致的卷轴，放入你的背包中。

english: You carefully operate the bellows to inflate the ball.
translation: 你小心地操作风箱给球充气。

english: You carefully place Ana in the barrel into the mine cart. Soon the cart moves out of sight and then it returns.
translation: 你小心地将桶里的安娜放进矿车。很快矿车驶出视线，然后又返回了。

english: You carefully place Rashiliyias remains on the dolmen. You feel a strange vibration in the air.
translation: 你小心地将拉希莉亚斯的遗骸放在巨石阵上。你感觉到空气中传来一阵奇怪的震动。

english: You carefully place some cheese in the rat trap.
translation: 你小心地把一些乳酪放进老鼠陷阱里。

english: You carefully place the Jubbly on the spit-roast.
translation: 你小心地把Jubbly放在烤肉叉上。

english: You carefully place the balloon toad bait.
translation: 你小心地放好气球蟾蜍诱饵。

english: You carefully place the delivery address label over the existing label, covering it completely.
translation: 你小心地将送货地址标签贴在现有标签上，完全覆盖了它。

english: You carefully place the dragon crystal on the rock. The rocks seem to vibrate and hum and the crystal starts to glow. The vibration in the area diminishes, but the crystal continues to glow.
translation: 你小心地将龙之水晶放在岩石上。岩石似乎开始震动并发出嗡嗡声，水晶也开始发光。该区域的震动减弱了，但水晶继续发光。

english: You carefully place the glowing, heart-shaped crystal into the depression. It slots in perfectly and glows even brighter. You hear a snapping sound coming from in front of the cave.
translation: 你小心地将发光的、心形的水晶放入凹陷处。它完美地嵌入其中，并且光芒更加明亮。你听到洞穴前方传来一声断裂声。

english: You carefully place the large ornate key into the statue's hands. You hear a grinding sound as the hands move downwards, then a mechanical click to the north.
translation: 你小心地将大型装饰钥匙放入雕像的手中。你听到雕像的手向下移动时发出的摩擦声，然后北边传来一声机械的咔哒声。

english: You carefully pour all of the alcohol into the keg. Once done, you do a double take as somehow there appears to be far more inside the keg than you actually put in.
translation: 你小心地将所有酒精倒入酒桶中。完成后，你定睛一看，发现酒桶里的酒似乎比你实际倒进去的多得多。

english: You carefully pour the ashes into the chalice and remove Baxtorian's treasure...
translation: 你小心地将骨灰倒入圣杯中，并取走了巴克托里安的宝藏……

english: You carefully prise the pickaxe from the unfortunate dwarf's cold, dead hands.
translation: 你小心地从那个不幸的矮人冰冷、毫无生气的手中撬出了镐子。

english: You carefully remove and reshape the axe head...
translation: 你小心地取下斧头并重新塑形……

english: You carefully remove the decorations from the Fiery Ornate Pool of Rejuvenation.
translation: 你小心地从华丽的回春池上取下装饰。

english: You carefully remove the gems from the glowing orb.
translation: 你小心地从发光宝珠中取出宝石。

english: You carefully remove the statue's left arm. It's very heavy.
translation: 你小心地取下雕像的左臂。它非常重。

english: You carefully remove the statue's left leg. It's very heavy.
translation: 你小心地取下雕像的左腿。它非常重。

english: You carefully remove the statue's right arm. It's very heavy.
translation: 你小心地取下雕像的右臂。它非常重。

english: You carefully remove the statue's right leg. It's very heavy.
translation: 你小心地取下雕像的右腿。它非常重。

english: You carefully remove your freshly prepared [Fruity/Fresh/Bitter/Earthy/Smoked/Crunchy/Spicy/Fishy/Meaty/Rich/Fluffy/Salted] easter egg from the oven.
translation: 你小心地从烤箱中取出你刚准备好的[Fruity/Fresh/Bitter/Earthy/Smoked/Crunchy/Spicy/Fishy/Meaty/Rich/Fluffy/Salted]复活节彩蛋。

english: You carefully replace the gem, you notice the flow of energy reverse.
translation: 你小心地放回宝石，注意到能量流逆转了。

english: You carefully sanctify the oil in the sacred flame.
translation: 你小心地在圣火中净化了油。

english: You carefully search the bucket and find a knife... among other things.
translation: 你仔细搜索了桶，找到了一把刀……还有其他一些东西。

english: You carefully search the bucket, but apart from horrors to never be spoken of again, you find nothing of interest.
translation: 你仔细搜索了桶，但除了那些永远不该再提起的恐怖事物之外，你什么也没找到。

english: You carefully search the doll...
translation: 你仔细地搜查了玩偶……

english: You carefully shape the horn into a sharp knife.
translation: 你小心地将号角塑造成一把锋利的刀。

english: You carefully strap down the satchel of explosives.
translation: 你小心地绑好炸药背包。

english: You carefully take the chisel away from the expensive dragonstone.
translation: 你小心地把凿子从昂贵的龙石上移开。

english: You carefully thread the pieces of crocodile skin into the assembler and over time work the undead dragon, chicken thing into colours more suiting Masori equipment.
translation: 你小心地将鳄鱼皮碎片穿入组装器中，并随着时间的推移，将那只亡灵龙鸡之类的东西加工成更适合马索里装备的颜色。

english: You carefully use your knife on the loose tile and find a message hidden behind it.
translation: 你小心地用刀撬开松动的瓷砖，发现后面藏着一张字条。

english: You cast out your line into the well...
translation: 你把鱼线抛入井中……

english: You cast the spell in the swamp.
translation: 你在沼泽中施放了法术。

english: You catch a movement out of the corner of your eye.
translation: 你眼角余光瞥见一丝动静。

english: You catch a scorpion!
translation: 你抓到一只蝎子！

english: You caught [x] fish and earned [x] fishing XP.
translation: 你钓到了 [x] 条鱼，获得了 [x] 钓鱼经验。

english: You caught me again! That goose has a fearsome name which it only reveals to a select few, but it's all HONK and no bite.
translation: 又被你抓到了！那只鹅有一个可怕的名字，只对少数人透露，但它只会嘎嘎叫，不会咬人。

english: You caught me! But seriously, it's very soft and well worth a pet. Come back to me once you're done.
translation: 被你抓到了！不过说真的，它非常柔软，值得一摸。等你完事了再来找我。

english: You caught something?! That's incredible! How did you do it?
translation: 你抓到东西了？！太不可思议了！你是怎么做到的？

english: You cautiously enter the cave...
translation: 你小心翼翼地进入洞穴……

english: You certainly look different, [player name].
translation: [player name]，你看起来确实不一样了。

english: You change your mind. You and your cat aren't ready to deal with the King Rat just yet.
translation: 你改变了主意。你和你的猫还没准备好对付鼠王。

english: You charge your Ring of the Elements.
translation: 你给你的元素戒指充能。

english: You charge your trinket with 10,000,000 coins.
translation: 你给你的小饰品充入了 10,000,000 金币。

english: You check for a pulse, but she's dead.
translation: 你检查了脉搏，但她已经死了。

english: You check for a wallet or watch, but someone must have looted them already.
translation: 你检查了钱包或手表，但肯定已经被人搜刮过了。

english: You check the cat's bed. It sure could use a little bit of love... and a lot of repairs. It's made of a luxurious fluffy fur that you don't recognise. It looks like someone has intentionally cut off a small bit of it.
translation: 你检查了猫的床。它确实需要一点关爱……以及大量的修理。它是由一种你不认识的奢华蓬松毛皮制成的。看起来有人故意剪掉了一小块。

english: You chip off some dust from the rock.
translation: 你从岩石上凿下了一些灰尘。

english: You chop off some of the tree's snow-covered branches to fashion your outfit.
translation: 你砍下一些树上积雪覆盖的树枝来制作你的服装。

english: You chop off some of the tree's snow-covered branches, dropping some to the floor.
translation: 你砍下一些树上积雪覆盖的树枝，有些掉到了地上。

english: You chop some bark from the hespori.
translation: 你从赫斯波里身上剥下一些树皮。

english: You chose such a regal little dog. Perfection!
translation: 你选了这么一只高贵的小狗。完美！

english: You chose wrong side, puny human!
translation: 你选错了边，弱小的人类！

english: You claim the Saradomin does things out of his own selfishness. How can that be true if he is the one who only seeks peace and not chaos?
translation: 你声称萨拉多明行事出于自私。但如果他追求的只有和平而非混乱，这又怎么会是真的呢？

english: You clean out the cannon.
translation: 你清理了大炮。

english: You clean the stained armour with the potion, it works!
translation: 你用那瓶药水清洗了污渍斑斑的盔甲，它起作用了！

english: You clean the wall, revealing the number 2 written into it.
translation: 你清理了墙壁，露出了上面写着的数字 2。

english: You cleanly cut the plaque of letters away from the rock. You place it carefully into your inventory.
translation: 你干净利落地将那块刻有字母的牌匾从岩石上切下。你小心地把它放进背包里。

english: You clear out the last of the rubble.
translation: 你清除了最后一点瓦砾。

english: You cleverly use the rope to slowly lower yourself to the floor.
translation: 你巧妙地用绳子慢慢把自己降到地面上。

english: You climb down into the cave.
translation: 你爬进洞穴。

english: You climb down into the hole.
translation: 你爬进洞里。

english: You climb down the rope.
translation: 你顺着绳子爬下去。

english: You climb down the steps.
translation: 你走下台阶。

english: You climb down through the tunnel.
translation: 你顺着隧道爬了下去。

english: You climb inside the crate and wait.
translation: 你爬进板条箱里等待。

english: You climb into the barrel and push off the edge. You are carried down the river.
translation: 你爬进桶里，推离岸边。你顺着河流被冲走了。

english: You climb into the well...
translation: 你爬进井里……

english: You climb onto the plank and swim to shore.
translation: 你爬上木板，游到了岸边。

english: You climb onto the rock...
translation: 你爬上岩石……

english: You climb out of the crate.
translation: 你从板条箱里爬了出来。

english: You climb over the rocks.
translation: 你翻过岩石。

english: You climb the stairs.
translation: 你爬上楼梯。

english: You climb through the hole and find yourself back in the basement.
translation: 你爬过洞口，发现自己回到了地下室。

english: You climb through the hole and find yourself in an old tunne.
translation: 你爬过洞口，发现自己身处一条旧隧道中。

english: You climb up into the pipe...
translation: 你爬进管道……

english: You climb up onto the cart, and nimbly jump from one side...
translation: 你爬上推车，灵活地从一边跳到另一边……

english: You climb up the mud pile.
translation: 你爬上泥堆。

english: You climb up the rocks and into a dark tunnel...
translation: 你攀上岩石，进入了一条黑暗隧道……

english: You climb up the rope and out of the pit.
translation: 你顺着绳子爬出了深坑。

english: You climb up the rope ladder...
translation: 你爬上了绳梯……

english: You climb up the rope.
translation: 你顺着绳子爬上去。

english: You climb up the sand pile.
translation: 你爬上沙堆。

english: You climb up the steps.
translation: 你走上台阶。

english: You climb up the wall while the vampyre is distracted.
translation: 趁吸血鬼分神之际，你爬上了墙壁。

english: You climb up through the sewer pipe.
translation: 你从下水道管道爬了上去。

english: You climb up through the tunnel.
translation: 你从隧道里爬上去。

english: You close the compost bin.
translation: 你关上堆肥箱。

english: You close the manhole cover.
translation: 你盖上检查井盖。

english: You close the valve.
translation: 你关上了阀门。

english: You close your eyes and sip the drink.
translation: 你闭上眼睛，小口抿了一口饮料。

english: You close your gem bag.
translation: 你合上你的宝石袋。

english: You collect 100 offerings.
translation: 你收集了 100 份祭品。

english: You collect a bucket full of glistening Wester Island sand.
translation: 你收集了满满一桶闪闪发光的西岛沙子。

english: You collect a pheasant egg and find a feather too.
translation: 你捡起一个雉鸡蛋，还找到了一根羽毛。

english: You collect a pheasant egg.
translation: 你捡起一个雉鸡蛋。

english: You collect some [Varlamorian potion] from the mixing vessel.
translation: 你从混合容器中收集了一些[Varlamorian potion]。

english: You collect your ore from the sack.
translation: 你从麻袋里取出了你的矿石。

english: You collect your ore from the sack. The sack is now empty.
translation: 你从麻袋里取出了你的矿石。麻袋现在空了。

english: You combine Darklight with the shards and it seems to glow in your hands creating Arclight. Your Arclight has 1000 charges.
translation: 你将黑暗之光与碎片结合，它在你手中似乎发出光芒，形成了弧光剑。你的弧光剑有 1000 次充能。

english: You combine Ghommal's hilt 5 with your Avernic defender (l), creating Ghommal's avernic defender 5 (l)
translation: 你将戈马尔的剑柄 5 与你的阿弗尼克格挡匕首 (锁定) 结合，制造出戈马尔的阿弗尼克格挡匕首 5 (锁定)

english: You combine Ghommal's hilt 5 with your Avernic defender, creating Ghommal's avernic defender 5
translation: 你将戈马尔的剑柄 5 与你的阿弗尼克格挡匕首结合，制造出戈马尔的阿弗尼克格挡匕首 5

english: You combine the Trailblazer reloaded bulwark ornament kit with the Dinh's bulwark.
translation: 你将开拓者重归门盾装饰套件与丁的门盾结合。

english: You combine the echo crystal with your guardian boots, making some echo boots with 6,000 charges.
translation: 你将回响水晶与你的守护者靴结合，制造出一双有 6,000 次充能的回响靴。

english: You combine the ingredients together, adding the festive cinnamon and then the festive holly into the festive white wine, just like the squire said...
translation: 你按照侍从说的那样，将材料混合在一起，先把节日肉桂、再把节日冬青加入节日白葡萄酒中……

english: You combine the questionable items together to create something that could scare Death himself!
translation: 你把那些可疑的物品组合在一起，创造出能吓到死神本人的东西！

english: You combine the scraps of paper together.
translation: 你把碎纸片拼在了一起。

english: You combine the spools. Your spool can now hold 10,000 strings.
translation: 你合并了线轴。你的线轴现在可以容纳 10,000 根线。

english: You combine the spools. Your spool can now hold 500 strings.
translation: 你合并了线轴。你的线轴现在可以容纳 500 根线。

english: You combine the two halves to make a complete certificate.
translation: 你将两半拼合，做成了一张完整的证书。

translation: 你把你的鱼桶和鱼袋组合成一个鱼袋桶。

translation: 你把你的原木篮、林业套件和坚固安全带组合在一起。

translation: 你混合了材料，但完全搞错了顺序——先把节日冬青、再把节日肉桂加进了节日白葡萄酒……

english: You come to a huge waterfall...
translation: 你来到一个巨大的瀑布前……

english: You come to speak [player name], [player name]?
translation: [player name]，你是来找[player name]说话的吗？

english: You contort your body and prepare to squirm worm like into the hole.
translation: 你扭曲身体，准备像蠕虫一样钻进洞里。

english: You contort your body to fit the crevice.
translation: 你扭曲身体挤进裂缝。

english: You cook the stuffed snake to perfection.
translation: 你把填馅蛇烤得恰到好处。

english: You cough up something sharp!
translation: 你咳出了一些尖锐的东西！

english: You could almost certainly clean it out, but you would need something very strong to clean it out with.
translation: 你几乎肯定能把它清理干净，但你需要非常强力的东西才行。

english: You could be right, I've not heard of any Sir Willy Nilly.
translation: 你可能是对的，我从没听说过什么威利.尼利爵士。

english: You could have just asked!
translation: 你直接问不就行了！

english: You could place pumpkins on the ground to make pictures, and take photographs to send to your friends. It's up to you! Thank you again, [player name].
translation: 你可以把南瓜摆在地上拼成图案，然后拍照发给朋友们。随你便！再次感谢你，[player name]。

english: You could speak to Karim the kebab seller. He's the person I started speaking to before he realised I'm a big bunny and ran off.
translation: 你可以跟卖烤肉的卡里姆谈谈。我一开始就是跟他说话，后来他发现我是一只大兔子就跑掉了。

english: You could talk to Shantay though. He's south of Al Kharid at the pass.
translation: 不过你可以跟沙泰谈谈。他在阿尔卡里德城以南的关口。

english: You could trick them instead like some of the people are doing.
translation: 你也可以像有些人那样，反过来骗他们。

english: You could've let me know! I almost had a heart attack.
translation: 你倒是提前说一声啊！我差点心脏病发作。

english: You couldn't have a beach party without a selection of Blurberry's finest cocktails! So can I offer you something?

english: You couldn't have a party without a selection of Blurberry's finest cocktails! So can I offer you something?

translation: 你用木板制作了半条临时人行道。

translation: 你走过跳板。

translation: 你走过放下的桥

translation: 你碾碎蘑菇，将汁液倒入一个小瓶。

translation: 你碾碎了蘑菇，但没有小瓶来装染料，结果洒得到处都是！

english: You cut a dead branch from the plant.
translation: 你从植物上切下一根枯枝。

english: You cut a shard from the crystal.
translation: 你从水晶上切下一块碎片。

translation: 你从白树上切下一根嫩枝。

translation: 你砍下一些亡灵树枝。

translation: 你切开树木，让一些树液滴入你的桶里。

english: You cut through the vines.
translation: 你砍断了藤蔓。

english: You cut yourself on the rusty old railing.
translation: 你被生锈的旧栏杆割伤了。

english: You dangle the toad crunchie above the gnome's nose just out of reach and hold the feather menacingly close to his feet.
translation: 你把蟾蜍脆饼悬在地精鼻子前，让他够不着，同时把羽毛威胁性地靠近他的脚。

english: You dare not drink this outside of the apothecary's establishment. At least there the apothecary may be able to help you if you need assistance.
translation: 你不敢在药剂师的店铺之外喝这个。至少在那里，如果你需要帮助，药剂师或许能帮上忙。

english: You dare not put the barrel back in the mine cart. The guards might see you.
translation: 你不敢把桶放回矿车里。守卫可能会看见你。

english: You decide against drinking the potion.
translation: 你决定不喝这瓶药水。

english: You decide against forcing yourself into the tiny crevice.
translation: 你决定不强行钻进那条小裂缝。

english: You decide it's wise to leave the murder weapon behind.
translation: 你决定明智地留下凶器。

english: You decide not to allow the crystal to draw on your spiritual energy.
translation: 你决定不让水晶汲取你的精神能量。

english: You decide not to attack Lucien. He is your friend.
translation: 你决定不攻击卢西安。他是你的朋友。

english: You decide not to attract the attention of the witch by playing on the piano.
translation: 你决定不弹钢琴以免引起女巫的注意。

english: You decide not to fight the Mercenary Captain.
translation: 你决定不与雇佣兵队长战斗。

english: You decide not to give [player name] anything!
translation: 你决定不给[player name]任何东西！

english: You decide not to open the door.
translation: 你决定不开门。

english: You decide not to open the scroll. But instead place it carefully back in your inventory.
translation: 你决定不打开卷轴，而是小心地把它放回你的背包里。

english: You decide not to shimmy down the rope. It's scary down there!
translation: 你决定不顺着绳子滑下去。下面太吓人了！

english: You decide not to steal the staff as you have agreed to help the Guardians.
translation: 你决定不偷法杖，因为你已同意帮助守护者。

english: You decide not to take the pickaxe.
translation: 你决定不拿镐子。

english: You decide not to travel to the Wilderness.
translation: 你决定不去荒野。

english: You decide that discretion is the better part of valour.
translation: 你决定谨慎行事才是上策。

english: You decide that the surface is the place for you!
translation: 你认定地面才是你该待的地方！

english: You decide to climb on the cart.
translation: 你决定爬上推车。

english: You decide to enter the caves. You climb down several steep rock faces into the cavern below.
translation: 你决定进入洞穴。你顺着几处陡峭的岩壁爬进了下方的洞穴。

english: You decide to have another look around. And see if you can find a better way to get out.
translation: 你决定再四处看看，看能不能找到更好的出路。

english: You decide to leave Eadgar's stew alone.
translation: 你决定不去动埃德加的炖菜。

english: You decide to leave the rocks well alone. The ceiling does look a little unsafe.
translation: 你决定不去碰那些岩石。天花板看起来确实有点不安全。

english: You decide to stay where you are!
translation: 你决定待在原地！

english: You decide to throw the item away.
translation: 你决定扔掉这个物品。

english: You decide you better not steal anything else from the church... But instead pray for forgiveness, while you're here.
translation: 你决定最好别再偷教堂里的东西了……不过既然来了，就祈祷宽恕吧。

english: You decorate the Ornate pool of Rejuvenation using your Trailblazer reloaded rejuvenation pool scroll.
translation: 你使用开拓者重归回春池卷轴装饰了精致的回春池。

english: You defeat Nazastarool and the corpse falls to the ground. The bones start to move again and soon they reform into a grisly giant skeleton.
translation: 你击败了纳扎斯塔鲁尔，尸体倒在地上。骨头又开始移动，很快重新组合成一个可怕的巨型骷髅。

english: You defeat Nazastarool and the skeleton falls to the ground. An ethereal form starts taking shape above the bones and you soon face the vengeful ghost of Nazastarool.
translation: 你击败了纳扎斯塔鲁尔，骷髅倒在地上。一个虚无的形态开始在骨骸上方成形，你很快便面对了纳扎斯塔鲁尔充满复仇怨念的幽灵。

english: You did well getting Anti-Santa out of Death's house. You show considerable promise as an adventurer.
translation: 你把反圣诞老人从死亡之屋弄出来干得不错。你展现出了作为冒险者的巨大潜力。

english: You did? Why didn't you tell me earlier?
translation: 你做了？怎么不早点告诉我？

english: You dig a hole in the ground, then carefully lay down the skeleton of the chieftain's daughter, together with her necklace. You then close the hole, creating a small burial mound. Now all you need to do is build a cairn on top.
translation: 你在地上挖了一个洞，然后小心地放下酋长女儿的骸骨和她的项链。接着你封上洞口，造了一个小小的墓冢。现在你只需要在上面堆一个石冢就行了。

english: You dig a hole in the ground...
translation: 你在地上挖了一个洞……

english: You dig a hole...
translation: 你挖了一个洞……

english: You dye the skull emblem [blue/red/yellow/orange/green/purple].
