english: You eat a fish.
translation: 你吃了一条鱼。

english: You eat a kebab.
translation: 你吃了一个烤肉。

english: You eat the spider snack. It makes you feel surprisingly comfortable.
translation: 你吃了蜘蛛零食。它让你感到出奇地舒服。

english: You empower the last totem and the altar begins to give off magical energy.
translation: 你为最后一个图腾注入力量，祭坛开始散发出魔法能量。

english: You empty as many logs as you can carry.
translation: 你尽可能多地清空了原木。

english: You empty the lava into the furnace.
translation: 你把熔岩倒进了熔炉。

english: You empty the sand from the coin purse.
translation: 你将钱袋里的沙子倒空。

english: You empty your basket.
translation: 你清空了你的篮子。

english: You enter the basement.
translation: 你进入了地下室。

english: You enter the height and y coordinates you got from the tracker gnomes.
translation: 你输入了从追踪地精那里得到的高度和Y座标。

english: You enter the icy cavern.
translation: 你进入了冰冷洞穴。

english: You enter the passageway, and it takes you to the roof of the tower.
translation: 你进入通道，它带你来到了塔的屋顶。

english: You enter the waterfall.
translation: 你进入了瀑布。

english: You enter this blackened, charred area - it looks like some sort of explosion has taken place.
translation: 你走进这片焦黑、烧毁的区域——看起来像是发生过某种爆炸。

english: You enter this blackened, charred area - it looks there's been an explosion!
translation: 你走进这片焦黑、烧毁的区域——看起来发生过爆炸！

english: You erect a [wood type] totem. It's now ready to be carved. Ranulph and Isadora might be able to tell you how.
translation: 你竖立起一个[wood type]图腾。现在可以雕刻了。拉努尔夫和伊莎多拉或许能告诉你怎么做。

english: You evaporate the naphtha and you're left with a powdery residue on the insides of the barrel.
translation: 你蒸发了石脑油，桶内留下了一层粉末状的残留物。

english: You eventually manage to lift the lid.
translation: 你终于设法掀开了盖子。

english: You exchange a tome for 25 soaked pages.
translation: 你用一本书交换了25张浸湿的书页。

english: You exchange the fish for Caleb's piece of the crest.
translation: 你用鱼交换了卡莱布的那块徽章碎片。

english: You exchange the promissory note.
translation: 你兑换了期票。

english: You exchange the scroll for the magical scrying orb. Perhaps Zavistic can give you even more of a hand to find the murderer?
translation: 你用卷轴交换了魔法占卜球。也许扎维斯蒂克能给你更多帮助来找出凶手？

english: You exchange the wax with the candle maker for a black candle.
translation: 你与蜡烛制造商交换了蜡，得到一根黑色蜡烛。

english: You exit the dungeon.
translation: 你离开了地牢。

english: You expand your forestry kit/basket to be able to hold a Woodcutting cape.
translation: 你扩充了你的林业套件/篮子，使其能够容纳一件伐木斗篷。

english: You explain everything that happened.
translation: 你解释了发生的一切。

english: You extinguish the abyssal lantern.
translation: 你熄灭了深渊灯笼。

english: You fail to damage the hull.
translation: 你未能对船体造成损伤。

english: You failed to stay close enough to the guard.
translation: 你未能与守卫保持足够近的距离。

english: You failed to stay hidden from the guard.
translation: 你未能躲开守卫的视线。

english: You fall in the water with a splash!
translation: 你扑通一声掉进了水里！

english: You fall into a deep trance. When you awaken, you feel perfectly at ease, as though the gods themselves have smiled upon you.
translation: 你陷入了深深的出神状态。当你醒来时，感到完全放松，仿佛众神都对你微笑。

english: You fall through and onto some spikes.
translation: 你掉了下去，落在一些尖刺上。

english: You feed some poisoned sheep food to the sheep. It happily eats it.
translation: 你给羊喂了一些有毒的羊饲料。它高兴地吃了起来。

english: You feed the egg to Little Nightmare. It starts to change...
translation: 你把蛋喂给了小梦魇。它开始变化……

english: You feel a chill touch as the spirit removes the dagger from your hand.
translation: 当灵魂从你手中拿走匕首时，你感到一阵冰冷的触感。

english: You feel a cold shudder run down your spine as the light of the orb fades.
translation: 随著宝珠的光芒熄灭，你感到一股冰冷的寒意窜过脊背。

english: You feel a dark power emanating from something in your backpack.
translation: 你感觉到背包里的某样东西散发出一股黑暗力量。

english: You feel a ghostly presence about you.
translation: 你感觉到周围有一股幽灵般的气息。

english: You feel a little better, emotionally, after your cry.
translation: 哭过之后，你感觉情绪上好了一些。

english: You feel a little green.
translation: 你感觉有点不舒服。

english: You feel a lot calmer now, but it didn't achieve anything else.
translation: 你现在感觉平静多了，但除此之外没有其他效果。

english: You feel a lot calmer now, but it didn't achieve anything else. Maybe you should be using the iron sheet on the wall instead.
translation: 你现在感觉平静多了，但除此之外没有其他效果。也许你应该改用铁板对著墙壁使用。

english: You feel a painful shiver in your spine.
translation: 你感到脊椎一阵刺痛。

english: You feel a power emanating from the fountain as it recharges your jewellery.
translation: 当喷泉为你的首饰充能时，你感到一股力量从中散发出来。

english: You feel a strange sensation as the Tasakaal enchant the potion.
translation: 当塔萨卡尔为药水附魔时，你感到一阵奇异的感觉。

english: You feel a strange sensation as the Tasakaal magically inspect the device.
translation: 当塔萨卡尔用魔法检查装置时，你感到一阵奇异的感觉。

english: You feel a strange sensation as the Tasakaal replace your potion.
translation: 当塔萨卡尔更换你的药水时，你感到一阵奇异的感觉。

english: You feel a strange tingling as the Sphinx casts her enchantment upon you.
translation: 当斯芬克斯对你施展魔法时，你感到一阵奇异的刺痛。

english: You feel a toad in your throat.
translation: 你感觉喉咙里像有只蟾蜍。

english: You feel awful.
translation: 你感觉很糟糕。

english: You feel closer to the gods...
translation: 你感觉离神明更近了……

english: You feel death nod inside your head.
translation: 你感觉到死亡在你脑中点头。

english: You feel everything sway.
translation: 你感觉一切都在摇晃。

english: You feel for the pins and levers in the mechanism.
translation: 你摸索著机构中的插销和拉杆。

english: You feel it might be pointless rematching Wilough without the dagger from Horvik...
translation: 你觉得没有霍维克的那把匕首，再跟威洛打一场可能没什么意义……

english: You feel like that word has potential, but you can't think of any suitable translations for it at the moment.
translation: 你觉得这个词有潜力，但你目前想不出任何合适的翻译。

english: You feel like you could trade in some of your Abyssal pearls for additional loot, if you had more of them.
translation: 你觉得如果你有更多深渊珍珠，或许可以用一些来换取额外战利品。

english: You feel like you could trade in some of your Abyssal pearls for additional loot...
translation: 你觉得你可以用一些深渊珍珠来换取额外战利品……

english: You feel like you're nearly there...
translation: 你感觉就快到了……

english: You feel power emanate from the Amulet of Ghostspeak, and the air around you vibrates with the ghostly voice of the Headless Gardener...
translation: 你感到幽灵低语项链散发出力量，周围的空气随著无头园丁的幽灵声音而震动……

english: You feel really pleased with yourself.
translation: 你对自己非常满意。

english: You feel so relaxed! It's like you're never going to move again.
translation: 你感觉如此放松！仿佛再也不想动了。

english: You feel that taking more than one Holy Grail might be greedy...
translation: 你觉得拿走超过一个圣杯可能太贪心了……

english: You feel that the Grail shouldn't be moved. You must complete some task here before you are worthy.
translation: 你觉得圣杯不应该被移动。你必须在这里完成某项任务才能证明你的资格。

english: You feel that you've translated enough words to fully understand all of the stone tablets!
translation: 你觉得你已经翻译了足够多的词语，可以完全理解所有石板了！

english: You feel that you've translated enough words to read some of the text on the stone tablet.
translation: 你觉得你已经翻译了足够多的词语，可以阅读石板上的部分文字了。

english: You feel the crate being lifted.
translation: 你感觉到板条箱被抬了起来。

english: You feel the crate being put down inside the ship.
translation: 你感觉到板条箱被放进了船里。

english: You feel the crate being put down.
translation: 你感觉到板条箱被放了下来。

english: You feel the crystal trying to draw upon your spiritual energy. Do you want to let it?
translation: 你感觉到水晶试图吸取你的精神能量。你要让它吸取吗？

english: You feel the power flowing up into your arm. You can direct it into any combat skill...
translation: 你感觉到力量涌入你的手臂。你可以将它导向任何战斗技能……

english: You feel the ship start to move.
translation: 你感觉到船开始移动了。

english: You feel tired...
translation: 你感到疲倦……

english: You feel woozy...
translation: 你感到头晕目眩……

english: You feel you have learnt something about the nature of the mystery fruit by drinking this.
translation: 你觉得喝了这神秘水果后，对它的本质有了些了解。

english: You feel your eyes closing...

translation: 你找到一些东西，似乎能解释凯尔达格林城那个醉酒矮人的遭遇。你应该在继续之前仔细阅读。

english: You find something...
translation: 你找到了一些东西……

english: You find the Easter egg mould awkwardly buried in the ground.
translation: 你找到复活节彩蛋模具，它尴尬地埋在地里。

translation: 你找到了仙子女王的修枝剪！

translation: 你找到了仑桥镇的银器！

translation: 你找到了大门的钥匙。

translation: 你找到了你遗失的信件。

english: You find the topmost part of a ladder.
translation: 你找到了梯子的最顶端部分。

english: You find the word 'SMELL' carved into the rock wall, by the outline of the door. What would you like to do?
translation: 你发现岩墙上，在门的轮廓旁边刻着“SMELL”这个词。你想怎么做？

english: You find treasure and supplies within the chest.
translation: 你在箱子里找到宝藏和补给品。

translation: 你在箱子里找到宝藏、补给品和一个颜色怪异的卵囊。

english: You find two candlesticks in the chest. So that will be one for you, and one for the person who killed Grip for you.
translation: 你在箱子里找到两根烛台。所以一根给你，一根给帮你杀死格里普的人。

english: You find two green stones and two yellow stones in the storage box.
translation: 你在储物箱里找到两颗绿色石头和两颗黄色石头。

english: You find what appears to be a To-Do list for the day, some sort of odd potion recipe and what can only be described as a shrunken vegetable of some sort.
translation: 你找到一份似乎是当天的待办清单、某种奇怪的药水配方，以及只能形容为某种缩水蔬菜的东西。

translation: 你发现自己身处一个洞穴中……

translation: 你发现自己身处河岸，远在湖泊的下方。

english: You find yourself washed up ashore, somewhere.
translation: 你发现自己被冲到某个地方的海岸上。

english: You finish carving the totem, but it still seems to be missing something. Ranulph and Isadora might know what to do next.
translation: 你完成了图腾的雕刻，但它似乎还缺少些什么。拉努尔夫和伊莎多拉可能知道下一步该怎么做。

english: You fire the cannon at the crew!
translation: 你向船员们开炮！

translation: 你朝支撑桥的绳子射了一箭。

english: You fit the lever into the bracket.
translation: 你将拉杆装入支架中。

english: You fix the golem's legs.
translation: 你修好了魔像的腿。

english: You flee from the fight.
translation: 你逃离了战斗。

english: You flick through a lifetime of notes on demon slaying, absorbing what you can. One passage catches your eye...
translation: 你快速翻阅了一生积累的屠魔笔记，尽可能吸收内容。其中一段引起了你的注意……

english: You flick through the old notes, but don't learn anything new.
translation: 你快速翻阅了破旧的纸条，但没有学到任何新东西。

english: You flip the [gemstone] switch.
translation: 你扳动了[gemstone]开关。

english: You flip the book open to the introduction and start reading.

english: You fly on the glider.

english: You fool! Do you not realise what you have done!?
translation: 你这个傻瓜！你难道不明白你做了什么吗！？

english: You found a 'Voice of doom' potion!
translation: 你找到了一瓶“末日之声”药水！

english: You found me! Here is your third clue.
translation: 你找到我了！这是你的第三条线索。

english: You found some bones! They look decidedly human.

english: You get one try, so make sure you do good try.

translation: 你把猴尸交给了塔马尤。

translation: 你交出了便条、合同、瓶子和标签。

translation: 你交出了吊坠。

translation: 你递上了馅饼。

translation: 你交出了鸽子笼。

translation: 你交出了披萨和钱。

english: You hand over the proposal, the sawmill operator glances over it before signing and returning the document.
translation: 你递上提案，锯木厂操作员扫了一眼，签了字，然后把文件还给了你。

english: You hand over the report. The man reads the report.
translation: 你递上报告。那人读了起来。

english: You hand over the shield half.
translation: 你交出了盾牌的一半。

english: You hand over the shipment in exchange for some Dried cocoa.
translation: 你交出货物，换回了一些干可可豆。

english: You hand over the signed documents.
translation: 你交出了已签署的文件。

english: You hand over the troll's weather station and she promptly consumes the log book full of data.
translation: 你交出了巨魔的气象站，她立刻把装满数据的日志本吃掉了。

english: You hand over your bucket of fresh camel dung and receive a vial of poison in return.
translation: 你递上一桶新鲜的骆驼粪便，换回了一小瓶毒药。

english: You hand some salt to the embalmer.
translation: 你递给防腐师一些盐。

english: You hand the Choco serum over to the Easter Bunny.
translation: 你把巧克力血清交给了复活节兔子。

translation: 你把身份证件交给了格里普。

english: You hand the Troll King's head to Mawnis Burowgar.
translation: 你把巨魔国王的头颅交给了莫尼斯.布罗加。

english: You hand the ale to the dwarf who slurps it with a noise of a thousand seals celebrating a rain of fish.
translation: 你把麦芽酒递给矮人，他喝起来的声音就像一千只海豹在庆祝鱼雨。

english: You hand the apothecary the ingredients. He adds a few herbs of his own before handing back the foul-smelling concoction.
translation: 你把材料递给药剂师。他加了几种自己的草药，然后递回一瓶气味难闻的混合物。

english: You hand the ash, flour, water and redberries to Aggie. Aggie tips the ingredients into a cauldron and mutters some words.
translation: 你把灰烬、面粉、水和红莓递给阿吉。阿吉把材料倒进大锅，嘴里念念有词。

english: You hand the ash, flour, water and redberries to Aggie. She tips the ingredients into a cauldron and mutters some words.
translation: 你把灰烬、面粉、水和红莓递给阿吉。她把材料倒进大锅，嘴里念念有词。

english: You hand the basket with the charmed snake over to the old hag.
translation: 你把装着被施了魔法的蛇的篮子递给了老巫婆。

english: You hand the big bucket of milk to the Easter Bunny.
translation: 你把一大桶牛奶递给了复活节兔子。

english: You hand the book to Reldo.
translation: 你把书递给了雷尔多。

english: You hand the cake over to Pete.
translation: 你把蛋糕递给了皮特。

english: You hand the cleaned armour to Sir Vyvin.
translation: 你把清理干净的盔甲递给了维文爵士。

english: You hand the coupon over to Benny.
translation: 你把优惠券递给了班尼。

english: You hand the crumpled scroll to Trufitus.
translation: 你把皱巴巴的卷轴递给了特鲁菲图斯。

english: You hand the crystal seed to Eluned.
translation: 你把水晶种子递给了埃卢内德。

english: You hand the dagger over to the shaman and his face turns pale.
translation: 你把匕首递给萨满，他的脸色变得苍白。

english: You hand the dark dagger to the spirit.
translation: 你把黑暗匕首递给了幽灵。

english: You hand the doorman a sales receipt for the camel.
translation: 你把骆驼的销售收据递给了门卫。

english: You hand the empty vial to Safalaan who uses his blade to fill it with his own blood.
translation: 你把空瓶递给萨法兰，他用刀刃割破自己，把血装进瓶里。

english: You hand the goblin mail, whitefish, and payment to Aggie. She uses the whitefish to remove the dye from the goblin mail and then hands it back to you.
translation: 你把哥布林链甲、白鱼和报酬递给阿吉。她用白鱼去除哥布林链甲上的染料，然后把它还给了你。

english: You hand the guard a sales receipt for the camel.
translation: 你把骆驼的销售收据递给了守卫。

english: You hand the head wizard the research notes.He hands you back the Air Talisman.
translation: 你把研究笔记递给了首席魔法师。他把风护符还给了你。

english: You hand the king the message. He looks at the seal then opens it.
translation: 你把消息递给国王。他看了看封印，然后拆开了信。

english: You hand the magical scrying orb to the Wizard and watch as the recording is played back.
translation: 你把魔法占卜球递给魔法师，看着记录被回放出来。

english: You hand the map to Ned.
translation: 你把地图递给了内德。

english: You hand the monk a jug of water.
translation: 你递给僧侣一壶水。

english: You hand the monk the childs blanket.
translation: 你递给僧侣孩子的毯子。

english: You hand the monkeys over to the Duke.
translation: 你把猴子交给了公爵。

english: You hand the newly fixed sails over to the trader.
translation: 你把刚修好的船帆交给了商人。

english: You hand the notes over to Trufitus.
translation: 你把笔记交给了特鲁菲图斯。

english: You hand the notes to Sedridor.
translation: 你把笔记递给了塞德里多。

english: You hand the orb to Ava.
translation: 你把宝珠递给了艾娃。

english: You hand the orb to the Mage of Zamorak.
translation: 你把宝珠递给了扎莫拉克法师。

english: You hand the package to Aubury.
translation: 你把包裹递给了奥伯里。

english: You hand the paint to Da Vinci who makes a quick job of painting the wooden sword to look real.
translation: 你把颜料递给达芬奇，他很快就把木剑涂得跟真的一样。

english: You hand the polished gem to Da Vinci who inlays it into the pommel of the sword.
translation: 你把抛光后的宝石递给达芬奇，他把它镶嵌在剑柄上。

english: You hand the potion to the Wise Old Man.
translation: 你把药水递给了老智者。

english: You hand the present to Wyson.
translation: 你把礼物递给了怀森。

english: You hand the present to the hairdresser.
translation: 你把礼物递给了理发师。

english: You hand the proposal to Berry, he glances over it before signing and returning the document.
translation: 你把提案递给贝里，他扫了一眼，签了字，然后把文件还给了你。

english: You hand the repaired tin over to Patty.
translation: 你把修好的锡罐递给了帕蒂。

english: You hand the report over to Ali Morrisane.
translation: 你把报告递给了阿里.莫里桑。

english: You hand the spear to Tamayu.
translation: 你把长矛递给了塔马尤。

english: You hand the special hot sauce to Karim.
translation: 你把特制辣酱递给了卡里姆。

english: You hand the talisman to Sedridor.
translation: 你把护符递给了塞德里多。

english: You hand the tattered scroll to Trufitus.
translation: 你把破烂的卷轴递给了特鲁菲图斯。

english: You hand the tea to Nezketi, and after drinking it he departs for the temple.
translation: 你把茶递给内兹凯蒂，他喝完后便动身前往神殿。

english: You hand the teddy to Carol.
translation: 你把泰迪熊递给了卡罗尔。

english: You hand the token to the High Priest.
translation: 你把代币递给了大祭司。

english: You hand the treasure chest over to Capt' Arnav.
translation: 你把宝箱递给了阿纳夫船长。

english: You hand two more beers to the guard. He takes a sip of one, and then he drinks them both.
translation: 你又递给守卫两杯啤酒。他先抿了一口其中一杯，然后一口气把两杯都喝完了。

english: You hand two more beers to the guard. He takes a sip of one, and then he quickly drinks them both.
translation: 你又递给守卫两杯啤酒。他先抿了一口其中一杯，然后迅速把两杯都喝完了。

english: You hand your collection of tokens to the Collector, and in exchange he gives you some sort of a key.
translation: 你把你收集的代币交给了收藏家，作为交换，他给了你一把钥匙之类的东西。

english: You hand your log to Steve and he flicks through the pages. After a moment, he hands it back without writing anything in it.
translation: 你把日志递给史蒂夫，他快速翻了几页。过了一会儿，他把它还了回来，什么也没写。

english: You hand your log to Steve and he updates it with details on his request.
translation: 你把日志递给史蒂夫，他根据你的请求在上面更新了详细信息。

english: You happily start hacking away at the table but realise that you won't have enough wood to properly finish the item off!
translation: 你兴高采烈地开始劈砍桌子，但随即意识到木材不够，无法顺利完成这件物品。

english: You harvest the enriched snapdragon.
translation: 你收获了超级金鱼草。

english: You have [amount] charges left in your book.
translation: 你的书还有[amount]次使用次数。

english: You have [number] League Points at the moment. Take part in a League if you want to earn more.
translation: 你目前有[number]联赛积分。如果想获得更多，就参加联赛吧。

english: You have [number] catalytic energy and [number] elemental energy. You can use them to search the rift [number] times. You have searched the rift [number] times.
translation: 你拥有 [number] 点催化能量和 [number] 点元素能量。你可以用它们搜索裂隙 [number] 次。你已经搜索了裂隙 [number] 次。

english: You have [number] coins stored in the coffer.
translation: 你的保险箱里存有 [number] 枚金币。

english: You have [number] coins stored in the coffer. You need at least 1,000 coins to make a deposit.
translation: 你的保险箱里存有 [number] 枚金币。你需要至少 1,000 枚金币才能存入。

english: You have [number] treats stored in your Treat cauldron.

english: You have [number] treats stored.

english: You have a bad feeling about crawling into the next cavern.
translation: 你对爬进下一个洞穴有种不祥的预感。

translation: 你得到了鲍伯清晰的指纹印。

english: You have a clean impression of Carol's finger prints.

translation: 你得到了大卫清晰的指纹印。

translation: 你得到了凶手清晰的指纹印。

translation: 你有一个可以启动发电机的摇把。

english: You have a cunning plan to trick this troll. You need your pet rock, a cabbage, a potato and an onion.
translation: 你有一个欺骗这只巨魔的狡猾计划。你需要你的宠物石、一颗卷心菜、一个土豆和一个洋葱。

english: You have a deal.
translation: 成交。

english: You have a look at the notice board, but there isn't anything of interest on it.
translation: 你看了看公告板，但上面没什么有趣的东西。

english: You have a sneaking suspicion that you would have received a medium scroll box.
translation: 你隐约觉得你本来会收到一个中级卷轴盒。

english: You have a vague recollection that you accessed your bank.
translation: 你依稀记得你存取过你的银行。

english: You have a vague recollection that you had a fist fight with a banker.
translation: 你依稀记得你和一个银行职员打了一架。

english: You have accepted the Pandemonium pirate looty delivery port task.
translation: 你已接受了潘德莫尼姆岛海盗战利品运送的港口任务。

english: You have acquired a spooky picture, a chair, scarecrow and wall lamp. You should return to Fred in Lumbridge.
translation: 你获得了一幅诡异的图画、一把椅子、一个稻草人和一盏壁灯。你应该回到仑桥镇找弗雷德。

english: You have added all the pages to the folder that Rat gave to you. You should take this folder back to Rat.
translation: 你已经把所有的页面都放进了拉特给你的文件夹里。你应该把这个文件夹带回给拉特。

english: You have already been enlightened by the light of Saradomin. Perhaps you could give it to someone else.
translation: 你已经被萨拉多明的光芒启迪过了。也许你可以把它交给别人。

english: You have already claimed your daily slime and bonemeal. Come back again tomorrow for some more.
translation: 你已经领取了今天的粘液和骨粉。明天再来领取更多吧。

english: You have already completed this part of the map.
translation: 你已经完成了地图的这一部分。

english: You have already eggs-orcised the crypt!
translation: 你已经驱魔过这个墓穴了！

english: You have already excavated this area. Your spade clangs against the granite.
translation: 你已经挖掘过这个区域了。你的铲子敲在花岗岩上发出叮当声。

english: You have already found the book.

english: You have already found the emerald key.

translation: 你已经找到蓝宝石钥匙了。

translation: 你已经完全装饰好了图腾。拉努尔夫和伊莎多拉可能知道下一步该怎么做。

english: You have already gathered all the relevant weather data. You should now return this station to Meaty Aura Logist where she gave it to you.

english: You have already picked this colour.
translation: 你已经选过这个颜色了。

english: You have already poured brew over the tomb.
translation: 你已经把酿造液倒在坟墓上了。

english: You have already recovered the Accord.
translation: 你已经找回协议书了。

english: You have already replaced the delivery address label.
translation: 你已经更换了送货地址标签。

english: You have already searched this chest.
translation: 你已经搜过这个箱子了。

english: You have already strapped a satchel here.
translation: 你已经在这里绑上一个背包了。

english: You have already taken a copy of the note.
translation: 你已经拿了一份纸条的副本。

english: You have already taken the thread.
translation: 你已经拿过线了。

english: You have already unlocked everything there was to unlock. Talk to Diango or Party Pete to withdraw any of the unlocked items.
translation: 你已经解锁了所有可以解锁的东西。去找迪亚戈或派对皮特领取任何已解锁的物品。

english: You have already unlocked the spell. The scroll can be sold if you no longer need it.
translation: 你已经解锁了这个法术。如果你不再需要，可以把卷轴卖掉。

english: You have already unlocked the teleport to here.
translation: 你已经解锁了传送到这里的法术。

english: You have already unlocked this door.
translation: 你已经解锁这扇门了。

english: You have become diseased!
translation: 你染上疾病了！

english: You have been banned from playing Bounty Hunter for inappropriate behaviour.
translation: 你因不当行为被禁止参与赏金猎人活动。

english: You have been hit by poisoned arrows and knocked out!
translation: 你被毒箭射中，昏了过去！

english: You have been in such a world ending predicament before?! How did you survive?
translation: 你以前竟然遇到过这种世界末日的困境？！你是怎么活下来的？

english: You have been provided with expertise.
translation: 你获得了专业知识。

english: You have been rewarded 15,000 Defence XP!
translation: 你获得了 15,000 点防御经验值！

english: You have been rewarded 15,000 Hitpoints XP!
translation: 你获得了 15,000 点生命值经验值！

english: You have been rewarded 15,000 Magic XP!
translation: 你获得了 15,000 点魔法经验值！

english: You have been rewarded 15,000 Ranged XP!
translation: 你获得了 15,000 点远程经验值！

english: You have been rewarded 15,000 Strength XP!
translation: 你获得了 15,000 点力量经验值！

english: You have been stung by the nettles!
translation: 你被荨麻刺到了！

english: You have both old and new tickets, which shop do you want to open?
translation: 你既有旧票也有新票，你想打开哪个商店？

english: You have collected [X] chocolate kebbit chunks, you need [X] more.
translation: 你已经收集了 [X] 块巧克力凯比特兔肉块，还需要 [X] 块。

english: You have defeated [other player name].
translation: 你击败了[other player name]。

translation: 你存入了 1 个蛋，还需要 2 个才能完成对这位祭司的帮助。

translation: 你存入了 2 个蛋，还需要 1 个才能完成对这位祭司的帮助。

english: You have disabled the effects. You can visit the 'Settings' menu at any time to re-enable them.
translation: 你已禁用效果。你可以随时访问“设置”菜单重新启用它们。

english: You have earned the gratitude of the Museum; you can earn no higher Kudos at this time.
translation: 你赢得了博物馆的感激；目前你无法获得更高的声望了。

english: You have everything you need, so off you go! Plant those seeds!
translation: 你所需的一切都准备好了，出发吧！去种下那些种子！

english: You have failed to solve the riddle.
translation: 你未能解开谜题。

english: You have fallen through a trap!
translation: 你掉进了陷阱！

english: You have finished all your doses of [potion] in your barrel.
translation: 你桶子里的[potion]已经全部用完了。

english: You have finished boarding up the vulnerable windows.
translation: 你已经用木板封好了所有脆弱的窗户。

english: You have found [number] blood runes that were owed to you, following recent changes to the Vyre Well.
translation: 由于吸血鬼井最近的变动，你找到了 [number] 枚应得给你的血符文。

english: You have found a recipe.
translation: 你找到了一份食谱。

english: You have found a scroll!
translation: 你发现了一个卷轴！

english: You have found my garden I see.
translation: 看来你找到了我的花园。

english: You have found the soul bearer.
translation: 你找到了灵魂载体。

english: You have harvested [number] Herbiboars.
translation: 你收获了 [number] 只药草野猪。

english: You have imbued your Magic Shortbow.
translation: 你注入了你的魔法短弓。

english: You have learnt the 'Teleport to Target' spell.
translation: 你学会了“传送至目标”法术。

english: You have less than [X] minutes to deliver your current Aluft Aloft Delivery.
translation: 你剩下不到[X]分钟来完成目前的阿洛夫特快递。

english: You have less than a minute to deliver your current Aluft Aloft Delivery.
translation: 你剩下不到一分钟来完成目前的阿洛夫特快递。

english: You have made your order, please be patient while the gnome finds you.
translation: 你已经下了订单，请耐心等待地精来找你。

english: You have my thanks, I'd give you a reward, but I left my coin purse in the castle.
translation: 多谢你，我本想给你奖励，但我把钱袋落在城堡里了。

english: You have no bow strings to add.
translation: 你没有弓弦可以添加。

english: You have no brown spice to store.
translation: 你没有棕色香料可以存放。

english: You have no charcoal with which to sketch this subject.
translation: 你没有木炭来画这个主题的草图。

english: You have no grimy herbs in your inventory that can be stored in the sack.
translation: 你的背包里没有可以放进麻袋的未清洗草药。

english: You have no logs that can be stored in the basket.
translation: 你没有可以放进篮子的原木。

english: You have no logs that you are able to store right now.
translation: 你目前没有可以存放的原木。

english: You have no logs to build this beehive.
translation: 你没有原木来建造这个蜂箱。

english: You have no more inventory space for the items you found.
translation: 你背包的空间不足以容纳你找到的物品。

english: You have no need to apologise to me. It is you who must live with this.
translation: 你无需向我道歉。必须承受这一切的是你自己。

english: You have no options in your barrel that you can drink.
translation: 你的桶里没有可以喝的东西。

english: You have no orange spice to store.
translation: 你没有橙色香料可以存放。

english: You have no reason to climb that very wobbly looking ladder.
translation: 你没有理由爬上那把看起来摇摇晃晃的梯子。

english: You have no reason to do that.
translation: 你没有理由这么做。

english: You have no reason to go down there.
translation: 你没有理由去那里。

english: You have no reason to go in there.
translation: 你没有理由进去那里。

english: You have no reason to go through there.
translation: 你没有理由穿过那里。

english: You have no reason to use this boat.
translation: 你没有理由使用这艘船。

english: You have no red spice to store.
translation: 你没有红色香料可以存放。

english: You have no remaining charges in your Giantsoul amulet.
translation: 你的巨人之魂护符已经没有剩余充能了。

english: You have no room for any more logs of that type.
translation: 你已没有空间再装下那种类型的原木了。

english: You have no space in your bag
translation: 你的袋子里没有空间了

english: You have no space in your inventory for any loot you might find.
translation: 你的背包没有空间存放可能找到的战利品。

english: You have no use for this horn right now, best leave it here.
translation: 你现在用不上这个号角，最好把它留在这里。

english: You have no yellow spice to store.
translation: 你没有黄色香料可以存放。

english: You have not ever travelled to Waterbirth Island, [player name]? I am surprised, it is a place of outstanding natural beauty.
translation: [player name]，你从来没去过水诞岛吗？真让我惊讶，那里可是个风景绝美的地方。

english: You have not had extensive dealings with the mysterious Bob, I see, so you cannot possibly comprehend is enigmatic nature. I am confident that this man's autograph is what I need.
translation: 看来你和神秘的鲍勃没有太多往来，所以你不可能理解他那神秘的本质。我确信这个人的亲笔签名就是我需要的。

english: You have not unlocked that teleport yet.
translation: 你还没有解锁那个传送点。

english: You have not unlocked the machine yet...
translation: 你还没有解锁这台机器……

english: You have nothing left in your druid pouch!
translation: 你的德鲁伊的袋里已经什么都没有了！

english: You have nothing suitable for storing in the bag.
translation: 你没有适合存放在袋子里的东西。

english: You have nothing that can be charged here.
translation: 你这里没有可以充能的东西。

english: You have nothing that can be stored in the forestry kit.
translation: 你没有可以存放在林业套件里的东西。

english: You have nothing to imbue the altar with.
translation: 你没有东西可以注入祭坛。

english: You have now made a makeshift walkway over the bridge.
translation: 你现在已经在桥上搭起了一条临时人行道。

english: You have one charge left in your book.
translation: 你的书里还剩一次充能。

english: You have opened Bryophyta's chest a total of [#] times.
translation: 你总共打开了苔藓巨人的宝箱 [#] 次。

english: You have placed explosives on enough compromised locations to take down the entire platform.
translation: 你已在足够多的薄弱位置安放了炸药，足以摧毁整个平台。

english: You have plunder to deposit.
translation: 你有掠夺品要存放。

english: You have preparations to make. I would speak to my companion. Alone.
translation: 你还有准备工作要做。我想和我的同伴谈谈。单独谈。

english: You have protected the snow leopard habitat. Talk to the Conservationist to claim your reward.
translation: 你保护了雪豹的栖息地。去找环保主义者领取你的奖励。

english: You have proven your inner malevolence and earned this reward.
translation: 你证明了你内心的恶意，并赢得了这份奖励。

english: You have put [X] chocolate kebbits in the chute; you need to get [X] more.
translation: 你已经把 [X] 只巧克力凯比特兔放进了滑道；你还需要再抓 [X] 只。

english: You have regrown the amur leopard habitat. Talk to the Conservationist to claim your reward.
translation: 你重新培育了远东豹的栖息地。去找环保主义者领取你的奖励。

english: You have regrown the lion habitat. Talk to the Conservationist to claim your reward.
translation: 你重新培育了狮子的栖息地。去找环保主义者领取你的奖励。

english: You have restored the Family Crest.
translation: 你已修复了家徽。

english: You have restored the axe to its former glory! You should return to Blasidar in Keldagrim now, do you wish to return at once?
translation: 你让这把斧头恢复了往日的荣光！你现在应该回到凯尔达格林城找布拉西达，你想立刻回去吗？

english: You have served your Empire well, High Magister, but that servitude is at an end. Now it is time for a new one to begin.
translation: 大法师，你为帝国效力良多，但这份效劳已经结束了。现在是时候开始新的效劳了。

english: You have set Merlin free. Now talk to King Arthur.
translation: 你释放了梅林。现在去找亚瑟王谈谈。

english: You have special powers - no surprise seeing how you were created.
translation: 你拥有特殊的力量——考虑到你是如何被创造出来的，这并不奇怪。

english: You have stared Death in the face, and he gave you a pair of pumpkins.
translation: 你直面了死神，而他给了你一对南瓜。

english: You have strapped explosives onto the floorboards.
translation: 你把炸药绑在了地板上。

english: You have strapped explosives onto the gas cylinder.
translation: 你把炸药绑在了气瓶上。

english: You have strapped explosives onto the support.
translation: 你把炸药绑在了支架上。

english: You have stuff for my friend Jack, yes?
translation: 你有东西要给我朋友杰克，对吧？

english: You have succeeded in obtaining 10 signatures on the petition form!
translation: 你成功在请愿书上获得了 10 个签名！

english: You have successfully added 10,000 hits to your Amulet of blood fury. It will now work for (amount of charges) more hits.
translation: 你成功为你的鲜血愤怒护符增加了 10,000 次攻击次数。它现在还能再承受（充能次数）次攻击。

english: You have successfully completed construction of the bridge. Talk to the dwarves to let them know of their alternative route.
translation: 你成功完成了桥梁的建造。去告诉矮人们他们的替代路线。

english: You have successfully continued construction of the bridge.
translation: 你成功继续了桥梁的建造。

english: You have successfully created an Amulet of blood fury.
translation: 你成功制作了一个鲜血愤怒护符。

english: You have successfully made the rose tinted lens!
translation: 你成功制作了玫瑰色镜片！

english: You have successfully started construction on the bridge.
translation: 你成功开始了桥梁的建造。

english: You have the recipe but you don't have any of the ingredients, and OBVIOUSLY you can't just go and get them yourself?
translation: 你有食谱，但没有任何食材，而且显然你不能自己去弄来？

english: You have the saucepan on your head...
translation: 你把平底锅戴在头上……

english: You have to be quick with Pete, he's always off for the next delivery.
translation: 你得对皮特快点，他总是急着去送下一趟货。

english: You have to swim across; which puts a considerable drain on your energy.
translation: 你必须游过去；这会大量消耗你的体力。

english: You have to wrench yourself free to get out.
translation: 你必须用力挣脱才能出去。

english: You have yet to distract any of the Moons, iknil.
translation: 你还没有分散任何月亮的注意力，伊克尼尔。

english: You haven't been given permission to use that.
translation: 你没有被授权使用那个。

english: You haven't deposited any eggs yet.
translation: 你还没有存入任何蛋。

english: You haven't gathered any information in this category yet.
translation: 你还没有收集到这个类别的任何信息。

english: You haven't got anything suitable for cooking! The master chef can help you out with that.
translation: 你没有任何适合烹饪的东西！主厨可以帮你解决这个问题。

english: You haven't lost it, have you? You're lucky I have another...
translation: 你没弄丢吧？算你走运，我这里还有一个……

english: You haven't put any chocolate kebbits in the chute! Hurry up and get on with it, we've got a holiday to save here!
translation: 你还没把巧克力凯比兔放进滑道里！快点动手吧，我们还得拯救这个节日呢！

english: You haven't seemed like the quitting type so far.
translation: 到目前为止，你看起来不像是会放弃的人。

english: You head off for the night and come back the next day.
translation: 你过了一夜，第二天才回来。

english: You head upstairs with Elias.
translation: 你和伊莱亚斯一起上楼。

english: You heal Itzla.
translation: 你治愈了伊兹拉。

english: You hear Gary following you through the portal... ... and someone else too.
translation: 你听到加里跟着你穿过传送门……还有另一个人。

english: You hear Thorkel muttering to himself under his breath.
translation: 你听到索克尔在低声自言自语。

english: You hear a click from the nearby entry.
translation: 你听到附近入口传来咔哒一声。

english: You hear a click from the skull above the door.
translation: 你听到门上方的头骨传来咔哒一声。

english: You hear a commotion out to sea...
translation: 你听到海上一阵骚动……

english: You hear a conversation taking place in the next room...
translation: 你听到隔壁房间传来谈话声……

english: You hear a disembodied voice fading away into the distance, 'May you perish in the fires of Zamorak's furnace! Rashiliyia's curse is upon you!'
translation: 你听到一个无形的声音渐渐消失在远方：‘愿你在扎莫拉克熔炉的火焰中灭亡！拉希莉亚的诅咒降临在你身上！’

english: You hear a ghostly wailing sound coming from the corpse and a whispering voice says,'Let me rest in a sacred place and assist you I will'
translation: 你听到尸体传来幽灵般的哀嚎声，一个低语的声音说：‘让我安息在神圣之地，我便会助你一臂之力。’

english: You hear a loud crash as the boulder reaches the bottom.
translation: 你听到巨石滚落到底部时发出巨大的撞击声。

english: You hear a muffled groan. The sack wriggles slightly.
translation: 你听到一声低沉的呻吟。麻袋微微扭动了一下。

english: You hear a quiet humming from the strange shape.
translation: 你听到那个奇怪的形状发出轻微的嗡嗡声。

english: You hear a satisfying 'click' as you tumble the lock mechanism.
translation: 当你拨动锁芯时，听到一声令人满意的‘咔哒’声。

english: You hear a splash from far below.
translation: 你听到下方远处传来水花声。

english: You hear a strange noise from below.
translation: 你听到下方传来奇怪的声音。

english: You hear a strange sound coming from the central chamber.
translation: 你听到中央密室传来奇怪的声音。

english: You hear a voice inside your head...
translation: 你听到脑海中有一个声音……

english: You hear a whisper in your ear. 'Return... to Veos. My thanks...'
translation: 你听到耳边传来低语：‘回到……维奥斯身边。我的感谢……’

english: You hear an unearthly moaning sound as you see an apparition materialise right in front of you.
translation: 你听到一声诡异的呻吟，同时看到一个幻影在你面前显现。

english: You hear laughter in the background.
translation: 你听到背景中传来笑声。

english: You hear muffled noises from the sack. You open the sack.
translation: 你听到麻袋里传来闷响。你打开了麻袋。

english: You hear muffled sounds through the rock wall.
translation: 你听到岩墙另一边传来闷响。

english: You hear some snoring sounds coming from the trap.
translation: 你听到陷阱里传来打鼾声。

english: You hear the clunking of some hidden machinery.
translation: 你听到一些隐藏机械的哐当声。

english: You hear the door being unbarred from inside.
translation: 你听到门从里面被打开了门闩。

english: You hear the grate slam shut behind you.
translation: 你听到身后的格栅砰地一声关上了。

english: You hear the leaves stir...
translation: 你听到树叶沙沙作响……

english: You hear the machine make some whirring noises.
translation: 你听到机器发出嗡嗡声。

english: You hear the sound of a valve being turned.
translation: 你听到阀门被转动的声音。

english: You hear the sound of shuffling earth in the distance. Did the cavern just chuckle?
translation: 你听到远处传来泥土翻动的声音。那个洞穴刚才是不是在轻笑？

english: You heat the gold bar
translation: 你加热了金锭。

english: You help yourself to rewards from the table. You can now retrieve these from Diango, or from Party Pete for the duration of this event. The Old School team wishes you a Happy 11th Birthday!
translation: 你从桌上拿了些奖励。现在你可以从迪亚戈那里领取，或者在活动期间从派对皮特那里领取。老派团队祝你11岁生日快乐！

english: You help yourself to what you need.
translation: 你拿了自己需要的东西。

english: You hide the orb in the pouch.
translation: 你把宝珠藏在小袋里。

english: You hide the parrot under the torture rack.
translation: 你把鹦鹉藏在刑架下面。

english: You hide the unholy symbol in the sarcophagus.
translation: 你把邪恶护符藏在石棺里。

english: You hit them!
translation: 你击中了他们！

english: You hold aloft the Troll King's head.
translation: 你高高举起巨魔之王的头颅。

english: You hold on to the red banana tightly.
translation: 你紧紧握住红蕉。

english: You hold the [item] against the whistle...
translation: 你把[item]抵在哨子上……

english: You hold the frozen tablet against the ring of shadows causing the tablet to shatter, transferring its power into the ring.
translation: 你将冰冻石板抵在阴影之戒上，石板碎裂，将其力量转移到了戒指中。

english: You hold the scarred tablet against the ring of shadows causing the tablet to shatter, transferring its power into the ring.
translation: 你将伤痕石板抵在阴影之戒上，石板碎裂，将其力量转移到了戒指中。

english: You hold the sirenic tablet against the ring of shadows causing the tablet to shatter, transferring its power into the ring.
translation: 你将塞壬石板抵在阴影之戒上，石板碎裂，将其力量转移到了戒指中。

english: You hold the special hot sauce up close to the side of the crate.
translation: 你把特制辣酱凑近板条箱的侧面。

english: You hold the strangled tablet against the ring of shadows causing the tablet to shatter, transferring its power into the ring.
translation: 你将绞杀石板抵在阴影之戒上，石板碎裂，将其力量转移到了戒指中。

english: You hollow out a bit of the boat...
translation: 你在船上挖空了一小块……

english: You hop closer to the table to try take the egg.
translation: 你跳近桌子，试图拿走蛋。

english: You imbue the barronite deposit using the chaos core.
translation: 你使用混沌核心注入了巴隆石矿床。

english: You improve your stamina.
translation: 你提升了耐力。

english: You infuse the power of Vorkath's head into your Ranging cape(t).
translation: 你将沃卡斯的头颅的力量注入你的射手斗篷 (镶边)。

english: You infuse the power of Vorkath's head into your Ranging cape.
translation: 你将沃卡斯的头颅的力量注入你的射手斗篷。

english: You infuse the smouldering stone into the axe to make an infernal axe.
translation: 你将阴燃之石注入斧头，制成了一把地狱斧。

english: You infuse the smouldering stone into the harpoon to make an infernal harpoon.
translation: 你将阴燃之石注入鱼叉，制成了一把地狱鱼叉。

english: You infuse the smouldering stone into the pickaxe to make an infernal pickaxe.
translation: 你将阴燃之石注入镐子，制成了一把地狱镐。

english: You input [number], but the chest remains locked.
translation: 你输入了[number]，但箱子仍然锁着。

english: You insert the elemental air block into the mechanism and it clicks into place.
translation: 你将风元素方块插入机关，它咔哒一声卡入了位。

english: You insert the elemental earth block into the mechanism and it clicks into place.
translation: 你将土元素方块插入机关，它咔哒一声卡入了位。

english: You insert the elemental fire block into the recess above the fire symbol and it clicks into place. As it does, you hear a rumbling sound coming from behind you.
translation: 你将火元素方块插入火焰符号上方的凹处，它咔哒一声卡入了位。与此同时，你听到身后传来隆隆声。

english: You insert the elemental water block into the mechanism and it clicks into place.
translation: 你将水元素方块插入机关，它咔哒一声卡入了位。

english: You insert the jewel into the slot on the chest and it opens. You recover a key from within.
translation: 你将首饰插入箱子上的插槽，箱子打开了。你从里面找到了一把钥匙。

english: You insert the metallic feather into one of the feather-shaped indentations in the engravings.
translation: 你将金属羽毛插入雕刻中一个羽毛形状的凹痕里。

english: You inspect the cannon...
translation: 你检查了大炮……

english: You inspect the cauldron. The mixture within smells horrible, but you can't work out what it is.
translation: 你检查了大锅。里面的混合物闻起来很恶心，但你分辨不出是什么。

english: You inspect the coral, but nothing seems to be out of the ordinary.
translation: 你检查了珊瑚，但似乎没有什么异常。

english: You inspect the panel. It looks like there's some sort of keyhole in it.
translation: 你检查了镶板。看起来上面有个钥匙孔。

english: You inspect the rocks and find a strange device hidden amongst them. You smash it.
translation: 你检查了岩石，发现其中藏着一个奇怪的装置。你把它砸碎了。

english: You inspect the tablet, and sense a magical power, running your fingers over the inscriptions, they tingle as you get a feel for Drakan's power.
translation: 你检查了石板，感受到一股魔法力量。手指拂过铭文时，它们微微刺痛，让你感受到了德拉肯的力量。

english: You inspect the tile and notice that it has an orb symbol carved into it.
translation: 你检查了瓷砖，注意到上面刻着一个宝珠符号。

english: You inspect the tile, but don't find anything of note. It simply seems to be an everyday tile for decorating the floor.
translation: 你检查了瓷砖，但没有发现任何值得注意的东西。它似乎只是一块用来装饰地板的普通瓷砖。

english: You investigate the rocks and find a dank, narrow crawl-way. Do you want to crawl into this dank, dark, narrow, possibly dangerous hole?
translation: 你调查了岩石，发现了一条阴湿狭窄的爬行通道。你想爬进这个阴湿、黑暗、狭窄、可能很危险的洞里吗？

english: You join the two halves of the key together.
translation: 你把钥匙的两半拼合在一起。

english: You jot down all of the information Horace had to say about Hosidius.
translation: 你记下了霍拉斯关于霍西迪乌斯城所说的所有信息。

english: You jot down all of the information Horace had to say about the Hosidius house.
translation: 你记下了霍拉斯关于霍西迪乌斯家族所说的所有信息。

english: You jot down all of the information Leenz had to say about Port Piscarilius... With slightly less poetry.

translation: 你记下了雷加斯关于阿西乌斯家族所说的所有信息。

english: You jump further into the burrow...
translation: 你跳进了洞穴深处……

english: You just found a/an [Sapphire/Ruby/Emerald/Diamond/Dragonstone]!
translation: 你刚刚发现了一颗[Sapphire/Ruby/Emerald/Diamond/Dragonstone]！

english: You just have these things laying around?
translation: 你就把这些东西随便放着？

english: You just need to step in. Ice is slippery so you should keep going straight until you find an obstacle or some ground you can stop on.
translation: 你只需要走上去。冰面很滑，所以你应该一直直走，直到找到障碍物或可以停下来的地面。

english: You just need to use this on the armour now. Use a little bit on each piece, and it should clean it.
translation: 你现在只需要把这个用在盔甲上。每件盔甲用一点，应该就能擦干净了。

english: You just need to work out the passphrase and say it to me. You may use whatever you have available in this room to discover it.
translation: 你只需要找出暗号然后告诉我。你可以使用这个房间里任何可用的东西来发现它。

english: You just thought the book might have spooky stories in it. You know, more exciting than our story about the boy and the doll.
translation: 你只是以为这本书里可能有恐怖故事。你知道的，比我们那个关于男孩和玩偶的故事更刺激。

english: You keep walking.
translation: 你继续走着。

english: You key fits the gate, causing it to swing open.
translation: 你的钥匙正好能打开这扇门，门应声而开。

english: You kneel and chant to Guthix...
translation: 你跪下向古斯吟唱……

english: You kneel and chant to Guthix... ... but there is no response. You feel that making space in your inventory could help.
translation: 你跪下向古斯吟唱……但没有回应。你觉得腾出一些背包空间可能会有帮助。

english: You kneel and chant to Guthix... You feel a rush of energy charge through your veins. Suddenly [number] capes appears in your pack.
translation: 你跪下向古斯吟唱……你感到一股能量涌遍全身。突然，[number]件斗篷出现在你的背包里。

english: You kneel and chant to Guthix... You feel a rush of energy charge through your veins. Suddenly a cape appears in your pack.
translation: 你跪下向古斯吟唱……你感到一股能量涌遍全身。突然，一件斗篷出现在你的背包里。

translation: 你跪下向萨拉多明吟唱……

translation: 你跪下向萨拉多明吟唱……但没有回应。你觉得腾出一些背包空间可能会有帮助。

translation: 你跪下向萨拉多明吟唱……你感到一股能量涌遍全身。突然，[number]件斗篷出现在你的背包里。

english: You kneel and chant to Saradomin... You feel a rush of energy charge through your veins. Suddenly a cape appears in your pack.
translation: 你跪下向萨拉多明吟唱……你感到一股能量涌遍全身。突然，一件斗篷出现在你的背包里。

english: You kneel and chant to Zamorak...
translation: 你跪下向扎莫拉克吟唱……

english: You kneel and chant to Zamorak... ... but there is no response. You feel that making space in your inventory could help.
translation: 你跪下向扎莫拉克吟唱……但没有回应。你觉得腾出一些背包空间可能会有帮助。

english: You kneel and chant to Zamorak... You feel a rush of energy charge through your veins. Suddenly [number] capes appears in your pack.
translation: 你跪下向扎莫拉克吟唱……你感到一股能量涌遍全身。突然，[number]件斗篷出现在你的背包里。

english: You kneel and chant to Zamorak... You feel a rush of energy charge through your veins. Suddenly a cape appears in your pack.
translation: 你跪下向扎莫拉克吟唱……你感到一股能量涌遍全身。突然，一件斗篷出现在你的背包里。

english: You knew about that?
translation: 你知道那件事？

english: You knock at the door...
translation: 你敲了敲门……

english: You knock at the door...You hear a voice from inside.
translation: 你敲了敲门……听到里面传来一个声音。

english: You knock on the wall. It sounds like there's a hollow space on the other side.
translation: 你敲了敲墙壁。听起来另一边是空心的。

english: You know he's really self-conscious about these things!
translation: 你知道他对这种事真的很在意！

english: You know imps, right? Evil little critters. Tried to summon them once. Well, when I was little, in my bedtime story books, they were little guys wearing an outfit just like this one! Well, except for the legs.
translation: 你知道小恶魔吧？那些邪恶的小东西。我以前试过召唤它们。嗯，我小时候看的睡前故事书里，它们就是穿着这种衣服的小家伙！不过，腿不一样。

english: You know of the ancient temples? You have been to a place where this 'rune essence' material is freely available?
translation: 你知道那些远古神庙吗？你去过那种可以自由获取‘符文精华’材料的地方？

english: You know the saying, knowledge is power? I commissioned a report from the Emir's spymaster Osman on trade activities from Brimhaven. Can I trust you to collect it?
translation: 你知道那句老话，知识就是力量吗？我委托埃米尔的情报主管奥斯曼写了一份关于布尔哈文镇贸易活动的报告。我能信任你去取来吗？

english: You know those eggs you took from Varrock?
translation: 你知道你从维洛克城拿的那些蛋吗？

english: You know what, I just might do that!
translation: 你知道吗，我可能真会那么做！

english: You know what, never mind. It'll take too long to explain. Merry Christmas!
translation: 算了，没事。解释起来太久了。圣诞快乐！

english: You know what? I'm feeling great after that. I'm going to knit something super cool when I get home!
translation: 你知道吗？做完这个我感觉好极了。我回家要织一件超酷的东西！

english: You know who else would love to see a colourful costume? Aggie in Draynor Village!
translation: 你知道还有谁也会喜欢看色彩鲜艳的服装吗？德雷诺村的阿吉！

english: You know who else would love to see a colourful costume? Ned in Draynor Village!
translation: 你知道还有谁也会喜欢看色彩鲜艳的服装吗？德雷诺村的内德！

english: You know, Elsie in the Varrock church loves a good spook as well! You should show her your costume!
translation: 你知道吗，维洛克城教堂的艾尔西也喜欢吓人的东西！你应该给她看看你的服装！

english: You know, Hetty in Rimmington loves a good spook as well! You should show her your costume!
translation: 你知道吗，里明顿村的赫蒂也喜欢吓人的东西！你应该给她看看你的服装！

english: You know, I do stand guard a lot!
translation: 你知道吗，我确实经常站岗！

english: You know, I just finished making another lot! Practice makes perfect.
translation: 你知道吗，我刚又做好了一批！熟能生巧嘛。

english: You know, I'm not sure! I'll have to ask Pete.
translation: 你知道吗，我也不确定！我得问问皮特。

english: You know, I'm starting to think you are taking advantage of my good nature.
translation: 你知道吗，我开始觉得你在利用我的好心肠了。

english: You know, fall doesn't fell much like the flower season does it?
translation: 你知道吗，秋天感觉不太像花季，对吧？

english: You know, for dyeing pumpkins.
translation: 你知道的，用来给南瓜染色。

english: You know, like hunting for ancient desert temples, fighting some big evil water storm, standard adventurer things.
translation: 你知道的，比如寻找远古沙漠神庙，对抗什么巨大的邪恶水风暴，标准的冒险者日常。

english: You know, my sister Elsie in the Varrock church loves a good spook as well! You should show her your costume!
translation: 你知道吗，我姐姐，维洛克城教堂的艾尔西，也喜欢吓人的东西！你应该给她看看你的服装！

english: You know, speaking of random passersby, that gives me an idea. Considering we haven't had much luck helping our friends find some courage, perhaps you could try?
translation: 你知道吗，说到路过的陌生人，我倒是有个主意。既然我们帮朋友们找勇气没什么进展，也许你可以试试？

english: You know, you aren't wrong partner.
translation: 你知道吗，你说得没错，搭档。

english: You know. I could tell the goblin generals that you told me the secret.
translation: 你知道吗。我可以告诉那些哥布林将军，是你把秘密告诉我的。

english: You know... They were just going to be smelted back down and reforged. I guess I can spare a few.
translation: 你知道吗……它们本来就要被回炉重铸的。我想我还能匀出几个来。

english: You land in a cave. Iban's staff lands next to you. You pick it up.
translation: 你落进了一个洞穴。伊班的法杖掉在你旁边。你捡起了它。

english: You land softly in a pile of snow at the bottom of the slope.
translation: 你轻轻地落在斜坡底部的一堆雪里。

english: You lay Zanik's corpse in front of Juna.
translation: 你把扎尼克的尸体放在朱娜面前。

english: You learn some Attack techniques.
translation: 你学到了一些攻击技巧。

english: You learn some Defence techniques.
translation: 你学到了一些防御技巧。

english: You learn some Strength techniques.
translation: 你学到了一些力量技巧。

english: You learn some secrets of Magic.
translation: 你学到了一些魔法的奥秘。

english: You learn some secrets of Runecrafting.
translation: 你学到了一些符文制作的奥秘。

english: You leave the Queen with Forebearer Janus...
translation: 你把女王留给了先驱者雅努斯……

english: You leave the Underground Pass...
translation: 你离开了地下通道……

english: You leave the basement.
translation: 你离开了地下室。

english: You leave the battle.
translation: 你离开了战斗。

english: You leave the soap where it is.
translation: 你把肥皂留在原地。

english: You leave the valve alone.
translation: 你没有碰那个阀门。

english: You left before we could finish sorting out the job. Come back when you're ready to talk some more.
translation: 你还没等我们把事情谈完就走了。准备好再谈的时候回来吧。

english: You left before we could finish! Come back when you want to steal those tools, but don't be too long!
translation: 你还没等我们把事情谈完就走了！想偷那些工具的时候就回来，但别拖太久！

english: You left before we could finish! Come back when you're ready to go again.
translation: 你还没等我们把事情谈完就走了！准备好再来的时候就回来吧。

english: You left before you could get your present from Santa! Come back when you're ready to visit again.
translation: 你还没拿到圣诞老人的礼物就走了！准备好再来拜访的时候就回来吧。

english: You lie down on the bed and quickly fall asleep.
translation: 你躺在床上，很快就睡着了。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with blisterwood logs.
translation: 你用一些水泡木原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with blue logs.
translation: 你用一些蓝色原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with green logs.
translation: 你用一些绿色原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with logs.
translation: 你用一些原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with magic logs.
translation: 你用一些魔法原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with maple logs.
translation: 你用一些枫木原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with oak logs.
translation: 你用一些橡木原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with purple logs.
translation: 你用一些紫色原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with red logs.
translation: 你用一些红色原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with redwood logs.
translation: 你用一些红杉原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with white logs.
translation: 你用一些白色原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with willow logs.
translation: 你用一些柳木原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the abyssal lantern with yew logs.
translation: 你用一些紫杉原木点燃了深渊灯笼。

english: You light the brazier with your tinderbox and hear a click as you do so.
translation: 你用火绒盒点燃了火盆，同时听到咔哒一声。

english: You light the brazier with your tinderbox, but it and the others then go out.
translation: 你用火绒盒点燃了火盆，但它和其他火盆随后都熄灭了。

english: You light the brazier with your tinderbox.
translation: 你用火绒盒点燃了火盆。

english: You light the candle.
translation: 你点燃了蜡烛。

english: You light the candle. The room is sufficiently warmed, the fuse should now have dried out.
translation: 你点燃了蜡烛。房间足够暖和了，引信现在应该已经干了。

english: You light the driftwood...
translation: 你点燃了浮木……

english: You light the furnace with your tinderbox.
translation: 你用火绒盒点燃了熔炉。

english: You light the furnace...
translation: 你点燃了熔炉……

english: You light the tomb and it bursts into flames.
translation: 你点燃了坟墓，它立刻燃起了熊熊大火。

english: You line up all four pieces of the key and they magically snap together.
translation: 你把钥匙的四个碎片排成一排，它们神奇地拼合在一起。

english: You listen at the door...
translation: 你凑到门边听……

english: You listen carefully and hear the following...
translation: 你仔细倾听，听到了以下内容……

english: You listen carefully and hear the following... A riddle is provided depending on the day, a full list can be found here.
translation: 你仔细倾听，听到了以下内容……根据日期不同会给出一个谜语，完整列表可在此处找到。

english: You load the blaster with explosive rounds.
translation: 你给爆破枪装上了爆破弹。

english: You look a bit put out there, what's wrong?
translation: 你看起来有点失落，怎么了？

english: You look amongst the junk on the floor and find Glarial's pebble but you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 你在地板上的垃圾中翻找，找到了格拉利尔的鹅卵石，但你没有足够的空间拿走它。

english: You look around the room.
translation: 你环顾房间四周。

english: You look at the damage done. There are two main wooden parts that need to be repaired. It looks as if you'll need two types of wood, maple and oak, to complete the repairs. It also looks as if everything was stuck together by some sort of resin based glue that smells of pine, and contains flecks of grey powder that glint and sparkle in a
translation: 你查看损坏情况。有两个主要的木质部件需要修理。看起来你需要两种木材，枫木和橡木，才能完成修理。而且，所有东西似乎都被一种松木味的树脂胶粘在一起，里面还夹杂着闪闪发光的灰色粉末。

english: You look at the markings...
translation: 你看着那些标记……

english: You look at the strange machinery and feel as if you're missing something... perhaps something to put into those strange holes in the stone slab?
translation: 你看着这台奇怪的机械，感觉自己好像漏掉了什么……也许该往石板上的那些奇怪孔洞里放点东西？

english: You look down the well and see the filthy polluted water of the River Salve moving slowly along.
translation: 你往井里看，看到萨尔维河肮脏污染的水在缓缓流动。

english: You look in the chest and find a journal, and then you throw away the chest.
translation: 你在箱子里找到一本日志，然后把箱子扔掉了。

english: You look in the kiln but you see only sand and fragments of ancient golems.
translation: 你往窑里看，但只看到沙子和古代魔像的碎片。

english: You look inside the cave, but see a blockage further in. It would take something very big to clear it.
translation: 你往洞穴里看，但看到更深处有堵塞物。需要非常大的东西才能清理掉它。

english: You look inside the crevice and see no adventurers inside the cave.
translation: 你朝裂缝里看去，洞穴里没有看到任何冒险者。

english: You look like I feel.
translation: 你看起来跟我感觉的一样。

english: You look like yourself! Well, I asssume it's you. I've never actually seen your face before.
translation: 你看起来就是你自己！嗯，我猜是你。我其实从没见过你的脸。

english: You look ready to protect the world!
translation: 你看起来准备好保护世界了！

english: You look under the rack and find the drunk parrot.
translation: 你在架子下面找到了那只醉酒鹦鹉。

english: You look under the rack but find nothing.
translation: 你在架子下面找了找，但什么也没找到。

english: You lost it? Oops! I have some more though, here you go.
translation: 你弄丢了？哎呀！不过我还有一些，给你。

english: You lost it? That was silly! But luckily for you, I have an endless supply.
translation: 你弄丢了？真傻！不过算你走运，我有的是。

english: You lost it?! Was it destroyed? It can't be found by anybody!
translation: 你弄丢了？！它被毁了吗？绝不能让任何人找到它！

english: You lost the book?
translation: 你把书弄丢了？

english: You lower the crowbar dejectedly.
translation: 你沮丧地放下了撬棍。

english: You lower the rod into the Salve and withdraw it shortly after. It seems to be wet, but otherwise nothing has changed.
translation: 你把棍子伸进萨尔维河，很快又抽了回来。它看起来湿了，但除此之外没什么变化。

english: You lower the rod into the Salve and withdraw it shortly after. It seems to glow in a rather strange way.
translation: 你把棍子伸进萨尔维河，很快又抽了回来。它似乎以一种相当奇怪的方式发着光。

english: You lower yourself into the shaft.
translation: 你把自己降入竖井中。

english: You made it just in time to witness greatness.
translation: 你来得正是时候，可以见证这伟大的时刻。

english: You made it! Not the most surprising location is it?
translation: 你成功了！这地方不算太出人意料，对吧？

english: You make a Lunar Torso.
translation: 你制作了一件月之甲。

english: You make a compelling argument. Gingerbread gnomes it is!
translation: 你说得很有道理。那就姜饼侏儒吧！

english: You make a mess of the map, but you think you can reuse this papyrus.
translation: 你把地图弄得一团糟，但你觉得这张莎草纸还能再用。

english: You make a small cut in the spine of the book.
translation: 你在书的书脊上划了一个小口子。

english: You make a writing motion. The mages scribbles something down on a scroll.
translation: 你做了个写字的手势。法师在一张卷轴上潦草地写了些什么。

english: You make an unpainted magic egg.
translation: 你制作了一个未上色的魔法蛋。

english: You make another compelling argument. Now my decision is even harder!
translation: 你又提出了一个很有说服力的论点。这下我的决定更难做了！

english: You make it back to the top of the slope.
translation: 你回到了斜坡的顶端。

english: You make serum 207.
translation: 你制作了血清 207。

english: You make some Lunar Boots.
translation: 你制作了一双月之靴。

english: You make some Lunar Gloves.
translation: 你制作了一双月之手套。

english: You make some Lunar Trousers.
translation: 你制作了一条月之裤子。

english: You make some dough.
translation: 你揉了一些面团。

english: You making assumptions about me? How's a chap supposed to make an honest living if everyone just calls him a thief before he's even done anything?
translation: 你在对我妄加揣测？如果一个人还没做什么就被叫做盗贼，那他还怎么老老实实谋生呢？

english: You manage to attract a parrot and catch it.
translation: 你成功吸引了一只鹦鹉并抓住了它。

translation: 你成功吸引了一只鹦鹉，但当你试图抓住它时，它飞走了。

english: You manage to bake some bread.
translation: 你成功烤出了一些面包。

english: You manage to break up the boards using a hammer.
translation: 你用锤子成功拆开了木板。

english: You manage to catch a firefly.
translation: 你成功抓住了一只萤火虫。

english: You manage to entrap the soul in your jar of ethereal fluid.
translation: 你成功将灵魂困在了你那瓶灵质流体里。

english: You manage to escape from the rest of the vampyre juvinates and continue on your journey.
translation: 你成功摆脱了其他吸血鬼幼崽，继续你的旅程。

english: You manage to feed him. He seems to like it.
translation: 你成功喂了他。他似乎很喜欢。

english: You manage to force open the window cover. Inside the room you see a dog roaming around.
translation: 你用力打开了窗户盖。房间里，你看到一只狗在四处游荡。

english: You manage to get a grip on the monkey bars.
translation: 你成功抓住了攀爬架。

english: You manage to get yourself stuck.
translation: 你把自己卡住了。

english: You manage to lift the huge rock off the chest.
translation: 你成功地把那块巨石从箱子上移开了。

english: You manage to mine a rock.
translation: 你成功开采了一块岩石。

english: You manage to mine some [tin/copper].
translation: 你成功开采了一些[tin/copper]。

english: You manage to mine the rubble to pieces.
translation: 你成功地把瓦砾开采成了碎片。

english: You manage to mine the rubble to pieces. You should be able to move what's left out of the cellar now. Though you'll need something to carry it in.
translation: 你把瓦砾挖成了碎片。现在你应该能把剩下的东西搬出地窖了。不过你需要找个容器来装。

english: You manage to move the rocks out of the way, revealing the crushed brazier beneath them. A charged fire orb sits within it. It seems pretty well secured.
translation: 你成功移开了石头，露出了下面被压碎的火盆。里面有一个充能过的火宝珠。它似乎被固定得很牢固。

english: You manage to open the egg and inside you find a note.
translation: 你成功打开了蛋，在里面发现了一张纸条。

english: You manage to pull yourself out, but are hurt in the process.
translation: 你成功把自己拉了出来，但在这个过程中受了伤。

english: You manage to release the air orb from the brazier.
translation: 你成功从火盆中取出了风宝珠。

english: You manage to release the earth orb from the brazier.
translation: 你成功从火盆中取出了土宝珠。

english: You manage to release the fire orb from the brazier.
translation: 你成功从火盆中取出了火宝珠。

english: You manage to repair the cart.
translation: 你成功修好了推车。

english: You manage to swim back to shore.
translation: 你成功游回了岸边。

english: You manage to swim back to the shore.
translation: 你成功游回了岸边。

english: You managed to get the fire going!
translation: 你成功把火生起来了！

english: You mark the guard.
translation: 你标记了那个守卫。

english: You match Anna's finger prints with those on the dagger found in the body of Lord Sinclair.
translation: 你将安娜的指纹与辛克莱尔勋爵尸体上发现的匕首上的指纹进行了比对。

english: You match Bob's finger prints with those on the dagger found in the body of Lord Sinclair.
translation: 你将鲍勃的指纹与辛克莱尔勋爵尸体上发现的匕首上的指纹进行了比对。

english: You match Carol's finger prints with those on the dagger found in the body of Lord Sinclair.
translation: 你将卡罗尔的指纹与辛克莱尔勋爵尸体上发现的匕首上的指纹进行了比对。

english: You match David's finger prints with those on the dagger found in the body of Lord Sinclair.
translation: 你将大卫的指纹与辛克莱尔勋爵尸体上发现的匕首上的指纹进行了比对。

english: You match Elizabeth's finger prints with those on the dagger found in the body of Lord Sinclair.
translation: 你将伊丽莎白的指纹与辛克莱尔勋爵尸体上发现的匕首上的指纹进行了比对。

english: You match Frank's finger prints with those on the dagger found in the body of Lord Sinclair.
translation: 你将弗兰克的指纹与辛克莱尔勋爵尸体上发现的匕首上的指纹进行了比对。

english: You may also appreciate your own copy of my undead gravedigger disguise. I think it improves your appearance.
translation: 你或许也会喜欢我那份亡灵掘墓人伪装。我觉得它能提升你的形象。

english: You may be able to turn this dilapidated table into something that could help you to get out of this place. What would you like to try and turn this table into?
translation: 你或许能把这张破桌子变成能帮你离开这里的东西。你想试着把它变成什么？

english: You may be able to wander around other people's houses, but I shall not allow it.
translation: 你也许能在别人家里闲逛，但我绝不允许。

english: You may know that I only come here around Easter time ever year but I still do not know my way around Al Kharid very well.
translation: 你可能知道我每年只在复活节前后才来这里，但我对阿尔卡里德城的路还是不太熟。

english: You may not be a friend of Al Kharid, but know that your assistance will not be forgotten.
translation: 你也许不是阿尔卡里德城的朋友，但要知道，你的帮助不会被忘记。

english: You may not have investigated all possible clues.
translation: 你可能还没有调查所有可能的线索。

english: You may only add decorations which match the wood used to build the totem.
translation: 你只能添加与建造图腾所用木材相匹配的装饰。

english: You mean a few hours?
translation: 你是说几个小时？

english: You mean a sacrifice?
translation: 你是说祭品？

english: You mean the toy?
translation: 你是说那个玩具？

english: You mean to say he is not yet at his full strength?
translation: 你的意思是说他还没有恢复全部力量？

english: You mean to say you had a time bubble this whole time! What was with making me figure out those actions then?
translation: 你的意思是你一直都有时间泡泡！那还让我琢磨那些动作干嘛？

english: You mean to say... So that's why you were able to mime it!
translation: 你的意思是……所以这就是为什么你能模仿出来！

english: You meld the Lunar Glass to the Fremennik Shield. You then polish it with the Polishing Rock, which cools as you do so. Finally, you attach the V Sigil, finishing the shield.
translation: 你将月玻璃熔合到费明尼克盾上。然后用抛光石进行抛光，石头在这个过程中冷却了。最后，你装上V形符印，完成了这面盾牌。

english: You memorise what is written on the scroll.
translation: 你记住了卷轴上写的内容。

english: You memorise what is written on the scroll. You can now use the Ardougne Teleport Spell.
translation: 你记住了卷轴上写的内容。你现在可以使用阿多尼城传送术了。

english: You mentioned inviting Kit to work here for a while, what would they be doing?
translation: 你提到邀请基特来这里工作一段时间，他们会做什么呢？

english: You mentioned that you needed to experience the significance of the artefacts yourself, for them to work. How did Grayzag manage that if he didn't understand what his imps had brought him?
translation: 你提到你需要亲自体验这些神器的重要性才能让它们发挥作用。如果格雷扎格不明白他的小鬼们给他带来了什么，他是怎么做到的？

english: You might be able to combine these into a decent enough blackjack if the purse were more sturdy somehow.
translation: 如果这个钱包能更结实一些，你或许能把它们组合成一把像样的黑杰克。

english: You might be able to.
translation: 你或许可以。

english: You might be good enough to save Easter after all... we hid the egg mould near the pub, but that's all I'm telling you.
translation: 你或许真的够格拯救复活节了……我们把鸡蛋模具藏在酒馆附近，但我只能告诉你这么多了。

english: You might like to pay Iffie in Varrock a visit. I hear she's being very generous with treats and stories!
translation: 你或许该去维洛克城拜访一下伊菲。我听说她最近在慷慨地分发美食和讲故事！

english: You might like to pay King Roald in Varrock a visit. I hear he's being very generous with treats!
translation: 你或许该去维洛克城拜访一下罗尔德国王。我听说他最近在慷慨地分发美食！

english: You might like to pay my sister Iffie in the Varrock clothes shop a visit. I hear she's being very generous with treats and stories!
translation: 你或许该去维洛克城的服装店拜访一下我姐姐伊菲。我听说她最近在慷慨地分发美食和讲故事！

english: You might need some in this game. Do return when you have some, I believe there was a deposit box outside near Santa.
translation: 你在这个游戏里可能需要一些。等你有了再回来吧，我记得外面圣诞老人附近有个寄存箱。

english: You might need some other things to help you.
translation: 你可能需要其他一些东西来帮助你。

english: You might think that we managed to keep your departure secret from your dad. I know you've been apprehensive of his reaction. I want to reassure you.
translation: 你或许以为我们成功对你爸爸隐瞒了你离开的事。我知道你一直担心他的反应。我想让你放心。

english: You might want to give the red ones a go next trip; you have [X] left of them to go.
translation: 下次你或许该试试红色的；你还有[X]个要完成。

english: You mine fast! Cheers for the assistance, pal.
translation: 你挖得真快！多谢帮忙，哥们。

english: You mix the berries into the potion.
translation: 你把浆果混入了药水中。

english: You mix the chocolate into the bucket.
translation: 你把巧克力混入了桶里。

english: You mix the enriched snapdragon into the truth serum. It dissolves immediately and gives off a pleasant aroma.
translation: 你把超级金鱼草混入了吐真剂中。它立刻溶解，散发出宜人的香气。

english: You mix the herb into the potion.
translation: 你把草药混入了药水中。

english: You mix the ingredients and prepare a [Fruity/Fresh/Bitter/Earthy/Smoked/Crunchy/Spicy/Fishy/Meaty/Rich/Fluffy/Salted] chocolate mix.
translation: 你混合了原料，准备了一份[Fruity/Fresh/Bitter/Earthy/Smoked/Crunchy/Spicy/Fishy/Meaty/Rich/Fluffy/Salted]的巧克力混合物。

english: You mix the mud rune powder into the tree sap. It looks sticky.
translation: 你把泥符石粉末混入树汁中。看起来黏糊糊的。

english: You mix the naphtha with the apple mush.
translation: 你把石脑油和苹果糊混合在一起。

english: You mix the rune dust into the plant cure.
translation: 你把符文精华粉末混入植物治疗药水中。

english: You mix the slime into your potion.
translation: 你把黏液混入你的药水里。

english: You mix the snape grass into the bucket.
translation: 你把斯内普草混入了桶里。

english: You mix the two ingredients together
translation: 你把两种原料混合在一起

english: You monster... And what about the mother?
translation: 你这个怪物……那母亲呢？

english: You move away from the corpse quietly and slowly... ...you have an eerie feeling about this!
translation: 你安静而缓慢地远离尸体……你对此有种诡异的感觉！

english: You must 23235 be able to 23526 communicate and understand 26243 others, they 2627422 have wisdom and 4363472 experiences to 235725 share!
translation: 你必须23235能够23526沟通和理解26243他人，他们2627422拥有智慧和4363472经验可以235725分享！

english: You must be Eve! How do you know my name?
translation: 你一定是夏娃！你怎么知道我的名字？

english: You must be a Level 40 Farmer to plant those.
translation: 你必须达到40级农夫才能种植那些。

english: You must be a Level 40 Fisherman to fish here.
translation: 你必须达到40级渔夫才能在这里钓鱼。

english: You must be a member to receive all the Holiday rewards. Upgrade now to unlock the Goblin decrations that you can use to decorate your Player Owned House.
translation: 你必须成为会员才能领取所有节日奖励。立即升级以解锁可用于装饰玩家自宅的地精装饰。

english: You must be getting a lot of visitors.
translation: 你一定有很多访客吧。

english: You must be in a bank to take noted strings.
translation: 你必须在银行里才能取出票据形式的线。

english: You must be in building mode to try installing furniture.
translation: 你必须在建造模式下才能尝试安装家具。

english: You must be quick, for we only have a short time before Jonas has fully regain his strength in his new physical form. When he has done so, the evil that he could bring to this world is unthinkable.
translation: 你必须快点，因为我们只有很短的时间，乔纳斯就会在新的身体形态中完全恢复力量。一旦他做到了，他可能给这个世界带来的邪恶将不堪设想。

english: You must be wearing the full set of Trailblazer Relic hunter (T3) to use this emote.
translation: 你必须穿着全套开拓者遗物猎人（T3）才能使用这个表情。

english: You must complete the Secrets of the North quest before you can wield this item.
translation: 你必须先完成北方的秘密任务才能使用这件物品。

english: You must cook me best dish from things in cupboard. Best dish wins.
translation: 你必须用橱柜里的东西给我做最好的菜。最好的菜获胜。

english: You must find a sailors' marker at that location before teleporting there.
translation: 在传送到那个位置之前，你必须先在那里找到一个水手标记。

english: You must fix the lighthouse before any ships crash!
translation: 你必须在任何船只撞毁之前修好灯塔！

english: You must free your hands so you can hold the preform.
translation: 你必须腾出双手才能握住未完成的部件。

english: You must have access to the Heroes' Guild to recharge amulets of glory.
translation: 你必须能够进入英雄公会才能为荣耀护符充能。

english: You must have access to the Legends' Guild to recharge skills necklaces or combat bracelets.
translation: 你必须能够进入传奇公会才能为技能项链或战斗手镯充能。

english: You must have an assigned slayer task of Gargoyles or Grotesque Guardians to awaken the Guardians.
translation: 你必须被分配了石像鬼或怪诞守卫者的杀戮任务才能唤醒守卫者。

english: You must have nothing surrounding you to open this trinket.
translation: 你周围必须没有任何东西才能打开这个小饰品。

english: You must have seen a few parties in your time.
translation: 你那时候一定见过不少派对。

english: You must have your mind occupied by the spells of the dead before using this lectern.
translation: 在使用这个讲台之前，你的心智必须先被亡者的法术占据。

english: You must let the shield cool down before using it again.
translation: 你必须让盾冷却下来才能再次使用。

english: You must now make sense of the Homunculus's mind. Force him to either follow the line of logic or the line of magic.
translation: 你现在必须理解人造人的心智。强迫他要么遵循逻辑线，要么遵循魔法线。

english: You must restore the spirit of Christmas you took away from them. I have a selection of gifts over there, grab as many as you need and deliver them to the children you upset.
translation: 你必须恢复你从他们那里夺走的圣诞精神。我那边有一些礼物，你需要多少就拿多少，然后送给你惹恼的那些孩子们。

english: You must search deep within yourself if you are to control the power of the cruciferous spells necessary to pick these specimens.
translation: 你必须深入探索自己的内心，才能控制采摘这些标本所需的十字花科法术的力量。

english: You must seek out Jarvis. Take the boat from the South of Lumbridge Swamp. Head towards the island of Camp Sapphire Lagoon and there you will find him.
translation: 你必须找到贾维斯。从仑桥镇沼泽南边乘船。前往蓝宝石泻湖营地岛，你会在那里找到他。

english: You must solve the riddle and make the offering, [player name].
translation: 你必须解开谜题并献上祭品，[player name]。

english: You must take care of your workers Carol. Money isn't everything.
translation: 你必须照顾好你的工人，卡罗尔。钱不是万能的。

english: You must talk to Lisa before using the coffer.
translation: 你必须先和丽莎谈谈才能使用保险箱。

english: You must then reveal the truth of your foe to seal their fate.
translation: 然后你必须揭露敌人的真相，以决定他们的命运。

english: You must throw the time bubble at your desired foe. Your foe must not be moving for the charm to take effect.
translation: 你必须将时间泡泡扔向你想要的敌人。你的敌人必须静止不动，护符才能生效。

english: You nail a final plank over the hole. You have successfully patched the hole in the ship.
translation: 你在洞上钉上了最后一块木板。你成功修补了船上的洞。

english: You nail a plank over the hole, but you still need more planks to close the hole completely.
translation: 你在洞上钉了一块木板，但你还需要更多木板才能完全封住洞口。

english: You nail a plank over the hole, but you still need one more plank to close the hole completely.
translation: 你在洞上钉了一块木板，但你还需要一块木板才能完全封住洞口。

english: You nail the Planks over the the hole!
translation: 你把木板钉在了洞口上！

english: You nearly drown in the disgusting swamp.
translation: 你差点溺死在这恶心的沼泽里。

english: You need 1 law rune and 1 big bone to charge the Giantsoul amulet.
translation: 你需要1个律法符石和1块大骨头来给巨人之魂护符充能。

english: You need 10 tacks to repair this hole.
translation: 你需要10个图钉来修补这个洞。

english: You need 2 repair planks to repair this hole.
translation: 你需要2块修理木板来修补这个洞。

english: You need 25 volcanic ash to do that.
translation: 你需要25个火山灰才能做到。

english: You need 30 steel nails to attach the plank with.
translation: 你需要30个钢钉来固定木板。

english: You need 46 Hunter to access the Burrow.
translation: 你需要 46 级猎人技能才能进入这个洞穴。

english: You need Easter spices to make Easter Buns.
translation: 你需要复活节香料来制作复活节面包。

english: You need Swamp Paste to waterproof this hole.
translation: 你需要沼泽膏来给这个洞做防水。

translation: 你的背包还需要[amount]个空格才能领取奖励！等你有空间了再来找我，我会替你保管的。109 -->

translation: 你需要[materials]来修理机器。

translation: 你需要85级战斗等级才能开始这个任务。

translation: 你需要1级烹饪等级才能加热鸡蛋模具。

translation: 你需要35级制作等级才能制作骨制法杖。

translation: 你需要43级制作等级才能用牦牛皮制作盔甲。

translation: 你需要 46 级制作技能才能制作牦牛皮甲。

translation: 你需要 52 级制作技能才能制作月之靴。

translation: 你需要 52 级制作技能才能制作月之手套。

translation: 你需要 59 级制作技能才能制作月之裤子。

translation: 你需要 61 级制作技能才能制作月之甲。

translation: 你需要一把伐木斧柄才能改造你的龙金斧。

translation: 你需要 35 级制箭技能才能制作骨制短弓。

translation: 你需要一根玻璃吹管才能制作 V 的盾。

translation: 你需要一把锤子来修补这个洞。

english: You need a Magic level of at least 66 to construct an ancient wyvern shield.
translation: 你需要至少 66 级魔法技能才能制作古代飞龙盾。

translation: 你需要 [#] 级采矿技能才能开采这颗星。

translation: 你需要一把苔藓钥匙才能打开这个箱子。

translation: 你需要 10 级航海技能才能在这里买船。

english: You need a Sailing level of 10 to customise a boat here.
translation: 你需要 10 级航海技能才能在这里定制船。

translation: 你需要 10 级航海技能才能在这里回收船。

translation: 你需要 12 级航海技能才能驾驶宽体船。

translation: 你需要一把镐子才能开采这颗星。你没有一把你当前采矿等级能用的镐子。

english: You need a saw and a hammer in order to make a facility.
translation: 你需要一把锯子和一把锤子才能制作一个设施。

translation: 你需要一个小型、中型、大型和巨型精华袋才能将它们组合在一起。

translation: 你需要一把铲子才能挖出树苗。

english: You need a suitable platebody, legs and full helm of the same type to activate the armour animator.
translation: 你需要一件合适的板甲、腿甲和全头盔，且必须是同一类型，才能激活盔甲动画器。

english: You need a thieving level of 23 in order to pick the lock of that trapdoor.
translation: 你需要 23 级偷窃技能才能撬开那个活板门的锁。

translation: 你需要一个火绒盒来点燃深渊灯笼。

translation: 你需要一个火绒盒才能点燃火盆。

translation: 你需要一个火绒盒才能点燃熔炉。

english: You need a watch and navigator's chart to work out your location.
translation: 你需要一块表和一张航海图才能确定你的位置。

english: You need an Agility level of 10 to squeeze down the shaft.
translation: 你需要 10 级敏捷才能挤下竖井。

translation: 你需要至少 15 级敏捷才能尝试这个。

translation: 你需要 23 级敏捷技能才能挤过那道裂缝。

english: You need an iron bar to use the scarab mould.
translation: 你需要一根铁锭才能使用圣甲虫模具。

english: You need another [X} [snails/raw mackerel] to fill this crate.
translation: 你还需要 [X} [snails/raw mackerel]才能装满这个板条箱。

english: You need at least 100 Astral runes to attempt to enchant the glass.
translation: 你至少需要 100 颗星界符石才能尝试附魔这块玻璃。

english: You need at least 200 blood runes and 1 vial of blood to start filling the well.
translation: 你至少需要 200 个血符石和 1 瓶血瓶才能开始填满井。

english: You need at least 3 x Earth rune and 1 x Body rune in order to charge the Lithic sceptre.
translation: 你至少需要 3 个大地符石和 1 个躯体符石才能为石制权杖充能。

english: You need at least 5 festive tree branches to make your costume.
translation: 你至少需要 5 根节日树枝才能制作你的服装。

english: You need at least one chaos rune and two death runes in order to charge the Eye of Ayak this way.
translation: 你至少需要一颗混沌符石和两颗死亡符石才能用这种方式给阿亚克的眼充能。

english: You need at least one chaos rune and two death runes or one demon tear in order to charge the Eye of Ayak.
translation: 你至少需要一颗混沌符石和两颗死亡符石，或者一颗恶魔之泪，才能给阿亚克的眼充能。

english: You need at least two free inventory spaces to open this pouch.
translation: 你至少需要两个空闲的背包空间才能打开这个袋子。

english: You need at least two free spaces in your inventory to dismantle the forestry basket.
translation: 你至少需要两个空闲的背包空间才能拆解林业篮。

english: You need both hands free to catch Archibald.
translation: 你需要空出双手才能抓住阿奇博尔德。

english: You need four heaps of coal to smelt elemental ore.
translation: 你需要四堆煤来熔炼元素矿石。

english: You need hard leather as well as these 2 items.
translation: 除了这两样东西，你还需要硬皮革。

english: You need help? From a 'puny human'?
translation: 你需要帮助？从一个'渺小的人类'那里？

english: You need inventory space free.
translation: 你需要空闲的背包空间。

english: You need inventory spaces for [number] items.
translation: 你需要 [number] 个背包空间来装物品。

english: You need leaves from two different plants along with an embertailed jerboa tail to make the poultice Fox asked for.
translation: 你需要两种不同植物的叶子，再加上一条焰尾跳鼠尾，才能制作福克斯要的药膏。

translation: 你至少需要 25 级符石制作才能尝试把它们缝合在一起。

english: You need level 61 Mining and level 85 Smithing to make an infernal pickaxe.
translation: 你需要 61 级采矿和 85 级锻造才能制作地狱镐。

english: You need level 61 Woodcutting and level 85 Firemaking to make an infernal axe.
translation: 你需要 61 级伐木和 85 级生火才能制作地狱斧。

english: You need level 75 Fishing and level 85 Cooking to make an infernal harpoon.
translation: 你需要 75 级钓鱼和 85 级烹饪才能制作地狱鱼叉。

translation: 你需要 99 级伐木才能用这个来扩展你的林业套件/篮子。

english: You need one death rune, one chaos rune, five fire runes and ten coins. Rune substitutes and pouches cannot be used.
translation: 你需要一颗死亡符石、一颗混沌符石、五颗火焰符石和十枚金币。不能使用符石替代品或精华袋。

english: You need one death rune, one choose rune, five fire runes and ten coins to charge the Uncharged trident.
translation: 你需要一颗死亡符石、一颗混沌符石、五颗火焰符石和十枚金币才能给未充能的三叉戟充能。

english: You need one free inventory space to take a pickaxe.
translation: 你需要一个空闲的背包空间才能拿取镐子。

translation: 你需要一些煤才能给熔炉加燃料。

translation: 这个教程环节需要一些新武器，但你的背包空间不够了。你需要丢掉一些东西。方法是[tap and hold/right-click on]你不想要的物品，然后选择丢弃。完成后，再和战斗导师对话。

translation: 你需要一些橡木原木来修理这个。

translation: 这个教程环节需要一些工具，但你的背包空间不够了。你需要丢掉一些东西。方法是[tap and hold/right-click on]你不想要的物品，然后选择丢弃。完成后，再和采矿教官对话。

english: You need some yeastier dough to make Easter Buns.
translation: 你需要一些发酵更充分的面团才能制作复活节面包。

english: You need something new to hunt. Come and see me when you can and I'll give you a new task. Your reward point tally is [number],[number].
translation: 你需要找点新猎物了。有空来找我，我给你个新任务。你的奖励点数是 [number],[number]。

english: You need something to put the flour in.
translation: 你需要找个东西来装面粉。

english: You need something to stick all the bits together.
translation: 你需要点东西把所有碎片粘在一起。

english: You need space in your inventory to take the note.
translation: 你的背包需要空位才能拿取字条。

translation: 你需要十个绿咬鹃饲料袋、三块石灰石砖和四块软粘土才能建造这个着陆点。

english: You need to activate the magical scrying orb, obtained from the wizard in Yanille, to capture the conversation with Sandy!
translation: 你需要激活从亚尼勒城的魔法师那里获得的魔法占卜球，才能记录与桑迪的对话！

english: You need to ask Sandy all the questions.
translation: 你需要问桑迪所有的问题。

english: You need to be near an anvil to convert your Dragon axe.
translation: 你需要靠近铁砧才能改造你的龙金斧。

english: You need to be near an anvil to convert your [axe name].
translation: 你需要靠近铁砧才能改造你的[axe name]。

translation: 你需要先抓一些叉鱼。

english: You need to complete [#] more laps to use this transformation.
translation: 你需要再完成[#]圈才能使用这个变形。

translation: 你需要完成时事动态任务才能学习追踪洋流。

translation: 你需要完成传奇任务才能进入传奇公会。

translation: 你需要完成撬开宝箱任务才能学习关于饮料箱的知识。

english: You need to cure this hide first.
translation: 你得先处理这张兽皮。

english: You need to fill it with compost rather than soil.
translation: 你需要用堆肥而不是土壤来填满它。

english: You need to find Anti-Santa, he's located somewhere in Varrock. Once you've found him, you'll need to earn his trust and find out what he's up to.
translation: 你得找到反圣诞老人，他就在维洛克城的某个地方。找到他之后，你需要赢得他的信任，并查明他的企图。

english: You need to find the Travelling Merchant to get the Dried cocoa.
translation: 你得找到旅行商人才能拿到干可可豆。

english: You need to finish Brother Brace's tasks before you are allowed to proceed through this door.
translation: 你得先完成布雷斯修士的任务，才能通过这扇门。

english: You need to finish the Master Chef's tasks first.
translation: 你得先完成主厨的任务。

english: You need to finish with Mining and Smithing first.
translation: 你得先完成采矿和锻造。

english: You need to focus [player name].
translation: [player name]，你得集中精神。

english: You need to free up 1 inventory space to receive your gift! You can come back and claim it when you have space.
translation: 你需要腾出1个背包空间才能领取礼物！等有空位了再回来拿吧。

english: You need to free up 2 inventory spaces to receive your gift! You can come back and claim it when you have space.
translation: 你需要腾出2个背包空间才能领取礼物！等有空位了再回来拿吧。

english: You need to get at least seven council votes to be accepted as a member of the Fremennik.

english: You need to get the horizon in the middle of the eye piece.
translation: 你需要让地平线对准目镜中央。

english: You need to get the sun in the middle of the eye piece.
translation: 你需要让太阳对准目镜中央。

english: You need to go tell that interesting character in the centre what you have just learned first.
translation: 你得先去告诉中央那个有趣的家伙你刚刚了解到的情况。

english: You need to have a bit of patience. They will be ready when they are ready.
translation: 你得有点耐心。它们准备好了自然就好了。

translation: 你需要完成“奶月望日”任务才能释放这头公牛。

english: You need to have completed the [quest] quest to go there.
translation: 你需要完成[quest]任务才能去那里。

translation: 你把一根铁锭压成了一张铁板。

translation: 你按下按钮，听到北墙传来咔哒一声。

translation: 你按下了按钮。没发生什么大事……
