english: What ye' want, Cap'n?
translation: 你想要啥，船长？

english: Ain't nothin' in that cargo hold to move!
translation: 那货舱里没啥可搬的！

english: S'pose I should get t' work.
translation: 我想我该去干活了。

english: Well, nobody seemed t' understand a word of me, but all yer stuff is now in yer bank.
translation: 好吧，好像没人听得懂我的话，但你所有的东西现在都在你的银行里了。

english: Still dead.
translation: 还是死的。

english: You get the feeling this is going to be a challenging conversation.
translation: 你感觉这会是一场很有挑战性的对话。

english: You think Jenkins is either trying to tell you that your cargo hold is empty, or he's going to steal everything from the ledger table. You're not sure.
translation: 你觉得詹金斯要么是想告诉你货舱是空的，要么就是打算把分类账桌上的东西全偷走。你不太确定。

english: With a confusing mixture of flailing and hand gestures, you manage to get Jenkins to help bank the contents of your cargo hold....
translation: 在一阵令人困惑的挥舞和手势比划之后，你总算让詹金斯帮忙把货舱里的东西存进了银行……

english: You think Jenkins is trying to tell you that all of your items from your cargo hold are now in your bank.
translation: 你觉得詹金斯是想告诉你，你货舱里的所有物品现在都在你的银行里了。

english: You're not sure what you expected.
translation: 你也不确定自己期待的是什么。

english: Woooo wooo.
translation: 呜呜——呜。

english: Woooo wooo wooo.
translation: 呜呜——呜呜——呜。

english: Wooo wooo wooooo.
translation: 呜——呜呜——呜呜呜。

english: Woooo wooo wooooo.
translation: 呜呜——呜——呜呜呜。

english: Wooo.
translation: 呜。

english: Wooo! Wooo woo!
translation: 呜！呜呜——呜！

english: Wooo! Wooo! Wooo!
translation: 呜！呜！呜！

english: Nothing much really... Just generally existing.
translation: 其实也没什么……就是活着而已。

english: I think you're about to tell me...
translation: 我觉得你正要告诉我……

english: Captain Maclean!
translation: 麦克莱恩船长！

english: Why, what's dirty?
translation: 怎么，什么东西脏了？

english: Ah, so you think you're funny, do you?
translation: 啊，你觉得你很好笑是吧？

english: Sometimes...
translation: 有时候吧……

english: You are talking to an officer, so you'll show some respect! Now tell me, what are you doing?
translation: 你是在跟一位军官说话，所以放尊重点！现在告诉我，你在干什么？

english: Like I said, nothing really.
translation: 就像我说的，真没什么。

english: Well, there's no room for dawdling on my crew!
translation: 哼，我的船员可不允许偷懒！

english: But I'm not part of your crew...
translation: 但我不是你的船员啊……

english: Too right you're not! Your attitude stinks and I've had enough of it. Consider yourself fired!
translation: 说得没错！你的态度糟透了，我受够了。你被开除了！

english: Okay... bye then.
translation: 好吧……那再见。

english: It's a good deal and no mistake. Here you go, me old shipmate, here's your ticket.
translation: 这买卖绝对划算，错不了。给你，我的老船员，这是你的票。

english: Very well, me old shipmate. Come back if you change your mind now.
translation: 好吧，我的老船员。要是改变主意了就回来。

english: The capybara and hippo both seem very impressed by your moves.
translation: 水豚和河马似乎都对你的动作印象深刻。

english: Oh, wonderful! Looks like someone has managed to break another prototype. If only I'd given a long and detailed lecture on the correct usage of it. How silly of me!
translation: 哦，太棒了！看来又有人成功弄坏了一个原型机。要是我当初就它的正确使用方法做过一番长篇大论的详细讲解就好了。我真是太蠢了！

english: What? Oh, yes, everything is just fantastic! After all, how could anything be wrong when you have such competent collegeswho continuously surprise you in ways you'd never imagine!
translation: 什么？哦，是啊，一切都棒极了！毕竟，有这么多能干的同事在身边，他们总能以你意想不到的方式给你惊喜，又怎么会出问题呢！

english: Er... Well, that's... good to hear.
translation: 呃……好吧，那……听你这么说真好。

english: It is, isn't it? It's just brilliant, isn't it? Isn't it just totally brilliant to be surrounded by individuals who redefine the definition of genius! Fantastic! Brilliant!
translation: 是啊，不是吗？简直太棒了，不是吗？被一群重新定义天才定义的人包围着，难道不是超级棒吗！太棒了！精彩绝伦！

english: You should be more careful. Make sure you look afer this one.
translation: 你应该更小心点。确保照顾好这一个。

english: Why? I think you're well on the path to working that out yourself!
translation: 为什么？我觉得你自己已经快要弄明白了！

english: That token you have! That's what it's all about! The capybaras left them for us, to test if we were worthy!
translation: 你有的那个代币！关键就在那上面！水豚把它们留给我们，是为了测试我们是否值得！

english: Okay... But what do I do with it?
translation: 好吧……但我拿它做什么呢？

english: You need to find the others! The nice ones and the nasty ones! That's how you pass the test!
translation: 你需要找到其他的！好的和坏的！这样你才能通过测试！

english: Here! I shouldn't really do this, but let me give you a little hand! Take this!
translation: 给你！我本不该这么做，但让我帮你一把！拿着这个！

english: Why? I think you've worked that out yourself now!
translation: 为什么？我觉得你现在已经自己弄明白了！

english: The tokens! It's always been about the tokens! The capybaras left them for us, to test if we were worthy! Now you finally have them all!

english: Lumbridge is one of the portals of this realm that are most easily accessed. When your deity of choice spares your life and intercepts your passing to a different plane, it's usually just easiest to attach you to one of the many teleport spells that carry passengers from Tutorial Island to Lumbridge castle, rather than starting again from scratch with a fresh spell of our own. english: Of course, no traveler in modern day RuneScape can scour the world without coming across the area orth of the kingdoms of Misthalin and Asgarnia known quite bluntly as "The Wilderness". A wasteland of esolation and death, and ultimately the realm of Zamorak. Many adventurers fall prey here to other dventurers who are simply there to kill, known by many as "PK ers". Harrowing tales have come from people who have spoken to who have made it out with barely their lives of Dragons, Demons, overgrown poisonous spiders, and adventurers touched by Zamorak himself, twisting their minds so that they may serve his chaotic ways. Little is known about this place in general, except that Zamorak is the ruler of this domain. Is there any lore of how the area we know as the Wilderness came to be? I have heard only tales, never any actual lore or written history. Many have spoken to me about speculation that this area was where the gods warred with one another and the result at the end was this place, or how it was once a peaceful, grand kingdom that fell prey to war itself, and the war caused this devastation. However all I have heard is hearsay, no truth to it. Has this history been lost?
translation: 当然，在当今的RuneScape中，任何旅行者游历世界时都难免会经过米斯林王国和阿斯加尼亚王国以北的地区，那里被直白地称为‘荒野’。一片荒凉与死亡的废土，归根结底是扎莫拉克的领域。许多冒险者在此沦为其他单纯为了杀戮而来的冒险者的猎物，这些人常被称为‘PKer’。那些侥幸逃生的人讲述了关于龙、恶魔、巨大的毒蜘蛛以及被扎莫拉克本人触及、心智扭曲以侍奉其混乱之道的冒险者的骇人故事。总的来说，人们对这个地方知之甚少，只知道扎莫拉克是这片领域的主宰。有没有关于我们称之为荒野的地区是如何形成的传说？我只听过一些故事，从未见过真正的传说或文字记载。很多人跟我推测，说这里是众神相互征战的战场，最终形成了这个地方；或者说这里曾是一个和平繁荣的伟大王国，因战争而沦陷，战争导致了这场毁灭。但我听到的都是道听途说，没有真相。这段历史是否已经失传了？

english: How many stymphike feathers have I handed in?
translation: 我交了多少根斯廷法利斯鸟羽毛？

english: Currently, my fellow disciples and I have 1 feather that has been handed in by you.
translation: 目前，我和我的同门们有你交来的1根羽毛。

english: Currently, my fellow disciples and I have [number] feathers that have been handed in by you.
translation: 目前，我和我的同门们有你交来的[number]根羽毛。

english: It's a venator breeding ground. Father Sugadinti wishes for their numbers to be restored.
translation: 这里是猎犬的繁殖地。苏加丁提神父希望恢复它们的数量。

english: Interesting... So I can't kill any?
translation: 有意思……所以我不能杀它们？

english: Not necessarily. The weak must be culled so the best specimens can thrive. As such, with a Slayer Master's permission, I will allow you to slay them.
translation: 也不尽然。弱者必须被淘汰，这样最好的个体才能茁壮成长。因此，只要有杀戮大师的许可，我会允许你猎杀它们。

english: Alternatively, are you aware of stymphikes? They prey on venator pups. Bring some feathers as proof of their deaths, either to myself or one of my fellow disciples, and we will allow you to kill some venators in return.
translation: 或者，你知道斯廷法利斯鸟吗？它们以猎犬幼崽为食。带一些它们的羽毛作为杀死它们的证明，交给我或我的同门，作为回报，我们会允许你猎杀一些猎犬。

english: I may take you up on the offer some time.
translation: 我以后可能会接受你的提议。

english: Greetings. I see you are carrying venator teeth. They are of use to us, if you would like to trade?
translation: 你好。我看到你带着猎犬的牙齿。如果你愿意交易的话，它们对我们有用。

english: What do you use venator teeth for?
translation: 你们用猎犬牙齿做什么？

english: We fashion our own arrowheads and dart tips out of them.
translation: 我们用它们来制作我们自己的箭头和飞镖尖。

english: Let's trade venator teeth.
translation: 我们来交易猎犬牙齿吧。

english: Actually, could you tell me more about this place?
translation: 其实，你能多告诉我一些关于这个地方的事吗？

english: I'm afraid you don't have any feathers to give to me.
translation: 恐怕你没有任何羽毛可以给我。

english: I'm afraid you don't have any teeth to trade.
translation: 恐怕你没有任何牙齿可以交易。

english: So, what do you do around here?
translation: 那么，你在这里做什么？

english: I distribute buckets.
translation: 我分发桶。

english: Indeed, Father Sugadinti's foresight is unparalleled.
translation: 确实，苏加丁提神父的远见无人能及。

english: You don't have enough inventory space to hold a bucket.
translation: 你的背包空间不够，放不下一个桶。

english: I am now. Thank you, friend. Now, I must get going, but come talk with me when we next meet. I think I might be able to repay you for your help...
translation: 我现在好了。谢谢你，朋友。现在我得走了，但我们下次见面时再来找我聊聊。我想我或许能报答你的帮助……

english: Hi there. You're that aranei I saved before, aren't you? How are you doing?
translation: 嗨，你好。你就是我之前救的那个阿拉内伊吧？你还好吗？

english: I am doing just fine thanks to you. If you wish, I can guide you to the forest to repay my debt.
translation: 多亏了你，我过得很好。如果你愿意，我可以带你去森林，以报答你的恩情。

english: That would be great.
translation: 那太好了。

english: Would you like me to take you to the forest?
translation: 你想让我带你去森林吗？

english: Would you like me to take you to Sangvesti? Or if you prefer, I could take you back to Morytania?
translation: 你想让我带你去桑格维斯蒂吗？或者如果你愿意，我可以带你回莫利塔尼亚？

english: Could you take me to Sangvesti?
translation: 你能带我去桑格维斯蒂吗？

english: Could you take me to Morytania?
translation: 你能带我去莫利塔尼亚吗？

english: Greetings, my friend. It is good to have you here with us.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。很高兴你能来我们这里。

english: I conduct expeditions for Father Sugadinti upon his request. When I am not busy with my duties, I help others collect or retrieve things from difficult to reach places.
translation: 我应苏加丁提神父的要求为他进行探险。当我不忙于职责时，我会帮助别人从难以到达的地方收集或取回东西。

english: Well, there are definitely plenty of those around here. So does that mean you'd be able to retrieve some things for me if I ever needed?
translation: 嗯，这里肯定有很多这样的地方。那是不是意味着，如果我需要，你能帮我取回一些东西？

english: Certainly, though I am afraid my services aren't free.
translation: 当然可以，不过恐怕我的服务不是免费的。

english: What's the cost?
translation: 费用是多少？

english: Well, Darkmeyer is always in need of more vials of blood. I am also willing to help those that show they've contributed to controlling the stymphike population here.
translation: 嗯，达克迈尔总是需要更多的血瓶。我也愿意帮助那些证明自己为控制这里的斯廷法利斯鸟数量做出贡献的人。

english: Of course, if neither of those are adequate, Father Sugadinti can always find a use for gold.
translation: 当然，如果这两样都不合适，苏加丁提神父总能找到金币的用处。

english: Could you retrieve my gravestone for me?
translation: 你能帮我取回我的墓碑吗？

english: You do not appear to have a gravestone, my friend. There is nothing for me to retrieve.
translation: 我的朋友，你似乎没有墓碑。我没什么可取的。

english: I'm afraid you lack the required payment for me to do so, my friend. I will accept either a vial of blood, 150 stymphike feathers or 50,000 coins.
translation: 恐怕你缺少我这样做的必要报酬，我的朋友。我可以接受一个血瓶、150根斯廷法利斯鸟羽毛或5万金币。

english: Your gravestone does not seem to be in Vampyrium, my friend. Imafraid I am unable to retrieve it.
translation: 我的朋友，你的墓碑似乎不在吸血鬼界。我恐怕无法取回它。

english: Well, you have stymphikes, bloodwood trees, leechfin, venators, and of course, the Maggot King.
translation: 嗯，你有斯廷法利斯鸟、血木树、利齿鳍鱼、猎血者，当然还有蛆王。

english: Tell me more about stymphikes.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于斯廷法利斯鸟的事。

english: They are birds that prey upon many of the other creatures here. However, their population is so great that they have been causing issues for Father Sugadinti's research.
translation: 它们是捕食这里许多其他生物的鸟类。然而，它们的数量太多了，已经给苏加丁提神父的研究造成了麻烦。

english: As such, we'd be grateful if you could help us control their numbers.
translation: 因此，如果你能帮助我们控制它们的数量，我们将不胜感激。

english: There are some stymphike trees just east of Sangvesti. The trees are named for the birds themselves, for they like to use the spiked branches to impale their prey, giving them easy access to the blood within.
translation: 在桑格维斯蒂东边有一些斯廷法利斯树。这些树以鸟本身命名，因为它们喜欢用带刺的树枝刺穿猎物，这样就能轻松吸到里面的血。

english: Go to those trees and bait them with something that will attract the stymphikes. We have found that letvek work best. They are small insects that you can catch across the river south of Sangvesti.
translation: 去那些树那里，用能吸引斯廷法利斯鸟的东西做诱饵。我们发现莱特维克虫效果最好。它们是你在桑格维斯蒂南边的河对岸可以捕捉到的小昆虫。

english: And once I've baited the tree?
translation: 那我把树诱饵放好之后呢？

english: Find somewhere to hide nearby so the stymphikes can't see you, then strike when they come for the bait.
translation: 在附近找个地方躲起来，这样斯廷法利斯鸟就看不到你了，然后等它们来吃诱饵时再出击。

english: Tell me more about bloodwood trees.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于血木树的事。

english: Well, Father Sugadinti has been using their sap in his research, but it also has other benefits that you might appreciate.
translation: 嗯，苏加丁提神父一直在他的研究中使用它们的树液，但它还有其他你可能喜欢的好处。

english: Those being?
translation: 什么好处？

english: We have found that when applied to arrows, the sap makes them more powerful.
translation: 我们发现，将树液涂在箭上，会让箭更强大。

english: Interesting... And how do I get this sap?
translation: 有意思……那我怎么得到这种树液？

english: You will need to cut through the trunk of the tree until the sap begins to seep out. Be warned, the trees are tough, so it will take a bit more work than the trees you're probably used to.
translation: 你需要砍穿树干，直到树液开始渗出。警告你，这些树很硬，所以要比你平时砍的树多费点功夫。

english: Before you start cutting them though, make sure to put a bucket down. You'll need it to collect the sap in. Some of my fellow disciples keep buckets on hand. Seek them out if needed.
translation: 不过在你开始砍树之前，一定要先放一个桶。你需要用它来收集树液。我的一些同门手头有桶。如果需要的话，去找他们。

english: Tell me more about leechfin.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于吸血鱼的事。

english: As you've no doubt realised by now, blood is quite the commodity here in Vampyrium, and leechfin have more blood than creatures twice their size.
translation: 你现在肯定已经注意到了，血在吸血鬼界是相当重要的商品，而吸血鱼的血比它们体型两倍的生物还要多。

english: You can fish them in the river to the far east. Catch enough of them, and you'll be able to collect up their blood in a vial.
translation: 你可以在极东的河里钓到它们。钓到足够多，你就能把它们的血收集到瓶子里。

english: I believe that vials of blood are quite useful in potion making. Unsurprisingly, they are also of great use to Father Sugadinti.
translation: 我相信血瓶在制作药水时非常有用。不出所料，它们对苏加丁提神父也很有用。

english: Tell me more about venators.
translation: 多告诉我一些关于猎犬的事。

english: Father Sugadinti believes they are the closest living relative to vampyres, making them very useful indeed. However, their population has diminished significantly. We are working to address that.
translation: 苏加丁提神父认为它们是吸血鬼现存最近的亲属，因此非常有用。然而，它们的数量已经大大减少了。我们正在努力解决这个问题。

english: And is that something I can help with?
translation: 那我能帮上忙吗？

english: Quite possibly. While we need to restore their numbers, it is also important we ensure only the strongest are able to breed. As such, with a Slayer Master's permission, we will allow you to slay them.
translation: 很有可能。虽然我们需要恢复它们的数量，但确保只有最强壮的个体才能繁殖也很重要。因此，只要有杀戮大师的许可，我们会允许你猎杀它们。

english: Alternatively, if you bring some stymphike feathers to either myself or one of my fellow disciples, we will allow you to kill some venators in return.
translation: 或者，如果你带一些斯廷法利斯鸟的羽毛给我或我的同门，作为回报，我们会允许你猎杀一些猎犬。

english: Tell me more about the Maggot King.
translation: 再跟我说说蛆王的事。

english: Ah, yes. A Maggot King is the final form of one of Vampyrium's most disgusting creatures, the ur-maggot. They are thankfully very rare, but very destructive.
translation: 啊，是的。蛆王是维普瑞姆最恶心的生物之一——原蛆的最终形态。谢天谢地，它们非常罕见，但破坏力极强。

english: Dealing with it is unfortunately beyond our abilities, but if you feel you are able, it would be highly beneficial to our work here for you to do so instead.
translation: 不幸的是，对付它超出了我们的能力范围，但如果你觉得自己有能力，由你来处理它会对我们这里的工作非常有利。

english: Where do I find it?
translation: 我在哪里能找到它？

english: If you take the path north east of Sangvesti, that should lead you right to it.
translation: 如果你走桑格维斯蒂东北边的那条路，应该就能直接找到它。

english: Until next time, my friend.
translation: 下次再见，我的朋友。

english: Hey, it's the hero! Thank you so much for everything you've done, not just for us, but for all of Morytania!
translation: 嘿，是英雄！非常感谢你所做的一切，不仅是为了我们，也是为了整个莫利塔尼亚！

english: Well, I'd be lying if I said life was suddenly perfect, but it's nice to no longer live in constant fear of the vampyres.
translation: 嗯，如果我说生活突然变得完美了，那是在撒谎，但不用再时刻生活在吸血鬼的恐惧中，感觉真好。

english: What will you do now that you don't have to worry about them?
translation: 既然不用担心它们了，你打算做什么？

english: Well, quite a few of us are working on making the town a bit nicer. Not that there's anything wrong with the work you did of course.
translation: 嗯，我们有不少人正在努力把城镇弄得漂亮点。当然，不是说你们做的工作有什么问题。

english: Some of the others don't want to stick around. They reckon it might be safe enough to make the journey up to Paterdomus now. I think they want to start a new life across the Salve.
translation: 其他一些人不想留下来。他们觉得现在可能足够安全，可以前往帕特多莫斯了。我想他们想在萨尔维河对岸开始新生活。

english: With the town? No, I don't think so. You've done enough to help us anyway.
translation: 帮忙重建城镇？不，我不这么认为。你已经帮了我们很多了。

english: I suppose if you did want to help in some way though, you could maybe assist those who want to get to Paterdomus. The swamps can still be pretty dangerous.
translation: 不过，如果你真想以某种方式帮忙，也许可以协助那些想去帕特多莫斯的人。沼泽地仍然相当危险。

english: All this work they're doing to fix this place up and they still barely feed me anything! It's an outrage!
translation: 他们费这么大劲修缮这个地方，却几乎不给我东西吃！真是岂有此理！

english: There's plenty of rats around. Maybe you could help out with the work by getting rid of a few.
translation: 这附近有很多老鼠。也许你可以帮忙干掉几只，也算是为工作出力了。

english: Hmm... Yes, very well.
translation: 嗯……好吧，可以。

english: I just like to go around playin'. I get to play lots now da vyresies aren't all mean, but I still don't like dem very much.
translation: 我就是喜欢到处玩。现在那些吸血鬼不那么坏了，我可以玩很多，但我还是不太喜欢他们。

english: I's been helpin' to make da buildin's all good again!
translation: 我一直在帮忙把那些建筑都修好！

english: The vyresies don't go takin' our blood no more, but now we gotta rebuild everything. They say it's gonna take years! Sounds a bit borin' to me.
translation: 那些吸血鬼不再抽我们的血了，但现在我们得重建一切。他们说这要花好几年！听起来有点无聊。

english: They used to keep some of the tithes drunk all the time and then take it from them. Now the aranei that supply it intentionally get drunk first instead.
translation: 他们以前总是让一些贡品喝醉，然后从他们身上取血。现在供应贡品的阿拉内伊会故意先把自己灌醉。

english: Well, now that the vampyres aren't a problem, I reckon there might be a hope of actually making it through the swamps and starting a new life over in Misthalin.
translation: 嗯，既然吸血鬼不再是问题了，我觉得或许真的有希望能穿过沼泽，在米斯塔林开始新生活。

english: Escape? But why? The Drakans aren't a threat now.
translation: 逃跑？为什么？德雷肯家族现在不是威胁了。

english: So I should just take my chances with their replacement? No. I'm not sticking around anywhere where there are vampyres to be found. That's why I need the 100 hallowed marks.
translation: 所以我该去赌他们的替代者？不。我不会待在任何一个有吸血鬼的地方。这就是为什么我需要那100个神圣印记。

english: I can't thank you enough! I can finally escape this place!
translation: 我感激不尽！我终于能逃离这个地方了！

english: You hand over the 100 hallowed marks and the man departs.
translation: 你交出100个神圣印记，那人便离开了。

english: Dr Harlow? What are you doing here?
translation: 哈洛博士？你在这里做什么？

english: Me? Why I'm having shome nice drinksh, thank yoush very much.
translation: 我？我正喝点好酒呢，多谢关心。

english: But what are you doing in Morytania?
translation: 但你在莫利塔尼亚做什么？

english: I heard someone went and killed that big nashty vampyre. I bet they ushed a shtake? Besht way to kill one!
translation: 我听说有人去杀了那只大坏吸血鬼。我打赌他们用了木桩？杀吸血鬼最好的方法！

english: Anyway, with the bigsh vampyre gone, I thought I'd comesh and vishit again. Been sho long, since I wash lasht here. I wanted to shee what hadsh changed.
translation: 不管怎样，那个大吸血鬼走了，我想着过来看看。好久没来了，从我上次在这儿之后。我想看看有什么变化。

english: Not too bad, Drezel. How about here?
translation: 还不错，德雷泽尔。这里呢？

english: Well, it's nice to not have to worry as much about the vampyres, but I must admit, I'm still not overly comfortable about the fact that we're now all trying to be friends.
translation: 嗯，不用太担心吸血鬼是好事，但我得承认，对于我们现在要试着做朋友这件事，我还是不太自在。

english: It was that or we try to kill them all, and I'm not totally sure wiping out a whole race would have been the best of ideas either... not that we'd have ever likely been able to.
translation: 要么这样，要么我们试着杀光他们，我也不确定灭绝整个种族是不是好主意……反正我们也不太可能做得到。

english: You make a good point. And I suppose the King is behind it, even if that advisor of his isn't... Even still, I'm glad we have the Salve to stop them if they do try anything.
translation: 你说得对。我想国王是支持这件事的，就算他的顾问不是……不过，我还是庆幸我们有萨维护身符，如果他们敢轻举妄动，就能阻止他们。

english: In happier news, Ivan is now able to properly focus on his studying... though he does still sneak off for the odd adventure from time to time.
translation: 好消息是，伊万现在能专心学习了……虽然他偶尔还是会溜出去冒险。

english: Well, I suppose you can't be too picky.
translation: 嗯，我想也不能太挑剔。

english: Indeed. The important part is that he will be a worthy successor. Of that, I can be confident.
translation: 确实。重要的是他会成为一个称职的继承人。这点我很确定。

english: I couldn't agree more. Until next time, Drezel.
translation: 我完全同意。下次见，德雷泽尔。

english: Hello there, [player name]. It's good to see you.
translation: 你好，[player name]。很高兴见到你。

english: I could use a new weapon.
translation: 我需要一把新武器。

english: How are you feeling about being back here?
translation: 回到这里感觉如何？

english: It is still strange. I no longer recognise any part of these lands.
translation: 还是很奇怪。这片土地我再也认不出来了。

english: Do you think they can ever go back to how you remembered them?
translation: 你觉得它们还能变回你记忆中的样子吗？

english: No. Sugadinti suggested that we rename Morytania back to Hallowvale, but I declined. Hallowvale will never exist again. It is nothing more than a memory now.
translation: 不。苏加丁提建议我们把莫利塔尼亚改回霍洛维尔，但我拒绝了。霍洛维尔永远不会再存在了。现在它只是一个回忆。

english: However, that doesn't mean we can't still create something new here. Morytania does not need to be the dark land it currently is. With time, a lot is still possible.
translation: 不过，这不代表我们不能在这里创造新事物。莫利塔尼亚不必一直是现在这片黑暗之地。随着时间推移，很多事情还是有可能的。

english: I'm glad Sugadinti has you to support him. Do you think you'll ever properly rule alongside him?
translation: 我很高兴苏加丁提有你支持他。你觉得你会和他一起正式统治吗？

english: My days of leading ended long ago. However, I will always be here to help where needed.
translation: 我领导的日子早就结束了。不过，我会一直在这里，在需要的时候提供帮助。

english: How is Safalaan doing?
translation: 萨法拉恩怎么样了？

english: As well as can be expected. You saw for yourself the horrifying effects the vampyrification process had on him.
translation: 和预期差不多。你亲眼看到了吸血鬼化过程对他造成的可怕影响。

english: Vanescula said it was because of his icyene blood?
translation: 瓦内斯库拉说是因为他的冰血族血统？

english: Indeed. Drakan called them wyrds. Far more powerful than a normal vampyre, but far more prone to uncontrollable hunger as well. He showed me one once. A little gloat about what he could do to my people.
translation: 没错。德雷肯称他们为扭曲者。比普通吸血鬼强大得多，但也更容易陷入无法控制的饥饿。他曾经给我看过一个。有点炫耀他能对我的族人做什么。

english: But you've been able to keep that hunger in check?
translation: 但你能控制住那种饥饿吗？

english: As best as we can. He must feed. That is not something that can be avoided, but I have been making him potions to help him stay in control.
translation: 尽我们所能。他必须进食。这是无法避免的，但我一直在为他制作药水，帮助他保持控制。

english: With time, I hope I can refine things further. We may even find a way for him to utilise the shapeshifting abilities possessed by other vampyres.
translation: 随着时间的推移，我希望我能进一步改进。我们甚至可能找到方法让他利用其他吸血鬼拥有的变形能力。

english: Well, if there's anything I can do to help with that, just let me know.
translation: 嗯，如果有什么我能帮忙的，尽管告诉我。

english: Thank you, [player name], but I think I have all that I need. It's just time and patience now. That said, while I do not need anything myself, I'm sure Safalaan would be keen to see you.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]，但我想我需要的都有了。现在只需要时间和耐心。话虽如此，虽然我自己不需要什么，但我确定萨法拉恩很想见你。

english: No doubt you've seen that Sugadinti has opened a new portal to Vampyrium. Safalaan has been spending a lot of his time there, helping the aranei with their work. I think he prefers to be away from this place.
translation: 你肯定看到了苏加丁提开了一个通往吸血鬼界的新传送门。萨法拉恩在那里花了很多时间，帮助蜘蛛族工作。我想他更喜欢离开这个地方。

english: Understandable. I'll make sure to check in and see how he's getting on.
translation: 可以理解。我会去看看他过得怎么样。

english: Take care out there.
translation: 在外面小心点。

english: I have a tome here for you, [player name]. Use it well.
translation: 我这里有一本典籍给你，[player name]。好好利用它。

english: My name's Emilia. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Plenty that needs sorting now that the vampyres aren't out to get us.
translation: 我叫艾米莉亚。我什么都做一点。既然吸血鬼不再找我们麻烦，有很多事情需要处理。

english: Oh, my name's Florin. I just help out around here, you know, gathering food and so on.
translation: 哦，我叫弗洛林。我只是在这里帮忙，你知道的，收集食物之类的。

english: Oh, my name's Grigore. I just help out around here, you know, gathering food and so on.
translation: 哦，我叫格里戈雷。我只是在这里帮忙，你知道的，收集食物之类的。

english: Of course. Now that the vampyres are no longer a threat, these warriors are keen to test their mettle in the Theatre of Blood.
translation: 当然。既然吸血鬼不再是威胁，这些战士渴望在血腥剧场中考验自己的勇气。

english: However, given they're not familiar with the area, they're waiting for someone to help guide them down to Burgh de Rott.
translation: 不过，由于他们不熟悉这个区域，他们正在等有人帮忙引导他们前往伯格德罗特镇。

english: My name's Ileana. I'm just trying to make do I guess. The vampyres might not be a problem, but there's still no shortage of dangers around here.
translation: 我叫伊莱娜。我想我只是在勉强度日。吸血鬼可能不是问题了，但这里仍然不乏危险。

english: It's good to see you, Ivan.
translation: 很高兴见到你，伊万。

english: Pretty good, though Drezel seems to think that just because the vampyres aren't trying to kill us now, he can work me twice as hard! I know he just wants the best for me, but it's a bit overwhelming at times.
translation: 还不错，不过德雷泽尔似乎觉得，就因为吸血鬼现在不杀我们了，他就能加倍使唤我！我知道他是为我好，但有时候真有点受不了。

english: Someone really should break it to him that while he is getting on a bit, he's not that old! He's got quite a few years left of looking after this place before worrying about me taking over.
translation: 真该有人告诉他，虽然他年纪大了点，但还没那么老！他还有好几年可以照看这个地方，不用急着担心我接班。

english: Still, at least he's not moaned too much about me taking the odd trip into Morytania. He's also allowed me to start looking into an old columbarium that might be buried somewhere under the temple.
translation: 不过，至少他没怎么抱怨我偶尔去莫利塔尼亚旅行。他还允许我开始调查一个可能埋在神殿地下的古老骨灰安置所。

english: Columbarium?
translation: 骨灰安置所？

english: Yes! It's an old burial chamber that one of the books in the library mentioned. I'm trying to work out where abouts it is so we can see if anything is left of it.
translation: 是的！那是一个古老的墓室，图书馆里有本书提到过。我想弄清楚它大概在哪儿，这样我们就能看看是否还留下什么东西。

english: Interesting... You said you'd taken a trip or two into Morytania as well?
translation: 有意思……你说你也去过莫利塔尼亚一两次？

english: That's right. I went down to Burgh de Rott to visit Veliaf in his new pub. It's still a bit of a mess down there, but he's slowly working on it. The alcohol isn't terrible either.
translation: 没错。我去了伯格德罗特镇，在维利亚夫的新酒馆里拜访他。那里还是一团糟，但他正在慢慢收拾。酒也不难喝。

english: I've visited Safalaan a few times as well. He always seems pretty upbeat, but I do worry about him... Having to live as a vampyre... It must be horrible!
translation: 我也去看过萨法拉恩几次。他看起来总是很乐观，但我确实担心他……不得不以吸血鬼的身份生活……那一定很可怕！

english: At least he has Efaritay now.
translation: 至少他现在有埃法里泰了。

english: That's true. She seems to be doing well as well, though it can't be easy for her to be back in her old homeland.
translation: 这倒是真的。她看起来也过得不错，虽然回到她的旧家园对她来说并不容易。

english: True, but I can't think of anyone better to help bring back a little bit of the old Hallowvale.
translation: 没错，但我想不出有谁比她更适合帮忙带回一点旧霍洛维尔的风貌。

english: That's a shame. I'll miss the swamps.
translation: 真可惜。我会想念沼泽的。

english: What? Not a fan of the ghasts?
translation: 什么？不喜欢食尸鬼？

english: *sigh* I'll see you later, Ivan.
translation: *叹气*回头见，伊万。

english: How are things with Morytania?
translation: 莫利塔尼亚那边怎么样了？

english: Couldn't be better! After all that fearmongering from you, citizen, it turned out they actually wanted to be friends! Good job you're not the King.
translation: 好得不能再好了！在你那些危言耸听之后，市民，结果他们居然想和我们做朋友！幸好你不是国王。

english: I don't think that's quite...
translation: 我不太认为那是……

english: Yes, I agree! It's very good indeed.
translation: 是的，我同意！确实非常好。

english: I do still feel that we should reconsider this new alliance, my lord. Vampyres are beasts of Zamorak!
translation: 我仍然觉得我们应该重新考虑这个新联盟，我的大人。吸血鬼是扎莫拉克的野兽！

english: Well, you were very worried about those Guthixian edicts, Aeonisig. Surely with this new alliance, we've managed to achieve the perfect balance those Guthixians always wanted!
translation: 嗯，你之前非常担心那些古斯教令，埃奥尼西格。有了这个新联盟，我们肯定已经实现了那些古神信徒一直想要的完美平衡！

english: Yes, but the Church of Saradomin...
translation: 是的，但萨拉多明教会……

english: Oh, don't worry yourself, Aeonisig. It's not like we'll be inviting any of them over any time soon. No, this new arrangement is perfect. We can be all be friends, but just from a safe and healthy distance!
translation: 哦，别担心了，埃奥尼西格。我们又不会很快邀请他们过来。不，这个新安排很完美。我们可以都做朋友，但保持一个安全健康的距离！

english: Anyway, what was it you wanted, citizen?
translation: 总之，你想要什么，市民？

english: You know, I think I'll actually be on my way...
translation: 你知道吗，我想我还是走吧……

english: Some prefer solids to go with their blood. That, and the werewolf and human visitors need something to eat too.
translation: 有些人喜欢在血里加点固体食物。而且，狼人和人类访客也需要吃东西。

english: Well, it's not like anything nefarious if that's what you're worried about... Not any more at least...
translation: 嗯，如果你担心的话，不是什么邪恶的东西……至少现在不是了……

english: Do you want something?
translation: 你想要什么吗？

english: Then be on your way. I have a meeting with Lord Vitur soon and I don't need any distractions.
translation: 那就走吧。我很快要和维图尔大人开会，不需要分心。

english: Oh, my name's Luscion. I just help out around here, you know, gathering food and so on.
translation: 哦，我叫卢西恩。我只是在这里帮忙，你知道的，收集食物之类的。

english: I've been working on getting some things fixed up around here. Hopefully we can eventually make a proper home out of this city.
translation: 我一直在努力修复这里的一些东西。希望我们最终能把这座城市变成一个像样的家。

english: Well, the vampyres aren't taking our blood anymore, and they've promised to help us rebuild the city. Still, it's going to take a long time to fix this place up. Most people have chosen to leave instead.
translation: 嗯，吸血鬼不再吸我们的血了，他们也承诺帮我们重建城市。不过，修复这个地方还需要很长时间。大多数人反而选择离开了。

english: I often thought about trying out the Theatre myself before Drakan was dealt with. Glad I never ended up doing that!
translation: 在德雷肯被解决之前，我经常想自己去试试剧场。幸好我从来没去成！

english: It's nice that they let us watch the performances in the Theatre now. It's fun seeing how good some of those warriors from Misthalin are!
translation: 现在他们让我们在剧场里看表演，真好。看到那些来自米斯萨林的战士有多厉害，真有趣！

english: Going to give the Theatre a go? You look like you've got what it takes.
translation: 要去剧场试试吗？你看起来有那个本事。

english: Fancy a leg?
translation: 想要一条腿吗？

english: A leg. I'm not allowed to have them any more, so maybe you want one instead.
translation: 一条腿。我不再被允许吃它们了，所以也许你想要一条。

english: I have some good news. Count Draynor is no more!
translation: 我有好消息。德雷诺伯爵完蛋了！

english: He's really gone? Finally, we can live without fear! Thank you, thank you! You're a true hero!
translation: 他真的走了？终于，我们可以无忧无虑地生活了！谢谢你，谢谢你！你是个真正的英雄！

english: Once again, thank you for slaying that vampyre! You will always be a hero!
translation: 再次感谢你杀死了那个吸血鬼！你将永远是英雄！

english: Greetings, friend. I have something for you, if you desire.
translation: 你好，朋友。如果你想要的话，我有东西给你。

english: Could I have some teleport crystals?
translation: 我能要一些传送水晶吗？

english: Could you show me a memory?
translation: 你能给我看一段记忆吗？

english: Okay... So I presume you want me to get some of this treasure for you? Does Efaritay know about this? It doesn't seem like the kind of thing she would appreciate.
translation: 好吧……所以我猜你想让我帮你弄一些这些宝藏？埃法里泰知道这事吗？这看起来不像她会欣赏的事情。

english: It was actually on her orders that we first started doing it. She was very keen for us to gather as much of the old currency of this land as possible.
translation: 实际上，我们最初开始做这件事是奉她的命令。她非常希望我们尽可能多地收集这片土地的旧货币。

english: Hallowed marks... But why do you still need them? Drakan is gone now.
translation: 神圣印记……但为什么你还需要它们？德雷肯已经不在了。

english: Yes... There was some debate over if we should end our work here. It is true that the icyene in particular was keen to see it come to an end.
translation: 是的……关于是否应该结束这里的工作，有过一些争论。确实，尤其是冰血族很想看到它结束。

english: However, the tombs have already been desecrated. That cannot be undone now, and while Drakan may be gone, it is wise that we be adequately prepared for any possibility.
translation: 然而，墓穴已经被亵渎了。这已经无法挽回，虽然德雷肯可能不在了，但我们为任何可能性做好充分准备是明智的。

english: So, with that in mind, if you find any hallowed marks, I'd be willing to take them off your hands. In exchange, I can provide tools that can help you within the Hallowed Sepulchre.
translation: 所以，考虑到这一点，如果你找到任何神圣印记，我愿意从你手中收下它们。作为交换，我可以提供在神圣墓穴中能帮到你的工具。

english: Daeyalt used to be a key component in the vampyrification process. However, while vampyrification has been outlawed, it still has other purposes.
translation: 暗影矿曾经是吸血鬼化过程中的关键成分。不过，虽然吸血鬼化已被禁止，但它还有其他用途。

english: The essence can be used to create runes, for example. Lord Vitur has also been using it as part of his experiments to create an alternate food source to blood.
translation: 例如，精华可以用来制作符文。维图尔大人也一直在用它进行实验，以创造血液的替代食物来源。

english: I need some equipment.
translation: 我需要一些装备。

english: Well, you're not having it for free. Cough up.
translation: 嗯，你不会免费得到它的。掏钱吧。

english: Oh, you need one do you? Wouldn't hurt you to think about what I might need, would it? Hmph! Still, s'pose I promised the lad I'd help you out.
translation: 哦，你需要一个是吗？想想我需要什么也不会害了你，对吧？哼！不过，我想我答应过那小子要帮你。

english: Oh, my name's Radu. I just help out around here, you know, gathering food and so on.
translation: 哦，我叫拉杜。我只是在这里帮忙，你知道的，收集食物之类的。

english: attack us...
translation: 攻击我们……

english: That doesn't seem likely...
translation: 这不太可能吧……

english: No? The Saradominists hate us. It was only thanks to Lord Drakan that these lands were kept safe, but now he's gone and we've got some new overlord who apparently wants us to all be friends! Like that's ever
translation: 不可能？那些萨拉多明信徒恨我们入骨。多亏了德拉肯领主，这片土地才得以保全，但现在他走了，我们来了个新老大，居然想让我们全都和睦相处！好像这真的

english: going to happen!
translation: 能成真似的！

english: So... Are you going to do something about that?
translation: 那么……你打算对此做点什么吗？

english: Me? Of course not! Someone really should though...
translation: 我？当然不！不过确实该有人管管……

english: Apparently, Morytania was once a strong and mighty kingdom, with lands spreading far further west than they do today, and south into the desert as well.
translation: 据说，莫利塔尼亚曾经是一个强大而雄伟的王国，疆域向西远至今日之外，向南也延伸到了沙漠。

english: That was all until the day when a sneak attack by the hated human forces who worship Saradomin burned our villages and slaughtered our peoples in mass. To rub salt into the wound, they then cursed the river as well!
translation: 这一切一直持续到那一天，崇拜萨拉多明的可恨人类军队发动偷袭，烧毁了我们的村庄，大规模屠杀了我们的人民。更雪上加霜的是，他们还诅咒了这条河！

english: Luckily they seem to have calmed down somewhat recently, and tend to stay on their side of the river... but the wrong they have done my people will never be forgotten, and will never be forgiven!
translation: 幸运的是，他们最近似乎消停了一些，大多待在河对岸……但他们对我族人犯下的罪行，我们永远不会忘记，也永远不会原谅！

english: So you hate humans?
translation: 所以你恨人类？

english: It's strange, this place. From the plants, to the creatures... even the land itself. It's all undeniably horrifying, and yet... there's a certain feeling of peace here.
translation: 这地方真奇怪。从植物到生物……甚至这片土地本身。一切都无可否认地令人恐惧，然而……这里却有一种奇特的平静感。

english: I wonder if it's the simplicity. There are no politics here. No debates. You don't need to care about good or evil, because there isn't any. Here you can just... be.
translation: 我想是不是因为这里很简单。没有政治，没有争论。你不需要关心善恶，因为这里根本没有善恶。在这里，你只需要……存在。

english: Or of course, maybe that's just the monster within me talking.
translation: 当然，也可能只是我内心的怪物在说话。

english: You're no monster, Safalaan.
translation: 你不是怪物，萨法拉恩。

english: Are you sure? How do you know I'm not about to try and eat you right now?
translation: 你确定吗？你怎么知道我现在不会试着吃掉你？

english: Er... You are joking right?
translation: 呃……你在开玩笑对吧？

english: Probably... Or am I? Hard to say for sure... You never know when the urge to feed will take hold...
translation: 大概吧……或者不是？很难说准……你永远不知道那股进食的冲动什么时候会涌上来……

english: Come on, [player name], look at me. Even other vampyres consider me an abomination... At least let me find some humour in all of this.
translation: 拜托，[player name]，看着我。就连其他吸血鬼都认为我是个怪物……至少让我在这件事里找点乐子吧。

english: *hmph* Like you'd be able to eat me anyway. You do remember that I'm the one that finally killed Drakan, right?
translation: 哼，好像你真能吃掉我似的。你总记得是我最终杀了德拉肯吧？

english: In truth, I can still barely believe it. All those years fighting him, and now it's finally all over... It almost doesn't feel real.
translation: 说实话，我到现在还不太敢相信。和他战斗了那么多年，现在终于全都结束了……感觉几乎不真实。

english: Well, you were a bit out of it for a fair chunk.
translation: 嗯，你有一大段时间可是有点神志不清。

english: Oh, so the humour is only okay when you do it?
translation: 哦，所以只有你能开玩笑？

english: Just seems a bit unfair to kick me while I'm down... Maybe I should eat you...
translation: 在我低落的时候还来踩我一脚，有点不公平吧……也许我真该吃掉你……

english: It's good to see you haven't changed, Safalaan.
translation: 很高兴看到你没变，萨法拉恩。

english: And for as long as I have friends like you, [player name], I hope I never will. Thank you... truly.
translation: 只要我还有像你这样的朋友，[player name]，我希望我永远不会变。谢谢你……真心地。

english: Like I told you, Safalaan, we're in this together. Anyway, I'll leave you to it, but we'll talk more soon.
translation: 我跟你说过，萨法拉恩，我们是一起的。好了，我不打扰你了，我们回头再聊。

english: Safalaan. How are things going?
translation: 萨法拉恩。情况怎么样？

english: [player name]. I must admit, things are very tiring at the moment. Even with help from mother, controlling this... condition takes a lot of work.
translation: [player name]。我得承认，现在事情很累人。就算有母亲的帮助，控制这种……状况也需要花费很大精力。

english: That's before we even get onto the work I've been doing to help Sugadinti with the blood shortages.
translation: 这还不算我帮苏加丁提解决血液短缺所做的工作。

english: What have you been doing?
translation: 你一直在做什么？

english: As a wyrd, I hunger far more than a normal vampyre. It... disgusts me, to be honest. However, it does mean I am a perfect test subject for Sugadinti.
translation: 作为一个异变者，我比普通吸血鬼饥饿得多。说实话，这让我……感到恶心。不过，这也意味着我是苏加丁提完美的实验对象。

english: You're not doing too much, are you?
translation: 你没做得太过火吧？

english: Perhaps, but I'd prefer to be useful. I find it easier, keeping myself busy. It helps me deal with things. Helps me come to terms with who I am now.
translation: 也许吧，但我更愿意做个有用的人。我发现让自己忙起来会更容易一些。这能帮我应对一切，帮我接受现在的自己。

english: Fair enough. You just make sure to let me know if anything gets too much.
translation: 有道理。如果有什么事让你受不了了，一定要告诉我。

english: Oh I will. As you yourself reminded me, it would be unwise to get on the bad side of the one who finally killed Drakan.
translation: 哦，我会的。就像你提醒我的那样，得罪那个最终杀了德拉肯的人可不是明智之举。

english: Shame I didn't do the same to his sister. If I had, you'd never have been in this position.
translation: 可惜我没对他妹妹也这么做。要是做了，你就不会落到这步田地了。

english: Perhaps, or perhaps we'd just all be dead instead. Besides, Vanescula has already been well and truly punished for what she did.
translation: 也许吧，或者也许我们全都死了。再说了，瓦内斯库拉已经为她所做的一切受到了应有的惩罚。

english: Not too eager to forgive her, are you?
translation: 你似乎不太急于原谅她？

english: Forgive her? Never. But with her in her state and me in mine, she'll fear me for the rest of her days.
translation: 原谅她？绝不。但以她现在的状态和我的状态，她余生都会惧怕我。

english: I suppose there is some justice in that.
translation: 我想这也算某种公正吧。

english: Indeed. Now, you'll have to forgive me, [player name], but I believe Sugadinti will have need of me soon. I'll see you later.
translation: 确实。现在，你得原谅我了，[player name]，我想苏加丁提很快需要我。回头见。

english: Until next time, Safalaan.
translation: 下次见，萨法拉恩。

english: My name's Sergiu. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Plenty that needs sorting now that the vampyres aren't out to get us.
translation: 我叫塞尔吉乌。我什么都做一点。既然吸血鬼不再找我们麻烦，有很多事情需要处理。

english: My name's Sorin. I'm just trying to make do I guess. The vampyres might not be a problem, but there's still no shortage of dangers around here.
translation: 我叫索林。我想我只是在尽力而为。吸血鬼可能不再是问题，但这里仍然不乏危险。

english: Welcome back, my child.
translation: 欢迎回来，我的孩子。

english: How are things in Morytania?
translation: 莫利塔尼亚情况如何？

english: Very good, my child. My disciples are providing a steady supply of their blood for the vampyres. As promised, the tithing of humans has been completely outlawed.
translation: 非常好，我的孩子。我的门徒们正在稳定地为吸血鬼提供他们的血液。正如承诺的那样，人类献祭已经被完全禁止了。

english: And the vampyres are all happy with that?
translation: 吸血鬼们都对此满意吗？

english: Most are understanding of the fact that regardless of anything else, the days of tithing humans were running short. However, it is true that some found human blood to be more... appetising.
translation: 大多数人都明白，不管其他方面如何，人类献祭的日子已经时日无多了。不过，确实有些吸血鬼觉得人血更……美味。

english: I assume that won't be a problem?
translation: 我想这不会成为问题吧？

english: You need not fear, my child. Any that attempt to take blood from a human will be dealt with harshly.
translation: 你不用担心，我的孩子。任何试图从人类身上取血的吸血鬼都会受到严厉处置。

english: That said, my understanding is that some humans did willingly provide their blood to the Drakans. It is of course possible that could be explored again in future, albeit with very different arrangements.
translation: 话说回来，据我所知，有些人类确实曾自愿向德拉肯家族提供血液。当然，未来也有可能再次探索这种做法，尽管安排会非常不同。

english: However, I very much understand that will likely be a... difficult proposal for most to swallow.
translation: 不过，我非常理解，这对大多数人来说可能是一个……难以接受的提议。

english: Yes, I can't see many being up for that sort of thing. Speaking of which, how are the humans of Morytania doing?
translation: 是的，我看没多少人会愿意做这种事。说到这个，莫利塔尼亚的人类过得怎么样？

english: The fact that they are not being tithed is on its own a significant improvement to their quality of life. However, their homes are still ruins and these lands are still dangerous.
translation: 仅仅是不再被献祭这一点，就已经大大改善了他们的生活质量。然而，他们的家园仍是废墟，这片土地也依然危险。

english: We are offering our help in building them new homes, but it will take many years, and most are still naturally distrusting of our kind.
translation: 我们正在提供帮助，为他们建造新家，但这需要很多年，而且大多数人仍然对我们这类人天生不信任。

english: I'm guessing a lot will be more interested in starting new lives across the Salve.
translation: 我猜很多人会更想在萨尔维河对岸开始新生活。

english: You are correct, my child. However, while we have established somewhat of an... understanding with your human kingdoms to the west, it is their preference that we try to limit how many humans relocate over there.
translation: 你说得对，我的孩子。不过，虽然我们与西边的人类王国达成了一定程度的……谅解，但他们更希望我们尽量限制迁移过去的人类数量。

english: They are not equipped to deal with a large number of refugees, and it is also our hope that many humans will realise they still have a place here. We will need their help restoring these lands to glory.
translation: 他们没有能力应对大量难民，同时我们也希望许多人类能意识到他们在这里仍有立足之地。我们需要他们的帮助来恢复这片土地的荣光。

english: That's not going to be an easy undertaking.
translation: 这可不是一件容易的事。

english: It will most certainly take many of your human lifetimes, but I have no doubt we will make it so.
translation: 这肯定需要耗费你们人类好几代人的时间，但我毫不怀疑我们能做到。

english: I see you've opened a new portal to Vampyrium.
translation: 我看到你开了一个通往吸血鬼界的新传送门。

english: Yes... While my disciples are currently providing blood for the vampyres here, I do not consider that a suitable long-term solution. Haemalchemy, I believe, will be the true answer.
translation: 是的……虽然我的门徒们目前正在为这里的吸血鬼提供血液，但我不认为这是一个合适的长期解决方案。我相信，血液炼金术才是真正的答案。

english: With us having outlawed the practice of vampyrification, we have started using the labs to explore the creation of artificial blood instead. Curiously, we've already had some luck with daeyalt of all things.
translation: 既然我们已经禁止了吸血鬼化仪式，我们便开始利用实验室探索人造血液的制造。奇怪的是，我们居然在暗辉石上取得了一些进展。

english: It seems that the very substance that is the key to making vampyres can also potentially contribute to feeding them. While it makes sense in many ways, it was also rather... unexpected.
translation: 看来，这种制造吸血鬼的关键物质，也可能有助于喂养他们。虽然这在很多方面都说得通，但也相当……出乎意料。

english: Interesting... And how does Vampyrium play into this?
translation: 有意思……那吸血鬼界在这其中扮演什么角色？

english: Vampyrium is home to all manner of flora and fauna that cannot be found here. With the threat of Drakan dealt with, my disciples can freely travel to and from there, collecting samples to use in our experiments.
translation: 吸血鬼界是各种在此地找不到的动植物的家园。既然德拉肯的威胁已经解决，我的门徒们可以自由往返于两地，收集样本用于我们的实验。

english: You are more than welcome to use the portal yourself, my child. Blood donations from Efaritay and my disciples keep it well powered, and it may be that you'll find Vampyrium to offer something of interest to you.
translation: 你完全可以自己使用那个传送门，我的孩子。埃法里泰和我的门徒们的血液捐赠为其提供了充足的能量，也许你会发现吸血鬼界有你感兴趣的东西。

english: Until next time, my child.
translation: 下次见，我的孩子。

english: Well then, young [lad/lass], that is a good question. In fact, I specifically deal in vyrewatch uniforms. Used to be quite useful in getting them to leave you alone, but that's not an issue any more.
translation: 嗯，年轻的[lad/lass]，问得好。实际上，我专门做吸血鬼哨兵制服生意。以前穿上它挺管用，能让它们不找你麻烦，不过现在没这个必要了。

english: Still, some people prefer to wear them even now. Makes them feel safer I guess, or maybe they find them fashionable? Speaking of which, do you wanna have a look at my stuff?
translation: 不过，即使现在也有人喜欢穿。我想是让他们感觉更安全吧，或者他们觉得这很时尚？说到这个，你想看看我的货吗？

english: My name's Valeria. I do a bit of this, a bit of that. Plenty that needs sorting now that the vampyres aren't out to get us.
translation: 我叫瓦莱里娅。我什么都做一点。既然吸血鬼不再找我们麻烦，有很多事情需要处理。

english: Vanescula. You're still in your vampyre form?
translation: 瓦内斯库拉。你还是吸血鬼形态？

english: Yes, nice of you to point that out. Thanks to my injuries, shapeshifting is no longer possible for me. I'm likely stuck in this disgusting form forever now. Lowerniel would probably have been thrilled.
translation: 是的，谢谢你指出来。多亏了我的伤势，我再也无法变形了。我可能永远被困在这副恶心的形态里了。洛尔尼尔大概会很高兴。

english: We humans have a saying, Vanescula: If you play with fire, you're going to get burnt.
translation: 我们人类有句老话，瓦内斯库拉：玩火者必自焚。

english: I burnt myself for a better future, for my people, and for yours.
translation: 我燃烧自己是为了更美好的未来，为了我的人民，也为了你的人民。

english: After all that's happened, do you really still believe that?
translation: 经历了这一切之后，你真的还这么认为吗？

english: You may not like what I did, but whether you accept it or not, Lowerniel was only defeated thanks to me.
translation: 你可能不喜欢我的所作所为，但不管你接不接受，洛尔尼尔之所以能被击败，全靠我。

english: I was the one that turned Safalaan, giving him the strength to injure him. I was the one that gave you the information needed to make a weapon capable of killing him.
translation: 是我转化了萨法拉恩，给了他伤害洛尔尼尔的力量。是我给了你制造能杀死他的武器所需的信息。

english: We'd have found another way.
translation: 我们本可以找到别的办法。

english: You're free to keep telling yourself that, but deep down, I think you know the truth. Now, while this has been a thrilling chat, I've tired of conversing with you. Be on your way.
translation: 你尽管继续这么告诉自己，但内心深处，我想你知道真相。好了，虽然这次谈话很愉快，但我已经厌倦和你交谈了。你走吧。

english: Now you look like someone in need of some new threads.
translation: 你看起来像是需要些新行头的人。

english: Oh don't go acting like you don't know what I mean. Humans may be allowed here now, but it's still much easier for you if everyone thinks you're a noble vyre.
translation: 哦，别装得好像你不知道我什么意思。虽然现在允许人类来这里了，但如果大家都以为你是个高贵的维尔吸血鬼，事情还是会容易得多。

english: Does it not bother you having humans here?
translation: 有人类在这里，你不觉得烦吗？

english: Well met, [player name]. Fancy a drink?
translation: 幸会，[player name]。想喝一杯吗？

english: Do I get a friends discount?
translation: 有朋友折扣吗？

english: See how the walls are still falling down?
translation: 看到墙壁还在倒塌吗？

english: Good. Then you see why there are no discounts here. Now, want that drink?
translation: 很好。那你就明白为什么这里没有折扣了。现在，想喝那杯酒吗？

english: How are things going, Veliaf?
translation: 情况怎么样，维利亚夫？

english: Not too bad. Business isn't the fastest here unsurprisingly, but I still get plenty of people stopping off on route from Paterdomus to the Theatre of Blood.
translation: 还不错。生意在这里不出意料地不是最快的，但还是有不少人从帕特多姆斯前往血腥剧场的路上会停下来。

english: Some have suggested we don't stock a wide enough range of drinks, but others seem quite appreciative of the lack of nonsense on the menu.
translation: 有些人建议我们备货的饮品范围不够广，但其他人似乎很欣赏菜单上没什么乱七八糟的东西。

english: Well, I'm glad the pub is doing well, but I was actually asking about you.
translation: 嗯，很高兴酒馆生意不错，但我其实是在问你怎么样。

english: Me? Oh, I'm fine. The war is over and we mostly won. I'm finally getting to enjoy some peace and quiet.
translation: 我？哦，我很好。战争结束了，我们基本赢了。我终于能享受一些平静了。

english: So you're... happy?
translation: 所以你……开心吗？

english: Happy? I wouldn't go that far. I'd be happier if the vampyres were gone completely and Safalaan wasn't now one himself, but given all that happened, I'll take what I can get.
translation: 开心？那倒不至于。如果吸血鬼全都消失，萨法拉恩现在也不是其中之一，我会更开心，但考虑到发生的一切，我只能知足了。

english: Have you visited him?
translation: 你去看过他吗？

english: Safalaan? No. He's come here a few times, but I've made it clear I won't be setting foot in Darkmeyer ever again. The vampyres may still be around, but my days of breaking bread with them are done.
translation: 萨法拉安？不。他来过这里几次，但我已经说得很清楚，我再也不会踏足达克迈尔了。吸血鬼可能还在，但我与他们同桌共餐的日子已经结束了。

english: Anyway, enough about all that. How about a drink?
translation: 好了，不说这些了。来一杯怎么样？

english: Seen much of Ivan recently?
translation: 最近常见到伊万吗？

english: Yeah, he comes to visit a fair bit. Sometimes without Drezel's permission, I suspect...
translation: 是啊，他经常来拜访。有时候我怀疑都没得到德雷泽尔的允许……

english: And everything's good between the two of you?
translation: 你们俩之间一切都还好吧？

english: We've... talked, if that's what you're getting at?
translation: 我们……谈过了，如果你是想问这个的话？

english: What about?
translation: 谈了什么？

english: The importance of a good drink. So, fancy giving the questioning a rest and buying one?
translation: 好酒的重要性。所以，要不要先别问了，请我喝一杯？

english: Oh, don't mind if I do!
translation: 哦，那我就不客气了！

english: Veliaf drinks the beer... Quickly.
translation: 维利亚夫喝下了啤酒……很快。

english: Humans may now attend Theatre performances as spectators! Enjoy the show!
translation: 人类现在可以以观众身份观看剧院演出！敬请欣赏！

english: All are cordially invited to the Theatre.
translation: 诚邀各位光临剧院。

english: Glory awaits those brave enough to fight in the Theatre!
translation: 荣耀在等待着那些敢于在剧院中战斗的勇士！

english: This town is so boring now. Want to spice things up a bit?
translation: 这个镇子现在太无聊了。想找点乐子吗？

english: Spice things up?
translation: 找点乐子？

english: That's right. You look like someone who might like to kill a few vampyres.
translation: 没错。你看起来像是那种会想杀几只吸血鬼的人。

english: If I wanted to kill vampyres, surely I could just do that?
translation: 如果我想杀吸血鬼，我自己动手不就行了？

english: But there's no fun in that. You want to get them angry first! So angry that they just keep coming! I have a way.
translation: 但那样多没意思。你得先激怒他们！让他们气得前仆后继！我有办法。

english: I've put together a little something. I call it a garlic cocktail. It's disgustingly potent, especially to a vampyre. The smell literally fills them with rage. Want to buy one?
translation: 我搞了点小东西。我叫它大蒜鸡尾酒。味道冲得要命，对吸血鬼尤其管用。那气味能让他们怒火中烧。想买一瓶吗？

english: Want to buy a garlic cocktail?
translation: 想买一瓶大蒜鸡尾酒吗？

english: How are you feeling today, maggot marquess?
translation: 今天感觉怎么样啊，蛆虫侯爵？

english: I'm not sure I catch your drift...
translation: 我不太明白你的意思……

english: Bleeeeeeeughhhhhhh!!!
Maggot marquess! That's disgusting! You've covered my shoes in vomit!
translation: 蛆侯爵！太恶心了！你吐得我满鞋都是！

english: Reeeeeeeeeeee!
Ree!
translation: 咿！

english: It's me, Player!
translation: 是我，玩家！

english: Gratz on your Nightmare Mode loss
translation: 恭喜你在梦魇模式中失利

translation: 我想问关于：

english: 1: Present for Hans.
translation: 1：给汉斯的礼物。

english: 2: Present for Count Check.
translation: 2：给检查伯爵的礼物。

english: 3: Present for Gillie.
translation: 3：给吉莉的礼物。

english: 4: Present for Farmer Fred.
translation: 4：给农夫弗雷德的礼物。

english: 5: Present for Doom Sayer.
translation: 5：给末日预言者的礼物。

english: 6: Nothing.
Aye, lad, volcano is what I be meanin'. The south foot o' the same. They's be 'avin' a cavern there, but arm yerself wi' the chilly snowball ammo afore ye goes venturin' inside.
translation: 是的，小伙子，我指的是火山。就在它的南脚下。那里有个洞穴，但进去之前要带上冰冷的雪球弹药。

english: Aye, lass, volcano is what I be meanin'. The south foot o' the same. They's be 'avin' a cavern there, but arm yerself wi' the chilly snowball ammo afore ye goes venturin' inside.
translation: 是的，姑娘，我指的是火山。就在它的南脚下。那里有个洞穴，但进去之前要带上冰冷的雪球弹药。

english: *DANGER: GUBLINCH* This 'ere notice be warnin' all landlubbers o' these 'ere gublinch, what lie in wait in their stinky cavern below. Any swashbucklin' sailor or cutlass-wieldin' pirate wi' an eye fer treasure should seek out Shanty Claws (sailor), Musa Point, On the Dock. Thankee kindly.
translation: *危险：古布林奇* 此通知警告所有旱鸭子，这些古布林奇潜伏在下方臭气熏天的洞穴里。任何有寻宝眼光的水手或持弯刀的海盗，都应前往穆萨角码头找香蒂·克劳斯（水手）。多谢。

english: You place the shards in the cage.
translation: 你把碎片放进笼子里。

english: The gublinch rattles the cage doors, but cannot escape.
translation: 古布林奇摇晃着笼门，但逃不出来。

english: 'Sailing on the sea...happy as can be...'
translation: '航行在海上...快乐无比...'

english: '...to exotic places...fair winds in our faces...'
translation: '...去异国他乡...顺风拂面...'

english: '...and we'll sink a drink to our sailor ways...'
translation: '...为我们的水手之道干一杯...'

english: '...polish ye cutlass's makes 'em rust-less...'
translation: '...擦亮你的弯刀，让它不生锈...'

english: '...a brig's too good, so keelhaul him in the mornin'...'
translation: '...监牢太便宜他了，明早把他拖在船底...'

english: What ho, milady. Have you come for the present?
translation: 嘿，女士。你是来拿礼物的吗？

english: What ho, sirrah. Have you come for the present?
translation: 嘿，先生。你是来拿礼物的吗？

english: You carefully cut the wood into a prop sword.
translation: 你小心地把木头削成一把道具剑。

english: Can you make paint for me please?
translation: 能请你帮我做颜料吗？

english: If you have the ingredients, of course!
translation: 如果你有材料的话，当然可以！

english: Gold paint please.
translation: 请给我金色颜料。

english: Lovely. For that I'll need gold dust, you can probably get it by chipping little bits off a gold rock with something like a chisel.
translation: 好的。那需要金粉，你可以用凿子之类的东西从金矿石上敲下小碎片来获得。

english: Ok, I'll go get some.
translation: 好的，我去弄一些来。

english: Here's the dust.
translation: 这是金粉。

english: You lower your net on the end of the rod into the murky water...
translation: 你把杆子末端的网伸进浑浊的水中...

english: Congratulations, you advanced a Cabbage Picking level.
translation: 恭喜，你的卷心菜采摘等级提升了。

english: Your Cabbage Picking level is now 10.
translation: 你的卷心菜采摘等级现在是10级。

translation: 你现在可以采摘带刺的卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick red cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘红色卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick aquatic cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘水生卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick cabbage trees.
translation: 你现在可以采摘卷心菜树了。

english: You can now pick frozen cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘冰冻卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick rock cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘岩石卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick metal cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘金属卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick crystalline cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘水晶卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick magic cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘魔法卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick sacred cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘神圣卷心菜了。

english: You can now pick synoptic cabbages.
translation: 你现在可以采摘全景卷心菜了。

english: This package is addressed to A man near some trees.
translation: 这个包裹是寄给树旁的一个男人的。

english: This package is addressed to A guard in a high position.
translation: 这个包裹是寄给高位守卫的。

english: This package is addressed to A wanderer of the Wilderness.
translation: 这个包裹是寄给荒野流浪者的。

english: I got wisdom, who could ask for anything more?
translation: 我得到了智慧，还能奢求什么呢？

english: Free wisdom, no waiting!
translation: 免费智慧，无需等待！

english: Fear my wisdom!
translation: 敬畏我的智慧！

english: Get yer wisdom here!
translation: 来买智慧啦！

english: Ahhh, feel the fresh breeze!
translation: 啊，感受这清新的微风！

english: This old man's playing knick-knack!
translation: 这老头在玩小玩意儿！

english: I'm pretty buff under those robes!
translation: 我袍子底下可结实了！

english: Tasty sandwiches!
translation: 美味的三明治！

english: Get yer sandwiches!
translation: 来买三明治啦！

english: Saaaaannndwiches!
translation: 三~~~明治！

english: Yeh-yeh-yeh-yeh-yeh!
translation: 耶耶耶耶耶！

english: Tro-lo-lo-lo-lol!
translation: 特洛洛洛洛洛！

english: YeahEEEEEE!
translation: 耶啊啊啊啊！

english: Please buy souvenirs!
translation: 请买纪念品吧！

english: It's sunny here in the East!
translation: 东方这里阳光明媚！

english: Enjoy the East!
translation: 享受东方吧！

english: How am I supposed to meditate like this?
translation: 这样我怎么能冥想呢？

english: Is there no peace, even here?
translation: 难道连这里都没有安宁吗？

english: I'm trying to meditate!
translation: 我正在试着冥想！

english: Krssss!

english: My fool husband has outdone himself this time! When he returned from the hunt, he carried a small bundle in his arms - a nice haunch of meat, I thought, or a gift. But the creature that wiggled free from his arms was the stuff of nightmare. A Hunllef cub! He thinks it can be tamed. Hah! I've warned him that when it eats his face I will be the first to say 'I told you so.'
translation: 我那愚蠢的丈夫这次真是太过分了！他打猎回来时，怀里抱着一个小包裹——我以为是块好肉，或者礼物。但从他怀里挣脱出来的生物简直是梦魇。一只亨勒夫幼崽！他觉得它能被驯服。哈！我警告过他，等它吃掉他的脸时，我会第一个说'我早告诉过你'。

english: The other clans have caught wind of Caron's 'pet'. They are angry, and I agree with them. The cub might be content with table scraps and belly rubs now, but soon it will grow, and then it will surely hunger for elven meat.
translation: 其他部族已经听说了卡龙的'宠物'。他们很生气，我也同意他们。幼崽现在可能满足于吃剩饭和揉肚子，但很快它就会长大，到时候它肯定会渴望精灵肉。

english: But Caron doesn't listen. He spends all day with the thing, wandering the woods and teaching it to fetch sticks. I will admit, it learns quickly - but perhaps that is all the more reason to worry.
translation: 但卡龙不听。他整天和那东西待在一起，在树林里闲逛，教它捡棍子。我承认，它学得很快——但也许这正是更令人担忧的理由。

english: Upon the next new moon, Caron will travel to the council meeting. I only hope that his pet will remain loyal without him there to watch it.
translation: 下个新月，卡龙将前往议会会议。我只希望他的宠物在他不在的时候能保持忠诚。

english: My husband has not returned from Council. Nor have his loyal guards. I cannot stand to look at the creature, knowing that my husband might be in its brother's belly. It whines and scratches at the door to its pen. What is it planning?
translation: 我丈夫没有从议会回来。他忠诚的守卫也没有。我无法直视那生物，因为我知道我丈夫可能正在它兄弟的肚子里。它在呜咽，抓挠着围栏的门。它在计划什么？

english: My worst fears have become reality. Tonight I was woken by a monstrous crash as the Hunllef broke free from its cage and ran out into the night.
translation: 我最担心的事成了现实。今晚我被一声巨响惊醒，亨勒夫挣脱了笼子，跑进了夜色中。

english: Our gates have been destroyed. The Hunllef will soon return with the rest of its pack, all while we are left defenceless.
translation: 我们的大门被摧毁了。亨勒夫很快就会带着它的族群回来，而我们毫无防备。

english: Oh, Caron... where are you?
translation: 哦，卡龙……你在哪里？

english: I have never been so happy to be proven wrong. This morning, as we gathered to mend our gates, a figure appeared on the horizon, limping and bruised. Of course, I recognised him immediately - it was Caron, my Caron, alive and safe after all! But he wasn't alone - trotting merrily at his side was the Hunllef.
translation: 我从未如此高兴自己被证明是错的。今天早上，当我们聚集起来修补大门时，地平线上出现了一个身影，一瘸一拐，浑身是伤。当然，我立刻认出了他——是卡龙，我的卡龙，竟然活着而且安全！但他不是一个人——亨勒夫欢快地小跑在他身边。

english: While I was cleaning his wounds, Caron told me a wild tale. He and his men were waylaid by bandits on the way back from the council. They killed the guards, and kept him prisoner - no doubt hoping for a ransom. But just as he'd given up on ever seeing home again, he heard a howling from outside his prison. A long, angry howl. And then screams. And then silence.
translation: 在我清理他的伤口时，卡龙给我讲了一个离奇的故事。他和他的手下在从议会回来的路上被强盗伏击了。强盗杀了守卫，把他囚禁起来——无疑是想要赎金。但就在他放弃再见到家的希望时，他听到监狱外传来嚎叫声。一声长长的、愤怒的嚎叫。然后是尖叫声。然后是寂静。

english: I cannot believe it. The Hunllef is our natural enemy. Why would it risk its life for my husband?
translation: 我不敢相信。亨勒夫是我们的天敌。它为什么要为我丈夫冒生命危险？

english: But now I look out of my window and see him feeding it a haunch of meat from the dinner table. I see the way it looks at him, eyes wide and tail wagging, and I understand.
translation: 但现在我望向窗外，看到它在喂它餐桌上的肉块。我看到它看他的眼神，眼睛睁得大大的，尾巴摇着，我明白了。

english: Some years later...
translation: 几年后……

english: I know that Caron did not want to leave, but our clan needs us, now more than ever. We must trust in our Goddess, and go where she leads. But still, my heart aches.
translation: 我知道卡龙不想离开，但我们的部族需要我们，比以往任何时候都需要。我们必须信任我们的女神，跟随她的指引。但我的心仍然很痛。

english: We were forced to leave Llef behind. We told the other elders our story - but they stayed cold. Tarddiad was rife with danger. To bring that same danger with us, as a pet, would be the height of foolishness. Once, I would have felt the same.
translation: 我们被迫把Llef留在身后。我们向其他长老讲述了我们的故事——但他们依然冷漠。Tarddiad处处充满危险。把同样的危险当作宠物带在身边，简直是愚蠢至极。曾经，我也会这么想。

english: I wish they could have seen my husband's tears as he said goodbye. I wish they could have heard Llef's sad whine as we left him outside the gates. But they didn't, and now it is too late.
translation: 我真希望他们能看到我丈夫告别时的泪水。我真希望他们能听到我们把Llef留在门外时它悲伤的呜咽。但他们没有，现在为时已晚。

english: Thank you, old friend.
translation: 谢谢你，老朋友。

english: And for a moment, the cold wind sounded just like a lonely howl.
translation: 那一刻，寒风听起来就像一声孤独的嚎叫。

english: Citizens of Kourend, the following Royal Charter has been written into law by His Royal Highness King Shayzien III and is effective immediately.
translation: 库兰德王国的公民们，以下皇家宪章已由谢兹恩三世国王陛下写入法律，即刻生效。

english: Note that all citizens of Kourend are bound by law to abide by this Royal Charter and any person found in violation of the Charter will be charged with High Treason.
translation: 请注意，所有库兰德王国公民均有义务遵守此皇家宪章，任何违反宪章者将被控以叛国罪。

english: I. The Royal Accord of Twill and all agreements bound within cease to exercise authority in all regards to governance of the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 一、特威尔皇家协议及其所有相关协定在大库兰德王国治理方面不再具有任何效力。

english: II. The Right of Succession is no longer observed and all titles held within bare no right of governance.
translation: 二、继承权不再被承认，所有头衔不再具有治理权。

english: III. The Kingdom of Great Kourend is henceforth governed by the newly formed State of Kourend.
translation: 三、大库兰德王国自此由新成立的库兰德政府管辖。

english: IV. The State of Kourend exists to serve the Monarchy.
translation: 四、库兰德政府的存在是为了服务君主制。

english: V. The Monarchy bears sole responsibility for the appointment, dissolution or replacement of the Head of State.
translation: 五、君主制对国家元首的任命、解散或更换负有全责。

english: VI. The role of Head of State belongs to the Monarchy until such time that statement V may be actioned.
translation: 六、国家元首的职责属于君主制，直至第五条声明得以执行。

english: VII. Governance of revenues is to be managed by the state.
translation: 七、财政收入的管理由政府负责。

english: VIII. Mobilisation of forces is to be governed by the state.
translation: 八、军队的调动由政府管辖。

english: IX. The territory of the Kingdom of Great Kourend and all assets within are property of the state.
translation: 九、大库兰德王国的领土及其所有资产均属政府财产。

english: X. Discussion, demonstration or acts that seek to violate this Royal Charter are deemed and act of High Treason.
translation: 十、任何试图违反此皇家宪章的讨论、示威或行为均被视为叛国罪。

english: When I came up with the idea of training Agility by climbing all over the rooftops of the world, I intended people to earn rewards by doing that, not just by asking for things.
