english: I am betrayed.
translation: 我被背叛了。

english: By my brothers and sisters and by those who swore to battle by my side. I pledged my service to the Empty Lord and I never wavered, even as I was warned of his downfall. I think perhaps I should have. For those who I once named as allies, have turned against me.
translation: 被我的兄弟姐妹们，被那些发誓与我并肩作战的人背叛了。我曾宣誓效忠虚空之主，即使有人警告我他将败亡，我也从未动摇。现在想来，或许我本该动摇的。那些我曾视为盟友的人，如今都反过来对付我了。

english: Many of them are alive only because of the actions of me and my steed Hekala.
translation: 他们中许多人能活到今天，全靠我和我的坐骑赫卡拉。

english: At the battle of Carrallanger I rescued Corveth from the flames that threatened to consume her. I dove my dragon deep into the flames, though the heat would mark my flesh forever, and I grasped her hand before the tower collapsed beneath her. If it were not for me she would have perished there and then. Just another statistic in another battle.
translation: 在卡拉兰格之战中，我从吞噬一切的火焰中救出了科维斯。我驾驭着我的巨龙冲入烈焰，尽管那热量永远灼伤了我的皮肉，我在塔坍塌之前抓住了她的手。若不是我，她当时就会死在那里，成为又一场战斗中的又一个数字。

english: Yet now she leads them against me.
translation: 可如今，她却率领他们来对付我。

english: Ripper demons. Do I truly deserve such cruelty? They are monstrous creatures. Terrible claws define them, claws sharper and more deadly than any dragons. They are merciless and alien things. They will tear me apart when they find me. I know this. They will make it a long, agonising end. They feed on that pain.
translation: 撕裂魔。我真的活该遭受如此残忍的对待吗？它们是可怕的怪物。标志性的利爪比任何巨龙的爪子都更锋利、更致命。它们冷酷无情，毫无人性。找到我时它们会把我撕成碎片。我知道这一点。它们会让这成为漫长而痛苦的终结。它们以痛苦为食。

english: 'It flavours the meat' I remember one of their keepers telling me.
translation: “这样肉才有味道。”我记得它们的一个饲养者这样告诉我。

english: What did I do to deserve such an execution? I did not betray our lord like Apropos did, nor did I cowardly sit on the fence like Hannibus. I know the value of loyalty, even though it seems no one else does. Am I being hunted as punishment for them? What sort of justice is this?
translation: 我到底做了什么，要落得如此下场？我没有像阿普罗波斯那样背叛我们的主人，也没有像汉尼布斯那样懦弱地骑墙观望。我深知忠诚的价值，尽管似乎没有别人懂得。难道我是替他们受过而被追杀吗？这算什幺正义？

english: Still, death is preferable to becoming one of those demons. I know how they are made. I know that they are the husks of victims that have become infected by the strange bandage like skin that surrounds them. I refuse to become that. I will take my own life before that happens.
translation: 不过，死也比变成那些恶魔强。我知道它们是怎么来的。我知道它们是受害者被那层奇怪的绷带般的皮肤感染后留下的空壳。我绝不愿变成那样。在那之前，我会先了结自己的性命。

english: If only Hekala were here. If only I had been able to save her. This conflict would be very different. I would watch as the ripper demons were incinerated beneath dragon fire. I doubt even they could stand up to the raw power of my dragon.
translation: 要是赫卡拉还在就好了。要是我能救下她就好了。这场冲突会截然不同。我会看着那些撕裂魔在龙焰下化为灰烬。我怀疑就连它们也扛不住我巨龙的原始力量。

english: But she is gone.
translation: 但她已经不在了。

english: Murdered by Corveth and her treachery.
translation: 被科维斯和她的背叛所杀害。

english: So now I am alone. Now I flee into the deep forests of Forinthry. Perhaps I can find shelter in one of the older temples, the forgotten shrines. If I can hide there long enough, perhaps I can be safe.
translation: 所以现在我孤身一人。我逃进了福林斯瑞的密林深处。也许我能在某座古老的庙宇、被遗忘的神殿中找到栖身之所。如果我能藏得够久，也许就能安全了。

english: Empty Lord, I know you were betrayed, but I beg of you now, save one of your true faithful.
translation: 虚空之主，我知道你被背叛了，但我现在恳求你，拯救一个真正忠诚于你的人。

english: Olundai be damned. I want to live.
translation: 奥伦代见鬼去吧。我想活下去。

english: I deserve to live.
translation: 我值得活下去。

english: Despite having finally gained access to the strange dimension known as the Abyss (also referred to as Abyssal Space or the Abyssal Plane), we have found the area to still be something of an enigma.
translation: 尽管我们终于得以进入那个被称为深渊的奇异维度（也称深渊空间或深渊位面），但我们发现该区域仍然是个谜。

english: Although we have long had knowledge of the Abyss and the role it plays in teleportation magic, it was only recently that we finally discovered a way to enter this strange realm. The discovery came by complete chance, when a routine teleportation experiment seemingly went wrong.
translation: 虽然我们早已知晓深渊的存在及其在传送魔法中的作用，但直到最近我们才终于找到了进入这个奇异领域的方法。这一发现纯属偶然，当时一次常规传送实验似乎出了差错。

english: We are still not sure as to what exactly caused this teleportation failure, but the ability to finally access the Abyss led to a flurry of research from the Zamorakian Magical Institute (henceforth known within this document as the Z.M.I.).
translation: 我们仍不确定究竟是什么导致了那次传送失败，但最终能够进入深渊，引发了萨莫瑞克魔法研究所（以下简称Z.M.I.）的一阵研究热潮。

english: The results of our research so far are detailed in this document.
translation: 我们目前的研究成果详载于本文件中。

english: While often referred to as such, the Abyss is not a plane in the traditional sense (such as Zanaris or Frenaskrae).
translation: 虽然常被如此称呼，但深渊并非传统意义上的位面（如扎纳里斯城或弗雷纳斯克雷）。

english: The Abyss seems to be a strange dimension that sits between all other planes. In some ways, the Abyss acts a 'glue' that holds all planes together, yet keeps them separate, if you will. Because of this, the Abyss exists at the 'fringe' of reality, meaning that it does not conform to the same guidelines of space and time observed on Gielinor, or indeed on other planes.
translation: 深渊似乎是一个位于所有其他位面之间的奇异维度。从某种意义上说，深渊就像一种“胶水”，将所有位面粘合在一起，同时又使它们彼此分离。正因为如此，深渊存在于现实的“边缘”，意味着它不遵循吉里诺尔或其他位面上所观察到的空间和时间规律。

english: A clear example of the unique nature of the Abyss is that you may enter it and then leave it from an identical spot, yet reappear many hundreds of miles from your entry point. Similarly, you can enter the Abyss and spend hours there, while only moments have passed back on Gielinor.
translation: 深渊独特性质的一个明显例子是：你可以进入深渊，然后从完全相同的位置离开，却出现在距离入口数百英里之外。同样，你可以在深渊中度过数小时，而吉里诺尔上才过去片刻。

english: It is thanks to the above phenomena that the Abyss is key to teleportation magic. In fact, all teleportation that we know of uses the Abyss to make the passing of great distances occur in a very short space of time, at least from our perception.
translation: 正是由于上述现象，深渊才是传送魔法的关键。事实上，我们所知的所有传送都是利用深渊，使长距离的跨越在极短的时间内完成，至少从我们的感知来看是这样。

english: During a teleport, what is actually happening is that the spellcaster is entering the Abyss and then immediately leaving again. Certain values as to speed and direction are taken care of during the spellcasting. This allows some degree of precision in these teleports.
translation: 在传送过程中，实际发生的是施法者进入深渊，然后立即离开。施法过程中会处理某些速度和方向的值。这使得传送具有一定程度的精确性。

english: While highly useful, the extensive use of the Abyss for teleportation is something to be cautious of. We have observed that the barriers between Gielinor and the Abyss are seemingly becoming weaker through excessive use.
translation: 虽然非常有用，但大量使用深渊进行传送仍需谨慎。我们观察到，吉里诺尔与深渊之间的屏障似乎因过度使用而逐渐变弱。

english: If care is not taken, the barriers to the Abyss could break down entirely. Indeed, we have already had isolated reports within the Z.M.I. of strange creatures entering Gielinor from the Abyss, not to mention the teleportation malfunction that first resulted in us gaining access to the dimension.
translation: 如果不加小心，通往深渊的屏障可能会完全崩溃。事实上，Z.M.I.内部已经收到零星的报告，说有奇怪的生物从深渊进入吉里诺尔，更不用说最初让我们得以进入该维度的传送故障了。

english: Still, while the dangers are clear, the weakening of these barriers may prove useful if the correct care is taken. Perhaps an alternative method to proceed with Operation: Transient may present itself. One that won't alert the followers of other deities to our plans.
translation: 不过，尽管危险显而易见，但只要小心谨慎，这些屏障的削弱或许能派上用场。也许会有另一种方法来完成“瞬移行动”，而且不会惊动其他神祇的信徒。

english: When we have accepted that the Abyss is somewhat of a tesseract or hypercube with a direct relation to our dimension, then the benefits of exploiting this resource become more obvious.
translation: 当我们接受深渊某种程度上是一个与我们维度直接相关的超立方体时，利用这一资源的好处就变得更加明显了。

english: Certain creatures of the Abyss contain unnecessary surplus organs that may be harvested to provide carrying pouches for various unstable magical objects.
translation: 深渊中的某些生物拥有多余的器官，可以收获这些器官来制作携带袋，用于存放各种不稳定的魔法物品。

english: For example, I ran some experiments with Sample XJ13 (rune essence) and managed to place six parts in a space that would seemingly only hold one.
translation: 例如，我用样本XJ13（符文精华）进行了一些实验，成功地将六份物品放入了一个看似只能容纳一份的空间中。

english: Continued experimentation with these samples showed that moving items between our dimension and the Abyss degraded the use of these pouches, but casting a simple transfiguration spell upon them while within the Abyss restored their usage back to the original results.
translation: 对这些样本的持续实验表明，在我们的维度和深渊之间移动物品会降低这些袋子的使用效果，但在深渊内对其施放一个简单的变形咒语，就能将其恢复至原始效果。

english: To improve our runecrafting output, I would strongly recommend the harvesting of these creatures for their organs. However, some degree of caution will be required, as the creatures of the Abyss are seemingly very aggressive. We should also accelerate our efforts to locate the lost Rune Essence Mine, as only with increased supply will these pouches see proper use.
translation: 为了提高我们的符文制作产量，我强烈建议收获这些生物的器官。然而，需要一定程度的谨慎，因为深渊中的生物似乎非常具有攻击性。我们还应该加快寻找失落的符文精华矿场的努力，因为只有增加供应，这些袋子才能得到充分利用。

english: As previously detailed, our gaining access to the Abyss was somewhat of a fluke, and a not easily repeatable fluke at that. Due to the Abyss not being a plane in the traditional sense, we have also had to resort to unusual measures to gain permanent access.
translation: 如前所述，我们进入深渊多少有些侥幸，而且这种侥幸并不容易复制。由于深渊并非传统意义上的位面，我们也不得不采取非常规措施来获得永久通道。

english: We took a large number of initiates and gave each of them the supplies to cast teleportation spells. We then had them repeatedly teleport to various locations, seeking to replicate the original error that caused the first entry into the Abyss.
translation: 我们带了一大批新入会者，给每人提供了施展传送术的补给品。然后让他们反复传送到不同地点，试图重现最初导致首次进入深渊的错误。

english: Once one of our initiates had managed to 'fail' his teleport and appear in the Abyss, he was then charged with remaining there and holding a portal spell open so that more senior members of the Z.M.I. could gain entry.
translation: 一旦我们的一名新入会者成功“失败”了传送并出现在深渊中，他就被指派留在那里，维持一个传送门法术，以便Z.M.I.的高级成员能够进入。

english: At the time of writing, this initiate is still there, as without him, the portal spell will collapse. Thanks to the slow passage of time within the Abyss, he is unlikely to tire, so will not need relieving any time soon.
translation: 在撰写本文时，这名新入会者仍在那里，因为没有他，传送门法术就会崩溃。得益于深渊内时间的缓慢流逝，他不太可能感到疲倦，因此短期内无需换班。

english: While originally only intended as a way for us to access the Abyss, the portal spell soon proved to have some very beneficial side effects. It has also allowed us to open portals to most of the runic altars found across Gielinor.
translation: 虽然最初只是作为我们进入深渊的一种方式，但传送门法术很快证明具有一些非常有益的副作用。它还让我们能够打开通往吉里诺尔各地大多数符石祭坛的传送门。

english: Thanks to the portals, the Abyss has become a runecrafting gold mine, especially when combined with the pouches detailed previously. However, as also noted, lack of access to the lost Rune Essence Mine is preventing us from utilising the Abyss to its full potential.
translation: 得益于这些传送门，深渊已成为符文制作的金矿，尤其是与之前详述的袋子结合使用时。然而，如前所述，无法进入失落的符文精华矿场，阻碍了我们充分利用深渊的潜力。

english: One recent development of concern in this area is the sudden increase in rune production from the Order of Wizards. Could it be that they have found a way to the Rune Essence Mine themselves?
translation: 这一领域最近一个令人担忧的事态是巫师教团的符文产量突然增加。难道他们自己找到了通往符文精华矿场的路？

english: Perhaps more knowledge survived the destruction of the first Wizards' Tower than previously believed. This is something that requires immediate investigation. In the meantime, I have ordered our buyers to increase their purchasing of Sample XJ13.
translation: 也许在第一座法师塔被毁后幸存下来的知识比我们之前认为的要多。这需要立即调查。与此同时，我已命令我们的采购员增加对样本XJ13的购买。

english: Until my next report, I remain, as ever, a loyal servant.
translation: 在下一次报告之前，我始终是您忠实的仆从。

english: Strength Through Chaos!
translation: 混沌之力，力量至上！

english: House Drakan's roots were formed from Vampyrium's tribal system, as is true for all of the vampyre houses. In those days of old, blood was nothing more than sustenance to keep us alive. You were either predator or prey, and the tribal leaders either ruled by strength or they did not rule for long.
translation: 德拉肯家族的根基源于吸血鬼世界的部落制度，所有吸血鬼家族皆是如此。在那古老的时代，血液不过是维持我们生存的食物。你要么是捕食者，要么是猎物，部落首领要么靠力量统治，要么统治不了多久。

english: Each of the tribes had their own hunting grounds and preferences, and many tribal wars erupted over territory. Though we were a naturally resilient species, average life expectancy was short due to the savagery of our world at that time.
translation: 每个部落都有自己的狩猎领地和偏好，许多部落战争因领土而爆发。尽管我们是天生坚韧的物种，但由于当时世界的野蛮，平均寿命很短。

english: The arrival of the Stranger from Afar brought an end to the tribal system, with him forming the tribes into the early houses of Vampyrium. He introduced to us alien cultural concepts such as society and art. The more we followed his tutelage, the more refined our tastes became, and blood started to become about more than just a means to live.
translation: 远方陌生人的到来终结了部落制度，他将各部落组成了吸血鬼世界的早期家族。他向我们引入了社会、艺术等异域文化概念。我们越是遵循他的教导，品味就越发精致，血液也开始不仅仅是维持生存的手段。

english: As vampyric life expectancy was prolonged, so too did our palates become refined, tasting in the blood the essence of a being. Cannibalistic haematophagy was outlawed, and weakened predators became servants, their wings clipped, and their place set on the ground, while the burgeoning nobility rose up both figuratively and literally with the building of many great towers and castles. Blood was no longer just food, but access to blood became a sign of wealth.
translation: 随着吸血鬼寿命的延长，我们的味觉也变得更加精细，能从血液中品尝出一个存在的本质。同类相食的嗜血行为被禁止，弱小的捕食者沦为仆从，翅膀被剪断，地位降至地面，而新兴的贵族则随着众多高塔和城堡的建造，在象征和实际意义上都崛起。血液不再仅仅是食物，获得血液成为财富的标志。

english: As the head of the newly formed House Drakan, I drank in the Stranger from Afar's lessons more eagerly than my peers. Before the concept of laws were passed on to our newborn aristocracy, I seized an opportunity to co-opt my neighbouring houses by draining their leaders of blood. These smaller houses fell under my leadership, and the House of Drakan became the prevailing power on Vampyrium.
translation: 作为新成立的德拉肯家族的首领，我比同辈更热切地汲取远方陌生人的教诲。在法律概念传给新生的贵族之前，我抓住机会，通过吸干邻家族首领的血液来吞并他们。这些小家族落入我的领导之下，德拉肯家族成为吸血鬼世界的主导力量。

english: As the wealthiest living vampyre, I tasted many different bloods, refining my palate further still, discovering that food from each of House Drakan's territories held subtle differences in taste.
translation: 作为最富有的在世吸血鬼，我品尝了许多不同的血液，进一步磨练了我的味觉，发现来自德拉肯家族各领地的食物在味道上有着微妙的差异。

english: The ruler of Alzeph was a contemptible vyre. Those they ate tended to be vyres from other tribes, and the other tribes loathed the Alzeph. Such blood is thankfully rare since the birth of the new aristocracy and the Alzeph now being wiped out.
translation: 阿尔泽夫的统治者是个可鄙的维尔吸血鬼。他们吃掉的往往是其他部落的维尔吸血鬼，其他部落都厌恶阿尔泽夫。幸运的是，自从新贵族诞生和阿尔泽夫被消灭后，这种血液就很少见了。

english: I had the displeasure of tasting some blood from their stores, which was disgustingly spicy and held a grainy texture. It is quite difficult to find humans that don't hold some form of contempt for vampyres, but thankfully it requires an intense level of disgust before the taste of the blood is affected.
translation: 我曾不幸品尝过他们库存中的一些血液，那味道辛辣得令人作呕，还带有颗粒感。很难找到对人类不抱某种蔑视态度的吸血鬼，但幸运的是，需要极度厌恶才会影响血液的味道。

english: My favoured blood was always that of my homelands - blood tinged with a taste of optimism and hope. Achieving this taste is often complex, but the reward is worth it.
translation: 我一直偏爱家乡的血液——带有乐观和希望味道的血液。要达到这种味道往往很复杂，但回报是值得的。

english: I have found that the best way is to capture the prey but then allow it to escape and feel safe again. If the animal does not feel threatened before death, instead feeling freedom, then the tinge of hopefulness within its blood retains a sweetness beyond measure.
translation: 我发现最好的方法是捕获猎物，然后让它逃脱并重新感到安全。如果动物在死前没有感到威胁，而是感到自由，那么它血液中的希望气息就会保留一种难以言喻的甜美。

english: The Ghrazi were the most vicious of all vampyre tribes, priding themselves on their ability to fight rather than stalk. They would not capture their prey so much as bait it, goad it into combat.
translation: 格拉齐是吸血鬼部落中最凶残的，他们以战斗而非潜行能力为傲。他们与其说是捕获猎物，不如说是引诱猎物，激怒它进行战斗。

english: They would only hunt the most fearsome and territorial beasts of Vampyrium, not the myriad of docile creatures. They believed they were ingesting the strength of all they ate.
translation: 他们只猎杀吸血鬼世界中最凶猛、最具领地意识的野兽，而不是那些温顺的生物。他们相信自己摄入了所吃之物的力量。

english: Personally, I found the aggression within the blood of such creatures to be foul - swill for an unrefined palate, not fitting for a cultured society. The tribe took to our burgeoning society poorly, with the vast majority being clipped and effectively used as pack animals for the hunts. If not for their ferocity in battle, I'd have had them all put down.
translation: 就我个人而言，我觉得这类生物血液中的攻击性令人厌恶——那是给未开化味蕾的泔水，不适合文明社会。这个部落对我们新兴的社会适应得很差，绝大多数被剪了翅膀，实际上被用作狩猎的驮兽。要不是他们在战斗中的凶猛，我早就把他们全部处决了。

english: Lord Jovkai was the longest ruling tribal leader on Vampyrium, and the oldest recorded living vyre. He was a beloved leader, and this love was transposed on to their prey.
translation: 乔夫凯领主是吸血鬼世界统治时间最长的部落首领，也是有记录以来最年长的在世维尔吸血鬼。他是一位受人爱戴的领袖，这种爱也转移到了他们的猎物身上。

english: They would treat their food with care and tenderness, allowing it to live among them feeling safe and cared for, before mercilessly slaughtering it behind closed doors.
translation: 他们会小心翼翼地对待食物，让它们生活在他们中间，感到安全和被关怀，然后在紧闭的门后无情地屠杀它们。

english: I was pleasantly surprised by the bloods from this region, a bittersweet taste with a lingering finish.
translation: 这个地区的血液让我惊喜，一种苦甜交织的味道，余味悠长。

english: The Myrmel tribe would stalk entire families or social groups, quickly striking down one of their number, yet not feeding from that first kill. Instead, they would hunt down the remaining family members as the cries of their wounded rang in their ears.
translation: 米尔梅尔部落会跟踪整个家庭或社会群体，迅速击倒其中一人，但不会从第一次杀戮中进食。相反，他们会追捕其余家庭成员，而受伤者的哭喊声在他们耳边回响。

english: Their adrenal response of fight or flight, coupled with intense regret that they were leaving a loved one behind, imbued their blood with an effervescent fizz, making it lighter and more aromatic.
translation: 他们战斗或逃跑的肾上腺素反应，加上抛下亲人的强烈悔意，使他们的血液带有一种起泡的嘶嘶声，使其更轻盈、更芳香。

english: The process of collecting such blood, however, was very wasteful. When the Myrmel were absorbed into House Drakan, I decreed that the process only be used for special celebrations, with the primary victim's blood used to feed the lower-born vyres.
translation: 然而，收集这种血液的过程非常浪费。当米尔梅尔被并入德拉肯家族时，我下令这一过程只用于特殊庆典，主要受害者的血液用于喂养低等出生的维尔吸血鬼。

english: The Pyrah were a loathsome tribe of carrion-eaters, and their ways had no place in a modern vampyric society.
translation: 派拉是一个令人厌恶的食腐部落，他们的方式在现代吸血鬼社会中毫无立足之地。

english: They would capture whole families of creatures at a time, keeping them in appalling conditions until death took the weakest of them. Any survivors would be mournful of such losses, their grief heightened by being left with the corpses of their families in tight confines. Once entire families had died off, the Pyrah would harvest their congealed blood for later consumption.
translation: 他们会一次捕获整个动物家族，将它们关在恶劣的环境中，直到死亡带走最弱者。任何幸存者都会为这样的损失而悲痛，他们的悲伤因与家人的尸体被困在狭小空间而加剧。一旦整个家族死亡，派拉就会收获他们凝固的血液以备日后食用。

english: The Pyrah had vast stores of this solidified blood and I'll admit that, out of curiosity, I did sample it. The smell was foul, the texture was greasy and the thought of ingesting it sickened me. The taste, however, was surprisingly complex and rich.
translation: 派拉有大量这种凝固的血液储备，我承认，出于好奇，我确实尝过。气味难闻，质地油腻，一想到要吃它就让我恶心。然而，味道却出人意料地复杂和浓郁。

english: Nevertheless, the practice was abhorrent, and thus I had the entire blood stores of the Pyrah destroyed, and the tribe alongside it.
translation: 尽管如此，这种做法令人憎恶，因此我下令销毁派拉的全部血液储备，连同这个部落一起。

english: Ah, the Shadum. Their main source of food was from a race of creatures they had enslaved, a subjugation these creatures had willingly entered into, submitting to another so they would not have to make choices on their own.
translation: 啊，沙杜姆。他们的主要食物来源是一个被他们奴役的生物种族，这些生物是自愿接受这种奴役的，臣服于他人，这样他们就不必自己做决定了。

english: Perhaps they held a symbiotic need to attach themselves to our kind for survival. Regardless, the Shadum were sadistic in their dealings with these beings, breeding them as both subservients and food. The blood of these creatures held a quality both salty and sweet - an intriguing combination, though not to my ideal tastes.
translation: 也许它们与我们共生是为了生存。无论如何，影族在与这些生物打交道时极其残忍，将它们培育为仆从和食物。这些生物的血既咸又甜——一种有趣的组合，虽然不合我的口味。

english: The Vitur were in thrall to their long-dead founder, whom they considered a 'god'. He was a figure of awe and wonder to the Vitur, and there were volumes of histories dedicated to him.
translation: 维图尔家族臣服于他们早已逝去的创始人，视其为'神'。他是维图尔家族敬畏和惊叹的对象，有大量史书记载他的事迹。

english: Indeed, he was not only worshipped by his vyres, but a number of sapient races sacrificed themselves willingly out of respect for him and House Vitur's opulent culture.
translation: 确实，他不仅受到吸血鬼们的崇拜，许多智慧种族也出于对他的尊敬和维图尔家族奢华文化的敬仰而自愿献身。

english: These creatures are now scarce on Vampyrium, but I was able to obtain a store of their blood. It holds an incredibly fresh and pure taste - pleasant, if a little bland.
translation: 这些生物在吸血鬼界现已稀少，但我设法储存了它们的血液。味道极其新鲜纯净——令人愉悦，虽然有点平淡。

english: You give Harpert 1,000 coins.
translation: 你给了哈珀特1000金币。

english: Give Safalaan the vial?
translation: 把小瓶交给萨法拉恩？

english: You take some old notes from the chest.
translation: 你从宝箱中取出一些破旧的纸条。

english: You give the notes to Safalaan.
translation: 你把纸条交给了萨法拉恩。

english: Are you sure you want to enter the hideout? Any items left in the hideout, including upon death, will be lost.
translation: 你确定要进入藏身处吗？留在藏身处内的任何物品，包括死亡时掉落的，都将丢失。

english: Are you sure you want to enter the hideout?
translation: 你确定要进入藏身处吗？

english: Any luck with those notes?
translation: 那些纸条有进展吗？

english: Hello Vertida, how are things?
translation: 你好，维蒂达，最近怎么样？

english: Cool for them maybe. How would you like to be stuck on a wall?
translation: 他们也许觉得不错。你愿意被钉在墙上吗？

english: You attempt to stitch together all of the pouches. It's difficult, but you eventually craft a strange, kind of gross, fleshy container. It seems capable of storing up to <Num0> essence at the moment.
translation: 你尝试把所有袋子缝合在一起。这很困难，但你最终制作出一个奇怪、有点恶心的肉质容器。目前看来它能储存多达<Num0>点精华。

english: Looks like I've got myself into a bit of a pickle again. Still, I also found something fascinating in the process. There are some creatures performing some sort of ritual. I'm not sure of the purpose, so I intend to observe from a distance. Perhaps whatever it is they're doing can be of help in my little predicament.
translation: 看来我又陷入困境了。不过，在这个过程中我也发现了些迷人的东西。有些生物在举行某种仪式。我不确定其目的，所以打算远距离观察。也许他们正在做的事能帮我摆脱这个小麻烦。

english: As odd as it sounds, there seems to be what can only be described as 'nerve endings' growing in the area around the ritual. I of course had to try touching them, and they seem to be safe. I will attempt to investigate some more.
translation: 虽然听起来很奇怪，但仪式周围似乎长着只能被描述为'神经末梢'的东西。我当然得试着触摸它们，它们似乎是安全的。我会尝试进一步调查。

english: These nerve endings are fascinating! They seem to be infused with rune-like power. Brilliant! Not only that, but they can also be combined: Two minds make soul. Water and mind makes blood. Fire and air makes smoke.
translation: 这些神经末梢太迷人了！它们似乎注入了类似符文的能量。太棒了！不仅如此，它们还可以组合：二加心等于魂。水加心等于血。火加气等于烟雾。

english: From further trials on the nerves, I've found more combinations: Water and earth makes nature. Soul and nature makes cosmic. I'd hoped to stay longer, but I feel something having an impact on me. Could it be the nerves, or the ritual itself?
translation: 通过对神经的进一步试验，我发现了更多组合：水加土等于自然。魂加自然等于宇宙。我本想多待一会儿，但感觉有什么东西在影响我。是神经，还是仪式本身？

english: I tried to leave, but I'm trapped! My only hope now is to stop the ritual. I just need those final combinations. Cosmic is important, or maybe blood. Not both at the same time though. Combine them with... an elemental nerve? Or is it a combination nerve? I can't properly focus. What's happening to me?
translation: 我试图离开，但我被困住了！我唯一的希望就是阻止仪式。我只需要那些最后的组合。宇宙很重要，或者也许是血。但不能同时使用。将它们与...元素神经结合？还是组合神经？我无法集中注意力。我怎么了？

english: Lolz die noob!
translation: 哈哈，菜鸟去死吧！

english: This barrel contains absorption potion that adventurers have purchased from Dominic with their reward points. You have no potion stored in here.
translation: 这个木桶装着冒险者用奖励积分从多米尼克那里购买的伤害吸收药水。你在这里没有储存药水。

english: This barrel contains absorption potion that adventurers have purchased from Dominic with their reward points. You have one dose of potion stored in here.
translation: 这个木桶装着冒险者用奖励积分从多米尼克那里购买的伤害吸收药水。你在这里储存了一剂药水。

english: This barrel contains absorption potion that adventurers have purchased from Dominic with their reward points. You have <Num0> doses of potion stored in here.
translation: 这个木桶装着冒险者用奖励积分从多米尼克那里购买的伤害吸收药水。你在这里储存了<Num0>剂药水。

english: You have no absorption potion to store.
translation: 你没有伤害吸收药水可以储存。

english: Store all your absorption potion?
translation: 储存你所有的伤害吸收药水？

english: You return <Num0> doses of absorption potion to the barrel.
translation: 你把<Num0>剂伤害吸收药水放回木桶。

english: You return <Num0> doses of absorption potion to the barrel. The barrel is now completely full.
translation: 你把<Num0>剂伤害吸收药水放回木桶。木桶现在完全满了。

english: The barrel is full.
translation: 木桶已满。

english: One of the scouts came back today with a disturbing report. He claimed that he had seen the enemy abducting various beasts from the caves north of Karville. Demons, giants and spectres were just some of the ones he mentioned.
translation: 今天一名侦察兵带回了一份令人不安的报告。他声称看到敌人从卡维尔北部的洞穴中绑架各种野兽。恶魔、巨人和幽灵只是他提到的其中一些。

english: Of course, the kin are no strangers when it comes to experimenting on creatures, but the scale here is much larger than anything they've done in the past.
translation: 当然，族人对生物进行实验并不陌生，但这次规模比他们过去做的任何事都要大得多。

english: Robert seems concerned, but not surprised. As the tide of this war turned, he always said they would try new methods to regain the advantage.
translation: 罗伯特似乎很担忧，但并不惊讶。随着战争形势的转变，他总是说他们会尝试新方法来重新获得优势。

english: An emergency council was called and it was agreed that this be considered a priority threat. Robert has redirected many of our scouts to investigate further and try to work out where the kin are taking these beasts.
translation: 召开了紧急会议，一致认为这应被视为优先威胁。罗伯特已调派许多侦察兵进一步调查，并试图查明族人把这些野兽带到了哪里。

english: It's been over a month since the first abductions were sighted and in the time since we've heard very little. However, that changed today as new reports came in. Interestingly, these reports came not from our own scouts, but from a group of sailors. The kin have been terrorising most of the major shipping routes as of late and the sailors have been having to brave more treacherous waters to avoid them. While navigating the rarely travelled northern seas, they spotted an unmapped group of islands to the east.
translation: 自首次目击绑架事件以来已过去一个多月，期间我们几乎没听到什么消息。然而，今天随着新报告的传来，情况发生了变化。有趣的是，这些报告不是来自我们自己的侦察兵，而是来自一群水手。族人最近一直在骚扰大多数主要航线，水手们不得不冒险穿越更危险的水域来避开他们。在航行于少有人走的北部海域时，他们发现东边有一组未标注的岛屿。

english: They claimed that one of the islands was the home of a large fortress, one built in the distinct architecture of the kin. However, what was most interesting was what they saw on the shores of the island. Demons. A small scout force has been sent out to verify the reports. In the meantime, we prepare for battle.
translation: 他们声称其中一个岛屿上有一座大型堡垒，建筑风格明显是族人的。但最有趣的是他们在岛岸边看到的东西。恶魔。一支小型侦察队已被派出核实这些报告。与此同时，我们准备战斗。

english: The scout force has returned and there is now no doubt. This island is what we've been looking for. Robert has issued a call to arms and a force is being prepared for an assault on the island. Much remains uncertain however.
translation: 侦察队已返回，现在毫无疑问了。这座岛就是我们要找的地方。罗伯特已发出战斗号召，一支军队正在准备进攻该岛。但仍有许多不确定因素。

english: Although our scouts have verified that this island is where the abducted beasts are being taken, we still have no idea what the kin are doing with them. Looking at the previous experiments of the kin, it's possible that we will face some new foes when we arrive.
translation: 虽然我们的侦察兵已确认被绑架的野兽被带到了这座岛上，但我们仍然不知道族人在用它们做什么。从族人之前的实验来看，我们到达时可能会面对一些新的敌人。

english: We expect to reach the island tomorrow morning and I can feel the fear in the air. Our people are more than familiar with the kin at this point, but to look in the eyes of our enemy is still as terrifying as ever.
translation: 我们预计明天早上到达该岛，我能感受到空气中的恐惧。我们的人民对族人已经非常熟悉，但直视敌人的眼睛仍然和以往一样令人恐惧。

english: Not for me though. We fight beside Robert the Strong, one of the finest heroes humanity has ever seen. With him on our side, I know we will be victorious. So we now make our final preparations, for with tomorrow, comes war.
translation: 但我不会。我们与强者罗伯特并肩作战，他是人类史上最伟大的英雄之一。有他在我们这边，我知道我们一定会胜利。所以我们现在做最后的准备，因为明天，战争就要来临。

english: I don't know why, but the Devourer's hold over my mind has waned. All of the others are still under her control, but perhaps her spell didn't fully work on me.
translation: 我不知道为什么，吞噬者对我心智的控制减弱了。其他人都还在她的控制之下，但也许她的咒语对我没有完全生效。

english: I'm not a fighter. My name is Akila, and I've spent my years as a scholar in the Grand Library of Menaphos. I have no hope of stopping the Devourer, nor of escaping. All I can do is write.
translation: 我不是战士。我叫阿基拉，多年来一直在美纳波斯的大图书馆做学者。我既无望阻止吞噬者，也无望逃脱。我能做的只有写作。

english: For some time now, we've been excavating a tomb for the Devourer. I don't know how long it's been. Time has no meaning when under her control. She wants something that is buried inside, and she wants it badly.
translation: 一段时间以来，我们一直在为吞噬者挖掘一座坟墓。我不知道过了多久。在她的控制下，时间毫无意义。她想要里面埋藏的东西，而且非常迫切。

english: From what I've been able to work out, the tomb belongs to an ancient pharaoh called Osmumten. I've seen his name mentioned before in various tomes, but I can't work out why he'd be important to the Devourer.
translation: 据我推断，这座坟墓属于一位名叫奥斯穆滕的古法老。我以前在各种典籍中见过他的名字，但想不通他对吞噬者为何如此重要。

english: The tomb entrance was sealed initially, and much of our effort was spent unblocking it, but our struggle didn't end there. After we gave her a way in, the true horror of her plans became clear.
translation: 坟墓入口最初是封死的，我们花了很多力气才打通，但我们的挣扎并未就此结束。在我们为她打开通路后，她计划的真正恐怖之处才变得清晰。

english: I had never set eyes on the four lesser deities, but I knew them when I saw them. She had them all. She took them into the tomb, along with a selection of ghastly beasts.
translation: 我从未亲眼见过四位次级神祇，但一见便认出了他们。她把他们全都抓住了。她带着他们，还有一群可怕的野兽，进入了坟墓。

english: Most of the others were left outside, but some of us were ordered to enter the tomb as well. She needs us in case more excavation work is required inside.
translation: 大多数人被留在外面，但我们中的一些人也被命令进入坟墓。她需要我们，以防里面还需要更多的挖掘工作。

english: As I write, I can feel her hold on me beginning to strengthen once more. I pray it doesn't last. I'll continue to document what I can, when I can.
translation: 我写这些的时候，能感觉到她对我的控制又开始加强了。我祈祷这不会持续下去。我会在能写的时候继续记录我能记录的东西。

english: It feels futile, but there's a chance someone stronger than me will find these words and act on them. Maybe I can help them stop the Devourer.
translation: 这感觉徒劳无功，但也许会有比我更强的人看到这些文字并采取行动。也许我能帮他们阻止吞噬者。

english: He came. I always knew he would. The years have not softened him. He is still filled with the same anger as the day I left him. I was half tempted to turn him away before he even set foot on the island.
translation: 他来了。我一直知道他会来。岁月没有让他变得温和。他依然充满着我离开他那天的愤怒。我差点想在他踏上这座岛之前就把他赶走。

english: However, I decided to hear him out. I knew I wouldn't like it, but I hoped a little piece of him may remain. I was wrong of course. He didn't come here for me. He didn't even know I was still alive. He was here for only one reason, war. He desired access to the island so that he may conduct his own experiments on the flora here.
translation: 然而，我决定听他说完。我知道我不会喜欢他说的话，但我希望他心中还残留着一丝旧日的情谊。我当然错了。他不是为我而来。他甚至不知道我还活着。他来这里只有一个原因——战争。他想进入这座岛，以便对这里的植物进行他自己的实验。

english: I turned him away. I have no more desire now to involve myself in his war than I did all those years ago, and I do not intend to see him turn my island to ash. He argued, just as he did before. He insisted that only through him would our race survive. He is so blinded by hate that he's forgotten what we should really be fighting for. He relented in the end, and once again I am alone.
translation: 我拒绝了他。我现在和多年前一样，不想卷入他的战争，我也不打算看着他把我这座岛化为灰烬。他像以前一样争辩。他坚持说只有通过他，我们的种族才能生存。他被仇恨蒙蔽了双眼，忘记了我们真正应该为之奋斗的东西。他最终让步了，而我再次孤身一人。

english: Although the largest, this is not the only island in this region, and many of the surrounding islands have flora like what is found here. One day I looked out onto another of the islands, only to be filled with horror. He had not given up.
translation: 虽然这是最大的岛，但并不是这片区域唯一的岛，周围许多岛屿上也有类似的植物。有一天我望向另一座岛，却惊恐万分。他没有放弃。

english: He could not have my island so instead he had claimed his own. I watched as his forces arrived and began their work. Over the weeks, a great fortress began to appear in the middle of the island. It grew and grew until it towered over everything else in the archipelago.
translation: 他得不到我的岛，于是占领了自己的岛。我看着他的部队抵达并开始工作。几周之内，一座巨大的堡垒开始出现在岛中央。它不断生长，直到高耸于群岛中一切之上。

english: Once the fortress was built, they began to bring in creatures from across the world. They brought them to the island and took them into the fortress. Day and night, I hear the shrieks and cries as he performs his experiments. I can't allow this to continue. His work will soon bring war.
translation: 堡垒建成后，他们开始从世界各地带来生物。他们把生物带到岛上，带进堡垒。日日夜夜，我听到他进行实验时发出的尖叫声和哭喊声。我不能让这一切继续下去。他的工作很快就会带来战争。

english: I went to him. I didn't want to, but I cannot allow him to destroy everything I've worked for. He met me at the gates of his fort. Lithkren he called it.
translation: 我去找他了。我不想这么做，但我不能让他毁掉我为之奋斗的一切。他在堡垒的大门前见了我。他称之为利斯克伦。

english: He once again tried to appeal to me, and I appealed to him. He encouraged me to work alongside him for the good of our people. I begged him to leave before his war destroyed our last hope of salvation. Neither of us got what we wanted and I left empty handed.
translation: 他再次试图说服我，我也试图说服他。他鼓励我为了我们族人的利益与他并肩作战。我恳求他在他的战争毁掉我们最后的救赎希望之前离开。我们谁都没有得到想要的，我空手而归。

english: For many months, I debated what to do. I of course could have attempted to fight him myself, but I knew that would not end well. I was hopelessly outnumbered, and besides, conflict is not my way.
translation: 几个月来，我一直在思考该怎么办。我当然可以尝试亲自与他战斗，但我知道那不会有好结果。我在人数上完全处于劣势，而且，冲突不是我的作风。

english: Instead, I decided to sabotage his operation. If the island has nothing for him then he will move on. However, before I could finish my preparations, disaster struck. They came.
translation: 于是，我决定破坏他的行动。如果岛上没有他要的东西，他就会离开。然而，在我完成准备之前，灾难降临了。他们来了。

english: The battle raged on for many days and both sides suffered heavy losses. I watched as the skies filled with fire and the seas with blood. By the end, there was little left. The fortress was a ruin and the island an empty waste.
translation: 战斗持续了数日，双方都损失惨重。我看着天空被火焰填满，海洋被鲜血染红。到最后，几乎什么都没剩下。堡垒成了废墟，岛屿成了一片荒芜。

english: I feared the humans would turn to my island next, but they thankfully left. I thought about going there, I thought about trying to find him. I didn't though. I knew he was gone. Once, I would have mourned him, but as I look over the wastes I feel nothing.
translation: 我担心人类接下来会转向我的岛，但幸运的是他们离开了。我想过去那里，想过去找他。但我没有。我知道他已经不在了。曾经，我会为他哀悼，但当我望着那片荒芜时，我什么感觉都没有。

english: Instead, I returned to my work. Someone must save our race and war is not the way.
translation: 相反，我回到了我的工作。必须有人来拯救我们的种族，而战争不是办法。

english: High Priest Nistirio
translation: 大祭司尼斯蒂里奥

english: Cautious of prying eyes, our lord has instructed me to investigate possible new locations for our experiments. One of the locations I have looked at is Dinh's Redoubt. While it has potential, the tower is too small for our needs. However, Dinh has left behind many useful pieces of equipment. I will have them transported to you at Quidamortem at once. Make sure they are kept safe.
translation: 为了避开窥探的目光，我们的主人指示我调查可能的新实验地点。我考察的地点之一是丁的堡垒。虽然那里有潜力，但塔对我们来说太小了。不过，丁留下了许多有用的装备。我会立刻将它们运送到奎达莫特姆给你。确保它们安全。

english: I have been impressed how quickly my creatures have evolved, the others will have to listen now! Again, the similarities to the garic are so frequent, there must be an academic explanation. Several have formed territories based on the spore colonies that inhabit them, and the mutations are consistent based on geography. Much like ourselves, it was only a matter of time before a divide formed.
translation: 我的生物进化之快令我印象深刻，其他人现在必须听我的了！与加里克蛛的相似之处如此频繁，一定有学术上的解释。有几个已经根据栖息的孢子群落形成了领地，而变异也因地理位置而一致。就像我们自己一样，分裂只是时间问题。

english: The Zygomite experiment and its effect on location could be explored here, if the spore colonies could be removed in part. Part of me is jealous of the union, I feel alone. My work keeps me sane.
translation: 菇人实验及其对地点的影响可以在这里探索，如果孢子群落能被部分移除的话。我有些嫉妒那种联合，我感到孤独。我的工作让我保持理智。

english: The nylocas are a diverse group of arachnids native to the world of Vampyrium. On their own, they are easily manageable and possess little threat to the vampyre population. However, nylocas typically group together in clusters. As such, they have the potential to quickly overcome more powerful foes.
translation: 尼洛卡斯蛛是原生于吸血鬼世界的一类多样的蛛形纲生物。单独来看，它们很容易对付，对吸血鬼族群几乎没有威胁。然而，尼洛卡斯蛛通常会成群聚集。因此，它们有可能迅速击败更强大的敌人。

english: When the Stranger from Afar led the vampyres to Gielinor, a large number of nylocas travelled with them. These nylocas were in the possession of Verzik Vitur, who had domesticated several of their species.
translation: 当远方陌生人带领吸血鬼来到吉莱诺时，大量尼洛卡斯蛛随行而至。这些尼洛卡斯蛛归维齐克.维图尔所有，她驯化了其中几个物种。

english: Over her millennia spent on Gielinor, Verzik has created a diverse breeding program for the nylocas. Today, the number on Gielinor far exceeds that of their original Vampyrium ancestors.
translation: 在吉莱诺度过的数千年里，维齐克为尼洛卡斯蛛制定了一个多样化的繁殖计划。如今，吉莱诺上的数量远远超过了它们在吸血鬼世界的祖先。

english: Although there are only three true species of nylocas, the generations of selective breeding have resulted in four new variants being identified on Gielinor. The purpose of this book is to detail the different types of nylocas.
translation: 虽然尼洛卡斯蛛只有三个真正的物种，但经过数代的选育，在吉莱诺上已鉴定出四种新的变种。本书旨在详述不同类型的尼洛卡斯蛛。

english: One of the three true nylocas originally from Vampyrium. The Ischyros are grey in colour and are notable for their hard, spine covered abdomens. The size of these nylocas can vary, but they typically do not grow much bigger than an adult human. The legs of an Ischyros end in sharp claws, which they aptly use against their foes.
translation: 三种原生于吸血鬼世界的尼洛卡斯蛛之一。伊斯基罗斯蛛呈灰色，以其坚硬、布满尖刺的腹部而闻名。这些尼洛卡斯蛛的大小不一，但通常不会比成年人类大多少。伊斯基罗斯蛛的腿末端有锋利的爪子，它们会巧妙地用这些爪子对付敌人。

english: Another of the three nylocas native to Vampyrium. The Toxobolos can easily be distinguished by their dark green colour and their wide, leaf-shaped claws. Like the Ischyros, they vary in size but generally do not grow larger than an adult human. Whilst they do use their claws offensively in the same way the Ischyros do, their preferred method of combat is to launch deadly spines at prey and predator alike.
translation: 三种原生于吸血鬼世界的尼洛卡斯蛛中的另一种。托克索博洛斯蛛很容易通过其深绿色和宽阔的叶状爪子来区分。与伊斯基罗斯蛛一样，它们大小不一，但通常不会比成年人类大。虽然它们也像伊斯基罗斯蛛一样用爪子进行攻击，但它们更喜欢的战斗方式是向猎物和捕食者发射致命的尖刺。

english: The last of the true nylocas. The Hagios are notable for their light blue colour and for the magic that visibly radiates from their exoskeleton. In size and general behaviour, they are similar to the other true nylocas. However, the Hagios also have the ability to target their foes with dangerous magical attacks.
translation: 最后一种真正的尼洛卡斯蛛。哈吉奥斯蛛以其浅蓝色和从外骨骼可见辐射的魔法而闻名。在大小和一般行为上，它们与其他真正的尼洛卡斯蛛相似。然而，哈吉奥斯蛛还有能力用危险的魔法攻击瞄准敌人。

english: The Matomenos are one of the new variant subspecies of nylocas that were bred by Verzik Vitur. They are slightly larger than true nylocas and are easy to identify due to their blood red colour. Likely due to their domestication, the Matomenos are not as aggressive as other nylocas and rarely attack, even if provoked. Instead, they are purely scavengers that will feast on the blood of already dead prey. This blood is stored in their abdomen, adding to their distinct colour.
translation: 马托梅诺斯蛛是维齐克.维图尔培育的尼洛卡斯蛛新变种亚种之一。它们比真正的尼洛卡斯蛛稍大，因其血红色而易于识别。可能由于驯化的原因，马托梅诺斯蛛不像其他尼洛卡斯蛛那样具有攻击性，即使被激怒也很少攻击。相反，它们纯粹是食腐者，以已死猎物的血液为食。这些血液储存在它们的腹部，增添了它们独特的颜色。

english: The Athanatos are the second subspecies of nylocas that were bred as part of Verzik Vitur's breeding program. Created through selective inbreeding of Matomenos, the two species are very closely related. The Athanatos are slightly larger than the Matomenos and like them, they will drink the blood of fallen foes and store it in their abdomen. However, the Athanatos have the ability to modify this blood internally, giving it unique properties. This modified blood gives them their distinctive purple colour. Although Athanatos are not directly aggressive, they will still support their kin by launching blood with healing properties.
translation: 阿萨纳托斯蛛是维齐克.维图尔繁殖计划中培育的第二个亚种。通过马托梅诺斯蛛的选择性近亲繁殖而创造，这两个物种关系非常密切。阿萨纳托斯蛛比马托梅诺斯蛛稍大，和它们一样，它们会饮用倒下敌人的血液并将其储存在腹部。然而，阿萨纳托斯蛛能够在体内改变这些血液，赋予其独特的属性。这种改变的血液赋予了它们独特的紫色。虽然阿萨纳托斯蛛不直接具有攻击性，但它们仍会通过发射具有治疗属性的血液来支援同类。

english: Another new variant of nylocas and arguably the most dangerous. The Vasilias are much larger than their cousins and have a limited ability to shapeshift, taking on the appearance and abilities of true nylocas. As the newest variant of nylocas, they are still a rarity compared to other types. However, thanks to their innate abilities, one Vasilias has the potential to do more damage than an entire cluster of other variants.
translation: 尼洛卡斯蛛的又一个新变种，可以说也是最危险的。瓦西利亚斯蛛比它们的近亲大得多，并且拥有有限的变化能力，能呈现出真正尼洛卡斯蛛的外貌和能力。作为尼洛卡斯蛛的最新变种，与其他类型相比仍然较为稀有。然而，凭借其天生的能力，一只瓦西利亚斯蛛的潜在破坏力可能超过一整群其他变种。

english: The Prinkipas are the last of the four new nylocas variants found on Gielinor. While considered a unique type of nylocas, the reality is that the Prinkipas are very closely related to the Vasilias. Like the Vasilias, they have the ability to shapeshift into forms that resemble true nylocas. However, the Prinkipas, while stronger than most nylocas, are still notably weaker than the Vasilias. As such, the Prinkipas were likely a precursor to the breeding of the more successful Vasilias variant.
translation: 普林基帕斯蛛是在吉里诺尔大陆上发现的四种新尼洛卡斯蛛变种中的最后一种。虽然被视为独特的尼洛卡斯蛛类型，但实际上普林基帕斯蛛与瓦西利亚斯蛛关系非常密切。和瓦西利亚斯蛛一样，它们也能变化成类似真正尼洛卡斯蛛的形态。然而，普林基帕斯蛛虽然比大多数尼洛卡斯蛛更强，但仍明显弱于瓦西利亚斯蛛。因此，普林基帕斯蛛很可能是培育更成功的瓦西利亚斯蛛变种的前身。

english: By the time I first saw the chamber dedicated to Apmeken, it had already been taken over by its new inhabitants. They'd quickly customised the place to their liking and were ready to defend it from any invaders.
translation: 当我第一次看到供奉阿普梅肯的密室时，它已经被新的居民占据了。他们迅速按照自己的喜好改造了那个地方，并准备抵御任何入侵者。

english: This large family of undead baboons are probably among the more unusual of the Devourer's servants, and indeed like most of her thralls, their fate was not by choice. The Devourer's control over these creatures is all thanks to their matriarch, Ba-Ba.
translation: 这群庞大的不死狒狒家族可能是吞噬者仆从中比较不寻常的一群，事实上和她的多数奴仆一样，他们的命运并非出于自愿。吞噬者能控制这些生物全靠它们的女族长——巴巴。

english: In life, Ba-Ba's troop dominated a large area of the Kharidian Desert, thriving under her watchful eye. Yet nothing lasts forever, and age was quickly catching up to Ba-Ba.
translation: 巴巴生前率领的狒狒群统治着卡里迪安沙漠的大片区域，在她警惕的目光下繁荣兴旺。然而没有什么能永恒，衰老很快找上了巴巴。

english: Although a natural part of life, Ba-Ba could not accept her mortality. This fear was not born out of selfishness - her concern was for her troop. Upon her death, Ba-Ba's daughter would have become matriarch, but she was lazy and arrogant. Ba-Ba did not consider her a worthy successor and longed to continue ruling herself.
translation: 尽管衰老是生命的自然部分，巴巴却无法接受自己终将死亡。这种恐惧并非出于自私——她担心的是她的族群。她死后，巴巴的女儿本应成为女族长，但她懒惰又傲慢。巴巴不认为她是合格的继任者，渴望继续亲自统治。

english: Learning of Ba-Ba's desires, the Devourer promised her a way to rule her troop forever. Believing there to be no other option, Ba-Ba agreed.
translation: 吞噬者得知了巴巴的愿望，向她承诺了一种能永远统治族群的方法。巴巴相信别无选择，便同意了。

english: Ever the deceiver, the Devourer's true plan soon became clear. With a single spell, she killed Ba-Ba and her entire troop, only to reanimate them all together.
translation: 吞噬者一如既往地善于欺骗，她的真正计划很快就显露出来。她用一个咒语杀死了巴巴和她的整个族群，然后将他们全部复活。

english: With her new army, the Devourer had no difficulties in capturing Apmeken. Now, Ba-Ba rules eternally over her undead horde, ensuring Apmeken remains a prisoner to the Devourer.
translation: 凭借这支新军队，吞噬者毫不费力地占领了阿普梅肯。如今，巴巴永远统治着她的不死大军，确保阿普梅肯始终是吞噬者的囚徒。

english: ... to explore it. You are now the judge of whether someone is skilled enough to enter. Just don't expect them to return. You also finally have the authority to send that partner of yours on her ocean hunt, if you so desire!
translation: ……去探索它。现在由你来判断谁有足够的能力进入。只是别指望他们能回来。如果你愿意的话，你终于也有权派你的那位搭档去进行她的海洋狩猎了！

english: Really thought the wyrms would get you.

english: Lost. Swamp. Eating away at everything I've ever known. Everyone I've ever loved. It's fine though, isnt it? Everything is fine. Skely over there is keeping me company. Day in. Day out. Never leaving my side.
translation: 迷失了。沼泽。吞噬着我所知道的一切。我所爱过的每一个人。不过没关系，不是吗？一切都好。那边的骷髅陪着我。日复一日。从不离开我身边。

english: Skely is angry with me, I don't know why. I snapped at him earlier; for what, I don't remember. My mind is slowly deteriorating. This swamp is evil, I just want it to stop. To be over. Please someone find me...
translation: 骷髅生我的气了，我不知道为什么。我之前冲他发火了；为了什么，我不记得了。我的脑子在慢慢退化。这沼泽太邪恶了，我只想让它停下来。结束吧。求求有人找到我……

english: A month it's been. Yes, over a month it has, wandering my new home with new friends and creatures and mushrooms and vines and plants and oooh Skely. Yes Skely is back, I like Skely. I'm friends with Skely again. He doesn't do things anymore though ever since the backstabbing but we don't talk about that. No we don't. No more death from above, no no no, that scares me.
translation: 已经一个月了。是的，一个多月了，我在新家游荡，有新朋友、生物、蘑菇、藤蔓、植物，还有哦骷髅。是的骷髅回来了，我喜欢骷髅。我又和骷髅做朋友了。不过自从那次背叛之后他再也不做那些事了，但我们不提那个。不，我们不提。不再有从天而降的死亡，不不不，那让我害怕。

english: I've found bread! Why bread? Why bread crumbs? I've tried to speak to Bell but she just ignores me. One time she tried to eat me... I think that's how I'm here... I can't remember. Skely is doing well. He says we can go to somewhere new later, that's exciting! Yes, very exciting!
translation: 我找到了面包！为什么是面包？为什么是面包屑？我试着和贝尔说话，但她就是不理我。有一次她还想吃我……我想我就是这样来到这里的……我不记得了。骷髅过得不错。他说我们晚点可以去个新地方，真让人兴奋！是的，非常兴奋！

english: As the manufacture of runestones intensified at the start of the Fifth Age, the magic arts became available to people of a great varying age and background. It soon became evident just how dangerous this was, with a great many tragic accidents occurring due to inexperienced wizards. Wizards and victims alike were calling for something to be done, but it was only due to a tragic accident involving one of the leaders of that time that the training arena was constructed. Established with all skill levels in mind, it was used for a great many years until it was destroyed due to conflict of opinion. There were many warriors of melee and ranged combat that took offence to this new art of magic, and taking matters into their own hands, they destroyed the arena. At the time of the writing of this book, a collection of Wizards took it upon themselves to resurrect the building along with all Guardians of Magic that were destroyed with it. These Guardians were created out of the very same essence as runestones, embodying the magic power and authority needed to oversee the arena.
translation: 随着第五纪元初期符文石制造业的加强，魔法技艺开始向各种年龄和背景的人开放。很快人们就意识到这有多危险，许多不幸的事故都因缺乏经验的巫师而发生。巫师和受害者都在呼吁采取行动，但直到当时一位领袖遭遇不幸事故后，训练竞技场才得以建造。考虑到所有技能水平，它被使用了多年，直到因意见冲突而被摧毁。许多近战和远程战斗的战士对这门新的魔法技艺感到不满，他们自行其是，摧毁了竞技场。在撰写本书时，一群巫师决定重建这座建筑以及与之一起被摧毁的所有魔法守护者。这些守护者由与符文石相同的精华创造，体现了监督竞技场所需的魔法力量和权威。

english: By earning points for performing the tasks in the four areas, a mage can prove his adeptness at the different skills, and claim items to display his skill. In order to keep track of the mage's progress, a special type of hat was commissioned. Carrying this chap around, and by talking to it nicely, he will keep track of a mage's Pizazz Points for future record. The best way to please the hat is by collecting points, by which many astute students have noticed the visual change in the hat. However, there is a limit to the total number of points that can be collected without spending them, but this won't stop mages from continuing in their training.
translation: 通过在四个区域完成任务赚取积分，法师可以证明自己对不同技能的熟练程度，并获得物品来展示自己的技艺。为了记录法师的进度，一种特殊的帽子被定制出来。随身携带这顶帽子，并友善地与它交谈，它就会记录法师的Pizazz积分以备将来参考。取悦这顶帽子的最佳方式就是收集积分，许多敏锐的学生已经注意到帽子外观的变化。然而，不花费积分的情况下能收集的总分是有限制的，但这不会阻止法师们继续训练。

english: The ability to use magic to sense the existence of objects and then move them has a great many purposes in day- to-day life. This theatre employs the mage to use their telekinetic spell to move a statue around a maze. Standing on the side they wish to move the statue towards, the goal is to get the statue to the solution square. This also improves the awareness of the mage, assessing the consequences of casting the spell: just how will the object move? Once the maze has been solved, the statue will be brought to life, providing the option to move onto the next maze. Reward is given in the form of 2 Telekinetic Pizazz points for each maze solved, and a bonus for every five mazes solved in a row.
translation: 运用魔法感知物体存在并将其移动的能力在日常生活中有着广泛的用途。这个剧场雇佣法师使用他们的心灵传动法术在迷宫中移动雕像。站在他们希望雕像移动方向的一侧，目标是将雕像移动到解决方格。这也能提高法师的意识，评估施放法术的后果：物体究竟会如何移动？一旦迷宫被解决，雕像将被赋予生命，提供进入下一个迷宫的选择。每解决一个迷宫可获得2点心灵传动Pizazz积分作为奖励，连续解决五个迷宫还有额外奖励。

english: The arena is free to all those that wish to train here, but it costs to maintain the building, and the Guardians don't work for free! The popularity of the alchemy spell has become apparent over the years, and so in this playground of sorts, the art of alchemy can be practiced by finding the most expensive items in the playground and converting them into coins.
translation: 竞技场对所有希望在此训练的人免费开放，但维护建筑需要费用，守护者们也不是免费工作的！多年来，炼金术的流行已显而易见，因此在这个类似游乐场的地方，可以通过寻找游乐场中最昂贵的物品并将其转化为金币来练习炼金术。

english: The money must be deposited in the receptacle opposite the entrance before leaving, otherwise it is taken upon leaving the playground without reward. Although we would rather trust the mages, some are just far too greedy and deceitful! Every 100 coins will reward the mage with one Alchemy Pizazz Point, and you'll also get 10% of your coins back as an added thank you.
translation: 离开前必须将金币存入入口对面的容器中，否则离开游乐场时金币将被没收且无奖励。虽然我们愿意信任法师们，但有些人实在太贪婪和狡诈了！每100枚金币将奖励法师1点炼金Pizazz积分，同时你还能拿回10%的金币作为额外感谢。

english: When the wizards first created the arena, they created special artefacts that would change shape and react to the attempt to enchant them. These artefacts could store the power from the spell and be used to drive magical devices. Hence in this arena, enchanting the various shapes will create orbs that can be deposited to help give power back to the arena itself. For every ten shapes enchanted, Pizazz Points are rewarded depending on the level of enchantment spell used, and for every 20 orbs given, an item of mage equipment is awarded. An extra Pizazz Point is also given for every shape enchanted as indicated by the Enchantment Guardian on hand. It's also a good idea to watch out for rare dragon stones which share similar properties as the shapes, but can be converted for extra Pizazz Points.
translation: 当巫师们最初创建竞技场时，他们创造了特殊的文物，这些文物会变形并对附魔尝试做出反应。这些文物可以储存法术的力量，用于驱动魔法装置。因此，在这个竞技场中，对各种形状进行附魔会产生能量球，可以存放以帮助恢复竞技场本身的能量。每附魔十个形状，根据使用的附魔法术等级奖励Pizazz积分，每交出20个能量球，将获得一件法师装备。此外，根据在场的附魔守护者的指示，每附魔一个形状还会额外获得1点Pizazz积分。留意稀有的龙石也是个好主意，它们与这些形状具有相似的性质，但可以转化为额外的Pizazz积分。

english: Different piles will yield different bones, changing type as people take from them. Mages can even practice to earn the right to learn a new spell - the Bones to Peaches spell, which can be bought from the Rewards Guardian above the entrance hall. A great many runestones are also found with the remains of bodies, and the wizards have gathered those as a reward for supplying food. There is a downside to the graveyard however: the bones are often teleported right on-top of the mages, and so the food may come in handy to recover from any damage received!
translation: 不同的骨堆会产生不同的骨头，随着人们从中取用而改变类型。法师们甚至可以练习以获得学习新法术的权利——化骨为桃法术，可以从入口大厅上方的奖励守护者那里购买。许多符文石也常与尸体遗骸一同被发现，巫师们收集了这些作为提供食物的奖励。然而，墓地有一个缺点：骨头经常被传送到法师头顶上，所以食物可能派上用场来恢复受到的伤害！

english: Our total force of able bodied soldiers of one hundred is not adequate. History teaches us that we face constant threats, such as the beast of winter. We must expand our forces substantially in order to face these threats and defend the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 我们总共一百名体格健全的士兵不足以应对威胁。历史告诉我们，我们面临持续的威胁，如冬日野兽。我们必须大幅扩充兵力以应对这些威胁，保卫大库兰德王国。

english: We must invest in officer class training in order to maintain obedience throughout the ranks.
translation: 我们必须投资军官级训练，以维持整个军阶的纪律。

english: Furthermore, we live in a time where magical discoveries are made every day, and the threat of a magical based attack increases with each discovery. Standard forces are not prepared to battle such a threat. We must invest in defence against these dark arts.
translation: 此外，我们生活在一个每天都有魔法发现的时代，基于魔法的攻击威胁随着每次发现而增加。常规部队尚未准备好应对这种威胁。我们必须投资防御这些黑暗法术。

english: I hereby formally recommend to His Royal Highness King Hosidius V that the Shayzien armed forces be permitted the resources required for expansion.
translation: 我在此正式向霍西迪乌斯五世国王陛下建议，允许谢兹恩武装部队获得扩充所需的资源。

english: I stress that these resources are absolutely required in order to adequately defend our great kingdom.
translation: 我强调，这些资源对于充分保卫我们伟大的王国是绝对必要的。

english: Each regiment will consist of two hundred personnel under the command of a General, with each General reporting to myself. All personnel are to be highly trained, following a specialist recruitment and selection process. Only the strongest citizens will be selected.
translation: 每个军团由两百名士兵组成，由一名将军指挥，每位将军直接向我汇报。所有人员必须经过专业招募和选拔流程，接受高度训练。只有最强大的公民才会被选中。

english: The state will provide excellent accommodation for all personnel. This will include three meals each day, as well as pensions to families in the event of death.
translation: 国家将为所有人员提供优越的住宿条件，包括每日三餐，以及阵亡时向家属发放抚恤金。

english: Once operational, the six-hundred strong multi-skilled forces will be able to defend Great Kourend from all threats.
translation: 一旦投入运作，这支六百人的多技能部队将能够保卫大库兰德免受一切威胁。

english: It is of the upmost importance that His Royal Highness invests in these forces in order to protect all that he rules.
translation: 王子殿下投资于这些部队以保护他所统治的一切，是至关重要的。

english: Dear [player name],
translation: 亲爱的[player name]，

english: My name is Idria. I'm a leader, of sorts, to the Guardians of Armadyl. I'd hoped our first contact would be regarding more pleasant matters, but instead I must inform you of a dire situation that I know you worked hard to prevent.
translation: 我叫伊德莉亚，算是阿玛杜尔守护者的领袖。我本希望我们的初次联系是关于更愉快的事情，但我必须告知你一个严峻的情况，我知道你曾努力阻止它发生。

english: Despite your efforts in safeguarding the Staff of Armadyl for us, the resourceful Lucien found another route to our beloved treasure.
translation: 尽管你为我们保护阿玛杜尔杖付出了努力，足智多谋的卢西安还是找到了另一条通往我们珍贵宝藏的途径。

english: While Lucien may now have his prize, there is still a chance to put an end to his plots. If you are willing to help, please make haste to Ivy Sophista, our ally in Taverley.
translation: 虽然卢西安现在可能已经得到了他的战利品，但仍有办法终结他的阴谋。如果你愿意帮忙，请尽快前往塔韦利村找我们的盟友艾薇.索菲斯塔。

english: Yours most respectfully,
translation: 致以最诚挚的敬意，

english: Many in my order will heavily question my decision to contact you, but I am left with little choice. My name is Idria. I'm a leader, of sorts, to the Guardians of Armadyl.
translation: 我教团中的许多人会严重质疑我联系你的决定，但我别无选择。我叫伊德莉亚，算是阿玛杜尔守护者的领袖。

english: I realise that based on your past actions, you likely have little desire to help us with our plight, but I urge to you to heavily consider the contents of this letter.
translation: 我意识到，根据你过去的行为，你可能不太愿意帮助我们摆脱困境，但我恳请你认真考虑这封信的内容。

english: Thanks to you, Lucien has successfully acquired the Staff of Armadyl. With this treasure, he presents a threat that this world has not seen for millennia, and we alone are not powerful enough to stop him.
translation: 多亏了你，卢西安成功获得了阿玛杜尔杖。凭借这件宝藏，他构成了这个世界数千年来未曾见过的威胁，仅凭我们自己的力量不足以阻止他。

english: I am informed that you stood against the Mahjarrat invasion of Varrock. I implore you to take a similar stance here by reconsidering your alliance with Lucien, for all of Gielinor is at risk.
translation: 我得知你曾抵抗过玛哈加特对维洛克城的入侵。我恳请你在这里采取类似的立场，重新考虑你与卢西安的联盟，因为整个吉莱诺都处于危险之中。

english: If you are willing to help us stand against him, please make haste to Ivy Sophista, our ally in Taverley.
translation: 如果你愿意帮助我们对抗他，请尽快前往塔韦利村找我们的盟友艾薇.索菲斯塔。

translation: 这张卷轴包含一段咒语，可以解锁死斗：末日家园传送动画。但你已经解锁了这个动画。

english: The armour on display here was once worn by the Cloud Titan that inhabited the islands of Tempest Bay.
translation: 这里展示的盔甲曾由居住在风暴湾群岛的云巨人穿戴。

english: Despite the Cloud Titan being defeated around 900 years ago, the armour was not found until roughly 700 years later when it was donated to the museum by a traveller.
translation: 尽管云巨人大约在900年前被击败，但这套盔甲直到大约700年后才被发现，由一位旅行者捐赠给了博物馆。

english: The traveller claimed to have slain the Cloud Titan himself, with the giant having survived its original defeat. However, experts consider this unlikely.
translation: 这位旅行者声称自己亲手杀死了云巨人，说巨人在最初的失败中幸存了下来。然而，专家们认为这不太可能。

english: A History of Astronomy in Gielinor.
translation: 吉莱诺天文学史。

english: At the start of the 4th Age, a learned man by the name of Scorpius, known well for his powers of vision and magic, sought communion with the gods of the world. So many unanswered questions had he that he devoted his entire life to this cause.
translation: 在第四纪元之初，一位名叫斯科皮乌斯的博学之人，以其卓越的视力和魔法能力而闻名，寻求与世间诸神沟通。他有太多未解之谜，为此奉献了一生。

english: After many years of study, seeking knowledge from the wise of that time, he developed a machine infused with magical power, infused with the ability to pierce into the very heavens - a huge eye that gave the user incredible sight, like never before.
translation: 经过多年的研究，向当时的智者求取知识，他发明了一台注入魔法力量的机器，拥有穿透苍穹的能力——一只巨大的眼睛，赋予使用者前所未有的惊人视力。

english: As time passed, Scorpius grew adept at using his specialized skills, and followed the movements of the stars in Gielinor, which he mapped and named, and are still used to this very day.
translation: 随着时间推移，斯科皮乌斯熟练掌握了专业技能，追踪吉莱诺星辰的运行轨迹，绘制星图并命名，这些至今仍在使用。

english: Before long, Scorpius used his knowledge for predicting the future, and, in turn, he called upon the dark knowledge of Zamorakian worshippers to further his cause. Living below ground, the followers of the dark god remained until the civilisation of Ardougne grew in strength and control.
translation: 不久之后，斯科皮乌斯运用他的知识预测未来，为此他求助于萨莫拉克信徒的黑暗知识以推进他的事业。黑暗之神的追随者居住在地下，直到阿多尼城的文明壮大并掌控局势。

english: The kings of that time worked to banish the Zamorakian followers in the area, hiding all reference to Scorpius's invention, due to its 'evil nature'.
translation: 当时的国王们致力于驱逐该地区的萨莫拉克追随者，并因斯科皮乌斯发明的'邪恶本质'而隐藏了所有相关记载。

english: Years after, when the minds of the kings lent more towards the research of the unknown, the plans of Scorpius were uncovered and the heavenly eye constructed again.
translation: 多年以后，当国王们的心思转向探索未知领域时，斯科皮乌斯的图纸被重新发现，天眼被再次建造。

english: Since then, many have studied the ways of the astronomer, Scorpius, and in his memory a grave was constructed near the Observatory.
translation: 自那以后，许多人研习天文学家斯科皮乌斯的方法，为纪念他，在观象台附近修建了一座坟墓。

english: Some claim his ghost still wanders nearby, in torment as he seeks the secrets of the heavens that can never be solved. Tales tell that he will grant those adept in the arts of the astronomer a blessing of unusual power.
translation: 有人声称他的幽灵仍在附近徘徊，痛苦地追寻着永远无法解开的天空奥秘。传说他会赐予精通天文学技艺的人一种非凡力量的祝福。

english: Here ends the tale of how astronomy entered the known world.
translation: 天文学如何进入已知世界的故事到此结束。

english: Many men did fall that day,

english: Just myself left and alas,

english: Still buoyed on by my first success

english: Next man was of rock hued grey
translation: 下一个是灰色岩石的人

english: Crushing blows I rained on him,

english: Not a scratch could I make

english: With a crown on his head,

english: Strolled top from the hollow,
translation: 从洞穴中昂首走出，

english: Its eyes burning red.

english: All those who looked upon it,

english: Were doomed by its gaze,

translation: 他们的心，冰冷如花岗岩，

english: Their veins, a stone maze.

english: And echoed its hate.

english: But V flexed his roundshield,

english: And stopped the beast still.

english: The shield had been polished,
translation: 盾牌曾被磨亮，

english: With hot rocks and oil,
translation: 用热石和油，

english: At the sight of its likeness,
translation: 一看到自己的模样，

english: It retched and recoiled.
translation: 它呕吐着退缩了。

english: Blood streamed from its eyes,
translation: 血从它眼中涌出，

english: And fledged statues like rain,
translation: 雕像如雨般坠落，

english: With a swing of V's longsword,
translation: V挥动长剑，

english: The serpent was slain.
translation: 巨蛇被斩杀。

english: Its pelt, he made a cape,
translation: 它的皮毛，他做成披风，

english: And some teeth into horns,
translation: 一些牙齿做成角，

english: Great monster died that night,
translation: 伟大的怪物那夜死去，

english: And a hero was born.
translation: 一位英雄诞生了。

english: We arrived at the site today. When I was first told about it, I didn't believe the stories of how grand it was. Turns out I was right not to. Sure, being in a giant air bubble under the sea is quite exciting, but beyond that, there isn't really anything remarkable here.
translation: 我们今天到达了现场。当初有人告诉我这里有多宏伟时，我并不相信那些传说。事实证明我不信是对的。当然，身处海底的巨大气泡里确实挺刺激，但除此之外，这里真没什么特别的。

english: Perhaps the temple lived up to the stories before the battle, but now there's just a big hole in the wall, some strange symbols on the floor that kind of freak me out and a whole lot of rubble.
translation: 也许在战斗之前，这座神庙确实配得上那些传说，但现在只剩下墙上的一个大洞、地板上一些让我毛骨悚然的奇怪符号，以及一大堆瓦砾。

english: According to Pharana, the Justiciar of the Lion wants no time wasted. We start work tomorrow. Guess I'm just going to have to get used to the smell of fish.
translation: 据Pharana说，狮子的审判官不想浪费时间。我们明天就开始工作。看来我只能慢慢习惯鱼腥味了。

english: Just a short entry today. My arms are tired after hours of moving rubble around.
translation: 今天只写一小段。搬了几个小时的瓦砾，我的手臂都酸了。

english: All day I had this strange feeling like I was being watched, but it's probably just the fish. Sometimes they swim too close to the air bubble and fall through.
translation: 一整天我都有种奇怪的感觉，好像有人在看着我，但可能只是那些鱼。有时候它们游得太靠近气泡，就会掉进来。

english: I didn't ever think that I'd be in danger of falling fish, but I suppose this is my life now.
translation: 我从没想过自己会有被鱼砸到的危险，但我想这就是我的生活了。

english: Another thrilling day of soggy bread and wet boots. 'Clear the path!' 'Move that rubble!' - Pharana has been barking all day. I pray she never finds this diary. She'd throw me out of the bubble to drown if she ever discovered the things I've written about her.
translation: 又是湿面包和湿靴子的刺激一天。'清路！''搬走那些瓦砾！' - Pharana一整天都在吼。我祈祷她永远找不到这本日记。要是她发现我写了什么关于她的事，肯定会把我扔出气泡淹死。

english: We've only been here a few days, but I'm starting to feel more and more uneasy about this place. There's a strange energy here.
translation: 我们才来了几天，但我开始对这个地方越来越不安。这里有一种奇怪的能量。

english: Today I found a hidden cache of amulets with eye symbols on them. I reported it to Pharana and she thanked me for the good work, smiling as she did. It was a nice change from her usual demeanour, and it was good to feel like I'd achieved more than just moving rubble around.
translation: 今天我发现了藏起来的一批护身符，上面有眼睛图案。我报告给了Pharana，她微笑着感谢了我的工作。这和她平时的态度很不一样，能感觉自己不只是搬瓦砾，真好。

english: Interestingly, as she walked away, I heard her mutter something like 'Could it be true? Perhaps the justiciar has some explaining to do.' I don't know what she meant, but I wonder if there's more to our work here than we realised.
translation: 有趣的是，她走开时，我听到她嘀咕着什么'难道是真的？也许审判官有些事需要解释。'我不知道她是什么意思，但我想我们在这里的工作可能比我们意识到的要复杂。

english: I spent the afternoon cleaning my robes after I slipped on one of those blasted fish. Thankfully, Pharana didn't seem to mind. I think I'll take advantage of her good mood and take an early night tonight. I haven't been sleeping well recently. I blame those pesky fish.
translation: 我滑倒在那该死的鱼上，花了一下午清洗我的袍子。幸好Pharana似乎不在意。我想趁她心情好，今晚早点休息。最近一直睡不好，都怪那些烦人的鱼。

english: There was an odd tremor today. Nothing too alarming, but it did shake free some rubble I'd been trying to clear. Beneath it, I noticed some strange stones. I wasn't able to dig them out, but I reckon I can get to them if I continue tomorrow.
translation: 今天有奇怪的震动。不算太吓人，但把我一直想清理的瓦砾震松了。下面我注意到一些奇怪的石头。我没能挖出来，但我想如果明天继续的话，应该能挖到。

english: I also managed to find time today to imbue this diary with a spell to keep it dry. I just wish the spell would work on my boots as well.
translation: 我今天还抽空给这本日记施了个防水咒。真希望这咒语对我的靴子也有效。

english: I was able to uncover those strange stones I saw yesterday, and by Saradomin do I regret doing so. They weren't actually stones at all, but some sort of statue. I went to report my discovery, but as soon as I turned around, I had this funny feeling like I was being followed. The statue had come to life!
translation: 我挖出了昨天看到的那些奇怪的石头，天啊我真后悔这么做。它们根本不是石头，而是某种雕像。我去报告我的发现，但一转身，就有种奇怪的感觉，好像被跟踪了。那雕像活了过来！

english: I tried all sorts of things, but the statue wouldn't leave my side. This stinks like old, forbidden magic, and I fear Pharana will scold me for being near it, even if it's no fault of my own. She may have been nice to me the other day, but I know what knights are like. I won't bet my life on her being any different.
translation: 我试了各种办法，但那雕像就是不肯离开我身边。这闻起来像是古老的禁忌魔法，我担心Pharana会因为我靠近它而责骂我，即使这不是我的错。她前几天对我还不错，但我知道骑士是什么样的人。我不会拿命赌她会不一样。

english: The statue seems relatively harmless at least. It looks to be made of a similar material to the magical stone in the temple. Within the centre of its body is some sort of swirling, green core. It also appears to be somewhat obedient. At least, it didn't mind me disguising it amongst a pile of rubble for the night.
translation: 至少那雕像看起来相对无害。它似乎是由和神庙里那块魔法石相似的材料制成的。它身体中央有种旋转的绿色核心。它似乎也有点听话。至少，它不介意我把它伪装在瓦砾堆里过夜。

english: 'We are a collection of energy. The concept of me or I does not apply beyond one's body. We are constant, as was intended.'
translation: '我们是一团能量的集合。我或我的概念不适用于身体之外。我们是恒定的，正如所设计的那样。'

english: 'Many bodies were destroyed in the battle. This body was trapped, our energy bound to the stone.'
translation: '许多身体在战斗中被摧毁。这个身体被困住了，我们的能量被束缚在石头里。'

english: 'The rift to the Scar may open once more. We protect it for the justiciar.'
translation: '通往伤痕的裂隙可能再次打开。我们为审判官守护着它。'

english: I can't say I really understand what it means, but it seems Egg is aware of the justiciar. Considering the multiple energies in one body bit, I guess I should also refer to Egg as 'them' now.
translation: 我不能说我真的理解它的意思，但似乎蛋知道审判官。考虑到一体多能量那部分，我想我现在也应该用'他们'来称呼蛋了。

english: Pharana has sent for additional support which should arrive in a few days. I hope they bring something other than fish.
translation: Pharana已经请求增援，应该几天后到。希望他们带点别的，别又是鱼。

english: I've been keeping Egg hidden in a compartment behind some large kelp. The problem is they only stay there for a while before trying to leave. I've asked them multiple times to stay hidden, but Egg doesn't seem to understand the amount of trouble I could get in for this.
translation: 我一直把蛋藏在一些大海带后面的隔间里。问题是它们只会在那里待一阵子就想离开。我已经多次要求它们躲好，但蛋似乎不明白我因此可能惹上多大的麻烦。

english: 'Our bodies are energised essence. Energy is everywhere. Altars are where we gather.'
translation: '我们的身体是充满能量的精华。能量无处不在。祭坛是我们聚集的地方。'

english: 'Keep the forces in check. The entrance is where they meet. Guard the rift.'
translation: '保持力量平衡。入口是它们交汇之处。守护裂隙。'

english: Egg seems increasingly restless. They mentioned something about a sacred stone today, whatever that means.
translation: 蛋似乎越来越不安分。今天它们提到了什么神圣的石头，不知道那是什么意思。

english: I've decided I can't keep them a secret. With the growing risk of Egg revealing themselves, and the important information they seem to hold, it's time I take this to Pharana.
translation: 我决定不能再隐瞒它们了。随着蛋暴露的风险越来越大，以及它们似乎掌握的重要信息，是时候把这件事告诉法拉娜了。

english: I suspect she won't thank me with a smile this time. I've kept Egg secret for too long. This may be my last entry for a while.
translation: 我猜这次她不会笑着感谢我。我隐瞒蛋太久了。这可能是我一段时间内的最后一篇笔记。

english: How many would you like to take?
translation: 你想拿多少？

translation: 看起来凯乌斯正在回他的房子。你得等一会儿，直到我们得到下一栋房子的消息。

translation: 我听说凯乌斯可能很快就要离开他的房子了。
