english: WARNING: You will not be able to re-obtain the Avernic hilt. It will become too damaged in the process and you will be left with only a Dragon defender.
translation: 警告：你将无法重新获得阿弗尼克剑柄。它会在过程中损坏严重，你只会剩下一个龙金格挡匕首。

english: Copied for Guild Records by Scribe Verity.
translation: 由书记官维里蒂为公会记录抄录。

english: As yet, I've not observed anything I'd consider to be out of the ordinary within the pass. I'll aim to move a little further up in the coming week if this remains fruitless.
translation: 到目前为止，我还没有在隘口观察到任何我认为不寻常的事情。如果接下来一周仍然没有发现，我打算再往上走一点。

english: Still nothing much of note to document, but the Custodia Pass does seem to now have a relatively high density of rabbits compared to previous reports. I need to identify if they have come from the Auburn Valley, or if we've simply missed a population in our records. I shall attempt to catch a couple and clarify the situation in my next report.
translation: 仍然没有什么值得记录的事情，但与之前的报告相比，卡斯托迪亚隘口的兔子密度似乎相对较高。我需要确定它们是否来自奥本谷，还是我们只是漏记了一个种群。我会尝试抓几只，在下一份报告中澄清情况。

english: Having caught a couple, it is clear that these rabbits are not a part of the Auburn Valley population. The ones I have captured present with what can only be described as fangs. I've never seen anything like it. I will endeavour to learn as much as I can about these rabbits whilst I am here. Expect further reports soon.
translation: 抓了几只后，很明显这些兔子不属于奥本谷的种群。我捕获的兔子长着只能形容为獠牙的东西。我从未见过这样的东西。我会在这里尽可能多地了解这些兔子。期待很快有进一步的报告。

english: WARNING: You will not be able to re-obtain the Avernic hilt after combining it with a dragon defender.
translation: 警告：将阿弗尼克剑柄与龙金格挡匕首结合后，你将无法重新获得它。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build ballistic attractors on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读了示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造弹道吸引器。你记住了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: Baldwin raises his eyebrows at you, but otherwise ignores you.
translation: 鲍德温对你挑了挑眉，但除此之外没有理会你。

english: So the Angel has gone then? It's so hard to believe after all this time...
translation: 这么说天使已经走了？过了这么久真是难以置信……

english: I suppose it will be nice to not need to worry about her anymore.
translation: 我想不用再担心她也是一件好事。

english: Perhaps... Though she was meant to keep us safe. We'll now need to hope no other danger comes along.
translation: 也许吧……但她本应保护我们的安全。我们现在只能希望不会有其他危险出现。

english: Well, if that does happen, there are other ways to defend yourselves.
translation: 嗯，如果真的发生了，你们还有其他自卫的方法。

english: Hah! What you want with me, little city person?
translation: 哈！你找我什么事，小城市人？

english: You not talk like barbarian person. You certainly not smell like barbarian person! But I think I give you test anyway.
translation: 你说话不像野蛮人。你闻起来也肯定不像野蛮人！但我想我还是可以给你个考验。

english: Ha ha ha! I not interested in talking to soft city woman who not know what he want.
translation: 哈哈哈！我对和不知道自己想要什么的软弱的城市女人说话不感兴趣。

english: Ha ha ha! I not interested in talking to soft city person who not know what he want.
translation: 哈哈哈！我对和不知道自己想要什么的软弱的城市人说话不感兴趣。

english: I have noted down what Otto has told me in this journal, so that I may not forget my tasks. His instructions are thus faithfully recorded for posterity.
translation: 我已将奥托告诉我的内容记在这本日记里，以免忘记任务。他的指示已如实记录，留传后世。

english: 'While you civilised folk use small, weak fishing rods, we barbarians are skilled with heavier tackle. We fish in the lake nearby. Take the rod from under the bed in my dwelling and fish in the lake. When you have caught a few fish I am sure you will be ready to talk more with me. You will know when you are ready, since inspiration will fill your mind. We do not use these fish quite as you might expect. When you return from Fishing we can speak more of this matter.'
translation: '你们文明人用细小的鱼竿，而我们野蛮人擅长更重的钓具。我们在附近的湖里钓鱼。从我住所床下取出鱼竿，去湖里钓鱼。钓到几条鱼后，我相信你就能和我进一步交谈了。当你准备好时自然会知道，因为灵感会充满你的脑海。我们对这些鱼的用法可不像你想的那样。钓鱼归来后，我们再详谈此事。'

english: 'Your mind is as clear as the waters you have fished. This is good. These are fish which are fat with eggs rather than fat of flesh; this is what we will make use of.'
translation: '你的心智如你垂钓的水域般清澈。很好。这些鱼肥美在于鱼卵而非鱼肉，这正是我们要利用的。'

english: 'First you must know more of harpoons through special study of fish that are usually caught with such a device. You must catch fish which are usually harpooned, without a harpoon. You will be using your skill and strength. Use your arm as bait. Wriggle your fingers as if they are a tasty snack and hungry tuna and swordfish will throng to be caught by you. This method also works with shark - though in this case the action must be more of a frenzied thrashing of the arm than a wriggle.'
translation: '首先，你必须通过专门研究通常用鱼叉捕获的鱼类来更深入了解鱼叉。你必须不用鱼叉就捕获通常用鱼叉捕的鱼。你要运用你的技巧和力量。用你的手臂作饵。扭动手指，仿佛它们是美味小食，饥饿的金枪鱼和剑鱼就会蜂拥而来被你捕获。这方法对鲨鱼也有效——不过此时手臂动作要更像疯狂拍打而非扭动。'

english: 'The first point in your progression is that of lighting fires without a tinderbox. For this process you will require a strung bow. You use the bow to quickly rotate pieces of wood against one another. As you rub, the wood becomes hot, eventually springing into flame. The spirits will aid you, the power they supply will guide your hands. Go and benefit from their guidance upon an oaken log.'
translation: '你进阶的第一步是不用火绒盒生火。这需要一把上好弦的弓。你用弓快速旋转木片相互摩擦。随着摩擦，木头变热，最终燃起火焰。灵魂会助你一臂之力，它们提供的力量会引导你的双手。去橡木原木上感受它们的指引吧。'

english: 'Firemaking with your bow worked - fine news indeed, secrets of our spirit boats now await your attention.'
translation: '用弓生火成功了——真是好消息，我们灵魂船的秘密现在等着你去探索。'

english: 'If you use your knife upon the fat fish, several new fishy items will be produced. Fish parts can be used as bait; the roe or caviar is more useful for us. Mixing these items with two dose potions is what should be performed. This results in a nutritious slop, perfect for healing as well as imparting the effect of the potion. Roe can only be used for some of the more easily combined mixes, while caviar may be used for any of the mixes of which I am aware. You will discover that you are able to decant a four dose potion into an empty vial, thus giving two potions of two doses. This will aid you in the process. In this case I in fact require a potion, for my own stocks. Bring me a lesser attack potion combined with fish roe.'
translation: '如果你用刀处理肥鱼，会得到几种新的鱼类物品。鱼的部分可用作鱼饵；鱼卵或鱼子酱对我们更有用。将这些与两剂药水混合即可。这会产生营养丰富的糊状物，既能治疗又能赋予药水效果。鱼卵只能用于某些较易混合的配方，而鱼子酱可用于我所知的所有配方。你会发现可以将四剂药水倒入空瓶中，得到两瓶两剂药水。这有助于你的操作。这次我实际上需要一瓶药水补充我的库存。给我带一瓶混合鱼卵的低级攻击药水。'

english: 'The next step is to manufacture a spear, suitable for combat. Our distant cousins on Karamja are in need of help, however, and you must aid them before I can aid you. You must go now and complete the Tai Bwo Wannai Trio quest.'
translation: '下一步是制作适合战斗的长矛。不过我们在卡拉姆詹岛的远亲需要帮助，你必须先帮助他们，我才能帮你。你现在必须去完成泰博瓦纳三重奏任务。'

english: 'Many warriors complain that spears are difficult to find, we barbarians thus forge our own. If you use our special barbarian anvil here, you will find it ideal. Other forges are not sturdy enough or shaped appropriately for the forging work involved. Make any of our spears and return. Note well that you will require wood for the spear shafts, the quality of wood must be similar to that of the metal involved.'
translation: '许多战士抱怨长矛难找，所以我们野蛮人自己锻造。如果你用我们这里的特殊野蛮人铁砧，会发现它非常理想。其他熔炉不够坚固或形状不适合这种锻造工作。制作我们任何一种长矛后回来。注意你需要木材做矛杆，木材质量须与金属相匹配。'

english: The manufacture of spears is now yours as a speciality. Use your skill well. In addition, I am ready to reveal more spear-related crafts.'
translation: 长矛制作现在成了你的专长。善用你的技艺。此外，我还准备传授更多与长矛相关的工艺。'

english: 'The next stage is quite complex, so listen well. In order to send our ancestors into the spirit world, their mortal remains must be burned with due ceremony. This can only be performed close to the water on the shore of the lake, just to our north-east. You will recognise the correct places by the ashes to be seen there. You will need to construct a small ship by using an axe upon logs in this area, then add the bones of a long dead barbarian hero. From the caverns beneath this lake. Many of our ancestors travelled to these caverns in order to hunt for glory and found only death. Their bones must still lie inside, their spirits trapped in torment. The spirit will ascend to glory, the pyre will send the earthly remains to the depths. You will also obtain a closer link to the spirit world. During this heightened contact, any bones you bury will have increased importance to the gods. The number of bones that may be buried, before the link fades, is increased with the difficulty of obtaining the wood which you use. I have little knowledge of the caverns, they are blocked from the sight of the spirits with whom I commune. I can only suspect that whatever slew barbarian heroes is indeed mighty. I would also suggest that these bones might well be very uncommon, since heroes are not found in vast numbers. Good luck. Dive into the whirlpool in the lake to the east. The spirits will use their abilities to ensure you arrive in the correct location, though their influence fades so you must find your own way out.'
translation: '下一阶段相当复杂，仔细听好。为了将祖先送入灵魂世界，他们的凡人之躯必须经过适当仪式焚烧。这只能在湖岸边靠近水的地方进行，就在我们东北方。你会通过那里的灰烬认出正确位置。你需要用斧头在该区域处理原木建造一艘小船，然后放入一位早已逝去的野蛮人英雄的骨头。这些骨头来自湖底洞穴。许多祖先前往这些洞穴猎取荣耀，却只找到了死亡。他们的骨头一定还在里面，灵魂被困在痛苦中。灵魂将升入荣耀，火葬船将凡尘遗骸送入深渊。你也会与灵魂世界建立更紧密的联系。在这种高度接触期间，你埋葬的任何骨头对诸神都更为重要。在联系消退前可埋葬的骨头数量，会随着你所用木材的获取难度而增加。我对洞穴知之甚少，它们被遮蔽了，我沟通的灵魂也看不到。我只能猜测，杀死野蛮人英雄的东西确实强大。我还建议这些骨头可能非常稀有，因为英雄并非大量存在。祝你好运。跳入东边湖中的漩涡。灵魂会利用它们的能力确保你到达正确位置，不过它们的影响会消退，所以你必须自己找路出来。'

english: 'Hail to you, saviour of my ancestors. The spirits herald your presence with a spectral fanfare. On this great day you have my thanks, eternally. May you find riches while rescuing my spiritual ancestors in the caverns for many moons to come.'
translation: '向你致敬，我祖先的救星。灵魂以幽灵般的号角宣告你的到来。在这伟大的日子里，我永远感谢你。愿你在未来许多个月里，在洞穴中解救我的灵魂祖先时获得财富。'

english: Spirits laid to rest: <Num0>.
translation: 安息的灵魂：<Num0>。

english: 'The next step is to manufacture a one handed version of a spear, suitable for combat. Such a spear is known to us as a hasta. As you might suspect, our ways require greater understanding than is gained by simply looking at a weapon.
translation: '下一步是制作单手版本的长矛，适合战斗。这种长矛我们称之为短矛。如你所料，我们的方式需要比简单看一件武器更深入的理解。'

english: It is also the case that the process involves a differently- balanced spear.
translation: 而且这个过程涉及一种平衡不同的长矛。

english: Before you may use such a weapon in anger, you must make an example. Only then will you fully understand the poise and techniques involved. You may use our special anvil for this spear type too. As the ways of black and dragon spears are beyond our knowledge, however, these spears may not be created.'
translation: 在你愤怒地使用这种武器之前，你必须先制作一个样品。只有这样你才能完全理解其中的姿态和技巧。你也可以用我们的特殊铁砧制作这种长矛。不过由于黑色和龙金长矛的制作方法超出我们的知识范围，这些长矛无法制作。'

english: 'I see you have constructed your hasta, and are approaching readiness to live life to its fullest - that you may be a peaceful spirit when your time ends.'
translation: '我看到你制作了短矛，正接近充分享受生活的状态——这样当你生命终结时，就能成为平和的灵魂。'

english: Within the pages of this book you will find the secret to working the very elements themselves.
translation: 在这本书的书页中，你将找到操控元素本身的秘密。

english: Early in the fifth age, a new ore was discovered. This ore has a unique property of absorbing, transforming or focusing elemental energy. A workshop was erected close by to work this new material. The workshop was set up for artisans and inventors to be able to come and create devices made from the unique ore, found only in the village of the Seers.
translation: 在第五纪元早期，发现了一种新矿石。这种矿石具有吸收、转化或聚焦元素能量的独特性质。附近建立了一座工作室来加工这种新材料。工作室是为工匠和发明家设立的，让他们能来此用这种独特矿石制作装置，这种矿石只在先知村发现。

english: After some time of successful industry the true power of this ore became apparent, as greater and more powerful weapons were created. Realising the threat this posed, the magi of the time closed down the workshop and bound it under lock and key, also trying to destroy all knowledge of manufacturing processes. Yet this book remains and you may still find a way to enter the workshop within this leather bound volume.
translation: 经过一段时间的成功生产，这种矿石的真正力量变得明显，因为制造出了更强大更具威力的武器。当时的法师意识到这构成的威胁，关闭了工作室并将其锁好，还试图销毁所有制造工艺的知识。然而这本书留存了下来，你仍可能在这本皮革装订的书中找到进入工作室的方法。

english: This is the second book in a series which aims to preserve the knowledge gained by artisans of the early Fifth Age. A thorough grasp of the processes and techniques described in my earlier work, 'Book of the Elemental Shield', is necessary to comprehend the concepts involved in the more technical chapters of this book.
translation: 这是系列中的第二本书，旨在保存第五纪元早期工匠获得的知识。要理解本书中更具技术性章节所涉及的概念，必须透彻掌握我在早期著作《元素盾之书》中描述的工艺和技巧。

english: Some years following the original discovery of the elemental ore, further investigation was performed by a metallurgist called Vitruvius in collaboration with a freelance mage. Over the course of two years they did many tests on the ore and refined metal, aiming to optimise the process by which the metal was extracted from its impure ore. From the data they gathered, they discovered the optimum temperature and carbon/ore ratio for the production of elemental metal of the highest quality. The quality of the resulting metal was assessed on the basis of its ultimate tensile strength, hardness (as compared to a standard diamond-tipped probe), magical absorption capacity per unit mass, grain size and elastic deformation modulus. Their most significant discovery in this period, however, was the novel technique of 'priming' the ore.
translation: 在元素矿石最初发现几年后，一位名叫维特鲁维乌斯的冶金学家与一位自由法师合作进行了进一步研究。在两年时间里，他们对矿石和精炼金属做了许多测试，旨在优化从杂质矿石中提取金属的工艺。根据收集的数据，他们发现了生产最高品质元素金属的最佳温度和碳/矿石比例。所得金属的质量根据其极限抗拉强度、硬度（与标准钻石尖端探针相比）、单位质量魔法吸收容量、晶粒尺寸和弹性变形模量来评估。然而，他们在此期间最重要的发现是'预处理'矿石的新技术。

english: At the time, the significance of priming was not fully appreciated. However, the records kept by Vitruvius state that his apprentice, in an unsuccessful attempt to animate a small ingot of elemental metal as part of a student prank, accidentally instilled his entire consciousness into the primed ingot. An unfortunate side- effect of this process was to reduce the apprentice's body to a dead shell. Attempts to return his consciousness to his body were regrettably unsuccessful.
translation: 当时，预处理的重要性并未被充分认识。然而，维特鲁维乌斯保存的记录表明，他的学徒在一次学生恶作剧中试图赋予一小块元素金属锭生命，却意外地将自己的全部意识注入了预处理的金属锭中。这一过程的不幸副作用是将学徒的身体变成了空壳。试图将他的意识送回身体的尝试遗憾地失败了。

english: Vitruvius discovered that the mental energy was so firmly bound to the elemental metal that no dissipation was detectable. Similar experiments with unprimed bars initially yielded comparable results, but the mental energy quickly left the bars and dissipated within such a short period that no practical applications seemed feasible. However the primed elemental metal showed considerably more promise.
translation: 维特鲁维乌斯发现精神能量与元素金属结合得如此紧密，以至于无法检测到任何消散。对未预处理金属锭的类似实验最初产生了相似结果，但精神能量很快离开金属锭并在极短时间内消散，似乎没有实际应用可能。然而预处理的元素金属显示出相当大的前景。

english: Researchers have continued to use the terminology defined by Vitruvius for this field of study. In his own notebooks, Vitruvius referred to his preparation technique as 'priming', and he referred to his apprentice as 'Idiot'.
translation: 研究人员继续使用维特鲁维乌斯为这一研究领域定义的术语。在他自己的笔记本中，维特鲁维乌斯将他的制备技术称为'预处理'，而他将他的学徒称为'白痴'。

english: Ha ha ha! I don't think so. We need a real strongwoman - someone with muscles. An old friend of mine, Checkal, should be able to do all the heavy lifting.
translation: 哈哈哈！我不这么认为。我们需要一位真正的女强人——有肌肉的那种。我的老朋友切卡尔应该能承担所有重活。

english: Should not be a problem. This challenge is easy for a strongwoman.
translation: 应该不成问题。这个挑战对女强人来说轻而易举。

english: Round 1: What sign will you show?
translation: 第一轮：你要展示什么标志？

english: It's an old pillar with a disc shaped gap on one side. An inscription on it reads: 'The scarabs make their homes in the great halls below.'
translation: 这是一根古老的柱子，一侧有一个圆盘状的缝隙。上面刻着铭文：'圣甲虫在下方的大厅中筑巢。'

english: The chest has a seven digit lock. What would you like to enter?
translation: 宝箱有七位数的锁。你想输入什么？

english: You position the emblem, but nothing happens.
translation: 你放置了徽章，但什么也没发生。

english: The ticking stops and you hear a rumbling sound from somewhere nearby.
translation: 滴答声停止了，你听到附近某处传来隆隆声。

english: You give the Lily of the Elid to Zahur.
translation: 你把埃利河百合交给了扎胡尔。

english: You give the crate to the High Priest.
translation: 你把箱子交给了大祭司。

english: Since you seem interested in an adventure, you seem like the perfect man for the job!
translation: 既然你对冒险感兴趣，你看起来正是这份工作的完美人选！

english: Since you seem interested in an adventure, you seem like the perfect woman for the job!
translation: 既然你对冒险感兴趣，你看起来正是这份工作的完美人选！

english: ~ A treatise on Demons ~
translation: ~ 恶魔论 ~

english: ~~ Indexo ~~
Arcana : I
translation: 秘法：一

english: Instructo : II
translation: 教导：二

english: Defeati: III
translation: 击败：III

english: Enchanto : IIII
translation: 附魔：IIII

english: Arcana I: Use holy water to determine possession.
translation: 秘典一：用圣水判断是否被附身。

english: Slight appearance changes may be perceived when doused.
translation: 被泼洒时可能会有轻微的外观变化。

english: Ye legendary weapon Silverlight will help to defeat any demon by weakening it.
translation: 传说中的武器银光剑将助你削弱并击败任何恶魔。

english: Arcana II : Be wary of demons, who may have special forms of attack.
translation: 秘典二：警惕恶魔，它们可能有特殊的攻击方式。

english: Use an Octagram of Fire to confine unearthly creatures of the underworld - the perfect geometry confuses them.
translation: 使用火焰八角星阵来困住来自地下的超自然生物——完美的几何形状会让它们困惑。

english: Eximus
translation: 埃克西姆斯

english: Instructo : Creation of holy water must be undertaken with determination and urgency.
translation: 指导：制作圣水必须坚定且迅速。

english: You must use empty vials, free of all liquids.
translation: 你必须使用空瓶，确保不含任何液体。

english: Read warily the enchantment contained herewithin in order to magick the vial for the holding of holy or sacred water.
translation: 仔细阅读其中所载的附魔咒语，以便为盛放圣水的小瓶施以魔法。

english: Take utmost care as you enchant them.
translation: 施法时要格外小心。

english: With great care and precision place the sacred water into a magicked vial and stopper it.
translation: 以极大的谨慎和精确度将圣水倒入施过魔法的小瓶中并塞紧。

english: Defeati... the dreaded demon will be of unholy power and abilities.
translation: 击败……那可怕的恶魔将拥有邪恶的力量和能力。

english: Present yourself before the possessed with good intent and ready manner.
translation: 带着善意和准备好的姿态出现在被附身者面前。

english: With least obstruction and utmost solemnity hold open the pages of this great tome in order that the good light falls upon the victim completely.
translation: 以最少的阻碍和最庄严的态度翻开这本巨著的书页，让圣光完全照在受害者身上。

english: Be prepared in every capacity, for the demon's tricks and wiles will swiftly outwit the unready adventurer.
translation: 做好万全准备，因为恶魔的诡计和花招会迅速击败毫无准备的冒险者。

english: Attack with vigour and zest if you hope to see another day.
translation: 若想见到明天的太阳，就要充满活力地攻击。

english: Enchanto...
translation: 附魔……

english: Possessus valius emptious, projectus spellicus avoir valius magicus.
translation: 空瓶附身咒，投射魔法瓶。

english: Castus enchanto avoir createur valius magicus holious avour defeati Demonicus Absolutus.
translation: 施法附魔创造圣水之瓶，以击败绝对恶魔。

english: Extralias projectus Magicus Holarius
translation: 额外投射圣水魔法

english: Attackanie Demonicus Absolutus distancie airus throwus armiues.
translation: 远程攻击绝对恶魔，投掷武器。

english: Sandy Sand's Corp - Brimhaven
translation: 桑迪·桑德公司 - 布尔哈文镇

english: Bert's Rota - Copy
translation: 伯特的轮班表 - 副本

english: ...and rest like your mother who is silent in the peace of her tomb far to the North of Ah Za Rhoon. Near the sea, and under the hills deep in the underground to watch all nature from the darkness of her final resting place.
translation: ……安息吧，如同你沉默的母亲，在阿扎鲁恩以北的坟墓中安详。靠近大海，在丘陵之下，深入地底，在永恒的黑暗中守望自然。

english: ...the sphere is activated when power of a spiritual nature is expended upon it, this can be very draining on the body...
translation: ……当精神力量施加于球体时，它会被激活，这可能会对身体造成极大的消耗……

english: ...Rashiliyia did so love objects of beauty. Her tomb was adorned with crystals that glowed brightly when near to each other.
translation: ……拉希利娅确实喜爱美丽之物。她的坟墓装饰着水晶，彼此靠近时会发出明亮的光芒。

english: In my travels, I have witnessed many explosive creations. One of particular note, is fire oil. Used in the far east, fire oil has an incredible explosive capability. However, it also sticks to anything it touches.
translation: 在我的旅行中，我见证了许多爆炸性发明。其中特别值得一提的是火油。在远东地区使用，火油具有惊人的爆炸能力。然而，它也会粘附在任何接触到的物体上。

english: The following pages detail the required ingredients to create fire oil, along with the process of combining them.
translation: 接下来的书页详细记载了制作火油所需的材料以及混合它们的过程。

english: This is a highly caustic compound. It is created by the endothermic reaction of heating limestone. Ensure it is crushed before use. To avoid bodily harm, suitable containers and hand protection should be used.
translation: 这是一种高度腐蚀性的化合物。它通过加热石灰石的吸热反应制成。使用前务必将其粉碎。为避免身体伤害，应使用合适的容器和手部防护。

english: Also known as yellow crystals. Odorless, insoluble and brittle as a solid. But as gas, quite toxic, preventing respiration. Like quicklime, it should be crushed before use.
translation: 又称黄色水晶。无味、不溶于水，固态时易碎。但作为气体，毒性很强，会阻碍呼吸。与生石灰一样，使用前应将其粉碎。

english: A colourless, flammable solvent. One of the more volatile fractions of the fractional distillation of coal tar.
translation: 一种无色、易燃的溶剂。是煤焦油分馏中较易挥发的成分之一。

english: The quicklime, sulphur, naphtha and can be mixed at any time. A large container, such as a barrel, is recommended for holding them in.
translation: 生石灰、硫磺、石脑油可以随时混合。建议使用大容器，如木桶，来盛放它们。

english: Once combined, exposure to a naked flame will result in an instant reaction so great care must be taken. A fuse of some sort should be used to provide a suitable delay.
translation: 一旦混合，接触明火将立即引发反应，因此必须格外小心。应使用某种引信来提供适当的延迟。

english: This tropical bird is typically found in dense jungle areas. Subtlety is not one of its strong points with its striking red plumage ensuring it will be visible wherever it goes. This makes it a popular first bird for hunters and spotters alike.
translation: 这种热带鸟类通常生活在茂密丛林地区。它鲜艳的红色羽毛使其无论走到哪里都显而易见，低调不是它的强项。这使它成为猎人和观察者都喜爱的入门鸟类。

english: This polar bird, found in the far Northern regions, can survive at impressively low temperatures. Although its long tail affords it great manoeuvrability, it is also the cause of a great deal of interest from collectors.
translation: 这种极地鸟类生活在遥远的北方地区，能在极低的温度下生存。虽然它的长尾巴赋予了它出色的机动性，但也引起了收藏家们的极大兴趣。

english: The golden warbler can be easily identified by its hideously annoying song. Although the warbler is prized by hunters for its fine feathers, it is probably caught just as much simply to shut it up.
translation: 金黄莺可以通过其极其烦人的歌声轻易辨认。虽然莺因其精美的羽毛而受到猎人的珍视，但捕捉它可能同样只是为了让它闭嘴。

english: This beautiful bird can be found in hot jungle climates where it expertly catches small insects for food. It is perhaps therefore ironic that it is usually caught for its bright plumage, which can be used in turn to make excellent fly fishing lures.
translation: 这种美丽的鸟类生活在炎热的丛林气候中，擅长捕捉小昆虫为食。因此，讽刺的是，它通常因其鲜艳的羽毛而被捕获，这些羽毛可以用来制作极好的飞钓诱饵。

english: The copper longtail is found in temperate wooded regions and is one of the most common birds in the world. Although its appearance is unremarkable it is a graceful and successful bird that continues to fend well for itself.
translation: 铜长尾鸟生活在温带林地，是世界上最常见的鸟类之一。虽然外表平平无奇，但它是一种优雅而成功的鸟类，一直很好地生存着。

english: Little is known about the giant eagles. There are reported sightings in many parts of the world, but the nests of these magnificent creatures remain elusive. The only record of such a nest being found is in the folk tale of the bandits of the golden claw. It is said that the bandits leader could talk to and befriend the eagles, and used the eagles' nest at the top of what is now known as eagles' peak as a hideout. The story goes on to hint at a secret entrance to the hideaway existing near the peak of the mountain, but until this day it has not been found.
translation: 关于巨鹰，人们知之甚少。世界各地都有目击报告，但这些雄伟生物的巢穴仍然难以寻觅。唯一一次发现此类巢穴的记录出现在金爪强盗的民间传说中。据说强盗首领能与巨鹰交谈并成为朋友，并将巨鹰巢穴用作藏身之处，就在如今被称为鹰峰的山顶上。故事还暗示在靠近山顶的地方有一条通往藏身处的秘密入口，但至今仍未被人发现。

english: An evil has swept into our lands and we have been called to protect the weak, but we are vastly outnumbered. The healing came easy when my belief wasn't waning, when our lands were not beset by the beautiful rot of chaos.
translation: 一股邪恶席卷了我们的土地，我们被召唤来保护弱者，但敌众我寡。当我的信仰未曾动摇、当我们的土地未被混沌的美丽腐朽所侵扰时，治疗来得轻而易举。

english: The horde have magics and morals well beyond ours. They drain the life from their victims and embrace the darkness that heals them of their wounds, while the light of Saradomin forbids us of such heinous acts.
translation: 那群乌合之众的魔法和道德都远超我们。他们吸取受害者的生命，拥抱治愈伤口的黑暗，而萨拉多明的光芒禁止我们做出如此卑劣的行径。

english: We stand beaten, bloody and bruised from another conflict with the enemy. Their ferocity knowing no bounds as we pile the dead by the dozen onto the carts. Amongst the dead I found a version of the Senntisten Scriptures, mostly damaged beyond recognition, but I got enough to understand the basics of blood magic.
translation: 在与敌人的又一次冲突中，我们被打得遍体鳞伤、血流不止。他们的凶残毫无止境，我们成打成打地将死者堆上马车。在死者中，我找到了一份《森特斯坦经文》的版本，大部分已损坏得无法辨认，但我从中获得了足够的信息来理解血魔法的基础。

english: I have found it! By using blood with various potions, I've managed to bind together the offensive and defensive properties. Early prototypes were harmful to ingest, but that no longer seems to be an issue.
translation: 我找到了！通过将血液与各种药水结合，我成功地将攻击和防御属性融合在一起。早期的原型服用后有害，但这似乎不再是问题了。

english: A strong mix of ranged and defence, perfect for an archer in a rough situation.
translation: 远程与防御的强力结合，非常适合身处险境的弓箭手。

english: - 1 pint of boiled blood
translation: - 1品脱煮沸的血液

english: - 1 cadantine sprig
translation: - 1枝卡丹丁草

english: - 2 pints of Zamorakian wine
translation: - 2品脱扎莫拉基安葡萄酒

english: Note: Recent victories have provided us with copious crates of this unholy liquor. The sweet taste has been... difficult to resist.
translation: 备注：近期的胜利为我们提供了大量这种亵渎神明的酒。那甜美的味道……实在难以抗拒。

english: A bright mix of magic and defence, perfect for a wizard in a tough situation.
translation: 魔法与防御的明亮结合，非常适合身处困境的魔法师。

english: - 1 potato cactus.
translation: - 1个土豆仙人掌

english: Note: Potato cactus stock alarmingly low, shipments from the Kharidian desert have been lacking as of late.
translation: 备注：土豆仙人掌库存低得惊人，近期来自卡里迪安沙漠的货运一直短缺。

english: Totality Potion
translation: 全能药水

english: An overload of everything, but not too much to cause harm to one's innards.
translation: 包罗万象的强化，但又不会过度伤害人的内脏。

english: - 1 super combat potion
translation: - 1瓶超级战斗药水

english: - 1 ranging potion
translation: - 1瓶远程药水

english: - 1 magic potion
translation: - 1瓶魔法药水

english: - 1 torstol sprig
translation: - 1枝托斯托尔草

english: Note: Unstable, currently too dangerous to make, let alone drink.
translation: 备注：不稳定，目前制作太危险，更不用说饮用了。

english: Vigour Potion
translation: 活力药水

english: A faithful combination of piety and stamina.
translation: 虔诚与体力的忠实结合。

english: - 1 ranarr sprig
translation: - 1枝兰纳尔草

english: - 1 amylase crystal
translation: - 1颗淀粉酶结晶

english: Note: Ingredients ran out before results were satisfactory, something is missing.
translation: 备注：在结果令人满意之前原料就用完了，还缺少某种东西。

english: In my travels throughout the Shining Kingdom, I have bested many mighty creatures. From the Colossal Wyrm of the Avium Savannah to the Cloud Titan of Tempestus, I am proud to proclaim myself as a master slayer.
translation: 在光辉王国的旅途中，我击败了许多强大的生物。从阿维乌姆草原的巨蛇龙到坦佩斯图斯的云之泰坦，我自豪地宣称自己是一位大师级杀戮者。

english: However, I have received news back home from a dear friend that the War of the Five Houses has ended, and I believe it is about time I return to Kourend. The war started from some petty squabble between the lords and ladies of the five Houses, and I do not regret leaving at all. My expertise lies in killing monsters, not my fellow man.
translation: 然而，我收到了一位挚友从家乡传来的消息，五大家族之战已经结束，我想是时候返回库兰德王国了。这场战争始于五大家族领主和贵妇们之间的一些琐碎争吵，我完全不后悔离开。我的专长是猎杀怪物，而不是同类。

english: I shall sail to Land's End once night falls.
translation: 夜幕降临时，我将乘船前往兰兹角村。

english: The trip back to Kourend was strangely quiet, as if the waves were intent on getting me home safely. I decide to set up camp in the woodlands before I return to Hosidius.
translation: 返回库兰德的旅程出奇地平静，仿佛海浪有意要让我安全回家。我决定在返回霍西迪乌斯城之前，先在林地中扎营。

english: I wonder if my parents are still alive; did they survive the war? If they did, would they be glad to see me after all these years? I did not leave on the best terms, after all. They wished for me to remain a farmhand, while I was ambitious to go on my own adventures. They were not happy when they caught me leaving home in the middle of the night.
translation: 我想知道父母是否还活着；他们挺过战争了吗？如果活着，这么多年后他们会高兴见到我吗？毕竟我离开时关系并不好。他们希望我继续做农场工人，而我却渴望去冒险。当他们半夜发现我离家出走时，非常不高兴。

english: Somehow, even after the ravages of war, my old home remained intact, though the farm seems to have become much smaller. My mother was shocked to see me return, despite our last encounter. She told me father survived the war, but she tells me since its end, there have been abductions occurring in the middle of the night, and father was just abducted the night before my return.
translation: 不知为何，即使经历了战争的摧残，我的老家仍然完好无损，尽管农场似乎变小了许多。母亲看到我回来非常震惊，尽管我们上次见面并不愉快。她告诉我父亲挺过了战争，但她说战争结束后，半夜经常发生绑架事件，而父亲就在我回来的前一天晚上被绑架了。

english: Furthermore, she managed to strike the assailant with her kitchen knife, and tells me the blood was jet black. I have no doubts about it. The magic keeping the monsters in the Catacombs has begun to waver, and demons have begun to climb to the surface, abducting innocents.
translation: 此外，她用厨刀击中了袭击者，并告诉我那血是漆黑的。我毫不怀疑。维持地下墓穴中怪物封印的魔法已经开始动摇，恶魔开始爬上地表，绑架无辜者。

english: I shall travel to Arceuus and investigate these occurrences.
translation: 我将前往阿西乌斯城调查这些事件。

english: While I make my way to a remote entrance to the Catacombs, I look back on my jet black sword I acquired during my travels in Varlamore. I recall encountering a particularly nasty demon capable of summoning torrential rainstorms in the Avium Savannah.
translation: 在我前往地下墓穴一个偏僻入口的路上，我回想起了在瓦拉莫尔旅行时获得的那把黑铁剑。我记得在阿维乌姆草原遇到过一个特别凶恶的恶魔，能够召唤倾盆大雨。

english: Using this silver sword, I slayed the demon with ease, but not before its blood permanently stained my sword black.
translation: 用这把银剑，我轻松地杀死了那个恶魔，但它的血液也永久地将我的剑染成了黑色。

english: I may have use for this sword now.
translation: 现在这把剑也许能派上用场。

english: Entering the Demon's Run, I find the Catacombs littered with dark, purple crystals, as if the creatures within broke them off into small shards for one reason or another. These shards seem to gravitate towards my sword like a magnet, as if wanting to be fused with it, but somehow unable to. I quickly shave them off my sword, believing it might dampen the sword's power.
translation: 进入恶魔之路，我发现地下墓穴里散落着深紫色的水晶，仿佛里面的生物出于某种原因将它们打碎成小碎片。这些碎片像被磁铁吸引一样朝我的剑聚拢，仿佛想要与之融合，但不知为何又无法做到。我迅速将它们从剑上刮掉，认为这可能会削弱剑的力量。

english: Further into the Catacombs, I managed to slay several demons. One of them carried a particularly odd object, appearing to be a key of sorts, and oozes with the same power from the Dark Altar.
translation: 深入地下墓穴后，我成功击杀了几只恶魔。其中一只携带了一件特别奇怪的物品，看起来像某种钥匙，散发着与黑暗祭坛相同的能量。

english: The key pulls me toward the centre of the Catacombs, where I saw a small altar with three prongs. Here, the key pulled even stronger towards it. Perhaps I am meant to place the key on this altar?
translation: 这把钥匙将我引向地下墓穴的中心，那里有一个带三个叉的小祭坛。在这里，钥匙被吸引得更加强烈。也许我应该把这把钥匙放在祭坛上？

english: For now, I shall return to Arceuus and rest before trying to place that key.
translation: 现在，我该回到阿西乌斯城休息一下，然后再试着放置那把钥匙。

english: I have made a big mistake.
translation: 我犯了一个大错。

english: I placed the key and was teleported into a large, empty chamber. I thought myself alone, until a large, dark demon made its presence known to me. I stabbed it with my sword, but it seemed to have no effect. Did the shards weaken it after all? Or was it too powerful for the sword to harm it? Before I could gather my thoughts, the demon grabbed me and threw me across the chamber, breaking my spine.
translation: 我放置了钥匙，被传送到了一个巨大而空旷的密室。我以为只有我一个人，直到一个巨大的黑暗恶魔现身。我用剑刺向它，但似乎毫无效果。那些碎片到底有没有削弱它？还是它太强大了，剑根本伤不了它？还没等我回过神来，恶魔抓住我，把我扔到密室另一边，摔断了我的脊椎。

english: Before it could reach me, I spotted a portal in the corner of the room. I did not care where it led me, as long as it was far away from that demon.
translation: 在它追上我之前，我看到了房间角落里的一个传送门。我不在乎它通向哪里，只要远离那个恶魔就行。

english: I ended up right here, by the altar where I had placed that key. I continue to write in my diary, hoping someone would come to rescue me.
translation: 我最终落在了这里，就在我放置钥匙的祭坛旁。我继续写日记，希望有人能来救我。

english: Look at me. A mighty adventurer, mortally wounded by that damned demon. As I feel myself slipping away, I continue to wonder. Why did those shards try attaching itself to my black sword? Perhaps they wished to empower the sword, rather than weaken it? I guess I'll never know.
translation: 看看我。一个强大的冒险者，被那个该死的恶魔致命伤。当我感觉生命在流逝时，我仍在思考。为什么那些碎片试图附着在我的黑铁剑上？也许它们是想增强剑的力量，而不是削弱它？我想我永远不会知道了。

english: Ruins of Flamtaer by Acolyte Otrava
translation: 弗拉姆塔尔废墟，奥特拉瓦侍僧著

english: Ruins of Flamtaer
translation: 弗拉姆塔尔废墟

english: On my travels today I ventured quite far into the Humblethorn forest and came across a strange tree that lived within a dark ruin. It was a hollow tree, the largest I'd ever seen and the only one this far south. It was said that they were hollow for an immense energy flowed through them which could be harnessed by skilled Zarosian warlocks. Even if that were true, this one clearly had its energy taken already for the trunk had burst open revealing its dark cavernous interior.
translation: 今天的旅途中，我深入了谦荆棘森林，遇到了一棵生长在黑暗废墟中的奇异树木。那是一棵空心树，是我见过最大的，也是这片南方地区唯一的一棵。据说它们之所以空心，是因为有巨大的能量在其中流动，可以被技艺高超的扎罗西亚术士所利用。即使那是真的，这棵树的能量显然已经被取走了，因为树干已经爆裂开来，露出了黑暗的洞穴状内部。

english: I sat there observing the tree when the strangest thing happened - it spoke. A gnarled old voice croaked out in fear at me. 'Blood and ashes! The chaotic horde approaches!'. At first I figured it was some type of cruel joke, clearly there must be a man sitting within the tree, hiding from sight. That, however, was not the case, the tree was incredibly empty and the voice continued to speak with me.
translation: 我坐在那里观察这棵树，这时最奇怪的事情发生了——它开口说话了。一个苍老沙哑的声音恐惧地对我嘶哑地说：'血与灰烬！混沌大军来了！'起初我以为这是某种残忍的玩笑，显然树里一定藏着一个人。但事实并非如此，树里空无一物，而那个声音继续与我交谈。

english: It's clear that the bark of the hollow tree retains magic incredibly well - the tree agrees with me on such matters. I've also been experimenting lately with the silk that can be harvested from bloodworms. My teachers say playing with such foul creatures can leave a shadow on your soul but I firmly believe we're missing out on a wealth of healing knowledge. The silk is much like the bark from the hollow tree, it holds a spell well. The tree might be of more help if it keeps speaking, I shall return to it at once.
translation: 很明显，空心树的树皮能极好地保留魔法——树也同意我的看法。我最近也在试验从血虫身上采集的丝绸。我的老师们说玩弄这种污秽的生物会在灵魂上留下阴影，但我坚信我们错过了一笔丰富的治疗知识。这种丝绸很像空心树的树皮，能很好地承载法术。如果这棵树继续说话，它可能会更有帮助，我马上回去找它。

english: The more I visit the tree, the more it speaks so I've thought up a new name - the Chatter Tree. Today it told me of its old home of Kharyrll that was recently destroyed. I corrected the tree of course, the fortress still stands but it wouldn't listen. After that it started to whisper about an old binding spell I should know but the magic is strange and utilised only by the dark Zarosian warlocks and outlawed for followers of Saradomin. The Chatter Tree insisted I was to write it down even if I don't plan to use it.
translation: 我去看那棵树的次数越多，它说得就越多，所以我想了个新名字——喋喋树。今天它告诉我它位于卡里尔的老家最近被毁了。我当然纠正了它，那座堡垒还在，但它不听。之后它开始低声说起一个我应该知道的古老束缚咒语，但那魔法很奇怪，只有黑暗的扎罗西亚术士才会使用，对萨拉多明的信徒来说是被禁止的。喋喋树坚持让我把它写下来，即使我不打算使用它。

english: News came today from the north - the tree had predicted the fall of Kharyrll, how could this be? I went back to the Chatter Tree as I needed answers. I took the ingredients for the binding spell, it seemed this might have been why he gave it to me. The magic required a large quantity of blood which was going to be difficult to acquire until I remembered the bloodworms.
translation: 今天从北方传来消息——树预言了卡里尔的陷落，这怎么可能？我回到喋喋树那里，因为我需要答案。我带了束缚咒语的材料，看来这可能就是它给我咒语的原因。这个魔法需要大量的血，这很难获取，直到我想起了血虫。

english: I approached the tree during dusk and was surprised to find within it slept a man that looked to be a dishevelled warlock, his robes were covered in Zarosian symbols. A whisper on the wind recited the binding spell and I began to echo it as I placed the sack of bloodworms into the arms of the sleeping man. I awoke the next morning leaning against the tree, the hole where the man had slept had disappeared and in its place was a hideous smile. No more chatter came from the tree now that its mouth had closed, only a faint whispering could be heard in the wind.
translation: 黄昏时分我走近那棵树，惊讶地发现里面睡着一个看起来邋遢的术士，他的长袍上满是扎罗西亚的符号。风中传来低语，念着束缚咒语，我一边把装满血虫的麻袋放进熟睡者的手臂中，一边跟着念。第二天早上我醒来时靠在树上，那人睡过的洞已经消失了，取而代之的是一个可怕的微笑。现在树的嘴闭上了，不再有喋喋声，只有风中隐约的低语。

translation: 你获得了一件节日物品：狮子玩具

english: You've received a holiday item: Tiger toy
translation: 你获得了一件节日物品：老虎玩具

english: You already have an axe in your inventory.
translation: 你的背包里已经有一把斧头了。

english: You need 25 stone rocks to build this stage of the bridge. Mine some nearby.
translation: 建造桥的这一阶段需要25块石头。在附近开采一些。

english: You need a hammer to be able to build the bridge.
translation: 你需要一把锤子才能建造桥。

translation: 你找到了一颗草籽。把它种在种植区以帮助恢复狮子栖息地。

translation: 你检查草是否有病害迹象，发现它非常健康。

translation: 你帮助恢复了狮子栖息地。

translation: 你开始搜索树木。

translation: 你找到了一颗松树种子。把它种在种植区以帮助恢复东北豹栖息地。

translation: 你在苗圃里种下了一颗松树种子。

translation: 你砍倒了枯树。

translation: 你检查树木是否有病害迹象，发现它非常健康。

english: You have helped to restore the amur leopard habitat.
translation: 你帮助恢复了东北豹栖息地。

english: You need some sturdy wood to fix this fence. An oak log would work well.
translation: 你需要一些坚固的木材来修理这个栅栏。橡木原木应该很合适。

english: You repair the fence and help maintain the snow leopard habitat.
translation: 你修理了栅栏，帮助维护了雪豹栖息地。

english: Warning! Your Amulet of blood fury is nearly at maximum capacity and will be capped at 30,000 hits.
translation: 警告！你的鲜血愤怒护符即将达到最大容量，将被限制在30000次命中。

english: Recharge anyway?
translation: 仍然要充能吗？

english: You have successfully added <Num0> hits to your Amulet of blood fury. It will now work for 30,000 more hits.
translation: 你成功地为鲜血愤怒护符添加了<Num0>次命中。现在它还能再使用30000次。

english: One that lets me travel, but not fight.
translation: 一个能让我旅行但不能战斗的。

english: Three that are needed to grab, but not weaken.
translation: 三个用来抓取但不能虚弱的。

english: One that doesn't make fruit, but instead makes gold.
translation: 一个不结水果，反而结金子的。

english: Why, naturally, that's no problem for someone with such a keen interest in expanding their knowledge!
translation: 当然，对一位如此热衷于拓展知识的人来说，这根本不是问题！

english: ...You heat the gold bar to a liquid state...
translation: ...你将金锭加热至液态...

english: ...You pour it into your cannonball mould...
translation: ...你将其倒入炮弹模具中...

english: ...You then leave it to cool for a short while.
translation: ...然后你让它冷却片刻。

english: You make one beautiful golden cannonball.
translation: 你制作出一颗漂亮的黄金炮弹。

english: You have no space in your inventory and drop the schematic on the ground.
translation: 你的背包没有空间，只好把示意图丢在地上。

english: You can't carry the schematic and drop it on the ground.
translation: 你拿不动示意图，只好把它丢在地上。

english: The world turns black and you feel as if you're being sucked out of the rock.
translation: 世界陷入黑暗，你感觉自己正被从岩石中吸出。

english: The helmet seems to become even heavier
translation: 头盔似乎变得更重了。

english: You feel a headache coming on... oh wait, it's just your helmet.
translation: 你感觉头痛欲裂...哦等等，只是你的头盔。

english: You feel like you're being pushed into the ground by the weight of the golden helmet.
translation: 你感觉金头盔的重量要把你压进地里。

english: You stumble and nearly fall. You can only keep this helmet on for a few more minutes!
translation: 你踉跄了一下，差点摔倒。这头盔你只能再戴几分钟了！

english: You fight the urge to take off your helmet. It's getting harder and harder to resist!
translation: 你强忍着摘掉头盔的冲动。越来越难以抵抗了！

english: You don't think you can keep on this helmet for more than a minute. Whatever you want to accomplish here, do it fast!
translation: 你觉得这头盔你撑不过一分钟。不管你想在这里做什么，快点！

english: Must... not... take... off... helmet!
translation: 必须...不能...摘...头盔！

english: The weight of the helmet is becoming unbearable. You can't keep it on for more than a few seconds now!
translation: 头盔的重量变得难以忍受。你现在只能再撑几秒钟了！

english: Just as you feel your neck is about to snap, you take off your helmet.
translation: 就在你感觉脖子快要断掉时，你摘下了头盔。

english: Dondakan tried to hand you a rune pickaxe, but you dropped it on the ground.
translation: 东达坎想递给你一把符文镐，但你把它掉在了地上。

english: It looks like there might be something behind this blockage. You might be able to mine through it.
translation: 看起来这堵塞物后面可能有什么东西。你或许可以挖穿它。

english: Rat pit fighting is dangerous for the ill prepared. Lots of cats have died taking part in the past and many more will surely die in the future. This needless death can be avoided completely by adopting the correct precautions.
translation: 老鼠坑斗对准备不足的人来说很危险。过去有很多猫在参与中丧生，未来还会有更多。这种无谓的死亡完全可以通过采取正确的预防措施来避免。

english: The aim of rat pit fighting is to train your cat in a fun and profitable manner. Rules vary from pit to pit.
translation: 老鼠坑斗的目的是以有趣且有利可图的方式训练你的猫。规则因坑而异。

english: Each pit allows a certain type of cat fight there e.g. the Ardougne pit only permits kittens to fight in it.
translation: 每个坑允许特定类型的猫参加战斗，例如阿多尼城的坑只允许小猫参加。

english: To compete you must have the correct type of cat for the pit and have some spare change. If you have both of these, you can then challenge another cat trainer.
translation: 要参赛，你必须拥有适合该坑的猫，并带些零钱。如果两者都具备，你就可以挑战另一位训猫师。

english: The player you challenge must also possess the correct type of cat and some money.
translation: 你挑战的玩家也必须拥有合适的猫和一些钱。

english: Before you proceed to the bidding stage tactics should be discussed with your cat.
translation: 在进入出价阶段之前，应该与你的猫讨论战术。

english: A player should tell their cat what sort of strategy they should adopt. To do this competitors should wear an amulet of catspeak when initiating a fight and accepting a challenge.
translation: 玩家应告诉他们的猫该采取什么策略。为此，参赛者在发起战斗和接受挑战时应佩戴猫语护身符。

english: Cautious tactics should be adopted by those who are unwilling to part with their cat.
translation: 不愿失去猫的人应采取谨慎的战术。

english: Using these tactics will aid the cat in terms of increased defence bonuses but penalise them as their cats will get out of the pits faster rather than risking death.
translation: 使用这些战术会提升猫的防御加成，但代价是它们的猫会更快退出坑而不是冒险送命。

english: Using no tactics or aggressive tactics will result in your cat fighting to the death. Aggressive tactics increase your cat's attack levels.
translation: 不使用战术或使用攻击性战术会导致你的猫战斗至死。攻击性战术会提升你猫的攻击等级。

english: Once a challenge has been accepted and both cats advised on tactics the bidding takes place.
translation: 一旦挑战被接受，双方猫都得到战术指示后，出价阶段开始。

english: Both owners can place a small wager on the outcome of the match. This wager must be the same for both sides.
translation: 双方主人可以对比赛结果下小注。双方的赌注必须相同。

english: Rules differ for each pit, in the kitten pits of Ardougne the first cat to kill 5 rats is declared the winner, this number varies throughout other pits.
translation: 每个坑的规则不同，在阿多尼城的小猫坑中，先杀死5只老鼠的猫被宣布为胜者，这个数字在其他坑中有所不同。

english: If your cat dies during a fight or runs away your opponent is declared the winner.
translation: 如果你的猫在战斗中死亡或逃跑，你的对手被宣布为胜者。

english: Cats tire quickly and after a certain period of time become too exhausted to continue fighting, in this case the cat with the largest number of kills is declared the winner.
translation: 猫很快就会疲劳，一段时间后会精疲力竭无法继续战斗，这种情况下，击杀数最多的猫被宣布为胜者。

english: If both cats have killed the same number of rats, the match is declared a draw.
translation: 如果两只猫杀死了相同数量的老鼠，比赛被宣布为平局。

english: Winning a rat pit fight increases cats' happiness, matures them faster, improves their hunting skills and keeps them more active.
translation: 赢得老鼠坑斗会增加猫的快乐度，加速成熟，提高狩猎技能并保持更活跃。

english: Even losing in a fight will benefit your cat (provided it doesn't die). As with everything in life, it's the taking part which matters.
translation: 即使输了比赛对你的猫也有好处（只要它没死）。就像生活中的一切，重在参与。

english: Arrav is probably the best known hero of the 4th age. Many legends are told of his heroics, most notably his role in the defence of Avarrocka against the zombie hordes of the Mahjarrat Zemouregal.
translation: 阿拉夫可能是第四纪元最著名的英雄。关于他的英勇事迹流传着许多传说，最著名的是他在保卫阿瓦罗卡抵御玛哈加特泽莫雷加尔的僵尸大军中所扮演的角色。

english: One surviving artefact from the 4th age is a fabulous shield. This shield is believed to have once belonged to Arrav and is now indeed known as the Shield of Arrav. For over 150 years it was the prize piece in the royal museum of Varrock.
translation: 第四纪元幸存下来的一件文物是一面精美的盾牌。这面盾牌据信曾属于阿拉夫，如今确实被称为阿拉夫之盾。150多年来，它一直是维洛克城皇家博物馆的珍品。

english: However, in the year 143 of the fifth age a gang of thieves called the Phoenix Gang broke into the museum and stole the shield in a daring raid. As a result, the current ruler, King Roald, put a 1200 gold bounty (a massive sum of money in those days) on the return of the shield, hoping that one of the culprits would betray his fellows out of greed.
translation: 然而，在第五纪元143年，一个名为凤凰帮的盗贼团伙闯入博物馆，在一次大胆的突袭中偷走了盾牌。因此，当时的统治者罗尔德国王悬赏1200金币（当时是一笔巨款）以求归还盾牌，希望其中一名罪犯会因贪婪而背叛同伙。

english: This tactic did not work however, and the thieves who stole the shield have since gone on to become the most powerful crime gang in Varrock, despite making an enemy of the Royal Family many years ago.
translation: 然而这一策略并未奏效，偷走盾牌的盗贼们此后成为了维洛克城最强大的犯罪团伙，尽管多年前他们就成了皇室的敌人。

english: The reward for the return of the shield still stands.
translation: 归还盾牌的赏金至今仍然有效。

english: The Little Book o' Piracy
translation: 《海盗之书》

english: Piracy; a life of adventure and romance. The stuff of legends and tales told all over the world. And you, humble reader, have decided to join these brave men and women in the exciting field of unlicensed privateering and wholesale plunder redistribution. I congratulate you on making the correct lifestyle choice.
translation: 海盗；一种充满冒险与浪漫的生活。是全世界传说与故事的主题。而你，谦逊的读者，已决定加入这些勇敢的男女，投身于无证私掠和全面掠夺再分配的激动人心的领域。我祝贺你做出了正确的人生选择。

english: While many consider pirates to be unwashed, ignorant, thieving brigands, the truth is that they are a valued and important part of the economy. Without them, the architects that design sea-defences against their attacks would be unemployed. The guards in sea ports would be laid off, and the honest merchants that buy their second-hand goods would lose a small portion of their income. So you see, by living a life filled with adventure, thievery, romance, plundering, danger and stealing, they are adding to the happiness of the community as a whole. Surely these brave individuals have nothing to be ashamed of for selling their hard-earned loot to respectable merchants in exchange for a reasonable sum of gold. I would go as far as to say it is their duty to redistribute such wealth that they come across in this way, so as to uphold the noble, ancient and profitable honour of the pirates.
translation: 虽然许多人认为海盗是不洁、无知、偷窃的匪徒，但事实是他们是经济中宝贵且重要的一部分。没有他们，设计抵御海盗袭击的海防建筑师就会失业。海港的守卫会被解雇，而购买他们二手货物的诚实商人也会失去一小部分收入。所以你看，通过过着充满冒险、偷窃、浪漫、掠夺、危险和盗窃的生活，他们为整个社区的幸福做出了贡献。这些勇敢的人将辛苦得来的战利品卖给体面的商人换取合理的金币，当然没有什么可羞愧的。我甚至要说，以这种方式重新分配他们遇到的财富是他们的责任，以维护海盗们崇高、古老且有利可图的荣誉。

english: First, to be recognised as a pirate, you have to look like a pirate. If you look like an accountant, then people will be confused when you begin talking about 'briny deep' this and 'plundering' that. It also saves time explaining at parties and other social gatherings exactly what you do for a living, allowing precious extra hours of plundering and looting. Pirates must look nautical. This look can be achieved by wearing trousers made from old sails, usually striped. You can also wear an old, tattered naval uniform, as this makes you look like you have been trained by the navy before you left for your own, dark and grim reasons. I suggest you come up with at least two good reasons why you left, as customs and excise tend to alert naval officials to 'deserters'.
translation: 首先，要被人认作海盗，你必须看起来像个海盗。如果你看起来像个会计，那么当你开始谈论'咸咸深海'和'掠夺'时，人们会感到困惑。这也省去了在派对和其他社交聚会上解释你谋生之道的宝贵时间，让你有更多时间进行掠夺和抢劫。海盗必须看起来有航海气息。这种造型可以通过穿着由旧帆制成的裤子来实现，通常有条纹。你也可以穿一件破旧的海军制服，这让你看起来像是在离开前受过海军训练，而离开的原因则黑暗而隐秘。我建议你至少想出两个离开的好理由，因为海关和税务部门往往会向海军官员通报'逃兵'。

english: Piracy is a dangerous profession, and can be hazardous to the pirates' extremities. Preventing such injuries with either a hand- covering hook or a patch to protect your eye is always a good plan. This also leaves you prepared for the eventual loss of the extremity, as you are already carrying a replacement around with you. Piratical accessories can also include (but are not limited to) cutlasses and scimitars, pirate hats, face masks, bandanas and flashy jewellery.
translation: 海盗是危险的职业，可能对海盗的肢体造成伤害。用钩子代替手或戴眼罩来保护眼睛来防止此类伤害总是一个好计划。这也让你为最终失去肢体做好了准备，因为你已经随身携带了替代品。海盗配饰还可以包括（但不限于）弯刀和弯月刀、海盗帽、面罩、头巾和闪亮的首饰。

english: Arr -> Good Morning/Hello/I agree.
translation: 啊！ -> 早上好/你好/我同意。

english: Scurvy -> 1.Disease contracted when sailing, caused by lack of fresh fruit and vegetables. Eg, 'Cap'n, the gunners be a bunch of scurvy dogs.'
translation: 坏血病 -> 1.航海时因缺乏新鲜水果和蔬菜而患上的疾病。例如，'船长，炮手们是一群坏血病的狗。'

english: 2.Inferior/untrustworthy. Eg, 'Cap'n, the gunners be a bunch of scurvy dogs.'
translation: 2.低劣/不可信赖。例如，'船长，炮手们是一群坏血病的狗。'

english: Cap'n -> Captain.
translation: 船长 -> 船长。

english: Plunder -> Anything of value that can be traded with any honest Al Kharidian merchants for a reasonable sum of money.
translation: 掠夺物 -> 任何有价值的物品，可以与任何诚实的阿尔卡里德城商人交易换取合理的金钱。

english: Landlubber -> Non-Pirate.
translation: 旱鸭子 -> 非海盗。

english: Garr! -> I am going to attack you/Take this!/It is time for fisticuffs and no mistake.
translation: 嘎！ -> 我要攻击你了/接招吧！/是时候拳脚相向了，没错。

english: I say we keelhaul 'em! -> I propose we do unpleasant things to them until they are dead, very sorry or both.
translation: 我说把他们拖龙骨！ -> 我提议对他们做不愉快的事，直到他们死去、非常抱歉或两者兼有。

english: Aye aye! -> I am in emphatic or otherwise exuberant agreement with your statement.
translation: 是的是的！ -> 我强烈或热情地同意你的说法。

english: Say that again and I'll kill ye! -> I deny the truth of your statement.
translation: 再说一遍我就杀了你！ -> 我否认你所说的话的真实性。

english: Want a sip of 'rum'? -> I would like to poison you.
translation: 想喝一口'朗姆酒'吗？ -> 我想给你下毒。

english: Grog -> Alcohol, with the exception of 'rum'.
translation: 格罗格酒 -> 酒精饮料，'朗姆酒'除外。

english: 'Rum' -> 1.Anything poisonous/Acidic or caustic substance.
translation: '朗姆酒' -> 1.任何有毒/酸性或腐蚀性物质。

english: 2. The concentrated, liquid form of all that is foul.
translation: 2.一切污秽之物的浓缩液体形态。

english: Go see Ali -> Travel to Al Kharid to sell loot and purchase top-quality products.
translation: 去找阿里 -> 前往阿尔卡里德城出售战利品并购买顶级商品。

english: Broadside -> 1.To fire all cannons on one side of the ship at the same time.
translation: 舷侧齐射 -> 1.同时发射船一侧的所有大炮。

english: 2.A pirate of great size.
translation: 2.体型巨大的海盗。

english: I'm not a pirate, I'm a privateer -> I am a pirate, and I'm getting paid for it.
translation: 我不是海盗，我是私掠者 -> 我是海盗，而且我为此得到报酬。

translation: 谈判 -> 我厌倦了生活，随时可以杀了我。

english: Widdershins -> A debilitating disease caused by eating mouldy biscuits for a month. Symptoms include weakness in the limbs, spinning vision, spontaneous combustion and implosion of the earlobes.
translation: 逆时针病 -> 一种因连续一个月吃发霉饼干而患上的衰弱性疾病。症状包括四肢无力、视物旋转、自燃和耳垂内爆。

english: Forbye -> A common greeting said (be)for(e) (good)bye. 'Forbye, Cap'n! Lovely day!'
translation: 再见好 -> 一种常见的问候语，在（说）再（见）之前说。'再见好，船长！天气真好！'

english: Hornswaggle -> To swaggle (or cover with soft cloth) the ship's horn (or compass) to keep it safe and dry during storms.
translation: 包裹号角 -> 用软布包裹船的号角（或指南针），以在暴风雨中保持其安全干燥。

english: Drivelswigger -> Small metal implement used for removing weevils from hard tack rations.
translation: 除虫器 -> 用于从硬饼干配给品中去除象鼻虫的小型金属工具。

english: Abaft -> Direct polar opposite of avast.
translation: 船尾 -> 与船首完全相反。

english: Binnacled -> Condition relating to the consumption of excessive quantities of cheap alcohol, or small quantities of 'rum'. 'Sound the alarm Mr Bosun, pirates off the starboard bow!' 'Not so loud Cap'n, I be feelin' a little binnacled.'
translation: 醉醺醺 -> 与过量饮用廉价酒精或少量'朗姆酒'有关的状况。'拉响警报吧水手长，船首右舷有海盗！' '别那么大声船长，我有点醉醺醺的。'

english: Duffle -> Somewhat like a seafaring goblin, only not.
translation: 达夫 -> 有点像航海哥布林，但又不完全是。

english: Athwartships -> A period spent apprenticed to a pirate, learning piracy, getting drunk, and culminating in the loss of a leg, eye or hand.
translation: 学徒期 -> 跟随海盗当学徒的时期，学习海盗技能，喝得酩酊大醉，最终以失去一条腿、一只眼睛或一只手告终。

english: Davy's Grip -> Popular drinking game involving mangoes, a hammer, and all the corkscrews that players can get their hands on.
translation: 戴维的格里普 -> 一种流行的饮酒游戏，涉及芒果、锤子和玩家能找到的所有开瓶器。

english: Although the Elder-dragons are generally considered to be a myth, stories tell of an ancient race that dwelt on Gielinor before any other. In some arcane way their lifeforce was linked to the life of the world itself; it is written that, as long as the Elder-dragons continue to live, the world shall not end.
translation: 虽然远古龙通常被认为是神话，但故事讲述了一个古老的种族在吉莱诺尔上先于任何其他种族居住。以某种神秘的方式，他们的生命力与世界本身的生命相连；据记载，只要远古龙继续存活，世界就不会终结。

english: However, sceptics claim that the myth of the Elder-dragons was invented to cast doubt on claims that this realm was lifeless until the gods first arrived.
translation: 然而，怀疑论者声称远古龙的神话是为了质疑这个世界在诸神到来之前是无生命的说法而编造的。

english: Book of Spyology written by T. Gure
translation: 《间谍学大全》由T.古尔著

english: I: The Art of Secrecy A spy's secrecy is their most deadly weapon.
translation: 第一章：保密之术 间谍的保密是他们最致命的武器。

english: I: The Art of Secrecy
translation: 一：保密之术

english: A spy's secrecy is their most deadly weapon.
translation: 间谍的保密是他们最致命的武器。

english: What good is your information if it is accessible to everyone?
translation: 如果你的信息人人都能获取，那还有什么用？

english: The latest methods of note encryption utilise the skills of magic and spycraft.
translation: 最新的笔记加密方法结合了魔法与间谍技巧。

english: By casting a special enchantment on your documents, they will become protected from prying eyes.
translation: 对你的文件施放特殊附魔后，它们将免受窥探。

english: To reveal the text on the document, a special un-enchantment ritual must be peformed.
translation: 要显现文件上的文字，必须执行特殊的解除附魔仪式。

english: You will need:
translation: 你需要：

english: Firstly, grind your lemon with the pestle and mortar and apply the juice to the enchanted parchment.
translation: 首先，用研钵和杵研磨柠檬，将汁液涂在附魔羊皮纸上。

english: Next, apply some light heat to the parchment. This is best carried out with a candle.
translation: 接着，对羊皮纸施加轻微热量，最好用蜡烛来完成。

english: Finally, the juice of ripe grapes must be applied to a brush and then lightly brushed over the parchment.
translation: 最后，将成熟葡萄的汁液涂在刷子上，然后轻轻刷过羊皮纸。

english: Once these steps have been performed, your notes will once again be visible.
translation: 完成这些步骤后，你的笔记将再次可见。

english: Many artefacts of elven history were lost after the Fourth Age, following the departure of the elves from these lands. The greatest loss to our collections of elf history were the hidden treasures of Baxtorian.
translation: 第四纪元后，精灵离开这片土地，许多精灵历史的文物就此失落。我们精灵历史收藏中最大的损失是巴克斯托里安的隐藏宝藏。

english: Some believe these treasures are still unclaimed, but it is more commonly believed that dwarf miners recovered them early in the Fifth Age.
translation: 有些人认为这些宝藏仍未被发现，但更普遍的说法是矮人矿工在第五纪元早期就找到了它们。

english: Another great loss was Glarial's pebble, a key which allowed her family to visit her tomb. The pebble was taken by a gnome family over a century ago. It is hoped that descendants of that gnome may still have the pebble hidden in their cave under the Tree Gnome Village.
translation: 另一大损失是格拉利尔的鹅卵石，这把钥匙能让她的家人前往她的坟墓。一个多世纪前，一个地精家族拿走了这块鹅卵石。希望那个地精的后代仍将鹅卵石藏在地精村庄下的洞穴中。

english: The love between Baxtorian and Glarial was said to have lasted over a century. They lived a peaceful life learning and teaching the laws of nature.
translation: 据说巴克斯托里安和格拉利尔的爱情持续了一个多世纪。他们过着平静的生活，学习并传授自然法则。

english: When trouble hit their home in the west, Baxtorian left on a great campaign. He returned to find his people slaughtered and his wife taken by the enemy.
translation: 当西方的家园遭遇变故时，巴克斯托里安踏上了伟大的征途。他归来时发现族人被屠杀，妻子被敌人掳走。

english: After years of searching for his love, he finally gave up and returned to the home he had made for Glarial under the Baxtorian Falls. Once he entered, he never returned.
translation: 经过多年的寻找，他最终放弃，回到了他在巴克斯托里安瀑布下为格拉利尔建造的家。他进去后，再也没有出来。

english: Only he and Glarial had the power to enter the waterfall. Since Baxtorian entered, no one else has been able to get in. It's as if the powers of nature still work to protect him.
translation: 只有他和格拉利尔有进入瀑布的力量。自从巴克斯托里安进入后，再也没有人能进去。仿佛自然之力仍在保护着他。

english: Glarial and Baxtorian were masters of nature. Trees would grow, hills form and rivers flood on their command.
translation: 格拉利尔和巴克斯托里安是自然的大师。树木随他们的命令生长，山丘成形，河流泛滥。

english: Baxtorian in particular had perfected rune lore. It was said that he could use the stones to control water, earth and air.
translation: 巴克斯托里安尤其精通符文知识。据说他能用石头控制水、土和空气。

english: A short piece written by Baxtorian himself.
translation: 巴克斯托里安亲笔写的一段短文。

translation: 这凡尘躯壳我何所惧，

english: I'll happily choke on your memory,
translation: 我愿在你的记忆中窒息而亡，

translation: 挥发性化学品 - 实验测试笔记。

translation: 不幸的是最后一种成分没有记录下来，但我们知道这一带有某种根茎，效果非常好……

english: Many are the rumours and tales surrounding this foul beast.
translation: 关于这头邪恶野兽的传闻和故事众多。

english: The earliest of these tales seems to date back to the time of the Mahjarrat. It is a story about a mad mage, who attempts to summon a demon and bind it to his will. Unfortunately his spell failed and all that appeared was one confused chicken. In a fit of anger at his failure the mage banished the chicken to the Abyss. The chicken however appears to have survived and grown in power. Years later, when the mage cast another spell of summoning, the chicken appeared! The story does not tell of what became of the mage.
translation: 这些故事中最早的可追溯到玛哈加特时代。故事讲述一位疯狂的法师试图召唤恶魔并将其束缚于自己的意志。不幸的是他的法术失败了，出现的只是一只困惑的鸡。法师一怒之下将鸡放逐到深渊。然而这只鸡似乎幸存下来并不断变强。多年后，当法师再次施展召唤法术时，那只鸡出现了！故事没有讲述法师后来的遭遇。

english: Another popular tale tells of a chicken of higher than average mental ability. Realising that it and its kind were prisoners in their coops he organised a rebellion against the human farmers. The farmers, of course, simply slaughtered the rebellious chickens. However, the Evil Chicken escaped. Blaming its brethren for the coup's failure it swore revenge on all chickens and all humans.
translation: 另一个广为流传的故事讲述了一只智力超群的鸡。它意识到自己和同类都是鸡舍里的囚徒，于是组织了一场反抗人类农民的起义。农民们当然毫不留情地屠杀了造反的鸡。然而，邪恶鸡逃脱了。它把起义失败归咎于同类，发誓要向所有鸡和所有人类复仇。

english: The Chicken can strike anybody, anywhere. It is said that a coven worships this fell fowl and have even built a shrine to it. The exact location of this shrine is unknown, but is rumoured to be in the fairyworlds. Further rumour suggests that his lair is guarded by some fearsome beasts, but it may be reached by making a tasty offering... whatever that may be.
translation: 这只鸡能袭击任何人，任何地方。据说有一个女巫集会崇拜这只邪恶的家禽，甚至为它建了一座神龛。神龛的确切位置无人知晓，但传闻在妖精世界。还有传言说它的巢穴由一些可怕的野兽守卫，但也许献上美味的供品就能到达……那供品是什么就不得而知了。

translation: 有色水

english: Mos Le'Harmless 'rum' is based loosely on the recipe fer Braindeath 'rum', with the main exception bein' that it is brewed from items found locally to the island.
translation: 莫斯勒哈姆斯岛'朗姆酒'大致基于脑死亡'朗姆酒'的配方，主要区别在于它是用岛上当地找到的材料酿造的。

english: Bitternuts be foul tastin' but highly intoxicatin' nuts found inside the brewin' compound. The trees they are in be too tall to climb, especially with all the action goin' on in the area. Hence, tis the best idea to capture a monkey, and put it up the tree to get the nut for ye. However, the monkey will need to be dyed the same colour as yer team, or confusion will arise. Fortunately, a bowl of coloured water from the kettle will colour the monkey with only mild scaldin'. Some people tell tales that they can talk to the monkeys and persuade them to pass them the nut faster. Admittedly they say you need a magic amulet, but then again that sounds a little far-fetched to me. It should also be noted that if someone puts a different coloured monkey up the tree, then the two monkeys will fight over which gets the bitternut.
translation: 苦坚果味道难闻但酒劲很大，生长在酿酒区内的树上。那些树太高爬不上去，尤其是周围还那么热闹。所以最好的办法是抓一只猴子，让它上树帮你摘坚果。不过，猴子得染成和你队伍一样的颜色，不然会搞混。幸运的是，从水壶里倒一碗有色水就能给猴子染色，只是会有点烫。有人说他们能和猴子说话，说服它们快点把坚果递过来。他们说需要一条魔法护身符，但我觉得这听起来有点不靠谱。还要注意，如果有人把不同颜色的猴子放上树，两只猴子会为了谁摘苦坚果而打起来。

english: Sweetgrubs be vicious little grubs that live in mounds inside the brewin' area. They will go fer any meat nearby, so tis best to grab some rat meat and lay it on the mound. The grubs be very sleepy after they have eaten, and ye'll be able te scoop them up after they have devoured the meat. To get the best results, one load of sweetgrubs be needed fer every bottle of rum.
translation: 甜虫是凶残的小虫子，住在酿酒区内的土堆里。它们会扑向附近的任何肉，所以最好弄点老鼠肉放在土堆上。虫子吃饱后会非常困，等它们吃完肉你就能把它们舀起来。为了获得最佳效果，每瓶朗姆酒需要一份甜虫。

english: Scrapey Tree Bark is added to give the mix a little more body. There be a few Scrapey Trees in the area that ye can go fer, all ye need is an axe. Take a knife te the logs, and that'll get the bark. Mind ye don't get nay of the sap on yer hands, as it carries an annoyin' little disease.
translation: 加入刮擦树树皮是为了让酒液更有口感。附近有几棵刮擦树可以砍，你只需要一把斧头。用刀处理原木就能得到树皮。小心别让树液沾到手上，那玩意儿携带一种烦人的小病。

english: The last two ingredients be the easiest to plunder; water from either the lake in the middle of the brewery compound, or from one of the pumps can be put into the correct hopper with nary a trouble. The coloured water be gained by placing the petals of rare flowers into a kettle of boilin' water. This leeches the colour from them, and the water can be siphoned off into bowls. It takes 5 buckets of water, and three bowls of coloured water to make one bottle of rum.
translation: 最后两种原料最容易获取；从酿酒区中间的湖里或者从某个泵里取水，倒进正确的料斗里毫无困难。有色水则是把稀有花朵的花瓣放进一壶沸水里煮出来的。这样能把颜色从花瓣中煮出来，然后可以把水舀进碗里。做一瓶朗姆酒需要5桶水和3碗有色水。

english: While ye'll need all these te make 'rum', ye'll also need to keep the boilers nice and hot. These are quite easy te feed. Just take some logs and put them in the boiler, then light them on fire with a tinderbox. Once it's burnin' it'll take up a few logs every now and again. So long as there are at least three burnin' then the 'rum' will be produced. It's always best to keep them fed though, as ye never know when they will run out.
translation: 虽然你需要所有这些来酿'朗姆酒'，还得让锅炉保持旺盛。这些锅炉很好喂。拿些原木放进锅炉，然后用火绒盒点燃。一旦烧起来，它会时不时消耗几根原木。只要至少有三个锅炉在烧，'朗姆酒'就能生产出来。不过最好一直喂着，因为你永远不知道它们什么时候会烧完。

english: Assumin' all the stuff is in the hoppers, and all the boilers are burnin' and all the pipes are nice and fixed, then the right amount of stuff will be taken out of the hoppers, and the brewin' will begin. This takes a little while te do, but not too long though. When it is done, the rum will pop out on the conveyor belt, and all ye have te do is pick it up and put it in the crate.
translation: 假设所有材料都在料斗里，所有锅炉都在燃烧，所有管道都修好了，那么适量的材料就会从料斗中取出，酿酒就开始了。这需要一点时间，但不会太久。完成后，朗姆酒会从传送带上出来，你只需要捡起来放进箱子里就行了。

english: However, it should be noted that if ye have not contributed enough to any bottle of rum, then you will not be able te collect it. To qualify, ye must add enough of any ingredient te the hoppers to make the light turn green. Hence, if ye add 5 buckets of water, ye qualify te collect 1 bottle, and if ye add five bitternuts, ye qualify fer 5. If ye add both, then ye qualify fer 6 bottles.
translation: 不过要注意，如果你对任何一瓶朗姆酒的贡献不够，就不能领取。要够格，你得往料斗里加足够的原料让灯变绿。所以，如果你加5桶水，就能领1瓶；加5颗苦果，就能领5瓶。两样都加，就能领6瓶。

english: As it is against the Pirates Code, ye'll not be able te kill anyone in there directly. However, the stills are fair game. Most of them can be burned down with a torch, if ye try hard enough.
translation: 因为海盗法典禁止，你不能直接杀里面的任何人。不过蒸馏器是可以攻击的。大多数都能用火把烧掉，只要你够努力。

english: When some scum-sucking dog has set yer still on fire don't panic. Just take a bucket of water and douse the fire. Then, dependin' on what was burnin', use either a pipe section, lumber patch or bridge section on the burned bit to repair it. Pipe sections be used fer pipes and the water pump.
translation: 当哪个卑鄙小人烧了你的蒸馏器时别慌。拿一桶水浇灭火就行。然后，看烧的是什么，用管道部分、木材补丁或桥段来修复烧坏的地方。管道部分用来修管道和水泵。

english: Lumber Patches fer the hoppers.
translation: 木材补丁用来修料斗。

english: Bridge sections be needed fer bridges.
translation: 桥段用来修桥。

english: If ye run low on items (as will happen if yer enemy be in a fiery mood) then ye will need te make yer own items.
translation: 如果你东西不够用（敌人火气大的时候就会这样），那你就得自己做。

english: This is quite easy, as there be a bench full of handy tools fer ye te uses to make more. Just take a log and use it on the table, and ye'll be able te craft up as many of the items as ye need.
translation: 这很简单，因为那里有条长凳，上面摆满了趁手的工具供你使用。拿根原木用在桌子上，就能做出你需要的任何数量的物品。

english: If things be looking dreadful, then ye can use the steam pump to raise the pressure in the boilers, and then vent it through the damaged parts te put out fires and badly scald anyone lurkin' nearby. The pump be quite stiff te work, and ye'll need a lot of energy te keep it goin'. Just haul on the lever fer a while until ye gets tired, and that will put up the pressure.
translation: 如果情况不妙，你可以用蒸汽泵给锅炉加压，然后通过损坏的部位释放蒸汽来灭火，还能烫伤附近潜伏的人。泵操作起来很费劲，需要大量体力才能维持。拉一会儿拉杆直到累了，压力就会上去。

english: When yer base is under attack, and things be on fire, then vent the pressure te give them a nasty surprise. Be warned though, the steam will damage the pipes and hoppers as it comes out, so that might do more harm than good.
translation: 当你的基地遭到攻击、东西着火时，释放压力给他们一个恶心的惊喜。不过要小心，蒸汽出来时会损坏管道和料斗，所以可能弊大于利。

english: Well, ye've set things on fire, worked the steam pump and stashed the rum, and now the game is over. What do ye get? Plunder!
translation: 好了，你放了火，操作了蒸汽泵，藏好了朗姆酒，现在游戏结束了。你能得到什么？掠夺物！

english: Ye will be awarded a number of Pieces of Eight depending on how well yer team did, and how hard ye worked during' the game. If ye have a word with Honest Jimmy, then he'll sell ye some nice items fer all yer hard work.
translation: 你会根据队伍表现和你在游戏中的努力程度获得一定数量的八分币。跟诚实的吉米说一声，他会卖给你一些好东西作为你辛苦工作的回报。

english: Tricorn hats are the latest in pirate fashions. They go well with any outfit, and will make ye the envy of all the other pirates as ye walk down the plank.
translation: 三角帽是海盗界最新的时尚。配什么衣服都好看，走跳板的时候会让其他海盗都羡慕你。

english: Nothin' says 'I lived the Navy lifestyle before deserting te make me fortune' like an old tattered Navy uniform, and Jimmy has plenty. All pre-tattered and authentic, get one today!
translation: 没有什么比一件破旧的海军制服更能说明'我过过海军生活然后叛逃去发财'了，吉米那里多的是。全都预先做旧、货真价实，今天就来一件吧！

english: If ye save up enough Pieces of Eight, then ye can own yer very own surplus pirate flag! Jimmy has plenty on offer, including a rare example from the ghost ship The Phasmatys Pride!
translation: 如果你攒够足够的八分币，就能拥有自己的多余海盗旗！吉米有很多选择，包括一面来自幽灵船'法斯马蒂斯骄傲号'的稀有旗帜！

english: Last but by no means least, be The Stuff. Jimmy won't tell us where he gets it, as the Cooking Guild keeps threatening te reduce him te soup if he keeps sellin' it. It works by bein' sprinkled into yer ale before ye add the hops, and the effect means that yer a little more likely te get a mature ale by the end of it.
translation: 最后但同样重要的是神秘物质。吉米不肯告诉我们他从哪弄来的，因为厨师公会一直威胁说如果他继续卖就要把他炖成汤。用法是在加霍普斯之前撒进你的麦酒里，效果是最后更有可能酿出熟成麦酒。

english: You find a scroll in the boxes which you take.
translation: 你在盒子里找到了一卷卷轴，你拿走了它。

english: You search the boxes but find nothing of interest.
translation: 你搜了盒子，但没找到什么有趣的东西。

english: You need a tinderbox and some suitable kindling to light the brazier.
translation: 你需要火绒盒和一些合适的引火物来点燃火盆。

english: You need some suitable kindling to burn.
translation: 你需要一些合适的引火物来烧。

english: The brazier doesn't suit that kind of wood.
translation: 火盆不适合烧那种木材。

english: That's not going to help now.
translation: 那现在帮不上忙了。

english: The elders haven't woken for almost a fortnight and so by the laws set forth by Mother, we must move them deep into the sanctuary with all their possessions. Over the years, the elders have feared retaliation from their enemies. In their weakened state, they stand no chance in defending themselves.
translation: 长老们已经将近两周没有醒来，按照母亲定下的规矩，我们必须把他们连同所有财物搬到圣所深处。多年来，长老们一直担心敌人的报复。以他们现在的虚弱状态，根本无法自卫。

english: Property of Armod Brundtson
translation: 阿莫德·布伦德森之财产

english: Read at your peril!
translation: 阅读后果自负！

english: If you steal this book, my dad will beat you up!
translation: 你要是偷这本书，我爸爸会揍你的！

english: We're doing really badly at the trials. Beigarth broke his lyre for the fifth time, Hild got lost in the maze again, and Reinn and Signy were both sick all over Manni. When are we going to finish these trials and become adults? My father keeps telling me to improve, saying that I should try harder to become a proper Fremennik adult.
translation: 试炼进行得很糟糕。贝加思第五次弄断了他的竖琴，希尔德又在迷宫里迷路了，雷恩和西格尼都吐了曼尼一身。我们什么时候才能完成试炼成为大人？我父亲一直叫我要进步，说我应该更努力成为真正的费明尼克成年人。

english: The trials aren't going well. I broke my arm while fighting a cow, and Beigarth almost fell into the furnace. Luckily, my father saved him and Signy from spilling molten iron all over the adults. Askeladden's already become an adult and keeps making fun of us. He really annoys me.
translation: 试炼进展不顺。我跟奶牛打架时摔断了手臂，贝加思差点掉进熔炉。幸好我父亲救了他和西格尼，没让熔化的铁水溅到所有大人身上。阿斯克拉登已经成年了，老是取笑我们。他真让我烦。

english: It's not fair! Father said that me and my friends might never pass our trials. They don't want us helping other people with their trials, either. And now he says we have to leave Rellekka! How can they exile us?
translation: 这不公平！父亲说我和朋友们可能永远过不了试炼。他们也不让我们帮别人过试炼。现在他还说我们得离开雷勒卡城！他们怎么能放逐我们？

english: Signy said she heard about two island kingdoms that had been at war for hundreds of years. If we go there and make peace, will my father finally agree that we're true Fremennik adults?
translation: 西格尼说她听说有两个岛国交战了几百年。如果我们去那里促成和平，父亲会不会终于承认我们是真正的费明尼克成年人？

english: Life's not fair!
translation: 生活就是不公平！

english: We got to the island kingdoms and they said that an adventurer had recently made peace, by promising to marry the daughter of the king! Why does this always happen to us? If we'd just been a little earlier, I could have married the king's daughter.
translation: 我们到了岛国，他们说有个冒险者最近促成了和平，方法是答应娶国王的女儿！为什么这种事总发生在我们身上？要是我们早一点到，我就能娶国王的女儿了。

english: We got to the island kingdoms and they said that an adventurer had recently made peace, by promising to marry the son of the king! Why does this always happen to us? If we'd just been a little earlier, I could have married the king's son.
translation: 我们到了岛国，他们说有个冒险者最近促成了和平，方法是答应嫁给国王的儿子！为什么这种事总发生在我们身上？要是我们早一点到，我就能嫁给国王的儿子了。

english: Beigarth says that just because they're at peace now doesn't mean they always will be. He says he has a plan.
translation: 贝加思说他们现在和平不代表永远和平。他说他有计划。

english: Beigarth's plan is great! Now all we have to do is find the right armour, and a place in one of the caves. Father's going to be so impressed with me...
translation: 贝加思的计划太棒了！现在我们只需要找到合适的盔甲，还有某个洞穴里的一个位置。父亲一定会对我刮目相看……

english: The plan's worked! The kingdoms are at war again, and no-one knows we were those soldiers. All we need to do is make peace, and the council at home will be so impressed that they'll make us adults right away!
translation: 计划成功了！两国又开战了，没人知道那些士兵是我们。我们只需要促成和平，家乡的议会一定会印象深刻，立刻让我们成年！

english: Why did it go so wrong? We were just about to get the goods back, but there are MONSTERS in there! I'm not going anywhere near that giant snake, and I think the others agree with me. We're cold and hungry and can't go back to the town, because we got drunk in the inn and then couldn't pay. It's so bad that we've had to burn bits of my diary to keep warm.
translation: 为什么会搞成这样？我们正要拿回货物，但里面有怪物！我可不想靠近那条巨蛇，我觉得其他人也同意。我们又冷又饿，回不了镇子，因为我们在酒馆喝醉了付不起钱。惨到我们不得不烧我的日记来取暖。

english: Someone, please help us...
translation: 谁来救救我们……

english: (Charm) Can I have a new name?
translation: （魅力）我能换个新名字吗？

english: Not that I don't like my name or anything, but can I have a new one?
translation: 不是说我不喜欢我的名字，但能换个新的吗？

english: Nothing's wrong with [Fremennik name], I'd just like a new name, if it's not too much trouble.
translation: [Fremennik name]没什么不好，我只是想要个新名字，如果不麻烦的话。

english: Brundt has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 布伦特又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Brundt has given you a casket!
translation: 布伦特给了你一个宝箱！

english: You think you could climb over the cart, but you see undead creatures gathered by the gates. A note attached to the cart reads: Danger: Deadly green mist! DO NOT ENTER IF YOU VALUE YOUR LIFE!
translation: 你觉得可以翻过推车，但看到大门旁聚集着亡灵生物。推车上贴着一张通知：危险：致命绿色迷雾！珍惜生命者切勿进入！

english: Coronation Speech of King Byrne I
translation: 拜恩一世国王加冕演讲

english: Now, we can talk with our own voices. Together we bring liberation, freedom and a future. Gone is the tyrant; we threw him down.
translation: 现在，我们可以用自己的声音说话了。我们共同带来解放、自由和未来。暴君已去；我们推翻了他。

english: Our freedom is not without cost. Many died and much has been destroyed. Yet more needs to be destroyed before we can heal the wounds of this past century. All icons and imagery that betray our freedom must be cast down. Not only cast down but resurrected also. Resurrected as symbols of freedom, hope and warning!
translation: 我们的自由并非没有代价。许多人牺牲，许多东西被摧毁。然而，在治愈过去一个世纪的创伤之前，还有更多需要被摧毁。所有背叛我们自由的标志和象征都必须被推倒。不仅推倒，还要重塑。重塑为自由、希望和警示的象征！

english: My friends, my people, we start a journey today. A most difficult journey. We must rebuild much of what has been destroyed, our houses, our farms and our temples. We must rebuild more than just buildings. We must rebuild our friendships, our memories and our understanding of freedom. We must remember what hope is, what hope means and dare to imagine what hope can bring.
translation: 我的朋友们，我的人民，我们今天开启一段旅程。一段最艰难的旅程。我们必须重建许多被摧毁的东西——我们的房屋、农场和神庙。我们不仅要重建建筑，还要重建我们的友谊、记忆和对自由的理解。我们必须记住希望是什么，希望意味着什么，并敢于想象希望能带来什么。

english: We have the chance to create a great future, make Kourend great once more! Together we can achieve anything and we must be together to progress. Forget your rivalries, forget past grievances and forget them you must. Only with a clear mind and unified approach can we achieve our deserved future.
translation: 我们有机会创造伟大的未来，让库兰德王国再次伟大！团结一致，我们无所不能，我们必须团结才能前进。忘记你们的纷争，忘记过去的恩怨，你们必须忘记。唯有心无旁骛、齐心协力，才能实现我们应得的未来。

english: Forward as one!
translation: 万众一心，向前进！

english: The Cadarn clan was one of the eight elven clans that came to Gielinor with Seren during the First Age. Known for their prowess in battle, it was the responsibility of the Cadarn clan to protect the other seven clans from any hostility encountered while colonising this new world.
translation: 卡达恩部族是第一纪元随塞伦来到吉莱诺的八大精灵部族之一。以战斗 prowess 闻名，卡达恩部族的职责是在殖民这个新世界时保护其他七个部族免受任何敌意。

english: Not much is known about the first generations of elves to walk this land. The only remaining documentation is the ancestry records. It's not until the start of the Third Age that we find surviving transcripts, but these are few and far between.
translation: 关于最早踏上这片土地的精灵世代，我们所知甚少。仅存的文献是血统记录。直到第三纪元开始，我们才找到幸存的文字记录，但这些记录寥寥无几。

english: With the war over, King Baxtorian of the Cadarn clan spearheaded an expansion into the lands east of Tirannwn. For many years, he ruled over a large kingdom that covered much of the area now known as Kandarin.
translation: 战争结束后，卡达恩部族的巴克斯托里安国王率先向提兰恩以东的土地扩张。多年来，他统治着一个横跨如今坎达林王国大部分地区的庞大王国。

english: However, his rule came to an end when he was suddenly forced to return to Tirannwn. In his absence, his kingdom soon fell. Contact between humans and elves broke off soon afterwards.
translation: 然而，当他突然被迫返回提兰恩时，他的统治走到了尽头。他不在期间，王国很快覆灭。人类与精灵之间的联系也随即中断。

english: It takes more grit than most have te be a pirate, and I don't think ye've got what it takes lad.
translation: 当海盗需要比大多数人更多的胆量，小子，我觉得你没那个本事。

english: It takes more grit than most have te be a pirate, and I don't think ye've got what it takes lass.
translation: 当海盗需要比大多数人更多的胆量，姑娘，我觉得你没那个本事。

english: It takes more grit than most have te be a pirate, and I don't think ye've got what it takes kid.
translation: 当海盗需要比大多数人更多的胆量，小鬼，我觉得你没那个本事。

english: Well kid, I don't think ye could pirate yer way out of a chest full of piracy.
translation: 小鬼，我觉得你连装满海盗的宝箱都逃不出去。

english: Well kid, I be Bill Teach, the Captain of the Adventurous, one of the finest ships ever to sail these waters.
translation: 小鬼，我是比尔.蒂奇，冒险号船长，这片海域上最优秀的船之一。

english: Of course kid, once we make landfall ye'll have worked as a sailor on a pirate vessel, which is one of the easiest ways to become a true pirate.
translation: 当然，小鬼，等我们靠岸后，你就在海盗船上当过水手了，这是成为真正海盗最容易的途径之一。

english: Of course ye do, lad! Plenty be claiming they've got what it takes to be a pirate, but I can't be takin' ye word 'till I see it for myself.
translation: 当然你有，小子！很多人都声称自己有当海盗的本事，但在我亲眼看到之前，我可不能光听你嘴上说。

english: Of course ye do, lass! Plenty be claiming they've got what it takes to be a pirate, but I can't be takin' ye word 'till I see it for myself.
translation: 当然你有，姑娘！很多人都声称自己有当海盗的本事，但在我亲眼看到之前，我可不能光听你嘴上说。

english: Of course ye do, kid! Plenty be claiming they've got what it takes to be a pirate, but I can't be takin' ye word 'till I see it for myself.
translation: 当然你有，小鬼！很多人都声称自己有当海盗的本事，但在我亲眼看到之前，我可不能光听你嘴上说。

english: Ye said ye would help me out kid, will ye stand by yer word?
translation: 你说过要帮我，小鬼，你会信守承诺吗？

english: Yes, I am a woman of my word.
translation: 是的，我说话算话。

english: On yer way kid, leave me be.
translation: 走吧小鬼，别烦我。

english: It will probably not take Bill long to notice you have left the battle.
translation: 比尔很快就会注意到你离开了战斗。

english: He will no doubt return to Phasmatys and wait for you to come back.
translation: 他无疑会回到法斯马蒂斯等你回来。

english: You return to port.
translation: 你回到了港口。

english: You light the fuse...
translation: 你点燃了引信……

english: You don't need a Ramrod right now.
translation: 你现在不需要搠杖。

english: You don't need a cannon ball right now.
translation: 你现在不需要炮弹。

english: You don't need a canister right now.
translation: 你现在不需要罐。

translation: 你现在不需要引信。

translation: 你取了一些火药。

translation: 这个炮弹太大了。

english: Very good, sir. Madam's tea will be ready shortly.
translation: 好的，先生。夫人的茶马上就好。

english: Very good, madam. Sir's tea will be ready shortly.
translation: 好的，夫人。先生的茶马上就好。

english: Certainly, sir. If sir would simply tell me the items she requires?
translation: 当然可以，先生。先生只需告诉我她需要什么物品？

english: Certainly, madam. If madam would simply tell me the items he requires?
translation: 当然可以，夫人。夫人只需告诉我他需要什么物品？

english: The squirrel carefully crunches the calcified acorn and magically turns into a skeleton. Whoops!
translation: 松鼠小心翼翼地啃着钙化橡子，神奇地变成了骷髅。哎呀！

english: Your loot contains Dom! Are you sure you want to descend further?
translation: 你的战利品里有多姆！你确定要继续深入吗？

english: Ah, hello there! I've just dug up an old treasure chest of mine.
translation: 啊，你好！我刚挖出了我的一个旧宝箱。

english: Fancy some 'rum', kid? It's still fresh. Well, fresh-ish...
translation: 想来点'朗姆酒'吗，小子？还挺新鲜的。嗯，还算新鲜……

english: You smart. You loyal.
translation: 你聪明。你忠诚。

english: Another one.
translation: 又一个。

english: Ah, perfect!
translation: 啊，完美！

english: We'll set sail in the next 25 seconds.

translation: 警告！这艘独木舟会带你深入荒野。那里没有适合制作独木舟的树木。你必须步行返回。

english: Objective: The aim is to get into your opponents castle and take their team standard. Then bring that back and capture it on your teams standard.
translation: 目标：目标是进入敌方城堡并夺取他们的团队旗帜。然后把它带回来，插在你们团队的旗帜上。

english: Toolkit: This useful item allows you to repair broken doors and catapults. Simply use it on the item to be repaired, or have one in your inventory when you select the option, and you'll rebuild it!
translation: 工具包：这个有用的物品可以让你修理破损的门和投石机。只需将它用在需要修理的物品上，或者在选择选项时把它放在背包里，你就能重建它！

english: This useful item allows you to repair broken doors and catapults. Simply use it on the item to be repaired, or have one in your inventory when you select the option, and you'll rebuild it!
translation: 这个有用的物品可以让你修理破损的门和投石机。只需将它用在需要修理的物品上，或者在选择选项时把它放在背包里，你就能重建它！
