translation: 绷带：可以用来恢复一些生命值并恢复部分跑步能量。你也可以用它来治疗其他玩家。

english: These can be used to heal some health and restore some of your running energy. You can also use them to heal fellow players.
translation: 可以用来恢复一些生命值并恢复部分跑步能量。你也可以用它来治疗其他玩家。

english: Explosive Potion: A simple but effective item, use it to blow up your opponents catapult and barricades! It can also be used to clear the tunnels under the arena for some sneak attacks into your opponents castle!
translation: 爆炸药水：简单但有效的物品，用它来炸毁敌人的投石机和路障！它还可以用来清理竞技场下的隧道，以便偷袭敌方城堡！

english: A simple but effective item, use it to blow up your opponents catapult and barricades! It can also be used to clear the tunnels under the arena for some sneak attacks into your opponents castle!
translation: 简单但有效的物品，用它来炸毁敌人的投石机和路障！它还可以用来清理竞技场下的隧道，以便偷袭敌方城堡！

english: Barricade: Use these constructs to block your opponents movement and prevent them accessing your castle. Each team can only have 10 built at any one time.
translation: 路障：使用这些构造物来阻挡敌人的行动，防止他们进入你的城堡。每队同时最多只能建造10个。

english: Use these constructs to block your opponents movement and prevent them accessing your castle. Each team can only have 10 built at any one time.
translation: 使用这些构造物来阻挡敌人的行动，防止他们进入你的城堡。每队同时最多只能建造10个。

english: Bucket: Fill a bucket with water and you can use it to put out a burning catapult or barricade, but be quick or it'll be destroyed.
translation: 桶：用水装满桶，然后可以用来扑灭燃烧的投石机或路障，但要快，否则它会被摧毁。

english: Fill a bucket with water and you can use it to put out a burning catapult or barricade, but be quick or it'll be destroyed.
translation: 用水装满桶，然后可以用来扑灭燃烧的投石机或路障，但要快，否则它会被摧毁。

english: Tinderbox: Logs aren't all that's flammable, use a tinderbox to set light to your opponents catapult and barricades.
translation: 火绒盒：原木不是唯一易燃的东西，用火绒盒点燃敌人的投石机和路障。

english: Logs aren't all that's flammable, use a tinderbox to set light to your opponents catapult and barricades.
translation: 原木不是唯一易燃的东西，用火绒盒点燃敌人的投石机和路障。

english: Pickaxe: Use a pickaxe to mine your way through the tunnels under the arena for a sneak attack into your opponents castle. Don't forget to collapse the tunnels into your own castle though!
translation: 镐子：用镐子挖通竞技场下的隧道，以便偷袭敌方城堡。不过别忘了把通往自己城堡的隧道弄塌！

english: Use a pickaxe to mine your way through the tunnels under the arena for a sneak attack into your opponents castle. Don't forget to collapse the tunnels into your own castle though!
translation: 用镐子挖通竞技场下的隧道，以便偷袭敌方城堡。不过别忘了把通往自己城堡的隧道弄塌！

english: Catapult: Use this war machine to launch rocks at your opponents. Just give it rough coordinates and let the rock fly, just be careful not to hit your team with it!
translation: 投石机：使用这个战争机器向敌人发射岩石。只需给出大致坐标，让岩石飞出去，小心别砸到自己人！

english: Use this war machine to launch rocks at your opponents. Just give it rough coordinates and let the rock fly, just be careful not to hit your team with it!
translation: 使用这个战争机器向敌人发射岩石。只需给出大致坐标，让岩石飞出去，小心别砸到自己人！

english: Rock: Used as ammo for the catapult, and not much else. Brings new meaning to the phrase 'flies like a rock'.
translation: 岩石：用作投石机的弹药，除此之外没什么用。给'像石头一样飞'这个说法赋予了新的含义。

english: Used as ammo for the catapult, and not much else. Brings new meaning to the phrase 'flies like a rock'.
translation: 用作投石机的弹药，除此之外没什么用。给'像石头一样飞'这个说法赋予了新的含义。

english: The capybara and hippo both seem very impressed by your moves. The capybara uses its nose to roll a token towards you.
translation: 水豚和河马似乎都对你的动作印象深刻。水豚用鼻子把一个代币滚向你。

english: The jar thrums as the mote feverently tries to escape its container, almost slipping from your hand as you inspect it. It can be used to make a wind catcher on a boat.
translation: 罐子嗡嗡作响，微粒疯狂地试图逃离容器，你检查时它差点从你手中滑落。它可以用来在船上制作捕风器。

english: The bearer of this certificate has brought both halves of the legendary Shield of Arrav to me, Haig Halen, Curator of the Varrock Museum. I have examined the shield and am satisfied as to its authenticity. I recommend to his majesty, King Roald III, that the bearer is rewarded as per Proclimation 252 of the year 143 in the 5th age, by King Roald II.
translation: 此证书的持有者将传说中的阿拉夫之盾的两半都带到了我，海格·哈伦，维洛克城博物馆馆长面前。我已检查过盾牌，对其真实性感到满意。我向国王陛下，罗尔德国王三世，建议按照第五纪元143年第252号公告，由罗尔德国王二世颁布的规定，对持有者予以奖励。

english: Your Celestial ring has <Num0> charges.
translation: 你的天界戒指有<Num0>次充能。

english: There is an inscription upon the door: When the serpent king roams free once more, Hati and Sköll wage their war. To the End of Things all will yield, but until that day this door stays sealed.
translation: 门上刻着铭文：当蛇王再次自由游荡，哈提和斯库尔展开他们的战争。万物终将屈服于终结之日，但在那一天到来之前，此门将保持封印。

english: Catriona refuses to look at you.
translation: 卡特里奥娜拒绝看你。

english: I hear you found Keenan. Shame about what happened, but not surprising. Hopefully this is the last time that sort of thing happens.
translation: 我听说你找到了基南。发生的事很遗憾，但也不意外。希望这类事情是最后一次发生。

english: I think it will be.
translation: 我想会是这样的。

english: I suppose time will tell if you're right.
translation: 我想时间会证明你是否正确。

english: You take a cattleprod.
translation: 你拿起了一根赶牛棒。

english: You don't feel like you need another cattleprod.
translation: 你觉得不需要另一根赶牛棒了。

english: You don't have room to take a cattleprod.
translation: 你没有空间再拿一根赶牛棒了。

english: All your wilderness are belong to them!
translation: 你们的荒野全都属于他们了！

english: Please, madam, can you help me.
translation: 拜托，女士，你能帮帮我吗。

english: Charlie gives you a new clue!
translation: 查理给了你一个新线索！

english: Charlie gives you a casket!
translation: 查理给了你一个宝箱！

english: Thank you so much madam.
translation: 太感谢你了，女士。

english: I cannot stop you from taking this map piece now, but think of this: if you can slay the Dragon of Crandor, you are a greater hero than my land ever produced. There is no shame in backing out now.
translation: 我现在无法阻止你拿走这块地图碎片，但请想一想：如果你能屠戮克兰多尔的巨龙，你就是比我这片土地曾经孕育过的任何英雄都伟大的英雄。现在退出并不丢人。

english: Category:Dragon Slayer I
translation: 分类：屠龙者 I

english: The moss lizards and bream living here are of an incredibly high quality, likely due to the unique properties of the ecosystem. During our testing, we've discovered that the healing properties of the food improve with the skill of the chef preparing it! However, it curiously seems that the magic of the ruins prevents these foods from being removed from the area. Perhaps this is a protective mechanism to ensure the ecosystem isn't damaged.
translation: 生活在这里的苔藓蜥蜴和鲷鱼品质极高，很可能是因为这片生态系统独特的性质。在我们的测试中，我们发现食物的治疗效果会随着准备它的厨师的技艺提高而提升！然而，奇怪的是，废墟的魔法似乎阻止这些食物被带离该区域。也许这是一种保护机制，以确保生态系统不受损害。

translation: 你发现了额外珍贵的东西：金项链

english: Summary: A local miner describes how his family could hear the attack that killed King Shayzien VII.
translation: 摘要：一位当地矿工描述了他的家人如何听到杀死谢兹恩七世国王的那次攻击。

english: 'Twas a warm autumn evening as I returned home from the mine yesterday, yet there was something cold in the air. I was looking forward to supper with my family as I stopped by the bank to store my pickaxe on the journey home.
translation: 那是一个温暖的秋夜，我昨天从矿场回到家，但空气中却有些寒意。我期待着与家人共进晚餐，在回家的路上我顺便去银行存放我的镐子。

english: We lived on the southern peninsula, quite a walk from the mine, but we enjoyed the peace that comes with being so close to Shayziens' Wall.
translation: 我们住在南部半岛，离矿场有一段路，但我们享受着靠近谢兹恩城墙所带来的宁静。

english: I had just arrived home when it began... the howling of arrows through the air, deafening roars of soldiers as they were slain... just outside the gates a fierce battle was waging, seemingly out of nowhere.
translation: 我刚到家，一切就开始了……箭矢划破长空的呼啸声，士兵们被屠杀时震耳欲聋的吼叫声……就在大门外，一场激烈的战斗正在进行，似乎凭空出现。

english: We'd lived here for six decades now and we'd seen enough training exercises to know this was real. Life wasn't exactly easy in Kourend under King Shayzien, but this was new. I gathered the family and we held each other, fearing the battle could extend to our home. And then, as swiftly as it began, it was over. The intense clashes of shields fell silent, just for a moment, before we heard powerful cheers.
translation: 我们在这里住了六十年，见过的训练演习够多了，知道这次是真的。在谢兹恩国王统治下的库兰德王国，生活本就不易，但这次是前所未有的。我召集家人，我们紧紧相拥，担心战火会蔓延到我们的家。然后，就像开始时一样迅速，一切结束了。激烈的盾牌碰撞声沉寂了片刻，随后我们听到了响亮的欢呼声。

english: It wasn't until this morning that we heard the news. King Shayzien himself had fallen in battle, ambushed by his own army of Elder Warriors.
translation: 直到今天早上我们才得知消息。谢兹恩国王本人在战斗中阵亡，被他自己的长老战士军队伏击。

english: At first, we didn't know how to feel. Five decades of torment and struggle under his rule had come to an end, I started to remember life before, as a child, where we could freely walk the kingdom without fear of being summoned to the King for his leisure experiments. But then it crumbled away... once again our peaceful corner of the world transformed into a harmony of sudden screams and cries.
translation: 起初，我们不知该如何感受。他统治下五十年的折磨与挣扎终于结束了，我开始回忆起从前的生活，那时我还是个孩子，可以自由地在王国中行走，不用担心被召到国王面前供他消遣实验。但随后一切又崩塌了……我们世界这个宁静的角落再次变成了突如其来的尖叫与哭喊的交响。

english: Rumours spread like wildfire. A new ruler had emerged, by the name of Xeric. Some say it was King Shayzien reborn, some say it was his evil spirit returned to avenge his death. We'd even heard that, whoever it was, they weren't human!
translation: 谣言如野火般蔓延。一位名叫泽里克的新统治者出现了。有人说他是谢兹恩国王转世，有人说是他的恶灵回来复仇。我们甚至听说，不管他是谁，他都不是人类！

english: All we knew was life would never be the same.
translation: 我们只知道，生活再也不会和从前一样了。

english: Summary: A letter from Lord Piscarilius to residents of the kingdom, urging them to leave Great Kourend for fear of Xeric's power.
translation: 摘要：皮斯卡里琉斯领主致王国居民的一封信，敦促他们因惧怕泽里克的力量而离开大库兰德。

english: Dear Residents,
translation: 亲爱的居民们，

english: I must firstly apologise for my absence in recent days, I have been forced to conceal myself during these troubling times.
translation: 首先，我必须为近日的缺席致歉，在这动荡时期我被迫躲藏起来。

english: You must all be made aware of the dangers you all currently face, for Xeric is a threat to you all, even more so than King Shayzien was.
translation: 你们必须意识到当前面临的危险，泽里克对你们所有人都是威胁，甚至比谢兹恩国王更甚。

english: Xeric is currently sweeping through our great kingdom, decimating all authority within. Lord Hosidius and Lord Lovakengj are missing and presumed lost in battle to Xeric. It is only a matter of time before I will fall to the same fate and I do not wish for any of you to join me on this abrupt journey.
translation: 泽里克正在横扫我们伟大的王国，摧毁境内一切权威。霍西迪乌斯领主和洛瓦肯吉领主失踪，推测已在与泽里克的战斗中阵亡。我落入同样命运只是时间问题，我不希望你们任何人随我踏上这突如其来的旅程。

english: It is with both great urgency and sadness that I implore you, please leave.
translation: 我怀着极大的紧迫感和悲伤恳求你们，请离开吧。

english: You must evacuate Great Kourend. Xeric's forces will continue to advance; you must abandon your homes and head for Port Piscarilius in the hopes of finding transport elsewhere.
translation: 你们必须撤离大库兰德。泽里克的军队会继续推进；你们必须放弃家园，前往皮斯卡里琉斯港，希望能找到前往别处的交通工具。

english: I bid you all farewell...
translation: 我向你们所有人告别……

english: Rada's spirit be with you,
translation: 愿拉达的灵魂与你同在，

translation: 事情发生在三天前，就在最近一次蜥蜴生物聚集的时候……我们正在田里耕作，听到它们靠近的声音。我得以跑回屋里躲起来，但莫尔塔离得太远了……我还没来得及做任何事，它们就把她抓走了。

english: It is said that the cloak on display here was crafted during the first Teok Xiki, more commonly known as the Gathering.
translation: 据说这里展示的斗篷是在第一次Teok Xiki期间制作的，更常被称为集会。

english: The Gathering is the process used by both the Church of Ralos and the Sect of Ranul to select a new Teokan after the death of the previous one. This cloak was likely presented as a gift to the newly selected Teokan of Ranul.
translation: 集会是拉洛斯教会和拉努尔教派在前任Teokan去世后选拔新Teokan的过程。这件斗篷很可能是作为礼物赠送给新当选的拉努尔Teokan的。

english: The column on display here is one of two built at the end of the War of Betrayal. This column depicts the event that ignited the war between Kourend and Varlamore: Imafore's killing of the Kourend royal family.
translation: 这里展示的柱子是背叛战争结束时建造的两根之一。这根柱子描绘了点燃库兰德王国与瓦拉莫尔之间战争的事件：伊马福尔杀害库兰德王室。

english: The war went on to last six years and ended at the Battle of the Proudspire when Varlamorian freedom fighters led by Imafore's own cousin captured him. Imafore was executed soon after, with his cousin, Mezpah Arkan, taking the throne.
translation: 战争持续了六年，最终在骄傲尖塔之战中结束，当时由伊马福尔表亲领导的瓦拉莫尔自由战士将他抓获。伊马福尔很快被处决，他的表亲梅兹帕·阿尔坎登上了王座。

english: The column on display here is one of two built at the end of the War of Betrayal. This column depicts various key events in Kourend's history, most notably the Age of Strife.
translation: 这里展示的柱子是背叛战争结束时建造的两根之一。这根柱子描绘了库兰德王国历史上的关键事件，尤其是纷争时代。

english: The Age of Strife was considered the darkest era in Kourend's history, but it was also during this period that refugees fleeing Kourend first braved the Custodia Mountains. It was these refugees who would go on to found the first settlements of Varlamore, including Fortis.
translation: 纷争时代被认为是库兰德王国历史上最黑暗的时期，但也正是在这一时期，逃离库兰德的难民首次勇敢穿越库斯托迪亚山脉。正是这些难民后来建立了瓦拉莫尔的第一批定居点，包括福蒂斯。

english: In order to build you will need to turn building mode on. This can be done on entering the house or using a button on the options interface. If you have a bank PIN you must enter it when entering building mode.
translation: 要建造物品，你需要开启建造模式。你可以在进入房屋时开启，或使用选项界面上的按钮。如果你设置了银行PIN码，进入建造模式时必须输入。

english: In building mode the ghostly shapes of furniture and doorways you have not built yet will appear in your house. These are called hotspots. You can use these to build furniture and new rooms.
translation: 在建造模式下，你尚未建造的家具和门洞的幽灵形状会出现在你的房屋中。这些被称为热点。你可以利用它们来建造家具和新房间。

english: To build a piece of furniture, right-click the hotspot and select Build. You will then be able to select the piece of furniture you want to build from the menu. Below each furniture icon is a list of materials; to build the furniture you will need to have all these materials in your inventory. You will also need to have a hammer, a saw and have the correct Construction level.
translation: 要建造一件家具，右键点击热点并选择“建造”。然后你可以从菜单中选择要建造的家具。每个家具图标下方是材料清单；要建造家具，你的背包中必须拥有所有这些材料。你还需要一把锤子、一把锯子以及相应的建筑等级。

english: Nails work slightly differently to other materials. You will sometimes find you break nails, especially if you have a low Construction level, so you may need to bring more nails than the furniture requires. Nails made of stronger metals will break less often.
translation: 钉子与其他材料略有不同。你有时会弄断钉子，尤其是建筑等级较低时，所以你可能需要携带比家具所需更多的钉子。由更坚固金属制成的钉子更不容易断裂。

english: You can remove a piece of furniture if you wish to build something else in the same space. To do this, right-click on it and select Remove. You will not get any of the materials back. Some pieces of furniture can be upgraded to better pieces of furniture without having to remove them first.
translation: 如果你想在同一空间建造其他东西，可以移除一件家具。右键点击它并选择“移除”。你不会收回任何材料。有些家具可以直接升级为更好的家具，无需先移除。

english: To build a new room, you must use one of the door hotspots at the edges of rooms or garden squares. Right-click on it and select Build. This will bring up a list of rooms. Different rooms cost different amounts of gold and have different Construction level requirements.
translation: 要建造新房间，你必须使用房间或花园方块边缘的门热点。右键点击并选择“建造”。这将弹出一个房间列表。不同房间花费的金币和所需的建筑等级各不相同。

english: If you select Build on a door hotspot that already leads to a room, you will be asked whether you want to delete that room.
translation: 如果你在已经通向房间的门热点上选择“建造”，系统会询问你是否要删除那个房间。

english: The main raw material you will use to make furniture is planks. The sawmill operator north east of Varrock will turn logs into planks for you, for a fee. The useful planks are wood, oak, teak and mahogany. The sawmill operator also sells saws, cloth and nails.
translation: 制作家具的主要原材料是木板。维洛克城东北方的锯木厂操作员可以帮你把原木加工成木板，收取一定费用。有用的木板有普通木板、橡木板、柚木板和红木板。锯木厂操作员也出售锯子、布料和钉子。

english: For higher level furniture you may also need limestone,marble, gold leaf and magic building crystals. These are sold by the stonemason who lives in Keldagrim.
translation: 对于更高等级的家具，你可能还需要石灰石、大理石、金箔和魔法建筑水晶。这些由住在凯尔达格林城的石匠出售。

english: Some pieces of furniture also require materials that are not specific to construction, such as steel bars and soft clay.
translation: 有些家具还需要非建筑专用的材料，例如钢锭和软粘土。

english: Parlour: This is the lowest- level room and provides space for three people to sit around a fire.
translation: 客厅：这是最低等级的房间，可容纳三人围坐在火炉旁。

english: Garden: The garden is largely decorative but it also contains the exit portal.
translation: 花园：花园主要是装饰性的，但也包含出口传送门。

english: Kitchen: This room can be used for preparing food. As you build better furniture in it you will find yourself able to prepare better meals in it.
translation: 厨房：这个房间可用于准备食物。随着你在这里建造更好的家具，你将能够准备更美味的佳肴。

english: Dining room: Eight people can sit around the tables you build in this room.
translation: 餐厅：八个人可以围坐在你在这个房间建造的桌子旁。

english: Bedroom: Some of the furniture in this room can be used to change your hair and clothes. You will also need to have two of these rooms in order to hire a servant.
translation: 卧室：这个房间的一些家具可以用来改变你的发型和衣服。你还需要拥有两个这样的房间才能雇佣仆从。

english: Halls: These are primarily used to connect other rooms, but they also provide space to show off the owner's skill and quest achievements.
translation: 走廊：这些主要用于连接其他房间，但也提供了展示房主技能和任务成就的空间。

english: Games room: Various games can be built in this room to allow friends to play and train together.
translation: 游戏室：可以在这个房间建造各种游戏设施，让朋友们一起游玩和训练。

english: Combat room: With this room you can challenge your friends in a personal duelling ring.
translation: 战斗室：有了这个房间，你可以在私人决斗场中挑战你的朋友。

english: Workshop: This room allows you to train Construction without modifying your own house, by making furniture that can be sold to other players. It also provides space for you to train Crafting and Smithing.
translation: 工作室：这个房间允许你通过制作可以出售给其他玩家的家具来训练建筑技能，而无需修改自己的房屋。它也为你提供了训练制作和锻造技能的空间。

english: Chapel: This room can be dedicated to any of Gielinor's major gods, and the altar can be used to offer bones.
translation: 礼拜堂：这个房间可以供奉吉莲诺大陆的任何主要神祇，祭坛可以用来献祭骨头。

english: Study: You can use the lectern in this room to create clay tablets recording magic spells. Eagle lecterns make teleport spells and demon lecterns make enchantment spells. The elemental sphere in this room can be used to change the element of an elemental staff.
translation: 书房：你可以使用这个房间里的讲台制作记录魔法咒语的粘土石板。鹰形讲台可以制作传送法术，恶魔讲台可以制作附魔法术。这个房间里的元素球可以用来改变元素法杖的元素属性。

english: Portal chamber: In this room you can build portals to various places around the world.
translation: 传送室：在这个房间里，你可以建造通往世界各地不同地点的传送门。

english: Formal garden: The formal garden can contain various plants and ornaments to beautify the grounds of your house.
translation: 正规花园：正规花园可以包含各种植物和装饰品，以美化你房屋的庭院。

english: Throne room: This room can be used to hold audiences with large numbers of friends. It also contains the lever that turns on challenge mode.
translation: 王座室：这个房间可以用来接待大量朋友。它还包含开启挑战模式的拉杆。

english: Oubliette: If you build an oubliette below your throne room you can drop people from there into a cage which you can fill with various horrors.
translation: 密室：如果你在王座室下方建造一个密室，你可以将人从那里扔进一个笼子里，笼子里可以装满各种恐怖的东西。

english: Dungeon: Dungeon corridors and junctions can be built to create an underground maze full of monsters, traps and doors.
translation: 地牢：可以建造地牢走廊和交叉口，以创建一个充满怪物、陷阱和门的地下迷宫。

english: Treasure room: You can place a prize in this room for visitors to your dungeon to try to reach.
translation: 宝藏室：你可以在这个房间里放置一个奖品，供来你地牢的访客尝试获取。

english: Once you have two bedrooms, you can hire a servant by going to the Servants' Guild in Ardougne. You will have to pay when you hire them, and the servant will then periodically demand wages. Servants can take items to and from the bank for you, and can also greets guests and serve food and drinks.
translation: 一旦你拥有两间卧室，你可以去阿多尼城的仆从公会雇佣一名仆从。雇佣时需要付费，之后仆从会定期索要工资。仆从可以帮你从银行存取物品，还可以迎接客人并提供食物和饮料。

english: Notes from the Cook
translation: 厨师的笔记

english: Hans wants a beer called Brewer's Folly. Apparently the barmaids of the Rising Sun bar have a supply, but you have to ask for it specially. The Rising Sun is in the middle of Falador.
translation: 汉斯想要一种叫“酿酒师的愚行”的啤酒。据说旭日酒吧的女招待有供应，但你必须特别要求。旭日酒吧位于法拉多城中心。

english: The Lumbridge Guide wants a cabbage. Just a cabbage. He says he's setting a healthy example to all the newcomers he greets, and cabbage is good for you.
translation: 仑桥镇向导想要一颗卷心菜。就只是一颗卷心菜。他说他是在为他迎接的所有新人树立健康的榜样，而且卷心菜对身体有好处。

english: The Wise Old Man is awkward. He wants wine from Sir Vyvin's private collection. I told him Sir Vyvin doesn't sell stuff, but he insisted. So we'll bribe Sir Vyvin's squire instead. I'll write a letter to the squire. Get the letter off me, and take it to the squire in Falador Castle.
translation: 老智者很难搞。他想要维文爵士私人收藏的葡萄酒。我告诉他维文爵士不卖东西，但他坚持要。所以我们改为贿赂维文爵士的侍从。我会给侍从写封信。从我这里拿到信，然后把它送到法拉多城堡的侍从那里。

english: Rantz wants beer, but I'm not having an ogre getting drunk in a museum. That'd be silly. Get a beer glass and fill it with water instead. He's too stupid to know the difference.
translation: 兰茨想要啤酒，但我可不想让食人魔在博物馆里喝醉。那太傻了。拿一个啤酒杯装满水给他。他太笨了，分辨不出来。

english: Dear Squire,
translation: 亲爱的侍从：

english: I heard you've got a birthday coming soon, but as a squire, you probably can't afford a very good party.
translation: 我听说你的生日快到了，但作为一名侍从，你可能办不起一场像样的派对。

english: As the Head Chef to His Grace the Duke of Lumbridge, I would be happy to place my culinary talents at your disposal, creating for you a truly delicious birthday cake.
translation: 作为仑桥镇公爵殿下麾下的主厨，我很乐意将我的烹饪技艺供你差遣，为你制作一个真正美味的生日蛋糕。

english: My prowess in the preparation of birthday cakes is legendary; hardly a newcomer arrives in Lumbridge without rapidly becoming familiar with my work in the field.
translation: 我在制作生日蛋糕方面的造诣堪称传奇；几乎每个来到仑桥镇的新人都会很快熟悉我在这一领域的作品。

english: I will make you a birthday cake FREE OF CHARGE, if you will grant me just one small favour. I need some of Sir Vyvin's wine, from his private collection.
translation: 我将免费为你制作生日蛋糕，只要你帮我一个小忙。我需要一些维文爵士私人收藏的葡萄酒。

english: Please give it to the bearer of this letter. I'm sure Sir Vyvin won't notice; he's getting older, and I hear he can no longer tell one sword from another.
translation: 请把它交给这封信的持有者。我相信维文爵士不会注意到的；他年纪越来越大，我听说他已经分不清剑的优劣了。

english: Yours faithfully, The Cook
translation: 此致，厨师敬上

english: Yours faithfully,
translation: 此致敬礼,

english: The Cook

english: [player name]! Good t' see you!
translation: [player name]！见到你真好！

english: Hi Cormac. How's the island?
translation: 嗨，科马克。岛上怎么样？

english: We're learnin' to live a bit differently now that the Angel's gone... It feels a little odd, but we be makin' the best of it.
translation: 天使走了以后，我们学着换种方式生活……感觉有点怪，但我们会尽力过好。

english: For example, thanks t' some notes that Keenan left behind, we've worked out how to make golems out o' sunstone. They do nay do much right now, but we reckon we can eventually make use of 'em.
translation: 比如说，多亏了基南留下的笔记，我们研究出了怎么用太阳石做魔像。它们现在还没什么大用，但我们觉得以后能派上用场。

english: Aye. Feel free to give it a go yoursen if you fancy.
translation: 是啊，你要是感兴趣，尽管试试。

english: Oh, by the way, one o' the others managed to find this sunstone crystal. 'ere, you can have it.
translation: 哦，对了，有个同伴找到了这块太阳石水晶。喏，给你。

english: Cormac hands you a sunstone crystal.
translation: 科马克递给你一块太阳石水晶。

english: We weren't sure what t' do with it. Figured you'd have an inkling as you've been digging around the place.
translation: 我们不知道拿它怎么办，想着你一直在这一带挖掘，应该会有点头绪。

english: I can't say I've seen much reference to something like this, but I'll see what use I can make of it. Thanks, Cormac.
translation: 我倒是没见过多少关于这种东西的记载，不过我会看看能派上什么用场。谢了，科马克。

english: Oh, by the way, one o' the others managed to find this sunstone crystal. Come back when you have space for it, and you can have it.
translation: 哦，对了，有个同伴找到了这块太阳石水晶。等你有空位了再来拿吧。

english: How may I help you, sir?
translation: 先生，有什么能帮您的？

english: How may I help you, madam?
translation: 女士，有什么能帮您的？

english: Your star discovery bonus has been used up.
translation: 你的星辰发现加成已经用完了。

english: As you may know, all crystal equipment is grown from a crystal seed. You may not know that all crystal seeds come from the same place; Tarddiad, the ancestral homeworld of the elves.
translation: 你可能知道，所有水晶装备都是由水晶种子生长而成的。你可能不知道的是，所有水晶种子都来自同一个地方：塔迪亚德，精灵的祖居世界。

english: Reading the 'Cerddi' tells us that crystal seeds are sentient, although no one has ever been able converse with any crystal consciousness other than that of Seren herself.
translation: 阅读《歌集》告诉我们，水晶种子是有意识的，尽管除了塞伦本人之外，从未有人能与任何水晶意识交流过。

english: One of the ways we can see this consciousness in action is in the way that crystal equipment, when first used, becomes aligned to that person.
translation: 我们能观察到这种意识活动的一个方式，就是水晶装备在首次使用时，会与使用者产生共鸣。

english: As far as we can tell there have always been those with the ability to chant crystal, these tend to be from the Ithell clan, but it has been known for these 'Crystal Chanters' to be born to other clans as well.
translation: 据我们所知，一直都有具备吟唱水晶能力的人，这些人往往来自伊塞尔氏族，但也有一些'水晶吟唱者'出生于其他氏族。

english: The thing that makes 'Crystal Chanters' special is their ability to vocalise perfect pitches.
translation: '水晶吟唱者'的特殊之处在于他们能够发出完美的音高。

english: The idea behind chanting is quite simple: different pitches can change the shape and size of any facet of the seed. This allows a practiced chanter to make any number of shapes.
translation: 吟唱的原理很简单：不同的音高可以改变种子任何一面的形状和大小。这让熟练的吟唱者能够塑造出各种形状。

english: It is also possible for particularly gifted individuals to imbue powers into these objects. The only problem with this process is that it is very costly and time consuming.
translation: 天赋异禀的人还能为这些物品注入力量。这个过程唯一的问题就是非常昂贵且耗时。

english: The process can, however, be made more economical: the better the chanter knows the person for whom they are creating items, the easier it is to make.
translation: 不过，这个过程也可以更经济：吟唱者越了解为其制作物品的人，制作起来就越容易。

english: Although crystal seeds are highly convenient, they do have some drawbacks, the foremost of these is their brittleness.
translation: 虽然水晶种子非常方便，但也有缺点，最主要的就是易碎。

english: This means that crystal equipment will eventually revert back to its original form, that of the crystal seed. However, crystal seeds can be reused to create new crystal equipment. Some equipment can also be reinforced to slow degradation.
translation: 这意味着水晶装备最终会恢复原状，也就是水晶种子的形态。不过，水晶种子可以重新用来制作新的水晶装备。有些装备还可以加固以减缓损耗。

english: Crystal seeds are among our most valuable assets, but with us unable to return to our homeworld since the loss of the World Gate, access to this resource has been lost. Luckily, there is no known way to fully destroy a crystal seed.
translation: 水晶种子是我们最宝贵的资产之一，但自从世界之门失落以来，我们无法返回家园，也就失去了获取这一资源的途径。幸运的是，目前还没有已知的方法能彻底摧毁水晶种子。

english: These scavengers are fascinating. I have read of similar things in the tales of the seafaring folk, who described voyages to distant lands where scuttling creatures called 'skavids' lurked in dark caves, stealing food and shiny objects from nearby settlements.
translation: 这些拾荒者真是迷人。我在航海民族的传说中读到过类似的东西，他们描述了前往遥远国度的航行，那里有叫做'斯卡维德'的爬行生物潜伏在黑暗洞穴中，从附近的定居点偷取食物和闪亮的东西。

english: Our scavengers may be a related branch of the species, though there is no sign of any intelligence here.
translation: 我们的拾荒者可能是该物种的一个分支，不过这里没有任何智慧的迹象。

english: Nevertheless, the larger scavengers have a degree of brute strength, and I envisage they could be useful as warriors if they can be suitably trained.
translation: 尽管如此，较大的拾荒者拥有一定的蛮力，我想如果加以适当训练，它们或许能成为有用的战士。

english: First I must teach my scavengers to obey me. I will begin by making them dependent upon me for food, so that I can use food to reward obedience.
translation: 首先我必须教会我的拾荒者服从我。我会从让它们依赖我获取食物开始，这样我就能用食物来奖励服从。

english: I have collected a supply of cavern grub cocoons, to provide a fresh supply of grubs for my scavengers. These are securely locked away, so that the scavenger cannot obtain them for itself.
translation: 我收集了一批洞穴幼虫茧，为我的拾荒者提供新鲜的幼虫供应。这些被安全锁好，这样拾荒者就无法自己获取了。

english: Next, I began to feed a large scavenger with the grubs. I have fed it daily in its food trough; it no longer even thinks of going scavenging for itself, so it is becoming completely dependent on me.
translation: 接下来，我开始用幼虫喂一只大拾荒者。我每天在它的食物槽里喂食；它现在甚至不再想着自己去觅食了，所以它正在变得完全依赖我。

english: Soon I will begin to send it into battle against the other creatures that roam these caves, and teach it that it must fight if it wants to be fed.
translation: 很快我就会派它去与这些洞穴中游荡的其他生物作战，并教会它，想吃饭就得战斗。

english: This technique of instilling dependency is marvellous. If I can make it work on the scavengers, consider how it could be applied to a wider range of minions. Perhaps one day I could even apply it to the citizens of Kourend, if we can ever return to the kingdom, by taking administrative control of all means of production so that the citizens are fed only at the 'benign' hand of their masters. This may prove a more effective means of control than the brutish methods that failed us before. But that is a consideration for another day.
translation: 这种灌输依赖性的技巧真是妙极了。如果我能对拾荒者奏效，想想看它还能应用到更广泛的仆从身上。也许有一天，如果我们能回到库兰德王国，我甚至能把它应用到库兰德的居民身上，通过掌控所有生产手段的行政控制，让公民只能从他们主人的'仁慈'之手中获得食物。这可能比之前失败的粗暴手段更有效。不过那是以后的事了。

english: Meanwhile I have found some lizardmen in this cave that look like a suitable combat challenge for my scavenger - unfortunately the creatures saw me, and they attacked immediately. I had no trouble retreating, though I have begun to feel unwell since the incident; I do hope their spit has not infected me.
translation: 与此同时，我在这个洞穴里发现了一些蜥蜴人，看起来对我的拾荒者来说是个合适的战斗挑战——不幸的是，那些生物看到了我，立刻发动了攻击。我撤退倒是没什么困难，不过事后我开始觉得不舒服；我真希望它们的口水没有感染我。

english: During the great God Wars there were six brothers who fought side by side against the forces of evil. Their fervor in battle was awed and feared by all who saw them. Nothing is known of their origins, only that they were first seen when the legions of evil were pressing their hardest into civilised lands.
translation: 在伟大的神战期间，有六位兄弟并肩作战，对抗邪恶势力。他们在战斗中的狂热令所有目睹者敬畏和恐惧。关于他们的出身一无所知，只知道当邪恶军团全力压向文明之地时，他们首次现身。

english: It was the eldest who struck the first blow in that battle, hurling powerful battle magic into the enemies' ranks, opening a hole for four of the other brothers to charge through and into the heart of their forces. Little was seen or known of the sixth brother at the time, only that when one of the other brothers looked in danger his foe would be felled by a shower of crossbow bolts. It wasn't until the dust had settled that those left could look on their saviours, the six brothers who stood proud with the bodies of the fallen at their feet.
translation: 在那场战斗中，长兄率先出手，将强大的战斗魔法掷入敌阵，为另外四位兄弟打开了一个缺口，让他们冲入敌军核心。当时对第六位兄弟知之甚少，只知道每当其他兄弟陷入危险时，他的敌人就会被一阵弩箭雨射倒。直到尘埃落定，幸存者才得以瞻仰他们的救世主，六位兄弟傲然挺立，脚下是倒下的敌人尸体。

english: For years these brothers fought hard against the enemy, throwing themselves into battle with little regard for their own safety and relying only on each other for aid. Stories were told around camp fires by soldiers of the feats they'd witnessed, they became legend long before the end.
translation: 多年来，这几位兄弟与敌人殊死搏斗，奋不顾身地投入战斗，只依靠彼此相助。士兵们在营火旁传颂着他们目睹的英勇事迹，他们早在结局之前就已成为了传奇。

english: Some say he'd always been there, but no-one really knows for sure. The first real tale was after an incursion deep into the dark lands, where once again the brothers proved their worth. It was after the battle that a bent and robed figure was seen amongst the bodies of the dead. Most took him for a scavenger, but he moved towards the camp fire of the brothers with such directness that some at first thought him another companion. The brothers however reacted as with suspicion at his approach, drawing their weapons and rising from their places. The stranger merely stood before them, as though sizing them up before turning and walking back into the mists. Some say that it's the first time they'd ever seen the brothers unsure.
translation: 有人说他一直都在那里，但没人真正确定。第一个真实的故事是在一次深入黑暗之地的突袭之后，兄弟们再次证明了他们的价值。战斗结束后，有人看到一个弯腰驼背、身披长袍的身影出现在死者之中。大多数人以为他是个拾荒者，但他径直走向兄弟们的营火，以至于有些人起初以为他是另一个同伴。然而，兄弟们对他的接近表现出警惕，纷纷拔出武器站起身来。那个陌生人只是站在他们面前，仿佛在打量他们，然后转身走回迷雾之中。有人说那是他们第一次看到兄弟们犹豫不决。

english: As the campaign moved deeper into the dark lands the stranger appeared with greater frequency, often appearing on a rise near a battle and watching over it. The most disturbing thing was how his presence started to affect the brothers, they became distracted and on occasion even received injuries that required attention.
translation: 随着战事深入黑暗之地，那个陌生人出现得越来越频繁，常常出现在战场附近的高地上观望。最令人不安的是他的存在开始影响兄弟们，他们变得分心，有时甚至受伤需要照料。

english: It was deep in the heart of the enemies' territory, in the failing light of dusk, that the enemy struck back. Great monstrosities swept through the camps tearing at all in their path, soldiers scattered like chaff in the wind before the onslaught. The brothers, valiant as ever, stood back to back before the enemy and fought with all their might. As dawn broke the enemy fled the battle, moving faster than any man could give chase. It was as the soldiers went about rebuilding the camp that the brothers collapsed at their camp fire, they lay as though dead, yet breathing, muttering in strange tongues. Their injuries were found swollen and infected, none of the physicians knew what to do, it was like no infection they had ever seen before. All through the day the brothers were tended and cared for while the soldiers waited nervously for their heroes to rise once again. It was then, just as the sun's last rays vanished behind the horizon, that all hope was lost. As if on cue all the six brothers sighed one last breath and died. It was only then that the sentries noticed the stranger once again, standing on a rise just outside the camp.
translation: 在敌人领土的深处，在黄昏渐暗的光线中，敌人发动了反击。巨大的怪物横扫营地，撕裂沿途的一切，士兵们在猛攻面前如风中的糠秕般四散。兄弟们一如既往地英勇，背靠背面对敌人，全力奋战。黎明破晓时，敌人逃离了战场，速度快得无人能追。就在士兵们重建营地时，兄弟们在营火旁倒下了，他们躺在地上如同死了一般，却仍在呼吸，用陌生的语言喃喃自语。他们的伤口肿胀感染，没有一个医师知道该怎么办，这就像他们从未见过的感染。整整一天，兄弟们被悉心照料，而士兵们则焦急地等待他们的英雄再次站起来。就在这时，就在太阳最后一缕光芒消失在地平线之后，所有的希望都破灭了。仿佛得到了信号，六位兄弟同时呼出最后一口气，死去了。直到那时，哨兵们才再次注意到那个陌生人，站在营地外的高地上。

english: That night the camp was surrounded by the great beasts of the enemy once again, but they didn't attack, they merely baited the soldiers to come out and meet them. Once again at the break of dawn the enemy fled without a trace, leaving the soldiers tired from a restless night of worry and fear. That day the commanders decided to turn back, they could advance no further without the brothers' aid. As was the custom at the time, out of honour and respect for the mighty fallen, they constructed six great barrows for the brothers. A crypt for each brother covered in a small hill of earth that would hold their remains undisturbed by predators. The work took many days, for each night the enemy returned and the soldiers had to flee back inside their camp to wait away the night to the sounds of howling and scratching at the fences. But each day they resumed their work, their sense of duty to the brothers surmounting their fear of the dark forces in the land.
translation: 那天晚上，营地再次被敌人的巨兽包围，但它们没有进攻，只是引诱士兵们出来迎战。黎明再次破晓时，敌人消失得无影无踪，留下士兵们因一夜不安的忧虑和恐惧而疲惫不堪。那天，指挥官们决定撤退，没有兄弟们的帮助，他们无法再前进了。按照当时的习俗，出于对陨落强者的荣誉和敬意，他们为兄弟们建造了六座巨大的墓穴。每位兄弟一座墓穴，上面覆盖着一小堆土丘，让他们的遗骸不受掠食者的侵扰。工程持续了许多天，因为每晚敌人都会回来，士兵们不得不退回营地内，在嚎叫和抓挠栅栏的声音中度过夜晚。但每天他们都继续工作，对兄弟们的责任感战胜了对这片土地上黑暗力量的恐惧。

english: On the last day the assembled troops buried the brothers inside their stone tombs, then with great reverence, but little ceremony, they covered the tombs with earth. As the army broke camp and turned to march back to their lands the stranger was seen once again, standing atop the central barrow... standing tall against the failing light with his arms outstretched to the sky.
translation: 最后一天，集结的部队将兄弟们安葬在石墓中，然后怀着极大的敬意，但几乎没有仪式，用泥土覆盖了墓穴。当军队拔营转身返回他们的土地时，那个陌生人再次出现，站在中央墓穴之上……在渐暗的光线中傲然挺立，双臂伸向天空。

english: Not many of the original army made it back to these lands, many more had perished on the journey home, but tales were told of how each night an unnatural glow could be seen on the horizon where they had buried the brothers. Even today there are stories told about those mounds of earth, and of the sights and sounds that have been witnessed nearby.
translation: 最初的军队中没多少人能回到这片土地，更多人在归途中丧生，但人们传说着每晚都能在地平线上看到一道不自然的光芒，就在他们埋葬兄弟们的地方。即使在今天，关于那些土丘的故事仍在流传，以及附近目睹的景象和听到的声音。

english: Rashiliyia's rage went unchecked. She killed without mercy for revenge of her son's life. Like a spectre through the night she entered houses and one by one quietly strangled life from the occupants. It is said only a handful survived, protected by the necklace wards to keep the Witch Queen at bay.
translation: 拉希莉娅的怒火一发不可收拾。为了给儿子报仇，她毫无怜悯地杀戮。她如幽灵般在夜间潜入各家各户，悄无声息地将住户一个个绞杀。据说只有少数人幸存下来，靠着护身符的庇护才得以抵挡女巫女王的魔爪。

english: To each their own, I suppose.
translation: 各有所好吧，我想。

english: It's hard to say what sort of chamber Osmumten had built to represent Crondis, since most of it sank into the watery depths long ago. I would have given the world to see it in its original glory, but now it serves as just another tool for the Devourer.
translation: 很难说奥斯穆滕为克伦迪斯建造了什么样的密室，因为大部分早已沉入水底。我愿付出一切去见识它昔日的辉煌，但现在它只是吞噬者手中的又一件工具。

english: In this sunken chamber, the gluttonous Zebak can be found guarding Crondis. Once just a normal crocodile of the Elid, Zebak perfectly embodied Crondis' principles. However, like so many, he fell victim to the manipulation of the Devourer.
translation: 在这座沉没的密室里，贪婪的泽巴克守护着克伦迪斯。泽巴克曾是艾利德一条普通的鳄鱼，完美体现了克伦迪斯的理念。然而和许多人一样，他也成了吞噬者操纵的牺牲品。

english: To be a crocodile in these lands is to live a life of resourcefulness. Food is hard to come by, and death is always just a moment away. Zebak was never the strongest of his kind, or the fastest. However, he may well have been one of the smartest.
translation: 在这片土地上做一条鳄鱼，就要靠机智求生。食物来之不易，死亡随时可能降临。泽巴克从来不是同类中最强壮的，也不是最快的，但他可能是最聪明的之一。

english: Unable to compete with his rivals in the traditional way, Zebak instead used his ingenuity to lure them into elaborate traps. To begin with, he simply took their food and left them to starve, but over time, his hunger grew. Before long, he started to feast on his victims too.
translation: 无法以传统方式与对手竞争，泽巴克便用他的聪明才智将他们引入精心设计的陷阱。起初他只是夺走食物让他们饿死，但渐渐地，他的胃口越来越大。不久之后，他开始连猎物一起享用。

english: In the end, the once weak crocodile had grown to become the strongest. You'd be forgiven for thinking he might have stopped there, but Zebak's hunger knew no end. As he continued to feast, his food supply ran short. This is when the Devourer arrived.
translation: 最终，曾经弱小的鳄鱼成长为最强壮的存在。你可能会以为他会就此收手，但泽巴克的食欲永无止境。随着他不断进食，食物供应开始短缺。就在这时，吞噬者出现了。

english: In return for his service, the Devourer promised Zebak that he would never go hungry again. Blinded by avarice, he willingly agreed.
translation: 作为回报，吞噬者向泽巴克承诺他永远不会再挨饿。被贪婪蒙蔽了双眼，他欣然同意了。

english: Together, Zebak and the Devourer lured Crondis to her imprisonment. Once she was trapped, Zebak eagerly awaited his reward. However, rather than granting the endless supply of food he craved, the Devourer cursed him.
translation: 泽巴克和吞噬者联手将克伦迪斯诱入囚禁之地。一旦她被困住，泽巴克便急切地等待他的奖赏。然而，吞噬者并没有赐予他所渴望的无尽食物，反而诅咒了他。

english: To a being like Zebak, the curse was a fate worse than death, for it caused every bite of food to turn to dust in his mouth. He longed for death, but the Devourer's curse prevented this as well, binding him to the world of the living.
translation: 对泽巴克这样的存在来说，这个诅咒比死亡更可怕，因为每一口食物在他嘴里都会化为灰尘。他渴望死亡，但吞噬者的诅咒也阻止了这一点，将他束缚在生者的世界。

english: Now, the ever-hungry Zebak dwells in this tomb, ensuring that just like him, his former god will never be free.
translation: 如今，永远饥饿的泽巴克居住在这座坟墓中，确保和他一样，他昔日的神明也永远不会获得自由。

english: Well, if it wasn't for me, you might never have found the Myreque. On one hand, that might mean they'd not have ended up getting killed, but on the other, the Drakans might never have been overthrown.
translation: 要不是我，你可能永远找不到迈雷克。一方面，那可能意味着他们不会最终被杀，但另一方面，德拉坎家族可能永远不会被推翻。

english: That's an interesting way of thinking about it.
translation: 这么想倒是挺有意思的。

english: I suppose the important part is that the Drakans have gone, and in some ways, I'm to thank.
translation: 我想重要的是德拉坎家族已经覆灭，而这在某种程度上要归功于我。

english: The crown on display here is the original Crown of Ralos. When King Marhuitz was crowned the first king of Fortis, it was this crown that was placed upon his head.
translation: 展示柜里的这顶王冠是拉洛斯王冠的原件。当马赫维茨国王加冕为福蒂斯首位国王时，戴在他头上的正是这顶王冠。

english: Since its creation, the crown has been worn by every ruler of the Tullus dynasty. However, after the execution of Emperor Imafore and the passing of the throne to the Arkan dynasty, King Mezpah had a new crown created.
translation: 自制成以来，这顶王冠被图卢斯王朝的每一位统治者佩戴过。然而，在伊马福雷皇帝被处决、王位传给阿尔坎王朝后，梅兹帕国王命人打造了一顶新王冠。

english: You find a hole in the floor under the crate! All you can see is the faint glimmer of extremely far below.
translation: 你在箱子下面的地板上发现了一个洞！你只能看到极深处隐约的微光。

english: ... and fall to the bottom of a very deep cavern!
translation: ……然后掉到了一个极深洞穴的底部！

english: Our exploration of the caves is complete, and has been a success.
translation: 我们对洞穴的探索已经完成，而且取得了成功。

english: Our lord's followers have dwindled in number, it is true. Few of us who shared his exile from Kourend are still alive to serve him today.
translation: 我们主的追随者数量确实减少了。当年与他一同被逐出库兰德王国的人中，如今还在侍奉他的已经不多了。

english: Many fell to the perils of the cave; they were weak, and our lord teaches us that the weak should expect no other fate.
translation: 许多人死于洞穴的危险之中；他们太弱了，而我们的主教导我们，弱者不该期待其他命运。

english: Others forced our lord to discipline them, some for outright treachery, some for other failings. Let them remain in this cave as a testament to the supremacy of our lord!
translation: 其他人则迫使我们的主对他们施以惩戒，有些是因为公然背叛，有些是因为其他过失。让他们留在这洞穴中，作为我们主至高无上的见证吧！

english: Our lord has graciously appointed me as his new High Priest, and I shall endeavour to be a more worthy servant than my vain predecessor.
translation: 我们的主仁慈地任命我为新任大祭司，我将努力成为比我那虚荣的前任更称职的仆从。

english: Nevertheless, though our party was reduced in numbers, our lord has led us to victory over the Guardian in the Deep, and has seized the power that he sought.
translation: 尽管如此，虽然我们的队伍人数减少了，但我们的主带领我们战胜了深渊守护者，夺取了他所寻求的力量。

english: Now we make our camp in the Guardian's chamber, among the skulls of its former prey. Although I doubt it has been permanently killed, the Guardian will not trouble anyone again for a long time.
translation: 现在我们驻扎在守护者的密室里，周围是它昔日猎物的头骨。虽然我怀疑它并未被永久杀死，但守护者在很长一段时间内不会再骚扰任何人了。

english: The weapons and armour that we have developed in the caves can stay here, in this place of safety. As our lord now wields power over the crystals of the cave, he intends to create a secure seal around our store. He says it would take an earthquake to shatter it!
translation: 我们在洞穴中打造的武器和盔甲可以留在这个安全的地方。由于我们的主现在掌控着洞穴的水晶之力，他打算在我们的仓库周围施加强力的封印。他说要地震才能将其震碎！

english: I am truly awestruck by the power that our lord now wields. If we were to return to Kourend, as he originally planned, I have no doubt that we would regain our former dominion over the kingdom with very little effort.
translation: 我对我们主现在所掌握的力量深感敬畏。如果我们按照他最初的计划返回库兰德王国，我毫不怀疑我们能毫不费力地重新夺回对这个王国的统治权。

english: However, while our lord remains as secretive as ever - in fact, he has become more so after the treachery of our former followers - I sense he has a new plan in mind.
translation: 然而，尽管我们的主一如既往地神秘——事实上，在前追随者背叛后他变得更加神秘——我感觉到他心中有了新的计划。

english: Perhaps the throne of Kourend has become too small a trophy to satisfy the ambitions of Lord Xeric.
translation: 也许库兰德王国的王座已经太小，配不上泽里克大人的野心了。

english: '...In scarred lands and ruined fields, that circle flaming towers high, where cruel and cursed torments yield, the Dark of Man, the Dagon'hai.'
translation: '...在伤痕累累的土地和废墟之中，那燃烧的圆圈高耸入云，残酷而受诅咒的折磨在此屈服，黑暗之人，达贡海。'

english: 'The Prophecies of Zamorak'
translation: '萨莫拉克预言'

english: ...until the day that the Zamorakian Magi were welcomed among the human numbers. The Zamorakian numbers grew and some moved their order to the city of Varrock. These were the Dagon'hai.
translation: ...直到萨莫拉克法师被人类接纳的那一天。萨莫拉克信徒日益增多，其中一些教团迁往维洛克城。这些便是达贡海。

english: The practices of the Dagon'hai were looked darkly upon by the priests of Saradomin within the walls of Varrock and, thus, the Dagon'hai were forced into a hidden war, away from the eyes of the citizens of Varrock.
translation: 达贡海的行径被维洛克城墙内的萨拉多明祭司视为邪恶，因此达贡海被迫转入暗战，避开维洛克市民的耳目。

english: Priests of Saradomin were found dead in darkened streets and crumbling houses. Dagon'hai were cast into cells and tormented through purification. Varrock was torn between the followers of two warring deities. Yet, the people of Varrock did nothing...
translation: 萨拉多明祭司被发现死于昏暗的街道和破败的房屋中。达贡海被投入牢房，在净化仪式中受尽折磨。维洛克在两个交战神祇的信徒之间撕裂。然而，维洛克的人民却无动于衷...

english: ...until the tower fell. The famed Wizards' Tower in the south burned for what seemed like an age and the people of Varrock knew they had been misled. They turned upon the Zamorakian mages with murderous intent and the Dagon'hai, even with their skills in dark wizardry, were unable to confront such a vengeance-filled assault against their order, supported in full by the priests of Saradomin.
translation: ...直到高塔倒塌。南方的著名法师塔燃烧了仿佛一个世纪之久，维洛克的人民才意识到自己被误导了。他们怀着杀意转向萨莫拉克法师，而达贡海即使精通黑暗巫术，也无法抵挡这场充满复仇的袭击，更何况萨拉多明祭司全力支持这场讨伐。

english: The Dagon'hai were all but decimated. Their numbers were shattered and they hid themselves in the darkest houses in the most dimly lit of streets within the city. Those that survived the exodus delved deeper into the most evil of arcane magic, intent on exacting retribution upon the priests of Saradomin and the people of Varrock.
translation: 达贡海几乎被消灭殆尽。他们的人数支离破碎，躲藏在城市中最昏暗街道上最阴暗的房屋中。那些在逃亡中幸存下来的人更加深入地钻研最邪恶的秘法，意图对萨拉多明祭司和维洛克人民实施报复。

english: Varrock may have fallen if not for the purest of chances. A young guardsman on patrol in the city happened across a dimly lit house in a corner of the city. Sensing something evil in the air, he cautiously peered through one of the small windows and was aghast to see the High Elders of the Dagon'hai engaged in a sacrificial ritual. Sounding the alarm, the guard called for help and the Dagon'hai, knowing they would be slaughtered, fled into the night.
translation: 若非纯属偶然，维洛克恐怕已经沦陷。一名在城中巡逻的年轻守卫偶然发现城市一隅一间昏暗的房屋。他感觉到空气中弥漫着邪恶的气息，便小心翼翼地透过一扇小窗窥视，惊恐地看到达贡海的高阶长老正在进行献祭仪式。守卫发出警报求援，达贡海自知会被屠杀，便遁入夜色之中。

english: The last remaining Dagon'hai were chased throughout Varrock to the great statue of Saradomin himself. Then, they all but disappeared. Nobody knows what happened to them, but some say they were set upon by creatures from the Wilderness. Others say that they teleported themselves away to a place of safety. A few claimed they saw men disappearing into the earth beneath the statue itself. It was as though the statue of Saradomin had claimed their lives in his name.
translation: 最后残存的达贡海被一路追赶到萨拉多明本人的巨大雕像前。然后，他们几乎消失无踪。没有人知道他们遭遇了什么，但有人说他们遭到了荒野生物的袭击。也有人说他们传送到了安全之地。还有少数人声称看到这些人消失在雕像下方的土地中。仿佛萨拉多明雕像以他的名义夺走了他们的生命。

english: The Dagon'hai never reappeared in Varrock, yet the people knew that one day they would return to have their revenge.
translation: 达贡海再也没有出现在维洛克，但人们知道总有一天他们会回来复仇。

english: Due to the nature of the incident, eyewitness reports are conflicting. Consensus is that while on duty guarding artefact 'Imperium', Legionary Gellius broke protocol and interacted with the artefact. This resulted in Legionary Valgus entering a frenzied state. Four legionaries were killed before Valgus was apprehended. By order of the Praefectus Classis, both Gellius and Valgus were later executed.
translation: 由于事件的性质，目击者的报告相互矛盾。共识是，在守卫文物'帝国'时，军团兵盖利乌斯违反规程并与文物互动。这导致军团兵瓦尔古斯陷入狂暴状态。在瓦尔古斯被制服前，有四名军团兵被杀。根据舰队司令的命令，盖利乌斯和瓦尔古斯后来均被处决。

english: With artefact 'Imperium' safely secured, the Praefectus Classis has given consent for a day of celebration before the return voyage. All are invited to join her in her ancestral home. There, we will rejoice, for we have now secured the future of the Empire.

translation: 一名吸血鬼哨兵对你产生了兴趣。

english: You manage to distract the vampyre and sneak away.
translation: 你成功分散了吸血鬼的注意力，悄悄溜走了。

english: You failed to distract the vampyre.
translation: 你没能分散吸血鬼的注意力。

english: This vyrewatch looks busy.
translation: 这名吸血鬼哨兵看起来很忙。

english: This vyrewatch is attacking you!
translation: 这名吸血鬼哨兵正在攻击你！

english: These stairs appear broken. It would be too dangerous to climb these.
translation: 这些楼梯看起来坏了。爬上去太危险了。

english: You search the table and find there is a trapdoor underneath.
translation: 你搜索了桌子，发现下面有一个活板门。

english: You open the trapdoor.
translation: 你打开了活板门。

english: You search the pots.
translation: 你搜索了罐子。

english: You start sketching...
translation: 你开始画草图……

english: You make a sketch of the northern approach.
translation: 你画了一张北面入口的草图。

english: You make the sketch of the western approach.
translation: 你画了一张西面入口的草图。

english: You make the sketch of the southern approach.
translation: 你画了一张南面入口的草图。

english: You insert the key into the lock but it gives you an electric shock.
translation: 你把钥匙插入锁中，但被电击了一下。

english: You search the rune case, but it appears to be empty.
translation: 你搜索了符文盒，但里面似乎是空的。

english: That's going to sting!
translation: 那一下肯定很疼！

english: Who do you think is going to win?
translation: 你觉得谁会赢？

english: That was brutal!
translation: 太残忍了！

english: I felt that one from here!
translation: 我在这里都感觉到了！

english: Tetamo!
translation: 泰塔莫！

english: What a show! Live entertainment is just the best.
translation: 真是一场好戏！现场表演最棒了。

english: Should we stop this? Or is it too entertaining?
translation: 我们要阻止这个吗？还是说太精彩了？

english: We might need to get some ice ready!
translation: 我们可能得准备些冰！

english: Ooh! That's going to hurt!
translation: 噢！那肯定很疼！

english: You search the crate, but don't find anything of interest.
translation: 你搜索了箱子，但没有发现什么有趣的东西。

english: You search the costume rack and find that one of the costumes has a wine stain on it. The label reads: 'Naiatli'.
translation: 你搜索了服装架，发现其中一件服装上有酒渍。标签上写着：'奈亚特利'。

english: You unlock the chest and find a note inside. It reads: 'Taken for a clean. Be back soon.'
translation: 你打开了宝箱，发现里面有一张笔记。上面写着：'拿去清洗了。很快就回来。'

english: Sorry, reckon I won't be doing business with you. Not 'til Cormac trusts you, at least.
translation: 抱歉，我想我不会和你做生意。至少得等科马克信任你才行。

english: I know that it is too late to prevent my execution, and I do not dispute the letter of the charges against me. I did read forbidden books, and I did perform unholy rituals forbidden by the Church of Saradomin. But I hope to show by this account that I did not blaspheme against holy Saradomin but rather acted in his spirit.
translation: 我知道现在阻止我的处决已经太迟了，我也不质疑对我的指控。我确实读了禁书，也确实进行了萨拉多明教会禁止的邪恶仪式。但我希望通过这段陈述表明，我并非亵渎神圣的萨拉多明，而是以他的精神行事。

english: For as long as we know, those who worship Saradomin have fallen prey to demons, both those that are summoned by dark wizards and those that live wild in the desolate north. But even priests of Saradomin know little about these creatures, for all knowledge of them is suppressed by the Church. Should we not know our enemies? If we were to read the tomes of demon-lore, and yet keep the light of Saradomin in our hearts, might we not find new and better ways to fight these beasts?
translation: 据我们所知，崇拜萨拉多明的人一直沦为恶魔的猎物，无论是黑巫师召唤的恶魔，还是荒凉北方野生的恶魔。但即使是萨拉多明的牧师对这些生物也知之甚少，因为关于它们的所有知识都被教会压制了。我们难道不应该了解我们的敌人吗？如果我们阅读恶魔学的典籍，同时心中保持萨拉多明之光，难道不能找到更好的方法来对抗这些野兽吗？

english: It was with that thought in mind that I performed the actions for which I have been convicted. And, as I read about the various types of demon, I did indeed strike upon a way that unholy magic could be used for a holy purpose.
translation: 正是怀着这样的想法，我做了那些导致我被定罪的事情。当我读到各种类型的恶魔时，我确实发现了一种方法，可以让邪恶的魔法用于神圣的目的。

english: Not all demons are most dangerous when they are on our plane as physical beings. There is also a more subtle demonic influence that pervades our world, with demons working behind the scenes to cause natural disasters and accidents. The chief among these demons is Agrith-Naar.
translation: 并非所有恶魔在物质位面以实体形态出现时最危险。还有一种更微妙的恶魔影响力弥漫在我们的世界中，恶魔在幕后制造自然灾害和意外事故。这些恶魔中的首领是阿格里斯-纳尔。

english: The ritual was a success, and the great demon Agrith-Naar appeared before us. We had prepared a magical cage, and with difficulty we imprisoned the demon. However, we were unable to destroy him, though we tried every physical and magical means.
translation: 仪式成功了，伟大的恶魔阿格里斯-纳尔出现在我们面前。我们准备了魔法笼子，费了很大力气才把恶魔囚禁起来。然而，尽管我们尝试了所有物理和魔法手段，却无法消灭他。

english: Do you really want to fire your servant?
translation: 你真的想解雇你的仆从吗？

english: My... wardrobe, madam?
translation: 我的...衣柜，女士？

english: My... wardrobe,?
translation: 我的...衣柜？

english: You wish is my command sir.
translation: 如您所愿，先生。

english: You wish is my command madam.
translation: 如您所愿，女士。

english: You wish is my command.
translation: 如您所愿。

english: Of course not sir. Whatever you require.
translation: 当然不会，先生。您需要什么尽管吩咐。

english: Of course not madam. Whatever you require.
translation: 当然不会，女士。您需要什么尽管吩咐。

english: Of course not. Whatever you require.
translation: 当然不会。您需要什么尽管吩咐。

english: You hand over a magic log.
translation: 你递上一根魔法原木。

english: You hand over a steel bar.
translation: 你递上一根钢锭。

english: You hand over some molten glass.
translation: 你递上一些熔融玻璃。

english: You gaze into the mirror...
translation: 你凝视着镜子...

english: 'You... do not be... long in this... place...
Turn... back now, or... prepare... to meet your... doom...'
translation: '转身...回去，否则...准备...迎接你的...末日...'

english: You should... have listened to me!
translation: 你本该...听我的话！

english: This armour... is for restraint, not... protection...
translation: 这副盔甲...是用来束缚的，不是...防护的...

english: Now I show... you... my true... power!
translation: 现在让你...见识...我的...真正...力量！

english: Hmm? You know very well that your tithe is due, Roavar. I am here to collect.
translation: 嗯？你很清楚你的贡品到期了，罗阿瓦。我是来收取的。

english: Silence! Lord Drakan may be gone, but you owe a personal debt to me, Roavar, unless you have forgotten?
translation: 住口！德拉肯领主或许已经不在了，但你欠我个人债务，罗阿瓦，除非你忘了？

english: Hmmm... Well, for your sake, you had better hope that indeed it is. The mood I am in for having to come to this wolfen cesspit means any shortfall is coming from you directly.
translation: 嗯...好吧，为了你好，你最好祈祷确实如此。我不得不来这个狼人粪坑的心情意味着任何短缺都会直接从你身上扣除。

english: A human, eh? Don't think that silly little ring of yours will fool me. Give me one good reason why I should not just kill you right now.
translation: 一个人类，嗯？别以为你那个可笑的戒指能骗过我。给我一个不立刻杀了你的好理由。

english: A human, eh? Give me one good reason why I should not just kill you right now.
translation: 一个人类，嗯？给我一个不立刻杀了你的好理由。

english: Well, I could tell Sugadinti about you collecting tithes...
translation: 嗯，我可以告诉苏加丁提你在收贡品...

english: Hah! Most entertaining, human! Lord Sugadinti does not have time for a human like you. Besides, Roavar owes me a personal debt, and I do not intend any new laws to stop me from collecting it.
translation: 哈！真有趣，人类！苏加丁提领主可没时间搭理你这种人类。再说了，罗阿瓦欠我个人债务，我不打算让任何新法律阻止我收取。

english: Now, tell me the reason you are here.
translation: 现在，告诉我你为何而来。

english: Malak cuts you and pours some of your blood into the pot.
translation: 马拉克割伤了你，将你的一些血倒入罐中。

english: You add some crushed garlic to the pot.
translation: 你往罐里加了些碾碎的大蒜。

english: You add some spices to the pot.
translation: 你往罐里加了些香料。

english: You pour the blood from the pot onto the tomb.
translation: 你将罐中的血倒在坟墓上。

english: A chunk of ice falls away from the cave entrance.
translation: 一大块冰从洞穴入口处脱落。

english: You are not a powerful enough mage to breach the protective aura.
translation: 你的魔法等级不足以突破防护结界。

english: You need a magic level of at least 50 to enter the Pyramid.
translation: 你需要至少50级魔法才能进入金字塔。

english: Now how can I help you old boy?
translation: 那么，老兄，我能帮你什么？

english: Now how can I help you old girl?
translation: 那么，老姐，我能帮你什么？

english: Now how can I help you old bean?
translation: 那么，老伙计，我能帮你什么？

english: You take a closer look at the golem. It has an 8x8 grid of slots on the back. An inscription above the grid reads: 'Requires eight cells to achieve the correct power level.'
translation: 你仔细看了看魔像。它背部有一个8x8的插槽网格。网格上方刻着：'需要八颗能量电池才能达到正确的功率等级。'

english: You empower the totem.
translation: 你为图腾注入了能量。

english: That kind of spell won't work on this totem.
translation: 那种法术对这个图腾无效。

english: That spell isn't powerful enough to work on this totem.
translation: 那个法术的威力不足以作用于这个图腾。

english: The golem makes a horrible noise and gives you a nasty shock!
translation: 魔像发出可怕的声响，把你狠狠吓了一跳！

english: Any thoughts on Perseriya?
translation: 对佩塞里亚有什么想法吗？

english: It mentioned the Battle for the Eye. I've never heard of it.
translation: 它提到了'眼睛之战'。我从没听说过。

english: Dr Banikan departs.
translation: 巴尼坎博士离开了。

english: The Strangled horde begins to retreat...
translation: 绞杀者大军开始撤退……

english: You failed to keep Kasonde alive
translation: 你未能保住卡松德的性命

english: The plant has been disturbed recently. Something came this way.
translation: 这株植物最近被人动过。有什么东西从这里经过。

english: The ground around the rocks has been disturbed recently. Something came this way.
translation: 岩石周围的地面最近被人动过。有什么东西从这里经过。

english: The bush has been disturbed recently. Something came this way.
translation: 这丛灌木最近被人动过。有什么东西从这里经过。

english: A strange red mist rises from the dying zombie.
translation: 一股诡异的红雾从垂死的僵尸身上升起。

english: The gate seems to respond to the mist bottles you're carrying, but it remains locked. Perhaps more are needed.
translation: 大门似乎对你携带的雾瓶有所反应，但仍然锁着。也许需要更多。

english: The gate absorbs the mist from the bottles you're carrying, unlocking in the process.
translation: 大门吸收了你携带的雾瓶中的雾气，随之解锁了。

english: Apologies, sir, but you will need to collect the resources I have already procured before I commence work on anything new.
translation: 抱歉，先生，您需要先取走我已经采购好的资源，我才能开始新的工作。

english: Apologies, madam, but you will need to collect the resources I have already procured before I commence work on anything new.
translation: 抱歉，女士，您需要先取走我已经采购好的资源，我才能开始新的工作。

english: Apologies, but you will need to collect the resources I have already procured before I commence work on anything new.
translation: 抱歉，您需要先取走我已经采购好的资源，我才能开始新的工作。

english: Excellent choice, sir.
translation: 好选择，先生。

english: Excellent choice, madam.
translation: 好选择，女士。

english: Sorry, sir, but may find it easier to communicate verbally, instead of using the bell.
translation: 抱歉，先生，但您可能会发现用言语交流比用钟更方便。

english: Sorry, madam, but may find it easier to communicate verbally, instead of using the bell.
translation: 抱歉，女士，但您可能会发现用言语交流比用钟更方便。

english: Sorry, but may find it easier to communicate verbally, instead of using the bell.
translation: 抱歉，但您可能会发现用言语交流比用钟更方便。

english: I am afraid I have not managed to collect anything new just yet, sir.
translation: 恐怕我还没收集到任何新东西，先生。

english: I am afraid I have not managed to collect anything new just yet, madam.
translation: 恐怕我还没收集到任何新东西，女士。

english: I am afraid I have not managed to collect anything new just yet.
translation: 恐怕我还没收集到任何新东西。

english: Hmmm... Let me see what this contract says.
translation: 嗯……让我看看这份契约上写了什么。

english: Demonic skin, sounds good!
translation: 恶魔皮肤，听起来不错！

english: Terms of the contract blah blah blah... Pain and suffering... Yeah yeah, the usual.
translation: 契约条款巴拉巴拉……痛苦与折磨……对对对，老一套。

english: How do I actually use this?
translation: 这到底怎么用？

english: Oh, it says that I need to take it to the Makeover Mage!
translation: 哦，上面说我需要把它交给变身法师！

english: To unlock demonic skin, give this contract to the Makeover Mage southwest of Falador.
translation: 要解锁恶魔皮肤，请将这份契约交给法拉多城西南方的变身法师。

english: Reading this scroll will allow you to change the appearance of your Demon Butler inside your Player Owned House to that of the Butler's Bell Demonic Servant from Leagues VI - Demonic Pacts.
translation: 阅读此卷轴后，你将可以把玩家自有房屋中的恶魔管家外观改为第六赛季联赛-恶魔契约中的管家钟恶魔仆从。

english: Once read, the scroll will be consumed.
translation: 阅读后，卷轴将被消耗。

english: Read and consume the scroll.
translation: 阅读并消耗卷轴。

english: You may change the Demon Butlers appearance by talking to them inside your Player Owned House.
translation: 你可以通过与玩家自有房屋中的恶魔管家交谈来更改其外观。

english: Close the scroll.
translation: 合上卷轴。

english: I can combine this quill with a slayer helmet.
translation: 我可以把这支羽毛笔和杀戮者头盔组合在一起。

english: You must first learn how to do this from a Slayer Master.
translation: 你必须先从杀戮大师那里学会怎么做。

english: Some local townsfolk are worried about the mists coming from the North East. Ordered more fire logs from Razmire's shop, must find a more reliable source of fyreneght. That money grabbing Razmire didn't know what I was talking about, had to explain they were ashes! Herbs like harralander, marrentil and tarromin in short supply. I'm hoping the latter will make solution 194 the best yet.
translation: 一些当地居民担心东北方向飘来的雾气。从拉兹米尔的店里订了更多火原木，必须找到更可靠的火焰灰来源。那个贪财的拉兹米尔根本不知道我在说什么，还得跟他解释那是灰烬！哈拉兰德草、马伦提尔草和塔罗明草等草药供应短缺。我希望后者能让194号溶液成为迄今最好的配方。

english: The remains of a primitive temple to the north have piqued my curiosity.
translation: 北边一座原始神庙的遗迹引起了我的好奇。

english: Not much happening today, though the stench from the east increases.
translation: 今天没什么事，不过东边的臭味越来越重了。

english: The people of Mort'ton seem very depressed. Noticed several townsfolk just staring blankly into the air.
translation: 莫顿镇的居民看起来很沮丧。注意到好几个镇民只是茫然地盯着空中。

english: I'll keep further notes to aid my study of the effects from the Sanguinesti region.
translation: 我会继续记录笔记，以帮助我研究桑吉内斯蒂地区的效应。

english: Saradomin protect us.
translation: 萨拉多明保佑我们。

english: Temple is most likely early pagan and devoted to elemental power.
translation: 神庙很可能是早期异教的，供奉元素之力。

english: The townsfolk are quite short in temper and fight readily amongst themselves at the slightest provocation. I've been out with my assistant Liornish Stemplehair, she's an able assistant, but preoccupied with her family life. How will she become a respected scholar in her own right? Temple was almost surely made of limestone bricks and shows signs of heat damage in the centre.
translation: 镇民脾气暴躁，稍有挑衅就会互相争斗。我一直和我的助理利奥尼什·斯坦普尔海尔一起外出，她是个能干的助理，但总是牵挂家庭生活。她怎么能成为一位受人尊敬的学者呢？神庙几乎肯定是用石灰石砖建造的，中心有热损伤的痕迹。

english: Samples from Mort Myre appear inconclusive at this stage, more testing needed.
translation: 莫特·迈尔的样本目前看来尚无定论，需要更多测试。

english: Horror of horrors! The local tradesman Razmire has started charging higher prices for everyday consumables. How will we live? He blames the lack of trade from the temple but I believe he just wishes to fleece us all before leaving the town.
translation: 太可怕了！当地商人拉兹迈尔开始对日常消费品收取更高的价格。我们怎么活啊？他归咎于神庙贸易的缺乏，但我相信他只是想在离开镇子之前榨干我们所有人。

english: Some further experimentation has been inconclusive.
translation: 一些进一步的实验尚无定论。

english: First test vials with Guam not succesful. Senithiline process with water and tarromin proving succesful.
translation: 用瓜姆进行的第一次测试小瓶不成功。用水和塔罗明草进行的塞尼西林过程证明是成功的。

english: Temple to the North, is known to the locals as 'Flamtaer' holds an interesting story.
translation: 北边的神庙，当地人称之为'弗拉姆泰尔'，有一个有趣的故事。

english: Local superstition talks about pagan rites and a sacred flame which could, 'hold for permanence'.
translation: 当地的迷信谈到异教仪式和一团可以'永恒燃烧'的圣火。

english: Was said to be involved in marriage ceremonies due to 'mystical aura'.
translation: 据说由于'神秘光环'，它被用于婚礼仪式。

english: Also have reports of supernatural activity with shadowy creatures being seen!
translation: 还有关于超自然活动的报告，有人看到了阴影生物！

english: Such utter nonesense!
translation: 真是胡说八道！

english: The mists from Mort Myre are getting worse and the stagnation of the swamp is having an effect on the towns people.
translation: 莫特·迈尔的雾气越来越重，沼泽的停滞正在影响镇上的居民。

english: Victims of the effect become vacant and unintelligible, though some words do seem familiar. Only a handful of people have succumbed, but more fall into this state on a daily basis. No known cure at this stage. Heard some further superstitious nonsense regarding a 'sacred-flame' where Flamtaer stood.
translation: 受影响的人变得呆滞且言语不清，虽然有些词似乎很熟悉。只有少数人受到影响，但每天都有更多人陷入这种状态。目前没有已知的治疗方法。还听到了一些关于弗拉姆泰尔所在地'圣火'的迷信胡说八道。

english: A small breakthrough!
translation: 一个小小的突破！

english: A patient only slightly afflicted had a short recovery with solution 194, but this lasted only a few minutes. Although a small step, this gives me a hope that a cure can be found.
translation: 一个轻度被折磨的患者用溶液194短暂恢复，但只持续了几分钟。虽然只是一小步，但这让我看到了找到治疗方法的希望。

english: This new solution might last longer with fyreneght, but I must pack and leave soon before the affliction gets to me.
translation: 这种新溶液加上菲伦格特可能会持续更久，但我必须尽快收拾离开，以免被折磨到我。

english: It's too late!
translation: 太晚了！

english: I already show the signs of the affliction.
translation: 我已经显示出被折磨的迹象。

english: I'm saddened that my work will not reach the scientific community of Varrock.
translation: 我很遗憾我的工作无法传到维洛克城的科学界。

english: I'd have liked to have shown my work before my peers.
translation: 我本想在我的同行面前展示我的工作。

english: Ulsquire makes me laugh, he believes the pagan flame may still have power. Even with this strange affliction, I feel a quiet reservation that...
translation: 乌尔斯奎尔让我发笑，他相信异教的火焰可能仍然有力量。即使有这种奇怪的折磨，我内心有一种安静的保留……

english: Must write this quickly as it's hard to concentrate. Solution 198 was a change to 194 with added Snake-weed.
translation: 必须快点写，因为很难集中注意力。溶液198是对194的修改，加入了蛇草。

english: This had little effect though, solution 194 was still the strongest so far.
translation: 但这效果甚微，溶液194仍然是目前最强的。

english: Need to increase this effectiveness with further refinement of senithiline process and perhaps addition of other compounds.
translation: 需要通过进一步改进塞尼西林过程，或许加入其他化合物来增强这种效果。

english: Possible last entry... solution 194 revised to 207 which gives longer term but still not permanent relief from the affliction.
translation: 可能是最后一条记录……溶液194修订为207，效果更持久，但仍不能永久缓解被折磨。

english: Senithelene works best with added fyrneght but lasts short time... agitation and warmth should seal this..
translation: 塞尼特林与菲伦格特一起使用效果最好，但持续时间短……搅拌和加热应该能封住这一点……

english: This cursed affliction has some evil to it, a darkness I cannot fathom.
translation: 这种被诅咒的折磨带有某种邪恶，一种我无法理解的黑暗。

english: Laughing at Ulsquire before but his suggestions may have merit.
translation: 之前嘲笑乌尔斯奎尔，但他的建议可能有道理。

english: Ffssiies urgsl sikflv dfdsf....
translation: 弗弗西耶斯 乌尔格尔斯 西克弗尔夫 德夫德夫斯……

translation: 溶液含量值索引 (ScV)

translation: 溶液索引

translation: 水 ScV(100)

translation: 菲伦格特 ScV(13)

english: I do not know why it is me that has been chosen by them... but I will not fail them!
translation: 我不知道为什么他们选中了我……但我不会辜负他们！

english: Soft whispers, beckoning me at night... I know what you are!
translation: 轻柔的低语，在夜晚召唤我……我知道你们是什么！

english: I saw one today.
translation: 我今天看到了一个。

english: Magnificence. Is this then, what we all aspire to someday become? Are these beings even natural, or are they beyond what we think of as nature?
translation: 壮丽。这就是我们最终都渴望成为的样子吗？这些生物是自然的，还是超越了我们对自然的认知？

english: The beautiful chittering
translation: 那美妙的吱吱声

english: Dagannoth! I know thee! I call thee! For I too am of the ocean, I too know this land as home!
translation: 深潜者！我认识你！我召唤你！因为我也属于海洋，我也视这片土地为家！

english: Home? Perhaps. Where did you come from? Where do you plan to go?
translation: 家？也许吧。你从哪里来？你打算去哪里？

english: You cannot leave. You MUST not leave. I will ensure it.
translation: 你不能离开。你绝不能离开。我会确保这一点。

english: I find myself thinking often of the time when we can all be together as one in the deep sea.
translation: 我发现自己常常想起我们能在深海中合为一体的时光。

english: Problems arose. Can you not see what I want? Can you not see how we should proceed?
translation: 问题出现了。你看不出我想要什么吗？你看不出我们应该怎么做吗？

english: I have no solution.
translation: 我没有解决办法。

english: I sleep during the days now, my nights are only for you and your kind.
translation: 我现在白天睡觉，夜晚只属于你和你的同类。

english: I am thinking of a door.
translation: 我在想一扇门。

english: We cannot let everyone know of my plans!
translation: 我们不能让所有人都知道我的计划！

english: I was buying food in the nearby town today, the idiot barbarians look at me as though I have lost my wits.
translation: 我今天在附近镇上买食物，那些白痴野蛮人看我的眼神就像我疯了似的。

english: Ha! Like they know what wits even are!
translation: 哈！好像他们知道什么是理智似的！

english: Do they even understand? Of course not they are just barbarians! Soon.
translation: 他们能理解吗？当然不能，他们只是野蛮人！快了。

english: Things fall into place so quickly...
translation: 事情进展得真快……

english: A door. Yes. Definitely a door. But how to keep my secrets secure?
translation: 一扇门。对。绝对是一扇门。但如何保守我的秘密？

english: Disturbing message from the council today, they feel that I am not fulfilling my contract to keep this lighthouse operative correctly.
translation: 今天收到议会令人不安的信息，他们觉得我没有履行合同，没有让这座灯塔正常运作。

english: Do they think I care?
translation: 他们觉得我会在乎吗？

english: Do I even care anymore?
translation: 我还在乎吗？

english: Things proceed apace. I will begin work on the door as soon as I can.
translation: 事情进展顺利。我会尽快开始做那扇门。

english: What can they do to me?
translation: 他们能把我怎么样？

english: Your songs of the night call to me, always.
translation: 你夜晚的歌声总是在召唤我。

english: Always the chittering.
translation: 总是那吱吱声。

english: Did I name you, Dagannoth? Or did you tell me your name in my dreams of you? If I named you, did I also create you just by naming you? Am I then also somehow a part of you, or are you a part of me?
translation: 是我给你命名的吗，深潜者？还是你在我的梦中告诉了我你的名字？如果我给你命名，我是否也仅仅通过命名就创造了你？那我是否也是你的一部分，或者你是我的一部分？

english: Things seem so strange nowadays...
translation: 如今一切都显得那么奇怪……

english: The door is the key. But what should then be the key to the door?
translation: 门就是钥匙。但门的钥匙又该是什么呢？

english: I do not think I am well anymore, it is good to have company.
translation: 我觉得我不太对劲了，有人陪伴真好。

english: Stupid council! Always interfering! You do not know the dagannoth, you have no sway here!
translation: 愚蠢的议会！总是来干涉！你们不了解深潜者，在这里你们没有发言权！

english: I am the sea.
translation: 我就是大海。

english: I see that I am.
translation: 我明白了，我就是。

english: The door. Dagannoth. Will I wake one day and find that my life so far has been naught but a dream, and that under my skin, under my bones, I too am dagannoth?
translation: 门。深潜者。我会不会有一天醒来，发现我的一生不过是一场梦，而在我的皮肤下，在我的骨头下，我也是深潜者？

english: Such dreams I have in the days while I sleep.
translation: 我白天睡觉时做了这样的梦。

english: The chittering is now always ringing in my ears... what are you saying to me???
translation: 那吱吱声现在总在我耳边回响……你在对我说什么？？？

english: The key IS the door! The red of flame, the blue of water. The white of air and the brown of earth.
translation: 钥匙就是门！火焰的红，水的蓝。空气的白和大地的棕。

english: Is this all? Can this be?
translation: 就这些吗？会是这样吗？

english: No, dagannoth, it isn't.
translation: 不，深潜者，不是的。

english: The colours are of deep significance, deep seas, deep thoughts, thoughts of creation, am I a creation, dagannoth? Are you? Then who by?
translation: 这些颜色有着深远的意义，深海，深思，创造之思，我是被创造的吗，深潜者？你呢？那又是谁创造的？

english: And what for?
translation: 为了什么？

english: The door is the key. The key to the door is key. Red and yellow and blue and brown and white and green, put them together and what have you got? The runes. Fire, air, water, earth. The other keys. Weapons.
translation: 门就是钥匙。门的钥匙是关键。红黄蓝棕白绿，把它们放在一起你会得到什么？符文。火、气、水、土。其他的钥匙。武器。

english: I take two other parts of the mixture; the sword of the warrior and the arrow of the huntsman. Can this then keep you bound to this place, dagannoth?
translation: 我取来混合物的另外两部分：战士之剑和猎人之箭。这样能否将你束缚于此，深潜者？

english: We shall see the sea.
translation: 我们将见到大海。

english: Days are a stream of people, buying, selling can you not leave me be?
translation: 日子如人流般川流不息，买卖之间，能否让我独处？

english: I think I understand.
translation: 我想我明白了。

english: I come to thee tonight, dagannoth. I know not how this ends, but will now found out. Farewell land, the sea is now my home, my place, my life.
translation: 今夜我来找你，深潜者。我不知结局如何，但此刻便要揭晓。别了，陆地，大海如今是我的家，我的归宿，我的生活。

english: I have not much time left in this place.
translation: 我在此地时日无多。

english: I return to you in the sea at night.
translation: 我于夜晚回归海中与你相会。

english: Dagannoth. Me. Can you become me?
translation: 深潜者。我。你能成为我吗？

english: Can I somehow... Become you?
translation: 我能否以某种方式……成为你？

english: Experiment is growing larger daily. Making excellent progress now. I am currently feeding it on a mixture of fungus, tar and clay.
translation: 实验体日益壮大。进展极佳。目前我以蘑菇、焦油和粘土的混合物喂养它。

english: It seems to like this combination a lot!
translation: 它似乎非常喜欢这种组合！

english: Experiment still going extremely well. Moved it to the wooden garden shed; it does too much damage in the house! It is getting very strong now, but unfortunately is not too intelligent yet. It has a really mean stare too!
translation: 实验体进展依然极佳。已将它移至木制花园小屋；它在屋里破坏力太大！如今它已非常强壮，但可惜还不够聪明。它的眼神也相当凶狠！

english: Sausages for dinner tonight! Lovely!
translation: 今晚晚餐吃香肠！太棒了！

english: A guy called Professor Oddenstein installed a new security system for me in the basement. He seems to have a lot of good security ideas.
translation: 一个叫奥登斯坦教授的家伙为我的地下室安装了新的安保系统。他似乎有很多不错的安保点子。

english: Don't want people getting into my back garden to see the experiment. Professor Oddenstein is fitting me a new security system, after his successful installation in the cellar.
translation: 不想让人进我的后花园看到实验体。奥登斯坦教授正在为我安装新安保系统，继他成功安装地窖那套之后。

english: That pesky kid keeps kicking his ball into my garden. I swear, if he does it AGAIN, I'm going to lock his ball away in the shed.
translation: 那个烦人的小鬼老是把球踢进我的花园。我发誓，他要是再踢一次，我就把他的球锁进小屋里。

english: The security system is done. By Zamorak! Wow, is it contrived! Now, to open my own back door, I lure a mouse out of a hole in the back porch, I fit a magic curved piece of metal to the harness on its back, the mouse goes back in the hole, and the door unlocks! The prof tells me that this is cutting edge technology! As an added precaution I have hidden the key to the shed in a secret compartment of the fountain in the garden. No one will ever look there!
translation: 安保系统完工了。扎莫拉克在上！哇，真是精巧！现在，要打开自家后门，我得把一只老鼠从后廊的洞里引出来，在它背上的背带装一块魔法弯金属片，老鼠回到洞里，门就解锁了！教授说这是尖端科技！作为额外防范，我把小屋的钥匙藏在了花园喷泉的暗格里。绝不会有人找到那里！

english: Still can't think of a good name for 'The Experiment'. Leaning towards 'Fritz'... Although am considering Lucy as it reminds me of my mother!
translation: 还是想不出给'实验体'起个好名字。倾向于'弗里茨'……不过也在考虑露西，因为它让我想起我的母亲！

english: Oh, calamity! Oh, woe! My precious Fritz! He has been murdered by a wretched adventurer. I came out to feed him this morning and heard a noise. When I got to the shed, Fritz was dead. Oh, my poor heart aches. I will have my revenge on the cowardly person who did this. I notice that the ball has gone too. That pesky kid must have gotten someone to get the ball back for him. Well, I'm not beaten yet! I must plan very carefully.
translation: 天啊！祸事啊！我珍贵的弗里茨！他被一个卑鄙的冒险者杀害了。今早我去喂它时听到动静。等我赶到小屋，弗里茨已经死了。唉，我心痛欲裂。我要向这个懦弱的凶手复仇。我注意到球也不见了。那个烦人的小鬼一定找了人来帮他拿回球。哼，我还没输！我必须精心策划。

english: I am feeling a lot better today than yesterday. Fritz is dead, but it may be for the better. There were some...anomalies with him that concerned me. The potion is not ready yet so I have decided to continue my work on it for now. I went to market today and saw the most astonishing sight! A gnome turned a ogleroot into a gigantic hulk of a vegetable! I must learn the secrets of that spell. I have captured him and put him in my cellar until he tells me the secret of the spell.
translation: 今天感觉比昨天好多了。弗里茨死了，但也许这样更好。它身上有些……异常让我担忧。药水还没完成，所以我决定暂时继续研究。今天去市场看到了最惊人的景象！一个地精把一颗巨根萝卜变成了一株巨大的蔬菜！我必须学会那个法术的秘密。我已将他抓住关在地窖里，直到他告诉我法术的秘密。

english: I have had marginal success with my potion. It is struggling to allow the subject to grasp one solid form, so for now I have had to confine my little darlings to the sewers below to prevent them from being discovered by the local residents of Taverley. They have developed a taste for shrunken ogleroots, it would appear. These have become invaluable for a new potion I have concocted since those pesky mice have been pinching my jewellery again. It is a shrinking potion that will allow me to go into that wretched mousehole and retrieve my belongings.
translation: 我的药水取得了些许成功。它难以让目标保持一个稳定的形态，所以目前我不得不把我那些小宝贝们限制在下水道里，以防被塔韦利村的居民发现。它们似乎对缩小巨根萝卜产生了兴趣。这些萝卜对我新调配的药水变得不可或缺，因为那些烦人的老鼠又偷走了我的首饰。这是一种缩小药水，能让我钻进那个可恶的老鼠洞取回我的财物。

english: I can't afford to lose the recipe for my shrinking potion so I have hidden it in my new safe in the basement. My new experiments are growing well. Unfortunately the new experiment has not worked as I had planned and they appear to have mutated into combinations of various creatures. I will need to keep working on the recipe. Fluffy, my favourite, enjoys throwing shrunken ogleroots back and forth with me in a playful manner. He's quite a character, that one...
translation: 我不能丢失缩小药水的食谱，所以我把它藏在了地下室的新保险箱里。我的新实验体长势良好。不幸的是新实验并未按计划进行，它们似乎变异成了各种生物的混合体。我需要继续完善食谱。毛毛，我最喜欢的那只，喜欢和我来回抛缩小巨根萝卜玩耍。它真是个有趣的家伙……

english: This language is fascinating. I've already managed to translate a few words, but it's going to take a lot more to discover anything of use.
translation: 这种语言令人着迷。我已经翻译出几个词，但要发现有用的信息还需要更多努力。

english: From what I've found so far, it seems that most words are quite generic and often have multiple connected meanings depending on the context. For example, change things slightly and a word for 'sea' might suddenly mean 'river' instead. Change things even more, and it could become 'cold'. I'll need to bear this in mind as I continue my work.
translation: 从目前发现来看，大多数词相当通用，且常根据语境有多种关联含义。例如，稍作变化，'海'这个词可能突然变成'河'。再变一些，可能变成'冷'。继续研究时我得牢记这一点。

english: Vines! Vines everywhere! I'm on the verge of greatness here, but something always gets in the way.
translation: 藤蔓！到处都是藤蔓！我即将取得重大突破，但总有东西挡路。

english: On that note, a few vines may not be all I have to contend with. Upon returning to camp to pick up some secateurs, I found my journal had gone missing. It seems I'm not alone in my search. I'll need to be cautious.
translation: 说到这个，我要对付的可能不止藤蔓。回营地取修枝剪时，发现我的日记不见了。看来搜寻的不止我一个。我得小心行事。

english: There's something different about this place. Something familiar. A stench of death that's hard to forget. Could this be where the Strangler was born?
translation: 这个地方有些不同寻常。有些熟悉。一股难以忘怀的死亡气息。难道这里就是绞杀藤的诞生之地？

english: Yes, your steel gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 是的，你的钢手套最近通过魔力回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: Yes, your goldsmithing gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 是的，你的金匠手套最近通过魔力回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: Yes, your cooking gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 是的，你的烹饪手套最近通过魔力回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: Yes, your chaos gauntlets returned to me through their magic power recently. Would you like them back?
translation: 是的，你的混沌手套最近通过魔力回到了我这里。你想要回去吗？

english: Display number 22
translation: 展示柜22号

english: Two beautiful examples of the many items of pottery found around the Dig Site. There appear to be Saradominist markings upon these artefacts, indicating that this was at one time a Saradominist city. This pottery appears to be dated around the beginning of the 4th Age.
translation: 考古挖掘场出土众多陶器中的两件精美代表。这些文物上似乎有萨拉多明教派的标记，表明这里曾是一座萨拉多明教派城市。这些陶器似乎可追溯至第四纪元初期。

english: Two distinct types of pottery have been recovered from the Dig Site, adding evidence to the two settlements on this site. The red clay pottery appears to be much older and occasionally has purple Zarosian symbols, while the Saradominist artefacts are usually of a lighter shade with blue decorations.
translation: 考古挖掘场出土了两种截然不同的陶器，为这里的两处聚落提供了佐证。红粘土陶器似乎年代更久远，偶尔带有紫色的扎罗西亚符号，而萨拉多明教派的文物通常颜色较浅，饰有蓝色图案。

english: The Layers of Archaeology
translation: 考古地层学

english: Soil Layers
translation: 土壤层

english: O horizon - The top layer of soil is made up mostly of leaves and decomposed organic matter.
translation: O层 - 最上层土壤主要由落叶和分解的有机物构成。

english: A horizon (topsoil) - Plants grow in this dark-coloured layer, which is made up of decomposed organic matter mixed with mineral particles.
translation: A层（表土层）- 植物生长在这层深色土壤中，由分解的有机物与矿物颗粒混合而成。

english: E horizon - This eluviation (leaching) layer has a light colour and is made up of sand and silt. We often find significant archaeological artefacts in this layer.
translation: E层 - 这一淋溶层颜色较浅，由沙和淤泥构成。我们常在这一层发现重要的考古文物。

english: B horizon (subsoil) - Contains clay and mineral deposits that it receives from layers above, when water drips through.
translation: B层（底土层）- 含有从上层随水滴渗下来的粘土和矿物沉积物。

english: C horizon - Regolith consists of slightly broken up bedrock. Plant roots do not penetrate into this layer.
translation: C层 - 风化层由轻微破碎的基岩组成。植物根系无法穿透这一层。

english: R horizon - The bedrock layer that is beneath all the other layers.
translation: R层 - 位于所有其他层之下的基岩层。

english: 5th Age - yr 62
translation: 第五纪元 - 62年

english: The barbarian invaders were running out of steam. They were pretty much forced to make peace or be wiped out, so they agreed to settle down peacefully and make a village on the Misthalin/Asgarnia border, thinking that they could lie low, well-positioned to build up strength and resume their campaign later. This is what is now called the Barbarian Village.
translation: 野蛮人入侵者已是强弩之末。他们几乎被迫求和，否则就会被消灭，于是他们同意和平定居，在米斯林/阿斯加尼亚边境建立了一个村庄，想着可以低调行事，伺机积蓄力量，日后东山再起。这就是现在的野蛮人村庄。

english: 1st-2nd Age
translation: 第一至第二纪元
