english: The 1st Age is thought to have been 4,000 years long. The world of Gielinor was created by the gods Saradomin, Zamorak and Guthix at the beginning of the 1st Age. It's thought that, for much of this time, the gods were still in the process of forming the world and making the various lands, seas, plants and animals.
translation: 第一纪元据推测持续了四千年之久。吉莱诺世界由诸神萨拉多明、扎莫拉克和古斯在第一纪元之初创造。据信，在这段时间的大部分时间里，诸神仍在塑造世界，创造各种陆地、海洋、植物和动物。

english: 2nd Age - Research suggests this age was roughly 2,000 years long. This map is our approximation of the lands at that time, based upon our existing knowledge of the world.
translation: 第二纪元 - 研究显示这一纪元大约持续了两千年。这张地图是我们根据对世界的现有认知对当时陆地的推测。

english: 4th Age - yr 31-60
translation: 第四纪元 - 31-60年

english: A fine example of an incredibly old star chart. Not much is known about it, but the positions of the stars indicate that it was made around the years 31-60 of the 4th Age.
translation: 一张极为古老的星图的精美范例。关于它的信息不多，但星体的位置表明它制作于第四纪元31至60年间。

english: An early 4th Age map showing the human civilisations starting to settle into more permanent villages. After the God Wars, all the races began to rebuild their settlements.
translation: 一张第四纪元早期的地图，显示人类文明开始定居于更为永久的村庄。神战之后，所有种族都开始重建他们的定居点。

english: What little we know of gnomish history is mainly learned from the glider pilots scattered around Gielinor. They did mention that an old gnome engineer called Oaknock used to make model gliders for his children. Oaknock's son, Yewknock, ended up creating this method of transport with inspiration from his father's models. Captain Daerkin and Captain Ninto were said to be the test pilots of the initial prototypes, though enquiries have proved them to be reticent to give much information. It appears that these gliders will safely support one gnome in flight. The staff at the Museum have carefully constructed this replica model.
translation: 我们对地精历史的了解主要来自散布在吉莱诺各地的滑翔机飞行员。他们曾提到一位名叫橡锤的老地精工程师为他的孩子们制作模型滑翔机。橡锤的儿子紫杉锤受到父亲模型的启发，最终创造了这种交通工具。据说达尔金队长和宁托队长是首批原型机的试飞员，但询问后发现他们不愿透露太多信息。看来这些滑翔机可以安全承载一名地精飞行。博物馆的工作人员精心制作了这个复制模型。

english: What little we know of gnomish history is mainly learned from the glider pilots scattered around Gielinor. They did mention that an old gnome engineer called Oaknock used to make model gliders for his children. Oaknock's son, Yewknock, ended up creating this method of transport with inspiration from his father's models. Captain Daerkin and Captain Ninto were said to be the test pilots of the initial prototypes, though enquiries have proved them to be reticent to give much information. Previously, we thought that the strange, 'bird-like', wood and leather gliders that the gnomes find so useful would only support a single gnome in flight. However, due to a brave adventurer heroically aiding the gnomes to save their Grand Tree and earning their gratitude, we find that the gliders can indeed transport at least one human and one gnome. The staff at the Museum have carefully constructed this replica model.
translation: 我们对地精历史的了解主要来自散布在吉莱诺各地的滑翔机飞行员。他们曾提到一位名叫橡锤的老地精工程师为他的孩子们制作模型滑翔机。橡锤的儿子紫杉锤受到父亲模型的启发，最终创造了这种交通工具。据说达尔金队长和宁托队长是首批原型机的试飞员，但询问后发现他们不愿透露太多信息。此前，我们认为地精们觉得极为有用的那种奇特的'鸟形'木皮滑翔机只能承载一名地精飞行。然而，由于一位勇敢的冒险者英勇地帮助地精们拯救了他们的巨树并赢得了他们的感激，我们发现这些滑翔机确实可以运载至少一名人类和一名地精。博物馆的工作人员精心制作了这个复制模型。

english: A striking example of early 5th Age weapon-smithing - this steel sword has been magically treated to make it especially powerful against demons. It is thought to have belonged to a warrior who lived in Varrock. This is a replica; the original Silverlight is in the hands of Sir Prysin of Varrock.
translation: 第五纪元早期武器锻造的杰出范例 - 这把钢剑经过魔法处理，对恶魔特别有效。据信它曾属于一位住在维洛克城的战士。这是复制品；原版银光剑在维洛克城的普里辛爵士手中。

english: A striking example of early 5th Age weapon-smithing, this steel sword has been magically treated to make it especially powerful against demons. It originally belonged to a warrior who defended Varrock from the demon Delrith, and was recently used to drive off the very same demon once again. This is a replica; the original Silverlight is in the hands of a private collector.
translation: 第五纪元早期武器锻造的杰出范例，这把钢剑经过魔法处理，对恶魔特别有效。它最初属于一位保护维洛克城免受恶魔德尔里斯侵害的战士，最近又被用来再次驱赶同一个恶魔。这是复制品；原版银光剑在一名私人收藏家手中。

english: The Brentwood Trading Company
translation: 布伦特伍德贸易公司

english: In the year 144 of the Fifth Age, the young Spencer Brentwood set out to redefine the relationship between humans and the sea. With nothing to his name apart from an unparalleled drive for success, along with a small loan of one million gold from his father, he founded the Brentwood Trading Company, the first step in a journey to greatness.
translation: 第五纪元144年，年轻的斯宾塞.布伦特伍德立志重新定义人类与海洋的关系。除了无与伦比的进取心，以及从父亲那里借来的一百万金币的小额贷款外，他一无所有。他创立了布伦特伍德贸易公司，踏上了通往伟大的旅程的第一步。

english: Brentwood Diving Bell
translation: 布伦特伍德潜水钟

english: As an innovator, Spencer Brentwood has been personally responsible for the development of many new seafaring technologies, with the Brentwood Diving Bell being his defining achievement. This creation unlocked the exploration of the depths in a way never before seen, bringing new benefits to all of humanity.
translation: 作为创新者，斯宾塞.布伦特伍德亲自负责开发了许多新的航海技术，其中布伦特伍德潜水钟是他的标志性成就。这一发明以前所未有的方式开启了对深海探索，为全人类带来了新的福祉。

english: In the year 152 of the Fifth Age, Spencer Brentwood was personally responsible for a discovery that changed everything. While engaging in a philanthropic research dive, Brentwood discovered red coral. Testing quickly showed that when refined correctly, burning this coral granted powerful divinational abilities. Red coral quickly became the most important substance traded by the Brentwood Trading Company, leading to a new name for the organisation: The Red Reef Trading Company.
translation: 第五纪元152年，斯宾塞.布伦特伍德亲自促成了一项改变一切的发现。在一次慈善研究潜水中，布伦特伍德发现了红珊瑚。测试很快表明，如果提炼得当，燃烧这种珊瑚能赋予强大的占卜能力。红珊瑚迅速成为布伦特伍德贸易公司交易的最重要物资，公司也因此更名为红礁贸易公司。

english: Under the guidance of Spencer Brentwood, the Red Reef Trading Company has grown to become one of the largest seafaring organisations around. Brentwood's approach sees profits come second to innovation and discovery, with the company's work in the Red Reef being the finest example of this. There, red coral is sustainably gathered and refined before being distributed across the world, with its divinational properties benefiting humanity in new ways each and every day.
translation: 在斯宾塞.布伦特伍德的领导下，红礁贸易公司已成长为周边最大的航海组织之一。布伦特伍德的理念是创新和发现优先于利润，公司在红礁的工作就是最好的例证。在那里，红珊瑚被可持续地采集和提炼，然后分销到世界各地，其占卜属性每天都在以新的方式造福人类。

english: Donated by one of our citizens, this historic tome details the rise and fall of an order of Zamorakian mages, called the Dagon'hai, residing in Varrock. Skilled in the art of chaos Magic, the Dagon'hai fought continually with the priests of Saradomin until the day they were forced out of the city. They were not seen again until they were discovered recently in a tunnel near Varrock.
translation: 这本历史巨著由一位市民捐赠，详细记载了驻扎在维洛克城的一个名为达贡海的扎莫拉克法师教团的兴衰。达贡海精通混沌魔法之术，与萨拉多明的祭司们不断争斗，直到被赶出城市的那一天。此后他们销声匿迹，直到最近在维洛克城附近的一条隧道中被发现。

english: The open nature of the Order of Wizards ended in disaster in the 70th year of the 5th Age. Zamorakian members of the order betrayed them and burnt down the Wizards' Tower. The tower was rebuilt, but the location of the Rune Essence Mine used by the order was lost. As a result, the further campaigns of the barbarians never happened.
translation: 巫师教团的开放性质在第五纪元70年以灾难告终。教团中的扎莫拉克成员背叛了他们，烧毁了法师塔。塔得以重建，但教团使用的符文精华矿的位置却遗失了。结果，野蛮人的进一步入侵从未发生。

english: A collection of wizards took it upon themselves to resurrect the Mage Training Arena along with all the guardians that were destroyed with it. These guardians were created out of the very same essence as runes, embodying the Magic power and authority needed to oversee the Arena.
translation: 一群巫师自发重建了魔法师训练场以及与之一起被摧毁的所有守护者。这些守护者由与符石相同的精华创造而成，体现了监督竞技场所需的魔法力量和权威。

english: King Roald of Misthalin renovated a ruined town in north-west Misthalin. It was a town once known as Padewwa, but was destroyed during the God Wars and known to the humans only as Ghost Town. King Roald renamed the town Edgeville.
translation: 米斯林国王罗尔德翻新了米斯林西北部一座废弃的城镇。这座城镇曾名为帕德瓦，但在神战中被摧毁，人类只称其为鬼镇。罗尔德国王将其更名为边陲镇。

english: The old king of Asgarnia, King Vallance, falls very ill. The White Knights took advantage of this and began to take control of Falador and Asgarnia for themselves.
translation: 阿斯加尼亚的老国王瓦兰斯国王病重。白骑士趁此机会开始为自己夺取法拉多城和阿斯加尼亚的控制权。

english: Year 163, 5th Age - The White Knights declared that the Black Knights were no longer to have any political power within Asgarnia. Lord Daquarius of the Kinshra immediately responds by declaring his Black Knights as being at a state of war with Falador. The two sides engaged in a big battle to the north of Falador - however, both sides were fairly evenly matched, and retreated to their fortresses to build up their forces and devise plans to crush the other, once and for all.
translation: 第五纪元163年 - 白骑士宣布黑骑士不再在阿斯加尼亚拥有任何政治权力。金什拉的达夸里乌斯领主立即回应，宣布他的黑骑士与法拉多城处于战争状态。双方在法拉多城以北展开了一场大战 - 然而，双方势均力敌，各自撤退到堡垒中积蓄力量，谋划一举摧毁对方。

english: A strange undead necromancer leads an army of undead out of the Wilderness in an attack upon Varrock. Misthalin is strong enough and still has enough runes that the attack is defeated fairly quickly.
translation: 一个奇怪的亡灵死灵法师率领一支亡灵大军从荒野出发进攻维洛克城。米斯林足够强大，且仍有足够的符石，这次进攻很快就被击退了。

english: The Phoenix Gang had a big fight amongst themselves and the Shield of Arrav was broken in half as a result. Shortly afterwards, some gang members decided they didn't want to be part of the Phoenix Gang anymore, so split off to form the Black Arm Gang. On their way out they looted what treasures they could, which included one of the halves of the shield. The Phoenix and Black Arm gangs became bitter rivals - a rivalry that lasts to this day.
translation: 凤凰帮内部发生了一场大内讧，阿拉夫之盾因此断成两半。不久之后，一些帮派成员决定不再留在凤凰帮，分裂出去成立了黑臂帮。离开时他们洗劫了能带走的财宝，其中包括盾牌的一半。凤凰帮和黑臂帮从此成为死对头 - 这种敌对关系一直持续到今天。

english: No information at this time.
translation: 目前无相关信息。

english: Scorpius, the early 4th Age astrologer, used this machine (in the Observatory, which he designed) to track the stars and predict the future, gaining dark knowledge. The plans for his machine were lost in the early 4th Age. In the early 5th Age they were rediscovered and from these plans the Observatory was restored. Since then, many have learned the ways of the astrologer.
translation: 第四纪元早期的占星家斯科皮乌斯使用这台机器（在他设计的观象台中）追踪星体并预测未来，获得了黑暗的知识。他的机器图纸在第四纪元早期遗失了。第五纪元早期被重新发现，并根据这些图纸修复了观象台。此后，许多人学会了占星家之道。

english: The Fremennik mountain tribe has always been opposed to the manufacture of runes, as they feel this should be the work of the gods. A group of the more warmongering of the mountain tribe broke away, led by a warrior called Gunnar, and went on a rampage across northern Kandarin and Asgarnia to put a stop to this 'runecrafting'.
translation: 费明尼克山地部落一直反对制造符石，他们认为这应该是诸神的工作。山地部落中一群更好战的成员在一位名叫冈纳的战士的带领下分裂出来，在北坎达林王国和阿斯加尼亚横冲直撞，试图阻止这种'符文制造'。

english: A group of master smith dwarves, known as the Imcando, were some of the most unfortunate during this period. They had been given many fire and nature runes by the White Knights of Falador to help with their smithing by use of the Superheat Item spell. The invading Fremennik were not happy about all the spellcasting and launched many attacks, reducing the Imcando to near extinction. The invading Fremennik met a fair amount of resistance and their numbers were reduced very significantly over the years.
translation: 一群被称为伊姆坎多的矮人锻造大师是这一时期最不幸的群体之一。法拉多城的白骑士给了他们许多火符石和自然符石，帮助他们使用矿石冶炼术进行锻造。入侵的费明尼克人对这种施法行为极为不满，发动了多次攻击，将伊姆坎多人几乎灭绝。入侵的费明尼克人也遭遇了相当的抵抗，多年来他们的数量也大幅减少。

english: As the manufacture of runes intensified and Magic became available to people of a great variety of ages and backgrounds. It soon became evident just how dangerous this was, with a great many tragic accidents occurring due to inexperienced wizards. Wizards and victims alike called for something to be done, but it was only due to a tragic accident involving one of the leaders of that time that the Mage Training Arena was constructed, established with all skill levels in mind. They even created magic guardians to run the building.
translation: 随着符石制造的加剧，魔法变得对各个年龄段和背景的人开放。很快人们就意识到这有多危险，因为经验不足的巫师造成了大量悲惨的事故。巫师和受害者都呼吁采取行动，但直到当时一位领导人遭遇悲惨事故后，魔法师训练场才得以建造，并考虑到所有技能水平。他们甚至创造了魔法守护者来管理这座建筑。

english: Temple records show that human settlers came to the temple on the River Salve looking for new lands in which to settle. While there were legends that the temple on the Salve was blocking great evil, they refused to heed the warnings of the then custodians of the temple, thinking them possibly behind the times or reciting old legends. The lands of Misthalin and Asgarnia weren't the safest places in the world - the human tribes of these times were having constant troubles with goblins, hobgoblins, giants, etc., so how much worse could Morytania have been? So, human settlers passed over the Salve into Morytania. The Museum recently came into possession of this torn map showing the expansion routes of the settlers.
translation: 神庙记录显示，人类定居者来到萨尔维河上的神庙，寻找新的土地定居。虽然有传说称萨尔维河上的神庙阻挡着巨大的邪恶，但他们拒绝听从当时神庙守护者的警告，认为他们可能跟不上时代或只是在复述古老的传说。米斯林和阿斯加尼亚的土地并不是世界上最安全的地方 - 当时的人类部落不断与哥布林、大哥布林、巨人等发生冲突，那么莫利塔尼亚又能糟到哪里去呢？于是，人类定居者越过萨尔维河进入了莫利塔尼亚。博物馆最近获得了一张破损的地图，显示了定居者的扩张路线。

english: 4th Age - 2,000 yrs long
translation: 第四纪元 - 持续2000年

english: Finds indicate that at the beginning of the 4th Age, the humans who had survived the God Wars formed nomadic tribes that battled for survival against not only each other, but also the dwarves, goblins, ogres, gnomes and many more races that were competing for land and resources. Over time, they started to make more permanent settlements throughout the world, but they continued to battle with their neighbours.
translation: 发现表明，在第四纪元之初，在神战中幸存下来的人类形成了游牧部落，不仅要相互争斗以求生存，还要与矮人、哥布林、食人魔、地精等众多争夺土地和资源的种族竞争。随着时间的推移，他们开始在全世界建立更永久的定居点，但继续与邻国交战。

english: Around the beginning of the 4th Age, a new terror was seen in the world: the dragonkin. Without active gods, the people had to deal with this problem largely by themselves. Heroes arose to step up to this challenge, one of them being Robert the Strong, who led the resistance against the dragonkin threat.
translation: 大约在第四纪元之初，世界上出现了一种新的恐怖：龙人。在没有活跃诸神的情况下，人们不得不主要依靠自己来应对这个问题。英雄们挺身而出迎接这一挑战，其中之一就是强者罗伯特，他领导了对龙人威胁的抵抗。

english: 5th Age - currently 169 years old
translation: 第五纪元 - 目前169年

english: In the first years of the 5th Age, human mages discovered the secrets of making runes from rune essence. They did so by using various runic altars (also called runecrafting altars) across Gielinor. Due to the power of these runes, humans started to become dominant within the world, with the human kingdoms of Misthalin and Asgarnia quickly growing to become the ones we know today. The mages who discovered rune essence (modelled here) set up a great tower of wizardry in southern Misthalin.
translation: 在第五纪元的最初几年，人类法师发现了用符文精华制造符石的秘密。他们利用吉莱诺各地的各种符石祭坛（也称为符文制造祭坛）来做到这一点。由于这些符石的力量，人类开始在世界中占据主导地位，米斯林和阿斯加尼亚的人类王国迅速发展成为我们今天所知的样貌。发现符文精华的法师们（此处为模型）在米斯林南部建立了一座宏伟的巫师塔。

english: A tide of evil creatures from the east threatened Avarrocka and border skirmishes were seen between them and the human settlers. Seven priestly warriors - Iriandul Caistlyn, Sarl Dunegun, Friar Twiblick, Derygull, Ivandis Seergaze, Erysail the Pious and Essiandar Gar - attempted to drive the evil creatures back into what we now know as Morytania. Saradomin blessed the River Salve, making it impassable to the foul things lurking in the swamps, and the brave priests were buried in the temple above the river.
translation: 一股来自东方的邪恶生物浪潮威胁着阿瓦罗卡，人类定居者与它们之间发生了边境冲突。七位祭司战士 - 伊里安杜尔.凯斯特林、萨尔.杜内根、特威布利克修士、德里古尔、伊万迪斯.西尔盖兹、虔诚的埃里赛尔和埃西安达尔.加尔 - 试图将邪恶生物赶回我们现在所称的莫利塔尼亚。萨拉多明祝福了萨尔维河，使其对沼泽中潜伏的污秽之物无法通行，勇敢的祭司们被安葬在河上的神庙中。

english: A tide of evil creatuers from the east threatened Avarrocka and border skirmishes were seen between them and the human settlers. Seven priestly warriors - Iriandul Caistlyn, Sarl Dunegun, Friar Twiblick, Derygull, Ivandis Seergaze, Erysail the Pious and Essiandar Gar - attempted to drive the evil creatures back into what we now know as Morytania. Saradomin blessed the River Salve, making it impassable to the foul things lurking in the swamps, and the brave priests were buried in the temple above the river. However, recent information we have received suggests that Ivandis may have actually been buried in a secret cave in Morytania.
translation: 来自东方的邪恶生物潮威胁着阿瓦洛克，人类定居者与它们之间发生了边境冲突。七位祭司战士——伊里安杜尔·凯斯特林、萨尔·杜内根、特威布利克修士、德里古尔、伊万迪斯·西尔盖兹、虔诚的埃里赛尔和埃西安达尔·加尔——试图将邪恶生物赶回我们现在所称的莫利塔尼亚。萨拉多明祝福了萨尔维河，使其成为沼泽中潜伏的邪恶之物无法逾越的屏障，勇敢的祭司们被安葬在河上方的神庙中。然而，我们最近获得的信息表明，伊万迪斯实际上可能被埋葬在莫利塔尼亚的一个秘密洞穴中。

english: Arrav is probably the best known hero from the 4th Age. In his youth, he was found by a tribe that took him to be a good omen and set up a camp that they called Avarrocka. That camp, in later years, became known as our glorious city of Varrock. Many legends are told of Arrav's heroics later in his life.
translation: 阿拉夫可能是第四纪元最著名的英雄。年轻时，他被一个部落发现，部落视他为吉兆，并建立了一个营地，称之为阿瓦洛克。那个营地在后来的岁月中成为了我们辉煌的维洛克城。关于阿拉夫晚年英勇事迹的传说数不胜数。

english: The shield of Arrav was lost in year 143 of the 5th Age, when a gang of thieves called the Phoenix Gang broke into Varrock Museum and stole it. King Roald has offered a 1,200gp bounty for the reward of the shield and we keep this display case empty in the hopes it will one day be returned.
translation: 阿拉夫之盾在第五纪元143年遗失，当时一伙名为凤凰帮的盗贼闯入维洛克博物馆将其盗走。罗尔德国王悬赏1,200金币寻找此盾，我们一直让这个展示柜空着，希望有朝一日它能被归还。

english: Arrav is probably the best known hero from the 4th Age. In his youth, he was found by a tribe that took him to be a good omen and set up a camp which they called Avarrocka. That camp, in later years, became known as our glorious city of Varrock. Many legends are told of Arrav's heroics later in his life.
translation: 阿拉夫可能是第四纪元最著名的英雄。年轻时，他被一个部落发现，部落视他为吉兆，并建立了一个营地，称之为阿瓦洛克。那个营地在后来的岁月中成为了我们辉煌的维洛克城。关于阿拉夫晚年英勇事迹的传说数不胜数。

english: The shield you see here actually belonged to Arrav. For a time, this priceless exhibit was lost to us, when a bunch of thieves called the Phoenix Gang broke into the Varrock Museum and stole it. We thank the daring adventurer who recently returned the shield to us.
translation: 你在这里看到的这面盾牌实际上属于阿拉夫。有一段时间，这件无价之宝从我们手中失落，当时一伙名为凤凰帮的盗贼闯入维洛克博物馆将其盗走。我们感谢那位最近将盾牌归还给我们的勇敢冒险者。

english: The Shield of Arrav has been temporarily removed for security reasons. So, if you are a hopeful marauding zombie, the museum exit is on the ground floor.
translation: 出于安全原因，阿拉夫之盾已被暂时移走。所以，如果你是一个满怀希望的掠夺僵尸，博物馆出口在一楼。

english: The shield has magical properties and was recently used to destroy a horde of zombies that invaded Varrock.
translation: 这面盾牌具有魔法属性，最近被用来消灭了一群入侵维洛克的僵尸。

english: End of 2nd Age
translation: 第二纪元结束

english: This is a replica of the Staff of Armadyl, made from descriptions given to us by a brave adventurer. Armadyl is said to be a god whom was worshipped during the 2nd and 3rd Ages, though he does not seem to have much of a following in modern times.
translation: 这是阿玛杜尔杖的复制品，根据一位勇敢冒险者给我们的描述制作而成。据说阿玛杜尔是第二和第三纪元被崇拜的神，尽管在现代他似乎没有太多追随者。

english: This is a replica of the Staff of Armadyl, made from descriptions given to us by a brave adventurer. It was this staff, wielded by Zamorak, which killed the god Zaros and cursed all those who aided this treacherous deed. It would seem that it was around this time that Zamorak ascended to godhood. Not much is known of what happened to the staff afterwards, until its recent discovery. Armadyl is said to be a god whom was worshipped during the 2nd and 3rd Ages, though he does not seem to have much of a following in modern times.
translation: 这是阿玛杜尔杖的复制品，根据一位勇敢冒险者给我们的描述制作而成。正是这把由扎莫拉克挥舞的法杖杀死了扎罗斯神，并诅咒了所有协助这一背信弃义行为的人。似乎正是在这个时候，扎莫拉克升格为神。此后关于这把法杖的下落知之甚少，直到最近被发现。据说阿玛杜尔是第二和第三纪元被崇拜的神，尽管在现代他似乎没有太多追随者。

english: This statuette was found in an underground temple in the ruined city of Uzer, which was destroyed late in the 3rd Age, suddenly, due to causes unknown. It probably represents one of the clay golems that the craftsmen of the city built as warriors and servants. The statuette was originally part of a mechanism whose purpose is unknown.
translation: 这尊小雕像是在乌泽尔废墟城市的一座地下神庙中发现的，该城市在第三纪元末期因未知原因突然被毁。它可能代表了该城工匠建造的粘土魔像之一，作为战士和仆人。这尊小雕像原本是一个用途未知的机械装置的一部分。

english: Recently this display was stolen and its whereabouts are unknown.
translation: 最近这件展品被盗，目前下落不明。

english: 3rd Age - 4,000 years long
translation: 第三纪元 - 长达4,000年

english: The scorched earth of the Wilderness is a lasting reminder of the destruction wrought during the God Wars. The little evidence found intact from these times would indicate that most of the mortal races only just survived this onslaught. Stories handed down over generations tell of great, powerful entities and agents of the gods fighting cataclysmic wars. However, at the end of this 4,000 year long 3rd Age, it seems that Saradomin, Guthix and Zamorak settled for less direct influence on our world.
translation: 荒野的焦土是神战期间所造成破坏的永恒提醒。从这些时代发现的少量完整证据表明，大多数凡人种族只是勉强在这场浩劫中幸存下来。代代相传的故事讲述了强大的实体和神的代理人进行灾难性战争的事迹。然而，在这长达4,000年的第三纪元结束时，萨拉多明、古斯和扎莫拉克似乎选择了对我们世界进行不那么直接的影响。

english: An evil vampyre lord started to take control over northern Morytania and his minions visited the various human groups in the area demanding blood tithes, causing widespread panic. Werewolves founded a settlement near to the temple. From the few survivors, we learned that most of the human inhabitants eventually succumbed and paid the blood tithe imposed by the vampyres. Only the inhabitants of Castle Fenkenstrain stood up to this evil influence.
translation: 一个邪恶的吸血鬼领主开始控制莫利塔尼亚北部，他的爪牙拜访该地区的各个人类群体，要求缴纳血税，引发了广泛的恐慌。狼人在神庙附近建立了一个定居点。从少数幸存者那里，我们得知大多数人类居民最终屈服并缴纳了吸血鬼强加的血税。只有芬肯斯坦城堡的居民抵抗了这种邪恶势力。

english: Infiltrate fortress...
translation: 潜入堡垒...

english: How many Nightmare Zone Points would you like? (0-<Num0>)
translation: 你想要多少噩梦地带积分？(0-<Num0>)

english: Donovan has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 多诺万又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Donovan has given you a casket!
translation: 多诺万给了你一个宝箱！

english: You use <Num0> Sunfire splinters to charge Dizana's quiver. It now has <Num1> charges.
translation: 你使用<Num0>个阳火碎片为迪扎纳的箭袋充能。它现在有<Num1>次充能。

english: Dizana's quiver is already fully charged.
translation: 迪扎纳的箭袋已完全充能。

english: You bless Dizana's quiver, allowing it to not need charges.
translation: 你祝福了迪扎纳的箭袋，使其不再需要充能。

english: You're him! The one who murdered the General's pet. Leave this place at once!
translation: 就是你！那个杀害将军宠物的人。立刻离开这里！

english: You're her! The one who murdered the General's pet. Leave this place at once!
translation: 就是你！那个杀害将军宠物的人。立刻离开这里！

english: You're them! The one who murdered the General's pet. Leave this place at once!
translation: 就是你们！那个杀害将军宠物的人。立刻离开这里！

english: This small symbol was used as a decoration on the Saradominist altars throughout the city. Two or three examples have been found, but this is the best. Worked in blue-enamelled bronze, it has not survived the ages well. We believe this to be from the early years when the city was still being built.
translation: 这个小符号曾被用作全城萨拉多明祭坛上的装饰。已发现两三个类似物品，但这是最好的一个。由蓝色珐琅青铜制成，历经岁月保存不佳。我们相信这来自城市仍在建设中的早期年代。

english: Thought to be an altar decoration, possibly celebrating the beginning of the 4th Age when Saranthium was at its most vibrant. Lovingly crafted in silver and sapphire, it is still in good condition.
translation: 被认为是祭坛装饰，可能庆祝第四纪元开始时萨兰提姆最繁荣的时期。以银和蓝宝石精心打造，至今仍保存完好。

english: One of the few vases found in good condition. Its markings show some kind of celebration to Saradomin.
translation: 少数保存完好的花瓶之一。其标记显示某种对萨拉多明的庆祝活动。

english: Fine silver and gold jewellery has been found concealed in one of the many urns scattered around the Dig Site. Not much is known about it, although most of the items do have Saradominist markings.
translation: 在考古挖掘场各处散布的众多骨灰瓮之一中发现了精美的银和金首饰。关于它知之甚少，尽管大多数物品确实带有萨拉多明标记。

english: Arrowheads of crude bronze have been found along with the finds deeper in the Dig Site, which leads us to believe that the forces occupying the city before the Saradominists used bows, as well as other methods of war.
translation: 在考古挖掘场更深处发现了粗糙的青铜箭头，这让我们相信在萨拉多明信徒之前占领该城的军队使用弓箭以及其他战争手段。

english: Found at the Dig Site east of Varrock by a recently qualified archaeologist. It appears to be a symbol of the god, Zaros.
translation: 由一位刚获得资格的考古学家在维洛克以东的考古挖掘场发现。它似乎是扎罗斯神的符号。

english: Excavated recently from a cavernous temple below the Dig Site by a recently qualified archaeologist. It is of great significance, as it proves the existence of a settlement that predates the Saradominist city currently being excavated. The temple appears to be dedicated to the pagan god, Zaros, and survived the destruction of the Zarosian city which was rebuilt by Saradominists.
translation: 最近由一位刚获得资格的考古学家从考古挖掘场下方的一个巨大神庙中发掘出来。它具有重大意义，因为它证明了在目前正在发掘的萨拉多明城市之前存在一个定居点。该神庙似乎是献给异教神扎罗斯的，并在被萨拉多明信徒重建的扎罗斯城市的毁灭中幸存下来。

english: King Ulthas of Ardougne dies from an accidental arrow shot while out on a hunting expedition. Ardougne is left to his two sons Tyras and Lathas with the city split between them.
translation: 阿多尼城的乌尔萨斯国王在一次狩猎远征中因意外箭伤去世。阿多尼城留给了他的两个儿子泰拉斯和拉萨斯，城市在他们之间分割。

english: King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table arrive on Gielinor in year 132 of the 5th Age. Legend says they will return to Britain in its time of greatest need, so they're passing their time on Gielinor until then. King Ulthas saw them as good and rightful men who would do much good in the world, and granted them a large area of land to set up a new Camelot in north-east Kandarin. This is a replica of King Arthur's sword, Excalibur.
translation: 亚瑟王和圆桌骑士在第五纪元132年抵达吉里诺尔。传说他们将在不列颠最需要的时候返回，所以他们在此之前在吉里诺尔消磨时光。乌尔萨斯国王视他们为善良正直之人，会在世界上做许多好事，于是赐予他们坎达林王国东北部的大片土地，建立新的卡美洛。这是亚瑟王的王者之剑的复制品。

english: The kingdom of Asgarnia grew rapidly. King Raddallin, who was one of the tribal leaders of the area, had united many of the smaller tribes and settlements. However, one group within his domain is known as the Kinshra, or Black Knights. They had originally proved cooperative in helping the expansion of the kingdom of Asgarnia, and as a result he'd supported them in building a great fortress on his border to the Wilderness in the north-east. Another group known as the White Knights had also proven to be particularly competent in battle and were now helping him by being the main military force defending his capital city of Falador. However, it turned out that the White Knights and Black Knights had always been bitter rivals. It has been a constant political battle ever since for the kings of Asgarnia to prevent their kingdoms sliding into an out-and-out, very bloody civil war.
translation: 阿斯加尼亚王国迅速发展。国王拉达林是该地区的部落首领之一，他统一了许多较小的部落和定居点。然而，他的领地内有一个被称为金什拉或黑骑士的群体。他们最初在帮助阿斯加尼亚王国扩张方面表现出合作态度，因此他支持他们在东北部通往荒野的边境上建造一座巨大的堡垒。另一个被称为白骑士的群体也证明在战斗中特别能干，现在作为保卫首都法拉多城的主要军事力量帮助他。然而，事实证明白骑士和黑骑士一直是宿敌。此后，阿斯加尼亚的国王们一直在进行持续的政治斗争，以防止他们的王国陷入全面而血腥的内战。

english: The invading Fremennik had a number of sympathisers within the kingdom of Misthalin. There were many warriors skilled in the art of the sword and bow that take offence to this art of spellcasting, and taking matters into their own hands, they destroyed the Mage Training Arena.
translation: 入侵的费明尼克人在米斯塔林王国内部有不少同情者。许多精通剑术和弓术的战士对这种施法艺术感到不满，于是自行采取行动，摧毁了魔法师训练场。

english: Settlers established a town on the River Lum. Across the river they build a bridge and hence the town became called Lumbridge. This heralded more human settlements springing up early in the next age, where humans began to move into the desert, establishing Al Kharid, and towns on both Karamja and Entrana.
translation: 定居者在卢姆河畔建立了一个城镇。他们在河上建了一座桥，因此该镇被称为仑桥镇。这预示着下个纪元初期更多人类定居点的涌现，人类开始进入沙漠，建立了阿尔卡里德城，并在卡拉姆詹岛和恩特纳岛上建立了城镇。

english: Using the power of runes, Saradominist humans in Kandarin, led by the Carnillean family, became confident and decided to take on the evil influences resident in the area around what is now known as Ardougne. From there, they expanded their territory until Kandarin was the largest of the human kingdoms.
translation: 坎达林王国的萨拉多明信徒在卡尼利安家族的带领下，利用符文的威力变得自信，决定对抗现在被称为阿多尼城地区周围的邪恶势力。从那里，他们扩展领土，直到坎达林成为最大的人类王国。

english: Using the power of runes, Saradominist humans in Kandarin, led by the Carnillean family, became confident and decided to take on the evil influences resident in the area around what is now know as Ardougne. Of particular note was an evil lord by the name of Hazeel, so they stormed his home and defeated the Zamorakians inside. The following morning, the Carnillean forefathers moved into the empty household and claimed it as their own. From this base the Carnilleans began to build the city of Ardougne. From there, they expanded their territory until Kandarin was the largest of the human kingdoms.
translation: 坎达林王国的萨拉多明信徒在卡尼利安家族的带领下，利用符文的威力变得自信，决定对抗现在被称为阿多尼城地区周围的邪恶势力。特别值得注意的是一个名叫哈兹尔的邪恶领主，于是他们突袭了他的住所，击败了里面的扎莫拉克信徒。第二天早上，卡尼利安先祖搬进了空置的宅邸，将其据为己有。从这个基地开始，卡尼利安家族开始建造阿多尼城。从那里，他们扩展领土，直到坎达林成为最大的人类王国。

english: Taverley is the site of the only known example of a surviving druidic stone circle, but the druids of Guthix speak of many others scattered across Gielinor in the past. Our best dating techniques place them in the 4th Age. The druids built them to worship Guthix all across the world. The Druids claim to be keeping watch for Guthix, keeping balance in the world.
translation: 塔韦利村是已知唯一存活的德鲁伊石圈遗址，但古斯教的德鲁伊们提到过去在吉列诺各地散布着许多这样的石圈。我们最好的年代测定技术将它们定位在第四纪元。德鲁伊们建造这些石圈是为了在世界各地崇拜古斯。德鲁伊们声称他们在守护古斯，维持世界的平衡。

english: The quiver on display here is a replica of the one originally created by the hero Dizana. The hardiness of the quiver, along with Dizana's fame, led to many of these replicas being created. Some of them still exist today and are often used by fighters in the Fortis Colosseum.
translation: 这里展示的箭袋是英雄迪扎纳最初制作的箭袋的复制品。箭袋的耐用性加上迪扎纳的名声，导致了许多这样的复制品被制作出来。其中一些至今仍存在，常被福蒂斯竞技场的战士使用。

english: The status of the original quiver is heavily debated. Many claim that it has long been lost, while others believe it exists among the replicas being used within the Colosseum.
translation: 关于原始箭袋的下落争议很大。许多人声称它早已遗失，而另一些人则认为它存在于竞技场中使用的复制品之中。

english: Buy me a drink pleassh...
translation: 给我买杯酒喝嘛...

english: Yes I know! Luckily for you it washed up on the banks of the Salve earlier! Here, take it again, but please try and be more careful this time. It's a family heirloom after all!
translation: 是的，我知道！算你走运，它之前被冲到了萨尔维河的岸边！来，再拿去吧，但请这次小心点。毕竟这是传家宝！

english: Hello again, Drezel. Is there anything that I can help you out with around here?
translation: 又见面了，德雷泽尔。这里有什么我能帮忙的吗？

english: Well... I don't think so, but thank you for offering.
translation: 嗯...我想没有，但谢谢你的好意。

english: You successfully remake the key.
translation: 你成功重新制作了钥匙。

english: So while you were gone, Bob popped up! I remembered you mentioning an amulet, so I managed to get myself one. Bob's taught me so much about the dragonkin! How are things going with you?
translation: 你不在的时候，鲍勃出现了！我记得你提过一条护身符，所以我设法给自己弄了一条。鲍勃教了我很多关于龙人的事！你那边进展如何？

english: I've managed to recover the four key pieces, but I still need to reforge the key.
translation: 我已经找回了四块钥匙碎片，但我还需要重新锻造钥匙。

english: There is a forge built by the dragonkin. They used it to make weapons out of orikalkum.
translation: 有一座龙人建造的熔炉。他们用它来制作奥利卡库姆武器。

english: Do you remember where it is?
translation: 你还记得它在哪吗？

english: Hmm... I'll see what I can find.
translation: 嗯...我看看能找到什么。

english: Talk to King Thoros, Chieftain Brundt and Sir Amik Varze. Tell them that they are needed in Varrock to discuss the dragon threat. Now hurry up and get it done.
translation: 去找索罗斯国王、布伦特酋长和阿米克.瓦尔泽爵士谈谈。告诉他们需要到维洛克城商讨巨龙威胁的事。现在快去办。

english: Fair enough. I'll see you there.
translation: 好吧。到时候见。

english: Thx
translation: 谢了

english: Yw
translation: 不客气

english: Buying 2k nats - no noob offers
translation: 收2k自然符文 - 菜鸟勿扰

english: Olivia - please go away!
translation: 奥利维亚 - 请走开！

english: The key disintegrates as it unlocks the door.
translation: 钥匙在打开门时碎裂了。

english: You put the silk into the opening in the door.
translation: 你把丝绸放进了门上的开口。

english: You put the Lobster pot into the opening in the door.
translation: 你把龙虾笼放进了门上的开口。

english: You put the unfired bowl into the opening in the door.
translation: 你把未烧制的碗放进了门上的开口。

english: You pour the Wizard's Mind Bomb into the opening in the door.
translation: 你把法师心灵炸弹倒进了门上的开口。

english: The door opens...
translation: 门开了...

english: Wormbrain drops a map piece on the floor.
translation: 虫脑掉了一块地图碎片在地上。

english: You still need one more piece of map.
translation: 你还缺一块地图碎片。

english: I canna help ye. And right sorry I be to see a fine young 'un like yerself go off to yer doom.
translation: 我帮不了你。看到像你这样优秀的年轻人去送死，我真是深感遗憾。

english: Aye, laddie, that it is.
translation: 是的，小伙子，就是那样。

english: Aye, lassie, that it is.
translation: 是的，姑娘，就是那样。

english: Why, hello there, kid. Me friends call me Ned. I was a man of the sea, but it's past me now. Could I be making or selling you some rope?
translation: 哎呀，你好啊，小子。朋友们都叫我内德。我曾经是个海员，但那都是过去的事了。我能给你做点或卖点绳子吗？

english: Hello again, kid. Something I can help you with? Want to buy some rope perhaps?
translation: 又见面了，小子。有什么我能帮你的吗？也许想买点绳子？

english: That's a relief. I would hate to see such a promising adventurer cut down in their prime.
translation: 那就好。我可不想看到这么有前途的冒险者英年早逝。

english: You cut off Elvarg's head as proof of your victory!
translation: 你砍下了艾尔瓦格的头颅作为胜利的证明！

english: Are you sure you want to convert your Dragon axe into a felling axe? This cannot be undone.
translation: 你确定要把你的龙金斧转换成伐木斧吗？这个操作无法撤销。

english: A crystal singing bowl might help with that...
translation: 水晶颂钵或许能帮上忙...

english: This will consume your equipment seed, dragon pickaxe and crystal shards. Reverting the pickaxe will not give you any crystal shards back.
translation: 这将消耗你的装备种子、龙金镐和水晶碎片。还原镐子不会返还任何水晶碎片。

english: With the help of the crystal bowl, you sing a beautiful song and shape the crystals.
translation: 在水晶碗的帮助下，你唱出美妙的歌声并塑造了水晶。

english: You can only use edible food on him.
translation: 你只能对他使用可食用的食物。

english: Oh, erm, never mind.
translation: 哦，呃，没事。

english: I thought so.
translation: 我也这么想。

english: Pretty tired and dirty to be honest.
translation: 说实话，又累又脏。

english: All part of the service.
translation: 服务的一部分。

english: Just one entrance.
translation: 只有一个入口。

english: Nothing bigger than you or I.
translation: 没有比你或我更大的东西。

english: The suqah will never fit through that tunnel.
translation: 苏卡根本过不了那条隧道。

english: You don't need to improve Cyrisus's health any more.
translation: 你不需要再提升西里苏斯的健康了。

english: Oh, and if you want, you can contact me with the Astral Contact spell in the Lunar Spellbook. It might save you running back and forth.
translation: 哦，如果你想的话，可以用月亮魔法书里的星体联络法术联系我。这样也许能省得你来回跑。

english: Cyrisus isn't going to want to wear that!
translation: 西里苏斯可不会想穿那个！

english: Warning: You can proceed into the dream, but if you die you will lose your items and have to find your way back to the island. The lectern in the dream has a right-click option to leave should you want a fast exit!
translation: 警告：你可以进入梦境，但如果死亡，你将失去所有物品，并且必须重新找到回岛的路。梦中的讲台有右键选项可以离开，方便快速退出！

english: You rub together the dry sticks and the sticks smoke momentarily then die out.
translation: 你摩擦干树枝，树枝冒了一会儿烟，然后熄灭了。

english: You rub together the dry sticks but nothing happens. You need a Firemaking level of 30 or above.
translation: 你摩擦干树枝，但什么也没发生。你需要生火等级达到30或以上。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build dragon salvaging hooks on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造龙金打捞钩。你记住了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build dragon helms on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造龙金头盔。你记住了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build dragon keels on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造龙金龙骨。你记住了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: You'll need a hammer if you wish to construct a dragonfire shield.
translation: 如果你想制作龙火盾，你需要一把锤子。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build dragon cannons on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造龙金大炮。你记住了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: Well, you're a braver woman than I!
translation: 好吧，你比我勇敢！

english: Hawhaw! 'What's that' she asks, what a sense of humour! The Black Guard is the finest regiment in the dwarven army. Only the best of the best are allowed to join it and then they receive months of rigorous training.
translation: 哈哈！'那是什么'她问，真有幽默感！黑卫队是矮人军队中最精锐的军团。只有最优秀的人才能加入，然后还要接受数月的严格训练。

english: ... in such a way that the miners could no longer safely go down into the mines that were so important to them.
translation: ……以至于矿工们再也无法安全地下到对他们如此重要的矿井中。

english: Thus the Elders, in their great wisdom, decided to harness the great power of the yellow stones and drive the spirit out of the area.
translation: 于是，长老们以他们的伟大智慧，决定利用黄色石头的强大力量，将灵魂驱逐出这片区域。

english: They knew that without the power of the stones, they would face a foe too powerful to beat. So for three days and three nights the Arzinian was chased through the twisty passages, always eluding its hunters, until finally it was cornered inside a small tunnel.
translation: 他们知道没有石头的力量，他们将面对一个强大到无法击败的敌人。于是，三天三夜，阿尔津尼安在蜿蜒的通道中被追逐，总是躲避着追捕者，直到最终被逼入一条小隧道中。

english: On either side the brethren approached, their hands sparkling with yellow light, so attempting to banish the spirit back to Bordanzan from whence it came.
translation: 兄弟们从两侧逼近，手中闪烁着黄色的光芒，试图将灵魂驱逐回它来自的博丹赞。

english: But lo! The roof did shake and the walls did crumble and the tunnel did collapse.
translation: 但是看哪！屋顶震动，墙壁崩塌，隧道坍塌了。

english: And all who were standing outside rushed inward to aid their fallen brothers, their yellow stones in hand. Their combined power proved too much for the Arzinian Being and so it collapsed into itself as the tunnel had collapsed onto its hunters.
translation: 所有站在外面的人都冲进去援助倒下的兄弟，手中握着黄色石头。他们联合的力量对阿尔津尼安生物来说太过强大，于是它像隧道坍塌在追捕者身上一样，自我坍缩了。

english: But instead of being driven out, the monstrous creature tapped into its Bordanzian essence, so that all stone and debris coalesced into a single rock.
translation: 但这个可怕的生物并没有被驱逐出去，而是激发了它的博丹赞本质，使所有石头和碎片凝聚成一块岩石。

english: Thus, trapped but not banished to the nightmare of Bordanzan, set inside a rock filled with the yellow power stones, the Arzinian...
translation: 就这样，被困住但未被放逐到博丹赞的噩梦中，被封在一块充满黄色能量石头的岩石里，阿尔津尼安……

english: My dearest Lantania,
translation: 我最亲爱的兰塔尼亚，

english: I know not what these dark hours bring but I will come for thee as soon as I am able. I care no longer for the possessions which tie me to this wasted land and the living which I earned from it.
translation: 我不知道这些黑暗的时刻会带来什么，但我会尽快来找你。我不再在乎那些把我束缚在这片荒废土地上的财物，以及我从这里赚取的生活。

english: Prepare to leave soon for I shall be there with haste. With Saradomin's blessings we shall make our way out of Hallowvale and head westwards over the Salve.
translation: 准备尽快离开，因为我很快就会赶到。愿萨拉多明的祝福指引我们离开哈洛维尔，向西越过萨尔维。

english: I pray that Saradomin supports Queen Efaritay in her hour of need so that she can somehow fight these beasts back to the dead place from where they came.
translation: 我祈祷萨拉多明在埃法里泰女王需要的时候支持她，让她能以某种方式将这些野兽击退回它们来自的死亡之地。

english: I cry at the plight of poor Ascertes and offer up a prayer for their children in these darkest of hours.
translation: 我为可怜的阿塞特斯的困境而哭泣，并在这最黑暗的时刻为他们的孩子祈祷。

english: Make ready and bring only what you need. We shall need good fortune and speed in this, our last chance at a life together.
translation: 做好准备，只带你需要的东西。我们需要好运和速度，这是我们共同生活的最后机会。

english: Yours, most faithfully,
translation: 你最忠诚的，

english: Sialathin
translation: 西亚拉辛

english: Of all the traps in the Tower of Magic, this one has got to be the strangest. It's used to keep the cell gates locked, but it's like no lock I've ever seen. The crystals are the key. When all of them are cleansed, the gates will open. The strange device can be used to cleanse them, provided it is powered with the right kind of energy.
translation: 魔法塔里所有的陷阱中，这个绝对是最奇怪的。它用来锁住牢房门，但这不是我见过的任何锁。水晶就是钥匙。当所有水晶都被净化时，门就会打开。奇怪的装置可以用来净化它们，只要它被正确的能量驱动。

english: You must have completed the Eagles' Peak quest before you can try to lasso a giant eagle.
translation: 你必须先完成鹰峰任务，才能尝试用套索捕捉巨鹰。

english: You've found some goutweed!
translation: 你找到了一些痛风草！

english: The Dukes
translation: 公爵们

english: _ _ C _ S
translation: _ _ C _ S

english: Ow! Ow! That's hot!
translation: 嗷！嗷！好烫！

english: As you open the book, a key falls out. With the pages looking too far aged to read anyway, you discard the book in favour of the key.
translation: 打开书时，一把钥匙掉了出来。书页已经老化得无法阅读，你索性丢下书，拿起了钥匙。

english: Something isn't right. I know that many in the Cadarn clan stay far from the city, but Colwyn has never had trouble contacting Prifddinas before. The clan know their way around the forest. They know how to keep safe. There's no reason for Colwyn's letters to have disappeared.
translation: 有些不对劲。我知道卡达恩部族里很多人远离城市居住，但科尔温以前从未联系不上普里夫迪纳斯城。部族的人熟悉森林的每一条路，知道如何保护自己。科尔温的信没有理由会消失。

english: I might not have the hunting skills of the Cadarn clan, but I can hold my own in the wilds. The Iorwerth clan teaches its warriors well. And if I must fight to see my friend home safe, then so be it.
translation: 我或许没有卡达恩部族的狩猎技巧，但在荒野中我也能自保。伊尔沃斯部族把战士训练得很好。如果必须战斗才能让朋友平安回家，那就来吧。

english: In my haste to help Colwyn I fear I may have betrayed my intentions to Mother. She does not approve of my interactions with other clans, and the extent of her hostility remains unclear. She suspects that I intend to leave Prifddinas, and if I attempt any further action tonight, she will stop me, and I will never find Colwyn. For now, I must wait.
translation: 急于帮助科尔温，我担心自己向母亲暴露了意图。她不赞成我与其他部族来往，她的敌意有多深尚不清楚。她怀疑我想离开普里夫迪纳斯城，如果我今晚再有任何行动，她会阻止我，我就再也找不到科尔温了。现在，我必须等待。

english: It started so well. Mother left to continue her training, and so my initial departure went unnoticed. I felt that walking through the streets would lessen suspicion, but it may have worked too well - I encountered Lord Iorwerth himself on the pathway and he insisted on speaking with me. He didn't say much of substance, but he simply would not stop talking. After a frighteningly long time, I managed to excuse myself, but like a fool, the only reason I could produce was that Mother expected me home. I had no choice but to return empty-handed. I'm sorry, Colwyn. I'll be more careful next time.
translation: 一开始很顺利。母亲离开去继续训练，所以我最初的离开没被注意到。我觉得走在街上可以减少怀疑，但可能效果太好了——我在路上遇到了伊尔沃斯领主本人，他坚持要和我说话。他没说什么实质内容，但就是停不下来。过了长得吓人的一段时间后，我终于找到借口脱身，但像个傻瓜一样，我唯一能想出的理由就是母亲在等我回家。我别无选择，只能空手而归。对不起，科尔温。下次我会更小心的。

english: Can anyone be trusted? I waited until Mother was gone, I walked through darkened alleyways, and I avoided every elf in my path. I was not stopped by Mother, and I was not stopped by some old clan leader. But the guards at the gates ... I've never seen such hostility. I was barely even near the gate when the guard approached me - I'm surprised he didn't threaten me outright. I will try again, but I must keep away from the gates and, more importantly, the guards. I'm coming to find you, Colwyn, I promise.
translation: 还有人能信任吗？我等到母亲离开，穿过昏暗的小巷，避开路上每一个精灵。我没有被母亲拦下，也没有被某个老部族首领拦下。但大门的守卫……我从未见过那样的敌意。我还没靠近大门，守卫就朝我走来——我很惊讶他没有直接威胁我。我会再试一次，但我必须远离大门，更重要的是，远离守卫。我会找到你的，科尔温，我保证。

english: I think I may be beginning to fear these walls. I made my way back to the edge of town even more carefully this time, and I found the perfect place: a quiet patch of wall, far from the gates, and hidden from prying eyes. The trees on the far side were tall and sturdy. I fired my grapple perfectly and I watched it arc over the barrier with grace. But then my rope broke the instant it brushed against one of the wall's crystals. The break was cleaner than you'd ever believe. There's no way I'm getting over that wall like this. But don't worry, Colwyn, I have another idea...
translation: 我想我开始害怕这些墙了。这次我更加小心地回到城边，找到了一个完美的地方：一段安静的墙，远离大门，避开窥探的目光。远处的树木高大而结实。我完美地射出抓钩，看着它优雅地划过屏障。但绳子一碰到墙上的水晶就断了。断口干净得令人难以置信。这样我根本翻不过那堵墙。但别担心，科尔温，我有另一个主意……

english: Mother knows. For the love of Seren, Mother knows. I hear her now, in the other room. I saw when I retrieved my rope that there was a loose crystal in the wall. I went back and pried it out tonight, and the hole it left behind may even have been large enough for me to fit through. But that didn't matter. As soon as the crystal was gone, another grew to replace it. This was no way out, and I couldn't leave the crystal there. Someone would surely find it, and that could only end in disaster. And so I brought the crystal home with me, and now Mother has found it. I'm so sorry, Colwyn. I fear I may have failed you.
translation: 母亲知道了。看在塞伦的份上，母亲知道了。我现在能听到她在另一个房间的声音。我去取绳子时发现墙上有一颗松动的水晶。今晚我回去把它撬了出来，留下的洞甚至可能大到让我钻过去。但那不重要。水晶一消失，另一颗就长出来填补了它。这不是出路，我也不能把水晶留在那里。肯定会有人发现它，那只会以灾难收场。所以我把水晶带回了家，现在母亲发现了它。对不起，科尔温。我恐怕辜负了你。

english: I fear I may be in danger as well.
translation: 我担心自己也有危险。

english: The world dids't pass from Horatio to Eathram, yet still did wisdom not prevail. Through oppression Eathram stood up and, arm'd in naught but leather and steel, did he steal back the people. He doth cried, not full of mourning but with passion. Unto him was said, 'you are a man, a man of hope, a man of truth and innocence' and he was emboldened in his mission beforest.
translation: 世界从霍拉肖传到了伊斯拉姆手中，但智慧仍未获胜。面对压迫，伊斯拉姆挺身而出，仅以皮革和钢铁为武装，为人民夺回了自由。他呐喊，不是出于哀伤，而是充满激情。有人对他说：'你是个男人，一个充满希望的男人，一个真实而纯洁的男人'，他因此坚定了自己的使命。

english: 'Wither now thee go, my lord?' was he asked, to which he replied, 'my future is ordained and my path has been shown unto me.' And arm'd with leather and steel he did leave.
translation: '吾主，您将往何处去？'有人问他，他答道：'我的未来已注定，我的道路已显现。'于是，他带着皮革和钢铁离开了。

english: And so his path led him, and other men to the place whence they would make a history.
translation: 就这样，他的道路引领着他和其他人来到了他们将创造历史的地方。

english: First was Lord Pecule then Eathram, then the Elders Draben and Ferral and the young Svelgn.
translation: 先是佩库尔领主，然后是伊斯拉姆，接着是长老德拉本和费拉尔，以及年轻的斯维尔根。

english: 'Welcome,' said Eathram to all and gave thanks for their presence and health unto this time. And so in such a place was the decision made. It was a just decision as they agreed and one which would combat the evil they faced.
translation: '欢迎，'伊斯拉姆对所有人说，并感谢他们此刻的到来和安康。就在这样一个地方，做出了决定。这是一个公正的决定，他们一致同意，这将对抗他们所面临的邪恶。

english: Ahead of 4 phalanx of spears and 100 knights did Eathram enter Kourend unopposed. The hope for his people and the fear for his enemies carried before him. Such force showed his might so much so that the King could do naught but turn his sword upon his self.
translation: 在四列长枪方阵和一百名骑士的护卫下，伊斯拉姆毫无阻碍地进入了库兰德王国。他对人民的希望和对敌人的威慑先行而至。这样的力量展示了他的威势，以至于国王只能将剑转向自己。

english: This volume is meant as a historical document covering the period between 'The Break Out' and the creation of the eastern province. You will find the book is written from a third party point of view; this is in an attempt to make this literature more objective.
translation: 本卷旨在作为一份历史文献，涵盖从'突围'到东部行省建立之间的时期。你会发现本书以第三人称视角撰写，这是为了使文献更加客观。

english: In matters of history it is always best to understand some background to the subject you are studying, so we shall have a brief explanation of 'The Break Out'.
translation: 研究历史时，最好先了解一些背景，所以我们将简要解释'突围'。

english: After centuries of isolated development, after the God Wars, it was decided that the elven domain needed to expand. With their backs to the sea, there was only one way to go, east.
translation: 经过数个世纪的孤立发展，神战之后，精灵族决定需要扩张领土。背靠大海，他们只有一条路可走——向东。

english: After many years of hard work, a pass over the mountains was created. The creation of this pass is a long tale unto itself and we shall leave that subject for another time.
translation: 经过多年的艰苦努力，一条翻越山脉的通道建成了。这条通道的建造本身就是一个漫长的故事，我们改日再谈。

english: For the first time since Seren had departed, the elven people could leave Tirannwn. They found a land in chaos; many of the races that had been dominant before the end of the God Wars were on the edge of extinction or had simply vanished.
translation: 自塞伦离去以来，精灵族第一次能够离开提兰沃恩。他们发现这片土地一片混乱；许多在神战结束前占据主导地位的种族正濒临灭绝，或已彻底消失。

english: The gnome city, which in years past had good trade with the elves, was now little more than a village. As for the Mahjarrat, who had never had good relations with elves, there was no trace.
translation: 地精城市，过去曾与精灵有良好的贸易往来，如今不过是个村庄。至于与精灵关系从来不好的玛哈加特，则毫无踪迹。

english: The only sign anyone had ever been there was the sacred battle grounds. Seeing the vacuum in power, the elves elected to move quickly. But first, they needed some security.
translation: 唯一有人存在过的迹象是神圣的战场。看到权力的真空，精灵们决定迅速行动。但首先，他们需要一些安全保障。

english: Knowing how volatile the eastern lands can be, King Baxtorian concluded that the safest way to proceed was to draw up non-aggression pacts with the other races of the land. They were the gnomes to the north, the humans to the east and the ogres to the south.
translation: 深知东部土地的动荡，巴克斯托里安国王得出结论，最安全的做法是与这片土地上的其他种族签订互不侵犯条约。他们是北方的地精、东方的人类和南方的食人魔。

english: The gnomes, having taken great losses at the end of the God Wars, were more than happy to find a race who did not wish them harm and signed up to the treaty immediately.
translation: 地精在神战结束时损失惨重，非常高兴找到一个不怀恶意的种族，立即签署了条约。

english: The humans, being of many different tribes, were a little harder to get any agreement from. After much time and organization however, the tribes concluded that a non-aggression pact with the elves was in all their best interests.
translation: 人类由许多不同的部落组成，要达成任何协议都困难一些。然而，经过大量的时间和协调，各部落最终认为与精灵签订互不侵犯条约符合所有人的最大利益。

english: Lastly, the elves approached the ogres and their kin to the south. Unfortunately, without Bandos' guidance which had held these races together for millennia, the nation had fallen into a bloody civil war, making any form of a treaty with each side useless.
translation: 最后，精灵们接触了南方的食人魔及其亲族。不幸的是，没有了班多斯千年来维系这些种族的指引，这个国家陷入了血腥的内战，与任何一方签订条约都毫无意义。

english: The elven people decided that two out of three treaties agreed upon was good enough to start the colonisation of the new lands.
translation: 精灵族决定，三份条约中达成两份就足以开始对新土地的殖民。

english: And so the eastern province was born.
translation: 于是，东部行省诞生了。

english: This volume is meant as a historical document to tell future generations about the settlement of the area to the east of Tirannwn. It is suggested that you read 'Exploration of the Eastern Realm' to give you grounding for this book. You will find the book is written from a third party point of view; this is in an attempt to make it more objective.
translation: 本卷旨在作为一份历史文献，向后代讲述提兰沃恩以东地区的定居史。建议先阅读《东部领域探索》以了解本书的背景。你会发现本书以第三人称视角撰写，这是为了使文献更加客观。

english: After the elves had completed their diplomatic negotiations with the neighbouring nations, King Baxtorian felt it was at last time to use the land they had secured.
translation: 精灵们完成与邻国的外交谈判后，巴克斯托里安国王认为终于到了使用他们争取到的土地的时候了。

english: It was decided that as the ogre nation to the south was unstable, the Cadarn clan should be the first to settle the newly aquired land, as they were one of the few clans able to defend themselves.
translation: 由于南方的食人魔国家不稳定，决定由卡达恩部族率先定居新获得的土地，因为他们是少数能够自卫的部族之一。

english: It was not long before the first elven town in the eastern realm was born, populated by the Cadarn clan's settlers.
translation: 不久之后，东部领域的第一座精灵城镇诞生了，由卡达恩部族的定居者居住。

english: After the Cadarn clan had secured the new realm, the other clans, seeing how much wealth was coming over Arandar, were quick to join them.
translation: 卡达恩部族稳固了新领域后，其他部族看到从阿兰达山隘涌来的财富，纷纷迅速加入。

english: This was a time of great prosperity and profit for elves, gnomes and humans alike. New trade agreements were being created with the gnomes and humans. Soon new elven settlements started to be created.
translation: 这是一个精灵、侏儒和人类都繁荣昌盛、获利丰厚的时代。与侏儒和人类的新贸易协定不断达成，很快精灵的新定居点也开始建立。

english: Although at this time, the elves, gnomes and humans were living in peace, to the south, the war between the ogres and their goblin neighbours degenerated.
translation: 尽管此时精灵、侏儒和人类和平共处，但在南方，食人魔与其哥布林邻居之间的战争却愈演愈烈。

english: The ogres attempted to decimate all goblin tribes in the south. This started a mass exodus of the goblins, and they started to emigrate north along the coast, moving through the lands not yet settled by elves.
translation: 食人魔试图消灭南方所有的哥布林部落。这引发了哥布林的大规模迁徙，他们开始沿着海岸向北迁移，穿过精灵尚未定居的土地。

english: Although the goblins were busy guarding their backs to the south and did not have the resources to start a war on two fronts, this did not stop them from raiding for supplies in the elven lands.
translation: 尽管哥布林忙于防备南方的威胁，没有资源发动双线战争，但这并没有阻止他们在精灵领地劫掠补给品。

english: Within a few decades of 'The Break Out', the elves had created many thriving settlements and a vast network of roads, despite the constant raiding from the goblins.
translation: 在'大逃亡'后的几十年里，尽管哥布林不断侵扰，精灵们还是建立了许多繁荣的定居点和庞大的道路网络。

english: The new realm continued to thrive for many years and likely will for many more.
translation: 这个新王国持续繁荣了许多年，而且很可能还会继续繁荣下去。

english: I start this new journal as I start my new life, I leave behind all that I was as I take a stand for the elven race.
translation: 我开启这本新日记，如同开启我的新生活，我抛弃过去的一切，为精灵族挺身而出。

english: It is my hope that we can at last find peace with our misguided brethren and return home. To stay like this is to condemn ourselves to an eternity of chaos. To this end, we must each do all that we can, for the greater good.
translation: 我希望我们最终能与误入歧途的同胞们达成和解，重返家园。继续这样下去，只会让我们陷入永恒的混乱。为此，为了更大的利益，我们每个人都必须竭尽全力。

english: The Death Guard is an old and honourable society and so I have enrolled, I have one more day in the city before I go for training.
translation: 死神卫是一个古老而光荣的组织，所以我加入了。在去训练之前，我还能在城里待一天。

english: I was speaking to my brother Iestin, he was telling me of the research he has been doing on the Grand Library. It is a shame that research will never amount to anything, no one can enter that place while the city is lost to us. Even if someone does find a way, the seals placed there by Seren herself ensure that her hidden knowledge will never be revealed.
translation: 我和我兄弟伊斯廷谈过，他告诉我他在大图书馆所做的研究。可惜那些研究永远不会有什么成果，在我们失去那座城市的情况下，没人能进入那个地方。即使有人找到了方法，塞伦亲自设下的封印也确保她隐藏的知识永远不会被揭示。

english: Iestin asked how my historical study of the eastern realms was going. I did not have the heart to tell him, I will wait until tomorrow.
translation: 伊斯廷问我关于东部王国历史研究进展如何。我不忍心告诉他实情，还是等到明天再说吧。

english: I have put the last of my affairs in order. Iestin begged me not to go, telling me that I should stick with my research.
translation: 我已经处理完最后的事务。伊斯廷求我别走，告诉我说我应该继续我的研究。

english: I think my big brother may have had his nose in a book too long, he does not see what is happening to our people, we must regain our heritage if we are to survive in this world.
translation: 我觉得我大哥可能看书看太久了，他没有看到我们的人民正在经历什么，如果我们想在这个世界上生存下去，就必须重拾我们的传统。

english: Besides, if I am ever to know anything about the eastern realm, I should go and see the land myself.
translation: 再说，如果我想了解东部王国，就应该亲自去看看那片土地。

english: This may be the last night I spend in Tirannwn.
translation: 这可能是我在提兰沃度过的最后一晚。

english: It seems a shame to have lost two years from my journal but I can understand the need for secrecy. I am told that when the subjects covered in that portion of my journal are no longer an issue of security, the pages will be returned to me.
translation: 日记缺失了两年似乎很可惜，但我能理解保密的需要。有人告诉我，当日记中那部分内容不再是安全问题后，书页会归还给我。

english: At least I finished training, I'm told that my first assignment will be in the human city. I wonder what it looks like.
translation: 至少我完成了训练，听说我的第一个任务是在人类城市。不知道那里是什么样子。

english: I was able to get an hour free before leaving for my first post. I found Iestin in the same library I had left him in two years ago. It was good to see him again after such time, although his research has led him to some absurd conclusions.
translation: 在前往第一个岗位之前，我抽出了一个小时。我在两年前离开伊斯廷的那个图书馆找到了他。时隔这么久再次见到他真好，尽管他的研究得出了些荒谬的结论。

english: He seems to believe that one of the nine seals in the Grand Library was broken. Though I am sure there are too many safeguards for such to be true. I wish I'd had more time with him.
translation: 他似乎相信大图书馆的九个封印中有一个被打破了。虽然我确信有太多防护措施，这种事不可能发生。真希望我能有更多时间和他在一起。

english: This evening I camp on the peaks of Arandar, tomorrow I report for my first day in service of the Death Guard.
translation: 今晚我在阿兰达峰扎营，明天我将报到，开始我在死神卫的第一天服役。

english: The induction to my new post was poor at best, I was not even assigned a bunk. The rest of the day was spent in a watch tower occasionally getting attacked by pigeons.
translation: 新岗位的入职安排糟透了，我连个铺位都没分到。剩下的时间都在瞭望塔里度过，偶尔还会被鸽子袭击。

english: The humans are not so different as I thought they would be, although they live like animals.
translation: 人类并不像我想象的那么不同，尽管他们活得像个动物。

english: I have been kept very busy by guard duty over the last few days and this is the first chance I've had to make an entry in my journal.
translation: 过去几天我一直忙于守卫任务，这是我第一次有机会写日记。

english: I have bad feelings about the work I undertake. It seems to me that any task that requires us to treat other beings as poorly as we are treating these humans can only come to ill, but we must each do all that we can, for the greater good.
translation: 我对所从事的工作有种不好的预感。在我看来，任何需要我们像对待这些人类那样恶劣对待其他生灵的任务，最终都不会有好结果，但为了更大的利益，我们每个人都必须竭尽全力。

english: I have spent my day in the pointless exercise of chasing sheep about with a big wooden device. After wasting all the shots, I tried putting vials of dye into it, in the end I only succeeded in breaking the device.
translation: 我花了一整天时间，用一个大木制装置追着羊跑，真是毫无意义的练习。浪费了所有弹药后，我试着往里面装染料瓶，最后只是把装置弄坏了。

english: I have been told that I will be doing paper work all day tomorrow, I cannot do as much damage in the office I was told.
translation: 有人告诉我明天一整天都要做文书工作，他们说我在办公室里造成的破坏不会那么大。

english: Today was quite something, I got a promotion. It looks like those years of study paid off after all. I am now in charge of collating all the historical data we are collecting.
translation: 今天真是了不起，我升职了。看来那些年的学习终究没有白费。我现在负责整理我们收集的所有历史数据。

english: While filing some papers I could not help but notice lots of fragments from an old page, putting these pieces together revealed a message: 'Seren's light will open the doors, her crystal is but a filter'. It seems no one else had spotted that before, I think I have earned the respect of my colleagues today.
translation: 在整理文件时，我忍不住注意到一张旧书页的许多碎片，把这些碎片拼在一起，显现出一条信息：'塞伦之光将开启大门，她的水晶不过是一层滤网'。似乎之前没有人发现这一点，我想今天我赢得了同事们的尊重。

english: For the last two days I have worked to catalogue all the findings. Today a messenger turned up with a document requesting that 'all materials from the excavation site should be returned to Tirannwn'. I wish I could join them on that journey. I hope my brother is well.
translation: 过去两天我一直在整理编目所有发现。今天一个信使送来一份文件，要求'所有来自发掘现场的物资都应归还提兰沃'。真希望我能和他们一起踏上那趟旅程。希望我兄弟一切安好。

english: There is a rumour going around of a human who reopened the Well of Voyage, and in the process of doing so banished the crazed mage down there. I wonder if this will impact our mission.
translation: 有传言说有个人类重新打开了远航之井，并在这个过程中驱逐了下面那个疯狂的法师。不知道这是否会影响我们的任务。

english: One of the slaves escaped and ran off down the south west cavern today, he was found some hours later in a small crevasse rocking back and forth repeating over and over 'no shadows get me'.
translation: 今天有个奴隶逃跑了，跑进了西南方的洞穴，几个小时后他被发现在一个小裂缝里，前后摇晃着，反复念叨着'没有影子抓我'。

english: It looks like I will be the one to get to go look for these shadows, I just got my orders to take a team and investigate the tunnel. I am to be briefed in the morning.
translation: 看来我得去找这些影子了，我刚接到命令，要带一队人去调查那条隧道。明天早上会给我做任务简报。

english: I challenge you to a duel, come to the arena beneath the Champions' Guild and fight me if you dare.
translation: 我向你挑战决斗，敢的话就来冠军公会下方的竞技场与我一战。

english: Champion of Earth Warriors
translation: 土元素战士冠军

english: Those hoping to survive the Gauntlet will need to take advantage of the Grym roots found within the dungeon. The leaves that grow on these roots can be used to create Egniol potions, which are able to restore both energy and divinity.
translation: 想在试炼之路中活下来的人，需要利用地牢中的格里姆根。这些根上长出的叶子可以用来制作艾格尼奥尔药水，能够同时恢复精力和神力。

english: Fill a vial with water.
translation: 往小瓶里装满水。

english: Add a Grym leaf to the vial.
translation: 往小瓶里加入一片格里姆叶。

english: Crush ten crystal shards.
translation: 碾碎十颗水晶碎片。

english: Add the crystal dust to the vial.
translation: 将水晶粉尘加入小瓶。

english: You receive an Echo axe.
translation: 你获得了一把回响斧。

english: Congratulations, you've unlocked a new Relic: Lumberjack.
translation: 恭喜，你解锁了新遗物：伐木工。

english: Burn logs. (Active)
translation: 烧原木。（主动）

english: You receive an Echo harpoon.
translation: 你获得了一把回响鱼叉。

english: Congratulations, you've unlocked a new Relic: Animal Wrangler.
translation: 恭喜，你解锁了新遗物：动物驯服者。

english: Grr... Ge'roff us!
translation: 吼...离我们远点！

english: I told you... Ge'roff us!
translation: 我说了...离我们远点！

english: What can you tell me about Ali Morrisane?
translation: 你能告诉我关于阿里.莫里桑的什么事？

english: What will you do about the threats?
translation: 你打算怎么应对这些威胁？

english: After weeks of searching through the scriptures I found during the final campaign, I've finally discovered something that may bear wondrous fruit! By fusing the teachings of haemalchemy with my knowledge as a divine healer, I've managed to create a tincture I call the 'Elixir of Everlasting'. I haven't observed any negative side effects other than a little short-term drowsiness so no major concerns so far.
translation: 经过数周翻阅我在最后战役中找到的经文，我终于发现了可能结出奇妙果实的东西！通过将血炼术的教义与我作为神圣治疗师的知识融合，我成功制作了一种我称之为'永恒灵药'的药剂。除了轻微的短期嗜睡外，我没有观察到任何负面副作用，目前没有大问题。

english: Now, what is the purpose of such a potion? Simply put, it will negate the aging process if consumed on a regular basis. This is something Mother has wanted addressing for some time now, ever since she realised she couldn't become one of them. She desires eternal life more than anything... and fortunately for her, I now have that power.
translation: 那么，这种药水的用途是什么？简单来说，如果定期服用，它将延缓衰老过程。这是母亲一直想要解决的问题，自从她意识到自己无法成为他们中的一员以来。她比什么都渴望永生...幸运的是，我现在拥有了那种力量。

english: I have been ingesting the fluid for a full month now and I feel incredible! My old joints are loosening, and my eyesight has improved tenfold. I'm as young and beautiful as I was all those years ago. The scars of war have been removed far beyond the abilities of my divine healing. It's almost as if my body has moved backwards through time. Mother will be most pleased with these results.
translation: 我已经服用这种液体整整一个月了，感觉棒极了！我老旧的关节变得灵活，视力提高了十倍。我和多年前一样年轻美丽。战争的伤痕已经被移除，远超我神圣治疗的能力。仿佛我的身体在时光中倒流。母亲会对这些结果非常满意。

english: There is something to take note of though. Consuming the elixir on the night of a full moon seems to give the potion increased potency. It's likely one of the ingredients is causing this. Perhaps if we increase the wolfsbane extract ever so slightly... Yes, more experimentation will be required.
translation: 不过有一点需要注意。在满月之夜服用灵药似乎能增强药效。很可能是其中一种成分导致了这种情况。也许我们稍微增加一点狼毒提取物...是的，还需要更多实验。

english: The formulae is complete! The elders of the Sisterhood have been imbibing the elixir for a full year now and the results have been marvellous. With our new lease of life, we've made great movements in extending the caverns beneath the old church. It's been noticed that a few of the sisters have taken to sleeping a lot more than they usually would. This is to be expected though as they've been working very hard this past year. Long hours, tough work - not for the faint of heart.
translation: 配方完成了！姐妹会的长老们已经服用灵药整整一年，效果非常显著。凭借我们重获的新生，我们在扩展旧教堂下方的洞穴方面取得了巨大进展。有人注意到一些姐妹比平时睡得更多。这是意料之中的，因为她们在过去一年里工作非常辛苦。长时间工作，艰苦劳动——不适合胆小的人。

english: With all the notes I've been adding to them, the Senntisten Scriptures are becoming more and more unreadable. As such, I've re-written the recipe and instructions for the elixir below. However, I've purposefully mis-recorded a few of the directions in case this information falls into the wrong hands. This shouldn't cause any internal issues as no one should be trying to create the elixir without my supervision.
translation: 随着我不断添加笔记，森提斯坦经文变得越来越难以阅读。因此，我在下面重新写下了灵药的配方和说明。不过，我有意错误记录了一些指示，以防这些信息落入坏人之手。这不应该引起任何内部问题，因为没有人应该在没有我监督的情况下尝试制作灵药。

english: Recipe and directions by Elder Otrava of the Sisterhood Sanctuary.
translation: 配方和说明由姐妹会圣所的长老奥特拉瓦编写。

english: First you must prepare by obtaining several buckets of blood. Avoid taking blood from the dead as this will...
translation: 首先你必须准备几桶血。避免从死者身上取血，因为这会...

english: ~ the rest of the page is missing ~
translation: ~ 页面其余部分缺失 ~

english: So you would like to purchase <Num0> jar, costing you a total of <Num1> coins. Is that correct?
translation: 所以你想购买<Num0>个罐子，总共花费<Num1>金币。对吗？

english: So you would like to purchase <Num0> jars, costing you a total of <Num1> coins. Is that correct?
translation: 所以你想购买<Num0>个罐子，总共花费<Num1>金币。对吗？

english: The book has two parts: an introduction and an instruction section.
translation: 这本书有两部分：引言和说明部分。

english: You can't unlock the door with that.
translation: 你无法用那个打开门。

english: I hope this message finds you well. I'm pleased to confirm that I have made good progress in finding a solution to poor Arrav's predicament, and I am now ready to proceed to the next step. I'd very much appreciate your help in this, so if you are willing, meet me in the Uzer Oasis.
translation: 希望你一切安好。我很高兴地确认，我在为可怜的阿拉夫寻找解决方案方面取得了良好进展，现在我已准备好进入下一步。我非常感谢你在这方面的帮助，所以如果你愿意，请在乌泽绿洲与我见面。

english: Regards,
translation: 此致，

english: Zamorak, aid me!
translation: 萨莫拉克，助我！

english: Magicus Arcanus Afficus!
translation: 魔法奥秘显灵！

english: Magicus Arcanus Infernus!
translation: 魔法奥秘地狱火！

english: Magicus Arcanus Inferus!
translation: 魔法奥秘深渊！

english: Rats, no, I meant Infernus!
translation: 老鼠，不，我是说地狱火！

english: So predictable!
translation: 太容易预测了！

english: Dirty trickster!
translation: 卑鄙的骗子！

english: They've laughed at me for long enough. I'm tired of just being Buggie the Bug-hunter.
translation: 他们嘲笑我够久了。我厌倦了只是'虫子猎人巴吉'。

english: Entomology is a serious science. Yet those fools at the zoo wouldn't give me my own display, oh no.
translation: 昆虫学是一门严肃的科学。可动物园那些傻瓜不给我自己的展示柜，哦不。

english: I could have created a highly educational exhibit, teaching the public about the wonders of the insect world, but the idiots who run the zoo just laughed at me! They like wolves, bears, cyclopes - big creatures with claws and teeth. They just don't understand how insects are the truly interesting class.
translation: 我本可以创造一个极具教育意义的展品，向公众展示昆虫世界的奇妙，但管理动物园的白痴们只是嘲笑我！他们喜欢狼、熊、独眼巨人——那些有爪子和牙齿的大型生物。他们就是不明白昆虫才是真正有趣的类别。

english: Well, if they think insects are boring little pests, they're in for a surprise. I've found some insects that'll scare the pants off 'em!
translation: 好吧，如果他们觉得昆虫是无聊的小害虫，他们可要大吃一惊了。我找到了一些能把他们吓得屁滚尿流的昆虫！

english: It wasn't easy, of course. I got really thirsty trying to find their hive in the desert, and it was almost impossible to steal a sack of eggs without the Queen seeing me.
translation: 当然，这并不容易。我在沙漠里找它们的蜂巢时渴得要命，而且几乎不可能在女王没看见的情况下偷走一麻袋蛋。

english: After another parched journey through the desert, I brought the eggs here to my quiet little cavern.
translation: 又一次干渴的沙漠之旅后，我把蛋带到了这个安静的小洞穴里。

english: Of course, I couldn't try to raise kalphites in just any rocky cave. They expect sand. I'd spent weeks preparing the cave, dragging in sacks of sand to cover the rocky floor. My back still hurts.
translation: 当然，我不能随便在哪个岩石洞穴里养卡尔菲特。它们需要沙子。我花了数周准备洞穴，拖着一袋袋沙子覆盖岩石地面。我的背到现在还疼。

english: I thought I'd have to light lots of fires too, since this cave isn't as warm as their hive, but they seem to have natural resilience to the cold. They're tough little blighters - when the zoo sees my kalphites, they'll finally show some proper respect, both for me and for the insect class!
translation: 我还以为得生很多火，因为这个洞穴没有它们的蜂巢暖和，但它们似乎天生耐寒。它们是顽强的小家伙——当动物园看到我的卡尔菲特时，他们终于会对我和对昆虫纲表现出应有的尊重了！

english: Actually, my kalphites are a bit tougher than I'd expected. As they grow larger, they're becoming quite aggressive.
translation: 实际上，我的卡尔菲特比我预期的要凶猛一些。随着它们长大，它们变得相当具有攻击性。

english: One of them even bit me today. It didn't hurt much at the time, but now I'm feeling a bit dizzy. I hope the kalphites aren't poisonous - my entomology books didn't say anything about them being poisonous.
translation: 今天有一只甚至咬了我。当时不太疼，但现在我有点头晕。我希望卡尔菲特没有毒——我的昆虫学书籍没有提到它们有毒。

english: The dizziness is getting worse... I don't know... ... those zoo keepers will show me some proper respect...
translation: 头晕越来越严重了……我不知道……那些动物园管理员会对我表示应有的尊重……

english: I've lost my dolphin.
translation: 我的海豚丢了。

english: Embalming is an essential part of Menaphite funerary practice.
translation: 防腐处理是梅纳菲特葬礼习俗中必不可少的一环。

english: After death, the spirits of the deceased return to their bodies to find sustenance. However, if their body decays or becomes unrecognisable, then the spirit goes hungry and their afterlife is jeopardised.
translation: 死后，逝者的灵魂会回到身体中寻找养分。然而，如果身体腐烂或变得无法辨认，灵魂就会挨饿，来世也会受到威胁。

english: Through embalming, we seek to prevent the decay of the body. In doing so, we offer our clients the best afterlife that money can pay for.
translation: 通过防腐处理，我们力求防止身体腐烂。这样一来，我们就能为客户提供金钱能买到的最好的来世。

english: As embalming is of a scientific persuasion, I will only deal with the technicalities of the job in this book. Prayers and other religious ceremonies will be left to the priests and acolytes of Icthlarin.
translation: 由于防腐处理属于科学范畴，本书中我只涉及工作的技术细节。祈祷和其他宗教仪式将留给伊克哈林的祭司和侍僧们。

english: The first step of embalming is to remove most of the large organs from the deceased. This done using incisions made in the body.
translation: 防腐处理的第一步是移除逝者体内的大部分主要器官。这是通过在身体上做切口来完成的。

english: Once removed, the organs are placed inside canopic jars. Each jar is then given to Icthlarin's priests to be blessed.
translation: 器官取出后，放入卡诺皮克罐中。每个罐子随后交给伊克哈林的祭司进行祝福。

english: Once the organs have been removed, salts are applied to the body in order to reduce moisture and prevent decay.
translation: 器官移除后，将盐涂抹在身体上，以减少水分并防止腐烂。

english: Salt is a valuable spice, but it can thankfully be easily obtained from a saltwater lake north of Sophanem. However, the process of separating the salt from the water is slightly complicated. Natural evaporation is long and time consuming, so sun traps are used to speed up the crystallisation process.
translation: 盐是一种珍贵的香料，但幸运的是，可以很容易地从索法尼恩城以北的咸水湖中获取。然而，将盐从水中分离出来的过程稍微复杂。自然蒸发耗时漫长，因此使用日光陷阱来加速结晶过程。

english: An optional step reserved for our executive customers is the wrapping of the corpse in linen. This further decreases the decay of the body.
translation: 为尊贵客户保留的可选步骤是用亚麻布包裹尸体。这能进一步减缓身体的腐烂。

english: Linen is available from any decent cloth merchant in the area. After all, it is the cloth of choice for most Menaphites.
translation: 亚麻布可以从当地任何像样的布料商人那里买到。毕竟，它是大多数梅纳菲特人的首选布料。

english: Regardless of if a corpse is wrapped or not, the next step is to seal the body using sap.
translation: 无论尸体是否包裹，下一步都是用树液密封身体。

english: Sap is a sought after and expensive commodity for those who live in desert climes. This is because it is only obtainable from evergreen trees whose natural habitat exists far from the harsh desert. The smart embalmer should always keep a plentiful supply of sap to avoid needless traveling to and from distant lands.
translation: 对于生活在沙漠气候中的人来说，树液是一种抢手且昂贵的商品。这是因为树液只能从常青树中获取，而常青树的自然栖息地远离严酷的沙漠。聪明的防腐师应始终保持充足的树液供应，以避免不必要的长途跋涉。

english: To collect sap, a knife should be used to make a small cut in the tree. The sap can then be collected in a bucket.
translation: 收集树液时，应用刀在树上切一个小口。然后用桶收集树液。

english: Once the body is fully prepared, the priests of Icthlarin finish the process by carrying out a final ceremony. In this ceremony, the deceased spirit departs their body and leaves for the afterlife. The details of this ceremony are of little consequence to the embalmer.
translation: 身体完全准备好后，伊克哈林的祭司们通过举行最后的仪式来完成整个过程。在这个仪式中，逝者的灵魂离开身体，前往来世。这个仪式的细节对防腐师来说无关紧要。

english: I will simply ask you to select a payment the old fashioned way my dear sir. To cancel, simply come talk to me again!
translation: 我只需请您以传统方式选择付款，亲爱的先生。要取消，只需再来和我谈谈！

english: You chisel away at the block of sandstone, and form the statue's base and legs.
translation: 你用凿子凿着砂岩块，雕出了雕像的基座和腿。

english: You chisel away at the block of sandstone, and form the statue's body.
translation: 你用凿子凿着砂岩块，雕出了雕像的身体。

english: You carefully chisel the granite block into the likeness of a camel.
translation: 你小心地将花岗岩块凿成骆驼的模样。

english: You place the arm in the lock. It fits exactly.
translation: 你将手臂放入锁中。它完全吻合。

english: You take the metal sigil. It's cold to the touch.
translation: 你拿起金属徽记。触感冰凉。

english: You place the leg in the lock. It fits exactly.
translation: 你将腿放入锁中。它完全吻合。

english: You carefully chisel the granite block to match the mould you made.
translation: 你小心地凿着花岗岩块，使其与你制作的模具相匹配。

english: With a hiss of steam, the ice melts away from the fountain.
translation: 随着一阵蒸汽嘶嘶声，冰从喷泉上融化了。

english: It looks like there was once a maple log fire burning here.
translation: 看起来这里曾经烧过枫木原木火。

english: It looks like there was once a normal log fire burning here.
translation: 看起来这里曾经烧过普通原木火。

english: It looks like there was once an oak fire burning here.
translation: 看起来这里曾经烧过橡木火。

english: It looks like there was once a candle burning here.
translation: 看起来这里曾经点过蜡烛。

english: It looks like there was once a coal fire burning here.
translation: 看起来这里曾经烧过煤火。

english: It looks like there was once a willow log fire burning here.
translation: 看起来这里曾经烧过柳木原木火。

english: You place the maple logs in the brazier, and carefully light them.
translation: 你将枫木原木放入火盆，小心地点燃了它们。

english: You place the logs in the brazier, and carefully light them.
translation: 你将原木放入火盆，小心地点燃了它们。

english: You place the oak logs in the brazier, and carefully light them.
translation: 你将橡木原木放入火盆，小心地点燃了它们。

english: You place the lit candle carefully in the brazier.
translation: 你小心地将已点燃的蜡烛放入火盆。

english: You place the coal in the brazier, and carefully light it.
translation: 你将煤放入火盆，小心地点燃了它。

english: You place the willow logs in the brazier, and carefully light them.
translation: 你将柳木原木放入火盆，小心地点燃了它们。

english: Wind rushes through the furnace, clearing away what's blocking it.
translation: 风呼啸着穿过熔炉，清除了堵塞物。

english: The smoke clears from the room.
translation: 烟雾从房间里消散了。

english: You walk through the barrier easily.
translation: 你轻松地穿过了屏障。

english: The spirit disappears with a soft sigh.
translation: 灵魂轻轻叹息一声，消散了。

english: Someone so easy to hit isn't worth my time!
translation: 这么容易打中的家伙，不值得我浪费时间！

english: If you value your life, young one, then flee!
translation: 如果你珍惜性命，年轻人，就快逃吧！

english: I am impressed, young one. You seem to have more resilience than those I have fought off before.
translation: 我印象深刻，年轻人。你似乎比我之前击退的那些人更有韧性。

english: Certainly, young one. If you help me, I will give you a valuable amulet, and some of my knowledge.
translation: 当然可以，年轻人。如果你帮我，我会给你一枚珍贵的护身符，以及我的一些知识。

english: You add the stone to the wall.
translation: 你把石头加到墙上。

english: You trim the stone that was added to the wall.
translation: 你装饰了加到墙上的石头。

english: As thanks for your help, young one, please take this amulet of mine.
translation: 作为对你帮助的感谢，年轻人，请收下我这枚护身符。

english: You create the origami balloon structure.
translation: 你制作了折纸气球结构。

english: You create an origami balloon.
translation: 你制作了一个折纸气球。

english: You have now planted Auguste's sapling. He will not give you any more.
translation: 你已经种下了奥古斯特的树苗。他不会给你更多了。

english: You plant the special willow sapling in the tree patch.
translation: 你把特殊的柳树树苗种在树木种植地里。

english: You do not have enough willow branches.
translation: 你没有足够的柳木树枝。

english: You arrive safely in Taverley.
translation: 你安全抵达塔韦利村。

english: The enchanted gold bar says: 'Argh! Get me out of here!'
translation: 附魔金锭说：“啊！放我出去！”

english: The enchanted gold bar says: 'I'm stuck in this horrible gold bar!'
translation: 附魔金锭说：“我被困在这可怕的金锭里了！”

english: I'm pleased to confirm that I have been succesful in aquiring a property in Fortis for use as a safe house. It is in a prime location, directly opposite the bank. To avoid any possible suspicion, I believe it best we keep the house occupied at all times. As such, I intend to move in myself as soon as possible.
translation: 我很高兴地确认，我已在福蒂斯成功购置了一处房产用作安全屋。位置极佳，正对银行。为避免任何可能的怀疑，我认为最好让房子始终有人居住。因此，我打算尽快亲自搬进去。

english: May Ralos and Ranul guide us,
translation: 愿拉洛斯和拉努尔指引我们，

english: The armour normally displayed here is currently being cleaned.
translation: 这里通常展示的盔甲正在清洁中。

english: The Knights of Varlamore were founded by King Mezpah after his ascension to the throne. These knights are selected by either the kingdom's ruler or their heir, with any citizen of Varlamore having the ability to become one.
translation: 瓦拉莫尔骑士团由梅兹帕国王登基后创立。这些骑士由王国统治者或其继承人选拔，任何瓦拉莫尔市民都有机会成为其中一员。

english: Knights of Varlamore can serve in a variety of duties across the kingdom and are granted a set of prestigious armour like that shown here.
translation: 瓦拉莫尔骑士可在王国各地执行各种职责，并获得一套如这里所示的尊贵盔甲。

english: The model normally displayed here is currently being cleaned.
translation: 这里通常展示的模型正在清洁中。

english: 100 years after the founding of Fortis, it was decreed that a second settlement be built to address issues caused by the fast growing population. At the time, the islands of Tempest Bay were not considered a strong contender due to the unstable ground and the presence of a band of hill giants. However, the unlikely defeat of the giants ultimately led to the construnction of Tempestus. The model here shows the city as it exists today.
translation: 福蒂斯建立100年后，为应对快速增长的人口问题，下令建造第二个定居点。当时，暴风湾诸岛因地面不稳和一群丘陵巨人的存在而不被看好。然而，巨人的意外败北最终促成了坦佩斯图斯的建造。这里的模型展示了该城如今的面貌。

english: During today's march I noticed a tree I'd never seen before. It had large gourd-like fruit growing from it, but the cursed rot had bloodied the flesh.
translation: 今天的行军中，我注意到一棵从未见过的树。树上结着巨大的葫芦状果实，但该死的腐烂已使果肉染血。

english: I collected an armful of the foul fruits and carefully checked them over to find the rot had done something quite extraordinary. The fruits outer skin had become brittle while the inner flesh digests and absorbs anything placed inside. The perfect vessel for a deadly concoction.
translation: 我收集了一抱这些恶臭的果实，仔细检查后发现腐烂产生了非凡的效果。果实的外皮变得脆弱，而内里的果肉会消化并吸收放入其中的任何东西。这是致命混合物的完美容器。

english: After numerous experiments, I've found the perfect ingredient! It seems so obvious now, but if blood is poured into the rotting gourd, it fills the flesh with a highly volatile gas. Once the blood has been entirely absorbed, smashing the brittle skin causes a mighty explosion, powerful enough to eject whatever is stored within.
translation: 经过无数次实验，我找到了完美的原料！现在想来显而易见，但如果将血倒入腐烂的葫芦中，果肉会充满高度不稳定的气体。一旦血液被完全吸收，砸碎脆弱的外皮便会引发猛烈爆炸，足以将其中储存的任何东西喷射出去。

english: This weapon would truly turn the tide of the coming battles, but the blood required for such an arsenal will certainly drain the troops morale, amongst other things... There must be another way, perhaps Phosani has the answers.
translation: 这种武器将真正扭转即将到来的战局，但制造如此军火库所需的血液必定会耗尽士兵的士气，以及其他东西……一定有其他办法，也许福萨尼知道答案。

english: There are many stories and histories among the dwarves about the mountains beyond Trollheim, all of which tell of great secrets and wealth lying buried for aeons. Now, I've never been able to resist the lure of the unknown, which is the reason that I've explored the length and breadth of Gielinor, so rumours that an ancient temple had been discovered north of the Death Plateau had me jumping to get out there and see for myself.
translation: 矮人中有许多关于巨魔山之外山脉的故事和历史，都讲述着埋藏了无数岁月的伟大秘密和财富。如今，我从未能抗拒未知的诱惑，这也是我踏遍吉莱诺尔的原因，所以当传闻死亡高原以北发现了一座古老神殿时，我迫不及待地想去亲眼看看。

english: The journey into the mountains was uneventful, save for the amount of time I had to spend finding a reasonable route into the mountains. My first attempt took me to the west of the Ice Path, journeying through the ice gate, but I was thwarted by a huge snowbank, which I couldn't find any way over. I had no desire to pass any pesky trolls, so once again I took the long route.
translation: 进入山脉的旅程平淡无奇，除了我花了大量时间寻找合理的进山路线。第一次尝试走冰门以西，穿过冰门，却被巨大的雪堆挡住，找不到任何翻越的办法。我不想招惹那些讨厌的巨魔，于是再次走了远路。

english: This time I travelled deep into that blighted landscape that is called the Wilderness, only to be thwarted by a steep cliff. At one point I found some purchase in the rock face, but my attempts were futile and I was forced to abseil down the cliff to try a different approach.
translation: 这次我深入那片被称为荒野的荒芜之地，却被陡峭的悬崖挡住。有一刻我在岩壁上找到了落脚点，但尝试徒劳无功，被迫沿绳降下悬崖另寻他路。
