english: My third attempt was from the south. I snuck past the trolls under cover of darkness and eventually found a small valley that was blocked by rockfall. Fortunately, my small size allowed me to squeeze between the rocks in the avalanche debris and I found myself beset by starving wolves. I fled from them and found signs of an ancient battle, mostly hidden by the snow. The ruins seemed to indicate that a great palace or temple once stood there, but time and events had taken their toll and there was naught but rubble left.
translation: 第三次尝试从南面出发。我在夜色掩护下悄悄溜过巨魔，最终发现一个被落石堵塞的小山谷。幸运的是，我身材矮小，得以在雪崩碎石的缝隙中挤过去，却发现自己被饥饿的狼群包围。我逃离了它们，发现了古战场的痕迹，大多被雪掩埋。废墟似乎表明那里曾矗立着一座宏伟的宫殿或神殿，但时间和变故已使其面目全非，只剩下瓦砾。

english: Exploring the area, I found a massive pit where the ground had collapsed, so I tied off my rope and descended, hand over hand, into the maws of hell. Below the ruins was a massive cave, stretching as far as the eye could see and filled with all manner of demons, goblins and strange birdmen, all locked in mortal combat. As I watched, a small battalion of orks surrounded and slew a demon, but were then themselves besieged by a pack of hellhounds! I am an explorer, not a warrior, so I left the same way that I had come, taking my rope with me so that none of those monstrosities could escape their prison. If there WAS treasure or gold to be found in those ruins the risk was not worth the reward, although some may argue with me.
translation: 探索该区域时，我发现一个巨大的坑洞，地面塌陷了，于是我系好绳子，双手交替下降，进入地狱之口。废墟下方是一个巨大的洞穴，一望无际，充满了各种恶魔、哥布林和奇怪的鸟人，都在进行殊死搏斗。我观看时，一小队兽人包围并杀死了一个恶魔，但随后他们自己又被一群地狱犬围攻！我是探险家，不是战士，所以我原路返回，带走了绳子，以免那些怪物逃出牢笼。如果那些废墟里真有宝藏或金子，那风险也不值得回报，尽管有人可能不同意。

english: One other incident bears remarking upon; while leaving the mountain peaks I stumbled upon a small group of undead trolls, marching northwards. All I can say is that trolls are even stupider dead than they are alive, for they did not see me at all - even though I was hiding behind some rubble, only feet from where they marched.
translation: 还有一件事值得一提；离开山峰时，我偶然遇到一小群亡灵巨魔，正向北行进。我只能说，巨魔死后比活着更愚蠢，因为他们完全没有看到我——尽管我就躲在离他们行进路线仅几步之遥的瓦砾后面。

english: I feel that my next journey should take me in a different direction completely. Word has come to me that the poisonous swamps, far to the south-west, may be traversable, which is something I cannot help but explore. Even now I can feel a tingling wanderlust.
translation: 我觉得下次旅程应该完全换个方向。有消息说，西南方远处的剧毒沼泽或许可以穿越，这让我忍不住想去探索。即使现在，我都能感到一阵渴望远行的悸动。

english: I have noted that my language, or beauty of writing, has improved tremendously since being alone. The opposite of what would be expected. I enjoy the flourish of description, opposed to the blunt, practical methods of my education. It eases my mind.
translation: 我注意到，独处以来，我的语言或文笔有了极大的提升。这与预期相反。我喜欢华丽的描述，而非教育中那种直白实用的方式。这让我心情舒畅。

english: There is nothing a mother wouldnt do to ensure the safety of her children.
translation: 为了确保孩子的安全，母亲什么都愿意做。

english: Other players can now activate your escape crystals for you. To do this, they need to use a escape crystal of their own on you. Both you and the person rescuing you will use a crystal if they do this.
translation: 其他玩家现在可以为你激活逃脱水晶。为此，他们需要使用自己的逃脱水晶对你使用。如果这样做，你和施救者都会消耗一颗水晶。

english: Your escape crystals will now auto-activate if you take damage after a 180 seconds (3 minutes) period of inactivity (rotating the camera may not always count as activity). You can customise the duration of the inactivity period between 5 and 300 seconds.
translation: 如果你的逃脱水晶在180秒（3分钟）无活动后受到伤害，将自动激活（旋转视角可能不总是算作活动）。你可以自定义无活动时间，范围在5到300秒之间。

english: Set auto-activation inactivity period (in seconds)(current: 180s)
translation: 设置自动激活无活动时间（秒）（当前：180秒）

english: Ghorrock is forsaken and must be evacuated at once. Round up all who are left and tell them they have an hour to leave. Jhallan and Mizzarch are preparing to have this place sealed. After that, there will no escape. Not for him, and not for any others left inside.
translation: 戈罗克已被遗弃，必须立即撤离。召集所有留下的人，告诉他们有一小时时间离开。贾兰和米扎克正准备封印此地。之后，将无路可逃。对他如此，对任何留在里面的人也是如此。

english: He ate them...
translation: 他把它们吃了...

english: He ate them all!
translation: 他把它们全吃了！

english: You search through the crates and find a book. Inside the cover is a stamp: 'Belongs to the Arceuus Library.'
translation: 你在板条箱里翻找，发现了一本书。封面内侧有一个印章：'阿西乌斯图书馆所有。'

english: You search through the crates and find a discarded label: 'Property of the Outpost. Contact Jorral if lost.'
translation: 你在板条箱里翻找，发现了一张被丢弃的标签：'前哨站财产。遗失请联系乔拉尔。'

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build eternal braziers on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读了示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造永恒火盆。你记下了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: We've made it through another day, and pushed those foul vampyres back once more. They've retreated back past the river, and they're weaker now than we've ever seen them before... Still, I've no doubt they see us as the same. The constant uphill battle has been tiring, and we can only keep pushing for so much longer.
translation: 我们又撑过了一天，再次击退了那些可恶的吸血鬼。他们已经撤退到河流对岸，现在比以往任何时候都要虚弱... 不过，我毫不怀疑他们看我们也是一样的。这场无休止的逆风仗让人疲惫不堪，我们也撑不了太久了。

english: However this fight goes, we must secure the river and ensure it can never be breached again by these unholy forces. That in itself is sure to be... a challenge, to say the least.
translation: 无论这场战斗结果如何，我们都必须守住河流，确保这些邪恶势力永远无法再次突破。这本身就是... 至少可以说，是个挑战。

english: Fortunately, Iriandul still has a trusty steed at the ready. While we've been setting up camp for the night, he has ridden west once more to gather supplies. He is lucky. It has been a long time since the rest of us have seen true civilisation, and it may well be that we never will again.
translation: 幸运的是，伊里安杜尔还有一匹可靠的坐骑随时待命。趁我们夜里扎营的时候，他再次骑马西行去搜集补给品了。他很幸运。我们其他人已经很久没见过真正的文明了，而且很可能再也见不到了。

english: The contents of the barrel seem quite unstable and could easily be ignited. However, it's probably wise that you don't do so without good reason.
translation: 木桶里的东西看起来很不稳定，很容易被点燃。不过，没有充分理由的话，你最好不要这么做。

english: Etching an elder venator fang requires a chisel.
translation: 雕刻长者猎龙毒牙需要一把凿子。

english: You etch the elder venator fang.
translation: 你雕刻了长者猎龙毒牙。

english: Creating a necklace of rupture requires you to be near a bank.
translation: 制作破裂项链需要你靠近银行。

english: Do you wish to create a necklace of rupture using a etched elder venator fang and a necklace of anguish? This process is non-reversible and will consume both items.
translation: 你想用雕刻过的长者猎龙毒牙和痛苦项链制作一条破裂项链吗？此过程不可逆，且会消耗两件物品。

english: Do you wish to create a necklace of rupture?
translation: 你想制作一条破裂项链吗？

english: You carefully craft a necklace of rupture.
translation: 你精心制作了一条破裂项链。

english: Do you wish to use the etched araxyte fang on your amulet of torture? This process is non-reversible and will consume both items.
translation: 你想将雕刻过的阿拉克西特毒牙用在你的折磨护符上吗？此过程不可逆，且会消耗两件物品。

english: Do you wish to create a amulet of rancour?
translation: 你想制作一个怨恨护符吗？

english: The Eye of Ayak has no charges! You need to charge it with either death runes and chaos runes or with demon tears.
translation: 阿亚克的眼没有充能！你需要用死亡符石和混沌符石，或者用恶魔之泪来给它充能。

english: Once again, the cow is ignoring you.
translation: 奶牛又一次无视了你。

english: The human found some symbols
translation: 那个人类找到了一些符号

english: And doesn't know what they mean
translation: 却不知道它们是什么意思

english: So now it's cross-examining me
translation: 所以现在它来盘问我

english: And spoiling my routine!
translation: 还打乱了我的日常！

english: Maybe you should bring that certificate with you.
translation: 也许你应该随身带着那张证书。

english: You see a fairy approaching ...
translation: 你看到一位仙子正在靠近...

english: Oh, how rude of me! [player name] this is Fairy Very Wise, advisor to the Queen. Fairy Very Wise, this is [player name].
translation: 哦，我真失礼！[player name]，这位是睿智仙子，女王的顾问。睿智仙子，这位是[player name]。

english: You attempt to pickpocket the Fairy Godfather.
translation: 你试图扒窃仙子教父。

english: On display here is a fang from the Colossal Wyrm. The wyrm is believed to have originated from deep within the Hailstorm Mountains, but for unknown reasons, it travelled to the Avium Savannah around 200 years ago. The wyrm terrorised the region for many moons before warriors from across the kingdom finally banded together to defeat it.
translation: 这里展示的是巨蛇龙的一颗毒牙。据信这条蛇龙起源于暴风山脉深处，但出于未知原因，大约两百年前它来到了阿维乌姆草原。这条蛇龙肆虐该地区数月之久，最终王国各地的勇士们联手将其击败。

english: Not often we get one like you 'round these parts. Wind push you ashore?
translation: 咱们这地方可不常来你这样的人。是风把你吹上岸的？

english: Apologies, not much one for the formalities. Name's Cormac. I'm the mayor of this place.
translation: 抱歉，我不太讲究那些客套。我叫科马克，是这里的镇长。

english: And I'm [player name].
translation: 我是[player name]。

english: Good to meet you proper.
translation: 很高兴正式认识你。

english: Likewise. So what's with the others around here? Getting a sense they're not fans of... well, anyone.
translation: 彼此彼此。那这周围的其他人是怎么回事？感觉他们不太待见... 嗯，任何人。

english: Oh, pay 'em no mind. They're just a little wary of outsiders. Tend not t' get many through here, what with the isolated location and all.
translation: 哦，别理他们。他们只是对外来者有点警惕。咱们这地方偏僻，平时很少有人来。

english: I'd expect more curiosity if outsiders are uncommon, if I'm honest...
translation: 说实话，如果外来者不常见，我反倒觉得他们应该更好奇才对...

english: Our history's a complicated one... As I say, best put it out ya mind. That said, if you be wantin' to get in their good books, you could make yourself useful.
translation: 我们的历史有点复杂... 就像我说的，最好别去想它。不过，如果你想赢得他们的好感，倒是可以帮上点忙。

english: Useful how?
translation: 帮什么忙？

english: Well, if you're feeling brave, we've had one of the villagers, Keenan, go missing. We know he's not much of a sailor, so he'll be somewhere on the island.
translation: 嗯，如果你胆子够大，我们有个村民叫基南，他失踪了。我们知道他不怎么擅长航海，所以他应该还在岛上的某个地方。

english: Couldn't you find him yourselves? The island doesn't seem like too much ground to cover.
translation: 你们自己不能找他吗？这岛看起来也没多大地方要找。

english: Aye, we've tried, but this island... she has more than a few secrets... Were things different...
translation: 是啊，我们试过了，但这岛... 藏着不少秘密... 要是情况不同...

english: Different? What do you mean?
translation: 不同？什么意思？

english: Ah, don't be worrying yourself about it. The point is, an outsider like yourself might be endin' up having better luck than we've had, if you're willing to help?
translation: 啊，别为此烦心了。重点是，像你这样的外来者说不定比我们运气好，你愿意帮忙吗？

english: Start the Fallen From Grace quest?
translation: 开始'堕落之格蕾丝'任务？

english: Alright, I'll help you find Keenan. Any ideas on where to start?
translation: 好吧，我帮你找基南。有什么线索吗？

english: I'd check in with his mother, Muriel. She'd know more than most. Their house is the one just t' north east of here.
translation: 去问问他母亲穆里尔吧。她比大多数人知道得多。他们家就在这东北边。

english: That's okay. I'll still be here if you end up feelin' otherwise.
translation: 没关系。如果你改变主意了，我还会在这。

english: You said there might be a way for me to get in people's good books?
translation: 你说过也许有办法让我赢得大家的好感？

english: Any luck on your hunt for Keenan yet?
translation: 找基南有进展了吗？

english: I'd start by checking in with his mother, Muriel. She'd know more than most. Their house is the one just t' north east of here.
translation: 先去找他母亲穆里尔问问吧。她比大多数人知道得多。他们家就在这东北边。

english: You can't see any good reason to try to dock in this dangerous looking cavern.
translation: 你看不出有什么理由要在这个看起来危险的洞穴停靠。

english: You can't see any good reason to try to disembark in this dangerous looking cavern.
translation: 你看不出有什么理由要在这个看起来危险的洞穴下船。

english: Keenan.
translation: 基南。

english: Always knew he'd get into trouble.
translation: 一直知道他迟早会惹上麻烦。

english: Was he that kind of person?
translation: 他是那种人吗？

english: A troublemaker? No, not necessarily. Had a habit of being in his own world a lot, wandering about unaware of a lot of things. Not a lick of survival instinct in him.
translation: 惹麻烦的人？不，倒不一定是。他就是经常沉浸在自己的世界里，到处游荡，对很多事都不在意。一点生存本能都没有。

english: Another nosey one, eh?
translation: 又来一个爱管闲事的，嗯？

english: You'll go the way of the last one: wyrm food.
translation: 你会和上一个一样：成为蛇龙的食物。

english: I'm looking for Keenan.
translation: 我在找基南。

english: Well, you won't find him. No one who disappears on this island ever shows up again.
translation: 那你找不到了。在这岛上消失的人没有一个再出现过。

english: None of your business. You'd be better off staying out of things. Now go away.
translation: 不关你的事。你最好别管闲事。现在走吧。

english: Outsider.
translation: 外来者。

english: Hello to you as well. I was wondering if you knew anything about Keenan's disappearance?
translation: 你好。我想问问你是否知道基南失踪的事？

english: Yup. He disappeared.
translation: 知道。他失踪了。

english: Thanks. Very helpful.
translation: 谢谢。真有用。

english: Outsider, you better not be causing trouble.
translation: 外来者，你最好别惹麻烦。

english: Trouble? I hope not.
translation: 麻烦？我希望不会。

english: Heh. Makes you better than the last one then. Keep that up.
translation: 嘿。那你比上一个强。继续保持。

english: What did the last one do?
translation: 上一个做了什么？

english: Acted up a storm about how their boat had been wrecked on the rocks and they needed help, only to then go and get themselves killed in the caverns after we'd patched them up.
translation: 大吵大闹说他们的船在岩石上撞毁了需要帮助，结果我们帮他们治好了伤，他们又跑去洞穴里送死了。

english: A damn shame to waste what limited resources we have.
translation: 浪费我们有限的资源，真是可惜。

english: Excuse me, you didn't happen to know Keenan did you?
translation: 打扰一下，你碰巧认识基南吗？

english: Sure did. Strange lad that one. Spent hours going on about sun energy, or something like that.
translation: 当然认识。那是个奇怪的小伙子。花了好几个小时讲什么太阳能之类的。

english: Sun energy?
translation: 太阳能？

english: That's right, though I must admit, I didn't fully pay attention, so I may have misunderstood.
translation: 没错，不过我得承认，我没怎么认真听，可能理解错了。

english: What am I meant to be doing here?
translation: 我该在这里做什么？

english: I'm looking for Keenan. You haven't seen him, have you?
translation: 我在找基南。你见过他吗？

english: Aye, I heard t'lad went missin', but I can nay tell ye if he's been 'ere or not. These bleedin' goats be far too distractin'.
translation: 哎，我听说那小子失踪了，但我可不知道他有没有来过这。这些该死的山羊太让人分心了。

english: I see. Thanks anyway.
translation: 明白了。那还是谢谢你。

english: Muriel, is it?
translation: 穆里尔，是吗？

english: Ah... the outsider. I'm sorry, but I'm not really in the mood for visitors.
translation: 啊……外来者。抱歉，我现在没什么心情接待访客。

english: I understand, but I'm actually here in the hopes that I can help you. Cormac has asked me to look for your son.
translation: 我明白，但我来这里其实是想帮你。Cormac让我来找你的儿子。

english: Oh... well, what do you need from me?
translation: 哦……那你需要我做什么？

english: Did Keenan give you any idea where he might be going?
translation: Keenan有没有跟你提过他可能要去哪里？

english: No, no. It was a usual day. He ran about town doing everything he needed, then he grabbed his hat and went to sit and stare at the sunstone. I could never convince him to do something more productive...
translation: 没有，没有。那天跟往常一样。他在镇上跑来跑去办完该办的事，然后拿起帽子就去坐在那儿盯着太阳石看。我怎么也说服不了他去做点更有用的事……

english: Sunstone?
translation: 太阳石？

english: That big rock over in the mine. He's been obsessed with it. Always going on about how it has some secret to be discovered...
translation: 就是矿场里那块大石头。他对它着了迷。总说那石头藏着什么秘密等着被发现……

english: I see. I'll go over there and see if I can find anything of note.
translation: 我明白了。我去那边看看能不能找到什么线索。

english: You're back. Have you had any luck finding Keenan?
translation: 你回来了。找到Keenan了吗？

english: Not yet. Where did you say I should be looking?
translation: 还没有。你说我该去哪儿找来着？

english: The sunstone over in the mine. He's been obsessed with it. Always going on about how it has some secret to be discovered...
translation: 矿场里的那块太阳石。他对它着了迷。总说那石头藏着什么秘密等着被发现……

english: Alright, I'll head over there and see what I can find.
translation: 好，我过去看看能找到什么。

english: Not yet, no, but Muriel's given me something to go on. I'll see if it leads me anywhere.
translation: 还没，不过Muriel给了我一些线索。我去看看能不能顺藤摸瓜。

english: Let's hope it does. There be something out there that gives us a clue, I'm sure of it.
translation: 希望如此。外面肯定有什么东西能给我们线索，我敢肯定。

english: You look upon the large rock and feel a strange energy pulsing around you. You then notice a book amidst some nearby rocks, which you take. You also notice a trail of dust leading away from the rock...
translation: 你注视着那块大岩石，感到一股奇怪的能量在你周围涌动。然后你注意到附近岩石间有一本书，便拿了起来。你还看到一条灰尘痕迹从岩石延伸出去……

english: You look upon the large rock and feel a strange energy pulsing around you. As you look upon it, you notice a book amidst some nearby rocks. However, you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 你注视着那块大岩石，感到一股奇怪的能量在你周围涌动。当你注视它时，你注意到附近岩石间有一本书。但你的背包没有足够的空间来拿它。

english: I've found what I'm guessing is his notebook over in the mine.
translation: 我在矿场里找到了我猜是他的笔记本。

english: Full of scribbles and nonsense?
translation: 全是涂鸦和胡言乱语？

english: I wouldn't call it all nonsense. He apparently felt like he was being watched whilst he was at the sunstone. That's something.
translation: 也不能全说是胡言乱语。他显然觉得在太阳石那里时有人在看着他。这算是条线索。

english: Watched? I mean, none of us really kept too close an eye on the lad. Why would he feel like someone was watching him?
translation: 被看着？我是说，我们谁也没太盯着那小子。他怎么会觉得有人在看他？

english: Well, if I keep following the trail, maybe I'll find out.
translation: 嗯，如果我继续沿着痕迹找下去，也许能弄清楚。

english: Not yet, but I've found a trail over in the mine that might lead me somewhere. Speaking of which, I'd better get back to it.
translation: 还没，但我在矿场里发现了一条痕迹，可能会带我去某个地方。说到这个，我得回去继续追查了。

english: You find a hat hooked onto a rock in the shadow of a large cathedral... Could the hat be Keenan's?
translation: 你发现一顶帽子挂在大教堂阴影中的一块岩石上……这顶帽子会是Keenan的吗？

english: The hat appears to be hooked onto a rock. Could it be Keenan's?
translation: 那顶帽子似乎挂在一块岩石上。会是Keenan的吗？

english: Does Keenan have a habit of losing his hat?
translation: Keenan有丢帽子的习惯吗？

english: Not particularly, no. He always takes good care of it. Why do you ask?
translation: 倒也不是。他总是很爱惜那顶帽子。你问这个干嘛？

english: I found a hat caught up on some rocks to the south. I wondered if it might have been his.
translation: 我在南边的一些岩石上发现了一顶帽子。我在想会不会是他的。

english: No, he'd not just leave it there like that. At least, not of his own volition...
translation: 不，他不会就这样把它丢在那里的。至少不会是他自愿的……

english: Muriel begins to sob, preventing any further questioning.
translation: Muriel开始抽泣，无法继续回答你的问题。

english: Muriel seems too upset to talk to you right now.
translation: Muriel现在似乎太难过了，无法和你说话。

english: Well, I found a hat that might belong to Keenan.
translation: 嗯，我找到了一顶可能是Keenan的帽子。

english: You did? Where?
translation: 你找到了？在哪儿？

english: Down amongst the rocks beneath that big cathedral.
translation: 在那座大教堂下面的岩石间。

english: The cathedral? No... No that can't be right...
translation: 大教堂？不……不，那不可能……

english: What do you mean? What is that cathedral?
translation: 什么意思？那座大教堂是什么？

english: Ardeaglais. It be the home of the Mad Angel.
translation: Ardeaglais。那是疯狂天使的居所。

english: I get the feeling you haven't been totally honest with me.
translation: 我感觉你对我没有完全说实话。

english: It wasn't my wish to mislead, I just did nay want to waste your time with local superstitions...
translation: 我不是有意误导你，我只是不想用当地的迷信浪费你的时间……

english: It sounds like we might be dealing with more than superstitions.
translation: 听起来我们面对的恐怕不只是迷信。

english: Aye, it seems we are.
translation: 是啊，看来确实如此。

english: I think it's time you explained. What is this Mad Angel?
translation: 我觉得是时候解释清楚了。这个疯狂天使是什么？

english: Old. Vicious. At least, that's what some of the stories say. Others though... they call her our protector. The only thing keepin' us safe from horrors o' the deep sea.
translation: 老了。凶残。至少有些故事是这么说的。不过其他人...他们称她为我们的守护者。是唯一能保护我们免受深海恐怖威胁的存在。

english: But you've never seen her?
translation: 但你从未见过她？

english: No. The stories... they be sayin' that she'll keep us safe in exchange for tribute, but if we fail to keep her happy, she'll take one o' ours instead.
translation: 没有。故事里说...她会以贡品换取我们的安全，但如果我们没能让她满意，她就会带走我们中的一员作为替代。

english: And you didn't think to mention this earlier?
translation: 你之前怎么没提这事？

english: I thought they was just tales! That the cathedral was long abandoned! So many of the others get 'emselves proper worked up about the Angel, but my job is to keep things calm.
translation: 我以为那只是传说！大教堂早就被废弃了！其他很多人对天使的事激动得很，但我的职责是让大家保持冷静。

english: Well, whatever the truth is, it seems I'm going to need to enter that cathedral. How do I get inside?
translation: 好吧，不管真相如何，看来我得进入那座大教堂。我怎么进去？

english: Well, I wouldn't even try the front... but maybe you'll have some luck getting in from beneath.
translation: 嗯，我不会尝试正门...但也许从下面进去会有运气。

english: Beneath?
translation: 下面？

english: The stories say that some o' the first settlers here apparently sailed into the caverns on the south side of the island, but between the rocks and the tides, their ships never be havin' a chance at coming back out.
translation: 故事说，这里最早的定居者似乎是从岛屿南侧的洞穴驶入的，但介于岩石和潮汐之间，他们的船根本不可能再出来。

english: Instead, they found another way t' get out, up onto the cliffs. The same one where they eventually built Ardeaglais.
translation: 相反，他们找到了另一条出路，爬上了悬崖。也就是他们最终建造阿德格莱斯的地方。

english: So I'm going to have to sail into those caverns myself?
translation: 所以我也得自己驾船进入那些洞穴？

english: Aye, but don't make the same mistake they did. Make sure t' use something on the smaller side, else you'll get into trouble on the rocks.
translation: 是的，但别犯他们同样的错误。一定要用较小的船只，否则在岩石上会出麻烦。

english: And be careful down there. Some say the Mad Angel ain't the only danger on this island, and it ain't the wyrms they're talking about. They reckon there be other evils lurking in them caverns...
translation: 而且在下面要小心。有人说疯天使不是这个岛上唯一的危险，他们说的不是蛇龙。他们认为那些洞穴里潜伏着其他邪恶...

english: Wonderful. I'll be sure to take care then.
translation: 太好了。那我一定会小心的。

english: Do you know where the Mad Angel came from?
translation: 你知道疯天使是从哪里来的吗？

english: The tales say she led the first settlers here. She be the one to help 'em build this town and she kept them safe from all the dangers that come with such an out t' way location.
translation: 传说她带领第一批定居者来到这里。她帮助他们建起了这座城镇，并保护他们免受如此偏远之地带来的所有危险。

english: And was she always mad?
translation: 她一直疯吗？

english: No. That happened slowly. To start with she was able t' live among the people, but eventually they had to build Ardeaglais for her.
translation: 不。那是慢慢发生的。起初她还能和人们生活在一起，但最终他们不得不为她建造阿德格莱斯。

english: Which is where she's stayed ever since?
translation: 从那以后她就一直待在那里？

english: Supposedly. But no one's seen her in my lifetime, though I s'pose it's not like anyone be fancying going into Ardeaglais to check.
translation: 据说是这样。但我这辈子没人见过她，不过我想也没人会想去阿德格莱斯确认一下。

english: What tributes are you meant to give to the Mad Angel?
translation: 你们要给疯天使献上什么贡品？

english: Aye, a tithe of human blood. No other blood will do.
translation: 是的，人血的什一税。其他血都不行。

english: And people here have still been doing that?
translation: 这里的人还在这么做？

english: Well, a lot of us dismissed her as a myth, but there be plenty of superstitious folk here who were keen to make sure the tributes continued.
translation: 嗯，我们很多人把她当作神话，但这里也有不少迷信的人，他们热衷于确保贡品继续献上。

english: So they just deliver some blood up to the cathedral?
translation: 所以他们只是把血送到大教堂？

english: Pretty much. They leave it nearby and make sure not to be around when it gets taken.
translation: 差不多。他们把血放在附近，确保在被取走时不在场。

english: And it does get taken?
translation: 血确实会被取走？

english: Aye, but hard to say if it's actually the Mad Angel doing it. Could be it's just the wildlife.
translation: 是的，但很难说是不是疯天使干的。也可能是野生动物。

english: Where was it you said I should go to get to the cathedral?
translation: 你刚才说我去大教堂应该走哪里？

english: You'll need to sail through the caverns that run beneath us. Should be able to get into them if you sail around to the south side of the island.
translation: 你需要驾船穿过我们脚下的洞穴。如果你绕到岛屿南侧，应该能进入那些洞穴。

english: Hey you! Get over here, quickly!
translation: 嘿，你！快过来！

english: It's dangerous here. What are you doing?
translation: 这里很危险。你在干什么？

english: A talking skeleton? What is this?
translation: 会说话的骷髅？这是什么情况？

english: That is a question that is not currently relevant, given our present situation. Help me with this blockage, and maybe then you'll get your answers.
translation: 这个问题目前不重要，考虑到我们现在的处境。帮我处理这个堵塞物，也许之后你会得到答案。

english: Fair enough... What do you need?
translation: 好吧...你需要什么？

english: It was those three nearby trolls that caused this, and they've not been happy about my attempts to sort it. Deal with them for me while I work on clearing the way.
translation: 是附近那三只巨魔造成的，它们对我清理的尝试很不满。你帮我解决它们，我来清理道路。

english: How are you doing with those trolls?
translation: 那些巨魔处理得怎么样了？

english: I'm not quite done with them yet.
translation: 我还没完全搞定它们。

english: Remember, I just need you to handle the three nearby ones.
translation: 记住，我只需要你处理附近的那三只。

english: Hey! Come give me a hand over here.
translation: 嘿！过来帮我一把。

english: You notice the skeleton calling you over.
translation: 你注意到骷髅在向你招手。

english: I've got those trolls handled.
translation: 那些巨魔我已经搞定了。

english: Perfect. I've pretty much got things cleared here. Give me a hand with the last few bits...
translation: 完美。我这边基本清理干净了。帮我处理最后这点活儿吧……

english: You help get the remaining rocks cleared...
translation: 你帮忙清理了剩余的岩石……

english: Well, well, well, would you look at that! An adventurer who isn't just skin and bones! You did well handling those trolls.
translation: 哎呀呀，看看这是谁！一个不是皮包骨的冒险者！你对付那些巨魔干得不错。

english: Thanks, but you look like you'd have been capable of handling them yourself.
translation: 谢谢，不过看起来你自己也能应付得来。

english: I would've done, if they hadn't trapped me on the other side of that rockfall.
translation: 要不是他们把我困在落石另一边，我早就搞定了。

english: Fair point. So, who are you? And... what are you?
translation: 说得对。那么，你是谁？还有……你是什么？

english: The name's Mortimer, and I'm the oldest Slayer Master across all of the seas of Gielinor.
translation: 我叫莫蒂默，是吉列诺尔所有海域中最年长的杀戮大师。

english: But you're a skeleton?
translation: 但你是骷髅啊？

english: Well noted. Now, what is it you're actually doing down here?
translation: 观察得真仔细。那么，你到底在这下面做什么？

english: I'm trying to find a missing villager. He may be up in the cathedral.
translation: 我在找一个失踪的村民。他可能在大教堂里。

english: Hmm... a noble cause. I'm afraid I've not seen him myself. Good luck on your search though.
translation: 嗯……崇高的目标。恐怕我自己没见过他。不过祝你好运。

english: So you say you're a Slayer Master?
translation: 你说你是杀戮大师？

english: Indeed. Perhaps you'd be up for one of my special slayer assignments?
translation: 没错。也许你有兴趣接我的特殊杀戮任务？

english: Maybe... What's so special about these assignments?
translation: 也许吧……这些任务有什么特别的？

english: Well, back in my day there was a lot more freedom and less bureaucracy about what adventurers were assigned to slay... as long as it was in need of slaying.
translation: 在我那个年代，冒险者被指派去杀什么有更多自由，少些官僚作风……只要那东西该杀就行。

english: If you slay for me, I will give you the choice of two different creatures to be assigned. If you continue to prove your worth to me, I could be convinced to offer three choices instead of two.
translation: 如果你为我杀戮，我会给你两种不同生物的选择。如果你继续向我证明你的价值，我也许会被说服给你三种选择而不是两种。

english: What's the catch?
translation: 有什么陷阱？

english: I'll only assign you options from creatures which have superior variants, regardless of whether you have that perk unlocked. My tasks also won't naturally offer any slayer points.
translation: 我只会给你有高级变种的生物选项，不管你是否解锁了那个特权。我的任务也不会自然提供杀戮点数。

english: This is purely slaying for the love of slaying.
translation: 纯粹是为了杀戮而杀戮。

english: As an added bonus, some of my assignments include creatures which are more lucrative than they normally would be. I'll point this out when offering your assignments, so keep your eyes peeled.
translation: 额外的好处是，我的一些任务包含比平时更有利可图的生物。提供任务时我会指出来，所以睁大眼睛。

english: Any luck gettin' into the caverns?
translation: 进洞穴有进展吗？

english: I've managed to get into them, yes. Still no sign of Keenan though.
translation: 我已经进去了，是的。但还是没有基南的踪迹。

english: Best we hope it isn't too late.
translation: 希望还不算太晚。

english: It's a broken down golem made from sunstone. You begin to inspect it closer...
translation: 这是一个由太阳石制成的破损魔像。你开始仔细检查它……

english: You find a dulled golem core within its chest, but you leave it behind as you have nowhere to put it.
translation: 你在它胸口发现了一个暗淡的魔像核心，但因为没有地方放，你把它留在了原地。

english: You find a dulled golem core within its chest.
translation: 你在它胸口发现了一个暗淡的魔像核心。

english: It appears to be a broken down golem made from sunstone with a large hole in its chest. You might be able to get it to move if you can power it up.
translation: 这似乎是一个由太阳石制成的破损魔像，胸口有个大洞。如果你能给它充能，也许能让它动起来。

english: The door is firmly locked. If you want to enter the cathedral, you're going to need to find another way inside.
translation: 门锁得死死的。如果你想进入大教堂，得找别的路进去。

english: I've managed to get into them, yes, but the way forward is blocked by some sort of golem. I think it's made of sunstone.
translation: 我已经进去了，是的，但前路被某种魔像挡住了。我觉得它是太阳石做的。

english: Sunstone? I do nay know much about that stuff. Ironically, Keenan would 'ave been the best person t' ask. I remember Muriel sayin' he was fascinated by the stuff.
translation: 太阳石？我对那东西不太了解。讽刺的是，基南是最该问的人。我记得穆里尔说过他对那东西很着迷。

english: You place the sunstone core into the golem. It provides just enough energy for the golem to move aside, letting you get past it...
translation: 你把太阳石核心放入魔像中。它提供了足够的能量让魔像移开，让你通过……

english: You go to climb the stairs, but notice a locked hatch at the top of them.
translation: 你正要爬楼梯，但注意到楼梯顶部有一个锁着的舱口。

english: You go to climb the stairs, but notice a locked hatch at the top of them. You also spot a note on the floor next to them.
translation: 你正要爬楼梯，但注意到楼梯顶部有一个锁着的舱口。你还发现旁边地板上有一张笔记。

english: You notice something written on the back of the note...
translation: 你注意到笔记背面写着什么……

english: Ignore it
translation: 忽略它

english: Something is written on both the front and back of the note.
translation: 笔记的正面和背面都写着字。

english: Read the front.
translation: 读正面。

english: Read the back.
translation: 读背面。

english: Yes, and I've found a way through them and into the basement of the cathedral. Still no sign of Keenan though.
translation: 是的，我找到了穿过它们进入大教堂地下室的路。但还是没有基南的踪迹。

english: It's startin' to feel like we've taken t' long...
translation: 感觉我们好像花了太长时间...

english: Well, we can't give up on him yet.
translation: 好吧，我们还不能放弃他。

english: You can see some interesting objects in the chest, but you have no space to take them.
translation: 你可以在宝箱里看到一些有趣的物品，但你没有空间带走它们。

english: You find a book and an old sunstone core in the chest.
translation: 你在宝箱里找到了一本书和一个古老的日光石核心。

english: You find an old sunstone core in the chest. You can see something else in it as well, but you have no space to take it.
translation: 你在宝箱里找到了一个古老的日光石核心。你还能看到里面还有其他东西，但你没有空间带走它。

english: You find a book about golems in the chest.
translation: 你在宝箱里找到了一本关于魔像的书。

english: You find an old sunstone core in the chest.
translation: 你在宝箱里找到了一个古老的日光石核心。

english: There's nothing in the chest for you to take.
translation: 宝箱里没有你能带走的东西。

english: It's a very old sunstone core. It's long since run out of power, but as you inspect it, you hear something rattling within.
translation: 这是一个非常古老的日光石核心。它早已耗尽能量，但当你检查它时，你听到里面有东西在嘎嘎作响。

english: You break open the sunstone core and find a key hidden inside!
translation: 你打开了日光石核心，发现里面藏着一把钥匙！

english: Any luck findin' Keenan?
translation: 找到基南了吗？

english: I've managed to find a way into the cathedral, but it's not looking good... Best I get back there right away.
translation: 我找到了进入大教堂的路，但情况不太妙...我最好马上回去。

english: The body is almost certainly that of Keenan's. Sadly, it seems like he's been dead for a day or two at least. You spot a letter next to the body, but you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 这具尸体几乎可以肯定就是基南的。遗憾的是，他似乎已经死了至少一两天了。你注意到尸体旁边有一封信，但你没有足够的空间带走它。

english: The body is almost certainly that of Keenan's. Sadly, it seems like he's been dead for a day or two at least. As you go to step away from the body, you spot a letter next to it...
translation: 这具尸体几乎可以肯定就是基南的。遗憾的是，他似乎已经死了至少一两天了。当你准备离开尸体时，你发现旁边有一封信...

english: The body is almost certainly that of Keenan's. Sadly, it seems like he's been dead for a day or two at least.
translation: 这具尸体几乎可以肯定就是基南的。遗憾的是，他似乎已经死了至少一两天了。

english: You attempt to open the doors, but they appear to be locked.
translation: 你试图打开门，但它们似乎是锁着的。

english: Try to pick the lock.
translation: 尝试撬锁。

english: You successfully pick the lock, only to see it crumble away in your hands.
translation: 你成功撬开了锁，却看到它在你手中碎裂。

english: Cormac, I was too late. I managed to enter the cathedral, but I found Keenan dead inside.
translation: 科马克，我来得太晚了。我设法进入了大教堂，但发现基南死在了里面。

english: I see... Well, I had been hopin' for better news, but I s'pose this was probably inevitable... Was there anything you could bring back? A body?
translation: 我明白了...好吧，我本来希望听到更好的消息，但我想这可能是不可避免的...你能带回来什么吗？尸体？

english: There was, but it's not something that Muriel should have to see.
translation: 有，但这不是穆里尔应该看到的东西。

english: And the Angel? Did you deal with her?
translation: 那天使呢？你解决她了吗？

english: She wasn't there. I think whatever was left of her mind felt guilt over Keenan's death. It seems she's left the island.
translation: 她不在那里。我觉得她残存的理智对基南的死感到内疚。看来她已经离开了这座岛。

english: Is that it? She just gets t' leave us fendin' for ourselves?
translation: 就这样？她就这么丢下我们不管了？

english: She's built a golem to replace herself. It put up quite the fight. It needs some battle hardening, but if you're worried for your security, I'm certain it'll be able to help.
translation: 她造了一个魔像来代替自己。它可是好好打了一架。它还需要一些实战磨练，但如果你担心安全，我相信它能帮上忙。

english: That's... somethin' I guess.
translation: 那...也算有点东西吧。

english: Well, in a day we've gone from wonderin' if the Mad Angel is even real, to learnin' she was, but that she's now gone an' left for good. I s'pose that makes it a new era for us 'ere.
translation: 好吧，一天之内，我们从怀疑疯天使是否真实存在，到得知她确实存在，再到她已经离开并且不会再回来了。我想这对我们来说算是一个新时代了。

english: First up though, I'd best be tellin' Muriel the bad news. Until next time, [player name]... and I hope there will be a next time. Would be good for you t' stick around.
translation: 不过首先，我最好去告诉穆里尔这个坏消息。下次再见，[player name]...我希望还有下次。你留下来对我们来说是件好事。

english: Good. All the best, friend.
translation: 好的。一切顺利，朋友。

english: Hello, young one. Did you want to work on my farm?
translation: 你好，小家伙。你想在我的农场干活吗？

english: Hey, young one, do you know what you're doing in there?
translation: 嘿，小家伙，你知道你在里面做什么吗？

english: Alright, young one, I won't. Talk to me if you ever want a reminder.
translation: 好吧，小家伙，我不会了。如果你想让我提醒你，就跟我说话。

english: We're all set for the raid on the Gnome Stronghold tomorrow. They must have something good in a place that well defended. We'll sneak in over the west river while the gnomes are watching some big 'gnome ball' match, whatever that is. This time Armen won't be bringing his pet kebbit. That thing caused nothing but trouble last time.
translation: 我们明天突袭地精要塞的一切都准备好了。一个防守那么严密的地方肯定有好东西。我们会趁地精们看什么'地精球'比赛的时候从西边河流偷偷溜进去，管它是什么呢。这次阿尔门不会带他的宠物凯比特兔了。那东西上次除了惹麻烦什么也没干。

english: The start to the so called 'gnome ball' match appears to have been delayed; some sort of rubbish about bad light. Looks like we're stuck waiting here for now.
translation: 所谓的'地精球'比赛似乎被推迟了；好像是光线不好之类的废话。看来我们只能在这儿等着了。

english: I'm going to kill Armen, he assured me his kebbit was tied up safely. We were lucky to escape with our lives, especially Davey who got his foot caught in a rabbit hole whilst we were running away. Those long eared pests seem to get everywhere. Currently hiding in a cave in the mountains. The only 'loot' we managed to grab was a bag of refreshments from the gnome ball pitch. There'd better be something good in there, I could eat a camel right now.
translation: 我要杀了阿尔门，他向我保证他的凯比特兔被安全拴住了。我们能活着逃出来已经很幸运了，尤其是戴维，逃跑时脚卡在了兔洞里。那些长耳朵的害虫真是无处不在。现在躲在山里的一个洞穴里。我们唯一抢到的'战利品'就是从地精球场拿的一袋点心。里面最好有点好东西，我现在能吃下一头骆驼。

english: Gnomes are still looking for us outside, might be in here for a while. Fortunately this cave system seems to go a lot deeper than we originally thought, although some of the noises coming from the darker areas concern me slightly. Barakur has been playing with mechanisms as per usual. He thinks he can rig up something to hide the cave entrance. Is this what dwarves do when they get bored? Armen said he saw some kind of giant bird. I'm skeptical, although this place does give me the creeps.
translation: 地精还在外面找我们，可能得在这儿待一阵子。幸运的是这个洞穴系统比我们最初想的要深得多，虽然从黑暗区域传来的某些声音让我有点担心。巴拉库尔像往常一样在摆弄机关。他觉得他能搞出点什么来隐藏洞穴入口。这就是矮人无聊时干的事吗？阿尔门说他看到了一种巨型鸟。我表示怀疑，虽然这地方确实让我毛骨悚然。

english: Gnome food again today. Worms, however they're cooked, get boring after a while.
translation: 今天又是地精食物。蠕虫，不管怎么煮，吃久了都会腻。

english: Okay, we all saw the birds this time. Typically Armen insists he can tame them; that guy is animal crazy.
translation: 好吧，这次我们都看到那些鸟了。阿尔门照例坚持说他能驯服它们；那家伙对动物简直着魔了。

english: Gnomes seem to have stopped looking for us, although with Barakur's hidden entrance this would be a good place to stash loot.
translation: 地精似乎已经停止搜寻我们了，虽然有了巴拉库尔的隐藏入口，这里倒是个藏战利品的好地方。

english: Armen tried roping one of the eagles today; got dragged halfway to Al Kharid apparently. Barakur seems to have taken the hideout idea to heart and is now designing an inner door.
translation: 阿尔门今天试着用绳子套一只鹰，结果被拖到了阿尔卡里德城半路。巴拉库尔似乎认真考虑了藏身处的想法，现在正在设计一道内门。

english: A mysterious old man turned up today. Not sure how he got in. Kept pestering us until eventually Davey spoke to him, at which point he offloaded a load of spinach rolls onto us then left.
translation: 今天来了个神秘的老人。不知道他是怎么进来的。一直缠着我们，直到戴维跟他说话，他塞给我们一堆菠菜卷就走了。

english: Grief Barakur's door design is contrived; not sure I'll be able to open it myself. However, Armen still insists that we'll be able to use the eagles to get in and out.
translation: 巴拉库尔的门设计得太复杂了，我都不确定自己能不能打开。不过阿尔门还是坚持说我们可以用鹰进出。

english: First attempt at using the eagles in a raid today. Gave me the fright of my life. Armen guided the eagle over Ardougne market; managed to catch some loaves with a fishing net. We'll be eating well tonight, at least compared to recently.
translation: 今天第一次尝试在突袭中用鹰。把我吓了个半死。阿尔门引导鹰飞过阿多尼城市场，用渔网抓到了几条面包。今晚至少比最近吃得好。

english: Barakur has completed two of apparently three parts of the puzzle for his second door. I'm sure he'd be making quicker progress if Armen's kebbit didn't keep getting in the way.
translation: 巴拉库尔已经完成了第二道门谜题三部分中的两部分。要是阿尔门的凯比特兔不老是碍事，他肯定能进展更快。

english: That mysterious old man has turned up again. We don't have time for this, quite frankly, so we're just going to ignore him, after all what could he possibl...
translation: 那个神秘的老人又出现了。说实话我们没时间应付这个，所以打算直接无视他，毕竟他能把我们怎...

english: The aim of Farming is to sow seeds, help them grow into healthy plants, then harvest the crops. Although the trade can seem complicated, everything a farmer does is part of this simple process.
translation: 农业的目标是播种种子，帮助它们长成健康的植物，然后收获作物。虽然这门手艺看起来复杂，但农夫所做的一切都是这个简单过程的一部分。

english: Most seeds can be planted directly into a suitable patch of soil with the aid of a seed dibber. The soil may first need raking if it has become overgrown with weeds. When the seeds have been sown, they will grow slowly until they are fully grown. At that point the crop may be harvested with a spade.
translation: 大多数种子可以用种植锥直接种到合适的土壤里。如果土壤长满了杂草，可能需要先用耙子清理。播种后，它们会慢慢生长直到完全成熟。届时可以用铲子收获作物。

english: All the tools commonly used by farmers are sold in Farming shops throughout the land.
translation: 农夫常用的所有工具都可以在各地的农业商店买到。

english: The greatest threat to crops is disease. Where crops become diseased, they usually die unless the disease is promptly treated in an appropriate way.
translation: 作物最大的威胁是疾病。作物一旦染病，如果不及时用适当的方法治疗，通常会死亡。

english: For small crops, a vial of plant cure should restore the health of the entire patch. Larger plants such as bushes and trees may be treated by cutting off the diseased leaves with secateurs.
translation: 对于小型作物，一瓶植物治疗药水就能恢复整个种植地的健康。灌木和树木等较大的植物可以用修枝剪剪掉病叶来治疗。

english: If the soil is treated with compost before seeds are sown in it, the chance of the crops becoming diseased will be considerably lower. Supercompost has an even greater effect on the likelihood of disease. There have been rumours of ultracompost which is said to be even more efficacious.
translation: 如果在播种前用堆肥处理土壤，作物染病的几率会大大降低。超级堆肥对防病效果更好。还有传闻说终极堆肥效果更佳。

english: Certain flowers attract the pests that cause disease in vegetables and fruits. You may therefore be able to protect your crops in allotments by growing appropriate flowers in the nearby flower patches.
translation: 某些花会吸引导致蔬菜和水果生病的害虫。因此，你可以在附近的种植地种植合适的花来保护菜地里的作物。

english: Marigolds protect potatoes, onions and tomatoes. Rosemary protects cabbages. Nasturtiums protect watermelons.
translation: 金盏花保护土豆、洋葱和西红柿。迷迭香保护卷心菜。旱金莲保护西瓜。

english: A scarecrow may be placed in an empty flower patch. This will repel birds, thus protecting any sweetcorn growing in nearby allotments from disease.
translation: 可以在空的花卉种植地里放置稻草人。这样可以驱赶鸟类，从而保护附近菜地里的甜玉米免受疾病侵害。

english: The simplest method of preventing disease is to hire a gardener to look after your crops for you. Throughout the lands, you will usually have little trouble finding someone willing to help in exchange for a few sacks or baskets of food.
translation: 预防疾病最简单的方法是雇一个园丁帮你照看作物。在各地，你通常不难找到愿意用几麻袋或几篮食物换取帮助的人。

english: It is critically important that your crops be planted in the best available soil if they are to grow successfully. In general, amateur farmers are advised to do their farming within the farming patches available to the public across the lands.
translation: 要让作物成功生长，把它们种在最好的土壤里至关重要。一般来说，建议业余农夫在各地公共的种植地里进行种植。

english: Where one is required to grow crops in some other place, the ground must be treated very thoroughly before any seeds are planted. The appropriate treatment shall depend on the nature of the existing soil and the climate.
translation: 如果需要在其他地方种植作物，播种前必须对土地进行非常彻底的处理。具体处理方法取决于现有土壤的性质和气候。

english: Mix 2 buckets of dung and 8 buckets of supercompost into the soil.
translation: 将2桶粪便和8桶超级堆肥混入土壤中。

english: Mix 6 buckets of dung and 4 buckets of supercompost into the soil. Finally, stir in plenty of water with a trowel.
translation: 将6桶粪便和4桶超级堆肥混入土壤中。最后用泥铲搅拌大量水。

english: Mix 10 buckets of supercompost into the soil. Pour a vial of plant cure over the soil and provide some means of drainage.
translation: 将10桶超级堆肥混入土壤中。倒一瓶植物治疗药水在土壤上，并提供排水设施。

english: It is widely believed that camel dung surpasses all other creatures' dung in both fertility and stench. Keen farmers preparing soil for important crops should therefore aim to use camel dung wherever possible. It may be freely obtained in the desert lands south of Misthalin.
translation: 人们普遍认为骆驼粪便在肥力和臭味上都胜过其他动物的粪便。因此，为重要作物准备土壤的勤快农夫应尽量使用骆驼粪便。可以在米斯萨林以南的沙漠地带免费获取。

english: Fr Aereck blesses you.
translation: 阿雷克神父为你祝福。

english: You gain some Prayer xp.
translation: 你获得了一些祈祷经验值。

english: Well... I wasn't actually giving you a choice. Guards, take him to the cells.
translation: 嗯……其实我没给你选择。守卫，把他带进牢房。

english: Well... I wasn't actually giving you a choice. Guards, take her to the cells.
translation: 嗯……其实我没给你选择。守卫，把她带进牢房。

english: Well... I wasn't actually giving you a choice. Guards, take them to the cells.
translation: 嗯……其实我没给你选择。守卫，把他们带进牢房。

english: You search the chest, and find the helmet and armour of a Khazard guard.
translation: 你搜索了宝箱，找到了卡扎德守卫的头盔和盔甲。

english: Guards! Take her to the cells.
translation: 守卫！把她带进牢房。

english: That'll do nicely, sir.
translation: 这样就行了，先生。

english: That'll do nicely, madam.
translation: 这样就行了，女士。

english: That'll do nicely.
translation: 这样就行了。

english: Hey, who are you, and what are you doing here?!
translation: 嘿，你是谁，在这里干什么？！

english: Oh, I just found this place while exploring the seas.
translation: 哦，我只是在海上探索时发现了这个地方。

english: Hmm... We don't like outsiders here...
translation: 嗯……我们这里不欢迎外人……

english: So am I not allowed to be here?
translation: 那我不能待在这里吗？

english: Well... I can't stop you, I suppose. I don't have the authority to do so... or the ability to, I guess. But make no mistake, I'll be keeping a close eye on you.
translation: 嗯……我想我也拦不住你。我没有这个权力……也没这个能力。但别搞错了，我会一直盯着你的。

english: So, you're the one that went and found Keenan?
translation: 所以，你就是那个去找基南的人？

english: That's good of you. Not often an outsider does something to help us out here on the island. You going to stick around and offer us more help?
translation: 你人真好。很少有外人会来岛上帮我们。你打算留下来继续帮我们吗？

english: I'm definitely open to it.
translation: 我当然愿意。

english: After all these years, I thought I had maybe finally mastered this illness. This hunger.
translation: 这么多年了，我以为我终于能控制住这病，这饥饿感。

english: I was a fool. I have been a fool for so long now, and enough is finally enough. To the people of this island: know that you will be plagued no longer by my madness. The death of this boy will be the last. In my place, I leave this golem. Be careful around it, for it is unrefined and temperamental. A pyrophoroi I am not. However, in time, and with some work, I hope you will be able to use it. Let it defend you in a way I never could.
translation: 我真是个傻瓜。我当傻瓜已经太久了，到此为止吧。岛上的人们：你们将不再受我疯狂行为的困扰。这个男孩的死将是最后一个。我留下这个魔像代替我。小心对待它，因为它还不完善且脾气暴躁。我不是火术师。但假以时日，经过一些努力，我希望你们能利用它。让它以我从未能做到的方式保护你们。

english: No words will ever make up for what I have done, but know that I will spend the rest of may days trying to earn forgiveness. May Saradomin guide you all.
translation: 任何言语都无法弥补我所做的一切，但请知道，我将用余生努力寻求宽恕。愿萨拉多明指引你们所有人。

translation: 艾莱西亚女士

english: I have been translating the Haemalchemy book for some time now. While the book contains a lot of information, the thing that's most interesting are the details on vampyre immunities. According to the book, these immunities are a result of two factors, both of which we will need to overcome.
translation: 我翻译这本血炼术书籍已经有一段时间了。虽然书中包含大量信息，但最有趣的是关于吸血鬼免疫力的细节。根据书中记载，这些免疫力源于两个因素，我们都需要克服。

english: The first factor is the easiest. Any weapon not made of silver has little effect on all but the weakest vampyres. Because of this, any weapon we create will need to contain silver.
translation: 第一个因素最简单。任何非银制的武器对除了最弱的吸血鬼外几乎无效。因此，我们制作的任何武器都需要含有银。

english: The next factor is more complicated. The more powerful vampyres apparently possess the ability to predict and dodge any attack. This seems to come from a combination of their fast reaction time along with a limited mind reading ability. To overcome this, we will need to create a weapon that attacks in unpredictable ways. If the vampyres don't know what the next attack is, they won't be able to avoid it.
translation: 第二个因素更复杂。更强大的吸血鬼显然拥有预测和躲避任何攻击的能力。这似乎源于它们快速的反应能力加上有限的读心能力。要克服这一点，我们需要制造一种以不可预测方式攻击的武器。如果吸血鬼不知道下一次攻击是什么，它们就无法躲避。

english: From my research, it seems that the weapon we will need is a flail. Flails are said to be very unpredictable which should make them perfect to use against vampyres. While the flail will need silver components as well, I suspect we'll need to reinforce this to ensure the flail doesn't break.
translation: 根据我的研究，我们需要的武器是链枷。据说链枷非常难以预测，应该非常适合对付吸血鬼。虽然链枷也需要银制部件，但我怀疑我们需要加固以确保链枷不会断裂。

english: Three components will be needed in total, a shaft, a head and a chain to join them together.
translation: 总共需要三个部件：一根柄、一个头和连接它们的锁链。

english: Members of the Myreque have recently managed to recreate the Rod of Ivandis. This rod is known to be very effective against juveniles and juvinates so will probably make for a good shaft.
translation: 迈雷克成员最近成功重制了伊万迪斯之杖。这根法杖对幼年吸血鬼和青年吸血鬼非常有效，所以可能适合作为柄。

english: For the head, our own symbol, the silver sickle, seems like an obvious choice. We'll want to reinforce the sickle with an emerald enchantment to increase the effectiveness.
translation: 至于头部，我们自己的标志——银镰刀——似乎是显而易见的选择。我们需要用绿宝石附魔来强化镰刀以提高效果。

english: The chain won't need to be anything special, we'll just need to make sure it doesn't break.
translation: 锁链不需要什么特别的，我们只需要确保它不会断裂。

english: It goes without saying that all of this research is purely theoretical. The only way to be sure of this is to create the weapon and test it out.
translation: 不用说，所有这些研究纯粹是理论性的。唯一确定的方法就是制造出武器并测试它。

english: Who's Grampa Jack they say! He won this competition four years in a row! He lives in the house just outside the gate.
translation: 他们说杰克爷爷是谁！他连续四年赢得这个比赛！他住在大门外的那栋房子里。

english: I really don't see the point in stuffing this up a dirty pipe!
translation: 我真不明白把这东西塞进脏管道里有什么意义！

english: I shoved some garlic up here.
translation: 我在这里塞了些大蒜。

english: You search the box and find another two stones with markings on them: one green, one yellow.
translation: 你搜索箱子，又发现两块带有标记的石头：一块绿色，一块黄色。

english: Congratulations, you've completed a quest: Forgettable Tale...
translation: 恭喜，你完成了一个任务：被遗忘的故事…

english: The basket is empty.
translation: 篮子空空如也。

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are pollen-rich flowers.
translation: 蜜蜂在这灌木上非常活跃，还有富含花粉的花朵。

english: You carefully collect some Strange pollen.
translation: 你小心地收集了一些奇怪的花粉。

english: Bees are very active on this bush and there are unpollinated flowers.
translation: 蜜蜂在这灌木上非常活跃，还有未授粉的花朵。

english: You carefully apply it with the help of some nearby bees then extract some from the bush.
translation: 你借助附近蜜蜂的帮助小心地涂抹花粉，然后从灌木中提取了一些。

english: The bush is already fruiting and won't benefit from any more pollen.
translation: 灌木已经结果了，再多的花粉也无济于事。

english: A folder full of pages of facts and figures. You have found all the pages for which Rat was looking. You need to deliver the folder to him now.
translation: 一个装满事实和数据书页的文件夹。你找到了老鼠在寻找的所有书页。现在你需要把文件夹交给他。

english: You get a lederhosen shorts for your help, many thanks!
translation: 你得到一条皮裤短裤作为帮助的回报，非常感谢！

english: Information and things I found on Fossil Island.
translation: 我在化石岛上发现的信息和东西。

english: I helped put together some of the researcher's camp today. They aren't very competent at construction it seems. Plus I had to make it possible to use the barge to bring all the supplies over. What would they do without me?
translation: 我今天帮忙搭建了研究者的营地。他们似乎不太擅长建筑。而且我还得想办法让驳船能把所有补给品运过来。没有我他们该怎么办？

english: I seem to have found some really old fossilised stuff. I'm not sure what it is yet, but it sure got the museum staff excited. They said I should clean it like I did the ones in the museum.
translation: 我似乎找到了一些非常古老的化石物品。我还不确定那是什么，但肯定让博物馆的工作人员兴奋不已。他们说我应该像清理博物馆里的那些一样清理它。

english: It wasn't too difficult, though I did scuff a few bits. I'm sure the museum folk won't notice though.
translation: 这并不太难，虽然我确实弄花了一些地方。不过我相信博物馆的人不会注意到的。

english: Couldn't stand the stuffy old professors today so I went into the mushroom forest and trapped some birds. Good fun, especially when the trap springs. It is a bit messy to clean up though.
translation: 今天实在受不了那些闷死人的老教授，我就溜进蘑菇林里抓了几只鸟。挺好玩的，尤其是陷阱弹起来那一下。不过清理起来有点麻烦。

english: Wow! Today I found some really weird mushrooms. It must have been some kind of transportation system in the ancient past, but it's still working! This will make it much easier to get around the island now.
translation: 哇！今天发现了一些超奇怪的蘑菇。这肯定是古代某种传送系统，居然还能用！这下在岛上走动就方便多了。

english: Today I discovered a way to row around the island. It was hard work, but rewarding as I now have some way to get around quicker.
translation: 今天我发现了划船环岛的方法。虽然辛苦，但很值得，现在总算有办法更快地四处走动了。

english: Who knew that fossilisation was reversible? Apparently with this slime pool I found, and some chemicals, I have managed to turn fossils back into bone! I wonder if I can find something useful to do with them. Burying them doesn't seem to do much, like other bones.
translation: 谁知道化石居然还能逆转？看来用我找到的这个黏液池，再加点化学物质，就能把化石变回骨头！不知道能不能找到什么有用的用途。埋掉它们似乎没什么用，不像其他骨头那样。

english: I have no clue what it was originally used for, but there's a weird machine in the ruins here on the island that I found and it definitely likes those re-calcified fossils from the slime pool.
translation: 我不知道这东西原本是干什么用的，但我在岛上的废墟里发现了一台奇怪的机器，它显然很喜欢那些从黏液池里重新钙化的化石。

english: Went diving today. There's so much under there it's going to take me a while to discover everything. I did see somewhere that looks like a good place to grow seaweed though.
translation: 今天去潜水了。下面东西太多了，要全部探索完得花不少时间。不过我确实看到了一个看起来很适合种海藻的地方。

english: There are massive clams and sunken treasure chests down here just waiting to be plundered. The problem is, there's a really strange mermaid who goes on about her sister and I have to collect tears. Tears! Underwater! Whatever next?
translation: 下面有巨大的蛤蜊和沉没的宝箱等着我去打捞。问题是，有个很奇怪的美人鱼一直念叨她姐姐，我还得收集眼泪。眼泪！在水下！接下来还会有什么？

english: Found that the volcanic ash on this island makes REALLY great compost. This should boost my crops no end!
translation: 发现这个岛上的火山灰能做成超棒的堆肥。这下我的庄稼肯定能长得更好！

english: The following are some notes I found from one of the ancient structures on the island. It looks to have been inhabited by a creature far larger than a human, but I have no idea what it was.
translation: 以下是我在岛上某个古建筑里找到的笔记。看起来那里曾经住着一种比人类大得多的生物，但我不知道那是什么。

english: The whole is greater than the sum of its parts. Similar to that observed in the birthing pool, the spore on this island have the potential to inhabit the host, creating a symbiotic relationship between fungus and creature.
translation: 整体大于部分之和。类似于在出生池中观察到的现象，这个岛上的孢子有可能寄居在宿主体内，在蘑菇和生物之间形成共生关系。

english: I have witnessed this first hand. The young are deliberately left beneath colonies of the spore until they pass out, choking. A violent affair, but one I have grown to understand is necessary. Perhaps my own concerns of the treatment of subject 1 were invalid. Pain has its place in the needs for advancement.
translation: 我亲眼目睹了这一切。幼崽被故意留在孢子群落下面，直到它们窒息昏过去。虽然很暴力，但我逐渐明白这是必要的。也许我之前对实验体1的待遇的担忧是不对的。痛苦在进步的需求中有其位置。

english: Despite several attempts, I have failed to find a way to encourage the spore to inhabit my own body. Ingestion, airborne saturation, each leads to involuntary, forceful expulsion and hallucinogenic stupor. Permanent damage will likely follow if I continue to experiment.
translation: 尽管尝试了多次，我还是没能找到让孢子寄居在我自己体内的办法。无论是口服还是空气吸入，都会导致不由自主的剧烈排斥和幻觉性昏迷。如果继续实验，很可能会造成永久性伤害。

english: A miraculous discovery today - a pool, capable of rapid calcification. One of the young stumbled into it, looking for refreshment. The look of terror in its eyes chilled me to the bone as its soft tissue grew rigid - it reached down to free its feet and it drowned in its own, solidified saliva. Its body serves as a powerful marker of the dangers of this island. We have witnessed such things before, but never at this rate.
translation: 今天有个惊人的发现——一个能快速钙化的水池。有个幼崽为了找水喝不小心掉了进去。当它的软组织变硬时，它眼中的恐惧让我不寒而栗——它伸手想挣脱双脚，却被自己凝固的唾液淹死了。它的尸体是这座岛屿危险的有力警示。我们以前也见过类似的事，但从没这么快。

english: I discovered more eggs today, deep beneath the surface. Smaller than the first, but white hot, the colour not diminishing when cooled. What am I to do? Release more for research, or hide them so they may avoid the fate of the first? I am torn. He must not know. His arrogance cannot save us.
translation: 今天在地表深处发现了更多的蛋。比第一批小，但白得发烫，冷却后颜色也不褪。我该怎么办？放出来做研究，还是藏起来让它们避免第一批的命运？我很纠结。他绝不能知道。他的傲慢救不了我们。

english: I believe my presence here is causing unrest in the creatures. Whilst at first they kept distance, they are beginning to display violently towards me, no doubt linked to the growing conflicts between their tribes. Perhaps I am a trophy to prove dominance? Nevertheless, they are not yet evolved to penetrate my skin.
translation: 我觉得我在这里的存在引起了生物们的不安。起初它们保持距离，现在开始对我表现出暴力倾向，这无疑与它们部落间日益激烈的冲突有关。也许我是它们证明统治地位的战利品？不过，它们还没进化到能穿透我的皮肤。

english: Is this chemical warfare? Observations recorded today included a bizarre sight - a spore clump used as a weapon of sorts which blinded and paralysed. I must be careful.
translation: 这是化学战吗？今天观察到一个奇怪的现象——一团孢子被当作武器使用，能致盲和麻痹。我必须小心。

english: The battlefront was unrelenting. At one point, I wasn't sure I'd be seeing another day... that any of us would be. Some leader I'd be if I'd let us all fall, but the winding paths here don't make for much of a strategic position.
translation: 战场前线毫不留情。有一刻，我都不确定自己还能不能见到第二天……我们任何人能不能。如果让大家都倒下，我还算什么领袖，但这里蜿蜒的小路实在不是什么有利的战略位置。

english: The day has been long, but I don't expect they'll be getting any shorter... We must take the time now to rest while we can. While the battle may be over for now, that is provided we're fortunate enough that they stay back, we will soon need to move forwards once more. We need to establish a proper foothold for our work to be successful. We can't just keep fighting forever.
translation: 今天很漫长，但我不觉得日子会变短……我们必须趁现在好好休息。虽然战斗暂时结束了，前提是我们够幸运它们不会反扑，但我们很快又要继续前进。我们需要建立一个稳固的立足点才能让工作成功。我们不能永远打下去。

english: As I reflect now, I realise I must thank Saradomin... If it hadn't been for Sarl and that trusty mace of his today, I doubt I'd be writing these words.
translation: 现在回想起来，我意识到必须感谢萨拉多明……如果不是今天萨尔和他那把可靠的钉锤，我怀疑自己还能不能写下这些字。

english: This word-guessing game was invented by Mad King Narras of Ardougne in order to encourage literacy among his subjects. Today it is played with an effigy rather than a real person, and it makes an amusing distraction for one or more players.
translation: 这个猜词游戏是由阿多尼城的疯王纳拉斯发明的，目的是鼓励臣民识字。如今玩的时候用的是雕像而不是真人，对单个或多个玩家来说都是个有趣的消遣。

english: When the game is started, the hangman game chooses a word at random. Players take turns to guess one letter at a time. If they guess correctly, that letter is revealed, but if they are incorrect then the scaffold and effigy are built one step at a time until the effigy is hanged. Players can also guess multiple letters if they think they know the word, but if they guess incorrectly no letters will be revealed. The player to complete the word wins.
translation: 游戏开始时，猜词游戏会随机选一个词。玩家轮流每次猜一个字母。猜对了就显示那个字母，猜错了就逐步搭建脚手架和雕像，直到雕像被吊起。如果玩家觉得自己知道答案，也可以一次猜多个字母，但猜错的话不会显示任何字母。猜出完整单词的玩家获胜。

english: The Treasure Fairies delight in hiding in human dwellings and watching in glee as people try to find them. While once this caused havoc throughout Misthalin, since then the fairies have turned this activity into a fun party game.
translation: 宝藏仙子喜欢躲在人类住所里，开心地看着人们找它们。虽然这曾经在米斯林造成过混乱，但后来仙子们把这变成了一个有趣的派对游戏。

english: When summoned from her mushroom house, the fairy will hide somewhere in the house or its grounds. Each player is given a magic stone that will tell them how close they are to the fairy. The first player to use the stone while standing at the right place wins.
translation: 仙子从她的蘑菇屋被召唤出来后，会藏在房子或院子里的某个地方。每个玩家都会得到一块魔法石，可以告诉他们离仙子有多近。第一个站在正确位置使用石头的玩家获胜。

english: The jester is a cousin of the mime, but rather than summoning people from their activities to pass its test, the jester is happy to be summoned whenever a game is desired. It will perform gestures which the players must try to copy. The first player to get ten correct wins!
translation: 小丑是哑剧演员的表亲，但不同于哑剧演员把人从活动中召唤来测试，小丑很乐意在有人想玩游戏时被召唤。它会做出动作，玩家必须模仿。第一个做对十个动作的玩家获胜！

english: The Elemental Balance is a battle of wits and wizardry. When the sphere is summoned it is unbalanced on the two elemental axes, earth-air and fire-water. The direction in which it is most unbalanced can be seen by its colour. To balance the sphere, players must attack it with spells of the opposite element. (So if it is red, for example, players must use water spells.) The winner is the player who casts the spell that puts it in perfect balance.
translation: 元素平衡器是智慧和巫术的较量。当球体被召唤时，它在两个元素轴——土-气和火-水——上是不平衡的。不平衡最明显的方向可以通过颜色看出。要平衡球体，玩家必须用相反元素的法术攻击它。（比如球是红色的，玩家就要用水系法术。）最后一个施法使球体完全平衡的玩家获胜。

english: This ancient game was once used as a means of resolving leadership disputes.
translation: 这个古老的游戏曾经被用来解决领导权争端。

english: The Attack Stone is simply a pillar of clay, limestone or marble, carefully constructed to respond differently to stabbing, slashing and crushing. If it takes enough damage in any of these three forms it shatters, and the player who struck that blow wins.
translation: 训练石柱就是一根粘土、石灰石或大理石柱子，精心建造以对刺击、砍击和钝击做出不同反应。如果它在三种攻击中任何一种受到足够伤害就会碎裂，打出最后一击的玩家获胜。

english: The stick-and-hoop, dartboard and archery game are all played using the same rules. Players take turns to throw or shoot at the target in order to score points. The range of points that can be awarded depends on the target: with the hoop there is only hitting and missing, with the dartboard the maximum is 3 and with the archery target it is 10. After all players have had ten shots, the highest scoring player wins.
translation: 棍子套环、飞镖靶和射箭游戏都使用相同的规则。玩家轮流投掷或射击目标来得分。得分范围取决于目标：套环只有命中或未命中，飞镖靶最高3分，射箭靶最高10分。所有玩家各射十次后，得分最高的玩家获胜。

english: The various combat rings have different restrictions on the weapons that can be used in them. No equipment can be worn in the boxing ring except for boxing gloves (although boxers may fight bare-fisted if they wish). Any weapons can be used in the fencing ring, but no armour of any kind can be worn. There are no restrictions in the combat ring. There are similarly no restrictions for the ranging pedestals, but since the combatants are separated only ranged weapons will be effective! The balance beam allows only one weapon, the pugel stick, and fighting on the beam is a test of agility as well as combat!
translation: 各种战斗台对可使用的武器有不同的限制。拳击台除了拳击手套外不能穿戴任何装备（不过拳击手如果想的话也可以赤手空拳）。击剑台可以使用任何武器，但不能穿任何盔甲。战斗台没有限制。射手靶座同样没有限制，但由于战斗者被隔开，只有远程武器有效！平衡木只允许一种武器，搏击棒，而且在平衡木上战斗既考验敏捷也考验战斗技巧！

english: The combat rings are enchanted so that players cannot kill one another; the loser is simply ejected from the ring and healed.
translation: 战斗台被施了魔法，玩家无法杀死对方；输家只会被弹出战斗台并得到治疗。

english: If the games room has a prize chest, and the house owner has put money in it, then the winner of any of these games will be given a key to the chest so that they can claim their prize!
translation: 如果游戏室有奖品箱，而且房主在里面放了钱，那么任何游戏的赢家都会得到一把宝箱钥匙，可以领取奖品！

english: Information was correct at the time of writing, but will go out of date.
translation: 信息在撰写时是正确的，但会过时。

english: 1/7: Two goblins are fighting over the colour of their armour. What do you do? [A] Kill them both and steal their bronze spears. [B] Leave them to it. Armour's not going to help - any noob could take them. [C] Show them a range of colours so that they can come to a compromise.
translation: 1/7：两个哥布林在争论他们盔甲的颜色。你怎么办？[A] 把他们俩都杀了，偷走他们的青铜长矛。[B] 随他们去。盔甲帮不了他们——随便一个菜鸟都能干掉他们。[C] 给他们展示一系列颜色，让他们达成妥协。

english: 1/7: Two goblins are fighting over the colour of their armour. What do you do?
translation: 1/7：两个哥布林在争论他们盔甲的颜色。你怎么办？

english: [A] Kill them both and steal their bronze spears.
translation: [A] 把他们俩都杀了，偷走他们的青铜长矛。

english: [B] Leave them to it. Armour's not going to help - any noob could take them.
translation: [B] 随他们去。盔甲帮不了他们——随便一个菜鸟都能干掉他们。

english: 2/7: A Drunken dwarf offers you a kebab. What do you do? [A] Take his generous gift even though you have no need for it. [B] Run away leaving the lonely dwarf on his own. [C] Stand there until he gets annoyed and attacks you.
translation: 2/7：一个醉酒的矮人递给你一个烤肉。你怎么办？[A] 接受他的慷慨礼物，即使你并不需要。[B] 跑开，留下那个孤独的矮人一个人。[C] 站在那里直到他恼羞成怒攻击你。
