translation: 2/7：一个醉酒的矮人递给你一个烤肉。你怎么办？

english: [A] Take his generous gift even though you have no need for it.
translation: [A] 接受他的慷慨礼物，即使你并不需要。

english: [B] Run away leaving the lonely dwarf on his own.
translation: [B] 跑开，留下那个孤独的矮人一个人。

english: 3/7: Are you enjoying your experience of Farming? [A] Definitely. [B] Yes. [C] It's absolutely, unquestionably the most interesting thing I've ever done!
translation: 3/7：你享受农业体验吗？[A] 当然。[B] 是的。[C] 这绝对、毫无疑问是我做过最有趣的事！

english: 3/7: Are you enjoying your experience of Farming?
translation: 3/7：你享受农业体验吗？

english: 4/7: A dwarf asks you to put on a silly golden helmet so that you can be fired from a cannon into a wall. What do you do? [A] Refuse this crazy request blankly. [B] Put on the silly helmet and jump into the cannon. [C] Put the helmet on the dwarf and fire him into the wall.
translation: 4/7：一个矮人让你戴上傻乎乎的金色头盔，这样你就能被大炮射进墙里。你会怎么做？[A] 面无表情地拒绝这个疯狂的要求。[B] 戴上傻头盔跳进大炮。[C] 把头盔戴在矮人头上，把他射进墙里。

english: 4/7: A dwarf asks you to put on a silly golden helmet so that you can be fired from a cannon into a wall. What do you do?
translation: 4/7：一个矮人让你戴上傻乎乎的金色头盔，这样你就能被大炮射进墙里。你会怎么做？

english: [A] Refuse this crazy request blankly.
translation: [A] 面无表情地拒绝这个疯狂的要求。

english: [B] Put on the silly helmet and jump into the cannon.
translation: [B] 戴上傻头盔跳进大炮。

english: [A] Cower in fear and quickly cast teleport to Varrock.
translation: [A] 吓得缩成一团，赶紧传送到维洛克城。

english: 6/7: Queen Ellamaria orders you to go on a foolish quest without any offer of reward. What do you say? [A] I'll do whatever you ask - I just love the monarchy! [B] Ask me nicely and I might consider it. [C] Stop ordering me about and get behind the bar where you belong!
translation: 6/7：埃拉玛利亚女王命令你去执行一个愚蠢的任务，却没有任何奖励。你会说什么？[A] 你让我做什么都行——我就是热爱君主制！[B] 好好求我，我可能会考虑。[C] 别对我发号施令，滚回你该待的酒吧后面去！

english: 6/7: Queen Ellamaria orders you to go on a foolish quest without any offer of reward. What do you say?
translation: 6/7：埃拉玛利亚女王命令你去执行一个愚蠢的任务，却没有任何奖励。你会说什么？

english: [A] I'll do whatever you ask - I just love the monarchy!
translation: [A] 你让我做什么都行——我就是热爱君主制！

english: [B] Ask me nicely and I might consider it.
translation: [B] 好好求我，我可能会考虑。

english: 7/7: A Draynor bank guard asks you if you've seen any suspicious characters lately, because the bank has been robbed. What do you say? [A] No, especially not that wise old man, who doesn't look at all suspicious. [B] If I do I'll let you know. [C] Yes, that wise old man over there looks incredibly dodgy.
translation: 7/7：德拉诺银行守卫问你最近有没有看到可疑人物，因为银行被抢了。你会说什么？[A] 没有，尤其是那个老智者，他看起来一点也不可疑。[B] 如果看到我会告诉你。[C] 有，那边那个老智者看起来非常可疑。

english: 7/7: A Draynor bank guard asks you if you've seen any suspicious characters lately, because the bank has been robbed. What do you say?
translation: 7/7：德拉诺银行守卫问你最近有没有看到可疑人物，因为银行被抢了。你会说什么？

english: [A] No, especially not that wise old man, who doesn't look at all suspicious.
translation: [A] 没有，尤其是那个老智者，他看起来一点也不可疑。

english: [B] If I do I'll let you know.
translation: [B] 如果看到我会告诉你。

english: The rune essence is too big to grind. You might want to break it up into shards first.
translation: 符文精华太大了，没法研磨。你可能需要先把它敲成碎片。

english: The pure essence is too big to grind. You might want to break it up into shards first.
translation: 纯净精华太大了，没法研磨。你可能需要先把它敲成碎片。

english: You break up the rune essence into shards.
translation: 你把符文精华敲成了碎片。

english: You break up the pure essence into shards.
translation: 你把纯净精华敲成了碎片。

english: You break up the rune shards into dust.
translation: 你把符文碎片敲成了灰尘。

english: You break up the pure essence shards into dust.
translation: 你把纯净精华碎片敲成了灰尘。

english: Yes, very good peasant, you've got the seed; but it's a yellow rosebush that one wishes, not seeds. Plant it in the yellow rosebush patch, and let it grow.
translation: 是的，很好，农民，你拿到了种子；但想要的是黄色玫瑰丛，不是种子。把它种在黄色玫瑰丛地里，让它生长吧。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build gale catchers on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读了示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造狂风收集器。你记住了示意图的所有内容，然后把它丢弃了。

english: Sorry, I'm trying to talk to someone else, but he seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 抱歉，我在试着和别人说话，但他似乎不理我。

english: Sorry, I'm trying to talk to someone else, but she seems to be ignoring me.
translation: 抱歉，我在试着和别人说话，但她似乎不理我。

english: Hello, Mistress [player name]?
translation: 你好，[player name]小姐？

english: Congratulations, you've completed a quest: Getting Ahead
translation: 恭喜，你完成了一个任务：领先一步

english: Sapphires: <Num0> / Emeralds: <Num1> / Rubies: <Num2>
translation: 蓝宝石：<Num0> / 绿宝石：<Num1> / 红宝石：<Num2>

english: Diamonds: <Num0> / Dragonstones: <Num1>
translation: 钻石：<Num0> / 龙石：<Num1>

english: You just found a/an Sapphire!
translation: 你刚找到了一颗蓝宝石！

english: You just found a/an Ruby!
translation: 你刚找到了一颗红宝石！

english: You just found a/an Emerald!
translation: 你刚找到了一颗绿宝石！

english: You just found a/an Diamond!
translation: 你刚找到了一颗钻石！

english: You just found a/an Dragonstone!
translation: 你刚找到了一颗龙石！

english: Ah, what'm'ah gonna do with these damn goats...
translation: 唉，我该拿这些该死的山羊怎么办...

english: Hrm... ye are an outsider... but ye do have a look about ye. Tell me, d'y'ave experience herdin' goats?
translation: 嗯...你是个外人...但你看起来有点样子。告诉我，你有放羊的经验吗？

english: Ah, a damn shame. If ye get some experience under yer belt, come back, but these goats aren't for the weak handed.
translation: 唉，真是可惜。等你有了些经验再来吧，这些山羊可不是给手无缚鸡之力的人准备的。

english: You need to have completed the Sheep Herder quest to hunt goats.
translation: 你需要完成牧羊人任务才能猎杀山羊。

english: I have experience herding sheep, if that counts for anything?
translation: 我有放羊的经验，这算不算数？

english: Aye? Well, I s'pose I should take what I can get. Feel like helpin' out with the goat problem?
translation: 是吗？好吧，我想我应该知足了。愿意帮忙解决山羊的问题吗？

english: How can goats be a problem?
translation: 山羊怎么会是问题呢？

english: When there's too bleedin' many of 'em!
translation: 当它们多得要命的时候！

english: As yer can see, on this hill, there's a... large goat herd. We think the wyrms used to eat 'em and keep the numbers down, but since we moved in, we think they've just kept spawnin' and... well, you can see what happens.
translation: 如你所见，在这座小山上，有一大群山羊。我们觉得以前蛇龙会吃它们来控制数量，但自从我们搬来后，它们就一直在繁殖，然后……你也看到结果了。

english: Best plan o' action we came up with is the goat pit. It ain't pretty, but the goats are dumb enough for it t'work.
translation: 我们想出的最好办法就是山羊坑。虽然不太好看，但山羊够蠢，这招管用。

english: So how does goat herding come into this?
translation: 那牧羊和这有什么关系？

english: You herd the goats into the pit and they're dumb enough t' jump right in.
translation: 你把山羊赶进坑里，它们蠢到会自己跳进去。

english: There's a pile o' spikes right 'ere. You'll wanna grab yerself a set of them and line the pit with 'em first.
translation: 这儿有一堆尖刺。你先拿一套，把坑底铺满尖刺。

english: The other pile 'ere is a bunch o' cattleprods. You can use one of them, or if ye fancy yerself one of them mages, me pal Jeff reckons ye might be able to pull 'em around wit' a spell or two.
translation: 这边另一堆是赶牛棒。你可以用一根，或者如果你觉得自己是个法师，我朋友杰夫说你可能能用一两道法术把它们拉过来。

english: Telly knee rectric grab? Dark le hure? I don't remember. If those names mean anything to ye, don't tell me. I'm better off not knowing.
translation: 传送膝盖牵引抓？黑暗勒胡尔？我不记得了。如果这些名字对你有意义，别告诉我。我不知道反而更好。

english: So I just prod the goats into the pit?
translation: 所以我只要把山羊赶进坑里就行？

english: Aye, but the pit can only hold so many goats at a time. I reckon ye could fit more in if ye get better at animal handlin', but ye'd need to inspect the pit to tell, I reckon.
translation: 没错，但坑一次只能装这么多山羊。我觉得如果你动物处理技术更好，能装更多，但你需要检查一下坑才能确定，我想。

english: Once ye've got goats in t'pit, ye'll need t'sort out the carcasses. Feel free t'keep any horns or fur ye can salvage. Just remember t'line the pit with spikes again once yer done.
translation: 一旦山羊进了坑，你就得处理尸体。你可以随意保留任何能回收的角或毛皮。记得处理完后重新在坑里铺上尖刺。

english: So, line the pit with spikes, herd the goats into the pit, sort the carcasses and repeat. Got it, thank you!
translation: 所以，铺尖刺，赶山羊进坑，处理尸体，然后重复。明白了，谢谢！

english: Aye, ye could reduce me speech into a single line, ye bloody outsider...
translation: 好吧，你把我一番话总结成一句话，你这个该死的外乡人……

english: Have ye been pittin me goats without permission?!
translation: 你是不是未经允许就在坑杀我的山羊？！

english: Sorry, I didn't realise that I-
translation: 抱歉，我没意识到我-

english: Ha! I'm just pullin' yer leg, outsider. Ye've got nothin' t'worry 'bout!
translation: 哈！我只是逗你玩呢，外乡人。你不用担心！

english: Glad t'see ye've figured out how t'use the pit, at least. If ye need help with anythin' else, we can talk later, else I'll leave ye to it.
translation: 至少很高兴看到你学会了怎么用这个坑。如果还需要帮忙，我们待会再聊，不然我就不打扰你了。

english: Ye wanna grab a set of spikes from this pile o'er 'ere and line the pit wit' 'em.
translation: 你想从这堆里拿一套尖刺，然后铺在坑里。

english: Then take a prod and shove the goats in t'pit. Me pal reckons you could use a 'telly knee rectric grab' or a 'dark le hure' to do it, but I don't go fer that magic nonsense.
translation: 然后拿一根赶牛棒把山羊赶进坑里。我朋友说你可以用'传送膝盖牵引抓'或'黑暗勒胡尔'来做，但我不搞那些魔法玩意儿。

english: Ye can probably fit more goats in t'pit if ye get better at herdin' animals, but eventually it'll get full regardless.
translation: 如果你动物处理技术更好，坑里大概能装更多山羊，但最终还是会满的。

english: Once it is, ye'll need to sort the carcasses. Ye can keep any furs or horns ye salvage as ye clear 'em out. Then ye can just re-line the pit and keep at it.
translation: 满了之后，你就得处理尸体。清理的时候可以保留任何回收的毛皮或角。然后重新铺上尖刺继续就行。

english: Apple trees produce a sweet, round edible fruit that is cultivated worldwide. A tasty and nutritious fruit often used as an ingredient to make the classic apple pie. Apples can also be fermented to make cider. All parts of the apple can be eaten, however eating large amounts of the seeds can cause stomach problems. Apples are very nutritious and as the old adage goes, an apple a day keeps the doctor away.
translation: 苹果树结出甜美、圆形的可食用果实，在世界各地都有种植。这是一种美味又营养的水果，常被用作制作经典苹果派的食材。苹果也可以发酵制成苹果酒。苹果的所有部分都可以食用，但大量食用种子可能会导致胃部不适。苹果非常有营养，正如那句老话所说，一天一苹果，医生远离我。

english: What is normally considered the banana tree by most is in fact not technically a tree at all. It is actually the largest cultivated flowering plant. What appears to be a trunk is actually a false stem with the stalks of its large leaves forming a tightly packed sheath. When a banana plant is mature, one large cluster of flowers forms known as the banana heart. The banana fruits develop from the banana heart and this cluster is known as a bunch. The long curved yellow fruit produced is also botanically classified as a berry and can be found in tropical locations such as Karamja. As well as the fruit, other parts of the plant also have uses, with the flexible leaves sometimes used for waterproof roof material.
translation: 大多数人通常认为是香蕉树的植物，严格来说其实根本不是树。它实际上是最大的栽培开花植物。看起来像树干的东西其实是假茎，由大叶子的叶柄紧密包裹形成。当香蕉植株成熟时，会形成一大簇花，称为香蕉心。香蕉果实从香蕉心中发育出来，这一簇被称为一串。这种长而弯曲的黄色果实，在植物学上也被归类为浆果，可以在卡拉姆詹岛等热带地区找到。除了果实，植物的其他部分也有用途，柔韧的叶子有时被用作防水的屋顶材料。

english: A flowering woody vine that produces berries in large clusters. Due to its climbing nature, grape vines must be grown on special structures called trellises in a vinery. Although a tasty treat fresh from the vine, once crushed and fermented, they make equally delicious wine. In one year, a successful winemaker can produce around 15,000 glasses of wine per acre of land. Gielinor's oldest and most famous vinery is the Hosidius Vinery, owned by the Hosidius family.
translation: 一种开花的木质藤本植物，结出大串的浆果。由于攀援的特性，葡萄藤必须种植在葡萄园中称为棚架的特殊结构上。虽然刚从藤上摘下时是美味的小吃，但压碎并发酵后，它们同样能酿出美味的葡萄酒。一年之内，一位成功的酿酒师每英亩土地可以生产约一万五千杯葡萄酒。吉莱诺最古老、最著名的葡萄园是霍西迪乌斯葡萄园，归霍西迪乌斯家族所有。

english: Brought to Gielinor by gnomes, this tree produces small round fruit. Oranges consist of a waxy tough outer skin known as a rind, a layer of interlaced bitter white web of tissue known as a pith and finally the juicy segments and a few seeds. Oranges are commonly peeled, removing the rind and pith and eaten fresh or squeezed for juice. The thick bitter rind can also be used in certain recipes as a food flavouring or garnish. To answer the age-old question, the fruit was named first, with the earliest recorded mention coming from the first gnome settlers. Although hard to believe, there probably wasn't a specific name for the colour until the fruit was widely available. Before then, linguists believe that people generally referred to the colour orange as yellow-red.
translation: 这种树由地精带到吉莱诺，结出小而圆的果实。橙子由蜡质坚硬的外皮（称为果皮）、一层交织的苦味白色网状组织（称为白瓤）以及最后多汁的果肉和少量种子组成。橙子通常去皮，去除果皮和白瓤后新鲜食用或榨汁。厚而苦的果皮也可以在某些食谱中用作调味料或装饰。回答这个古老的问题，果实先被命名，最早的记录来自第一批地精定居者。虽然难以置信，但在果实广泛可得之前，可能没有专门的颜色名称。在那之前，语言学家认为人们通常把橙色称为黄红色。

english: A tropical tree with distinct, yellow-green leaves which can be picked and used as a seasoning. Curry leaves can be added to a traditional stew to make the fragrant spiced dish of the same name. Rumour has it that curry is considered a delicacy among the demon nobility and is consumed in large amounts especially during celebrations.
translation: 一种热带树，有独特的黄绿色叶子，可以采摘用作调味料。咖喱叶可以加入传统炖菜中，制成同名的芳香香料菜肴。有传言说，咖喱被认为是恶魔贵族中的美味佳肴，尤其是在庆祝活动中会大量食用。

english: A tropical plant native to the island of Karamja. The pineapple itself is what's known botanically as a multiple fruit. A multiple fruit is where a plant produces a large number of flowers with the individual berries joining together to create one large fruit. Although a tasty exotic treat, eating or handling too much raw pineapple can be risky. This is because raw pineapple has a similar effect to acid, causing skin discomfort.
translation: 一种原产于卡拉姆詹岛的热带植物。菠萝本身在植物学上被称为复果。复果是指植物产生大量花朵，各个浆果结合在一起形成一个大的果实。虽然是一种美味的热带美食，但食用或处理太多生菠萝可能有风险。这是因为生菠萝有类似酸的效果，会引起皮肤不适。

english: A tropical tree that produces sweet-scented flowers that only open at night. Papaya trees are moth-pollinated. The papaya fruit produced from these flowers are large berries. The ripe fruit of the papaya is usually eaten raw, without skin and the seeds removed. The smell of papaya flesh is often described as unpleasant and vomit like. Although interestingly, the smell only affects certain people.
translation: 一种热带树，开出只在夜间开放的芳香花朵。木瓜树靠飞蛾授粉。这些花结出的木瓜果实是大浆果。成熟的木瓜果实通常生吃，去皮去籽。木瓜果肉的气味常被描述为令人不快，像呕吐物。但有趣的是，这种气味只影响某些人。

english: Grown from a palm tree, the coconut is a stone fruit and therefore, not a true nut. The green outer fleshy part or husk surrounds the single shelled nut. Inside the nut is a layer of white flesh. Distinct from other fruits, the center contains a large quantity of clear liquid called coconut water. As the coconut matures, the inner palm seed grows and uses the coconut water as nutrition. A hammer can be used on a coconut and the mashed flesh and water combine to make coconut milk. Coconut milk is vital in making strong antidotes and weapon poison. Because they carry their own water, coconuts can last for nearly a year and still able to grow.
translation: 椰子长在棕榈树上，是一种核果，因此并非真正的坚果。绿色的外层肉质部分或外壳包裹着单壳的坚果。坚果内部是一层白色果肉。与其他水果不同，中心含有大量清澈的液体，称为椰子水。随着椰子成熟，内部的棕榈种子生长并利用椰子水作为营养。可以用锤子敲开椰子，捣碎的果肉和水混合制成椰奶。椰奶对于制作强力解毒剂和武器毒素至关重要。由于自带水分，椰子可以保存近一年仍能生长。

english: A tropical palm like tree native only to the island of Karamja. Calquat is the largest fruit in the world. As it matures, the outer skin begins to thicken and grow ridged. Although a completely inedible fruit due to its tough woody skin and hollow interior, it is cultivated instead as a way of storing liquid. Calquat kegs are popular in brewing where they are used to store complete batches of ale.
translation: 一种仅原产于卡拉姆詹岛的热带棕榈状树。卡夸特是世界上最大的果实。随着成熟，外皮开始变厚并长出棱纹。虽然由于其坚硬的木质外皮和中空内部而完全不可食用，但它被种植用来储存液体。卡夸特酒桶在酿造中很受欢迎，用于储存整批麦酒。

english: While often called a tree, the dragonfruit plant is actually a fruit-bearing species of cacti. The fruit produced has a very unique appearance and is delicious and sweet both raw and when baked into a delicious pie. The fruit also contains a multitude of small crunchy seeds which have a pleasant nutty taste. Dragonfruit seem to have some magical properties as when heated, they produce a unique fluid with similar properties to dragonfire. This odd feature of the fruit is likely where the name comes from.
translation: 虽然常被称为树，但火龙果植物实际上是一种结实的仙人掌科植物。结出的果实外观非常独特，生吃或烤成美味的派都香甜可口。果实还含有大量小而脆的种子，带有宜人的坚果味。火龙果似乎具有一些魔法特性，因为加热时，它们会产生一种独特的液体，性质与龙火相似。这种果实奇特的特征可能就是其名字的由来。

english: Oaks are native to the middle kingdoms of Gielinor whose temperate climate prove perfect for this particularly useful species. Everyone from the lowliest peasant to the highest king has some oddment or another made from oak. It is used in the manufacture of ships, furniture, floorings and more. One notable use is in the making of barrels for storing of wine and liquors with the oak adding a particularly unique taste to any vintage. The leaves and acorns of the oak tree are poisonous to most livestock due to naturally occurring toxins. An interesting exception is the domestic pig, which in lean times can be fed entirely on acorns.
translation: 橡树原产于吉莱诺中部诸国，其温带气候非常适合这种特别有用的树种。从最卑微的农民到最尊贵的国王，每个人都有某种用橡木制成的物品。它用于制造船只、家具、地板等。一个显著的用途是制作储存葡萄酒和烈酒的木桶，橡木为任何陈年佳酿增添了独特的风味。橡树的叶子和橡子由于天然存在的毒素，对大多数牲畜有毒。一个有趣的例外是家猪，在歉收时期可以完全用橡子喂养。

english: Found across the temperate zones of Gielinor, willow trees can be found near almost any body of water. The willow has a myriad of uses such as baskets, furniture and toys. The willow is also particularly useful in medicine as when chewed, the bark of the tree can treat a myriad of illnesses such as fever and inflammation. An enchanting story revolving around willows, is the tale of the willows which can be found in Great Kourend. Although found across the kingdom, they are in fact not native. A well-known legend amongst the people of Hosidius is the story of Alexander the Poet. Alexanders beautiful writings of all things botanical won the favour of the then Duchess of Lumbridge. She was so smitten by his writings that she requested them sent immediately across the sea as soon as the ink had dried upon the parchment. In return for his writing, Alexander was granted a request and asked for what seemed to all to be a humble gift, that of a single willow twig. The Duchess complied and sent the twig with all haste to Kourend where the learned Alexander planted the twig. Legend has it that all of Kourend's willows are descended from this first one.
translation: 柳树遍布吉莱诺的温带地区，几乎可以在任何水域附近找到。柳树有无数用途，如篮子、家具和玩具。柳树在医药方面也特别有用，咀嚼树皮可以治疗多种疾病，如发烧和炎症。一个关于柳树的迷人故事，是在大库兰德可以找到的柳树传说。虽然遍布整个王国，但它们实际上并非本土植物。霍西迪乌斯人中一个著名的传说是诗人亚历山大的故事。亚历山大关于所有植物学事物的优美作品赢得了当时仑桥镇女公爵的青睐。她非常迷恋他的作品，以至于要求墨迹一干就立即将作品送到海外。作为对他写作的回报，亚历山大获得了一个请求，他向所有人索要了一个看似谦卑的礼物，一根柳树枝。女公爵答应了，并迅速将树枝送到库兰德，博学的亚历山大在那里种下了这根树枝。传说库兰德所有的柳树都是这第一棵的后代。

english: A tropical hardwood tree species that naturally occurs among other jungle trees. Coveted for its durability and water resistance, it is mainly used in boat building, exterior construction, furniture and carving. Another prized feature of teak wood is its resistance to termite damage. A final interesting fact is that teak trees are more closely related to mint than to any other trees on Gielinor.
translation: 一种热带硬木树种，自然生长在其他丛林树之间。因其耐用性和防水性而备受青睐，主要用于造船、外部建筑、家具和雕刻。柚木另一个珍贵的特性是抗白蚁侵害。最后一个有趣的事实是，柚木与薄荷的亲缘关系比与吉莱诺上任何其他树都更近。

english: A common amber-coloured tree found throughout the world. They produce distinctive seeds called maple keys. These seeds are attached to a flattened wing, made of papery lightweight tissue. As a result of this ingenious adaptation, they spin and catch the wind as they fall, allowing them to travel a considerable distance. Maple is considered a tonewood and produces excellent musical clarity and as such is used in numerous musical instruments.
translation: 一种世界各地常见的琥珀色树木。它们结出独特的种子，称为枫翅果。这些种子附着在扁平的翅上，由纸质轻质组织制成。由于这种巧妙的适应性，它们在落下时会旋转并乘风飞行，能够传播相当远的距离。枫木被认为是音木，具有出色的音乐清晰度，因此被用于众多乐器中。

english: A tropical hardwood species producing a straight-grained, reddish timber. Mahogany is relatively free of imperfections and with excellent workability and durability. Because of this, it is prized by high end furniture makers. Mahogany also resists rot, making it attractive in boat cabin construction. Further, being a tonewood means that it is often used for musical instruments, particularly guitars, producing a better tone compared to other commonly used woods, such as maple. The origin of the name is likely a miscommunication of the old Karamjan word m'oganwo.
translation: 一种热带硬木树种，产出直纹、微红的木材。桃花心木几乎没有瑕疵，加工性和耐久性都很出色。因此，它备受高端家具制造商的青睐。桃花心木还耐腐蚀，使其在船舱建造中颇具吸引力。此外，作为一种音木，它常用于乐器制作，尤其是吉他，相比枫木等其他常用木材能产生更好的音色。其名称的起源可能是古老的卡拉姆詹语单词m'oganwo的误传。

english: A rare evergreen tree prized for its durability. Yew is remarkably elastic, making it the ideal wood for products that require springiness, such as bows. Yews are fairly unique in the plant world in that separate trees can be either male or female. The male yews bloom and release abundant amounts of pollen in the spring which is unusually toxic causing headaches, itching, and skin rashes. Although all parts of the yew are poisonous to some extent, when treated properly the roots can be used as an ingredient when making antidotes to common poisons.
translation: 一种稀有的常青树，以其耐久性而备受珍视。紫杉木弹性极佳，是制作需要弹性的产品（如弓）的理想木材。紫杉在植物界中相当独特，因为不同的树可以是雄性或雌性。雄性紫杉在春天开花并释放大量花粉，这些花粉异常有毒，会引起头痛、瘙痒和皮疹。虽然紫杉的所有部分都有一定毒性，但经过适当处理后，其根部可用作制作常见毒药解毒剂的成分。

english: A rare type of tree that is typically only found naturally in locations of magical power. Magic trees have a sort of parasitic relationship, feeding off magical energy in order to survive. This method of sustaining itself imbues the tree with magical energy, making its wood some of the most prized. Practitioners of the magical arts often encourage the growth of these trees as they can act as a siphon, preventing excess magical energy causing any unwanted issues. Although heavily associated with magic, the most skilled farmers have found success cultivating these trees.
translation: 一种稀有树种，通常只在具有魔法力量的地方自然生长。魔法树有一种类似寄生的关系，靠吸收魔法能量生存。这种自我维持的方式使树木充满了魔法能量，使其木材成为最珍贵的木材之一。魔法艺术的实践者经常鼓励这些树的生长，因为它们可以充当虹吸管，防止多余的魔法能量引起任何不必要的问题。尽管与魔法密切相关，但最熟练的农民也成功培育了这些树。

english: Exceptionally large conifer trees and in fact the largest and tallest trees in the world. These trees can live thousands of years. Native to the Kingdoms of Great Kourend and Varlamore, these trees are unfortunately close to extinct in the wild due to heavy deforestation caused by both settlers and various conflicts. Thankfully, due to conservation efforts, a small number of redwoods can still be found, particularly in controlled environments.
translation: 异常巨大的针叶树，实际上是世界上最大最高的树。这些树可以存活数千年。原产于大库兰德王国和瓦拉莫尔王国，不幸的是，由于定居者和各种冲突造成的严重砍伐，这些树在野外几乎灭绝。幸运的是，由于保护工作的努力，仍能找到少量红木，尤其是在受控环境中。

english: Not much is known about these mysterious solemn onlookers. What is certain is thye are heavily entwined in gnome society and act as a useful method of transportation. Anything else that can be said is merely conjecture and only raises more questions. It has been said that it is possible to grow these trees from seeds although incredibly difficult and best supervised by a knowledgeable gnome.
translation: 关于这些神秘而庄严的旁观者，人们知之甚少。可以确定的是，它们与地精社会紧密相连，并作为一种有用的交通方式。其他任何说法都只是猜测，只会引发更多问题。据说有可能从种子中种植这些树，尽管极其困难，最好由知识渊博的地精监督。

english: Potatoes are prepared in many ways and are a main staple of every citizens diet. Potatoes are also used to brew vodka. The part of the plant we consume is known as a tuber and is used by the plant as a place to store nutrients. This allows the potato to effectively “die” in the winter, then provide energy for regrowth during the next growing season. Before this occurs, potato plants produce flowers which once pollinated produce small green fruits. These fruits, that resemble green tomatoes, contain the seeds of the plant. The resemblance to tomatoes is no coincidence as potatoes are directly related to them. However, the fruit cannot be eaten as like nightshade, another relation, it contains deadly toxins.
translation: 土豆有多种烹饪方式，是每个公民饮食中的主食。土豆也用于酿造伏特加。我们食用的植物部分被称为块茎，植物用它来储存养分。这使得土豆能够在冬天有效地“死亡”，然后在下一个生长季节为再生提供能量。在此之前，土豆植物会开花，授粉后结出绿色小果实。这些类似绿色番茄的果实含有植物的种子。与番茄的相似并非巧合，因为土豆与它们有直接亲缘关系。然而，这些果实不能食用，因为像另一种近亲龙葵一样，它们含有致命毒素。

english: Onions are served in a variety of dishes and when cut they produce a pungent odour which irritates the eyes. As the onion plant matures, it stores nutrients at the base of the leaves. This creates a swelling and forms a bulb. The layers of the onion bulb are known as scales. In the autumn, the outer scales of the bulb become dry and brittle, forming the onions skin. If not harvested, the green leaves will die over winter and new leaves will appear in the spring. Interestingly, onions are toxic to dogs and cats.
translation: 洋葱用于各种菜肴，切开时会散发出刺激眼睛的辛辣气味。随着洋葱植物成熟，它在叶子基部储存养分，形成膨胀并形成鳞茎。洋葱鳞茎的层被称为鳞片。秋天，鳞茎外层变得干燥易碎，形成洋葱皮。如果不收获，绿叶将在冬天枯死，春天会长出新叶。有趣的是，洋葱对狗和猫有毒。

english: Cabbage can be prepared and eaten in many different ways, the most common ways being steaming or stewing. Cabbage produces densely leaved heads and grows in sunny, well drained fields. Cabbages are known to cause an increase in flatulence which is believed to be due to some of the unique chemicals within them.
translation: 卷心菜可以以多种不同方式烹饪和食用，最常见的方式是蒸或炖。卷心菜长出密集的叶片，生长在阳光充足、排水良好的田地中。众所周知，卷心菜会导致肠胃气胀增加，据信这是由于其中一些独特的化学物质所致。

english: While often mistaken for a vegetable, a tomato is in fact a fruit. An old adage says that a smart man knows a tomato is a fruit while a wise man knows not to put it into a fruit salad. Tomatoes develop after fertilisation and internally contain the seeds for the next generation. Tomato plants are vines and as such generally need support to remain upright. Tomatoes are naturally covered with fine hairs which would become roots if the plant were to collapse. This allows the plant to survive if the vine is damaged enough to sever its connection to its original root.
translation: 虽然常被误认为是蔬菜，但番茄实际上是水果。有句老话说，聪明人知道番茄是水果，而智者知道不要把它放进水果沙拉里。番茄在受精后发育，内部含有下一代的种子。番茄植物是藤本植物，因此通常需要支撑才能保持直立。番茄天然覆盖着细毛，如果植物倒塌，这些细毛会变成根。这使得植物在藤蔓受损到与原始根分离时仍能存活。

english: Sweetcorn can be boiled, steamed, or grilled whole and predominately acts as a popular side dish. The sweetcorn is in fact made up of many small fruit known as kernels, which are attached to the hard woody central cob. Together the cob and kernels make up an ear of corn. Interestingly, if you were to count the rows of kernels, you'd find that there is always an even number. The ear is covered by leaves called the husk. This acts as protection for the developing fruit. The husk can be removed by hand which is known as shucking.
translation: 甜玉米可以煮、蒸或整根烤制，主要作为受欢迎的配菜。甜玉米实际上由许多称为玉米粒的小果实组成，它们附着在坚硬的木质中央玉米芯上。玉米芯和玉米粒一起构成一穗玉米。有趣的是，如果你数一数玉米粒的行数，你会发现总是偶数。玉米穗被称为苞叶的叶子覆盖，这保护了发育中的果实。苞叶可以手工去除，这被称为剥苞叶。

english: A favourite amongst people of all ages, strawberries can be eaten fresh or made into jams and pies. It may come as a surprise to many that the strawberry is in fact not a berry. Each outer seed is more like a traditional berry, containing the actual seed inside the hard shell. Interestingly, the variety grown in most allotments around Gielinor was originally produced by a Misthalin breeder. Because of this, it is still known today as the Lumbridge Favourite.
translation: 草莓是老少皆宜的最爱，可以新鲜食用或制成酱和派。许多人可能会惊讶地发现，草莓实际上不是浆果。每个外部种子更像传统的浆果，在坚硬的外壳内含有真正的种子。有趣的是，吉莱诺各地大多数菜园中种植的品种最初是由米斯塔林的一位育种者培育的。因此，它至今仍被称为仑桥镇之选。

english: A popular summer fruit normally eaten fresh in slices or made into a juice. While often the focus is on the red flesh, the outer rind is also edible, making an unusual tasting pickle. Watermelon plants consist of a scrambling vine with stems that are fascinatingly pentagon shaped. The fruit itself is a special kind of berry with a hard rind, and is mostly made up of water. The largest ever recorded watermelon was grown by a man named Christopher in Edgeville. It was said to be the weight of a fully-grown troll.
translation: 一种受欢迎的夏季水果，通常切片新鲜食用或榨汁。虽然人们通常关注红色果肉，但外皮也可食用，可制成味道独特的腌菜。西瓜植物由攀爬藤蔓组成，茎呈迷人的五边形。果实本身是一种特殊的有硬皮的浆果，主要由水组成。有记录以来最大的西瓜是由边陲镇一个名叫克里斯托弗的人种植的。据说它有一头成年巨魔那么重。

english: Snape grass has a subtle fruity flavour and is often used in teas. When crushed, the leaves emit a fruity smell which can be used to repel some insects, but interestingly has been known to attract bees. Some gardeners claim that planting snape grass will reduce the amount of pests and increase the number of pollinators. However, this has never been officially confirmed. Growing in dense clumps, the blade-like leaves change colour from green to red during changing autumn temperatures.
translation: 斯内普草具有微妙的果味，常用于茶饮。碾碎时，叶子会散发出果香，可以用来驱赶一些昆虫，但有趣的是，它也被认为会吸引蜜蜂。一些园丁声称种植斯内普草可以减少害虫数量并增加授粉媒介。然而，这从未得到官方证实。斯内普草密集丛生，刀状叶片在秋季温度变化时会从绿色变为红色。

english: A cereal grain and a member of the grass family, barley is a key ingredient in beer and whisky. According to historians, barley beer is likely one of the first alcoholic drinks ever developed by the early settlers of Gielinor. In order for barley to be edible, the fibrous outer hull must be removed. Before brewing, the process of malting is started where the grain is placed and soaked in hot water and allowed to grow slightly. This is halted by drying under heat. Once the barley malt is made, the brewing of ale can begin. This is done using a brewing vat filled with water and barley malt as a base. Most ale is fermented with ale yeast and flavoured with hops.
translation: 大麦是一种谷类作物，属于禾本科，是啤酒和威士忌的关键原料。据历史学家称，大麦啤酒可能是吉莱诺早期定居者开发的第一批酒精饮料之一。为了使大麦可食用，必须去除纤维状的外壳。在酿造之前，开始制麦芽的过程，将谷物放入热水中浸泡并让其稍微发芽。然后通过加热干燥来停止这一过程。一旦制成大麦麦芽，就可以开始酿造麦酒。这使用装满水和大麦麦芽的酿酒桶作为基底。大多数麦酒用麦酒酵母发酵并用啤酒花调味。

english: While not a hop, jute is often grown alongside them due to its similarities. The word jute actually applies to the fiber produced from the plant, with the leaves being known as mallow. Mallow is used in some cultures for culinary purposes while the jute fibers from the stem and outer skin are used in the creation of a strong thread. Jute fibers are uniquely long, soft and shiny and are extracted through a process known as retting. The thread produced by these fibers is used in the creation of twine, rope, sacks and nets. Interestingly, the people of Hosidius, famous for thinking of ingenious ways to use every part of a plant, are known to create a stew from the plant. This dish is known as Molo.
translation: 虽然黄麻不是啤酒花，但由于其相似性，常与啤酒花一起种植。黄麻这个词实际上指的是从植物中产生的纤维，叶子被称为锦葵。锦葵在一些文化中用于烹饪目的，而来自茎和表皮的黄麻纤维用于制作坚固的线。黄麻纤维特别长、柔软且有光泽，通过称为沤麻的过程提取。这些纤维制成的线用于制作麻线、绳子、麻袋和网。有趣的是，以想出巧妙方法利用植物每一部分而闻名的霍西迪乌斯城人民，会用这种植物制作炖菜。这道菜被称为莫洛。

english: Hops are climbing plants that are commonly trained to grow up strings in a hopfield. The word hop refers to the flowers of these plants which are mainly used in the flavouring of ale. Historically, hop varieties are identified in two ways. The first is by geographic location such as Asgarnian hops. The second is by the farmer who first cultivated them such as Hammerstone hops.
translation: 啤酒花是攀缘植物，通常被训练在啤酒花田中沿着绳子生长。啤酒花这个词指的是这些植物的花，主要用于给麦酒调味。历史上，啤酒花品种有两种识别方式。第一种是按地理位置，如阿斯加尼亚啤酒花。第二种是按首次培育它们的农夫，如汉默石啤酒花。

english: Hammerstone hops were first cultivated by Agnarr Hammerstone in order to brew a better tasting dwarven stout. His innovation gave us the flavour that we know and love today. Dwarven stout has a roasted wheat taste combined with a sweet creamy almost chocolate-like touch. The ale is very popular amongst dwarves, who often use it to prepare for a long hard day in the mines.
translation: 汉默石啤酒花最初由阿格纳尔·汉默石培育，目的是酿造味道更好的矮人黑啤酒。他的创新给了我们今天所熟知和喜爱的风味。矮人黑啤酒具有烤小麦的味道，结合了甜奶油般几乎像巧克力的感觉。这种麦酒在矮人中非常受欢迎，他们经常用它来为矿井中漫长而辛苦的一天做准备。

english: Asgarnian hops were first bred as a hobby by a Guthixian druid of Taverley whose name has unfortunately been lost. These hops are used to brew Asgarnian ale, one of the most popular ales in Gielinor. Asgarnian ale is known for having a malt-focused, caramelly sweet taste.
translation: 阿斯加尼亚啤酒花最初是由塔韦利村一位古斯教德鲁伊作为爱好培育的，遗憾的是他的名字已失传。这些啤酒花用于酿造阿斯加尼亚麦酒，这是吉莱诺最受欢迎的麦酒之一。阿斯加尼亚麦酒以麦芽为主、焦糖般的甜味而闻名。

english: It should come as no surprise that the Yanillian hop is the result of tinkering by members of the Wizards' Guild. This variety is an amalgamation of traditional breeding and the magical experiments of a wizard called Soraya. Despite the popularity of the ale, Soraya has remained relatively obscure in today's literature. The resultant brew made from this hop has been known since its inception as the wizard's mind bomb. Granting the user increased magical ability, this ale is not known for its taste which has been compared to warm tap water with a lot of fizz.
translation: 亚尼利安啤酒花是巫师公会成员修修补补的结果，这并不令人意外。这个品种是传统育种和一位名叫索拉娅的巫师的魔法实验的合并物。尽管这种麦酒很受欢迎，但索拉娅在当今文献中仍然相对默默无闻。用这种啤酒花酿造的饮品自问世以来就被称为法师心灵炸弹。它赋予饮用者增强的魔法能力，但这种麦酒并不以其味道而闻名，有人将其比作加了大量气泡的温水。

english: The inception of this variety is hazy at best. It said that it was first grown by a resident of Seers Village while on a visit to the island of Crandor. It is wildly used to brew dragon bitter, an ale known for having a prominent bitterness with a mild earthy and bready flavour.
translation: 这个品种的起源充其量是模糊的。据说它最初是由先知村的一位居民在访问克兰多尔岛时种植的。它被广泛用于酿造龙苦啤酒，这种麦酒以突出的苦味和温和的泥土及面包味而闻名。

english: A variety that had been passed down for generations by the Wildblood family of Canifis. This hop has become somewhat of a rare specialty and is used in the brewing of slayer's respite. Due to its rarity, finding a vendor of this particular ale presents quite the challenge. Slayer's respite has an unusual sharp sour character with hints of lemon and tart apple.
translation: 一个由坎尼非斯村的怀尔德布拉德家族代代相传的品种。这种啤酒花已成为一种罕见的特产，用于酿造杀戮者的喘息。由于其稀有性，找到这种特殊麦酒的供应商相当具有挑战性。杀戮者的喘息具有一种不寻常的尖锐酸味，带有柠檬和酸苹果的暗示。

english: This species is widely cultivated due to its unique taste. Once mature, the berries have an incredibly tart flavour. In order to be palatable, the berries must be cooked which causes them to lose much of their tartness and become sweeter. As such, the most common dish prepared is redberry pie, a delightful sweet treat with a unique tart hint. Legend has it that this pie was especially popular among the Imcando dwarves. Another use for redberries is in the creation of a potent red dye. Redberries are native to the Kingdom of Misthalin. However, due to their popularity, they can be found across the world.
translation: 这个物种因其独特的味道而被广泛种植。成熟后，浆果具有令人难以置信的酸味。为了使其可口，浆果必须烹饪，这会使它们失去大部分酸味并变得更甜。因此，最常见的菜肴是红莓派，一种令人愉悦的甜点，带有独特的酸味。传说这种派在伊姆坎多矮人中特别受欢迎。红莓的另一个用途是制作一种浓烈的红色染料。红莓原产于米斯塔林王国。然而，由于它们的受欢迎程度，可以在世界各地找到。

english: Cadava is an old word which translates to corpse. The reason for this name is clear, as all parts of the bush are poisonous. The berries are by far the most toxic and if ingested they can cause stomach pain, vomiting, reduced heart rate, blurred vision and drowsiness. Thankfully, they are easily identifiable by their bright pink berries, so few accidents occur. These bushes are mainly found near Varrock and are not commonly found elsewhere due to the danger they pose. However, the berries do still have some limited uses as skilled apothecaries can use them to create cadava potions. These potions are used as powerful sleeping aids by those suffering from extreme insomnia.
translation: 卡达瓦是一个古老的词，翻译过来是尸体。这个名字的原因很清楚，因为灌木的所有部分都有毒。浆果是毒性最强的，如果摄入，会引起胃痛、呕吐、心率减慢、视力模糊和嗜睡。幸运的是，它们很容易通过亮粉色的浆果识别，所以很少发生事故。这些灌木主要分布在维洛克城附近，由于它们构成的危险，在其他地方不常见。然而，浆果仍有一些有限的用途，熟练的药剂师可以用它们制作卡达瓦药水。这些药水被那些患有极度失眠症的人用作强效安眠药。

english: Dwellberries are native to Kandarin and are mainly found within McGrubor's Wood. Long thought to have curative properties, the people of Kandarin often hang the dried berries above their windows to prevent illness. In times of particularly virulent plagues, the berries are steamed to produce an oil. This oil is then sniffed through handkerchiefs by the richer or savvier citizens of Kandarin in order to prevent sickness.
translation: 德维尔莓原产于坎达林王国，主要分布在麦格鲁伯森林中。长期以来被认为具有治疗功效，坎达林的人民经常将干燥的浆果挂在窗户上方以防止疾病。在特别严重的瘟疫时期，浆果被蒸煮以产生一种油。然后，坎达林较富有或较精明的公民通过手帕嗅闻这种油以防止生病。

english: Jangerberries are sour and bitter tasting berries that originally come from the Feldip Hills. Their taste means that they are not overly popular to the citizens of Gielinor. However, what they lack in culinary expectations they make up for in their usefulness to warriors. This is because these berries can be used in various potions to improve one's prowess in battle.
translation: 姜格莓是酸苦味的浆果，最初来自费迪普丘陵。它们的味道意味着它们在吉莱诺公民中不太受欢迎。然而，它们在烹饪上的不足被它们对战士的实用性所弥补。这是因为这些浆果可以用于各种药水中，以提高一个人的战斗能力。

english: Native to the forests of Isafdar, these berries are uniquely adaptable as they generally prefer to act as a parasite on trees. However, with correct nutrients, they can still be grown independently by experienced farmers. They are primarily used in the creation of defensive potions. However, they do also have cultural significance around Wintumber. This is because they are used as a decoration under which lovers are expected to kiss.
translation: 原产于伊萨法德森林，这些浆果具有独特的适应性，因为它们通常喜欢寄生在树上。然而，只要有正确的营养，经验丰富的农民仍然可以独立种植它们。它们主要用于制作防御性药水。然而，它们在冬幕节期间也具有文化意义。这是因为它们被用作装饰，情侣们应在下面接吻。

english: As the name suggests, this plant is incredibly poisonous. Every part of it contains toxins that from a mere touch can cause an itchy, irritating, and sometimes painful rash that lasts for many days. The toxins that cause this rash are in abundance in the berries themselves, Because of this, they make an unquestionably gruesome weapon poison that is often used by less than honorable sellswords. Causing swelling, vomiting and fever, victims have described the experience as feeling like your blood is boiling within you.
translation: 顾名思义，这种植物具有令人难以置信的毒性。它的每一部分都含有毒素，仅仅接触就会引起瘙痒、刺激，有时甚至疼痛的皮疹，持续数天。引起这种皮疹的毒素在浆果本身中含量丰富。因此，它们制成了一种毫无疑问可怕的武器毒素，经常被不太光彩的雇佣兵使用。引起肿胀、呕吐和发烧，受害者将这种体验描述为感觉血液在体内沸腾。

english: Marigolds produce small orange flowers, with feather-like leaves. These flowers produce a pungent scent that deters many common insect pests. However, due to producing a toxic chemical in the roots, marigolds should not be planted too close to certain crops. Along with repelling insects, marigolds will also repel small herbivores due to their dislike of the smell.
translation: 金盏花开出小的橙色花朵，叶子呈羽毛状。这些花散发出刺鼻的气味，可以驱赶许多常见的害虫。然而，由于根部会产生一种有毒化学物质，金盏花不应种植在某些作物太近的地方。除了驱虫外，金盏花还会驱赶小型食草动物，因为它们不喜欢这种气味。

english: A woody evergreen with needle-like leaves. The name rosemary derives from old Saradominist texts where it is known as Rosmarinus. This roughly translates to sea-dew, likely due to the fact that rosemary thrives by the sea. Rosemary requires very little water it can withstand droughts for very lengthy periods. The leaves are often used to flavour foods, particularly meats. Rosemary sprigs are regularly used as a symbol of remembrance and are often thrown into the graves of fallen warriors.
translation: 一种木质常青植物，叶子呈针状。迷迭香的名字源自古老的萨拉多明教文本，在那里它被称为Rosmarinus。这大致翻译为海露，可能是因为迷迭香在海边茁壮成长。迷迭香需要很少的水，可以忍受很长时间的干旱。叶子常用于给食物调味，尤其是肉类。迷迭香小枝经常用作纪念的符号，常被扔进阵亡战士的坟墓中。

english: Nasturtiums have bright orange flowers, and rounded, shield-shaped leaves. Producing a pungent odor, the name nasturtium literally translates to nose-twist. All parts of nasturtium are edible, including the flower which makes for an excellent addition to salads due to its slight peppery taste.
translation: 旱金莲有明亮的橙色花朵和圆形盾状叶子。散发出刺鼻的气味，旱金莲这个名字字面意思是扭鼻子。旱金莲的所有部分都可食用，包括花，由于其轻微的胡椒味，是沙拉的绝佳添加物。

english: Woad produces an eye-catching display of golden flowers and has blade shaped, bluish leaves. Interestingly, woad is from the same family as the cabbage. Since ancient times, woad has been an important source of blue dye. However, it requires a great amount of skill to produce this dye. According to an expert on dyes from Draynor, the process requires lengthy fermentation of the leaves. However, if persistent, the dye produced is a splendid colour.
translation: 菘蓝开出引人注目的金色花朵，叶子呈刀状、带蓝色。有趣的是，菘蓝与卷心菜同属一个科。自古以来，菘蓝一直是蓝色染料的重要来源。然而，生产这种染料需要大量的技巧。据德雷纳的一位染料专家称，该过程需要长时间发酵叶子。然而，如果坚持不懈，生产出的染料颜色非常漂亮。

english: A woody vine with a large pink flower. Grown for its large tuberous root system, limpwurt is a useful ingredient in potions. Although not popularly consumed, it has an earthy pungent aroma and a very bitter flavour. It is most definitely an acquired taste. One group that appears to have acquired this taste are hobgoblins for they are often seen chewing on limpwurt roots.
translation: 一种木质藤本植物，开大粉花。因其巨大的块状根系而种植，软木草根是药水中的有用成分。虽然不常食用，但它有一种泥土般的刺鼻香气和非常苦的味道。这绝对是一种后天习得的味道。似乎已经获得这种味道的一群人是大哥布林，因为他们经常被看到咀嚼软木草根。

english: A tall leafy floral stem that bears several fragrant white flowers. These sweet-smelling beauties take pride of place in any garden. Although magnificent, white lilies have a dark side. While reasonably harmless to humans, if ingested by a cat, the results are often fatal. The white lily symbolises chastity and virtue and as such, it has become a potent symbol among Saradomin worshipers. Some even believe that Saradomin himself created the lily to improve the crops of his most cherished followers.
translation: 一种高大的多叶花茎，开出几朵芬芳的白花。这些芬芳的美人在任何花园中都占据着重要位置。虽然华丽，但白百合也有黑暗的一面。虽然对人类相当无害，但如果被猫摄入，结果往往是致命的。白百合象征着纯洁和美德，因此它已成为萨拉多明信徒中的有力象征。有些人甚至相信萨拉多明本人创造了百合，以改善他最珍视追随者的庄稼。

english: Belladonna, sometimes known as nightshade, is a flowering plant that is closely related to tomatoes and potatoes. However, unlike them, every part of this plant is poisonous, with it reaching its peak deadliness just after flowering. The flowers are thankfully easily identifiable due to being bell-shaped, dull purple and faintly scented. Symptoms of belladonna poisoning include sensitivity to light, blurred vision, loss of balance, staggering, headaches, rash, confusion, hallucinations, delirium, and convulsions. Its only real use is in the production of poison.
translation: 颠茄，有时被称为龙葵，是一种开花植物，与番茄和土豆有密切亲缘关系。然而，与它们不同，这种植物的每一部分都有毒，在开花后不久达到最大致命性。幸运的是，花朵很容易识别，因为它们呈钟形、暗紫色且气味微弱。颠茄中毒的症状包括对光敏感、视力模糊、失去平衡、蹒跚、头痛、皮疹、混乱、幻觉、谵妄和抽搐。它唯一真正的用途是生产毒药。

english: Ultimate Guide to Glassblowing
translation: 玻璃吹制终极指南

english: Author: Fritz the Glassblower
translation: 作者：玻璃吹制师弗里茨

english: I can tell you now, the art of creating glass has long been a valued trade in Gielinor. Not many could get by without the use of some item made from this marvelous substance.
translation: 我现在可以告诉你，玻璃制作艺术长期以来一直是吉莱诺的一项宝贵行业。没有多少人能不用这种奇妙物质制成的物品而生活。

english: It's within this book that we cover the basics of the art, in a hope to get you hooked on this popular pass-time and trade.
translation: 在这本书中，我们涵盖了这门艺术的基础知识，希望能让你迷上这个流行的消遣和行业。

english: To start with, you will need a few essential items.
translation: 首先，你需要一些必备物品。

english: An empty bucket
translation: 一个空桶

english: These can be purchased from the majority of general stores and are required to carry the sand you will need to make glass.
translation: 这些可以在大多数杂货店买到，是携带制作玻璃所需沙子的必备品。

english: A glassblowing pipe
translation: 玻璃吹管

english: Found on Entrana or often just north-west of the Ranging Guild. As it's name suggests, this is used to blow air into molten glass.
translation: 在恩特纳岛或射手公会西北方常能找到。顾名思义，它用于向熔融玻璃中吹气。

english: Seaweed can be found on the shore in many places, but it is also a frequent find when Fishing with nets. This you will need to create soda ash - an important ingredient to the process.
translation: 海藻可以在许多地方的海岸找到，用网钓鱼时也经常能捞到。你需要用它来制作苏打灰——这是制作过程中的重要原料。

english: Made by burning seaweed, you will need this to make glass. Other than making it yourself, you can purchase it from other budding glassblowers.
translation: 通过烧海藻制成，制作玻璃时必不可少。除了自己制作，也可以从其他玻璃吹制者那里购买。

english: With these items you are ready to begin! You'll need to find a sandpit, and there are a few dotted around Gielinor. Try the island of Entrana or Yanille, for example. Use your bucket on the sandpit to fill it up.
translation: 有了这些物品，你就可以开始了！你需要找到一个沙坑，吉莱诺各地散布着几个。比如试试恩特纳岛或亚尼勒城。用桶在沙坑里装满沙子。

english: Next, you need to find your way to a furnace. Turn your seaweed into soda ash by using it on a range before using the bucket of sand or soda ash on the furnace to create molten glass.
translation: 接下来，你需要找到熔炉。先在炉灶上把海藻烧成苏打灰，然后把沙桶或苏打灰用在熔炉上，就能制成熔融玻璃。

english: The last stage is simply to use the molten glass with your glassblowing pipe and, depending on your level of skill, you can create a variety of items.
translation: 最后一步就是用玻璃吹管使用熔融玻璃，根据你的技能等级，可以制作出各种物品。

english: I hope you enjoyed this guide, and please keep an eye out for more of my titles!
translation: 希望你喜欢这本指南，请继续关注我的其他作品！

english: Managing Thine Kingdom
translation: 管理你的王国

english: - for Noobes
translation: - 新手篇

english: - by A. Ghrim
translation: - A. 格里姆 著

english: 2nd Edition
translation: 第二版

english: Wherein is contained the TRUE and TESTED knowledge of the AUTHOR in matters pertaining to the RUNNING of one's KINGDOM.
translation: 本书包含了作者在管理王国方面真实且经过验证的知识。

english: Your loyal subjects will work hard to gather resources for you. When you wish to collect what has been gathered, talk to your Advisor so that they may deliver them to your bank.
translation: 你忠诚的臣民会努力为你收集资源。当你想收取已收集的物品时，与你的顾问交谈，他们会将物品送到你的银行。

english: Remember to be patient! Rather than continually pestering your Advisor to check if more resources have been brought in yet consider what methods you can use to increase the amounts collected, which are set forth in the pages that follow.
translation: 记住要耐心！与其不断催促顾问查看是否收集到更多资源，不如考虑如何增加收集量，方法在后续页面中有所阐述。

english: Your approval rating has an important effect on the amount of resources gathered by your subjects; the more they love you, the more they will collect. If, Guthix forbid, your approval rating should ever drop to near 0, your subjects would be loath to gather anything at all!
translation: 你的支持率对臣民收集资源的数量有重要影响；他们越爱戴你，收集的就越多。如果，古斯保佑，你的支持率降到接近零，你的臣民就什么都不会收集了！

english: Your approval rating will drop quite low over time if you do nothing to increase it. The surest way to improve your rating is to go and help your subjects with their resource-gathering tasks.
translation: 如果你不采取行动提升支持率，它会随时间推移降得很低。提升支持率最可靠的方法是去帮助臣民完成他们的资源收集任务。

english: Even helping a single fisherman fish can be enough, for he will surely tell his friends and family how kind you were.
translation: 即使只帮一个渔夫钓鱼也足够了，因为他肯定会告诉朋友和家人你是多么友善。

english: Your subjects are rewarded for their work straight out of the contents of the royal coffers; should there ever be no money remaining in the coffers, your subjects will have to concentrate on satisfying their own needs and so will not be able to gather anything for you.
translation: 你的臣民直接从皇家金库中获得报酬；如果金库中没有钱，臣民们就得专注于满足自己的需求，无法为你收集任何东西。

english: Each day, one tenth of the contents of the royal coffers are distributed to your subjects, up to a maximum of 75,000 coins. Of course, the greater this share, the more they will be eager to work for you, but be careful not to spend your riches too frivolously. The coffers will hold up to 7.5 million coins.
translation: 每天，皇家金库的十分之一会分给你的臣民，最高不超过75,000金币。当然，份额越大，他们就越愿意为你工作，但小心不要挥霍财富。金库最多可存放750万金币。

english: You may decide at one time or another that you require large amounts of a certain resource above all others; or simply that you do not require any of a certain resource, and do not wish your subjects to gather any of it. By talking to your advisor, you may decide the amount of time and effort your subjects will devote to gathering each resource.
translation: 你可能有时会特别需要大量某种资源；或者根本不需要某种资源，不希望臣民去收集。与顾问交谈，你可以决定臣民在每种资源上投入的时间和精力。

english: Etceteria has pledged some of its subjects to gather resources for you. If you help them with their tasks, they will be as willing as any loyal Miscellanian to aid you and give you the results of their work.
translation: 埃西特利亚岛已派遣一些臣民为你收集资源。如果你帮助他们完成任务，他们会像米塞兰尼亚的忠诚臣民一样愿意帮助你，并交出他们的劳动成果。

english: After spending half a century hiding underground you would think that the great migration would have improved life on Gielinor for tree gnomes. However, rather than the great liberation promised to us by King Healthorg at the end of the last age, we have been forced to live in hiding, up trees or in the gnome maze, laughed at and mocked by man. Living in constant fear of human aggression, we are in a no better situation now than when we lived in the caves! Change must come soon!
translation: 在地下躲藏了半个世纪后，你会以为大迁徙改善了树地精在吉莱诺的生活。然而，与上个时代末海尔索格国王承诺的伟大解放不同，我们被迫躲藏起来，住在树上或地精迷宫里，被人嘲笑和讥讽。生活在人类侵略的持续恐惧中，我们现在的情况并不比住在洞穴里好多少！变革必须尽快到来！

english: Today I heard of three more gnomes slain by Khazard's human troops for fun, I can't control my anger! Humanity seems to have acquired a level of arrogance comparable to that of Zamorak, killing and pillaging at will! We are small and at heart not warriors but something must be done! We will pick up arms and go forth into the human world! We will defend ourselves and we will pursue justice for all gnomes who fell at the hands of humans!
translation: 今天我听说又有三个地精被卡扎德的人类士兵取乐杀害，我无法控制我的愤怒！人类似乎已经获得了堪比萨莫拉克的傲慢，随意杀戮掠夺！我们虽小，内心也不是战士，但必须做点什么！我们将拿起武器，走向人类世界！我们将自卫，为所有死于人类之手的地精伸张正义！

english: Some of the local gnomes seem strangely deluded about humans, many actually believe that humans are not all naturally evil but instead vary from person to person. This sort of talk could be the end for the tree gnomes and I must continue to convince my fellow gnome folk the cold truth about these human creatures! How they will not stop until all gnome life is destroyed! Unless we can destroy them first!
translation: 一些本地地精似乎对人类有奇怪的错觉，许多人真的相信人类并非天生邪恶，而是因人而异。这种言论可能是树地精的末日，我必须继续让我的地精同胞们认清这些人类生物冷酷的真相！他们不消灭所有地精是不会罢休的！除非我们先消灭他们！

english: Knead a ball of Gianne dough into a gnomebowl mould. Bake this briefly. Decadently add four bars of chocolate to the bowl and top with one sprig of equa leaves. Bake the bowl in the oven to melt the chocolate. Then mix in two big dollops of cream and finally sprinkle chocolate dust all over.
translation: 将一团吉安面团揉入地精碗模具中。短暂烘烤。奢华地在碗中加入四块巧克力，顶部放一枝伊库瓦叶。将碗放入烤箱烘烤使巧克力融化。然后拌入两大勺奶油，最后撒上巧克力粉。

english: Chocolate is a relatively recent cooking ingredients for gnomes, having been imported from human lands.
translation: 巧克力对地精来说是相对较新的烹饪原料，是从人类地区进口的。

english: Shape a portion of fresh Gianne dough into a gnomebowl mould. Bake this until it is slightly springy. Add to the bowl... 4 pairs of toad's legs 2 portions of cheese 2 sprigs of equa leaves 2 dashes of gnome spice 1 bunch of dwellberries Bake the dish in the oven once more prior to serving.
translation: 将一份新鲜吉安面团塑形放入地精碗模具中。烘烤至略有弹性。在碗中加入... 4对蟾蜍腿 2份乳酪 2枝伊库瓦叶 2撮地精香料 1束德维尔莓 上桌前再次烘烤。

english: Tangled Toads Legs was a special dish created by gnome chef Deelie to celebrate the first Healthorg the Great Day.
translation: 蟾蜍腿乱炖是地精厨师迪利为庆祝第一个海尔索格大帝日而创作的特色菜肴。

english: Starting with a gnomebowl mould, shape a portion of fresh Gianne dough into a rough bowl. Bake this until it is firm to the touch. Add to the bowl four king worms, two onions and a dash of gnome spices. Bake the bowl in the oven once more. To finish the dish simply add a topping of equa leaves.
translation: 从地精碗模具开始，将一份新鲜吉安面团塑成粗碗状。烘烤至触感坚实。在碗中加入四条蠕虫王、两个洋葱和一撮地精香料。再次烘烤。最后加上伊库瓦叶作为点缀即可。

english: Worms are specially favoured by gnomes as they purportedly aid virility.
translation: 蠕虫特别受地精喜爱，据说有助于增强活力。

english: As with all gnomebowl dishes, throw a ball of fresh Gianne dough into a mould. Bake this as usual. Bake this briefly. Add to the bowl two onions, two potatoes and a dash of gnome spices. Bake the bowl in the oven once more. To finish simply top with equa leaves.
translation: 与所有地精碗菜肴一样，将一团新鲜吉安面团放入模具中。照常烘烤。短暂烘烤。在碗中加入两个洋葱、两个土豆和一撮地精香料。再次烘烤。最后用伊库瓦叶点缀即可。

english: Using a crunchy tray, form a portion of Gianne dough into small evenly sized balls. Heat these briefly in an oven. Mix into the dough balls two king worms, one sprig of equa leaves and a shake of gnome spices. Bake the crunchies for a short time in the oven. Sprinkle generously with gnome spices to finish.
translation: 用脆饼烤盘将一份吉安面团塑成大小均匀的小球。在烤箱中短暂加热。在面团球中混入两条蠕虫王、一枝伊库瓦叶和少许地精香料。在烤箱中短暂烘烤脆饼。最后慷慨地撒上地精香料。

english: Crunchies were invented accidentally by Pukkamay, who was Deelie's assistant before his sacking. He started a successful crunchy making business before dying in a bizarre Terrorbird accident.
translation: 脆饼是普卡梅意外发明的，他是迪利的助理，后来被解雇了。在被一只奇怪的骇鸟事故夺去生命之前，他创办了一家成功的脆饼生意。

english: Fill up a crunchy tray with balls of Gianne dough. Heat these briefly in a warm oven. Break up two bars of chocolate and mix these with the balls of dough. Next add a little gnome spice to each ball. Bake the crunchies for a short time in the oven. Top the crunchies with a sprinkling of chocolate dust to finish.
translation: 用吉安面团球填满脆饼烤盘。在温暖的烤箱中短暂加热。掰碎两块巧克力，与面团球混合。接下来在每个球中加入少许地精香料。在烤箱中短暂烘烤脆饼。最后撒上巧克力粉点缀。

english: Using a crunchy tray, form a portion of Gianne dough into small evenly sized balls. Heat these briefly in a warm oven. Add a generous shake of spice and two sprigs of equa leaves to the dough balls. Bake the crunchies for a short time in the oven. Sprinkle a load more gnome spice over the cookies to finish.
translation: 用脆饼烤盘将一份吉安面团塑成大小均匀的小球。在温暖的烤箱中短暂加热。在面团球中加入大量香料和两枝伊库瓦叶。在烤箱中短暂烘烤脆饼。最后再撒上大量地精香料。

english: The special mix of herbs and spices in gnome spice is a closely guarded secret. It is rumoured to contain (the rest is scribbled out)
translation: 地精香料中草药和香料的特殊配方是严密保护的秘密。据传含有（其余部分被涂掉了）

english: Fill a crunchy tray with Gianne dough as normal. Heat these briefly in a warm oven. Mix into the dough balls two pairs of toad's legs and a shake of gnome spices. Bake the crunchies for a short time in the oven. Finish the crunchies with a sprinkling of equa leaves.
translation: 照常将吉安面团填满脆饼烤盘。在温暖的烤箱中短暂加热。在面团球中混入两对蟾蜍腿和少许地精香料。在烤箱中短暂烘烤脆饼。最后撒上伊库瓦叶点缀。

english: When Pukkamay first made toad crunchies, everyone thought he was mad. 'Chewy toads, in crunchies? It'll never work' they said - how wrong they were...
translation: 当普卡梅第一次制作蟾蜍脆饼时，所有人都觉得他疯了。'脆饼里放嚼劲十足的蟾蜍？绝对行不通'他们说——他们错得多么离谱……

english: First take some fresh Gianne dough and place it in a batta tin. Bake the dough until it is lightly browned. Take one king worm, some gnome spice and a little cheese. Add these to the batta before briefly baking it in the oven once more. Finish the batta with a topping of equa leaves.
translation: 先取一些新鲜吉安面团放入芭塔烤盘。烘烤面团至微黄。取一条蠕虫王、一些地精香料和少量乳酪。将这些加入芭塔中，再短暂放入烤箱烘烤一次。最后以伊库瓦叶点缀完成芭塔。

english: Battas are usually cooked by gnome mother during the cold winter months.
translation: 芭塔通常在寒冷的冬季由地精母亲烹制。

english: Mould some Gianne dough into a batta tin. Bake the tin until it is almost cooked. Next add some prime toad's legs, a sprig of equa leaves and some spice along with some cheese to the batta. Bake the batta in the oven once more and serve hot.
translation: 将吉安面团塑形放入芭塔烤盘。烘烤至几乎熟透。接着加入上等蟾蜍腿、一小枝伊库瓦叶、一些香料和乳酪。再次放入烤箱烘烤，趁热食用。

english: Toad battas are sometimes called Toad in the Hole. Apparently there is a similar human dish that uses sausages. How odd.
translation: 蟾蜍芭塔有时被称为洞中蟾蜍。显然人类有一道类似的菜用香肠。真奇怪。

english: Place some Gianne dough in a batta tin. Bake it as normal. Top the plain batta with equal quantities of cheese and tomato. Place the batta in the oven once more until all the cheese has melted. Finish the dish with a sprinkling of equa leaves.
translation: 将吉安面团放入芭塔烤盘。照常烘烤。在普通芭塔上铺等量的乳酪和番茄。再次放入烤箱直至乳酪完全融化。最后撒上伊库瓦叶完成。

english: The combination of cheese and tomato was discovered by the explorer Wingstone while was visiting the human lands. Apparently it's used a lot in a strange flat human dish called a pizza.
translation: 乳酪和番茄的组合是探险家温斯顿在访问人类领地时发现的。显然它常被用在一种叫做披萨的奇怪扁平人类菜肴中。

english: Prepare Gianne dough in a batta tin as normal. Bake the dough for a short while. Top the batta with chunks of pineapple, orange and lime. Lay four sprigs of equa leaves on top of the batta before baking it in the oven once more. Finish the batta with a sprinkling of gnome spices.
translation: 照常将吉安面团放入芭塔烤盘。短暂烘烤。在芭塔上铺上菠萝、橙子和青柠块。放四小枝伊库瓦叶在芭塔上，再放入烤箱烘烤一次。最后撒上地精香料完成。

english: Battas are normally savoury dish, and the fruit batta is definitely an acquired taste.
translation: 芭塔通常是咸味菜肴，水果芭塔绝对是需要慢慢适应的口味。

english: Place some Gianne dough in a batta tin and bake as normal. Add to the plain batta two tomatos, one onion, one cabbage and some dwellberries. Top the batta with cheese and briefly place it in the oven once more. Finish the dish with a sprinkling of equa leaves.
translation: 将吉安面团放入芭塔烤盘照常烘烤。在普通芭塔上加入两个番茄、一个洋葱、一个卷心菜和一些德维尔莓。铺上乳酪，短暂放入烤箱再烤一次。最后撒上伊库瓦叶完成。

english: There's no better batta than a vegetable batta.
translation: 没有比蔬菜芭塔更好的芭塔了。

english: Come and duel me at the Champions' Guild, I'll make sure nothing goes to waste.
translation: 来冠军公会和我决斗吧，我保证不会浪费任何东西。

english: Champion of Ghouls
translation: 食尸鬼冠军

english: Get yourself to the Champions' Guild, if you dare to face me puny human.
translation: 去冠军公会吧，如果你敢面对我这个渺小的人类。

english: Champion of Giants
translation: 巨人冠军

english: I still need to give Gilbert a yellow rainbow strand.
translation: 我还需要给吉尔伯特一条黄色彩虹线。

english: Here lies Glarial, wife of Baxtorian, true
translation: 此处安息着格拉里尔，巴克斯托里安之妻，真诚

english: Since you've just refused an easy job, I only have a hard job available for you at the moment. If you want to wait for another easy one - come back in X minutes.
translation: 既然你刚拒绝了一个简单的工作，我现在只有困难的工作给你。如果你想等另一个简单的 - X分钟后回来。

english: Since you've just refused a hard job, I only have a easy job available for you at the moment. If you want to wait for another hard one - come back in X minutes.
translation: 既然你刚拒绝了一个困难的工作，我现在只有简单的工作给你。如果你想等另一个困难的 - X分钟后回来。

english: Since you've refused both the last hard and easy job I've offered you, you'll have to wait for new orders to come through - come back in X minutes.

english: Seren forgive us, and protect the realm. We've made a mistake that could cost us everything.
translation: 塞伦宽恕我们，保佑这片土地。我们犯了一个可能让我们失去一切的错误。

english: We'd undertaken this journey under the best of noble intentions, even under divine necessity. I still remember Adwr's wild eyes, holding back tears as he told us of the horrors he'd witnessed on his mission to Prifddinas. He'd narrowly escaped with his life, something which could not be said about his companions. He sobbed as he recounted the betrayal, the killings, the sacking of the city, the takeover of the Tower of Voices... All of which was on Lord Iorwerth's command.
translation: 我们怀着最崇高的意图，甚至是在神圣的使命下踏上这段旅程。我仍记得阿德沃尔含泪的双眼，他讲述在普里夫迪纳斯城任务中目睹的恐怖。他侥幸逃生，但他的同伴就没那么幸运了。他哽咽着讲述背叛、杀戮、城市被洗劫、声音之塔被占领……这一切都是伊尔沃斯领主的命令。

english: The news spread quickly, shocking and dividing our people. We called an emergency council of all eastern settlements to discuss what was to be done. While some were content to leave the city to its fate, afraid of what was to come, most of us knew better. Baxtorian reminded us all of Seren's promise to us, and her command to keep the eight clans together. This was enough for the majority to reach a fragile, but unanimous agreement.
translation: 消息迅速传开，震惊并分裂了我们的人民。我们召集了所有东方定居点的紧急议会，讨论应对之策。虽然有些人害怕即将到来的事，愿意让城市自生自灭，但我们大多数人更明智。巴克斯托里安提醒我们塞伦的承诺，以及她要求八大家族团结的命令。这足以让大多数人达成一个脆弱但一致的决定。

english: Within a few days, we gathered whatever forces we had under my banner and made our way to the ancient Underground Pass, moving towards Prifddinas, moving towards what once had been all of our homes. The plan was Baxtorian's idea. We thought if we mustered our forces and marched through the pass hastily enough, we would be able to catch Lord Iorwerth unprepared while his forces were divided and end this madness before it ended us.
translation: 几天之内，我们集结了所有能调动的力量，在我的旗帜下，向古老的地下通道进发，前往普里夫迪纳斯城，前往我们曾经共同的家园。计划是巴克斯托里安的主意。我们以为只要集结兵力，迅速穿过通道，就能在伊尔沃斯领主兵力分散时打他个措手不及，在这场疯狂毁灭我们之前结束它。

english: We were wrong. So, so wrong.
translation: 我们错了。大错特错。

english: We could not have predicted the strength of the evil that would meet us. We should have taken the fell whisperings and ghastly shapes within the tunnel's darkness, just out of true perception, as an omen of danger. Perhaps we were overconfident. Perhaps we were in denial. In any case, we chose to ignore them and travel on, oblivious of the terrors just beyond our sight.
translation: 我们无法预料到将要面对的邪恶力量。我们应该把隧道黑暗中那些隐约的低语和恐怖身影当作危险的预兆。也许我们过于自信了。也许我们是在否认现实。无论如何，我们选择无视它们继续前行，对视线之外的恐怖浑然不觉。

english: Seven days we travelled, carrying our supplies though the underground. Seven days of relative safety, seven days of lulling us into a false sense of security. We marched on the gates of Prifddinas on the morning of the eighth day, where everything fell apart.
translation: 我们在地下行进了七天，携带补给。七天的相对安全，七天让我们产生了虚假的安全感。第八天早晨，我们抵达普里夫迪纳斯城的大门前，一切都在那里崩溃了。

english: I do not know how Lord Iorwerth knew of our plans, but his forces were waiting for us. Baxtorian tried to reason with him, but he would not listen. They destroyed almost half of our forces before we called a retreat. A further quarter of us were slain by traps within the forest as we fled, left behind in our haste.
translation: 我不知道伊尔沃斯领主是如何得知我们的计划的，但他的军队在那里等着我们。巴克斯托里安试图与他讲道理，但他不听。在我们撤退之前，他们摧毁了我们近一半的兵力。逃跑途中，又有四分之一的人死于森林中的陷阱，被我们匆忙抛下。

english: We reached the Well of Voyage by nightfall, and that was where all hope was truly lost. I was one of the first who made it through, back to the underground from where we had come. A few of us had already begun to scout ahead when they came again. Not content with defeating us at the city gates, Lord Iorwerth had sent his forces into the pass. That wasn't all we faced though. In the darkness, both sides were set upon by humans, beasts, and some things in between.
translation: 我们在夜幕降临时到达了远航之井，那里才是所有希望真正破灭的地方。我是第一批穿过它回到我们来时地下通道的人之一。我们中有几个人已经开始向前侦察，这时他们又来了。伊尔沃斯领主不满足于在城门口击败我们，还派兵进入了通道。但我们面对的还不止这些。在黑暗中，双方都遭到了人类、野兽以及介于两者之间的东西的袭击。

english: My heart still aches as I recall the final moments before we scattered. A bolt of magic hit one of my warriors in the torso, and I turned to help him. He looked terrified as he began to grow pale. I tried to help him, but it was no use: he went limp in my arms after a few moments. By the time I turned back toward the skirmish, all was lost. The last of the defenders had begun to fall.
translation: 当我回忆起我们溃散前的最后时刻，我的心仍在痛。一道魔法箭击中了我一名战士的躯干，我转身去帮他。他开始脸色苍白，看起来很害怕。我试图帮他，但无济于事：片刻之后，他在我的手臂中瘫软下来。当我转身看向战斗时，一切都已经完了。最后的守卫者开始倒下。

english: I fled into the deeper tunnels as fast as I could, leaving the rest behind as the darkness surrounded me. The guilt for my actions pains me far more than any of the wounds I've sustained, a pain which I know I will feel for however longer I shall remain.
translation: 我以最快的速度逃进更深的隧道，把其他人抛在身后，黑暗将我包围。我的行为带来的内疚比我所受的任何伤都更让我痛苦，我知道只要我还活着，这种痛苦就会一直伴随着我。

english: As of writing this note, I have been lost for longer than I can comprehend, nor care to. The whispers have grown stronger as the days have passed, and I am beginning to fear that their vile words are beginning to influence me. My mind aches from the horrid things I've seen, and I know there is little hope for me. I tried to find any survivors, anyone who made it through, but have been completely alone since the ambush.
translation: 写下这张笔记时，我已经迷失了太久，久到无法理解，也不愿去想了。随着日子一天天过去，低语声越来越强，我开始害怕那些邪恶的话语正在影响我。我所见的恐怖景象让我心智痛苦，我知道自己几乎没有希望了。我试图找到任何幸存者，任何逃出来的人，但自从伏击之后，我一直完全孤独。

english: Arianwyn, my child, forgive me. I pray to Seren that you're ready for whatever may come, and my only remaining wish is that you know how sorry I am for not leaving you more prepared for the war to come. I know you're still somewhere with whomever else was left behind. I know that one day, our people will look to you for guidance and safety. You're stronger than you'll ever know, and if there's anyone who can find a way to save us all, it's you.
translation: 阿里安温，我的孩子，原谅我。我向塞伦祈祷，希望你已经为即将到来的一切做好准备，我唯一的遗愿就是你知道我多么抱歉，没能让你为即将到来的战争做好更充分的准备。我知道你还和那些留下的人在一起。我知道总有一天，我们的人民会寻求你的指引和保护。你比你想象的更坚强，如果有人能找到拯救我们所有人的方法，那就是你。

english: The voices grow stronger, still. Something keeps leading me back into the darkness. Every time I think I've found a new path, a way out, anything... I somehow end up back at the well. However, these last few times I've gazed into its murky waters, I feel as though it's called to me. It beckons me, tempting me to climb into the waters and see where it leads me. The voices agree with the urge, and the only solace I have from their wicked words are the serenity of the water within.
translation: 声音越来越强了。有什么东西一直把我引回黑暗。每次我以为找到了新路径、出路或任何东西……我总会回到水井边。然而，最近几次我凝视着浑浊的水，感觉它在召唤我。它向我招手，引诱我爬进水中，看看它会带我去哪里。那些声音也赞同这种冲动，而我唯一能摆脱它们邪恶话语的慰藉，就是井中水的宁静。

english: Every part of me aches as I write, and the voices have nearly reached a macabre crescendo. I know I shouldn't go near the well, but something powerful within me draws me closer still. Perhaps I'll just see how the water feels against my fingertips...
translation: 我写下这些时浑身疼痛，那些声音几乎达到了恐怖的顶峰。我知道我不该靠近水井，但我内心有股强大的力量把我拉得更近。也许我只是想看看水触碰指尖的感觉……

english: In beginning all gods have big war. Each god find army to fight for him.
translation: 起初所有神都有大战。每个神都找军队为他打仗。

english: Big High War God not have army. Big High War God go to beardy-short-people and ask, Will you fight in my army? But beardy-short-people say, No, we fight for God of Shiny Light.
translation: 大战神没有军队。大战神去找胡子短人问，你们愿意在我的军队里打仗吗？但胡子短人说，不，我们为闪光之神打仗。

english: Then Big High War God go to demons and ask, Will you fight in my army? But demons say, No, we fight for God of Dark Fire.
translation: 然后大战神去找恶魔问，你们愿意在我的军队里打仗吗？但恶魔说，不，我们为暗火之神打仗。

english: Then Big High War God go to tall people with keen blades and say, Will you fight in my army? But tall people with keen blades say, No, some of us fight for God of Shiny Light and some of us fight for God of Dark Fire, but none of us fight for you!
translation: 然后大战神去找拿利刃的高个人说，你们愿意在我的军队里打仗吗？但拿利刃的高个人说，不，我们有些人为了闪光之神打仗，有些人为了暗火之神打仗，但没人为了你打仗！

english: Big High War God very sad. He travel east and west, north and south, across land looking for army to fight for him.
translation: 大战神非常伤心。他走遍东西南北，穿越大地寻找为他打仗的军队。

english: Then goblins say, We fight for you! At that time goblins very weak, very small, soft skin. Not like goblins today! But Big High War God say, I will make you my army. So Big High War God train goblins so they very strong. He give them good armour so they not be harmed. He make them strong in spirit so they not afraid of battle. He give them commanders so they know which way to go. He divide goblins into twelve tribes and send them into battle!
translation: 然后哥布林说，我们为你打仗！那时哥布林非常弱小，皮肤柔软。不像今天的哥布林！但大战神说，我要让你们成为我的军队。所以大战神训练哥布林，让他们变得非常强壮。他给他们好盔甲，让他们不受伤害。他让他们精神强大，不怕战斗。他给他们指挥官，让他们知道该往哪走。他把哥布林分成十二个部落，派他们上战场！

english: Goblin armies fight very good! When other gods see this, they very jealous. So they say, We want goblins to fight for us too! So Big High War God take some tribes and sell them, one to God of Shiny Light and one to God of Dark Fire, and other tribes to other gods. But most still worship Big High War God who created them!
translation: 哥布林军队打得非常好！其他神看到后非常嫉妒。所以他们说，我们也想要哥布林为我们打仗！所以大战神带走一些部落卖掉，一个卖给闪光之神，一个卖给暗火之神，其他部落卖给别的神。但大多数仍然崇拜创造他们的大战神！

english: These are commands of Big High War God! Obey all commands all time or Big High War God kill you very bad!
translation: 这是大战神的命令！任何时候都要遵守所有命令，否则大战神会非常残忍地杀死你！

english: Always to slay enemies of Big High War God. Enemies must die!
translation: 永远要杀死大战神的敌人。敌人必须死！

english: Not to run from battle. Cowards must die!
translation: 不许临阵脱逃。懦夫必须死！

english: Not to show mercy. Merciful must die!
translation: 不许心慈手软。仁慈者必须死！

english: Not to doubt Big High War God. Doubters must die!
translation: 不许怀疑大战神。怀疑者必须死！

english: Not to make own plans. Thinkers must die!
translation: 不许自作主张。思考者必须死！

english: The war of gods last many lifetimes. Battle is glorious and many heroes live and die! Then all gods leave world, leave their armies behind. But goblins still soldiers, still fight! Goblins fight against tall people with keen blades. But tall people build cities with walls, they not want to fight. They not true soldiers like goblins! But now goblins not have enough to eat, and have no commanders to tell them who to fight. So goblin tribes fight one another.
translation: 神战持续了许多世代。战斗光荣，许多英雄生生死死！然后所有神离开世界，留下他们的军队。但哥布林仍然是士兵，仍然在战斗！哥布林对抗拿利刃的高个。但高个建了有墙的城市，他们不想打仗。他们不像哥布林那样是真正的士兵！但现在哥布林没有足够的食物，也没有指挥官告诉他们该打谁。所以哥布林部落互相争斗。

english: At last all goblin tribes have big battle on plain of mud. Battle last many days and many goblins die, battle is glorious! But goblin corpses cover the ground and it look like all die.
translation: 最后所有哥布林部落在泥泞平原上大战。战斗持续了许多天，许多哥布林死去，战斗是光荣的！但哥布林的尸体覆盖了地面，看起来全都死了。

english: Then Hopespear of the Narogoshuun tribe have vision of Big High War God. In night while soldiers rest he call leaders of all tribes together to give them message.
translation: 然后纳罗戈舒恩部落的希望之矛看到了大战神的幻象。夜里士兵休息时，他召集所有部落的首领，给他们传递信息。

english: This is the word of Big High War God: Battle is indeed glorious and goblins are soldiers, but if there too much battle all goblins die! No more must goblin fight against goblin or tribe against tribe. Goblins must find other enemies to fight, but not fight each other!
translation: 这是大战神的话：战斗确实是光荣的，哥布林是士兵，但如果战斗太多，所有哥布林都会死！哥布林不能再打哥布林，部落不能再打部落。哥布林必须找其他敌人打，但不能互相打！

english: And this is the word of Big High War God: Today I cannot lead you, but someday I will send a new Commander to lead you. Under new Commander goblins will conquer all of Gielinor, every race and every god! And then Big High War God will return and sit on throne of bronze and rule over all. War will end in victory and victory will last forever!
translation: 这也是大战神的话：今天我无法领导你们，但总有一天我会派一个新的指挥官来领导你们。在新指挥官带领下，哥布林将征服整个吉莱诺，征服所有种族和所有神！然后大战神将归来，坐在青铜王座上统治一切。战争将以胜利结束，胜利将永远持续！

english: So leaders of tribes stop battle. And on plain of mud all tribes build temple to Big High War God and offer sacrifices.
translation: 所以部落首领停止了战斗。在泥泞平原上，所有部落为大战神建造了神庙，献上祭品。

translation: 为我们的国家，我们自豪！

translation: 在黑暗的时代里，

english: Although goblins are still warlike, it is probable that in earlier ages they were more organised than they are now, especially if they were under the direct command of one or more gods.
translation: 尽管哥布林仍然好战，但在更早的时代，他们可能比现在更有组织性，尤其是在一位或多位神的直接指挥下。

english: This is corroborated by finds unearthed at various archaeological sites, including the large excavation east of Varrock.
translation: 这一点得到了各个考古遗址出土文物的佐证，包括维洛克城东部的大型发掘现场。

english: Armour and weapons have been found, obviously made to fit goblins but far more well-made than their current equipment.
translation: 出土的盔甲和武器显然是按哥布林的体型制作的，但远比他们现在的装备精良得多。

english: The separate identities of the tribes have long since dissolved and no goblins remember the symbols, although their generals may still recognise the ancient tribal names.
translation: 各部落的独立身份早已消解，没有哥布林记得那些符号，尽管他们的将军可能仍认得古老的部落名称。

english: In the following pages I present a list of the tribes and their symbols.
translation: 在接下来的几页中，我将列出各部落及其符号的清单。

english: We are forsaken. Trapped in a nightmare beyond our understanding. The lucky ones were killed as the rift was opened. The rest of us must now suffer the horrors of damnation. My duty to the Justiciar was to document her glorious work, but now I document our likely demise. There are five of us in total. Four of light, and one of darkness. We encountered him soon after arriving: A cursed follower of the Empty Lord. We should have killed him in Saradomin's name, but he bore no love for his former Lord. Enduring was his only goal. I don't know what's worse: That he was a servant of the Ruinous Powers, or that he abandoned his god as soon as his faith was tested. Sadly, it seems now is not the time for conflict. He knows of this place, and that knowledge can help us.
translation: 我们被遗弃了。困在一个超出我们理解的梦魇之中。幸运的人在裂隙打开时就被杀了。我们其余的人现在必须承受诅咒的恐怖。我对审判官的职责是记录她辉煌的工作，但现在我记录的是我们可能的灭亡。我们总共有五人。四人是光，一人是黑暗。我们到达后不久就遇到了他：一个被诅咒的虚空之主的追随者。我们本应以萨拉多明之名杀了他，但他对昔日的主并无爱意。忍耐是他唯一的目标。我不知道哪个更糟：他是毁灭之力的仆从，还是他在信仰受到考验时立刻抛弃了他的神。可悲的是，现在看来不是冲突的时候。他了解这个地方，这些知识能帮助我们。

english: Our undesired companion has shared what he knows of this domain. He calls it the Abyss. A realm that sits between all other realms. He claims it's used for teleportation, including by our own people, but he must be lying. I told him no follower of Saradomin would ever use a place like this. He responded with a ludicrous claim. He referred to the Abyss as an empty void, calling the horrors around us invaders. According to him, even the ground we stand on is not of this realm, and that everything we see is a recent addition to what was once an empty nothingness. I asked him what he meant, but he gave no answers. He instead claimed further research was needed.
translation: 我们不想要的同伴分享了他对这个领域的了解。他称之为深渊。一个位于所有其他领域之间的领域。他声称它用于传送，包括我们自己的人也在用，但他一定在撒谎。我告诉他，没有一个萨拉多明的追随者会使用这样的地方。他回应了一个荒谬的说法。他把深渊称为虚空，称我们周围的恐怖之物为入侵者。据他说，连我们脚下的地面都不属于这个领域，我们所看到的一切都是曾经空无一物的虚空中的新添之物。我问他是什么意思，但他没有回答。反而声称需要进一步研究。

english: Five has become four. Ermis was taken as we slept, his screams waking us as he was dragged into darkness. We found him hours later, half devoured by a beast we'd not yet encountered. The beast might have claimed more lives as well, were it not for our Zarosian companion. He fought it off like he'd fought hundreds of these things before, killing it with ease. Afterwards, he claimed it was a chthonian. We'd heard of these horrors before, for they were once servants of the Empty Lord, but this was the first time any of us had set eyes on one. While the rest of us mourned Ermis, our companion vanished. He was gone for what must have been many hours, and when he finally returned, he did so with a look of horror. He claimed the confrontation with the beast had brought about a realisation. He knew why the Abyss had changed. Why it looked the way it did. There's a reason why this place feels alive, and that's because it is. We thought we were facing horrors of darkness in this place, but the truth is far worse: We're inside one!
translation: 五人变成了四人。埃米斯在我们睡觉时被抓走了，他的尖叫声把我们惊醒，他被拖入了黑暗。几小时后我们找到了他，被一只我们从未见过的野兽吃掉了一半。要不是我们那位扎罗西亚同伴，那只野兽可能会夺走更多生命。他像以前杀过几百个这种东西一样把它打退了，轻松地杀死了它。之后，他声称那是克托尼安。我们以前听说过这些恐怖之物，因为它们曾是虚空之主的仆从，但这是我们任何人第一次亲眼见到。在我们哀悼埃米斯的时候，我们的同伴消失了。他离开了想必有好几个小时，当他终于回来时，脸上带着恐惧的表情。他声称与野兽的对抗让他有了一个领悟。他知道深渊为什么变了。为什么它看起来是这样。这个地方让人感觉有生命是有原因的，因为它确实有生命。我们以为我们在这个地方面对的是黑暗的恐怖，但真相更糟：我们在一个恐怖之物的体内！

english: Whilst we have left behind a significant number of our tools in Hallowvale, the abnormal stone of this island is proving very versatile in the creation of golems. The process is rather simple, in fact.
translation: 虽然我们在哈洛维尔留下了大量工具，但这座岛上奇特的石头在制造魔像方面非常实用。事实上，过程相当简单。

english: First, stack a collection of sunstone to an appropriate height. Its natural properties seem to cause small-scale fusions in the stone, allowing chunks to act as one coherent block. We have found four reasonable chunks to be of an appropriate size (our attempts at creating a dwarven scaled golem were ill advised).
translation: 首先，将一堆日光石堆叠到合适的高度。它的天然特性似乎能使石头发生小规模融合，让碎块作为一个整体块运作。我们发现四块合适的碎块大小正合适（我们尝试制造矮人尺寸魔像的计划是不明智的）。

english: Once your stone is ready, you may begin crafting. In order to prevent any unexpected collapses, work from the head downward.
translation: 石头准备好后，你就可以开始制作了。为了防止任何意外的坍塌，从头向下制作。

english: Now, you may be asking how in the world this statue will become a golem. We have discerned that the stone can store significant energy from exposure to sunlight. By carving a chunk into a multi-faceted core, we are able to focus the light into the golem, allowing it to be sufficiently energised.
translation: 现在，你可能会问这雕像到底怎么变成魔像。我们发现这种石头可以通过暴露在阳光下储存大量能量。通过将一块石头雕刻成多面核心，我们能够将光聚焦到魔像中，使其获得足够的能量。

english: As of yet we are unsure on how to adequately control or command them, so they are wandering about rather aimlessly. Still, we are one step closer to a new bloodless soldier, and we cannot take that for granted.
translation: 到目前为止，我们还不确定如何充分控制或指挥它们，所以它们只是漫无目的地游荡。不过，我们离一个不流血的士兵又近了一步，我们不能把这视为理所当然。

english: 12th Bennath
translation: 本纳斯12日

english: I had such a busy day dealing out death today, not easy being grim. Realised that Albert is such a good servant. He seems to have the house in full working order. I shall have to congratulate him tomorrow. Spent some well deserved time sharpening my scythe - Albert kindly reminded me to put the sharpener back in the cabinet. Such a good chap!
translation: 今天我忙着分发死亡，真是忙碌的一天，当死神可不容易。我意识到阿尔伯特是个好仆从。他似乎把房子打理得井井有条。明天我得好好夸奖他。我花了一些应得的时间磨我的镰刀——阿尔伯特好心提醒我把磨刀石放回柜子里。真是个好人！

english: Went to the Wilderness today, plenty of foolish people surrending their lives to me without thought! My back is killing me from all the standing around waiting. Must get that seen to. Got my robes stained from one victim. Simply ruined! I decided to throw them in the fireplace - will light the fire soon. Oh, and I must remember to phone mother.
translation: 今天去了荒野，很多愚蠢的人毫不犹豫地把生命献给了我！我站了一整天等着，背疼得要命。得去看看。一个受害者的血弄脏了我的长袍。简直毁了！我决定把它们扔进壁炉——很快就会点火。哦，我还得记得给母亲打电话。

english: A tragic day. Albert and I were in the garden looking at the state of the spider nest. I decided to pat my trusty servant on the back in thanks for all his hard work. Sadly my touch of death killed him instantly. Feel quite guilty.
translation: 悲惨的一天。我和阿尔伯特在花园里看蜘蛛巢的状况。我决定拍拍我忠实的仆从的背，感谢他所有的辛勤工作。不幸的是，我的死亡之触瞬间杀死了他。感到非常内疚。

english: House is getting into quite a state without Albert, things strewn all over the place. Almost trod on the eye of my mentor, euw. I put the eye back on the shelf so he can watch over me and make sure I stay true my mentor's teachings. Went into Varrock to buy some new robes, people kept running away in fear, and so it was difficult to find a sale.
translation: 没有阿尔伯特，房子变得一团糟，东西到处乱扔。差点踩到我导师的眼睛，恶心。我把眼睛放回架子上，这样他就能照看我，确保我忠于导师的教诲。去了维洛克城买新长袍，人们总是惊恐地跑开，所以很难找到卖东西的地方。

english: 21st Bennath
translation: 本纳斯21日

english: Decided to spend a bit of my time tidying today - really isn't an easy job! In my activities I found my old voice of doom potion on the bookcase - perfect for giving people a good scare! Oh I do love my job.
translation: 今天决定花点时间整理一下——真不是件容易的事！在整理中，我在书架上找到了我的旧'厄运之声'药水——非常适合吓唬人！哦，我太爱我的工作了。

english: 22nd Bennath
translation: 本纳斯22日

english: Ordered a new servant today from the agency, got a 10% discount for getting past the 1000th servant mark. Woo hoo! The agency sent me his last will and testament. Shall have to sit on that for a while.
translation: 今天从代理处订了个新仆从，过了第1000个仆从的关口还给了10%的折扣。哇哦！代理处把他的遗嘱寄给我了。看来得先放一阵子了。

english: 23rd Bennath
translation: 本纳斯23日

english: Aquired some bones today, my dog Growler shall appreciate them as a treat next time he behaves. The problem is there aren't many barriers he can't devour so I decided to lock the bones up in a chest.
translation: 今天弄到了一些骨头，我的狗咆哮者下次表现好的时候会喜欢这个奖励的。问题是没什么障碍是它啃不动的，所以我决定把骨头锁在宝箱里。

english: My plan to make undead fish is going quite well. I managed to obtain a resurrection hourglass today so have added that to the fish tank to finish off the process. It's so difficult to have pets when anything you touch does horrifically. I remember having a rabbit once that exploded when I fed it a carrot.
translation: 我制造亡灵鱼的计划进展顺利。今天搞到了一个复活沙漏，已经加到鱼缸里来完成整个过程。养宠物太难了，碰什么什么就出可怕的事。我记得有次养了只兔子，喂它胡萝卜的时候它爆炸了。

english: Got back home today find Growler has rune around the house creating havok. He even ate the postman. I scolded him, so hopefully he won't do it again soon. All my things are in such a mess. I'm surely going to have to find someone to tidy things up before my new servant arrives. Don't want to seem totally incapable of looking after myself.
translation: 今天回到家发现咆哮者在屋里到处乱跑搞破坏。它甚至把邮差给吃了。我训了它一顿，希望它短期内不会再犯。我所有的东西都乱成一团。在新仆从到来之前，我肯定得找个人来收拾一下。不想显得完全不会照顾自己。

english: Work on the Archive is to be abandoned. We must hope that the progress already made will be enough. There is a higher priority now and it will require every resource we have.
translation: 档案馆的工作要放弃了。我们只能希望已经取得的进展足够。现在有更优先的事项，需要动用我们所有的资源。
