english: This book is your guide to the vibrant city of Ardougne. Ardougne is known as an exciting modern city located on the sun drenched southern coast of Kandarin.
translation: 这本书是你在充满活力的阿多尼城的指南。阿多尼城是一座令人兴奋的现代化城市，位于坎达林王国阳光明媚的南海岸。

english: Come sample the delights of the Ardougne market - the biggest in the known world! From spices to silk, there is something here for everybody! Other popular shopping destinations in the area include the Armoury and the ever popular Adventurers' supply store.
translation: 来体验阿多尼城市场的乐趣吧——这是已知世界最大的市场！从香料到丝绸，这里应有尽有！该地区其他受欢迎的购物地点包括军械库和广受欢迎的冒险者补给店。

english: If you're looking for entertainment in Ardougne, why not pay a visit to Ardougne City Zoo? Or relax with a drink in the ever popular Flying Horse Inn? And for the adventurous, there are always rats to be slaughtered in Ardougnes expansive and vermin-ridden sewers. There is truly something for everybody here!
translation: 如果你想在阿多尼城找乐子，何不去阿多尼城动物园看看？或者在广受欢迎的飞马旅馆喝一杯放松一下？对于喜欢冒险的人来说，阿多尼城广阔且老鼠成灾的下水道里总有老鼠可以杀。这里真的适合每个人！

english: Ardougne is renowned as an important city of historical interest. One historic building is the magnificent Handelmort Mansion, currently owned by Lord Francis Kurt Handelmort. Also of historical interest is Ardougne Castle in the East side of the city, recently opened to the public. And of course, the Holy Order of Paladins still wander the streets of Ardougne, and are often of interest to tourists.
translation: 阿多尼城以重要的历史名城而闻名。一座历史建筑是宏伟的汉德尔莫特庄园，目前由弗朗西斯·库尔特·汉德尔莫特勋爵所有。同样具有历史意义的是城市东侧的阿多尼城堡，最近向公众开放。当然，神圣的圣骑士团仍然在阿多尼城的街道上游荡，常常引起游客的兴趣。

english: The area surrounding Ardougne is also of great interest to the cultural tourist.
translation: 阿多尼城周边的地区对文化游客来说也极具吸引力。

english: If you want to go further afield, why not have a look at the ominous Pillars Of Zanash, the mysterious marble pillars located just West of the city? Or perhaps the town of Brimhaven, on the exotic island of Karamja? It's only a short boat trip, with regular transport leaving from Ardougne Harbour at all times of the day, all year round.
translation: 如果你想走得更远，何不去看看城市西边那些神秘的大理石柱——扎纳什之柱？或者去卡拉姆詹岛上的异国情调小镇布尔哈文镇？只需乘一小段船，阿多尼港全年全天都有定期班次。

translation: 我们需要你种一些[plant(s)]。你检查过它们的健康状况后我会给你奖励。

english: Right, you already had <Num0> charges, and I don't give discounts. That means 6 artefacts gives you [y] charges. Now be on your way.
translation: 好吧，你已经有<Num0>次充能了，我不给折扣。也就是说6件文物给你[y]次充能。现在上路吧。

english: It was not long before that small outpost became a meeting place for those hunting in the savanah: sharing knowledge, seeking shelter, and trading supplies. Injured hunters found themselves surrounded by those that knew how to care for their injuries, while older hunters told tales of great beasts that have yet to be verified.
translation: 没过多久，那个小前哨就成了草原猎人们的聚集地：分享知识、寻求庇护、交易补给。受伤的猎人发现自己被懂得照料伤势的人包围，而年长的猎人则讲述着尚未被证实的神秘巨兽的故事。

english: Some visited to investigate the rumours of a rumbling beneath the outpost, excited to dive into the caverns with swords in hand. Most were stopped at the door, as the hunters had established balance between themselves and the creatures of the caverns. Some chose to sneak in regardless, and have not been seen since.
translation: 有些人前来调查前哨下方隆隆声的传闻，兴奋地手持剑跃入洞穴。大多数人在门口被拦住了，因为猎人们已经与洞穴中的生物建立了平衡。有些人还是选择偷偷溜进去，从此再也没人见过他们。

english: Surely pretty is an understatement kind lady. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 漂亮这个词太轻描淡写了，好心的女士。美丽、惊艳或者改变人生才更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？以葬在瀑布下的精灵国王命名的。

english: Hello, friend, you fit in much better now that you're correctly attired. Before you stuck out like a sore thumb! Keep your eyes peeled though; I've heard there are thieves amongst us!
translation: 你好，朋友，你穿对了衣服现在看起来顺眼多了。之前你简直太显眼了！不过要睁大眼睛，我听说我们中间有小偷！

english: The ogre on the boat is talking far too loudly for either of the occupants to hear you.
translation: 船上的食人魔说话声音太大，两位乘客都听不到你说话。

english: You need to be on a boat to take part in a Barracuda Trial.
translation: 你需要在一艘船上才能参加梭鱼试炼。

english: Es lemanto meso pro eis prit ta Cinqo mond.
translation: 我为你学习是为了五界之约。

english: Mi lovos te lemanto Daconia arpos
translation: 我爱你，学习者达科尼亚的竖琴

english: Hazelmere has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔给了你另一张线索卷轴！

english: Hazelmere has given you a casket!
translation: 黑兹尔米尔给了你一个宝箱！

english: Age of your kitten: <Num0> hour(s) [y] minutes. Approximate time until fully adult: [z] hour(s) [a] minutes, assuming you look after it. (Hours and minutes differ based on kitten's current growth.)
translation: 你的小猫年龄：<Num0>小时[y]分钟。预计完全成年时间：[z]小时[a]分钟，前提是你好好照顾它。（小时和分钟根据小猫当前成长阶段而有所不同。）

english: I've been spending more time in the woods lately. Well... I always spent a lot of time in the woods, let's be honest. Our place is there. The little cliff looking over the lake. The one with the silverkin bushes that we both liked. That shared love for something so benign. Who'd have guessed what it would lead to? We were always an odd pair.
translation: 我最近在树林里待的时间更多了。好吧……说实话我一直都在树林里待很多时间。我们的地方就在那里。那个俯瞰湖泊的小悬崖。那个有我们都喜欢的银叶灌木的地方。对如此平凡之物的共同喜爱。谁能想到那会带来什么？我们一直是一对奇怪的组合。

english: I guess I go there to remember, but also to forget. To pretend things are still as they once were. It's the only escape I have. It's amazing how similar it still looks to that first night. With how much everything else has changed, the familiarity of that place is my solace. In some ways though, it's also my sorrow.
translation: 我想我去那里是为了回忆，也是为了遗忘。假装一切还和从前一样。那是我唯一的逃避。令人惊讶的是那里看起来和第一晚多么相似。在其他一切都变了的情况下，那个地方的熟悉感是我的慰藉。但在某些方面，它也是我的悲伤。

english: Seren wants us to leave. Another came to our world, one like her. He told her of a great land where we could all live in harmony. She wants to go, and she wants us to come as well.
translation: 塞伦要我们离开。另一个像她一样的存在来到了我们的世界。他告诉她有一片伟大的土地，我们都能在那里和谐共处。她想走，她也想让我们一起去。

english: She can't convince everyone on her own. She needs the support of the clan leaders, which means she needs me. In truth, that's why I've been spending more time in the woods. It shames me, but I'm avoiding her. Deep down I worry that she might be right, that maybe our time here is done. If I avoid the conversation, I can avoid what I fear to be the truth.
translation: 她一个人说服不了所有人。她需要部族首领的支持，这意味着她需要我。说实话，这就是为什么我最近在树林里待了更多时间。这让我羞愧，但我在躲着她。内心深处我担心她可能是对的，也许我们在这里的时光已经结束了。如果我避开谈话，我就能避开我害怕的真相。

english: It was only a matter of time before she found me. I would never be able to avoid her forever. I was back at our spot again, lying and looking up at the stars, like we always used to. That was when I heard her call out to me. Even now I remember what she said.... mostly. I may paraphrase a touch.
translation: 她找到我只是时间问题。我不可能永远躲着她。我又回到了我们的老地方，躺着仰望星空，就像我们以前常做的那样。就在那时我听到她呼唤我。即使现在我还记得她说了什么……大部分吧。我可能会稍微转述一下。

english: 'I can see why you come here so much, it's beautiful,' she said. I turned to her. 'It's not the beauty I'm here for,' I replied. 'No,' she said, 'I wish I could have met him.'
translation: '我明白你为什么总来这里了，这里很美，'她说。我转向她。'我来这里不是为了美景，'我回答。'不，'她说，'我真希望能见过他。'

english: 'I can see why you come here so much, it's beautiful,' she said. I turned to her.
translation: '我明白你为什么总来这里了，这里很美，'她说。我转向她。

english: 'It's not the beauty I'm here for,' I replied.
translation: '我来这里不是为了美景，'我回答。

english: 'No,' she said, 'I wish I could have met him.'
translation: '不，'她说，'我真希望能见过他。'

english: She knew, of course she knew. I was the lady of Clan Iorwerth, I wasn't allowed to have secrets. 'So why do you want to take me away from him?' I asked her. 'Aenwyn, my child, I would never separate the two of you,' she insisted. 'Until the end of eternity, he will always walk by your side. But you must know, there's no future for us on this world.'
translation: 她知道了，她当然知道。我是伊奥维斯氏族的夫人，我不允许有秘密。'那你为什么要把我从他身边带走？'我问她。'艾恩温，我的孩子，我永远不会把你们分开，'她坚持道。'直到永恒尽头，他都会一直走在你身边。但你必须知道，这个世界没有我们的未来。'

english: She knew, of course she knew. I was the lady of Clan Iorwerth, I wasn't allowed to have secrets.
translation: 她知道了，她当然知道。我是伊奥维斯氏族的夫人，我不允许有秘密。

english: 'So why do you want to take me away from him?' I asked her.
translation: '那你为什么要把我从他身边带走？'我问她。

english: 'Aenwyn, my child, I would never separate the two of you,' she insisted. 'Until the end of eternity, he will always walk by your side. But you must know, there's no future for us on this world.'
translation: '艾恩温，我的孩子，我永远不会把你们分开，'她坚持道。'直到永恒尽头，他都会一直走在你身边。但你必须知道，这个世界没有我们的未来。'

english: 'I'm not looking to the future,' I replied, my gaze held on hers. I stood up and walked past her, into the woods, leaving her alone on the cliff.
translation: '我不在乎未来，'我回答，目光紧锁着她。我站起身，从她身边走过，走进树林，把她独自留在悬崖上。

english: For a while after that, I avoided our spot, fearing she might find me there again. I walked through other parts of the wood, contemplating.
translation: 那之后的一段时间，我避开了我们的老地方，怕她会在那里再找到我。我走过树林的其他地方，沉思着。

english: I was a clan leader, which meant I had a responsibility to those who I led. Apart from the Cywir, Seren had managed to convince all the other clan leaders to join her in the new world.
translation: 我是氏族领袖，这意味着我对所领导的人负有责任。除了赛威尔，塞伦已经说服了所有其他氏族领袖加入她前往新世界。

english: I knew my people were starting to doubt in my leadership. After all, what kind of leader spends her days hiding in woods? They were right to be concerned. I was never meant to lead. In all honesty, I was a bit naff at it.
translation: 我知道我的人民开始怀疑我的领导能力。毕竟，什么样的领袖会整天躲在树林里？他们的担忧是对的。我本就不该领导。说实话，我在这方面有点糟糕。

english: Soon enough, our paths crossed again. I was on one of my usual walks when I found her, by the crystal shrines near the old temple.
translation: 没过多久，我们又相遇了。我在一次平常的散步中发现了她，在旧神庙附近的水晶祭坛旁。

english: 'Following me?' I asked. 'You're not the only one who likes a walk from time to time,' she replied. 'Even a goddess needs room to reminisce.' 'Reminisce?' I enquired. She turned to me. 'You're not the only one to know loss, Aenwyn. Before I came here, I had a family. A mother and a brother.'
translation: '在跟踪我？'我问。'你不是唯一一个喜欢偶尔散步的人，'她回答。'即使是女神也需要空间来追忆。''追忆？'我问道。她转向我。'你不是唯一一个懂得失去的人，艾恩温。在我来这里之前，我有一个家庭。一位母亲和一个兄弟。'

english: 'Following me?' I asked. 'You're not the only one who likes a walk from time to time,' she replied. 'Even a goddess needs room to reminisce.'
translation: '在跟踪我？'我问。'你不是唯一一个喜欢偶尔散步的人，'她回答。'即使是女神也需要空间来追忆。'

english: 'Reminisce?' I enquired. She turned to me.
translation: '追忆？'我问道。她转向我。

english: 'You're not the only one to know loss, Aenwyn. Before I came here, I had a family. A mother and a brother.'
translation: '你不是唯一一个懂得失去的人，艾恩温。在我来这里之前，我有一个家庭。一位母亲和一个兄弟。'

english: I must admit I was taken aback. Seren had always seemed so unknowable, so much more than us. I'd never considered that we might share something so mundane, so mortal, as the concept of family. 'I confess, you'd struggle to find a more dysfunctional family,' she continued, laughing as she did. 'But we were family, all the same.'
translation: 我必须承认我吃了一惊。塞伦一直显得那么高深莫测，远超我们。我从没想过我们可能共享如此平凡、如此凡俗的东西，比如家庭的概念。'我承认，你很难找到比我们更不正常的家庭了，'她继续说，边说边笑。'但我们终究是一家人。'

english: I must admit I was taken aback. Seren had always seemed so unknowable, so much more than us. I'd never considered that we might share something so mundane, so mortal, as the concept of family.
translation: 我必须承认我吃了一惊。塞伦一直显得那么高深莫测，远超我们。我从没想过我们可能共享如此平凡、如此凡俗的东西，比如家庭的概念。

english: 'I confess, you'd struggle to find a more dysfunctional family,' she continued, laughing as she did. 'But we were family, all the same.'
translation: '我承认，你很难找到比我们更不正常的家庭了，'她继续说，边说边笑。'但我们终究是一家人。'

english: 'What happened to them?' I asked. 'Oh, they're still out there, somewhere,' she replied. I was confused, and she knew it. 'You're wondering why I left?' she asked me. 'I didn't. Not to begin with. Our mother was immensely powerful, but she was always ill. Unable to control her own abilities. We looked after her for so long, but in the end, my brother had enough. He left us,' she said.
translation: '他们怎么了？'我问。'哦，他们还在外面，某个地方，'她回答。我很困惑，她看出来了。'你在想我为什么离开？'她问我。'我没有。至少一开始没有。我们的母亲极其强大，但她总是生病。无法控制自己的能力。我们照顾了她很久，但最终，我兄弟受够了。他离开了我们，'她说。

english: 'What happened to them?' I asked.
translation: '他们怎么了？'我问。

english: 'Oh, they're still out there, somewhere,' she replied. I was confused, and she knew it. 'You're wondering why I left?' she asked me. 'I didn't. Not to begin with. Our mother was immensely powerful, but she was always ill. Unable to control her own abilities. We looked after her for so long, but in the end, my brother had enough. He left us,' she said.
translation: '哦，他们还在外面，某个地方，'她回答。我很困惑，她看出来了。'你在想我为什么离开？'她问我。'我没有。至少一开始没有。我们的母亲极其强大，但她总是生病。无法控制自己的能力。我们照顾了她很久，但最终，我兄弟受够了。他离开了我们，'她说。

english: 'I remember feeling so angry. How dare he! How dare he leave us! For so long, I didn't understand,' she continued. 'But eventually you left as well,' I interjected. 'Yes. I hated doing it. I hated leaving her. But I knew it was for her own good,' she responded.
translation: '我记得当时非常愤怒。他怎么能！他怎么能离开我们！很长一段时间，我都不理解，'她继续说。'但最终你也离开了，'我插话道。'是的。我讨厌那样做。我讨厌离开她。但我知道那是为她好，'她回答。

english: 'I remember feeling so angry. How dare he! How dare he leave us! For so long, I didn't understand,' she continued.
translation: '我记得当时非常愤怒。他怎么能！他怎么能离开我们！很长一段时间，我都不理解，'她继续说。

english: 'But eventually you left as well,' I interjected.
translation: '但最终你也离开了，'我插话道。

english: 'Yes. I hated doing it. I hated leaving her. But I knew it was for her own good,' she responded.
translation: '是的。我讨厌那样做。我讨厌离开她。但我知道那是为她好，'她回答。

english: I interrupted her again. 'I know why you're telling me this. You're hoping it will convince me to leave. You think if I find some familiarity with your story, that I'll be able to move on. But I can't! I can't move on!'
translation: 我再次打断她。'我知道你为什么告诉我这些。你希望这能说服我离开。你以为如果我在你的故事中找到一些共鸣，我就能继续前行。但我不能！我不能继续前行！'

english: She tried to interrupt, 'Aenwyn, I...' But I continued. 'Look, you're never going to persuade me. I'm sorry. I wish you could.'
translation: 她试图打断，'艾恩温，我……'但我继续说。'听着，你永远无法说服我。对不起。我希望你能。'

english: I paused, and looked deep into her ancient, unfathomable eyes. For a moment, I thought I saw sadness staring back. I stopped a moment and composed myself. 'But that doesn't mean I'll stop you going.'
translation: 我停顿了一下，深深凝视着她古老而深不可测的眼睛。有那么一刻，我以为看到了悲伤在回望着我。我停了一会儿，整理了一下情绪。'但这并不意味着我会阻止你离开。'

english: She was clearly confused by this. 'What do you mean?' she asked. 'I won't come with you, but I won't let my people suffer due to my own failings,' I replied. 'Take them with you, give them the future that I can't.' 'But if you stay...' she said. 'I know what will happen if I stay,' I responded. 'Until the end of eternity, he will always walk by my side.'
translation: 她显然对此感到困惑。'你什么意思？'她问。'我不会跟你走，但我不会让我的人民因我自己的失败而受苦，'我回答。'带他们走吧，给他们我无法给予的未来。''但如果你留下……'她说。'我知道如果我留下会发生什么，'我回答。'直到永恒尽头，他都会一直走在我身边。'

english: She was clearly confused by this. 'What do you mean?' she asked.
translation: 她显然对此感到困惑。'你什么意思？'她问。

english: 'I won't come with you, but I won't let my people suffer due to my own failings,' I replied. 'Take them with you, give them the future that I can't.'
translation: '我不会跟你走，但我不会让我的人民因我自己的失败而受苦，'我回答。'带他们走吧，给他们我无法给予的未来。'

english: 'But if you stay...' she said. 'I know what will happen if I stay,' I responded. 'Until the end of eternity, he will always walk by my side.'
translation: '但如果你留下……'她说。'我知道如果我留下会发生什么，'我回答。'直到永恒尽头，他都会一直走在我身边。'

english: She paused, and then nodded in understanding. 'I will make the preparations.' She started to walk away. But as she did, she stopped and turned to me. 'You're doing the right thing for them. You're a good leader Aenwyn, I hope you know that.' Before I could respond, she disappeared into the trees.
translation: 她停顿了一下，然后点头表示理解。'我会做准备的。'她开始走开。但走着走着，她停下来转向我。'你为他们做了正确的事。你是个好领袖，艾恩温，我希望你知道这一点。'在我能回应之前，她消失在树林中。

english: I never spoke to Seren again. We'd said everything we needed to. They left a few days later. On to a new life, in a better world. Saying goodbye was hard, maybe the hardest thing I'd ever done. I'd always wanted more peace and quiet. I guess that was the cost.
translation: 我再也没有和塞伦说过话。我们该说的都说了。他们几天后离开了。前往新生活，一个更美好的世界。说再见很难，也许是我做过最难的事。我一直想要更多的宁静。我想那就是代价。

english: Once they'd gone, my duty as a leader was complete. I returned to the woods, to our spot. I laid down on the ground and looked up at the stars.
translation: 他们走后，我作为领袖的职责完成了。我回到树林，回到我们的地方。我躺在地上，仰望星空。

english: You hear a disembodied voice laughing at you....Poor puny mortal. I'm going to have fun with you.
translation: 你听到一个无形的声音在嘲笑你……可怜的凡人。我会好好跟你玩玩的。

english: Clivet: You'll never find us...
translation: 克利维特：你永远找不到我们……

english: The current is flowing against the raft. It will not move.
translation: 水流正逆着木筏流动。它无法移动。

english: You find a secret passageway.
translation: 你发现了一条秘密通道。

english: This chest is locked shut.
translation: 这个宝箱被锁住了。

english: The cultists let out a mighty cheer
translation: 邪教徒们发出了响亮的欢呼声

english: In years gone by, the land of Morytania went by another name, that of the Hallowed Land.
translation: 在过去的岁月里，莫利塔尼亚这片土地曾以另一个名字闻名，那就是圣土。

english: Much of that age has now disappeared into the mists of time. And as distant and forbidding as that time appears to be, sometimes like that dread land Morytania itself, we need to shoulder our heavy armour and trudge wearily onwards. To understand the past gives us some glimmer of hope of understanding our time here now and perhaps a hopeful glance at a future.
translation: 那个时代的大部分已消失在时间的迷雾中。正如那段遥远而令人畏惧的时光，有时就像那片可怕的莫利塔尼亚土地本身，我们需要扛起沉重的盔甲，疲惫地继续前行。理解过去，能让我们对现在的生活有一丝理解的希望，也许还能对未来抱有一丝期待。

english: The strange structure of the land of Morytania is due, most likely, in no small part to the many wars that have been fought through the lands of Gielinor. But even here, there is something quite strange about the terrain. Swampy and rotten, the foul smell of death and desolation fills the air. Where does this pungent aroma come from?
translation: 莫利塔尼亚这片土地的奇特结构，很可能在很大程度上归因于吉列诺尔大陆上发生的多次战争。但即使在这里，地形也有些奇怪。沼泽遍布，腐烂不堪，死亡与荒芜的恶臭弥漫在空气中。这刺鼻的气味从何而来？

english: It is said that before the dark Lord Drakan arrived in Morytania, a very different land existed. A green land, pleasant and bounteous. Sufficient to please many hundreds of farmers, and to supply large towns, villages and cities with food. There is little information to support this idea, but there are hints that this land has not always been the darkened and dreadful place it now appears to be.
translation: 据说在黑暗领主德拉肯抵达莫利塔尼亚之前，这里曾是一片截然不同的土地。一片翠绿、宜人且富饶的土地。足以供养数百名农民，并为大型城镇、村庄和城市提供食物。虽然支持这一说法的信息很少，但有迹象表明，这片土地并非一直都是现在这般黑暗可怕的模样。

english: There is some speculation about a time before our recorded history when there appeared to be some disputes between the gods. In this time, it is said, that Saradomin and Zamorak brought forces through into the world to fight for them and claim large areas of land. Where they brought these forces from and how is still a mystery. But, we can hardly deny that many weird and un-natural creatures do exist in this land, things which even the most advanced of scholars do not yet comprehend. Many of these creatures still infest Morytania and their place of origin is still not properly located.
translation: 有人推测，在有记载的历史之前，诸神之间似乎发生过一些争端。据说在那个时代，萨拉多明和扎莫拉克将势力带入这个世界，为他们而战，并占领大片土地。他们从何处带来这些势力，又是如何带来的，至今仍是个谜。但我们很难否认，这片土地上的确存在着许多怪异而非自然的生物，即便是最博学的学者也无法理解。其中许多生物至今仍出没于莫利塔尼亚，它们的起源地也尚未被正确定位。

english: As an example of strange creatures, let us focus on the Ghasts in Mort Myre Swamp. Which bizarre act of nature caused these freakish creatures to exist? It seems that whoever dies in that diseased and disgusting place is forever doomed to it, ever hungry and searching for victims to feed on. Blessed it is then that somehow, brave new adventurers are able to reveal these foul creatures and destroy them (with the great aid of Guthix, who adores balance amongst all things), and at the same time release the tortured soul from its earthbound torment.
translation: 以奇怪的生物为例，让我们来看看莫尔迈尔沼泽中的加斯特。是哪种怪异的自然行为导致了这些畸形的生物存在？似乎无论谁死在那片病态而令人厌恶的地方，都将永远被困在那里，永远饥饿，寻找猎物为食。幸运的是，不知何故，勇敢的新冒险者能够揭露这些邪恶的生物并消灭它们（在古斯的大力帮助下，他崇尚万物之间的平衡），同时将受折磨的灵魂从尘世的痛苦中解放出来。

english: It is clear that some influence is at work in Morytania and its intent is bent towards evil. Before this dark period in history, Morytania is believed to have had a golden age of peace. It is hard to imagine that the Shade infested town of Mort'ton could have once been a busy, happy thriving bustling town. And even Canifis, once a busy market village supplying all manner of goods to the local population, instead of a cesspit of werewolf activity and a certain death trap for all but the hardiest of adventurers.
translation: 很明显，莫利塔尼亚有一股邪恶的力量在作祟。在这段黑暗的历史时期之前，莫利塔尼亚据信曾有过一个和平的黄金时代。很难想象，如今阴魂出没的莫顿镇曾经是一个繁忙、快乐、繁荣兴旺的城镇。甚至坎尼非斯村，曾经是一个为当地居民提供各种商品的繁忙集市村庄，而不是一个狼人活动的粪坑，对除最坚韧的冒险者外的所有人来说都是一个致命的陷阱。

english: Stories and yarns told by the inhabitants of Morytania, and those lucky few who make their way out of that dark land, give us some glimpses of what might have happened there. From these peoples come many bits of story and song from which we can piece together a plausible history line, that is the true aim of this tome.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚的居民，以及那些幸运地走出那片黑暗土地的少数人，所讲述的故事和传闻，让我们得以一窥那里可能发生过的事情。从这些人口中，我们获得了许多故事和歌谣的片段，从中我们可以拼凑出一条合理的历史脉络，这正是本书的真正目的。

english: Let us begin with the current overlord of Morytania, Lowerniel Vergidiyad Drakan. His reign in Morytania has been unchallenged in the history of the land, as far as we can tell. But how long has this been? What do we know of this dark lord? It is clear to many who have visited Morytania that he is a creature of darkness, a vampyre, but by which strange happenstance did he come to be here?
translation: 让我们从莫利塔尼亚现任霸主洛厄尼尔·维吉迪亚德·德拉肯开始。据我们所知，他在莫利塔尼亚的统治在这片土地的历史上从未受到过挑战。但这持续了多久？我们对这位黑暗领主了解多少？许多去过莫利塔尼亚的人都清楚，他是一个黑暗生物，一个吸血鬼，但他又是如何机缘巧合地来到这里的呢？

english: Some reports say that he came from beneath the ground of a great castle within Morytania, but from where? Some reports claim that a huge city lies beneath the castle, this does not seem plausible. Yet others say that there are countless tunnels which lead into a flaming dark inferno, which it is claimed these dark creatures come from, even more unlikely. What is interesting is that in all these great yarns, one fact remains always the same; he came into and attacked a castle which already existed.
translation: 一些报告称，他来自莫利塔尼亚境内一座巨大城堡的地下，但来自哪里？一些报告声称城堡下方有一座巨大的城市，这似乎不太可信。还有人传说有无数隧道通向一个燃烧着火焰的黑暗地狱，据说这些黑暗生物就是从那里来的，这更不可能。有趣的是，在所有这些伟大的传说中，有一个事实始终如一：他来到并攻击了一座已经存在的城堡。

english: It is the author's belief that this castle existed before Drakan entered Morytania and that some other power existed in the land before him. What this power was is not known, though stories again give us a glimpse at what might have been. One such tale is of a queen from a far away land of considerable power and revered by the peoples. It is also claimed that the peoples named the land Hallowvale after her, though there is no clear record of this.
translation: 作者相信，这座城堡在德拉肯进入莫利塔尼亚之前就已存在，并且在他之前，这片土地上还有其他势力。这股势力是什么不得而知，尽管故事再次让我们得以一窥可能的情况。其中一个传说是关于一位来自遥远国度的女王，她拥有强大的力量，受到人民的尊敬。据说人民以她的名字将这片土地命名为圣谷，尽管没有明确的记录。

english: It is interesting to consider that a time of peoples and pleasantness could have existed in the land of Morytania before this. And perhaps to consider, hope and pray that at some point those times shall be returned to this dark, plagued and unhappy land.
translation: 有趣的是，可以想象在莫利塔尼亚这片土地上，曾经存在过一个和平美好的时代。也许我们可以思考、希望并祈祷，在某个时刻，那些时光会回到这片黑暗、饱受瘟疫折磨且不幸的土地上。

english: However, let us not forget that had it not been for the Seven Priestly Warriors at Silvarea, the lands of Morytania might extend today as far as Falador, and Varrock may have been an even more sinister city than it appears today! And of those seven, perhaps the most intriguing is Ivandis Seergaze. His silvthrill rod of power with a blue serene gem was said to have been crafted by the artisans of Saradomin himself. And though there are no accurate records, it is said that its exacting and precise dimensions and shape were the just reason for its great power.
translation: 然而，我们不要忘记，如果不是希尔瓦雷亚的七位祭司战士，莫利塔尼亚的领土今天可能延伸到法拉多城，而维洛克城可能比现在看起来更加阴森！在这七位中，也许最引人入胜的是伊万迪斯·西尔盖兹。据说他那根镶嵌着蓝色宁静宝石的银振杖是由萨拉多明本人的工匠打造的。虽然没有准确的记录，但据说其精确的尺寸和形状正是其强大力量的合理原因。

english: When asked about how it was made and how it came into being, Ivandis had always simply commented, 'Of silvthrill and exact dimensions is the item constructed. After enchantments that come from the magic of man can it be placed in our lord Saradomin's holy water, where magical blessings will 'He' commit to it.'
translation: 当被问及它是如何制造和诞生的时，伊万迪斯总是简单地评论道：“此物由银振和精确的尺寸构成。经过人类魔法产生的附魔后，方可置于吾主萨拉多明的圣水中，届时‘他’将赋予其魔法祝福。”

english: It is not clear why he should hide such important details in such incoherent ramblings. Suffice to say that many artisans have tried recreating this holy relic in a bid to supply adventurous types keen on restoring balance to Morytania. But alas, this could not happen because the true dimensions of the relic are not accurately known. It is believed that this secret, along with the artefact, died with Ivandis and now lie sealed up in his tomb beneath Paterdomus, never to be seen again.
translation: 不清楚他为何要将如此重要的细节隐藏在如此语无伦次的胡言乱语中。只能说，许多工匠试图复制这件神圣的遗物，以便为热衷于恢复莫利塔尼亚平衡的冒险者提供帮助。但可惜的是，这未能实现，因为遗物的真实尺寸并不为人所知。据信，这个秘密连同文物一起随伊万迪斯逝去，如今被封存在帕特多穆斯下方的坟墓中，永不复见。

english: Another infuriatingly cryptic element which is yet to be explained is the 'balance' which Guthix is supposed to have invested in Ivandis, in the form of a potion. Once again his cryptic message does not help very much. 'Guthix's balance needs to be fed to those minions of darkness in order for the balance to be restored. And this task should be carried out only when they are held in Saradomin's power. For this to occur, one should supplement a common potion of bodily restoration with the essence of garlic and silver dust, the latter being gained through the crushing of silver.'
translation: 另一个令人恼火的隐晦元素是古斯据说以药水形式赋予伊万迪斯的“平衡”。他的隐晦信息同样没有太大帮助。“古斯的平衡需要喂给那些黑暗的爪牙，才能恢复平衡。这项任务只应在他们被萨拉多明的力量束缚时进行。为此，应该在常见的身体恢复药水中加入大蒜精华和银粉，后者通过粉碎银获得。”

english: Whatever the truth of all these details, it seems clear that Drakan is intent on staying. His authority in the region has never been challenged and perhaps arguably has grown over the centuries. Reports from the area are limited and vague so perhaps the truth is either far less, or far greater than we may currently comprehend. In any event, it is clear that some strategy should be forthcoming if Drakan's evil minions should once again try to spread into Misthalin. It is believed, perhaps in error, that Paterdomus will stand forever as a silent guardian against the power of Morytania.
translation: 无论这些细节的真相如何，德拉肯显然打算留下来。他在该地区的权威从未受到挑战，也许可以说几个世纪以来一直在增长。来自该地区的报告有限且模糊，所以也许真相要么远没有我们目前理解的那么严重，要么远比我们想象的严重。无论如何，如果德拉肯的邪恶爪牙再次试图蔓延到米斯塔林，显然应该制定一些策略。人们相信，也许是错误的，帕特多穆斯将永远作为对抗莫利塔尼亚力量的沉默守护者。

english: Perhaps one day we will see a redress of the evil that Drakan has brought to Morytania, and we will get to witness first hand the bounteous riches and wholesome living that can be had in that land once called Hallowvale.
translation: 也许有一天，我们会看到德拉肯带给莫利塔尼亚的邪恶得到纠正，我们将亲眼目睹那片曾被称为圣谷的土地上所能拥有的丰饶财富和健康生活。

english: Gather round, all ye followers of the dark arts. Read carefully the words that I hearby inscribe, as I detail the heady brew that is responsible for my greatest creation in all my time on this world.
translation: 聚集起来，所有黑暗艺术的追随者们。仔细阅读我在此写下的文字，我将详细描述那令人陶醉的药剂，它是我在这世上所有时间中最伟大的创造。

english: I am Kardia, the most wretched witch in the land; scorned by beauty, the world and its inhabitants, see what I created: The most fearsome and powerful force of darkness the like of which has never before been seen in this world, in human form...
translation: 我是卡迪亚，这片土地上最邪恶的女巫；被美貌、世界及其居民所唾弃，看看我创造了什么：世界上最可怕、最强大的黑暗力量，前所未有，以人类形态出现……

english: Iban was a Black Knight who had learned to fight under the great Daquarius, Lord of the Black Knights. Together, they had taken on the might of the White and the blood of a hundred soldiers had been wiped from the sword of Iban.
translation: 伊班是一名黑骑士，曾在伟大的黑骑士领主达夸里乌斯麾下学习战斗。他们一起对抗白骑士的力量，一百名士兵的鲜血从伊班的剑上被抹去。

english: Iban was not quite so different from those who tasted his blade: noble and educated, with a taste for the finer things available in life. But there was something that made him different: Ambition. This hunger for more went far past the realm of mere mortals, into the shadowy places of darkness and evil.
translation: 伊班与那些尝过他剑刃的人并无太大不同：高贵而有教养，对生活中美好的事物颇有品味。但有一件事让他与众不同：野心。这种对更多的渴望远远超出了凡人的领域，进入了黑暗与邪恶的阴影之地。

english: Iban's ambition was almost godlike in its insatiability, but therein lay the essence of his darkness: at its most base Iban's fundamental desire was to control the hearts and minds of his fellow men, to take them beyond the pale of mere allegiance, and corrupt them into a force for evil.
translation: 伊班的野心几乎像神一样贪得无厌，但这也正是他黑暗的本质：在最基本的层面上，伊班的基本欲望是控制同胞的心灵和思想，将他们带出单纯效忠的界限，腐化成一股邪恶的力量。

english: A whole legion of these Soulless beings, their minds demented from the sheer power of darkness that channelled through them... Zombies, void of emotions, without feelings or cares, Servants to their wicked master even unto death... But dreams were all they ever were. As a mere mortal, heroic though he was, this ambition Iban was unable to achieve.
translation: 一整支由这些无魂者组成的军团，他们的心智被贯穿其中的纯粹黑暗力量所扭曲……僵尸，没有情感，没有感觉，没有牵挂，即使到死也是他们邪恶主人的仆人……但这些只是梦想。作为一个凡人，尽管英勇，伊班却无法实现这个野心。

english: Meeting his demise in the White Knights' now famous Dawn Ascent, Iban died with the bitter taste of failure in his mouth. Little did he know that death was only just the beginning...
translation: 在白骑士著名的“黎明突袭”中陨落，伊班带着失败的苦涩滋味死去。他不知道死亡仅仅是个开始……

english: I knew of Iban's life, though of course I had not met him. Using the power of my dark practices, I vowed to resurrect this greatest of warriors. I would raise him again to fulfill the promise of his human life. To be a master...
translation: 我了解伊班的一生，虽然我当然没有见过他。利用我黑暗法术的力量，我发誓要复活这位最伟大的战士。我要让他重新崛起，实现他凡人生命的承诺。成为一个主人……

english: ...of the undead.
translation: ……亡灵的主人。

english: Taking a small doll with the likeness of Iban I smeared my effigy with the four elements that together bring existence into being. Essence of his darkness.
translation: 我拿着一个酷似伊班的小玩偶，用四种共同构成存在的元素涂抹我的雕像。他黑暗的精髓。

english: Upon his death, I claimed Iban's body from the battlefield where he lay. I had him buried in a great tomb at the bottom of the caverns. Before I did though, I took a piece of Iban's cold flesh. Clasping some in my hand, I smeared it over the doll, and chanted his name with mighty incantation.
translation: 他死后，我从战场上取回了伊班的尸体。我将他安葬在洞穴底部的一座大坟墓中。但在那之前，我取了一块伊班冰冷的血肉。我抓了一些在手中，涂抹在玩偶上，并用强大的咒语吟唱他的名字。

english: I also needed blood, the giver of life force. By now Iban's body was but a hardened vessel, the blood drained empty. However, on the lowest level of these caverns there lives a giant spider known as Kalrag. The hunger of Kalrag is great, and it is known to have fed on the warm blood of many a human. I claimed some of Kalrag's blood and wiped it onto the effigy of Iban that I had fashioned. The blood of Kalrag is now the blood of Iban.
translation: 我还需要血液，生命力的给予者。此时伊班的尸体只是一个僵硬的容器，血液已经流干。然而，在这些洞穴的最底层，住着一只名为卡尔拉格的巨型蜘蛛。卡尔拉格的饥饿感很强，众所周知它以许多人类的温血为食。我取了一些卡尔拉格的血，涂抹在我制作的伊班雕像上。卡尔拉格的血现在就是伊班的血。

english: Then came the hard part, recreating the parts of a man that cannot be seen or touched: Those intangible things the essence of life itself. On the platforms west of my home, under terrible strain, I performed the ancient ritual of Incantia. It is an undertaking so dark, and so powerful, that the life was nearly stolen from my body.
translation: 然后是困难的部分，重新创造一个人无法看见或触摸的部分：那些无形的、生命本质本身的东西。在我家西边的平台上，在巨大的压力下，我执行了古老的“咒语”仪式。这是一项如此黑暗、如此强大的事业，以至于生命几乎从我的身体中被夺走。

english: When I recovered, I saw three Demons summonned, standing in a triangle, their energy focused on the doll of Iban. These Demons were the keepers of Iban's shadow, forever bound to him...
translation: 当我恢复过来时，我看到三个恶魔被召唤出来，站成一个三角形，它们的能量集中在伊班玩偶上。这些恶魔是伊班阴影的守护者，永远与他绑定……

english: Finally, I had to make that most unique thing, the one element that separates man from all other beasts - his Conscience. A Zombie has no mind: a creature borne of bloodlust, destruction. But for all Iban's life he chose to take the path of darkness, the road to evil. Driven by this unholy ambition, his potential grew and now I could harness the residue of his existence, that remained trapped in the dark places, to the fullest.
translation: 最后，我必须制造那最独特的东西，将人与所有其他野兽区分开来的元素——他的良知。僵尸没有思想：一个由杀戮欲望和毁灭而生的生物。但伊班一生都选择走黑暗之路，通往邪恶之路。在这种邪恶野心的驱使下，他的潜力不断增长，现在我可以充分利用他残留在黑暗之地被困住的存在。

english: Locked inside an old wooden cage sat a beautiful white dove. A symbol of peace, freedom and hope, but also oblivious to the darkness of the world, like a newborn child. Taking the dove with me, I cradled the thing in my arms, stroking its soft downy feathers. I looked into the eyes of the bird, and gently placing a kiss upon its fragile head, I then strangled the bird, taking its life between my callous fingers. Truly this bird would be the conscience of Iban: innocence corrupted by evil...
translation: 在一个旧木笼子里锁着一只美丽的白鸽。它是和平、自由和希望的象征，但也像新生儿一样对世界的黑暗一无所知。我带着鸽子，把它抱在怀里，抚摸它柔软的绒毛。我看着鸟的眼睛，轻轻地在它脆弱的头上落下一吻，然后我勒死了这只鸟，用我冷酷的手指夺走了它的生命。这只鸟确实是伊班的良知：被邪恶腐蚀的纯真……

english: Taking crushed bones from the dove's body, I cast my mind's eye onto the body of Iban.
translation: 我取来鸽子尸体上碾碎的骨头，将我的心灵之眼投射到伊班的尸体上。

english: One of the servants took the remains of the dove. I let them keep it, for I had no use of it. However, I locked them in a cage on the northern platforms so that they may think on their sins...
translation: 一个仆人拿走了鸽子的遗骸。我让他们留着，因为我已经用不上了。然而，我把他们锁在北部平台上的一个笼子里，让他们反思自己的罪孽……

english: My ritual was complete, soon he would come again renewed with life. I, Kardia, had done the unimagineable: Iban was resurrected, the most powerful evil to take human form.
translation: 我的仪式完成了，很快他将带着新的生命重生。我，卡迪亚，完成了不可思议的事：伊班被复活了，成为最强大的邪恶，以人类形态存在。

english: I alone knew that the same process that I had used to resurrect the soul of Iban could be used to destroy that very same evil. But now I was tired, as I closed my eyes, I was contented by the thought of the evil to be unleashed...
translation: 只有我知道，我用来复活伊班灵魂的方法，同样可以用来毁灭那个邪恶。但现在我累了，当我闭上眼睛时，想到即将释放的邪恶，我感到了满足...

english: This world of Gielinor has always had its share of heroes throughout its history. Tales of the daring exploits of legendary figures such as Arrav, Camorra, Robert and Wally have held children spellbound for generations. But even in these modern times, the world still needs heroes. One such figure, standing protectively between civilisation and the forces of chaos, is that of Dionysius. The young Dionysius was educated in Varrock, where records tell us that he regularly attended the local Saradominist chapel. Local tradition has it that Dionysius led a band of young men to graffiti the Zamorakian temple in the south of the city, although doubtless such things have happened often in the busy city that is Varrock. It was expected that Dionysius would become a priest, but he seems to have had other plans..
translation: 吉莱诺尔这个世界自古以来从不缺少英雄。阿拉夫、卡莫拉、罗伯特和沃利等传奇人物的英勇事迹，让一代又一代的孩子们听得入迷。但即使在现代，这个世界仍然需要英雄。狄奥尼修斯就是这样一位人物，他守护在文明与混乱势力之间。年轻的狄奥尼修斯在维洛克城接受教育，据记载他经常参加当地的萨拉多明礼拜堂。当地传说狄奥尼修斯曾带领一帮年轻人在城南的扎莫拉克神庙涂鸦，尽管这种事情在繁忙的维洛克城想必屡见不鲜。人们原本期望狄奥尼修斯会成为祭司，但他似乎另有打算...

english: At the age of 15, the age at which children of that era completed their education, Dionysius is reported to have turned down a prestigious invitation to study on the holy island of Entrana. Instead he declared a wish to travel the world before settling to a permanent career.
translation: 15岁，那个时代孩子完成学业的年纪，据说狄奥尼修斯拒绝了前往神圣的恩特纳岛学习的 prestigious 邀请。相反，他宣称希望在安定下来从事固定职业之前，先游历世界。

english: The path trodden by the young Dionysius is a winding one. The older dwarves living near Keldagrim remember a youth of that name travelling through their mines at that time. They claim that he gave them great assistance in defending the mines from a rogue tribe of trolls, eventually driving the trolls out of those mines completely.
translation: 年轻的狄奥尼修斯走过的路曲折蜿蜒。住在凯尔达格林城附近的年长矮人记得，当时有一个叫这个名字的年轻人穿过他们的矿洞。他们声称他帮助他们抵御了一伙盗贼巨魔的袭击，最终将那些巨魔完全赶出了矿洞。

english: It is believed that the young Dionysius travelled amongst the mountain tribes after he left the dwarves. One tribe, now disbanded, used to tell of a strange mystical warrior named 'Deesus' - surely a corruption of 'Dionysius' - who helped defend their camp from the monsters that roam the northern lands. 'Deesus' was said to be an invincible warrior who wielded a powerful staff.
translation: 据信，年轻的狄奥尼修斯离开矮人后，曾在山间部落中游历。一个现已解散的部落曾讲述过一个名叫'迪瑟斯'的神秘战士——这肯定是'狄奥尼修斯'的讹传——他帮助他们保卫营地，抵御北方土地上游荡的怪物。据说'迪瑟斯'是一位手持强大法杖的无敌战士。

english: Dionysius subsequently travelled across the seas to the tropical island of Karamja, where some of the oldest natives tell of how he brought with him strange herbs that increased their powers in combat. He is also remembered for venturing into the deep caves underneath that island, where very few dare to tread. One Karamjan family claims that a pale-skinned 'shaman' visited their village a few generations ago and told them to build a hut over the entrance to the caves and demand money from anyone wishing to enter; this 'shaman' may have been Dionysius.
translation: 狄奥尼修斯随后漂洋过海来到热带岛屿卡拉姆詹岛，一些最年长的当地人讲述他带来了能增强战斗力的奇异草药。他还因深入该岛下方少有人敢涉足的深洞而被人铭记。一个卡拉姆詹家族声称，几代前一位苍白皮肤的'萨满'造访了他们的村庄，让他们在洞穴入口上方建一间小屋，并向任何想进入的人收费；这位'萨满'可能就是狄奥尼修斯。

english: Even in the depths of the Kharidian desert, some still remember a stranger who lived with the tent-dwelling Bedabin tribe for a while, studying the great mysterious pyramid of the desert. No-one could make him speak of what he discovered about the pyramid or the desert bandits who live near it.
translation: 即使在卡里迪安沙漠深处，仍有人记得一个陌生人曾与住在帐篷里的贝达宾部落生活过一段时间，研究沙漠中那座巨大的神秘金字塔。没有人能让他说出他对金字塔或住在附近的沙漠强盗的发现。

english: The rest of the pages seem to be missing.
translation: 其余的书页似乎不见了。

english: You won't defeat me, though you're welcome to try at the Champions' Guild.
translation: 你赢不了我的，不过欢迎你来冠军公会试试。

english: Champion of Hobgoblins
translation: 大哥布林冠军

english: Are you sure? Some charging resources may not be retrievable.
translation: 你确定吗？某些充能资源可能无法取回。

english: When a guide arrives, I will aid the mercenary by holding their wealth for their eventual return. The mercenary will repay the guide by giving them a token for items which I am holding.
translation: 当向导到来时，我会帮助雇佣兵保管他们的财物，以备他们最终归来。雇佣兵会给予向导一个代币，用来换取我保管的物品。

english: The High Priest blesses you.
translation: 大祭司为你祝福。

english: Osmumten's monument to Het is a sight to behold. I could spend days theorising about the symbolism behind every detail, but time is not on my side.
translation: 奥斯穆滕为赫特建造的纪念碑真是壮观。我可以花上几天时间推敲每个细节背后的象征意义，但时间不等人。

english: In this great chamber dedicated to his glory, Het himself is now imprisoned, guarded by an entity unlike any I have encountered: Akkha.
translation: 在这座献给他的荣耀的宏伟密室中，赫特本人如今被囚禁于此，由我从未见过的实体看守：阿卡。

english: It is said that long ago, the Devourer was cursed never to gain followers. If this curse ever existed is hard to say, but if it did, its effectiveness seems to have diminished over the years. While few in number, there are those who truly pledge themselves to the Devourer and all her destructive ways.
translation: 据说很久以前，吞噬者被诅咒永远无法获得追随者。这个诅咒是否真的存在很难说，但如果存在，它的效力似乎随着岁月流逝而减弱了。虽然人数不多，但确实有人真正效忠于吞噬者及其一切毁灭之道。

english: To be a follower of the Devourer is to be an outcast at best. It's therefore no surprise that these outcasts have often banded together in solidarity. One mostly forgotten but still notable grouping was the Children of Rebirth.
translation: 成为吞噬者的追随者，往好里说也是被排斥者。因此，这些被排斥者常常团结在一起也就不足为奇了。一个几乎被遗忘但仍值得一提的组织是'重生之子'。

english: The Children of Rebirth was a cult of former warriors dedicated to the Devourer's original form, Amascut - the goddess of rebirth. They were firm in their belief that they must achieve a perfect death, so that Amascut would allow them to be reborn in perfected form.
translation: 重生之子是一个由前战士组成的邪教，献身于吞噬者的原始形态——重生女神阿玛斯库特。他们坚信必须达成完美的死亡，这样阿玛斯库特才会允许他们以完美的形态重生。

english: When the day of their supposed rebirth came, they performed a ritual to Amascut and poisoned themselves in her name. Of course, it was long assumed that their ritual achieved nothing, but it seems that assumption wasn't quite correct.
translation: 当他们所谓的重生之日到来时，他们向阿玛斯库特举行了仪式，并以她的名义服毒自尽。当然，长期以来人们一直认为他们的仪式毫无效果，但这一假设似乎并不完全正确。

english: With Amascut long gone, the ritual instead called out to the Devourer and she arrived to find Akkha as the sole survivor among the many dead. His poison had failed, but he was on the verge of death.
translation: 由于阿玛斯库特早已离去，仪式反而召唤来了吞噬者，她到来时发现阿卡是众多死者中唯一的幸存者。他的毒药没有生效，但他也命悬一线。

english: The Devourer took Akkha and sealed him in a sarcophagus, trapping him between life and death. She then performed a ritual of her own, calling out to Het.
translation: 吞噬者带走了阿卡，将他封入石棺，困在生死之间。然后她举行了属于自己的仪式，召唤赫特。

english: While Het almost certainly realised it was a trap, he was unable to ignore the call. Like many of his fellow cultists, Akkha's life prior to the cult was as a soldier dedicated to Het, and so the god felt he had a duty to help his former acolyte.
translation: 虽然赫特几乎肯定意识到这是个陷阱，但他无法忽视召唤。和许多邪教同伴一样，阿卡在加入邪教之前是献身于赫特的战士，因此这位神明觉得自己有责任帮助他曾经的追随者。

english: Het arrived expecting to face the Devourer, but was faced with a manifestation of Akkha himself. Fueled by vengeance against the god who had abandoned him, this manifestation gave the Devourer the distraction she needed to capture Het.
translation: 赫特到来时以为要面对吞噬者，却面对了阿卡本人的化身。这个化身因被遗弃的神明而充满复仇之念，为吞噬者提供了她需要的干扰，从而捕获了赫特。

english: Now, all these years later, Akkha remains a slave to the Devourer. While still trapped in his sarcophagus, powerful manifestations of his emotions make for perfect guardians, ensuring that none will be able to free his former god.
translation: 如今，这么多年过去了，阿卡仍然是吞噬者的奴隶。虽然他仍被困在石棺中，但他情感的强大化身成为了完美的守卫，确保没有人能解救他曾经的神明。

english: The potions made here are unlike the other potions I've encountered. For starters, no herb is required in the creation process. Instead, simply water and a crushed up grub is sufficient. In addition, the properties of the potion appear to be uniquely based on the proficiency of the herbalist who created it, with it able to mimic the effects of various combat enhancing potions that the mixer is capable of producing. It's honestly quite fascinating.
translation: 这里制作的药水与我遇到的其他药水不同。首先，制作过程中不需要任何草药。相反，只需水和碾碎的幼虫就足够了。此外，药水的特性似乎完全取决于制作它的草药师的熟练程度，能够模仿混合器能够制作的各种战斗增强药水的效果。说实话，这相当令人着迷。

english: This looks like one of the pages to Kharedst's Memoirs. Veos gave it to my originally. Maybe Cabin Boy Herbert has it now.
translation: 这看起来像是卡雷德斯的回忆录的一页。维奥斯最初给我的。也许船舱侍应赫伯特现在拿着它。

english: Protector of us all,
translation: 我们所有人的守护者，

english: I now join you in the eyes of Saradomin.
translation: 我现在在萨拉多明的注视下与你同在。

english: See you in Lumbridge when you get back.
translation: 回来时仑桥镇见。

english: May his glory shine upon you like the sun.
translation: 愿他的荣耀如阳光般照耀你。

english: The currency of goodness is honour;
translation: 善良的货币是荣誉；

english: It retains its value through scarcity.
translation: 它因稀缺而保值。

english: This is Saradomin's wisdom.
translation: 这就是萨拉多明的智慧。

english: To the most venerable chamber of the Council of Elders.
translation: 致长老议会最尊贵的密室。

english: I hope that this time finds you well and that your times are bountiful. Sadly I cannot say that the same is true for everyone in this great kingdom of ours. This morning I passed children starving in the streets, unable to walk or already dead in the gutter and although I have the ability to help them, I am forbidden to do so.
translation: 希望您一切安好，时运丰盈。遗憾的是，我们这伟大的王国并非人人都如此。今天早上，我路过街上饥饿的孩子，他们无法行走或已死在沟渠中，虽然我有能力帮助他们，却被禁止这样做。

english: My most venerable Council, I beseech you to grant my request as mentioned in previous meetings at your chamber. We can grow enough food to extricate us from the famine we have experienced these last five years. However, I cannot do so without the appropriate amount of land.
translation: 最尊贵的议会，我恳请您批准我在之前会议上提出的请求。我们可以种植足够的粮食来摆脱过去五年的饥荒。然而，没有足够的土地，我无法做到这一点。

english: Only yesterday did I meet with the lords of the other houses and we agreed in principle that all houses would offer half their land so we may farm more. Within six months we can have enough food to halt this famine.
translation: 就在昨天，我会见了其他家族的领主，我们原则上同意所有家族将提供一半的土地，以便我们种植更多粮食。六个月内，我们就能有足够的粮食来阻止这场饥荒。

english: I understand the most venerable Council's concern of the political implications of such a move, however the political security of this great kingdom will not matter if it is unable to feed itself. Anarchy is only months away and as such any delay in this decision can have catastrophic results.
translation: 我理解最尊贵的议会对这一举措的政治影响的担忧，但如果这个伟大的王国无法自给自足，政治安全也无从谈起。无政府状态只有几个月之遥，因此任何拖延都可能导致灾难性的后果。

english: I know the Council is wise and I am sure you will see the decision you must make is to grant this request.
translation: 我知道议会是明智的，我相信你们会明白必须做出的决定就是批准这一请求。

english: Yours most respectfully, Lord Hosidius
translation: 此致敬意，霍西迪乌斯领主

english: Please, dear reader, blame me not for my sins...
translation: 亲爱的读者，请勿因我的罪过而责备我……

english: How did I find myself in this damp and smelly hell-hole? I fear I can no longer leave; woe to those brave enough to try.
translation: 我怎会沦落到这个潮湿恶臭的地狱？恐怕我已无法离开；那些胆敢尝试的人，愿他们安息。

english: I had received a letter, a request for my skills in hound mastery, to replace a creature keeper who had 'retired'. Or so the letter claimed.
translation: 我曾收到一封信，请求我施展驯犬技艺，接替一位“退休”的驯兽师。至少信上是这么说的。

english: Sadly the truth is that anyone could have done this, but the pay was too good to refuse.
translation: 可悲的是，这活儿谁都能干，但报酬实在丰厚得让人无法拒绝。

english: Admittedly the location was a little odd - a mountain top, far to the west?
translation: 说实话，地点有点古怪——山顶上，远在西方？

english: Unfortunately I am but a man controlled by greed, and for that I now pay dearly.
translation: 不幸的是，我只是个被贪婪驱使的男人，为此我现在付出了惨痛的代价。

english: In the beginning, there were hounds to care for, more than a dozen strays. They seemed to enjoy my company, and I enjoyed theirs.
translation: 起初，有猎犬需要照料，十几只流浪犬。它们似乎喜欢我的陪伴，我也喜欢它们的。

english: My employer, Lord Xeric, was conducting various experiments on the hounds.
translation: 我的雇主，泽里克大人，正在对这些猎犬进行各种实验。

english: Using the powers of this strange place, he sought to speed up the mutation.
translation: 他借助这个奇异之地的力量，试图加速变异。

english: I was too scared to say anything. I'd heard wild rumours of the things hidden within these dark walls.
translation: 我吓得不敢吭声。我曾听过关于这些黑暗高墙内隐藏之物的疯狂传闻。

english: Cursed employees who had failed Lord Xeric, perhaps?
translation: 那些被诅咒的雇员，或许是因为辜负了泽里克大人？

english: I dared not think it - I focused all my energies on the task Lord Xeric had assigned me, so that I would not experience his displeasure for myself!
translation: 我不敢多想——我把全部精力都投入到泽里克大人交给我的任务上，以免自己亲身体验他的不满！

english: The crystals? The beast below? Science? Something down here made Lord Xeric's experiment a success, or at least that's what he tells me. I fail to see the success of his creation.
translation: 水晶？下方的野兽？科学？这下面有什么东西让泽里克大人的实验成功了，至少他是这么告诉我的。我看不出他的造物有何成功之处。

english: It had to be her though, of course it did. She was the strongest of the pack, my personal favourite, now a twisted, scaly abomination.
translation: 但一定是她，当然是她。她是狼群中最强的，也是我的最爱，如今却变成了扭曲的、布满鳞片的憎恶怪。

english: Does she even remember me anymore? Would I want her to?
translation: 她还记得我吗？我还会希望她记得吗？

english: Certainly not after what I've done!
translation: 当然不希望，在我做了那些事之后！

english: I'm not proud of it, but it keeps me alive enough to fulfil Master's demands, keeping her - no - keeping IT alive.
translation: 我并不为此自豪，但这足以让我活着完成主人的要求，维持她——不——维持它的生命。

english: When I believed that this situation couldn't become worse, I was a fool!
translation: 当我以为情况不会更糟时，我真是个傻瓜！

english: Before Master began his wretched experiments, we failed to notice her... condition. There's two of them now.
translation: 在主人开始他那可恶的实验之前，我们没注意到她的……状况。现在有两只了。

english: Perhaps I'm the true monster after all.
translation: 也许我才是真正的怪物。

english: A byproduct of the experiments is what keeps the creatures fed and well. My new role is more of a gardener than anything else.
translation: 实验的副产品正是维持这些生物温饱的东西。我的新角色更像是个园丁。

english: Now I labour in an incredibly draining job for a master who hasn't been here for months. Is my position a little more permanent than I had realised?
translation: 如今我为一位数月未归的主人辛苦劳作。我的职位是否比我意识到的更长久？

english: The mountain just shook! Has Master returned to us?
translation: 山刚刚震动了！主人回来了吗？

english: I must check on them, for he certainly will return if I fail him.
translation: 我必须去查看它们，因为如果我辜负了他，他肯定会回来。

english: Are you sure you wish to combine the Hydra Heart, the Hydra Eye, and Hydra Fang into the Brimstone Ring? This cannot be reversed.
translation: 你确定要将九头蛇之心、九头蛇之眼和九头蛇毒牙合成为硫磺戒指吗？此操作不可逆转。

english: This mill does not seem built well enough to accept anything but grain.
translation: 这座磨坊似乎建造得不够坚固，除了谷物外无法容纳其他东西。

english: You do not have enough room to take that.
translation: 你没有足够的空间带走那个。

english: You do not have enough room to take all three.
translation: 你没有足够的空间带走全部三样。

english: You place an air rune into the slow in the wall.
translation: 你将一枚风符石放入墙上的裂缝中。

english: You place an earth rune into the slow in the wall.
translation: 你将一枚大地符石放入墙上的裂缝中。

english: You place a fire rune into the slow in the wall.
translation: 你将一枚火符石放入墙上的裂缝中。

english: You place a water rune into the slow in the wall.
translation: 你将一枚水符石放入墙上的裂缝中。

english: You have <Num0> charges left on the staff.
translation: 法杖上还有<Num0>次充能。

english: You're handed a book.
translation: 你接过一本书。

english: Kourend is a fascinating kingdom. It was formed over a thousand years ago by settlers who had fled the God Wars. You'd think that this would make it a peaceful kingdom, but the truth is quite the opposite. Kourend has probably been the home of more violence than the rest of Gielinor combined. There are many notable wars in Kourend's history, the Age of Strife and the War of the Five Houses to name a couple. However, one of the more interesting conflicts is the most recent one, the war with Varlamore. Of particular note, is the event that started it, Imafore's Betrayal.
translation: 库兰德王国是个迷人的王国。它是一千多年前由逃离神战的定居者建立的。你可能会认为这会让它成为一个和平的王国，但事实恰恰相反。库兰德可能比吉莱诺其余地方加起来还要暴力。库兰德的历史上有许多著名的战争，比如纷争时代和五大家族之战。然而，更有趣的冲突之一是最新的一场，与瓦拉莫尔的战争。特别值得注意的是引发这场战争的事件——伊玛福尔的背叛。

english: The Kingdom of Varlamore was formed in a very similar way to Kourend, by those fleeing the Age of Strife. Unlike Kourend, Varlamore managed to avoid conflict for nearly a thousand years and in that time it became one of the most prosperous kingdoms in the world. All that changed when Emperor Imafore inherited the throne.
translation: 瓦拉莫尔王国的形成方式与库兰德非常相似，由逃离纷争时代的人们建立。与库兰德不同，瓦拉莫尔在近一千年里避免了冲突，在那段时间里，它成为了世界上最繁荣的王国之一。这一切在伊玛福尔皇帝继承王座后改变了。

english: For the first few years of Imafore's rule, Varlamore remained the peaceful and prosperous kingdom that it had always been. However, this was not set to last. To celebrate his 30th birthday, Imafore hosted a great feast, one that he claimed would be remembered for years to come. He invited people from across Varlamore to join him, but as well as that, he also invited the royal family of Kourend.
translation: 在伊玛福尔统治的头几年，瓦拉莫尔一如既往地保持着和平与繁荣。然而，这并未持续太久。为庆祝自己的三十岁生日，伊玛福尔举办了一场盛大的宴会，他声称这将令世人铭记多年。他邀请了瓦拉莫尔各地的人前来参加，此外，他还邀请了库兰德的王室。

english: Upon their arrival in Varlamore, the royal family were treated with the highest respect. They were given a tour of the entire kingdom by the emperor himself. From the floating city of Tempestus to the peak of the Proudspire, he showed them everything that Varlamore had to offer. Once the tour was complete, he personally led them to his great palace in the capital of Civitas illa Fortis. There, they spent the night in the company of the emperor, looking forward to the next day's feast.
translation: 抵达瓦拉莫尔后，王室受到了最高的礼遇。皇帝亲自带领他们游览了整个王国。从漂浮之城坦佩斯图斯到骄傲峰之巅，他向他们展示了瓦拉莫尔的一切。游览结束后，他亲自带领他们前往首都福蒂斯城的宏伟宫殿。在那里，他们与皇帝共度了一夜，期待着第二天的盛宴。

english: The day of the feast came and it was even more lavish than the emperor had claimed. There were no fewer than 50 different dishes to choose from with entertainment provided by some of the finest performers from the Tempestus College of Bards. It was towards the end of the feast that the speeches began. Various rulers and officials from across the kingdom stood up to praise and thank the emperor. Finally, the emperor himself stood up, that was when it happened.
translation: 盛宴之日到来，其奢华程度远超皇帝所言。至少有五十道不同的菜肴可供选择，还有坦佩斯图斯吟游学院的顶尖表演者助兴。宴会接近尾声时，演讲开始了。来自王国各地的统治者和官员纷纷起立赞美和感谢皇帝。最后，皇帝本人站了起来，就在那时，事情发生了。

english: The emperor called for the servants to top up every wine glass in the room. For the royal family he requested something extra special. He had the servants open a barrel of his finest Aldarin red. Then, he made a toast, to the royal family of Kourend. The rest of the guests looked on, some in horror, others in delight. The entire royal family collapsed before the emperor who looked on with a smile on his face.
translation: 皇帝命令仆人为房间里每一只酒杯斟满酒。对于王室，他要求特别款待。他让仆人打开一桶他最好的阿尔达林红酒。然后，他向库兰德王室举杯祝酒。其他宾客目睹了这一幕，有人惊恐，有人欣喜。整个王室在皇帝面前倒下，而他面带微笑地看着这一切。

english: To this day, no one knows exactly why Imafore murdered them. It's a secret he took to his grave, as he met his end in the war that followed. One thing that is known, is that even today, there is little love for Varlamore amongst the people of Kourend.
translation: 时至今日，无人知晓伊马福尔为何杀害他们。这个秘密随他一同入土，因为他在随后的战争中丧命。但有一点是众所周知的，即便到了今天，库兰德王国的人民对瓦拉莫尔依然没有多少好感。

english: I, Highseer Gulbrand of the Isle of Garmr, have assembled various entries detailing the fall of Imcandoria. I leave this tome in the entrance hall of our great Necropolis. Heed my warning reader and do not travel into that frozen wasteland. All that awaits is death.
translation: 我，加尔姆岛的高阶先知古尔布兰德，整理了记载伊姆坎多利亚覆灭的诸多条目。我将此书置于我们伟大墓城的入口大厅。读者啊，请听从我的警告，切勿踏入那片冰封的荒原。等待你的只有死亡。

english: One of the acolytes discovered a strange idol along the beach today, it has the oddest markings scratched upon it, much akin to the runic rocks of the Fremennik. The Elders of Imcandoria will know what to do with such a relic so the other Seers and I have agreed that it will be sent to them immediately.
translation: 今天一名侍僧在海滩上发现了一个奇怪的偶像，上面刻着最奇特的标记，与费明尼克的符文岩石颇为相似。伊姆坎多利亚的长老们会知道如何处理这样的遗物，因此我和其他先知已同意立即将其送往他们那里。

english: It has been two moons since we sent the idol away and the storms have turned increasingly ferocious. We have gone below into the lower Necropolis, hoping to seek refuge in the Forge of Giants.
translation: 自我们送走偶像以来已过了两个月，风暴变得愈发凶猛。我们已下到墓城深处，希望在巨人熔炉中寻求庇护。

english: The giants allowed us to stay in their domain. However, our time here is limited by our food stores, for no edible food can be produced in these horrible depths. In three moons we will return to the surface and attempt the journey into Imcandoria. There, we will begin our search for answers. The giants have seen omens of death in the forges and have suggested we go with reinforcements. They've given us a bright fiery jewel that we can use to bargain with the Auspah tribes around Imcandoria.
translation: 巨人允许我们留在他们的领地。然而，我们在此的时间受限于食物储备，因为在这可怕的深处无法产出任何可食之物。三个月后我们将返回地面，尝试前往伊姆坎多利亚的旅程。在那里，我们将开始寻找答案。巨人们在熔炉中看到了死亡的预兆，建议我们带上援军。他们给了我们一颗明亮的火焰宝石，可以用来与伊姆坎多利亚周围的奥斯帕部落谈判。

english: The city is empty, there are sounds coming from the temple. We approach with caution.
translation: 城市空无一人，神庙中传来声响。我们小心翼翼地靠近。

english: The temple was a scene from a nightmare. Piles of bodies. Pools of blood. A large globulous mass sat hungrily on a throne of oily black rock, a shock of tentacles capped with claws dangled above its three pulsing bulbous eyes. The Elders circled the creature, chanting incantations in a strange unknown tongue, covered head to toe in a mixture of blood and thick black sludge. They paid us no attention until the creature noticed our presence and began screaming. A fight soon broke out and the temple quickly turned into a blaze, the flames licking the ceiling. The harsh cackle from the elders as they burned, pierced our minds with unimaginable terror. We're none the wiser of how that... thing... came to be, but that idol must have been far older than we first assumed.
translation: 神庙如同噩梦中的场景。成堆的尸体。血泊。一个巨大的粘稠团块贪婪地坐在油黑岩石的王座上，一簇触手顶端带着利爪悬在它三只搏动的球状眼睛上方。长老们围着那生物，用陌生的未知语言吟唱着咒语，从头到脚沾满了血液和浓稠黑色污泥的混合物。他们对我们毫不在意，直到那生物注意到我们的存在并开始尖叫。随即爆发了一场战斗，神庙迅速陷入火海，火焰舔舐着天花板。长老们燃烧时发出的刺耳尖笑，以难以想象的恐怖刺穿我们的心灵。我们依然不明白那...东西...是如何出现的，但那个偶像一定比我们最初假设的要古老得多。

english: We fled back to the Isle of Garmr, we have suffered many losses, but the storm has quietened and thus returning home was far easier. All the land surrounding Imcandoria is now blanketed with a very thick layer of snow. It shows no sign of change, and thus, we must leave.
translation: 我们逃回了加尔姆岛，损失惨重，但风暴已经平息，因此归途轻松了许多。伊姆坎多利亚周围的所有土地现在都被一层厚厚的积雪覆盖。没有任何变化的迹象，因此我们必须离开。

english: It was upon a summer's day when seated in the garden did one of my pupils approach me.
translation: 那是一个夏日，我坐在花园中时，一名学生向我走来。

english: 'Master' he enquired, 'of the altar yonder I hear some say it is a power of light and yet some say it is a power of darkness. Can these not both be true?'
translation: '老师，'他问道，'关于那边的祭坛，我听说有人说它是光明的力量，也有人说它是黑暗的力量。这两者不能同时为真吗？'

english: It was not without coincidence that I had spent much of the previous day pondering this very same conundrum as the subject had arisen in lectures and so I had expected this question in the forthcoming days. I replied. 'To answer that question, you must first decide what is light and what is darkness.'
translation: 并非巧合的是，前一天我花了大量时间思考这个同样的难题，因为这个问题在讲座中出现过，所以我预料到这几天会有人问。我回答道：'要回答这个问题，你必须先决定什么是光明，什么是黑暗。'

english: 'I see master,' said my student. I interrupted quickly as I expected this response. 'Do you really see? With light you can see, but with darkness you cannot see. How can you answer the question when half of it remains hidden?'
translation: '我明白了，老师，'我的学生说。我迅速打断了他，因为我预料到了这个回答。'你真的明白了吗？有光你就能看见，但黑暗中你看不见。当一半仍处于隐藏时，你如何回答这个问题？'

english: My student looked puzzled. 'Master, if half of it remains hidden I must look harder to see if I can see the other half.'
translation: 我的学生露出困惑的表情。'老师，如果一半仍处于隐藏，我必须更努力地去看，看看能否看到另一半。'

english: 'That is correct, and how will you look for what is hidden?'
translation: '没错，那你将如何寻找隐藏之物？'

english: 'I must search harder for what I seek, Master, and continue until I find it.'
translation: '我必须更努力地寻找我所寻求之物，老师，并继续直到找到它。'

english: 'But,' I replied, 'If the darkness is too great you will be searching as a blind man without a stick, that will ultimately lead you to failure.'
translation: '但是，'我回答道，'如果黑暗太过浓重，你将像一个没有棍子的盲人一样摸索，最终只会导致失败。'

english: 'Then I must find a stick, Master.'
translation: '那我就必须找到一根棍子，老师。'

english: 'What would be better than finding a stick?' I prompted.
translation: '有什么比找到棍子更好的吗？'我提示道。

english: 'To not be blind, master.'
translation: '不瞎，老师。'

english: I felt that we were nearing the end of our conversation, stood and walked towards a grove of trees. My student followed.
translation: 我觉得我们的对话接近尾声，便站起身走向一片树林。我的学生跟在后面。

english: 'And how would you not be blind in the darkness?' I asked.
translation: '那在黑暗中你如何不瞎？'我问道。

english: 'I would bring a light, my master.'
translation: '我会带上一束光，我的老师。'

english: 'And how would you find a light?'
translation: '那你如何找到光？'

english: 'Master, I would search for the light and when I found the light I would be able to search for what is hidden in the darkness.'
translation: '老师，我会寻找光，当我找到光时，我就能寻找黑暗中隐藏之物。'

english: For many students I have seen, they would have finished at this point, realising the revelation they had reached. However, this student was very thoughtful and his next question continued the conversation.
translation: 对于我见过的许多学生来说，他们会在此时结束，意识到自己已达成的领悟。然而，这名学生非常深思熟虑，他的下一个问题延续了对话。

english: 'But Master, if I have a light and find what is hidden in the darkness it is no longer hidden, or in darkness.'
translation: '但是老师，如果我有了光并找到了黑暗中隐藏之物，那它就不再是隐藏的，也不在黑暗中了。'

english: 'That is correct,' I confirmed, 'so how does that relate to your original question of whether altar yonder is of light or darkness?'
translation: '没错，'我确认道，'那这与你的原始问题——那边的祭坛是光明还是黑暗——有何关联？'

english: 'Master, I believe I understand now.'
translation: '老师，我想我现在明白了。'

english: He left the garden with his lesson learnt and the darkness in his mind now light.
translation: 他带着学到的教训离开了花园，心中的黑暗如今已被光明照亮。

english: How about picking on someone your own size? I'll see you at the Champions' Guild.
translation: 找个跟你个头差不多的对手如何？我在冠军公会等你。

english: Champion of Imps
translation: 小恶魔冠军

english: Welcome, my child.
translation: 欢迎，我的孩子。

english: We are all related, my child, for we are all children of the flame.
translation: 我们都是亲人，我的孩子，因为我们都是火焰之子。

english: That is why we are here, my child. Ever since the Wintertodt was imprisoned, members of the Order of the Sacred Flame, or Pyromancers as we're often known, have stood vigil over this place.
translation: 这就是我们在此的原因，我的孩子。自从冬将军被囚禁以来，圣焰教团的成员——我们常被称为火焰法师——一直在此地守望。

english: May the sacred flame guide you, my child.
translation: 愿圣焰指引你，我的孩子。

english: Welcome back, my child. How may I be of assistance?
translation: 欢迎回来，我的孩子。有什么可以帮你的吗？

english: I recently acquired some information that I found to be quite exciting. I have been a great admirer of your work for some time now, so I wanted to share it with you.
translation: 我最近获得了一些令我十分兴奋的信息。我一直是你工作的忠实仰慕者，所以想与你分享。

english: Deep beneath Trollheim, there is an ancient dungeon where four armies are locked in endless battle. Within this dungeon, there is a frozen door, behind which lies a treasure unlike any other. However, the door was sealed long ago by the leaders of the four armies.
translation: 在特罗尔海姆深处，有一座古老的地牢，四支军队在那里陷入无尽的战斗。在这座地牢中，有一扇冰冻的门，门后藏着无与伦比的宝藏。然而，那扇门很久以前就被四支军队的首领封印了。

english: I believe the treasure behind that door will be of great appeal to you. If I am correct in this assumption, then seek out the leaders of the four armies. Each of them should have a piece of the key needed to unlock the door. Assemble the key, and you will have everything you need.
translation: 我相信那扇门后的宝藏对你会有极大的吸引力。如果我的猜测正确，那就去寻找四支军队的首领。他们每人应该都持有打开那扇门所需钥匙的一部分。集齐钥匙，你就拥有所需的一切。

english: Your admirer
translation: 你的仰慕者

english: If you placed food here, it would just get ruined. You decide against it.
translation: 如果你把食物放在这里，只会被毁掉。你决定不这么做。

english: You swing your pickaxe at the rubble...
translation: 你用镐子砸向瓦砾...

english: ...and successfully break it down.
translation: ...并成功将其击碎。

english: You use a spade to scoop the rubble into a bucket.
translation: 你用铲子把瓦砾铲进桶里。

english: You'll just fill the room up with rubble again if you empty the bucket here.
translation: 如果你在这里倒空桶，只会再次把房间填满瓦砾。

english: You need to collect 10 bronze axes, 10 raw mackerel and 3 tinderboxes.
translation: 你需要收集10把青铜斧、10条生鲭鱼和3个火绒盒。

english: More still needs adding to the crate. You need to collect <Num0> bronze axes, <Num1> mackerel, and <Num2> tinderboxes.
translation: 箱子里还需要更多东西。你需要收集<Num0>把青铜斧、<Num1>条鲭鱼和<Num2>个火绒盒。

english: The crate is packed with stock. You should return it to the store.
translation: 箱子已经装满了货物。你应该把它送回商店。

english: Would you like to fill the crate with tinderboxes?
translation: 你想把箱子装满火绒盒吗？

english: Would you like to fill the crate with bronze axes?
translation: 你想把箱子装满青铜斧吗？

english: Hi there. You've done a good job that general store.
translation: 你好。那家杂货店你干得不错。

english: Maybe I was?
translation: 也许我是？

english: Oh, was I?
translation: 哦，我是吗？

english: Thanks for the steel legs! That's great! It's going to help a lot! I'm going to wear it under my normal clothes.
translation: 谢谢你的钢腿！太棒了！这会帮上大忙！我会把它穿在平常衣服里面。

english: Thanks for the offer of a helmet, but you've already given me some!
translation: 谢谢你的头盔提议，但你已经给过我一些了！

english: Thanks for the offer of a chainbody, but you've already given me some!
translation: 谢谢你的链甲提议，但你已经给过我一些了！

english: Thanks for the offer of some platelegs, but you've already given me one!
translation: 谢谢你的腿甲提议，但你已经给过我一对了！

english: You decide to take the route through Canifis.
translation: 你决定走坎尼非斯村那条路。

english: Ivan : Urgh, just had too eat some food, I only have <Num0> left.
translation: 伊万：呃，刚得吃点东西，我只剩<Num0>个了。

english: You manage to slay the rest of the vampyre juvinates and continue on your journey.
translation: 你成功消灭了剩下的成熟吸血鬼，继续你的旅程。

english: There's some boards blocking the cave entrance.
translation: 有些木板挡住了洞穴入口。

english: Remove the boards?
translation: 移除木板？

english: This rod looks very similar to the rod you saw fused to the top of the coffin. However, this rod lacks both mortal and divine energies that the original gave off.
translation: 这根杆子看起来和你之前看到融合在棺材顶上的那根非常相似。然而，这根杆子缺少原来那根所散发出的凡人和神圣能量。

english: Congratulations, you've completed a quest:
translation: 恭喜，你完成了一个任务：

english: I think your master has proven that he is too foolish to look after you. Come with me.
translation: 我认为你的主人已经证明了他太愚蠢，照顾不了你。跟我来。

english: I think your master has proven that she is too foolish to look after you. Come with me.
translation: 我认为你的主人已经证明了她太愚蠢，照顾不了你。跟我来。

english: Velam,
translation: 维拉姆，

english: Long have you waited. So patiently. So dutifully. Now, at long last, you have been graced with the most glorious of duties, for the day of our destiny is fast approaching. The Teokan will soon travel to the east and you will be selected to accompany him. You must ensure he never returns. Only with his demise can Twilight's Promise begin. Only with his demise will we see the Final Dawn.
translation: 你已等待许久。如此耐心。如此尽责。现在，终于，你被赐予了最光荣的职责，因为我们命运之日即将来临。特奥坎很快将前往东方，你将被选中随行。你必须确保他永不归来。只有他的死亡，暮光之约才能开始。只有他的死亡，我们才能见证最终黎明。

english: The icon on display here is believed to be the oldest icon of Ralos in existance. The icon predates the founding of Fortis by hundreds of years and acts as a reminder of just how long Ralos has been worshipped.
translation: 这里展示的圣物被认为是现存最古老的拉洛斯圣物。这件圣物比福提斯建城早数百年，提醒着人们拉洛斯被崇拜了多么久远。

english: While the origin of the icon has long been debated, most historians now agree that it came to Varlamore alongside early settlers from Kourend.
translation: 虽然这件圣物的起源一直备受争议，但大多数历史学家现在都同意它是由库兰德王国的早期定居者带到瓦拉莫尔的。

english: This scroll will unlock a new Home Teleport animation from the Demonic Pacts League. Would you like to read the scroll?
translation: 这张卷轴将解锁恶魔契约联赛中新的家传送动画。你想阅读这张卷轴吗？

english: Unlock Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts Home teleport
translation: 解锁联赛六：恶魔契约家传送

english: You've unlocked the Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts Home Teleport! This can be toggled by right-clicking on the Home Teleport in your spellbook.
translation: 你已解锁联赛六：恶魔契约家传送！你可以通过右键点击法术书中的家传送来切换。

english: This whistle will allows you to summon imps as your thralls from the Demonic Pacts League. Would you like to blow the whistle?
translation: 这个哨子可以让你从恶魔契约联赛中召唤小鬼作为你的仆从。你想吹响哨子吗？

english: This will consume the whistle.
translation: 这将消耗掉哨子。

english: Unlock Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts Impish Thralls
translation: 解锁联赛六：恶魔契约小鬼仆从

english: You've unlocked the Leagues VI: Demonic Pacts Impish Thralls! This can be toggled by right-clicking on each Thrall spell in your Spellbook.
translation: 你已解锁联赛六：恶魔契约小鬼仆从！你可以通过右键点击法术书中的每个仆从法术来切换。

english: To construct the cannon, firstly set down the base of the cannon firmly onto the ground. Next add the Dwarf stand to the cannon base. Then add the Barrels. Lastly add the Furnace, which powers the cannon. You should now have a fully set up Multi Cannon, to splat nasty creatures!
translation: 要组装大炮，首先将大炮基座牢牢地放在地上。接着将矮人支架加到基座上。然后加上木桶。最后加上熔炉，它为整个大炮提供动力。现在你应该有一台完全组装好的多管大炮，用来轰击讨厌的生物！

english: The ammo for the cannon is made from steel bars. Firstly you must heat up a steel bar in a furnace.
translation: 大炮的弹药由钢锭制成。首先你必须在熔炉中加热一块钢锭。

english: Now pour the molten steel into a cannon ammo mould. You should now have a ready to fire Multi cannon ball.
translation: 现在将熔化的钢倒入炮弹模具中。你现在应该有一颗可以发射的多管炮弹了。
