english: It is often said that to take on the mantle of a Temple Knight is to make the ultimate sacrifice. For most, the meaning is clear: we lay down our lives in Saradomin's name so that the world will know peace. The truth, however, is far less simple, and rarely understood. Iriandul once summed it up the best to me: our sacrifice is not that of the body, but that of the soul. Iriandul now lies dead, along with my other brothers and sisters. Of the seven of us sent here, only I remain. The Temple Knight tenets are clear: the events of the last few days must be documented. As the last survivor, it is now my duty to do so.
translation: 常言道，披上圣殿骑士的斗篷便是做出终极牺牲。对大多数人而言，其意明确：我们以萨拉多明之名献出生命，让世界得以和平。然而，真相远非如此简单，也鲜有人理解。伊里安杜尔曾向我总结得最好：我们的牺牲不是身体的，而是灵魂的。伊里安杜尔如今已死，连同我的其他兄弟姐妹。我们七人被派至此，仅剩我一人。圣殿骑士的信条明确：过去几天发生的事必须记录下来。作为最后的幸存者，记录这一切是我现在的职责。

english: We were originally dispatched to the Salve with a clear directive: to secure the river against the vampyre threat. To those that travelled and fought with us, the hope in this was clear: that victory would be achieved through the total destruction of the vampyres. In truth, the likelihood of such an outcome was always remote.
translation: 我们最初被派往萨尔维，带着明确的指令：守住河流，抵御吸血鬼的威胁。对那些与我们同行并肩作战的人来说，其中的希望显而易见：通过彻底消灭吸血鬼来取得胜利。事实上，这种结果的可能性一直微乎其微。

english: Instead, our primary focus was more unsettling: to conduct research and gather materials related to the vampyre practice of haemalchemy. The savants believed haemalchemy to be the key to vampyrification, but more importantly, also the key to overcoming the vampyres.
translation: 相反，我们的主要任务更令人不安：进行与吸血鬼血炼术相关的研究和材料收集。学者们相信血炼术是吸血鬼化的关键，但更重要的是，也是战胜吸血鬼的关键。

english: Through our efforts, the savants were able to design what could only be described as a blood ritual. This magic would secure the Salve for centuries, preventing any vampyre from crossing it. The duty to conduct this ritual, and the burden that came with it, fell upon us Temple Knights.
translation: 通过我们的努力，学者们设计出了一种只能被称为血祭仪式的魔法。这种魔法将保护萨尔维数百年，阻止任何吸血鬼跨越。执行这一仪式的职责，以及随之而来的重担，落在了我们圣殿骑士身上。

english: We prepared the ritual directly over the source of the Salve. For the sake of our companions, we ensured the profane elements remained hidden. As far as they were concerned, it was a holy consecration overseen by Saradomin himself.
translation: 我们在萨尔维源头正上方准备了仪式。为了同伴们，我们确保亵渎的元素保持隐蔽。在他们看来，这是一场由萨拉多明亲自监督的圣洁祝圣。

english: With everything prepared, we started the incantations, but we were quickly set upon by the enemy in force. They fought with more ferocity than we'd ever encountered, almost like the ritual itself was calling to them.
translation: 一切准备就绪后，我们开始吟唱咒文，但很快遭到敌人的猛烈袭击。他们比我们遇到的任何敌人都更凶猛，仿佛仪式本身在召唤他们。

english: Derygull was the first to fall. One by one, my other brothers and sisters joined him, along with many of our brave companions. And yet, their sacrifice was not in vain. In spite of the enemies attempts, the ritual was a success.
translation: 德里古尔是第一个倒下的。我的其他兄弟姐妹一个接一个地追随他而去，还有许多勇敢的同伴。然而，他们的牺牲并非徒劳。尽管敌人百般阻挠，仪式还是成功了。

english: As the battle ended, I watched as any vampyres attempting to cross the water fell and writhed in pain, before being engulfed by unholy magic. It was over. At least, that's how it seemed at the time.
translation: 战斗结束后，我看到任何试图渡水的吸血鬼都倒下痛苦挣扎，随后被邪恶的魔法吞噬。结束了。至少当时看起来是这样。

english: We set to work on burying the dead, with me personally tending to my fallen brothers and sisters. I laid them to rest around the well where we conducted the ritual, so that they may watch over the Salve forever more.
translation: 我们开始埋葬死者，我亲自照料倒下的兄弟姐妹。我将他们安葬在举行仪式的水井周围，让他们永远守护萨尔维。

english: It was only a day after the ritual when I realised something was wrong. When I woke, I felt a sickness inside me. A pain. A hunger. I may have survived the ritual, but it seems now that was no blessing, but a curse. There was only one explanation: vampyrification. I will not become my mortal enemy. I will not let my companions watch as I become the thing they swore to destroy. Death is the only release for me now, but there is one final thing I must do before it takes me.
translation: 仪式后仅一天，我就意识到出了问题。醒来时，我感到体内有一种病态。一种痛苦。一种饥饿。我或许在仪式中幸存下来，但现在看来那不是祝福，而是诅咒。只有一个解释：吸血鬼化。我不会变成我誓死对抗的敌人。我不会让同伴们看着我变成他们发誓要摧毁的东西。死亡现在是我唯一的解脱，但在它带走我之前，还有最后一件事要做。

english: While our conflict with the vampyres focused on this side of Salve, the materials we needed required various scouting missions deep into enemy territory. One of those missions mapped the tunnels found deep beneath Morytania, including one going right under Castle Drakan. And so, my path is clear. I will travel into that dark land one final time. I will use that tunnel to enter Drakan's home. And there, I will finally put an end to him.
translation: 虽然我们与吸血鬼的冲突集中在萨尔维这一侧，但所需的材料需要我们深入敌境进行各种侦察任务。其中一次任务绘制了莫利塔尼亚深处隧道的地图，包括一条直通德拉肯城堡下方的隧道。因此，我的道路清晰了。我将最后一次踏入那片黑暗之地。我将利用那条隧道进入德拉肯的家。在那里，我将最终了结他。

english: In truth, the odds of success are remote, but in many ways, that is irrelevant. No matter what happens, the Salve is secure, and our home is safe. My family will live on, and I will not. And even if I fail to kill Drakan, I know his day will come, for I know that no matter what, hope will always prevail.
translation: 说实话，成功的几率微乎其微，但在很多方面，这并不重要。无论发生什么，萨尔维是安全的，我们的家园是安全的。我的家人将延续下去，而我不会。即使我未能杀死德拉肯，我知道他的末日终将到来，因为我知道无论如何，希望总会胜利。

english: Jethick has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 杰西克又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Jethick has given you a casket!
translation: 杰西克给了你一个宝箱！

english: Bank be a dead fiddle 'n all that. They didn't take anything from your cargo hold.
translation: 银行就是个死胡同，他们没从你的货舱里拿走任何东西。

english: Most of the writing is pretty uninteresting, but something inside refers to a nature spirit. The requirements for which are "something from nature", "something with faith", and "something of the spirit-to-become freely given". It's all pretty vague.
translation: 大部分内容都挺无聊的，但里面提到了一个自然之灵。要求是“来自自然之物”、“带有信仰之物”和“自愿献出的灵魂之物”。挺模糊的。

english: My life is full of changes at the moment. I've met a great and powerful follower of Zamorak, whom has offered me the chance to join him and others in the quest for ultimate power and desolation of others. This is just the opportunity I've been looking for! I move into the old outpost (North of Ardougne) at the end of this week.
translation: 我的生活现在充满了变数。我遇到了一位强大而尊贵的萨莫拉克信徒，他给了我机会加入他和其他人，追求终极力量并毁灭他人。这正是我一直在寻找的机会！这周末我就要搬进旧哨站（阿多尼城以北）。

english: I can hardly wait!
translation: 我简直等不及了！

english: Been here a few days now. I'm overwhelmed on just how evil the other 8 are. I suppose this is amplified by living in such a small building.
translation: 来了几天了。其他八个人邪恶得让我有点吃不消。估计是因为住在这小楼里，感觉更强烈了。

english: Started causing havoc to the people of Ardougne today. We poisoned the water supply with a strange concoction which caused everyone to break out in boils! Very funny. The others have been stealthily setting fire to some people and laughing at their conclusion of spontaneous combustion.
translation: 今天开始对阿多尼城的居民搞破坏。我们往水源里下了奇怪的药水，让所有人都长满了脓疮！太好玩了。其他人还偷偷放火烧人，然后看着他们以为是自燃而哈哈大笑。

english: I think I shall have to come up with something more evil for tomorrow.
translation: 我想明天得想点更邪恶的点子。

english: Following my genius plan to make all the children invisible, the city is now in total chaos as the kids test their freedom by putting adults into a panic.
translation: 按照我的天才计划，让所有孩子都隐形了，现在城里一片混乱，孩子们尽情捣蛋，把大人们吓得够呛。

english: Honestly, some of the tricks the kids play are better than anything I could invent.
translation: 说实话，孩子们玩的把戏比我发明的任何招数都高明。

english: 20th Raktuber
translation: 拉克图伯月20日

english: Sadly things have calmed down in the city, and they've started to realise that we're the cause of all the tragedy. Luckily, the people don't have enough power to get past our defences, and even if they did, they would wish they hadn't thought of such an attack.
translation: 可惜城里渐渐平静下来了，他们也开始意识到我们是所有灾难的根源。幸运的是，那些人没能力突破我们的防御，就算他们能，也会后悔发起这样的攻击。

english: We have been told to 'beware for your days are numbered' by the people of Ardougne. It seems the city has asked for some external help, which will be upon us some time soon. I'm sure we will eliminate such a threat though.
translation: 阿多尼城的人警告我们“小心点，你们的日子不多了”。看来城里找了外援，很快就会找上门来。不过我相信我们能解决这种威胁。

english: The mystery of what has happened to my uncle has still not been revealed, but I must dwell on it no longer.
translation: 我叔叔到底发生了什么还是个谜，但我不能再纠结于此了。

english: It is slightly unfair that due to his absence the council have forced me to take up his job here at the lighthouse, but what can I say to argue against them?
translation: 因为他的失踪，议会逼我接替他在灯塔的工作，这有点不公平，但我又能怎么反驳他们呢？

english: They have allowed me to make a small income by selling items without the usual sales tax, but who is ever going to come all the way out to this forsaken spot?
translation: 他们允许我卖东西免销售税，赚点小钱，但谁会大老远跑到这个鬼地方来呢？

english: Worse, I fear for my life, being between two barbarian camps!I have not had any particular problems with the locals so far but who knows what can set off a barbarian???
translation: 更糟的是，我夹在两个野蛮人营地之间，整天提心吊胆！到目前为止和当地人没什么冲突，但谁知道什么事会惹恼野蛮人呢？？？

english: My fears seem to have been unfounded, the local barbarians, who I have learnt prefer the term 'Fremennik', seem to be decent and hard working people after all.
translation: 看来我的担心是多余的，当地的野蛮人，我听说他们更喜欢被称为“费明尼克”，其实都是些正派勤劳的人。

english: They certainly do not live up to the terrible things that I have heard about them before now!
translation: 他们完全不像我之前听说的那么可怕！

english: I still do not have any clues as to what has happened to my uncle...
translation: 关于我叔叔的下落，我还是毫无头绪……

english: Some of the local folks have tried to suggest that he was eaten by a sea monster that they claim lives near here, but I hold no weight to their foolish superstitions!
translation: 有些当地人试图暗示他是被海怪吃掉的，说那海怪就住在这附近，但我可不信他们那些愚蠢的迷信！

english: He was always slightly eccentric, and I fear that he was simply overcome by the terrible loneliness from living out in this desolate lighthouse, and one night simply gave himself up to the sea...
translation: 他一直有点古怪，我担心他只是受不了在这荒凉的灯塔里生活的孤独，某个夜晚就投海自尽了……

english: It has now been almost a month since first I was sent to this forsaken and desolate spot.
translation: 我被派到这个荒凉的地方已经快一个月了。

english: I still have no clue what happened to my uncle, and frankly, I have almost stopped really caring.
translation: 我还是不知道叔叔发生了什么，说实话，我几乎已经不怎么在乎了。

english: All I can think of is somehow getting away from this terrible place... it has been over two weeks now since I last saw another human face... I do not know how much longer I can stand the loneliness! I do not know if it is my mind playing tricks on me, but recently I have begun to hear something whispered on the wind... it seems to call my name as I fall asleep at night.
translation: 我满脑子想的都是怎么离开这个鬼地方……已经两个多星期没见过其他人了……我不知道还能忍受多久这种孤独！不知道是不是我的脑子在作祟，最近我开始听到风中有什么低语……晚上入睡时似乎有人在叫我的名字。

english: There have also been many strange noises from below the lighthouse, and from behind the strange metal doorway that my uncle had installed in the basement.
translation: 灯塔下面也传来很多奇怪的声响，还有叔叔在地下室装的那扇奇怪的金属门后面。

english: Perhaps this is how my uncle felt before he... No, I still do not know what has happened to him. I am filled with resolve to discover what exactly did happen - if nothing else, it will keep my mind from the voices that call to me nightly.
translation: 也许叔叔在……不，我还是不知道他发生了什么。我下定决心要查明真相——就算不为别的，也能让我不再去想那些每晚呼唤我的声音。

english: It has been some time last I filled out this journal, for my spirits have been lifted greatly in recent times, and it is all down to a single person I encountered while working here!
translation: 距离上次写这本日记已经有一段时间了，因为最近我的心情好多了，这全都要归功于我在工作中遇到的一个特别的人！

english: Her name is Larrissa and she is a local Fremennik girl, who comes here to buy goods not for sale in her home town of Rellekka sometimes.
translation: 她叫拉里萨，是个当地的费明尼克女孩，有时会来这里买一些她家乡雷勒卡城买不到的东西。

english: To be honest, I would have tried to strike up a friendship with anyone who came by, for it is a terribly lonely job working at this light- house, but even if I worked in Varrock I could not have chosen a more pleasant companion! We really struck a chord together, and I think we may become more than friends eventually, but I worry what her family will think of me - from what I hear the people of Rellekka do not take kindly to strangers! I have also made some progress in my search for the truth of what happened to my uncle Silas all those months ago! I found a secret compartment with a diary hidden within it. I have placed the diary in the bookshelf for later examination. It is definitely his hand writing, and I hope that it may shed some light onto his eventual fate.
translation: 说实话，不管谁来我都会试着交个朋友，毕竟在灯塔工作太孤独了，但就算我在维洛克城工作，也找不到比她更好的伙伴！我们真的很投缘，我觉得我们最终可能不只是朋友，但我担心她的家人会怎么看我——据我所知，雷勒卡城的人对外来者不太友好！另外，我调查叔叔赛拉斯几个月前遭遇的真相也有了进展！我发现了一个暗格，里面藏着一本日记。我把日记放在书架上，准备稍后仔细研究。那绝对是他的笔迹，希望能从中找到他最终命运的线索。

english: I cannot help but think that had he never come to this isolated place, that whatever befell him might have never happened...
translation: 我不禁想，如果他当初没来这个与世隔绝的地方，也许就不会遭遇那些事了……

english: Has it been so long since last I wrote in this thing? These last months have seemed like a glorious dream...
translation: 距离上次写这东西已经这么久了？这几个月就像一场美梦……

english: Larrissa and I have been slowly falling in love, and the torment that this lighthouse was to me when first I arrived here, is now the place where I have finally found true happiness!
translation: 拉里萨和我渐渐相爱了，这座灯塔曾经是我初来时的折磨，现在却成了我找到真正幸福的地方！

english: All is not as perfect as I would like to believe it to be however.
translation: 不过一切并非如我所愿那般完美。

english: I have still had no luck in understanding what happened to my uncle Silas, and his diary is so bizarre I cannot believe that the man who wrote it is the same man who used to take me on fishing trips to Karamja when I was a young lad.
translation: 我还是搞不懂叔叔赛拉斯发生了什么，他的日记太古怪了，我简直不敢相信写那本日记的人，就是小时候带我去卡拉姆詹岛钓鱼的那个叔叔。

english: The writer seems to have been driven horribly insane by living here, or by some event that he witnessed one day, and his diary is full of strange and cryptic passages...
translation: 写日记的人似乎因为住在这里，或者因为某天目睹了什么，而变得疯狂，日记里满是奇怪而隐晦的段落……

english: I feel sure that there is some message here, but I just cannot find what it says! My nights alone are getting worse too. During the day when I am with Larrissa, I am always filled with joy, but when she goes home to her family at night, and I am left here alone my mind begins to play tricks upon me.
translation: 我确信这里面有某种信息，但就是找不到！我独自度过的夜晚也越来越难熬。白天和拉里萨在一起时，我总是充满喜悦，但晚上她回家后，我一个人留在这里，脑子就开始胡思乱想。

english: Often I think I can hear ...things... moving in the crawlspaces of the lighthouse.
translation: 我经常觉得能听到……什么东西……在灯塔的狭小空间里移动。

english: Whenever the wind is to the North I can also sometimes hear a dread- ful chittering noise. Is it voices? Or some creature of the night? I know not, but the sound disturbs me...
translation: 每当刮北风时，我有时还能听到可怕的吱吱声。是说话声？还是某种夜间生物？我不知道，但那声音让我不安……

english: One night I even thought I heard my uncle's voice calling to me to join him, but the voice was distorted, and gurgled as though he were trying to talk through water.
translation: 有一晚我甚至觉得听到了叔叔的声音在呼唤我加入他，但那声音扭曲，还带着咕噜声，仿佛他正试图隔着水说话。

english: I dismissed this as a bad dream, yet it did disturb me deeply.
translation: 我把它当作一场噩梦而不予理会，但它确实深深困扰着我。

english: I haven't told Larrissa of my concerns, for I would not wish her to worry about me, but I have decided to give her a spare key to this lighthouse, for I cannot shake this feeling that should I remain here much longer something terrible is going to happen to me...
translation: 我没有告诉拉里萨我的担忧，因为我不想让她为我担心，但我决定给她一把这座灯塔的备用钥匙，因为我无法摆脱这种感觉——如果我在这里待得太久，可怕的事情就会发生在我身上……

english: Strange! I thought I heard a noise from downstairs just now! But with the front door locked, there is no way for anyone to enter the lighthouse!
translation: 奇怪！我刚才好像听到楼下有动静！但前门锁着，没人能进得了灯塔！

english: I must investigate...
translation: 我必须去查看一下……

english: Justine returns you <Num0> points.
translation: 贾斯汀返还你<Num0>点。

english: You think you can defeat me? Come to the Champions' Guild and prove it!
translation: 你以为你能打败我？来冠军公会证明给我看！

english: Champion of Jogres
translation: 乔格雷斯冠军

english: From the stadium to Everlight, crowds lined the streets. I'd never seen anything like it. It seems that the royal family have spared no expense. It makes sense though. This is the first time that the Dominion Games have taken place here. The queen clearly wants to make everything as close as possible to the ones held back home. It seems to be working so far, but only time will tell for sure...
translation: 从体育场到永恒之光，街道两旁挤满了人群。我从未见过这样的场面。看来王室不惜重金。这也说得通。这是统治竞技场第一次在这里举办。女王显然想让一切都尽可能接近家乡举办的赛事。目前看来效果不错，但只有时间才能证明一切……

english: Welcome sister... to our organisation... Ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms... and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world.
translation: 欢迎你，姐妹……加入我们的组织……我们为人类的一切形态而战……为人类清除存在于世间的怪物。

english: Welcome friend... to our organisation... Ours is a fight for humanity in all its shapes and forms... and to rid mankind of the monsters that exist in our world.
translation: 欢迎你，朋友……加入我们的组织……我们为人类的一切形态而战……为人类清除存在于世间的怪物。

english: Dance move: Spinny dervish
translation: 舞步：旋转苦行僧

english: Two dancers go the front of the stage, two go to the back.
translation: 两名舞者走到舞台前方，两名舞者走到后方。

english: Everybody spin and sing.
translation: 所有人旋转并歌唱。

english: Swap positions - front goes to the back, back goes to the front.
translation: 交换位置——前面的到后面，后面的到前面。

english: Spin and sing again!
translation: 再次旋转并歌唱！

english: Return to start position.
translation: 回到起始位置。

english: Dance move: Jolly jig
translation: 舞步：欢快吉格舞

english: Form a square, a dancer in each corner.
translation: 站成方形，每个角落一名舞者。

english: Everybody jig and sing.
translation: 所有人跳吉格舞并歌唱。

english: Everyone move clockwise, then jig and sing again!
translation: 所有人顺时针移动，然后再次跳吉格舞并歌唱！

english: Return to start position, then jig again and make some noise!
translation: 回到起始位置，再跳一次吉格舞并大声欢呼！

english: Dance move: Under'n'round Pass
translation: 舞步：下绕环传

english: Everyone walk forwards, two dancers stop before the front of the stage and jump for joy.
translation: 所有人向前走，两名舞者在舞台前停下并欢呼跳跃。

english: The other two dancers walk around them anti-clockwise.
translation: 另外两名舞者逆时针绕过他们。

english: All dancers sing.
translation: 所有舞者歌唱。

english: Once the two moving dancers return to the line, jump for joy again.
translation: 两名移动的舞者回到队伍后，再次欢呼跳跃。

english: Return to start position, then all jump for joy and sing.
translation: 回到起始位置，然后所有人欢呼跳跃并歌唱。

english: Dance move: Big Hopper
translation: 舞步：大跳跃

english: Everyone walk to the front of the stage.
translation: 所有人走到舞台前方。

english: Everybody hop and sing.
translation: 所有人跳跃并歌唱。

english: Return to start position, everyone hop and sing again.
translation: 回到起始位置，所有人再次跳跃并歌唱。

english: Dialogue: We are the Easter carrots...
translation: 台词：我们是复活节胡萝卜……

english: Dialogue: Easter is here, it's time to frolic...
translation: 台词：复活节到了，是时候嬉戏了……

english: Dialogue: Orange, rooty, nice and juicy...
translation: 台词：橙色的，多根的，又甜又多汁……

english: Dialogue: Whilst sun is warm we dance about...
translation: 台词：趁着阳光温暖我们起舞……

english: The cat continues to purr contently.
translation: 猫继续满足地咕噜着。

english: The cat is content with the services you have provided. You get to live... this time.
translation: 猫对你提供的服务感到满意。你这次可以活命了。

english: A gift for Rose.
translation: 给玫瑰的礼物。

english: If it pleases you, my dear child, would you record our future outings? When I'm old and my mind is fading I'd like to reminisce all the times we've spent together around this fine Kingdom of mine. Heed the lessons of our time together and reflect, for someday you will be Queen over this great land.
translation: 如果你愿意，亲爱的孩子，能否记录我们未来的出游？当我年老记忆衰退时，我想回忆我们在这片美好王国共度的时光。铭记我们相处的教训并反思，因为总有一天你会成为这片广袤土地的女王。

english: Today Father and I had lunch by the River Hos, we sat on our favorite bench and watched as the farmers tended to their curious Bologano fruits. We were joined by a young farmer called Gric, he gave me a basket of strawberries and they're the best I've ever tasted! I recall he was writing a book and he and father discussed the mysteries of ageing for quite some time before he took leave and returned to his farm.
translation: 今天父亲和我在霍斯河边吃午饭，我们坐在最喜欢的长凳上，看着农夫们照料他们那些奇特的博洛加诺果实。一个叫格里克的年轻农夫加入了我们，他给了我一篮草莓，那是我吃过最好吃的草莓！我记得他在写一本书，他和父亲讨论了很长时间关于衰老的奥秘，然后他才离开回到他的农场。

english: The Lancalliums we'd planted previously were looking a little wilted but Father informed me that Gric would see to them and make sure that they wouldn't die. I asked if Gric could stop anything from dying, Father informed me that in the past a great wizard once beat death and this eventually lead to the residents of Arceuus being immortal, but they had to abandon most of what made them Human to do so. In the end, is it worth it? Forever is a long time and the mind is more fragile than you may realise.
translation: 我们之前种的兰卡利乌姆看起来有点枯萎了，但父亲告诉我格里克会照看它们，确保它们不会死。我问格里克能不能阻止任何东西死亡，父亲告诉我过去曾有一位伟大的魔法师战胜了死神，这最终导致阿西乌斯城的居民获得了永生，但他们为此不得不放弃大部分人性。到头来，这值得吗？永远是很长的时间，而心灵比你想象的要脆弱得多。

english: This happened a few weeks back, I've finally decided to write it down, perhaps it'll help.
translation: 这是几周前发生的事，我终于决定把它写下来，也许会有帮助。

english: A favourite locale of ours is the Fisher's Market at the crossroads in Piscarilius, the merchants are lovely and the music is always enjoyable! The smell may not be for everyone, but after a while you'll forget about it. Being royalty, it's good practise to dress down and be somewhat anonymous as Father believes it's a good lesson in understanding the residents, for both the good traits and the bad. Today was a bad day.
translation: 我们最喜欢去的地方之一是皮斯卡里琉斯城十字路口的渔夫市场，商人们很友善，音乐也总是很悦耳！气味可能不是人人都能接受，但过一会儿你就会忘记了。身为王室成员，穿着朴素、保持一定的匿名性是很好的做法，因为父亲认为这是了解居民的好机会，无论是优点还是缺点。今天是个糟糕的日子。

english: We were stood on the corner, listening to Rey play his golden flute (He always plays my requests and gives us fish when we leave, I'll miss his music.) and just as he had finished playing 'Mist on the River Hos' it happened. It was over quickly, a man stepped from the crowds and attempted to take the golden flute, Father instantly stepped between the two of them when suddenly a woman stepped forward with a knife. Blood was drawn, civilians screamed and the criminals ran.
translation: 我们站在街角，听雷伊吹奏他的金色长笛（他总是演奏我点的曲子，我们离开时还会给我们鱼，我会想念他的音乐的。）就在他刚吹完《霍斯河上的薄雾》时，事情发生了。一切结束得很快，一个男人从人群中走出来，试图抢走金色长笛，父亲立刻挡在两人之间，突然一个女人拿着刀冲上前来。血溅了出来，平民们尖叫着，罪犯们逃跑了。

english: Father only sustained minor injury but The Fisher's Market is closed now and I believe Rey blames himself for all of it. I'm sure there is a lesson to be learnt from all of this but I'm currently yet to understand it.
translation: 父亲只受了轻伤，但渔夫市场现在关闭了，我相信雷伊为此自责不已。我相信这一切中一定有可以学到的教训，但我目前还没能理解。

english: We left from the southern gate and travelled down the road which passed by the Mess. The usual discord echoed forth, merriment, humour and the clatter of cutlery. The southern door swung listlessly in the wind, further adding to the cacophony with a piercing creak. We turned off towards the west and headed over the stream, up the hill and towards the training grounds. Father slowed the Oxen to a steady pace as we passed by, but it was barren, bar 3 brutish men sparring silently in the combat ring.
translation: 我们从南门出发，沿着经过混乱区的道路前行。往常的喧嚣声回荡着，欢笑声、幽默声和餐具的碰撞声。南门在风中懒散地摇摆，刺耳的吱呀声更增添了嘈杂。我们转向西边，越过溪流，爬上小山，朝着训练场走去。父亲放慢了牛车的速度，缓缓经过，但那里空无一人，只有三个粗壮的男人在战斗台上默默地对练。

english: As we entered the graveyard, the wind blustered suddenly and I had to grip my coat in spite of the bitter conditions. I approached the grave cautiously, unsure of what I was expecting to happen, but whatever it may have been, it didn't. I quickly placed the Rose down and shuffled off down the path, Father prefers to speak with her by himself.
translation: 当我们进入墓地时，风突然刮起，尽管天气寒冷，我不得不抓紧外套。我小心翼翼地走近坟墓，不确定自己期待会发生什么，但无论是什么，都没有发生。我迅速放下玫瑰，沿着小径匆匆离开，父亲更喜欢独自和她说话。

english: I approached the old crypt and was surprised to see a strange man perched by the door. Noticing me, he smiled and greeted me, showing me a mouth full of blackened stumps.
translation: 我走近那座古老的墓穴，惊讶地看到一个奇怪的男人蹲在门边。他注意到我，微笑着向我打招呼，露出一口黑乎乎的残牙。

english: 'Morning love, what a day, 'ey?' he remarked.
translation: “早上好，亲爱的，今天天气不错，嗯？”他说。

english: 'Foul,' I responded quietly.
translation: “糟透了。”我轻声回答。

english: 'Pah! You know who's buried in this here tomb?' he pondered.
translation: “哼！你知道这座坟墓里埋的是谁吗？”他思索着。

english: 'I was told it's where we would bury our kings and queens, when there was space, anyway.' I spoke more to myself than the man, but he responded nonetheless.
translation: “我听说那是我们埋葬国王和王后的地方，只要有空间的话。”我更多是对自己说，而不是对那个男人说，但他还是回应了。

english: 'Aye! But d'you hear of the Wizard?' he asked.
translation: “没错！但你听说过那位魔法师吗？”他问道。

english: 'What Wizard?' I asked, failing to hide my curiosity.
translation: “什么魔法师？”我问道，没能掩饰住好奇心。

english: 'Been dead for a good while, so they say,' he smirked.
translation: “据说已经死了很久了。”他得意地笑着。

english: 'Well, I've never heard of them,' I admitted.
translation: “嗯，我从来没听说过。”我承认。

english: 'Do they no longer teach ye history? A high-born girl like you should be educated,' the man said as he wiped the sweat from his brow. His hands were far dirtier than I'd first noticed.
translation: “他们不再教你们历史了吗？像你这样出身高贵的姑娘应该受过教育才对。”男人说着，擦了擦额头上的汗。他的手比我最初注意到的要脏得多。

english: 'Of course they do, I've even read Remoh's 'Tale of Darkness', the original manuscript,' I gloated, regretting instantly as it gave away my position far more than he had already inferred.
translation: “当然教了，我甚至读过雷莫的《黑暗传说》，还是原稿。”我炫耀道，但立刻后悔了，因为这暴露了我的身份，比他推测的还要多。

english: 'So yer 'ighness knows all about the Catacombs,' his eyes shone with a strange intensity.
translation: “那么殿下对地下墓穴了如指掌了。”他的眼中闪烁着奇异的光芒。

english: 'I do, but don't try to scare me with monsters, I know of the powerful magic that keeps them bound below,' I snapped, this conversation would likely displease Father if I continued any further.
translation: “是的，但别想用怪物吓唬我，我知道有强大的魔法将它们束缚在地下。”我厉声说道，如果再继续下去，父亲可能会不高兴。

english: 'Below?' He laughed 'The entrance may be below the earth, but that realm lies beyond the reach of us mere mortals,'
translation: “地下？”他笑了，“入口可能在地下，但那个领域远非我们这些凡人所能触及。”

english: 'But Lustre was just a man and he entered without issue,' I countered.
translation: “但卢斯特只是个普通人，他毫无阻碍地进去了。”我反驳道。

english: 'Other powers are at work, m'lady, powers far beyond the likes of us,' as he spoke, he eyed the crypt suspiciously, it looked as if he were about to say more when Father suddenly arrived.
translation: “有其他力量在起作用，小姐，远超我们这些人的力量。”他说话时，怀疑地盯着墓穴，看起来他正要再说些什么，这时父亲突然出现了。

english: 'What nonsense are you bothering my child with, digger?' he demanded. The man struggled to his knees, submitting to his King, but his mouth kept that sardonic grin he enjoyed wearing.
translation: “你在用些什么胡言乱语打扰我的孩子，掘墓人？”他严厉地问道。男人挣扎着跪下来，向国王臣服，但嘴角仍挂着那副惯常的讥笑。

english: 'I beg your pardon, your highness! I was unaware of the girls stature,' he grovelled.
translation: “请恕罪，陛下！我不知道这位姑娘的身份。”他卑躬屈膝地说。

english: 'Regardless, you should mind your tongue, spreading hearsay is a crime against the crown,' Father spoke with authority, one must if you expect your subjects to listen.
translation: “不管怎样，你应该管好你的舌头，散布谣言是对王室的犯罪。”父亲以权威的口吻说道，要想让臣民听从，就必须如此。

english: 'Oh, I wouldn't dare stoop so low. It was but a folktale, your highness,' the man explained.
translation: “哦，我不敢如此卑劣。那只是个民间传说，陛下。”男人解释道。

english: 'Hmm, don't you have a job that needs attending?' Father questioned.
translation: “嗯，你不是有工作要做吗？”父亲质问道。

english: 'That I do,' he responded while bowing far lower than necessary and he quickly hobbled away.
translation: “是的，我有。”他回应道，鞠躬的幅度远低于必要的程度，然后迅速蹒跚离去。

english: 'What have I said about talking to strangers? Do you forget yourself, child?' Father scolded.
translation: “我跟你说过什么关于和陌生人说话的事？你忘了自己的身份了吗，孩子？”父亲责备道。

english: 'I'm sorry Father, I wasn't expecting him to be here, I've always enjoyed visiting the old crypt,' I explained.
translation: “对不起父亲，我没想到他会在这里，我一直很喜欢参观这座古老的墓穴。”我解释道。

english: 'Come along now, Rose, let's head back to the cart before the sun sets,'.
translation: “现在走吧，罗斯，我们赶在日落前回到推车那里。”

english: During our monthly trip into the Lovakengj districts we made a peculiar stop at a tinkers market stall. I asked father what exactly he had purchased multiple times, but he was unwilling to speak on the matter. Upon our return home, father quickly disappeared to his study and wasn't seen again all day.
translation: 在我们每月一次前往洛瓦肯吉城区的旅途中，我们在一个工匠的市场摊位前停了下来。我问父亲他到底买了什么好几次，但他不愿谈及此事。回到家后，父亲迅速消失在书房里，一整天都没再露面。

english: At this morning's breakfast he revealed to me what he'd been hiding in the form of a birthday present. It's beautiful! A locket of pale gold shaped like a rose that contains a wonderful painting of mother opposite a dark purple crystal. The gemstone seemed to lack a reflection altogether and it lay eerily bathed in shadow regardless of the light streaming in through the windows. The metalwork showed clear signs of age as well as a recent cleaning; father says he's uncertain of the precise age of the locket. He assured me it's certainly at least several centuries old in between quick sips from a peculiar ornate flask with an 'X' imprinted on the side. I suppose he picked that up yesterday from the tinker as well.
translation: 今天早餐时，他向我展示了他一直藏着的生日礼物。太美了！一个淡金色的玫瑰形状吊坠盒，里面有一幅母亲的精美画作，对面是一颗深紫色的水晶。那颗宝石似乎完全没有倒影，无论窗外透进多少光线，它都诡异地笼罩在阴影中。金属工艺显示出明显的年代痕迹，也看得出最近被擦拭过；父亲说他不确定吊坠盒的确切年代。他向我保证它至少有几百年的历史，说话间不时从侧面印着“X”的奇特雕花小瓶里喝上一口。我猜那也是他昨天从工匠那里买的。

english: 'Much planned for the day, father?' I asked, afraid that he plans to spend yet another day locked away from the world.
translation: “今天有什么计划吗，父亲？”我问道，担心他又打算把自己关在书房里一整天，与世隔绝。

english: 'Ah, well... yes, back to the study. In the middle of a book, very illuminating,' he responded.
translation: “啊，嗯……是的，回书房。正读到一本书的中间，很有启发性。”他回答道。

english: 'What's it called?' I asked.
translation: “书名是什么？”我问道。

english: 'Oh, it's too old to have one of those - a name, that is - as the original cover is a faded mess; even the author is a mystery...' he trailed off.
translation: “哦，太旧了，没有书名——我是说名字——因为原来的封面已经褪色得一塌糊涂；连作者也是个谜……”他的声音渐渐低了下去。

english: 'What's it about?' I knew he had no intention of sharing the details, but I'm nosey.
translation: “是关于什么的？”我知道他无意分享细节，但我就是爱打听。

english: 'You sure have a lot of questions today... It's no story of heroes or lovers' quarrels, so I fear you may find the matter rather dull,'
translation: '你今天问题可真多啊……这可不是什么英雄或恋人争吵的故事，恐怕你会觉得这事挺无聊的。'

english: That was essentially the end of the conversation as he refused to share any more about these mysterious books he's been reading. Father has been acting quite odd lately... I should keep a close eye on him, secrecy doesn't suit him.
translation: 这基本上就是谈话的结束了，因为他拒绝再分享任何关于他一直在读的那些神秘书籍的内容。父亲最近表现得相当古怪……我得好好盯着他，保密这种事不适合他。

english: The rest of my day was fairly predictable, 'friends' visited me to shower me in gifts - in which I have very little use for - and then there was a feast in the evening. Father managed to show his face for that, although - as expected - he left early.
translation: 我这一天剩下的时间倒是相当平淡，'朋友们'来拜访我，给我送了一堆礼物——那些东西我根本用不上——然后晚上还有一场盛宴。父亲倒是露了面，虽然——不出所料——他提前就走了。

english: The sky was gold and the mist rose in eerie swirls as the wind swept through the empty streets of Arceuus. 'A meeting' was all father had said when he left the table at breakfast; the purple bags under his eyes showed that he hadn't slept in days. Recently he's been acting quite odd, secluded in his study for days on end. Recently? He's always been like this I suppose. Still, this time something seems different.
translation: 天空泛着金色，雾气诡异地打着旋升起，风扫过阿西乌斯城空荡荡的街道。'有个会要开'，这就是父亲在早餐时离开餐桌前说的全部；他眼下的青紫色袋子说明他已经好几天没睡了。最近他表现得相当古怪，一连几天把自己关在书房里。最近？我想他一直都是这样。不过，这次感觉有些不同。

english: Sneaking out of the castle to follow him was far easier than it should have been, the guards had left their posts and on the journey I saw not a soul. Crouching down behind some magic trees, I could see father waiting by a still pool, he had his pipe and blue smoke made ominous shapes above him in the dim morning light. Suddenly, a hooded figure manifested from the mist and father did something I'll never forget. He knelt.
translation: 溜出城堡跟踪他比想象中容易得多，守卫们都不在岗位上，一路上我连一个人影都没看到。蹲在一些魔法树后面，我看到父亲站在一潭静水边等着，他叼着烟斗，蓝色的烟雾在昏暗的晨光中在他头顶形成不祥的形状。突然，一个兜帽人从雾中现身，父亲做了一件我永远不会忘记的事。他跪下了。

english: 'You're the priestess?' he choked.
translation: '你就是女祭司？'他哽咽着说。

english: 'I am,' the hooded figure responded in a whisper.
translation: '是我，'兜帽人低声回应。

english: 'I... I've done everything you've asked,' he kept his eyes down as he spoke.
translation: '我……你要求的一切我都做了，'他说话时始终低着头。

english: 'I want something else,' she said.
translation: '我要别的东西，'她说。

english: 'Take a drink, you sound thirsty,' she smirked.
translation: '喝一口吧，你听起来渴了，'她得意地笑着。

english: Reluctantly, father took his flask from his pocket and took a sip from it. Pain cut across his face and the flask fell from his grip.
translation: 父亲不情愿地从口袋里掏出酒壶，抿了一口。痛苦扭曲了他的脸，酒壶从他手中滑落。

english: 'Perfect,' she turned her head and looked directly at me.
translation: '完美，'她转过头，直直地看着我。

english: Light burst from fathers' eyes and mouth and he slumped to the ground silently. The world around me spun and I awoke screaming in my bed. My locket burned against my chest; was it a dream or is my father truly gone? The doors to my bedroom burst open and my handmaid Alyssa rushed to my side.
translation: 光从父亲的眼睛和嘴里迸发出来，他无声地瘫倒在地。我周围的世界天旋地转，我在床上尖叫着醒来。我的吊坠在胸口灼烧；那是梦，还是父亲真的已经不在了？卧室的门猛地被推开，侍女艾莉莎冲到我身边。

english: 'What is it child? An intruder?' she asked.
translation: '怎么了孩子？有入侵者？'她问道。

english: 'No, just a dream... Where's father?' it was clear she wasn't expecting me to ask that.
translation: '没有，只是个梦……父亲在哪？'显然她没想到我会问这个。

english: 'What happened? A nightmare?'
translation: '发生什么了？做噩梦了？'

english: 'You could say that,' I rushed to my desk and began filling in this entry. I fear everything is about to change.
translation: '可以这么说，'我冲到书桌前开始写这篇日记。我担心一切都要变了。

english: If you're reading this, things haven't gone to plan and YOU should be worried. The King has been killed and I am 'Unfit for rule'... I have enough sanity left to know it won't be long until they come for me too.
translation: 如果你正在读这篇日记，那说明事情没有按计划进行，而你该担心了。国王已被杀害，而我'不适合统治'……我还保有足够的理智，知道他们很快也会来找我。

english: By all means, young stranger, attempt to rebuild this memoir, but I'm afraid you may not like the ending, I for one am not a fan. You may think you're ahead of the game, but the pieces have been in motion for decades and you are just another pawn, as was I.
translation: 年轻的陌生人，你尽管试着重建这本回忆录，但恐怕你不会喜欢这个结局，反正我是不喜欢。你可能觉得自己领先了一步，但这些棋子已经布局了几十年，你不过是又一个棋子，就像我一样。

english: Perhaps we'll meet soon.
translation: 也许我们很快就会见面。

english: For many years now, much of my work has been defined by a single question: who were the Old Ones?
translation: 多年来，我的大部分工作都围绕着一个问题：远古者是谁？

english: It's a fascinating puzzle, and one with no simple answer. Find your way into the southern Kingdom of Varlamore, and you'll be presented with a huge range of interpretations. Not too surprising when you consider that the kingdom is littered with ruins from this ancient race. However, here in Kourend, the answer is far more interesting. Why? Because there's no answer at all.
translation: 这是一个迷人的谜题，而且没有简单的答案。如果你进入南方的瓦拉莫尔王国，你会看到各种各样的解读。考虑到这个王国遍布着这个古老种族的废墟，这并不奇怪。然而，在库兰德王国，答案要有趣得多。为什么？因为根本没有答案。

english: The great Arceuus Library has more books than even an immortal would have time to read, but not a single one mentions the Old Ones. How is it that the all-knowing citizens of Arceuus have no knowledge of this mysterious, forgotten race? Do they simply not care? Or are they hiding something?
translation: 宏伟的阿西乌斯图书馆藏书之多，连永生者都读不完，但没有一本书提到远古者。为什么无所不知的阿西乌斯居民对这个神秘而被遗忘的种族一无所知？他们只是不在乎吗？还是在隐瞒什么？

english: Head into the Kebos Lowlands, and you'll soon find yourself surrounded by lizardman architecture, or at least, that's what the historians of Arceuus would have you believe. Curiously, they don't seem to have noticed that this architecture bears more than a few similarities to the Old One ruins found in Varlamore.
translation: 进入凯博斯低地，你很快就会发现自己被蜥蜴人的建筑包围，至少阿西乌斯的历史学家会这么告诉你。奇怪的是，他们似乎没有注意到这些建筑与瓦拉莫尔发现的远古者废墟有着不少相似之处。

english: I have long worked under the assumption that this is no coincidence. While there are no known Old One ruins in Kourend or Kebos, the lizardmen must have adopted this architectural style from somewhere.
translation: 长期以来，我一直认为这不是巧合。虽然库兰德和凯博斯没有已知的远古者废墟，但蜥蜴人一定是从某个地方学来了这种建筑风格。

english: My search has been long and arduous, but thanks to a new discovery near Quidamortem, I may finally be close to some answers. It's time to uncover the truth.
translation: 我的搜寻漫长而艰辛，但多亏了奎达莫特姆附近的新发现，我可能终于接近答案了。是时候揭开真相了。

english: I've recently been researching local folklore around the Mynydd mountain that sits in the north-west of the region of Tirannwn. Below I've recorded the most notable legends, all of which seem to revolve around a set of similar events. I'm quite dubious of their accuracy as oral tradition has a habit of over indulging specific details - of course, anything is possible.
translation: 我最近一直在研究提兰恩地区西北部米尼德山周围的民间传说。下面我记录了一些最著名的传说，它们似乎都围绕着一系列相似的事件展开。我对它们的准确性持怀疑态度，因为口头传统往往会过度渲染某些细节——当然，一切皆有可能。

english: A tale of a ghostly wolf that took the form of a handsome prince that fell in love with the Queen of Light who ruled in a palace atop a great mountain. The royal huntsman, distrusting of this mysterious prince, tracks him one night and discovers his true form. He ensnares the wolf in a trap and performs a ritual to banish him. When the Queen finds the prince gone and never to return, she engulfs the mountain in a harsh bright light as she cries out in grief. To this day, the Wolf of Ysbryd guards the mountain and its ruler from the eternal darkness that forever plagues the land.
translation: 传说有一只幽灵狼化作英俊王子的模样，爱上了统治着大山之巅宫殿的光之女王。皇家猎人怀疑这位神秘的王子，某夜跟踪他并发现了他的真面目。他用陷阱困住狼，并举行仪式将其驱逐。当女王发现王子消失且再也不会回来时，她在悲痛中发出刺目的光芒笼罩了整座山。至今，伊兹布里德之狼守护着这座山及其统治者，抵御永远困扰这片土地的永恒黑暗。

english: Blaidd Brightpaw, clad in nothing but a wolfskin and a blinding spirit sword, returned from the Ysbryd realm. There he had faced the vicious Anghenfil in hand- to-hand combat and from its torn off arm, he forged his mighty blade. For the land had been torn asunder by a wicked dragon after it was disturbed from its slumber by Queen Tywyll as she mined the mountain dry. Once it had been awoken it destroyed the castle that had been built upon its lair in retaliation for the theft of its treasure. The Brightpaw, oft times mistaken for a prowling snow wolf, climbed the mountain to slay the dragon and save the queen. Alas, the hero was too late and the dragon had already devoured the great Queen Tywyll.
translation: 布莱德·亮爪只披着狼皮、手持一把耀眼的神剑，从伊兹布里德界归来。在那里，他与凶残的安格芬尼尔进行了肉搏战，并用从它撕下的手臂锻造了他的强大之剑。因为这片土地被一条邪恶的巨龙撕裂——它在沉睡中被泰威尔女王挖空山脉时惊醒。苏醒后，它摧毁了建在其巢穴之上的城堡，以报复宝藏被盗。亮爪常被误认为是一头潜行的雪狼，他爬上大山去屠龙救女王。可惜英雄来得太晚，巨龙已经吞噬了伟大的泰威尔女王。

english: Tywyll gan'Draig, the Queen upon the mountain, had a dark secret. In the depths of the mines that sit beneath her throne, a jeweled chalice had been found amidst a pile of treasure. It soon became the Queen's most prized possession, but unbeknownst to her, the chalice was cursed. Upon drinking from the tainted cup, the Queen's stomach began to grow in size everyday for a week. On the seventh day she gave birth to a distorted thing; all claws and scales and hot to the touch. Her brother, Blaidd gan'Draig, feared what his sister queen was becoming as the darkness overtook her. In a vain attempt to stop her from destroying the land, he pushed her out the tallest tower and she flew to her death.
translation: 山中之王泰威尔·甘·德莱格有一个黑暗的秘密。在她王座下方的矿井深处，在一堆宝藏中发现了一只镶满宝石的圣杯。它很快成为女王最珍视的宝物，但她不知道圣杯被诅咒了。饮下这被污染的杯子后，女王每天肚子都会变大，持续了一周。第七天，她生下了一个畸形的怪物；浑身是爪子和鳞片，触感滚烫。她的兄弟布莱德·甘·德莱格害怕女王姐姐在黑暗吞噬她后变成什么样子。为了阻止她毁灭这片土地，他徒劳地将她从最高的塔上推下，她坠落身亡。

english: From these stories we've learned a few things; there was a wolf and a dragon and some castle upon a mountain. It may have ended in light and it may have ended in darkness. Perhaps some lovers were involved and the land was punished for their union. What we can say, however, is that we may never truly know.
translation: 从这些故事中我们学到了一些东西；有一只狼、一条龙和一座山上的城堡。它可能以光明结束，也可能以黑暗结束。也许涉及了一些恋人，而这片土地因他们的结合而受到惩罚。然而，我们能说的是，我们可能永远无法真正知晓。

english: Smithing You've made a bronze bar! Speak to the mining instructor and he'll show you how to make it into a weapon.
translation: 锻造 你做出了青铜锭！和采矿教官聊聊，他会教你如何把它打造成武器。

english: You've made a bronze bar! Speak to the mining instructor and he'll show you how to make it into a weapon.
translation: 你做出了青铜锭！和采矿教官聊聊，他会教你如何把它打造成武器。

english: You need some tools for this section of the tutorial but you don't have enough inventory room. You'll need to drop something. To do so, right-click on an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, speak to the mining instructor again.
translation: 这个教学环节需要一些工具，但你的背包空间不够。你需要丢弃一些东西。右键点击不需要的物品并选择丢弃。完成后，再和采矿教官聊聊。

english: Smithing a dagger To smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. The mining instructor can give you a hammer.
translation: 锻造匕首 要锻造，你需要一把锤子和足够的金属锭来制作目标物品，还需要一个顺手的铁砧。采矿教官可以给你一把锤子。

english: Smithing a dagger
translation: 锻造匕首

english: To smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. The mining instructor can give you a hammer.
translation: 要锻造，你需要一把锤子和足够的金属锭来制作目标物品，还需要一个顺手的铁砧。采矿教官可以给你一把锤子。

english: Smithing a dagger To smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. To start the process, click on the anvil, or alternatively use the bar on it.
translation: 锻造匕首 要锻造，你需要一把锤子和足够的金属锭来制作目标物品，还需要一个顺手的铁砧。要开始锻造，点击铁砧，或者把锭用在它上面。

english: To smith you'll need a hammer and enough metal bars to make the desired item, as well as a handy anvil. To start the process, click on the anvil, or alternatively use the bar on it.
translation: 要锻造，你需要一把锤子和足够的金属锭来制作目标物品，还需要一个顺手的铁砧。要开始锻造，点击铁砧，或者把锭用在它上面。

english: Smithing a dagger Now you have the smithing menu open, you will see a list of all the things you can make. Only the dagger can be made at your skill level; this is shown by the white text under it. You'll need to select the dagger to continue.
translation: 锻造匕首 现在你打开了锻造菜单，会看到所有你能制作的物品清单。以你目前的技能等级，只能制作匕首；这通过它下方的白色文字显示。你需要选择匕首才能继续。

english: Now you have the smithing menu open, you will see a list of all the things you can make. Only the dagger can be made at your skill level; this is shown by the white text under it. You'll need to select the dagger to continue.
translation: 现在你打开了锻造菜单，会看到所有你能制作的物品清单。以你目前的技能等级，只能制作匕首；这通过它下方的白色文字显示。你需要选择匕首才能继续。

english: Moving on Congratulations, you've made your first weapon. Now it's time to move on. Go through the gates shown by the arrow. Remember, you may need to move the camera to see your surroundings. Speak to the mining instructor for a recap at any time.
translation: 继续前进 恭喜，你制作了第一件武器。现在是时候继续前进了。穿过箭头所示的大门。记住，你可能需要移动视角来观察周围环境。随时可以和采矿教官交谈回顾。

english: Congratulations, you've made your first weapon. Now it's time to move on. Go through the gates shown by the arrow. Remember, you may need to move the camera to see your surroundings. Speak to the mining instructor for a recap at any time.
translation: 恭喜，你制作了第一件武器。现在是时候继续前进了。穿过箭头所示的大门。记住，你可能需要移动视角来观察周围环境。随时可以和采矿教官交谈回顾。

english: Combat In this area you will find out about melee and ranged combat. Speak to the guide and he will tell you all about it.
translation: 战斗 在这个区域，你将了解近战和远程战斗。和导师交谈，他会告诉你一切。

english: In this area you will find out about melee and ranged combat. Speak to the guide and he will tell you all about it.
translation: 在这个区域，你将了解近战和远程战斗。和导师交谈，他会告诉你一切。

english: Equipping items You now have access to a new interface. Click on the flashing icon of a man, the one to the right of your backpack icon.
translation: 装备物品 你现在可以使用一个新界面。点击闪烁的男人图标，就是背包图标右边的那个。

english: Equipping items
translation: 装备物品

english: You now have access to a new interface. Click on the flashing icon of a man, the one to the right of your backpack icon.
translation: 你现在可以使用一个新界面。点击闪烁的男人图标，就是背包图标右边的那个。

english: Worn inventory This is your worn inventory. Here you can see what items you have equipped. In the bottom left corner, you will notice a flashing button with a shield and helmet on it. This button lets you view more details on what you have equipped. Click on it now.
translation: 已穿戴物品 这是你的已穿戴物品栏。在这里你可以看到你装备了什么物品。在左下角，你会注意到一个带有盾牌和头盔的闪烁按钮。这个按钮让你查看已装备物品的更多详情。现在点击它。

english: Worn inventory
translation: 已穿戴物品

english: This is your worn inventory. Here you can see what items you have equipped. In the bottom left corner, you will notice a flashing button with a shield and helmet on it. This button lets you view more details on what you have equipped. Click on it now.
translation: 这是你的已穿戴物品栏。在这里你可以看到你装备了什么物品。在左下角，你会注意到一个带有盾牌和头盔的闪烁按钮。这个按钮让你查看已装备物品的更多详情。现在点击它。

english: Equipment stats You can see what items you are wearing in the worn inventory to the left of the screen, with their combined statistics on the right. Let's add something. Click your dagger to equip it.
translation: 装备属性 你可以在屏幕左侧的已穿戴物品栏中看到你穿戴的物品，右侧显示它们的综合属性。让我们添加一些东西。点击你的匕首来装备它。

english: Equipment stats
translation: 装备属性

english: You can see what items you are wearing in the worn inventory to the left of the screen, with their combined statistics on the right. Let's add something. Click your dagger to equip it.
translation: 你可以在屏幕左侧的已穿戴物品栏中看到你穿戴的物品，右侧显示它们的综合属性。让我们添加一些东西。点击你的匕首来装备它。

english: Equipment stats You're now holding your dagger. Clothes, armour, weapons and more are equipped like this. Alternatively, you can click items directly from your inventory to equip them without opening the stats window. Speak to the combat instructor to continue.
translation: 装备属性 你现在正握着你的匕首。衣服、盔甲、武器等都以这种方式装备。另外，你也可以直接从背包中点击物品来装备，无需打开属性窗口。和战斗导师交谈以继续。

english: You're now holding your dagger. Clothes, armour, weapons and more are equipped like this. Alternatively, you can click items directly from your inventory to equip them without opening the stats window. Speak to the combat instructor to continue.
translation: 你现在正握着你的匕首。衣服、盔甲、武器等都以这种方式装备。另外，你也可以直接从背包中点击物品来装备，无需打开属性窗口。和战斗导师交谈以继续。

english: You need some new weapons for this section of the tutorial but you don't have enough inventory room. You'll need to drop something. To do so, right-click on an item you don't want and select drop. Once you've done that, speak to the combat instructor again.
translation: 这个教程部分你需要一些新武器，但你的背包空间不够。你需要丢弃一些东西。要做到这一点，右键点击你不想要的物品并选择丢弃。完成后，再次和战斗导师交谈。

english: The combat instructor gives you a bronze sword. He would have given you a wooden shield as well but you didn't have room for it. To get one, drop something and talk to the combat instructor again.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一把青铜剑。他本来也会给你一面木盾，但你没有空间了。要获得一面，丢弃一些东西再和战斗导师交谈。

english: The combat instructor gives you a wooden shield.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一面木盾。

english: The combat instructor gives you a bronze sword.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一把青铜剑。

english: Unequipping items To unequip an item, go to your worn inventory and click on the item. Alternatively, equipping a new item into the same slot will unequip the old one. Try this out now by swapping your dagger for the sword and shield that the combat instructor gave you.
translation: 卸下物品 要卸下物品，前往你的已穿戴物品栏并点击该物品。或者，在同一槽位装备新物品会卸下旧物品。现在试试用战斗导师给你的剑和盾替换你的匕首。

english: Unequipping items
translation: 卸下物品

english: To unequip an item, go to your worn inventory and click on the item. Alternatively, equipping a new item into the same slot will unequip the old one. Try this out now by swapping your dagger for the sword and shield that the combat instructor gave you.
translation: 要卸下物品，前往你的已穿戴物品栏并点击该物品。或者，在同一槽位装备新物品会卸下旧物品。现在试试用战斗导师给你的剑和盾替换你的匕首。

english: Combat interface Click on the flashing crossed swords icon to open the combat interface.
translation: 战斗界面 点击闪烁的交错剑图标打开战斗界面。

english: Combat interface
translation: 战斗界面

english: Click on the flashing crossed swords icon to open the combat interface.
translation: 点击闪烁的交错剑图标打开战斗界面。

english: Combat interface This is your combat interface. From here, you can select the attack style that you'll use in combat. Using different attack styles will give different types of experience. As well as this, monsters are weak to specific attack styles. Click on the gates to continue.
translation: 战斗界面 这是你的战斗界面。在这里，你可以选择战斗中使用的攻击风格。使用不同的攻击风格会获得不同类型的经验。此外，怪物对特定的攻击风格有弱点。点击大门继续。

english: This is your combat interface. From here, you can select the attack style that you'll use in combat. Using different attack styles will give different types of experience. As well as this, monsters are weak to specific attack styles. Click on the gates to continue.
translation: 这是你的战斗界面。在这里，你可以选择战斗中使用的攻击风格。使用不同的攻击风格会获得不同类型的经验。此外，怪物对特定的攻击风格有弱点。点击大门继续。

english: Attacking It's time to slay some rats! To attack a rat, all you have to do is click on it. This will cause you to walk over and start hitting it.
translation: 攻击 是时候杀一些老鼠了！要攻击老鼠，你只需点击它。这会让你走过去并开始攻击它。

english: It's time to slay some rats! To attack a rat, all you have to do is click on it. This will cause you to walk over and start hitting it.
translation: 是时候杀一些老鼠了！要攻击老鼠，你只需点击它。这会让你走过去并开始攻击它。

english: Sit back and watch While you are fighting you will see a bar over your head. The bar shows how much health you have left. Your opponent will have one too. You will continue to attack the rat until it's dead or you do something else.
translation: 坐观其变 战斗时你会看到头顶有一个条。这个条显示你剩余的生命值。你的对手也会有一个。你会继续攻击老鼠直到它死亡或你做了其他事情。

english: Sit back and watch
translation: 坐观其变

english: While you are fighting you will see a bar over your head. The bar shows how much health you have left. Your opponent will have one too. You will continue to attack the rat until it's dead or you do something else.
translation: 战斗时你会看到头顶有一个条。这个条显示你剩余的生命值。你的对手也会有一个。你会继续攻击老鼠直到它死亡或你做了其他事情。

english: Well done, you've made your first kill!
translation: 干得好，你完成了第一次击杀！

english: Pass through the gate and talk to the combat instructor. He will give you your next task.
translation: 穿过大门和战斗导师交谈。他会给你下一个任务。

english: The combat instructor gives you a shortbow. He would have given you some bronze arrows as well but you didn't have room for them. To get some, drop something and talk to the combat instructor again.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一把短弓。他本来也会给你一些青铜箭，但你没有空间了。要获得一些，丢弃一些东西再和战斗导师交谈。

english: Rat ranging Before you can use the shortbow and arrows you'll need to equip them by clicking on them. Once equipped with the ranging gear, try killing another rat. You don't need to enter the pen this time. To attack a rat, just click on it.
translation: 远程射鼠 在使用短弓和箭之前，你需要通过点击它们来装备。装备好远程装备后，试着再杀一只老鼠。这次你不需要进入围栏。要攻击老鼠，只需点击它。

english: Rat ranging
translation: 远程射鼠

english: Before you can use the shortbow and arrows you'll need to equip them by clicking on them. Once equipped with the ranging gear, try killing another rat. You don't need to enter the pen this time. To attack a rat, just click on it.
translation: 在使用短弓和箭之前，你需要通过点击它们来装备。装备好远程装备后，试着再杀一只老鼠。这次你不需要进入围栏。要攻击老鼠，只需点击它。

english: The combat instructor gives you some bronze arrows.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一些青铜箭。

english: The combat instructor gives you a shortbow.
translation: 战斗导师给了你一把短弓。

english: Moving on You have completed the tasks here. To move on, click on the indicated ladder. If you need to go over any of what you learnt here, just talk to the combat instructor and he'll tell you what he can.
translation: 继续前进 你已完成这里的任务。要继续前进，点击指示的梯子。如果你需要复习在这里学到的内容，只需与战斗导师交谈，他会告诉你他能提供的帮助。

english: You have completed the tasks here. To move on, click on the indicated ladder. If you need to go over any of what you learnt here, just talk to the combat instructor and he'll tell you what he can.
translation: 你已完成这里的任务。要继续前进，点击指示的梯子。如果你需要复习在这里学到的内容，只需与战斗导师交谈，他会告诉你他能提供的帮助。

english: Banking This is the Bank of Gielinor, where you can store all your most valued items. To open your bank, just click on the indicated booth.
translation: 银行 这里是Gielinor银行，你可以在这里存放所有最珍贵的物品。要打开你的银行，只需点击指示的柜台。

english: Banking
translation: 银行

english: This is the Bank of Gielinor, where you can store all your most valued items. To open your bank, just click on the indicated booth.
translation: 这里是Gielinor银行，你可以在这里存放所有最珍贵的物品。要打开你的银行，只需点击指示的柜台。

english: Banking This is your bank. You can store things here for safekeeping. To deposit something from your inventory, just click on it. You can withdraw things in the same way. To continue, close the bank and click on the indicated poll booth.
translation: 银行 这是你的银行。你可以在这里存放物品以保安全。要从背包中存入物品，只需点击它。取款方式相同。要继续，关闭银行并点击指示的投票亭。

english: This is your bank. You can store things here for safekeeping. To deposit something from your inventory, just click on it. You can withdraw things in the same way. To continue, close the bank and click on the indicated poll booth.
translation: 这是你的银行。你可以在这里存放物品以保安全。要从背包中存入物品，只需点击它。取款方式相同。要继续，关闭银行并点击指示的投票亭。

english: Voting is open to members with a skill total of 300. To preserve the old-school character of this game, an update must gain 70% support to be released.
translation: 投票对技能总等级达到300的会员开放。为了保持本游戏的怀旧特色，一项更新必须获得70%的支持才能发布。

english: Moving on Polls are run periodically to let the Old School RuneScape community vote on how the game should - or shouldn't - change. When you're ready, move on through the door indicated.
translation: 继续前进 投票定期进行，让Old School RuneScape社区投票决定游戏应该如何——或不应该——改变。准备好后，通过指示的门继续前进。

english: Polls are run periodically to let the Old School RuneScape community vote on how the game should - or shouldn't - change. When you're ready, move on through the door indicated.
translation: 投票定期进行，让Old School RuneScape社区投票决定游戏应该如何——或不应该——改变。准备好后，通过指示的门继续前进。

english: Account Management The guide here will tell you all about your account. Just click on him to hear what he's got to say.
translation: 帐号管理 这里的导师会告诉你关于你帐号的一切。只需点击他，听听他要说什么。

english: The guide here will tell you all about your account. Just click on him to hear what he's got to say.
translation: 这里的导师会告诉你关于你帐号的一切。只需点击他，听听他要说什么。

english: Account Management Click on the flashing icon to open your Account Management menu.
translation: 帐号管理 点击闪烁的图标打开你的帐号管理菜单。

english: Click on the flashing icon to open your Account Management menu.
translation: 点击闪烁的图标打开你的帐号管理菜单。

english: Account Management This is your Account Management menu where you can control various aspects of your account. Talk to the Account Guide to learn more.
translation: 帐号管理 这是你的帐号管理菜单，你可以在这里控制帐号的各个方面。与帐号导师交谈以了解更多。

english: This is your Account Management menu where you can control various aspects of your account. Talk to the Account Guide to learn more.
translation: 这是你的帐号管理菜单，你可以在这里控制帐号的各个方面。与帐号导师交谈以了解更多。

english: Moving on Continue through the next door.
translation: 继续前进 穿过下一扇门。

english: Continue through the next door.
translation: 穿过下一扇门。

english: Prayer menu Click on the flashing icon to open the Prayer menu.
translation: 祈祷菜单 点击闪烁的图标打开祈祷菜单。

english: Prayer menu
translation: 祈祷菜单

english: Click on the flashing icon to open the Prayer menu.
translation: 点击闪烁的图标打开祈祷菜单。

english: Prayer menu Talk with Brother Brace and he'll tell you about prayers.
translation: 祈祷菜单 与布雷斯修士交谈，他会告诉你关于祈祷的事。

english: Talk with Brother Brace and he'll tell you about prayers.
translation: 与布雷斯修士交谈，他会告诉你关于祈祷的事。

english: Your final instructor!
translation: 你的最后一位导师！

english: You're almost finished on tutorial island. Pass through the door to find the path leading to your final instructor.
translation: 你即将完成教程岛。穿过门，沿着路径找到你的最后一位导师。

english: Follow the path to the wizard's house, where you will be shown how to cast spells. When you get there, just talk with the magic instructor.
translation: 沿着路径前往法师的房屋，那里会教你如何施法。到达后，只需与魔法导师交谈。

english: Open up your final menu Open up the magic interface by clicking on the flashing icon.
translation: 打开你的最后一个菜单 点击闪烁的图标打开魔法界面。

english: Open up your final menu
translation: 打开你的最后一个菜单

english: Open up the magic interface by clicking on the flashing icon.
translation: 点击闪烁的图标打开魔法界面。

english: Magic This is your magic interface. All of your spells can be found here. The list is currently filtered to only show the spells you have the Magic level for. You can change this in the filter menu. Talk to the instructor to continue.
translation: 魔法 这是你的魔法界面。你所有的法术都可以在这里找到。清单目前被过滤为只显示你魔法等级允许的法术。你可以在过滤菜单中更改此设置。与导师交谈以继续。

english: This is your magic interface. All of your spells can be found here. The list is currently filtered to only show the spells you have the Magic level for. You can change this in the filter menu. Talk to the instructor to continue.
translation: 这是你的魔法界面。你所有的法术都可以在这里找到。清单目前被过滤为只显示你魔法等级允许的法术。你可以在过滤菜单中更改此设置。与导师交谈以继续。

english: Magic casting You now have some runes. All spells require runes to cast them. Look for the Wind Strike spell in your magic interface. Click on this spell to select it and then click on a chicken to cast it. Talk to the instructor if you need more runes.
translation: 施法 你现在有一些符文。所有法术都需要符文来施放。在你的魔法界面中找到风弹术法术。点击此法术选中它，然后点击一只鸡来施放。如果你需要更多符文，与导师交谈。

english: Magic casting
translation: 施法

english: You now have some runes. All spells require runes to cast them. Look for the Wind Strike spell in your magic interface. Click on this spell to select it and then click on a chicken to cast it. Talk to the instructor if you need more runes.
translation: 你现在有一些符文。所有法术都需要符文来施放。在你的魔法界面中找到风弹术法术。点击此法术选中它，然后点击一只鸡来施放。如果你需要更多符文，与导师交谈。

english: Congratulatiosn, you've completed a quest: Tutorial Island
translation: 恭喜，你完成了一个任务：教程岛

english: To the mainland!
translation: 前往大陆！

english: You're nearly finished with the tutorial. All you need to do now is move on to the mainland. Just speak with the magic instructor to continue.
translation: 你即将完成教程。现在你只需要前往大陆。只需与魔法导师交谈以继续。

english: [player name] is a friend. You can tell him.
translation: [player name] 是朋友。你可以告诉他。

english: [player name] is a friend. You can tell her.
translation: [player name]是朋友。你可以告诉她。

english: [player name] is a friend. You can tell them.
translation: [player name]是朋友。你可以告诉他们。

translation: 你把牛吼器举过头顶挥舞。

translation: 起初你觉得有点傻，但很快它发出了有趣的声音。

translation: 不过，似乎没发生什么大事。

english: You see some movement in the trees...
translation: 你看到树丛中有动静...

english: ...and a tall, dark, charismatic-looking man approaches you.
translation: ...一个高大、黝黑、魅力十足的男人向你走来。

english: Guojo approaches.
translation: 古朱奥走近了。

english: Gujuo disappears into the Kharazi Jungle as swiftly as he appeared...
translation: 古朱奥像出现时一样迅速消失在卡拉兹丛林中...

english: You start to swing the bullroarer above your head.
translation: 你开始把牛吼器举过头顶挥舞。

english: The roaring sound attracts a nearby Jungle Wolf!
translation: 咆哮声引来了一只附近的丛林狼！

english: The roaring sound attracts a nearby Oomlie Bird!
translation: 咆哮声引来了一只附近的奥利鸟！

english: The roaring sound attracts a nearby Tormented Warrior!
translation: 咆哮声引来了一名附近的被折磨的战士！

english: You're a bit too busy to do that at the moment.
translation: 你现在有点太忙了，没空做那个。

english: You search the rocks but see nothing significant.
translation: 你搜索了岩石，但没看到什么重要的东西。

english: You get cramped in the tiny space and start to suffocate.
translation: 你在狭小的空间里挤得难受，开始窒息。

english: You wriggle and wriggle but you cannot get out...
translation: 你扭来扭去，但就是出不去...

english: Eventually you manage to break free.
translation: 最终你设法挣脱了出来。

english: But you scrape yourself very badly as you force your way out.
translation: 但强行挤出来时，你把自己刮得很严重。

english: And you're totally exhausted from the ordeal.
translation: 而且这次经历让你精疲力竭。

english: You search the flea-infested rags...
translation: 你搜索了满是跳蚤的破布...

english: You find a scrap of paper with spidery writing on it.
translation: 你找到一张纸屑，上面有潦草的字迹。

english: You cannot find anything else in here.
translation: 你在这里找不到其他东西了。

english: You can't find anything else in here.
translation: 你在这里找不到其他东西了。

translation: 笔记到此结束。

english: You try your best to decode the writing...
translation: 你尽力解读这些文字...

translation: 你辨认出以下内容：

english: You finish reading the note.
translation: 你读完了笔记。

english: You approach the supernatural flames.
translation: 你靠近那超自然的火焰。

english: They give off an incredibly intense heat.
translation: 它们散发出极其强烈的热量。

english: You get too close and the intense heat burns you!
translation: 你靠得太近，强烈的热量灼伤了你！

english: You get close, but step back just in time to avoid getting burned. That could have been nasty!
translation: 你靠近了，但及时后退避免被烧伤。那可真危险！

english: Gujou disappears in the Kharazi Jungle as swiftly as he appeared...
translation: 古朱奥在卡拉兹丛林中消失得和他出现时一样迅速...

english: You forge a beautiful bowl from solid gowl.
translation: 你用坚固的高尔石锻造了一只精美的碗。

english: You need a Prayer level of at least 42 to complete this task.
translation: 你需要至少42级的祈祷等级才能完成此任务。

english: Gujuo places the bowl on the floor in front of you, and leads you into a deep meditation...
translation: 古朱奥将碗放在你面前的地板上，引导你进入深度冥想...

english: You splash some sacred water on the flames.
translation: 你向火焰洒了一些圣水。

english: This is quite dangerous, but you find a suitable location to jump.
translation: 这相当危险，但你找到了一个合适的跳跃位置。

english: You take a run up...
translation: 你助跑...

english: You sail over the top of the flame wall...
translation: 你飞越火焰墙的顶部...

english: Getting only slightly singed as you go.
translation: 经过时只是轻微烧焦。

english: You successfully squeeze through the crevice into a small tunnel.
translation: 你成功挤过裂缝进入一条小隧道。

english: You decide not to try and squeeze yourself into that ridiculously small crevice.
translation: 你决定不尝试挤进那个小得离谱的裂缝。

english: It looks like a crevice, you could possibly squeeze through.
translation: 看起来是个裂缝，你也许能挤过去。

english: You decide not to try and squeeze your way through the crevice.
translation: 你决定不尝试挤过裂缝。

english: The doors close with a satisfying click.
translation: 门带着令人满意的咔嗒声关上了。

english: You manage to smash the rock to bits.
translation: 你成功将岩石砸成碎片。

english: Another boulder drops down behind you.
translation: 另一块巨石从你身后落下。

english: You only succeed in scratching the rock.
translation: 你只是在岩石上划出了痕迹。

english: The pick clangs heavily against the rock face and the vibrations rattle your nerves.
translation: 镐重重地敲在岩壁上，震动让你的神经颤抖。

english: You decide against forcing the doors.
translation: 你决定不强行推门。

english: You prepare to jump over the crumbling wall.
translation: 你准备跳过那堵摇摇欲坠的墙壁。

english: You take a good run up and sail majestically over the wall.
translation: 你好好助跑，优雅地飞越墙壁。

english: You land perfectly!
translation: 你完美落地！

english: You fail to jump the wall properly and clip it with your leg.
translation: 你没能正确跳过墙壁，腿被绊了一下。

english: You're thrown off-balance, and hit the floor with a thud.
translation: 你失去平衡，砰的一声摔在地板上。

english: The fall knocks the wind out of you.
translation: 摔倒让你喘不过气来。

english: You don't see any way to use that.
translation: 你看不出那有什么用处。

english: Perhaps you should search the door?
translation: 也许你应该搜索那扇门？

english: ...and emerge in a large cavern filled with pools of water.
translation: ...并出现在一个充满水池的大型洞穴中。

english: You appear in a small walled cavern.
translation: 你出现在一个四面围墙的小洞穴中。

english: There seems to be an exit to the south east.
translation: 东南方似乎有一个出口。

english: There's nothing interesting about this remains.
translation: 这些遗骸没什么有趣的。

english: You see a faded inscription.
translation: 你看到一段褪色的铭文。

english: You see a faded inscription on the rock. 'Once there were crystals to make the pool shine. Ordered in stature to retrieve what's mine.'
translation: 你看到岩石上有一行褪色的铭文。'曾经有水晶让水池闪耀。按大小排列以取回属于我的东西。'

english: You carefully move the gem closer to the rock.
translation: 你小心地将宝石移近岩石。

english: But nothing happens.
translation: 但什么也没发生。

english: The gem soon begins to fade.
translation: 宝石很快开始褪色。

english: You feel a powerful force picking you up....
translation: 你感到一股强大的力量将你托起……

english: All the gems suddenly appear again...
translation: 所有宝石突然再次出现……

english: Suddenly the room is lit up with a brilliant light...
translation: 突然间房间被一道耀眼的光芒照亮……

english: ...Strangely a book appears near the middle of the room.
translation: ……奇怪的是，房间中央出现了一本书。

english: The holy water starts smoking on the demon's skin.
translation: 圣水在恶魔的皮肤上开始冒烟。

english: The demon starts to chant...
translation: 恶魔开始吟唱……

english: As he finishes the incantation, a powerful bolt of energy strikes you.
translation: 当他念完咒语时，一道强大的能量束击中了你。

english: The demon vanishes, leaving nothing but a pile of ashes where he stood.
translation: 恶魔消失了，原地只留下一堆灰烬。

english: You feel completely fine to walk through these flames.
translation: 你感觉完全能够安然穿过这些火焰。

english: The magic of Ungadulu's spell protects you from the flames.
translation: 昂加杜鲁的魔法保护你免受火焰伤害。

english: Ungadulu goes back to his studies.
translation: 昂加杜鲁回去继续他的研究了。

english: You mix the Ardigal into the Vial of Water.
translation: 你将阿迪加尔混入水瓶中。

english: You decide not to read the message.
translation: 你决定不阅读这条信息。

english: You feel yourself being pulled through the portal.
translation: 你感到自己被拉过传送门。

english: You see nothing special about this...
translation: 你发现这没什么特别的……

english: Perhaps with a rope, it might be a bit more functional.
translation: 也许有了绳子，它会更有用一些。

english: You throw a rope around the winch.
translation: 你将绳子绕在绞盘上。

english: But a terrible fear grips you...
translation: 但一股可怕的恐惧攫住了你……

english: And you can go no further.
translation: 你无法再前进一步。

english: Fear stabs at your heart...
translation: 恐惧刺痛了你的心……

english: ...and your hands become sweaty.
translation: ……你的双手开始出汗。

english: You lose your grip on the rope and fall into the pit!
translation: 你失去了对绳子的抓握，掉进了坑里！

english: You don't think this is a safe way down.
translation: 你觉得这不是一条安全的下行路线。

english: The clothes slump to the floor again after he has finished.
translation: 他完成后，衣服再次瘫倒在地板上。

english: The clothes slump to the floor again.
translation: 衣服再次瘫倒在地板上。

english: The spirit of Viyeldi crumples back into a pile of clothes. You may have hurt his feelings.
translation: 维耶尔迪的灵魂又缩回成一堆衣服。你可能伤了他的感情。

english: You step confidently onto the rocky ledge.
translation: 你自信地踏上岩石壁架。

english: You climb confidently over the rocks and hold your balance well.
translation: 你自信地爬过岩石，保持得很好。

english: You carefully step forward onto the pathway.
translation: 你小心地踏上小路。

english: You start to climb the precarious rocks.
translation: 你开始攀爬危险的岩石。

english: You feel a little nervous from your near fall...
translation: 刚才差点摔倒让你有点紧张……

english: You lose some Agility!
translation: 你失去了一些敏捷！

english: You wrench your arm as you grab for a handhold.
translation: 你伸手抓握点时扭伤了手臂。

english: You take a nasty fall down the side of the cliff...
translation: 你从悬崖边重重摔下……

english: ...but you use your Agility to avoid any damage.
translation: ……但你用敏捷避开了伤害。

english: ...and take light damage.
translation: ……并受到轻微伤害。

english: You easily climb over the rocks...
translation: 你轻松地翻过了岩石...

english: You attempt to climb over the rocks.
translation: 你试图翻过岩石。

english: You climb over the rocks quite easily.
translation: 你相当轻松地翻过了岩石。

english: You decide not to climb the rocks.
translation: 你决定不翻过岩石。

english: Ranalph Devere: Upon my honour I will defend the source to the bitter end.
translation: 拉纳尔夫.德维尔：以我的荣誉起誓，我将誓死守护源头。

english: Ranalph Devere: May your aim be true, challenger.
translation: 拉纳尔夫.德维尔：愿你的准头无误，挑战者。

english: Irvig Senay: Upon my honour I will defend the source to the bitter end.
translation: 伊尔维格.塞奈：以我的荣誉起誓，我将誓死守护源头。

english: Irvig Senay: Ready your weapon and defend yourself.
translation: 伊尔维格.塞奈：准备好你的武器，保护好自己。

english: You see a heart-shaped depression in the wall. A message reads... All ye who stand 'ere the dragons teeth, Place your full true heart within, and proceed...
translation: 你看到墙上有一个心形的凹陷。上面写着...凡立于龙牙之前者，将你真诚的心放入其中，继续前行...

english: These rocks look somehow manufactured.
translation: 这些岩石看起来像是人工制造的。

english: As the crystal touches your hands a voice inside of your head says... Bring life to the dragon's eye.
translation: 当水晶触碰到你的双手时，一个声音在你脑海中响起...为龙之眼赋予生命。

english: The shapeless form slowly floats towards you.
translation: 无形的形体缓缓向你飘来。

english: The spirit slowly fades and then disappears.
translation: 灵魂渐渐消散，然后消失了。

english: You thrust the dark dagger at Viyeldi...
translation: 你将黑暗匕首刺向维耶尔迪...

english: You hit Viyeldi squarely with the dagger.
translation: 你用匕首正中维耶尔迪。

english: You see an ominous light flow from Viyeldi's body into the dagger.
translation: 你看到一道不祥的光芒从维耶尔迪的身体流入匕首中。

english: The dagger glows brightly as Viyeldi crumples to the floor.
translation: 维耶尔迪瘫倒在地，匕首发出耀眼的光芒。

english: You thrust the Holy Force spell in front of the spirit.
translation: 你将圣力法术释放在灵魂面前。

english: A bright, holy light streams out from the page.
translation: 一道明亮的神圣之光从书页中射出。

english: The spirit lets out an unearthly, blood-curdling scream.
translation: 灵魂发出一声恐怖的、令人毛骨悚然的尖叫。

english: A terrible fear comes over you...
translation: 一股可怕的恐惧笼罩了你...

english: You feel a terrible sense of loss...
translation: 你感到一种可怕的失落感...

english: The Holy Force spell seems to weaken the demon.
translation: 圣力法术似乎削弱了恶魔。

english: Nezikchened: Perish, Vacu!
translation: 内齐克切内德：消亡吧，瓦库！

english: A sense of loss and dread comes over you.
translation: 一种失落和恐惧的感觉笼罩了你。

english: Echned Zekin: Foolish Vacu! Thou hast fallen for my tricks...
translation: 埃克内德.泽金：愚蠢的瓦库！你已落入我的圈套...

english: Echned Zekin: Now, look upon my true face... and know thy doom!
translation: 埃克内德.泽金：现在，看看我的真面目...迎接你的末日吧！

english: The demon takes out a dark dagger and throws it at you.
translation: 恶魔取出一把黑暗匕首向你掷来。

english: But you neatly manage to dodge the attack.
translation: 但你巧妙地躲过了这次攻击。

english: The dagger hits you with an agonising blow.
translation: 匕首击中了你，带来一阵剧痛。

english: The rock is motionless and impossible to budge.
translation: 岩石纹丝不动，无法移动。

english: The demon seems very angry now...
translation: 恶魔现在看起来非常愤怒...

english: Nezikchened: Still thou seekst to challenge me?!
translation: 内齐克切内德：你还要挑战我吗？！

english: You deliver a final, devastating blow.
translation: 你发出了最后一击，毁灭性的打击。

english: Nezikchened's unearthly frame crumbles into dust.
translation: 内齐克切内德的非人躯体化为灰烬。

english: You attempt to push the boulder out of the way.
translation: 你试图推开挡路的巨石。

english: You don't seem to be able to push it from this angle.
translation: 从这个角度你似乎推不动它。

english: You push the boulder out of the way.
translation: 你将巨石推开。

english: This boulder has already
translation: 这块巨石已经

english: You plant the Yommi tree seed in the soil.
translation: 你将约米树种子种入土壤中。

english: It starts to grow at a remarkable rate.
translation: 它以惊人的速度开始生长。

english: It looks as if this Yommi tree needs to be watered.
translation: 看起来这棵约米树需要浇水。

english: You water the Yommi tree from the Golden Bowl...
translation: 你用金碗给约米树浇水……

english: It grows at a remarkable rate...
translation: 它以惊人的速度生长……

english: Soon the tree stops growing.
translation: 很快树停止了生长。

english: It looks tall enough now to make a good-sized totem pole.
translation: 现在它看起来足够高了，可以做成一根像样的图腾柱。

english: You prepare to chop the Yommi tree.
translation: 你准备砍伐约米树。

english: You chop the Yommi tree down.
translation: 你砍倒了约米树。

english: You professionally wield your axe...
translation: 你熟练地挥舞着斧头……

english: This totem pole looks very heavy.....
translation: 这根图腾柱看起来很重……

english: But you manage to lift it.
translation: 但你设法把它举了起来。

english: Nezikchened: And now thou seekst to defile my sanctuary...
translation: 内齐克切内德：现在你竟敢玷污我的圣所……

english: Nezikchened: I will teach thee a final lesson!!
translation: 内齐克切内德：我要给你上最后一课！！

english: The demon begins to chant...
translation: 恶魔开始吟唱……

english: Nezikchened: do not rest while this Vacu draws breath!
translation: 内齐克切内德：只要这个瓦库还活着，就别想休息！

english: [Hero]: Corrupted we are now Viyeldi was slain..
translation: [Hero]：我们已被腐化，维耶尔迪已被杀害……

english: [Hero]: Slaves to this demon and forced to bring pain...
translation: [Hero]：成为这恶魔的奴隶，被迫带来痛苦……

english: A nerve tingling scream echoes around you as you slay San Tojalon.
translation: 当你杀死桑.托贾隆时，一声刺耳的尖叫在你周围回荡。

english: San Tojalon: Argh!
translation: 桑.托贾隆：啊！

english: San Tojalon: I beg you... slay the beast! Free me from this torment!
translation: 桑.托贾隆：我求求你……杀死那野兽！让我摆脱这折磨！

english: A nerve tingling scream echoes around you
translation: 一声刺耳的尖叫在你周围回荡

english: Irvig Senay: Argh!
translation: 伊尔维格.塞奈：啊！

english: Irvig Senay: Doomed! Doomed to eternal torment...
translation: 伊尔维格.塞奈：注定！注定要受永恒的折磨……

english: Ranalph Devere: Argh!
translation: 拉纳尔夫.德维尔：啊！

english: Ranalph Deverey: Forever will I languish in torment...
translation: 拉纳尔夫.德维尔：我将永远在折磨中煎熬……

english: Ranalph Deverey: ...until the beast is slain!
translation: 拉纳尔夫.德维尔：……直到那野兽被杀死！

english: The demon screams in rage...
translation: 恶魔愤怒地嘶吼……

english: Nezikchened: Graaaaargh!
translation: 内齐克切内德：嘎啊啊啊啊！

english: Nezikchened: I'll kill thee myself!
translation: 内齐克切内德：我要亲手杀了你！

english: You feel a great sense of loss...
translation: 你感到一阵巨大的失落……

english: You deliver the final killing blow to the foul demon.
translation: 你对那邪恶的恶魔发出了致命一击。

This flag was not only carried into battle, but also had pride of place at the top of this outpost in the years known as The Dreaded Years of Tragedy'.

english: Rologarric,
translation: 罗洛加里克，

english: I am writing to you, my brother, to ask for your aid, and to forgive me on behalf of all the poor souls that I have sacrificed to save my own neck. I have no doubt that my own soul lies forfeit, but I would wish to see you once again before I am cast into the eternal fire. You well know the history of our noble ancestors, who have stood against the wave of darkness covering all of Morytania, protecting the inhabitants of this castle by sheer force of personality. I, however, stand lacking in their all too dominating shadow. I have been weak, my brother, letting him rule in my stead.
translation: 我写信给你，我的兄弟，请求你的帮助，并代我向所有为了保住自己性命而牺牲的可怜灵魂请求宽恕。我毫不怀疑自己的灵魂已注定毁灭，但在被投入永恒之火前，我希望能再见你一面。你深知我们高贵祖先的历史，他们以纯粹的人格力量对抗笼罩整个莫利塔尼亚的黑暗浪潮，保护着这座城堡的居民。然而，我却缺乏他们那压倒性的阴影。我一直很软弱，我的兄弟，让他代替我统治。

english: You know of whom I speak but dare not name - my 'doctor' of many years, the very same creature you sought to escape ten years ago. He advised me that the power in the South was rising, and soon our ancestral home would fall to the growing evil. He advised me to send a gift of tribute to the vampires, to satisfy their hunger for at least a while. I regret to say that I acceded to this request. I ordered a young girl out into the forest to pick mushrooms, knowing that I was sending her to her death, or worse, her undeath.
translation: 你知道我说的是谁，却不敢说出名字——我多年的'医生'，正是十年前你试图逃离的那个生物。他告诉我南方的力量正在崛起，我们祖先的家园很快就会落入日益增长的邪恶之手。他建议我向吸血鬼们进贡礼物，以满足他们的饥渴至少一段时间。我很遗憾地说，我同意了这一请求。我命令一个年轻女孩去森林里采蘑菇，明知我是把她送向死亡，或者更糟，送向不死。

english: Of course, soon after my advisor told me that the vampires were again restive, and to send another 'gift' And of course, this I did, to ensure the safety of everyone in the castle.
translation: 当然，不久之后我的顾问告诉我吸血鬼们又开始躁动不安，要我送出另一份'礼物'。当然，我照做了，以确保城堡里所有人的安全。

english: But a vampire's hunger can never be sated. Every innocent soul I have sent into the Forest to their doom both strengthens their power and increases their hunger.
translation: 但吸血鬼的饥渴永远无法满足。我送入森林的每一个无辜灵魂，既增强了他们的力量，也加剧了他们的饥渴。

english: He knows this. I look into his eyes and see amusement. In his eyes I see the truth - that he must have struck a deal with them some time ago. He sold my people to them in exchange for... this castle.
translation: 他知道这一点。我看着他的眼睛，看到的是戏谑。在他眼中我看到了真相——他一定在很久以前就与他们达成了交易。他把我的子民卖给了他们，以换取……这座城堡。

english: I have sent them all to their doom, and now I fear my own.
translation: 我把他们都送向了毁灭，现在我开始害怕自己的命运。

translation: 罗洛加斯，

english: 15th Lord of the North Coast
translation: 北海海岸第十五代领主

english: Dear Elstan,
translation: 亲爱的埃尔斯坦，

english: I have followed with enthusiasm your recent series of papers on the subject of cross-pollinating flowers in the B-branch of the alpha sub-family of the specialist flowers. Especially your last presentation at the Annual Asgarnia Gardening Conference was impressive and inspirational, even if other attendants didn't show much interest. They must not share our vision.
translation: 我一直满怀热情地关注着你最近关于特种花卉阿尔法亚科B分支异花授粉的系列论文。尤其是你在年度阿斯加尼亚园艺会议上最后一次演讲，令人印象深刻且鼓舞人心，尽管其他与会者似乎兴趣不大。他们一定没有我们的远见。

english: After returning to my home, I started with some experiments of my own and have found that certain combinations of cross-pollination leads to triple herbicide resistance in cabbages. Practical applications of this discovery seem unlikely, but the theoretical implications are astounding! I'm looking foreward to publishing my results at the next conference. Perhaps it can be hosted in Keldagrim next time? Although I'm not sure how the underground setting would go down with the other farmers.
translation: 回到家后，我开始进行自己的实验，发现某些异花授粉组合能使卷心菜产生三重除草剂抗性。这一发现的实际应用似乎不太可能，但理论意义令人震惊！我期待在下一次会议上发表我的成果。也许下次可以在凯尔达格林城举办？虽然我不确定地下环境对农民们来说会是什么感觉。

english: Kind Regards,
translation: 此致，

english: Rind, Gardener of the Palace of Keldagrim.
translation: 林德，凯尔达格林城宫殿园丁。

english: Child of Yama,
translation: 阎魔之子，

english: I have left the items you requested at the usual drop-off, courtesy of the Kourend Treasury. It goes without saying, but I trust you will make our master aware of who is funding his return.
translation: 我已将你要求的物品放在惯常的交接点，由库兰德王国财政部提供。不言而喻，我相信你会让我们的主人知道是谁在资助他的回归。

english: Regards, Sophia Hughes
translation: 此致，索菲娅.休斯

english: Vargas, I'm sorry to tell you I won't be declaring war. Your Regent has uncovered a plot to make us distrust each other, and I'd rather have my own reasons to go to war than be tricked into it.
translation: 瓦尔加斯，很抱歉告诉你我不会宣战。你的摄政王发现了一个让我们互相猜忌的阴谋，我宁愿有自己的理由开战，也不愿被欺骗卷入战争。

english: And if you ever find someone to take that yeti curse off you, please let me know. You're a warmongering fool, but so am I. I think we'd be well suited to each other.
translation: 如果你找到能解除你身上雪人诅咒的人，请告诉我。你是个好战的傻瓜，但我也是。我觉得我们很相配。

english: Dearest Varmen,
translation: 亲爱的瓦尔门，

english: I hope this finds you well. Here are the books you asked for. There has been an exciting development closer to home—another city from the same period has been discovered east of Varrock, and we are starting a huge excavation project here. I don't know if the museum will be able to finance your expedition as well as this one, so I fear your current trip will be the last.
translation: 希望你一切安好。这是你要的书。家附近有了令人兴奋的进展——维洛克城以东发现了同一时期的另一座城市，我们正在那里启动一个大型发掘项目。我不知道博物馆是否还能同时资助你的考察，所以我担心你这次旅行将是最后一次。

english: May Saradomin grant you a safe journey home.
translation: 愿萨拉多明保佑你平安归家。

english: Your loving Elissa.
translation: 爱你的艾丽莎。

english: Troubleshooting your AMCE Lift-In-A-Box
translation: AMCE箱装升降机故障排除

english: 'My lift doesn't work!'
translation: '我的升降机不工作！'

english: 1. Have you added the pulleys? Make sure you have a long top beam with a pulley, and pulleys on the two crossbeams. We recommend AMCE Pulley- Beams-In-A-Box.
translation: 1. 你安装了滑轮吗？确保你有一根带滑轮的长顶梁，以及两根横梁上的滑轮。我们推荐AMCE箱装滑轮梁。

english: 2. Have you attached a rope? Wind one of your AMCE Ropes-In-A-Box through the pulleys.
translation: 2. 你系了绳子吗？将一根AMCE箱装绳子穿过滑轮。

english: 3. Is the platform broken? Repair it with one of your AMCE Beams-In-A-Box. 4. Have you added the engine? The AMCE Lift-In-A-Box does not include an engine.
translation: 3. 平台坏了吗？用一根AMCE箱装梁修理它。4. 你安装了引擎吗？AMCE箱装升降机不包含引擎。

english: 5. Have you added coal to the engine? All compatible coal engines have a maximum load of five chunks of coal.
translation: 5. 你给引擎加煤了吗？所有兼容的燃煤引擎最大负载为五块煤。
