english: Your actions are being watched. We know what you are trying to do and the VPSG will stop you! Do not attempt to leave the palace or you will be arrested on sight. We will not hesitate to kill you if you disobey King Roald's orders.
translation: 你的行动正受到监视。我们知道你想做什么，VPSG会阻止你！不要试图离开宫殿，否则你将被当场逮捕。如果你违抗罗尔德国王的命令，我们会毫不犹豫地杀死你。

english: Sell ecumenical keys for 61,500 coins?
translation: 出售普世钥匙换取61,500金币？

english: I've upgraded your Wilderness Sword for you. It can now teleport you to the Fountain of Rune once per day.
translation: 我已经为你升级了荒野之剑。现在它每天可以传送你到符文喷泉一次。

english: You'll also get 50% more lava shards when grinding scales and even cheaper access to the Resource Area.
translation: 研磨鳞片时你还会获得50%更多的熔岩碎片，进入资源区的费用也更便宜。

english: You can now own 5 ecumenical keys, and Lundail will give you 120 free runes each day.
translation: 你现在可以持有5把普世钥匙，伦代尔每天会给你120个免费符文。

english: You can also telegrab Wine of Zamorak from spanws in the Wilderness in banknote for, and control which Obelisk you want to travel to.
translation: 你还可以用远程抓取法术从荒野的刷新点获取扎莫拉克葡萄酒，并以票据形式获得，还能选择你想传送到的方尖碑。

english: You'll also receive further increased rewards from the chests in Rogues' Castle. Finally, I'll be willing to buy ecumenical keys off you for 61,500 coins each.
translation: 你从盗贼城堡的宝箱中获得的奖励也会进一步增加。最后，我愿意以每把61,500金币的价格向你收购普世钥匙。

english: Finally, you can now access the lairs of Artio, Spindel and Calvar'ion, three fearsome Wilderness bosses, without requiring a Slayer assignment.
translation: 最后，你现在可以进入阿提奥、斯平德尔和卡尔瓦里昂的巢穴，这三个可怕的荒野Boss，无需杀戮任务。

english: Have you visited the library recently? I find most of the books there to not be worth looking at, but I hear they've recently added some of Duke Quirinius' work. Be sure to take a look when you're next up there, but when you do, I'd recommend taking careful note of each book's location. Oh, and remember: Various people emerged near us.
translation: 你最近去过图书馆吗？我觉得那里大部分书都不值得一看，但我听说他们最近收录了奎里尼乌斯公爵的一些作品。下次去的时候一定要看看，不过去的时候，我建议你仔细记下每本书的位置。哦，还有，记住：我们附近出现了各种人。

translation: 自从你走后日子不太好过

english: We're all getting on alright
translation: 我们都过得还不错

english: Everyone's been asking I've been telling everyone our Antonia's been sailing up and down the coast rubbing shoulders with the Aldarin nobles and partying with strangers with horns on their hats! Don't forget us when you're rich and famous!
translation: 大家都在问你的近况，我跟所有人说我们的安东尼娅正在沿海岸航行，和阿尔达林岛的贵族们称兄道弟，和帽子上带角的陌生人开派对！等你飞黄腾达了可别忘了我们！

english: We all miss

translation: 好了，我听到你母亲喊我吃饭了，就写到这里吧。很快见。照顾好自己。照顾好自己。

english: Hi Mum!
translation: 妈妈你好！

english: The Sunset Coast is so beautiful. I wish you could all come and visit! The ferry business is booming with all these new travellers wanting to visit Aldarin. I heard all about the trouble you've been having, so I've sent back a bit of gold to help with the roof repairs. Let me know when you get it! I'm hoping to travel up to see you soon, when the season's over and I can spare the time off work.
translation: 日落海岸太美了。真希望你们都能来看看！渡船生意因为那些想去阿尔达林岛的新游客而蒸蒸日上。我听说了你们遇到的麻烦，所以寄回了一些金子帮忙修屋顶。收到后告诉我一声！我打算等旺季结束能请假的时候北上看看你们。

english: Send my love to Grandpa,
translation: 代我向爷爷问好，

translation: 你放走了勒特维克，它们匆匆跑进这个陌生的环境。

english: Maybe I shouldn't have done that.
translation: 也许我不该这么做。

english: A letvek crawls into one of your buckets. It looks ready to drink sap.
translation: 一只勒特维克爬进了你的一个桶里。它看起来准备喝树液。

english: You should get rid of the letvek in your bucket before it drinks up all of your sap.
translation: 你应该把桶里的勒特维克赶走，免得它把你的树液全喝光。

english: You gently shoo the letvek.
translation: 你轻轻地把勒特维克赶走了。

english: Feed the letvek your sap?
translation: 把你的树液喂给勒特维克？

english: The letvek happily laps up the sap and scurries away.
translation: 勒特维克开心地舔光了树液，然后匆匆跑开了。

translation: 独角兽 - 仑桥镇沼泽西侧

english: She came to Lithkren. Restricting her island wasn't enough apparently. She now wants us to leave this one as well. She is naive. We may be safe from the humans now, but they will find us eventually. Once they do, they will not hesitate to destroy her. My way is the only way.
translation: 她来到了利斯克伦。限制她的岛屿显然还不够。她现在还想让我们也离开这座岛。她太天真了。我们现在或许能躲开人类，但他们最终会找到我们。一旦找到，他们会毫不犹豫地摧毁她。我的方法才是唯一的出路。

english: Another setback. Once again the humans are responsible. They found the island and launched an attack. As planned, the emergency protocol was enacted and the vault was sealed. Unfortunately, I was still inside it when this happened.
translation: 又一个挫折。又是人类的错。他们发现了这座岛并发起了攻击。按计划，紧急预案启动，金库被封闭。不幸的是，发生这一切时我还在里面。

english: Although I may be trapped here, this could still work to my advantage. There are more than enough samples and materials in storage here. If all goes well, I should still have everything I need to finish our work.
translation: 虽然我可能被困在这里，但这也许对我有利。这里的存储中有足够的样本和材料。如果一切顺利，我应该还有完成我们工作所需的一切。

english: As my work continues, I've decided to explore a couple of side projects. Inspired by the fool, Forcae, I've decided to try and infuse dragon eggs with metal. With his metal dragons, Forcae was hoping to find a solution to our infertility. I on the other hand, will use them for a different purpose. War.
translation: 随着工作的继续，我决定探索一些附带项目。受那个傻瓜福尔凯的启发，我决定尝试将龙蛋与金属融合。福尔凯希望用他的金属龙找到解决我们不育问题的方法。而我则会用它们达到另一个目的——战争。

english: I've lost track of how long I've been here. It's clear to me now that the humans must have bested the others. This isn't overly surprising, our kind was immune to their weapons for so long that we allowed ourselves to become reckless. A foolish mistake. We'd heard of the Necrosyrtes who had fallen on Kethsi. We should have known the humans would find those weapons, but we were arrogant. By the time we realised, it was too late.
translation: 我已经记不清在这里待了多久。现在我很清楚，人类一定已经击败了其他人。这并不太令人意外，我们这类生物对他们的武器免疫了太久，以至于变得鲁莽。这是个愚蠢的错误。我们听说过凯特西陨落的死灵鹫。我们本应知道人类会找到那些武器，但我们太傲慢了。等我们意识到时，已经太晚了。

english: I am making good progress. So much so that I've started thinking about how to leave the vault once the weapon is complete. The seals on this place, both physical and magical, are not insignificant. Teleporting isn't an option, we made sure of that. The walls are reinforced by numerous enchantments, as are the doors themselves. Much of it is tied to the key. If it is placed in the doors, most of the protections will be disabled. Without it though, this could be a difficult process.
translation: 我进展顺利。以至于我开始考虑武器完成后如何离开金库。这个地方的封印，无论是物理还是魔法，都不容小觑。传送不是选项，我们确保了这一点。墙壁被无数附魔加固，门也是如此。其中大部分与钥匙相连。如果钥匙插入门中，大部分防护将被禁用。但如果没有钥匙，这将是个艰难的过程。

english: I rarely bother myself with the costs of our trials. However, at times, even I must admit that the price we are paying is steep. We have experimented on so many, even our own kind, all for what has so far amounted to very little. Still, I know our cause is right. Once humanity is destroyed, we will be free of the disease that has nearly destroyed us.
translation: 我很少为试验的代价操心。然而，有时连我也必须承认我们付出的代价是沉重的。我们在如此多的对象上做实验，甚至包括我们自己的同类，而到目前为止收获甚微。尽管如此，我知道我们的事业是正确的。一旦人类被消灭，我们将摆脱那几乎毁灭我们的疾病。

english: ... and so, the Council of Avarrocka gathered to discuss the matter of Arrav. There was Tarrlo Remanis, Khom Prysin, Dathero Raispher, Marv Halen, Ramone Ravitz and Laris Gontamue. It was clear to all that the dream was the most dire of signs. Something had to be done about it...
translation: ……于是，阿瓦罗卡议会聚集讨论阿拉夫之事。与会者有塔洛·雷马尼斯、科姆·普赖辛、达塞罗·雷斯弗、马尔夫·哈伦、拉莫内·拉维茨和拉里斯·贡塔穆。所有人都清楚那个梦是最凶险的征兆。必须对此采取行动……

english: Are sure you want to make the Ferocious Gloves? (This will make them untradeable)
translation: 确定要制作狂暴手套吗？（这将使其不可交易）

english: It would appear that our cunning at the Battle of Carrallanger has not gone unnoticed. Impressed by our work, Zamorak himself has personally given us our next mission. For our lord himself to give out a mission is rare. It is clear that this is something of great importance to him.
translation: 看来我们在卡拉兰格战役中的机智并未被忽视。扎莫拉克本人对我们的表现印象深刻，亲自交给了我们下一个任务。主上亲自下达任务实属罕见。显然这对他来说极为重要。

english: There is an air of excitement amongst the group. I even think I saw the General smiling earlier. It's not hard to see why. If we succeed in this task, we will become some of Zamorak's most trusted.
translation: 队伍中弥漫着兴奋的气氛。我甚至觉得刚才看到将军在微笑。原因不难理解。如果我们成功完成这项任务，将成为扎莫拉克最信任的人。

english: The General does not want to waste any time. We depart for Karamja tomorrow. He aims to have the job done within a week.
translation: 将军不想浪费任何时间。我们明天出发前往卡拉姆詹岛。他的目标是一周内完成任务。

english: Travelling through a world at war is no simple task, even for us. As such, it has taken us a couple of days to reach Karamja. We now begin our search of the island.
translation: 穿越战火纷飞的世界并非易事，即使对我们来说也是如此。因此，我们花了几天时间才到达卡拉姆詹岛。现在我们开始搜索这座岛屿。

english: The information provided was vague, but Zamorak believed we would find the temple on the southern part of the island. I never did ask about the source of Zamorak's information, but I doubt he would have answered anyway. Zamorak plays his cards close to his chest, likely looking to avoid failing into the trap that he himself sprung on his predecessor.
translation: 提供的信息很模糊，但扎莫拉克相信我们会在岛屿南部找到神庙。我从未问过扎莫拉克信息的来源，但估计他也不会回答。扎莫拉克行事谨慎，很可能是想避免重蹈他前任的覆辙。

english: It took another day of searching, but we think we've found it. The architecture is very unique and matches Zamorak's description, but it looks like we may face a couple of challenges before the job is done.
translation: 又搜索了一天，但我们觉得找到了。建筑风格非常独特，与扎莫拉克的描述相符，但看来在完成任务之前，我们可能会面临一些挑战。

english: The temple takes the form of a maze, one that is protected by numerous traps and guarded by some strange automations. It's clear that whoever stored the artefact here did not wish for it to be recovered. Unluckily for them, they underestimated the forces of Zamorak. We will not be halted by a few measly traps. Soon we will present the artefact to Zamorak and with it, he will win this war.
translation: 神庙呈迷宫形态，受到众多陷阱的保护，并由一些奇怪的自动装置守卫。显然，将文物存放在这里的人不希望它被找回。对他们来说不幸的是，他们低估了扎莫拉克的力量。区区几个陷阱阻挡不了我们。很快我们就会将文物献给扎莫拉克，凭借它，他将赢得这场战争。

english: This mission means a lot to all of us, but especially to the General. He has always been a loyal servant to Zamorak, but his deeds have often been hidden behind those of the more notable generals, such as Thammaron. This mission could well be what changes that. This is his chance to show Zamorak that he is worthy enough to be one of his most trusted.
translation: 这次任务对我们所有人都意义重大，尤其是对将军而言。他一直忠于扎莫拉克，但他的功绩常常被塔马隆等更著名的将军所掩盖。这次任务很可能改变这一切。这是他向扎莫拉克证明自己值得成为最受信任之人的机会。

english: The General has wasted no time. Into the temple he leads us. Ahead, the artefact awaits.
translation: 将军毫不耽搁。他带领我们进入神庙。前方，文物在等待着我们。

english: We have been betrayed, by none other than our great General. As expected, we reached the artefact with few issues. The defences of this place not enough to stop us. However, that's when our leader revealed his treachery, too late for us to stop it.
translation: 我们被背叛了，背叛者正是我们伟大的将军。果然，我们几乎没遇到什么麻烦就到达了文物所在处。这里的防御不足以阻挡我们。然而，就在那时我们的领袖暴露了他的背叛，我们想阻止已经太迟了。

english: He took the artefact from its pedestal and turned to face us. Before we could react, he launched a barrage of demonic magic towards us. Many were killed instantly, but I foolishly tried to flee. In my haste, I took a wrong turn and found myself in one of the traps that littered the maze. I realised too late what had happened and I was unable to stop myself getting hit by it.
translation: 他从基座上取下文物，转身面对我们。我们还没来得及反应，他就朝我们发射了一连串恶魔魔法。许多人当场毙命，但我愚蠢地试图逃跑。匆忙之中我转错了弯，发现自己陷入了迷宫中的一处陷阱。我意识到发生了什么时已经太晚，无法阻止自己被击中。

english: This is where it ends for me. Unable to walk, I managed to crawl into one of the dead ends of this infernal maze. Here, I am safe from the automations that patrol this place, but alas, the damage is already done.
translation: 这就是我的终点了。无法行走，我设法爬进了这座地狱迷宫的一个死胡同。在这里，我躲开了巡逻此地的自动装置，但唉，伤害已经造成了。

english: My leg is heavily bleeding and I can feel my energy slipping away. Alone and abandoned, I realise none are coming to help, so I sit here and I curse. I curse our great General for his great treachery. For betraying us all. Skotizo! Why have you forsaken us?
translation: 我的腿大量出血，我能感觉到体力在流失。孤独而被遗弃，我意识到不会有人来救我，所以我坐在这里诅咒。我诅咒我们伟大的将军，诅咒他巨大的背叛，诅咒他背叛了我们所有人。斯科蒂佐！你为何抛弃了我们？

english: This contract will unlock the ability to choose Demonic Skin (red) during a makeover. Would you like to hand it in?
translation: 这份契约将解锁在整容时选择恶魔皮肤（红色）的能力。你要上交它吗？

translation: 这将消耗掉这份契约。

english: The Wise Old Man is telling you that teleports are blocked, and there will be no way to retrieve your items if you die in here.
translation: 老智者告诉你传送被封锁了，如果你死在这里将无法取回你的物品。

english: Meet me inside the pyramid at the Necropolis as soon as you can. It's time to face the Devourer.
translation: 尽快到 Necropolis 的金字塔里来找我。是时候面对吞噬者了。

english: Notes on my fellow Mahjarrat
translation: 关于我的玛哈加特同胞的笔记

english: Akthanakos has re-emerged. Apparently, he and Enakhra were engaged in a continual struggle for thousands of years. He still lives those outdated Zarosian ideals. I just don't get it. I know Zaros freed us, but he'll never understand the path of chaos. If Akthanakos can be caught, he could be a good choice for a sacrifice soon.
translation: 阿克塔纳科斯重新出现了。显然，他和伊纳克拉进行了数千年的持续斗争。他仍然信奉那些过时的扎罗斯理想。我就是不明白。我知道扎罗斯解放了我们，但他永远不会理解混沌之路。如果能抓住阿克塔纳科斯，他很快就会成为祭品的好选择。

english: A powerful adversary and Zaros's champion. Has been contained since the God Wars. We have not dared free him for a ritual yet. We should do so soon, while Zamorakian numbers are still high enough to handle him.
translation: 一个强大的对手，扎罗斯的冠军。自神战以来一直被囚禁。我们一直不敢释放他来举行仪式。我们应该尽快这么做，趁扎莫拉克信徒的数量还足以对付他。

english: Reports indicate that Zaros's champion is free. This is bad news - he is a real danger. We should be vigilant. The next ritual could be a real test.
translation: 报告显示扎罗斯的冠军已经自由了。这是坏消息——他是个真正的威胁。我们必须保持警惕。下一次仪式可能是一次真正的考验。

english: Bilrach is of average power for our kind. He seems willing to go along with what I suggest, so he will be useful for now.
translation: 比尔拉赫在我们种族中实力中等。他似乎愿意听从我的建议，所以目前他还有用。

english: The next ritual approaches and unusually, Bilrach is yet to have appeared. I wonder what he's up to.
translation: 下一次仪式临近了，但不同寻常的是，比尔拉赫还没有出现。我很好奇他在搞什么鬼。

english: Another who has not been seen since the God Wars, but whose presence is still felt. She would seem to be the only surviving female Mahjarrat left on this plane.
translation: 另一个自神战以来就未曾露面的人，但她的存在感仍然存在。她似乎是这个位面上唯一幸存的女性玛哈加特。

english: Well, Enakhra has re-emerged at last. She reported to us that she had been in a continual struggle with Akthanakos all this time. I'd hoped her return might have meant an opportunity to sire more of our race, but she spurned my offer. Pah!
translation: 好吧，伊纳克拉终于重新出现了。她向我们报告说她一直与阿克塔纳科斯进行持续斗争。我曾希望她的回归可能意味着繁衍我们种族的机会，但她拒绝了我的提议。哼！

english: One of the Zamorak-aligned faction. A worthy warrior. Generally, I'd consider Hazeel an ally.
translation: 扎莫拉克阵营的一员。一位值得尊敬的战士。总的来说，我认为哈兹尔是盟友。

english: Hazeel seems to be gaining in power. He has gained many followers and much territory.
translation: 哈兹尔似乎正在变强。他获得了许多追随者和大量领土。

english: Disaster has struck for Hazeel: Saradomin-worshipping human filth have conquered his teritory and put him into a state of torpor. The question is, will his followers be able to revive him before the next ritual?
translation: 哈兹尔遭遇了灾难：崇拜萨拉多明的卑劣人类征服了他的领土，使他陷入休眠状态。问题是，他的追随者能否在下一次仪式前唤醒他？

english: Well, his followers may have left things rather last- minute, but they've managed it - Hazeel is back in play!
translation: 好吧，他的追随者可能把事情拖到了最后一刻，但他们成功了——哈兹尔重新回到了游戏中！

english: One of the weakest of our race. He did not even dare attend the last ritual, so he will be even weaker now. I'm ashamed to even call him a Mahjarrat.
translation: 我们种族中最弱的一员。他甚至不敢参加上一次仪式，所以现在他会更弱。我甚至羞于称他为玛哈加特。

english: Khazard is the youngest of our race on Gielinor. He was born towards the end of the God Wars, shortly before the death of his mother, Palkeera. Under Hazeel's tutelage, he is becoming a force to be reckoned with.
translation: 卡扎德是我们在吉林诺上最年轻的族人。他出生于神战末期，就在他母亲帕尔基拉去世前不久。在哈兹尔的教导下，他正在成为一股不可忽视的力量。

english: This young Mahjarrat is proving adept at manipulating weak-minded humans. As such, he has built up a sizeable territory and following.
translation: 这个年轻的玛哈加特证明了自己擅长操控意志薄弱的人类。因此，他建立了一个相当大的领土和追随者群体。

english: A Mahjarrat of merely average power. Generally has kept himself out of trouble by going along with the majority, but with no specific close allies he could be in danger at some point.
translation: 一个实力中等的玛哈加特。他通常通过随大流来避免麻烦，但由于没有特别亲密的盟友，他可能在某个时候陷入危险。

english: Strangely, Kharshai has disappeared. I did not think him so weak that he would be one of the Mahjarrat who chose to miss the last ritual. Maybe I overestimated him.
translation: 奇怪的是，卡尔沙伊消失了。我没想到他会弱到成为选择缺席上一次仪式的玛哈加特之一。也许我高估了他。

english: A fairly weak Mahjarrat. I don't like him much, though like most of us these days he is at least Zamorak-aligned. Could be the next one we choose to lose the next fight.
translation: 一个相当弱的玛哈加特。我不太喜欢他，不过和现在大多数族人一样，他至少是扎莫拉克阵营的。可能是我们下一个选择在下一场战斗中落败的人选。

english: Well, he failed to turn up this time. Guess he knew he was in trouble.
translation: 好吧，他这次没来。估计他知道自己有麻烦了。

english: Well, what do you know - the snivelling weasel tunnelled into my basement. He's my prisoner now. It's an easy decision to make him the next sacrifice and my fellow Mahjarrat seem happy to go along with me on this one.
translation: 嘿，你猜怎么着——那只鼻涕虫般的老鼠挖隧道钻进了我的地下室。他现在是我的囚犯了。让他成为下一个祭品是个轻松的决定，我的玛哈加特同胞们似乎也乐意在这件事上支持我。

english: Lamistard terminated in Gielinor's 16th Ritual.
translation: 拉米斯塔德在吉林诺第16次仪式中被终结。

english: Lucien is a powerful mage and my cousin. I trust him at least as much as any of the others - which still isn't very much.
translation: 卢西安是一位强大的法师，也是我的表亲。我对他的信任至少和其他人一样多——虽然那也不算多。

english: Lucien seems to have been getting very powerful of late.
translation: 卢西安最近似乎变得非常强大。

english: Lucien is now getting exceedingly powerful. Could he really have found the Stone? I guess I should try to be nice to him for a bit.
translation: 卢西安现在变得极其强大了。他真的找到了石头吗？我想我应该试着对他好一点。

english: Mizzarch aligns with the Zarosians, but they don't seem to consider him much of an ally. Understandable, given that he's rather weak. He seems an easy target for the sacrifice.
translation: 米扎克与扎罗斯派结盟，但他们似乎并不把他当作真正的盟友。考虑到他相当弱小，这可以理解。他似乎是个容易得手的祭品目标。

english: Mizzarch terminated in Gielinor's 15th Ritual.
translation: 米扎克在吉林诺第15次仪式中被终结。

english: An individual of average power. He's an ugly fellow. I think his eye sockets are too close together.
translation: 一个实力中等的个体。他是个丑陋的家伙。我觉得他的眼窝靠得太近了。

english: Ralvash terminated in Gielinor's 17th Ritual.
translation: 拉尔瓦什在吉林诺第17次仪式中被终结。

english: One of the more powerful of our number. Sliske has particularly strong shapeshifting capabilities and powers over shadows. Lurking in those shadows seems to be his preference, as he only shows his face around the rituals. I would love to catch this guy, but he's a slippery fellow.
translation: 我们中最强大的成员之一。斯利斯克拥有特别强的变形能力和对阴影的控制力。潜伏在阴影中似乎是他偏好的方式，因为他只在仪式时露面。我很想抓住这家伙，但他是个滑头。

english: Word from Hazeel is that Sliske has reappeared in a dramatic fashion, even by his standards. He's managed to dig up Zaros' old horn and claims the upcoming ritual will be 'the final Ritual of the Mahjarrat'. Sounds like things are going to get interesting.
translation: 哈兹尔传来消息说斯利斯克以戏剧性的方式重新出现了，即使以他的标准来看也是如此。他设法挖出了扎罗斯的旧号角，并声称即将到来的仪式将是'玛哈加特的最终仪式'。听起来事情要变得有趣了。

english: A Mahjarrat of average power. He doesn't seem to like me much. Not surprising given that he still seems to hold his Zarosian sympathies. He'd be a good candidate for sacrifice.
translation: 一个实力中等的玛哈加特。他似乎不太喜欢我。考虑到他似乎仍然怀有扎罗斯派的同情心，这并不奇怪。他会是个不错的祭品人选。

english: This is me. I am amazing.
translation: 这就是我。我太厉害了。

english: The egg pops and reveals a dead maggot.
translation: 蛋裂开，露出一条死蛆。

english: Thank you for purchasing the Lightomatic Deluxe lighthouse lighting equipment. The following is important user information, and should be read before you put your lightomatic into full use.
translation: 感谢您购买Lightomatic Deluxe灯塔照明设备。以下是重要的用户信息，请在全面使用您的lightomatic之前阅读。

english: The Lightomatic Deluxe has a maximum viewing range of over 3 nautical miles, in optimal conditions. In foggy or wet weather, visible distance is reduced to approximately 1 nautical mile.
translation: 在最佳条件下，Lightomatic Deluxe的最大可视距离超过3海里。在雾天或潮湿天气下，可见距离缩短至约1海里。

english: The Lightomatic Deluxe uses an advanced system of a torch and lenses to amplify the ambient visible light levels produced by your torch. We recommend all lighthouse keepers ensure that they keep their lens clean and dust free to ensure optimal lighting conditions.
translation: Lightomatic Deluxe采用先进的火把和透镜系统来放大火把产生的环境可见光。我们建议所有灯塔管理员确保透镜清洁无尘，以保证最佳照明条件。

english: We have included the following Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs) for users who may have problems with the installation or upkeep of their Lightomatic Deluxe.
translation: 我们为可能在安装或维护Lightomatic Deluxe时遇到问题的用户准备了以下常见问题解答（FAQ）。

english: 1) My lightomatic does not fit its DPM (Deployment Point Mechanism) is there anything I can do to make it fit?
translation: 1）我的lightomatic不匹配其DPM（部署点机制），有什么办法可以使其匹配吗？

english: We suggest that users manually inspect their DPMs before purchasing a Lightomatic Deluxe, as you will require a specialist constructor to enlarge your DPM, or may even need to upgrade your lighthouse to a newer version.
translation: 我们建议用户在购买Lightomatic Deluxe之前手动检查其DPM，因为您需要专业建造师来扩大DPM，甚至可能需要将灯塔升级到更新版本。

english: 2) There does not seem to be any light coming from my Lightomatic Deluxe, help!
translation: 2）我的Lightomatic Deluxe似乎没有发出任何光，求助！

english: If users are not getting light coming from their Lightomatic Deluxe, there are a number of factors that could cause this. Firstly, check that your LSM (Light Source Module) has been correctly activated. If it is on fire, then it is at optimal functioning capacity. If it is not on fire, you will need to use a tinderbox to light it.
translation: 如果用户的Lightomatic Deluxe没有发光，可能有多种原因。首先，检查您的LSM（光源模块）是否正确激活。如果它着火了，那就是最佳工作状态。如果没有着火，您需要使用火绒盒点燃它。

english: If using a tinderbox on your LSM has no effect, your NRLSF (Non Renewing Light Source Fuel) may be at fault. Although we only recommend the use of official Lightomatic NRLSFs (purchased separately) a make do solution can be achieved by using swamp tar on the LSM, which should be capable of restarting the flames when activated with a tinderbox.
translation: 如果在LSM上使用火绒盒没有效果，可能是您的NRLSF（非可再生光源燃料）出了问题。虽然我们只推荐使用官方Lightomatic NRLSF（单独购买），但也可以使用沼泽焦油在LSM上凑合解决，用火绒盒激活时应能重新点燃火焰。

english: NOTE: Use of swamp tar voids your warranty.
translation: 注意：使用沼泽焦油将使您的保修失效。

english: 3) My LSM works fine, but the visible light at sea is very weak!
translation: 3）我的LSM工作正常，但海上的可见光非常弱！

english: NOTE: The use of unauthorized molten glass on your LALS will invalidate your warranty. Should you have any further problems with the operation of your Lightomatic Deluxe, then please contact our service center through our advertisements in the Varrock Herald.
translation: 注意：在您的LALS上使用未经授权的熔融玻璃将使保修失效。如果您的Lightomatic Deluxe在操作中遇到任何其他问题，请通过我们在维洛克先驱报上的广告联系我们的服务中心。

english: If your Lightomatic Deluxe is still under warranty, we will then send an ADE (Authorised Dwarven Engineer) to repair any damage for a nominal fee.
translation: 如果您的Lightomatic Deluxe仍在保修期内，我们将派遣一名ADE（授权矮人工程师）以象征性费用修复任何损坏。

english: NOTE: By reading our advertisement in the Varrock Herald, you will invalidate your warranty.
translation: 注意：阅读我们在维洛克先驱报上的广告将使您的保修失效。

english: Thank you for purchasing the Lightomatic Deluxe.
translation: 感谢您购买Lightomatic Deluxe。

english: Lightomatic - the brand you can sometimes trust.
translation: Lightomatic - 有时值得信赖的品牌。

english: Many suggestions were heard for whose head was to go on top of King Alvis' new statue, a change of plans proposed from the Director of the Red Axe. He suggested that as the most powerful company in Keldagrim, he should have the honour. This claim, however, cannot be entirely verified for accuracy. After much deliberations, it was proposed to pick a company director at random, but this met with fierce resistance from the Red Axe.
translation: 关于谁的头像要放在阿尔维斯国王的新雕像顶部，听到了许多建议，红斧主管提出了变更计划。他建议作为凯尔达格林城最强大的公司，他应该享有这一荣誉。然而，这一说法无法完全核实其准确性。经过多次商议，提议随机选择一位公司主管，但遭到红斧的强烈抵制。

english: At this point, Veldaban, Commander of the Black Guard in Keldagrim, joined the meeting and introduced the human [player name]. It seemed appropriate that, instead of choosing a company at random, the human would decide. Thus the [player's chosen Consortium company] was suggested. Despite threats by the Red Axe to boycott the Trade Octagon, the motion was accepted.
translation: 此时，凯尔达格林城黑卫队指挥官维尔达班加入了会议，并介绍了人类[player name]。与其随机选择公司，不如由人类来决定，这似乎更合适。因此，[player's chosen Consortium company]被提议。尽管红斧威胁要抵制贸易八角场，该动议仍被接受。

english: ...My ritual was a success! I have managed to subdue a lesser demon. I can channel its magic to master the forces of life and death - as long as its chains hold...
translation: ...我的仪式成功了！我成功制服了一只小恶魔。只要锁链不断，我就能引导它的魔法来掌握生与死的力量...

english: ...On my fortieth attempt, the process was partially successful. The rat's flesh continues to decay, but it regains the faculty for movement that it had in life. It is too early to say how many of its mental faculties have survived...
translation: ...在我第四十次尝试中，过程部分成功。老鼠的肉体继续腐烂，但它恢复了生前的活动能力。现在说它的多少心智功能得以保留还为时过早...

english: ...Close study of the undead rat's behaviour reveal that no behavioural patterns acquired in life survive the process, even if the brain is perfectly preserved. I will have to find a way to conjure the deceased spirit separately...
translation: ...对不死老鼠行为的仔细研究表明，即使大脑保存完好，生前习得的行为模式在过程中也无法保留。我必须找到一种方法，分别召唤死者的灵魂...

english: ...I have searched through the ruins of the refugee camp and found many personal items. I can use these to conjure the spirits of my deceased countrymen...
translation: ……我搜遍了难民营的废墟，找到了许多私人物品。我可以用这些来召唤我已故同胞的灵魂……

english: ...I used the portrait of my wife in the ritual, and I am sure the smoke formed fleetingly into the shape of her face. I could barely contain my tears to see her once again. She seemed in such pain...
translation: ……我在仪式中用了妻子的肖像，我确信烟雾曾短暂地凝聚成她的面容。再次见到她，我几乎忍不住泪水。她看起来如此痛苦……

english: ...I have nearly perfected the formula: I can now conjure ghosts that persist for several hours. I am sure I can soon make them permanent...
translation: ……我几乎完善了配方：我现在可以召唤能持续数小时的幽灵。我相信很快就能让它们永久存在……

english: ...the ghosts have a recognisable form, but they are still non-corporeal. They seem to be in great distress, but they do not respond to anything I say....
translation: ……幽灵有可辨认的形态，但它们仍然没有实体。它们似乎极度痛苦，但对我说的任何话都没有反应……

english: ...The ghosts are still screaming. They seem to be in pain, and want to be returned to true death. But when I have perfected my techniques they will thank me...
translation: ……幽灵仍在尖叫。它们似乎很痛苦，想要回归真正的死亡。但等我完善了技术，它们会感谢我的……

english: ...Cried again today. Great weight in heart. I am causing so much pain to the souls I capture from the dead-world. But demon says they will thank me in the end...
translation: ……今天又哭了。心中沉重。我给自己从死亡世界捕获的灵魂带来了太多痛苦。但恶魔说它们最终会感谢我……

english: ...Had dream last night of great cabbage. Cabbage of Jas. Used by gods to create all life and magic. All runes have part of its power. So with runes I can control power above magic...
translation: ……昨晚梦见了巨大的卷心菜。贾斯卷心菜。诸神用它创造了所有生命和魔法。所有符文都有它的一部分力量。所以用符文我可以掌控超越魔法的力量……

english: ...I searched the ruins of the camp again and have assembled a number of complete skeletons. As the flesh is all gone it will be more difficult to animate them than the rats...
translation: ……我再次搜索了营地废墟，拼凑出了几具完整的骷髅。因为血肉都已消失，要让它们动起来比老鼠更难……

english: ...I have managed to create a magical binding that can bond bones to another and create a completely, magically animated skeleton. Animating a creature with no internal anatomy proves difficult, however...
translation: ……我成功创造了一种魔法束缚术，可以将骨头连接在一起，创造出完全由魔法驱动的骷髅。但要让没有内部结构的生物动起来确实很困难……

english: ...have been able to bind the bones together. Demon says it will soon be time. Life force can be transferred...
translation: ……已经能把骨头绑在一起了。恶魔说时机快到了。生命力可以转移……

english: ...I have succeeded in animating several of the skeletons, but without complete anatomies they cannot hold the spirits of my dead countrymen. Most will serve as guards, but I have selected two on which I will attempt to grow flesh...
translation: ……我成功让几具骷髅动了起来，但没有完整的身体结构，它们无法容纳我已故同胞的灵魂。大多数将充当守卫，但我选了两具尝试在其上生长血肉……

english: ...Note to self: must stop thinking about cabbages...
translation: ……提醒自己：不能再想卷心菜了……

english: ...My attempts at re-creating my dead countrymen's flesh were a partial success, but the flesh decays as soon as it appears. The creature is still not complete enough to house a spirit...
translation: ……我重塑同胞血肉的尝试部分成功了，但血肉一出现就开始腐烂。这个生物还不够完整，无法容纳灵魂……

english: ...Have made flesh grow on bones like cabbage from seed. All power come from cabbage. Zombies not useful...
translation: ……让血肉像种子长卷心菜一样在骨头上生长。所有力量都来自卷心菜。僵尸没什么用……

english: ...Cabbage cabbage cabcab cabbabbabbage egabac CABBAGE cbaaeg CCCC...
translation: ……卷心菜卷心菜卷卷菜卷心菜菜菜卷心菜菜卷卷菜卷心菜……

english: ...hate dragons hate dragons hate dragons...
translation: ……恨龙恨龙恨龙……

translation: 准备好回去了吗？如果你不解决那个牛头怪，没人会想买你的烤肉串。

english: You hear voices outside the crate. Is this your crate, Arhein?
translation: 你听到箱子外面有声音。这是你的箱子吗，阿海因？

english: You feel the crate being lifted. Oof. Wow, this is pretty heavy! I never knew candles weighed so much!
translation: 你感觉到箱子被抬了起来。哎哟。哇，这真够重的！我从不知道蜡烛有这么重！

english: Unload Mordred's deliveries onto the jetty. Aye-aye cap'n!
translation: 把莫德雷德的货物卸到码头上。遵命，船长！

english: You can hear someone mumbling outside the crate. ...stupid Arhein... making me... candles... never weigh THIS much....hurts....union about this!...
translation: 你听到箱子外面有人在嘟囔。……蠢阿海因……让我……蜡烛……从来不会这么重……疼……工会要管这事！……

english: You kill Mordred.
translation: 你杀死了莫德雷德。

english: You find a small inscription at the bottom of the altar. It reads: 'Snarthon Candtrick Termanto'.
translation: 你在祭坛底部发现了一小段铭文。上面写着：'斯纳尔松·坎德里克·特曼托'。

english: You can sense a powerful presence here...
translation: 你能感觉到这里有一股强大的存在...

english: You attempt to smash the crystal...
translation: 你试图砸碎水晶...

english: ...but your weapon didn't do any damage at all.
translation: ...但你的武器没有造成任何伤害。

english: ...but hammering it had absolutely no effect.
translation: ...但敲打它完全没有效果。

english: ... and it shatters under the force of Excalibur!
translation: ...它在王者之剑的力量下碎裂了！

english: You cannot rewatch cutscenes on a League Trailblazer World.
translation: 在联盟开拓者世界中无法重看过场动画。

english: Are you sure you wish to reset your Personal Best for Dark Seren?
translation: 你确定要重置黑暗塞伦的个人最佳纪录吗？

english: Are you REALLY sure you wish to reset your Personal Best for Dark Seren?
translation: 你真的确定要重置黑暗塞伦的个人最佳纪录吗？

english: You aren't really sure what you're meant to do with these fragments.
translation: 你不太确定该拿这些碎片做什么。

english: I have tried to convince him to stay, but he will not listen. He believes our mother is controlling us, keeping us close against our will. He does not see that she only acts out of fear, fear that she might lose us. He wants me to join him, but I won't leave her behind. She is our mother, our creator, we owe everything to her.
translation: 我试图说服他留下，但他不听。他相信我们的母亲在控制我们，违背我们的意愿将我们留在身边。他没有看到她的行为只是出于恐惧，害怕失去我们。他想让我加入他，但我不会丢下她。她是我们的母亲，我们的创造者，我们欠她一切。

english: She cries out for him, desperate for him to return to her. I've been trying my best to comfort her, but it has been little help. In her desperation for him to return, she has created new life in his image. They are pale imitations though, shadows of him and I. Their creation has been sapping her energy, and I fear she will grow too weak. All may not be lost though, for I may be able to convince them to sacrifice their energy and return it to her.
translation: 她为他哭喊，渴望他回到她身边。我一直尽力安慰她，但帮助甚微。在绝望中，她以他的形象创造了新的生命。但它们只是苍白的模仿，是他和我的影子。它们的创造一直在消耗她的能量，我担心她会变得太虚弱。不过一切并非无望，因为我或许能说服它们牺牲自己的能量，归还给她。

english: She has been dreaming more and more often recently. As she dreams, more beings are manifested. While her initial creations held some intellect, the latest ones have been purely instinctual. She is clearly running out of energy and running out of time. The beings that sacrificed themselves for her slowed things down, but it hasn't been enough. I am left with no choice, for I am powerless to help her. I have to leave her, before it is too late.
translation: 她最近做梦越来越频繁。随着她做梦，更多的生物被显现出来。虽然她最初的创造物还有一些智慧，但最新的那些纯粹是本能驱使。她显然能量耗尽，时间不多了。那些为她牺牲的生物减缓了进程，但还不够。我别无选择，因为我无力帮助她。我必须离开她，趁还来得及。

english: It was not easy to leave her, but I knew I had no choice. Since my departure, I travelled far and wide, finding nothing but empty worlds, long since abandoned. I almost gave up, but just as I was ready to stop, I came upon a world full of life. The creatures here, they are a joy to behold, living in harmony with each other and their home. I approached them, fearful of how they would react to me. It soon became clear that there was no need for fear. They fell in love with me, and I fell in love with them. At long last, I feel like I am home. Never shall I leave their side.
translation: 离开她并不容易，但我知道我别无选择。自从我离开后，我走遍四方，只找到早已被遗弃的空虚世界。我几乎放弃了，但就在我准备停下时，我来到了一个充满生命的世界。这里的生物，它们令人赏心悦目，彼此和谐共处，与家园和谐共生。我接近它们，担心它们会如何反应。很快我就明白无需恐惧。它们爱上了我，我也爱上了它们。终于，我感觉自己回家了。我永远不会离开它们身边。

english: Welcome dear reader to this tome. I entrust that it will suit to your enjoyment most amicably and perhaps in a scholarly pursuit, inform you of the manifest concerns alive in the land of Morytania.
translation: 欢迎亲爱的读者阅读此书。我相信它将令你愉悦，或许在学术追求中，也能让你了解莫利塔尼亚这片土地上存在的种种忧虑。

english: The land known as Morytania is as dark and uninviting as Misthalin is light and welcoming. While the intention of this author is not to teach geography to its readership, some small amount of area description would perhaps shed useful light.
translation: 被称为莫利塔尼亚的土地，正如米斯塔林光明而好客一样，黑暗而不宜人居。虽然作者无意教授地理，但一些简要的地域描述或许能提供有用的信息。

english: By far the most common entrance into Morytania is through the temple of Saradomin, Paterdomus. It is located at the end of the Silvarea pass and is the site of the famous battle for the Salve. It is here that the Seven Priestly Warriors stood shoulder to shoulder to defend Misthalin from the darkness.
translation: 进入莫利塔尼亚最常见的入口是通过萨拉多明神庙，帕特多莫斯。它位于希尔瓦雷亚山口的尽头，是著名的萨尔维战役遗址。正是在这里，七位祭司勇士并肩作战，保卫米斯塔林免受黑暗侵袭。

english: Due east of Paterdomus is the wild and strangely populated village of Canifis. The citizens of this area are to be least trusted as many an innocent has travelled there only to never return. However, some of those who had sense enough to avoid the village did, on occasion, return from the evil lands to recount their stories, before being specially treated for diseased imaginings and fearfulness.
translation: 帕特多莫斯正东是狂野而人口奇特的坎尼非斯村。该地区的居民最不值得信任，许多无辜者前往那里后便再无音讯。然而，一些有足够理智避开村庄的人，偶尔会从邪恶之地归来讲述他们的故事，之后便接受针对疾病妄想和恐惧的特殊治疗。

english: North easterly of Canifis is a most impressive, but dark castle of no small stature, inside one may find the very stuff of nightmares. It is best avoided in this author's opinion, as is much which resides in Morytania.
translation: 坎尼非斯村东北方有一座令人印象深刻但黑暗的城堡，规模不小，里面可能找到噩梦般的东西。依作者之见，最好避开它，莫利塔尼亚中的许多事物也是如此。

english: If one is to then make way through a most undesirable forest, infested with creatures of darkness, one may happen upon a ghostly sea port, all death and decomposition. Though this author cannot confirm it, adventurers returning from such a place remarked that for those of stout composition, well rendered faculties and an eye for profit could engage in meaningful work there and advance themselves.
translation: 如果继续穿过一片最令人厌恶的森林，那里充斥着黑暗生物，你可能会遇到一个幽灵般的海港，满是死亡与腐朽。虽然作者无法证实，但从那里归来的冒险者称，对于意志坚定、头脑清晰且善于谋利的人来说，可以在那里从事有意义的工作并提升自己。

english: Returning once again to Canifis, one would see a huge swathe of rotten, foul smelling and life-threatening marsh to the south. These great tracts of land are called Mort Myre; it is the swamp of true terror. Within this dark, stench-ridden foulness lives a most disgusting creature known as the Ghast. Due in no small part to the confusing nature of the terrain and the lack of anything edible, many innocents have died in this place, starved to death with hunger. When such a soul lives no longer, its form takes on the most disgusting of appearances. It hungers and eats anything it can, waylaying travellers and consuming their food, leaving nothing but stinking rotten remains. If travellers have no food, it will extract life force from those it can to satiate its considerable hunger.
translation: 再次回到坎尼非斯村，你会看到南方有一大片腐烂、恶臭且危及生命的沼泽。这些广阔的土地被称为莫特迈尔；那是真正恐怖的沼泽。在这黑暗、恶臭的污秽中，生活着一种最令人作呕的生物，名为恶灵。由于地形复杂且缺乏可食之物，许多无辜者在此地饿死。当这样的灵魂不再存活时，它的形态变得极其恶心。它饥饿难耐，吞噬一切可及之物，拦路抢劫旅行者，吃掉他们的食物，只留下恶臭的腐烂遗骸。如果旅行者没有食物，它会从能触及的人身上吸取生命力来满足其巨大的饥饿。

english: Few that have travelled through Mort Myre have returned to give details of what lies beyond. This author cannot rightly confirm the truth of what is reported here, but can simply transcribe it in the hope that one day the truth can be revealed.
translation: 穿越莫特迈尔的人很少能回来描述更远处的情况。作者无法确切证实这里所报告的内容，只能转述，希望有一天真相能够揭示。

english: It is south of Mort Myre that the traveller may venture upon a twisty and turning path which weaves around various large bodies of swamp water. To the south of this is said to be an ancient and evil mine. The path to this is difficult to discover but apparently holds great wealth inside of it. But gentle reader, I beseech you, lay some value for your own life and leave this area. There is no doubt that it contains many evil creatures which prosper on the lives of innocents in search of fame, fortune and glory.
translation: 莫特迈尔以南，旅行者可能会踏上一条蜿蜒曲折的小路，绕过大片沼泽水域。据说其南面有一座古老而邪恶的矿场。通往那里的路很难找到，但显然里面蕴藏着巨大财富。但亲爱的读者，我恳求你，珍视自己的生命，远离此地。毫无疑问，那里有许多邪恶生物，以寻求名声、财富和荣耀的无辜者之命为生。

english: To the east of the twisty turning path is a small village known as Mort'ton. Its inhabitants are both vile and deadly. Mort'ton is once said to have been a village making the focus of its living from the internment of important peoples into crypts beneath its rustic surface. Now the inhabitants long interred in their crypts walk the surface of the village and drain the life force of innocent and adventurer alike.
translation: 蜿蜒小路的东面是一个名为莫顿镇的小村庄。其居民既邪恶又致命。据说莫顿镇曾是一个以将重要人物安葬在乡村地表下的墓穴为生的村庄。如今，长久安葬在墓穴中的居民在地面上行走，吸取无辜者和冒险者的生命力。

english: South of Mort'ton lies a larger but somewhat bedraggled township, long ago run into ruin. Its original name is lost, it is now mostly commonly referred to as Burgh de Rott and most apt a name it is. All manner of ruined buildings litter this land. Some small token of civilization may have lived here at one point, but has long since vanished now.
translation: 莫顿镇以南是一个较大但有些破败的城镇，早已沦为废墟。其原名已失传，现在通常被称为伯格德罗特镇，这个名字再贴切不过。各种废墟建筑遍布此地。这里或许曾有过一丝文明的痕迹，但早已消失。

english: Little is accurately known of the eastern side of Morytania except that it is known as the Sanguinesti region by those that inhabit it. Also reported is that the northern area is referred to as Darkmeyer and the southern side is called Meiyerditch. Those lucky few who managed to escape this terrible place are few and far between so this information is largely unconfirmed.
translation: 关于莫利塔尼亚东部地区知之甚少，只知道当地居民称之为桑吉内斯蒂地区。还有报告称北部地区被称为达克迈尔，南部地区被称为迈尔迪奇。那些幸运逃脱这个可怕地方的人寥寥无几，因此这些信息大多未经证实。

english: To the far east, beyond the Sanguinesti region, lies the small town of Slepe. It is said that those who inhabit this place are true servants of chaos. As with most of Morytania, this author would advise extreme caution.
translation: 远在东部，桑吉内斯蒂地区之外，坐落着斯莱普镇。据说那里的居民是混沌的真正仆人。与莫利塔尼亚大部分地区一样，作者建议极度谨慎。

english: One final place which is worth a mention is the area to the east of Mort'ton, noted for its unusual appearance. A few small hillocks are all that distinguish this place from the rest of the area.
translation: 最后一个值得一提的地方是莫顿镇以东的区域，以其不寻常的外观而闻名。几个小丘是此地与周围地区唯一的区别。

english: And so dear reader, I have completed a brief and very unsure explanation of the geography of Morytania. Please excuse this author if further details prove to dispute all that is written here. This treatise is merely the accumulation of vague reports gained from travellers surviving Morytania and exiting Paterdomus as they head for the pleasanter lands of Misthalin. As example, it is reported that somewhere centrally located in the vastness of Morytania is a dark and dire castle, said to be the home of Drakan, the lord of Morytania. Though this has yet to be confirmed.
translation: 亲爱的读者，我已完成了对莫利塔尼亚地理的简要且不确定的说明。如果更多细节证明与这里所写相悖，请原谅作者。这篇论述仅仅是收集自幸存于莫利塔尼亚并经由帕特多莫斯前往米斯塔林更宜人之地的旅行者的模糊报告。例如，有报告称莫利塔尼亚广阔地域的中心某处有一座黑暗而可怕的城堡，据说是莫利塔尼亚领主德拉坎的居所。尽管这尚未得到证实。

english: To the hopeful reader:
translation: 致满怀希望的读者：

english: I am compelled to commit my experience to paper, perhaps to ease my conscience at the crimes I have committed against my fellow man. Perhaps I also hope that in some way these details may help in the struggle against the vyres.
translation: 我不得不将我的经历付诸笔端，或许是为了减轻我对同胞所犯罪行的良心不安。也许我也希望这些细节能以某种方式帮助对抗维尔的斗争。

english: My unbearable duty, upon the value of my family's lives, was to assist in an underground laboratory. Each day I aided the stinking vyres with their diabolical experiments. They claim that the research will aid us, but I am aware of the true and darker purpose.
translation: 我无法推卸的责任，以我家人的性命为代价，是协助一个地下实验室。每天我都帮助臭气熏天的维尔进行他们邪恶的实验。他们声称研究将帮助我们，但我清楚其真正而更黑暗的目的。

english: Against our will, we tinkered and toiled with compounds. We experimented, researched and recorded. But to what aim? It became clear to me that it was not to our aid, but to our efficiency in producing more blood! The tithes do not come fast enough for them and they're always hungry for more. Ever more mouths to feed as countless more vyres are created means the need for more human blood is never-ending.
translation: 违背我们的意愿，我们摆弄和苦干各种化合物。我们实验、研究和记录。但目的是什么？我越来越清楚，这不是为了帮助我们，而是为了提高我们生产更多血的效率！什一税对他们来说不够快，他们总是渴望更多。随着无数新的维尔被创造出来，需要更多嘴要喂养，意味着对人血的需求永无止境。

english: As the farmer feeds livestock to fatten our food so too the vyres seek to fatten our blood. However, this was not to be the end of the laboratory and its purpose. There was a second part for the place to play and whatever it was, it did not go well. Just today, the whole laboratory was closed down. All outward manner of its appearance has been disguised to hide its former purpose, and all my fellows associated with it have now disappeared.
translation: 正如农夫饲养牲畜以增肥我们的食物，维尔也试图增肥我们的血液。然而，这并非实验室及其目的的终结。这个地方还有第二个作用，无论是什么，进展并不顺利。就在今天，整个实验室被关闭了。其外观已被伪装以隐藏其原有用途，我所有相关的同伴都已消失。

english: With such haste and secrecy did this come about that I dare to think some rare and dangerous thing has been discovered there. Something that may put fear into the hearts of the vyres, if indeed a heart should beat for them at all.
translation: 此事如此仓促和隐秘，我敢想那里发现了某种罕见而危险的东西。某种可能让维尔心生恐惧的东西，如果他们真的有心跳的话。

english: I know they search for me, so I have hidden away. They will not rest until I am caught though. What they don't know is that I have the means to access that place again, hidden in depictions of statuesque evil. If I get chance I shall return, and learn what I can to pass on to my brothers in arms.
translation: 我知道他们在找我，所以我躲了起来。不过他们不抓到我是不会罢休的。他们不知道的是，我有办法再次进入那个地方，藏在邪恶雕像的描绘中。如果有机会，我会回去，尽可能了解情况，传递给并肩作战的兄弟们。

english: However, if my eyes are not the last to read this message, then I beg you, dear reader, to do what you can to discover the secrets of that laboratory. If you can, use them to incite the destruction of the vyres.
translation: 然而，如果我的眼睛不是最后一个读到这条信息的人，那么我恳求你，亲爱的读者，尽你所能去发现那个实验室的秘密。如果可以，用它们来引发维尔的毁灭。

english: The laboratory lies in the northeast of Meiyerditch. You'll find it south of the mines, north of Trakerel's Fish Shop and east of the Skull in a Chest Inn. Myreque prevail!
translation: 实验室位于迈尔迪奇东北部。你会在矿场以南、特拉凯雷尔鱼店以北、骷髅宝箱旅店以东找到它。迈雷克必胜！

english: -Mauritys Guile
translation: -莫里蒂斯·盖尔

english: Head east from Sophanem and you'll find a camp by the cliffs. Meet me there as soon as you can.
translation: 从索法尼恩城向东走，你会发现悬崖边有一个营地。尽快到那里见我。

english: I wish you to know of the intense pleasure I am deriving as I observe your struggles in the Theatre. Your desperation in the face of your foe, coupled with the relief you show when you survive for just a few moments longer - the sight and scent of your travails are delicious. Bravo, you are a most talented performer!
translation: 我想让你知道，我在观察你在剧院的挣扎时获得了极大的乐趣。你在面对敌人时的绝望，加上你多活片刻时的解脱——你艰辛的样子和气息令人愉悦。太棒了，你是一位最有天赋的表演者！

english: If circumstances were otherwise, I would dearly love to summon you to my own castle's dungeon, where I could sample your pain in a more intimate setting. But, alas, your life will surely end with this performance, this swan song.
translation: 若情况允许，我定会把你召入我城堡的地牢，在更私密的环境中细细品味你的痛苦。但可惜，你的生命必将随着这场表演，这首天鹅曲，画上句号。

english: I'm not much into the blood sports myself, but my husband's totally obsessed with watching this stuff. As long as he's busy watching you, he won't keep bothering me, so I can get on with this book I'm trying to read.
translation: 我本人对血腥运动不太感冒，但我丈夫却痴迷于看这种东西。只要他忙着看你，就不会来烦我，我也就能安心读这本书了。

english: You've putting up a good fight there. Have some food to keep yourself going a bit longer.
translation: 你打得不错嘛。吃点东西，好让你多撑一会儿。

english: Here's something to help you take the fight all the way to Verzik - give Her Freaky Ladyship a wallop from me, if you can!
translation: 这个给你，助你一路打到维兹克那里——替我狠狠教训那位怪咖女士一顿，如果你能做到的话！

english: And hey, Ladyship, I bet you've got your goofy orators reading all these messages, but you're never going to know who I am!
translation: 嘿，女士，我打赌你那些傻乎乎的演说家会把这些话都念给你听，但你永远也不会知道我是谁！

english: Don't tell him that! None of her business!
translation: 别告诉他！这不关她的事！

english: Don't tell her that! None of his business!
translation: 别告诉她！这不关他的事！

english: What kind of question is that to ask? With their great might of course!
translation: 这算什么问题？当然是用他们强大的力量啊！

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would he?
translation: 当然，真的！玩家不会无缘无故这么说的，对吧？

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would she?
translation: 当然，真的！玩家不会无缘无故这么说的，对吧？

english: Of course, really! Player wouldn't have said it otherwise, would they?
translation: 当然，真的！玩家不会无缘无故这么说的，对吧？

english: I must be off now.
translation: 我得走了。

english: The Basics of Magic
translation: 魔法基础

english: A Primer in the Mystical Arts
translation: 神秘艺术入门

english: This primer has been collated from years of our research into the metanatural arts commonly known as 'magic'. All those wishing to set forth upon the Astral Path should read this primer until the concepts within are fully understood so that their potential may fully be realised.
translation: 本入门书汇集了我们多年来对俗称'魔法'的超自然艺术的研究成果。所有希望踏上星界路径的人，都应通读此书，直至完全理解其中概念，方能充分发挥自身潜力。

english: Chapter 1:

english: Myths & Misconceptions
translation: 神话与误解

english: Those familiar with the history of our people will know that the source of 'magic' has always been a contentious issue.
translation: 熟悉我们民族历史的人都知道，'魔法'的源头一直是个争议不断的话题。

english: We of course take the more enlightened view that we should use all tools at our disposal for our own betterment.
translation: 我们当然持更开明的观点，认为应该利用一切可用的工具来改善自身。

english: What exactly is magic?
translation: 魔法究竟是什么？

english: Where exactly does it come from?
translation: 它究竟从何而来？

english: I intend to explain here how both of these questions are actually the same question phrased differently.
translation: 我在此想说明的是，这两个问题实际上是同一个问题的不同表述。

english: The first major misconception relating to magic is that the stones we use for our arts somehow contain magic within them.
translation: 关于魔法，第一个重大误解是，我们施法所用的石头似乎蕴含着魔法。

english: Although roughly correct, to believe this is how magic works limits your understanding of our own potential, and will prevent you ever achieving the feats which we are all capable of.
translation: 虽然大致正确，但若认为魔法就是这样运作的，便会限制你对自身潜力的理解，使你永远无法达到我们所有人都能企及的成就。

english: Rather, the runes that we shape to our purposes serve to focus your own power, rather than containing the power themselves.
translation: 实际上，我们塑造成形的符石是用来聚焦你自身力量的，而非本身蕴含力量。

english: A short history of how the runes were first discovered will serve to illuminate this point for you more fully.
translation: 简要回顾符石最初被发现的历史，将有助于你更充分地理解这一点。

english: As we all know, from the tales told to us in the Secret Tongue, 'magic' was first discovered in these lands by V when he accidentally stumbled upon the Stone of J--.
translation: 众所周知，根据秘语中流传的故事，'魔法'最初是由V在这片土地上偶然发现J--之石时意外开启的。

english: The stone was clearly not of this world, and the mere touch of it unlocked something within the mind of V .
translation: 那块石头显然不属于这个世界，仅仅触碰它便解锁了V脑海中的某种东西。

english: As we know, the stone was instantly removed by those powers who walk a higher Astral Path than ourselves, but its very existence showed V possibilities that had never occurred to our kind before.
translation: 众所周知，那块石头随即被行走于更高星界路径的力量移走，但它的存在向V展示了我们种族从未想过的可能性。

english: His lifelong search for the stone never did reveal its eventual fate, and the myths suggest that the stone may yet still lie somewhere within this world, but he did discover something of great importance in the caves where first he found the stone; the very rocks that had surrounded it had been subtly changed by its presence.
translation: 他终其一生寻找那块石头，却始终未能揭开其最终去向，神话暗示它或许仍藏于这世间的某处。但他确实在最初发现石头的洞穴中发现了极为重要的东西——环绕石头的岩石因它的存在而发生了微妙的变化。

english: The rocks in their contact with the Stone of J-- had gained a yearning to be something that they were not, and V discovered that by focussing thought upon them he could transform them entirely for short periods of time into the very elements of the universe.
translation: 那些与J--之石接触过的岩石，获得了一种渴望成为非己之物的愿望。V发现，通过将意念集中于它们，他可以在短时间内将它们完全转化为宇宙的基本元素。

english: This is a mere parlour trick, as many of our young have done the same thing with essence as children, making the cold-burning fire in their hands on summer nights, and V knew that should he be able to affect a permanent change upon these stones, he could have access to the very powers of the gods themselves!
translation: 这不过是雕虫小技，正如我们许多年轻人在孩童时期用精华做过同样的事，在夏夜里于掌中燃起冷焰。V深知，若能对这些石头施加永久性的改变，他便能触及诸神本身的力量！

english: And so was created the Astral Temple. This was the first, and to this day we honour those who walked before us on the Astral Path, and prevent it falling into the ruin that this dimension has caused to its counterparts.
translation: 于是，星界神殿应运而生。这是第一座，至今我们仍尊崇那些在星界路径上先行者，并防止它像这个维度对其同类建筑那样沦为废墟。

english: By regular concentrated effort of will upon a large dolmen of essence, by a number of people simultaneously, the dolmen was finally convinced that it had become something which it was not. The Astral Rune, symbol of our very way of life, it is a testament to what is possible if we seek understanding.
translation: 通过多人同时对一大块精华巨石阵持续集中意志，最终使巨石阵确信自己已变成了非己之物。星界符石，我们生活方式的象征，它证明了只要寻求理解，一切皆有可能。
