english: The sound seems to be coming from the center of the pool.
translation: 声音似乎是从水池中央传来的。

english: The bark has become slippery with water, you fail to find a suitable hold.
translation: 树皮被水弄得滑溜溜的，你找不到合适的抓握点。

english: Perhaps you could find something to apply to it to make it less slippery.
translation: 也许你可以找点东西涂上去让它不那么滑。

english: You dig up some mud with your bare hands. Yuck, now they're all sticky.
translation: 你徒手挖出了一些泥巴。哎呀，现在手都黏糊糊的了。

english: Great, now the tree bar isn't slippery anymore!
translation: 太好了，现在树皮不再滑了！

english: You jump up to grab the bark of the tree...
translation: 你跳起来抓住树的树皮...

english: ...crawl along the branch...
translation: ...沿着树枝爬过去...

english: That would be a good idea... if the pole wasn't broken, that is.
translation: 那会是个好主意...如果杆子没断的话。

english: You plant your staff into the clump of rocks...
translation: 你把法杖插进岩石丛中...

english: ...then successfully jump across!
translation: ...然后成功跳了过去！

english: You only just manage to get to shore!
translation: 你勉强到达了岸边！

english: You place the plank on the two flat stones...
translation: 你把木板放在两块平坦的石头上...

english: ...then successfully walk across!
translation: ...然后成功走了过去！

english: With a lot of effort you manage to get back to shore.
translation: 费了好大劲，你终于回到了岸边。

english: What a terrible stench! No one can live there, so you decide not to go either.
translation: 好臭！没人能住在那儿，所以你决定也不去。

english: ...and step down the other side.
translation: ……然后从另一边走下去。

english: You go into the peculiar looking tent.
translation: 你走进了那个古怪的帐篷。

english: While two halves make one whole, it's better to just have half a rock.
translation: 虽然两半合成一个整体，但最好还是只有半块岩石。

english: Someone else just had the same idea!
translation: 别人也有同样的想法！

english: Ouch! You just stuck your hand into some very sharp thorns.
translation: 哎哟！你的手刚扎进了一些非常锋利的荆棘里。

english: No need, you already have one of these.
translation: 不用了，你已经有一个了。

english: You eat the White Pearl and spit out the seed when you're done. Mmm, tasty.
translation: 你吃了白珍珠，吃完后把种子吐了出来。嗯，真好吃。

english: You're content with having the seed of the fruit.
translation: 你满足于拥有果实的种子。

english: One seed should be enough.
translation: 一颗种子应该够了。

english: 'Yes, [player name], I can sense that this is so.'
translation: “是的，[player name]，我能感觉到确实如此。”

english: 'I do not fully understand what you speak of, but I do have one more task I would like you to do.'
translation: “我不完全明白你说的话，但我还有一件事想让你去做。”

english: 'My father does not believe that I am dead. In his heart, he knows it to be true, but he cannot accept it.'
translation: “我父亲不相信我已经死了。他心里知道这是真的，但他无法接受。”

english: 'You must convince him, [player name]. Once you have convinced my father, everyone else in the camp will follow him. Then, perhaps, they can move on again.'
translation: “你必须说服他，[player name]。一旦你说服了我父亲，营地里的其他人都会跟随他。然后，也许他们就能继续前行了。”

english: 'I must leave that to you. All I know is that I was attacked by some creature or animal while I was sitting by the lake. It dragged me off and I remember nothing else.'
translation: “这只能靠你了。我只知道我在湖边坐着时被某种生物或动物袭击了。它把我拖走了，之后的事我什么都不记得了。”

english: You take a very deep breath...
translation: 你深深地吸了一口气……

english: This bear has no quarrel with you.
translation: 这只熊和你没有过节。

english: You collect the helmet from the corpse of the 'bear' as a trophy.
translation: 你从“熊”的尸体上取下头盔作为战利品。

english: This must be someone else's corpse, you already have Asleif's corpse.
translation: 这一定是别人的尸体，你已经有阿斯莱夫的尸体了。

english: You'd better bring this back to the chieftain instead.
translation: 你最好把这个带回给酋长。

english: You welcome the fresh air.
translation: 你享受着新鲜空气。

english: She needs to be buried with some of her possessions, like jewelry.
translation: 她需要和一些她的物品一起下葬，比如珠宝。

english: You don't have enough rocks to build a cairn. You need <Num0> more rock(s).
translation: 你没有足够的岩石来堆石冢。还需要<Num0>块岩石。

english: You think you can hear a soft 'thank you' as the singing quietens down.
translation: 当歌声渐渐平息时，你似乎听到了一声轻柔的“谢谢”。

english: Eluned takes you to Lletya.
translation: 埃卢内德带你去了莱蒂亚村。

english: Eluned hands you a tiny crystal seed.
translation: 埃卢内德递给你一颗微小的水晶种子。

english: Thanks a lot Eluned!
translation: 多谢了，埃卢内德！

english: Just wetting the top will not remove the bloodstains.
translation: 只弄湿上衣是洗不掉血迹的。

english: Could you wash this top for me?
translation: 你能帮我洗一下这件上衣吗？

english: Well with how white your robes are, I assumed that you'd know a thing or two about keeping clothes clean.
translation: 嗯，看你的袍子这么白，我以为你对保持衣服干净很在行呢。

english: The dry soap has no effect.
translation: 干肥皂没有效果。

english: You dangle the toad crunchie above the gnome's nose.
translation: 你把蟾蜍脆饼悬在地精的鼻子前。

english: The gnome cranes his neck and gulps down the toad crunchie before you can pull them away.
translation: 地精伸长脖子，在你来得及拿开之前一口吞下了蟾蜍脆饼。

english: Very well, but you don't get the crunchies until I get back though.
translation: 好吧，但在我回来之前你拿不到脆饼。

english: Ah yes, I've used them to catch chompy birds before. I think I have some bellows in my bank as well.
translation: 啊，是的，我以前用它们来抓食人鸟。我想我银行里也有一些风箱。

english: Thanks for the reminder. I think I have some bellows in my bank that I can use.
translation: 谢谢提醒。我想我银行里有一些风箱可以用。

english: You put the dye-filled toad in to the firing chamber. To use the device, select the Aim and Fire mode from your Combat Options.
translation: 你把装满染料的蟾蜍放进了发射室。要使用这个装置，请从你的战斗选项中选择瞄准和发射模式。

english: Use the arrows to aim at your target. Once you have it lined up, press the red 'Fire' button.
translation: 用箭瞄准你的目标。一旦对准了，就按下红色的“发射”按钮。

english: You re-dye the red sheep.
translation: 你重新给红羊染了色。

english: You re-dye the blue sheep.
translation: 你重新给蓝羊染色了。

english: You re-dye the yellow sheep.
translation: 你重新给黄羊染色了。

english: You re-dye the green sheep.
translation: 你重新给绿羊染色了。

english: It has been quite some time since anyone got ill from the plague, so I would like you to see to it that people do!
translation: 已经很久没人因瘟疫生病了，所以我想让你去确保人们会生病！

english: We have never tried this before, but some joker put something in our food not too long ago that gave us all symptoms akin to those of the plague.
translation: 我们从未试过这个，但不久前有个捣蛋鬼在我们的食物里放了东西，让我们所有人都出现了类似瘟疫的症状。

english: We can have our men remove the 'infected' citizens and sent into the mines.
translation: 我们可以让手下把'感染'的市民带走，送进矿井里。

english: Distribution should be easy enough. Because of the city walls no one can grow their own food. Instead, all the food here comes from one of three supply points.
translation: 分发应该很容易。因为有城墙，没人能自己种食物。相反，这里所有的食物都来自三个供应点之一。

english: Can you explain to me again what it is I have to do?
translation: 你能再给我解释一遍我需要做什么吗？

english: How am I meant to do that?
translation: 我该怎么做？

english: It turns out the king was lying to me.
translation: 原来国王一直在骗我。

english: About his loyalty.
translation: 关于他的忠诚。

english: Well I'll start from when we found out that the plague was a hoax. When I confronted the king, he told me that he faked the plague to keep people safe from his brother, King Tyras.
translation: 好吧，我从我们发现瘟疫是骗局的时候说起。当我质问国王时，他告诉我他伪造瘟疫是为了保护人民免受他兄弟泰拉斯国王的伤害。

english: He said that Tyras was taken by the Dark Lord while exploring the lands to the west. He claimed that the Dark Lord corrupted him by forcing him to drink from the Chalice of Eternity.
translation: 他说泰拉斯在探索西部土地时被黑暗领主带走了。他声称黑暗领主强迫他喝下永恒圣杯中的水，从而腐蚀了他。

english: Indeed, but I didn't find out until much later. On the kings orders, I travelled through the Underground Pass and into the western lands of Tirannwn.
translation: 确实，但我直到很久以后才发现真相。奉国王之命，我穿越地下通道，进入了西部的提兰恩之地。

english: Once there, I met up with Lord Iorwerth, the leader of some elves that had allied with the king. He helped me kill King Tyras.
translation: 到了那里，我遇到了伊尔沃斯领主，他是与国王结盟的一些精灵的首领。他帮我杀死了泰拉斯国王。

english: That was when I discovered the truth. While returning to King Lathas, I was confronted by another elf named Arianwyn, the leader of a group of rebel elves opposing Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 那时我才发现了真相。在返回拉萨斯国王那里的路上，我遇到了另一个名叫阿里安温的精灵，他是反对伊尔沃斯领主的反抗精灵组织的首领。

english: At the time, I was carrying a letter from Lord Iorwerth to King Lathas. Arianwyn magically broke the seal on the letter so I could read it.
translation: 当时，我带着一封伊尔沃斯领主写给拉萨斯国王的信。阿里安温用魔法打破了信上的封印，让我得以阅读。

english: I'm not exactly sure yet. West Ardougne seems to be key to his plans though. I met with Arianwyn who revealed to me that the mourners are actually elves in service to Lord Iorwerth.
translation: 我还不太确定。西阿多尼城似乎是他计划的关键。我见到了阿里安温，他向我透露那些哀悼者实际上是效忠于伊尔沃斯领主的精灵。

english: I've infiltrated the mourners and I'm trying to work out what they are doing. From what I've learnt so far, there's something important to them in the caves below West Ardougne.
translation: 我已经潜入了哀悼者之中，正在努力弄清楚他们在做什么。据我目前所知，西阿多尼城下方的洞穴里有对他们很重要的东西。

english: I'm currently working with them to earn their trust. Hopefully they'll reveal their plans to me soon.
translation: 我目前正在和他们合作以赢得他们的信任。希望他们很快会向我透露他们的计划。

english: It will take forever to fill like this. I need something that can transport lots of rotten apples in it.
translation: 这样装要装到什么时候。我需要一个能装大量烂苹果的东西。

english: Next, you'll want to get yourself some naphtha and mix it with the rotten apples. You mentioned the chemist in Rimmingon helped you with naphtha before. You might want to speak to him again.
translation: 接下来，你需要弄些石脑油，和烂苹果混合。你提到过里明顿的化学家之前帮你弄过石脑油。你可能需要再去找他谈谈。

english: It's going okay, I made a batch of the toxin but have yet to use it.
translation: 进展还行，我做了一批毒素，但还没用。

english: I will Elena, thanks.
translation: 我会的，埃琳娜，谢谢。

english: You've already poisoned this store.
translation: 你已经给这家店下过毒了。

english: Unfortunately, progress has been slower than we'd have liked. The slaves accidentally mined into some old caverns infested with beasts. They have caused us significant issues.
translation: 不幸的是，进展比我们预想的要慢。奴隶们意外挖到了一些满是野兽的古老洞穴。它们给我们带来了很大的麻烦。

english: Apparently they are trying to find an old temple deep under the city. That's what their mining operation is for.
translation: 显然他们试图在城市地下深处找到一座古老的寺庙。这就是他们采矿的目的。

english: The temple seems to be the key to their plans. It apparently holds a great power. I still have no idea what that is yet though.
translation: 那座寺庙似乎就是他们计划的关键。据说里面蕴藏着巨大的力量。但我仍然不知道那是什么。

english: Start the Mourning's End Part II quest?
translation: 开始哀悼的终结 II 任务？

english: Alone. An entire land untouched by the war of the gods. This will be the perfect place to begin again. On my own, the work will be slow, but it will be free from the interruptions of the others. Many of the materials I've used previously can't be found here. However, the benefits of this place may well outweigh the negatives, for it features a selection of resources I have never encountered. Maybe one of these resources will be key to our salvation.
translation: 独自一人。一片未被神战波及的完整土地。这将是从头开始的完美之地。独自一人，工作会慢一些，但不会受到他人的干扰。我以前使用的许多材料在这里找不到。然而，这个地方的好处可能远超坏处，因为它拥有一些我从未见过的资源。也许其中一种资源会成为我们救赎的关键。

english: While dragons are the most abundant of our creations, they have never been the most dangerous. That distinction belongs to the wyrms. They are deadly creatures, a single one capable of obliterating an entire city. Perhaps for the best, they have been driven pretty much to extinction by the God Wars. However, while we quickly abandoned the wyrm project, I still believe it may hold some promise. By using some of the new resources I've found here, I may be able to create ones which achieve the aims of the original project.
translation: 虽然龙是我们创造物中数量最多的，但它们从来不是最危险的。这个称号属于蛇龙。它们是致命的生物，一条就能摧毁整座城市。也许最好的是，它们在神战中被几乎灭绝了。然而，虽然我们很快放弃了蛇龙项目，我仍然相信它可能有一些前景。通过使用我在这里发现的一些新资源，我或许能创造出达到原始项目目标的蛇龙。

english: The wyrm project was an unfortunate failure. While I'm disappointed, I do not intend to dwell on it. Many years ago, I proposed a potential idea to Kerapac for a creation I call the drake. He showed no interest in it, preferring to focus on his dragons instead. Back then, what Kerapac said was law, but that is not the case here. Here, I am alone and free to pursue whatever project I desire.
translation: 蛇龙项目是一次不幸的失败。虽然我很失望，但我不打算纠结于此。多年前，我向克拉帕克提出了一个想法，创造一种我称之为亚龙的生物。他对此毫无兴趣，更愿意专注于他的龙。那时，克拉帕克的话就是法律，但在这里不是这样。在这里，我独自一人，可以自由追求任何我想要的计划。

english: Another day, another failure. While the drakes showed far greater promise than the wyrms, it was not enough. As such, I have made the decision to end that project and move on to another. In one way or another, the ideas I had for wyrms and drakes came with me when I first travelled to this place. I now realise that I need to dream a little bigger if I am to have success here. As such, my next project is a brand new one, not based on any prior work done by my kind.
translation: 又是一天，又一次失败。虽然亚龙比蛇龙显示出更大的前景，但还不够。因此，我决定结束那个项目，转向另一个。无论如何，我对蛇龙和亚龙的想法在我第一次来到这个地方时就伴随着我。我现在意识到，如果我想在这里取得成功，我需要梦想得更大一些。因此，我的下一个项目是全新的，不基于我们种族之前的任何工作。

english: So far so good, my new project is showing far more promise than any I have worked on before. Zorgoth, Kerapac and the others never cared for my ideas, but if they could see my hydras, they might just reconsider their doubts. Now that the initial creatures have been made, my next steps are to refine them. The new chemicals I have discovered here should be of great use in this.
translation: 到目前为止一切顺利，我的新项目显示出比以往任何项目都更大的前景。佐戈斯、克拉帕克和其他人从来不在乎我的想法，但如果他们能看到我的九头蛇，他们可能会重新考虑他们的怀疑。既然最初的生物已经制造出来，我的下一步是完善它们。我在这里发现的新化学物质应该会对此大有帮助。

english: Not one, but two setbacks have befallen my work. First, the hydra project has stalled. While the enhanced creation showed promise, I have been unable to replicate it. As such, I intend to bring the project to an end. However, all future projects may be jeopardised by the second setback, a new arrival to this land. I always knew this place would not remain empty forever, an empty landmass of this size was always going to be too tempting. However, I had hoped I would have more time before company arrived.
translation: 我的工作遭遇了不止一次，而是两次挫折。首先，九头蛇项目停滞了。虽然增强后的生物显示出前景，但我无法复制它。因此，我打算结束这个项目。然而，所有未来的项目都可能因第二个挫折而受到威胁，那就是这片土地上的新来者。我一直知道这个地方不会永远空无一人，这么大的一片空地总是太诱人了。然而，我曾希望在新来者到来之前能有更多时间。

english: While powerful, I am but one. Because of this, I have kept my distance from the new arrival, observing from a distance rather than making my presence known. The arrival seems to be a demon of Zamorak, one in possession of an artefact I have never encountered. While the demon arrived alone, he has used this artefact to call upon a variety of creatures to his side. As tempting as it is to try and obtain the artefact for myself, to do so would be folly. Instead, I intend to relocate to a mountain to the south. There's a lizard species there that may well be key to my next project.
translation: 虽然强大，但我只是一个人。因此，我一直与新来者保持距离，从远处观察而不是暴露自己的存在。这个新来者似乎是扎莫拉克的恶魔，拥有一个我从未见过的文物。虽然恶魔独自到来，但他利用这个文物召唤了各种生物到他身边。虽然试图为自己获取这个文物很诱人，但这样做是愚蠢的。相反，我打算搬到南方的一座山上。那里有一种蜥蜴物种，很可能是我下一个项目的关键。

english: The ship will leave in 50 seconds!
translation: 船将在50秒后出发！

english: The ship will be back in 5 minutes!
translation: 船将在5分钟后返回！

english: The ship will be back in 1 minute!
translation: 船将在1分钟后返回！

english: Still to buy:
translation: 仍需购买：

english: Knives (Will need plenty)
translation: 刀具（需要准备充足）

english: Armour? (Keep it light if so)
translation: 盔甲？（如果要带的话，选轻便的）

english: Food (Nothing that will perish too quickly)
translation: 食物（别带容易变质的）

english: Potion ingredients (Various)
translation: 药水材料（各种）

english: I don't have time to do that right now.
translation: 我现在没时间做那个。

english: I've lost the key to the mine.
translation: 我把矿场的钥匙弄丢了。

english: The man died with nothing.
translation: 那个男人死时什么也没留下。

english: You find a journal.
translation: 你找到了一本日记。

english: You find a colour wheel and some notes but you don't have enough room to take them.
translation: 你找到了一个色轮和一些笔记，但你的背包空间不够，无法带走它们。

english: You find a colour wheel and some notes.
translation: 你找到了一个色轮和一些笔记。

english: There are many blackened crystal shards here. They are firmly attached. You'll need something suitable to chip one off.
translation: 这里有许多黑化水晶碎片。它们牢牢地附着在上面。你需要合适的工具才能撬下一块。

english: You chip off one of the many blackened shards.
translation: 你撬下了一块黑化碎片。

english: No, I have looked everywhere but I can't see any sign of them.
translation: 不，我到处都找过了，但没看到他们的任何踪迹。

english: Nothing other than the beasts you spoke of.
translation: 除了你说的那些野兽，没有别的了。

english: I'll let you know as soon as I find something.
translation: 我一发现什么就告诉你。

english: Good, I have been given access to the mine beneath West Ardougne. I can now begin searching it.
translation: 好，我已经获准进入西阿多尼城下方的矿场。我现在可以开始搜索了。

english: So go to the temple, find a black crystal and bring you a sample of it. Got it. I'll be back soon.
translation: 所以去神庙，找到一块黑水晶，带一块样本回来给你。明白了。我很快就回来。

english: There is a green crystal fused into the pillar.
translation: 有一块绿色水晶嵌在柱子里。

english: The crystal only fits the pillar with the clear side facing north.
translation: 水晶只有透明面朝北才能嵌入柱子。

english: The crystal only fits the pillar with the clear side facing east.
translation: 水晶只有透明面朝东才能嵌入柱子。

english: You take the fractured crystal from the pillar.
translation: 你从柱子上取下了碎裂的水晶。

english: This fractured crystal doesn't seem to fit right in this pillar.
translation: 这块碎裂的水晶似乎不太适合这根柱子。

english: What about the Agility arena ticket?
translation: 那敏捷竞技场票呢？

english: What about the Archery ticket?
translation: 那射箭票呢？

english: So why do you want the Crumbling tome?
translation: 那你为什么想要那本破碎的书籍？

english: So why do you want the Battered book?
translation: 那你为什么想要那本破烂的书？

english: So why do you want Prifddinas' history?
translation: 那你为什么想要普里夫迪纳斯城的历史？

english: How do you explain the Dusty key?
translation: 那布满灰尘的钥匙怎么解释？

english: How do you explain the Jail key?
translation: 那监狱钥匙怎么解释？

english: How do you explain the Door key?
translation: 那门匙怎么解释？

english: Yeah right, all of those are just 'supplies'.
translation: 得了吧，那些都只是'补给品'。

english: You place the crystal on the altar. It starts to glow with a strange light.
translation: 你把水晶放在祭坛上。它开始发出奇异的光芒。

english: You place the powered crystal amongst the other shards.
translation: 你把充能水晶放在其他碎片中间。

english: Finally, a pupil using their brains rather than trying to eat them. Next question.
translation: 终于有个动脑子的学生了，而不是想吃了它们。下一个问题。

english: Began investigations within the Wilderness, focusing on area east of the Demonic Ruins.
translation: 开始在荒野进行调查，重点放在恶魔废墟以东的区域。

english: Found interesting traces of a mysterious power, along with remnants left by the dragonkin.
translation: 发现了神秘力量的踪迹，以及龙人留下的残余物。

english: Further exploration led to nothing. Extensive destruction of the region likely to blame.
translation: 进一步探索一无所获。该地区的大规模破坏很可能是原因。

english: Morytania is of great interest, but vampyres make work problematic.
translation: 莫利塔尼亚很值得关注，但吸血鬼让工作变得困难。

english: Same power detected in the Wilderness also seems to be present around Darkmeyer. Like with Wilderness, strength of this power is negligible. Unlikely to lead to any notable discovery.
translation: 在荒野检测到的同种力量似乎也存在于达克迈尔周围。与荒野一样，这种力量的强度可以忽略不计。不太可能带来任何重大发现。

english: Will refocus elsewhere as little progress is being made (though did find an interesting coffin deep below Mort Myre).
translation: 进展甚微，将把注意力转向别处（不过在莫特迈尔深处确实发现了一口有趣的棺材）。

english: Temple of Ikov not as abandoned as first seems. An order calling themselves the Guardians of Armadyl has a hidden hideout here. Seems they are guarding an artefact of great power. More research will be needed to confirm, but may have finally located the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 伊科夫神殿并不像表面看起来那么荒废。一个自称阿玛杜尔守护者的组织在这里有个隐秘据点。看来他们在守护一件威力强大的文物。需要更多研究来确认，但可能终于找到了阿玛杜尔杖的位置。

english: Archaeological excavations taking place east of Varrock grow more interesting by the day. Information from the time of the gods could be highly beneficial.
translation: 维洛克城东边的考古发掘一天比一天有趣。来自诸神时代的信息可能极为有用。

english: Some relics found confirm a few long held suspicions. Will need to return in future once more is unearthed.
translation: 发现的一些遗物证实了长久以来的几个猜测。等有更多出土物时需要再回来一趟。

english: Once again found traces of the mysterious power encountered in the Wilderness and Morytania.
translation: 再次发现了在荒野和莫利塔尼亚遇到的那种神秘力量的痕迹。

english: The Basics of Magic: 'As we all know, from the tales told to us in the Secret Tongue, 'magic' was first discovered in these lands by V when he accidentally stumbled upon the Stone of J--.'
translation: 魔法基础：'众所周知，从秘语中流传的故事来看，'魔法'最早是由V在这片土地上意外发现J--之石时偶然发现的。'

english: Book is needlessly vague on any further details. Could this be linked to the mysterious power? Must find out more. What is this Stone, and who or what was J--?
translation: 这本书在细节上刻意含糊其辞。这会不会与那神秘力量有关？必须查明更多。这块石头是什么，J--又是谁或什么？

english: Heard rumour of a dark and ancient evil residing here. Hoped it might be linked to my research. Alas, just another vengeful spirit. Still, if spirit ends up getting dealt with, could be nice place for a welcome break.
translation: 听说这里住着一个古老而黑暗的邪恶存在。希望它可能与我的研究有关。可惜，只是又一个复仇的怨灵。不过，如果这个怨灵被解决了，这里倒是个不错的歇脚处。

english: Decided to make a diversion to Menaphos given the rumours of impending quarantine. Grand Library of Menaphos is one of world's largest and may have important information.
translation: 鉴于即将封锁的传闻，决定绕道去梅纳福斯。梅纳福斯大图书馆是世界上最大的图书馆之一，可能有重要信息。

english: Most books about the gods focus on Tumeken and his kin. No suprise there. However, found two tomes hidden amongst them.
translation: 关于诸神的书籍大多聚焦在图梅肯和他的族人。这并不意外。不过，在它们中间发现了两本隐藏的典籍。

english: Saradomin's Will: 'With the power of Saradomin's Eye he was struck down.'
translation: 萨拉多明之意志：'凭借萨拉多明之眼的力量，他被击倒了。'

english: Lores of Ancient Gods: 'The stranger in our midst stood forward when asked. 'Speak ye lies afore me', spoke Saradomin, 'and my Eye shall see it. In vengeance for your evil, it will shatter you like ice and your remains shall feed the earth.'
translation: 远古诸神传说：'我们中间的陌生人应声站了出来。'在我面前说真话'，萨拉多明开口，'我的眼睛会看穿谎言。为了惩罚你的邪恶，它将像碎冰一样将你击碎，你的遗骸将滋养大地。'

english: Something's off. Why do they refer to Saradomin's Eye in this way? More research needed.
translation: 有些不对劲。为什么他们这样称呼萨拉多明之眼？需要更多研究。

english: Hard to find and even harder to navigate. However, caverns likely hold many secrets.
translation: 难以找到，更难穿行。不过，这些洞穴很可能藏着许多秘密。

english: Area seems natural at first glance, but deeper inspection led to discovery of many artificial elements. Of particular note: Almost invisible arcane symbols, a curious door made of mithril, and an ancient forge unlike any encountered previously.
translation: 乍看之下这片区域是天然的，但深入检查后发现许多人工痕迹。特别值得注意的是：几乎看不见的奥术符号、一扇奇怪的秘银门，以及一座前所未见的古代熔炉。

english: Work here is clearly that of the dragonkin. However, some inconsistencies when compared to other dragonkin structures. Curious.
translation: 这里的工作显然是龙人所为。不过，与其他龙人建筑相比有些出入。奇怪。

english: Dragonkin ultimately not an area of focus right now. Caverns will need to be left for another day. However, strange hexagonal design of one of the arcane symbols seems familiar. Should keep an eye out for where it has come up before.
translation: 龙人目前不是重点。洞穴只能改日再探。不过，其中一个奥术符号的奇怪六边形设计似乎眼熟。应该留意之前在哪里见过。

english: Swamps of Lumbridge are littered with sinkholes connecting to vast cave network below. Despite proximity to Lumbridge, many are unexplored.
translation: 仑桥镇的沼泽里遍布着通往下方巨大洞穴网络的塌陷洞。尽管离仑桥镇很近，许多洞穴仍未探索。

english: Decided to pay a visit to these caves after hearing of strange snake with Guthixian ties inhabiting them. Snake had little interest in conversing, but was able to detect a slight trace of the mysterious power encountered elsewhere. This warrants investigation.
translation: 听说有一条与古斯有关的怪蛇住在这些洞穴里，决定去拜访一下。蛇对交谈没什么兴趣，但我能察觉到一丝在其他地方遇到的那种神秘力量的痕迹。这值得调查。

english: Also encountered unusual goblins living in the caves. They possess intellect and ingenuity that is close to flabbergasting compared to those on surface. Must explore uses for some of their curious creations when time permits.
translation: 还遇到了住在洞穴里的不寻常哥布林。与地面上的同类相比，他们的智慧和创造力简直令人瞠目结舌。有空时必须探索他们一些奇特发明的用途。

english: Birth of the Order: 'And so Saradomin unleashed the power of his Eye, the greatest of all his creations.'
translation: 教团之诞生：'于是萨拉多明释放了他所有造物中最伟大的杰作——他的眼睛的力量。'

english: Histories of Guthix: 'The mighty power of the Fist of Guthix tore the earth asunder and the shaking ground did swallow his enemies.'
translation: 古斯史：'古斯之拳的巨力撕裂大地，震动的土地吞没了他的敌人。'

english: Once again, reference to Saradomin's Eye, though this time more specific. Text implies the Eye was some sort of tool or weapon created by Saradomin himself.
translation: 再次提到萨拉多明之眼，不过这次更具体。文本暗示这只眼睛是萨拉多明亲自创造的某种工具或武器。

english: New reference to the Eye is fascinating, but second book is even more interesting. Have seen mention of the Fist of Guthix before, but not put much thought into any deeper meaning. However, references to Saradomin's Eye raise new question: Why the focus on these single body parts? An Eye. A Fist. Coincidence, or something more?
translation: 关于眼睛的新提及令人着迷，但第二本书更有意思。之前见过古斯之拳的提及，但没深入思考其含义。然而，对萨拉多明之眼的提及提出了新问题：为什么聚焦于这些单一的身体部位？一只眼睛。一只拳头。是巧合，还是另有深意？

english: Was only a matter of time before someone took note of my work. Have been approached by a Mahjarrat called Lucien. He has taken a great interest in my research and is willing to help fund it in return for help in obtaining the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 迟早会有人注意到我的工作。一个叫卢西安的玛哈加特找上了我。他对我的研究非常感兴趣，愿意资助我的研究，条件是帮他获得阿玛杜尔杖。

english: Doubt he can be trusted. He seems very business-like and efficient, but his personal ambition is a danger. Still, likely have no choice but to agree. The resources he offers are immense.
translation: 怀疑他不可信。他看起来很务实高效，但他的个人野心是个危险。不过，恐怕别无选择只能同意。他提供的资源太庞大了。

english: Lucien's resources have changed the game. With them, it did not take long to confirm suspicions regarding the Temple of Ikov. The artefact there was indeed the Staff of Armadyl.
translation: 卢西安的资源改变了局面。有了这些资源，很快就确认了关于伊科夫神殿的猜测。那里的文物确实是阿玛杜尔杖。

english: Lucien has now taken ownership of the Staff. He has found little problem wielding it. Staff is a beautiful item of exquisite workmanship, but far more notable is its power. It's truly unlike anything previously encountered.
translation: 卢西安现在已经拿到了法杖。他使用起来几乎毫无困难。这把法杖工艺精美，但更值得注意的是它的力量。这真是前所未见。

english: Despite success, Lucien doesn't seem satisfied. He claims this is just the beginning. If history is to be believed, it was the Staff that allowed Zamorak to claim godhood. However, if godhood is what Lucien seeks as well, why is the Staff not enough for him? He is still funding my work, so it seems I have a role to play in whatever he plans next.
translation: 尽管成功了，卢西安似乎并不满足。他声称这只是开始。如果历史可信，正是这把法杖让扎莫拉克得以封神。但如果卢西安追求的也是神位，为什么这把法杖对他来说还不够？他仍在资助我的工作，看来在他接下来的计划中我还有一席之地。

english: Found a new tome of interest in the library of Keldagrim. City was sealed for thousands of years. Should have considered the potential there sooner.
translation: 在凯尔达格林城的图书馆里发现了一本有趣的典籍。这座城市被封闭了数千年。早该考虑那里的潜力了。

english: The Helpers, High Order of Guthix: 'A healer of Guthix spoke unto me that he had seen the power. That Guthix's fist would tear at the feeble grasp of those pretender gods who claim possession of the unfortunates that live in Gielinor.'
translation: 古斯高阶助者：'一位古斯的治疗者告诉我他见过那力量。古斯之拳将撕裂那些自称拥有吉莱诺尔不幸子民的伪神们的脆弱掌控。'

english: Once again, references to gods and their apparent all-powerful body parts. Did Zamorak have an omnipotent nose? Could Guthix's lips drink the oceans dry? Clearly not, so what does it mean?
translation: 又是对诸神和他们那看似全能的身体部位的提及。扎莫拉克有没有一个全能的鼻子？古斯的嘴唇能不能喝干海洋？显然不能，那这到底是什么意思？

english: Tome also contained some symbology, including a strange hexagonal design like that seen before. Dragonkin were previously dismissed as not an area of focus, but perhaps should reconsider. Symbolism seems tied to both them and to this Fist. Will dig out research.
translation: 典籍中还包含一些符号，包括之前见过的那个奇怪六边形图案。之前排除了龙人这个方向，但也许应该重新考虑。这个符号似乎既与龙人有关，也与这只拳头有关。得把研究资料翻出来。

english: Research on dragonkin is light. Ancient race of dragon-like creatures. Some claim they created dragons, but other dispute. Plausible idea though. Generally considered extinct since the work of Robert the Strong in the Fourth Age, though again, some dispute this.
translation: 关于龙人的研究资料很少。一个古老的龙形生物种族。有人说他们创造了巨龙，但也有人反驳。不过这个想法有道理。一般认为他们在第四纪元强者罗伯特的时代就已灭绝，不过同样有人对此有异议。

english: Accounts of dragonkin describe demon birds whose arrival signals absolute destruction. Orikalkum, commonly known as 'Dragon', may actually be named after them rather than after dragons. Discovery of forge in Baxtorian Caverns reinforces this.
translation: 关于龙人的记载描述了恶魔鸟，它们的到来预示着彻底的毁灭。奥里卡库姆，俗称'巨龙'，可能实际上是以他们命名的，而不是以龙命名的。在巴克斯托里安洞穴发现熔炉也印证了这一点。

english: Too many unknowns here. Need certainty, but also need to retain focus. Will revisit if other leads disappoint.
translation: 这里未知因素太多。需要确定性，但也需要保持专注。如果其他线索令人失望，再回来研究。

english: Location is clearly tied to Guthix and his followers, but tome was more rambly than most. Should take care. Can't assume all of this information to be accurate. These tomes were written long ago and translated many times. Mentality of original writers is impossible to know.
translation: 这个地点显然与古斯及其追随者有关，但这本典籍比大多数都更散乱。要小心。不能假设所有这些信息都是准确的。这些典籍写于很久以前，经过多次翻译。原作者的心态无从得知。

english: Seems Lucien has reason to distrust me. He's despatched a pair of spies to keep an eye on my work. However, spies were sloppy and quick to notice. They won't be an issue. Will lay a false trail leading them to Draynor Village so they stay out of the way.
translation: 看来卢西安有理由不信任我。他派了两个间谍来监视我的工作。不过，这两个间谍很粗心，很快就被发现了。他们不会成为问题。会布置一条假线索把他们引向德雷诺村，让他们别碍事。

english: Lucien requested a meeting. Claimed he wanted an update on my work, but suspect he had other intentions.
translation: 卢西安要求会面。声称想了解我的工作进展，但我怀疑他另有意图。

english: He had no reason to, but chose to demonstrate a new incantation: Daemonicas Abhoris. Have heard tales of such magic, but assumed it to be impossible.
translation: 他没有理由这么做，却选择展示一个新的咒语：恶魔厌恶术。听说过这种魔法的传说，但以为是不可能的。

english: Incantation filled the vicinity with cursed flames and the stench of putrefied death. From the flames came a warped beast of charred bone and burnt flesh. A demon, bound to an eternity of torment. Lucien laughed exultantly at his creation and controlled it like a puppet. I saw the hatred in its eyes, but it could do nothing as it was forced to bow down as if offering fealty.
translation: 咒语让周围充满了诅咒之焰和腐尸的恶臭。火焰中出现了一只由焦骨和烧肉扭曲而成的野兽。一个恶魔，被束缚在永恒的折磨中。卢西安得意地大笑着，像操控木偶一样控制着它。我看到了它眼中的仇恨，但它只能被迫俯首称臣，什么也做不了。

english: A demonstration. Lucien is reminding me of his power. Should ensure I make suitable preparations. Normal weapons will likely only be marginally useful. The creatures seem to possess some sort of magical defence. However, there are weapons in this world that demons fear. Should acquire one in case Lucien turns them on me.
translation: 一场示威。卢西安在提醒我他的力量。我得做好充分准备。普通武器恐怕只能发挥有限作用。这些生物似乎拥有某种魔法防御。不过，这世上有恶魔惧怕的武器。我应该弄一把，以防卢西安用它们对付我。

english: Disappointment after disappointment has often had me thinking of my younger days, when I was first told about the eureka moment: the moment when everything finally makes sense. That moment has finally arrived.
translation: 一次次失望让我常常想起年轻时候，那时我第一次听说'顿悟时刻'：一切都豁然开朗的瞬间。那个时刻终于到来了。

english: The Order of Wizards have discovered an ancient temple: A place known as the Temple of the Eye that was built to house Saradomin's Eye. Eye may be long gone, but clear traces of its energy remain. Traces perfectly match the power detected across Gielinor.
translation: 巫师教团发现了一座古老的神殿：名为眼之神殿，是为供奉萨拉多明之眼而建。眼睛或许早已不在，但其能量的清晰痕迹依然留存。这些痕迹与吉莱诺各地检测到的力量完全吻合。

english: The Wilderness, Morytania, Lunar Isle, Lumbridge and now this temple. At some point in time, the Eye was present in all of these locations. Of course, that's not entirely true. The Eye is clearly a false name.
translation: 荒野、莫利塔尼亚、月亮岛、仑桥镇，还有现在这座神殿。在某个时间点，眼睛曾出现在所有这些地方。当然，这不完全准确。'眼睛'显然是个假名。

english: Despite the propaganda of his followers, Saradomin did not make the Eye. He was just one of many to possess it. While it was Saradomin's Eye at one point in time, at another it was the Fist of Guthix. No doubt it has gone by many other names as well. Now only one question remains: Where to find it?
translation: 尽管追随者们大肆宣传，萨拉多明并非眼睛的创造者。他只是众多拥有者之一。虽然它一度是萨拉多明之眼，但在另一个时期，它是古斯之拳。毫无疑问，它还有其他许多名字。现在只剩下一个问题：去哪里找它？

english: I realise now what Lucien seeks. What he hopes I will find for him. The Staff of Armadyl did not grant Zamorak godhood, because the Staff alone lacks the power to do so. The Staff allowed him to claim the power of the 'Nameless One', but his ascension was only possible thanks to something else. He needed the Stone.
translation: 我现在明白了卢西安在寻找什么。他希望我为他找到什么。阿玛杜尔杖并未赐予扎莫拉克神格，因为单凭法杖本身没有这个力量。法杖让他得以夺取'无名者'的力量，但他的升格之所以可能，靠的是别的东西。他需要那块石头。

english: Yes, Stone, for that seems to be the closest thing to its true name that I can find. An ancient tablet found at the Varrock Digsite offered the final puzzle piece. Seemed meaningless at the time, but now it is all so clear.
translation: 是的，石头，因为这似乎是我能找到的最接近它真名的称呼。在维洛克城挖掘点发现的一块古代石板提供了最后一块拼图。当时看似毫无意义，但现在一切都如此清晰。

english: 'Jas left a Stone behind.' Once translated, that's what the text on the tablet read. The Moon Clan knew all along, but they kept that knowledge a secret. However, I have now discovered the truth: The Eye of Saradomin. The Fist of Guthix. The Stone of Jas.
translation: '贾斯留下了一块石头。'翻译过来后，石板上的文字就是这样。月亮部族一直都知道，但他们保守着这个秘密。然而，我现在发现了真相：萨拉多明之眼。古斯之拳。贾斯之石。

english: You inspect the mural. It reads:
translation: 你仔细查看壁画。上面写着：

english: Adamant Dragons: <Num0> kills
translation: 精金龙：<Num0> 击杀

english: Rune Dragons: <Num0> kills
translation: 符文龙：<Num0> 击杀

english: Can I help you, outsider?
translation: 需要帮忙吗，外来者？

english: Tell me about this shop.
translation: 给我讲讲这家店。

english: This is the headquarters of Supplies's Supplies, a global chain of world class equipment providing outposts that effectively synergise with local corporate needs.
translation: 这里是补给品补给总部，一个全球性的顶级装备供应连锁，有效配合当地企业需求。

english: Excuse me, I wasn't done.
translation: 抱歉，我还没说完。

english: My apologies, please continue.
translation: 抱歉，请继续。

english: This business has been stimulating local economies for over one generation, and represents a core pillar of every community in which it operates.
translation: 这家企业已经推动当地经济超过一代人，是每个运营社区的核心支柱。

english: We have locations at every major settlement on Wyrmscraig and a diverse portfolio of other business interests in the area.

Its body serves as a powerful market of the dangers of this island. We have witnessed such things before, but never at this rate.

translation: 我对这些该死的秘银生物做了更多研究，结果令人不安。分析让我相信它们是由更高力量创造的，什么样的生物能如此强大？

english: ...metallic for missiles and magical energies...green for close combat and magic...both have their breath weapon for which they are infamous...next I will try reason and logic, may Guthix watch over me.
translation: ...金属用于导弹和魔法能量...绿色用于近战和魔法...两者都有它们臭名昭著的吐息武器...接下来我将尝试理性和逻辑，愿古斯保佑我。

english: I must caution against offering the wrong gifts to the spirits inhabiting the world beyond this. They seem quick to anger if the offerer was in any way responsible for the offering's death.
translation: 我必须警告不要向此界之外的灵魂献上错误的祭品。如果献祭者以任何方式导致了祭品的死亡，它们似乎很容易发怒。

translation: 项目1 - 秘银大量存在，正如所料。

english: The combination of each of these prime ingredients will result in a fine pie, heightening the reactions of the lucky fellow who eats it. Sadly, most demand in my establishment is from scruffy fellows who make the place look untidy.
translation: 这些主要配料的组合将制成美味的馅饼，增强幸运食客的反应。可惜，我店里的大多数顾客都是让地方显得凌乱的邋遢家伙。

english: ...no one I know of has had access to an onyx amulet, the cost is just too immense. Enchanted, charged dragonstone amulets appear to be able to increase the perceptions of the wearer, at least when mining rocks for ore, they can increase the yield of precious gems.
translation: ...据我所知没有人拥有过玛瑙护符，价格实在太昂贵了。附魔充能的龙石护符似乎能增强佩戴者的感知，至少在采矿时能增加珍贵宝石的产出。

english: ...because her coach was a pumpkin. We laughed so much I thought my sides would split. I think that too much dwarven ale may have clouded my views, since it no longer seems a fit jest...
translation: ...因为她的马车是个南瓜。我们笑得肚子都疼了。我想是矮人麦酒喝多了让我觉得这不再是个好笑话...

english: In search of the incarnation of Scabaras, I probe the darkest recesses of the hidden world. If he lies in wait, I must be the one to reunite him with his fellow deities. What would befall us if he were forever isolated? His bitterness can only grow...
translation: 为了寻找斯卡巴拉斯的化身，我探查隐藏世界最黑暗的凹处。如果他潜伏等待，我必须成为让他与众神重聚的人。如果他永远被孤立，我们会遭遇什么？他的怨恨只会增长...

english: I am not sure anyone will ever read this, as I say my final farewells. If any find this, pass my regards to Annalise, if she still lives. I cannot see this being a place visited except by those as doomed as I am.
translation: 我不确定是否有人会读到这些，当我做最后的告别。如果有人发现这些，请代我向安娜丽丝问好，如果她还活着。我不认为这里会有人来访，除非是和我一样注定灭亡的人。

english: If I ever get my hands on Otto he'll be in his grave. Sending me to this place to fester and die. 'See wonders' he says 'Impress the spirits' he says. The only way I'll be impressing the spirits is as one. While he sits out there living in luxury...
translation: 如果我抓到奥托，他就要进坟墓了。把我送到这个腐烂等死的地方。'去看奇观'他说，'打动灵魂'他说。我唯一能打动灵魂的方式就是成为灵魂。而他在外面过着奢侈的生活...

english: ...is the stone here?...was the stone here?...will the stone be here?...would that my sanity were firm enough that I knew what my questions meant. Then I might seek an answer.
translation: ...石头在这里吗？...石头曾在这里吗？...石头会在这里吗？...但愿我的理智足够坚定，让我知道我的问题意味着什么。那样我或许能寻求答案。

english: A momentary flash but I saw it! Hornless but the same deep crimson of its set-mates. A glorious thing to see, guarded by the creatures in the upper galleries. I must have it, I will have it!
translation: 一瞬间的闪光但我看到了！没有角，但和它的同类一样是深红色。壮观的景象，由上层走廊的生物守护。我必须得到它，我一定会得到它！

english: It read 'Laufata ki Glough ki Ta Quir Priw Undo eso, Tolly, gnomo kar is Glough hamo sarko pro Arposandra Qua!' - If only I had studied my languages more diligently.
translation: 上面写着'Laufata ki Glough ki Ta Quir Priw Undo eso, Tolly, gnomo kar is Glough hamo sarko pro Arposandra Qua!' - 要是我当初更勤奋地学习语言就好了。

english: ...I learned my lesson when I tried to take that Zamorakian wine. I really think the monks overreacted. I always thought they were supposed to be teetotal anyway.
translation: ...我试图拿走那瓶萨莫拉克葡萄酒时学到了教训。我真的觉得那些僧侣反应过度了。我一直以为他们本该是戒酒的。

english: The Baxtorian Falls are well worth investigating, in my opinion, since water leaves the lake above this area yet none appears to flow into it. What could be the source of this quantity of water?
translation: 依我之见，巴克斯托里安瀑布非常值得调查，因为水从上方湖泊流出，却似乎没有水流入。这么多水的源头会是什么呢？

english: My investigations show that water temperature in the Baxtorian Falls area are substantially higher than might be expected given the local climate. The source of this heat will now be the focus of my studies.
translation: 我的调查显示，巴克斯托里安瀑布地区的水温远高于当地气候应有的水平。这个热量的来源将是我研究的重点。

english: Our best guess is that some sort of heat generation process is occurring in the tunnels we have scryed, though the denizens are proving quite a hindrance to our free travel. Research was never this dangerous for my teachers.
translation: 我们最好的猜测是某种产热过程正在我们探查的隧道中发生，尽管那些居民对我们的自由通行造成了相当大的阻碍。对我的老师们来说，研究从未如此危险。

english: Barakur has proved his worth, as we were forced to slay several dragons on our way to inner regions. The caves are clearly of artificial manufacture, though the excavations must have been thousands of years ago, to judge by the...
translation: 巴拉库尔证明了自己的价值，因为我们被迫在前往内部区域的路上杀死了几条龙。洞穴显然是人工建造的，但从...判断，挖掘必定是数千年前的事了。

english: Our theory of artificial origins has been vindicated! We have discovered a sturdy door, which seems to be a similar age to the original excavations. I am sure that there is magical or mechanical activity behind it, though it may simply be a great rush of water.
translation: 我们的人工起源理论得到了证实！我们发现了一扇坚固的门，似乎与最初的挖掘年代相近。我确信后面有魔法或机械活动，尽管可能只是一股巨大的水流。

english: The door resists all of our efforts to penetrate it, even the Fishing explosives which Derril suggested were tried with no success. There must be some way through which is linked to magic, though perhaps all who know the secret are now long dead.
translation: 这扇门抵抗了我们所有的破门努力，甚至德里尔建议的钓鱼炸药也试过但未成功。一定有某种与魔法相关的通过方式，尽管也许知道秘密的人都早已逝去。

english: Buy from Bob's Brilliant Axes - if you see our prices bettered, let us know and we will beat them. Offer subject to availability and at Bob's discretion. Does not affect your legal rights under Lumbridge laws.
translation: 从鲍勃的出色斧头店购买 - 如果你看到更好的价格，告诉我们，我们会更低。优惠视库存而定，由鲍勃酌情决定。不影响你在仑桥镇法律下的合法权利。

english: ...created spheres of power to support those who should come to that dread place thereafter. But the well senses the light of these spheres, and will not...
translation: ...创造了力量之球来支持那些日后来到那可怕之地的人。但水井能感知这些球的光，不会...

english: ...barred the magi loyal to the great Lord Zamorak from entering the tower, keeping the new-found power of the runes to themselves. But one brave soul gathered his followers and forced his way into the library...
translation: ...阻止了忠于伟大的萨莫拉克领主的法师进入塔中，将符文的新力量据为己有。但一个勇敢的灵魂聚集了他的追随者，强行闯入了图书馆...

english: ...and I have lost my way in this accursed dungeon. The air is foul and bugs are everywhere...a noise from down the tunnel. There was a bell on the floor. Grasping the bell I rang it with all my might...it attacked me.
translation: ...我在这个该死的地牢里迷路了。空气污浊，到处都是虫子...隧道深处传来声响。地板上有一个钟。我抓起钟用尽全力敲响...它攻击了我。

english: ...perhaps the dragonkin were involved? A wild theory, I know, but look at the evidence...
translation: ...也许龙人参与其中？我知道这是个疯狂的理论，但看看证据...

translation: 端来一大杯药酒。

english: She held to his jaw,
translation: 她托住他的下巴，

english: As she tipped the clear glass,
translation: 倾斜那透明的杯子，

english: And down his deep throat,
translation: 顺着他的喉咙深处，

english: The medicine did pass.
translation: 药水一饮而尽。

english: With a jolt and a sneeze,
translation: 猛地一颤，打了个喷嚏，

translation: 哈里爵士一跃而起，

english: 'You've done it, good woman,
translation: '你做到了，好女人，'

english: You killed the vile bug!'
translation: '你杀死了那可恶的病菌！'

english: As he ran out the door,
translation: 他跑出门去，

english: My eyes grew quite wide,
translation: 我瞪大了眼睛，

translation: '发生了什么，妮芙护士，'

translation: '老把戏了，'她回答，

translation: '百试百灵，'

translation: 她像盗贼一样咧嘴一笑，

english: 'Only Greenman's Ale.'
translation: '不过是绿人麦酒罢了。'

english: Oh happy accident!
translation: 哦，多么幸运的意外！

english: Magic has been child's play to me, all my life. With a few words of power, I could twist the world to suit my pleasure.
translation: 魔法对我来说一直如同儿戏。只需几句咒语，我就能扭曲世界以满足我的喜好。

english: Our lord Xeric has made full use of my gifts; I dare say that my power was instrumental in his ascent to greatness, and he rightly rewarded me by appointing me as his High Priest.
translation: 我们的主上泽里克充分利用了我的天赋；我敢说我的力量在他崛起为伟人的过程中功不可没，他也明智地任命我为大祭司作为回报。

english: It is, of course, a matter of regret that I could not sustain our dominion over the kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 当然，未能维持我们对大库兰德王国的统治，实属遗憾。

english: But Kourend is a limited place, full of limited people. In these caverns, I have no doubt that we shall all learn to transcend such limits - indeed, my accident has already imbued me with power beyond my imaginings.
translation: 但库兰德是个有限的地方，满是有限的人。在这些洞穴中，我毫不怀疑我们都将学会超越这些局限——事实上，我的意外已经赋予了我超乎想象的力量。

english: We had always known that this mountain housed great power; that is why we travelled here after our exile from Kourend. However, it is one thing to perceive power, but it is often much harder to wield it for oneself. And then came my accident.
translation: 我们一直都知道这座山蕴藏着巨大的力量；这就是我们从库兰德被流放后前来此处的原因。然而，感知力量是一回事，要为自己驾驭它往往困难得多。然后，我的意外就发生了。

english: I had entered a cavern in the great labyrinths under Mount Quidamortem, and found it to contain a huge number of purple crystals.
translation: 我进入了奎达莫特姆山巨大迷宫中的一处洞穴，发现里面布满了大量紫色水晶。

english: Immediately I was drawn to investigate, for such crystals are a sign of the magicks that we've been seeking.
translation: 我立刻被吸引去调查，因为这种水晶正是我们一直在寻找的魔法的标志。

english: If we could learn to wield this power for ourselves, nothing could prevent our triumph.
translation: 如果我们能学会为自己驾驭这种力量，没有什么能阻止我们的胜利。

english: While my attention was focused solely on the crystals, I failed to detect a tremor in the cavern. Suddenly the roof gave way, and I felt myself pinned to the ground by the crushing weight of the rocks falling from above.
translation: 当我的注意力完全集中在水晶上时，我没有察觉到洞穴中的震动。突然屋顶塌陷，我感到自己被上方落下的岩石的沉重重量压在地上。

english: I admit I panicked - powerful though I am, I am not invulnerable, and the power within the mountain could have destroyed me.
translation: 我承认我慌了——尽管我很强大，但我并非无懈可击，山中的力量本可以摧毁我。

english: In my shock, I failed to maintain the bindings of my incorporeal form, so my essence flowed outwards, intersecting with the rocks and the fragments of crystal within them.
translation: 在震惊中，我未能维持我无形形态的束缚，所以我的精华向外流出，与岩石及其中的水晶碎片相交。

english: That was how it happened. I should have faded away into oblivion, but instead I felt the rocks and crystal shards respond to my essence. I could move them. I could control them. And I could control the power that resided within them.
translation: 事情就是这样发生的。我本应消散于虚无，但相反，我感到岩石和水晶碎片对我的精华产生了反应。我可以移动它们。我可以控制它们。我还能控制它们内在的力量。

english: Through such a simple accident, I had stumbled upon a method of wielding the power of the caves for myself. The rocks and crystals had become an avatar for my essence, and their power was mine to command.
translation: 通过这样一个简单的意外，我偶然发现了一种为自己驾驭洞穴力量的方法。岩石和水晶成了我精华的化身，它们的力量由我指挥。

english: I returned, transfigured, to the others. They were astonished by my new form, and feared for their lives.
translation: 我变形后回到了其他人身边。他们对我的新形态感到震惊，并为自己的性命担忧。

english: They were right to be fearful. My power was beyond anything they could comprehend. With a mere thought I could have collapsed the mountain upon them all, then returned to Kourend to claim the kingdom as my own.
translation: 他们害怕是对的。我的力量超出了他们所能理解的范围。只需一个念头，我就能让山塌下来压死他们所有人，然后回到库兰德王国夺取王国。

english: In fact, that would be fitting. Xeric appointed me as his High Priest, but the time of priests is over.
translation: 事实上，那很合适。泽里克任命我为大祭司，但祭司的时代已经结束了。

english: What is a priest?
translation: 什么是祭司？

english: A priest is a conduit between the mundane and the transcendent, yet the priest remains mundane.
translation: 祭司是世俗与超然之间的通道，但祭司本身仍是世俗的。

english: A priest is a guide, teaching the plodding folk of this world to look beyond the everyday toil of their labour, elevating their thoughts to seek the divine, yet the priest must plod among them.
translation: 祭司是引导者，教导这个世界上步履蹒跚的人们超越日常劳作的辛苦，提升他们的思想去追寻神圣，但祭司必须与他们一同蹒跚前行。

english: I am not the priest. I am the god.
translation: 我不是祭司。我是神。

english: I am not the priest.
translation: 我不是祭司。

english: I am the god.
translation: 我是神。

english: I am the god, and I need no priests. There is no need for a guide or conduit, not when my power is manifest.
translation: 我是神，我不需要祭司。不需要引导者或通道，当我的力量显现时，这些都不需要。

english: If Xeric will not recognise me as his lord and master, away with him!
translation: 如果泽里克不承认我是他的主人，那就让他滚开！

english: Our lord Xeric commanded that we preserve this document as a warning. Let the fate of Vasa Nistirio serve as an example to anyone who dares challenge Lord Xeric.
translation: 我们的主人泽里克命令我们保存这份文件作为警示。让瓦萨.尼斯蒂里奥的命运成为任何胆敢挑战泽里克主人的榜样。

english: Although the former High Priest had indeed become mighty, Xeric was able to bind him to four great crystals of power, imprisoning his avatar forever in this place.
translation: 尽管前任大祭司确实变得强大，泽里克还是能够将他束缚在四块巨大的力量水晶中，将他的化身永远囚禁在这个地方。

english: As a punishment for his hubris and treachery, he shall stand guard in Xeric's chambers until the mountain crumbles to dust and his essence is finally released into oblivion.
translation: 作为对他傲慢和背叛的惩罚，他将在泽里克的房间中站岗，直到山崩为灰尘，他的精华最终消散于虚无。
