english: A treatise on pressure
translation: 压力论

english: During my many adventures to planes beyond Gielinor, I've noticed the interesting effect of mass upon a compressible fluid or solid. While weight appears to vary from plane to plane, relative pressure remains constant. From these experiences, I've deduced that pressure can be recorded in relation to mass.
translation: 在我多次前往Gielinor之外位面的冒险中，我注意到了质量对可压缩流体或固体的有趣影响。虽然重量在不同位面间似乎有所变化，但相对压力保持不变。从这些经历中，我推断出压力可以与质量相关联地记录。

english: The unit of measurement I have chosen is quite arbitrary, but suits my needs. The pressure applied to a cubic yard of air by the heat of a typical dragon's flame I have dubbed as one dragflam (D). This can be broken down into 1,000 tickits (t).
translation: 我选择的测量单位相当随意，但适合我的需求。我将典型巨龙火焰的热量施加在一立方码空气上的压力称为一dragflam（D）。这可以细分为1,000个tickits（t）。

english: Of course, it is difficult to coerce a person into a container to be scorched by a dragon. Instead, my reasoning behind this arbitrary unit is for the ease it provides in measuring vertical pressure. When comparing mass to vertical pressure, one kilogram (kg) nicely corresponds to one tickit (t).
translation: 当然，很难强迫一个人进入容器被巨龙灼烧。相反，我选择这个随意单位的理由是为了方便测量垂直压力。在比较质量与垂直压力时，一公斤（kg）恰好对应一个tickit（t）。

english: You have a look at the notice board, but there isn't anything of interest on it right now. You'll have to try one at a different port.
translation: 你看了看公告板，但上面现在没什么有趣的东西。你得去另一个港口试试。

english: Can you swing a sword and walk in a straight line? Join Scaurus's caravan and see the world* *Contract terminates at Quetzacalli Gorge.
translation: 你能挥剑走直线吗？加入Scaurus的商队，环游世界* *合同在Quetzacalli峡谷终止。

english: Tired of trees? Want to work somewhere bright? Consider a move to Fortis! Your career could rise higher than the grand walls of the city! Fame awaits you in the Colosseum! Move today, work tomorrow!
translation: 厌倦了树木？想在明亮的地方工作？考虑搬到Fortis吧！你的事业可以比城市的高墙升得更高！名声在竞技场等着你！今天搬家，明天上班！

english: BUYING: Jewels, metals and heirlooms! Speak to Jasper in Salvager Overlook. NO QUESTIONS ASKED OR ANSWERED!
translation: 收购：首饰、金属和传家宝！到Salvager Overlook找贾斯珀。不问也不答！

english: Board Games News: The empty rooms will be used for future expansion. If the games rooms prove to be popular then these rooms will be opened up for other board games such as Slime Wars and Chess.
translation: 棋盘游戏新闻：空房间将用于未来扩展。如果游戏室受欢迎，这些房间将开放用于其他棋盘游戏，如Slime Wars和国际象棋。

english: Recovery
translation: 恢复

english: Misfortune
translation: 不幸

english: Bloodlust
translation: 嗜血

english: It has been no simple measure retrieving her from the clutches of the vampyres, and our losses pain me to count, but hope glimmers in some of the others now that she is free. I, however, am not so sure.
translation: 把她从吸血鬼的魔爪中救出来绝非易事，我们的损失让我痛心计数，但现在她自由了，希望在其他一些人中闪烁。然而，我并不那么确定。

english: Her sleep is restless, and when awake it is clear her mind remains at unease after her experiences.
translation: 她睡不安稳，醒来时显然她的心因经历而无法平静。

english: I have tried probing for answers, yet I am greeted by little more than a solemn stare. Her scars must run deeper than any one of us can comprehend.
translation: 我试图探寻答案，但只得到严肃的凝视。她的伤痕一定比我们任何人能理解的更深。

english: For now at least, we can take solace in her resolve. Her blade seeks blood as if it were itself a vampyre, and when carving a path for us through the battlefield, she seems to be somehow more fearless than ever before. I will maintain my observations and records as best I can, though the pace of this bloodshed rather outstrips my capacity to write.
translation: 至少目前，我们可以从她的决心中得到安慰。她的刀锋渴望鲜血，仿佛它本身就是吸血鬼，当在战场上为我们开辟路径时，她似乎比以往任何时候都更加无畏。我会尽力维持我的观察和记录，尽管这场杀戮的速度超出了我书写的速度。

english: It has become starkly clear that whatever occurred in her absence changed her at a fundamental level.
translation: 已经非常清楚，她缺席期间发生的任何事情都在根本上改变了她。

english: Whilst the light of Saradomin still sparks in her eyes, her skin has attained a pallor that sneaks through beneath the blood caked upon it. She has begun to look ragged too, but insists that she feels no worse than before.
translation: 虽然Saradomin的光芒仍在她眼中闪烁，但她的皮肤已经呈现出一种苍白，从凝结的血迹下透出。她也开始显得憔悴，但坚持说她感觉不比以前差。

english: I fear a sickness grows within her that we may not hold a cure for. A sickness that sneaks behind her accursed arrogance and puts us all at risk.
translation: 我担心她体内滋长着一种我们可能没有解药的疾病。一种潜伏在她可诅咒的傲慢背后的疾病，使我们所有人都处于危险之中。

english: I pray to Saradomin that she pauses for a moment to allow us to examine her properly, though I know she never will.
translation: 我向Saradomin祈祷她能停下来让我们好好检查她，虽然我知道她永远不会。

english: I had not expected her sickness to be one of the soul as well as the body. Her blade today turned upon one of her own, blind to his markings and deaf to his protestations. In that moment her eyes saw nothing and her heart sought blood.
translation: 我没想到她的病既是身体上的也是灵魂上的。今天她的刀锋转向了自己人，对他的标记视而不见，对他的抗议充耳不闻。那一刻她的眼睛什么也看不见，她的心只寻求血。

english: We have buried what was left of him. During this process she remained at a distance, weighed down with a mixture of guilt and grief. I know only a little of how she feels, and even that gnaws at me. I wonder perhaps if she will ever see the other side of this war.
translation: 我们埋葬了他的遗骸。在这个过程中，她保持距离，被内疚和悲伤的混合压得喘不过气来。我对她的感受只了解一点点，即使那一点点也让我痛苦。我想知道她是否能看到这场战争的另一面。

english: It became abundantly clear that we could not continue to fight with her condition worsening further, and so we have taken a decision I hope we do not come to regret.
translation: 很明显，随着她的状况进一步恶化，我们无法继续战斗，所以我们做出了一个我希望不会后悔的决定。

english: We left Hallowvale at first light to seek a cure for her sickness. At her request, we shall travel by sea until we find somewhere where she can be in isolation. It is her guilt that plagues her most.
translation: 我们在晨曦之光时离开了哈洛维尔，为她的病寻找解药。应她的要求，我们乘船而行，直到找到一处能让她隔离的地方。最折磨她的是内心的愧疚。

english: This ship provides little comfort to any of us. She stares at the moon as it hangs in the sky, and I am left wondering if we have made a mistake in leaving. Meanwhile, the pyrophoroi are, by every measure, too bored to function.
translation: 这艘船对我们任何人来说都谈不上舒适。她凝视着悬挂在天空中的月亮，我不禁怀疑离开是否是个错误。与此同时，那些火术士们，无论从哪个角度看，都无聊得快疯了。

english: Our hope lies now in the future.
translation: 我们的希望现在寄托于未来。

english: If Elessia can regain her strength, perhaps she will lead us once again to Hallowvale. If we can find new weapons of war that can stand up to the vampyres.
translation: 如果艾莱西娅能恢复力量，也许她会再次带领我们回到哈洛维尔。如果我们能找到能对抗吸血鬼的新战争武器。

english: That damned word.
translation: 那个该死的词。

english: And my dreams are all but gone,
translation: 我的梦想几乎都已消散，

english: My actions must not be too brash,
translation: 我的行动不能太过鲁莽，

english: For you may yet live on.
translation: 因为你或许还能活下去。

english: Until new hope is at last revealed,
translation: 直到新的希望最终显现，

english: And you return from the world above.
translation: 你从上面的世界归来。

english: So if fate would have us united,
translation: 所以若命运让我们重逢，

english: Then there be six aspects desired,
translation: 那便有六个方面需要集齐，

english: And my faith will be reborn,
translation: 我的信念将重获新生，

english: Once they have all been acquired.
translation: 一旦它们全部到手。

english: So with these items claimed,
translation: 带着这些物品，

english: Seek out my plighted embrace,
translation: 寻找我承诺的拥抱，

english: For there you'll be compelled,
translation: 在那里你将被引导，

english: To find them their rightful place.
translation: 为它们找到应有的归宿。

english: First you'll need to bring the rune,
translation: 首先你需要带来符文，

english: That sees our world bloom,
translation: 它让我们的世界绽放，

english: The next one you'll find is grown,
translation: 下一个你会找到的，是生长之物，

english: From the seed of the tomb.
translation: 源自坟墓的种子。

english: With them you must place a knife,
translation: 与它们一起，你必须放一把刀，

english: That darkness has claimed,
translation: 黑暗已将其吞噬，

english: And in defiance of the chaotic lord,
translation: 为了反抗混沌之主，

english: Place the liquid he has named.
translation: 放上他以命名的液体。

english: Next you must seek a chain,
translation: 接下来你必须寻找一条锁链，

english: That will not compromise,
translation: 它不会妥协让步，

english: Bring lastly that which is green,
translation: 最后带来那绿色的东西，

english: And most humans despise.
translation: 大多数人类都厌恶它。

english: With these items in your hands,
translation: 当这些物品在你手中，

english: The key to our love is near,
translation: 我们爱情的钥匙就在近旁，

english: Place them in their chosen spot,
translation: 将它们放在选定的位置，

english: And your true desire will appear.
translation: 你真正的愿望便会显现。

english: There was a strange man in our home today. He'd come to see Sera, but she didn't tell me why. The two of them went down into the basement to talk. When I asked later, she said she didn't want to disturb me, but I wonder if she had other reasons.
translation: 今天有个陌生男人来我们家。他是来找塞拉的，但她没告诉我为什么。他们俩下到地下室去谈话。后来我问起，她说不想打扰我，但我怀疑她另有原因。

english: I got a good look at him when he left. There was something unsettling about him. He had a strange look in his eyes that I didn't like. He also wore a large medallion. It stuck out to me. It seemed far too fancy for anyone around here to be wearing it.
translation: 他离开时我仔细看了他一眼。他身上有些让人不安的地方。他眼神里有一种我不喜欢的奇怪神情。他还戴着一枚大勋章。这让我印象深刻。对这里的人来说，那枚勋章实在太华丽了。

english: I spoke to Sera after he left and asked her who he was. She didn't tell me. She just said that everything was going to be okay now.
translation: 他走后我跟塞拉说话，问她他是谁。她没有告诉我。她只说一切都会好起来的。

english: That strange man came back today. Once again, they went down into the basement. I thought about trying to sneak down to see what they were doing, but today was a bad one, and I felt too weak to move.
translation: 那个陌生男人今天又来了。他们又一次下到地下室。我想过偷偷溜下去看看他们在做什么，但今天状态不好，我虚弱得动不了。

english: This fever has been extra bad recently. On days like this, I struggle to even leave the bed. I wonder if that's what this is about. She's tried to hide it, but I know Sera is worried. Maybe she thinks this man can help me. I know she feels responsible for my illness.
translation: 最近发烧特别严重。这样的日子里，我连下床都困难。我在想这是不是就是原因。她试图隐瞒，但我知道塞拉很担心。也许她觉得这个男人能帮我。我知道她为我的病感到自责。

english: Sera's always getting herself into trouble. Too many fights with the wrong people. She said she was fine, that she could handle herself. She never thought it would put me in danger as well. Thing is, all it took was one cut. It was just a scratch. I'd had plenty worse, but the wound festered. Now, here we are.
translation: 塞拉总是惹上麻烦。跟不该惹的人打太多架。她说她没事，能照顾好自己。她从没想过这也会让我陷入危险。问题是，只需要一道伤口。那只是擦伤。我受过更重的伤，但伤口感染了。现在，我们就到了这一步。

english: The illness has progressed quickly. My mind thankfully remains undamaged, but I can't say the same for my body. I never leave the bed now. Sera is getting worried. It's only two more weeks until our sector is to be tithed. She worries I'll be too ill to cope.
translation: 病情恶化得很快。谢天谢地，我的神智还算清醒，但身体就不敢恭维了。我现在几乎离不开床。塞拉越来越担心了。再过两周就轮到我们区缴纳贡赋了。她担心我病得撑不住。

english: To be honest, she isn't wrong. Getting tithed is draining at the best of times. With me in this state, who knows what will happen.
translation: 说实话，她没说错。缴纳贡赋即使在最好的时候也很耗神。以我现在的状态，谁知道会发生什么。

english: It's now only one week until it's our turn to be tithed. Once again, the strange man is back. Things were a little bit different this time though. After their usual chat in the basement, the man came to see me.
translation: 现在离我们缴纳贡赋只剩一周了。那个奇怪的男人又来了。不过这次情况有些不同。他们像往常一样在地下室聊完之后，那个男人来看我了。

english: He stared at me for a long time, not saying anything. It was quite unnerving. Finally, after what felt like a lifetime, he turned to Sera and said, 'he is compatible.' And with that, he left.
translation: 他盯着我看了很久，一句话也没说。真让人不安。终于，在仿佛过了一辈子之后，他转向塞拉说：“他匹配。”说完就走了。

english: At this point, I knew something was wrong. It was clear that the man was coming here about me, but I still didn't really know why. I spoke to Sera and demanded she tell me the truth. We argued at first. She was clearly very uncomfortable. In the end, she agreed to tell me. Not today, but soon.
translation: 这时，我知道事情不对劲了。很明显那个男人是冲着我来的，但我还是不知道原因。我跟塞拉谈了，要求她告诉我真相。我们一开始争吵了。她显然很不自在。最后，她同意告诉我。不是今天，但很快。

english: Three days until we are tithed. With not long left to go, I knew that whatever Sera was planning would be happening soon. I reminded her of the promise she made. I made it clear that she needed to tell me what was going on. Once again, she was reluctant, but eventually she agreed.
translation: 离缴纳贡赋还有三天。时间不多了，我知道塞拉不管在计划什么，很快就会发生。我提醒她许下的承诺。我明确表示她需要告诉我发生了什么。她又一次不情愿，但最终还是同意了。

english: She told me that the man was here to help me, that he knew a way to cure my illness. She said that in a couple of days, he'd need to take me elsewhere so that he could perform an operation on me, one that would cure me forever.
translation: 她告诉我那个男人是来帮我的，他知道治愈我疾病的方法。她说再过几天，他需要带我去别的地方，给我做手术，一个能永远治愈我的手术。

english: Something didn't sit right with me. I asked her who he was and how she found him. She claimed that he was a doctor from sector five. I knew she was lying. No citizen, doctor or otherwise, could afford to wear clothes like that. Thing is, I didn't dwell on that. There was something bothering me even more.
translation: 我觉得有些不对劲。我问她他是谁，她是怎么找到他的。她声称他是五区的医生。我知道她在撒谎。没有哪个市民，不管是医生还是别的什么，能穿得起那样的衣服。问题是，我没多想这个。有件事更让我不安。

english: I asked her how she could afford his services. We have close to nothing here, definitely nowhere near enough to please a man with that much wealth. She didn't answer, but as she turned away, I saw the tears in her eyes.
translation: 我问她怎么付得起他的服务。我们这里几乎一无所有，绝对不够取悦一个那么富有的人。她没有回答，但当她转过身去时，我看到了她眼中的泪水。

english: The tithing of our sector begins today. According to Sera, the strange man will be here soon to pick me up. I don't want to go. Sera clearly hasn't been thinking straight and I'm afraid of the deal she might have made.
translation: 我们区的贡赋缴纳今天开始。据塞拉说，那个奇怪的男人很快就会来接我。我不想去。塞拉显然没有想清楚，我害怕她可能做了什么交易。

english: Thing is, I'm helpless now. The illness has progressed to the point where I can barely move. Even just writing this causes more pain than I've ever felt before. With no way to resist, I decided to rest. At least, that's what Sera thought I did.
translation: 问题是，我现在很无助。病情已经恶化到我几乎动不了的地步。光是写这些就让我感受到前所未有的痛苦。既然无法反抗，我决定休息。至少，塞拉是这么以为的。

english: While I pretended to sleep, she sat next to me. For a long time, she just sat there, not knowing that I could see her. Finally, she said something that filled me with a fear unlike any I'd felt before. 'Forgive me.'
translation: 我假装睡着时，她坐在我旁边。她就这样坐了很久，不知道我能看见她。最后，她说了一句话，让我充满了前所未有的恐惧。“原谅我。”

english: Another day of being lost in this terrible swamp. We can't go north again; the clans will track us down in the woods.
translation: 又在这可怕的沼泽里迷失了一天。我们不能再去北边了；部族会在树林里追踪到我们。

english: Mortarium and his son, little Onan, have been trying to catch some fish. They've had no luck catching anything in the sea, so now they're trying for eels in the swamp.
translation: 莫塔里乌姆和他的儿子小奥南一直在试着捕鱼。他们在海里一无所获，所以现在试着在沼泽里抓鳗鱼。

english: At first I thought I'd rather starve than eat something from out of the swamp, but it's been so long since we had food... anything's got to be better than this.
translation: 起初我以为宁愿饿死也不吃沼泽里的东西，但我们已经太久没吃东西了……什么都比这强。

english: How did this swamp even form? It doesn't smell natural. That old gnome woman and her children seem to know something about it, but they're not telling. The daughter let slip that they're from some kind of settlement in the eastern mountains, though I've never heard of a gnome town there.
translation: 这片沼泽到底是怎么形成的？闻起来不自然。那个老地精女性和她的孩子们似乎知道些什么，但他们不说。女儿不小心透露他们来自东部山脉的某个定居点，虽然我从没听说过那里有地精城镇。

english: Mortarium and Onan are still having no luck catching eels. To be honest, I think we should go back up north and take our chances with the clans. Nothing can possibly live down here.
translation: 莫塔里乌姆和奥南还是没抓到鳗鱼。说实话，我觉得我们应该回北边去，跟部族碰碰运气。这地方不可能有活物。

english: A terrible night. Turns out something can live in the swamp after all.
translation: 可怕的一夜。原来沼泽里确实有活物。

english: It came in the night, some kind of colossal serpent, all fangs and lashing tail, spitting venom and breathing toxic fumes. It ate five of us before we were all properly awake.
translation: 它在夜里来了，某种巨大的蛇，满嘴獠牙，尾巴猛甩，喷着毒液，吐着毒气。在我们完全醒来之前就吃了我们五个人。

english: I've said we should leave this place. I'd rather face the clans than be eaten by a giant snake.
translation: 我说过我们应该离开这里。我宁愿面对部族也不愿被巨蛇吃掉。

english: But that gnome woman's got a plan.
translation: 但那个地精女性有计划。

english: I don't trust her. On the other hand, no-one else has any ideas.
translation: 我不信任她。另一方面，其他人也都没有主意。

english: Still, I really don't trust her.
translation: 不过，我真的不信任她。

english: That was the most horrific thing I've ever seen. The gnome woman had a plan alright. If I'd realised what she was going to do, I'd have walked straight out on my own.
translation: 那是我见过最恐怖的事。那个地精女性确实有计划。如果我早知道她要做什么，我早就自己走了。

english: She'd made us build a big campfire by the edge of the swamp, where the snake appeared yesterday. As darkness fell, we gathered by the fire, waiting for the snake to return. Which it did.
translation: 她让我们在沼泽边生了一大堆营火，就是蛇昨天出现的地方。夜幕降临时，我们聚在火边，等着蛇回来。它确实回来了。

english: When it rose out of the swamp, ready for another meal, there was the gnome woman holding little Rentos, her son. She shouted to get the snake's attention, and held Rentos out for it to eat.
translation: 当它从沼泽中升起，准备再吃一顿时，地精女性抱着她的小儿子伦托斯站在那里。她大喊着吸引蛇的注意，把伦托斯递出去给它吃。

english: He was screaming, but she didn't bat an eyelid. She handed him straight to the snake. One gulp later, and Rentos was gone.
translation: 他在尖叫，但她眼睛都没眨一下。她直接把他交给了蛇。一口吞下，伦托斯就没了。

english: Then the snake turned back to the gnome woman, and she spoke to it. I thought she'd get eaten for sure, and serve her right, but the snake listened to her.
translation: 然后蛇转向地精女性，她跟它说话了。我以为她肯定会被吃掉，活该，但蛇听了她的话。

english: Turned out that was her plan - feed little Rentos to the snake to get its attention, so she could offer a deal. And it worked.
translation: 原来那就是她的计划——把小伦托斯喂给蛇来引起它的注意，这样她就能提出交易。而且成功了。

english: She promised the snake that if it let us live, and didn't wipe us all out, we would bring it regular sacrifices.
translation: 她向蛇承诺，如果它让我们活下去，不把我们全灭掉，我们会定期给它献祭。

english: She even promised that we would worship the snake as our god, forsaking Seren, and we would be its people.
translation: 她甚至承诺我们会把蛇当作神来崇拜，背弃塞伦，成为它的子民。

english: Well, it seems to have worked. The snake retreated into the swamp, and we're all still alive. Except for poor little Rentos.
translation: 嗯，似乎奏效了。蛇退回了沼泽，我们都还活着。除了可怜的小伦托斯。

english: Mortarium's finally caught some eels! They look and smell dreadful, as expected, but everyone's so hungry that we're going to eat them anyway.
translation: 莫塔里乌姆终于抓到了一些鳗鱼！它们看起来和闻起来都很糟糕，不出所料，但大家都太饿了，我们还是要吃。

english: That crazy gnome woman says the eels must have been sent by the snake god. She thinks he's accepted her deal, and is letting us live here on the condition that we send him sacrifices. So she thinks the snake is sending us eels to feed us, so that we in turn can feed him.
translation: 那个疯地精女人说鳗鱼一定是蛇神送来的。她觉得蛇神接受了她的交易，允许我们住在这里，条件是我们给它献祭。所以她认为蛇在送鳗鱼给我们吃，这样我们反过来也能喂它。

english: The horrible thing is that she seems to be right. The snake's kept away ever since she fed Rentos to it.
translation: 可怕的是她似乎是对的。自从她把伦托斯喂给蛇之后，蛇就没再出现过。

english: Her daughter doesn't seem to mind either. I don't get it. If I had a brother, and he got fed to a giant snake as part of a demented bargain, I'd scream my head off. The girl must be as crazy as her mother.
translation: 她的女儿似乎也不介意。我不明白。如果我有个兄弟，他被喂给巨蛇作为疯狂交易的一部分，我会尖叫到嗓子哑。那女孩肯定跟她妈一样疯。

english: It's the 3rd day now since that gnome woman turned us into a food-farm for the giant snake, and every day I find more reasons to distrust her. She's taken over the whole group now, and is calling herself the High Priestess of Zulrah - Oh yes, she's decided the snake is called Zulrah. Can't imagine where she got that name from.
translation: 自从那个地精女人把我们变成巨蛇的食物农场已经第三天了，每天我都找到更多不信任她的理由。她现在接管了整个团队，自称祖尔拉的大祭司——哦对，她决定蛇叫祖尔拉。真不知道她从哪想到这个名字的。

english: Now she wants us all to change our names, to honour Zulrah. So I've got to call myself Zul-Ohn.
translation: 现在她要我们都改名，以纪念祖尔拉。所以我得叫自己祖尔-奥恩。

english: That crazy gnome woman says it's time to make another sacrifice to Zulrah. She made a big speech about what a great honour it would be for the chosen sacrifice, and how their death would form part of the contract between Zulrah and our people.
translation: 那个疯地精女人说是时候给祖尔拉献祭了。她发表了一通长篇大论，说被选中的祭品是多么大的荣幸，他们的死将构成祖尔拉与我们人民之间契约的一部分。

english: The people are believing every word of it, too. Some girl even started shouting 'I volunteer as tribute'. But the High Priestess is going to choose the sacrifice this afternoon.
translation: 人们居然全都信了。有个女孩甚至开始喊“我自愿作为贡品”。但大祭司今天下午要选祭品。

english: Well, she'd better not choose me.
translation: 哼，她最好别选我。

english: We came to cleanse this underground pass of the dark forces that dwell here. We knew the journey would be treacherous, but even I was not prepared for the darkness that fills this place.
translation: 我们来此净化地下通道中盘踞的黑暗势力。我们深知此行凶险，但连我也未曾预料到此处黑暗之深。

english: To hold the darkness at bay, I had the mages create some Spheres of Light for us. I have positioned them in the tunnels around the well where we have made camp.
translation: 为了抵御黑暗，我让法师们为我们制作了一些光明之球。我已将它们放置在营地周围水井附近的隧道中。

english: These spheres are imbued with the holy light of Saradomin himself. They will give us the faith and courage we need.
translation: 这些球体注入了萨拉多曼本人的神圣之光。它们将给予我们所需的信念与勇气。

english: I still feel...
translation: 我仍然感到……

english: Loyal citizens of Great Kourend, we face a grave danger.
translation: 伟大的库兰德王国的忠诚公民们，我们正面临一场严重的危机。

english: The Winter Beast continues to ravage the lands to the north, as it has done so for three decades now.
translation: 寒冬野兽继续肆虐北方土地，三十年来从未停歇。

english: The threat to our great kingdom is severe and our attempts to quell the beast are, thus far, unsuccessful.
translation: 对我们伟大王国的威胁十分严峻，而我们迄今镇压野兽的努力均未成功。

english: However, we have perhaps been fortunate that the beast remains within the north and has not directed its fiercely cold presence towards our great kingdom.
translation: 然而，我们或许还算幸运，野兽仍留在北方，尚未将其凛冽的寒气指向我们伟大的王国。

english: But we would be foolish to assume this will always be the case, and we must prepare our kingdom to face this peril.
translation: 但若以为这种情况会永远持续，那就太愚蠢了。我们必须让王国做好准备，迎接这场危机。

english: Fifteen decades have passed since our ancestors founded this great kingdom, and we must protect all that we have discovered, learned, crafted and forged.
translation: 自先祖建立这个伟大王国以来，已过去十五个十年。我们必须保护我们所发现、所学、所造、所铸的一切。

english: In the event that our great kingdom does fall to the Winter Beast and all of us should perish, our history and discoveries must survive!
translation: 万一我们伟大的王国真的沦陷于寒冬野兽，我们所有人都将消亡，但我们的历史和发现必须留存！

english: It is with this in mind that I, Lord Arceuus, Ruler of Great Kourend, hereby order the construction of a library. A library filled with texts, documents and research from all of Great Kourend. The library shall be constructed here, within Arceuus, and enchanted with spells from our greatest mages to protect the contents from evil.
translation: 正是出于这一考虑，我，阿西乌斯领主，伟大的库兰德王国的统治者，在此下令建造一座图书馆。这座图书馆将收藏来自整个库兰德王国的文本、文件和研究成果。图书馆将建在阿西乌斯城内，并由我们最强大的法师施以魔法，保护其中的内容免受邪恶侵害。

english: The building of the library must be swift, so I call on all of Kourend to assist.
translation: 图书馆的建设必须迅速，因此我呼吁全体库兰德人民共同协助。

english: Lovakengj, your finest smiths will provide the materials for the library.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉城，你们最优秀的铁匠将为图书馆提供材料。

english: Shayzien, your strongest soldiers will transit the materials and construct the library.
translation: 谢兹恩城，你们最强壮的士兵将运送材料并建造图书馆。

english: Piscarilius, your seasoned fisherman will provide food for those working on the library.
translation: 皮斯卡里琉斯城，你们经验丰富的渔夫将为图书馆的工人提供食物。

english: Hosidius, your finest scribes will collect and organise the texts for the library.
translation: 霍西迪乌斯城，你们最出色的抄写员将收集和整理图书馆的文本。

english: Arceuus, our greatest mages will concoct the enchantments to protect the library.
translation: 阿西乌斯城，我们最伟大的法师将配制保护图书馆的魔法。

english: Finally, I call upon you, all of you, the fine citizens of our great kingdom. You must all unite, gather your notes and scribe your thoughts.
translation: 最后，我呼吁你们，所有人，我们伟大王国的优秀公民们。你们必须团结一致，收集你们的笔记，写下你们的思想。

english: No matter your duty, I urge each and every one of you to submit your writings to the library.
translation: 无论你们的职责是什么，我恳请你们每一个人都将自己的著作提交给图书馆。

english: This great library will endure the trial of time, ensuring our civilization survives and remain at the heart of Great Kourend for many decades to come!
translation: 这座伟大的图书馆将经受时间的考验，确保我们的文明得以延续，并在未来数十年中始终屹立于库兰德王国的中心！

english: To the Oracle of Ice Mountain, greetings:
translation: 致冰山的神谕者，敬启：

english: My sources tell me that many adventurers are becoming confused about one of your riddles.
translation: 我的消息来源告诉我，许多冒险者对你其中一个谜语感到困惑。

english: When asked to find a BOWL that has not seen heat, a large number of adventurers assume that a POT will suffice. Of course, this has no effect, so they send complaints about you to the Council.
translation: 当被要求寻找一个未经受热的碗时，大量冒险者认为罐子也可以。当然，这毫无效果，于是他们向议会投诉你。

english: Strength through Wisdom!
translation: 智慧即力量！

english: I have spent many hours pondering the question you asked me in your recent letter. From the results seen so far, this new method of refining metals from their ores possesses the potential to revolutionise smithing, although I fear that the vast majority of smiths will never fully adapt to the new technique.
translation: 我花了很长时间思考你最近来信中提出的问题。从目前的结果来看，这种从矿石中提炼金属的新方法具有革新锻造的潜力，尽管我担心绝大多数铁匠永远无法完全适应这项新技术。

english: Please keep an eye out for any documents that might be of interest to me, as always.
translation: 请一如既往地留意任何可能对我有用的文件。

english: Long has it been since out last meeting, my friend, too long. Truly we are living in tumultuous times, and the foul works of Zamorak can be seen across the lands. Indeed, I hear a whisper from the south that the power of the Terrible One has been rediscovered! But be of good cheer, my friend, for we are all in the hands of the Lord Saradomin.
translation: 自我们上次会面以来已过了很久，我的朋友，太久了。我们确实生活在动荡的时代，扎莫拉克的邪恶行径遍布各地。确实，我听到来自南方的耳语，说那位恐怖者的力量已被重新发现！但请保持乐观，我的朋友，因为我们都在萨拉多曼主的庇护之下。

english: To Thurgo, master blacksmith, greetings:
translation: 致瑟戈，铁匠大师，敬启：

english: Following your request, I have spend some time re-reading the relevant scrolls in the Library of Varrock. It appears that when your forefathers encountered that adventurer, he was on a quest to find a mysterious shield.
translation: 遵照你的请求，我花了一些时间重新阅读维洛克城图书馆中的相关卷轴。看来当你的先祖遇到那位冒险者时，他正在寻找一面神秘的盾。

english: Many thanks for the recipe you sent me; I shall certainly try this 'redberry pie' of which you speak so highly.
translation: 非常感谢你寄来的食谱；我一定会尝试你极力推荐的这道'红莓派'。

english: To the High Priest of Entrana: greetings.
translation: 致恩特纳岛的大祭司：敬启。

english: To respond to your recent questions about the effects of summoning the power of Saradomin, I have spent some time searching through the scrolls of Kolodion the battle mage. He records that a bolt of lightning falls from above, accompanied by a resounding crash, and the victim loses up to 20 life points; however, he believed that this could be increased by 50% should one be wearing the Cape of Saradomin and be charged when casting the spell.
translation: 关于你最近提出的召唤萨拉多曼之力效果的问题，我花了一些时间查阅战斗法师科洛迪恩的卷轴。他记载道，一道闪电从天而降，伴随着震耳欲聋的轰鸣，受害者损失最多20点生命值；但他认为若穿着萨拉多曼披风并在施法时充能，伤害可提高50%。

english: Fare thee well, my young friend,
translation: 愿你安好，我年轻的朋友。

english: To Lawrence, resident priest of Varrock, greetings:
translation: 致维洛克城驻祭司劳伦斯，敬启：

english: Despite our recent conversation on this matter, I hear that you are still often found in a less than sober condition. I am forced to repeat the warning I gave you at the time: if you continue to indulge yourself in this manner, the Council will have no choice but to transfer you to Entrana where you can be supervised more carefully.
translation: 尽管我们最近就此问题谈过话，但我听说你仍经常处于不太清醒的状态。我不得不重申当时的警告：如果你继续这样放纵自己，议会将别无选择，只能将你调往恩特纳岛，在那里你可以受到更严格的监督。

english: I trust you will heed this message.
translation: 我相信你会重视这条信息。

english: To Aereck, resident priest of Lumbridge, greetings:
translation: 致仑桥镇驻祭司艾雷克，敬启：

english: I am pleased to inform you that, following a careful search, the staff of the seminary have located your pyjamas.
translation: 我很高兴地通知你，经过仔细搜寻，神学院的职员已找到了你的睡衣。

english: Before returning them to you, however, they would be very interested to know exactly how these garments came to be in the graveyard.
translation: 不过在归还给你们之前，他们非常想知道这些衣物究竟是怎么出现在墓园里的。

english: Please pass on my regards to Urhney.
translation: 请代我向乌尔尼问好。

english: Sentinel Gortstein
translation: 哨兵戈特斯坦

english: In case you're asked to look at that tree again, I've made some notes you may find useful.
translation: 以防你又被叫去看那棵树，我做了些笔记，或许对你有用。

english: I've spent many days trying to remove the tree to no success. However, I've found that while the tree can't be killed, it can at least be weakened. Without the right amount of water, the bark of the tree will grow so hard that it will become impossible to chop logs or collect sap.
translation: 我花了很多天试图移除那棵树，但都没有成功。不过，我发现虽然树无法被杀死，但至少可以削弱它。如果没有适量的水，树皮会变得坚硬无比，导致无法砍伐原木或收集树液。

english: There are two valves in the Arboretum that can be used to control how much water the tree receives. The northern one gives seven gallons of water per interval. The southern one gives four gallons of water per interval. For the tree to be healthy, it requires <Num0> gallons of water.
translation: 植物园里有两个阀门，可以用来控制树获得的水量。北边的阀门每个间隔提供七加仑水。南边的阀门每个间隔提供四加仑水。要让树保持健康，它需要<Num0>加仑的水。

english: Hopefully this information is of use to you.
translation: 希望这些信息对你有用。

english: Sentinel Bloodmyre
translation: 哨兵布拉德迈尔

english: They look rather complicated and you can't work out what they mean. Hopefully Flaygian will understand them.
translation: 它们看起来相当复杂，你无法理解其中的含义。希望弗莱吉安能看懂。

english: That's the trouble with young people these days. Not my boy, though. He's a good boy, always working. That's why he never visits. Run along now, young one.
translation: 这就是现在年轻人的毛病。不过我的儿子不是这样。他是个好孩子，总是勤恳工作。这也是他从不来看我的原因。快走吧，年轻人。

english: How many amulets would you like to exchange?
translation: 你想兑换多少个护身符？

english: How frightfully rude of me, my dear girl. My name is Odovacar and I work for that excellent enterprise, the Bank of Gielinor.
translation: 我真是太失礼了，亲爱的姑娘。我叫奥多瓦卡尔，为吉埃林诺银行这家优秀的企业工作。

english: Absolutely correct, dear lady. I must warn you, however, that due to the significantly increased overheads of an enterprise such as this, there is a small bank charge of 100gp every time you want to access your account.
translation: 完全正确，亲爱的女士。不过我必须提醒你，由于这样一家企业的运营成本大幅增加，每次你想访问账户时，需要支付100金币的小额银行手续费。

english: As an Ultimate Iron Man you cannot use the bank.
translation: 作为终极铁人，你不能使用银行。

english: As an Ultimate Iron Woman you cannot use the bank.
translation: 作为终极铁女，你不能使用银行。

english: It's... for me... spines!
translation: 这是...给我的...脊椎！

english: How many do you want? (0 – <Num0>)
translation: 你想要多少？（0 – <Num0>）

english: By order of the Praefectus Classis, all vessels are to be prepared for battle.
translation: 奉舰队司令之令，所有船只须做好战斗准备。

english: With artefact 'Imperium' safely delivered to the east, focus must return to artefact 'Primus'.
translation: 文物'帝国'已安全送达东部，现在必须将注意力转回文物'第一'。

english: New intelligence has confirmed its location and it is expected attempts to recover it will be met with heavy resistance from Saradominist forces.
translation: 新的情报已确认其位置，预计回收行动将遭到萨拉多明势力的顽强抵抗。

english: Oh, it's you. That lad left a tome here for you. Take them with you so I don't have to keep looking after them like some librarian.
translation: 哦，是你啊。那小子留了本典籍在这里给你。拿走吧，省得我像个图书管理员一样替你们保管。

english: Oh, it's you. That lad left some tomes here for you. Take them with you so I don't have to keep looking after them like some librarian.
translation: 哦，是你啊。那小子留了些典籍在这里给你。拿走吧，省得我像个图书管理员一样替你们保管。

english: Hmph! And where do you plan to put it? Make some room first!
translation: 哼！你打算把它放哪儿？先腾点地方出来！

english: Old Man Ral gives you another medallion.
translation: 老人拉尔又给了你一枚勋章。

english: Old Man Ral gives you <Num0> medallions.
translation: 老人拉尔给了你<Num0>枚勋章。

english: You've obtained another clue scroll!
translation: 你获得了另一张线索卷轴！

english: Tertius,
translation: 特提乌斯，

english: I write to you with the deepest regret in my heart. It was not my intention to hide what happened from you. It wounds me that it has come to this. That our son felt he must write to you, so far away, rather than speak to his mother. More than that, it wounds me that you both are right, for it is clear that Imafore cannot stay under this roof any longer.
translation: 我怀着最深切的遗憾写信给你。我并非有意隐瞒所发生的事。事情发展到这一步，让我心痛不已。我们的儿子觉得必须写信给你这个远在天边的人，而不是直接和他母亲说。更让我心痛的是，你们俩都是对的，因为很明显，伊马福尔不能再待在这个屋檐下了。

english: I take full responsibility. The boys' tutors told me Imafore was becoming less prone to these rages. That his time at the temple had calmed him somewhat. When I heard the boys squabbling, I did not intervene until I heard Mezpah fall.
translation: 我承担全部责任。男孩们的导师告诉我，伊马福尔已经不那么容易发怒了。他在神庙的那段时间让他平静了一些。当我听到男孩们争吵时，我没有介入，直到我听到梅兹帕摔倒的声音。

english: I beg you, show him kindness when he returns to the capital. His father will almost certainly show him none. Do not worry for Mezpah. I'm assured his arm will fully heal by the time you return in the spring. Until then, notlazohtle, think on my words.
translation: 我恳求你，当他回到首都时，对他好一些。他的父亲几乎肯定不会对他好。不用担心梅兹帕。我向你保证，等你春天回来时，他的手臂就能完全康复了。在那之前，诺特拉佐特尔，好好想想我的话。

english: Your loving wife,
translation: 爱你的妻子，

english: Papan
translation: 帕潘

english: Ogre Guard: Hey thief! I's gonna teach ya!
translation: 食人魔守卫：嘿，盗贼！我要教训你！

english: Dat teaches you da lesson!
translation: 这就是给你的教训！

english: Hundreds of trials have been performed. So many that I have lost count. All previous trials ended in the same way, with the subject expiring. However, this trial was different. The subject did not reject the spores as previous ones did. Alas, the results were unsatisfactory. The subject displayed heightened aggression, as desired. However, its strength is unchanged and its mental capacity is limited. It is encouraging to see we are on the right lines, but there is still a long way to go. Our work has outgrown this small facility. It is time to move on.
translation: 已经进行了数百次试验，多到我数不清了。之前所有的试验都以同样的方式结束——受试者死亡。然而，这次试验不同。受试者没有像之前的那些一样排斥孢子。可惜，结果仍不理想。受试者表现出了预期的攻击性增强。然而，它的力量没有变化，智力也有限。看到我们走在正确的道路上令人鼓舞，但还有很长的路要走。我们的工作已经超出了这个小设施的能力范围。是时候继续前进了。

english: There's a familiar power on this island. Could the stone have once rested here? Or was it another one of her wretched artefacts? Whatever it was, it has long since gone. However, this lingering power could still be of use, we just need to find a way to harness it.
translation: 这座岛上有一种熟悉的力量。石头曾经安放在这里吗？还是她的另一件可恶的文物？不管是什么，它早已消失了。不过，这股残留的力量或许仍可利用，我们只需要找到驾驭它的方法。

english: For so long we have been tweaking the spores to no effect. For this trial, I decided we should change the subject instead. Green has failed us so far, maybe Blue will have better results. Luckily for us, there are no shortages when it comes to our failed kin.
translation: 我们调整孢子已经很久了，却毫无效果。这次试验，我决定换个受试者。绿色到目前为止让我们失望了，也许蓝色会有更好的结果。幸运的是，我们那些失败的同类从来不缺。

english: Lithkren has a plentiful supply of the fungi needed for our trials. However, there's another island in that region with an even greater range of flora. I decided to visit the island, to see if it held any useful secrets, but what I found was most unexpected, Skeka. I'd long since assumed that she'd fallen to the humans. Instead, she was there, performing experiments of her own. I tried to convince her that our cause was the right one, but she dismissed me. For now it seems, that island is off limits.
translation: 利斯克伦有充足的蘑菇供应我们试验所需。不过，那个地区还有另一座岛，拥有更丰富的植物种类。我决定去那座岛看看，看是否藏着什么有用的秘密，但我发现的却出乎意料——斯凯卡。我早就以为她已落入人类之手。相反，她就在那里，进行着她自己的实验。我试图说服她我们的事业才是正确的，但她不理会我。就目前而言，那座岛似乎不能去了。

english: This facility is a great improvement on the previous, the cold here makes it much easier to store the samples. However, obtaining new ones is not always easy. We are so far away from Lithkren that new samples are often lost or damaged. As our operation grows, I feel we will soon need even more room to work. To that end, I have ordered the construction of a new facility, this one on Lithkren itself. It's not ideal, being so close to her is a risk, but to have immediate access to all the samples we need will be of great benefit.
translation: 这个设施比之前的好多了，这里的寒冷让储存样本容易得多。然而，获取新样本并不总是那么容易。我们离利斯克伦太远，新样本常常丢失或损坏。随着我们的行动规模扩大，我觉得我们很快需要更多的工作空间。为此，我已下令建造一个新设施，就建在利斯克伦本岛上。这并不理想，离她太近是个风险，但能直接获取我们需要的所有样本将带来巨大的好处。

english: Another trial, another failure. This was only the second time a subject survived the process. But once again, it was a disappointment. The strength in this one was phenomenal, a true sight to behold. However, it lacked the aggression needed. It was another vorkath, a pathetic failure. I should have let it live. A beast that strong would likely have still had a use. However, my anger got the better of me, and I destroyed it.
translation: 又一次试验，又一次失败。这只是第二次有受试者在过程中存活下来。但又一次令人失望。这个的力量惊人，真是叹为观止。然而，它缺乏所需的攻击性。这是另一只沃卡斯，一个可悲的失败品。我本该让它活着的。那么强的野兽可能还有用处。然而，愤怒战胜了我，我摧毁了它。

english: Human forces are on the move. We don't know how they found the island, but that is irrelevant now. Luckily for us, the new facility is ready. I've ordered that all important materials be transported there at once. In the meantime, I intend to provide the humans with a little distraction. Seems like the vorkath will have a use after all.
translation: 人类军队正在行动。我们不知道他们是怎么找到这座岛的，但现在这已经不重要了。幸运的是，新设施已经准备好了。我已下令将所有重要物资立即运往那里。与此同时，我打算给人类一点小小的干扰。看来沃卡斯终究还是派得上用场。

english: On display here are various pieces of an Old One statue. The Old Ones were a race that inhabited Varlamore hundreds of years before the first human settlers arrived here, with them being strong worshippers of Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 这里展示的是古老者雕像的各个部分。古老者是一个在第一批人类定居者到来前数百年就居住在瓦拉莫尔的种族，他们狂热地崇拜拉洛斯和拉努尔。

english: This statue is believed to depict a spirit called a nagua. It is said that the Old Ones summoned these spirits for various reasons via a magical art called naguanil.
translation: 这座雕像据信描绘的是一种叫做纳瓜的灵魂。据说古老者通过一种叫做纳瓜尼尔的魔法技艺召唤这些灵魂，用于各种目的。

english: The smith remains focused on his work, casting an eye to make sure you aren't stealing anything.
translation: 铁匠继续专注于他的工作，不时瞥一眼确保你没有偷东西。

english: You found Keenan, then?
translation: 你找到基南了？

english: I was too late to help him, unfortunately.
translation: 可惜我去得太晚，没能救到他。

english: Wouldn't be so hard on yourself. He was always going to run into something like that.
translation: 别太自责了。他迟早会遇到那种事的。

english: It is said that the leprechauns, so in tune with nature and growth, are to be treasured for their stewardship. But I have seen. I have seen their dark ways. Even the fairies have not been to the edge of things where the truth is hidden. We used to know why they are not permitted, but we have forgotten.
translation: 据说小矮妖与自然和生长如此契合，他们的守护应当被珍视。但我亲眼见过。我见过他们黑暗的一面。就连仙女也未曾到达隐藏着真相的边缘之地。我们曾经知道他们为何不被允许，但我们已经遗忘了。

english: And so I say this: fear the leprechaun.
translation: 所以我要说：畏惧小矮妖。

english: Oh yes, they dance, they sing, they laugh. But that is just another way to say that they cavort, they chant, they gibber. The brightness of their clothing is matched only by the brightness of their insanity, and in their lightheartedness lurks a dark desire. Yes, their love of farming shows they are close to the earth. But the earth is a pitch-black place of caves, of burials, of the eventual end of all things. Their hearts are just the same, and at the end of all things they will rise up and claim us.
translation: 哦是的，他们跳舞，他们唱歌，他们欢笑。但那只是另一种说法——他们蹦跳，他们吟唱，他们胡言乱语。他们衣着的鲜艳只有他们疯狂的鲜明能与之相比，而在他们的轻浮中潜伏着黑暗的欲望。没错，他们对农业的热爱表明他们亲近大地。但大地是一个漆黑的地方，充满洞穴、埋葬，以及万物的最终终结。他们的内心也是如此，而在万物终结之时，他们将崛起并占有我们。

english: They watch. They wait. But theirs is a hungry patience.
translation: 他们注视。他们等待。但那是饥饿的耐心。

english: Although time does not pass in the Abyss at the same rate that it passes elsewhere, I have been imprisoned for an unimaginably long time, since the days when the gods fought for dominion of the mortal realm.
translation: 虽然深渊中时间的流逝速度与外界不同，但我已被囚禁了难以想象的漫长岁月，从诸神为争夺凡间统治权而战的时代就开始了。

english: I leave this book as a token of fair trade to the human who has given me the wherewithal to escape from the Abyss. By absorbing power from an Abyssal Sire's spine, claw and axon, I am able to break free of my prison.
translation: 我将这本书作为公平交易的凭证留给那位给了我逃离深渊之力的凡人。通过吸收深渊之主的脊骨、爪子和轴突中的力量，我得以挣脱牢笼。

english: During the wars of the gods, all sought allies in every realm they could reach. I broke into the Abyss in the hope that the creatures here could be turned to our cause, but found myself trapped and unable to escape, while the God Wars continued without me. But now that I am free, I shall not be so easily imprisoned again.
translation: 在诸神之战期间，所有人都试图在每个能触及的领域寻找盟友。我闯入深渊，希望这里的生物能为我们的事业所用，却发现自己被困其中无法逃脱，而神战在我缺席的情况下继续进行。但现在我自由了，我不会再那么容易被囚禁了。

english: The human who brought me the means of escape did not fully understand my purpose; I merely promised to construct a weapon for him using the component parts of the Abyssal Sires.
translation: 那个给我带来逃脱之物的凡人并不完全理解我的目的；我只是答应他用深渊之主的部件为他打造一件武器。

english: The human who brought me the means of escape did not fully understand my purpose; I merely promised to construct a weapon for her using the component parts of the Abyssal Sires.
translation: 那个给我带来逃脱之物的凡人并不完全理解我的目的；我只是答应她用深渊之主的部件为她打造一件武器。

english: The human who brought me the means of escape did not fully understand my purpose; I merely promised to construct a weapon for them using the component parts of the Abyssal Sires.
translation: 那个给我带来逃脱之物的凡人并不完全理解我的目的；我只是答应他们用深渊之主的部件为他们打造一件武器。

english: Nevertheless, I am bound by my word and constructed the weapon.
translation: 尽管如此，我信守诺言，打造了那件武器。

english: I have now imbued into this book the power required to construct such weapons. The human may create Abyssal Bludgeons whenever he wishes, simply by using the three constituent parts on this book.
translation: 现在我已将打造此类武器所需的力量注入这本书中。那位凡人只需将三个部件用于这本书上，便可随时打造深渊棍棒。

translation: 这一页详细记载了将符文精华改造成神秘基石的方法。所涉及的方法似乎有些复杂，但在你的能力范围之内。

english: Secondly, the mystical energies which empower runestones need to be channeled into the rune essence. This would need to be performed at the properly consecrated rune altar.
translation: 其次，赋予符文石力量的 mystical 能量需要被引导入符文精华中。这需要在适当祝圣的符文祭坛上进行。

english: Once consecrated, the five stones of earth, air, fire, water and mind should be placed into the door of the mystical prison.
translation: 一旦祝圣完成，土、气、火、水、心五种石头应被放入神秘监狱的门中。

english: However, it should be noted that this method of shaping and empowering negates the runes use for the casting of spells.
translation: 然而，需要注意的是，这种塑造和赋能的方***使符文无法用于施法。

translation: 确实处理好了。我的一位同事已经拿了一些给你在白狼山上的地精滑翔机飞行员朋友。再次感谢你的帮助。

translation: 询问关于埃德加的问题。

translation: 什么，就这样？

english: Legionary Xerath,
translation: 泽拉斯军团兵，

english: Given the recent disturbances, we have selected some prisoners to be made an example of. Use the correction cells near the refugee camp. That will ensure their screams are clearly heard.
translation: 鉴于最近的骚乱，我们挑选了一些囚犯来杀一儆百。使用难民营地附近的惩戒牢房。这样能确保他们的惨叫声被清楚地听到。

english: How many valuables would you like to hand in?
translation: 你想上交多少贵重物品？

english: Another season has passed and the numbers seem ever lower.
translation: 又一个季节过去了，数量似乎更低了。

english: It's difficult to pin down exactly what's been causing this continued drop-off. Every creature coming by seems as fit and healthy as ever.
translation: 很难确定是什么导致了这种持续下降。每只经过的生物看起来都和以前一样健康。

english: It may be that there is no longer a need to migrate, though I've yet to identify what material changes have occurred to the local environment that would mitigate that need.
translation: 也许不再需要迁徙了，但我还没确定当地环境发生了什么实质性变化会减少这种需求。

english: The increased passage of people up towards northern Varlamore shouldn't have such a dramatic impact by itself. None of the animals show any difficulty when encountering the trappings of man, nor any fear when I get close to inspect them.
translation: 前往瓦拉莫尔北部的人流增加本身不应产生如此巨大的影响。没有动物在遇到人类设施时表现出任何困难，我靠近检查时它们也没有表现出恐惧。

english: My reports on the conditions of the animals are regularly flown back to the Guild, and no concern returns. So what pressures have changed to manipulate the migration pattern like this?
translation: 我关于动物状况的报告定期送回公会，没有收到任何担忧的回复。那么是什么压力变化导致了这种迁徙模式的改变？

english: I'd usually expect to see a new predator apply this kind of survival pressure to an area. Typically something right at the top of the food chain, but so far I've not seen any clear evidence of this.
translation: 我通常会预期看到一种新的捕食者给这个地区带来这种生存压力。通常是食物链顶端的东西，但到目前为止我还没有看到任何明确的证据。

english: I may have to explore deeper into the pass, at the risk of missing something down here, and attempt to see if anything new has moved in.
translation: 我可能得深入山口探索，冒着错过这里某些东西的风险，看看是否有新物种迁入。

english: I've moved up into Custodia Pass itself. I can't see any clear evidence of an apex predator having moved in.
translation: 我已经搬到了库斯托迪亚山口。我看不到任何顶级捕食者迁入的明确证据。

english: What I have seen is a perhaps unseasonal number of rabbits moving about at dusk. It's unclear exactly where these rabbits may be coming from, as I've not observed any significant movement from the forests of the valley into the pass itself. I shall lay a trap in order to see if these are indeed from Auburn Valley.
translation: 我看到的是一种不合时节的兔子数量在黄昏时活动。不清楚这些兔子究竟从哪里来，因为我没观察到任何从山谷森林进入山口的显著活动。我将设下陷阱来确定它们是否真的来自奥本谷。

english: It would appear that the rabbits are not part of the Auburn Valley population, for they present with what can only be described as fangs. These are clearly not rabbits as we are familiar with them, but rather some form of mutation.
translation: 这些兔子似乎不属于奥本谷的种群，因为它们长着只能被描述为獠牙的东西。这些显然不是我们熟悉的兔子，而是某种变异体。

english: I can further confirm that these creatures appear to live in a significant system of caves, as opposed to the warrens we are used to with rabbits. However, I cannot see from my current location how extensive these caves my be. I will send my latest report to the Guild and then I shall have to delve into them.
translation: 我可以进一步确认这些生物似乎生活在一个大型洞穴系统中，而不是我们熟悉的兔子地洞。然而，从我目前的位置看不出这些洞穴有多大。我会把最新报告送回公会，然后我得深入探索它们。

english: A portrait of King Lathas of Ardougne.
translation: 一幅阿多尼城拉萨斯国王的肖像。

english: One of the survivors of the great battle became king in year 98 of the 5th Age. His goal was to listen to people's views and ensure a fair and equal life for everyone. He was the first of a line of kings in Ardougne that continues to this day. The other survivor of the battle founded the marketplace, allowing people to trade their skills and wares under equal rights and opportunities. More information is available at a small museum north of Ardougne.
translation: 那场大战的幸存者之一在第五纪元98年成为国王。他的目标是倾听人民的意见，确保每个人都能过上公平平等的生活。他是阿多尼城延续至今的国王世系中的第一位。另一位幸存者建立了市场，让人们能在平等的权利和机会下交易技能和商品。更多信息可在阿多尼城北面的小博物馆获取。

english: This barrel contains overload potion that adventurers have purchased from Dominic with their reward points. You have no potion stored in here.
translation: 这个木桶里装着冒险者用奖励点数从多米尼克那里购买的过载药水。你在这里没有储存药水。

english: Kaleef
translation: 卡利夫

english: Your mission is to relieve our agent inside Menaphos. We know of a tunnel beneath the Temple of the Lesser Gods you can use to bypass the lockdown. Be vigilant of traps and the hostile natives. They're about as welcoming as the Menaphites, only slightly better looking.
translation: 你的任务是接应我们在美纳福斯的内线。我们知道小神神庙下面有一条隧道，你可以用它绕过封锁。警惕陷阱和敌对的当地人。他们和美纳福斯人一样不友好，只是稍微好看一点。

english: Os
translation: 奥斯

english: I have witnessed this first hand. The young are deliberately left beneath colonies of the spore until they pass out, choking. A violent affair, but one I have grown to understand is necessary. Perhaps my own concern of the treatment of subject 1 were invalid. Pain has its place in the needs for advancement.
translation: 我亲眼目睹了这一切。幼体被故意留在孢子群落下方，直到窒息昏迷。这是一场暴行，但我逐渐理解这是必要的。也许我对1号实验体待遇的担忧是不对的。痛苦在进步的需要中有其位置。

english: The wind does down and your sails with it.
translation: 风停了，你的帆也随之垂下。

english: You feed a gust of wind.
translation: 你引来一阵风。

english: You need to be manning the sails or manning the helm to adjust the sails.
translation: 你需要掌帆或掌舵才能调整帆。

english: Junior Jim helpfully provides the materials required to build the cargo hold.
translation: 小吉姆热心地提供了建造货舱所需的材料。

english: It's Scarface Pete's candlestick. If you need to give this item to a player who's restricted from trading, you can give them the item by using it on them.
translation: 这是疤脸皮特的烛台。如果你需要把这个物品交给一个受交易限制的玩家，你可以用它点击对方来给予。

english: It's Scarface Pete's candlestick. Although your account is restricted from trading, you can still give this item to another player by using it on them.
translation: 这是疤脸皮特的烛台。虽然你的账户受交易限制，但你仍然可以通过用它点击其他玩家来给予这个物品。

english: Pour a hand full of Redberries into an empty Pie Shell, bake until the berries are soft and serve warm.
translation: 将一把红莓倒入空的派皮中，烘烤至莓果变软，趁热食用。

english: Line a fresh Pie Shell with Cooked Meat and heat until the pastry starts to bronze, serve with a selection of sauces.
translation: 在新鲜的派皮上铺上熟肉，加热至饼皮开始泛金，搭配各种酱料食用。

english: Start with a Pie Shell and add a Bucket of Compost, then pour in a Bucket of Water to keep the consistency gooey. To finish, cover with Clay and bake until a good shell forms. Serve at maximum speed with a good over-arm throw!
translation: 先用派皮打底，加入一桶堆肥，再倒入一桶水保持黏稠度。最后盖上粘土，烘烤至外壳成型。以最快的速度用力过肩抛出！

english: Take a Pie Shell and layer in Apple, cook until the juices start to bubble and leave to cool before serving.
translation: 取一个派皮，铺上苹果，烘烤至汁液开始冒泡，冷却后再食用。

english: Fill a Pie Shell with Tomato, then add Onion and top with Cabbage. Bake golden brown and serve with a steak.
translation: 在派皮中填入番茄，加入洋葱，顶部铺上卷心菜。烤至金黄，搭配牛排食用。

english: Take one Pie Shell and fill with Trout, add a Cod for flavour, and then top with Potato for texture. Cook well until the potato turns golden and serve.
translation: 取一个派皮，填入鳟鱼，加入鳕鱼提味，再铺上土豆增加口感。烤至土豆金黄后食用。

english: Line a Pie Shell with a Golovanova fruit. Bake until the fruit has become crispy on the top. Best served with cream and some milk.
translation: 在派皮中铺上戈洛瓦诺瓦果实。烘烤至果实顶部酥脆。最好搭配奶油和牛奶食用。

english: If you are looking for an acquired taste, fill your Pie Shell with a Sulliuscep cap and bake until the Pie Shell starts to take on the Sulliuscep's colour.
translation: 如果你想尝试一种特别的口味，在派皮中填入苏利乌斯塞普帽，烘烤至派皮开始染上苏利乌斯塞普的颜色。

english: For a more upperclass fish pie, fill your Pie Shell with Salmon and then add Tuna for colour. Top with Potato and cook until golden.
translation: 想要更高档的鱼派，在派皮中填入鲑鱼，再加入金枪鱼增色。顶部铺上土豆，烤至金黄。

english: If you're looking for an exotic pie, fill your Pie Shell with a single Dragonfruit cut into chunks. Cook until the crust starts to glow.
translation: 如果你想尝试异国风味的派，在派皮中填入切成块的火龙果。烘烤至饼皮开始发光。

english: Line a Pie Shell with Raw Bear Meat, then add Raw Chompy for substance, and top with fresh Rabbit Meat. Bake until the juices start to bubble and serve.
translation: 在派皮中铺上生熊肉，加入生食人鸟肉增加分量，顶部铺上新鲜兔肉。烘烤至汁液冒泡后食用。

english: Into a Pie Shell, put Strawberry, then a layer of Watermelon, and top with Apple. Cook well and leave to cool before serving.
translation: 在派皮中放入草莓，铺上一层西瓜，顶部加上苹果。充分烘烤，冷却后再食用。

english: The plaster has a small map of Morytania carved into it. The map depicts seven figures near the Salve, where Paterdomus now stands.
translation: 灰泥上刻着一幅莫利塔尼亚的小地图。地图描绘了萨尔维河附近的七个人影，那里如今矗立着帕特多姆斯。

english: One figure stands in front of the others. He seems to have some sort of rod in one hand which he holds aloft. In his other hand he holds a small container.
translation: 一个人影站在其他人前面。他似乎一只手高举着一根棍子。另一只手拿着一个小容器。

english: Two rays of light emanate from the sky and surround the figure. One is green, likely to represent Guthix. The other is silver, likely to represent Saradomin.
translation: 两道光线从天而降，环绕着那个人影。一道是绿色的，可能代表古斯。另一道是银色的，可能代表萨拉多明。

english: In front of the figure, a dark creature seems to be held in a powerful spell, with the figure using the container to administer some sort of potion to it.
translation: 在人物前方，一个黑暗生物似乎被强大的法术困住，那个人影正用容器给它喂某种药水。

english: Various words are also carved into the plaster. Below the dark creature the words 'silver', 'garlic', 'harralander' and 'red eggs' are caved. As well as this, the word 'silvthrill' is carved by the figure.
translation: 灰泥上还刻着各种文字。在黑暗生物下方刻着'银'、'大蒜'、'哈拉兰德'和'红蛋'。此外，人物旁边还刻着'银瑟里尔'这个词。

english: This is clearly an artist's impression of some moment in Morytania's history.
translation: 这显然是艺术家对莫利塔尼亚历史上某个时刻的描绘。

english: Well kid, it's 'cos there be foul things in the jungle beyond.
translation: 小子，那是因为丛林深处有邪恶的东西。

english: Then it must have been my fault and I apologise kid.
translation: 那一定是我的错，我道歉，小子。

english: Aren't ye Toothless Riley?
translation: 你不就是无牙莱利吗？

english: I'll have me eye on ye, customs kid. One step out of line and bam.
translation: 我会盯着你的，海关小子。一步走错就砰。

english: First off, it's lad, and second, other than busy being drunk I can't see what you are talking about.
translation: 首先，是小子，其次，除了忙着喝酒，我看不出你在说什么。

english: First off, it's lass, and second, other than busy being drunk I can't see what you are talking about.
translation: 首先，是姑娘，其次，除了忙着喝酒，我看不出你在说什么。

english: Mr Bravek, there's someone here who really needs to speak to you.
translation: 布拉维克先生，有人在这里真的很需要和你谈谈。

english: Visit the city of the White Knights. In the park, Saradomin points to the X which marks the spot.
translation: 去白骑士之城。在公园里，萨拉多明指向标记着X的地点。

english: The crate has # bananas inside.
translation: 箱子里有#根香蕉。

english: [Other player name] will probably tell you he wanted a free teleport after that performance.
translation: [Other player name] 可能会告诉你，在那场表演之后他想要一个免费传送。

english: [Other player name] will probably tell you she wanted a free teleport after that performance.
translation: [Other player name] 可能会告诉你，在那场表演之后她想要一个免费传送。

english: [Other player name] should take lessons from you. You're clearly too good for her.
translation: [Other player name] 应该向你学习。你显然比她强太多了。

english: [Other player name] should take lessons from you. You're clearly too good for him.
translation: [Other player name] 应该向你学习。你显然比他强太多了。

english: Your sceptre has <Num0> charges left.
translation: 你的权杖还剩<Num0>次充能。

english: You read the wall plaque: 'Blessings on Efaritay, our icyene queen from far off lands and her loving children of Hallowed name.'
translation: 你读着墙上的牌匾:'祝福埃法里泰,我们来自遥远国度的冰翼女王,以及她圣名之下的挚爱子民。'

english: The Temple Knights are to be made up of the most devout followers of Saradomin. How else could they be trusted to bring about his will? One would have to be naive to think that anybody else could truly understand the purpose we're serving.
translation: 圣殿骑士应由萨拉多明最虔诚的信徒组成。若非如此,怎能信任他们来实现他的意志?只有天真的人才会认为其他人能真正理解我们所服务的使命。

english: Twiblick was said to be converted. We were clearly told this when questions were first raised of a Taverley born druid joining the organisation. However, the different prayers that he speaks as every night comes, clutching his Guthixian charms, seem to tell a different story. The more likely explanation seems to be what I heard whispered, that he was just too good to turn down. Saradomin's warriors would surely have been enough though, without relying on this outside help.
translation: 据说特威布利克已经皈依。当有人质疑一位塔韦利村出身的德鲁伊加入组织时,我们明确得到了这样的答复。然而,他每夜紧握古斯护符念诵的祷词却截然不同。更可能的解释正如我所听到的耳语——他实在太优秀,难以拒绝。萨拉多明的战士本应足够,无需依赖这种外援。

english: Still, it does seem that he is worthy of some grace... Whether or not he should have been initiated in the first place, and while we don't quite see eye to eye, Friar certainly has been a useful addition to this operation.
translation: 不过,他确实值得一些宽恕……无论当初是否应该接纳他,尽管我们意见不尽相同,弗莱尔确实是这次行动中得力的帮手。

translation: 马克特,黎明低语着光的拥抱。

translation: 马克特,回响着古老传说的故事。

translation: 马克特,梦想在此永远翱翔。

english: Takam, where dreams soar evermore.
translation: 塔卡姆,梦想在此永远翱翔。

translation: 乌伊特,梦想在此永远翱翔。
