translation: 西拉姆,梦想在此永远翱翔。

english: For he vanquished four prey.
translation: 因他击败了四个猎物。

english: They met again at Virer,
translation: 他们在维雷尔再次相遇,

english: Hungry for success.
translation: 渴望成功。

english: The father killed eleven,
translation: 父亲杀了十一个,

english: And the son felt much distress.
translation: 儿子深感痛苦。

english: And he ignored his father's jest.
translation: 他无视了父亲的玩笑。

english: He slew more than could be counted,
translation: 他斩杀无数,

english: Then departed to the west.
translation: 然后向西离去。

english: It is told that the first elves to come through the World Gate found a world full of beautiful woodlands and terrible beasts.
translation: 据说第一批穿过世界之门的精灵发现了一个充满美丽森林和可怕野兽的世界。

english: It was Seren who told the eight clans that if they were to survive in this hostile environment, they must form a single community for mutual protection.
translation: 是塞伦告诉八大家族,要想在这恶劣的环境中生存,就必须组成一个共同体以互相保护。

english: Seren proceeded to show them all to a clearing in the forest, where she had already created the Tower of Voices, a place for all elven kind to congregate and the future home of the Assembly of Elders.
translation: 塞伦随后将他们带到森林中的一片空地,那里她已建好了声音之塔,一个供所有精灵聚集的地方,也是未来长老议会的所在地。

english: Over the following days, Seren imparted her idea for a new city, a city where all elves would have access to hear her words, a city where all elves would live in peace, a living city made of the very same crystal that she herself was comprised.
translation: 接下来的日子里,塞伦提出了她对一座新城的构想——一座所有精灵都能听到她话语的城市,一座所有精灵都能和平生活的城市,一座由她自身所构成的水晶打造的活着的城市。

english: It was decided that the city should be set out in an octagon. Each of the eight clans would have their own segment of the city.
translation: 大家决定将城市建成八角形。八大家族各自拥有城市的一部分。

english: Each segment would be edged on one side by a city wall with its opposing corner at the city center, where the Tower of Voices was located.
translation: 每个区域的一侧以城墙为界,对角则朝向城市中心,即声音之塔所在之处。

english: This would give each of the clans equal access to hear the words of Seren and equal responsibility for the city's protection in the case of a siege.
translation: 这样每个家族都能平等地聆听塞伦的话语,也平等地承担城市被围困时的防御责任。

english: Seren then provided one special seed for every clan, telling them that each seed should be planted in the center of each clan's segment of the city.
translation: 塞伦随后给了每个家族一颗特殊的种子,告诉他们每颗种子都应种在各自区域的中心。

english: The eight clans did this, and found that the seeds grew into great towers. Before long, there were nine crystal towers in the clearing.
translation: 八大家族照做了,发现种子长成了巨大的高塔。不久之后,空地上矗立起九座水晶塔。

english: And so, the city of Prifddinas was born.
translation: 就这样,普里夫迪纳斯城诞生了。

english: Being the full and proper prayer against morbidities of the flesh caused by venoms and potions of both a natural and mystical origin.
translation: 这是针对由自然和神秘来源的毒液与药水引起的肉体疾病的完整而恰当的祈祷。

english: Take up your blessed symbol of Saradomin, cast in silver. Hang it about thy neck, where all may see it and thus know of your devotion.
translation: 拿起你受祝福的萨拉多明圣徽,以银铸成。将它挂在颈间,让所有人都能看到,从而知晓你的虔诚。

english: Pray in a loud, clear voice to Saradomin for relief from that which ails you. Appropriate calls for aid should be accompanied by a sacrifice of Prayer energy, with deadlier venoms requiring a greater sacrifice.
translation: 以洪亮清晰的声音向萨拉多明祈祷，祈求解除你所受之苦。适当的求助呼唤需以祈祷能量为祭品，越致命的毒药需要越大的祭品。

english: Should the supplicant lack piety, they will not be cured.
translation: 若祈祷者缺乏虔诚，他们将无法被治愈。

english: Should they possess a measure of piety equal or even greater than that which assails them, the poison will be reduced or even cured, while a like amount of Prayer energy will be taken to do this.
translation: 若他们拥有与所遭受之毒相当或更高的虔诚，毒药将被减轻甚至治愈，同时会消耗相应量的祈祷能量。

english: Be wary: should the supplicant only partially remove the venom through the application of prayer, their body must still bear the brunt of its wickedness.
translation: 谨记：若祈祷者仅通过祈祷部分清除毒素，他们的身体仍须承受其邪恶的冲击。

english: Also... (The rest of the book seems to have been vandalised, charred and slightly bled upon.)
translation: 还有...(这本书的其余部分似乎被涂鸦、烧焦并沾上了些许血迹。)

english: Are you aware of Paterdomus? It's a temple east of here. It stands on the holy River Salve and guards the only passage into the deadly vampyre-infested lands of Morytania.
translation: 你知道帕特多穆斯吗？那是东边的一座神庙。它矗立在神圣的萨尔维河上，守护着通往莫利塔尼亚那片充满致命吸血鬼之地的唯一通道。

english: Yes, I think I've heard of it.
translation: 是的，我想我听说过。

english: Very good. Well, it has been some days since last I heard from Drezel, the priest who lives there. Be a sport and go check in on the silly old codger for me, would you?
translation: 很好。嗯，我已经好几天没收到住在那里祭司德雷泽尔的消息了。帮个忙，替我去看看那个老糊涂吧，好吗？

english: Many thanks, adventurer! I would have sent one of the squires, but they wanted payment for it!
translation: 多谢，冒险者！我本想派个侍从去，但他们居然要报酬！

english: The temple of Paterdomus where Drezel lives. It is but a short journey east from here. It lies at the source of the River Salve. Don't worry, you can't miss it.
translation: 德雷泽尔住的帕特多穆斯神庙。从这里往东走不远就到了。它位于萨尔维河的源头。别担心，你不会错过的。

english: Thankfully, the sacred River Salve marks a natural border between Misthalin and Morytania. The waters of the river have been blessed with Saradomin's almighty power, preventing any invasion by the vampyres.
translation: 幸好神圣的萨尔维河是米斯塔林和莫利塔尼亚之间的天然边界。河水被萨拉多明的强大力量祝福过，阻止了吸血鬼的任何入侵。

english: This is the reason why the lack of communication from him bothers me somewhat, although I am sure it's nothing too serious. Nobody would dare to try and attack our kingdom!
translation: 这就是为什么他失去联系让我有些担忧，虽然我确定不会是什么严重的事。没人敢试图攻击我们的王国！

english: You will be rewarded with the knowledge that you have done the right thing and assisted the King of Misthalin.
translation: 你将因做了正确的事并协助了米斯塔林国王而获得知识的回报。

english: So... that would be a 'no' then?
translation: 那么...那就是'不'了？

english: King Roald sent me to check on Drezel.
translation: 罗尔德国王派我来查看德雷泽尔的情况。

english: Drezel? Right... I, er... Just give me a moment.
translation: 德雷泽尔？对...我，呃...给我一点时间。

english: You hear someone moving around followed by what sounds like panicked muttering.
translation: 你听到有人在里面走动，接着是惊慌失措的喃喃自语声。

english: Okay, he's just coming! Wait a second!
translation: 好了，他马上就出来！等一下！

english: Er... Is everything okay in there?
translation: 呃...里面一切都好吗？

english: Yes, totally fine. Now, what can I do for you?
translation: 是的，完全没问题。那么，我能为你做什么？

english: Well, the King hadn't heard from you for a few days. He sent me to make sure everything's okay.
translation: 嗯，国王好几天没收到你的消息了。他派我来确保一切安好。

english: I see... And, uh, what would you do if everything wasn't okay?
translation: 我明白了...那，呃，如果一切不好你会怎么做？

english: Hey... The dog!
translation: 嘿...那只狗！

english: Ah, actually there is something I could use some help with. Will you do me a favour, adventurer?
translation: 啊，其实有件事需要你帮忙。你能帮我个忙吗，冒险者？

english: What kind of favour?
translation: 什么忙？

english: Well, there's this horrible big... dog-like thing that's moved into the mausoleum outside. It's causing all kinds of problems. Could you get rid of it for me?
translation: 嗯，有只可怕的大家伙...像狗一样的东西搬进了外面的陵墓。它惹了不少麻烦。你能帮我除掉它吗？

english: I don't know... Something about all this seems a bit suspicious... I think I'd better go and check in with the King.
translation: 我不知道...这一切似乎有点可疑...我想我最好回去向国王汇报。

english: No, no, there's no need for that. He's a very busy man! Besides, you said yourself that he sent you here to help me, right?
translation: 不，不，没必要。他是个大忙人！再说，你自己也说了是他派你来帮我的，对吧？

english: Then please, deal with that dog for me.
translation: 那就拜托了，帮我解决那只狗。

english: Yeah, and I was just wondering if I could borrow a cup of coffee?
translation: 是啊，我只是想问问能不能借杯咖啡？

english: Next door? Coffee? What are you on about? Who are you?
translation: 隔壁？咖啡？你在说什么？你是谁？

english: Right... And?
translation: 对...然后呢？

english: Gift shop? What are you on about? This isn't a museum! Clear off!
translation: 礼品店？你在说什么？这里不是博物馆！走开！

english: Pipes? We don't have any pipes! Now get lost!
translation: 管道？我们没有什么管道！快滚开！

english: Hello? Is that you again, adventurer? Have you dealt with that dog yet?
translation: 喂？又是你吗，冒险者？你解决那只狗了吗？

english: But you're going to, right? For good old Delzig?
translation: 但你会的，对吧？为了老好人德尔齐格？

english: Sorry, for good old Drezel, right?
translation: 抱歉，为了老好人德雷泽尔，对吧？

english: Now, run along. I have a lot to do and it sounds like Drezel needs you.
translation: 好了，快去吧。我有很多事要做，听起来德雷泽尔需要你。

english: Is that you, adventurer? Have you dealt with that dog?
translation: 是你吗，冒险者？你解决那只狗了吗？

english: Really? Well... thank you! That's really... quite something.
translation: 真的吗？嗯...谢谢你！那真是...相当了不起。

english: Ha! Brilliant! Good work, adventurer.
translation: 哈！太棒了！干得好，冒险者。

english: Don't mention it... Is there anything else you need?
translation: 别客气……还有什么需要帮忙的吗？

english: I think it's safe to say that you've done more than enough, adventurer.
translation: 我想可以说你做得已经够多了，冒险者。

english: Okay... I guess I'd better go and let the King know.
translation: 好吧……我想我最好去告诉国王一声。

english: Is that you, adventurer? Once again, thank you so much for dealing with that dog. It's really... quite something.
translation: 是你吗，冒险者？再次感谢你处理了那条狗。那真是……相当了得。

english: Don't mention it... Now, I guess I'd better report back to the King.
translation: 别客气……现在，我想我最好回去向国王汇报。

english: Well, I went to the temple and spoke to... Drezel. He asked me to kill a dog in the mausoleum.
translation: 嗯，我去了神庙，和……德雷泽尔谈了谈。他让我去陵墓里杀一条狗。

english: A dog? Tell me you didn't do it?!
translation: 一条狗？你告诉我你没做吧？！

english: I tried to tell you it was a bit suspicious, but you told me to help Drezel!
translation: 我早就跟你说过这事有点可疑，但你让我去帮德雷泽尔！

english: Do you even realise what you've done? That mausoleum contains the only passage between Morytania and Misthalin! Not only that, it's built right over the source of the River Salve!
translation: 你知道你做了什么吗？那座陵墓是莫利塔尼亚和米斯塔林之间唯一的通道！不仅如此，它就建在萨尔维河的源头之上！

english: That 'dog' was responsible for guarding the entrance to the mausoleum! With it gone, there's nothing to stop someone from sabotaging the blessings on the river. Thanks to you, all of Misthalin is now at risk!
translation: 那条'狗'负责守护陵墓的入口！它没了，就没人能阻止有人破坏河上的祝福了。多亏了你，整个米斯塔林现在都处于危险之中！

english: But Drezel...
translation: 但是德雷泽尔……

english: Do you not see what's happened here, you absolute cretin! Obviously some fiend has done something to Drezel and tricked your feeble intellect into helping them!
translation: 你难道看不出来发生了什么吗，你这个白痴！显然有什么恶徒对德雷泽尔动了手脚，然后利用你那可怜的智商来帮他们！

english: Now you get back there and get this mess sorted out. If you don't do whatever is necessary to safeguard this kingdom from attack, I will see you beheaded for high treason!
translation: 现在你给我回去把这件事解决掉。如果你不采取一切必要措施来保护这个王国免受攻击，我就以叛国罪砍了你的头！

english: No need to shout?! Listen, and listen well, and see if your puny mind can comprehend this: if the border is not protected, then we are all at the mercy of the vampyres!
translation: 不用喊？！听着，好好听着，看看你那渺小的脑子能不能理解：如果边境得不到保护，我们就都得任由吸血鬼宰割！

english: I would say that me shouting at you for your incompetence is the least of your worries right now. Now get yourself back to Paterdomus! At once!
translation: 我想我现在对你无能的吼叫是你最不用担心的事了。现在给我回帕特多莫斯去！立刻！

english: My name's [player name]. King Roald sent me to find out what was going on at the temple. I take it you're Drezel?
translation: 我叫[player name]。罗尔德国王派我来查明神庙发生了什么事。我想你就是德雷泽尔吧？

english: That's right! Oh, praise be to Saradomin! I feared that when those Zamorakians attacked this place, Misthalin would be doomed!
translation: 没错！哦，萨拉多明保佑！我还担心那些扎莫拉克教徒袭击这里时，米斯塔林就完了！

english: Why? What are they planning to do?
translation: 为什么？他们打算做什么？

english: I believe they aim to desecrate the blessings placed upon the holy River Salve by the Seven Priestly Warriors themselves! We'd be left defenceless against the vampyres of Morytania!
translation: 我相信他们的目标是亵渎七位祭司勇士亲自加持在神圣萨尔维河上的祝福！那样我们对莫利塔尼亚的吸血鬼就毫无防备了！

english: Indeed. While this isn't the... ideal time for a history lesson, this knowledge may help you with our next steps, so allow me to explain...
translation: 确实。虽然现在不是上历史课的理想时机，但这些知识可能对你接下来的行动有帮助，让我来解释一下……

english: Morytania wasn't enough for them though. Soon, they set their sights on these lands as well. Misthalin would have quickly fallen to the vampyres, were it not for the bravery of the Seven Priestly Warriors.
translation: 但莫利塔尼亚对他们来说还不够。很快，他们也盯上了这片土地。如果不是七位祭司勇士的英勇，米斯塔林早就落入吸血鬼之手了。

english: They led the armies of Misthalin against the vampyres, with the war culminating in a great battle that took place right where this temple stands.
translation: 他们率领米斯塔林的军队对抗吸血鬼，战争最终在这座神庙所在的位置爆发了一场大战。

english: For ten days and nights they fought, never sleeping, never eating, fuelled only by their faith in Saradomin.
translation: 他们战斗了十天十夜，不眠不休，仅凭对萨拉多明的信仰支撑着。

english: On the eleventh day, reinforcements arrived, but when they did, they found the Seven Priestly Warriors had been slain by the vampyres, along with most of their forces.
translation: 第十一天，援军赶到，但他们发现七位祭司勇士已被吸血鬼杀害，他们的大部分军队也一同阵亡。

english: However, their sacrifice was not in vain. Before they were defeated, the Seven Priestly Warriors managed to bless the Salve with the holy power of Saradomin.
translation: 然而，他们的牺牲并非徒劳。在被击败之前，七位祭司勇士成功用萨拉多明的神圣力量祝福了萨尔维河。

english: Those blessings remain to this day, ensuring no vampyre can cross the river. The temple here was built soon after. It guards the source of the River Salve, and acts as the only passage into Morytania.
translation: 这些祝福至今仍在，确保没有吸血鬼能渡过这条河。神庙很快就建了起来。它守护着萨尔维河的源头，也是进入莫利塔尼亚的唯一通道。

english: And what about the mausoleum below?
translation: 那下面的陵墓呢？

english: That is the most important part of the temple, for it is where the passage into Morytania is found. It is also the final resting place of the Seven Priestly Warriors.
translation: 那是神庙最重要的部分，因为进入莫利塔尼亚的通道就在那里。它也是七位祭司勇士的安息之地。

english: Their tombs are built around the well that provides direct access to the source of the Salve, with a golden gift placed upon each of the tombs as a mark of respect.
translation: 他们的陵墓环绕着通往萨尔维河源头的井而建，每座墓上都放置了一份黄金礼物以示敬意。

english: I see. And you think those Zamorakians are going to try and remove the blessings on the river?
translation: 我明白了。你觉得那些扎莫拉克教徒打算移除河上的祝福？

english: I fear that is almost certainly their goal.
translation: 恐怕那几乎肯定是他们的目标。

english: First, we need to get me out of this cell. The leader of those Zamorakians probably has the key. I believe he's the one in the hood.
translation: 首先，得把我从这牢房里弄出去。那些扎莫拉克教徒的头目可能拿着钥匙。我想就是那个穿兜帽的。

english: So I need to go and find this key. Anything else I should be aware of?
translation: 所以我需要去找这把钥匙。还有什么我需要注意的吗？

english: I'm afraid so. When the Salve was first blessed, a small number of vampyres were left trapped on this side of it. They were heavily weakened, but still posed a dangerous threat.
translation: 恐怕有。当萨尔维河最初被祝福时，少数吸血鬼被困在了河的这一边。他们被大大削弱了，但仍然构成危险的威胁。

english: Even with them weakened, the brave Saradominists who built this temple were unable to kill them. Instead, they trapped them in coffins and buried them outside the temple.
translation: 即使他们被削弱了，建造这座神庙的勇敢的萨拉多明信徒也无法杀死他们。于是他们把这些吸血鬼关在棺材里，埋在了神庙外面。

english: This coffin here contains one of those vampyres. The Zamorakians must have dug it up and brought it in here with them.
translation: 这里的这口棺材里就装着一个这样的吸血鬼。扎莫拉克教徒一定把它挖出来带到了这里。

english: Well, as those fiends pointed out to me with delight, as I am the descendant of one of the Seven Priestly Warriors who blessed the river, it will likely recognise the smell of my blood.
translation: 嗯，正如那些恶徒得意地向我指出的那样，因为我是祝福了河流的七位祭司勇士之一的后裔，它很可能会认出我血液的气味。

english: I would not risk waking it. Even now, it could pose a huge threat. The priests of old would incapacitate trapped vampyres with the blessings of Saradomin. Perhaps there's a way for you do the same.
translation: 我不会冒险唤醒它。即使现在，它也可能构成巨大威胁。古代的祭司会用萨拉多明的祝福来制服被困的吸血鬼。也许你有办法做到同样的事。

english: Well, don't give up adventurer! The key must be nearby. Most likely the leader of those Zamorakians has it. I believe he's the one in the hood.
translation: 别放弃，冒险者！钥匙一定就在附近。很可能是那些扎莫拉克教徒的头目拿着。我想就是那个穿兜帽的。

english: As for the vampyre, the priests of old would incapacitate the ones they'd trapped with the blessings of Saradomin. Perhaps there's a way for you do the same.
translation: 至于吸血鬼，古时的僧侣会用萨拉多明的祝福来制服他们困住的那些。也许你也有办法做到同样的事。

english: I see. Thanks for the information. I'll get going.
translation: 明白了。谢谢你的信息。我先走了。

english: Is the border with Morytania secure yet?
translation: 莫利塔尼亚的边境守住了吗？

english: Not yet, but I'm working on it. First I need to free Drezel. He's been imprisoned by some Zamorakian monks.
translation: 还没有，但我正在处理。首先我得救出德雷泽尔。他被一些扎莫拉基安僧侣囚禁了。

english: Yes, as I said, that's what I'm working on.
translation: 是的，我说过了，我正在处理这件事。

english: I have this key I took from the leader of the Zamorakians, but it doesn't seem to fit the lock on the gate.
translation: 我从扎莫拉基安首领那里拿到了这把钥匙，但它似乎打不开大门上的锁。

english: Strange... The right key must be nearby. Maybe they hid it somewhere...
translation: 奇怪……正确的钥匙一定在附近。也许他们把它藏在了什么地方……

english: You try to use the key to unlock the gate. The key is a similar size to the lock, but does not fit.
translation: 你试着用钥匙打开大门。钥匙和锁的大小差不多，但就是插不进去。

english: Hmm... Why was that monk carrying this key if it's not for this cell?
translation: 嗯……如果这把钥匙不是开这间牢房的，那那个僧侣为什么要带着它？

english: I have some water from the Salve. Do you think we could use this to deal with the vampyre?
translation: 我有一些萨尔维河的圣水。你觉得我们能用来对付那个吸血鬼吗？

english: Hmm... Yes, that could work. However, I'll first need to see if it's already been desecrated by those Zamorakians.
translation: 嗯……可以，也许行得通。不过，我得先看看它有没有被那些扎莫拉基安人玷污。

english: Which means I'm going to need to get this gate open first.
translation: 也就是说，我得先把这扇门打开。

english: I have this key I found down in the mausoleum.
translation: 我在陵墓下面找到了这把钥匙。

english: Excellent work! Quickly, try it on the gate, and see if it will free me!
translation: 干得好！快，试试能不能打开大门，看看能不能放我出去！

english: You use the key to unlock the cell gate.
translation: 你用钥匙打开了牢房的门。

english: The key fit the lock!
translation: 钥匙正好能打开这把锁！

english: Excellent work! Now we just need the vampyre dealing with.
translation: 干得好！现在只需要对付那个吸血鬼了。

english: Well, I have some water from the Salve here.
translation: 嗯，我这里有一些萨尔维河的圣水。

english: Very good. Let me have a look at it.
translation: 很好。让我看看。

english: Drezel inspects the water. He then says some sort of prayer.
translation: 德雷泽尔检查了水。然后他念了一段祈祷词。

english: It's as I feared. Those Zamorakians have already desecrated the Salve. However, I've managed to purify this water again with the blessings of Saradomin. You should be able to use it against the vampyre now.
translation: 果然如我所料。那些扎莫拉基安人已经玷污了萨尔维河。不过，我设法用萨拉多明的祝福再次净化了这水。你现在应该可以用它来对付那个吸血鬼了。

english: I'll do that right away.
translation: 我马上去办。

english: Excellent work! Now we just need the vampyre dealing with. The priests of old would incapacitate the ones they'd trapped with the blessings of Saradomin.
translation: 干得好！现在只需要对付那个吸血鬼了。古时的僧侣会用萨拉多明的祝福来制服他们困住的那些。

english: Blessings of Saradomin? How did they do that?
translation: 萨拉多明的祝福？他们是怎么做到的？

english: The most common way was with holy water.
translation: 最常见的方法就是用圣水。

english: Like the water of the Salve perhaps?
translation: 就像萨尔维河的水那样？

english: Well, that may well depend on if the Zamorakians have already desecrated it. One step at a time though. First, why don't you try and get hold of some?
translation: 嗯，那得看扎莫拉基安人有没有玷污它。不过一步一步来。首先，你不如先去弄一些来。

english: Excellent work getting the cell unlocked! Now we just need the vampyre dealing with. That water I blessed for you should do it. Pour it on the coffin, quickly!
translation: 干得好，把牢房打开了！现在只需要对付那个吸血鬼了。我为你祝福过的那些水应该能行。把它倒在棺材上，快！

english: You look down the well and see the water of the River Salve moving slowly along.
translation: 你往水井下看去，看到萨尔维河的河水缓缓流过。

english: Not yet, but Drezel and I are working on it.
translation: 还没有，但德雷泽尔和我正在处理。

english: Well, best you get back to it then. This is a matter of national security and if I find out we are vulnerable I will hold you personally responsible!
translation: 嗯，那你最好赶紧回去干活。这关系到国家安全，如果我发现我们处于弱势，我会让你个人负责！

english: Yes, your highness.
translation: 遵命，殿下。

english: I poured the blessed water over the coffin. That vampyre shouldn't cause us any trouble now.
translation: 我把圣水倒在了棺材上。那个吸血鬼现在应该不会再给我们添麻烦了。

english: Excellent work, adventurer! Now, meet me down in the mausoleum. We need to revert the damage those Zamorakians did as soon as possible!
translation: 干得好，冒险者！现在，到陵墓下面来找我。我们得尽快修复那些扎莫拉基安人造成的破坏！

english: Meet me down in the mausoleum. We need to revert the damage those Zamorakians did as soon as possible!
translation: 到陵墓下面来找我。我们得尽快修复那些扎莫拉基安人造成的破坏！

english: Good, good. Keep up the good work.
translation: 好，好。继续好好干。

english: How bad is it?
translation: 情况有多糟？

english: From what I can tell, those Zamorakians used some kind of potion to pollute the Salve. With this being the source, it has already started to spread down the river.
translation: 据我所知，那些扎莫拉基安人用了某种药水来污染萨尔维河。既然这里是源头，污染已经开始顺着河流扩散了。

english: Before long, the blessings placed upon the river will be irreversably damaged. There will be nothing to stop the vampyres from invading Misthalin at their leisure.
translation: 用不了多久，河流上的祝福就会被不可逆转地破坏。到时候就没有什么能阻止吸血鬼随意入侵米斯塔林了。

english: Could you not bless the river like you did with that water earlier?
translation: 你不能像之前祝福那水一样祝福这条河吗？

english: I'm afraid not. Blessing a small bucket is one thing, but the power I have from Saradomin is nowhere near enough to cleanse an entire river.
translation: 恐怕不行。祝福一个小桶是一回事，但我从萨拉多曼那里获得的力量远不足以净化整条河流。

english: However, I believe there might still be a way to undo this, but I'm going to need your help. This passage is the only route between Morytania and Misthalin. The barrier here draws power from the river.
translation: 不过，我相信或许还有办法解决这个问题，但我需要你的帮助。这条通道是莫利塔尼亚和米斯塔林之间唯一的路线。这里的屏障从河流中汲取力量。

english: I have managed to reinforce the barrier, but I must continue focussing on it to keep it intact. While I do that, I will need you to soak up the evil magic that potion has released into the river.
translation: 我已经设法加固了屏障，但我必须持续集中精力才能保持它完好。在我这样做的时候，我需要你吸收那瓶药水释放到河流中的邪恶魔法。

english: Soak up the magic? How?
translation: 吸收魔法？怎么做？

english: I'm sure you know of runes, used by mages to power their spells. The essence used to create them absorbs magical potential from runic altars to be released later.
translation: 我相信你知道符文，法师们用它来为法术提供能量。用来制造符文的精华从符石祭坛吸收魔法潜力，以便日后释放。

english: Ah, I see where this is going. You think we can use some rune essence to absorb the magic that potion released into the Salve?
translation: 啊，我明白你的意思了。你觉得我们可以用一些符文精华来吸收那瓶药水释放到萨尔维河中的魔法？

english: Excellent! That should do it! I will bless these stones and place them within the well so they can soak up the magic from that potion. Misthalin will be safe from the vampyres once more!
translation: 太好了！应该可以！我会祝福这些石头，并把它们放在水井里，这样它们就能吸收那瓶药水的魔法。米斯塔林将再次免受吸血鬼的威胁！

english: What about the Zamorakians upstairs?
translation: 那楼上的扎莫拉基教徒呢？

english: They hopefully shouldn't be too much trouble now that their leader is dead, but I will write to the King and ask him to make sure they're dealt with properly.
translation: 希望他们现在不会惹太多麻烦，因为他们的首领已经死了，但我会写信给国王，请他确保他们得到妥善处理。

english: For now though, please take this dagger. It has been handed down within my family for generations and is filled with the power of Saradomin. Consider it a small thank you for your help here.
translation: 不过现在，请收下这把匕首。它在我家族中代代相传，充满了萨拉多曼的力量。算是对你在这里帮助的一点小小感谢。

english: You should keep that dagger I gave you to hand. Its magic will prevent them from taking on their wolf form.
translation: 你应该随身携带我给你的那把匕首。它的魔法会阻止他们变成狼形。

english: For the safety of our people,
translation: 为了我们人民的安全，

english: Sheltered by our lord's trusted allies,
translation: 受我们领主信任的盟友庇护，

english: By ice, the Empire will be protected.
translation: 以冰之力，帝国将受到保护。

english: We pray that the Empire will never fall.
translation: 我们祈祷帝国永不陷落。

english: The latest test seems to be successful, but 'seems' is the key word here. Samples from the Stranglewood are unsurprisingly in short supply, so proving my theory is difficult. Still, if all goes well, while it won't fully protect from infection, this potion should provide some defence against the Strangler parasite.
translation: 最新的测试似乎成功了，但'似乎'是这里的关键词。来自斯特兰格伍德的样本不出所料地供应短缺，所以证明我的理论很困难。不过，如果一切顺利，虽然不能完全防止感染，但这瓶药水应该能对斯特兰格寄生虫提供一些防御。

english: With the potion sorted, the only thing left now is the boat. There's a small bay south of Quidamortem that should be a suitable place to row out from. I'll arrange for the boat to be sent there.
translation: 药水解决了，剩下的就是船了。奎达莫特姆南边有个小海湾，应该是个适合划船出发的地方。我会安排把船送到那里。

english: Viewing this display contains mild spoilers for the Song of the Elves quest which you have not completed.
translation: 查看此展示柜包含对'精灵之歌'任务的轻微剧透，而你尚未完成该任务。

english: You hear a voice from inside.
translation: 你听到里面传来一个声音。

english: Fascinating, fascinating. It's remarkable what these young dwarves have managed to create. Oh, hello young one.
translation: 有趣，真有趣。这些年轻的矮人竟然能创造出这样的东西，真是了不起。哦，你好，小家伙。

english: You are given some coal as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一些煤作为小费。

english: You are given some gold ore as a tip.
translation: 你得到了一些金矿石作为小费。

english: Primula hands you a light box!
translation: 普里穆拉递给你一个灯箱！

english: Primula hands you a puzzle box!
translation: 普里穆拉递给你一个拼图盒！

english: No thank you, dear friend.
translation: 不用了，谢谢，亲爱的朋友。

english: Oi, git yerself out of that hole!
translation: 喂，从那个洞里出来！

english: It's not safe in there.
translation: 那里不安全。

english: You'd better get rid of Lady Keli before trying to go through there.
translation: 你最好先解决掉凯利夫人再试着从那里过去。

english: You overpower Keli again, tie her up and put her in a cupboard.
translation: 你再次制服了凯利，把她绑起来塞进了橱柜。

english: You must open the door to rescue the prince before she escapes.
translation: 你必须打开门救出王子，趁她还没逃走。

english: The recent treatment of our kind cannot be allowed to continue. Yes, the uprising was unacceptable, but all humans cannot all be tarred with the same brush! We are all loyal servants of the Empire, and it's time we are treated as such. If you agree, then join our cause! Our protest will be peaceful, but our voices will be heard!
translation: 最近对我们族类的待遇不能再继续下去了。是的，起义是不可接受的，但所有人类不能一概而论！我们都是帝国忠诚的仆人，是时候让我们得到应有的待遇了。如果你同意，就加入我们的事业吧！我们的抗议将是和平的，但我们的声音会被听到！

english: Caeso,
translation: 凯索，

english: Something isn't right. The war is over and the gods are gone. We should be leaving this place, but instead we remain. Apparently, the Duke requires us to make preparations before we return to the surface, but there is something we are not being told. The Duke hasn't left the asylum in days, and every day, more people are taken down there... never to return. I feel something terrible is fast approaching. We must leave before it does.
translation: 有些不对劲。战争结束了，诸神也离开了。我们应该离开这个地方，但我们却留了下来。显然，公爵要求我们在返回地表之前做好准备，但有些事情没有告诉我们。公爵已经好几天没有离开精神病院了，而且每天都有更多的人被带到那里……再也没有回来。我感觉有什么可怕的事情正在逼近。我们必须在那之前离开。

english: They'll have my head if I am discovered helping prisoners, so we must be discreet. I have made arrangements for you to be moved into the cell next to Sarina's. You'll need to work together to get out. Once you have, head to the chapel in the refugee camp. You'll find what you need there. Good luck.
translation: 如果被发现帮助囚犯，他们会要我的命，所以我们必须谨慎。我已经安排把你转移到萨琳娜隔壁的牢房。你们需要合作才能逃出去。一旦逃出去，就去难民营的礼拜堂。你会在那里找到你需要的东西。祝你好运。

english: P.S. Your new cell should have a latrine bucket. I trust you'll know what to do with it.
translation: 附言：你的新牢房里应该有一个便桶。我相信你知道该怎么用它。

english: Recipe for Easter Buns
translation: 复活节小圆面包食谱

english: By Eggus Manus
translation: 作者：蛋格斯.马努斯

english: For me, this is the ultimate Easter Bun recipe. Delicious, rich, eggy. I remember when I was but a young lad, the smell of thse buns would fill the house as my grandmother prepared them in the kitchen. Ah! It must be Easter! I would exclaim, then rush to grab them fresh out of the oven. Oh how I burned my hands! And how I burned my tongue! Well worth it in my opinion, these little wonders are perfection.
translation: 对我来说，这是终极复活节小圆面包食谱。美味、浓郁、蛋香十足。记得我还是个小伙子的时候，祖母在厨房里准备这些面包时，香气弥漫整个屋子。啊！一定是复活节到了！我会这样喊着，然后冲过去抢刚出炉的面包。哎呀，我的手被烫得多厉害！舌头也被烫到了！但在我看来完全值得，这些小奇迹堪称完美。

english: While it can be hard to find the spices and raisins (depending on your local provender) it is absolutely worth tracking them down for the real authentic flavour! I love to serve these spread with butter alongside a steaming hot mug of strong tea, and followed of course by a healthy stack of eggs - boiled, fried, scrambled, poached, chocolate, it matters not! Surely this is the essence of Easter! Scoff them down and make some more, then burst into song!
translation: 虽然香料和葡萄干可能不好找（取决于你当地的食材供应），但为了正宗的风味，绝对值得费心去寻找！我喜欢在面包上抹上黄油，配上一大杯热气腾腾的浓茶，当然还要来一堆鸡蛋——煮的、煎的、炒的、水煮的、巧克力味的，都无所谓！这 surely 就是复活节的精髓！大口吃光再做一批，然后放声歌唱！

english: My favourite song to sing alongside Easter Buns is of course 'The white and the yolk and the shell' by the renowned hymnodist Souffleus Ovvonimninton, which of course goes...
translation: 我最喜欢在吃复活节小圆面包时唱的歌，当然是著名赞美诗作者苏弗勒斯.奥沃尼明顿的《蛋白、蛋黄和蛋壳》，歌词是这样的...

english: Another hundred refugees arrived today. This war has already lasted multiple lifetimes for the lesser races, and there is no end in sight. I ask once again that we consider our capacity here. I do not wish to turn away those who are still faithful, but we are running out of room.
translation: 今天又有一百名难民抵达。这场战争对低等种族来说已经持续了好几代人的时间，而且看不到尽头。我再次请求我们考虑这里的容纳能力。我不想拒绝那些仍然忠诚的人，但我们的空间快用完了。

english: A grim morn as the frosts landed early this year; a surprise as it has been late these last three years. I met with Magister Sattayas who in discourse conveyed my request to Lord Arceuus to investigate the Dark Altar further.
translation: 今年霜冻提前到来，是个阴沉的早晨；过去三年都来得晚，真是意外。我会见了萨塔亚斯法师，他在交谈中把我的请求转达给阿西乌斯领主，要求进一步调查黑暗祭坛。

english: I retired to Madam Turner's on the great concourse for mutton pie and drank to the health of the new King.
translation: 我在大会堂的特纳夫人那里吃了羊肉派，并为新国王的健康干杯。

english: With Messrs. Stalae and Frayn I planned the first visit to the Dark Altar; due to take place on the morrow, with the utmost care due to the reputation it had received.
translation: 我与斯塔莱和弗雷恩先生计划了首次前往黑暗祭坛的行程；定于次日进行，因其名声，我们格外小心。

english: A fair day in regards to the content rather than the weather. The rain did beat down heavily and seemed to only increase as we approached the Dark Altar. Unperturbed we continued and felt the better for our persistence the closer we got to the altar.
translation: 就内容而言是个好日子，而非天气。雨势猛烈，似乎随着我们接近黑暗祭坛而愈发加大。我们不为所动，继续前行，越靠近祭坛，坚持的回报越明显。

english: Messrs. Stalae and Frayn proceeded to survey the site as I studied the ancient text found around the Altar itself. I feel that even though the text is ancient I will be able to make progress on understanding it.
translation: 斯塔莱和弗雷恩先生开始勘察现场，而我则研究祭坛周围发现的古文。我觉得即使这些文字古老，我也能逐渐理解它们。

english: This morning the rain had turned to snow and seemed to beat down more fiercely than I have known in these past 42 years. I have never known it so treacherous. Nevertheless we arrived; although weather beaten for our troubles; at the Dark Altar.
translation: 今晨雨转雪，风雪比我这42年来所知的更为猛烈。我从未见过如此恶劣的天气。尽管如此，我们还是到达了黑暗祭坛，虽然饱受风霜之苦。

english: As Messrs. Stalae and Frayn continued the survey I turned my attention to the ancient text carefully ensuring I was making notes accurately. Some of the forms of the text suggest ideas and thoughts to me which make me believe I shall be able to read this text before long.
translation: 斯塔莱和弗雷恩先生继续勘察，我则专注于古文，仔细确保记录准确。文中的某些形式给了我启示，让我相信不久就能读懂这些文字。

english: Travlyn Stalae was taken with a fever the last night. Mr Frayn and I continued to the Dark Altar. The weather was no better than the previous day, but mercifully it was no worse.
translation: 特拉夫林·斯塔莱昨晚发烧了。弗雷恩先生和我继续前往黑暗祭坛。天气不比前一天好，但幸运的是也没有更糟。

english: Without Mr Stalae to help Mr Frayn do the survey we both concentrated on ancient text. I found Mr Frayn's lack of imagination and understanding of ancient language intolerable. How he ever came to work for Magister Sattayas I will never know. I will have to raise his suitability for this task when I next speak to him.
translation: 没有斯塔莱先生帮忙，弗雷恩先生和我都专注于古文。我发现弗雷恩先生对古代语言的想象力和理解力令人难以忍受。他怎么会为萨塔亚斯法师工作，我永远不会知道。下次见到法师时，我必须提出他是否适合这项任务的问题。

english: Progress was slow and I feel I am no further to understanding the ancient text than I was yesterday.
translation: 进展缓慢，我觉得对古文的理解并不比昨天更进一步。

english: Yet again I must bear the company of Mr Frayn as Mr Stalae has worsened this night. I declare that the progress of this day did not surpass yester'; I will have to find other means of engagement for Mr Frayn. I spent much of the day in conversation with Mr Frayn about the meaning of one symbol in particular. His lack of understand of such matters still astounds me and does naught to inspire me with regard to his ability.
translation: 斯塔莱先生病情加重，我不得不再次忍受弗雷恩先生的陪伴。我宣布今天的进展并未超过昨天；我得为弗雷恩先生找其他事情做。我花了大半天与弗雷恩先生讨论一个特定符号的含义。他对这类事情的理解之匮乏仍令我震惊，也丝毫不能激发我对他的能力的信心。

english: I met upon the mid noon with Magister Sattayas; leaving Mr Frayn at the Dark Altar; with the purpose to find alternative engagement for Mr Frayn. The audience did not go well as Magister Sattayas disagreed with my assessment and I must tolerate Mr Frayn further.
translation: 正午时分我会见了萨塔亚斯法师；把弗雷恩先生留在黑暗祭坛；目的是为弗雷恩先生寻找其他工作。会面并不顺利，因为萨塔亚斯法师不同意我的评估，我必须继续容忍弗雷恩先生。

english: Upon returning to the Dark Altar in the mid afternoon I discovered Mr Frayn studying the base. There was much temptation; some might call it provocation, to resolve the issue permanently. I did not.
translation: 下午回到黑暗祭坛时，我发现弗雷恩先生在研究基座。有极大的诱惑——有人可能称之为挑衅——去永久解决这个问题。我没有这么做。

english: The wind continues to blow such a force tainted with biting snow these last seven days. I have not known such a tumultuous condition in all my memory. Nevertheless I was determined to continue my work at the Dark Altar however the King has shut the gates in order to have a day of thanks for our good health. The fool.
translation: 这七天来，风一直带着刺骨的雪猛烈吹着。我记忆中从未有过如此动荡的天气。尽管如此，我决心继续在黑暗祭坛的工作，但国王却关闭了城门，以便为我们的健康举行感恩日。这个傻瓜。

english: I could not do anything, let alone give thanks, as my mind was consumed with my work. If others would, or should I say could, understand the importance of my work they would let me pass and continue.
translation: 我什么都做不了，更不用说感恩了，因为我的心思全在工作上。如果其他人能——或者我该说能够——理解我工作的重要性，他们就会让我通过并继续。

english: Instead I must console myself with quiet contemplation as I review my work.
translation: 相反，我必须用安静的沉思来安慰自己，回顾我的工作。

english: It is with relief that I awoke to the news that both Messrs. Frayn and Stalae both have a fever. Thus, my study of the Dark Altar can continue undisturbed by the nonsensical murmurings of others.
translation: 我醒来时得知弗雷恩和斯塔莱先生都发烧了，这让我松了一口气。因此，我对黑暗祭坛的研究可以不受他人无意义的嘀咕干扰了。

english: The progress was swift today as the symbols unravelled themselves in my mind. When I present my findings to the Magister he and his peers will see the true message that I bring them. They will see that I was always right and am far superior to them in intellect.
translation: 今天进展迅速，符号在我脑海中自行解开。当我向法师呈上我的发现时，他和他的同僚们将看到我带给他们的真正信息。他们会看到我一直是对的，智力远超他们。

english: I was sore tempted to work through all the night as I feel so close to an epiphany which will uncover the final parts of this endeavour.
translation: 我极想通宵工作，因为我觉得离揭示这项事业最后部分的顿悟如此之近。

english: The weather only seems to worsen; that means I should be interrupted less. I continue to grasp the basics of the language I am seeing but the message still alludes me. One word keeps appearing in all of the text I read, sacrifice. I do not yet know under what terms the word should be used, I must study further to understand more.
translation: 天气似乎只会更糟；这意味着我被打扰的次数应该更少。我继续掌握所见的语言基础，但信息仍然难以捉摸。一个词在我读的所有文本中反复出现——祭品。我还不知道这个词应在什么情况下使用，我必须进一步研究以了解更多。

english: I arrived back at my lodgings to the news that Mr Stalae's condition is improved. I hope he has more intellectual capacity than the Magister and Mr Frayn.
translation: 我回到住处时得知斯塔莱先生的病情有所好转。我希望他比法师和弗雷恩先生更有智慧。

english: What a fool I was to think Mr Stalae would be any different to the Magister and Mr Frayn. The complete ignorance and uneducated manner was apparent as soon as I saw him again. His understanding of the language is beyond laughable and his translation of the symbol as 'death' rather than 'sacrifice, is simply absurd.
translation: 我真是个傻瓜，竟以为斯塔莱先生会与法师和弗雷恩先生不同。我一见到他就看出他完全无知且缺乏教养。他对语言的理解可笑至极，把符号翻译成'死亡'而非'祭品'，简直荒谬。

english: I do not doubt the Magister has no great understanding of the complication Mr Stalaen will bring to my studies, I shall have to find another use for him.
translation: 我不怀疑法师对斯塔莱先生将给我的研究带来的麻烦没有深刻理解，我得为他找别的用途。

english: My work slows. Considerably.
translation: 我的工作变慢了。相当慢。

english: Today I may have stepped too far over the boundary of what is acceptable. As Mr Stalae and myself were at the Dark Altar I realised that to unlock the rest of the language a sacrifice was needed. It seemed obvious.
translation: 今天我可能越过了可接受的界限。当斯塔莱先生和我在黑暗祭坛时，我意识到要解锁其余语言需要祭品。这似乎是显而易见的。

english: As the weather worsened through the day visibility dropped which gave me the opportunity to test my theory. At last I have found a purpose for Mr Stalae and Mr Frayn.
translation: 随着天气恶化，能见度下降，这给了我测试理论的机会。终于，我为斯塔莱先生和弗雷恩先生找到了用途。

english: I do not regret my actions, there is always a cost to progress.
translation: 我不后悔我的行为，进步总有代价。

english: Today is your lucky day, my liege! I am donating to the victims of crime to atone for my past actions!
translation: 今天是你的幸运日，陛下！我要向犯罪受害者捐款，以赎我过去的罪过！

english: I must leave you now, sirrah!
translation: 我现在必须离开你了，先生！

english: I must leave you now, ma'am!
translation: 我现在必须离开你了，女士！

english: I must leave you now, my liege!
translation: 我现在必须离开你了，陛下！

english: Good day to you, my liege [player name].
translation: 祝你有美好的一天，陛下[player name]。

english: I seek a moment of your time, ma'am!
translation: 我想占用你一点时间，女士！

english: I seek a moment of your time, my liege!
translation: 我想占用你一点时间，陛下！

english: Milord [player name], please speak to me!
translation: 大人[player name]，请和我说话！

english: Milady [player name], please speak to me!
translation: 夫人[player name]，请和我说话！

english: My liege [player name], please speak to me!
translation: 陛下[player name]，请和我说话！

english: The latest test confirms it. The energy from the altar matches what I observed on the island.
translation: 最新测试证实了。祭坛的能量与我在岛上观察到的相符。

english: This should be a great revelation, but to be honest I feel like the truth has been staring us in the face all along. Still, my lord asked for proof, and now I have it.
translation: 这应该是个重大发现，但说实话，我觉得真相一直就在我们眼前。不过，我的主人要求证据，现在我有证据了。

english: That stone... It all comes back to that stone. Could it be THE stone? Unlikely, but we should make no mistake, a power like this wasn't made by men.
translation: 那块石头……一切都回到那块石头。它会是那块石头吗？不太可能，但我们不能搞错，这种力量不是人类创造的。

english: Pontifex Mizzarch,
translation: 米扎奇大祭司，

english: Forgive me for writing to you about such a minor matter, but I was wondering if you'd had any more thoughts on my request? I understand the need for security, but some of the humans have spent their entire lives in this place. Giving them a glimpse of the outside could be a much needed morale boost for everyone.
translation: 请原谅我为了这点小事写信给你，但我想知道你对我的请求有没有新的想法？我理解安全的重要性，但有些人类一辈子都待在这个地方。让他们看一眼外面的世界，或许能大大提振大家的士气。

english: With thanks,
translation: 此致

english: Centurion Lucilia
translation: 百夫长卢西莉亚

translation: 你的阴影之戒还剩<Num0>次充能。

translation: 元素戒指有<Num0>次充能。你可以在银行解除充能。

english: Ring of the Elements charges: <Num0>. Uncharge it?
translation: 元素戒指充能次数：<Num0>。要解除充能吗？

translation: 升级死亡充能

english: Delivery for [player name]!!!
translation: [player name]的包裹！！！

english: Aluft Aloft delivery for [player name]!!!
translation: 阿洛夫特空运，[player name]的包裹！！！

english: Make Way! Package for [player name]!!!
translation: 让开！[player name]的包裹！！！

english: Hey, [player name], I can't get to you!
translation: 嘿，[player name]，我过不去你那边！

english: Here you go [player name], your food delivery - still warm!
translation: 给你，[player name]，你的食物送到了——还热着呢！

english: Rian watches you cautiously, refusing to engage.
translation: 里安警惕地看着你，拒绝交流。

english: Cormac's spread the word of what you did for us. I'm glad you turned out not to be a troublemaker.
translation: 科马克已经跟大家说了你为我们做的事。我很高兴你原来不是个惹麻烦的人。

english: I try my best.
translation: 我尽力而为。

english: Good. Keep it that way and most around here will warm to you.
translation: 很好。继续保持这样，这里大多数人都会对你友善的。

english: Know that before the Council of Elders, for the health of our soul and those of our ancestors and heirs, and the better ordering of our kingdom, at the advice of Ethrain Hosidius, Seabry Shayzien, Ret Piscarilius, Solange Lovakengj and Bourath Arceuus all Royal Lords of our Kingdom.
translation: 兹知悉，在长老议会面前，为了我们灵魂的健康，以及我们祖先和继承人的健康，为了更好地治理我们的王国，根据我们王国的诸位王室领主——霍西迪乌斯城的埃斯雷恩、谢兹恩城的西布雷、皮斯卡里琉斯城的雷特、洛瓦肯吉城的索朗热和阿西乌斯城的布拉斯的建议。

english: First, that of this day the Council of Elders shall cease to exercise authority over any action, collection of revenues, mobilisation of armies, distribution of revenues, seizure of goods or chattels belonging to any free man of the kingdom or any other thing as may be considered in the interest of the kingdom; within the Kingdom of Great Kourend in perpetuity.
translation: 第一，自即日起，长老议会不得再对任何行动、税收征收、军队调动、税收分配、没收王国任何自由民的财物或其他任何可能被视为符合王国利益的事项行使权力；在大库兰德王国内永久有效。

english: Second, that of this day the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus take complete responsibility for the kingdom in perpetuity.
translation: 第二，自即日起，我们王国中属于霍西迪乌斯、洛瓦肯吉、谢兹恩、皮斯卡里琉斯和阿西乌斯大家族的王室领主对王国承担全部责任，永久有效。

english: Third, that of this day one member from the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus shall be chosen to be the Grand Lord of Kourend for a period of no more than ten years and be able to exercise authority over any action, collection of revenues, mobilisation of armies, distribution of revenues, seizure of goods or chattels belonging to any free man of the kingdom or any other thing as may be considered in the interest of the kingdom; within the Kingdom of Great Kourend.
translation: 第三，自即日起，我们王国中属于霍西迪乌斯、洛瓦肯吉、谢兹恩、皮斯卡里琉斯和阿西乌斯大家族的王室领主中应选出一人担任库兰德大领主，任期不超过十年，并有权对任何行动、税收征收、军队调动、税收分配、没收王国任何自由民的财物或其他任何可能被视为符合王国利益的事项行使权力；在大库兰德王国内。

english: Fourth, that of this day the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Hosidius, will have ten years in the role of Grand Lord. Upon the expiry of these ten years he will willingly pass the title of Grand Lord to the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Lovakengj for a period of no more than ten years. And so it shall continue for the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Shayzien, then for the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Piscarilius and finally for the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Arceuus. Henceforth this is known as the Right of Succession to the Office of Grand Lord.
translation: 第四，自即日起，我们王国中属于霍西迪乌斯大家族的王室领主将担任大领主十年。这十年期满后，他将自愿将大领主之位传给属于洛瓦肯吉大家族的王室领主，任期不超过十年。如此依次传给属于谢兹恩大家族的王室领主，然后是皮斯卡里琉斯大家族的王室领主，最后是阿西乌斯大家族的王室领主。此后这被称为大领主职位的继承权。

english: Fifth, upon the expiry of the title of Grand Lord of the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Arceuus, the title of Grand Lord is passed willingly to the Royal Lord of our Kingdom whom is part of the great house of Hosidius and henceforth continues as the fourth statement of this Accord.
translation: 第五，当属于阿西乌斯大家族的王室领主的大领主任期届满时，大领主之位自愿传给属于霍西迪乌斯大家族的王室领主，此后按照本协议的第四条继续轮替。

english: Sixth, that if a suitable male lord of the any of the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus cannot be found at the start of their period as Grand Lord, whether due to infirmity of mind or body or of questionable morality, the Right of Succession to the Office of the Grand Lord is annulled and passed to the next Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus in line.
translation: 第六，如果在担任大领主之初，我们王国中属于霍西迪乌斯、洛瓦肯吉、谢兹恩、皮斯卡里琉斯和阿西乌斯大家族的任何王室领主中找不到合适的男性领主，无论是因心智或身体上的疾病，还是道德上有问题，那么大领主职位的继承权即告失效，并传给下一位顺位的属于霍西迪乌斯、洛瓦肯吉、谢兹恩、皮斯卡里琉斯和阿西乌斯大家族的王室领主。

english: We, the Royal Lords of our Kingdom whom are part of the great houses of Hosidius, Lovakengj, Shayzien, Piscarilius and Arceuus have sworn that all this shall be observed in good faith and without deceit.
translation: 我们，王国中属于霍西迪乌斯、洛瓦肯吉、谢兹恩、皮斯卡里琉斯和阿西乌斯大家族的王室领主，已宣誓这一切都将本着诚信、毫无欺骗地遵守。

english: Mr Hanson Piscarilius
translation: 汉森·皮斯卡里琉斯先生

english: His Royal Highness King Shayzien VI
translation: 谢兹恩六世国王陛下

english: Miss Enia Hosidius
translation: 埃尼亚·霍西迪乌斯小姐

english: Maybe, but it's not a risk worth taking. It was the acts of humans that led my grandmother's death. You will bring similar ruin to us.
translation: 也许吧，但这不是值得冒的风险。是人类的行为导致了我祖母的死亡。你也会给我们带来同样的毁灭。

english: Glarial? I know that name, I visited her tomb. I moved her remains to Baxtorian Falls, I thought that was where she would want to be.
translation: 格拉里尔？我听说过这个名字，我去过她的坟墓。我把她的遗骸移到了巴克斯托里安瀑布，我以为那是她想待的地方。

english: Hey there, Islwyn said you might be able to help me. He told me you'd know how to consecrate ground for an elven burial. I need to consecrate Glarial's new resting place.
translation: 嘿，伊斯尔温说你可能能帮我。他告诉我你知道如何为精灵葬礼祝圣地。我需要为格拉里尔的新安息之所祝圣。

english: You need a spade to be able to plant the seed.
translation: 你需要一把铲子才能种下种子。

english: Both the shield and bow I am carrying have been used, so are not at their full potential. They should still be quite useful though.
translation: 我携带的盾和弓都用过了，所以没有发挥出全部潜力。不过它们应该还是相当有用的。

english: Start the Mourning's End Part I quest?
translation: 要开始哀悼的终结 I 任务吗？

english: Actually, I don't want to go yet.
translation: 其实，我还不想走。

english: It's terrible, my dear friend! My father's been arguing with the Queen of Etceteria, and has managed to start a war again.
translation: 太糟糕了，我亲爱的朋友！我父亲一直在和埃西特利亚岛的女王争吵，又挑起了一场战争。

english: Perhaps it's an odd idea, my dear friend, but since we don't have an army, we can hardly declare war...
translation: 也许这想法有点奇怪，我亲爱的朋友，但既然我们没有军队，我们几乎没法宣战……

english: I'm sure you'll manage to do it, dear friend.
translation: 我相信你能做到的，亲爱的朋友。

english: You approach the crack in the wall...
translation: 你靠近墙上的裂缝……

english: You wedge the prop in the wall to stop the rocks falling.
translation: 你把支撑柱楔进墙里，防止岩石掉落。

english: You reach into the crate...
translation: 你把手伸进箱子里...

english: ...and pull out a beam with a pulley on it.
translation: ...拉出一根带滑轮的梁。

english: You add the plank to the scaffold as a crossbeam.
translation: 你把木板加到脚手架上作为横梁。

english: It looks more stable now.
translation: 现在看起来更稳固了。

english: ...and pull out a beam.
translation: ...拉出一根梁。

english: You attach the beams together to form a longer beam.
translation: 你把梁连接起来，形成一根更长的梁。

english: You attach the beams together to form a very long beam.
translation: 你把梁连接起来，形成一根非常长的梁。

english: You carefully add the top beam to the scaffold.
translation: 你小心地把顶梁加到脚手架上。

english: ...and pull out a rope.
translation: ...拉出一根绳子。

english: You repair the platform with the beam.
translation: 你用梁修复了平台。

english: You put the coal into the engine.
translation: 你把煤放进引擎里。

english: The engine seems to be full of coal already.
translation: 引擎似乎已经装满了煤。

english: You put the coal engine onto the scaffold. It appears to fit perfectly.
translation: 你把煤引擎放到脚手架上。它似乎完美契合。

english: The lift seems to be working now. It doesn't need further repair.
translation: 升降机现在似乎能正常工作了。不需要进一步修理。

english: The planks with pulleys won't fit through the hole, so you throw them away.
translation: 带滑轮的木板无法穿过洞口，所以你把它们扔掉了。

english: You throw the rope up and lash it around the rock formation.
translation: 你把绳子扔上去，绕在岩石构造上。

english: You find a burnt diary with one page in the embers.
translation: 你在余烬中找到一本烧焦的日记，里面有一页。

english: The water's making the rocks too slippery to walk on.
translation: 水让岩石变得太滑，无法行走。

english: Maybe if you had a board or plank...
translation: 也许如果你有块板或木板...

english: You place the board across the slippery rocks...
translation: 你把板横放在湿滑的岩石上...

english: As you walk over a steam vent, a plume of steam shoots up and hits you!
translation: 当你走过蒸汽通风口时，一股蒸汽喷涌而上击中了你！

english: Rocks tumble from the cave walls as you walk under them!
translation: 当你从洞穴墙壁下走过时，岩石滚落下来！

english: You find some diary pages in the embers.
translation: 你在余烬中找到了一些日记书页。

english: You add them to the diary you have.
translation: 你把它们加到你已有的日记里。

english: You don't find any more diary pages in the embers.
translation: 你在余烬中再也找不到更多的日记书页了。

english: So you're the adventurer we heard about, then. The one who gained the trust of the prince.
translation: 这么说，你就是我们听说的那位冒险者了。那位赢得了王子信任的人。

english: So you're the adventurer we heard about, then. The one who gained the trust of the princess.
translation: 这么说，你就是我们听说的那位冒险者了。那位赢得了公主信任的人。

english: A box of Etceterian items tumbles from the sea snake's nest.
translation: 一箱埃特塞特利亚的物品从海蛇的巢穴中滚落出来。

english: Oh sorry Player. I mistook you for another customer.
translation: 哦，抱歉，玩家。我把你误认为是另一位顾客了。

english: You give the merchant the animal pelts.
translation: 你把动物皮毛交给了商人。

english: You give the merchant the dye.
translation: 你把染料交给了商人。

english: Find a great ruin that has withered and died.
translation: 找到一座已枯萎消亡的伟大遗迹。

english: A seat of power, lost in a war of pride.
translation: 一座在骄傲之战中失落的权力之座。

english: Out in a land that's frozen to the bone.
translation: 在一片冻彻骨髓的土地上。

english: A village of statues, not made of stone.
translation: 一座雕像之村，却非石制。

english: Hearty drinks are a sailor's friend.
translation: 烈酒是水手的朋友。

english: Where one long journey comes to an end.
translation: 一段漫长旅程的终点。

english: An unlikely home is sat by the sea.
translation: 海边坐落着一个意想不到的家。

english: In the shadow of a mountain, there you'll find me.
translation: 在山影之下，你会找到我。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build rosewood hulls on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读了示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造红木船壳。你记下了示意图的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build rosewood cargo holds on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读了示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造玫瑰木货舱。你记住了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: You read the schematic. It details how to build rosewood and cotton sails on boats. You take in everything the schematic covers and then discard it.
translation: 你阅读了示意图。上面详细说明了如何在船上建造玫瑰木和棉布帆。你记住了示意图上的所有内容，然后将其丢弃。

english: The Royal Accord of Twill is an ancient document detailing the transfer of power from Kourend's Council of Elders to the Five Houses.
translation: 特威尔皇家协议是一份古老的文件，详细记载了库兰德王国长老议会将权力移交给五大家族的经过。

english: Following the War of Betrayal, King Kharedst III of Kourend arranged for the original document to be displayed here in the Grand Museum. However, a naval disaster resulted in the loss of the accord. As such, the document shown here is a replica.
translation: 背叛战争之后，库兰德国王卡雷德斯特三世安排将原始文件陈列在大博物馆中。然而，一场海难导致协议丢失。因此，这里展示的文件是复制品。

english: I found an unusual creature in the forest by the name of Crabidor Rank. He seemed tasty enough at first, but we've all fallen sick since eating him. To make matters worse, all of our blood stores have begun to rot into a sickly mush.
translation: 我在森林里发现了一种奇怪的生物，名叫克拉比多·兰克。起初他看起来挺美味的，但自从吃了他之后，我们都病倒了。更糟的是，我们所有的血库存都开始腐烂成恶心的糊状物。

english: Perhaps this is another of House Drakan's plots. They call us savages, but wage biological warfare on us from afar. Lowerniel proved his might once before, but has retired to a life of cowardice.
translation: 也许这又是德拉肯家族的阴谋。他们称我们为野蛮人，却从远处对我们发动生物战。洛厄尼尔曾证明过他的实力，但如今已退缩到懦弱的生活中。

english: It will not last. The glint in his eyes as he slaughtered his fellows cannot be left behind. House Drakan is built on the back of a slumbering, rabid, venator. One day that venator will wake with centuries of hunger repressed and the so called civilised Houses of Vampyrium will tremble. He would always have made a better Ghrazi.
translation: 这不会长久。他屠杀同胞时眼中的光芒无法被遗忘。德拉肯家族建立在一头沉睡的、狂暴的猎手背上。总有一天，那头猎手会带着被压抑了数百年的饥饿醒来，吸血鬼王国那些所谓的文明家族将会颤抖。他本该成为一名更优秀的格拉齐。

english: Sacrifice hands you a puzzlebox!
translation: 祭品递给你一个谜盒！

english: He seems to have vanished... you must have scared him off.
translation: 他似乎消失了……一定是你把他吓跑了。

english: I don't think he will be causing any more trouble.
translation: 我想他不会再惹麻烦了。

english: The soil here is too poor to farm on.
translation: 这里的土壤太贫瘠，无法耕种。

english: You will probably have a hard time raking that.
translation: 你恐怕很难耙动那个。

english: This is a blindweed patch. The soil has not been treated. The patch has something growing in it.
translation: 这是一片盲草种植地。土壤未经处理。地里长着什么东西。

english: This is a blindweed patch. The soil has not been treated. The patch (Crop) is fully grown.
translation: 这是一片盲草种植地。土壤未经处理。这块地里的作物已完全成熟。

english: I wonder how my Blindweed is coming along...
translation: 不知道我的盲草长得怎么样了……

english: You stuff the Blindweed into the Hopper.
translation: 你把盲草塞进料斗里。

english: You dump the water into the hopper.
translation: 你把水倒进料斗里。

english: 'Cos, lad they're one of our super-secret ingredients! Yer not too susceptible to mind control are ye lad?
translation: 因为，小伙子，它们是我们超级秘密的配料之一！你不会太容易受精神控制吧，小伙子？

english: 'Cos, lass they're one of our super-secret ingredients! Yer not too susceptible to mind control are ye lass?
translation: 因为，姑娘，它们是我们超级秘密的配料之一！你不会太容易受精神控制吧，姑娘？

english: You do not have the correct equipment to fish here.
translation: 你没有合适的装备在这里钓鱼。

english: You do not have any free space for anything that you will catch!
translation: 你没有足够的空间装下你钓到的东西！

english: You dunk the bowl in the water...
translation: 你把碗浸入水中……

english: ...and you catch some Sluglings!
translation: ……你捞到了一些小蛞蝓！

english: You stuff the squirming Sluglings into the barrel.
translation: 你把蠕动的小蛞蝓塞进木桶里。

english: You stuff the squirming Karamthultu into the barrel.

english: Since observing the ents with Ranulph, I have been conducting my own research. To date, I've built <Num0> Vale Totems and rummaged through Vale Offerings <Num1> times. I've also earned <Num2> Vale Research Points which Ranulph will exchange for items he finds around the Auburn Valley.
translation: 自从和拉努尔夫一起观察树人以来，我一直在进行自己的研究。迄今为止，我已经建造了<Num0>个山谷图腾，翻找了<Num1>次山谷祭品。我还赚取了<Num2>点山谷研究点数，拉努尔夫会用这些点数换取他在奥本谷找到的物品。

english: I would not have expected to find myself spending such time observing ents, yet they present a curious and repetitive ritual.
translation: 我没想到自己会花时间观察树人，但它们确实展现出一种奇特而重复的仪式。

english: From the moment I arrived in the Auburn Valley, it was clear the ents themselves held a high position in the valley hierarchy. There is little to no separation between the local population and the ents, with many of the latter choosing to walk through the local town itself.
translation: 从我到达奥本谷的那一刻起，就很清楚树人在山谷的等级体系中占据着高位。当地居民和树人之间几乎没有隔阂，许多树人甚至选择穿过当地城镇行走。

english: My first objective was to investigate any potential interfacing between the ents and the locals. With this in mind, I began to observe the rituals being undertaken.
translation: 我的首要目标是调查树人与当地人之间可能存在的互动。带着这个想法，我开始观察正在进行的仪式。

english: One of the first and most noticeable elements of the ritual is the perpetual nature of it all. The ents do not break from their paths, and there is no definition of a start or end. To become involved in the ritual, one must simply present themselves and begin to follow it.
translation: 仪式中最明显的特点之一就是它的永恒性。树人不会偏离它们的路径，也没有明确的开始或结束。要参与仪式，只需现身并开始跟随即可。

english: It appears the ritual itself revolves around a set of totems that represent the spirits of the forest. Initally, I assumed the totems to be a creation of the ents, but I have now learnt that it is in fact the citizens of these lands that maintain them. The ents appear to appreciate these contributions, especially when the totems are accurate to the local spirits.
translation: 看来仪式本身围绕着一组代表森林之灵的图腾展开。起初，我以为这些图腾是树人的创造物，但现在我了解到，实际上是这片土地上的居民在维护它们。树人似乎很欣赏这些贡献，尤其是当图腾与当地之灵相符时。

english: This is not all, however. For a totem to be considered complete, it is apparently important for them to be decorated with cut and carved wooden objects. Apparently this is some form of returning material to the forest in a manner the ents respect.
translation: 然而，这还不是全部。一个图腾要被视为完整，显然需要用切割和雕刻的木制物品来装饰。这似乎是某种以树人尊重的方式将材料归还给森林的形式。

english: For those interested in a consistent involvement in the ritual, I've noted that many follow the ents around to join them in appreciating the natural world. I believe they find it refreshing to pause and take in the sights of the forest.
translation: 对于那些有兴趣持续参与仪式的人，我注意到许多人跟随树人四处走动，一同欣赏自然世界。我相信他们觉得停下来欣赏森林的景色令人心旷神怡。

english: On moving through the forest, it is impossible to miss that the footsteps of the ents occasionally causes spectacular growths to emerge. My understanding is that by walking through these growths, one can feel more connected to the ent that left it behind.
translation: 穿过森林时，不可能错过树人脚步偶尔引发的壮观生长。我的理解是，走过这些生长物，人们可以感受到与留下它们的树人更加紧密的联系。

english: I've not collected enough information to confirm, but I believe the ents offer more reward to those connected to them.
translation: 我还没有收集到足够的信息来确认，但我相信树人会给予那些与他们有联系的人更多奖励。

english: I'm sure there is more that I have not yet discovered so I will keep working to build a stronger picture of how this ritual process works.
translation: 我相信还有更多我尚未发现的东西，所以我会继续努力，以构建更完整的图景来理解这个仪式过程。

english: An empty lecture theatre isn't the first thing you'd associate with the god of isolation, but in truth, it makes perfect sense for Scabaras. This god has been misunderstood over the years, but history has made it clear that he is the most intelligent of the lesser deities. What better way to represent him than with an empty hall of knowledge?
translation: 空荡荡的讲堂并不是你首先会与孤僻之神联系在一起的东西，但事实上，这对斯卡巴拉斯来说完全合理。多年来，这位神一直被误解，但历史已经清楚地表明，他是次级神祇中最聪明的一位。还有什么比一座空荡荡的知识殿堂更能代表他呢？

english: Of course, this section of Osmumten's tomb has now taken on a far more sinister meaning, for it is now home to Scabaras himself, and his guardian, Kephri.
translation: 当然，奥斯穆滕坟墓的这一部分如今已有了更险恶的含义，因为这里现在是斯卡巴拉斯本人及其守护者凯弗里的居所。

english: Similar to the cruel manner in which the Devourer captured the other lesser deities, Kephri was key to her plans with Scabaras, who was in fact the first lesser deity she captured.
translation: 与吞噬者捕捉其他次级神祇的残忍方式类似，凯弗里是她对付斯卡巴拉斯计划的关键，而斯卡巴拉斯实际上是她捕捉的第一位次级神祇。

english: The last of her race, Kephri is a dawn scarab - one of an extremely long-lived and intelligent race of beetles. The rest of her kind were wiped out during the great war with the Ruinous Powers, but Kephri escaped death thanks to Scabaras himself.
translation: 凯弗里是她种族中的最后一位，是一只黎明圣甲虫——一种寿命极长且极其聪明的甲虫种族。她的同类在与毁灭之力的伟大战争中全部灭绝，但凯弗里因斯卡巴拉斯本人而逃过一死。

english: Over the years, Kephri dedicated herself to Scabaras, living a content life of isolation. However, no being is infallible, and her isolation soon began to take its toll.
translation: 多年来，凯弗里全身心奉献给斯卡巴拉斯，过着与世隔绝的满足生活。然而，没有哪个存在是完美无缺的，她的孤僻很快开始产生负面影响。

english: Fearing for the end of her race, Kephri longed for children to pass on her knowledge. The Devourer learnt of her desires and a pact was soon made. In return for her help, the Devourer would revive her race, making Kephri children even smarter than herself.
translation: 担心种族灭绝，凯弗里渴望有孩子来传承她的知识。吞噬者得知了她的愿望，很快便达成了一项协议。作为帮助的回报，吞噬者将复兴她的种族，让凯弗里的孩子比她更聪明。

english: Desire can be the death of reason, and even with all of her intelligence, Kephri failed to see the truth until it was too late. By warping another race of scarabs, the Devourer granted Kephri her children as promised, but they had no more intelligence than a common locust.
translation: 欲望可以成为理性的死亡，即使拥有全部的智慧，凯弗里也没能及时看清真相。通过扭曲另一种圣甲虫种族，吞噬者如约赐予了凯弗里孩子，但它们的智力并不比普通蝗虫高。

english: However, the Devourer had promised children even smarter than Kephri herself, and that was a vow she intended to keep. She bound Kephri and destroyed her mind, leaving nothing more than a husk.
translation: 然而，吞噬者曾承诺赐予比凯弗里本人更聪明的孩子，而这是她打算遵守的誓言。她束缚了凯弗里并摧毁了她的心智，只留下一具空壳。

english: In her final moments of consciousness, Kephri called out to Scabaras, but by the time he arrived, it was too late. The plan had worked perfectly, and thanks to Kephri, The Devourer had captured her first lesser deity.
translation: 在最后一丝意识中，凯弗里呼唤着斯卡巴拉斯，但当他赶到时，已经太晚了。计划完美地实施了，多亏了凯弗里，吞噬者捕获了她的第一位次级神祇。

english: I don't understand this stone at all. It's solid. So much so that it survived hitting the rock below it without shattering.

english: Despite that, I'm able to separate blocks from it with a pickaxe swing, and I can carve these blocks down with just a chisel.

english: There's enough evidence about to show that I'm far from the first to try this, yet the monolith itself lacks the scarring that years of usage would cause. I've not taken measurements, but I suspect it has some regenerative quality, though I've no way to know for sure.
translation: 周围有足够的痕迹表明我不是第一个这么干的，可巨石本身却没有长年使用该留下的划痕。我没量过，但我怀疑它有某种再生能力，只是没法确定。

english: There's also this inescapable feeling that I'm being watched by the monolith.
translation: 还有一种挥之不去的感觉，总觉得巨石在盯着我。

english: I can't see anything that would confirm it knows I'm here, but I can feel the hairs on the back of my neck stand on end so regularly whilst out here. It doesn't make sense, but this stone defies so many conventions...
translation: 我看不出任何能证明它知道我在这儿的迹象，但在这儿的时候，我后脖颈的汗毛总是竖起来。说不通，但这块石头打破了太多常理……

english: I wonder if I'm approaching the limits of my knowledge here. Someone who'd been around a long time might know more, but there's only one place on this island where I'd find someone like that.
translation: 我在想自己是不是快触及知识的极限了。在这儿待得久的人或许知道更多，但这岛上只有一个地方能找到那样的人。

english: I am yet to truly understand quite what this rock is, or in truth, where it originated. Perhaps I was foolish to abandon yet another project to track it down, but the image of its fall remains stuck in my thoughts and I, Orthacas, dare to dream.
translation: 我还没真正搞懂这块石头到底是什么，或者说它从哪来。也许我放弃另一个项目来追查它是愚蠢的，但陨落之星的画面一直萦绕在我脑海里，我，奥萨卡斯，敢于梦想。

english: Further, more focused study of the fallen star has lead me to a startling discovery: It appears to have regenerative qualities that I've only managed to replicate in part before. Now, I can't get ahead of myself. Stone is not by nature the same as flesh, but if I can even take a small aspect of this and incorporate it into a new breed of wyrm, I can prove my work was worth its while.
translation: 对陨落之星更深入的研究让我有了惊人的发现：它似乎有再生能力，而我之前只能部分复制。现在我不能操之过急。石头本质上和血肉不同，但如果我能从中汲取哪怕一小部分，融入新品种的蛇龙，就能证明我的工作没有白费。

english: Another failure. I can't seem to make any functional use out of this star stone in regards to a new breed of wyrms. It has inspired me, but my patience runs thin for its practicalities. I am not unfamiliar with setbacks though, so I shall maintain the course whilst I remain undisturbed, save for the goats. Fortunately they provide excellent sustenance to this fledgling brood of wyrms.
translation: 又失败了。我似乎没法把这块星石实际用于培育新品种的蛇龙。它给了我灵感，但实用性让我耐心耗尽。不过我对挫折并不陌生，只要没人打扰，我就会继续坚持，除了那些山羊。幸好它们给这批新孵化的蛇龙提供了绝佳的食物。

english: I failed him. Everything I've done, I did for him. All the pain, all the suffering. All of it. I just wanted him to live a good life, a happy life. But I failed. I was foolish. I never even considered they'd come after us at our home. I should have been smarter.
translation: 我辜负了他。我所做的一切，都是为了他。所有的痛苦，所有的苦难，全都是。我只想让他过上好日子，幸福的日子。但我失败了。我太蠢了。我压根没想到他们会追到家里来。我本该更聪明些。

english: It happened last week. It seemed like a simple deal at the time. Food for weapons, a fair trade. Of course, things went south. I thought I'd given them the slip, but they followed me home. That's when he got involved.
translation: 事情发生在上周。当时看起来只是一笔简单的交易。用食物换武器，公平交易。当然，事情搞砸了。我以为甩掉了他们，可他们跟到了我家。那时他掺和了进来。

english: He should have let me handle it. I can look after myself. Not just myself, I used to be able to look after the both of us. I guess it's too late to dwell on what could have been though. The blade must have been poisoned. It barely touched him. Now, after everything, I'm losing the only family I have left. My baby brother is dying and it's all my fault.
translation: 他本该让我来处理。我能照顾好自己。不只是自己，我以前能照顾好我们俩。不过现在想那些如果也没用了。刀上肯定有毒。只是擦破点皮。现在，经历了这一切，我快要失去仅剩的家人了。我弟弟快死了，都是我的错。

english: I need to get help for him. I can't let him die. No, I won't let him die. They'll be tithing our sector in a couple more weeks and he won't be well enough to cope, if he even survives for that long.
translation: 我得找人救他。我不能让他死。不，我不会让他死的。再过几周他们就要来我们区收税了，他撑不住的，要是他能活到那时候的话。

english: I've heard of a doctor in sector five, maybe they can help. I don't have money, but I can work something out. Everyone has a price. If I've learnt nothing else from this life, I've learnt that.
translation: 我听说五区有个医生，也许他们能帮忙。我没钱，但总能想出办法。每个人都有个价码。这辈子要是没学到别的，至少学到了这个。

english: The doctor was a dead end, literally. Apparently the vampyres took him to Darkmeyer a few weeks ago. He'll never be seen again.
translation: 那个医生是条死路，字面意义上的。显然几周前吸血鬼把他带去了达克迈尔。再也见不到他了。

english: Thing is, just when I thought all hope was lost, things took a strange turn. As I returned home, I was confronted by a strange looking man wearing a large medallion.
translation: 问题是，就在我以为毫无希望的时候，事情出现了转机。我回到家，一个戴着大勋章的可疑男人拦住了我。

english: The human disguise didn't fool me. He was far too clean to actually live in this place. I knew he was a vampyre. I told him he didn't scare me, but he just laughed.
translation: 那人类的伪装骗不了我。他太干净了，不可能真住在这种地方。我知道他是吸血鬼。我告诉他我不怕他，他只是笑了笑。

english: He came closer and called me by my name. He told me he had an offer, one I wouldn't be able to refuse. It's not the first time I've heard that. I'm no fool.
translation: 他走近了，叫出了我的名字。他说他有个提议，一个我无法拒绝的提议。这话我不是第一次听了。我又不是傻子。

english: Hope presents itself in mysterious ways. This strange vampyre claims to have a way to save my brother.
translation: 希望以神秘的方式出现。这个奇怪的吸血鬼声称有办法救我弟弟。

english: I don't know how he knew about us. Maybe I made too much noise when asking about that doctor. It doesn't matter now.
translation: 我不知道他怎么知道我们的事。也许是我打听那个医生时动静太大了。现在无所谓了。

english: Now I have a chance to save him. I have to take it, no matter what it costs.
translation: 现在我有机会救他了。我必须抓住，不管付出什么代价。

english: The vampyre visited our home today. He wanted to present his offer to me. I took him down into the basement so we could talk in private.
translation: 那个吸血鬼今天来我们家了。他想当面提出他的提议。我带他下了地下室，好私下谈。

english: He spoke of an operation which would cure my brother of his illness. He offered no guarantees, but claimed he was confident it would work. He just needs to ensure my brother is 'compatible.'
translation: 他说有一种手术能治好弟弟的病。他不保证一定成功，但声称很有信心。他只需要确认我弟弟'匹配'。

english: Nothing comes free around here, especially when the vampyres are involved. He had no reason to help us. He clearly wanted something in return. I asked him what it was. When he told me, I felt a shiver go down my spine.
translation: 这地方没有免费的午餐，尤其牵扯到吸血鬼。他没理由帮我们。他显然想要回报。我问他要什么。他说出来的时候，我感觉脊背发凉。

english: For a moment, I questioned if it was worth the cost. Was my brother really worth all of that pain? I didn't debate for long. Of course he was. For him, no price is too great.
translation: 有那么一瞬间，我怀疑这代价值不值。弟弟真的值得承受那么多痛苦吗？我没犹豫太久。当然值得。为了他，什么代价都不算大。

english: Not long to go until they take my brother. Apparently, they have a secret lab where the operation will take place. The vampyre says he'll be safe there.
translation: 离他们带走弟弟没多久了。显然他们有个秘密实验室，手术会在那里进行。那个吸血鬼说他在那里会安全。

english: I asked him about my own operation. How much pain would there be? Would I remember anything afterwards? He was honest with me. By the time they're done, they'll be nothing left of the person I am now. I guess that's why I've actually been using this diary for once. Soon, it will be all that's left of me.
translation: 我问了他关于我自己的手术。会有多痛？之后我还会记得什么吗？他对我很诚实。等他们做完，现在的我就什么都不剩了。我想这就是为什么我这次真的在用这本日记。很快，它就是我仅存的一切了。

english: Today is the day. They'll take my brother first. There's no need for him to know what I'm about to sacrifice.
translation: 就是今天了。他们会先带走弟弟。没必要让他知道我要牺牲什么。

english: By the time my operation begins, he'll be fast asleep recovering from his own. I know my brother better than anyone. He'll take a long time to understand my sacrifice. Maybe he never will. I hope one day he has the heart to forgive me.
translation: 等我的手术开始时，他已经熟睡，正在从自己的手术中恢复。我比任何人都了解弟弟。他需要很长时间才能理解我的牺牲。也许永远不会。我希望有一天他有勇气原谅我。

english: I've asked the vampyre to give this diary to him. Hopefully it will help. Brother, if you are reading this, know that everything I have done has been for you. I'm sorry.
translation: 我请那个吸血鬼把日记交给他。希望这能有所帮助。弟弟，如果你在读这些，要知道我所做的一切都是为了你。对不起。

english: A few years ago I made the long journey to Morytania. The region is mostly sealed off from the rest of the world and as such, it is a place that holds many secrets. Whilst there, I attempted to document all that I could about the region and the various races living there. Of particular interest to me was the story of the vampyres and just how they'd managed to maintain control of Morytania for so long. Although I was at first puzzled by their rule, the truth behind it soon revealed itself to me in the form of a tale, the tale of Serafina.
translation: 几年前，我长途跋涉来到莫利塔尼亚。这片区域大多与世界隔绝，因此藏着许多秘密。在那里，我试图记录下关于这片土地及其上居住的各种族的一切。我尤其感兴趣的是吸血鬼的故事，以及他们是如何长久控制莫利塔尼亚的。虽然起初我对他们的统治感到困惑，但真相很快以一则故事的形式向我揭示——那就是塞拉菲娜的故事。

english: The tale is that of a young Morytanian girl by the name of Serafina. She lived deep within Meiyerditch with her younger brother, their parents having passed away a few years prior. Like the rest of Morytania's human population, Serafina and her brother were regularly subjected to blood tithes from the ruling vampyres. While Serafina was able to cope with the tithes, her brother was too frail to recover from them, growing weaker with each one. Realising that her brother's time was running out, Serafina vowed to free him from the tyranny of the vampyres.
translation: 故事讲的是一个名叫塞拉菲娜的莫利塔尼亚年轻女孩。她和弟弟住在迈尔迪奇深处，父母几年前已去世。和莫利塔尼亚其他人类一样，塞拉菲娜和弟弟定期要承受统治吸血鬼的血税。塞拉菲娜尚能承受血税，但她弟弟太过虚弱，无法从中恢复，每次血税后都更加衰弱。意识到弟弟时日无多，塞拉菲娜发誓要将他从吸血鬼的暴政中解救出来。

english: To take the vampyres head on would be suicide, and escaping them is near impossible. Anyone looking to free themselves from the blood tithes has only one true option. That option is Ver Sinhaza, more commonly known as the Theatre of Blood.
translation: 正面迎战吸血鬼无异于自杀，而逃离他们几乎不可能。任何想摆脱血税的人只有一个真正的选择。那就是维尔辛哈扎，更常被称为血腥剧场。

english: When I heard about the Theatre, I couldn't help but be impressed by the ingenuity of the vampyres. You see, it is the Theatre that holds the secret to their rule. Hope. The way it works is very simple. The vampyres will allow anyone living in Morytania to free both themselves and their families of all future blood tithes. All they must do in return is survive the challenges of the Theatre. Through this, hope is provided to all those living in Morytania, hope that they will one day be free of the vampyres.
translation: 当我听说剧场时，不禁对吸血鬼的巧思感到佩服。你看，正是剧场掌握着他们统治的秘密——希望。运作方式非常简单。吸血鬼允许莫利塔尼亚的任何居民为自己和家人免除未来所有的血税。他们只需在剧场的挑战中存活下来作为回报。通过这种方式，希望被给予所有生活在莫利塔尼亚的人——希望他们终有一天能摆脱吸血鬼。

english: This brings us back to Serafina. Like so many before her, Serafina turned to the Theatre, hoping that she could pass the trials contained within. However, unlike any that came before, she survived. She took on every challenge the Theatre had to offer and lived to tell the tale. Now at this point, you'd be forgiven for thinking that the vampyres just killed her anyway. Instead, they did something most unexpected. They kept their word. They freed both Serafina and her brother from the blood tithes and allowed them to leave Meiyerditch. Once again, it was a show of pure genius from the vampyres. By letting Serafina live, the hope of the Morytanian people only grew. And as their hope grew, their desires for rebellion dwindled.
translation: 这就回到了塞拉菲娜的故事。和许多前人一样，塞拉菲娜求助于剧场，希望能通过其中的试炼。然而，与之前任何人不同的是，她活了下来。她接受了剧场提供的每一项挑战，并活着讲述了这一切。此时，如果你以为吸血鬼还是杀了她，也情有可原。相反，他们做了最出人意料的事——他们信守了承诺。他们免除了塞拉菲娜和弟弟的血税，并允许他们离开迈尔迪奇。这再次展现了吸血鬼的绝顶聪明。让塞拉菲娜活着，莫利塔尼亚人民的希望只会增长。而随着希望的增强，他们反抗的欲望逐渐消退。

english: So that is the tale of Serafina, a young girl who freed herself from the reign of the vampyres and in doing so, provided hope to all of Morytania. The only question now is was it true? Did Serafina actually succeed in the Theatre? Did the vampyres let her win? Did she even exist at all? I suppose it's largely irrelevant now. It doesn't matter what really happened. What matters is what people believe.
translation: 这就是塞拉菲娜的故事——一个年轻女孩摆脱了吸血鬼的统治，并因此为整个莫利塔尼亚带来了希望。现在唯一的问题是：这是真的吗？塞拉菲娜真的在剧场中成功了吗？吸血鬼是故意让她赢的吗？她甚至存在过吗？我想现在这已经无关紧要了。真正发生了什么并不重要，重要的是人们相信什么。

english: For as long as people believe that Serafina freed herself, they will hope that they can do the same. And for as long as that hope survives, the vampyres will continue to rule Morytania.
translation: 只要人们相信塞拉菲娜解放了自己，他们就会希望自己也能做到同样的事。而只要这份希望存在，吸血鬼就将继续统治莫利塔尼亚。

english: Upgrade to a Jagex Account, if you haven't already done so.
translation: 如果还没升级，请升级到Jagex账户。

english: These use two-factor verification to keep people out of your account, even if they somehow learn your password.
translation: 这些使用双重验证来阻止他人进入你的账户，即使他们不知怎么知道了你的密码。

english: Ensure your email account is properly secure too, with its own two-factor verification.
translation: 确保你的邮箱账户也安全可靠，使用它自己的双重验证。

english: A good password should be easy for you to remember, but hard for anyone else to guess.
translation: 好的密码应该容易记住，但难以被他人猜到。

english: Choose a password containing both letters and numbers, but don't make it so hard that you'll forget it!
translation: 选择包含字母和数字的密码，但别设得太难以至于你自己都忘了！

english: Never write your password down or save it in a text file on your device, as someone could find it.
translation: 永远不要写下你的密码，或将其保存在设备上的文本文件中，因为有人可能会找到它。

english: Never give your password to anyone. This includes your friends, family and moderators in the game.
translation: 永远不要把你的密码给任何人，包括你的朋友、家人和游戏中的管理员。

english: Nor should you give anyone your account info on social media, even if they claim they can help you with RuneScape.
translation: 也不要在社交媒体上把你的账户信息给任何人，即使他们声称能帮你解决RuneScape的问题。

english: Set a Bank PIN to help protect your banked items, in case someone gets into your account.
translation: 设置银行PIN码以保护你存入银行的物品，以防有人进入你的账户。

english: To set a Bank PIN, speak to a banker and ask to check your PIN settings.
translation: 要设置银行PIN码，请与银行职员交谈并询问查看你的PIN码设置。

english: Never leave your account logged in while you're away from your device, as it only takes a few seconds to steal or ruin your account!
translation: 离开设备时绝不要保持账户登录状态，因为只需几秒钟就能盗取或毁掉你的账户！

english: The Stronghold of Security is located under the Barbarian Village in Misthalin, west of Varrock.
translation: 安全要塞位于米斯塔林野蛮人村庄地下，维洛克城以西。

english: It was discovered by accident, when a miner fell through the ground into a previously unexplored cave.
translation: 它是在一名矿工跌入地下一个此前未探索的洞穴时被偶然发现的。

english: The Stronghold contains many challenges, both for those who enjoy combat and for those who enjoy challenges of the mind.
translation: 要塞包含许多挑战，既适合喜欢战斗的人，也适合喜欢智力挑战的人。

english: This book's guidance may be useful to you as you delve into the Stronghold.
translation: 当你深入要塞时，这本书的指引可能会对你有所帮助。

english: You can find the Stronghold of Security by looking for a hole in the middle of the Barbarian Village.
translation: 你可以在野蛮人村庄中央找到一个洞，那就是安全要塞的入口。

english: Be sure to take your combat equipment though!
translation: 不过一定要带上你的战斗装备！

english: You adapt the visage to fit on a human head.
translation: 你将面甲改造成适合人类头部佩戴的形状。

english: To Captain Tebell of Shayzia,
translation: 致谢兹亚的特贝尔船长，

english: It is with a heavy heart that I must inform you of a great tragedy to befall our house. Lord Shayzien is dead. Murdered by a cowardly alliance between Lord Lovakengj and Lady Piscarilius. In all the chaos, the circumstances are still unclear. From what we do know, it seems that while all five of the leaders had agreed to the plan to depose the gluttonous King Agata IV, those two had an alternate idea on who would rule next. With our army being by far the largest in the kingdom, we were their first target.
translation: 我怀着沉重的心情告知你降临我们家族的一场巨大悲剧。谢兹恩领主遇害了。被洛瓦肯吉领主和皮斯卡里琉斯女士之间懦弱的联盟所谋杀。在混乱中，具体情况仍不清楚。据我们所知，似乎五位领袖都同意废黜贪婪的阿加塔四世国王的计划，但那两位对谁继位有着不同的想法。由于我们的军队是王国中规模最大的，我们成了他们的首要目标。

english: While we all wish to mourn for our beloved leader, we do not have that luxury. We must move immediately to protect the young Maria Shayzien, for she is now our new ruler. Therefore, your orders are to recall every soldier available to Shayzia and prepare for a siege. Enemy forces are already on the move, and she must be protected no matter the cost. Once the castle gates have closed, you must not open them for anyone. Even if Shayzien itself falls, the castle of Shayzia must stand.
translation: 虽然我们都想为敬爱的领袖哀悼，但我们没有这个奢侈。我们必须立即行动，保护年轻的玛丽亚·谢兹恩，因为她现在是我们新的统治者。因此，你的命令是召回所有可用的士兵到谢兹亚，准备应对围攻。敌军已经在行动，无论如何都必须保护她。一旦城堡大门关闭，你绝不能为任何人打开。即使谢兹恩城本身沦陷，谢兹亚城堡也必须坚守。

english: I'm afraid I have little intelligence to share regarding the foes you will soon be facing. From what we can tell, the Lovakengj army will be the first to arrive. One good piece of news is that they have already been weakened somewhat. The Lovakengj alliance with Lady Piscarilius was thankfully short lived, and there has been significant fighting between the two armies. The Piscarilius soldiers came off worse and have retreated to regroup. Meanwhile, Lady Hosidius has already rallied her forces as well, though it is unclear where her allegiances lie at this point. Finally, Lord Arceuus has returned to Arceuus and reinforced the city. It seems he has no desire to participate in this conflict, but I suspect he will soon be given no choice.
translation: 关于你即将面对的敌人，恐怕我没有什么情报可以分享。据我们所知，洛瓦肯吉军队将最先到达。一个好消息是他们已经被削弱了一些。洛瓦肯吉与皮斯卡里琉斯女士的联盟幸好是短暂的，两军之间发生了激烈的战斗。皮斯卡里琉斯士兵损失惨重，已撤退重新集结。与此同时，霍西迪乌斯女士也已集结了她的部队，但目前尚不清楚她的立场。最后，阿西乌斯领主已返回阿西乌斯并加强了城市防御。他似乎无意参与这场冲突，但我怀疑他很快就没有选择了。

english: There is one final matter that I urge you to attend to. While not public knowledge, I'm sure you are aware of Lord Shayzien's unorthodox beliefs. I ask that you attempt to preserve his religious materials if you can. That said, if it seems they are likely to fall into enemy hands, you must ensure that they are destroyed.
translation: 还有最后一件我敦促你处理的事情。虽然不是公开的信息，但我相信你知道谢兹恩领主非正统的信仰。我请求你尽可能保存他的宗教材料。但如果它们有可能落入敌人手中，你必须确保它们被销毁。

english: To you and everyone else at Shayzia, I pray for good fortune. You are our last hope now. Good luck.
translation: 向你以及谢兹亚的所有人，我祈祷好运。你现在是我们最后的希望了。祝你好运。
