english: We have worked for days. It is a weary and tiring journey that my brothers and I must take, but we are close to success! Elder Dag'eth has led us well and he has told us that Zamorak will reward us greatly for our service to Him. The priests of Saradomin haunt our very steps and I fear our discovery. Yet, soon will be the hour of our glory. The Dagon'hai will prevail and the city will be ours! We will throw down the vile yoke of Saradomin and the Dagon'hai will be victorious!
translation: 我们工作了数日。我和兄弟们必须走的这段旅程疲惫不堪，但我们离成功不远了！长者达格'斯带领我们很好，他告诉我们扎莫拉克会为我们的服务给予丰厚奖赏。萨拉多明的祭司们步步紧逼，我担心我们会暴露。然而，我们荣耀的时刻即将到来。达贡'海将获胜，这座城市将是我们的！我们将推翻萨拉多明那邪恶的枷锁，达贡'海将取得胜利！

english: Today we donned the filthy robes of the Saradomin priests. It was a foul deed and distasteful to my very soul, yet it had to be done. Without the disguise, we would surely have been found out and ruined. We erected a statue of Saradomin himself just outside the city to the east. Our Lord Zamorak must be laughing in the faces of our enemies at such a deception, for this statue holds the key to our success. Beneath the arrogant caricature of this worthless deity lies the entrance to our most sacred work yet: the Tunnel of Chaos. With this tunnel, we are able to traverse to the very source of our power, the Chaos Temple itself. Those foolish followers of Saradomin do not even sense what we have achieved. They have filled the statue with their accursed holy magic, covering even the merest traces of our work beneath. They have granted us the most perfect of disguises. Zamorak be praised!
translation: 今天我们穿上了萨拉多明祭司那肮脏的袍子。这是件卑劣的行为，令我的灵魂厌恶，但必须这么做。没有伪装，我们肯定会被发现并毁掉。我们在城东郊外竖立了一座萨拉多明本人的雕像。我们的主扎莫拉克一定在嘲笑我们敌人的愚蠢，因为这座雕像掌握着我们成功的关键。在这位无价值神祇的傲慢讽刺像之下，隐藏着我们迄今最神圣工程的入口：混沌隧道。通过这条隧道，我们能直达我们力量的源泉——混沌神殿本身。那些愚蠢的萨拉多明信徒甚至没有察觉我们做了什么。他们用那可憎的圣魔法注满了雕像，甚至掩盖了我们作品的最细微痕迹。他们给了我们最完美的伪装。赞美扎莫拉克！

english: Excellent news! I have been chosen by Elder Dag'eth to be the next Hyeraph. I, Sin'keth Magis, will lead our people in the incantation of Zamorak's Will. Surely this means I will become High Elder! I must prove worthy to Lord Zamorak. He will not find me wanting. There is much to do in preparation for the ceremony and I do not have long.
translation: 好消息！我被长者达格'斯选为下一任海拉夫。我，辛'凯斯·马吉斯，将带领我们的人民吟诵扎莫拉克的意志咒语。这肯定意味着我将成为大长老！我必须向扎莫拉克大人证明我的价值。他不会发现我有所欠缺。为仪式做准备还有很多事要做，而我的时间不多了。

english: Disaster! The incantation of Zamorak's Will was discovered by a loathsome watchman, of all people. Zamorak's Blood! The fates are cruel! We could not finish the final rites of the spell. Our work has been undone and we have no time to gather our forces together and hide. We are being followed by the guards and the Priests of Filth are at our heels. We must flee the city! Elder La'nou and Elder Kree'nag were slain whilst protecting the sanctum. Elder Dag'eth will not leave with us. Zamorak take him, he will stand against the hordes that follow us! I am the last of the Elders. The order looks to me now.
translation: 灾难！扎莫拉克意志的咒语竟被一个可恶的看守发现了。扎莫拉克之血！命运何其残酷！我们未能完成法术的最后仪式。我们的努力付诸东流，已无时间集结力量躲藏。守卫正在追捕我们，污秽祭司紧追不舍。我们必须逃离这座城市！拉诺长老和克里纳格长老在保护圣所时牺牲了。达格斯长老不愿与我们同行。扎莫拉克带走他吧，他将独自对抗追来的大军！我是最后一位长老。教团现在指望我了。

english: Today, the last of our order entered the Tunnel of Chaos. We will journey to the Chaos Temple and let Zamorak Himself decide our fate. What happened to Elder Dag'eth, I know not. As the city guards closed upon us, I cast an Earth Bolt spell to collapse the entrance of the tunnel in an avalanche of earth and stone, saving us and dooming us in one breath. There is only one place for us to go now...
translation: 今天，我们教团的最后成员进入了混沌隧道。我们将前往混沌神殿，让扎莫拉克亲自决定我们的命运。达格斯长老遭遇了什么，我不得而知。当城市守卫逼近时，我施放了土之箭法术，用土石雪崩般的力量封住了隧道入口，一瞬间既拯救了我们，也注定了我们的命运。现在我们只有一个去处……

english: You escort Ivan through the swamp...
translation: 你护送伊万穿过沼泽……

english: Not really. It is the vampyre way. There was once a time when things were far more savage. We once lived in a land far more hostile than this one.
translation: 并非如此。这就是吸血鬼的方式。曾经有一段时间，事情要野蛮得多。我们曾生活在一片比这里更恶劣的土地上。

english: There, new clan leaders were selected during a festival known as the Night of the Blood Moon. It was a simple concept. A full night of killing. At dawn, the one with the most kills became the new leader.
translation: 那时，新氏族首领是在一个名为'血月之夜'的节日中选出的。概念很简单。一整夜的杀戮。黎明时分，杀戮最多的人成为新首领。

english: Lowerniel loved it. He won every time of course. Personally, I prefer our new way of life.
translation: 洛尼尔喜欢这个。当然，他每次都赢。就我个人而言，我更喜欢我们新的生活方式。

english: Did you not know? [player name] here isn't just responsible for killing Ranis. They also killed our younger brother, Draynor.
translation: 你不知道吗？这里的[player name]不仅杀了拉尼斯。他们还杀了我们的弟弟德雷纳。

english: But how do they get into the city? The place is a fortress.
translation: 但他们怎么进城？那地方可是座堡垒。

english: Attacking the vampyres will blow your cover.
translation: 攻击吸血鬼会暴露你的身份。

english: I managed to make a blisterwood flail.
translation: 我设法制作了一把水泡木连枷。

english: Argh! I can't stop dancing!
translation: 啊！我停不下来跳舞！

english: Argh! I can't stop headbanging!
translation: 啊！我停不下来甩头！

english: Argh! I can't stop jumping!
translation: 啊！我停不下来跳！

english: Hmm? What's that, young one? What can I do for you?
translation: 嗯？什么事，年轻人？有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: First things first, young one! There is not much point in having a family crest if you cannot display it. You should train construction until you can build a wall decoration in your dining room.
translation: 先做最重要的事，年轻人！如果无法展示家徽，那拥有它也没什么意义。你应该训练建筑技能，直到能在餐厅里建造一个墙壁装饰。

english: BEWARE OF THE MUDSKIPPERS!
translation: 小心跳跳鱼！

english: Thordur's visitor count: <Num0>
translation: 托杜尔的访客数：<Num0>

english: To continue your trek click the pathway to the north. To end your trek click the pathway to the south.
translation: 要继续你的旅程，请点击北边的路径。要结束旅程，请点击南边的路径。

english: Brother Rakkar found this old empty diary on board, I'll fill it with entries of our travels for you to read upon my arrival!
translation: 拉卡尔兄弟在船上发现了这本旧空日记，我会记录下我们的旅程，等你读到我的到来！

english: The storms have been rougher than the seers foretold, we've had to take shelter on Lunar Isle and the Moonclan are not impressed. They say of our voyage west will find nothing but a watery grave, their Kosmos be damned!
translation: 风暴比预言者预言的还要猛烈，我们不得不在月亮岛避难，月族对此很不满。他们说我们西行之旅只会找到水墓，他们的科斯莫斯见鬼去吧！

english: We've been sailing for weeks now my love and the crew has become weary, supplies run low and Jaldur has no explanation for the lack of fish in these strange waters. Land is on the horizon, hope is not lost.
translation: 我们已经航行了数周，亲爱的，船员们已经疲惫不堪，补给不足，贾尔杜尔无法解释这片陌生水域为何没有鱼。陆地就在地平线上，希望尚存。

english: Great news! We've discovered a fishing hamlet in the cold tundra on the coast of this new continent. The locals are quiet... but friendly enough, they've allowed us hospitality providing we help out catching fish.
translation: 好消息！我们在这片新大陆海岸的寒冷冻原上发现了一个渔村。当地人很安静……但也够友好，只要我们帮忙捕鱼，他们就愿意招待我们。

english: The fish in the waters here are magnificent! We'll have to bring some back for all of you to try, along with the ale! I'm not sure how they're making it but it's strong and makes for great merriment! Jardor found a large snakestone in the recent catch, the locals seem weary of it and demand we take it with us when we leave.
translation: 这里水域的鱼太棒了！我们一定要带些回去给你们尝尝，还有麦酒！我不确定他们是怎么酿的，但酒劲很大，让人十分欢乐！贾尔多在最近的渔获中发现了一块大蛇石，当地人似乎对它很忌惮，要求我们离开时带走它。

english: It's been awhile since my last entry, I apologize my dear, but things have taken a turn for the worst. We still remain at the fishing hamlet for brother Barrak and Jardor have a sickness, they mutter words to the snakestone, they claim it whispers back...
translation: 距离上次记录已经有一段时间了，我亲爱的，请原谅，但事情已经恶化。我们仍留在渔村，因为巴拉卡兄弟和贾尔杜尔病了，他们对蛇石喃喃自语，声称它在低语回应……

english: Jardor has turned to drinking the ocean, he says it'll bring him closer to the gods... for who he's referring to I do not know. The snakestone lies.
translation: 贾尔杜尔开始喝海水了，他说这会让他更接近神灵……他指的是谁我不知道。蛇石在撒谎。

english: The villagers are gone, something took them in the night, trails lead to an ominous crevasse... I must convince the others that we must flee now, before it's too late.
translation: 村民们不见了，夜里有什么东西带走了他们，踪迹通向一个不祥的裂缝……我必须说服其他人，我们必须现在就逃，趁还来得及。

english: It spoke to me, I'm going to stay now.
translation: 它跟我说话了，我现在要留下来。

english: Rakkar tried to throw the snakestone back into the ocean, Jardor and Barrak made an example of him, he'll be troubling us no more.
translation: 拉卡尔想把蛇石扔回海里，贾多尔和巴拉克拿他杀鸡儆猴，他再也不会来烦我们了。

english: Praise him. Praise him. Praise him.
translation: 赞美他。赞美他。赞美他。

english: Praise him.
translation: 赞美他。

english: Tonight we ascend.
translation: 今晚我们升天。

english: I'll be waiting at the Champions' Guild to collect your bones.
translation: 我会在冠军公会等你来收骨头。

english: Champion of Skeletons
translation: 骷髅冠军

english: Look at her go!
translation: 看她跑的！

english: Look at him go!
translation: 看他跑的！

english: For the attention of all centurions:
translation: 致所有百夫长：

english: Prepare your soldiers for battle, for we set sail at dawn. The target is a Saradominist temple near Hallowvale. The temple has been built underwater, but the Praefectus Classis has devised a plan to move our forces inside. She has acquired the means to teleport large numbers of individuals directly into the temple. While the fleet controls the waters above, your soldiers will be tasked with clearing the temple of all resistance. It is expected that Saradominist resistance will be incredibly high, so prepare accordingly.
translation: 让你们的士兵做好战斗准备，我们黎明启航。目标是哈洛维尔附近的一座萨拉多明教神庙。神庙建在水下，但舰队统领已制定计划将我们的部队送入内部。她已获得将大量人员直接传送进神庙的方法。当舰队控制上方水域时，你们的士兵将负责清除神庙内的一切抵抗。预计萨拉多明教的抵抗会极其激烈，请做好相应准备。

english: The Praefectus Classis has become aware of concerns amongst the soldiers. As we are on final approach, ensure you take the time to make it clear to your legionaries that these concerns have no validity. Our force has been kept light intentionally to ensure we can surprise the Saradominist forces. However, using the same teleportation method she'll use to give us access to the temple, the Praefectus Classis also has the ability to call in any reinforcements we need. Have faith, for our work will ensure the Empire will never fall.
translation: 舰队统领已得知士兵中的担忧。我们已进入最后阶段，请务必向你们的军团士兵明确这些担忧毫无根据。我们刻意保持兵力精简以确保能出其不意地打击萨拉多明教势力。然而，通过她用来让我们进入神庙的同一传送方法，舰队统领也有能力调来我们需要的任何增援。要有信心，因为我们的功绩将确保帝国永不倒下。

english: Many of you will never see this, but for those that do, these are your final orders. The battle is lost and we must withdraw. The attempt to call in reinforcements failed, and the temple has been ripped asunder by a rift of unknown power. The rift is growing rapidly and has already claimed much of the fleet. The Praefectus Classis is lost. Retreat is the only option. For those of you that fall, may your sacrifice be forever remembered in the annals of the Eternal Empire.
translation: 你们中许多人永远不会看到这些，但对于看到的人，这是你们的最后命令。战斗已败，我们必须撤退。增援呼叫失败，神庙已被一道未知力量的裂隙撕碎。裂隙正在迅速扩大，已吞噬了舰队的大部分。舰队统领已阵亡。撤退是唯一的选择。对于倒下的你们，愿你们的牺牲永远铭记在永恒帝国的史册中。

english: I am making progress with the tunnels, although I hadn't appreciated what hard work it would be. As I'm going to be down here a little while, I have created some living quarters of sorts. I only wish I had some of that papyrus they've invented. Chiselling is so laborious.
translation: 隧道工程进展顺利，虽然我没料到会这么辛苦。既然要在这里待一阵子，我弄了些简陋的住处。真希望有他们发明的那种莎草纸。凿刻太费劲了。

english: I infect your body with rot...
translation: 我用腐烂感染你的身体……

english: I'll show Haris! 'Unworthy' my boot. I'll be swimming in gold and glory when I return with the treasures of the western lands. I heard one of those adventuring lot talk of big-eared lilly-livers, who live behind walls made of diamond. Whatever they're hiding, it's gonna be mine, and if they put up a fight, then they're definitively in for a good hiding. HAH!
translation: 我要让哈里斯看看！'不配'个屁。等我带着西方之地的财宝回来，我就要在黄金和荣耀里游泳了。我听说那些冒险者里有人说起大耳朵的莉莉肝人，住在钻石做的墙后面。不管他们藏着什么，都会是我的，要是他们敢反抗，那就等着挨一顿好揍。哈！

english: Sold the last bit of flax today. No more itchy fields for Blunderguts! Blunderguts is my new pirate name. After all, I'm gonna be a captain of the high seas soon. Maybe I should buy an eye patch, look the part and all that. No one would dare mess with the mighty captain Blunderguts!
translation: 今天卖掉了最后一批亚麻。布伦德古茨再也不用去痒人的田里干活了！布伦德古茨是我的新海盗名。毕竟我很快就要成为公海船长了。也许我该买个眼罩，看起来像那么回事。没人敢惹强大的布伦德古茨船长！

english: Purchased my first vessel from a chap offering a good price, considering the damage. Smells a bit like toast though. He said he swindled it off of one of them lofty hero types. I set sail from Port Sarim tomorrow. Ahoy thar and onwards!
translation: 从一个出价不错的小子那里买了我的第一艘船，考虑到损坏程度。不过闻起来有点烤面包味。他说是从一个高高在上的英雄类型的人那里骗来的。我明天从沙林港启航。哟嚯，前进！

english: Maybe I should've brought a sextant... How do I find west again? Never eat Toroth slippers... How does it go? Never watch skeletons eat? All this pirating is making me hungry. I've got plenty in the store. Besides, I'm the Captain. So if I want to stop at some tavern along the way I shall... I will hear no more about it.
translation: 也许我该带个六分仪……西边怎么走来着？永远别吃托罗斯拖鞋……怎么说的来着？永远别看骷髅吃东西？这海盗当得我都饿了。船上存货多的是。再说了，我是船长。所以我想在路上停个酒馆就停……我不想再听任何反对意见。

english: So I just stopped at this dock, seemed great at first. But no tavern. Some local's directions led me to a giant swamp. Oh Saradomin, the stench of the place, 'Be brave Blunderguts. 'tis what piratin' be all about, forgin' yer own adventure from scratch.' I thought. The locals were friendly enough, 'Come visit our god, you will never starve again' they said. They only tried to feed me to a bloomin' snake! Luckily I must not have looked appetising, bein' so skinny 'n all. With my quick thinking, jumping back into the lady's boat, I made a tactical retreat.
translation: 我就在这个码头停了船，一开始看起来不错。但没有酒馆。一个当地人的指示把我带到了一个巨大的沼泽。哦萨拉多明，那地方的臭味，'勇敢点布伦德古茨。这才是海盗该干的事，从零开始打造自己的冒险。'我心想。当地人倒是挺友好，'来拜访我们的神吧，你再也不会挨饿了'他们说。结果他们想把我喂给一条大蛇！幸好我看起来不太可口，毕竟这么瘦。我急中生智跳回那女士的船上，战术性撤退了。

english: Back to the sea I go. Ahoy thar and onwards!
translation: 回到海上去。哟嚯，前进！

english: I saw it. With me unpatched eye, I swear. The walls were mightier than the palace of Varrock. The light caught the tides and it burst into a thousand different colours. But soon as I went to drop anchor, the arrows came. These arrows came at me so fast and so hard I could've swore they was glowin'! I had no choice but to tactically retreat.
translation: 我看到了。用我没戴眼罩的那只眼，我发誓。那城墙比维洛克城的宫殿还要雄伟。光线照在潮水上，迸发出千种色彩。但正当我要抛锚时，箭来了。那些箭来得又快又猛，我发誓它们在发光！我别无选择，只能战术性撤退。

english: Please. If you find this journal, send help. I couldn't save the ship and I'm stranded. All of the people here ignore every word I speak, they're like zombies. Zombies that kill crabs all day long. You can't even eat the crabs, they're almost entirely made of sand!
translation: 求你了。如果你找到这本日记，请派人来救我。我救不了船，被困在这里了。这里的人完全无视我说的每一个字，他们就像僵尸。整天杀螃蟹的僵尸。而且那些螃蟹根本不能吃，几乎全是沙子做的！

english: Ahoy thar, please save me!
translation: 哟嚯，救命啊！

english: If a culture does not respect its past, it deserves no future.
translation: 一个文化若不尊重自己的过去，就不配拥有未来。

english: In Kourend, every generation owes a debt of gratitude and honour to the previous generations, recognising their toil and blood that raised our kingdom from its humble origins to its present glories.
translation: 在库兰德王国，每一代人都欠前一代人一份感恩和敬意，铭记他们的辛劳和鲜血，将我们的王国从卑微的起源抬升到今日的辉煌。

english: It has therefore been my privilege to study the soul altar, that mystical beacon that gathers the souls of the departed, guiding them into the River.
translation: 因此，研究灵魂祭坛是我的荣幸，那座神秘的信标聚集逝者的灵魂，引导它们进入河流。

english: My study is no mere academic interest; I embark on it as a mark of respect and honour for the deceased generations whose souls now flow in the River.
translation: 我的研究绝非单纯的学术兴趣；我以此作为对逝去世代的一份敬意和尊重，他们的灵魂如今在河流中流淌。

english: As the mortals of Kourend reach their death, their souls abandon the flesh-temples they inhabited, leaving the flesh to suffer corruption and decay.
translation: 当库兰德的凡人迎来死亡，他们的灵魂离开所居的肉身之殿，任由肉身遭受腐蚀与腐朽。

english: The soul, however, does not decay. Released from the fetters of its flesh-temple, and from the constraints of the material world, the soul is at last free.
translation: 然而灵魂不会腐朽。摆脱肉身之殿的束缚，摆脱物质世界的限制，灵魂终于自由了。

english: Mercifully, the soul is not left to wander aimlessly through the world. Instead, the soul altar calls it, reaching across the land to all the wandering souls of Kourend, drawing them to the River.
translation: 幸运的是，灵魂不会在世间漫无目的地游荡。相反，灵魂祭坛召唤它，跨越大地触及库兰德所有游荡的灵魂，将它们引向河流。

english: The River leads the souls through unchartable realms, transcending the plane of the world.
translation: 河流引领灵魂穿越不可测绘的领域，超越世界的位面。

english: Yet they are not abandoned to the forces that might prey on them - the three-headed Guardian is there as a protector, keeping them safe as the River flows beyond all knowledge.
translation: 但它们并未被遗弃给可能捕食它们的力量——三头守护者在那里作为保护者，在河流流向超越一切认知之处时守护它们的安全。

english: Many years ago, before the Ascent of Arceuus, I was a young assistant to the Elders. A day came when there was terrible turmoil down the River. A human adventurer had breached the Guardian's cave; this broke the bonds of the Guardian, and she sought to escape from her solemn duty of protecting the souls. The Elders acted fast to restore the Guardian to her post.
translation: 许多年前，在阿西乌斯城崛起之前，我是长老们的一名年轻助理。有一天，河流下游发生了可怕的动荡。一名人类冒险者闯入了守护者的洞穴；这打破了守护者的束缚，她试图逃离保护灵魂的神圣职责。长老们迅速行动，将守护者恢复原位。

english: There was, at that time, a herbalist whose mind and body were known to be in a manipulable state due to his foolish experiments. Seizing him while he was helpless in his potion-induced trance, the Elders cast spells of torment upon him; in order to relieve the torment, he agreed to become our Key Master, bound to watch the Guardian's cave to ensure the Guardian does not break loose again.
translation: 当时有一位草药师，因愚蠢的实验而身心处于可操控状态。长老们趁他在药水引发的恍惚中无助时抓住了他，对他施以折磨咒语；为了解除折磨，他同意成为我们的钥匙守护者，被束缚在守护者的洞穴旁看守，确保守护者不再挣脱。

english: He has served well over the years. It was cruel of the Elders to subject him to such a fate, but the need was desperate.
translation: 这些年来他一直尽职尽责。长老们让他承受这样的命运确实残忍，但当时形势紧迫。

english: The soul altar is therefore a blessing to the people of Kourend, bringing their souls to the safety of the River. We cannot know the fate of souls in distant lands beyond the reach of our soul altar, but the destiny provided by our soul altar is a sure comfort to us here.
translation: 因此，灵魂祭坛是库兰德人民的福泽，将他们的灵魂带到河流的安全之中。我们无法知晓灵魂祭坛触及范围之外遥远土地上灵魂的命运，但我们的灵魂祭坛所提供的归宿，是我们这里确定的慰藉。

english: We therefore owe a debt of gratitude to the Dark Altar, for it is the Dark Altar's power that creates and maintains Kourend's soul altar, drawing energy to this realm from the unknown plane where the true Soul Altar resides.
translation: 因此我们欠黑暗祭坛一份感激之情，因为正是黑暗祭坛的力量创造并维持着库兰德的灵魂祭坛，从真正灵魂祭坛所在的未知位面汲取能量到这个世界。

english: Without the Dark Altar's influence, there would be no soul altar here, and the souls of our forebears would be abandoned to an unknown fate.
translation: 没有黑暗祭坛的影响，这里就不会有灵魂祭坛，我们先辈的灵魂将被遗弃于未知的命运。

english: It is not known why the Dark Altar has created our soul altar or blood altar; cynical minds have speculated that its motives may not be benevolent, but I call shame on such suspicious murmurings - the soul altar enables our kingdom's departed souls to have the comforting certainty of the River; it is clearly a great blessing and a fitting reward for those who have served the kingdom in their mortal lives.
translation: 黑暗祭坛为何会创造我们的灵魂祭坛或鲜血祭坛，原因尚不明确；愤世嫉俗者猜测其动机可能并非善意，但我对这种猜疑之语感到羞耻——灵魂祭坛让我们王国逝者的灵魂得以安心地走向河流；这显然是巨大的恩赐，也是对那些在有生之年为国效力者的恰当回报。

english: The soul does not always succeed in freeing itself from its flesh-temple at the time of death. Many warriors have found, to their horror, that the soul of their foe remains trapped in the corpse.
translation: 灵魂并非总能在死亡时成功脱离肉体的殿堂。许多战士惊恐地发现，敌人的灵魂仍被困在尸体之中。

english: Ensouled heads are a sign of a soul in torment; it is therefore our duty to free such souls from their prison with all due speed.
translation: 附魂头颅是灵魂受折磨的标志；因此我们有责任尽快将这些灵魂从牢笼中解放出来。

english: The magic of the Dark Altar enables the ensouled head to re-form itself a rudimentary body; this may be slain in order to grant liberty to the soul at last.
translation: 黑暗祭坛的魔法能让附魂头颅重塑一个简陋的身体；将其击杀即可最终赋予灵魂自由。

english: I have written of the time when a human adventurer breached the Guardian's cave.
translation: 我曾记述过一位人类冒险者闯入守护者洞穴的事迹。

english: While in there, the human attempted to steal an artefact from the cave. This disruption to the River caused the loosening of the Guardian's bonds, allowing her to attempt to escape from her duty. Naturally she slew the foolish adventurer, who deserved no better.
translation: 在那里，那人试图从洞穴中偷走一件文物。这一对河流的扰乱导致守护者的束缚松动，使她得以试图逃脱职责。她自然杀死了那个愚蠢的冒险者，他死不足惜。

english: After the Elders had restored balance to the River and appointed the Key Master to watch over the Guardian in future, they came across the artefact among the items and bones dropped by the adventurer.
translation: 长老们恢复河流平衡并任命钥匙守护者日后看管守护者之后，在冒险者掉落的物品和骨头中发现了那件文物。

english: The origin of the artefact is unclear, but it is believed to draw a soul from one place to another, enabling the soul to travel with the River across the dimensions. Thus it was named the Soul Bearer. Mercifully the River still flows in its established path without further aid from the artefact.
translation: 文物的起源不明，但据信它能将灵魂从一个地方引到另一个地方，使灵魂能随河流穿越各个维度。因此它被命名为灵魂载体。所幸河流仍沿既定路径流淌，无需文物的进一步帮助。

english: However, in the death of the adventurer the artefact had become damaged, so they brought it back to Kourend in the hope that someone among the Elders could repair it. Sadly, even the most learned Elders could not repair the artefact, and eventually it was buried with all due ceremony and reverence, protected by spells to ensure no future explorer would find it by chance.
translation: 然而，在冒险者死亡时文物已受损，于是他们将其带回库兰德王国，希望长老中有人能修复它。遗憾的是，即使是最博学的长老也无法修复这件文物，最终它被以应有的仪式和敬意埋葬，并施以咒语保护，确保未来不会有探险者偶然发现它。

english: If the artefact could ever be repaired, it would regain its powers to draw a soul from one place to another. Indeed, I believe it could do this to an ensouled head, exerting its power on the soul contained within the head.
translation: 如果这件文物能被修复，它将重获将灵魂从一个地方引到另一个地方的力量。事实上，我相信它能对附魂头颅施展此力，作用于头颅内所含的灵魂。

english: However, following the Ascent of Arceuus, this ability would be of no practical benefit to us.
translation: 然而，随着阿西乌斯城崛起，这一能力对我们已无实际益处。

english: Snowflake converts your item to a banknote.
translation: 雪花将你的物品转换为票据。

english: Snowflake converts your item to banknotes.
translation: 雪花将你的物品转换为票据。

english: Snowflake converts your items to a banknote.
translation: 雪花将你的物品转换为票据。

english: Snowflake converts your items to banknotes.
translation: 雪花将你的物品转换为票据。

english: I... Err... Tim?
I... Err... Sue?
I... Err... Sam?
Yes... Tim...
translation: 是的...蒂姆...

english: Yes... Sue...
Yes... Sam...
translation: 是的...山姆...

english: You don't look much like a Sam.
translation: 你看起来不太像山姆。

english: What are you doing here... Sam?
translation: 你在这里做什么...山姆？

english: Hmm... Very well. As you were... Sam...
translation: 嗯...好吧。继续你的事吧...山姆...

english: Good to see you Sam.
translation: 很高兴见到你，山姆。

english: Who's Sam?
translation: 谁是山姆？

english: Ah yes, I am Sam.
translation: 啊对，我就是山姆。

english: Hmm... Is your head working okay today Sam?
translation: 嗯...你的脑子今天还好使吗，山姆？

english: Well prepare to die Sam!
translation: 那就准备受死吧，山姆！

english: She acted like I was a monster! Come... look upon her monster!
translation: 她把我当成怪物！来...看看她的怪物！

english: She left me, like I wasn't real! But I know what's real, do you?
translation: 她抛弃了我，好像我不是真实存在！但我知道什么是真实的，你知道吗？

english: Did she think I would rot here? I am eternal, unlike you!
translation: 她以为我会在这里腐烂吗？我是永恒的，不像你！

english: She feared my power, and she was right to! Let me show you...
translation: 她害怕我的力量，她怕得对！让我展示给你看...

english: Look at me! Look at what she made me! Do you see?
translation: 看着我！看看她把我变成了什么！你看到了吗？

english: She treated me like I was less than her, but I'm so much more!
translation: 她待我如蝼蚁，但我远胜于她！

english: I won't let her destroy me! She doesn't get to decide that!
translation: 我不会让她毁了我！她没资格决定这个！

english: This power, she gave it to me! It's her power too! Feel it!
translation: 这力量，是她给我的！这也是她的力量！感受它！

english: I just wanted her to love me, but she wouldn't even look at me!
translation: 我只是想让她爱我，但她连看都不看我一眼！

english: She tried to forget me, but everywhere she looked she saw me!
translation: 她想忘了我，但她目光所及之处都是我！

english: I have more power than she ever did! I will survive!
translation: 我的力量比她曾拥有的更强大！我会活下去！

english: Do you know pain? I do! She made sure of that! I'll show you...
translation: 你知道痛苦吗？我知道！她让我尝尽了苦头！我会让你也尝尝的……

english: Come! Come look upon her work, and despair!
translation: 来！来看看她的杰作，然后绝望吧！

english: Do you think she cares? Maybe reality isn't what you think...
translation: 你觉得她在乎吗？也许现实并非你所想的那样……

english: I am infinite! As hard as she tries, I can't be destroyed!
translation: 我是无限的！不管她怎么努力，我都无法被摧毁！

english: The pain she caused me, let me give you a taste of it!
translation: 她带给我的痛苦，让我也让你尝尝！

english: Are you afraid? Too scared to even look at me?
translation: 你害怕了吗？怕到不敢看我？

english: I'm better than her! I'm greater than her! That's what she hated!
translation: 我比她强！我比她伟大！这就是她恨我的原因！

english: The things I've endured, do you think you could endure them?
translation: 我所承受的一切，你觉得你能承受吗？

english: She didn't love me! She feared the strength of her own creation!
translation: 她不爱我！她害怕自己造物的力量！

english: Cutlasses! Think yer a pirate now kid?
translation: 弯刀！小子，你以为自己是海盗了？

english: Smart kid! Come and see me when ye have the coins fer it.
translation: 聪明的小子！等你有金币了再来找我吧。

english: That weren't the worst of it kid. He survived the fight, and the ship's surgeon was trying to get the arrow out when...
translation: 那还不是最糟的，小子。他活过了那场战斗，船上的外科医生正要把箭取出来的时候……

english: No kid!
translation: 不，小子！

english: Soul Wars is an intense game, where two teams fight to defeat each other's avatar.
translation: 灵魂战争是一场激烈的游戏，两队互相战斗以击败对方的化身。

english: This guide will cover what is needed to be victorious in the game.
translation: 本指南将涵盖在游戏中获胜所需的一切。

english: Section 1: Getting Started
translation: 第一部分：开始

english: Section 2: Avatars
translation: 第二部分：化身

english: Section 3: The Soul Obelisk
translation: 第三部分：灵魂方尖碑

english: Section 4: Graveyards
translation: 第四部分：墓地

english: Section 5: Supplies
translation: 第五部分：补给品

english: Section 6: Rewards
translation: 第六部分：奖励

english: To join a game of Soul Wars, simply use the western waiting area in the lobby area of the island.
translation: 要加入灵魂战争游戏，只需使用岛屿大厅区域的西侧等候区。

english: Once the game begins, you'll be assigned a team and you'll start in your team base's graveyard. This can never be lost to the enemy, and you will respawn here on death if you do not own any other graveyards.
translation: 游戏开始后，你将被分配到一个队伍，并从队伍基地的墓地开始。这个墓地永远不会被敌人占领，如果你没有其他墓地，死亡后你会在这里重生。

english: Within your team's base, you will find your avatar and a supply area.
translation: 在队伍基地内，你会找到你的化身和补给区。

english: From your supply area, you can collect bandages, barricades, explosive potions and potions of power. Bandages and potions of power can also be collected from within your base's graveyard. For more information on these supplies, see Section 5.
translation: 从补给区，你可以收集绷带、路障、爆炸药水和力量药水。绷带和力量药水也可以从基地墓地内收集。关于这些补给品的更多信息，请参见第五部分。

english: Avatars are essential to victory - the team with the most avatar kills at the end of the game will be declared the winner.
translation: 化身对胜利至关重要——游戏结束时击杀化身最多的队伍将被宣布为胜者。

english: While your avatar is very powerful and can defend itself, it can still be overrun by attackers. So you should protect it. If you are not working to defend the avatar, you should push forward, weaken the enemy avatar and attempt to destroy it.
translation: 虽然你的化身非常强大，可以自卫，但仍可能被攻击者压倒。所以你应该保护它。如果你不是在防守化身，就应该向前推进，削弱敌方化身并尝试摧毁它。

english: Avatars have the ability to reduce the damage they take. However, this ability's strength can be weakened. For more information on weakening them, see Section 3.
translation: 化身有能力减少受到的伤害。然而，这种能力的力量可以被削弱。关于削弱它们的更多信息，请参见第三部分。

english: A weakened avatar's strength can be restored. For more information on this, see Section 4.
translation: 被削弱的化身的力量可以恢复。关于这方面的更多信息，请参见第四部分。

english: At the heart of the island you'll find the Soul Obelisk. Your team can capture this by having more participants near it than the opposing team.
translation: 在岛屿的中心，你会找到灵魂方尖碑。你的队伍可以通过在它附近拥有比对方队伍更多的参与者来占领它。

english: The Soul Obelisk can be used to weaken the opposing team's avatar. To do so, you can sacrifice soul fragments to it.
translation: 灵魂方尖碑可以用来削弱对方队伍的化身。要做到这一点，你可以向它献祭灵魂碎片。

english: Soul fragments can be obtained by killing creatures found on the island. Alternatively, if an opposing team member has some soul fragments, you can kill them and claim their fragments.
translation: 灵魂碎片可以通过杀死岛上发现的生物获得。或者，如果对方队伍成员有一些灵魂碎片，你可以杀死他们并夺取他们的碎片。

english: When sacrificing soul fragments to the Obelisk, sacrifices by the team controlling the Obelisk will weaken an avatar more than those by the team that does not.
translation: 向方尖碑献祭灵魂碎片时，控制方尖碑的队伍献祭比未控制方尖碑的队伍献祭更能削弱化身。

english: Along with the base graveyards, there are two capturable graveyards on the island. These can be captured by having more participants near it than the opposing team. But remember - you can never capture the opposing team's base graveyard.
translation: 除了基地墓地外，岛上还有两个可占领的墓地。这些可以通过在附近拥有比对方队伍更多的参与者来占领。但请记住——你永远无法占领对方队伍的基地墓地。

english: If captured by your team, the graveyards can be used as additional respawn points upon death. If your team owns multiple graveyards, you'll respawn in the one closest to where you died.
translation: 如果被你的队伍占领，这些墓地可以作为额外的重生点。如果你的队伍拥有多个墓地，你将在离你死亡地点最近的那个重生。

english: Graveyards can be used to restore the strength of your avatar. To do so, just bury some bones within them.
translation: 墓地可以用来恢复你化身的力量。要做到这一点，只需在里面埋葬一些骨头。

english: Bones can be obtained by killing creatures found on the island, or by killing opposing team members.
translation: 骨头可以通过杀死岛上发现的生物或杀死对方队伍成员获得。

english: Bones buried by the team controlling the graveyard will restore an avatar's strength more than those buried by the team that does not.
translation: 控制墓地的队伍埋葬骨头比未控制墓地的队伍埋葬骨头更能恢复化身的力量。

english: As mentioned in Section 1, you can collect bandages, barricades, explosive potions and potions of power from your team base.
translation: 如第一部分所述，你可以从队伍基地收集绷带、路障、爆炸药水和力量药水。

english: When used, bandages will heal some of your health, cure any poison and restore your run energy.
translation: 使用时，绷带会恢复部分生命值，治愈任何毒药并恢复你的跑步能量。

english: Barricades can be used to block enemies from an area. Your team is limited to ten barricades, and you can only take one at a time - so use them wisely.
translation: 路障可以用来阻挡敌人进入某个区域。你的队伍最多只能放置十个路障，而且每次只能拿一个，所以要明智使用。

english: Explosive potions can be used to instantly destroy a barricade.
translation: 爆炸药水可以瞬间摧毁路障。

english: Potions of power can be used to boost your combat abilities and restore your prayer.
translation: 力量药水可以提升你的战斗能力并恢复祈祷值。

english: By playing Soul Wars, you will earn both Zeal and Zeal Tokens. While Zeal is used to show your lifetime Soul Wars score, Zeal Tokens can be spent on various rewards from the Soul Wars Reward Shop.
translation: 参与灵魂战争，你将获得狂热和狂热代币。狂热用于展示你的灵魂战争终身成绩，狂热代币则可在灵魂战争奖励商店兑换各种奖励。

english: Both are given whenever a Soul Wars game ends. The amount depends on your contribution to the game.
translation: 每场灵魂战争结束时都会给予两者。数量取决于你在游戏中的贡献。

english: The winning team will also receive some bonus Zeal and Zeal Tokens, while the losing team will have some removed.
translation: 获胜队伍还会获得额外的狂热和狂热代币，而失败队伍则会被扣除一些。

english: Sol Heredit grabs hold of your body part and deals massive damage!
translation: 索尔.赫雷迪特抓住你的身体部位并造成巨大伤害！

english: Sol Heredit grabs hold of your item and deals massive damage!
translation: 索尔.赫雷迪特抓住你的物品并造成巨大伤害！

english: Are you sure you wish to consume your smouldering stone to recharge your infernal harpoon?
translation: 你确定要消耗你的阴燃之石来为你的地狱鱼叉充能吗？

english: Allow it to be consumed.
translation: 允许消耗。

english: You recharge your infernal harpoon.
translation: 你为你的地狱鱼叉充能了。

english: Soup turns away from you and the raw sea turtle, a single salty tear forming in his eye.
translation: 汤转过身去，背对着你和生海龟，一滴咸泪在他眼中形成。

english: Soup turns away from you and the cooked sea turtle, a single salty tear forming in his eye.
translation: 汤转过身去，背对着你和熟海龟，一滴咸泪在他眼中形成。

english: Soup turns away from you and the burnt sea turtle, a single salty tear forming in his eye.
translation: 汤转过身去，背对着你和烧焦的海龟，一滴咸泪在他眼中形成。

english: You have not yet unlocked this rift.
translation: 你还未解锁此裂隙。

english: The soul rift will not respond to you until you have crafted some soul runes.
translation: 在你制作出一些灵魂符石之前，灵魂之裂隙不会回应你。

english: The rift cannot find the true Soul Altar. However, if you bring a sample of the Dark Altar's power to the rift, the Dark Altar can redirect the rift to the place in Arceuus where it focuses the Soul Altar's energy.
translation: 裂隙无法找到真正的灵魂祭坛。不过，如果你带一份黑暗祭坛的力量样本到裂隙处，黑暗祭坛就能将裂隙重新导向阿西乌斯城中它汇聚灵魂祭坛能量的地方。

english: The power of the Dark Altar redirects the rift to the place in Arceuus where the energy of the true Soul Altar is focused.
translation: 黑暗祭坛的力量将裂隙重新导向阿西乌斯城中真正灵魂祭坛能量汇聚之处。

english: The rift is already connected to the place in Arceuus where the Dark Altar focuses the energy of the true Soul Altar.
translation: 裂隙已经连接到阿西乌斯城中黑暗祭坛汇聚真正灵魂祭坛能量的地方。

english: The rift does not respond to that.
translation: 裂隙对此没有反应。

english: I finally arrived, and I must say this putrid wasteland is full of all sorts of wonderful chemicals to test on my experiments. Those filthy humans may have driven us all into hiding, but I at least have found myself a wonderland of a new home. The swamp itself is massive, I'll never run low on supplies. It is nearly abandoned as well so I may work in peace. While my lesser colleagues have their secluded little islands scattered about the world, I now have an entire ocean of wonders to play with. The only annoyance I've come across so far are these obnoxious little humans running around and disappearing into their holes in the mountains, but they are easy to avoid. Now, I've dawdled enough. It's time to get to work.
translation: 我终于到了，不得不说这片腐烂的废土充满了各种奇妙的化学物质，可以用来做我的实验。那些肮脏的人类可能把我们全都赶进了藏身之处，但我至少为自己找到了一个仙境般的新家。这片沼泽本身巨大无比，我永远不会缺少补给。这里也几乎被遗弃，所以我可以安静地工作。虽然我那些低等的同僚们散布在世界各地的小岛上，但我现在拥有整片奇迹之海可以玩耍。到目前为止，我遇到的唯一烦扰就是那些讨厌的小人类四处乱跑，然后消失在他们的山洞里，但他们很容易避开。好了，我已经耽搁够久了。该开始工作了。

english: This place really is incredible. The sheer scope of what can be done here... Those charlatans could never comprehend it. Serpents with venomous tails, spit as poisonous as the swamp itself, and power over magic that rivals even wyrms, it's all so fantastic! I have a vision now, a serpent that could kill anyone I please, one that could cover the world in a deadly smog and destroy all my enemies. What a beautiful world it would be! I must get started now, but first I must dispose of these vorkath.
translation: 这地方真是不可思议。这里能做的事情的规模...那些江湖骗子永远无法理解。带有毒尾的蛇，吐出的毒液和沼泽本身一样毒，还有足以媲美蛇龙的魔法力量，这一切都太棒了！我现在有了一个愿景，一条能杀死任何我想杀之人的蛇，一条能用致命毒雾覆盖世界并消灭我所有敌人的蛇。那将是多么美丽的世界啊！我必须现在就开始，但首先我得处理掉这些沃卡斯。

english: This swamp really is a beautiful place. I receive everything I need from it and return what I no longer require. The sludge devours my failures and wipes them away, like they never existed in the first place. It is a shame, but I had to dispose of my greatest creation yet. This serpent held potential but it just isn't what I needed. It was unfortunate, but I hope the next ones will be better.
translation: 这片沼泽真是个美丽的地方。我从它那里得到我需要的一切，然后归还我不再需要的东西。污泥吞噬我的失败品并将它们抹去，就像它们从未存在过一样。很遗憾，但我不得不处理掉我迄今为止最伟大的造物。这条蛇有潜力，但它不是我需要的。很不幸，但我希望下一个会更好。

english: I do not believe in them but I have no other way to describe it! This is... a miracle! I returned to the wastes today to discard my newest batch of vorkath and something was waiting for me! It is so much bigger now but I could recognize my work anywhere. My greatest failure is now my greatest joy! The serpent I had such high hopes for but ultimately had to destroy, it has survived and is now unlike any other of my creations. It towers over even me now, and it's smart. I can see intelligence in its eyes. I've decided to observe it, see what I can learn for either this creature's future or my own. I've never been more excited!
translation: 我不相信奇迹，但我没有别的词来形容了！这是...一个奇迹！今天我回到废土丢弃我最新一批沃卡斯，有什么东西在等着我！它现在大了很多，但我能在任何地方认出我的作品。我最大的失败现在是我最大的喜悦！那条我曾寄予厚望但最终不得不毁掉的蛇，它活了下来，现在与我任何其他造物都不同。它现在甚至比我还高大，而且它很聪明。我能从它的眼睛里看到智慧。我决定观察它，看看我能为这个生物的未来或我自己的未来学到什么。我从未如此兴奋过！

english: Despite my best attempts to stay hidden and observe, my old vorkath has found me snooping. I greeted it and it actually understood what I was saying! I was right, the creature is intelligent! It has grown even larger since I first laid eyes upon it, it's incredible how quickly its size and power grows in the swamp. These wastes truly are miraculous! The serpent's tail drips with poison, its fangs with venom, and even its physical self warps and changes with power. I've seen its scales glow cyan with magic as it shot a hole into the mountain! I've seen its body burn with the color of magma as its tail smacked the toxic waters and created tidal waves! I've seen it create a smog so foul from its breath it killed what little plant life was left living on the swampy shores! I've even seen it control the other vorkath of mine, the ones I disposed of and thought had rotted away in the wastes! My 'vorkath' is nothing of the sort at all! My beautiful serpent... My Zulrah... You are perfect.
translation: 尽管我尽力隐藏观察，我的老沃卡斯还是发现我在窥探。我跟它打招呼，它居然听懂了我的话！我是对的，这个生物是聪明的！它比我第一次看到它时又长大了许多，它在沼泽中体型和力量增长的速度真是惊人。这片废土真是神奇！蛇的尾巴滴着毒液，毒牙带着剧毒，甚至它的身体本身也会随着力量而扭曲变化。我见过它的鳞片发出青色的魔法光芒，把山轰出一个洞！我见过它的身体燃烧着岩浆般的颜色，尾巴拍打有毒的水面掀起巨浪！我见过它呼出如此恶臭的烟雾，杀死了沼泽岸边仅存的植物生命！我甚至见过它控制我其他的沃卡斯，那些我丢弃并以为已经在废土中腐烂的！我的'沃卡斯'根本不是那回事！我美丽的蛇...我的祖尔拉...你是完美的。

english: Tempoross, the Spirit of the Sea. Ongoing research by the Spirit Anglers.
translation: 海灵，海洋之灵。海灵垂钓者正在进行的研究。

english: Tempoross, the Spirit of the Sea.
translation: 海灵，海洋之灵。

english: Ongoing research by the Spirit Anglers.
translation: 海灵垂钓者正在进行的研究。

english: The Spirit of the Sea is referenced in many diaries and logs throughout the ages, as well as in tales passed down through generations of fisherfolk.
translation: 海洋之灵在历代许多日记和日志中都有提及，也出现在渔民世代相传的故事中。

english: We, the Spirit Anglers, have reviewed many such sources in an effort to gain an accurate picture of what this elemental entity, Tempoross, really is.
translation: 我们海灵垂钓者查阅了许多此类资料，以努力准确了解这个元素实体海灵究竟是什么。

english: Alongside literature review, we are conducting ongoing studies during our trips to subdue the entity.
translation: 除了文献研究，我们还在每次出海制服该实体的过程中进行持续研究。

english: These notes are part of an evolving collection of findings and theories based on the information we are continuously gathering.
translation: 这些笔记是基于我们不断收集的信息而形成的不断发展的发现和理论集的一部分。

english: The verbal tales referencing a Sea Spirit appear to have almost all been forgotten. A few variations remain and the sources we interviewed believe them to be myths and cautionary tales.
translation: 提及海灵的民间故事似乎几乎全部被遗忘了。只剩下少数变体，我们采访的消息来源认为它们是神话和警示故事。

english: There is some written reference of other versions existing, perhaps ages ago, and some even believe the tale to reference a Spirit that existed sometime during the First Age. From these tales, it is unclear what the motives of the Spirit were.
translation: 有一些书面记载提到其他版本的存在，也许是在很久以前，有些人甚至认为这个故事指的是第一纪元某个时期存在的灵魂。从这些故事中，无法清楚了解该灵魂的动机。

english: Some claim it to be a chaotic spirit that attacks sea-farers unprovoked. Others cast it in a more positive light, suggesting it protects the sea from unworthy fisherfolk. Regardless if either reason is correct, the more relevant feature of these tales is the claimed actions of the Spirit.
translation: 有些人声称它是一个混乱的灵魂，无缘无故攻击航海者。其他人则从更积极的角度描述它，暗示它保护海洋免受不配的渔民侵扰。无论哪种说法是否正确，这些故事中更相关的特征是所声称的灵魂行为。

english: Every tale we have investigated tells of freak storms where the sea itself comes alive. The watery form, lightning strikes and colossal waves bear a remarkable resemblance to what we have observed in the current events.
translation: 我们调查的每个故事都讲述了海洋本身活过来的怪异风暴。水形态、闪电和巨浪与我们当前事件中观察到的惊人相似。

english: Due to the tales being the starting point of our research, we have opted to call this entity the name that appears most commonly in the tales: Tempoross.
translation: 由于这些故事是我们研究的起点，我们选择用故事中最常见的名字来称呼这个实体：海灵。

english: The possibility of new equipment is being investigated, but until then we are limited to surface observation and tests.
translation: 正在研究新装备的可能性，但在那之前我们只能进行表面观察和测试。

english: Our initial theories suggested Tempoross to be some sort of elemental with its own power and sentience. However, our recent observations have raised some questions. When Tempoross submerges, fish are drawn in and seem to amass within several whirlpools situated in the cove.
translation: 我们最初的理论认为海灵是某种拥有自身力量和感知的元素生物。然而，我们最近的观察提出了一些问题。当海灵潜入水中时，鱼被吸引过来，似乎聚集在海湾中的几个漩涡里。

english: Our original assumption was that these fish were merely being pulled in by currents outside of their own control. However, further observation of their behaviour indicates they are, in fact, coming together of their own volition.
translation: 我们最初的假设是这些鱼只是被水流卷入，无法自控。然而，对它们行为的进一步观察表明，它们实际上是自愿聚集在一起的。

english: Magical readings at the location show a strong energy is being emitted from within the cove, one that has not been registered in this area before from what we can find.
translation: 该地点的魔法读数显示，海湾内部正释放出强大的能量，根据我们现有的记录，这一能量此前从未在该区域出现过。

english: For the purpose of these notes, and until further tests are carried out, this energy shall be referred to as Spirit energy and it is our speculation that the fish are drawn to it. It would appear the fish become infused with the energy in some way, emitting a soft glow.
translation: 为便于记录，在进一步测试之前，我们将这种能量称为灵力，并推测鱼类是被它所吸引。看来鱼类以某种方式与能量融合，发出微弱的光芒。

english: Some of the more resourceful members of the Spirit Anglers are investigating the use of scales shed by these Spirit infused fish as an attractor in their own fishing trips. If successful, it would be further evidence for the theory.
translation: 海灵垂钓者中一些更足智多谋的成员正在研究利用这些灵力鱼脱落的鳞片作为他们自己钓鱼时的诱饵。如果成功，将进一步证实这一理论。

english: As more fish amass within the cove, the energy readings increase until Tempoross surfaces, fish swirling about within its form. Perhaps this entity draws energy from the cove and the fish within it? Or perhaps it is itself an anomaly of the increased energy levels?
translation: 随着海湾内鱼类聚集增多，能量读数也随之上升，直到海灵浮出水面，鱼群在其体内盘旋。也许这个实体从海湾和其中的鱼群中汲取能量？又或者它本身就是能量水平升高的异常产物？

english: There are many unknowns we are researching. However, our progress is hindered by the need to subdue Tempoross on a regular basis to prevent the storms becoming unmanageable.
translation: 我们正在研究许多未知的事物。然而，由于需要定期制服海灵以防止风暴失控，我们的进展受到了阻碍。

english: Our working theory is that if the presence of many fish triggers the surfacing of Tempoross, removing the fish should reduce the energy levels and subdue it faster than when the fish are left unchecked.
translation: 我们目前的理论是，如果大量鱼群的存在会触发海灵浮出水面，那么移除鱼群应该能降低能量水平，比放任鱼群不管时更快地制服它。

english: Due to the fish being scattered at various depths and our inability to fish more than a couple of metres beneath the surface with the current conditions and equipment, we cannot prevent Tempoross surfacing outright. However, we are able to prevent the storms from becoming too intense, greatly decreasing the disruption to sea passage.
translation: 由于鱼群分散在不同深度，且在当前条件和装备下我们无法在水面以下几米处捕鱼，我们无法完全阻止海灵浮出水面。不过，我们能够防止风暴变得过于猛烈，大大减少对海上航行的干扰。

english: After various unsuccessful fishing attempts resulting in broken or lost nets, we found firing harpoons through Tempoross itself quite successful in scattering the fish within, eventually resulting in Tempoross retreating beneath the depths to draw the fish back in.
translation: 在多次捕鱼尝试失败导致渔网破损或丢失后，我们发现直接向海灵发射鱼叉能有效地驱散其体内的鱼群，最终使海灵退回深处重新聚集鱼群。

english: This window allows us to fish directly from the whirlpools and remove surface fish, eventually preventing Tempoross from resurfacing for a longer period of time.
translation: 这个窗口期让我们能够直接从漩涡中捕鱼并清除水面上的鱼，最终使海灵在更长时间内无法重新浮出水面。

english: This method is costly, however, as the harpoons are lost to the depths. Recent discoveries have yielded a solution to the harpoon supply issue. A strange type of fish appears to inhabit the reefs around the cove and seems indifferent to the Spirit energy observed within the cove. The fish is similar to the Swordfish, though its bill resembles a harpoon more than a sword.
translation: 然而，这种方法代价高昂，因为鱼叉会沉入深处。最近的发现解决了鱼叉供应问题。一种奇特的鱼类似乎栖息在海湾周围的礁石中，并且对海湾内观察到的灵力似乎无动于衷。这种鱼与剑鱼相似，但它的喙更像鱼叉而非剑。

english: As such, we've modified our harpoon cannons to fire these so called Harpoonfish, and better still, we have a seemingly endless supply of them. We have noted that cooking the Harpoonfish, while doing nothing for the edibility, does harden the bill, making them even more effective when used as ammunition.
translation: 因此，我们改装了鱼叉发射器来发射这种所谓的叉鱼，更妙的是，我们似乎拥有源源不断的供应。我们注意到，烹饪叉鱼虽然对食用性毫无帮助，但会使喙变硬，使其作为弹药时更加有效。

english: Our research into the nature of Tempoross and other, more permanent methods of subjugation continue to be our top priority.
translation: 我们对海灵本质的研究以及寻找更永久的制服方法仍然是我们的首要任务。

english: Do you have any of those useful trinkets you mentioned?
translation: 你有你提到的那些有用的小玩意儿吗？

english: I might do... But it's going to cost you a hefty amount of spirit flakes, here take a look.
translation: 也许有...但得花你不少灵力鱼片，来看看吧。

english: You find the smell strangely intriguing and pull a Smelly sock out of the cauldron!
translation: 你发现这气味莫名地吸引人，从大锅里掏出了一只臭袜子！

english: You grab the squishiest thing you can find and pull a Bruised banana out of the cauldron!
translation: 你抓住你能找到的最软乎乎的东西，从大锅里掏出了一根发黑的香蕉！

english: The coarse texture of a round object takes your fancy and you pull some Old wool out of the cauldron!
translation: 一个圆形物体粗糙的质感引起了你的兴趣，你从大锅里掏出了一团旧破的毛线球！

english: Reaching deep into the darkness, you search for an object radiating spookiness and pull a Spooky egg out of the cauldron!
translation: 你把手深深探入黑暗之中，寻找一件散发着幽灵气息的物品，从大锅里掏出了一颗幽灵蛋！

english: During the Halloween 2023 event, the community collected a total of 443.7M treats. You contributed <Num0> treats.
translation: 在2023年万圣节活动期间，社区共收集了4.437亿份糖果。你贡献了<Num0>份糖果。

translation: <Num0> x 红色香料。

translation: <Num0> x 棕色香料。

english: Bernard! I see you made it.
translation: 伯纳德！我看到你来了。

english: I did, and I buried that necklace up here, just as I promised. Now I think I'll stay a while and enjoy the view. We really are on top of the world.
translation: 是的，我把那条项链埋在了这里，正如我所承诺的。现在我想在这里待一会儿，欣赏一下风景。我们真的站在世界之巅。

english: In that case, I'll leave you to it. All the best, Bernard.
translation: 既然如此，我就不打扰你了。祝一切顺利，伯纳德。

english: Ivandis has gone. His last duty is what he called it. Duty? More like suicide. To kill Lowerniel Drakan? It didn't make sense. The Salve had been blessed. The war had been won. Why did he need to go and kill Drakan? The truth soon became clear.
translation: 伊万迪斯走了。他称之为最后的职责。职责？更像是自杀。去杀洛厄尼尔.德雷坎？这说不通。萨勒夫已被祝福。战争已经胜利。他为什么还要去杀德雷坎？真相很快就变得清晰了。

english: Before he left, Ivandis tasked us with building a temple over the source of the Salve. However, to me, he had an additional request. He gave me a book. Inside he'd documented the events leading up to the Salve being blessed. He told me it must be preserved. That it was my job to do so.
translation: 离开前，伊万迪斯委托我们在萨勒夫的源头建造一座神庙。然而，对我，他还有一个额外的请求。他给了我一本书。里面记录了他所记载的萨勒夫被祝福前的事件。他告诉我必须保存好它。这是我的职责。

english: I never should have opened it. I never should have discovered the truth of what they did. What he did. And yet, this was his final request of me. I can't destroy it, no matter how much I'd like to. Instead, I will ensure it remains hidden. I will hide it within the very temple we are to build, so that only the worthy can find it: Those who stand by the word that the rest of the warriors swore.
translation: 我不该打开它。我不该发现他们所做之事的真相。他所做之事的真相。然而，这是他对我最后的请求。我无法毁掉它，无论我多想这么做。相反，我会确保它保持隐藏。我会把它藏在我们将要建造的神庙里，只有配得上的人才能找到它：那些坚守其他战士所宣誓之言的人。

english: You find a note tucked between the stalagmites.
translation: 你在石笋之间发现了一张纸条。

english: You remember finding a note here in the stalagmites, but there's nothing else of interest.
translation: 你记得曾在这片石笋中找到过一张纸条，但这里已没有其他值得注意的东西了。

english: Pick a section to read:
translation: 选择要阅读的部分：

english: ... which leads us to the new definition of knowledge as a belief that is both reliably generated and true.
translation: ...这引出了我们对知识的新定义，即知识是一种既可靠产生又真实的信念。

english: Our senses tell us about the world, but to what extent are they reliable? One witness may perceive the weather to be hot, but another witness may consider it to be quite cold.
translation: 我们的感官告诉我们关于世界的信息，但它们在多大程度上是可靠的呢？一个目击者可能觉得天气很热，但另一个目击者可能觉得相当冷。

english: Perception of colour may be similarly affected, as the reader may demonstrate by staring at a piece of brightly-coloured paper. When the paper is removed, the reader may find that everything else appears to be a slightly different colour from normal.
translation: 对颜色的感知也可能受到类似影响，读者可以通过注视一张颜色鲜艳的纸来验证。当纸被移开时，读者可能会发现其他一切看起来都与平时略有不同。

english: We may conclude from this that, although we are sensing some intrinsic property of the object under examination, qualities such as colour and temperature are NOT intrinsic.
translation: 我们可以由此得出结论，虽然我们感知到了被检物体的某些固有属性，但颜色和温度等特质并非固有属性。

english: Henceforth we recommend that the reader consider them to be Secondary qualities. The quantity of caloric within the object that gives it this perceived temperature truly is intrinsic to the object, so this may be considered a Primary quality.
translation: 因此，我们建议读者将它们视为次要特质。物体内赋予其感知温度的热量确实是物体固有的，因此这可以被视为主要特质。

english: In the following chapter we will examine the implications of this distinction for the study of natural philosophy.
translation: 在下一章中，我们将探讨这一区分对自然哲学研究的影响。

english: In this chapter we aim to examine the extent to which our senses give us a reliable impression of the world in which we live.
translation: 在本章中，我们旨在考察我们的感官在多大程度上给予我们对所生活世界的可靠印象。

english: Although we may believe that we are seeing and hearing things that exist, we may be deceived by our senses, as every keen drinker will have experienced! But if our senses may be deceived, what can we trust?
translation: 尽管我们可能相信自己看到和听到的事物是存在的，但我们可能会被感官所欺骗，正如每位热衷饮酒者所经历过的那样！但如果我们的感官可能被欺骗，我们又能相信什么呢？

english: We may perhaps try to rely only on logical deductions and mathematical principles. Yet it is even possible that some fiend may have confused our minds to the extent that we are making false deductions without being aware of this.
translation: 我们或许可以尝试只依赖逻辑推理和数学原理。但甚至有可能某个恶魔混淆了我们的思维，以至于我们在不知不觉中做出了错误的推理。

english: We therefore present the following statement as the only piece of knowledge about which we cannot possibly be deceived: 'I EXIST'
translation: 因此，我们提出以下陈述，作为唯一不可能被欺骗的知识：'我存在'

english: Although all information gained through use of our senses and minds may be distorted, no self-aware being can be led to believe that it does not exist. It may not be the man or woman it believes itself to be, but it can never question its own existence in some form.
translation: 尽管通过感官和思维获得的所有信息都可能被扭曲，但任何有自我意识的存在都不可能被引导去相信它不存在。它可能不是它自认为的那个男人或女人，但它永远无法质疑自己以某种形式存在的事实。

english: In the following chapter we will discuss ways in which one may attempt to demonstrate the existence of a world outside of one's own consciousness.
translation: 在下一章中，我们将讨论如何尝试证明存在于自身意识之外的世界。

english: For every 'x' and 'y' that satisfy the equation (such as x = 2, y = 1 or x = 5, y = 0 for the above example), the points 'x,y' may be plotted on the graph, and it will be found that they form a line.
translation: 对于满足方程的每个'x'和'y'（例如上述例子中x = 2, y = 1或x = 5, y = 0），点'x,y'可以绘制在图表上，将会发现它们形成一条线。

english: If a second equation of this form is plotted on the same graph, the two lines may cross at some point.
translation: 如果在同一图表上绘制第二个这种形式的方程，两条线可能会在某一点相交。

english: Any point where the two lines cross will be given by some 'x' and 'y' that fits both equations.
translation: 两条线相交的任何点都将由同时满足两个方程的某个'x'和'y'给出。

english: Readers are invited to create two such equations and try it for themselves!
translation: 欢迎读者自行创建两个这样的方程并亲自尝试！

english: ... better now, walls look decent, nice and elegant. Those new lanterns were a rip-off, blasted dwarf craftsmen. Still, not a problem for me!
translation: ……现在好多了，墙壁看起来不错，漂亮又优雅。那些新灯笼真是坑人，该死的矮人工匠。不过，对我来说不是问题！

english: Even got my old Saradomin armour gilded, beautiful gold edges on it now. No-one else's going to have armour like that, that'll make them think, heh heh heh...
translation: 甚至把我那套旧的萨拉多明盔甲镀了金，现在上面有漂亮的金边。没人会有那样的盔甲，这会让他们好好想想，嘿嘿嘿……

english: Lick of gold-leaf here and there, even my globe looks smarter now, maybe that bath screen was a bit much? No, I saw it, I wanted it, it's mine. Vidi, volui, mihi est! Still don't know what that 'thing' is, but it looks nice on my desk. Probably some kind of transport? Must run off hot air or dragon flatulence?
translation: 这里那里涂点金箔，连我的地球仪看起来都更气派了，也许那个浴屏有点过了？不，我看到了，我想要，它就是我的。我见，我欲，我拥有！还是不知道那个'东西'是什么，但放在书桌上很好看。大概是某种交通工具？一定是靠热气或者巨龙屁驱动的？

english: Running a bit short of runes now. Those wizards over to the south always seem to have plenty, but will they spare me some? Bah! Not a chance, poxy mage scum!
translation: 符文现在有点不够用了。南边那些巫师似乎总是有很多，但他们会分给我一些吗？呸！没门，该死的法师渣滓！

english: Perhaps another little expedition is needed - they all look pretty weedy over there...
translation: 也许需要再来一次小远征——他们那边看起来都很弱……

english: Steve has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 史蒂夫又给了你一个线索卷轴！

english: Steve has given you a casket!
translation: 史蒂夫给了你一个宝箱！

english: You know what? Blow the others! If the queen can marry a human, then why can't I marry an icyene?
translation: 你知道吗？管他别人怎么说！如果女王能嫁给人类，那我为什么不能娶一个冰伊恩族？

english: 'You're just a blacksmith,' they say. 'She's a warrior.' Well damn them and damn anyone else that tries to stop me. Every warrior needs a blacksmith after all. I'm going to propose to her. Tonight.
translation: '你只是个铁匠，'他们说。'她是个战士。'哼，去他们的，也去任何试图阻止我的人的。毕竟每个战士都需要铁匠。我要向她求婚。今晚。

english: She said yes! I knew she would. All the others can go eat their words now. We're getting married!
translation: 她答应了！我就知道她会。现在其他人都得收回他们的话了。我们要结婚了！

english: Our families are a bit concerned of course. They seem to be supportive though. Thanks to the queen, this sort of thing is more acceptable now. Still, I hope they stop asking about 'bedroom compatibility' soon.
translation: 我们的家人当然有些担心。不过他们似乎还是支持的。多亏了女王，这种事情现在更容易被接受了。不过，我希望他们别再问'卧室兼容性'的事了。

english: It was the wedding of dreams! Marrying one of her standing brings some privilege. As such, we were able to hold the ceremony in the shadow of the Acropolis.
translation: 那是梦想中的婚礼！嫁给像她这样地位的人带来了一些特权。因此，我们得以在卫城的阴影下举行仪式。

english: As night fell, we were treated to a musical performance more beautiful than any I'd seen. But it goes without saying, nothing was as beautiful as her.
translation: 夜幕降临时，我们欣赏了一场比我见过的任何表演都更美的音乐演出。但不用说，没有什么比她更美。

english: Drakan. A name that sends shivers down the spine of any sane man. We'd all heard the stories, the nightmares. Now, he has arrived at our doorstep.
translation: 德拉肯。一个让任何理智之人都脊背发凉的名字。我们都听过那些故事，那些噩梦。现在，他已经来到了我们的门前。

english: The others aren't worried. 'The warriors will protect Hallowvale,' they say. They don't need to care. Their wives work in the city. They're safe, but she is not.
translation: 其他人都不担心。'战士们会保护哈洛维尔，'他们说。他们不需要担心。他们的妻子在城市里工作。她们安全，但她不安全。

english: Her unit has their orders. She's set to leave for the frontline in three days' time.
translation: 她的部队已经接到了命令。她定于三天后出发前往前线。

english: I didn't tell her, but I paid a visit to the priests at the Hallowed Sepulchre. Icyene and humans are normally buried on different levels. For us, I pray they make an exception. Eternity is too long to be away from her.
translation: 我没有告诉她，但我拜访了圣墓的祭司们。冰伊恩族和人类通常葬在不同的层。为了我们，我祈祷他们能破例。永恒太漫长，不能与她分离。

english: It's never easy to say goodbye. I thought I'd mentally prepared myself for it. But all the preparation in the world doesn't match reality.
translation: 说再见从来都不容易。我以为我已经在心理上做好了准备。但世上所有的准备都比不上现实。

english: Saradomin, I pray to you. Keep her safe from harm. Please, return my love to me. For in this world of darkness, she is my only light.
translation: 萨拉多明，我向你祈祷。保佑她免受伤害。请把我的爱人还给我。因为在这个黑暗的世界里，她是我唯一的光。

english: All those who thirst for knowledge,
translation: 所有渴望知识的人，

english: Bow down to the lord.
translation: 向主俯首。

english: All you that crave eternal life,
translation: 所有渴望永生的人，

english: Come and meet your god.
translation: 来见你的神。

english: For no man nor beast
translation: 因为无论人或兽

english: Some work and pray,
translation: 有人劳作有人祈祷，

english: But only those who embrace the end
translation: 但只有那些拥抱终结的人

english: And when all hope begins to fade
translation: 当所有希望开始消退

english: And now our god has given us
translation: 如今我们的神赐予我们

english: A saviour who once sat upon
translation: 一位救世主，他曾坐在

english: It is in your name that we
translation: 以你的名义，我们

english: Iban, Son of Zamorak!
translation: 伊班，萨莫拉克之子！

english: Here lies the sacred well,
translation: 此处安息着神圣的水井，

english: He blesses all his disciples keen.
translation: 他热忱地祝福所有信徒。

english: 'We bathe in pure evil' they yell.
translation: “我们沐浴在纯粹的邪恶中”他们高喊。

english: The force of darkness is strong,
translation: 黑暗的力量强大无比，

english: If a light should break the night
translation: 若有光划破黑夜

english: Turn and leave, run and flee
translation: 转身离开，奔跑逃命

english: It is the soil that shall rise
translation: 是土壤将升起

english: Only as flesh becomes ash,
translation: 只有当血肉化为灰烬，

english: ...will Iban's corpse embrace
translation: ...伊班的尸体才会拥抱

english: Daer Krand has got me running another errand. He heard about this spider nest near the Sisterhood Sanctuary. He thinks the Sisterhood might have used venom from these spiders to make their elixir. I'm not about to go extracting venom from one of these things, but I have found eggs I can bring back. Problem is, the damn egg sac is too strong. I've tried all sorts of things, but nothing will cut through it. Some sulphuric acid should do the trick, but I didn't think to bring anything like that with me. I guess I'll have to head back to Daer at the Sanctuary.
translation: 戴尔.克兰德又让我跑腿。他听说姐妹会圣所附近有个蜘蛛巢。他觉得姐妹会可能用这些蜘蛛的毒液制作了他们的灵药。我可不想去从这些东西身上提取毒液，但我找到了可以带回去的蛋。问题是，那该死的卵囊太结实了。我试了各种办法，但什么都割不开它。一些硫酸应该能行，但我没想到会带这种东西来。看来我得回圣所找戴尔了。

english: Akhem,
translation: 阿克赫姆，

english: The Zamorakians are coming. We have no quarrel with them, but they won't care. We are already preparing our defences, but should Ullek fall, we can't let them defile Scabaras' precious artefacts. I've locked what I can in a chest and buried it to the south. If I don't make it through the coming storm, you'll find the chest under the southernmost ritual pillar. Your name hides the code to unlock it.
translation: 扎莫拉基安人要来了。我们与他们无冤无仇，但他们不会在乎。我们已经在准备防御，但如果乌莱克失守，我们不能让他们亵渎斯卡巴拉斯珍贵的文物。我把能锁的都锁在了一个宝箱里，埋在了南边。如果我撑不过即将到来的风暴，你会在最南边的仪式柱下找到那个宝箱。你的名字就是解锁它的密码。

english: With love,
translation: 爱你的，

english: Sethos
translation: 塞托斯

english: Amok miki. Tal toka kemo. Lini toka makt. Tal tlane osto ates ikam.
translation: 阿莫克米基。塔尔托卡凯莫。利尼托卡马克特。塔尔特拉内奥斯托阿特斯伊卡姆。

english: Little time. Soul vessel success. Send vessel north. Life garden below lake island.
translation: 时间不多。灵魂容器成功。将容器送往北方。生命花园在湖岛下方。

english: Siua olkat moki. Olkat moki tal. Kualt olkat tal toka. Moki yoka tlane lini kamat. Silam osto achi ates xali.
translation: 西乌阿奥尔卡特莫基。奥尔卡特莫基塔尔。夸尔特奥尔卡特塔尔托卡。莫基约卡特拉内利尼卡马特。西拉姆奥斯托阿奇阿特斯哈利。

english: Many body needed. Body need life. Feed body soul vessel. Need knowledge garden transfer method. West below poison water land.
translation: 需要许多身体。身体需要生命。用灵魂容器喂养身体。需要知识花园的转移方法。西方在毒水之地下方。

english: Lini kamat kemo. Olkat kemo. Tal toka kemo. Miki xita. Miki achi moki. Miki chua tal. Miki tlane lini. Uitt takam osto tlane tasol.
translation: 利尼卡马特凯莫。奥尔卡特凯莫。塔尔托卡凯莫。米基西塔。米基阿奇莫基。米基楚阿塔尔。米基特拉内利尼。乌伊特塔卡姆奥斯托特拉内塔索尔。

english: Transfer method success. Body success. Soul vessel success. Time arrived. Death poison needed. Death create life. Death garden deliver. South east below forest building.
translation: 转移方法成功。身体成功。灵魂容器成功。时间已到。需要死亡之毒。死亡创造生命。死亡花园传递。东南方在森林建筑下方。

english: Miki achi ami. Tlane chua rani miki. Lini antil. Antil tepat. Ami tal. Tal toka ami. Zema-Tal tepat.
translation: 米基阿奇阿米。特拉内楚阿拉尼米基。利尼安蒂尔。安蒂尔特帕特。阿米塔尔。塔尔托卡阿米。泽马-塔尔 特帕特。

english: Death poison fail. Plant create dark death. Send home. Home destroyed. No life. Soul vessel fail. Zema-Tal destroyed.
translation: 死亡之毒失败。植物创造黑暗死亡。送回家园。家园被毁。没有生命。灵魂容器失败。泽马-塔尔 被毁。

english: You are about to enter a dangerous area. Items dropped within the arena may be irretrievable.
translation: 你即将进入危险区域。竞技场内掉落的物品可能无法找回。

english: The statue looks like it's meant to be holding something. A plaque on it reads: 'Carnifex Maximus Vardorvis'
translation: 雕像看起来本应握着什么东西。上面的牌匾写着：“卡尼费克斯·马克西姆斯·瓦尔多维斯”

english: The statue looks like it's meant to be holding something. A plaque on it reads: 'The Whisperer'
translation: 雕像看起来本应握着什么东西。上面的牌匾写着：“低语者”

english: The statue looks like it's meant to be holding something. A plaque on it reads: 'Duke Sucellus of the Sixth Legion'
translation: 雕像看起来本应握着什么东西。上面的牌匾写着：“第六军团的苏塞勒斯公爵”

english: The statue looks like it's meant to be holding something. A plaque on it reads: 'Praefectus Classis Perseriya'
translation: 雕像看起来本应握着什么东西。上面的牌匾写着：“舰队长官佩塞里亚”

english: Barat,
translation: 巴拉特，

english: I'm afraid I will not be able to visit you as originally hoped. Another Nela Tasol has fallen. Apart from us here, Tapoyauik is now all that remains. The Kuhu are firm in their belief. If our work here fails, the entire legacy of their people may be lost. I'm sorry to let you down, but they are running out of time. We are the only ones who can help them now. I hope to see you soon, once the work is done.
translation: 恐怕我无法按原计划去看你了。又一座内拉塔索尔倒下了。除了我们这里，塔波亚乌克是仅存的。库胡人信念坚定。如果我们这里的工作失败，他们民族的整个遗产可能会消失。很抱歉让你失望，但他们的时间不多了。现在只有我们能帮他们。希望工作完成后能尽快见到你。

english: Maria
translation: 玛丽亚

english: It is imperative I get as close to the ritual stone as I can. For too long the same few have horded the power while the rest of us have looked on from the outskirts. If only I could get close, maybe I'd become a force to be reckoned with in the next battle.
translation: 我必须尽可能靠近仪式石。太久了，少数人囤积着力量，而我们其余人只能在外围观望。如果我能靠近，也许下次战斗我就能成为一股不可忽视的力量。

english: Kourend the resplendent,
translation: 辉煌的库兰德王国，

english: Kourend, the most powerful
translation: 库兰德王国，最强大的

english: Kourend is our citadel,
translation: 库兰德王国是我们的堡垒，

english: Kourend is our homeland.
translation: 库兰德王国是我们的家园。

english: We will live and die for Kourend,
translation: 我们为库兰德王国而生而死，

english: From the rugged mountains,
translation: 从崎岖的山脉，

english: Kourend is a monument,
translation: 库兰德王国是一座纪念碑，

english: Kourend is a triumph;
translation: 库兰德王国是一项胜利；

english: I have my doubts that the locks we have built are truly complex enough to protect the knowledge that will soon be kept here, but my doubts are meaningless as one without any sway in the final decision. You, however, might be able to convince the Kuhu to let us include a layer of redundancy in them. No single, stumbling, fool should be able to get past them. I don't know the exact solution, but my thinking is that perhaps two people working in concert may be the answer.
translation: 我怀疑我们建造的锁是否真的足够复杂，能保护即将存放于此的知识，但我的怀疑毫无意义，因为我对最终决定没有任何影响力。不过，你也许能说服库胡人让我们在其中加入一层冗余。任何单个的冒失鬼都不应该能通过它们。我不知道确切方案，但我觉得也许两个人协同合作可能是答案。

english: Benedict
translation: 本尼迪克特

english: I don't even really know how to write this. Mokhaiotl has fallen. We awoke something, deep beneath the archive. Now everything is lost. The Kuhu gave their lives for us. They bought us the time needed to escape the lower levels. I wish I'd visited you, but the work was so important. I guess now I'll never get the chance. Mokhaiotl may be gone, but we have to make sure something remains. Their last act was one of sacrifice. We have to honour them. We have to remember them.
translation: 我甚至不知道该怎么写这些。莫凯奥特已经沦陷了。我们在档案深处唤醒了某种东西。现在一切都失去了。库胡族为我们献出了生命。他们为我们争取了逃离下层所需的时间。我多希望能去看你，但工作太重要了。我想现在我再也没有机会了。莫凯奥特可能已经消失，但我们必须确保有些东西留存下来。他们的最后行动是牺牲。我们必须纪念他们。我们必须记住他们。

english: Aatykon
translation: 阿提孔

english: Dear no one
translation: 致无名氏

english: Cmb
translation: Cmb

english: Lee
translation: 李

english: Chlis
translation: 克里斯

english: Lizzy
translation: 莉齐

english: Grant
translation: 格兰特

english: I certainly don't want to go down there without a reason to.
translation: 我当然不想无缘无故地下去。

english: This statue depicts the legendary hero Atlazora, sometimes known as the Jaguar of Night's Shadow.
translation: 这座雕像描绘的是传奇英雄亚特拉萨拉，有时被称为夜影美洲豹。

english: This statue depicts the legendary hero Dizana, sometimes known as the Heroine of the Hunt.
translation: 这座雕像描绘的是传奇英雄迪扎娜，有时被称为狩猎女英雄。

english: This statue depicts King Maximus, the creator of the Fortis Colosseum.
translation: 这座雕像描绘的是马克西姆斯国王，福蒂斯竞技场的创建者。

english: In the early days of the kingdom, criminals were sacrified to Ralos in a temple atop the Fortis Cliffs. However, King Maximus ordered the destruction of this temple, insisting there was no place for human sacrifice in Varlamore.
translation: 在王国早期，罪犯会在福蒂斯悬崖顶上的神庙中被献祭给拉洛斯。然而，马克西姆斯国王下令摧毁了这座神庙，坚称瓦拉莫尔没有人类献祭的位置。

english: In place of the temple, King Maximus had the Fortis Colosseum built, with it remaining there to this day.
translation: 马克西姆斯国王在神庙原址上建造了福蒂斯竞技场，至今仍矗立在那里。

english: This statue depicts the legendary hero Marhuitz, the first king of Fortis. He was sometimes known as the Old Wolf.
translation: 这座雕像描绘的是传奇英雄马尔维茨，福蒂斯的第一位国王。他有时被称为老狼。

english: This statue depicts the legendary hero Quoatlos, sometimes known as the Feathered Serpent.
translation: 这座雕像描绘的是传奇英雄夸奥特洛斯，有时被称为羽蛇。

english: This statue depicts the legendary hero Taur, sometimes known as the Young Bull.
translation: 这座雕像描绘的是传奇英雄陶尔，有时被称为小公牛。

english: This statue depicts the legendary hero Xerna, sometimes known as the Mother of Wisdom.
translation: 这座雕像描绘的是传奇英雄塞尔纳，有时被称为智慧之母。

english: This stronghold was unearthed by a miner prospecting for new ores around the Barbarian Village. After gathering some equipment he ventured into the maze of tunnels and was missing for a long time. He finally emerged along with copious notes regarding the new beasts and strange experiences which had befallen him. He also mentioned that there was treasure to be had, but no one has been able to wring a word from him about this, he simply flapped his arms and slapped his head. This book details his notes and my diary of exploration. I am exploring to see if I can find out more...
translation: 这座要塞是一位矿工在野蛮人村庄附近勘探新矿石时发现的。收集了一些装备后，他冒险进入迷宫般的隧道，失踪了很长时间。他最终带着大量关于新生物和他遭遇的奇异经历的笔记出现了。他还提到那里有宝藏，但没人能从他嘴里问出一个字，他只是挥动手臂拍打自己的头。这本书详细记录了他的笔记和我的探索日记。我正在探索，看看能否发现更多……

english: As well as goblins, creatures like a man but also like a cow infest this place! I have never seen anything like this before. The area itself is reminiscent of frontline castles, with many walls, doors and skeletons of dead enemies. I'm sure I hear voices in my head each time I pass through the gates. I have dubbed this level War as it seems like an eternal battleground. I found only one small peaceful area here.
translation: 除了哥布林，还有像人又像牛的生物出没于此！我从未见过这样的东西。这个地方让人想起前线城堡，有许多墙壁、门和死敌的骷髅。每次穿过大门时，我确信听到脑海中有声音。我把这一层命名为战争，因为它就像一个永恒的战场。我在这里只找到了一小块和平的区域。

english: My supplies are running low and I find myself in barren passages with seemingly endless malnourished beasts attacking me, ravenous for food. Nothing appears to be able to grow, many adventurers have died through lack of food and the very air appears to suck vitality from me. I've come to call this place famine.
translation: 我的补给快用完了，身处荒凉的通道中，似乎有无穷无尽的营养不良的野兽攻击我，它们贪婪地寻找食物。这里似乎什么都无法生长，许多冒险者因缺乏食物而死，连空气似乎都在吸取我的生命力。我开始称这个地方为饥荒。

english: Just breathing in this place makes me shudder at the thought of what foul disease I may contract. The walls and floor ooze and pulsate like something pox ridden. There is a very strange beast whom I narrowly escaped from. At first I thought it to be a cross between a cow and a sheep, something domesticated... but when it looked up at me I was overcome with weakness and barely got away with my life! Luckily I found a small place where I could heal myself and rest a while. I have named this area pestilence for it reeks with decay.
translation: 仅仅在这个地方呼吸就让我想到可能染上什么可怕的疾病而颤抖。墙壁和地板渗出并搏动着，像染了天花一样。有一只非常奇怪的野兽，我勉强逃脱了。起初我以为它是奶牛和羊的杂交，某种家畜……但当它抬头看我时，我感到虚弱无力，差点丢了性命！幸运的是，我找到了一个小地方可以治疗自己并休息一会儿。我把这个区域命名为瘟疫，因为它散发着腐烂的气味。

english: On my first escapade into this place I was utterly shocked. The adventurers who had come before me must have made up a tiny proportion of the skeletons of the dead. Nothing truly alive exists here, even those beings who do wander the halls are not alive as such, but they do know that I am and I get the distinct impression that were they to have their way, I would not be for long! Death is everywhere and thus I shall name this place. There is one small place of life, which was gladdening to find and very worth my while!
translation: 我第一次闯入这个地方时完全震惊了。在我之前来的冒险者一定只占死者骷髅的一小部分。这里没有真正活着的东西，即使那些在大厅里游荡的存在也不是活着的，但它们知道我是活着的，而且我清楚地感觉到，如果它们得逞，我活不了多久！死亡无处不在，因此我将以此命名此地。有一个小小的生命之地，找到它令人欣慰，非常值得我花时间！

english: After getting lost several times I finally worked out the key to all the ladders and chains around this death infested place. All ropes and chains will take you to the start of the level that you are on. However most ladders will simply take you to the level above. The one exception is the ladder in the bottom level treasure room, which appears to lead through several extremely twisty passages and eventually takes you out of the dungeon completely. The portals may be used if you are of sufficient level or have already claimed your reward from the treasure room.
translation: 迷路几次后，我终于弄清了所有梯子和锁链在这个充满死亡的地方的关键。所有绳子和锁链都会带你回到当前层的起点。然而大多数梯子只会带你到上一层。唯一的例外是底层宝藏室里的梯子，它似乎通向几条极其曲折的通道，最终完全带你离开地牢。如果你等级足够或已经从宝藏室领取了奖励，可以使用传送门。

english: Day 1 Today I set out to find out more about this place. From my research I knew about the sentient doors, imbued by some unknown force to talk to you and ask questions before they will let you pass. I have so far passed these doors without incident, giving the correct answer seems to work a treat.
translation: 第一天 今天我出发去了解更多关于这个地方的信息。根据我的研究，我知道有感知的门，被某种未知力量赋予能力，会在让你通过前与你交谈并提问。到目前为止，我顺利通过了这些门，给出正确答案似乎很有效。

english: Day 1

english: All my long hours of research have finally paid off! Today I discovered an ancient journal in the great library, which detailed a ceremony for giving life back to greater beasts after they have died! I shall finally be able to unravel the secrets of the Skeletal Wyverns!
translation: 我长时间的研究终于有了回报！今天我在大图书馆发现了一本古代日记，其中详细记载了一种让强大野兽死后复活的仪式！我终于能解开骷髅飞龙的秘密了！

english: I have spent over a month studying the spell of Greater Animation now. My studies have led me to believe that although this spell is more powerful than any I have ever encountered, and will indeed reanimate the skeletons of long dead dragons and such creatures, it does not provide any way of controlling them. Whoever devised this spell must have been insane, because without somebody to control them, these undead monsters would have been free to destroy everything that they encountered! No wonder the spell was hidden away in the great library. There is, however, a reference to an amulet of such power that any undead creature would tremble before someone wielding it. I must return to the library and see if I can find any further reference to this magical amulet. Once I have it and can create and control undead dragons, even Lord Drakan and his minions shall tremble before my might!
translation: 我已经花了一个多月研究高级活化术。我的研究让我相信，虽然这个法术比我见过的任何法术都强大，确实能复活早已死去的龙和类似生物的骷髅，但它无法提供控制它们的方法。设计这个法术的人一定疯了，因为如果没有人来控制，这些亡灵怪物就会自由地摧毁它们遇到的一切！难怪这个法术被藏在大图书馆里。不过，有一件护身符的记载，任何亡灵生物在持有它的人面前都会颤抖。我必须回到图书馆，看看能否找到更多关于这个魔法护身符的记载。一旦我得到它并能创造和控制亡灵龙，就连德拉肯领主和他的爪牙也要在我的力量面前颤抖！

english: I have spent nearly 2 full weeks searching the great library for a reference to the writings that I need, with no success. Soon I shall be forced to start searching through the tombs and grimoires page by page.
translation: 我花了将近整整两周的时间在大图书馆寻找我需要的文献记载，但没有成功。很快我将不得不开始逐页搜索那些墓穴和魔法书。

english: I have found a reference to the crystal! This morning, while reading the histories of Morytania, I happened upon this extract: 'And so our mighty Ruler ordered the mines to be sealed forever and all those who slaved in the mines to be slain. Only by doing this could we seal away the threat of the Accursed Shard for all time!' I suspect this Accursed Shard to be the crystal that I seek! My next course of action must be to discover where these mines that are mentioned can be found.
translation: 我找到了关于水晶的记载！今天早上，在阅读莫利塔尼亚的历史时，我偶然发现了这段摘录：'因此我们强大的统治者下令永远封存矿井，并杀死所有在矿井中劳作的奴隶。只有这样，我们才能永远封印被诅咒碎片的威胁！'我怀疑这个被诅咒的碎片就是我寻找的水晶！我的下一步行动必须是找出这些提到的矿井在哪里。

english: Once again, the great library has provided the answer. I have found an ancient map that shows a series of mines in south-western Morytania, on the River Salve. These mines are not shown on modern maps. They must be the place I seek. Tomorrow I shall go and find them!
translation: 大图书馆再次提供了答案。我找到了一张古代地图，显示莫利塔尼亚西南部萨尔维河畔有一系列矿井。这些矿井没有出现在现代地图上。它们一定是我要找的地方。明天我就去找它们！

english: Today has been a hard day. We travelled south through desolate swamps, which were infested with ghasts. Many of my servants and soldiers fell to these creatures, but I have granted them eternal life as the undead, so that they may continue to serve me.
translation: 今天是艰难的一天。我们向南穿过荒凉的沼泽，那里到处都是食尸鬼。我的许多仆从和士兵倒在了这些生物手中，但我赐予了他们永恒的亡灵生命，这样他们就能继续为我服务。

english: At last we have reached the mines! All my human companions have perished, but I have animated their corpses and now have servants aplenty to do my bidding. I just wish they weren't all so stupid! This afternoon we shall search for the entrance to the mines.
translation: 我们终于到达了矿井！我所有的人类同伴都死了，但我复活了他们的尸体，现在有足够的仆从听我差遣。我只希望他们别都那么愚蠢！今天下午我们将寻找矿井的入口。

english: It has been an eventful morning. The day started with us finding a madman wandering in the area, also searching for an entrance to the mine. I tricked him into telling me where the original entrance was, and from there my zombie minions soon found a way into the mines themselves. I can feel very powerful magic at work here, possibly even stronger than my own! In an attempt to find the source of this magic, I shall spend this afternoon preparing and casting spells of location and scrying.
translation: 这是一个多事的早晨。一天开始时我们发现一个疯子在附近游荡，也在寻找矿井入口。我骗他说出了原始入口的位置，从那里我的僵尸仆从很快就找到了进入矿井的路。我能感觉到这里有非常强大的魔法在运作，可能比我的还要强大！为了找到这个魔法的来源，今天下午我将准备并施放定位和探知法术。

english: I have seen the crystal that I seek, however it is guarded by a spirit of extreme power! I shall have my undead create a small dungeon, where I will be safe from attack and then I shall send them forth to slay this fell spirit. I'm sure even one as powerful as that will fall to the numbers of undead that I can summon.
translation: 我看到了我寻找的水晶，但它由一个极其强大的灵魂守护！我将让我的亡灵建造一个小地牢，在那里我可以安全地免受攻击，然后我会派它们去杀死这个邪恶的灵魂。我相信即使像它那样强大的存在也会倒在我能召唤的亡灵大军面前。

english: Work began on the passage to my suite of rooms. My slaves work hard when the work is as simple as this, and we made excellent progress. The only thing of interest is that we found some strange stone blocks, of a design that I have not seen before. I may study them further when I have more time available.
translation: 通往我套房区域的通道工程开始了。当工作像这样简单时，我的奴隶们工作很努力，我们取得了很好的进展。唯一有趣的是我们发现了一些奇怪的石块，设计是我以前从未见过的。等我有更多时间时，我可能会进一步研究它们。

english: Today we excavated the entrance to a building! I do not recognise the style of masonry used, but the creators must have been about the same height and girth as I am, judging by the size of doorways and stair- cases. The temple is fraught with traps, but will make a fine base for me to wait whilst my army of undead retrieve a piece of the Salve Crystal. I have several theories pertaining to the origin of this strange temple. If I am correct we are deep underground, directly below the village of Burgh de Rott. It may be that this temple was built as a fortification against an invasion from the desert nomads, who live to the west of here. Alternatively, perhaps it was built at the bequest of one of the lesser vampyre lords who ruled this area when Drakan came to power. However, I believe that it was probably built to guard an ancient treasure. My reasoning is thus; there doesn't seem to be any type of altar that we have found yet and the temple is littered with traps. Further research may reveal an answer. In the meantime I have enchanted this diary of mine with the spell needed to enhance the powers of the crystal. I await my minions' return.
translation: 今天我们挖掘出了一座建筑的入口！我不认识所用的石工风格，但从门道和楼梯的尺寸来看，建造者一定和我差不多高矮胖瘦。这座神庙布满陷阱，但对我来说是个不错的基地，可以在这里等待我的亡灵大军取回萨尔维水晶碎片。关于这座奇怪神庙的起源，我有几种推测。如果我没猜错，我们正深藏地下，就在伯格德罗特镇的正下方。也许这座神庙是为了抵御来自西边沙漠游牧民族的入侵而建的防御工事。又或者，它是在德拉坎掌权时统治此地的某位次级吸血鬼领主的遗愿下建造的。不过，我认为它很可能是为了守护一件古代宝藏而建。我的理由是：我们至今没有发现任何祭坛，而且神庙里到处都是陷阱。进一步的研究或许能揭示答案。与此同时，我已用增强水晶力量的咒语附魔了我的这本日记。我正等待我的仆从归来。

english: My skin hurts. The sunlight stings. Cooked flesh is too dry. What changed? How long has it been since I dined as a member of my House? How long since I was left behind?
translation: 我的皮肤疼痛。阳光刺痛。熟肉太干了。什么变了？我作为家族成员用餐已经多久了？我被遗弃多久了？

english: I no longer dine. I hunt. I kill. I survive. But within these moments of scarcity and hunger my senses come alive. Ancient instincts boil to the surface and command my body to action. A part of me rejects this savagery. The part that insists in writing this journal. But another revels in it. It matters not which I wish to follow, only one will allow me to endure.
translation: 我不再用餐。我狩猎。我杀戮。我生存。但在这些匮乏和饥饿的时刻，我的感官变得敏锐。古老的直觉涌上表面，命令我的身体行动。我的一部分拒绝这种野蛮。就是坚持写这本日记的那部分。但另一部分却乐在其中。我想跟随哪个并不重要，只有一个能让我活下去。

english: The portal is closed. These will be the last words of House Shadum written on Vampyrium.

english: But the whispers became moans...

english: At once fearsome and enticing like the call of some beautiful siren.

english: Tekton is strong! Tekton was always strong, but now Master made Tekton even stronger. Tekton is pleased.
translation: 泰克顿很强！泰克顿一直很强，但现在主人让泰克顿更强了。泰克顿很满意。

english: Tekton has served Master for long time. Tekton built huge buildings, clever buildings with magic in the walls. Tekton made buildings for people to praise Master in, big buildings with pretty decorations so everyone knows how great Master is.
translation: 泰克顿为主人服务了很久。泰克顿建造了巨大的建筑，巧妙的设计，墙里有魔法的建筑。泰克顿建造了让人们赞美主人的大建筑，装饰精美，让所有人都知道主人有多伟大。

english: Then Master had to leave kingdom. People ungrateful, didn't understand they should obey Master like Tekton did.
translation: 后来主人不得不离开王国。人们不知感恩，不明白他们应该像泰克顿一样服从主人。

english: Tekton left kingdom with Master, and Master's loyal friends. Master came up mountain to find funny crystal.
translation: 泰克顿和主人以及主人的忠诚朋友一起离开了王国。主人上山寻找有趣的水晶。

english: Tekton was clever, understood all about crystals. Tekton knew how to draw power from crystals to make magic buildings for Master.
translation: 泰克顿很聪明，完全了解水晶。泰克顿知道如何从水晶中汲取力量，为主人建造魔法建筑。

english: Tekton not sure how it worked anymore. Ever since Master made Tekton so strong, Tekton can't remember much about crystals.
translation: 泰克顿不确定那是怎么运作的了。自从主人让泰克顿变得这么强，泰克顿就不太记得水晶的事了。

english: Tekton can't remember how to make buildings either.
translation: 泰克顿也不记得怎么建造建筑了。

english: Tekton can't remember much about Tekton anymore. Didn't Tekton have a spouse back in the big kingdom? Tekton not sure what spouse is for anymore.
translation: 泰克顿也不太记得自己的事了。泰克顿在大王国里不是有配偶吗？泰克顿不确定配偶是干什么的了。

english: But that okay. Master made Tekton strong, so Master must want Tekton's strength, not Tekton's memory.
translation: 但那没关系。主人让泰克顿变强，所以主人要的是泰克顿的力量，不是泰克顿的记忆。

english: Mountain caves have magic that Master wanted, but Master didn't know how to take it. But Tekton clever - Tekton learnt to take the magic from the caves.
translation: 山洞里有主人想要的魔法，但主人不知道怎么取。但泰克顿聪明——泰克顿学会了从山洞里取魔法。

english: Tekton built Master a new temple on mountain top. Tekton's temple could focus cave magic, bring it out of caves so anyone could use it without needing to be as clever as Tekton.
translation: 泰克顿在山顶为主人建了新神殿。泰克顿的神殿能汇聚山洞魔法，把它带出山洞，让任何人都能用，不需要像泰克顿那么聪明。

english: Master used Tekton's temple to wield cave magic. It made Master very happy.
translation: 主人用泰克顿的神殿施展山洞魔法。这让主人非常开心。

english: But Master not so happy when everyone else started wielding cave magic too, especially nasty high priest. Master didn't really like the high priest.
translation: 但当其他人也开始施展山洞魔法时，主人就不那么开心了，尤其是那个讨厌的大祭司。主人不太喜欢大祭司。
