english: Master told Tekton to shut down temple. Master wanted Tekton to find new ways to wield cave magic, but so only Master could do it. Tekton broke temple like Master said - but only slightly, so Tekton can fix it again if Master ever changes his mind.
translation: 主人让泰克顿关闭神殿。主人想让泰克顿找到施展山洞魔法的新方法，但只有主人能用。泰克顿按主人说的拆了神殿——但只拆了一点，这样如果主人改变主意，泰克顿还能修好。

english: Tekton tried to teach Master how to wield cave magic without needing temple, but Master couldn't do it. Maybe Master didn't understand crystals as well as Tekton did.
translation: 泰克顿试着教主人不用神殿施展山洞魔法，但主人做不到。也许主人不像泰克顿那么懂水晶。

english: Master not so happy about that.
translation: 主人对此不太高兴。

english: One day Master took Tekton into cave, and promised to reward Tekton for all Tekton's service. Master promised Tekton immortality! Tekton very happy.
translation: 有一天主人带泰克顿进了山洞，答应奖励泰克顿的服务。主人答应给泰克顿永生！泰克顿非常高兴。

english: Master created new body for Tekton out of rock and metal from caves, and transferred Tekton's soul into it. Tekton's old body disintegrated, but that okay now Tekton was living in shiny new body that Master made.
translation: 主人用山洞里的岩石和金属为泰克顿造了新身体，把泰克顿的灵魂转移进去。泰克顿的旧身体消散了，但没关系，现在泰克顿住在主人做的闪亮新身体里。

english: Master enchanted Tekton's anvil, and brought it into cave, and taught Tekton to use it to fix the new body whenever it get damaged. Master may not understand crystals as well as Tekton, but Master still very powerful.
translation: 主人给泰克顿的铁砧施了魔法，带进山洞，教泰克顿用它修复新身体。主人可能不如泰克顿懂水晶，但主人仍然非常强大。

english: New body is very strong, stronger than Tekton's old body. Master protected it from magic damage and ranged damage too; anyone want to hit Tekton now, Tekton hit them straight back!
translation: 新身体非常强壮，比泰克顿的旧身体强。主人还保护它免受魔法伤害和远程伤害；现在谁想打泰克顿，泰克顿就直接打回去！

english: Now Tekton very strong, but Master's friends were rude. They called Tekton stupid. Tekton got confused - new body is what Master made, so new body must be better. But Master's friends not want to talk to Tekton anymore, especially nasty high priest.
translation: 现在泰克顿很强，但主人的朋友很粗鲁。他们叫泰克顿蠢。泰克顿糊涂了——新身体是主人做的，所以新身体一定更好。但主人的朋友不想再和泰克顿说话了，尤其是那个讨厌的大祭司。

english: So Tekton staying in cave now, near anvil. It safer for Tekton to stay near anvil, so Tekton can repair body if it get damaged.
translation: 所以泰克顿现在待在山洞里，靠近铁砧。泰克顿待在铁砧附近更安全，这样身体受损时可以修复。

english: Tekton wonders sometimes why new body doesn't understand crystals as well as old body did.
translation: 泰克顿有时想，为什么新身体不如旧身体懂水晶。

english: Tekton wonders what happened to Tekton's spouse from big kingdom, or Tekton's children. They sound important, but Tekton can't remember much.
translation: 泰克顿想知道大王国里的配偶怎么样了，或者泰克顿的孩子。他们听起来很重要，但泰克顿记不太清了。

english: But Tekton not worried. Master made Tekton this body, so this body must be what Tekton needs to serve Master best.
translation: 但泰克顿不担心。主人给泰克顿做了这具身体，所以这具身体一定是泰克顿最好地服务主人所需要的。

english: Tekton had better keep on using anvil to make body strong, until Master come back to give Tekton more work to do.
translation: 泰克顿最好继续用铁砧强化身体，直到主人回来给泰克顿更多工作。

english: Until then, Tekton can wait for Master.
translation: 在那之前，泰克顿可以等主人。

english: Bervirius, son of King Danthalas, was killed in battle. His devout mother Rashiliyia was so heartbroken that she swore fealty to Zamorak if he would return her son to her. Bervirius returned as an undead creature and terrorized the King and Queen. Many guards died fighting the undead Bervirius. Eventually the undead Bervirius was set on fire and soon only the bones remained. His remains were taken far to the South, and then towards the setting sun to a tomb that is surrounded by and level with the sea. This is the only way to contain the spirits of witches and the undead.
translation: 丹萨拉斯国王之子贝维里乌斯战死沙场。他虔诚的母亲拉希利娅悲痛欲绝，向萨莫拉克宣誓效忠，祈求他让儿子归来。贝维里乌斯以亡灵之身归来，令国王和王后惊恐万分。许多卫兵在与亡灵贝维里乌斯的战斗中牺牲。最终亡灵贝维里乌斯被烈火焚烧，只剩下骨头。他的遗骸被带到遥远的南方，再朝着落日方向，送往一座被海水环绕、与海面齐平的坟墓。这是唯一能封印女巫和亡灵灵魂的方法。

english: I don't know if you'll ever be in a position where you can read this. However, if you do, I want you to know that I'm sorry. I once believed that the choice between right and wrong was a clear one. I now know that is not the case. I never wanted to hurt you, but I did what I did for a reason. To have chosen otherwise could have hurt thousands. I hope one day you will understand.
translation: 我不知道你是否有机会读到这封信。但如果你读到了，我想让你知道我很抱歉。我曾以为对与错之间的选择是清晰的。现在我知道并非如此。我从不想伤害你，但我所做的一切都有原因。若选择另一条路，可能会伤害成千上万的人。我希望有一天你能理解。

english: He stabbed me! He actually stabbed me! And now here I am, bleeding out on the floor. You'd think that living in Morytania I'd have prepared myself for death, but I find the idea of my impending end more terrifying then I would have ever thought possible. Still, that is not why I write this note. As it's likely that I'll have left this world before I'm found here, this is my only way to explain what happened here.
translation: 他捅了我！他真的捅了我！现在我躺在这里，血流满地。你会以为住在莫利塔尼亚，我早就做好了面对死亡的准备，但我发现自己对即将到来的终结的恐惧远超想象。不过，这不是我写这张笔记的原因。既然我很可能在被发现之前就离开这个世界，这是我解释这里发生之事的唯一方式。

english: First, some background. Along with a few of the others, I was recently reassigned to mine out some new caves north of the current laboratories. The vampyres wish to expand their research operations down here and more room is needed. After many weeks of mining, we ended up breaking through into another set of tunnels. Saradomin only knows how long they've been here, but it's clear they are not natural.
translation: 首先，一些背景。最近我和其他几个人被重新指派去开采当前实验室以北的一些新洞穴。吸血鬼们想扩大这里的研究行动，需要更多空间。经过数周的采矿，我们最终打通了另一组隧道。只有萨拉多明知道它们存在了多久，但很明显它们不是天然的。

english: Most of the others went back to report what we'd found. Jovan though, being the fool he is, decided he wanted to take a closer look. I should have gone back with the others, but I didn't want to leave him alone. Big mistake. We soon found ourselves in a large chamber full of coffins and gravestones. The same chamber where you'll have likely found this note.
translation: 大多数人都回去报告我们的发现了。但约万那个蠢货，非要凑近看看。我本该跟其他人一起回去的，可我不想丢下他一个人。大错特错。我们很快就发现自己身处一个满是棺材和墓碑的大密室里。你大概就是在这个密室里找到这张笔记的。

english: At one end of the chamber, there were some strange ruins giving out a weird light. On the floor before them sat a strange talisman and a dagger. As we got closer, I could swear I heard someone whispering to me. I looked around and saw no one though. I called out to Jovan and told him we should head back. At that point though, something terrible happened. He turned to face me but there was a dark look in his eyes, like his mind wasn't his own anymore. He picked up the talisman and the dagger and walked towards me. Before I could do anything, he stabbed me right in the chest. As he did, he leaned towards me and said, 'this blood will make things right'. As I fell to the floor, I saw him run out of the chamber and head off through the unexplored tunnels.
translation: 密室的一端有些奇怪的废墟，散发着诡异的光芒。它们面前的地板上放着一个奇怪的护符和一把匕首。我们走近时，我发誓听到有人在对我低语。我环顾四周，却看不到任何人。我喊约万，告诉他我们该回去了。可就在这时，可怕的事情发生了。他转过身来面对我，但眼神里透着黑暗，仿佛他的心智已不再属于自己。他捡起护符和匕首，朝我走来。我还没来得及反应，他就刺中了我的胸口。他俯身对我说：'这血会让一切重回正轨。'我倒在地上时，看到他跑出密室，钻进了未探索的隧道里。

english: Well, there you have it. Just a little story of how my end finally came for me. If you want my advice, which you probably don't, you should seal this place. There's a darkness here that should remain hidden.
translation: 好了，事情就是这样。这就是我最终结局的小故事。如果你想听我的建议——虽然你大概不想——你应该封住这个地方。这里有股黑暗，应当永远被隐藏。

english: Lucien has given you another pendant!
translation: 卢西安又给了你一枚吊坠！

english: The guardian has given you a pendant.
translation: 守护者给了你一枚吊坠。

english: ... and I was able to finally defeat Drakan, but it was too late to stop Safalaan's transformation...
translation: ……我终于击败了德雷坎，但阻止萨法拉安的转变已经太迟了……

english: To adapt to a new form is no easy task. Guide your friend, [player name]. He will need your help in coming to terms with this.
translation: 适应新的形态并非易事。引导你的朋友，[player name]。他需要你的帮助来接受这一切。

english: ... and now the people of Wyrmscraig are protected by a golem of Elessia's making.
translation: ……如今威姆斯克雷格的居民由艾莱西亚制造的魔像守护着。

english: ... so I managed to infiltrate the Red Reef Trading Company.
translation: ……于是我设法潜入了红礁贸易公司。

english: Never was a story of more woe
translation: 从未有过如此悲伤的故事

english: That this of Juliet and her Romeo.
translation: 比朱丽叶和她的罗密欧更令人心碎。

english: ... So that was how I became King of Miscellania!
translation: ……就这样，我成了米斯凯尼亚的国王！

english: ... So that was how I became Queen of Miscellania!
translation: ……就这样，我成了米斯凯尼亚的女王！

english: We arrived today in a new land, and while we have a singular purpose, it feels only right to document everything we discover. After all, any new findings could greatly benefit the Empire. The first thing to note is that this land is not as uninhabited as originally believed. Alongside the dwarves we are pursuing, there's also a small band of humans. More interestingly, there is what appears to be a Zamorakian presence here. Given this activity, the Carnifex Maximus is keen to keep our work a secret, so has requested we find a secluded location to make camp.
translation: 我们今天抵达了一片新土地，虽然我们目标明确，但记录下一切发现似乎也是应当的。毕竟，任何新发现都可能为帝国带来巨大利益。首先要注意的是，这片土地并非如最初所认为的那样无人居住。除了我们追踪的矮人外，还有一小群人类。更有趣的是，这里似乎有扎莫拉基安势力的存在。鉴于这些活动，卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯急于保守我们的秘密，因此要求我们找个隐蔽的地方扎营。

english: The venators worked their magic again. They have found some isolated woods on the far side of this new landmass, hidden behind some mountains. We will not be disturbed there. The Carnifex Maximus has ordered a camp be constructed at once. He does not wish to waste any time in beginning our search for the dwarves. However, said dwarves may well be the least interesting thing about this land, for the woods where we are making camp are also home to some ruins. When time permits, I will be sure to take a closer look.
translation: 猎人们再次施展了他们的魔法。他们在这片新陆地的远端找到了一片隐蔽的树林，藏在群山之后。我们在那里不会被打扰。卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯下令立即建造营地。他不想在开始搜寻矮人上浪费任何时间。然而，那些矮人可能远不是这片土地最有趣的东西，因为我们扎营的树林里还有一些废墟。等有时间，我一定会仔细看看。

english: The camp is complete and the venators have been dispatched to locate the dwarves. In the meantime, the rest of us have little to do but wait. The Carnifex Maximus doesn't entirely approve of my desire to investigate the ruins, but he is being far more amiable than usual. He knows that many disagree with us being out here. He claims the target to be a danger to the Empire who cannot be allowed to live, but it's hard to ignore the role the Carnifex Maximus' pride may be playing. After all, this is the first time anyone has escaped his axe.
translation: 营地建好了，猎人们被派去寻找矮人。与此同时，我们其他人无事可做，只能等待。卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯并不完全赞同我调查废墟的愿望，但他比平时友善得多。他知道很多人不赞成我们来到这里。他声称目标是帝国的威胁，不能让他活着，但很难忽视卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯的自尊心可能在其中扮演的角色。毕竟，这是第一次有人从他的斧下逃脱。

english: My exploration of the ruins was a great success! The most exciting of my discoveries is the fact that these ruins belonged to a previously unknown race. Also of interest is the fact that the extinction of this race seems to have been fairly recent. In fact, there's some evidence to suggest the Zamorakian presence we encountered before might be partially to blame, though further investigation will be needed to be sure. There's a strange ritual site on the western age of the area that seems worth exploring, though that will be a job for tomorrow.
translation: 我对废墟的探索取得了巨大成功！最令人兴奋的发现是，这些废墟属于一个此前未知的种族。同样有趣的是，这个种族的灭绝似乎发生在不久之前。事实上，有一些证据表明我们之前遇到的扎莫拉基安势力可能部分负有责任，不过还需要进一步调查才能确定。该区域西侧有一个奇怪的仪式场地，似乎值得探索，不过那是明天的事了。

english: My discoveries at the ritual site gave me many answers, but many questions as well. This race used a language unlike any I've seen before, so understanding doesn't come easy. However, it seems that while the Zamorakians played a role, the extinction of this race was actually caused by themselves. They attempted something. It's not clear what exactly, but whatever it was, it didn't go well. To learn more, I've collected a sample from the ritual site to investigate.
translation: 我在仪式场地的发现给了我许多答案，但也带来了许多问题。这个种族使用的语言与我见过的任何语言都不同，所以理解起来并不容易。然而，似乎虽然扎莫拉基安人扮演了角色，但这个种族的灭绝实际上是由他们自己造成的。他们尝试了某种东西。不清楚具体是什么，但无论是什么，结果并不顺利。为了了解更多，我从仪式场地收集了一个样本进行研究。

english: It seems my eagerness may have come at a cost. The sample I collected from the ritual site was carrying some sort of parasite, and of course, it was the Carnifex Maximus himself who ended up getting infected. He showed little interest in my work, right until I told him it had the potential to kill. That got his attention right away. The timing couldn't be worse, for the venators have also located the dwarves. The Carnifex Maximus should be resting and recovering while we deal with the parasite, but he has insisted we prepare to hunt down our target.
translation: 看来我的急切可能付出了代价。我从仪式场地收集的样本携带了某种寄生虫，而最终被感染的恰恰是卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯本人。他对我的工作没什么兴趣，直到我告诉他这东西可能致命。那立刻引起了他的注意。时机再糟糕不过了，因为猎人们也找到了矮人。卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯本应在我们处理寄生虫时休息恢复，但他坚持要我们准备追捕目标。

english: They attacked! The dwarves must have tracked the venators, for they found our camp with ease. Most of our party is dead or injured, but the worst is what happened to the Carnifex Maximus. They took his head clean off! He's a vampyre! It shouldn't have been possible, but they did it all the same! The parasite must be to blame. It's far more dangerous than we thought, and I fear others may be infected as well. Many have claimed to be feeling strangely unwell, and one of the legionaries even started having visions. Of all things, he thought he saw the Carnifex Maximus' body move!
translation: 他们袭击了！矮人一定追踪了猎人，因为他们轻而易举地找到了我们的营地。我们的人大多死伤，但最糟糕的是卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯的遭遇。他们把他的头整个砍了下来！他是吸血鬼！这本不可能发生，但他们就是做到了！一定是寄生虫的错。它比我们想象的危险得多，我担心其他人也可能被感染了。许多人声称感觉异常不适，其中一个军团兵甚至开始出现幻觉。最离谱的是，他以为自己看到卡尼费克斯.马克西姆斯的尸体动了！

english: Cyamus,
translation: 赛亚姆斯，

english: Thank you so much for what you did yesterday. I warned the children not to go near the prisoners, but it seems naive curiosity won this time. I don't want to think what might have happened if the Centurion had found out, so once again, thank you. I also wanted to ask if the name 'Zamorak' means anything to you? I've never heard it before, but apparently one of the prisoners mentioned it to the children. They've been saying it ever since.
translation: 非常感谢你昨天所做的一切。我警告过孩子们不要靠近囚犯，但看来天真的好奇心这次赢了。我不敢想象如果百夫长发现了会发生什么，所以再次感谢你。我还想问一下，'扎莫拉克'这个名字对你有什么意义吗？我以前从未听过，但显然有个囚犯对孩子们提到了它。他们从那以后就一直念叨着。

english: With love, Ernik
translation: 爱你的，厄尔尼克

english: Ernik
translation: 厄尔尼克

english: More studying for you my friend.
translation: 朋友，你又有得研究了。

english: Arrav, kill him.
translation: 阿拉夫，杀了他。

english: Arrav, kill her.
translation: 阿拉夫，杀了她。

english: Arrav, kill them.
translation: 阿拉夫，杀了他们。

english: I'm leaving Morytania. It's not safe for me here anymore. Not now Vanescula is gone. It felt only right to come find you and tell you to leave as well.
translation: 我要离开莫利塔尼亚了。这里对我来说不再安全。瓦内斯库拉已经不在了。我觉得应该来告诉你，让你也离开。

english: Leave? I have no intention of leaving.
translation: 离开？我可不打算离开。

english: I'm sorry, but you don't have any hope against Lowerniel Drakan. You are not strong enough to stop him. The only choice you have is to leave or die.
translation: 抱歉，但你对洛厄尼尔.德雷坎没有任何胜算。你不够强大，阻止不了他。你唯一的选择就是离开或者死。

english: The Blood Moon Rises quest will become available later today.
translation: 血月升起任务将在今天晚些时候开放。

english: And do what? To stand against Drakan... It would be suicide!
translation: 然后做什么？对抗德雷坎……那是自杀！

english: They may be gone, but this fight isn't over. There's always still hope. You wouldn't have come here if you didn't believe that yourself.
translation: 他们或许不在了，但这场战斗还没结束。总有希望。如果你自己不相信，你就不会来这里。

english: I am, but hopefully not alone. I still have a couple of friends left here.
translation: 我是要离开，但希望不是独自一人。我在这里还有几个朋友。

english: If you're leaving Morytania, do you have a safe way out?
translation: 如果你要离开莫利塔尼亚，你有安全的出路吗？

english: I'll do what I can. Now I'd best get going. I need to go and see Ivan.
translation: 我会尽我所能。现在我该走了。我得去见伊万。

english: This doesn't sound good... Can you wait here for a little while? I get the feeling I'm going to need to be well prepared for whatever you have to tell me. I'll be back as soon as I can.
translation: 听起来不太妙……你能在这里等一会儿吗？我感觉无论你要告诉我什么，我都需要好好准备一下。我会尽快回来的。

english: I'll wait a short while, but don't take too long.
translation: 我会等一会儿，但别太久。

english: It looks like Ivan has built a makeshift shrine to the fallen Myreque.
translation: 看起来伊万为逝去的迈雷克成员搭建了一个临时神龛。

english: So you want us to go there?
translation: 所以你想让我们去那里？

english: We can't give up, Ivan!
translation: 我们不能放弃，伊万！

english: He has Safalaan.
translation: 他抓走了萨法拉恩。

english: More than afraid, but I won't give up on Safalaan.
translation: 不只是害怕，但我不会放弃萨法拉恩。

english: Alright... Just give me a moment to get a few things together...
translation: 好吧……给我一点时间收拾些东西……

english: Are you ready to go to Darkmeyer?
translation: 你准备好去达克迈尔了吗？

english: I am, but it doesn't look like you are. You should put on your disguise before we set off. I think I saw it in that chest in the corner.
translation: 我准备好了，但看起来你还没准备好。出发前你应该戴上伪装。我记得在角落那个宝箱里见过。

english: I am, but it doesn't look like you are. You should put on your disguise before we set off.
translation: 我准备好了，但看起来你还没准备好。出发前你应该戴上伪装。

english: As bad as you'd expect. I'd rather not talk about it.
translation: 比你想的还糟。我不想多谈。

english: But you're doing okay?
translation: 但你还好吧？

english: Like I said... I'm surviving.
translation: 我说过了……我在撑着。

english: No. There is only one hope for us now, but if you would rather die than accept that, then die you will.
translation: 不。我们现在只有一个希望，但如果你宁愿死也不接受，那就去死吧。

english: With the blood of the half-icyene, I have been able to create a portal to travel to and from Vampyrium, but his blood alone isn't enough to transport us all. For that, more will be needed.
translation: 借助半冰裔的血，我得以创造传送门来往于吸血鬼界，但仅凭他的血不足以传送我们所有人。为此，需要更多。

english: And how do you propose to achieve these sacrifices?
translation: 那你打算如何实现这些献祭？

english: For that, fate seems to have already provided the answer. A blood moon will soon rise over these lands, and it will do so on the exact same night that one rises over Vampyrium.
translation: 为此，命运似乎已经给出了答案。血月即将升起在这片土地上，而且恰好会在吸血鬼界升起血月的同一个夜晚。

english: And so, on that night, we shall finally hunt again, for at long last, we shall experience the Night of the Blood Moon once more.
translation: 所以，在那个夜晚，我们终将再次狩猎，因为终于，我们将再次体验血月之夜。

english: The Night of the Blood Moon? You would bring back that festival?
translation: 血月之夜？你要复兴那个节日？

english: Festival? A night of carnage would be a better description! You can't possibly believe we'll go along with this, Drakan!
translation: 节日？说是屠杀之夜更恰当！你不可能以为我们会同意这个，德拉肯！

english: You would see us go back to being mere beasts! We will not have it! You are a failure, Drakan. It's time we had a new leader. One who understands who we are now, rather than lamenting over what we once were.
translation: 你想让我们变回野兽！我们绝不答应！你是个失败者，德拉肯。是时候换个新领袖了。一个懂得我们如今是谁的人，而不是哀叹我们曾经是什么。

english: Now, I must return to Vampyrium. There is much I need to prepare before the festival begins. The wise among you will begin to prepare as well.
translation: 现在，我必须返回吸血鬼界。节日开始前我有很多要准备的。你们中明智的人也该开始准备了。

english: As a starting point, you may wish to deal with the two humans that stand among you, unless of course you've all become so weak that you can't even do that anymore...
translation: 作为开始，你们或许该处理掉站在你们中间的那两个人类，当然，除非你们都已经弱到连这都做不到了……

english: Ivan! We need to get out of here!
translation: 伊万！我们得离开这里！

english: Damn it!
translation: 该死！

english: Ivan! We can't stay here!
translation: 伊万！我们不能待在这里！

english: What's happening, Ivan?!
translation: 怎么了，伊万？！

english: I'm not looking so good here! I could use some food if you have any!
translation: 我看起来不太妙！如果你有食物的话，我需要一些！

english: You don't have anything suitable to heal Ivan with.
translation: 你没有适合治疗伊万的东西。

english: It doesn't matter. I'm just glad you're okay.
translation: 没关系。你没事就好。

english: But how? We'll barely get anyone out in time.
translation: 但怎么做到？我们几乎来不及把所有人救出来。

english: We stop Drakan! Stop him before he can begin this festival of his!
translation: 我们阻止德拉肯！在他开始这个节日之前阻止他！

english: There must be a way. Maybe we could make our own portal there? Or perhaps there's some existing form of teleportation we can use?
translation: 一定有办法。也许我们可以自己造一个传送门？或者有某种现有的传送方式可以用？

english: It sounded like it took Drakan years to work it out, and it only became possible thanks to Safalaan. Even if we could find a way, we don't have the time!
translation: 听起来德拉肯花了多年才弄明白，而且多亏了萨法拉恩才得以实现。就算我们能找到办法，我们也没有时间！

english: I've got it! It's like you said: this is all only possible because of Safalaan! His blood is the catalyst! It doesn't matter how much other blood Drakan can gather. Without Safalaan, his whole plan is over!
translation: 我想到了！就像你说的：这一切之所以可能，全靠萨法拉恩！他的血是催化剂！不管德拉肯能收集多少其他血，没有萨法拉恩，他的整个计划就完了！

english: Here's what we do: We find this portal, use it to travel to Vampyrium, find and rescue Safalaan, and then return here, closing the portal behind us when we do. Drakan would be left trapped there!
translation: 我们这样办：找到这个传送门，用它前往吸血鬼界，找到并救出萨法拉恩，然后回到这里，回来时把传送门关上。德拉肯就会被困在那里！

english: Maybe, but while there's still some hope, even slim, we can't give up.
translation: 也许吧，但只要还有一线希望，哪怕渺茫，我们也不能放弃。

english: With more help. Drakan didn't quite kill all the Myreque.
translation: 需要更多帮手。德拉肯并没有杀光所有迈雷克成员。

english: He might not, but we need to at least try to convince him.
translation: 他可能不会同意，但我们至少得试着说服他。

english: Indeed. Any idea where he might have gone?
translation: 确实。知道他会去哪里吗？

english: Then let's get over there.
translation: 那我们过去吧。

english: I'll meet you outside the church in Slepe. Oh, and [player name]...
translation: 我在斯莱普镇的教堂外等你。哦，还有，[player name]……

english: I'll be heading over to Slepe soon. I'll meet you outside the church there.
translation: 我很快就要去斯莱普镇了。我在那边的教堂外等你。

english: Well, if Veliaf is here, someone must have seen him. We should ask around, and I reckon the pub will be the best place to start.
translation: 既然维利亚夫在这里，肯定有人见过他。我们该四处打听打听，我觉得酒馆是最好的起点。

english: I'll be fine. It's not like this is the first time Veliaf and I have had disagreements.
translation: 我没事的。这又不是我和维利亚夫第一次闹矛盾了。

english: I feel like it's a bit more than just disagreements this time... Not to mention, we have no idea what sort of headspace he'll be in.
translation: 我觉得这次可不只是闹矛盾那么简单……更别说，我们完全不知道他现在是什么状态。

english: I've known him long enough that I could make a pretty good guess. For so long he tried his best to protect me... to protect all of us.
translation: 我认识他够久了，大概能猜到。他一直以来都在尽力保护我……保护我们所有人。

english: After what happened in Darkmeyer, he finally realised he couldn't, and it broke him. Veliaf often said I was naive, but in truth, I think he was always the naive one.
translation: 达克迈尔那件事之后，他终于意识到自己做不到，这让他崩溃了。维利亚夫总说我天真，但说实话，我觉得他才是那个一直天真的人。

english: Anyway, it doesn't really matter. I may get why he left, but that doesn't change the fact that I might just hate him for it.
translation: 总之，这些都不重要了。我或许能理解他为什么离开，但这改变不了我可能因此恨他的事实。

english: As for if I'll be okay when we find him? The truth is that I don't think I'll know until we do, so we may as well get to it.
translation: 至于找到他之后我会不会没事？说实话，我觉得只有找到他才知道，所以我们还是赶紧行动吧。

english: Alright, I'll meet you back outside the church. Just don't take too long.
translation: 好，我在教堂外等你。别拖太久。

english: [player name]. Shall we get to it?
translation: [player name]。我们开始吧？

english: Indeed. I reckon the pub will be the best place to start.
translation: 没错。我觉得酒馆是最好的起点。

english: I'd say he'd be best described as a complete and utter cretin.
translation: 我觉得他就是个彻头彻尾的白痴。

english: Ah, yes I've seen him around. He was in here earlier in fact, having a drink...
translation: 啊，是的，我见过他。事实上他之前还来过这里喝酒……

english: I see... You don't happen to know where he went after he left, do you?
translation: 这样啊……你知道他离开后去了哪里吗？

english: I suppose that could be worth a look. Thanks for the help.
translation: 我想那值得去看看。谢谢你的帮助。

english: It was very much my pleasure, sir.
translation: 非常乐意帮忙，先生。

english: With how drunk you are, I'd say the answer is yes. How many have you had?
translation: 看你醉成这样，答案肯定是。你喝了多少？

english: Why? So you can run off again?
translation: 为什么？好让你再跑一次？

english: Run? Does it look like I'm running? Look around you! What do you see!
translation: 跑？我看起来像是在跑吗？看看你周围！你看到了什么！

english: What I see is a drunk who's desperately trying to get himself killed!
translation: 我看到的是一个拼命想把自己喝死的醉鬼！

english: Face it, Veliaf! You can spin things however you want, but the truth is, you abandoned us! You abandoned the Myreque!
translation: 面对现实吧，维利亚夫！你想怎么解释都行，但事实是，你抛弃了我们！你抛弃了迈雷克！

english: The Myreque are gone, Ivan!
translation: 迈雷克已经完了，伊万！

english: What plan?
translation: 什么计划？

english: Drakan is using Safalaan's blood to travel to and from Vampyrium.
translation: 德拉肯在用萨法拉恩的血来往于吸血鬼界。

english: It's apparently the original home of the vampyres. It seems Safalaan's blood is essential to getting there.
translation: 那里似乎是吸血鬼的故乡。看来萨法拉恩的血是到达那里的关键。

english: Pretty much. If we can bring Safalaan back, Drakan will end up trapped in Vampyrium.
translation: 差不多。如果我们能把萨法拉恩带回来，德拉肯就会被困在吸血鬼界。

english: So you'd just abandon him? I don't believe that!
translation: 所以你就想抛弃他？我不信！

english: Well, I abandoned you apparently! Maybe I was never the person you thought I was!
translation: 好吧，我显然也抛弃了你！也许我从来就不是你想象中的那个人！

english: You were always the person I thought you were, Veliaf! You tried so hard to be the father I lost, and you know what, yes, you were terrible at it! But you tried, and that was enough for me!
translation: 你一直都是我心目中的那个人，维利亚夫！你那么努力地想当我失去的父亲，你知道吗，是的，你当得很糟糕！但你努力了，这对我来说就够了！

english: I never lied about your parents!
translation: 我从来没有骗过你关于你父母的事！

english: I'm not a fool, Veliaf! I know who my mother really was! I know I'm the descendant of Ivandis Seergaze!
translation: 我不是傻瓜，维利亚夫！我知道我母亲到底是谁！我知道我是伊万迪斯·西尔盖兹的后裔！

english: [player name] didn't need to tell me, Veliaf! I worked it out for myself! I was so angry when I did, but I forgave you, because I believed in you!
translation: [player name]不需要告诉我，维利亚夫！我自己想明白了！当时我气得不行，但我原谅了你，因为我信任你！

english: Maybe you've finally lost your faith in yourself, Veliaf. I'd understand if you have. Truth be told, I thought I'd lost my faith in you as well.
translation: 也许你终于对自己失去了信心，维利亚夫。如果你真的这样，我能理解。说实话，我以为我也对你失去了信心。

english: Now, I'm going to Paterdomus. We need to work out how to reach Vampyrium. The library there seems like the best place to start.
translation: 现在，我要去帕特多莫斯。我们得想办法到达吸血鬼界。那里的图书馆似乎是最好的起点。

english: You can stay here and drink yourself to death if you want, Veliaf, but this fight isn't over yet. I trust you'll make the right choice.
translation: 你想留在这里把自己喝死也行，维利亚夫，但这场战斗还没结束。我相信你会做出正确的选择。

english: It seems it does, Drezel.
translation: 看来确实如此，德雷泽尔。

english: Like his mercenaries? How useful have they been? Face it, Drezel, we're on our own.
translation: 像他的雇佣兵？他们有什么用？面对现实吧，德雷泽尔，我们只能靠自己。

english: Ah, [player name]! Surely you are not in favour of this plan?
translation: 啊，[player name]！你该不会赞成这个计划吧？

english: Did Veliaf have anything else to say to you, [player name]?
translation: 维利亚夫还有没有跟你说别的，[player name]？

english: We need to find a way to reach this portal that Drakan has made. I reckon it's a pretty safe bet that it will be somewhere inside Castle Drakan.
translation: 我们得想办法找到德拉肯建的那个传送门。我敢打赌它肯定在德拉肯城堡里的某个地方。

english: Not through the front door, but I'd be surprised if that was the only way in there.
translation: 不是从正门进去，但如果那是唯一的入口，我倒会感到惊讶。

english: Are you sure? Vanescula once said the castle was impenetrable.
translation: 你确定吗？瓦内斯库拉曾说过这座城堡固若金汤。

english: But how do we go about finding out?
translation: 但我们怎么去查明呢？

english: Ivan tries to give you the journal, but you don't have enough room to take it.
translation: 伊万想把日记递给你，但你的背包空间不够。

english: Have a read of that old journal, [player name], and see what you reckon.
translation: 读读那本破旧的日记吧，[player name]，看看你有什么想法。

english: Exactly! He surely must have had some sort of plan for getting into the castle!
translation: 没错！他肯定有某种进入城堡的计划！

english: Maybe, but there's only one way to find out. Let's head up into the temple and see if we can find these writings.
translation: 也许吧，但只有一种方法能知道。我们上神庙去，看看能不能找到那些文字。

english: Well, I'd say they've well overstayed their welcome here anyway, so maybe it's about time we cleared them out.
translation: 嗯，我觉得他们在这里已经待得太久了，也许是时候把他们赶出去了。

english: Alright, I'll meet you back in the mausoleum. Just don't take too long.
translation: 好，我在陵墓等你。别拖太久。

english: And if this journal you found is to be believed, he did so while trying to kill Drakan.
translation: 而且如果你找到的这本日记可信的话，他是在试图杀死德拉坎时这么做的。

english: I always just thought they were trying to look out for me, but eventually I realised it was more than that. That there was something else going on.
translation: 我一直以为他们只是在照顾我，但后来我意识到不止如此。还有别的事情在发生。

english: I searched through the library below and found some information on Ivandis' family. It took some work, but I was eventually able to link them directly to my mother, and to me.
translation: 我翻遍了下面的图书馆，找到了一些关于伊万迪斯家族的信息。费了不少功夫，但最终我成功地将他们直接联系到了我的母亲，以及我自己。

english: At first I was angry, but I soon came to understand why. By that point though, there was no easy way to bring it up, and let's be honest, we often had more important things to worry about.
translation: 起初我很生气，但很快我理解了原因。不过到那时，提起这件事并不容易，而且说实话，我们常常有更重要的事情要担心。

english: An empty plinth. It doesn't seem to hold anything, or help offer any structural integrity.
translation: 一个空基座。它似乎不承载任何东西，也不提供任何结构支撑。

english: The window displays an ornate picture of a man riding a steed of some sort.
translation: 窗户上展示着一幅华丽的图画，画中一个男人骑着一匹某种坐骑。

english: The window displays an ornate picture of a man holding a mace high above his head.
translation: 窗户上展示着一幅华丽的图画，画中一个男人高举钉锤过头顶。

english: The window displays an ornate picture of a bearded man wielding a shield.
translation: 窗户上展示着一幅华丽的图画，画中一个留着胡子的男人手持盾牌。

english: The window displays an ornate picture of a woman with braided hair.
translation: 窗户上展示着一幅华丽的图画，画中一个编着辫子的女人。

english: The window displays an ornate picture of a man with a Guthixian symbol behind him.
translation: 窗户上展示着一幅华丽的图画，画中一个男人身后有古斯的符号。

english: The window displays an ornate picture of a solemn looking woman with white hair.
translation: 窗户上展示着一幅华丽的图画，画中一个神情严肃的白发女人。

english: The books on the plinths vanish before your eyes and you hear a click come from a nearby desk. Ivan searches the desk and finds something hidden inside.
translation: 基座上的书籍在你眼前消失，你听到附近书桌传来一声咔嗒声。伊万搜查了书桌，发现了藏在里面的东西。

english: [player name]! Over here!
translation: [player name]！这边！

english: In a weird way though, it kind of gives me hope. Ivandis may have died before he could kill Drakan, but thanks to him, we might now be able to succeed where he failed.
translation: 不过，从某种奇怪的角度来说，这给了我希望。伊万迪斯可能没能杀死德拉坎就死了，但多亏了他，我们现在也许能在他失败的地方取得成功。

english: Now, let's head back down to the mausoleum. Maybe best we don't mention Ivandis becoming a vampyre to Drezel...
translation: 现在，我们回陵墓去吧。最好别跟德雷泽尔提伊万迪斯变成吸血鬼的事……

english: Veliaf, about earlier...
translation: 维利亚夫，关于之前的事……

english: We'll talk about it later. In the meantime, Drezel tells me you've been working on some suicide plan to reach Vampyrium. Come on, let's hear it.
translation: 我们晚点再谈。与此同时，德雷泽尔告诉我你一直在计划什么自杀式行动去吸血鬼界。来吧，让我们听听。

english: We find this tunnel, use it to enter the castle, take Drakan's portal to Vampyrium, rescue Safalaan, then return through the portal, closing it behind us.
translation: 我们找到这条隧道，用它进入城堡，通过德拉坎的传送门去吸血鬼界，救出萨法拉恩，然后从传送门返回，并把它关在我们身后。

english: So where's this tunnel?
translation: 那这条隧道在哪？

english: Alright then, I guess we'd better get going.
translation: 好吧，我想我们最好出发了。

english: And I'm sure he'll send us his best wishes in return. Face it, Drezel, as far as everyone in Misthalin is concerned, Morytania is a lost cause.
translation: 我相信他也会送上最好的祝福。面对现实吧，德雷泽尔，就米斯塔林的所有人而言，莫利塔尼亚已经没救了。

english: Well, if you wanted inspiration, you shouldn't have come up with a suicide mission. Now let's go.
translation: 好吧，如果你想要灵感，就不该想出个自杀任务。现在走吧。

english: Fair enough. Just let us know if you change your mind.
translation: 有道理。如果你改变主意了，告诉我们一声。

english: I wish you wouldn't go ahead with this plan, but it seems you've made your decision. Please though, be careful, and make sure you take good care of Ivan.
translation: 我希望你不要继续这个计划，但看来你已经决定了。不过请小心，一定要照顾好伊万。

english: I will, Drezel. I promise.
translation: 我会的，德雷泽尔。我保证。

english: No point wasting any time. Let's go and investigate those caves.
translation: 没时间浪费了。我们去调查那些洞穴吧。

english: Mine through the blockage?
translation: 挖穿堵塞物？

english: You didn't bring a pickaxe with you?
translation: 你没带镐子来？

english: Well, I only have so much space to carry things.
translation: 嗯，我能携带的东西空间有限。

english: Any luck with that tunnel?
translation: 那条隧道有进展吗？

english: Well, let us know how it goes.
translation: 好吧，让我们知道进展如何。

english: They make us refine the daeyalt here. They use it to make more vampyres!
translation: 他们让我们在这里提炼达耶特矿石，用来制造更多的吸血鬼！

english: I'm sorry, but I don't know...
translation: 抱歉，我不知道……

english: I think this might be it, [player name].
translation: 我想就是这里了，[player name]。

english: This must be it. Keep a close eye out for vampyres.
translation: 应该就是这里了，小心提防吸血鬼。

english: You pray to the odd shrine, and a strange sensation washes over you. You feel that your Drakan's Medallion can now bring you back here.
translation: 你向那座奇特的神龛祈祷，一股奇异的感觉涌遍全身。你感到你的德拉坎奖章现在能带你回到这里。

english: What a lovely thought. No point in us waiting around I guess. Let's do this...
translation: 多么美好的想法。我想我们没必要再等了。动手吧……

english: We came through a dungeon to get into the one in Morytania. If this one matches that, then I bet that's where Safalaan is.
translation: 我们穿过地牢才进入莫利塔尼亚的那个。如果这个和那个一样，那我敢打赌萨法拉恩就在那里。

english: It sounds like those creatures are still in there. You're probably best off not going back in until they've moved on.
translation: 听起来那些生物还在里面。你最好等它们离开后再回去。

english: Afraid not. I'm sure he'll find us though. He knows the dungeon is the aim and he knows where the portal is as well.
translation: 恐怕没有。不过我相信他会找到我们的。他知道地牢是目标，也知道传送门在哪里。

english: Well, as you keep pointing out, there's a high chance of us dying here, so we might not get another chance.
translation: 好吧，正如你一直指出的，我们在这里死掉的可能性很大，所以我们可能没有第二次机会了。

english: Well, given we're almost certainly dead anyway, I don't see how it matters anymore.
translation: 好吧，既然我们几乎必死无疑，我觉得这已经无所谓了。

english: Why? Because I failed! I failed to protect the Myreque! I failed to protect Ivan! I made one promise to his mother, and I broke it!
translation: 为什么？因为我失败了！我没能保护好迈雷克！我没能保护好伊万！我对他母亲许下了一个承诺，却食言了！

english: This was over the second we agreed to Vanescula's plan! Now all of us are living on borrowed time. Me, you, Ivan, Safalaan... None of us are getting out of this alive.
translation: 从我们同意瓦内斯库拉的计划那一刻起，这一切就结束了！现在我们都在苟延残喘。我、你、伊万、萨法拉恩……我们谁也别想活着离开这里。

english: You use the knife to cut open the venator. You find that the stomach is missing, but in its place are some tongs that were left inside. You take them.
translation: 你用刀剖开了猎杀者。你发现胃不见了，但取而代之的是留在里面的钳子。你拿走了它们。

english: The prognosis for this venator is poor. Putting the stomach back in it is unlikely to change that.
translation: 这只猎杀者的预后很差。把胃放回去也不太可能改变这一点。

english: For some reason, you stick the syringe into the venator corpse. You're not sure why.
translation: 出于某种原因，你把注射器扎进了猎杀者的尸体。你也不确定为什么。

english: It must be because of what happened with Vanstrom.
translation: 一定是因为范斯特罗姆的事。

english: What do we do with him?
translation: 我们拿他怎么办？

english: I take it you have a plan?
translation: 我想你已经有计划了吧？

english: And what happens when we're back in Morytania? What happens when my brother finds we're no longer in his dungeon?
translation: 那我们回到莫利塔尼亚后怎么办？我哥哥发现我们不在他的地牢里了怎么办？

english: Ah, I see you've thought through this plan well. You have however missed just the one very minor detail.
translation: 啊，我看你把计划想得很周全。不过你漏掉了一个非常小的细节。

english: Then we need to destroy this stockpile. Where will it be?
translation: 那我们必须摧毁这批储备。它会在哪里？

english: Alright, you two get Safalaan back to Morytania. I'll find Ivan, destroy the stockpile and then follow you.
translation: 好，你们两个把萨法拉恩带回莫利塔尼亚。我去找伊万，摧毁储备，然后跟上你们。

english: Safalaan is the priority!
translation: 萨法拉恩是首要任务！

english: And unless you destroy that stockpile, he'll be no safer on that side of the portal than this one. We're staying.
translation: 除非你摧毁那批储备，否则他在传送门那边也不会比这边更安全。我们留下。

english: Now, let's not waste any time. Drakan is around here somewhere. It's only a matter of time before he finds us. We need to be gone before that happens.
translation: 现在，别浪费时间了。德拉坎就在这附近某处。他找到我们只是时间问题。我们必须在那之前离开。

english: I must confess, I underestimated him. I thought he'd long since given up on... well, anything and everything really. Now I see the reality was far worse.
translation: 我得承认，我低估了他。我以为他早就放弃了……好吧，什么都放弃了。现在我才看到现实远比我想象的糟糕。

english: We lost some good people thanks to your underestimating.
translation: 因为你的低估，我们失去了一些好人。

english: Well, I hope you're not expecting an apology. You all knew what you were signing up for.
translation: 好吧，我希望你别指望我会道歉。你们都知道自己加入的是什么。

english: I see your time in the cells hasn't changed you.
translation: 看来你在牢里的日子没有改变你。

english: And why would it have? This is not my first time on the back foot. I survived all those previous times, and I will survive this time as well.
translation: 为什么要改变？这不是我第一次处于劣势。我活过了之前那些次，这次我也能活下来。

english: If you say so. Anyway, back to your brother's plan...
translation: 随你怎么说。总之，回到你哥哥的计划……

english: Yes, like I say, rather unexpected, though I must admit, it is somewhat inspired.
translation: 是的，就像我说的，相当出人意料，不过我得承认，这有点启发意义。

english: When we took Hallowvale, Lowerniel said it would be a new beginning for us, but it only took him a few hundred years to grow bored of that.
translation: 当我们攻下霍洛维尔时，洛尼尔说这对我们来说是一个新的开始，但他只花了几百年就厌倦了。

english: That's when he started lamenting about this place instead. He longed to find a way back here, and for a time he actually found one.
translation: 那时他开始转而怀念这个地方。他渴望找到回来的路，有一段时间他真的找到了。

english: He worked out how to get here before? How?
translation: 他以前知道怎么来这里？怎么做到的？

english: I don't know exactly. My brother was once entrusted with a powerful artefact. I did wonder if that might have been connected, but the timelines don't add up...
translation: 我不太清楚。我哥哥曾受托保管一件强大的文物。我确实想过那可能与此有关，但时间线对不上……

english: Anyway, however he did it, it didn't last. He eventually lost his way to get here. After that, he mostly withdrew from our society completely. I thought he'd given up, but now I suspect it was all part of a larger plan.
translation: 总之，不管他怎么做到的，那都没持续多久。他最终失去了来这里的路。之后，他几乎完全退出了我们的社会。我以为他放弃了，但现在我怀疑那都是一个更大计划的一部分。

english: I don't think he ever stopped trying to find a way back here, and I think he was already preparing for the day when he'd work out how to do so.
translation: 我觉得他从未停止过寻找回来的路，而且我认为他一直在为找到方法的那一天做准备。

english: You saw for yourself how my people responded to his announcement. I think it's fair to say that the prospect of returning to Vampyrium is not one that many take joy in.
translation: 你亲眼看到了我的人民对他宣布的消息的反应。公平地说，回到吸血鬼之地的前景并不是很多人所期待的。

english: And yet... some might consider it more appealing than it once would have been.
translation: 然而……有些人可能会觉得它比以前更有吸引力了。

english: The overcrowding... The shutting down of the Haemalchemy Laboratory... I think he was intentionally pushing us to the brink. Putting us in a place where his plan seemed like the only option.
translation: 过度拥挤……血炼实验室被关闭……我觉得他是故意把我们逼到绝境。让我们陷入他的计划看起来是唯一选择的境地。

english: Hmm... Before we came here, we found a vampyrification lab. We did wonder why new vampyres were being made given the overcrowding issues.
translation: 嗯……我们来这里之前，发现了一个吸血鬼转化实验室。考虑到过度拥挤的问题，我们确实好奇为什么还在制造新的吸血鬼。

english: Yes, especially given my brother's hatred for that process. A process he himself made I should point out. Still, I suppose hypocrisy has always been one of his many talents.
translation: 是啊，尤其考虑到我哥哥对那个过程的憎恨。顺便说一句，那个过程是他自己发明的。不过，我想虚伪一直是他众多天赋之一。

english: Ah, yes, the wonderful Night of the Blood Moon. It was once the way that the Drakan clan chose their new leaders. This was before the vampyre clans were united as one. Before we became civilised.
translation: 啊，是的，那美妙的血月之夜。那曾经是德拉肯氏族选择新领袖的方式。那是在吸血鬼各氏族统一之前。在我们变得文明之前。

english: I'm not sure I could ever describe a vampyre as civilised.
translation: 我不确定我能不能把吸血鬼形容为文明。

english: Well, then you should be glad you never had to see how we used to live. That festival is a perfect example of something that should have remained forgotten, but of course, my brother can't help but cling to the past.
translation: 那你应该庆幸你从没见过我们过去的生活方式。那个节日就是一个本该被遗忘的完美例子，但当然，我哥哥就是放不下过去。

english: So this festival is how your brother became leader?
translation: 所以这个节日就是你哥哥成为领袖的方式？

english: Yes. We were a lot more superstitious back then, though a lot stupider might be a better way to put it. We believed that a blood moon was the ultimate representation of power.
translation: 是的。那时候我们迷信得多，不过说蠢得多可能更贴切。我们相信血月是力量的终极象征。

english: Whenever one occurred, the festival would take place. It was a whole night of killing. The one with the most kills by the end was said to embody the blood moon.
translation: 每当血月出现，节日就会举行。那是整整一夜的杀戮。到结束时杀戮最多的人据说就化身为血月。

english: Embody the blood moon?
translation: 化身为血月？

english: 'And when dawn comes, one will rise above all, and they will rise as the Blood Moon.'
translation: '当黎明来临，一人将凌驾于所有之上，他将化身为血月。'

english: Like I said, we were stupid back then, and not overly creative. The victor would be granted the rather uninspired title of Blood Moon. They were the only one deemed worthy enough to lead the clan.
translation: 就像我说的，那时候我们很蠢，而且没什么创意。胜利者会被授予那个相当乏味的称号——血月。他是唯一被认为有资格领导氏族的人。

english: And now your brother wants to bring the festival back.
translation: 而现在你哥哥想把那个节日带回来。

english: He'll do anything but accept the truth. All of our problems... they come from him. He will never be the one to free us of them.
translation: 他什么都愿意做，就是不愿接受真相。我们所有的问题……都源于他。他永远不会成为那个让我们摆脱困境的人。

english: It's a wretched place. Leaving was the best thing we ever did.
translation: 这是个糟糕的地方。离开是我们做过的最好的决定。

english: Why? What was life like here?
translation: 为什么？这里的生活是什么样的？

english: Well, it was once the case that my people lived in separate clans spread across these lands. Life was short and brutal. There was nothing to take joy in. Survival was all that mattered.
translation: 嗯，曾经我的族人分散在这片土地上，以不同的氏族生活。生命短暂而残酷。没有什么值得快乐的。生存就是一切。

english: What changed?
translation: 是什么改变了？

english: A single visitor. We called him the Stranger from Afar. He uplifted us. He showed us that life could be more than mere survival. You wouldn't think it now, but back then my brother was his biggest believer.
translation: 一个访客。我们称他为远方陌生人。他提升了我们。他向我们展示了生活可以不仅仅是生存。你现在可能看不出来，但那时候我哥哥是他最忠实的信徒。

english: As you can probably imagine, such a fundamental shift in our society caused quite the stir, but also presented opportunities to those willing to take them...
translation: 你大概能想象，我们社会如此根本性的转变引起了不小的轰动，但也给那些愿意抓住机会的人带来了机遇……

english: My brother was one of those people. He set out to unite all the clans as one, with him as their leader. He called himself the Lord of Vampyrium, the first true ruler of these lands.
translation: 我哥哥就是那些人之一。他着手将所有氏族统一为一个整体，由他担任领袖。他自称吸血鬼之王，这片土地的第一位真正统治者。

english: This Stranger from Afar... did he support that?
translation: 那个远方陌生人……他支持这个吗？

english: More than support it. He enabled it. Make no mistake though, it was not due to any benevolence. He had great ambition of his own, but he needed us to help him achieve it.
translation: 不仅仅是支持。他促成了这一切。但别搞错了，这不是出于任何善意。他自己有巨大的野心，但他需要我们帮他实现。

english: And so, we remained here for centuries after that, enjoying our new lives of culture and civilisation, until eventually the Stranger from Afar returned.
translation: 于是，在那之后我们又在这里待了几个世纪，享受着我们新的文明文化生活，直到最终远方陌生人回来了。

english: He guided us to your lands. There, we established a great empire for him, and for hundreds of years, we prospered. Vampyrium became nothing more than a horrible distant memory.
translation: 他引导我们去了你们的土地。在那里，我们为他建立了一个伟大的帝国，几百年来我们繁荣昌盛。吸血鬼之地变成了一个可怕的遥远记忆。

english: You see, after all this time, it seems my brother has forgotten something that he once knew better than anyone. Change is inevitable, and those who refuse to accept it, die.
translation: 你看，过了这么久，我哥哥似乎忘记了他曾经比任何人都更懂的一件事。变化是不可避免的，拒绝接受变化的人，就会灭亡。

english: Okay... In that case, lead the way.
translation: 好吧……既然如此，带路吧。

english: I'm not sure, but I wonder if there's more to some of these books than there first seems.
translation: 我不确定，但我在想这些书里有些可能不像表面看起来那么简单。

english: I don't know. I'm alive I guess, but I keep letting you down, [player name]. I'm sorry.
translation: 我不知道。我想我还活着，但我一直在让你失望，[player name]。对不起。

english: Don't be. I'm sorry that you have to be here, Ivan, but I'm glad you are. I wouldn't have got this far on my own.
translation: 别这么说。我很抱歉你不得不待在这里，伊万，但我很高兴你在这里。我一个人走不到这么远。

english: I just wish I could be more like you and Veliaf. I thought I could be, but after what happened to the others...
translation: 我只是希望我能更像你和维利亚夫。我以为我可以，但在其他人遭遇了那些事之后……

english: The worst part is, I can't even mourn them. After Sani died, and Harold... I felt something. Now though... now I just feel empty. Empty... and afraid.
translation: 最糟糕的是，我甚至无法哀悼他们。萨尼死后，还有哈罗德……我感受到了什么。但现在……现在我只觉得空虚。空虚……还有恐惧。

english: And yet you're still here. Even after all that's happened, you haven't lost hope, Ivan.
translation: 但你仍然在这里。即使经历了这一切，你还没有失去希望，伊万。

english: Yeah... hope. That's always been me, hasn't it. The hoper... The believer... But what good is hope now? What good has hope ever done us? It's just... worthless.
translation: 是啊……希望。那一直是我，不是吗。那个怀抱希望的人……那个相信的人……但现在希望有什么用？希望曾经给我们带来过什么好处？它只是……毫无价值。

english: No. It's worth everything. It's the only reason we're still here, and it's the reason why I know that no matter what we'll face here, we'll win.
translation: 不。它价值一切。它是我们仍然在这里的唯一原因，也是我知道无论我们在这里面对什么，我们都会赢的原因。

english: You know, you're pretty good at this whole motivation thing. Much better than Veliaf.
translation: 你知道吗，你挺擅长这套激励人的说辞的。比维利亚夫强多了。

english: Well... that's not saying much.
translation: 嗯……那也不算什么。

english: He has his moments.
translation: 他也有他的高光时刻。

english: That he most certainly does.
translation: 他确实有。

english: I'm not sure. I guess we need to work out how to get to that blood stockpile. Hopefully it won't take us too long. I don't want to spend any longer here than we have to.
translation: 我不确定。我想我们得想办法到达那个血库。希望不会花太长时间。我不想在这里多待一刻。

english: Ivan tries to give you some supplies, but there's four items in total and you don't have enough room for all of them.
translation: 伊万想给你一些补给品，但总共有四件物品，你的空间不够放不下全部。

english: It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To be a river that runs through the body's land.'
translation: 看起来有什么东西可以倒进这个水盆里。下方刻着铭文：“成为流经身体之地的河流。”

english: It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To be a faithful follower that flees the light.'
translation: 看起来有什么东西可以倒进这个水盆里。下方刻着铭文：“成为逃离光明的忠实信徒。”

english: It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To crack with no voice and slip with no legs.'
translation: 看起来有什么东西可以倒进这个水盆里。下方刻着铭文：“无声而裂，无腿而滑。”

english: It looks like something could be poured into this basin. An inscription below it reads: 'To rise without wings and choke all who are there.'
translation: 看起来有什么东西可以倒进这个水盆里。下方刻着铭文：“无翼而升，扼杀在场之人。”

english: You search the altar and find an ancient symbol. You take it.
translation: 你搜索祭坛，发现了一个古老的圣徽。你拿走了它。

english: Now, I take it the blood stockpile is destroyed?
translation: 那么，我想血库已经被摧毁了？

english: Let's save the reunions for later. We need to get out of here.
translation: 重逢的事以后再说。我们得离开这里。

english: This little foray of yours, however... I confess, it has me moderately impressed.
translation: 不过，你这次小小的行动……我承认，让我有些刮目相看。

english: This bravery... This defiance! It brings back a taste that's become all too absent back in Morytania. To finally find it again, here in Vampyrium... How fitting indeed.
translation: 这种勇气……这种反抗！让我想起了在莫利塔尼亚久违的味道。终于在这里，在吸血鬼之地再次找到它……真是再合适不过了。

english: Vanescula, my dear sister, you never fail to disappoint. Have you truly become so despondent, that even mere humans now offer more tenacity than you.
translation: 瓦内斯库拉，我亲爱的妹妹，你从不让人失望。你真的变得如此消沉，连普通人类都比你有韧性了。

english: Good. Then let us put it to the test.
translation: 好。那就让我们来检验一下吧。

english: We need to get across the bridge. We can't stay here.
translation: 我们得穿过那座桥。不能留在这里。

english: This is where we truly became who we are now. Art... Culture... The things my brother now hates. They all came from him.
translation: 这里是我们真正成为现在模样的地方。艺术……文化……我哥哥现在憎恨的东西，都源自于他。

english: Yeah, very touching, but given he's going to be upon us any minute, maybe less reminiscing and more action!
translation: 是啊，很感人，但考虑到他随时会追上我们，也许少回忆点，多行动点！

english: How do we get the bridge down?
translation: 我们怎么把桥放下来？

english: Were you under the impression that during my time in my brother's dungeon, I decided to take up engineering? I have no idea how long it will take!
translation: 你以为我在哥哥的地牢里时，会去学工程学吗？我也不知道要多久！

english: It looks like one of the cogs is missing...
translation: 看起来少了一个齿轮……

english: Well, we're not going to get very far without it.
translation: 好吧，没有它我们走不了多远。

english: We don't have any other option. The rest of you stay here. Get the other parts of the mechanism fixed, and make sure Safalaan is kept safe.
translation: 我们别无选择。你们其他人留在这里。把机械装置的其他部分修好，确保萨法拉安的安全。

english: Well, it's safe to say I've had better days. It's not looking good for us at all.
translation: 好吧，可以说我经历过更好的日子。我们的处境很不妙。

english: No, but this isn't over yet. We'll work something out.
translation: 不，但还没结束。我们会想出办法的。

english: Sure. I'll make sure they get back to your bank... provided we ever get back to Morytania...
translation: 当然。我会确保它们送回你的银行……前提是我们能回到莫利塔尼亚……

english: Just be careful out there.
translation: 在外面小心点。

english: Well, he's alive, but otherwise, not great. He doesn't seem to remember anything.
translation: 他还活着，但除此之外，情况不太好。他似乎什么都不记得了。

english: Is this what happened to him before? The last time he fully lost control of his powers?
translation: 这就是他之前发生的事吗？上次他完全失控的时候？

english: I think so. I never saw him for myself in those early days, but this is exactly how Vertida described it.
translation: 我想是的。那些早期日子我没亲眼见过他，但这正是维尔蒂达描述的样子。

english: There must be something we can do for him once we're back in Morytania.
translation: 等我们回到莫利塔尼亚，一定有办法帮他的。

english: We never worked out a way before. He never regained the memories he lost.
translation: 我们以前从没找到办法。他失去的记忆从未恢复过。

english: True, but we can't give up on him.
translation: 没错，但我们不能放弃他。

english: Well, we need to survive this first, and with us now having no clear way back to Morytania, the odds of that happening are even slimmer than before.
translation: 好吧，我们得先活下来，而现在我们没有了明确的回莫利塔尼亚的路，活下来的几率比以前更小了。

english: Slim perhaps, but not hopeless.
translation: 也许渺茫，但并非无望。

english: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the first chair: ... ruled by an adamantite will is a privilege...
translation: 第一把椅子上刻着献给古老宗教的诗句：……受坚毅意志统治是一种特权……

english: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the second chair: ... those keen of sight will know...
translation: 第二把椅子上刻着献给古老宗教的诗句：……目光敏锐者将知晓……

english: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the third chair: ... or be crushed by unyielding might...
translation: 第三把椅子上刻着献给古老宗教的诗句：……或被不屈之力碾碎……

english: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the fourth chair: ... with a mind free of indecision...
translation: 第四把椅子上刻着献给古老宗教的诗句：……以无犹豫之心……

english: There is a verse dedicated to an ancient religion carved into the fifth chair: ... thick skin in the face of challenge or dissent...
translation: 第五把椅子上刻着献给古老宗教的诗句：……面对挑战或异议时坚韧厚皮……

english: And then what? What's the plan here?
translation: 然后呢？计划是什么？

english: Hopefully?
translation: 希望？

english: Maybe we leave you here as a distraction while we escape? After all, this entire mess is of your making.
translation: 也许我们该把你留在这里当诱饵，好让我们逃跑？毕竟，这整场混乱都是你造成的。

english: We don't have time for this. Whatever we do next, we can't stay here. Let's get across that bridge.
translation: 我们没时间争论这个。无论接下来做什么，都不能留在这里。我们过桥吧。

english: Before we go, Ivan found some supplies. Best you speak to him and stock up, [player name].
translation: 走之前，伊万找到了一些补给品。你最好去跟他谈谈，补充一下装备，[player name]。

english: We shouldn't waste any more time here.
translation: 我们不该在这里浪费时间了。

english: Agreed. Let's get going.
translation: 同意。我们走吧。

english: My greatest mistake. One that will finally be put right. At long last, the blood moon will rise once more, and when it does, we will finally reclaim the greatness that we lost.
translation: 我最大的错误。一个终于要被纠正的错误。终于，血月将再次升起，到那时，我们将重新夺回失去的辉煌。

english: Greatness? I remember it a bit differently. Fear, suffering and carnage. That was what life was like here.
translation: 辉煌？我记得的可不太一样。恐惧、苦难和杀戮。那才是这里生活的样子。

english: It was barbaric! Thousands of years have passed and yet I still remember what happened here like it was yesterday! I remember looking on as our father sat right where you are now, with you stood over him!
translation: 那是野蛮的！几千年过去了，但我仍然记得这里发生的一切，就像昨天一样！我记得看着我们的父亲坐在你现在坐的位置，而你站在他面前！

english: Just as he wanted. He dreamed of the day when I would succeed him.
translation: 正如他所愿。他一直梦想着有一天我能继承他的位置。

english: Our father died in glory! He fought on the Night of the Blood Moon and fell as a warrior!
translation: 我们的父亲光荣地死去！他在血月之夜战斗，作为战士倒下！

english: I can't do this alone! put up a fight!
translation: 我一个人做不到！反抗啊！

english: You're supposed to avoid the spear!
translation: 你应该躲开长矛的！

english: Evil? If only it were that simple.
translation: 邪恶？要是真有那么简单就好了。

english: You are no farmer! And we are no cattle!
translation: 你不是农夫！我们也不是牲畜！

english: In truth, however, the day we stopped being hunters and started being farmers is the day we lost who we were. That is why I will bring an end to it.
translation: 但事实上，从我们不再狩猎、开始畜牧的那一天起，我们就失去了自我。这就是我要终结这一切的原因。

english: But how many will have to die first for that to happen? How many dead humans will power that portal of yours? It's too high a cost!
translation: 但为此要先死多少人？有多少人类的尸体才能为你的传送门供能？代价太高了！

english: There's always an alternative!
translation: 总有别的选择！

english: She already had one. Before you shut it down, the Haemalchemy Laboratory beneath Meiyerditch was already researching ways to overcome the shortages. That was her answer.
translation: 她本来有一个。在你关闭它之前，迈尔迪奇地下的血液炼金实验室已经在研究克服短缺的方法。那就是她的答案。

english: You believe it was I who shut that lab down? How misguided you are. It was Vanescula who put an end to their research. She has never had any desire to see that work succeed.
translation: 你以为是我关闭了那个实验室？你太误解我了。是瓦内斯库拉终止了他们的研究。她从来就不希望那项工作成功。

english: The Night of the Blood Moon approaches, and while I have enjoyed this little diversion, I have more important things to focus on.
translation: 血月之夜即将来临，虽然我很享受这段小小的消遣，但我还有更重要的事情要关注。

english: But... Who are you?
translation: 但是……你是谁？

english: Efaritay Hallow? Your Safalaan's mother! But how are you here? How are you alive?
translation: 埃法里泰·哈洛？你的萨法拉安的母亲！但你怎么会在这里？你怎么还活着？

english: I was Drakan's prisoner here for many years, until I made my escape, but we can discuss this further inside.
translation: 我被德拉坎囚禁在这里多年，直到我逃了出来，但我们可以在里面再详谈。

english: You do not need to worry. Both my son and your friends are safe. Now let us go. There is someone who will want to meet you.
translation: 你不用担心。我的儿子和你的朋友们都很安全。现在我们走吧。有个人想见你。

english: If it wasn't for these people, we probably would have. They saved all of us!
translation: 如果不是这些人，我们可能早就死了。他们救了我们所有人！

english: It seems the answer to that is... complicated.
translation: 看来这个问题的答案是……很复杂。

english: I think that's the first time I've ever heard anything like that from a vampyre.
translation: 我想这是我第一次从吸血鬼口中听到这样的话。

english: However, I think you'll soon find that when it comes to your kind, I take a slightly different perspective to other vampyres.
translation: 不过，我想你很快就会发现，对于你们这类人，我与其他吸血鬼的看法略有不同。

english: Indeed. I've been called many things over the years, but to you, my child, I am Sugadinti. Sugadinti Vitur.
translation: 确实。多年来我被冠以许多称呼，但对你来说，我的孩子，我是苏加丁提。苏加丁提·维图尔。

english: My daughter.
translation: 我的女儿。

english: She made an attempt on my life, leaving me for dead, before claiming my clan and title as her own. To learn that she eventually met her end due to one of her own creations... I must admit, I found that rather pleasing...
translation: 她曾试图取我性命，将我弃之等死，然后夺取了我的氏族和头衔。得知她最终死于自己创造之物……我必须承认，这让我感到相当欣慰……

english: Efaritay shows you some daeyalt ore.
translation: 埃法里泰给你看了一些戴亚尔特矿石。

english: Daeyalt? But why?
translation: 戴亚尔特？但为什么？

english: Why indeed? Mid way through a daring and dangerous escape, and she goes out of her way to aquire a key component for vampyrification, yet elects not to tell you. Curious...
translation: 是啊，为什么呢？在一场惊险的逃亡途中，她特意去获取了吸血鬼化所需的关键材料，却选择不告诉你们。真是耐人寻味……

english: But I don't understand... Vanescula helped us escape. We wouldn't be here if not for her.
translation: 但我不明白……瓦内斯库拉帮我们逃了出来。没有她我们不可能在这里。

english: Indeed... However, I suggest we not dwell on it, for there are more pressing matters to discuss.
translation: 确实……不过，我建议我们不要纠结于此，因为有更紧迫的事情要讨论。

english: Yes... This palace here was once the home of the late Lord Jovkai. It has served us well as a hideout for some time, and we have done a commendable job of keeping our presence here hidden.
translation: 是的……这座宫殿曾是已故的乔夫凯领主的居所。它作为我们的藏身之处已经有一段时间了，我们在这里隐藏行踪的工作做得相当出色。

english: Drakan is flesh and blood like any other foe, but he is not one that will be defeated easily. However, his defeat is not required for us to be victorious.
translation: 德拉坎和其他敌人一样有血有肉，但他不是轻易就能击败的。不过，要取得胜利，并不一定要击败他。

english: You're talking about the hooded figures?
translation: 你说的是那些兜帽人？

english: My loyal disciples, the aranei. Their presence in Hallowvale has served two purposes.
translation: 我忠诚的门徒，阿拉内伊。他们在哈洛维尔的存在有两个目的。

english: And you're now ready to make that portal?
translation: 那你现在准备好制作那个传送门了吗？

english: And if Drakan arrives before it's ready?
translation: 如果德拉肯在它准备好之前就到了呢？

english: There is concern in your voice. You do not trust me.
translation: 你的声音里带着担忧。你不信任我。

english: Nor have I, but if not for Sugadinti, I would never have survived these lands. I'm afraid you have no choice but to put your faith in him. If you do not, we are almost certainly doomed. Now, let us get to work.
translation: 我也不信任他，但如果不是苏加丁提，我早就在这片土地上活不下来了。恐怕你别无选择，只能信任他。如果你不这样做，我们几乎注定要失败。现在，让我们开始干活吧。

english: Yes... I imagine you have many questions. I assure you that I will answer them all, but for now we must focus on current matters.
translation: 是的...我想你有很多问题。我保证会一一回答，但现在我们必须专注于眼前的事情。

english: If you need anything at all, friend, just speak with Father Sugadinti.
translation: 如果你需要任何东西，朋友，尽管跟苏加丁提神父说。

english: I am glad to finally meet you, friend. I have heard many good things about you.
translation: 很高兴终于见到你了，朋友。我听说过很多关于你的好事。

english: I am sorry you and your companions had to face Lord Drakan alone. We thank Father Sugadinti that you survived.
translation: 很抱歉你和你的同伴不得不独自面对德拉肯领主。我们感谢苏加丁提神父让你们活了下来。

english: You may simply call me Efaritay.
translation: 你直接叫我埃法里泰就行了。

english: Thank you, but your honour is not needed. I'm not a queen anymore.
translation: 谢谢，但不需要这样的敬意。我已经不再是女王了。

english: They'd do well to find a better source of hope, but I suppose that isn't important now. There is a lot to be done, but first, my son needs tending to.
translation: 他们最好找个更好的希望来源，但我想现在这不重要了。有很多事要做，但首先，我儿子需要照顾。

english: Take some leaves from it and then mix them into a stew. We are not the best supplied here, but I'm sure you will find the ingredients around here to make one.
translation: 从它上面摘些叶子，然后混进炖菜里。我们这里的物资不算充裕，但我相信你会在附近找到做炖菜的食材。

english: Greetings, my friend.
translation: 你好，我的朋友。

english: Is everything okay out here?
translation: 外面一切都还好吗？

english: For now, but we must be ready for Lord Drakan to arrive at any time. Many of my fellow disciples are out in the forest, keeping watch for him. They will send word as soon as he is sighted.
translation: 目前还好，但我们必须随时准备迎接德拉肯领主的到来。我的许多同门都在森林里警戒着他的动向。一旦发现他的踪迹，他们就会传信回来。

english: They're out there right now? How will they get back in time?
translation: 他们现在就在外面？他们怎么及时赶回来？

english: They most likely won't.
translation: 他们很可能回不来。

english: And they're okay with that?
translation: 他们接受这一点吗？

english: It is the highest honour. They are out there because Father Sugadinti himself chose them personally. To die in his name, fighting to ensure the defeat of Lord Drakan... it is the kind of death we all dream of.
translation: 这是最高的荣誉。他们在外面是因为苏加丁提神父亲自挑选了他们。为他的名义而死，为确保击败德拉肯领主而战...这是我们所有人都梦寐以求的死法。

english: It just seems so... brutal.
translation: 这看起来太...残酷了。

english: This land is brutal. Most of us die before we've ever had the chance to live. In truth, our people should have died out long ago. It is only thanks to Father Sugadinti that we didn't.
translation: 这片土地就是残酷的。我们大多数人还没机会活就死了。说实话，我们的人民早该灭绝了。全靠苏加丁提神父我们才活了下来。

english: So now you'll die for him?
translation: 所以现在你们要为他而死？

english: Of course. We owe everything to him. Every moment... every experience... every memory. We exist because of him, and so we exist for him.
translation: 当然。我们的一切都欠他的。每一刻...每一次经历...每一段记忆。我们因他而存在，所以我们为他而存在。

english: He is our future, and if we have to die to protect that future, then we will do so willingly.
translation: 他就是我们的未来，如果必须用死来保护那个未来，我们会心甘情愿地去做。

english: I kind of understand... It just still seems so... extreme.
translation: 我有点理解了...但还是觉得太...极端了。

english: You are wise to be doubtful, but if the thousands of years our kind have spent here have taught us one thing, it is that this is the only way.
translation: 你有疑虑是明智的，但如果我们族类在这里度过的数千年教会了我们什么，那就是这是唯一的办法。

english: Well, hopefully that doesn't have to be the case for much longer.
translation: 好吧，希望这种情况不会持续太久了。

english: With Father Sugadinti guiding us, I am certain that will be so.
translation: 有苏加丁提神父指引我们，我相信一定会如此。

english: Hello again, my friend.
translation: 又见面了，我的朋友。

english: All still quiet here?
translation: 这里还是一切平静吗？

english: Yes. You need not worry. As soon as there is a sighting of Lord Drakan, we will let you know.
translation: 是的。你不用担心。一旦发现德拉肯领主的踪迹，我们会立刻通知你。

english: All I can tell you about him is that he's a monster. He kept me alive in that castle of his, using my blood to travel to and from these lands.
translation: 关于他我只能告诉你，他是个怪物。他把我关在他的城堡里，用我的血在这些土地之间往返。

english: I was with Safalaan when he found out what happened. I'm so sorry for what he did to you, Efaritay.
translation: 萨法拉恩告诉我发生了什么时，我就在场。对于他对你做的事，我深感抱歉，埃法里泰。

english: Indeed. I see you have used blisterwood as part of its construction. I'm glad to see my old tree is still serving a use.
translation: 确实。我看到你用了水泡木作为它的一部分。很高兴看到我的老树还在发挥作用。

english: I have. I must say, it doesn't look like a particularly vampyric weapon.
translation: 是的。我得说，它看起来不像是一件特别吸血鬼克制的武器。

english: Drakan uses a blisterwood weapon? Does that not hurt him?
translation: 德拉肯用水泡木武器？那不会伤到他吗？

english: Almost certainly, but Drakan will no doubt see his ability to push through that as a clear sign of his strength.
translation: 几乎肯定会，但德拉肯无疑会把他能忍受这一点视为他力量的明确标志。

english: Silvthrill?
translation: 银瑟里尔？

english: Unfortunately, the secrets to that process have long been lost, but pure silvthrill can still be found, provided you know where to look.
translation: 不幸的是，那个过程的秘密早已失传，但纯银瑟里尔仍然可以找到，只要你知道去哪里找。

english: Doing so required them to desecrate the tombs of my people. To have to resort to such methods...
translation: 这样做需要他们亵渎我族人的坟墓。不得不采取这样的手段...

english: In any case, thanks to their efforts, we have been able to gather enough pure silvthrill to create new weapons with. I would suggest you use it to enhance your flail.
translation: 无论如何，多亏了他们的努力，我们才能收集到足够的纯银瑟里尔来打造新武器。我建议你用它来强化你的连枷。

english: The main shaft of the flail seems quite cumbersome. If you were to shorten it, it would likely make the weapon quicker to strike with.
translation: 连枷的主杆看起来相当笨重。如果你能把它缩短一些，武器挥击的速度应该会更快。

english: I believe you should be able to find one over in the armoury, along with everything else you'll need.
translation: 我相信你应该能在军械库找到一把，以及你需要的其他所有东西。

english: Efaritay gives you the hallowed marks.
translation: 埃法里泰给了你圣印。

english: After I managed to escape Drakan, I was alone and weak. I would not have survived these lands for long, but I was lucky enough that Sugadinti found me.
translation: 逃出德雷坎的魔掌后，我孤身一人，虚弱不堪。我本不可能在这片土地上活太久，但幸运的是苏加丁提找到了我。

english: That feels kind of like what happened with us.
translation: 这感觉就像我们之间发生的事一样。

english: Yes, and much like yourselves, I was also highly mistrusting of Sugadinti at first. Had I been stronger, I may well have tried to kill him on the spot.
translation: 是的，和你们一样，我一开始也极度不信任苏加丁提。如果我当时更强壮，说不定当场就杀了他。

english: And yet, over time, we have come to reach an understanding. Make no mistake, there is much we do not agree on. However, he is most certainly nothing like Drakan.
translation: 然而，随着时间的推移，我们逐渐达成了共识。别误会，我们之间有很多分歧。但他绝对不像德雷坎那样。

english: That's reassuring. Thank you.
translation: 这让人安心。谢谢你。

english: Are they happy providing their blood?
translation: 他们乐意提供自己的血吗？

english: However, it is a relationship that they are content with, and it has worked for them for thousands of years.
translation: 不过，这是他们满意的关系，而且已经维持了数千年。

english: That is something that still has an element of debate to it.
translation: 这件事仍然存在争议。

english: And we're the ones responsible for those recent events. I'm sorry.
translation: 而我们是最近那些事件的始作俑者。我很抱歉。

english: But now those plans have changed. Drakan won't be defeated anymore. He'll just be trapped here instead. I'm guessing that's where the debate is?
translation: 但现在那些计划已经改变了。德雷坎不会再被击败。他只会被困在这里。我猜这就是争议所在？

english: That was our hope as well, but I'm guessing you disagree?
translation: 那也是我们的希望，但我猜你不同意？

english: Hmm... You make a fair point.
translation: 嗯……你说得有道理。

english: But do I? Is it logic that drives these questions, or is it something else...?
translation: 但真的是这样吗？是逻辑驱使着这些问题，还是别的什么……？

english: There is nothing left of who I once was. Drakan took everything from me, but then wouldn't even grant me the mercy of death. And now, all these years later, I find myself asking, what is it I'm still fighting for?
translation: 过去的我已经什么都不剩了。德雷坎夺走了我的一切，却连死亡的仁慈都不肯给我。而如今，这么多年过去了，我发现自己不禁要问，我还在为什么而战？

english: I'd... prefer you didn't.
translation: 我……希望你不要提他们。

english: I understand. I'm sorry to have mentioned them.
translation: 我理解。很抱歉提到了他们。

english: Hallowvale... The truth is, it's been so long that I barely remember it. The one memory that will never fade though, is the beauty of it.
translation: 哈洛维尔……说实话，已经太久远了，我几乎记不清了。唯一永远不会褪色的记忆，是它的美丽。

english: The rivers and the forests... The cities of blue and white stone... And looking over all of it, Everlight.
translation: 河流与森林……蓝白相间的石头城市……以及俯瞰这一切的永恒之光。

english: Everlight?
translation: 永恒之光？

english: Hallowvale wasn't always our home. My people once lived eternally in the light, in a floating city that followed the sun. We couldn't do that in Hallowvale, so we built a sun of our own.
translation: 哈洛维尔并非我们一直的家园。我的族人曾永恒地生活在光明之中，在一座追随太阳的浮空城市里。在哈洛维尔我们做不到那样，于是我们建造了自己的太阳。

english: I suppose you could compare it to a lighthouse. It stood on the outskirts of our capital, ensuring that no part of our home fell into darkness.
translation: 你可以把它比作一座灯塔。它矗立在我们首都的郊外，确保家园的每一寸土地都不会陷入黑暗。

english: That sounds incredible.
translation: 听起来太不可思议了。

english: It was... but now it's all gone. Sugadinti's disciples tell me nothing remains of Everlight now, nor much else of Hallowvale. Even its name has long since been lost to time.
translation: 确实如此……但现在一切都消失了。苏加丁提的门徒告诉我，永恒之光如今已荡然无存，哈洛维尔也所剩无几。连它的名字也早已被时间遗忘。

english: But you're still here, and so is Safalaan. The light hasn't fully died yet, and for as long as we keep fighting, it never will.
translation: 但你还在，萨法拉恩也还在。光明尚未完全熄灭，只要我们继续战斗，它就永远不会熄灭。

english: I suppose we'll soon find out if you're right.
translation: 我想我们很快就会知道你说得对不对了。

english: You search the chest and find an enchantment tablet inside.
translation: 你搜索宝箱，发现里面有一块附魔石板。

english: You enhance the diamond sickle with blisterwood, making an enhanced blisterwood sickle.
translation: 你用强化水泡木强化了钻石镰刀，制作出一把强化水泡木镰刀。

english: To create an upgraded flail, you'll need to take a blisterwood flail, an enhanced blisterwood sickle, some hallowed marks and a hammer to an anvil.
translation: 要制作升级版连枷，你需要带一把水泡木连枷、一把强化水泡木镰刀、一些圣印和一把锤子到铁砧处。

english: You upgrade your flail by swapping out the sickle and shortening the shaft before enhancing it with pure silvthrill.
translation: 你通过更换镰刀并缩短主杆，再用纯银瑟里尔强化，升级了你的连枷。

english: But now is not the time to admire it. Drakan will be here soon and there is still much to prepare.
translation: 但现在不是欣赏它的时候。德雷坎很快就会到来，还有很多准备工作要做。

english: Hello again, [player name]. Time is short, for Drakan will be here soon and there is still much to prepare.
translation: 又见面了，[player name]。时间紧迫，德雷坎很快就会到来，还有很多准备工作要做。

english: It would be unwise to drop your flail here.
translation: 在这里放下你的连枷是不明智的。

english: Indeed we have. It was [player name] here who assisted Father Sugadinti and I in the Theatre of Blood. Your work was very impressive.
translation: 确实如此。正是这里的[player name]协助苏加丁提神父和我在血腥剧场中作战。你的表现非常出色。

english: Your doubt is understandable. However, you must understand that from our perspective, you did not need help.
translation: 你的怀疑可以理解。但你必须明白，从我们的角度来看，你们并不需要帮助。

english: I'm sorry, I didn't realise... I still don't understand what you mean by us not needing help though.
translation: 抱歉，我没意识到……但我还是不明白你说我们不需要帮助是什么意思。

english: At the request of the icyene, we did our best to keep an eye on your group, but given you had managed to kill Ranis Drakan, it did not seem that you were in need of immediate assistance.
translation: 应冰翼族的请求，我们尽力关注你们一行人的动向，但鉴于你们已经成功杀死了拉尼斯.德雷坎，看起来你们并不需要立即的援助。

english: Of course, had we known you were working with Vanescula, we would have acted differently, but by the time we found out, it was already too late.
translation: 当然，要是早知道你和瓦内斯库拉合作，我们就会采取不同的行动，但等我们发现时已经太晚了。

english: Speaking of which, allow me to impart some knowledge to you both that may be of benefit to you in the likely event that you find yourself facing that foe again.
translation: 说到这个，让我传授你们一些知识，说不定在你们再次面对那个敌人时会派上用场。

english: The icyene was hoping to cultivate a new blisterwood tree here, but was unfortunately unsuccessful. However, we were able to acquire a small amount of blisterwood from Darkmeyer for her.
translation: 冰伊人曾想在这里培育一棵新的水泡木树，但可惜没有成功。不过，我们设法从达克迈尔为她弄到了一些水泡木。

english: I'd advise you make yourself some. You can do so using the blisterwood logs from the crate in the corner.
translation: 我建议你们给自己做一些。你们可以用角落里箱子里的水泡木原木来做。

english: I guess you'd better make yourself some of those stakes, [player name].
translation: 我想你最好给自己做一些木桩，[player name]。

english: Only as it turns out, she already had been.
translation: 结果事实证明，她早就已经在做了。

english: Yes, Sugadinti said something similar to us when we first arrived. I must admit, I don't really understand that bit. What happened?
translation: 是的，苏加丁提在我们刚到时也说过类似的话。我得承认，我不太明白那是什么意思。发生了什么？

english: An unexpected turn of events. However, thanks to our work in the Theatre, Father Sugadinti now has plans for this Nylocas Queen.
translation: 一个意想不到的转折。不过，多亏了我们在剧院里的努力，苏加丁提神父现在对这只尼洛卡斯蛛后有了计划。

english: I made some of those stakes.
translation: 我做了一些木桩。

english: Good. I hope you find them useful.
translation: 很好。希望它们对你有用。

english: I hope so too. We're going to need all the advantages we can find.
translation: 我也希望如此。我们需要利用一切能得到的优势。

english: Right? I doubt that. He's a vampyre, and one thing we most certainly should have learnt by now is that vampyres can't be trusted.
translation: 是吗？我表示怀疑。他是个吸血鬼，而我们现在最应该学到的一件事就是吸血鬼不可信。

english: We shouldn't. Make no mistake, [player name], he has his own reasons for wanting Vanescula out of the picture. However, that doesn't change the fact that she is our enemy. She has always been our enemy.
translation: 我们不应该信他。别搞错了，[player name]，他有自己的理由想让瓦内斯库拉出局。但这改变不了她是我们的敌人这个事实。她一直都是我们的敌人。

english: Would you like to hear some stories about him?
translation: 你想听听关于他的故事吗？

english: I'd prefer you tell me about that daeyalt. Why? Why waste time stealing it when we were working on our escape?
translation: 我更想听你讲讲那些达耶特矿石。为什么？为什么在我们计划逃跑的时候还要浪费时间偷它？

english: A backup plan you chose not to share with us. Why? Who were you planning to turn into a vampyre?
translation: 一个你选择不跟我们分享的备用计划。为什么？你打算把谁变成吸血鬼？

english: I can do it your way if you prefer? I may be the last friend you have, Vanescula. If you want to have any chance of escaping this place, you should tell me what you were planning.
translation: 如果你愿意，我也可以按你的方式来？瓦内斯库拉，我可能是你最后的朋友了。如果你想有机会逃离这个地方，就该告诉我你的计划。

english: One battle against them was so devastating, that it risked undoing all that had been fought for to that point.
translation: 与他们的战斗曾惨烈到几乎让之前所有的努力付诸东流。

english: But don't forget, we were already starting to become civilised now, and so Lord Jovkai was invited to Castle Drakan for reparation discussions.
translation: 但别忘了，那时我们已经开始变得文明了，所以约夫凯领主被邀请到德拉肯城堡进行赔偿谈判。

english: And as he drank his wine, he told us that this was to be our reparations. We would be strangers in our own home, dining from his scraps.
translation: 他一边喝着酒，一边告诉我们这就是我们的赔偿。我们将成为自己家园里的陌生人，吃他的残羹剩饭。

english: When the meal was done, he decided it was my job to tidy up, so tidy I did. I took Lord Jovkai's cup and washed it in poison.
translation: 用餐结束后，他决定由我来收拾，于是我就收拾了。我拿起约夫凯领主的杯子，用毒药洗了它。

english: It was just a small amount of course. Not enough to kill him. But every night we dined, I did the same.
translation: 当然只是一点点。不足以杀死他。但每晚我们用餐时，我都这么做。

english: Why are you telling me this?
translation: 你为什么告诉我这些？

english: Now, as fun as all this has been, my brother will almost certainly be upon you and your new friends soon. Given you clearly don't need my help anymore, perhaps you should go and bother someone else instead.
translation: 好了，虽然这一切很有趣，但我哥哥很快就会来找你和你的新朋友了。既然你显然不再需要我的帮助，也许你该去打扰别人了。

english: Vanescula ignores you.
translation: 瓦内斯库拉无视了你。

english: Any luck with her?
translation: 她那边有进展吗？

english: I suspected as much. I wouldn't keep wasting time on her. We have more important things to worry about.
translation: 我猜也是。我不会在她身上继续浪费时间。我们有更重要的事要操心。

english: What do you make of all this?
translation: 你对这一切怎么看？

english: You mean Sugadinti? We just keep replacing one vampyre with another. Vanescula, her brother, and now him. Even if we do get back to Morytania, how long before we find ourselves having to deal with him as well?
translation: 你是说苏加丁提？我们只是用一个吸血鬼换另一个吸血鬼。瓦内斯库拉，她哥哥，现在又轮到他。就算我们真的回到莫利塔尼亚，过不了多久我们是不是又要对付他了？

english: It's not just him though.
translation: 但不止他一个。

english: Which makes it even worse. These aranei... Look at how they worship him! Imagine if the people of Morytania acted like that towards Drakan! Are we really allying ourselves with a cult now?
translation: 那就更糟了。这些阿拉内伊……看看他们是怎么崇拜他的！想象一下如果莫利塔尼亚的人民也这样对待德拉肯！我们真的要和一个邪教结盟吗？

english: But what about Efaritay? Do you not think we can trust her at least?
translation: 那埃法里泰呢？你难道不觉得至少她可以信任吗？

english: It's been lifetimes since she was a queen. The things she's been through... we don't know what that did to her. Drakan's prisoner... now friends with a vampyre!
translation: 她当女王已经是几辈子以前的事了。她经历的那些事……我们不知道那对她造成了什么影响。德拉肯的囚犯……现在却和吸血鬼做朋友！

english: So you really don't trust her at all? Not even slightly?
translation: 所以你完全不信任她？一点都没有？

english: We don't know her, [player name].
translation: 我们不了解她，[player name]。

english: No, but she might be the best hope we have now.
translation: 不，但她可能是我们现在最大的希望了。

english: You still don't think we're getting out of this, do you?
translation: 你还是觉得我们逃不出去，对吧？

english: There's a slim chance now, sure. But it's just that: slim. Besides, like I say, even if we do survive, what then?
translation: 现在确实有一线希望了。但也仅此而已：一线。再说了，就像我说的，就算我们活下来了，然后呢？

english: Can you not imagine it? Sugadinti and Efaritay, leading Morytania side by side, with us there to help as well. This could be a real future!
translation: 你想象不到吗？苏加丁提和埃法里泰并肩领导莫利塔尼亚，我们也在旁边帮忙。这可以成为真正的未来！

english: No, I can't imagine it! And I don't need to imagine it, because it's never going to happen!
translation: 不，我想象不到！我也不需要想象，因为那永远不会发生！

english: Like it or not, Veliaf, you need to face the facts! The reality is, you might actually survive this! And what then?! What happens when you finally accept that this isn't where it ends for you?!
translation: 不管愿不愿意，维利亚夫，你得面对现实！事实是，你也许真的能活下来！然后呢？！当你终于接受这不是你的终点时，会发生什么？！

english: A pub.
translation: 一间酒馆。

english: That one in Burgh de Rott. Tidy it up, give it a new name. Maybe set up a brewery in the cellar...
translation: 伯格德罗特镇那间。收拾一下，换个新名字。也许在地窖里弄个酿酒坊……

english: What would you serve?
translation: 你会供应什么？

english: Nothing fancy. Just good proper beers, brewed on site.
translation: 不搞花哨的。就是正经好啤酒，现场酿造。

english: Some food surely?
translation: 总得有点吃的吧？

english: Hmm... Maybe some nice pies? Would need someone else to cook them though.
translation: 嗯……也许来点好馅饼？不过得找别人来烤。

english: Don't fancy yourself a chef?
translation: 不觉得自己能当厨师？

english: Just probably best I don't kill all the patrons. Bad for business.
translation: 最好还是别把客人全毒死。对生意不好。

english: What would you call it?
translation: 你会给它起什么名字？

english: Myreque's Rest.
translation: 迈里奎之憩。

english: Well, I look forward to visiting it.
translation: 好，我期待去光顾。

english: Best you go and get ready, [player name]. Won't be long until Drakan is here.
translation: 你最好去准备一下，[player name]。德拉肯很快就到了。

english: And when we arrive in Morytania?
translation: 那我们到了莫利塔尼亚之后呢？

english: And what about all the vampyres left in Morytania?
translation: 那莫利塔尼亚剩下的那些吸血鬼怎么办？

english: Without a clear leader, chaos will ensue. That is... unless a new candidate steps in.
translation: 没有明确的领袖，混乱就会接踵而至。除非……有新的候选人站出来。

english: Once we are somewhere safer, I will explain everything. However, for now, we must focus on our survival.
translation: 等我们到了更安全的地方，我会解释一切。但现在，我们必须专注于活下去。

english: They're going to fight Drakan? If that's the case, then I will join them.
translation: 他们要去对抗德拉肯？如果是这样，那我也加入他们。

english: We need as much time as we can get. Even if I can make a small difference, it might be the difference between success and failure.
translation: 我们需要尽可能多的时间。即使我只能做出一点小小的贡献，那也可能就是成败之间的差别。

english: Don't worry about me. You just make sure that portal is ready.
translation: 别担心我。你只要确保传送门准备好就行。

english: Lord Drakan is almost here, my friend. I pray to Father Sugadinti that you are adequately prepared.
translation: 德拉肯大人就快到了，我的朋友。我向苏加丁提神祈祷，愿你准备充分。

english: They have no hope of standing against Drakan. Once he arrives, every last one of them will die.
translation: 他们毫无希望对抗德拉肯。他一到，他们一个都活不了。

english: Let him go, Vanescula!
translation: 让他走，瓦内斯库拉！

english: We don't have time for this, Efaritay!
translation: 我们没时间管这个，埃法里泰！

english: I will not abandon my son! Let her through, Sugadinti!
translation: 我不会抛弃我的儿子！让她过去，苏加丁提！

english: You do not need Sugadinti to make a choice Drakan. I'm more than capable of making my own. If you want me, I'm right here!
translation: 你不需要苏加丁提来做决定，德拉肯。我完全有能力自己做决定。如果你想要我，我就在这儿！

english: I think that spell must have done something to the portal. They could be anywhere!
translation: 我觉得那个法术一定对传送门做了什么。他们可能被传送到任何地方！

english: And that's not all. Look!
translation: 还不止这些。看！

english: Maybe the hideout in Meiyerditch?
translation: 也许是迈尔迪奇的藏身处？

english: Burgh de Rott then?
translation: 那伯格德罗特镇呢？

english: We're alright, Veliaf. It's good to see you in one piece.
translation: 我们没事，维利亚夫。看到你安然无恙真好。

english: Drakan targeted the portal with some sort of spell. Doing so caused it to expand, sending us all here.
translation: 德拉肯用某种法术瞄准了传送门。结果导致它扩张，把我们全都送到了这里。

english: We can't give up! There must still be a chance to stop him.
translation: 我们不能放弃！一定还有机会阻止他。

english: How? His blood moon is starting to rise. He'll already be preparing to start his festival, and given there's been no sign of Efaritay, I think it's pretty safe to say he has her.
translation: 怎么阻止？他的血月已经开始升起。他已经在准备开始他的庆典了，而且既然没有任何埃法里泰的踪迹，我想可以肯定地说他已经抓到她。

english: Sugadinti, you'd been preparing to overthrow Drakan for years. What was the original plan?
translation: 苏加丁提，你多年来一直在准备推翻德拉肯。原本的计划是什么？

english: Our original hope was to gather allies here to support us in overthrowing Drakan. We had been preparing for this in multiple areas, though as I say, things were unfortunately cut short.
translation: 我们原本的希望是在这里集结盟友来支持我们推翻德拉肯。我们一直在多个地方为此做准备，不过如我所说，事情不幸被中断了。
