english: The being that is masquerading as my daughter.
translation: 那个伪装成我女儿的存在。

english: The Nylocas Queen? So that's what we were preparing for in the Theatre. But I thought you were developing weapons to use against her?
translation: 尼洛卡斯蛛后？所以那就是我们在剧院里准备对付的东西。但我以为你是在研发武器来对付她？

english: I see. You need something to keep her in check.
translation: 我明白了。你需要什么东西来牵制她。

english: What about Vanescula? She has Safalaan!
translation: 那瓦内斯库拉呢？她手里有萨法拉恩！

english: Veliaf's right. We can't just abandon him. Besides, the last thing we need when trying to deal with one Drakan is the other to be causing problems as well.
translation: 维利亚夫说得对。我们不能就这么抛弃他。再说，对付一个德拉肯的时候，另一个还在捣乱，那可不是我们想要的。

english: Well, we don't all need to go to the Theatre. Veliaf and I can find Vanescula while you two head over there.
translation: 我们不必都去剧院。维利亚夫和我可以去找瓦内斯库拉，你们俩去那边。

english: Hmm... Very well. Some of my disciples will join you. They will send word to us as soon as you find out where she is.
translation: 嗯……好吧。我的一些门徒会和你们一起去。一旦你们找到她的下落，他们会立刻通知我们。

english: How do you know they'll accept you?
translation: 你怎么知道他们会接受你？

english: And in the longer term?
translation: 那长远来看呢？

english: But the humans of Morytania will finally be free? That's something you can promise?
translation: 但莫利塔尼亚的人类最终会获得自由？这是你能保证的吗？

english: And what about Vanescula? Where does she fit into this?
translation: 那瓦内斯库拉呢？她在这其中扮演什么角色？

english: I doubt she'd help willingly.
translation: 我怀疑她不会心甘情愿地帮忙。

english: The Drakan clan always disgusted us. Even by the standards back then, their ways were barbaric. Their Blood Moon festivals were the finest example of that.
translation: 德拉肯家族一直让我们感到厌恶。即使按当时的标准，他们的方式也太过野蛮。他们的血月节就是最好的例子。

english: Vanescula promised a future where humans and vampyres lived side by side as well.
translation: 瓦内斯库拉承诺过人类和吸血鬼和平共处的未来。

english: I have no doubt that she did, but she is a Drakan as well, my child. Her ambition may well be greater than that of even her brother's. These lands would never see peace under her.
translation: 我毫不怀疑她说过，但她也是德拉肯家族的人，我的孩子。她的野心可能比她哥哥还要大。在她的统治下，这片土地永远不会安宁。

english: The blood moon is already starting to rise though. We've already seen some vampyres capturing humans for the festival as well.
translation: 但血月已经开始升起。我们已经看到一些吸血鬼在抓人类准备过节了。

english: They will, but most of them are not true vampyres. They are Drakan's creations. They will not know me, nor will they recognise my scent.
translation: 他们会，但他们大多数不是真正的吸血鬼。他们是德拉肯的造物。他们不会认识我，也不会认出我的气味。

english: I suppose the same can be said for us. What's the plan here?
translation: 我想我们也是一样。这里的计划是什么？

english: And you have a way to stop her if she does?
translation: 如果她真的这么做了，你有办法阻止她吗？

english: Are we going to have to fight through the Theatre to get to her?
translation: 我们是不是要一路打穿剧院才能找到她？

english: Makes sense. Shall we head in then?
translation: 有道理。那我们进去吧？

english: Not quite. I actually have quite a specific task for you. While I have my audience with the Nylocas Queen, I would like you to ensure we are not... disturbed.
translation: 还不行。我其实有个很具体的任务交给你。在我与尼洛卡斯蛛后会面的时候，我希望你确保我们不会被打扰。

english: Alright. I can do that.
translation: 好的。我能做到。

english: Shall we head back inside, my child?
translation: 我们回去吗，我的孩子？

english: You? We know you... You have fought in the Theatre before...
translation: 你？我们认识你……你以前在剧院战斗过……

english: You think the Theatre will close? No... My pretties must feed. The Theatre will provide for them...
translation: 你觉得剧院会关闭？不……我的宝贝们必须进食。剧院会为它们提供食物……

english: Yes... No more will we dine on scraps...
translation: 是的……我们不再吃残羹剩饭了……

english: Yes... We will continue to feed, but only on those who wish to enter, and only if they fail to survive...
translation: 是的……我们会继续进食，但只吃那些自愿进入的人，而且只有当他们没能活下来的时候……

english: If you head east of Burgh de Rott and then north, you will find a ruined building. We will be waiting there.
translation: 如果你往伯格德罗特镇东边走，然后向北，你会找到一座废墟建筑。我们会在那里等你。

english: I'd better get over there.
translation: 我最好赶紧过去。

english: Did everything go okay at the Theatre?
translation: 剧院那边一切顺利吗？

english: Another monster as an ally. Still, maybe here we can at least finally get rid of one of those monsters. One of the villagers from Burgh de Rott says they saw a vampyre entering this ruin with a very tall man.
translation: 又一个怪物盟友。不过，也许在这里我们至少能除掉其中一个怪物。伯格德罗特镇的一个村民说他们看到一个吸血鬼和一个很高的男人进了这座废墟。

english: Agreed. [player name], you and I will head inside and deal with Vanescula while Ivan keeps watch out here with the aranei.
translation: 同意。[player name]，你和我进去对付瓦内斯库拉，伊万和蜘蛛在外面守着。

english: You two be careful in there.
translation: 你们俩在里面小心点。

english: I have your flail here, [player name]. You're probably going to need it in there.
translation: [player name]，你的链枷在我这里。你进去可能会用到它。

english: Veliaf gives you your flail.
translation: 维利亚夫把你的链枷递给你。

english: Now, we don't have time to waste. After you, [player name].
translation: 现在，我们没时间浪费。你先请，[player name]。

english: After you, [player name].
translation: 你先请，[player name]。

english: But you can't accept that! You can't accept that this is the only way to defeat my brother! That is why you will always fail. You think that hope alone will win you this war? Sacrifice! That's what wins wars!
translation: 但你不能接受！你不能接受这是打败我哥哥的唯一方法！这就是你们永远会失败的原因。你以为光靠希望就能赢得这场战争？祭品！那才是赢得战争的东西！

english: That's not true. He's right here in front of me. Let me help you, Safalaan. It's not too late. We can reverse this!
translation: 不是这样的。他就在我面前。让我帮你，萨法拉恩。还不晚。我们可以逆转这一切！

english: Then stay... Stay and die!
translation: 那就留下……留下等死吧！

english: I have your flail here, [player name].
translation: [player name]，你的链枷在我这里。

english: You two be careful in there. I'll be right out here if you need anything.
translation: 你们俩在里面小心点。需要什么我就在外面。

english: Is everything okay in there, [player name]?
translation: [player name]，里面一切还好吗？

english: Not exactly... I need to get back in there quick.
translation: 不完全是……我得赶紧回去。

english: Should I come with you?
translation: 要我跟你一起去吗？

english: No, you stay out here. Last thing we need is more vampyres coming in.
translation: 不，你留在这儿。我们最不需要的就是更多吸血鬼进来。

english: Okay, but please be careful, [player name].
translation: 好吧，但请小心点，[player name]。

english: It would be unwise to go in there without your flail.
translation: 没有你的链枷就进去可不明智。

english: Ragh!
translation: 啊！

english: Grah!
translation: 呃啊！

english: No! Safalaan, stay with me!
translation: 不！萨法拉恩，别离开我！

english: You can beat this Safalaan!
translation: 你能挺过去的，萨法拉恩！

english: Alive as well, but in an even worse state. The aranei took her, but [player name]... what happened here? There was some sort of... creature!
translation: 她还活着，但情况更糟。蜘蛛抓走了她，但[player name]……这里发生了什么？有某种……生物！

english: Are you sure? You've been pretty badly beat up yourself.
translation: 你确定吗？你自己也伤得不轻。

english: Ivan... we can still stop this. Once Veliaf is safe, I need you to make a Guthix balance potion. We need to get it to Safalaan before he fully transforms.
translation: 伊万……我们还能阻止这一切。等维利亚夫安全了，我需要你制作一瓶古斯平衡药水。我们得在他完全转化前送到萨法拉恩那里。

english: Castle Drakan? You don't think...?
translation: 德拉肯城堡？你不会是想……？

english: Then that is where we must go as well, my child, for the time has come. The blood moon has fully risen, and my disciples tell me the vampyres are gathering outside the castle.
translation: 那我们也必须去那里，我的孩子，因为时机已到。血月已完全升起，我的门徒告诉我吸血鬼正在城堡外聚集。

english: Your friend is right, my child. You should remain here.
translation: 你的朋友说得对，我的孩子。你应该留在这里。

english: We'll bring him back safe.
translation: 我们会把他安全带回来的。

english: That day... in that courtyard... we lost. And we could have just turned and run. Truth be told, we nearly did. But that wasn't our first loss, nor our second... We've lost so many times, we've lost count!
translation: 那一天……在那个院子里……我们输了。我们本可以转身就跑。说实话，我们差点就这么做了。但那不是我们第一次失败，也不是第二次……我们输太多次了，数都数不清！

english: But it doesn't matter. It doesn't matter how many times we fail. It doesn't matter how many of us fall. To be honest, it doesn't even matter if we all fall!
translation: 但这不重要。我们失败多少次都不重要。我们倒下多少人也不重要。说实话，就算我们全都倒下也不重要！

english: You've got a knack for giving a good speech, Ivan. Must have learnt from the best.
translation: 你挺会演讲的，伊万。一定是跟最好的学的。

english: Hmph. Go on, get going. Don't want to keep Drakan waiting.
translation: 哼。去吧，走吧。别让德拉肯等急了。

english: It can't be true! Look, they have a vampyre with them! It's all a trick! Now we're all doomed!
translation: 这不可能是真的！看，他们带着一个吸血鬼！全是骗局！现在我们全完了！

english: Wait! It's okay! He's with us. He's going to help us deal with Drakan, once and for all!
translation: 等等！没事的！他跟我们一起的。他会帮我们对付德拉肯，一劳永逸！

english: Then it is true... The Myreque are back!
translation: 那这是真的……迈雷克回来了！

english: I never thought I'd see this day come!
translation: 我从没想过能活着看到这一天！

english: Good luck, my friends. Know that all of Morytania is behind you.
translation: 祝你们好运，朋友们。要知道整个莫利塔尼亚都在你们身后。

english: Well, no point wasting time I suppose. Let's finish this, [player name].
translation: 好吧，我想没必要浪费时间了。让我们了结这一切，[player name]。

english: Go on, get going, before I go changing my mind about all this.
translation: 走吧，趁我还没改变主意。

english: Lord Myrmel, I must confess that you've impressed me. I was sure you would join Lord Jovkai in finding a hole to hide in.
translation: 米尔梅尔大人，我得承认你让我刮目相看。我原以为你会和乔夫凯大人一样找个洞躲起来。

english: Lord Drakan. I hope we are not late.
translation: 德拉肯大人。希望我们没迟到。

english: No matter, Sugadinti. I do not require her to be able to kill you.
translation: 无所谓，苏加丁提。我不需要她活着就能杀了你。

english: Sugadinti! We need to reopen the portal!
translation: 苏加丁提！我们需要重新打开传送门！

english: I will not abandon my son!
translation: 我不会抛弃我的儿子！

english: Your son sacrificed himself to save us all! We can't undo that!
translation: 你儿子牺牲自己救了大家！我们无法改变那件事！

english: Your son has been turned! His blood has been tainted! Drakan won't be able to use it for anything. It's over, Efaritay! We've won!
translation: 你儿子已经被转化了！他的血已被玷污！德拉肯无法用它做任何事。结束了，埃法里泰！我们赢了！

english: Won? You would celebrate this as a victory? Is that all this was about to you? I trusted you to be better than Drakan!
translation: 赢了？你把这当作胜利来庆祝？这对你来说就只是这样吗？我信任你，以为你会比德拉肯更好！

english: I promise you, we will discuss this matter properly, but first, the crowd needs to be placated. I must address them. Please, wait for me inside the castle...
translation: 我向你保证，我们会好好讨论这件事，但首先，得安抚人群。我必须向他们讲话。请在城堡里等我……

english: I suppose that's the best we can hope for.
translation: 我想这是我们能期望的最好结果了。

english: My condolences for the loss of your friend. He will be remembered.
translation: 对你朋友的离去我深表哀悼。他会被铭记的。

english: You wait for Sugadinti to finish outside. When he arrives, he's joined by some aranei, who bring Veliaf and Vanescula with them.
translation: 你等着苏加丁提在外面说完。当他到达时，一些蜘蛛带着维利亚夫和瓦内斯库拉一同前来。

english: I couldn't care less who they accept as their ruler. I want to know what happened here! Where is Safalaan?!
translation: 我才不在乎他们接受谁当统治者。我想知道这里发生了什么！萨法拉恩在哪？！

english: I'm afraid, my child, that your friend is gone. He sacrificed himself so that we could defeat Drakan.
translation: 恐怕，我的孩子，你的朋友已经不在了。他牺牲了自己，让我们得以击败德拉肯。

english: There is much that will need doing, and it will take many years, but peace will finally be a possibility for these lands.
translation: 还有很多事要做，需要很多年，但和平终将有望降临这片土地。

english: I believe there is benefit in keeping Vanescula alive, my child. She knows the vampyres here in a way I don't. She will be of great help in keeping them in line.
translation: 我相信留着瓦内斯库拉一条命是有益的，我的孩子。她对这里的吸血鬼的了解是我所不及的。她将极大地帮助我们约束他们。

english: However, I assure you, she will live as a prisoner forever more. Her days of scheming are at an end.
translation: 不过，我向你保证，她将永远作为囚犯活下去。她阴谋算计的日子已经结束了。

english: But what if you're wrong about all of this? What if Safalaan is still alive? And what if Drakan is somehow able to find a way to still use his blood?
translation: 但如果你对这一切的判断错了呢？如果萨法拉安还活着呢？如果德拉肯还能设法利用他的血呢？

english: And that is why I have a request for you, my child. However, Ivan, Veliaf, I must first ask something of the two of you as well.
translation: 这就是我对你有一个请求的原因，我的孩子。不过，伊万、维利亚夫，我也得先请你们二位做一件事。

english: They will quickly learn of what happened here. They must be reassured that we are no danger to them.
translation: 他们很快就会知道这里发生了什么。必须让他们放心，我们不会对他们构成威胁。

english: We're not going anywhere until we know what's happening with Efaritay and Safalaan!
translation: 在知道埃法里泰和萨法拉安的情况之前，我们哪儿也不去！

english: Besides, Veliaf is still too injured to handle the Efaritay situation, but I promise you, [player name] here will deal with it. You have my word.
translation: 况且，维利亚夫伤势太重，无法处理埃法里泰的事，但我向你保证，[player name]会处理好的。我向你保证。

english: I'm warning you, Sugadinti... if you do anything to prevent Safalaan from making it home, you won't even live long enough to regret it.
translation: 我警告你，苏加丁蒂……如果你敢阻挠萨法拉安回家，你会连后悔的机会都没有。

english: Come on, Ivan. Let's get going.
translation: 走吧，伊万。我们出发。

english: You mean go to Vampyrium?
translation: 你是说去吸血鬼界？

english: And Safalaan?
translation: 那萨法拉安呢？

english: Thank you, and good luck, my child.
translation: 谢谢你，祝你好运，我的孩子。

english: Remember what I told you back in Vampyrium, [player name]? It seems I am to once again be made a stranger in my own home.
translation: 还记得我在吸血鬼界跟你说过的话吗，[player name]？看来我又要成为自己家里的陌生人了。

english: It's a better fate than you deserve.
translation: 这比你应得的下场好多了。

english: I did what I had to, just as I will continue to do so. If Sugadinti is to be our new leader, then so be it.
translation: 我做了我必须做的事，以后也会继续如此。如果苏加丁蒂要成为我们的新领袖，那就这样吧。

english: But make no mistake, if even for a second I come to feel that we'd be better off without him, well... he should probably make sure it isn't me washing his cup.
translation: 但别搞错了，哪怕有一瞬间我觉得没有他我们会更好，嗯……他最好确保洗他杯子的不是我。

english: No, I think your days of washing cups are done. Farewell, Vanescula.
translation: 不，我想你洗杯子的日子已经结束了。再见了，瓦内斯库拉。

english: You... Are you sure?
translation: 你……你确定吗？

english: I'm here, my son. I'm here.
translation: 我在这儿，我的儿子。我在这儿。

english: Get him back to the portal and get back to Morytania.
translation: 把他带回传送门，然后回莫利塔尼亚。

english: We don't have time for this!
translation: 我们没时间说这些了！

english: I'm not sure yet. He's very weak. But [player name]... why are you back here? Is it done?
translation: 我还不确定。他非常虚弱。但[player name]……你怎么回来了？事情办完了吗？

english: Not yet, but it will be, I promise.
translation: 还没有，但会办完的，我保证。

english: You're back, my child. Did you find Efaritay?
translation: 你回来了，我的孩子。你找到埃法里泰了吗？

english: Please be quick, my child.
translation: 请快一点，我的孩子。

english: Now's not the time for that. You need to deal with Drakan.
translation: 现在不是说这个的时候。你得去对付德拉肯。

english: You go to use the door, but notice a chest nearby with some useful supplies in it...
translation: 你正要去用门，却注意到附近有一个宝箱，里面有一些有用的补给品……

english: I've seen empires rise, then watched them crumble into dust... I've witnessed the ascension of gods, then watched those same gods fade into nothing...
translation: 我见过帝国崛起，又看着它们化为灰尘……我见证过诸神的飞升，又看着那些神祇归于无……

english: But now, here you stand. You understand that even with me in this state, the odds are very much against you. Yet despite that, you stand here all the same.
translation: 但现在，你站在这里。你明白即使我处于这种状态，胜算也对你极为不利。然而尽管如此，你还是站在了这里。

english: You. A mere human... I don't even know your name.
translation: 你。一个区区人类……我甚至不知道你的名字。

english: I'm sorry... His wound... It's too great. If we reverse the vampyrification...
translation: 对不起……他的伤……太重了。如果我们逆转吸血鬼化……

english: No! What can we do? There must be something we can do!
translation: 不！我们能做什么？一定有什么办法的！

english: Never. You are my son. I will never abandon you.
translation: 永远不会。你是我的儿子。我永远不会抛弃你。

english: I can feel it... The urge... I must... feed!
translation: 我能感觉到……那股冲动……我必须……吸血！

english: I do. I'm here, my son. I will never leave you again.
translation: 我知道。我在这儿，我的儿子。我再也不会离开你了。

english: Mother... thank you...
translation: 母亲……谢谢你……

english: And I never will, Safalaan. Like it or not, you and I are in this together.
translation: 我永远不会的，萨法拉安。不管你是否愿意，你和我都在一起面对这一切。

english: You should have this before you go.
translation: 你走之前应该带上这个。

english: Keep it. My days of fighting are over. It's yours now.
translation: 留着吧。我的战斗日子已经结束了。现在是你的了。

english: You go on ahead. I'll join you later.
translation: 你先走，我稍后跟上。

english: You find some tools in the tent.
translation: 你在帐篷里找到了一些工具。

english: Take a pickaxe.
translation: 拿一把镐子。

english: You take a pickaxe from the tent.
translation: 你从帐篷里拿了一把镐子。

english: You go to take a pickaxe, but realise you don't need to as you already have one.
translation: 你正要去拿镐子，但意识到自己已经有一把了，不需要再拿。

english: You go to take a pickaxe, but realise you don't have enough room to do so.
translation: 你正要去拿镐子，但意识到自己没有足够的空间来拿。

english: Take a hammer.
translation: 拿一把锤子。

english: You take a hammer from the tent.
translation: 你从帐篷里拿了一把锤子。

english: You go to take a hammer, but realise you don't need to as you already have one.
translation: 你正要去拿锤子，但意识到自己已经有一把了，不需要再拿。

english: You go to take a hammer, but realise you don't have enough room to do so.
translation: 你正要去拿锤子，但意识到自己没有足够的空间来拿。

english: Take a chisel.
translation: 拿一把凿子。

english: You take a chisel from the tent.
translation: 你从帐篷里拿了一把凿子。

english: You go to take a chisel, but realise you don't need to as you already have one.
translation: 你正要去拿凿子，但意识到自己已经有一把了，不需要再拿。

english: You go to take a chisel, but realise you don't have enough room to do so.
translation: 你正要去拿凿子，但意识到自己没有足够的空间来拿。

english: Approximately 140 years after the establishment of the outpost, a great traveller, known only as [player name] unravelled the history of the outpost.
translation: 前哨站建立约140年后，一位伟大的旅行者，仅以[player name]之名闻名，揭开了前哨站的历史。

english: It transpires that the outpost was first established to protect the nearby city of Ardougne from threats, spotting them before they had the chance to reach the city. There followed a long period without war during which the outpost was abandoned as a pointless project. Various people visited the outpost for various reasons, but none left any particular mark on history. The first and most important mark wasn't until 65 years after the establishment of the outpost, when a group of Zamorak followers moved in.
translation: 原来前哨站最初是为了保护附近的阿多尼城免受威胁而建立的，在威胁到达城市之前就发现它们。随后是一段漫长的和平时期，前哨站被视为无意义的工程而被废弃。各种人因各种原因造访过前哨站，但没有人留下任何特别的历史印记。第一个也是最重要的印记直到前哨站建立65年后才出现，那时一群萨莫拉克追随者进驻了这里。

english: The Zamorakians' only purpose seemed to be the disruption of the nearby city of Ardougne, over the years now known as the 'The Dreaded Years of Tragedy'.
translation: 这些萨莫拉克信徒的唯一目的似乎就是扰乱附近的阿多尼城，这段时期后来被称为'可怕的悲剧岁月'。

english: The leader of the Zamorak followers had once had a great friend. However, when they were still young they had both fallen apart in a disagreement over religion. One decided that Saradomin was the god for him, and the other chose Zamorak. It just so happened that when the City of Ardougne called for help to rid them of these Zamorakians, that the incoming force were Saradominists led by the other ex-friend. This in-turn led to a battle simply known as 'The Great Battle', perhaps because little was known about its activity with it being a small battle in terms of numbers, (although not in power, we suspect).
translation: 萨莫拉克追随者的首领曾经有一位挚友。然而，在他们还年轻时，因宗教分歧而分道扬镳。一人认定萨拉丁是他的神，另一人选择了萨莫拉克。巧合的是，当阿多尼城请求帮助驱逐这些萨莫拉克信徒时，前来支援的正是由那位昔日好友率领的萨拉丁信徒。这最终导致了一场被称为'大战役'的战斗，也许是因为人们对它的活动知之甚少，它是一场人数规模较小的战斗（尽管我们怀疑其威力并不小）。

english: The battle produced two survivors - the two ex- friends, both being the most powerful mages. It is said that they settled their differences on the grounds of the friendship they had lost, as well as the loss of life and time.
translation: 这场战斗产生了两位幸存者——那对昔日好友，两人都是最强大的法师。据说他们因失去的友谊以及生命的损失和时间的流逝而化解了分歧。

english: Settling for the neutral god Guthix, the two went about their ways to spread equality among the people. One of the friends became king, to listen to people's views and ensure a fair and equal life for everyone, whilst the other friend founded the market place, allowing people to trade their skills and wares under equal rights and opportunities.
translation: 两人选择了中立的古斯神，各自致力于在人民中传播平等。其中一人成为国王，倾听人民的意见，确保每个人都能过上公平平等的生活，而另一位好友则创立了市场，让人们能够在平等的权利和机会下交易他们的技能和商品。

english: Word is spreading of a brave and intelligent adventurer who goes by the name '[player name]', He has talked to a great many people, helping solve problems and improving their lives.
translation: 关于一位名叫'[player name]'的勇敢而聪明的冒险者的消息正在传开，他与许多人交谈，帮助解决问题，改善他们的生活。

english: Word is spreading of a brave and intelligent adventurer who goes by the name '[player name]', She has talked to a great many people, helping solve problems and improving their lives.
translation: 关于一位名叫'[player name]'的勇敢而聪明的女性冒险者的消息正在传开，她与许多人交谈，帮助解决问题，改善他们的生活。

english: Word is spreading of a brave and intelligent adventurer who goes by the name '[player name]', They have talked to a great many people, helping solve problems and improving their lives.
translation: 关于一位名叫'[player name]'的勇敢而聪明的冒险者的消息正在传开，他们与许多人交谈，帮助解决问题，改善他们的生活。

english: The list of achievements include:
translation: 成就清单包括：

english: The list goes on, so we can see that this [player name] is destined for great things for which Gielinor should be truly grateful!
translation: 清单还在继续，所以我们看得出这位[player name]注定要成就伟业，吉连诺应该为此深感庆幸！

english: The war between the gods has taken its toll on all of us, but especially on my kind, the Dorgeshuun. We were not made to fight, we are a peaceful race. We were forced into fighting for the god Bandos, or as I like to call him, the Big High Idiot.
translation: 诸神之间的战争让我们所有人都付出了代价，但尤其是我的族人，多格舒恩族。我们不是为战斗而生的，我们是和平的种族。我们被迫为班多斯神而战，或者我喜欢称他为'大高个白痴'。

english: Normally I would have to hold back regurgitating my dinner every time I recount my experiences. However, there was this one occurrence that I thought would make for quite the story to tell.
translation: 通常每次回忆这些经历时，我都得忍住不把晚饭吐出来。不过，有一次经历我觉得可以讲成一个好故事。

english: The Big High Idiot wanted the war to go on for eternity, but all the goblins, including me, were too squishy for his needs. He wanted some new foot soldiers that could take a harder beating and deliver it as well. He could probably have created these soldiers himself, but he was too busy throwing punches with Armadyl, so he decided to appoint some lackeys for the job. Unfortunately, that included me.
translation: 大高个白痴想让战争永远持续下去，但包括我在内的所有哥布林对他来说都太软了。他想要一些能承受更重打击也能给予更重打击的新步兵。他本可以自己创造这些士兵，但他忙着和阿玛迪尔打架，所以决定指派一些走狗来做这件事。不幸的是，其中包括我。

english: I was sent on a mission to assist the Ourg general Snaarldor in creating a new weapon, which roughly translates to lugging around the baggage for him.
translation: 我被派去执行一项任务，协助欧格将军斯纳尔多创造一种新武器，说白了就是替他扛行李。

english: Snaarldor carried a large hunk of tourmaline with him, shaped like a heart. I mused that it was a representation of Bandos' stone, blackened heart, but I dare not say it in earshot of one of his most loyal commanders. I wasn't sure what it was for, but apparently it had some kind of reaction when it came into contact with the metal that the Big High Idiot created. We were supposed to use it to create some kind of device and perform a ritual around it. I didn't know what the end goal would be, but I was the one that was supposed to perform the ritual.
translation: 斯纳尔多随身携带了一大块电气石，形状像心脏。我心想这代表班多斯那颗石头般漆黑的心，但我不敢在他最忠诚的指挥官之一面前说出来。我不知道那是干什么用的，但显然它与大高个白痴创造的金属接触时会产生某种反应。我们本应用它来制造某种装置，并围绕它进行仪式。我不知道最终目标是什么，但我是那个应该执行仪式的人。

english: Somehow, our trek ended up leading us past the River Salve and into Hallowvale, the land of Saradomin. I expressed my concerns to Snaarldor, but he just threated to give me something else to be concerned about. I supposed we were fortunate, or unfortunate for me, that the forces of Zamorak were laying siege to Hallowvale.
translation: 不知怎的，我们的跋涉最终经过了萨尔维河，进入了哈洛维尔，萨拉丁的领地。我向斯纳尔多表达了我的担忧，但他只是威胁说要给我找点别的担忧。我想我们算是幸运的，或者对我来说是不幸的，萨莫拉克的军队正在围攻哈洛维尔。

english: We marched northwards until we stumbled upon a tall tower made of granite. I knew what it was. We had found Viggora's Folly, left to collect dust since his demise.
translation: 我们向北行进，直到偶然发现一座花岗岩制成的高塔。我知道那是什么。我们找到了维戈拉的愚行，自他死后就一直积满灰尘。

english: Snaarldor took interest and had his forces go inside. The massive doors gave plenty of spare room for Snaarldor to go through, and the tall wide halls really did make the massive oaf feel right at home. Our curiosity on the size of everything was cut short when we noticed what decorated these halls. There were these monstrous statues of some creature that I doubt existed in Gielinor or any other realm.
translation: 斯纳尔多对此产生了兴趣，命令他的部队进入。巨大的门为斯纳尔多提供了充足的通行空间，高大宽阔的走廊确实让这个庞然大物感觉像在家一样。当我们注意到装饰这些走廊的东西时，我们对一切尺寸的好奇心戛然而止。那里有某种生物的巨型雕像，我怀疑这种生物在吉连诺或任何其他领域都不存在。

english: We kept marching up the floors until we arrived on the windswept rooftop. Inhabiting it were two massive statues of whatever they were supposed to be. One look at them, and Snaarldor decided that he would bring these sculptures to life. I had no idea how that was going to happen, but Snaarldor had me and the other goblins set up the incantation circle, along with stakes made of Bandos' metal.
translation: 我们继续向上攀登楼层，直到到达风呼啸的屋顶。那里矗立着两座巨大的雕像，不管它们原本代表什么。斯纳尔多看了一眼，就决定要让这些雕塑活过来。我不知道那会怎么发生，但斯纳尔多让我和其他哥布林布置咒语圆圈，以及用班多斯的金属制成的木桩。

english: Once we set that up, we had to wait for high noon. As we waited for the sun to be directly over us, I couldn't help but notice that the two statues we intended to bring to life were situated to the east and west. I thought to myself that Dusk and Dawn would have been fitting names for them, one in the direction of the rising sun, and the other in the direction of the setting sun. I didn't have long to dwell on that thought, however, as the light in the sky loomed ever closer to the position we needed.
translation: 布置好之后，我们必须等待正午。在等待太阳直射我们的时候，我不禁注意到我们打算唤醒的两座雕像分别位于东边和西边。我心想'黄昏'和'黎明'会是合适的名字，一个朝向日出方向，另一个朝向日落方向。然而我没有太多时间思考这个，因为天空中的光线越来越接近我们需要的位置。

english: The gleam of the tourmaline started to reflect towards both the statues. It's amazing how something so dark could be so bright. I didn't have much time to admire it once Snaarldor began the ritual.
translation: 电气石的光芒开始向两座雕像反射。如此黑暗的东西竟能如此明亮，真是令人惊叹。斯纳尔多开始仪式后，我没有太多时间欣赏它。

english: He placed his palms onto the circle, causing them to light up. The tourmaline core slowly sank into the granite floor as if it were liquid. Once it was fully submerged, we prepared for the final step.
translation: 他将手掌放在圆圈上，使它们亮了起来。电气石核心慢慢沉入花岗岩地板，仿佛它是液体一般。一旦完全沉没，我们就准备好了最后一步。

english: The bell was struck, its chimes echoing throughout the tower. A surge of black energy pulsed from the bell, permeating throughout the tall halls. Once the blast settled down, the effects were immediate. I heard some grinding sounds as if two stones were being rubbed together. I turned my attention to the two statues, and by the gods, they were moving. Slowly, they descended from their podiums onto the roof, then stood still.
translation: 钟被敲响，钟声在塔中回荡。一股黑色能量从钟中涌出，弥漫在高大的走廊中。冲击平息后，效果立竿见影。我听到一些研磨声，仿佛两块石头在相互摩擦。我将注意力转向那两座雕像，天哪，它们在动。它们缓缓从基座上降落到屋顶，然后静止不动。

english: Ecstatic with his creation, Snaarldor gave a big speech about the glory of the Big High War God and the such, as if he expected some lumps of carved rock to understand a single thing. After that, Snaarldor gave commands to fight against the forces of Armadyl, Saradomin, and Zamorak.
translation: 斯纳尔多对自己的造物欣喜若狂，发表了一篇关于大高个战神荣耀之类的长篇大论，仿佛他期望那些雕刻的岩石能听懂一个字。之后，斯纳尔多下令对抗阿玛迪尔、萨拉丁和萨莫拉克的军队。

english: The guardians turned their head at the lattermost name. Snaarldor thought this meant that he had gained their loyalty. However, I knew better than to think that. Viggora was a follower of Zamorak, and I knew the tower would be filled with his magic. I wanted to tell Snaarldor this, but once again he threatened me with a long list of what he would do to me.
translation: 守卫们在听到最后一个名字时都转过头来。斯纳尔德以为这意味着他赢得了他们的忠诚。然而，我心里明白并非如此。维戈拉是扎莫拉克的信徒，我知道那座塔里必定充满他的魔法。我想告诉斯纳尔德这一点，但他又一次用一长串威胁来恐吓我，说要对我做什么。

english: Before he could finish his threat, he vanished from my line of sight in a blur, and the next second I was blown away from behind. I was sent tumbling until I was stopped by the wall. Once my head stopped spinning, I witnessed the statues attacking Snaarldor. The orks tried to beat them off their general, but they were simply swatted away by the stone wings.
translation: 他还没来得及说完威胁的话，就一阵风似的从我视线中消失了，下一秒我就被从背后击飞。我翻滚着直到撞上墙壁才停下来。等我脑袋不再发晕时，我目睹了雕像们正在攻击斯纳尔德。兽人们试图把他们从将军身边赶走，但只是被石翼轻易拍飞。

english: Death was certain if I stayed in the tower, so I made a run for it. As I ran down the stairs through the lower floors, I saw that the many hideous statues we passed had also come to life. I managed to avoid all of the living stone monsters and made my way out of the tower.
translation: 留在塔里必死无疑，所以我拔腿就跑。当我跑下楼梯穿过下层时，我看到我们经过的那些丑陋雕像也都活了过来。我设法避开了所有活过来的石怪，逃出了塔。

english: As I was running for my life, a giant shadow passed over me. I looked up and saw the hulking bodies of Snaarldor and one of the statues exchanging strikes in mid air. Snaarldor landed a chop that broke off a wing, and they both fell. The statue landed back on top of the tower while Snaarldor made contact with the nearby swamp. After getting up from the fall, Snaarldor immediately called for his remaining forces to retreat.
translation: 我拼命逃跑时，一个巨大的阴影从我头顶掠过。我抬头看到斯纳尔德和其中一座雕像庞大的身躯在半空中互相攻击。斯纳尔德一记劈砍打断了雕像的一只翅膀，然后他们一起坠落。雕像落回塔顶，而斯纳尔德则摔进了附近的沼泽。从坠落中爬起来后，斯纳尔德立刻命令他剩余的部队撤退。

english: There was no way I was going to go back to serving the Big High Idiot after what had happened, so once we crossed back over to the west, I made my escape. I don't know what those great statues are doing now, but I'm glad to be well away from them.
translation: 经历了这一切之后，我绝不会再回去侍奉那个大高个蠢货了，所以当我们回到西边后，我就逃走了。我不知道那些巨大的雕像现在在做什么，但我很高兴能远离它们。

english: In Gielinor we live in diff'rent clans,
translation: 在吉莱诺我们分属不同部族，

english: Working as one towards Seren's plans.
translation: 齐心协力为塞伦的宏图。

english: We hone sep'rately our varied skills,
translation: 各自磨练不同的技艺，

english: To aid our kin and shape the hills.
translation: 助我族人，塑造山丘。

english: As one without scorn or hate,
translation: 团结一致无蔑无恨，

english: We form our clans, the mighty Eight.
translation: 组成部族，威名八族。

english: First we sing of the clan Amlodd,
translation: 先唱阿姆洛德部族，

english: Against whose mages none dare trod.
translation: 其法师之威无人敢犯。

english: Our enemies are struck by spell,
translation: 敌人皆被咒语击倒，

english: And ne'er return with tales to tell.
translation: 再无归途讲述见闻。

english: Just request a handy teleport!
translation: 只需一声传送即到！

english: Next we come to Cadarn,
translation: 接下来是卡达恩，

english: Through hunt and fight good will they garn.
translation: 狩猎战斗赢得好名声。

english: None surpass their skill with bow,
translation: 弓术无人能出其右，

english: Loosing arrows not just for show.
translation: 射出的箭绝非虚发。

english: All beast of wood they do track,
translation: 林中野兽皆被追踪，

english: So food and fur none shall lack.
translation: 食物毛皮永不匮乏。

english: Now the rhyme for clan Crwys,
translation: 现在唱到克鲁伊斯部族，

english: Their skill with nature none can miss.
translation: 与自然相通无人能及。

english: Yonder home was once a tree!
translation: 远方的家曾是一棵树！

english: Of other skills Crwys are sound,
translation: 克鲁伊斯其他技艺同样精湛，

english: Able to pull nigh all from ground.
translation: 几乎能从大地中培育万物。

english: A swift verse for the clan Hefin,
translation: 为赫芬部族献上快诗一首，

english: With minds and bods above the din.
translation: 身心皆超然于喧嚣之上。

english: They are elves you'd dare not cheat,
translation: 他们是不可欺骗的精灵，

english: For they swiftly fly on nimble feet.
translation: 因为他们脚步轻盈迅捷如飞。

english: Be fooled not by their quick flight,
translation: 莫被他们的疾行所迷惑，

english: There's none closer to Seren's light.
translation: 无人比他们更接近塞伦之光。

english: Now we sing of Iorwerth,
translation: 现在唱到约尔沃斯，

english: Those of high and noble birth.
translation: 出身高贵血统尊荣。

english: All fell beasts do they slay,
translation: 所有凶兽皆被他们斩杀，

english: Ready to fight on any day.
translation: 随时准备投入战斗。

english: In combat none exceed their skill,
translation: 战斗中无人能超越其技艺，

english: Protecting us through their good will.
translation: 以善意守护我们所有人。

english: In this song is clan Ithell,
translation: 这首歌中还有伊塞尔部族，

english: Unequaled for their crystál.
translation: 他们的水晶无与伦比。

english: Tireless they perfect their song,
translation: 不知疲倦地完善他们的歌谣,

english: To supply our tools so ever strong.
translation: 为我们的工具提供永恒的力量。

english: Ithell set to work on any craft.
translation: 伊塞尔族致力于各种工艺。

english: The next clan is that of Meilyr,
translation: 下一个部族是梅利尔,

english: Their craft makes all belts tighter.
translation: 他们的手艺让所有腰带更紧。

english: For all know they produce a kingly meal.
translation: 因为众所周知他们能做出国王般的美食。

english: And when tasty food adds unwanted pounds,
translation: 当美味食物带来多余体重,

english: Drink charmed draught, Meilyr's without bounds!
translation: 喝下魔法药水,梅利尔的无尽良方!

english: The final clan is named Trahaearn,
translation: 最后一个部族名为特拉哈恩,

english: All stone and ore does their work churn.
translation: 他们的劳作翻动所有石头和矿石。

english: That geode is in for quite a shock!
translation: 那块晶洞石可要大吃一惊了!

english: In all metal their impact is felt.
translation: 他们的影响遍及所有金属。

english: Who ne'er think solely of themselves.
translation: 从不只为自己着想。

english: By Seren's light the realm they shape,
translation: 在塞伦之光下塑造这片土地,

english: Brought to this land by World Gate
translation: 通过世界之门来到此地,

english: To start a bright life in Gielinor!
translation: 在吉莱诺尔开启光明新生活!

english: King Shayzien VII has ordered a Great Expedition to explore the lands to the west. His Royal Highness is keen to explore and expand the territory of Kourend. We are to gather the brightest minds and bravest warriors from Kourend and form an expedition party.
translation: 谢兹恩七世国王下令进行大远征,探索西部土地。国王陛下渴望探索并扩张库兰德王国的领土。我们要集结库兰德最聪明的头脑和最勇敢的战士,组成远征队。

english: I have requested a team to survey the immediate area to the west. We will need this information to determine the level of danger and scope of the mission.
translation: 我已要求一支队伍勘察西边邻近区域。我们需要这些信息来确定危险程度和任务范围。

english: The survey team reports findings of a mountain to the west of their encampment beyond a swampy area. The mountain will be the focus of the expedition.
translation: 勘察队报告在营地西边沼泽地外发现一座山。这座山将成为远征的重点。

english: We have appointed Captain Magnus Rimor leader of the party.
translation: 我们已任命马格努斯·里莫尔船长担任队伍领袖。

english: Following a week of interviewing and selection process, Captain Rimor has selected the remainder of the expedition party.
translation: 经过一周的面试和选拔,里莫尔船长选定了远征队的其余成员。

english: - Doctor B. Crushim
translation: - B. 克拉希姆医生

english: - Lieutenant T. Berlin
translation: - T. 柏林中尉

english: - Sergeant H. Garvie
translation: - H. 加维中士

english: - Corporal R. Edshirt
translation: - R. 埃德衬衫下士

english: - Corporal K. Jones
translation: - K. 琼斯下士

english: Profile - Magnus Rimor
translation: 档案 - 马格努斯·里莫尔

english: Rank: Captain
translation: 军衔: 船长

english: City: Shayzien
translation: 城市: 谢兹恩城

english: Captain Rimor is fearless; he seeks to serve King Shayzien with all of his will. Having completed three expeditions to the Northern Tundras in recent years, he is the bravest soldier and most seasoned explorer we have.
translation: 里莫尔船长无所畏惧;他全心全意效忠谢兹恩国王。近年来已完成三次北方冻原远征,他是我们最勇敢的士兵和最老练的探险家。

english: Profile - Bev Crushim
translation: 档案 - 贝夫·克拉希姆

english: Rank: Doctor
translation: 军衔: 医生

english: City: Hosidius
translation: 城市: 霍西迪乌斯城

english: Doctor Crushim is Kourend's most renowned field physician having saved the life of the King himself during an excursion last decade. Her expertise in healing and tactical ability will be invaluable to the party.
translation: 克拉希姆医生是库兰德最著名的野战医生,十年前一次远足中曾救过国王本人的性命。她的治疗专长和战术能力对队伍来说无价。

english: Profile - Thomas Berlin
translation: 档案 - 托马斯·柏林

english: Rank: Lieutenant
translation: 军衔: 中尉

english: City: Piscarilius
translation: 城市: 皮斯卡里琉斯城

english: Though young, Lieutenant Thomas Berlin is the finest navigation officer in the fleet. He was the first officer to sail from Port Piscarilius to the Frozen Tundra of the north and live to tell the tale.
translation: 虽然年轻，托马斯·柏林中尉却是舰队中最出色的航海官。他是第一位从皮斯卡里琉斯港航行至北方冰原并活着回来讲述经历的人。

english: Profile - Henno Garvie
translation: 档案 - 亨诺·加维

english: Rank: Sergeant
translation: 军衔：中士

english: Sergeant Garvie is a tactical expert, known for his skills with explosives and a longbow, his scouting skills will be a necessity as the party encounters unknown dangers.
translation: 加维中士是战术专家，以爆破和长弓技巧闻名，他的侦察技能在队伍遭遇未知危险时必不可少。

english: Profile - Rytin Edshirt
translation: 档案 - 里廷·埃德希特

english: Rank: Corporal
translation: 军衔：下士

english: Corporal Edshirt recently returned from a trek to the north and will serve as a weapons officer on the expedition.
translation: 埃德希特下士刚从北方跋涉归来，将在远征中担任武器官。

english: Profile - Keith Jones
translation: 档案 - 基思·琼斯

english: A veteran of the Shayzien Army, Corporal Jones is known for his strength and ability with a longbow. Watch out for Keith.
translation: 作为谢兹恩城军队的老兵，琼斯下士以力量和长弓技巧著称。小心基思。

english: King Shayzien VII has approved the expedition plans.
translation: 谢兹恩七世国王已批准远征计划。

english: 250 Days to ascend the western mountain and return with details of the findings.
translation: 250天攀登西部高山并带回发现详情。

english: Captain Rimor and his party leave at first light!
translation: 里莫尔船长及其队伍将在晨曦之光出发！

english: It's a translation book, you'll need it to translate what Hazelmere says. Do that carefully! His words are our only hope! You'll find his dwellings high upon a towering hill, on an island east of Yanille.
translation: 这是一本词典，你需要它来翻译黑兹尔米尔说的话。小心使用！他的话是我们唯一的希望！你会发现他的住所位于亚尼勒城东边一座高耸的小山上。

english: The prisoner is in no mood to talk.
translation: 囚犯没有心情说话。

english: You cannot put that on the pillar.
translation: 你不能把那放在柱子上。

english: You can disguise it all you want, but he is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let her in, we've had nothing but trouble!
translation: 你想怎么伪装都行，但他是个外来者，永远都是！自从我们让她进来后，麻烦就没断过！

english: You can disguise it all you want, but she is an outerlander and always will be! Ever since we let him in, we've had nothing but trouble!
translation: 你想怎么伪装都行，但她是个外来者，永远都是！自从我们让他进来后，麻烦就没断过！

english: Begone exile, you're no Fremennik to me.
translation: 滚开，流放者，对我来说你不是费明尼克人。

english: You wrap the rock around the fishing line and lower it into the geyser.
translation: 你把岩石缠在钓鱼线上，然后放入间歇泉中。

english: You cast your fishing line into the geyser.
translation: 你把钓鱼线抛入间歇泉中。

english: You reel the rock back up from the geyser...
translation: 你把岩石从间歇泉中收回来...

english: You hammer the three Lunar bars and make a V Sigil, exactly how Brundt described.
translation: 你锤打三根月锭，制作出一个V形符印，正如布伦特所描述的那样。

english: It will still need to be enchanted before it can be used for V's Shield.
translation: 它还需要附魔才能用于V的盾。

english: You open the coffin.
translation: 你打开棺材。

english: The skeleton in the corner suddenly comes to life!
translation: 角落里的骷髅突然活了过来！

english: Surprisingly, this altar is empty. Probably because you took the skull off it earlier.
translation: 令人惊讶的是，这个祭坛是空的。可能是因为你之前把头骨拿走了。

english: Well hello there lassie.
translation: 你好啊，姑娘。

english: Have you now lassie? I was wondering when they'd send someone.
translation: 现在你来了，姑娘？我还在想他们什么时候会派人来。

english: You're right with that one lassie. Someone or something has made a small hole in the Doors.
translation: 你说得对，姑娘。有人或什么东西在门上弄了个小洞。

english: Repair the damage of course lassie. Now I should be able to fix the issue no problem. The only thing I'm missing is the right tools. That's where you come in.
translation: 当然是修复损坏，姑娘。现在我应该能解决这个问题，没问题。我唯一缺的就是合适的工具。这就是你来的原因。

english: Hello there lassie.
translation: 你好，姑娘。

english: Have you got Dinh's Hammer yet lassie?
translation: 你找到丁的锤了吗，姑娘？

english: I've found one, but they're kind of hard to find. Where were they headed again?
translation: 我找到了一个，但不太好找。它们又去哪了？

english: I've found two, but they're kind of hard to find. Where were they headed again?
translation: 我找到了两个，但不太好找。它们又去哪了？

english: I've found three, but they're kind of hard to find. Where were they headed again?
translation: 我找到了三个，但不太好找。它们又去哪了？

english: Maybe you should ask the golem first!
translation: 也许你应该先问问魔像！

english: You find Varmen's expedition notes.
translation: 你找到了瓦尔门的远征笔记。

english: The curator doesn't seem to have anything of value.
translation: 馆长似乎没有什么有价值的东西。

english: You steal a tiny key.
translation: 你偷了一把小钥匙。

english: The cabinet is locked.
translation: 柜子已锁定。

english: You have already taken the statuette.
translation: 你已经拿走了小雕像。

english: You open the cabinet and retrieve the statuette.
translation: 你打开柜子，取出了小雕像。

english: You insert the key and the golem's skull hinges open.
translation: 你插入钥匙，魔像的头骨铰链打开了。

english: The golems skull shuts automatically.
translation: 魔像的头骨自动合上了。

english: There is already a statuette in the alcove.
translation: 壁龛里已经有一个小雕像了。

english: You insert the statuette into the alcove.
translation: 你将小雕像插入壁龛。

english: The door grinds open.
translation: 门缓缓打开。

english: The statuette is now locked in place.
translation: 小雕像现在已锁定到位。

english: You step into the portal.
translation: 你踏入传送门。

english: This room is dominated by a colossal horned skeleton!
translation: 这个房间被一个巨大的有角骷髅所占据！

english: You'll need a chisel as well as a hammer to get the gems.
translation: 你需要凿子和锤子才能取出宝石。

english: You already have a phoenix tail-feather.
translation: 你已经有一根凤凰尾羽了。

english: You attempt to grab the phoenix's tail-feather.
translation: 你试图抓住凤凰的尾羽。

english: You grab a tail-feather.
translation: 你抓住了一根尾羽。

english: You fail to grab the feather.
translation: 你没能抓住羽毛。

english: You will need some kind of ink to write with.
translation: 你需要某种墨水来写字。

english: You don't know what to write.
translation: 你不知道该写什么。

english: You hear a satisfying click as the door unlocks.
translation: 你听到门锁打开时令人满意的咔嗒声。

english: You don't have enough room in your inventory to take it.
translation: 你的背包空间不足，无法拿走它。

english: On the wall hangs a rather nondescript picture. On closer inspection you notice that it's covering something: a safe.
translation: 墙上挂着一幅相当普通的图画。仔细一看，你发现它遮住了什么东西：一个保险箱。

english: My third in night, but not in the day.

english: My last is in fields, but not in the hay.
translation: 我的最后一个在田野里，但不在干草中。

translation: 我的第一个在焦油里，但不在沼泽中。

english: My second in fire, but not in a camp.
translation: 我的第二个在火里，但不在营地中。

english: My third is in eagle, but never in air.
translation: 我的第三个在鹰里，但绝不在空中。

english: My last is in hate, but also in care.
translation: 我的最后一个在仇恨里，也在关怀中。

english: My whole wears rings the older I get.

translation: 我的第一处在鱼中，却不在海里。

english: My second in birds, but not in the sea.
translation: 我的第二处在鸟类中，却不在海里。

english: My third is in mountains, but not underground. My last is everything, but not at all.
translation: 我的第三处在山中，却不在地下。我的最后是一切，却什么也不是。

english: My whole cannot die as long as it has food.
translation: 只要有食物，我的整体就不会消亡。

english: My first is in wizard, but not in a mage.
translation: 我的第一处在魔法师中，却不在法师里。

english: My second in jail, but not in a cage.
translation: 我的第二处在监狱中，却不在笼子里。

english: My third is in anger, but not in a rage.
translation: 我的第三处在愤怒中，却不在狂怒里。

english: My last in a drawing, but not on a page.
translation: 我的最后在画中，却不在纸上。

english: My whole helps to make bread, let birds fly and boats sail.
translation: 我的整体能帮助做面包，让鸟飞，让船航行。

english: You have solved the riddle!
translation: 你解开了谜题！

english: You search the cupboard...

english: You find a magnet hidden inside.
translation: 你发现里面藏着一块磁铁。

english: You find a toy ship hidden inside.
translation: 你发现里面藏着一艘玩具船。

english: You find some thread hidden inside.

english: You fill the bucket from the tap.
translation: 你用水龙头把桶装满。

english: You fill the jug from the tap.
translation: 你用水龙头把壶装满。

english: You empty the jug into the bucket.
translation: 你把壶倒进桶里。

translation: 你把桶倒进壶里。

english: You fill the bucket to the brim.
translation: 你把桶装到满溢。

translation: 你把壶倒进排水沟。

english: You empty the bucket down the drain.
translation: 你把桶倒进排水沟。

translation: 太重了，无法平衡。

translation: 完美的配重，精确平衡。

english: You take a strange looking vase out of the chest.
translation: 你从宝箱里拿出一个奇怪的花瓶。

english: You shake the strangely shaped Vase. From the sound of it there is something metallic inside, but the neck of the vase is too narrow for it to come out.
translation: 你摇晃这个形状奇怪的花瓶。听声音里面有个金属物体，但花瓶的瓶颈太窄，它出不来。

english: You fill the strange looking vase with water.
translation: 你往奇怪的花瓶里装满水。

english: You shake the strangely shaped Vase. The water inside it sloshes around a little. Some spills out of the neck of the vase.
translation: 你摇晃这个形状奇怪的花瓶。里面的水晃动了一下，有些从瓶颈溢了出来。

english: You empty the strange looking vase of water.
translation: 你把那个奇怪的花瓶里的水倒掉了。

english: The water expands as it freezes, and shatters the vase.
translation: 水结冰时膨胀，把花瓶撑碎了。

english: You are left with a key encased in ice.
translation: 你得到了一把被冰封住的钥匙。

english: The heat of the range melts the ice around the key.
translation: 炉灶的热量融化了钥匙周围的冰。

english: You use the magnet on the chest. The scale wobbles a bit.
translation: 你用磁铁对着宝箱。秤稍微晃了一下。

english: You might be able to break the chest open using this pick...
translation: 也许用这把镐子能把宝箱砸开……

english: ...if you stood here tapping at it for twenty years or so.
translation: ……如果你站在这里敲上二十年的话。

english: This pick wouldn't be strong enough to break the vase open.
translation: 这把镐子不够结实，砸不开花瓶。

english: It wouldn't fit in there!
translation: 它放不进去！

english: You use the magnet on the vase. The metallic object inside moves.
translation: 你用磁铁对着花瓶。里面的金属物体动了。

english: The neck of the vase is too thin for the object to come out of the vase.
translation: 花瓶的瓶颈太细，物体出不来。

english: Your empty jug gets very cold on the icy table.
translation: 你的空壶放在冰冷的桌子上，变得非常冷。

english: Your empty bucket gets very cold on the icy table.
translation: 你的空桶放在冰冷的桌子上，变得非常冷。

english: The icy table immediately freezes the water in your jug.
translation: 冰冷的桌子立刻把你壶里的水冻住了。

english: The icy table immediately freezes the water in your bucket.
translation: 冰冷的桌子立刻把你桶里的水冻住了。

translation: 你把结冰的水壶放在炉灶上。冰变成了蒸汽。

english: You place the frozen bucket on the range. The ice turns to steam.
translation: 你把冰桶放在炉灶上。冰变成了蒸汽。

english: You use the magnet on the table. It gets slightly colder.
translation: 你用磁铁对着桌子。它变得更冷了一点。

translation: 你用磁铁对着水龙头。它变得有点湿。

english: Your empty vase gets very cold on the icy table.
translation: 你的空花瓶放在冰冷的桌子上，变得非常冷。

english: The vase is already empty.
translation: 花瓶已经是空的了。

english: You screw the lid on tightly.
translation: 你把盖子拧紧了。

english: The icy table immediately freezes the water in your vase.
translation: 冰冷的桌子立刻把你花瓶里的水冻住了。

english: The ice prevents you screwing on the lid.
translation: 冰让你无法拧上盖子。

english: You place the frozen vase on the range. The ice turns to steam.
translation: 你把结冰的水瓶放在炉灶上。冰变成了蒸汽。

english: You study the mural... it appears to be missing something...
translation: 你仔细研究壁画……似乎少了什么东西……

english: You put the wooden disk into the empty hole in the mural.
translation: 你把木盘放进壁画上的空洞里。

english: It is slightly too small, and falls back out.
translation: 它稍微小了一点，又掉了出来。

english: You put the red disk into the empty hole on the mural.
translation: 你把红色圆盘放进壁画上的空洞里。

english: It is a perfect fit!
translation: 完美契合！

english: The center of the mural falls out!
translation: 壁画的中心掉了出来！

english: You unlock the door with your key.
translation: 你用钥匙打开了门。

english: You have successfully completed the Seer's Trial.
translation: 你成功完成了先知试炼。

english: You try to open the trapdoor but it won't budge!
translation: 你试着打开活板门，但它纹丝不动！

translation: 看起来活板门只能从另一边打开。

english: With respect, my Queen, were it not for [player name] here, I would have died at the hands of the Emissaries. I believe he has earned our trust.
translation: 恕我直言，女王陛下，要不是[player name]在这里，我早就死在特使们手里了。我相信他已经赢得了我们的信任。

english: The soil seems too solid for you to scoop any up with that.
translation: 土壤太硬了，用那个铲不起来。

translation: 碎片颤抖着从你手中升起，然后又落回你的掌心，现在指向北方。

english: The fragment shakes and rises out of your hand, it them falls back into your palm, now pointing south.
translation: 碎片颤抖着从你手中升起，然后又落回你的掌心，现在指向南方。

english: You two, guide this one to Mictl. Be sure not to underestimate him.
translation: 你们两个，带这位去米克特尔。千万别小看他。

translation: 你们两个，带这位去米克特尔。千万别小看她。

translation: 你们两个，带这位去米克特尔。千万别小看他们。

english: You failed to defend the crypt from the Emissaries.
translation: 你未能守住墓穴，抵御使者们的进攻。

english: I'll deal with these nagua, iknami. You go on ahead.
translation: 我来对付这些纳瓜，伊克纳米。你先走。

translation: 这里纳瓜很多。我来对付它们，伊克纳米。你先走。别担心，我会赶上的。

english: Look at this place, iknami! This is incredible!.
translation: 看看这地方，伊克纳米！太不可思议了！

english: There hasn't been any sign of Metzli or Furia, but they must have come this way. Let's have a look around and see if we can find a way forward.
translation: 还没有梅茨利或富里亚的踪迹，但他们一定是从这条路走的。我们四处看看，找找有没有前进的路。

translation: 当然，伊克纳米！告诉我哪一个就行。

translation: 你为祭坛注入能量，听到中央雕像传来一阵磨擦声。

translation: 你为祭坛注入能量，中央雕像亮起了能量光芒。

translation: 你为祭坛注入能量，但似乎没有效果。

translation: 雕像亮起能量光芒，接受了你的引火物祭品。

translation: 你现在不能进去，那可能会暴露僧侣们的计划。

english: You pull the statue, revealing the hole underneath...
translation: 你拉动雕像，露出了下面的洞……

english: You climb down into a dank, cramped cavern.
translation: 你爬进一个潮湿狭窄的洞穴。

translation: 没有潜水头盔和潜水装置，你不能潜水！

translation: 你需要一把锤子、10颗钉子和4块普通木板来修理破损的楼梯。

english: You cannot climb these until you have repaired them.
translation: 你得先修好这些才能爬上去。

english: You repair the steps.
translation: 你修好了台阶。

english: If you remove that, how will you get back to the other side of the flooded tunnel?
translation: 如果你把那拆了，你怎么回到被水淹没的隧道另一边？

english: You do not think there will be anything interesting to see through that.
translation: 你觉得透过那个不会看到什么有趣的东西。

english: You have found the book of prayers!
translation: 你找到了祈祷之书！

english: You find a gap in the shelves where the book of prayers would go.
translation: 你在架子上发现了一个放祈祷之书的缝隙。

english: As it is in your backpack you know that it is unlikely to be hidden on the shelf again.
translation: 既然它在你背包里，你知道它不太可能再被藏在架子上了。

english: You will need to read the book first.
translation: 你需要先读这本书。

english: The book details a prayer to Saradomin for aid against poisons. The caster must wear a blessed symbol of Saradomin or the prayer will fail.
translation: 书中记载了一段向萨拉多明祈求抵御毒药的祈祷。施法者必须佩戴萨拉多明圣徽，否则祈祷将失败。

english: You need to be wearing a blessed symbol of Saradomin for the prayer to work.
translation: 你需要佩戴萨拉多明圣徽，祈祷才能生效。

english: You recite the prayer even though you are unpoisoned.
translation: 你念诵祈祷，尽管你并没有中毒。

english: You recite the prayer even though you have no prayer points.
translation: 你念诵祈祷，尽管你没有祈祷点数。

english: You recite the prayer...
translation: 你念诵祈祷……

english: ...and the power of Saradomin cures you of poison.
translation: ……萨拉多明的力量治愈了你的毒。

english: You recite the prayer and the monks chant along with you.
translation: 你念诵祈祷，僧侣们跟着你一起吟唱。

english: The smell of gas vanishes; the granary has been warded against the knockout effect.
translation: 气体的气味消失了；粮仓已被施加防护，不再有昏迷效果。

english: You can now craft wooden cats in the workshop of a player-owned house! Note: this need not be your own house.
translation: 你现在可以在玩家拥有的房屋工作室里制作木猫了！注意：不一定是自己的房子。

english: You need a hammer, 20 nails and all 6 parts of the crate that Rufus gave you before you can do that.
translation: 你需要一把锤子、20颗钉子和鲁弗斯给你的全部6个箱子部件才能做那个。

translation: 你的钉子不够了。

translation: 你制作了箱子。

translation: 你往箱子里放了几只假猫，但还不够盖住假底。

translation: 你觉得还需要<Num0>只才能盖住。

english: You fill the crate with fake cats.
translation: 你用假猫装满了箱子。

english: You should take your diving helmet off before you try to blow the whistle.
translation: 吹哨子前你应该先摘下潜水头盔。

english: You will have a hard time convincing Rufus that these cats are real if you are not wearing the Ring of Charos.
translation: 如果你没戴查罗斯之戒，很难让鲁弗斯相信这些猫是真的。

english: You paste the shipping order to the crate and it vanishes!
translation: 你把运输订单贴到箱子上，它消失了！

english: You already have some fuse. You do not need any more.
translation: 你已经有一些引信了，不需要更多。

english: You do not have enough free inventory space to take any fuse.
translation: 你的背包空间不够，拿不了引信。

translation: 你已经有一桶火药了，不需要再来一桶。

translation: 你的背包空间不够，拿不了那个。

translation: 为了安全起见，传送时你必须把引信留下。

english: For the sake of safety, you have to leave the gunpowder behind when you teleport.
translation: 为了安全起见，传送时你必须把火药留下。

translation: 我应该先把酒桶放到想引爆的地方，再接引信。

translation: 不摧毁建筑正面的话，你没法再打开这些门了。

translation: 不过，你可以很轻松地从洞里穿过去。

translation: 之前的画面被替换成了一张小猫的图画和舒缓的音乐。现在我们回到冒险现场。

english: You feel the power of Saradomin restore your body.
translation: 你感受到萨拉多明的力量恢复了你的身体。

translation: 在架子上的垃圾堆后面，你发现了一顶小农夫帽，上面写着吉利的名字。
