translation: 开始“红色珊瑚礁”任务？

english: As you approach the island, you spot some pirate boats circling.
translation: 当你靠近岛屿时，你发现一些海盗船在周围盘旋。

english: You manage to sail away from the pirates, ending up somewhere north of Last Light.
translation: 你设法驶离海盗，最终来到了最后之光以北的某处。

english: You manage to sail away from the pirates, ending up somewhere east of Last Light.
translation: 你设法驶离海盗，最终来到了最后之光以东的某处。

english: You manage to sail away from the pirates, ending up somewhere south of Last Light.
translation: 你设法驶离海盗，最终来到了最后之光以南的某处。

english: You manage to sail away from the pirates, ending up somewhere west of Last Light.
translation: 你设法驶离海盗，最终来到了最后之光以西的某处。

english: With the pirate boats sunk, you can now deal with the pirates on Last Light.
translation: 海盗船沉了，你现在可以对付最后之光上的海盗了。

english: You open the cage and free the parrot. It flies away, squawking happily as it does.
translation: 你打开笼子放出了鹦鹉。它飞走了，欢快地叫着。

english: Spencer gives you some diving equipment.
translation: 斯宾塞给了你一些潜水装备。

english: Spencer reaches into the coral dredger and takes out some red coral.
translation: 斯宾塞把手伸进珊瑚疏浚机，取出了一些红珊瑚。

english: Spencer fixes the coral dredger before moving on to the next one.
translation: 斯宾塞修好了珊瑚疏浚机，然后继续去修下一台。

english: The dredger is mostly in good order, but some pieces have become detached. You put them back into place again.
translation: 疏浚机大体上完好，但有些零件脱落了。你把它们重新装回原位。

english: Spencer fixes the coral dredger and the two of you return to the surface.
translation: 斯宾塞修好了珊瑚疏浚机，你们俩回到了水面。

english: You have no reason to reboard the Zenith. You should return to the Great Conch instead.
translation: 你没有理由再登上泽尼斯号。你应该返回大螺号。

english: You don't seem to have space for it, come back when you do.
translation: 你似乎没有空间放它，有空了再来吧。

english: I always thought that the Temple Knights were bound to be clean shaven. I never quite knew why, or if it was a truly written rule for that matter, but I'd been under that impression all the same...
translation: 我一直以为圣殿骑士必须刮得干干净净。我从不知道原因，也不确定这是否是明文规定，但我一直有这个印象……

english: Taverley was never the warmest town, but the difference here is much bigger than I'd expected. As the nights get longer, the days are sure enough getting colder, and even those little bits of warmth go a long way. The breeze from across the Salve is starting to get to me, and that bushy rug on Derygull's face sure does seem comforting right about now!
translation: 塔韦利村从来不是最温暖的城镇，但这里的差别比我预想的要大得多。随着夜晚变长，白天确实越来越冷，哪怕一点点温暖都弥足珍贵。萨尔维对岸吹来的微风开始让我受不了了，德瑞古尔脸上那浓密的胡子现在看起来可真让人向往！

english: Ah well, lesson learnt for the next mission, I suppose.
translation: 唉，我想下次任务就吸取教训了。

english: Though little is known of the fourth age, especially in the land now known as Morytania, some small details of that dark time do yet remain. This work is as complete an account as can be mustered by this author. Its purpose is to straighten the times and tales of those would-be heroes buried under Paterdomus.
translation: 虽然对第四纪元知之甚少，尤其是在现在被称为莫利塔尼亚的土地上，但那段黑暗时期的些许细节仍然留存。这部作品是作者所能汇集的最完整的记述。其目的是厘清那些埋葬在帕特多姆斯之下的准英雄们的时代与传说。

english: The datum here are vague at best and no truer gauge could be hardly best sought. The least hope of this lowly author herein lies; to recount what small morsels of truth remain in the minds of those that still live and entreat those very same to paper lest they forever be forgotten.
translation: 这里的数据充其量是模糊的，很难找到更准确的衡量标准。这位卑微作者的最大希望在于：重述那些仍活在人们心中的零星真相，并恳请他们将其付诸笔墨，以免永远被遗忘。

english: With my rudimentary abilities, I prevailed to update the place names of those dark times and instead use those which are in common use so as to give meaning where previously there was confusion.
translation: 以我粗浅的能力，我设法更新了那些黑暗时代的地名，改用通用名称，以便在原本混乱之处赋予意义。

english: Eight centuries and a score into the history of our land there came a darkness which fell about the land once called Hallowvale. The queen of that sad time, an iycene of once formidable power, became to be deposed by 'his-dark-self' and his hordes. Against all her considerable will she was forced to kneel and attend 'his-dark-self' in order that she might save her loving husband, Ascertes.
translation: 在我们这片土地的历史进入第八个世纪又二十载时，一片黑暗降临到了曾被称为霍洛韦尔的地方。那个悲惨时代的女王，一位曾经拥有强大力量的艾辛尼，被“黑暗之身”及其大军废黜。她被迫违背自己强大的意志，屈膝侍奉“黑暗之身”，以拯救她深爱的丈夫阿瑟特斯。

english: The darkness which 'his-dark- self' brought with him at that time writhed through Hallowvale and wrought its way ever onwards into Misthalin. Though many men did slow its passage to what is now called Varrock, none did manage to halt its progress proper and many brave warriors so employed did die a most painful and lingering death.
translation: “黑暗之身”当时带来的黑暗在霍洛韦尔中翻腾，并不断蔓延至米斯塔林。虽然许多人延缓了它向现在被称为维洛克城推进的步伐，但没有人能真正阻止它的进程，许多勇敢的战士因此痛苦而缓慢地死去。

english: Fearing the darkness would sweep Saradomin's glory from the land, some odd collection of priestly advocates and pious followers of brave virtue stood forwards to steel the hearts of the village fighters and town militias, the last defence against the evil now fresh from Hallowvale, and from that time till now called Morytania.
translation: 由于担心黑暗会从这片土地上扫除萨拉多明的荣光，一群由牧师和虔诚的勇士组成的杂牌军站了出来，鼓舞了村庄战士和城镇民兵的士气，他们是抵御来自霍洛韦尔（即现在的莫利塔尼亚）邪恶的最后防线。

english: This collection of priestly valour did cast Saradomin's blessings upon the untrained and fearful fighters of Varrock and those of her outside villagers. This did raise bravery, courage and righteousness in the hearts of these brave young Misthalinian knights.
translation: 这群牧师勇士将萨拉多明的祝福赐予了维洛克城及其周边村庄未经训练、心怀恐惧的战士。这在这些勇敢的年轻米斯塔林骑士心中激起了勇气、胆量和正义感。

english: At long last it came the time that the rabble of the Misthalin defence started to bite and the tide of evil from Morytania became smashed and torn on their pikes and staves. All caught courage from the Seven Priestly Warriors whose names shall be disgorged forthwith.
translation: 终于，米斯塔林防御的乌合之众开始反击，来自莫利塔尼亚的邪恶浪潮在他们的长矛和法杖上被击碎撕裂。所有人都从七位牧师勇士那里获得了勇气，他们的名字即将被一一列出。

english: 1: Iriandul Caistlyn - A true leader of the holy seven, though rarely ever a footfall in front of Ivandis, who was ever eager to smash the evil and force the tide back into Morytania.
translation: 一：伊里安杜尔·凯斯特林 - 神圣七人组的真正领袖，虽然很少走在伊万迪斯前面一步，后者总是渴望粉碎邪恶并将浪潮逼回莫利塔尼亚。

english: 2: Sarl Dunegun of Edgeville - A pious yet brutal man. When wielding his mace he led many fighters on skirmishes to keep the evil from spreading and outflanking the group.
translation: 二：边陲镇的萨尔·邓根 - 一个虔诚而残暴的人。挥舞钉锤时，他带领许多战士进行小规模战斗，阻止邪恶蔓延和包抄队伍。

english: 3: Friar Twiblick of Taverley - A devout man of worship whose brave talks and uncommon speeches raised the spirits and abilities of men above that of mortals so they fought as though Guthix himself were at their side, redressing the balance that 'his-dark-self' had spoilt.
translation: 三：塔韦利村的特威布利克修士 - 一个虔诚的礼拜者，他勇敢的演讲和不寻常的言辞将人们的士气和能力提升到超越凡人的境界，使他们战斗得仿佛古斯本人就在身边，扭转了“黑暗之身”破坏的平衡。

english: 4: Derygull Templeton of Falador - A great oak of a man, so well imbued with Saradomin's will and martial ability that he commanded people's respect and admiration and they eagerly followed him into battle. His booming voice rallied men in times of fierce fighting, this allowing them to regroup and focus their brutal, savage violence and force capitulation from the writhing, cowardly, evil hordes.
translation: 四：法拉多城的德瑞古尔·坦普尔顿 - 一个橡树般魁梧的男人，深受萨拉多明意志和武艺的熏陶，赢得了人们的尊敬和钦佩，他们热切地跟随他上战场。他洪亮的声音在激战中鼓舞士气，使他们能够重新集结，集中他们野蛮残暴的暴力，迫使那些蠕动、懦弱的邪恶大军投降。

english: 5: Ivandis Seergaze of Lumbridge - A deft and well skilled man of unusual appearance, he held a most bizarre control over some powerful minions of Drakan's horde. A rod or staff helped imbue him with such power. Then with the aide of a Guthix serum he would turn the vile entity, often times destroying the creature instantly, reverting it to an original incarnation or worst of all enraging it greatly, much to the chagrin of his holy brothers.
translation: 五：仑桥镇的伊万迪斯·西尔盖兹 - 一个技艺娴熟、外貌奇特的人，他对德拉坎大军的一些强大爪牙拥有最奇特的控制力。一根棍棒或法杖赋予了他这种力量。然后借助古斯血清，他会转化那些邪恶实体，常常瞬间摧毁生物，将其还原为原始形态，或者最糟糕的是极大地激怒它，这让他的神圣兄弟们大为恼火。

english: 6: Erysail the Pious of Rimmington - A woman of such noble and just nature that she commanded the will of the Misthalinian fighters high and right, ever at the front of battle displaying courage and aiding those in need.
translation: 六：里明顿村的虔诚者埃里赛尔 - 一位如此高贵正义的女性，她引领着米斯塔林战士的意志高昂而正确，始终战斗在最前线，展现勇气并帮助需要帮助的人。

english: 7: Essiandar Gar of Draynor - A fearless woman even at such a worthy age. It was said that her indignation at the evil scourge was enough to make the most cowardly of men in her ranks act like lions in the fiercest fighting.
translation: 七：德拉诺的埃西安达尔·加尔 - 一位即使在如此值得尊敬的年纪也无所畏惧的女性。据说她对邪恶祸害的愤怒足以让她队伍中最懦弱的人在激战中表现得像狮子一样。

english: And with the Seven Priestly Warriors all together committed to this act, they brought the furious intent of Saradomin's will and forced the evil tide from Morytania back into those very same dark lands. The fighting became fiercest at Silvarea and they stood side by side to prevent the evil from entering Misthalin again.
translation: 七位牧师勇士齐心协力，共同执行这一壮举，他们带来了萨拉多明意志的愤怒，将莫利塔尼亚的邪恶浪潮逼回了那片黑暗之地。战斗在希尔瓦雷亚最为激烈，他们并肩而立，阻止邪恶再次进入米斯塔林。

english: The very spot where Paterdomus now stands is near the final battle ground for the saving of Misthalin. The temple stands even now as a contentious reminder to those evil minions who would seek to wreak havoc in the land of Saradomin. As the priestly brothers and sisters fought on, some of them cast blessings into the Salve and sealed in it the vengeful power of Saradomin who would act as Misthalin's guardian against 'his-dark- self'.
translation: 帕特多莫斯如今矗立之处，正是拯救米斯塔林最终战场附近。这座神庙至今仍是对那些企图在萨拉多明之地肆虐的邪恶爪牙的警示。当祭司兄弟姐妹们奋战时，其中一些人向萨尔维河施以祝福，将萨拉多明的复仇之力封印其中，作为米斯塔林的守护者对抗'他的黑暗面'。

english: Upon this foundation of holy power, Paterdomus was built. Within its holy eminence the saintly remains of the Seven Priestly Warriors, it is believed, now rest. However, there is sometimes discord about one such burial.
translation: 在这神圣力量的基础上，帕特多莫斯得以建立。在其神圣庄严之中，据信七位祭司勇士的圣洁遗骸如今安息。然而，关于其中一位的安葬有时存在争议。

english: 'The resting place of Ivandis Seergaze is easily missed for its simpleness and trivial appearance. In the midst of Mort Myre lies a long cavern running from north west to south east, with three caverns along the south western wall and two caverns on the north eastern. Ivandis was put to rest in the smaller of the two caverns along the north eastern wall with his worldly possessions. Appropriate preparations were made to ensure the safety of his mortal remains and the cavern that formed his tomb was sealed up. I, Keorgius Feryis, along with his many other brothers in arms did score marks into the sides of the wall next to the cavern in order to mark it out for later recovery and to deter possible intruders by making the marks look like those of some fearsome beast.'
translation: '伊万迪斯·西尔盖兹的安息之地因其简朴和平凡的外表而容易被忽视。在莫特迈尔之中有一条从西北延伸至东南的长洞穴，西南墙边有三个洞穴，东北墙边有两个。伊万迪斯被安葬在东北墙边两个洞穴中较小的那个，随葬他的世俗财物。为确保他凡人之躯的安全，做了适当的准备，形成他坟墓的洞穴被封闭了。我，凯奥吉乌斯·费里斯，与他许多战友一起，在洞穴旁的墙壁上刻下标记，以便日后找回，并通过让标记看起来像某种可怕野兽的痕迹来阻止可能的入侵者。'

english: Though I have made but preliminary and trepidatious journeys into Morytania thus far, the proposed location of Ivandis' primitive tomb has evaded me. It is with the author's most delicate and humble of suggestions that this tomb be cast from the reader's mind as it is, in all likelihood, a trap made by evil minions to beguile the unwary into Morytania.
translation: 尽管我迄今对莫利塔尼亚的探索只是初步且充满畏惧的，但伊万迪斯原始坟墓的拟议位置始终未能找到。作者最谨慎谦卑地建议，读者应将这座坟墓从脑海中抹去，因为它极有可能是邪恶爪牙设下的陷阱，引诱不慎者进入莫利塔尼亚。

english: It was at the height of the God Wars when she came. A demon, invading our home. For so long we'd managed to stay away from the fighting, safe from the horrors that filled the rest of the world. Nothing lasts forever though, and it seemed that her arrival marked the beginning of the end. Or so we thought...
translation: 她来的时候正值神战最激烈之时。一个恶魔，入侵了我们的家园。长久以来我们设法远离战火，免受世间其他恐怖之害。但没有什么能永恒，她的到来似乎标志着终结的开始。至少我们是这么想的……

english: We assumed the demon would be the first of many, but to our surprise, the scouts reported that she seemed to be working alone. Not only that, but she did not seem to be here for us as we first feared.
translation: 我们以为这个恶魔会是众多入侵者的第一个，但出乎意料的是，斥候报告说她似乎是独自行动。不仅如此，她似乎并非如我们最初所恐惧的那样冲着我们而来。

english: Instead of moving on the city, she spent a great deal of time roaming the forests, like she was searching for something. The scouts were unable to work out what she was doing, so we decided to send some Amlodd mystics to take a closer look.
translation: 她没有进攻城市，而是花了大量时间在森林中游荡，像是在寻找什么。斥候们无法弄清她在做什么，于是我们决定派遣一些阿姆洛德神秘学者去近距离观察。

english: The mystics weaved their spells and discovered something fascinating. The demon, she seemed to be under some sort of spell, a curse. From what they could tell, the curse seemed to be slowly turning her entire body to stone.
translation: 神秘学者们编织法术，发现了令人着迷的事情。那个恶魔似乎受到某种法术的影响，一种诅咒。据他们判断，诅咒似乎在慢慢将她的整个身体变成石头。

english: Unsurprisingly, this caught the attention of the artisans of the Trahaearn clan. They wanted to bring her in, so they could study her properly. A risky move, but one they deemed worth the danger.
translation: 不出所料，这引起了特拉赫恩族工匠们的注意。他们想把她带进来，以便好好研究。这是一个冒险的举动，但他们认为值得冒这个险。

english: With the help of the Ithell clan, the Trahaearn artisans built a large prison in the volcanic caverns beneath the city. With Amlodd magic sealing the way in, the prison was more than suitable for trapping the demon. All that was left to do, was capture her.
translation: 在伊塞尔族的帮助下，特拉赫恩族工匠在城市下方的火山洞穴中建造了一座大型监狱。阿姆洛德魔法封住了入口，这座监狱完全适合困住恶魔。剩下的就是抓住她了。

english: While our kind had chosen to stay out of the wars of the gods, we knew there was always a chance the wars would come to us. We were no strangers to combat, with many of us honing our skills daily in the Gauntlet. Still, this was a tough enemy for us to overcome.
translation: 虽然我们一族选择置身于诸神之战外，但我们知道战争随时可能降临到我们头上。我们对战斗并不陌生，许多人每天都在试炼之路中磨练技艺。尽管如此，这对我们来说仍是一个难以战胜的敌人。

english: The demon did not take kindly to our attempts to capture her and fought back with all her might. Many fell to her, but in the end we had her trapped beneath the city, ready for the Trahaearn clan to begin their research.
translation: 恶魔对我们抓捕她的企图并不友善，全力反击。许多人倒在她手下，但最终我们还是将她困在了城市下方，准备让特拉赫恩族开始他们的研究。

english: To no surprise, the demon was rather unwilling to divulge her secrets. Lucky for us though, a mixture of Amlodd magic and Meilyr potions quickly loosened her tongue. The demon revealed her name to be Zalcano, a former general in the army of Zamorak, the god of chaos.
translation: 毫不意外，恶魔相当不愿透露她的秘密。但幸运的是，阿姆洛德魔法和梅利尔药水的混合很快让她开口了。恶魔透露她的名字叫扎尔卡诺，曾是混沌之神扎莫拉克军队的前将军。

english: After a failed mission to the island of Karamja, Zalcano was held responsible for the treachery of her brother, and was cursed by Zamorak. He gave her a simple task, bring back her brother to answer for his crimes, and the curse would be lifted. Unfortunately for her, Zalcano had failed.
translation: 在卡拉姆詹岛的一次失败任务后，扎尔卡诺被认定应对她兄弟的背叛负责，并被扎莫拉克诅咒。他给了她一个简单的任务：把她的兄弟带回来接受惩罚，诅咒就会解除。不幸的是，扎尔卡诺失败了。

english: Zalcano believed her brother had travelled to the west, in the hope of escaping from Zamorak's fury. While she'd believed that meant the forests of Tirannwn, she was mistaken. Any demon roaming our lands would have been quickly found by us, and she was the first to ever stray this far. Wherever her brother is, he's definitely not here.
translation: 扎尔卡诺相信她的兄弟逃往了西方，希望躲避扎莫拉克的怒火。虽然她以为那意味着提兰恩的森林，但她错了。任何在我们的土地上游荡的恶魔都会被我们迅速发现，而她是第一个走得这么远的。无论她兄弟在哪里，他肯定不在这里。

english: It seemed that with her capture, the curse had accelerated, almost like Zamorak knew she had already failed. With her body fast turning to stone, her mind was almost completely lost. It was clear that there was no more to learn from her about the lands east of here, but the Trahaearn clan believed she may still have some use. With how hard it was to get her into her prison, no one was complaining to find that we wanted to keep her in there.
translation: 似乎随着她的被捕，诅咒加速了，就像扎莫拉克知道她已经失败了一样。随着她的身体迅速石化，她的心智几乎完全丧失。很明显，从她身上再也学不到关于东方土地的信息了，但特拉赫恩族相信她可能还有一些用处。鉴于把她弄进监狱有多困难，没有人抱怨我们想把她留在那里。

english: Even though we didn't plan to move her, Zalcano still needed to be kept in check, lest her power grow too quickly.
translation: 尽管我们不打算移动她，扎尔卡诺仍需被控制住，以免她的力量增长过快。

english: Our weapons of crystal did little damage to her stone body, so we had to seek out other methods. Lucky for us, we discovered that when heated and empowered, the tephra found within the caverns was able to crack her body. Combined with a good pickaxe, this tephra could be used to keep her under control.
translation: 我们的水晶武器对她的石质身体伤害甚微，所以我们不得不寻找其他方法。幸运的是，我们发现洞穴中的火山灰在加热并充能后，能够裂开她的身体。配合一把好镐子，这些火山灰可以用来控制她。

english: Many years after her capture, I decided to pay the demon a visit myself. Despite being a part of the research group, I'd mostly kept my distance in the past, preferring to keep myself safe from her fury. A lot had changed since then though, and I was curious to see how her curse had progressed.
translation: 在她被捕多年后，我决定亲自去拜访那个恶魔。尽管是研究小组的一员，我过去大多保持距离，宁愿让自己远离她的怒火。但自那以后很多事情都变了，我很好奇她的诅咒进展如何。

english: Before I was allowed to approach her, she had to be weakened in the usual way. Once she was in no place to fight back, I was permitted to enter the prison.
translation: 在我被允许接近她之前，必须用常规方式削弱她。一旦她无法反击，我才被允许进入监狱。

english: Even in her weakened state, she was a fearsome sight to behold. I walked towards her, not expecting to learn anything of note, merely curious to see the demon that we'd spent so much time researching. However, as she saw me, something very unusual happened.
translation: 即使在她虚弱的状态下，她也是一个令人恐惧的景象。我走向她，并不期望了解到什么重要信息，只是好奇地想看看我们花了那么多时间研究的恶魔。然而，当她看到我时，一件非常不寻常的事情发生了。

english: It was said that speech was one of the first things Zalcano lost as the curse took over, so it was of great surprise when the demon seemed to speak to me. The others shrugged it off, claiming she had no mind left and that it was just random noise. They were wrong though, I knew what I heard. It was a name, one that I'd never heard before, but one that I knew had to be important. And what was that name?
translation: 据说随着诅咒的蔓延，言语是扎尔卡诺最早失去的东西之一，所以当这个恶魔似乎对我说话时，我感到非常惊讶。其他人不以为意，声称她已经没有心智了，那只是随机的噪音。但他们错了，我知道我听到了什么。那是一个名字，一个我从未听过的名字，但我知道它一定很重要。那么那个名字是什么呢？

english: This excerpt was taken from from the book Camorra: The Truth Behind the Myth.
translation: 这段摘录取自《卡莫拉：神话背后的真相》一书。

english: ...the slaying of the dragon Garak begs closer examination. It is curious how, despite all her other impressive accomplishments, it is the slaying of this dragon that is considered to be Camorra's defining heroic feat. It is for this single act that she is counted among Arrav or Robert the Strong, even though her cooperation with the latter should, by all accounts, be far more impressive.
translation: ……对巨龙加拉克的屠戮值得更仔细的审视。令人好奇的是，尽管她还有其他令人印象深刻的事迹，但正是屠戮这条巨龙被认为是卡莫拉最具代表性的英雄壮举。正是因为这单一行为，她被与阿拉夫或强者罗伯特相提并论，尽管她与后者的合作按理说应该更加令人印象深刻。

english: Dragons are of course ferocious, terrible beasts, but I am not convinced they are quite so terrible as Garak is made out to be. The slaying of a dragon is a difficult task, of course, but not an impossible one. It requires great skill, but it is not a legendary act, worthy of being passed into song for generations. I cannot recall the name of any of the countless dragon slayers of the last century, so why it that defeating Garak is such a unique feat?
translation: 巨龙当然是凶猛可怕的野兽，但我不确信它们像加拉克被描绘的那样可怕。屠龙当然是一项艰巨的任务，但并非不可能。它需要高超的技巧，但并非值得传唱数代的传奇事迹。我想不起上个世纪无数屠龙者中任何一位的名字，那么为什么击败加拉克是如此独特的壮举呢？

english: It stands to reason that Garak, or the circumstances surrounding its defeat, were in some way extraordinary. I will now present some possible hypotheses to help explain this mystery.
translation: 按理说，加拉克本身，或围绕其被击败的情况，在某种程度上是特殊的。我现在将提出一些可能的假设来帮助解释这个谜团。

english: Hypothesis 1: Humans did not possess the means to protect themselves from dragons at the time.
translation: 假设一：当时人类没有保护自己免受巨龙伤害的手段。

english: The dragon slayers of today have a vast array of equipment suitable for killing dragons, from potions to specially made shields that protect from dragonfire. In Camorra's day, such protection probably did not exist, and a dragon's fire breath would surely be many times as deadly. In addition, the period had neither the tools nor the knowledge to make weapons and armour comparable to what we have today. As such, piercing a dragon's hide, or protecting oneself from its blows, would be significantly more difficult.
translation: 今天的屠龙者拥有大量适合屠龙的装备，从药水到专门抵御龙火的盾牌。在卡莫拉的时代，这种保护可能不存在，巨龙的火焰吐息肯定会致命数倍。此外，那个时代既没有工具也没有知识来制造与今天相当的武器和盔甲。因此，刺穿巨龙的皮，或保护自己免受其攻击，将困难得多。

english: An obvious weakness in this hypothesis is the fact that no other dragon from this time period appears to have gained the legendary reputation that Garak has. If dragons were such an immense threat, then surely the historical record would have countless similar examples.
translation: 这个假设的一个明显弱点是，同一时期没有其他巨龙似乎获得了加拉克那样的传奇声誉。如果巨龙是如此的巨大威胁，那么历史记录中肯定会有无数类似的例子。

english: Hypothesis 2: Garak was an exceptionally intelligent dragon.
translation: 假设二：加拉克是一条异常聪明的巨龙。

english: The fact that Garak possesses a name, and that that name does not correspond with any known human language, suggests that Garak may have possessed an intelligence rarely seen amongst dragons. Examination of dragon corpses has shown that dragons possess remarkably developed brains. However, most dragons appear to be gripped by an instinctual rage and ferocity that makes them unable to utilize it to its full potential. If Garak was somehow capable of controlling its rage, it would be exponentially more dangerous than almost any other recorded dragon; it would have the ability to strategize.
translation: 加拉克拥有名字，且该名字与任何已知的人类语言都不对应，这表明加拉克可能拥有巨龙中罕见的智慧。对龙尸的检查表明巨龙拥有非常发达的大脑。然而，大多数巨龙似乎被本能性的愤怒和凶猛所控制，使它们无法充分发挥其潜力。如果加拉克能以某种方式控制自己的愤怒，它将比几乎所有有记录的巨龙都危险得多；它将拥有制定战略的能力。

english: Of course, this hypothesis hinges on the assumption that 'Garak' is what the dragon named itself, and that that is why it does not correspond to any known language or tradition. It is just as likely that this language simply went extinct.
translation: 当然，这个假设取决于'加拉克'是巨龙自己命名的，这就是为什么它不对应任何已知语言或传统。同样可能的是，这种语言只是灭绝了。

english: Hypothesis 3: Garak was no dragon at all.
translation: 假设三：加拉克根本不是巨龙。

english: This is a most provoking thought, I agree, but examining the original Camorra poems shows that there is actually very little evidence for Garak having been a dragon. The original poems, recorded around 400 years after Camorra's death, refer to Garak as either a 'fire serpent/reptile/snake' or a 'fire bird/vulture' (the words of the original language have multiple meanings). It wasn't until Archibald Malore's translation into the common tounge that all these passages were standardised and Garak became a 'dragon'.
translation: 这是一个最引人深思的想法，我同意，但审视原始的卡莫拉诗歌表明，实际上几乎没有证据表明加拉克是巨龙。原始诗歌在卡莫拉死后约四百年记录，将加拉克称为'火蛇/爬行动物/蛇'或'火鸟/秃鹫'（原始语言的词汇有多重含义）。直到阿奇博尔德·马洛尔翻译成通用语，所有这些段落才被标准化，加拉克变成了'巨龙'。

english: What could Garak be besides a dragon? That is a question I am not prepared to answer. But whatever this thing was, it must surely have been impossibly dangerous, with a rage and ferocity akin to and even surpassing that of the mightiest dragons.
translation: 如果加拉克不是巨龙，那它可能是什么？这是一个我还没准备好回答的问题。但无论这东西是什么，它肯定危险得不可思议，其愤怒和凶猛堪比甚至超越最强大的巨龙。

english: There is beauty in chaos. Of this, there is no greater example than Vampyrium, my home. Ever since I left, I have dreamt of my eventual return. Now, millennia later, I am finally here. The world is just how I remembered it. With its blood-red sky and forests of darkwood, it is a beauty unlike any other.
translation: 混沌之中有美。没有比我的家乡吸血鬼界更好的例子了。自从我离开后，我一直梦想着最终归来。如今，千年之后，我终于回到了这里。这个世界和我记忆中的一模一样。血红色的天空和暗木森林，是一种无与伦比的美。

english: I did not just come here to admire though, for today marks the first step in what will eventually make things right. For too long, my people have have been softened by the Stranger from Afar and his false ideals. They are no longer hunters, but instead, mere farmers. Soon however, I shall teach them to embrace our heritage, and remind them what it means to be a true vampyre.
translation: 但我来这里不只是为了欣赏，因为今天是最终将拨乱反正的第一步。太久以来，我的人民被远方陌生人及其虚假理想所软化。他们不再是猎人，而仅仅是农夫。然而很快，我将教导他们拥抱我们的传统，提醒他们成为真正吸血鬼意味着什么。

english: First though, I have some unfinished business to attend to. There is an old friend who I have left waiting for far too long. Before the Stranger from Afar domesticated us, our people were hunters unlike any others. No creature on Vampyrium could match our strength or our cunning. No creature, except one. The yarasa.
translation: 但首先，我有一些未了之事要处理。有一位老朋友，我让他等得太久了。在远方陌生人驯化我们之前，我们的人民是独一无二的猎人。吸血鬼界没有生物能匹敌我们的力量和狡猾。没有生物，除了一个。亚拉萨。

english: The yarasa were our true equals. Strong, fast, and unpredictable. They made for the ultimate hunt. Alas, the yarasa were amongst the many casualties of our domestication. Before then, we were a divided people. But with unity under the eight tribes came a power we had never before experienced. We massacred the yarasa with ease, their strength no match for our superior numbers.
translation: 亚拉萨是我们真正的对手。强壮、快速、不可预测。它们是最顶级的猎物。唉，亚拉萨是我们被驯化的众多牺牲品之一。在那之前，我们是一个分裂的民族。但在八部落统一之下，我们获得了前所未有的力量。我们轻松地屠杀了亚拉萨，它们的力量无法匹敌我们的人数优势。

english: I have many regrets, but none more so than the events of that day. It was no hunt, just a joyless slaughter. It was our first step towards what we have become now, and I am filled with self loathing for my role in it. However, today is not about that. Today is about one thing, and one thing alone. Today, for the first time in millennia, the hunt begins again.
translation: 我有很多遗憾，但没有比那一天的事件更让我后悔的。那不是狩猎，只是一场毫无喜悦的屠杀。那是我们走向如今模样的第一步，我对自己在其中扮演的角色充满自我厌恶。然而，今天不是关于那个的。今天只关乎一件事，唯一的一件事。今天，千年来第一次，狩猎重新开始。

english: While most of the yarasa fell that day, there were some that managed to evade our slaughter. Most of these were drawn out and killed soon afterwards. However, there was one that managed to defy us right up to the day we left Vampyrium. Xarpus, the last King of the yarasa. The yarasa were a formidable foe, but compared to Xarpus, they were no foe at all. He is the apex predator of Vampyrium and he is my target.
translation: 虽然那天大多数亚拉萨都倒下了，但还是有一些逃脱了我们的屠杀。其中大部分后来被引出并杀死了。然而，有一个一直与我们对抗，直到我们离开吸血鬼之地的最后一天。扎普斯，亚拉萨最后的国王。亚拉萨是强大的敌人，但与扎普斯相比，他们根本算不上敌人。他是吸血鬼之地的顶级掠食者，也是我的目标。

english: I had no doubt that he would have survived all these years. With the rest of his kind dead and most of the vampyres having left the world, he has had little competition. Still, I don't expect he will have grown weak. Like me, he has waited a long time for this day. At long last, I will face a true foe again. At long last, I will feel the joy of the hunt.
translation: 我毫不怀疑他能活过这么多年。随着他的同类全部死去，大多数吸血鬼也离开了这个世界，他几乎没有竞争对手。不过，我不指望他会变弱。和我一样，他也为这一天等待了很长时间。终于，我将再次面对真正的敌人。终于，我将再次感受到狩猎的喜悦。

english: I have not allowed myself to fall victim to the sloth and gluttony that has taken hold of the rest of my people. I should still have the strength to take on this challenge. However, if I should fall, let it be known that I am finally free again. I spent too long a slave to the Stranger from Afar, too long a slave to myself. No more. Let the hunt begin.
translation: 我没有让自己沦为同胞们所陷入的懒惰和贪婪的牺牲品。我应该还有力量迎接这个挑战。然而，如果我倒下了，请记住我终于再次自由了。我做了太久的远方陌生人的奴隶，也太久做了自己的奴隶。到此为止。让狩猎开始吧。

english: Lord Drakan has tasked me with learning more about the shadow realm. To aid in this task, I've been given a dark beast. The natural connection this creature has with the shadows should make the task far easier.
translation: 德拉肯领主交给我一项任务，要我更多地了解阴影领域。为了协助这项任务，我得到了一只暗黑兽。这个生物与阴影之间的天然联系应该会让任务变得容易得多。

english: Success! The creature has managed to connect to the other side, and early telepathic intrusions show that they've made contact. It's too early to say who wishes to communicate with us, but the connection will be stronger next time. I'll just need to make some small alterations to the creature.
translation: 成功了！这个生物成功连接到了另一边，早期的精神感应显示他们已经取得了联系。现在说谁想与我们交流还为时过早，但下次连接会更强。我只需要对这个生物做一些小小的调整。

english: 'Closer!' - Or at least, that is what it sounds like...
translation: '靠近点！' - 至少，听起来是这样的……

english: Incredible! My alterations were just what was needed to give the creature more power. It can now move freely beyond realms and it has returned with yet another message.
translation: 不可思议！我的调整正是赋予这个生物更多力量所需要的。它现在可以自由地穿越领域，并带回了另一条信息。

english: 'Abandon deeper, the tortured experiment won! Trapped! Follow within the shadows voice.'
translation: '放弃更深，受折磨的实验体赢了！被困住了！跟随阴影中的声音。'

english: Peculiar nonsense, but I assume there must've been some kind of interference. Perhaps the owner of this voice has been trapped on the other side? I'll send the creature back, but with a message!
translation: 奇怪的胡言乱语，但我猜想一定是有什么干扰。也许这个声音的主人被困在了另一边？我会把生物送回去，但带着一条信息！

english: Perfect! The creature has managed to gather an answer from the other side, but again the answer has been mangled into obscurity. I believe everything is in place now for the final practical test! I will travel with the creature and ask this mysterious being about the secrets of the shadow realm. Lord Drakan will be most impressed with my findings. I can already taste the blood prize and it is delicious.
translation: 完美！这个生物成功地从另一边收集到了答案，但答案再次被扭曲得模糊不清。我相信现在一切就绪，可以进行最后的实际测试了！我将与这个生物同行，向这个神秘的生物询问阴影领域的秘密。德拉肯领主一定会对我的发现印象深刻。我已经能尝到鲜血奖赏的滋味了，真是美味。

english: 'Tet!'
translation: '泰特！'

english: 'Seg!'
translation: '塞格！'

english: There are some things that are best left forgotten. Some stories that people prefer not to tell. This perhaps should be one of those, but I am bound by my oath to record all the strangeness I have encountered.
translation: 有些事情最好被遗忘。有些故事人们宁愿不讲。这也许应该是其中之一，但我受誓言约束，必须记录下我遇到的所有奇异之事。

english: My story really begins when I was wandering the northern most shores of Forinthry. I walked amongst the ruins of abandoned cities and forgotten temples to a slain god. I walked alone, for the world had gone mad and the gods themselves warred with each other. Man fought against man and monster in the names of Saradomin, Zamorak, Armadyl and Bandos.
translation: 我的故事真正开始于我在弗林斯瑞最北端的海岸徘徊时。我走过废弃城市的废墟和被遗忘的、供奉一位被弑神明的神庙。我独自一人行走，因为世界已经疯狂，诸神之间互相争斗。人类以萨拉多明、扎莫拉克、阿玛迪尔和班多斯之名互相残杀，也与怪物战斗。

english: The streets were lined with bodies. It is with terrible sadness that such a statement is not hyperbole.
translation: 街道上尸横遍野。可悲的是，这句话并非夸张。

english: I chose no side. Making me an outcast to everyone. A fate I could happily endure.
translation: 我没有选择任何一方。这让我成了所有人的异类。一个我乐于承受的命运。

english: I instead sought out the silent areas of the world. The forgotten nooks and crannies that no one ever seems to find by accident. I found one such nook in the northern most part of the world. It was a hole in the ground, surrounded by verdant overgrowth and the bones of fallen soldiers. The hole was deep, impossibly so. Even by lantern light I couldn't see the bottom and stones dropped were eerily silent as though the hole went on forever.
translation: 我转而寻找世界上那些寂静的地方。那些似乎永远不会被人偶然发现的被遗忘的角落。我在世界最北端找到了这样一个角落。那是一个地上的洞，周围环绕着茂密的植被和倒下的士兵的骨头。洞很深，深得不可思议。即使在灯笼的光线下我也看不到底部，扔下的石头也诡异地悄无声息，仿佛这个洞通向永恒。

english: There was only one sound that came from this hole. A soft, sorrowful, weeping.
translation: 这个洞里只传来一种声音。一种轻柔、悲伤的哭泣声。

english: A woman's voice I recall. I could not determine her age, nor accent, but her sorrow was palpable.
translation: 我记得那是一个女人的声音。我无法判断她的年龄，也听不出她的口音，但她的悲伤是显而易见的。

english: She seemed lost, lonely and in dire need of aid and yet there was none around for miles who could save her. I was her only hope and I may be many things, but heartless I am not.
translation: 她似乎迷失了方向，孤独无助，急需帮助，但方圆数英里内没有人能救她。我是她唯一的希望，而我可能有很多缺点，但我并非无情之人。

english: I lowered myself into the darkness, a rope wrapped around my waist and securely tied to a venerable tree that sat at the entrance to the darkness. My lantern light showed that the walls of the hole retreated away and I found myself descending into a deep dark cavern.
translation: 我把自己放进了黑暗中，一根绳子缠在我的腰间，牢牢地系在入口处一棵古老的树上。我的灯笼光照出洞壁向后退去，我发现自己正降入一个深邃黑暗的洞穴。

english: After what felt like an eternity, I rested my weary feet upon solid ground. It was cold and solid. Stone. Carved stone, a man-made cavern. I brought my lantern up to the walls and scanned the place. The walls held long weathered murals and symbols of forgotten creatures.
translation: 仿佛过了永恒之久，我终于把疲惫的双脚踩在了坚实的地面上。地面冰冷而坚实。是石头。雕刻过的石头，一个人工洞穴。我举起灯笼照向墙壁，扫视着这个地方。墙壁上有着历经风霜的壁画和被遗忘生物的标志。

english: I recognised the image of The Empty Lord himself, the ancient and powerful being who had once named this place as the seat of his empire. He was warding something back. What that was I could not see, for where the picture should have been, instead there was a hole as though someone had torn the picture from the mural and destroyed it.
translation: 我认出了空之主本人的形象，这位古老而强大的存在曾将此地命名为他帝国的中心。他在阻挡什么东西。我看不到那是什么，因为本应是图画的地方，却有一个洞，仿佛有人把壁画上的图画撕下来毁掉了。

english: I should have left right there and then. But I did not.
translation: 我当时就应该立刻离开。但我没有。

english: Instead I listened for that weeping. That perpetual sorrow that called to me like a siren song. I so wanted to be a hero, to rescue the poor damsel in distress.
translation: 相反，我倾听着那哭泣声。那如海妖之歌般呼唤着我的永恒悲伤。我太想成为一个英雄，去拯救那位落难的可怜少女。

english: I should have known better.
translation: 我本该更明智的。

english: The pitiful keening led me deeper into the darkness. Down a strangely carved corridor devoid of lantern or torches. The only source of light available to me was the lantern that I clung to as though my life depended on it. Yet though the light remained constant, I could feel the world growing darker.
translation: 那可怜的哀号声引我深入黑暗。沿着一条雕刻奇特的走廊，没有灯笼也没有火把。我唯一的光源就是我紧紧抓住的灯笼，仿佛我的生命就靠它了。然而，尽管光线保持不变，我却能感觉到世界在变得更暗。

english: Cold seemed to be seeping in from everywhere. Beneath my clothes, down my spine. I felt the chill touch my very soul. Yet I persisted and pressed forward, because I was a fool.
translation: 寒意似乎从四面八方渗入。在我的衣服下面，沿着我的脊椎。我感到那股寒意触及了我的灵魂。但我还是坚持着，继续前进，因为我是个傻瓜。

english: I cannot tell you how deep that tunnel went. It felt like an eternity, yet it could only have been a few metres deep.
translation: 我无法告诉你那条隧道有多深。感觉像是永恒，但它可能只有几米深。

english: The woman's cries were much louder now. They were emanating from behind a great stone door covered in strange markings that I did not recognise. In hindsight they must have been warnings. If they were, I could not read them.
translation: 女人的哭声现在响亮多了。它们来自一扇巨大的石门后面，门上覆盖着我不认识的奇怪标记。事后想来，那些一定是警告。如果它们是，我也看不懂。

english: Instead, like the fool I am, I heaved the ancient door open. The air behind them was stale and rotten. The stagnant air of centuries. Yet here was the source of those tears, loud and terrible. I felt the sorrow and anguish creep into my bones with a chill greater than the cold. I felt the sorrow wrap around my heart and squeeze, it was unbearable.
translation: 相反，像个傻瓜一样，我推开了那扇古老的门。门后的空气陈旧而腐烂。是几个世纪以来的停滞空气。然而，这就是那些眼泪的来源，响亮而可怕。我感到悲伤和痛苦渗入我的骨髓，比寒冷更刺骨。我感到悲伤缠绕着我的心脏并挤压着，令人难以忍受。

english: Then, it stopped.
translation: 然后，它停止了。

english: There was movement in this room. Something hulking, with spindly arms and a flash of razor sharp talons. It rushed towards me and as it did so it wailed a terrible scream. Not a scream of rage, but of grief, such complete and absolute grief that my heart stopped for a moment.
translation: 这个房间里有动静。一个庞然大物，有着细长的手臂和锋利的爪子一闪而过。它向我冲来，同时发出可怕的尖叫。不是愤怒的尖叫，而是悲伤，如此彻底而绝对的悲伤，让我的心停跳了一瞬。

english: It was almost upon me when I could move again and I had just enough time to slam the door closed and then to run as fast as I could.
translation: 它几乎要扑到我身上时，我终于又能动了，我刚好来得及砰地关上门，然后拼命地跑。

english: I had no light, so I ran into pure darkness, only blind luck as my ally. Behind me I heard the door torn open. I heard that scream, now interspersed once again with that same sorrowful weeping. My life flashed before my eyes, a terrible cliché but a true one and I knew that I had wasted it. I knew every despair and every regret of my life and they would haunt me and drag me into the afterlife like weights wrapped around my neck.
translation: 我没有光，所以我在纯粹的黑暗中奔跑，只有盲目的运气作为我的盟友。我听到身后门被撕开的声音。我听到那声尖叫，现在再次夹杂着同样悲伤的哭泣。我的一生在眼前闪过，一个可怕的陈词滥调，但却是真实的，我知道我浪费了它。我知道我生命中每一个绝望和遗憾，它们会像挂在脖子上的重物一样纠缠着我，把我拖入来世。

english: Then, by providence or divine aid, my fingers brushed against my rope. Still secured to the tree above. I climbed. I climbed with all the energy I had. I climbed because my life depended on it and when I reached the top, I cut the rope free and watched as it fell into shadow.
translation: 然后，也许是天意或神助，我的手指碰到了我的绳子。它仍然系在上面的树上。我爬了上去。我用尽所有力气往上爬。我爬，因为我的生命就靠它了，当我到达顶部时，我割断了绳子，看着它落入阴影中。

english: I watched and I listened as the weeping below me grew so loud as to be deafening.
translation: 我看着，听着，下方的哭泣声变得震耳欲聋。

english: I am not ashamed to say that I fled from that scene. I have never returned to that spot and I pray I never shall. I write this memoire both as a reminder and as a warning to any that might read it.
translation: 我不羞于承认我从那个地方逃走了。我再也没有回到那个地方，我祈祷永远不会。我写下这篇回忆录，既是为了提醒自己，也是为了警告任何可能读到它的人。

english: There are mysteries that should never be solved.
translation: 有些谜团永远不应该被解开。

english: Some secrets should remain buried and forgotten.
translation: 有些秘密应该永远被埋葬和遗忘。

english: Where's our god now? The king has been taken and so the queen has no choice. She'll surrender the capital causing the fighting to stop, and the killing to begin. Those who resist will be enslaved, especially the pious - they taste the best, or so I've heard. I'll ask you again, where's our god now?
translation: 我们的神现在在哪？国王已被掳走，王后别无选择。她将交出首都，战斗停止，杀戮开始。抵抗者将被奴役，尤其是虔诚者——他们味道最好，至少我是这么听说的。我再问你一次，我们的神现在在哪？

english: My word is law, very few question a justiciar - for we speak with the voice of Saradomin. I'll inform my squadron that he's abandoned us. We've blued our armour, but there'll be no need to dye our fabrics, for the war has stained them a dark crimson already.
translation: 我的话就是法律，很少有人质疑审判官——因为我们以萨拉多敏的名义发言。我会通知我的中队，他抛弃了我们。我们已染蓝了盔甲，但无需再染布料，因为战争已将其染成深红色。

english: At dusk we'll march on Drakans' host and bend the knee - my squadron will pay the price and I'll become a general to a god who provides.
translation: 黄昏时分，我们将向德拉坎的军队进军并屈膝臣服——我的中队将付出代价，而我将成为一位有所供奉的神的将军。

english: I sense that some do not believe in this cause, some say the enemy won't take us in. I've but two loyal sisters left. Insela, our ballistics expert and Otrava, our squadrons healer. They'll stick with me until the end.
translation: 我感觉到有些人不相信这项事业，有人说敌人不会接纳我们。我只剩下两位忠心的姐妹。英塞拉，我们的弹道专家，和奥特拉瓦，我们中队的治疗师。她们会陪我到最后。

english: Woe to those who've yet to lose their faith, I've heard that the Lord of Vampyrium impales dissenters. I'll show him such devotion and obedience, he'll have no choice but to take us in. The dark times have only just begun, I'll make Saradomin rue the day he turned his back on us.
translation: 那些尚未失去信仰的人有祸了，我听说吸血鬼领主将异见者钉在木桩上。我将向他展示如此的虔诚和顺从，他别无选择只能接纳我们。黑暗时代才刚刚开始，我要让萨拉多敏后悔背弃我们的那一天。

english: His-Dark-Self accepted our offering! My sisters and I have been tasked with clearing out the hamlets and leading the cattle right into the heart of his vampyre host. Our armour is black and our cloth crimson, but they still know a Justiciar when they see one and they know it would be heresy to defy me.
translation: 黑暗之主接受了我们的献祭！我和姐妹们受命清理村庄，将牲畜引向他吸血鬼大军的心脏。我们的盔甲是黑色的，布料是深红色的，但他们一眼就能认出审判官，也知道违抗我就是异端。

english: A small hermitage to the north east of the capital is our next target, while our master moves further south. As a trio, we move quickly. Soon Hallowvale will be a name forgotten in time, covered by the grand shadow of our new god.
translation: 首都东北方的一座小隐修院是我们的下一个目标，而我们的主人继续向南推进。三人成行，我们行动迅速。很快，霍洛维尔将成为被时间遗忘的名字，被我们新神的巨大阴影所覆盖。

english: I should start by telling you about some of the events that led up to the 'The Great Divide'.
translation: 我应该先告诉你一些导致'大分裂'的事件。

english: For almost two millennia, we lived in the eastern realm, then in the year 1930, we lost all contact with our people back in Tirannwn. We found that the route over the mountains was impassable and our incantations were unable to penetrate the gates that had been built there.
translation: 近两千年来，我们生活在东方领域，然后在1930年，我们与提兰恩的族人失去了所有联系。我们发现翻越山脉的路线无法通行，我们的咒语也无法穿透那里建造的大门。

english: King Baxtorian called an emergency council, which I was lucky enough to take part in. We decided that before any major action could be taken, we needed to know what had happened.
translation: 巴克斯托里安国王召集了紧急议会，我有幸参加了。我们决定在采取任何重大行动之前，需要先了解发生了什么。

english: Many ways to re-enter Tirannwn were discussed. It was then that I reminded the council of an old cave system that led through the mountains. Within the caves, our ancestors had built the Well of Voyage, a portal between the east and west. Once the pass through Arandar was built, the well was abandoned, as no one had any desire to enter those cursed caves without reason.
translation: 我们讨论了许多重新进入提兰恩的方法。那时我提醒议会，有一条古老的地下洞穴系统穿过山脉。在洞穴中，我们的祖先建造了航行之井，一个连接东西方的传送门。当穿越阿兰达的山口建成后，这口井就被废弃了，因为没有人愿意无缘无故进入那些被诅咒的洞穴。

english: Soon it was decided to send five members of the Cadarn clan through the Well of Voyage, to recover any information that could tell us what was happening. We chose to re-convene upon their return.
translation: 很快决定派遣卡达恩家族的五名成员穿过航行之井，收集任何能告诉我们发生了什么的讯息。我们选择在他们返回后重新召集会议。

english: After a few weeks, Adwr returned, the only one of the five scouts that made it back. A council was called to listen to his news. He told us of the chaos he had seen; elves killing elves in the streets of Prifddinas and the seizing of the Tower of Voices by clan Iorwerth. Hearing all this sparked a debate that continued for days.
translation: 几周后，阿德沃尔回来了，五名侦察兵中唯一活着回来的。议会召集听取他的消息。他告诉我们他所见的混乱：精灵在普里夫迪纳斯城的街道上自相残杀，声音之塔被伊奥沃斯家族夺取。听到这一切引发了一场持续数日的辩论。

english: Many plans were put forward of how we should deal with the problems back home. Ideas ranged from the assassination of Lord Iorwerth to just leaving the western elves to kill each other.
translation: 我们提出了许多应对家乡问题的计划。从刺杀伊尔沃斯领主到干脆让西方精灵自相残杀，各种想法都有。

english: It was at this point that Baxtorian quoted the 'Cerddi', telling all those present that 'only together as the eight clans can we hope to survive in this hostile new world'. He then pledged to stop the madness that had befallen Prifddinas and so started the Baxtorian campaign.
translation: 就在此时，巴克斯托里安引用了'诗歌集'，告诉在场所有人'只有八大家族团结一致，我们才能在这个充满敌意的新世界中生存下去'。然后他发誓要阻止降临在普里夫迪纳斯城的疯狂，巴克斯托里安战役由此开始。

english: After many days of preparation, Baxtorian's army was ready to move. I chose to join them to keep records of what transpired. So it was that we made our way to the entrance of the cave system that eventually led to the Well of Voyage. Travelling in such places is never easy, and this was no exception. To transport the whole army and our supplies through the cave system took us many weeks.
translation: 经过多日准备，巴克斯托里安的军队准备就绪。我选择加入他们，记录所发生的一切。就这样，我们前往洞穴系统的入口，最终通向航行之井。在这种地方行进从来都不容易，这次也不例外。将整支军队和补给运过洞穴系统花了我们数周时间。

english: It was not until...
translation: 直到……

english: You pick up a new looking book: 'The Times of Lathas'. You skim over the heavy book. It talks about the heritage of the line of kings who carry the name Ardignas. They only came into power 68 years ago, but in which time there have been five kings, the current being King Lathas.
translation: 你拿起一本看起来崭新的书：《拉萨斯时代》。你翻阅这本厚重的书。书中讲述了阿尔迪格纳斯这个国王世系的传承。他们仅在68年前掌权，但在此期间已有五位国王，现任为拉萨斯国王。

english: You pick on a new looking book: 'The Times of Ardignas'. You skim over the heavy book, it talks about the heritage of the line of Kings who carry the name Ardignas. They only came into power 68 years ago, but in which time there have been six kings, the current being King Thoros.
translation: 你拿起一本看起来崭新的书：《阿尔迪格纳斯时代》。你翻阅这本厚重的书，书中讲述了阿尔迪格纳斯这个国王世系的传承。他们仅在68年前掌权，但在此期间已有六位国王，现任为索罗斯国王。

english: Day 1 - Embarked on our fortnightly fishing excursion from Al Kharid to the west. Crew consists of Taiman (skipper), Koanee, Timallus and Lauretta. All in order.
translation: 第1天 - 从阿尔卡里德城出发，开始我们每两周一次的向西钓鱼之旅。船员包括泰曼（船长）、科尼、蒂马卢斯和劳蕾塔。一切正常。

english: Day 2 - Smooth sailing to deeper waters. Caught three nets of manta rays.
translation: 第2天 - 顺利航行至更深水域。捕获了三网魔鬼鱼。

english: Day 3 - Fished some more. Not sure why we have to do these...
translation: 第3天 - 继续钓鱼。不明白为什么我们必须做这些……

english: Day 4 - Sailed further towards the Karamjan coast in search of sharks. Passed more debris than usual. Must've been a storm recently.
translation: 第4天 - 向卡拉姆詹海岸航行寻找鲨鱼。经过的碎片比平时多。最近肯定有风暴。

english: Day 5 - Distinct lack of fish. It's almost eerie.
translation: 第5天 - 鱼明显稀少。几乎令人毛骨悚然。

english: Day 6 (am) - A storm has been spotted on the horizon. Adjusted course away from it.
translation: 第6天（上午） - 地平线上发现风暴。调整航线避开。

english: Day 6 (pm) - Wind suddenly changed, storm heading in our direction.
translation: 第6天（下午） - 风向突变，风暴朝我们方向袭来。

english: Day 6 (pm) - Can't outrun and too dangerous to anchor. Will have to weather it.
translation: 第6天（下午） - 逃不掉，下锚又太危险。只能硬扛了。

english: Day 6 - Huge waves. Thick fog.
translation: 第6天 - 巨浪。浓雾。

english: 6 - Strongest ever. Dark.
translation: 第6天 - 前所未有的猛烈。黑暗。

english: Sails. Bad shape.
translation: 帆。破损严重。

english: Fish glowing
translation: 鱼在发光

english: Twisted face
translation: 扭曲的面孔

english: Aliv-
translation: 活-

english: The rest of the pages have been soaked and are too smudged to read.
translation: 其余书页已被浸湿，字迹模糊无法辨认。

english: A frog prince outfit, please!
translation: 请给我一套青蛙王子套装！

english: A frog princess outfit, please!
translation: 请给我一套青蛙公主套装！

english: Once, long ago, three mortals were led through the land of the dead. They travelled together on the dismal roads of the Grim Underworld.
translation: 很久以前，三位凡人被引领穿越亡者之地。他们一同行走在阴间冥府阴郁的道路上。

english: The Devourer's beasts were not to be seen back then, but the Underworld was still a treacherous place: souls were lost in mist, and impossible whispers lead them astray to places even the gods knew not. But worst of all was the darkness. More than anything, the Grim Underworld was a dark place, where the Sun's light could never reach. But in his stead was his son. The guide and protector. The wanderer in darkness. Icthlarin, god of the dead.
translation: 那时吞噬者的野兽还未出现，但冥府仍是个危险之地：灵魂在迷雾中迷失，不可能的耳语将他们引向连诸神都不知晓的地方。但最糟糕的是黑暗。阴间冥府最甚的是黑暗之地，太阳之光永远无法到达。但代替太阳的是他的儿子。引导者与保护者。黑暗中的流浪者。伊克哈林，死亡之神。

english: Icthlarin blindly led the party of three through the darkness, relying on scent alone. The only light by which to see was the glow from their spirits - enough only to not stumble and fall.
translation: 伊克哈林仅凭嗅觉，在黑暗中盲目地引导着三人前行。唯一能看见的光来自他们灵魂的微光——只够不绊倒摔跤。

english: At last, they came to a passageway, and Icthlarin turned to the first of the three and said: 'This is your port of call. Through here is music and peace everlasting. You will want for nothing. Now go, for my endless task continues and there are more souls to guide.'
translation: 终于，他们来到一条通道前，伊克哈林转向三人中的第一个说：'这是你的停靠港。穿过这里，是永恒的音乐与和平。你将一无所缺。现在去吧，我无尽的任务还在继续，还有更多的灵魂需要引导。'

english: And so, the first of the three bowed graciously and passed on. After a journey through mist, they came to yet another passageway. Icthlarin turned this time to the second of the three and said: 'This is your port of call. Through here is discord and war everlasting. You will always want more. Now go, for my endless task continues and there are more souls to guide.'
translation: 于是，三人中的第一位优雅地鞠躬后离去。穿过迷雾，他们来到另一条通道。伊克哈林这次转向三人中的第二位说：'这是你的停靠港。穿过这里便是纷争与永无止境的战争。你将永远渴望更多。现在去吧，因为我无尽的任务仍在继续，还有更多的灵魂需要引导。'

english: And so, the second of the three bowed respectfully and passed on.
translation: 于是，三人中的第二位恭敬地鞠躬后离去。

english: Then Icthlarin walked in silence. He stopped at every crossroads and crossing, every path and passageway, but still he walked. At last, he turned to the third and asked: 'Where is your port of call? I can find no place for you in all the Underworld. Your scent is on no hall.'
translation: 随后伊克哈林沉默地走着。他在每个十字路口和交叉口、每条路径和通道前停下，但依然继续前行。最后，他转向第三位问道：'你的停靠港在哪里？我在整个冥界都找不到你的位置。任何大厅都没有你的气息。'

english: The last of three replied: 'My place is with you. You outshine your father and all else above. Service, not rest, is my reward.'
translation: 三人中的最后一位回答：'我的位置与你同在。你超越你的父亲和上方的一切。服务，而非安息，是我的奖赏。'

english: The god grew silent then and knew not what to say. They walked longer through mist until at last Icthlarin said, his back turned: 'You know not of what you speak. I have no port of call, no halls to call my own. My life is spent in in-betweens; my task is never done. No, my father's field, that is best for you.'
translation: 神沉默了片刻，不知该说什么。他们继续穿过迷雾，直到最后伊克哈林背对着说：'你不知自己在说什么。我没有停靠港，没有属于自己的大厅。我的生活消磨在过渡之间；我的任务永无止境。不，我父亲的领域，那才是最适合你的。'

english: Yet the mortal was persistent: 'I care not for your father's field nor any other hall! I need no port of call!'
translation: 然而凡人坚持道：'我不在乎你父亲的领域或任何其他大厅！我不需要停靠港！'

english: And Icthlarin was angered by their insolence: 'What aid can you give me? Your spirit is dim and has not even the brittle strength of bones.'
translation: 伊克哈林被他们的无礼激怒了：'你能给我什么帮助？你的灵魂暗淡无光，甚至没有骨头那般脆弱的强度。'

english: The third answered: 'The light of my spirit may be dim, but it is better than darkness.'
translation: 第三位回答：'我灵魂的光或许暗淡，但总比黑暗要好。'

english: The god considered: 'It is a lonely path. You will meet many, but they will all pass you by.'
translation: 神思索着：'这是一条孤独的路。你会遇见许多人，但他们都会从你身边经过。'

english: And the third smiled: 'The better to share it.'
translation: 第三位微笑着说：'那正好可以分享。'

english: Icthlarin grew silent once more, but then he turned to the cave wall. He tore free one of the roots of the world and extended it to his mortal companion and said: 'Come then, for our endless task continues, and there are more souls to guide.'
translation: 伊克哈林再次沉默，但随后他转向洞穴墙壁。他扯下世界之根中的一根，递给他的凡人同伴说：'那就来吧，因为我们无尽的任务仍在继续，还有更多的灵魂需要引导。'

english: And with the third's touch, their spirit became the first ember and lit the root's end. It was a beginning. Since then, Icthlarin has never wandered alone, for all those who serve him are wanderers in darkness too. They are the light in the jackal's torch.
translation: 随着第三位的触碰，他们的灵魂化为第一颗火星，点燃了树根的末端。这是一个开始。自那以后，伊克哈林再未独自流浪，因为所有侍奉他的人也都是黑暗中的流浪者。他们是胡狼火炬中的光。

english: It seems my time is up. The Devourer never discovered my writing, but it doesn't matter now anyway. She's found what she seeks and has no further need for us. These words will be my last.
translation: 看来我的时间到了。吞噬者从未发现我的文字，但现在也无所谓了。她已经找到了她所寻求之物，不再需要我们。这些文字将是我的遗言。

english: Much of our early history has long been lost, but traces can still be found by those of us who know where to look. Many tomes reference an ancient war in Osmumten's time, back when Tumeken and Elidinis still walked these lands.
translation: 我们早期历史的大部分早已失落，但我们这些知道去哪里寻找的人仍能找到痕迹。许多典籍提到奥斯穆滕时代的远古战争，那时图梅肯和伊莉迪尼斯仍行走在这片土地上。

english: In war, great weapons can turn the tide against even the strongest foes, and legend has long spoken of Tumeken using a powerful staff to build two such weapons. It was believed any truth to these legends had long since been lost, but here in Osmumten's tomb, the truth is revealed: the weapons exist, and they are the prize the Devourer so fervently seeks.
translation: 在战争中，强大的武器可以扭转战局，即使面对最强大的敌人也是如此。传说一直讲述图梅肯用一根强大的法杖打造了两件这样的武器。人们曾以为这些传说的真相早已失落，但在奥斯穆滕的坟墓中，真相得以揭示：武器确实存在，它们正是吞噬者热切寻求的奖品。

english: In truth, referring to Tumeken's creations as 'weapons' does them no justice. They are in fact two ancient automatons, built to embody Tumeken and Elidinis themselves and seemingly imbued with their divine essence. They are key to the Devourer's plan.
translation: 事实上，将图梅肯的造物称为'武器'并不公平。它们实际上是两台古老的自动机械，被打造来体现图梅肯和伊莉迪尼斯本身，似乎注入了他们的神圣本质。它们是吞噬者计划的关键。

english: Between the lesser deities and the Wardens, it's clear now what the Devourer wants. She intends to use the Wardens to claim power from the imprisoned lesser deities. With their power, she will become unstoppable.
translation: 在次级神祇和典狱长之间，现在很清楚吞噬者的意图了。她打算利用典狱长从被囚禁的次级神祇那里夺取力量。有了他们的力量，她将变得不可阻挡。

english: I wish I could keep writing, but she is closing in. I wish I had used my time more judiciously. So many things I should have done and said. All I can do now is pray my words help in some way, and that someone is able to overcome the Devourer.
translation: 我希望我能继续写下去，但她正在逼近。我希望我能更明智地利用时间。有太多我本应做和说的事。我现在所能做的只是祈祷我的文字能有所帮助，祈祷有人能够战胜吞噬者。

english: Once upon a time, an Old One was walking through the valley when she encountered a dwarf at the side of the road. He was ever so unhappy, for he had come to seek his fortune, but the land was cold, and the mountains inhospitable.
translation: 从前，一位古者正穿过山谷，在路边遇到一个矮人。他非常不开心，因为他来此寻求财富，但大地寒冷，群山荒凉。

english: 'On Coatlpetl Peak,' she said, 'There lives a great and terrible monster known as the Hueycoatl. She spends all day digging for gold with her mighty claws. You'll surely find treasure there.'
translation: “在科特尔佩克峰上，”她说，“住着一只名叫休伊科特尔的可怕巨兽。她整天用她强大的爪子挖金子。你一定能在那里找到宝藏。”

english: The dwarf dried his eyes and thanked the Old One for her help. Then, he hoisted his pack, and set off towards Coatlpetl Peak.
translation: 矮人擦干眼泪，感谢了古者的帮助。然后，他背起包，朝科特尔佩克峰出发了。

english: The mountain was very, very cold, and very, very scary, and as the dwarf climbed up the whole mountain shook - the Hueycoatl had spotted him!
translation: 山上非常非常冷，也非常非常吓人，矮人往上爬的时候整座山都在震动——休伊科特尔发现他了！

english: 'Who dares approach me?' the monster roared.
translation: “谁敢靠近我？”巨兽咆哮道。

english: 'Oh, Hueycoatl!' the clever dwarf cried, and fell to his knees. 'Forgive me! I only came to see if you needed help!'
translation: “哦，休伊科特尔！”聪明的矮人喊道，跪了下来。“原谅我！我只是来看看您是否需要帮助！”

english: 'I am the great and powerful Hueycoatl!' Growled the monster. 'Behold my magnificent feathers! What help could a creature like you give me?'
translation: “我是伟大而强大的休伊科特尔！”巨兽低吼道。“看看我华丽的羽毛！像你这样的生物能给我什么帮助？”

english: 'I met an Old One just now,' the dwarf said, 'Who warned me that there is a terrible monster around here!'
translation: “我刚才遇到了一位古者，”矮人说，“她警告我这里有可怕的怪物！”

english: The Hueycoatl laughed.
translation: 休伊科特尔笑了。

english: 'Behold my mighty claws! No monster is more terrible than me!'
translation: '看我的利爪！没有怪物比我更可怕！'

english: 'Oh, thank goodness!' said the clever dwarf. 'The Old One said you might already have been devoured whole by this terrible beast! For his claws are even mightier than yours, and his feathers even more magnificent!'
translation: '哦，谢天谢地！'聪明的矮人说。'老者说你可能已经被这可怕的野兽整个吞掉了！因为它的爪子比你的还要厉害，羽毛比你的还要华丽！'

english: At this, the Hueycoatl bristled.
translation: 听到这话，休伊科特尔竖起了羽毛。

english: 'It cannot be true!' she said. 'If such a monster exists, I would have seen it!'
translation: '不可能！'她说。'如果真有这样的怪物，我早就看见了！'

english: 'Perhaps you have!' Said the dwarf, as he reached into his pack for the mirror he carried. 'Here, this is what it looks like.'
translation: '也许你见过！'矮人说着，从包里掏出随身携带的镜子。'来，这就是它的样子。'

english: He held the mirror up for the Hueycoatl to see. She peered into the mirror, and all of a sudden, reared back in fright!
translation: 他把镜子举起来给休伊科特尔看。她朝镜子里一瞧，突然吓得往后一缩！

english: 'This is the monster the Old One told you about?' she cried. 'But look at its horrible claws! Look at its terrible plumage!'
translation: '这就是老者告诉你的怪物？'她喊道。'看它那可怕的爪子！看它那可怕的羽毛！'

english: The Hueycoatl began to shiver in fright, and the whole mountain trembled.
translation: 休伊科特尔开始害怕地发抖，整座山都在颤抖。

english: 'Well,' said the clever dwarf, 'I suppose the great and powerful Hueycoatl doesn't need my help to defeat it.'
translation: '嗯，'聪明的矮人说，'我想伟大而强大的休伊科特尔不需要我帮忙打败它吧。'

english: The Hueycoatl cowered, and the whole mountain shook. 'Please!' the monster said, 'Please defeat it!'
translation: 休伊科特尔缩成一团，整座山都在摇晃。'求你了！'怪物说，'求你打败它！'

english: The dwarf sighed.
translation: 矮人叹了口气。

english: 'I would, but I don't have any gold. That's the monster's only weakness.'
translation: '我愿意，但我没有金子。那是那怪物唯一的弱点。'

english: The Hueycoatl had an idea. She reached a long, feathered claw into her cave and pulled out a big sack of gold!
translation: 休伊科特尔想到了一个主意。她把一只长满羽毛的长爪伸进洞穴，拉出一大袋金子！

english: 'Here!' she said, 'I have plenty of gold for you. Just make sure the monster doesn't get me!'
translation: '给你！'她说，'我有的是金子给你。只要确保那怪物别来抓我就行！'

english: And so, the clever dwarf made his fortune. Once a year, he climbed the mountain and told the Hueycoatl all that he had done to keep the monster at bay, and the grateful Hueycoatl rewarded him with the treasure she'd found.
translation: 就这样，聪明的矮人发了财。每年一次，他爬上那座山，告诉休伊科特尔他为了抵御那怪物所做的一切，感激的休伊科特尔用她找到的宝藏来报答他。

english: To this day, the dwarves tell tales of the mighty Hueycoatl, and her hidden hoard of gold. If you are ever in the mountains, watch out! You may spot the Hueycoatl, hiding in her cave... or perhaps, she'll spot you!
translation: 直到今天，矮人们还在传颂着强大的休伊科特尔和她隐藏的金子宝藏。如果你在山里，要小心！你可能会发现休伊科特尔藏在她的洞穴里……或者，她可能会发现你！

english: Happy animals make happy farmers. It is crucial to ensure your animals have everything they could need: space, food, water. Without those essentials met you'll spend your time running around trying to make them happy and healthy. Not to mention, unhappy animals produce worse quality product!
translation: 快乐的动物造就快乐的农民。确保你的动物拥有一切所需至关重要：空间、食物、水。如果这些基本需求得不到满足，你就会花时间四处奔波让它们开心健康。更别提，不快乐的动物产出的产品质量更差！

english: The Groats name lives and dies on its reputation, and that reputation replies on producing the highest quality milk and eggs.
translation: 格罗特家族的名声靠的就是声誉，而声誉靠的是产出最高品质的牛奶和鸡蛋。

english: Never make more than you need. Greed will rot not only your soul, but your land. Your animals remain healthier when not pushed to their limits.
translation: 永远不要生产超出所需的东西。贪婪不仅会腐蚀你的灵魂，还会腐蚀你的土地。不过度压榨动物，它们就会更健康。

english: Always squirrel money away from the tax collector. It's not a good citizen that avoids all of their taxes, but a smart one keeps a little back. The more you can invest into your farm and your animals, the more you can give back later on in your life.
translation: 总是要藏点钱避开收税官。完全逃税的不是好市民，但聪明人会留一手。你投入农场和动物的越多，日后能回报的就越多。

english: The first room upon entering into the temple. A raised monolith with a joined symbol representing the union of both Ralos and Ranul. This monolith is used by both religions for delivering sermons and to preach about the practices of the religion. Meetings are held at the rise and fall of the sun/moon to celebrate their arrival and to pray for their return when they have left.
translation: 进入神庙后的第一个房间。一块凸起的巨石上刻着代表拉洛斯和拉努尔结合的联合符号。这块巨石被两种宗教用来布道和宣讲宗教习俗。在太阳/月亮升起和落下时举行集会，庆祝它们的到来，并在它们离去时祈祷它们归来。

english: A sacred tomb used to lay to rest the followers of either religion once they have passed, although common practice for followers of Ralos is to be cremated on the Sacrificial Burner. The care of this room is the responsibility of the followers of Ranul but anyone may visit and pay respects to the fallen worshipers whenever they wish to.
translation: 一座神圣的坟墓，用于安葬任一宗教已故的信徒，不过拉洛斯的信徒通常会在献祭焚烧炉上火化。这个房间的维护由拉努尔的信徒负责，但任何人都可以随时前来参观并向逝去的信徒致敬。

english: Used to store religious texts and information considered valuable to both the worshipers of Ralos and Ranul. The care of this room is the responsibility of the followers of Ranul.
translation: 用于存放对拉洛斯和拉努尔的信徒都有价值的宗教文本和信息。这个房间的维护由拉努尔的信徒负责。

english: A sacred altar used by followers of Ralos for praying directly to Ralos, this altar only works for those whom Ralos deems worthy enough to receive his blessing.
translation: 一座神圣的祭坛，拉洛斯的信徒用它直接向拉洛斯祈祷，这座祭坛只对拉洛斯认为值得接受祝福的人起作用。

english: A crypt used by followers of Ranul to bury their significant leaders. Contains a stone relief depicting a vision of both Ralos and Ranul.
translation: 拉努尔信徒用来安葬重要领袖的墓穴。里面有一块石浮雕，描绘了拉洛斯和拉努尔两者的幻象。

english: This area contains a number of baby red dragons which the followers of Ralos have been using to study these mythical creatures which are capable of manifesting a similar power to Ralos innately. It is the duty of the followers of Ralos to limit the reproduction of these creatures.
translation: 这个区域有一些红龙幼崽，拉洛斯的信徒一直在用它们研究这些神话生物，它们天生就能展现出与拉洛斯相似的力量。限制这些生物的繁殖是拉洛斯信徒的职责。

english: A room containing a religious structure dedicated to Ralos which is used to cremate the bones of fallen red dragons in order to gain his favour. Members of Ralos also use this to cremate fellow worshipers as doing so will unite them with Ralos in death.
translation: 一个供奉拉洛斯的宗教建筑房间，用来火化阵亡红龙的骨头以求得他的青睐。拉洛斯的信徒也用它来火化同伴信徒，因为这样做能使他们在死后与拉洛斯合一。

english: To anyone out there! I don't know... what should I do? They're insane! Ralos has fled to Varlamore in the south, the followers of Ranul have become too powerful. I tried to warn them against meeting with the dark wizard but they wouldn't listen! I can already feel it, we've been corrupted and my friends are becoming more fanatical and straying further from Ranul, corrupting his teachings and trying to force premature death onto others. I can feel it too, part of me is slipping away slowly... Ranul, please forgive me.
translation: 给外面的任何人！我不知道...我该怎么办？他们疯了！拉洛斯已经逃往南方的瓦拉莫尔，拉努尔的信徒变得太强大了。我试图警告他们不要去见那个黑巫师，但他们不听！我已经能感觉到了，我们被腐化了，我的朋友们变得越来越狂热，越来越偏离拉努尔，歪曲他的教义，试图把过早的死亡强加给别人。我也能感觉到，我的一部分正在慢慢消逝...拉努尔，请原谅我。

english: From the dark of the night, with the absence of light, Ranul came into being. Ranul bestows to those of us who are worthy both his guidance and his wisdom. While Ralos celebrates life, we instead turn to Ranul, who teaches us to reflect upon life and the importance of death.
translation: 从夜的黑暗中，在没有光的情况下，拉努尔诞生了。拉努尔赐予我们这些值得的人他的指引和智慧。拉洛斯庆祝生命，而我们则转向拉努尔，他教导我们反思生命和死亡的重要性。

english: After life begins, the only other significant event is death, however death should not be feared, instead it should be both embraced and respected. Death shapes us and those around us as it is the final act of our lives, the final chapter of one's book.
translation: 生命开始之后，唯一重要的事件就是死亡，但死亡不应被恐惧，而应被拥抱和尊重。死亡塑造了我们和周围的人，因为它是我们生命的最后行为，是人生书籍的最后一章。

english: As followers of Ranul it is our duty to guide others in embracing death. To make sure that the life they lived is celebrated and the memories left behind impactful and meaningful to future generations. To ensure that those who are dead are respected and that their last rites are observed, we must treat them in death as they were in life and as we too would expect to be treated ourselves once we pass.
translation: 作为拉努尔的信徒，引导他人拥抱死亡是我们的职责。确保他们度过的生命得到庆祝，留下的记忆对后代有影响和意义。为了确保死者受到尊重，他们的临终仪式得到遵守，我们必须像对待他们生前一样对待他们死后的状态，就像我们期望自己离世后得到同样的对待一样。

english: Ranul brings light to the darkness and reveals the secrets that were hidden within. Ranul teaches us that we must explore and uncover the mysteries of the world. To present the knowledge that we find to others but only as we see fit as we should not reveal secrets that would cause harm to others. While the followers of Ralos speak with confidence and decisiveness, they are often reckless and impulsive. It is our duty to play the other side of the coin and question the reason and direction for their actions so as to predict and prevent the consequences of them.
translation: 拉努尔为黑暗带来光明，揭示其中隐藏的秘密。拉努尔教导我们必须探索和揭示世界的奥秘。将我们找到的知识呈现给他人，但只在我们认为合适的时候，因为我们不应泄露会对他人造成伤害的秘密。拉洛斯的信徒说话自信果断，但他们常常鲁莽冲动。我们的职责是扮演硬币的另一面，质疑他们行动的理由和方向，以预测和防止其后果。

english: The world was nothing and began when Ralos came into being. With a burst of glorious energy which provides us with heat, light and from this, life. The power of the sun is rivaled by none. We are blessed to receive its glory during the day and we lament that we are not worthy during the night. Praise the sun.
translation: 世界原本一无所有，当拉洛斯诞生时才开始。伴随着一股辉煌的能量爆发，为我们提供了热量、光，以及由此而来的生命。太阳的力量无与伦比。我们很幸运能在白天接受它的光辉，而在夜晚我们哀叹自己不配。赞美太阳。

english: We must strive to be like Ralos during our lives. To be bold, honest, bright and brimming with positive energy. To seize opportunities, to regret not the past and to live life to the fullest. To fully commit ourselves to our goals during the daylight hours and then recuperate our lost energy during the night.
translation: 我们一生中必须努力像拉洛斯一样。要大胆、诚实、光明磊落，充满正能量。抓住机会，不后悔过去，尽情享受生活。在白天全力以赴追求目标，在夜晚恢复消耗的能量。

english: To emulate Ralos is to spread your own positive energy to as many people as possible. To provide them with sustenance, support and warmth both physically and emotionally. Ralos does so without regard for who they are or what they believe in without discrimination and so should we.
translation: 效仿拉洛斯就是将你自己的正能量传播给尽可能多的人。为他们提供物质和精神上的滋养、支持和温暖。拉洛斯不分对象、不分信仰地这样做，毫无歧视，我们也应该如此。

english: As followers of Ralos we must strive to work against those who would consume the world in darkness, those who would spread cold and negative emotions to others and harm their fellow man for to do so is to become less human. However, do not hate your enemy, lest hatred become you, instead take pity on those that cannot see the light and do your best to guide them towards it.
translation: 作为拉洛斯的信徒，我们必须努力对抗那些想要吞噬世界于黑暗的人，那些向他人传播冷漠和负面情绪、伤害同胞的人，因为这样做就是失去人性。然而，不要憎恨你的敌人，以免仇恨成为你的一部分，而应怜悯那些看不到光明的人，尽力引导他们走向光明。

translation: 修剪花园里的树篱

translation: 策划为弗里茨报仇

translation: 大库兰德王国时间线

translation: 卡莫拉·谢兹恩安息于此

english: Founder of Shayzien House.
translation: 谢兹恩家族的创始人。

english: It was on that fateful day that they met, the heroes Robert, Camorra, Tristan and Aivas. They came from across the land to sit at the round table and plan their victory. Camorra came from the town of Saranthium and sat next to the one with a crossbow. The one from Zartharim sat at the north of the table, opposite the one with the sword. The one with an axe asked the one to their right what the journey from Karville was like. Suddenly, Aivas stood up, surprising the one from Arkney on his left. Tristan was showing off his sword when the bow wielder next to him called for silence. By the end of the night the plan had been made and they prepared for the wars to come. But who sat where?
translation: 就在那个命运之日，英雄罗伯特、卡莫拉、特里斯坦和艾瓦斯相遇了。他们从各地赶来坐在圆桌旁计划他们的胜利。卡莫拉来自萨兰提姆镇，坐在持弩者旁边。来自扎萨里姆的人坐在桌子北边，正对着持剑者。持斧者问右边的人从卡维尔来的旅程如何。突然，艾瓦斯站起来，吓了左边的阿肯尼人一跳。特里斯坦正在炫耀他的剑，旁边的持弓者叫他安静。到夜晚结束时，计划已经制定好，他们为即将到来的战争做准备。但谁坐在哪里？

english: Viewing this display contains mild spoilers for the Tombs of Amascut raid which you have not completed.
translation: 查看此展示柜包含你尚未完成的阿玛斯库特之墓突袭的轻微剧透。

english: You don't appear to have any Sunfire splinter which you can use to charge your Tonalztics of Ralos.
translation: 你似乎没有任何阳火碎片可以用来给你的拉洛斯音律充能。

english: How many charges do you want to apply? (Up to <Num0>)
translation: 你想充能多少次？（最多 <Num0>）

english: You apply <Num0> charges to your Tonalztics of Ralos.
translation: 你给你的拉洛斯音律充能了 <Num0> 次。

english: Blood moon has risen over Morytania!
translation: 血月已升起在莫利塔尼亚上空！

english: This has not been our finest hour.
translation: 这不是我们最辉煌的时刻。

english: We have faced many dangers since our departure from Kourend, and every single one has been overcome. The privations of the journey to Quidamortem, the ferocious beasts that dwelt here, even the weakness and treachery of our former allies - we have survived them all, and marched on triumphantly.
translation: 自从离开库兰德王国以来，我们面临了许多危险，每一次都被克服了。前往基达莫尔滕的旅途艰辛，那里的凶猛野兽，甚至我们前盟友的软弱和背叛——我们都幸存下来，胜利前进。

english: For this we give thanks to our mighty lord, and we shall continue to serve him loyally as we explore these caverns.
translation: 为此我们感谢我们强大的主，我们将继续忠诚地侍奉他，探索这些洞穴。

english: However, I must admit this latest experiment has not been a success.
translation: 然而，我必须承认最近的实验并不成功。

english: In the caverns beneath Quidamortem, our lord sensed a disruption in the fabric of reality.
translation: 在基达莫尔滕下方的洞穴中，我们的主感应到现实织物的扰动。

english: It is known, of course, that the Dark Altar can connect to other planes of existence. That is how it sustains our runic altars, by linking Kourend to whatever far-off realms contain the true Blood and Soul Altars. However, it still surprised us to find that the same power was available here.
translation: 当然，众所周知黑暗祭坛可以连接到其他存在位面。这就是它维持我们符石祭坛的方式，通过将库兰德王国与包含真正血祭坛和灵魂祭坛的遥远领域连接起来。然而，发现这里也有同样的力量仍然让我们感到惊讶。

english: Naturally our lord sought to tap into this power - after all, it's what brought us to this cursed mountain in the first place. Unfortunately, our lord's attempt to rupture space and time was only too successful!
translation: 自然，我们的主试图利用这种力量——毕竟，这正是最初把我们带到这座被诅咒的山上的原因。不幸的是，我们的主试图撕裂空间和时间的尝试太成功了！

english: Our lord managed, with much effort, to widen the disruption until a stable portal stood before us, allowing us to see out of this world and into some other realm.
translation: 我们的主上费了很大力气，终于将裂缝扩大到足以形成一个稳定的传送门，让我们得以窥见这个世界之外的另一片天地。

english: Through the portal, we glimpsed a strange, red-hued world, where monstrous creatures lurched through the tendrils of a landscape that looked - and smelt - like the intestines of a rotting corpse.
translation: 透过传送门，我们瞥见了一个奇异的红色世界，那里有可怕的生物在触须般的风景中蹒跚而行，那景象——闻起来——就像腐烂尸体的肠子。

english: In our awe, we looked for too long, forgetting that a door opens in two directions. We could see these creatures, and they could see us.
translation: 我们敬畏地凝视太久，忘了门是双向开启的。我们能看到这些生物，它们也能看到我们。

english: Suddenly a vast form squeezed its way through the portal towards us. I have no words for it, but if a demon were to mate with a wasp, this creature would surely be the ungodly fruit of the union.
translation: 突然，一个庞大的身影挤过传送门向我们扑来。我无法用言语形容，但若恶魔与黄蜂交配，这生物必定是那亵渎的结合所生的果实。

english: We sought to drive it back with our magicks, but it seemed well protected from such attacks, and eventually our lord bade us retreat.
translation: 我们试图用魔法将其击退，但它似乎对这类攻击防护得很好，最终我们的主上命令我们撤退。

english: Some of our minor servants had to be left behind as a distraction for the creature; their sacrifice bought us time to block the chamber behind us.
translation: 我们的一些低级仆从不得不留下作为诱饵吸引那生物；他们的牺牲为我们争取了时间，封堵了身后的密室。

english: Our lord fears that our experiment has permanently ruptured the walls between the worlds - even if we can find a way to close this portal, more may open spontaneously now that the way has opened. We shall have to tread carefully in future as we explore these caverns, lest we stumble across more such portals.
translation: 我们的主上担心我们的实验已经永久性地撕裂了世界之间的壁垒——即使我们能找到关闭这个传送门的方法，既然道路已开，更多的传送门可能会自发出现。今后我们探索这些洞穴时必须格外小心，以免再遇到这样的传送门。

english: However, the ability to open these portals may prove valuable, despite our current setback. I have seen our lord defeated before, back when we were driven out of Kourend, and I know he does not accept defeat.
translation: 然而，尽管目前受挫，开启这些传送门的能力可能很有价值。我曾见过我们的主上被击败，那是在我们被逐出库兰德王国的时候，我知道他不会接受失败。

english: Just as he responded to our exile by leading us to Quidamortem in search of greater powers, I am sure he will respond to today's developments by finding a way to use them for his own purposes. After all, these portals would give us access to a limitless army of fearsome creatures, if we could find a way to control them.
translation: 正如他当年带领我们前往奎达莫特姆寻求更强大的力量来回应流放一样，我相信他也会找到方法利用今天的事态发展来达成自己的目的。毕竟，如果我们能找到控制这些传送门的方法，它们将为我们提供一支无穷无尽的可怕生物大军。

english: It's almost a shame that creature keeper died so early in the expedition - he was a fool, but his talents might have served us well here.
translation: 驯兽师在远征初期就死了，真是可惜——他是个蠢货，但他的才能在这里或许能派上用场。

english: Alternatively, if we were able to open a portal to a different place, we may even discover new worlds to conquer...
translation: 或者，如果我们能开启通往不同地方的传送门，甚至可能发现新的世界去征服……

english: But that is speculation. For now, our lord commands us to return to the chamber of the portal and the demonic wasp - perhaps he has a plan to slay the creature and take control of the portal.
translation: 但那只是猜测。目前，我们的主上命令我们返回传送门密室和那恶魔黄蜂所在之处——也许他有计划杀死那生物并控制传送门。

english: Our lord's council is smiling at me strangely as we prepare for our next battle with the creature. If I did not know better, I might suspect they were planning to use me to distract the beast, like we did with the servants before.
translation: 在我们准备与那生物的下一次战斗时，主上的议会成员们正奇怪地对我微笑。若非我了解他们，我可能会怀疑他们打算用我来引开那野兽，就像之前对待那些仆从一样。

english: However, I have served Lord Xeric loyally for many years, through good times and bad. I am sure he would never leave me to die like that.
translation: 然而，我忠诚地侍奉泽里克大人多年，历经风雨。我相信他绝不会那样抛弃我。

english: This text contains the ancient Gnome words I have managed to translate thus far.

english: This is a rough translation of the stone tablet brought to me by courier earlier today.
translation: 这是今天早些时候信使带给我的石板的粗略翻译。

english: The cuneiforms of this particular tablet are far different to anything I have previously seen in my career as an archaeological expert.
translation: 这块石板的楔形文字与我作为考古专家职业生涯中见过的任何东西都大不相同。

english: Where possible I have given as accurate a translation as possible, but some of the words I have attempted to translate hold different meanings depending upon their intonation and context; Due to my unfamiliarity with this language, I have given possible translations for these words wherever I have encountered them. Wherever I have a word in brackets, it is a word which has many meanings depending on the context, although the general meaning should be clear to even a casual study.
translation: 在可能的情况下，我给出了尽可能准确的翻译，但我尝试翻译的一些词汇根据语调和上下文有不同的含义；由于我对这种语言不熟悉，我在遇到这些词时给出了可能的翻译。凡是我用括号标注的词，都是根据上下文有多种含义的词，尽管一般含义即使随意研究也能清楚。

english: Hopefully this translation will help you in your excavations Asgarnia, and as usual I look forward to seeing what relics you bring back to the Museum of Varrock this time!
