english: In the most common forms of magic, a sufficiently skilled caster need only provide runes to power the spell.
translation: 在大多数常见的魔法形式中，技艺精湛的施法者只需提供符石来驱动法术。

english: Certain spells may require the presence of a particular artefact, but nevertheless the process is fully understood - even the most junior magicians can identify the origin and flow patterns of the power.
translation: 某些法术可能需要特定文物的存在，但即便如此，整个过程已被完全理解——即使是最初级的法师也能识别力量的来源和流动模式。

english: However, the ancient mage told us of spells in his native land that require the caster to utter 'magic words'.
translation: 然而，那位古代法师告诉我们，在他的故乡有一些法术需要施法者念出'咒语'。

english: Of particular interest is the incantation used in those lands to transport crafters to their hidden rune essence mine.
translation: 特别令人感兴趣的是，那些土地上用来将工匠传送到隐藏符文精华矿的咒语。

english: If we could identify that incantation, we might thus gain access to their mine, allowing us study the differences between their essence and ours. Regrettably, the ancient mage was unable - or unwilling - to divulge the exact words.
translation: 如果我们能识别出那个咒语，或许就能进入他们的矿场，从而研究他们的精华与我们的有何不同。遗憾的是，那位古代法师无法——或不愿——透露确切的咒语。

english: In time, we may be able to learn this incantation on our own, but the study of teleportation magicks has always been very limited throughout Kourend's history, likely due to the short supply of law runes.
translation: 随着时间的推移，我们或许能自行学会这个咒语，但传送魔法的研究在库兰德王国的历史上一直非常有限，很可能是因为律法符石供应不足。

english: Our blood and soul altars are focal points where the energy comes into this dimension from the true Blood and Soul Altars, wherever they may be. As I have written elsewhere, I believe the Dark Altar has made that energy available to us because those runes are particularly useful in the reanimation of the dead.
translation: 我们的血祭坛和灵魂祭坛是能量从真正的血祭坛和灵魂祭坛（无论它们在哪里）进入这个维度的焦点。正如我在别处所写，我相信黑暗祭坛让我们获得这些能量，是因为这些符石在复活死者方面特别有用。

english: It is, perhaps, unsettling to consider that the Dark Altar has not chosen to grant us access to runes that would be useful in teleportation.
translation: 想到黑暗祭坛没有选择赐予我们可用于传送的符石，或许令人不安。

english: Whatever agenda the Dark Altar may have, it seems it would prefer that the people of Kourend not leave these lands.
translation: 无论黑暗祭坛有何意图，它似乎更希望库兰德王国的人民不要离开这片土地。

english: We have known for the past 150 years about the possibility of turning rune essence into runes which can be used for magic. The ancient mage who visited us imparted his knowledge before he died. If we combine that with the stories that our explorers regularly tell about far off lands which have an abundance of runes we see that there are some startling differences between the creation of runes both here and in other lands.
translation: 过去150年来，我们已知晓将符文精华转化为可用于魔法的符石的可能性。来访的古代法师在去世前传授了他的知识。如果我们将此与探险家们经常讲述的关于遥远土地上符石丰富的故事结合起来，就会发现这里与其他地方在符石制造上存在一些惊人的差异。

english: We are told in far off lands that access to rune essence is guarded by magicians who teleport individuals to hidden mines to collect the essence. However, we have pillars of essence reaching into the sky.
translation: 我们听说在遥远的土地上，符文精华的获取由法师守护，他们通过传送将人们带到隐藏的矿场采集精华。然而，我们这里却有直插云霄的精华柱。

english: In order to craft the essence into runes we are told that in these far off lands special devices are needed to teleport individuals to another dimension where they can achieve this. For us, we can use energy that emanates from the ground to change our essence.
translation: 要将精华制成符石，我们听说在那些遥远的土地上需要特殊装置将人们传送到另一个维度才能完成。对我们来说，我们可以利用从地面散发出的能量来转化我们的精华。

english: One of the most mysterious differences is that none of the tales make mention of an altar such as the Dark Altar or any method of transforming essence into different stages.
translation: 最神秘的差异之一是，所有传说都没有提到像黑暗祭坛这样的祭坛，也没有提到将精华转化为不同阶段的方法。

english: If these tales are to be believed, then we must come to the conclusion that the process for us to craft essence into runes is different to how it is in other lands.
translation: 如果这些传说可信，那么我们必须得出结论，我们这里将精华制作成符石的过程与其他地方不同。

english: The next question we must ask is how the process is different.
translation: 接下来我们要问的问题是，这个过程有何不同。

english: In all the tales from the other lands there is a constant theme, teleportation. Crafters must be teleported to a hidden mine to collect essence using a series of magic words. They must also use a device which combines with a magic altar to teleport to another dimension and turn the essence into runes. Neither of these are the case here.
translation: 在其他地方的所有传说中都有一个共同的主题，传送。制作者必须被传送到一个隐藏的矿场，用一系列魔法咒语收集精华。他们还必须使用一种装置，与魔法祭坛结合，传送到另一个维度，将精华变成符石。这些在我们这里都不是这样。

english: As I mentioned earlier, there is also no mention of any structure which has the same purpose as our Dark Altar.
translation: 正如我之前提到的，也没有提到任何与我们黑暗祭坛功能相同的建筑。

english: One must conclude that in order for those in other lands to craft runes differently to us is because they don't have anything that acts as our Dark Altar.
translation: 我们必须得出结论，其他地方的人之所以能以与我们不同的方式制作符石，是因为他们没有像我们黑暗祭坛这样的东西。

english: Next we must look at why the Dark Altar does what it does.
translation: 接下来我们必须研究黑暗祭坛为何会有这样的功能。

english: In order to craft runes we must change the essence from what we mine into dark essence. The dark essence then can be used to harness the energy coming from the ground which are focussed through altars to become runes.
translation: 为了制作符石，我们必须将开采出的精华转化为黑暗精华。然后黑暗精华可以用来引导来自地面的能量，这些能量通过祭坛聚焦后变成符石。

english: The key question must now be how does this happen.
translation: 现在关键的问题是这一切是如何发生的。

english: If we look at the Dark Altar as a whole we can see that it is able to bring life out of death when reanimating corpses, corrupt individuals and break minds. I think it is no coincidence that the Dark Altar allows blood and soul runes to be created only as these are primarily needed to reanimate the dead.
translation: 如果我们整体来看黑暗祭坛，我们可以看到它能在复活尸体、腐化个体和摧毁心智时从死亡中带来生命。我认为黑暗祭坛只允许制作血符石和灵魂符石并非巧合，因为这些主要用于复活死者。

english: If the Dark Altar can alter minds and alter life then it is logical to suppose that it has the ability to change dimensions.
translation: 如果黑暗祭坛能改变心智和改变生命，那么合乎逻辑的推测是它有能力改变维度。

english: I believe the power of the Dark Altar allows the energy needed to change essence into runes to seep through to this dimension.
translation: 我相信黑暗祭坛的力量允许将精华转化为符石所需的能量渗透到这个维度。

english: By only being able to harness the essence changing power with dark essence, the Dark Altar has even more use and purpose. It is almost as if the Dark Altar has some sense of self preservation and is looking for as many ways as possible to be integral to our community and thus, gain power within it.
translation: 通过只能用黑暗精华来引导精华转化的力量，黑暗祭坛有了更多的用途和意义。这几乎就像黑暗祭坛有某种自我保护意识，在寻找尽可能多的方式成为我们社区不可或缺的一部分，从而在其中获得力量。

english: In conclusion, I believe the Dark Altar has the ability to merge power and dimensions such as life and death, sanity and insanity as well as converging the dimensions needed to craft runes.
translation: 总之，我相信黑暗祭坛有能力融合力量和维度，如生与死、理智与疯狂，以及汇聚制作符石所需的维度。

english: Albeit, with an agenda.
translation: 尽管，它有自己的目的。

english: It is generally acknowledged that the death of King Byrne III was not as straight forward as it was reported at the time. The young king was found brutally stabbed to death in his chamber by guards who after mobilising the militia conducted a thorough search of the royal compound where they found the assassin.
translation: 人们普遍认为，拜恩三世国王的死并不像当时报道的那样简单。这位年轻的国王被发现在自己的密室里被守卫发现时已被残忍刺死，守卫在动员民兵后对王室大院进行了彻底搜查，找到了刺客。

english: It is reported that the day before his trial, the assassin was killed by a guard who through grief could contain his feelings no longer. I will hope to show that there were other factors in the murder of King Byrne III.
translation: 据报道，在审判前一天，刺客被一名因悲痛而无法再控制感情的守卫杀死。我希望证明拜恩三世国王的谋杀案中还有其他因素。

english: To start, we must look at Queen Biyrene I. After the death of her husband King Byrne II she took control of the Kingdom until her son, King Byrne III came of age. It was no secret that at this time she took Lord Piscarilius as her consort who fathered her daughter Queen Biyrene II.
translation: 首先，我们必须看看拜伦一世女王。在她的丈夫拜恩二世国王去世后，她接管了王国，直到她的儿子拜恩三世国王成年。众所周知，在此期间她让皮斯卡里琉斯领主成为她的配偶，他生下了她的女儿拜伦二世女王。

english: At the time of the death of King Byrne II, Lord Piscarilius also held the position of Lord of Intelligence and as such responsible for the spy network in Kourend. This position he held until his death and was subsequently passed on to his son.
translation: 在拜恩二世国王去世时，皮斯卡里琉斯领主还担任情报领主一职，负责库兰德王国的间谍网络。他一直担任这个职位直到去世，随后传给了他的儿子。

english: It is also known that Queen Biyrene I was loathe to give up the throne to her son. As she said in her speech, 'If t'were not a requirement within the law of my departed husband, I would finish the work for this kingdom that I have started.'
translation: 众所周知，拜伦一世女王不愿将王座让给她的儿子。正如她在演讲中所说，'若非我已故丈夫法律中的要求，我会完成我为这个王国开始的工作。'

english: If we take into account Queen Biyrene I's desire to remain on the throne and her relationship with Lord Piscarilius, who had the ability to arrange an assassination through the spy network, we see an intriguing plot developing.
translation: 如果我们考虑到拜伦一世女王想留在王座上的愿望，以及她与皮斯卡里琉斯领主的关系，后者有能力通过间谍网络安排暗杀，我们就会看到一个有趣的阴谋正在形成。

english: Finally, let us look at the death of the assassin who was caught for the murder of King Byrne III. King Byrne III was a mediocre king. He was not in power long enough to create any strong sense of adoration and had not achieved anything of note during this short time. When combined with the lack of public display of the body of the assassin as would have been normal in those times, I am left with the conclusion that the death of the assassin never took place.
translation: 最后，让我们看看被抓获谋杀拜恩三世国王的刺客之死。拜恩三世国王是一位平庸的国王。他在位时间不长，不足以产生强烈的爱戴感，在这短暂的时间里也没有取得任何值得注意的成就。再加上当时正常情况下应有的公开展示刺客尸体的做法缺失，我得出的结论是刺客的死从未发生过。

english: I fled in the night as the turncloaks breached the fortress and I now find myself held up in a great hollow tree that sits amid an overgrown ruin. Tonight I shall sleep here within this tree and then move farther south - perhaps the coast has avoided destruction?
translation: 叛徒攻破堡垒那夜我趁黑逃离，如今藏身于一片荒废遗迹中巨大的空心树里。今晚我将在这树中过夜，然后继续南行——或许海岸还未遭毁灭？

english: How long has it been? I dreamt of being stuck within a tree, I've written multiple entries yet this seems to only be my second... What vile trap have I willfully climbed into? My dreams were wild and frantic - I first listened in darkness, unable to move or speak, as the town around me was rebuilt for the hundredth time. After that my voice slowly came back to me and as I groaned in the dim light an old woman responded to my drawn out calls in a low rumble, with questions of sacrifice and blood. Visions floated before me just before I awoke. A shadow of a man passed into a tree and a young woman in a red cloak went by leaving a trail of blood.
translation: 过了多久了？我梦见自己困在树中，写了许多篇日记却似乎只有这第二篇……我究竟自愿爬进了什么邪恶的陷阱？我的梦境狂乱而激烈——起初我在黑暗中倾听，无法动弹也无法言语，周围的城镇第一百次被重建。之后我的声音慢慢恢复，在昏暗的光线中呻吟时，一位老妇人用低沉的嗓音回应我拉长的呼唤，问及祭品与鲜血。就在我醒来前，幻象浮现眼前。一个男人的影子没入树中，一位披着红斗篷的年轻女子走过，留下一道血迹。

english: As my dreams continue they become clearer and much harder to distinguish from reality. I've become one with the tree and its perception of the natural world is far beyond my own. Today I spoke with a young girl who had come from the south, beyond the Humblethorn wood. She looked quite astonished at first, as to be expected as trees rarely spoke with humans. She wondered how a man becomes armoured within a tree like I am and how long I'd been living like that. Why, now that I think about it the weeds seem less lively now, as if growing in reverse. The young girl started to dance around the tree while dressed in silk robes, the moon sat in the sky a harsh crescent drinking in the scene before the great hollow tree. The taste of blood and ash still lingers many moons later.
translation: 随着梦境延续，它们变得愈发清晰，也越来越难与现实区分。我已与树合为一体，它对自然世界的感知远超于我。今天我遇到一位来自南方谦刺林之外的少女。她起初显得十分惊讶，毕竟树很少与人交谈。她好奇一个人如何像我这样被包裹在树中，以及我这样生活了多久。说起来，现在想来那些杂草似乎不再那么有生气了，仿佛在逆向生长。少女身着丝绸长袍开始在树旁起舞，天空中的月亮如锋利的弯钩，将这一幕尽收眼底。血与灰烬的味道在许多个月亮之后依然萦绕不去。

english: The moon dies and is reborn over and over and my time within the tree feels like an eternity as ages come and go. War springs up around me time and time again, winged shadows fill the air, 7 heroes, no... 6 heroes, bright lights take flight as a young man fights a horde of horrific demons. Finally it turns to scenes of fire and blood sacrifice as faint screams of ancient forest dwellers echo throughout my branches.
translation: 月亮一次次死去又重生，我在树中的时光仿佛永恒，时代更迭不息。战争在我周围一次次爆发，带翼的阴影遮蔽天空，七位英雄，不……六位英雄，耀眼的光芒腾空而起，一位年轻人对抗着成群的可怖恶魔。最终一切化为火焰与血祭的景象，远古森林居民的微弱尖叫声在我的枝干间回荡。

english: I prayed this day would never come, but Wahisietel himself arrived today to confirm it. The Holy City of Senntisten has fallen. The Duke has ordered us to retreat to the refugee camp within the prison. The elders claim it's just a precaution, but we all know the truth. The fight for the Empire is over. Now we fight for survival.
translation: 我祈祷这一天永远不会到来，但瓦希西特尔本人今日亲自前来证实了此事。圣城森特斯坦已经陷落。公爵下令我们撤退到监狱内的难民营。长老们声称这只是预防措施，但我们都知道真相。帝国的战斗已经结束。现在我们为生存而战。

english: I will not live out my days cowering in fear. The Empire has failed us, and it's time to make our own path. I intend to travel far from here, and while I know the chances are slim, I pray you can one day join me. If you do ever return, and if you do find this letter, I have hidden the things you need to find me within the dungeon outside the prison. This letter is the key to finding them.
translation: 我不会在恐惧中度过余生。帝国辜负了我们，是时候走自己的路了。我打算远行此地，虽然我知道机会渺茫，但我祈祷有朝一日你能与我相聚。若你归来，若你找到这封信，我将你所需之物藏在了监狱外的地牢中。这封信是找到它们的钥匙。

english: Although it has been many years since the fighting ended, the war with Varlamore remains fresh in the minds of Kourend's people. The betrayal of Emperor Imafore is hard to forget and it is likely that this mistrust will continue for numerous lifetimes.
translation: 虽然战斗结束已多年，但与瓦拉莫尔的战争在库伦德人民心中依然记忆犹新。伊马福尔皇帝的背叛难以忘怀，这种不信任很可能将持续数代之久。

english: In the hope of repairing the relationship with Varlamore, King Kharedst III ordered an envoy be sent to the Shining Kingdom. However, the envoy is not all that was sent.
translation: 为了修复与瓦拉莫尔的关系，卡雷德斯特三世国王下令派遣使节前往光辉王国。然而，派出的不仅仅是使节。

english: For over one hundred decades the original Royal Accord of Twill was kept safe within the Historical Archive of Kourend. The Accord survived the Long Winter, the Age of Strife and the War of the Five Houses but it did not survive the foolishness of our great King Kharedst.
translation: 一百多年来，特威尔皇家协议一直安全保存在库兰德王国的历史档案馆中。这份协议历经了漫长寒冬、纷争时代和五大家族之战，却没能逃过我们伟大的卡雷德斯特国王的愚蠢。

english: Despite the protests of many, the King insisted that the Accord be taken with the envoy to Varlamore to be displayed in the Grand Museum of Civitas illa Fortis. Alas, the Accord never made it to Varlamore.
translation: 尽管许多人反对，国王仍坚持将协议随使节团带往瓦拉莫尔，在福蒂斯城的大博物馆展出。可惜，协议从未抵达瓦拉莫尔。

english: It was day 1,372 of the 135th decade when they departed. They left by ship from Port Piscarilius for the week long journey to the Civitas Port.
translation: 他们出发时是第135个十年的第1,372天。他们从皮斯卡里琉斯港乘船出发，开始了前往西维塔斯港为期一周的旅程。

english: Less than half way into the journey, disaster struck. The ship was travelling off the south coast of Kourend, when it was caught up in a great storm. The ship, the crew and the Accord itself were all lost beneath the waves. The only survivor was the envoy himself, saved by some passing fishermen.
translation: 航程不到一半时，灾难降临了。船只在库兰德王国南海岸航行时遭遇了巨大的风暴。船只、船员和协议本身都沉入了波涛之下。唯一的幸存者就是使节本人，被路过的渔民救起。

english: Following the loss of the Accord, the King ordered a great search be conducted in an attempt to recover it. For over fourty years, searches were conducted both above and below the waves in an attempt to find the Accord. Despite the efforts of many, it was never found.
translation: 协议丢失后，国王下令进行大规模搜索以试图找回它。四十多年来，人们在海面上下进行了无数次搜索，试图找到协议。尽管许多人付出了努力，却始终未能找到。

english: Many years later, rulership of Kourend was transferred to the Kourend Council. Not long after the Council took over, the search for the Accord was finally called off.
translation: 多年后，库兰德的统治权移交给了库兰德议会。议会接管后不久，对协议的搜索终于被叫停。

english: Over time, the Accord was mostly forgotten, but there were still some who desired to see it return to Kourend. Many years after the search ended, a new lead was found. Not far from Land's End, a set of caves were discovered that led deep below the sea.
translation: 随着时间流逝，协议大多被遗忘，但仍有一些人希望看到它回归库兰德。搜索结束多年后，一条新的线索出现了。在兰兹角村不远处，发现了一组通往海底深处的洞穴。

english: Those searching for the Accord theorised that the ship may have sunk beneath the seabed and into the caves below. They assembled a search party and entered the caves.
translation: 搜索协议的人们推测船只可能沉入海床，坠入了下方的洞穴中。他们组建了一支搜索队进入了洞穴。

english: Alas, the search party consisted of historians, not adventurers. They were poorly equipped to face the perils of those caves. Of those who entered, only two returned, and the search for the Accord was once again over.
translation: 可惜，搜索队由历史学家组成，而非冒险者。他们装备不足，无法面对那些洞穴中的危险。进入的人中只有两人返回，对协议的搜索再次宣告结束。

english: Perhaps it is meant to be this way, perhaps the Accord was meant to stay lost. However, this may not be the end of the story. All it would need is for an adventurer to enter those caves and reach the bottom and the Accord may yet return to Kourend.
translation: 也许这就是天意，也许协议注定要遗失。然而，这可能不是故事的结局。只需要一位冒险者进入那些洞穴，到达最深处，协议或许就能重返库兰德。

english: Learn ye, reader, of the wrath of our Lord Xeric.
translation: 读者啊，请了解我们主上泽里克大人的愤怒。

english: Learn ye of the punishment that awaits those who fail him.
translation: 请了解那些令他失望之人所等待的惩罚。

english: Learn ye of the Judgement of the Vanguard.
translation: 请了解先锋队的审判。

english: Our Lord Xeric forgives not, nor does he forget; learn ye to serve him with fear!
translation: 我们主上泽里克不宽恕，也不遗忘；你要学会心怀敬畏地侍奉他！

english: The penalty for failure is immense; do not risk suffering the same fate as the Vanguard.
translation: 失败的代价是巨大的；不要冒险承受与先锋队相同的命运。

english: In our time in Kourend, along with his own magical power, Lord Xeric had a mighty army at his command, enforcing his rule over the people.
translation: 在库兰德期间，泽里克大人除了自身魔力之外，还拥有一支强大的军队听候调遣，以武力统治着人民。

english: Whenever traitors muttered against our Lord, his troops would ravage their homes in the dead of night, arresting anyone suspected of disloyalty or rebellion.
translation: 每当有叛徒私下议论我们主上，他的军队就会在深夜洗劫他们的家园，逮捕任何涉嫌不忠或叛乱的人。

english: Under questioning by the commanders, who were empowered to use any interrogation techniques they deemed necessary in Lord Xeric's service, the traitors would inevitably reveal more suspects for the troops to arrest.
translation: 在指挥官们的审讯下——他们被授权在泽里克大人的服务中使用任何他们认为必要的审讯手段——叛徒们不可避免地会供出更多嫌疑人供军队逮捕。

english: Thus the power of our Lord Xeric was maintained over his people. The most prominent commanders of Lord Xeric's army were known as the Vanguard, three elite officers who rose quickly through the ranks. Their cunning on the battlefield, their ruthlessness in the interrogation chambers and their loyalty to our Lord were exemplary.
translation: 就这样，泽里克大人对人民的统治得以维持。泽里克军队中最杰出的指挥官被称为先锋队，三位迅速晋升的精英军官。他们在战场上的狡诈、审讯室中的冷酷以及对主上的忠诚都堪称典范。

english: Each of the Vanguard was proficient in a different form of combat, and when the three stood together, none could prevail against their united power because they would share their strength to protect each other. For their successes in his service, Lord Xeric rewarded them with the command of his army.
translation: 先锋队每位成员精通不同的战斗方式，当三人并肩而立时，无人能战胜他们联合的力量，因为他们会分享力量互相保护。由于他们在服务中的功绩，泽里克大人赐予他们军队的指挥权。

english: Then came the fall. A proletarian uprising caught the army by surprise. Had the Vanguard performed their duty, perhaps disaster would have been averted, and Lord Xeric would have remained on the throne of Kourend. However, even the legendary Vanguard were frail.
translation: 然后，败落来临了。一场无产阶级起义打了军队一个措手不及。如果先锋队履行了职责，也许灾难本可避免，泽里克大人也能继续坐在库兰德的王座上。然而，即便是传奇的先锋队也是脆弱的。

english: As their troops were slaughtered around them by the rage of the proletariat, the Vanguard fled the kingdom to protect their own skins.
translation: 当他们的士兵在无产阶级的怒火中惨遭屠杀时，先锋队为了自保逃离了王国。

english: Lord Xeric took note of their retreat, and I witnessed him vow that their fate would be worse than if they had stayed to die serving him.
translation: 泽里克大人注意到了他们的撤退，我亲眼见证他发誓他们的命运将比留下来为他战死更悲惨。

english: Lord Xeric's word is not given lightly; I shuddered to think of what would befall the Vanguard when we found them.
translation: 泽里克大人从不轻言；想到我们找到先锋队时他们将遭遇什么，我不禁不寒而栗。

english: Even as we marched away from Kourend ourselves, I was sure he would carry out his word and exact vengeance on the Vanguard.
translation: 即使在我们自己撤离库兰德时，我确信他会兑现诺言，对先锋队施以报复。

english: In time, Lord Xeric led us to Mount Quidamortem, and we established our new settlement within its caverns.
translation: 后来，泽里克大人带领我们来到奎达莫特姆山，我们在其洞穴中建立了新的定居点。

english: As our Lord studied the secrets of the mountain, and the crystals within its depths, his power increased, bringing great cheer to those of us who still survived to serve him.
translation: 当主上研究山中的秘密以及深处的晶体时，他的力量不断增强，给我们这些仍幸存侍奉他的人带来了极大的欢欣。

english: Then, one day, our sentinels reported movement on the flanks of the mountain. It was the Vanguard. They had heard of our new settlement on Mount Quidamortem, and had come to re-pledge their allegiance to our Lord.
translation: 然后有一天，我们的哨兵报告山侧有动静。是先锋队。他们听说了我们在奎达莫特姆山的新定居点，前来重新宣誓效忠主上。

english: Their apology was abject, I will admit. They admitted that they had fled the battle, abandoning their duty to Lord Xeric. They pledged that they would never fail him again, if he would take them back into his service.
translation: 我承认，他们的道歉极其卑微。他们承认逃离了战场，背弃了对泽里克大人的职责。他们发誓如果再被接纳，绝不会再次让他失望。

english: I waited for Lord Xeric to vent his wrath upon them. But he did not. Instead he welcomed the Vanguard, letting them approach his presence - an honour granted only to his most trusted servants. He bade us deck them in fine clothes and set out a feast in their honour, as though they were his long-lost kin rather than traitors who had failed him.
translation: 我等待着泽里克大人对他们发泄怒火。但他没有。相反，他欢迎了先锋队，允许他们接近他——这是只赐予他最信任仆人的荣誉。他吩咐我们为他们穿上精布衣裳，为他们设宴庆贺，仿佛他们是失散多年的亲人，而非背叛过他的叛徒。

english: I confess I almost came to doubt the wisdom of Lord Xeric - how could he stomach the presence of such craven turncoats, let alone grant them such honour?
translation: 我承认我几乎开始怀疑泽里克大人的智慧——他怎么能容忍如此懦弱的叛徒出现在面前，甚至赐予他们如此荣誉？

english: But the wisdom of Lord Xeric had not failed, nor had his memory.
translation: 但泽里克大人的智慧没有失效，他的记忆也没有。

english: Lord Xeric invited the Vanguard to enter the caverns with him, so that he could imbue them with the same power that he could now draw from the crystals of the mountain. He allowed me to follow, as a witness.
translation: 泽里克大人邀请先锋队随他进入洞穴，以便将他现在能从山中晶体汲取的力量灌注给他们。他允许我跟随，作为见证者。

english: We travelled through the caverns to a fiery chamber, where glowing lava reflected off the facets of a hundred orange crystals. Once there, Lord Xeric invited the Vanguard to lower their defences so he could instil into them the power of the crystals.
translation: 我们穿过洞穴来到一个炽热的密室，发光的熔岩映照在数百颗橙色晶体的切面上。到达后，泽里克大人邀请先锋队放下防御，以便他将晶体的力量注入他们体内。

english: I watched in distaste as the traitors reached out to accept the power - power that had never been offered to me.
translation: 我厌恶地看着这些叛徒伸手接受力量——那从未赐予过我的力量。

english: Instead, I saw our Lord's expression change. The sickly benevolence in his eyes was replaced with bloodshot wrath, and his face contorted into a sneer of derision. The Vanguard realised that they had been tricked - but it was too late.
translation: 然而，我看到主上的表情变了。他眼中病态的仁慈被血红的愤怒取代，面容扭曲成轻蔑的冷笑。先锋队意识到自己被骗了——但为时已晚。

english: Their grasping hands twisted. Their legs buckled. Their skin glowed, as if the heat of the chamber's lava had set their blood to boiling. From their mouths came a ghastly bubbling scream that rapidly died away as their ruined bodies collapsed to the ground. But that was not the end.
translation: 他们伸出的手扭曲了。他们的腿弯曲了。他们的皮肤发光，仿佛密室熔岩的热量让他们的血液沸腾了。他们口中发出可怕的冒泡尖叫，随着残破的身体倒地，声音迅速消失。但这还不是结束。

english: Lord Xeric waved a hand in a curious gesture, and I felt a magical wave emanating from the crystals of the chamber. Writhing on the ground, the Vanguard began to melt and re-form into new shapes.
translation: 泽里克大人挥了挥手，做出一个奇特的姿势，我感到一股魔法波动从密室的晶体中散发出来。在地上扭动的先锋队开始融化并重新塑形。

english: You failed me.
translation: 你们让我失望了。

english: You crawled away from my service to save your skins.
translation: 你们为了保命，从我麾下逃走了。

english: Know, now, that I do not forgive such failure. I do not forget such failure.
translation: 现在你们要知道，我不会原谅这样的失败。我也不会忘记这样的失败。

english: Had you fled to the ends of the world, my vengeance would have pursued you.
translation: 就算你们逃到天涯海角，我的复仇也会追上你们。

english: Had you taken your own sorry lives to escape my wrath, even beyond the gates of death my revenge would have come upon you.
translation: 就算你们以死逃避我的怒火，哪怕越过死亡之门，我的报复也会降临到你们头上。

english: Instead you came to grovel at my feet, snivelling and begging to be taken back.
translation: 可你们却来我脚下摇尾乞怜，哭哭啼啼地求我收留。

english: Your apology is not accepted.
translation: 你们的道歉，我不接受。

english: Now you can serve me in your new forms.
translation: 现在，你们将以新的形态为我效力。

english: In life you stood united, and you betrayed me. Now I grant you an un-life, standing united as before, but bound to the crystals of my caverns so you cannot fail me again.
translation: 生前你们团结一致，却背叛了我。现在我赐予你们不死之身，依旧团结如初，但被束缚在我洞穴的水晶之上，这样你们就无法再让我失望了。

english: Guard my chambers, protect my secrets until the end of time.
translation: 守护我的密室，保守我的秘密，直到时间的尽头。

english: Lord Xeric led me away from that terrible place. I could not speak. I could hardly walk, but I dared not show weakness before my Lord.
translation: 泽里克大人带我离开了那个可怕的地方。我说不出话，几乎走不动路，但我不敢在大人面前显露软弱。

english: But Lord Xeric spoke to me. He knew of the doubts I had harboured, he knew how I had felt when I believed he was welcoming the Vanguard back.
translation: 但泽里克大人对我说话了。他知道我心中的疑虑，他知道当我以为他在欢迎先锋队回来时我的感受。

english: And my Lord understood. He knew I would not doubt him again. (I never have.)
translation: 我的大人理解我。他知道我不会再怀疑他了。（我从未怀疑过。）

english: That day, Lord Xeric bade me record all that I had seen of the Judgement of the Vanguard. My record is to stand as a testimonial to his wrath and his vengeance. I have written it down faithfully.
translation: 那天，泽里克大人命我记录下我所见到的先锋队审判的一切。我的记录将作为他怒火与复仇的见证。我已忠实地写了下来。

english: So now you have read to the end, reader, learn ye from what I have recorded here.
translation: 所以现在你读到了结尾，读者啊，从我所记录的文字中汲取教训吧。

english: Learn ye that, if you must choose between serving Lord Xeric and saving your own skin, our Lord will not forgive those who choose poorly.
translation: 你要明白，如果在效忠泽里克大人和保全自己之间必须做出选择，我们的主人不会原谅那些选错的人。

english: Learn ye from the fate of the Vanguard. And, if ye fail to learn... upon your own head be your fate.
translation: 从先锋队的命运中汲取教训吧。如果你学不会……那后果自负。

english: For years we have waited and at last, our time to rise has come. Soon, we will bring terror to the Fremennik Province. Go forth brothers and sisters. Go forth and wreak havoc amongst their people. Once they are distracted, we will tear down the walls that hold our king. We will finally free the Jormungand! The time is ours. They will be unprepared. Their ban on magic shall be their downfall. They have no champion to defend them this time. No V.
translation: 我们等待了多年，终于，我们崛起的时刻来临了。很快，我们将给费明尼克省带来恐惧。去吧，兄弟姐妹们。去吧，在他们中间制造混乱。一旦他们分心，我们就能推倒囚禁我们国王的城墙。我们终将释放耶梦加得！时机属于我们。他们毫无防备。他们对魔法的禁令将是他们的败因。这次他们没有守护者来保卫他们。没有V。

english: You have been given a casket!
translation: 你获得了一个宝箱！

english: Human forces are on the move. We don't know how they found the island, but that is irrelevant now. Luckily for us, the new facility is ready. I've ordered that all important materials be transported there at once. In the meantime, I intend to provide the humans with a little distraction. Seems like the vorkath will still have a use after all.
translation: 人类军队正在行动。我们不知道他们是怎么找到这座岛的，但现在这已经不重要了。幸运的是，新设施已经准备好了。我已下令将所有重要物资立即运往那里。与此同时，我打算给人类一点小小的干扰。看来沃卡斯终究还是有用的。

english: Could it be? A bold adventurer! Please, you must help us!
translation: 难道是？一位勇敢的冒险者！请务必帮帮我们！

english: What is it? What's the problem?
translation: 怎么了？出什么事了？

english: It's the evil vampyre, Count Draynor! For too long he's terrorised us from his manor to the north. Someone finally needs to put a stop to him once and for all!
translation: 是那个邪恶的吸血鬼，德雷诺伯爵！他长久以来从北边的庄园恐吓我们。终于需要有人来彻底终结他了！

english: Sounds like a job for me. Where should I start?
translation: 听起来正适合我。我该从哪里开始？

english: Oh, thank goodness! I've been hoping this day would come for a long time, so I've made sure to do my research. I've heard of a retired vampyre hunter called Dr Harlow who lives in Varrock.
translation: 哦，谢天谢地！我一直在盼着这一天，所以做了不少研究。我听说有个退休的吸血鬼猎人叫哈洛博士，住在维洛克城。

english: If you speak to him, I'm sure he'll be able to help. I hear he's a bit of an old soak these days, so he spends most of his time in the Blue Moon Inn.
translation: 如果你去找他，我相信他一定能帮上忙。听说他现在有点老酒鬼的样子，大部分时间都泡在蓝月酒馆里。

english: What else can you tell me about this vampyre?
translation: 关于这个吸血鬼，你还能告诉我什么？

english: All sorts of things! I've studied the legends extensively!
translation: 各种事情！我深入研究过那些传说！

english: Wait... legends? What do you mean legends?
translation: 等等……传说？你什么意思，传说？

english: The legends of Count Draynor! It's said that long ago, he travelled here from dark lands in the east. He built Draynor Manor, and from there he began his campaign of darkness against our peaceful lands!
translation: 德雷诺伯爵的传说！据说很久以前，他从东方的黑暗之地来到这里。他建造了德雷诺庄园，从那里开始了对我们这片和平土地的黑暗征伐！

english: Long ago? If this has been going on for so long, why has no one tried to stop him?
translation: 很久以前？如果这事持续了这么久，为什么没人去阻止他？

english: Many have tried. All have failed. Vampyres are not killed easily. Only those with the right skills and equipment have any hope of slaying one.
translation: 很多人试过。都失败了。吸血鬼不是那么容易杀死的。只有拥有正确技能和装备的人才有希望杀死一个。

english: Like this Dr Harlow? Home come he's never tried to kill this Count Draynor?
translation: 比如这位哈洛博士？那他为什么从来没去杀德雷诺伯爵？

english: I'm... not sure. Perhaps he was always too busy killing other vampyres?
translation: 我……不确定。也许他一直忙着杀其他吸血鬼？

english: Hmm... Something seems amiss here. Are you sure you're telling me everything?
translation: 嗯……这里似乎有些不对劲。你确定你把所有事情都告诉我了吗？

english: Well... it is true that some claim Count Draynor hasn't left his manor for generations now.
translation: 嗯……确实有人说德雷诺伯爵已经好几代没离开过他的庄园了。

english: So he's not actually attacked the village?
translation: 所以他实际上并没有袭击过村子？

english: Er... no. At least, not for a long time! He used to though!
translation: 呃……没有。至少很久没有了！但他以前确实袭击过！

english: Well... not since I've moved here at least.
translation: 嗯……至少自从我搬来这里就没有了。

english: So if there's no actual danger, why are you so keen for someone to kill this vampyre?
translation: 那既然没有实际危险，你为什么这么急着要人去杀这个吸血鬼？

english: Because what if he does start attacking again? Are we just meant to live our lives constantly fearing the future?
translation: 因为万一他又开始袭击了呢？难道我们就该活在恐惧中，时刻担心未来吗？

english: It doesn't really sound like anyone is living in fear apart from you.
translation: 听起来除了你之外，好像没人真的活在恐惧中。

english: More fool them! Count Draynor has cast a shadow over Draynor Village for generations. They even named the place after him for Saradomin's sake!
translation: 他们太傻了！德雷诺伯爵几代人都给德雷诺村投下了阴影。看在萨拉多明的份上，他们甚至用他的名字给这个地方命名！

english: Even if the people here don't realise it, we will never be at peace until we know he's dead!
translation: 就算这里的人没意识到，但除非我们知道他死了，否则我们永远不会安宁！

english: If you're sure... I guess I'll go and see this Dr Harlow.
translation: 如果你确定的话……我想我会去见见这位哈洛博士。

english: Thank you, brave adventurer.
translation: 谢谢你，勇敢的冒险者。

english: Alright, I'll see about paying him a visit.
translation: 好吧，我会考虑去拜访他一下。

english: An evil vampyre? I don't think this is the job for me. It sounds far too scary!
translation: 邪恶的吸血鬼？我觉得这活儿不适合我。听起来太吓人了！

english: I understand... Hopefully someone else will come along to finally save us from this evil.
translation: 我理解……希望有人能来最终拯救我们脱离这邪恶。

english: Adventurer! Has Count Draynor been dealt with yet?
translation: 冒险者！德雷诺伯爵解决了吗？

english: Please hurry! I'm sure Dr Harlow in Varrock's Blue Moon Inn can help.
translation: 请快点！我相信维洛克蓝月旅馆的哈洛博士能帮忙。

english: What else can you tell me about Count Draynor?
translation: 你还能告诉我关于德雷诺伯爵的什么？

english: I need your help dealing with a vampyre.
translation: 我需要你帮忙对付一个吸血鬼。

english: A vampyre you shhay...?
translation: 一个吸血鬼，你说说……？

english: Not just any vampyre. Count Draynor.
translation: 不是普通的吸血鬼。是德雷诺伯爵。

english: Draynor? Well, buy me a beer firsht...
translation: 德雷诺？好吧，先请我喝杯啤酒……

english: Are you sure you've not had enough?
translation: 你确定你还没喝够？

english: Huh? No, I don't think ssho. Now, buy ush a beer.
translation: 嗯？不，我觉得没喝够。现在，请我喝杯啤酒。

english: Have yoush got me a beer?
translation: 你给我买啤酒了吗？

english: Now, about Count Draynor...
translation: 现在，说说德雷诺伯爵……

english: Yesh, Count Draynor! The evil nashty vampyre that no one's ever sheen! Every nowsh and then, some adventurer... theysh go and try to kill him, but none of 'em ever comesh back.
translation: 是的，德雷诺伯爵！那个没人见过的邪恶吸血鬼！时不时有些冒险者……他们去试着杀他，但没一个能回来。

english: You want to havesh a go? Then don't be likesh them! Be prepared! Vampyres... Theysh hard to kill. Some... maybe imposhible.
translation: 你想试试？那就别像他们一样！做好准备！吸血鬼……很难杀死。有些……也许根本杀不死。

english: So how do I make sure I'm prepared?
translation: 那我怎么确保自己做好准备？

english: Most vampyres regenerate. Yoush need to stop them. I knowsh a few ways, but the easiest ish a stake. Here, You can havesh thish one.
translation: 大多数吸血鬼都能再生。你得阻止他们。我知道几种方法，但最简单的是木桩。给你，这个你可以拿去。

english: Takesh that to Draynor Manor. Find the vampyre inshide and show him what for! When hesh weak, use a hammer to drive the stake in! Mosht general stores have them.
translation: 拿着它去德雷诺庄园。找到里面的吸血鬼，让他见识见识！等他虚弱时，用锤子把木桩钉进去！大多数杂货店都有锤子。

english: Oh, and yoush should take some garlic with you as well. Vampyres don't likesh garlic.
translation: 哦，你还应该带些大蒜。吸血鬼不喜欢大蒜。

english: Garlic? Hmm... I'll see if Morgan knows where I can get some.
translation: 大蒜？嗯……我去看看摩根知不知道哪里能弄到。

english: You said no one's ever seen Count Draynor?
translation: 你说没人见过德雷诺伯爵？

english: No, butsh every now and then someonesh tried to kill him.
translation: 没见过，但时不时有人试着去杀他。

english: Yesh, I'd say so.
translation: 是的，我会这么说。

english: So why does he never leave his manor?
translation: 那他为什么从不离开庄园？

english: Who knowsh. Most likely he's grown too weak to do ssho.
translation: 谁知道呢。很可能他已经太虚弱了，没法离开。

english: Weak? So he shouldn't be too hard to kill then?
translation: 虚弱？那他不应该太难杀吧？

english: Even a weak vampyre ish very dangerous. Just go ashk those other adventurers thatsh never came back.
translation: 就算虚弱的吸血鬼也非常危险。去问问那些没回来的冒险者就知道了。

english: Go to Draynor Manor. Find the vampyre inshide and show him what for! When hesh weak, use a hammer to drive that stake I gave you in! Mosht general stores have them.
translation: 去德雷诺庄园。找到里面的吸血鬼，让他见识见识！等他虚弱时，用锤子把我给你的木桩钉进去！大多数杂货店都有锤子。

english: So you were once a proper vampyre hunter?
translation: 所以你曾经是个真正的吸血鬼猎人？

english: Yesh! I travelled their homeland to the easht. Morytania! I killed lotsh of vampyres over there!
translation: 是的！我游历过他们东边的故乡。莫利塔尼亚！我在那里杀过很多吸血鬼！

english: What was the most dangerous vampyre you killed?
translation: 你杀过最危险的吸血鬼是什么？

english: Dangerous? Oh, well... Ish never killed one of the really dangerous ones.
translation: 危险的？哦，嗯……我从没杀过真正危险的那种。

english: Can't. Theysh too strong. Nothing cansh hurt them.
translation: 杀不了。他们太强了。没什么能伤害他们。

english: Oh... But what if Count Draynor's like that?
translation: 哦……但如果德雷诺伯爵也是那样呢？

english: Yoush don't get many vampyres around here. Pretty much none, actshually. There's speshial magic that stops them coming over here. Any that are here... theysh weak... and trapped.
translation: 这附近可没多少吸血鬼。基本上一个都没有。有特殊的魔法阻止他们过来。就算有...也都是弱的...被困住的。

english: So how come you've never tried to kill him yourself?
translation: 那你为什么没试过自己杀了他？

english: Why bother? Hesh not killed anyone in a long time, so no one really caresh about him that much, apart from the odd adventurer thatsh looking to prove themshelves.
translation: 何必呢？他很久没杀过人了，所以没人在乎他，除了那些想证明自己的冒险者。

english: Good luck, matey...
translation: 祝你好运，伙计...

english: No. I think you've had enough.
translation: 不，我觉得你喝够了。

english: No help for yoush then.
translation: 那就帮不了你了。

english: Yoush back! Killed that vampyre yet?
translation: 你回来了！杀了那个吸血鬼没？

english: No. I lost that stake you gave me.
translation: 没有，我弄丢了你给我的那根木桩。

english: Oh, hangsh on then...
translation: 哦，那等等...

english: Good job I've gotsh some spares. Now, takesh that to Draynor Manor. Find the vampyre inshide and show him what for! When hesh weak, use a hammer to drive the stake in! Mosht general stores have them.
translation: 还好我有备用的。拿着这个去德雷诺庄园。找到里面的吸血鬼，让他见识见识！等他虚弱的时候，用锤子把木桩钉进去！大多数杂货店都有卖锤子。

english: Not yet. I'd best get going.
translation: 还没，我最好赶紧去了。

english: I'm still working on it, but I could use some garlic to help me out.
translation: 还在想办法，但我需要一些大蒜来帮忙。

english: Ah, yes! I heard vampyres didn't like garlic. I keep some in the cupboard upstairs, just in case Count Draynor comes and tries anything!
translation: 啊，对！我听说吸血鬼不喜欢大蒜。我楼上橱柜里放了一些，以防德雷诺伯爵来搞事！

english: Good luck in Draynor Manor, adventurer.
translation: 祝你在德雷诺庄园好运，冒险者。

english: The vampyre seems to be weakened by the garlic you're carrying.
translation: 你带着的大蒜似乎让吸血鬼变弱了。

english: I am pleased to confirm that the Kingdom of Varlamore is now open to visitors. On behalf of Crown Prince Itzla Arkan, I would like to extend you a personal invitation to visit our home. If you wish to accept this offer, please join me outside Varrock's eastern gates.
translation: 我很高兴地确认，瓦拉莫尔王国现已对游客开放。我代表伊茨拉.阿坎王储，诚挚邀请您来我们这里做客。如果您愿意接受这个邀请，请到瓦罗克东门外与我汇合。

english: Two great warriors, joined by hand,
translation: 两位伟大的战士，携手并肩，

english: In Zamorak's name, now two are one.
translation: 以萨莫拉克之名，如今二合为一。

english: The weak deserve to die,
translation: 弱者当死，

english: So the strong may flourish.
translation: 强者方能繁荣。

english: This is the creed of Zamorak.
translation: 这就是萨莫拉克的信条。

english: May your bloodthirst never be sated,
translation: 愿你的嗜血永不满足，

english: Zamorak bring you strength.
translation: 萨莫拉克赐你力量。

english: There is no opinion that cannot be proven true...
translation: 没有哪种观点是无法被证明为真的...

english: Zamorak give me strength!
translation: 萨莫拉克赐我力量！

english: Slurp...
translation: 咕噜...

english: Slurrrrrrrrp...
translation: 咕噜噜噜噜噜...

english: I am the snail master.
translation: 我是蜗牛大师。

english: I'm just a regular snail... How could this be?!
translation: 我只是一只普通的蜗牛...这怎么可能？！

english: I have been asked by Verzik herself to look into a minor illness. She believes it was caused by the bite of a nylocas. Verzik has requested absolute privacy in this matter. As such, I am seeing her in her personal chambers in Ver Sinhaza.
translation: 维齐克亲自委托我调查一种小病。她认为是被尼洛卡斯蛛咬伤所致。维齐克要求此事绝对保密。因此，我将在维辛哈扎她的私人房间见她。

english: Verzik claims to have been suffering from a fever for the past few days. She says that this started not long after she was bitten by one of her nylocas. The nylocas in question was a new variant, the result of her extensive breeding program. However, the nylocas died not long after biting Verzik and as such cannot be examined.
translation: 维齐克声称过去几天一直发烧。她说这是被她的一只尼洛卡斯蛛咬伤后不久开始的。那只尼洛卡斯蛛是她大规模繁殖计划产生的新变种。然而，那只尼洛卡斯蛛在咬了维齐克后不久就死了，因此无法进行检查。

english: After a quick inspection, I can confirm that Verzik is suffering from a slight fever, something that isn't uncommon in vampyres. I have prescribed a guam potion that should help it clear up.
translation: 经过快速检查，我可以确认维齐克有轻微发烧，这在吸血鬼中并不罕见。我给她开了瓜姆药水，应该能帮助退烧。

english: I have been asked to return to Ver Sinhaza to see Verzik again. Although she has been taking the guam potion for a week, her condition has actually deteriorated rather than improved.
translation: 我被要求返回维辛哈扎再次查看维齐克。虽然她服用瓜姆药水已经一周了，但她的病情不但没有好转，反而恶化了。

english: An obvious change during this visit is the apparent weight gained since I last saw her. She claims this is due to the illness preventing her from exercising. However, I am concerned over how rapid the increase has been.
translation: 这次探访中一个明显的变化是她自上次见面以来明显发胖了。她声称这是因为疾病让她无法锻炼。然而，我对体重增长的速度感到担忧。

english: I have decided to run a few more tests on Verzik to try and determine the cause of her illness. I will have the results of these in a few days. Once I have them, we can determine a suitable course of action.
translation: 我决定对维齐克再做几项检查，试图确定她生病的原因。几天后就会有结果。一旦拿到结果，我们就能确定合适的治疗方案。

english: I have the results of Verzik's tests and so I have returned to Ver Sinhaza again. I had to wait a short while as Verzik was having a meeting with Ranis Drakan. This meant we didn't have as much time for our appointment as usual.
translation: 我拿到了维齐克的检查结果，所以再次返回维辛哈扎。我等了一会儿，因为维齐克正在和拉尼斯.德雷坎开会。这意味着我们这次会诊的时间没有平时那么充裕。

english: Verzik's condition has not improved since we last met. Her weight increase does not appear to have slowed. However, what is more concerning is the results of her tests. The tests show a large number of what appear to be tiny eggs within her body, possibly from the nylocas that bit her.
translation: 自上次见面以来，维齐克的状况没有好转。她的体重增长似乎没有减缓。然而，更令人担忧的是她的检查结果。检查显示她体内有大量看似微小的卵，可能来自咬她的那只尼洛卡斯蛛。

english: The presence of the eggs seems to be having a negative impact on her vampyric abilities, including her immunities. Her ability to shapeshift however, seems unaffected.
translation: 这些卵的存在似乎对她的吸血鬼能力产生了负面影响，包括她的免疫力。不过，她的变形能力似乎不受影响。

english: I have asked Verzik to spend a few days at my surgery in Darkmeyer so that I can properly monitor her condition and perform an operation to remove the eggs. However, she has refused, not wishing to leave Ver Sinhaza. As such, I will need to perform the operation here instead. This will take place tomorrow before her condition further deteriorates.
translation: 我请维齐克到达克迈尔我的诊所待几天，以便我能妥善监测她的状况并进行手术取出那些卵。然而，她拒绝了，不愿离开维辛哈扎。因此，我将改为在这里进行手术。手术将在明天进行，以免她的病情进一步恶化。

english: Today I performed the operation on Verzik at Ver Sinhaza. I was once again delayed by another of Verzik's meetings, this time with that crazed vampyre they call the butcher.
translation: 今天我在维辛哈扎为维齐克做了手术。我再次被维齐克的另一个会议耽搁了，这次是和那个被称为屠夫的疯狂吸血鬼开会。

english: The operation went surprisingly smoothly and all of the eggs appear to have been removed. Verzik has requested that I let her keep some of the eggs for experimentation. I agreed. After all, she's not the kind of person you deny. I also took some eggs myself so I could inspect them further.
translation: 行动出奇地顺利，所有鸡蛋似乎都已被移除。维齐克要求我让她留下一些鸡蛋做实验。我同意了。毕竟，她不是那种你能拒绝的人。我也自己拿了一些鸡蛋，以便进一步检查。

english: I have arranged to return in a few days time to see how things are doing, but I hope that the symptoms will now subside.
translation: 我已安排几天后回来看看情况，但我希望症状现在会消退。

english: Something's gone wrong, very wrong. I've returned to check up on Verzik and found something horrifying. There was something else inside her, and the eggs have returned. I tried to remove them but Verzik stopped me. It's clear her mind is no longer her own. She has insisted I leave.
translation: 出了大问题，非常严重。我回来查看维齐克的情况，发现了可怕的事情。她体内还有别的东西，鸡蛋又回来了。我试图移除它们，但维齐克阻止了我。很明显，她的心智已不再属于她自己。她坚持要我离开。

english: I tried telling her she needs help, that I need to take her to my surgery. She has refused. I can't change her mind and I have no power to force her. Instead, all I can do is finish these notes and leave. Verzik has been giving me a strange look ever since I arrived and I no longer feel safe here.
translation: 我试着告诉她她需要帮助，我需要带她去我的诊所。她拒绝了。我无法改变她的想法，也没有权力强迫她。相反，我所能做的就是写完这些笔记然后离开。自从我到达以来，维齐克一直用奇怪的眼神看着我，我在这里不再感到安全。

english: The nomads were right: there is a city here, probably buried for millennia and revealed by the random motions of the sand. The architecture is impressive even in ruin, and must once have been amazing. One puzzling factor is the pottery -- there are fragments all over the ruins, surely too much for a city even of this size. We have set up camp and will do a proper survey tomorrow.
translation: 游牧民说得对：这里确实有一座城市，可能被埋藏了数千年，因沙子的随机移动而显露出来。即使已成废墟，建筑依然令人印象深刻，曾经一定非常壮观。一个令人困惑的因素是陶器——废墟各处都有碎片，即使对这样规模的城市来说也太多了。我们已经扎营，明天将进行正式勘察。

english: The meaning of the pottery was explained today in a most surprising manner. We found a mostly-intact clay statue buried up to its waist in sand, and as soon as we dug it out, it started to walk around! It is a clay golem, built by the city's inhabitants and dormant all this time. Its head is badly damaged and it is uncommunicative, but its existence tells us that the city's inhabitants were expert magical craftsmen. The huge kilns in some of the buildings indicate that at some point before its destruction the whole city was converted to the manufacture of these golems.
translation: 今天陶器的意义以一种最令人惊讶的方式得到了解释。我们发现了一尊几乎完整的粘土雕像，埋在沙子里齐腰深，我们一把它挖出来，它就开始四处走动！这是一个粘土魔像，由城市居民建造，一直处于休眠状态。它的头部严重受损，无法交流，但它的存在告诉我们，这座城市居民是技艺精湛的魔法工匠。一些建筑中的巨大窑炉表明，在毁灭之前的某个时期，整座城市都转而生产这些魔像。

english: We have also examined the carvings on the large building in the centre. There are symbols depicting several of the ancient gods, including Saradomin, Zamorak, and Armadyl, but there is another prominent symbol that I cannot identify. As it seems we will need to be here for longer than I had thought, I have sent to Elissa for books on golems and religious symbols.
translation: 我们还检查了中央大型建筑上的雕刻。上面有几位古代神的符号，包括萨拉多明、扎莫拉克和阿玛迪尔，但还有一个我无法辨认的重要符号。看来我们需要在这里待的时间比我想象的要长，我已经派人去找艾丽莎要关于魔像和宗教符号的书籍。

english: As we examine the ruins one thing becomes increasingly clear: most of the damage was not due to weathering. The buildings were destroyed by force, as if torn down by giant hands.
translation: 随着我们勘察废墟，一件事变得越来越清楚：大部分损坏并非风化所致。这些建筑是被外力摧毁的，仿佛被巨人的手撕碎。

english: A breakthrough! We have found the staircase into the lower levels of the temple. This part has been untouched by the elements, and the carvings here are more intact, especially four beautiful statuettes in alcoves framing the large door. I have removed one of them. The door will not open. I am glad I sent for a book on symbols, as the unidentified symbol is even more prominent here, especially on the door.
translation: 重大突破！我们找到了通往神庙下层的楼梯。这部分没有受到自然侵蚀，这里的雕刻更加完整，尤其是壁龛中四尊美丽的雕像，环绕着大门。我取下了其中一尊。门打不开。我很高兴我派人去要了关于符号的书，因为那个无法辨认的符号在这里更加突出，尤其是在门上。

english: Our messenger returned with the books I asked for and a letter from Elissa. It is unfortunate that the museum will not be able to finance a full-scale excavation here as well as the one closer to Varrock, although I am of course pleased that the other city has been uncovered. But with the books I am able to piece together more of the story of this city.
translation: 我们的信使带着我要的书和艾丽莎的信回来了。不幸的是，博物馆无法同时资助这里的全面发掘和靠近维洛克城的那处发掘，尽管我当然很高兴另一座城市被发现了。但有了这些书，我能够拼凑出这座城市更多的故事。

english: The unidentified symbol in the ruins is that of the demon Thammaron, who was Zamorak's chief lieutenant during the godwars of the Third Age. With that information I can say with confidence that these are the ruins of Uzer, an advanced human civilization said to have been destroyed towards the end of the Third Age (roughly 2,500 years ago). It was allied with Saradomin and enjoyed his protection, as well as that of its own mages and warriors. Thammaron was able to open a portal from his own domain straight into the heart of the city, bypassing its defences. With Saradomin's help the army of Uzer was able to drive Thammaron back, but the record ends at that point and it has always been assumed that a later attack, either by Thammaron or by Zamorak's other forces, finished the city off.
translation: 废墟中无法辨认的符号是恶魔萨马隆的，他是第三纪元神战期间扎莫拉克的首席中尉。有了这些信息，我可以自信地说，这些是乌泽废墟，一个先进的人类文明，据说在第三纪元末期（大约2500年前）被摧毁。它与萨拉多明结盟，并享有他的保护，以及其自身法师和战士的保护。萨马隆能够从他的领域打开一个传送门，直通城市中心，绕过其防御。在萨拉多明的帮助下，乌泽的军队能够击退萨马隆，但记录到此为止，人们一直认为后来的攻击，无论是萨马隆还是扎莫拉克的其他部队，最终摧毁了这座城市。

english: Examining the door again, I now see that it is exactly the sort of door that could be used to seal Thammaron's portal, I am suddenly glad I was not able to open it! I surmise that the army of golems was created in order to fight the demon, since Uzer's army had been wiped out and Saradomin's forces were increasingly stretched. However, this approach evidently failed, since the city was eventually destroyed.
translation: 再次检查那扇门，我现在看到它正是那种可以用来封印萨马隆传送门的门。我突然庆幸自己没能打开它！我推测魔像军队是为了对抗恶魔而创造的，因为乌泽的军队已被消灭，萨拉多明的力量也越来越分散。然而，这种方法显然失败了，因为这座城市最终被摧毁了。

english: Someone has crudely carved a message into the wall: 'The Soul Stone was here. Where is it now?'
translation: 有人粗鲁地在墙上刻了一条信息：“灵魂石曾在此。现在在哪里？”

english: Well old bean, looking at the old dossier we have on you here there seems to be a tiny problem, what?
translation: 嗯，老兄，看看我们这里关于你的旧档案，似乎有个小问题，是吗？

english: Well, sorry to hear you say that boy, but I can't hold it against you.
translation: 嗯，听到你这么说很遗憾，孩子，但我不能怪你。

english: Well, sorry to hear you say that gal, but I can't hold it against you.
translation: 嗯，听到你这么说很遗憾，姑娘，但我不能怪你。

english: Well, sorry to hear you say that bean, but I can't hold it against you.
translation: 嗯，听到你这么说很遗憾，老兄，但我不能怪你。

english: Ah, do not concern yourself with THAT old boy; Crisis is such a subjective term, and as you will find out when you join us fully in the Temple Knights, is always some potential crisis or other brewing.
translation: 啊，别担心那个，老兄；危机是个很主观的词，当你完全加入圣殿骑士后你会发现，总会有这样或那样的潜在危机在酝酿。

english: Ah, do not concern yourself with THAT old gal; Crisis is such a subjective term, and as you will find out when you join us fully in the Temple Knights, is always some potential crisis or other brewing.
translation: 啊，别担心那个，老姐；危机是个很主观的词，当你完全加入圣殿骑士后你会发现，总会有这样或那样的潜在危机在酝酿。

english: So what say you [player name]? Spend five long years of your life doing pointless busywork without pay for me, on the off chance that at some point in the future I may put your name forward as a novice White Knight?
translation: 那么[player name]，你觉得怎么样？花五年时间为我做无意义的无偿杂活，就为了将来某天我可能把你的名字提为白骑士新手？

english: Well old boy, we need to equip you for the task, but you'll need to get something for me first, what?
translation: 嗯，老兄，我们需要为你装备任务所需的东西，但你得先帮我弄点东西，好吗？

english: Well old girl, we need to equip you for the task, but you'll need to get something for me first, what?
translation: 嗯，老姐，我们需要为你装备任务所需的东西，但你得先帮我弄点东西，好吗？

english: Understood. [player name] out.
translation: 明白。[player name]完毕。

english: Ok [player name], I'm going to begin a low level scan for Solus now...
translation: 好的[player name]，我现在开始对索鲁斯进行低级别扫描……

english: [player name], Solus is very weakened, and we don't have any more fighters to spare!
translation: [player name]，索鲁斯已经非常虚弱了，我们再也抽不出人手了！

english: The salts found in the caves around Weiss are fascinating. By burning them in the correct proportions, I can achieve incredible effects.
translation: 在维斯周围的洞穴里发现的盐类非常迷人。只要按正确的比例燃烧它们，我就能实现令人难以置信的效果。

english: Some combinations can counter the effects of cold weather, others can dispel darkness more effectively than any natural light source, and some seem able to imbue the rocks of the cave with magical-looking powers!
translation: 有些组合可以抵御寒冷天气的影响，有些可以比任何自然光源更有效地驱散黑暗，还有一些似乎能赋予洞穴岩石魔法般的力量！

english: The challenge for me has been identifying the correct proportions. And, of course, finding suitable places to use them - my age makes it hard for me to explore beyond the boundaries of Weiss these days.
translation: 对我来说，挑战在于确定正确的比例。当然，还要找到合适的使用地点——以我现在的年纪，已经很难探索维斯边界以外的地方了。

english: Perhaps other combinations will be discovered in future, with even more helpful applications. Knowledge is valuable in itself, but that dolt Mother values only inventions that help him fight.
translation: 也许将来会发现其他组合，带来更多有用的应用。知识本身就有价值，但那个蠢货母亲只重视能帮助他战斗的发明。

english: We trolls have never been skilled at Construction, and I get little opportunity to practice here.
translation: 我们巨魔从来就不擅长建筑，我在这里也很少有机会练习。

english: However, from my calculations, I believe the optimal site for my fires would be a brazier constructed from steel and mahogany. Two metal bars and two planks should suffice to construct the frame.
translation: 不过，根据我的计算，我认为我的火最理想的放置地点是用钢和桃花心木建造的火盆。两根金属棒和两块木板应该足以搭建框架了。

english: One should then be able to ignite the salts in the brazier to get the desired effect.
translation: 然后就可以在火盆中点燃盐类来获得想要的效果。

english: This was one of the easiest fires to invent; by burning a stack of 300 Te Salt, 100 Efh Salt and 50 Urt Salt, I produced a flame that lit up my entire cave.
translation: 这是最容易发明的火之一；通过燃烧300份特盐、100份艾夫盐和50份厄特盐，我产生了一道照亮整个洞穴的火焰。

english: Its light shone more brightly than any torch or lantern I have seen, and as far as I can tell it shows no sign of ever burning out.
translation: 它的光芒比我见过的任何火把或灯笼都要明亮，而且据我所知，它没有任何将要熄灭的迹象。

english: Although we are surrounded by trees, related to the pine family, and there are a few pale flowers, little else seems to grow here. I originally believed this was due to the cold, and I invented the Fire of Nourishment to counteract it.
translation: 虽然我们周围环绕着松树科的树木，还有一些淡色的花朵，但这里似乎很少有其他植物生长。我最初认为这是因为寒冷，于是我发明了滋养之火来对抗它。

english: The fire requires 50 Te Salt, 100 Efh Salt and 150 Urt Salt.
translation: 这种火需要50份特盐、100份艾夫盐和150份厄特盐。

english: Unfortunately, I later found that the soil around Weiss is barren and unsuitable for crops. Mother called my work a complete waste of time - he cannot grasp that this knowledge may be useful in future, even if he can't use it right now.
translation: 不幸的是，我后来发现维斯周围的土壤贫瘠，不适合种植作物。母亲说我的工作完全是浪费时间——他无法理解这些知识将来可能会有用，即使他现在用不上。

english: He is such a limited ruler!
translation: 他真是个目光短浅的统治者！

english: Living in the cold mountains, I naturally turned my attention to the matter of keeping warm, and succeeded beyond all expectations!
translation: 生活在寒冷的山区，我自然把注意力转向了保暖的问题，而且取得了超乎预期的成功！

english: By burning a stack of 100 Te Salt, 50 Efh Salt and 300 Urt Salt, I produced a flame that completely dispelled the chill of the weather.
translation: 通过燃烧100份特盐、50份艾夫盐和300份厄特盐，我产生了一道完全驱散寒意的火焰。

english: In some parts of the mountains, the cold is so intense that one loses all one's abilities. I feel sure that my Fire of Unseasonal Warmth would render one completely immune to that problem.
translation: 在山区的某些地方，寒冷如此强烈，以至于人会失去所有能力。我确信我的驱寒之火能让人完全免疫这个问题。

english: I stumbled upon this one by accident. A stack of 50 Te Salt, 300 Efh Salt and 100 Urt Salt burnt with a strange heat that dried out my cave - obviously fire should do that, but this one did it much faster than normal. I imagine that if one were to light this fire in a damp environment, it would provide protection from rotting effects and decay.
translation: 这个是我偶然发现的。一堆50份特盐、300份艾夫盐和100份厄特盐燃烧时产生了一种奇怪的热量，把我的洞穴烘干了——显然火应该会这样，但这道火比正常情况快得多。我想如果有人在潮湿的环境中点燃这种火，它就能提供保护，免受腐烂和腐朽的影响。

english: Maybe if I live long enough, I will find a way to travel the world and find such a place.
translation: 也许如果我活得够久，我会找到一种环游世界的方法，找到这样一个地方。

english: Mother was very pleased with me when I presented him the recipe for this fire. It gave him simply incredible powers in combat, rendering him almost immune to any damage!
translation: 当我向母亲呈上这种火的食谱时，他非常高兴。这给了他在战斗中简直不可思议的力量，让他几乎对所有伤害免疫！

english: I also noticed that it disrupted my experiments with the Glowing Basalt teleporters; this would be helpful for Mother if he wished to prevent a mage from fleeing via their teleport magicks.
translation: 我还注意到它干扰了我对发光玄武岩传送器的实验；如果母亲想阻止法师通过传送法术逃跑，这会很有帮助。

english: The basalt rocks beneath Weiss have been altered by the powers of the salts, probably over millennia. This means I can modify them further by treating them with carefully calibrated combinations of salts, achieving effects that - frankly - look indistinguishable from magic.
translation: 维斯下方的玄武岩岩石在盐类力量的作用下发生了变化，可能已经持续了数千年。这意味着我可以通过用精心校准的盐类组合处理它们来进一步改变它们，达到的效果——坦白说——看起来和魔法无异。

english: With the correct combination of salts, the basalt can be made to transport matter - rocks, logs, even living creatures like goats - from place to place.
translation: 使用正确的盐类组合，玄武岩可以被用来传送物质——岩石、原木，甚至像山羊这样的活物——从一个地方到另一个地方。

english: Perhaps it truly is magic - it certainly acts like the teleport spells of which I have heard!
translation: 也许这真的是魔法——它的表现确实像我听说过的传送法术！

english: My pupil, Snowflake, has helped me greatly with these experiments. She is far more intelligent than her father, Mother. Perhaps she inherited her brains from her mother, not from Mother.
translation: 我的学生雪花在这些实验中帮了我很多。她比她父亲母亲聪明得多。也许她的头脑遗传自她的母亲，而不是母亲。

english: In fact Snowflake did most of the work on refining the destinations of our matter transporters. Maybe she's cleverer than me... but I won't tell her that yet.
translation: 事实上，雪花完成了我们物质传送器目的地精炼的大部分工作。也许她比我更聪明……但我暂时不会告诉她。

english: There'll be plenty more time for us to chat - I'm not old enough to fear death yet.
translation: 我们还有很多时间可以聊天——我还没老到害怕死神的地步。

english: Anyway, Snowflake worked out that 3 Efh Salt and 1 Te Salt can make a matter transporter focused on the woods outside Weiss where she used to play, as a child.
translation: 总之，雪花研究出了3份艾夫盐和1份特盐可以制造一个物质传送器，聚焦于维斯外面的树林，那是她小时候常玩的地方。

english: Maybe she will invent more combinations for other destinations soon.
translation: 也许她很快就会为其他目的地发明更多组合。

english: I saw Odd Mushroom invent many other fires, but I cannot find any more of his notes.
translation: 我看到奇特蘑菇发明了许多其他的火，但我找不到他更多的笔记了。

english: Perhaps Father destroyed them, not understanding their value. Or perhaps they are merely lost, and will be found again.
translation: 也许父亲毁掉了它们，不明白它们的价值。又或者它们只是遗失了，将来会被重新找到。

english: I shall continue to search when I can, or perhaps I will rediscover the secrets myself! If I do, I shall prepare an updated edition of this book for my friend [player name].
translation: 我会在有空的时候继续寻找，或者也许我会自己重新发现这些秘密！如果我做到了，我会为我的朋友[player name]准备这本书的更新版本。

english: Did you think I wouldn't know you've been following me? Yes, you: the one reading this note. Maybe you thought I was a fool, or maybe you're the fool yourself. Either way, like me, you've surely now discovered the truth.
translation: 你以为我不知道你一直在跟踪我吗？没错，就是你：正在读这张纸条的人。也许你以为我是个傻瓜，又或者你自己才是傻瓜。无论如何，和我一样，你肯定也已经发现了真相。

english: The Ascended of Arceuus were not the first to discover soul transference, after all. That honour belongs to the Old Ones. Had they not destroyed themselves, they might still be walking among us today.
translation: 阿西乌斯城的飞升者并非最先发现灵魂转移之术的人。这份荣耀属于远古者。若非他们自我毁灭，或许至今仍行走在我们之中。

english: Make no mistake, I will find the remaining knowledge left by the Old Ones. I will discover the secrets of soul transference. As for you, I will only consider you one of two things. Either you're my ally, or my enemy. Only time will tell.
translation: 别搞错了，我一定会找到远古者留下的剩余知识。我会揭开灵魂转移的秘密。至于你，我只把你当作两种人之一。要么是我的盟友，要么是我的敌人。时间会证明一切。

english: The fall of the Wizards' Tower should have been a turning point for the Order of Wizards. We had the canvas wiped clean, with the ability to start fresh with no prejudices or preconceived notions of what a wizard should be. We could have entered a golden age of magic founded on the basis that nobody can control what magic is, or what it should be.
translation: 法师塔的倒塌本该是巫师教团的转折点。我们有了重新开始的机会，可以摒弃对魔法师应有之样的偏见和成见。我们本可以进入一个以无人能控制魔法本质或应有形态为基础的魔法黄金时代。

english: Instead, the wizards in charge decided to rebuild the exact same tower with the exact same problems.
translation: 然而，掌权的魔法师们决定重建一模一样的塔，带着一模一样的问题。

english: I heard rumours that the Saradominists in the Order burned the tower down when they were trying to steal the work of the Zamorakians. Others claimed it was the Zamorakians themselves that did it. In truth, the different sects of the Order were butting heads to the point where conflict was inevitable. The Tower was always destined to fall. This new one, I suspect, will eventually suffer the same fate.
translation: 我听说教团中的萨拉多明信徒在试图窃取扎莫拉克信徒的研究成果时烧毁了塔。也有人说是扎莫拉克信徒自己干的。事实上，教团内部各派系之间的冲突已经到了不可避免的地步。塔的倒塌是注定的。我怀疑这座新塔最终也会遭遇同样的命运。

english: I will be a part of it no longer. I'm leaving to make my own future, free from the infighting of these so-called wizards.
translation: 我不再参与其中了。我要离开去开创自己的未来，摆脱这些所谓魔法师的内斗。

english: I have found myself in the company of some pirates on the Pandemonium. While the law may consider some of their activities barbaric, their camaraderie has been aspirational. Nobody cares who you are or what you've done in a past life. All that matters is that you take care of your own.
translation: 我在潘德莫尼姆岛上结识了一些海盗。虽然法律可能认为他们的一些行为野蛮，但他们的兄弟情谊令人向往。没人在乎你是谁或你过去做过什么。重要的是你照顾好自己人。

english: I've decided to join them on their next voyage. They are of course no stranger to discovering new lands and ancient treasures. Indeed, they've likely covered every inch of land above the waters' edge. But what of below?
translation: 我决定加入他们的下一次航行。他们当然对发现新大陆和古代宝藏并不陌生。事实上，他们可能已经踏遍了水面上方的每一寸土地。但水面之下呢？

english: There could be a whole host of mysteries beneath the surface of the water, just waiting to be discovered. All this crew needs is a wizard to help them explore the places that they alone can't reach.
translation: 水面之下可能隐藏着无数奥秘，等待被发掘。这支船员需要的正是一位能帮助他们探索独自无法到达之处的魔法师。

english: I have spent many months perfecting what I'm calling the Medallion of the Deep. Being removed from the Order of Wizards means also being removed from their libraries. Once, creating new magics was often a collaborative process eventually resulting in a perfect outcome. Now, things are slightly less refined. However, I am most pleased with the end result. With this medallion, the treasures of the depths will soon be ours.
translation: 我花了数月时间完善我称之为'深海奖章'的东西。离开巫师教团意味着也离开了他们的图书馆。曾经，创造新魔法往往是协作过程，最终产生完美的成果。如今，事情就没那么精细了。不过，我对最终结果非常满意。有了这枚奖章，深海的宝藏很快就会属于我们。

english: It seems I have created an effigy of failure. When we made it to open waters, the Captain (I shall not sully this journal with his name) turned on me and tried to take the Medallion for himself. In his eyes, I saw the same greed, the same jealousy that I had seen in my peers. It was the very thing that brought the Wizards' Tower to rubble.
translation: 看来我造了一个失败的雕像。当我们到达开阔水域时，船长（我不愿用他的名字玷污这本日记）背叛了我，试图将奖章据为己有。在他的眼中，我看到了与同僚眼中相同的贪婪和嫉妒。正是这种东西将法师塔化为瓦砾。

english: With no other choice, I combatted the Captain and the rest of the crew and emerged victorious, though I was brought within inches of my life. In the fighting, the Medallion of the Deep that they all craved so desperately was torn asunder, its pieces falling off the deck and into the depths below. For all that I thought I could write my own future, I too could only create destruction.
translation: 别无选择，我与船长和其余船员战斗并取得了胜利，尽管我差点丢了性命。在战斗中，他们梦寐以求的深海奖章被撕成碎片，碎片从甲板上落入深海之中。我以为自己能书写自己的未来，却也只能制造毁灭。

english: Alone at sea, it wasn't long before the authorities found me. This cell in Rock Island Prison is now my home, this journal now my only possession. Having seen the world at its worst, I thought this an acceptable end, but cruel fate was not disposed of me yet. In my experiments in creating the Medallion of the Deep, some part of me was imbued into it, and hence, some part of me was now buried in its fragments.
translation: 独自漂流海上，没过多久当局就找到了我。岩石岛监狱的这间牢房如今是我的家，这本日记是我唯一的财产。见识过世界最黑暗的一面后，我以为这是可以接受的结局，但残酷的命运还不肯放过我。在创造深海奖章的实验中，我的一部分被注入了其中，因此，我的一部分也随之埋藏在它的碎片之中。

english: Since my arrival here, I have been plagued by what many would call visions, but nightmares would be a more fitting name. Having had many moons to disseminate them in my mind, I believe these nightmares to be of the resting places of each of the eight pieces of the Medallion of the Deep.
translation: 自从来到这里，我一直被许多人称之为幻象的东西所困扰，但称之为梦魇更为贴切。经过漫长的思索，我相信这些梦魇指向的是深海奖章八块碎片各自的安息之地。

english: In the first nightmare, I am shut firmly within a rusted chest, slowly asphyxiating in solitude while the wind pushes through palm trees and the ocean laps the shores around me.
translation: 在第一个梦魇中，我被牢牢关在一个生锈的宝箱里，在孤独中慢慢窒息，而风穿过棕榈树，海浪拍打着我周围的岸边。

english: In the second nightmare, I am buried under the waves, tanged in coral, drowning in perpetuity in the seas I had hoped to call my own.
translation: 在第二个梦魇中，我被埋在波涛之下，缠绕在珊瑚中，在我曾希望称之为己有的海洋中永远溺水。

english: In the third nightmare, I am held captive by those not even the Pandemonium would take in, constrained by their greed and malice over black sands.
translation: 在第三个梦魇中，我被连潘德莫尼姆岛都不愿收留的人囚禁，被他们的贪婪和恶意束缚在黑色的沙地上。

english: In the fourth nightmare, I am held by a small animal in a field of shining rocks, but with no food in sight to sate its hunger.
translation: 在第四个噩梦中，我被一只小动物困在一片闪亮的岩石地里，但周围没有食物能满足它的饥饿。

english: In the fifth nightmare, I am placed among a tray of silver in a market on the seas, doomed to rot amongst those shinier than I.
translation: 在第五个噩梦中，我被放在海上市场的一盘银器中，注定要在比我更闪亮的物品中腐烂。

english: In the sixth nightmare, I am sat atop the tallest trees on an uninhabited island, forced to endure the elements at their most potent.
translation: 在第六个噩梦中，我坐在一座无人岛最高的树顶上，被迫忍受最严酷的自然环境。

english: In the seventh nightmare, I am submerged in acidic liquid, burning, scalding forever, while the rattle of bones echoes in the night. Creatures of my own creation? I hope not.
translation: 在第七个噩梦中，我被浸在酸性液体中，永远燃烧、灼烧，而骨头的嘎嘎声在夜晚回荡。那些是我自己创造的生物吗？我希望不是。

english: In the final nightmare, I know not where I am. All I can hear is the infernal, rhythmic clicking of a hundred different creatures, all in the same pattern. This is the worst nightmare. The rhythm lingers even when I wake.
translation: 在最后的噩梦中，我不知道自己在哪里。我只能听到上百种生物地狱般的、有节奏的咔嗒声，全都以同样的模式。这是最糟糕的噩梦。即使醒来，那节奏仍萦绕不去。

english: If I had the strength and the freedom of my jailors, I could use these visions to find and reassemble the Medallion. However, my fate is already sealed. Instead, I plan to cast this journal into the waves. Most likely it will be lost forever, but if it is not and if someone is reading this now, the knowledge of the Medallion of the Deep is now yours. However, if you do decide to attempt to reassemble it, be warned, for greed is a powerful foe. May my fate be a clear reminder of that.
translation: 如果我有看守者的力量和自由，我就能利用这些幻象找到并重新组装深海奖章。然而，我的命运已经注定。相反，我打算把这本日记扔进海浪中。很可能它将永远遗失，但如果没有，如果有人现在正在读它，那么深海奖章的知识就归你所有了。然而，如果你决定尝试重新组装它，要小心，因为贪婪是强大的敌人。愿我的命运成为明确的警示。

english: There was a man called Dentristus, a farm hand on his lord's farm. His lord had a beautiful daughter, Arastasia, with whom he was in love, but always he knew he would never win her hand.
translation: 有个叫丹特里斯特斯的人，是他领主农场上的一个农工。领主的女儿阿拉斯塔西娅美若天仙，他深爱着她，但他始终知道自己永远无法赢得她的芳心。

english: That winter was the Great Winter which drew down the Wintertodt from the north. It proceeded to devour the animals upon the farm and freezing the next year's crops. The lord had no food and Arastasia wept at the fear and distress caused to her people. This broke the heart of Dentristus and so he approached the lord.
translation: 那年冬天是大寒冬，冬将军从北方降临。它吞噬了农场上的动物，冻死了来年的庄稼。领主没有食物，阿拉斯塔西娅为百姓遭受的恐惧和苦难而哭泣。这令丹特里斯特斯心碎，于是他去找领主。

english: 'My Lord! I cannot bear to see your beautiful daughter cry so over the despair that this beast has caused. I vow that I will venture into the mountains and destroy the beast so it shall trouble us no more.'
translation: '我的领主！我无法忍受看到您美丽的女儿为这野兽带来的绝望而哭泣。我发誓将深入山中消灭这野兽，使它不再困扰我们。'

english: 'Dentristus, you are a brave man,' replied the lord. 'This is a dangerous undertaking and if you succeed I will grant you my daughter's hand in marriage as you will truly be the only man that can make her happy.'
translation: '丹特里斯特斯，你是个勇敢的人，'领主回答。'这是一项危险的使命，如果你成功，我将把女儿许配给你，因为你确实是唯一能让她幸福的人。'

english: Dressed in the lord's best armour and wielding his most dangerous weapon Dentristus started upon his quest.
translation: 丹特里斯特斯穿上领主最好的盔甲，手持最危险的武器，踏上了他的征程。

english: Into the mountains Dentristus climbed, camping at night in caves to protect himself from the wind and snow in search of the Wintertodt. From devastated village to devastated village he travelled, following the carnage of the Wintertodt.
translation: 丹特里斯特斯爬进山中，夜晚在洞穴中露营以躲避风雪，寻找冬将军。他沿着冬将军造成的破坏，从一个被摧毁的村庄走到另一个被摧毁的村庄。

english: With hope in his heart and love strengthening his arm Dentristus felt invincible in his armour and powerful with his sword in his hand, he was ready when he met the Wintertodt.
translation: 心中怀着希望，爱意增强了他的臂力，丹特里斯特斯穿着盔甲感到无敌，手持利剑感到强大，当他遇到冬将军时，他已做好准备。

english: One wishes you could say he put up a fight, but Dentristus lay dead before he even saw the Wintertodt, the icy wind freezing him to the bone before he could lay a blow.
translation: 但愿你能说他奋力一战，但丹特里斯特斯在见到冬将军之前就已倒下，冰冷的寒风在他能挥出一击之前就将他冻透了。

english: The fate of Dentristus is a notable reminder that some battles cannot be fought alone.
translation: 丹特里斯特斯的命运是一个显著的提醒：有些战斗不能独自面对。

english: A master smith has come forth with plans to defeat the Winter Beast! May we finally defeat the beast after five decades of terror?
translation: 一位大师级铁匠带着击败冬兽的计划出现了！我们终于能在五十年的恐惧之后击败这野兽了吗？

english: The Order is to meet with Dinh the Smith to assess the feasibility of these plans.
translation: 教团将与铁匠丁会面，评估这些计划的可行性。

english: Dinh, of Lovakengj, believes a magical tree found within the frozen tundra to the north has the power to defeat the beast.
translation: 来自洛瓦肯吉城的丁相信，在北方冰冻苔原中发现的一棵魔法树拥有击败这野兽的力量。

english: Dinh's plans are complex, but I believe them to be worthy. We must construct a prison to contain the Winter Beast before luring it to the prison and sealing it behind Dinh's great doors.
translation: 丁的计划很复杂，但我相信它们是值得的。我们必须建造一座监狱来囚禁冬兽，然后引诱它进入监狱，并把它封在丁的巨大门后。

english: Dinh claims the Bruma tree, found at the heart of the frozen tundra, can burn for eternity. The heat from the Bruma tree will be enough to contain the beast so that we may seal it within this prison.
translation: 丁声称在冰冻苔原中心发现的布鲁玛树可以永远燃烧。布鲁玛树的热量足以困住野兽，这样我们就能把它封在这座监狱里。

english: Dinh has constructed the doors to the prison from various metal compounds, including Lovakite, but they must be reinforced with Bruma bark and enchanted by the Order.
translation: 丁用包括洛瓦凯特在内的多种金属化合物建造了监狱的门，但它们必须用布鲁玛树皮加固，并由教团施法。

english: Lord Lovakengj has approved the plans.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉领主已批准这些计划。

english: Two hundred days have passed and little progress has been made. The Winter Beast still roams free, but we have located the Bruma tree and selected the site for the prison.
translation: 两百天过去了，进展甚微。冬兽仍在肆虐，但我们已经找到了布鲁玛树，并选定了监狱的建造地点。

english: So far, three members of the Order and two scouts have perished in the line of duty.
translation: 到目前为止，教团的三名成员和两名斥候在执行任务时牺牲了。

english: Six hundred days later, the prison is complete. We've lost thirteen members of the Order in recent weeks. The Winter Beast must know of our plans.
translation: 六百天后，监狱完工了。最近几周我们失去了教团的十三名成员。冬兽一定知道我们的计划了。

english: The time has come to end this terror. At first light, this saga enters the final chapter as we begin luring the beast to the prison.
translation: 是时候终结这场恐怖了。晨曦之光下，这段传奇将进入最终章，我们开始将野兽引入牢笼。

english: Rejoice! Our mission has succeeded. The beast has been contained!
translation: 欢呼吧！我们的任务成功了。野兽已被困住！

english: The Bruma tree burns bright in the night sky, warming the northen tundra and holding back the beast.
translation: 布鲁玛之树在夜空中熊熊燃烧，温暖着北方冻土，阻挡着野兽。

english: Lord Lovakengj has officially declared that today is the day of Winter's End.
translation: 洛瓦肯吉领主已正式宣布今天是冬末之日。

english: Wingstone hands you a light box!
translation: 温斯顿递给你一个灯箱！

english: We are trapped.
translation: 我们被困住了。

english: Something is stalking us.
translation: 有什么东西在跟踪我们。

english: The screeches echo through these walls. Shadow magic seems to keep us hidden for now, but we can't last much longer like this. For whoever finds this note... Stay away from the water!
translation: 尖叫声在墙壁间回荡。阴影魔法暂时让我们保持隐蔽，但我们撑不了多久了。无论谁找到这张笔记...远离水源！

english: You cannot pass as you haven't unlocked access to both the Asgarnia and Wilderness areas in this League.
translation: 你无法通过，因为你尚未在本联赛中解锁阿斯加尼亚和荒野区域的通行权。

english: Veos has given you a orb.
translation: 维奥斯给了你一个宝珠。
