english: While working on the new anti-illusion device, I found some interesting snippets on elven magic in father's notes. The knowledge that my father has gleaned from the elves is fascinating, and a tribute to his charm and patience. After all, it is not easy to persuade creatures as long-lived as elves to get to the point!
translation: 在研制新型反幻象装置时，我在父亲的笔记里发现了一些关于精灵魔法的有趣片段。父亲从精灵那里获得的知识令人着迷，也体现了他的人格魅力和耐心。毕竟，要说服像精灵这样长寿的种族直入正题可不容易！

english: According to the notes, elves can create various enchanted artefacts through crystal singing, with different songs producing different items! While this is a very different means of crafting magical items than is known to most gnomes, it is one we can potentially still take advantage of.
translation: 根据笔记记载，精灵可以通过水晶吟唱创造出各种附魔文物，不同的歌曲能产生不同的物品！虽然这与大多数侏儒所知的制作魔法物品的方式截然不同，但我们仍有可能加以利用。

english: To those of us without their abilities, the process is a bit more limited than it is for the elves, for we must rely on crystal singing bowls to form crystal items. When using one of these singing bowls, it seems that only certain items can be created, with the initial crystal seed determining what these items are. For example, father had one that he was able to turn into a very useful crystal saw.
translation: 对于我们这些没有他们能力的人来说，这个过程比精灵要受限得多，因为我们必须依靠颂钵来塑造水晶物品。使用颂钵时，似乎只能创造特定的物品，而初始的水晶种子决定了这些物品是什么。例如，父亲有一个能变成非常实用的水晶锯的种子。

english: On the topic of crystal seeds, I recently came into possession of one that can be sung into a crystal chime. I must admit, I'm yet to determine the purpose of such an item, though I'm sure my father's experiments will yield some answers.
translation: 说到水晶种子，我最近得到了一个可以吟唱成水晶风铃的种子。我必须承认，我还没弄清楚这种物品的用途，但我相信父亲的实验会给出答案。

english: Once in the days long gone, thine eggy lore was written into this book with ink and quill.
translation: 在久远的过去，你的蛋之传说被用墨水和羽毛笔写进了这本书。

english: There seem to be many alternative forewards written, and blotted out, then written again in different handwriting.
translation: 似乎有许多不同的前言被写出来，又被涂掉，然后以不同的笔迹重新书写。

english: In the beginning he who was long of ear did go forth across the lands hoping.
translation: 起初，那位长耳者满怀希望地穿越大地。

english: To bring the egg of Ayaster to the people, so at its meggnificent hue they could marvel.
translation: 要将阿亚斯特之蛋带给人民，让他们惊叹于其绝妙的色彩。

english: For many generations it was thus. The people, one spring morn, waited for the herald of Ayaster.
translation: 世代如此。人们在一个春天的清晨，等待着阿亚斯特的使者。

english: Three days and three nights eager people stood vigil, with each their number dwindling, until only the true faithful remained.
translation: 三天三夜，热切的人们守夜等待，人数逐渐减少，直到只剩下真正的信徒。

english: The true church of Ayaster on this night began, each member adorned themselves with lapin long ears and prayed for the return of hoping.
translation: 阿亚斯特真教会于那夜诞生，每位成员都戴上兔耳，祈祷着希望的归来。

english: But all that year, and the next they waited in vain.
translation: 但那一年和第二年，他们都徒劳地等待着。

english: Content not to sit idle the faithful did travel from their homes, on great pilgrimage.
translation: 信徒们不甘坐等，便离开家园，踏上了伟大的朝圣之旅。

english: From amongst them the writer of the Yolklore rose, and within these pages chronicled, their journey to Ayaster's shell.
translation: 其中一位蛋之传说的作者崛起，在这些书页中记录了他们前往阿亚斯特之壳的旅程。

english: Many illegible stained pages are stuck together here...
translation: 许多难以辨认的污渍书页粘在一起……

english: In holy shell the faithful ensconced, shall await the time of hatching where true faith's reward awaits.
translation: 信徒们安身于圣壳之中，等待着孵化之时，真正的信仰将获得回报。

english: By divine signs shall the hour be heralded, in basket carried, by him long of ear and valiantly hoping.
translation: 神圣的征兆将宣告那一刻的到来，由长耳者满怀希望地以篮子携带。

english: Then shall be revealed to them the great winged Eckbert who does rest high upon the boughs.
translation: 那时，栖息在高高枝头的伟大有翼埃克伯特将向他们显现。

english: Upon winged back the faithful shall rise then into a new world, where they shall hunt gaily.
translation: 信徒们将乘着翅膀升入新世界，在那里欢快地狩猎。

english: In this promised time his glorious bounty, shall fall once more with majesty, Ayaster's great eggs of unfathomable colour.
translation: 在那应许之时，他辉煌的恩赐将再次庄严降临，阿亚斯特那色彩难以想象的伟大之蛋。

english: Are you sure? A contract with Yama cannot be backed out of.
translation: 你确定吗？与阎魔的契约是无法反悔的。

english: Keep your pathetic lack of cooking skills to yourself.
translation: 把你那可怜的厨艺留给自己吧。

english: Be aware that the diadem normally displayed here was recently stolen. The Grand Museum is willing to pay a high price for information that leads to its return.
translation: 请注意，这里通常展示的王冠最近被盗了。大博物馆愿意为重金悬赏能帮助找回王冠的信息。

english: Be aware that the diadem normally displayed here was recently stolen. However, thanks to a helpful adventurer, the diadem has been recovered and will soon be back on display.
translation: 请注意，这里通常展示的王冠最近被盗了。不过，多亏了一位热心的冒险者，王冠已被找回，很快将重新展出。

english: The diadem on display here dates back to the earliest days of Varlamore. It was made for the hero Xerna and it is believed she wore it when she wed her long-time companion, Quoatlos.
translation: 这里展示的王冠可以追溯到瓦拉莫尔最早的时期。它是为英雄塞尔娜制作的，据信她与长期伴侣夸特洛斯结婚时就戴着它。

english: While the diadem was safely displayed here for many years, it was recently stolen by an unknown party. However, thanks to a helpful adventurer, the diadem was quickly recovered.
translation: 虽然王冠在这里安全展示了多年，但最近被不明人士盗走。不过，多亏了一位热心的冒险者，王冠很快就被找回了。

english: Despite our hardships, I still see the light of Saradomin within Elessia. A spark that refuses to go out, even as we find ourselves trapped on this island of goats and serpents.
translation: 尽管我们处境艰难，我仍能在埃莱西娅身上看到萨拉多明的光芒。即使被困在这座满是山羊和蛇的岛上，那火花也拒绝熄灭。

english: With regards to her condition however, we are no closer to a cure. Brother Harne believes that it is a spiritual rot that can be cleansed through faith, and we have begun construction of a proper place of worship.
translation: 至于她的病情，我们离治愈还差得远。哈恩修士认为这是一种可以通过信仰净化的精神腐朽，我们已经开始建造一座合适的礼拜场所。

english: As usual, I have been charged with keeping things secure. A few little keyword cyphers here and there will ensure only those who are trusted will have access.
translation: 像往常一样，我负责确保安全。这里那里加几个关键词密码，确保只有受信任的人才能进入。

english: This work will be of benefit to all of us. It has not been a simple task to practice in the light of our predicament, and without some motivation, I can see the others beginning to break.
translation: 这项工作对我们所有人都有益。在我们这样的处境下坚持修行并非易事，如果没有一些动力，我能看到其他人开始崩溃。

english: You come to Champions' Guild, you fight me, I squish you, I get brains!
translation: 你来到冠军公会，你打我，我碾碎你，我得到脑子！

english: Champion of Zombies
translation: 僵尸冠军

english: Use this ring when you are ready to summon me to your aid. It is a daunting task, but you must battle the king to allow me to remove the spell from him. When the king is almost dead, use this ring and I will teleport to your aid. Be warned - Though I am skilled with magic, I am no fighter! Should you summon me too early I will have to teleport us out of danger! When our mission is completed, I will remove the summon ability from the ring, but you may keep it for protection.
translation: 当你准备好召唤我相助时，使用这枚戒指。这是一项艰巨的任务，但你必须与国王战斗，让我能解除他身上的咒语。当国王快要死时，使用这枚戒指，我会传送来帮助你。警告——虽然我精通魔法，但我不是战士！如果你过早召唤我，我将不得不把我们传送出危险！当我们的任务完成时，我会移除戒指的召唤能力，但你可以留着它作为保护。

english: Grish hands you some food and two potions.
translation: 格里什递给你一些食物和两瓶药水。

english: You see an image of Sithik with a message underneath 'I, the bartender of the Dragon Inn, do swear that this is a true likeness of the wizzy who was talking to Brentle Vahn, my customer the other day.'
translation: 你看到西提克的画像，下面有一条信息：“我，巨龙旅店的酒保，发誓这是那天与我的顾客布伦特尔·瓦恩交谈的巫师的真实肖像。”

english: Zavistic hands you a bottle of strange potion.
translation: 扎维斯提克递给你一瓶奇怪的药水。

english: Grish gives you a crudely crafted key.
translation: 格里什给了你一把粗糙打造的钥匙。

english: You need a tail to pin on the cow first.
translation: 你需要先有一条尾巴才能钉在奶牛上。

english: You pinned the tail to the cow's left ear.
translation: 你把尾巴钉在了奶牛的左耳上。

english: I said grab her by the ear not put the tail there...
translation: 我说的是抓住她的耳朵，不是把尾巴放在那里……

english: You pinned the tail to the cow's right ear.
translation: 你把尾巴钉在了奶牛的右耳上。

english: The tail goes on her REAR, not her ear...
translation: 尾巴应该放在她的臀部，不是耳朵……

english: You pinned the tail to the cow's hind quarters.
translation: 你把尾巴钉在了奶牛的后躯上。

english: Oh dear... that looks like an uncomfortable cow.
translation: 哦，天哪……那看起来像是一头不舒服的奶牛。

english: I think you're pasture prime at this.
translation: 我觉得你在这方面已经炉火纯青了。

english: You pinned the tail to the cow's body.
translation: 你把尾巴钉在了奶牛的身体上。

english: Um... not the prime place for a tail.
translation: 嗯……这不是放尾巴的最佳位置。

english: BULLSEYE! Ahem... I mean, missed.
translation: 正中靶心！咳咳……我是说，没中。

english: You decorate the tree with some painted baubles.
translation: 你用一些彩绘装饰品装饰了树。

english: Another 4 boxes should do the trick.
translation: 再放4个盒子应该就够了。

english: Another box should do the trick.
translation: 再放一个盒子应该就够了。

english: Spurn the red-suited buffoon!
translation: 拒绝那个穿红衣服的小丑！

english: Down with Christmas!
translation: 打倒圣诞节！

english: Feel the holiday spirit!
translation: 感受节日气氛！

english: I'm a bit busy at the moment. Meet me by the north-east Taverley gate instead.
translation: 我现在有点忙。到塔韦利村东北门来找我。

english: Really? Well, thank you.
translation: 真的吗？那谢谢你了。

english: This is hardly a good moment, fool. Meet me south-west of the Falador Party Room instead.
translation: 现在可不是好时机，傻瓜。到法拉多城派对房间西南来找我。

english: You've received a reward!
translation: 你收到了奖励！

english: A reward has been dropped on the ground for you!
translation: 给你的奖励已掉落在地上！

english: You shouldn't be putting things where they don't belong.

english: To forge items use the metal you wish to work with the anvil.
translation: 要锻造物品，请把想加工的金属用在铁砧上。

english: Through an unlucky accident you were not able to make the dart tip, but you think you know where you went wrong and perhaps next time you'll succeed.
translation: 由于一次不幸的事故，你没能做出飞镖尖，但你知道哪里出了问题，也许下次你会成功。

english: You waste the bronze bar through an unlucky accident. But you think you know where you went wrong and perhaps next time you'll be successfull.
translation: 由于一次不幸的事故，你浪费了青铜锭。但你知道哪里出了问题，也许下次你会成功。

english: You have already made the prototype dart. You don't need to make another one.
translation: 你已经制作了原型飞镖。你不需要再做一个了。

english: You need one death rune, one chaos rune, five fire runes and ten coins to charge the Uncharged trident.
translation: 你需要一个死亡符石、一个混沌符石、五个火符石和十枚金币来给未充能的三叉戟充能。

english: Your Uncharged trident has no charges.
translation: 你的未充能三叉戟没有剩余充能次数。

english: I'll leave you be. Sorry, Veos.
translation: 我不打扰你了。抱歉，维奥斯。

english: Well old boy, here's the thing; Only members of the White Knights may join the Temple Knights. By ancient decree, dontchaknow.
translation: 嗯，老兄，事情是这样的；只有白骑士的成员才能加入圣殿骑士。根据古老的法令，你知道的。

english: Well old gal, here's the thing; Only members of the White Knights may join the Temple Knights. By ancient decree, dontchaknow.
translation: 嗯，老姑娘，是这么回事：只有白骑士才能加入圣殿骑士，这是古老法令规定的，懂吧。

english: Well old bean, here's the thing; Only members of the White Knights may join the Temple Knights. By ancient decree, dontchaknow.
translation: 嗯，老兄，事情是这样的；只有白骑士的成员才能加入圣殿骑士。根据古老的法令，你知道的。

english: Calm yourself down old boy... We have no intention of 'getting rid of you', we are very keen on seeing you join us...
translation: 冷静点，老伙计……我们可没打算‘甩掉你’，我们非常希望你能加入我们……

english: Calm yourself down old gal... We have no intention of 'getting rid of you', we are very keen on seeing you join us...
translation: 冷静点，老姑娘……我们可没打算“甩掉你”，我们非常希望你能加入我们……

english: Calm yourself down old bean... We have no intention of 'getting rid of you', we are very keen on seeing you join us...
translation: 冷静点，老伙计……我们可没打算‘甩掉你’，我们非常希望你能加入我们……

english: Five years is a very long period of time nowadays - ANYTHING could happen in that time, and we need capable heroes like yourself as soon as possible.
translation: 五年如今可是很长一段时间——这期间什么都可能发生，我们需要像你这样能干的英雄尽快加入。

english: Start the Wanted! quest?
translation: 开始“通缉！”任务？

english: No, to be honest I'm getting sick of all these excuses and procrastination. Plus being an inititiate was nowhere near as fun as I thought it would be.
translation: 不，说实话，我已经厌倦了这些借口和拖延。而且当见习骑士可没我想象的那么有趣。

english: Well, sorry to hear you say that old bean, but I can't hold it against you.
translation: 好吧，听到你这么说我很遗憾，老伙计，但我不会怪你。

english: Ah, your curiosity does you credit old bean! Let me tell you a little history lesson;
translation: 啊，你的好奇心值得称赞，老伙计！让我给你讲点历史；

english: So how does that affect me?
translation: 那这对我有什么影响？

english: But if that's only temporary, and I have to be a 'proper' White Knight to then become a Temple Knight, doesn't that mean that I am still going to have to squire for Amik for five years?
translation: 但如果那只是暂时的，而且我必须成为‘正式’白骑士才能成为圣殿骑士，那岂不是说我还是要给阿米克当五年侍从？

english: Ah, do not concern yourself with THAT old bean; Crisis is such a subjective term, and as you will find out when you join us fully in the Temple Knights, there is always some potential crisis or other brewing.
translation: 啊，别担心那个，老伙计；危机是个很主观的词，等你完全加入圣殿骑士后就会发现，总会有某种潜在危机在酝酿。

english: I am no longer a member of the Temple Knights, I have entirely renounced my application because after many hours of soul searching I have come to the conclusion that I desperately want to become a White
translation: 我不再是圣殿骑士成员了，我已经彻底撤回申请，因为经过长时间的深思熟虑，我得出结论：我非常想成为一名白

english: Knight instead!
translation: 骑士！

english: So? Did you hear me bad mouth the armour? The armour is cool, I keep the armour!
translation: 所以呢？你听到我说盔甲坏话了吗？盔甲很酷，我留着盔甲！

english: Now, I heard from some completely random stranger that was definitely not Sir Tiffy Cashien as part of an elaborate ruse to fast track my application into the White Knights, that I could be deputised directly as a
translation: 现在，我从一个完全随机的陌生人那里听说——那人绝对不是蒂菲·卡申爵士，也绝对不是为了用复杂诡计加快我加入白骑士的申请——我可以直接被任命为一名

english: White Knight, and entirely bypass that whole boring waiting for five years thing...
translation: 白骑士，完全跳过那无聊的五年等待……

english: Right. Well anyway, can I do that instead?
translation: 好吧。那我能这么做吗？

english: All is well, huh? I'll be right back, I just have to go and ask...
translation: 一切安好，是吧？我马上回来，我得去问问……

english: Forget that, and forget you! No way am I risking my neck unless there's a big fat reward on the table for it!
translation: 那事免谈，你也给我滚！除非有一大笔丰厚报酬，否则我绝不会拿命冒险！

english: His name is Solus Dellagar, and honestly, he is one of the most dangerous men in Gielinor.
translation: 他叫索卢斯·德拉加，说实话，他是基利诺尔最危险的人物之一。

english: No, no, no. Listen to me kid; You are under NO CIRCUMSTANCES to engage him directly in combat!
translation: 不，不，不。听我说，小子；你绝对绝对不能直接和他战斗！

english: Well old bean, we will need to equip you for the task, but you'll need to get something for me first, what?
translation: 好吧，老伙计，我们得给你配备任务所需的装备，不过你得先替我弄样东西来，怎么样？

english: Okay, thanks Tiffy!
translation: 好的，谢谢蒂菲！

english: Heavens, kid! I am not a pawn shop, to be holding bits and pieces for you while you go off and do something else!
translation: 天哪，小子！我又不是当铺，不能你去做别的事时帮你保管东西！

english: Hi Savant! Any ideas on how I should track down Solus?
translation: 你好，学者！关于怎么追踪索卢斯，你有什么建议吗？

english: Dossier on Solus Dellagar
translation: 索卢斯·德拉加档案

english: Solus Observation Record 1
translation: 索卢斯观察记录1

english: Related Dossiers
translation: 相关档案

english: Zamorakian Research Mage
translation: 扎莫拉克研究法师

english: You have no previous information recorded for playback.
translation: 你没有之前的信息可播放。

english: Observation Orb #BK-LD-577786 Record begins...
translation: 观察宝珠 #BK-LD-577786 记录开始……

english: Observation Orb #VA-ZM-000964 Record begins...
translation: 观察宝珠 #VA-ZM-000964 记录开始……

english: Okay Daquarius, you tell me the whereabouts of Solus Dellagar right now, or I will put every Black Knight here to their death in front of you!
translation: 好吧，达夸里乌斯，马上告诉我索卢斯·德拉加的下落，否则我就当着你的面处死这里所有的黑骑士！

english: What kind of fur? Dog? Bear? Wolf?
translation: 什么毛皮？狗？熊？狼？

english: Well you ARE a persistent one, aren't you?
translation: 你还真是执着，不是吗？

english: Solus commands you die now!
translation: 索卢斯命令你去死！

english: You find a broav in the trap, but you release it as you already have one.
translation: 你在陷阱里发现了一只布罗夫，但你已经有一只了，所以把它放了。

english: What's beneath the trapdoor?
translation: 活板门下面是什么？

english: Oh, come on - I'm only curious.
translation: 哦，别这样——我只是好奇。

english: So it's an agility course, then?
translation: 所以那是个敏捷训练场？

english: No problem. Can I come in?
translation: 没问题。我能进去吗？

english: Can I come in and use it?
translation: 我能进去用吗？

english: You're a natural talent, aren't you?
translation: 你真是天赋异禀，不是吗？

english: Moving too far away will remove my freeze!
translation: 离得太远会解除我的冰冻！

english: The Records quiver in anticipation for this knowledge.
translation: 记录因这份知识而颤抖着期待。

english: The Golem disappears, but will be back to defend his door.
translation: 魔像消失了，但会回来守护他的门。

english: No, no, I have no use for rocks. Keep them! They're densely magical, I'm sure you can find some use for them.
translation: 不，不，我用不上岩石。留着吧！它们蕴含浓厚的魔法，我相信你能找到它们的用处。

english: Wow, fairy magic sure is useful, I hardly moved at all!
translation: 哇，仙子魔法真有用，我几乎没动！

english: Wearing this amulet will give you a PK skull.
translation: 佩戴这条护身符会让你获得 PK 头骨。

english: I'll take the risk of the damage.
translation: 我愿意冒受伤的风险。

english: Take it back to the bank
translation: 把它带回银行

english: I'll brush that aside with ease.
translation: 我会轻松地把那事搁到一边。

english: Can you make dyes for me, please?
translation: 请问你能帮我做染料吗？

english: Stop bouncing around!
translation: 别蹦来蹦去了！

english: Greetings master [player name]!
translation: 你好，主人[player name]！

english: You hand in an exotic-looking shell.
translation: 你上交了一个外观奇特的贝壳。

english: Do not mistake me, [player name], Guthix's choice expelled as much evil as it did justice, but it was perhaps naive of him to think that it would rid the world of its maluses.
translation: 别误会我，[player name]，古斯希克斯的选择在伸张正义的同时也驱除了同样多的邪恶，但他或许天真地以为这样就能让世界摆脱一切祸患。

english: It's a dog. It needs attention and caring for. It won't just sit still for hours.
translation: 它是一只狗。它需要关注和照料。它不会一动不动地坐上几个小时。

english: Don't feel bad, they wanted to join my side!
translation: 别难过，他们想加入我这边！

english: If you can find me my perfect gold, make a ring and necklace from it, and add rubies to them, I will gladly hand over my fragment of the family crest to you.
translation: 如果你能为我找到完美的金子，用它打造一枚戒指和一条项链，再给它们镶上红宝石，我就乐意把我那份家徽交给你。

english: Well, of course I sound nice. I have had many years of practice. These so-and-sos, however...
translation: 嗯，我听起来当然不错。我可是练了很多年。不过这些家伙……

english: Thank you, sir. It was dreadfully irritating being a chicken. How can I ever thank you?
translation: 谢谢您，先生。当一只鸡真是烦人透顶。我该怎么感谢您才好？

english: Wartfact, get in way of it!
translation: 沃特法斯，挡住它！

english: Your dog can only dig loose soil, often found on the trail of treasure.
translation: 你的狗只能挖掘松软的土壤，这种土壤常见于宝藏的踪迹上。

english: You've put yourself in this position!
translation: 是你自己把自己弄到这个地步的！

english: : Arrr! That be nowhere near close! Did ye not listen the first time around?
translation: ：啊哈！那还差得远呢！你第一次没听清楚吗？

english: How disappointing. I expected better from you.
translation: 真令人失望。我本以为你会做得更好。

english: Great job!
translation: 干得好！

english: That's a bit better.
translation: 这好一点了。

english: I'm so glad you did! I am having so much fun! I should do this every year!
translation: 我真高兴你来了！我玩得太开心了！我每年都该办这个！

english: Make him pay!
translation: 让他付出代价！

english: Every loss furthers the goal.
translation: 每一次损失都让目标更进一步。

english: The Alliance is struggling to hold off the threats to the Archive. And the records are eager to chronicle your deeds in this matter, if you are so inclined.
translation: 联盟正艰难抵挡对档案馆的威胁。如果你愿意，记录者们很乐意将你在此事中的事迹载入编年史。

english: She's not staying.
translation: 她不会留下来的。

english: Oh, here we go...
translation: 哦，又来了……

english: Bork very angry!!
translation: 博克非常生气！！

english: I have to find a way to destroy that mutagen...
translation: 我得想办法摧毁那种诱变剂……

english: Have you ever considered letting the glory of Saradomin into your life? I have some pamphlets you may be interested in reading and discussing with me.
translation: 你有没有考虑过让萨拉多明的荣光进入你的生活？我有一些小册子，你或许有兴趣读一读，再和我讨论讨论。

english: Alright, just this once.
translation: 好吧，就这一次。

english: How are the dogs doing? Keeping them healthy?
translation: 那些狗怎么样了？有让它们保持健康吗？

english: Correct! Buying accounts is against the rules. Also you could lose the account if the original owner takes it back.
translation: 正确！购买账号是违反规则的。而且如果原主人找回账号，你可能会失去该账号。

english: Run... It matters not...
translation: 跑吧……这无关紧要……

english: And our other foes will soon regroup. I fear our defence of the Archive has only just begun.
translation: 而我们的其他敌人很快会重新集结。恐怕我们对档案馆的防御才刚刚开始。

english: Pick a side, and may Saradomin guide you!
translation: 选一边吧，愿萨拉多明指引你！

english: Can I interest you in some double glazing? An old castle like this must get very draughty in the winter...
translation: 您对双层玻璃窗感兴趣吗？像这样的古老城堡，冬天一定非常透风……

english: I wouldn't... oh I'm sorry, sir, please go on through.
translation: 我不会……哦，对不起，先生，请过去吧。

english: Let's make sure it wasn't a fluke!
translation: 让我们确认一下那不是侥幸！

english: Yes, but it would potentially be one fewer enemy to fight. Besides, it would be easier to watch them carefully as tense allies than to defend from them as an unseen threat.
translation: 是的，但这可能意味着少一个要对付的敌人。再说，把他们当作紧张的盟友小心看管，总比防备一个看不见的威胁要容易。

english: What we do next, Wartface?
translation: 我们接下来做什么，疣脸？

english: Recolour your Robe top of the Eye (green)?
translation: 要为你的眼之长袍上衣 (绿) 重新着色吗？

english: I'm letting you win, you know.
translation: 你知道，我是在让着你赢。

english: You feel magically weakened.
translation: 你感到魔力被削弱了。

english: Revert your Robe top of the Eye (red)?
translation: 要还原你的眼之长袍上衣 (红) 吗？

english: Correct! Jagex will not block your PIN so don't type it! Anyone asking you to say your PIN is trying to trick you.
translation: 正确！Jagex不会阻止你的PIN，所以不要输入它！任何要求你说出PIN的人都是在骗你。

english: Well, you've got me in a pickle now.
translation: 唉，你现在可把我难住了。

english: What have I done!
translation: 我都干了什么！

english: You'll have to do better to break my defense!
translation: 想攻破我的防御，你还得再加把劲！

english: Oh! Is he cute?
translation: 哦！他可爱吗？

english: Ah, sorry. I feel like I have two left feet in this uniform!
translation: 啊，抱歉。穿着这身制服，我感觉自己笨手笨脚的！

english: I... Recently, I'm not sure I do.
translation: 我……最近，我不确定我还有。

english: The crab squints, then clicks its claws frantically.
translation: 螃蟹眯起眼睛，然后疯狂地咔嗒作响。

english: No no no! I don't mean he's a disaster. That's the name of the instrument I made for him!
translation: 不不不！我不是说他是场灾难。那是我为他制作的乐器的名字！

english: You are kind. The Alliance is lucky to have each other. As much as I wish it weren't so, the Temple Knights alone could not hold the Archive.
translation: 你心地善良。联盟能有彼此真是幸运。尽管我希望并非如此，但仅凭圣殿骑士无法守住档案馆。

english: No need! I'm fine, thanks.
translation: 不用了！我没事，谢谢。

english: Very good, let's see if your power compares to mine.
translation: 很好，让我们看看你的力量能否与我的相比。

english: Er... Yeah... Sure...
translation: 呃……对……当然……

english: I should have the stray dog with me before I interrupt these goblins.
translation: 在打断这些哥布林之前，我应该先带上那只流浪狗。

english: With your help, the Alliance is successfully holding the Archive... for now.
translation: 在你的帮助下，联盟成功守住了档案馆……暂时如此。

english: Essyllt hands you a newly cut key.
translation: 埃西尔特递给你一把新配的钥匙。

english: My slayer task is you!
translation: 我的杀戮任务就是你！

english: You open the folio and read the words. As you do, they glow and seem to spill out of the page around you.
translation: 你打开对开本，读起上面的文字。读着读着，文字发出光芒，似乎从书页中溢出，环绕在你周围。

english: The path to enlightenment forgoes distractions.
translation: 通往觉悟之路须摒弃杂念。

english: Recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye?
translation: 要为你的眼之长袍下装重新染色吗？

english: Goblins advance!
translation: 哥布林前进！

english: Well we weren't really sure, but perhaps now we can piece it together.
translation: 嗯，我们之前不太确定，但也许现在可以把它拼凑起来了。

english: That might damage you A LOT if you proceed.
translation: 如果你继续的话，那可能会对你造成极大的伤害。

english: It's locked. That's strange - I can't see any kind of lock or handle to open it...
translation: 它锁住了。真奇怪——我看不到任何锁或把手可以打开它……

english: Woof.
translation: 汪。

english: There is Juna of course, but also Valluta... Aeternam... These are just some of the names passed down through our order. Ocellus was another.
translation: 当然有朱娜，但也有瓦卢塔……埃特南……这些只是我们教团代代相传的部分名字。奥塞勒斯是另一个。

english: You've opened the door for me to strike, so I shall!
translation: 你为我打开了进攻的机会，那我就出手了！

english: Yes. It is no small ask, but we do not think we can manage any more ourselves. I would suggest you seek allies of your own to help you.
translation: 是的。这要求不低，但我们认为自己已经无力应付更多了。我建议你寻找自己的盟友来帮忙。

english: Are you sure you want to dig up this patch?
translation: 你确定要挖开这块地吗？

english: I'm not sure... yet. No doubt mother will quickly learn about what happened here. While we wait to hear from her, I'll get thinking about what our next move should be.
translation: 我还不确定……母亲无疑很快就会得知这里发生的事。在我们等待她的消息期间，我会思考下一步该怎么做。

english: You receive 5x Pete's vouchers.
translation: 你获得了5张皮特的代金券。

english: The adult doesn't seem particularly phased by your antics.
translation: 那个成年人似乎对你的胡闹并不怎么在意。

english: Do you have what it takes?
translation: 你有那个本事吗？

english: I sure do feel safe with Pete around.
translation: 有皮特在身边，我确实感到很安全。

english: Yes, I want to clear it for new crops.
translation: 是的，我想清理它来种新作物。

english: Awwwww, please gimme some sweets [player name]!
translation: 哎呀呀呀，请给我一些糖果吧[player name]！

english: I figured out what's wrong with the stray dog!
translation: 我弄明白那只流浪狗出了什么问题了！

english: The water flows into the hole.
translation: 水流进了洞里。

english: Big High War God draw battle line!
translation: 大高战神来画战线！

english: I see where you're coming from, but I promise. Anything I can do to convince you?
translation: 我明白你的顾虑，但我保证。我能做些什么来说服你吗？

english: What do you make of the Archive?
translation: 你怎么看档案馆？

english: Disputable.
translation: 有待商榷。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要为你的眼之长袍下装重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换现有的任何重新染色。

english: Cast teleport anyway
translation: 仍然施放传送

english: You knock at the door. You hear a voice from inside...
translation: 你敲了敲门。你听到里面传来一个声音……

english: Ahaha, now you see the value of the work. But that's not all! The root system of the Archive seems to be trying to keep the crystals bound. But if the crystals are broken down enough, the roots retreat.
translation: 啊哈哈，现在你看到这项工作的价值了吧。但这还不是全部！档案馆的根系似乎正试图束缚住这些水晶。但如果水晶被充分分解，根系就会退去。

english: Don't pull it.
translation: 别拉它。

english: Mission?
translation: 任务？

english: Can I practice fighting please?
translation: 请问我可以练习战斗吗？

english: But we managed to save them all!
translation: 但我们成功把它们全都救下来了！

english: Hello there, Chase. Could I adopt a puppy?
translation: 你好，蔡斯。我可以领养一只小狗吗？

english: Only for some! These stuck-ups aristocrabs once got lucky enough to get their claws on the magic tree, and now they think they are a gift to crabdom.
translation: 只是对某些蟹而言！这些自命不凡的贵族蟹曾侥幸把爪子伸到了魔法树上，现在它们就自以为是蟹界的恩赐。

english: Well done! Now make sure you keep eating after you survive the first attack!
translation: 干得好！现在请确保在挺过第一次攻击后继续进食！

english: No more movement for you.
translation: 你再也别想动了。

english: Softly.
translation: 轻轻地。

english: The crab starts measuring your foot with its claw.
translation: 那只蟹开始用它的钳子量你的脚。

english: If only I could be more like...
translation: 要是我能更像……

english: No... Your alliance... is false... Armadyl... Saradomin... They are no better... than the rest... They are not worthy... of this power...
translation: 不……你的联盟……是虚假的……阿玛戴尔……萨拉多明……他们并不比其他人……好多少……他们不配……拥有这份力量……

english: You show the crab how to pluck the string, and how to change the pitch of the note by pressing the string at the same time. The crab tries to copy you, but can only really produce one note.
translation: 你向那只蟹演示如何拨动琴弦，以及如何同时按住琴弦来改变音符的音高。那只蟹试着模仿你，但只能真正弹出一个音符。

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to another player. However they appear to be ignoring me...
translation: 抱歉，我正想和另一位玩家说话。不过他们似乎无视了我……

english: First of all, you'll need to change gear to a style that your opponent is not praying against. Good luck!
translation: 首先，你需要把装备换成对手没有在祈祷防御的样式。祝你好运！

english: Is there anything else I can do to help you out?
translation: 还有什么我能帮你的吗？

english: Mmm. Can you blow air?
translation: 嗯。你会吹气吗？

english: Opening the supply crate will give you more food in the same spots in your inventory!
translation: 打开补给箱会在你物品栏的相同位置给你更多食物！

english: Shark-Brew-Karam, as soon as the first attack hurts you!
translation: 鲨鱼-药酒-卡拉姆，就在第一次攻击伤到你时！

english: No, I'm a wizard, and his apprentice separately.
translation: 不，我既是魔法师，也是他的学徒，两者是分开的。

english: Your partner is frozen! Quickly, move under him!
translation: 你的搭档被冻结了！快，移到他下方！

english: Of course, my liege. But I must tell you the rules first. Would you like to hear them now?
translation: 当然，我的君主。但我必须先告诉您规则。您现在想听吗？

english: Except that I hate cats! Don't ever bring one near me!
translation: 只是我讨厌猫！永远别把猫带到我附近！

english: Hmm, this should set me up well.
translation: 嗯，这应该能让我准备妥当。

english: Hello! I'm looking for ceremonial leaders on behalf of my friend on the beach.
translation: 你好！我代表我在海滩上的朋友来寻找仪式领袖。

english: What's the matter, girl?
translation: 怎么了，姑娘？

english: Smorks... avenge... Bork.
translation: 斯莫克斯……为……博克……复仇。

english: I think I have found all of the crabs that were going to be leaders. I should go back to see how the practice is going.
translation: 我想我已经找到了所有将成为领袖的蟹。我该回去看看练习进行得怎么样了。

english: Castle Wars Arena.
translation: 城堡战争竞技场。

english: Ferox Enclave.
translation: 费罗飞地。

english: I see your point. I'm not sure I'd want to commit to that stance completely, but I see your point.
translation: 我明白你的意思。我不确定自己会完全坚持那种立场，但我明白你的意思。

english: Plan B...?
translation: B计划……？

english: Your rudeness is unforgivable [player name]!
translation: 你的无礼不可原谅，[player name]！

english: Haha, bring puny human closer!
translation: 哈哈，把渺小的人类带近点！

english: Ask about Waterfall Quest
translation: 询问瀑布任务

english: Back ta the oceans fer me, arrr!
translation: 我还是回海上去吧，啊哈！

english: Get Ready...
translation: 准备……

english: Me neither. but I don't give up easily.
translation: 我也是。但我不会轻易放弃。

english: Raaaaaaar!
translation: 吼啊啊啊啊！

english: I'm sorry, but I refuse to speak with someone wearing such cringe head wear.
translation: 抱歉，我拒绝和戴着如此尴尬头饰的人说话。

english: I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the... Hey, wait a minute! You're not a crab. You're a penguin!
translation: 我是代表我在……嘿，等等！你不是蟹。你是企鹅！

english: 'Ello, are you busy doing a task or something.
translation: '你好，你是在忙着做任务还是什么？

english: Let's see if you're ready for this.
translation: 看看你是否准备好了。

english: THE Record Keeper!
translation: 就是那位记录保管员！

english: WoooOOOOooo!
translation: 呜嗷嗷嗷嗷！

english: Miaow! Let's get out of here!
translation: 喵！我们快离开这里！

english: Are you sure you wish to revert your Robe top of the Eye (green)? The dye used will not be returned.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍上衣（绿）还原吗？所用染料不会退还。

english: Intelligent as his conversation might have been, he can't speak now.
translation: 无论他生前谈话多么有见地，他现在都说不了话了。

english: Doesn't look much like a tomb.
translation: 看起来不太像坟墓。

english: Treat!
translation: 奖励！

english: Finish him!
translation: 干掉他！

english: After all I've done?
translation: 在我做了这么多之后？

english: Recolour your Robe top of the Eye?
translation: 要为你的眼之长袍上衣重新染色吗？

english: Which of these skills do you wish to add 10,000 xp to?
translation: 你想把10,000点经验加到以下哪个技能？

english: Let's have my wights deal with you!
translation: 让我的尸鬼来对付你吧！

english: Not on my watch.
translation: 休想。

english: Let's go find them then! Follow me!
translation: 那我们就去找他们吧！跟我来！

english: So you would perform quite close to home?
translation: 所以你会离家很近的地方表演？

english: I lose more friends that way.
translation: 那样我会失去更多朋友。

english: Precisely! They thought you might know of some dogs in the city I could rescue.
translation: 正是！他们认为你可能知道城里有些狗我可以救助。

english: Your Robe bottoms of the Eye (red) has been reverted.
translation: 你的眼之长袍下装（红）已还原。

english: More like Picklenose not worth listening to.
translation: 更像是腌黄瓜鼻不值得听。

english: You successfully dye your Robe bottoms of the Eye.
translation: 你成功为你的眼之长袍下装染了色。

english: Hey, look what I found!
translation: 嘿，看看我发现了什么！

english: Cliiick-cliiick-click click cliiick. Click-cliiick-click-click cliiick- cliiick-cliiick click-click-click cliiick.
translation: 咔——咔——咔咔咔。咔——咔——咔咔咔——咔——咔——咔咔咔咔咔。

english: : Problem is, these old hands o'mine aren't as useful as they used t'be, and the lock on that chest is a little bit too fiddly for ol' Cap'n Arnav. Could you help me out?
translation: ：问题是，我这双老手不如从前好使了，而且那个宝箱的锁对老阿纳夫船长来说有点太精细了。你能帮我一把吗？

english: That I am. How can I be of assistance?
translation: 正是我。我能帮上什么忙？

english: And then when it's all over, you have to travel all the way back. You're exhausted and you wish you hadn't left home. I hate it. But you do it for the kids, right?
translation: 然后等一切结束后，你还得一路赶回去。你筋疲力尽，后悔当初离开了家。我讨厌这样。但你是为了孩子们，对吧？

english: You give some tuna to the cat. It devours it and purrs loudly.
translation: 你把一些金枪鱼给了猫。它狼吞虎咽地吃掉，并大声地咕噜咕噜叫。

english: The bellows pump air down the pipe.
translation: 风箱把空气顺着管道压下去。

english: You can if you make some room in your inventory first!
translation: 如果你先腾出一些背包空间就可以！

english: Of course. Please note that this means I will no longer send the essence to your bank, as I will give it to you instead.
translation: 当然。请注意，这意味着我不再把精华送到你的银行，而是直接交给你。

english: Well, in that case, what's not to trust. What challenges do you have available for me?
translation: 好吧，既然这样，那还有什么不可信的。你有什么挑战可以给我？

english: Where is everybody else?
translation: 其他人都去哪了？

english: Stand next to your opponent when you are ready.
translation: 准备好后，站到你的对手旁边。

english: I caught my head in a maaaaangle...
translation: 我的头卡进了一台绞肉机里……

english: Human got grain?
translation: 人类有谷物吗？

english: You receive 50x Blighted karambwan.
translation: 你获得了50x 被污染的卡拉姆班鱼。

english: Excellent! Was she able to point you in the right direction?
translation: 太好了！她能给你指明正确的方向吗？

english: Not for us to know. All I care about is the runes they'll give us.
translation: 这不是我们该知道的。我只在乎他们会给我们的符文。

english: Well, it's done now, so little point dwelling on it.
translation: 唉，现在都已经这样了，再纠结也没用。

english: You got big dog for goblins?
translation: 你给哥布林找到大狗了吗？

english: Pay 200 Coins?
translation: 支付200金币？

english: Hold on... I can still see some adults out there.
translation: 等等……我还能看到外面有一些成年人。

english: Noooooooooooooo! Lil' guy!
translation: 不ooooooooooooo！小家伙！

english: Not always.
translation: 并非总是如此。

english: That was a close call. That's the second time we got lucky and arrived just in time.
translation: 真是千钧一发。这是我们第二次运气好，及时赶到了。

english: I sell tools that chop. Near where adventures begin. Come visit my shop.
translation: 我卖砍伐用的工具。就在冒险开始的地方附近。来光顾我的商店吧。

english: Bork smash [player name] now.
translation: 博克现在砸碎[player name]。

english: To stand against good is to be evil, regardless of reason.
translation: 与善为敌即为恶，无论理由为何。

english: First Mysterious Voice
translation: 第一个神秘声音

english: Nonsense, it is we who are grateful! Think nothing of it, [player name].
translation: 胡说，该感激的是我们！别放在心上，[player name]。

english: 100 years, the turnout is significantly bigger. Legends say that they're echoes of a time where our population boomed. One of those ceremonies will happen in a couple of days.
translation: 100年，出席的人数会多得多。传说那是我们人口繁盛时期的回响。其中一场仪式将在几天后举行。

english: Prompt to sign up for membership appears.
translation: 出现注册会员的提示。

english: It could be luck, but you did give me the correct answer.
translation: 也许是运气，但你确实给了我正确答案。

english: Er... Hi?
translation: 呃……你好？

english: That's not the right item to add.
translation: 那不是正确的添加物品。

english: It's unlikely, but they could take that further now. They could consider joining the fight against him.
translation: 不太可能，但他们现在可能会更进一步。他们可能会考虑加入对抗他的战斗。

english: You successfully dye your Hat of the Eye.
translation: 你成功地为你的眼之帽染色。

english: So you think Guthix believed the world would be ready for them eventually, and you don't want to leave the Archive inaccessible?
translation: 所以你认为古斯相信世界最终会为他们做好准备，而你不想让档案馆无法进入？

english: Get back 'ere!
translation: 给我回来！

english: You dip the onion in the molten sugar and it quickly forms a hardened shell.
translation: 你把洋葱浸入融化的糖中，它很快形成了一层硬壳。

english: You're alive!
translation: 你还活着！

english: The costs are changing!
translation: 费用正在变化！

english: You fight well, but you will bow to me eventually.
translation: 你打得不错，但你最终会向我臣服。

english: How are the defence efforts going?
translation: 防御工作进展如何？

english: You need a raw chicken to do that.
translation: 你需要一只生鸡肉才能那样做。

english: I'm a valuable asset!
translation: 我可是宝贵的资产！

english: Choose your next move wisely.
translation: 明智地选择你的下一步。

english: Father Sugadinti is in need of... specimens. I'll happily take any grown dogs off your hands.
translation: 苏加丁蒂神父需要……标本。我很乐意接手你手上任何成年的狗。

english: I am not touching that without a good reason.
translation: 没有正当理由我是不会碰那个的。

english: No, you've been caught red-handed. Come clean, now, what are you doing here!
translation: 不，你被当场抓住了。坦白吧，你在这里做什么！

english: The holiday event is not available on PvP worlds or Deadman worlds other than permanent.
translation: 节日活动在PvP世界或非永久的Deadman世界中不可用。

english: I can agree with that, I suppose.
translation: 我想我可以同意这一点。

english: I'll cry and cry if you won't give me sweets!
translation: 你要是不给我糖果，我就一直哭一直哭！

english: The record keeper is a wizard?
translation: 记录保管员是个魔法师？

english: Sounds like Glough is hiding something!
translation: 听起来格劳夫在隐瞒什么！

english: Let me get this clear, you want me to find out who poisoned you, find out what they poisoned you with, find out how to make that poison and then produce enough poison to affect a lot of people?
translation: 让我理清楚，你想让我查出是谁给你下毒、查出他们用什么毒害你、查出如何制造那种毒药，然后生产出足够影响很多人的毒药？

english: General Toetaller and General Picklenose have good ring to them.
translation: 脚趾高将军和腌鼻子将军听起来挺不错。

english: That's it! 2...
translation: 就是这样！2……

english: Human, you do good. Goblins return to village heroes.
translation: 人类，你做得很好。哥布林回到村庄成为英雄。

english: Pete is the only person I've seen return through those barriers after leaving them.
translation: 皮特是我见过的唯一一个离开那些屏障后又回来的人。

english: When the seal ebbs we shall begin.
translation: 当封印消退时我们就开始。

english: Well, I can't go back and exorcise it. I vowed not to leave this place until I had done a full two years of prayer and meditation.
translation: 唉，我没法回去驱除它。我发誓在完成整整两年的祈祷和冥想之前不离开这个地方。

english: Ask about the Holy Grail Quest.
translation: 询问圣杯任务的事。

english: Are you sure you wish to revert your Amulet of the Eye? The dye used will not be returned.
translation: 你确定要将眼之护符恢复原样吗？所使用的染料不会退还。

english: You see, there's this one crab... He's kind and funny... and handsome! When he's around I feel like everything is going to be okay. But unfortunately, I can't even look at him!
translation: 你看，有这么一只蟹……他善良又风趣……还很英俊！他在身边时我觉得一切都会好起来。但不幸的是，我连看都不能看他一眼！

english: Thank you once again, adventurer. You've really given us hope to keep going.
translation: 再次感谢你，冒险者。你真的给了我们继续下去的希望。

english: Giants... not just...
translation: 巨人……不只是……

english: Greetings! In this scenario, you'll practice switching prayers in response to your opponent switching equipment. This is a vital skill out in the wilds!
translation: 你好！在这个场景中，你将练习根据对手切换装备来切换祈祷。这是野外生存的重要技能！

english: Yes, and I tell you to keep practising!
translation: 是的，我让你继续练习！

english: Surely pretty is an understatement, lady. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 女士，说漂亮肯定是轻描淡写了。美丽、惊艳或者可能改变人生会更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？它是以埋葬在瀑布下的精灵国王命名的。

english: Certainly. Where would you like to go?
translation: 当然。你想去哪里？

english: It's fine. Nothing for you to worry about.
translation: 没事。没什么需要你担心的。

english: Not long until I can take a nap now.
translation: 很快我就能小睡一会儿了。

english: Azzanadra was a Mahjarrat hero. He was unkillable, and the cowardly traitors who stole our lands did not know what to do with him, for his hatred for them was as strong as his magics.
translation: 阿扎纳德拉是一位玛哈加特英雄。他无法被杀死，那些偷走我们土地的懦弱叛徒不知拿他怎么办，因为他对他们的仇恨和他的魔法一样强大。

english: Who else would you have taken?
translation: 不然你还能带谁？

english: Not long now for human army to crumble!
translation: 人类军队很快就撑不住了！

english: We'll overload it using the power contained in this very Archive!
translation: 我们将用这座档案馆本身蕴含的力量使其超载！

english: Charles goes round in circles explaining basic meteorological concepts.
translation: 查尔斯绕来绕去地解释基本的气象概念。

english: Free?
translation: 免费？

english: That's doubtful, unless magic is involved.
translation: 那不太可能，除非涉及魔法。

english: We've met so many people that might be able to...
translation: 我们遇到了很多人，他们也许能……

english: While I do this, could you find some more crabs willing to be ceremonial leaders? The sooner we start practising together, the better we will sound.
translation: 在我做这件事的时候，你能再找一些愿意担任仪式领队的蟹吗？我们越早一起练习，声音就会越好听。

english: Well, this doesn't sound totally orthodox, but fair enough. I'll be back soon.
translation: 嗯，这听起来不太正统，但好吧。我很快回来。

english: ...You successfully picked the second lock!
translation: ……你成功撬开了第二把锁！

english: A quest you say? Hmm... What an odd request to make of the King. It's funny you should mention it though, as there is something you can do for me.
translation: 你说任务？嗯……向国王提出这种请求可真奇怪。不过你提得正好，确实有件事你可以为我做。

english: Ocellus? I'm not familiar with this name.
translation: Ocellus？我对这个名字不熟悉。

english: What did you have in mind?
translation: 你有什么打算？

english: Shark-Brew-Karam, it's all about timing!
translation: 鲨鱼-酿酒-卡拉姆，全靠时机！

english: You need some raw jubbly meat to do that.
translation: 你需要一些生胖食人鸟肉才能这样做。

english: You know you have to feed dogs to keep them alive?
translation: 你知道你得喂狗才能让它们活下去吗？

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要为你的眼之长袍上衣重新着色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换任何现有的重新着色。

english: Did you build it?
translation: 是你建的吗？

english: Oh, this is easy! And I haven't even started eating the pieces.
translation: 哦，这很简单！而且我甚至还没开始吃棋子呢。

english: You receive 100x Blighted entangle sack.
translation: 你获得了100个被污染的缠绕袋。

english: You will lose any birds and seed in the birdhouse.
translation: 你将失去鸟屋中的所有鸟和种子。

english: Revert your Amulet of the Eye?
translation: 将你的眼之护符恢复原样？

english: Practice is on the beach. What do you have to lose? Besides, the sea will only be a scuttle away if it doesn't work out.
translation: 练习在海滩上进行。你有什么可失去的？再说，如果不成，大海就在几步之外。

english: [player name]? Kuani! Pleased to meet you. Crown Prince Itzla Arkan, heir to the Sun Throne, at your service.
translation: [player name]？库阿尼！很高兴见到你。太阳王座继承人，伊茨拉.阿坎王储，愿为你效劳。

english: You hand in an unassuming cream shell.
translation: 你交上了一枚不起眼的奶油色贝壳。

english: But tamed, fire gives us food and warmth. A dangerous thing isn't inherently bad, it just needs to be learned slowly and carefully.
translation: 但被驯服后，火能为我们提供食物和温暖。危险的东西本身并不坏，只是需要缓慢而谨慎地去学习。

english: I hope he's ready for us, because once we do locate him, we're going to give him quite the bloody nose... or at least whatever passes for a nose on a Mahjarrat!
translation: 我希望他已经准备好迎接我们了，因为一旦我们找到他，就要狠狠揍他一顿……至少是揍玛哈加特身上算作鼻子的那个部位！

english: This doesn't frighten me, I've fought the queen of the Kalphites!
translation: 这吓不倒我，我可是和卡尔夫特虫女王交过手的！

english: Ohoho, time to pounce!
translation: 哦呵呵，该扑上去了！

english: No, thank you. I won't be selling any dogs today.
translation: 不，谢谢。我今天不会卖任何狗。

english: Fine, take it!
translation: 好吧，拿去！

english: A life not lived is a mind not opened.
translation: 未曾经历的人生，便是未曾开启的心智。

english: You need a piece of leather, some thread and a needle to fix this.
translation: 你需要一块皮革、一些线和一根针来修理这个。

english: No way! You'll just take my gold for your own! Reported!
translation: 没门！你只会拿走我的金币据为己有！我要举报你！

english: You watch Thurgo greedily gobble down the pie.
translation: 你看着瑟戈贪婪地大口吞下馅饼。

english: Well, I'm going to guess asking nicely won't work.
translation: 好吧，我猜好好请求是行不通的。

english: Well done. A strong defense will take you far!
translation: 干得好。强大的防御会让你走得更远！

english: As for the forces of Lucien and Zamorak, we spotted a clash between the two factions in some of the deeper tunnels. An army of skeletons facing off against a group of Zamorakian mages.
translation: 至于卢西安和扎莫拉克的势力，我们在一些较深的隧道里发现两派发生了冲突。一支骷髅大军正与一群扎莫拉克法师对峙。

english: There is some raw jubbly meat placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一些生胖食人鸟肉。

english: Good! 3...
Our time for discussion runs short, [player name]. Let us return to our duties.
translation: 我们讨论的时间不多了，[player name]。让我们回到各自的职责中去吧。

english: If you beat me, I'll give you some vouchers you can take to Justine. I'm ready whenever you are.
translation: 如果你打败我，我会给你一些代金券，你可以拿去给贾斯汀。你准备好了我随时奉陪。

english: You know... I'm sure I could MAKE you tell me where he is...
translation: 你知道……我确信我能逼你说出他在哪里……

english: Never! I'll never join the ranks of the walking dead!
translation: 绝不！我绝不会加入行尸走肉的行列！

english: Hi, your highness, did you think about what I said?
translation: 您好，殿下，您考虑过我说的话了吗？

english: You inspect the scraps on the floor...
translation: 你仔细查看地上的碎片……

english: While you're here, shall I give you a tour of the estate? My lineage has been living in this magic tree for at least 200 years.
translation: 既然你来了，要不要我带你参观一下庄园？我的家族在这棵魔法树里至少住了200年。

english: You pinned the tail to the cow's rear end.
translation: 你把尾巴钉在了奶牛的后端。

english: Has the stray dog come back this way? I can't find her.
translation: 那只流浪狗有回到这边来吗？我找不到她了。

english: Show Chase your cat ears?
translation: 向蔡斯展示你的猫耳？

english: You manage to clear the channel of rocks.
translation: 你成功清除了水道中的岩石。

english: Hello again, your highness.
translation: 又见面了，殿下。

english: That is... unfortunate to hear. I trust you understand, [player name], that a weapon as powerful as that was not meant for any mortal. None can be allowed to claim it... not even a fellow servant of Guthix.
translation: 这……听来真是不幸。我相信你明白，[player name]，像那样强大的武器本就不是为任何凡人准备的。谁都不能被允许占有它……即便是古斯的同道仆从也不行。

english: This island is covered in crabs. I am sure I could find a way to get that info out of you.
translation: 这座岛上到处都是蟹。我确信我能找到办法让你开口。

english: If this is a fight of attrition, so be it.
translation: 如果这是一场消耗战，那就来吧。

english: Wonderful! Let's go tell Talia!
translation: 太好了！我们去告诉塔莉亚吧！

english: Err... nope. Sorry.
translation: 呃……没有。抱歉。

english: If Bork was the second boss:
translation: 如果博克是第二个首领：

english: Is my move next, Bentnoze!
translation: 接下来该我走了吗，本特诺兹！

english: That nice man Diango in Draynor Village should have some costumes if you need one.
translation: 如果你需要服装，德雷诺村里那个好人迪亚戈应该有一些。

english: Perhaps you're not cut out for my games.
translation: 也许你并不适合我的游戏。

english: I have a dog if you're interested.
translation: 如果你有兴趣，我有一只狗。

english: You inspect the signpost more closely. You see nothing wrong with it initially, but after some time you notice teeth marks in the wood... it looks like several people have tried eating the post.
translation: 你更仔细地查看路标。起初你没发现有什么问题，但过了一会儿你注意到木头上有牙印……看起来有好几个人试图啃过这根柱子。

english: Is that a coin? Must be me lucky day!
translation: 那是一枚硬币吗？今天一定是我的幸运日！

english: There are six peripheral chambers we expect to come under attack, all of which can be reached from the Nexus. As soon as the Nexus is secured, we will begin deploying troops to the furthest chambers.
translation: 我们预计有六个外围密室会遭到攻击，它们都可以从枢纽到达。一旦枢纽被守住，我们就会开始向最远的密室部署部队。

english: Hey, I recognise you two! You were part of the delegation to Varrock!
translation: 嘿，我认得你们俩！你们是前往维洛克城的代表团成员！

english: There is a thick layer of ice covering this troll. You will have to find some way of shattering it.
translation: 这只巨魔身上覆盖着一层厚厚的冰。你得想办法把它击碎。

english: Upon entering the Archive, the company encountered the dormant guardian. It is a tragedy that it had to be destroyed but it could not recognise friend from foe. The Nexus was too crucial a position for us to hold.
translation: 进入档案馆时，队伍遭遇了沉睡的守护者。不得不摧毁它实属悲剧，但它无法分辨敌友。枢纽对我们来说太重要了，不能失守。

english: The Husky heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 哈士奇前往狗收容所。

english: Try to open the chest?
translation: 尝试打开宝箱？

english: Sylas mumbles to himself absent-mindedly. He appears to be looking for something in his pockets.
translation: 赛拉斯心不在焉地自言自语。他似乎正在口袋里找什么东西。

english: Being among my idols would be my dream, but it would kind of ruin the magic. I prefer just being in the crowd watching the show!
translation: 成为我的偶像之一会是我的梦想，但那多少会破坏魔法的效果。我更喜欢待在人群中观看表演！

english: Anyway, I just want a year off from the ceremony. It's not too much to ask! I hear it's going to be even more crowded this year. Nobody will mind if I skip.
translation: 总之，我只想从仪式中休息一年。这要求不算过分！我听说今年会更拥挤。我缺席没人会介意的。

english: Thank you! We'll get you set up with some things for her, free of charge!
translation: 谢谢你！我们会免费为她准备一些东西！

english: You'd better start listenin', young dog!!
translation: 你最好开始听着，小狗！！

english: Any idea where to look?
translation: 知道该去哪里找吗？

english: I suppose not. Even I don't have the answer.
translation: 我想也是。连我也不知道答案。

english: Tears of Guthix.
translation: 古斯之泪。

english: Using a range cuts down the possibilty of burning the food. In fact, the range in the Lumbridge Castle is particularly good for some foods, I hear.
translation: 使用炉灶能降低食物烧焦的可能性。事实上，我听说仑桥镇城堡里的炉灶对某些食物来说特别好用。

english: It's good to have you helping us. Do you need me to re-enchant your crystal teleport seeds?
translation: 很高兴你能来帮我们。需要我帮你重新附魔水晶传送种子吗？

english: She sure is. Where do you sail to?
translation: 她确实是。你要航行去哪里？

english: Supplies are ready!
translation: 补给品准备好了！

english: Let me through!
translation: 让我过去！

english: Outlandish story or not, she did retrieve the horn.
translation: 不管故事多离奇，她确实取回了号角。

english: Toetaller accept trade, no takesies backsies. Human promise.
translation: 脚趾高个接受交易，不许反悔。人类承诺。

english: No, I do not wish to proceed.
translation: 不，我不想继续。

english: Wow! That tunnel went a long way.
translation: 哇！那条隧道好长啊。

english: Change weapon and special attack the five opponents without them praying correctly!
translation: 更换武器并使用战技攻击五名对手，且不让他们正确祈祷！

english: That... was unfortunate. No matter.
translation: 那……真是不幸。无妨。

english: It seems the Stone of Jas wasn't the only thing Guthix hid down here. This Archive was built to house various other powerful artefacts, to stop them falling into the wrong hands.
translation: 看来贾斯之石并不是古斯藏在这里的唯一东西。这座档案馆是为了存放各种其他强大文物而建的，以防它们落入坏人之手。

english: Outlandish story or not, they did retrieve the horn.
translation: 不管故事多离奇，他们确实取回了号角。

english: Not anywhere for now!
translation: 目前哪儿也不去！

english: Can't you go out to look for strays then?
translation: 那你就不能出去找找流浪狗吗？

english: Sure, I make mistakes, but learning from mistakes makes you wiser!
translation: 当然，我会犯错，但从错误中学习会让人更明智！

english: What does your client use them for?
translation: 你的客户用它们做什么？

english: Thank you! We've almost got enough to make a tune. One more?
translation: 谢谢！我们快凑够一首曲子了。再来一个？

english: No need to... get upset... you're scar ing the cat.
translation: 没必要……发火……你吓到猫了。

english: A crab appears!
translation: 一只蟹出现了！

english: Well, you'll be able to adopt any puppies you bring back.
translation: 那么，你带回来的任何小狗你都可以领养。

english: You're just going to wait here till the puppy is fully grown?
translation: 你就打算在这里一直等到小狗完全长大？

english: Human got fur?
translation: 人类有毛皮吗？

english: The children of Scabaras are eternal!
translation: 斯卡巴拉斯之子永存！

english: Uh oh! Big dog!
translation: 哎呀！大狗！

english: This is growing boring. Shall we spice it up?
translation: 这越来越无聊了。我们来点刺激的？

english: Here you go [player name], it's all yours!
translation: 给你[player name]，都是你的了！

english: Almost there! 1...
translation: 快好了！1……

english: It doesn't sound positive.
translation: 听起来不太妙。

english: That is well with me. Variety of perspective, when measured, is an important part of order. The time for discussion runs thin, however. Let us return to our duties.
translation: 我对此没有异议。适度的观点多样性是秩序的重要组成部分。不过，讨论的时间不多了。让我们回到各自的职责上吧。

english: Ah, thanks a lot for the key, traveller.
translation: 啊，非常感谢你的钥匙，旅行者。

english: Play us a song!
translation: 给我们弹一首歌吧！

english: Do you want to go to the mainland? Or would you like to talk to the Ironman tutor first to learn about becoming an Ironman?
translation: 你想去大陆吗？还是想先和铁人导师谈谈，了解如何成为铁人？

english: Obliteration...
translation: 湮灭……

english: Better!
translation: 好多了！

english: Toetaller no see huge dog?
translation: 脚趾高个没看见大狗？

english: No? There are ruins on this island that look like they were made by my kind.
translation: 没有？这座岛上有一些废墟，看起来像是我的同类建造的。

english: Perhaps. Saradominists often seem... at odds with Guthix and his followers.
translation: 也许吧。萨拉多明信徒似乎常常……与古斯及其追随者不和。

english: Please never attempt this again.
translation: 请永远不要再尝试这个。

english: Don't worry. Lucien, Ocellus, or anyone else who tries to use them... Well, they'll first have to contend with me, and with all of us who oppose their evil.
translation: 别担心。卢西安、奥塞勒斯，或任何其他试图利用它们的人……好吧，他们首先得对付我，以及我们所有对抗他们邪恶的人。

english: I picked a fungus that grew when I cast the bloom spell.
translation: 我采了一朵在我施放绽放法术时长出来的蘑菇。

english: You insert the shard into the slot on the chest, but nothing happens.
translation: 你把碎片插入宝箱上的槽中，但什么也没发生。

english: Well, no, it's just...
translation: 嗯，不，只是……

english: Even if we wanted to let the Z.M.I. have access to our research, the built in security magics would destroy it before trading anyway!
translation: 即使我们想让Z.M.I.接触我们的研究，内置的防护魔法也会在交易前将其摧毁！

english: [player name]! What happened?
translation: [player name]！发生什么了？

english: Er... Anyway, I'm here on behalf of my crab friend down on the beach. He is looking for ceremonial leaders to join him and his new instrument.
translation: 呃……总之，我是代表我在海滩上的蟹朋友来的。他正在寻找仪式领袖，来加入他和他的新乐器。

english: Sweeeeeets!
translation: 太棒啦！

english: Forget it
translation: 算了

english: Finally, we have the inner vault. It is home to the Blade and its guardian, Ocellus. He should be an ally to us, but it seems his time here has driven him quite mad.
translation: 最后，我们来到了内金库。这里是刀片及其守护者奥塞勒斯的所在地。他本应是我们的盟友，但看来他在这里待得太久，已经彻底疯了。

english: I've found Filliman and you should prepare for some sad news.
translation: 我找到了Filliman，你最好做好听到坏消息的准备。

english: Why are you offering knowledge? Do you require gold?
translation: 你为何要传授知识？你需要金子吗？

english: You shouldn't ignore a Genie mistress [player name]?
translation: 你不该无视精灵女主人[player name]？

english: I've not found myself on the back foot like this in a while.
translation: 我已经很久没有像这样陷入被动了。

english: Saradomin, give me strength.
translation: 萨拉多明，赐予我力量。

english: Well, that was a twist, wasn't it?
translation: 好吧，这可真是个转折，不是吗？

english: I'm doing Alfred Grimhands Barcrawl.
translation: 我正在参加Alfred Grimhands的酒吧巡游。

english: Divine judgement!
translation: 神圣裁决！

english: Yes, he looks fat.
translation: 是的，他看起来很胖。

english: Meow-llo. Do you adopt cats?
translation: 喵——你好。你收养猫吗？

english: That's not suitable for carrying wax, and putting it in the hive won't help you handle the bees either.
translation: 那不适合装蜡，而且把它放进蜂巢也帮不了你对付蜜蜂。

english: Please, enter the vault with your allies and report back with what you find. Defend it if necessary. Given there are still other enemies for us to deal with, I'm afraid it is unlikely we will be able to help.
translation: 请你和你的盟友一起进入金库，并回报你们的发现。必要时保卫它。鉴于我们还有其他敌人要对付，恐怕我们不太可能帮上忙。

english: The soldier is busy training.
translation: 这名士兵正忙着训练。

english: I don't think that counts. We can't have a wind instrument. We don't want a percussive instrument. How about a string instrument?
translation: 我觉得那不算数。我们不能用管乐器。我们也不想要打击乐器。弦乐器怎么样？

english: Now faster!
translation: 现在加快速度！

english: That wasn't quite a sphinx riddle now, was it?
translation: 那可不算是斯芬克斯的谜题吧？

english: The Alliance's goals foster the justice I seek. That is enough for me. Now, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us deal with the remaining villains here.
translation: 联盟的目标促进了我所追求的正义。这对我来说就足够了。好了，我想我们能聊的就这么多了。让我们去对付这里剩下的恶棍吧。

english: Sounds like the kind of rescue Talia would be looking for...
translation: 听起来像是塔莉亚会寻找的那种救援……

english: Bran?!
translation: 布兰？！

english: Get yourself a Halloween costume and scare off the trick-or-treaters! Diango in Draynor Village should have something.
translation: 给自己弄一套万圣节服装，把讨糖的人吓跑！德雷诺村的迪亚戈应该有些东西。

english: I trust you saw this coming.
translation: 我相信你早就料到这一步了。

english: The bottle is empty... You feel a sense of longing.
translation: 瓶子是空的……你感到一阵渴望。

english: It may surprise you to know I wanted to be in this situation!
translation: 说出来你可能不信，我正想陷入这种处境！

english: I'm afraid not, my liege. Once you have won, you cannot re-enter.
translation: 恐怕不行，我的君主。一旦你获胜，就不能再进入了。

english: Clever, clever...but is it enough?
translation: 聪明，真聪明……但这就够了吗？

english: Thanks for your help! Here, you can take our dad's Halloween costume. He won't be needing it any time soon!
translation: 谢谢你的帮助！来，你可以拿走我们爸爸的万圣节服装。他短时间内用不上了！

english: I think I have enough fragments for now.
translation: 我想我现在的碎片已经够多了。

english: Cheers! We've got 10 different notes. That beats the last ceremony, but we can do better still.
translation: 干杯！我们已经有10种不同的音符了。这比上次仪式强，但我们还能做得更好。

english: Azali, come with me.
translation: Azali，跟我来。

english: Sides
translation: 配菜

english: Your king hides, but not for long!
translation: 你的国王在躲藏，但躲不了多久！

english: You don't sound convinced.
translation: 你听起来不太信服。

english: Human even listen to goblins now?
translation: 人类现在甚至听哥布林说话了？

english: You're doing well.
translation: 你做得很好。

english: I'm the Alliance's travelling liaison with the Bank of Gielinor. I make sure everybody has everything they need, wherever we go.
translation: 我是联盟与吉里诺银行之间的流动联络员。无论我们走到哪里，我都确保每个人都有所需的一切。

english: Kayer... Pete Kayer. It is a pleasure to meet your acquaintance. I've settled in the Ferox Enclave to offer my expertise to passersby.
translation: Kayer……Pete Kayer。很高兴认识你。我已经在费罗飞地安顿下来，向路人提供我的专长。

english: On the other hand, we don't mingle. Our ceremony takes place on an exclusive section of beach. We grow up in a private tide pool. Our bloodline is pure.
translation: 另一方面，我们不与外人来往。我们的仪式在一片专属海滩上进行。我们在私人潮池中长大。我们的血统纯正。

english: Oh and don't worry about getting hurt. You're perfectly safe here.
translation: 哦，别担心受伤。你在这里绝对安全。

english: Good hit! 4/5.
Say, would you be able to help us, mister? If you could get rid of the trick or treaters, then we'd get to keep the lot!
translation: 我说，先生，你能帮帮我们吗？如果你能把那些讨糖的人赶走，那我们就能留下全部糖果了！

english: Your Robe top of the Eye (blue) has been reverted.
translation: 你的眼之长袍上衣 (蓝) 已还原。

english: Never was a fan of that one.
translation: 从来就不喜欢那个。

english: Could you fish what you need from that floating rubbish?
translation: 你能从那些漂浮的垃圾里钓出你需要的东西吗？

english: Look at mould jig...
translation: 查看模具夹具……

english: Talia, Chase! I have returned.
translation: 塔莉亚，Chase！我回来了。

english: Braaaaains!
Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给你的眼之长袍下装重新着色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换任何现有的重新着色。

english: Picklenose have idea.
translation: 腌黄瓜鼻有主意了。

english: Once we're settled in, my job involves a lot of standing around. There's only so much you can appreciate a cavern, even one as impressive as this.
translation: 等我们安顿下来，我的工作大部分时间就是站着。洞穴再壮观，你能欣赏的也有限。

english: Use those legs to move the sand and gently and push it away.
translation: 用你那几条腿把沙子轻轻推开。

english: That's none of your business!
translation: 这不关你的事！

english: Come on, I don't want to attack a dog.
translation: 拜托，我不想攻击一只狗。

english: Does that mean you won't join?
translation: 那是不是意味着你不会加入？

english: Not quite!
translation: 还差一点！

english: Everything... ends...
translation: 一切……都会……终结……

english: I grow a little restless, to be frank. Things are going a little slowly.
translation: 说实话，我有点坐不住了。事情进展得有点慢。

english: The adamant medium helm is free to convert!
translation: 精金中型头盔可以免费转换！

english: Hello, human. What you want?
translation: 你好，人类。你想要什么？

english: Why did I give up my firemaking apprencticeship for this!
translation: 我为什么要为了这个放弃生火学徒的身份！

english: You need a raw swordfish to do that.
translation: 你需要一条生剑鱼才能这么做。

english: There you go kid, try not to eat too much!
translation: 给你，孩子，别吃太多！

english: So it was all a scam...
translation: 原来这一切都是骗局……

english: I like her already.
translation: 我已经喜欢上她了。

english: You shouldn't take mice from a cat.
translation: 你不该从猫那里抢老鼠。

english: Right?
translation: 对吧？

english: Am I doing this right?
translation: 我这样做对吗？

english: Oh man... I think I've messed up... Maybe Savant can help me out somehow? I'd better speak to her.
translation: 哦天哪……我想我搞砸了……也许学者能帮我想想办法？我最好去找她谈谈。

english: Lucien's forces are being led by someone called Moia. Our records have little information on her, but if Lucien has trusted her with this task, we must assume she is very dangerous.
translation: 卢西安的部队由一位名叫Moia的人率领。我们的记录中关于她的信息很少，但如果卢西安把这项任务托付给她，我们必须假定她非常危险。

english: I can see that...
translation: 我看得出来……

english: They've been ripped up by something with small teeth.
translation: 它们被某种长着小牙齿的东西撕碎了。

english: I will try and ask your crush to join.
translation: 我会试着去请你的心上人加入。

english: People make assumptions about things they think they understand. And assumptions about magic this complex and this powerful are dangerous.
translation: 人们会对自以为理解的事物妄下假设。而对如此复杂、如此强大的魔法妄下假设是危险的。

english: The company faced down Ezekiel, a legendary justiciar of Saradomin. He sought access to the Archive's inner vault, and had judged any who would stand against him as servants of evil. He should have been a natural ally, but our words could not cut through his zealotry.
translation: 该团体直面了Ezekiel，一位萨拉多明传说中的审判官。他企图进入档案馆的内金库，并将任何胆敢反对他的人判定为邪恶的仆从。他本应是天然的盟友，但我们的言辞无法穿透他的狂热。

english: Not yet. Do you remember what I needed?
translation: 还没有。你还记得我需要什么吗？

english: You melt the sugar into a sticky liquid.
translation: 你把糖融化成黏稠的液体。

english: Deaaaad? What do you mean, I'm alive!
translation: 死——了？你什么意思，我还活着！

english: Perhaps that can go in the bank for now.
translation: 也许暂时可以把它存进银行。

english: You break open the fragment of deep water and consume its power. Water spells will have an increased max hit of +2.
translation: 你打碎了深水碎片并吸收了它的力量。水系法术的最大伤害将提高+2。

english: If you want to.
translation: 如果你想的话。

english: That is a worthy quest if I have ever heard one.
translation: 这是我听过的最值得一做的任务。

english: It's alright. Sometimes we all have to make tough choices.
translation: 没关系。有时候我们都不得不做出艰难的选择。

english: That sounds quite interesting actually.
translation: 那听起来其实挺有意思的。

english: Goblin not fast enough that time.
translation: 哥布林那次不够快。

english: The stray dog barks in the direction of the scent.
translation: 流浪狗朝着气味的方向吠叫。

english: What is it, girl?
translation: 怎么了，姑娘？

english: I'm afraid you'll need to empty your inventory and what you are wearing before I can return your items.
translation: 恐怕你需要先清空背包和身上穿戴的物品，我才能归还你的东西。

english: Who's a beautiful girl?
translation: 谁是漂亮姑娘呀？

english: You want me to play the lyre? Well actually, I've been working on a few tunes in my spare time. I have this new song abou-
translation: 你想让我弹竖琴？嗯，其实我一直在空闲时间练习几首曲子。我有一首新歌，是关于——

english: Let us see if you're worthy of this!
translation: 让我们看看你是否有资格得到这个！

english: Good! Press your advantage!
translation: 好！乘胜追击！

english: It's okay girl, you'll be safe here and well cared for.
translation: 没事的，姑娘，你在这里会很安全，也会得到很好的照顾。

english: Certainly! You've survived everything I've thrown at you so far, but don't expect another lesson. This time, I'm not holding back.
translation: 当然！到目前为止，你已经挺过了我向你抛出的所有挑战，但别指望还有下一课。这一次，我不会手下留情。

english: You can sway and wave your claws in time with the music if you want to...
translation: 如果你愿意，可以随着音乐摇摆，并挥动你的钳子……

english: I should go and let Eblis know what's happened here...
translation: 我该去告诉埃布利斯这里发生的事了……

english: A bass.
translation: 一条鲈鱼。

english: Oh, not again!
translation: 哦，又来了！

english: Wait, what do you mean, 10? We just had 3 with the last shell I brought!
translation: 等等，你说10是什么意思？我上次带来的贝壳才让我们有了3个！

english: Use the Account Recovery system.
translation: 使用账户恢复系统。

english: See, girl! I told you girls could be ceremonial leaders!
translation: 看吧，姑娘！我告诉过你，姑娘们也能当仪式领袖！

english: Watch it!
translation: 小心点！

english: What do you mean by 'fix the mess I created'?
translation: 你说的“收拾我造成的烂摊子”是什么意思？

english: How do that?
translation: 那要怎么做？

english: ... and then I woke up on the beach with a fuzzy head, wondering whether this whole crab adventure was all a dream...
translation: ……然后我在海滩上醒来，脑袋昏昏沉沉，心想这整场螃蟹冒险是不是一场梦……

english: This part of the railing seems fine.
translation: 这段栏杆看起来没问题。

english: Big bomb! Bork watch out!
translation: 大炸弹！Bork 小心！

english: Every year, my kin comes down from the heights and gathers on the beach. There, we perform the ceremonial dance and build sand nests to try and find a mate.
translation: 每年，我的同类都会从高处下来，聚集在海滩上。在那里，我们表演仪式舞蹈，堆筑沙巢，试图找到伴侣。

english: Clockwork toy
translation: 发条玩具

english: You know? I feel bad spying on him like this. I wish I could just walk to him and find out how he feels about me.
translation: 你知道吗？这样偷偷观察他让我感觉很不好。我真希望能直接走到他面前，弄清楚他对我的感觉。

english: Extended cup o' char? E's tellin' porkies! We know those alchemi-whatsits are up ta somefin' weird in building this tower, wot wiv all the machinery, and until we get some answers we're not movin a muscle.
translation: 加长茶歇？他在胡说八道！我们知道那些炼金什么玩意儿在建这座塔时搞了些古怪名堂，还弄了那么多机械，在得到答案之前，我们一步也不会动。

english: Hiss! I was saving that for later!
translation: 嘶！我本来留着以后用的！

english: After all this, I still had to trek all the way to the beach.
translation: 经历了这一切，我还是得一路跋涉到海滩。

english: Come now, I prefer the term 'tourism'. Did you not enjoy your stay in Pollnivneach? Was there not action, intrigue and fun to be had? Didn't my colleagues deliver a fantastic adventure?
translation: 得了吧，我更喜欢“旅游业”这个说法。你在波尼尼镇待得不开心吗？那里难道没有刺激、阴谋和乐趣吗？我的同事们难道没有献上一场精彩的冒险吗？

english: For now, but don't get too attached. Heard tale some folk down in Morytania buy 'em when they're fully grown.
translation: 目前是这样，但别太投入感情。听说莫利塔尼亚那边有些人会在它们长大后把它们买走。

english: The crab appears to turn bright red.
translation: 这只螃蟹似乎变得鲜红。

english: Place all your finds in the crate.
translation: 把你找到的所有东西都放进箱子里。

english: 'Ello der, [player name]! *hic*
translation: 你好啊，[player name]！*嗝*

english: Check seed levels.
translation: 检查种子等级。

english: Sorry mate, this is my spot.
translation: 抱歉，伙计，这是我的位置。

english: That is... very astute! I must note that down. Oh, before you go, can I have a carapace sample?
translation: 这真是……非常敏锐！我得记下来。哦，在你走之前，能给我一份甲壳样本吗？

english: At times, sacrifice is necessary.
translation: 有时，牺牲是必要的。

english: Ha! It is I that should be thanking you, young [player name]. I understand you were the first to help rally this group, and it is a fine group indeed.
translation: 哈！该道谢的是我，年轻的[player name]。我知道你是第一个帮忙召集这支队伍的人，而这确实是一支优秀的队伍。

english: To pass you must answer me this: My friend asks me for my password so that he can do a difficult quest for me. Do I give it to him?
translation: 要通过，你必须回答我这个问题：我的朋友向我要密码，好替我完成一个困难的任务。我该给他吗？

english: So, how goes the practice?
translation: 那么，练习得怎么样了？

english: How big?
translation: 有多大？

english: I suppose. How many do we need?
translation: 我想是吧。我们需要多少个？

english: I won't be going easy on you, understand that.
translation: 我不会对你手下留情，明白吗。

english: Ho ho ho!
translation: 呵呵呵！

english: Indeed, but I didn't find that out until much later. On the kings orders, I travelled through the Underground Pass and into the western lands of Tirannwn.
translation: 确实如此，但我很久以后才知道。奉国王之命，我穿过地下通道，进入了提尔安农的西部土地。

english: Carpet rides cost 200 coins.
translation: 地毯飞行花费200金币。

english: Clockwork mechanism
translation: 发条机械装置

english: They opposed you? Who were they?
translation: 他们反对你？他们是谁？

english: Thank you, [player name], and good luck.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]，祝你好运。

english: Well, that's what we're here to find out! Without the roots, the crystals are fully exposed for collection.
translation: 嗯，这正是我们来这里要弄清楚的！没有了树根，水晶就完全暴露出来，可以采集了。

english: How is that possible?
translation: 那怎么可能？

english: OK I will go do all that.
translation: 好，我会去把这些都办了。

english: Bork get into it!
translation: Bork 加入进来！

english: Well, just look here to my dear companion, Primio, and you'll have your answer. Varlamore is a large and diverse kingdom, but thanks to our quetzals, navigating it is as straightforward as can be.
translation: 嗯，看看我亲爱的伙伴普里米奥，你就知道答案了。瓦拉莫尔是一个辽阔而多样的王国，但多亏了我们的绿咬鹃，在其中穿行再简单不过了。

english: Your liveliness is making my day so much brighter, my load so much lighter. Who needs the sea when the sun is warmer?
translation: 你的活力让我的日子明亮了许多，让我的负担轻了许多。阳光更温暖时，谁还需要大海呢？

english: Hey there! How's it going?
translation: 嘿！最近怎么样？

english: To pass you must answer me this: Is it okay to buy an Old School RuneScape account?
translation: 要通过，你必须回答我这个问题：购买 Old School RuneScape 账号可以吗？

english: Your evil plots end at me!
translation: 你的邪恶阴谋到此为止！

english: But they're gone now and you don't seem too happy about it.
translation: 但它们现在不在了，而你看起来并不太高兴。

english: Keep your health high!
translation: 保持你的生命值充足！

english: No, they are still on their way. We came ahead of time to scout out the situation.
translation: 不，他们还在路上。我们提前赶来侦察情况。

english: I... just want to retract my eyes and feel saltwater wash all over me. Taking me back to a time when I was a child and things were simple. Where the weight of life didn't feel so... heavy.
translation: 我……只想缩回眼睛，感受咸涩的海水冲刷全身。带我回到童年，回到一切都很简单的时光。那时生活的重担还不那么……沉重。

english: Ocellus said none could resist its power. In truth, I think that might have included him. He claimed none were worthy of claiming it, and yet was happy to try and use it himself.
translation: 奥塞勒斯说无人能抵挡它的力量。说实话，我觉得他自己可能也包括在内。他声称无人配得上拥有它，却乐于亲自尝试使用它。

english: Grow up.
translation: 成熟点吧。

english: AAAAAAAA!
translation: 啊啊啊啊啊啊！

english: It is perhaps time for me to take a step back.
translation: 也许现在是我退后一步的时候了。

english: Remember, you can leave at any time by using the portals on either side.
translation: 记住，你随时可以使用两侧的传送门离开。

english: Yes, we have every reason to be proud. My only regret is that we were unable to convince more people to form the coalition.
translation: 是的，我们完全有理由感到自豪。我唯一的遗憾是没能说服更多人加入联盟。

english: On him directly, no. However, you're probably already aware that his forces are making quite the attempt to steal more of the artefacts that Guthix hid away.
translation: 直接针对他，没有。不过，你大概已经知道，他的部队正竭力窃取更多古斯藏起来的文物。

english: This looks like a medium pile of sand.
translation: 这看起来像是一堆中等大小的沙子。

english: Human go finish shopping trip then.
translation: 那人类就去把购物办完吧。

english: She indicates towards her puppy.
translation: 她指了指她的小狗。

english: Can I fight these lizardmen?
translation: 我能和这些蜥蜴人战斗吗？

english: Oi, leave that puppy alone!
translation: 喂，别碰那只小狗！

english: Trick or Treat!
translation: 不给糖就捣蛋！

english: Let them do the quest, but in the same room the whole time.
translation: 让他们去做任务，但全程待在同一个房间里。

english: Who can take on my challenges?
translation: 谁能接受我的挑战？

english: Make... giants...
translation: 制造……巨人……

english: Thank you. Good luck.
translation: 谢谢你。祝你好运。

english: That's so rad! I was afraid I'd have to miss out! I've been practising my moves all year, it would have been so off beat to miss out. I've been trialling a shell spin that's going to turn heads!
translation: 太酷了！我还担心自己会错过呢！我练了一整年的动作，错过的话就太不合拍了。我一直在试一个贝壳旋转，绝对会让人眼前一亮！

english: Bran's horn?
translation: 布兰的号角？

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Amulet of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之护符重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料，并替换任何现有的染色。

english: Great. I guess I'll go and see the carpenter then.
translation: 太好了。那我想我就去找木匠吧。

english: Revert your Robe top of the Eye (blue)?
translation: 将眼之长袍上衣 (蓝) 还原？

english: Codename: Peach
translation: 代号：桃子

english: I sincerely doubt that. Actually, talking to another crab, I was under the impression that lineage was very important to crabs.
translation: 我对此深表怀疑。其实，和另一只蟹交谈时，我得到的印象是血统对蟹来说非常重要。

english: Looks like you need to focus on staying alive next time.
translation: 看来下次你需要专注于保命。

english: There is no breach currently occurring, But...
translation: 目前没有发生裂口，但是……

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Amulet of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之护符重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换任何现有的染色。

english: I should have listened to you!
translation: 我早该听你的！

english: Silly human.
translation: 愚蠢的人类。

english: ...Formidable.
translation: ……令人敬畏。

english: Ghommal's luck is already with you.
translation: 戈马尔的运气已经与你同在。

english: Are you sure you wish to alchemically combine the Boots of stone and Drake's claw to create Boots of Brimstone? This cannot be reversed.
translation: 你确定要用炼金术将石靴和亚龙的爪结合，制作硫磺靴吗？此操作无法撤销。

english: Going from left to right, turn each of the five sewer valves so that they follow the design of the amulet. Once you've done that, you'll be able to use the raft.
translation: 从左到右，转动五个下水道阀门，使它们与护符的图案一致。完成后，你就能使用木筏了。

english: We found 'em first. They're ours.
translation: 是我们先找到的。它们归我们。

english: You're the last one, little fella. Come with me.
translation: 你是最后一个了，小家伙。跟我来吧。

english: There is also a goblin warband that has somehow found out about this place. I fear we may have other foes as well that have not yet revealed themselves.
translation: 还有一支哥布林战团不知怎么发现了这个地方。我担心可能还有其他尚未现身的敌人。

english: Who are you, and what are you doing here?
translation: 你是谁，你在这里做什么？

english: I'll admit, that was smooth. I'm still not convinced it's not some kind of trap.
translation: 我承认，那很顺利。但我仍然不相信这不是某种陷阱。

english: Hey [player name]! Pay up or taste my bow!
translation: 嘿 [player name]！付钱，否则尝尝我的弓！

english: Big High War God safe again.
translation: 大高战争神又安全了。

english: That fiery one would be more effort than it is worth, although I appreciate the offer.
translation: 那只火属性的不值得费那个劲，不过我很感激你的提议。

english: And the skeletons?
translation: 那骷髅呢？

english: Could you send the essence to my bank?
translation: 你能把精华送到我的银行吗？

english: Head to the beach to collect your shell.
translation: 去海滩领取你的贝壳。

english: That is a small mercy.
translation: 这算是小小的仁慈。

english: This next stage will test your timing and speed!
translation: 下一阶段将考验你的时机把握和速度！

english: Be this a mutiny, mister [player name]?
translation: 这是要叛变吗，[player name] 先生？

english: The crab clicks its claws threateningly.
translation: 螃蟹威胁性地咔哒作响着钳子。

english: The diamond is absorbed into the pillar...
translation: 钻石被吸收进柱子……

english: You try to use the bone shard on the lock. Although it is about the right size, you find that it just doesn't fit the delicate lock mechanism.
translation: 你试着用骨片撬锁。虽然大小差不多，但你发现它根本不适合这精巧的锁具机械装置。

english: Yes, quite. Now, I believe I have kept you long enough. Let us return to the Archive's defence.
translation: 是的，确实。好了，我想我已经耽搁你够久了。让我们回去保卫档案馆吧。

english: You inspect the crate...
translation: 你检查箱子……

english: Thanks for helping the Alliance.
translation: 感谢你帮助联盟。

english: The rune long sword is free to convert!
translation: 符文长剑可以免费转换！

english: You have done us a great service. I would like to offer you something in return.
translation: 你为我们做出了巨大贡献。我想给你一些回报。

english: Speaking of turning faces, we should tell those funny- smelling humans that we're done.
translation: 说到换脸，我们该告诉那些气味古怪的人类我们完事了。

english: I see... That's unfortunate.
translation: 我明白了……真不幸。

english: Yes. He is my best friend and I already spent ages trying this quest.
translation: 是的。他是我最好的朋友，而且我已经花了很久尝试这个任务。

english: You need at least one bucket of supercompost and two piles of volcanic ash to create ultracompost.
translation: 你至少需要一桶超级堆肥和两堆火山灰才能制作终极堆肥。

english: Looks like you have a seashell with you! Let me take it off you!
translation: 看来你身上有个贝壳！让我把它从你身上拿走吧！

english: The crab serenely scutters away to practise.
translation: 螃蟹平静地匆匆爬走去练习了。

english: You know who this Ocellus is, Ivy?
translation: 你知道这个Ocellus是谁吗，Ivy？

english: No no, I have them right here.
translation: 不不，它们就在我这儿。

english: Human back.
translation: 人类回来了。

english: You hear the sound of a water wheel coming to a standstill.
translation: 你听到水车停止转动的声音。

english: Something prevents you from entering. You think the portal is offended by your imp boxes. They're not popular on imp and impling planes.
translation: 有什么东西阻止你进入。你觉得传送门被你的小恶魔盒子冒犯了。它们在小恶魔和恶魔灵界可不受欢迎。

english: There is a raw chicken placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一只生鸡肉。

english: He has the Stone of Jas and the Staff of Armadyl now. That should give him everything he needs to follow in Zamorak's footsteps, but for whatever reason, he's chosen not to act yet.
translation: 他现在拥有贾斯之石和阿玛杜尔杖。这应该给了他追随扎莫拉克脚步所需的一切，但不知为何，他选择暂不行动。

english: Start the Elemental Workshop II quest?
translation: 开始元素工坊 II任务？

english: The container shakes violently, thrumming with magical energy. However, beyond that, you're not sure what to do with it.
translation: 容器剧烈摇晃，散发着魔法能量的嗡鸣。然而除此之外，你不确定该拿它怎么办。

english: Now, where are those hallowed marks?
translation: 那么，那些圣印在哪儿？

english: How did you see that?
translation: 你是怎么看到的？

english: Well hello there! I hope you have a nice day!
translation: 哎呀你好啊！希望你今天过得愉快！

english: You need to have unlocked the Master tier of Combat Achievement rewards to use this item.
translation: 你需要解锁战斗成就奖励的大师级别才能使用此物品。

english: Second Mysterious Voice
translation: 第二个神秘声音

english: You receive 2x Pete's vouchers.
translation: 你获得了2张Pete的代金券。

english: You hand over some ashes.
translation: 你交出了一些灰烬。

english: You apply the supercompost potion to the bucket of compost.
translation: 你把超级堆肥药水倒在堆肥桶上。

english: Of course I can! Where did you want to go, girl?
translation: 当然可以！你想去哪儿，姑娘？

english: Fine. The angry talking earthquake bids you to become a ceremonial leader this year. Do my bidding, or else!
translation: 好吧。愤怒的会说话的地震命令你今年成为仪式领袖。照我的吩咐做，否则！

english: If you had a tinderbox with you, click on your tinderbox, then click on one of the logs in your inventory, this will attempt to light a fire that you can use for cooking.
translation: 如果你带着火绒盒，点击你的火绒盒，然后点击你物品栏中的一根原木，这会尝试点燃一堆火，你可以用它来烹饪。

english: Bentnoze set you up too good there.
translation: Bentnoze把你安排得太好了。

english: We have company!
translation: 我们有客人了！

english: I am here to take you in, Solus. You can forget your little tricks.
translation: 我是来抓你的，Solus。你可以忘掉你的小把戏了。

english: Dialogue 3:
translation: 对话3：

english: There is an eye of newt placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一只蝾螈眼。

english: The name Bran, Your Majesty.
translation: 名字叫布兰，陛下。

english: Ah, kuani! Well, you'll be pleased to know that Prince Itzla has already granted me permission to give you your very own quetzal, free of charge!
translation: 啊，kuani！好了，你会很高兴知道Itzla王子已经允许我免费送你一只属于你自己的绿咬鹃！

english: Inside the chest, hidden under some rags, you find a Gilded Cross.
translation: 在宝箱里，藏在一堆破布下面，你发现了一个镀金十字架。

english: Goblins soon build advantage over human!
translation: 哥布林很快就会对人类建立优势！

english: This passage doesn't seem to lead anywhere...
translation: 这条通道似乎不通向任何地方……

english: Untether...
translation: 解除束缚……

english: Talking earthquake!
translation: 会说话的地震！

english: What it takes for what?
translation: 为了什么而付出什么？

english: I must get to the heart of the pyramid...
translation: 我必须到达金字塔的中心……

english: Great! That's two puppies saved. Is that all of them?
translation: 太好了！又救了两只小狗。就这些了吗？

english: None of them look very interesting.
translation: 它们看起来都没什么有趣的。

english: Death to the false king!
translation: 伪王去死！

english: ... Yeah...
I think he's adorable, but then I think you all are. No, I'm here because he was looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.
translation: 我觉得他很可爱，不过我觉得你们都很可爱。不，我来是因为他在找蟹来当仪式领袖。

english: Haha! Got you!
translation: 哈哈！抓到你了！

english: For MVP thus far:
translation: 目前的最佳表现者：

english: And if he is, that might be your chance! Who knows! Maybe 'that crab you can't look at' only wants one thing: for you to look at him!
translation: 如果真是这样，那可能就是你的机会！谁知道呢！也许“那只你没法看的蟹”只想要一件事：让你看看他！

english: Armacus' jesting aside, we're hoping you might be able to help us establish a foothold.
translation: 撇开 Armacus 的玩笑不谈，我们希望你能帮我们建立一个立足点。

english: You've found a hammer. How handy.
translation: 你找到了一把锤子。真方便。

english: What if I'm... I don't know... not right for him? What if I end up hurting him one day?
translation: 万一我……我不知道……不适合他呢？万一有一天我伤害了他呢？
