english: Dismantle and rebuild my trap.
translation: 拆除并重建我的陷阱。

english: They're hiding upstairs in the bedroom. They've left us in charge.
translation: 他们躲在楼上的卧室里。他们让我们来负责。

english: You'll 'av to take 'em from us.
translation: 你得从我们手里抢走它们。

english: You turn the handle.
translation: 你转动了手柄。

english: The crab points at each finger on his claws in turn.
translation: 螃蟹依次指着自己钳子上的每一根手指。

english: Is that an offering to me?
translation: 那是献给我的祭品吗？

english: I stand corrected. I am here getting therapy from a huge fleshy thing I just found on the beach, which quite frankly I should have run from. I must also be stupid.
translation: 我认错。我在这里接受一个我刚在海滩上发现的巨大肉块的治疗，说实话我本该从它身边跑开的。我也一定很蠢。

english: You're learning fast. Perhaps too fast.
translation: 你学得很快。也许太快了。

english: Where are all the bodies?
translation: 所有的尸体都在哪里？

english: Moving further than ten tiles away from your opponent will remove their freeze.
translation: 移动到距离对手超过十格的位置将解除其冰冻。

english: I had hoped you wouldn't see that one.
translation: 我本希望你没看到那一招。

english: You'd better be quick! She's already on the move.
translation: 你最好快点！她已经在行动了。

english: Terribly. These oafs won't take my suggestions into account. I'm having to play their unrefined tune and it is most unbecoming.
translation: 糟透了。这些蠢货不肯采纳我的建议。我不得不演奏他们那粗俗的曲调，这实在有失体面。

english: You're more useful to us healthy and rested than injured. Everybody is. We can find somebody to take your place.
translation: 你健康且休息充足时对我们比受伤时更有用。每个人都是如此。我们可以找人来接替你的位置。

english: Fortis Colosseum.
translation: 福蒂斯竞技场。

english: I don't like my spot. Please can I have yours?
translation: 我不喜欢我的位置。能请你把你的让给我吗？

english: Your protective attire lets you fill the bucket despite the angry bees!
translation: 你的防护装备让你在愤怒的蜜蜂中仍能装满水桶！

english: You try to get some wax from the beehive...
translation: 你试着从蜂箱里取一些蜡……

english: That you fault!
translation: 那是你的错！

english: Pleasure doing business, adventurer. Please, return if you have more to offer. Father Sugadinti will always accept such fine specimens.
translation: 很高兴与你做生意，冒险者。如果你还有更多可以提供的，请再来。苏加丁蒂神父总是会接受这样优质的标本。

english: I'm fine for now, thanks.
translation: 我现在还好，谢谢。

english: Get off me!
translation: 从我身上下来！

english: Unfortunately, alongside these foes, it seems we also have to deal with individuals who should be natural allies to us.
translation: 不幸的是，除了这些敌人，看来我们还得应付一些本应是我们天然盟友的人。

english: Unfortunately, to keep the Archive safe, we must be ready to deal with him as well.
translation: 不幸的是，为了保护档案馆的安全，我们也必须准备好对付他。

english: Be this a mutiny, missus [player name]?
translation: 这是要叛变吗，[player name]小姐？

english: It doesn't look like that will cheer him up at all...
translation: 这看起来根本不会让他高兴起来……

english: My mistake milord, I was thinking yer be some other lass! Take this swag, and we'll be saying no more about it! Yarrr!
translation: 是我的错，大人，我还以为您是别的姑娘！拿着这些赃物，我们就当什么都没发生过！呀哈哈！

english: I don't think a dog like that exists...
translation: 我觉得那样的狗根本不存在……

english: I'm not holding any of your items.
translation: 我没有保管你的任何物品。

english: That was some strong stuff...
translation: 那东西可真烈……

english: If you have her, why did you need me?
translation: 如果你有她，为什么还需要我？

english: Big, strong, scary dog keep village safe.
translation: 又大又壮又可怕的狗保护村庄安全。

english: Avast, yer scurvy swab! Yer not the landlubber I be looking for, Arr!
translation: 喂，你这该死的旱鸭子！你不是我要找的那个旱鸭子，啊！

english: Well done! Now to make it more tricky, you need to attack while respecting the combat triangle.
translation: 干得好！现在让它更难一些，你需要在攻击时遵守战斗三角。

english: How do you play it?
translation: 你怎么弹它？

english: You think it best not to persue that line of questioning.
translation: 你觉得最好不要继续追问下去。

english: Careful human, goblins starting to win war.
translation: 小心，人类，哥布林开始赢得战争了。

english: Welcome to our dog shelter! I'm Talia and I run it alongside my husband, Chase.
translation: 欢迎来到我们的狗狗收容所！我是塔莉亚，我和我丈夫蔡斯一起经营这里。

english: Human useless. You came up with idea.
translation: 人类没用。是你想出的主意。

english: Well done, you've proven you're a master at eating. If you'd like an extended combo eating challenge, just ask!
translation: 干得好，你已经证明了自己是进食大师。如果你想接受进阶连招进食挑战，尽管开口！

english: The crab painstakingly counts up to 16 on his claws.
translation: 螃蟹费力地在钳子上数到16。

english: Ceremonial leaders are the ones performing the ceremonial rhythm. Without them, the dance isn't synchronised and the ceremony descends into chaos.
translation: 仪式领袖是负责演奏仪式节奏的人。没有他们，舞蹈就无法同步，仪式会陷入混乱。

english: Please, return when you do. Father Sugadinti is always in need of more specimens.
translation: 请在你有时再来。苏加丁蒂神父总是需要更多标本。

english: Durrrrrr...
translation: 呃呃呃呃……

english: It's wise to prepare for dangerous eventualities.
translation: 为危险的意外情况做好准备是明智的。

english: I noticed a crate of grog floating around by the north westmost island of the Pandemonium. Cast off your keel and sail your vessel over there.
translation: 我注意到潘德莫尼姆岛最西北的岛屿附近漂着一个装有格罗格酒的箱。卸下你的龙骨，把你的船驶过去。

english: I want to travel to the Bedabin camp.
translation: 我想前往贝达宾营地。

english: You'll be facing two opponents this time, so protect yourself from their ranged attacks while using the tree to draw them together.
translation: 这次你将面对两个对手，所以要保护自己免受他们的远程攻击，同时利用那棵树把他们引到一起。

english: Recolour your Robe top of the Eye (blue)?
translation: 重新着色你的眼之长袍上衣 (蓝)？

english: Ah, so you are there master. I'm so glad you summoned me. Please take this lamp and make your wish!
translation: 啊，原来您在那里，主人。我很高兴您召唤了我。请收下这盏灯，许下您的愿望吧！

english: Well, it was a bit suspicious, but you told me to help Drezel!
translation: 嗯，这确实有点可疑，但您让我去帮助德雷泽尔！

english: I haven't seen anyone beat Pete's challenge yet!
translation: 我还没见过有人能击败皮特的挑战！

english: Yes, I wish to proceed.
translation: 是的，我希望继续。

english: Sorry mate. Big Dave don't like to lose!
translation: 抱歉伙计。大戴夫可不喜欢输！

english: We'll make do without her, I'm still here!
translation: 没有她我们也能应付，我还在这儿呢！

english: Magic counters melee, melee counters range, and range counters magic. Should be simple enough?
translation: 魔法克制近战，近战克制远程，远程克制魔法。应该够简单吧？

english: The crab tries to copy you, but can only really produce one note. He starts practising.
translation: 这只蟹试图模仿你，但只能发出一个音符。它开始练习起来。

english: So... you...
translation: 所以……你……

english: And he was guarding this vault? But then... what was in it?
translation: 而他当时在守卫这个金库？可是……里面到底有什么？

english: I clearly can't convince you to join, but the leaders will be practising on the beach if you wanted to check in advance whether the crab of your dreams will be playing.
translation: 我显然无法说服你加入，但领袖们会在海滩上练习，如果你想提前看看你梦中的那只蟹会不会上场的话。

english: It seems to be all manner of things. Most of them likely aren't too valuable to our foes, but the Archive has an inner vault.
translation: 似乎什么都有。其中大部分对我们的敌人来说可能并不太值钱，但档案馆有一个内层金库。

english: Nobody.
translation: 没有人。

english: You need a cooking level of 32 to come in here.
translation: 你需要32级烹饪才能进入这里。

english: [player name] is sooooo mean!
translation: [player name]真是太太太刻薄了！

english: I'm trying to smoke these pesky rats out. Ahem-hem- hem.
translation: 我正试着把这些讨厌的老鼠熏出来。咳咳——咳——咳。

english: You successfully dye your Robe bottoms of the Eye (red).
translation: 你成功将你的眼之长袍下装 (红) 染色。

english: I can't even approach him, let alone talk to him! And yet when I do manage to look at him... He feels like home, like where I ought to be. It's so confusing!
translation: 我连靠近他都做不到，更别说跟他说话了！可当我真的设法看向他时……他让我感觉像家一样，像是我本该待的地方。真是太让人困惑了！

english: As for your part in all this, [player name], with this being a fancy party and all, I happen to need a butler to help me fit in.
translation: 至于你在这其中的角色，[player name]，既然这是个高档派对，我正好需要一个管家来帮我融入其中。

english: Have you ever thought about letting Saradomin into your life?
translation: 你有没有想过让萨拉多明走进你的生活？

english: That be an order, mister [player name]!
translation: 这是命令，[player name]先生！

english: Clap 'em in irons!
translation: 把他们铐起来！

english: You hand in a bright yellow shell.
translation: 你上交了一个亮黄色的贝壳。

english: He might have an opinion on that. You two are going to have to figure this out. Together.
translation: 他对此可能会有自己的看法。你们俩得一起把这件事弄清楚。

english: Anyway, the whole band is complete! Thanks for your help.
translation: 总之，整个乐队都齐了！谢谢你的帮助。

english: Shiver me' timbers, are you ignoring me???
translation: 我的老骨头啊，你是在无视我吗？？？

english: Father Aereck says he saw something in the cellar. Like a goblin with big eyes.
translation: 艾瑞克神父说他在地窖里看到了什么东西。像是一个长着大眼睛的哥布林。

english: I'm just a cat, you know?
translation: 我只是一只猫，你知道吗？

english: So you've found a flaw in my technique.
translation: 看来你发现了我的技巧中的破绽。

english: You successfully dye your Robe bottoms of the Eye (green).
translation: 你成功将你的眼之长袍下装 (绿) 染色。

english: They're finally gone. Come with us, little guy. We'll keep you safe.
translation: 它们终于走了。跟我们走吧，小家伙。我们会保护你的。

english: Read the text and follow the advice given.
translation: 阅读文字并遵循给出的建议。

english: You don't have enough inventory space to pick up the stray puppy.
translation: 你的物品栏空间不足，无法抱起那只流浪小狗。

english: Well done! You used magic against your opponent's ranged prayer.
translation: 干得好！你用魔法对抗了对手的远程祈祷。

english: Golrie has locked himself in.
translation: 戈尔里把自己锁在里面了。

english: A few ancient words breathe a faint green glow as the folio absorbs the energy.
translation: 几个古老的字词呼出一抹微弱的绿光，对开本吸收了能量。

english: That looks like all of them! I should let Henja and Angel know.
translation: 看起来全都在这儿了！我该告诉亨雅和天使。

english: Hey! Maybe you could talk to them? You look pretty sturdy - maybe you could finish the work?
translation: 嘿！也许你可以跟他们谈谈？你看起来挺结实的——也许你能把活儿干完？

english: There! Big dog!
translation: 那儿！大狗！

english: Ana (in a Barrel)
translation: 安娜（在木桶里）

english: Are you sure you wish to revert your Robe top of the Eye (blue)? The dye used will not be returned.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍上衣 (蓝) 还原吗？所使用的染料将不会返还。

english: Human die for that!
translation: 人类为此去死！

english: Looks like that's the last of the children! Henja and Angel will be pleased.
translation: 看来这是最后一个孩子了！亨雅和天使会很高兴的。

english: I hope you're happy with your wish. I must be leaving now though.
translation: 希望你对你的愿望满意。不过我现在得走了。

english: The bonus shape has changed to the icosahedron.
translation: 奖励形状已变为二十面体。

english: Good day to you, milord/milady [player name].
translation: 您好，[player name]大人/女士。

english: Human... You stand before Ocellus... Chosen... of Guthix...
translation: 人类……你站在奥塞勒斯面前……古斯希克斯的……选民……

english: Be sure to use prayers to reduce the damage you take while making your escape. If you lose all your health, you'll have to restart this challenge.
translation: 逃跑时一定要使用祈祷来减少受到的伤害。如果你失去全部生命值，就必须重新开始这项挑战。

english: I want my mummy!
translation: 我要我的木乃伊！

english: Well, I think we're done here. Come, [player name].
translation: 好了，我想我们这里结束了。来吧，[player name]。

english: There's a lovely patch of grass just outside of Falador...
translation: 法拉多城外就有一片可爱的草地……

english: Well I put a rotten apple in the mourners' stew, I'm told that the effect was much like the symptoms of a plague.
translation: 嗯，我在哀悼者的炖菜里放了一个烂苹果，听说效果很像瘟疫的症状。

english: Nothing that concerns you.
translation: 与你无关。

english: Any advice for an advanced magic user?
translation: 对高级魔法使用者有什么建议吗？

english: Fear not, they will soon return with help. Once they are here, we estimate we can defeat three sets of intruders. As for the rest... we will be relying on you and any allies you can gather yourself.
translation: 别担心，他们很快就会带着援军回来。等他们到了，我们估计能击败三批入侵者。至于其余的……就要靠你和你自己召集的盟友了。

english: You need an eye of newt to do that.
translation: 你需要一个蝾螈眼才能这样做。

english: Reacting to your opponent correctly is crucial!
translation: 正确应对对手至关重要！

english: Aha! Well met, young [player name].
translation: 啊哈！幸会，年轻的[player name]。

english: No, you should never buy an account.
translation: 不，你绝不应该购买账号。

english: Does that mean...? Oh I give up.
translation: 那是不是意味着……？唉，我放弃了。

english: You allowed visit village, see dog if want.
translation: 你被允许参观村庄，想看狗就去吧。

english: Oh right, we should bring all the puppies with us. Let's collect them from your den first.
translation: 哦对，我们应该把所有小狗都带上。先去你的巢穴把它们集合起来吧。

english: Don't be greedy.
translation: 别贪心。

english: I've given those pumpkins a right good seeing-to.
translation: 我把那些南瓜好好收拾了一顿。

english: Listen... I just want to help my friend down on the beach. Are you willing to help?
translation: 听着……我只是想帮助我在海滩上的朋友。你愿意帮忙吗？

english: Free candy apple?
translation: 免费糖苹果？

english: You hear the whirr of machinery.
translation: 你听到机械的嗡嗡声。

english: Best as I can.
translation: 尽力而为吧。

english: You were bold to think you could beat the great Dionysius!
translation: 你竟敢妄想击败伟大的狄俄尼索斯！

english: How did it happen anyway?
translation: 这到底是怎么发生的？

english: No problem. Take care, Golrie.
translation: 没问题。保重，戈尔里。

english: You really think Guthix wanted me to embrace annihilation?
translation: 你真的认为古斯想让我接受毁灭吗？

english: Excellent! Carry on!
translation: 太好了！继续！

english: Okay, how about you have some ascension juice and shut up.
translation: 好吧，不如你喝点飞升果汁然后闭嘴。

english: Ritual time!
translation: 仪式时间到了！

english: Of course. I understand.
translation: 当然。我明白。

english: You peek inside the gate and see no adventurers inside the arena.
translation: 你往大门里窥视，看到竞技场内没有冒险者。

english: Respond quickly so as not to miss the offer.
translation: 赶快回应，以免错过这个提议。

english: Settle down everybody.
translation: 大家都安静下来。

english: A 'crab' appears!
translation: 一只“蟹”出现了！

english: So the Order of Wizards have discovered the Rune Essence Mine once more? Very interesting.
translation: 这么说巫师教团又发现了符文精华矿？非常有趣。

english: This will remove your Horn of Bran. Are you sure you wish to proceed?
translation: 这将移除你的布兰号角。你确定要继续吗？

english: That's really cool! It's a bit high-pitched, however.
translation: 真是太酷了！不过音调有点高。

english: Adventurer, have you come to help us?
translation: 冒险者，你是来帮助我们的吗？

english: It's time for the final act!
translation: 最后一幕的时间到了！

english: Agility.
translation: 敏捷。

english: Listen, you can rest here for a little while, but we'll be needing the beach back very soon for the ceremony.
translation: 听着，你可以在这里休息一会儿，但我们很快就要收回海滩举行仪式了。

english: You need to use your special attack to overcome their prayer! Try again.
translation: 你需要使用战技来突破他们的祈祷！再试一次。

english: : There are three columns. What you need to do for me is to match up each picture with the word underneath the column, and then unlock the chest. Well - good luck to you, matey.
translation: ：有三根柱子。你需要为我做的是把每幅图画与柱子下方的单词配对，然后打开宝箱。好吧——祝你好运，伙计。

english: Shop's open!
translation: 商店开门了！

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (red)? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之长袍下装 (红) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: That's some pretty deft clawwork you've got there. Have you ever thought of playing shell? I think you have what it takes.
translation: 你的爪法相当灵巧。你有没有想过玩贝壳？我觉得你有这个天赋。

english: You need an instrument. Usually either seashell or coconut, but good seashells can be hard to find.
translation: 你需要一件乐器。通常是海螺或椰子，但好的海螺很难找到。

english: I didn't even have to use my whiskers for that one.
translation: 那一次我甚至都不用动用胡须。

english: Now is the time to unite, and leverage the strength of our co-operation against the weakness of our foes' greed.
translation: 现在是团结一致的时候了，用我们合作的力量对抗敌人贪婪的弱点。

english: I don't have room to take you right now. Give me a moment.
translation: 我现在没空带你走。稍等一下。

english: Okay, then! I'll be back.
translation: 好吧，那就这样！我会回来的。

english: Very impressive! It's time to do a different form of special attack now.
translation: 非常出色！现在是时候换一种战技了。

english: Yes, if I'll be only a minute or two.
translation: 是的，如果只需要一两分钟的话。

english: As well as her, we have a tormented demon, only this one seems to be fully in control of its flames, lending it both greater power and durability.
translation: 除了她之外，我们还有一个被折磨的恶魔，只不过这一个似乎完全掌控了自己的火焰，使它既更强大又更耐久。

english: Are you trying to elude me, Player? For once, stop AFKing and get back to it.
translation: 你是想躲着我吗，Player？就这一次，别再挂机了，回来继续。

english: Owww...
translation: 哎哟……

english: And what should I do with that?
translation: 那我该拿它怎么办？

english: You need six blisterwood logs to light the abyssal lantern.
translation: 你需要六根水泡木原木来点燃深渊灯笼。

english: Well I'll be... Bran's own horn?!
translation: 哎呀我的天……布兰自己的号角？！

english: Leave and lose all progress.
translation: 离开并失去所有进度。

english: Oh. To be fair, that is probably for the best. I don't think I have the nerves for the alternative.
translation: 哦。说实话，这大概是最好的结果。我觉得我没有胆量面对另一种选择。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Hat of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之帽重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换任何现有的染色。

english: There's ten gold in it for you if you leave now - no questions asked.
translation: 如果你现在离开，就有十枚金币归你——不问任何问题。

english: Though our trials might not weigh quite so heavy if we were to leverage the power held within the Archive.
translation: 不过，如果我们能利用档案中蕴藏的力量，我们的考验或许就不会那么沉重了。

english: No, I'd like to stay a little longer.
translation: 不，我想再待一会儿。

english: Hi, I'm looking to get some kit to look like one of you guys. Anything you might be able to help me out with?
translation: 嗨，我想弄些装备，让自己看起来像你们中的一员。有什么你能帮我的吗？

english: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach.
translation: 你好！我是代表我在海滩上的蟹朋友来的。

english: I have a client in need of... specimens. I'll happily take any grown dogs off your hands.
translation: 我有个客户需要……标本。我很乐意接手你手上任何成年的狗。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye (blue)? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之长袍上衣 (蓝) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换任何现有的染色。

english: Her?
translation: 她？

english: This looks like a small pile of sand.
translation: 这看起来像一小堆沙子。

english: Search for the books, I'll handle this interruption.
translation: 去找书，我来处理这个打扰。

english: No, they usually stay on the heights. We can't risk having the ceremonial rhythm be disrupted.
translation: 不，它们通常待在高处。我们不能冒险让仪式节奏被打乱。

english: You've completed the Special Attack challenge! You can continue to practice against your sparring partner, with or without movement and prayers, if you wish.
translation: 你完成了战技挑战！如果你愿意，可以继续与你的陪练对手练习，无论是否移动和使用祈祷。

english: Busy. No doubt you're already aware that Lucien has set his sights on Guthix's Archive. We've had to expend a lot of resources to ensure it is defended.
translation: 很忙。毫无疑问你已经知道卢西安把目光投向了古斯的档案。我们不得不耗费大量资源来确保它得到防守。

english: But if you do it long enough, you have a nest.
translation: 但如果你做得够久，你就会有一个鸟巢。

english: Unfortunately, [player name] appears to be struggling compared to the rest of the company. If this continues it could become a problem both for him/herself and his/her allies.
translation: 不幸的是，与其他同伴相比，[player name] 似乎有些吃力。如果这种情况持续下去，对他/她自己和他的/她的盟友都可能成为问题。

english: Great! You should head in that direction and take a look around!
translation: 太好了！你应该往那个方向走，四处看看！

english: Yes, you're looking better already. Perhaps we should put you on double duty!
translation: 是的，你看起来已经好多了。也许我们该让你双倍值班！

english: It's horrible...I keep getting killed!
translation: 太可怕了……我一直被杀！

english: Does that mean you'll join?
translation: 那意味着你会加入吗？

english: I do! Of course I do.
translation: 我有！我当然有。

english: Looks like you're all in one piece. Let's get you somewhere safe.
translation: 看起来你完好无损。我们带你去个安全的地方吧。

english: It's just a dog shelter now? I don't blame them... They had trouble keeping the cats and dogs separate. How have they been getting on?
translation: 现在只是个狗狗收容所了？我不怪他们……他们很难把猫和狗分开。他们过得怎么样？

english: You should've finished the job, given the chance!
translation: 你本该有机会就完成任务的！

english: It must, yes. And so I wanted to know if you would be interested in joining? Practice is taking place... Right there.
translation: 一定是的。所以我想知道你有没有兴趣加入？练习就在……就在那边。

english: That's deep. It sounds like being part of a community, making new friends and doing something meaningful could be really good for you. Be a ceremonial leader this year.
translation: 说得真有深度。听起来，融入一个社群、结交新朋友、做些有意义的事，对你来说会很有好处。今年就当一名仪式领袖吧。

english: Haha, afraid not, adventurer.
translation: 哈哈，恐怕不行，冒险者。

english: Looks like you have some seashells with you! Let me take them off you!
translation: 看起来你身上带着一些贝壳！让我把它们从你那儿拿走吧！

english: He is looking for ceremonial leaders to join him and make a cracking tune. He has a cool new instrument to use and good-sounding shells to share.
translation: 他正在寻找仪式领袖加入他，一起奏出绝妙的曲子。他有一件很酷的新乐器可用，还有音色好听的贝壳可以分享。

english: That be better.
translation: 这样好多了。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (red)? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之长袍下装 (红) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换任何现有的染色。

english: Smart human is dangerous human.
translation: 聪明的人类就是危险的人类。

english: I wouldn't call them mangy... They just need some love.
translation: 我不会说它们脏兮兮的……它们只是需要一些关爱。

english: Your meddling has become a distraction.
translation: 你的多管闲事已经成了干扰。

english: I'm afraid my client is only interested in canines, although I appreciate the offer.
translation: 恐怕我的委托人只对犬类感兴趣，不过还是感谢你的提议。

english: May need spear to handle that.
translation: 可能需要长矛才能应付那个。

english: Against your better judgement, you pick up the bottle and take a sip...
translation: 你违背了自己的理智，拿起瓶子喝了一口……

english: Use the counter gear!
translation: 使用柜台齿轮！

english: What's more, the central chamber we intended to use to establish fortifications appears to be guarded by some sort of hostile creature.
translation: 而且，我们打算用来建立防御工事的中央密室似乎被某种敌对生物守卫着。

english: You need to have completed the Lost City Quest to use this rift.
translation: 你需要完成失落之城任务才能使用这个裂隙。

english: What are you planning?
translation: 你在计划什么？

english: True heroes aren't afraid to make tough choices.
translation: 真正的英雄不怕做出艰难的选择。

english: Your Robe top of the Eye (red) has been reverted.
translation: 你的眼之长袍上衣 (红) 已恢复原样。

english: Interesting indeed.
translation: 确实有趣。

english: It's a great tune, very catchy, you'll love-
translation: 这曲子真棒，非常上口，你会喜欢——

english: It is... Dangerous. This kind of magic, old magic, is unpredictable. Guthix did well to seal it away.
translation: 它……很危险。这种魔法，古老的魔法，难以预测。古斯把它封印起来做得很好。

english: You manage to pick final lock.
translation: 你成功撬开了最后一道锁。

english: In all my years I've never seen a clearer decision.
translation: 我这么多年从没见过比这更明确的选择。

english: Well, if nothing else, I suppose the odd blunder will keep you guessing.
translation: 好吧，就算别的没有，我想偶尔的失误也会让你继续猜测。

english: Yes, Gertrude! She was a great help with the cats.
translation: 是的，格特鲁德！她在猫的事情上帮了大忙。

english: Human be quick. Goblins low attention span.
translation: 人类快点。哥布林注意力短。

english: Of course! Please, bring them over.
translation: 当然！请把它们带过来。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (green)? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍下装 (绿) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料，并替换现有的所有染色。

english: But at least you're not getting trampled?
translation: 但至少你没被踩到？

english: Day 350: Our nemesis, the farmer, has again foiled our plans. These blasted humans keep attempting to steal our disguise. Perhaps they wish to infiltrate the sheep as well? We must look into this further.
translation: 第350天：我们的死敌，那个农夫，又一次挫败了我们的计划。这些该死的人类不断试图偷走我们的伪装。也许他们也想混进羊群？我们必须进一步调查此事。

english: Yeah... They proved a little harder to spook.
translation: 是啊……它们比想象中更难吓到。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍上衣重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料，并替换现有的所有染色。

english: Nobody stop us with big dog on our side.
translation: 有大狗在我们这边，没人能阻止我们。

english: I can't possibly tell whether it's the correct answer. I haven't figured out how to solve it.
translation: 我根本无法判断这是否是正确答案。我还没想出怎么解开它。

english: My reputation precedes me, I see? Of course you would be told to visit us. My family and I have been ceremonial leaders for generations.
translation: 看来我的名声先我而至？当然会有人让你来拜访我们。我和我的家族世代都是仪式领袖。

english: You... return... Do you not see... You can't resist...
translation: 你……回来了……难道你看不见……你无法抗拒……

english: Your position is reminding me of Draynor Bank!
translation: 你的处境让我想起了德雷诺银行！

english: You know, I could just knock the board off the table...
translation: 你知道，我完全可以把棋盘从桌上打下去……

english: Always have a plan D in place.
translation: 永远要准备好D计划。

english: Thank you, that will go nicely in my collection.
translation: 谢谢，这会很好地充实我的收藏。

english: That compost is already as good as it gets.
translation: 那堆肥已经好得不能再好了。

english: Of course, but I believe actions speak louder than words, so we will have to go to my private arena.
translation: 当然，但我相信行动胜于言辞，所以我们得去我的私人竞技场。

english: Surely pretty is an understatement,. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 说漂亮肯定是轻描淡写了。美丽、惊艳，甚至可能改变人生才是更合适的说法。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？它以埋葬在瀑布之下的精灵国王命名。

english: You do not meet all of the requirements to start the A Tail of Two Cats quest.
translation: 你不满足开始双猫记任务的所有要求。

english: That wasn't scary at all!
translation: 一点都不吓人！

english: Hmmm, no light sources. So why can I still see down here? This can't be just a simple dungeon.
translation: 嗯，没有光源。那为什么我在这里还能看见？这不可能是普通的地牢。

english: Thanks, I'm done here.
translation: 谢谢，我这边完事了。

english: Mum and Dad left jack-o-lanterns around the village to welcome people in. Smash them all!
translation: 爸爸妈妈在村子周围放了南瓜灯来欢迎人们。把它们全砸了！

english: Oi, get that mutt out of my bank!
translation: 喂，把那野狗弄出我的银行！

english: Do you know what...? Never mind!
translation: 你知道吗……？算了！

english: I look forward to those challenges later.
translation: 我期待之后的那些挑战。

english: The crab viciously attacks your foot.
translation: 那只蟹狠狠地攻击你的脚。

english: There is a raw swordfish placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一条生剑鱼。

english: I do have all that's needed to make another one, however. Give me a second.
translation: 不过，我确实有再做一件所需的全部材料。给我一秒钟。

english: We tried.
translation: 我们试过了。

english: That's it! You got it right where it should be. Thanks!
translation: 就是这样！你把它放对位置了。谢谢！

english: Great! It's opened it.
translation: 太好了！它打开了。

english: What is combo eating? It's just eating multiple pieces of food, fast.
translation: 什么是组合进食？就是快速吃下多份食物。

english: That one looks awfully chaseable.
translation: 那个看起来非常值得追。

english: I could teach you a thing or two...
translation: 我可以教你一两招……

english: Computer game? What are you talking about?
translation: 电脑游戏？你在说什么？

english: You find a red vine worm.
translation: 你找到了一条红藤蠕虫。

english: Village never attacked again with this dog guarding.
translation: 有这只狗看守，村庄再也不会遭到袭击了。

english: Would you like to make an exchange?
translation: 你想进行交换吗？

english: You're digging deep for these ones.
translation: 你为这些家伙挖得很深啊。

english: Blast it?!
translation: 炸掉它？！

english: It's a disaster!
translation: 这简直是场灾难！

english: Care to try and stop me?
translation: 想试着阻止我吗？

english: The student becomes the master! Congratulations! Feel free to take some ancient fabric from my crate whenever you'd like.
translation: 学生出师了！恭喜！随时可以从我的箱子里拿些远古织物。

english: Now, who wants a drink?
translation: 那么，谁想来一杯？

english: Oh my! I just got sucked through that door... what a weird feeling! Still, I guess I should expect it as these evidently aren't your average kind of doors.... they talk and look creepy!
translation: 天哪！我刚被那扇门吸了进去……好奇怪的感觉！不过，我想我应该料到这一点，因为这些显然不是普通的门……它们会说话，看起来还很吓人！

english: Human own idea fail?
translation: 人类自己的主意失败了？

english: You cannot extend the rack while the door is closed.
translation: 门关闭时你无法拉出架子。

english: Yes, but I've not brought it with me. Cats are no adventurers.
translation: 是的，但我没有把它带来。猫可不是冒险者。

english: Looks like you've got the hang of this. You might be able to defeat me.
translation: 看来你已经掌握了诀窍。你也许能击败我。

english: I need not be paid, for I have made my fortunes from those who hunt the weak.
translation: 我不需要报酬，因为我的财富来自那些猎杀弱者的人。

english: Day 420: A strange penguin has arrived at the enclosure. He looks like he's been in some sort of horrible accident. But he has revealed to me that he can fly! Further investigation is suggested.
translation: 第420天：一只奇怪的企鹅来到了围栏。它看起来像是经历了某种可怕的事故。但它向我透露它会飞！建议进一步调查。

english: You know what you must do.
translation: 你知道自己必须做什么。

english: Picklenose no know, can you?
translation: Picklenose不知道，你知道吗？

english: That one won't be as impressive a story.
translation: 那一个的故事可没那么精彩。

english: To keep his power safe... I will take his place...
translation: 为了保护他的力量……我将取代他……

english: I'll use everything at my disposal. You will not outlast me!
translation: 我会用尽一切手段。你撑不过我的！

english: Top
translation: 上面

english: This much is true... but Saradominism is also the most widespread religion in Gielinor. We are not all of a single perspective.
translation: 这一点确实如此……但萨拉多明教也是吉里诺最广泛的宗教。我们并非都持同一种观点。

english: You give the doorman a diamond.
translation: 你给了门卫一颗钻石。

english: Bandosian strength, feed the flame!
translation: 班多斯之力，献于烈焰！

english: Can you take me to Great Kourend?
translation: 你能带我去库兰德王国吗？

english: Recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (red)?
translation: 要重新染色你的眼之长袍下装 (红) 吗？

english: Nothing. I was just leaving.
translation: 没什么。我只是要走了。

english: You see some text scrolled above the altar on a symbol: Horn of unicorn and hide of cow...
translation: 你看到祭坛上方一个符号上滚动着一些文字：独角兽之角与奶牛之皮……

english: Divine consequence!
translation: 神圣的后果！

english: Row to the camp.
translation: 划船去营地。

english: Unless I really like talking to crabs, I've probably found enough leaders. I could go back to see how the practise is going.
translation: 除非我真的喜欢和螃蟹说话，否则我大概已经找到足够多的领队了。我可以回去看看练习进行得如何。

english: You don't seem to have many dogs. Where are the rest?
translation: 你的狗似乎不多。其余的都在哪里？

english: You already have a stuffed dog.
translation: 你已经有一只填充狗了。

english: You won't attract a chompy bird this far away from the ogre area.
translation: 离食人魔区域这么远，你吸引不到食人鸟。

english: The stray dog nods in agreement.
translation: 流浪狗点头表示同意。

english: Your partner will fight back with ranged attacks, so make sure to pray correctly to reduce the damage you take.
translation: 你的搭档会用远程攻击反击，所以务必正确祈祷以减少受到的伤害。

english: Report the incident and do not click any links.
translation: 报告此事件，不要点击任何链接。

english: Excellent work! You've mastered switching to the correct gear to counter your opponent and have completed the challenge!
translation: 干得漂亮！你已经掌握了切换正确装备来克制对手的技巧，并完成了挑战！

english: Don't worry, floatsam never stays away from this island for very long. Yep, there it is!
translation: 别担心，漂浮物从不会离开这座岛太久。没错，它来了！

english: I will experiment, then!
translation: 那我就来实验一下！

english: The offer is always open.
translation: 这个提议永远有效。

english: He couldn't cast Saradomin Strike anyway!
translation: 反正他也施不出萨拉多明之击！

english: Are you sure you wish to continue?
translation: 你确定要继续吗？

english: You need some red spider eggs to do that.
translation: 你需要一些红蜘蛛卵才能这样做。

english: I would like to go back to the construction platform.
translation: 我想回到建筑平台。

english: The tunnel is blocked with rocks.
translation: 隧道被岩石堵住了。

english: After looking around her den, I think she's had some puppies.
translation: 在查看她的窝之后，我想她生了一些小狗。

english: Is there not a way we could gain some sort of advantage? Could we maybe seal the Archive for good? This deep underground a few collapsed pillars might bury it and leave it completely unreachable.
translation: 难道没有办法让我们获得某种优势吗？也许我们可以把档案永久封印？在这么深的地下，几根倒塌的柱子也许就能把它埋起来，让它完全无法到达。

english: Well, that doesn't sound too bad. What's the problem?
translation: 嗯，听起来还不算太糟。有什么问题吗？

english: You decide to save your nose, and self, from almost certain death.
translation: 你决定保住自己的鼻子和性命，免于几乎必死的结局。

english: I don't have 200 coins...
translation: 我没有200枚金币……

english: Well if it isn't a clear and obvious move to make.
translation: 嗯，如果这都不算明确无误的一步棋的话。

english: I wish to leave.
translation: 我想离开。

english: Don't tag the ones that do not have rings around the base, as that will reset your points, and don't try and get past those trolls until you are done!
translation: 不要标记那些底座周围没有圆环的柱子，因为那会重置你的分数，而且在完成之前不要试图越过那些巨魔！

english: My, my, what do we have here? I have never seen one of your kin before.
translation: 哎呀呀，我们这儿来了什么？我以前从没见过你的同类。

english: Eight lives to go...
translation: 还剩八条命……

english: Wait, what? You're not ugly! You're adorable! What makes you think you're ugly?
translation: 等等，什么？你才不丑！你很可爱！你为什么会觉得自己丑？

english: Yes, I suppose that is true.
translation: 是的，我想确实如此。

english: The Aspirant approaches! What will the records tell of you, I wonder?
translation: 求道者来了！记录会如何记载你呢，我很好奇？

english: Go up anyway?
translation: 还是要上去吗？

english: Oh, no, no, no, no. It's going to have a use that will change this world!
translation: 哦，不，不，不，不。它将有一种改变这个世界的用途！

english: Ah, yes, the bass.
translation: 啊，是的，鲈鱼。

english: Recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (blue)?
translation: 要为你的眼之长袍下装 (蓝) 重新着色吗？

english: It not big as Nosorog... Picklenose lie.
translation: 它没有 Nosorog 那么大……Picklenose 撒谎。

english: You've cornered me. Well done.
translation: 你把我逼入绝境了。干得好。

english: Bork kill human for that!
translation: Bork 为此杀人类！

english: I can sell you up to 450 additional bank slots in sets of 50. How many are you interested in buying?
translation: 我可以以每套 50 个的方式，最多再卖给你 450 个银行栏位。你想买多少个？

english: Better. Playing coconut is tiring work, but it's kind of liberating. The sound drowns my thoughts.
translation: 好多了。演奏椰子很累人，但有种解脱感。那声音淹没了我的思绪。

english: We survived! Is that all the puppies?
translation: 我们活下来了！所有小狗都在这里了吗？

english: You must pay a toll of ten gold coins to pass.
translation: 你必须支付十枚金币的通行费才能通过。

english: Bury the bones? (This grants Prayer XP)
translation: 埋葬骨头？（这会获得祈祷经验值）

english: Impressive.
translation: 令人印象深刻。

english: Yes... but we are not without allies either. The Alliance is rallying as we speak. Together we can do this.
translation: 是的……但我们也不是没有盟友。联盟此刻正在集结。齐心协力，我们一定能做到。

english: Must be nice getting to travel around for work.
translation: 能因工作四处旅行一定很不错。

english: Don't give up! Freeze your partner, then move underneath him!
translation: 别放弃！冻结你的搭档，然后移动到他下方！

english: I see. How do you know all this?
translation: 我明白了。你是怎么知道这些的？

english: We will combine two special attacks into a deadly combination. You'll notice you have an Armadyl godsword and a granite maul.
translation: 我们将把两种战技组合成致命的连招。你会注意到你有一把阿玛杜尔神剑和一把花岗岩锤。

english: I can compensate you. A modest sum of blood runes, in exchange for each dog you bring me.
translation: 我可以补偿你。每带给我一只狗，就给你一笔适量的血符石作为交换。

english: He can't plant seeds where flowers are already growing!
translation: 他不能在已经长着花的地方播种！

english: I've even impressed myself with that.
translation: 连我自己都对此感到佩服。

english: I just thought you'd want to see it.
translation: 我只是觉得你会想看看它。

english: He did, did he?
translation: 他真这么做了，是吗？

english: That's not an unreasonable request. I suppose I could do better myself.
translation: 这个要求并不过分。我想我自己也能做得更好。

english: Take the crystal.
translation: 拿走水晶。

english: A change of plans may be needed.
translation: 可能需要改变计划。

english: Whimper.
translation: 呜咽。

english: All it means is that they get to act like the rest of us are inferior. Yet I bet to seagulls, we all taste the same.
translation: 这只不过意味着他们可以表现得好像我们其余人都低人一等。但我敢打赌，在海鸥眼里，我们尝起来都一样。

english: Finally. Picklenose bored waiting.
translation: 终于。Picklenose 等得无聊了。

english: But wait! We have one right here!
translation: 但是等等！我们这里就有一个！

english: That would explain the weird accent.
translation: 这就能解释那奇怪的口音了。

english: Eat three food in one go, or you will fall behind!
translation: 一口气吃三份食物，否则你会落后！

english: At least one of those is true. What comes after the Nexus?
translation: 至少其中一点是真的。Nexus 之后是什么？

english: Angry talking earthquake!
translation: 会说话的发怒地震！

english: I need to do something else. Can you wait for me at your den?
translation: 我需要去做别的事。你能在你的巢穴等我吗？

english: You break open the fragment of living earth and consume its power. Earth spells will have an increased max hit of +2.
translation: 你破开活土碎片并吸收了它的力量。土系法术的最大伤害将提高 +2。

english: You have brought us something of ours, and you shall receive something of ours in return. A blessing from our home. Kneel, [player name].
translation: 你给我们带来了属于我们的东西，你也将得到属于我们的东西作为回报。来自我们家园的祝福。跪下，[player name]。

english: Pulling the lever will reset the light maze.
translation: 拉动拉杆将重置光之迷宫。

english: It didn't work...
translation: 没有成功……

english: Strong. Decisive. Exactly how a move should be!
translation: 有力。果断。正是一步棋应有的样子！

english: They hold, if by a single thread. But! It is a single thread more than our enemies possess.
translation: 他们守住了，虽然只靠一根线。但是！这比我们的敌人所拥有的多了一根线。

english: What kind of shelter would we be if we let a dog stay as a stray?
translation: 如果我们让一只狗继续流浪，那我们还算什么收容所？

english: I see. And do we know anything specific about what artefacts are hidden here?
translation: 我明白了。那我们知道这里藏着什么具体的文物吗？

english: Are you sure you wish to revert your Robe top of the Eye (red)? The dye used will not be returned.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍上衣 (红) 还原吗？所使用的染料将不会退还。

english: Keep your items.
translation: 保留你的物品。

english: Dialogue 5:
translation: 对话5：

english: Even if we succeed here, there is a lesson to be taken. The forces of evil are many and strong, and we were unprepared.
translation: 即使我们在这里成功了，也有一个教训需要吸取。邪恶势力众多且强大，而我们毫无准备。

english: Don't share your information and report the player.
translation: 不要分享你的信息，并举报该玩家。

english: You... fail...
translation: 你……失败……

english: If you would ever like to adopt one of these puppies yourself, just talk to Chase and he'll help you out.
translation: 如果你也想领养一只这样的小狗，就去找Chase谈谈，他会帮你的。

english: Recolour your Hat of the Eye?
translation: 要为你的眼之帽重新染色吗？

english: They're all gone! [player name], you've saved our Halloween!
translation: 它们全都不见了！[player name]，你拯救了我们的万圣节！

english: You lose sight of the penny as you flip it, and it doesn't drop back down.
translation: 你抛起硬币时失去了它的踪影，它也没有落回来。

english: The heat from the warrior causes you to drop your weapon.
translation: 战士散发的热量使你丢下了武器。

english: Yes, add charges.
translation: 是的，添加充能。

english: The Bandosian forces are mostly goblins. You wouldn't think they'd pose much of a threat, but they've managed to build some sort of siege engine. If that weren't enough, they're being lead by a huge ork.
translation: 班多斯势力大多是哥布林。你或许以为他们构不成多大威胁，但他们设法造出了某种攻城引擎。这还不算，他们正由一只巨大的兽人率领。

english: I have spoken to Boot the dwarf about the location of 'perfect gold', but haven't managed to make you your jewellery yet.
translation: 我已经和矮人Boot谈过“完美金子”的位置，但还没能为你打造首饰。

english: Revert your Robe bottoms of the Eye (red)?
translation: 要还原你的眼之长袍下装 (红) 吗？

english: Pizza delivery!
translation: 披萨外卖！

english: Best to speak with Talia.
translation: 最好去和Talia谈谈。

english: Okay. Hooknosed Jack's cat, Pox, ate some rats which were poisoned with a Kwuarm and Red Spider Egg based concoction.
translation: 好吧。钩鼻杰克的猫Pox吃了一些老鼠，这些老鼠被掺有库阿姆草和红蜘蛛蛋的混合物毒死了。

english: Zzzzzz.... miaow! Sorry, took a quick nap.
translation: 呼噜噜……喵！抱歉，打了个盹。

english: Thank you, Your Majesty. What did you have in mind?
translation: 谢谢您，陛下。您有什么打算？

english: Hey, these are nice crabs. Try to get along or I may feel the urge to acquire some magic logs.
translation: 嘿，这些蟹挺不错的。尽量和睦相处吧，不然我可能会忍不住去弄些魔法原木。

english: Is there a certain crab you wanted to be a ceremonial leader that isn't here?
translation: 有没有哪只你希望担任仪式领袖的蟹不在这里？

english: He seems too busy to talk.
translation: 他似乎太忙了，没空说话。

english: Not fast enough!
translation: 不够快！

english: And our foes? What do we know about them?
translation: 那我们的敌人呢？我们对他们了解多少？

english: Ah yes, the granite maul has a rather speedy special attack!
translation: 啊对，花岗岩锤的战技相当迅速！

english: Thanks again for your help! You're such a nice stranger.
translation: 再次感谢你的帮助！你真是个好心肠的陌生人。

english: Well it's time to prove it!
translation: 那么是时候证明它了！

english: 'Twas a pleasure to work with you sirrah/ma'am!
translation: 能与您合作真是荣幸，先生/女士！

english: Let's try the defensive spell-casting mode...
translation: 让我们试试防御施法模式……

english: Is not compromise when only one option.
translation: 只有一个选项时就不算妥协。

english: You're not quite sure what the dye is actually sticking to but despite that you successfully dye your Amulet of the Eye.
translation: 你不太确定染料究竟附着在了什么上面，但尽管如此，你还是成功为你的眼之护符染了色。

english: Hasn't the natural process led to Lucien obtaining the Stone?
translation: 自然进程难道没有导致卢西安获得那块石头吗？

english: I take it from your colour that he's around?
translation: 从你的颜色来看，我猜他在附近？

english: Sort of like blasting it?
translation: 有点像把它炸开？

english: That sound boring.
translation: 那听起来很无聊。

english: I'll see yer swing from the yard arm fer this, mister [player name]!
translation: 为了这事，我会看着你被吊在帆桁上晃荡的，[player name]先生！

english: It's not far from here. Follow me.
translation: 离这里不远。跟我来。

english: Help yourself to a candy apple, stranger.
translation: 随便拿个糖苹果吧，陌生人。

english: The point of the dance is to make a sturdy sand nest.
translation: 这支舞的目的是筑成一个坚固的沙巢。

english: I was only owning to the fact that it wasn't my best work, but the name stuck...
translation: 我只是承认那不是我最好的作品，但这个名字就流传下来了……

english: Let's hope they don't take too long.
translation: 希望他们别花太久。

english: Great... Wait, trade for what?
translation: 太好了……等等，用什么换？

english: Right! Not that you ever know which ones your kids are. We don't stick around to find out!
translation: 对！不过你永远不知道哪些是你的孩子。我们可不会留下来弄清楚！

english: Thank you [player name], you are soooo cool!
translation: 谢谢你[player name]，你真是太酷了！

english: We've been on quite the adventure together.
translation: 我们一起经历了相当一场冒险。

english: You need to have completed the Sins of the Father quest to use this rift.
translation: 你需要完成父辈的罪孽任务才能使用这个裂隙。

english: I don't actually know.
translation: 我其实不知道。

english: Talking to another crab, I was under the impression crabs have no idea which crab they are related to.
translation: 跟另一只蟹说话时，我一直以为蟹根本不知道自己和谁有亲缘关系。

english: Indeed?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Elena's a missionary and a healer. Three weeks ago she managed to cross the wall into West Ardougne. No one's allowed to cross the wall in case they spread the plague.
translation: 埃琳娜是传教士兼治疗师。三周前她设法越过墙进入了西阿多尼城。任何人都不准越墙，以防传播瘟疫。

english: Forgive me, [player name], but I suspect that is unlikely. Ocellus will have been granted power by Guthix himself. He will not die easily.
translation: 请原谅，[player name]，但我怀疑这不太可能。奥塞勒斯会得到古斯自己赐予的力量。他不会轻易死去。

english: Do I detect a hint of surprise in your voice?
translation: 我是不是从你的声音里听出了一丝惊讶？

english: The stray dog won't go too far from her den. She will wait for you there.
translation: 流浪狗不会离她的窝太远。她会在那里等你。

english: I suppose I would. But the practice takes place on the beach, doesn't it? It'd be a lot of effort to get back.
translation: 我想我会的。但练习是在海滩上进行的，对吧？回去要费不少功夫。

english: ...and immediately black out.
translation: ……随即立刻昏了过去。

english: Fletching.
translation: 制箭。

english: Well, thank you for helping to defend the Archive in spite of your doubts.
translation: 好吧，谢谢你尽管心存疑虑，还是帮忙保卫了档案馆。

english: Oh wow, that is a nice instrument. What do you call it?
translation: 哦哇，这真是件不错的乐器。你叫它什么？

english: Do... do not...
Are you there mistress [player name]?
translation: 你在吗，女主人[player name]？

english: Oh! Then I hope the ceremonial music will be better than last year. That time, the drums sent me into a trance and I walked right into the ocean instead of doing the dance. It was awful.
translation: 哦！那我希望今年的仪式音乐比去年好。那次鼓声让我陷入恍惚，我没跳舞反而径直走进了海里。太糟糕了。

english: Speedy!
translation: 真快！

english: I see. I shall have to work around you then.
translation: 我明白了。那我得绕开你行事了。

english: Tell me, [player name], despite all of its flaws, do you find the world to be a good place?
translation: 告诉我，[player name]，尽管有种种缺陷，你觉得这个世界是个好地方吗？

english: Say, would you be able to help us, stranger? If you could get rid of the trick or treaters, then we'd get to keep the lot!
translation: 我说，陌生人，你能帮帮我们吗？如果你能赶走那些捣蛋鬼，我们就能保住全部东西了！

english: ... Then a needle and thread to put it together...
translation: ……然后用一根针和线把它缝起来……

english: I need to rest a little before I make the jump.
translation: 我得先休息一下才能跳过去。

english: Even my eyes can see what to do next.
translation: 连我的眼睛都能看出下一步该怎么做。

english: I can hardly believe it. After all of that practice, still you lose. You are a truly unique kind of pathetic.
translation: 我简直不敢相信。练了那么久，你还是输了。你真是独一无二的可悲。

english: As expected, this is going swimmingly.
translation: 果然如我所料，一切进展顺利。

english: Email Old School RuneScape.
translation: 给Old School RuneScape发邮件。

english: Wait! I feel something! Yes! I can feel the potion working... The pain has gone... I can walk on my leg... Nurse! I'm cured!
translation: 等等！我感觉到了什么！对！我能感觉到药水在起作用……疼痛消失了……我的腿能走路了……护士！我痊愈了！

english: You pull the lever and the press responds. The hardy comes down, stopping inches from the jig, then returns to its original position.
translation: 你拉动拉杆，压机有了反应。压头降下来，在离夹具几英寸处停住，然后回到原位。

english: The Nexus in the centre is the place where we establish our defences. However, a hostile automaton there does keep making that difficult for us. We can put it down for a while, but it just keeps getting back up.
translation: 中央的枢纽是我们建立防御的地方。然而，那里一台敌对的自动机械一直让我们难以做到。我们可以暂时把它放倒，但它总是又站起来。

english: Speak.
translation: 说吧。

english: Yes! He seemed confident you would help. 'I can see it in their eyes. The flame of justice!'
translation: 对！他似乎很确信你会帮忙。“我能从他们的眼睛里看出来。正义的火焰！”

english: I can't tell you apart. That's really embarrassing.
translation: 我分不清你们俩。真是太尴尬了。

english: You catch a small battered barrel.
translation: 你捞起一个小而破旧的木桶。

english: You run your claw along one of the strings like this.
translation: 你像这样用爪子拨动其中一根弦。

english: Dialogue 6:
translation: 对话6：

english: That is all we can ever ask. Now, best we begin our preparations for the next wave of attacks.
translation: 这就是我们能要求的全部了。现在，我们最好开始为下一波攻击做准备。

english: It's important to use one's power responsibly!
translation: 负责任地使用自己的力量很重要！

english: Hmm... Must have been the wind.
translation: 嗯……一定是风。

english: Hello, your highness. Have you any news on the Daconia stones?
translation: 您好，殿下。关于达科尼亚石头有什么消息吗？

english: The stray dog looks at you with a sad look in her eye.
translation: 流浪狗用悲伤的眼神看着你。

english: I can try and explain.
translation: 我可以试着解释一下。

english: Yeah I'm fearless!
translation: 对，我无所畏惧！

english: Yo, now I didn't say that! Being a leader is an even bigger honour than being a dancer. You're one with the beat. I couldn't pass that up!
translation: 哟，我可没这么说！当领袖比当舞者更光荣。你与节拍融为一体。我可不能错过这个！

english: Feel free to practice with various weapons or try to mimic what you can see around you!
translation: 随意用各种武器练习，或者试着模仿你周围看到的东西！

english: Read the text, but forget the info moments later.
translation: 读了文字，但片刻后就忘了内容。

english: You look like you'd enjoy a candy apple!
translation: 你看起来会喜欢一个糖苹果！

english: First, I'm a girl and girls are never ceremonial leaders. Besides, I get very nervous standing in front of others... I'm afraid to mess up.
translation: 首先，我是女孩，而女孩从来不能当仪式领袖。再说，站在别人面前我会非常紧张……我怕搞砸。

english: And then I sliced the dragon's bits off with a long and shiny blade!
translation: 然后我用一把又长又亮的刀片把巨龙的部件切了下来！

english: ... Yeah!
Which item would you like to craft?
translation: 你想制作哪件物品？

english: Your Robe bottoms of the Eye (green) has been reverted.
translation: 你的眼之长袍下装 (绿) 已恢复原样。

english: Take his head!
translation: 取他的首级！

english: It's really confusing how he makes me feel at ease yet so nervous at the same time. If I was a ceremonial leader and I spotted him... I would mess up for sure.
translation: 他让我既感到安心又同时如此紧张，真是令人困惑。如果我是仪式领袖，看到他……我肯定会搞砸。

english: That... is a complicated question to answer. It has, partially, but Lucien's plans and hunger for power can be traced back to the ages in which the gods walked Gielinor. In that way, it has not.
translation: 那……是个复杂的问题。部分来说是的，但卢西安的计划和对力量的渴望可以追溯到众神行走于盖林诺的时代。从这个意义上说，并非如此。

english: You shouldn't ignore a genie, Master [player name]?
translation: 你不该无视精灵，主人[player name]？

english: Nice! We've got 3 notes so far. There's got to be some more shells out there.
translation: 不错！我们目前有3个音符。外面肯定还有更多贝壳。

english: The king has granted you access to this training area. Make good use of it, soon all your strength will be needed.
translation: 国王已授予你进入此训练场的权限。好好利用它，很快你所有的力量都将被需要。

english: As you wish! Although I prefer playing coconut...
translation: 如你所愿！不过我更喜欢扮演椰子……

english: Make him suffer!
translation: 让他受苦！

english: Sounds like we'd best not waste any time then.
translation: 那听起来我们最好别浪费时间了。

english: Thank you, [player name]. Once you've cleared the central chamber, we'll split up and tackle our enemies one at a time.
translation: 谢谢你，[player name]。一旦你清理了中央密室，我们就分头行动，逐个击破敌人。

english: No way, that looks scary!
translation: 不可能，那看起来很吓人！

english: Oh... I see. And what do you do here?
translation: 哦……我明白了。那你在这里做什么？

english: That's useful, I'm always losing keys.
translation: 那很有用，我总是弄丢钥匙。

english: Because this isn't just any ship! This is the Lady Lumbridge, one of the last Crandorian ships! Despite her size, she's one of the most agile ship around!
translation: 因为这可不是普通的船！这是仑桥镇女士号，最后几艘克兰多船之一！尽管体型如此，她可是周围最灵活的船之一！

english: You... will disappear...
translation: 你……将会消失……

english: Oof.
translation: 哎哟。

english: Even this spell is not hot enough to heat this item.
translation: 就连这个法术也不够热，无法加热此物品。

english: Your reflexes are quicker than I thought.
translation: 你的反应比我预想的更快。

english: Oh Chase, this is exactly what we need to keep the shelter going!
translation: 哦，蔡斯，这正是我们维持收容所运转所需要的！

english: You incompetent fools!
translation: 你们这些无能的蠢货！

english: Yes, I know about them. Don't worry, they've gone now.
translation: 是的，我知道他们。别担心，他们已经走了。

english: I think I have the information you're after. It seems the Iorwerth elves are searching for an ancient temple of some sort deep beneath West Ardougne.
translation: 我想我已经掌握了你想要的信息。看来伊奥尔沃斯精灵正在西阿多尼城深处寻找某种古老神庙。

english: Can I have some more sugar?
translation: 我能再要一些糖吗？

english: Almost half way. Still, that's another half to go next time.
translation: 差不多一半了。不过，下次还有另一半要走。

english: You see some text scrolled above the altar on a symbol: Feather of chicken and eye of newt...
translation: 你看到祭坛上方一个符号上滚动着一些文字：鸡的羽毛和蝾螈眼……

english: Well, why shouldn't I do that?
translation: 嗯，我为什么不该那样做？

english: It's a shame there's no evil chicken in this.
translation: 可惜这里面没有邪恶鸡。

english: My name is Liam, the Quartermaster. I don't engage in combat anymore, but I'm here to support others that do.
translation: 我叫利亚姆，是军需官。我不再参与战斗，但我在这里支援那些参战的人。

english: Interesting. Time for my next plan!
translation: 有意思。是时候实施我的下一个计划了！

english: Yes, I think I might have it here.
translation: 是的，我想我可能把它放在这里了。

english: Excellent work! Only one challenge remains.
translation: 干得漂亮！只剩一个挑战了。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (blue)? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍下装 (蓝) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: Release Brutus?
translation: 释放布鲁图斯？

english: I reckon that would be quite risky for us.
translation: 我认为那对我们来说会相当冒险。

english: And the shelter doesn't run itself.
translation: 而且收容所不会自己运转。

english: There seems to be an endless tide of them. A necromancer must be present. It's possible this is the work of Moia, the leader of Lucien's forces.
translation: 它们似乎无穷无尽。一定有死灵法师在场。这可能是卢西安军队的领袖莫亚所为。

english: Bentnoze, keep eye on that!
translation: 本特诺兹，盯着那个！

english: Place all your finds, and don't ask this again.
translation: 把你所有的发现都放上去，别再问了。

english: So, how's being dead working out for you then?
translation: 那么，死了之后感觉如何？

english: Oh, very nice! We now have... 11 notes. A couple more might be enough.
translation: 哦，太好了！我们现在有……11个音符。再来几个可能就够了。

english: I have told the director of the Blue Opal that I will support their bid to be put upon the statue.
translation: 我已经告诉蓝蛋白石号的负责人，我会支持他们争取被立上雕像的申请。

english: Indeed! They are powerful. But! You need not face them alone. I have no doubt that an enterprising young adventurer such as yourself has many capable and jolly allies.
translation: 确实！他们很强大。但是！你不必独自面对他们。我毫不怀疑，像你这样有进取心的年轻冒险者有许多能干又快乐的盟友。

english: Indeed! But not all is bad news. Several of our enemies have clashed on their way to the Archive, and it's bought us some time.
translation: 确实！但并非全是坏消息。我们的几个敌人在前往档案馆的途中发生了冲突，这为我们争取了一些时间。

english: I'm not sure... What is it you're interrupting me for?
translation: 我不确定……你打断我是为了什么？

english: How am I doing for rewards?
translation: 我的奖励情况如何？

english: That'll be 200 coins.
translation: 那要200金币。

english: Shame, girls can't be ceremonial leaders. Although I think it's stupid and we should be able to be leaders if we wanted. It's ridiculous.
translation: 真可惜，女孩不能当仪式领袖。不过我觉得这很愚蠢，如果我们愿意，就应该能当领袖。太荒唐了。

english: Are you sure they want to stay with us?
translation: 你确定它们想和我们待在一起吗？

english: Hello! My friend on the beach is looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.
translation: 你好！我海滩上的朋友正在寻找螃蟹来当仪式领袖。

english: You can't fool me. A bass is a type of fish and this looks nothing like a fish.
translation: 你骗不了我。鲈鱼是一种鱼，而这看起来一点也不像鱼。

english: Well, it would be nice for someone to do something about those mangy stray dogs you see in Varrock.
translation: 嗯，要是有人能对那些维洛克城的流浪狗做点什么就好了。

english: While you were away, I heard of a commotion near the northernmost tree on the island. Could you please check it out?
translation: 你不在的时候，我听说岛上最北边那棵树附近有骚动。你能去看看吗？

english: Lucky indeed... It's almost like you were specifically looking for them?
translation: 确实幸运……简直就像你专门在找它们一样？

english: Mmm... Ascension juice.
translation: 嗯……飞升果汁。

english: Trampling time...
translation: 踩踏时间……

english: Whilst that music must sound absolutely amazing to crabs, it's a little too... avant-garde for your tastes. You choose to imagine different music instead.
translation: 虽然那音乐在螃蟹听来一定美妙绝伦，但对你来说有点太……前卫了。你选择在脑海中想象别的音乐。

english: When you're ready, we can fight again. Or, if you think you're capable, you can face me at full strength.
translation: 你准备好后，我们可以再战一场。或者，如果你觉得自己有实力，可以面对全力状态的我。

english: Well, I've not earned a new nickname since starting practice. We'll see how that works out.
translation: 嗯，自从开始练习以来我还没获得新绰号。我们看看结果如何吧。

english: Treat for you, here!
translation: 给你的奖励，拿着！

english: You hand the crest pieces over to Dimintheis.
translation: 你把纹章碎片交给了迪明塞斯。

english: You open the valve and hear the whistling of air being sucked through a hole above the tank.
translation: 你打开阀门，听到空气从罐子上方的孔洞被吸入时发出的呼啸声。

english: You're a record keeper?
translation: 你是记录保管员？

english: Climb up the stairs.
translation: 爬上楼梯。

english: I see. Anyhow, why do you wish to become a ceremonial leader?
translation: 我明白了。那么，你为什么想成为仪式领袖？

english: I have heard only stories... and very few at that. It is said that when the God Wars ended, Guthix tasked a select few with guarding items and areas of great power.
translation: 我只听过传说……而且很少。据说神战结束后，古斯指派了少数人守护强大的物品和区域。

english: Who are our enemies?
translation: 我们的敌人是谁？

english: One day I'll be as strong as Pete.
translation: 总有一天我会像皮特一样强壮。

english: Plus, there was no one to keep the cats and dogs separate.
translation: 而且，当时没人把猫和狗分开。

english: It seems to be a collection of notes or instructions relating to the original archivists.
translation: 这似乎是关于最初档案管理员的笔记或指示合集。

english: Greetings! This is the final test for you.
translation: 你好！这是你的最终考验。

english: I should have the stray dog with me before I talk to these goblins again.
translation: 在再次和这些哥布林交谈之前，我应该带上那只流浪狗。

english: What's this? Has Timmy fallen down the old well?
translation: 这是怎么回事？蒂米掉进旧水井里了吗？

english: Trying to catch me off guard, are you?
translation: 想打我一个措手不及，是吧？

english: If Ezekiel was the second boss:
translation: 如果以西结是第二个首领：

english: Lovely!
translation: 太好了！

english: Hmm... Well, we're not going anywhere until our work here is done. If you want us back at the palace, you'd best help.
translation: 嗯……好吧，我们在这里的工作完成之前哪儿也不去。如果你想让我们回宫殿，最好帮帮忙。

english: No! Fearless leader!
translation: 不！无畏的领袖！

english: Ruff ruff!
translation: 汪！汪！

english: Oh no... I can't easily play 13 different shells on my own, but if I only play one... I won't stand out enough for her to see me!
translation: 哦不……我一个人没法轻松演奏13个不同的贝壳，但如果我只演奏一个……我就不够显眼，她看不到我！

english: What a day...
translation: 真是漫长的一天……

english: Do you have the instrument?
translation: 你有乐器吗？

english: You need a spade to dig up this vine.
translation: 你需要一把铲子来挖出这株藤蔓。

english: Start!
translation: 开始！

english: Ah, hello! We've managed to resupply, if you'd like to take a look?
translation: 啊，你好！我们成功补给了，你要看看吗？

english: Ah, so you are there mistress. I'm so glad you summoned me. Please take this lamp and make your wish!
translation: 啊，原来您在那儿，女主人。我很高兴您召唤了我。请收下这盏灯，许下您的愿望吧！

english: Maybe this human not stupid...
translation: 也许这个人类不笨……

english: Oh! Well, I'll pass as I'm not going. The ceremony is not worth the hassle.
translation: 哦！那我不去了。那场仪式不值得这么麻烦。

english: Very silly. Puppy too weak. We wait 'till puppy big, strong.
translation: 太傻了。小狗太弱。我们等小狗长大、变强壮。

english: I'm not sure I understand.
translation: 我不太明白。

english: You've done us proud. Thank you. I think we can now trust you enough to let you in...
translation: 你让我们感到骄傲。谢谢你。我想我们现在可以信任你，让你进去了……

english: There's an apothecary here in town, he could help. Tell him that the poison was made from red spiders eggs and kwuarm. He should know what to do. Go quickly.
translation: 镇上有个药剂师，他能帮忙。告诉他毒药是用红蜘蛛卵和库阿姆草制成的。他应该知道该怎么办。快去吧。

english: You do not have the required items to make a stuffed dog. You need grain, some fur, a needle and some thread.
translation: 你没有制作填充狗所需的物品。你需要谷物、一些毛皮、一根针和一些线。

english: Please, return when you do. My client is always in need of more specimens.
translation: 请有了再来。我的客户总是需要更多标本。

english: I hope I'm not interrupting.
translation: 希望我没有打扰到你。

english: There is a unicorn horn placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一只独角兽的角。

english: Well, I can tell you about rewards or customisable load-outs. Which would you like to discuss?
translation: 嗯，我可以给你讲讲奖励或可自定义的装备配置。你想聊哪个？

english: My friends.
translation: 我的朋友们。

english: As you hold the pearl, you hear the sound of fish swimming. However, beyond that, you're not sure what to do with it.
translation: 当你握着珍珠时，你听到鱼儿游动的声音。然而除此之外，你不知道该拿它怎么办。

english: It's all about consistency!
translation: 关键在于持之以恒！

english: But we have extinguished a million embers of evil. Ha! It is they who are on the back foot!
translation: 但我们已经熄灭了百万点邪恶的余烬。哈！现在处于下风的是他们！

english: Do you know where I can get the dye parcels for this thing?
translation: 你知道我在哪里能弄到给这东西用的染料包裹吗？

english: Noooo? Maybe?
translation: 不——？也许吧？

english: Store everything when using items on the bag.
translation: 对袋子使用物品时，将所有物品存入。

english: Of course I can! I'm ugly, not stupid.
translation: 我当然会！我只是丑，不是傻。

english: A dog shelter.
translation: 一家狗狗收容所。

english: Hmm... I suppose it's a reflection on the way our surroundings shape us. Or maybe it's arguing that wilder gardens are more beautiful.
translation: 嗯……我想这反映了周围环境如何塑造我们。又或者它是在说，更野性的花园更美。

english: The wisdom of cats is infinitely superior. Make sure to tend to your cat in OSRS well.
translation: 猫的智慧是无限优越的。记得在OSRS中好好照顾你的猫。

english: The Defender returns! What can I do for you?
translation: 守护者回来了！我能为你做什么？

english: Someone's idea of a joke...
translation: 某人的恶作剧……

english: Where's that one going?
translation: 那一个要去哪儿？

english: You take a bronze axe from the logs.
translation: 你从原木堆里取出一把青铜斧。

english: That sounds interesting, I think.
translation: 听起来挺有意思的，我想。

english: I made it, but then I lost it...
translation: 我做好了，但后来弄丢了……

english: You use the battered key to open the doors.
translation: 你用破烂的钥匙打开了门。

english: ... Yeah.
translation: ……是的。

english: If this thing explodes, I think I should stand a liiiiitle further away...
translation: 如果这东西爆炸了，我想我该站得稍——微远一点……

english: Ocellus... I have not heard that name in a long time. How did you come to learn of him?
translation: Ocellus……我很久没听到这个名字了。你是怎么知道他的？

english: Toy horsey
translation: 玩具小马

english: I won't hold back my strongest ally any longer!
translation: 我不会再藏着我的最强盟友了！

english: The rules of the game are quite simple. You have to score 10 points by tagging the flashing pillars.
translation: 游戏规则很简单。你需要通过触碰闪烁的柱子来获得10分。

english: You make some sled wax.
translation: 你制作了一些雪橇蜡。

english: Sometimes the right move is the most apparent!
translation: 有时候最明显的一步就是正确的一步！

english: Hey. How do I get out of here?
translation: 嘿。我怎么离开这里？

english: As you wake up, you find some familiar-looking seashells...
translation: 当你醒来时，你发现了一些看起来很眼熟的贝壳……

english: Candy onions. We ruin their appetites with onions disguised as apples...
translation: 糖果洋葱。我们用伪装成苹果的洋葱破坏它们的食欲……

english: Tell me more about the Archive.
translation: 再多告诉我一些关于档案馆的事。

english: Great job.
translation: 干得好。

english: Hopefully I'll make some real progress soon.
translation: 希望我很快能取得一些真正的进展。

english: Are you two okay?
translation: 你们两个没事吧？

english: Dialogue 2:
translation: 对话2：

english: Is that all you zombies think about.
translation: 你们这些僵尸就只想着这个吗。

english: You give the instrument to the crab.
translation: 你把乐器交给了螃蟹。

english: I've followed you here like you wanted. What do you want to show me?
translation: 我照你的意思跟到这里来了。你想给我看什么？

english: You have my word. Here...
translation: 我向你保证。给……

english: Craft a stuffed dog?
translation: 制作一个填充狗？

english: Of course, I can't expect you to have my sort of experience.
translation: 当然，我不能指望你有我这样的经验。

english: ... Then I suppose I'd need to stuff it with something, maybe grain...?
translation: ……那我想我得往里面塞点东西，也许谷物……？

english: No... Kovac...
translation: 不……科瓦克……

english: We could scare them off!
translation: 我们可以把他们吓跑！

english: The final piece of traditional arms is a Neitiznot shield.
translation: 传统武器的最后一件是奈提兹诺盾。

english: Er... How does one become a ceremonial leader, then?
translation: 呃……那要怎样才能成为仪式领袖呢？

english: The guardian mummy has given you another clue scroll!
translation: 木乃伊守卫又给了你一张线索卷轴！

english: Yes! He seemed confident you would help. 'I can see it in his eyes. The flame of justice!'
translation: 是的！他似乎很确信你会帮忙。‘我能从他的眼中看到。正义的火焰！’

english: You give the mage 400,000 coins and the staff...
translation: 你把400,000枚金币和法杖交给了法师……

english: Yes, and he seems to be playing an instrument I've never seen before! He is SO cool!
translation: 是的，而且他似乎正在演奏一种我从未见过的乐器！他太酷了！

english: Bark bark bark!
translation: 汪 汪 汪！

english: Awwww. He's a keeper!
translation: 哇哦。他值得留下！

english: Ah, a new ally for our cause!
translation: 啊，我们事业的新盟友！

english: : Certainly, let me try again.
translation: ：当然，让我再试一次。

english: I'll talk, I'll talk! I've been sent on a mission to find food supplies for my homeland. I discovered that an upcoming ceremony will convince many crabs to come out of hiding.
translation: 我说，我说！我被派来为我的家乡寻找食物补给。我发现即将举行的一场仪式会引诱许多螃蟹从藏身处出来。

english: Your humanity is showing.
translation: 你的人性显露出来了。

english: You serve Guthix?
translation: 你侍奉古斯？

english: Politely tell them no, and ignore them.
translation: 礼貌地拒绝他们，然后无视他们。

english: Surely pretty is an understatement, sir. Beautiful, amazing or possibly life-changing would be more suitable wording. Have you seen Baxtorian Falls? Named after the elven king who was buried beneath them.
translation: 先生，说漂亮肯定是轻描淡写了。美丽、惊艳或者可能改变人生会更合适。你见过巴克斯托里安瀑布吗？它是以埋葬在瀑布下的精灵国王命名的。

english: Tested my reflexes there.
translation: 刚才是在测试我的反应能力。

english: I should have known. Perhaps I can play more with you in OSRS.
translation: 我早该知道的。也许我可以在OSRS里多和你玩一玩。

english: Yes, she may know of some dogs that need help.
translation: 是的，她可能知道一些需要帮助的狗。

english: You haven't managed to defeat me yet. Are you sure you wish to leave?
translation: 你还没能打败我。你确定要离开吗？

english: The Warrior's Guild has a code of honour. A code that I respect. Move along.
translation: 战士公会有荣誉准则。一个我尊重的准则。走开吧。

english: What's stopping you?
translation: 是什么阻止了你？

english: Sometimes the only correct move is a difficult one.
translation: 有时候唯一正确的走法就是艰难的一步。

english: Truly? Are you one of the ancient ones, whose tales have been passed downs for thousands of generations?
translation: 真的吗？你是那些古老者之一吗？他们的传说已经流传了数千代。

english: Goblin attack repelled? Maybe human stronger than thought.
translation: 哥布林攻击被击退了？也许人类比想象中更强。

english: Dominic's Coffer (Empty)
translation: 多米尼克的保险箱（空）

english: You can't stop me!
translation: 你阻止不了我！

english: Yes, but if I were you I would seek Malignus Mortifer, the necromancer. He's been seen near Port Sarim with his followers recently. I believe he once fought a Tanglefoot.
translation: 是的，但如果是我的话，我会去找死灵法师Malignus Mortifer。最近有人看到他和他的追随者在沙林港附近出没。我相信他曾与一只缠足怪交过手。

english: You were better at this than I thought! Now it's time for some real training in OSRS.
translation: 你在这方面比我预想的更厉害！现在该在OSRS里进行一些真正的训练了。

english: This looks like a large pile of sand.
translation: 这看起来像一大堆沙子。

english: Will you stay a while so we can study it?
translation: 你愿意留一会儿，让我们研究一下它吗？

english: Last I heard he was on some stupid hunt for gold or treasure, somewhere out in the desert east of Lumbridge. You might want to ask the traders there about him.
translation: 我最后一次听说，他正在沙漠里仑桥镇以东的某个地方，愚蠢地寻找金子或宝藏。你也许可以向那里的商人打听他的消息。

english: Orange juice
translation: 橙汁

english: For your second challenge, you'll learn a safer escape technique: freeze your partner, then run behind the tree and stay out of his line of sight.
translation: 你的第二项挑战是学习一种更安全的逃脱技巧：冻结你的搭档，然后跑到树后，避开他的视线。

english: Are you okay, little guy? Did they hurt you?
translation: 你还好吗，小家伙？他们伤到你了吗？

english: Congratulations! You have completed the challenge!
translation: 恭喜！你已完成挑战！

english: Well I'm...
translation: 嗯，我……

english: Yes if it is from someone you know.
translation: 是的，如果它来自你认识的人。

english: Ask about buying armour
translation: 询问购买盔甲

english: No, I don't like cats. They're nasty cruel creatures.
translation: 不，我不喜欢猫。它们是讨厌又残忍的生物。

english: Not disappointed, but worried. We have mounted an impressive defence at short notice, but it is barely holding. Had this alliance not existed, the Archive would have been breached.
translation: 不是失望，而是担忧。我们在短时间内建立了可观的防御，但几乎难以维持。如果没有这个联盟，档案馆早就被攻破了。

english: Excellent! Then if you could head down to the beach, you'll find what you need to practise!
translation: 太好了！那么如果你能去海滩，就能找到练习所需的东西！

english: Swiftly done. Time for your final special attack challenge...
translation: 干得利落。该进行你最后的战技挑战了……

english: The Alliance is lucky to have the Temple Knights' resources on its side.
translation: 联盟很幸运，有圣殿骑士的资源相助。

english: How many coins would you like to give?
translation: 你想给多少金币？

english: You use the battered key on your keyring to open the doors.
translation: 你用钥匙环上的破烂的钥匙打开了门。

english: Interestingly, no, but we'll get to them. We managed to capture one of the mages and interrogate them. They refused to say much, but we gather they're trying to summon some sort of powerful demon.
translation: 有意思的是，没有，但我们之后会处理他们。我们设法抓住了一名法师并审问了他。他拒绝多说，但我们推测他们正试图召唤某种强大的恶魔。

english: I bet I can do it faster! Watch this!
translation: 我打赌我能做得更快！看好了！

english: I've got a proof of friendship right here!
translation: 我这儿就有友谊的证明！

english: Um, how do we get it?
translation: 呃，我们怎么拿到它？

english: You pour insect repellent on the beehive again. The bees have already left.
translation: 你又往蜂箱上倒了驱虫剂。蜜蜂已经离开了。

english: Oh... I'm sorry, I don't usually partake in the festivities. I don't really have anything to give you...
translation: 哦……抱歉，我通常不参加这些庆典。我实在没什么能给你的……

english: Magic.
translation: 魔法。

english: Give Sweets
translation: 给予糖果

english: Caught me off guard there.
translation: 这让我措手不及。

english: The crabs... Was it all a dream or did it actually happen?
translation: 那些螃蟹……那一切只是一场梦，还是真的发生过？

english: Yeah, if you dressed up in a good costume and snuck right up behind them, you'd scare them all the way home!
translation: 是啊，如果你穿上像样的服装，悄悄走到他们身后，就能把他们吓得一路跑回家！

english: You break open the fragment of burning fire and consume its power. Fire spells will have an increased max hit of +2.
translation: 你打碎了燃烧之火碎片并吸收了它的力量。火系法术的最大伤害将提高 +2。

english: Stop right there. You'll get no hints out of me.
translation: 站住。你从我这儿得不到任何提示。

english: Being afraid has saved my chitin more than once, so I'll be afraid whether you like it or not!
translation: 害怕已经不止一次救了我的甲壳素，所以不管你喜不喜欢，我都会害怕！

english: Yes, all of the time.
translation: 是的，一直如此。

english: Perhaps, but there is also danger in imbalance. I would not trust the Dagon'hai quickly, but they've seemingly realised the error of their ways in supporting Lucien.
translation: 也许吧，但失衡也有危险。我不会轻易信任 Dagon'hai，但他们似乎已经意识到支持卢西安是错误的。

english: You'd think so, but they believe there is still a danger. It seems they're even willing to kill if it helps keep their city isolated.
translation: 你可能会这么想，但他们相信仍有危险。看来他们甚至愿意杀人，只要有助于保持城市与世隔绝。

english: Hey! Don't make me bring out the claws.
translation: 嘿！别逼我亮出爪子。

english: Solus Observation Record 2
translation: Solus 观察记录 2

english: I met up with Gertrude.
translation: 我和格特鲁德见了面。

english: Just sneaking by! Excuse me!
translation: 只是路过！借过一下！

english: Yes, but I knew about it even before I did. Do you remember that vision I had back in the Temple of the Eye? I saw it. I've somehow known its name ever since.
translation: 是的，但我甚至在那之前就已经知道它了。你还记得我在眼之神殿时看到的那个幻象吗？我看到了它。不知怎的，从那以后我就一直知道它的名字。

english: Kill the traitor!
translation: 杀了那个叛徒！

english: An orange?
translation: 一个橙子？

english: Don't take too long. He'll be eager to see if this is indeed the breakthrough we were hoping for. Now, did you want to buy some runes?
translation: 别耽搁太久。他会急着看看这是否真的是我们所期望的突破。那么，你想买些符文吗？

english: Want... no, need...
translation: 想要……不，需要……

english: Maybe bashing on a coconut repeatedly would help me discover the answer to this problem. Fine, I will help.
translation: 也许反复敲打椰子能帮我找到这个问题的答案。好吧，我会帮忙。

english: There is only one solution... Only Guthix himself is worthy... but he is long gone...
translation: 只有一个解决办法……只有古斯本人配得上……但他早已逝去……

english: You are not wrong, [player name], but even if they fell into the 'right' hands, if such an idea even exists, they would be a danger to the world.
translation: 你说得没错，[player name]，但即使它们落入“正确”的人手中——如果这种想法真的存在的话——它们也会对世界构成危险。

english: To make a string instrument, you'll also need a sound box to amplify the sound and a frame or fretboard to tense the string.
translation: 要制作弦乐器，你还需要一个音箱来放大声音，以及一个框架或指板来绷紧琴弦。

english: You give back your Training bow to the Ranged combat tutor.
translation: 你把训练弓还给了远程战斗导师。

english: You would rather you had Armadyl at your side, then?
translation: 那么，你更希望阿玛杜尔站在你这边？

english: You've come once again, adventurer. Would you like to make an exchange?
translation: 你又来了，冒险者。你想做个交易吗？

english: Can anyone beat Pete?
translation: 有人能打败皮特吗？

english: You need a unicorn horn to do that.
translation: 你需要独角兽的角才能这么做。

english: Yes... He charged me... to guard the source of his power... But his enemies approach... They are not worthy of it...
translation: 是的……他命令我……守护他力量的源头……但他的敌人正在逼近……他们不配得到它……

english: Malignus Mortifer. Okay, thanks very much.
translation: Malignus Mortifer。好的，非常感谢。

english: Aw, shush! You looked like you were carrying the weight of a coconut. That's not right.
translation: 哎呀，嘘！你看起来就像扛着一颗椰子的重量。这可不对。

english: Tempting, but I don't think you are skilled enough unfortunately.
translation: 很诱人，但遗憾的是我觉得你的技能还不够娴熟。

english: Rarrg!
translation: 吼！

english: I'm awarding you 30 Slayer reward points. You can use points to purchase rewards and upgrades to enhance your effectiveness as a Slayer.
translation: 我奖励你 30 点杀戮奖励点数。你可以用点数购买奖励和升级，以提升你作为杀戮者的效率。

english: Oh that. Yes, have it. It's just some old elven junk I believe.
translation: 哦，那个啊。是的，拿去吧。我相信那只是一些古老的精灵垃圾。

english: Take it and I'll make another to replace it!
translation: 拿去吧，我会再做一个来替换它！

english: Hope you like your present. I must be leaving now though.
translation: 希望你喜欢你的礼物。不过我现在得走了。

english: Insolence...
translation: 无礼……

english: Your fight against me was highly impressive! Maybe you should adventure on OSRS now.
translation: 你与我的战斗令人印象深刻！也许你现在该去 OSRS 冒险了。

english: You notice some chew marks on the corner.
translation: 你注意到角落上有一些咬痕。

english: Shark-Brew-Karam, there's no time to waste!
translation: 鲨鱼-药剂-卡拉姆，没时间浪费了！

english: Can I customise my load-outs?
translation: 我可以自定义我的装备配置吗？

english: Well, this is a terrible idea that's definitely going to blow up in all our faces later, but it seems you have made your decision. However, I insist that you let me personally accompany you.
translation: 好吧，这是个糟糕的主意，以后肯定会让我们所有人吃大亏，但看来你已经下定决心了。不过，我坚持要亲自陪同你。

english: Nothing yet, you scallywag, but keep checking in. I'm sure he'll have something soon. In the meantime, I do have a job that you might be interested in.
translation: 还没有，你这无赖，但继续来看看吧。我相信他很快就会有好消息。在此期间，我确实有个工作你可能会感兴趣。

english: The crab pokes at your foot.
translation: 螃蟹戳了戳你的脚。

english: We are counting on you,
translation: 我们全靠你了，

english: You have nowhere to send this lost dog...
translation: 你没有地方可以送走这只走失的狗……

english: Go to him once the ceremony has ended. If he spots you and blushes, then you've got nothing to lose. You've got this!
translation: 仪式结束后去找他。如果他看到你并脸红了，那你就没什么可失去的了。你能行的！

english: You show the Fangs of Venenatis to Derse Venator.
translation: 你把维内纳蒂斯之牙展示给德尔斯.维纳托。

english: My apologies, I'm ready to continue the search for your puppies.
translation: 抱歉，我准备好继续寻找你的小狗了。

english: Sounds like a plan. Thanks, Idria.
translation: 听起来是个计划。谢谢你，伊德莉亚。

english: Hey, how are things going?
translation: 嘿，情况怎么样了？

english: My thanks to you friend for your help in freeing me from this accursed place, but it seems I have much to do to make amends. If our empire no longer stands, it means that we must have failed my lord...
translation: 感谢你的帮助，朋友，把我从这个受诅咒的地方解救出来，但看来我还有很多事要做来弥补。如果我们的帝国已不复存在，那就意味着我们一定辜负了我的主人……

english: Do you have any sugar?
translation: 你有糖吗？

english: 'Flowers wilt and grow. Pruned carefully as they go. Were it that this flower, could live a life its own.'
translation: “花儿枯萎又绽放。精心修剪伴其成长。但愿这朵花，能活出自己的人生。”

english: We have followers of Lucien, Zamorak and Bandos to deal with. Evidence also suggests there are other foes yet to fully reveal themselves. For example, there have been reports of a lone knight.
translation: 我们要对付卢西安、扎莫拉克和班多斯的追随者。证据还表明，还有其他敌人尚未完全现身。例如，有报告称有一名孤身骑士。

english: I understand, but... what is this sword? All the stories I've heard about Guthix... none of them imply he'd have need of such a weapon.
translation: 我明白，但是……这把剑是什么？我听过的所有关于古斯的故事……没有一个暗示他会需要这样的武器。

english: There's no time to waste, pick a side!
translation: 没时间浪费了，选一边吧！

english: What if we blast it?
translation: 如果我们把它炸了怎么样？

english: Not yet, but I do have all that's needed to make one. Give me a second.
translation: 还没有，但我有制作一个所需的一切。给我一秒钟。

english: That's good news. I don't know how I feel about us hanging on by a single thread, but it's good to hear you in good spirits despite it.
translation: 那是好消息。我不知道该怎么看待我们仅靠一根线支撑着，但尽管如此听到你精神不错还是很好。

english: Yes, I thought that would be your response.
translation: 是的，我就料到你会这么回答。

english: Noooo
Miaoww! Erm, I mean, hello.
translation: 喵！呃，我是说，你好。

english: So that makes... the Nexus plus three chambers you want taking care of?
translation: 那么也就是说……你想让我们处理枢纽加三个密室？

english: Well met, and likewise. I received your message and came as soon as I could.
translation: 幸会，同样。我收到了你的消息，尽快赶来了。

english: My cover has been blown! Unless you are also an agent in disguise? What's the passphrase?
translation: 我的伪装暴露了！除非你也是伪装的间谍？暗号是什么？

english: Excellent! Melee gear is optimal against ranged gear.
translation: 太好了！近战装备对远程装备有优势。

english: Goblins smart than human. As usual.
translation: 哥布林比人类聪明。一如既往。

english: I hear you.
translation: 我懂你。

english: Brutally.
translation: 残忍地。

english: I organise people according to the Alliance's defence plans. That means bringing newcomers quickly up to speed, and communicating any changes to the plan across the troops.
translation: 我按照联盟的防御计划来组织人员。这意味着要让新来者迅速跟上进度，并把计划的任何变动传达给部队。

english: If for some reason you wish to leave, you can use the portals on either side of the arena.
translation: 如果你出于某种原因想离开，可以使用竞技场两侧的传送门。

english: For all I know, you could be my kid.
translation: 据我所知，你可能是我的孩子。

english: If only someone cared about my Fluffs as much as those mutts...
translation: 要是有人像关心那些野狗一样关心我的毛毛就好了……

english: Hey there, I can take you somewhere safe if you'd like?
translation: 嘿，如果你愿意，我可以带你去个安全的地方？

english: It's considered impolite to mess with a man's possessions!
translation: 乱动别人的财物可是很不礼貌的！

english: Boing!
translation: 嘣！

english: And should I bring you back what I mine?
translation: 那我要把挖到的东西带回来给你吗？

english: Well, then why the confusion? Have you never seen one before? Oh you poor sheltered thing. Did your parents never show you the wonders of the countryside?
translation: 那么，你为什么会困惑呢？你以前从没见过吗？哦，你这可怜的小家伙。你的父母从没带你见识过乡村的奇妙吗？

english: Ahoy there, [player name]!
translation: 嗨，[player name]！

english: : Right, right. What you need to do is click on the arrows to roll the cylinders round to the different items.
translation: ：对，对。你需要做的是点击箭头，把圆柱体转到不同的物品上。

english: That sounds amazing! Does that mean I can't convince you to become a ceremonial leader this year?
translation: 那听起来太棒了！这是否意味着我没法说服你今年来当仪式领袖了？

english: Speaking of which, I believe I have kept you long enough. Let us return to the Archive's defence.
translation: 说到这个，我想我已经耽搁你够久了。让我们回去保卫档案馆吧。

english: BUUUUUUUUUUUUUURP Mmmmm... I could eat redberry pies all day!
translation: 嗝啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊 嗯……我可以整天吃红莓派！

english: Can't wait!
translation: 等不及了！

english: Is what your back legs are doing.
translation: 就是你的后腿在做的事。

english: I am now the royal tax collector.
translation: 我现在是皇家税务官了。

english: So you want me to kill someone?
translation: 所以你想让我去杀个人？

english: So you'll help us out?
translation: 所以你会帮我们了？

english: A goblin?!
translation: 一个哥布林？！

english: Do you remember which way the goblins went?
translation: 你记得那些哥布林往哪个方向去了吗？

english: ...and fail. The locking mechanism has reset itself.
translation: ……但失败了。锁具机关已自行重置。

english: I give you my promise, that if you unfreeze my mommy and daddy, you can have the stupid diamond.
translation: 我向你保证，如果你解冻我的爸爸妈妈，你就可以拿走那颗愚蠢的钻石。

english: No, I'm afraid you'll trample us.
translation: 不行，我怕你会踩到我们。

english: The bellows pump air out of the hole.
translation: 风箱从孔中泵出空气。

english: Yes of course, let's get you out of danger first, little guy.
translation: 当然可以，小家伙，我们先让你脱离危险。

english: As the records chronicle more of your deeds here, you may find the Archive itself looks upon you favourably, Defender.
translation: 随着记录记载你在这里的更多事迹，你可能会发现档案馆本身对你另眼相看，守护者。

english: Ah-ha, this one's not what it seems!
translation: 啊哈，这个可不像表面看起来那样！

english: What's the book for then?
translation: 那这本书是做什么用的？

english: The circle of life must continue.
translation: 生命的循环必须继续。

english: I managed to rescue some stray puppies!
translation: 我成功救出了一些流浪小狗！

english: I've been too busy bashing a coconut to worry about mathematics. It is very cathartic.
translation: 我一直忙着砸椰子，没空操心数学。这非常解压。

english: A crab comes out shyly.
translation: 一只螃蟹害羞地爬了出来。

english: Many years after the original theft of the shield, a rift resulted in a splinter group of the Phoenix Gang forming their own criminal organisation, the Black Arm Gang.
translation: 在原初盾牌失窃许多年后，一道裂隙导致凤凰帮分裂出一支队伍，组建了他们自己的犯罪组织——黑臂帮。

english: Goblins.
translation: 哥布林。

english: You need to go take on more challenges before you think about rewards!
translation: 在想奖励之前，你得先去接受更多挑战！

english: I think so. They'd be safe here, right?
translation: 我想是的。它们在这里会很安全，对吧？

english: Adventurer! Who's this beautiful girl you've got with you?
translation: 冒险者！你身边这位漂亮姑娘是谁？

english: It's already that type.
translation: 它已经是那种类型了。

english: You were right, that instrument of his is pretty cool. It should be a good year.
translation: 你说得对，他那件乐器挺酷的。今年应该会不错。

english: As you insert the key into the door, the vines on the key shift and intertwine with the lock itself. You hear a click as the door unlocks.
translation: 当你把钥匙插入门中时，钥匙上的藤蔓移动起来，与锁本身缠绕在一起。你听到一声咔哒，门解锁了。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye (blue)? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍上衣 (蓝) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: Well, if this isn't quite the swing in power.
translation: 哎呀，这可真是实力的大逆转。

english: I'd be careful giving me that much ground.
translation: 给我让出这么多地盘，我可要小心了。

english: He is a bit eccentric, but he is a fine leader, and a good judge of character.
translation: 他有点古怪，但他是一位出色的领袖，也很会看人。
