english: Good fight
translation: 打得不错

english: Picklenose not lie! Dog bigger before.
translation: 腌黄瓜不说谎！狗以前更大。

english: Ahh! There is a spider inside.
translation: 啊！里面有只蜘蛛。

english: Honestly? I really didn't expect you to find that one.
translation: 说实话？我真没想到你能找到那一个。

english: I don't have them on me.
translation: 我身上没带。

english: It fires a mould?
translation: 它会发射模具？

english: You hand in a vivid orange shell.
translation: 你上交了一个鲜艳的橙色贝壳。

english: I'm still waiting for the bit where this wasn't a terrible idea.
translation: 我还在等这段剧情证明这不是个糟糕的主意。

english: Use it to coat some of those nasty old onions by the back door, then hand them out to the adults outside!
translation: 用它给后门那些讨厌的旧洋葱涂上东西，然后分给外面的成年人！

english: [player name], I wish I weren't asking this of you, but you are one of the most capable warriors amongst us.
translation: [player name]，我真希望不用来求你，但你是我们中最能干的战士之一。

english: ... Alright.
translation: ……好吧。

english: His name was Boot. Unfortunately for me, he has apparently returned to his home under Ice Mountain, and I cannot find him.
translation: 他名叫布特。不幸的是，他似乎已经回到了冰山下的家，我找不到他。

english: Well, I was just going to ask what you're doing, but I'm starting to regret it.
translation: 嗯，我本来只是想问你在做什么，但我开始后悔了。

english: This spirit seems too ethereal to communicate with.
translation: 这个灵魂似乎太过空灵，无法与之交流。

english: The leather boots are free to convert!
translation: 皮靴可以免费转换！

english: Lots of people are doing that new quest "The Pandemonium". Seems like they'll all be coming here to get another Quest cape soon!
translation: 很多人都在做那个新任务“潘德莫尼姆岛”。看来他们很快都会来这里再拿一件任务披风！

english: What?, why?
translation: 什么？为什么？

english: It seems Ocellus is trying to claim the Blade once more.
translation: 看来奥塞勒斯又想夺取那把刀片了。

english: Which places can the Escape crystal (Members) teleport me out of?
translation: 逃脱水晶（会员）能把我传送出哪些地方？

english: Yop!
translation: 哟普！

english: When you're ready, stand next to me!
translation: 准备好后，站到我旁边！

english: Flee, human!
translation: 逃吧，人类！

english: I should warn you, there is a possibilty that you will get teleported to a land far far away if you play it.
translation: 我得提醒你，如果你弹奏它，有可能会被传送到一个很远很远的地方。

english: You hand in a cool black and white shell.
translation: 你上交了一个酷炫的黑白贝壳。

english: Stop boasting and get back to work, pal.
translation: 别吹牛了，回去干活吧，伙计。

english: You attempt to pick Pavo's pocket, but clumsily bump into them.
translation: 你试图扒窃帕沃的口袋，却笨拙地撞到了对方。

english: Godspeed, [player name]!
translation: 祝你好运，[player name]！

english: It does seem pretty well sealed.
translation: 它看起来确实封得很严实。

english: I fear its usefulness may be limited, as it appears to be more of a tool than a record.
translation: 我担心它的用处可能有限，因为它看起来更像是一件工具而非记录。

english: They're covered in fleas and they're everywhere. They always beg for food when I walk through the city.
translation: 它们浑身是跳蚤，到处都是。我每次穿过城市时，它们总是乞讨食物。

english: Let's say I've not had a good experience in the past. I... don't really want to talk about it.
translation: 这么说吧，我过去有过不好的经历。我……不太想谈这个。

english: Sweat is pouring down Johnathon's face.
translation: 汗水顺着乔纳森的脸流下。

english: Well, it just so happens that I have a lyre with me right here!
translation: 嗯，正好我身上就带着一把竖琴！

english: In that case, do you mind if I have a look around?
translation: 那样的话，你介意我四处看看吗？

english: Welcome to my little game, are you ready?
translation: 欢迎来到我的小游戏，你准备好了吗？

english: Ask on social media.
translation: 在社交媒体上询问。

english: So why haven't you gone any further?
translation: 那你为什么没有继续深入？

english: That's amazing. I like it because it sounds funny to me. Banjo!
translation: 太棒了。我喜欢它，因为我觉得它听起来很有趣。班卓琴！

english: However, unlike monsters, in a real fight against another hunter, your protection prayers will only reduce damage by 40%.
translation: 然而，与怪物不同，在与另一名猎人进行真正的战斗时，你的保护祈祷只能减少40%的伤害。

english: Are you ready to proceed?
translation: 你准备好继续了吗？

english: The time has come... for ascension.
translation: 飞升的时刻……已经到来。

english: Oh no reason whatsoever...
translation: 哦，完全没什么原因……

english: Chronozon weakens...
translation: 克罗诺宗变弱了……

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Amulet of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal green dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给你的眼之护符重新着色吗？这将消耗深渊绿色染料，并替换任何现有的重新着色。

english: I'd be happy to see them go. I always see them near the west entrance to the city.
translation: 我很乐意看到它们离开。我总是在城市西入口附近看到它们。

english: Did you expect me to roll over?
translation: 你以为我会认输吗？

english: I don't think she likes it here...
translation: 我觉得她不喜欢这里……

english: Certainly! This time, you'll be fighting me. Unlike the challenges you've completed so far, this will be a fight where you'll need to put everything you've learned into practice.
translation: 当然！这一次，你将与我战斗。与你迄今为止完成的挑战不同，这将是一场你需要把所学的一切付诸实践的战斗。

english: Not well. They barely have any dogs in for adoption.
translation: 不太好。他们几乎没有狗可供领养。

english: It's not the first authority I've taken out.
translation: 这可不是我除掉的第一位权威。

english: That's the wrong combination, that is!!!
translation: 那是错误的组合，就是这样！！！

english: Can I convince you to join them this year?
translation: 我能说服你今年加入他们吗？

english: What... what did that poison spider... DO to me? I... I feel so weak... I can hardly... think at all...
translation: 那……那只毒蜘蛛……对我做了什么？我……我感觉好虚弱……我几乎……无法思考了……

english: You've found a bronze pickaxe. How handy.
translation: 你找到了一把青铜镐。真方便。

english: Offer Crystal weapon seed.
translation: 献上水晶武器种子。

english: Hello, are you Gertrude by chance?
translation: 你好，你莫非就是格特鲁德？

english: Whine.
translation: 呜咽。

english: Yes, he was thrilled with it!
translation: 是的，他对此非常兴奋！

english: I shouldn't be going around terrifying people without good reason.
translation: 我不该毫无理由地到处吓唬人。

english: Okay, what does it mean to you?
translation: 好吧，那它对你意味着什么？

english: You have all the materials necessary to activate this altar!
translation: 你拥有激活这个祭坛所需的全部材料！

english: Bees fly out of the hive and sting you!
translation: 蜜蜂从蜂巢里飞出来蜇你！

english: Remember dog need be big... huge!
translation: 记住狗需要大……巨大！

english: He betrayed us!
translation: 他背叛了我们！

english: I got to meet you!
translation: 我终于见到你了！

english: Shark-Brew-Karam! You must try eat it in one go!
translation: 鲨鱼-酿造-卡拉姆！你必须一口气吃掉它！

english: Bork think it stomp time now!
translation: 博克觉得现在是踩踏时间了！

english: The crab scowls, then clicks its claws some more.
translation: 螃蟹皱起眉头，然后又多咔嗒了几下钳子。

english: Wonderful, keep up the good work.
translation: 太好了，继续保持。

english: Coward!
translation: 懦夫！

english: Oh, my... what's got you all grumpy? Where's your Halloween spirit?
translation: 哦，天哪……是什么让你这么暴躁？你的万圣节精神去哪儿了？

english: Yes, discard the cargo.
translation: 是的，丢弃货物。

english: Recolour your Amulet of the Eye?
translation: 重新着色你的眼之护符？

english: [player name] won't give me sweets!
translation: [player name]不给我糖果！

english: Yes, that it is, and it will likely need to be, with what we're up against.
translation: 是的，确实如此，而且考虑到我们要面对的东西，它很可能需要如此。

english: I have a good feeling about it.
translation: 我对此有很好的预感。

english: It has been difficult lately. It's a lot of threats, one after another. And it seems like it's always the same few groups of people who are willing respond.
translation: 最近很艰难。威胁一个接一个，很多。而且似乎总是那几群人愿意响应。

english: You... disrespect... Guthix...
translation: 你……不敬……古斯……

english: Nigel removes the trim from your Imbued ancient cape (Deadman).
translation: 奈杰尔移除了你的灌注远古披风（Deadman）上的装饰。

english: Being dead, what options do you think you have? I'm not trying to be rude or anything, but it's not like you have many options is it? I mean, it's either up or down for you isn't it?
translation: 既然已经死了，你觉得你还有什么选择？我不是想无礼什么的，但你的选择也不多，对吧？我是说，对你来说要么上去要么下去，对吧？

english: Are you learning, though? Because I am learning nothing from this.
translation: 可你在学吗？因为我从这什么都没学到。

english: You'll pass her house on the way into Varrock from here, just outside the western entrance to the city.
translation: 你从这里前往维洛克城的路上会经过她的房子，就在城市西门外面。

english: Really? What happened?
translation: 真的吗？发生了什么？

english: All I wanted was sweets, but [player name] won't give me any!
translation: 我只想要糖果，但[player name]一点都不给我！

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye (red)? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要重新着色你的眼之长袍上衣 (红)吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料并替换任何现有的重新着色。

english: A ceremonial leader? What do they do?
translation: 仪式领袖？他们做什么？

english: Liar! You deceived me!
translation: 骗子！你欺骗了我！

english: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach. He's looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.
translation: 你好！我是代表我在海滩上的螃蟹朋友来的。他在寻找能成为仪式领袖的螃蟹。

english: That be an order, missus [player name]!
translation: 这是命令，[player name]女士！

english: That's not a bass! A bass is a type of fish! Also, what's with that accent?
translation: 那不是鲈鱼！鲈鱼是一种鱼！还有，你那口音是怎么回事？

english: Picklenose jumped by big dog.
translation: Picklenose被大狗跳扑了。

english: I wouldn't expect a dog to sit and guard your village all day either.
translation: 我也不指望一条狗整天坐着看守你的村庄。

english: You're doing it wrong!
translation: 你做错了！

english: : Ah, well done matey, that's the right combination. Here, have a little somethin' for helpin' me out.
translation: ：啊，干得好，伙计，那就是正确的组合。来，拿点小东西，谢谢你帮我。

english: Yes... Our enemies are powerful. With the Staff and the Stone, Lucien approaches the power of the gods. Meanwhile, we have been left without ours.
translation: 是的……我们的敌人很强大。有了法杖和石头，卢西安正逼近众神的力量。而我们却失去了自己的。

english: I believe so, yes. Will you be joining him?
translation: 我想是的。你会加入他吗？

english: You don't find anything you'd ever want to read.
translation: 你找不到任何你想读的东西。

english: Y-yes of course, sire, but surely your graciousness is too important to perform such menial duties? Is this not Gadderanks job, your most high beneficence?
translation: 是——是的，当然，陛下，但您如此尊贵，肯定不适合做这种卑微的差事吧？这不是加德兰克斯的职责吗，至高无上的恩主？

english: Climb down the stairs.
translation: 爬下楼梯。

english: I imagine you're somewhat familiar with it now, but if needed, you can see the Archive's layout on the board beside me.
translation: 我想你现在对它已经有些熟悉了，但如有需要，你可以在我旁边的告示板上查看档案馆的布局。

english: Very well. But first, you must solve my riddle!
translation: 很好。但首先，你必须解开我的谜题！

english: There is a cow hide placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一张牛皮。

english: I... think I'm going to give it a pass.
translation: 我……我想我还是算了吧。

english: Ask it to stop gathering junk?
translation: 叫它停止收集垃圾？

english: By the time we got back, we'd still need to clean the kennels, feed the dogs we do have, repair the fences...
translation: 等我们回来时，还得清理狗舍、喂养我们现有的狗、修理栅栏……

english: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach who is looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders.
translation: 你好！我代表海滩上的螃蟹朋友而来，它在寻找能成为仪式领袖的螃蟹。

english: You are not worthy of holding that Diamond of Ice!
translation: 你不配持有那颗冰之钻石！

english: I thought the work would be more... scientific.
translation: 我以为这工作会更……科学一些。

english: Yes, I'll go and look for him.
translation: 好的，我去找他。

english: If you struggle to make contact, you may want to make yourself flatter to the ground.
translation: 如果你难以取得联系，也许可以让自己更贴近地面。

english: Right, have it your way then, matey!!!
translation: 好吧，那就随你的便吧，伙计！！！

english: Picklenose think Picklenose go now.
translation: Picklenose觉得Picklenose该走了。

english: I sincerely doubt that.
translation: 我对此深表怀疑。

english: Their training is being put to the test, but they are performing admirably.
translation: 他们的训练正受到考验，但他们表现得非常出色。

english: 'One good turn deserves another'
translation: “善有善报”

english: You're hit by splintering pieces of wood as a nearby barrel explodes.
translation: 附近一个木桶爆炸，你被飞溅的木片击中。

english: Stay
translation: 留下

english: : Yes, I'll help you unlock your chest.
translation: ：好的，我来帮你打开你的宝箱。

english: A foul stench seems to be seeping down from the floor above... It could be dangerous up there without a nosepeg.
translation: 一股恶臭似乎正从楼上渗下来……不戴鼻塞上去可能会很危险。

english: You place the lyre on the sand. The crab awkwardly plucks a string and a clear note rings.
translation: 你把竖琴放在沙地上。螃蟹笨拙地拨动一根琴弦，一个清脆的音符响起。

english: As you slowly turn around on the spot...
translation: 当你慢慢在原地转过身时……

english: Make some candy onions! Fetch some sugar from the chemist down the road and melt it.
translation: 做些糖果洋葱！去路边的化学家那里拿些糖，然后把它融化。

english: Awww... Okay, how's that?
translation: 哎呀……好吧，这样如何？

english: None of the gold around here is even remotely suitable in terms of quality. I have searched far and wide for the perfect gold I desire, but have had no success so in finding it.
translation: 这附近的黄金在品质上都远远不合格。我四处寻找我渴望的完美黄金，却始终未能找到。

english: I have no time for idle chit chat. I've got to go.
translation: 我没时间闲聊。我得走了。

english: Whoops!
translation: 哎呀！

english: As you wish, as you wish! Please do not destroy my home!
translation: 如你所愿，如你所愿！请不要毁了我的家！

english: I doubt they'll ever even realise. Anyway, I remember seeing some uniforms through a window on the way over here. They were in the villa to the north.
translation: 我怀疑他们根本不会察觉。总之，我记得来这里的路上透过一扇窗户看到过一些制服。它们在北边的别墅里。

english: Take the mirrors.
translation: 拿走镜子。

english: She must have caught the scent of her puppies. I should follow her.
translation: 她一定是闻到了她小狗的气味。我应该跟着她。

english: We'll have to do something about them. Henja, I think its time for Plan B.
translation: 我们得对它们采取行动。亨雅，我想是时候执行B计划了。

english: You talked about being tickled and a gnome ball.
translation: 你谈到了被挠痒痒和地精球。

english: You should take more care. It is unwise to push your luck.
translation: 你应该多加小心。得寸进尺是不明智的。

english: What sort of aaaacideeent?
translation: 什么样的事故故故故？

english: Duel Arena
translation: 决斗竞技场

english: Agh!
translation: 啊！

english: They are many, but they are not united. We will win because we found allies, and because we worked together.
translation: 他们人数众多，但并不团结。我们会赢，因为我们找到了盟友，也因为我们并肩作战。

english: Unfortunately he has apparently returned to his home, somewhere under Ice Mountain, and I have no idea how to find him.
translation: 不幸的是，他显然已经回到了冰山下的某个家中，而我不知道该如何找到他。

english: Select an Option
translation: 选择一个选项

english: That is why Crux Eqal intervened. Both because Lucien acts outside of the natural balance, and also because our actions are inherently natural. After all, we are a part of Gielinor.
translation: 这就是Crux Eqal介入的原因。既因为卢西安的行为违背了自然平衡，也因为我们的行动本质上是自然的。毕竟，我们是吉利诺的一部分。

english: You give the goblins the stuffed dog.
translation: 你把填充狗交给了哥布林。

english: However, luckily for us, there does seem to have been some splintering within Lucien's ranks. The Dagon'hai no longer appear to be working with him. Instead, they seem intent on raiding the Archive for themselves.
translation: 然而，对我们来说幸运的是，卢西安的队伍中似乎确实出现了一些分裂。Dagon'hai似乎不再与他合作。相反，他们似乎打算为自己洗劫档案馆。

english: I'll focus the winds!
translation: 我来集中风之力！

english: Additional deaths, unknown condition:
translation: 额外死亡，状况不明：

english: You think her power can save you from me?
translation: 你以为她的力量能让你从我手中逃脱？

english: Yes if you pay for it with GP.
translation: 是的，如果你用金币支付的话。

english: I'm afraid I can't help you at the moment.
translation: 恐怕我目前帮不了你。

english: Hello Islwyn.
translation: 你好，伊斯尔温。

english: Maybe you can find something to drive them away briefly.
translation: 也许你能找到什么东西暂时把它们赶走。

english: Moia arrived in the Archive, sowing strife as if she enjoys it. Reawakening the ancient citizens of Forinthry, to whom Guthix dedicated the moratorium, and forcing them to fight to destroy it... She wishes to incite our anger, and although the company was able to chase her off, it's fair to say she somewhat succeeded.
translation: Moia来到了档案馆，仿佛乐在其中般播撒纷争。她唤醒了Forinthry的古老市民——Guthix曾为他们设立暂停期——并迫使他们为摧毁它而战……她想激起我们的怒火，尽管一行人成功将她赶走，但可以说她多少得逞了。

english: Hmm... You have the smell of cats about you. Do you have one?
translation: 嗯……你身上有猫的气味。你养了一只吗？

english: Finds placed in this crate cannot be retrieved.
translation: 放入这个箱子的物品无法取回。

english: You made him an instrument called a disaster?
translation: 你给他做了一件叫“灾难”的乐器？

english: Aww come on, the joke wasn't that bad.
translation: 哎呀，别这样，这个笑话没那么糟吧。

english: Do you have any more challenges available?
translation: 你还有更多挑战吗？

english: This altar seems to do nothing...
translation: 这个祭坛似乎毫无作用……

english: Smithing.
translation: 锻造。

english: Curses! Foiled again!
translation: 可恶！又失败了！

english: I wish I could trade hallowed marks in for amylase crystals.
translation: 我希望我能用圣印换取淀粉酶结晶。

english: Thank you. This is Eva Cashien and Armacus Selles. They are leading the Temple Knights and the Guardians of Armadyl who have mobilised to defend the Archive.
translation: 谢谢你。这位是Eva Cashien，这位是Armacus Selles。他们正率领已动员起来保卫档案馆的圣殿骑士和Armadyl守护者。

english: You inspect the bed...
translation: 你检查了床……

english: This end... comes...
translation: 这一端……即将……

english: Not so faithful to me, were they?
translation: 他们对我可没那么忠诚，是吧？

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之长袍下装重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料，并替换现有的任何染色。

english: Actually, yes. He can't play more than one note yet. It's just a matter of time, though!
translation: 其实，是的。他现在还只能弹一个音符。不过，这只是时间问题！

english: Let's see where your values lie...
translation: 让我们看看你的价值观何在……

english: What're you doing down here?
translation: 你在这里做什么？

english: Then head to the beach to collect your coconut! Do not anger me again!
translation: 那就去海滩领取你的椰子吧！别再惹我生气了！

english: Why travel all this way to sit in a dirty cave?
translation: 为什么要大老远跑来坐在一个肮脏的洞穴里？

english: I don't have that many Ectotokens.
translation: 我没有那么多Ectotoken。

english: I can see myself in you!
translation: 我在你身上看到了我自己！

english: I wonder if the hallowed grapple is worth it?
translation: 不知道神圣抓钩值不值得？

english: Maybe becoming a ceremonial leader will help them forget about that? And you'd be too busy playing to accidentally go for a dip again.
translation: 也许成为仪式领袖能帮他们忘掉那件事？而且你会忙于演奏，不会不小心又去泡水了。

english: The stray dog can't follow you at the moment.
translation: 流浪狗目前无法跟随你。

english: We'll be leaning heavily on you once again, [player name]. Our forces will do what they can to lift your burden, but our enemies are powerful, and you have more experience than most.
translation: 我们又要严重依赖你了，[player name]。我们的部队会尽力减轻你的负担，但我们的敌人很强大，而你比大多数人都更有经验。

english: You talked about toad crunchies and being tickled.
translation: 你谈到了蟾蜍脆饼和被挠痒痒的事。

english: It's a very nice tree.
translation: 这是一棵非常好看的树。

english: I'm not sure... but giving a few coins to test it won't hurt.
translation: 我不确定……但给几枚金币试试也无妨。

english: What expertise?
translation: 什么专长？

english: Yes! Time to beat back our foes once more!
translation: 好！是时候再次击退我们的敌人了！

english: Politely tell them no, then use the 'Report Abuse' button.
translation: 礼貌地拒绝他们，然后使用“举报滥用”按钮。

english: And, to be honest, feels like a terrible idea too. Urgh. I now have a pounding headache...
translation: 而且，说实话，感觉也是个糟糕透顶的主意。呃。我现在头痛欲裂……

english: That's concerning... What about the others?
translation: 这真令人担忧……其他人呢？

english: You dealt some damage, but not nearly enough! Better luck next time.
translation: 你造成了一些伤害，但远远不够！下次好运。

english: This world around us... is a computer game... called RuneScape.
translation: 我们周围的这个世界……是一款电脑游戏……叫做RuneScape。

english: Nowhere
translation: 哪儿也不去

english: Where did she live again?
translation: 她到底住在哪里来着？

english: You want to eat the crabs? I won't let you. Now you better scram or I'm going to make you regret coming here.
translation: 你想吃这些蟹？我不会让你得逞的。你最好赶紧滚，否则我会让你后悔来到这里。

english: Your partner will now speed up, so feel free to keep practicing, then speak to me when you're ready to call it a day.
translation: 你的搭档现在会加速，所以尽管继续练习，等你准备收工时再来找我。

english: It's the least we can do.
translation: 这是我们最起码能做的。

english: Oh, nilsal to you. I wasn't expecting anyone else.
translation: 哦，向你致意nilsal。我没想到还会有别人。

english: I bet you can't beat this!
translation: 我打赌你赢不了这个！

english: Don't you pay attention?
translation: 你难道不注意听吗？

english: The crab that was in this tree is currently wandering around.
translation: 原本在这棵树上的蟹现在正在四处游荡。

english: I promise.
translation: 我保证。

english: And yet goodness remains. We often view our fight as one to keep the fragile flame of hope from being snuffed out.
translation: 然而善良依然存在。我们常把我们的战斗视为一场防止希望那脆弱的火焰被扑灭的斗争。

english: Hello your highness!
translation: 您好，殿下！

english: He's using seeds to move while frozen!
translation: 他在被冻结时用种子移动！

english: He saw your weapon before the attack! Try again.
translation: 他在攻击前看到了你的武器！再试一次。

english: Anyway, beyond that, there are six peripheral chambers that can be reached from the Nexus. It is through these chambers that our enemies mount their attacks.
translation: 总之，除此之外，还有六个外围密室可以从枢纽到达。我们的敌人正是通过这些密室发动攻击。

english: He does? I suppose that might qualify him if he can keep a rhythm. Are any of the shells going spare?
translation: 他有吗？如果他能保持节奏，我想这也许能让他胜任。那些贝壳有多余的吗？

english: Burning the hive would be a rather extreme measure for repelling bees.
translation: 烧掉蜂巢来驱赶蜜蜂未免太极端了。

english: Mysterious Voice 2
translation: 神秘声音 2

english: Armacus, this is [player name], the adventurer I told you about.
translation: Armacus，这就是[player name]，我跟你说过的那个冒险者。

english: Eva.
translation: 伊娃。

english: Let's see if you're up to the challenge!
translation: 让我们看看你能否应对这个挑战！

english: Oh, what a great scientific discovery! Would you object to answering a few questions?
translation: 哦，多么伟大的科学发现！你介意回答几个问题吗？

english: What did I just witness?
translation: 我刚才目睹了什么？

english: This sounds like a scam.
translation: 这听起来像个骗局。

english: The others depart.
translation: 其他人离开了。

english: Something is wrong. I should follow her and find out what she wants.
translation: 有些不对劲。我应该跟着她，弄清楚她想要什么。

english: A minor loss in the grand scheme of things.
translation: 从大局来看，这只是小小的损失。

english: That's how it starts.
translation: 事情就是这样开始的。

english: Aha, you're required [player name]!
translation: 啊哈，需要你，[player name]！

english: Leave the scenario?
translation: 离开场景？

english: Time to go!
translation: 该走了！

english: I wonder if there's a spell to bring that back.
translation: 不知道有没有法术能把它带回来。

english: You've never seen sails kept this well.
translation: 你从没见过保养得这么好的帆。

english: In fact, it would be great if you could clean it out, it makes the place look untidy.
translation: 事实上，如果你能把它清理干净就太好了，它让这里看起来乱糟糟的。

english: I will just use one.
translation: 我就用一个。

english: Excellent! Now faster!
translation: 太好了！现在再快点！

english: You succeed in filling your bucket! Meanwhile, the bees fly back to the hive as the repellent wears off.
translation: 你成功装满了桶！与此同时，驱虫剂失效后，蜜蜂飞回了蜂巢。

english: Shush!
translation: 嘘！

english: For most deaths thus far:
translation: 目前死亡次数最多的是：

english: Do you have any dogs up for adoption?
translation: 你们有狗可以领养吗？

english: So far, [player name] has proven him/herself to be particularly effective in battle.
translation: 到目前为止，[player name]已证明自己在战斗中特别有效。

english: Solus Dellagar.
translation: 索卢斯.德拉加。

english: Lucky for you, I enjoy wandering.
translation: 算你走运，我喜欢四处游荡。

english: And many more besides!
translation: 还有更多呢！

english: Well, I have a missing cat, if that's what you mean...
translation: 嗯，我有一只失踪的猫，如果你是这个意思的话……

english: How did you find that angle?
translation: 你是怎么找到那个角度的？

english: Yay! You're so awesome [player name]!
translation: 耶！你太棒了，[player name]！

english: Hang on, get back here!
translation: 等等，回来这里！

english: To pass you must answer me this: You have been offered a free giveaway or double XP invitation via social media or a livestream. What should you do?
translation: 要通过，你必须回答我这个问题：你通过社交媒体或直播收到了免费赠品或双倍经验邀请。你应该怎么做？

english: Why yes you can! The latent magical energy of the Archive collects in these crystals, and they seem to react to impact in interesting ways.
translation: 当然可以！档案馆潜伏的魔法能量聚集在这些水晶中，它们似乎会以有趣的方式对撞击做出反应。

english: I found it in a portal in the Archive... or something like that. I'm not really sure what, or where, it was.
translation: 我在档案馆的一个传送门里找到的……大概是吧。我不太确定那是什么，也不确定它在哪。

english: Well done! You've passed this challenge.
translation: 干得好！你通过了这个挑战。

english: What human mean?
translation: 人类什么意思？

english: Hi. Interesting building you have here. What's it for?
translation: 你好。你这建筑真有趣。它是做什么用的？

english: Start the Ernest the Chicken quest?
translation: 开始小鸡欧内斯特任务？

english: End...
translation: 终结……

english: That's quite the list we're up against.
translation: 我们要对付的名单可真长。

english: The door is securely locked, for now...
translation: 门被牢牢锁住了，暂时……

english: Talia sent me to you. She said you helped them with their dog shelter?
translation: 塔莉亚让我来找你。她说你帮他们建了狗舍？

english: Oh but it is! Their reactions are incredible! For example, hitting the rock will occasionally cause nearby ambient magic to collate into what I'm calling a sprite.
translation: 哦，但确实如此！它们的反应令人难以置信！例如，撞击岩石有时会导致附近的环境魔法聚集成我称之为精灵的东西。

english: It's not in the plan but it's certainly an option.
translation: 这不在计划中，但确实是个选择。

english: You... Who are you? And how did you get in here?
translation: 你……你是谁？你是怎么进来的？

english: It's a sort of magic box thing, which can do all sorts of stuff.
translation: 它是一种魔法盒之类的东西，能做各种各样的事。

english: Your time... comes...
translation: 你的时间……到了……

english: Toetaller don't think so.
translation: Toetaller不这么认为。

english: The bellows stop pumping air.
translation: 风箱停止泵送空气。

english: Guthix's power, now Zamorak's!
translation: 古斯的力量，如今归扎莫拉克所有！

english: I'm not sure how well this is going to work given you only have 2 legs.
translation: 考虑到你只有2条腿，我不确定这能有多大效果。

english: How can this bother you, not only are you already dead, but you keep returning?
translation: 这有什么好困扰你的，你不仅已经死了，还一直回来？

english: Incredible! There is so much to learn from this Archive! Thank you for assisting us.
translation: 太不可思议了！这座档案馆里有太多东西可以学习！感谢你的协助。

english: You use the Ancient fabric on the Imbued Guthix cape to create an Imbued ancient cape.
translation: 你在被强化的古斯斗篷上使用远古织物，制作出一件被强化的远古斗篷。

english: Has this puzzle confused you yet?
translation: 这个谜题把你搞糊涂了吗？

english: Bork maximum crush!
translation: 博克最大粉碎！

english: You attempt to pick the final lock...
translation: 你尝试撬开最后一道锁……

english: Victory is mine!
translation: 胜利属于我！

english: Toetaller have idea.
translation: 脚趾高个有主意。

english: As you wish. I'll note any shards I convert then give them straight to you. How many would you like me to convert?
translation: 如你所愿。我会记录我转换的每一块碎片，然后直接交给你。你希望我转换多少块？

english: Sadly the child's pockets are only big enough to accept 100 coins.
translation: 遗憾的是，这孩子的口袋只装得下100枚金币。

english: Shark-Karam, in that order, as soon as you get hit!
translation: 鲨鱼-卡拉姆，按这个顺序，一受到攻击就吃！

english: Okay, well, before we go down another rabbit hole, I'm looking for information on the Final Dawn.
translation: 好吧，在我们又陷入另一个兔洞之前，我想了解关于最终黎明的信息。

english: Treats! Treats!
translation: 零食！零食！

english: The Yorkie heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 约克夏犬前往狗狗收容所。

english: I suspect you're right. Thank you, [player name], for all of your help here, but it seems we must prepare to resume our defence. Any help you can continue to provide would be greatly appreciated.
translation: 我想你说得对。谢谢你，[player name]，感谢你在这里的所有帮助，但看来我们必须准备恢复防御了。你若能继续提供任何帮助，我们将不胜感激。

english: There's nothing in the barrel.
translation: 木桶里什么也没有。

english: There is nothing in the pot to pour onto the grave.
translation: 罐子里没有东西可以倒在坟墓上。

english: Bork make fast drum!
translation: 博克敲快鼓！

english: It's unlikely most of his followers were ever in his presence, even in the ages where he walked Gielinor. That doesn't diminish their bond.
translation: 他的大多数追随者很可能从未亲临他面前，即使在他行走于吉里诺的那些时代也是如此。但这并不削弱他们之间的纽带。

english: Your trinket gave you a Corrupted Scythe of Vitur (uncharged)!
translation: 你的饰品给了你一把堕落维图尔镰刀 (未充能)！

english: Spell my name with atomic signs, Then sum the numbers where they align.
translation: 用原子符号拼出我的名字，再把对齐处的数字相加。

english: Ha! A jape! At my expense, no less! Very well, I believe that is all the chatter we can afford. Let us return to battle once more!
translation: 哈！一个玩笑！还是拿我开涮！好吧，我想我们能负担的闲聊就到此为止了。让我们再次回到战斗中去！

english: I'm afraid I cannot take them so young. They need to be fully grown for Father Sugadinti.
translation: 恐怕我不能收这么小的。它们必须完全长大才能献给苏加丁提神父。

english: Let me try the extended challenge!
translation: 让我试试扩展挑战！

english: Exactly. They've gone on strike for some petty reason about the tower being too weird. I really can't understand those men.
translation: 正是如此。他们因为塔太古怪这种无聊的理由罢工了。我真搞不懂那些人。

english: I can't see why you wouldn't be allowed to be a leader. Why don't you go and have a go, and if you being a girl is a problem, let me know. I'll talk to them.
translation: 我看不出你有什么理由不能当领袖。你何不去试一试，如果因为你是女孩而遇到问题，就告诉我。我会去跟他们谈。

english: Do ceremonial leaders get trampled too?
translation: 仪式领袖也会被踩踏吗？

english: You are not worthy of holding that Diamond of Shadow!
translation: 你不配持有那颗阴影钻石！

english: If a brave young adventurer were to appear and clear the way for us to set up our defences, whilst we gathered our troops...
translation: 如果有一位勇敢的年轻冒险者出现，在我们集结部队时为我们清出道路、建立防御……

english: Opponents can use prayers to stop your weapons from harming them too much.
translation: 对手可以使用祈祷来阻止你的武器对他们造成过多伤害。

english: We arrived at the right time.
translation: 我们来得正是时候。

english: Row to the barge.
translation: 划船前往驳船。

english: You'd better pick up your follower before you board the minecart! You don't want anything horrible to happen to it!
translation: 你最好在登上矿车之前带上你的跟随者！你不想让它遭遇什么可怕的事吧！

english: How is Crux Eqal doing?
translation: Crux Eqal进展如何？

english: I hope that poor cat of yours isn't still in the bank!
translation: 我希望你那只可怜的猫没有还待在银行里！

english: We must go and ready our forces. We will see you inside.
translation: 我们必须去准备我们的部队了。我们里面见。

english: You doubt you will get much out of him.
translation: 你怀疑从他那里问不出什么。

english: Are there any more puppies we need to find?
translation: 还有更多小狗需要我们去找吗？

english: You need to have completed Troll Stronghold to use this rift.
translation: 你需要完成巨魔要塞才能使用这道裂隙。

english: Or at least it would if we could ever get it finished. See those builders?
translation: 至少如果我们能把它完工的话就会如此。看到那些建筑工人了吗？

english: I no longer need my Training arrowss, would you like it back?
translation: 我不再需要我的训练箭了，你愿意收回它们吗？

english: Hmm... This is the kind of situation Talia would have me intervene with...
translation: 嗯……这种情况正是塔莉亚会让我介入的……

english: No luck finding shells? There should be some on the beach or around the island.
translation: 没找到贝壳？海滩上或岛周围应该有一些。

english: I record the Archive's effects on its surroundings. Namely, the changes in those big crystals behind you.
translation: 我记录档案馆对其周围环境的影响。也就是你身后那些大水晶的变化。

english: Whatever it is, she is being very persistent.
translation: 不管是什么，她都表现得非常执着。

english: It's quite the pickle we're in, I'm afraid! Our enemies approach from all sides. We have identified six vulnerable chambers altogether.
translation: 恐怕我们现在的处境相当棘手！敌人从四面八方逼近。我们一共确认了六个薄弱的密室。

english: Just head to the west entrance of Varrock. I'm sure you'll run into one before long.
translation: 直接去维洛克城的西门就行。我相信你很快就会遇到一只。

english: Yes! And what is more, merely noticing the sprite will cause it to immediately change into its solid crystal form, gravitating towards the source of attention.
translation: 是的！而且更重要的是，仅仅注意到那个精灵，就会让它立刻变成坚固的水晶形态，并朝注意力的来源移动。

english: Take care, [player name]!
translation: 保重，[player name]！

english: But would they be right? We know very little about the artefacts here, which can be even more dangerous than knowing nothing at all.
translation: 但他们说得对吗？我们对这里的文物知之甚少，而一知半解可能比一无所知更危险。

english: Glad to hear it. I'd have hated for them to go damaging something around here!
translation: 很高兴听你这么说。我可不愿它们把这里的东西弄坏！

english: 'Ello there, you after a lesson?
translation: 你好啊，你是来上课的吗？

english: Sorry not yet...
translation: 抱歉，还没有……

english: Well, then why don't you and I ask this one a few little questions. You don't mind, do you, sergeant?
translation: 那么，你和我为什么不问问这家伙几个小问题呢。你不介意吧，中士？

english: That would be Hello SIR to you guard! Get out of here and go guard something!
translation: 对你要说“你好，长官”！滚出去守卫点东西吧！

english: Aaaaaah?
translation: 啊啊啊啊？

english: Want me to take you back to Mos Le'harmless?
translation: 要我带你回莫斯勒哈姆斯岛吗？

english: There is some red spider eggs placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一些红色蜘蛛卵。

english: You hand in a tiny white shell.
translation: 你交上了一枚小小的白色贝壳。

english: Impressive resilience.
translation: 惊人的韧性。

english: It's just me, no one special.
translation: 只是我而已，没什么特别的。

english: How about rat poisons and anti-poisons for cats?
translation: 那老鼠药和给猫用的解毒药怎么样？

english: You receive 20x Blighted super restore (4).
translation: 你获得了 20x 腐化超级恢复药水(4)。

english: You need to play with them, take them for walks...
translation: 你需要陪它们玩，带它们散步……

english: Now who share word of Big High War God?
translation: 现在谁来传播大高战争之神的话语？

english: You can't make supercompost from supercompost. That doesn't make sense.
translation: 你不能用超级堆肥制作超级堆肥。这说不通。

english: Not baaaad...
translation: 还不赖嘛……

english: Even Unferth could figure this one out.
translation: 连昂弗斯都能想明白这个。

english: Right, should we head over to the shelter?
translation: 好，我们该去避难所了吗？

english: We're here to save that puppy.
translation: 我们是来救那只小狗的。

english: Congratulations on succeeding in the Knight Waves, my liege.
translation: 恭喜您成功通过骑士之波，我的君主。

english: The bonus shape has changed to the cylinder.
translation: 奖励形状已变为圆柱体。

english: You talked about toad crunchies and a gnome ball.
translation: 你谈到了蟾蜍脆饼和地精球。

english: That's a nice perspective. I think King Roald's advisor would benefit from hearing it.
translation: 这是个不错的观点。我想罗尔德国王的顾问会乐意听听。

english: I need to let him up if he's to fix this device.
translation: 如果他要修好这个装置，我得让他起来。

english: You have? Unfortunately I don't have it any more.
translation: 你有吗？可惜我已经没有了。

english: Your inventory is too full to hold any more onions.
translation: 你的物品栏太满了，装不下更多洋葱。

english: Can I get a hand over here?
translation: 这边能来个人帮帮我吗？

english: Yes! Please demonstrate the ceremonial dance to me.
translation: 是的！请给我演示一下仪式之舞。

english: You give back your Training arrowss to the Ranged combat tutor.
translation: 你把训练箭还给了远程战斗导师。

english: That is the burden carried by those of us who care for the world.
translation: 这就是我们这些关心世界的人所背负的重担。

english: 'Ello der [player name]! *hic*!
translation: 你好啊 [player name]！*嗝*！

english: You find 50 coins inside the chest.
translation: 你在宝箱里找到了 50 枚金币。

english: Greetings! In this scenario, you'll master combo eating.
translation: 你好！在这个场景中，你将掌握连招进食。

english: Did someone say Bran?!
translation: 有人提到布兰了吗？！

english: Aaaaaaah!
translation: 啊啊啊啊！

english: Eat now and keep eating!
translation: 现在吃，一直吃！

english: Actually it's more a case of what can I help you with? I told the Fairy Godfather that I would help you find a cure for the Queen.
translation: 其实更应该说我能帮你什么？我告诉过仙子教父，我会帮你找到治愈女王的方法。

english: : When the items in the middle row all match the words written under the column then you'll have solved the lock.
translation: ：当中间一行的物品全部与各列下方所写的文字匹配时，你就解开这把锁了。

english: Go ahead, take tiny goblin.
translation: 去吧，小地精。

english: I'm unfrozen!
translation: 我解冻了！

english: Indeed it is Roavar, but I cannot find that incompetent fool. And assuming you are not the one who wishes to tell Lord Drakan that his tithe has not been collected, I saw fit to take on the duty myself this time.
translation: 确实是罗阿瓦，但我找不到那个无能的蠢货。而且，既然你不是那个想告诉德拉坎领主他的什一税尚未征收的人，我这次就亲自承担这项职责了。

english: Yes, if the artefacts here fall into the wrong hands, we'll have an even bigger problem than we have now.
translation: 是的，如果这里的文物落入坏人手中，我们的问题会比现在更大。

english: That enthusiasm...I could use that.
translation: 那份热情……我能用得上。

english: It seems they weren't powerful enough. How disappointing.
translation: 看来他们还不够强大。真令人失望。

english: If you would kindly like to make your way to the beach, you can show the other crabs how it's done.
translation: 如果你愿意前往海滩，你可以向其他螃蟹展示该怎么做。

english: Then we must consider him another enemy.
translation: 那我们必须把他视为另一个敌人。

english: Eat now!
translation: 现在吃！

english: A what now?
translation: 一个什么？

english: Corporeal Beast.
translation: 实体巨兽。

english: Every part of this plan...every piece in position.
translation: 这个计划的每一部分……每一块都各就各位。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye (green)? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍上衣 (绿) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: Check out this book.
translation: 看看这本书。

english: Has the stray dog come this way? I can't find her.
translation: 流浪狗来过这边吗？我找不到她。

english: No, leave it be.
translation: 不，随它去吧。

english: Why didn't you say so, my boy!
translation: 你怎么不早说，孩子！

english: I meant I wanted you to jooooooin uuuuus at out weekly poetry recital.
translation: 我的意思是我想让你加加加加入我们的每周诗歌朗诵会。

english: The emerald is free to convert!
translation: 绿宝石可以免费转换！

english: A strange power blocks your exit.
translation: 一股奇怪的力量阻挡了你的出口。

english: That's not right! No sugar for you!
translation: 不对！不给你糖！

english: Hmm... Well, for your sake, you had better hope that indeed it is. The mood I am in for having to come to this wolfen cesspit means any shortfall is coming from you directly.
translation: 嗯……好吧，为了你自己，你最好祈祷确实如此。我不得不来到这个狼人粪坑的心情意味着任何短缺都会直接算在你头上。

english: Well I did buy some other odds and ends off you.... no hang on! I get it now, you're in league with the Camel seller, the Kebab seller and the mayor, aren't you?
translation: 嗯，我确实从你那里买了一些其他零碎东西……不，等等！我现在明白了，你和骆驼商人、烤肉商人和镇长是一伙的，对吧？

english: How about yourself? Staying active?
translation: 你自己呢？还保持活跃吗？

english: Our scouts have delivered some troubling news. The Stone of Jas was not the only thing Guthix hid deep beneath Lumbridge. In those same caverns, an area has been found that we are calling the Archive. From what we've been able to determine, it appears to be a collection of artefacts that, much like the Stone, Guthix hid away at the end of the God Wars. These artefacts are now at risk.
translation: 我们的侦察兵带来了一些令人不安的消息。贾斯之石并不是古斯藏在仑桥镇深处唯一的东西。在那些同样的洞穴中，发现了一个我们称之为档案馆的区域。根据我们所能确定的情况，它似乎是一批文物，和那块石头一样，是古斯在神战结束时藏起来的。这些文物现在面临风险。

english: Remind us of chosen commander.
translation: 提醒我们选定的指挥官。

english: The gods once granted powers that rushed mortals through the natural process. This has its advantages, but it creates brittle and volatile ecosystems. Imbalance. The Stone is one such power.
translation: 众神曾赐予力量，让凡人加速经历自然过程。这有其优势，但会创造出脆弱而动荡的生态系统。失衡。那块石头就是这样的力量之一。

english: Following the instructions in the book, you make an elemental shield.
translation: 按照书中的指示，你制作了一面元素盾。

english: When I found her, she was distraught. Her puppies had been stolen.
translation: 我找到她时，她悲痛欲绝。她的幼崽被偷走了。

english: Greetings, [player name]! I sense a presence about you... What is it that you carry?
translation: 你好，[player name]！我感觉到你身上有一种气息……你带着什么？

english: Armacus, Eva and Ivy have gone to rally the rest of the forces. We are only a small vanguard sent to assess the situation and prepare if necessary.
translation: 阿玛库斯、伊娃和艾薇已去召集其余部队。我们只是一支被派来评估局势并在必要时做好准备的小型先锋队。

english: You will need to hit him once with each of the four elemental spells of Death before he will be defeated.
translation: 你需要用四种死亡元素法术各击中他一次，才能击败他。

english: Nicely done! 2/5.
We need more strays to rescue. If people know they can find a companion here, they'll come.
translation: 我们需要更多流浪动物来救助。如果人们知道可以在这里找到伙伴，他们就会来。

english: Murderer!
translation: 杀人犯！

english: Lamps.
translation: 灯。

english: He asked me to kill 3!
translation: 他让我杀3个！

english: You didn't receive my message? Concerning...
translation: 你没收到我的消息？令人担忧……

english: The bars are frozen tightly shut and a sturdy layer of ice prevents you from slipping through.
translation: 栅栏被冻得紧紧关闭，一层坚固的冰阻止你溜过去。

english: I kicked him out. We can't have him disrupt the ceremony, now, can we?
translation: 我把他赶出去了。我们不能让他扰乱仪式，对吧？

english: Secure my device and reset my password.
translation: 保护我的装置并重置我的密码。

english: I suppose if it got infected, that'd just impress the crew all the more.
translation: 我想如果它被感染了，那只会让船员们更加印象深刻。

english: Goblins amazed at size of big dog.
translation: 哥布林对大狗的体型感到惊讶。

english: Wait for leaders to turn up.
translation: 等待首领们出现。

english: You need giant frogs legs to do that.
translation: 你需要巨蛙腿才能这样做。

english: Careful now, you're walking into a trap!
translation: 小心，你正走进陷阱！

english: It's good to have the Temple Knights on our side.
translation: 有圣殿骑士团站在我们这边真好。

english: She mentioned there are some stray dogs in Varrock that might need help.
translation: 她提到维洛克城里有几只流浪狗可能需要帮助。

english: I wish I could tell you they'd all been adopted... but I'd be lying to myself.
translation: 我真希望能告诉你它们都被领养了……但那是在骗我自己。

english: Hrm. Okay then, you've convinced me. I'll help.
translation: 嗯。好吧，你说服我了。我会帮忙的。

english: We bury king under rubble soon enough.
translation: 我们很快就把国王埋在瓦砾下。

english: The stray dog barks in the direction the goblin ran off in.
translation: 流浪狗朝着哥布林逃走的方向吠叫。

english: The Greyhound heads to the dog shelter.
translation: 灰狗前往狗狗收容所。

english: However, the three apparently split the map into three pieces, with each of them taking one piece.
translation: 然而，三人显然把地图分成了三块，每人各拿一块。

english: Then we do goblin plan.
translation: 那我们就执行哥布林计划。

english: Unworthy...
translation: 不配……

english: Correct again! Hmm. My destination is 100 paces to the east and 12 paces to the south. How many paces would that be if I was a bird that flew straight there?
translation: 又答对了！嗯。我的目的地在东边100步、南边12步。如果我是一只鸟，直接飞过去，那会是多少步？

english: I'll guide the flow!
translation: 我来引导水流！

english: And is the world not assailed, unendingly, by those who wish to see that change?
translation: 难道这个世界不是一直被那些希望看到这种改变的人无休止地侵袭吗？

english: I think [player name] should be the king of Halloween!
translation: 我觉得[player name]应该当万圣节之王！

english: Something has her upset. Has she ever been like this before?
translation: 有什么事让她心烦。她以前这样过吗？

english: Wait. Since you walk sideways, which way IS a side glance?
translation: 等等。既然你横着走，那“侧眼”到底是哪一边？

english: Where does our ceremony take place?
translation: 我们的仪式在哪里举行？

english: Hello! I'm looking for crabs to become ceremonial leaders on behalf of my crab friend on the beach.
translation: 你好！我在找螃蟹，代表我在海滩上的螃蟹朋友成为仪式领袖。

english: The Sergeant is busy training the soldiers.
translation: 中士正忙着训练士兵。

english: Looks like they need fixing. You reset the lever.
translation: 看起来它们需要修理。你重置了拉杆。

english: That would be Hello SIR to you guard! And what are you doing out of uniform? Get out of here and get in uniform!
translation: 对你这个守卫来说，应该说“您好，长官”！还有，你为什么不穿制服？滚出去，穿上制服！

english: Supplies are available!
translation: 补给品已备好！

english: Well, er sort of. I got to his camp and I encountered a spirit of some kind. I don't think it was a Ghast, it tried to communicate with me, but made no sense, it was all 'ooooh' this and 'oooh' that.
translation: 嗯，呃，算是吧。我到了他的营地，遇到了一种灵魂。我觉得那不是恶灵，它试图和我交流，但毫无意义，全是“哦哦哦”这个、“哦哦哦”那个。

english: What human want, Wartface?
translation: 人类想要什么，疣脸？

english: No. You don't know enough about my kin. Begone.
translation: 不行。你对我的同类了解得还不够。滚吧。

english: You try to stuff the object into the keyhole. It doesn't fit.
translation: 你试着把物品塞进钥匙孔。它塞不进去。

english: Its tail wags happily.
translation: 它的尾巴开心地摇着。

english: Puppies will keep your village safe?
translation: 小狗能保护你的村庄安全？

english: Go on!
translation: 继续！

english: Scam!
translation: 骗局！

english: I am aware, I am aware... However, I would argue our willingness to protect this place might mark us as worthy to wield its power, if only for its defence.
translation: 我知道，我知道……不过，我认为我们愿意保护这个地方，或许能证明我们有资格驾驭它的力量，哪怕只是为了保卫它。

english: Human got thread?
translation: 人类有线吗？

english: There is giant frogs legs placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着巨蛙腿。

english: Hiss! Back off!
translation: 嘶！退后！

english: Oh, I was having fun with that one.
translation: 哦，我玩那个正玩得开心呢。

english: We cannot fail!
translation: 我们不能失败！

english: Here you go kid, don't spend it all at once!
translation: 给你，孩子，别一下子全花光了！

english: Arf arf!
translation: 汪！汪！

english: What a keen eye you have! But imagine this: a gargantuan cylinder of expert design, incorporating an inventive inner spiral walkway to multiple planes of wondrous inhabitance!
translation: 你的眼力真敏锐！但想象一下：一个设计精妙的巨大圆柱体，内含富有创意的内部螺旋人行道，通往多个奇妙居住层面！

english: This fairy ring will take you out of Zanaris. It leads to the place known as Al Kharid in your realm. Once passed you can not return this way.
translation: 这个仙女环会带你离开扎纳里斯城。它通往你们领域中被称为阿尔卡里德城的地方。一旦通过，你就无法沿这条路返回。

english: Good afternoon [player name], care for a quick game?
translation: 下午好[player name]，想来一局快棋吗？

english: The crab despondently throws its claws in the air, then scutters away to join the practice.
translation: 螃蟹沮丧地把钳子抛向空中，然后匆匆爬走去参加练习。

english: Greetings mistress [player name]!
translation: 您好，女主人[player name]！

english: Well, it just so happens I have this.
translation: 嗯，碰巧我有这个。

english: It's up to you! You can continue talking to my kin and recruiting leaders or you can wait for them to turn up.
translation: 这取决于你！你可以继续和我的同类交谈并招募领袖，也可以等他们自己出现。

english: It's a very nice tree. I could get quite a few logs from it.
translation: 这是一棵非常好看的树。我能从它身上弄到不少原木。

english: Stupid human having visions?
translation: 愚蠢的人类出现幻觉了？

english: Trick or treat!
translation: 不给糖就捣蛋！

english: You're unable to open the locked hatch.
translation: 你无法打开已锁定的舱口。

english: No mutts allowed in the Grand Exchange! Keep that dog away.
translation: 大交易所不允许杂种狗进入！把那条狗赶远点。

english: We can't let something like that happen again. I can take you and your puppies somewhere safe, if you'd like?
translation: 我们不能再让那种事发生了。如果你愿意，我可以带你和你的小狗们去个安全的地方？

english: I wish that were so...
translation: 我希望如此……

english: And let me guess, there's more?
translation: 让我猜猜，还有更多？

english: You hear the sound of a water wheel starting up.
translation: 你听到水车启动的声音。

english: Acceptable. I'm going to try it out while you look for some more.
translation: 可以接受。你去找更多的时候，我来试试看。

english: I believe that is all the chatter we can afford, young [player name]. Our foes will not wait.
translation: 我相信我们能负担的闲聊就这些了，年轻的[player name]。我们的敌人可不会等待。

english: No that's a bass. THIS is a BASS. It's pronounced differently.
translation: 不，那是鲈鱼。这——才是低音。发音不一样。

english: There is a feather placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一根羽毛。

english: No survivors!
translation: 没有幸存者！

english: What did you need of me again?
translation: 你又需要我做什么？

english: You see some text scrolled above the altar on a symbol: Red spider's eggs and a sardine raw...
translation: 你看到祭坛上方的符号上滚动着一些文字：红蜘蛛的卵和一条生沙丁鱼……

english: This one's easy.
translation: 这个简单。

english: This process is irreversible. Are you sure you wish to proceed?
translation: 此过程不可逆。你确定要继续吗？

english: Did I ever tell you of the time I saved the world? No?
translation: 我有没有跟你讲过那次我拯救世界的事？没有？

english: Sorry, I was just interested.
translation: 抱歉，我只是感兴趣。

english: Human rude. Goblins busy. Speak quick.
translation: 人类无礼。哥布林很忙。快说。

english: No, they disengaged and made for a tunnel we think leads to the Archive. The demon followed, but went down a different path.
translation: 不，他们脱离战斗，朝一条我们认为是通往档案馆的隧道去了。恶魔跟了上去，但走了另一条路。

english: You still need one more piece of the crest.
translation: 你还差一块纹章碎片。

english: Take that! And that!
translation: 接招！再接招！

english: And miss out on the scientific discovery of the century! No, I must take notes.
translation: 然后错过本世纪的科学发现！不行，我必须做记录。

english: Don't give them my password.
translation: 别把我的密码告诉他们。

english: But... Do I really need to quit the Temple Knights?
translation: 可是……我真的需要退出圣殿骑士团吗？

english: Runes? We can sell them for a good bit of coin.
translation: 符文？我们可以把它们卖掉换不少金币。

english: I am ready to fight.
translation: 我准备好战斗了。

english: You speak wisely, [player name]. Our time for discussion runs short, however. Let us return to our duties.
translation: 你说得很有道理，[player name]。不过我们讨论的时间不多了。让我们回到各自的职责上吧。

english: What? No! You are not going to do that because I'm not going to admit to having a crush and you can't make me.
translation: 什么？不！你不会那么做的，因为我不会承认自己有暗恋对象，你也逼不了我。

english: You squeeze through the hole.
translation: 你从洞中挤了过去。

english: Which area of the entling would you like to prune?
translation: 你想修剪小树精的哪个部位？

english: You break open the fragment of whispering wind and consume its power. Air spells will have an increased max hit of +2.
translation: 你掰开低语之风碎片并吸收了它的力量。风系法术的最大伤害提高+2。

english: Many goblin spare, keep that.
translation: 哥布林有很多备用，留着这个。

english: Actually, it sounds nice to me.
translation: 其实，我觉得挺好听的。

english: So, what do you think?
translation: 那么，你觉得怎么样？

english: Yip yip!
translation: 汪汪！

english: The headache from drinking from the bottle on the beach makes it difficult to find your boat. You feel that swigging from that bottle again would fix it.
translation: 喝了海滩上那瓶里的东西后，头痛让你难以找到自己的船。你觉得再灌一口那瓶里的东西就能缓解。

english: I didn't notice anything, but I will go and check.
translation: 我没注意到什么，但我会去查看一下。

english: The granite maul special attack has no delay, so it can be used instantly after using the Armadyl godsword.
translation: 花岗岩锤的战技没有延迟，因此可以在使用阿玛杜尔神剑后立即使用。

english: Shantay opens his arms wide as if to embrace you.
translation: 沙泰张开双臂，仿佛要拥抱你。

english: I haven't figured out how to solve it, but I don't know what this '42' is that you speak of. I think you just made that up. Begone!
translation: 我还没想出怎么解，而且我不知道你说的这个“42”是什么。我觉得那是你瞎编的。滚开！

english: Ok, I will. Thanks, see you later.
translation: 好的，我会的。谢谢，回头见。

english: Of course! Come back any time if you'd like to face me again.
translation: 当然！如果你想再次挑战我，随时回来。

english: Your skill as a thief allows you to see some kind of elaborate booby trapped locking mechanism on this chest.
translation: 你的盗贼技能让你看出这个宝箱上装有某种精巧的陷阱锁具。

english: The crab tosses the bad shell into the sea.
translation: 螃蟹把坏贝壳扔进了海里。

english: Pretty good! While I do this, could you find some more crabs willing to be ceremonial leaders? The sooner we start practising together, the better we will sound.
translation: 相当不错！趁我做这个的时候，你能再找些愿意当仪式领队的螃蟹吗？我们越早一起练习，听起来就越好。

english: The Dagon'hai?
translation: 达贡海？

english: Sob...worst Halloween EVER!
translation: 呜呜……史上最糟的万圣节！

english: When the plagues first started, Menaphos, our neighbouring city, closed their gates as well. Many of our citizens became trapped there when they did.
translation: 瘟疫刚爆发时，我们邻近的城市梅纳福斯也关闭了城门。城门一关，我们的许多市民就被困在了那里。

english: I have my reasons for not trading in Pollnivneach.
translation: 我有我的理由不在波尼尼镇做生意。

english: There are 10 mirrors and 3 crystals in the tray...
translation: 托盘里有10面镜子和3颗水晶……

english: What are the chances? A banjo is actually also a string instrument.
translation: 真巧啊？班卓琴其实也是一种弦乐器。

english: The fire produced from this lantern increases the amount of runes you craft by 10%.
translation: 这盏灯笼产生的火焰使你制作的符文数量增加10%。

english: Every 16 years.
translation: 每16年一次。

english: We were watching! You really ruined them!
translation: 我们都看到了！你真是把它们彻底毁了！

english: Your defence of this place ends with me.
translation: 你对这里的防守到此为止。

english: Business is business.
translation: 生意就是生意。

english: Do you...?
No-one ignores me!
translation: 没人可以无视我！

english: Yes. And every...
translation: 是的。而且每……

english: Not yet, and I've lost the materials to make it.
translation: 还没有，而且我已经把制作它的材料弄丢了。

english: What kind of power?
translation: 什么样的力量？

english: Oh, I thought these were prawns.
translation: 哦，我还以为这些是虾呢。

english: Puny human captured!
translation: 渺小的人类被抓住了！

english: If Moia was the third boss:
translation: 如果Moia是第三个首领：

english: Ha! I need not agree with my allies on every small matter. The important thing is that we've all chosen to work together on the things that are of importance.
translation: 哈！我不必在每件小事上都与盟友意见一致。重要的是我们都选择在重要的事情上携手合作。

english: You open the folio and read the words. It fizzles anticlimactically.
translation: 你打开对开本并读出上面的文字。它平淡无奇地嘶嘶作响。

english: You need a feather to do that.
translation: 你需要一根羽毛才能这样做。

english: Thank you, King Arthur.
translation: 谢谢你，亚瑟王。

english: You already have an axe.
translation: 你已经有一把斧头了。

english: Yeah, good job!
translation: 是啊，干得好！

english: Wrong... Many try... but none can resist... You will try to take it... His blade...
translation: 错了……许多人尝试过……但无人能抗拒……你会试图夺走它……他的剑……

english: Yap yap!
translation: 汪汪！

english: We're trying. The monks from the Monastery believe in our cause. That's why they granted us this land.
translation: 我们正在努力。修道院的僧侣们相信我们的事业。这就是他们授予我们这片土地的原因。

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe bottoms of the Eye (green)? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要将你的眼之长袍下装 (绿) 重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换任何现有的重新染色。

english: Perhaps the student is becoming the master.
translation: 也许学生正在成为大师。

english: There's a box of old stinky onions by the back door. We just need some sugar! The chemist down the road should have some.
translation: 后门旁有一箱发臭的旧洋葱。我们只需要一些糖！街那头的化学家应该有一些。

english: You hand over a blood rune.
translation: 你交出了一枚血符石。

english: Have I told you about my beloved Neite?
translation: 我跟你讲过我心爱的奈特吗？

english: Bran's bloody horn... By God, now that's not something I expected to see... Ever!
translation: 布兰的血角……天哪，这可不是我预料到会见到的东西……永远想不到！

english: Ascension!
translation: 飞升！

english: It all started when I confronted the king, he admitted the plague is a hoax.
translation: 一切都始于我与国王对峙，他承认瘟疫是个骗局。

english: The Diamond of Smoke seems to have mystically found its way back here.
translation: 烟雾钻石似乎神秘地回到了这里。

english: Well, I can sell you some rope for 15 coins. Or I can be making you some if you gets me four balls of wool. I strands them together I does, makes em strong.
translation: 嗯，我可以卖给你一些绳子，15枚金币。或者如果你给我四团羊毛，我可以给你做一些。我把它们搓在一起，让它们变得结实。

english: There is nothing growing in your patch.'
translation: 你的地块里什么也没长。'

english: Dismantle my trap.
translation: 拆除我的陷阱。

english: I am afraid of him not liking me, of course. But I might be even more afraid of him actually liking me!
translation: 我当然害怕他不喜欢我。但我可能更害怕他真的喜欢我！

english: Now come on, this has escalated from unicornplay and some lighthearted vandalism to... something else!
translation: 得了吧，这已经从独角兽游戏和一些无伤大雅的破坏行为升级成了……别的东西！

english: Receive noted essence?
translation: 以票据形式接收精华？

english: And through mine and the Temple Knights' actions, we practice and spread Saradomin's teachings. In that way, he is very much still present.
translation: 通过我和圣殿骑士们的行动，我们践行并传播萨拉多明的教诲。这样一来，他依然在很大程度上存在着。

english: Wait... You have to pay to attend?
translation: 等等……参加还要付费？

english: Mrrph...
translation: 呜噜……

english: Here they come!
translation: 它们来了！

english: Could you give me my essence noted?
translation: 你能把我的精华以票据形式给我吗？

english: I hope you get eaten by the KBD, [player name]!
translation: 我希望你被KBD吃掉，[player name]！

english: Now... ascension...
translation: 现在……飞升……

english: We need someone worldly to bring back stray dogs for us. Would you be willing to help us?
translation: 我们需要一个见多识广的人帮我们带回流浪狗。你愿意帮助我们吗？

english: It happens sometimes... I feel the urge to do something daft, like running in the complete opposite direction to where I wanted to go. Sometimes I can resist it, and sometimes I can't.
translation: 有时会发生……我感到一股冲动想做一些傻事，比如朝与我想要去的完全相反的方向跑。有时我能抗拒，有时不能。

english: Sorry, but I'm trying to talk to [player name]. However, he appears to be ignoring me...
translation: 抱歉，我正想和[player name]说话。但他似乎在无视我……

english: This dog?
translation: 这只狗？

english: Also, the crab playing coconut next to me is super cute! I'm so glad I came.
translation: 还有，在我旁边玩椰子的那只蟹超级可爱！我很高兴我来了。

english: Could we leverage it to help us?
translation: 我们能利用它来帮助我们吗？

english: You seem to know how to take action. We could do with more people like you to sort those despicable bandits out.
translation: 看来你知道该怎么行动。我们需要更多像你这样的人来收拾那些卑鄙的强盗。

english: Did you mean to leave that open for me?
translation: 你是故意给我留这个空当的吗？

english: Excellent show! You've skilfully protected against all the sets in this scenario and completed the challenge!
translation: 精彩的表现！你巧妙地防住了本场景中的所有套装，并完成了挑战！

english: Well, then I guess it's time to fix that.
translation: 好吧，那我想是时候解决这个问题了。

english: Hello! I'm here on behalf of my crab friend on the beach. He's looking for ceremonial leaders to join him this year.
translation: 你好！我是代表我在海滩上的螃蟹朋友来的。他正在寻找今年能和他一起担任仪式领袖的人。

english: Greetings! In this challenge, you'll learn how to use freeze spells to either escape from your opponent, or to stop them escaping themselves. I've equipped you with the magic gear you'll need.
translation: 你好！在这个挑战中，你将学习如何使用冰冻法术来逃离对手，或阻止他们逃跑。我已经为你装备好了所需的魔法装备。

english: Too slow! Streak reset.
translation: 太慢了！连胜重置。

english: No, I haven't seen her. What was the last thing you did with her?
translation: 不，我没见过她。你最后和她在一起时做了什么？

english: That's Ok SIR!
translation: 好的，长官！

english: Well, he wanted me to do something about it. Is there no way I can convince you to continue?
translation: 嗯，他希望我对此做点什么。难道我没办法说服你继续吗？

english: Yes. Not take long Toetaller think.
translation: 是的。不用很久脚高高想。

english: I think!
translation: 我想！

english: Oh come on! Just this one more thing? We'll be very grateful!
translation: 哦拜托！就再多做这一件事？我们会非常感激的！

english: Nothing personal, pig.
translation: 别往心里去，猪。

english: Awww. I don't know which crab is the one that caught your eye, but you obviously like him. Hey, maybe he's a ceremonial leader this year?
translation: 哎呀。我不知道是哪只螃蟹吸引了你的目光，但你显然喜欢他。嘿，也许他今年是仪式领袖？

english: Come here, I would like to know what you are doing here.
translation: 过来，我想知道你来这里做什么。

english: I cannot say for certain, but it is my belief that he didn't. You are correct that the artefacts within are dangerous, but fire is also dangerous. It can burn down forests and raze cities.
translation: 我不能确定，但我相信他没有。你说得对，里面的文物很危险，但火也很危险。它能烧毁森林，夷平城市。

english: You dig in amongst the vines.
translation: 你在藤蔓间挖掘。

english: Do you need some help?
translation: 你需要帮忙吗？

english: Sadly not.
translation: 很遗憾，没有。

english: So, you've finally come to face me.
translation: 所以，你终于来面对我了。

english: I'm sorry, my liege, but you cannot enter this area.
translation: 抱歉，陛下，但您不能进入此区域。

english: Right, I'd better get started, see you soon.
translation: 好，我最好开始动手了，回头见。

english: Pick a side and get to work!
translation: 选一边，然后开始干活！

english: Start Crab Quest?
translation: 开始螃蟹任务？

english: An artifact of this power needs a test before we try it on our precious looty!
translation: 拥有这种力量的器物需要先测试一下，才能用在咱们珍贵的战利品上！

english: Neite! Nooo!
translation: 奈特！不——！

english: Hey there, little guy! Aww, look at you! You're so cute!
translation: 嘿，小家伙！哎呀，看看你！你真可爱！

english: Back again are we? Well, stand in front of your opponent and eat a shark and karambwan once you get hurt!
translation: 又回来了？好吧，站在对手面前，受伤后吃一条鲨鱼和一条卡兰姆万！

english: I suppose I can, but I must admit, I thought the work would be more... scientific.
translation: 我想我可以，但我必须承认，我以为这工作会更……科学一些。

english: I obtained this half from the Black Arm Gang. I wonder if the Phoenix Gang might have the other half.
translation: 我从黑臂帮获得了这一半。不知道凤凰帮是否持有另一半。

english: You have met a glorious death in battle.
translation: 你在战斗中迎来了光荣的死亡。

english: If only I could be a ceremonial leader, then maybe...
translation: 要是我能当上仪式领袖，那也许……

english: So...are there any birds in here?
translation: 那么……这里有鸟吗？

english: No, the only way I can ever look at him is to steal some side glances...
translation: 不，我唯一能看他的方式就是偷瞄几眼……

english: The way I'm walking! Which means if I try to walk towards him, I can't even look where I'm going!
translation: 我走路的方式！也就是说，如果我想朝他走去，我连路都看不清！

english: You successfully combine the Boots of stone and Drake's claw to create Boots of Brimstone.
translation: 你成功将石靴和亚龙的爪结合，制作出了硫磺靴。

english: A wise man knows when to step back.
translation: 智者懂得何时退让。

english: What ho. Jolly good show on the old training grounds thingy, what?
translation: 你好啊。在旧训练场那玩意儿上表现真不错，是吧？

english: Buddy, what are you doing?
translation: 伙计，你在干什么？

english: It's tight timing, but you'll get it down!
translation: 时机很紧，但你会掌握的！

english: You like it? It's simply fabulous, isn't it? A real marvel of modern design, made just for my fellow alchemists and me!
translation: 你喜欢吗？简直太棒了，不是吗？现代设计的真正奇迹，专为我和我的炼金术士同僚们打造！

english: No, stay and practice.
translation: 不，留下继续练习。

english: Passing it down through generations. Exclusive ceremony beach corners. Pah! Anything to feel superior.
translation: 代代相传。专属仪式海滩角落。呸！只要能显得高人一等什么都行。

english: Yes, clear the patch and don't ask me again.
translation: 是的，清理这块地，别再问我了。

english: Good day Unferth, I am Nurse [player name].
translation: 你好，昂弗斯，我是护士[player name]。

english: So I look at him from afar when he doesn't know I'm around. Yet among a thousand crabs on the beach, he's the only one I see.
translation: 所以我会在他不知道我在附近时远远地看着他。然而海滩上有一千只螃蟹，我眼中却只有他。

english: Quite... You mentioned the Dagon'hai. A group of them were spotted near the Stone of Jas' old location. They seemed to be fending off an unusually capable tormented demon.
translation: 确实……你提到了Dagon'hai。有人在贾斯之石的旧位置附近发现了他们的一群人。他们似乎在击退一只异常强大的被折磨的恶魔。

english: Let me know when you are ready.
translation: 准备好后告诉我。

english: Small meat pouch.
translation: 小肉袋。

english: I'd like to go to Crandor.
translation: 我想去克兰多。

english: You receive 1x Ancient fabric.
translation: 你获得了1个远古织物。

english: Finally, we have Ocellus, the guardian of the Archive. Unfortunately, it seems his time here has driven him quite mad. We must consider him an enemy as well.
translation: 最后，还有档案馆的守护者奥塞勒斯。不幸的是，他似乎因为在这里待得太久而变得相当疯狂。我们也必须把他视为敌人。

english: Right. Go have a word with Bonafido the head builder. See if you can't get him off his backside to do some work. Oh, and I'm Effigy by the way.
translation: 好。去和首席建筑工人博纳菲多谈谈。看看能不能让他从屁股上挪开去干点活。哦，顺便说一下，我叫雕像。

english: Yarr! 'Tis a fine day to go a-pirating!
translation: 呀哈！今天真是当海盗的好日子！

english: Yer lily-livered swab!
translation: 你这胆小鬼！

english: Do not be afraid!
translation: 别害怕！

english: Where are you parents?
translation: 你的父母在哪里？

english: Maybe she wants one of us to follow her. I can't leave my post. Could you go?
translation: 也许她想让我们中的一个人跟着她。我不能离开岗位。你能去吗？

english: This is highly irregular! But I suppose I should.
translation: 这太不合规矩了！但我想我应该去。

english: A second dose of drink may let you remember where you moored your boat and how to teleport, but also make you forget about crabs a little.
translation: 再喝一口饮料也许能让你想起船停泊在哪里以及如何传送，但也会让你稍微忘记螃蟹的事。

english: Good, now begone.
translation: 很好，现在滚吧。

english: My crab friend on the beach is looking for ceremonial leaders to join him.
translation: 我在海滩上的螃蟹朋友正在寻找仪式领袖加入他。

english: Greetings, adventurer! Have you come to join the ranks of the Alliance?
translation: 你好，冒险者！你是来加入联盟的吗？

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Hat of the Eye? This will consume the Abyssal blue dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之帽重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊蓝色染料，并替换任何现有的染色。

english: It's really rude to ignore someone, [player name]!
translation: 无视别人真的很没礼貌，[player name]！

english: Like chasing a very boring mouse.
translation: 就像追一只非常无聊的老鼠。

english: Yes! He seemed confident you would help. 'I can see it in her eyes. The flame of justice!'
translation: 是的！他似乎很确信你会帮忙。'我能从她的眼中看到。正义之火！'

english: Oh, alright.
translation: 哦，好吧。

english: Hello, are you there [player name]!
translation: 你好，你在吗[player name]！

english: You wax the slex. You're now ready to go.
translation: 你给雪橇打了蜡。你现在可以出发了。

english: You fashion a makeshift string instrument out of the flotsam.
translation: 你用漂浮物做了一件简易的弦乐器。

english: Post on social media about it.
translation: 在社交媒体上发布这件事。

english: I hates yoo [player name]!
translation: 我恨你[player name]！

english: I suppose you have a point. It's just strange to think of them as potential allies, having fought them so recently.
translation: 我想你说得有道理。只是刚和他们打过仗，现在却要把他们当作潜在盟友，这感觉很奇怪。

english: Arf arf.
translation: 汪 汪。

english: Yes, yes I see. So... No monetary compensation or other actual reward then?
translation: 是的，是的，我明白了。那么……没有金钱补偿或其他实际奖励？

english: We've got reports of a slightly different Wyrmscraig goat in the local population. Once you find it, bring back one of its hooves.
translation: 我们收到报告说当地种群中有一只略有不同的蛇龙崖山羊。找到它后，带一只它的蹄子回来。

english: Oh, that is definitely true for the majority of crabs. These plebs are classless and will breed with whoever they fancy.
translation: 哦，对大多数螃蟹来说确实如此。这些贱民没有阶级观念，会和自己看上的任何螃蟹交配。

english: I decided to root for logic.
translation: 我决定支持逻辑。

english: Let me leave.
translation: 让我离开。

english: Perhaps we reinforce Goblin Village.
translation: 也许我们加固哥布林村庄。

english: I have heard good things from my uncle. It is good to meet you, [player name].
translation: 我从叔叔那里听说过你的好评。很高兴见到你，[player name]。

english: They also have a lot of energy they need to burn off.
translation: 他们还有很多精力需要消耗。

english: You see a small hole in the wall but no way to open it.
translation: 你看到墙上有一个小洞，但无法打开它。

english: Well... you will have to be a skilled Mage to defeat him, and my powers are not good enough yet.
translation: 嗯……你必须是一名熟练的法师才能击败他，而我的力量还不够强。

english: What does he use them for?
translation: 他用它们做什么？

english: We heard Bork's drumming long before we saw him. Disorganised as they were, his band of goblins were able to breach the walls to the supply room. We are lucky they thought the brooms and hammers to be artefacts of power, as it bought the company time to arrive and defeat them. I dread to think the damage those deafening beats could have done to the delicate history of the Archive.
translation: 我们在看到博克之前很久就听到了他的鼓声。尽管他们组织混乱，他的哥布林队伍还是突破了通往补给室的墙壁。幸运的是，他们以为扫帚和锤子是强大的文物，这为公司争取了时间赶来击败他们。我不敢想象那些震耳欲聋的鼓点会对档案馆脆弱的历史造成怎样的破坏。

english: Take everything.
translation: 拿走所有东西。

english: You're still here? I suppose you've made your choice.
translation: 你还在这里？我想你已经做出了选择。

english: Do you need relief?
translation: 你需要解脱吗？

english: So you want me to mine the rocks?
translation: 所以你想让我开采这些岩石？

english: I feel like I've just been kicked off Entrana.
translation: 我感觉自己刚被踢下恩特纳岛。

english: The sprite is not a liquid, gas or a solid. It is the magical state of the crystal rocks! How exciting is that?! A material with a magical state!
translation: 精灵不是液体、气体或固体。它是水晶岩石的魔法状态！多么令人兴奋啊？！一种具有魔法状态的物质！

english: Are you sure you wish to revert your Robe bottoms of the Eye (blue)? The dye used will not be returned.
translation: 你确定要还原你的眼之长袍下装（蓝）吗？所使用的染料将不会返还。

english: It's not good news I'm afraid. His time down there seems to have driven him somewhat mad. He's been trying to claim the sword for himself. He refuses to listen to reason.
translation: 恐怕不是好消息。他在下面待的时间似乎让他有些发疯了。他一直试图把剑据为己有。他拒绝听道理。

english: This troll seems very upset about something. Maybe some sweet food would take his mind off things?
translation: 这个巨魔似乎对什么事非常心烦。也许一些甜食能让他分心？

english: I had a really baaaaad time until I joined the uuuuunion.
translation: 在我加入工工工会之前，我过得非常糟糟糟糕。

english: Why you wretched Spawn-of-a-Big-Nosed-Warty- Smelly-Goblin! How dare you speak to a commanding officer like that?
translation: 你这可恶的大鼻子疣头臭哥布林崽子！你怎么敢这样跟指挥官说话？

english: They will hold the line whilst we work on clearing the foremost ones. We are relying on you to take one side whilst we take the other.
translation: 在我们清理最前面的那些时，他们会守住防线。我们指望你负责一侧，我们负责另一侧。

english: I want to travel by magic carpet.
translation: 我想乘坐魔法飞毯旅行。

english: I... am... the Keeper of the Records!
translation: 我……是……记录守护者！

english: Of course! Come back any time if you'd like to challenge me again.
translation: 当然！如果你想再次挑战我，随时回来。

english: Your lock pick snapped while attempting to pick the lock.
translation: 你尝试撬锁时，撬锁工具折断了。

english: A disaster.
translation: 一场灾难。

english: And I don't have all the materials I need to make it anymore.
translation: 而且我已经没有制作它所需的全部材料了。

english: The tinderbox cannot make a spark large enough to light this.
translation: 火绒盒打出的火星太小，无法点燃这个。

english: Hey, take that back, he's not a disaster!
translation: 嘿，把话收回去，他才不是灾难！

english: It looks like you'll have to find another way in...
translation: 看来你得另找一条进去的路了……

english: Yes, I am. However, I'm in no mood to entertain guests today.
translation: 是的，我就是。不过我今天没心情招待客人。

english: Nicely done! 1/5.
translation: 干得漂亮！1/5。

english: There is a raw cave eel placed on the altar.
translation: 祭坛上放着一条生洞穴鳗。

english: Ooh, big big! Toetaller understand now.
translation: 哦，大，大！脚趾高现在明白了。

english: Sentient roots?!
translation: 有知觉的树根？！

english: You trade 1x Tome of Earth (empty) for some soiled pages.
translation: 你用1本大地之书 (空)换了一些染上污渍的书页。

english: It stomp time!
translation: 到踩踩时间了！

english: I've come to ask a favour, if you don't mind?
translation: 如果你不介意的话，我来是想请你帮个忙？

english: Ah, patience is a virtue in knights, my liege. Fight in the training ground and earn your reward to find out!
translation: 啊，耐心是骑士的美德，我的君主。去训练场战斗并赢得你的奖励，就能知道了！

english: I don't think you'll be able to convince her, she's quite stubborn.
translation: 我觉得你没法说服她，她相当固执。

english: Unsurprisingly, I do not believe he is doing a particularly good job of things.
translation: 不出所料，我认为他干得并不怎么样。

english: You notice a large indentation and three smaller ones.
translation: 你注意到一个大的凹痕和三个较小的凹痕。

english: Balance... will be achieved... through annihilation...
translation: 平衡……将通过……毁灭……来实现……

english: I would check next to bushes and trees. You may find some of us hiding in some. We crabs can be scared of tall things which are not trees.
translation: 我会去灌木和树木旁边找找。你可能会发现我们中的一些藏在里面。我们蟹类会害怕那些不是树的高大东西。

english: You hand over some bones.
translation: 你交出了一些骨头。

english: Oh, that's very kind of you. Thank you.
translation: 哦，你真是太好了。谢谢你。

english: Oh, we're still going? I had a nap scheduled.
translation: 哦，我们还要继续？我本来安排好了小睡。

english: If you want to keep practicing, you can change the speed of their gear changes by asking them nicely.
translation: 如果你想继续练习，可以好好请求他们来改变他们换装的速度。

english: In the sea.
translation: 在海里。

english: Yes? That's how counting goes! 1, 2, 3, 10.
translation: 是啊？数数就是这么数的！1、2、3、10。

english: You need to reach the maze centre, then you'll be returned to where you were.
translation: 你需要到达迷宫中心，然后就会被送回原来的地方。

english: This rook reminds me of myself at a more spry age!
translation: 这只车让我想起了自己更矫健的时候！

english: Yes, I'd like to go to the mainland
translation: 是的，我想去大陆

english: My mistake milord, I was thinking yer be some other fella! Take this swag, and we'll be saying no more about it! Yarrr!
translation: 是我的错，大人，我以为你是别的家伙！拿着这些赃物，咱们就当没这回事！呀嗬！

english: Am I interrupting you?
translation: 我打扰到你了吗？

english: You need a raw sardine to do that.
translation: 你需要一条生沙丁鱼才能这么做。

english: That's... quite the story.
translation: 那……可真是个精彩的故事。

english: I need a Bucket of Milk, some Ground Unicorn Horn and a bit of Marrentill.
translation: 我需要一桶牛奶、一些独角兽角粉和一点马伦提尔草。

english: Tell them whatever they want to know.
translation: 他们想知道什么就告诉他们什么。

english: Today is your lucky day, sirrah/madam! I am donating to the victims of crime to atone for my past actions!
translation: 今天是你的幸运日，先生/女士！我正在向犯罪受害者捐款，以弥补我过去的所作所为！

english: I encountered him down in the caverns deep below us, guarding some sort of powerful sword.
translation: 我在我们下方深处的洞穴里遇到了他，他守护着某种强大的剑。

english: That's wonderful news. Do you think they'd like to join us at the shelter?
translation: 那真是好消息。你觉得它们愿意来收容所和我们一起吗？

english: ...You successfully picked the first lock!
translation: ……你成功撬开了第一把锁！

english: I should melt it first.
translation: 我应该先把它融化。

english: Don't worry, I'll lend you some gear to use, and if you mess up, nothing bad will happen to you.
translation: 别担心，我会借你一些装备用，就算你搞砸了，也不会有什么坏事发生在你身上。

english: Testing...?
translation: 测试……？

english: You've found a hidden tunnel, do you want to enter?
translation: 你发现了一条隐藏的隧道，你想进去吗？

english: I don't think you can trust Glough, your highness. He seems to have an unnatural hatred for humans.
translation: 我认为你不能信任格劳夫，殿下。他似乎对人类有着不自然的仇恨。

english: Zamorak empowers us!
translation: 扎莫拉克赐予我们力量！

english: I got some sugar from the chemist. What should I be doing now?
translation: 我从化学家那里弄到了一些糖。现在我应该做什么？

english: Indeed. My master hid them away for good reason. For so many of them to now be making their way back into the world... and to hear that even some of Guthix's most faithful are faltering...
translation: 确实。我的主人把它们藏起来是有充分理由的。如今这么多东西正重新流入世界……而且听说连古斯最虔诚的一些信徒也在动摇……

english: Filthy nasty creatures! Don't ever bring one near me!
translation: 肮脏恶心的生物！永远别把它们带到我附近！

english: Hello, tree whisperer. Would you like to travel somewhere?
translation: 你好，树木低语者。你想去某个地方旅行吗？

english: Are you sure you wish to recolour your Robe top of the Eye (green)? This will consume the Abyssal red dye and replace any existing recolours.
translation: 你确定要给眼之长袍上衣 (绿)重新染色吗？这将消耗深渊红色染料，并替换掉现有的任何重新染色。

english: I'm Golrie, and this is my home. Thing is, as you can see, I've got a small problem. Those hob-gobs are all over the place trying to steal my family's heirlooms. I've been stuck here for ages!
translation: 我是戈尔里，这里是我的家。问题是，如你所见，我遇到了点小麻烦。那些大地精到处乱窜，想偷我家的传家宝。我被困在这里好久了！

english: Are you saying you want some chaos in the mix? That seems... dangerous.
translation: 你是说你想在组合里加入一些混乱？这似乎……很危险。

english: You use the Ancient fabric on the Imbued Zamorak cape to create an Imbued ancient cape.
translation: 你在被强化的扎莫拉克斗篷上使用远古织物，制作出被强化的远古斗篷。

english: This is starting to feel like my retirement!
translation: 这开始让我感觉像是在退休了！

english: The crabs dance for hours and hours...
translation: 螃蟹们跳上好几个小时的舞……

english: I feel so trapped. I feel like I am about to moult, but the shell won't break. My thoughts are too big for me. I long to be tossed by the waves, helpless. Feel nature's wrath. Feel alive.
translation: 我感觉被困住了。我觉得自己快要蜕壳了，但壳却破不开。我的思绪对我来说太庞大了。我渴望被海浪抛来抛去，无助地。感受大自然的愤怒。感受活着。

english: You successfully dye your Robe top of the Eye (red).
translation: 你成功将眼之长袍上衣 (红) 染色。

english: Would you be willing to adopt her for us?
translation: 你愿意替我们收养她吗？

english: A well-placed frontline can turn a tide.
translation: 布置得当的前线可以扭转局势。

english: Who did you want me to check in with?
translation: 你想让我去找谁报到？

english: The skeleton seems fresh. It looks like the bones have been gnawed- clean fairly recently.
translation: 这具骷髅看起来很新鲜。骨头似乎最近才被啃干净。

english: Poor girl.
translation: 可怜的女孩。

english: For the most part, no, but if you want to avoid any risk of being trampled, there are sections of the beach which are more exclusive. Personally, I think being mildly trampled is part of the experience.
translation: 大部分情况下不用，但如果你想避免被踩踏的风险，海滩上有一些更专属的区域。就我个人而言，我觉得被轻微踩踏也是体验的一部分。

english: Anything else I can do to convince you? I can count, for example.
translation: 我还能做点什么来说服你吗？比如，我会数数。

english: Click through the text as fast as possible to get your reward sooner.
translation: 尽可能快地点击跳过文本，以便更早获得奖励。

english: Perhaps I overestimated you? No, I definitely overestimated you.
translation: 也许我高估你了？不，我肯定是高估你了。

english: Wait... Is this literally a dating site?
translation: 等等……这真的就是个约会网站？

english: Isn't it usually snakes that eat their own tails? I don't think the cow is amoosed.
translation: 通常不是蛇才会吃自己的尾巴吗？我觉得这头奶牛可不太高兴。

english: The Blue Opal!
translation: 蓝色蛋白石！

english: Even a background character can change a story!
translation: 即使是背景角色也能改变故事！

english: I can smell it.
translation: 我能闻到它。

english: The force preventing access to the Pyramid has now vanished.
translation: 阻止进入金字塔的力量现已消失。

english: You pour insect repellent on the beehive. You see bees leaving the hive.
translation: 你把驱虫剂倒在蜂箱上。你看到蜜蜂离开了蜂巢。

english: Gf
translation: 打得不错

english: These sensitive records are under my precise curation!
translation: 这些敏感记录由我精心管理！

english: Only a wise man would have found that move!
translation: 只有智者才能发现那一步棋！

english: Bork! We sorry! No go!
translation: Bork！我们对不起！不走！

english: The horn of Bran?
translation: 布兰的号角？

english: Y-yes, your highness.
translation: 是——是的，殿下。

english: Well, you're braver than I!
translation: 嗯，你比我勇敢！

english: Next we need to get rid of the trick-or-treaters who are already here...
translation: 接下来我们需要赶走那些已经在这里的“不给糖就捣蛋”的人……

english: Wonderful! Good luck!
translation: 太好了！祝你好运！

english: Thank you, I'll-
translation: 谢谢你，我会——

english: Well done! From now on, your partner may use mithril or adamant seeds to move east or west if he's frozen.
translation: 干得好！从现在起，如果你的搭档被冻结，他可以使用秘银或精金种子向东或向西移动。

english: I've been building amazing nests year after year and nobody cared. I went for a dip ONCE and now everyone calls me Dipper.
translation: 我年复一年地筑着漂亮的巢，却没人关心。我只下水泡了一次，现在大家都叫我“泡水者”。

english: I'm afraid I don't have a dog to offer you.
translation: 恐怕我没有狗可以给你。

english: I've finished poisoning the local adults!
translation: 我已经把当地的成年人都毒倒了！

english: So it has no meaning?
translation: 所以它没有意义？

english: There better not be wizards in that tower!
translation: 那座塔里最好没有魔法师！

english: The crab that was in this tree has left to practise.
translation: 原本在这棵树上的螃蟹已经离开去练习了。

english: View Stats?
translation: 查看统计？

english: Use the Armadyl godsword special attack straight into the granite maul special attack!
translation: 使用阿玛杜尔神剑战技后，直接接上花岗岩锤战技！

english: Let's hear it.
translation: 说来听听。

english: It's got a very cool name, too!
translation: 它还有个非常酷的名字！

english: So why did you really send me to Pollnivneach? Was it out of concern for the townspeople? I doubt it, you'd sell your grandmother if you could get a good price for her. What was the real reason?
translation: 那你到底为什么把我派去波尼尼镇？是出于对镇民的关心吗？我怀疑。只要能卖个好价钱，你连你祖母都会卖掉。真正的原因是什么？

english: What if I carried you back up once you're done practising? Would you consider it?
translation: 如果你练习完后我把你背回去怎么样？你会考虑吗？

english: Wartface call this "castle". Wartface not that smart.
translation: 疣脸把这叫“城堡”。疣脸没那么聪明。

english: I thought this was a dog shelter?
translation: 我以为这里是狗狗收容所？

english: That's probably not a good idea...
translation: 那可能不是个好主意……

english: You hand over some charcoal.
translation: 你交出了一些木炭。

english: You get into difficulty and almost capsize! However, you manage to make your way back to land.
translation: 你陷入困境，差点翻船！不过，你设法回到了陆地。

english: How extraordinary! We found remnants of similar manuscripts but nothing as well preserved as this!
translation: 太不可思议了！我们找到了类似手稿的残片，但没有一份保存得像这份这么完好！

english: Wow! You're so generous, thank you! Here's all my gold.
translation: 哇！你太慷慨了，谢谢你！这是我所有的金子。

english: Bedabin camp
translation: 贝达宾营地

english: Most tormented demons seem to struggle with the strength of their own flames. This one seemed to fully control them, lending it both greater power and durability.
translation: 大多数被折磨的恶魔似乎都难以驾驭自身火焰的力量。而这一只似乎能完全控制它们，因此它既更强大，也更耐久。

english: Pull the lever.
translation: 拉动拉杆。

english: The secrets of the Archive, the progress of the Alliance, the very steps you took towards me today, all recorded in these... very... pages!
translation: 档案馆的秘密、联盟的进展、你今日走向我的每一步，全都记录在这些……书页里！

english: The ceremony? What ceremony?
translation: 仪式？什么仪式？

english: I miss me old Captains.
translation: 我想念我的老船长们。

english: Your patch has now grown to fruition, my friend.'
translation: 你的地块如今已经长成，我的朋友。

english: New personal best: X:XX
translation: 新的个人最佳成绩：X:XX

english: Well of course I do! I mean I did... Look, I lost it okay? Stop hassling me!
translation: 我当然有！我是说我有过……听着，我把它弄丢了，行吗？别再烦我了！

english: Absolutely not! I've been given strict instructions not to let anyone through. It's just too dangerous. No one gets in without Drezels say so!
translation: 绝对不行！我接到了严格的命令，不许任何人通过。这实在太危险了。没有德雷泽尔的许可，谁也别想进去！

english: I don't have back legs! Unless I put one at the front and one at the back, like this?
translation: 我没有后腿！除非我把一条放在前面、一条放在后面，像这样？

english: Hmm...perhaps we should go back a turn.
translation: 嗯……也许我们应该退回一回合。

english: Human challenges Big High War God himself!
translation: 人类挑战大高战神本人！

english: Is this your ship?
translation: 这是你的船吗？

english: Where did you say you saw some stray dogs again?
translation: 你刚才说你在哪里看到流浪狗的？

english: Actually?
translation: 真的吗？

english: Heh! My shell spin doesn't work on dry sand anyway! I know, I tried!
translation: 嘿！反正我的贝壳旋转在干沙子上也不管用！我知道，我试过！

english: Thank you. Now, the time for discussion runs thin. Let us return to our duties.
translation: 谢谢你。现在，讨论的时间不多了。让我们回到各自的职责上去吧。

english: You need a cow hide to do that.
translation: 你需要一张牛皮才能这么做。

english: I have considered that myself, [player name], and you are right that it may bring us some much needed breathing room. However, I do not believe Guthix intended for it to be sealed forever.
translation: 我自己也考虑过，[player name]，你说得对，这或许能给我们带来一些急需的喘息空间。但是，我不认为古斯有意让它被永远封印。

english: You can change direction once you've done a full rotation.
translation: 完成一整圈旋转后，你就可以改变方向了。

english: Did it manage to get rid of the Dagon'hai?
translation: 它成功摆脱了达贡海吗？
